1a1873fa6302d3ab3dc6741717912a7b09a47e95.sourceText: “占领五一”游行 思市逮捕1人 （亚省时报） 警方说，”占领五一”抗议活动吸引了过百人聚集在思格斯岱市中心，周二晚有一人因阻碍公共交通要道而被捕。警方并没有透露被捕者姓名。 示威者在下午5时左右开始聚集在思格斯岱老城，大约一小时后游行至时尚购物中心广场。有约25名警员到场维持治安，警方后来投放四个小烟雾弹驱散人群，但没有任何伤亡或财产损失报告。示威者在7:45分左右散去。 组织者声称，此次示威游行是全国各地的”占领运动”之一。
1a1873fa6302d3ab3dc6741717912a7b09a47e95.translatedText: "Occupy May Day" march, one person was arrested in Si City (Alberta Times) Police said the "Occupy May Day" protest attracted more than a hundred people to the center of Scottsdale, and one person was arrested on Tuesday night for obstructing a public transportation thoroughfare. Police did not disclose the names of those arrested. Demonstrators began to gather in the Old Town of Skarsdale around 5 p.m. and marched to the Fashion Mall Plaza about an hour later. About 25 police officers attended the scene to maintain law and order. The police later launched four small smoke grenades to disperse the crowd, but there were no reports of any casualties or property damage. The demonstrators dispersed around 7:45. Organizers claimed that the demonstration was part of the "Occupy movement" across the country.

0484bc5d2d6f0e7fdea933a303429bcba0b82145.sourceText: 凤凰城中文学校 来稿 五月六日凤凰城中文学校在梅莎社区大学举行了2012 年的毕业典礼。 在毕业生入场就坐之后，程秀玲校长带着依依不舍的心情为毕业生致词。 今年一共有五位毕业生：活泼好动的潘正浩，热爱中文的杨思安，篮球高手李耀彤，秀外慧中的沈佩颖，和好学不倦的余颖亨。 最难能可贵地是沈佩颖从小至今，坚持了十五年上中文学校。 潘正浩、李耀彤和余颖亨三人为表兄弟，从小一同来上中文学校。 在家虽然说广东话，但说起中文也是非常流利。
0484bc5d2d6f0e7fdea933a303429bcba0b82145.translatedText: Phoenix Chinese School Contributed On May 6th, Phoenix Chinese School held its 2012 graduation ceremony at Mesa Community College. After the graduates entered and took their seats, Principal Cheng Xiuling delivered a speech to the graduates with a reluctant heart. There are five graduates this year: the lively Pan Zhenghao, the Chinese-loving Yang Sian, the basketball master Li Yaotong, the smart Shen Peiying, and the studious Yu Yingheng. The most commendable thing is that Shen Peiying has persisted in attending Chinese school for fifteen years since she was a child. Pan Zhenghao, Li Yaotong and Yu Yingheng are cousins ​​and went to Chinese school together since childhood. Although I speak Cantonese at home, I am also very fluent in Chinese.

657a35657df5de53ef30858ffa43108f4f5d9c09.sourceText: 贵宾张晴玲女士致辞 本校很荣幸邀请到亚利桑那州华人商界和侨界皆具盛名的张晴玲女士来致词。 张女士和现场的毕业生、在校生及家长分享了宝贵的人生经验。 她从年轻时代成为代表台湾的网球国手，在网球生涯的冲向高峰之时，却因为身体状况迫使她结束网球专业生涯，人生因此而改向。 在日本早稻田大学毕业后，辗转来到了美国，后来在凤凰城机场旁开了一家Best Western 加盟旅馆。 张女士不仅在商业界展露头角，更积极参与侨界活动，和同乡之间的互动。 她不断地鼓励自己的女儿学习中文，等到她们进入职场，中文便成为她们的优势。 因此她鼓励在场的毕业生在毕业后持续学习中文，相信这一项技能，会是他们日后求职就业的利器。
657a35657df5de53ef30858ffa43108f4f5d9c09.translatedText: >Dignified guest Ms. Zhang Qingling delivered a speech. Our school is honored to invite Ms. Zhang Qingling, who is well-known in the Chinese business community and overseas Chinese community in Arizona, to give a speech. Ms. Zhang shared valuable life experiences with the graduates, current students and parents present. She became a national tennis player representing Taiwan from a young age. When her tennis career was reaching its peak, her physical condition forced her to end her professional tennis career, and her life changed direction. After graduating from Waseda University in Japan, he moved to the United States and later opened a Best Western franchise hotel next to Phoenix Airport. Ms. Zhang not only distinguished herself in the business community, but also actively participated in activities of the overseas Chinese community and interacted with her fellow residents. She constantly encourages her daughters to learn Chinese. When they enter the workplace, Chinese will become their advantage. Therefore, she encouraged the graduates present to continue learning Chinese after graduation. She believed that this skill would be a useful tool for them to find jobs in the future.

09cd01771595fe71f85a77a9262cb0869ef45db9.sourceText: 接着由毕业班导师卢贞玲老师介绍毕业生。 卢老师用每一位毕业生的照片为他们制作个人成长的投影片，并由每一位毕业生朗读一段徐志摩的”再别康桥”。 藉由这一首诗带入了离别的心情”悄悄的我走了，正如我悄悄的来；我挥一挥衣袖，不带走一片云彩。”在这五位毕业生所发表的感言中， 竟不约而同表示他们刚开始都不愿意来上中文学校，而今回想起来，反而感谢父母的坚持，和老师们谆谆教诲，让他们持续了多年中文学习。 毕业生发表感言之后，与十年级的在校生一同合唱，”童年”、”朋友”和”彩虹”。 希望藉由这三首歌能唤起他们欢乐童年的记忆；和朋友一起相扶持，一同成长的过程。 并愿他们日后能成为一道闪亮的彩虹，照耀人生的大道。 接着学校颁发毕业证书与礼物，张晴玲女士也送给每位毕业生Apple礼券。 最后在卢老师和刘玉婵老师带领下，在校生合唱”祝你幸福”将毕业典礼带入尾声。 在此祝福他们展翅高飞，鹏程万里！ 2012年凤凰城中文学校秋季班将于八月十二日注册开学，如果您想多认识凤凰城中文学校，或是想加入这个大家庭，请与校长程秀玲联络(480-620-1982) 或参观 学校网页( http://www.clsphoenix.org/ )。
09cd01771595fe71f85a77a9262cb0869ef45db9.translatedText: Then the graduating class instructor, Ms. Lu Zhenling, introduced the graduates. Teacher Lu used the photos of each graduate to create a slideshow of their personal growth, and each graduate read a passage from Xu Zhimo's "Farewell to Cambridge". This poem brought a feeling of farewell, "I left quietly, just as I came quietly; I waved my sleeves, not taking away a single cloud." In the speeches given by these five graduates, they all said that they were not willing to attend Chinese school at first. But now that they think about it, they are grateful to their parents for their persistence and the teachers' earnest teachings, which allowed them to continue learning Chinese for many years. After the graduates gave their speeches, they sang "Childhood," "Friends" and "Rainbow" with the current tenth grade students. I hope that these three songs can evoke their happy childhood memories; the process of supporting and growing up together with their friends. And hope that they can become a shining rainbow in the future, illuminating the road of life. Then the school issued graduation certificates and gifts, and Ms. Zhang Qingling also gave each graduate an Apple gift certificate. Finally, under the leadership of Teacher Lu and Teacher Liu Yuchan, the students sang "I wish you happiness" to bring the graduation ceremony to an end. Here’s wishing them to spread their wings and fly high, and achieve great success! Registration for the 2012 Phoenix Chinese School fall class will start on August 12. If you want to know more about Phoenix Chinese School or want to join this big family, please contact the principal Cheng Xiuling (480-620-1982) or visit the school website ( http://www.clsphoenix.org/ ).

1c7377c6108c2461e04dfdc85929d02ce0d658b0.sourceText: 2013财政年度 教育经费大涨 （亚省时报） 亚利桑那州的教育经费经过多年的削减，新的财政年度预算终于有所改变。在州长即将签署的预算协议中，ASU和NAU两所州立大学将获得额外拨款1570万，但基础教育（K-12）相比之下就少了许多。 新预算中的教育开支项目包括：4000万经费给K-3改善阅读技巧。软资本（如教科书）支出1500万。300万给学校举办K-2竞赛。增加ASU和NAU两所州立大学经费1500万。大学的医学院经费600万。 2012财政年度中，州府为平衡开支，削减公共教育经费3500万，以换取联邦政府的Edujobs拨款，参众两会去年为此争论不休。今年的预算案不仅终止了这项削减，并增加1500万，使公共教育的学区经费达到5000万元。州教育部获得3.64亿美元，用于公立学校和特许学校。 尽管基础教育经费比2008年少了9亿，但比2012财政年度多了2800万。一些校区还是不得不关闭学校来应付经费不足。 此外，州立大学收到经费7.037亿，其中包括大学委员会经费，和社区学院经费6590万。为使三所公立大学的每个学生得到资助，ASU和NSU获1500万经费。 去年，ASU每个学生比UA学生得到经费少900美元，NAU学生稍好点，也比UA学生少近760美元。针对经费差异，大学委员会特意增加了两所大学拨款。从7月1日起，接下来的四年都连续增加，确保ASU每年获得拨款6000万，NAU每年获得拨款1650万。
1c7377c6108c2461e04dfdc85929d02ce0d658b0.translatedText: Education funding has surged in fiscal year 2013 (Alberta Times) After years of cuts, Arizona's education funding has finally changed in the new fiscal year's budget. In the budget deal the governor is about to sign, two state universities, ASU and NAU, will receive an additional $15.7 million, but basic education (K-12) will receive much less. Education spending items in the new budget include: $40 million to improve reading skills in K-3. Expenditure on soft capital (such as textbooks) is 15 million. 3 million for schools to host K-2 competitions. Increase funding for two state universities, ASU and NAU, by $15 million. The university's medical school has a funding of 6 million. In the 2012 fiscal year, the state government cut public education funding by $35 million in order to balance expenditures in exchange for federal Edujobs funding. The House and Senate debated this issue last year. This year's budget not only ends that cut but adds $15 million, bringing district funding for public education to $50 million. The state Department of Education received $364 million for public and charter schools. Although basic education funding is 900 million less than in 2008, it is 28 million more than in fiscal year 2012. Some school districts still have to close schools to cope with lack of funds. In addition, state universities received $703.7 million in funding, including College Board funding, and $65.9 million in community college funding. In order to provide funding for every student at the three public universities, ASU and NSU received $15 million in funding. Last year, ASU students received $900 less per student than UA students. NAU students did slightly better, nearly $760 less than UA students. In response to the funding discrepancy, the College Board specifically increased funding for the two universities. Starting July 1, there will be consecutive increases for the next four years, ensuring that ASU will receive an annual allocation of 60 million and NAU will receive an annual allocation of 16.5 million.

981e633f6650e2546c6781d45ce480d2a9cd67d2.sourceText: 习近平就钓鱼岛问题所提出的一个新思路 中国即将接班的领导人习近平就钓鱼岛问题所提出的一个新思路，他跳开了什么”钓鱼台是中国固有领土”这种老套八股说法，直指这是二次世界大战后未完全解决的领土问题，其中西方国家（当然主要是美国）也负有不可推卸的责任。这种说法将所有人情绪拉回到60多年前日本投降时节，中、美是共同受降者，如今美国如何能帮著当时与中国共同打败的侵略者，再次侵略当时同为战胜国的中国领土呢？这个问题令美国也难以应对，是个高明的提法。请欣赏下文……！ 徐静波：中国高层透露”钓鱼岛问题新思路” 2012年9月20日自钓鱼岛问题发生以来，日本政府和日本舆论一直关注著一个人：”他為什麼没有说话？”这个人，就是中国国家副主席习近平。 习近平副主席19日会见了美国国防部长帕内塔，首次开口谈钓鱼岛问题，而且在日本媒体看来，不说则已，一说就是”一鸣惊人”。习近平副主席的以下这段话，在日本的电视和报纸上反复出现：”日方应该悬崖勒马，停止一切损害中国主权和领土完整的错误言行。希望美方从地区和平稳定大局出发，谨言慎行，不要介入钓鱼岛主权争议，不要做任何可能激化矛盾和令局势更加复杂的事情。” 日本媒体特别对习近平副主席使用的一个词予以了放大，这个词，就是”闹剧”。习近平副主席说：”81年前，日本製造了震惊中外的’九一八事变’。日本军国主义不仅给中华民族造成深重灾难，也给包括美国在内的亚太国家造成巨大创伤。日本国内一些政治势力非但不深刻反省对邻国和亚太国家造成的战争创伤，反而变本加厉、一错再错，演出’购岛’闹剧。” 朝日电视台昨夜在时政节目中评论”闹剧”两个字时，特别分析说：”这句话显示出这位中国未来最高领导人对於日本将尖阁列岛(註：中国名：钓鱼岛)国有化做法的愤怒，同时也表现出对日本政府做法不屑一顾的姿态。” 但是，我们注意到，习近平副主席与中国其他领导人谈钓鱼岛问题时，角度发生了较大的变化。这些变化可以解读為以下二点： 第一、习近平在与美国国防部长会谈时，没有过多地从歷史的角度去过多强调中国政府对钓鱼岛的”自古以来”的拥有歷史，而是强调了钓鱼岛问题是日本侵华战争与第二次世界大战结束后未予公正处理的”遗留问题”。他谈到了以美国為首的战胜国集团在处理日本投降问题时签署的几个公约，并指出日本政府一直没有遵守这几个公约。言下之意，美国政府和包括英法在内的反法西斯战胜国，在战后均没有监督日本政府认真履行这几个公约，应该对目前造成的钓鱼岛问题负有一定的责任。 习近平副主席透露的这一观点与资讯，等於是要求西方国家要负起歷史责任，敦促日本信守投降诺言，帮助中国来一起处理好钓鱼岛这一、二战遗留问题。这一观点是迄今為止，中国领导人从没有公开表述过的新思路。显然也是中国政府争取欧美国家理解中国政府在钓鱼岛问题上的立场，支持中国政府对钓鱼岛主权的一种新策略。 第二、习近平副主席在与帕内塔部长会谈时，特别强调了两国在二战的反法西斯战争中相互支持共同作应对日本侵略的歷史。这一段歷史的回顾，是刻意在提醒美国，在对日问题上，中美过去是同盟军，现在也应该是一条战壕裡的战友，不应该出现如今 ”美军帮助日本来对付中国”的怪局。 习近平副主席对於美国的提醒，能否遏制美军在冲绳附近协助日本的军事行动，现在还是一个未知数，但是，日本政府和社会通过此次美国政府在钓鱼岛问题上的’中立立场’，已经明白了一个道理：一旦中日為钓鱼岛交战，美军是不可能与日本自卫队一起并肩作战，更不可能去替日本当中国的抱灰。从这一点上来说，中国政府採取的”争取美国，游说欧洲”的新策略，必定有效，而且将会对解决钓鱼岛主权问题產生相当重要的作用。因為，习近平副主席一定告诉给了美国国防部长，中国在钓鱼岛问题上的最后底线。
981e633f6650e2546c6781d45ce480d2a9cd67d2.translatedText: A new idea put forward by Xi Jinping on the Diaoyu Islands issue China's incoming leader Xi Jinping put forward a new idea on the Diaoyu Islands issue. He skipped the old stereotype that "Diaoyutai is China's inherent territory" and pointed out that this is a territorial issue that has not been completely resolved after World War II. Western countries (of course, mainly the United States) also bear unshirkable responsibility. This statement brings everyone's emotions back to the time when Japan surrendered more than 60 years ago. China and the United States were the common surrenderers. How can the United States now help the invaders that it defeated with China at that time and invade again the territory of China, which was also a victorious country at that time? This problem is difficult for the United States to deal with. It is a clever formulation. Please enjoy below...! Xu Jingbo: Chinese senior officials revealed "new ideas on the Diaoyu Islands issue." Since the Diaoyu Islands issue occurred on September 20, 2012, the Japanese government and Japanese public opinion have been paying attention to one person: "Why didn't he speak?" This person is Chinese Vice President Xi Jinping. Vice President Xi Jinping met with US Secretary of Defense Panetta on the 19th and talked about the Diaoyu Islands issue for the first time. In the eyes of the Japanese media, if he did not talk about it, it would be a "blockbuster". The following words from Vice Chairman Xi Jinping have repeatedly appeared on Japanese television and newspapers: "The Japanese side should step back from the brink and stop all wrong words and deeds that undermine China's sovereignty and territorial integrity. We hope that the United States will proceed from the overall interests of regional peace and stability, be cautious in its words and deeds, not to intervene in the dispute over the sovereignty of the Diaoyu Islands, and not to do anything that may intensify conflicts and make the situation more complicated." The Japanese media particularly amplified a word used by Vice Chairman Xi Jinping, which is "farce." Vice Chairman Xi Jinping said: "81 years ago, Japan caused the 'September 18th Incident' that shocked China and the rest of the world. Japanese militarism not only caused serious disasters to the Chinese nation, but also caused huge trauma to Asia-Pacific countries, including the United States. Instead of deeply reflecting on the trauma caused by the war to neighboring countries and Asia-Pacific countries, some political forces in Japan intensified their efforts, made mistakes again and again, and staged the farce of 'island purchase'." When TV Asahi commented on the word "farce" in a current affairs program last night, it analyzed specifically: "This sentence shows the future supreme leader of China's anger towards Japan's nationalization of the Senkaku Islands (Note: Chinese name: Diaoyu Islands), and also shows his disdain for the Japanese government's actions." However, we noticed that Vice President Xi Jinping's perspective changed significantly when he discussed the Diaoyu Islands issue with other Chinese leaders. These changes can be interpreted as the following two points: First, when Xi Jinping met with the US Secretary of Defense, he did not put too much emphasis on the Chinese government's "since ancient times" ownership of the Diaoyu Islands from a historical perspective. Instead, he emphasized that the Diaoyu Islands issue is a "legacy issue" that was not dealt with fairly after Japan's war of aggression against China and the end of World War II. He talked about several conventions signed by the victorious group of nations headed by the United States when dealing with the issue of Japan's surrender, and pointed out that the Japanese government had not abided by these conventions. The implication is that the U.S. government and the victorious anti-fascist countries, including Britain and France, failed to supervise the Japanese government's conscientious implementation of these conventions after the war, and should bear some responsibility for the current Diaoyu Islands issue. The views and information disclosed by Vice Chairman Xi Jinping are tantamount to asking Western countries to shoulder their historical responsibilities, urging Japan to keep its promise of surrender, and help China jointly deal with the Diaoyu Islands and issues left over from World War II. This view is a new idea that has never been publicly expressed by Chinese leaders so far. It is obviously a new strategy used by the Chinese government to win European and American countries to understand the Chinese government's position on the Diaoyu Islands issue and support the Chinese government's sovereignty over the Diaoyu Islands. Second, when Vice President Xi Jinping met with Minister Panetta, he particularly emphasized the history of the two countries supporting each other and jointly responding to Japanese aggression during the anti-fascist war in World War II. This review of history is a deliberate reminder to the United States that on the issue of Japan, China and the United States were allies in the past, and now they should be comrades in the same trench. The strange situation of "the U.S. military helping Japan to deal with China" should not occur today. Vice President Xi Jinping's reminder from the United States is still unknown whether it can curb the US military's military operations to assist Japan near Okinawa. However, the Japanese government and society have understood a truth through the US government's "neutral position" on the Diaoyu Islands issue: Once China and Japan go to war over the Diaoyu Islands, the US military will not be able to fight side by side with the Japanese Self-Defense Forces, let alone act as China's ashes for Japan. From this point of view, the new strategy adopted by the Chinese government to "win over the United States and lobby Europe" is bound to be effective and will play a very important role in resolving the issue of sovereignty over the Diaoyu Islands. Because Vice Chairman Xi Jinping must have told the U.S. Secretary of Defense China’s final bottom line on the Diaoyu Islands issue.

e0c483bdf6443fc9ca93277681574f7a4dcca7d9.translatedText: A senator's proposal to build a nuclear power waste dump met with opposition. Could Arizona be a future nuclear waste dumping ground? That's exactly the plan proposed by a state senator. But then...

33ca37611bb7eb2b64c2e849320e7819757812ee.sourceText: 参议员建议建核电废料场 遭反对 亚利桑那州可能成为未来的核废料倾销地？这正是一名州参议员提出的计划。偏偏到目前为止，州议会支持他的计划。批评者说，该提案根本不负责任。 图森的共和党州参议员阿尔梅尔文提出立法，在本州建立核废料回收和储存设施。梅尔文说，只有4%的有毒废料被淹埋，其余的废料将全部回收作其他用途。他要求联邦官员批准亚利桑那州这个牵涉数亿美元的项目。 ”与内华达的尤卡山不同，我们的重点在回收废料，”梅尔文解释。并且已经为回收设施选好地点，他认为北部山区的金曼，霍尔布鲁克，萨福德和皮尔乔山几个地方都是核废料回收和储存设施的良好场所，因为这些地方地底都有大量的固体盐。 旗杆埠的民主党众议员汤姆查宾提出反对意见。他说那瓦霍郡，科科尼诺郡，雅瓦培郡的居民都不接受这种设施建在自家后院。 梅尔文参议员希望民众对核废料的恐惧消除后，以上四个地区的官员能考虑到他的建议。因为这计划可能为这些地区带来五万个工作职位。
33ca37611bb7eb2b64c2e849320e7819757812ee.translatedText: The senator's proposal to build a nuclear power waste site was opposed. Could Arizona become a dumping ground for nuclear waste in the future? That's exactly the plan proposed by a state senator. But so far, state lawmakers support his plan. Critics say the proposal is fundamentally irresponsible. Republican state Sen. Al Melvin of Tucson has introduced legislation to establish a nuclear waste recycling and storage facility in the state. Melvin said that only 4% of the toxic waste is buried, and the rest will be recycled for other uses. He asked federal officials to approve the multibillion-dollar project in Arizona. "Unlike Yucca Mountain in Nevada, our focus is on recycling waste," Melvin explains. And has already selected a location for the recycling facility. He believes that Kingman, Holbrook, Safford and Pilcio Mountain in the northern mountains are good places for nuclear waste recycling and storage facilities because there are large amounts of solid salt underground in these places. Democratic Rep. Tom Chapin of Flagstaff objected. He said residents in Navajo, Coconino and Yavapai counties would not accept such a facility being built in their backyards. Senator Melvin hopes officials in the four regions will consider his suggestions once public fears about nuclear waste are dispelled. Because this plan may bring 50,000 jobs to these areas.

4e774a3aefd4445f050439e7d23a56d6cd3f2314.sourceText: 双方父母为遇害瞿铭，吴颖冥婚 洛警局和校方宣布将加强该地区一系列安全措施 （亚省时报记者甄松伟洛杉矶报道） 南加大中国留学生瞿铭，吴颖在校园附近遭枪击遇害，日前，已在洛杉矶阿罕布拉世界中华殡仪馆举行遗体告别仪式后火化。由于受害者家属要求低调，不想受到干扰，当日的遗体告别仪式可谓戒备森严，5辆警车严阵以待，多名戴墨镜黑衣人在四处警戒，不仅不允许媒体采访拍照，就连靠近一步都被勒令禁止。仪式完毕后，双方父母在黑衣人的层层保护下乘车离去，所有参加告别仪式的南加大师生也没有人愿意接受采访。 事隔几天后，南加大中国学生学者联谊会会长王伟楠才向媒体透露，当天大家之所以都不接受采访，是对受害者家属保持低调的尊重，而且大家的心情非常糟糕，担心在采访过程中情绪失控，几天过去心情才稍为平静了许多。据王伟楠透露，遇难学生瞿铭，吴颖在阿罕布拉世界中华殡仪馆举行的遗体告别仪式上，经双方父母同意举行冥婚。瞿铭，吴颖真心相爱，感动亲友，沉浸在悲恸中的双方父母为这对有情人举办简短的冥婚，希望爱子爱女步入天国后幸福相守，百年好合，并为分别穿着白色和黑色寿衣的吴颖，瞿铭交换戒指。悲喜交加的现场气氛让人动容，带来的是更多的悲痛，包括双方父母亲属，南加大师生都控制不住自己的情绪，当场失声痛哭，大家围着瞿铭，吴颖的灵柩绕场一周，向两位新婚燕尔的有情人送上最后的祝福。 属于民间风俗的冥婚无结婚证书，更多的是寄托着双方父母对子女的认可和祝福，同时也很大程度上安抚家长的哀痛。随后，南加大师生和站在一旁的双方家长握手告别，劝慰他们节哀顺变，学生们还在殡仪馆的停车场烧冥币，纸房子，纸车等天国用品，送这对新人升天上路。 针对瞿铭，吴颖遇害，华文记者协会，全美中华留学生权益协会发函要求南加大校方提高悬赏揖凶金50万，全美中华青年联合会发出慰问信，希望能够提供力所能及的协助，尽快平复学生的不安情绪，表达该团体对留学生的关切之情。南加大校方和洛杉矶警局近日也召开新闻发布会，宣布将加强一系列安全措施，加强学校周围治安和街区安全，洛杉矶市市长维拉莱构沙，洛杉矶警局局长贝克，南加大校长尼基亚斯高度重视亲自到场。
4e774a3aefd4445f050439e7d23a56d6cd3f2314.translatedText: The parents of both parties are Qu Ming who was killed, and Wu Yingming was married. The Los Angeles Police Department and the school announced that they will strengthen a series of security measures in the area. (Alberta Times reporter Zhen Songwei reported from Los Angeles) Qu Ming and Wu Ying, Chinese international students at the University of Southern California, were shot and killed near the campus. They were cremated after a farewell ceremony was held at the Alhambra World Chinese Funeral Home in Los Angeles. As the families of the victims requested a low profile and did not want to be disturbed, the farewell ceremony that day was heavily guarded, with 5 police cars. Many people wearing sunglasses and black clothes were on guard. Not only were the media not allowed to interview and take photos, but they were also ordered to stop even taking a step closer. After the ceremony, the parents of both parties left in a car under the protection of the people in black. No one from the Southern California teachers and students who attended the farewell ceremony was willing to be interviewed. A few days after the incident, Wang Weinan, president of the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of the University of Southern California, revealed to the media that the reason why everyone did not accept interviews that day was out of respect for the families of the victims and to keep a low profile. Moreover, everyone was in a very bad mood and worried about their emotions during the interview. After a few days, I felt a little calmer. According to Wang Weinan, the deceased students Qu Ming and Wu Ying held a ghost marriage with the consent of their parents at the farewell ceremony held at the World Chinese Funeral Home in Alhambra. Qu Ming and Wu Ying truly loved each other. Friends, parents who were immersed in grief held a brief ghost wedding for the lovers, hoping that their beloved son and daughter would stay together happily and be together for a hundred years after entering the kingdom of heaven. They also exchanged rings for Wu Ying and Qu Ming, who were wearing white and black shrouds respectively. The atmosphere of the scene was filled with joy and sorrow. People were moved, but it brought more grief, including parents and relatives of both parties. The teachers and students of Southern California could not control their emotions and burst into tears on the spot. Everyone circled the coffins of Qu Ming and Wu Ying to send their final blessings to the two newlywed lovers. It is a folk custom that ghost marriages do not require a marriage certificate, which is more of a sign of the parents' approval and blessing for their children, and also largely comforts the parents' grief. Afterwards, the teachers and students of Nanjing University shook hands with the parents standing aside to say goodbye, and encouraged them to mourn and accept the incident. The students also burned ghost coins, paper houses, paper cars and other heavenly supplies in the parking lot of the funeral home to send the newlyweds on their way to heaven. In response to the murders of Qu Ming and Wu Ying, the Chinese Journalists Association and the National Chinese Students Rights Association issued a letter asking the University of Southern California to increase the reward of 500,000 for the murders. The National Chinese Youth Federation issued a letter of condolences, hoping to provide assistance within its ability to calm the students' uneasiness as soon as possible and express the group's support for the international students. Students' concerns. The University of Southern California and the Los Angeles Police Department also held a press conference recently to announce that they would strengthen a series of security measures to strengthen security around the school and the safety of the neighborhoods. Los Angeles Mayor Villaraigosa, Los Angeles Police Chief Baker, and USC President Nikias paid great attention to the visit in person.

703ad9c37c02084f8d1c15fed024835ad6273689.sourceText: 编者按：中国有钱人越来越多。根据胡润百富杂志（Hurun Report），中国现有96万个千万富翁，资产起码为1千万元（相当于150万美元）。
703ad9c37c02084f8d1c15fed024835ad6273689.translatedText: Editor’s note: There are more and more wealthy people in China. According to Hurun Report, China currently has 960,000 multi-millionaires with assets of at least 10 million yuan (equivalent to 1.5 million US dollars).

250e2575db7f6355724c7f9d8cce9cf79e49e948.sourceText: 中国人天性爱买房子。美国房价从2006年峰顶滑落至今，多数地方已经跌去三分之一。美国没有限购政策。中国的一些精明的有钱人开始瞄准美国房地产市场，赴美购房。 前不久，《今日美国》（USA Today）形容说，中国长城般的现金正在涌入美国房地产市场（China’s great wall of cash is pouring into the struggling U.S. property market）。 中国人喜爱在美国哪儿买房呢？ 一是华人集中的城市。最受青睐的是纽约、旧金山和洛杉矶。在这类大城市，既能体验资本主义纸醉金迷的生活方式，又能保留故国老家的饮食文化，而且不懂英语也不会成为”聋子哑巴”：中文报纸上密密麻麻的广告覆盖了几乎所有你能想到的各种服务。 二是美国房产重灾区。比如佛罗里达和内华达州。位于内华达州的拉斯维加斯，十来万美元就可以买到一栋相当漂亮的别墅。但那儿气候干燥，夏天酷热，不是居住的好地方。中国富人在那儿买房子，目的在于投资，等待升值。 三是美国亲戚所在区。有些中国富人已经有亲戚先行赴美，留学的、工作的，都有。他们分布在美国四面八方。除了上述地方外，较多的居住在华盛顿州、德克萨斯州、伊利诺伊斯州、新泽西州州、马里兰州、维吉尼亚州、麻省等。中国富人在亲戚所在地买房子，可以让亲戚分享或者帮助照应。 根据美国地产协会的资料，截止2012年3月底，过去12个月，来自中国的富人在美国买房子，共花了74亿美元，帮助美国低迷的房地产市场”拉动内需”。 美国房子的中间价不到20万美元。热门地区，如加州、纽约、麻省等，则要50万左右。中国富人的理念是”只买最贵的”，所以通常都是”大手笔”，买的都是百万美元以上的。而且，令美国人瞠目结舌的是，很多富人都是现金一笔付清。 美国各地都有华人的地产经纪人。他们没有工资，靠佣金生活。但佣金通常为房子售价的百分之三左右。一个月卖掉一栋房子，收入就远远超过工程师。美国没有”售楼小姐”，大多是中老年经纪人，其中许多人拥有美国正宗的博士学位。来自中国的富人，是他们的”财神爷”。 美国的信息是透明的。任何人的房产情况，都是公开的。比如，想要知道名叫Bo Jieying的房产，稍稍一查，就会查到在麻省有一栋房子，地址是25 Hundreds Cir Wellesley Hills, MA。两层楼房。四个卧室，三个全套浴室和一个非全套的卫生间。不算车库楼道等，居住面积为3712平方英尺（约345平方米）。占地面积为49970平方英尺（约4642平方米）。1930年建造的老式独户洋房。1987年全新装修。绿茵环抱。波士顿西边。属于高档住宅区。2003年9月23日过户，售价为213万美元。地产税每年约2万美元。不过，据说，现无人居住。
250e2575db7f6355724c7f9d8cce9cf79e49e948.translatedText: Chinese people naturally love to buy a house. U.S. housing prices have fallen from their peak in 2006, and have fallen by one-third in most places. There is no purchase restriction policy in the United States. Some savvy wealthy people in China have begun to target the U.S. real estate market and go to the United States to buy houses. Not long ago, USA Today described that China’s great wall of cash is pouring into the struggling U.S. property market. Where do Chinese people like to buy houses in the United States? One is the city where Chinese people are concentrated. The most popular are New York, San Francisco and Los Angeles. In such big cities, you can not only experience the lavish lifestyle of capitalism, but also retain the food culture of your home country, and you will not become "deaf and mute" if you don't understand English: Chinese newspapers are densely packed with advertisements covering almost all kinds of services you can think of. The second is the hardest-hit real estate area in the United States. Such as Florida and Nevada. Located in Las Vegas, Nevada, you can buy a very beautiful villa for more than 100,000 US dollars. But the climate there is dry and the summers are very hot, so it’s not a good place to live. Rich Chinese buy houses there for the purpose of investing and waiting for appreciation. The third is the area where relatives in the United States live. Some wealthy Chinese already have relatives who have gone to the United States first, either to study or work. They are located in all parts of the United States. In addition to the places mentioned above, more people live in Washington State, Texas, Illinois, New Jersey, Maryland, Virginia, Massachusetts, etc. When rich Chinese buy a house where their relatives live, they can let their relatives share it or help take care of it. According to the National Real Estate Association, as of the end of March 2012, wealthy Chinese from China had spent a total of US$7.4 billion on buying houses in the United States in the past 12 months, helping the sluggish real estate market in the United States to "stimulate domestic demand." The median house price in the United States is less than $200,000. Popular areas, such as California, New York, and Massachusetts, cost around 500,000. The philosophy of wealthy Chinese is to "only buy the most expensive", so they usually make "big purchases" and buy more than a million dollars. Moreover, what makes Americans stunned is that many wealthy people pay in cash. There are Chinese real estate agents all over the United States. They receive no salary and live on commission. But the commission is usually about three percent of the home’s sales price. Selling a house in a month can earn far more than an engineer. There are no "sales ladies" in the United States. Most of them are middle-aged and elderly agents, many of whom have authentic American doctorates. Rich people from China are their "gods of wealth." America's information is transparent. Everyone’s property status is public. For example, if you want to know about the real estate named Bo Jieying, after a little research, you will find that there is a house in Massachusetts, the address is 25 Hundreds Cir Wellesley Hills, MA. Two story building. Four bedrooms, three full baths and one partial bathroom. Not counting the garage corridor, etc., the living area is 3,712 square feet (approximately 345 square meters). The floor area is 49,970 square feet (approximately 4,642 square meters). An old-fashioned single-family house built in 1930. Newly renovated in 1987. Surrounded by greenery. West side of Boston. It is a high-end residential area. The property was transferred on September 23, 2003 and sold for US$2.13 million. Property taxes are approximately $20,000 per year. However, it is said that it is currently uninhabited.

8a9c8a70ba0893d5e02b2729266335fc65a69b18.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学房地产专家麦克奥尔表示从 2011 年 9 月开始亚利桑那的房地产开始稳步， 2012 年 3 月强势上扬，整个地区的房屋供应量与去年相比下降了 64% ，，房屋的亏损率也降低了 82% 。他说，在这么短的时间内房屋市场迅速恢复，说明亚利桑那房地产市场波动比较大。与其他州相比亚利桑那破产屋风潮结束的比较早，这也可能是这里市场恢复早的原因。尽管亚利桑那有很强的市场恢复的信号，但是我们也看到了一些其他的信号，例如市民拥有房屋的比率也达到了 15 年来的最低，也就是说很多人在破产风潮中没有了房屋所有权。
8a9c8a70ba0893d5e02b2729266335fc65a69b18.translatedText: Real estate expert at Arizona State University, Mike Orr, said that from September 2011, real estate in Arizona began to stabilize, and in March 2012 After a strong monthly increase, the region's housing supply fell by 64% compared with last year, and the housing loss rate also decreased by 82%. He said that the rapid recovery of the housing market in such a short period of time shows that the Arizona real estate market is relatively volatile. The bankruptcy housing trend ended relatively early in Arizona compared to other states, which may also be the reason why the market here has recovered so early. Although there are strong signs of market recovery in Arizona, we also see some other signs. For example, the homeownership rate has reached a 15-year low, which means that many people have lost their home ownership in the bankruptcy wave.

2f26a65c59d1339cde1756dc39cced7db6f291f5.sourceText: 另外，还有值得关注的好消息，本周二亚利桑那州立法院签署 2013 年的政府预算。从全美贷款服务中拿到了 50000 万美元的预算帮助家庭解决贷款危机。这些钱会用于要求银行为那些濒临破产的家庭做二次贷款，减少损失。亚利桑那州的基金还将用于加强执法，检控按揭诈骗，作为抵押贷款欺诈而蒙受损失的补偿。资金也可用于房屋咨询，破产援助热线，破产调解方案，法律援助，住房整治项目，以及相关工作人员提供资金。更多房地产新闻请咨询金信地产 Tinna 电话： (480)287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
2f26a65c59d1339cde1756dc39cced7db6f291f5.translatedText: In addition, there is good news worth paying attention to. On Tuesday, the Arizona State Court signed the 2013 government budget. Received a $500 million budget from National Loan Services to help families address their mortgage crisis. The money will be used to require banks to provide second loans to families on the verge of bankruptcy to reduce losses. Arizona's funds will also be used to increase enforcement and prosecution of mortgage fraud and to compensate for losses suffered due to mortgage fraud. Funds may also be used to fund housing counseling, bankruptcy assistance hotlines, bankruptcy mediation programs, legal aid, housing remediation projects, and related staff. For more real estate news, please contact Goldtrust Realty Tinna Tel: (480)287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

fd4c4b9abaca6d6195c56d90b6509859af4cbf5d.sourceText: 3岁女童用智能手机救母 （亚省时报） 住在三潭谷的居民热议三岁女童用手机救母的故事。 上周四早上，住在三潭谷的丽贝卡做完手术回家后陷入昏迷，当时陪伴在家的只有她三岁的女儿麦迪森贝克。小小麦迪森见母亲无反应，居然会用智能手机打电话给在德州的外婆，通过外婆叫911，救了妈妈一命。 事后大家都对小麦迪森的行为感到惊讶，按理说她应该不会打电话，可能当时她拿起手机玩，偏巧按了外婆家的电话号码……重要的是她在那时刻打了电话给外婆，进而救了妈妈。 消防局的急救人员说，如果小麦迪森不呼救的话，她妈妈的状况将不堪设想。
fd4c4b9abaca6d6195c56d90b6509859af4cbf5d.translatedText: used a smartphone to save her mother (Alberta Times) Residents living in San Tan Valley were hotly discussing the story of a three-year-old girl who used a mobile phone to save her mother. Rebecca, who lives in San Tan Valley, fell into a coma last Thursday morning after returning home from surgery with only her three-year-old daughter, Madison Baker, at home. When little Madison saw that her mother was unresponsive, she actually used her smartphone to call her grandmother in Texas and called 911 through her grandmother, saving her mother's life. Afterwards, everyone was surprised by Maddison's behavior. Logically speaking, she should not be able to make phone calls. Maybe she picked up her mobile phone to play with it and happened to press her grandmother's phone number... The important thing is that she called her grandmother at that moment and saved her mother. Fire department paramedics said her mother's condition would have been dire if little Madison had not called for help.

704c78cedec4fb75a52049fa2afcea0e70657340.sourceText: ASU中文领航项目的两名优秀学生被邀请参加2012年汉语桥中文比赛 （孔子学院) 每年来自美国各个地区的学生都会汇聚一堂，角逐代表美国参加中央电视台播出的汉语桥中文决赛的机会。 西南地区的汉语桥选拔赛由加州大学洛杉矶分校孔子学院和中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆协同主办，将于2012年5月5日在该校Popper剧院举行。 今年，中文领航项目的两名学生马麟和丹强尼将代表亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院前往加州大学洛杉矶分校参加汉语桥中文选拔赛。丹强尼和马麟两人都是中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆选出的杰出参赛选手。比赛要求所有参赛选手用汉语进行脱稿演讲（5分钟以内），展示与中国文化相关的才艺，并回答一系列涉及汉语知识、中华文化常识和中国国情知识的问题，表现自己对中国文化的理解。为参加这次比赛，丹强尼和马麟做了充分的准备。 在才艺展示环节，丹强尼将表演大山的相声或自己的喜剧独白《哭笑不得》。马麟则演唱布仁巴雅尔的经典曲目《父亲的草原母亲的河》。 Jonny Dangerfield Zach Marin (丹强尼) (馬麟) 丹强尼和马麟是中文领航项目的学生。该项目是一个高级中文学习项目，旨在培养学生不仅能熟练应用中文，而且能够使用中文学习专业知识的能力。当问到学习语言有何建议时，丹强尼评论说学习语言是个挑战，需要付出巨大的艰辛和努力，但同时这也是一种乐趣。大家要越过”安全区”大胆尝试。马麟的评论则是学习语言必须全身心投入激情昂扬。无论困难多大，只要肯努力，获得成功只是一个时间问题。 ”汉语桥”中文比赛是国家汉办主办的大型国际汉语比赛项目，是世界人文交流领域的知名品牌活动，共分为”汉语桥”世界大学生中文比赛、”汉语桥”世界中学生中文比赛和”汉语桥”在华留学生汉语大赛三项比赛。每年一届，由汉语桥比赛组委会进行项目的具体组织和实施。近年来，”汉语桥”中文比赛项目采取汉办与地方政府合作的方式，并结合电视呈现，取得较好效果。截至目前，大学生比赛已举办八届，先后吸引了来自 世界60多个国家的705名大学生来华参加了复赛、决赛。 在此，亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院衷心祝愿丹强尼和马麟能够在五月的选拔赛中取得成功！加油！
704c78cedec4fb75a52049fa2afcea0e70657340.translatedText: Two outstanding students from the ASU Chinese Navigation Program were invited to participate in the 2012 Chinese Bridge Chinese Competition (Confucius Institute) Every year, students from all regions of the United States gather together to compete for the opportunity to represent the United States in the Chinese Bridge finals broadcast on CCTV. The Southwest Chinese Bridge Trial Competition is co-sponsored by the Confucius Institute at UCLA and the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles and will be held on May 5, 2012 at the University’s Popper Theater. This year, two students from the Chinese Navigation Program, Ma Lin and Dan Johnny, will represent the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University and go to UCLA to participate in the Chinese Bridge Chinese Trials. Johnny Dan and Ma Lin were both outstanding contestants selected by the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles. The competition requires all contestants to give unscripted speeches in Chinese (within 5 minutes), demonstrate their talents related to Chinese culture, and answer a series of questions involving Chinese knowledge, common sense of Chinese culture and knowledge of China’s national conditions to demonstrate their understanding of Chinese culture. To participate in this competition, Johnny Dan and Ma Lin made full preparations. In the talent show, Johnny Dan will perform Dashan's cross talk or his own comedy monologue "Crying or Laughing." Ma Lin sang Buren Bayar's classic song "Father's Grassland and Mother's River". Jonny Dangerfield Zach Marin (Dan Johnny) (Ma Lin) Jonny Dangerfield and Ma Lin are students in the Chinese Navigation Program. This program is an advanced Chinese language learning program designed to cultivate students’ ability to not only apply Chinese proficiently, but also to use Chinese to learn professional knowledge. When asked for advice on learning a language, Danjoni commented that learning a language is a challenge and requires a lot of hard work and effort, but it is also a lot of fun. Everyone should cross the "safe zone" and try boldly. Ma Lin's comment is that learning a language must be done with full concentration and passion. No matter how difficult it is, as long as you work hard, success is only a matter of time. The "Chinese Bridge" Chinese Proficiency Competition is a large-scale international Chinese proficiency competition hosted by Hanban and a well-known brand event in the field of world cultural exchanges. It is divided into three competitions: the "Chinese Bridge" Chinese Proficiency Competition for Foreign College Students, the "Chinese Bridge" Chinese Proficiency Competition for Foreign Secondary School Students and the "Chinese Bridge" Chinese Proficiency Competition for International Students in China. Once a year, the Chinese Bridge Competition Organizing Committee will carry out the specific organization and implementation of the project. In recent years, the "Chinese Bridge" Chinese language competition project has adopted the method of cooperation between Hanban and local governments, combined with television presentations, and achieved good results. Up to now, the college student competition has been held for eight times, attracting 705 college students from more than 60 countries around the world to China to participate in the semi-finals and finals. Here, the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University sincerely wishes Johnny Dan and Ma Lin success in the selection competition in May! come on!

a6bb6515e632352c00440029f4b8c1594580eca8.sourceText: 凤凰城气如虹：生活随笔-记钓鱼台 最近这些日子，钓鱼台的话题甚嚣尘上，几乎无人不知。 我对于钓鱼台，存有非常深刻印象，不过那钓鱼台和这钓鱼台完全不同，大有差别，那是人的艺名，不是海上列岛。 近日沸腾谈论的钓鱼台，起因是日本非法购岛的闹剧，令中日关系紧张，激怒了全球华人齐声反抗，弄得国际局势风起云涌，前途暗淡。 我每天在网上都收到有关讨论此问题的资讯，与朋友茶叙一定也少不了这个重要话题。 其实，钓鱼台的问题存在已久，甲午战争签订马关条约时就割让给日本了，第二次世界大战后，没有明确与台湾一起交还中华民国，反而随着琉球群岛由美国托管。 到一九七二年，美国不理会中方抗议，一并交给日本，种下日后磨擦的因素。 四十年来双方一直搁置争议，保持友好关系，直到今天在种种围堵中国的气氛下发生，并不寻常，摆明是有位渔翁，搞弄鹬蚌相争而获利，政治目的大于军事 目的。 有人说，政治与女人生殖器，是世界上最肮脏的东西，也最为诱人，利害攸关，朋友可变成敌人，敌人会成为朋友。 作为一个普通子民，必须要冷静和理智地剖析，不可被政治人物的态度所蒙蔽。 钓鱼台列岛事件，现在每天都在新闻时事中谈论著，但是，每次提起钓鱼台，就让我很自然地记得这熟识名字，不是正在海上纷争的钓鱼台，而是昔日居住在越南堤岸，替人 择吉批命占算八字的钓鱼台先生。 一九七五年以前的越南南方，是在美国援助下的自由社会，只要不犯法，不亲共，什么行业都可随意经营，算命占卜属自由职业，可在报纸上广告，也可在门前 张贴大字招牌，那时的命理学家，很少采用真姓名，都习惯改个艺名，在堤岸华人区域稍有名气的，不外是：何铁言、钓鱼台、白云山、雁南飞、铁面 判官等。 其中何铁言和钓鱼台给我印象较为深刻。 何铁言馆址在当时品湖街九如巷，是何雪梅同学的父亲，同学们常以那有趣广告词语取笑她，因为有句「婚姻有没有，再嫁可以否？」那时代人们思想还很保守， 妇人「返头嫁」几乎是一种忌讳，他的广告敢如此刊登，实在大胆；而最多人喜欢仿效​​的，却是那句「先生礼拜无休息」，星期日如果谁还在工作，必定会说出 这句话。 钓鱼台则是让我佩服的算命家，馆址在阮廌街近东源鸡饭店旁边，家居芽菜巷内。 大多数人找他批命，将生辰八字写下，递交给他，并缴交相金，所谓「相金先惠，格外留神」，他约定客人某一天来取批文，然后当面解释命理，指点迷津， 逢凶化吉。 我在此顺便解释所谓「八字」，即是根据出生那年的天干地支，那个月份、日子和时间的干支，每组准确记录有两个字，年月日时，总共为八个字，每一 组可称为「柱」，所以「八字」即「四柱」，或称「四柱八字」。 我之所以佩服钓鱼台，是有位朋友黄南金，她父亲经营工厂，每年新春开市，都要去钓鱼台择吉开张，年年生意兴隆，赚到盘满钵满，她说要让钓鱼台钓一下才行好运 。 有一年她自己去批命，后来拿给我看那份批命存折，只见钓鱼台三个横排名字下面注明：「时真命准，报假不灵」。 在批算她的未来，最令我拍案叫绝的是有句：「具有嫁外国人之心​​！」她是才女，任职法亚银行，里面有位法国青年正追求她，她总是在我们男子 面前赞扬法国人如何有风度，如何浪漫，还明言贬低华人、越人，说是无法相比，恨不得立刻嫁去法兰西。 这种情形，只有我们亲切混熟才知道，稍为生疏都不晓得，钓鱼台怎么会算得出，简直太神奇了。 于是，我结婚后也找他算一算，这时越南政权易帜，这行业被视为不正当的欺骗谋生，明令禁止；钓鱼台已不敢公开营业，只有相识者上门求教，当作朋友式的探访 ，偷偷摸摸地拈笔进行批算。 批示我与太座的过去大致准确，性格表现也算符合，指出我的配偶是贤妻良母，持家有道，但绝不容纳第三者的骚扰，事后证明无差错。 最令我惊讶的是他将批文交给我后，附带说一句：「老兄，嗱！我没有见过你太太，但我知道她的皮肤白皙亮丽，髀罅上还有颗黑痣哩！」 奇怪，他怎么会知道？ 钓鱼台真厉害，让我铭记。 后来越南局势凌乱，人人逃亡出国，钓鱼台去了何处，没有音讯。 现在谈到钓鱼台，都是日本觊觎着的岛屿，可是我总记起那位钓鱼台先生！
a6bb6515e632352c00440029f4b8c1594580eca8.translatedText: Phoenix City is full of energy: Life Essays - Notes on Diaoyutai In recent days, the topic of Diaoyutai has been very popular, and almost no one knows about it. I have a very deep impression of Diaoyutai, but that Diaoyutai is completely different from this Diaoyutai. There is a big difference. That is a person's stage name, not an island on the sea. Diaoyutai, which has been hotly discussed recently, was caused by the farce of Japan's illegal purchase of the island, which strained Sino-Japanese relations and provoked Chinese people all over the world to join forces to resist, making the international situation turbulent and the future bleak. I receive messages discussing this issue every day on the Internet, and this important topic is indispensable for a chat with friends. In fact, the problem of Diaoyutai has existed for a long time. It was ceded to Japan when the Treaty of Shimonoseki was signed during the Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1894. After World War II, it was not explicitly returned to the Republic of China along with Taiwan. Instead, the Ryukyu Islands were placed under U.S. custody along with the Ryukyu Islands. By 1972, the United States ignored China's protests and handed it over to Japan, sowing factors for future friction. For 40 years, the two sides have shelved disputes and maintained friendly relations. Until today, the incident happened in the atmosphere of various sieges against China. It is unusual. It is obvious that there is a fisherman who makes profits from fighting between snipe and clams. The political purpose is greater than the military purpose. Some people say that politics and women's genitals are the dirtiest and most tempting things in the world. The stakes are so high that friends can become enemies and enemies can become friends. As an ordinary citizen, we must analyze it calmly and rationally and not be blinded by the attitudes of politicians. The Diaoyutai Islands Incident is discussed in the news every day. However, every time I mention the Diaoyutai Islands, I naturally remember this familiar name. It is not the Diaoyutai Islands that are engaged in disputes at sea, but Mr. Diaoyutai Islands, who used to live on the embankment of Vietnam and choose good luck and fortune-telling for people. Before 1975, South Vietnam was a free society with the assistance of the United States. As long as it did not break the law or be pro-communist, any industry could be operated at will. Fortune-telling and fortune-telling were freelancing. They could advertise in newspapers or put up large-character signboards in front of the door. Numerologists at that time rarely used their real names and were accustomed to changing their stage names. The ones who were slightly famous in the Chinese area of ​​the embankment were: He Tieyan, Diaoyutai, Baiyun Mountain, Yan Nanfei, Tiemian The judge waits. Among them, He Tieyan and Diaoyutai impressed me the most. He Tieyan's library was located in Jiuru Lane, Pinhu Street, and was the father of classmate He Xuemei. Her classmates often teased her with that interesting advertising slogan, because there was a saying, "Marriage or not, is it okay to remarry?" At that time, people were still very conservative, and it was almost a taboo for a woman to "remarry". It was really bold that his advertisement dared to be published like this. However, what most people liked to imitate was the phrase "Mr. does not have a day off during the week." If anyone was still working on Sunday, he would definitely say this sentence. Diaoyutai is a fortune teller that I admire. It is located on Ruan Lai Street, next to Dongyuan Chicken Restaurant, in Bean Cai Lane. Most people come to him for approval, write down their birth date and birth date, submit it to him, and pay the fortune. As the saying goes, "the fortune comes first, so pay special attention to it." He agrees with the guests to come to get the approval on a certain day, and then explains the numerology in person, gives advice, and turns misfortune into good luck. I would like to explain the so-called "Bazi" by the way, that is, based on the heavenly stems and earthly branches of the year of birth, the stems and branches of that month, day and time, each group has two characters accurately recorded. The year, month, day and time are eight characters in total. Each group can be called a "pillar", so the "Bazi" is the "four pillars", or "four pillars and eight characters". The reason why I admire Diaoyutai is that I have a friend Huang Nanjin. Her father runs a factory. Every year when the market opens in the New Year, she goes to Diaoyutai to choose auspicious times to open her business. Business is booming every year and she makes a lot of money. She said that fishing in Diaoyutai will bring good luck. One year, she went to get her fortune approved by herself. Later, when she showed me the passbook of her fortune telling, I saw the following words under the three rows of names in Diaoyutai: "The fortune is accurate when the time is right, but when the fortune is false, it doesn't work." When evaluating her future, the sentence that impressed me the most was: "She has the desire to marry a foreigner!" She is a talented woman who works at the Bank of France and Asia, where a young French man is pursuing her. She always praises the French in front of us men for how graceful and romantic they are, and she also explicitly disparages the Chinese and Vietnamese, saying they are incomparable, and she wants to marry France immediately. Only those of us who are familiar with it know this kind of situation. Even those who are not familiar with it don’t know it. How Diaoyutai can calculate it is simply amazing. So, after I got married, I asked him to do the calculations. At this time, the Vietnamese regime changed. This industry was regarded as an unfair and deceptive way to make a living, and it was banned. The remark on my past with Taizu was generally accurate, and my character performance was consistent. It was pointed out that my spouse was a good wife and mother who managed the household well, but would never tolerate harassment from a third party. It was later proven that there was no mistake. What surprised me the most was that after he handed me the approval document, he said in passing: "Brother, hey! I have never met your wife, but I know that her skin is fair and bright, and she has a black mole on her temples!" Strange, how did he know? Diaoyutai is so awesome, I will remember it forever. Later, the situation in Vietnam was chaotic, everyone fled abroad, and there was no news about the whereabouts of Diaoyutai. Now when we talk about Diaoyutai, they are all islands that Japan covets, but I always remember that Mr. Diaoyutai!

9ab31bda6b2f8e3515d7335a5e682966af868548.sourceText: 不论是否喜欢 各州积极筹备健保交易市场 （亚省时报） 像许多共和党州长一样，布鲁尔州长虽然强烈批评美国总统奥巴马的医疗保健法，指称奥巴马健保法越权、危害州政府权利和个人自由，但布鲁尔和部份共和党州长正在积极筹设健保交易市场（insurance exchange）。 布鲁尔承认正在积极运作一项新的保险交换，其它的共和党州长也说，他们正在准备11月16日的健保法案的保险交换，在大选后10天，若各州未能提出自己的保险交换法规，就表示该州将采行联邦推广的健保保险交换法规。 奥克拉何马州上周接受了奥巴马医疗改革方案；密西西比州的保险监理专员钱尼在今夏的午餐会上被众多共和党官员围着寻问保险专业资讯。 布鲁尔的医疗政策顾问休斯说：”如果我们必须有一个”，”那么由亚利桑那州为自己设计，会比让联邦政府来做更好。”但他也说，布鲁尔也不会在大选前做出最后的决定。 健保法案规定于2014年1月生效后，所有州都必需有健保交易市场，这是一个网上交易市场，任一小企业或个人都可以购买私人医疗保险计划，若无医疗保险的美国人则将科以罚金。若各州在截止日期前未能运行自己的健保交易市场，联邦政府将代州政府运行。届时收入介于贫困水平的133%和400%之间的人，可以通过交易获得联邦税收补贴的更实惠的价格。 目前，只有13个州和哥伦比亚特区已正式运行自己的健保交易市场，除罗得岛州的州长为倾向民主党的独立人士外，其余均为民主党。但6个共和党州长表示他们不用运行州健保交易市场，包括阿拉斯加州、佛罗里达州、路易斯安那州、缅因州、南卡罗来纳州和德克萨斯州。 剩下的一些州长，其中有22个共和党州，都在探索他们的选择。亚利桑那州之后，至少有密西西比州、内华达州和新墨西哥州3个，做了足够的规划，以满足11月的最后期限，他们决定运行自己的健保交易市场。而大多数共和党州长，包括布鲁尔州长，都在等待总统大选的结果，才作出最后决定。因为罗姆尼已承诺若胜选，将废除该法。
9ab31bda6b2f8e3515d7335a5e682966af868548.translatedText: Whether he likes it or not, states are actively preparing for health insurance exchange markets (Alberta Times) Like many Republican governors, although Governor Brewer strongly criticized US President Obama's health care law, claiming that Obama's health care law overstepped its authority and endangered the rights of state governments and personal freedoms, Brewer and some Republican governors are actively preparing for an insurance exchange. Brewer admitted that a new insurance exchange is actively being operated. Other Republican governors also said that they are preparing for the insurance exchange in the November 16 health insurance bill. Ten days after the election, if states fail to propose their own insurance exchange regulations, they will adopt federally promoted health insurance exchange regulations. Oklahoma accepted Obamacare last week; Chaney, Mississippi's insurance commissioner, was surrounded by Republican officials at luncheons this summer asking for insurance expertise. "If we have to have one," said Hughes, Brewer's health policy adviser, "it would be better for Arizona to design it for itself than to have the federal government do it." But he also said Brewer wouldn't make a final decision before the election. After the health care bill takes effect in January 2014, all states are required to have a health insurance exchange, an online marketplace where any small business or individual can purchase a private health insurance plan. Americans without health insurance will be fined. If states fail to run their own health insurance exchanges by the deadline, the federal government will run them on their behalf. People with incomes between 133% and 400% of the poverty level will then be able to access more affordable prices subsidized by federal taxes through the deal. Currently, only 13 states and the District of Columbia have officially run their own health insurance exchange markets, and except for the governor of Rhode Island, who is an independent who leans toward the Democratic Party, the rest are all Democrats. But six Republican governors said they would not need to operate state health insurance exchanges, including Alaska, Florida, Louisiana, Maine, South Carolina and Texas. Some remaining governors, 22 of whom are Republican, are exploring their options. After Arizona, at least three others, Mississippi, Nevada and New Mexico, have done enough planning to meet the November deadline and decided to run their own health insurance exchanges. Most Republican governors, including Governor Brewer, are waiting for the results of the presidential election before making a final decision. Because Romney has promised to repeal the law if he wins.

3f0f1a0c8c9af7dc25bd5e87872a87a1e95e1ba2.sourceText: EAA艺术课堂公开日中，大家将有机会走进新东方独具特色的中国舞课堂现场，观摩诸位老师的教学，共同体验明星锻造的过程。新东方艺术学校的中国舞教学是大凤凰城地区乃至亚省范围里特色独具的中国传统文化教育项目。学校致力于培养百位中国舞学员，其年龄跨度从3岁到PRE-K到青少年到成人。中国舞训练的教育方式以北京舞蹈学院中国舞考级的教育体系为蓝本，配以针对美国中国舞学员具体需求的特色内容，每年为社区大小舞台、亚省华人春晚提供大量的优秀表演节目和风采独具的中国舞演员。学员们的精彩表演深得华人社区内外的好评。不论您是艺术爱好者，关心艺术教育的家长，还是成人舞蹈爱好者，学校欢迎你们在公开日走进舞蹈课堂，现场体验并教师直接沟通。 在突出传统中国舞教学的基础上，新东方艺术学校大力开发丰富多样的艺术新课堂。舞蹈老师、舞蹈编导胡秋子老师应针对社区广大成人舞学习高涨的热潮，新开设Male + Female 成人舞创新班。课程以中国民族民间舞为核心，以芭蕾和现代舞基础训练为辅助，同堂训练男、女成人舞蹈学员，着重舞蹈的交流、配合和个性化的编舞。一方面希望为未来的文化舞台培养更多的优秀成年舞蹈明星，同时更通过舞蹈训练激发学员的自信心、艺术气质和创造力。课程授课时间为每周四晚7:30-9:00pm。 新东方亲子合唱班是近期学校大力推出的另外一项新颖的艺术课堂。亲子合唱班的招生对象是热爱音乐并想系统学习声乐的小朋友和家长。课程把专业的乐理发声训练和经典的中国歌曲结合起来，孩子和家长一起学，把高质量的亲子交流融入课堂，把美好的歌声从课堂带回家庭和社区。此课程由资深合唱教育家、女中音范毓玖老师执教。范老师毕业于四川音乐学院声乐系，后赴北京中央乐团进修。她曾长期担任广东珠海市艺术馆声乐指导，并帅珠海市室内合唱团获得全省合唱大赛一等奖，第四届中国国际合唱节表演奖和中国合唱节比赛金奖。范毓玖个人同时也是广东省专业女中音独唱演员，多次在全省，全国艺术节舞台上担任独唱、活动策划。范毓玖老师来美后继续和美国东岸、西岸高水平的音乐团体保持频繁合作，如：加州硅谷的Menlo Park Presbyterian Church Choir和东岸巴尔的摩的Arbutus United Methodist Church 等。亲子合唱班授课时间为：每周日上午10:00-11:30am. 公开日当天下午2:00pm, 范老师欢迎大朋友、小朋友一同体验她的公开课教学。 新东方近期推介的新艺术课还包括音乐、经典手工制作等课程。公开日当日下午您还将欣赏到钢琴、小提琴和精典手工制作的精彩展示。 当日其他的公开课程还包括美术课、武术课等精彩课程。更多详细内容、信息欢迎您当日现场体验、交流！也欢迎您有问题致电学校：602-490-8613。
3f0f1a0c8c9af7dc25bd5e87872a87a1e95e1ba2.translatedText: During the EAA Art Class Open Day, everyone will have the opportunity to enter New Oriental's unique Chinese dance class, observe the teaching of teachers, and experience the process of star forging together. The Chinese dance teaching at New Oriental Art School is a unique Chinese traditional culture education project in the greater Phoenix area and even the province. The school is committed to cultivating hundreds of Chinese dance students, whose ages range from 3 years old to PRE-K to teenagers to adults. The educational method of Chinese dance training is based on the education system of Beijing Dance Academy’s Chinese dance examination, with special content tailored to the specific needs of American Chinese dance students. Every year, it provides a large number of excellent performances and unique Chinese dancers for community stages and the Alberta Chinese Spring Festival Gala. The wonderful performances of the students were well received both inside and outside the Chinese community. Whether you are an art lover, a parent who cares about art education, or an adult dance enthusiast, the school welcomes you to enter the dance class during the open day, experience it on the spot and communicate directly with the teacher. On the basis of highlighting traditional Chinese dance teaching, New Oriental Art School vigorously develops rich and diverse new art classes. Dance teacher and choreographer Hu Qiuzi should respond to the rising craze for adult dance learning in the community and open a new innovative adult dance class of Male + Female. The course takes Chinese folk dance as the core and is supplemented by basic ballet and modern dance training. It trains male and female adult dance students in the same class, focusing on dance communication, coordination and personalized choreography. On the one hand, we hope to cultivate more outstanding adult dance stars for the future cultural stage, and at the same time, we hope to inspire students' self-confidence, artistic temperament and creativity through dance training. Course teaching time is every Thursday evening from 7:30-9:00pm. The New Oriental parent-child choir class is another novel art class recently launched by the school. The parent-child choir class is open to children and parents who love music and want to learn vocal music systematically. The course combines professional music vocal training with classic Chinese songs. Children and parents learn together, integrating high-quality parent-child communication into the classroom, and bringing beautiful singing from the classroom back to families and communities. This course is taught by senior chorus educator and mezzo-soprano Fan Yujiu. Teacher Fan graduated from the Vocal Music Department of Sichuan Conservatory of Music and later went to Beijing Central Orchestra for further studies. She has been the vocal director of Zhuhai Art Museum in Guangdong for a long time, and directed the Zhuhai Chamber Chorus to win the first prize in the Provincial Chorus Competition, the Performance Award in the 4th China International Chorus Festival and the Gold Medal in the China Chorus Festival Competition. Fan Yujiu is also a professional mezzo-soprano soloist in Guangdong Province. She has served as a soloist and event planner in the province and national art festivals many times. After coming to the United States, Teacher Fan Yujiu continued to maintain frequent cooperation with high-level music groups on the east and west coast of the United States, such as the Menlo Park Presbyterian Church Choir in Silicon Valley, California, and the Arbutus United Methodist Church in Baltimore on the east coast. The parent-child choir class teaching time is: 10:00-11:30am every Sunday. On the open day at 2:00pm, Teacher Fan welcomes adults and children to experience her open class teaching. The new art classes recently introduced by New Oriental also include music, classic handcrafting and other courses. On the afternoon of the open day, you will also enjoy wonderful displays of pianos, violins and classic handcrafts. Other open courses on that day also included art classes, martial arts classes and other exciting courses. For more detailed content and information, you are welcome to experience and communicate on the day! You are also welcome to call the school if you have any questions: 602-490-8613.

414fa6f8d81fb239213a2adbdcb01f0ccd6aa7c3.sourceText: SB1070移民法 最高法院聆审 亚省时报记者 凯婴编译 联邦最高法院24日开始聆审亚利桑那州移民法，欧巴马政府认为，本州2010年制定的移民法要取缔非法移民，与联邦法律冲突。移民法要求州警执行拦检时，可检查对方移民身分，该法并规定无证移民求职为犯罪行为。 移民法的上述两项规定因为干预了联邦移民法律而遭联邦法院封杀，但其他州仍相继制定出类似的移民法。 这是高院大法官继欧巴马政府的健保改革法之后，在不到一个月内，第二次听取有关联邦权力受到挑战的辩论。 州议会认为，他们制定移民法是为了减少非法移民人口，许多无证移民已自愿离开，显示移民法取得成功。 但批评者说，移民法伤害了亚省的形象，部分组织呼吁抵制亚利桑那，取消在本州举办活动。他们认为法律基于肤色的种族歧视对大量的拉丁裔移民很不公平。 移民法和欧巴马健保法的争议焦点，实质上是欧巴马政府和民主党执政的各州，反对共和党执政各州和茶党同情者试图挑战联邦政府的权威。 共和党的州前检察长伍兹认为，非法移民是本州的严重问题，但并不代表各州就应各行其是，制定各自的移民政策。他说，双方的争议是源自国会未能推动移民体制改革。 司法部前检察总长克莱蒙特将代表本州出席最高法院的辩论，他说，亚利桑那是因联邦政府不能保证边界安全，才被迫对非法移民採取行动。非法移民占本州人口6%，导致全州监狱人满为患、公校不堪重负，公民与合法居民的薪资下降。 将代表联邦政府辩护的司法部检察总长韦瑞利认为，联邦政府已加强了边界执法，没有不顾亚省的安全，亚利桑那移民法与国会的法律冲突。 周二，民主党参议员舒曼表示，如果高院支持这项法桉，那么他将草拟备份计划禁止州政府和地方当局执行自己的移民政策。”当亚利桑那州和阿拉巴马州撰写自己的法律时，他们就不会再以?#24110;助联邦政府执行法律”来逃避责任了。?BR> 起草提出这项法桉的被罢免参议员皮尔斯辩护说这项法桉是打击非法移民的有效手段。”今天我们面临着非法移民带来的各种问题，包括毒品走私、盗卖枪支、贩卖人口等，对我们国家造成了极大威胁。” 高院预计6月会做出裁决。
414fa6f8d81fb239213a2adbdcb01f0ccd6aa7c3.translatedText: >SB1070 Immigration Law, Supreme Court Hearing, Alberta Times Reporter, Kaiying Compilation The federal Supreme Court began hearing on Arizona's immigration law on the 24th. The Obama administration believes that the state's immigration law enacted in 2010 to outlaw illegal immigration conflicts with federal law. Immigration law requires state police to check the immigration status of other people when they stop them. The law also makes it a crime for undocumented immigrants to seek employment. The above two provisions of the immigration law were blocked by the federal court because they interfered with federal immigration laws, but other states have still enacted similar immigration laws. This is the second time in less than a month that the Supreme Court justices have heard arguments on a challenge to federal power, following the Obama administration's health care reform law. State legislators believe they enacted immigration laws to reduce the illegal immigrant population, and many undocumented immigrants have left voluntarily, demonstrating the success of the immigration laws. But critics say the immigration law hurts the province's image, and some groups have called for a boycott of Arizona and the cancellation of events in the state. They believe the law's racial discrimination based on skin color is unfair to the large number of Latino immigrants. The focus of the dispute over immigration laws and Obama's health care law is essentially between the Obama administration and Democratic-governed states, against attempts by Republican-governed states and Tea Party sympathizers to challenge the authority of the federal government. Woods, the Republican former state attorney general, believes that illegal immigration is a serious problem in the state, but it does not mean that each state should go its own way and formulate its own immigration policies. He said the dispute between the two sides stems from Congress's failure to promote immigration reform. Claremont, the former attorney general of the Department of Justice, will represent the state in the Supreme Court argument. He said that Arizona was forced to take action against illegal immigrants because the federal government failed to ensure border security. Illegal immigrants account for 6% of the state's population, causing overcrowding in prisons across the state, overwhelmed public schools, and declining wages for citizens and legal residents. Justice Department Attorney General Verrilli, who will defend the federal government, believes the federal government has stepped up border enforcement without disregarding the safety of Alberta and that Arizona's immigration laws conflict with the laws of Congress. On Tuesday, Democratic Senator Robert Schuman said he would draft a backup plan to prohibit state and local authorities from enforcing their own immigration policies if the high court supports the bill. "When Arizona and Alabama write their own laws, they can no longer evade responsibility by helping the federal government enforce their laws." ?BR> Ousted Senator Pierce, who drafted the bill, defended it as an effective means to combat illegal immigration. "Today we are faced with various problems caused by illegal immigration, including drug smuggling, gun theft, human trafficking, etc., which pose a great threat to our country." The High Court is expected to make a ruling in June.

19dcb0cf5950e90f45ce7e069e013b9cb1a0a57d.sourceText: 4共和党候选人争夺吉福兹空缺 去年被枪伤的亚利桑那州第八区国会议员吉福兹，在一月辞职后留下的空缺，共和党人周二投票通过由吉福兹原来的助手罗恩巴博暂代，直至大选换届。 共和党人对这个空缺也虎视眈眈，有四名共和党参选人宣传争夺这个原本属于民主党的位置，他们分别是吉福兹2010年的对手杰西凯利，一个茶党商人，州参议员弗兰克安通瑞，美国退休空军飞行员，政治新人玛莎麦莎利，和商人、电台主播戴夫斯顿。 目前来看，凯利的知名度可能为他带来更多选票。
19dcb0cf5950e90f45ce7e069e013b9cb1a0a57d.translatedText: 4 Republican candidates vying for the Giffords vacancy. The vacancy left by Giffords, the congressman from Arizona's 8th District who was shot and wounded last year, resigned in January. Republicans voted on Tuesday to temporarily replace Giffords' original assistant Ron Barber until the election. Republicans are also eyeing this vacancy, with four Republican candidates campaigning for the position that originally belonged to the Democratic Party. They are Giffords' 2010 opponent Jesse Kelly, a Tea Party businessman, state Senator Frank Antony, retired U.S. Air Force pilot and political newcomer Martha McSally, and businessman and radio host Dave Stone. For now, Kelly's popularity may bring him more votes.

eb619ecbfe5020e60655444883524b203c84ab44.sourceText: 胡子大盗连劫7银行 遭通缉 （亚省时报） 警方在寻求公众提供信息，追缉一名抢劫了7家银行的犯罪嫌疑人。 据警方资料，该疑犯自去年12月22日至今年4月3日期间，化妆成大胡子，连续打劫7家银行，而且作案手法相似，多是走至出纳员窗口，要求对方拿出现金后徒步逃离。这疑犯被描述成一个白人男性，年龄约20至50岁，6英尺至6英尺2英尺高，180-250磅左右，黏着假胡子。 警方欢迎有线索的市民提供消息，可拨打沉默线人热线480-WITNESS（480-9486377）或登录silentwitness.org，信息一经证实有用，可获奖金1000元。
eb619ecbfe5020e60655444883524b203c84ab44.translatedText: Bearded robber wanted for robbing seven banks in a row (Alberta Times) Police are seeking information from the public to find a suspect who robbed seven banks. According to police information, from December 22 last year to April 3 this year, the suspect dressed up as a bearded man and robbed seven banks in a row. His committing methods were similar. He usually walked to the teller window and asked the other person to take out cash before fleeing on foot. The suspect is described as a white male, approximately 20 to 50 years old, 6 feet to 6 feet 2 feet tall, 180 to 250 pounds, and wearing a fake beard. The police welcome citizens with clues to provide information. They can call the silent informant hotline 480-WITNESS (480-9486377) or log on to silentwitness.org. Once the information is confirmed to be useful, a reward of 1,000 yuan will be awarded.

af42cbcd5aeea0338fe941b931ff1a275fd5999a.sourceText: 美5顶尖大学联合开放免费网上课程 （亚省时报） 免费网上教育平台Coursera的数名创始人周三宣布，美国五家最富盛名的大学将通过新型互动的教育平台提供免费在线课程。两名创始人都是斯坦福大学计算机科学教授，他们并且宣布，已经收到来自两家硅谷风险投资公司的1,600万美元资金。 Coursera在未来将通过它的网站coursera.org提供超过三十门大学课程，内容从希腊神话到经神病学，从微积分到现代美国诗歌。这些课程是由斯坦福大学、普林斯顿大学、加州伯克利大学、宾州大学和密西根大学的教授设计和教学。 Coursera联合一个致力让高等教育更方便更实惠的雄心勃勃的网上项目。许多这类参与者，仅仅是把整个的教学录像贴在网站上，没有互动的内容。其他人则试图从头建立全新的大学。 创始人科勒和安德鲁吴说Coursera将不同于其他类似的系统，因为教授们来自顶尖大学，将以他们大学的名义教学并且将把他们最受欢迎的课程量身定做的放到网上，把作 业和考试加到教学录像当中，在网上论坛回答学生的问题，甚至可能通过视频会议开通办公时间。 多选题和简答题将使用电脑评分。Coursera将很快设立一个同行打分系统来评估更加复杂的作业，比如论文和逻辑。 发言人说，学生们将不会获得大学学分。但是Coursera可能提供”完成证书”或者收费出具成绩单。公司可能通过录用某方面有才能的学生也能获益。 参与的大学希望藉此提升他们在海外的知名度，跟校友建立联系，也希望从心存感谢的网上学生那儿获得捐款。 宾州大学校长古特曼说：”这将增加我们对世界的影响力。” 部份Coursera上的课程有点粗糙。密西根大学政治学教授佩吉将他教授的一门”思考模式”的讲课进行录像，他站在他正装修的住房的一扇没有油漆的门前。 其中一些场景他看起来显得脾气暴躁。他的网上测验也包含一些错误。他的幻灯片有时候很难辨认。他的狗不时冲着画面叫嚷。 但是仍然，每周全世界三万多人坚持来听课，做作业，观看讲课录像并且在现场讨论论坛上互相聊天。 ”这棒极了。”佩吉计算了一下，如果要面对面讲课，需要150年的时间才能完成对这么多人的授课。 吴教授的一门课程是”人工智能”也非常受欢迎。近25,000名学生完成大多数的课程，13,000名学生获得的分数足以获得斯坦福大学的?#25104;就证明?#65288;Statement of accomplishment）。一些人甚至把讲课翻译成他们自己国家的语言并且加上字幕。 这些概念也有一些陷阱。 教授们无法知道谁完成了作业和考试。Heidelberg大学数学教授文科勒说，很难复制传统课堂上学生们合作学习一起解决问题的情景。 但是，文科勒还是惊讶网上课程的质量和严厉，他要求他的博士生修其中一些课作为完成课程的必需要求。 乔治亚技术所21世纪中心主任德米洛说，随着网上教育的成熟，学生们能够通过Coursera这样的网站获得免费的一流大学教育。 这样可能会让一些大学难以维生。德米洛说：”他们不能够认为源源不断的学生”愿意支付高昂的大学教育。 但是密西根大学的教务长韩龙说，他不担心免费课程会降低他们学校的吸引力。相反，他说该技术将提高校园经历。教授们可以指导学生观看网上讲课来学习特定主题，节约课题时间用来做实践活动，这些无法在数字空间复制。
af42cbcd5aeea0338fe941b931ff1a275fd5999a.translatedText: Five top universities in the United States jointly offer free online courses (Alberta Times) Several founders of the free online education platform Coursera announced on Wednesday that five of the most prestigious universities in the United States will provide free online courses through a new interactive education platform. The two founders, both professors of computer science at Stanford University, also announced that they had received $16 million in funding from two Silicon Valley venture capital firms. Coursera will offer more than thirty college courses in the future through its website coursera.org, ranging from Greek mythology to neuropsychiatry, from calculus to modern American poetry. These courses are designed and taught by professors from Stanford University, Princeton University, University of California at Berkeley, University of Pennsylvania, and University of Michigan. Coursera joins an ambitious online program dedicated to making higher education more accessible and affordable. Many of these participants just post the entire teaching video on the website without interactive content. Others are trying to build entirely new universities from scratch. Founders Kohler and Andrew Wu say Coursera will be different from other similar systems because professors from top universities will teach in their university's name and will tailor their most popular courses online, add assignments and exams to the teaching videos, answer student questions in online forums, and maybe even hold office hours via video conferencing. Multiple-choice and short-answer questions will be scored using a computer. Coursera will soon set up a peer-grading system to assess more complex assignments, such as essays and logic. Students will not receive college credit, the spokesman said. However, Coursera may provide a "certificate of completion" or issue transcripts for a fee. Companies may also benefit from hiring students who are talented in certain areas. Participating universities hope to increase their visibility overseas, build relationships with alumni and generate donations from grateful online students. "This will increase our impact on the world," said Gutman, president of the University of Pennsylvania. Some of the courses on Coursera are a bit rough. Peggy, a professor of political science at the University of Michigan, videotaped a lecture he taught on "Thinking Models" while standing in front of an unpainted door of the house he was renovating. There are some scenes where he seems grumpy. His online quizzes also contained some errors. His slides are sometimes hard to read. His dog barks at the screen from time to time. But still, more than 30,000 people around the world come every week to attend lectures, do homework, watch lecture videos and chat with each other in live discussion forums. "This is great." Peggy calculated that it would take 150 years to teach so many people face-to-face. One of Professor Wu's courses on "Artificial Intelligence" is also very popular. Nearly 25,000 students complete most courses, and 13,000 students earn scores sufficient to earn Stanford's Statement of Accomplishment. Some even translated the lectures into their own language and added subtitles. These concepts also have some pitfalls. Professors have no way of knowing who has completed assignments and exams. Wenkler, a professor of mathematics at Heidelberg University, said that it is difficult to replicate the situation in a traditional classroom where students work together to learn and solve problems together. Still, Wenkler was surprised by the quality and rigor of the online courses, and he required his doctoral students to take some of them as a requirement to complete the program. DeMillo, director of the 21st Century Center at the Georgia Institute of Technology, said that with the maturity of online education, students can obtain free first-class university education through websites such as Coursera. This may make it difficult for some universities to survive. "They can't assume there will be a steady stream of students" willing to pay for a high-priced college education, DeMillo said. But Long Han, provost of the University of Michigan, said he is not worried that free courses will make his school less attractive. Instead, he said the technology will enhance the campus experience. Professors can instruct students to watch online lectures to learn specific topics, saving subject time for practical activities that cannot be replicated in the digital space.

2f5c3833390d1fc4fb360cc3965d645b70ef63cd.sourceText: 两航空公司合并在即 亚省人忧AA搬离坦佩 （亚省时报） 全美航空公司(US Airways)并购破产的美国航空公司(American Airlines)在即，并向工会承诺尽量接承原美航的工人合约。但经济学家担忧，两公司合并后，原本在坦佩设立总部的美航撤销，办公楼及员工随之搬至全美的总部德州，将给坦佩经济带来重创。 曾是全美第三大航空公司的美航去年11月宣布破产，今年1月开始与全美航空商讨合并案。目前，全美是美国第五大航空公司。 全美航空董事长兼首席执行官道格派克上周五表示，合并成功可节省6200个就业机会，以保持目前两家航空公司的航线和航班，对抗美联航和三角洲航空两个公司。但也意味着一半美航员工将卷铺盖回家。此话一出，代表超过五万飞行员、空服员和地勤人员的工会提出抗议，最后，全美承诺尽量接承原有员工的工作合同。 但，随着美航总部的搬离，业界分析师估计，坦佩至少损失数百个就业机会。在全国的机场，美航的航班已经明显减少。 另，美航设在图森的呼叫中心已经关闭，约有680名员工转到其他工作岗位，800名员工将办公室搬回家。
2f5c3833390d1fc4fb360cc3965d645b70ef63cd.translatedText: The merger of the two airlines is imminent, and people in Alberta are worried about AA moving out of Tempe (Alberta Times) US Airways is about to merge with the bankrupt American Airlines, and has promised to the union to try to inherit the original American Airlines worker contract. However, economists are worried that after the merger of the two companies, American Airlines, which originally set up its headquarters in Tempe, will cancel its headquarters and move its office buildings and employees to its national headquarters in Texas, which will cause a heavy blow to Tempe's economy. American Airlines, once the third largest airline in the United States, declared bankruptcy last November and began discussing a merger with US Airways in January this year. Currently, Transamerica is the fifth largest airline in the United States. US Airways Chairman and CEO Doug Pike said on Friday that a successful merger could save 6,200 jobs and maintain the current routes and flights of the two airlines against United Airlines and Delta Air Lines. But it also means that half of American Airlines employees will pack up and go home. As soon as these words came out, the union representing more than 50,000 pilots, flight attendants and ground staff protested. In the end, the United States promised to try to accept the work contracts of the original employees. However, with the relocation of American Airlines' headquarters, industry analysts estimate that Tempe will lose at least hundreds of jobs. American Airlines flights have been significantly reduced at airports across the country. In addition, American Airlines' call center in Tucson has been closed. About 680 employees have transferred to other jobs and 800 employees have moved their offices home.

87bd9672bd83ef36e1b374957919836a6a3413d5.sourceText: 手机连网测试出炉 AT＆T最快Sprint最慢 （亚省时报） 科技网站《PCWorld》近期公布手机网络测试结果，连网速度最快的赢家为AT＆T公司和T-Mobile公司。 根据测试结果，AT＆T的4G LTE网络显示出最快的平均值，尽管其竞争对手Verizon的LTE网络的上传速度稍好。T-Mobile公司在3G网络的上传和下载具有明显的优势。 Sprint的网络速度排在所有测试城市的最后，其4G WiMAX产品的网络速度，甚至落后于其竞争对手的3G网络速度。该公司正在将其WiMax网络转向LTE。根据该份报告，该公司一直致力于其发展资源的转换。 这个测试遍布全美13大城市，华盛顿地区的覆盖面反映了全国的结果。尽管T-Mobile的4G网络在下载速度上表现好一点。华盛顿地区测试结果还表明，该地区AT＆T的3G网络不如国内其他地区强。事实上，该区的AT＆T 3G速度是全国最差的。 但是，总的来说，该结果表明运营商将继续打造出了自己的3G网络并增加容量以跟上手机增长趋势。 手机增长速度非常显著。根据尼尔森公司(Nielsen)3月份报告，智能手机占所有手机用户的一半，正好为49.7％，三分之二以上的新手机购买者选择智能手机，而非功能手机。这意味着消费者对数据传输速度有着更多更快的需求。
87bd9672bd83ef36e1b374957919836a6a3413d5.translatedText: Mobile phone network test results revealed: AT&T is the fastest, Sprint is the slowest (Alberta Times) The technology website "PCWorld" recently announced the results of a mobile phone network test. The winners with the fastest network speeds are AT&T and T-Mobile. According to the test results, AT&T's 4G LTE network showed the fastest average, although its rival Verizon's LTE network had slightly better upload speeds. T-Mobile has obvious advantages in uploading and downloading on 3G networks. Sprint's network speed ranked last in all test cities, and the network speed of its 4G WiMAX product even lagged behind the 3G network speed of its competitors. The company is moving its WiMax network to LTE. According to the report, the company has been committed to converting its development resources. The test is available in 13 major cities across the United States, with coverage in the Washington area mirroring national results. Although T-Mobile's 4G network performs a little better in download speeds. The Washington area test results also show that AT&T's 3G network in the area is not as strong as in other parts of the country. In fact, the area's AT&T 3G speeds are among the worst in the country. But, overall, the results suggest operators will continue to build out their 3G networks and add capacity to keep up with mobile phone growth. The growth rate of mobile phones is very significant. Smartphones account for half of all mobile phone users, exactly 49.7%, and more than two-thirds of new phone buyers choose smartphones over feature phones, according to a March report from Nielsen. This means consumers have more and faster demands for data transmission speeds.

1a3bb79ce649c8c9f55ef46619adc846fd1e67e4.sourceText: 肇16车祸5伤 BMW7面临召回 全国公路交通安全管理署(NHTSA)16日表示，当局针对宝马(BMW)7系列豪华轿车传动控制系统的问题，进行八个月调查后发现，该问题已造成16起车祸和五人受伤。 NHTSA是从去年8月展开这项调查，目前调查进度已接近召回前的工程分析阶段，但该型车至今仍未被召回。 这项调查涵盖近12万2000辆2002年份至2008年份的BMW 7系列轿车，该型车均配备引擎启停按钮和电子传动控制系统。 调查发现在一些桉例中，驾驶人可能会在车子处于空档(N档)时，误以为在停车状态。NHTSA在网站上公布的文件指出，该问题可能造成车子意外滑动和导致车祸。 NHTSA在文件中说，BMW公司和调查人员已接获50件有关该问题的投诉；其中一名2002年份BMW 745LI的车主声称，他2010年3月29日把车子停在亚特兰大一处托儿中心时，车子突然向前滑动40码，最后撞上停车场的护坡才停住，幸无人受伤。 另一名2006年份BMW 750车型的车主则指出，他2007年2月21日曾在停车时，按下引擎停止按钮后，车子应当自动变换为停车状态，但却在他下车后，倒退约100呎，并撞上一根灯柱。事后经销商向这名车主表示，无法查出故障原因。 BMW公司发言人布契科表示，该公司正配合当局的调查。NHTSA指出，当局已把该调查升级至工程分析阶段，以进一步评估车主投诉的瑕疵可能出现的安全后果。
1a3bb79ce649c8c9f55ef46619adc846fd1e67e4.translatedText: BMW 7 faces recall after 16 car crashes, 5 injured The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said on the 16th that after an eight-month investigation into a problem with the transmission control system of the BMW 7 Series luxury sedan, it was found that the problem had caused 16 car accidents and five injuries. NHTSA started this investigation in August last year. The investigation is now approaching the engineering analysis stage before the recall, but this model of vehicle has not yet been recalled. The survey covered nearly 122,000 BMW 7 Series sedans from 2002 to 2008, which are equipped with engine start-stop buttons and electronic transmission control systems. The investigation found that in some cases, drivers may mistakenly think that the car is parked when it is in neutral (N gear). Documents posted on the NHTSA website pointed out that the problem could cause the car to slide unexpectedly and cause a crash. NHTSA said in the document that BMW and investigators have received 50 complaints about this problem; one of the owners of a 2002 BMW 745LI claimed that when he parked his car at a child care center in Atlanta on March 29, 2010, the car suddenly slid forward 40 yards and finally hit the parking lot's berm before coming to rest. Fortunately, no one was injured. Another owner of a 2006 BMW 750 model pointed out that when he was parking his car on February 21, 2007, after pressing the engine stop button, the car should automatically change to a parking state, but after he got out of the car, it backed up about 100 feet and hit a lamp post. Afterwards, the dealer told the car owner that the cause of the failure could not be found. BMW spokesman Buchko said the company was cooperating with the authorities' investigation. NHTSA pointed out that the authority has upgraded the investigation to the engineering analysis stage to further evaluate the possible safety consequences of the defects complained by vehicle owners.

fafba53ce4ae10d48cf0af3ba72d5554e11961a8.sourceText: 江苏省(南京）夏令营招募海外华裔青少年 中国华文教育基金会 2012海外 华裔青少年南京文化行-金辉夏令营 【全美中文学校协会简讯】 今夏中国华文教育基金会将在江苏南京为海外华裔青少年举办夏令营。全美中文学校协会为这次的江苏夏令营，在全美组织华裔青少年的报名活动。 全美中文学校协会已向各会员学校发出通知，递交电子报名表格的截止日期为 4月30日 。本州几所中文学校已向家长转发通知，目前协会已收到一些中文学校家长的电邮为孩子申请报名。 这次夏令营的活动时间为7月29日至8月6日共九天。活动主要内容是学习中国传统文化（中国歌曲，剪纸，中国结，书法及中国武术等），所有的课程由优秀的专业教师任教。有的任教教师曾出版了相关的专业书籍，并在东南亚巡教时受到高度好评。营员在南京期间，还将参观游览江苏名胜古迹，体验当地生活。 江苏是经济文化教育大省，南京是历史文化名城。江苏夏令营将利用江苏省的各方面优势，为海外华裔青少年举办一系列有特色的活动。 营员在夏令营期间的食宿行费用由中国华文教育基金会赞助。从居住国至南京的往返旅费自理。营员需交$120报名费， 对营员的要求是品行端正，好学上进，身体健康，具有一定汉语基础且有较强生活自理能力的海外12周岁?8岁周岁的华裔青少年。 因名额有限，协会采用”先报名者优先”原则。 请有意参加此次活动的学校或家长，在4月30日前以电邮方式向全美中文学校协会副会长帅致若报名： maryshuai99@yahoo.com ，需要电子报名表格的家长，也请发邮件到上述邮址。 协会经办人收到电子报名表格后，将回复确认，并通知中文学校和家长汇寄须要签字的书面表格和报名支票。邮寄地址将另行通知。 协会接受各学校集体报名。报名超过10名以上的学校或地区可配备一名领队，领队由各校推荐校务人员或教师担任。全美中文学校协会将给领队人员一定的旅费补贴， 若有其它要求或建议，请于4月30日之前与全美中文学校协会副会长帅致若联系： maryshuai99@yahoo.com 。 中国华文教育基金会2012海外华裔青少年 南京文化行-金辉夏令营日程安排 日期 行程 地点 备注 第一天 07.29 全天报到 fafba53ce4ae10d48cf0af3ba72d5554e11961a8.translatedText: Jiangsu Province (Nanjing) Summer Camp Recruits Overseas Chinese Teenagers China Chinese Education Foundation 2012 Overseas Chinese Teenagers Nanjing Cultural Tour - Jinhui Summer Camp [Newsletter from the National Association of Chinese Schools] This summer, the China Chinese Education Foundation will hold a summer camp for overseas Chinese teenagers in Nanjing, Jiangsu. The National Association of Chinese Schools organized registration activities for Chinese teenagers across the United States for this Jiangsu summer camp. The National Association of Chinese Schools has issued a notice to all member schools that the deadline for submitting electronic registration forms is April 30. Several Chinese schools in the state have forwarded notices to parents. Currently, the association has received emails from parents of some Chinese schools to apply for registration for their children. The summer camp will last for nine days from July 29th to August 6th. The main content of the activity is to learn traditional Chinese culture (Chinese songs, paper-cutting, Chinese knots, calligraphy, Chinese martial arts, etc.). All courses are taught by excellent professional teachers. Some teachers have published relevant professional books and received high praise during their teaching tours in Southeast Asia. During their stay in Nanjing, campers will also visit Jiangsu scenic spots and experience local life. Jiangsu is a major economic, cultural and educational province, and Nanjing is a famous historical and cultural city. Jiangsu Summer Camp will take advantage of the various advantages of Jiangsu Province to organize a series of unique activities for overseas Chinese teenagers. The campers’ food, accommodation and travel expenses during the summer camp are sponsored by the China Chinese Education Foundation. You are responsible for the round-trip travel expenses from your country of residence to Nanjing. Campers need to pay a registration fee of $120. The requirements for campers are overseas Chinese teenagers between the ages of 12 and 8 who have good conduct, are studious and motivated, are in good health, have a certain foundation in Chinese and have strong self-care abilities. Due to limited places, the association adopts the principle of "first come first served". Schools or parents who are interested in participating in this event are asked to register by email to Shuai Zhiruo, Vice President of the National Association of Chinese Schools, before April 30: maryshuai99@yahoo.com. Parents who need electronic registration forms, please also send an email to the above email address. After receiving the electronic registration form, the association manager will reply to confirm and notify the Chinese school and parents to remit the written form and registration check that require signatures. The mailing address will be notified separately. The association accepts collective registration from all schools. Schools or regions with more than 10 registrations can be assigned a team leader, who will be a school administrator or teacher recommended by each school. The National Association of Chinese Schools will provide certain travel subsidies to the team leaders. If you have other requirements or suggestions, please contact Shuai Zhiruo, Vice President of the National Association of Chinese Schools, before April 30: maryshuai99@yahoo.com.
