93c2c152629aac6767228f15b9b32a2d345f6d9d.sourceText: 美莎夫妇摇老虎机赢了570万 （亚省时报） 一个真正暴富故事－两个人到赌场试运气，扔夸特(Quarter)咬老虎机，一个没中，几十数百都没中，最后一个中了，还是大奖，570万。 美莎的金伯莉和杰拉尔德菲利普过去的日子一直过得紧巴巴，他们和11岁的儿子挤在一个房间公寓里，他们需要坐公车去上班，为了报税手续费，杰拉尔德去Casino Arizona赌场玩幸运轮试试手气，最后赢了570万大奖。 得奖后一家子生活没什么变化，除了给儿子买了只蜥蜴当宠物，杰拉尔德买了一辆卡车代步，金伯莉还是一如既往去二手商店购物。他们说还要继续工作。
93c2c152629aac6767228f15b9b32a2d345f6d9d.translatedText: Mesa and his wife won $5.7 million by playing the slot machine (Alberta Times) A ​​real story of getting rich - two people went to the casino to try their luck, threw quarters and bit the slot machine. One of them missed, dozens of hundreds missed, but the last one won, and still won the grand prize, 5.7 million. Kimberly and Gerald Phillip of Mesa have been living a tight life in the past. They squeezed into a one-room apartment with their 11-year-old son. They had to take the bus to work. To pay for tax filing fees, Gerald went to the Casino Arizona to try his luck playing the Lucky Wheel, and finally won a $5.7 million jackpot. After winning the award, the family's life has not changed much. Apart from buying a lizard for his son as a pet, Gerald bought a truck for transportation, and Kimberly went shopping at second-hand stores as usual. They said they had to keep working.

113bddc450646386b57d15477ba32e67ff156383.sourceText: AA496气流颠簸 4乘客送医 全美航空公司上周末才凤凰城飞往丹佛的496航班，遭受剧烈”震荡”后，造成4人受伤送医院救治。 据全美航空(AA)公司发言人说，两名乘客和两名空服员受伤，其中一名空姐被脱落的天花板砸伤，遭受骨折。伤者伤势稳定，一名乘客和一名空服员在周一已出院。 发言人也证实国家运输安全委员会正调查这一事件。全民航空提醒搭乘飞机的旅客，全程系好安全带非常有必要。
113bddc450646386b57d15477ba32e67ff156383.translatedText: AA496 airflow turbulence sent 4 passengers to hospital. US Airways flight 496 from Phoenix to Denver suffered a severe "concussion" last weekend, causing four people to be injured and sent to the hospital for treatment. Two passengers and two flight attendants were injured, including one who was hit by a falling ceiling and suffered a broken bone, a US Airways spokesman said. The injured were in stable condition and one passenger and one flight attendant were discharged from hospital on Monday. A spokesman also confirmed that the National Transportation Safety Board is investigating the incident. QIA reminds passengers taking flights that it is very necessary to fasten seat belts at all times.

91243985bc9016b1b9088d45706ea8978c0a2337.sourceText: FBI的通缉犯 可能藏在佩森 （亚省时报） 联邦调查局发出警告，2001年在斯格思岱市犯下谋杀案的嫌疑人罗伯特费舍尔，可能藏在本州北部的佩森地区。 当局一直在追捕费舍尔，因为他的妻子和两个孩子于2001年4月10日被发现倒闭家中。证据显示费舍尔割破他家人的喉咙，打爆妻子的头部，并烧毁他们的房子来掩饰罪证。10天后，费舍尔妻子的SUV在佩森外的山区被发现，车里还有他家的宠物狗。 12年来，FBI一直没有找到费舍尔的踪迹，费舍尔也因此上了联邦十大通缉犯的名单。近日由银行摄影监控发现，一名貌似费舍尔的男子，在佩森附近使用银行柜员机。FBI呼吁民众，如有通缉犯消息，请即报警 。
91243985bc9016b1b9088d45706ea8978c0a2337.translatedText: FBI's most wanted man may be hiding in Payson (Alberta Times) The FBI has issued a warning that Robert Fisher, the suspect who committed a murder in Scottsdale in 2001, may be hiding in Payson in the northern part of the state. Authorities have been hunting Fisher since his wife and two children were found inside their collapsed home on April 10, 2001. Evidence showed Fisher slit his family's throats, blasted his wife's head and burned down their house to hide the evidence. Ten days later, Fisher's wife's SUV was found in the mountains outside Payson, with his family's pet dog inside. For 12 years, the FBI has not found any trace of Fisher, and Fisher has been on the federal list of the ten most wanted fugitives. Recently, bank camera surveillance discovered a man who looked like Fisher using a bank teller machine near Payson. The FBI urges the public to call police if you have information about a wanted suspect.

22e0154defc7ed11efb471c581f6c3d516a04c15.sourceText: 大溪谷国家公园官员说，通往大峡谷北缘的主要道路，将于5月15日重新开放，标志着大峡谷夏天旅游旺季正式到来。 5月15日同时开放的还有北缘的大峡谷旅馆和北缘的其他设施，如露营场地，餐饮服务，食品和礼品店，服务站等。 亚利桑那67号公路通往北缘的道路通常在每年冬季的11月下旬关闭，大多数设施在10月15日关闭，今年预定关闭时间也同往年一样，也就是说，大峡谷北缘每年只开放5个月时间，而较受欢迎的南源路线则全年开放。
22e0154defc7ed11efb471c581f6c3d516a04c15.translatedText: Grand Canyon National Park officials said that the main road leading to the North Rim of the Grand Canyon will reopen on May 15th, marking the official arrival of the Grand Canyon's summer tourist season. Also opening on May 15 will be the Grand Canyon Lodge on the North Rim and other facilities on the North Rim, such as camping sites, dining services, food and gift shops, service stations, etc. Arizona Highway 67's road to the North Rim is usually closed in late November each winter, with most facilities closed on October 15. This year's scheduled closure time is the same as in previous years, which means that the North Rim of the Grand Canyon is only open for 5 months each year, while the more popular South Source route is open year-round.

However, market research in the first quarter of 2012 showed that food prices in the state increased by 6% compared with the same period last year. Nationwide, food prices rose 7% year-on-year. The Agriculture Bureau said that this season is a good time to save money by cooking at home and buying fruits and vegetables.

According to the Washington Post, the most popular governors include Virginia Gov. Bob McDonnell, Montana Gov. Brian Swetzhal, New Mexico Gov. Susana Martinez, Nevada Gov. Brian Sandoval, Colorado Gov. John Hickenlooper, Arkansas Gov. Mike Beebe, New Hampshire Gov. John Lynch, Indiana Gov. Mitch Daniels, New Jersey Gov. Chris Christie, and New York Gov. Andrew Mocco. 46b5d7e2d153cdb4c2c2ead32d8838d9d85ae791.translatedText: Performance content: Yo-Yo Ma, a cello master who has been famous in the world music scene for many years, pianist Kathryn Stott and South American guitarist The Assad Brothers will bring unusual classic music at 7:30 pm on April 22 at the Mesa Arts Center. Please don't miss this unique live concert.

fbc1fc3bbb5bb1d4e86ba82cd59778f92c71a718.sourceText: 作为15次获得格莱美奖的大提琴演奏家，马友友一直希望通过与不同文化之间的合作，探索一条突破传统西方古典音乐的道路。马友友这次与英国钢琴家Kathryn Stott的联袂演奏，不再是简单的伴奏关系，而是通过分享音乐制作理念之后一次充满能量的合作。Assad Brothers则会为此次演奏注入充满艺术创新的巴西音乐元素。
fbc1fc3bbb5bb1d4e86ba82cd59778f92c71a718.translatedText: As a 15-time Grammy Award-winning cellist, Yo-Yo Ma has always hoped to explore a way to break through traditional Western classical music through cooperation with different cultures. Yo-Yo Ma's joint performance with British pianist Kathryn Stott is no longer a simple accompaniment relationship, but an energetic collaboration through sharing music production concepts. The Assad Brothers will inject Brazilian music elements full of artistic innovation into this performance.

c903f02f1f3db64a22db1defa68b4a6016f1287c.translatedText: (Alberta Times reporter Zhen Songwei reported in Los Angeles)

40d200497c63183a399ff7a3bea26505011a1c99.sourceText: 北美华人新移民越来越多，尤是南加州是美国华人众多，也是新移民的首选，洛杉矶也是美国西岸主要商贸文化中心，华人人口超过80万，超过十万户华人家庭，UHF数字电视覆盖整个南加州地区达1300万人口。该地区也就成为了华语电视媒体竞争激烈的地方，中国大陆，台湾，香港的电视台陆续登陆南加州洛杉矶。除了开播十几年从每天几小时到全天的洛城电视（LA18.8）以外，近年陆续落户洛杉矶的UHF免费数字电视有27.3NEXTTV壹电视美洲台，31.4GDTV广东国际美洲台，31.5天下卫视，31.7TBWTV世界电视，31.8银视数码台（播放CCTV 4 频道），31.9播放CCTV 9 ，31.10泰山电视，57.9 ZWTV中旺电视，44.6 ICN 国际卫视，44.7唐人电视。
40d200497c63183a399ff7a3bea26505011a1c99.translatedText: There are more and more new Chinese immigrants in North America, especially Southern California, which has a large number of Chinese in the United States and is the first choice for new immigrants. Los Angeles is also a major commercial and cultural center on the West Coast of the United States. The Chinese population exceeds 800,000 and there are more than 100,000 Chinese households. UHF digital TV covers the entire Southern California area with a population of 13 million. This area has become a place of fierce competition for Chinese-language television media. TV stations from mainland China, Taiwan, and Hong Kong have successively landed in Los Angeles, Southern California. In addition to Los Angeles TV (LA18.8), which has been broadcasting from a few hours a day to all day long for more than ten years, UHF free digital TVs that have settled in Los Angeles in recent years include 27.3NEXTTV One TV America, 31.4GDTV Guangdong International America, 31.5 Tianxia TV, 31.7TBWTV World TV, 31.8 Silver TV Digital Station (playing CCTV 4 channel), 31.9 broadcasting CCTV 9 , 31.10 Taishan TV, 57.9 ZWTV Zhongwang TV, 44.6 ICN International Satellite TV, 44.7 Tangren TV.

6727b9dab2a949810544ad3df0a801dfb8c83da8.sourceText: 44.8 ICN 国际卫视英文频道，44.9 G&E 环球东方，62.2 HTTV 汉天电视，62.6 超视等24小时连续播放的免费数字电视。过去华侨华人要观看华语中文电视，一定要安装月月交费的有线电视或者安装每月交费的卫星电视，随着越来越多的华语中文电视的登陆洛杉矶，让华侨华人多了选择，也更加丰富了华人日常娱乐生活的多元化，只要家裡是数码电视机或者加装数码转换盒，就能随意收看这些免费的华语中文电视节目。
6727b9dab2a949810544ad3df0a801dfb8c83da8.translatedText: 44.8 ICN International Satellite TV English Channel, 44.9 G&E Global Oriental, 62.2 HTTV Hantian TV, 62.6 Supervision and other 24-hour free digital TV. In the past, overseas Chinese had to install a monthly paid cable TV or a monthly paid satellite TV to watch Chinese-language TV. As more and more Chinese-language TVs are launched in Los Angeles, the overseas Chinese have more choices, which also enriches the diversity of Chinese daily entertainment life. As long as the home has a digital TV or a digital converter box, they can watch these free Chinese-language TV programs at will.

1c50a8b9f923fee27db4843e54e35056610c8261.sourceText: 今日，山东电视台国际频道，美国泰山国际传媒集团在洛杉矶举办泰山电视台新增无线数字频道31.4的新闻发布会，正式加入华语中文电视洛杉矶地区开播。泰山电视台，作为山东电视台的国际频道，是中国国家广播电视总局批准的在境外可以多种方式落地的省级电视媒体，成为华人了解山东，了解中国的重要信息平台，也是山东和世界，中国和世界交流互动的平台。泰山电视台每天除了推出一系列强档栏目，汇萃山东电视台各频道的热播节目，也播出在美国本地自办的节目，如黄金挡新闻栏目《美洲播报》，访谈专栏节目《美洲对话》，跨国互动节目《中美地带》等等。可以预计的是，随着中国在世界的影响力的不断加强，华人移民的不断增加，以后还会有更多的电视媒体登陆美国各地，丰富当地华侨华人的娱乐生活。
1c50a8b9f923fee27db4843e54e35056610c8261.translatedText: Today, Shandong TV International Channel and American Taishan International Media Group held a press conference in Los Angeles for Taishan TV’s new wireless digital channel 31.4, officially joining the Chinese-language TV broadcast in the Los Angeles area. Taishan TV, as the international channel of Shandong TV, is a provincial-level TV media approved by the State Administration of Radio and Television of China that can be deployed overseas in various ways. It has become an important information platform for Chinese people to understand Shandong and China. It is also a platform for exchanges and interactions between Shandong and the world, and between China and the world. In addition to launching a series of strong columns every day, Taishan TV collects popular programs from various channels of Shandong TV, and also broadcasts self-produced programs in the United States, such as the prime time news column "American Broadcast", the interview column program "American Dialogue", the cross-border interactive program "China-America Zone" and so on. It can be expected that as China's influence in the world continues to strengthen and the number of Chinese immigrants continues to increase, more TV media will land in various parts of the United States to enrich the entertainment life of local overseas Chinese.

faba895e90ffd935da191b8b2ed04e2781b9c25a.sourceText: 福特在美召回逾14万辆Focus 据美国安全监管机构表示，福特汽车将在美国召回140,310辆2012年款式的Focus汽车，因为乘客侧的雨刷马达需要修理。 据国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）提供的文件显示，雨刷马达少了一个密封塞，让水可以进入马达的电气连接处，可以造成雨刷失效，导致能见度降低，并增加撞车的风险。 福特表示，目前没有因为此问题造成任何意外或受伤。NHTSA说，福特预备在5月21日的那一週通知业主，雨刷马达要清理和密封。 在另外的NHTSA的文件中，克莱斯勒汽车将召回1,689辆2012年的吉普爱国者（Jeep Patriot）和罗盘（Compass）越野车，因为汽车的油箱系统含有一损坏了的活门 。NHTSA说，在发生事故或侧翻时，燃油可能洩漏，增加了火灾的危险。 克莱斯勒表示，目前没有任何意外事故，洩漏，火灾或受伤是与此问题有关的。此次召回预计会在六月开始。
faba895e90ffd935da191b8b2ed04e2781b9c25a.translatedText: Ford is recalling more than 140,000 Focus vehicles in the U.S. Ford Motor Co. is recalling 140,310 2012 model Focus vehicles in the United States because the passenger-side wiper motor needs repair, according to U.S. safety regulators. According to documents provided by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), the wiper motor is missing a sealing plug, allowing water to enter the motor's electrical connection, which can cause the wiper to fail, reduce visibility, and increase the risk of a crash. Ford said there have been no accidents or injuries related to the issue. NHTSA said Ford plans to notify owners the week of May 21 that the wiper motors need to be cleaned and sealed. In a separate NHTSA filing, Chrysler will recall 1,689 2012 Jeep Patriot and Compass SUVs because the vehicle's fuel tank system contains a damaged valve. In the event of an accident or rollover, fuel can leak, increasing the risk of fire, NHTSA said. Chrysler says there are currently no accidents, leaks, fires or injuries related to this issue. The recall is expected to begin in June.

US telecommunications companies are working on developing a database of stolen mobile phones, a move that is part of the latest efforts to curb the theft of mobile phones...

9c8e46f209cbf591566d9f2765fc891930c4ec03.sourceText: 电信公司力阻被盗手机再度使用 美国电信公司正在着手制定被盗窃手机的数据库，此举是为了遏制盗窃手机所采取的最新行动的一部分。 手机在美国广泛使用，但是在这个全球最大的经济体，盗窃价格昂贵的手提通讯设备的罪行日渐增长。美国政府的联邦通讯委员会表示，已经与几家大型无线通讯运营商达成协议，制定一个被盗手机的数据库，最终阻止被盗手机再度使用。 联邦通讯委员会主席格纳考斯基说，该机构正寻求”降低被盗智能手机的价值”。 目前，两个最大的手机运营商 Verizon 和Spint Nextel已经阻止被盗手机重新启动，但是，另外两家公司AT&T 和德意志电信的T-Mobile还没有采取行动。不过，所有四家公司都同意了上述的反盗窃计划。 未来6个月内，上述运营商都将阻止被盗手机在其网络重新使用。目标是18个月后，阻止被盗手机在任何通讯网络上重新工作。
9c8e46f209cbf591566d9f2765fc891930c4ec03.translatedText: Telecommunications companies are trying to prevent the reuse of stolen mobile phones. US telecommunications companies are working on developing a database of stolen mobile phones, a move that is part of the latest efforts to curb theft of mobile phones. Cellphones are widely used in the United States, but the crime of stealing expensive handheld communication devices is growing in the world's largest economy. The U.S. government's Federal Communications Commission said it has reached an agreement with several large wireless communications operators to develop a database of stolen mobile phones to ultimately prevent stolen phones from being used again. FCC Chairman Genakowski said the agency is seeking to "reduce the value of stolen smartphones." Verizon and Spint Nextel, the two largest cell phone carriers, have stopped stolen phones from being rebooted, but the other two companies, AT&T and Deutsche Telekom's T-Mobile, have not yet taken action. However, all four companies agreed to the anti-theft plan described above. Within the next six months, the above-mentioned operators will prevent stolen mobile phones from being re-used on their networks. The goal is to prevent stolen phones from working again on any communications network after 18 months.

f871f22dfafbc1a37a1224a9d8867161be78625b.sourceText: 儿童意外死亡人数 10年降29% 联邦疾病防治中心(CDC)16日提出研究报告说，过去十年美国19岁以下儿童和青少年意外死亡人数降低29%，从每年大约1万2400人减至大约9100人，可是婴儿窒息死亡和青少年中毒死亡率提高。 意外受伤致死仍为19岁以下孩子最主要的死因，平均每小时就有一个人因火灾、跌倒和其他意外丧生。 每年意外死亡的儿童，有一半以上是因车祸丧命，而2000年至2009年意外死亡儿童减少，与车祸死亡人数剧降41%很有关係。 有关官员认为车祸死者减少，与儿童安全座椅改进，以及对青少年驾驶人加强训练有关。儿童因溺水、火灾和跌倒而死亡的人数也大减。 不过，与2000年相比，2009年15到19岁孩子中毒死亡人数暴增91%，主要是服用处方药过量致死。美国整个人口群也有同样趋势。 2009年有824名儿童和青少年意外中毒死亡，其中一半以上是15岁到19岁的年轻人。CDC说，一些孩子似乎用处方药取代大麻追求快感，而且有些人是偷吃父母的药物。 2009年有1160个儿童窒息死亡，比2000年增加54%，其中大约1000人是不满一岁的婴儿。 CDC再度呼吁父母让婴儿仰卧睡觉、拿开鬆脱的被褥和柔软玩具，并採取其他步骤加强婴儿床和睡眠地方的安全。 研究报告发现美国每一州儿童意外死亡人数都下降，德拉瓦、爱阿华、俄勒冈和维吉尼亚州降幅最大。死亡率最高的仍然是密西西比州，2009年19岁以下的孩子每10万人就有25人意外死亡，死亡率最低的麻州每10万人只有四人死亡。
f871f22dfafbc1a37a1224a9d8867161be78625b.translatedText: The number of accidental deaths among children has dropped by 29% in 10 years. The federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) reported on the 16th that the number of accidental deaths among children and adolescents under the age of 19 in the United States has decreased by 29% in the past decade, from approximately 12,400 to approximately 9,100 per year. However, the death rates from infant suffocation and adolescent poisoning have increased. Accidental injury remains the leading cause of death for children under 19, with one person killed every hour due to fires, falls and other accidents. More than half of the children who die accidentally every year are killed in car accidents. The decrease in accidental death of children from 2000 to 2009 is closely related to the 41% drop in the number of car accident deaths. Officials believe the decrease in car accident deaths is related to improved child safety seats and enhanced training for teenage drivers. Child deaths from drowning, fires and falls have also dropped significantly. However, compared with 2000, the number of poisoning deaths among children aged 15 to 19 increased by 91% in 2009, mainly due to overdose of prescription drugs. The same trend is seen across the U.S. population as a whole. In 2009, 824 children and teenagers died from accidental poisoning, more than half of whom were young people aged 15 to 19. The CDC says some children appear to be using prescription drugs instead of marijuana to get high, and some are stealing their parents' drugs. In 2009, 1,160 children died of suffocation, a 54% increase from 2000, of which approximately 1,000 were infants under one year old. The CDC reiterates its call for parents to place babies on their backs to sleep, remove loose bedding and soft toys, and take other steps to make cribs and sleeping areas safer. The study found that accidental child deaths fell in every U.S. state, with the largest declines occurring in Delaware, Iowa, Oregon and Virginia. Mississippi still has the highest death rate, with 25 accidental deaths per 100,000 children under the age of 19 in 2009, while Massachusetts has the lowest death rate, with only four deaths per 100,000 people.

a7a67411383cc22daadb86a2deed8887e1ea57e5.sourceText: 5月13日是母亲节，在母亲节主日崇拜以后，于下午1:30在教会大堂，举行了盛大的中文学校2012年结业典礼。 能容纳500多人的大堂内，坐满了中文学校的学生和家长。 学生们个个欢欣雀跃、家长们欣喜等待结业典礼的开始。 结业典礼由梁绍伟夫妇二人主持，当主持人宣布结业典礼开始后，首先请教会杨牧师为典礼祝祷，并由杨牧师向二十位优秀学生颁发〝成绩特优奖〞。 然后开始了天真可爱、活泼热情的学生们表演各式各样的文娱节目。 中文学校共有29个班级，每个班级都精心准备了文娱节目，像中简五班同学表演的朗读〝三字经〞并演唱一首〝春天在哪里？〞，这些学生真不简单，用 标准的国语，清清脆脆的童声，三字一句字正腔圆，听得心里美滋滋的，有这样的成绩，老师和学生都下了大功夫。 动听的童声合唱〝春天在哪里？〞更是美妙的天籁之歌声，打动着每一个人的心。 唱游班的小同学为大家献上一首风趣动听的〝萤火虫〞歌曲。 儿童舞蹈〝茉莉花〞；正体二班的同学们，自编话剧〝北风与太阳〞，能编排如此寓意深刻的话剧，令人刮目相看这些有神恩赐的孩子们，将来必能在文学创作领域 大展宏图，独领风骚！ 中简三班同学们表演的儿童诗歌〝让赞美飞扬〞，学前注音班的小朋友表演的〝青蛙〞和〝颜色歌〞，更是引人入胜、风趣可爱；中正五班梁嘉恩同学自己作曲的钢琴演奏； 中简4班同学表演唐诗背诵可棒了，抑扬顿挫的古诗朗诵很有韵味！ 简直就像涓涓泉水、清脆悦耳像唱歌一样，一首接一首使听得人陶醉其中；青少年舞蹈班表演的〝凤阳花鼓〞，小女孩们手持红绸，随着欢快的音乐翩翩起 舞，表现出孩童的天真烂漫、幸福快乐；最后一个节目是由正体五班、七班、八班和AP班联合表演的〝游子吟〞和〝中国话〞，风趣可爱，吸引孩子们对中国 话的性趣和热爱。 节目中间串插有中文学校李珍校长的致词，她向全体老师和同工们致谢，感谢他(她) 们在这一年的辛勤付出，祝贺学生们取得优秀的学习成绩，勉力学生们在 假期，不要忘记说中文,读中文,写中文, 并欢迎大家上GPCCS.org中文学校网页流缆查看中文学年校刊和学校动态。 在典礼文娱节目中还设有TRIVIA问题抢荅和由潘震宇董事，给中文作文比赛优秀得奖的19名学生颁奖。 文娱节目在全场欢声笑语中结束，学生们高高兴兴、三五成群地飞快涌向奖品区领奖，对自己一年的辛勤学习，有个美好的奖赏。 凤凰城华人基督教会中文学校成立于1983年，至今已有29年的历史，是一个非营利组织学校。 目前学校设有正体班8个、简体班7个、双语班3个、会话班1个、中文AT班1个、课后活动班中有2个舞蹈班, 1个绘画班和电脑班、 唱游班，学前注音班1个、进阶注音班1个、中简启蒙班1个、双语基础班1个等共有29个班级250多位学生。 办校宗旨是教导学生学习中文及中国传统文化以外，并融和基督博爱真理来培养学生健全品格。 而教师专业化、教材系统化、教学趣味化、学校社区化、家长参与化一直是学校多年来努力的目标。 该校的电脑教室,图书馆为学生们学习中文提供了更多地帮助。 该校老师、同工皆本着荣神益人、传扬中华文化为心志。 聘任的老师和助教均是具有爱心、服务热忱、肯牺牲奉献，志同道合的伙伴。 本年度校长李珍校长，在中文学校执教9年，去年2011年度，是第一次荣任中文学校校长，在李珍校长的领导下，中文学校2011-2012学年度，大力开展各项工作，取得不寻常 的业绩。 盼望凤凰城基督教会中文学校越办越好，欢迎对传扬中华文化有责任感的有志之士，到中文学校与全体同工同心协力办好学！
a7a67411383cc22daadb86a2deed8887e1ea57e5.translatedText: May 13th is Mother’s Day. After the Mother’s Day Sunday service, a grand Chinese School 2012 graduation ceremony was held in the church lobby at 1:30 pm. The lobby, which can accommodate more than 500 people, was filled with students and parents from Chinese schools. The students were all excited and the parents were eagerly waiting for the graduation ceremony to begin. The graduation ceremony was hosted by Mr. and Mrs. Liang Shaowei. When the host announced the commencement of the graduation ceremony, he first asked Pastor Yang of the church to pray for the ceremony, and Pastor Yang awarded "Excellent Achievement Awards" to twenty outstanding students. Then the innocent, cute, lively and enthusiastic students began to perform various entertainment programs. There are 29 classes in the Chinese school, and each class has carefully prepared entertainment programs. For example, the fifth class of Chinese-Simplified Chinese students performed a recitation of the "Three Character Classic" and sang a song "Where is the Spring?" The beautiful children's chorus "Where is the Spring?" is a beautiful song of nature that touches everyone's heart. The young students from the singing class performed a funny and beautiful song "Fireflies" for everyone. Children's dance "Jasmine"; students from the second formal class wrote their own drama "The North Wind and the Sun". They were able to choreograph such a profound drama, which is impressive. These children who are gifted by God will surely make great achievements in the field of literary creation and lead the way in the future! The children's poem "Let Praises Fly" performed by the students of Class 3 of Simplified Chinese and Simplified Chinese. The children of the preschool phonetic class performed "Frog" and "Color Song", which were even more fascinating, funny and cute; the piano performance composed by Liang Jiaen of Class 5 of Simplified Chinese and Simplified Chinese; and the recital of Tang poems performed by the students of Class 4 of Simplified Chinese and Simplified Chinese were great, and the ups and downs of ancient poems recited were very charming! Just like trickling spring water, crisp and sweet, like singing, one song after another makes people intoxicated; the youth dance class performed "Fengyang Flower Drum", the little girls held red silk and danced to the cheerful music Dance, showing children's innocence, happiness and joy; the last program is "Wandering Zi Yin" and "Chinese Language" jointly performed by Classes 5, 7, 8 and AP Class, which are funny and cute, attracting children's interest and love for Chinese. The program was interspersed with a speech by the principal of the Chinese school, Li Zhen. She thanked all the teachers and colleagues for their hard work this year, congratulated the students on their excellent academic performance, and encouraged the students not to forget to speak Chinese, read Chinese, and write Chinese during the holidays. She also welcomed everyone to go to the GPCCS.org Chinese school webpage to view the Chinese annual school magazine and school news. The entertainment program at the ceremony also included a TRIVIA question quiz and Director Pan Zhenyu presented awards to the 19 outstanding students in the Chinese composition competition. The entertainment program ended with laughter and laughter from the audience. The students happily rushed to the prize area in small groups to receive their awards, which was a wonderful reward for their hard work for a year. Phoenix Chinese Christian Church Chinese School was established in 1983 and has a history of 29 years. It is a non-profit organization school. At present, the school has 8 traditional Chinese classes, 7 simplified Chinese classes, 3 bilingual classes, 1 conversational class, 1 Chinese AT class, after-school activity classes including 2 dance classes, 1 painting class, computer class, singing class, 1 pre-school phonetic class, 1 advanced phonetic class, 1 Chinese-Simplified enlightenment class, 1 basic bilingual class, etc. There are a total of 29 classes with more than 250 students. The purpose of the school is to teach students to learn Chinese and traditional Chinese culture, and to integrate the truth of Christian love to cultivate students' sound character. The professionalization of teachers, systematization of teaching materials, fun teaching, school communityization, and parent participation have been the goals that the school has been striving for for many years. The school's computer classroom and library provide more help for students to learn Chinese. The teachers and co-workers of the school all have the ambition to glorify God, benefit people, and spread Chinese culture. The teachers and teaching assistants hired are caring, dedicated, willing to sacrifice and like-minded partners. This year’s principal, Principal Li Zhen, has taught in Chinese schools for 9 years. Last year in 2011, he was appointed as the principal of a Chinese school for the first time. Under the leadership of Principal Li Zhen, the Chinese school vigorously carried out various tasks in the 2011-2012 school year and achieved unusual results. I hope that Phoenix Christian Church Chinese School will get better and better. We welcome people with lofty ideals who have a sense of responsibility for spreading Chinese culture to come to the Chinese school and work together with all the co-workers to run a good school!

fd7b8696f52345b61d0dd9bac039c91558b606de.sourceText: 1.作家沈宁谈’民国’ ”’民国”这两个字，实在是中国人心里最复杂的一个字眼。很多年中，隔着那艘”南湖”里的红船，”民国”的历史就藏在那烟雨苍茫之中。如今，共和国的岁月已过了甲子之年，关于”民国”的记忆却越发地鲜亮起来。人们开始怀想民国，不仅仅是民国璀璨的文学，还有民国的文化，尤其是那些民国里的人物。出生于1947年的作家沈宁，幽默地说自己是民国人，5月5日他将到凤凰城与大家谈谈心中的的”民国”。本活动由国民党亚利桑那直属分部，亚省时报，新东方艺术学校，”太阳鸟”亚利桑那华人网，亚利桑那作家协会，亚利桑那笔会联合主办。’ 详情: http://www.sunbirdarizona.com/News-Detail.asp?keyno=2597

1f9dfc863d2d7f3a72a66e4e1a6de85795cb15f2.sourceText: 专家提醒开车人：报税日车祸多 据《今日美国》报道，开车人赶在截至时刻之前匆忙前往邮局也许是原因之一。研究人员说，也可能是报税压力分散开车人的注意力，造成人为的错误。 他们查看了30年的数据，发现报税日共有6,783起车祸死亡，平均每天226起。相比之下，截至日期先后一个星期平均每天213起。 通常都是4月15日的报税日车祸死亡比4月其它日子的车祸死亡人数高出6%。报告作者雷德密尔说，一天增加13起死亡事故相当于社会一年4000万美元的损失。那种估计包括生命损失、受伤和财产损失。 研究人员分析了国家高速交通安全局的数据。研究结果星期三发表在《美国医疗协会杂志》上。 公路安全保险研究所发言人拉德说，更多开车人上路和更多人跑在不是每天都走的路线上也许是报税日风险大的原因。其它研究说，酗酒也许增加其它节日的死亡事故，比如超级杯星期天、7月4日和选举日。
1f9dfc863d2d7f3a72a66e4e1a6de85795cb15f2.translatedText: Experts remind drivers: There are many car accidents on tax day. According to "USA Today", drivers rushing to the post office before the deadline may be one of the reasons. Researchers say it's also possible that the stress of filing taxes distracts drivers, causing human error. They looked at 30 years of data and found there were 6,783 crash fatalities on tax day, an average of 226 per day. This compares to an average of 213 starts per day in the week leading up to the date. Typically, the number of car crash deaths on tax day, April 15, is 6% higher than the number of car crash deaths on other days in April. Report author Redmire said that an additional 13 fatal accidents a day would cost society $40 million a year. That estimate includes loss of life, injuries and property damage. The researchers analyzed data from the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration. The findings were published Wednesday in the Journal of the American Medical Association. More drivers on the road and more people taking routes they don't take every day may be why tax day is risky, said Rudd, a spokesman for the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety. Other studies say binge drinking may increase deaths on other holidays, such as Super Bowl Sunday, the Fourth of July and Election Day.

4b47b88f971d25cc4bb9d994d5730b3871a1f593.sourceText: 方励之丧礼于周六下午4时（香港时间昨晨 7时），在图桑市的东一墓园举行。下午 2时多，方在亚利桑那大学的同事、学生陆续到场，还有不少是从中国大陆、台湾以及美国其他地方赶来的学生、现今天文物理学研究领域的领军人物。下午 3时礼堂开放，吊唁者签名入内，排成两行瞻仰遗容，依序鞠躬。方先生躺在花篮簇拥的棺木中，面容安详。礼堂内外摆放着数十个花篮，署名有亲戚朋友、有「六四」时的学生、民运人士、北京大学部份教职员工；最多的还是中国科学技术大学校友。
4b47b88f971d25cc4bb9d994d5730b3871a1f593.translatedText: Fang Lizhi's funeral was held at 4 pm on Saturday (7 o'clock yesterday morning, Hong Kong time) at Dongyi Cemetery in Tucson City. At around 2 p.m., Fang’s colleagues and students from the University of Arizona arrived one after another. Many of them were students from mainland China, Taiwan and other places in the United States, and are now leaders in the field of astrophysics research. The auditorium opened at 3 p.m., and condolences signed in, lined up in two rows to pay homage to the remains, and bowed in order. Mr. Fang was lying in a coffin surrounded by flower baskets, with a peaceful face. Dozens of flower baskets were placed inside and outside the auditorium, signed by relatives and friends, students from the June Fourth Movement, pro-democracy activists, and some faculty and staff of Peking University; the largest number were alumni of the University of Science and Technology of China.

4978c84441162b1fc21a444d1e9675828416c1bc.sourceText: 方励之儿子方克称，父亲为他创造快乐童年。 妻：失去他是一生最痛 家属此次治丧低调，仅靠邮件进行私下邀请，直到当天才在亚利桑那州地方报纸刊登讣告，公告丧礼的时间地点。尽管如此，礼堂座无虚席，另闢的房间也坐满了人。下午 3时 30分，方励之遗孀李淑娴由王丹搀扶入场。 「他是我的丈夫、我的爱人、我的灵魂、我的心……你安息吧，我亲爱的。」李淑娴的深情表白令在座者无不动容。她回顾了在动荡的时代两人历经艰辛却充满甜蜜的爱情，回首一生，李说：「他生而有幸，一生做自己愿意且喜欢的事情，科学的、人文的、政治的，不计对自己带来的后果。我有幸与他相识相爱相守，共度风雨，生死与共，不枉此生，如今过早失去他是我一生最大的痛。」 「亲爱的小哥，我们永远爱你怀念你。」么妹方平之代表其馀三兄姐从大陆来美国参加丧礼。 20多年来，除了这位妹妹 08年曾到美国见过方励之一面，哥哥、姐姐则因年迈无法赴美，生死永隔。方励之长子方克表示，父亲电脑的背景图是北京颐和园的照片，是当年他们一家四口常常游玩之处。忆起父亲教他欣赏自然之美、自製收音机等，在那个物质贫乏、政治动荡的岁月里为他创造快乐的童年，令他深以父亲为傲。
4978c84441162b1fc21a444d1e9675828416c1bc.translatedText: Fang Liz’s son Fang Ke said that his father created a happy childhood for him. Wife: Losing him is the most painful thing in life. The family held the funeral in a low-key manner and only relied on private invitations via email. It was not until the same day that they published an obituary in a local newspaper in Arizona to announce the time and place of the funeral. Despite this, the auditorium was packed, and the separate room was also filled with people. At 3:30 pm, Fang Lizhi’s widow Li Shuxian entered the ceremony supported by Wang Dan. "He is my husband, my lover, my soul, my heart... Rest in peace, my dear." Li Shuxian's affectionate confession moved everyone present. She recalled the hardships but sweet love between the two in a turbulent era. Looking back on her life, Li said: "He was born lucky to do what he wanted and liked throughout his life, scientific, humanistic, and political, regardless of the consequences for himself. I was lucky enough to know him, fall in love with him, and live together through thick and thin, life and death. This life was not in vain. Losing him prematurely now is the biggest pain in my life." "Dear little brother, we will always love you and miss you." My sister Fang Pingzhi came to the United States from mainland China to attend the funeral on behalf of the other three brothers and sisters. Over the past 20 years, except for this sister who went to the United States to meet Fang Lizhi once in 2008, my brother and sister were unable to go to the United States due to their old age, and they were separated forever. Fang Lizhi's eldest son, Fang Ke, said that the background image on his father's computer was a photo of the Summer Palace in Beijing, where his family of four often visited. He recalled that his father taught him to appreciate the beauty of nature, make his own radio, etc., and created a happy childhood for him in those years of material poverty and political turmoil, which made him deeply proud of his father.

bf51826a640e30ba5214eeae06df2ea16492d0f7.sourceText: 林培瑞（左一）与友人慰问方的遗孀李淑娴。
bf51826a640e30ba5214eeae06df2ea16492d0f7.translatedText: Lin Perry (first from left) and friends express condolences to Fang’s widow Li Shuxian.

2ca8eb13ff565e0a9bce8749889af02c367ec733.sourceText: 14日的丧礼，有近 300人出席。 学生戏称老师「方老邪」 方先生的学生休也上台分享与恩师点点滴滴。来自北京的冯博士是方励之 82年在科大带的研究生，近年与方励之合作发表了 40篇学术论文。他回忆当年学生戏称方励之「方老邪」，是认为方像金庸笔下的桃花岛主黄药师那权胸怀豁达。应邀在丧礼致词的嘉宾，多是学术界人士，八九学运领袖王丹属例外。他评价方励之是「政治上的审美者」，他引述方励之说：「对知识分子来说，关心社会是权利和义务！」 一名陈姓博士也在丧礼上回顾方励之八十年代的几句名言，如：「经济上是人民养活政府，而不是政府养活人民。」「除领导人个人的错误，共产制度本身恐怕也有缺陷。否则为甚麽那麽多人觉得在国外比较幸福？」丧礼进行了三个多小时，直到晚上 8时半弔唁者才离去。此外，香港支联会在昨早举行的毋忘六四长跑前，亦有向方励之默哀。
2ca8eb13ff565e0a9bce8749889af02c367ec733.translatedText: >The funeral on the 14th was attended by nearly 300 people. Students jokingly called their teacher "Fang Laoxie". Mr. Fang's student Xiu also came on stage to share his experiences with his teacher. Dr. Feng from Beijing was Fang Lizhi’s graduate student at HKUST in 1982. In recent years, he and Fang Lizhi published 40 academic papers. He recalled that his students jokingly called Fang Lizhi "Fang Laoxie" because they thought Fang was like Huang Yaoshi, the master of Peach Blossom Island in Jin Yong's novel, who was as open-minded and open-minded. Most of the guests invited to give speeches at the funeral were academics, with the exception of Wang Dan, the leader of the 1989 student movement. He commented that Fang Lizhi was a "political esthete." He quoted Fang Lizhi as saying: "For intellectuals, caring about society is a right and obligation!" A doctor surnamed Chen also recalled some of Fang Lizhi's famous sayings in the 1980s at the funeral, such as: "Economically, the people feed the government, not the government feeds the people." "In addition to the personal mistakes of the leaders, the communist system itself may also have flaws. Otherwise, why do so many people feel happier abroad?" The funeral lasted for more than three hours until the evening. The condolences left at half past eight. In addition, the Hong Kong Advocacy Association also paid a moment of silence to Fang Li before the Long-distance Run to Remember June 4th held yesterday morning.

e544306b8847c1733550721eb8c261ea82a6ca34.sourceText: 方励之事件簿 丧礼现场，家属展示方励之历年来拍摄的照片。
e544306b8847c1733550721eb8c261ea82a6ca34.translatedText: Fang Lizhi’s Event Book At the funeral site, family members showed photos taken by Fang Lizhi over the years.

92b40906469e75bf182f87dacb9d817234b23573.sourceText: 1986年任职中国科技大学副校长时，倡导推动学生民主运动。
92b40906469e75bf182f87dacb9d817234b23573.translatedText: When he served as vice president of the University of Science and Technology of China in 1986, he advocated and promoted the student democratic movement.

ea6b5f4e05f9ae75f2c007a55907fa42bfbdfbb5.sourceText: 1987年 1月，与时任《人民日报》记者刘宾雁、作家王若望，被邓小平点名开除出中共。
ea6b5f4e05f9ae75f2c007a55907fa42bfbdfbb5.translatedText: In January 1987, he was expelled from the CCP by Deng Xiaoping along with the then "People's Daily" reporter Liu Binyan and writer Wang Ruowang.

6f23254c4d2a1ff6af7a6b0ef4a3d4a49cb8a341.sourceText: 1989年春天，任北京天文台研究员期间，支持北京大学生民主运动，被誉八九学运精神领袖。
6f23254c4d2a1ff6af7a6b0ef4a3d4a49cb8a341.translatedText: In the spring of 1989, while serving as a researcher at the Beijing Observatory, he supported the Beijing student democratic movement and was hailed as the spiritual leader of the 1989 student movement.

3019cce820c0abf786f497a883c79259a114675a.sourceText: 1989年六四后被通缉，入美国驻华大使馆避难，一年后赴美。
3019cce820c0abf786f497a883c79259a114675a.translatedText: He was wanted after the Tiananmen Massacre in 1989 and took refuge in the U.S. Embassy in China. He went to the United States a year later.

0ac92640be57469867483844e0642c167d40dd79.sourceText: 1990年后，任教于美国亚利桑那大学物理系；其间关注中国人权事业。
0ac92640be57469867483844e0642c167d40dd79.translatedText: After 1990, he taught in the Department of Physics at the University of Arizona in the United States; during this period, he paid attention to the cause of human rights in China.

a2eba2b71b3bfa60a8421381461cf9a1768799f6.sourceText: 2012年 4月 6日，在亚利桑那州图桑市猝逝，终年 76岁。
a2eba2b71b3bfa60a8421381461cf9a1768799f6.translatedText: Died suddenly in Tucson, Arizona on April 6, 2012, at the age of 76.

3ae734834468b3026d406e7e240afcbf03795f89.sourceText: 女子因拨打911投诉警员而被捕 斯格思岱一女子投诉警员没有启用非紧急电话，而拨打了911。 警方的报告中说，上周六凌晨约5点，住在斯格思岱老城一座公寓大楼的浮士德女士和她的朋友喝醉了，勐敲她前男友家大门，说她的手机在里头。警员接获求助后到场，搜查公寓后没有发现手机，稍后警员要求浮士德离开。 浮士德认为警员对她无礼，直接拨打911紧急电话投诉。在亚利桑那州，非紧急情况拨打911电话是一种犯罪。911接线员对浮士德解释后，她仍然坚持她的投诉。于是接线员让浮士德报上地址后挂断电话，直接通知在场警员将酗酒的浮士德逮捕。 浮士德女士滥用911可导致750元罚款和长达4个月的监禁。
3ae734834468b3026d406e7e240afcbf03795f89.translatedText: Woman arrested for calling 911 to complain about police officers A Scottsdale woman complained that police officers did not activate the non-emergency line and called 911. The police report said that at about 5 a.m. last Saturday, Ms. Faust, who lived in an apartment building in Old Town Scottsdale, and her friends were drunk and knocked on the door of her ex-boyfriend's house, saying that her cell phone was inside. The police arrived at the scene after receiving the call for help. After searching the apartment, no mobile phone was found. Later, the police asked Faust to leave. Faust believed the officer was rude to her and called 911 to complain. In Arizona, it is a crime to make a non-emergency 911 call. After the 911 operator explained to Faust, she still stood by her complaint. So the operator asked Faust to give his address, hung up the phone, and directly notified the police officers present to arrest the drunken Faust. Ms Faust's misuse of 911 could result in a $750 fine and up to four months in jail.

496367f44a73d514f5deef0d0f209efe6e9a9edb.translatedText: The U.S. State Department mourns the death of Fang Lizhi: he was a pioneer in human rights and democratic reform (picture) Voice of America The U.S. government on Monday expressed its condolences on the news of the death of the famous Chinese dissident Fang Lizhi...

70f2f7575ce6327779d4d154b084a25b2ce1fa42.sourceText: 美国政府星期一对著名中国异议人士方励之去世的消息表达哀悼。美国国务院说，方励之是中国人权与民主改革的先驱。有华文媒体报导说，方励之的告别式初步定于这个星期六举行。
70f2f7575ce6327779d4d154b084a25b2ce1fa42.translatedText: The U.S. government on Monday expressed its condolences on the news of the death of the famous Chinese dissident Fang Lizhi. The U.S. State Department said that Fang Lizhi is a pioneer in China's human rights and democratic reforms. Some Chinese media reported that Fang Lizhi's farewell ceremony is initially scheduled to be held this Saturday.

3706253f9ecc0e88c4687280fadc12d58a765ca4.sourceText: 美国国务院女发言人纽兰9号在例行简报的一开始，对方励之溘然而去的消息表达哀悼。
3706253f9ecc0e88c4687280fadc12d58a765ca4.translatedText: At the beginning of her regular briefing on the 9th, U.S. State Department spokeswoman Nuland expressed condolences over the news of Fang Lizhi’s passing.

0af1e0e03185da3ba072bfa10aa085e539487576.sourceText: 纽兰说：”中国民主维权人士与天体物理学家方励之去世的消息，让我们感到哀伤。他是中国人权与民主改革的先驱，我们对他的家属表达悼念。”
0af1e0e03185da3ba072bfa10aa085e539487576.translatedText: Newland said: "We are saddened by the news of the death of Chinese democratic rights defender and astrophysicist Fang Lizhi. He was a pioneer in China's human rights and democratic reforms, and we express our condolences to his family."

bdee2e04e855224dd2d8b74abafb960de44601b9.sourceText: 旅居美国的方励之4月6日在家中突然去世，终年76岁。他所任教的亚利桑那大学发表声明说，方励之的去世为巨大损失。亚利桑那大学还赞许方励之的非凡勇气与信念。
bdee2e04e855224dd2d8b74abafb960de44601b9.translatedText: Fang Lizhi, who lived in the United States, died suddenly at home on April 6 at the age of 76. The University of Arizona, where he taught, issued a statement saying that Fang Lizhi's death was a huge loss. The University of Arizona also commended Fang Lizhi for his extraordinary courage and belief.

d1dee25d1d33fb7472b959f861df95f6e00a3a8c.sourceText: 视频截图国务院发言人纽兰
d1dee25d1d33fb7472b959f861df95f6e00a3a8c.translatedText: Video screenshot State Council Spokesperson Nuland

4aa01d9f43e7ed816a44df6a092336d941304664.sourceText: 达赖喇嘛致函方励之的遗孀李淑娴，表示悼念之意。达赖喇嘛在信中说，方励之坚信追求真理必须有民主和言论自由，方励之以巨大的勇气不遗余力地把这个简单的道理传授给他的同胞，尤其是中国的年轻人。
4aa01d9f43e7ed816a44df6a092336d941304664.translatedText: The Dalai Lama sent a letter to Fang Lizhi’s widow Li Shuxian to express his condolences. The Dalai Lama said in the letter that Fang Lizhi firmly believed that the pursuit of truth requires democracy and freedom of speech. Fang Lizhi used great courage to spare no effort to teach this simple truth to his compatriots, especially China's young people.

95a6d02f9bad02b6bd73b6c088339220118a8182.sourceText: 流亡海外的中国民运人士正酝酿为方励之举行追思集会和网上悼念活动。华文媒体报导说，方励之的告别式初步定于14号在亚利桑那州图桑市举行。
95a6d02f9bad02b6bd73b6c088339220118a8182.translatedText: Chinese pro-democracy activists in exile are planning to hold memorial rallies and online condolences for Fang Lizhi. Chinese media reported that Fang Lizhi’s farewell ceremony is initially scheduled to be held on the 14th in Tucson, Arizona.

0bc7ec5265286ee1b0dcafb00146d14c6d4178eb.translatedText: The Overseas Chinese Federation led the beauties to visit the Luo Provincial Chinese Association (2011)

9e24db8eaa0d984f68d7cbea3137e299d2d42f8d.sourceText: 传统侨社筹备庆祝美国国庆的《龙腾凤舞》活动已经开始。而”人才”和”人、财”两个方面，是目前工作的重点。各种人才不但要在侨联团体中去选拔，也要在义工队伍中去发掘。义工有热情，有才华，并来自社会各个阶层，不少人学有专长，心怀绝技，更有一颗奉献之心。庆祝国庆既是一个扣紧主流的重要活动，也是一个让广大义工服务侨众和展示才华的平台，大家积极参与，活动才会办得声有色。
9e24db8eaa0d984f68d7cbea3137e299d2d42f8d.translatedText: >The traditional overseas Chinese community's preparations for the "Dragon and Phoenix Dance" event to celebrate the National Day of the United States have begun. The two aspects of "talent" and "people and finance" are the focus of the current work. Various talents must be selected not only among the Overseas Chinese Federation groups, but also among the volunteer teams. Volunteers are enthusiastic and talented, and come from all walks of life. Many have expertise, unique skills, and a heart of dedication. Celebrating National Day is not only an important event that closely follows the mainstream, but also a platform for volunteers to serve the overseas Chinese and showcase their talents. Only when everyone actively participates will the event be successful.

8dc611875fcfe4027ec2a579362e7023aed01ffa.sourceText: 有了”人才”，还要去发掘”人、财”，其中的”人”指的是参选的佳丽，选美是每年庆典中最亮丽的环节，如何鼓励佳丽报名参加，是目前主要任务。国庆活动得到各报刊的大力支持，除了用优惠价刊登广告外，《美西侨报》、《亚美报》还不加价地再次登载，太阳鸟网站、凤凰艺文网亦免费刊登。另外，副主席余文泽漏夜赶印了数十份彩页选美广告，而义工们接到广告后就马上行动起来，四处张贴，不少人还亲自向亲朋好友动员。凤凰城的华裔小姐选美不同其它选美，它不是商业活动，奖金奖品并不太多，侨联希望能通过选美的培训，让佳丽克服胆怯的心理，培养良好的仪态和艺能，提升自身的素质，并搭建一个平台让佳丽在庆典中显露才华。
8dc611875fcfe4027ec2a579362e7023aed01ffa.translatedText: Once we have "talent", we also need to discover "people and wealth". The "people" refer to the beauties participating in the contest. The beauty pageant is the most beautiful part of the annual celebration. How to encourage the beauties to sign up is the current main task. The National Day activities have received strong support from various newspapers and periodicals. In addition to publishing advertisements at discounted prices, the "American Spanish Overseas Chinese News" and "Asian American News" will re-publish them at no extra charge. The Sunbird website and Phoenix Art and Literature Network also publish them for free. In addition, Vice Chairman Yu Wenze spent the whole night rushing to print dozens of color page beauty pageant advertisements. As soon as the volunteers received the advertisements, they immediately took action and posted them everywhere. Many of them even personally mobilized their relatives and friends. The Miss Chinese Beauty Pageant in Phoenix is ​​different from other beauty pageants. It is not a commercial event and there are not many bonuses and prizes. The Overseas Chinese Federation hopes that through the beauty pageant training, the beauties can overcome their timidity, develop good manners and artistic skills, improve their own qualities, and build a platform for the beauties to show their talents in the celebration.

ffdc3bf726a524b3a115cb13d6ffba8dc2495bd6.sourceText: 这两年，侨联带动佳丽去作义工，提高了她们服从团体，服务社群，多作贡献的意识，短短数月，受益无穷，这也佳丽参加选美的另一种收获。除了动员佳丽报名外，还有一大任务就是要去求”财”，有道是”三军未动，粮草先行。”一个大的活动，缺少经费难于成事。侨联是个大家庭，长期以来，因为有其属下的十多个团体鼎力支持，让每年的国庆庆典首先有了一个经济基础，今次活动刚开始，凤凰城龙冈公所就有四位职员马上答应做选美佳丽的赞助人；其次，一批对我们侨社有着深厚感情的老一辈华侨，他们不但自己赞助，还带动周边的人出钱出力，令人感动，值得赞扬。目前出钱赞助佳丽参选的，已有余文劲先生、关宗任先生、胡寿柏先生、环球布斐(张华芳)、艺文网(张肇鸿)、徐国富保险、刘全知医生等人(每位赞助佳丽六百元)，，让庆典活动有了一个良好的开局。我们希望有更多的善长仁翁能给予赞助和支持，相信下一期有更加多的好消息告知大家。
ffdc3bf726a524b3a115cb13d6ffba8dc2495bd6.translatedText: In the past two years, the Overseas Chinese Federation has led the beauties to do volunteer work, which has improved their awareness of obeying the group, serving the community, and making more contributions. In just a few months, they have benefited a lot. This is another gain for the beauties from participating in the beauty pageant. In addition to mobilizing beauties to sign up, another major task is to seek "money". There is a saying that "before the three armies are moved, food and grass go first." It is difficult to accomplish a large event without funds. The Overseas Chinese Federation is a big family. For a long time, thanks to the strong support of more than ten groups under it, the annual National Day celebration has an economic foundation. At the beginning of this event, four employees from the Longgang Office in Phoenix City immediately agreed to be sponsors of the beauty pageant. Secondly, a group of older overseas Chinese who have deep feelings for our overseas Chinese community not only sponsored themselves, but also encouraged people around them to contribute money and efforts. This is touching and worthy of praise. Currently, Mr. Yu Wenjin, Mr. Guan Zongren, Mr. Hu Shoubai, Global Buffet (Zhang Huafang), Yiwenwang (Zhang Zhaohong), Xu Guofu Insurance, Dr. Liu Quanzhi and others have sponsored the contestants (each sponsoring 600 yuan for the contestant), which gave the celebration a good start. We hope that more philanthropists can provide sponsorship and support. We believe that there will be more good news for everyone in the next issue.

7dad7a703acb4e8ea365dda2873b59b689ac7a3c.sourceText: 2名儿童手指受伤 台湾产自行车座椅遭召回 由于产品设计问题，导致两名儿童手指被座椅割伤，本週美国联邦政府召回在REI等零售店出售的一款婴儿自行车座椅。 美国消费品安全委员会（CPSC）报告的这次自愿性召回，涉及在马萨诸塞州Todson经销的品牌TOPEAK Babyseat II。CPSC报告了两起事故，分别导致儿童手指需要缝合和被挤伤。抬起扶手杆抱下孩子时，孩子的手指如果正好放在扶手杆的铰链处，可能给儿童带来指头切除和破口风险。 此类问题虽然不是儿童产品中最严重的安全威胁，但相当普遍，从婴儿车到夹在桌子上的婴儿椅，都可能导致儿童受伤。 CPSC计划在未来几週内，要求设置家用产品自愿性标准的组织提高童车安全标准，解决推车导致儿童受危害的问题。 TOPEAK婴儿自行车座椅已经得到重新设计，新款正运往商店。 召回涉及到自2009年1月至2012年4月在全美出售的4万个儿童座椅。CPSC建议消费者，应立即停止使用该款自行车用儿童座椅，型号为 TCS2100、TCS2101和TCS2102，并与Todson公司联繫免费获取铰链盖改进工具。可致电公司800-250-3068或在 store.todson.com/safety.html网上查询。
7dad7a703acb4e8ea365dda2873b59b689ac7a3c.translatedText: > 2 children have injured their fingers. Bicycle seats made in Taiwan have been recalled. Due to product design problems, two children's fingers were cut by the seats. This week, the U.S. federal government recalled an infant bicycle seat sold at retail stores such as REI. The voluntary recall reported by the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) involves the brand TOPEAK Babyseat II distributed in Todson, Massachusetts. The CPSC reported two incidents in which children's fingers required stitches and were crushed. When lifting the armrest to take down the child, if the child's fingers are placed exactly on the hinge of the armrest, the child may be at risk of finger amputations and lacerations. While not the most serious safety threat in children's products, such problems are common and can lead to injuries in everything from strollers to baby chairs that clip onto tables. The CPSC plans to ask organizations that set voluntary standards for household products to improve stroller safety standards in the coming weeks to address the problem of strollers endangering children. The TOPEAK baby bike seat has been redesigned and the new model is shipping to stores. The recall involves 40,000 child seats sold in the United States from January 2009 to April 2012. CPSC advises consumers to immediately stop using the bicycle child seats, model numbers TCS2100, TCS2101 and TCS2102, and contact Todson to obtain a free hinge cover improvement tool. You can call the company at 800-250-3068 or check online at store.todson.com/safety.html.

045b58f3670be09d0ecfac4f7865c150f784d791.sourceText: 金信地产新闻:2012年3月大凤凰城地区房地产市场的大变化 2012年3月大凤凰城地区房地产市场上，房屋的库存量比去年同期下降了41%。三月份有8855个房子完成了交易。房屋在市场上的滞留时间从2011年平均3.8个月，变成了2.5个月。房屋的销售价格为$129，900，比2011年3月上涨了18%。3月凤凰城有8160个新房屋被销售，比2011年减少了20%。 2012年3月大量的投资者进入凤凰城房地产市场，很多房屋上市交易仅一天就收到近10个购买合同，交易非常活跃。大凤凰城地区房价跌到近百年的低点，除了是投资的好时机这个重要原因以外，目前，大凤凰城，加州湾区的大经济环境崛起，就业机会增多，人口的增加，大量的房屋硬性需求者也增多，他们也成为了购买的主力。更多房地长信息请咨询金信地产Tinna 电话480-287-0180 E-mail goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
045b58f3670be09d0ecfac4f7865c150f784d791.translatedText: Jinxin Real Estate News: Big changes in the real estate market in the Greater Phoenix area in March 2012 In the Greater Phoenix area real estate market in March 2012, housing inventory fell 41% compared to the same period last year. There were 8,855 completed sales in March. Homes stayed on the market for an average of 2.5 months, up from 3.8 months in 2011. The home sold for $129,900, an 18% increase from March 2011. There were 8,160 new homes sold in Phoenix in March, a 20% decrease from 2011. In March 2012, a large number of investors entered the Phoenix real estate market. Many houses received nearly 10 purchase contracts in just one day after they were put on the market, and transactions were very active. Housing prices in the Greater Phoenix area have fallen to a low of nearly a century. In addition to being a good time for investment, the current economic environment in Greater Phoenix and the Bay Area of ​​California is rising. Job opportunities have increased, the population has increased, and a large number of hard demanders for housing have also increased. They have also become the main force in purchasing. 587a1a22dff9f0b4a43d1de41edb3c11e9e384d1.sourceText: (AACYF洛杉矶讯） 由中国国务院侨务办公室主办、河南省侨办承办，全美中华青年联合会海外协办的?012海外华裔青少年中国寻根之旅?#22799;令营河南营现已正式开始接受报名！欢迎全美各地12-18岁的华裔青少年踊跃报名参加！夏令营将在7月14日举办开营仪式，为期两周，7月26日晚在郑州举行闭营仪式。 河南省是中原文化发源地，”少林武功”是中华武术中赫赫有名的一张名片，今年在河南举办的夏令营，将带领华裔青少年参观少林寺，邀请少林大师讲解禅武文化、在学习汉语知识的同时，营员们也有机会学习少林武术的基本功、少林小洪拳等，亲身体验中华武术文化。河南营在安排营员学习剪纸、书法、汉语等中华文化知识同时，也将会带领营员在郑州、安阳、洛阳、开封等地，深入中原大地参观龙门石窟、中岳嵩山、岳飞庙、白马寺、开封铁塔、相国寺、殷墟博物馆、嵩阳书院等久负盛名的历史文化景点。 活动费用：国务院侨办将负责在夏令营（两周）活动期间的食、住、行、以及参观学习的费用；其它费用如：国际机票、签证费、报名费（河南营需另增加800元人民币）等由学员自行承担。
587a1a22dff9f0b4a43d1de41edb3c11e9e384d1.translatedText: (AACYF Los Angeles News) Sponsored by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council of China, hosted by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Henan Province, and co-sponsored by the National Chinese Youth Federation Overseas, the 012 Overseas Chinese Youth Journey to China Roots Camp Henan Camp is now officially open for registration! Chinese-American youths aged 12-18 from all over the United States are welcome to sign up! The summer camp will hold an opening ceremony on July 14, which will last for two weeks, and a closing ceremony will be held in Zhengzhou on the evening of July 26. Henan Province is the birthplace of Central Plains culture, and "Shaolin Kung Fu" is a famous business card in Chinese martial arts. This year's summer camp in Henan will lead Chinese teenagers to visit the Shaolin Temple and invite Shaolin masters to explain Zen martial arts culture. While learning Chinese knowledge, campers will also have the opportunity to learn the basic skills of Shaolin Kung Fu, Shaolin Xiaohong Fist, etc., and experience the Chinese martial arts culture first-hand. While Henan Camp arranges campers to learn Chinese cultural knowledge such as paper-cutting, calligraphy, and Chinese, it will also lead campers in Zhengzhou, Anyang, Luoyang, Kaifeng and other places to visit the Longmen Grottoes, Zhongyue Songshan, Yuefei Temple, White Horse Temple, Kaifeng Iron Tower, Xiangguo Temple, Yinxu Museum, Songyang Academy and other prestigious historical and cultural attractions in the Central Plains. Activity expenses: The Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council will be responsible for the food, accommodation, transportation, and study tour expenses during the summer camp (two weeks); other expenses such as international air tickets, visa fees, registration fees (an additional RMB 800 is required for the Henan camp), etc. shall be borne by the students themselves.

b426ddefceee01096660655509e4a82a115e64d3.translatedText: The University of Southern California is located in downtown Los Angeles, California, and gang crime cases have been frequent nearby. Police said there have been four murders in the neighborhood this year, but the violent crime rate has dropped by 20% compared to previous years. Mitbbs.com

6d5ac46403816ebea0537ca66fd3c7ac76f841e6.sourceText: 南加大共有38000名学生，其中19%来自国外，来自中国的留学生约有2500人。 Mitbbs.com
6d5ac46403816ebea0537ca66fd3c7ac76f841e6.translatedText: >There are 38,000 students at the University of Southern California, 19% of whom are from abroad, and there are about 2,500 international students from China. Mitbbs.com

91a549a70a0cd270e2416f7f6772f8b7aad87315.sourceText: 另中央社报道，南加大指出，遇害的两名学生都是就读于电子工程系的中国学生，男性被害人的姓名为瞿铭，女性被害人则是吴颖。 Mitbbs.com
91a549a70a0cd270e2416f7f6772f8b7aad87315.translatedText: Central News Agency reported that the University of Southern California pointed out that the two students who were killed were Chinese students studying in the Department of Electronic Engineering. The male victim was named Qu Ming, and the female victim was Wu Ying. Mitbbs.com

c9a8665b7fd40a065a27b5553458603f3b90af29.sourceText: 位于洛杉矶市中心的南加大，一向被认为是贵族学校，国际学生也多，不过一名曾经在南加大就读的台湾学生指出，南加大在韩国城旁，也有老墨区，据说还有帮派分子，治安一直都不算好，附近的住家也都安装铁窗，避免意外。 Mitbbs.com
c9a8665b7fd40a065a27b5553458603f3b90af29.translatedText: The University of Southern California is located in the center of Los Angeles. It has always been considered an aristocratic school and has many international students. However, a Taiwanese student who once studied at the University of Southern California pointed out that the University of Southern California is located next to Koreatown and there is also the Lao Mo District. It is said that there are gang members. The public security has not been good, and nearby homes have iron windows installed to avoid accidents. Mitbbs.com

3786a47a65396d797886b984f6085722cf0f92d1.sourceText: 为了保护学生的安全，南加大不仅有24小时的保安，这几年来也不断加强周边地区的安全人员，警方也加派人手巡逻，不料还是发生这起令人遗憾的案件。 Mitbbs.com
3786a47a65396d797886b984f6085722cf0f92d1.translatedText: In order to protect the safety of students, the University of Southern California not only has 24-hour security, but has also continuously strengthened security personnel in surrounding areas in recent years, and the police have also deployed more patrols. Unexpectedly, this regrettable case still occurred. Mitbbs.com

44d6488d779bf9e4a5224b694ffc7fca8a36a356.sourceText: 南加大校方也发信给所有学生，强调南加大这些年来对于学生安全的重视，但未来仍会继续加强。 Mitbbs.com
44d6488d779bf9e4a5224b694ffc7fca8a36a356.translatedText: The University of Southern California also sent a letter to all students, emphasizing that USC has attached great importance to student safety over the years, but will continue to strengthen it in the future. Mitbbs.com

72bc7543a8c847d0a60efe3b7799867beb920a42.sourceText: 美国移民局将于4月2日（星期一）开始接受2013财政年度的H1B签证申请。大部分申请人都是在OPT实习期间（文科学生12个月，STEM学生29个月）申请H1B获批的申请人必须要等到10月1日才开始工作，一旦H1B申请人出现OPT身份过期问题，应该如何应对？ 案例一：OPT在4月1日到10月1日期间失效 如果申请人的OPT在6月1日到期，申请人4月份递交了H-1B申请，并获得了批准，申请人的合法身份和工作许可将会自动延长到9月30日，10月1日申请人的H-1B正式生效。因为申请人在OPT失效之前递交H1B，从OPT失效到10月1日期间，申请人可以在美国合法居留和工作。 案例二：OPT在2月份失效，但雇主愿意为你申请H1B 如果申请人的OPT在2月份失效，根据专业不同，可分为两类情况。一类是STEM学科的毕业生，此类申请人可以通过将OPT延长17个月的方法来保持其在H1B申请期间的合法身份。另一类是非STEM学科的毕业生，对于这类申请人，如果申请人的OPT是在2月5日失效，由于OPT失效后有一个为期60天的Grace Period （宽限期）。因此，申请人在4月1日之前（60天内）仍然可以合法居留美国，等雇主4月2日递交H1B申请之后，申请人也仍然可以以等待审批结果为理由合法在美国居住。但是，由于OPT在H1B申请前已经失效，申请人可合法在美国居留等待H-1B批准，但不可以继续在美工作。 案例三：OPT在2月份之前过期，但雇主愿意为你申请H1B 如果申请人OPT实习期在2月份之前就过期，之后雇主在4月2日递交H-1B申请，申请人必须保持在美国的合法身份，如有必要，申请人需要首先转换身份。如找到学校延续F-1的身份，或者有家庭的申请人可以转换成H4或者F2。才能保证在4月2日递交H-1B申请的时候，申请人的身份是有效的。
72bc7543a8c847d0a60efe3b7799867beb920a42.translatedText: USCIS will begin accepting H1B visa applications for fiscal year 2013 on Monday, April 2. Most applicants are applying for H1B during their OPT internship period (12 months for liberal arts students and 29 months for STEM students). Applicants who are approved for H1B must wait until October 1 to start working. Once an H1B applicant encounters the problem of OPT expiration, how should they deal with it? Case 1: OPT expires from April 1 to October 1. If the applicant's OPT expires on June 1, and the applicant submitted an H-1B application in April and was approved, the applicant's legal status and work permit will be automatically extended to September 30, and the applicant's H-1B will officially take effect on October 1. Because the applicant submitted H1B before the expiration of OPT, the applicant can legally stay and work in the United States from the expiration of OPT to October 1. Case 2: OPT expires in February, but the employer is willing to apply for H1B for you. If the applicant's OPT expires in February, it can be divided into two types of situations depending on the major. One category is graduates of STEM subjects. Applicants of this type can maintain their legal status during the H1B application period by extending OPT for 17 months. The other category is graduates of non-STEM subjects. For this type of applicant, if the applicant's OPT expires on February 5, there is a 60-day Grace Period after the OPT expires. Therefore, the applicant can still legally reside in the United States before April 1 (within 60 days). After the employer submits the H1B application on April 2, the applicant can still legally reside in the United States on the grounds of waiting for the approval result. However, since OPT has expired before H1B application, the applicant can legally stay in the United States and wait for H-1B approval, but cannot continue to work in the United States. Case 3: OPT expires before February, but the employer is willing to apply for H1B for you. If the applicant's OPT internship period expires before February, and the employer submits an H-1B application on April 2, the applicant must maintain his legal status in the United States. If necessary, the applicant needs to change status first. If you find a school to extend your F-1 status, or if you have a family, you can switch to H4 or F2. Only in this way can we ensure that the applicant’s identity is valid when the H-1B application is submitted on April 2.

89a1bd89c8d8beda4e9542e7f32ed4571661d738.sourceText: 据美国媒体昨日报道，高管薪酬追踪机构 Equilar 近日公布了2011年100家上市公司高管的年薪排行榜，苹果CEO蒂姆?#24211;克以3.78亿美元的年薪高居榜首。
89a1bd89c8d8beda4e9542e7f32ed4571661d738.translatedText: According to US media reports yesterday, Equilar, an executive compensation tracking agency, recently announced the annual salary rankings of executives of 100 listed companies in 2011. Apple CEO Tim Grams topped the list with an annual salary of US$378 million.

2f4cb378fdbf9d5ad9e9b9626c3c9daa274e83f4.sourceText: 去年库克的薪酬总收入达3.78亿美元，包括工资、额外收入、奖金和一次性股票奖励。其中股票奖励所占份额最大，为3.762亿美元。这些股票会在未来十年内解禁，一半解禁于2016年，另一半则为2021年。
2f4cb378fdbf9d5ad9e9b9626c3c9daa274e83f4.translatedText: Last year, Cook's total compensation income reached US$378 million, including salary, additional income, bonuses and one-time stock awards. Among them, stock awards accounted for the largest share, accounting for US$376.2 million. These stocks will be unlocked over the next ten years, half in 2016 and the other half in 2021.

259374f64fb9146287e90670d3b915cb1db4d6d1.sourceText: 库克出任CEO以来，苹果的经营策略发生了一系列创新，如派发股息和更加重视中国市场，促使苹果股价上涨了近70%。4月6日美股收盘时，苹果 股价报收633.68美元，首次超越 谷歌 ，此时的苹果市值达5900亿美元，位居全球第一，将近谷歌三倍。而当乔布斯从苹果CEO位置上辞职时，苹果股价 只有373.72美元。单从盈利角度来看，苹果支付库克接近4亿美元的年收入物有所值。
259374f64fb9146287e90670d3b915cb1db4d6d1.translatedText: Since Cook became CEO, Apple's business strategy has undergone a series of innovations, such as paying dividends and paying more attention to the Chinese market, which has caused Apple's stock price to rise by nearly 70%. When the US stock market closed on April 6, Apple's stock price closed at US$633.68, surpassing Google for the first time. At this time, Apple's market value reached US$590 billion, ranking first in the world, nearly three times that of Google. When Jobs resigned as Apple CEO, Apple's stock price was only $373.72. From a profit perspective alone, Apple’s payment of nearly $400 million in annual income to Cook is well worth the money.

c08c06cebfbfdc5aa4152d7e019a54107d3b7dbc.sourceText: 薪酬排行榜上位居第二的是甲骨文CEO拉里 埃里森， 薪酬总额 为7760万美元。排名第三的是美国服饰百货公司J.C.Penny的CEO罗纳德 约翰逊，薪酬总额为5330万美元。新闻集团CEO默多克排在第十位，年收入为2940万美元。(记者林其玲 实习生葛文婕)

0c6af7082b0edcf45d1f8cb72bc0da76ed6ffdb0.sourceText: 凤凰城房地产价格连涨两个月 从 2008 年到 2010 年凤凰城房地产市场常常作为负面新闻的头条” 房价又跌了多少”. 最近，凤凰城房地产市场仍然占据全国新闻的头条的位置，但是完全不同的是，现在凤凰城成为了房地长市场价格最强健的城市之一。来看看如下的数据，据最新的数字显示，凤凰城 2011 年 12 月到 2012 年 1 月，成为了房屋增值最多的城市。该城市的价格涨幅也是最大，连续两个月，价格上扬。 从 2012 年 1 月比去年同期价格上涨的城市全美只有三个城市分别是凤凰城 丹佛，底特律。凤凰城上涨了 1.3% ，底特律上涨了 1.7% 。 二月联邦政府与最大的贷款机构达成了协议。允许银行全面加速破产屋的处理，这可能会导致破产屋的数量还有可能出现一个小高潮, 但是这个对整个凤凰城大市场的影响不大，房屋价格暴涨的情况的出现可能性不大。很多购房者对目前抢购房屋的情况很苦恼，与其他城市相比，这不会持续太久。更多地产信息请咨询金信地产 Tinna 480-287-0180 goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com 。
0c6af7082b0edcf45d1f8cb72bc0da76ed6ffdb0.translatedText: Phoenix real estate prices rose for two months in a row. From 2008 to 2010, the Phoenix real estate market often made the headlines of negative news "How much have house prices fallen again?" Recently, the Phoenix real estate market still dominates the national news headlines, but completely different is that Phoenix is ​​now one of the cities with the strongest real estate market prices. Let’s take a look at the following data. According to the latest figures, Phoenix became the city with the largest increase in housing value from December 2011 to January 2012. The city also saw the largest price increase, with prices rising for two consecutive months. There are only three cities in the United States where prices have increased since January 2012 compared with the same period last year: Phoenix, Denver, and Detroit. Phoenix was up 1.3% and Detroit was up 1.7%. The federal government struck a deal with the largest lenders in February. Allowing banks to fully speed up the processing of bankrupt homes may lead to a small peak in the number of bankrupt homes, but this will have little impact on the entire Phoenix market, and it is unlikely that housing prices will skyrocket. Many homebuyers are distressed by the current rush to buy homes, and compared to other cities, this won't last long.
