e08e0431b5ce1ab4223d40a2fb1419346508b29c.sourceText: 3月31日18时27分，中国成功发射”亚太7号”通信卫星，一块残骸坠落尚寨土家族乡蜂子坳组附近
e08e0431b5ce1ab4223d40a2fb1419346508b29c.translatedText: At 18:27 on March 31, China successfully launched the "Asia-Pacific 7" communications satellite. A piece of debris fell near the Fengzi'ao Group in Tujia Township, Shangzhai

c03995d8feb7bc1692319bfc3badf887768fab98.sourceText: 火箭残骸冒出浓烈刺鼻的黄烟。黄烟为残留的四氧化二氮分解后形成的二氧化氮。四氧化二氮，分子式为N2O4，无色的气体，强氧化剂，为火箭推进剂之一。剧毒，且有腐蚀性。易分解为二氧化氮为红棕色的气体，具有神经麻醉的毒性。
c03995d8feb7bc1692319bfc3badf887768fab98.translatedText: The rocket debris emitted thick and pungent yellow smoke. Yellow smoke is nitrogen dioxide formed after the decomposition of residual dinitrogen tetroxide. Nitrogen tetroxide, with the molecular formula N2O4, is a colorless gas, a strong oxidant, and one of the rocket propellants. Highly toxic and corrosive. It easily decomposes into nitrogen dioxide, which is a reddish-brown gas and has neuronarcotic toxicity.

c6f8075bc7f934ab98dfdccf5fb96da71b60ae3f.sourceText: 2012年3月31日下午6点34分左右，尚寨上空冒出白烟，随后传来几声爆炸声，一块银白色物体越落越大、越落越近，最后坠入尚寨土家族乡蜂子坳组旁边。
c6f8075bc7f934ab98dfdccf5fb96da71b60ae3f.translatedText: At around 6:34 pm on March 31, 2012, white smoke appeared in the sky above Shangzhai, followed by several explosions. A silvery-white object fell bigger and closer, and finally fell next to the Fengzi'ao Group in Tujia Township, Shangzhai.

32b8af39ffecddd831e8a7fbca650e2e5ff736ab.sourceText: 跟随乡卫星发射器残骸落区指挥部紧急赶赴现场，整个小溪沟黄烟弥漫，刺鼻难受，看不清物体，胆大的屏住呼吸，走近卫星发射器残骸，一睹发射器残骸真面目。发射器坠入小溪沟斜坡断为四大块，两块嵌入土壤斜卧在斜坡上，两大块滚入稻田一直冒出缕缕黄烟。
32b8af39ffecddd831e8a7fbca650e2e5ff736ab.translatedText: Followed the township satellite launcher debris landing area headquarters and rushed to the scene. The entire creek was filled with yellow smoke, pungent and uncomfortable, and objects could not be seen clearly. I bravely held my breath and approached the satellite launcher debris to see the true face of the launcher debris. The launcher crashed into a creek and broke into four large pieces. Two pieces were embedded in the soil and were lying on the slope. The two large pieces rolled into the rice fields and emitted wisps of yellow smoke.

98899e88e1c4580869b54158c56187f0ef8e6ca8.sourceText: 据该组村民反映，看到物体直奔村民们而来，村民中，有的已惊吓哭起来，有的抱起小孩直跑，尽量远离落体，一声巨响，庞然大物落在该组小溪旁边，刺鼻的黄烟把整个小溪全部覆盖，慢慢向四散扩散去，村民们只能远远向坠体处，等待乡政府干部们的到来。
98899e88e1c4580869b54158c56187f0ef8e6ca8.translatedText: According to the reports of the villagers in this group, they saw the object heading straight towards the villagers. Some of the villagers were frightened and cried, and some picked up their children and ran straight away, trying to stay away from the falling body. With a loud noise, the giant object landed next to the group of creeks. The acrid yellow smoke covered the entire creek and slowly spread in all directions. The villagers could only move far away from the falling body and wait for the arrival of the township government cadres.

f8219387ec4dad8c22c505173fc04840ec3e10d4.sourceText: 经乡卫生星残骸落区指挥部和县民政局进行仔细核查，此次卫星发射器残骸降落，虽惊吓了村民，但没有造成村民的房屋等财产损失，落区群众生命财产安全。
f8219387ec4dad8c22c505173fc04840ec3e10d4.translatedText: After careful verification by the township health satellite debris landing area headquarters and the county civil affairs bureau, the satellite launcher debris landing this time frightened the villagers, but did not cause any damage to the villagers' houses or other property, and the lives and property of the people in the landing area are safe.

ef5f2300a18dd054fae926851a4ad38461302c7a.sourceText: 美国总统奥巴马2012年初推出一项新军事战略，强调美国虽然面临预算压力，但将努力确保其”军事超强”地位，同时将美国军事重心转向亚太地区。在一定程度上，美国转向亚太被认为是出于包围中国考虑，而美国媒体4月5日刊登文章，猜测中国应对美国的五大措施。
ef5f2300a18dd054fae926851a4ad38461302c7a.translatedText: U.S. President Obama launched a new military strategy in early 2012, emphasizing that although the United States faces budget pressures, it will strive to ensure its "military superpower" status and shift its military focus to the Asia-Pacific region. To a certain extent, the U.S.’s pivot to the Asia-Pacific is considered to be out of consideration to encircle China. The U.S. media published an article on April 5 speculating on China’s five major measures to deal with the United States.

f93073a23c000752fd5097a5f8e532c23f9d5f22.sourceText: 美国总统奥巴马(Barack Obama)与国防部长帕内塔(Leon Panetta)2012年1月5日公布了一份题为《维持美国的全球领导地位：21世纪国防的优先任务》的新军事战略。新战略暗示美国将缩减陆军并减少在欧洲的军事存在，转而加强在亚太地区的军事存在，以维护亚太的”安全与繁荣”。
f93073a23c000752fd5097a5f8e532c23f9d5f22.translatedText: On January 5, 2012, U.S. President Obama and Defense Secretary Leon Panetta announced a new military strategy titled "Maintaining U.S. Global Leadership: Priorities for National Defense in the 21st Century." The new strategy implies that the United States will shrink its army and reduce its military presence in Europe, and instead strengthen its military presence in the Asia-Pacific region to maintain the "security and prosperity" of the Asia-Pacific.

a9c1545f6162aea427985a668b7f7b23eb6bf037.sourceText: 美国有线电视新闻网(CNN)4月5日刊登韩国釜山大学政治外交学院的教授克里(Rober Kelly)的文章称，美国采取的措施则得中国认为，此举意在遏制中国崛起。西方则在讨论中国可能采取的应对措施。
a9c1545f6162aea427985a668b7f7b23eb6bf037.translatedText: On April 5, CNN published an article by Rober Kelly, a professor at the School of Political Science and Diplomacy at Pusan ​​National University in South Korea, saying that the measures taken by the United States were considered by China to be intended to contain China's rise. The West is discussing China's possible response measures.

461fc999bf18b967cab2872c95fc0877e891c8c2.translatedText: 1. Or pull South Korea into its orbit

daf1bb4164eb0186116b58a7518107d3408f56ad.sourceText: 这个可能听起来非常荒谬，众所周知，韩国是美国的盟友。但是，克里认为，韩国存在传统的反美情绪，虽然美韩是盟友。然而，很大程度上，韩国需要美国，而不是作为美国的盟友，美韩关系并不存在非常重要的密切关系。
daf1bb4164eb0186116b58a7518107d3408f56ad.translatedText: This may sound ridiculous. As we all know, South Korea is an ally of the United States. However, Kerry believes that there is traditional anti-American sentiment in South Korea, even though the United States and South Korea are allies. However, to a large extent, South Korea needs the United States rather than being an ally of the United States. There is no very important close relationship between the United States and South Korea.

a9f79031de1d619b62483b5495c01de527f56edd.sourceText: 很多韩国人认为，美国必须对分裂国家、欺辱韩国领导人、无端挑衅朝鲜、对韩国进行不公平贸易以及美军的胡作非为负有重大责任。朝鲜半岛是希望统一的，而众多韩国人认为，中国外交在这方面具有优势。中国可以说是朝鲜的盟友。但是，韩国人明白统一的前提是驻韩美军撤离。中国与韩国文化上非常相似，同属儒家文化。韩国也不像日本、美国一样宣称中国是其主要敌人。
a9f79031de1d619b62483b5495c01de527f56edd.translatedText: Many Koreans believe that the United States must bear major responsibility for dividing the country, insulting South Korean leaders, unprovoked provocations to North Korea, unfair trade with South Korea, and the abuses of the US military. The Korean Peninsula hopes to be reunified, and many Koreans believe that Chinese diplomacy has advantages in this regard. China can be said to be North Korea's ally. However, Koreans understand that the prerequisite for reunification is the withdrawal of US troops stationed in South Korea. China and Korea are very similar culturally and both belong to Confucian culture. South Korea also does not declare that China is its main enemy like Japan and the United States.

18200a6e31c1bca71d620b232c04aa33843ddcbc.sourceText: 中印关系向来不太热乎，并且在边界上也存在紧张局势。但是，需要注意的一点是，如果印度不进入美国阵营，那么中国肯定会受益。印度总理辛格(Manmohan Singh)在首尔核安全峰会期间对媒体表示”中国是无法遏制的”。
18200a6e31c1bca71d620b232c04aa33843ddcbc.translatedText: Sino-Indian relations have never been warm, and there are also tensions on the border. However, one thing to note is that if India does not enter the US camp, China will definitely benefit. Indian Prime Minister Manmohan Singh told the media during the Seoul Nuclear Security Summit that "China cannot be contained."

95d1e2ccd511225d1d389f1d621f548d19f07e08.sourceText: 辛格表示：”我们的目标就是与中美两国保持合作关系。我不认为像中国这样强大和充满活力的国家是能够被遏制的。”他还强调，即使美印关系持续改善，但一个强大且充满活力的中国是无法遏制的。
95d1e2ccd511225d1d389f1d621f548d19f07e08.translatedText: Singh said: "Our goal is to maintain cooperative relations with China and the United States. I don't think a country as powerful and dynamic as China can be contained." He also emphasized that even if US-India relations continue to improve, a powerful and dynamic China cannot be contained.

2c5720d7f572baed5488fe64ec487af11064f2df.sourceText: 辛格上述讲话的潜台词有两个：一是印度不赞成美国”遏制”中国，不会跟随美国起舞；二是印度将在中美之间保持均衡外交，即如他所说”与中美两国保持合作关系”。
2c5720d7f572baed5488fe64ec487af11064f2df.translatedText: There are two subtexts in Singh's above speech: First, India does not agree with the United States' "containment" of China and will not follow the United States; second, India will maintain a balanced diplomacy between China and the United States, that is, as he said, "maintain cooperative relations with China and the United States."

b71a376d6d7a318371c73a6e0f3d7c4b4d6b11ca.sourceText: 辛格的话很值得玩味。他实际上阐述了印度对华的外交立场。印度不会给美国当炮弹去攻击中国。虽然美国一直在拉拢印度，试图组建所谓美日澳印的”四国同盟”，在亚洲地区”遏制”中国的发展势头，但印度不会追赶美国起舞。
b71a376d6d7a318371c73a6e0f3d7c4b4d6b11ca.translatedText: >Singer’s words are worth pondering. He actually elaborated on India's diplomatic stance towards China. India will not use it as a bomb for the United States to attack China. Although the United States has been wooing India and trying to form the so-called "Quadruple Alliance" of the United States, Japan, Australia, and India to "contain" China's development momentum in Asia, India will not follow the United States.

0068d69c09d079d7a108504cc9897611bf5aacab.sourceText: 3. 优先发展导弹和无人机
0068d69c09d079d7a108504cc9897611bf5aacab.translatedText: 3. Prioritize the development of missiles and drones

fc5bf2242b36f440d7ac44d88db80bcf035ca407.sourceText: 中国在西太平洋与美国形成对峙并不明智。日本在二战时期的表现就是最好的证明，美国人的反击可谓是武装到牙齿。中国首先应该追求区域领导权(东亚)，随后才是与美国在太平洋的公开竞争。所以，介入与区域阻隔(access-denial)是可选的一步。
fc5bf2242b36f440d7ac44d88db80bcf035ca407.translatedText: It is not wise for China to confront the United States in the Western Pacific. Japan's performance during World War II is the best proof. The Americans' counterattack can be said to be armed to the teeth. China should first pursue regional leadership (East Asia) and then open competition with the United States in the Pacific. Therefore, intervention and area blocking (access-denial) are optional steps.

565bf81488d5b5d5156e4f1c315b398431c7b96b.sourceText: 发射导弹以及派遣无人机对付昂贵以及移动缓慢的美国航母非常有效。目前，中国正在大力研究航母，但是其实导弹建设以及无人机省时省力。
565bf81488d5b5d5156e4f1c315b398431c7b96b.translatedText: Launching missiles and sending drones is very effective against expensive and slow-moving US aircraft carriers. Currently, China is vigorously researching aircraft carriers, but missile construction and drones actually save time and effort.

be5d0944b800965e94505cb55525c268ab1c51e4.sourceText: 购买欧洲国债可以提高中国应对西方的杠杆，以便提醒美国，中国是其最大的债务国。中国完全可以将大量资金花在别处，而不是美国国债。克里称，购买欧债或许导致美国利率上升，并且让美国人知道，对中国这个”大银行”应该采取合适的政策。同时，也可以阻止欧洲在亚洲纠缠与中美之间。
be5d0944b800965e94505cb55525c268ab1c51e4.translatedText: Buying European government bonds can increase China's leverage against the West and remind the United States that China is its largest debtor. China could simply spend a lot of its money elsewhere instead of in U.S. Treasuries. Kerry said that buying European debt may lead to an increase in U.S. interest rates and let Americans know that appropriate policies should be adopted towards China, a "big bank." At the same time, it can also prevent Europe from getting entangled with China and the United States in Asia.

419653a64d8969f1357cd84193e3e7e6d9f529fa.sourceText: 5. 与美国的”眼中钉”保持友好关系
419653a64d8969f1357cd84193e3e7e6d9f529fa.translatedText: 5. Maintain friendly relations with the "thorns in the flesh" of the United States

cca4b9b69f09f950863945cd37a86c3ce5086c96.sourceText: 众所周知，世界范围内，美国的”眼中钉、肉中刺”众多，包括伊朗、伊拉克、委内瑞拉以及古巴。外界一致认为美国在与这些所谓的”坏家伙”打招呼时，花费太大的精力与资金。作为中国，这些国家当然是很好的工具。中国与这些国家保持良好关系，会令美国认为，中国可能会支持任何一个国家。这种外交策略的好处就是，在消耗美国军事花费的同时，也会挑动美国神经。
cca4b9b69f09f950863945cd37a86c3ce5086c96.translatedText: As we all know, there are many "thorns in the flesh" of the United States around the world, including Iran, Iraq, Venezuela and Cuba. The outside world unanimously believes that the United States spends too much energy and money in dealing with these so-called "bad guys." As China, these countries are certainly good tools. China's maintaining good relations with these countries will make the United States believe that China may support any country. The advantage of this diplomatic strategy is that while it consumes U.S. military expenses, it also stirs up the nerves of the United States.

afb46f097d35f9e35c9cebe7ee57314d9b419dd8.sourceText: 但是，分析认为，克里的五大对策中也有其不妥的地方，特别是将韩国拉入中国轨道一条尤为不可信。战后初期，美韩就已经建立同盟关系。1953年10月韩美签署相互防御条约，确立军事同盟关系。目前美国在韩约有2.85万驻军，掌握韩军战时指挥权，对韩国负有安全防卫义务。也可以理解为，美国掌握韩国全部军事大权，包括朝鲜半岛的美军部队和韩国部队，最高统帅是美国人，韩国也是世界上唯一一个首都有外国驻军的国家（除了伊拉克和阿富汗），虽然美国不久后会将军事指挥权交出，但是目前为止韩国人还是无法自由掌控自己国家的军队。中国要想拉近韩国，困难系数非常大。
afb46f097d35f9e35c9cebe7ee57314d9b419dd8.translatedText: However, analysts believe that there are also flaws in Kerry's five major countermeasures, especially the one that pulls South Korea into China's orbit. In the early postwar period, the United States and South Korea had already established an alliance. In October 1953, South Korea and the United States signed a mutual defense treaty and established a military alliance. Currently, the United States has approximately 28,500 troops stationed in South Korea. It has wartime command of the South Korean military and has security and defense obligations towards South Korea. It can also be understood that the United States controls all military power in South Korea, including the US military and South Korean troops on the Korean Peninsula. The supreme commander is an American. South Korea is also the only country in the world with foreign troops stationed in its capital (except for Iraq and Afghanistan). Although the United States will soon hand over military command power, so far South Koreans still cannot freely control their own country's military. It is very difficult for China to get closer to South Korea.

dc1d2d7e5724c90f66241c6ee4cf5963d63f973b.sourceText: 美报告称中国军事战略性欺骗令专家误判
dc1d2d7e5724c90f66241c6ee4cf5963d63f973b.translatedText: US report says China's strategic military deception has led experts to misjudge

310dd2d50580308a150ad77d305bdef8098d708b.sourceText: 美国5日发布的一份报告称，中国军方在生产现代化武器装备方面继续进步，不过中国有选择性的透明度或是战略性的欺骗，可能给军事和情报界以外的外国观察家造成误导。
310dd2d50580308a150ad77d305bdef8098d708b.translatedText: A report released by the United States on the 5th stated that the Chinese military continues to make progress in the production of modern weapons and equipment, but China's selective transparency or strategic deception may mislead foreign observers outside the military and intelligence communities.

6112cd7b70f550c3f514e3e0db52063934caaf47.sourceText: 据美国之音4月5日报道，美国国会下属的美中经济与安全审议委员会（The US-China Economic and Security Review Commission）5日公布了一份研究报告，其中列举了美国几次错误评估中国自主研发武器进程的案例。美国分析人士和决策者将会看到中国军方在生产现代化武器装备方面继续进步，同时看到中国人民解放军的作战能力不断增强。美国必须提高分析手段和能力，才能跟上这些变化。
6112cd7b70f550c3f514e3e0db52063934caaf47.translatedText: According to a Voice of America report on April 5, the US-China Economic and Security Review Commission (The US-China Economic and Security Review Commission) under the US Congress released a research report on the 5th, which listed several cases in which the United States misassessed China's independent development of weapons. U.S. analysts and policymakers will see the Chinese military continue to make progress in producing modern weapons and equipment, while also seeing the People's Liberation Army's combat capabilities continue to grow. The United States must improve its analytical tools and capabilities to keep up with these changes.

339c724b3bcefab91bb62895334809566aa7a14e.sourceText: 报告指出，1979年以来，随着快速的经济增长，中国展开了大规模的军事现代化行动。从1990年代中期开始，中国加快了军事改革，国防开支稳步增长。中国2008年的国防白皮书说，要在2010年之前为国防发展奠定”牢固的基础”，”在2020年前完成向机械化和信息化的重大转变”，在本世纪中期实现国防现代化。
339c724b3bcefab91bb62895334809566aa7a14e.translatedText: The report pointed out that since 1979, with rapid economic growth, China has launched a large-scale military modernization operation. Since the mid-1990s, China has accelerated military reform and its defense spending has grown steadily. China's 2008 national defense white paper stated that it would lay a "solid foundation" for national defense development by 2010, "complete a major transition to mechanization and informatization by 2020," and achieve national defense modernization by the middle of this century.

d6a44acbfaba3ed1b9120ab798389b29e5276af1.sourceText: 中国军事现代化的进程包括自行研发武器系统，其中一些项目的发展、采购和部署的进程超过了美国和其他国家的估计。这份研究报告重点关注让美国分析人士吃惊的4项关键性武器系统：包括039A/B/041型元级柴电攻击型潜艇、SC-19 反卫星系统、东风-21D型反舰弹道导弹以及歼-20隐形战斗机。
d6a44acbfaba3ed1b9120ab798389b29e5276af1.translatedText: China's military modernization process includes the development of its own weapons systems, some of which have progressed in development, procurement, and deployment beyond the estimates of the United States and other countries. This research report focuses on four key weapon systems that surprised American analysts: including the Type 039A/B/041 Yuan-class diesel-electric attack submarine, the SC-19 anti-satellite system, the Dongfeng-21D anti-ship ballistic missile, and the J-20 stealth fighter.

054322be856f02bff50df22550c1efaaba6f1118.sourceText: 根据对这4个案例的研究，公开发表的美国政府分析报告对中国武器的自主研发趋势并没能得出一个可信的结论。很多证据显示，美国的分析报告没能预测到2004年中国海军推出元级潜艇，更没有料到这种潜艇可能使用不依赖空气的动力系统（AIP）。在另外一方面，美国官员对中国反卫星武器发展非常敏感。多份报告显示，美国官员知道中国可能在2007年测试反卫星武器，虽然他们可能没有估计到测试的具体时间。然而，美国政府分析人士准确地预测了几方面的发展，如SC-19 反卫星系统；可是中国有选择性的透明度，或是战略性的欺骗，宣称反对发展空间武器，可能给军事和情报界以外的外国观察家造成误导。
054322be856f02bff50df22550c1efaaba6f1118.translatedText: Based on the study of these four cases, the publicly published U.S. government analysis report failed to draw a credible conclusion on the trend of China’s independent research and development of weapons. A lot of evidence shows that the US analytical report failed to predict the launch of the Yuan-class submarine by the Chinese Navy in 2004, let alone the possibility that such a submarine would use an air-independent power system (AIP). On the other hand, U.S. officials are very sensitive to China's development of anti-satellite weapons. Multiple reports indicate that U.S. officials were aware that China might test an anti-satellite weapon in 2007, although they may not have estimated the specific timing of the test. However, U.S. government analysts accurately predicted several developments, such as the SC-19 anti-satellite system; however, China's selective transparency, or strategic deception, in declaring its opposition to the development of space weapons may have misled foreign observers outside the military and intelligence communities.

c41f3caffbeb89b20473dba59fb268b7e0363e52.sourceText: 几个案例显示，美国错误地估算了中国自主研发武器的速度。虽然美国情报部门知道中国在2008年研发陆基反舰弹道导弹，可是美国学术界和政府人士都指出，美国低估了中国反舰弹道导弹的发展进程。美国国防部官员估计，中国的反舰弹道导弹在2010年12月取得初始作战能力，可是中国和台湾的媒体都报道说，中国人民解放军已经进行实地部署。美国原先估计，中国在2012年对第五代战斗机歼-20进行样机试飞，可是美国又一次低估了它的发展速度，中国2011年1月就进行了试飞。
c41f3caffbeb89b20473dba59fb268b7e0363e52.translatedText: Several cases show that the United States miscalculated the speed of China's independent research and development of weapons. Although U.S. intelligence agencies know that China developed land-based anti-ship ballistic missiles in 2008, U.S. academics and government figures have pointed out that the United States has underestimated the development process of China's anti-ship ballistic missiles. U.S. Department of Defense officials estimate that China's anti-ship ballistic missiles achieved initial operational capability in December 2010, but media in China and Taiwan have reported that the Chinese People's Liberation Army has already deployed them on the ground. The United States originally estimated that China would conduct a prototype test flight of the fifth-generation fighter J-20 in 2012, but the United States once again underestimated its development speed. China conducted a test flight in January 2011.

e4584ab9de23cf26a3504c07cd2363d28b6508ab.sourceText: 信息封闭或欺骗：中国对很多军事活动进行保密，或者有意发出错误和误导信息。近年来，美国国防官员经常抱怨中国军事现代化发展缺乏透明度。
e4584ab9de23cf26a3504c07cd2363d28b6508ab.translatedText: Information occlusion or deception: China keeps many military activities secret or intentionally sends out false and misleading information. In recent years, U.S. defense officials have often complained about the lack of transparency in China's military modernization development.

92cb41901d9ab74d1a6dcfe23c8bdda0c1a0a672.sourceText: 低估中国国防工业的改革：曾经被看作是臃肿、僵化和适应性差的中国军事工业过去10年来的表现超出了批评人士的预料。中国国防工业虽然仍然面临很多问题，可是它生产现代化武器的能力已经大大超过了1980和1990年代的水平。
92cb41901d9ab74d1a6dcfe23c8bdda0c1a0a672.translatedText: Underestimating the reform of China’s defense industry: China’s military industry, once seen as bloated, rigid and poorly adapted, has performed beyond critics’ expectations over the past decade. Although China's defense industry still faces many problems, its ability to produce modern weapons has greatly exceeded the level of the 1980s and 1990s.

7e65dd0a6229aae70fbf45301bad7aed5f2a9862.sourceText: 难以理解中国国家安全决策过程：中国政府决策过程不透明，特别是在军事政策和国家安全问题等方面缺乏透明度。某些自主研发武器的公开亮相和试验暴露出协调方面的官僚问题，以及中国决策层中文职官员和军官之间可能存在分歧。
7e65dd0a6229aae70fbf45301bad7aed5f2a9862.translatedText: It is difficult to understand China’s national security decision-making process: The Chinese government’s decision-making process is not transparent, especially in terms of military policy and national security issues. The public appearances and testing of some indigenously developed weapons have exposed bureaucratic problems with coordination and possible divisions between civilian and military officials in China's decision-making hierarchy.

6aa2a35606f84173e5b9970aa0876fb3e7f4faa3.sourceText: 低估了北京感到受威胁的程度：很多媒体、学术界和政府分析人士可能没有完全意识到中国领导人把美国看作是对中国安全的一个根本威胁。近年来，几起事件加强了这种威胁预感，包括1996年台湾海峡危机，和1998年美国战机误炸中国驻贝尔格莱德（前南斯拉夫）大使馆辅楼。
6aa2a35606f84173e5b9970aa0876fb3e7f4faa3.translatedText: Underestimating the extent to which Beijing feels threatened: Many media, academic and government analysts may not fully realize that Chinese leaders view the United States as a fundamental threat to China’s security. In recent years, several incidents have strengthened this threat perception, including the Taiwan Strait crisis in 1996 and the accidental bombing of the annex building of the Chinese Embassy in Belgrade (former Yugoslavia) by US warplanes in 1998.

76533673f56af7157c92e098bf741107190fc125.sourceText: 中国增加科技投资：过去20年来，中国大力刺激自主科研和发展能力，不管是通过科学教育、国家科研拨款、购买外国技术，还是从事工业间谍活动，这些都大大增强了中国生产先进武器的能力。此外，中国还加强了军民两用技术的探索，例如可用于国防工业的多用途电子产品。
76533673f56af7157c92e098bf741107190fc125.translatedText: China increases investment in science and technology: Over the past 20 years, China has vigorously stimulated independent scientific research and development capabilities, whether through scientific education, national scientific research funding, purchasing foreign technology, or engaging in industrial espionage, which have greatly enhanced China's ability to produce advanced weapons. In addition, China has also stepped up its exploration of dual-use technologies, such as multi-purpose electronic products that can be used in the defense industry.

2c70a9e5b2d8334abd5f0123a7a522071fa28fdd.sourceText: 对公开中文材料缺乏理解能力或关注：由于美方增加了对公开材料，特别是学术界技术杂志和相关出版物的关注，研究人员纠正了过去的部分错误。增加对中国权威媒体消息和政治学术出版物的关注，也可以促进对中国领导人世界观的理解。
2c70a9e5b2d8334abd5f0123a7a522071fa28fdd.translatedText: Lack of understanding or attention to publicly available Chinese materials: As the United States has increased its focus on publicly available materials, especially academic technical journals and related publications, researchers have corrected some of their past mistakes. Increasing attention to China’s authoritative media news and political academic publications can also promote understanding of the worldview of Chinese leaders.

037bf8ab7a4a39c0f92b4d82e3ba5bf295746a8c.sourceText: 过去几十年来的趋势已经不再是研究中国国防工业的可靠指南，此外，美国观察人士不应该只看到中国政府军事政策声明的表面价值，这些声明可能具有欺骗性，或者是由对军事问题没有真正发言权的机构(比如中国外交部)发出的。美中经济与安全审议委员会认为，美国分析人士和决策者应该看到中国发展现代化先进武器的能力将持续提高，中国人民解放军的作战能力也将随之增强。
037bf8ab7a4a39c0f92b4d82e3ba5bf295746a8c.translatedText: Trends over the past few decades are no longer a reliable guide to studying China's defense industry. Furthermore, U.S. observers should not take the Chinese government's military policy statements at face value, which may be deceptive or issued by institutions (such as the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs) that have no real say in military matters. The U.S.-China Economic and Security Review Commission believes that U.S. analysts and policymakers should see that China’s ability to develop modern advanced weapons will continue to improve, and the combat capabilities of the Chinese People’s Liberation Army will also increase accordingly.

f5def5491f606755e596c68cfbe945011471bd62.sourceText: 亚省居民对政客不感兴趣 （亚省时报） 上周五一个全新的民意调查显示，亚利桑那州居民对他们的州议员不太感兴趣。 受访者表示，34%认为立法者表现”不佳”，35%认为立法者”还好”，只有29%的人认为议员们”做得好”。 对布鲁尔州长的表现，大部分受访者，52%认为她”还好”或者”差”。 大部分受访者认定自己是共和党。 这次民意调查是亚利桑那州工作家庭联盟授权湖泊研究合作（公司）所作，于3月26至28日对400名受访者作出调查，误差率是正负4.9%。这项调查还发现： 76%的受访者表示，他们支持支持布鲁尔的施政报告。40%的受访者希望立法者将议政题目集中在创造就业机会和教育改革。9%的受访者表示立法者的重点应该改变目前的雇用和解雇公务员的过程。
f5def5491f606755e596c68cfbe945011471bd62.translatedText: Arizona residents not interested in politicians (Alberta Times) Arizona residents are not very interested in their state legislators, a new poll showed on Friday. Respondents said that 34% thought the legislators' performance was "poor", 35% thought the legislators were "ok" and only 29% thought the legislators were "doing a good job". Regarding Governor Brewer's performance, the majority of respondents, 52%, thought she was "fair" or "poor." The majority of respondents identified themselves as Republicans. The poll was conducted by the Lake Research Partnership (Inc.) under the auspices of the Arizona Working Families Alliance. It surveyed 400 respondents from March 26 to 28. The margin of error was plus or minus 4.9%. The survey also found: 76% of respondents said they supported Brewer's policy address. 40% of respondents hope that legislators will focus on job creation and education reform. Nine percent of respondents said lawmakers should focus on changing the current process for hiring and firing public servants.

19e52061e8b7040dabd94ecaf7037c863af0778b.sourceText: 离中共十八大举行不到半年时间，随着省级领导班子相继换届，省级司法系统的领导层也发生了大规模变动。其中，18位省级公检法司”四长”履新领导岗位，其中包括新任重庆市公安局局长何挺。
19e52061e8b7040dabd94ecaf7037c863af0778b.translatedText: Less than half a year before the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, with the successive changes of provincial leadership teams, large-scale changes have also taken place in the leadership of the provincial judicial system. Among them, 18 "four chiefs" of the provincial Public Security Bureau and Justice Department took up new leadership positions, including He Ting, the new director of the Chongqing Municipal Public Security Bureau.

d5b605e89dc36039f944736bc4d09216ea269c45.sourceText: 中央政法委机关报《法制日报》4月6日报道，随着各省（自治区、直辖市）领导班子相继换届，一些省（自治区、直辖市）高级人民法院院长、人民检察院检察长、公安厅（局）长、司法厅（局）长发生了变动。报道称，截至目前，全国已有18位省级公检法司”四长”履新领导岗位。
d5b605e89dc36039f944736bc4d09216ea269c45.translatedText: "Legal Daily", the organ of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, reported on April 6 that as the leadership teams of various provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities) changed one after another, the presidents of the higher people's courts, the chief prosecutors of the people's procuratorates, the directors of the public security departments (bureaus) and the directors of the justice departments (bureaus) of some provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities) have changed. According to the report, as of now, 18 "four chiefs" of provincial public prosecutors and judicial departments have assumed new leadership positions across the country.

6ee748d5a6181232ff44b35cb17c6238583167d9.sourceText: 报道称，他们中大多数有丰富的政法省级人民检察院检察长工作经验，异地交流任职者众多。其中，更换人数最多，已有山西、内蒙古、吉林、黑龙江、山东、贵州、新疆7省（区）人民检察院检察长易人。
6ee748d5a6181232ff44b35cb17c6238583167d9.translatedText: reported that most of them have rich experience in working as chief prosecutors of provincial people's procuratorates in politics and law, and there are many people who have exchanged positions in other places. Among them, the largest number of people have been replaced. The chief prosecutors of the people's procuratorates of seven provinces (districts) including Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Jilin, Heilongjiang, Shandong, Guizhou and Xinjiang have changed their positions.

1eed1a412742e220eb3637927e79abf559af1ee8.sourceText: 值得注意的是，报道称，此次履新的省级公检法司”四长”大多是”50”?#65292;有的过去在地方党委、人大、政府或政法单位担任领导职务；有的是从政法单位新提拔上来的或者从上级政法单位调任的。譬如，新任四川省高级人民法院院长王海萍此前担任贵州省委政法委副书记，新任内蒙古自治区人民检察院检察长马永胜此前担任山东省人民检察院党组副书记、副检察长，而新任吉林省人民检察院检察长杨克勤是从中央政法委调任的。
1eed1a412742e220eb3637927e79abf559af1ee8.translatedText: It is worth noting that reports say that most of the "four chiefs" of the provincial public security and judicial departments who took up their duties this time are "50"?#65292; Some have held leadership positions in local party committees, people's congresses, governments or political and legal units in the past; some are newly promoted from political and legal units or transferred from higher-level political and legal units. For example, Wang Haiping, the newly appointed president of the Sichuan Provincial Higher People's Court, previously served as deputy secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Committee of the Guizhou Provincial Committee. Ma Yongsheng, the newly appointed prosecutor-general of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region People's Procuratorate, previously served as deputy secretary of the Party Leadership Group and deputy prosecutor-general of the Shandong Provincial People's Procuratorate. Yang Keqin, the new prosecutor-general of the Jilin Provincial People's Procuratorate, was transferred from the Central Political and Legal Affairs Committee.

b49a3d587c8b3d25576b17b94d77c63e3117a1ee.sourceText: 多州乐透协会(MUSL)31日宣布创下历史纪录的6亿4000万元兆彩(Mega Millions)的中奖细节，除有三张头奖外，包括本州在内共有161张中得奖金25万元的二奖。 亚利桑那州的彩票公司说，本州有三张票中了5个号码，但不是大彩球，而二奖则是指除大彩球以外的五个号码全部对中，税前奖金为25万元。还有12张彩票中了4个号码，奖金是一万美元。 MUSL提醒中奖人，要在彩券背面写上姓名，以免衍生失去奖金的枝节。依据美国法律，中奖彩券视同不记名票据，意味任何持有者均可兑换奖金；一旦完成签署，即拥有中奖彩券的产权。 尽管中奖彩券有180天至12个月的领奖期限，但MUSL呼吁奖人尽速完成领奖程序。
b49a3d587c8b3d25576b17b94d77c63e3117a1ee.translatedText: The Multi-State Lottery Association (MUSL) announced on the 31st the winning details of the record-breaking $640 million Mega Millions. In addition to three first prizes, a total of 161 winning tickets, including the state, won the second prize of $250,000. The Arizona Lottery Company said that three tickets in the state matched five numbers, but not the big ball. The second prize refers to all five numbers except the big ball matching, and the pre-tax bonus is 250,000 yuan. There were also 12 lottery tickets with four winning numbers, and the prize was $10,000. MUSL reminds winners to write their names on the back of their lottery tickets to avoid any inconvenience of losing their prize money. According to U.S. law, the winning lottery ticket is regarded as a bearer instrument, which means that any holder can redeem the prize; once signed, he/she owns the property rights of the winning lottery ticket. Although the winning lottery ticket has a period of 180 days to 12 months to claim the prize, MUSL urges the winners to complete the prize claiming process as soon as possible.

24115cd4ac5ad6faf0e1fd461b0b5f6fe9dd6add.sourceText: 亚省时报 房屋销售在三月份上涨了22.3％，很多买家在购买高峰抢购房屋。 价格上调是一个适度的价格上涨，表示硅谷低迷的的住房市场正在复苏，最近几个月的许多指标之一。今年春天收购狂潮的家庭谁都不愿意错过历史低位，ARMLS通讯主任克里斯说。
24115cd4ac5ad6faf0e1fd461b0b5f6fe9dd6add.translatedText: Alberta Times Home sales rose 22.3 per cent in March, with many buyers snapping up homes during the peak buying season. The price hike is one of many indicators that the Valley's sluggish housing market is recovering in recent months. No one wants to miss out on historically low prices for families who have been on a buying spree this spring, said Chris ARMLS communications director.

68000fde9e6eb3420edbcfc5d4889900fde40428.sourceText: ”由于住房是如此令人难以置信的实惠，人们只买房子像疯了似的，”她说。 ARMLS三月的数字显示全面改善。待售房屋库存继续下降，下降了7.9％，至21863个房屋。三月的数字类似2003年和2004年，其中任克里斯称为最后的正常市场?#65292;超过56,000家，在2009年11月上市。 任克里斯她说：”我们开始看到我们的代理商抱怨说，有没有足够的库存。” 这售价不到10万美元的房屋尤其如此。那些便宜的房屋最近已佔据市场主导地位，但供应已经不多了。供应紧张，2006年6月的高值的房主。价格暴跌59.1％，在2011年5月的底部，房子值108 300美元，自那时以来价格已经增长19.9％，到三月价值129,900美元。 ”它很慢，它是稳定的” 任克里斯说”我知道，我们总是希望它反弹，但它可能是健康的，我们走慢，比我们发疯好。” 任克里斯预计，破产危机的最坏的已经过去了，经济更生放缓。 一个比较正常的市场需要更高的就业机会和更多的人迁移到亚利桑那州。任克里斯说迁移只能改善住房价格时，在其他市场，让业主可以买得起并搬到这里。
68000fde9e6eb3420edbcfc5d4889900fde40428.translatedText: "Because housing is so incredibly affordable, people are just buying houses like crazy," she said. ARMLS March numbers show improvement across the board. The inventory of homes for sale continued to decline, falling 7.9% to 21,863 homes. March numbers are similar to 2003 and 2004, which Chris calls the last normal market with more than 56,000 homes listed in November 2009. “We started seeing complaints from our agents that there wasn’t enough inventory,” Chris Ren said. This was especially true for homes selling for less than $100,000. Those cheaper homes have dominated the market lately, but supply is running out. Tight supply, high value homeowners in June 2006. Prices plummeted 59.1% and at the bottom in May 2011 the house was worth $108,300. Since then prices have grown 19.9% ​​to be worth $129,900 in March. "It's slow, it's stable," Chris Yam said. "I know, we always want it to rebound, but it's probably better for it to be healthy and for us to go slow than for us to go crazy." Chris Yam predicts that the worst of the bankruptcy crisis has passed and economic renewal is slowing. A more normal market would require higher employment opportunities and more people moving to Arizona. Chris Yam said relocation can only improve housing prices in other markets, making it more affordable for homeowners to move here.

6060183b880ef89dbf650ce67da3bcd8ee79616b.sourceText: 从其他ARMLS结果：?#22312;4月份的房屋平均房价中值将达到$ 133,000。?#27861;拍屋小幅上涨后​​，持续了一年多的下降。三月份破产屋一直维持在约1.8万，同比下降与​​2009年11月的50,568个单元相比。一个正常的市场将有每月约5000法拍屋中，任克里斯表示。 作为一个整体亏损的百分比下降了4.6％。这是第一次，这个数字已低于50％，ARMLS跟踪这个度量。在2010年9月的亏损率达到74.1％。
6060183b880ef89dbf650ce67da3bcd8ee79616b.translatedText: From other ARMLS results: The median home price in April will be $133,000. ?#27861;After a slight increase, house auction prices continued to decline for more than a year. House bankruptcies in March have remained at about 18,000 units, down from 50,568 units in November 2009. A normal market would have about 5,000 foreclosures per month, Chris Yam said. The percentage loss as a whole fell 4.6%. For the first time, this number has dropped below 50%, with ARMLS tracking this metric. The loss rate reached 74.1% in September 2010.

bf67036e23624d6880b3435c7db24d50c76511b7.sourceText: 北京时间4月13日，接近中共内部直接处理”薄熙来案件”的消息人士对多维新闻表示，根据中共调查组目前所掌握的大量证据显示，薄熙来涉及的罪责将是”性质极其恶劣的贪腐问题，重大的刑事案件，以及挑战中央的’个人山头主义”’。
bf67036e23624d6880b3435c7db24d50c76511b7.translatedText: On April 13, Beijing time, a source close to the CCP who directly handled the "Bo Xilai case" told Duowei News that according to the large amount of evidence currently possessed by the CCP's investigation team, Bo Xilai's crimes will be "corruption issues of extremely egregious nature, major criminal cases, and 'personal mountaineering' that challenges the central government."

1e3c5363492319d28659c14ed2f5d5b0b9d0ad4c.sourceText: 有消息表明，中共已初步掌握了他数额惊人的海外资产，很有可能成为中国共产党内历史上最大的贪腐案件。目前有证据显示其个人亲自指示或参与了几起涉及命案的刑事案件。此外，个人”狂妄自大”蔑视中央权威，甚至挑战和威胁中央领导层。根据中共高层对薄熙来以上”罪责”的初步定调，这位前政治局委员、重庆市委书记不仅政治生涯已经结束，甚至其生命也将因此终结。
1e3c5363492319d28659c14ed2f5d5b0b9d0ad4c.translatedText: There is news that the Chinese Communist Party has initially gained control of his staggering amount of overseas assets, which is likely to become the largest corruption case in the history of the Chinese Communist Party. There is currently evidence that he personally directed or participated in several criminal cases involving homicides. In addition, individuals are "arrogant" and defy the central authority, and even challenge and threaten the central leadership. According to the initial tone of the CCP’s senior leadership’s “culpability” for Bo Xilai and above, not only is the former Politburo member and Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Secretary’s political career over, but his life will also be ended.

d73e274f8dd91cacbf6864f2255eb570ba110344.translatedText: The Chinese Communist Party has mastered a large amount of irrefutable evidence

55f527f1f92e6106ee13cb92bf2acab628966077.sourceText: 据这位消息人士透露，目前外界流传的中央”3号文件”及”5号文件”基本属实，即前重庆市副市长、公安局长王立军因与薄熙来发生矛盾擅自进入美国驻重庆总领事馆以及谷开来、薄瓜瓜与英国人海伍德发生经济利益冲突而涉嫌将其杀害。
55f527f1f92e6106ee13cb92bf2acab628966077.translatedText: According to this source, the central government's "No. 3 Document" and "No. 5 Document" currently circulating outside are basically true, namely that Wang Lijun, the former Chongqing deputy mayor and public security director, entered the U.S. Consulate General in Chongqing without authorization due to a conflict with Bo Xilai, and that Gu Kailai, Bo Guagua and the British Heywood were suspected of murdering him due to a conflict of economic interests.

ce2988c7f2a6b91f0437d8c667bc172e5fdf6b5e.sourceText: 根据这两份文件透露出的信息，中央高层包括胡锦涛在内，于两会前乃至两会召开之时对薄熙来问题依然没有清晰的脉络。但在中央调查组两个多月的调查过程当中，王立军爆出的有关薄熙来的问题越来越多，证据越来越充分，其他涉及人员也开始将薄熙来的情况进行交代。据了解，罪责性质之恶劣令中共高层都感到”相当震惊”。虽然此前外界普遍猜测薄熙来被中央”拿下”的主要原因是政治斗争，是其执政理念与中央不一致而产生路线问题。但现在种种证据显示，薄熙来问题远上升不到党内路线分歧，毕竟他仅是一个直辖市的市委书记。他涉及的是正在浮出水面的重大贪腐和刑事大案。
ce2988c7f2a6b91f0437d8c667bc172e5fdf6b5e.translatedText: According to the information revealed in these two documents, senior central officials, including Hu Jintao, still had no clear understanding of the Bo Xilai issue before and even at the time of the Two Sessions. However, during the more than two months of investigation by the Central Investigation Team, Wang Lijun exposed more and more questions about Bo Xilai, the evidence became more and more abundant, and other involved personnel also began to explain Bo Xilai's situation. It is understood that the egregious nature of the crime made even the top leaders of the CCP feel "quite shocked." Although it has been widely speculated that the main reason why Bo Xilai was "taken down" by the central government was political struggle, and that his governance philosophy was inconsistent with the central government's and caused line issues. But now various evidence shows that the issue of Bo Xilai is far less than the disagreement over the party's line. After all, he is only the municipal party committee secretary of a municipality directly under the central government. He was involved in major corruption and criminal cases that were surfacing.

0764e167020e7b87ec8e5c96f00b7b1621c7951f.sourceText: 据悉，目前薄熙来所面临的指控包括：1、与英国人海伍德被杀一案有直接关系，并有可能涉及其他多起重大刑事案件。2、数目巨大的贪腐金额和不明财产，其海外资产远远不止此前流传的80亿元人民币。3、在主政辽宁省（尤其是大连市）、重庆市等地期间大搞”家天下”、”山头主义”。 为满足其个人利益，不惜动用手中的党政大权，专横跋扈，无法无天，其培育的党羽势力和小圈子渗透蔓延党政商业等机构，为其获得政治权益和经济利益提供条件。
0764e167020e7b87ec8e5c96f00b7b1621c7951f.translatedText: It is reported that the charges currently faced by Bo Xilai include: 1. Directly related to the murder of British Heywood, and may be involved in many other major criminal cases. 2. There is a huge amount of corruption and unidentified property, and its overseas assets are far more than the 8 billion yuan previously circulated. 3. When he was in charge of Liaoning Province (especially Dalian City), Chongqing City and other places, he promoted "family world" and "shantou doctrine". In order to satisfy his personal interests, he does not hesitate to use the power of the party and government in his hands. He is domineering and lawless. The party members and small circles he has cultivated have penetrated and spread into party, government, business and other institutions, providing conditions for him to obtain political rights and economic interests.

504e7026ea655ef2fd5cc2c0c6973aa295b362b0.sourceText: 对此，已有多个消息源指出，虽然目前官方尚未公布对薄熙来的进一步的调查结果，目前称其”违反党纪”也仅仅是一种非常”保守”说法，随后更为惊人的调查和处理结果将会陆续公布。由于其骇人的案件，薄熙来被判决死刑应不属意外。
504e7026ea655ef2fd5cc2c0c6973aa295b362b0.translatedText: In this regard, multiple sources have pointed out that although the official has not announced further investigation results against Bo Xilai, the current statement that he "violated party discipline" is just a very "conservative" statement. More shocking investigation and handling results will be announced one after another. Due to his horrific case, it is not surprising that Bo Xilai was sentenced to death.

342b0428a54ea6678c5e68a47364c7d6cb3a7633.sourceText: 成中共反腐决心试金石
342b0428a54ea6678c5e68a47364c7d6cb3a7633.translatedText: Became a touchstone of the CCP’s determination to fight corruption

1925d162868b53b88775ed23543c9892b903bd67.sourceText: 根据4月10日新华社公布官方通稿宣布对薄熙来妻子谷开来的处理通告中，最后一句以极为罕见的强烈措辞强调”有关部门负责人表示，我国是社会主义法治国家，法律的尊严和权威不容践踏。不论涉及到谁，只要触犯法律，都将依法处理，决不姑息”。暗示问题将走向一个可能性棗除谷开来外，薄熙来本人也涉及了性质严重的腐败、刑事案件。
1925d162868b53b88775ed23543c9892b903bd67.translatedText: According to the official press release issued by Xinhua News Agency on April 10 announcing the treatment of Bo Xilai’s wife Gu Kailai, the last sentence emphasized in extremely rare and strong terms that “the head of the relevant department stated that our country is a socialist country governed by the rule of law, and the dignity and authority of the law cannot be trampled on. No matter who is involved, as long as they violate the law, they will be dealt with in accordance with the law and will never be tolerated.” It hints at the possibility that the problem will move towards the future. In addition to Gu Kailai, Bo Xilai himself has also been involved in serious corruption and criminal cases.

a64ecf2d419774ec85e06a1bfd6a0b01fbba5393.sourceText: 自薄熙来主政大连开始，有关他与妻子谷开来贪污腐败的负面消息就在大陆坊间流传。虽然薄频频否认谷开来曾凭借其政治关系谋取商业利益的传闻。但中纪委目前掌握的大量证据显示，目前薄家名下在海外有超过80亿人民币的巨额资金来源不明；大量的海外投资涉及洗钱交易；原先声称早已关闭的律师事务所事实上也一直在为”打黑”提供法律咨询并从中获益；其子薄瓜瓜被怀疑在”黑金”的捐助下赴美留学；而被认为是薄家”金主”的大连实德集团董事长徐明被中纪委带走协助调查的消息，也成为该项指控成立的有力证据之一。
a64ecf2d419774ec85e06a1bfd6a0b01fbba5393.translatedText: Since Bo Xilai took power in Dalian, negative news about the corruption of him and his wife Gu Kailai has been circulating in mainland China. Although Bo frequently denied the rumors that Gu Kailai had relied on her political connections to seek business interests. However, a large amount of evidence currently available to the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection shows that the Bo family currently has a huge amount of more than 8 billion yuan of funds overseas with unknown sources; a large number of overseas investments involve money laundering transactions; and the law firm that originally claimed to have been closed has actually been providing services for the "crackdown". He received legal advice and benefited from it; his son Bo Guagua was suspected of studying in the United States with donations from "black money"; and the news that Xu Ming, chairman of Dalian Shide Group, who was considered the "finance master" of the Bo family, was taken away by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection to assist in the investigation, has also become one of the strong evidences for the establishment of this accusation.

088e18c0827f251203637091cd722c520f2c0296.sourceText: 假若薄熙来贪污腐败罪名成立，能否将其法办将考验中共的反腐决心。2012年年初，胡、温二人即郑重向整个社会表达反腐决心。随后，被认为是下一届中共领导人的习近平多次出台讲话，谈党的廉政建设，并在3月16日《求是》杂志刊文，提出领导干部要以身作则带头保持党的纯洁性。再联系今年早些时候解放军总后勤部副部长谷俊山中将因贪腐落马，胡锦涛成立全军审计组整肃军队等一系列动作，可以彰显中共在十八大前的贪腐决心之大。此时，如何惩治薄熙来这个前政治局委员、重庆市委书记、外界眼中的”红二代”，也成为中共兑现承诺，取信于民的”试金石”。
088e18c0827f251203637091cd722c520f2c0296.translatedText: If Bo Xilai is found guilty of corruption, whether he can be brought to justice will test the CCP's determination to fight corruption. In early 2012, Hu and Wen solemnly expressed their determination to fight corruption to the entire society. Subsequently, Xi Jinping, who is considered the next leader of the Communist Party of China, gave many speeches to talk about the party's clean government. In an article published in "Qiushi" magazine on March 16, he proposed that leading cadres should set an example and take the lead in maintaining the party's purity. Coupled with a series of actions such as the dismissal of Lieutenant General Gu Junshan, deputy director of the General Logistics Department of the People's Liberation Army earlier this year due to corruption, and Hu Jintao's establishment of an army-wide audit team to rectify the army, it can be seen that the CCP is determined to commit corruption before the 18th National Congress. At this time, how to punish Bo Xilai, a former member of the Politburo, Secretary of the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee, and the "Second Generation Red" in the eyes of the outside world, has become a "touchstone" for the CCP to fulfill its promises and win the trust of the people.

c5e3b61161e9099609d29d2b977d3afbb0fe44d3.sourceText: 不能完全否定”唱红打黑”
c5e3b61161e9099609d29d2b977d3afbb0fe44d3.translatedText: "Singing red and fighting gangsters" cannot be completely denied

4053e9ce769ad61ee42ac2d0c3a52d02edfa674b.sourceText: 对于外界认为薄熙来因为进行”路线斗争”而导致其下台的猜测，有政治观察人士指出，薄熙来无论从其个人的政治能量、党内地位还是其在重庆的所作所为对中共全党产生的影响来看，都不足以构成”路线斗争”的标准。目前中共仅确定薄熙来有”政治问题”，只是暂时没有公布于众。
4053e9ce769ad61ee42ac2d0c3a52d02edfa674b.translatedText: Regarding the speculation that Bo Xilai stepped down because of his "line struggle", some political observers pointed out that Bo Xilai's personal political energy, status within the party, or the impact of his actions in Chongqing on the entire CCP are not enough to constitute a "line struggle". At present, the CCP has only determined that Bo Xilai has "political problems", but has not made it public yet.

ee52e343a4fd6df24ae0c7a65b9f094e80a83e99.sourceText: 而对于薄熙来在重庆进行的”唱红打黑”运动，自始至终中央都没表示否定。表明在中共领导人的眼里，如果撇清其薄熙来个人的政治因素及运动式的处理方式，”唱红打黑”本身并无不妥之处。反而在中国经过几十年的经济建设后所面临的现实情况下有其存在的必要性和必然性。”唱红”符合中共的基本属性，既能继续保持中共作为一个崇尚社会主义政党的纯洁性，又能对今天已经极度”物质崇拜”的民众进行道德教化。而”打黑”则更是应民所愿，对社会转型期出现的黑暗面进行清扫，保证整个社会的稳定和可持久性。
ee52e343a4fd6df24ae0c7a65b9f094e80a83e99.translatedText: As for Bo Xilai's "singing red and cracking down on gangsters" campaign in Chongqing, the central government did not deny it from beginning to end. This shows that in the eyes of the CCP leaders, if one puts aside Bo Xilai’s personal political factors and campaign-style handling methods, there is nothing wrong with “singing reds and cracking down on gangsters” in itself. On the contrary, it has the necessity and inevitability of its existence in the reality faced by China after decades of economic construction. "Singing famously" is in line with the basic attributes of the CCP. It can not only continue to maintain the purity of the CCP as a party that advocates socialism, but also provide moral enlightenment to today's people who have extremely "materialistic worship." The "cracking down on gangsters" is more in line with the people's wishes, cleaning up the dark side that emerged during the social transformation period, and ensuring the stability and sustainability of the entire society.

9e8ba9974e03f9d368b5c78843ee66901f80b326.sourceText: 翻看中共党史，在”落马”的政治局委员或以上的高官中，只有文革后的江青、张春桥被法庭宣判死刑，缓期两年执行。因此，假如根据消息源的爆料，薄熙来有可能将成为中共有史以来首位被判死刑的”政治局委员”。这对即将在今年秋季举行的中共十八大产生怎样的影响，对整个中国政坛有怎样的震动，都有待于进一步观察。
9e8ba9974e03f9d368b5c78843ee66901f80b326.translatedText: Looking at the history of the Communist Party of China, among the "fallen" Politburo members or above, only Jiang Qing and Zhang Chunqiao were sentenced to death by the court after the Cultural Revolution, with a two-year reprieve. Therefore, if according to the information revealed by the source, Bo Xilai may become the first "Member of the Politburo" sentenced to death in the history of the CCP. It remains to be seen what impact this will have on the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China to be held this fall, and how it will shock the entire Chinese political arena.

fddb3395b836565061bb835c53ca087e4b61e3b4.sourceText: 渔猎部颁布网上钓鱼地图 （亚省时报） 亚利桑那州游戏及渔猎部推出新的网上钓鱼地图，为喜爱钓鱼的人们提供了方便。 渔猎部公布了可钓鱼的湖泊、溪流和河流共150处，同时也有这些水域常见的鱼种信息。除此150处外，人们在任何本州水域钓鱼是非法的。 地图的详情，请参阅：gis.azgfd.gov/fishandboat。
fddb3395b836565061bb835c53ca087e4b61e3b4.translatedText: Department of Fish and Game releases online fishing map (Alberta Times) The Arizona Game, Fish and Game Department has launched a new online fishing map to provide convenience for people who love fishing. The Department of Fish and Game has announced a total of 150 lakes, streams and rivers that can be fished, as well as information on common fish species in these waters. Except for these 150 places, it is illegal for people to fish in any state waters. For map details, see: gis.azgfd.gov/fishandboat.

17bb9f82c90799f8aff7143c4eb2681de3635a45.sourceText: 交通管理公司招工 （亚省时报） 交通管理公司GlobalTran将在凤凰城建立新工作基地，并为之带来至少100个新的就业机会。 职位包括销售代表，营运商的采购代表和客户服务代表。这些职位不需要工作经验。 GlobalTran公司于三家州立大学和其他高校合作，有吸收应届大学毕业生的计划，但也向社会招工。 GlobalTran在凤凰城的公司在101高速和56街附近，拥有7500英尺的办公楼。
17bb9f82c90799f8aff7143c4eb2681de3635a45.translatedText: Traffic management company recruiting (Alberta Times) Traffic management company GlobalTran will establish a new work base in Phoenix and bring at least 100 new job opportunities. Positions include sales representative, carrier purchasing representative and customer service representative. No work experience is required for these positions. GlobalTran cooperates with three state universities and other colleges and universities. It has plans to recruit recent college graduates, but it also recruits workers from the society. GlobalTran's Phoenix office has a 7,500-square-foot office building near Highway 101 and 56th Street.

e994a0921611a1c4ea57222d068cf3987967df73.sourceText: 州府有意让各市合法拘留酗酒人士 （亚省时报） 本州的立法机关在推进一项法案，赋予各城市权力，逮捕因酗酒闹事对自己或他人构成威胁的人。 参议会法案1351将允许城市经营自己的拘留所，或与郡、州签订使用拘留所的合同，用于拘捕在公共场所酗酒过激，造成危险的人士。 法案已在众议会通过，州长首肯，需要参议会最后表决。 本案由共和党籍喷泉山众议员约翰卡瓦纳提出。他说，这法案与现行的交通酒驾法例不冲突。 该法起源于一桩当地执法。去年12月20日，斯格思岱尔市法官詹姆斯布雷克裁定斯格思岱尔市对酗酒闹事人执法违法，禁止郡、市使用州法对酗酒人士拘捕。 斯格思岱尔警方说，在市中心繁华娱乐区逮捕酗酒人已成为他们的主要工作之一。在Scottsdale路东至南 Camelback 路一带，是高密度的夜总会和酒吧地区，也是酗酒人密集场所。 斯格思岱尔警察联谊总裁吉姆诺兰说：”我们希望沉迷酒精的人士能找到回家的路，至少有一个安全方式找到自己的家人。” 由于没有逮捕权利，诺兰说，他和他的同事经常看到那些宿醉在街头的人，只能让他们自生自灭。
e994a0921611a1c4ea57222d068cf3987967df73.translatedText: The state intends to let cities legally detain drunken people (Alberta Times) The state's legislature is advancing a bill that would give cities the power to arrest people who pose a threat to themselves or others due to drunkenness and disorder. Senate Bill 1351 would allow cities to operate their own detention facilities or contract with counties or states to use detention facilities to detain people who are excessively drunk in public places and pose a danger. The bill has been passed by the House of Representatives, approved by the governor, and needs a final vote by the Senate. The case was brought by Rep. John Kavanagh, R-Fountain Hills. He said the bill does not conflict with existing traffic and drunk driving laws. The law originated from a local law enforcement incident. On December 20 last year, Scottsdale City Judge James Blake ruled that the city of Scottsdale violated the law in enforcing the law on drunken troublemakers and prohibited counties and cities from using state laws to arrest drunken people. Scottsdale police say arresting drunken people in downtown's bustling entertainment district has become one of their main priorities. The area from Scottsdale Road east to Camelback Road south is a high-density area of ​​nightclubs and bars, as well as a gathering place for alcoholics. "We want people who are addicted to alcohol to be able to find their way home and at least have a safe way to find their families," said Jim Nolan, president of the Scottsdale Police Fraternity. Without arrest powers, Nolan said he and his colleagues often see hungover people on the streets, leaving them to fend for themselves.

cf3bd54addecd835526a9f0399a17ee97aaa6df2.sourceText: 75%的美国人上厕所用手机 男性更甚 （亚省时报） 如果下次你跟同事打电话听到马桶的抽水声，可千万别惊讶。最新研究显示，75%的美国人会在卫生间里使用手机。 市场研究机构11mark调查1000位美国人发现，男性和女性上卫生间时使用手机的比例大体相同，不过男性似乎更喜欢上厕所时用手机。30%的男性和20%的女性同意这一说法：”我上厕所就得带着手机”。 超过一半的调查对象（63%）会在厕所里接电话，几乎一半的调查者（41%）则会在厕所里打电话。不过情况还不止如此：卫生间里的挂壁式电话可以实现 智能手机的所有功能。76%的调查对象会在卫生间里读短信息，39%的人会浏览网页。男性在卫生间里更会忙工作：20%的男性称会接跟工作相关的电话，而 女性则只有13%。 一如预期，年轻的Y代人（1981年后出生）是”移动无处不在”行动的标兵，91%的年轻一代表示会在厕所里使用手机。不过，老一代的人们也不甘落 后：80%的X代人（1961年到1981年出生）会在厕所使用手机；婴儿潮一代（1946年至1965年出生）有65%；沉默一代（1925年至 1945年出生）则有47%。 不过智能手机在线，用户可不仅仅是浏览网页。16%的年轻一代表示他们会在厕所网购。iPhone手机用户尤其可能在厕所里刷网页和网购：22%的iPhone手机用户都在卫生间网购过，而全美手机用户网购的比例也只有10%。 11mark负责人Nicole Burdette表示：”就像卫生间的标语写的那样，这个研究也证实了我们都了解的事实：最后的一片隐私地也没了隐私。” 研究结果发现，在厕所打手机的过程中，高科技时代的卫生安全也受到了打击。92%的手机用户表示在上完卫生间后会洗手，但只有14%的人表示会清洁手机。
cf3bd54addecd835526a9f0399a17ee97aaa6df2.translatedText: 75% of Americans use their cell phones in the bathroom, even more so among men (Alberta Times) Don’t be surprised if you hear the toilet flush next time you’re on the phone with a coworker. New research shows that 75% of Americans use their phones in the bathroom. Market research firm 11mark surveyed 1,000 Americans and found that men and women use mobile phones in the bathroom at roughly the same rate, but men seem to prefer using their phones in the bathroom. 30% of men and 20% of women agreed with the statement: "I have to take my phone with me when I go to the bathroom." More than half of the respondents (63%) answer the phone in the toilet, and almost half (41%) do so in the toilet. But there's more: a wall-mounted phone in the bathroom can perform all the functions of a smartphone. 76% of respondents read text messages in the bathroom, and 39% browse the web. Men are more likely to be busy working in the bathroom: 20% of men said they answer work-related calls, compared with only 13% of women. As expected, the young Generation Y (born after 1981) is the pacesetter in the "Mobile Everywhere" movement, with 91% of the younger generation saying they use their mobile phones in the toilet. However, the older generations are not far behind: 80% of Generation But with smartphones online, users can do more than just browse the web. 16% of the younger generation said they would shop online from the toilet. iPhone users are especially likely to browse the web and shop online in the bathroom: 22% of iPhone users have made online purchases in the bathroom, while only 10% of U.S. mobile phone users shop online. Nicole Burdette, the person in charge of 11mark, said: "Just like the slogan in the bathroom says, this study also confirms what we all know: the last place of privacy is no longer private." The study results found that in the process of using mobile phones in the bathroom, health safety in the high-tech era has also been hit. 92% of mobile phone users said they wash their hands after using the bathroom, but only 14% said they clean their phones.

3e7a539e393cb17c270826042becda1ccabd4bc4.sourceText: 来自台湾的亚省华裔花漫野小姐Laetitia Hua，荣获美国主流2012年亚利桑那妙龄小姐后冠Miss Arizona Teen America，花漫野Laetitia Hua将是唯一代表亚利桑那州，前往美国田纳西州参加美国全美妙龄小姐Miss Teen America选美竞赛。 花漫野小姐Laetitia Hua今年刚满十八岁，美丽优雅，诚恳大方，又十分热心公益，目前就读Chaparral 高中四年级，是学校品学兼优的高材生与模范生，功课好又非常多才多艺，自小就有多种语言天分，会中文、英文、法文及西班牙文，也精通画画、舞蹈、钢琴和小提琴，同时在绘画，舞蹈，和音乐方面曾获得过很多次第一名和杰出优胜奖项，也得到过Ball Room Dance第一名。 花漫野Laetitia Hua在2010年曾经在美国主流两百多位参赛佳丽中，得到凤凰城青少年小姐后冠Miss Jr.Teen Phoenix，如今又得到亚利桑那妙龄小姐后冠Miss Arizona Teen America，她是在美国主流社会里唯一的华裔有如此杰出的成就，可见她有很卓越与优秀的条件，才能连续获得两顶后冠，现在祝福她代表亚利桑那州有更优胜的成绩。 花漫野Laetitia Hua的取名是来自圣经，意思是天上的飞鸟和野地的花都会受到神的眷顾。花漫野Laetitia Hua很高兴能代表亚利桑那州参加美国妙龄小姐选美竞赛，她表示人生是需要不断的学习与增长经验，借着学习可以让自己成长和增加智慧，借着选美的经验，可以培养独立，建立自信，以及宣传中华文化与促进多元文化交流。 花漫野Laetitia Hua是唯一代表亚利桑那州，到田纳西州参加全美的妙龄小姐选美竞赛，同时每一州都有投票，支持自己的佳丽竞选全美妙龄小姐，由Facebook大众选出最上镜头小姐，希望亚利桑那州的乡亲也能支持花漫野Laetitia Hua，请上您的Facebook，找到Miss Arizona Teen America 2012 Like Laetitia Hua photo to vote投票。
3e7a539e393cb17c270826042becda1ccabd4bc4.translatedText: Laetitia Hua, a Chinese-American from Taiwan, won the Miss Arizona Teen America title in 2012. Laetitia Hua will be the only representative of Arizona to participate in the Miss Teen America beauty pageant in Tennessee, USA. Miss Hua Manye, Laetitia Hua, has just turned eighteen this year. She is beautiful, elegant, sincere and generous, and very enthusiastic about charity. She is currently studying at Chaparral In the fourth grade of high school, he is a top student and a model student with excellent academic performance in the school. He is good at homework and very versatile. He has been talented in multiple languages since he was a child. He can speak Chinese, English, French and Spanish. He is also proficient in painting, dance, piano and violin. At the same time, he has won many first places and outstanding awards in painting, dance, and music, and also won the first place in Ball Room Dance. In 2010, Laetitia Hua won the title of Miss Jr.Teen Phoenix among more than two hundred mainstream beauties in the United States. Now she has won the title of Miss Arizona Teen America. She is the only Chinese American in mainstream society in the United States to have such an outstanding achievement. It shows that she has excellent and excellent conditions to win two crowns in a row. Now I wish her better results on behalf of Arizona. The name of Laetitia Hua comes from the Bible, which means that the birds in the sky and the flowers in the field will be favored by God. Laetitia Hua is very happy to represent Arizona in the Miss Teen USA pageant. She said that life requires constant learning and experience. Through learning, you can grow and increase your wisdom. Through the experience of the beauty pageant, you can cultivate independence, build self-confidence, promote Chinese culture and promote multicultural exchanges. Laetitia Hua is the only one representing Arizona to participate in the Miss Teen America pageant in Tennessee. At the same time, every state has a vote to support its own beauty to compete for Miss Teen America. The Facebook public will select the most photographed girl. I hope that the folks in Arizona can also support Laetitia Hua. Please go to your Facebook and find Miss Arizona Teen America 2012 Like Laetitia Hua photo to vote.

52770406a31d5ee6682d85110b468eca39f59522.sourceText: （亚省时报报道）由新美国媒体（ New America Media ）与亚利桑那州立大学 沃尔特 朗凯特新闻学院 ( Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication)
52770406a31d5ee6682d85110b468eca39f59522.translatedText: (Alberta Times report) The "Environment and 2012 Elections" Arizona Minority Media Exchange, co-organized by New America Media and Arizona State University's Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication

5746c473076fca1aec515fed8d224d6d9502d021.sourceText: 共同举办的”环境与 2012 选举”亚利桑那少数族裔媒体交流会，于 4 月 11 日在亚利桑那州立大学市中心校区圆满举行。当日有近十家少数族裔媒体参加了会谈。大凤凰城华人侨团总会（侨联）会长张华芳，亚省时报主编 新闻主管谢成彦代表华裔出席，在会上就华裔社区对环境和选举问题发表了看法。
5746c473076fca1aec515fed8d224d6d9502d021.translatedText: , was successfully held on April 11 at the downtown campus of Arizona State University. Nearly ten ethnic minority media outlets participated in the meeting that day. Zhang Huafang, president of the Chinese Overseas Chinese Association of Greater Phoenix (Overseas Chinese Federation), and Xie Chengyan, editor-in-chief and news director of the Alberta Times, attended on behalf of the Chinese and expressed their views on environmental and election issues in the Chinese community at the meeting.

f41e718e9b73ae233da9c1ad65721caac2208a4c.sourceText: 新美国媒体的执行总监桑迪克洛斯（ Sandy Close ）首先致辞欢迎媒体和社区代表的出席，并强调了少数媒体的声音对城市管理政策出台的重要性。就少数族裔对环境问题的投票支持率，从事洛矶山保护在西部调查的大卫 梅兹（ Dave Metz ）布伦丹 (Brendan P Boepple) 都对调查数据中少数族裔的投票情况做了详细分析。从洛矶山保护项目投票中看，少数族裔与西裔观点基本一致的。”阳光走廊保护项目”的负责人大卫 瑞琼斯（ Dave Richins ）就他们正在从事的经济发展与天然沙漠，开放空间，城市生活四个方面的增长与变化，可持续发展的模式，做了介绍。亚利桑那荒漠联盟，黑美莎水联盟，将保护母亲河，保护水源问题的紧迫性。他们介绍目前一些印第安保护区依然处于无水，无电的情况，环境保护和经济发展迫在眉睫。这些问题的解决，都希望得到少数族裔的支持和投票，最终影响政客们的决策。
f41e718e9b73ae233da9c1ad65721caac2208a4c.translatedText: Sandy Close, executive director of New American Media, first made a speech to welcome the media and community representatives to attend, and emphasized the importance of the voices of minority media in the formulation of urban management policies. Regarding the voting support of ethnic minorities on environmental issues, Dave Metz and Brendan P Boepple, who are engaged in the Rocky Mountain Conservation in the West survey, have made detailed analysis of the voting status of ethnic minorities in the survey data. Judging from the voting on the Rocky Mountain Conservation Project, the views of minorities and Hispanics are basically the same. Dave Richins, the person in charge of the "Sun Corridor Protection Project", gave an introduction to the economic development they are engaged in, the growth and changes in four aspects of natural desert, open space, urban life, and the sustainable development model. The Arizona Desert Alliance, Black Mesa Water Alliance, will protect the Mother River and protect the urgency of water issues. They introduced that some Indian reserves are still without water or electricity, and environmental protection and economic development are urgent. To solve these problems, we hope to gain the support and votes of ethnic minorities, which will ultimately influence the decision-making of politicians.

8098bc5fc02255d73db61e132649b62fa9bfb8e9.sourceText: 侨联主席接受新美国媒体采访
8098bc5fc02255d73db61e132649b62fa9bfb8e9.translatedText: Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation was interviewed by New America Media

166e7912e601d4d8b829c9fe3291ce0519de1383.sourceText: 侨联主席张华芳表示华裔社区是有重视环境问题的长远历史，中国的”风水”就是研究环境与人类生存的重要关系。但是中国移民来到美国后，面对着很大的生存压力，往往忽视对环境的关注。亚省时报主编 新闻主管谢成彦则从媒体的角度出发，首先提出华裔新移民关注工作，关注日常生活中的开支，关注孩子教育，环境问题被放在其后。作为媒体就应该从细节联系主流事件。将环境问题的阐述与新移民关心的问题联系起来。例如大家呼吁使用新能源，那么就应该给新移民算个账，新能源的使用会对他们每月交的水电费造成怎样的影响，为环境问题投票，在新政策出台后，给移民的日常生活带来的变化做详细的分析。深入浅出的介绍，才能更好的建立起环境科学研究与选民的桥梁。
166e7912e601d4d8b829c9fe3291ce0519de1383.translatedText: Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Zhang Huafang said that the Chinese community has a long history of attaching importance to environmental issues. Chinese "Feng Shui" is the study of the important relationship between the environment and human survival. However, after Chinese immigrants came to the United States, they faced great pressure to survive and often neglected to pay attention to the environment. From the perspective of the media, Xie Chengyan, editor-in-chief and news director of the Alberta Times, first proposed that new Chinese immigrants should focus on work, daily expenses, and children’s education, and environmental issues should be put second. As a media, you should contact mainstream events from the details. Relate the articulation of environmental issues to issues of concern to newcomers. For example, if everyone calls for the use of new energy, then we should calculate accounts for new immigrants, how the use of new energy will affect their monthly utility bills, vote for environmental issues, and conduct a detailed analysis of the changes brought to the daily lives of immigrants after the introduction of new policies. An in-depth and simple introduction can better build a bridge between environmental scientific research and voters.

b0ef92e5855254664192e095e23e61334a6e8497.sourceText: 与会者都表示这样的交流会有深远的意义，一方面让媒体了解目前环境保护各个领域的最新发展，同时也通过媒体将这些信息带到每个少数族裔社区。
b0ef92e5855254664192e095e23e61334a6e8497.translatedText: Participants said that such exchanges would be of far-reaching significance. On the one hand, they would allow the media to understand the latest developments in various fields of environmental protection, and at the same time, they would also bring this information to every minority community through the media.

7f9ed2416a819703701c6f94a696230a1fd7fc75.sourceText: 中国留学生赴美国留学趋势成疯
7f9ed2416a819703701c6f94a696230a1fd7fc75.translatedText: The trend of Chinese students studying in the United States has become crazy

ea10d120209b303a7d07a5b1ed8b931a6c14900f.sourceText: 中国留学生赴美国留学趋势成疯 中国中产阶级人数不断增加，刺激了中国留学生赴美留学的浪潮。2010至2011…
ea10d120209b303a7d07a5b1ed8b931a6c14900f.translatedText: The trend of Chinese students studying in the United States has become crazy. The increasing number of Chinese middle class has stimulated a wave of Chinese students studying in the United States. 2010 to 2011…

9dd63ffca172aa8ce214fc797dec0e53c3d15d95.sourceText: 根据美国研究生院(the Council of Graduate Schools )最新调查报告显示，2012年中国大学生申请美国研究生学院的数量在今年9月份将上升18%，这一数据提前揭示了中国大学生赴美研究院留学继续上升的趋势。大部分中国留学生选择的留学项目为：工程学、商学以及地球科学。
9dd63ffca172aa8ce214fc797dec0e53c3d15d95.translatedText: According to the latest survey report of the Council of Graduate Schools, the number of Chinese college students applying to U.S. graduate schools in 2012 will increase by 18% in September this year. This data reveals in advance that the number of Chinese college students studying in U.S. graduate schools continues to rise. The study abroad programs chosen by most Chinese students are: engineering, business and earth sciences.

f2793bb0befe4777241146dc1801a73cc079d64f.sourceText: 据美国研究生学院集团分析人士介绍，2010年和2011年，中国赴美留学生数量分别上升20%、21%。这一数据已经连续7年每年保持双位数的增长。2012年，中国留学生赴美研究院的数量占美国际学生数量的一半，已经有514,298位留学生申请了赴美留学项目，最终通过申请的留学生数量将在今年夏季公布。
f2793bb0befe4777241146dc1801a73cc079d64f.translatedText: According to analysts from the American Graduate School Group, the number of Chinese students studying in the United States increased by 20% and 21% respectively in 2010 and 2011. This data has maintained double-digit growth every year for seven consecutive years. In 2012, the number of Chinese students studying in graduate schools in the United States accounted for half of the number of international students in the United States. 514,298 international students have applied for study abroad programs in the United States. The final number of international students who have successfully applied will be announced this summer.

0a7b2f3969f9227a72efe226fe88976983d60280.sourceText: 究其原因，很大程度上是因为中国中产阶级人数增加，对子女的教育愈加重视，将大笔资金投向美国昂贵的大学，促使赴美留学生数量大幅增加。与此同时，中国大学的教育体系质量不断提高，越来越多的中国留学生发现留学美国指日可待。另外，中国留学生赴美学习人数的增加，带动了他们周边的朋友以及同学申请赴美留学，这就是所谓的”指数效应”。
0a7b2f3969f9227a72efe226fe88976983d60280.translatedText: The reason is largely due to the increase in the number of Chinese middle class, which pays more and more attention to the education of their children and invests large sums of money in expensive universities in the United States, resulting in a substantial increase in the number of international students studying in the United States. At the same time, the quality of the education system at Chinese universities continues to improve, and more and more Chinese students are finding that studying in the United States is just around the corner. In addition, the increase in the number of Chinese students studying in the United States has driven their friends and classmates around them to apply to study in the United States. This is the so-called "exponential effect."

c506696d235d292448ec1aae4abada01f57111a0.sourceText: 申请美国研究生院的国际留学生中，中国留学生所占的比例大大超过其他国家。韩国和印度赴美留学研究生的比例这两年也有增加。
c506696d235d292448ec1aae4abada01f57111a0.translatedText: Among the international students applying to graduate schools in the United States, the proportion of Chinese students greatly exceeds that of other countries. The proportion of graduate students from South Korea and India studying in the United States has also increased in the past two years.

6a39c1538011ae71363028998a5fff37f7374b91.sourceText: 美国院校也致力于吸引中国留学生，行政人员表示，一些做学术研究的国际学生在调查过程中，会联系美国院校寻找项目研究伙伴，最终这些国际学生很有可能成为美国商院有利可图的、行政教育项目的学生。
6a39c1538011ae71363028998a5fff37f7374b91.translatedText: U.S. colleges and universities are also committed to attracting Chinese students. Administrators said that some international students doing academic research will contact U.S. colleges and universities to find project research partners during the investigation process. In the end, these international students are likely to become students in lucrative executive education projects in U.S. business schools.

617f0aefa2b7f2babf18fa88116d299442a16d6c.sourceText: 美国俄亥俄州大学，每年大约有1万名研究生毕业，已经在中国上海开设了招募国际学生的办事处。该项目今年招募的各国留学生数量较2011年上升18%；而在中国招募的留学生数量上升29%；在印度招募的国际留学生数量上升了3%。
617f0aefa2b7f2babf18fa88116d299442a16d6c.translatedText: Ohio State University in the United States, which graduates approximately 10,000 graduate students every year, has opened an office to recruit international students in Shanghai, China. The number of international students recruited by this project from various countries this year has increased by 18% compared with 2011; the number of international students recruited in China has increased by 29%; the number of international students recruited in India has increased by 3%.

582e5ac140aef1ab0aa48b4445b0f1a8ca0500b8.sourceText: 美国各大研究生院表示，对于当前留学生人数不断上升的现状不会自鸣得意，因为该市场依旧强劲。
582e5ac140aef1ab0aa48b4445b0f1a8ca0500b8.translatedText: Major graduate schools in the United States say they will not be complacent about the current rising number of international students because the market is still strong.

7c5f98d8763b4eada8f944b17dbb7ec0accd167b.sourceText: 根据美国研究生院数据显示，美国在2010年招募的国际留学生人数占总数的20%，2011年国际留学生招募人数上升至28%。
7c5f98d8763b4eada8f944b17dbb7ec0accd167b.translatedText: According to data from American graduate schools, the number of international students recruited in the United States accounted for 20% of the total in 2010, and the number of international students recruited in 2011 rose to 28%.

517c3bc377bbdea7a70be73772c35b024167cc39.sourceText: 美国研究生院委员会每年在2月、6月和9月份分别对所属的成员高校进行调查，统计各高校研究生院的申请者、被录取者以及实际注册的国际学生人数。研究生委员会的这些数据来自于全国145家研究生院得出，其中包括25家拥有国际学生最多的美国高校。
517c3bc377bbdea7a70be73772c35b024167cc39.translatedText: The American Council of Graduate Schools conducts surveys on its member universities in February, June and September every year to count the number of applicants, admitted students and actually registered international students in each university's graduate school. The Graduate Council's data comes from 145 graduate schools across the country, including the 25 U.S. colleges and universities with the largest number of international students.

2a33bbeaf89cfba0e719ea4b47a39ac508ebc6a3.sourceText: 愚人节：面对中国现状之无奈一笑
2a33bbeaf89cfba0e719ea4b47a39ac508ebc6a3.translatedText: April Fool's Day: A helpless smile in the face of China's current situation

e110e355fe88a1c9b3f73ce82b41e6aeee8038bf.sourceText: 愚人节：面对中国现状之无奈一笑 赵本山：请听题，他不认识你也代表你的人是谁？ 范 伟：私生子他爹。高秀敏：错！…
e110e355fe88a1c9b3f73ce82b41e6aeee8038bf.translatedText: April Fool's Day: A helpless smile in the face of China's current situation Zhao Benshan: Please listen to the question. Who is the person who represents you even if he doesn't know you? Fan Wei: His father is an illegitimate child. Gao Xiumin: Wrong! …

80a467f1ec66887407c3a0a220b019ac16cf5d3b.sourceText: 赵本山：请听题，他不认识你也代表你的人是谁？ 范 伟：私生子他爹。 高秀敏：错！是人大代表。
80a467f1ec66887407c3a0a220b019ac16cf5d3b.translatedText: Zhao Benshan: Please listen to the question. Who is the person who represents you even though he doesn’t know you? Fan Wei: His father is an illegitimate child. Gao Xiumin: Wrong! He is a deputy to the National People's Congress.

85d56474d143f4e29d21715adde1472e12b6b50d.sourceText: 赵本山：请听题，从小就听说有，但你现在一直没见过的是什么？ 范 伟：鬼。 高秀敏：错！是共产主义社会。
85d56474d143f4e29d21715adde1472e12b6b50d.translatedText: Zhao Benshan: Please listen to the question. I have heard about it since I was a child, but what is it that you have never seen? Fan Wei: Ghost. Gao Xiumin: Wrong! It is a communist society.

017a1d9dec8df911163dce6f5ef1db56fce201d2.sourceText: 赵本山：请听题，一个永远要你对她负责而她却不对你负责的是谁？ 范 伟：二奶。 高秀敏：错！是银行。
017a1d9dec8df911163dce6f5ef1db56fce201d2.translatedText: Zhao Benshan: Please listen to the question. Who is the person who always wants you to be responsible for her but she is not responsible for you? Fan Wei: Second wife. Gao Xiumin: Wrong! It's a bank.

0ac3c94994a7a88dc8672b78d0cf1373f5fd0a46.sourceText: 赵本山：请听题，你只有 10 平米的房屋，邻居从 0 平米换到 100 平米，你的居住面积有没有增加？ 范 伟：没有。 高秀敏：错，你附近的平均住房面积里被增加了 50 平米, 你的幸福感应明显增加, 来, 笑一个。
0ac3c94994a7a88dc8672b78d0cf1373f5fd0a46.translatedText: Zhao Benshan: Please listen to the question. You only have a house of 10 square meters, and your neighbor changes it from 0 square meters to 100 square meters. Has your living area increased? Fan Wei: No. Gao Xiumin: No, the average housing area in your neighborhood has been increased by 50 square meters, and your sense of happiness has increased significantly. Come on, have a smile.

07d107996d4501ced2ab6c68ee4f73c2e08fd4ce.sourceText: 赵本山：请听题，边做假药广告、边说假药效果、边痛斥假药危害的是什么？ 范 伟：江湖骗子。 高秀敏：错，是 CCTV 。
07d107996d4501ced2ab6c68ee4f73c2e08fd4ce.translatedText: Zhao Benshan: Please listen to the question. What is the point of advertising fake drugs, talking about the effects of fake drugs, and denouncing the dangers of fake drugs at the same time? Fan Wei: Charlatan. Gao Xiumin: Wrong, it’s CCTV.

2e53def2436aeca7049ae633a6467826ae272230.sourceText: 赵本山：请听题，中国当官要精通哪四种语言？ 范 伟：英语、法语、俄语和日语。 高秀敏：错！假话、空话、大话和套话。
2e53def2436aeca7049ae633a6467826ae272230.translatedText: Zhao Benshan: Please listen to the question. What four languages ​​do you need to be proficient in to be an official in China? Fan Wei: English, French, Russian and Japanese. Gao Xiumin: Wrong! Lies, empty words, big words and clichés.

1d7364c744049ccc01c24a12ab512fd8d66659a8.sourceText: 马利科巴郡任命新当家 汤姆马诺斯 （亚省时报） 马利科巴郡监事会周二通过，任命汤姆马诺斯为马利科巴郡政经理，接替4月27日退休的大卫史密斯。 59岁的马诺斯现任马利科巴郡工业发展局局长和郡人文服务经理。曾任郡审计经理和郡首席财政官。 66岁的大卫史密斯二月宣布退休，他为马利科巴郡服务超过17年。 马利科巴郡是全国第四大郡，政府工作预算为23亿美元，有3.8万居民。郡政经理是全郡最高行政长官。
1d7364c744049ccc01c24a12ab512fd8d66659a8.translatedText: Maricopa County appoints new manager Tom Manos (Alberta Times) The Maricopa County Board of Supervisors on Tuesday approved the appointment of Tom Manos as Maricopa County Manager, replacing David Smith, who retired on April 27. Manos, 59, is currently director of the Maricopa County Industrial Development Agency and county human services manager. Served as County Audit Manager and County Chief Financial Officer. David Smith, 66, announced his retirement in February after serving Maricopa County for more than 17 years. Maricopa County is the fourth largest county in the country, with a government budget of $2.3 billion and 38,000 residents. The county manager is the highest administrative officer in the county.

1c7f1c441dc1685b9f19ea0a087004d7ded1e981.sourceText: 参议会通过反堕胎法案 （亚省时报） 亚利桑那州参议会通过一项彻底的反堕胎法案，一般情况下，禁止任何机构为妊娠超过20周的女性堕胎，并要求需要堕胎的妇女观看由州府特别设立的网页内胎儿图像。 根据法案，20周禁止堕胎法并不适用于医疗紧急情况，对本州的人工流产个案不会造成很大的影响。支持者说，在怀孕20周后，胎儿能感觉到疼痛。 民主党人认为，医生不能百分百确定怀孕周数，”任意”的最后期限可能妨碍医生诊断胎儿异常。 法案以20:10通过，返回众议会作最后审批。
1c7f1c441dc1685b9f19ea0a087004d7ded1e981.translatedText: The Senate passed an anti-abortion bill (Alberta Times) The Arizona Senate passed a thorough anti-abortion bill that generally prohibits any institution from providing abortions to women over 20 weeks of pregnancy and requires women who need abortions to view fetal images on a webpage specially set up by the state. According to the bill, the 20-week abortion ban does not apply to medical emergencies and will not have a major impact on abortion cases in the state. Supporters say the fetus can feel pain after 20 weeks of pregnancy. Democrats argue that doctors cannot be 100 percent certain about the number of weeks into pregnancy and that the "arbitrary" deadline could prevent doctors from diagnosing fetal abnormalities. The bill passed by 20:10 and returned to the House of Representatives for final approval.

95598bf411a010c1972456d3a5d3ee28c0a35dd0.sourceText: 液压故障 全美航班飞返空港 （亚省时报） 周一下午，全美航空(US Airway)一架从凤凰城飞往华盛顿特区的航班，因液压故障，飞返空港机场。 联邦航管局发言人说，这架空客320在周一下午3:15安全飞抵空港机场。目前尚不清楚是什么原因引起液压故障。全美航空官员也没有对此次紧急返航作出评论。 这架飞机原定飞往华盛顿的罗纳德里根国家机场，当局也没公布机上有多少乘客。
95598bf411a010c1972456d3a5d3ee28c0a35dd0.translatedText: Hydraulic failure, a US Airways flight returned to the airport (Alberta Times) On Monday afternoon, a US Airway flight from Phoenix to Washington, D.C., returned to the airport due to a hydraulic failure. A spokesman for the Federal Aviation Administration said the Airbus 320 arrived at the airport safely at 3:15 pm on Monday. It's unclear what caused the hydraulic failure. US Airways officials also did not comment on the emergency return. The plane was bound for Ronald Reagan National Airport in Washington, and authorities did not release how many passengers were on board.

addd92c037ddeb6f09f14b6f67ccb4aad4ac2f1b.sourceText: 油价飙升 驾车者吝惜分毫 （亚省时报） 油价高居不下，悭油悭油的方法层出不穷。使用公共交通工具，骑自行车出行不失为好方法。有人不用到油箱最后一滴油不加油，则得不偿失。 美国汽车协会(AAA)数据显示，今年1月因燃料耗尽汽车半路抛锚而寻求拖车服务的个案，比2011年同期增加了14%，2月上涨更快，同比增加了16%。 AAA表示，汽车在油箱耗尽的情况下运行，不仅不能省油省钱，反而导致油泵损坏，过滤器或注射器损耗等，车主往往为此付出昂贵的维修费。 改变驾驶习惯也许能为你省油，比如减少踩刹车，匀速行驶，减少忽然加速等。
addd92c037ddeb6f09f14b6f67ccb4aad4ac2f1b.translatedText: Soaring gas prices, motorists are stingy with every penny (Alberta Times) With gas prices remaining high, there are endless ways to save fuel. Using public transportation or cycling is a good way to get around. If someone doesn't refuel to the last drop of fuel in the tank, the gain outweighs the loss. Data from the American Automobile Association (AAA) shows that in January this year, the number of cases seeking towing services because cars broke down because they ran out of fuel increased by 14% compared with the same period in 2011. The increase was even faster in February, with a year-on-year increase of 16%. AAA said that running a car with a depleted fuel tank not only fails to save fuel and money, but also causes damage to the oil pump, loss of filters or syringes, etc., for which car owners often pay expensive repair fees. Changing your driving habits may help you save fuel, such as braking less, driving at a constant speed, and reducing sudden acceleration.
