d54e03fb7fa45eb88bd8fd02979faf4b92a23e08.sourceText: 斐匿华人耆英会春宴联欢于3月24日晚在六福酒家举行，三百二十人出席。华人耆英们载歌载舞，表演灯笼舞、民族舞，还有大合唱和独唱等，别看他们年过半百，表演起来都尽心尽力，身手利落，舞姿优美，在座每一位宾客都受到感染，个个笑逐顔开，沉浸在他们带来的欢乐气氛中。 当晚的宴会由吴亮祖、李爱珍主持。 斐匿华人耆英会主席邓情芬分别用英文及广东话致欢迎词，杨济群用国语翻译。 本州议员余艳芬、副市长约翰逊、市政府总经理克瓦索斯先后致词。 在吴亮祖介绍来宾之后，是灯笼舞表演以及国语歌合唱”大地回春”和”迎春花”。由于国语歌咏团的电子琴伴奏师当晚不能出席，他们临时请来一位小妹妹梁嘉恩帮忙伴奏，原来这位小朋友在维也纳Golden Key International Piano作曲比赛中，获得青少年11-14岁组的第三名，她将于今年七月到维也纳国际音乐节参加颁奖典礼并表演，当主持人介绍这位梁嘉恩小妹妹时，她立刻成为了当晚宴会的亮点。 接着邓情芬主席带领耆英会全体职员向大家举杯敬酒祝贺新年。 由戚云清和罗淑庄表演的、独具特色的新疆民族舞蹈”大坂城的姑娘”获得观众热烈的掌声。 邓情芬主席、闵中英副主席、裴霞云主任代表耆英会,向崔增祈、司徒存、毕南、马笑梅、邓月庭、高月英六位会员颁发了服务奖。 之后是粤语歌咏团的合唱”贺新年”和”彩云追月”，粤语组的阵容有40人之多，虽然都是年过半百的耆英，但大家都老当益壮，演唱得很认真、很投入，让观众融入他们的快乐气氛之中。 当晚获得奖学金的学生有：头奖Emily Yee；二奖Joseph Dong；三奖陈子铭。获得题名奖的分别是：司徒欣华、黄颖思。本年度的奖学金赞助单位是：邓广肇家族纪念奖学金共一千元。 周贵卿演唱粤曲”红棉赞”，她浑厚的声音，专业的表演，获得观众喝彩和好评，并一致要求她加唱两首。 晚会的抽奖奖品均由尹凤影、六福酒家、南华酒家、红锅布斐、欣欣超市赞助。 向来热心支持耆英会的资深侨领余文劲、胡寿柏、余文裕夫人、余文伟夫人，共同捐助华人耆英会瑞狮团经费二百元，以表示鼓励之意。 最后由副主席闵中英、英文书记尹凤影分别用中英文致答谢词，晚会在一片喜气洋洋及欢乐气氛中结束。 看着这些耆英们，能拥有如此健康的体魄及欢乐年轻的心境，我深感羡慕，并深深感到，其实年龄并不重要，关键是心境，心态好，身体自然会健康。 在此衷心祝愿所有华人耆英健康长寿，生活幸福，希望明年再与他们共聚，共度欢乐好时光。
d54e03fb7fa45eb88bd8fd02979faf4b92a23e08.translatedText: The Spring Banquet of the Phoenix Chinese Senior Citizens Association was held at Lukfook Restaurant on the evening of March 24th, with 320 people in attendance. The Chinese senior citizens sang and danced, performing lantern dances, folk dances, cantata and solos, etc. Even though they were over fifty years old, they performed with all their heart and soul, with nimble skills and graceful dancing. Every guest present was infected and smiled brightly, immersed in the joyful atmosphere they brought. The banquet that night was hosted by Wu Liangzu and Li Aizhen. Chairman of the Phenomenal Chinese Senior Citizens Association, Deng Qingfen, delivered welcome speeches in English and Cantonese respectively, and Yang Jiqun translated in Mandarin. State Councilor Yu Yanfen, Vice Mayor Johnson, and Municipal Government General Manager Kvassos delivered speeches successively. After Wu Liangzu introduced the guests, there was a lantern dance performance and the Mandarin song chorus "The Earth Rejuvenates" and "Spring Flowers". Since the electronic piano accompanist of the Mandarin Chorus could not attend that night, they temporarily invited a little sister Liang Jiaen to help with the accompaniment. It turned out that this child won the third place in the 11-14-year-old youth group in the Golden Key International Piano Composition Competition in Vienna. She will attend the award ceremony and perform at the Vienna International Music Festival in July this year. When the host introduced this little sister Liang Jiaen, she immediately became the highlight of the banquet that night. Then Chairman Deng Qingfen led all the staff of the Senior Citizens Association to toast everyone to celebrate the New Year. The unique Xinjiang folk dance "Girls from Osaka City" performed by Qi Yunqing and Luo Shuzhuang received warm applause from the audience. Chairman Deng Qingfen, Vice Chairman Min Zhongying, and Director Pei Xiayun presented service awards to six members, Cui Zengqi, Situ Cun, Bi Nan, Ma Xiaomei, Deng Yueting, and Gao Yueying, on behalf of the Senior Citizens Association. This was followed by the Cantonese singing group's chorus "Happy New Year" and "Colorful Clouds Chasing the Moon". The Cantonese group has a lineup of 40 people. Although they are all senior citizens over fifty years old, everyone is still strong and performs very seriously and deeply, allowing the audience to blend into their happy atmosphere. The students who won scholarships that night were: first prize Emily Yee; second prize Joseph Dong; third prize Chen Ziming. The winners of the title awards are: Situ Xinhua and Huang Yingsi. This year’s scholarship sponsor is: Deng Guangzhao Family Memorial Scholarship, totaling one thousand yuan. Zhou Guiqing sang the Cantonese song "Red Cotton Praise". Her rich voice and professional performance won applause and praise from the audience, who unanimously asked her to sing two more songs. The raffle prizes at the party are all sponsored by Yin Fengying, Luk Fook Restaurant, Nanhua Restaurant, Red Pot Buffet, and Xinxin Supermarket. Senior overseas Chinese leaders Yu Wenjin, Hu Shoubai, Mrs. Yu Wenyu, and Mrs. Yu Wenwei, who have always been enthusiastic supporters of the Senior Citizens Association, jointly donated 200 yuan to the Swiss Lion League of the Chinese Senior Citizens Association to express their encouragement. Finally, Vice Chairman Min Zhongying and English Secretary Yin Fengying delivered speeches of thanks in Chinese and English respectively. The party ended in a jubilant and joyful atmosphere. Looking at these senior citizens who have such a healthy body and a happy and youthful mind, I feel deeply envious and deeply feel that age is not important in fact, the key is the state of mind. If the state of mind is good, the body will naturally be healthy. I sincerely wish all Chinese senior citizens a long and healthy life and a happy life. I hope to gather with them again next year and spend a good time together.

6c9c8d4d13448eb65bee1d7f1f7928dbd3b53cf1.sourceText: 雇主对长期失业者说不 （亚省时报） 《今日美国》称，许多雇主对长期失业在家的求职者持歧视态度。报道称，很少有求职者知道面试失败的原因，但曾经应聘信息技术人员的米歇尔却是例外，54岁的米歇尔说，两年前，有雇主相中了她的资历，本想安排面试。但后来当这名雇主知道米歇尔在家待业已经长达13个月后，便取消了面试。米歇尔称：”这些雇主不会考虑失业超过六个月的求职者，他们不了解的是现在处于非常时期。” 经济大萧条爆发4年后，失业率依旧居高不下，因长期找不到工作，艰难度日的人们表示，他们受到了歧视，来自美国劳工部的数据显示1300万劳力仍处于失业状态。 截至到一月份，加利福尼亚，康涅狄格州，佛罗里达州，爱荷华，密歇根，明尼苏达，内布拉斯加，纽约，俄亥俄州，宾夕法尼亚，南达科他州和田纳西州正在考虑立法禁止雇主通过以招工广告的方式拒绝失业者的申请，一旦发现违法，这些雇主通常会被罚款。以俄勒冈为例，一旦雇主违反规定，将面临1000美元的罚 款。 主要负责招聘临时工的迈克尔斯称，”尽管一些小公司存在不成文的规定：不招聘失业两年以上的人员，但我认为这种将这批人员排除在外的招聘办法不可取。””雇主虽然不明着说出来，但他们会用行动表明意图。” 迈克尔斯接着表示，”雇主们一般喜欢曾经当过临时工或者志愿者的应聘人员。””不具备这些身份的人士不会受到雇主的青睐，这是歧视吗？我不知道。””当众多人申请职位时，长期失业在家的人士就会被另眼相待。” 新泽西议员塞莱斯特说，那些求职者即使长期失业也应该保持积极地态度，”别坐在家里，应该主动将自己推介给你的社区。”她还说：”我很痛恨雇主歧视长期失业在家人员的做法，他们应该根据技能的水平而非工作的长短来进行招聘。”
6c9c8d4d13448eb65bee1d7f1f7928dbd3b53cf1.translatedText: Employers say no to long-term unemployed (Alberta Times) "USA Today" said that many employers have a discriminatory attitude towards job seekers who have been unemployed at home for a long time. According to reports, few job seekers know the reasons for failed interviews, but Michelle, who once applied for an information technology job, is an exception. Michelle, 54, said that two years ago, an employer took notice of her qualifications and wanted to arrange an interview. But later, when the employer learned that Michelle had been unemployed at home for 13 months, he canceled the interview. Michel said: "These employers will not consider job seekers who have been unemployed for more than six months. What they don't understand is that this is an extraordinary period." Four years after the outbreak of the Great Recession, the unemployment rate remains high. People who are struggling to survive for a long time say they have been discriminated against. Data from the U.S. Department of Labor shows that 13 million workers are still unemployed. As of January, California, Connecticut, Florida, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Nebraska, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Dakota and Tennessee were considering legislation that would prohibit employers from rejecting job applications through job advertisements, often subjecting them to fines if found to be in violation. Taking Oregon as an example, once an employer violates the regulations, it will face a fine of $1,000. Michaels, who is mainly responsible for recruiting temporary workers, said, "Although some small companies have unwritten rules that do not recruit people who have been unemployed for more than two years, I think this recruitment method that excludes this group of people is not advisable." "Although employers may not say it clearly, they will show their intentions with actions." Michaels went on to say, "Employers generally like applicants who have worked as temporary workers or volunteers." "People who do not have these identities will not be favored by employers. Is this discrimination? I don't know." "When many people apply for positions, those who have been unemployed for a long time will be treated differently." New Jersey Congressman Celeste said those job seekers should maintain a positive attitude even if they are unemployed for a long time. "Don't sit at home and actively promote yourself to your community." She also said: "I hate employers who discriminate against people who have been unemployed for a long time. They should recruit based on the level of skills rather than the length of the job."

ba8840a4d77e7d142805df663c3f86a2911b8ac6.sourceText: 2011年亚省人均收入增长3.9% （亚省时报） 根据美国经济分析部最新数据显示，亚利桑那州2011年人均收入为$35,875，比2010年的$34,539增加了3.9%，增幅低于全美平均水平的4.3%。 尽管数字不如理想，但亚利桑那州商业学院的经济学家汤姆雷克斯表示不悲观。他说，政府是根据人口多少来计算人均收入的。雷克斯说，过去十年内，亚利桑那州的人口不断增长。 而雇主制裁法案在此也起了很大作用。该法允许州法官暂停或撤销任何被发现雇用无证工人的公司营业执照。雷克斯说，这项法律已经造成本州的人口流失。简单地说，如果联邦使用较低的人口数字统计，那么人均收入会更高。 亚利桑那大学艾勒管理学院的马歇尔韦斯特，同意雷克斯关于人口数量的看法。他说不知联邦根据本州多少人口推出$34,539这一数字。 ”亚利桑那州的人均一直落后于全国平均水平，”韦斯特说。事实上，这种状况有所改变。 例如，1986年，本州人均收入是全国平均水平的93.5%，去年已经下滑到86.1%，最低点时达到85.9%。 雷克斯说，亚利桑那的经济属于典型的周期性，不会一下子成为全国的龙头老大。喜欢本州的人多是喜欢本州的”阳光”，愿意接受比其他地方略低的工资水平。 韦斯特指出，按年利率计算，本州个人年收入增长了5.9%。另，”转让收益”类，如失业保险，社会保障福利和残障金等，下降了1.4%。
ba8840a4d77e7d142805df663c3f86a2911b8ac6.translatedText: Per capita income in Arizona increased by 3.9% in 2011 (Alberta Times) According to the latest data from the U.S. Department of Economic Analysis, Arizona's per capita income in 2011 was $35,875, an increase of 3.9% from $34,539 in 2010, and an increase lower than the national average of 4.3%. While the numbers are less than ideal, economist Tom Rex of the Arizona College of Business is not pessimistic. He said the government calculates per capita income based on population. Arizona's population has grown over the past decade, Rex said. And the Employer Sanctions Act also plays a big role here. The law allows state judges to suspend or revoke the business license of any company found to be employing undocumented workers. Rex said the law has caused a loss of population in the state. Simply put, if the federation used lower population statistics, per capita income would be higher. Marshall West of the University of Arizona's Eller School of Management agrees with Rex about population numbers. He said he didn’t know the federal government’s estimate of $34,539 based on the state’s population. "Arizona has consistently lagged behind the national average per capita," West said. In fact, this situation has changed. For example, in 1986, the state's per capita income was 93.5% of the national average. Last year it fell to 86.1%, reaching its lowest point of 85.9%. Rex said Arizona's economy is typically cyclical and it won't suddenly become the nation's leader. Most people who like this state like its "sunshine" and are willing to accept slightly lower wages than elsewhere. West pointed out that on an annualized basis, annual personal income in the state increased by 5.9%. In addition, the "transfer income" category, such as unemployment insurance, social security benefits and disability benefits, fell by 1.4%.

ce46a5aa7f39613e193038ffc80348597bfc0c69.sourceText: 为了防范舞弊，美国大学理事会27日和纽约纳苏郡检方27日宣布，今秋参加美国大学测验(ACT)或学术性向测验(SAT)的学生，必须提交有照片的身分证明和申请书，在学生进入考场前，试务人员将以此比对考生的身分证明。 这是纽约州长岛一些高中发生测验作弊事件后，考试机构所採取的防范措施之一。 在长岛去年发生的SAT测验作弊事件中，20名学生被捕。纳苏郡地区检察官凯瑟琳莱斯表示，有些学生帮其他学生代考SAT，获得3500元报酬。SAT成绩是许多大学招生的关键指标之一。 在2010-2011年度，全世界约300万名学生参加SAT测验，160万人参加ACT测验。 新考试规则要求，学生申请参加SAT或ACT考试时，必须上传一张本人照片，不能上传者可以邮寄照片。测验机构会把印有考生照片扫描的准考 证邮寄给考生。考生照片不仅印在准考证上，还印在考场考生名册上，以便考试中心跟考生的身分证进行核对。考试中心向高中和大学报告考试成绩时，考生照片也将印在成绩单上。 其他新规则包括考试中心核对考生身分证明会更加频繁：考生初次进考场要核对身分证；中间休息后再进入考场也要核对身分证；递交考卷时又要核对身分证。
ce46a5aa7f39613e193038ffc80348597bfc0c69.translatedText: In order to prevent fraud, the College Board and the Nassau County Prosecutor's Office in New York announced on the 27th that students who take the American College Test (ACT) or Academic Aptitude Test (SAT) this fall must submit a photo ID and application form. Before the student enters the examination room, test staff will compare the candidate's ID. This is one of the precautionary measures taken by testing agencies after cheating incidents occurred in some high schools in Long Island, New York. Twenty students were arrested in a SAT cheating scandal on Long Island last year. Nassau County District Attorney Katherine Rice said some students were paid $3,500 to take the SAT for other students. SAT scores are one of the key indicators for admissions to many colleges. In 2010-2011, approximately 3 million students around the world took the SAT and 1.6 million took the ACT. The new exam rules require that when students apply to take the SAT or ACT exam, they must upload a photo of themselves. Those who cannot upload can mail the photo. The testing agency will mail the admission ticket with the scanned photo of the candidate to the candidate. The candidate's photo is not only printed on the admission ticket, but also printed on the candidate roster in the examination room so that the examination center can verify it with the candidate's ID card. When test centers report test scores to high schools and colleges, the test taker's photo will also be printed on the transcript. Other new rules include that examination centers will check candidates' proof of identity more frequently: candidates will need to check their ID cards when they first enter the examination room; they will also need to check their ID cards when they enter the examination room after a break; and they will need to check their ID cards when submitting exam papers.

6fb0056327e661e2df290333698c82284a70a0f5.sourceText: （黄慧莉律师） 国务院同时表示，所有FY2012 的EB-1 可用名额都会被充份使用，因此也没有多馀的名额给EB-2 使用。 国务院官员 Charlie Oppenheim 在2012年1月19日的一次会议上，讨论了有关未来几个月的排期预测，以下是相关的内容﹕从FY-2012 (2011年10月1日)起职业移民配额的使用量并不是很多。国务院在过去几个月加速了移民排期的速度，主要是为了要看还有多少申请人还在等待移民排期。 Oppenheim 预估今年EB-1 的申请人数比去年少约1,000 个 ，预估会有约12,000 个名额可以拨给EB-2 使用﹔但是由于EB-5 投资移民申请人数的增加，EB-5 剩馀可以给EB-2 的名额也会减少。 目前所有职业移民配额的申请中，约有85% 至90% 是透过申请I-485 最终取得绿卡，其他的10% 至15% 则是经由使领馆的面谈在海外签证后取得绿卡 职业移民排期预测如下﹕国务院预估2012年3月份职业移民排期仍然呈现前进的情况，最多可能可以前进6个月。由于移民局对I-485 的审理时间大约是4至6个月，三月份 递件可能I-485 可能可以在FY2012( 2011年9月30日) 前获得批准，因此Mr. Oppenheim 表示，在三月份的排期表公佈之后，四月份及移民排期可能呈现停滞的状态直到今年夏天，再视今年夏天职业移民名额的使用状况调整移民排期。
6fb0056327e661e2df290333698c82284a70a0f5.translatedText: (Lawyer Huang Huili) The State Council also stated that all available EB-1 quotas for FY2012 will be fully used, so there are no excess quotas for EB-2. In a meeting on January 19, 2012, State Department official Charlie Oppenheim discussed the forecast for the next few months. Here is the relevant content: Starting from FY-2012 (October 1, 2011), employment-based immigration quotas have not been used very much. The State Department has accelerated immigration processing in the past few months, mainly to see how many applicants are still waiting for immigration processing. Oppenheim estimates that the number of EB-1 applicants this year will be about 1,000 less than last year, and it is estimated that about 12,000 places will be allocated to EB-2. However, due to the increase in the number of EB-5 investment immigration applicants, the remaining EB-5 places that can be allocated to EB-2 will also decrease. Currently, about 85% to 90% of all applications for employment-based immigration quotas are obtained through applying for I-485, and the remaining 10% to 15% are obtained through overseas visa interviews at embassies and consulates. The employment-based immigration waiting list is forecast as follows: The State Council estimates that the employment-based immigration waiting list will still be improving in March 2012, and may be advanced by up to 6 months. Since the processing time of I-485 by the Immigration Bureau is about 4 to 6 months, the I-485 filed in March may be approved before FY2012 (September 30, 2011). Therefore, Mr. Oppenheim said that after the release of the March schedule, the April and immigration schedules may be stagnant until this summer, and the immigration schedule will be adjusted based on the use of employment immigration quotas this summer.

2cb22a5c37b309e7e53086587e3842d3462f8bbe.sourceText: 由于目前Mr.Oppenheim没有足够的数据，所以还没有办预测FY-2012 (2012年7月1日至2012年9月30日) 最后一个季度的职业移民排期。国务院负责移民排期的官员Mr. Oppenheim 在2012年3月16日美国移民律师协会的会议中表示，在2012年5月或6月的移民排期，中国大陆及印度出生的职业移民排期第二优先将大倒退到2007年8 月份左右。由于国务院预期5至6月份EB-2 移民排期将大倒退，我们提醒排期已经到却还没送件的申请人抓紧时间赶快提出申请。
2cb22a5c37b309e7e53086587e3842d3462f8bbe.translatedText: Since Mr. Oppenheim currently does not have enough data, he has not yet predicted the employment immigration schedule for the last quarter of FY-2012 (July 1, 2012 to September 30, 2012). Mr. Oppenheim, the State Department official in charge of immigration scheduling, stated at a meeting of the American Immigration Lawyers Association on March 16, 2012 that in the immigration scheduling of May or June 2012, the second priority for employment-based immigrants born in mainland China and India will be greatly regressed to around August 2007. Since the State Council predicts that the EB-2 immigration waiting list will be greatly regressed from May to June, we remind applicants who have arrived but have not yet submitted their documents to hurry up and apply.

4a2fce155d16ca6f28b5c391fec9bddd264d0979.sourceText: 今年侨联班子新人新气象，主席张华芳是近年的侨社新秀，有热情有魄力，这两年统筹过选美活动，在努力工作中积累经验，组织起侨联需要的新的活力班底，目前张华芳主席依靠集体力量，建立领导班子架构，并有如下安排： 第一副主席余文泽主管广告客户，其任务艰巨。余文泽长期在通用动力公司的无线系统任总工程师，曾获得过29项美国专利，是个工作有鑽劲，认真负责的人，他长期服务宗亲团体和侨联，担任过余风采堂主席，在ABC系中树有威信。主管广告工作的还有前侨联主席余自任、邓情芬和义工等一班人马，相信会将任务完成。 副主席崔增祈，曾任中国煤矿建设开发总公司总工程师，中国矿业大学、西安矿业学院兼职教授；从事煤矿建设技术和工程管理工作43年，经验丰富。他退休来凤凰城后，曾任凤凰城华人耆英会主席，现安排负责领导佳丽行政方面的工作，相信胜任有余。在具体的技术培训方面，由新东方艺术学校吕丽华校长和艺术总监胡秋子负责，她们有实际的技术力量和临场经验，能安排培训场地，相信佳丽有专业老师指导和在良好的环境中，短期内能有长足的进步。 副主席张肇鸿，廿年来在多个侨团负责文书和秘书长工作，为发掘和丰富华人侨社历史而努力不懈，曾任凤凰城龙冈公所主席，近年负责对国庆选美的宣传策划工作，国庆特刊总编，今年将和英文书记余文焯、中文书记高志中、前侨联主席邓贺铮一起担负起与论和特刊编辑, 前侨联主席方慧贤负责出版工作。本年度的董事中Brenda Fung是侨联通讯和总召集，关嬿仪为财政把关。 除了由侨联领导班底作为主干线外，主席张华芳亦组织起本年度的义工团队，带领一批多年来热诚为社区服务和贡献的支持者为办好今年国庆选美而努力，其中有:阮霭明、闻玲琳、陈志钢、古雅瑜、周畅、陈彩屏、黄欣明、黄文、陈雪莉、王浩、秋香、朱 毅、徐振隆、万培杰、朱其华、柯国基、杨涛、何婷、庄淑华、朱汇迅、邓军泉、伍蔼婢、Hodgie乔… 不胜枚举，义工队伍在扩大之中，《龙飞凤舞》点将台将继续直击报导!
4a2fce155d16ca6f28b5c391fec9bddd264d0979.translatedText: This year, the Federation of Overseas Chinese has a new atmosphere. Chairman Zhang Hua Fang is a rising star in the overseas Chinese community in recent years. She is enthusiastic and courageous. She has coordinated beauty pageants in the past two years, accumulated experience through hard work, and organized a new dynamic team needed by the Overseas Chinese Federation. Currently, Chairman Zhang Huafang relies on collective strength to establish a leadership team structure and has the following arrangements: First Vice Chairman Yu Wenze is in charge of advertising accounts and has a difficult task. Yu Wenze has long been the chief engineer of General Dynamics' wireless systems. He has obtained 29 U.S. patents. He is a diligent, serious and responsible person. He has long served clan groups and overseas Chinese federations, served as chairman of Yu Fengcaitang, and has established prestige in the ABC system. Also in charge of the advertising work are former Overseas Chinese Federation presidents Yu Ziren, Deng Qingfen and volunteers. I believe they will complete the task. Vice Chairman Cui Zengqi, once served as the chief engineer of China Coal Mine Construction and Development Corporation, and a part-time professor at China University of Mining and Technology and Xi'an Mining Institute. He has been engaged in coal mine construction technology and engineering management for 43 years and has rich experience. After he retired and came to Phoenix, he served as the chairman of the Phoenix Chinese Senior Citizens Association. He is now responsible for leading the administrative work of Belle. I believe he is more than qualified. In terms of specific technical training, the principal of New Oriental Art School Lu Lihua and the artistic director Hu Qiuzi are in charge. They have practical technical strength and on-the-spot experience and can arrange training venues. I believe that the beauties will make great progress in the short term with the guidance of professional teachers and in a good environment. Vice Chairman Zhang Zhaohong, who has been responsible for clerical and secretary-general duties in several overseas Chinese associations over the past 20 years, has worked tirelessly to discover and enrich the history of overseas Chinese associations. He was once the chairman of Longgang Office in Phoenix City. In recent years, he has been responsible for the promotion and planning of the National Day beauty pageant. He is also the chief editor of the National Day special issue. This year, he will be the editor of the special issue together with the English secretary Yu Wenzhuo, the Chinese secretary Gao Zhizhong, and the former chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Deng Hezheng. Former overseas Chinese Federation chairman Fang Huixian is responsible for publishing work. Among the directors this year, Brenda Fung is the communications and general convener of the Overseas Chinese Federation, and Guan Yanyi is the financial control. In addition to the leadership team of the Federation of Overseas Chinese as the main line, Chairman Zhang Huafang also organized this year's volunteer team and led a group of supporters who have dedicatedly served and contributed to the community for many years to work hard to organize this year's National Day beauty pageant, including: Ruan Aiming, Wen Linglin, Chen Zhigang, Gu Yayu, Zhou Chang, Chen Caiping, Huang Xinming, Huang Wen, Chen Shirley, Wang Hao, Qiu Xiang, Zhu Yi, Xu Zhenlong, Wan Peijie, Zhu Qihua, Ke Guoji, Yang Tao, He Ting, Zhuang Shuhua, Zhu Huixun, Deng Junquan, Wu Aijiao, Hodgie Qiao... There are too many to mention, and the volunteer team is expanding, and the "Flying Dragon" station will continue to report directly!

d37267739ad45c35df4777f9ffd64552b3423bcb.sourceText: 根据最新更改，2012年度凤凰城华裔小姐报名年龄重新订为从17岁(原为18岁) 至27岁，欢迎佳丽从速报名, 更多资讯可上网www. sunbirdarizona.com,www.paaca.us查询。
d37267739ad45c35df4777f9ffd64552b3423bcb.translatedText: According to the latest changes, the registration age for Miss Chinese Phoenix 2012 has been reset from 17 years old (originally 18 years old) to 27 years old. Contestants are welcome to register as soon as possible. More information can be found online at www.sunbirdarizona.com, www.paaca.us.

982bf711521251ba934c0c045ab27ec37e1ece2b.sourceText: 造谣者被拘留一批传谣网站被查处 微博被警告
982bf711521251ba934c0c045ab27ec37e1ece2b.translatedText: Rumor spreaders were detained, and a number of rumor spreading websites were investigated and punished. Weibo was warned

9562c688e62571405e0b7e721284b5adbab42bb4.sourceText: 造谣者被拘留一批传谣网站被查处 微博被警告 新华社北京3月30日电记者从北京市公安局了解到，近期，有个别网…
9562c688e62571405e0b7e721284b5adbab42bb4.translatedText: Rumor spreading websites were detained. A number of rumor spreading websites were investigated and punished. Weibo was warned. Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, March 30 (Xinhua) The reporter learned from the Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau that recently, some Internet...

cb196e7d2ee6a3ca91025ce369df80756c29c21f.sourceText: 新华社北京3月30日电记者从北京市公安局了解到，近期，有个别网民在互联网上特别是微博中编造、传播所谓”军车进京、北京出事”等谣言，产生了恶劣的社会影响。北京市公安机关迅速展开调查，依据有关法律法规，对在网上编造谣言的李某、唐某等6人依法予以拘留，对在网上传播相关谣言的其他人员进行了教育训诫。相关人员对编造、传播谣言的行为供认不讳，对自己的行为表示悔过，并作出检讨。
cb196e7d2ee6a3ca91025ce369df80756c29c21f.translatedText: The Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau quickly launched an investigation, and in accordance with relevant laws and regulations, six people including Li and Tang who fabricated rumors online were detained in accordance with the law, and other personnel who spread relevant rumors online were educated and admonished. The relevant personnel confessed to fabricating and spreading rumors, expressed remorse for their actions, and made self-examination.

d102edf415d8c362e92e2a38db777b20495cbcc4.sourceText: 北京市公安局有关负责人表示，利用互联网编造、传播谣言的行为严重扰乱社会秩序、影响社会稳定、危害社会诚信，公安机关对此将依法查处。希望广大网民自觉遵守法律法规，不信谣、不传谣，发现谣言及时举报，共同维护健康的网络环境和良好的社会秩序。
d102edf415d8c362e92e2a38db777b20495cbcc4.translatedText: The relevant person in charge of the Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau stated that the use of the Internet to fabricate and spread rumors seriously disrupts social order, affects social stability, and jeopardizes social integrity. The public security organs will investigate and deal with this in accordance with the law. We hope that the majority of netizens will consciously abide by laws and regulations, do not believe or spread rumors, report them promptly when they find them, and jointly maintain a healthy online environment and good social order.

798219830dcd72fd5c92d0a484fd678dc6ee6c8f.sourceText: 新华社北京3月30日电据国家互联网信息办公室发言人今日披露，一批传播谣言的互联网站被依法查处。
798219830dcd72fd5c92d0a484fd678dc6ee6c8f.translatedText: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, March 30: According to a spokesman for the Cyberspace Administration of China, a number of Internet websites that spread rumors have been investigated and punished in accordance with the law.

b1e8bf6a4db79323c0c7d1ebbd2056b9b986217f.sourceText: 近日，一些不法分子在互联网上无端编造、恶意传播所谓”’军车进京、北京出事”等谣言。少数网站违反国家相关法律法规，疏于管理，致使网上谣言传播，造成恶劣社会影响。根据《全国人民代表大会常务委员会关于维护互联网安全的决定》、《互联网信息服务管理办法》、《互联网新闻信息服务管理规定》等法律法规，国家互联网信息办公室责成有关地方网络管理部门进行严肃查处，电信管理部门依法对梅州视窗网、兴宁528论坛、东阳热线、E京网等16家造谣、传谣，疏于管理造成恶劣社会影响的网站予以关闭。
b1e8bf6a4db79323c0c7d1ebbd2056b9b986217f.translatedText: Recently, some lawless elements have made up and maliciously spread rumors on the Internet such as "military vehicles entering Beijing and an accident in Beijing." A small number of websites violate relevant national laws and regulations and are poorly managed, causing online rumors to spread and causing negative social impact. In accordance with laws and regulations such as the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Maintaining Internet Security, the Measures for the Administration of Internet Information Services, and the Regulations on the Administration of Internet News Information Services, the Cyberspace Administration of China instructs relevant local network management departments to conduct serious investigations and punishments. The telecommunications management department has shut down 16 websites in accordance with the law, including Meizhou Window Network, Xingning 528 Forum, Dongyang Hotline, and Ejing Network, which spread rumors and neglected management and caused negative social impact.

d5c357fcedf70a620125550bb5a08bbc425e1792.sourceText: 针对新浪和腾讯微博客网站集中出现的谣言，违反国家有关法律法规，造成恶劣影响的问题，北京市和广东省互联网信息管理部门分别对两个网站提出严肃批评，做了相应惩处。两个网站表示要认真落实相关要求，采取整改措施，进一步加强管理。
d5c357fcedf70a620125550bb5a08bbc425e1792.translatedText: In response to the rumors that appeared on Sina and Tencent microblog websites, which violated relevant national laws and regulations and caused adverse effects, the Internet Information Management Department of Beijing Municipality and Guangdong Province respectively severely criticized the two websites and imposed corresponding punishments. The two websites stated that they will conscientiously implement relevant requirements, take corrective measures, and further strengthen management.

69b2e67dc0f16c2f02819290b31f205d8e4f1788.sourceText: 编造传播谣言须依法惩处
69b2e67dc0f16c2f02819290b31f205d8e4f1788.translatedText: Fabricating and spreading rumors must be punished in accordance with the law

d85599b7cbe9392b76496be9ba6b8679a160bae0.sourceText: 北京市公安机关对在网上编造谣言者依法予以拘留，对在网上传播相关谣言的其他人员进行了教育训诫；国家互联网信息办公室对一批传播谣言的互联网站依法进行了查处。这再次证明编造传播谣言必将受到法律的惩处，再次显示了法治对维护互联网健康环境的重要作用。
d85599b7cbe9392b76496be9ba6b8679a160bae0.translatedText: The Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau will detain those who fabricate rumors online in accordance with the law, and educate and admonish other personnel who spread relevant rumors online; the Cyberspace Administration of China has investigated and punished a number of Internet websites that spread rumors in accordance with the law. This once again proves that fabricating and spreading rumors will be punished by law, and once again shows the important role of the rule of law in maintaining a healthy Internet environment.

95e1b1e93fd65097253154bfbe58453259173ac1.sourceText: 网络是虚拟社会，但虚拟社会与现实社会密不可分，直接关系现实社会的和谐稳定。网络谣言把谎言包装成”事实”，将猜测翻转成”存在”，在网上兴风作浪，扰乱人心。如果任其横行，将严重扰乱社会秩序，影响社会稳定，危害社会诚信。
95e1b1e93fd65097253154bfbe58453259173ac1.translatedText: The Internet is a virtual society, but the virtual society is inseparable from the real society and is directly related to the harmony and stability of the real society. Internet rumors package lies as "facts" and turn speculation into "existence", causing trouble on the Internet and disturbing people's hearts. If allowed to run rampant, it will seriously disrupt social order, affect social stability, and endanger social integrity.

5f16a3929448822239a7125fa38c17dca461c09f.sourceText: 我们的社会是法治社会，现实社会需要法治，快速发展的网络也需要法治。维护网络的法治就是维护基本的社会秩序，维护人民的基本权益。我国有一系列关于互联网的法律法规，这是维护互联网健康环境的基本遵循，所有互联网站和网民都必须遵守。编造传播谣言者触犯了法律，就要受到法律惩处。这也再次警醒我们，无论互联网站还是网民，都要增强法律意识，依法办网，依法上网，共同维护健康的网络环境和良好的社会秩序。
5f16a3929448822239a7125fa38c17dca461c09f.translatedText: Our society is a society ruled by law. The real society needs the rule of law, and the rapidly developing network also needs the rule of law. Maintaining the rule of law on the Internet means maintaining basic social order and safeguarding the basic rights and interests of the people. Our country has a series of laws and regulations regarding the Internet, which are the basic rules for maintaining a healthy Internet environment. All Internet websites and netizens must abide by them. Those who fabricate and spread rumors have violated the law and will be punished by law. This also reminds us once again that both Internet websites and netizens must enhance their legal awareness, operate the Internet in accordance with the law, surf the Internet in accordance with the law, and jointly maintain a healthy Internet environment and good social order.

0cdb2d63cfd5be8297b91125ccb7d6e4ea9201bd.sourceText: 迟到的流感季 （亚省时报） 州卫生官员说，发生在冬天最后一周的流感，竟佔整个冬季的30%。上周有338宗流…
0cdb2d63cfd5be8297b91125ccb7d6e4ea9201bd.translatedText: Late flu season (Alberta Times) State health officials said that flu cases that occurred in the last week of winter accounted for 30% of the entire winter. There were 338 cases of influenza last week...

720e49e5648a657d0e5ec096503e4e9ada30fdff.sourceText: 州卫生官员说，发生在冬天最后一周的流感，竟佔整个冬季的30%。上周有338宗流感备桉，整个季度共有1169宗流感记录。 拉巴斯郡是本州15个郡中唯一一个没有流感发生的郡，健康服务署主任威尔韩堡说。 韩堡说，跟往年一样，大多数流感病人并为报告，得不到妥善的治疗。他说，单靠购买成药自我治疗是不够的，尤其是当病人遇到高烧或呼吸困难是，应及时到药疗机构寻求帮助，以免发生危险。
720e49e5648a657d0e5ec096503e4e9ada30fdff.translatedText: State health officials say that flu cases that occurred in the last week of winter accounted for 30% of the entire winter. There were 338 flu cases recorded last week, and a total of 1,169 cases were recorded throughout the quarter. La Paz County is the only one of the state's 15 counties that is flu-free, said Will Hambold, director of the Department of Health Services. Hamburger said that, as in previous years, most flu patients go unreported and do not receive proper treatment. He said that it is not enough to buy over-the-counter medicines for self-treatment. Especially when patients encounter high fever or difficulty breathing, they should seek help from a medical treatment institution in time to avoid danger.

d61ef2973208fa407a784ea2a19fe62414be7886.sourceText: 超速摄相机可能玩完 （亚省时报） 对日常开车的朋友来说，电子摄像头可能是个梦魔，你超速或者不超速，它就在那…
d61ef2973208fa407a784ea2a19fe62414be7886.translatedText: > Speed ​​cameras may be over (Alberta Times) For those who drive daily, the electronic camera may be a nightmare. Whether you are speeding or not, it is there...

5c7a6a3cfc8098bb7de32b0bd50ba5074f84e7ba.sourceText: 对日常开车的朋友来说，电子摄像头可能是个梦魔，你超速或者不超速，它就在那裡，不撤不离。你闯红灯或者不闯，它就在那裡，想闪就闪。喜欢它的人不多，讨厌它的大有人在。 眼下，州立法者将对州内超速摄像头是否关闭作表决投票。 支持继续使用摄像头的人士说，统计显示摄像头可以给驾车人提示，对防止意外，拯救生命有极大的帮助。 反对者则说，摄像头只是为许多驾车人带来不必要的罚票。他们称摄像头的存在代替了交警的执法。有一部机器裁决你是否犯规是相当可笑的，而且，机器可能因气候、断电等原因造成的差错，明显对驾车人不公平。
5c7a6a3cfc8098bb7de32b0bd50ba5074f84e7ba.translatedText: For those who drive daily, the electronic camera may be a nightmare. Whether you are speeding or not, it is there and cannot be removed. Whether you run a red light or not, it is there and you can flash it whenever you want. Not many people like it, but there are many who hate it. Now, state lawmakers will vote on whether to turn off speed cameras across the state. Those who support the continued use of cameras say that statistics show that cameras can give drivers tips and are of great help in preventing accidents and saving lives. Opponents say the cameras simply result in unnecessary tickets for many motorists. They claim that the existence of cameras replaces the enforcement of traffic police. It is quite ridiculous to have a machine to judge whether you have committed a foul. Moreover, the machine may make errors due to weather, power outages, etc., which is obviously unfair to the driver.

9154b276d20e72b912af2d107c53edd6acb189eb.translatedText: The report found that some members were using their power for personal gain (Alberta Times) There are reports of corruption among public officials on both sides of the Taiwan Strait, especially in the mainland, every day. Have you ever thought that the United States...

73636227f7d29368a08a14f0c737694c79ca17af.sourceText: 报告发现 有议员以权谋私 （亚省时报） 台海两岸，尤其是大陆的公职人员贪污腐败消息每天都有。曾否想过，美国的议员也会以权谋私？近日一项针对美国众议院的研究阐明，原来衣冠楚楚的美国议员也会利用职权为自己以及家人谋私利。 亚利桑那州现任的七名众议员中，有三名被点名。他们分别是杰夫弗拉奇，本奎尔和埃德帕斯特。 报告称，弗拉奇众议员报销了近2万美元的旅费，伙食费及其他开支。奎尔议员为自己父亲的公司支付了250美元的设施租金和人员服务费。 埃德帕斯特最离谱，从2008?010年，他妻子和侄子在起卡诺普拉可思工作时，帕斯特为该公司支付180万美元好处。报告还指出，帕斯特为女儿谋取南山社区学院的工作提供金援。它说，帕斯特在2008年至2009年拨款100万美元给南山学院的ACE项目，并为其争取到超过100万美元的联邦基金，四个月后，他的女儿得到南山学院的职位。巧合的是，帕斯特小姐的工资高得莫名其妙。 以上三位众议员拒绝对报告发布评论。
73636227f7d29368a08a14f0c737694c79ca17af.translatedText: Report found that some members were using their power for personal gain (Alberta Times) There are reports of corruption among public officials on both sides of the Taiwan Strait, especially in the mainland, every day. Have you ever thought that American congressmen would abuse their power for personal gain? A recent study of the U.S. House of Representatives revealed that well-dressed U.S. lawmakers also use their power to benefit themselves and their families. Three of Arizona's seven current House members were named. They are Jeff Frache, Ben Quayle and Ed Pastor. The report states that Rep. Frache was reimbursed nearly $20,000 for travel, meals and other expenses. Congressman Quayle paid $250 for facility rental and personnel services for his father's company. The most outrageous thing about Ed Pastor is that from 2008 to 2010, when his wife and nephew were working at Canoplacos, Pastor paid US$1.8 million in benefits to the company. The report also states that Pastor provided financial assistance for his daughter to obtain a job at South Mountain Community College. It said Pastor allocated $1 million to South Mountain College's ACE program from 2008 to 2009 and secured more than $1 million in federal funds for it, four months after his daughter was offered a position at South Mountain College. As it happens, Miss Pastor's salary is inexplicably high. The three congressmen declined to comment on the report.

3daeabbb4636e9713fcac03a23929b55f95becbb.translatedText: Phoenix Police's new first brother, Chief Garcia (Alberta Times) Phoenix City Manager David Cavazos announced Monday afternoon the appointment of Daniel Garcia as Phoenix...

faabbda39f22281fc4ee5c846826b5dd1dca347f.sourceText: 凤凰城警察新一哥 加西亚总长 （亚省时报） 凤凰城市政经理大卫卡瓦佐斯周一下午宣布，任命丹尼尔加西亚为凤凰城警察总长。 加西亚服务达拉斯警局34年，自2004年以来一直担任当地的助理警察总长。他将接替四月离职的杰克哈里斯。哈里斯总长因不当使用联邦资金而下台。 参加竞选凤凰城警长总长职位有：凤凰城警察总监乔亚纳，凤凰城助理警察总监凯文罗宾逊，前加州圣荷西警察总监罗伯特戴维斯。
faabbda39f22281fc4ee5c846826b5dd1dca347f.translatedText: Phoenix Police's new first brother, Chief Garcia (Alberta Times) Phoenix City Manager David Cavazos announced Monday afternoon the appointment of Daniel Garcia as Phoenix Police Chief. Garcia has served the Dallas Police Department for 34 years and has served as the local assistant chief of police since 2004. He will replace Jack Harris, who left in April. Commissioner Harris stepped down due to improper use of federal funds. Candidates for the position of Phoenix Chief of Police are: Phoenix Police Chief Joanna, Phoenix Assistant Police Chief Kevin Robinson, and former San Jose, California Police Chief Robert Davis.

cfbe6db9177c7fa81927efefdac2c8cbdbb8439d.sourceText: 焊接瑕疵 本田召回2006年CR-V （亚省时报） 本田(Honda)汽车公司23日宣布，在美国召回131…
cfbe6db9177c7fa81927efefdac2c8cbdbb8439d.translatedText: Welding defects Honda recalls 2006 CR-V (Alberta Times) Honda Motor Company announced on the 23rd that it would recall 131...

631b8e4b30f33f2cf9226d9c1c768461d3b9268a.sourceText: 本田(Honda)汽车公司23日宣布，在美国召回1316辆2006年款的CR-V多功能车，因为汽车零件的焊接有瑕疵，可能影响驾驶人的操作。 本田公司在一份声明中说，2006年款车的控制杆在生产过程中，使用的焊接方式不当，可能导致焊接处发生断裂，影响到汽车的驾驶操作，增加发生车祸的危险。 但本田公司说，没有出现过焊接问题导致的撞车与人员伤亡报告。 公司从4月中旬开始将发函通知车主，也鼓励车主去经销商检查和更换零件。
631b8e4b30f33f2cf9226d9c1c768461d3b9268a.translatedText: Honda Motor Company announced on the 23rd that it would recall 1,316 2006 CR-V multi-purpose vehicles in the United States because the welding of car parts is defective, which may affect the driver's operation. Honda said in a statement that improper welding methods were used on the control levers of the 2006 model cars during the production process, which may cause the welding joint to break, affecting the driving operation of the car and increasing the risk of a car accident. But Honda said there have been no reports of crashes or injuries caused by welding problems. The company will start sending letters to vehicle owners in mid-April, and also encourages owners to go to dealers to check and replace parts.

3a9e582bb4c5c182e8c71641279954d7f130c188.sourceText: 州参议员提桉，所有申请失业救济者要先通过毒品测试。但州官员说，这规定违反联邦规则和法律，并可能花费州府的数百万联邦资金，而最终为亚利桑那州雇主带来巨大的加税。 药物测试提桉的发起人，共和党参议员史蒂夫史密斯说，他不认为州府这麽做有什麽不妥，至少确定纳税人的钱不是给瘾君子买毒品。 史密斯参议员的提桉与共和党收紧公共福利的措施不谋而合。稍早前的二月，共和党人在国会力推联邦立法，在全国范围内，要求所有申请失业救济者通过药物测试。此提桉未获国会通过。 在共和党执政的几个州，如乔治亚州、爱荷华州、俄克拉荷马州和南卡罗纳州提出类似立法，威斯康辛州、印第安纳州已经立法，今年1月起限製药物呈阳性或拒绝药物测试者领取失业救济。 然而，联邦劳工部明确告诉州府，根据联邦法规和法律，申请联邦失业福利不需要任何药物测试。劳工部的信函中说，申请人的资格不应因失业之外因素而丧失应用的福利。 州经安部说，联邦机构的立场意味着亚利桑那州的联邦资助失业福利计划不能联邦法规保持一致。这将使州府每年花费超过270万联邦资金来实现药物测试，这些费用最终将转嫁到雇主身上。预计雇主将为每个僱员支出的失业福利税从每年的$42升至$420。
3a9e582bb4c5c182e8c71641279954d7f130c188.translatedText: State senators proposed that all applicants for unemployment benefits must first pass a drug test. But state officials say the provision violates federal rules and laws and could cost the state millions in federal funds, ultimately resulting in huge tax hikes for Arizona employers. Republican Senator Steve Smith, the sponsor of the drug testing proposal, said he doesn't think there is anything wrong with the state doing this, at least to make sure taxpayer money is not used to buy drugs for addicts. Senator Smith's proposal coincides with the Republican Party's measures to tighten public welfare. Earlier in February, Republicans pushed for federal legislation in Congress that would require all people applying for unemployment benefits to pass drug tests nationwide. This proposal was not passed by Congress. Several Republican-controlled states, such as Georgia, Iowa, Oklahoma and South Carolina, have proposed similar legislation. Wisconsin and Indiana have already enacted legislation to restrict those who test positive for drugs or refuse drug tests from receiving unemployment benefits starting in January this year. However, the federal Department of Labor clearly told states that under federal regulations and laws, applying for federal unemployment benefits does not require any drug testing. The Labor Department letter said an applicant's eligibility should not lose applied benefits due to factors other than unemployment. The state Department of Economic and Social Security said the federal agency's position means Arizona's federally funded unemployment benefits program cannot be consistent with federal regulations. It would cost the state more than $2.7 million in federal funds each year to implement drug testing, costs that would ultimately be passed on to employers. Employers are expected to pay taxes on unemployment benefits per employee, rising from $42 to $420 per year.

1a1f57e8bfc3f5275b2d131975f8562d56556c66.sourceText: 华美半导体协会凤凰城分会（CASPA_PHOENIX）2012年年会于2月12日星期天晚上在Phoenix Palace酒家召开，几位CASPA成员聚集一堂， 愉快的品味了中国美食，席间交流一年来的心得和收穫。 会议由周浩华付会长主持，会上对过去的2011年CASPA所做的job fair,seminar,delegation接待等工作进行了总结，并对新一年的工作进行了安排和展望。
1a1f57e8bfc3f5275b2d131975f8562d56556c66.translatedText: The Phoenix Chapter of the Chinese and American Semiconductor Association (CASPA_PHOENIX) was held at the Phoenix Palace Restaurant on the evening of Sunday, February 12th. Several CASPA members gathered together. We had a pleasant taste of Chinese food and exchanged our experiences and achievements over the past year. The meeting was chaired by President Zhou Haohua. At the meeting, we summarized the job fair, seminar, delegation reception and other work done by CASPA in 2011, and made arrangements and prospects for the work in the new year.

c4fbfd9f25c999188cac42c420c5c70840b21f04.sourceText: CASPA奉行的宗旨是: 将北美半导体专业人士组成一个网络，促进会员联谊,研讨专业知识，交换半导体创业与就业资讯，推动中国和环太平洋高科技机构半导体创业与就业资讯;推动中国和环太平洋高科技机构半导体工业与人才的合作。 CASPA_PHOENIX所有的工作一直也将围绕这个宗旨。 会上施晟会长对今年在加州硅谷和亚利桑纳州凤凰城两个城市举办的job fair进行了安排。今年的job fair将于2012年5月5日週六在加州硅谷(10am~4pm) 圣克拉拉万豪酒店(Marriott Hotel) 和2012年5月7日週一在亚利桑那州凤凰城(4:30pm~ 9pm), Fiesta Conference Center 召开. 主要针对高科技，半导体，软件专业人士和商业专业人士。最后部分2012年届的理事合影留念。 华美半导体协会感谢大家的支持，欢迎大家参加即将召开的招聘会和有关的讲座，具体情况请点击 http://www.caspa.com/events 。
c4fbfd9f25c999188cac42c420c5c70840b21f04.translatedText: The purpose of CASPA is: To form a network of North American semiconductor professionals, promote member networking, discuss professional knowledge, exchange semiconductor entrepreneurship and employment information, and promote semiconductor entrepreneurship and employment information in China and Pacific Rim high-tech institutions; all work of CASPA_PHOENIX will always focus on this purpose. At the meeting, President Shi Sheng made arrangements for this year’s job fair to be held in Silicon Valley, California and Phoenix, Arizona. The fair will be held on Saturday, May 5, 2012 at the Santa Clara Marriott Hotel in Silicon Valley, California (10am~4pm) and on Monday, May 7, 2012 at the Fiesta Conference Center in Phoenix, Arizona. It is mainly aimed at high-tech, semiconductor, software professionals and business professionals. The last part of the 2012 session of directors took a group photo. Huamei Semiconductor Association thanks everyone for your support and welcomes everyone to attend the upcoming job fair and related lectures. For details, please click http://www.caspa.com/events.

45c3aba422282740b825f3da196dc24ccd8db154.sourceText: 科工专3月25日SuperStiti​on登山报道（图） （Amoy Yang) 科工专一直坚持”服务社区，娱乐大众”的办会方针，在凤凰城炎热夏季到来之前，科工专的资深成员，也是科工专活动组织者杨夏(Amoy Yang)的又一次的倡导及精心准备下，在本月的十八日，新旧成员二十多人来到了位于Apache Junction 的 Superstition Mountain Wilderness ， 为了调动大家的积极性和考验大家的耐力和毅力，这次特地选择了难度系数大，行程长达9.5英里的 Upper First Water Creek，在下午 的三点钟，每个成员在自身身体条件允许下完成各自的目标，其后，大家拿出各自准备的拿手菜围在一起参与最后一项活动—野餐，大家一边品尝美食，一边愉快地谈论身边的喜闻乐见。科工专从冬天的滑雪到春天的爬山，每一次的活动都吸引着新旧成员的积极参与，也让成员们更期待下一次的活动。 Welcome our new ACSE members: Jonathan Yang and Tony Wang
45c3aba422282740b825f3da196dc24ccd8db154.translatedText: The Science and Engineering College’s SuperStition mountaineering report on March 25 (Photo) (Amoy Yang) The College of Science and Technology has always adhered to the policy of "serving the community and entertaining the public". Before the hot summer in Phoenix, with the advocacy and careful preparation of Amoy Yang, a senior member of the College of Science and Technology and the organizer of the activities of the College of Science and Technology, more than 20 new and old members came to the Superstition Mountain Wilderness in Apache Junction on the 18th of this month. In order to mobilize everyone's enthusiasm and test everyone's endurance and perseverance, this time we specially chose a difficult course with a length of 9.5 miles. At Upper First Water Creek, at three o'clock in the afternoon, each member completed their own goals as long as their physical conditions allowed. Afterwards, everyone took out their own special dishes and gathered together to participate in the last activity - a picnic. While everyone tasted the food, they happily talked about what they liked and heard around them. From skiing in the winter to mountain climbing in the spring, every activity of the College of Science and Technology attracts the active participation of new and old members, and makes the members look forward to the next activity. Welcome our new ACSE members: Jonathan Yang and Tony Wang

33467c3d7963da8d278ee6fbaaf587d0119aac22.sourceText: 华裔女众议员余艳芬成为亚利桑那四十八位最有魅力女性之一 （亚省时报译） 第十区华裔女众议员余艳芬代表凤凰城（Phoenix），格勒戴尔（Glendale）西北部地区，被评选为亚利桑那州四十八位最有魅力女性之一。这四十八位女性的故事将作为亚利桑那百年餐桌书在部分书店出售。余艳芬是第一位在亚利桑那众议院服务的亚裔女性。 余艳芬说：”真的非常荣幸与其他四十七位女性成为具有开拓意义，历史意义的杰出女性的代表。 作为一个亚利桑那人，我感谢家乡给予的殊荣，亚利桑那百年庆典一书，我与每一页的故事都相关，与大家共同来分享这些故事。这里的每个女性都为亚利桑那州的发展做出了伟大的贡献。” 亚利桑那州最有魅力的四十八位女性评选是亚利桑那州百年庆典项目的一部分，这是亚利桑那州成为美国第四十八个州百年的标致。获奖者来自各行各业，他们有监狱长，法官，斗牛士等等。 四十八位魅力女性的评选是与亚利桑那历史协会，社区基金会共同合作评选。这些女性都来自不同的行业，具有不同的背景，她们的领导意识和能力，在行业中都非常卓越，为建设一个更加精彩的亚利桑那州有重大贡献。 这四十八位获奖女性的名单被列在 www.48women.org 上，其中包括余艳芬以及凤凰城华裔女法官 Roxanne Song Ong，前州长Rose Mofford, Jane D. Hull and Janet Napolitano,美国联邦最高法院大法官Sandra Day O扖onnor,以及美国众议员Gabrielle Giffords等等。 另外本次评选活动的主席科尼（Connie Robinson）说：”评选委员会知道很多亚利桑那的女性每天都非常努力工作，为了提高他人的生活质量，让亚利桑那变得更美好。这次全州参与提名的女性的数量和质量都证明了这些。他们的工作和信念是非常了不起的。” 本次颁奖午宴将于3月26日中午12点到下午2点在斯科茨代尔的凤凰酒店举行（The Phoenician Resort in Scottsdale）。 主办方将向获奖者致辞。 《亚利桑那最有魅力四十八位女性》一书，用照片和文字讲述女人的故事。在颁奖午宴中可以购买到这本书，价格为65美元，同时在州内的书店也将上市。 希望赞助本次午宴的朋友可以拨打电话602-896-9000,午宴票出售截止到3月25日下午5点。
33467c3d7963da8d278ee6fbaaf587d0119aac22.translatedText: Chinese-American Congresswoman Yu Yanfen has become one of the 48 most attractive women in Arizona (Translated by the Alberta Times) Chinese-American Congresswoman Yu Yanfen of the 10th District represents Phoenix and the northwest region of Glendale. She was selected as one of the 48 most attractive women in Arizona. The stories of these forty-eight women will be available in select bookstores as the Arizona Centennial Table Book. Yanfen Yu is the first Asian woman to serve in the Arizona House of Representatives. Yu Yanfen said: "I am really honored to join the other 47 women as representatives of outstanding women with pioneering and historical significance. As an Arizonan, I am grateful for the honor given by my hometown. In the book Arizona Centennial Celebration, I am related to the stories on every page and share these stories with everyone. Every woman here has made a great contribution to the development of Arizona." The selection of the 48 most attractive women in Arizona is part of the Arizona Centennial Celebration project, which is the mark of the centenary of Arizona becoming the 48th state of the United States. The winners come from all walks of life, including prison governors, judges, bullfighters and more. Forty-eight attractive women were selected in collaboration with the Arizona Historical Society and the Community Foundation. These women all come from different industries and have different backgrounds. Their leadership awareness and abilities are outstanding in the industry and they have made significant contributions to building a more exciting Arizona. The list of the 48 award-winning women is listed on www.48women.org, including Yu Yanfen and Phoenix Chinese female judge Roxanne Song Ong, former governors Rose Mofford, Jane D. Hull and Janet Napolitano, U.S. Supreme Court Justice Sandra Day O'Onnor, and U.S. Representative Gabrielle Giffords, etc. In addition, Connie Robinson, chairman of this selection event, said: "The selection committee knows that many Arizona women work very hard every day to improve the quality of life for others and make Arizona a better place. The number and quality of women nominated across the state this time proves this. Their work and belief are extraordinary." The awards luncheon will be held from 12 noon to 2 p.m. on March 26 at The Phoenician Resort in Scottsdale. The organizer will address the winners. The book "The Forty-Eight Most Attractive Women of Arizona" tells women's stories with photos and words. The book will be available for purchase at the awards luncheon for $65 and will also be available in bookstores around the state. Friends who wish to sponsor this luncheon can call 602-896-9000. Luncheon tickets are on sale until 5 pm on March 25.

bee9452e9f5f1d00adf191859f7cff2ce20ddf91.sourceText: 由于法拍文件处理丑闻而在去年受到拖延的大量法拍屋再度上市，导致2011年最后一个季度法拍屋销售大增，其比例从前一季度的五分之一上升到将近四 分之一。专家预计今年法拍屋对于市场的压力不减，但困难资产销售却从银行持有资产（REO）转向短售（short sale）等”前法拍”（pre-foreclosure）为主。
bee9452e9f5f1d00adf191859f7cff2ce20ddf91.translatedText: A large number of foreclosures, which had been delayed last year due to the foreclosure document handling scandal, were once again put on the market, leading to a surge in foreclosure sales in the last quarter of 2011, with the proportion rising to nearly a quarter from one-fifth in the previous quarter. Experts predict that the pressure on the market from foreclosures will continue this year, but sales of distressed assets will shift from bank-owned assets (REO) to short sales and other "pre-foreclosure" methods.

86092862c5be9ab9045d004c80da080b52b8c5fc.sourceText: 根据地产跟踪（RealtyTrac）的最新报告，2011年全年共有90.7万套进入法拍过程或者被银行收回的房屋被出售给第三方。
86092862c5be9ab9045d004c80da080b52b8c5fc.translatedText: According to the latest report from RealtyTrac, a total of 907,000 houses entered the foreclosure process or were repossessed by banks and were sold to third parties throughout 2011.

0c9eeed0f7395b234be9c3c4d69e448101f7f4bb.sourceText: 地产跟踪执行长摩尔（Brandon Moore）说，”我们预计法拍相关的销售2012年增加，尤其是前法拍销售（pre-foreclosure sales）增长更快，因为贷款银行积极处理由于抵押贷款服务公司造成的过去18个月来僵局中（积压的）困难资产。”
0c9eeed0f7395b234be9c3c4d69e448101f7f4bb.translatedText: Real Estate Tracking CEO Brandon Moore said, "We expect foreclosure-related sales to increase in 2012, especially pre-foreclosure sales (pre-foreclosure sales) to grow faster as lenders actively deal with the (backlog of) distressed assets caused by the deadlock caused by mortgage servicers over the past 18 months."

7b26821ebc37e29c17587f504fc6189e71777ed8.sourceText: 房利美（Fannie Mae）和房地美（Freddie Mac）的监管者试行的项目向投资者大批量出售，共完成2500套法拍屋的交易；这一项目已经导致投资者涌入。投资者兴趣最近已经升温，部分地产商报告加 州和内华达州部分地区出现竞投战（bidding wars），因为那些地区银行推迟行动已导致供应量下降。当然地产市场并非只是银行持有资产出现竞投战。
7b26821ebc37e29c17587f504fc6189e71777ed8.translatedText: Fannie Mae (Fannie Mae) and Freddie Mac (Freddie) A program piloted by Macau regulators to sell in bulk to investors, completing 2,500 foreclosure transactions, has already led to an influx of investors. Investor interest has picked up recently, with some real estate developers reporting bidding wars in parts of California and Nevada where bank delays have led to a drop in supply. Of course, the real estate market is not just about bidding wars for assets held by banks.

5bbcea4b212e04f2c93cdd961f6685a021bc1750.sourceText: 摩尔说，第四季度我们继续看到更 多销售从银行持有资产转向前法拍或短售（short sales）–即经过银行批准，屋主以低于房贷馀额的价格售出。他说，就全国来说，前法拍销售比一年前上升15%，银行持有资产（REO）下降12%。 在包括洛杉矶、迈阿密和菲尼克斯在内的7个晴雨錶市场，前法拍销量已经超过银行持有资产销量，而在一年前那些市场是银行持有资产销售超过前法拍。
5bbcea4b212e04f2c93cdd961f6685a021bc1750.translatedText: In the fourth quarter, Moore said, we continued to see more sales shift from bank-held properties to pre-foreclosure or short sales - where the owner sells for less than the mortgage balance with bank approval. Nationally, he said, pre-foreclosure sales are up 15% from a year ago and bank holdings (REOs) are down 12%. In seven barometer markets, including Los Angeles, Miami and Phoenix, pre-foreclosure sales have exceeded bank-held property sales, where bank-held property sales exceeded pre-foreclosure sales a year ago.

30a2024c5f0191c5cabc0ffefa1f413fad91407b.sourceText: 由于银行看到短售比法拍代价要低，新的改进项目和政府的刺激措施正在促进这类资产的售出。儘管全美前法拍销量都在上升，但上升幅度最大的仍然是遭受房市崩溃打击最严重的几个州：密西根勐升103%，佐治亚增长59%，亚利桑那增长48%。
30a2024c5f0191c5cabc0ffefa1f413fad91407b.translatedText: New improvement projects and government stimulus are boosting sales of such assets as banks see short sales being cheaper than foreclosures. While pre-foreclosure sales are rising across the country, the biggest increases are in states hardest hit by the housing collapse: Michigan up 103%, Georgia up 59% and Arizona up 48%.

80a9827d2c5c05ae1dba708b77dc9de36641f321.sourceText: 前法拍房屋去年第四季度平均价格比正常销售低21%。根据地产跟踪的数据，银行收回资产的平均价低于市场价36%。但是，法拍屋销售完成时间只有短售房屋的一半：短售平均318天才能完成全部手续。
80a9827d2c5c05ae1dba708b77dc9de36641f321.translatedText: The average price of former foreclosure homes in the fourth quarter of last year was 21% lower than normal sales. According to data from Real Estate Tracking, the average price at which banks repossess assets is 36% lower than the market price. However, the completion time for foreclosure sales is only half that of short-sale homes: short-sales take an average of 318 days to complete all procedures.

7e45f293f84a1a4228eb4eaa20737203bdf2b117.sourceText: 加州、佛罗里达、亚利桑那和内华达佔2011年困难资产销售总量的一半多，但它们的数量正在下降，而佐治亚、明尼苏达和华盛顿等州这类资产销量上升。此外， 法拍需要经过法庭程式的州同不需要法官干预的州差别很大。儘管银行已经同各州和联邦政府达成260亿美元的法拍文件机器人签名丑闻解决协议，在新泽西等法 拍需要经过法庭程式的州，银行持有房屋仍然大量积压。新泽西法拍屋完成交易平均900天以上。
7e45f293f84a1a4228eb4eaa20737203bdf2b117.translatedText: California, Florida, Arizona and Nevada accounted for more than half of all distressed property sales in 2011, but their numbers are declining, while sales are rising in states such as Georgia, Minnesota and Washington. In addition, there is a big difference between states where foreclosure requires court proceedings and states where a judge does not need to intervene. Even though banks have reached a $26 billion agreement with states and the federal government to resolve the robo-signing scandal in foreclosure documents, there is still a massive backlog of bank-owned homes in states such as New Jersey, where foreclosures require court proceedings. It takes an average of more than 900 days for New Jersey foreclosure transactions to complete.

4ffcbd6a94138da3680492a5cf30dd0c8d81f554.sourceText: 由于银行现在加快处理400万笔抵押贷款违 约和200万套已经进入法拍程式的房屋，2012年法拍屋销售看来会继续增加。儘管政府正在提供修改贷款条件的新措施，许多抵押贷款已经没救。由于全国房 价继续下降，部分借款人的房屋”负资产”下陷程度更深，因此违约风险上升。全国经济虽然在缓慢复苏，就业市场也在改善，经济学家说，这些不足以挽救已经深 陷麻烦的大额房贷。
4ffcbd6a94138da3680492a5cf30dd0c8d81f554.translatedText: Foreclosure sales look set to continue to increase in 2012 as banks are now expediting processing of 4 million mortgage defaults and 2 million homes in foreclosure proceedings. Although the government is offering new measures to modify loan conditions, many mortgages are no longer salvageable. As house prices continue to fall across the country, some borrowers' housing "negative equity" has fallen deeper, and the risk of default has increased. Although the national economy is slowly recovering and the job market is improving, economists say these are not enough to save large mortgages that are already in trouble.

8c070f8f90b144c78d3c8722ea5e9f44537a8714.sourceText: 金信地产新闻：现金投资者驱动房价上涨 （亚省时报） 整个凤凰城的房地产销售都在上升。许多购买房屋自主的家庭被越来越多的投资者挤掉。 投资者破产屋和短首屋的投资者都是付现金，而普通的买家都需要贷款。贷款者常常被淘汰。这种情况在整个凤凰城地区都出现。 不好的消息是现在买房竞争越来越激烈，但是好的方面是那些亏了好多钱的屋主看到房屋价格上升的越来越快。我们说现金是国王，大部分卖家都亲睐现金买家。市场专家表示在普通情况下现金交易只占交易量的10%，现在是40%。亚利桑那州里大学经济学院的教授欧尔说，”非常让人沮丧，一些人已经出了十多个合同购买房屋，可是都未购买成功。目前房屋的价格上涨的很快，几乎是每个星期上涨1%， 所以时间非常重要，有些人现在买的房子，下个月就会贵5%。” 25万以下的房屋，原来在市场的囤积期在130天，最近只有27天，每个月房屋的库存量都在下降。教授欧尔说：”我不知道这样的趋势什么时候会终止，但是目前显然没有新的房屋供给。” 更多信息请咨询金信地产Tinna 480-287-0180 Email:goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com。
8c070f8f90b144c78d3c8722ea5e9f44537a8714.translatedText: Jinxin Real Estate News: Cash Investors Drive Home Price Rise (Alberta Times) Real estate sales are on the rise across Phoenix. Many families who buy their own homes are being squeezed out by a growing number of investors. Investors in bankruptcies and short-term first-time homes pay cash, while ordinary buyers require a loan. Lenders are often left out. This is happening throughout the Phoenix area. The bad news is that competition to buy a home is becoming increasingly fierce, but the good news is that homeowners who have lost a lot of money are seeing home prices rising faster and faster. We say cash is king, and most sellers prefer cash buyers. Market experts say that under normal circumstances cash transactions accounted for only 10% of trading volume, but now it is 40%. Ohl, a professor at Arizona State University's School of Economics, said, "It's very frustrating. Some people have made more than ten contracts to buy houses, but none of them have been successful. The current price of houses is rising very fast, almost 1% every week, so time is very important. The houses some people buy now will be 5% more expensive next month." The hoarding period for houses under 250,000 yuan was originally 130 days on the market, but recently it was only 27 days. The inventory of houses is declining every month. Professor Orr said: "I don't know when this trend will end, but there is obviously no new housing supply at the moment." For more information, please contact Goldtrust Realty Tinna 480-287-0180 Email:goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com.
