e281ea8d2729103ead107d8c7b3a19cb88044dee.sourceText: 侨务委员会为协助侨胞研习适合于海外创业之中餐料理烹饪技术课程，藉以培植侨胞创业实力及提升经营事业能力，特于2012年5月28日至6月8日开办「2012年中餐烹调製作班」，本研习班由「实践大学」承办，聘请该校专业餐厨教师及国内知名主厨担任师资，本次研习课程包括学习中式料理之炸、蒸、炒、煮、熘、拌、烩、燻、烧、爆等各式基本烹调技法及分析市场趋势与经营策略、如何在海外开中式餐饮店等创业基础课程，以及参访点水楼、台客蓝、莺歌陶瓷餐具、迪化街南北杂货商圈等，并安排与相关知名业者进行经营经验分享交流。 研习课程之教材、师资、场地及材料等学杂费用由侨务委员会负担，学员自付由侨居地往返之交通费用、研习期间之膳宿费，有意报名者请于2012年5月5日前迳洽橙县华侨文教服务中心714-754-9999。招生简章及相关讯息请自本中心网站（ www.ocac.gov.tw/la1 ）下载。
e281ea8d2729103ead107d8c7b3a19cb88044dee.translatedText: > In order to assist overseas Chinese in studying Chinese cuisine and cooking technology courses suitable for overseas entrepreneurship, so as to cultivate the entrepreneurial strength of overseas Chinese and improve their business management capabilities, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission specially launched the "2012 Chinese Food Cooking Class" from May 28 to June 8, 2012. This workshop was hosted by "Jianxi University" and hired professional chefs and chefs from the school. Domestic well-known chefs serve as teachers. This training course includes learning various basic cooking techniques of Chinese cuisine such as frying, steaming, stir-frying, boiling, stewing, mixing, stewing, smoking, roasting, and quick-frying, as well as analyzing market trends and business strategies, basic entrepreneurial courses such as how to open Chinese restaurants overseas, and visiting Dianshuilou, Taikelan, Yingge Ceramic Tableware, Dihua Street North and South Grocery Business Districts, etc., and arranging business experience sharing and exchanges with relevant well-known industry players. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Council will bear the tuition and fees for the study courses, such as teaching materials, teachers, venues, and materials. Students will have to pay for their own transportation costs to and from their place of residence, as well as board and lodging expenses during the study period. Those interested in registering should contact the Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center at 714-754-9999 before May 5, 2012. Please download the admission brochure and related information from the center’s website (www.ocac.gov.tw/la1).

f4b2625aa2d2869c02cf23f38fcfb750d3ce4b25.sourceText: 报告：本州高中毕业率不高 （亚省时报） 根据一组教育机构周一公布的研究，虽然四年级和八年级学生阅读成绩有所提升，但亚利桑那州和新墨西哥州的高中毕业率有历年下跌的趋势。 报告显示，在童年贫困方面，亚利桑那州排第五，新墨西哥州排第六。两州的西裔和原住民学生也比全国其他州多，但似乎这两个族群的高中毕业率比其他族裔低。 根据报告，2002年，本州的高中毕业率为74.7%，2009年则为72.5%。新墨西哥州更差，从67.4%到64.8%。 为此，本州教育部门作出改革，例如在2008年通过为美国学生建立教育和职业计划方桉，还开展了在每一个年级教师和校长的年度辍学预防会议等。这些努力都得到可喜的回报。最新数据显示，毕业率从2007年的73.4%上升到2009年的76.1%。 研究人员指出了解决方法，如要求所有学生在全年级内阅读、学生到校上课的年龄提高到18岁，和设立预警机制，以便及早发现有辍学倾向的学生。 奥巴马总统在国情咨文中鼓励各州立法，规定学生须毕业或年满18岁才能离校。 报告估计，高中毕业生一生的收入比辍学生多出13万元，一生创造的税收和为政府开支的贡献，比辍学生多出20万元以上。
f4b2625aa2d2869c02cf23f38fcfb750d3ce4b25.translatedText: Report: State’s high school graduation rates are low (Alberta Times) High school graduation rates in Arizona and New Mexico have been on a downward trend despite improvements in reading scores among fourth- and eighth-graders, according to a study released Monday by a group of educational institutions. The report shows Arizona ranks fifth and New Mexico ranks sixth when it comes to childhood poverty. Both states also have more Hispanic and Native students than any other state in the country, but these two groups appear to have lower high school graduation rates than other groups. According to the report, the state's high school graduation rate was 74.7% in 2002 and 72.5% in 2009. New Mexico was even worse, from 67.4% to 64.8%. To this end, the state’s education department has made reforms, such as establishing educational and career planning programs for American students in 2008 and conducting annual dropout prevention meetings for teachers and principals at every grade. These efforts have paid off gratifyingly. The latest data shows that the graduation rate increased from 73.4% in 2007 to 76.1% in 2009. Researchers point to solutions such as requiring all students to read throughout the grade, raising the age at which students can attend school to 18, and establishing early warning mechanisms to identify students who are likely to drop out early. In his State of the Union address, President Obama encouraged states to enact legislation requiring students to graduate or turn 18 before leaving school. The report estimates that high school graduates’ lifetime income is 130,000 yuan more than dropouts, and their lifetime tax revenue and contribution to government spending is more than 200,000 yuan more than dropouts.

d7c98f3a6a79e60da5bc25f5427a7f2209e282f2.sourceText: 凤凰城市长的社区咨询委员会公开会议 （亚省时报讯 薇薇） ３月２０日下午6：00凤凰城市长斯坦顿（Stanton）的社区咨询委员会公开会议在伯顿巴尔中心图书馆举行（Burton Barr Central Library）。市长斯坦顿，社区咨询委员会全体委员，以及近百的公众参加了本次公开会议。就社区咨询委员会的使命和目标展开了讨论。 市长斯坦顿致欢迎此，说只有一个好的社区，才能建成好的城市。市长感谢在坐的各位对社区建设的努力，社区咨询委员会也为了建设一个安全，高质量的社区在幕后工作了很长一段时间。例如他们出台了会议法案，并讨论了委员会的使命和目标。在咨询委员会了情况后，市民们纷纷提出自己的看法。整个会场相当的热闹。记录人员将公众的意见纷纷记录下来，将会在下次会议中做详细的解释和并提出参考意见。会议中，提供发言卡片，只要愿意发言的人都能够畅所欲言。 市长斯坦顿对本次公开会议的举办相当满意，他指出只有接纳和慎重考虑民众的意见，我们的社区咨询委员会才能把社区的事情做好，落到实处，因为这是关心到凤凰城每个市民生活的大事，其中也更包括保护少数族裔的利益。
d7c98f3a6a79e60da5bc25f5427a7f2209e282f2.translatedText: Phoenix Mayor Stanton's Community Advisory Committee public meeting (Alberta Times News Weiwei) A public meeting of Phoenix Mayor Stanton's Community Advisory Committee was held at 6:00 pm on March 20 at the Burton Barr Central Library. Mayor Stanton, all members of the Community Advisory Committee, and nearly a hundred members of the public attended this public meeting. A discussion took place regarding the mission and goals of the Community Advisory Committee. Mayor Stanton welcomed this and said that only a good community can build a good city. The mayor thanked everyone here for their efforts in community building. The Community Advisory Committee has also been working behind the scenes for a long time to build a safe and high-quality community. For example, they introduced conference bills and discussed the mission and objectives of the committee. After the advisory committee reviewed the situation, citizens expressed their opinions. The whole venue was quite lively. The record-keeper will record the public's opinions and will provide detailed explanations and reference opinions at the next meeting. During the meeting, speech cards are provided so that anyone who is willing to speak can speak freely. Mayor Stanton was very satisfied with the holding of this public meeting. He pointed out that only by accepting and carefully considering the opinions of the public can our community advisory committee do a good job in community affairs and implement them effectively, because this is a major matter that cares about the lives of every citizen in Phoenix, and it also includes protecting the interests of ethnic minorities.

e3e3d52dc576d5deee1ad41b38219c9e62047c75.sourceText: 据美国建筑总承建商协会数据，凤凰城大都会建筑业工人就业率在2005年至2006年达高峰后一直回落，从2006年就业人数175,500到2011年底的81,900，增长率负53%，在全美337个大都会城市中，排名307。 总承建商的报告还显示，本州的哈瓦苏湖区域近年有70%建筑工人失业，是全美该行业失业率最高的地区。哈瓦苏湖和金曼地区在2005年12月有7600个建筑业岗位，至去年底，下跌至2300人，意味着70%人失业。 肯恩西蒙森，美国总承建商协会首席经济学家说，房地产泡沫破灭负主要责任。 但最近几个月，凤凰城的建筑工地出现一片繁忙景象。西蒙森说，过去已住宅为主体的建筑业，已悄然转向零售店铺，清洁能源和医疗建筑。过去一年，该行业增加了1900个岗位。 ”过去12个月，凤凰城建筑业就业率回升比全国很多地区都好，西蒙森说。”这表明凤凰城大都会的潜在实力棗不仅仅在退休，度假或商务旅客方面，逐渐形成一个就业中心。” 很多人认为，即使本州的建筑行业走在复苏的道路上，它很可能永远不会返回2005?006年的高峰水平。
e3e3d52dc576d5deee1ad41b38219c9e62047c75.translatedText: According to the National Association of General Building Contractors, the employment rate of construction workers in the Phoenix metropolitan area has been declining since reaching its peak between 2005 and 2006. From 175,500 employees in 2006 to 81,900 at the end of 2011, the growth rate was negative 53%, ranking 307th among 337 metropolitan cities in the United States. The general contractor's report also shows that 70% of construction workers in the Lake Havasu area of ​​the state have lost their jobs in recent years, which is the highest unemployment rate in this industry in the United States. The Lake Havasu and Kingman area had 7,600 construction jobs in December 2005. By the end of last year, the number had dropped to 2,300, meaning 70% were unemployed. Kenn Simonson, chief economist of the National Association of General Contractors, said the housing bust was largely responsible. But construction sites in Phoenix have been busy in recent months. Simonson said that the construction industry, which used to be mainly residential, has quietly turned to retail stores, clean energy and medical buildings. Over the past year, the industry has added 1,900 jobs. "Phoenix's construction employment recovery over the past 12 months has been better than many regions across the country," Simonson said. "This demonstrates the potential strength of the Phoenix metropolitan area beyond just retirement, vacation or business travelers, emerging as an employment center." " Many believe that even if the state's construction industry is on the road to recovery, it will likely never return to the peak levels of 2005-2006.

c3b565c01aa15ced7cee1b6779c1322dde89cec0.sourceText: 罕见暴风雪 亚利桑那交通瘫痪 （亚省时报） 本州突然遭到冬末暴风雪侵袭之后，19日本州山区仍笼罩在大雪之下。大雪已造成学校停课及交通大瘫痪。 美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）报导，美国国家气象局已对亚利桑那州中部和东部山区发布暴风雪警报。气象预报说：”北亚利桑那广大地区仍将大雪纷飞，而且会持续到周一（19日），开车会非常危险，特别是山区。” 北部的旗杆市周末至周一，仍然困在10到14吋的积雪当中，全市学校今天都已宣布停课。普瑞斯考特市积雪也达到8到12吋深。 狂风挟带大雪昨天也迫使当局封闭北亚利桑那40号州际公路长达180哩的路段。州公路警察局表示，恢复通车需等候进一步通知。
c3b565c01aa15ced7cee1b6779c1322dde89cec0.translatedText: Rare snowstorm paralyzes traffic in Arizona (Alberta Times) After the state was suddenly hit by a late winter blizzard, the mountainous areas of Japan were still shrouded in heavy snow on the 19th. Heavy snow has caused schools to close and traffic to be paralyzed. CNN reported that the National Weather Service has issued a blizzard warning for the mountainous areas of central and eastern Arizona. The weather forecast said: "There will still be heavy snowfall in vast areas of Northern Arizona, and it will continue until Monday (19th). Driving will be very dangerous, especially in the mountainous areas." Flagstaff City in the north was still trapped in 10 to 14 inches of snow from the weekend to Monday, and schools in the city have announced closures today. Prescott also had 8 to 12 inches of snow. Strong winds and heavy snow also forced authorities to close a 180-mile section of Interstate 40 in northern Arizona yesterday. The State Highway Police said it would reopen to traffic pending further notice.

6dff58176726059254e7b4ab8cb38132da672109.sourceText: Goodyear城市经理约翰菲斯巴赫周二宣布，在服务该市近四年后，他已经递交辞呈，并于4月1日生效。 Goodyear市长罗德赞扬了菲斯巴赫在该市杰出的工作，并称他为公众服务了35年后，退休是当之无愧的。 加入该市政服务之前，菲斯巴赫曾在科罗拉多州的柯林斯堡，华盛顿州的温哥华，伊利诺州的森林湖和明尼苏达州的罗宾斯岱尔担任过市政经理，还担任过华盛顿州杰弗逊郡的郡管理员。 菲斯巴赫辞职后，副市政经理布莱恩代克将暂代他的职务，直到下周市议会开会决定谁替补上位 。
6dff58176726059254e7b4ab8cb38132da672109.translatedText: Goodyear City Manager John Fischbach announced Tuesday that he has submitted his resignation, effective April 1, after nearly four years of service to the city. Goodyear Mayor Rod praised Fischbacher's outstanding work in the city and said his retirement is well-deserved after 35 years of service to the public. Prior to joining the municipal service, Fischbach served as city managers in Fort Collins, Colorado, Vancouver, Washington, Lake Forest, Illinois, and Robbinsdale, Minnesota, and as county administrator for Jefferson County, Washington. Following Fischbach's resignation, Deputy City Manager Brian Dyke will temporarily take over his duties until the City Council meets next week to decide who will replace him.

8d5c8778e071e8f873a4db26888bfc3fabf62676.sourceText: 据一个列有对美国年轻人来说最好的15项工作的名单中，那些希望有一份收入不错、时间灵活而且较有保障的工作的人可以考虑到医疗卫生系统谋职。 福布斯网披露，医疗卫生板块是美国经济中成长最快的部门。该最佳工作名单上有近一半的工作属于该部门的工种。 在该排名中，牙科助理以中间年薪3万3470美元而处于榜首，医疗助理的年工资以2万8860美元排在第三。接着是物理治疗师助理（其中间年工资近5万美元）及其卫生助理（年工资为2万又560美元）。 在排名前5的工种中，自我充实课程的教师（如教授陶器制作和教授艺术）是唯一与医疗卫生没关的工种。 在前10名的工种中，健身教练和健美操指导员、药房技师和外科技师也名列其中。 由于这些工作中有许多是可以以兼职方式工作的，因此他们对那些继续在上学的人来说是很合适的工作。这些工作中还有某些可提供员工职业前景和提升的机会。 专家称，年轻人可能还没有确定他们想从事什么样的工作。他们可利用这些工作来发现他们喜欢什么样的工作以及他们合适做什么样的工作。
8d5c8778e071e8f873a4db26888bfc3fabf62676.translatedText: Those looking for a job that pays well, has flexible hours and is more secure can consider careers in the health care system, according to a list of the 15 best jobs for young Americans. Forbes.com disclosed that the health care sector is the fastest growing sector in the U.S. economy. Nearly half of the jobs on this best jobs list are in this sector. Dental assistants topped the list with a median annual salary of $33,470, while medical assistants ranked third with a median annual salary of $28,860. Next are physical therapist assistants (whose median annual salary is nearly $50,000) and their health assistants (whose annual salary is $20,560). Among the top five jobs, teaching self-enrichment courses (such as teaching pottery making and teaching art) is the only job that has nothing to do with health care. Fitness trainers and aerobics instructors, pharmacy technicians and surgical technicians also made the list of the top 10 jobs. Because many of these jobs can be worked on a part-time basis, they are great jobs for those who continue to attend school. Some of these jobs also offer employees career prospects and opportunities for advancement. Experts say young people may not yet be sure what kind of work they want to do. They can use these jobs to discover what kind of work they like and what kind of work they would be suitable for.

cb5ed50a2762c6494502c0c918e6e959246b6503.sourceText: 温蒂(Wendy’s)挤下汉堡王(Burger King)成为全美第二大汉堡连锁店。 根据食品业市场调查公司Technomic Inc.资料，自温蒂速食店1969年创立以来，去年首次销售量超过汉堡王。 温蒂去年销售量达85亿元，超过汉堡王的84亿元。麦当劳销售额远超过这两家连锁店，该公司去年销售额达342亿元。 Technomic根据各该公司系统内加盟店和公司拥有的连锁店估计出上述数字，这些数字和各该公司公布的营业数字不同，因为不包括向加盟店收取的特许费。汉堡王在全世界连锁店的数目还是超过温蒂，而汉堡王仍是全世界第二大汉堡连锁店。 虽然最近数年经济衰退，麦当劳在最近数年仍透过低价、新菜单和餐厅翻新等策略，保持高成长率。过去五年，麦当劳成长率为26%，温蒂为9%，而汉堡王持平。 汉堡王2010年被3G Capital投资公司收购后，进行商业模式重新评估，该公司去年的行销活动已不再使用公司吉祥物「The King」，其最近广告活动更强调食物本身的价值。 尽管温蒂业绩超过汉堡王，温蒂也透过企业改造，将该公司打造成一家高级、优质汉堡速食店。温蒂去年推出较高级的Dave’s Hot’N Juicy汉堡。温蒂总部位于俄亥俄州都柏林，最近数年业绩其实并不太理想。该集团总裁布利克说，温蒂近年受制于「自我造成的伤害」，因此，该集团计画今年透过提高员工工作标准，并以更现代化的店面提升竞争力和服务品质。
cb5ed50a2762c6494502c0c918e6e959246b6503.translatedText: Wendy’s has overtaken Burger King to become the second largest burger chain in the United States. According to food industry market research firm Technomic Inc., Wendy's sales surpassed Burger King's last year for the first time since it was founded in 1969. Wendy's sales last year reached 8.5 billion yuan, surpassing Burger King's 8.4 billion yuan. McDonald's sales far exceed those two chains, with sales of 34.2 billion yuan last year. Technomic estimates the above figures based on franchised stores in the company's system and company-owned chain stores. These figures differ from the operating figures published by each company because they do not include franchise fees charged to franchised stores. Burger King still has more chains worldwide than Wendy's, and Burger King remains the second largest burger chain in the world. Despite the economic recession in recent years, McDonald's has maintained high growth rates in recent years through strategies such as low prices, new menus and restaurant renovations. Over the past five years, McDonald's has grown 26%, Wendy's has grown 9%, and Burger King has remained flat. After Burger King was acquired by 3G Capital in 2010, it re-evaluated its business model. The company no longer used the company mascot "The King" in its marketing campaigns last year, and its recent advertising campaigns have emphasized the value of the food itself. Although Wendy's performance exceeds that of Burger King, Wendy's has also transformed the company into a high-end, high-quality burger fast food restaurant through corporate transformation. Wendy’s launched a higher-end Dave’s Hot ‘N Juicy burger last year. Wendy's is headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, and its performance in recent years has actually been less than ideal. Blick, the group's president, said Wendy's has suffered from "self-inflicted injuries" in recent years. Therefore, the group plans to improve its competitiveness and service quality this year by improving employee work standards and building more modern stores.

39aa2e04cbec8ecad8929e3d6e2996b117bc49bc.sourceText: 劳工部说，亚利桑那州在过去三年内因不当发放失业金损失超过4.34亿美元，达失业金总发放量的四分之一。 经济安全部的就业与再就业服务助理主任马克达玛说，估计每年有近19000人谎报资料，导致社安局错误发放失业金。他们正试图整顿这些漏洞。 根据劳工部的数据，不当支付的大部分是因为经安部人员无法核实申请人的资料。州政府要求失业救济金申请人有积极寻找工作的动机。似乎有些人领了政府补贴就不愿再找工作，而另一些人则是找到了工作，还继续领取失业救济金。 为此，州政府已经采取多项措施堵截漏洞。达玛说，如果一经核实资料不属实，州政府将从受益人的报税中直接扣除已发放款项。情节严重者，将视为诈骗桉起诉。去年10月至12月，经安部已提交25起失业救济诈骗桉起诉，在一周内回收数十万元不当发放。 官员说，有些雇主不及时将新员工和解雇员工信息更新，使得问题复杂化。
39aa2e04cbec8ecad8929e3d6e2996b117bc49bc.translatedText: The Labor Department said Arizona lost more than $434 million in improper unemployment benefits in the past three years, accounting for a quarter of the total unemployment benefits. Mark Dammar, assistant director of employment and reemployment services at the Department of Economic Security, said it is estimated that nearly 19,000 people falsely report information each year, causing the Social Security Administration to erroneously issue unemployment benefits. They are trying to rectify these vulnerabilities. According to the Department of Labor, the majority of improper payments are due to the inability of Department of Labor and Security personnel to verify applicants' information. State governments require unemployment benefit applicants to be motivated to actively seek work. It seems that some people are unwilling to look for work after receiving government subsidies, while others find jobs and continue to receive unemployment benefits. To this end, the state government has taken several measures to plug loopholes. Damar said that if the information is verified to be untrue, the state government will directly deduct the disbursed money from the beneficiary's tax return. In serious cases, it will be prosecuted as fraud. From October to December last year, the Ministry of Economy and Security has submitted 25 unemployment benefit fraud prosecutions, recovering hundreds of thousands of dollars in improper payments within a week. Officials say some employers compound the problem by not updating new hires and layoffs in a timely manner.

34326fcd8dabe749b3af171dc39ba0dab10894b0.sourceText: 美国《纽约时报》昨报道，在华府能源政策支持，加上钻探科技进展，美国近年油气产量成功扭转近20年来跌势，近半世纪以来首度有望迈向「能源独立自主」，不再依赖入口原油，产油量甚至有望在未来10年追上沙特等主要产油国。分析家指出，美国欲藉能源独立，重塑全球战略格局，最重要是不用再受制于中东产油国，一众产油国的外交本钱面临削弱，目前油组内以委内瑞拉和伊朗为首的反美阵营的影响力料将减弱。
34326fcd8dabe749b3af171dc39ba0dab10894b0.translatedText: The New York Times reported yesterday that with the support of Washington’s energy policy and the advancement of drilling technology, the United States’ oil and gas production has successfully reversed the decline of the past 20 years. For the first time in the past half century, the United States is expected to become “energy independent” and no longer rely on imported crude oil. Oil production is even expected to catch up with major oil-producing countries such as Saudi Arabia in the next 10 years. Analysts pointed out that the United States wants to use energy independence to reshape the global strategic landscape. The most important thing is that it no longer needs to be controlled by the oil-producing countries in the Middle East. The diplomatic capital of many oil-producing countries is facing weakening. The influence of the anti-American camp headed by Venezuela and Iran in the oil group is expected to weaken.

c3db95a1ddc393dd7a41236b5905ae1a7bed9f6c.sourceText: 华府数据显示，近20年美国产油量曾出现跌势，由1970年的每日960万桶，跌至2008年每日495万桶，但受2000年代中期油价上升影响，小布殊政府在任内推行有利于油气业界发展的政策，包括加快审批国内开采油气资源的许可，奥巴马政府亦延续相类的政策抗衡高油价，为石油增产打下基础。加上开采油气的科技改进，美国产油量近年大幅增加，过去4年反弹至每日570万桶。能源部估计，2020年国内原油产量可增至每日700万桶的水平，有专家甚至认为可望日产1000万桶，与沙特的主要产油国看齐。至于10年前一度忧虑藏量耗尽的天然气，近年亦大幅增产，甚至正寻求外销欧亚。
c3db95a1ddc393dd7a41236b5905ae1a7bed9f6c.translatedText: Data from Washington show that U.S. oil production has declined in the past 20 years, from 9.6 million barrels per day in 1970 to 4.95 million barrels per day in 2008. However, due to the decline in the mid-2000s, Affected by the rise in oil prices in the future, the George W. Bush administration implemented policies conducive to the development of the oil and gas industry during his tenure, including accelerating the approval of permits for domestic oil and gas exploration. The Obama administration also continued similar policies to combat high oil prices and laid the foundation for increasing oil production. Coupled with technological improvements in oil and gas extraction, U.S. oil production has increased significantly in recent years, rebounding to 5.7 million barrels per day in the past four years. The Ministry of Energy estimates that domestic crude oil production can increase to 7 million barrels per day in 2020, and some experts even believe that it is expected to produce 10 million barrels per day, in line with the major oil producing countries of Saudi Arabia. As for natural gas, which was once worried about running out of reserves 10 years ago, production has increased significantly in recent years and is even seeking to be exported to Europe and Asia.

f9041c24a1923817d1960cd29021c78934601b3b.sourceText: 与此同时，受汽油价格高企及金融海啸经济衰退影响，美国民众近年纷改用高能源效能汽车，并减少驾驶，令汽油消耗明显减少。在供应大增、耗用减少下，美国正向着自1970年代尼克逊总统面对全球能源危机后提倡的「能源独立自主」目标迈进。2011年，美国液态燃料入口仅占总用量的45%，比2005年的历史高峰60%大幅减少。近3年美国向石油输出国组织（OPEC）入口原油量亦减少达20%，更是自杜鲁门总统时代以来，首次成为精炼石油产品（包括汽油）的净出口国。
f9041c24a1923817d1960cd29021c78934601b3b.translatedText: At the same time, affected by high gasoline prices and the economic recession caused by the financial tsunami, Americans have switched to high-energy-efficiency vehicles and reduced driving in recent years, resulting in a significant reduction in gasoline consumption. With the supply greatly increased and consumption reduced, the United States is moving towards the goal of "energy independence" advocated by President Nixon in the 1970s when he faced the global energy crisis. In 2011, US liquid fuel imports accounted for only 45% of total usage, a significant decrease from the historical peak of 60% in 2005. In the past three years, the United States has also reduced its crude oil imports to the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) by 20%. It has become a net exporter of refined petroleum products (including gasoline) for the first time since the era of President Truman.

1768e339d31c150550535a9987b9e6250210b4c8.sourceText: 能源及环境专家利瓦伊（Michael A. Levi）认为，美国迈向能源独立，减少对入口能源的依赖，将给予国家安全政策更大弹性，对世界局势影响深。有石油业界人士更形容，能源独立是「美国百年来最大成就」，「可比19世纪燃煤推动工业革命，让我们可用全球最便宜的能源推动经济」。不过前能源部高级官员哈克斯（Jay Hakes）认为，虽然能源独立可带来许多经济与国家安全方面的好处，但亦要对应环保问题，例如空气及水源污染，绝对是挑战。另外，原油价格仍受全球因素影响，例如非洲供应波动、主要产油国伊朗的核问题持续，以及全球复苏令能源需求增加等，都可能令国际油价高居不下，美国油气增产后的长期影响，现仍难以预料。
1768e339d31c150550535a9987b9e6250210b4c8.translatedText: Energy and environment expert Michael A. Levi believes that the United States' move towards energy independence and reducing its dependence on imported energy will give greater flexibility to national security policies and have a profound impact on the world situation. Some people in the oil industry even described energy independence as "the greatest achievement of the United States in a century." "Compared to the coal-burning power of the industrial revolution in the 19th century, we can use the cheapest energy in the world to drive the economy." However, Jay Hakes, a former senior official at the Department of Energy, believes that although energy independence can bring many economic and national security benefits, it is definitely a challenge to deal with environmental issues, such as air and water pollution. In addition, crude oil prices are still affected by global factors, such as supply fluctuations in Africa, the ongoing nuclear issue in major oil-producing country Iran, and increased energy demand due to global recovery, which may keep international oil prices high. The long-term impact of the increase in U.S. oil and gas production is still difficult to predict.

a6ea97c4627695317604e40d22636a077c67edfb.sourceText: 警方最近严厉打击偷车犯罪，美莎警局和马利科巴郡警长办公室上周拘捕了两名偷车贼。 上周一，美莎警方逮捕了一名43岁女子，周四，MCSO拘捕了一名30岁男性，他们都与车辆盗窃有关。两人被送至第四大道的拘留所。 美莎警局的茱蒂马丁内斯军士警官说，从2003年起，亚利桑那执法部门利用警车作诱饵，打击盗窃汽车和入车行窃罪桉。 2011年，亚利桑那州有八分之一的汽车被盗，是全国丢失车最多的州之一。
a6ea97c4627695317604e40d22636a077c67edfb.translatedText: Police have recently cracked down on car theft, with the Mesa Police Department and the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office arresting two car thieves last week. Last Monday, Mesa police arrested a 43-year-old woman and on Thursday, MCSO arrested a 30-year-old man in connection with vehicle thefts. Both men were transported to the Fourth Avenue Detention Facility. Sgt. Judy Martinez of the Mesa Police Department said that starting in 2003, Arizona law enforcement agencies used police cars as decoys to combat auto theft and vehicle break-ins. In 2011, one in eight cars was stolen in Arizona, making it one of the states with the highest number of lost cars in the country.

852fd35fc82032650bac9ccfd9fe40477f8aacb7.translatedText: Two women concealed drugs in their bodies and excreted them, sorted them out, and hurriedly swallowed their feces when confronted by the police Yaxin Network News Two Sichuan women came to Xinjiang with drugs in their bodies and were caught on the spot by the police while excreting and sorting them...

a326ee27f51517a6074c1ce4c4f7471bb6c10d49.sourceText: 两名四川女子体内藏毒来疆，正在排泄分拣时被警方当场抓获。记者3月21日从石河子市公安局禁毒支队获悉，两名女子对运毒、贩毒罪行供认不讳。
a326ee27f51517a6074c1ce4c4f7471bb6c10d49.translatedText: Two Sichuan women came to Xinjiang with drugs in their bodies and were caught by the police while sorting their excretions. Reporters learned from the Anti-Narcotics Detachment of Shihezi City Public Security Bureau on March 21 that two women confessed to drug trafficking and drug trafficking crimes.

51668f49c3aa2c438f8266549910b8a4d8825e87.sourceText: 3月16日，石河子市公安局民警来到石总场种畜队住宅区排查民情。在一处房屋门口，门缝中传出的恶臭”吸引”了民警。
51668f49c3aa2c438f8266549910b8a4d8825e87.translatedText: On March 16, police from the Shihezi City Public Security Bureau came to the residential area of ​​the Shizongchang Breeding Team to investigate the public situation. At the door of a house, the stench coming from the crack in the door "attracted" the police.

da946aef2355b5e661d37a581654c92d06d386cb.sourceText: 民警敲门并报出身份，但屋内没动静。民警意识到屋里可能有问题，将门撞开，却看到了惊人的一幕。在客厅，两名年轻女子蹲在地上边?#26041;便?#65292;边用手挤捏着排出的粪便。看到突然出现的警察，两人疯了一样在粪便上找寻着什么，然后抓起粪便朝嘴里塞去。
da946aef2355b5e661d37a581654c92d06d386cb.translatedText: The police knocked on the door and identified themselves, but there was no movement inside the house. Realizing that there might be something wrong in the house, the police opened the door and saw a shocking scene. In the living room, two young women were squatting on the floor and squeezing the feces with their hands. Seeing the sudden appearance of the police, the two of them frantically searched for something on the feces, then grabbed the feces and stuffed it into their mouths.

3a6319916ffd80448549cdef26da819483718b7a.sourceText: 民警上前制止了她们的疯狂行为，随后在现场找到了50粒（小袋）密封包装成指头大小的毒品，共500克。经查，两人是体内藏毒，正在排泄分拣。其中一人19岁，另外一人28岁，均来自四川西昌市。
3a6319916ffd80448549cdef26da819483718b7a.translatedText: The police stepped forward to stop their crazy behavior, and then found 50 pills (small bags) of drugs sealed and packaged into finger-sized pieces at the scene, totaling 500 grams. After investigation, it was found that the two men had poison in their bodies and were excreting and sorting it out. One of them is 19 years old and the other is 28 years old, both from Xichang City, Sichuan Province.

52947eb11696537f726cbc2f6d930e648b98e86d.sourceText: 同日，石河子市公安局在石河子市客运中心附近的旅馆内将另外两名体内藏毒的四川籍毒贩抓获，缴获9克毒品和毒资1万元。
52947eb11696537f726cbc2f6d930e648b98e86d.translatedText: On the same day, the Shihezi City Public Security Bureau captured two other Sichuan drug dealers hiding drugs in their bodies in a hotel near the Shihezi City Passenger Transport Center, and seized 9 grams of drugs and 10,000 yuan in drug money.

60b63533a9e62ef118d67208f4be32a7be034538.translatedText: Obama talks about the U.S.-China solar trade war and frequently wields the trade stick against China

5a84751727a75f62668a5feda3041b1f6e665024.sourceText: 奥巴马谈美中太阳能贸易战 频挥对华贸易大棒 在美国商务部初裁对中国输美太阳能电池板征收惩罚性关税一天后，美…
5a84751727a75f62668a5feda3041b1f6e665024.translatedText: Obama talks about the U.S.-China solar trade war and frequently wields the trade stick against China One day after the U.S. Department of Commerce initially ruled to impose punitive tariffs on solar panels imported from China, the United States...

f1880a5dfda5c681b6950d0924274c5856c959aa.sourceText: 在美国商务部初裁对中国输美太阳能电池板征收惩罚性关税一天后，美国总统奥巴马21日”巧合”地访问了内达华州一家太阳能公司并谈起了这起贸易救济案，美国正在加强贸易执法，以确保他所谓的像中国这样的国家不给他们的太阳能公司以不公平的优势。
f1880a5dfda5c681b6950d0924274c5856c959aa.translatedText: One day after the U.S. Department of Commerce initially ruled to impose punitive tariffs on solar panels imported from China, U.S. President Obama "coincidentally" visited a Nevada solar company on the 21st and talked about the trade remedy case. The United States is strengthening trade enforcement to ensure that countries like China do not give their solar companies an unfair advantage.

ef0cdd8b658b8a15ce0e09cd241b63da0b207456.sourceText: ”事实上，昨天我们的行政部门已裁定中国对其太阳能企业给予不公平的补贴，所以我们采取了确保平等竞争的第一步”，奥巴马说。
ef0cdd8b658b8a15ce0e09cd241b63da0b207456.translatedText: "In fact, yesterday our administration ruled that China unfairly subsidizes its solar companies, so we took the first step to ensure a level playing field," Obama said.

39dc647094a7772893cc7f599490ce8f3fa62e65.sourceText: 开发清洁能源是奥巴马政府力推的重要政策，最近他已多次声称：”不想看到风力涡轮机、太阳能电池板和高科技电池来自其他国家、由他国工人生产。我希望这些产品由美国自己生产。”
39dc647094a7772893cc7f599490ce8f3fa62e65.translatedText: The development of clean energy is an important policy promoted by the Obama administration. Recently, he has repeatedly stated: "I don't want to see wind turbines, solar panels and high-tech batteries coming from other countries and produced by workers from other countries. I want these products to be produced in the United States."

4644f18244d7ae589ccf6bdf71a6b0b6cf7ef09c.sourceText: 目前，美国共有5600多家太阳能企业，这些公司生产的太阳能电力足够供73万美国家庭用电。不过，这些公司中有相当多都是小型企业，它们正面临”物廉价美”的中国同行的强力竞争。
4644f18244d7ae589ccf6bdf71a6b0b6cf7ef09c.translatedText: Currently, there are more than 5,600 solar energy companies in the United States, and the solar power produced by these companies is enough to power 730,000 American households. However, many of these companies are small enterprises and they are facing strong competition from their Chinese counterparts who are "cheap and good".

f9f21da6c5daa0edb8f6561e4ed228d0f7418eb2.sourceText: 多家美国太阳能产品生产商此前控告中国同行获得了政府不公平的补贴，并在美国以低于成本的价格销售其产品。对此，美国商务部20日作出初裁，宣布向中国产太阳能电池板加征2.9%至4.73%的关税。
f9f21da6c5daa0edb8f6561e4ed228d0f7418eb2.translatedText: Many U.S. solar product manufacturers have previously accused their Chinese counterparts of receiving unfair government subsidies and selling their products in the United States at prices below cost. In response, the U.S. Department of Commerce made a preliminary ruling on the 20th and announced an additional tariff of 2.9% to 4.73% on Chinese-made solar panels.

e5959c87be7531978ea4c0e989ea171c8a02d08c.sourceText: 就在美国商务部作出裁决的第二天，奥巴马就前往太阳能公司视察，此举颇有取悦美国太能公司及其工人之嫌。对此，白宫新闻发言人卡尼在当天记者会上仅回应称，短短的一天时间难以评估这一裁决的效果和市场反应。
e5959c87be7531978ea4c0e989ea171c8a02d08c.translatedText: On the day after the U.S. Department of Commerce made its ruling, Obama went to inspect solar energy companies. This move seemed to please the U.S. solar companies and their workers. In response, White House Press Secretary Carney only responded at the press conference that day that it was difficult to evaluate the effect of this ruling and the market reaction in just one day.

190eeec4b58b73cc7c6843e3d685efe26e2d3c7a.sourceText: 最近，奥巴马政府频繁挥舞对华贸易大棒，仅仅在20日一天就对华作出四项贸易救济案的肯定性裁决，除太阳能电池板之外，还涉及中国输美的化学增白剂、镀锌钢丝、金属硅等产品。
190eeec4b58b73cc7c6843e3d685efe26e2d3c7a.translatedText: Recently, the Obama administration has frequently wielded the trade stick against China. On the 20th alone, it made affirmative rulings on four trade remedy cases against China. In addition to solar panels, it also involved chemical brighteners, galvanized steel wires, metallic silicon and other products exported to the United States from China.

33a07fe43f6276e08e11d0464ea76136c0735336.sourceText: 分析人士认为，由于美国2012年大选临近，奥巴马政府此举一方面是为回应共和党”对华政策太软弱”的批评，另一方面也是为取悦部分选民，捞取选票。
33a07fe43f6276e08e11d0464ea76136c0735336.translatedText: Analysts believe that as the 2012 U.S. election is approaching, the Obama administration’s move is on the one hand in response to the Republican Party’s criticism that its China policy is too weak, and on the other hand, it is also to please some voters and win votes.

7b96fc263c5855a07496d47bb634a8d22562b52e.sourceText: 对此，中国政府已多次批评这种带有贸易保护主义色彩的措施，希望美方共同维护自由、开放、公正的国际贸易环境，以更加理性的方法妥善处理贸易摩擦。
7b96fc263c5855a07496d47bb634a8d22562b52e.translatedText: In this regard, the Chinese government has repeatedly criticized such protectionist measures and hopes that the United States will jointly maintain a free, open, and fair international trade environment and properly handle trade frictions in a more rational way.

a65838bdb73f18b7a23e01aabf3da05c217cd295.sourceText: 美国七天六挑贸易争端 政客游戏”损人损己”
a65838bdb73f18b7a23e01aabf3da05c217cd295.translatedText: The United States picks trade disputes six times in seven days. Politicians play the game of "hurting others and themselves"

56dd16fb6e4749906be57c34347752c0e2750c5e.sourceText: 美国大选年，贸易保护主义这张”选举牌”再度被参选各方频繁打出。短短7天内，美国针对中国出口产品挑起的经贸事端就已达六起。政客们努力打造捍卫公众利益的形象，但这种损人不利己的摩擦，既无法降低美国贸易赤字，也无法从根本上解决美国工作岗位外流问题。
56dd16fb6e4749906be57c34347752c0e2750c5e.translatedText: In the US election year, the "election card" of trade protectionism was once again frequently played by all parties participating in the election. In just seven days, the United States has provoked six economic and trade incidents against Chinese exports. Politicians strive to create an image of defending public interests, but this kind of friction that harms others and does not benefit oneself can neither reduce the U.S. trade deficit nor fundamentally solve the problem of the outflow of American jobs.

616a50d74197a01bdf7d59f3e561a0e8f27e439d.sourceText: 2011年，美国贸易赤字达7372亿美元。作为世界最大出口国，中国成为许多政客”理所当然”的攻击目标。
616a50d74197a01bdf7d59f3e561a0e8f27e439d.translatedText: In 2011, the U.S. trade deficit reached US$737.2 billion. As the world's largest exporter, China has become a "natural" target for many politicians.

65b228d778fce93dd3e7d8e5cd616c13f092b9b1.sourceText: ”新一轮指责中国的浪潮正在出现”， 耶鲁大学教授史蒂芬圠奇表示，在谈及就业问题时，指责声尤其强烈，但人们必须注意到，美国和另外87个国家同样存有贸易赤字。
65b228d778fce93dd3e7d8e5cd616c13f092b9b1.translatedText: "A new wave of accusations against China is emerging," Yale University professor Stephen Winch said. When talking about employment issues, the accusations are particularly strong, but people must note that the United States and 87 other countries also have trade deficits.

f1adbb7d20471e1570111e93d8c297236aa4f1fd.sourceText: 中国商务部部长陈德铭也推算说，中国对美国贸易顺差大概只占美国整个贸易逆差的1/4到1/5。
f1adbb7d20471e1570111e93d8c297236aa4f1fd.translatedText: Chinese Minister of Commerce Chen Deming also estimated that China’s trade surplus with the United States only accounts for 1/4 to 1/5 of the entire U.S. trade deficit.

57d397cc5afe6272dc26a49940d7ba7b3b344e7d.sourceText: 在陈德铭看来，作为结算与储备货币的美元在海外不断沉淀，是美国长期贸易逆差的深层次原因之一。陈强调，在美国对世界贸易总体不平衡的前提下，仅讨论中美间的平衡意义不大。
57d397cc5afe6272dc26a49940d7ba7b3b344e7d.translatedText: In Chen Deming's view, the US dollar, as a settlement and reserve currency, continues to accumulate overseas, which is one of the underlying reasons for the long-term trade deficit in the United States. Chen emphasized that under the premise that the United States has an overall imbalance in world trade, it is of little significance to just discuss the balance between China and the United States.

fc977a8a9479f6940f456a0cc02051b65970c862.translatedText: Who will solve the trade imbalance?

1f68b996f5d3cc977b55999494353603b3d2627b.sourceText: 因此，对于中美贸易不平衡问题，陈德铭表示应由美国商务部长做出回答。他指出，西方政客经常批评中国不顾全球平衡，但却从来不提中国也是进口第二大国。
1f68b996f5d3cc977b55999494353603b3d2627b.translatedText: Therefore, regarding the issue of Sino-US trade imbalance, Chen Deming said that the answer should be given by the US Secretary of Commerce. He pointed out that Western politicians often criticize China for disregarding global balance, but they never mention that China is also the second largest importing country.

9398b6a23690e6956a3040ee90b9f9f664a9f3c2.sourceText: 金融危机爆发以来，中国社会商品零售总额以每年15%－18%的速度增长，国际货币基金组织总裁克里斯蒂娜拉加德曾坦言，如果不是中国提供动力，全球经济局势也许还会更糟糕。
9398b6a23690e6956a3040ee90b9f9f664a9f3c2.translatedText: Since the outbreak of the financial crisis, China's total retail sales have been growing at an annual rate of 15%-18%. International Monetary Fund President Christine Lagarde once said frankly that if China had not provided the driving force, the global economic situation might have been even worse.

3b954f028230d15949ffa83336e5878552bc0478.sourceText: 在这种局面下，扩大对中国出口成为美国缩小其贸易逆差的可行路径，但截至目前，美国仍有约2400项产品未对中国放开。不过，据美国驻华大使骆家辉日前透露，美将对华放开46项高科技产品出口。中方已对美方有意放宽部分对华高科技产品出口限制表示欢迎。
3b954f028230d15949ffa83336e5878552bc0478.translatedText: Under this situation, expanding exports to China has become a feasible path for the United States to reduce its trade deficit. However, as of now, the United States still has about 2,400 products that have not been opened to China. However, according to Gary Locke, the U.S. ambassador to China, he recently revealed that the United States will liberalize the export of 46 high-tech products to China. China has welcomed the U.S.’s intention to relax some export restrictions on high-tech products to China.

45e24eea9f628c1a384af5a559c555fe447c16a1.sourceText: 一方面指责中国限制稀土出口，另一方面却以安全为由限制稀土产品出口中国。陈德铭希望这种讽刺性的情形能得到改变，他呼吁美国允许中国企业赴美投资。
45e24eea9f628c1a384af5a559c555fe447c16a1.translatedText: On the one hand, it accuses China of restricting rare earth exports, but on the other hand, it restricts the export of rare earth products to China on the grounds of safety. Chen Deming hopes that this ironic situation can be changed. He calls on the United States to allow Chinese companies to invest in the United States.

e593347c77a16e818f8a31c09969f4c5cf1c805f.sourceText: 不过在大选年，如何通过对问题的假想敌开火，争取选民支持才是最优先议题，美对华贸易保护近期持续升温也成为?#39064;中之意?#12290;
e593347c77a16e818f8a31c09969f4c5cf1c805f.translatedText: However, in an election year, how to win the support of voters by attacking the imaginary enemy of the issue is the top priority issue. The recent continuous increase in U.S. trade protection against China has also become a problem.

dde0076164318c06d94c2fc5ea744f949f0af2b4.translatedText: Who is hurt by the trade dispute?

0f27d631eb6a39b5ac3320fdb89194f865a28a8f.sourceText: 美国近期的举动概括起来包含两大目标：其一，用”双反”等手段，”限制”晶体硅光伏电池等中国产品的进口；其二，通过多平台施压，要求中国”不得限制”稀土出口。
0f27d631eb6a39b5ac3320fdb89194f865a28a8f.translatedText: The recent actions of the United States can be summarized as having two major goals: first, to use "double reverse" and other means to "restrict" the import of Chinese products such as crystalline silicon photovoltaic cells; second, to put pressure on China through multiple platforms to "not restrict" the export of rare earths.

4e2fbf72c0567142f1c3de040e38ad2b32b350a5.sourceText: 对于美方这些举动，陈德铭曾表示”非常不可理解”，他强调，贸易保护主义不仅对其他国家不公，对该国公民和企业也不公正，也不会有好的效果。
4e2fbf72c0567142f1c3de040e38ad2b32b350a5.translatedText: Chen Deming once said that these actions by the United States are "very incomprehensible." He emphasized that trade protectionism is not only unfair to other countries, but also unfair to the country's citizens and companies, and will not have good results.

e54eb05e67ae31cd2dd8aa1673859ac43f8d9578.sourceText: 就中国出口企业而言，在外部主要市场遇冷、劳动力成本上升、人民币升值的大环境下，美国挥舞的贸易大棒无疑会雪上加霜。
e54eb05e67ae31cd2dd8aa1673859ac43f8d9578.translatedText: As far as Chinese export companies are concerned, in an environment where major external markets are cold, labor costs are rising, and the RMB is appreciating, the trade stick wielded by the United States will undoubtedly make things worse.

a5e547155ead32dd2a4af2b01e748d2bc16edfb5.sourceText: 美国亦难成为赢家。美国廉价太阳能联合会此前估算说，若美方对来自中国的光伏电池及组件征收100%的惩罚性关税，其将在未来3年内损失5万个工作岗位。
a5e547155ead32dd2a4af2b01e748d2bc16edfb5.translatedText: The United States is also unlikely to be the winner. The American Affordable Solar Energy Federation previously estimated that if the United States imposes 100% punitive tariffs on photovoltaic cells and modules from China, it will lose 50,000 jobs in the next three years.

8554d4b0cbad19a69bee952bc1c60ecb7df00487.sourceText: 在经济领域外，贸易保护主义抬头的负面影响或继续扩散。显然，经贸关系是稳定整个中美关系的”压舱石”， 诚如中国商务部长所言：”你要去挑战它，绊你的脚是无可非议的。”
8554d4b0cbad19a69bee952bc1c60ecb7df00487.translatedText: Outside the economic field, the negative impact of the rise of trade protectionism may continue to spread. Obviously, economic and trade relations are the "ballast stone" that stabilizes the entire Sino-U.S. relationship. As China's Minister of Commerce said: "If you want to challenge it, it is beyond reproach to stumble on you."

12dbfa878831477f89a07a17f05e0805d9c025f9.sourceText: 亚利桑那州失业率下降至8.7%

bc32649cb43e72b3faa3e221624e14e969c92806.sourceText: 亚利桑那州失业率下降至8.7% （亚省时报） 近日公布的亚利桑那州一月份失业数据为8.7%。经济学家说，2…
bc32649cb43e72b3faa3e221624e14e969c92806.translatedText: Arizona's unemployment rate dropped to 8.7% (Alberta Times) Arizona's January unemployment data released recently was 8.7%. Economists said, 2…

cb218fafef04b65dca80670f3d7fc34d58805509.sourceText: 近日公布的亚利桑那州一月份失业数据为8.7%。经济学家说，2011年最后一个月原本也是8.7%，使用了新的计算标准后校正为9%。 劳工部报告说，由于精简人手，本州一月份失去了34,300个非农业职位。但经济学家指出，一月份的失业率远低于过去10年经济衰退期间的平均数。 大多裁员的机构为私营部门，如零售业和服务业。劳工部说，这两个行业有在假日购物季聘请临时工的习惯。 全美一月份失业率平均为8.3%，最低的州为北卡，3.2%，其次为内布拉斯加州，4.0%。失业率最高的是内华达，12.7%，此外，美属波多黎各以15.1%傲视同侪。
cb218fafef04b65dca80670f3d7fc34d58805509.translatedText: Arizona’s January unemployment data released recently was 8.7%. Economists said the figure for the last month of 2011 was originally 8.7%, but was revised to 9% using new calculation standards. The Labor Department reported that the state lost 34,300 non-farm jobs in January due to downsizing. But economists noted that January's unemployment rate was well below the average during recessions over the past decade. Most of the layoffs are in the private sector, such as retail and service industries. The Labor Department said both industries have a habit of hiring temporary workers during the holiday shopping season. The national average unemployment rate in January was 8.3%, with the lowest state in North Carolina at 3.2%, followed by Nebraska at 4.0%. The highest unemployment rate is in Nevada, at 12.7%. In addition, the U.S. territory of Puerto Rico leads the way with 15.1%.

ade979b098e4096fcaae2b92ce0a923a68bf88ae.translatedText: Tempe city services are recognized by residents

1bf406da70295be519b43e7803cb9b9fd6faad2c.sourceText: 坦佩城市服务获居民肯定 （亚省时报） 年度城市的满意度调查显示，坦佩居民对自己的生活质量感到满意，但他们希…
1bf406da70295be519b43e7803cb9b9fd6faad2c.translatedText: Tempe city services are recognized by residents (Alberta Times) The annual city satisfaction survey shows that Tempe residents are satisfied with their quality of life, but they want...

3160ba2020649384aa00d34c5a9dbb7a000928c0.sourceText: 年度城市的满意度调查显示，坦佩居民对自己的生活质量感到满意，但他们希望生活环境更安全。 这项由堪萨斯一个公司负责的调查报告，86%的坦佩居民满意城市的生活质量，87%喜欢自己的城市形象，90%满意城市服务。 全国居民满意城市服务的平均数是57%。由于政府财政短缺，削减服务，这项满意度平均下降了2%至3%。 坦佩也在削减开支。市长休霍尔曼说，市政府一直重视居民意见，希望在削减财政的同时，保持市民服务的原有水准。 坦佩居民对交通、人行道、越野道和垃圾收集方面的满意度远超于全国。居民希望市政府将重点放在安全和商用物业和民宅保护维修方面。在安全方面，坦佩的受访者希望市政府加强维修路灯等公共设施。 另一问题的公众参与决策满意度，只有53%人满意。调查公司说，这个数字全美满意度都低，不足为奇。 调查在去年10月进行，收回803份随机问卷，误差幅度为3.5%。
3160ba2020649384aa00d34c5a9dbb7a000928c0.translatedText: The annual city satisfaction survey shows that Tempe residents are satisfied with their quality of life, but they want a safer living environment. The survey, conducted by a Kansas company, found that 86% of Tempe residents are satisfied with the city's quality of life, 87% like their city's image, and 90% are satisfied with city services. The national average of residents' satisfaction with urban services is 57%. Satisfaction dropped by an average of 2% to 3% due to government financial constraints and service cuts. Tempe is also cutting back. Mayor Hugh Holman said the city government has always valued residents' opinions and hopes to maintain the original level of citizen services while cutting finances. Tempe residents far outpace the nation in satisfaction with transportation, sidewalks, off-road trails and trash collection. Residents want the city to focus on safety and preservation and repair of commercial properties and homes. In terms of safety, respondents in Tempe want the city to do more repairs on public facilities such as street lights. On another issue, only 53% of people were satisfied with public participation in decision-making. The survey company said that this number is unsurprisingly low among Americans. The survey was conducted in October last year and 803 random questionnaires were returned, with a margin of error of 3.5%.

5566daa431f16af1886cb2260104f867931efbee.sourceText: H1签证者，海外有银行账户，是否需要申报
5566daa431f16af1886cb2260104f867931efbee.translatedText: H1 visa holders who have bank accounts overseas, do they need to declare

1e6b46c728299a7c0dd831b5f7257bda4ac68021.sourceText: H1签证者，海外有银行账户，是否需要申报 黄慧莉 我在台湾有银行帐户﹐是否今年04月15日以前要申报﹐我是…
1e6b46c728299a7c0dd831b5f7257bda4ac68021.translatedText: H1 visa holders have bank accounts overseas, do they need to declare Huang Huili I have a bank account in Taiwan. Do I need to declare it before April 15 this year? I am...

9407093c7f6d0c0c487ef8ce1a37ba94fb5a7c60.sourceText: 我在台湾有银行帐户﹐是否今年04月15日以前要申报﹐我是H-1B签証者﹐并没有绿卡﹖ 去年美国颁布新的针对美国纳税人海外金融资产披露与增值部分的报税的法规FATCA，其后，这项法规只是专门针对纳税人的海外金融账户和金融资产，并非所有海外资产。并且，新法桉依旧不会对金融资产进行征税，只是要求披露，仅对收入部分需要报税。接下来，我们来仔细看看新法桉的规定。对于满足FATCA条件的美国纳税人，需要额外填写8938表格并连同1040表格一起在4月15日之前提交美国国税局IRS。8938需要填写海外的收入数额（利息，分红，办税等等）；而TD F 90-22.1表格只需要填写账户信息，并不需要填写收入或金融资产的增值。8938要求4月15日前与1040报税表一起提交给美国国税局IRS，但TD F 90-22.1表格要求6月30日提交给美国财政部，并且特地说明不要与报税表一起提交。需要提交8938表格的 申报人的身份包括 美国公民﹐ 美国永久居民；或符合”实质性居住测试”在美住满183天以上的非移民签证持有者，比如某些H-1，L-1签证持有者等等。需要向美国申报的资产类别包括： 海外金融机构中的金融账户；以及持有非美国公司发行的股票或其他证券；任何由海外实体作为发行方或交易方的金融商品或合同﹐共同基金及其他私募投资基金。对于金融资产需要”用于投资”的，对于房产而言，如果是明显属于个人使用的私人房产不属于金融资产，而用于投资的房地产公司中的股份则属于金融财产。
9407093c7f6d0c0c487ef8ce1a37ba94fb5a7c60.translatedText: I have a bank account in Taiwan. Do I need to declare it before April 15 this year? I am an H-1B visa holder and do not have a green card? Last year, the United States promulgated a new regulation, FATCA, which targets the disclosure and tax return of the value-added portion of overseas financial assets of US taxpayers. Subsequently, this regulation only specifically targets taxpayers’ overseas financial accounts and financial assets, not all overseas assets. Moreover, the new law still does not tax financial assets, but only requires disclosure, and only the income part needs to be taxed. Next, let’s take a closer look at the provisions of the new law. For U.S. taxpayers who meet the requirements of FATCA, an additional Form 8938 needs to be completed and submitted together with Form 1040 to the IRS before April 15. 8938 needs to fill in the amount of overseas income (interest, dividends, taxes, etc.); while the TD F 90-22.1 form only needs to fill in the account information, and does not need to fill in the income or the appreciation of financial assets. 8938 is required to be submitted to the IRS together with the 1040 tax return before April 15, but Form TD F 90-22.1 is required to be submitted to the U.S. Treasury Department on June 30, and specifically states not to be submitted with the tax return. The status of the declarer who needs to submit Form 8938 includes U.S. citizens, U.S. permanent residents; or non-immigrant visa holders who meet the "substantial presence test" and have lived in the United States for more than 183 days, such as certain H-1, L-1 visa holders, etc. Asset classes that need to be reported to the United States include: financial accounts in overseas financial institutions; and holdings of stocks or other securities issued by non-U.S. companies; any financial products or contracts with overseas entities as issuers or counterparties, mutual funds and other private investment funds. For financial assets that need to be "used for investment", as for real estate, if it is a private real estate that is obviously for personal use, it is not a financial asset, while shares in a real estate company used for investment are financial assets.

656c235b042898b44d1af10c670d373f4512c6f7.sourceText: 对于外海非金融资产收入的报税需要用到其他表格，比如2555表格。需要申报的金额如果未婚且居住在美国：在纳税年末国外总金融资产超过5万美元或者在纳税年内的任何时刻国外总金融资产超过7万5千美元。已婚且居住在美国，并且与配偶合并申报：在纳税年末国外总金融资产超过10万美元或者在纳税年内的任何时刻国外总金融资产超过15万美元。纳税人居住美国境外且独立申报：在纳税年末国外总金融资产超过20万美元或者在纳税年内的任何时刻国外总金融资产超过30万美元。居住美国境外但与配偶合并申报：在纳税年末国外总金融资产超过40万美元或者在纳税年内的任何时刻国外总金融资产超过60万美元。不依法对海外金融资产进行申报会面临高达1万美元的罚款，如果在美国国税局通知后依旧不依法申报或缴纳税款的，罚款将会上升至5万美元。而对于未足额申报的部分，最高可处该不足额部分的40%作为罚款。 海外收入的追溯（追缴）根据FATCA新规定，该规定适用于2010年3月18日之后的纳税人的海外金融资产的披露以及，即2011年报税开始适用。FATCA新规定中还有重要的一环，就是要求在美国营业的海外金融机构，比如银行，在2013年6月30之前加入一个与美国国税局IRS的协议。协议的主要内容是：这些海外金融机构必须对其储户进行特定的身份调查和其他尽职审查并向美国国税局IRS上报其美国储户的相关信息。而未参加协议的海外金融机构必须暂扣并向美国国税局上缴其美国收入的30%。
656c235b042898b44d1af10c670d373f4512c6f7.translatedText: For tax returns on overseas non-financial asset income, other forms are required, such as Form 2555. Amounts required to be reported If unmarried and residing in the United States: Total foreign financial assets exceed $50,000 at the end of the tax year or total foreign financial assets exceed $75,000 at any time during the tax year. Married and residing in the United States and filing jointly with your spouse: Total foreign financial assets exceed $100,000 at the end of the tax year or total foreign financial assets exceed $150,000 at any time during the tax year. Taxpayers who reside outside the United States and file independently: Total foreign financial assets exceed $200,000 at the end of the tax year or total foreign financial assets exceed $300,000 at any time during the tax year. Living outside the U.S. but filing jointly with your spouse: Total foreign financial assets exceed $400,000 at the end of the tax year or total foreign financial assets exceed $600,000 at any time during the tax year. Failure to declare overseas financial assets in accordance with the law will result in a fine of up to US$10,000. If you still fail to declare or pay taxes in accordance with the law after being notified by the IRS, the fine will rise to US$50,000. For under-declared portion, a penalty of up to 40% of the insufficient amount may be imposed. Retrospective (recovery) of overseas income is based on the new FATCA regulations, which apply to the disclosure of overseas financial assets of taxpayers after March 18, 2010, that is, starting from the 2011 tax return. Another important part of the new FATCA regulations is that it requires overseas financial institutions operating in the United States, such as banks, to join an agreement with the IRS before June 30, 2013. The main content of the agreement is that these overseas financial institutions must conduct specific identity investigations and other due diligence reviews of their depositors and report relevant information about their U.S. depositors to the IRS. Overseas financial institutions that do not participate in the agreement must withhold and surrender 30% of their U.S. income to the IRS.

21e821b9e9c70caa51dfa5feac7be0e063e7b56f.sourceText: 根据2010年人口普查结果，在全美10万人口以上的大城市中，本州的斯格思岱尔人口平均年龄为45.4，为全美最高。 本州的坦佩市平均年龄为28.1，为全美年轻人最多的城市之一。经济学家说，坦佩人口年轻化是与州立大学的存在有莫大关联。当然，还有更年轻的城市，犹他州最年轻的城市平均年龄为23.3。 太阳城和其他退休社区不包括在内，因为他们人口不达十万，不在全美大城市之列。 全美大城市平均年龄最高的城市还有佛罗里达州的清水湾，43.8，珊瑚角，42.4，劳德代尔堡42.2，海厄利亚，42.2，和圣彼得堡41.6。
21e821b9e9c70caa51dfa5feac7be0e063e7b56f.translatedText: According to the 2010 census results, among the large cities with a population of more than 100,000 in the United States, the average age of the population in Scottsdale is 45.4, the highest in the United States. The average age of Tempe in this state is 28.1, making it one of the cities with the most young people in the United States. Economists say Tempe's youthful population is closely related to the presence of state universities. Of course, there are younger cities, with the youngest city in Utah having an average age of 23.3. Sun City and other retirement communities are not included because they have a population of less than 100,000 and are not among the nation's largest cities. The cities with the highest average age among major U.S. cities include Clearwater, Florida, at 43.8, Cape Coral, 42.4, Fort Lauderdale, 42.2, Hialeah, 42.2, and St. Petersburg, 41.6.

8e12e47c67c37ea67c3a0b7df5665092451fc4be.sourceText: 看过HBO的Game Change后，很多本地居民很郁闷，情节涉及亚利桑那州，拍摄地点怎麽在新墨西哥州？ 州众议会少数党领袖查德坎贝尔众议员说：”这是一个金钱的损失，一个就业机会的损失，我们不应该让这种情况重演。” 原本亚利桑那州为电影工作者免税，但现在这一优惠政策不再使人感兴趣。邻近的新墨西哥州计划在电影工业方面创造9000个新职位。事实上，自2008年以来，新墨西哥州在电影工业方面收入超过一亿美元。 相似的地形，近似的风景，”我们拿什麽跟人竞争？”坎贝尔说。 亚利桑那州众议会正讨论HB2127草桉，为电影製作商提供更多税收优惠政策。
8e12e47c67c37ea67c3a0b7df5665092451fc4be.translatedText: After watching HBO's Game Change, many local residents are very depressed. The plot involves Arizona. Why is the filming location in New Mexico? Rep. Chad Campbell, the minority leader in the state House of Representatives, said: "This is a loss of money, a loss of jobs, and we should not let this happen again." Arizona originally provided tax exemptions for film workers, but now this preferential policy is no longer of interest. Neighboring New Mexico plans to create 9,000 new jobs in the film industry. In fact, New Mexico has generated over $100 million in revenue from the film industry since 2008. Similar terrain, similar scenery, "What do we have to compete with others?" Campbell said. The Arizona House of Representatives is discussing HB2127, a bill that would provide more tax incentives for film producers.

a70767468c656efd91963be257d56a4778395854.sourceText: 警方说，两名男子週二在瓜达卢佩镇的Ramada酒店外的停车场射击十多枪，所幸没有人受伤。 马利科巴郡警长办公室探员说，枪战发生在繁忙的AZ Mill购物中心附近，现场留下的子弹壳很多，枪手在警方到达之前已逃离现场，其中一人驾车逃去，另一人跑向马路对面的AZ Mill购物中心。 事后，坦佩警察搜查商场，MSCO直升机从空中搜索都没有找到疑犯，商场的闭路电视也没有任何可疑人出现。探员表示，他们没有任何疑犯的线索，两名嫌疑人好像凭空出现，遁地而去。
a70767468c656efd91963be257d56a4778395854.translatedText: Police said two men fired more than a dozen shots in the parking lot outside the Ramada Hotel in Guadalupe Town on Tuesday. Fortunately, no one was injured. Detectives from the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office said the shootout occurred near the busy AZ Mill Shopping Center. There were many bullet casings left at the scene. The gunmen had fled the scene before the police arrived. One of them drove away and the other ran towards the AZ Mill Shopping Center across the road. Afterwards, Tempe police searched the mall, and MSCO helicopters did not find the suspect in an aerial search. No suspicious person appeared on the mall's CCTV. Detectives said they had no clues about the suspects, and that the two suspects seemed to appear out of thin air and flee.

7f97c5dc8be6bd6644ea561c3de02be2c8e03ce5.sourceText: 何谓产权保险（Title Insurance） 买卖房屋时都会购买产权保险，透过购买产权保险可以让您在产权…
7f97c5dc8be6bd6644ea561c3de02be2c8e03ce5.translatedText: What is Title Insurance? Title insurance will be purchased when buying and selling a house. By purchasing title insurance, you can protect your rights...

9266778384c28e5a890f8df396478c94cfa5bf8e.sourceText: 买卖房屋时都会购买产权保险，透过购买产权保险可以让您在产权发生问题时还能保障自己的权益。房地产的产权为什麽会有问题? 有几个原因: 可能是从前产权过户时没有处理好(Defects in the chain of Title)、该房地产曾经有未清偿的抵押借款(Mortgages)、曾经被扣押(liens)，或是有地役权(Easements)，所谓的地役权，指的是土地所有人对他人土地可行使之权利。这些产权的问题，有些是不容易被察觉的，例如: 诈欺行为、产权转让程序错误等，有些比较容易被察觉，但是不容易或不可能将它移除，像是: 被扣押、有地役权等等。
9266778384c28e5a890f8df396478c94cfa5bf8e.translatedText: Title insurance will be purchased when buying and selling a house. By purchasing title insurance, you can protect your rights and interests when there is a problem with the property rights. Why are there problems with the property rights of real estate? There are several reasons: Defects in the chain of Title may not have been handled properly during the transfer of property rights, the property may have had unpaid mortgages, liens, or easements. The so-called easements refer to the rights that the land owner can exercise over other people's land. Some of these property rights problems are not easy to detect, such as: fraud, errors in property transfer procedures, etc. Some are easier to detect, but it is not easy or impossible to remove them, such as: being seized, having an easement, etc.

21f371261f5342bcf2b2ed7a68e6dc7eb4d90ac5.sourceText: 产权保险基本上跟一般保险一样，都是保险公司和投保者之间的一个契约，当投保者有损失时，保险公司会依照合约上的条款，赔偿投保者，但产权保险最大的不同点，在于它通常只保障保险契约订定之前已存在的问题，不像一般保险，是保障契约生效之后所发生的问题。
21f371261f5342bcf2b2ed7a68e6dc7eb4d90ac5.translatedText: Title insurance is basically the same as general insurance. It is a contract between the insurance company and the insured. When the insured suffers a loss, the insurance company will compensate the insured in accordance with the terms of the contract. However, the biggest difference with title insurance is that it usually only protects problems that existed before the insurance contract was entered into. Unlike general insurance, it protects problems that occur after the contract takes effect.

6e21340620a222fab98deac9c6d47058f054f2bf.sourceText: 所以产权保险是为了保障房地产购买者，不会因为购买到产权有问题的房地产而遭受损失，您如果是贷款买房地产，贷款银行也会为了保障自身的权益，而要求您购买产权保险，因此产权保险有两种，一种是产权人保单(Owner抯 Policy)、它保障您的权益，通常由卖方付保费，另一种是银行保单(Lender抯 Policy)、在保障银行的权益，传统上由贷款人付保费，可视为贷款费用的一部份。
6e21340620a222fab98deac9c6d47058f054f2bf.translatedText: Therefore, title insurance is to protect real estate buyers from suffering losses due to the purchase of real estate with questionable title. If you buy real estate with a loan, the lending bank will also require you to purchase title insurance in order to protect its own rights and interests. Therefore, there are two types of title insurance, one is the owner's policy (Owner's Policy), which protects your rights and interests. The seller usually pays the premium, and the other is the bank policy (Lender's policy). Policy), in order to protect the interests of the bank, the lender traditionally pays the premium, which can be regarded as part of the loan fee.

The second preference for Chinese-born professional immigrants remains unchanged and may go backwards in the future. Relative-based immigration category: First priority (unmarried adult children of citizens): eight weeks before transfer. Second priority: Category 2 (spouse and minor children of permanent residents): ten weeks after immigration. Category 2 (unmarried adult children of permanent residents): eight weeks of immigration. Third priority (married children of citizens): six weeks in advance. Fourth priority (brothers and sisters of adult citizens): Moved within four weeks. Occupational immigration category: second priority for those born in China (those with advanced degrees or special abilities): stay put. The world’s third priority general category (skilled workers, professionals): moved three weeks earlier. Third priority general category for those born in China: eight weeks before transfer. The third priority category in the world (other categories (unskilled workers such as nannies and housekeepers)): moved in for three weeks. The third-priority category for Chinese-born students is still standing still.

0ffe760c6c54cf943777500dc2b9b6de84789bb6.sourceText: 又到一年报税时，谈如何避免被查税 （亚省时报） 在2010年每10个被查税的人中，有八个人要补税和罚款。在…
0ffe760c6c54cf943777500dc2b9b6de84789bb6.translatedText: When it’s time to file taxes again, let’s talk about how to avoid being audited (Alberta Times) In 2010, eight out of every 10 people who were audited had to pay back taxes and fines. In...

c327302f9bd9109583c6995119b3967f1b5db2a8.sourceText: 在2010年每10个被查税的人中，有八个人要补税和罚款。在2011年，国税局扣除（garnish）工资或查封银行帐户370万个。要减少查税机率，必须对自己的收入和支出有全面的掌握，收集所有报税文件，保存好原始单据，使自己报税符合税法并合法省税。 由于电脑科技的发展和报税日益複杂，国税局已不用人工筛选查税，所有的筛选程序都用电脑进行。不被查税首先是不要被电脑亮起 Red Flag, Red Flag 亮起是由于国税局在电脑程序中设定各种比对。这些比对的差异超过一定限度，电脑就会亮起「Red Flag」。最重要的比对有三个：一是W-2表和1099 表都是由第三方如雇主同时提供给个人和国税局。今年报税，国税局在股票公司呈报国税局的1099B表中加入每股股票交易成本，将与新的8949表比对；增加新的商业卡和第三方付款的1099K表与小生意C表比对；增加新的海外资产申报8939表与外国银行呈报给国税局资料比对。二是个人报税与其他类似个人的平均数比对。如果该地区的其类似职业的人扣除各种费用后有四至五万元的淨收入，但此人为领低收入退税和医疗保险，总收入只剩一万元淨收入，就可能被查。三是个人报税与本人其他资料相比对。如个人报低收入一万元，但银行报给国税局你付给银行的房屋抵押贷款利息却有两万元；还有个人报低收入多年，却能用现金买多处房产，都可能被查税。 2011年，国税局查了160 万个人税表，约占总报税的1%。其中20万以上收入被查比率为3.9%, 100万收入以上为12.5%。高收入者报税时，用各种抵扣如慈善捐款、居家办公、汽车里程、请客娱乐等花费时要特别小心。如果小生意C表出现负数，被查机率几乎为百分之百。另一方面，申领个人低收入退税（EITC）被查税的比率也非常高。 国税局将从「事后追踪报税人」的方式，转变到「事前或即时的减少查税负担」的方法。比如上国税局对2011年低收入退税审查的8867表，会计师要详细询问客户收入来源，如无收入证明W-2或1099表，对现金收入者要进一步询问合理解释。不符合资格申请低收入退税，会计师要将其以书面计入客户文件桉，以备国税局稽查。该8867表，要由会计师签名与客户个人报税一起呈交国税局。不实申报者，会计师和客户都得受罚。由于注册会计师有政府和行业的严格规范，由他们签名的个人报税，被查税的机率比一般报税业者要小得多。
c327302f9bd9109583c6995119b3967f1b5db2a8.translatedText: In 2010, eight out of every 10 people who were audited had to pay back taxes and fines. In 2011, the IRS garnished wages or seized bank accounts from 3.7 million people. To reduce the chance of tax audit, you must have a comprehensive understanding of your income and expenses, collect all tax filing documents, and keep the original documents so that your tax filing complies with tax laws and saves taxes legally. Due to the development of computer technology and the increasing complexity of tax filing, the IRS no longer needs to manually screen and inspect taxes. All screening procedures are conducted by computer. The first thing to avoid being audited is to avoid having the computer light up the Red Flag. The Red Flag lights up because the IRS sets various comparisons in the computer program. If the difference between these comparisons exceeds a certain limit, the computer will light up the "Red Flag". There are three most important comparisons: First, W-2 forms and 1099 forms are both provided to individuals and the IRS by third parties such as employers. For this year's tax filing, the IRS added per-share transaction costs to Form 1099B reported by stock companies to the IRS, which will be compared with the new Form 8949; added Form 1099K for commercial cards and third-party payments for comparison with Form C for small businesses; added new Form 8939 for declaration of overseas assets for comparison with information reported to the IRS by foreign banks. The second is to compare the individual tax return with the average of other similar individuals. If people in similar occupations in the area have a net income of 40,000 to 50,000 yuan after deducting various expenses, but this person receives low-income tax rebates and medical insurance, and the total income is only 10,000 yuan in net income, he may be investigated. The third is to compare the personal tax return with other personal information. For example, if an individual reports a low income of 10,000 yuan, but the bank reports to the IRS that the mortgage interest paid to the bank is 20,000 yuan; if an individual reports a low income for many years, but is able to buy multiple properties with cash, they may be subject to tax inspection. In 2011, the IRS reviewed 1.6 million personal tax returns, accounting for about 1% of all tax returns. Among them, the investigation rate was 3.9% for those with incomes above RMB 200,000, and 12.5% ​​for those with incomes above RMB 1 million. When filing taxes, high-income earners should be particularly careful when using deductions for various expenses such as charitable donations, home offices, car mileage, entertainment, etc. If a negative number appears on the C list of a small business, the probability of being investigated is almost 100%. On the other hand, the rate of tax inspections for those who apply for the Individual Income Tax Credit (EITC) is also very high. The IRS will shift from the method of "tracking tax filers after the event" to the method of "reducing tax audit burdens beforehand or immediately." For example, in the IRS's 2011 low-income tax refund review form 8867, the accountant must inquire in detail about the client's source of income. If there is no W-2 or 1099 form to prove income, cash earners must further inquire for a reasonable explanation. If you are not eligible to apply for a low-income tax refund, the accountant must include it in writing in the client's file for IRS inspection. This Form 8867 must be signed by an accountant and submitted to the IRS along with the client's personal tax return. Both accountants and clients will be punished for false declarations. Since CPAs are subject to strict government and industry regulations, personal tax returns signed by them are much less likely to be audited than general tax preparers.

267e5f3e4c50b693e2beecc3395e1e0a56c1e00b.sourceText: 一间在亚利桑那州4卧2浴及烧木柴壁炉的住宅，估价达12万5000元，现在进行1分钱大拍卖，这个推广相信是同类网上拍卖的首次。
267e5f3e4c50b693e2beecc3395e1e0a56c1e00b.translatedText: A 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home with a wood-burning fireplace in Arizona is valued at $125,000. It is now being auctioned for 1 cent. This promotion is believed to be the first of its kind online auction.

d93bd9368ac8ad012382ede518f2bce9a95263a9.sourceText: ABC新闻报道，电子和其他各种消费品的1分钱拍卖早已屡见不鲜，但房地产1分钱拍卖似乎还是首次。
d93bd9368ac8ad012382ede518f2bce9a95263a9.translatedText: >ABC News reported that one-cent auctions of electronics and various other consumer goods have long been common, but this seems to be the first time that real estate has been auctioned for one cent.

64ecd0be3cef1ed0bcbf4a46022e364221238edc.sourceText: 经过房子于周日的开放日后，叫价即由周五的5分钱，「暴涨」至15分。
64ecd0be3cef1ed0bcbf4a46022e364221238edc.translatedText: After the house's open house on Sunday, the asking price "skyrocketed" from 5 cents on Friday to 15 cents.

0644e15a3bc8fc89920eec6233987f93b2f35009.sourceText: 网站iBidForAcent.com的创作者和拥有人塔尔博特表示，这幢1749平方呎的住宅是一间全装修、有匙即住的家。他于1月时在法拍以8万1000元买下，再花了2万元去进行改善。卧室和客厅都有新地毯、新油漆及新装置，厨房也有新橱柜、花岗岩台面和用具。这位处于亚利桑那州格伦代尔(Glendale)的West Acoma Drive 6214号。
0644e15a3bc8fc89920eec6233987f93b2f35009.translatedText: Talbot, creator and owner of iBidForAcent.com, said the 1,749-square-foot home is a fully furnished, move-in ready home. He bought it at a foreclosure sale in January for NT$81,000 and spent another NT$20,000 on improvements. The bedrooms and living room have new carpet, new paint and new fixtures, and the kitchen has new cabinets, granite countertops and appliances. This one is located at 6214 West Acoma Drive in Glendale, Arizona.

c15905a772c51802941de904073e1ba1ce6adf5e.sourceText: 在被问及对于最高叫价仍是15分会否感到失望，塔尔博特说，「目前仍然为时尚早。」拍卖将于亚利桑那州时间的明天(13日)下午5时结束。他说，很多的叫价也是最后才出手。「我们有来自全国各地的人注册。」
c15905a772c51802941de904073e1ba1ce6adf5e.translatedText: Asked if he was disappointed that the highest asking price was still 15 cents, Talbot said, "It's still too early." The auction will end at 5 pm Arizona time tomorrow (13th). He said many of the bids were made last. "We have people from all over the country registering."

f5414ba26b9a04441c4e1a63b1c606538b2c632e.sourceText: 到了13日的下午5时，「公开竞投将结束，之后就会开始20秒的延长投标。在这20秒的倒数中如果有人出价的话，就会再开始倒数20秒，直至在20秒之内都没有人出价为止。最后就价高者得。」
f5414ba26b9a04441c4e1a63b1c606538b2c632e.translatedText: At 5 pm on the 13th, "the public bidding will end, and then a 20-second extended bidding will begin. If someone bids during this 20-second countdown, the countdown will start again." 0 seconds, until no one bids within 20 seconds, the highest bidder will win."

066e26f1fa28ab061a5090a3df6b4aa2e8384aa8.sourceText: 这间房子的底价是2750元，即是它可以卖出的最低价格，塔尔博特预计最终成交可能会低至5000元。
066e26f1fa28ab061a5090a3df6b4aa2e8384aa8.translatedText: The reserve price of this house is 2,750 yuan, which is the lowest price it can be sold for. Talbot predicts that the final transaction may be as low as 5,000 yuan.

915b825eaf6c90b91008a49812a8eb0620481fd3.sourceText: 由于设有最低价，塔尔博特竞，「我有点害怕没有人会出价。」于是，他发起了一些奖励措施。在其间出价次数最多的人，将自动获得1万5000元，而第二多的则获得5000元。
915b825eaf6c90b91008a49812a8eb0620481fd3.translatedText: Since there was a minimum price, Talbot said, "I was a little scared that no one would bid." So he launched some incentives. The person with the most bids will automatically receive $15,000, while the second-highest bidder will receive $5,000.

4b338da530dd2c874240206a495ba106d0689817.sourceText: 塔尔博特也有透过售卖投标包来赚钱，这些从60元至6000元的投标包，是用来在网上叫价。而每一次叫价的话，也要支付60分的费用。
4b338da530dd2c874240206a495ba106d0689817.translatedText: Talbot also makes money by selling bid packages. These bid packages, ranging from 60 yuan to 6,000 yuan, are used to bid online. And every time you bid, you have to pay a fee of 60 cents.

7ba59b670b16156565eafcea2433024950e98482.sourceText: 如果这次的房子1分钱大拍卖证实成功的话，塔尔博特表示将扩展至其他城市，包括达拉斯和拉斯维加斯。
7ba59b670b16156565eafcea2433024950e98482.translatedText: If the penny home auction proves successful, Talbot said it will expand to other cities, including Dallas and Las Vegas.

5b13bf99f3b8230de85a47c6c545333706b8f5eb.sourceText: 2012年亚利桑那州立大学（ASU）中文夏令营将于6月10日至6月24日在ASU Tempe校区举行。夏令营一共15天住校生活，给学生提供用中文以及中国文化拓展知识的机会。活动有非常鲜明而且具有建设性的主题，以及课程。在活动中学生能够学习到中文，并参与到有趣的文化活动。 整个夏令营将会以生活化的环境，进行学习和参与，学生们可以感受到大学生的生活。在夏令营后，也可以继续申请中文学习。 本次夏令营招收9到12年级的高中生，他们可以是完全没有中文基础的，或者是中级中文水平。学费，住宿，餐费以及学习材料，全免费，由Startalk计划来承担。活动只需要175美元不能返还的注册费。如果您对中文有兴趣，并且希望提高中文，就欢迎报名！报名时间截止到2012年4月5日。 报名材料请到下面链接 http: //asu.edu/clas/silc/startalk.
5b13bf99f3b8230de85a47c6c545333706b8f5eb.translatedText: 2012 Arizona State University (ASU) Chinese Summer Camp will be held at ASU from June 10th to June 24th Held on the Tempe campus. The summer camp has a total of 15 days of living on campus, providing students with the opportunity to expand their knowledge in Chinese and Chinese culture. The activities have very distinct and constructive themes and courses. During the activities, students can learn Chinese and participate in interesting cultural activities. The entire summer camp will be conducted in a living environment for learning and participation, and students can feel the life of college students. After the summer camp, you can also continue to apply for Chinese language learning. This summer camp recruits high school students from grades 9 to 12. They can have no Chinese foundation at all or have an intermediate level of Chinese. Tuition, accommodation, meals and study materials are all free of charge and will be borne by the Startalk plan. The event only requires a non-refundable registration fee of $175. If you are interested in Chinese and want to improve your Chinese, you are welcome to sign up! Registration deadline is April 5, 2012. Please go to the following link for registration materials: //asu.edu/clas/silc/startalk.

c5624de81fcabcdff8a788bc4eca97f2b5ec9608.sourceText: 由凤凰城侨界共同发起，为庆祝中华人民共和国成立六十三周年共同举办的升旗典礼巳准备就绪，定於2012年9月15日上午九点整在美国退伍军人亚省总部门前广塲举行。这是凤凰城地区华人华侨对祖国爱心的展示，也是献给祖国生日的一份珍贵的礼物。我们祝愿我们的祖国更加繁荣昌盛，人民幸福安康，也祝愿中美两国的友谊和相互交往不断巩固和发展。
c5624de81fcabcdff8a788bc4eca97f2b5ec9608.translatedText: Co-sponsored by the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix City and co-organized to celebrate the 63rd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, the flag-raising ceremony is ready and is scheduled to be held at 9:00 a.m. on September 15, 2012 in front of the American Veterans Affairs Department of Alberta Headquarters. This is a display of love for the motherland by the Chinese and overseas Chinese in the Phoenix area, and it is also a precious gift dedicated to the birthday of the motherland. We wish that our motherland will become more prosperous and its people happy and healthy, and that the friendship and mutual exchanges between China and the United States will continue to consolidate and develop.

c562ad4853b2c12c1a83131421f67c9345b2da47.sourceText: 升旗典礼己收到中华人民共和国驻洛杉磯总领馆发来的贺信，卞立新副总领事将到会祝贺并发表讲话；亚利桑那的议员也将到会祝贺，欢迎本地华人华侨踊跃参加，共襄盛举。参加升旗典礼的朋友请於八点四十五分前入场，九点正式开始。 此次升旗典礼主席团成员由各侨团负责人33人组成。（名字不分先后）
c562ad4853b2c12c1a83131421f67c9345b2da47.translatedText: The flag-raising ceremony has received a congratulatory letter from the Consulate General of the People's Republic of China in Los Angeles. 6d46821c2468582724aeb380bb4f611ba2a8a4f8.sourceText: 九月十五日上午十时，纪念九一八和抗战胜利座谈会在凤凰城华人耆英 会召开。座谈会邀请了普林斯顿大学博士，歷史学部研究员，亚利桑那州立大学助理教授陈怀宇先生主讲，题目是”国际视野下的中日衝突与抗战时期的文化抗争”许多朋友将回顾抗战时期中国人民同仇敌愾，抗击日本侵略军的英勇事蹟和本地华侨支援与投身抗日的史实。华人耆英会的长者将以激动的心情演唱抗战时期聂耳、洗星海创作的歌曲，把人们带回到那苦难和热血沸腾的年代。这将是一堂生动的歷史课，机会难得。本次座谈会向社会免费开放，欢迎大家参加。由部份发起人赞助，中午座谈会结束时备有简易午歺。
6d46821c2468582724aeb380bb4f611ba2a8a4f8.translatedText: At 10:00 am on September 15th, a symposium to commemorate September 18th and the victory of the Anti-Japanese War was held at the Phoenix Chinese Elders Association. The symposium invited Mr. Chen Huaiyu, a Ph.D. from Princeton University, researcher in the Department of History, and assistant professor at Arizona State University, to give a lecture titled "The Sino-Japanese Conflict from an International Perspective and the Cultural Struggle during the Anti-Japanese War." Many friends will review the heroic deeds of the Chinese people during the Anti-Japanese War, when they shared the same hatred against the Japanese invaders and the historical facts of local overseas Chinese supporting and participating in the anti-Japanese war. The elders of the Chinese Senior Citizens Association will sing with excitement the songs composed by Nie Er and Xi Xinghai during the Anti-Japanese War, bringing people back to that suffering and passionate era. This will be a vivid history lesson and a rare opportunity. This symposium is free and open to the public, and everyone is welcome to attend. Sponsored by some sponsors, a simple lunch will be served at the end of the symposium.

02e13ef7ced7a56f89929548578165b53f487e0e.sourceText: 员工福利研究所28日公布最新研究显示，50岁以上美国人中约有20%的人为了省钱，而选用便宜的处方药、不服该用的药，或者根本不就医。 研究结果表明，高昂的健保费迫使部分美国人在花钱与维护身体健康之间犹豫不决。 员工福利研究所对2009年调查的4433名逾50岁的美国人进行分析，以找出多少人因经济负担而不去看病和吃药。结果有19%的人说，他们为省钱而不去看医生或推迟医生预约。21.5%的人说，他们为省钱而更改处方药，许多人是选用便宜的普通药或免费的试用药。 约四分之一更改处方药的人说，他们的服药时程停过一次或多次。另有约四分之一的人说，为了延长服药的时间，他们每次服药时，是把药片分成小片或减少剂量。 偶尔一次停止服药或不去看医生，对身体健康的人可能影响并不大。但研究人员发现，最可能停止服药或不去看医生的人，往往是身体较差的人，再就是单身女性与非洲裔。
02e13ef7ced7a56f89929548578165b53f487e0e.translatedText: The Employee Benefit Research Institute released the latest research on the 28th, showing that in order to save money, about 20% of Americans over the age of 50 take cheaper prescription drugs, do not take the medicines they should take, or do not seek medical treatment at all. The findings suggest that high health care premiums are forcing some Americans to hesitate between spending money and maintaining their health. The Employee Benefit Research Institute analyzed a 2009 survey of 4,433 Americans over the age of 50 to find out how many were skipping doctor's appointments and taking medications because of financial burdens. As a result, 19% said they skipped seeing a doctor or postponed doctor's appointments to save money. 21.5% said they changed their prescription drugs to save money, with many choosing cheaper generic drugs or free trial drugs. About a quarter of people who changed their prescriptions said they had stopped taking them one or more times. About a quarter of people said that in order to extend the time they took the medicine, they broke the pill into smaller pieces or reduced the dose each time they took the medicine. Stopping medication or not seeing a doctor once in a while may not have much impact on a healthy person. But researchers found that the people most likely to stop taking their medications or see a doctor tended to be those in poor health, followed by single women and African Americans.

637736065bab8f9560d4e362f1b51cc9f504de91.sourceText: 未注射疫苗的孩子仍会受疾病威胁 （亚省时报） 联邦卫生官员周四表示，2011-2012学年，尽管绝大多数学前班孩子已经注射了麻疹等可预防疾病的疫苗，但有些社区未注射疫苗的孩子，仍然会受到疾病的威胁。 据路透社报道，联邦疾病控制和预防中心在一份新报告中认为，依照联邦指导方针，95％以上的学前班孩子都注射了白喉、破伤风、无细胞型百日咳、脊髓灰质炎和B型肝炎疫苗疫苗。 研究发现，94.8％的学前班孩子已经注射了麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹疫苗，93.2％的学前班孩子注射了两剂量的水痘疫苗，这样的疫苗接种率略低于联邦政府95％的目标水平或更高的接种率。 这项由联邦公众健康和安全机构所作的研究，其数据来源于47个州和哥伦比亚特区，该研究发现了儿童未注射疫苗或疫苗接种率过低的那些地区，但该报告没有公布这些区域的具体位置。 联邦疾病预防控制中心说，尽管就州的层面而言，疫苗接种覆盖率已经或接近达到联邦目标水平，但对疫苗接种覆盖率低的地区来说，像麻疹这样的传染性疾病仍然会公共健康。 去年全国共爆发了17次麻疹疫情，总共出现了 222例麻疹患者，这是自1996年以来的最高值。国家免疫和呼吸系统疾病中心副主任沃顿（Melinda Wharton）博士指出，绝大多数从其他国家感染到麻疹的患者，都没有注射麻疹疫苗，这进一步凸显了高接种率对美国学童的重要性。 有些孩子的父母出于安全的考虑，会不让或推迟让孩子注射疫苗，比如，他们担心注射疫苗和自闭症会不会有关系，但迄今为止，国家疾病控制中心的研究都没有发现这两者之间有任何关系。
637736065bab8f9560d4e362f1b51cc9f504de91.translatedText: Unvaccinated children are still at risk from disease (Alberta Times) Federal health officials said Thursday that although the vast majority of preschool children were vaccinated against preventable diseases such as measles during the 2011-2012 school year, unvaccinated children in some communities are still at risk from the disease. According to Reuters, the federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention concluded in a new report that more than 95% of preschool children are vaccinated against diphtheria, tetanus, acellular pertussis, polio and hepatitis B in accordance with federal guidelines. The study found that 94.8 per cent of pre-K children had received the measles, mumps and rubella vaccine and 93.2 per cent of pre-K children had received two doses of chickenpox vaccine, which is slightly below the federal government's target level of 95 per cent or higher. The study by the federal public health and safety agency, which drew data from 47 states and the District of Columbia, identified areas where children were unvaccinated or had low vaccination rates, but the report did not release the exact locations of those areas. The federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention said that although at the state level, vaccination coverage is at or close to reaching federal target levels, infectious diseases like measles remain a public health concern in areas with low vaccination coverage. Last year, there were 17 measles outbreaks across the country, with a total of 222 cases of measles, the highest number since 1996. Dr. Melinda Wharton, deputy director of the National Center for Immunization and Respiratory Diseases, pointed out that the vast majority of patients infected with measles from other countries have not been vaccinated against measles, which further highlights the importance of high vaccination rates for American schoolchildren. Some parents of children will not allow or delay vaccinations for their children due to safety concerns. For example, they worry about whether there is a relationship between vaccinations and autism. However, so far, research by the National Centers for Disease Control has not found any relationship between the two.
