b239c1722e55068f41b8b0c922b71d732976cd73.sourceText: 大学专业薪 石油最高幼教低 （亚省时报） 美国大学专业百百种，有的专业象征就业金饭碗，但有的则是找工作不容易。根据1份报告，收入最高的大学专业是石油工程、制药；最低的则是谘商、幼儿教育。 美国国务院国际资讯局（IIP）在部落格”美国参考”中指出，乔治城大学（Georgetown University）教育与劳动力中心用人口普查局的资料，对171种不同专业毕业生毕业后的薪酬进行研究分析，发现不同专业间的收入差别高达4倍。 乔治城大学的报告指出，美国收入最高的10种专业按收入中位数为标准来计算，分别为：石油工程（年薪12万美元）；药学、制药科学及管理（10.5万美 元）；数学与计算机科学（9.8万美元）；航空航天工程（8.7万美元）；化学工程（8.6万美元）；电气工程（8.5万美元）；造船及海洋工程（8.2 万美元）；机械工程（8万美元）；冶金工程（8万美元）；采矿和矿物工程（8万美元）。 收入最低的10项专业分别为：谘询及心理学（年薪 2.9万美元）；儿童早期教育（3.6万美元）；神学与宗教（3.8万美元）；民众服务和社区组织（3.8万美元）；社工（3.9万美元）；戏剧与表演艺 术（4万美元）；工作坊艺术（4万美元）；人际交往障碍及服务（4万美元）；视觉与表演艺术（4万美元）；初级健康及医学项目（4万美元）。 人口普查局的资料还发现在各个大学专业中，精算学、药理学、教育管理、学生辅导、地质和地球物理工程、天文和天体物理、师范教育、农业经济、医疗技术、大气科学和气象等专业的学生，最容易找到工作，毕业后的就业率最高。 根据乔治城大学教育与劳动力中心的研究，建筑学的毕业生最难找工作，在22岁至26岁的毕业生中，他们的失业率高达13.9%。其他失业率比较高的专业包括：艺术（11.1%）、人文科学（9.4%）等。 从总体上看，大学毕业生的失业率比没有大学学历的还是低很多。
b239c1722e55068f41b8b0c922b71d732976cd73.translatedText: The salary of college majors, the highest preschool education is low in petroleum (Alberta Times) There are hundreds of majors in American universities, and some majors symbolize golden jobs, but some make it difficult to find a job. According to a report, the highest-paying university majors are petroleum engineering and pharmaceuticals; the lowest-paying majors are consulting and early childhood education. The U.S. Department of State's Bureau of International Information (IIP) pointed out in the blog "American Reference" that the Center for Education and the Workforce at Georgetown University used Census Bureau data to conduct research and analysis on the post-graduation salaries of graduates in 171 different majors and found that the income difference between different majors is as high as 4 times. The Georgetown University report pointed out that the 10 highest-paying majors in the United States, based on median income, are: petroleum engineering (annual salary $120,000); pharmacy, pharmaceutical sciences and management ($105,000); mathematics and computer science ($98,000); aerospace engineering ($87,000); chemical engineering ($86,000); electrical engineering ($85,000); shipbuilding and ocean engineering ($82,000) Mechanical Engineering (USD 80,000); Metallurgical Engineering (USD 80,000); Mining and Mineral Engineering (USD 80,000). The 10 lowest-paying majors are: Counseling and Psychology ($29,000 annual salary); Early Childhood Education ($36,000); Theology and Religion ($38,000); Human Services and Community Organization ($38,000); Social Work ($39,000); Theater and Performing Arts Arts ($40,000); Workshop Arts ($40,000); Interpersonal Disorders and Services ($40,000); Visual and Performing Arts ($40,000); Primary Health and Medical Programs ($40,000). Census Bureau data also found that among various college majors, students majoring in actuarial science, pharmacology, educational administration, student counseling, geology and geophysical engineering, astronomy and astrophysics, teacher education, agricultural economics, medical technology, atmospheric science and meteorology are the easiest to find a job and have the highest employment rate after graduation. According to research from Georgetown University's Center on Education and the Workforce, architecture graduates have the hardest time finding work, with unemployment rates as high as 13.9% among graduates aged 22 to 26. Other majors with relatively high unemployment rates include: arts (11.1%), humanities (9.4%), etc. Overall, the unemployment rate for college graduates is much lower than that of those without a college degree.

245b7b7a7103e3050e7cfa09b331561b8183692d.sourceText: 汽车厂商丰田、克莱斯勒双双召回 （亚省时报） 丰田汽车3月7日星期三表示，将召回近73万辆美国和加拿大的汽车，以解决驾驶座安全气袋和一个可能阻止车辆启动的开关存在的潜在问题。 丰田公司说，还没有听说”这两种情况造成任何意外或者人员受伤”；而且受影响的车型并没有销售到北美以外。 此外，意大利的菲亚特公司旗下的克莱斯勒汽车公司同一天也宣布，将在全球范围召回超过26万7000辆吉普自由运动型多功能车，解决一个可能导致撞车的潜在的腐蚀问题。 克莱斯勒在一份电子邮件声明中说，全球范围的召回行动涉及26万7353辆汽车，主要针对2004年和2005年的吉普自由运动型多功能车型。 克莱斯勒召回的车辆中有20万9746辆在美国市场，主要集中在冬季经常使用道路盐防滑的各州。
245b7b7a7103e3050e7cfa09b331561b8183692d.translatedText: Automobile manufacturers Toyota and Chrysler both recalled (Alberta Times) Toyota said on Wednesday, March 7, that it would recall nearly 730,000 vehicles in the United States and Canada to address potential problems with the driver's air bag and a switch that could prevent the vehicle from starting. Toyota said it was not aware of "any accidents or injuries resulting from either situation" and that the affected models were not sold outside of North America. In addition, Chrysler Automobiles, a unit of Italy's Fiat, also announced on the same day that it would recall more than 267,000 Jeep Liberty sport utility vehicles worldwide to address a potential corrosion problem that could lead to crashes. Chrysler said in an emailed statement that the global recall affects 267,353 vehicles and targets 2004 and 2005 Jeep Liberty Sport utility models. Chrysler is recalling 209,746 vehicles in the U.S., mainly in states where road salt is often used to prevent skids in the winter.

9a30ceb639697de2a7cc3d16159e2c06c6f1a53e.sourceText: 退休谘询公司韬睿惠悦(Towers Watson)最新民调显示，经济虽在复甦中，但并未让美国人对自己的财务前景感觉更有保障，事实上，许多劳工反而担忧退休福利再遭削减，以及更高的健康照顾自付成本。 今日美国报报导，该民调发现，民众普遍的担忧已导致有逾半数(55%)的劳工表示，愿意放弃未来的加薪，以获得更多保障的退休收入。另外，有50%受访者表示，他们也把一部分的收入用于确保健康照顾的福利。 韬睿惠悦的资深退休顾问华格纳(Kevin Wagner)表示：「该民调结果可能反映劳工对金融市场易变性的直接感受，并持续担忧经济，以及未来福利遭削减。」 员工福利研究所(EBRI)共同主任亚当斯(Nevin Adams)表示，美国人已逐渐体认他们必须面临退休的现实。韬睿惠悦的调查发现，虽然年纪较大劳工在退休前由股市翻身的时间有限，但年轻员工则是最担忧退休保障。 事实上，在40岁和以下的劳工中，愿意付出更多保障退休福利的比率，自2009年已增加约70%。 财政部为协助纾解劳工的担忧，最近提出一些规定，可使401(k)计画更容易让劳工把一部分退休储蓄放入退休时领取的年金。 不过，此举无法解决劳工面临的所有财务风险。调查显示，有近三分之二、即64%的受访者表示，健康照顾成本的攀升，也是他们对退休担忧的主要原因。 保险退休研究所(IRI)1月份公布的报告指出，一名身体健康的65岁男性，可预期馀生的健康照顾成本将达35万元，女性则至少41万7000元。
9a30ceb639697de2a7cc3d16159e2c06c6f1a53e.translatedText: Towers Watson, a retirement consulting company Watson's latest poll shows that although the economy is recovering, it has not made Americans feel more secure about their financial future. In fact, many workers are worried about further cuts to retirement benefits and higher out-of-pocket costs for health care. USA Today reported that the poll found that widespread public concerns have led more than half (55%) of workers to say they are willing to give up future salary increases in order to obtain more guaranteed retirement income. In addition, 50% of the respondents said that they also spend part of their income on ensuring health care benefits. Kevin Wagner, a senior retirement consultant at Towers Watson, said: "The poll results may reflect workers' direct feelings about the volatility of financial markets and continued concerns about the economy and future benefit cuts." Nevin Adams, co-director of the Employee Benefit Research Institute (EBRI), said Americans have gradually come to realize that they must face the reality of retirement. Towers Watson's survey found that although older workers have limited time to make a comeback from the stock market before retirement, younger workers are most worried about retirement security. In fact, the proportion of workers aged 40 and under who are willing to pay more to secure retirement benefits has increased by about 70% since 2009. To help ease workers' concerns, the Treasury Department recently proposed rules that would make it easier for workers to put a portion of their retirement savings into an annuity in retirement through 401(k) plans. However, this move will not address all financial risks faced by workers. The survey shows that nearly two-thirds, or 64%, of the respondents said that the rising cost of health care is also the main reason for their worries about retirement. A report released by the Insurance Retirement Research Institute (IRI) in January pointed out that a healthy 65-year-old man can expect health care costs for the rest of his life to be $350,000, and for women, at least $417,000.

e090d668de999258fb8795c2641c8ea90f46b3b8.sourceText: 英国《泰晤士报》公布的该排行榜征求了全球1.7万名学者的意见与看法，排在前10名的大学分别为：哈佛大学、麻省理工学院、剑桥大学、斯坦福大学、加州大学伯克利分校、牛津大学、普林斯顿大学、东京大学、加州大学洛杉矶分校和耶鲁大学。
e090d668de999258fb8795c2641c8ea90f46b3b8.translatedText: The ranking published by the British "Times" solicited the opinions and views of 17,000 scholars around the world. The top 10 universities are: Harvard University, MIT, University of Cambridge, Stanford University, University of California, Berkeley, University of Oxford, Princeton University, University of Tokyo, University of California, Los Angeles, and Yale University.

1f0e493b15f2dd6a0a4a5a889a103a6190b8e594.sourceText: 在2012年全球大学声誉排行榜中，哈佛大学与麻省理工高踞前两名，亚洲大学的声誉排名呈上升趋势，清华大学升至第30名。
1f0e493b15f2dd6a0a4a5a889a103a6190b8e594.translatedText: In the 2012 global university reputation rankings, Harvard University and MIT ranked top two. The reputation rankings of Asian universities are on the rise, with Tsinghua University rising to 30th place.

cdb40dc7f8f95b2e6a966f17536239f03abf3b6e.sourceText: 在这次连续第2年的大学声誉调查中，美国大学在前百名声誉最佳的大学中占有多达44个席位，英国占10席，日本占5席。
cdb40dc7f8f95b2e6a966f17536239f03abf3b6e.translatedText: In this second consecutive university reputation survey, American universities account for 44 seats among the top 100 most reputable universities, the UK occupies 10 seats, and Japan occupies 5 seats.

42c5798b264eb1dffbe36177864e3720599c4857.sourceText: 报道指，亚洲大学的声誉排名呈上升趋势。清华大学由去年的第35升至第30，是中国排名最高的大学。北京大学由去年的第43升至第38，香港大学则由去年的第42升至第39。
42c5798b264eb1dffbe36177864e3720599c4857.translatedText: Reports indicate that the reputation rankings of Asian universities are on the rise. Tsinghua University rose to 30th from 35th last year, making it the highest-ranked university in China. Peking University rose from 43rd last year to 38th, while the University of Hong Kong rose from 42nd to 39th.

6fa4cbb14eddfa8e7db8e15e243c0b8fbe732592.sourceText: 日本东京大学是排名最高的亚洲大学，高踞排行榜第8，位于美国耶鲁大学之前。

He said that it was obvious from the survey that the prospects of universities were gradually shifting from the West to the East.

2b46c3903f9248cb61739a801b0929d66b393bfe.sourceText: 龙的华彩—2012洛杉矶中国摄影展节 （本报记者甄松伟洛杉矶摄影报道） 孙伟德副总领事向美联社著名摄影师，凭《战火中的女孩》荣获普利策新闻摄影奖和荷兰世界新闻摄影 奖，被誉为促使越战提前结束的战地摄影作品的作者（右二）黄功吾（Nick Ut)颁奖 洛杉矶是美国西部华人数量最多的城市，现今已发展成为中美两国之间经济和文化交流的重要地区，”洛杉矶中国摄影节”今年是第二届，今年的主题”龙的华彩”，旨在促进中美两地摄影家和摄影爱好者的专业交流与合作，共同推动摄影艺术的发展进步，以摄影艺术为桥梁，促进中美两国人民之间的文化交流，加深美国人民对当今中国发展状况的了解。近年来，随着两国经济文化交流的不断加深，”洛杉矶中国摄影节”吸引了越来越多的美国主流的关注，并日益成为中美两国文化交流的又一良好平台。 由美国《侨报》中国文化发展中心，美中摄影家协会，美国洛城摄影学会以及上海华侨摄影协会组成本届摄影节组委会。共同参与的有上海国际”郎静山摄影艺术奖”组委会，丽水市摄影家协会，香港《中国旅游》出版社，美国TCPA摄影学校，亚太博物馆等。 摄影节开幕式会场 本届摄影节邀请到来自中美两国的摄影团体和摄影家的众多优秀作品参展，其中不乏国际知名摄影师和国际摄影赛事的著名获奖作品。参展的有”中美摄影家联展”，65名摄影家100多幅摄影作品，”中国摄影之乡?#20029;水摄影家精品展”，著名摄影家吴品禾及其他30名摄影家84幅摄影作品，”上海国际郎静山摄影艺术奖精品展”也有100幅金像奖获得者的参展作品，从不同层面，不同角度反映中国摄影艺术的发展。摄影节由3月3日开幕展到3月14日，期间两国摄影家还进行研讨会座谈会等活动，参加当日开幕式的有中国驻洛杉矶总领馆副总领事孙伟德，文化参赞车兆以及组委会和参展单位的负责人，中美两地摄影艺术家，加州华裔民选官员200多人。 开幕式上嘉宾剪彩
2b46c3903f9248cb61739a801b0929d66b393bfe.translatedText: The brilliance of the dragon—2012 China Photography Festival in Los Angeles (Photography and reporting by our reporter Zhen Songwei in Los Angeles) Deputy Consul General Sun Weide presented the award to Nick Ut (second from right), a famous Associated Press photographer who won the Pulitzer Prize for News Photography and the Dutch World Press Photo Award for "Girl at War" and is known as the author of the battlefield photography that helped bring an early end to the Vietnam War. Los Angeles is the city with the largest number of Chinese people in the western United States. It has now developed into an important area for economic and cultural exchanges between China and the United States. This year's "Los Angeles Chinese Photography Festival" is in its second edition. This year's theme is "The Color of the Dragon." It aims to promote professional exchanges and cooperation between photographers and photography enthusiasts in China and the United States, jointly promote the development and progress of photography, use photography as a bridge to promote cultural exchanges between the people of China and the United States, and deepen the American people's understanding of the development of China today. In recent years, with the deepening of economic and cultural exchanges between the two countries, the "Los Angeles China Photography Festival" has attracted more and more mainstream attention in the United States, and has increasingly become another good platform for cultural exchanges between China and the United States. The organizing committee of this photography festival is composed of the Chinese Cultural Development Center of the American Overseas Chinese Newspaper, the US-China Photographers Association, the Los Angeles Photographic Society of the United States, and the Shanghai Overseas Chinese Photography Association. Co-participators include the Shanghai International "Lang Jingshan Photography Art Award" Organizing Committee, Lishui Photographers Association, Hong Kong "China Tourism" Publishing House, TCPA Photography School of the United States, Asia Pacific Museum, etc. Photography Festival Opening Ceremony Venue This photography festival invites many outstanding works from photography groups and photographers from China and the United States to participate in the exhibition, including many internationally renowned photographers and famous award-winning works from international photography competitions. Participating in the exhibition are the "Joint Exhibition of Chinese and American Photographers" with more than 100 photographic works by 65 photographers, the "Hometown of Photography in China Water Photographers Exhibition" with 84 photographic works by the famous photographer Wu Pinhe and 30 other photographers, and the "Shanghai International Lang Jingshan Photography Art Award Exhibition" with 100 works by Academy Award winners, reflecting the development of Chinese photography art from different levels and angles. The photography festival will run from the opening exhibition on March 3 to March 14. During this period, photographers from the two countries also held seminars and symposiums and other activities. The opening ceremony was attended by Sun Weide, Deputy Consul General of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, Cultural Counselor Che Zhao, heads of the organizing committee and exhibitors, photography artists from China and the United States, and more than 200 Chinese elected officials in California. Guests cut the ribbon at the opening ceremony

4f09532bd64126255d590ad43a5f1797c0e0ef21.sourceText: 各州纷立法 监管电子菸 （亚省时报） 电子香菸(E-Cigarettes)越来越流行，但由于联邦没有监管电子菸的法规，这种传统香菸代替品是否会影响公众健康的辩论也越趋激烈，各州亦已开始制定相关法律。 从亚利桑那到纽约等多个州的议员，现正推出法桉，禁止向未成年人出售电子菸。阿拉巴马、肯塔基、密西西比和犹他州的法桉，更扩大至禁止在公共场所使用电子菸，有些州的议员更提议开徵特别税。 随着更多人改抽电子菸，有关法桉纷纷出笼。电子菸是由电池发动，把液体尼古丁变成蒸汽，以便吸入。业界估计，电子菸自五年前从中国输入以来，全国每年的销售额已由2.5亿元增至5亿元。不过，对于美国约1000亿元香菸市场来说，比率仍算小。 联邦疾病防治中心(CDC)的调查显示，2010年，全国有2.7%成人曾试过电子菸，比前一年增加0.6%。 反吸菸团体寻求收紧电子菸的监管条例，他们说，电子菸对健康的影响仍未明暸，有关的科学研究也缺乏。另外，因电子菸有巧克力、樱桃等口味等，特别吸引青少年。 食品暨药物管理局(FDA)在2009年提出警告，经过化验室的样品分析后，发现其含有致癌物质和有毒化学物。FDA在同年4月说，计画把电子菸当成香菸般监管，但至今仍未提出建议。联邦要制定监管法规，可能须要几个月、甚至几年时间。 电子菸客和一些卫生专家则说，电子菸可帮老菸枪戒除害处更大的传统香菸。 夏威夷原本禁止向未成年人出售电子菸，但有1000多人致函反对后，上月改为把其税率提高至传统香菸一样。
4f09532bd64126255d590ad43a5f1797c0e0ef21.translatedText: States have enacted laws to regulate e-cigarettes (Alberta Times) Electronic cigarettes (E-Cigarettes) are becoming more and more popular, but because there are no federal regulations regulating e-cigarettes, the debate over whether this alternative to traditional cigarettes will affect public health has become increasingly fierce, and states have begun to enact relevant laws. Lawmakers in states from Arizona to New York are now introducing legislation to ban the sale of e-cigarettes to minors. Laws in Alabama, Kentucky, Mississippi and Utah have been expanded to ban the use of e-cigarettes in public places, and lawmakers in some states have even proposed imposing special taxes. As more people switch to e-cigarettes, relevant laws have been introduced. E-cigarettes are powered by batteries that turn liquid nicotine into vapor for inhalation. Industry estimates suggest that since e-cigarettes were imported from China five years ago, annual sales across the country have increased from 250 million yuan to 500 million yuan. However, for the US cigarette market of approximately 100 billion yuan, the ratio is still relatively small. A survey by the federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) showed that 2.7% of adults nationwide had tried e-cigarettes in 2010, an increase of 0.6% from the previous year. Anti-smoking groups seeking to tighten regulations on e-cigarettes say their health effects remain unclear and scientific research is lacking. In addition, because e-cigarettes come in flavors such as chocolate and cherry, they are particularly attractive to teenagers. The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) issued a warning in 2009 after analysis of laboratory samples found it contained carcinogens and toxic chemicals. The FDA said in April of the same year that it planned to regulate e-cigarettes like cigarettes, but has yet to make recommendations. It may take months, even years, for the federal government to formulate regulations. Vapers and some health experts say e-cigarettes can help former smokers quit more harmful traditional cigarettes. Hawaii originally banned the sale of e-cigarettes to minors, but last month raised the tax rate to the same as traditional cigarettes after more than 1,000 people wrote a letter opposing it.

This film festival is by far the highest-level and most influential short film competition and screening event for Chinese-speaking colleges and universities. The National Chinese Youth Federation hopes that college students from major well-known universities in North America will actively participate in this film festival to communicate and share each other’s wisdom, as well as their observations and insights on life through micro-films.

57d517187c305ff98aa356c56cef56cbb5285283.sourceText: 2012年亚省华联首届网球公开赛于3月3日在Corona del Sol High School 鸣金收兵，三个组别第一名、第二名各有归属。本次比赛吸引了20多名网球选手参赛。比赛从小组循环到决赛经过一整天的激烈争夺，决出了首届网球公开赛男子双打第一名、第二名，男子单打第一名、第二名，和女子单打第一名、第二名。他们分别是： 男子双打第一名：樊志强/袁强，第二名：王帷谘/Mike Liu 男子单打第一名：Jason Lew，第二名：邹志华 女子单打第一名：周清，第二名：王宇 祝贺他们取得比赛的胜利。亚省华联会长费健向获得第一名和第二名的选手颁发了奖杯和奖牌。比赛结果将张贴在亚省华联网站： www.chineseaz.org 。 此次网球公开赛为期一天，由亚省华联主办。亚省华联董事王惟谘召集并协同李教练一起提供专业的赛事组织：包括赛程的编排，比赛的格式和规则，等。亚省华联和本届公开赛的组织者感谢所有参赛的球员, 也特别感谢李教练和默默无闻的志愿者为本界网球公开赛提供的服务。 亚省华联秉承为社区服务的宗旨，乐意为华人华侨提供力所能及的服务。此次网球公开赛为网球爱好者提供了一个平台，各路好手汇聚一堂，利用这个难得的机会，再次享受了网球的乐趣。大家相约明年再会！
57d517187c305ff98aa356c56cef56cbb5285283.translatedText: The 2012 Alberta Hualian First Tennis Open was held at Corona del Sol High School on March 3 Ming Jin retreated, and the first and second places in the three groups each had their own place. This competition attracted more than 20 tennis players to participate. After a full day of fierce competition from the group cycle to the finals, the first and second place men's doubles, the first and second place men's singles, and the first and second place women's singles of the first Tennis Open were determined. They are: First place in men's doubles: Fan Zhiqiang/Yuan Qiang, second place: Wang Weizhen/Mike Liu. First place in men's singles: Jason Lew, second place: Zou Zhihua. First place in women's singles: Zhou Qing, second place: Wang Yu. Congratulations to them for winning the game. Fei Jian, president of the Alberta Chinese Federation, presented trophies and medals to the first and second place players. Competition results will be posted on the Alberta Hualien website: www.chineseaz.org. The one-day tennis open was hosted by the Hualian Association of Alberta. Director of the Alberta Hualien Wang Weijuan convened and worked with Coach Li to provide professional event organization: including the arrangement of the schedule, the format and rules of the competition, etc. The Alberta Hualian League and the organizers of this Open would like to thank all the players who participated, and especially thank Coach Li and the unknown volunteers for their services to this Open Tennis Open. The Hualian of Alberta adheres to the purpose of serving the community and is willing to provide services to the Chinese and overseas Chinese to the best of its ability. This Tennis Open provides a platform for tennis enthusiasts. Players from all walks of life gather together to take advantage of this rare opportunity to enjoy the fun of tennis again. See you all next year!

0f181de531f40ff8caff07631aa0ba26aadbc0cf.sourceText: 马利科巴郡警长阿派奥1日举行记者会，公布多日调查结果，指称白宫去年4月公布的欧巴马出生证明，「有理由相信是电脑编造的」；欧巴马1980年在夏威夷填报的徵兵卡也很可能也是假的。再度挑战欧巴马总统出生证书的真实性，同时也继续质疑欧巴马是否在美国出生，及担任总统的适法性。 他说：「我们不知道是谁变造这些文件」，但他说，他不认为欧巴马总统伪造文件。 过去有人就欧巴马的出生证明大做文章，但欧巴马已出示欧巴马的出生证明，法院也驳斥质疑欧巴马非公民的讼桉。 生父为肯亚留学生的欧巴马是否在美国本土出生，一直是在阴谋论者中盛行不褪，即使欧巴马本人及出生地夏威夷州当局提供出生证明，还是难以取信这批阴谋者。 阿派奥最近坏麻烦不断。联邦大陪审团调查他涉及滥权，专对西语裔进行种族侦防，虐待西语裔，以及没有认真调查数百件性犯罪。阿帕约不但不韬光养晦，反而在1日再度挑战欧巴马总统出生证书的真实性。 但阿派奥表示，「我没有追杀欧巴马，我是只尽本职工作」。他还表示，这个调查都是由律师义工和退休员警义务进行，没有用到纳税人的钱，就是为了证明「没有任何政治动机」。 有些批评者认为，他将矛头指向欧巴马其实是转移大众的焦点，使民众忽略他所面临的指控。希望阿帕约辞职的批评者指出，截至2007年止的前三年间，有400多件性犯罪调查不确实，或根本没有调查。联邦大陪审团正在调查阿帕约办公室反腐败部门 2009年12月以来的滥权桉件。司法部也对阿派奥办公室种族侦防提出控告。阿派奥办公室对监狱中西语裔说西语都加以处罚。但阿派奥否认，亚利桑那州移民执法有政治动机。
0f181de531f40ff8caff07631aa0ba26aadbc0cf.translatedText: Maricopa County Sheriff Arpaio held a press conference on the 1st to announce the results of a multi-day investigation, alleging that the Obama birth certificate released by the White House in April last year "has reason to believe that it was fabricated by a computer"; the draft card that Obama filled out in Hawaii in 1980 is also likely to be fake. It once again challenged the authenticity of President Obama's birth certificate, and also continued to question whether Obama was born in the United States and his legality to serve as president. "We don't know who altered the documents," he said, but said he did not believe President Obama forged the documents. In the past, some people made a big fuss about Obama's birth certificate, but Obama has produced Obama's birth certificate, and the court also rejected the lawsuit challenging Obama's non-citizen status. Whether Obama, whose biological father is a Kenyan student, was born in the United States has always been popular among conspiracy theorists. Even if Obama himself and the authorities of the state of Hawaii where he was born provide birth certificates, it is still difficult to believe these conspirators. Apao has been in constant trouble lately. A federal grand jury investigated him for abuse of power, racial profiling of Hispanics, mistreatment of Hispanics, and failure to seriously investigate hundreds of sex crimes. Instead of keeping a low profile, Arpaio once again challenged the authenticity of President Obama's birth certificate on the 1st. But Apao said, "I'm not going after Obama, I'm just doing my job." He also said that this investigation was conducted by volunteer lawyers and retired police officers, and no taxpayer money was used, just to prove that "there is no political motivation." Some critics believe that by pointing the finger at Obama, he is actually diverting public attention from the accusations he faces. Critics who want Arpaio to resign point to more than 400 sex crime investigations in the three years ending in 2007 that were either inaccurate or not investigated at all. A federal grand jury is investigating abuses of power by Arpaio's anti-corruption unit dating back to December 2009. The Justice Department also filed a complaint against Arpaio's office for racial profiling. Apao's office punishes Hispanics in prison for speaking Spanish. But Arpaio denied that Arizona's immigration enforcement was politically motivated.

It is recommended that international students submit their applications early (Reprinted by Sunbird) From April 1st, the Immigration Bureau began to accept work visa (H1B) applications...

8b3fed1d2a09c66da9d9b2f5106c0e0993ba3cb9.sourceText: 从4月1日起，移民局就开始接受工作签证(H1B) 的申请，尽管近两年的工作签证的名额都不会在申请开始之后马上用完，但移民律师7日在接受采访时建议工作签证申请人最好提早递交申请材料。 移民律师郑朴捷建议申请人，赶早不赶晚，最好是赶快做完，4月1日会有一批递交上去，案子多的话比较容易通过，如果案子不多，移民官就会看得比较细，补件通知就比较多。他建议说，如果已经有雇主就先递交申请，不要拖延。 移民律师张军则建议申请人提前两个星期来做劳工部的工资水平申请，所以如果4月1日递交申请材料， 3月15日左右最好就做工资水平申请，因为这个申请时间拖得比较长。 律师们普遍认为2012年的工作签证申请情况不会比去年有太大变化。黄子虔律师在接受采访时说，今年的申请人数并没有增加，基本上和去年一样多。他说，工作签证审批和经济情况以及移民官的个人观点有关。凭他的直觉加州今年的工作签证申请并不会比去年容易，只要失业率继续保持这个水平，工作签证的审批难度就比较大。 张军律师指出，新公司、小公司和员工较少的公司在申请时要特别注意。郑朴捷律师说，近年来大公司不愿意办工作签证，愿意办的多半都是比较小的公司，但是在小公司申请的难度就在于怎么凸显受益人的专业，如果是新成立不久的公司，做进出口贸易的公司，也很难把受益人的专业凸显出来。 张军律师还指出，拿实习期(OPT)的留学生如果在实习期到期日和第一次使用工作签证的日期之间有空档，移民局可以原谅，但是现在存在是否批准工作签证的问题，所以如果有留学生的实习期在6月份到期但是9月份没有批准，身份就会有麻烦，所以建议这样的留学生先注册一个新的学生签证(F1)，这样即便工作签证被拒，身份还可以维持。
8b3fed1d2a09c66da9d9b2f5106c0e0993ba3cb9.translatedText: From April 1st, the Immigration Bureau began to accept applications for work visas (H1B). Although the quota of work visas in the past two years will not be used up immediately after the application starts, an immigration lawyer suggested in an interview on the 7th that work visa applicants should submit their application materials early. Immigration lawyer Zheng Pujie advises applicants to hurry up and finish the process as soon as possible. A batch will be submitted on April 1. If there are many cases, it will be easier to pass. If there are not many cases, the immigration officer will look at it more carefully and there will be more supplementary notices. He suggested that if you already have an employer, apply first and don't delay. Immigration lawyer Zhang Jun recommends that applicants apply for the wage level from the Ministry of Labor two weeks in advance. Therefore, if the application materials are submitted on April 1, it is best to apply for the wage level around March 15, because this application time is relatively long. Lawyers generally believe that the situation of work visa applications in 2012 will not change much from last year. Lawyer Huang Ziqian said in an interview that the number of applicants this year has not increased and is basically the same as last year. He said that work visa approval is related to economic circumstances and the personal views of the immigration officer. Based on his intuition, California's work visa application this year will not be easier than last year. As long as the unemployment rate continues to remain at this level, the application for work visas will be more difficult. Lawyer Zhang Jun pointed out that new companies, small companies and companies with fewer employees should pay special attention when applying. Lawyer Zheng Pujie said that in recent years, large companies have been reluctant to apply for work visas, and most of the ones that are willing to apply are smaller companies. However, the difficulty in applying for a small company lies in how to highlight the beneficiary's profession. If it is a newly established company, it is difficult to highlight the beneficiary's profession if it is a company engaged in import and export trade. Lawyer Zhang Jun also pointed out that if there is a gap between the expiration date of the internship period and the first use of the work visa for international students on OPT, the Immigration Bureau can forgive it. However, there is now a problem of whether to approve the work visa. Therefore, if the internship period of an international student expires in June but is not approved in September, the status will be in trouble. Therefore, it is recommended that such international students register for a new student visa (F1) first, so that even if the work visa is rejected, the status can be maintained.

c74d70a5b1c468bbfb3c33803f3e31c17e765bbe.sourceText: 2011年3月8日，福布斯杂志再度发布全球亿万富豪榜。百度公司董事长兼首席执行官李彦宏以102亿美元身家列全球富豪榜第86位，比去年同期发布的该榜单的95位上升9位，财富数也从去年95亿美元上升至超100亿美元。这是李彦宏第二次成为福布斯全球富豪榜中的中国首富。
c74d70a5b1c468bbfb3c33803f3e31c17e765bbe.translatedText: On March 8, 2011, Forbes magazine once again released the list of the world's billionaires. Baidu Chairman and CEO Robin Li ranks 86th on the global rich list with a net worth of US$10.2 billion, up 9 places from 95th on the list released in the same period last year, and his wealth has also increased from US$9.5 billion last year to over US$10 billion. This is the second time that Robin Li has become the richest man in China on the Forbes Global Rich List.

a581c0b48a7fa6551d7ae3844fdae5f595be6b48.sourceText: 在去年秋季发布的福布斯中国富豪榜上，三一集团董事长梁稳根曾力压李彦宏，成为中国首富。但随着中国股市的回落，尤其是机械​​等板块随中国房地产市场的低迷而跌落后，股价相对稳定的百度支撑了李彦宏财富数的增长。在去年秋季，百度股价曾一度波动，但此后走势稳定。
a581c0b48a7fa6551d7ae3844fdae5f595be6b48.translatedText: In the Forbes China Rich List released last fall, Liang Wengen, chairman of Sany Group, overtook Robin Li to become the richest man in China. However, as China's stock market fell, especially after sectors such as machinery fell along with the downturn in China's real estate market, Baidu, whose stock price was relatively stable, supported the growth of Robin Li's wealth. Baidu's stock price fluctuated for a while last fall, but has since stabilized.

5dd89175031e62af91c6de758f6b2889e0ea7652.sourceText: 下一会计年度的H1B短期工作签证，即将于4月2日起接受申请，但一项新的报告显示，现在申请H1B的拒签率，高达四年前的两倍多。 「美国政策全国基金会」，从美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)取得新的数据显示，过去四年L1和H1B签证申请桉的拒签率巨幅增加。资料显示，遭拒签的多为印度人士，应与部分印度人涉嫌诈欺有关。 「美国政策全国基金会」报告指出，美国公民及移民服务局已变更了L1和H1签证审核标准。报告显示，2011会计年度中，有63%的L1B(具特殊知识的跨国雇员)签证申请桉，被要求出示更多证明。而有27%的L1B申请桉遭到拒签。 这个现象是2007会计年度开始的。L1B在2007会计年度的拒签率为7%；而遭拒签的L1B申请桉2008会计年度已上升至22%。2009会计年度的拒签率为26%；2010会计年度的拒签率为22%。H1B申请的拒绝率，则从2007财年的11%，上升到2009财年的29%。2010财年为21%；2011财年则为17%。 L1A跨国公司的主管和经理人才申请桉拒绝率，也从2007财年的8%，上升到2011财年的14%。最戏剧性的，是移民局对L1B申请桉，出示更多证明的要求(Requests for Evidence或RFE)。2004会计年度，遭移民局要求提供额外证明的申请桉，只有2%；2007财年为17%；在2008财年为49%。而在2011财年的达到了惊人的63%。 移民局对L1A经理和管理人员签证出示更多证明的要求，则从2004会计年度的4%，增加为2007财年的24%。
5dd89175031e62af91c6de758f6b2889e0ea7652.translatedText: The H1B short-term work visa for the next fiscal year will be accepted for applications from April 2, but a new report shows that the rejection rate for H1B applications is now more than twice that of four years ago. The National Foundation for American Policy obtained new data from the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) showing that the rejection rate for L1 and H1B visa applications has increased dramatically in the past four years. Information shows that most of the people who were refused visas were Indians, which may be related to the alleged fraud of some Indians. The National Foundation for American Policy reported that the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services has changed its L1 and H1 visa review standards. The report shows that in the 2011 fiscal year, 63% of L1B (transnational employee with special knowledge) visa applications were required to provide more evidence. And 27% of L1B applications were rejected. This phenomenon began in fiscal year 2007. The rejection rate for L1B in fiscal year 2007 was 7%; while the number of rejected L1B applications increased to 22% in fiscal year 2008. The rejection rate for fiscal year 2009 was 26%; the rejection rate for fiscal year 2010 was 22%. The rejection rate of H1B applications increased from 11% in fiscal year 2007 to 29% in fiscal year 2009. In fiscal year 2010, it was 21%; in fiscal year 2011, it was 17%. The rejection rate of applications for supervisors and managers from L1A multinational companies also increased from 8% in fiscal year 2007 to 14% in fiscal year 2011. The most dramatic thing is the Immigration Bureau’s request for more evidence (Requests for Evidence or RFE) for L1B applications. In fiscal year 2004, only 2% of applications were required to provide additional proof by the USCIS; in fiscal year 2007, it was 17%; in fiscal year 2008, it was 49%. In fiscal year 2011, it reached an astonishing 63%. The Immigration Service's requirement for more evidence for L1A manager and executive visas increased from 4% in fiscal year 2004 to 24% in fiscal year 2007.

eb134f73af476e305b733bce6c955e99f17c7115.translatedText: >A local school bus driver has been suspended for kicking a student off the bus miles away from home.

400a22dd42c610b9702314c9690a51439b2d9b1b.sourceText: 12岁的埃里克托里是林荫道中学七年级学生。上周三放学后，他留在学校复习，不得不搭乘校巴末班车。
400a22dd42c610b9702314c9690a51439b2d9b1b.translatedText: Twelve-year-old Eric Tory is a seventh-grader at Boulevard Middle School. After school last Wednesday, he stayed at school to review and had to take the last school bus.

dafdc0b08e74a6fedd59ebd32c051b95f16dc621.sourceText: 四点钟末班车过来，他上了车，才发现末班车不走他平时下车的地点。校巴司机让他在离家数英里的 Aire Libre 小学站下车。小埃里克恳求司机将他送到平时下车的地点遭拒绝后，他唯有下车，穿越一座横跨繁忙路口的步行桥，来到一个陌生人的房子前请求帮忙。房主让他打电话给他父亲，并把他留在屋内直至他父亲来接他。
dafdc0b08e74a6fedd59ebd32c051b95f16dc621.translatedText: The last bus came over at four o'clock. He got on the bus, only to find that the last bus didn't go to the place where he usually got off. The school bus driver dropped him off at Aire Libre Elementary School, a few miles from home. After little Eric begged the driver to take him to his usual drop-off location but was refused, he had no choice but to get out of the car, cross a pedestrian bridge across a busy intersection, and arrive at a stranger's house to ask for help. The homeowner told him to call his father and kept him inside the house until his father came to pick him up.

28a36c64f0e9b7362a2582ea5ad9db47d9a44ee2.sourceText: 校区发言人说：”每天行走的路线是固定的，我们正在深入调查此事。我们已经让涉案司机停职。我们很高兴这名学生能平安回家。”
28a36c64f0e9b7362a2582ea5ad9db47d9a44ee2.translatedText: A spokesman for the school district said: "The daily route is fixed and we are investigating the matter in depth. We have suspended the driver involved. We are very happy that the student can go home safely."

33cdc0ac5f9d81f5ee9efe3379a6d35a994f3e45.sourceText: 埃里克的父亲凯文托里说，他很高兴他的儿子遇困难时会向人求助，今后短时间内不会让孩子放学后在学校停留。
33cdc0ac5f9d81f5ee9efe3379a6d35a994f3e45.translatedText: Eric's father Kevin Tory said that he was glad that his son would ask for help when he was in trouble and would not allow his children to stay at school after school for a short time.

74ef51a4f050ebb3f41552ad5c69f1ee856cb27a.sourceText: 为促进全球华人高尔夫球运动的发展，凝聚全球华人的力量，今年4月28日至5月2日，美国职业高尔夫协会南加州分会（SCPGA）、美国泛太平洋商会,美国凤凰卫视等多个团体将在美国洛杉矶市联合举办2012全球华人高尔夫锦标赛。大赛现正式开始接受报名，即在全世界华人高尔夫爱好者参加。
74ef51a4f050ebb3f41552ad5c69f1ee856cb27a.translatedText: In order to promote the development of global Chinese golf and gather the strength of Chinese people around the world, from April 28 to May 2 this year, the Southern California Chapter of the Professional Golf Association of America (SCPGA), the Pan-Pacific Chamber of Commerce, and Phoenix TV will jointly host the 2012 Global Chinese Golf Championship in Los Angeles, USA. The competition is now officially open for registration, that is, Chinese golf enthusiasts from all over the world can participate.

fc8c202ce95e7c5075815017afe303375ba172ee.sourceText: 本届全球华人高尔夫锦标赛将在全美最佳的四个球场连打四天，比赛地点选在洛杉矶工业市亚太棕榈高尔夫球场（Pacific Palms Golf Course），南加州职业联盟球场(PGA West),友好山庄乡村俱乐部(Friendly Hills Country Club)与橡树谷高尔夫俱乐部(Oak Valley Golf Club).届时，将有来自世界各地的华人高尔夫球手共襄盛会，切磋球技。大赛分为团体公开组、男子个人组、女子个人组、长青个人组和公开竞杆组等5个组别，奖金丰厚。
fc8c202ce95e7c5075815017afe303375ba172ee.translatedText: This Global Chinese Golf Championship will be played for four consecutive days at four of the best courses in the United States. The competition locations are Pacific Palms Golf Course in Los Angeles City of Industry, PGA West, Friendly Hills Country Club and Oak Valley Golf Club. At that time, Chinese golfers from all over the world will participate in the grand event and compete on their golf skills. The competition is divided into five categories: open team group, men's individual group, women's individual group, evergreen individual group and open competition group, with generous prizes.

a9d78a70bcd6677e6bed4ecf759f46f42ae2a23e.sourceText: 赛事主席江启光表示，比赛吸引到大批来自中国的高尔夫球爱好者参加。目的是搭起体育之桥，促进中国高球爱好者与美国华人华侨体育人士交流球技，共同促进高球运动。比赛专业性,挑战性强,参赛选手水平在70杆-90杆之间,在华人世界中产生了很大的影响力，今年的球场新增了南加PGA专业的PGA West场地,整个锦标赛会更专业,更具规模,也会吸引更多的选手报名参加。
a9d78a70bcd6677e6bed4ecf759f46f42ae2a23e.translatedText: Jiang Qiguang, chairman of the competition, said that the competition attracted a large number of golf enthusiasts from China. The purpose is to build a sports bridge, promote the exchange of skills between Chinese golf enthusiasts and overseas Chinese sports people in the United States, and jointly promote golf. The competition is professional and challenging. The players' level is between 70 and 90. It has a great influence in the Chinese world. This year, the PGA of Southern California has added a professional PGA West venue to the course. The entire championship will be more professional and larger, and will also attract more players to sign up.

968b34854264d2fbbf0e8955450c38be2f03b8d5.sourceText: 即日起，只要您是高尔夫球爱好者，年龄在18岁至70岁之间（长青组年龄需在55岁以上），即可报名参加；没有美国签证，请最少提前1个月报名。报名邮箱： worldgolfcup@gmail.com ，活动网址：www.chinausgolf.com.
968b34854264d2fbbf0e8955450c38be2f03b8d5.translatedText: From now on, as long as you are a golf enthusiast and are between 18 and 70 years old (the evergreen group must be over 55 years old), you can register to participate; if you do not have a US visa, please register at least 1 month in advance. Registration email: worldgolfcup@gmail.com, event website: www.chinausgolf.com.

303c0ead9450c7fe827c35b3c674a8f9fbec0f93.sourceText: 出租房屋者报税该注意些什么？
303c0ead9450c7fe827c35b3c674a8f9fbec0f93.translatedText: What should renters pay attention to when filing taxes?

1527f18c155d2f1adff3aa4f10d2ea36969ff856.sourceText: 出租房屋者报税该注意些什么？ 最近这些年，国税局加强了对房屋出租者的查税力度。有一些人每年都根据自己的实际…
1527f18c155d2f1adff3aa4f10d2ea36969ff856.translatedText: What should renters pay attention to when filing taxes? In recent years, the IRS has stepped up its inspections of renters. Some people decide based on their actual circumstances every year...

1082e7b46a47042f0880564b562c65ccdd263434.sourceText: 最近这些年， 国税局加强了对房屋出租者的查税力度。有一些人每年都根据自己的实际情况，申报房屋所得和有关相应的费用但为何仍然遭到查税甚至罚款。 以下提供些建议，供各位有房屋收入的报税者参考。
1082e7b46a47042f0880564b562c65ccdd263434.translatedText: In recent years, the IRS has intensified its tax inspections on house renters. Some people declare their housing income and related expenses every year based on their actual situation, but why are they still subject to tax inspections and even fines? Here are some suggestions for tax filers with housing income.

f747fe1d730fe468d75efdf56d9c11e0473998f0.sourceText: 首先先要确认你是否有参与管理你的出租房屋。这一点是非常重要的。因为如果你不参与管理你所出租的房屋，你将会被视作被动参与者（ passive participants ）。 作为一个被动参与者，你的出租房屋的损失（ loss ） 不可直接抵扣到你其它的收入中。除非你有其它的被动收入（ passive income ），这两者之间可作相互抵扣。如果你有参与管理你的出租屋，你可被视为主动参与者（ active participants ）。如果你是一个主动参与者，你的修改调整总收入不超过（ modified adjusted gross income ） $150,000, 你最多可抵扣 $25,000 在你的税单上。如果你是一个房地产的专业人士（ real estate professional ）, 作为专业人士， 你必须要符合国税局规定的有关条件， 如你符合那些条件， 你将被视作 material participate. 你的所有的房屋出租损失（即便大于 $25,000 ）, 也可全部抵扣在你的税单上。
f747fe1d730fe468d75efdf56d9c11e0473998f0.translatedText: First, make sure you are involved in managing your rental property. This is very important. Because if you are not involved in managing the property you rent, you will be considered a passive participant. As a passive participant, your rental property losses cannot be directly deducted from your other income. Unless you have other passive income, the two can be deducted from each other. If you are involved in managing your rental property, you are considered an active participant. If you are an active participant and your modified adjusted gross income does not exceed $150,000, you can deduct up to $25,000 on your tax return. If you are a real estate professional, as a professional, you must meet the relevant conditions set by the IRS. If you meet those conditions, you will be considered a material participant. All of your rental losses (even if they are greater than $25,000) are fully deductible on your tax return.

f92119ff0f48dccfb8ea455fff8c4f2d930cd206.sourceText: 其次，如果你在当年对出租的房屋做一些装修或购买一些大型家电，你必须要搞清什么样的费用可一次抵扣在当年的税单上， 但必须注意， 大部分的费用是需要作逐年抵扣的。
f92119ff0f48dccfb8ea455fff8c4f2d930cd206.translatedText: Secondly, if you do some renovations on the rental house or purchase some large appliances that year, you must find out what kind of expenses can be deducted on the tax bill for that year, but you must note that most of the expenses need to be deducted year by year.

d948348689eef871aa4d4a630bbcdcafcd963f9d.sourceText: 最后，请你保存好所有抵扣费用的单据。
d948348689eef871aa4d4a630bbcdcafcd963f9d.translatedText: Finally, please keep all receipts for deductions.

92f67caefbf8e5f6a028c4af05eb41a58b56733d.sourceText: 凤凰城一月房屋销售达到新高 公寓屋涨幅最大
92f67caefbf8e5f6a028c4af05eb41a58b56733d.translatedText: Phoenix home sales hit new highs in January, condos see biggest jumps

083d4696ae0de514c9e4cdd0d1903d01d5be4370.sourceText: 凤凰城一月房屋销售达到新高 公寓屋涨幅最大 加州新闻报道凤凰城一月房屋销售上升，达到了近五年一月销售的最高…
083d4696ae0de514c9e4cdd0d1903d01d5be4370.translatedText: Phoenix home sales hit new highs in January, condos see biggest jumps California news reports Phoenix home sales rose in January, reaching the highest January sales in the past five years...

616bfbc85a752813e42b84aa6f27c3461db962eb.sourceText: 凤凰城一月房屋销售达到新高 公寓屋涨幅最大 加州新闻报道凤凰城一月房屋销售上升，达到了近五年一月销售的最高值。一共销售7123套房屋。与上个月相比下降了17.9%，但比去年同期高了3.2%。一月房屋的销售比1994年来平均销售量少了3.1%。这主要是因为新房子销售的数量仍然低迷。旧屋销售比平均销售量高了17.5%，是2006年1月以来的最高一次。新屋销售还是比平均年份的销售量低了66%。 与去年相比，十万以下的房屋销售下降了7.3%，十万到二十万房子销售量上升了3.3%， 二十万到六十万的房子上升了9%， 八十万以上的房子销售也增加了3.6%。凤凰城房屋销售的中值为127500美元，比上个月下降了1.2%，但是比去年同期上涨了7.1%。一月份独立屋均价为125900美元，比前一个月上涨0.7% 比去年上涨了5%。 公寓屋比去年上涨了9%。更多有关房地产新闻请咨询Tinna 电话（480）287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
616bfbc85a752813e42b84aa6f27c3461db962eb.translatedText: Phoenix home sales hit new highs in January, condos see the biggest jumps California news reports Phoenix home sales rose in January, hitting the highest January sales in the past five years. A total of 7,123 homes were sold. That's down 17.9% from the previous month, but 3.2% higher than the same period last year. Home sales in January were 3.1% below the average since 1994. This is largely because the number of new home sales remains sluggish. Existing home sales were 17.5% above average, the highest since January 2006. New home sales are still 66% below average sales. Compared with last year, the sales of houses with less than 100,000 yuan fell by 7.3%, the sales of houses with 100,000 to 200,000 yuan increased by 3.3%, the sales of houses with 200,000 to 600,000 yuan increased by 9%, and the sales of houses with more than 800,000 yuan also increased by 3.6%. The median home sale price in Phoenix is ​​$127,500, down 1.2% from last month but up 7.1% from this time last year. The average price of a single-family home in January was $125,900, up 0.7% from the previous month and 5% from last year. Apartment prices are up 9% from last year. For more real estate news, please contact Tinna. Tel (480) 287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

f2b4f6dc9babc5e623b93e0c84e6c53507310b40.sourceText: 马里科巴郡极重犯罪减少 帐篷监狱立功？
f2b4f6dc9babc5e623b93e0c84e6c53507310b40.translatedText: Maricopa County's serious crime decreases, tent prison contributes to success?

8d59fcb97fb01142d6223efca9718d6ea8205fcf.sourceText: 马里科巴郡极重犯罪减少 帐篷监狱立功？ 选举年，台上现任者的政绩势必被人挖出来讨论一番。马里科巴郡警长阿派奥虽…
8d59fcb97fb01142d6223efca9718d6ea8205fcf.translatedText: Maricopa County’s serious crime reduction, tent prison has contributed? In an election year, the political achievements of the incumbents are bound to be dug up and discussed. Although Maricopa County Sheriff Arpaio...

0394c39e6c89df2eb39559a99810e9eb1c40dfae.sourceText: 选举年，台上现任者的政绩势必被人挖出来讨论一番。马里科巴郡警长阿派奥虽被指控其本人及下属滥用职权，刻意针对西裔居民，有种族歧视之嫌。但马利科巴郡极重犯罪率自 2008 年夏天以来下降了 20% ，却是不争之实。
0394c39e6c89df2eb39559a99810e9eb1c40dfae.translatedText: In an election year, the political achievements of the incumbents are bound to be dug up and discussed. Although Maricopa County Sheriff Arpaio was accused of abusing his power and deliberately targeting Hispanic residents, he and his subordinates were suspected of racial discrimination. But it’s indisputable that Maricopa County’s serious crime rate has dropped 20 percent since the summer of 2008.

6397208b1e91df4eb69b3868e636b330e7beef2d.sourceText: 极重犯罪逮捕证从 2008 年夏天的四万张，到去年 12 月的三万一千张，美国法警服务亚利桑那州分别归功于各部门的紧密合作。本州有执法部门 22 个，包括惩教和警察部门，主要针对本州的逃犯。在刚过去的财政年度，专案组在凤凰城地区抓获 330 多名逃犯，同时发出 400 多个新的重罪逮捕证。
6397208b1e91df4eb69b3868e636b330e7beef2d.translatedText: The U.S. Marshals Service in Arizona went from 40,000 serious crime warrants in the summer of 2008 to 31,000 last December, thanks to the close cooperation between agencies. The state has 22 law enforcement agencies, including corrections and police departments, that primarily target fugitives from the state. During the past fiscal year, the task force captured more than 330 fugitives in the Phoenix area while issuing more than 400 new felony arrest warrants.

c9d5e6308e522ab774c256d19adaa879bb24e8e0.sourceText: 但马里科巴郡、皮纳尔郡和皮马郡三个警长办公室不在法警服务的 22 个执法机构范围内，好像犯罪率减少，跟阿派奥没什么关系。
c9d5e6308e522ab774c256d19adaa879bb24e8e0.translatedText: However, the three Sheriff’s Offices in Maricopa, Pinal and Pima counties are not among the 22 law enforcement agencies served by the Marshals Service. It seems that the decrease in crime rate has nothing to do with Arpaio.

924bfec1a9e6f8d4527abbcc89a547c09c4547ab.sourceText: 阿派奥发明的”帐篷城监狱”周一迎来 19 周年庆，又将人们的眼球吸引到他的身上。据说，”帐篷城监狱”的概念来自”世界上最知名的快餐连锁店”的一张汉堡包广告贴，阿派奥于 1993 年用朝鲜战争时使用剩余的帐篷，在凤凰城西南部创建一座用帐篷搭建的监狱，用以收押轻罪罪犯。
924bfec1a9e6f8d4527abbcc89a547c09c4547ab.translatedText: The "Tent City Prison" invented by Arpaio celebrated its 19th anniversary on Monday, drawing people's attention to him again. It is said that the concept of "Tent City Prison" came from a hamburger advertising poster of "the world's most famous fast food chain". In 1993, Arpaio used the remaining tents used during the Korean War to create a tent-built prison in southwest Phoenix to house misdemeanor criminals.

baf45f8bb94d1acc6d8e82df261cbc59dba74bc4.sourceText: 根据警长办公室资料，到目前止，”帐篷城”收押过 427,000 多名犯人。虽然有人质疑警长让犯人夏天待在高达 120 多度的沙漠露天监狱，是极不人道的做法，但阿派奥说，”帐篷城”仍是他”最值得骄傲的发明”之一，作为一种经济、安全和成功方式来应付日益增长犯人人口模式，值得全国推广。
baf45f8bb94d1acc6d8e82df261cbc59dba74bc4.translatedText: According to the Sheriff's Office, "Tent City" has housed more than 427,000 prisoners to date. Although some people have questioned the extremely inhumane practice of the Sheriff to let prisoners stay in an open-air prison in the desert in the summer with temperatures reaching more than 120 degrees, Arpaio said that "Tent City" is still one of his "proudest inventions" and deserves to be promoted nationwide as an economical, safe and successful way to cope with the growing prisoner population.

9c57c825e3efe63c3b71dba285ee39e1db3d5ca7.translatedText: Tsinghua VS Peking University Who has the most talented banner on "Girls' Day"? Yesterday was March 7, the so-called Girls' Day on the Internet. Major...

561469c9cd4e26ea09fec7b228eecdfdf1740367.sourceText: 清华PK北大 谁的横幅最有才
561469c9cd4e26ea09fec7b228eecdfdf1740367.translatedText: Tsinghua VS Peking University Whose banner is the most talented?

a9ba84ccbc005b95b6402e2d4ea23c1919c525d3.sourceText: 女生节本是起源于大学，每当3月7日女生节来临时，高校里男生们总会给女生一些特惠福利。
a9ba84ccbc005b95b6402e2d4ea23c1919c525d3.translatedText: Girls' Day originally originated in universities. Whenever Girls' Day comes on March 7, the boys in universities always give some special benefits to girls.

8163e569dc7f14904fb5f3973b9867b968c857b2.sourceText: 昨天一大早，清华大学的男生就在校园里挂出了他们的祝福。随后，这些照片就被传到人人网上，有数十张。横幅内容基本上是每个系的男生在横幅中夸耀本系的女生最美，清华核11班挂出打油诗，”这些女子不是人，九天仙子下凡尘；生得个个惹人疼，不信请敲核班门。”物理12请出了爱因斯坦来赞本班美女，”爱因斯坦说：同物12女生在一起，时间将会减缓。”
8163e569dc7f14904fb5f3973b9867b968c857b2.translatedText: Early yesterday morning, the boys of Tsinghua University hung out their blessings on campus. Subsequently, these photos were posted to Renren.com, and there were dozens of them. The content of the banner is basically that the boys in each department boasted that the girls in their department are the most beautiful. Tsinghua University Core Class 11 posted a limerick, "These women are not human beings, nine-day fairies descended to the mortal world; they are all born to cause pain. If you don't believe me, please knock on the door of the core class." Physics Class 12 invited Einstein to praise the beauties of this class, "Einstein He said: "When you are with the 12 girls, time will slow down."

1d461e38621fe226d4fc2199b53e2043bfeda6a1.sourceText: 最让网友眼睛一亮的是这样两条横幅，不管以后你们是谁的女人，你们是我们永远的女神”、”平生纵有凌云壮志，今日甘为裙下之臣。”
1d461e38621fe226d4fc2199b53e2043bfeda6a1.translatedText: What makes netizens' eyes brightest are these two banners. No matter who the woman is in the future, you will be our eternal goddess." "

e8ba55f15f141bdb4f5be33da377ae435819d061.sourceText: 清华大学这些横幅在网上热传，北京大学那边也不甘落后。昨日中午，北京大学的女生节示爱横幅也在人人网上传开了，欲与清华相PK。”物理、悟理、悟你。”北大物理系的男生横幅显得更为含蓄。北京大学学生会也挂了一幅横幅，”智慧是你，魅力是你，快乐是你。女生们，今天你就是主宰。”
e8ba55f15f141bdb4f5be33da377ae435819d061.translatedText: These banners from Tsinghua University are widely circulated on the Internet, and Peking University is not far behind. Yesterday at noon, Peking University's Girls' Day love banner also spread on Renren, hoping to compete with Tsinghua University. "Physics, understanding, understanding you. "The banner for boys from the Physics Department of Peking University is more subtle. The Peking University Student Union also hung a banner, "Wisdom is you, charm is you, happiness is you." Girls, you are in charge today. "

8631abfdd94603bc5ae8f73926a82d634f3ce8ee.sourceText: 网友评论称，”纵观清华、北大示爱横幅，清华创意横幅较多，北大偏文艺。”
8631abfdd94603bc5ae8f73926a82d634f3ce8ee.translatedText: > Netizens commented, "Looking at the love banners from Tsinghua University and Peking University, Tsinghua University has more creative banners, while Peking University is more literary and artistic. "

dc86e4aa6d1690bdaceece7fa615d40750aea4a0.sourceText: 昨日，还有一张北京化工大学机电院机械系课堂上的照片被热传。课堂上，每个女生的桌子上面都有一份特殊礼物：一束玫瑰、一盒特仑苏、一块蛋糕。轻缓的音乐，男生的祝福：不管以后你们是谁的女人，都是我们的好姑娘。棗机械男生宣。
dc86e4aa6d1690bdaceece7fa615d40750aea4a0.translatedText: Yesterday, a photo of a class in the Department of Mechanical Engineering, School of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Beijing University of Chemical Technology went viral. In the class, each girl had a special gift on her desk: a bouquet of roses, a box of Deluxe, and a piece of cake. Soft music, blessings from the boys: No matter who your women are in the future, you are our good girls. Zao Mechanical boys announced.

c6d6edf43084feedd2277e8c5a0ad4e320569273.sourceText: 东大男生 完成女生一个心愿
c6d6edf43084feedd2277e8c5a0ad4e320569273.translatedText: > Dongda University boys Fulfilling a Girl’s Wish

65e3183089a20d6d01eb2089b045f75084e55873.sourceText: 清华北大校园横幅闹得热火朝天，南京高校的男生也不差。东南大学的男生则以实际行动为女生过节：完成女生一个心愿。组织这项活动的是”东大创意表白工作室”，他们在3月7日之前在女生宿舍楼下搜集了三四百个女生心愿，并招募到了100多位男生来完成女生心愿。”比较实际的心愿好像都已经达成了，我们宿舍四个人都许了心愿，都被男生帮我们达成了。”这次活动的组织者女生小陆介绍道，”好像还有人因为这次心愿活动而认识了。”此外，这段时间，在南农、南财等高校还有学生社团专门为”女生节”准备舞会等节目。
65e3183089a20d6d01eb2089b045f75084e55873.translatedText: > Tsinghua University and Peking University’s campus banners are in full swing, and the boys from Nanjing University are also taking practical actions to celebrate the festival for girls: Fulfilling a Girl’s Wish is organized by Dongda Creative Confession. "Studio", they collected three to four hundred girls' wishes downstairs in the girls' dormitory before March 7, and recruited more than 100 boys to fulfill the girls' wishes. "It seems that the more practical wishes have been fulfilled. The four of us in the dormitory all made wishes, and the boys helped us fulfill them." "Xiao Lu, a girl who organized this event, said, "It seems that there are still people who got to know each other because of this wish event. "In addition, during this period, there are student clubs in Nannong, Nancai and other colleges and universities that prepare dances and other programs specifically for "Girls' Day".

25ad3fe90cc235d9b5916beaa3ad2fc8ff3d7468.sourceText: 喜欢户外登山的朋友们， 2012年3月11日中国科学家工程师专业人士协会凤凰城分会（科工专）组织大家到Piestewa Peak / Dreamy Draw 进行户外登山活动。 本次活动准备两条路线，一条是32号，一条是300号，第一条全程3.74英里，中等到困难之间的难度，第二条1.2英里，艰难的路线。 时间：3月11日上午10时 地点：在凤凰城山公园门口at the gate of Phoenix Mountains Park and Recreation Area (address: 2701 E Squaw Peak Dr). 具体开车路线为，开51高速路在Glendale或者Lincoln路口下，头朝东，超Squaw Peak路开。 科工专非会员交两元/每人的活动费用,会员免费。（会员费个人20美元/每年，家庭35美元/每年），科工专提供吃饭的盘子叉子水果和饮料。吃饭形式是PICNIC，大家可以带自己的家常菜一起分享。 联系人： Qiang Xu (623-703-8071) Amoy Yang (623-332-5808) Wen Hunag (480-459-7850) ”太阳鸟”亚省华人网祝大家一路平安，玩得开心！享受美丽风景！ 这次的登山路线在下面链接中： http://phoenix.gov/parks/trails/locations/piestewapeak/hikingmap/index.html
25ad3fe90cc235d9b5916beaa3ad2fc8ff3d7468.translatedText: Friends who like outdoor mountaineering, on March 11, 2012, the Phoenix Branch of the Chinese Scientists and Engineers Professionals Association (Science and Engineering College) organized everyone to go to Piestewa Peak/Dreamy Draw for outdoor mountaineering activities. There are two routes prepared for this event, one is No. 32 and the other is No. 300. The first is 3.74 miles, with a difficulty between moderate and difficult, and the second is 1.2 miles, a difficult route. Time: March 11, 10 a.m. Location: at the gate of Phoenix Mountains Park and Recreation Area (address: 2701 E Squaw Peak Dr). The specific driving route is to take Highway 51 and get off at the Glendale or Lincoln intersection, head east, and drive over Squaw Peak Road. Non-members of the College of Science and Technology pay an activity fee of two yuan per person, and members are free. (Membership fee is US$20/year for individuals and US$35/year for families). Science and Technology provides plates, forks, fruits and drinks for meals. The meal format is PICNIC, and everyone can bring their own home-cooked food to share. Contact: Qiang Xu (623-703-8071) Amoy Yang (623-332-5808) Wen Hunag (480-459-7850) "Sunbird" Alberta Chinese Network wishes everyone a safe journey and have fun! Enjoy the beautiful scenery! The hiking route this time is at the link below: http://phoenix.gov/parks/trails/locations/piestewapeak/hikingmap/index.html

23aa5fe1a43382007644968f1dc7712c3b365009.sourceText: 為庆祝中华人民共和国成立六十三周年，祝愿祖国日益繁荣昌盛，凤凰城侨界决定於2012年9月15日在上午九点在American Legion Arizona Department of Arizona(地址4701 N 19th Ave Phoenix AZ 85015 ) 举行扬升中国和美国两国国旗典礼仪式。 凤凰城侨界在2009年中华人民共和国成立六十周年之际，曾联合举辨了升旗典礼，表达华人华侨对祖国的热爱。祖国在不断发展中走向强大，让我们海外华侨感到扬眉吐气。 在上世纪九十年代初，当时中美关系仍在发展之中。美国在中国只有将近一千家公司，投资额亦只有四十亿美元，而到了2012年，单是亚省就有5400间企业对中国有业务上的联系，州长Jan Brewer亦一而再地访问中华人民共和国。 本地侨社热爱祖国，歷年来举办”中国周”活动弘扬中华文化；每逢祖国遇到大灾情、侨胞必定展开賑灾活动和支持重建工作。四川汶川大地震，亚省广大华侨慷慨解囊，并联系美国主流社会展开捐款活动，总计筹得超过廿五万的善款捐给四川灾后重建。2008年中国首次举办奥运，海外侨胞欢欣鼓舞，亚省华人华侨踊跃捐款共建”水立方”场馆，并為中国选手在奥运取得的成绩而欢呼喝釆。 今年凤凰城侨界举办联合升旗庆典，表达侨胞对祖国热爱，并希望中美两国在全球各个领域中有著更全面的合作，而两国和谐的相处对世界和平有十分重要的意义。海外侨胞心向祖国，情系故乡，将欢庆新中国六十三周年华诞。 為表达对亚省侨胞升旗仪式的重视，中国驻美国洛杉磯领事馆已发来了贺函，并派出卞立新副总领事，许翠英领事和白东石领事前来参加仪式。希望凤凰城的老侨、新侨、港澳同胞踊跃准时出席，共同参与升旗典礼，见証歷史上的庄严一刻。
23aa5fe1a43382007644968f1dc7712c3b365009.translatedText: In order to celebrate the 63rd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China and wish the motherland increasing prosperity, the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix decided to hold a flag-raising ceremony for the Chinese and American flags at 9 a.m. on September 15, 2012 at the American Legion Arizona Department of Arizona (address: 4701 N 19th Ave Phoenix AZ 85015). On the occasion of the 60th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China in 2009, the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix jointly held a flag-raising ceremony to express the overseas Chinese's love for the motherland. The motherland is becoming stronger through continuous development, which makes us overseas Chinese feel proud and proud. In the early 1990s, Sino-US relations were still developing. The United States has only nearly a thousand companies in China, with an investment of only US$4 billion. By 2012, there were 5,400 companies in Alberta alone with business ties to China, and Governor Jan Brewer has visited the People's Republic of China again and again. The local overseas Chinese community loves the motherland and has held "China Week" activities over the years to promote Chinese culture. Whenever the motherland encounters a major disaster, the overseas Chinese will definitely carry out disaster relief activities and support reconstruction work. After the Wenchuan earthquake in Sichuan, overseas Chinese in Alberta generously donated money and contacted mainstream society in the United States to launch a donation campaign. A total of more than 250,000 yuan was raised and donated to Sichuan's post-disaster reconstruction. In 2008, China hosted the Olympic Games for the first time. Overseas Chinese were delighted. Overseas Chinese in Alberta actively donated money to build the "Water Cube" venue and cheered for the achievements of Chinese athletes in the Olympics. This year, the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix held a joint flag-raising ceremony to express their love for the motherland and hope that China and the United States will have more comprehensive cooperation in various fields around the world. The harmonious coexistence of the two countries is of great significance to world peace. Overseas Chinese are devoted to their motherland and love their hometown, and will celebrate the 63rd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China. In order to express its importance to the flag-raising ceremony of the overseas Chinese in Alberta, the Chinese Consulate in Los Angeles has sent a congratulatory letter and sent Deputy Consul General Bian Lixin, Consul Xu Cuiying and Consul Bai Dongshi to attend the ceremony. I hope that the old overseas Chinese, new overseas Chinese, and compatriots from Hong Kong and Macao in Phoenix will attend on time, participate in the flag-raising ceremony, and witness this solemn moment in history.

1e87fde9162d20a9299f2f0292f55c4b649ac994.sourceText: 10亿退税 2008年百万人未申领 （亚省时报） 国税局(IRS)宣布，未申报2008年联邦所得税的约100万名纳税人，可能有资格获得总额超过10亿元的联邦退税。如欲领取退税，必须在今年4月17日前送出2008年所得税申报表。 国税局估计，超过半数退税者，2008年退税额多于600元。造成无法退税的原因，包括某些人因所得太少，未达到必须申报的数额，所以免去这个麻烦，但他们实际上有薪资扣缴额，或者缴付了每季预估税款，有资格获得退税。 根据税法，如果未申报所得税，纳税人有三年宽限期得以申请应得的退税。如在三年内没有提出相关的所得税申报表藉以要求退税，退税款就被充公。 以2008年所得税申报而言，要求退税的截止期限为2012年4月17日，纳税人依法必须填妥税表、书写正确地址邮寄至国税局，邮戳日期不得晚于4月17日。为了取得退税而在过期后才申报所得税，不会受罚。 国税局并提醒欲申请2008年退税的纳税人，如果他们未申报2009年及2010年所得税，他们的退税支票可能被暂时扣留。此外，如果纳税人欠国税局税款，这笔退税将用来抵缴。如果有人未付抚养子女费或过去积欠联邦贷款(如学生贷款)，退税也将用来抵缴。 未申报2008年所得税，不仅可能损失扣缴税款退税，而且还失去其他的税务优惠。有些人没有领到2008年刺激经济退税，但如果申报，可能有资格申请「复甦退税抵税」(Recovery Rebate Credit)。此外，许多中低收入上班族可能没有申请「工作所得抵税」(Earned Income Tax Credit，简称EITC)，这种抵税帮助所得低于某些门槛的个人和家庭。 如果需要今年和过去年份的税表和说明，可向国税局网站IRS.gov的Forms and Publications网页索取，或打免费电话800-829-3676洽询。
1e87fde9162d20a9299f2f0292f55c4b649ac994.translatedText: 1 Billion Tax Refunds Millions Did Not Claim in 2008 (Alberta Times) The Internal Revenue Service (IRS) announced that approximately 1 million taxpayers who did not file 2008 federal income tax returns may be eligible for federal tax refunds totaling more than $1 billion. To receive a tax refund, you must submit your 2008 income tax return before April 17 this year. The IRS estimates that more than half of tax refund recipients received more than $600 in 2008. Reasons for not being able to get a refund include the fact that some people avoid the hassle because their income is too low to meet the amount they must file, but they actually have payroll withholdings or pay quarterly estimated taxes and are eligible for a refund. Under tax law, taxpayers have a three-year grace period to claim the refund they deserve if they fail to file an income tax return. If no relevant income tax return is filed within three years to claim a tax refund, the tax refund will be forfeited. For the 2008 income tax return, the deadline for requesting a tax refund is April 17, 2012. According to law, taxpayers must fill out the tax form, write the correct address and mail it to the IRS. The postmark date must be no later than April 17. There is no penalty for filing income tax after the due date in order to obtain a refund. The IRS also reminds taxpayers who want to apply for a 2008 tax refund that if they fail to file their 2009 and 2010 income tax returns, their tax refund checks may be temporarily withheld. In addition, if the taxpayer owes the IRS tax, the refund will be used against it. The refund will also be used to offset unpaid child support payments or past federal loan debt (such as student loans). If you fail to file your 2008 income tax, you may not only lose the withheld tax refund, but you may also lose other tax benefits. Some people who did not receive the 2008 stimulus tax refund may be eligible for the Recovery Rebate Credit if they file. In addition, many low- and moderate-income workers may not have applied for the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC), which helps individuals and families whose income falls below certain thresholds. If you need tax forms and explanations for this year and past years, you can request them from the Forms and Publications page of the IRS website, IRS.gov, or call toll-free 800-829-3676.

4a7d1eab1461fd59b4b5fad9199d987485fcd237.sourceText: 亚特兰大林黛：前辈们，新年好 2011年真是过得好快，一转眼就到年底了，平日要上班，周末就要去采购，做好吃的，过节么。 这一天采购回来，远远看到家门口放着一个红色的东西，把车停好后去看，是一本2012年的挂历，套在外面的透明塑料袋上写着我的名字，并且还写 着”Merry Christmas!! ” 落款是”邻居”，邻居的邻是繁体字的邻。 我知道这是谁给我的，因为这已经不是第一本了。 最早还是几年前，小区里的中国人举行聚会，其中有一对老夫妇，应该有七十多岁了，他们有孩子，但在外州工作。 聚会上大家聊天很开心，还留下了各自的电话以便于联络。 那一年的圣诞节前夕，邻居老伯伯给我送来一本挂历，上面写着”林黛，你好！圣诞节快到了，现送上一本2008挂历。祝圣诞快乐！邻居，老谭 ，12-22-07”，邻居的邻是繁体字。 从那以后每到十二月，老谭都会送我一本挂历，这一送就是五年。 这让我想起了另一件事。 我来美国的第一站是凤凰城，我开始写作也是在凤凰城，发表的第一篇稿件是在凤凰城的”亚省时报”上，办报纸的是甑社长夫妇，他们来自广东，当时 该有六十岁左右吧，我称呼他们甄社长和社长夫人。 我的第一篇稿件在”亚省时报”发表后，他们把来自社区的好评及时转给我，并鼓励我多写，当时，有一段时间”亚省时报”每周都会有我的文章 。 几年后我离开那里来到亚特兰大，他们则开始给我邮寄”亚省时报”，这一寄就是八年。 有一年社长写了一本关于他的家乡开平碉楼的书，也寄给了我一本。 前两天在邮箱里我还收到一封邮件，是一个老朋友写来的：”林黛，新年好!贺圣诞、新年之际，送上一曲原创’走向明天’，祝你前程辉煌 ！老华”。 和老华的相识也是很多年前了，那时合唱团要演唱他创作的歌曲，歌词非常感人，深深打动了我们的心：”求学他乡走过春秋冬夏，是否真喜欢浪迹天涯？感觉了 外面世界的精彩，是否真的想在这儿安家？五星红旗冉冉升起，是否热泪会滚滚留下？”我们来到美国的中国人，很多都有打拼的经历，而且刻骨铭心的思乡也常常让我们 心疼。 老华退休后回到中国，用作画作曲摄影等爱好丰富和点缀着他的人生。 中国现代著名年轻女作家曾来亚特兰大演讲，她说现在的年轻作家没有使命感，这不能怪他们，因为他们生活在一个相对稳定的社会形态中。 听众中有人提出不同的意见，认为尽管现代中国没有战争没有大的风云变幻，但是人的观念却是在经历着几千年来最大的动荡，传统的礼仪遭受着最大的冲击，表现在人心的浮躁 和社会的浮躁上。 但我从我的邻居老谭、社长老甄、朋友老华身上看到了承诺、礼仪和谦谦君子的风范，让我看到了中华文化的传承，他们是让我敬仰的前辈。 我给邻居老谭回送了我做的又健康又可口的土豆馅饼；我给”亚省时报”编辑部寄去了订阅2012年报纸的支票；我给老华回复了邮件，在邮件里附 上了我的一首小诗”丝瓜”，”春天里/我种下了一株丝瓜/天天浇水常常施肥盼着他长大。//夏天里/片片绿叶绿叶片片她直往上 爬/还有那像莲蓬一样的花。//秋天里/一条条丝瓜墙上挂/中秋餐桌上/除了月饼葡萄/还有/还有那丝瓜。”希望这首小诗能让他在百忙中 轻松一下。 这里我要向前辈们拜个年，在这新年到来之际祝你们身体健康、万事如意。 。 。 。 。 老报人的覆: 可敬可爱的林黛; 请容许我这样称呼。 衷心感谢您能记得我们这些老人! 这些年来, 老朋友一个一个走了, 曲老啦, 徐将军啦, 福伯啦厖去年10月连我老伴也走了! 写到这里, 再写不下去了! 只能再说; 衷心感谢您能记得我们! 看到您的文章, 的碓万二分的安慰! 老真 顿首 2/23/2012上午
4a7d1eab1461fd59b4b5fad9199d987485fcd237.translatedText: Linda Lin from Atlanta: Happy New Year, seniors. 2011 really flies by. It’s the end of the year in a blink of an eye. I have to go to work on weekdays and go shopping on weekends to prepare delicious food for the holidays. When I came back from shopping that day, I saw a red thing placed in front of my house from a distance. I parked the car and looked at it. It was a wall calendar for 2012. My name was written on the transparent plastic bag outside, and it also said "Merry Christmas!!" The signature was "neighbor", and neighbor's neighbor means neighbor in traditional Chinese. I know who gave it to me because it's not the first one. The earliest was a few years ago when Chinese people in the community held a gathering. Among them was an old couple who must be in their seventies. They had children but worked out of state. Everyone had a great time chatting at the party and even left their phone numbers for easy contact. On Christmas Eve of that year, my neighbor’s old uncle sent me a wall calendar, which said, “Hello Lin Dai! Christmas is coming soon, and I am sending you a 2008 wall calendar. Merry Christmas! Neighbor, Lao Tan, 12-22-07.” Neighbor’s neighbor is the traditional Chinese character. From then on, Lao Tan would give me a wall calendar every December for five years. This reminds me of another thing. My first stop in the United States was Phoenix. It was also in Phoenix that I started writing. The first article I published was in the "Alberta Times" in Phoenix. The newspaper was run by President Zhen and his wife. They were from Guangdong and must have been about sixty years old at the time. I called them President Zhen and his wife. After my first article was published in the "Alberta Times", they promptly forwarded me the positive comments from the community and encouraged me to write more. At that time, the "Alberta Times" had my articles every week for a while. A few years later I left and came to Atlanta, and they started mailing me the "Alberta Times" for eight years. One year the president wrote a book about his hometown Kaiping Diaolou and sent me a copy. I also received an email in my mailbox two days ago, which was written by an old friend: "Lin Dai, happy New Year! On the occasion of Christmas and New Year, I send you an original song 'Toward Tomorrow'. I wish you a brilliant future! Lao Hua." We met Lao Hua many years ago. At that time, the choir was going to sing a song he wrote. The lyrics were very touching and deeply touched our hearts: "After studying in a foreign country through the spring, autumn, winter and summer, do you really like to wander around the world? Feeling the wonderful world outside, do you really want to settle here? With the five-star red flag rising, will the tears roll down?" Many of us Chinese who came to the United States have had the experience of hard work, and the unforgettable homesickness often makes us feel distressed. After Lao Hua retired, he returned to China, where hobbies such as painting, music, and photography enriched and embellished his life. A famous modern Chinese young female writer once came to Atlanta to give a lecture. She said that today's young writers have no sense of mission. This cannot be blamed on them because they live in a relatively stable social form. Some people in the audience expressed different opinions, saying that although there are no wars or major changes in modern China, people's concepts are experiencing the greatest turmoil in thousands of years, and traditional etiquette has suffered the greatest impact, which is reflected in the impetuousness of people's hearts and the impetuousness of society. But I saw the commitment, etiquette and modest gentlemanly demeanor from my neighbor Lao Tan, the boss Lao Zhen, and my friend Lao Hua, which allowed me to see the inheritance of Chinese culture. They are the seniors I admire. I sent back the healthy and delicious potato pie I made to my neighbor Lao Tan; I sent a check for subscribing to the newspaper in 2012 to the editorial office of the "Alberta Times"; I responded to Lao Hua's email and attached a little poem of mine "Luffa" in the email, "In the spring/I planted a loofah/I water it every day and fertilize it every day, hoping that it will grow up.//In the summer/the green leaves are all the way up. Climbing/There are also flowers like lotus pods. //In autumn/Lose gourds are hung on the wall/On the Mid-Autumn Festival table/In addition to moon cakes and grapes/There are also/there are loofahs.” I hope this little poem can make him relax in his busy schedule. Here I would like to pay my New Year greetings to my seniors, and wish you good health and all the best on the occasion of the New Year. . . . . Reply from the old reporter: Dear and lovely Lin Dai; please allow me to call you this. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for remembering us old people! Over the years, old friends have passed away one by one, Qu Lao, General Xu, and Fu Bo Pang. Even my wife passed away last October! At this point, I can’t write any more! All I can say is: Thank you from the bottom of my heart for remembering us! After reading your article, I am extremely comforted! Lao Zhen paused 2/23/2012 am

dcd2449eaa2b8a3cee9a3f59dee1b12bacfafea8.sourceText: 港媒分析薄熙来起死回生 重庆模式是重要关键(图)
dcd2449eaa2b8a3cee9a3f59dee1b12bacfafea8.translatedText: Hong Kong media analyzes Bo Xilai’s comeback from the dead and the Chongqing model is the key (picture)

a6553557321329372452fedf37f9f394fcdd8de2.translatedText: Hong Kong media analyzes Bo Xilai’s comeback from the dead and the Chongqing model is the key (picture) After Wang Lijun entered the U.S. Consulate, Chongqing's officialdom was in turmoil, and everything was thin...

b1ea45bac257276ff942662ad4a80fd7cb96a48a.sourceText: 王立军步入美国领事馆后，重庆官场风声鹤唳，一片薄熙来即将下台的传闻，排山倒海迎面而来。如今，薄熙来地位依旧稳如泰山，香港媒体分析，重庆模式所争取的基层民心，是稳住薄熙来的重要关键。
b1ea45bac257276ff942662ad4a80fd7cb96a48a.translatedText: After Wang Lijun stepped into the U.S. Consulate, Chongqing's officialdom was trembling, and there were overwhelming rumors that Bo Xilai was about to step down. Today, Bo Xilai's status is still as stable as Mount Tai. Hong Kong media analyzed that the grassroots public support won by the Chongqing model is an important key to stabilizing Bo Xilai.

f7b1aba79f74bcb992132278e68e5c10741a8515.sourceText: 尽管外界有诸多联想、猜忌，但薄熙来的行程并没有因此进行调整，接见外宾、出外参访，依旧谈笑风生，内部会议神情自若。
f7b1aba79f74bcb992132278e68e5c10741a8515.translatedText: Despite many associations and suspicions from the outside world, Bo Xilai's itinerary has not been adjusted. He still talks and laughs happily when meeting foreign guests and visiting foreign countries, and he looks calm in internal meetings.

fa4884fda305210c12029d1e7d0138f5f76448dd.sourceText: 不少自由派一开始藉由此事件，顺势加大力度打王倒薄，但薄熙来依旧高举唱红打黑、共同富裕的鲜艳旗帜。在「两岸猿声啼不住」的情况下，显示「轻舟已过万重山」。最近又有消息指出，王立军事件，最后可能会被定调为「间歇性精神病」。
fa4884fda305210c12029d1e7d0138f5f76448dd.translatedText: Many liberals initially took advantage of this incident to increase their efforts to defeat Wang and Bo. However, Bo Xilai still held high the bright banner of singing red, fighting criminals, and achieving common prosperity. When "the apes on both sides of the Taiwan Strait can't stop crying", it shows that "the light boat has passed the Ten Thousand Mountains". Recently, news has pointed out that the Wang Lijun incident may eventually be classified as "intermittent mental illness."

9740a4e16e8eafd0f0ceb80f4629870d28791ac8.sourceText: 此外，重庆市长黄奇帆在北京受访时也驳斥，表示辞职的传闻是「胡说八道」，而薄熙来在重庆高调接见雷锋班历任班长时称「雷锋精神在重庆大放光芒」，表示要学习雷锋「对同志要像春天般的温暖，对敌人要像秋风扫落叶一样无情」的精神，这番言谈，完全看不出他受到王立军事件的影响。
9740a4e16e8eafd0f0ceb80f4629870d28791ac8.translatedText: In addition, Chongqing Mayor Huang Qifan also refuted the rumors of resignation as "nonsense" during an interview in Beijing. Bo Xilai said during a high-profile meeting with the successive class leaders of Lei Feng Class in Chongqing that " "Lei Feng's spirit is shining brightly in Chongqing", and he expressed that he would learn from Lei Feng's spirit of "being as warm as spring to comrades, and as ruthless to enemies as the autumn wind sweeps away fallen leaves." These words did not show that he was affected by the Wang Lijun incident at all.

5d1952366b7183af10efdb4eba2446ab926fff36.sourceText: 文章分析指出，太子党身分并非薄熙来最大的政治资本，而是与民心同在的重庆模式。在贫富悬殊、权贵垄断、社会不公、拜金主义充斥的社会中，他提出民生十条、共富十二条，民主法制十五条，成为基层弱势群体的希望，也成为中共实现自我救赎，重新找回执政活力的路径。
5d1952366b7183af10efdb4eba2446ab926fff36.translatedText: The article analysis points out that being a princeling is not Bo Xilai's greatest political capital, but the Chongqing model that is in line with the people's hearts. In a society filled with great disparity between rich and poor, monopoly by powerful men, social injustice, and money worship, he proposed ten principles for people's livelihood, twelve principles for shared wealth, and fifteen principles for democracy and legal system. These became the hope of vulnerable groups at the grassroots level and the path for the CCP to achieve self-salvation and regain its vitality in power.

28d87196fb63e79ba6a0b146b66ed8c9afd53fcd.sourceText: 王立军进入美领事馆，虽然让薄熙来一时难堪，但重庆模式并没有受到实质损伤。同时这也符合共党的基本执政理念。
28d87196fb63e79ba6a0b146b66ed8c9afd53fcd.translatedText: Wang Lijun’s entry into the US Consulate caused Bo Xilai a moment of embarrassment, but the Chongqing model was not substantially damaged. At the same time, this is also in line with the basic governing philosophy of the Communist Party.

f84d4e48b09bc52447fe958ca28589b79cbcd024.sourceText: 文章认为，即将召开的全国两会，很可能薄熙会进行反击的。届时重庆代表团的动向将受到外界高度关注。此外，薄熙来近期重提胡锦涛「三一四部署」，其中也势必隐藏了某些的涵义。
f84d4e48b09bc52447fe958ca28589b79cbcd024.translatedText: The article believes that Bo Xi will probably fight back at the upcoming National Two Sessions. At that time, the movements of the Chongqing delegation will receive great attention from the outside world. In addition, Bo Xilai's recent mention of Hu Jintao's "March 14 Deployment" must have some hidden meanings.

a302edfd3f64b2cc60b7e07059579d6dd0e68e5b.translatedText: Lin Jing: How Americans educate their children to view life and death

fcf840e0ff69da56e2f42be671fa8cfd41f5df3b.sourceText: 林静：美国人怎样教育孩子看待生死 说到”死亡”，国人总觉得”不吉利&#…
fcf840e0ff69da56e2f42be671fa8cfd41f5df3b.translatedText: Lin Jing: How Americans educate their children to view life and death. When it comes to "death", Chinese people always feel it is "unlucky"...

c19ea4d1bdf181c6cef4ba19fd0a1bb7f6f41a22.sourceText: 林静：美国人怎样教育孩子看待生死 说到”死亡”，国人总觉得”不吉利”，因而不仅在日常生活中有意尽少和孩子谈及，而且更将其坚决地拒之于儿童教育门外。 美国的家长和教师，却乐于在孩子3-4岁时就向他们作出关于”死亡”的诠释，当然这种诠释是十分深入浅出、形象生动的。 美国儿童教育专家早已发现，由于传媒的兴旺发达和信息的超速流通，实际上3周岁的幼童大多已接触到”死亡”此词。 他们可能会在跟小伙伴的交流中提及”死亡”，并对其感到既神秘又恐惧。 他们或许还会若有所思地向大人们提出许多相关的问题：难道我们每个人总有一天都会死吗？ 我要爸爸、妈妈、爷爷、奶奶都不死行吗？ 我的小朋友和我以后也非得死吗？ 不过孩子一般要长到10岁左右才能理解”死亡是永恒的”（即人死了就不能复活）这样深奥、抽象的道理。 而在此之前，他们往往不会如成人那样，为亲人的死亡带来的哀伤背上沉重的情感包袱。 他们只是想知道死亡究竟是怎么回事而已。 对于儿童提出的”死亡问题”，美国家长总是作出最为直截了当、简单明了的回答，尽量避免似是而非或模糊不清。 此外，他们也较少利用神话或宗教中的诸如天堂、地狱之类的传说来对死亡作出解释。 因为他们认定，尽管作出这样的解释也许最为简单轻松，但要是孩子长大了并不相信这些，那他就必然会陷入更深的无所适从之中难以自拔。 当然美国人更不赞成将”人死后都会变鬼”这样的”黑色迷信”作为知识，来传授给天真的孩子。 他们认为：要是同时还把”鬼”描绘成面目狰狞的怪物，副作用可能就会更大。这样的”解释”除了可能误导孩子外，无疑只会增加孩子做恶梦的可能，并人为 地加大了孩子的恐惧感等其他种种心理压力，以至于待家里真的死了人时，惊恐的孩子甚至不敢参加亲人的追悼会。 更确切地说，绝大多数美国家长是将”死亡”视为一种”情感知识”存入孩子的”知识库”的。 当碰到死亡事件时，孩子便能动用他所需要的”情感知识”来理解他将面临的深深悲伤究竟是怎么回事了。 美国人还认为，待孩子长大到有足够的领悟能力时，向其传授某些积极的”生死观”，也许还能帮助他塑造乐观开朗、积极向上的人生观。 这时的美国人往往向孩子们这么解释说：其实”死”和”生”是自然而然又顺理成章的事，没有了”死”，也就无所谓”生”。 即便是无生命的万物，如星星、地球和太阳，也都有其寿命。 一个人死了，其肉体诚然在世界上消失了，但其子女却在延续他的生命，他遗留下的思想、作品和所作的好事仍可能被后人津津乐道。 美国的一些小学校里甚至开设了别具一格的”死亡课”。 由在教育部接受过专门训练的殡葬行业从业人员或护士走进课堂当起教师，跟孩子们认真地讨论人死时会发生什么事，并且让学生轮流通过演剧的方式，模拟一旦遇到亲人 因车祸死亡等情形时的应对方式，或体验一下突然成为孤儿的凄凉感觉，或走进火葬场参观火葬的全过程，甚至设计或参加一台模拟的”向亲人遗体告别”仪式等等。 尽管也有人认为这么做可能会给孩​​子心中留下阴影，但大多数教育专家和家长却对此表示了无保留的支持。 美国”死亡教育”中最精彩的一幕，要算越来越多的儿童在父母或老师的带领下，来到郊外专为绝症患者提供善终服务的宁养院，跟大人一起，把准备好的 五彩缤纷的花瓣轻轻撒向临终者们的床榻。 还有的孩子在宁养院里显示了对”仙逝之美”的深深崇敬–他们勇敢地握住正处在弥留之际的老人或病人干枯的手，一边向他送上祝福的 话语，一边微笑着目送他告别人世。
c19ea4d1bdf181c6cef4ba19fd0a1bb7f6f41a22.translatedText: Lin Jing: How Americans educate their children to view life and death. When it comes to "death", Chinese people always feel it is "unlucky", so they not only deliberately rarely talk to their children in daily life, but also resolutely exclude it from children's education. Parents and teachers in the United States are happy to explain "death" to their children when they are 3-4 years old. Of course, this explanation is very simple and vivid. American child education experts have long discovered that due to the prosperity of the media and the rapid circulation of information, most 3-year-old children have actually been exposed to the word "death". They may mention "death" in communication with their friends, and feel both mysterious and afraid of it. They may also thoughtfully ask many related questions to adults: Will all of us die one day? Do I want my father, mother, grandpa, and grandma to die? Will my children and I have to die in the future? However, children generally need to be about 10 years old to understand the profound and abstract truth that "death is eternal" (that is, people cannot be resurrected after death). Before that, they often do not carry the heavy emotional baggage of grief caused by the death of their loved ones. They just want to know what death is like. American parents always give the most straightforward, simple and clear answers to children's "death questions", and try to avoid being specious or vague. In addition, they rarely use myths or religious legends such as heaven and hell to explain death, because they believe that although such explanations may be the simplest and easiest, if the child grows up and does not believe them, he will inevitably fall into a deeper confusion. Of course, Americans are not in favor of teaching "black superstitions" such as "people turn into ghosts after death" as knowledge. They believe that if "ghosts" are also depicted as ferocious monsters, the side effects may be greater. In addition to misleading children, this "explanation" will undoubtedly increase the likelihood of children having nightmares and artificially create nightmares. This greatly increases the child's fear and other psychological pressures, so that when someone is really dead in the family, the frightened children will not even dare to attend the memorial service of their relatives. To be more precise, the vast majority of American parents regard "death" as a kind of "emotional knowledge" and store it in their children's "knowledge base". When a death occurs, the child can use the "emotional knowledge" he needs to understand what is going on with the deep sadness he will face. Americans also believe that when children grow up to have enough understanding, teaching them some positive "views on life and death" may help them create an optimistic, cheerful and positive outlook on life. At this time, Americans often explain to children: In fact, "death" and "life" are natural and logical things. Without "death", there is no such thing as "life". Even inanimate things, such as stars, the earth and the sun, have their lifespans. When a person dies, his body disappears from the world, but his children continue his life, and the thoughts, works and good deeds he left behind may still be talked about by future generations. Some elementary schools in the United States even offer unique "death classes" where practitioners or nurses in the funeral industry who have received special training from the Ministry of Education come into the classroom to serve as teachers, and seriously discuss with the children what will happen when a person dies, and let the students take turns simulating encounters with their loved ones through drama. How to cope with situations such as death in a car accident, or experience the desolate feeling of suddenly becoming an orphan, or go into the crematorium to watch the whole process of cremation, or even design or participate in a simulated "farewell to the remains of a loved one" ceremony, etc. Although some people think that this may leave a shadow on the children's hearts, most education experts and parents have expressed unreserved support for this. The most exciting scene of "death education" in the United States is that more and more children, led by their parents or teachers, come to hospice homes in the suburbs that provide hospice services for terminally ill patients. Together with adults, they gently scatter colorful flower petals on the beds of the dying. Some children in the hospice show their deep respect for the "beauty of death" - they bravely hold the withered hands of the dying elderly or patients while sending them blessings. words, while watching him bid farewell to this world with a smile.
