1d3e90f38268e96605350b9fa8d9ab16abeed915.sourceText: 鲍家麟教授演讲《辛亥革命时期的妇女思想》 亚省时报讯： 2月22日在Flagstaff市北亚利桑那大学人文大楼有一场由该校亚洲研究项目主办的鲍家麟教授的演讲，题为《辛亥革命时期的妇女思想》。演讲后放映电影Autumn Gem (《秋瑾》)，到场者百余人。鲍家麟教授深入浅出地解说了中国在西风东渐以后、在帝国主义国家的侵略之下的中国妇女状况，到了20世纪初年，在国家危亡之际，无论立宪派、革命派、还是清政府，都以反缠足、兴女学为救国之良方，而秋瑾正是这个运动的先驱人物。她借演讲、诗词、弹词、报刊等媒介，试图唤醒国民、特别是中国的妇女同胞；最后，她于1907年为革命捐躯，”热血洒去化碧涛”，影响深远。 Rae Chang与Adam Tow费时两年，拍摄了这部获奖影片，熔秋瑾传记、学者访问、秋瑾作品与历史资料于一炉，带给大家以鉴湖女侠秋瑾生动的女英雄形象，确是成功之作。 参加这场盛会的有：该校亚洲研究项目主任Zauzanna Gulacsi，历史系的梁钢章教授，现代语言系的刘晓艺博士。北亚大学的亚洲研究辅修项目目前在读的已经有近200人，较去年增加一倍。
1d3e90f38268e96605350b9fa8d9ab16abeed915.translatedText: Professor Bao Jialin gave a speech on "Women's Thoughts during the Revolution of 1911" The Alberta Times reported: On February 22, Professor Bao Jialin gave a lecture titled "Women's Thoughts during the Revolution of 1911" at the Humanities Building of Northern Arizona University in Flagstaff, hosted by the school's Asian Studies Program. After the speech, the movie Autumn Gem ("Qiu Jin") was screened, with more than a hundred people in attendance. Professor Bao Jialin explained in a simple and easy-to-understand way the situation of Chinese women after the westward spread to the east and under the aggression of imperialist countries. In the early 20th century, when the country was in danger, both the constitutionalists, revolutionaries, and the Qing government all regarded anti-footbinding and the promotion of women's education as a way to save the country. Qiu Jin was the pioneer of this movement. She tried to awaken the people, especially Chinese women compatriots, through speeches, poems, ballads, newspapers and other media. Finally, she sacrificed her life for the revolution in 1907, "sprinkling her blood to transform Bitao", which had a profound impact. Rae Chang and Adam Tow spent two years filming this award-winning film, which combines Qiu Jin's biography, scholar interviews, Qiu Jin's works and historical materials to give everyone a vivid heroine image of Qiu Jin, the heroine of Jianhu Lake. It is indeed a success. Participating in this event were: Zauzanna Gulacsi, Director of the Asian Studies Program of the school, Professor Liang Gangzhang from the Department of History, and Dr. Liu Xiaoyi from the Department of Modern Languages. North Asia University’s Asian Studies minor program currently has nearly 200 students enrolled, double the number last year.

cc9402ea263d61b5819eb8f9d2c23a788837cadc.sourceText: 如果你认为现在的油价已经很高，该到顶了，那你就错了。 专家预测，三月一加仑4美元，四月初则达5美元。 ”这不是很好，我们哪有足够的钱来支付油费，”加油站里一位正在加油的车主说。 目前，本州油价平均每加仑$3.49，同比增长超过30美分。 有不少车主表示，如果油价一直涨下去，另找交通工具是唯一出路。 油箱比较小的摩托车，与人合开一辆车，或乘坐巴士都是比较经济的交通工具。
cc9402ea263d61b5819eb8f9d2c23a788837cadc.translatedText: If you think that the current oil price is already very high and has reached its peak, you are wrong. Experts predict that a gallon will cost $4 in March and $5 in early April. "This is not very good. How can we have enough money to pay for gas," said a car owner who was filling up at a gas station. Currently, gas prices in the state average $3.49 per gallon, an increase of more than 30 cents year-over-year. Many car owners said that if oil prices continue to rise, finding another means of transportation is the only way out. Motorcycles with relatively small fuel tanks are more economical means of transportation than sharing a car with others or taking the bus.

bfddda739f625575a10a28507a76ff3154b51d07.sourceText: 据州长公路安全协会的一个新的研究表示，本州青少年驾驶死亡人数上升。 事实上，全美青少年驾驶死亡人数都在上升，亚利桑那州在此排行23。 按现行法律规定，一个十几岁的青少年仅需在有驾车执照成人监管下学车30个小时就可以获得驾照，驾驶教练伯莎巴雷拉说，这条法律存在疏忽。 ” 30小时，绝对不够经验来操作汽车安全，”巴雷拉说。 青少年驾车事故频发，巴雷拉还归咎于手机来电、短信等。 ” 没什么比生命更重要，电话、短信可以等，钱包够不着没什么要紧。”? 州长公路安全协会呼吁，青少年安全驾驶，家长有必要加强监管。
bfddda739f625575a10a28507a76ff3154b51d07.translatedText: The number of teen driving deaths in the state is on the rise, according to a new study by the Governors Highway Safety Association. In fact, teen driving fatalities are on the rise across the country, with Arizona ranking 23rd. Under the current law, a teenager can get a driver's license after only 30 hours of learning to drive under the supervision of a licensed adult, but driving instructor Bertha Barrera says the law is an oversight. "Thirty hours is definitely not enough experience to operate a car safely," Barrera said. Barrera also blamed mobile phone calls and text messages for the frequent occurrence of driving accidents among teenagers. "Nothing is more important than life. Phone calls and text messages can wait. It doesn't matter if the wallet is out of reach." The Governor's Highway Safety Association called on parents to strengthen supervision for teenagers to drive safely.

8ee45774764036c86ac2520d64bad68f4edaf6b2.sourceText: 凤凰城将出售廉价房给低收入家庭 （亚省时报） 凤凰城计划今年向符合低收入条件和背景的家庭出售廉价房屋。 这是SSHP（Scattered Sites Housing Program）的一部分，起源于1990年代，市政府使用联邦住房补贴购买了数百幢房屋。到目前为止，这些房屋有部分出租，有部分已经出售给低收入家庭。现在，市政府计划扩大这些廉价房的销售面，使更多低收入家庭受惠。 条件不苛刻，一个四口之家，年收入在$16,650至$53,300之间，就有资格申请贷款。市政府会提供首期付款帮助，和强制性的贷款。 ”我们期待今年出售10个物业，如果销售成绩理想，也许能销售更多，”凤凰城房屋署主任金多利说。”这是一个给低收入家庭置业的好机会。” 垃圾车司机恩西索是这个计划的受惠者，2009年在凤凰城中心地区买了一幢价值11万的房子。金多利说，今年的房子可能低至8万1千左右。 根据SSHP，申请人必须是一个家庭，家庭成员至少两个，必须满足最低或最高收入要求。家庭成员年满12岁以上必须通过犯罪背景调查，信用调查，家庭成员必须有一个有支付租金历史。申请人不得有当前或以前的房产债务，不得拖欠任何金钱，没有在美国拥有任何房产。 欲了解更多信息，请参阅城市网站或致电602-534-4584。
8ee45774764036c86ac2520d64bad68f4edaf6b2.translatedText: Phoenix will sell low-cost housing to low-income families (Alberta Times) Phoenix plans to sell low-cost housing to families who meet low-income qualifications and backgrounds this year. This is part of the SSHP (Scattered Sites Housing Program), which originated in the 1990s when the city used federal housing subsidies to purchase hundreds of homes. So far, some of the houses are rented out and some have been sold to low-income families. Now, the city government plans to expand the sales scope of these low-cost houses to benefit more low-income families. The conditions are not harsh. A family of four with an annual income between $16,650 and $53,300 is eligible to apply for a loan. The city will provide down payment assistance and mandatory loans. "We're looking to sell 10 properties this year, and if sales go well, maybe more," said Phoenix Housing Director Kim Dolly. "This is a good opportunity for low-income families to buy homes." Garbage truck driver Enciso is a beneficiary of this program. In 2009, he bought a house worth 110,000 in central Phoenix. Jin Doli said that the price of a house this year may be as low as around 81,000. Under SSHP, applicants must be a family with at least two family members and must meet minimum or maximum income requirements. Household members 12 years and older must pass a criminal background check, a credit check, and one household member must have a history of paying rent. Applicants must not have current or previous real estate debt, be delinquent on any money, or own any real estate in the United States. For more information, see the city website or call 602-534-4584.

f95b83b4cb85d419adbd31c5a65a2688fd05efac.sourceText: 奥巴马总统周日在白宫举行正式晚宴，宴请全国的州长，讨论经济是会见中的主要话题。很多州的州长都出席，向总统汇报本州的经济进展。唯独亚利桑那州的布鲁尔州长，铁定不出席。
f95b83b4cb85d419adbd31c5a65a2688fd05efac.translatedText: President Obama held a formal dinner at the White House on Sunday, entertaining governors from all over the country, and discussing the economy was the main topic during the meeting. Governors from many states attended and reported to the president on their state's economic progress. Only Governor Brewer of Arizona will definitely not attend.

0486348cb216b5935c6f23ff978c04a024a5f215.sourceText: 布鲁尔告诉 NBC 主播，因为她事先有约。当 NBC 的戴维格雷格里问：”你这是不尊重总统吗？”州长说：”我不会不尊重美国总统，我有其他的承诺。”
0486348cb216b5935c6f23ff978c04a024a5f215.translatedText: > Brewer told the NBC anchor because she had a prior appointment. When NBC's David Gregory asked, "Are you disrespecting the president?" the governor said, "I'm not going to disrespect the president of the United States, I have other commitments."

8e1ad7000115eb05b504d7121126ee2e093299c6.sourceText: 布鲁尔告诉 NBC ，她将出席周一在白宫的政务会议。那是奥巴马总统和拜登副总统举办的全国州长协会年会。预计周一讨论的内容包括增加工作机会，儿童保护，健保，能源和国民自卫队的角色等。
8e1ad7000115eb05b504d7121126ee2e093299c6.translatedText: Brewer told NBC that she will attend Monday's administration meeting at the White House. It was the National Governors Association annual meeting hosted by President Obama and Vice President Biden. Discussions expected on Monday include increasing job opportunities, child protection, health care, energy and the role of the National Guard.

5568f4150295a58f8fb9cef0eaa56948fa49b7f0.sourceText: ”今晚的州长晚宴是社交事情，”布鲁尔州长说。
5568f4150295a58f8fb9cef0eaa56948fa49b7f0.translatedText: "Tonight's Governor's Dinner is a social affair," said Governor Brewer.

2cd37129af50eb6d2337f92a4e6cee8e8d039fd3.sourceText: ”我是州长，我有我的安排，但周一我会出席那里所有的会晤和讨论政策。”
2cd37129af50eb6d2337f92a4e6cee8e8d039fd3.translatedText: "I'm the governor, I have my schedule, but I will be there on Monday for all the meetings and policy discussions."

f6d04444c357e01d9483e9eae929f429611dff27.sourceText: 布鲁尔不去白宫晚宴，让人联想到 1 月 25 日在空港机场州长指着总统鼻子的一幕。布鲁尔说奥巴马反对她的移民政策，白宫说，布鲁尔在她的书中歪曲了总统和她会面的细节。二人势成水火已不是一两天的事。
f6d04444c357e01d9483e9eae929f429611dff27.translatedText: Brewer's absence from the White House dinner was reminiscent of the January 25 scene at the airport in which the governor pointed at the president's nose. Brewer said Obama opposed her immigration policies, and the White House said Brewer misrepresented details of meetings between the president and her in her book. It's not just a matter of a day or two that the two have become incompetent.

ed34f81666cf0f28c89f06f605c0c4d46520086a.sourceText: 开车族近来发现，油价进入2月份悄悄上扬，转眼已经逼近一加仑五元的关卡，媒体也纷传这股涨势还将持续。 民众各出奇招节省汽油，也改变生活习惯因应油价压力。 住巴沙迪那的Mike黄，近来将车停放车库内，改骑两轮的摩托车通勤。 他说，家中的摩托车原是周末休闲用，如今油价迭创新高，正好骑车省钱，这也是说服家人保留摩托车的最有利理由。 上班族郑凯文住钻石吧市，公司则是在安那罕。 因应油价压力，近来选择与同事共乘通勤，另他也取消周末出游，选择在住家附近购物避免无谓油耗。 经常驾驶长途的陈侨生分享经验，指称高速公路驾车多用行车定速装置（Cruise Control），他说避免突然加速、减速，也可让油耗获得改善。 律师周先生表示，现在举家出游更缜密规画，尽可能避开需绕道的路线，先透过网路地图计算里程。 他说，此举不但省油，还可以省下时间。 从事进出口贸易的黄安仁表示，以前嫌电动车续航力差，跑不了太远，现在发现同事的电动车环保又省钱，也考虑买一辆来开，今后不必跑加油站，晚上只要在家充电 即可。 住奇诺冈的孙先生指出，绿灯时避免急起步是省油窍门。 此外，他也以开窗吹自然风取代空调系统，平时都在好市多（Costco）卖场买汽油，车辆也定期保养，常保车况良好。 家住喜瑞都的江小姐，因公司位于车程约一个小时的圣塔蒙尼卡，将家中的3700c.c.大车入库，改开油电混合车上班。 她说，一样的距离，油电混合车可撑一周加油一次，大车却只有三天，一个月油钱差很大，这笔钱可供全家吃大餐，没必要贪图舒服而苦了 荷包。 在汽车产业服务的张淯翔，近来成为众人咨询的汽车专家。 他说，汽油引擎的车子要提高效率，可从减少车身重量下手，首先将不必要的东西移除，譬如置物箱、杂物甚至备胎。 此外，避免让车怠速持续运转、更换低磨擦系数与高滚动性轮胎、轻踩油门和煞车也是方法。 夏天来临时，他提醒车内的空调温度别调太低，检查汽车的喷油、点火效率和胎压。 不过，他坦承此举省下的钱很有限，顶多一加仑差一到两哩左右，从数据感受不到差别。 他建议，近期有意换车的民众，不妨考虑柴油车或者油电混合车。
ed34f81666cf0f28c89f06f605c0c4d46520086a.translatedText: Motorists have recently discovered that the price of oil has quietly risen in February, and in the blink of an eye it has approached the five-dollar-a-gallon mark. The media has also spread rumors that this upward trend will continue. People are finding new ways to save gasoline and changing their living habits to cope with the pressure of oil prices. Mike Huang, who lives in Pasadena, recently parked his car in the garage and commuted on a two-wheeled motorcycle. He said that the motorcycle he owned at home was originally used for leisure purposes on weekends. Now that gas prices are at record highs, riding a bike saves money. This is also the most favorable reason to convince his family to keep the motorcycle. Office worker Zheng Kaiwen lives in Diamond Bar, and his company is in Anaheim. In response to pressure from gas prices, he has recently chosen to share commutes with his colleagues. He has also canceled weekend trips and opted to shop near his home to avoid unnecessary fuel consumption. Chen Qiaosheng, who often drives long distances, shared his experience and pointed out that cruise control is often used when driving on highways. He said that avoiding sudden acceleration and deceleration can also improve fuel consumption. Mr. Zhou, a lawyer, said that now families plan their trips more carefully, avoiding routes that require detours as much as possible, and calculating mileage through online maps first. He said this not only saves fuel, but also saves time. Huang Anren, who is engaged in import and export trade, said that he used to think that electric vehicles had poor battery life and could not travel very far. Now that he has discovered that his colleague’s electric vehicle is environmentally friendly and saves money, he is considering buying one to drive. In the future, he will not have to go to a gas station and can just charge it at home at night. Mr. Sun, who lives in Chino Hills, pointed out that avoiding a sudden start when the light turns green is a fuel-saving tip. In addition, he also opens the windows to let in natural breeze instead of the air conditioning system. He usually buys gasoline at the Costco store. His vehicle is also regularly maintained to keep it in good condition. Ms. Jiang, who lives in Cerritos, put her family's 3700c.c. truck into storage and switched to a gasoline-electric hybrid vehicle to work because her company is located in Santa Monica, which is about an hour's drive away. She said that for the same distance, a gasoline-electric hybrid car can refuel once a week, but a large car can only refuel for three days. The difference in the cost of gas a month is huge. This money can be enough for the whole family to have a big meal, so there is no need to worry about comfort and hardship. Zhang Chuanxiang, who serves in the automobile industry, has recently become an automobile expert consulted by many people. He said that in order to improve the efficiency of gasoline engine cars, we can start by reducing the weight of the car body. First, remove unnecessary things, such as glove boxes, sundries and even spare tires. In addition, avoid letting the car idle continuously, replace tires with low friction coefficient and high rolling resistance, and lightly apply the accelerator and brake. When summer comes, he reminds the car's air conditioner not to adjust the temperature too low, and checks the car's fuel injection, ignition efficiency and tire pressure. However, he admitted that the money saved by this move is very limited. At most, the difference is about one to two miles per gallon. The difference cannot be felt from the data. He suggested that people who are interested in changing their cars in the near future may wish to consider diesel cars or gasoline-electric hybrid cars.

79158a29e3c0dede5d27418249e4577e7e02c512.sourceText: 一份新的分析显示，2011年亚利桑那州房屋销售中超过42％的交易是破产屋，这个数字比2010年增长12％，但是比2009年的数量略有下降。 某破产屋销售追踪调查公司周四公布的报告显示，在2011年最后三个月的销售，破产屋销售比例下降到38％的销售。去年破产屋和短售屋销售的价格比正常销售价格平均低出27%。平均销售价格为122,400美元左右。2011整个一年，全州有84698个房屋亏本销售，超过60,000人破产，或者正在办理破产手续。 更多有关房地产的信息请谘询金信地产公司的Tinna 电话：(480)287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
79158a29e3c0dede5d27418249e4577e7e02c512.translatedText: More than 42 percent of Arizona home sales in 2011 were bankruptcies, a new analysis shows. That number is up 12 percent from 2010 but down slightly from the 2009 number. A report released Thursday by a bankrupt home sales tracking company showed that in the last three months of 2011, the proportion of bankrupt home sales dropped to 38% of sales. Last year, bankruptcy and short-sale home sales averaged 27% below normal sales prices. The average sales price is around $122,400. Throughout 2011, 84,698 homes were sold at a loss across the state, and more than 60,000 people were bankrupt or in the process of bankruptcy. 01c08c12e0f479ceb9b2580c45ee394f05b6e056.sourceText: 皮纳尔郡警长保罗巴布向来以保守派强硬人物出现，与马利科巴郡阿派奥警长志同道合，打击非法移民绝不手软，指责奥巴马政府对非法移民不作为。 一月初，巴布宣布以共和党候选人身份参选亚利桑那州第四选区国会议员。 如今，巴布警长又多了一个身份棗同志，也就是同性恋。 一名墨西哥移民宣称是警长的前同性伴侣，并称巴布曾威胁他如果公开他俩身份，将被驱逐出境的丑闻后，上周六，巴布公开承认自己是同性恋者。 但巴布否认有任何不法行为，并发誓继续为共和党提名战斗。 巴布承认这是一场艰苦的选战，尤其在亚利桑那州这样一个注重家庭观念，拥有大量基督教福音派和摩门教教众的保守地区，他的同性恋身份引人注目。 但他希望选民坚定地支持他。 而他的竞争对手认为这是不可能的。 亚利桑那州参议员罗恩古尔德说，巴布一定会失去那些支持家庭价值观的选民。 巴布否认他试图威胁何塞。 他说，这些指控是企图伤害他的政治生涯。 何塞提供给《新时代》一些照片，其中包括他与巴布拥抱的照片，还用手机发布了自己穿着内衣和一个似乎是赤膊上身的警长在一间浴室，但巴布没有否认这些照片 的真实性。 巴布在2008年上任凤凰城南边郊郡警长后，与阿派奥警长一起大力打击走私贩毒和人口走私，成为当年全美的风云人物。 2010年曾支持麦凯恩竞选连任，为其边境安全计划出谋划策。 在周六新闻发布会之前，刚从罗姆尼竞选共同主席的位置辞职下来。 作为长期盟友的麦凯恩参议员告诉本地电视台，他把巴布看作朋友。 ” 我不知道细节，除了已在媒体上公布的，”参议员说。 ” 我敢肯定会有一个全面和完整的调查，如果有任何不当行为的指控。我可以说的是，在被证明无罪前，巴布应该像所有公民一样得到相当的尊重。”? 另一盟友阿派奥警长，对巴布的丑闻表明疏离态度。 ” 我只能说他是皮纳尔县警长，是他面对自己的问题，不是我的，”阿派奥说。 ” 我不认为自己被卷进来，我们会看到巴布警长如何处理自己的私事。”? 巴布对本州人来说一直是传奇。 他18岁在家乡麻省的北亚当斯市当选市议员，2001年竞选北亚当斯市长落败后来到亚利桑那州，成为钱德勒警察，2008年11月击败民主党候选人成为皮纳尔郡警长 。
01c08c12e0f479ceb9b2580c45ee394f05b6e056.translatedText: Pinal County Sheriff Paul Barb has always been a conservative and tough person, and he is like-minded with Sheriff Arpaio of Maricopa County. He will never show mercy to illegal immigrants and accuses the Obama administration of inaction on illegal immigrants. In early January, Barb announced his candidacy as the Republican candidate for Congress in Arizona's 4th District. Now, Sheriff Babu has another identity: gay, that is, gay. Barb came out as gay on Saturday following a scandal in which a Mexican immigrant claimed to be the Sheriff's ex-sex partner and said Barb threatened him with deportation if he disclosed their identities. But Barb has denied any wrongdoing and vowed to continue fighting for the Republican nomination. Barb acknowledged it was a tough race, especially in Arizona, a conservative, family-oriented state with large evangelical and Mormon congregations where his gay identity is conspicuous. But he hopes voters will solidly support him. His competitors thought this was impossible. Arizona Sen. Ron Gould said Babb is bound to lose voters who support family values. Barb denied that he tried to threaten Jose. He said the charges were an attempt to harm his political career. Jose provided some photos to New Times, including photos of him embracing Barb, and also used his cell phone to post photos of himself wearing underwear and what appeared to be a shirtless police chief in a bathroom, but Barb did not deny the authenticity of the photos. After taking office as Sheriff of the southern suburbs of Phoenix in 2008, Barb worked with Sheriff Arpaio to vigorously crack down on drug trafficking and human smuggling, becoming a man of the hour in the United States that year. In 2010, he supported McCain's re-election campaign and provided advice on his border security plan. Just before Saturday's press conference, he resigned as co-chairman of the Romney campaign. Senator McCain, a longtime ally, told local television that he considered Barb a friend. "I don't know the details, other than what has been published in the media," the senator said. "I'm sure there will be a full and complete investigation if there are any allegations of wrongdoing. What I can say is that Babu should be treated with the same respect as all citizens until proven innocent." Another ally, Sheriff Arpaio, has shown a distant attitude towards Babu's scandal. "All I can say is that he's the Pinal County Sheriff and he's dealing with his own problems, not mine," Arpaio said. "I don't think I'm involved, and we'll see how Chief Barb handles his personal affairs." Barb has always been a legend to people in this state. He was elected as a city councilor in his hometown of North Adams, Massachusetts at the age of 18. After losing the election for mayor of North Adams in 2001, he came to Arizona and became a Chandler police officer. In November 2008, he defeated the Democratic candidate to become the Pinal County Sheriff.

5ba426c08e60e36498a76b2452cea89ce74b8bd3.sourceText: ICE搜出美墨边境新走私隧道 （亚省时报） 美国移民及海关执法的国土安全调查官员说，他们与美国边境巡逻在图桑部门协调，发现一条横跨亚利桑那州诺加拉斯和墨西哥边境的毒品走私隧道。 隧道入口分别在墨境诺加拉斯的一个前院，和亚利桑那诺加拉斯一个仓库。国土安全部探员和墨西哥联邦警察于上周四凌晨同时进入隧道两端，没发现有人，但检获550磅大麻。该隧道低于地面五英尺，长约110英尺，平均两英尺宽，有木桩支撑。隧道没有任何通风或电气设备，相信完工没多久。 ”这条隧道的发现又是一个国土安全部和边境巡逻队，与墨西哥联邦警察合作的成功例子，”负责此次行动的诺加拉斯特别行动队凯文凯利警官说。”通过警惕和密切合作，我们可以在通道使用前将它封闭，减少毒品进入美国的可能。” 过去三年中，国土安全部已在诺加拉斯发现的跨境隧道22条，并已全部封闭。
5ba426c08e60e36498a76b2452cea89ce74b8bd3.translatedText: ICE uncovers new smuggling tunnel on U.S.-Mexico border (Alberta Times) Homeland Security Investigations officials with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement said they coordinated with the U.S. Border Patrol's Tucson division and discovered a drug smuggling tunnel across the border between Nogalas, Arizona, and Mexico. The tunnel entrances are in a front yard in Nogalas, Mexico, and in a warehouse in Nogalas, Arizona. Homeland Security agents and Mexican federal police entered both ends of the tunnel at the same time early Thursday morning. No one was found, but 550 pounds of marijuana was seized. The tunnel is five feet below ground level, approximately 110 feet long, averages two feet wide, and is supported by wooden piles. The tunnel does not have any ventilation or electrical equipment, and it is believed that it was completed not long ago. "The discovery of this tunnel is yet another successful example of collaboration between Homeland Security and Border Patrol, in conjunction with the Mexican Federal Police," said Nogalas Special Operations Officer Kevin Kelly, who led the operation. "Through vigilance and close cooperation, we can seal tunnels before they are used and reduce the possibility of drugs entering the United States." In the past three years, the Department of Homeland Security has discovered 22 cross-border tunnels in Nogalas and has sealed them all.

ee76d97d10c0f9b454875fd3236e145eb86ad21a.sourceText: 3枪手夜店外滥射 坦佩夜店14伤 （亚省时报） 坦佩一家夜店外，2日晚间发生枪击桉，三名疑为帮派成员的男子，疑因发生纠纷，开枪互射，让在现场排队等候入场的民众遭池鱼之殃，造成至少14人受伤。 枪击案发生后，现场一团溷乱，伤者不断呼叫救命，数以百计乘客则四散奔逃。目前警方已逮捕一名嫌犯，另有两人在逃。 坦佩市警局发言人贺恩表示，枪击桉发生在凤凰城郊区坦培市的「Clubhouse Music Venue」俱乐部，至3日为止，证实已至少有14人受伤，但没有人有生命危险，其中两人重伤、12人轻伤，有些人甚至是自行驾车前往医院接受治疗，贺恩表示：「民众听见枪响后，立刻四处逃命，现场十分溷乱，幸无人死亡。」 据信三名嫌犯为凤凰城帮派分子，当时至少有250人在店外排队等候，等候入场观赏俱乐部内的嘻哈表演。 贺恩指出，被捕的嫌犯已被控以13项加重攻击，以及一项协助犯罪帮派的罪名。
ee76d97d10c0f9b454875fd3236e145eb86ad21a.translatedText: 3 gunmen shot indiscriminately outside a nightclub in Tempe, injuring 14 (Alberta Times) A ​​shooting occurred outside a nightclub in Tempe on the evening of the 2nd. Three men suspected of being gang members shot at each other due to a dispute, injuring at least 14 people who were waiting in line at the scene. After the shooting, the scene was chaotic, with the injured constantly calling for help and hundreds of passengers running away. The police have arrested one suspect and two others are at large. Tempe Police Department spokesman Hern said that the shooting occurred at the "Clubhouse Music Venue" in Tempe, a suburb of Phoenix. As of the 3rd, it was confirmed that at least 14 people had been injured, but none of them were life-threatening. Two of them were seriously injured and 12 people were slightly injured. Some people even drove to the hospital for treatment. Hern said: "People immediately ran for their lives after hearing the gunshots. The scene was very chaotic, but luckily no one died." The three suspects were believed to be Phoenix gang members. At least 250 people were waiting in line outside the store to enter the club to watch the hip-hop performance. Hearne pointed out that the arrested suspect has been charged with 13 counts of aggravated assault and one count of assisting a criminal gang.

This year (2012), with the theme of "Touching 101", short films ranging from 120 seconds to 180 seconds will be solicited from Chinese people around the world. The winner will receive a prize of NT$200,000! The films selected for the competition in previous years are exquisite and stunning, fully demonstrating the ingenuity and potential of the Chinese people in audio and video creation; this year, Chinese people from all over the world are once again invited to share more wonderful stories, whether it is family, love, friendship or even emotions for the land, hometown, and country, all can be interpreted in the film. The "Touching 101?012 Chinese Golden Overseas Chinese Award Short Film Selection Campaign" has been inviting Chinese people from all over the world to participate through the Internet since February 1st. The global simultaneous call for submissions and uploading of participating videos will be opened from May 10th. In addition, starting from March, the "Qiao Qiao Super Health Award" event will also be held. As long as you join the "Lai Qitao Taiwan" fan group, you will have a chance to win grand prizes such as Hgengen-Dazs pint ice cream coupons, 7-11 gift certificates, and NT$3,000. This year, the champion work will receive NT$200,000. The runner-up and third runner-up will receive NT$100,000 and NT$50,000 respectively. There are also individual awards, masterpieces, and popularity awards. The total prize is up to NT$600,000. There are rich prizes. Everyone is welcome to participate in the event. For details of the selection event, please contact the Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center at 714-754-9999, or go to the event website: video.mactv.com.tw.

1ee19e13dd904f8305d852c5e8a86d8e1dbc7f73.sourceText: 美侨学界知名人士纪念尼克松总统访华40周年 （AACYF洛杉矶讯） 2012年的2月28日是尼克松总统访华、美中联合发表《上海公报》40周年的纪念日，全美侨学界知名人士以各种形式举办纪念活动。美国中美集邮中心策划并制作，在美中两地同时发行邮政外交纪念卡一张，以及各一枚两款的”尼克松总统访华40周年纪念封”，纪念尼克松总统访华这一美中关系史上最重要的历史事件。 纪念封由魏进发总策划，戴定国撰文、陈峰完成英文翻译，中国封左侧的周恩来总理迎接尼克森总统的图案由原中国邮票设计室主任李印清创作；美国封上是著名画家何茜粉笔手绘的毛泽东主席会见尼克松总统的图案。中国封则加盖(北京)首都机场航站楼二1邮戳，这是40年前周总理在北京机场欢迎尼克松总统原地足迹同日邮戳。 经美国邮政总局监製，尼克松总统故乡加利福尼亚州首府萨克拉门托邮政局专门为这次活动，採用中美集邮中心魏进发、魏中典联合设计, 专门刻制了一枚”尼克松总统访华40周年” 纪念邮戳；以及由姚佳珏设计的一枚”上海公报发表40周年”纪念邮戳。 纪念封系列策划委员会包括曾经在尼克松总统访华和中美建交等一系列重大事件中都作出过积极贡献的陈香梅女士、以及丁绍光、武益华、朱林骥、招思虹、刘少艺、都兰英、任向东、温桂芃、张铁流、李华等侨学界知名人士。 他们一致认为，尼克松访华、以及他访华之行最主要的成果《上海公报》，是美中关系史上最重要的里程碑。通过纪念封的发行和收藏，一方面是纪念两国关系发展史上最重要的外交事件，缅怀当年这些伟人们为美中关系发展所做出的巨大贡献；另一方面，在美中两国的民间留下两国人民友好关系持续发展的历史见证。美中两国人民的福祉、世界的和平、和谐发展都离不开美中两国的携手合作。
1ee19e13dd904f8305d852c5e8a86d8e1dbc7f73.translatedText: Eminent figures in the American and overseas Chinese academic circles commemorate the 40th anniversary of President Nixon's visit to China (AACYF Los Angeles News) February 28, 2012 is the 40th anniversary of President Richard Nixon's visit to China and the United States and China jointly issuing the "Shanghai Communique". Well-known figures in the overseas Chinese academic community across the United States held commemorative activities in various forms. Planned and produced by the U.S.-China Philatelic Center, a postal diplomatic commemorative card and two types of "Commemorative Envelopes for the 40th Anniversary of President Nixon's Visit to China" will be issued simultaneously in the United States and China to commemorate President Nixon's visit to China, the most important historical event in the history of U.S.-China relations. The commemorative cover was planned by Wei Jinfa, with text written by Dai Dingguo and English translation completed by Chen Feng. The pattern on the left side of the Chinese cover featuring Premier Zhou Enlai greeting President Nixon was created by Li Yinqing, the former director of the China Stamp Design Office. The American cover is a hand-drawn pattern of Chairman Mao Zedong meeting President Nixon in chalk by the famous painter He Qian. The Chinese cover is stamped with the postmark of (Beijing) Capital Airport Terminal Building 21. This is the postmark on the same day that Premier Zhou welcomed President Nixon at the Beijing Airport 40 years ago. Under the supervision of the U.S. Postal Service, the Post Office of Sacramento, the capital of California, the hometown of President Nixon, specially engraved a commemorative postmark for the "40th Anniversary of President Nixon's Visit to China" jointly designed by Wei Jinfa and Wei Zhongdian of the China-US Philatelic Center for this event; and a commemorative postmark for the "40th Anniversary of the Shanghai Communique" designed by Yao Jiajue. The planning committee for the commemorative envelope series includes Ms. Chen Xiangmei, who has made active contributions to a series of major events such as President Nixon's visit to China and the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and the United States, as well as well-known figures in overseas Chinese academic circles such as Ding Shaoguang, Wu Yihua, Zhu Linji, Zhao Sihong, Liu Shaoyi, Du Lanying, Ren Xiangdong, Wen Guipeng, Zhang Tieliu, and Li Hua. They agreed that Nixon's visit to China and the Shanghai Communique, the most important outcome of his visit to China, were the most important milestones in the history of U.S.-China relations. Through the issuance and collection of commemorative envelopes, on the one hand, it commemorates the most important diplomatic event in the history of the development of relations between the two countries and remembers the great contributions made by these great people to the development of U.S.-China relations; on the other hand, it leaves the people of the United States and China with historical witnesses of the continued development of the friendly relations between the two peoples. The well-being of the people of the United States and China, world peace, and harmonious development are all inseparable from the cooperation between the United States and China.

ba23ef971626a8149efd7e8f6bc2f0c997b539e4.sourceText: 中共重庆市委书记薄熙来日前再度主持重庆市委常委会议，听取关于贯彻落实国家主席胡锦涛「314总体部署」的情况汇报，薄熙来说，「314」总体部署是「重庆发展的总纲，具有重要的指导意义」。分析认为，自从本月初重庆市副市长王立军一度进入成都美国领事馆事件发生后，薄熙来的讲话调子发生变化，不再如以往般强调「唱红打黑」，而是频提改革开放和「科学发展观」，强调共同富裕，有向中央输诚的意味。
ba23ef971626a8149efd7e8f6bc2f0c997b539e4.translatedText: Bo Xilai, Secretary of the Chongqing Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China, chaired a meeting of the Standing Committee of the Chongqing Municipal Committee again recently and listened to a report on the implementation of President Hu Jintao's "314 overall deployment". Bo Xilai said that the "314" overall deployment is "the general outline of Chongqing's development and has important guiding significance." Analysts believe that since the incident of Wang Lijun, deputy mayor of Chongqing, entering the U.S. Consulate in Chengdu at the beginning of this month, the tone of Bo Xilai's speech has changed. He no longer emphasizes "singing red and fighting gangsters" as before. Instead, he frequently mentions reform and opening up and the "Scientific Outlook on Development", emphasizing common prosperity, which means showing sincerity to the central government.

55990a2692741bb94d173b77ceb5930d0acdf18e.sourceText: 而据新加坡传媒报道，王立军的问题很可能被定性为「间歇性精神病发作」。事件对薄熙来的影响，可能并不如外界揣测般严重。而薄治理重庆的经验，将续受肯定。
55990a2692741bb94d173b77ceb5930d0acdf18e.translatedText: According to Singapore media reports, Wang Lijun's problem is likely to be characterized as an "intermittent psychotic episode." The impact of the incident on Bo Xilai may not be as severe as outside speculation. Bo's experience in governing Chongqing will continue to be recognized.

4030da094914712754175d03d0eec9fc4b34c345.sourceText: 据《重庆日报》报道，在薄熙来上周五（24日）主持召开的重庆市委常委会议上，提出要以「314总体部署」为总纲，进一步深化改革、扩大开放，推动重庆科学发展。报道引述会议认为，「314总体部署」为重庆发展导航定向，提升了重庆的战略地位，指明了重庆的发展方向。
4030da094914712754175d03d0eec9fc4b34c345.translatedText: According to the "Chongqing Daily" report, at the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee meeting chaired by Bo Xilai last Friday (24th), it was proposed to use the "314 Overall Deployment" as the general outline to further deepen reform, expand opening up, and promote Chongqing's scientific development. The report quoted the meeting as saying that the "314 Overall Plan" provides navigation and orientation for Chongqing's development, enhances Chongqing's strategic status and points out Chongqing's development direction.

ece875521410e2fb6836eeba834699ed6b221c1c.sourceText: 薄熙来说，经过5年努力，重庆做大了经济总量，促进了社会公平正义，根本一条，就是坚持为人民服务，坚持改革开放。不仅在改革方面有创意、有突破，对外开放也有重大进步。他说，下一步，还要以「314总体部署」为总纲，进一步深化改革、扩大开放，更加注重改善民生和促进共同富裕，努力推动科学发展，不辜负中央的重託和人民的期待。
ece875521410e2fb6836eeba834699ed6b221c1c.translatedText: Bo Xilai said that after five years of hard work, Chongqing has enlarged its economic aggregate and promoted social fairness and justice. The fundamental thing is to persist in serving the people and persisting in reform and opening up. Not only have there been innovations and breakthroughs in reform, but we have also made significant progress in opening up to the outside world. He said that in the next step, we must take the "314 Overall Plan" as the general outline to further deepen reform and expand opening up, pay more attention to improving people's livelihood and promoting common prosperity, strive to promote scientific development, and live up to the central government's trust and the people's expectations.

3c19f4f74435aef92648797aad076a35cb79fc05.sourceText: 「314总体部署」是指2007年3月全国「两会」期间，国家主席胡锦涛参加重庆代表团会议时，针对重庆发展作出的3个定位、1个目标和4项任务（见另稿），被时任重庆市委书记汪洋称为重庆加快发展的「重要指针」。薄熙来抵达重庆之初，虽然也说过：「我到重庆后，重中之重的任务，就是与大家一起贯彻落实总书记做出的『314』总体部署。」但近年在讲话中却鲜有提到「314总体部署」。
3c19f4f74435aef92648797aad076a35cb79fc05.translatedText: "314 Overall Deployment" refers to the 3 positionings, 1 goal and 4 tasks (see separate article) made by President Hu Jintao for the development of Chongqing when he attended the Chongqing delegation meeting during the National "Two Sessions" in March 2007. Wang Yang, then Secretary of the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee, called it an "important guideline" for accelerating the development of Chongqing. When Bo Xilai first arrived in Chongqing, he said, "After I arrive in Chongqing, my most important task is to work with everyone to implement the "314" overall deployment made by the General Secretary." However, in recent years, he has rarely mentioned the "314 overall deployment" in his speeches.

97cac39fa6f12fff713afab10e3855d2772fdf3f.sourceText: 王立军事件之后，薄熙来除了陪澳门前特首何厚铧看了一场红歌表演外，在历次讲话中都只字未提以往津津乐道的「唱红打黑」，反而多次强调「改革开放」及胡锦涛提出的「科学发展观」，也频提「共同富裕」，有向北京中央输诚之意。
97cac39fa6f12fff713afab10e3855d2772fdf3f.translatedText: After the Wang Lijun incident, Bo Xilai, except for accompanying Macau's former Chief Executive Edmund Ho Hau Wah to watch a red song performance, never mentioned the much-talked-about "singing reds and fighting gangsters" in his previous speeches. Instead, he repeatedly emphasized "reform and opening up" and the "scientific outlook on development" proposed by Hu Jintao. He also frequently mentioned "common prosperity", which was a sign of sincerity to the central government of Beijing.

a7ac746d701a8d24113995a77ed57cc3f0337cf1.sourceText: 新加坡《联合早报》前日引述北京消息人士透露，王立军的问题很可能会定性为间歇性精神病发作。事件对薄熙来的影响，料止于晋身政治局常委会的机会大降。然而，薄熙来治理重庆的经验，继续受到肯定。
a7ac746d701a8d24113995a77ed57cc3f0337cf1.translatedText: Singapore's "Lianhe Zaobao" quoted sources in Beijing the day before yesterday saying that Wang Lijun's problem is likely to be characterized as an intermittent psychotic episode. The impact of the incident on Bo Xilai is expected to be that his chances of joining the Politburo Standing Committee have plummeted. However, Bo Xilai's experience in governing Chongqing continues to be recognized.

b0de150068cf3c39b02e68ca265b9b6892ff38a0.sourceText: 报道称，王立军进入总领馆后作出的诉求，不是寻求政治庇护，而是希望安全地离开重庆，等待中央派人接走自己。据说，王立军曾将自己在美领馆的所有言论都自行留证。而美方也将王立军的谈话录音交给中国政府。
b0de150068cf3c39b02e68ca265b9b6892ff38a0.translatedText: Reports stated that Wang Lijun’s request after entering the Consulate General was not to seek political asylum, but to leave Chongqing safely and wait for the central government to send someone to pick him up. It is said that Wang Lijun once kept his own certificates for all his remarks at the US consulate. The United States also handed over the recording of Wang Lijun's conversation to the Chinese government.

ce9f1d4de60c7a502475856baca50a0d86f3f208.sourceText: 美国移民局首场中文交流会于 2 月 16 日下午 12 时 30 分圆满结束。本次交流的主题是成为美国公民的基本条件和程序。凤凰城移民局的现场只来了 4 位华裔参加现场活动。移民局却为来宾准备了地道的中国点心和乌龙茶，希望为华裔带来”家”的感觉。
ce9f1d4de60c7a502475856baca50a0d86f3f208.translatedText: The first Chinese exchange meeting of the US Immigration Service ended successfully at 12:30 pm on February 16. The topic of this exchange is the basic conditions and procedures for becoming a U.S. citizen. Only four Chinese people came to the Phoenix Immigration Bureau to participate in the on-site event. However, the Immigration Bureau prepared authentic Chinese dim sum and oolong tea for the guests, hoping to bring a "home" feeling to the Chinese.

9c82e40b48824c207f44bccc60a6e796f4bdbbd5.sourceText: 交流会分为两个部分，第一部分是美国移民局官员 Yamei Chen 用普通话给大家介绍公民入籍的程序。第二部分就是现场来宾，电话会议参与者，网民的现场提问，移民局官员进行现场解答。通过基本常识的介绍，问题主要集中在入籍时间的计算上，特别是那些经常回中国的永久居民，多少个月会中断在美连续居住时间的计算。还有入籍费用是否可减免，什么情况符合减免的要求？以及一些移民子女错过了服兵役，是否会影响入籍，怎样补救等等。移民局官员对问题一一做了普通话和粤语的回答。
9c82e40b48824c207f44bccc60a6e796f4bdbbd5.translatedText: The exchange meeting was divided into two parts. In the first part, Yamei Chen, an officer from the US Immigration Service, introduced the naturalization process in Mandarin. The second part consists of on-site questions from on-site guests, conference call participants, and netizens, and on-site answers from Immigration Bureau officials. Through the introduction of basic common sense, the problem mainly focuses on the calculation of naturalization time, especially for those permanent residents who often return to China, how many months will interrupt the calculation of continuous residence time in the United States. Also, can the naturalization fee be reduced or exempted? What circumstances qualify for exemption? And some immigrant children missed their military service, whether it will affect naturalization, how to remedy it, etc. Immigration officials answered the questions one by one in Mandarin and Cantonese.

e98d753e97624d66b55abac50faf8773b3f81eb4.sourceText: 随着华裔移民数量的迅速增加， 凤凰城移民局提出了更多为华人服务的项目，其中就有打破语言障碍的服务。在移民局工作的职员就有会粤语的华裔，他们深刻能体会移民的语言交流的问题，表示以后还将继续开展这样的华人问题咨询会，并会跟华人媒体和网站加强合作。以后活动通知以及移民政策更改等信息，将会在《亚省时报》和《太阳鸟》亚省华人网同期刊登。
e98d753e97624d66b55abac50faf8773b3f81eb4.translatedText: With the rapid increase in the number of Chinese immigrants, the Phoenix Immigration Bureau has proposed more projects to serve the Chinese, including services to break language barriers. The staff working in the Immigration Bureau include Chinese people who can speak Cantonese. They have a deep understanding of the language communication problems of immigrants. They said that they will continue to hold such consultation meetings on Chinese issues in the future and will strengthen cooperation with Chinese media and websites. Future event notices and immigration policy changes and other information will be published in the "Alberta Times" and "Sunbird" Alberta Chinese Network at the same time.

4b2294aa1b43390765d268cad3e21eef4cbeca8b.sourceText: 第84届奥斯卡落下帷幕，《艺术家》最终获最佳影片，最佳导演，最佳男主角，最佳配乐，最佳服装设计5项大奖，成为当之无愧的最大赢家。最佳女主角由梅丽尔-斯特里普获得。克里斯托弗-普卢默和奥克塔维亚-斯宾瑟分获最佳男女配角，《雨果》同样赢得5个奖项，但主要为技术奖项。
4b2294aa1b43390765d268cad3e21eef4cbeca8b.translatedText: The 84th Oscars has come to an end, and "The Artist" finally won 5 awards for Best Picture, Best Director, Best Actor, Best Score, and Best Costume Design, becoming the well-deserved winner. Best Actress won by Meryl Streep. Christopher Plummer and Octavia Spencer won Best Supporting Actor and Actor respectively. "Hugo" also won 5 awards, but mainly technical awards.

2fe0883a3fef165ca31d20ac6b42aafcca6e8b5e.sourceText: 凤凰网娱乐讯 北京时间27日早晨7点，当地时间26日下午，第84届奥斯卡金像奖颁奖典礼在美国洛杉矶柯达剧场盛大举行。早前诸多猜测已经料到本届奥斯卡必然是《艺术家》独领风骚，以及以马丁-西科塞斯、伍迪-艾伦和梅丽尔-斯特里普几个老将的分庭抗礼。结果没有意外，《艺术家》拿下最佳影片、最佳导演、最佳男演员、最佳服装、最佳原创音乐等几个重量级奖项；最佳女主角则由梅丽尔-斯特里普凭借《铁娘子》获得；伊朗电影《纳德与西敏：一次别离》众望所归拿下最佳外语片奖；马丁-西科塞斯的《雨果》以卓越的视听效果获得了包括最佳视效、最佳摄影、最佳音效在内的五个技术奖项；伍迪-艾伦则以《午夜巴黎》获得最佳原创剧本奖。斯皮尔伯格导演的《战马》、布拉德-皮特主演的《点球成金》颗粒无收。
2fe0883a3fef165ca31d20ac6b42aafcca6e8b5e.translatedText: Ifeng.com Entertainment News At 7 a.m. Beijing time on the 27th and the afternoon of the 26th local time, the 84th Academy Awards ceremony was held grandly at the Kodak Theater in Los Angeles, USA. Many earlier speculations had predicted that this year's Oscars would be dominated by "The Artist", with several veterans such as Martin Scorsese, Woody Allen and Meryl Streep competing against each other. The result was no surprise. "The Artist" won several heavyweight awards such as Best Picture, Best Director, Best Actor, Best Costume, and Best Original Music; the Best Actress was won by Meryl Streep for "The Iron Lady"; the Iranian film "Nader and Simin: Once" "The Farewell" was widely expected to win the Best Foreign Language Film Award; Martin Scorsese's "Hugo" won five technical awards including Best Visual Effects, Best Cinematography, and Best Sound Effects for its excellent audio-visual effects; Woody Allen won the Best Original Screenplay Award for "Midnight in Paris". "War Horse" directed by Spielberg and "Moneyball" starring Brad Pitt failed to produce any results.

4f802da98711d8111c0f74cf47f25d935051778e.sourceText: 《艺术家》横扫五奖法国人拿奥斯卡最佳导演和演员
4f802da98711d8111c0f74cf47f25d935051778e.translatedText: "The Artist" swept five awards and the French won Oscars for Best Director and Actor

7230943223b4b5d2d4c1801b2244b52b9e7f970c.sourceText: 向默片时代致敬的《艺术家》拿下最佳影片、最佳导演、最佳男演员、最佳服装、最佳原创音乐等几个重量级奖项。除了首届奥斯卡以外，再没有一部无声电影曾经拿下最佳影片的奥斯卡。而自1968年的《奥利弗》以来，也没有一部拿到金球奖的最佳音乐/喜剧奖的影片能同时捧走奥斯卡最佳影片和最佳导演这两座最重要的小金人。
7230943223b4b5d2d4c1801b2244b52b9e7f970c.translatedText: "The Artist", which paid tribute to the silent film era, won several heavyweight awards such as Best Picture, Best Director, Best Actor, Best Costume, and Best Original Music. Apart from the first Oscar, no silent film has ever won the Oscar for Best Picture. Since "Oliver" in 1968, no film that has won the Golden Globe Award for Best Musical/Comedy has also won the two most important Oscars, Best Picture and Best Director.

4052311a1dd4604a4871cea2bf8b08813512f54e.sourceText: 导演米歇尔-哈扎纳维希乌斯《艺术家》 迈克尔曾以冒险喜剧《法国特工117》，在欧洲影坛获得关注。2011年，在新作《艺术家》中完全转变了以往的风格，一部黑白默片《艺术家》将观众带回1927年的好莱坞，并凭借此片在颁奖季中横扫众多奖项。本片女主角贝热尼丝-贝乔是她的妻子。迈克尔-哈扎纳维希乌斯获奖感言幽默地表示：’我要感谢小狗乌吉，虽然他可能不在乎。?/FONT>
4052311a1dd4604a4871cea2bf8b08813512f54e.translatedText: Director Michel Hazanavicius "The Artist" Michael once gained attention in the European film industry with the adventure comedy "French Agent 117". In 2011, the new work "The Artist" completely changed the previous style. The black and white silent film "The Artist" took the audience back to Hollywood in 1927, and with this film, it swept many awards during the awards season. The heroine of the film, Berenice Bejo, is her wife. Michael Hazanavicius said humorously in his acceptance speech: 'I want to thank the dog Uggie, even though he may not care. ?/FONT>

58ba8f6c53e9fb55d16cf01dca5727899e8e0ff2.sourceText: 而凭借该片获得最佳男主角奖的让杜雅尔丹是奥斯卡首位法国影帝，这是继1999年《美丽人生》之后获得的另外一位获得最佳男主角的外国人。他击败的对手同样强劲，有此前被普遍看好的乔治布鲁尼、万人迷布拉德皮特、老戏骨加里德曼等，他此前也一举赢得了第64届戛纳电影节金棕榈奖影帝。
58ba8f6c53e9fb55d16cf01dca5727899e8e0ff2.translatedText: Jean Dujardin, who won the Best Actor Award for this film, is the first French actor to win the Oscar. He is the only other foreigner to win the Best Actor Award after "Life is Beautiful" in 1999. The opponents he defeated were also strong, including George Bruni, the heartthrob Brad Pitt, veteran actor Gary Lidman, etc. who were generally optimistic before. He also won the Palme d'Or at the 64th Cannes Film Festival in one fell swoop.

80fbe4a519b99f5bf96fd833514d5c975c222415.sourceText: 《艺术家》曾被选作去年届戛纳电影节竞赛单元的惊喜电影，在最后时刻跻身金棕榈竞争者行列。最终让?#26460;雅尔丹凭借该片摘得了当届的影帝桂冠。影片中出现了很多经典电影的经典桥段，包括《一个明星的诞生》、《雨中曲》等等，导演还把用主人公乔治作放进了影中影1920年的默片《佐罗的标记》中。片中乔治聪明伶俐的宠物狗杰克会令人联想起《丁丁历险记》中的米卢（白雪），这也是导演再像比利时漫画家埃尔热致敬。而它的强劲对手是《艺术家》、《后裔》、《特别响，非常近》、《帮助》、《雨果》、《午夜巴黎》、《点球成金》、《生命之树》、《战马》。
80fbe4a519b99f5bf96fd833514d5c975c222415.translatedText: "The Artist" was selected as a surprise film in the competition section of last year's Cannes Film Festival, and became a Palme d'Or contender at the last moment. In the end, Jean?#26460; Jardan won the best actor crown with this film. Many classic scenes from classic movies appear in the film, including "A Star Is Born", "Singin' in the Rain", etc. The director also used the protagonist George in the 1920 silent film "The Mark of Zorro". George's clever pet dog Jack in the film is reminiscent of Milou (Snow) in "The Adventures of Tintin", which is another tribute to the Belgian cartoonist Hergé. Its strong rivals are The Artist, The Descendants, Loud and Close, The Help, Hugo, Midnight in Paris, Moneyball, The Tree of Life, and War Horse.

f023fa9f723b27752a1a52e842c011f5563a3e9e.sourceText: 《一次别离》不负众望 伊朗电影披荆斩棘[/b]
f023fa9f723b27752a1a52e842c011f5563a3e9e.translatedText: "A Separation" lived up to expectations and Iranian films overcame all obstacles[/b]

0e18dd50190598c0101d0dd4ca9e6dd7ec3b0d1a.sourceText: 最佳外语片奖毫无悬念的给了伊朗电影《纳德和西敏：一次别离》。这部电影以30万美元的投入、扎实的剧作、娴熟的导演技巧、对人性、阶级、宗教和良知的深刻探讨，成就了这部重重禁忌下的伊朗电影。这是伊朗电影首次获得奥斯卡奖，该片曾经在2011年柏林电影节上斩获金熊奖最佳导演、影片和女主角奖，也获得了当年的金球奖最佳外语片奖。该片的夺魁，或许应该给国内许多电影人以启示棗政治和审查的禁忌是不是电影的全部？
0e18dd50190598c0101d0dd4ca9e6dd7ec3b0d1a.translatedText: The Best Foreign Language Film Award went to the Iranian film "Nad and Simin: A Separation" without any suspense. With an investment of US$300,000, a solid script, skillful directing skills, and a profound discussion of human nature, class, religion, and conscience, this film has become an Iranian film under many taboos. This is the first time an Iranian film has won an Oscar. The film won the Golden Bear Award for Best Director, Film and Actress at the 2011 Berlin Film Festival, and also won the Golden Globe Award for Best Foreign Language Film that year. The film’s win may be a revelation to many domestic filmmakers: Are the taboos of politics and censorship the whole story of movies?

c092d848ae384a363f91c75c126be1b198595a4e.sourceText: 马丁-西科塞斯老而弥坚 3D《雨果》获多项技术奖
c092d848ae384a363f91c75c126be1b198595a4e.translatedText: Martin Scorsese's 3D "Hugo" won multiple technical awards

533421cfa656d38456afcd70ac0380ac5e365692.sourceText: 马丁-西科塞斯的《雨果》以卓越的视听效果获得了包括最佳视效、最佳摄影、最佳音效在内的五个技术奖项。作为十一项提名领跑的奥斯卡大热门，除了最佳影片和最佳导演之外，《雨果》精良的制作团队也在各个技术类奖项上获得颇多认可。这是老马丁思科塞斯的首部3D电影，能获得这么多技术奖项，也是对他的充分肯定。据称，此前该片还曾获得詹姆斯卡梅隆的赞誉。
533421cfa656d38456afcd70ac0380ac5e365692.translatedText: Martin Scorsese's "Hugo" won five technical awards including Best Visual Effects, Best Cinematography, and Best Sound Effects for its excellent audio-visual effects. As an Oscar favorite with 11 nominations, in addition to Best Picture and Best Director, the excellent production team of "Hugo" has also received a lot of recognition in various technical awards. This is Martin Scorsese's first 3D film. Being able to win so many technical awards is also a full recognition of him. It is said that the film had previously received praise from James Cameron.
