617f562cde4f3c7ea3bb039e0c6ba57d773d4938.sourceText: 女子邮寄母亲骨灰 邮局丢了 (亚省时报） 一个刚失去母亲的女人，将母亲的骨灰从太阳城邮局寄往科罗拉多州阿罗拉，结果她收到邮件，里面却没有骨灰。 这个伤心欲绝的女人面临再次失去亲人的痛苦。 林恩杨在丹佛告诉当地电视台，她于1月28日在本州的太阳城邮局将装有母亲骨灰的瓮寄出，结果她回家后只收到包裹通知，却没有骨灰瓮。 杨女士说，她不知道类似骨灰这样的物品在邮局邮寄时需要办理挂号信邮寄，当时邮局接受她包裹的邮递员也没有问她包裹里是什么物品。 太阳城邮政服务的发言人大卫鲁伯特说，邮递员正尽一切所能找到杨女士母亲的骨灰瓮。 根据讣告，杨老太的葬礼于1月27日在太阳城的公理教会举行，2月3日安葬在她已故的丈夫旁边，如今骨灰却不知去向，确实让家属悲痛欲绝。 蜜蜂蜇人 消防员灭之 周二，911中心收到皮奥利亚附近有人遭蜜蜂攻击报告，有四人受到伤害。 消防员出动，在71大道和皮奥利亚大道附近一家民居找到蜂群，蜜蜂咄咄逼人，一名穿了防护服的消防员被蜇了好几次。 消防员最后用泡沫杀死蜜蜂，将伤者送医院救治。
617f562cde4f3c7ea3bb039e0c6ba57d773d4938.translatedText: Woman mailed mother's ashes lost in post office (Alberta Times) A ​​woman who had just lost her mother sent her mother's ashes from the Sun City Post Office to Alola, Colorado, but when she received the mail, there was no ashes in it. The heartbroken woman faced the pain of losing a loved one again. Lynn Young told a local TV station in Denver that she mailed the urn containing her mother's ashes at the Sun City Post Office in the state on January 28. As a result, she only received a package notification but no urn when she returned home. Ms. Yang said that she did not know that items such as ashes need to be sent by registered mail when mailed by the post office. The postman who accepted her package at the post office did not ask her what was in the package. David Rupert, a spokesman for the Sun City Postal Service, said mail carriers were doing everything they could to locate the urn of Ms. Young's mother. According to the obituary, Mrs. Yang's funeral was held at the Congregational Church in Sun City on January 27, and she was buried next to her late husband on February 3. Now her ashes are missing, which really makes her family members grieved. Firefighters extinguished bee stings On Tuesday, 911 received a report of a bee attack near Peoria, injuring four people. Firefighters were dispatched and found a swarm of bees at a residence near 71st Avenue and Peoria Avenue. The bees were so aggressive that a firefighter wearing protective clothing was stung several times. The firefighters finally used foam to kill the bees and sent the injured to the hospital for treatment.

3bdefa7508badcfde045dbbbb3f5a1c76e82d5b7.sourceText: 薪资税减税案延长案 国会过关 （亚省时报） 国会18日通过折衷法案，将薪资税减税案和失业补助延长至2012年底。 这项法案旨在推动美国经济脱离低潮，但也使国会陷入恶斗。联邦众议院以293票对132票表决通过法案，联邦参议院不久也以60票对36票过关。 根据这项法案，社会安全税率优惠将再延10个月，失业救助也会延至2012年底。目前全國有22州的長期失業者合格領取93周以上的失業福利，只有18州可領取99周的失業福利，失業福利平均為每周近300元。延長減免2%的社安稅，讓年收入5萬元的個人，每月可少繳80元。 法案把目前最多可領99周的聯邦失業福利，在18個失業率最高的州延長至5月。到6月，失業福利減為最多可領79周，到9月，減為73周；其他的州，最多只可領63周。 聯邦長期失業福利是提供給失業超過六個月的人，此計畫對1800萬已領完26周州失業福利的工人，再提供聯邦失業福利，民主黨人希望把最多可領取的時間定為接近99周，以協助失業者和刺激經濟；而共和黨人主張減至59周，以減少聯邦赤字。 目前全國1300萬失業者中，有43%失業超過六個月，比自大蕭條時代以後任何經濟下滑時期都高，如果國會不延長聯邦失業福利計畫，約100萬人將在3月失去福利。 社会安全税率从6.2%降至4.2%的优惠，代表年收入5万美元的上班族，今年实得薪资可增加约1000美元。 至于削减联邦医疗保险（Medicare）对医生的给付，也将延至11月大选之后实施。联邦医疗保险是美政府提供老年人的公营保险。 这套法案成本预估达1500亿美元。
3bdefa7508badcfde045dbbbb3f5a1c76e82d5b7.translatedText: The payroll tax cut extension case passes Congress (Alberta Times) Parliament passed a compromise bill on the 18th to extend the payroll tax cut case and unemployment benefits until the end of 2012. The bill aims to lift the U.S. economy out of its doldrums, but it also plunges Congress into a vicious fight. The House of Representatives passed the bill by a vote of 293 to 132, and the Senate soon passed it by a vote of 60 to 36. Under this bill, Social Security tax incentives will be extended for another 10 months, and unemployment benefits will be extended until the end of 2012. Currently, long-term unemployed people in 22 states across the country are eligible to receive unemployment benefits for more than 93 weeks. Only 18 states can receive unemployment benefits for 99 weeks. The average unemployment benefit is nearly 300 yuan per week. The 2% reduction in social security tax will be extended, allowing individuals with an annual income of 50,000 yuan to pay 80 yuan less per month. The bill extends federal unemployment benefits, currently available for up to 99 weeks, through May in the 18 states with the highest unemployment rates. By June, unemployment benefits were reduced to a maximum of 79 weeks, and by September, they were reduced to 73 weeks; in other states, the maximum was only 63 weeks. Federal long-term unemployment benefits are provided to people who have been unemployed for more than six months. This plan will provide federal unemployment benefits to 18 million workers who have received 26 weeks of state unemployment benefits. Democrats hope to set the maximum period of benefits to be closer to 99 weeks to assist the unemployed and stimulate the economy; while Republicans advocate reducing it to 59 weeks to reduce the federal deficit. Of the 13 million unemployed people in the country, 43% have been unemployed for more than six months, which is higher than in any economic downturn since the Great Depression. If Congress does not extend the federal unemployment benefit program, about 1 million people will lose benefits in March. The reduction of the Social Security tax rate from 6.2% to 4.2% means that an office worker with an annual income of $50,000 can increase their take-home pay by about $1,000 this year. As for the reduction of federal medical insurance (Medicare) benefits to doctors, it will also be postponed until after the November election. Federal Medicare is the public insurance provided by the U.S. government to the elderly. The cost of this bill is estimated to be $150 billion.

7967aafa93a00d9ed45df832bf1e84130c9df3ea.sourceText: 经纪带买家看屋 一起被抢 记者王善言橙县报导 富乐顿月前传出地产经纪展示房子（Open House）时，潜在买主遭抢匪持枪抢劫。 获悉抢案的华人经纪大表吃惊，指出近年经济不景气，展示房子时，屋内陈设遭访客顺手牵羊事例增加，但鲜少听到抢案。 这宗抢案发生于月前，当时一名女性地产经纪下午1时40分在Summit View街2200号街区展示男性客户房子时，两名男士进入这栋三卧房屋。 其中一名男子掏枪令经纪及看房客人躺在地板上，然后拿走他们的手机、皮夹与钥匙。 其中一名抢匪跑到门外，搜查该客户的车，不久后两人带着大笔现金离去，所幸无人受伤。 该名地产经纪所属的安那罕「西太平洋地产经纪协会」（Pacific West Association of Realtors）向会员发出警告，敦促他们展示房子时提高警觉，避免单独作业。 富乐顿警方研判，该宗抢案并非随机作案，推测歹徒是尾随于洛杉矶开餐馆的潜在买家来到前址作案。 富乐顿地产经纪赖玲瑶指出，在富乐顿从事地产经纪多年，从未听说有经纪展示房子时遇到抢匪。 她所属的经纪协会则敦促经纪避免在奇怪时间，如天黑以后展示房子。 但近年她看到有经纪为争取生意，选择周间学生放学时间展示房子，认为可吸引到这些学生家长上门。 她并学到展示房子时尽量带新人同行，以便同时间有大批客人涌入时，一前一后有人照应。 但她发现，顺手牵羊的事仍防不胜防。 她曾听同业表示，有宵小利用多人同时进门看屋时去车库做手脚，几小时后趁现场没人再返回，偷走全新洗衣机。 虽然地产经纪展示房子前，都要求卖家将屋内贵重物品藏起来，仍有同业表示，卖家宣称钻戒遗失，孳生纠纷。 地产经纪王桂华说，展示房子若两名经纪一起作业，不少同业认为浪费人力，因此这么做的经纪不多。 多半经纪采提高警觉应对，如人潮变少时，若房子有可以内锁的纱窗门，会将其从内反锁，或搬个凳子坐在靠近路边的窗户，仔细端详前来的客人有无可疑 ，并看好后门逃离现场的出路，基本上是自求多福。 根据联邦劳工局统计，2003至2009年每年平均有75名从事房地产或租赁工作者丧生。
7967aafa93a00d9ed45df832bf1e84130c9df3ea.translatedText: The agent showed the house to the buyer and was robbed together. Reporter Wang Shanyan reported in Orange County. A few months ago in Fullerton, it was reported that when the real estate agent showed the house (open house), the potential buyer was robbed by a robber at gunpoint. The Chinese agent who learned of the robbery was shocked and pointed out that the economic downturn in recent years has led to an increase in the number of visitors taking advantage of the furnishings in the house when showing the house, but it is rare to hear of a robbery. The robbery occurred a month ago when a female real estate agent was showing a male client's house in the 2200 block of Summit View Street at 1:40 p.m. when two men entered the three-bedroom house. One of the men pulled out a gun and ordered the agent and house guests to lie on the floor, then took away their cell phones, wallets and keys. One of the robbers ran outside and searched the customer's car. Soon after, the two left with a large amount of cash. Fortunately, no one was injured. The Pacific West Association of Realtors in Anaheim, where the real estate agent belongs, issued a warning to members, urging them to be vigilant when showing homes and avoid working alone. Fullerton police determined that the robbery was not a random crime and speculated that the criminal followed a potential buyer of a restaurant in Los Angeles to the former location to commit the crime. Fullerton real estate agent Lai Lingyao pointed out that she has been working as a real estate agent in Fullerton for many years and has never heard of an agent encountering a robber when showing a house. Her association of real estate agents urges agents to avoid showing homes at odd times, such as after dark. But in recent years, she has seen some agents showing their houses during the week when students are out of school in order to win business, thinking that this can attract the parents of these students. She also learned to bring new people with her when showing the house, so that when a large number of guests came in at the same time, there would be someone to take care of them one after another. But she found that it was still hard to guard against stealing people. She once heard from colleagues that a small businessman went to the garage to do something when multiple people came in to inspect the house at the same time, and then stole a brand new washing machine a few hours later when no one came back. Although real estate agents require sellers to hide valuables in the house before showing the house, some colleagues say that the seller claimed that the diamond ring was missing, which caused disputes. Real estate agent Wang Guihua said that if two agents work together to show a house, many colleagues think it is a waste of manpower, so not many agents do this. Most real estate agents adopt a more vigilant approach. If the crowds of people decrease, if the house has a screen door that can be locked from the inside, they will lock it from the inside, or move a stool to sit on a window near the roadside, carefully check whether the guests who come are suspicious, and be optimistic about the way to escape the scene through the back door. Basically, you are asking for good luck. According to the Federal Bureau of Labor Statistics, an average of 75 real estate or rental workers lost their lives each year from 2003 to 2009.

388e43d60c9c0af6a8de198f9ac5dd5929f610ff.sourceText: 实现购屋梦 (三) 上周我们谈到了购买房屋时应注意的事项，如: 1.房子的价位、2.您应有的权利、3.如何寻找房屋及4.出价还价的过程，本周继续说明购买合约成立后 该注意的事项。 5. 当买卖双方对价格及所有附加条件都同意时，这时候购买合约便成立，同时也是信托帐户开立的时候，您所交付的订金必须在24小时内存入此帐户，此帐户就是所谓的 Escrow，它的主要目的是为了保障买卖双方的权益，这个帐户会一直维持到签约交屋那一天，这也是为什么签约交屋日通常称为COE?(Close of Escrow) 的原因。 6. 购屋者此时要继续进行贷款的手续，需配合贷款银行的要求，把需要的文件准备好，像是: 前两年的报税单、最近几次的薪资单、其他收入证明、银行 月结单以及您的资产负债状况等等。 7. 购屋合约成立后，要在期限内找有执照的房屋检查员对房屋进行检查，看看房屋是否有问题、有无需要修理的事项，同时也找专业白蚁检查公司看看该屋是否有受 白蚁侵袭的迹象，若对该房屋有不满意的问题可要求卖方处理或是取消购屋合约。 8.选择及比较房屋保险。 虽然贷款银行都会要求您购买保险，也把保费当成每个月房屋付款的一部份，以保障贷款银行的权益，但是您有权选择任何一家保险公司，所以记得多加比较，货比三家 不吃亏。 9.预先安排水、电、煤气等公司，在交屋日帮您开通服务。 在交屋的前几天，去对购买的房子做一次最后的检查，以确保之前要求卖方修复的项目或提出的附加条件都已完成。 另外，在交屋前您应该要收到一份Settlement Statement，这份文件会把所有本次交易所产生的费用列出来。 交屋日当天您将会有很多文件要签，通常惯例上会安排您到产权保证公司(Title Company)去签约或是将需要的文件公证后送到Title，通常在当天或隔天便会在 郡政府完成登记，完成登记的这一天就是房屋产权正式转到您名下的日子，恭喜您，您的美国梦已经跨出一大步了。 下周的专栏中，我们会再继续讨论房地产交易的各种问题，如果您有任何疑问，非常欢迎您打电话到我的专线(480) 612-4545 或email 至Rich@RichLiao.com
388e43d60c9c0af6a8de198f9ac5dd5929f610ff.translatedText: Realizing the dream of buying a house (3) Last week we talked about the things you should pay attention to when buying a house, such as: 1. The price of the house, 2. Your rights, 3. How to find a house and 4. The process of making a counter-offer. This week we continue to explain the things you should pay attention to after the purchase contract is established. 5. When the buyer and seller agree on the price and all additional conditions, the purchase contract is established and the trust account is opened. The deposit you pay must be deposited into this account within 24 hours. This account is called Escrow. Its main purpose is to protect the rights of the buyer and seller. This account will be maintained until the day when the contract is signed and the house is handed over. This is why the day when the contract is signed and the house is handed over is often called COE (Close of Escrow). 6. If you want to continue the loan process at this time, the home buyer needs to cooperate with the loan bank's requirements and prepare the required documents, such as: tax returns for the past two years, recent pay stubs, other income certificates, bank statements, and your asset and liability status, etc. 7. After the house purchase contract is established, you must find a licensed home inspector to inspect the house within the time limit to see if there are any problems with the house and whether there are any items that need repair. You should also find a professional termite inspection company to see if there are signs of termite infestation. If you are not satisfied with the house, you can ask the seller to deal with it or cancel the house purchase contract. 8. Choose and compare home insurance. Although the lending bank will require you to buy insurance and treat the premium as part of the monthly housing payment to protect the lending bank's rights, you have the right to choose any insurance company, so remember to compare more and shop around to avoid losing money. 9. Arrange in advance water, electricity, gas and other companies to help you activate services on the day of handover. A few days before closing, do a final inspection of the home to make sure any repairs or add-ons required of the seller have been completed. In addition, you should receive a Settlement Statement before handing over the house. This document will list all the costs incurred in this transaction. On the day when the house is handed over, you will have many documents to sign. Usually, you will be arranged to go to the title company (Title Company) to sign the contract or have the required documents notarized and sent to the title. Usually, the registration will be completed at the county government on the same day or the next day. The day when the registration is completed is the day when the property rights of the house are officially transferred to your name. Congratulations, your American dream has taken a big step. In next week's column, we will continue to discuss various issues in real estate transactions. If you have any questions, you are very welcome to call my hotline (480) 612-4545 or email to Rich@RichLiao.com

448de5a7b7f42c01315946e44a6205029035d39e.sourceText: 小投资 大决定 （亚省时报） 大凤凰城区的经济环境渐起，由于房屋价格的回落，中国，加拿大，美国其他城市的居民都把投资的眼光放到大凤凰区。对于不了解当地房屋情况的人，怎样做到正确的投资呢？在大凤凰城的投资者，大多的投资额在５万－１５万。凤凰城不同区的房屋价格差异非常大。怎样选择呢？凤凰城比较成熟的小房屋投资大多有如下几个区域，第一经济迅速发展区，这里有大量的企业，工作机会，有稳定的在职租客。第二度假屋区，凤凰城主要的游客就是高尔夫爱好者，针对这些游客的需求，在高尔夫球场附近的度假屋也是很好的投资。这里的投资房屋出租时间短，有的只有半年，但是租金就有盈余。第三学区，在外来人口比较多的大学附近，例如亚利桑那州立大学。这附近有大约６万的学生，其中大部分是在学校附近租房，有很稳定的租客。其实不一定要很了解各个区，只要做出决定抓住目标客户，告诉您的房屋经纪人，他就知道如何给你选合适的房屋。更多房屋资讯请联系金信地产的Tinna Xie 电话(480)287-0180 E-mail:goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
448de5a7b7f42c01315946e44a6205029035d39e.translatedText: Small investment, big decision (Alberta Times) The economic environment of the Greater Phoenix Area is gradually improving. Due to the decline in housing prices, residents from China, Canada, and other cities in the United States are focusing on the Greater Phoenix Area for investment. For people who don’t know the local housing situation, how can they make the right investment? Most investors in Greater Phoenix invest between 50,000 and 150,000. Home prices vary widely in different areas of Phoenix. How to choose? Most of the relatively mature small house investments in Phoenix are in the following areas, the first rapid economic development area, where there are a large number of companies, job opportunities, and stable working tenants. In the second vacation home area, the main tourists in Phoenix are golf enthusiasts. To meet the needs of these tourists, vacation homes near golf courses are also good investments. The investment houses here are rented for a short period of time, some only for half a year, but there is a surplus in rent. The third school district is near universities with a large immigrant population, such as Arizona State University. There are about 60,000 students nearby, most of whom rent houses near the school and have very stable tenants. In fact, you don’t have to know each area very well. As long as you make a decision to grab the target customers and tell your real estate agent, he will know how to choose the right house for you. For more housing information, please contact Tinna Xie of Gold Trust Realty at (480) 287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

a66e466eef0061ff930b1f4425d7c3417539db3e.sourceText: 本州民调 罗姆尼小赢 （亚省时报） 根据21日公布的民调，美国共和党总统参选人桑托荣在亚利桑那州的支持度与竞争对手罗姆尼不分轩轾，显示这场日趋激烈的共和党提名战可能会再次爆出冷门 。 时代杂志/有线电视新闻网联合民调结果显示，罗姆尼与桑托荣的支持度差距缩小，罗姆尼36%、桑托荣32%，这项调查正负误差为4.5个百分点。 先前民调中，罗姆尼领先桑托荣的差距达2位数。 亚利桑那州初选28日登场。 桑托荣未花太多精力经营亚利桑那州。 前联邦众议院议长金瑞契的民调支持度为18%，德州联邦众议员保罗只有6%。 亚利桑那州失利将重创罗姆尼选情。 而密西根州同样也将在28日举行初选。 尽管罗姆尼的父亲曾在密西根州担任过州长，民调显示，桑托荣当地的支持度微幅领先
a66e466eef0061ff930b1f4425d7c3417539db3e.translatedText: State poll: Romney narrowly wins (Alberta Times) According to a poll released on the 21st, U.S. Republican presidential candidate Santorini's support in Arizona is on par with rival Mitt Romney, indicating that this increasingly fierce Republican nomination battle may once again lead to an upset. The results of a joint Time Magazine/Cable News Network poll showed that the gap in support between Romney and Santoron narrowed, with Romney at 36% and Santoron at 32%. The survey had a plus or minus error of 4.5 percentage points. In previous polls, Romney led Santoron by double digits. The Arizona primary will be held on the 28th. Santoron didn't put much effort into running Arizona. Former House Speaker Gingrich's poll approval rating is 18%, while Texas Congressman Paul's approval rating is only 6%. A loss in Arizona would hit Romney hard. Michigan will also hold its primary election on the 28th. Even though Romney's father once served as governor of Michigan, polls show Santoron with a slight lead there.

9d0eb840ecb932fd0ef0721bd63b297d5ac5e0e0.sourceText: CDC促1945—65年出生民众筛检C肝 （亚省时报） 联邦卫生单位表示，C型肝炎造成的死亡病例越来越多，而最新资料显示，婴儿潮罹患C型肝炎的风险最高，卫生单位建议1945到1965年出生的婴儿潮年龄民众，进行血液检查。 卫生单位表示，发现C型肝炎的患者约三分之二为婴儿潮年龄民众，而许多在数十年前感染C型肝炎病毒，大部分感染病毒的民众不知道该病毒有如定时炸弹，数十 年后会损害肝脏。 联邦疾病防治中心(CDC)肝炎预防主管华德表示：「每33名婴儿潮年龄民众中，一人曾感染C型肝炎，大部分遭感染者没有症状，这是一个无声杀手。」 许多C型肝炎是注射毒品者共用针头所传染。 但输血也是感染C肝的管道之一，在1992年以前，输血前对于血液来源的检验并不严格，许多人因输血感染C肝。 估计美国约320万人有C肝，但其中半数民众不知道自己罹患C型肝炎。 罹患C肝者可能肝脏硬化或转变为肝癌。 许多肝硬化或罹患肝癌者，最后需要进行肝脏移植手术。 CDC20日公布的研究显示，过去十年C型肝炎死亡率增加。 2007年有1万5000人死于C型肝炎，比之前的 估计的高，并且超过爱滋病死亡人数的1万3000人。 更令人惊讶的是，四分之三C型肝炎死亡者发生在45到64岁。 根据CDC现行肝炎预防准则，CDC只建议对C肝高危险群进行筛检。 但因为去年夏季药厂推出Telaprevir和boceorevir，将C肝治愈率大幅提高到75%，因此让CDC考虑修改现行肝炎预防准则，为1945到1965年出生的人口进行C肝筛检。
9d0eb840ecb932fd0ef0721bd63b297d5ac5e0e0.translatedText: CDC urges people born between 1945 and 1965 to screen for hepatitis C (Alberta Times) Federal health units say that hepatitis C is causing an increasing number of deaths, and the latest data shows that baby boomers are at the highest risk of contracting hepatitis C. Health units recommend that baby boomers born between 1945 and 1965 get blood tests. Health authorities say that about two-thirds of the patients diagnosed with hepatitis C are baby boomers, and many were infected with the hepatitis C virus decades ago. Most people infected with the virus do not know that the virus is like a time bomb that will damage the liver decades later. "One in 33 baby boomers has been infected with hepatitis C, and most of those infected are asymptomatic. This is a silent killer," said Ward, director of hepatitis prevention at the federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Many hepatitis C infections are spread by injecting drug users who share needles. However, blood transfusion is also one of the channels for Hepatitis C infection. Before 1992, the testing of blood sources before blood transfusion was not strict, and many people were infected with Hepatitis C due to blood transfusion. An estimated 3.2 million people in the United States have hepatitis C, but half of them do not know they have hepatitis C. People suffering from hepatitis C may develop cirrhosis or develop liver cancer. Many people with cirrhosis or liver cancer eventually require liver transplant surgery. A study released by the CDC on the 20th showed that the death rate from hepatitis C has increased over the past decade. Hepatitis C killed 15,000 people in 2007, higher than previous estimates and exceeding the AIDS death toll of 13,000. Even more surprising is that three-quarters of hepatitis C deaths occur in people aged 45 to 64. According to the CDC's current hepatitis prevention guidelines, the CDC only recommends screening for those at high risk for hepatitis C. However, because pharmaceutical companies launched Telaprevir and boceorevir last summer, which significantly increased the cure rate for hepatitis C to 75%, the CDC was asked to consider revising the current hepatitis prevention guidelines to screen people born between 1945 and 1965 for hepatitis C.

4d546f0299fcd70e27793110532e1f980d3a6b31.sourceText: 一项匿名式网络调查发现美国的外科医生酗酒问题严重，大约有15%的外科医生酗酒或依赖酒精，男女外科医生有酗酒问题的比例则分别为14%和26%。 据HealthDay News，外科医生酗酒者比例超过了美国酗酒者的总体比例（8%至12%）。 华盛顿大学心理行为科学临床副教授奥里斯科维奇（Michael Oreskovich）说，必须强调的是，多项研究显示病人们因为外科医生酗酒而受到影响的现像极为罕见，其机率大约是1万分之1。 然而外科医生的酗酒现像也提出一个问题：为何其他安全敏感职业都会对执业者进行毒品抽查，但是对外科医生却没有。 奥里斯科维奇补充说，有些麻醉师现在也要接受毒品检验，所以外科医生不接受检验是没有道理的。 在这项研究中，研究人员分析了美国外科医师学会成员在2010年所做的调查，所有的调查都通过网络以匿名方式进行，参与调查的人不及外科医生总体人数（25000多名）的1 /3。 在参与调查的7200名外科医生中，有1112人申报的饮酒习惯达到酗酒和依赖酒精的程度。 那些在调查的3个月前犯过重大医疗错误的医生最易出现酗酒问题。 总体来看，男性外科医生、有孩子的医生和年龄较长的医生酗酒现像不大普遍，那些工作时数较长、经常待命或者受雇于联邦退伍军人事务部的医生酗酒者也较少。 奥里斯科维奇说，在美国外科医师学会发现酗酒问题实在是很奇异的事，它让我们发现了问题，而且实际情况有可能比统计数字更严重，因为有些外科医生可能没有诚实地回答问题 。
4d546f0299fcd70e27793110532e1f980d3a6b31.translatedText: An anonymous online survey found that American surgeons have a serious alcohol problem. About 15% of surgeons are alcoholics or dependent on alcohol. The proportions of male and female surgeons with alcoholism are 14% and 26% respectively. According to HealthDay News, the proportion of surgeons who are alcoholics exceeds the overall proportion of alcoholics in the United States (8% to 12%). Michael Oreskovich, a clinical associate professor of psychological and behavioral sciences at the University of Washington, said it must be emphasized that multiple studies have shown that patients being affected by alcoholism by surgeons is extremely rare, and the chance is about 1 in 10,000. But the phenomenon of binge drinking among surgeons also raises the question of why other safety-sensitive professions conduct drug checks on practitioners but not surgeons. Oriskovich added that some anesthesiologists are now also subject to drug testing, so it makes no sense that surgeons should not be tested. For the study, researchers analyzed a 2010 survey of members of the American College of Surgeons. All surveys were conducted anonymously online and included less than a third of the overall population of surgeons (more than 25,000 people). Of the 7,200 surgeons who participated in the survey, 1,112 reported drinking habits that amounted to binge drinking and alcohol dependence. Physicians who had made significant medical errors in the three months prior to the survey were most likely to have alcohol problems. Overall, binge drinking was less common among male surgeons, those with children, and among older physicians, as well as among those who worked longer hours, were often on call, or were employed by the federal Department of Veterans Affairs. "The discovery of alcoholism at the American College of Surgeons is really bizarre," Oriskovitch said. "It brings awareness to a problem that may be worse than the statistics because some surgeons may not be answering questions honestly."

096de1f31fbb60623ce98fc7f8cc11b55fd7c846.sourceText: FCC新规：电话促销需获顾客书面许可 （亚省时报） 近日，美国电讯业监管当局联邦通讯委员会(FCC)投票通过新法规，要求电话促销商必须获得消费者书面同意才可以进行电话促销。 FCC将对自动拨号方式的电话促销执行更严格的规则，命令自动拨号或预录电话必须事先得到消费者的书面同意，且公司也不能以和消费者有商业关系作为理由而使用自动拨号促销。 在FCC今年二月的第一次会议上，FCC主席詹纳乔斯基说：”成千的消费者向我们投诉抱怨这些自动拨号促销。”与此同时，慈善机构和竞选等政治活动，或通知学校关门、航班改变以及等将不受新法规的影响。 新法规着重打击为银行、保险公司、电话公司等进行电话促销的营销公司，以及钻法律漏洞继续对FCC禁止致电清单上的消费者进行电话促销的营销公司。 詹纳乔斯基说：”我们采取的命令将要求营销公司必须获得客户的书面参与同意书。”FCC表示，自动拨号促销侵犯了消费者的隐私，并说这些自动拨号消耗手机用户的付费时间。 FCC还投票通过一项对互联网电话(VoIP)服务公司的要求，互联网电话公司将需要向FCC报告那些影响用户拨打911紧急电话的网络中断事故。 这一报告要求在传统话务公司上已经生效，新的法规将法规有效范围延伸到VoIP电话用户中大约三分之一的居家电话服务。
096de1f31fbb60623ce98fc7f8cc11b55fd7c846.translatedText: New FCC regulations: Telemarketing requires written consent from customers (Alberta Times) Recently, the Federal Communications Commission (FCC), the U.S. telecommunications industry regulatory authority, voted to pass new regulations requiring telemarketers to obtain written consent from consumers before conducting telemarketing. The FCC will enforce stricter rules on automatic dialing phone promotions, ordering that automatic dialing or prerecorded calls must obtain the prior written consent of consumers, and companies cannot use automatic dialing promotions on the grounds of having a business relationship with consumers. At the FCC's first meeting in February, FCC Chairman Janachowski said: "Thousands of consumers have complained to us about these auto-dial promotions." At the same time, political activities such as charities and campaigns, or notifications of school closings, flight changes, etc. will not be affected by the new regulations. The new regulations focus on cracking down on marketing companies that conduct telemarketing for banks, insurance companies, phone companies, etc., as well as marketing companies that exploit legal loopholes to continue to conduct telemarketing to consumers on the FCC's prohibited call list. "The order we are taking will require marketing companies to obtain written consent from customers to participate," Janachowski said. The FCC said the auto-dial promotions violated consumers' privacy and said the auto-dialers consume paid time from cell phone users. The FCC also voted to pass a requirement for Internet phone service companies to report to the FCC network outages that affect users' ability to make 911 emergency calls. While this reporting requirement is already in effect for traditional telephone companies, the new regulations extend the scope of the regulations to approximately one-third of VoIP phone users' home phone services.

534790b0fa221c869bf88d53d1df09950da486b2.sourceText: 亚利桑那一所高中的棒球场周四发生一场枪击桉，1人受伤。枪击桉导致校园短暂关闭，一名成年嫌犯遭到拘禁。 柯奇士郡警方表示，枪击桉于下午3点15分左右发生在威尔考克斯的一所高中，该地距离凤凰城东南大约195英里。 ”有一人受伤，可能是学生，没有生命危险，另外可能有1人遭到关押，”警方女发言人卡帕斯说。 当地警方介绍，枪击事件发生后，警方立即赶到现场，威尔考克斯高中也随即关闭。之后，关闭解除，学生可以离开，该校行政助理贝尔说。 ”孩子们已经被允许离开，情况正逐步明朗，”贝尔在电话中说。 贝尔说她无法证实伤者或被关押者的年龄、性别或者身份。她说被关押者为一名成年人，事件发生地点为学校棒球场。
534790b0fa221c869bf88d53d1df09950da486b2.translatedText: One person was injured in a shooting at an Arizona high school baseball field on Thursday. The shooting briefly closed the campus and an adult suspect was taken into custody. Cochise County police said the shooting occurred at about 3:15 p.m. at a high school in Wilcox, about 195 miles southeast of Phoenix. "One person was injured, possibly a student, with non-life-threatening injuries, and another person may be in custody," police spokeswoman Capas said. According to local police, police rushed to the scene immediately after the shooting and Wilcox High School was immediately closed. Later, the closure is lifted and students can leave, said Bell, the school's administrative assistant. "The children have been allowed to leave and the situation is gradually becoming clearer," Bell said by phone. Bell said she could not confirm the age, gender or identity of the injured or those being held. She said the person being held was an adult and the incident occurred at the school's baseball field.

895f05c5e43cbe36bb5eeeec7a5d4c81a5846135.sourceText: 最佳汽车 丰田囊括5项第一 「消费者报导」杂志(Consumer Reports)28日在「华盛顿汽车记者协会」会议上宣布，在该杂志3月6日出版的年度汽车专刊评选的十类汽车中，丰田(Toyota)囊括了五项第一名。 上次一家车厂独拿五项第一是2003年的本田(Honda)。但该杂志表示，今年本田未获一项第一。 丰田重新设计的Camry油电溷能车(Hybrid)，被该杂志评为今年的最佳家庭轿车。2012年Camry溷能车速度更快，行驶更平顺，而且售价较低，还不到3万元。 该杂志评选的十类汽车第一名及其特点如下。 家庭轿车：丰田Camry Hybrid(2万9052)，一加仑跑38哩，宽敞、安静，加速快，操控灵活。 跑车：福特Mustang(2万8880至4万3880元)，加速快，操控灵活，前座舒适。 小型多功能车：丰田RAV4(2万4405至3万1328元)，耗油低(每加仑23至24哩)。 低价家庭轿车：现代Sonata(2万1800元)，宽敞，内装齐全，每加仑可跑27哩。 家用厢型车：丰田Sienna V6(3万5810元)，宽敞，舒适，可载八人，每加仑可跑20哩，是唯一可靠性较好的小型厢型车。 运动房车：Infiniti G(3万4225至3万7225元)，操控灵活，加速极快，连获六年第一。 绿能车：丰田Prius油电溷合车(2万6750至2万8217元)，44哩/加仑，经济实用。 小型轿车：速霸陆Impreza(2万1345元)，四轮驱动，27哩/加仑。 小卡车：雪佛兰Avalenche(4万7435元)，实用而灵活。 家用多功能车：丰田Highlander(3万8578至4万7225元)，舒适，安静，可靠性较高。
895f05c5e43cbe36bb5eeeec7a5d4c81a5846135.translatedText: Best Cars, Toyota Wins Five First Places Consumer Reports magazine announced at the Washington Automotive Journalists Association meeting on the 28th that Toyota won five first places among the ten categories of cars selected in the magazine’s annual car special issue published on March 6. The last time a car manufacturer took first place in five categories was Honda in 2003. But Honda didn't win a single first this year, the magazine said. Toyota's redesigned Camry hybrid car was named this year's best family car by the magazine. The 2012 Camry hybrid car is faster, has a smoother ride, and is priced at a lower price of less than 30,000 yuan. The magazine’s No. 1 cars in ten categories and their features are as follows. Family car: Toyota Camry Hybrid (29,052), 38 miles per gallon, spacious, quiet, quick acceleration, and flexible handling. Sports car: Ford Mustang (28,880 to 43,880 yuan), with fast acceleration, flexible handling, and comfortable front seats. Small multi-purpose vehicle: Toyota RAV4 ($24,405 to $31,328), with low fuel consumption (23 to 24 miles per gallon). Low-priced family car: Hyundai Sonata ($21,800), spacious, well-appointed interior, 27 miles per gallon. Family van: Toyota Sienna V6 ($35,810), which is spacious and comfortable, can carry eight people, and can run 20 miles per gallon. It is the only small van with good reliability. Sports car: Infiniti G (34,225 to 37,225 yuan), with flexible handling and extremely fast acceleration, it has won the first place for six consecutive years. Green car: Toyota Prius gasoline-electric hybrid car (26,750 to 28,217 yuan), 44 miles per gallon, economical and practical. Small car: Subaru Impreza ($21,345), four-wheel drive, 27 mpg. Small truck: Chevrolet Avalenche ($47,435), practical and flexible. Family multi-purpose vehicle: Toyota Highlander (38,578 to 47,225 yuan), which is comfortable, quiet, and highly reliable.

15933ac4531749aaf99deea92c29a34c31858a34.sourceText: 理财Q&A－投资基金 怎么配最安全 （记者周振宇） 世界新闻网北美华文新闻、华商资讯 问﹕有没有什么投资基金可以买了就「忘记」，然后等着自行增值？ 答﹕投资者可能还将经历一年波澜起伏的股市行情。 股市现在非常兴旺，吸引很多投资者入场，但是只要联邦政府财政再出新状况，或者是欧元债务危机进一步恶化，快速下滑将无法避免。 华尔街日报表示，在这种进退都有可能的行情中，投资者最想知道的，就是该怎么做。 是不是应该逢低进场，还是避免这种空头陷阱？ 已经大幅下跌的欧洲股票现在相对廉价，还是会进一步折价？ 过去一年，最好的投资就是债券，但随着债券收益率不断创新低，会不会现在就是盛宴结束前的高潮？ 目前，去年的股市投资收益，相比持有现金更为糟糕。 基本普通股市投资者都蒙受了亏损，只有黄金、债券及新兴市场投资者还能获得高于平均水平的收益。 对于想投资共同基金，希望由基金经理管理投资组合的人，可以考虑下面这些选择: 1‧平衡基金。 这类基金就是按照最简单的60%股票投资和40%债券投资的基金，这类基金也会按照行情变化，进行适当的权重调整。 同时这也是最为传统的共同基金，而且费用相当低，通常是每年0.26%。 2‧分散投资。 分散投资型基金，本身就拥有多种资产，包括国际及小盘股等，同时还有黄金和债券等。 当然这种由基金经理按照市场行情变化进行投资组合调整的基金，费用也不低。 3‧坚持投资策略。 有种称为永恒型的基金，他们会按照固定的比例购买黄金、白银、瑞士法郎、股票及债券。 设计目的就是预防通膨影响，当然低通膨时期表现也会欠佳。 4‧灵活投资基金。 和固定策略不同的是，投资者还可以挑选天才基金经理，按照他们的观点自主进行投资。 但是人都会犯错，而且在基金经理寻找投资机会的时候，会更高比率的持有现金，造成收益明显波动。 当然任何一种基金都无法担保，一定会获得更好的收益，但至少会好于把钱藏在床垫下。
15933ac4531749aaf99deea92c29a34c31858a34.translatedText: Financial Management Q&A - What is the safest way to allocate investment funds (Reporter Zhou Zhenyu) World News Network North American Chinese News, Chinese Business Information Question: Are there any investment funds that can be bought and "forgot", and then wait for the value to increase on their own? Answer: Investors are likely to experience another year of ups and downs in the stock market. The stock market is now very prosperous, attracting many investors to enter the market, but as long as there is a new situation in the federal government's finances, or the euro debt crisis further worsens, a rapid decline will be inevitable. The Wall Street Journal stated that in this market where both advance and retreat are possible, what investors want to know most is what to do. Should we enter the market on dips, or should we avoid this short trap? Are European stocks, which have fallen sharply, now relatively cheap, or will they be further discounted? Over the past year, the best investment has been bonds, but as bond yields continue to hit new lows, could now be the climax before the end of the feast? Currently, stock market investment returns last year were worse than holding cash. Basically, ordinary stock market investors have suffered losses, and only gold, bond and emerging market investors can still obtain above-average returns. For those who want to invest in mutual funds and have their portfolio managed by a fund manager, you can consider the following options: 1. Balanced funds. This type of fund is based on the simplest 60% stock investment and 40% bond investment. This type of fund will also make appropriate weight adjustments according to market changes. It is also the most traditional mutual fund and has fairly low fees, typically 0.26% per year. 2. Diversify your investment. Diversified investment funds themselves own a variety of assets, including international and small-cap stocks, as well as gold and bonds. Of course, this kind of fund, where the fund manager adjusts the investment portfolio according to changes in market conditions, has high fees. 3‧Adhere to the investment strategy. There is a type of fund called a perpetual fund, which buys gold, silver, Swiss francs, stocks and bonds in fixed proportions. The design purpose is to prevent the impact of inflation. Of course, performance will not be good during periods of low inflation. 4. Flexible investment funds. Unlike fixed strategies, investors can also select talented fund managers and invest independently according to their views. But everyone makes mistakes, and when fund managers look for investment opportunities, they will hold a higher proportion of cash, causing significant fluctuations in returns. Of course, there is no guarantee that any kind of fund will get better returns, but at least it will be better than hiding money under the mattress.

5ad1f44fbf5c5547e764bc0ff5eb7ee101b6fe30.sourceText: 乔布斯之后，2013年起，《财富》一美元年薪领袖排行榜上将会再度增添一位重量级人物。他在哈佛主修心理学，从小沉迷于计算机编程。他的公司从餐桌上起步，团队中的每个成员都是富有创造性才能的聪明人。他们一起寻求改变现状的方法。他们是室友，是合伙人。他们给空虚的社交编织了一张让无数人为之疯狂的网。他是扎克伯格。他的脸谱在短短不到一年时间便横扫美国校园。
5ad1f44fbf5c5547e764bc0ff5eb7ee101b6fe30.translatedText: After Steve Jobs, starting from 2013, Fortune will add another heavyweight to the list of leaders with annual salary of one dollar. He majored in psychology at Harvard and was obsessed with computer programming since childhood. His company started from the kitchen table, and every member of the team is a smart person with creative talents. Together they seek ways to make a difference. They are roommates and partners. They weave a web of empty social life that drives countless people crazy. He is Zuckerberg. His Facebook page spread across American campuses in less than a year.

1b57ee002dd20d5de883a9bd69be010f29c2125f.sourceText: 这个不平凡的开年，动荡的末日宣言沸沸扬扬方兴未艾，迎来了全球资本市场最瞩目最具轰炸性的热门新闻-美国第一社交网站facebook在2月2日向美国证券交易委员会正式递交首次公开募股申请。市值预期达千亿美元，计划融资50亿美元，是有史以来规模最大的网络公司IPO之一。一时间，2012年毫无争议的被定格为facebook的IPO之年。人们开始采用新的碎片化方式进行思考、沟通、探索和研究。有人将今天的facebook与昨天的google相比，有人回忆起95年网景IPO拉开的火爆大幕，还有人联想到2001年投资过热导致的股市崩盘厖究竟此举能为未来的科技产业及广告产业带来哪些影响？是否能为加州的财政收入带来超额增长？是否可能引发多种资产市场的新一轮牛市？又或者像业内分析人士所说，成为一个真实存在的、却即将破裂的巨大泡沫
1b57ee002dd20d5de883a9bd69be010f29c2125f.translatedText: In this extraordinary beginning of the year, turbulent doomsday declarations are in the ascendant, ushering in the most eye-catching and bombshell hot news in the global capital market - Facebook, the first social networking site in the United States, officially submitted an initial public offering application to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on February 2. The market value is expected to reach 100 billion U.S. dollars, and it plans to raise 5 billion U.S. dollars. It is one of the largest Internet company IPOs in history. For a time, 2012 was undoubtedly designated as the year of Facebook’s IPO. People are beginning to adopt new fragmented ways of thinking, communicating, exploring, and researching. Some people compare today's Facebook with yesterday's Google, some recall the explosive Netscape IPO in 1995, and others think of the stock market crash caused by overheated investment in 2001. What impact will this move have on the future technology industry and advertising industry? Can it bring excess growth to California’s fiscal revenue? Is it possible to trigger a new bull market in multiple asset markets? Or, as industry analysts say, it will become a real huge bubble that is about to burst

9fb57acde97ce39f340b9cec424c68546dab468a.sourceText: 无论如何，facebook独特的商业模式的确备受投资商青睐。尽管争议此起彼伏，其创始人马克 扎克伯格的创业历程仍然成为争相转载的、最火爆的话题之一。回想起去年第68届美国电视电影金球奖在好莱坞的饕餮盛宴，以马克 扎克伯格创办facebook为原型的电影《社交网络》斩获三个重量级奖项，成为该界金球奖最大赢家。有评论说这部电影的最大问题是：”它在真实和戏剧化之间的取舍显得非常的艰难和保守，它并非彻头彻尾的虚构，但你很难说这部电影是在纪实”。如果一部作品让你看过后不断的自我审视和反省，它无疑是成功的。究竟扎克伯格针对用户导向型互联网公司有着怎样的创业初衷？是真如影片中’冲冠一怒为红颜’吗？他的创业史能够是否值得全球同龄人借鉴？
9fb57acde97ce39f340b9cec424c68546dab468a.translatedText: In any case, Facebook's unique business model is indeed favored by investors. Despite the constant controversies, the entrepreneurial journey of its founder Mark Zuckerberg has still become one of the most popular topics for reprinting. Recalling the feast of the 68th American TV and Movie Golden Globe Awards in Hollywood last year, the movie "The Social Network" based on Mark Zuckerberg's founding of Facebook won three heavyweight awards and became the biggest winner of the Golden Globe Awards in the industry. One reviewer said that the biggest problem with this movie is: "Its choice between reality and dramatization seems very difficult and conservative. It is not completely fictional, but you can hardly say that this movie is a documentary." If a work makes you constantly examine and reflect on yourself after watching it, it is undoubtedly a success. What is Zuckerberg’s original intention for starting a user-oriented Internet company? Is it really like in the movie where 'a beauty becomes a beauty in anger'? Is his entrepreneurial history worth learning from his peers around the world?

ac142cd882e48eb937b4eceab3122d8964ab59c4.sourceText: 一月止赎通知数据上升 （亚省时报） 尽管一月份的止赎通知比12月份上升了14%，但数据仍比一年前低。 止赎追踪公司RealtyTrac说，一月份本州有4400家庭收到止赎通知，但实际银行收回4350家。这些数字比去年同期下降44%。 内华达州是全国止赎率最高，每198幢房子有一幢接到止赎通知，加州第二，亚利桑那州第三，每325家住宅或公寓有一家接到止赎通知。 尽管如此，这一消息对亚利桑那州来说相当不错。RealtyTrac说，2011年最后两个月，接受止赎申请的有4300家左右。去年最高数字是一个月内有7500家。
ac142cd882e48eb937b4eceab3122d8964ab59c4.translatedText: Foreclosure notification data rises in January (Alberta Times) Although foreclosure notifications in January were up 14 per cent from December, the data were still lower than a year ago. Foreclosure tracking company RealtyTrac said 4,400 homes in the state received foreclosure notices in January, but banks actually repossessed 4,350 of them. These figures are down 44% from the same period last year. Nevada has the highest foreclosure rate in the country, with one in every 198 homes receiving a foreclosure notice, California is second, and Arizona is third, with one in every 325 homes or apartments receiving a foreclosure notice. Still, the news is pretty good for Arizona. RealtyTrac said that in the last two months of 2011, about 4,300 properties accepted foreclosure applications. The highest number last year was 7,500 in one month.

74d9ae9d623c3e8be2525192faccca129ba3ae3e.sourceText: 一度是各州扫荡非法移民先锋的亚利桑那州，现在显示出对此议题态度已软化的迹象。 本州的企业、民间团体和宗教领袖1月公布了一项原则声明，称为「亚利桑那协议」(Arizona Accord)，呼吁该州对非法移民采取新的策略，并提出移民对经济的贡献，主张配合 联邦，而非该州的解决方案，反对导致家庭离散的政策，赞成包容性的文化。 迄今包括大凤凰城经济协会、亚利桑那农业委员会、数个大建设公司和农业机构的执行长都签署了此协议。 州议员去年提出数项进一步限制移民的法案都未被通过，企业界的游说扮演了重要的角色。 2010年通过严苛的反非法移民法，把无证移民定为罪犯，并要求警察查问人们的移民身分。 这个法律的主要条款被联邦法院禁止执行，联邦最高法院定4月对此法律进行审查。 本州的反非法移民法引起阿拉巴马等其他州的仿效。 但在去年11月，反非法移民法的推手、州参议会主席皮尔斯被罢免，在罢免选举中，主张较不具对抗性移民政策的路易斯当选。 一些过去赞成此法律的州议员，现在都改口，称此法律没有建设性。 在上一届州议会会期中，有五项反非法移民法案未被通过，而在本会期一开始的1月30日，九位共和党议员共同提出法案，把2007年一项惩罚雇用非法 移民雇主的法案加以软化，即对使用联邦电子身分认证系统(E-Verify)查核雇员移民身分的雇主提供保护，根据现行法，即使使用了该认证系统，在不知情的情形下雇用非法移民的雇主 ，仍有可能被刑事起诉。 州长珍布鲁尔的发言人班森也表示，目前移民议题不需要太多关注，「州长的观点认为，亚州人民期望州长致力保障边界安全，和推动改善经济」。 企业领袖说，在2010年的反非法移民法通过后，本州重要的观光和会议业受到重创，许多预定的活动被取消。 亚利桑那商会主席哈莫说，今年与过去数年不同，在商会最近与州民选官员举行的年度立法预测餐会中，移民一词并未被提出，「讨论的焦点是本州应该做什么来改善经济 」。
74d9ae9d623c3e8be2525192faccca129ba3ae3e.translatedText: Arizona, once a pioneer in states' crackdown on illegal immigration, is now showing signs of softening its attitude towards this issue. The state's business, civil society and religious leaders released a statement of principles in January, called the Arizona Accord, calling for the state to adopt a new approach to illegal immigration, highlighting the economic contribution of immigrants, advocating for federal rather than state solutions, opposing policies that separate families and favoring a culture of inclusion. Signatories so far include the Greater Phoenix Economic Association, the Arizona Agriculture Commission, several major construction companies and the CEOs of agricultural agencies. Several bills proposed by state lawmakers last year to further restrict immigration were unsuccessful, with lobbying from the business community playing an important role. A tough anti-illegal immigration law was passed in 2010, criminalizing undocumented immigrants and requiring police to ask people about their immigration status. Major provisions of the law have been blocked by a federal court, and the Supreme Court has scheduled a review of the law in April. The state's anti-illegal immigration laws have inspired other states, including Alabama, to follow suit. But in November last year, state Senate Chairman Pierce, the promoter of the anti-illegal immigration law, was recalled. In the recall election, Lewis, who advocated a less confrontational immigration policy, was elected. Some state lawmakers who supported the law in the past have now changed their tune, saying the law is unconstructive. In the last session of the state Legislature, five anti-illegal immigration bills were not passed. On January 30, at the beginning of this session, nine Republican congressmen co-sponsored a bill to soften a 2007 bill that punished employers for hiring illegal immigrants, that is, to provide protection for employers who use the federal electronic identity verification system (E-Verify) to check the immigration status of employees. According to current law, even if this verification system is used, employers who unknowingly hire illegal immigrants may still be criminally prosecuted. Governor Jean Brewer's spokesperson Benson also said that the immigration issue does not require much attention at the moment. "The governor's view is that the people of Asia expect the governor to be committed to ensuring border security and promoting an improved economy." Business leaders say the state's important tourism and convention industries were hit hard after the 2010 anti-illegal immigration law was passed, with many scheduled events canceled. Hamer, president of the Arizona Chamber of Commerce, said that this year is different from past years. At the chamber's recent annual legislative forecast dinner with state elected officials, the word immigration was not brought up. "The focus of the discussion was what the state should do to improve the economy."

b7388826db52ee958e4a67c267c2cb26346ec48c.sourceText: 据警方消息，上周发生的谋杀案基本定案，是一场婚外情引起的情杀案。 31岁的丹尼尔格里菲斯和30岁的珍妮弗格里菲斯，和受害人是格兰岱尔一个社区的邻居。 珍妮弗和爱德华阿吉雷出轨，发生婚外情，被丈夫丹尼尔发现。 珍妮弗承认，2月7日晚，珍妮弗以邀请阿吉雷做爱为幌，把受害人骗到她家，因为她丈夫想”吓唬”阿吉雷。 但结果丹尼尔开枪杀害了奸夫。 珍妮弗帮助丈夫被阿吉雷运往西部沙漠，然后倒上汽油，放火焚尸。 阿吉雷的妻子不见丈夫踪影后报警，警探开始研究他的手机记录和银行账户活动，很快把犯罪嫌疑人锁定在格里菲斯夫妇身上。 上周五上午，受害人的遗体被发现在白坦克山下。 丹尼尔格里菲斯被控涉嫌一级谋杀和藏尸罪，以100万美元担保，珍妮弗格里菲斯被控涉嫌抛尸和藏尸、篡改证据罪，以9万美元担保。
b7388826db52ee958e4a67c267c2cb26346ec48c.translatedText: According to police sources, the murder case that occurred last week has been basically confirmed as a love killing caused by an extramarital affair. Daniel Griffith, 31, and Jennifer Griffith, 30, were neighbors of the victim in a Glendale neighborhood. Jennifer cheated on her with Edward Aguirre and had an extramarital affair, which was discovered by her husband Daniel. Jennifer admitted that on the evening of February 7, Jennifer tricked the victim into coming to her house under the guise of inviting Aguirre to have sex because her husband wanted to "scare" Aguirre. But Daniel shot and killed the adulterer. Jennifer helped her husband be transported to the Western Desert by Aguirre, where he poured gasoline and set his body on fire. Aguirre's wife called the police after missing her husband. Detectives began studying his mobile phone records and bank account activities, and soon locked the suspects on the Griffiths. The victim's body was found at the foot of White Tank Mountain last Friday morning. Daniel Griffith was charged with first-degree murder and hiding a corpse, and was held on a $1 million bond. Jennifer Griffith was charged with dumping and hiding a body, and tampering with evidence, and was held on a $90,000 bond.

Don’t think wrongly...

617b39d25be8fdf18f1b7112544ea85adb4a9519.sourceText: 经济不景 出售身体部分成大生意 （亚省时报） 近年经济不景，很多人把出售自己身体部分当做赚钱的方式。别想歪了哦，不是卖淫。 斯科思岱尔的迪森卖过自己的头发，他说，头发的价钱7年来一直在长，$1200,$1500,甚至$2000。不信，可以上网看看： www.buyandsellhair.com 。 当然，头发不是我们身上唯一可舍得又值钱的东西。有私人经营的血液中心，以每次$35至$50 购买你的血浆或血小板。如果你符合资格，卖血可以每两星期一次。 还有一些医疗机构提供有偿试药，有偿捐精，至少可以拿100元，捐卵拿得更多，$3500到$5000不等。 总之，没有你想不到的，只有你不想买的，信不？
617b39d25be8fdf18f1b7112544ea85adb4a9519.translatedText: Economic downturn, selling body parts has become a big business (Alberta Times) In recent years, when the economy has been in recession, many people have turned to selling their body parts as a way to make money. Don't get me wrong, it's not prostitution. Deason, who sells his own hair in Scosdale, said the price of his hair has been increasing over the past seven years, ranging from $1,200 to $1,500 to even $2,000. If you don’t believe it, you can check it out online: www.buyandsellhair.com. Of course, hair is not the only valuable thing we have. There are privately run blood centers that can purchase your plasma or platelets for $35 to $50 a time. If you qualify, you can sell blood every two weeks. There are also some medical institutions that offer paid trial medicine, paid sperm donation, and you can get at least 100 yuan, and egg donation can get more, ranging from $3,500 to $5,000. In short, there is nothing you can’t think of, only things you don’t want to buy, believe it or not?

3164140c82de46177fd1d7d7211e77527c5dc271.translatedText: New regulations for H-2B visas, AirPlus benefits domestic and foreign workers (Alberta Times) The U.S. Department of Labor announced new regulations for H-2B visas last Friday (10th), influenced by...

88d26aba595d1301675ae4cd656dfaf11576d254.sourceText: 美国劳工部在上周五（10日）公布H-2B签证的新规定，受到外籍劳工和支持新法规人士的欢迎，赞同新法的人认为届时雇主将无法剥削外劳，同时也无法利用外劳 削减美国劳工的工作机会。 H-2B是发给来美从事非农业性、临时技术及非技术性工作人员的外国籍劳工签证。 美国劳工部将于今年4月23日，实施新H-2B签证规定，以维护外籍劳工权益，同时保护美国劳工不致受到旧H-2B签证的冲击，失去就业机会。 但美国雇主则普遍不看好新法规，认为新规定将拉长申请外劳工作签证的程序，无法及时满足季节性雇用劳工的需求，最终将降低外籍劳工在美国的工作机会。 提供季节性工作者多为渔业、海鲜处理、游乐园、旅馆、庭园工程等中小企业，这些行业的雇主是申请H-2B外籍劳工签证的主要申请者。 根据新规定，雇主必须透过劳工部建立的电子传输登记网站，上网登记需要H-2B签证的外劳工作项目及人数。 但雇主在上网登记申请H-2B签证的3周前，必须先应征适任的美国劳工，优先提供美国劳工就业机会。 过去雇主为外劳申请H-2B签证时，仅须在申请文件上简要说明，已对外征求美国劳工；但现在依法规定，雇主应向当地的州劳务管理局(State Workforce Agency)提出证明，证实 无法找到美国劳工，才能申请H-2B签证。 在保护外籍劳工方面，新规定要求雇主应支付外劳来美的50%交通费用，如果外劳已履行雇聘合同中的所有工作，或是遭雇主提前解雇，雇主应支付外劳返国的 交通费及签证费。 此外，新H-2B签证法规定，雇主应事先支付至少四分之三的雇用期薪资给外劳，既使在雇用期间无工作提供给外劳。 这项规定亦是最令美国雇主反弹和认为不合理的项目。
88d26aba595d1301675ae4cd656dfaf11576d254.translatedText: The U.S. Department of Labor announced new regulations for H-2B visas last Friday (10th), which were welcomed by foreign workers and those who support the new regulations. People who agree with the new law believe that employers will not be able to exploit foreign workers, and at the same time, they will not be able to use foreign workers to reduce job opportunities for American workers. H-2B is a foreign labor visa issued to people who come to the United States to engage in non-agricultural, temporary technical and unskilled work. The U.S. Department of Labor will implement new H-2B visa regulations on April 23 this year to safeguard the rights and interests of foreign workers and protect American workers from being impacted by the old H-2B visa and losing employment opportunities. However, U.S. employers are generally not optimistic about the new regulations, believing that the new regulations will lengthen the application process for foreign workers’ work visas, fail to meet the demand for seasonal workers in a timely manner, and will ultimately reduce the job opportunities for foreign workers in the United States. Seasonal workers are mostly provided by small and medium-sized enterprises such as fisheries, seafood processing, amusement parks, hotels, and gardening projects. Employers in these industries are the main applicants for H-2B foreign worker visas. According to the new regulations, employers must register online the work items and number of foreign workers who require H-2B visas through the electronic transmission registration website established by the Ministry of Labor. However, employers must first recruit qualified American workers three weeks before registering online to apply for an H-2B visa, and give priority to providing employment opportunities to American workers. In the past, when employers applied for H-2B visas for foreign workers, they only had to briefly state on the application documents that they were seeking American workers; but now, according to the law, employers must provide proof to the local State Workforce Agency to prove that they cannot find American workers before they can apply for an H-2B visa. In terms of protecting foreign workers, the new regulations require employers to pay 50% of the transportation costs for foreign workers to come to the United States. If the foreign workers have performed all the work in the employment contract or are fired early by the employer, the employer should pay the transportation costs and visa fees for the foreign workers to return to the country. In addition, the new H-2B visa law stipulates that employers should pay in advance at least three-quarters of the salary of the foreign worker during the employment period, even if there is no job to provide the foreign worker during the employment period. This requirement is also the item that American employers have the most backlash against and consider unreasonable.

ac2203906d285a9b1d93780c60f6403dc6dec05c.sourceText: iPhone4信号差 苹果赔偿美国用户每人15元(图)
ac2203906d285a9b1d93780c60f6403dc6dec05c.translatedText: iPhone 4 signal is poor, Apple compensates each American user 15 yuan (picture)

aa93267794a960f94c5f900fd26bade7243fb70b.sourceText: iPhone4信号差 苹果赔偿美国用户每人15元(图) 科技新闻网站CNET20日引述苹果声明报导，…
aa93267794a960f94c5f900fd26bade7243fb70b.translatedText: iPhone 4 signal is poor, Apple compensates each American user 15 yuan (picture) Technology news website CNET quoted an Apple statement on the 20th,...

d6bd74516a93f210993536121aa5ae3af175077f.sourceText: 科技新闻网站CNET20日引述苹果声明报导，苹果已就iPhone 4收讯问题的集体诉讼案，与美国消费者达成和解。iPhone 4美国用户将获得15美元赔偿或一具免费外壳。
d6bd74516a93f210993536121aa5ae3af175077f.translatedText: Technology news website CNET quoted an Apple statement on the 20th and reported that Apple has reached a settlement with American consumers in a class action lawsuit over iPhone 4 reception issues. US iPhone 4 users will receive $15 in compensation or a free case.

3f9356894008656e3153a363bf0cfe5190a14829.sourceText: 苹果2010年6月推出的iPhone 4因收讯问题，不断遭客户抱怨。苹果指出，iPhone 4的天线包覆于外壳边缘，而用户使用时常握住手机左下角，减弱银色边缘的收讯强度，是问题癥结所在。
3f9356894008656e3153a363bf0cfe5190a14829.translatedText: The iPhone 4 launched by Apple in June 2010 has been constantly complained by customers due to reception problems. Apple pointed out that the iPhone 4's antenna is wrapped around the edge of the case, and users often hold the lower left corner of the phone during use, which weakens the signal reception intensity at the silver edge, which is the crux of the problem.

d0c9153a5af1a6072e6c1d67f52e0505aa170550.sourceText: 若大幅减少或移除iPhone 4的外壳，问题就能大幅改善。去年10月上市的iPhone 4S未产生类似问题。
d0c9153a5af1a6072e6c1d67f52e0505aa170550.translatedText: If the iPhone 4 case is significantly reduced or removed, the problem can be greatly improved. The iPhone 4S, which was launched in October last year, did not have similar problems.

42813c398818b183b89d546688ce317c59f4b0cf.sourceText: 苹果最初忽略用户抱怨；接著由时任执行长贾柏斯在记者会宣布以免费外壳为补偿，并宣称其他厂牌手机也有相同问题。
42813c398818b183b89d546688ce317c59f4b0cf.translatedText: Apple initially ignored user complaints; then CEO Steve Jobs announced at a press conference that it would provide free cases as compensation, and claimed that other brands of mobile phones had the same problem.

aadb6de3eddffa996c378f31791d578d29ecf62b.sourceText: 苹果说：「这次和解主要针对少数遭遇收讯问题，且2010年不愿接受免费外壳作为补偿的iPhone 4使用者。」
aadb6de3eddffa996c378f31791d578d29ecf62b.translatedText: Apple said: "This settlement is mainly aimed at the small number of iPhone 4 users who encountered reception problems and were unwilling to accept free cases as compensation in 2010."

d11374269ce27785cdcd0aa8864dfcd1c595bf05.sourceText: CNET指出，符合资格的用户4月将收到苹果的电子邮件，并有120天时间申请15美元的赔偿。苹果也已建立相关网站，但尚未启用。
d11374269ce27785cdcd0aa8864dfcd1c595bf05.translatedText: CNET pointed out that eligible users will receive an email from Apple in April and have 120 days to apply for $15 in compensation. Apple has also established a related website, but it has not yet been launched.

715b45cfea0b1f46cfbe85b578926dd8e42d0e2c.sourceText: 但负责此案的律师罗斯肯表示，逾2,100万名iPhone 4用户都有资格获得赔偿，并指出苹果当时仅提供免费外壳三个月。他说：「我们相信苹果处理iPhone 4问题的方式公平、适当且合理。」
715b45cfea0b1f46cfbe85b578926dd8e42d0e2c.translatedText: But Lusken, the lawyer in charge of the case, said that more than 21 million iPhone 4 users are eligible for compensation, and pointed out that Apple only provided free cases for three months at the time. He said: "We believe that Apple's handling of the iPhone 4 issue is fair, appropriate and reasonable."

a60093896b0b6ffdcea6c41ce56fc357dc00cc3e.sourceText: 另外，日本部落格Macotakara20日引述消息人士报导，继去年10月苹果推出iPhone 4S后，iPhone 5也将于今年9或10月问世，未来数年也将在秋季发表新iPhone。
a60093896b0b6ffdcea6c41ce56fc357dc00cc3e.translatedText: In addition, Japanese blog Macotakara quoted sources on the 20th as reporting that after Apple launched the iPhone 4S in October last year, the iPhone 5 will also be released in September or October this year, and new iPhones will be released in the fall in the next few years.

fb27e6ecbc8fe7b69a03f8066d6457ba1a53c19a.sourceText: 秋季发表新iPhone能使苹果赶上年底的销售旺季，去年第四季苹果iPhone销售创3,700万支的新纪录。
fb27e6ecbc8fe7b69a03f8066d6457ba1a53c19a.translatedText: The release of new iPhones in the fall will allow Apple to catch up with the peak sales season at the end of the year. Apple's iPhone sales in the fourth quarter of last year hit a new record of 37 million units.

d199aae6560138437f2f03705cc0c5a9c7c82a06.translatedText: Valley Metro buses face cuts this summer (Alberta Times) Valley Metro buses are planning to reduce services this summer, including closing...

3de47341d6bfaf46561ee863e32269ecf8c564dc.sourceText: 谷都会（Valley Metro）巴士正计划在今夏减少服务，包括关闭或精简东谷特快路线。 该机构面临1.37亿美元的赤字削减，预计关闭9个特快线路，影响美莎、钱特勒和坦佩乘客。 其中一个是540路线，从钱特勒的Ray和Dobson路开往凤凰城市中心，另一个是美莎的Power路和Decatur街，目的地也是凤凰城市中心。 其他大多数快线将根据乘客数量缩短或关闭。 谷都会发言人苏珊蒂尔尼说：”我们非常期待精简整个特快路线系统，同时也希望得到乘客的反馈。”谷都会将于3月9日下午6时在美莎城市广场举行听证会， 听取公众意见后作最终决定。 市民也可以通过email反映意见，email地址： input@valleymetro.org 。
3de47341d6bfaf46561ee863e32269ecf8c564dc.translatedText: Valley Metro buses are planning to reduce services this summer, including closing or streamlining East Valley Express routes. The agency faces a $137 million deficit reduction and expects to close nine express routes, affecting passengers in Metsa, Chandler and Tempe. One is the 540 route, which runs from Ray and Dobson roads in Chandler to downtown Phoenix, and the other is from Power Road and Decatur Street in Mesa, also heading to downtown Phoenix. Most other express lines will be shortened or closed depending on ridership. Valley Metropolis spokesperson Susan Tierney said: "We are very much looking forward to streamlining the entire express route system and also hope to get feedback from passengers." Valley Metropolis will hold a hearing at 6 p.m. on March 9 at Methammer City Plaza to listen to public comments before making a final decision. Citizens can also express their opinions via email, email address: input@valleymetro.org.

61a51d387f08e015d102b4af341d043532b226c6.sourceText: 安微荷哈特（Ann Weaver Hart）博士为亚利桑那大学下任校长 （亚省时报） 亚利桑那州高教委员会2月17日宣布，位于图森的亚利桑那大学，选定安微荷哈特（Ann Weaver Hart）博士为下任校长。 哈特博士，曾任费城的天普大学校长，是天普大学，也是亚利桑那大学历史上第一位女校长。她将于今年7月1日到任。
61a51d387f08e015d102b4af341d043532b226c6.translatedText: Dr. Ann Weaver Hart is the next president of the University of Arizona (Alberta Times) The Arizona Higher Education Commission announced on February 17 that the University of Arizona in Tucson has selected Dr. Ann Weaver Hart as its next president. Dr. Hart, former president of Temple University in Philadelphia, was the first female president in the history of Temple University and the University of Arizona. She will take office on July 1 this year.

cdc1631b5a58a536a3480a7e9e9bab82dad69d6c.translatedText: The day with the most discounts... Wednesday (Alberta Times) Saving money is often related to timing. For example, which day of the week is the easiest to save money? The answer is at least four things...

d36545d0c8a6c1629279d2067820df882b601145.sourceText: 省钱往往和时机有关，例如一个星期中哪天最容易省钱？ 答案是至少在四样东西上，星期三通常是折扣最多的一天。 加油： 业界专家说，星期三早上加油最好，每加仑可以省下约五分钱。 他们说，许多加油站周三清晨价钱下调几分钱，然后周四早上调上去。 比较高的价位会持续到周末，因为周末出游需要加油的人较多。 买菜： MyGroceryDeals.com专家说，全国约有一半超级市场在周三更新每周减价内容。 虽然减价维持好几天，但是折扣人人抢，所以不要等到周四、周五再去，星期三就买回来。 网上买衣： 线上免费个人购物指南Shop It To Me做了一份研究，针对2010年6月1日到2011年6月1日期间打折扣的34万件女性商品统计，得出周三的女士和儿童商品折扣约40 %，是一周减价最多的一天。 飞机票： 航空公司之间的机票价格战通常周五开打，但是到周三价位通常不能再低。 更准确一点说，星期三凌晨1时据信是最好出手买机票的时间点。 「旅行侦探」 (The Travel Detective)一书作者彼得葛林柏格(Peter Greenberg)的说法是，到了午夜，航空公司会把前一天宣布的降价机票价钱更新到电脑上，这时候消费者的动作要快 ，因为通常24小时后降价就失效了。
d36545d0c8a6c1629279d2067820df882b601145.translatedText: Saving money is often related to timing. For example, which day of the week is the easiest to save money? The answer is on at least four items, with Wednesday usually being the day with the biggest discounts. Fill up on gas: Industry experts say it's best to fill up on Wednesday morning and save about a nickel a gallon. They said many gas stations dropped prices by a few cents early Wednesday morning and then raised them Thursday morning. The higher prices will continue into the weekends because more people need to refuel during weekend trips. Grocery shopping: Experts at MyGroceryDeals.com say about half of the country's supermarkets update their weekly sales on Wednesday. Although the sale lasts for several days, everyone is grabbing the discount, so don’t wait until Thursday or Friday to buy it on Wednesday. Buying clothes online: Shop It To Me, an online free personal shopping guide, conducted a study based on statistics on 340,000 women's products that were discounted between June 1, 2010 and June 1, 2011. It was concluded that women's and children's products were discounted by about 40% on Wednesday, which is the day with the most price reductions in a week. Air tickets: Air ticket price wars between airlines usually start on Friday, but prices usually can't get any lower by Wednesday. To be more precise, 1 a.m. on Wednesday is believed to be the best time to buy air tickets. According to Peter Greenberg, author of "The Travel Detective," at midnight, airlines will update the computer with the price reductions announced the day before. Consumers need to act quickly at this time, because price reductions usually expire after 24 hours.

015e94eda0b7810cad3190689fdd5dac9a9d1f1b.sourceText: 联邦疾病防治中心(CDC)7日公布一项惊人发现指出，面包和面卷(rolls)类面粉制食品已成为美国饮食中盐分来源最多的食物，钠含量甚至比马铃薯片等垃圾食物超出两倍 。 报告同时指出，美国人平均钠消耗量超过2300毫克的标准，仅十分之一美国人符合每日食用一茶匙盐的标准。 CDC在报告中列出钠含量十大食物来源，其中含盐零食事实上仅敬陪末座。 CDC主任费和平表示：「马铃薯片、椒盐脆饼(Pretzel)和爆米花这类我们认为含盐最多的食物，仅排名第十。」 共同完成该报告的CDC资深科学家科格斯威尔表示，面包和面卷类点心并非含盐量真正超过其他许多食物，而在于民众吃得比较多。 盐是大多数人摄取钠的主要来源，但钠会增加高血压的风险，并成为心脏病和中风的主因。 卫生官员表示，大多数美国人都吃太多盐了，其中大部分来自加工和餐馆的食物，而非自己添加。 虽然专家过去已掌握面包和其他某些食物的钠含量，会积少成多，但却未料到仅十种食物即占钠吸取量的44%。 CDC指出，面包和面卷类点心在美国人每日平均食用的盐量，约占7%；其他含盐较多的食物，包括冷肉、腌肉、披萨、新鲜和加工家禽类、汤 类，以及速食类的汉堡、三明治和起士。 根据饮食指南的建议，每天消耗的钠不应超过2300毫克，亦即约一茶匙盐；有些高血压患者的食用量应更少。 不过，该研究也发现，美国人平均钠消耗量约3300毫克。
015e94eda0b7810cad3190689fdd5dac9a9d1f1b.translatedText: ) The federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) announced a surprising finding on the 7th that flour-based foods such as bread and rolls have become the largest source of salt in the American diet, with sodium content even more than twice that of junk foods such as potato chips. The report also pointed out that the average sodium consumption of Americans exceeds the standard of 2,300 milligrams, and only one tenth of Americans meets the standard of consuming one teaspoon of salt per day. The CDC lists the top ten food sources of sodium in the report, and salty snacks are actually only at the bottom. "Potato chips, pretzels and popcorn, which we consider to be the most salty foods, only rank tenth," said CDC Director Fei Heping. Cogswell, a senior CDC scientist who co-authored the report, said it's not that bread and roll snacks actually contain more salt than many other foods, but that people eat more. Salt is the main source of sodium for most people, but sodium increases the risk of high blood pressure and is a major cause of heart disease and stroke. Health officials say most Americans eat too much salt, most of which comes from processed and restaurant foods rather than adding it themselves. Although experts have known in the past that the sodium content of bread and other certain foods can add up, they did not expect that just ten foods account for 44% of sodium intake. According to the CDC, bread and roll snacks account for about 7% of the average daily salt consumption of Americans; other foods with high salt content include cold meats, cured meats, pizza, fresh and processed poultry, soups, and fast-food burgers, sandwiches and cheese. Dietary guidelines recommend that you should consume no more than 2,300 milligrams of sodium per day, or about a teaspoon of salt; some people with high blood pressure should consume less. However, the study also found that the average American consumes about 3,300 milligrams of sodium.

f6acbf9d349a9daa443e0c1649c111fa01702b13.sourceText: 凤凰城房地产市场的健康迹象 凤凰城房地产的价格在这一年里，市民一直期待的迅速上涨终于发生了，这是房屋市场重新恢复的信号。 大凤凰城区房屋的中值价格在过去一年中上涨了30%。可供销售的房屋降到了六年内的低点，很多房子都同时收到大量的买单，其中很多来自投资者。 这些情况似乎和之前的房屋泡沫时期很像，但是房屋分析师说情况完全不同。 在2005年和2006年房屋疯涨是受投资者驱动的。房屋中值价格是在狂跌65%之前，暴涨了50%。但最近的市场，很多事实表明价格是有根据的上涨，不会是又一轮的泡沫。例如，信贷资格的加强， 随着价格上涨，投资者的减少，传统的买家和卖家成为市场的主体。 有一点可以马上证明房屋市场不是过热，那就是玛丽库帕郡房屋的中值价格在六月份少于1%。这是由于上市房屋短缺，推动价格走高，也已开始让很多投资者减少购买。 如果待售房屋的供应量开始增加，被压抑的需求仍会推高房价，在未来的几个月中，会以一个适度的速度上涨。 ”房地产市场是健康的，没有过热，”亚利桑那州立大学商学院，房地产分析师迈克?#22885;尔凯说。 现在与房地产泡沫时期的市场不同 买家与卖家交易的房屋类型都不相同。现在很少买家能够满足贷款的要求，大部分卖家是欠银行太多钱而不是通过卖房挣钱。 在地产泡沫时期，几乎没有市场的限制，房屋贷款非常容易，对贷款者的偿还能力没有评估，这些都使得市场完全失去控制。大部分投资者都是放很少的现金，甚至不放任何现金买房，这些事实都导致最后现金流的奔溃。泡沫时期，房屋几个上涨为每个月４％到７％，几乎没有破产屋。在２０１２年２月到５月，房屋上涨大约是每个月５％， ６月开始放缓。 奥尔凯说凤凰城房屋价格的上涨是因为投资者对低价屋的购买而驱动的。这不意味着所有的业主都看到了房屋价值的上升。 相反是大部分业主看到１０％到２０％的房屋价值的上升。 目前所有的热点都基于低价屋 在过去两年，低价屋主宰了整个市场，２００９年占到市场的７５％。相比之下，在泡沫时期是新房子占领了大部分市场。２０１１年８月投资者的市场是在１１２０００美元以下的房子。尽管在去年一年当中，凤凰城房地产价格已经上升，投资者购买房屋的中值是在１４６０００美元，这相当于２００３年５月，泡沫时期之前的价格。 投资者的不同 现在导致凤凰城房地产价格上涨是大量的投资公司和小的买家付现金购买破产屋和短售屋，他们都是长期投资者。房屋泡沫时期，大部分都是贷款投资，他们看到房地产不行了，就走人，几乎没有什么损失。随着价格的上涨和破产屋的减少，投资者会减少，可是他们用现金投资的房屋会比较稳定。 更多信号显示市场会恢复 传统的房屋销售会与市场的恢复相联系。因为市场需求在未来几个月中还会持续上升。大部分2003年以前买的房子都会有机会挣钱，再次上市。今年30％的升值幅度是不可持续的….但房屋升值将继续，因为需求仍然存在。更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的Tinna(480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
f6acbf9d349a9daa443e0c1649c111fa01702b13.translatedText: Signs of health in the real estate market in Phoenix During this year, the rapid rise in real estate prices in Phoenix that citizens have been looking forward to has finally happened. This is a sign that the housing market has re-opened. The median price of homes in the greater Phoenix area has increased 30% in the past year. The number of homes available for sale is at a six-year low, with many homes receiving a flood of offers, many from investors. These conditions may seem similar to previous housing bubbles, but housing analysts say the situation is completely different. The housing boom in 2005 and 2006 was driven by investors. The median home price surged by 50% before plummeting by 65%. But in the recent market, many facts show that the price rise is well-founded and will not be another round of bubbles. For example, credit qualifications strengthen, as prices rise, investors decrease, and traditional buyers and sellers become the main body of the market. One thing that immediately proves the housing market isn't overheated is that the median price of a home in Maricoopa County was less than 1 percent in June. This is due to a shortage of homes on the market, which is driving prices higher and has begun to discourage many investors from buying. If the supply of homes for sale begins to increase, pent-up demand could still push home prices higher at a modest pace in the coming months. "The housing market is healthy and not overheated," said Mike Erkel, a real estate analyst at Arizona State University's College of Business. Unlike the market during the housing bubble, buyers and sellers are trading on different types of homes. Few buyers these days can meet the loan requirements, and most sellers owe the bank too much money instead of making money from selling their homes. During the real estate bubble, there were almost no market restrictions, home loans were very easy, and there was no assessment of borrowers' ability to repay, which made the market completely out of control. Most investors put down very little cash or even put down no cash to buy a house. These facts lead to the final collapse of cash flow. During the bubble period, housing prices rose by 4% to 7% per month, and almost no houses went bankrupt. From February to May 2012, housing prices rose by approximately 5% per month, and began to slow down in June. Olcay said the increase in Phoenix home prices is driven by investors buying lower-priced homes. That doesn't mean all homeowners are seeing an increase in home values. Instead, most homeowners see a 10% to 20% increase in home value. All the current hot spots are based on low-cost housing. In the past two years, low-cost housing has dominated the entire market, accounting for 75% of the market in 2009. In contrast, during the bubble it was new homes that captured most of the market. The investor market in August 2011 was for homes under $112,000. Although Phoenix real estate prices have risen over the past year, the median price of a home purchased by investors is $146,000, which is equivalent to the pre-bubble price in May 2003. The Difference of Investors What's causing Phoenix real estate prices to rise right now is a large number of investment firms and small buyers paying cash for bankruptcies and short-sales properties, and they're all long-term investors. During the housing bubble, most investments were made with loans. When they saw that real estate was failing, they left with almost no losses. As prices rise and there are fewer bankruptcies, there will be fewer investors, but the homes they invest cash in will be more stable. More Signs the Market Will Recover Traditional home sales will be tied to the market's recovery. Because market demand will continue to rise in the coming months. Most houses bought before 2003 will have the opportunity to make money and be put on the market again. 30% appreciation this year is unsustainable....but home appreciation will continue because the demand is still there. 2261508384556b4597c7e94cd60e77b2e3a1382c.sourceText: 日产汽车公司(NISSAN)正在美国和加拿大召回3万9000辆2012年份的Versa轿车，因为驾驶人如果不踩着煞车，这些小型车的传动系统可能滑出停车档。 召回的汽车是在去年6月9日到今年1月13日出厂，附有自动排档或无段变速自动变速箱，其中有3万6600辆车是在美国售出。 日产致函美国国家公路交通安全管理署(NHTSA)说，由于排档头与变速杆之间的干扰，如不踩住煞车，这些汽车可能滑出停车档。 驾驶人若没有踩住煞车，可能意外使汽车挂上档，并增加撞车或伤及旁边路人的风险。 NHTSA规定驾驶人发动车时必须踩住煞车，才能挂上档。 日产说，Versa的问题还没有造成车祸或受伤的报告。 日产将在近期主动通知车主，为这些汽车免费更换零件，并确保汽车操作正常。 此外，国家公路交通安全管理署(NHTSA)10日说，它正在调查2007年丰田冠美丽(Toyota Camry)轿车和RAV4休旅车驾驶座车门会起火的报告。 这项调查可能影响多达83万辆汽车，不过这些汽车目前尚未召回。
2261508384556b4597c7e94cd60e77b2e3a1382c.translatedText: Nissan Motor Co. (NISSAN) is recalling 39,000 2012 Versa sedans in the United States and Canada because the small car's drivetrain could slip out of park if the driver does not apply the brakes. The recalled cars were manufactured between June 9 last year and January 13 this year and were equipped with automatic transmissions or continuously variable automatic transmissions. 36,600 of them were sold in the United States. Nissan sent a letter to the U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) saying that the cars could slide out of Park if the brakes are not applied due to interference between the shift knob and the gear lever. If the driver fails to apply the brake, he or she may accidentally shift the car into gear, increasing the risk of a crash or injuring bystanders. NHTSA stipulates that drivers must depress the brake when starting the car before they can shift into gear. Nissan said there have been no reports of crashes or injuries caused by the Versa's problems. Nissan will proactively notify car owners in the near future, replace parts for these cars free of charge, and ensure that the cars operate normally. Separately, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said on the 10th that it was investigating reports that the driver's door of the 2007 Toyota Camry sedan and RAV4 SUV could catch fire. The investigation could affect up to 830,000 vehicles, which have not yet been recalled.

76b9fb85bbc662bd156ef92f992c4e91b69917c3.sourceText: 2月25日新东方音乐欣赏讲座-亚省春晚总导演 刘洛宏 时间：2月25日（星期六）7:00pm 地点： 新东方艺术学校 主讲人： 刘洛宏 为提高人们对音乐的欣赏水平，开阔视野，陶冶情操，体会音乐美的享受。我们特地邀请到刘洛宏先生来举办《音乐欣赏》讲座。 刘洛宏先生毕业于中国人民解放军艺术学院（军艺）曾师从世界著名作曲家郭文景（现任中国中央音乐学院作曲系主任）学习作曲。从事艺术创作30年，创作了大量的器乐曲，歌曲及舞蹈音乐，多次在中国各级音乐比赛中获奖，最近的一次是刘先生创作的舞蹈音乐《流动娃》在2011中国中央电视台舞蹈大赛中获得儿童组第一名（金奖）。 刘先生这次着重从音乐的欣赏，音乐知识，乐曲分析结合他本人的音乐作品来提高大家对音乐的兴趣，搭建一个广交音乐朋友的平台。 欢迎热爱和喜欢音乐的朋友踊跃参加，刘先生讲座后，大家有提问和讨论的时间，请转告您的朋友一起来共同欣赏音乐，探讨音乐，共度愉快的周末。
76b9fb85bbc662bd156ef92f992c4e91b69917c3.translatedText: New Oriental Music Appreciation Lecture on February 25th - Liu Luohong, the Chief Director of the Alberta Spring Festival Gala Time: February 25 (Saturday) 7:00pm Venue: New Oriental Art School Speaker: Liu Luohong In order to improve people's appreciation of music, broaden their horizons, cultivate their sentiments, and experience the beauty of music. We specially invited Mr. Liu Luohong to give a lecture on "Music Appreciation". Mr. Liu Luohong graduated from the Chinese People's Liberation Army Art Institute (Military Arts) and studied composition under the world-famous composer Guo Wenjing (currently the director of the Composition Department of the Central Conservatory of Music of China). He has been engaged in artistic creation for 30 years and has created a large number of instrumental music, songs and dance music. He has won many awards in music competitions at all levels in China. The most recent one was the dance music "Flowing Baby" created by Mr. Liu, which won the first place (gold medal) in the children's category in the 2011 China Central Television Dance Competition. This time, Mr. Liu focused on music appreciation, music knowledge, and music analysis combined with his own music works to increase everyone's interest in music and build a platform for making music friends. Friends who love and like music are welcome to participate. After Mr. Liu’s lecture, there will be time for questions and discussions. Please tell your friends to come and enjoy music together, discuss music, and have a happy weekend.

2a0b6f9b2ec1bfc2a02b938b183d31c6d7d2785d.sourceText: 文扬：亚洲崛起，仍是只做不说 看电视新闻，镜头是2月4日慕尼黑安全政策会议期间的”美国、欧洲和亚洲崛起”主题讨论会。美国前国务卿基辛格、参议员麦凯恩、澳大利亚外长陆克文、法国前外长巴尼耶等几个西方国家大佬并排坐着，中间夹着中国外交部副部长张志军。 张副部长低头念稿子，一左一右基辛格和麦凯恩死死紧盯着这位中国人的脸看，如果光看画面不听声音，不知道这是开国际研讨会呢，还是公安局审讯逼供，或大学主考官面试。 中国人又怎么了？ 上网读文字，张副部长的发言，说的是亚洲崛起和西方的关系。崛起，就是暴发的官方用语：不好意思，我最近发了，发得挺大（清清喉咙），这个，呃…我和各位之间的关系需要改变一下了。张副部长的发言就是想说这个。 文章登出来，都是官方的书面语，若翻成大白话：第一、现在世界经济形势不好，多亏了亚洲倾力推动，全亚洲好几十亿人一起奔小康，其中几亿人成了暴发户，这个世界不想大变样也不可能了。第二、亚洲崛起，没什么可大惊小怪的，前几百年全世界都看着西方国家崛起，不是也都认了吗？现在亚洲崛起了，这叫国际力量均衡。第三、最好顺应潮流，承认现实，别不识时务，要想阻拦捣乱，中国生气了没准就来硬的了，要想平等互利，中国高兴了没准还能帮帮你们。 到底是人民共和国，还是厚道，就图个平等不受欺负，图个和睦大家发财，没想称王称霸，更没想反攻倒算。 但国际社会的”公安局”还是不放心，老觉得你中国要闹事；国际社会的”评委会”也不放心，老觉得你中国没学好。这就是慕尼黑安全政策会议上的这一幕：中国政府代表发言时，怎么看都像是面对审讯和考评。 如果不是这么一个姿态呢？如果中国政府不光在实际地位上要求平等，在话语上姿态上也要求平等，你说三道四我道四说三，你盛气凌人我劈头盖脸，你搬弄我的是非我指点你的江山，将会怎样？ 如果中国政府给张志军副部长下指示：发言时要居高临下，走路时要昂首阔步，谈判时要咄咄逼人，毫不留情，用天朝威武把这些靠借钱过日子的蛮夷小国给我压下去！将会怎样？ 其实，这并不是敢不敢的问题，够不够硬的问题，还要不要继续”韬光隐晦”的问题。在我看来，亚洲和中国的崛起，被几个重大的因素共同决定，在相当长时间内还只能是一种只做不说的崛起。 第一、现实是，国际政治舞台上，所有的台词都是西方人编的，你中国人最多是个演员，人家是编剧。演员和编剧吵架，小事还凑合，大事上、最核心的问题上赢不了，除非整个舞台上的台词全换成《左传》、《战国策》，一开口大家都是”郑伯克段于鄢”，”秦兴师临周而求九鼎”。 第二、西方强国的主流话语，并不是随便说说，本质上是全球统治体系的支柱，除了几处直接动武的地方，其他大部分都是靠说来管理。把一些国家稳住是靠说，把一些国家搞乱也是靠说，这些都已经成套，也一直行之有效。除非亚洲和中国就是要把现行国际体系推倒重来，否则还不能直接去拔这根柱子。 第三、东方人的传统，讲究言行一致，谨言慎行，君子一言驷马难追。振振有词和滔滔不绝从来就不是自身文化中的东西。西方政治已经发展到了可以将言和行分开，说和做分开，说完就完不必面对后果。而东方人的政治还没到这一步，跟着学就是自己和自己过不去。 如此看来，在国际舞台上，亚洲人和中国人也许根本就不必去追求雄辩的演讲，振振有词的声明，滔滔不绝的说辞。天天就笨嘴拙舌，就结结巴巴，颠来倒去那几句话，反来复去那几个理，也没什么，只要不耽误做事，不耽误继续崛起，就这样了。 等到亚洲和中国的崛起完全自成体系了，用实践证明了不需要那么多主义，那么多理论，那么多政治说辞，也一样能把国家和人民的事情都办好，东西方就真的趋向平衡了。▊ 2012年2月6日 Jerry Wen Yang Director Chief Editor The United Chinese Press www.ucpnz.com Tel: +64 9 369 7210 Fax: +64 9 369 7201 Level 4 A, 32-34 Mahuhu Cres, City Auckland, New Zealand PO Box 6710 Wellesley, Auckland 1141, New Zealand
2a0b6f9b2ec1bfc2a02b938b183d31c6d7d2785d.translatedText: Wen Yang: The rise of Asia is still a matter of action and not talk. Watching TV news, the scene was the theme discussion of "The Rise of the United States, Europe and Asia" during the Munich Security Policy Conference on February 4. Former U.S. Secretary of State Kissinger, Senator John McCain, Australian Foreign Minister Kevin Rudd, former French Foreign Minister Barnier and other Western bigwigs sat side by side, with Chinese Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs Zhang Zhijun sandwiched in the middle. Vice Minister Zhang lowered his head to read the manuscript, while Kissinger and McCain stared at the Chinese face. If you just looked at the picture without listening to the sound, you would not know whether it was an international seminar, an interrogation by the Public Security Bureau to extract a confession, or an interview with a university examiner. What happened to the Chinese? Reading the text online, Vice Minister Zhang’s speech was about the relationship between the rise of Asia and the West. Rise is the official term for the outbreak: Sorry, I posted it recently, and it was quite loud (clears throat). This, uh... the relationship between me and you needs to change. This is what Vice Minister Zhang said in his speech. The articles published are all official written language. If translated into vernacular: First, the current world economic situation is not good. Thanks to Asia's efforts, billions of people across Asia are working together to become well-off, and hundreds of millions of them have become nouveau riche. It is impossible for the world not to change drastically. Second, the rise of Asia is nothing to make a fuss about. In the past few hundred years, the whole world has watched the rise of Western countries, doesn’t it also recognize it? Now that Asia is rising, this is called the international balance of power. Third, it is best to follow the trend, acknowledge the reality, and do not be ignorant of current affairs. If you want to stop and cause trouble, China may be tough when it gets angry. If you want equality and mutual benefit, China may be able to help you if it is happy. After all, it is a people's republic, and it is still kind. It just wants to be equal and not bullied, and to be harmonious and make everyone rich. It doesn't want to be king and hegemony, let alone counterattack. But the "Public Security Bureau" of the international community is still not at ease, always thinking that China is going to cause trouble; the "Jury" of the international community is not at ease, always feeling that China has not learned well. This is the scene at the Munich Security Policy Conference: When representatives of the Chinese government spoke, it looked like they were facing interrogation and evaluation. What if it wasn't such a gesture? What will happen if the Chinese government not only demands equality in terms of actual status, but also demands equality in terms of words and gestures? If you make irresponsible remarks, I will make irresponsible remarks, if you are arrogant and I will criticize others, if you make trouble with me and I will point out yours, what will happen? If the Chinese government gives instructions to Vice Minister Zhang Zhijun: Be condescending when speaking, hold your head high when walking, be aggressive and merciless when negotiating, use the power of the Celestial Empire to suppress these small barbarian countries that live on borrowed money! What will happen? In fact, this is not a question of whether you dare or not, it is a question of whether it is tough enough, or whether you should continue to "keep your reputation secret". In my opinion, the rise of Asia and China is jointly determined by several major factors. For a long time, it can only be a rise of action but not talk. First, the reality is that on the international political stage, all the lines are written by Westerners. You Chinese are at best an actor, while others are screenwriters. The actors and screenwriters quarreled, and they got along over small things, but they couldn't win on the big issues and the most core issues, unless all the lines on the stage were changed to "Zuo Zhuan" and "Warring States Policy", and everyone said "Zheng Burke Duan Yu Yan" and "Qin Xingshi came to Zhou to ask for Jiuding". Second, the mainstream discourse of Western powers is not just casual talk. It is essentially the pillar of the global governance system. Except for a few places where force is directly used, most of the others are managed by talk. We rely on talk to stabilize some countries, and we also rely on talk to mess up some countries. These are already well established and have always been effective. Unless Asia and China want to overthrow the current international system and start over, they cannot directly pull out this pillar. Third, the Eastern tradition emphasizes consistency in words and deeds, and caution in words and deeds. A gentleman's words are hard to follow. Plausibility and eloquence have never been part of our culture. Western politics has developed to the point where words and deeds can be separated, words and actions can be separated, and words can be said without having to face the consequences. However, the politics of Eastern people have not yet reached this stage. If you follow suit, you will be in trouble with yourself. From this point of view, on the international stage, Asians and Chinese may not have to pursue eloquent speeches, persuasive statements, and endless rhetoric. It doesn't matter if you are clumsy and tongue-tied every day, stammering, reversing a few sentences over and over again, and repeating a few rationales over and over again. As long as you don't delay doing things and continue to rise, that's it. When the rise of Asia and China is completely self-contained, and practice proves that we don’t need so many doctrines, so many theories, and so many political rhetorics, we can still manage the affairs of the country and the people well, then the East and the West will really become more balanced. ▊ February 6, 2012 Jerry Wen Yang Director Chief Editor The United Chinese Press www.ucpnz.com Tel: +64 9 369 7210 Fax: +64 9 369 7201 Level 4 A, 32-34 Mahuhu Cres, City Auckland, New Zealand PO Box 6710 Wellesley, Auckland 1141, New Zealand
