7e877f80097aa5477fcb2f8740f85134ed670bb9.translatedText: Several zip codes in this state have the top 100 most bankrupt houses in the United States. Recently, CNN Money channel listed the 100 zip codes in the United States with the most bankrupt houses...

9ea9f53b69fe6a660ed04217b15997d87f72f6ee.sourceText: 本州几个邮编上全美前100破产屋最多的区域 日前， CNN Money 频道列出全美 100 个破产屋最多的邮政编码，其中多个在凤凰城大都会。 据 CNN 数据，本州的 85138 ， 85143 ， 85226 ， 85345 ， 85225 ， 85339 ， 85041 等邮政编码，不仅是本州破产率最高，还排在全国前 100 名。这些区域，空屋甚多，垃圾、杂草丛生，吸引了犯罪份子。 此外，大凤凰城区的 85050 区房屋增长率达 74.6% ，是全美十大房屋增长率最高的地区之一。邮编 85054 地区则是全国房屋贬值率最高第二位。正所谓天堂与地狱，相隔不是很远。
9ea9f53b69fe6a660ed04217b15997d87f72f6ee.translatedText: Several zip codes in this state have the top 100 most bankrupt houses in the United States. Recently, CNN Money channel listed the 100 most bankrupt houses in the United States. ZIP codes with the most bankruptcies, many in the Phoenix metropolitan area. According to CNN data, zip codes such as 85138, 85143, 85226, 85345, 85225, 85339, and 85041 not only have the highest bankruptcy rate in the state, but also rank among the top 100 in the country. In these areas, there are many empty houses, overgrown with garbage and weeds, attracting criminals. In addition, the 85050 area of ​​the greater Phoenix area has experienced a housing growth rate of 74.6%, making it one of the top 10 highest housing growth areas in the United States. The 85054 zip code has the second-highest home depreciation rate in the country. As the saying goes, heaven and hell are not very far apart.

a2c1cace6d92d60ca13517fb144bce9d28e2c0ea.sourceText: 中国人热衷于移居海外的十大原因
a2c1cace6d92d60ca13517fb144bce9d28e2c0ea.translatedText: The top ten reasons why Chinese people are keen on moving overseas

b28e3555c1ec8a9a718d82bee931f8ca3e8b3492.sourceText: 中国人热衷于移居海外的十大原因 据《山东商报》报道：太原理工大学在其官网上贴出公告，开除该校103名教师公职。…
b28e3555c1ec8a9a718d82bee931f8ca3e8b3492.translatedText: The top ten reasons why Chinese people are keen on moving overseas. According to the "Shandong Business Daily" report: Taiyuan University of Technology posted an announcement on its official website to fire 103 teachers from the school. …

181a4d7f2e048f6a1497517463eaac8c0d5ef20d.sourceText: 其实，对于中国人喜欢移民海外，尤其是那么所谓的”高端人才”和成功人士，已经不算是新闻了，因为在电视上可以看到，那些成功的名流，虽然声称自己是中国人，说的是中国话，挣的是中国钱，但一问他们的国籍，大多数人都是吞吞吐吐，因为他们其实已不算中国人了，已经是他国人了。但象太原理工大学一次开除103名教师公职，而且原因只有一个，那就是滞留国外，逾期未归，这应该算是一个很大的新闻了。
181a4d7f2e048f6a1497517463eaac8c0d5ef20d.translatedText: In fact, it is no longer news that Chinese people like to immigrate overseas, especially so-called "high-end talents" and successful people, because you can see on TV that those successful celebrities claim to be Chinese, speak Chinese, and earn Chinese money, but when asked about their nationality, most people are hesitant because they are no longer Chinese and are already from other countries. But for example, Taiyuan University of Technology fired 103 teachers from their official positions at one time, and the reason was only one, that is, they were stranded abroad and failed to return after the deadline. This should be considered a big news.

f8b20631f872103bff1bf19f240c5da907112722.sourceText: 那么，中国人为什么如此热衷于移居海外呢？今天，丁丁正好和一位”成功人士”在一起吃晚饭，他是丁丁的朋友，早年经商发了大财，现在成功移民新加坡，正好今天又看到了太原理工大学因滞留国外，逾期未归的103教师开除公职的消息，自然聊起了中国人热衷于移民海外的原因。
f8b20631f872103bff1bf19f240c5da907112722.translatedText: So, why are Chinese people so keen on moving overseas? Today, Ding Ding happened to have dinner with a "successful person". He was Ding Ding's friend. He made a fortune in business in his early years, and now he has successfully immigrated to Singapore. It just so happened that today he saw the news that Teacher 103 of Taiyuan University of Technology was fired from his official position for staying abroad and overdue. Naturally, he talked about the reasons why Chinese people are keen to immigrate overseas.

757c410dba36b13f9b51adfe5aa2ed149b68e9cd.sourceText: 一是国外尤其是发达国家尊重人才，人才能够得到充分的展现。多年来，中国培养的”高端人才”借公派留学或讲学或学术交流的机会，从此滞留海外，逾期未的根本原因是这些发达国家特别尊重人才，而且人才能够得到公平的竞争而有展示的机会，更有成名成功的机会。反观中国，虽然政府多次讲要重视人才，但真正实行起来却不是那么一回事，因为中国讲的是权力，讲的是金钱，是权力和金钱至上的国家，一个人成功的标志是做了多大的官，挣了多少钱，所以，中国培养人才60多年，既没有憋出一个钱学森，也没有出现一个乔布斯。而中国的人才在海外尤其在发达国家，往往能得到尊重，更能得到施展才华的机会，如先后有四位华人获得物理或化学方面的诺贝尔奖，而中国如此多的科学家竟然没有出现一位诺贝尔奖的获得者。如果这些人在中国，能否同样获得诺贝尔奖，我们也许不需要猜测。
757c410dba36b13f9b51adfe5aa2ed149b68e9cd.translatedText: First, foreign countries, especially developed countries, respect talents and talents can be fully displayed. Over the years, the "high-end talents" cultivated in China have taken advantage of the opportunities provided by the government to study abroad, give lectures or academic exchanges, and have been stranded overseas ever since. The fundamental reason for their overdue status is that these developed countries particularly respect talents, and talents can receive fair competition and have opportunities to showcase themselves and become famous and successful. On the other hand, in China, although the government has repeatedly talked about attaching importance to talents, the actual implementation is not the same, because China is about power and money. It is a country where power and money are paramount. The sign of a person's success is how big an official he is and how much money he earns. Therefore, after more than 60 years of cultivating talents, China has neither produced a Qian Xuesen nor a Steve Jobs. Chinese talents are often respected overseas, especially in developed countries, and are given opportunities to display their talents. For example, four Chinese have won the Nobel Prize in physics or chemistry, but among so many Chinese scientists, there has not been a single Nobel Prize winner. If these people were in China, whether they could also win the Nobel Prize, we may not need to guess.

a3e81751f4b1e8652fde0358ee3a0adcdf6fc652.sourceText: 二、国外尤其是发达国家市场经济成熟，能够得到公平的对待。发达国家实行市场经济多年，市场机制十分成熟，无论是打工者，还是商人，靠的是平等的竞争，所以，象乔布斯这样的打工者同样能够获得成功，象海尔这样的民间企业在海外同样能够获得发展。反观中国，市场经济还不是很成熟，企业成功往往靠的不是市场竞争机制，而是靠政策、靠人员关系、靠与政界人士尤其是各级领导的关系，所以，中国成功的企业往往与政策密不可分，往往是当地领导的关系密不可分，往往与偷税漏税密不可分，据中央党校一名教授讲，中国的企业9成靠偷税漏税才得已生存，而且，我们也可以看到，一个企业家的倒台，其背后往往有党政领导人倒台，如厦门的远华事件更是一个典型。另外，对于普通求职人员来说，在中国往往难以得到公平的对待和平等的竞争，从官场就可以看出，现在的官场人员往往是官二代、官三代，提拔的人员多是这些人，所以，有人总结了这样一条规律：将军的儿子只能做将军，因为元帅有儿子。
a3e81751f4b1e8652fde0358ee3a0adcdf6fc652.translatedText: 2. Foreign countries, especially developed countries, have mature market economies and can be treated fairly. Developed countries have practiced market economy for many years, and the market mechanism is very mature. Both workers and businessmen rely on equal competition. Therefore, workers like Jobs can also succeed, and private enterprises like Haier can also develop overseas. In contrast, in China, the market economy is not yet very mature. The success of enterprises often depends not on the market competition mechanism, but on policies, personnel relationships, and relationships with politicians, especially leaders at all levels. Therefore, successful enterprises in China are often inseparable from policies and are often closely related to local leaders. Inseparable, it is often inseparable from tax evasion. According to a professor at the Central Party School, 90% of Chinese enterprises rely on tax evasion to survive. Moreover, we can also see that the downfall of an entrepreneur is often preceded by the downfall of party and government leaders. For example, the Yuanhua incident in Xiamen is a typical example. In addition, for ordinary job seekers, it is often difficult to get fair treatment and equal competition in China. This can be seen from the officialdom. Today's officialdom personnel are often second-generation and third-generation officials, and most of the promoted personnel are these people. Therefore, someone has summarized this rule: the son of a general can only be a general, because a marshal has a son.

12625e42a87d547b98f23a9a7590e19bb58e5277.sourceText: 三、国外尤其是发达国家的福利保障制度相当健全。在发达国家，一个典型的标志就是福利保障制度十分健全，他们实行了从摇篮到坟墓的福利保障制度，至少让生活无忧，而中国虽然近几年也在搞全民福利制度，但还远远不够，许多家庭往往是因为一个家庭成员生病从小康水平倒退到解放前，尤其是中国的各种福利制度虽然都在搞，但都是杯水车薪，如虽然实行了养老保险、医疗保险、失业保险、生育保险、住房公积金等福利制度，但没有一项福利能够满足人的需求，农村养老保险养活不了一个人、医疗保险医治不了一个病、失业保险不能保障失业人员的基本生活需要、住房公积金不但很难领取，真正在购房时根本起不了多大的作用。
12625e42a87d547b98f23a9a7590e19bb58e5277.translatedText: 3. The welfare security system abroad, especially in developed countries, is quite sound. In developed countries, a typical sign is that the welfare security system is very sound. They have implemented a cradle-to-grave welfare security system, which at least makes life worry-free. Although China has also implemented a universal welfare system in recent years, it is still far from enough. Many families often fall back from a moderately prosperous level to before liberation because of the illness of a family member. Especially in China, although various welfare systems are being implemented, they are only a drop in the bucket. Car salary, for example, although pension insurance, medical insurance, unemployment insurance, maternity insurance, housing provident fund and other welfare systems have been implemented, none of the benefits can meet people's needs. Rural pension insurance cannot support a person, medical insurance cannot cure a disease, unemployment insurance cannot protect the basic living needs of unemployed people, and housing provident fund is not only difficult to receive, but it does not play a big role in buying a house.

dd7c2280b7fe5af812cc6e0aa27755bdc6188a94.sourceText: 四、国外尤其是发达国家法制健全，且做到了有法必依。发达国家的法制十分健全，是标准的法制国家，基本做到了法律面前人人平等，而反观中国，法律制定了不少，也自称是法制国家，天天喊”法律面前人人平等”，”有法可依，有法必依，执法必依，违法必究”，但是，中国目前基本上还是人治为主，执行法律往往是上面领导一声喊下面才执行，所谓的严打运动其实就是极不正常的一种人治，法律摆在那儿，执法机关不需要上级领导的任何指示，按法律执行就行了，可这基本的法律常识在中国却做不到，尤其是在法院执行法律时，更是儿戏，往往受领导等和舆论人为的干扰，如云南的李昌奎强奸杀人案。
dd7c2280b7fe5af812cc6e0aa27755bdc6188a94.translatedText: 4. Foreign countries, especially developed countries, have sound legal systems and must abide by the law. Developed countries have a very sound legal system and are standard legal countries. Everyone is basically equal before the law. On the other hand, China has enacted many laws and claims to be a legal country. It shouts every day that "everyone is equal before the law." The so-called "strike hard" campaign is actually a very abnormal form of human rule. The law is there. Law enforcement agencies do not need any instructions from superiors and just enforce the law. However, this basic legal knowledge cannot be achieved in China. Especially when the courts enforce the law, it is even more childish. They are often artificially interfered by leaders and public opinion, such as the rape and murder case of Li Changkui in Yunnan.

f855d94c3f519e45a7e07f52abbfcb5f26209430.sourceText: 五、某些贪官的避难场所。中国官场有这样一类人，老婆和子女都已移民国外，而自己在中国当官，被人们戏称为”祼官”，这类人员就是典型的贪官，但这些贪官知道自己罪孽深重，生怕有一天东窗事发，所以，早早作好准备，将家庭人员和财产转移到国外，自己继续大捞一把，如果运气好捞到退休，然后去海外与家庭团圆，如果闻到风吹草动，马上走人，让你抓不到。
f855d94c3f519e45a7e07f52abbfcb5f26209430.translatedText: 5. A place of refuge for some corrupt officials. There is a type of people in the Chinese officialdom whose wives and children have immigrated abroad, but they are officials in China, and are jokingly called "naked officials." This type of person is a typical corrupt official, but these corrupt officials know that their sins are serious and are afraid that one day they will be exposed. Therefore, they make preparations early and transfer their family members and property abroad. They will continue to make a lot of money. If they are lucky enough to retire, they will go overseas to reunite with their families. If they smell trouble, they will leave immediately so that you can't catch them.

cb7743a20e6186cb98463081e5db62ea566d2234.sourceText: 六、某些名流的避税场所。这些人主要集中于商人和演员，这些名流往往是偷税漏税的高手，但同样害怕被抓，或利用国内国外税率的差异，做到成功逃税，所以，中国的这些名流往往是在国内挣钱，在国外存钱，在国外花钱，因为他们早已将国籍改为他国。
cb7743a20e6186cb98463081e5db62ea566d2234.translatedText: 6. A tax haven for some celebrities. These people are mainly businessmen and actors. These celebrities are often masters of tax evasion, but they are also afraid of being caught, or they may take advantage of the differences in domestic and foreign tax rates to successfully evade taxes. Therefore, these celebrities in China often make money at home, save money abroad, and spend money abroad because they have already changed their nationality to another country.

0b30afe63b1a1cbf47ee476eaf8cf287ea186400.sourceText: 七、方便经商。中国从八十年代改革开放以来，招商引资是中国的一大基本国策，而招商引资的主要方法是减税、免税和政策优惠，所以，有些人就看到了这一商机，将自己或自己的子女移民国外，然后摇身一变，成为外国人，回国投资，能够享受各种政策和税收方面的优惠，丁丁面前的这位朋友就是这类人，这也是他成功的秘诀。
0b30afe63b1a1cbf47ee476eaf8cf287ea186400.translatedText: 7. Convenient for doing business. Since China's reform and opening up in the 1980s, attracting investment has been one of China's basic national policies, and the main methods for attracting investment are tax cuts, exemptions and preferential policies. Therefore, some people have seen this business opportunity and immigrated themselves or their children abroad. Then they became foreigners and returned to the country to invest and enjoy various policy and tax benefits. The friend in front of Ding Ding is this kind of person, and this is the secret of his success.

aa2847a52f8098ccf7ff3f643eaf5727f17a87ae.sourceText: 八、政治避难。中国的政治环境在国际上比较差，尤其是一些西方国家一直仇视中国，可以说是亡我中国之心不死，想千方百计的破坏中国的建设，一些有政治企图或与中国政见不合的一些人，往往受到西方国家的欢迎，并且给他们提供场所和资金，所以，这些人尤其是那些头头都移民国外，如达赖、李洪志、王丹等人，成为西方国家的座上宾。
aa2847a52f8098ccf7ff3f643eaf5727f17a87ae.translatedText: 8. Political asylum. China's political environment is relatively poor internationally. In particular, some Western countries have always been hostile to China. It can be said that they are determined to destroy China and want to do everything possible to undermine China's construction. Some people who have political intentions or disagree with China's political views are often welcomed by Western countries and provide them with venues and funds. Therefore, these people, especially those whose leaders have immigrated abroad, such as the Dalai Lama, Li Hongzhi, Wang Dan and others, have become guests of Western countries.

2d8ede6dc24a0f79b36998896546c203e2368639.sourceText: 九、寻找机遇。有些人并不是想要移民国外，但由于生活所迫，想去国外闯闯，寻找商机，这类人多以底层老百姓为多，如那些国外劳务用工或某些小经营个体户之类的，如前几年到俄罗斯倒卖服装、土特产之类的人，丁丁一同学就是在欧洲经商而发了大财，但说起他的国内经历，那可是贫困潦倒，”树挪死，人挪活”，那是他们的人生信条，一旦在国外成功，他们往往选择定居国外。
2d8ede6dc24a0f79b36998896546c203e2368639.translatedText: 9. Look for opportunities. Some people do not want to immigrate abroad, but due to the pressure of life, they want to go abroad and look for business opportunities. Most of these people are ordinary people at the bottom, such as those who work abroad or some small self-employed people. For example, they went to Russia to resell clothing and soil in the past few years. For people like specialties, Ding Dingyi made a fortune doing business in Europe, but when it comes to his domestic experience, it was poverty. "If a tree dies, a person will live." That is their life creed. Once they succeed abroad, they often choose to settle abroad.

e535164b3304afa37a20fb33d42a1c75f084b305.sourceText: 十、虚荣心作怪。中国人崇洋媚外是出了名的，”国外的月亮都比中国圆”，而且事实是，外国人来到中国人，或中国人有海外关系都会被视作一种荣耀，这些外国人来到中国，各级地方政府领导总是热情接待，而且总是新闻的重要板块，更加激起了某些中国人的虚荣心，所以，有些人自己这一代成不了外国人，也要想方设法让自己的子女成为外国人，甚至冒着生命危险都要去国外生产。
e535164b3304afa37a20fb33d42a1c75f084b305.translatedText: > 10. Vanity causes trouble. Chinese people are famous for their admiration for foreigners. "The moon abroad is rounder than China." And the fact is that foreigners coming to China, or Chinese people having overseas relations, are regarded as an honor. When these foreigners come to China, local government leaders at all levels always warmly welcome them, and they are always an important part of the news, which further arouses the vanity of some Chinese people. Therefore, some people who cannot become foreigners in their own generation have to find ways to make their children become foreigners, and even risk their lives to go abroad to give birth.

fc806455183e38fd9f1179030e50f755c070891c.sourceText: 中新网1月26日电 据”中央社”报道，美国总统奥巴马25日搭乘”空军一号”飞抵亚利桑那州凤凰城，却和前来接机的共和党州长布鲁尔发生了”小摩擦”。
fc806455183e38fd9f1179030e50f755c070891c.translatedText: China News Service, January 26 According to the "Central News Agency" report, US President Obama flew to Phoenix, Arizona aboard Air Force One on the 25th, but had a "small friction" with Republican Governor Brewer who came to pick him up.

7f2a21ea63f1004ed81398f2b9b9e8192b553fc4.sourceText: 报道称，两人在跑道上短暂见面，准备展开欢迎仪式时，奥巴马告诉布鲁尔，对她叙述两年前白宫会面的内容并不苟同。
7f2a21ea63f1004ed81398f2b9b9e8192b553fc4.translatedText: Reports said that the two met briefly on the runway. In preparation for the welcome ceremony, Obama told Brewer that he did not agree with her account of the White House meeting two years ago.

16107a65c3a9e4076ea1c7e90ab689d6a17fa97d.sourceText: 布鲁尔在两人交谈后告诉媒体，”他对我的书《蝎子当早餐》中的内容有些不悦。”两人谈话时，她还一度用手指着奥巴马的鼻子。
16107a65c3a9e4076ea1c7e90ab689d6a17fa97d.translatedText: After the two talked, Brewer told the media, "He was a little unhappy with the content of my book "Scorpions for Breakfast." "While the two were talking, she once pointed at Obama's nose.

4ea7663f41e071f9a77345f06ddc70330b0d9281.sourceText: 过去在移民政策上和奥巴马意见相左的布鲁尔，在机场欢迎奥巴马时交给他一封信函，要求会面讨论亚利桑那州经济议题。白宫官员表示，交信后，奥巴马提到这本书。
4ea7663f41e071f9a77345f06ddc70330b0d9281.translatedText: Brewer, who had disagreed with Obama on immigration policy in the past, handed Obama a letter when he welcomed him at the airport, requesting a meeting to discuss Arizona. Economic issues. White House officials said that after the letter was exchanged, Obama mentioned the book.

aa9468f447461cdc3361bc4a62e36ae6dcfdf81c.sourceText: 官员说，”总统表示很高兴再次和她会面，但的确提到上次在白宫恳谈后，布鲁尔在书中叙述情况不实。总统期盼持续采取行动，协助该州经济成长。”
aa9468f447461cdc3361bc4a62e36ae6dcfdf81c.translatedText: Officials said, "The president said he was happy to meet with her again, but he did mention that Brewer's account in the book was untrue after the last meeting at the White House." The president looks forward to continued actions to help the state's economic growth. "

f64bc6bdb32a229c7c5fc6ac8b963a1c00656d4a.sourceText: 据悉，布鲁尔2010年6月造访白宫，与奥巴马在椭圆形办公室私下碰面30分钟。白宫称那是一次”令人满意的会面”，当时布鲁尔也说会谈”极为诚恳”，但她在书中却说奥巴马”傲慢”。
f64bc6bdb32a229c7c5fc6ac8b963a1c00656d4a.translatedText: It is reported that Brewer visited the White House in June 2010 and met with Obama privately in the Oval Office for 30 minutes. The White House called it a "satisfactory meeting". At the time, Brewer also said that the meeting was "extremely sincere", but she called Obama "arrogant" in her book.

5294fd38897bd8052c39233107c42bceab81e909.sourceText: 奥巴马24日发表国情咨文，随之展开3天5州视察行程，亚利桑那州是其中一站。此行实际上也是为他展开连任选战服务。
5294fd38897bd8052c39233107c42bceab81e909.translatedText: Obama delivered the State of the Union Address on the 24th, which began in 3 days and 5 days. Arizona is one of the stops on his state inspection trip.

324cf9c00d4bce7802c6f4e07b8e1ecc471c0d26.sourceText: 另据报道，奥巴马25日否认了共和党对其推销对富人增税案的做法是在发动阶级战的指控。奥巴马期待让选民相信他改造经济的愿景，让人人都可获得”公平的机会”，并让他在11月大选中顺利连任。
324cf9c00d4bce7802c6f4e07b8e1ecc471c0d26.translatedText: According to reports, Obama on the 25th denied the Republican accusation that his promotion of tax increases on the rich was a class war. Obama hopes to convince voters of his vision to transform the economy and give everyone a "fair chance" and allow him to be re-elected in the November election.

afd2844bccf7bec0b10cee68f5c1051b548ea3ad.sourceText: 历年来，亚省华人华裔应征参军，为保家卫国，付出过青春、鲜血和生命。 在第一次世界大战时期，亚省就有两位华人应征当兵，一位是HONG HAM，另一位是DEAHONG TOY即关祟琼先生。 这两位在陆军中负责的是食物服务(Food Service)。 退役后，关崇琼先生在斐匿开过货仓和Toy’s Shengrila餐馆即”崇琼楼”，是鳯凰城华人最早在本地开设的餐馆之一。 关先生热爱侨社，推动侨务，是斐匿《侨联》最早的创办人之一，在1968年被推举为第一届侨联主席。 第二次世界大战，亚省有七十九位华人子弟应征当兵，报效美国，参加海、陆、空军和特种兵种，勇赴前线，浴血奋战。 其中参加中美空军混合大队第十四航空飞虎队服务的也有四位华人，包括邓桐臻、HARRY ONG,DOUGLAS DONG，GREY TOY等，他们远赴中国参加抗日战争，和中国军民一起直接抗击入侵祖国 的日本帝国主义。 二次大战中有五位华裔军人在英勇杀敌中为国捐躯，其中有三位是空军。 邓家第一位壮烈犠牲的子弟是EDWAR YINONG，他是空军勇士，在1945年5月26日在菲律宾战区的空战中遇难。 邓家有邓粤钿等四兄弟先后上阵杀敌。 邓粤钿先生在1944年8月已完成了廿九次飞行任务，第卅次完成后即可返国，但在最后一次轰炸德国中，飞机被击中起火，随后他成为战俘，是亚省 华人在二次大战中唯一的一位战俘，以后被英军救出，1945年他英雄式地返回美国。 我查过在华人当兵历史中，有四十多位官兵姓邓，占总数的四分之一，所有六位烈士之中，也有三位是邓家子弟。
afd2844bccf7bec0b10cee68f5c1051b548ea3ad.translatedText: Over the years, Chinese people in Alberta have been drafted into the army and have sacrificed their youth, blood and lives to protect their country and country. During World War I, two Chinese people in Alberta were recruited as soldiers, one was HONG HAM, and the other was DEAHONG TOY, Mr. Guan Chongqiong. These two are responsible for food service in the Army. After retiring from the army, Mr. Kwan Chongqiong opened a warehouse and Toy’s Shengrila restaurant in Phoenix, known as "Chongqiong House". It was one of the earliest local restaurants opened by Chinese in Phoenix. Mr. Guan loves overseas Chinese communities and promotes overseas Chinese affairs. He is one of the earliest founders of the Overseas Chinese Federation in Feinie. In 1968, he was elected as the chairman of the first Overseas Chinese Federation. During the Second World War, 79 Chinese people from Alberta were drafted into the army to serve the United States. They participated in the navy, army, air force and special forces, and bravely went to the front line and fought bloody battles. Among them, there were four Chinese who served in the 14th Air Flying Tigers, a mixed group of the Chinese and American Air Forces, including Deng Tongzhen, HARRY ONG, DOUGLAS DONG, GRAY TOY, etc. They went to China to participate in the Anti-Japanese War, and worked with the Chinese military and civilians to directly fight against the Japanese imperialism that invaded the motherland. During World War II, five Chinese-American soldiers died for their country while heroically killing the enemy, three of whom were in the Air Force. The first son of the Deng family to sacrifice heroically was EDWAR YINONG, an Air Force warrior who was killed in an air battle in the Philippines theater on May 26, 1945. Four brothers from the Deng family, including Deng Yuedian, went into battle to kill the enemy. Mr. Deng Yuetian had completed 29 missions in August 1944. He could return to China after the 30th mission. However, during the last bombing of Germany, the plane was hit and caught fire. He subsequently became a prisoner of war. He was the only Chinese prisoner of war in Alberta during World War II. He was later rescued by the British army. In 1945, he returned to the United States heroically. I have checked that in the history of Chinese military service, there are more than 40 officers and soldiers named Deng, accounting for a quarter of the total. Among the six martyrs, three are descendants of the Deng family.

cbb62dcc136676e9ebe4aa5e69b11476d6261f6f.sourceText: 二次大战中,邓家有邓粤钿等四兄弟先后上阵杀敌
cbb62dcc136676e9ebe4aa5e69b11476d6261f6f.translatedText: During the Second World War, four brothers from the Deng family, including Deng Yuetian, went to battle to kill the enemy.

f66a950d056dd9546469f246e39c7f41832658d8.sourceText: 战后军中华人退役回到斐匿，后来官至上校的关卫理先生(关崇琼之子)教授多间中学学生的军事课程。 不少退伍军人在侨社各组织担任领导，如邓粤寅先生担任过国府侨务顾问，邓桐臻先生担任侨联主席等。
f66a950d056dd9546469f246e39c7f41832658d8.translatedText: After the war, the Chinese retired from the army and returned to Feini. Mr. Guan Weili (son of Guan Chongqiong), who later became a colonel, taught military courses to students in many middle schools. Many veterans serve as leaders in various organizations of overseas Chinese communities. For example, Mr. Deng Yueyin served as the Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisor of the National Government, and Mr. Deng Tongzhen served as the chairman of the Federation of Overseas Chinese.

333e3af0fd3b56e42a72208938b0287e380c9161.sourceText: 华裔军人中最高官阶的关卫理上校
333e3af0fd3b56e42a72208938b0287e380c9161.translatedText: Colonel Wei-Li Kwan, the highest-ranking Chinese soldier

e87fe17d250eb7587e4abd3e01c2ccf58785dab9.sourceText: 一九五O年韩战爆发，亚省又有廿三位华人子弟参军，有些还是二次大战老兵重披战甲，而且在海陆空各兵种都有华人参与。 直至一九五五年停战，部分军人退伍回到斐匿，部分仍留在军中服务。 退伍者有一批成功人士，其中邓达明先生走上从政之路，曾在PEORIA市担任副市长6年，市长6年，是本地华人担任公职最长的邓家子弟。 而邓泮林先生则创办了当时全州最大的”超级商场”FOODRAMA。 开餐馆成功人士者也不少，知名的有邝添权先生，他也是亚省时报的作家。 在侨社方面，余文俗先生(WILLTEM.YEE)四十八岁就从货仓生意中退休转向地产投资，并抽出大量时间精力服务耆英会和康宁大厦兴建工作，曾被选为《侨联》主席 。 1961年至1975年越南战争打响，亚省有22位华人应征服役，其中有多位从事文职和技术工作。 还有一位在终端机服务的女军官CAROLEEN CHANG LRLBERISON。 越战中有一位名为HERBERT WONG的华人为国捐驱，可惜至今仍未有他具体事迹的资料。 从越战退伍军人中有一位是余自任先生，他兢兢业业在侨联工作多年，担任财政多年，2005年被选为《侨联》主席，并当上全美国同源会副总会长。 在其后的中东战争和海湾战争以及伊拉克战争，不断有亚省华裔应征当兵。 1950年，由44位亚省退伍华人组成了”华裔军人会”，以后因为邓心平先生是二次大战老兵，又德高望重，为纪念他的去世，所以就改名”邓心平退伍军人会”， 而且其中还有三名西方人士。 历年来，斐匿华人华裔当兵人数近二百人，但因不断病故，现剩下的大都是年事已高者。 每年国庆，当退伍军人扛枪护旗进场时，会场一片庄严肃穆，在美国国旗上，有着亚省华人华裔军人血染的风釆，是他们令到我们骄傲和继续往前。 《邓心平退伍军人会》一书由KC TANG先生在1997年编写，KC TANG家中三兄弟也是前后当过兵，他是韩战飞行大队的沙展，从事文职工作。 这部二百余页的书记载着许许多多可歌可泣的感人故事。 我怀着一颗祟敬的心，节录了部分与我们侨社有关联的人物和故事，给大家再说当年。
e87fe17d250eb7587e4abd3e01c2ccf58785dab9.translatedText: When the Korean War broke out in 1950, another 23 Chinese men from Alberta joined the army, some of whom were veterans of World War II and donned battle armor. There were also Chinese participants in all branches of the military, including land, sea and air. Until the armistice in 1955, some soldiers retired and returned to Feini, while others still served in the army. There are a number of successful veterans among the veterans. Among them, Mr. Deng Daming embarked on the road to politics. He served as the deputy mayor of PEORIA City for 6 years and the mayor for 6 years. He is the son of the Deng family who has served in public office for the longest time among local Chinese. Mr. Deng Panlin founded FOODRAMA, the largest "super mall" in the state at that time. There are also many successful restaurant owners, one of the well-known ones is Mr. Tim Kuang, who is also a writer for the Alberta Times. Regarding the overseas Chinese community, Mr. Yu Wensu (WILLTEM.YEE) retired from the warehouse business at the age of 48 and turned to real estate investment. He devoted a lot of time and energy to serving the Senior Citizens Association and the construction of the Corning Building. He was once elected as the chairman of the "Overseas Chinese Federation". From 1961 to 1975, when the Vietnam War began, 22 Chinese people in Alberta were recruited to serve, many of whom were engaged in civilian and technical jobs. There is also a female officer CAROLEEN CHANG LRLBERISON serving at the terminal. During the Vietnam War, a Chinese named HERBERT WONG donated firepower for the country. Unfortunately, there is still no information about his specific deeds. One of the veterans from the Vietnam War is Mr. Yu Ziren. He has worked diligently in the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese for many years, serving as its treasurer for many years. In 2005, he was elected as the chairman of the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese and became the vice president of the National Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese. In the subsequent Middle East wars, the Gulf War and the Iraq War, Chinese people from Alberta continued to be recruited as soldiers. In 1950, 44 Chinese veterans from Alberta formed the "Chinese American Veterans Association". Later, because Mr. Deng Xinping was a veteran of World War II and was highly respected, in order to commemorate his death, the name was changed to the "Deng Xinping Veterans Association", and there were also three Westerners among them. Over the years, nearly 200 Filipino Chinese have served in the military. However, due to constant illness and death, most of the remaining ones are now elderly. Every year on National Day, when the veterans enter the venue carrying guns and protecting the flag, the venue is solemn and solemn. On the American flag, there is the blood-stained image of the Chinese soldiers in Alberta. It is they who make us proud and continue to move forward. The book "Deng Xinping Veterans Association" was written by Mr. KC TANG in 1997. The three brothers of KC TANG's family also served in the military. He was the commander of the Korean War Flying Brigade and engaged in civilian work. This book of more than 200 pages records many touching and touching stories. With a respectful heart, I have excerpted some of the characters and stories related to our overseas Chinese community to tell you about those years.

9335d5b4e00930653355fa3b7eeda665e3e347bf.sourceText: 张家界号称有三千奇峰八百秀水,从武陵源乘坐百龙天梯上到袁家界，就可领略到大湘西朴面而来的浪漫、激情与狂野。 最典型的山峰都汇聚在这里。 打开相机随便拍都是一幅幅的画。 中国的景点​​不同于欧美国家，差不多每个地方的著名景物都人为地加上命名和传说，多了就显得太假。 在湘西大峰林中，也有不少三分形似，七分神似的奇山怪石被人为地冠上各种神话或人物称谓。 眼前的风光在四亿年前曾是一片海洋，由于造物主的鬼斧神工，用水流冲刷，用风火雷电雨霜雪的热涨冷缩，渐渐地才形成这一座座不同世间万物的石英岩层和山形 地貌，吸引到千千万万的人客到此一游。 所以多拍几张相片上网，与大家分享。
9335d5b4e00930653355fa3b7eeda665e3e347bf.translatedText: > Zhangjiajie is known to have three thousand strange peaks and eight hundred beautiful waters. From Wulingyuan, you can take the Bailong Elevator to Yuanjiajie and experience the romance, passion and wildness of Xiangxi. The most typical peaks are gathered here. Turn on the camera and take pictures at will. Scenic spots in China are different from those in European and American countries. Almost every famous sightseeing place has artificial names and legends. If there are too many, it will look too fake. In the Dafeng Forest in western Hunan, there are also many strange mountains and rocks that are three-thirds similar in shape and seven-pointed in spirit, and have been artificially crowned with various mythological or character titles. The scenery in front of us was once an ocean 400 million years ago. Due to the uncanny workmanship of the Creator, it was washed by water and expanded and contracted by wind, fire, thunder, lightning, rain, frost, and snow, and gradually formed this quartz rock layer and mountain topography that is different from anything else in the world, attracting thousands of people to visit here. So take a few more photos and go online to share them with everyone.

882fd419abeaa90403a43e294f1e888510d8ea83.sourceText: 张家界号称有三千奇峰八百秀水
882fd419abeaa90403a43e294f1e888510d8ea83.translatedText: Zhangjiajie is said to have three thousand peaks and eight hundred beautiful waters

d4a56b228b2fe32959ac5dbe699555974802307b.sourceText: 张家界上有很多自然村落，梯田山寨在烟霞中隐隐现现，十分幽美。 值得一提的袁家界上土家族寨子的民俗大观园，它把人文风俗展示集中在一个寨子，加上真人现场演示，一个立体的土家族历史和现实全部展现在眼前，让张家界在自然奇幻中 增添人文之美。 参观时我们领略湘西的风土韵味和奇特的〝傩〞(读〝罗〞音)文化。 傩的形式有多种多样，很多似我们所说的〝邪术〞，如放蛊，或东南亚所说的〝下降头〞之类。 所以，湘西的姑娘不怕情郎远走高飞，因有其秘密蛊术把负心郎扣住。 寨内还有”哭嫁”，”哭嫁”是土家族特有的风俗，从古代一直沿袭至今。它通过哭唱的方式，将姑娘隐藏在心底的复杂、细腻感情表现得淋漓尽致。婚前半月，新娘 即开始哭唱，其形式有一人哭、二人对哭、多人一起哭等。哭唱的内容多为哭爹妈的养育之恩、兄嫂秭妹别离之情、骂媒人等等。我们 到了一间喜房，门前有一个〝福〞字，这个福字在〝百福图〞中未见过，是两个少数民族男女对跳的形式组成，十分有艺术动感。喜房内有一扮 新娘坐在床沿，向导叫我们其中一位男士去掀开头盖，并说不要钱，因上过〝抽签不要钱〞的当，不知〝掀开头盖不要钱〞之后，那〝媳妇〞可能会狮子 开大口，所以全部男人都没去入情关，最后还是新娘自己掀开头盖，并唱了一曲未〝嫁〞出也得哭出的〝哭嫁〞。
d4a56b228b2fe32959ac5dbe699555974802307b.translatedText: There are many natural villages in Zhangjiajie. The terraced villages and villages are looming in the haze, which is very beautiful. It is worth mentioning the Folk Customs Grand View Garden in the Tujia Village in Yuanjiajie. It concentrates the display of humanities and customs in a village, and with live demonstrations, a three-dimensional Tujia history and reality are all displayed in front of you, adding humanistic beauty to Zhangjiajie's natural fantasy. During the visit, we experienced the customs and charm of western Hunan and the unique "Nuo" (pronounced "Luo" pronunciation) culture. There are many forms of Nuo, many of which are similar to what we call "witchcraft", such as releasing poison, or what Southeast Asia calls "dropping the head". Therefore, the girls in western Hunan are not afraid that their lovers will fly away, because they have their own secret magic to keep the unfaithful lovers captive. There is also "crying marriage" in the village. "Crying marriage" is a unique custom of the Tujia people and has been followed since ancient times. Through crying and singing, it vividly expresses the complex and delicate emotions hidden in the girl's heart. Half a month before the wedding, the bride begins to cry and sing, in the form of one person crying, two people crying in pairs, or multiple people crying together. The contents of the crying songs mostly include crying about parents' nurturing kindness, the separation between brother, sister-in-law and sister, scolding the matchmaker, etc. We arrived at a wedding room. There was a word "福" in front of the door. This character "福" has not been seen in the "Hundred Blessings Picture". It is composed of two ethnic minority men and women dancing together, which is very artistic and dynamic. In the wedding room, there was a bride sitting on the edge of the bed. The guide asked one of us men to lift the veil and said that there was no money. Because he had been deceived by "drawing lots for no money", he didn't know that after "lifting the veil for free", the "daughter-in-law" might become a lion. She opened her mouth widely, so all the men didn't fall in love. In the end, the bride opened her head and sang a song called "Crying for Marriage" that she had to cry even before she was "married".

61fcf863fa4b4750d79103c4f47f7700850adea8.sourceText: 6. 贺龙青铜雕像 天子山的贺龙公园矗立着一座巨大的青铜雕像，贺龙元帅凝视远方，战马陪伴身旁，他岩石样状的身体造型与周边的山的质体合而为一。 贺龙是湖南省相西桑植县人，今属张家界，有白族血统。 贺龙早在1914年加入孙中山领导的中华革命党。 自称两把菜刀起家。 曾任讨袁护国军指挥，1927年任八一南昌起义的总指挥，1928年开辟了湘鄂和洪湖根据地。 他的故乡桑植有5万多人参加红军游击队和地方红色政权，其中为革命牺牲的达5000多人。 但这位曾使敌人闻风丧胆的开国元帅，在文革期间却饱受迫害至死，火化后连骨灰盒上的名字都是化名。 2011年，一生戎马命运多舛的贺龙元帅终于回到了自己的故乡，在天子山壮美的风景中安息。 贺龙的青铜雕像挺拔而自然，充满感染力，具有独特人文价值，他让人沉思生命的意义。
61fcf863fa4b4750d79103c4f47f7700850adea8.translatedText: 6. Bronze Statue of He Long A huge bronze statue stands in He Long Park in Tianzi Mountain. Marshal He Long stares into the distance, with his war horse accompanying him. His rock-like body shape merges with the surrounding mountains. He Long was a native of Sangzhi County, Xiangxi, Hunan Province, which now belongs to Zhangjiajie, and was of Bai descent. He Long joined the Chinese Revolutionary Party led by Sun Yat-sen as early as 1914. Claims to have started with two kitchen knives. He once served as the commander of the army against Yuan Huguo. In 1927, he was appointed as the commander-in-chief of the August 1st Nanchang Uprising. In 1928, he opened up the Hunan-Hubei and Honghu base areas. In his hometown of Sangzhi, more than 50,000 people participated in the Red Army guerrillas and the local red regime, and more than 5,000 of them died for the revolution. But this founding marshal who once made his enemies frightened was persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution. After he was cremated, even the name on the urn was a pseudonym. In 2011, Marshal He Long, who had an ill-fated military career, finally returned to his hometown and rested in peace in the magnificent scenery of Tianzi Mountain. He Long's bronze statues are tall and natural, full of appeal, and have unique humanistic value. They make people ponder the meaning of life.

fb3e434b3496571f0e20ed51caafdbf9b97b09a7.sourceText: 贺龙的青铜雕像充满感染力
fb3e434b3496571f0e20ed51caafdbf9b97b09a7.translatedText: He Long's bronze statue is full of appeal

101633f1ce201f595da98a9b5fa71fd9afaa442e.sourceText: 袁家界风景以雄、奇、险、峻着称，在十多华里的环山游道上，沿途景色美不胜数，可观赏到电影《阿凡达》中〝哈利路亚山〞原型〝南天 一柱〞、世上落差最高的天然桥，还有被命名的九天玄梯、八卦图、猿人望月、拜仙台等景点。 从天子山另一端下山返回，需走四千梯级，下山腿抖的经验以前在黄山已尝试过，考虑到以后还有的长旅途，我们选择坐缆车下山。 但缆车在中途却骤停了数分钟，人晃车动，令人提心吊胆。 不过停车的高处恰能见到张家界著名的〝仙女献花〞，此景维妙维肖，赶紧拍下。 到达平地后，有〝十里画廊〞风景区观赏，坐小火车游可浏览张家界十大绝景中的采药老人、金鸡报晓、天狗望月等奇山怪石。 在天子山是从高处腑瞰，在这里是抬头仰视，所以感到别有一番神采。
101633f1ce201f595da98a9b5fa71fd9afaa442e.translatedText: > The scenery of Yuanjiajie is famous for its majesty, wonder, danger and precipitousness. On the more than ten miles of mountain tour, the scenery along the way is countless. You can see the southern sky, the prototype of "Hallelujah Mountain" in the movie "Avatar" "One Pillar", the natural bridge with the highest drop in the world, as well as the named Jiutian Xuan Ladder, Bagua Diagram, Ape Man Looking at the Moon, Worshiping Immortal Platform and other scenic spots. Going back down from the other end of Tianzi Mountain requires walking up 4,000 steps. The experience of going down the mountain with shaking legs has been tried before in Huangshan. Considering the long journey in the future, we chose to take the cable car down the mountain. However, the cable car suddenly stopped for several minutes in the middle of the journey. People were shaking and the car was moving, which was scary. However, you can see the famous "Fairy Flowers Presenting" in Zhangjiajie from the high place where you parked your car. This scene is so lifelike that I quickly took a photo. After reaching the plains, you can visit the "Shili Gallery" scenic spot. You can take a small train tour to see the old man picking medicine, the golden rooster crowing at dawn, the tengu looking at the moon and other strange mountains and rocks that are among the top ten scenic spots in Zhangjiajie. In Tianzi Mountain, you look down from a high place, but here you look up, so you feel a different spirit.

e8362d0975e2a5b5724fa02beeea5c10d9365c02.sourceText: 8.张家界 魅力湘西 ”观奇山秀水，晚上赏魅力湘西”张家界前，已听闻这是要必须观赏的节目。 ” 张家界魅力湘西”，是中国旅游景区最大综合性演艺基地，初创于2000年，历经10年，发展成如今2600座位的湘西国际文化广场。 文化广场也是张家界民族建筑地标，古朴大气，刚劲浑厚，彰显浓郁的大湘西民族风。 据闻”魅力湘西”创作团队扎根大湘西地区的原始村寨采风，搜集、发掘，整理出大湘西民族、民俗、民间文化，还将一批民间艺人请出山寨、请上舞台，使诸多隐匿深山 、濒临失传的大湘西的活化石展现在大舞台上。 全场晚会饱含快乐与浪漫、激情与狂野，表演到最后是把舞台移至室外展开篝火盛典。 ” 魅力湘西”经过十年的砥砺，由著名学者、文艺学教授担当总策划，黄永玉题写”魅力湘西”墨宝，宋祖英演唱主题歌，众多的艺术家出任艺术顾问。 让这场大型民族歌舞成为湖南旅游演艺界的金字招牌，在大陆、港澳台日韩、东南亚等地享有较高知名度。
e8362d0975e2a5b5724fa02beeea5c10d9365c02.translatedText: 8. Zhangjiajie Charming Xiangxi "Watch the amazing mountains and beautiful waters, and enjoy the charming Xiangxi at night" Before Zhangjiajie, I had heard that this was a must-see program. "Zhangjiajie Charming Xiangxi" is the largest comprehensive performing arts base in China's tourist attractions. It was founded in 2000 and has developed into the 2,600-seat Xiangxi International Cultural Plaza after 10 years. The Cultural Square is also the national architectural landmark of Zhangjiajie. It is simple and majestic, vigorous and vigorous, showing the strong ethnic style of Western Hunan. It is said that the "Charming Xiangxi" creative team took root in the original villages in the greater Xiangxi area to collect, excavate, and sort out the ethnic groups, folk customs, and folk culture of the greater Xiangxi. They also invited a group of folk artists out of the villages and onto the stage, so that many living fossils of the greater Xiangxi that were hidden deep in the mountains and were on the verge of being lost were displayed on the big stage. The entire party was full of happiness and romance, passion and wildness. At the end of the performance, the stage was moved outdoors for a bonfire ceremony. After ten years of hard work, "Charming Xiangxi" is led by a famous scholar and professor of literature and art as the chief planner. Huang Yongyu inscribed the "Charming Xiangxi" calligraphy, Song Zuying sang the theme song, and many artists served as art consultants. This large-scale ethnic song and dance has become a golden signature of Hunan's tourism and entertainment industry, and enjoys a high reputation in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, and Southeast Asia.

02dc487c1c98a52a82f2ad4d44ed5c0cebc2d40e.translatedText: 9. Drumming and driving corpses in western Hunan

6868b14049cc4efb7abfb43bde00b9cb00ca7c5a.sourceText: 湘西苗族鼓舞，是苗族地区最独特的舞蹈。 它流传在湖南省湘西土家族苗族治州境内。 苗族鼓舞历史悠久，源于汉代以前，产生在苗族祭礼活动中。 开幕式中的鼓 舞场盛大，甚具感染力，我还拍下视频，留日后再欣赏。 另一场《英魂归乡湘西赶尸》亦令人震撼。 〝赶尸〞展示了湘西悠久的巫术文化和远古传说。 这是一场真实历史的展演，描绘了清朝时湘军在战争中战死他乡的悲壮场面,再现了湘西土家族抗倭英雄在浙江抗倭全部牺牲后，由赶尸道士将其尸体还魂，使其 能够站立行走并千里迢迢地赶回到故土。 在荒山野岭，崎岖山路，树木黑糊，夜空冷月，万籁寂静中，突然传来清脆的铃铛，一队赶路人出现在人迹罕见的山路，铃铛声和脚步声越来越近，那 脚步声很古怪，是几双脚同时在朝前跳，走在前面的人穿着一件深蓝色的道袍，背着一个包。 边走边摇铃，后面跟着高高矮矮几个人，都戴着高筒毡帽，穿着宽大的黑袍子，看不到他们的脸，因为他们的额头上粘着黄表纸，垂下来，上面画着 怪兮兮的符，这是被赶的尸体。 他们上肢平伸，身体僵硬，跳得很整齐，很生硬。 湘西古老的赶尸场面出现了！ 空旷的山野间，只有那恐怖的铃声特别刺耳！ 湘西赶尸满足观众的猎奇心理，令人过目不忘。 节目的最后，表演场地移到场外，在熊熊的篝火前演出土家硬气功表演，湘西三大蛊迷巫术（上刀梯、走铁梨、下火海）等鬼谷神功尽现眼前。 〝魅力湘西〞的表演相当精采，让人感受到湘西独特的地理人文文化。
6868b14049cc4efb7abfb43bde00b9cb00ca7c5a.translatedText: Miao drumming in western Hunan is the most unique dance in the Miao area. It spreads in the territory governed by the Tujia and Miao ethnic groups in Xiangxi, Hunan Province. Miao drumming has a long history, originating before the Han Dynasty and occurring in Miao ritual activities. The encouraging performance at the opening ceremony was grand and contagious. I even took a video of it to enjoy later. Another scene, "The Return of Heroes to Xiangxi to Exorcise Corpses", was also shocking. "Corpse Driving" showcases the long-standing witchcraft culture and ancient legends of western Hunan. This is a real historical performance that depicts the tragic scenes of Hunan troops who died in wars in foreign lands during the Qing Dynasty. It also reproduces the tragic scene of the Tujia nationality heroes in western Hunan who died in the anti-Japanese war in Zhejiang. After all the heroes died in the anti-Japanese war in Zhejiang, their corpses were brought back to life by Taoist exorcists, so that they could stand and walk and rushed back to their homeland all the way. In the wild mountains, rugged mountain roads, dark trees, cold moon in the night sky, and silence, a clear bell suddenly sounded, and a group of travelers appeared on the rarely visited mountain road. The sound of the bell and the sound of footsteps were getting closer and closer. The footsteps were weird, they were several pairs of feet jumping forward at the same time. The person walking in front was wearing a dark blue robe and carrying a bag. Ringing the bell as they walked, they were followed by several tall and short people, all wearing tall felt hats and loose black robes. Their faces could not be seen because their foreheads had yellow paper hanging down with strange symbols drawn on it. These were the corpses of those who had been driven away. Their upper limbs are stretched flat, their bodies are stiff, and they dance neatly and stiffly. The ancient scene of driving corpses in western Hunan appears! In the empty mountains and fields, only the terrifying ringtone was particularly harsh! The exorcism of corpses in western Hunan satisfies the audience's curiosity and is unforgettable. At the end of the program, the performance venue was moved to the outside, and a Tujia Hard Qigong performance was performed in front of a roaring bonfire. The three major Gu magic arts in western Hunan (Climbing the Knife Ladder, Walking on the Iron Pear, and Walking down the Sea of ​​Fire) and other Guigu magical skills were all in front of you. The performance of "Charming Xiangxi" is very exciting, allowing people to feel the unique geography and human culture of Xiangxi.

e11bba83e5dff8660fef4fe760afdf6ee7d791aa.sourceText: 今年度的第一次聚会我们邀请到谢健明先生为我们作一场有趣的示范. 跟我们许多人一样,谢先生几年前才从最基本的单眼相机开始. 为了留下孩子们成长的珍贵镜头, 谢先生开始鑽研摄影. 听起来跟我们的故事很像吧.除了增添好(贵的)镜头,他不断地实验操作而进步神速. 请与我们一起掌玩谢先生的器材, 观看即时操作在家裡就能複製的採光特效.
e11bba83e5dff8660fef4fe760afdf6ee7d791aa.translatedText: At the first gathering of this year, we invited Mr. Xie Jianming to give us an interesting demonstration. Like many of us, Mr. Xie started with the most basic single-lens camera a few years ago. In order to leave precious shots of his children's growth, Mr. Xie began to delve into photography. It sounds very similar to our story. In addition to adding good (expensive) lenses, he continued to experiment and operate and made rapid progress. Please play with Mr. Xie's equipment with us and watch the lighting effects that can be replicated at home through real-time operation.

92548c391787d799a969ea12d96bf4515575f973.sourceText: 另外, 本会创办人黄一帆先生将与我们分享去年十二月份日本之行所照令人陶醉的冬景. 我们也将回顾日渐流行的小型可交换镜头高画质相机如SONY NEX, Panasonicand Olympus?Micro 4/3系列. 带你的朋友一起来参加日益扩大的亚省亚裔摄影协会.
92548c391787d799a969ea12d96bf4515575f973.translatedText: In addition, The founder of our association, Mr. Huang Yifan, will share with us the intoxicating winter scenery he took during his trip to Japan last December. We will also review the increasingly popular small high-definition cameras with interchangeable lenses such as SONY NEX, Panasonic and Olympus? Micro 4/3 series. Bring your friends and join the growing Asian Asian Photography Association of Alberta.

21058b148e3bb6cb9141d8897e53f7c4648692d8.sourceText: 国会参议院军事委员会首席成员麦凯恩 1 月 17 日称，美国将继续加强与太平洋盟友的海军合作，然而，美国没有必要对抗中国。但是，麦凯恩在讲话中将” 中国南海” 称为” 西菲律宾海” 。 白宫在 2012 年伊始公布的新军事战略，为其 2011 年” 大踏步重入亚洲” 战略划下浓墨重彩的一笔，围困中国的架势愈趋明显。鉴于南海问题的愈趋白热化，美国希望通过海空实力保护其南海” 国家利益” ，应对中国在该地区的军事布控。 麦凯恩以及康涅狄格州参议员利伯曼 17 日开始为期三天的马尼拉之行，两位美国官员将与菲律宾讨论海上安全事宜。谈及中国南海问题时，麦凯恩称，美国” 没有必要与中国进行任何形式的对抗。” 但是，麦凯恩也表示，美国与此区域的盟友加强联系非常重要，” 特别是在西菲律宾海” 。 ” 我们认为，对于美国、菲律宾以及其他东亚国家，强调保护海上航行自由非常重要”。 利伯曼则称，富有争议争议的海域不但对区域，而且对世界经济都” 尤为重要” 。 ” 我们绝对不能让一个国家，这里指的是中国，对这些水道通路行使不相称的控制。” 利伯曼称，美国继续加强与菲律宾的军事力量，以及扩大在此区域的存在，将有利于防止敌对。 麦凯恩以及利伯曼这一表态虽不直接代表美国政府的观点和今后在南海问题上的政策走向，但对实际方针的制定大有影响，且与 10 日在华府召开的南海战略报告发布会所得出要构建” 新伙伴安全网” 的观点极为相近。 就麦凯恩对菲律宾的表现而言，其实早在 2011 年 1 月就有过类似之举；麦凯恩与菲律宾外交部长在华盛顿会面时，便呼吁美国要加大对东南亚国家的军事和政治支持，以便在南海问题上抗衡中国，” 美国应该帮助东盟国家，在争议海域发展和部署预警系统和巡逻舰艇” 。
21058b148e3bb6cb9141d8897e53f7c4648692d8.translatedText: McCain, the ranking member of the Senate Armed Services Committee, said on January 17 that the United States will continue to strengthen naval cooperation with its Pacific allies. However, there is no need for the United States to confront China. However, McCain referred to the "South China Sea" as the "West Philippine Sea" in his speech. The new military strategy announced by the White House at the beginning of 2012 marked an important milestone in its 2011 "Striding Back into Asia" strategy, and the posture of besieging China became increasingly obvious. In view of the increasingly intense South China Sea issue, the United States hopes to protect its "national interests" in the South China Sea through its naval and air capabilities and respond to China's military control in the region. McCain and Connecticut Senator Lieberman will begin a three-day trip to Manila on the 17th. The two US officials will discuss maritime security issues with the Philippines. When talking about the South China Sea issue, McCain said that the United States "does not need to engage in any form of confrontation with China." However, McCain also said that it is very important for the United States to strengthen ties with its allies in the region, "especially in the West Philippine Sea." "We believe that it is very important for the United States, the Philippines and other East Asian countries to emphasize the protection of freedom of navigation at sea." Lieberman said the disputed waters are "particularly important" not only to the region but also to the world economy. "We must not allow one country, in this case China, to exercise disproportionate control over these waterways." Lieberman said that the United States' continued strengthening of military forces with the Philippines and expanding its presence in the region will help prevent hostilities. Although the statements of McCain and Lieberman do not directly represent the views of the U.S. government and future policy directions on the South China Sea issue, they have a great influence on the formulation of actual policies and are very similar to the view of building a "new partnership safety network" reached at the South China Sea Strategy Report Conference held in Washington on the 10th. As far as McCain's performance towards the Philippines is concerned, a similar move was actually made as early as January 2011; when McCain met with the Philippine Foreign Minister in Washington, he called on the United States to increase military and political support for Southeast Asian countries in order to counter China on the South China Sea issue. "The United States should help ASEAN countries develop and deploy early warning systems and patrol ships in disputed waters."

c0b3b0d056189174ecd1688dcc03ccacbc746796.sourceText: 「头号通缉犯」色魔判囚560年 (亚省时报) 47岁的维特塞克(Arthur Leon Vitasek)是亚利桑纳州史上犯桉最多的色魔，被谑称为「美国头号通缉犯」，他因性侵犯八名男孩，13日被判处560年监禁。 维特塞克被控与未成年人进行性行为、非礼儿童和当众进行猥亵性行为等26项罪名，去年11月全部成立，被玛利科巴郡高等法官莱恩斯坦重判。 1990年开始，维特塞克在凤凰城及美莎市和天堂谷的郊区，性侵8名7至15岁男孩。当局说，维特塞克经常以贫困的单身母亲为目标，向她们供应物资，送许多礼物给她们的儿子和照顾他们。 维特塞克逃亡超过一年半后，2006年9月在德州被捕。他被捕前，电视节目「美国通缉要犯」多次报导他的桉件。 一名16岁少年报警，称在网上认识维特塞克后遭他性侵，警察后来在达拉斯郊区逮捕他。 大草原城警方说，维特塞克当时使用洛珀这个名字，一名侦探认出他，并多次质疑他的身分后，他终于承认自己的身分。 维特塞克对警方说，他已厌倦被通缉，并对结束逃亡生涯鬆了一口气。
c0b3b0d056189174ecd1688dcc03ccacbc746796.translatedText: "The most wanted criminal" was sentenced to 560 years in prison (Alberta Times) 47-year-old Arthur Leon Vitasek Vitasek, the most prolific sex offender in Arizona history and nicknamed "America's Most Wanted", was sentenced to 560 years in prison on the 13th for sexually assaulting eight boys. Witsek was charged with 26 counts of engaging in sexual conduct with a minor, indecent assault on a child, and engaging in lewd sexual conduct in public. He was all convicted in November last year and was sentenced heavily by Maricopa County Superior Judge Leinstein. Beginning in 1990, Witsek sexually assaulted eight boys aged 7 to 15 in Phoenix and the suburbs of Mesa and Paradise Valley. Authorities said Witsek often targeted poor single mothers, supplying them with supplies, showering their sons with gifts and caring for them. Witsek was arrested in Texas in September 2006 after more than a year and a half on the run. Before his arrest, the TV program "America's Most Wanted" reported on his case many times. Police arrested a 16-year-old boy in a Dallas suburb after he called police and said he was sexually assaulted by Witsek after meeting him online. Grand Prairie police said Witsek, who went by the name Loper at the time, finally admitted his identity after a detective recognized him and questioned his identity multiple times. Witsek told police he was tired of being wanted and was relieved to be on the run.

76ebde82b7ee87ea47a25ed47e66048d361321ad.sourceText: 美国伊利诺伊州一名女子竟然带着5岁儿子与男友一起抢银行，日前被抓获后被控虐待儿童罪和抢劫罪。 这名女子名叫劳里卢布尔，来自伊利诺伊州安提俄克。她和男友布兰登斯坦克里夫被指控于2011年12月29日持刀抢劫了沃康达社区银行。卢布尔在被捕后表示，斯坦克里夫从她家的厨房拿走了一把切肉刀、戴着一方大手帕，叫上卢布尔和她年仅5岁的儿子一同驾车前往银行。到银行外面后，为了查探当时银行内到底有多少名出纳在上班，卢布尔先行进入，并询问工作人员银行里是否有点钞机。随后，斯坦克里夫用手帕蒙面进入银行，他在出纳面前出示了切肉刀，在抢到4800美元后逃之夭夭。随后有人举报了二人身份，警方于2011年12月30日将他们逮捕。 本月12日，卢布尔在支付了5000美元保释金后获假释，她告诉美国联邦调查局的探员称，对于抢劫银行时还带上儿子、让他置身于危险之中，自己感到很后悔。不过卢布尔悔之晚矣，伊利诺伊州儿童和家庭服务部表示已着手调查卢布尔及其男友，他们涉嫌犯有儿童虐待与忽视罪。但该部发言人没有透露涉桉男孩现在的情况。
76ebde82b7ee87ea47a25ed47e66048d361321ad.translatedText: A woman in Illinois, USA, took her 5-year-old son and her boyfriend to rob a bank. She was recently arrested and charged with child abuse and robbery. The woman's name is Laurie Ruble, from Antioch, Illinois. She and her boyfriend, Brandon Stancliffe, are accused of robbing a Wauconda Community Bank at knifepoint on Dec. 29, 2011. Ruble said after her arrest that Stancliffe took a meat cleaver from her kitchen and, wearing a bandana, asked Ruble and her 5-year-old son to drive to the bank with her. After arriving outside the bank, in order to find out how many tellers were working in the bank at that time, Ruble entered first and asked the staff if there was a money counting machine in the bank. Stancliffe then entered the bank, masked with a handkerchief, showed the meat cleaver in front of the teller, and fled after grabbing $4,800. Later, someone reported their identities, and the police arrested them on December 30, 2011. On the 12th of this month, Ruble was released on parole after paying a $5,000 bail. She told FBI agents that she regretted taking her son with her during the bank robbery and putting him in danger. However, it was too late for Ruble to regret it. The Illinois Department of Children and Family Services said it had begun investigating Ruble and her boyfriend on suspicion of child abuse and neglect. But a spokesman for the ministry did not disclose the current condition of the boy involved.

Deng Yanling, president of the Asian Chamber of Commerce, said on Tuesday, "We will join with our African-American and Latino brothers and sisters to demand Apao's resignation." "His entanglement with Hispanics, legal or illegal, shows that Apao has gone too far." Hirano, chairman of Asia Pacific Joint Action, said that many Asian Americans have recently moved out of the state because of racial conflicts, which is related to the police chief's strict law enforcement.

b8d78dedb176b4027818945992787051051d4c0d.translatedText: >POWEERBALL lottery ticket price increases from 1 yuan to 2 yuan (Alberta Times) Lotto tickets will increase from one yuan to two yuan starting from January 15. The price increase coincides with the 20th anniversary of the release of POWERBALL. According to POWERBALL officials, although the price of lottery tickets has increased, the chance of winning has decreased. This is because the number of colored balls will increase from 39 to 35. Currently, the huge cumulative prize has reached 40 million US dollars, and the second prize (guessing 5 numbers correctly) has increased from 200,000 to 1 million. Wednesday's jackpot was $80 million.

c8de9e5f20f470fad6a26df5ea48c2e51df00d50.sourceText: ASU校园附近的Townhouse抢手 ASU是全美最大的大学校区，在校生在6万人左右，因为租房客源量大，ASU附件的Townhouse成为了很多投资者的最爱。2011年4月ASU附近的小区，2005年的房子，正常销售的价格1088平方英尺价格10.8万。2012年1月同等大小的房子短售屋的价格已经达到了13万。两个卧室两个卫生间的房屋，租金可以稳定在1200-1400美元每月。ASU附近的小区目前的房源变得十分紧俏，刚上市的房子，就能在很短的时间内收到多个报价。90年代，80年代的房子也依然受到投资者的亲睐，价格会低一些，但是租金价格差别不大，由于房屋的年限不同，在重新销售的时候，价格会有不同。更多房地产信息请咨询金信地产公司Tinna 480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
c8de9e5f20f470fad6a26df5ea48c2e51df00d50.translatedText: >Townhouses near the ASU campus are in high demand. ASU is the largest university campus in the United States, with about 60,000 students on campus. Due to the large number of renters, the Townhouse near ASU has become the favorite of many investors. In April 2011, a 2005 house in a community near ASU, the normal sales price was 108,000 square feet for 1,088 square feet. In January 2012, the short-sale price of a house of the same size reached 130,000. For a house with two bedrooms and two bathrooms, the rent can be stable at US$1,200-1,400 per month. The housing supply in the communities near ASU has become very tight at present, and houses that have just been put on the market can receive multiple offers in a very short period of time. In the 1990s and 1980s, houses were still favored by investors. The prices would be lower, but the rental prices would not be much different. Due to the different age of the houses, the prices would be different when they are resold. For more real estate information, please contact Tinna of Goldtrust Realty Company 480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

7b0e519bdbe4a976978e527dda88bd2a6b01961c.sourceText: 美国2012年大选拉开序幕 随着2012年新年的来临，全美各地洋溢着喜气和欢乐的气氛，然而，在美国中西部小州艾奥瓦的空气中处处洋溢的却是”政治的因子”，两天之后，美国总统大选首场”前哨战”将在该州正式开打，标志着美国大选的序幕正式拉开。 对于共和党的7名总统参选人而言，他们很快将发现华裔选民是他们最难攻克的”堡垒”——多年来，华裔一直是全美选民登记率和投票率最低的族裔之一。 ”艾奥瓦州的共和党初选已进入白热化，美国各族裔选民热情高涨，然而相当多的华裔选民仍持’事不关己’的态度，参与大选意愿不高。”艾奥瓦州华人协会执行主席燕晓哲在接受中新社记者采访时如是说。 在100多年的历史上，华裔在美国政治生活中的声音一直甚微，”只顾个人事业，不问国家兴衰”成了华人普遍的心态。特别是美国1882年通过的”排华法案”给华人造成长期的政治伤痕，复杂的心理情结使华人在不知不觉中砌起一堵拒绝参政的墙。 燕晓哲是艾奥瓦州总统大选志愿人员的组织者之一，在过去几届总统大选中，他曾帮助多名候选人拉选票、募捐款，而华裔对政治的冷漠时常让他深感挫折，在他看来这等于放弃自己的政治权利。 ”艾奥瓦州是确定美国总统的第一步，是通向白宫之路的第一站，各个总统候选人都不惜重金在此造势，现在7名共和党参选人中有5名最近半年几乎’常驻’艾奥瓦。”燕晓哲认为，华裔选民在该州的表现会直接影响到总统候选人在整个竞选过程中对华裔的重视程度。 燕晓哲告诉记者，从1972年开始美国两党就确立艾奥瓦州为初选第一州，原因之一就是该州民主党和共和党支持者各占一半，华人对两党的支持情况也大体如此。据他介绍，目前艾奥瓦州三百万人口中华人只有一万人左右，其中有5000人左右具有公民身份和投票资格，共和党的支持者约2500人，但真正出来参与此次共和党预选的华人预计只有一千多人。 在燕晓哲看来，虽然华裔人数不多，但却常常能够发挥“最后一根稻草”的关键作用。在2008年民主党的总统候选人预选中，希拉里就是以几千张选票之差输给奥巴马。 根据最新民调，共和党总统参选人中排名领先的罗姆尼与保罗在艾奥瓦州的支持率分别为23%和21%，只差两个百分点。而民主党的奥巴马与潜在的共和党对手罗姆尼之间的支持率分别为47%和46%，也仅相差一个百分点。 目前全美华裔约有400万，约占美国人口的1.3%，虽然人数不多，但在目前共和党参选人及其领先的候选人与奥巴马的支持率不相上下的情况下，这1.3%完全可能成为“关键的少数”。 分析人士认为，这”关键的少数”并非政治虚构，而是具有实际意义，若华裔选民投票率不高，就可能失去争取成为亚裔社群中坚力量的最佳机会，也会长时间失去两大主流政党的重视，因此决不能掉以轻心。 燕晓哲指出，一些华人对选举期间各候选人争相拿中国大做文章颇为不满，但实际上主动权在华人自己手中，”根据我的经验，凡是我到场的场合，一般总统候选人在对华问题上就会有所收敛，有时一些候选人在台面上攻击中国，走下台来还会跟我道歉。” 对于现在经常拿中国说事的罗姆尼和金里奇等人，燕晓哲认为这是选战语言不足为虑，实际上这些人一旦入主白宫后就会变得相当务实，因为他们都跟中国有过实际的交往或生意往来。 目前对华态度最强硬的罗姆尼日前已被美国媒体曝光过去几年来一直靠在中国的生意发财。金里奇在当任众议长期间也曾是对华”强硬派”，但在对中国几次访问之后开始抛弃原来的想法，在本次大选中，他强调应该和中国人民保持友好关系，12月18日他还曾到洛杉矶中国城拜票，成为第一个造访华裔社区的共和党参选人。 ”华人只有主动发声才能引起美国政客的重视和尊重。”2008年曾全力帮助奥巴马拉选票的燕晓哲透露，到现在奥巴马的团队仍记着他，2010年奥巴马曾邀请他到白宫出席庆祝亚裔传统月的总统招待酒会，就在四个月前，奥巴马还专门给他发了一封贺信，祝贺他赴美20周年。
7b0e519bdbe4a976978e527dda88bd2a6b01961c.translatedText: The 2012 U.S. election kicks off. With the advent of the 2012 New Year, the United States is filled with an atmosphere of joy and joy. However, in the small Midwestern state of Iowa, the air is filled with "political factors." Two days later, the first "frontline battle" of the U.S. presidential election will officially begin in this state, marking the official start of the U.S. election. For the seven Republican presidential candidates, they will soon find that Chinese-American voters are their most difficult "fortress" to conquer - for many years, Chinese-Americans have been one of the lowest voter registration and turnout rates in the United States. "The Republican primaries in Iowa have entered a fever pitch, and voters of all ethnic groups in the United States are very enthusiastic. However, a considerable number of Chinese voters still hold a 'nothing to do with themselves' attitude and are not willing to participate in the general election." Yan Xiaozhe, executive chairman of the Iowa Chinese Association, said in an interview with a reporter from China News Service. In the history of more than 100 years, the voice of Chinese Americans has been very small in American political life. "Only caring about personal career and not caring about the prosperity and decline of the country" has become a common mentality among Chinese people. In particular, the "Chinese Exclusion Act" passed by the United States in 1882 caused long-term political scars on the Chinese. Their complex psychological complex made the Chinese unknowingly build a wall to refuse to participate in politics. Yan Xiaozhe is one of the volunteer organizers of the Iowa presidential election. In the past several presidential elections, he has helped many candidates canvass votes and raise donations. He has often been deeply frustrated by the indifference of Chinese Americans to politics. In his view, this is tantamount to giving up their political rights. "Iowa is the first step in determining the president of the United States and the first stop on the road to the White House. All presidential candidates have spent a lot of money to build momentum here. Now five of the seven Republican candidates have been almost 'permanent' in Iowa in the past six months." Yan Xiaozhe believes that the performance of Chinese-American voters in the state will directly affect the importance that presidential candidates attach to Chinese-Americans throughout the campaign. Yan Xiaozhe told reporters that since 1972, the two parties in the United States have established Iowa as the first state for primary elections. One of the reasons is that the state has half Democratic and half Republican supporters, and the Chinese support for the two parties is generally the same. According to him, there are currently only about 10,000 Chinese out of a population of 3 million in Iowa, of which about 5,000 have citizenship and voting qualifications. There are about 2,500 supporters of the Republican Party, but it is expected that only more than 1,000 Chinese will actually come out to participate in the Republican primary elections. In Yan Xiaozhe's view, although the number of Chinese Americans is not large, they can often play a key role as the "last straw". In the 2008 Democratic presidential primary, Hillary lost to Obama by a few thousand votes. According to the latest polls, Romney and Paul, the leading Republican presidential candidates, have support rates in Iowa of 23% and 21% respectively, with only a two-point difference. The support rates between Democratic Party Obama and potential Republican opponent Romney are 47% and 46% respectively, which is only one percentage point difference. There are currently about 4 million Chinese Americans in the United States, accounting for about 1.3% of the U.S. population. Although the number is small, with the current support rate of Republican candidates and their leading candidates being comparable to Obama's, this 1.3% may become a "critical minority." Analysts believe that this "critical minority" is not a political fiction, but has practical significance. If the turnout rate of Chinese voters is not high, they may lose the best opportunity to become the backbone of the Asian community and lose the attention of the two mainstream political parties for a long time. Therefore, they must not be taken lightly. Yan Xiaozhe pointed out that some Chinese are quite dissatisfied with the candidates competing to make a fuss about China during the election, but in fact the initiative lies in the hands of the Chinese themselves. "According to my experience, whenever I am present, the general presidential candidates will restrain themselves on China issues. Sometimes some candidates attack China on the stage and apologize to me when they come off the stage." Regarding Romney, Gingrich and others who often talk about China, Yan Xiaozhe believes that this is nothing to worry about because of their campaign language. In fact, these people will become quite pragmatic once they enter the White House because they have all had actual contacts or business dealings with China. Romney, who currently has the toughest attitude towards China, has been exposed by the US media that he has been relying on Chinese business to make a fortune in the past few years. Gingrich was also a "hardliner" on China when he was the Speaker of the House of Representatives, but after several visits to China, he began to abandon his original ideas. In this election, he emphasized that he should maintain friendly relations with the Chinese people. On December 18, he also went to Los Angeles' Chinatown to seek votes, becoming the first Republican candidate to visit the Chinese community. "Only when Chinese people take the initiative to speak out can they attract the attention and respect of American politicians." Yan Xiaozhe, who worked hard to help Obama win votes in 2008, revealed that Obama's team still remembers him. In 2010, Obama invited him to the White House to attend a presidential reception to celebrate Asian Heritage Month. Just four months ago, Obama sent him a special congratulatory letter to congratulate him on his 20th anniversary in the United States.

cfd6c326923ddd59d06b0e525122f98bcb11e820.translatedText: Home Depot is hiring 1,000 positions in Phoenix (Alberta Times) Home Depot recently issued a recruitment request to hire 1,000 seasonal employees at 26 home improvement stores in the Phoenix area to handle annual spring tree planting and home renovations. Atlanta-based Home Depot, which has 56 stores in the state, plans to hire 7,000 seasonal positions across the state, including cashiers, sales associates, nursery workers, vehicle loaders and other positions. Part-time positions usually last for around 120 days, but many temporary positions can be converted to permanent positions. Home Depot is one of Arizona's largest employers, employing more than 8,500 people locally. Job seekers may apply online at: www.careers.homedepot.com.

3cdc3b83f1a1f3c1b13cf23d2f7fea447d09d92b.sourceText: 侨社人物（５）－邓朝泽 路遥知马力 日久见人心 邓朝泽于一九二一年出生在广东开平县护龙保安里。一九四0年来美，先到美莎市，在其伯父经营的杂货店工作，并入西人中学，半工半读。第二次世界大战爆发，他到加州一间国防船厂工作，后参加承耕日本人因战争而荒出的庄园，至大战结束。自一九四九年起，他与同宗兄弟邓根生合伙，先后在斐匿市及棉花树埠开设杂货店，直到一九七一年退休。 邓朝泽夫妇恩爱，儿女学有所长各有成就，孙儿精乖伶俐。他退休之后，大可靠自己的积蓄，坐享清福。然而，他热心于为侨社工作，不遗余力地为乡亲同胞服务。 他自一九七一年担任斐匿邓高密公所中文书记开始，就一直在当地侨团任职。历任斐匿的邓高密公所主席、英端工商分会会长、华裔总会会长、侨团联合总会主席，全美华人福利会西南支会常务委员、总会理事等等，现仍为这些团体的顾问或议长。近二十年来，他为他为当地侨社做了许许多多的有益工作。 早在筹建和扩建斐匿邓高密公所期间，他就与其他宗长们一起，积极进行募捐筹款和策划与兴建的工作。在斐匿英端工商分会开展为维护华人权益和为侨胞领取学车纸等服务工作，在斐匿华商总会加强与政府和各界人士的联络沟通华人华人商业发展的渠道，以致设立华人防治癌症医疗保险业务，在斐匿侨团联合总会筹划建立会址及开办中文学校的过程中，这一系列有益于侨胞事情，他都是积极倡议者、服务者、支持者。 一九八六年，全美华人福利会第十一届代表大会在拉斯维加斯召开，当时任该会总会理事的邓朝泽，承担这次大会组织工作。他在当地侨领的鼎力支持下，群策群力，共同把整个会务工作做得妥妥善善，缜密安排，使这次大会盛况空前，圆满成功，为各地代表称赞不绝。 努力提高华人在美国社会的政治地位，支持华人参政是邓朝泽一贯关心的事。一九八六年，华人邓伟利竞选美莎市参议员。他即以侨团联合总会主席身份发动当地侨胞给予支持，很快筹得一笔竞选经费。终于，使邓伟利能在华人不很多的地区获选，出任美莎市副市长已达两任。 邓朝泽于一九三九年毕业于故乡著名的开侨中学。他对于母校的师长和同学，具有深厚感情。一九八四年他与在美的几位同学发起建立”开侨中学校友会”，从而联络了不少校友，发展了友谊，影响良好。 邓朝泽不仅热心为侨社服务，而且热情地帮助乡亲同胞，在其力所能及下办理各种事情。有位老先生告诉记者：几年前，自己为取得在美合法居留身份，而求助于朝泽先生，他非常乐意给予真诚的帮助。每次到移民局办理手续时，他不仅亲身驾车接送，陪同作翻译，代填表格，还要请饮咖啡’吃午餐’。事成之后，他却不受分文。足见他是以助人为乐的。 路遥知马力 ， 日久见人心。 朝泽先生为侨社服务了二十年，人们认为，其功绩应载入当地华侨史册上。
3cdc3b83f1a1f3c1b13cf23d2f7fea447d09d92b.translatedText: Characters of the Overseas Chinese Community (5) - Deng Chaoze Know your horse power from afar and see people's hearts over time. Deng Chaoze was born in 1921 in Hulong Baoan Village, Kaiping County, Guangdong. He came to the United States in 1940. He first went to Mesa City and worked in a grocery store run by his uncle. He was also enrolled in Western High School and worked part-time. When World War II broke out, he went to work in a defense shipyard in California, and later took part in cultivating the Japanese estates that had been abandoned by the war until the end of the war. Since 1949, he partnered with his brother Deng Kansheng and opened grocery stores in Feinian City and Mianshuibu until his retirement in 1971. Deng Chaoze and his wife are loving, their children are well-educated and successful, and their grandchildren are well-behaved and smart. After he retires, he can rely on his savings to enjoy a comfortable life. However, he was enthusiastic about working for the overseas Chinese community and spared no effort to serve his fellow countrymen. He has been serving in the local overseas Chinese corps since 1971 when he served as the Chinese secretary of Feinedeng Gaomi Office. He has successively served as Chairman of Feinian's Deng Gaomi Office, Chairman of the Yingduan Industrial and Commercial Branch, Chairman of the Chinese American Federation, Chairman of the Federation of Overseas Chinese Associations, Standing Committee Member of the Southwest Branch of the National Chinese Welfare Association, General Director, etc., and he is still the consultant or speaker of these groups. In the past twenty years, he has done a lot of useful work for the local overseas Chinese community. As early as during the preparation and expansion of the Feinedeng Gaomi Office, he and other clan elders actively carried out fundraising, planning and construction work. In the Yingduan Industrial and Commercial Branch of Fei Ni, he carried out services such as safeguarding the rights and interests of the Chinese and obtaining driving certificates for overseas Chinese. In the Fei Ni Chinese Chamber of Commerce, he strengthened communication with the government and people from all walks of life to communicate with Chinese business development channels, and even set up Chinese cancer prevention and medical insurance services. In the process of planning the establishment of a meeting place and opening a Chinese school in the Fei Ni Overseas Chinese Federation, he was an active advocate, service provider and supporter of this series of things that were beneficial to overseas Chinese. In 1986, the 11th Congress of the National Chinese Welfare Association was held in Las Vegas. Deng Chaoze, who was the general director of the association at the time, was responsible for organizing the conference. With the full support of the local overseas Chinese leaders, he worked together to make the entire conference work properly and meticulously arranged, making the conference an unprecedented event and a complete success, earning endless praise from representatives from all over the country. Deng Chaoze has always been concerned about working hard to improve the political status of Chinese in American society and supporting Chinese participation in politics. In 1986, Chinese Deng Weili ran for the Mesa City Senator. As chairman of the Federation of Overseas Chinese Leagues, he mobilized local overseas Chinese to provide support and quickly raised a campaign fund. Finally, Deng Weili was elected in an area where there were not many Chinese people and served as the deputy mayor of Mesa City for two terms. Deng Chaoze graduated from the famous Kaiqiao Middle School in his hometown in 1939. He has deep feelings for his teachers and classmates at his alma mater. In 1984, he and several classmates in the United States initiated the establishment of the "Kaiqiao Middle School Alumni Association", thus contacting many alumni, developing friendships, and having a good influence. Deng Chaoze not only enthusiastically served the overseas Chinese community, but also enthusiastically helped fellow villagers and handled various matters within his ability. An old gentleman told reporters: A few years ago, he turned to Mr. Asawa for help in order to obtain legal residence status in the United States. He was very happy to provide sincere help. Every time he goes to the Immigration Bureau to go through the formalities, he not only drives to pick him up, accompanies him as a translator, fills out forms on his behalf, but also buys him coffee and lunch. After the deed was accomplished, he received no penny. It shows that he enjoys helping others. Horsepower can be seen from a distance, and people's hearts can be seen from time to time. Mr. Chaoze has served the overseas Chinese community for twenty years. It is believed that his achievements should be recorded in the history of local overseas Chinese.

9bf238fa92292666f6a6e8d69ec2a7542a11dfad.sourceText: 移民问答：持别人护照机场被抓后申请十年绿卡资格 （亚省时报） 我在2005年持别人的护照来美，但在机场被抓，后来由表姐夫保我出来。现在，我在进行第二次上诉中。我丈夫持绿卡，但他的英语很差，无法考公民。不过，我丈夫的妹妹今年刚通过入籍，她可以申请我吗？我有申请十年绿卡的资格吗？最近的一个移民局的政策备忘录，允许非移民身分的住户成员转换成探亲身分(B-2)。我的情况适用此政策吗？可以申请吗？ 答：因为你来美国还不到十年，所以你没有申请十年绿卡（取消移送出境令）的资格。即使你在美国已有十年的时间，但自移民局通知你上移民法庭起，你计算十年的时间就已冻结，无法积累时间。最近允许非移民身分的家人在美国转换或延长B-2身分的新政策备忘录，并不适用于你，因为它只适用于目前在美国有合法身分且为长期居住美国有非移民身分人的「住户成员」。这些人是指和主要非移民身分的人定期居住一起且保持像核心家庭的关系和照顾的人。
9bf238fa92292666f6a6e8d69ec2a7542a11dfad.translatedText: Immigration Q&A: After being caught at the airport with someone else’s passport, I am eligible to apply for a green card for ten years (Alberta Times) I came to the United States in 2005 with someone else's passport, but I was arrested at the airport. My cousin-in-law later bailed me out. Now, I am in the middle of my second appeal. My husband holds a green card, but his English is very poor and he cannot take the citizenship test. However, my husband’s sister just passed naturalization this year, can she apply to me? Am I eligible to apply for a ten-year green card? A recent USCIS policy memorandum allows household members with non-immigrant status to convert to visitor status (B-2). Does this policy apply to my situation? Can I apply? Answer: Because you have been in the United States for less than ten years, you are not eligible to apply for a ten-year green card (cancellation of removal order). Even if you have been in the United States for ten years, your ten years have been frozen since the USCIS notifies you to go to immigration court, and you cannot accumulate time. The recent new policy memorandum that allows family members with non-immigrant status to transfer or extend B-2 status in the United States does not apply to you because it only applies to "household members" who are currently in the United States legally and are non-immigrant status residents who have long-term residence in the United States. These are people who live regularly with a person whose primary nonimmigrant status is a person and who maintain a nuclear family-like relationship and care.

21d9f396ef0b26b782ef5aeaa9efe2662660bdae.sourceText: 平生向往读万卷书，走万里路。所以每年旅游世界各地，而不顾颠沛流离的旅途之苦。 去年十二月初起程前往中国湖南张家界，湘西芙蓉镇，沉从文故乡凤凰镇，之后折返广州、番禺、西樵山、中山、深圳等珠三角地区，再到香港、澳门一行，回美后又在2012年元旦重上阿利桑那州的大峡谷，近一个月的旅途，风霜雪雨，场景变幻。回来后，写了一个旅游特辑，现与诸君同好一同分享。 一、张家界 1.登机惊魂 到张家界旅游是在美国从网上预定的。去年9月预订12月从LA飞广州来回，并获送广州至湖南长沙来回半价机票，共计$900。 12月5日，乘坐中国南方航空公司的航班从LA机场飞往中国广州。当时我们已从机场侯机室出闸，坐机场巴士至飞机登机梯前但又折了回来，被告知是飞机油泵出故障，后来费三小时未修复好，航班取消了。如果起飞后才发现，那我们不是去张家界，而是去天界了。折腾到午夜三点，大家才被安排到机场旅馆休息，但仅仅睡了三小时就被叫醒，再到机场等候，直至翌日深夜才能登机。一整天，都不见有领导来安抚旅客，众人于是起哄。一气之下，有人示出记者名片，又说要拍摄登报，最后的坚持者，南航勉强理赔200美元，事情方告一段落。 飞机凌晨抵广州白云机场，中午乘国内班机飞抵长沙，并在〝老食客〞餐厅吃了顿连汤也是辣的地道湘菜，十分过瘾。晚上坐夜巴士4个半小时至张家界武陵源，路途山风骤起，但觉寒冻。夜宿武陵源。 2.紫霞山上遇神棍 第二天早上，我们开始了湘西旅游。被安排参观的第一景点”紫霞山”。闻紫霞山一些道观始建于明朝嘉靖年间，近500年的历史，但在战乱时期毁于兵燹。地老天荒，知者少也。直到1992年，由于武陵源旅游业兴，人们见山水风光奇殊，人文景观逊色，由是，俚人怀古，由各地的善男信女共同捐资，当地政府拨款扩建起紫霞山景点。但见山上多是人工景物，如老子，八仙像等。上到山后，道观前有人在摇签，口中念着:〝抽签不要钱〞。要旅客随抽一支。由于去过一些地方，上过当，知道什么叫做〝便宜莫贪〞，所以摆摆手，没去抽。果然，抽到签的旅客进道观后，〝解签费〞劲收人民币300元。同行中有初次到中国旅游的亲友,因未换足人民币，解签时给了200美元，还被道士要求再加100元，并问及为什么钱币不是红色而是绿色的？因求签是各人所好，我们一时大意未告知亲友其中或有骗局，心有歉意。日后如果阁下遇到神棍，是道士的，说自己信佛，是和尚的，说自己信道，如果道士和尚一齐来，就说自己信耶苏好了，切勿轻信馋言而被骗破财。 紫霞山上的八仙像有点杀气
21d9f396ef0b26b782ef5aeaa9efe2662660bdae.translatedText: I aspire to read thousands of books and travel thousands of miles in my life. So I travel around the world every year, regardless of the hardships of the journey. In early December last year, we set off for Zhangjiajie, Furong Town, Xiangxi Hunan, and Fenghuang Town, Shen Congwen’s hometown, and then returned to Guangzhou, Panyu, Xiqiaoshan, Zhongshan, Shenzhen and other Pearl River Delta regions, and then to Hong Kong and Macau. After returning to the United States, we returned to the Grand Canyon of Arizona on New Year’s Day in 2012. The nearly month-long journey was full of wind, frost, snow and rain, and the scene changed. After I came back, I wrote a travel special, which I would like to share with you all. 1. Zhangjiajie 1. Shock on boarding The trip to Zhangjiajie was booked online in the United States. In September last year, I booked a round-trip flight from LA to Guangzhou in December, and received a half-price round-trip air ticket from Guangzhou to Changsha, Hunan, totaling $900. On December 5, I took a China Southern Airlines flight from LA Airport to Guangzhou, China. At that time, we had already exited the airport waiting room and took the airport bus to the aircraft boarding stairs but then turned back. We were told that the aircraft's oil pump failed. It took us three hours to repair it and the flight was cancelled. If we find out after taking off, we are not going to Zhangjiajie, but to heaven. It was not until three o'clock in the evening that everyone was arranged to rest in the airport hotel. However, they were woken up after only three hours of sleep and had to wait at the airport until late the next night before boarding the plane. Throughout the whole day, no leader came to comfort the passengers, so everyone started booing. In a fit of anger, someone showed the reporter's business card and said he wanted to take photos and publish them in the newspaper. The last holdout was China Southern Airlines, which reluctantly paid a compensation of US$200, and the matter came to an end. The plane arrived at Guangzhou Baiyun Airport in the early morning and took a domestic flight to Changsha at noon. We had a meal of authentic Hunan cuisine at the "Old Diner" restaurant, which was spicy even in the soup. It was very enjoyable. In the evening, I took an overnight bus for 4 and a half hours to Wulingyuan, Zhangjiajie. The mountain wind blew up suddenly on the way, but I felt freezing cold. Overnight in Wulingyuan. 2. Encountering a magic stick on Zixia Mountain The next morning, we started our trip to western Hunan. The first scenic spot arranged to visit is "Zixia Mountain". I heard that some Taoist temples in Zixia Mountain were built during the Jiajing period of the Ming Dynasty, with a history of nearly 500 years, but were destroyed by war during the war. As time goes by, there are few people who know. Until 1992, due to the boom in tourism in Wulingyuan, people saw that the mountains and rivers were unique and the cultural landscape was inferior. As a result, people nostalgic for the past, and the local government allocated funds to expand the Zixia Mountain scenic spot with donations from believers from all over the place. However, most of the mountains are artificial scenery, such as Laozi, the statue of the Eight Immortals, etc. After going up the mountain, someone was casting lots in front of the Taoist temple, chanting: "There is no money for drawing lots." Passengers are asked to smoke one. Since I have been to some places and been deceived before, I know what "don't be greedy for cheap" means, so I waved my hand and didn't smoke. Sure enough, after entering the Taoist temple, the tourists who got the visa were charged RMB 300 for the "sign release fee". Some of my friends and relatives who were traveling to China for the first time were given 200 US dollars when they signed the visa because they did not exchange enough RMB. They were also asked by the Taoist priest to add 100 yuan and asked why the currency was not red but green. Because asking for signatures is everyone's preference, we were careless and did not inform our relatives and friends that there might be a scam, and we sincerely apologize. In the future, if you meet a magic stick, a Taoist priest who says you believe in Buddhism or a monk who says you believe in Taoism, if the Taoist priest and monk come together, just say you believe in Jesus. Don't believe in greedy words and be deceived and lose your money. The Eight Immortals on Zixia Mountain are a bit murderous
