8636b1c6ab03c34898549aaa4670df6ccc8aea63.sourceText: 回凤城侨社历史和人物故事连载6：忆当年办报人 张肇鸿 张肇鸿 我保留着一篇关于黄仕蔚先生事迹的文章。这文章可能很少人看过，因为这篇采访报导发表的时候，凤凰城所有的中文报纸尚未面世。 以”传奇人物:荣誉警章得主黄仕蔚”为标题的文章，发表在1990年初本埠最早的华文杂志《凤城华声》季刊上。现在重新摘登，是让大家对黄仕蔚先生有更多的认识，也对本埠最早的文坛往事，提供多一些的资讯。 ”不论出生何处，由那里来，美国人总是视我们为黑头发，黄皮肤的中国人，中国人应团结组织成一强有力的团体发挥无限的潜能，为下一代更能有坚定的脚步而努力。”身佩荣誉警章的黄仕蔚先生一针见血地提出他的见解。 出生于菲律宾马尼拉总统府的黄仕蔚先生，父亲是马尼拉总统府最高的保安官员，他自幼就有除暴安良，助人为乐的品格，在受到良好的警备训练后，一直致力于消除犯罪，维护治安之职责。 1967年，黄先生以技术人员之身份来到美国，先后在加州等地经营过数间颇有声望的餐馆。 1987年他与家人迁居到急速城长的凤凰城。由于他热心地协助警方消除犯罪，对凤凰城警局有不少的贡献，那枚由警方颁发的荣誉警章的警辉亦代表了中国人的光彩。 他以丰富的经历指出，造成美国中国城犯罪偏高的主因乃是”好赌”，年青人一经陷入，便很难自拔，做成悲剧下场。他奉劝父母们应教育下一代为有责任的人，并鼓励孩子们到教会去，心中有信仰的孩子不会变坏。 他对青年学者也有期望，他认为中国留学生应主动结交美国朋友，不拘限在华人小圈子里，多加努力学习多一些的俚语、笑话，与主流社会打成一片。选择工作的时候，不要为工作而工作，应先选一些具有挑战又可学习和发挥的职业，刺激自我训练、自我教育，到最后必能达到成功的目标。 成功的男人背后必定有一位能干的太太，丹妮(葛慧贞女士的艺名)，当她还是位香港名歌星时，有次到马尼拉登台时和黄先生邂逅。温柔娴淑的黄太太不但人靓歌甜，更拥有一颗善良的心，他们从相识到相爱,最后组成家庭，之后他们有了三个孩子，长大成材，在事业上颇有成就，其女儿曾是1984年加州选美的”第四公主。” 以上是《凤城华声》在22年前采访荣誉警章得主黄仕蔚先生时的内容，以及他所表达的见解。 黄仕蔚先生一生热爱中华文化，就在《凤城华声》杂志采访他不久后，他自己也成为了本埠第一份华文报的创办者，他也是第一位在本地美国电台中创办中文节目的先行者。在美国国庆日，在中国周，在侨联及其它大大小小的华人活动场所，大家都能经常看到他那充满阳光的笑容，听到他那充满磁性的声音，他做节目主持的形象让人们久久不会忘怀。黄仕蔚先生非常乐意助人，他帮助过不计其数不懂英文的新移民，解决从衣食住行到​​入借方面种种问题。黄先生还关注华人从政，鼓励华人加入美国主流社会，团结一致去争取华人权益。 认识黄仕蔚先生已有廿余年。上世纪九十年代初，我已给本地的两份中文报纸撰文投稿，他任《亚利桑那华报》的社长的时侯，常和我们谈及有关华人从政的话题，他自己也曾经参加过竞选。记得1992年5月9日，《世界日报》发表了”当选市长为华人树典范”的文章，但在其报导中有严重失实之处，指当时的华裔邓伟利参选美莎(Mesa)市长竞选时，得不到本地华人的支持，文章写道: ”纵便全美第七大城的凤凰城，有二万多华人近在咫尺，当晚出现在美莎市开票中心为邓伟利加油打气的全是白人，邓伟利的竞选经费也非出自华人社区。” 这是歪曲事实的报导。其实凤凰城华人为支持邓伟利参选，早在1991年12月就开始筹划，本地两份华文报也配合华人参政展开了舆论声势。 2月8日，华人在华美酒家举办支持邓伟利参选的筹款餐会，据统计，邓伟利参选所得经费近半数来自华人社区，有些捐款直至到邓伟利初选成功后仍在延续。而在当晚的开票中心，就有来自美莎市和坦佩市的华人为邓伟利加油打气，其中包括有竞选筹款的负责人邓朝驹，圣地牙哥《联华报》的主编，以及《亚利桑那华报》的社长黄仕蔚。 为了澄清黑白，还凤凰城华人的一个公道，经过调查研究，我以”失实的报导伤害凤城华人”为题，把事实的真相写成报导，投给了敢于披露真相的《亚利桑那华报》 。在充分的证据下，黄仕蔚社长不惧怕财雄势大的大报，把这篇报导安排在报纸的头版头条刊登。由此可看到黄仕蔚社长办报坚持真相的勇气和精神。 现在，黄社长走了，但他的乐于助人，勇于创​​新的形象却长留于人世间。
8636b1c6ab03c34898549aaa4670df6ccc8aea63.translatedText: Serial 6 of the history and character stories of Huifengcheng Overseas Chinese Community: Reminiscing about the man who ran the newspaper Zhang Zhaohong Zhang Zhaohong I have kept an article about the deeds of Mr. Huang Shiwei. Few people may have read this article, because when this interview report was published, all Chinese newspapers in Phoenix had not yet been published. An article titled "Legendary: Honorary Police Medal Winner Huang Shiwei" was published in the quarterly "Fengcheng Huasheng", the earliest Chinese magazine in the city, in early 1990. Re-extracting it now is to let everyone know more about Mr. Huang Shiwei, and to provide more information about the earliest literary events in this city. "No matter where we are born or where we come from, Americans always regard us as Chinese with black hair and yellow skin. The Chinese should unite and organize into a strong group to unleash their unlimited potential and work hard for the next generation to have a firmer pace." Mr. Huang Shiwei, who wears an honorary police badge, put forward his insights to the point. Mr. Huang Shiwei was born in the Presidential Palace in Manila, Philippines. His father is the top security official of the Presidential Palace in Manila. He has the character of eliminating violence and helping others since he was a child. After receiving good security training, he has been committed to eliminating crime and maintaining public order. In 1967, Mr. Huang came to the United States as a technician and ran several prestigious restaurants in California and other places. In 1987, he and his family moved to Phoenix, the capital of Rapid City. Because he enthusiastically assisted the police in eliminating crime and made a lot of contributions to the Phoenix Police Department, the honorary police badge issued by the police also represents the glory of the Chinese people. With his rich experience, he pointed out that the main reason for the high crime rate in Chinatown in the United States is "gambling". Once young people fall into it, it is difficult to extricate themselves, leading to tragic consequences. He advised parents to educate the next generation to be responsible people and encourage their children to go to church. Children with faith in their hearts will not become bad. He also has expectations for young scholars. He believes that Chinese students studying abroad should take the initiative to make American friends, not be limited to small Chinese circles, work harder to learn more slang and jokes, and integrate with mainstream society. When choosing a job, don't work for the sake of work. You should first choose careers that are challenging and can be learned and used to stimulate self-training and self-education, and you will surely achieve the goal of success in the end. Behind every successful man, there must be a capable wife, Danni (Ms. Ge Huizhen's stage name). When she was a famous Hong Kong singer, she met Mr. Huang once when she was on stage in Manila. The gentle and courteous Mrs. Huang is not only beautiful and sweet, but also has a kind heart. They met, fell in love, and finally formed a family. After that, they had three children who grew up to be successful and successful in their careers. Her daughter was the "Fourth Princess" in the California beauty pageant in 1984. The above is the content of "Fengcheng Hua Sheng"'s interview with Mr. Huang Shiwei, the honorary medal winner 22 years ago, and the opinions he expressed. Mr. Huang Shiwei has loved Chinese culture all his life. Not long after he was interviewed by "Fengcheng Huasheng" magazine, he himself became the founder of the first Chinese-language newspaper in the city. He was also the first pioneer to establish a Chinese-language program on a local American radio station. On the Fourth of July, in China Week, at the Federation of Overseas Chinese and other large and small Chinese activity venues, everyone can often see his sunny smile and hear his magnetic voice. His image as a program host will never be forgotten for a long time. Mr. Huang Shiwei is very willing to help others. He has helped countless new immigrants who do not understand English to solve various problems ranging from food, clothing, housing and transportation to mortgage. Mr. Huang also pays attention to the participation of Chinese people in politics, encourages Chinese people to join mainstream American society, and unite to fight for Chinese rights and interests. I have known Mr. Huang Shiwei for more than 20 years. In the early 1990s, I had written and contributed articles to two local Chinese newspapers. When he was the president of the Arizona Chinese Newspaper, he often talked to us about the topic of Chinese participation in politics, and he himself had participated in the election. I remember that on May 9, 1992, "World Journal" published an article "The elected mayor sets an example for the Chinese." However, there were serious inaccuracies in its report. It pointed out that when the Chinese-American Deng Weili ran for mayor of Mesa, he did not receive the support of the local Chinese. The article read: "Even though there are more than 20,000 Chinese in Phoenix, the seventh largest city in the United States, all the people who showed up at the Mesa voting center to cheer for Deng Weili that night were white. Deng Weili's campaign funds did not come from the Chinese community." This is a report that distorts the facts. In fact, the Phoenix City Chinese began planning to support Deng Weili's candidacy as early as December 1991. Two local Chinese newspapers also launched a public opinion campaign in conjunction with Chinese participation in politics. On February 8, the Chinese held a fundraising dinner at Huamei Restaurant to support Deng Weili’s candidacy. According to statistics, nearly half of the funds for Deng Weili’s candidacy came from the Chinese community, and some donations continued after Deng Weili’s success in the primary election. At the voting center that night, there were Chinese people from Mesa and Tempe cheering for Deng Weili, including Deng Chaoju, the person in charge of campaign fundraising, the editor-in-chief of the Lianhua News in San Diego, and Huang Shiwei, the president of the Arizona Chinese News. In order to clarify the truth and bring justice to the Chinese people in Phoenix, after investigation and research, I wrote the truth as a report under the title "Inaccurate reports hurt the Chinese in Phoenix" and submitted it to the Arizona Chinese Newspaper, which dares to disclose the truth. With sufficient evidence, President Huang Shiwei was not afraid of the wealthy and powerful newspapers and arranged for this report to be published on the front page of the newspaper. From this we can see the courage and spirit of President Huang Shiwei in running a newspaper and adhering to the truth. Now, President Huang is gone, but his image of being helpful and innovative will remain in this world forever.

7c4e5e649ef7565e44b3e665608126ccb4d2f674.sourceText: 移民局颁新规 助亲人团聚 特派員林寶慶華盛頓報導 世界新聞網 北美華文新聞、華商資訊 美國移民局6日宣布一項有利非法移民合法化的規則草案，定案後將使部分在美逾期居留的親屬移民申請人，得以在美遞交「免除三到十年不能返美管制規定」的申請書。部分美國公民的非法移民親屬，可減少必須離開美國的時間，以利和親人團聚。 國會亞太裔小組主席趙美心讚揚歐巴馬總統及移民局的新規定。她指 出，新規定對亞太裔很重要。三分之二的美國亞太裔是移民。「亞美正義中心」也表示，亞太裔人口雖然只占全國的6%，卻占所有親屬移民的三分之一以上。 移民局長梅奧卡斯(Alejandro ‘Ali’ Mayorkas)6日舉行記者會，指移民局已於6日在「聯邦公報」宣布這項新規則草案，並徵詢各方意見，計畫今年稍晚最後定案實施。 梅奧 卡斯指出，新規則草案適用於申請依親移民的美國公民的配偶及子女，目的在減少非法移民與其在美親人分離的時間。 梅奧卡斯表示，移民法規定， 凡在美國逾期居留六個月以上者，一旦出境，三年內不得再入境；而逾期一年以上者，一旦出境，則十年不得再入境。 他說，這項移民法也有例外規定，如果能夠證明逾期居留的公民配偶或子女離開美國後，將對該公民造成極大的窘困(extreme hardship)，即可申請免除三到十年內不得返美的管制。目前這項申請必須由逾期居留者在海外提出。而新規則草案，則允許逾期居留者，留在美國提出這項申請。 梅奧卡斯表示，申請人須按指紋，並通過背景調查，且須沒有犯罪紀錄。而申請獲得批准後，仍須返國至當地美國使領館接受面談。而移民局將與美國國務院密切合作，以加快處理此類案件。 梅奧卡斯不願估計將會有多少人在美國提出申請。他否認新規則將使數百萬人受惠的說法。梅奧 卡斯表示，2011會計年度共收到2萬3000份申請書，其中1萬7000份申請獲准。 鑒於三到十年內不得返美的管制，許多逾期居留者不願 申請綠卡，因為申請獲准之後，須離開美國面談，面談並不保證通過，而且還將三到十年不得再返美。因而許多逾期居留者寧可繼續非法滯美。 新規 定可望減少美國的逾期居留非法移民。
7c4e5e649ef7565e44b3e665608126ccb4d2f674.translatedText: The Immigration Bureau issued new regulations to help reunite relatives. Special Correspondent Lin Baoqing reported in Washington. World News Network. North American Chinese News, Chinese Business Information. On the 6th, the U.S. Immigration Service announced a draft rule that would facilitate the legalization of illegal immigrants. Once finalized, some family-based immigration applicants who have overstayed their visas in the United States will be able to submit applications in the United States for "exemption from the three to ten-year prohibition on return to the United States." Some illegal immigrant relatives of U.S. citizens can reduce the time they have to leave the United States to reunite with their relatives. Congressional Asian Pacific American Caucus Chairwoman Maggie Chao praised President Obama and USCIS for the new rules. She noted that the new regulations are important to Asian and Pacific Islanders. Two-thirds of Asian and Pacific Islander Americans are immigrants. The Asian American Justice Center also stated that although the Asian and Pacific Islander population only accounts for 6% of the country, they account for more than one-third of all relative immigrants. Immigration Director Alejandro ‘Ali’ Mayorkas held a press conference on the 6th, stating that the Immigration Service had announced the draft new rules in the Federal Register on the 6th and had solicited opinions from all parties, with plans to finalize and implement them later this year. Mayo Kass pointed out that the new draft rules apply to the spouses and children of U.S. citizens who apply for dependent immigration, with the purpose of reducing the time for illegal immigrants to be separated from their relatives in the United States. Mayorkas said that immigration law stipulates that anyone who overstays his or her stay in the United States for more than six months will not be allowed to re-enter within three years once he leaves the country; and anyone who overstays his or her stay in the United States for more than one year will be barred from re-entering for ten years once he or she leaves the country. He said that this immigration law also has exceptions. If it can be proved that the spouse or children of a citizen who has overstayed his or her visa will cause extreme hardship to the citizen after leaving the United States, he or she can apply for exemption from the ban on returning to the United States within three to ten years. Currently this application must be made overseas by the overstayer. The new draft rules would allow overstayers to stay in the United States and file this application. Mayorkas said applicants must be fingerprinted, pass a background check and must have no criminal record. After your application is approved, you must still return to your country to be interviewed at the local U.S. embassy or consulate. USCIS will work closely with the U.S. Department of State to expedite the processing of such cases. Mayorkas would not estimate how many people will apply in the United States. He rejected suggestions that the new rules would benefit millions of people. Mayo Cass said that in fiscal year 2011, a total of 23,000 applications were received, of which 17,000 were approved. In view of the prohibition on returning to the United States within three to ten years, many overstayers are unwilling to apply for a green card because after their application is approved, they must leave the United States for an interview. Passage of the interview is not guaranteed, and they will not be allowed to return to the United States for another three to ten years. Therefore, many overstayers would rather continue to stay in the United States illegally. The new regulations are expected to reduce overstaying illegal immigrants in the United States.

d8435a3d06f058114c9927adc0e121e5b9dd0650.sourceText: 查税地雷：1040 税表是关键 记者王善言／洛杉矶报导 又到报税季节，华人会计师指出，国税局这几年查税趋严，被查税对象往往是因误触几个「地雷」。今年若想保平安，须避免踩到这些「地雷」。 华人会计师指出，易引发国税局查税的地雷，是由主流顶尖税务律师归纳出来，发现国税局除利用电脑核对税表与第三机构提供的相关资料，也利用「判别指数功能」（ Discriminant Index Function）公式对每分税表评分，评分愈高者被查税机率就愈高。 然而如何评分，会计师陈博仁说，答案就在纳税人填写的1040税表，该表有多处填写的答案若是负数，被查税机率就较高。包括该表第12行询问自雇的纳税人的生意收入或损失，第13行的利得（Capital Gain）或亏损，第14行的其余增值或亏损，第17行的租赁物业或版权等收入，如果填写的答案是负数，易获高分。 第21行与「其余收入」有关提问，如果列有其余收入，建议另附表格解释清楚，否则也易引发查税。 陈博仁说，在填写1040税表第40行逐项扣减或标准扣除额后，建议除以第38行的调整后所得，若结果超过40% ，也易引起查税，因意味纳税人支出比例偏高。国税局会质疑纳税人既然支出那么多，如何过活。不过这个项目并非全看比例，也看数字大小决定。假设第38行填的数字是50万元，第40行填的是20万元，即使比例已占40%，因中间相差30万元，意味着生活没问题。但若前者填3万元，后者填1万2000元，国税局就会质疑纳税人如何利用1万8000元过活。 第40行若填有贷款利息，由于国税局规定超过100万元以上贷款，其利息无法抵减所得，因此这栏填写的答案若不合理，易获高分。一般不能填写超过11万5000元利息，这是以房贷利息11.5%来看，但目前房贷利息低于5%，相当于前者一半，因此只要这栏填写的金额超过5万7500元，就易被查税。 至于第37行、也是第38行填写的调整后所得如果答案是负数，被查税机率几乎是100%。 会计师李新忠则说，根据该套公式，易获高分即易被查税的纳税人，以申请劳力所得补助（Earned Income Tax Credit）、拥有外国帐户、申报的慈善捐款与收入相比偏高、卖房子​​申报的基价偏高以便将净利减少，以及在逐项扣减时申报的支出偏高等纳税人。
d8435a3d06f058114c9927adc0e121e5b9dd0650.translatedText: Tax mines: 1040 tax forms are the key Reporter Wang Shanyan/Los Angeles report It’s tax filing season again, and Chinese accountants pointed out that the IRS has become more strict in tax inspections in recent years, and the targets of tax inspections often hit several “landmines” by mistake. If you want to stay safe this year, you must avoid stepping on these "landmines." Chinese accountants pointed out that the landmines that easily trigger tax audits by the IRS were summarized by top mainstream tax lawyers. They found that the IRS not only uses computers to check tax forms and relevant information provided by third parties, but also uses the "Discriminant Index Function" formula to score each tax form. The higher the score, the higher the chance of being audited. But how to score, accountant Chen Boren said, the answer lies in the 1040 tax form filled out by the taxpayer. If the answer in the form is negative in multiple places, the chance of being audited is higher. This includes line 12 of the form asking self-employed taxpayers about business income or loss, line 13 about capital gain or loss, line 14 about remaining appreciation or loss, and line 17 about income from rental properties or copyrights. If the answer you fill in is a negative number, it is easy to get high scores. Line 21 is about "remaining income". If there is remaining income, it is recommended to attach a separate form to explain it clearly, otherwise it will easily trigger a tax audit. Chen Boren said that after filling in the itemized deductions or standard deductions in line 40 of the 1040 tax form, it is recommended to divide the amount by the adjusted income in line 38. If the result exceeds 40%, it will easily trigger a tax audit because it means that the taxpayer's expenditure ratio is too high. The IRS will question how taxpayers can survive with so much money spent. However, this project is not all about proportion, but also the size of the numbers. Assume that the number filled in line 38 is 500,000 yuan, and the number filled in line 40 is 200,000 yuan. Even if the proportion is 40%, the difference of 300,000 yuan in the middle means that life is fine. But if the former fills in 30,000 yuan and the latter fills in 12,000 yuan, the IRS will question how the taxpayer uses 18,000 yuan to live on. If line 40 contains loan interest, since the IRS stipulates that the interest cannot be deducted from income for loans exceeding 1 million yuan, so if the answer in this column is unreasonable, it is easy to get high scores. Generally, you cannot fill in interest exceeding 115,000 yuan. This is based on the mortgage interest rate of 11.5%. However, the current mortgage interest rate is less than 5%, which is equivalent to half of the former. Therefore, as long as the amount filled in this column exceeds 57,500 yuan, it will be easily subject to tax inspection. As for the adjusted income filled in lines 37 and 38, if the answer is a negative number, the probability of being audited is almost 100%. Accountant Li Xinzhong said that according to this set of formulas, taxpayers who are likely to get high scores, that is, are prone to tax audits, are taxpayers who apply for Earned Income Tax Credit, have foreign accounts, declare charitable donations that are too high compared to their income, declare a base price for selling a house that is too high to reduce net profit, and declare expenses that are too high when making itemized deductions.

ee720e3eeed6bd8ff6ec3782092275dcf45781f9.sourceText: 6月1日，市场上房屋的数量下降到一个不同寻常的低点，只有8,550套。这在一年内下降了50％。供应紧张已导致招标战争和让买家应得的出价全部失败。一个钱德勒房子收到84个报价，并格伦代尔的房子有95个报价- 最后比官方报价高出17％的价格成交。 ”如果我要现在买房子，我会集中到一个新的部分，”奥尔说。城市东部仍然是市场中最热新房区域。吉尔伯特有187的新房子，钱德勒有49栋和梅萨的49栋。 5月凤凰记录有60新房上市。不过，整体房屋销售数量下跌近6％，由于供不应求的房源。奥尔预测未来市场上的表现比不会比前几个月更疯狂。如果买房自住的买家，因为价格上涨而失去了部分购买兴趣，奥尔说，强劲的投资需求将填​​补这一空白。
ee720e3eeed6bd8ff6ec3782092275dcf45781f9.translatedText: On June 1, the number of houses on the market dropped to an unusual low, with only 8,550 units. This is down 50% in one year. Tight supply has led to tender wars and failed attempts to get buyers their due. A house in Chandler received 84 offers, and a house in Glendale had 95 offers - and sold for 17% more than the official offer price. "If I were to buy a house now, I would focus on a new segment," Orr said. The east side of the city remains the hottest area in the market for new homes. There are 187 new homes in Gilbert, 49 in Chandler and 49 in Mesa. Phoenix recorded 60 new homes on the market in May. However, the overall number of home sales fell nearly 6% as demand outstripped supply. Orr predicts that the market performance in the future will not be any crazier than in the past few months. If owner-occupiers lose some interest as prices rise, Orr said strong investment demand will fill the gap.

f9ce07a9ce41f87dd1dad97eeaecbaaf951b8a99.sourceText: 新房建设在去年飙升57％，因为房源短缺。 ”建筑商会快速跟进，但由于劳工短缺，这并不是能非常快的实现，”奥尔说。 ”目前速度有多快还不能明确，填补劳工短缺需要一些时间。”
f9ce07a9ce41f87dd1dad97eeaecbaaf951b8a99.translatedText: New home construction surged 57% last year amid a shortage of housing. "Builders will be quick to follow, but because of the labor shortage, it's not something that can happen very quickly," Orr said. "How quickly that will happen is unclear at the moment and it will take some time to fill the labor shortage."

ec0d74fd137b65c9034ea4698a5c9d444b3dbe20.sourceText: 2011年平均退税额减少3% （亚省时报） 据美国国税局发布的最新统计资料指出，该局去年的退税案件不仅减少，而且平均退税款项也降低了近100美元。 纳税人在2011年收到的平均退税额为2,913美元，较前一年的3,003美元下降了3％。 IRS去年共交付1.093亿笔退税款项，合计3,185亿美元。较比2010年的1.094亿笔退款，总额达3,284亿美元，略有下降。 直接汇款是去年最受纳税人欢迎的退税方式，超过7,900万笔退税款被直接存放到纳税人帐户，比2010年增长6％。 超过75％纳税人的退税申报使用国税局的免费网上电子报税系统，比上一年增加近14％。虽然大多数使用电子报税系统者聘请税务专业人士来申报，但准备自己报税的纳税人数量增加了14％。 对于那些应该得到退税，但还没有收到任何税款的纳税人，你的税款可能还在。国税局在11月下旬表示，由于邮寄地址的错误，导致数千万美元的退税没有退回给纳税人。
ec0d74fd137b65c9034ea4698a5c9d444b3dbe20.translatedText: The average tax refund amount decreased by 3% in 2011 (Alberta Times) According to the latest statistics released by the Internal Revenue Service, not only did the agency's tax refund cases decrease last year, but the average tax refund amount also dropped by nearly $100. The average tax refund received by taxpayers in 2011 was $2,913, down 3 percent from $3,003 the previous year. The IRS delivered 109.3 million tax refunds last year, totaling $318.5 billion. This is a slight decrease from the 109.4 million refunds in 2010, totaling $328.4 billion. Direct transfers were the most popular refund method for taxpayers last year, with more than 79 million tax refunds deposited directly into taxpayer accounts, a 6% increase from 2010. More than 75% of taxpayers file their refunds using the IRS’s free online e-filing system, an increase of nearly 14% from the previous year. While the majority of those using e-filing systems hire a tax professional to file, the number of taxpayers preparing to file their own returns increased by 14%. For those taxpayers who are due a refund but haven't received any yet, your taxes may still be due. The Internal Revenue Service said in late November that tens of millions of dollars in tax refunds had not been returned to taxpayers due to mailing address errors.

b2488a9a6d279145a3d0289d4cf8000ef086b4ec.sourceText: 广州火车站已进入春运状态超6万人滞留 （亚省时报特约记者杨绮薇报导） 目前，广州火车站已提前进入春运状态。站前广场前搭建的8个16组临时候车雨棚已正式启用，每个雨棚可以安排临时候车旅客3000人，其中15号雨棚为母婴和特殊对象候车专用。 据悉，今年春运工作从1月8日开始，比去年提前了10多天时间，加上大学生寒假回家潮、元旦小黄金人流潮、入伍新兵运送潮和春节旅客返乡探亲潮四大人流潮连在一起，为保证春运万无一失，越秀区公安局专门增加了30名协警和20名城管。同时，越秀区团委组织了1000多名志愿力量，计划每天投入140名志愿人员服务旅客。在便民服务方面，广州火车站还准备了5万件一次性雨衣，遇到下雨天气时将免费派发给旅客。同时在火车站广场安放了20个移动公厕。 据广州火车站有关负责人介绍，今年春运期间广州站的客流运送最高峰预计达20万人次，虽然广州南站正式启用两年来，已经分流了一部分珠三角的客流，但由于今年的客流量比去年又有上升，故广州火车站的旅客运送压力并未因此减少。 据了解，目前广州火车站广场滞留人数已超过六万， 当火车站广场人流一旦超过8万，火车站将启动应急预案，并开启流花展馆作为临时候车馆，而当流花地区聚集的旅客超过15万人时，将全面启动火车站周边的流花展馆、锦汉展览中心及中小学校区作为临时安置点。如一旦铁路中断超过48小时以上，滞留旅客人数达21万人，有关方面将协调劝导旅客留守本地过年。
b2488a9a6d279145a3d0289d4cf8000ef086b4ec.translatedText: Guangzhou Railway Station has entered the Spring Festival travel season, with over 60,000 people stranded (reported by Yang Qiwei, special reporter of The Alberta Times) At present, Guangzhou Railway Station has entered the Spring Festival travel period ahead of schedule. Eight temporary bus canopies with 16 groups built in front of the station square have been officially opened. Each canopy can accommodate 3,000 temporary bus passengers. Among them, No. 15 canopy is reserved for mothers, infants and special objects. It is reported that this year's Spring Festival transportation work started on January 8, more than 10 days earlier than last year. In addition, there are four major flows of college students returning home during the winter vacation, the New Year's Day golden crowd, the recruitment of military recruits, and the Spring Festival tourists returning home to visit relatives. In order to ensure that the Spring Festival transportation is foolproof, the Yuexiu District Public Security Bureau specially added 30 assisting police officers and 20 urban management personnel. At the same time, the Yuexiu District Youth League Committee has organized more than 1,000 volunteers and plans to devote 140 volunteers to serve passengers every day. In terms of convenience services, Guangzhou Railway Station has also prepared 50,000 disposable raincoats, which will be distributed to passengers for free in rainy weather. At the same time, 20 mobile public toilets were installed in the train station square. According to the person in charge of Guangzhou Railway Station, the peak passenger flow of Guangzhou Station during the Spring Festival this year is expected to reach 200,000 people. Although Guangzhou South Railway Station has been officially opened for two years, it has diverted part of the passenger flow of the Pearl River Delta. However, because the passenger flow this year has increased compared with last year, the passenger transportation pressure of Guangzhou Railway Station has not been reduced. It is understood that the number of people stranded in the Guangzhou Railway Station Square has exceeded 60,000. Once the number of people in the Railway Station Square exceeds 80,000, the railway station will activate an emergency plan and open the Liuhua Exhibition Hall as a temporary bus stop. When the number of passengers gathered in the Liuhua area exceeds 150,000, the Liuhua Exhibition Hall, Jinhan Exhibition Center and primary and secondary school campuses around the train station will be fully activated as temporary resettlement sites. If the railway is interrupted for more than 48 hours and the number of stranded passengers reaches 210,000, relevant authorities will coordinate to persuade passengers to stay locally for the New Year.

A man in Louisiana, suspected of being under the influence of drugs, went crazy and bit off a piece of meat from his ex-wife's husband's face; a female thief in Connecticut bit off a piece of meat from the shop owner's arm while escaping.

392a385b4ab21bf679677df4d500dc46b06610ca.translatedText: MCSO: Teenager was arrested for playing with a laser (Alberta Times) The Maricopa Sheriff's Office (MCSO) said that last Friday night, a Surprise City teenager was arrested for using a laser to affect the helicopter they were carrying out a mission. An MSCO spokesperson said that the helicopter was on a mission to rescue two adults and two children who were in danger while climbing Mount White Tank. When it left the ground around 7 o'clock, it was severely interfered with by lasers four times. A Surprise police officer said the teenager shined a laser brightly on the helicopter near BELL Road. The investigation led to the arrest of a 14-year-old suspect who has been referred to the Juvenile Division of Superior Court for felony charges. In compliance with regulations to protect juveniles, the boy's name and gender have not been released.

bb50145b7a91a71e78f2ae17168b1f05d35e4ec9.sourceText: 阿派奥：警长和赛当那夫妇谋杀案出自同一人 阿派奥警长在周二上午的新闻发布会上说，根据凶器证据表明，日前杀害国歌镇警长的凶手与上周在雅瓦裴郡杀害一对夫妇的凶杀是同一人。 阿派奥说，从两个犯罪现场采取的弹头是一样的。 ”近日内的两起谋杀案，都涉及高功率步枪，”阿派奥说。 这两案的疑犯，30岁的德鲁瑞安马拉斯，在周日上午枪战中，与警长同时身亡。 警员们在国歌镇的医疗中心发现马拉斯在一辆客货车上呼呼大睡。科尔曼靠近车门，马拉斯突然朝警长开枪，其他警员跟着开枪还击，打死疑犯。科尔曼警长被送往当地医院，抵院后不久死亡。 现场调查表明，马拉斯开了29枪，其中两枪击中科尔曼要害。警员还击用了41发子弹。 警员说，马拉斯在赛当那一个公路出口开枪打死詹姆斯约翰逊和卡洛莱丝福夫妇。 探员与马拉斯在芝加哥的父亲通话，老父说马拉斯曾在海军陆战队预备队，可能忧郁症，在凤凰城居住18个月期间，几乎没有接触过家人。 据Facebook显示，马拉斯是州立大学毕业，曾写过一部网络科幻/新时代小说。
bb50145b7a91a71e78f2ae17168b1f05d35e4ec9.translatedText: Apaio: The police chief and the murder of the Sedona couple were committed by the same person. Sheriff Arpaio said at a press conference on Tuesday morning that evidence from the murder weapon indicated that the murderer who killed the Anthem Township police chief recently was the same person who killed a couple in Yavapai County last week. Arpaio said the slugs taken from both crime scenes were the same. "The two murders in recent days involved high-powered rifles," Arpaio said. The suspect in both cases, 30-year-old Drew Ryan Maras, was killed at the same time as the deputy during a shootout on Sunday morning. Officers found Marras asleep in a van at Anthem Medical Center. As Coleman approached the car door, Maras suddenly fired at the deputy, and other officers fired back, killing the suspect. Sheriff Coleman was transported to a local hospital, where he died shortly after arrival. An investigation at the scene showed that Maras fired 29 shots, two of which hit Coleman's vitals. The officers returned fire and fired 41 rounds. Police said Maras shot and killed James Johnson and Carol Lesford at a highway exit in Sedan. Detectives spoke with Maras' father in Chicago, who said Maras had been in the Marine Corps Reserves and may have suffered from depression. He had little contact with his family during the 18 months he lived in Phoenix. According to Facebook, Maras is a graduate of a state university and has written an online science fiction/new era novel.

5f7a067b4d58da6771f5d10c2f8976fbee80deab.translatedText: There are too many people queuing up. To ensure the safety of consumers and employees, Apple has suspended iPhone sales in directly-operated retail stores in Beijing and Shanghai.

5e878e5594b184748efa2d12f3c028b77db7eccc.sourceText: 买个iPhone 4S还得冒着零下寒冬，通宵排队，跟黄牛党一起抢。1月13日，iPhone4S在国内市场上市，北京和上海的苹果直营零售店被排队抢购的人群围得水泄不通，最后被迫直接关门停售，这是苹果公司有史以来在全球范围内的第一次。但广州”果粉”表现淡定：广州没有招惹黄牛的苹果直营零售店，要买iPhone4S也不用排队，付钱立马拿货厖新快报记者昨日在广州市内多个同步销售iPhone4S的渠道走访发现，联通营业厅、国美电器、苏宁电器等地的iPhone 4S货量充足，购机不用抢。
5e878e5594b184748efa2d12f3c028b77db7eccc.translatedText: To buy an iPhone 4S, you have to brave the sub-zero winter and queue up all night to grab it with scalpers. On January 13, iPhone 4S was launched in the domestic market. Apple's directly-operated retail stores in Beijing and Shanghai were overwhelmed by people queuing up to buy the iPhone 4S, and were eventually forced to close their doors and cease sales. This was the first time in Apple's history that it had to do so globally. But "Fruit Fans" in Guangzhou behaved calmly: There are no directly-operated Apple retail stores in Guangzhou that attract scalpers, and there is no need to queue up to buy an iPhone 4S. You can get it immediately after paying. Pang Xin Express reporters visited multiple iPhone 4S sales channels in Guangzhou yesterday and found that China Unicom business halls, Gome Electric Appliances, Suning Appliances and other places have sufficient iPhone 4S stocks, so there is no need to rush to buy one.

a85c4a8f49889c6fbeca897b9fe8d928310bb0b5.translatedText: >Scalpers besiege the city, and "egg attacks" stores

ed3dac52f9e0d6b8527a486b5a0a84dee7de45be.sourceText: 13日凌晨，北京三里屯苹果直营零售店外的黄牛党发生激烈冲突，为避免事态无法控制，该店早上宣布停止出售iPhone4S，结果此举进一步刺激了在店外的部分黄牛，有黄牛甚至买来成袋鸡蛋，向三里屯店玻璃外墙砸去。部分在店外彻夜排队的消费者也情绪激动，纷纷表示苹果店是骗子，明明说好13日开始出售，结果却暂停出售。而被黄牛党雇来排队的”临时工”们更气愤，”说好的排一个晚上150块钱，最终因苹果停售而无法兑现”。至13日中午，苹果中国公司发出公告称，为了保证消费者和雇员的安全，北京和上海的直营零售店将暂时不销售iPhone。
ed3dac52f9e0d6b8527a486b5a0a84dee7de45be.translatedText: In the early morning of the 13th, outside Apple's direct-operated retail store in Sanlitun, Beijing In order to prevent the situation from getting out of control, the store announced in the morning that it would stop selling iPhone 4S. As a result, this further stimulated some scalpers outside the store. Some scalpers even bought bags of eggs and threw them at the glass exterior wall of the Sanlitun store. Some consumers who queued up all night outside the store were also excited and said that the Apple store was a liar. It clearly promised that sales would start on the 13th, but ended up suspending sales. The "temporary workers" hired by the scalpers to queue up were even more angry. "We agreed to queue for 150 yuan a night, but in the end we couldn't cash it in because Apple stopped selling it." As of noon on the 13th, Apple China issued an announcement stating that in order to ensure the safety of consumers and employees, its directly-operated retail stores in Beijing and Shanghai will temporarily not sell iPhones.

b3c566f85033ac65d64760dbbd51d2ddf67798d6.translatedText: 500 "Little Red Riding Hoods" formed a group to grab apples

234c74e62205284dbb24c37ac377d4132b58b3ba.sourceText: 12日晚上，有网友在微博上透露：”晚上8点多，在淮海路香港广场的苹果专卖店门前出现惊人一幕，苹果店门口突然出现多辆金龙大巴，接着从车上下来几百人，而且每个人都头戴一顶醒目的小红帽。正当人们以为这是一个刚刚抵沪的旅行团时，这批”小红帽”竟排着整齐的队列，全部加入了通宵抢购iPhone4S的队伍中。”据悉，这些”小红帽”来自江苏启东，一共有11辆大巴，来了500人，大多是中老年人，都是冲着排一个晚上有150元而来的。
234c74e62205284dbb24c37ac377d4132b58b3ba.translatedText: On the evening of the 12th, some netizens revealed on Weibo: "At around 8 p.m., a shocking scene occurred in front of the Apple store in Hong Kong Plaza, Huaihai Road. Multiple King Long buses suddenly appeared in front of the Apple store, and then hundreds of people got off the bus. Everyone was wearing an eye-catching little red hat. Just when people thought it was a tour group that had just arrived in Shanghai, these "little red hats" lined up neatly and all joined the queue to buy iPhone4S all night long. "It is reported that these "little red hats" came from Qidong, Jiangsu. There were 11 buses and 500 people came, mostly middle-aged and elderly people, all for the 150 yuan they got from queuing for a night.

ea4b59a7481c7c74fd126e18d64600760690b3e2.translatedText: Online sales: Sold out on Apple’s official website

626fa3e168aa902e65f3d5aa7fafe4be44de7aa6.sourceText: 由于苹果官网出售的iPhone4S是不含联通合约的裸机，而且按照苹果官方的定价销售，去官网下单也成了广州”果粉”的首选。新快报记者13日早上8时许登入苹果官网，看到每个注册账号一次最多购买两台iPhone4S，但配送时间预计长达两周；延至中午前，苹果官网的iPhone4S已告售罄，消费者无法再下订单。获得联通授权的京东商城也向新快报记者披露，13日早上7时开始发售iPhone4S，到8时已售出超过3000台，其中超过90%都是联通的合约机；截至13日下午，16GB的裸机也告售罄。记者在京东商城看到，多种容量版本的iPhone4S联通合约机和裸机在北京和上海都显示为”预定”，而在广东还是”现货”状态。
626fa3e168aa902e65f3d5aa7fafe4be44de7aa6.translatedText: Since the iPhone 4S sold on Apple’s official website is a bare metal without a China Unicom contract and is sold according to Apple’s official pricing, going to the official website to place an order has become the first choice for “Apple fans” in Guangzhou. A reporter from Xinkuaibao logged into Apple's official website at around 8 a.m. on the 13th and saw that each registered account could purchase up to two iPhone4S at a time, but the delivery time was expected to be up to two weeks; before noon, the iPhone4S on Apple's official website had been sold out, and consumers could no longer place orders. Jingdong Mall, which is authorized by China Unicom, also revealed to the New Express reporter that iPhone 4S started selling at 7 a.m. on the 13th, and by 8 a.m., more than 3,000 units had been sold, more than 90% of which were contract machines from China Unicom; as of the afternoon of the 13th, the 16GB bare metal units had also been sold out. Reporters saw on JD.com that China Unicom contract and bare iPhone 4S models of various capacity versions were displayed as "pre-ordered" in Beijing and Shanghai, while they were still "in stock" in Guangdong.

bdb7014331d221d2a9d67fdf5f83b31aafec36fd.sourceText: 1.联通老用户可续约：新快报记者从中国联通营业厅了解到，合约没到期的iPhone老用户购买iPhone4S可以续约。”以购买16GB版的iPhone 4S为例，iPhone老用户只需付5880元即可，老的合约上还没返还完的话费依然会逐月返还到手机账户上”，中国联通工作人员提醒广大iPhone老用户，”手机SIM卡必须和旧的i-Phone手机保持匹配，即每个月至少需要把手机SIM卡插到旧iPhone手机里一次。”2.买合约机可0利息分期付款：中国联通和招商银行推出了分期付款购iPhone4S的活动，招商银行信用卡用户可选择12个月或24个月，分期消费金额在1200元-30000元，即可0利息0手续费分期购iPhone4S。
bdb7014331d221d2a9d67fdf5f83b31aafec36fd.translatedText: 1. Old users of China Unicom can renew their contracts: Xinkuaibao reporter learned from China Unicom’s business hall that old iPhone users whose contracts have not expired can renew their contracts if they buy iPhone 4S. ” to buy the 16GB version of iPhone 4S, for example, old iPhone users only need to pay 5,880 yuan, and the unpaid phone bills on the old contract will still be returned to the mobile phone account month by month." China Unicom staff reminded the majority of old iPhone users, "The mobile phone SIM card must match the old i-Phone, that is, the mobile phone SIM card must be inserted into the old i-Phone at least every month. iPhone once.” 2. You can pay in installments with zero interest when buying a contract phone: China Unicom and China Merchants Bank have launched an installment plan to purchase iPhone 4S. China Merchants Bank credit card users can choose 12 months or 24 months, and the installment consumption amount is between 1,200 yuan and 30,000 yuan, and they can buy iPhone 4S in installments with zero interest and no handling fees.

1d3d2aca83c9cd3c731a68a46f46a2aa5956e34f.sourceText: 3.港行iPhone4S比国行裸机划算：比起iPhone4S国行裸机售价被炒高上千元的境况，在广州购买港行裸机更划算，以16GB版本为例，后者目前在广州市场售价5000元左右。
1d3d2aca83c9cd3c731a68a46f46a2aa5956e34f.translatedText: 3. iPhone 4S from Hong Kong is more cost-effective than bare metal from China: Compared with the situation where the bare metal iPhone 4S from China is priced higher by thousands of yuan, it is more cost-effective to buy bare metal from Hong Kong in Guangzhou. Taking the 16GB version as an example, the latter currently sells for about 5,000 yuan in the Guangzhou market.

7aaa1eb4fff0f7e949e322a6373a20314b36ddaa.sourceText: 枪击案1周年 吉佛兹议员重返案发地 （亚省时报） 枪击案发生1年后，8日吉佛兹议员重返当年中枪的超市。报道称土桑市枪击案事发1年，8日举办纪念活动，当钟声响起，穿着白衣女孩曼妙起舞，神职人员也献上祈祷。 去年发生的这起枪案造成6死13伤，其中联邦众议员吉佛兹脑部重伤。吉佛兹头部伤势至今未完全康复，她和夫婿，退休航天员凯利共同出席当晚的独光晚会，为一整天连串纪念活动划下句点。 持枪歹徒去年1月8日在该处对参加选民见面会的群众开枪。19人中枪，其中6人不幸 丧生，包括年仅9岁的女孩、吉佛兹的助理，及1位联邦法官。涉嫌歹徒为23岁大学辍学生拉夫纳。拉夫纳有精神病史，被控49项罪名，包括一级谋杀及企图行刺吉佛兹。 官方纪念活动8日在去年案发时间上午10时11分正式展开，全市响起钟声。吉佛兹与夫婿8日晚出席在亚利桑那大学举办的烛光晚会。这项活动预期吸引数千名土桑市民参加
7aaa1eb4fff0f7e949e322a6373a20314b36ddaa.translatedText: >1st anniversary of the shooting, Councilor Giffords returned to the scene of the incident (Alberta Times) One year after the shooting, Councilor Giffords returned to the supermarket where he was shot on the 8th. According to reports, one year after the shooting in Tucson, a commemorative event was held on the 8th. When the bell rang, girls in white danced gracefully, and clergy also offered prayers. The shooting that occurred last year resulted in 6 deaths and 13 injuries, including Congressman Giffords who suffered a serious brain injury. Giffords has not fully recovered from her head injury. She and her husband, retired astronaut Kelly, attended the one-light party that night, which concluded a whole day of commemorative events. Gunmen opened fire on people attending a voter meeting there on January 8 last year. Nineteen people were shot, and six of them died, including a 9-year-old girl, Giffords' assistant, and a federal judge. The suspected gangster is 23-year-old college dropout Loughner. Loughner, who has a history of mental illness, was charged with 49 counts, including first-degree murder and attempted assassination of Giffords. The official commemoration event officially started on the 8th at 10:11 a.m., the time of the incident last year, and bells rang throughout the city. Giffords and her husband attended a candlelight vigil held at the University of Arizona on the evening of the 8th. The event is expected to attract thousands of Tucson residents

ae9f57380898e3d037d08509408cfc717eac7d8e.translatedText: Mother left home to drink, leaving three children at home and arrested (Alberta Times) Phoenix police arrested a woman who allegedly left three children at home while she went out to drink...

3c5f252b8da382c36a06f9070b18eeac36de0cd9.sourceText: 妈妈离家喝酒留3孩童在家 被捕 （亚省时报） 凤凰城警方拘捕一名女子，据称她将三名孩童留在家，自己出去喝酒。 根据法庭文件，警方在周六晚10时45分左右收到电话报案，在公寓大楼附近发现安吉增田三个孩子，分别是5岁，6岁和8岁，没有成人监护。孩子们在警员到达前35分钟回家。警员陪伴孩子等待他们的母亲，等了45分钟，增田才回来。 增田告诉警员，她出去同朋友喝东西了。虽然没有为孩子们雇保姆，但问过邻居，邻居也答应过来检查。 但邻居告诉警方，他们不愿意帮增田​​看管孩子，并表示增田总是让他们独自在家。 增田因三项虐待儿童罪名被逮捕，送到第四街监狱。孩子们被送到儿童保护服务监管。
3c5f252b8da382c36a06f9070b18eeac36de0cd9.translatedText: Mother left home to drink, leaving three children at home and was arrested (Alberta Times) Phoenix police arrested a woman who allegedly left three children at home while she went out to drink. According to court documents, police received a call around 10:45 p.m. on Saturday that Anji Masuda's three children, ages 5, 6 and 8, were found near the apartment building without adult supervision. The children returned home 35 minutes before officers arrived. The police accompanied the children and waited for their mother. After waiting for 45 minutes, Masuda came back. Masuda told officers she had gone out to drink with friends. Although I did not hire a nanny for the children, I asked my neighbors and they agreed to come and check on me. But neighbors told police they were unwilling to help Masuda watch the children and said Masuda always left them home alone. Masuda was arrested on three counts of child abuse and transported to the Fourth Street Jail. The children were transported to the custody of Child Protective Services.

6aeef2b45c14d16cccc4331ab3779e6f98004880.sourceText: 房市吸引国际买家佛州增长最快 亚省不弱
6aeef2b45c14d16cccc4331ab3779e6f98004880.translatedText: The real estate market is attracting international buyers, Florida is growing fastest, and Alberta is not weak

3b2d4e3edcb3db57aa4ac90a6c01e613aa7767ca.sourceText: 房市吸引国际买家佛州增长最快 亚省不弱 根据全美房地产经纪人协会上周周公布的2012年国际住房购买动态概况…
3b2d4e3edcb3db57aa4ac90a6c01e613aa7767ca.translatedText: The real estate market is attracting international buyers, Florida is growing fastest, and Alberta is not weak According to the 2012 International Housing Purchase Dynamics Overview released by the National Association of Realtors last week...

ecfe2def68302a5eeeace9428ec0cddcead68e37.sourceText: 根据全美房地产经纪人协会上周周公布的2012年国际住房购买动态概况，2011年3月至2012年3月全美房地产国际销售额预计在825亿美元，而佛罗里达州增长最快，是国际客户的首选目的地。
ecfe2def68302a5eeeace9428ec0cddcead68e37.translatedText: According to the 2012 International Housing Purchase Dynamics Overview released by the National Association of Realtors last week, international real estate sales in the United States are expected to be US$82.5 billion from March 2011 to March 2012, and Florida has the fastest growth and is the preferred destination for international customers.

6028d0533b9dfecf95195fce19d2e01979ccf312.sourceText: 全美房地产经纪人协会自2007年起，开始统计来自国际客户的房地产销售数据，国际客户包括非居民的外国人和持有签证居住超过六个月的外国人或新移民。数据显示，截止2012年3月的12个月之中，国际客户购买额占美国房地产销售总额的4.8％，达到825亿美元，较2011年同期的664亿美元增长了24%。非居民的外国人占了国际销售总额的五成。
6028d0533b9dfecf95195fce19d2e01979ccf312.translatedText: Since 2007, the National Association of Realtors has begun to collect real estate sales data from international customers. International customers include non-resident foreigners and foreigners or new immigrants who have stayed with visas for more than six months. Data show that in the 12 months ending March 2012, purchases by international customers accounted for 4.8% of total U.S. real estate sales, reaching $82.5 billion, an increase of 24% from $66.4 billion in the same period in 2011. Non-resident foreigners account for 50% of total international sales.

89a2b814675e477f10950a00e83c6040a804c393.sourceText: 国际买家在全美各地四处购买房产，但主要集中在四个州，佛罗里达州、加利福尼亚州、德克萨斯州和亚利桑那州。四个州的国际销售额占全美国际总销售额的51％。佛罗里达州的国际销售增长最快，是国际买家置业的黄金地段，占全美国际总销售额的26％。加利福尼亚州占11％，德克萨斯州和亚利桑那州均占7%。人口地理环境、航空运输条件、气候似乎是重要的考虑因素，例如，东海岸吸引欧洲人，西海岸对亚洲买家具吸引力，佛罗里达州吸引南美、欧洲和加拿大人。
89a2b814675e477f10950a00e83c6040a804c393.translatedText: International buyers are purchasing properties all over the United States, but are primarily concentrated in four states: Florida, California, Texas and Arizona. International sales in the four states account for 51% of total U.S. international sales. Florida has the fastest growing international sales and is a prime location for international buyers, accounting for 26% of total international sales in the United States. California accounts for 11%, and Texas and Arizona both account for 7%. Demographic geography, air transportation conditions, and climate appear to be important considerations, with the East Coast attracting Europeans, the West Coast attracting Asian buyers, and Florida attracting South Americans, Europeans, and Canadians, for example.

b7828400e3161b88b9e23011886013a964ef901d.sourceText: 尽管在美国市场的国际买家来自全球各地，但五个国家​​，加拿大、中国（包括香港）、墨西哥、印度和英国的国际客户占了55％的国际交易。加拿大和中国仍是增长最快的国家。中国从2011年的9%增至11％，加拿大占24％的国际销售，墨西哥8％，印度和英国都占6%。
b7828400e3161b88b9e23011886013a964ef901d.translatedText: Although international buyers in the US market come from all over the world, international customers from five countries, Canada, China (including Hong Kong), Mexico, India and the United Kingdom, account for 55% of international transactions. Canada and China remain the fastest growing countries. China increased to 11% from 9% in 2011, Canada accounted for 24% of international sales, Mexico 8%, India and the United Kingdom both accounted for 6%.

6d4da6d5225071693be850fa6ace34b958f055a0.sourceText: 国际交易超过一半，62％是现金交易，自2007年以来现金交易一直呈上升趋势，国际客户由于缺乏在美国的信用记录，没有社会安全号码，因此很难在美国得到抵押贷款。影响美国房地产国际销售的主要因素是移民法、贷款以及买方需要了解美国的习俗和商业模式，外汇市场也是一个因素。
6d4da6d5225071693be850fa6ace34b958f055a0.translatedText: More than half of international transactions, 62% are cash transactions. Cash transactions have been on the rise since 2007. It is difficult for international customers to get mortgages in the United States due to their lack of credit history and social security numbers in the United States. The main factors affecting the international sale of U.S. real estate are immigration laws, lending, and the buyer's need to understand U.S. customs and business models. The foreign exchange market is also a factor.

2853e5a78c3e5532d53adf5502d46b25a556ccf2.sourceText: 美杂志公布“全球失败国家榜” 中国排76美国159 【环球网报道 记者 李亮】美国著名政治杂志《外交政策》…
2853e5a78c3e5532d53adf5502d46b25a556ccf2.translatedText: US Magazine announced the "Global Failed Countries List", China ranked 76th and the US ranked 159th [Global Network Report Reporter Li Liang] The famous American political magazine "Foreign Policy"...

90f1bbc27bcbe46946e2931d738f8051f092a902.sourceText: 【环球网报道 记者 李亮】美国著名政治杂志《外交政策》6月19日发布了一份特别榜单，即全球”失败国家”排行榜，非洲国家索马里连续第五年占据榜首，成为世界上”最失败国家”，其它前10名的国家包括刚果、苏丹、乍得、阿富汗、伊拉克等。在榜首排名最后、意即最稳定的国家则大多来自北欧和北美。中国在这份榜单上排名76，比去年靠后，”稳定性”有所增加，俄罗斯则排名83，美国居第159。
90f1bbc27bcbe46946e2931d738f8051f092a902.translatedText: Global Network Report Reporter Li Liang] The famous American political magazine "Foreign Policy" released a special list on June 19, namely the global "failed countries" rankings. The African country Somalia has topped the list for the fifth consecutive year, becoming the "most failed country" in the world. Other top 10 countries include Congo, Sudan, Chad, Afghanistan, Iraq, etc. The countries at the bottom of the list, meaning the most stable, are mostly from Northern Europe and North America. China ranks 76th on this list, lower than last year, with increased "stability", Russia ranks 83rd, and the United States ranks 159th.

1b574621cad65c90fd8c64504789fd2c5e5c98bd.sourceText: 美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）6月19日报道称，这是《外交杂志》发布的第8份”世界失败国家”榜单，它根据12个社会、经济和政治指标，对全球177个国家进行”不稳定风险”评估，并于6月18日在网站上公布结果。
1b574621cad65c90fd8c64504789fd2c5e5c98bd.translatedText: CNN reported on June 19 that this is the eighth list of "World's Failed Countries" released by "Diplomacy Magazine". It assesses the "risk of instability" of 177 countries around the world based on 12 social, economic and political indicators, and announced the results on its website on June 18.

90c3a8b33f9e75d3786de76d469d29c1bbed4063.sourceText: 索马里因”普遍的无法可依、低效政府、恐怖主义、武装叛乱、犯罪和对外国车队的公然袭击” 以114.9分第五年位居榜单之首。其次是刚果（111.2分）、苏丹（109.4分）、乍得（107.6分）和津巴布韦（106.3分）。第6到10名分别是阿富汗（106分）、海地（104.9）、也门（104.8分）、伊拉克（104.3）、中非共和国（103.8）。此外，巴基斯坦排名13，朝鲜第22，伊朗第34。
90c3a8b33f9e75d3786de76d469d29c1bbed4063.translatedText: Somalia topped the list for the fifth year with a score of 114.9 due to "widespread lawlessness, ineffective government, terrorism, armed insurgency, crime and outright attacks on foreign convoys." Followed by Congo (111.2 points), Sudan (109.4 points), Chad (107.6 points) and Zimbabwe (106.3 points). Ranking 6th to 10th are Afghanistan (106 points), Haiti (104.9), Yemen (104.8 points), Iraq (104.3), and the Central African Republic (103.8). In addition, Pakistan ranks 13th, North Korea 22nd, and Iran 34th.

8421295006feff86c0c51490618e2605124ffefc.sourceText: 中国以78.3分排名第76，得分和排名均较去年有所下降，意即稳定性有所增加。俄罗斯第83的位置也较去年下降。而美国则以34.8分排名159.
8421295006feff86c0c51490618e2605124ffefc.translatedText: China ranked 76th with 78.3 points. Both the score and ranking have declined compared with last year, which means stability has increased. Russia's 83rd position also dropped from last year. The United States ranked 159th with a score of 34.8.

c21c2b198acbf6b9d6b5955691dffd19454e0457.sourceText: 受”阿拉伯之春”的影响，埃及、利比亚、叙利亚、突尼斯的情况大幅恶化，尤其是利比亚，从一直居于60名之外前进到今年的第50名，叙利亚则从2011年的48名上升到23名。日本因大规模地震与核电站爆炸事故等，排名跌至151位。由于经济危机与对政府的不信赖，希腊排名跌至138位。
c21c2b198acbf6b9d6b5955691dffd19454e0457.translatedText: Affected by the "Arab Spring", the situation in Egypt, Libya, Syria, and Tunisia has deteriorated significantly. Libya, in particular, has moved from being outside the 60th place to 50th this year. Syria has risen from 48th in 2011 to 23rd. Japan's ranking fell to 151st due to large-scale earthquakes and nuclear power plant explosions. Due to the economic crisis and distrust of the government, Greece's ranking fell to 138th.

3188ae43bfcd17f1250e2567e3809bda3e136f86.sourceText: 负责编撰榜单的美国非盈利组织”和平基金”在其网站上称，排名靠前的国家并非”必然是失败的，但是面临着巨大的压力，需克服诸如不平衡发展、经济衰退、人权等问题”。
3188ae43bfcd17f1250e2567e3809bda3e136f86.translatedText: The "Peace Fund", a US non-profit organization responsible for compiling the list, stated on its website that the countries at the top are not "necessarily failed, but are facing tremendous pressure to overcome problems such as uneven development, economic recession, and human rights."

1d68aca6f021a29ca2a2de8360a46a6c759b67d7.sourceText: 在榜首上排名最后的国家也是世界上最稳定的国家，新西兰排171，挪威排173，丹麦排175，瑞典和荷兰是排名的最后两位。
1d68aca6f021a29ca2a2de8360a46a6c759b67d7.translatedText: The country ranked last on the list is also the most stable country in the world. New Zealand ranks 171, Norway ranks 173, Denmark ranks 175, and Sweden and the Netherlands are the last two.

0cf3f3c041445ecdac375a708d5a09c186c6fd5f.translatedText: Group photo of the leadership team of Longgang Office

e243a95b33060edbe4a81bf744c2196f06096499.sourceText: (关昆容报道)鳯凰城龙冈公所于一月七日在多福餐馆召开年度会议，主席关嬿仪回顾了2011年的工作，总结去年工作包括有：春宴办得有声有色；七月四日协助鳯凰城侨联总会办好国庆和选美活动；十二月协办侨联郊游活动，并支持和赞助了新一届的中国週，鳯凰城龙冈公所的工作受到侨社的好评。 关嬿仪主席语重深长地提醒大家，服务侨社的宗旨是要公正严明，不能人云亦云，对不实的言论要加以抵制，无论做何事要以侨胞侨社利益为前提。大家十分赞同，并对她年度工作给予肯定和赞扬。 会议最后经大家选举，选出2012年度新一届的领导班子，主席是张华芳，她曾两次出任龙冈主席，在任其间表现出色，2005年举办过秋季郊游，办得非常好，深得侨社赞赏。 龙冈新一届的领导班子名单如下： 主席：张华芳 副主席：关兆锋、刘全知 财政：关嬿仪 中文书记：关昆容 英文书记：刘沃彪 核数：关锡樵 公关：刘邓情芬 顾问：刘汝章、关嬿仪、关宗任、张肇鸿
e243a95b33060edbe4a81bf744c2196f06096499.translatedText: (Kunrong Guan reported) Longgang Office in Longhuang City held its annual meeting at Duofu Restaurant on January 7. Chairman Guan Yanyi reviewed 2011 Summarizing the work of the past year, the work of last year includes: the spring banquet was held in a lively manner; assisting the Overseas Chinese Federation Association in Huanghuang City to organize the National Day and beauty pageant activities on July 4th; co-organizing the outing activities of the Overseas Chinese Federation in December, and supporting and sponsoring the new China Week. The work of the Longgang Office in Longgang City was well received by the overseas Chinese community. Chairman Guan Yanyi reminded everyone in profound words that the purpose of serving the overseas Chinese community is to be fair and strict, not to follow others' opinions, to resist untrue remarks, and to put the interests of the overseas Chinese community first in whatever she does. Everyone agreed and affirmed and praised her annual work. At the end of the meeting, everyone elected the new leadership team for 2012. The chairman is Zhang Huafang. She has served as the chairman of Longgang twice and performed well during her tenure. In 2005, she held an autumn outing, which was very well done and won the praise of the overseas Chinese community. The list of the new leadership team of Longgang is as follows: Chairman: Zhang Huafang Vice Chairman: Guan Zhaofeng, Liu Quanzhi Finance: Guan Yanyi Chinese Secretary: Guan Kunrong English secretary: Liu Wobiao Auditor: Guan Xiqiao Public relations: Liu Dengqingfen Consultants: Liu Ruzhang, Guan Yanyi, Guan Zongren, Zhang Zhaohong

b8c9e77b702dce6628a4d291b97ce49ef8a2f1e8.translatedText: Technology companies encounter a "mid-life crisis": Apple and IBM become a model for survival (pictures) No...

3b4be11b16d261437981bd52e5721a0fd4358898.sourceText: 不断创新是IBM成就百年大业的决定因素，也是值得其他科技公司借鉴的宝贵经验
3b4be11b16d261437981bd52e5721a0fd4358898.translatedText: Continuous innovation is the decisive factor in IBM's century-old achievements, and it is also a valuable experience that other technology companies can learn from

8907887f70d13109985286eb1c10c55a42e46365.sourceText: 导语：国外媒体今天撰文称，全球公司的”平均寿命”不到40岁，因此要想长期生存下去，克服这种业务模式老化、创新能力下滑、企业渐渐陷入困境的”中年危机”，就必须像苹果和IBM一样勇于突破现状，顺应行业发展趋势。
8907887f70d13109985286eb1c10c55a42e46365.translatedText: Introduction: Foreign media wrote an article today saying that the world The "average lifespan" of a company is less than 40 years old. Therefore, if you want to survive in the long term and overcome this "mid-life crisis" in which business models are aging, innovation capabilities are declining, and companies are gradually getting into trouble, you must be brave enough to break through the status quo and follow industry development trends like Apple and IBM.

40a78f78327a84d1f761c235af002a483c5b23f8.translatedText: The following is the full text of the article:

f95d331aa0cb0d2c3b1621b2ba8a6949084b067c.translatedText: The company does not live long

94179b81a109cd3bdc3c1e2fc907307b7c245f92.sourceText: 公司并不长寿。事实上，根据管理学教授查尔斯?#26031;特巴特(Charles Stubbart)和迈克尔?#22856;特(Michael Knight)对600多万家公司进行的调查，只有很少一部分能活过40年。”尽管规模、财务状况和人员构成各有不同，但公司的平均寿命仍然不及普通美国人。”他们总结道。
94179b81a109cd3bdc3c1e2fc907307b7c245f92.translatedText: The company does not live long. In fact, according to a survey of more than 6 million companies conducted by management professors Charles Stubbart and Michael Knight, only a handful survive past 40 years. "Despite differences in size, financial status, and personnel composition, the average life span of companies is still less than that of the average American," they concluded.

1fd0229b4323950031272bc63c5511f7d803f2c4.sourceText: 考虑到当今科技的快速发展，即使40岁似乎也是一个很难实现的数字。
1fd0229b4323950031272bc63c5511f7d803f2c4.translatedText: Considering the rapid development of today's technology, even 40 years old seems to be a difficult number to achieve.

2e1896d743235e1cce6d2238aa3f78241697f1fe.sourceText: 柯达、Blockbuster、巴诺书店(Barnes & Noble)和各大唱片公司的美国高官都在关注两个问题：大企业能否在平均寿命快速降低的环境中实现足够快的创新速度?如果能，应当怎么做?
2e1896d743235e1cce6d2238aa3f78241697f1fe.translatedText: U.S. officials from Kodak, Blockbuster, Barnes & Noble and major record companies are paying attention to two questions: Can large companies innovate fast enough in an environment where life expectancy is rapidly decreasing? If so, what should be done?

cd8e4879206f55ffddf570ded20c52c75dd49024.sourceText: 商业领袖、学者和风险投资家都表示，能够生存下来的大公司都拥有很强的变革意识。最成功的企业并不担心构建新业务会蚕食主要收入来源。他们会频繁地展开创新，借此引入新技术，并打开新市场棗但关键在于，这些并购的规模都比较小。除此之外，运气成分也很重要。
cd8e4879206f55ffddf570ded20c52c75dd49024.translatedText: Business leaders, academics and venture capitalists all say that large companies that can survive have a strong sense of change. The most successful businesses don't worry about cannibalizing their primary source of revenue by building new businesses. They frequently innovate, introduce new technologies, and open new markets. But the key is that these acquisitions are relatively small. In addition, the element of luck is also important.

3a6f00a06653cfc5a04488eb1ace51c25945e7d5.sourceText: 创立于1886年的强生以及刚刚迎来百年华诞的IBM都已经远超40岁的平均公司寿命。更近的例子时，35岁的苹果也已经从一家小型PC厂商转型为移动设备巨擘。创立于1998年的谷歌也在探索新的道路，以便在搜索广告市场之外寻找新的增长来源。
3a6f00a06653cfc5a04488eb1ace51c25945e7d5.translatedText: Johnson & Johnson, founded in 1886, and IBM, which just celebrated its centenary, have far exceeded the average company lifespan of 40 years. As a more recent example, 35-year-old Apple has also transformed from a small PC manufacturer into a mobile device giant. Google, founded in 1998, is also exploring new avenues to find new sources of growth outside of the search advertising market.

2ebf2052fa0dc83dbf8452bffb6ac9289f1bf975.sourceText: 另一方面，被”创造性破坏”(both good and bad)击败的企业通常会变得非常官僚化，过度看重防御，并且因为着眼规模庞大的并购在追赶市场趋势时落后于人。
2ebf2052fa0dc83dbf8452bffb6ac9289f1bf975.translatedText: On the other hand, companies defeated by "creative destruction" (both good and bad) often become highly bureaucratic, overly focused on defense, and lag behind in catching up with market trends by focusing on large-scale mergers and acquisitions.

b1f56dd2dfd1deca48f9659cdb6a3db44f80c623.sourceText: 美国风险投资公司Accel Partners合伙人兼沃尔玛和戴尔董事詹姆斯?#24067;雷耶(James Breyer)表示，成功大企业的顶级高管与小企业非常相似。他认为，这些高管都很聪明，可以在引入新业务的同时专注于公司核心业务。
b1f56dd2dfd1deca48f9659cdb6a3db44f80c623.translatedText: James Breyer, a partner at the US venture capital firm Accel Partners and a director of Wal-Mart and Dell, said that the top executives of successful large companies are very similar to small businesses. He believes that these executives are smart and can focus on the company's core business while introducing new business.

ca0f05bccd01383a6386ce8e448ec61474cdaa8f.sourceText: 他表示，由于Accel还是Facebook的股东，因此有人曾经问他，Facebook和沃尔玛的董事会有何不同。他回答道：”在这两家企业的高管之间，我看到的相似之处多于差异。”
ca0f05bccd01383a6386ce8e448ec61474cdaa8f.translatedText: He said that since Accel is still a shareholder of Facebook, someone once asked him what the difference is between the boards of directors of Facebook and Wal-Mart. He replied: "I see more similarities than differences between the executives of the two companies."

d216919a7f53104a3a19fe38210dc1bfc0f107c8.sourceText: 惠普和IBM之间的对比则凸显了这一挑战。当郭士纳(Louis V. Gerstner)接过IBM帅印时，他希望知道该公司为何持续错过新兴行业趋势。例如，IBM开发了首款商用路由器，但该市场却最终被思科主导。一份内部研究显示，IBM在成熟市场的成功使之难以拓展新领域，而且缺乏适当的组织结构来定确定并构建新项目。
d216919a7f53104a3a19fe38210dc1bfc0f107c8.translatedText: The contrast between HP and IBM highlights this challenge. When Louis V. Gerstner took over as CEO of IBM, he wanted to know why the company continued to miss emerging industry trends. For example, IBM developed the first commercial router, but the market was ultimately dominated by Cisco. An internal study showed that IBM's success in mature markets made it difficult to expand into new areas and lacked the appropriate organizational structure to identify and build new projects.

34bc9251a43c32477bcc447e8270f4066bccac6d.sourceText: 因此，郭士纳2000年发起了一个新项目，要求新兴业务组织在顶级高管的指导下寻找并培育增长机遇。根据2010年发表在《哈佛商业评论》上的一篇研究报告，此后5年，生命科学、Linux软件和普适计算已经为IBM增加了逾150亿美元的收入。
34bc9251a43c32477bcc447e8270f4066bccac6d.translatedText: Therefore, Gerstner launched a new program in 2000, requiring emerging business organizations to identify and cultivate growth opportunities under the guidance of top executives. According to a research report published in the Harvard Business Review in 2010, life sciences, Linux software and ubiquitous computing have increased IBM's revenue by more than $15 billion in the following five years.

0b0cd05d45e23a73ba35278f7397470e15d88d2a.sourceText: 在2011年底卸任的前CEO彭明盛(Samuel J. Palmisano)的领导下，IBM通过积极的并购战略弥补了内部的不足，挑选了数十家小型企业作为并购对象，并借此拓展了利润丰厚的软件和咨询业务。
0b0cd05d45e23a73ba35278f7397470e15d88d2a.translatedText: Under the leadership of former CEO Samuel J. Palmisano, who stepped down at the end of 2011, IBM made up for its internal shortcomings through an aggressive mergers and acquisitions strategy, selecting dozens of small companies as acquisition targets and expanding its lucrative software and consulting businesses.

4ebf43d4a56ee704e5aa263a7fd549504a07d96d.sourceText: 与此同时，彭明盛并不害怕做出艰难的抉择：他在PC全面商品化前，于2004年出售了PC业务。”我们之所以能活100年，是因为我们从不将视野局限于一款特定产品。”彭明盛去年接受媒体采访时说。
4ebf43d4a56ee704e5aa263a7fd549504a07d96d.translatedText: Meanwhile, Palmisano was not afraid to make tough choices: He sold the PC business in 2004, before PCs became fully commercialized. "The reason why we can live for 100 years is because we never limit our vision to one specific product." Palmisano said in an interview with the media last year.

be287d88b041548fbfa776d54e4e63a7593239ba.sourceText: 相比而言，惠普却决定做大PC业务，并于2002年花费250亿美元收购了竞争对手康柏。随着PC行业面临的威胁日渐明朗，该公司去年愚蠢地宣布可能出售PC业务，但最终迫于投资者压力放弃了该计划。
be287d88b041548fbfa776d54e4e63a7593239ba.translatedText: In contrast, HP decided to expand its PC business and spent US$25 billion to acquire rival Compaq in 2002. As threats to the PC industry became increasingly clear, the company foolishly announced last year that it might sell its PC business, only to abandon the plan under investor pressure.

c405b74944ffe25b187c543eda89376cfb886bc7.sourceText: 惠普在商业软件市场也起步较晚，而且花费不菲。当惠普去年秋天斥资110亿美元收购英国软件公司Autonomy时，很多分析师都认为这一高昂售价将损害股东价值。哈佛商学院教授罗萨白 坎特(Rosabeth Kanter)说：”惠普一直在尝试IBM五年前做过的事情。”
c405b74944ffe25b187c543eda89376cfb886bc7.translatedText: HP also started late in the business software market and spent a lot of money. When HP spent $11 billion to acquire British software company Autonomy last fall, many analysts believed the high price would hurt shareholder value. Rosabeth Kanter, a professor at Harvard Business School, said: "HP has been trying what IBM did five years ago."

682d01014b81564de3c6b704aeedeaa030fda214.sourceText: 苹果近年来的发展已经为如何逃脱创新困境提供了一个很好的案例。在前CEO史蒂夫?#20052;布斯(Steve Jobs)1990年代重返公司后，他更新了PC产品线，并凭借iPod在数字音乐领域建立了主导地位。但他却在几年后借助新产品将这两项业务至于风险之中。
682d01014b81564de3c6b704aeedeaa030fda214.translatedText: Apple's development in recent years has provided a good example of how to escape the innovation dilemma. After former CEO Steve Jobs returned to the company in the 1990s, he updated the PC line and established a dominant position in digital music with the iPod. But a few years later, he put both businesses at risk with the help of new products.

628fa124dab5c469c84f7aa59bb08179a34450cd.sourceText: 在推出iPhone后，乔布斯开始蚕食iPod的销量。但这种牺牲是值得的：在截至去年9月的季度内，iPhone及其相关产品为苹果贡献了39%的收入，并使之在增长迅猛的移动领域成为了领导者。苹果随后又通过iPad电脑冒险蚕食了PC和笔记本业务，该产品目前也已经为苹果贡献了24%的收入。
628fa124dab5c469c84f7aa59bb08179a34450cd.translatedText: After launching the iPhone, Jobs began to cannibalize iPod sales. But the sacrifice was worth it: iPhones and related products contributed 39% of Apple's revenue in the quarter ended last September, making it a leader in the fast-growing mobile sector. Apple then took the risk of cannibalizing the PC and notebook business through the iPad computer, which currently contributes 24% of Apple's revenue.

0dc93a1d7a0230f03395926aa2265aded528cd8e.sourceText: 谷歌成立至今只有13年时间，并且仍然极度依赖搜索广告业务，但该公司已经开始通过适度的并购在威胁其统治地位的新市场占据主导。
0dc93a1d7a0230f03395926aa2265aded528cd8e.translatedText: Google is only 13 years old and still relies heavily on search advertising, but the company has begun to dominate new markets that threaten its dominance through modest acquisitions.

a01ee53a41b79a3d43f19f077eaf6de4057c5d2f.sourceText: YouTube和Android是谷歌最知名的两项新业务，并且都是通过并购构建的。在收购了这些企业后，谷歌允许他们在创始人的领导下独立运营，并成长壮大。谷歌还在去年宣布斥资125亿美元收购摩托罗拉移动。该交易目前正在接受监管者的审核。
a01ee53a41b79a3d43f19f077eaf6de4057c5d2f.translatedText: YouTube and Android are Google's two most well-known new businesses, and both were built through mergers and acquisitions. After acquiring these businesses, Google allowed them to operate independently and grow under the leadership of their founders. Google also announced last year that it would acquire Motorola Mobility for $12.5 billion. The deal is currently under review by regulators.

e428baa2f62d59f0a7e238cb11d4fd2cf997fa89.sourceText: 新学期开始 希望中文学校喜迎300多位同学(组图) 2012年1月7日下午希望中文学校春季学期在美莎社区大学开学。300多位同学如期来到学校，开始中文以及才艺的学习。 中文课小朋友积极举手回答问题 下午2点注册办公室依然很满，家长们都来给孩子注册交钱，一些志愿者也开始协调学校各项工作，都各就各位，校长赵彩红更是忙着为各位老师解决开学的各种问题。教室里已经竟然有序开始了中文课，老师们用标准的中文，问同学们各种假期的趣事，同学们也高高举手发言，与中文老师互动。绘画老师将开学日办成了作品展，将学生去年的作品贴在一起，让来上课的家长和同学们欣赏。 学生作品展 少儿舞蹈班的孩子，则赶紧练习她们学习的舞蹈，因为在中国传统春节来临的时候，她们马上就要参加表演了。 舞蹈班学生正在排练 新学期中，学校在才艺课上又增加了素描，色彩，Zumba,街舞新课程。更让同学们兴奋的是学校还组建了青年乐队，据才艺组负责人谢晓红老师介绍，青年乐团是在蔡善皋老师的带领下组建起来的，在中国传统春节期间，青年乐团已经接受了社区的邀请，将会为大家带来精彩的表演。 新学期又开始了，新年的一年也开始了，祝愿同学们能学到更多的知识和才艺，也祝海外的中文学校能越办越红火！
e428baa2f62d59f0a7e238cb11d4fd2cf997fa89.translatedText: The new semester begins, Hope Chinese School welcomes more than 300 students (photo) On the afternoon of January 7, 2012, the spring semester of Hope Chinese School started at Mesa Community College. More than 300 students came to school as scheduled to start learning Chinese and talent. Children in the Chinese class actively raised their hands to answer questions. The registration office was still very full at 2pm. Parents came to register and pay their children. Some volunteers also began to coordinate various school work, and they were all in place. Principal Zhao Caihong was busy solving various problems for the teachers about the start of the school year. The Chinese class has started in the classroom in an orderly manner. The teachers used standard Chinese and asked the students about interesting things about the holidays. The students also raised their hands high to speak and interacted with the Chinese teacher. The painting teacher turned the first day of school into a work exhibition, pasting together students' works from last year for parents and classmates who came to class to appreciate. Student Works Exhibition The children in the children's dance class hurriedly practiced the dances they were learning because they were about to participate in performances when the traditional Chinese Spring Festival was approaching. Dance class students are rehearsing. In the new semester, the school has added new courses such as sketching, coloring, Zumba, and hip-hop to the talent class. What makes the students even more excited is that the school has also formed a youth band. According to teacher Xie Xiaohong, the head of the talent group, the youth band was formed under the leadership of teacher Cai Shangao. During the traditional Chinese Spring Festival, the youth band has accepted the invitation from the community and will bring wonderful performances to everyone. The new semester has begun again, and so has the new year. I wish the students can learn more knowledge and talents, and I also wish that overseas Chinese schools can become more prosperous!

d5b46476b02f6aac60312b00e2608d9c85093d38.sourceText: 汽油、星巴克咖啡及饮料涨价 （亚省时报） 新年伊始，全国传来许多商品即将涨价的坏消息。本周末的汽油价可能上涨4.5分，原因不在原油涨价，而是国会拒绝延长有30年历史的乙醇补贴政策，导致这项政府补贴失效。 美国普遍在汽油里掺入乙醇，以便减少排气烟雾。目前美国汽车使用的大多数汽油，含有10%乙醇，称为E-10。少数地区还出售E-85燃油，其乙醇含量高达85%。但只有使用「弹性燃料」(flex fuel)的汽车，才能使用E-85。 乙醇补贴政策结束后，汽油价将上涨多少以及何时上涨？这些问题还有待观察。 厂商生产一加仑乙醇混合汽油，可获45分钱抵税(tax credit)，这相当于生产一加仑E-10，厂商得到4.5分钱。由于原油和乙醇价格一直在波动，难以计算乙醇补贴停止后立即产生的影响。 全国2日的E-10常规汽油平均价为每加仑3.28元，一年前为3.07元。 E-85平均价为2.95元。 此外，咖啡业巨擘星巴克公司(Starbucks)3日宣布，由于原料费用上涨，将提高部分地区咖啡的价格。星巴克说，东北部和南方地区的咖啡售价将提高1%，但星巴克没有说明上述地区是否所有州的价格都将提高。包括纽约、南方多数州和华盛顿特区的价格都将上涨；加州和佛罗里达州尚不包括在内。上述地区的中杯(tall)咖啡将提价0.1元，另外六种饮料也将涨价。 星巴克发言人说，涨价反映出部分市场的竞争，和咖啡、燃油、牛奶与其他商品的成本升高。星巴克上一次大范围的涨价是在2007年。 纽约时报从这个星期一起涨价，周一到周六版，到报摊购买，每份售价2.5美元，这和报纸上印刷的订价是一样的。 至于周日版，纽约地区售价五美元，以外地区要六美元，送到家的订户，报费也调涨百分之四左右。网路版的​​订费则维持原价。 这是纽约时报两年多来，首次涨价，纽时没有说明涨价的原因，以及这次调涨可望替报社增加多少收入。
d5b46476b02f6aac60312b00e2608d9c85093d38.translatedText: Gasoline, Starbucks coffee and beverage prices increase (Alberta Times) At the beginning of the new year, bad news spread across the country that many commodities are about to increase in price. Gasoline prices may rise by 4.5 cents this weekend. The reason is not the increase in crude oil prices, but Congress's refusal to extend the 30-year-old ethanol subsidy policy, causing this government subsidy to lapse. In the United States, ethanol is commonly mixed with gasoline to reduce exhaust smoke. Most gasoline currently used in U.S. cars contains 10% ethanol, called E-10. E-85 fuel is also sold in a few areas, with an ethanol content of up to 85%. But only cars using "flex fuel" can use E-85. How much and when will gasoline prices rise after ethanol subsidies end? These issues remain to be seen. Manufacturers who produce a gallon of ethanol-blend gasoline can receive a tax credit of 45 cents, which is equivalent to producing a gallon of E-10 and the manufacturer receives 4.5 cents. Because crude oil and ethanol prices have been volatile, it is difficult to calculate the immediate impact of the discontinuation of ethanol subsidies. The national average price of E-10 regular gasoline on the 2nd was $3.28 per gallon, compared with $3.07 a year ago. The average price of E-85 is 2.95 yuan. In addition, coffee industry giant Starbucks announced on the 3rd that it will increase the price of coffee in some areas due to rising raw material costs. Starbucks said coffee prices in the Northeast and South would increase by 1%, but it did not say whether prices would increase in all states. Prices will increase in New York, most southern states and Washington, D.C.; California and Florida are not yet included. The price of tall coffee in the above-mentioned areas will increase by 0.1 yuan, and the prices of six other beverages will also increase. A Starbucks spokesman said the price increases reflected competition in some markets and higher costs for coffee, fuel, milk and other goods. The last time Starbucks had a large-scale price increase was in 2007. The New York Times will increase its price starting this Monday. The Monday to Saturday edition will be available at newsstands for $2.50 per copy, which is the same as the printing price in the newspaper. As for the Sunday edition, it costs US$5 in the New York area and US$6 in other areas. For subscribers who have it delivered to their homes, the newspaper fee will also increase by about 4%. The subscription fee for the online version remains at the original price. This is the first price increase for The New York Times in more than two years. The New York Times did not explain the reason for the price increase or how much revenue this increase is expected to bring to the newspaper.

efe4b8e968333435b59d216ce7608c70adb61b9b.sourceText: 有一位移民富豪跟本人接触后，大吐苦水。
efe4b8e968333435b59d216ce7608c70adb61b9b.translatedText: A wealthy immigrant complained bitterly after contacting me.

dd30c1f80baf1661440a739b38d14115e63a95aa.sourceText: 大家都看企业家很风光，其实经商办企业，不论你赚多少钱，都没有社会地位，一个党政机关的科员使唤你都像孙子。
dd30c1f80baf1661440a739b38d14115e63a95aa.translatedText: Everyone thinks that entrepreneurs are very prosperous. In fact, no matter how much money you make when running a business, you have no social status. A clerk in a party and government agency treats you like a grandson.

8e5e38e6f2cb453d7a112ae9580b31ade8eee0c1.sourceText: 为什么中国人都不敢露富，一旦知道你有钱，找上门来的不只是黑社会，一些官员比黑社会更黑。
8e5e38e6f2cb453d7a112ae9580b31ade8eee0c1.translatedText: Why don't Chinese people dare to reveal their wealth? Once they know you are rich, it is not just the underworld that will come to your door. Some officials are even more underworld than the underworld.

b7be5fb1daf4bfdb6291f0162803816ce94d4e6b.sourceText: 大家都批评官商勾结、权钱交易。谁不想正大光明的赚钱?可想赚钱，就得去找政府官员，在中国你想不跟政府官员打交道，行吗?一个小小人街道办事处都可能卡死你。
b7be5fb1daf4bfdb6291f0162803816ce94d4e6b.translatedText: Everyone criticizes collusion between government and businessmen and power-for-money transactions. Who doesn’t want to make money openly? But if you want to make money, you have to go to the government officials. In China, do you want to avoid dealing with government officials? Is that okay? A small person in the street office may get you stuck.

0e7736a489f4d4dfce84be14c0f3aed415dd479c.sourceText: 谁愿意权钱交易，把钱送给人家?可你不送，就办不成事，办不了事，办了事就要钱，笔笔算得清清的。文明点的，请你打麻将，或者识相点的请人打麻将，该送人家多少钱，开局前就把钱放好了，就是输给人家的。有的一看钱不如意，还不跟你打了，拍拍屁股走了，只好下次多准备钱再请。有的就直接了当：你给多少钱.。有的人还要股份，要干股。
0e7736a489f4d4dfce84be14c0f3aed415dd479c.translatedText: Who is willing to trade power for money and give money to others? But if you don't give it away, you won't be able to get things done. If you are a civilized person, I invite you to play mahjong, or if you are a sensible person, I invite someone to play mahjong. How much money should be given to others? If you put the money away before the game starts, you will lose to others. When some people see that the money is not what they want, they won't fight you, pat their butts and walk away, so they have to prepare more money for you next time. Some are straightforward: How much do you pay... Some people still want shares and stocks.

0ce40d930b25a5b9d221a2522c01dddead6e20bc.sourceText: 从街道办事处，到县区、市，多少个政府部门，从银行到派出所、公安局、法院，哪一个部门都是你的爷爷。你要从科长拜到处长、局长，一级都不能少。你不要认为只有主管部门管到你，谁来找你都不敢得罪。还有，你不能遇到事了再去找人家，那就晚了，平时就要搭上关系，办事时才好办。
0ce40d930b25a5b9d221a2522c01dddead6e20bc.translatedText: From street offices to counties, districts and cities, there are many government departments, from banks to police stations, public security bureaus and courts, every department is your grandfather. You have to go from section chief to division director and director, no less than one level is required. Don't think that only the competent authorities can control you, and you won't dare to offend anyone who comes to you. Also, you can't go to someone else when you encounter a problem. It will be too late. You usually have to establish a relationship to get things done.

cf011732c995a85e57e71c1ce711e28d90dd24c8.sourceText: 经营企业就是经营关系，经营关系就是喝酒，天天喝醉，喝不醉就不让你走，后来实在受不了，就装醉。有的官员无耻到不只是喝酒，还找小姐，不漂亮还不高兴。有的更干脆，拿一大堆夜总会的发票，让你报销。
cf011732c995a85e57e71c1ce711e28d90dd24c8.translatedText: Running a business is about managing relationships, and managing relationships is about drinking. I get drunk every day, and I won’t let you go until you are drunk. Later, I just can’t stand it anymore, so I pretend to be drunk. Some officials are so shameless that they not only drink, but also look for young ladies, and they are not happy even if they are not beautiful. Some are even more simple, taking a bunch of nightclub invoices and asking you to reimburse them.

cb0d5b590beecdd5da615b5d4ce3a32dc338bdba.sourceText: 这些年干部提拔太快，不停地换。一拨刚熟悉了，又换了新的，又要重新来一次。有些干部忘乎所以，早就忘了拿人家的钱犯法，不断有人出事，一出事，你也睡不着觉，弄不好把你也连累了，把那点送钱的事交待了，你就是行贿罪。
cb0d5b590beecdd5da615b5d4ce3a32dc338bdba.translatedText: Cadres have been promoted too quickly in recent years and are constantly changing. Once you get familiar with one group, you get a new one, and you have to do it all over again. Some cadres forget what they are doing and have long forgotten to break the law by taking other people's money. Things keep happening to people, and when something happens, you can't sleep, and it might get you involved too. If you explain the matter of sending money, you will be guilty of bribery.

80f6db52c4955152ebffb2c92c7cc203f197e007.sourceText: 在中国做企业。80%的精力都用在跟官场打交道上，只有20%的精力打理企业业务。
80f6db52c4955152ebffb2c92c7cc203f197e007.translatedText: Business in China. 80% of the energy is spent on dealing with official circles, and only 20% of the energy is spent on corporate business.

d5a66d878257acbe80ff67b013a7c9b074fdc3f5.sourceText: 真是太累太烦了，一跺脚，不干啦，不玩啦!移民啦!
d5a66d878257acbe80ff67b013a7c9b074fdc3f5.translatedText: I am so tired and bored, I just stamped my feet and stopped working and playing! Immigrant!

19746971c605edf3fc1f80da7a91ffae0c73057e.sourceText: 政府和官员们能检讨反思吗?有能力有钱的人都移民了，到底是为了什么?
19746971c605edf3fc1f80da7a91ffae0c73057e.translatedText: Can the government and officials reflect on it? People who have the ability and money have immigrated. What is the reason?

97d6ed2c820837764f690fc79d34c1be20e5fe5c.sourceText: 父子狩猎捡到200磅毒品 （亚省时报） 上周四，皮埃尔门多提假期带着儿子和朋友去美墨边境沙沙碧狩猎，不想没打着任何猎物，却捡到数百磅非法毒品。 ”近20年来，我每年的12月都在这一带狩猎。当天很多小鹿，就是没有大鹿。”门多提说。 他们到达山顶，发现在灌木地下有东西，不是动物，居然是成捆的大麻。 门多提说，他不知道是谁把毒品留在该地，于是他通知国民自卫队。 边境巡逻队无法证实这一事件，但说沙沙碧是在全美最繁忙的毒品走私走廊上，有可能是有人故意把毒品隐藏在上述地点。 ”边境巡逻队赞扬居民提供的帮助，因为他们提供非常​​有价值的消息。但我们强调，不鼓励任何人接近或干涉毒品，因为这涉嫌走私，非法入境，有可能为居民带来灾难性后果， ”边境巡逻队发言人说。 ”公民如遇可疑活动，可匿名致电1-877-872-7435。”
97d6ed2c820837764f690fc79d34c1be20e5fe5c.translatedText: Father and son hunt and pick up 200 pounds of drugs (Alberta Times) Last Thursday, Pierre Mendotti took his son and friends to hunt in Sasabi, the U.S.-Mexico border, during the holiday. Unexpectedly, he didn't catch any game, but picked up hundreds of pounds of illegal drugs. "I have been hunting in this area every December for the past 20 years. There were many small deer that day, but no big deer," Mendotti said. They reached the top of the mountain and found something under the bushes, not an animal, but bundles of marijuana. Mendotti said he didn't know who had left the drugs at the location, so he notified the National Guard. The Border Patrol could not confirm the incident, but said Sasabi is on one of the busiest drug smuggling corridors in the United States and it is possible someone intentionally hid the drugs at the location. "Border Patrol commends residents for their assistance as they provide very valuable information. However, we emphasize that we discourage anyone from approaching or interfering with drugs as this involves smuggling, illegal entry, and potentially catastrophic consequences for residents," a Border Patrol spokesperson said. "Citizens experiencing suspicious activity can anonymously call 1-877-872-7435."

8625339e895fce1273af57dce26e703e5eff4581.sourceText: 空军一号每小时花费近18万美元 （亚省时报） 如果下次你还在抱怨机票价格昂贵时，请先想一想空军一号昂贵的飞行费用。?#31354;军一号?#65288;Air Force One）是美国总统的专机，通常是一架波音747飞机。据最新国会研究服务报告显示，其每小时的飞行花费高达179750美元。 如果算进乘客和随行货机成本的话，那么每次飞行的总费用将更高。如果是执行公务的飞行，那么费用将由纳税人支付。如果是为了政治宣传的飞行，那么相关宣传机构会为政府支付费用。 虽然关于总统出行的飞行费用信息不多，但是从早先的一些研究中还是可以窥见一斑：1989年空军一号出行欧洲的费用为1百万美元，1990年出行夏威夷的费用为150万美元。如果加上额外一些相关花费，成本则更高。1998年美总统访问非洲、智利和中国的总费用分别为4280万美元，1050万美元和1880万美元。
8625339e895fce1273af57dce26e703e5eff4581.translatedText: Air Force One costs nearly $180,000 per hour (Alberta Times) If you are still complaining about the expensive air tickets next time, please think about the expensive flight cost of Air Force One. ?#31354;Military One?#65288;Air Force One) is the special plane of the President of the United States, usually a Boeing 747 aircraft. According to the latest Congressional Research Service report, its flight costs per hour are as high as $179,750. If you factor in the cost of passengers and accompanying cargo aircraft, the total cost per flight will be even higher. If the flight is on official business, the cost will be borne by taxpayers. If the flight is for political propaganda, the relevant propaganda agency will pay for the government. Although there is not much information about the cost of flying presidential travel, some early studies can still provide a glimpse: the cost of Air Force One to travel to Europe in 1989 was $1 million, and the cost of traveling to Hawaii in 1990 was $1.5 million. If additional related expenses are added, the cost will be even higher. The total cost of the US president's visits to Africa, Chile and China in 1998 was US$42.8 million, US$10.5 million and US$18.8 million respectively.

89161d759900ee4c161e4ed5a4daaed6d5a34e27.sourceText: 希拉河印第安部落将为202高速扩展投票 希拉河印第安社区居民将于2月7日投票是否允许南山高速公路通过部落土地延伸。 目前，耗资19亿美元的202环城高速公路扩展计划将凤凰城西边和钱德勒连接起来，全长22英里，双向8车道，在Pecos路止。 高速公路扩展将征收沿途阿瓦土奇的100多座住宅和交通，并将移平南山山区的部分山脊，而这些山脊属于希拉河部落。 部落有意保持南山完整，以不破坏原有的山体和建筑物为主诉。但州政府不得不进行谈判，并购买几份私人拥有土地作发展。
89161d759900ee4c161e4ed5a4daaed6d5a34e27.translatedText: Gila River Indian Tribe to vote on Highway 202 expansion Residents of the Gila River Indian Community will vote on February 7 whether to allow the South Mountain Highway to be extended through tribal lands. Currently, the $1.9 billion Beltway 202 expansion plan connects west Phoenix to Chandler, a 22-mile, eight-lane two-way stretch that ends at Pecos Road. The highway expansion would impose more than 100 homes and traffic on Ahwatukee along the route and would flatten some ridges in the South Mountains that belong to the Gila River Tribe. The tribe intends to keep Nanshan intact, and the main complaint is not to damage the original mountain and buildings. But the state government had to negotiate and purchase several parcels of privately owned land for development.
