ff924034dc2a0035bfcf28570d8b9f8e9756e2a1.sourceText: 美莎(Mesa) 全美第7大最安全城市 （亚省时报） 上周公布的一项调查显示，在美国人口超过25万的城市中，亚利桑那州美莎市被评为第7大最安全城市。该排名基于2010年联邦调查局的暴力犯罪和交通事故死亡报告。 美莎警察局长米尔斯坦将荣誉归功于社区伙伴关係和居民的相互信任。他指出，在过去几年内，住宅和汽车爆窃桉显着下降。 名单上的其他城市，包括被视为最安全的德州普莱诺，其次是内华达州亨德森，檀香山，加州圣安娜，圣何塞和内布拉斯加州的林肯。
ff924034dc2a0035bfcf28570d8b9f8e9756e2a1.translatedText: Mesa is the 7th safest city in the U.S. (Alberta Times) A survey released last week ranked Mesa, Arizona as the seventh-safest city among U.S. cities with a population of more than 250,000. The rankings are based on the 2010 FBI Violent Crime and Traffic Death Reports. Mesa Police Chief Milstein attributed the honor to community partnerships and the mutual trust of residents. He noted that home and car burglaries have dropped significantly over the past few years. Other cities on the list include Plano, Texas, considered the safest, followed by Henderson, Nevada, Honolulu, Santa Ana, California, San Jose and Lincoln, Nebraska.

7420a3153849d22159952a990db19938febbed12.sourceText: 2011年，面对国际上复杂多变的局势、国内经济复苏的缓慢艰难，美国政府没有能够及时有效的化解危机，反而在大部分时间里陷入党派政治的缠斗之中。以下是我认为比较有代表性的10个政治事件(以时间为序) ，它们在一定程度上反映了过去一年美国政坛的混乱局面。
7420a3153849d22159952a990db19938febbed12.translatedText: In 2011, faced with the complex and ever-changing international situation and the slow and difficult domestic economic recovery, the U.S. government failed to resolve the crisis in a timely and effective manner. Instead, it spent most of its time trapped in partisan political struggles. The following are 10 political events (in chronological order) that I think are relatively representative. They reflect, to a certain extent, the chaos in American politics over the past year.

bcdbbbb1c14e0cefbaf040b24c7a8ea24e61cf97.sourceText: 3月19日，美国军舰向利比亚发射112枚巡航导弹，由美国主导的北约针对卡扎菲政权的军事行动正式开始。
bcdbbbb1c14e0cefbaf040b24c7a8ea24e61cf97.translatedText: On March 19, the US warship launched 112 cruise missiles towards Libya, and the US-led NATO military operation against the Gaddafi regime officially began.

347e3cc70a1ea8072c179bd3c58e2ab92a53dce0.sourceText: 面对年初兴起的”阿拉伯之春”运动，美国政府的心态非常矛盾。一方面，很多在运动中被推翻的独裁者们，都是美国在巴以和反恐问题上的盟友，而这些国家通过民选上位的新兴政治力量对美国和以色列却不见得非常友好；另一方面，美国作为捍卫西方民主价值观的旗手和自由世界的”武林盟主”，对中东人民的民主诉求又必须予以积极的回应与支持。
347e3cc70a1ea8072c179bd3c58e2ab92a53dce0.translatedText: Faced with the "Arab Spring" movement that emerged at the beginning of the year, the US government has a very contradictory mentality. On the one hand, many of the dictators who were overthrown during the movement were allies of the United States on the issue of Palestine, Israel and anti-terrorism. However, the emerging political forces in these countries that came to power through democratic elections are not necessarily very friendly to the United States and Israel. On the other hand, the United States, as the standard bearer for defending Western democratic values ​​and the "martial arts leader" of the free world, must actively respond to and support the democratic demands of the people of the Middle East.

5aff9b43adfc5d5ac5faf1389cc63b9330f3a22a.sourceText: 这种两难处境导致奥巴马政府在应对”阿拉伯之春”时反应迟缓，被指责是”坐在后排领导”（leading from behind)。利比亚问题虽然在北约干涉下得以解决，但目前中东局势仍在剧烈变化中。叙利亚和伊朗都是让美国非常头痛的问题。有一点可以肯定的是，在”变天”后的中东地区，美国不得不面临自身影响力下降的复杂局面。
5aff9b43adfc5d5ac5faf1389cc63b9330f3a22a.translatedText: This dilemma led to the Obama administration's slow response in response to the "Arab Spring" and was accused of "leading from behind." Although the Libyan issue was resolved through NATO intervention, the situation in the Middle East is still undergoing drastic changes. Both Syria and Iran are serious headaches for the United States. One thing that is certain is that in the post-"change" Middle East, the United States has to face the complex situation of declining influence.

4db0678c6ba7910a6ec56e620993798107b1498e.sourceText: 2. 击毙本 拉登 反恐战略转型
4db0678c6ba7910a6ec56e620993798107b1498e.translatedText: 2. Killing bin Laden and transforming the counter-terrorism strategy

ca2102301d41d47b83f70cd6b3abb14b2d7cd9e2.sourceText: 5月1日，美国总统奥巴马向世界宣布，美军特种部队在特别行动中击毙了藏身于巴基斯坦的本 拉登。
ca2102301d41d47b83f70cd6b3abb14b2d7cd9e2.translatedText: On May 1, US President Obama announced to the world that US special forces killed bin Laden hiding in Pakistan during a special operation.

2c1bf1256a5da1eca27cb4ebda052f0f296b1cc1.sourceText: 虽然拉登早已不再指挥基地组织的实际行动，但击毙拉登仍对于美国的反恐战争具有极大的象征意义。接下来，9月份美国举国纪念911十周年，10月份奥巴马宣布将于年底从伊拉克撤军，12月15日美军正式结束在伊拉克的战斗任务。
2c1bf1256a5da1eca27cb4ebda052f0f296b1cc1.translatedText: Although Bin Laden no longer directs the actual operations of Al Qaeda, the killing of Bin Laden still has great symbolic significance for the United States' war on terrorism. Next, in September, the United States will commemorate the tenth anniversary of September 11th. In October, Obama will announce that it will withdraw its troops from Iraq by the end of the year. On December 15, the US military will officially end its combat mission in Iraq.

c685a1076e5e317b1802866900ec5bb1e406cfbc.sourceText: 虽然国内对奥巴马撤军的决定看法不一，但是即使一年后共和党总统上台，也不会再继续向中东增兵。消灭拉登和撤出伊拉克标志着美国的反恐战争进入了一个新阶段。从在海外打击基地组织，转向重点防范国内的孤立突发的恐怖事件，2011年美国的国家安全战略迎来了巨大转折。
c685a1076e5e317b1802866900ec5bb1e406cfbc.translatedText: Although domestic opinions on Obama's decision to withdraw troops are divided, even if the Republican president comes to power in a year, he will not continue to send more troops to the Middle East. The elimination of Bin Laden and the withdrawal from Iraq marked a new stage in the United States' war on terrorism. In 2011, the U.S. national security strategy ushered in a huge turning point from combating al-Qaida overseas to focusing on preventing isolated and sudden terrorist incidents at home.

5516e76a96d2ddf7e0d9e791a159d62427dac4cd.sourceText: 3. 混乱的共和党总统初选

653c3ca8dec90be3a48184cebb2d37a9f02572f1.sourceText: 6月2号，前马萨诸塞州州长米特 朗姆尼（Mitt Romney）正式宣布参加2012年总统竞选。
653c3ca8dec90be3a48184cebb2d37a9f02572f1.translatedText: On June 2, former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney officially announced his participation in the 2012 presidential election.

64ca7ee9ea60601bdb6d59f3f457f8f0232f2d9a.sourceText: 在国会白宫乌烟瘴气的乱战之外，共和党总统初选是2011年美国政坛另一场大戏。郎姆尼一直是被舆论普遍看好的候选人，同时他也是奥巴马最不愿意面对的一个对手。然而由于他的政治立场不够保守，很多共和党选民始终没有下决心全力支持他。于是2011年的共和党总统初选就成了一场挑选”朗姆尼的替代者”游戏。
64ca7ee9ea60601bdb6d59f3f457f8f0232f2d9a.translatedText: In addition to the chaotic battle in the White House of Congress, the Republican presidential primary election is another major drama in the American political arena in 2011. Rumney has always been the candidate generally favored by public opinion, and he is also the opponent Obama is least willing to face. However, because his political stance is not conservative enough, many Republican voters have never made up their mind to fully support him. So the 2011 Republican presidential primaries became a game of choosing "Trump's replacement."

8200f829e28b634ddf90dfceca0bfc5f7cd73d26.sourceText: 奥巴马的一个竞选顾问曾说过，竞选就像看一个猴子爬杆，一个候选人爬得越高，他的屁股就露出的越多。过去半年中，从巴克曼、佩里到凯恩，有实力挑战朗姆尼的候选人在短暂的领先后，都因种种问题纷纷落马。现在，前美国国会众议院议长金里奇成了最新一任领头羊，但是他的领先优势正在缩小中。
8200f829e28b634ddf90dfceca0bfc5f7cd73d26.translatedText: An Obama campaign adviser once said that campaigning is like watching a monkey climb a pole. The higher a candidate climbs, the more of his butt is exposed. In the past six months, candidates who had the strength to challenge Trump, from Bachman to Perry to Kaine, fell short due to various problems after a brief lead. Now, former Speaker of the House of Representatives Gingrich has become the latest leader, but his lead is shrinking.

549a9b5dfd438f74dd6651ecb9bd8319f6b2273e.sourceText: 如果目前进行预测的话，朗姆尼还是最有可能获得共和党提名的候选人。明年选举正式开始后，大选将是美国政治生活中的主旋律，而其结果也将影响美国社会乃至整个世界未来几年的发展。
549a9b5dfd438f74dd6651ecb9bd8319f6b2273e.translatedText: If predictions are made currently, Rumney is still the most likely candidate to win the Republican nomination. After the election officially begins next year, the election will be the main theme of American political life, and its results will also affect the development of American society and the entire world in the next few years.

9ff81f852c938d93b4e3e50218cc9a005d18b335.sourceText: 4. 标普下调美国评级 政府被判不及格
9ff81f852c938d93b4e3e50218cc9a005d18b335.translatedText: 4. Standard & Poor's downgraded the U.S. rating and the government was judged to have failed

c1052f194426ddcfbe2e9067f13e48dd1a873630.sourceText: 8月5日，标准普尔将美国长期主权信用评级由AAA降至AA+，评级展望为负面。
c1052f194426ddcfbe2e9067f13e48dd1a873630.translatedText: On August 5, Standard & Poor's lowered the long-term sovereign credit rating of the United States from AAA to AA+, with a negative rating outlook.

47a0af9a246fc03e5eaaea6aae2a1e58a0caef08.sourceText: 2011年的美国政坛充满了权力斗争，却鲜见沟通合作。标普降级表面上是对美国经济前景表示担忧，根本上其实是对美国政府几近瘫痪的处理问题能力表示失望。
47a0af9a246fc03e5eaaea6aae2a1e58a0caef08.translatedText: >The American political arena in 2011 was full of power struggles, but little communication and cooperation. S&P's downgrade is ostensibly an expression of concern about the U.S. economic prospects, but fundamentally it is an expression of disappointment in the U.S. government's nearly paralyzed ability to deal with problems.

6decd38e3d77e25a86c39a6764b0d1fd6e6f9b4d.sourceText: 整个2011年国会两党没有通过任何有效解决社会和经济问题的法案。在国家面临巨大挑战的时候，两个主要政党没有携手共济，而是为了各自的党派利益缠斗不休，白宫也没有在危机中显示应有的领导能力。标普降级事件，实际上是给美国政府处理危机的综合表现打了一个不及格的分数。
6decd38e3d77e25a86c39a6764b0d1fd6e6f9b4d.translatedText: Throughout 2011, the two parties in Congress did not pass any bill that effectively solved social and economic problems. At a time when the country is facing huge challenges, the two major political parties have not worked together, but have been fighting for their own partisan interests. The White House has also failed to show its due leadership in the crisis. The S&P downgrade actually gave the U.S. government a failing grade in its overall performance in handling the crisis.

6712d210bc68bf61687838ac83b4dfeab786ff87.sourceText: 然而在降级事件之后，国会两党和白宫并没有吸取教训，继续在争斗和扯皮中走完了2011年。
6712d210bc68bf61687838ac83b4dfeab786ff87.translatedText: However, after the downgrade incident, the two parties in Congress and the White House did not learn their lesson and continued to end 2011 in fighting and wrangling.

45aee0a24d4597b51695a45d382551e302954945.sourceText: 5. ”就业法案”搁浅 奥巴马束手无策
45aee0a24d4597b51695a45d382551e302954945.translatedText: 5. The "Jobs Act" ran aground and Obama was helpless

a9e9d725b9cb3e9bf2028df0c52b031f49e70e14.sourceText: 10月11日，奥巴马提出的”就业法案”因未能在参议院获得足够支持而搁浅。
a9e9d725b9cb3e9bf2028df0c52b031f49e70e14.translatedText: On October 11, the "Jobs Act" proposed by Obama ran aground because it failed to gain sufficient support in the Senate.

a405e6363dd7a18ac474c0836b7bd72d7755bf47.sourceText: 2011年是奥巴马执政的第三年，也是他在内政上建树最少的一年。面对严峻的经济形势，白宫几乎可以说是毫无作为。先是在年初对复苏前景估计不足，然后在同共和党的谈判中空手而归。奥巴马不仅招致了来自共和党和民主党双方的批评，民意支持率也降到了历史低点。在债务上限谈判中遭受挫折后，奥巴马提出的”就业法案”是他在经济上唯一一次、也是最后一次的主动努力，然而这个涉及四千亿美元的法案在奥巴马所属的民主党占多数的参议院都没能过关。
a405e6363dd7a18ac474c0836b7bd72d7755bf47.translatedText: 2011 was Obama’s third year in office, and it was also the year in which he made the least achievements in domestic affairs. Faced with the dire economic situation, the White House has done almost nothing. First, he underestimated the prospects for recovery at the beginning of the year, and then came away empty-handed from negotiations with the Republican Party. Not only has Obama attracted criticism from both Republicans and Democrats, but his public approval ratings have also dropped to historic lows. After suffering setbacks in the debt ceiling negotiations, Obama's "Jobs Act" was his only and last proactive effort on the economy. However, this $400 billion bill failed to pass the Senate, where Obama's Democratic Party holds a majority.

be8fb5a0a9c18ee723b6a0790f047476214884e7.sourceText: 2011年大部分时间里，白宫在国内事务中都处于被迫旁观的状态。12月号的GQ（《Gentlemen’s Quarterly》）杂志将奥巴马列为”世界上最无影响力的人物”之一，虽然有些夸张，但也反映了奥巴马过去一年在内政上难有作为、只能束手旁观的尴尬。
be8fb5a0a9c18ee723b6a0790f047476214884e7.translatedText: For much of 2011, the White House was forced to sit on the sidelines in domestic affairs. The December issue of GQ ("Gentlemen's Quarterly") magazine listed Obama as one of the "least influential people in the world." Although this is a bit exaggerated, it also reflects the embarrassment that Obama has been unable to do anything in domestic affairs over the past year and can only sit on the sidelines.

99f509a4b6939b9062dcb7fb59dfffe5594acf0e.sourceText: 11月14日，美国最高法院正式受理26个州政府起诉”医改法案”违宪一案。
99f509a4b6939b9062dcb7fb59dfffe5594acf0e.translatedText: On November 14, the U.S. Supreme Court officially accepted the case of 26 state governments suing the "Healthcare Reform Act" for being unconstitutional.

5a1b032d3c1a2167f42f375e7c234919a0a2f516.sourceText: ”医改法案”是奥巴马任上最大的一个政绩。然而这个法案在通过之后，激起了美国保守派的极大反弹。不仅直接推动了?#33590;党?#36816;动的发展壮大，而且间接导致了共和党在去年议会中期选举中翻盘。可以说，”医改法案”的通过彻底改变了美国政坛的权力格局。
5a1b032d3c1a2167f42f375e7c234919a0a2f516.translatedText: The "Health Care Reform Act" is Obama's biggest political achievement during his term of office. However, after this bill was passed, it sparked a huge backlash from American conservatives. Not only did it directly promote the development and growth of the party's movement, but it also indirectly led to the Republican Party's comeback in last year's congressional midterm elections. It can be said that the passage of the "Health Care Reform Act" completely changed the power structure of American politics.

e82bad397943c498e61e3645f5bee440cf9c974c.sourceText: 目前有26个州政府集体以法案违宪为由起诉联邦政府，在地方性的诉讼中，双方各有胜负，最后只能由最高法院来决定这个法案的命运。最高法院宣布受理此案的决定并不令人意外，但是在明年聆讯后九名大法官将会作出什么样的判决是一个未知数。
e82bad397943c498e61e3645f5bee440cf9c974c.translatedText: At present, 26 state governments have collectively sued the federal government on the grounds that the bill is unconstitutional. In local lawsuits, both parties have their own winners and losers. In the end, the fate of this bill can only be decided by the Supreme Court. The Supreme Court's decision to accept the case is not surprising, but it is unknown what decision the nine justices will make after the hearing next year.

bf8e18fcc54b5f64014723164b9f2cadca10c69c.sourceText: 明年是大选年，在选战胶着的情况下，最高法院的判决可能会影响最后总统的归属。
bf8e18fcc54b5f64014723164b9f2cadca10c69c.translatedText: Next year is an election year. With the election campaign in a stalemate, the Supreme Court's decision may affect the final choice of president.

089fff800434082b5bc4d8983c37e7041d36b308.sourceText: 7. 迷路的”占领华尔街”运动

65a302f4d1a520f8ce0b942e8b13dccf67bcb44b.sourceText: 11月15日凌晨，纽约市长布隆伯格下令警方对”占领华尔街”运动的大本营曼哈顿祖科蒂公园进行清场。
65a302f4d1a520f8ce0b942e8b13dccf67bcb44b.translatedText: In the early morning of November 15, New York Mayor Bloomberg ordered the police to clear Zuccotti Park in Manhattan, the headquarters of the "Occupy Wall Street" movement.

ff82b106275aca9530021f821ebb2736d7eb8ba5.sourceText: ”占领华尔街”是今年继阿拉伯之春后另一个全球性的群众政治运动。在很短的时间内从发源地纽约扩散至美国各地，进而席卷全球。推动这个运动发生发展的原因很多，最直接的是经济前景不佳，年轻人对现实不满，活动开始后迅速赢得了民众广泛支持和媒体的注意。
ff82b106275aca9530021f821ebb2736d7eb8ba5.translatedText: "Occupy Wall Street" is another global mass political movement this year after the Arab Spring. In a short period of time, it spread from New York, its birthplace, to all parts of the United States, and then swept the world. There are many reasons that promote the development of this movement. The most direct ones are poor economic prospects and young people's dissatisfaction with reality. After the start of the movement, it quickly won widespread public support and media attention.

cc221e5c4f8810034dc4d4f0c0016018e73aaf20.sourceText: 但是由于缺乏统一的组织和政治纲领，除了简单发泄对现实的不满，参与者没能进一步表达出明确的政治诉求。加之活动中不断出现暴力违法事件，导致”占领”运动逐渐失去群众支持。纽约市实施清场后，其它美国大城市也纷纷效法。目前运动的参与者正在寻找新的行动方向。从目前来看，这场声势浩大的示威运动对美国社会产生的实质性影响还很有限，而且正面临影响力不断下降的局面。
cc221e5c4f8810034dc4d4f0c0016018e73aaf20.translatedText: However, due to the lack of a unified organization and political platform, apart from simply venting their dissatisfaction with reality, participants were unable to further express clear political demands. In addition, violent and illegal incidents continued to occur during the activities, causing the "Occupy" movement to gradually lose mass support. After New York City implemented the clearance, other major American cities followed suit. Participants in the current movement are looking for new directions for action. From the current point of view, this massive demonstration movement has had a very limited substantive impact on American society, and it is facing a situation of declining influence.

ed6e5c69157a46e1d5a2a0784732dc9d4cc524df.sourceText: 8. ”超级委员会”减赤失败 国会几近瘫痪
ed6e5c69157a46e1d5a2a0784732dc9d4cc524df.translatedText: 8. "Super Committee" fails to reduce deficit and Congress is almost paralyzed

dcbe0fde64231bde6c596964e5327597f6b65ac9.sourceText: 11月21日，美国国会”超级委员会”发表联合声明，宣布未能在预定时间内就削减赤字问题达成协议。
dcbe0fde64231bde6c596964e5327597f6b65ac9.translatedText: On November 21, the "Super Committee" of the U.S. Congress issued a joint statement announcing that they failed to reach an agreement on deficit reduction within the scheduled time.

c668d71e361a6d6b66ad19aa16e6e4fe58530e18.sourceText: 在夏天围绕着提高债务上限进行的谈判中，共和党和民主党双方决定各派代表组成”超级委员会”，其成员负责在感恩节前制定出在未来十年削减1.2万亿美元赤字的财政计划。在谈判开始后，民主党不愿意削减福利，共和党拒绝提高税率，双方在互不相让中错过了达成协议的最后期限。
c668d71e361a6d6b66ad19aa16e6e4fe58530e18.translatedText: During the summer negotiations over raising the debt ceiling, Republicans and Democrats decided to form a "super committee" with representatives from each party, whose members would be responsible for formulating a fiscal plan to reduce the $1.2 trillion deficit over the next decade before Thanksgiving. After the negotiations began, the Democrats were unwilling to cut benefits and the Republicans refused to raise tax rates. The two sides missed the deadline for reaching an agreement while fighting each other.

f4840efdfda0ef284c95dfbf59472f1208b76ec1.sourceText: 在过去一年中，国会两党一直就预算和赤字问题打得不可开交。”超级委员会”这个桥段只是一个长篇连续剧中的一集。到明年1月24日，美国政府就已经有1000天没有通过正常的年度预算了。两党之间互不相让的斗争导致国会几近瘫痪，而美国民众对国会山上议员们的支持率也已经降到了个位数。
f4840efdfda0ef284c95dfbf59472f1208b76ec1.translatedText: Over the past year, the two parties in Congress have been at loggerheads over budget and deficit issues. The "Super Committee" episode is just one episode in a long-running series. By January 24 next year, the U.S. government will have not passed a normal annual budget for 1,000 days. The unrelenting struggle between the two parties has nearly paralyzed Congress, and the American people's support for lawmakers on Capitol Hill has dropped to single digits.

a7d284a912b3601c60e85bd15f6bbc7f017a5cbe.sourceText: 9. 希拉里会见昂山素季 美国”重返亚洲”
a7d284a912b3601c60e85bd15f6bbc7f017a5cbe.translatedText: 9. Hillary meets Aung San Suu Kyi The United States “returns to Asia”

f7cb4c8636c40d278e046d019ab7b17bc022287a.sourceText: 12月1日，美国国务卿希拉里访问缅甸并会见了著名异见人士昂山素季。
f7cb4c8636c40d278e046d019ab7b17bc022287a.translatedText: On December 1, US Secretary of State Hillary visited Myanmar and met with the famous dissident Aung San Suu Kyi.

55d7ac189d81cde4fecf86ce89cbd4bb9022c6eb.sourceText: 在美国民众普遍对华盛顿丧失信心之际，国务卿希拉里是屈指可数的拥有高民意支持率的政治人物之一。她在2009年上任之初就意识到美国外交的未来在亚太地区。在今年美军大幅撤出中东战场之际，美国外交重心也同时开始向环太平洋地区转移。在奥巴马访问澳大利亚宣布增兵之后，希拉里对缅甸的访问更凸显了美国”重返亚洲”的野心。
55d7ac189d81cde4fecf86ce89cbd4bb9022c6eb.translatedText: At a time when the American people are generally losing confidence in Washington, Secretary of State Hillary Clinton is one of the few politicians with high public approval ratings. When she took office in 2009, she realized that the future of U.S. diplomacy lay in the Asia-Pacific region. As the U.S. military withdraws significantly from the Middle East battlefield this year, the focus of U.S. diplomacy has also begun to shift to the Pacific Rim. After Obama visited Australia to announce the troop increase, Hillary's visit to Myanmar further highlighted the United States' ambition to "pivot to Asia."

355a95bcb80c044006da0a2f2ff95881d7b68710.sourceText: 同在中东问题上的被动应对不同，美国抓住缅甸国内政局变化的机会，第一时间派要员进行高层接触，这是奥巴马政府在外交上鲜见的主动出击。正所谓”项庄舞剑，意在沛公”，无论是奥巴马的大洋洲之行，还是希拉里的缅甸”破冰之旅”，很大意义上都是在战略上挑战和抑制中国在亚太地区的影响力。
355a95bcb80c044006da0a2f2ff95881d7b68710.translatedText: Different from its passive response to the Middle East issue, the United States seized the opportunity of changes in Myanmar's domestic political situation and immediately sent important officials to conduct high-level contacts. This is a rare initiative taken by the Obama administration in diplomacy. As the saying goes, "Xiangzhuang dances with sword, and his intention is Peigong." Whether it is Obama's trip to Oceania or Hillary's "ice-breaking trip" to Myanmar, in a large sense they are strategically challenging and inhibiting China's influence in the Asia-Pacific region.

70c86f73441bf970677e178bd506a4f5157b552a.sourceText: 在接下来的很多年里，美国和中国在亚太地区的互动博弈，也许是世界外交舞台上最为重要的一场较量。
70c86f73441bf970677e178bd506a4f5157b552a.translatedText: In the next many years, the interactive game between the United States and China in the Asia-Pacific region may be the most important contest on the world diplomatic stage.

af9b62d543601a89e522874e7bcabd36d1777250.sourceText: 10. 经济复苏缓慢 奥巴马连任前景不明
af9b62d543601a89e522874e7bcabd36d1777250.translatedText: 10. Economic recovery is slow and Obama’s re-election prospects are unclear

1fb08c5f90e5075ceddecc7d2968b222bf713ccf.sourceText: 12月2日，美国劳工部宣布11月份失业率降至8.6%。
1fb08c5f90e5075ceddecc7d2968b222bf713ccf.translatedText: On December 2, the U.S. Department of Labor announced that the unemployment rate dropped to 8.6% in November.

3391020b39e71796ad30ec3a4ad0079c902dcf75.sourceText: 年初，美国政府曾经乐观认为美国经济将会迎来一个”复苏的夏天”，但实际经济增长的速度要比预期慢得多，甚至在8月份就业数据还曾出现过零增长。舆论和经济学界曾一度担心经济将会陷入二次衰退。但进入第四季度后，很多经济指标显示情况似乎没有那么糟糕。
3391020b39e71796ad30ec3a4ad0079c902dcf75.translatedText: At the beginning of the year, the U.S. government was optimistic that the U.S. economy would usher in a "summer of recovery." However, the actual economic growth rate was much slower than expected, and the employment data even showed zero growth in August. Public opinion and the economic community once worried that the economy would fall into a double recession. But entering the fourth quarter, many economic indicators show that the situation does not seem to be that bad.

234c95d36b4e4dd9e86a328b050289e9bf29ca09.sourceText: 虽然11月份的失业率降到近两年半以来的最低点，但是美国经济的总体形势仍不容乐观。目前美国仍有1300多万人没有工作，同时欧洲债务危机和中国不明朗的经济前景，都为美国明年的经济形势增加了极大的不确定性。而明年美国大选的结果，无论是国会两院多数席位的归属，还是奥巴马能否连任，都将很大程度上取决于经济复苏的程度。
234c95d36b4e4dd9e86a328b050289e9bf29ca09.translatedText: Although the unemployment rate in November fell to the lowest point in nearly two and a half years, the overall situation of the US economy is still not optimistic. Currently, more than 13 million people in the United States are unemployed. At the same time, the European debt crisis and China's unclear economic prospects have added great uncertainty to the U.S. economic situation next year. The outcome of next year's US election, whether it is the majority of seats in both houses of Congress or whether Obama can be re-elected, will largely depend on the degree of economic recovery.

d497c36d9d6dc7976848c22555e01c53f2fbcdbf.sourceText: 15万美元境外财产得申报 IRS公布准则 （亚省新闻） 国税局近日宣布，即将推出一种新税表棗8938表（Form 8938），用于申报在国外的指定财产 (Statement of Specified Foreign Financial Assets)，纳税人将从2011纳税年度开始使用这一新税表。 无论在哪里生活和工作，美国公民或拥有美国及他国双重国籍者每年都需要向美国国税局报税。 在8938表中，纳税人须填报国外指定资产的具体种类和金额或国外的帐户。纳税人须明确他们是否符合国税局的新规定而需报税，因为一旦不报将面临严重处罚。 要求填写8938表的法律是在2010年制定的，目的是使在境外有财产的美国纳税人依法纳税。使用8938表格的纳税人，可以是美国公民和居民，选择夫妻联合报税的非居民，或居住在美国境内的某些非居民。 并不是所有在境外有资产的人都需用8938表报税。只有总价值超过一定值（threshold）时才需要申报。例如，在美国生活的联合报税的夫妇，一般不需 提交8938表，除非他们的国外总资产在该纳税年度的最后一天超过10万美元，或在该纳税年度的任何一天中超过15万美元。 居住在国外的纳税人的最低值较高。例如，在国外居住的联合报税的夫妇，如果其国外资产的价值在该纳税年度的最后一天超过40万美元，或在该纳税年度的任何一天中超过60万美元，则需填报8938表。 8938表的填表说明解释了需申报的最低值，什么构成了指定的国外资产，如何确定相关资产的总价值，什么样的资产免税，什么样的信息必须提供。 不须申报收入所得税的个人将不需填写8938表。 8938表不会取代或影响纳税人填报在国外的银行和财务帐号 (Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts，FBAR) 的义务。欲了解更多FBAR信息，请到irs.gov网站上的FBAR网页。 应当填报8938表而未报的，可能会导致1万美元的罚款。在收到国税局通知后仍然未能申报的的附加罚款可高达5万美元。任何低估未披露的应纳税的资产，其罚款可达资产的40％。 8938表的填表说明，以及这一新的境外资产报告的实施规定，和其它可以帮助纳税人确定他们是否需要填写8938表的信息，可以从irs.gov网站上的FATCA相关页面上找到。
d497c36d9d6dc7976848c22555e01c53f2fbcdbf.translatedText: The IRS announced the guidelines for reporting US$150,000 of overseas property (Alberta News) The IRS recently announced that it will launch a new tax form, Form 8938 (Form 8938), which is used to report designated foreign financial assets (Statement of Specified Foreign Financial Assets). Taxpayers will use this new tax form starting from the 2011 tax year. No matter where they live and work, U.S. citizens or those with dual citizenship of the United States and other countries need to report to the IRS every year. In Form 8938, taxpayers must fill in the specific types and amounts of designated foreign assets or foreign accounts. Taxpayers must clarify whether they meet the new IRS regulations and need to file taxes, because they will face serious penalties if they fail to report. The law requiring the completion of Form 8938 was enacted in 2010 to enable U.S. taxpayers with property abroad to pay taxes in accordance with the law. Taxpayers using Form 8938 can be U.S. citizens and residents, non-residents who choose to file jointly as a couple, or certain non-residents living in the United States. Not everyone who has assets abroad needs to file Form 8938. They are required to file only if the total value exceeds a certain value (threshold). For example, couples filing jointly in the United States generally do not need to file Form 8938 unless their total foreign assets exceed $100,000 on the last day of the tax year, or exceed $150,000 on any day during the tax year. The minimum is higher for taxpayers living abroad. For example, a couple filing jointly who lives abroad is required to file Form 8938 if the value of their foreign assets exceeds $400,000 on the last day of the tax year, or exceeds $600,000 on any day during the tax year. The instructions for completing Form 8938 explain the minimum value to be reported, what constitutes a designated foreign asset, how to determine the total value of the underlying assets, what assets are exempt, and what information must be provided. Individuals who are not required to file an income tax return will not need to complete Form 8938. Form 8938 does not replace or affect the taxpayer's obligation to file a Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR). For more FBAR information, please visit the FBAR page on the irs.gov website. Failure to file Form 8938 may result in a $10,000 penalty. Failure to file after receiving an IRS notice can result in additional penalties of up to $50,000. Penalties for any understatement of undisclosed taxable assets can be up to 40% of the assets. Instructions for completing Form 8938, as well as the implementation of this new foreign asset reporting requirement, and other information to help taxpayers determine whether they need to file Form 8938, can be found on the FATCA page on irs.gov.

88dd9d5452cd38482a5b50a8816934116ba30707.translatedText: The United States predicts the five major black swan events in 2012: China's GDP deceleration will be on the list

9eb8d3330233da78f6d36edd350432f59c1b8157.translatedText: The United States predicts the five major black swan events in 2012: China's GDP deceleration will be on the list [Reported on the US "Forbes" biweekly website on December 20] Title: 2012...

6a9efabe61c0f77863975dc2f452220d22f99442.sourceText: 【美国《福布斯》双周刊网站12月20日报道】题：2012 年的五大黑天鹅事件预测
6a9efabe61c0f77863975dc2f452220d22f99442.translatedText: [US "Forbes" biweekly website reported on December 20] Title: 2012 Five major black swan event predictions in 2019

63361f0822c259b59e47d7c9b6377de244a8fcdf.sourceText: 纳齐姆?#23612;古拉斯?#22612;利布在《黑天鹅》一书中构思出的黑天鹅事件成为一种隐喻，比喻对那些会对社会产生重大影响、本应预测到但却未料到的事件。
63361f0822c259b59e47d7c9b6377de244a8fcdf.translatedText: > The black swan event conceived by Nazim?#23612; Gulas?#22612; Lieb in the book "Black Swan" has become a metaphor for those events that will have a major impact on society and should have been predicted but were not expected.

07c73962d123dfde9047f22d656c8e6d8d56c00c.sourceText: 以下是对事后可能被视为黑天鹅事件的五大事件的预测。
07c73962d123dfde9047f22d656c8e6d8d56c00c.translatedText: The following are predictions of five major events that may be regarded as black swan events in hindsight.

cc43a5ac0ecfe4e7655cf973c79b503bd28d97bd.translatedText: 1. China's GDP growth will be lower than 8.5%

bd20e75d011e4c2ffe30d7007abf8084de1d6941.sourceText: 中国制造业11月份放慢，中国官方公布的采购经理人指数由10月份的 50.4降到了49。该指数超过50就意味着这个部门在发展，而低于50就表明该部门在收缩。一些经济学家认为，中国最近下调存款准备金率或许意味着对经济减速感到担忧。欧洲的危机将是造成减速的主要原因。
bd20e75d011e4c2ffe30d7007abf8084de1d6941.translatedText: China's manufacturing industry slowed down in November, and China's official purchasing managers index fell to 49 from 50.4 in October. An index above 50 means the sector is growing, while a reading below 50 means the sector is contracting. Some economists believe China's recent cut in its reserve requirement ratio may signal concerns about an economic slowdown. The crisis in Europe will be the main reason for the slowdown.

0cd14dfd9b47050d31dfdb1aa1a6c95956a31c34.sourceText: 中国的增长大部分来自它的制造业部门，当制造业放慢，它的经济也随之减速。本月早些时候，人们估计 2012年中国经济增速将放慢到9% -9.5%之间。期望中国人民银行在2012年再将准备金率下调几次以刺激经济的增长。
0cd14dfd9b47050d31dfdb1aa1a6c95956a31c34.translatedText: Much of China's growth comes from its manufacturing sector, and when manufacturing slows down, its economy slows down as well. Earlier this month, it was estimated that China's economic growth would slow to between 9% and 9.5% in 2012. It is expected that the People's Bank of China will lower the reserve requirement ratio several times in 2012 to stimulate economic growth.

25ccab3f17997d46f37e16fdc29fde5beabe5f62.translatedText: 2. The S&P 500 Index will fall by more than 25%

6a158b25e52aa6f959b93bd5ad6704504e5e3a47.sourceText: 考虑到发达国家的所有不确定性与问题，标普500 指数在过去3个月中涨幅超过2%，而今年截至目前下降了不到2%。
6a158b25e52aa6f959b93bd5ad6704504e5e3a47.translatedText: Taking into account all the uncertainties and problems in developed countries, the S&P 500 Index has increased by more than 2% in the past three months, and has fallen by less than 2% so far this year.

9bee0ba9c954e5a4ae91dfb39b244c129dd58fdb.sourceText: 既然美欧两国的债务问题都未得到解决，因此可能会发生黑天鹅事件。
9bee0ba9c954e5a4ae91dfb39b244c129dd58fdb.translatedText: Since the debt problems of the United States and Europe have not been resolved, a black swan event may occur.

f328ffd361443bb3df6f34ed2e5ce1aa76cdee34.sourceText: 从技术角度看，标普500 指数会继续跌破200日移动平均线。在过去4个月中，标普 500指数一直呈现菱形形态，而这通常是一种延续性的形态。按周计算，标普500指数在4 月达到2011年的最高点后开始走低，并一路下行，这一延续形态应该会导致市场进?#27493;下跌。25%的预测跌幅将会使标普500指数跌至2010年7月最低时的约1000点左右。
f328ffd361443bb3df6f34ed2e5ce1aa76cdee34.translatedText: From a technical perspective, the S&P 500 Index will continue to fall below the 200-day moving average. Over the past four months, the S&P 500 has been exhibiting a diamond formation, which is typically a continuation pattern. On a weekly basis, the S&P 500 has been trending lower since reaching its 2011 peak in April, a continuation of the pattern that should lead to a decline in the market. A forecast decline of 25% would take the S&P 500 to around the 1,000 level last seen in July 2010.

f45f718c1cbf59ef8d22dbdf7067dd6139d399e9.translatedText: 3. The U.S. dollar index will rise above 85

54d701e94e9d312e5e9516310a2947c1b8a107ed.sourceText: 随着欧美的问题继续显现，全球股市将开始下跌，投资者将会涌向美财政部发行的公债等非风险资产和美元。
54d701e94e9d312e5e9516310a2947c1b8a107ed.translatedText: As problems in Europe and the United States continue to emerge, global stock markets will begin to fall, and investors will flock to non-risk assets such as government bonds issued by the U.S. Treasury Department and the U.S. dollar.

f40a347986ee66856eb08a22f4b9e6bb5385e534.sourceText: 2011年4月，当美国股市达到顶峰时，美元指数由空前的72.86探底反弹。自那以后，美元指数上升了约 10%，达到目前的80左右。
f40a347986ee66856eb08a22f4b9e6bb5385e534.translatedText: In April 2011, when the U.S. stock market reached its peak, the U.S. dollar index bottomed out from an unprecedented 72.86. Since then, the U.S. dollar index has risen about 10% to currently trade around 80.

7eae81f491f49dd241ee9de565df005ebbeca65d.sourceText: 如果将目标设定在85，那么美元指数从空前低点上扬的整个过程已完成了约 60%。当美国股市2010年探底时，美元指数约为 88，因此如果股市下跌，就有这种可能性。
7eae81f491f49dd241ee9de565df005ebbeca65d.translatedText: If the target is set at 85, then the entire process of the U.S. Dollar Index rising from its all-time low is about 60% complete. When U.S. stocks bottomed in 2010, the U.S. Dollar Index was around 88, so if stocks fell, that was a possibility.

45d1199172e976722358fc37a94670a3be94c383.translatedText: 4. The European Central Bank will cut interest rates to below 1%

979154d48dd6b72b37fff6d13ad4c53cdbd26ed7.sourceText: 在全球股市下跌期间，欧洲央行将会通过下调利率努力刺激经济增长和投资，而美国不可能进一步降息。
979154d48dd6b72b37fff6d13ad4c53cdbd26ed7.translatedText: During the decline in global stock markets, the European Central Bank will try to stimulate economic growth and investment by lowering interest rates, while the United States is unlikely to cut interest rates further.

adfad74fee04508003c24996eae65691d6849cc9.sourceText: 目前，欧洲央行的利率为1%，而美国的利率为 0.25%，日本为0.1%，英格兰银行为0. 5%。因此唯一潜在的、有意义的下调就是欧洲央行的降息。
adfad74fee04508003c24996eae65691d6849cc9.translatedText: Currently, the European Central Bank's interest rate is 1%, while the interest rate in the United States is 0.25%, Japan is 0.1%, and the Bank of England is 0. 5%. So the only potential meaningful cut is a rate cut from the European Central Bank.

73814f374c959a94c92d8c2ad1608682800dea45.sourceText: 5.更多的量化宽松或救助方案
73814f374c959a94c92d8c2ad1608682800dea45.translatedText: 5. More quantitative easing or a rescue package

d439558ae8ab08b74a14c95c5e45ba1baf94280a.sourceText: 由于投资者继续涌向无风险交易，再加上降息、美元流动性交换，以及如果银行的准备金率下调没有发挥作用，全球领导人将不得不投入更大的力量，如新一轮量化宽松或某种形式的拯救方案。
d439558ae8ab08b74a14c95c5e45ba1baf94280a.translatedText: As investors continue to flock to risk-free trades, coupled with interest rate cuts, dollar liquidity swaps, and if bank reserve ratio cuts don't work, global leaders will have to invest in greater efforts, such as a new round of quantitative easing or some form of rescue package.

0fd3bf4d3556fc21046fbc1aecc74ac3c23ecbce.translatedText: Police busted a drug smuggling syndicate and arrested 203 people

819c647459ea559de4b56784376a9c468bfff645.sourceText: 警方破获毒品走私集团 逮捕203人 （亚省时报） 当局宣布捣毁了一个黑帮集团”锡那罗亚卡特尔”墨西哥毒品组织在亚利桑那州经营的毒品走私网，查封了数百万美元的毒品，逮捕了203人。 警方上周二表示，在坦佩警方与美国缉毒局（DEA）组织下，由多家机构共同参与，历时15个月的行动中，在凤凰谷地区共逮捕了203人，查封了780万美元现金、 1200多镑的毒品以及44支枪械。 警方介绍，他们捣毁的是墨西哥头号通缉犯、黑帮团伙”锡那罗亚卡特尔’老大、绰号”矮子”的华金古斯曼洛埃拉在亚利桑那州用于贩卖海洛因、可卡因、甲基苯丙胺和大麻等毒品的巢穴。 去年，坦佩警方逮捕了两名从事毒品交易的男子，调查发现他们是墨西哥走私集团的送货司机，为警方提供了有利线索。 负责人道科尔曼表示，这一行动将大量毒品、毒贩数百万美元的资金及强大的武器从城市的街道中消除，再次严重打击了贩毒组织试图将凤凰城大都市地区作为毒品分销主要枢纽的意图。 警方表示，被捕的人中包括美国和墨西哥公民。他们被控拥有、吸食及贩运毒品等罪。 锡那罗亚卡特尔贩毒最为活跃的地区在墨西哥，自2006年总统卡尔德龙上任以来，该国发生的与毒品有关的暴力事件已造成44000多人死亡，为此卡尔德龙多次派出军队对毒品走私者进行镇压。
819c647459ea559de4b56784376a9c468bfff645.translatedText: Police busted a drug smuggling syndicate and arrested 203 people (Alberta Times) The authorities announced the dismantling of a drug smuggling network run by the "Sinaloa Cartel" Mexican drug organization in Arizona, seizing millions of dollars in drugs and arresting 203 people. The police said last Tuesday that in a 15-month operation organized by Tempe police and the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) and involving multiple agencies, a total of 203 people were arrested in the Phoenix Valley area, and $7.8 million in cash and cash were seized. More than 1,200 pounds of drugs and 44 firearms. Police said they destroyed the lair used by Mexico's most wanted criminal, the boss of the Sinaloa Cartel, nicknamed "El Chapo" Joaquín Guzman Loera, to sell heroin, cocaine, methamphetamine and marijuana. Last year, Tempe police arrested two men in the drug trade and found they were delivery drivers for a Mexican smuggling ring, providing police with clues. Chief Doug Coleman said the operation removed large quantities of drugs, millions of dollars in drug traffickers' funds and powerful weapons from the city's streets, another serious blow to drug trafficking organizations' attempts to use the Phoenix metropolitan area as a major hub for drug distribution. Police said those arrested included U.S. and Mexican citizens. They were charged with possession, use and trafficking of drugs. The most active area for drug trafficking by the Sinaloa Cartel is in Mexico. Since President Calderon took office in 2006, drug-related violence in the country has killed more than 44,000 people. For this reason, Calderon has repeatedly sent troops to suppress drug smugglers.

5fb53710086e2d6f985c3e1b65effd8ce5496454.sourceText: 11月亚省失业率：8.7% 达到2009年以来最低的数字 州行政部门15日发布11月亚利桑那州失业率，8.7%，这是2009年以来最低的数字，略高于全国的平均数。10月份为9%。 本州在11月产生45800个职位，与去年同期相比，涨了1.9%。同时，全美的失业率也在下降，全国失业率从10月份的9%下降到11月份的8.6%。 州劳力经济学家克里凡瑟克警告，失业率逐步下降，但这个数字可能在未来几个月内上下波动。瑟克说，失业率下降可能得益于季节性劳动力市场，比如私营教育经费增长，和节日季节零售业增员等。是否长期增长，仍是未知数。
5fb53710086e2d6f985c3e1b65effd8ce5496454.translatedText: The unemployment rate in Alberta in November: 8.7%, reaching the lowest number since 2009. The state executive department released on the 15th that Arizona's unemployment rate in November was 8.7%, which is the lowest number since 2009 and slightly higher than the national average. It was 9% in October. The state generated 45,800 jobs in November, an increase of 1.9% compared with the same period last year. At the same time, the national unemployment rate is also falling, with the national unemployment rate falling from 9% in October to 8.6% in November. State labor economist Krivan Sirk warned that the unemployment rate is gradually declining, but that the number could fluctuate in the coming months. Sirk said the decline in the unemployment rate may be due to seasonal labor markets, such as increased private education funding and increased retail employment during the holiday season. Whether it will grow in the long term is still unknown.

ad135a82d40faa074ccd768cd702575f9fcce2fd.sourceText: 在经过长达三年的调查后，司法部15日指控，打击非法移民声名远播的马利科巴郡警长警长阿派奥及其下属，在打击非法移民过程中，专对西语裔进行种族侦防，并非法捕人，违犯民权法。 在司法部宣布调查结果后，国内安全部长珍妮纳波利塔诺随即宣布，国安部终止允许马利科巴郡警长办公室执行移民法规的联邦与亚省的协议。 司法部在这份长达22页的调查报告中说，阿派奥手下警员，经常非法盘查和逮捕西语裔，但没有证据显示他们过度使用武力或未能适当保护西语裔社区。
ad135a82d40faa074ccd768cd702575f9fcce2fd.translatedText: After a three-year investigation, the Justice Department accused on the 15th that the Maricopa County Sheriff, Sheriff Arpaio, who is famous for cracking down on illegal immigration, and his subordinates, in the process of cracking down on illegal immigration, specifically conducted racial detection on Hispanics and did not arrest people illegally, violating civil rights laws. Immediately after the Department of Justice announced its findings, Internal Security Minister Jeanine Napolitano announced that the Department of Homeland Security was terminating the federal-Alberta agreement that allowed the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office to enforce immigration regulations. The Justice Department said in the 22-page investigative report that Apao's officers frequently illegally interrogated and arrested Hispanics, but there was no evidence that they used excessive force or failed to properly protect the Hispanic community.

2f378a697b4b6ef56f2b93796468dd507af7b893.sourceText: 司法部民权司司长裴雷说：「我们发现歧视性执法深深植根于该警局的文化，导致警员长期地忽视宪法保护的基本权利。」 阿派奥警长否认西语裔和民权人士提出的种族侦防指控。 司法部还说，阿派奥的警员经常在当地一家企业，盘查黑皮肤的或说西班牙语的人。 司法部表示，西语裔驾车者被盘查的机率比非西语裔高四至九倍，阿派奥警长及警员还骚扰那些公开反对这种做法的人。马利科巴郡郡监狱也经常歧视那些英语不好的西语裔囚犯。 司法部限令马利科巴郡警察局在明年元月4日前，同意谈判解决这个问题，还警告说，如果该局不服从，司法部将诉诸法院强制该局服从。 马利科巴郡检察官蒙哥马利16日说，国内安全部长不让该郡警长办公室检查嫌犯的移民身分，最终会把罪犯重新放归社区，影响治安。他要求欧巴马总统介入，恢复该郡查验罪犯背景的资格。 蒙哥马利说，司法部的调查报告「没有价值」。他说，这样做只会让该州居民处于危险之境。蒙哥马利将请求欧巴马总统下令，重新向地方警察开放联邦政府的移民资料库。
2f378a697b4b6ef56f2b93796468dd507af7b893.translatedText: Director of the Civil Rights Division of the Department of Justice, Perrei, said: "We found that discriminatory law enforcement is deeply rooted in the culture of this police department, leading officers to long-term neglect of the basic rights protected by the Constitution." Chief Apao denied the accusations of racial profiling raised by Hispanics and civil rights activists. The Justice Department also said Arpaio officers frequently visited a local business to interrogate people with dark skin or who spoke Spanish. The Justice Department said Hispanic motorists were four to nine times more likely to be questioned than non-Hispanics, and Arpaio and his officers harassed those who spoke out against the practice. The Maricopa County Jail also frequently discriminates against Hispanic inmates who do not speak English well. The Department of Justice gave the Maricopa County Police Department until January 4 next year to agree to negotiate to resolve the issue, and also warned that if the bureau does not comply, the Department of Justice will resort to court to force the bureau to comply. Maricopa County Prosecutor Montgomery said on the 16th that the Minister of Internal Security did not allow the county Sheriff’s Office to check the immigration status of suspects, which would eventually lead to the release of criminals into the community and affect public security. He asked President Obama to step in and restore the county's ability to conduct background checks on criminals. Montgomery said the Justice Department's investigative report had "no merit." Doing so, he said, would only put the state's residents at risk. Montgomery will ask President Obama to order the reopening of the federal immigration database to local police.

372480ae5e36ad7b35e6cc870855b41c8d37da2d.sourceText: 送旧岁迎新年、总得回顾是否虚度了年华？ 自十余年前用电脑后，生活大事、创作、投稿、读书与旅游，都分门别类的输入文件档内，记录参考与鞭策。 本是私事，对他人不值一笑；报社主编忽传来「我的2011年」专题约稿，推敲思量后，不端浅陋撰下与文朋诗友和读者们分享。 岁始到今日、文学创作连同这一篇竟多达121篇，是历年来最多产了；包括微型小说5篇、散文21篇、杂文32篇、诗作63篇。 (过去多年、每年平均约九十余篇。) 总共阅读了诗集、散文集与小说等42部书册及文学杂志如:「香港文学」月刊、「新华文学」季刊、「泰华文学」双月刊等。 张奥列着的「澳华名士风采」和张劲帆的「初夜」也已在年中拜读了。 我的汉俳诗作「楚雄采风」四帖，获得「首届海内外汉俳创作大奖赛」优秀奖。 上周刚收到主办单位「中国汉俳学会」寄至的获奖「荣誉证书」。 说来惭愧、今年居然没有再作汉俳了。 年中意外被湖南省的「风雅汉俳学社」敦聘为该社的「名誉社长」；另二位获聘任的是「世界华文作协交流协会」副秘书长兼英文秘书、纽西兰的林 爽女士，世纪诗刊主编、新加坡的刘情玉诗友。 为参予「辛亥革命百周年庆祝」系列活动、四月我以「世华作家交流协会」秘书长身份，邀请了台湾著名作家陈若曦教授莅澳，在雪梨与墨尔本办了两场极成功的演讲 会。 拙著长篇小说「怒海惊魂30日」、和荣获去年度「澳洲南暝出版基金」赞助的诗集「三月骚动」，与台湾秀威出版社签约出版、分别在五月与七月面世发行。 先后为这两册拙著在墨尔本与雪梨举办新书发布会，为澳华文坛、诗坛盛事之一。 筹建「国父孙中山先生铜像」，历经十一年、最终在十一月二十日、假墨尔本华埠灵星门广场内，举行了竖立典礼。 我身为「筹建铜像委员会」秘书，顿感毋负华社殷望，完成「建国父铜像」任务、不必再为此事操心，真是轻松愉快。 今年仿佛是驿马星动、四月陪陈若曦教授赴雪梨演讲、没想到十月中又飞雪梨主持诗集发布会。 能与雪梨的文朋诗友们相聚，实在欢喜无限。 五月赴美国探亲、与长女、外孙和婉冰参加黄石公园八天游。 在旧金山获「世华交流会」常务顾问、知名幽默作家吴玲瑶女史邀宴；另由诗人潮声兄陪同、前往该市老人院探望作家、报人陈大哲兄。 途经赌城当晚、获「拉斯维加斯华文作家协会」会长、「世华交流协会」副秘书长、知名作家尹浩镠伉俪设宴招待。 没想到八月二十三日要再飞往旧金山，为仙逝的老岳母奔丧。 亦由于事发突然，七月中惊闻岳母患上末期癌；医生断定尚能生存半年，准备等办完拙诗集发布会后，才飞美国陪内子一起侍奉老人家。 因而婉拒参加香港举办的「旅游文学研讨会」，错过了与海内外作家、学者们交流的机会。 退而不休的忙碌过日子，生活充实，身心愉快；每天清晨六时即起，七时进入书斋、隔天上网并处理「世华交流会」会务、及协助管理「世交会」网站编务。 隔日到另一书房敲打电脑键盘，创作散文、小说、杂文或诗作品。 午休后读书、看报或翻阅杂志，偶而到庭园莳花剪草；晚间若无酬酢，则观看影片或剧集，渡过漫漫长夜。 晚晴余晖、一样要发光发热，奉行证严上人的语录:「懂得运用时间、利益人群就是幸福!」文学创作、抱持载道之心，算是「法布施」也。 「活到老、学到老」是我的座右铭，在退休后坚持学习和读书，因为「今生读书已太迟」了，再不用功，时不我予就空余恨啊。 人生苦短、我​​们要珍惜每天好时光，浪费光阴等于与自己保贵的生命开玩笑，愿与大家共勉。 并祝福读者们来年更上层楼，万事称心，家庭美满、身体安康；作家诗人们、灵思泉涌，幸福快乐、~~~^_^~~~口常开。
372480ae5e36ad7b35e6cc870855b41c8d37da2d.translatedText: Send off the old year and welcome the new year. I have to look back and see if my years have been wasted? Since I started using computers more than ten years ago, all major life events, creations, submissions, readings and travels have been input into files in categories to record references and encouragement. This is a private matter and not worthy of a smile to others. Suddenly, the editor-in-chief of the newspaper received an invitation to contribute to the special topic "My 2011". After careful consideration, I wrote a crude article to share with literary friends, poets, and readers. From the beginning of the year to today, there have been as many as 121 literary creations including this article, which is the most prolific in history; including 5 micro-novels, 21 essays, 32 essays, and 63 poems. (In the past many years, the average is about ninety articles per year.) I have read a total of 42 books such as poetry collections, essay collections and novels, as well as literary magazines such as: "Hong Kong Literature" monthly, "Xinhua Literature" quarterly, "Thai Chinese Literature" bimonthly, etc. "The Style of Australian and Chinese Celebrities" by Zhang Aoli and "The First Night" by Zhang Jinfan have also been read in the middle of the year. Four of my Chinese haiku poems "Chuxiong Collection" won the Excellence Award in the "First Domestic and Overseas Chinese Haiku Creation Grand Prix". I just received the award-winning "Certificate of Honor" from the organizer "Chinese Han Haiku Society" last week. It’s a shame to say that I didn’t make any more Han haiku this year. In the middle of the year, I was unexpectedly appointed as the "honorary president" of the "Fengya Han Haiku Society" in Hunan Province; the other two people appointed were the deputy secretary-general and English secretary of the "World Chinese Writers Association Exchange Association", Ms. Lin Shuang from New Zealand, and the editor-in-chief of Century Poetry Magazine and poetry friend Liu Qingyu from Singapore. In order to participate in the "Celebration of the Centenary of the Revolution of 1911" series of activities, in April, as the Secretary-General of the "Shihua Writers Exchange Association", I invited the famous Taiwanese writer Professor Chen Ruoxi to come to Macao and held two very successful lectures in Sydney and Melbourne. The novel "30 Days of Rage" and the poetry collection "March Riot", which was sponsored by the "Australian Nanming Publishing Fund" last year, were signed with Taiwan's Xiuwei Publishing House and released in May and July respectively. The book launch conferences for these two volumes of my novels were held in Melbourne and Sydney successively, which is one of the major events in the Australian and Chinese literary and poetry circles. It took eleven years to build the "Bronze Statue of Founding Father Dr. Sun Yat-sen", and finally the erection ceremony was held on November 20 at Lingxingmen Square in Melbourne's Chinatown. As the secretary of the "Committee for the Preparation of the Bronze Statue", I immediately felt that I had lived up to the high expectations of the Chinese community. It was so relaxing and joyful to complete the task of building the "Bronze Statue of the Founding Fathers" and no longer have to worry about it. This year, it seems that the horse is moving. In April, I accompanied Professor Chen Ruoxi to give a lecture in Sydney. Unexpectedly, I flew to Sydney to host a poetry collection conference in mid-October. It is such a joy to be able to gather with literary friends and poets from Sydney. In May, I went to the United States to visit relatives and participated in an eight-day trip to Yellowstone Park with my eldest daughter, grandson and Wanbing. In San Francisco, I was invited to a banquet by the famous humorist Wu Lingyao, the standing consultant of the World Chinese Exchange Association. Accompanied by the poet Chao Sheng, I went to the city's nursing home to visit the writer and journalist Chen Dazhe. That night when we passed through the casino, we were hosted by Mr. and Mrs. Yin Haoliu, the president of the "Las Vegas Chinese Writers Association", the deputy secretary-general of the "World Chinese Exchange Association" and the well-known writer. Unexpectedly, I had to fly to San Francisco again on August 23 to attend the funeral for my late mother-in-law. Due to the sudden incident, I was shocked to hear that my mother-in-law was suffering from terminal cancer in mid-July. The doctor determined that she could survive for half a year, and planned to fly to the United States to accompany my wife to serve the elderly after the release of my collection of poems. Therefore, I declined to participate in the "Tourism Literature Seminar" held in Hong Kong and missed the opportunity to communicate with writers and scholars at home and abroad. He lives a busy life in retirement, with a fulfilling life and a happy body and mind; he gets up at 6 a.m. every day, goes to the study room at 7 o'clock, surfs the Internet the next day, handles the affairs of the "World China Expo", and assists in the management of the "World Expo" website editing. The next day, I go to another study room to type on the computer keyboard and create prose, novels, essays or poems. After lunch break, they read books, newspapers or magazines, and occasionally go to the garden to plant flowers and cut grass. In the evening, if there is no social gathering, they watch movies or TV series to spend the long night. Even with the afterglow of the evening sky, we must shine brightly and follow the words of Master Cheng Yen: "Knowing how to use your time to benefit people is happiness!" Literary creation and holding the heart of carrying the Tao can be regarded as "Dharma giving". "Live until you are old and learn until you are old" is my motto. I will continue to study and study after retirement, because "it is too late to study in this life." Life is short, we should cherish the good time every day. Wasting time is equivalent to joking with our precious life. We would like to encourage everyone. And I wish the readers to achieve greater heights in the coming year, everything goes well, a happy family, good health; writers and poets, spiritual thoughts welling up, happiness, and ~~~^_^~~~ mouths open often.

Editor's note: According to the US "World Daily" report, a large number of Chinese students have gone to the United States to study in recent years...

9487ab63498b3b5b2946e9f9d54aae3214aab6c8.sourceText: 编者按：据美国《世界日报》报道，近年大批中国学生赴美国留学，所选专业大多数为商科，全美39%的MBA项目表示，外籍学生中增长速度最快的均为中国学生，而这些大学商学院的广告也如雪片一样飞入许多还在就读本科的中国留学生家中，有些课程因为学生和老师都是华人，索性直接用中文教学。 据美国当地媒体报道，中国是美国大学研究生中学生来源最多的三个国家之一，与去年相比，今年注册的中国研究生数量比去年多了21%。其中39%的MBA项目表示，在所有外籍学生申请者中，中国是生源增加最快的国家。 这一现象，让许多大学商学院把中国学生视为”财神爷”。从南加大毕业已半年的中国留学生Shelley，至今仍能不时收到全美各地大学商学院寄来的广告。她透露，在一年前曾经怕本科毕业后找不到工作，就注册并考了GMAT，之后家里就不停地收到全美各地学校寄来的商学院资料，有时候多到一下子可收到好几份， 其中不乏麻省理工、尔湾加大等名校的MBA项目。 Shelley对这些突然寄到家中的资料完全没有头绪，不知自己的私人信息如何被泄漏散布出去。她同时指出，这些资料都印制精美，而且信息丰富，加上邮资，想必成本不少。她认为，学校在现今经济不景气的情况下还这样分发垃圾邮件，太过浪费。 Shelley还透露，不仅家中邮箱常收到类似邮件，电子邮箱中也因为这些学校的垃圾邮件不堪其扰。 虽然这样的攻势给学校带去不少中国学生来源，但教育质量是否因此下降却不得而知。一名中国留学生透露，在其所上的一门关于生产线课程中，由于整个班级的老师和学生都会说中文，加上老师的英文水平不高，讲课到一半老师竟然询问学生是否可用中文授课。这件事情在他学校的中国留学生群众广为流传，该老师也成为笑柄。 但据他所知，这样的事情不仅在南加，全美许多大学均发生过，已不是秘密，相比商科，工科中类似例子更多。
9487ab63498b3b5b2946e9f9d54aae3214aab6c8.translatedText: Editor's note: According to the US "World Daily" report, a large number of Chinese students have gone to the United States to study in recent years, and most of their chosen majors are business. 39 in the United States % of MBA programs said that the fastest-growing foreign students are Chinese students, and advertisements from these university business schools are also flying into the homes of many Chinese students who are still studying for undergraduates. Some courses are simply taught in Chinese because the students and teachers are Chinese. According to local media reports in the United States, China is one of the three countries with the largest number of graduate students in American universities. Compared with last year, the number of Chinese graduate students registered this year increased by 21%. 39% of MBA programs stated that among all foreign student applicants, China is the country with the fastest growing number of students. This phenomenon has led many university business schools to regard Chinese students as the "gods of wealth." Shelley, a Chinese international student who has graduated from the University of Southern California half a year ago, still receives advertisements from business schools at universities across the United States from time to time. She revealed that a year ago, she was worried that she would not be able to find a job after graduating from her undergraduate degree, so she registered and took the GMAT. After that, her family kept receiving business school information from schools across the United States. Sometimes she received several at once, including MBA programs from prestigious schools such as MIT and UC Irvine. Shelley had no clue about the information that was suddenly sent to her home and had no idea how her private information was leaked and spread. She also pointed out that these materials were beautifully printed and rich in information, and with the postage, they must have cost a lot. She believes that it is too wasteful for schools to distribute spam in this way in today's economic downturn. Shelley also revealed that not only does her home mailbox often receive similar emails, but her email inbox is also plagued by spam from these schools. Although such an offensive has brought many Chinese students to the school, it is unknown whether the quality of education has declined as a result. A Chinese international student revealed that in a production line course he took, because all the teachers and students in the class could speak Chinese, and the teacher's English level was not high, halfway through the lecture the teacher actually asked the students whether the class could be taught in Chinese. This incident was widely circulated among the Chinese students at his school, and the teacher became a laughing stock. But as far as he knows, this kind of thing has happened not only in Southern California, but also in many universities across the United States. It is no secret. There are more similar examples in engineering than in business.

1f4bf66f1155fdfa4b9e28460f785924ebdced0d.sourceText: 据当局称，两名本地男子被麻州警方拘捕，并在他们的车上发现近160磅大麻。 34岁的惊喜镇居民安德鲁洛克，和30岁的凤凰城居民坦尼科尔，被麻州斯特布里奇警方发现可疑，随后被骑警的马闻到大麻气味来自他们的车内，从而被捕。 这两人19日在斯特布里奇上法庭。 稍早前，麻州警方在机场的托运行李中，搜到寄自亚利桑那州的毒品，几名男子当场被捕。目前，警方并未透露这两起案件有关联。
1f4bf66f1155fdfa4b9e28460f785924ebdced0d.translatedText: Two local men were arrested by Massachusetts police and nearly 160 pounds of marijuana was found in their car, authorities said. Andrew Locke, 34, of Surprise, and Tannic Cole, 30, of Phoenix, were arrested after police in Sturbridge, Mass., noticed they were acting suspiciously and were later arrested after a trooper's horse smelled the odor of marijuana coming from their vehicle. The two men went to court in Sturbridge on the 19th. Earlier, Massachusetts police found drugs sent from Arizona in checked luggage at the airport, and several men were arrested on the spot. At present, the police have not revealed that the two cases are related.

c4ed92bf1d02e985b536b66993db9ed8b3429673.sourceText: 西南青年舞蹈团 成功演出(组图) (特约记者 王帅报道) Gilbert, Arizona- ”It was very well!” 这是散场时，我们从观众口中听到的最多一句话。12月18日下午，由著名华裔芭蕾舞蹈家陈燕丽领衔的西南青年芭蕾舞蹈团(southwest youth ballet theatre) 也成功结束了他们在Higley Center of Performing Arts 的第二场演出。 整个 在本个演出季则一共有三场。而这也是西南青年芭蕾舞蹈团的”成立五周年庆典” 系列演出之一。 Higley Center of Performing Arts 陈燕丽女士出生在中国台湾，从15岁时候开始专门学习芭蕾舞，在1990年进入美国职业芭蕾舞蹈团体，此后在亚利桑那芭蕾舞蹈团(Ballet Arizona)担任首席演员长达12年。在2006年，陈燕丽女士退休之后成立西南青年芭蕾舞蹈团，并担任艺术总监。 作为西方经典芭蕾舞剧，由俄国作曲家柴可夫斯基编曲的 可谓是十分适合在圣诞季节上演，我们也看到了有很多家长带着小孩来一起观赏。 讲述了一个小女孩在平安夜得到的一个圣诞玩具-军官造型的胡桃夹子。小女孩做了一个奇妙的梦，在梦中胡桃夹子活过来，成为一名英俊的王子，并且与老鼠兵作战。胜利之后带着小女孩游览糖果王国的故事。作为一个音乐童话，其剧情轻松中充满喜庆气息，很适合全家一起观看。 胡桃夹子>场景一 胡桃夹子>场景二 胡桃夹子>场景三 胡桃夹子>场景四 作为一名在中华文化熏陶中成长，在西方接受职业教育的芭蕾舞者。陈燕丽女士力争将原汁原味的 献给观众。正如一名曾经做过职业舞者Jason所说，” 女士编排的 原汁原味地保留了这个西方经典曲目的精华，虽然成立时间很短，只有五六年。但是无论在与现场交响乐团(钱德勒交响乐团负责乐曲)的合作，还是从艺术水准来说，都达到了很高的水平。” 胡桃夹子>场景五 这次上演的 全剧一共两幕，时长两小时。许多观众在结束后仍然意犹未尽，虽然无法像交响乐曲一样，为大家再献上encore作为对观众的回报。但是同样持久而热烈的掌声，应该是对陈燕丽女士，以及所以辛苦排练演出的团员最好的褒奖。 满意而归的观众们

On the afternoon of December 18, the Southwest Youth Ballet Theatre, led by the famous Chinese ballet dancer Chen Yanli, also successfully concluded their second performance at the Higley Center of Performing Arts. This was also one of the Southwest Youth Ballet Theater's "Fifth Anniversary Celebration" series of performances this season. Ms. Chen Yanli was born in Taiwan, China. She began to study ballet at the age of 15. She entered the American professional ballet dance group in 1990 and served as the principal dancer of Ballet Arizona for 12 years. After her retirement in 2006, Ms. Chen Yanli established the Southwest Youth Ballet and served as the artistic director. As a classic Western ballet, it is arranged by the Russian composer Tchaikovsky and is very suitable for performance during the Christmas season. We have also seen many parents bringing their children to watch it. It tells the story of a little girl who got a Christmas toy in the shape of an army officer. The little girl had a wonderful dream in which the Nutcracker came to life and became a handsome prince. After the victory, he took the little girl to visit the candy kingdom. As a musical fairy tale, its plot is light and festive and suitable for the whole family to watch. 87ea2deb893807e75df2efd52c3cb0abb6e5681e.sourceText: 美银美林房地产市场分析师米歇尔?#36808;耶12月5日发布《2012年房市展望报告》表示，美国房地产市场的危机还远未结束，当前仍有大量止赎房产待售或尚待清算，预计明年至2013年一季度，全美房地产价格在现在基础上还将继续下跌7%。

160892d322f27c7c96c80b9935627d0e451450c7.sourceText: 美银美林证券化产品研究小组资料显示，自2007年至今，美国已有约600万套住房被清算；预计在未来4年内，还将有800万套住房被清算，总计将有1400万套房屋丧失抵押赎回资格，约占此期间抵押贷款购房总量的四分之一。
160892d322f27c7c96c80b9935627d0e451450c7.translatedText: Bank of America Merrill Lynch Securitization Products Research Group data shows that since 2007, about 6 million homes have been liquidated in the United States; it is expected that in the next four years, another 8 million homes will be liquidated, and a total of 14 million homes will be ineligible for mortgage foreclosure, accounting for about a quarter of the total mortgage loan purchases during this period.

09d41891df36154ff7620374d271feb9b3db8af2.sourceText: 迈耶表示，目前，全美不能按期还款的非机构抵押贷款项目，转入清算程序平均要花费25个月至30个月的时间，比金融危机前所需时间延长了一倍还多。
09d41891df36154ff7620374d271feb9b3db8af2.translatedText: Meyer said that currently, it takes an average of 25 to 30 months for non-agency mortgage loans across the United States to be transferred into liquidation procedures that cannot repay on time, which is more than double the time required before the financial crisis.

1b6b5da85564a30e3893532babeb2c62073a6101.sourceText: 由于止赎房屋大量积压，相关机构止赎清算困难加剧，将使2013年成为美国房地产市场最糟糕的一年。
1b6b5da85564a30e3893532babeb2c62073a6101.translatedText: Due to the large backlog of foreclosed houses and the intensified difficulties in foreclosure liquidation by relevant agencies, 2013 will become the worst year for the U.S. real estate market.

8c4f7ebb9c89021cd375a1d3a413595f3d8223b6.sourceText: 凤凰城广告牌新规 凤凰城市议会上周三通过新的广告牌条例，可能增加更多电子广告牌在城市道路，但禁止在居民区竖立广告牌，增加高速公路广告板密度。 市议会以5:4票通过条例，增加高速公路广告牌密度，缩小市内街道广告牌间距，以保护居民区和城市美观为出发点，将广告牌集中在一个合理路段。 新规还要求商户将广告牌转换成数码广告牌，旧建筑上的残旧广告牌，凡是1986年以前悬挂的广告牌将一律当做不合格处理。
8c4f7ebb9c89021cd375a1d3a413595f3d8223b6.translatedText: > Phoenix billboard regulations The Phoenix City Council passed a new billboard ordinance last Wednesday that may add more electronic billboards to city roads, but prohibits the erection of billboards in residential areas and increases the density of billboards on highways. The city council voted 5:4 to pass the ordinance to increase the density of billboards on highways and narrow the spacing between billboards on city streets. With the goal of protecting residential areas and the beauty of the city, the billboards will be concentrated in a reasonable section of the road. The new regulations also require merchants to convert billboards into digital billboards. Dilapidated billboards on old buildings and those hung before 1986 will be treated as unqualified.

b07d4b9c9b7e720d5af98dcfe99988b988d86c2d.sourceText: 你或你的家人有开车时使用手机的习惯吗?美国家运输安全委员会NTSB完成一系列调查后，周二建议所有州和区立法禁止驾驶使用手机，成为第一个呼吁彻底禁止开车时使用手机交谈 的联邦机构。 据官方估计，美国去年3,092起公路死亡车祸是由于驾驶分心，部份是因为使用手机。 独立的NTSB不具有国会的立法权，也没有白宫的监管权，但作为全美联邦安全的倡导者，他们的建议在府会两处都具份量。 它的建议还涵盖了政治意函：国会和政府是否要听取强大的手机业者游说，而让美国民众沉溺于手机或其他电子通讯。 NTSB周二的这项呼吁是因为刚完成2010年一起密苏里州的交通事故。 肇事者是一名19岁的卡车司机，曾在事故前的11分钟内发送了11个简讯，因而引发连环车祸。 这次事故殃及一辆拖柜车和一辆校车，造成两个人死亡、38人受伤。 据华盛顿邮报报导，现有35个州和区禁止驾驶传送简讯，9个州和区要求驾驶员使用免提装置。 其实最近一些权威研究得出结论，如果手机耳机贴在耳朵边，使用免提设备并没法使司机少点分神。 亚利桑那州没有禁止驾车传简讯和使用电话的规定，但近日各个网上论坛和媒体都在热议此事，看来驾车禁用手机是势在必行之事。
b07d4b9c9b7e720d5af98dcfe99988b988d86c2d.translatedText: Do you or your family have the habit of using cell phones while driving? After completing a series of investigations, the U.S. National Transportation Safety Board NTSB recommended on Tuesday that all states and territories legislate to ban the use of cell phones while driving, becoming the first to call for an outright ban on the use of cell phones while driving. of federal agencies. According to official estimates, 3,092 road fatalities in the United States last year were caused by distracted driving, in part due to cell phone use. The independent NTSB does not have the legislative power of Congress or the regulatory power of the White House, but as an advocate of federal security across the United States, their recommendations carry weight in both chambers of government. Its recommendations also cover the political question of whether Congress and the administration should heed the lobbying of powerful cell phone companies and allow Americans to become addicted to cell phones or other electronic communications. The NTSB's call Tuesday follows a 2010 traffic accident in Missouri. The perpetrator was a 19-year-old truck driver who sent 11 text messages in the 11 minutes before the accident, causing a series of car accidents. The accident affected a trailer truck and a school bus, killing two people and injuring 38 others. According to the Washington Post, 35 states and districts currently prohibit texting while driving, and 9 states and districts require drivers to use hands-free devices. In fact, some recent authoritative studies have concluded that using hands-free devices does not make drivers less distracted if the mobile phone earphones are placed against the ears. There are no regulations prohibiting text messaging and phone use while driving in Arizona, but various online forums and media have been hotly discussing this matter recently. It seems that banning mobile phones while driving is imperative.

785b33ae13a6240a1e9c069bbea3ee203536af34.translatedText: >Zhang Zhaohong’s daughter Xue Wei passed away on January 10th and held a memorial ceremony on January 18th, which lasted eight days. Xue Wei donated all the available organs in her body, and every part of her body...

2970eabd3d2ddead72fb6027a2225f0efa41b9be.sourceText: 和中国传统文化不同，聋哑朋友真情流露时七情上面，残障者在发表感言时甚至把拐仗摔在地上，还有些老妇人搂住薇薇的身体，吻在薇薇冰冷的额头上，就如薇薇生前与她们每次告别时，都要温馨拥抱后才离开一样。
2970eabd3d2ddead72fb6027a2225f0efa41b9be.translatedText: Different from traditional Chinese culture, the true feelings of the deaf-mute friend were revealed in Shiqi In terms of love, the disabled even threw their crutches on the ground when delivering their speeches, and some old women hugged Weiwei's body and kissed her cold forehead, just like when Weiwei said goodbye to them every time, she would give them a warm hug before leaving.

88ed8a77af63704abf82a2c3db074e3752ab00cd.sourceText: 薇薇用善良爱心和尽责为弱势群体服务，聋哑人群尊重她，赞美她，感谢给他们的心灵带来温暖。薇薇为我们华人的形象增添了亮丽和光彩。
88ed8a77af63704abf82a2c3db074e3752ab00cd.translatedText: Weiwei serves the disadvantaged groups with kindness, love and responsibility. The deaf-mute people respect her, praise her, and thank her for bringing warmth to their hearts. Weiwei adds brightness and luster to the image of our Chinese people.

55db7150801fd94482528ad1d7afc2a2141fe092.sourceText: 薇薇出生于1980年2月23日，我当时工作在外，几天后才回来。我把熟睡的她抱在怀中，片刻之后，她挣开了那水灵灵的眼睛并对着我微笑 ，此情景永远铭刻在我的心中，从此我们就有了一段数十年的缘分。
55db7150801fd94482528ad1d7afc2a2141fe092.translatedText: Weiwei was born on February 23, 1980. I was working away from home and came back a few days later. I held her sleeping body in my arms. After a while, she opened her eyes and smiled at me. This scene will always be engraved in my heart. From then on, we had a fate that lasted for decades.

a277ede315ff06e4cd9d8bdd26a5696d3d908e0c.sourceText: 我给她取名为薮薇，“薮”是集中的意思，“薇”是一种紫红色的小花。历史上有“伯夷叔齐饿死不食周粟，采薇而食”的典故，给“薇”附加了道与义的价值。这姓名包含着父母寄望女儿有一个花样年华和美好的人生。
a277ede315ff06e4cd9d8bdd26a5696d3d908e0c.translatedText: I named her Xue Wei. "Xu" means concentration, and "Wei" is a small purple-red flower. There is an allusion in history that "Bo Yi and Shu Qi starved to death and did not eat Zhousu millet, but picked Wei for food", which added the value of morality and justice to "Wei". This name contains the parents' hope that their daughter will have a happy life and a beautiful life.

4ed44dc62734259cb2d6c7762884b2a6e4454629.sourceText: 薇薇喜爱紫红色，所以我们就选了一套她生前喜欢的黑色并带有紫红花朵的衣服让她穿上，也特别订制了一个紫色的花冠来为她送别。
4ed44dc62734259cb2d6c7762884b2a6e4454629.translatedText: Weiwei loves purple, so we chose a set of black clothes with purple flowers that she liked during her lifetime for her to wear. We also specially customized a purple flower crown to send her off.

590496ca574c85102d382cf33091208174fcf2a9.sourceText: 薇薇自小就有爱心和同情心，活泼可爱，善解人意，还有勇气。记得她刚学游泳时，手臂带上两个小水泡就跳入游池中，很快就学会了在水中玩耍。薇薇美丽纯真，很得人喜爱。小时候她喜欢学写诗、跳舞，乖巧懂事，有了弟弟后，数十年来姐弟情深。
590496ca574c85102d382cf33091208174fcf2a9.translatedText: Weiwei has been loving and compassionate since she was a child, lively, cute, considerate, and courageous. I remember that when she first learned to swim, she jumped into the swimming pool with two small blisters on her arms and quickly learned to play in the water. Weiwei is beautiful, innocent and very popular. When she was a child, she liked to learn to write poems and dance, and she was well-behaved and sensible. After having a younger brother, she had a close sibling relationship for decades.

6c28c33b552d34cbfc291eb386997ddac1427e2c.sourceText: 薇薇在大学学的是手语翻译专科，在那个年代，象她这样学习美国手语的华裔，在亚利桑那亦只有她一个。
6c28c33b552d34cbfc291eb386997ddac1427e2c.translatedText: Weiwei majored in sign language interpretation in college. At that time, she was the only Chinese-American in Arizona who studied American Sign Language.

1f53d2435699cbcefecfa915435a5499747f0ded.sourceText: 毕业后，她开始为聋哑人作翻译工作。聋哑人中还有在聋哑了之后又盲了的人，看不到手语，薇薇就要手把手，把她亲人的讯息传递，让盲者明白。为了更好地翻译，她需要不断地进修，撑握更全面的知识，以至可以为不同学科的聋哑学生进行翻译。有年她要到北亚利桑那大学(Northern Arizona University)为聋哑大学生进行翻译，路途往返上山下山需要五个小时，当时她已怀有身孕，我只能小心翼翼地开车送她去学校。
1f53d2435699cbcefecfa915435a5499747f0ded.translatedText: After graduation, she began to work as a translator for the deaf-mute. Among the deaf-mute people, there are also people who become blind after becoming deaf-mute. They cannot see sign language, so Weiwei has to take care of her relatives and pass on the messages of her relatives so that the blind people can understand. In order to translate better, she needs to continue to learn and acquire more comprehensive knowledge, so that she can even translate for deaf-mute students in different subjects. One year she had to go to Northern Arizona University to translate for deaf-mute college students. It took five hours to go up and down the mountain. She was pregnant at the time, so I could only drive her to school carefully.

01a9a55f1e9f1aae120f19055de25a2e64fb3c4f.sourceText: 她为歌剧做现场翻译，让聋哑人群也能够欣赏。歌剧艺术沿于生活高于生活，演绎者更要了解历史背景和剧情细致的内容，她为那次的演出搜集了厚厚的一本资料。
01a9a55f1e9f1aae120f19055de25a2e64fb3c4f.translatedText: She provides live translation for operas so that deaf and mute people can also enjoy them. The art of opera is higher than life, and the performer must understand the historical background and the detailed content of the plot. She collected a thick book of information for that performance.

d7fbe1fee5dd15a4a62570740fa908b6744d9b98.sourceText: 她从事手语翻译20年。手语工作并非容易，长时间工作手很疲累。她的手腕有好长时间疼痛，还动过手术。按规定，手语工作每次不能超过四十五分钟，除了怕你累，还怕手僵手痛时翻译出错。
d7fbe1fee5dd15a4a62570740fa908b6744d9b98.translatedText: She has been engaged in sign language translation for 20 years. Sign language work is not easy, and your hands are tired from long hours of work. She had pain in her wrist for a long time and had surgery. According to regulations, sign language work cannot exceed forty-five minutes at a time. In addition to fearing that you will be tired, you are also worried that translation errors will occur when your hands are stiff and painful.

bf25e53979fa67dcb08b1ac642d912ab44deab45.sourceText: 薇薇天生丽质，19岁时，她参加凤鳳城华裔小姐选美，并赢得了冠军。
bf25e53979fa67dcb08b1ac642d912ab44deab45.translatedText: Weiwei is naturally beautiful. When she was 19 years old, she participated in the Miss Chinese Beauty Pageant in Fengfeng City and won the championship.

e93fe0311340e2b47dbdf68749bcd7a39d7396d0.sourceText: 薇薇有爱心也会感恩，她回馈华人社区和社会。她到电视台做义工，参加侨联选美活动等等。
e93fe0311340e2b47dbdf68749bcd7a39d7396d0.translatedText: Weiwei is caring and grateful. She gives back to the Chinese community and society. She volunteered at a TV station, participated in beauty pageants of the Overseas Chinese Federation, etc.

04ab69c09cfba800cf2b61d3d0be94b8409907d1.sourceText: 薇薇为中文学校表演“四海一家”节目作手语示范。老师把这个节目编排成舞蹈，在互联网路上广为流传，成为最高的点击率的艺术表演节目。
04ab69c09cfba800cf2b61d3d0be94b8409907d1.translatedText: Weiwei gave a sign language demonstration for the Chinese school's performance of "We Are All Together". The teacher choreographed this program into a dance, which was widely circulated on the Internet and became an art performance program with the highest click-through rate.

27778fdf2a44b5630b0a747426c2df27b8298bb8.sourceText: 18日前来参加薇薇追悼会的除了聋哑人的群体，还有大凤凰城侨团联合总会主席邓军泉，UCA AZ主席邓朝驹，亚省中国餐馆协会创会人徐国富、理事巫宜钊、周锦芳，亚省华人历史协会理事谢成彦、王益成、庄淑华，亚省华人华侨联合总会创会会长杨文田，科工专主席徐强，亚省川渝同乡会常务会长陈志钢，亚利桑那艺术学校校长吕丽华，凤凰城龙岡公所理事刘丽华、刘陈爱卿，凤凰导报社长Sunny，会计师李沃迏，保险理财王振梅，美西国际贸易徐薇等等。
27778fdf2a44b5630b0a747426c2df27b8298bb8.translatedText: In addition to the deaf-mute group who came to attend Weiwei’s memorial service on the 18th, there were also Deng Junquan, chairman of the Greater Phoenix Overseas Chinese Association, UCA AZ Chairman Deng Chaoju, founder of the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association Xu Guofu, directors Wu Yizhao and Zhou Jinfang, directors of the Alberta Chinese Historical Association Xie Chengyan, Wang Yicheng and Zhuang Shuhua, founding president of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Alberta Yang Wentian, chairman of the Science and Engineering College Xu Qiang, Alberta Chen Zhigang, executive president of Sichuan and Chongqing Association, Lu Lihua, principal of Arizona Art School, Liu Lihua and Liu Chen Aiqing, directors of Phoenix Longgang Office, Sunny, president of Phoenix Herald, accountant Li Woyi, insurance and financial management Wang Zhenmei, US-Western International Trade Xu Wei, etc.

87b8266290c0cfed03a7eb104bb2f0a4f6538c00.sourceText: 因为不是周末和假日，很多朋友只能通过致电或微信等转达悼念和哀思。凤凰城的善心好人在网上或用邮寄及递送等进行捐助，加州广府会的会员还通过捐款接龙，对薇薇的家庭进行资助。很多资料仍在汇集中，本人在此向各位亲朋好友表达万二分的感谢！
87b8266290c0cfed03a7eb104bb2f0a4f6538c00.translatedText: Because it is not a weekend or a holiday, many friends can only convey their condolences and condolences through phone calls or WeChat. Good-hearted people in Phoenix made donations online or by mail and delivery. Members of the California Cantonese Association also supported Weiwei's family through donations. A lot of information is still being collected. I would like to express my deepest gratitude to all my relatives and friends!

c8707c82d110150050f92852d8f35eb521ed4458.sourceText: 在最后的一刻，我再次凝视着亲爱的女儿，她的身上放满了白玫瑰和红玫瑰。她静静躺着，由于捐出了眼角膜，化妆后眼睛仍有些凹陷，她如睡着了一般，就像当年我第一把她抱在怀中一样，只不过她再也不能张开那美丽水灵的眼睛，而我也只能在梦中看到她的笑容，听到她的笑声。
c8707c82d110150050f92852d8f35eb521ed4458.translatedText: At the last moment, I stared at my dear daughter again, her body was filled with white roses and red roses. She lay quietly, her eyes still a little sunken after the makeup because she donated her corneas. She seemed to be asleep, just like when I held her in my arms for the first time, but she could no longer open her beautiful, watery eyes, and I could only see her smile and hear her laughter in my dreams.

1cb1a128cc047145919734492e9b26f0f1c24acf.sourceText: 一直以来，亚利桑那州是加拿大人购置第二个家的理想地点。 本周，加拿大的Coldwell Banker总裁苏珊塔德迪雅格来到凤凰城，与本地房地产经纪探讨如何吸引加拿大买家的话题。 房地产经纪说，亚利桑那州吸引加拿大购房者的主要条件有两个：一是天气（现在的艾伯特省大约只有华氏20度左右）；二是价格，众所周知，亚利桑那州是全美法拍屋 重灾区，同样面积的房屋，在凤凰城花的价钱可能只是加拿大的三分之一。 此外，许多加拿大老人有在冬天南飞亚利桑那过冬的传统，虽然有段时间加国政府裁减福利，使这些?#38634;鸟?#23545;温暖的凤凰城望而却步。 但婴儿潮一代已从祖父母处继承到一笔财富，加元坚挺，加国经济强劲，这些都是加拿大买家的优势。 经纪人说，现在的加国买家多为50至60岁人士，喜用现金。 新的趋势是，几个人合资买房，作为度假屋，共同使用。 德迪雅格说，百分之九十的加国买家喜欢在网上现挑房子，然后通过视频对物业作了解，很可能连交易程序都在网上完成，然后提着箱子就过来度假 。 这样的买家上哪儿找？
1cb1a128cc047145919734492e9b26f0f1c24acf.translatedText: Arizona has long been an ideal place for Canadians to buy a second home. This week, Canada-based Coldwell Banker President Susan Taddieag came to Phoenix to talk with local real estate agents about how to attract Canadian buyers. Real estate agents said that there are two main conditions for Arizona to attract Canadian home buyers: First, the weather (the current Albert province is only about 20 degrees Fahrenheit); second, the price. As we all know, Arizona is the hardest hit area for foreclosures in the United States. The price of a house of the same size in Phoenix may be only one-third of that in Canada. In addition, many Canadian seniors have the tradition of flying south to Arizona for the winter, although for a period of time the Canadian government cut welfare, keeping these birds away from the warm Phoenix. But the baby boomers have inherited a fortune from their grandparents, the Canadian dollar is strong, and the Canadian economy is strong, which are advantages for Canadian buyers. Agents say that most current Canadian buyers are 50 to 60 years old and prefer to use cash. The new trend is for several people to jointly purchase a house and use it as a vacation home together. Dediag said that 90% of Canadian buyers like to choose a house online, and then learn about the property through video. It is likely that even the transaction process is completed online, and then they come over for vacation with their suitcases in hand. Where can I find such buyers?
