5ffa5a5822dbd843972cee885393525a7cb0765d.sourceText: 美国历史上第一个华裔能源部长朱棣文，目前面临人生最大的考验。
5ffa5a5822dbd843972cee885393525a7cb0765d.translatedText: Chu, the first Chinese-American Energy Secretary in the history of the United States, is currently facing the biggest test in his life.

7e4bf5a495bef41028c14c93900fe276dd8dc476.sourceText: 17日是令他难忘的一天。大概从未有这麽多人，在同一天问他是否应该下台谢罪。
7e4bf5a495bef41028c14c93900fe276dd8dc476.translatedText: The 17th was an unforgettable day for him. Probably never before have so many people asked him on the same day whether he should step down and apologize.

14a1e8c405ef7481ad9971735e1be8ca18fcfb3b.sourceText: 朱棣文17日出席国会众能源委员会院的调查小组委员会，就曾被欧巴马政府当作创造就业样板的Solyndra太阳能板公司倒闭案举行的听证会。包括主席在内的多位共和党议员，当场指朱棣文明显违法，问朱棣文是否应下台谢罪，并向美国人民道歉。
14a1e8c405ef7481ad9971735e1be8ca18fcfb3b.translatedText: > On the 17th, Steven Chu attended the House of Representatives’ House of Representatives’ Investigative Subcommittee’s hearing on the collapse of Solyndra solar panel company, which was once used as a model for job creation by the Obama administration. Many Republican congressmen, including the chairman, pointed out on the spot that Steven Chu had clearly violated the law, and asked Steven Chu whether he should step down to apologize and apologize to the American people.

ccfa52ddc02ba29de1bb3a90154e58a431f111ea.sourceText: 朱棣文被质疑的，主要是该信贷的合法性，以及其中隐瞒公司财务状况的政治操作。
ccfa52ddc02ba29de1bb3a90154e58a431f111ea.translatedText: > What Zhu Diwen was questioned was mainly the legality of the credit and the political operation to conceal the company's financial status.

673e29a8a309cf59f066f5935ab420a60c78cc10.sourceText: Solyndra公司主要投资人奥克拉荷马州石油大亨凯瑟(George Kaiser)，是欧巴马总统的金主，欧巴马访问Solyndra时，曾被要求联邦政府採用该公司的产品，欧巴马表示将考虑。
673e29a8a309cf59f066f5935ab420a60c78cc10.translatedText: > Solyndra's main investor, Oklahoma oil tycoon George Kaiser, is a financial backer of President Obama. When Obama visited Solyndra, he was asked that the federal government adopt the company's products, and Obama said he would consider it.

06fdc79c4c01131016426e0b4a6558d1ed250475.sourceText: 朱棣文17日坚持他的清白，表示Solyndra信贷的决定未受白宫影响，而贷款本来就存在风险，当初评估的风险只有7.8%。
06fdc79c4c01131016426e0b4a6558d1ed250475.translatedText: > Steven Chu insisted on his innocence on the 17th, saying that the Solyndra credit decision was not affected by the White House, and that loans are inherently risky, with the original risk assessment being only 7.8%.

8ef3663c2f366fc33a242fc3c10680b22244b34c.sourceText: 共和党议员于听证会对朱棣文穷追猛打，认为朱棣文不可能一个人被蒙在鼓里。民主党议员则尽量为他护航，场面充满火药味。听证会由上午10时一直进行到下午2时许，主席史登斯(Cliff Sterans)仍然没有喊停的意思。民主党议员不满听证会中各议员反覆询问同样的问题，表示不如让朱棣文将来以书面答覆，民主党议员主张应该结束听证，史登斯则要投票决定。后来双方妥协，听证会于下午4时前结束。
8ef3663c2f366fc33a242fc3c10680b22244b34c.translatedText: Republican congressmen pursued Steven Chu fiercely during the hearing, believing that Steven Chu could not be kept in the dark alone. Democratic congressmen tried their best to protect him, and the scene was full of gunpowder. The hearing lasted from 10 a.m. to about 2 p.m., and Chairman Cliff Sterans still had no intention of stopping. Democratic congressmen were dissatisfied with the fact that congressmen repeatedly asked the same questions during the hearing, saying that it would be better to let Steven Chu give a written answer in the future. Democratic congressmen advocated that the hearing should be ended, and Stearns wanted to vote. Later, the two sides compromised and the hearing ended before 4 p.m.

1a66d88a44e0ced1c49821f93eb446d7a0613a9a.sourceText: 欧巴马政府已释出10馀万页以电邮为主的Solyndra公司相关资料，而共和党议员仍继续调查。
1a66d88a44e0ced1c49821f93eb446d7a0613a9a.translatedText: The Obama administration has released more than 100,000 pages of Solyndra-related information, mainly emails, while Republican lawmakers continue to investigate.

b0a417cc478ee947730d0096142ee3865d9aab87.sourceText: 朱棣文17日在国会仍然陈述他的理想。他说他当初离开史丹福大学，转任美国能源部下属劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室主任，是领导研究如何利用生物将太阳能转化为能源。
b0a417cc478ee947730d0096142ee3865d9aab87.translatedText: > Steven Chu still stated his ideals in Congress on the 17th. He said that when he left Stanford University and became the director of the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory under the U.S. Department of Energy, he was leading research on how to use organisms to convert solar energy into energy.

8d3ab4a791cfd4e07312d08d94774c6721dbc9b0.sourceText: 朱棣文当初风风光光的来到华府，大家都赞赏他最聪明。而现在不只是共和党议员攻击他，「欧巴马2008年竞选阵营研究主任」凯洛(Dan Carol)在今年2月发出的电邮，早已建议欧巴马将他及其他能源部高级主管撤换，要弃车保帅。
8d3ab4a791cfd4e07312d08d94774c6721dbc9b0.translatedText: Steven Chu came to Washington in glory, and everyone praised him as the smartest. And now it's not just Republican lawmakers who are attacking him. Dan Carol, "Obama's 2008 campaign research director," sent an email in February this year, already suggesting that Obama should replace him and other senior Department of Energy executives in order to keep him in charge.

53331bc326be8cc593bd8cc7f4bb763b212bbc78.sourceText: 明年是大选年，华府的气氛越来越政治对立。共和党人不会放弃能够打击民主党人的机会，欧巴马政府仅存的华裔部长朱棣文能否全身而退，也是各界瞩目的焦点。
53331bc326be8cc593bd8cc7f4bb763b212bbc78.translatedText: Next year is an election year, and the atmosphere in Washington is becoming increasingly politically confrontational. Republicans will not give up the opportunity to attack the Democrats. Whether Steven Chu, the only remaining Chinese-American minister in the Obama administration, can escape unscathed is also the focus of attention from all walks of life.

But we Chinese hope to enhance friendship and organize a Thanksgiving mountain climbing activity to share the joy of outdoor sports and Chinese food. Climbing South Mountain (South Mountain) at 10 a.m. on November 24th. Time: 10:00 a.m. on November 24th

2ce62cf9a221918407dfd7105ea7cd71e198142f.sourceText: 感恩节抢购 做好功课 今年感恩节后、25日的「黑色星期五」，各大商场如Macy’s、Target等首次将开门时间提前到午夜1​​2时，提前感受到今年黑色星期五抢购的火药味。 商家在网路和广告上撒下各种诱人的购物广告，消费者自然心动，但如何能在抢购大军中保持完胜，就需要策略。 有多年抢deal经验的Almanda说，经济不景气，大家都想买到便宜又好的东西，想先抢到好货，首先要熟悉战场地形，她建议周三先去商家暗访，如是第一次去 ，更要看好停车位置，避免当天为找车位浪费最佳时刻。 其次看好想买东西所在的位置，还要根据当天各个商家开门的时间，决定当日抢购的先后顺序。 阿罕布拉市纪先生说，星期五抢购要多做功课，购买方式也要有策略。 尽量选择地点偏远店铺，虽花费较多开车时间，但人少，竞争少，抢到好东西的机会就更高。 有人曾在驱车30哩外的Walmart买到不少好康货。 他说，现在不少商家都有网路促销，为避免当天去实体店家买到比网路上贵的产品，可将网路产品折扣和广告先作比较。 黑色星期五的抢购战同样发生在网路，不少商家在网路上设定抢购时限，如想领先对手，一定要确保网速够快，检查好电脑对插件有无安全限制，避免抢购当天出现页面打 不开的现象。 最好事先检查浏览该网站是否顺畅，另外要检查是否对新注册的用户有优惠，如果有，可再注册一个新帐号。 罗斯密何小姐曾在某名牌网站抢购一个钱包，因电脑临时出状况，商品总是放不到购物车，几秒之差，就被别的用户抢先，后悔不已。 如果目标是家庭电器，要想志在必得，除了早早排队，还要全家出动，不仅能分头抢购不同种类的产品，如事先安排一个人排好付钱队伍，还省时省力。 此外，既然是抢购高峰，最诱人的促销商品一定最多竞争对手，如果不是排在队伍前端，很可能失之交臂。 最好事先准备B计画，看是否还有其他东西值得此时购买，免得浪费排队时间。 另外一项抢购撇步是用信用卡付账挣积分，如Chase、Citi等信用卡都有购物退款和开卡送现金的活动，有的信用卡还在11月和12月的消费季，对指定商品种类 提供5%的退款。 且一些信用卡提供退货保证和价格保证，如果60天内所买的商品降价，信用卡公司会退还差价。 抢购前准备打折的礼品卡（Gift Card），建议可到Plastic Jungle.com ，Giftcards.com和CardPool.com等网站看百货公司如Target或Macy’s，及Bestbuy或Walmart常有折扣GiftCard出售，折扣3% 到25%不等。 在抢购前如能找到，保证买到最接近成本价的产品。
2ce62cf9a221918407dfd7105ea7cd71e198142f.translatedText: Do your homework for Thanksgiving shopping. This year’s “Black Friday” on the 25th after Thanksgiving, major shopping malls such as Macy’s and Target have moved their opening hours to 12 midnight for the first time, allowing them to feel the excitement of this year’s Black Friday shopping in advance. Merchants are spreading all kinds of tempting shopping advertisements on the Internet and in advertisements, and consumers are naturally attracted to them. However, how to maintain victory in the rush to buy requires strategies. Almanda, who has many years of experience in deal hunting, said that during the economic downturn, everyone wants to buy cheap and good things. If you want to grab good goods first, you must first be familiar with the terrain of the battlefield. She recommends going to the merchant for an unannounced visit on Wednesday. If it is your first time, you should also be optimistic about the parking location to avoid wasting the best time on the day to find a parking space. Secondly, look at the location of the things you want to buy, and decide the order of buying that day based on the opening hours of each merchant on that day. Mr. Ji, the mayor of Alhambra, said that people who rush to buy on Fridays need to do more homework and buy strategically. Try to choose stores in remote locations. Although it takes more driving time, there are fewer people and less competition, so the chance of grabbing good stuff is higher. Someone once bought a lot of good stuff at Walmart 30 miles away. He said that many merchants now have online promotions. To avoid going to physical stores on the same day and buying products that are more expensive than online, you can first compare online product discounts with advertisements. The Black Friday buying war also takes place online. Many merchants set time limits for buying online. If you want to stay ahead of your competitors, you must ensure that your internet speed is fast enough and check whether your computer has any security restrictions on plug-ins to avoid the page being unable to open on the day of the sale. It is best to check in advance whether browsing the website is smooth, and also check whether there are any discounts for newly registered users. If so, you can register a new account. Ms. Rosmiho once snapped up a wallet on a famous brand website. Due to a temporary computer problem, the items could not be placed in the shopping cart. Within seconds, other users had preempted her. She regretted it. If the target is home appliances, if you want to be sure to get them, in addition to lining up early, you also need to go out with the whole family. Not only can you buy different types of products separately, but also by arranging one person to queue up in advance to pay, it also saves time and effort. In addition, since it is the rush to buy, the most attractive promotional products must have the most competitors. If you are not at the front of the queue, you may miss it. It’s best to prepare a plan B in advance to see if there is anything else worth buying at this time to avoid wasting time in line. Another way to rush shopping is to earn points by paying with credit cards. Credit cards such as Chase and Citi offer refunds for purchases and free cash upon opening the card. Some credit cards also provide 5% refunds on designated product types during the consumption season in November and December. And some credit cards provide return guarantees and price guarantees. If the price of the goods purchased within 60 days drops, the credit card company will refund the price difference. Prepare discounted gift cards before rushing to buy them. It is recommended to go to websites such as Plastic Jungle.com, Giftcards.com and CardPool.com to see that department stores such as Target or Macy’s, Bestbuy or Walmart often sell discounted Gift Cards, with discounts ranging from 3% to 25%. If you can find it before the rush, you are guaranteed to get the product closest to the cost price.

f822bd45bc1a8d7cd7260292679e8fb0d25b4b9b.sourceText: 主题： Developing Standards-based and Culture/Content-Rich Curricular Themes for Chinese Learners 主讲人：Shuhan Wang 博士 ， 马里兰 大学 国家 外语中心 （ NFLC ） 副 主任 。 日期： 2011年 12月4日 ， 星期日 时间：上午9:00 至下午3:00 地点 ： 亚利桑那州立大学 坦佩 校园 ， MU， Turquoise Room 220室 在 这次教师培训 中 ， 王教授 将首先讨论 一个概念性的框架 ， 采用 标准 ，文化和 内容 。 她 将 分享 她的看法 如何 转化为 课程与教学 5Cs 。 与会者将有 机会去 通过 步骤去实现这些课外的主题 。 在 研讨会结束 时 ，与会者 将 能够解释 一个基于标准的 和文化 / 内容丰富 的 课外 主题 是 什么 ， 确定 这样一个主题 的 基本要素 ， 为 中国 的语言学习者， 通过这些 步骤 去 发展 其他 课程主题 。 此活动 是 由 亚利桑那州立大学 孔子学院 主办 ， 并 免费 向公众开放 。 将供应 早餐和午餐 。 请回信到董 志新 邮箱zhixin.dong @ asu.edu.
f822bd45bc1a8d7cd7260292679e8fb0d25b4b9b.translatedText: Topic: Developing Standards-based and/Content-Rich Curricular Themes for Chinese Culture Learners Lecturer: Dr. Shuhan Wang, University of Maryland Deputy Director of the National Foreign Language Center (NFLC). Date: Sunday, December 4, 2011 Time: 9:00 am to 3:00 pm Location: Arizona State University Tempe Campus, MU, Turquoise Room 220 In this teacher training, Professor Wang will first discuss a conceptual framework that adopts standards, culture, and content. She will share her thoughts on how to translate into the 5Cs of Curriculum and Instruction. Attendees will have the opportunity to go through the steps to implement these extracurricular themes. By the end of the workshop, participants will be able to explain what a standards-based and culturally/content-rich extracurricular topic is, identify the essential elements of such a topic for Chinese language learners, and go through these steps to develop other curriculum topics. This event is hosted by the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University and is free and open to the public. Breakfast and lunch will be served. Please reply to Dong Zhixin at zhixin.dong @ asu.edu.

9932739d2be5299a95316683fcdda09083b2649e.sourceText: 同一麦当劳遭3贼抢两次 贼笨还是… 警方正寻求公众帮助，找出20天内连续抢劫同一家麦当劳的三名嫌疑人。 位于Chandler Boulevard和Kyrene Road交界的麦当劳第一次被三名疑犯抢劫于10月27日凌晨3:30左右，第二次劫案发生在11月12日凌晨5时。被劫数目不详。两次的作案者均带万圣节面具，一辆红色的丰田四门卡车作为逃走工具。警方相信是同一批贼人作案。 第一嫌疑人被形容为白色或西班牙裔男性，5.5–5.7英尺身高，身形粗壮。第二个嫌疑人被描述为黑人男性，身高5.4?.6英尺，身材瘦削。第三个嫌疑人被描述为一个西班牙裔男性，身高5.6?.7英尺，中等身材和板寸头发型。他的左鼻孔穿有黄金箍耳环，左耳上部有一个金属棒。 与有关犯罪嫌疑人或车辆的信息，任何人都问钱德勒警察局480-782-4130联络。
9932739d2be5299a95316683fcdda09083b2649e.translatedText: The same McDonald's was robbed twice by three thieves. The thieves are still stupid... The police are seeking the public's help to identify three suspects who robbed the same McDonald's within 20 days. The McDonald's located at the intersection of Chandler Boulevard and Kyrene Road was first robbed by three suspects around 3:30 a.m. on October 27, and the second robbery occurred at 5 a.m. on November 12. The number of people robbed is unknown. The perpetrators in both cases wore Halloween masks and used a red Toyota four-door truck as a getaway vehicle. The police believe that the same group of thieves committed the crime. The first suspect is described as a white or Hispanic male, 5.5-5.7 feet tall, with a stocky build. The second suspect is described as a black male, 5'4" and 6" tall with a slim build. The third suspect is described as a Hispanic male, 5.6-7 feet tall, with a medium build and a short-cut hair style. He has a gold hoop earring pierced through his left nostril and a metal rod above his left ear. Anyone with information about the suspect or vehicle is asked to contact the Chandler Police Department at 480-782-4130.

405f14cb7570a0f9f8b900d94fa742e8ce6813af.sourceText: 本地华裔小学生梁嘉恩，今年十一岁，就读Gilbert市小学六年级，自己创作的两首音乐作品，荣获2012 年金键盘音乐节国际钢琴作曲比赛少年组第三名​。
405f14cb7570a0f9f8b900d94fa742e8ce6813af.translatedText: Local Chinese primary school student Liang Jiaen is 11 years old and studying in the sixth grade of Gilbert City Elementary School. Two musical works he composed by himself won the third place in the youth category of the 2012 Golden Keyboard Music Festival International Piano Composition Competition​.

1a695568731421165e2555b91dbc524278289afe.sourceText: 金键盘音乐节国际钢琴作曲比赛是一个非常着名的国际钢琴作曲比赛，有来自世界各地的参赛者。参赛者包括许多各国音乐学院学生，其中包括俄罗斯、中国、美国和欧盟国家，竞争非常激烈。金键盘音乐节国际钢琴作曲比赛旨在鼓励学生作曲家创意和自我发挥，得奖人受邀去奥地利维也纳，参加世界青少年作曲家颁奖典礼，并于颁奖典礼现场表演得奖作品。此外，他们也会参与为期一週的金键盘音乐节，享有额外的演出机会，并安排聆听大师级音乐教授的授课。
1a695568731421165e2555b91dbc524278289afe.translatedText: The Golden Keyboard Music Festival International Piano Composition Competition is a very famous international piano composition competition with contestants from all over the world. The contestants include students from conservatories from many countries, including Russia, China, the United States and EU countries, and the competition is very fierce. The Golden Keyboard Music Festival International Piano Composition Competition aims to encourage the creativity and self-expression of student composers. The winners are invited to Vienna, Austria, to participate in the World Young Composers Award Ceremony, and perform the winning compositions live at the award ceremony. In addition, they will also participate in the week-long Golden Keyboard Music Festival, enjoy additional performance opportunities, and be arranged to listen to lessons from master music professors.

968736df6d2406e67565c219e14a13674cf6581e.sourceText: 梁嘉恩从小就展现不凡的音乐天赋，三岁开始上音乐课，五岁开始上钢琴课，并创作了她第一首原创曲。此后，她每年都有一部创作参赛 Yamaha Music School 的青少年原创曲作曲比赛，并于 2010 及 2011年连续两年，拿下幼年组西区冠军。
968736df6d2406e67565c219e14a13674cf6581e.translatedText: Liang Jiaen has shown extraordinary musical talent since she was a child. She started taking music lessons at the age of three and piano lessons at the age of five, and composed her first original song. Since then, she has participated in the Yamaha Music School Youth Original Song Composition Competition every year, and won the West Region Championship in the Junior Category for two consecutive years in 2010 and 2011.

259f50cf837879f44db0b14d83153799b9f0716e.sourceText: 除了钢琴，梁嘉恩也有参加学校的管弦乐队，拉的是低音提琴。此外，梁嘉恩还在她教会，担任儿童合唱团的钢琴伴奏。这是她在教会服侍的第二年。她也多次在教会礼拜中演奏钢琴，以音乐来服侍神​。
259f50cf837879f44db0b14d83153799b9f0716e.translatedText: In addition to the piano, Liang Jiaen also participated in the school orchestra, playing the double bass. In addition, Liang Jiaen also serves as a piano accompanist for the children's choir in her church. This is her second year serving at the church. She also played the piano many times in church services to serve God with music.

788c3fddc66a0616c5260066e3d183325dbf3ef3.sourceText: 梁嘉恩音乐之外的兴趣，包括绘画，手工艺，阅读，电脑游戏，空手道及摺纸。问她长大想做什麽，她说她想成为电脑游戏艺术家，因为这样她可以在工作中创作及游戏。
788c3fddc66a0616c5260066e3d183325dbf3ef3.translatedText: Liang Jiaen’s interests outside of music include painting, handicrafts, reading, computer games, karate and origami. When asked what she wanted to be when she grew up, she said she wanted to be a computer game artist so she could create and play games at work.

ee0a3be0b44626f955c086461f92fde8f813d4ff.sourceText: 梁嘉恩也是凤城华人基督教会中文学校正体班学生，在校品学兼优，参加各项学校比赛，均有杰出表现。
ee0a3be0b44626f955c086461f92fde8f813d4ff.translatedText: >Liang Jiaen is also a student in the Chinese Language and Physical Education class of Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church. He has excellent academic performance in school and has participated in various school competitions with outstanding performance.

2c0f6f53c5c77de7a621b3a5d26465500eaa4338.sourceText: 中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆举行2012年春节招待会(组图) (亚省华联供稿) 2012年1月18日晚，中国驻洛杉矶总领事邱绍芳在总领事馆举行了2012年春节招待会。总领事邱绍芳、副总领事卞立新、孙伟德和全体总领事馆馆员、以及来自领区各界的华侨华人代表出席了招待会。 亚省华联董事长、会长费健和董事陶世诚代表亚省华联应邀出席了这次招待会并拜访了各位外交官。在与邱绍芳总领事和总领事馆馆员的交谈中，向他们简要汇报了亚省华联过去一年来在社区所做的工作和开展的活动，并希望进一步得到总领事馆对亚省华联工作的支持。在侨社事务中，若总领事馆有什么需要帮助的地方，亚省华联会尽力协助。同时，也借此机会，邀请邱总领事和总领事馆的外交官来凤凰城出席亚省第六届庆中秋迎国庆系列活动。 邱绍芳总领事在致辞中简要地向来宾介绍了总领事馆在过去一年中所开展的工作，回顾了2011年中国在经济、社会发展和外交工作中所取得的成就，以及中国在国际事务中所发挥的积极作用。他对广大华侨华人为促进中美友谊和文化交流所做的努力和贡献表示感谢，并向领区所有侨胞、留学人员和各界友人致以热烈的春节问候和美好祝愿。他还表示，总领事馆将进一步秉承”以人为本，为侨服务”的宗旨，继续关心侨胞的生活和支持侨胞在当地的发展，努力维护侨胞在美的合法权益，为推动中美两国在各领域的务实合作和健康发展做出应有的努力。 招待会现场充满了浓郁的乡情和友情，来宾们互道新年问候。春节招待会在洋溢着热烈祥和的气氛下圆满结束。 左起：亚省华联董事长、会长费健、邱绍芳总领事夫妇、陶世诚 费健与卞立新副总领事合影 费健与副总领事孙伟德合影 左起：陶世诚，侨务组王鹏领事，费健 孙伟德副总领事（右）与张华芳（中）原中国中央乐团首席小提琴现旅居凤凰城 的邱澜（左）亲切交谈
2c0f6f53c5c77de7a621b3a5d26465500eaa4338.translatedText: The Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles held a 2012 Spring Festival Reception (Photos) (Contributed by Alberta Hualian) On the evening of January 18, 2012, Qiu Shaofang, Consul General of China in Los Angeles, held a 2012 Spring Festival reception at the Consulate General. Consul General Qiu Shaofang, Deputy Consuls General Bian Lixin, Sun Weide, all members of the Consulate General, and representatives of overseas Chinese from all walks of life in the consular district attended the reception. On behalf of Alberta Hualian, Fei Jian, chairman and chairman, and Tao Shicheng, director, were invited to attend the reception and visited the diplomats. During the conversation with Consul General Qiu Shaofang and the staff of the Consulate General, I briefly reported to them the work and activities carried out by the Hualien of Alberta in the community in the past year, and hoped to receive further support from the Consulate General for the work of the Hualian of Alberta. In the affairs of overseas Chinese communities, if the Consulate General needs help, the Chinese Federation of Alberta will try its best to assist. At the same time, we also took this opportunity to invite Consul General Qiu and diplomats from the Consulate General to Phoenix to attend the sixth Alberta Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day series of events. In his speech, Consul General Qiu Shaofang briefly introduced the work carried out by the Consulate General in the past year to the guests, reviewed China's achievements in economic, social development and diplomatic work in 2011, as well as China's positive role in international affairs. He expressed his gratitude to the overseas Chinese for their efforts and contributions to promoting Sino-US friendship and cultural exchanges, and extended warm Spring Festival greetings and best wishes to all overseas Chinese, overseas students and friends from all walks of life in the consular district. He also said that the Consulate General will further adhere to the purpose of "people-oriented and serve overseas Chinese", continue to care about the lives of overseas Chinese and support their local development, strive to safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of overseas Chinese in the United States, and make due efforts to promote pragmatic cooperation and healthy development between China and the United States in various fields. The reception was full of strong nostalgia and friendship, and the guests exchanged New Year greetings. The Spring Festival reception ended successfully in a warm and peaceful atmosphere. From the left: Fei Jian, chairman and president of the Hualian Association of Alberta, Consul General Qiu Shaofang and his wife, Tao Shicheng. Fei Jian takes a photo with Deputy Consul General Bian Lixin. Fei Jian takes a photo with Deputy Consul General Sun Weide. From left: Tao Shicheng, Consul Wang Peng of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Section, Fei Jian, Deputy Consul General Sun Weide (right) and Zhang Huafang (middle), former chief violinist of the China Central Orchestra, and Qiu Lan (left), who now lives in Phoenix, have a cordial conversation.

b3e7331dd14f22bc9836c44f93f7f750b78feef3.sourceText: 2. ”新欧洲”不再爱恋欧元 两年前，加入欧元区被当做解决东欧国家债务忧虑的灵丹妙药。然而拥有10年历史的欧元遇到的更大的麻烦，希腊和意大利等国遇到严重的债务问题，使得欧盟遇到很大挑战，目前那些曾经一直试图加入欧元区的东欧国家也开始动摇是否加入或加入的时间。 波兰本该在2012年加入欧元区，但这一进程被无限期搁置了。4月份，保加利亚的中右翼政府推迟了2013年加入欧元区的计划，说还要再考虑。罗马尼亚总统也说，2015年加入欧元区的计划要推迟”一、两年”。拉脱维亚和立陶宛本来热衷于在爱沙尼亚后加入欧元区，但现在两国都表示，目前的时间表有点不切实际，立陶宛央行行长也警告说，欧元区成员地位”不是得不到就得死”。 3. 墨西哥毒品战争蔓延至中美洲 墨西哥北部边境的毒品暴力已经成为美国面临的主要政治问题，但是冲突给南部国家带来的灾难性后果却较少获得重视。锡那罗亚（Sinaloa）和泽塔斯（Zetas） 等贩毒集团的黑帮为了躲避墨西哥政府的打击，一直试图开辟新领域，它们在政治动荡的中美洲开了更多的毒品商店。 目前，中美洲的7个国家全部都登上了白宫制定的主要贩毒国名单。据美国国会研究服务中心报告显示，经墨西哥进入美国的可卡因有60%首先要经过中美洲国家。在过去5年中，这7个国家中有4个国家的杀人案件发生率大幅上升，在洪都拉斯翻了一番还多。 5 月份，危地马拉见证了1996年内战后最惨烈的大屠杀，27人在该国北部遭到贩毒黑帮斩首。整个地区基本上都处于墨西哥第二大贩毒集团泽塔斯的控制之下， 这个组织拥有机关枪、火箭弹，甚至自己还在丛林里建了飞机跑道。今年初的几个月里，危地马拉政府对墨西哥贩毒集团展开了大规模武装清剿，但是失败了。有很多报导说，危地马拉官员接受了贩毒集团的回扣，或者参与了贩毒活动。 截至目前，可卡因只在能够种植古柯叶的南美洲安第斯地区生产。但是在3月份，在洪都拉斯发现了第一个可卡因加工实验室。而犯罪率猛增的萨尔瓦多，锡那罗亚和泽塔斯据信与当地黑帮建立了联系，如臭名昭著的马拉萨尔瓦杜恰（Mara Salvatrucha）集团。 4. 骆驼数量锐减 联合国粮农组织报告，沙特肉用骆驼的存栏量从1997年的42.6万头下降到现在的26万头，降幅39%；巴基斯坦的骆驼数量现在已经降至70万头。从1994年到2004年，亚洲骆驼数量总数下降了20%。 在饱受饥荒困扰的索马里，有报导称，这些可用于为许多家庭提供运输、生计或者食物的骆驼大量死亡，一些部落里的人报告说他们损失了一半的骆驼。在非洲以前的 饥荒中，骆驼被视为人类死亡的早期信号。一位索马里老人2009年对联合国综合区域信息网（IRIN）说：”骆驼是最后死亡的动物，一旦骆驼开始死亡，人 开始死亡就只是时间问题了。”
b3e7331dd14f22bc9836c44f93f7f750b78feef3.translatedText: 2. The “New Europe” is no longer in love with the euro. Two years ago, joining the Eurozone was regarded as a panacea to solve the debt worries of Eastern European countries. However, the 10-year-old euro has encountered greater troubles. Countries such as Greece and Italy have encountered serious debt problems, which has caused the EU to encounter great challenges. Currently, those Eastern European countries that have been trying to join the euro area are also beginning to waver on whether to join or when to join. Poland was supposed to join the euro in 2012, but the process has been put on hold indefinitely. In April, Bulgaria's center-right government postponed its plan to join the euro zone in 2013, saying it would have to reconsider. Romania's president also said that the plan to join the euro zone in 2015 will be postponed for "one or two years." Latvia and Lithuania were originally keen to join the euro zone after Estonia, but now both countries say the current timetable is a bit unrealistic, and the governor of Lithuania's central bank has warned that euro zone membership is "do or die". 3. Mexico’s drug war spreads to Central America. Drug violence on Mexico’s northern border has become a major political issue facing the United States, but the disastrous consequences of the conflict on southern countries have received less attention. Cartel gangs such as the Sinaloa and Zetas have been trying to break into new territories as they evade crackdowns by the Mexican government, opening more drug shops in politically turbulent Central America. Currently, all seven Central American countries are on the White House’s list of major drug trafficking countries. According to a report by the U.S. Congressional Research Service, 60% of cocaine entering the United States through Mexico first passes through Central American countries. Over the past five years, homicide rates have increased significantly in four of the seven countries, more than doubling in Honduras. In May, Guatemala witnessed its worst massacre since the 1996 civil war, when 27 people were beheaded by drug gangs in the north of the country. The entire area is basically under the control of the Zetas, Mexico's second-largest drug cartel. This organization has machine guns, rockets, and even built its own airstrip in the jungle. In the early months of this year, the Guatemalan government launched a large-scale armed crackdown on Mexican drug cartels, but it failed. There have been numerous reports that Guatemalan officials accepted kickbacks from drug cartels or were involved in drug trafficking. As of now, cocaine is only produced in the Andean regions of South America where coca leaves can be grown. But in March, the first cocaine processing laboratory was discovered in Honduras. El Salvador, where crime rates have soared, Sinaloa and the Zetas are believed to have established ties with local gangs, such as the notorious Mara Salvatrucha group. 4. The number of camels has dropped sharply. The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations reported that the number of meat camels in Saudi Arabia has dropped from 426,000 in 1997 to 260,000 now, a decrease of 39%; the number of camels in Pakistan has now dropped to 700,000. From 1994 to 2004, the total camel population in Asia fell by 20%. In famine-stricken Somalia, there are reports of mass die-offs of the camels that provide transportation, livelihood or food for many families, with some tribesmen reporting losing half of their herds. In previous famines in Africa, camels were seen as an early sign of human death. An old Somali man told the United Nations Integrated Regional Information Network (IRIN) in 2009: "Camels are the last animals to die. Once camels start dying, it is only a matter of time before people start dying."

060b2706f2ae231b54db234b886a1ab65c6f544a.sourceText: 5. 美国打击非法移民 2012年美国共和党总统候选人正在争论谁能够更好地保卫美墨边境，同时也在批评各州向非法移民提供服务，而正当此时，白宫正在悄悄地对非法移民活动展开有史以来最严厉的打击。虽然奥巴马曾承诺进行全面的移民改革（对此国会不断作梗），遣返数量还是达到了历史最高值。 2010 年，美国破记录地遣返了39.2万名非法外国人，而在过去的这个财年里，遣返数量接近40万。截至10月，奥巴马政府已经累计遣返了将近120万人，而小布什政府在8年中才一共遣返了150万人。奥巴马政府还对雇佣非法移民的雇主进行了打击。对比奥巴马政府的第一年和小布什政府的最后一年，受到调查的企业数量增加了一倍。 6. 巴基斯坦的另外一场战争 俾路支省是巴基斯坦面积最大的省，占到该国国土面积的48%，该地区是分离主义组织暴力活动最活跃的地区（有时称作巴基斯坦的秘密战争），却远不如该国的其它危机那样吸引眼球。 在俾路支省，主要天然气管线多次发生爆炸，杀害旁遮普省移民的事时有发生，还时有对政要及石油公司员工的暗杀事件。 2010年，巴基斯坦政府对俾路支省军事打击也非常残酷，这一趋势也延续到了2011年。一份”人权观察”的报告显示，在今年1月到6月，可能由巴基斯坦安全部队实施的”杀戮并抛弃”行动中，有150人丧生，他们大多是俾路支分离势力中的年轻人。 总部位于省政府奎达（Quetta）的塔利班在该国与阿富汗800英里长的边境自由出入。这个人烟稀少的地区也成为了走私贩和伊朗反叛组织的避风港。
060b2706f2ae231b54db234b886a1ab65c6f544a.translatedText: 5. The United States cracks down on illegal immigration. In 2012, the Republican presidential candidates in the United States are debating who can better protect the U.S.-Mexico border, and are also criticizing states for providing services to illegal immigrants. At this time, the White House is quietly launching the toughest crackdown on illegal immigration in history. Despite Obama's promise of comprehensive immigration reform (which Congress has repeatedly blocked), deportations have reached an all-time high. In 2010, the United States deported a record 392,000 illegal aliens, and this past fiscal year, the number was nearly 400,000. As of October, the Obama administration had repatriated nearly 1.2 million people, while the Bush administration had repatriated a total of 1.5 million people in eight years. The Obama administration has also cracked down on employers who hire illegal immigrants. Comparing the first year of the Obama administration to the last year of the George W. Bush administration, the number of companies surveyed doubled. 6. Another war in Pakistan Balochistan is Pakistan’s largest province, accounting for 48% of the country’s land area. This region is the most active area of ​​violent activities by separatist groups (sometimes called Pakistan’s secret war), but it is far less eye-catching than other crises in the country. In Balochistan, major natural gas pipelines have exploded several times, killings of immigrants from Punjab have occurred, and there have been assassinations of political figures and oil company employees. In 2010, the Pakistani government also carried out very brutal military strikes against Balochistan, and this trend continued into 2011. A Human Rights Watch report shows that from January to June this year, 150 people were killed in "kill and abandon" operations possibly carried out by Pakistani security forces. Most of them were young people from the Baloch separatist forces. The Taliban, based in the provincial government of Quetta, have free access to the country's 800-mile border with Afghanistan. The sparsely populated area has also become a haven for smugglers and Iranian rebel groups.

15f06b8987c649a2b584fa06f770c30f4cae9e0a.sourceText: 7. 海盗全球化 截至2011年10月份，索马里海盗已经发起了199次攻击，而去年同期只有126次。但不幸的是，尽管人们认为近年来海盗已经在其它地区得到遏制，但海盗也没有局限在亚丁湾，全球海盗正在大幅反弹。 今年，石油资源丰富的几内亚湾海盗案例大幅飙升。2011年贝宁沿岸地区有19次海盗袭击报导，而2010年一起都没有。此外，尼日利亚沿岸发生了6起，加纳沿岸发生了3起，而且似乎还有更多案例没有报导。 西非的海盗相比索马里海盗更加传统，他们倾向于抢劫船上货物而不是绑架勒索。同时，印度尼西亚国际商会今年报告，海盗袭击达到了2007年以来的最高点。即使是在从没听说过海盗事件的秘鲁，今年还发生了一起针对日本拖网渔船的袭击，实施袭击的犯罪集团自称”海上强盗”。 据统计，今年前9个月，全球已经发生352起海盗事件，创下历史记录。
15f06b8987c649a2b584fa06f770c30f4cae9e0a.translatedText: 7. Globalization of Piracy As of October 2011, Somali pirates have launched 199 attacks, compared with only 126 in the same period last year. But unfortunately, although it is believed that piracy has been curbed in other areas in recent years, piracy is not limited to the Gulf of Aden, and global piracy is rebounding significantly. Piracy cases in the oil-rich Gulf of Guinea have soared this year. There were 19 reported pirate attacks off the coast of Benin in 2011, compared with none in 2010. In addition, six cases occurred off the coast of Nigeria and three off the coast of Ghana, and there appear to be many more cases that have not been reported. West African pirates are more traditional than Somali pirates and tend to rob ships rather than kidnap for ransom. Meanwhile, the Indonesian Chamber of International Commerce reported this year that pirate attacks were at their highest level since 2007. Even in Peru, which has never heard of piracy, there was an attack on a Japanese trawler this year. The criminal group that carried out the attack called itself "Sea Bandits." According to statistics, in the first nine months of this year, 352 piracy incidents occurred around the world, setting a historical record.

11b681f178fafb4a0405c337b84b6f5b9983968c.sourceText: 今年感恩节民众消费力破纪录，成为继2007年以来最高消费的一年，全民在24日至27日四天消费520亿元，为年底消费季开启好兆头。 美国全国零售联盟(National Retail Federation）称，在24日至27日四天里，有2亿2260万消费者进入实体店铺和在线消费，比去年同期增加1400万名消费者。 据BIGresearch的调查显示，感恩节期间消费者预计消费520亿元，每位消费者在该周末平均消费398.62元，比去年的365.34元增长近30元。 网路消费的平均额是150.53元，预计在网络星期一会继续增加。 阿罕布拉居民程小姐特别在24日和25日定期刷新网页，就为买到划算的产品。 她说，在网路购物不用和大家挤，省时省力，关键还节省运费和税。 尤其感恩节期间不少网站折扣都相当诱人，如时尚网站buefly和6pm都打提供70%off的折扣。 美国市场调查机构ShopperTrak26日报告显示，尽管消费者对经济和个人支出状况依然感到担忧，今年黑色星期五期间的销售额较去年增加6.6%，表明假日消费季开局不错。 今年的销售额创下2007年以来的最高增幅，去年增幅只有0.3%。 客流量也比去年增加5.5%。 洛杉矶居民范先生刚装修房子，26日购买以半折购买不少家电产品，如冰箱、电视等，比往常节省1万元。 他说，感恩节能得到最大实惠的就是家电产品，礼物折扣有限，只在10-15%左右，要等圣诞节才可能有更好折扣出现。 消费者购买力破纪录，他们侧重购买的东西也不同，在3826位消费者的调查中，44%的消费者表示所购买东西多数是买给自己，半数以上的消费者购买服装类产品，40% 的消费者购买电器产品，如电视和游戏产品。
11b681f178fafb4a0405c337b84b6f5b9983968c.translatedText: This year’s Thanksgiving Day, people’s consumption power broke a record, becoming the highest consumption since 2007. People spent 52 billion yuan in the four days from 24th to 27th, which bodes well for the year-end consumption season. The National Retail Federation said that in the four days from the 24th to the 27th, 222.6 million consumers entered physical stores and made purchases online, an increase of 14 million consumers over the same period last year. According to a survey by BIGresearch, consumers are expected to spend 52 billion yuan during Thanksgiving, with each consumer spending an average of 398.62 yuan during the weekend, an increase of nearly 30 yuan from last year's 365.34 yuan. The average amount spent online is 150.53 yuan and is expected to continue to increase on Cyber ​​Monday. Ms. Cheng, a resident of Alhambra, regularly refreshes the webpage on the 24th and 25th in order to buy cost-effective products. She said that when shopping online, you don’t have to squeeze in with other people, which saves time and effort. The most important thing is to save shipping costs and taxes. Especially during Thanksgiving, discounts on many websites are quite attractive. For example, fashion websites Buefly and 6pm both offer 70% off discounts. A report from U.S. market research agency ShopperTrak on the 26th showed that although consumers are still worried about the economy and personal spending conditions, sales during this year's Black Friday increased by 6.6% compared with last year, indicating a good start to the holiday consumption season. Sales this year hit the highest growth rate since 2007, compared with only 0.3% last year. Passenger traffic also increased by 5.5% compared to last year. Mr. Fan, a resident of Los Angeles, has just renovated his house. On the 26th, he bought many home appliances, such as refrigerators and TVs, at half discounts, saving 10,000 yuan compared to usual. He said that the biggest benefits during Thanksgiving are home appliances. Gift discounts are limited, only about 10-15%, and better discounts may not appear until Christmas. Consumer purchasing power has broken records, and the things they focus on buying are also different. In a survey of 3,826 consumers, 44% of consumers said that most of the things they purchased were for themselves, more than half of the consumers purchased clothing products, and 40% of consumers purchased electrical products, such as TVs and game products.

99d897476c125faeaa99fe2730d54de786a76309.sourceText: 2012年亚省春晚‘冲刺跑’中华人民共和国驻洛杉矶总领事贺信加油 中华人民共和国驻洛杉矶总领事馆发来的贺信 由新东方艺术学校、ASU孔子学院、图桑华声合唱团、美西侨报、亚省时报等单位携手奉献的 2012年亚省龙年春节迎新晚会 的筹备工作目前已经进入冲刺跑阶段。演员，工作人员，志愿者，业界，各华人社团都尽己所能，做好自己的”本职”工作， 相互支持，大力推进春晚的筹备工作。2012年新年伊始，中华人民共和国洛杉矶总领事邱绍芳特发来贺信，为此次活动加油，向亚省华侨华人朋友祝福新春，”向晚会筹委会和全体参与人员致以热烈的祝贺和新春的问候”祝愿华侨华人朋友新春愉快，阖家幸福，万事如意!” 时间：2012年1月21日（农历29日），周六晚7点 地点：Chandler Center for the Arts 250 North Arizona Ave., Chandler, AZ 85225 票价：$10/人 每年的亚省春晚是亚省华人欢庆春节不可或缺的热闹环节。以新东方艺术学校为主，联合各界艺术家，今年春晚的节目特别突出清新欢庆的主题。经过了近半年的精心准备、勤奋排练，以新东方艺术学校以百名演员的精彩阵容集，汇集汉族，藏族，羌族，傣族，彝族等中国舞、民族舞蹈经典作品，融入了中华功夫绝技、合唱及童声合唱、独唱、器乐、小主持人等丰富的节目样式，力图让观众享受到浓郁的祖国文化艺术气息和丰盛的中华文化大餐。 热情参与自己的春晚、支持自己的春晚–这是华人华侨在海外庆祝民族传统节日的幸福事儿。朋友们， 2012年亚省龙年春节迎新晚会 2012 AZ Chinese New Year Festival 的序幕即将拉开 ， 让我们精彩热闹再过个幸福年！ 时间：2012年1月21日（农历29日），周六晚7点 地点：Chandler Center for the Arts 250 North Arizona Ave., Chandler, AZ 85225 票价：$10/人 售票：新东方艺术学校（1100 N Alma School Rd #18， Chandler，AZ 85224蓝天餐馆同一广场) Chandler Center for the Arts TicketMaster.com Fast Facts When Saturday, January 21, 2012, at 7pm What 2012 AZ Chinese New Year Festival General Admission: $10/each 2012 AZ Chinese New Year Festival, a spectacular variety show, brings audiences a magical journey to China through performing arts right before the 2012 Chinese New Year. 99d897476c125faeaa99fe2730d54de786a76309.translatedText: 2012 Alberta Spring Festival Gala ‘Sprint’ Congratulatory letter from the Consulate General of the People’s Republic of China in Los Angeles Congratulatory letter from the Consulate General of the People’s Republic of China in Los Angeles The preparations for the 2012 Alberta Year of the Dragon Spring Festival Gala, jointly contributed by the New Oriental School of the Arts, the ASU Confucius Institute, the Tucson Chinese Singing Choir, the American Overseas Chinese Newspaper, and the Alberta Times, have now entered the sprint stage. Actors, staff, volunteers, the industry, and various Chinese associations all tried their best to do their "jobs", supported each other, and vigorously promoted the preparations for the Spring Festival Gala. At the beginning of the 2012 New Year, Qiu Shaofang, Consul General of the People's Republic of China in Los Angeles, sent a congratulatory letter to cheer for this event and wish the overseas Chinese friends in Alberta a new year. "I would like to extend warm congratulations and New Year greetings to the party organizing committee and all participants. I wish the overseas Chinese friends a happy New Year, happy families, and all the best!" Time: January 21, 2012 (the 29th of the lunar calendar), Saturday at 7 p.m. Location: Chandler Center for the Arts 250 North Arizona Ave., Chandler, AZ 85225 Tickets: $10/person The annual Alberta Spring Festival Gala is an indispensable and lively part of the Chinese New Year celebration in Alberta. It is hosted by New Oriental Art School and collaborates with artists from all walks of life. This year’s Spring Festival Gala specializes in the theme of freshness and celebration. After nearly half a year of careful preparation and diligent rehearsal, it features a wonderful lineup of hundreds of actors from New Oriental Art School. The collection brings together Chinese dance and ethnic dance classics from Han, Tibetan, Qiang, Dai, Yi and other ethnic groups, and integrates rich program styles such as Chinese kung fu stunts, chorus and children's chorus, solo singing, instrumental music, small hosts, etc., striving to allow the audience to enjoy the rich cultural and artistic atmosphere of the motherland and a rich Chinese cultural feast. Enthusiastically participate in and support your own Spring Festival Gala - this is a happy thing for overseas Chinese to celebrate traditional national festivals overseas. Friends, the 2012 AZ Chinese New Year Festival is about to kick off. Let’s have a wonderful and happy New Year! bbb557d62532f75b9b861bccd7eb1013e18c1784.sourceText: 亚利桑那州的众议会和参议会1月9日开始新一届会期。布鲁尔作为州长，第三次来到议会作开幕词。 参议会开幕当天履新的还有普雷斯格共和党议员史提夫皮尔斯，他代替11月8日因罢免选举离职的罗素皮雷斯，成为参议会议长。 本届议会到4月下旬结束。 布鲁尔州长在致辞中说，州府近日为庆祝2月14日建州一百年，在财政改善的情况下，准备回购几个因预算短缺而出售的建筑物。 布鲁尔在周一的立法两院开幕致辞中说，她会提出详细的地址清单后，议会有望建州日之前通过购回参众议会的九层官方办公楼。 在经过多年的预算削减，亚利桑那州的财政状况有明显好转。这次回购的三座主体建筑属州政府出售的22个物业中一部分，通过物业出售，州府获利10亿美元，以帮助填补往年预算缺口。 选民在2010年投票通过布鲁尔征加临时销售税，2010年和2011年，议员们也可用借款和削减开支形式，终于使开支接近平衡。虽然有支持者计划采取主动措施，延长临时销售税，布鲁尔表示，临时销售税将如期在2013年结束。 ”我们在一起，就像去年，让我们降低税收，削减监管，并告知所有雇主，亚利桑那州意味企业。”布鲁尔说，她将继续为经济持续复苏和增长努力，让联邦政府尊重州府权利。 布鲁尔还说，联邦政府应与亚利桑那州和边境安全不能忽视自己的责任，对资金没着落的健康保健或实验管理政策，离开森林受到大规模的森林大火。 这是布鲁尔第三个州政府工作包括。她原是民选州务卿，在那波丽塔塔辞职后转任美国国土安全部长后，接任亚利桑那州州长，现已连任两届。
bbb557d62532f75b9b861bccd7eb1013e18c1784.translatedText: Arizona's House of Representatives and Senate began a new session on January 9th. Brewer came to the Assembly for the third time as governor to deliver his opening speech. Also taking over on the opening day of the Senate was Prestig Republican Congressman Steve Pierce, who replaced Russell Pires, who resigned due to a recall election on November 8, as Senate Speaker. The current parliament ends in late April. Governor Brewer said in his speech that the state capital has recently celebrated the centenary of statehood on February 14 and is preparing to repurchase several buildings that were sold due to budget shortfalls as the finances improve. Brewer said in her opening speech to both chambers of the Legislature on Monday that she would provide a detailed list of addresses that would allow the Legislature to pass the purchase of the nine-story official office building of the House of Representatives and Senate before Statehood Day. After years of budget cuts, Arizona's fiscal situation has improved significantly. The three main buildings repurchased this time are part of 22 properties sold by the state government. Through the property sales, the state government made a profit of $1 billion to help fill budget gaps in previous years. Voters approved Brewer in 2010 to impose a temporary sales tax, and in 2010 and 2011, lawmakers also used borrowing and spending cuts to finally bring spending closer to balance. While some supporters plan to take proactive steps to extend the temporary sales tax, Brewer said the temporary sales tax will end as scheduled in 2013. "We are together, just like we were last year, let's lower taxes, cut regulations, and tell all employers that Arizona means business." Brewer said she will continue to work for continued economic recovery and growth and have the federal government respect state rights. Brewer also said the federal government should work with Arizona and border security not neglect their responsibilities for unfunded health care or experiment with management policies that leave forests affected by massive wildfires. This is Brewer's third state government job. She was the elected secretary of state. After Napolita resigned and became the U.S. secretary of homeland security, she took over as governor of Arizona and has been reelected for two terms.

0d161604847b62ab5dd0802eaf0c1f373d806016.sourceText: 警方在一项为期两周的扫荡行动中，在图森市沿10号州际公路附近西部山区，逮捕了241名与毒品走私有关的嫌疑犯。 参加这个代号为银铃的行动的共有7个单位，包括边境巡逻、交警、奥罗谷警方、马拉那警局、皮马郡警长办公室、移民局、吉拉河警察、和依莱警察。 重点搜查银贝尔和锯齿山脉，寻找走私渠道和破坏跨国犯罪组织。 到2月11日止，联合行动逮捕241人，缴获近4000磅大麻，19辆汽车，5支武器。
0d161604847b62ab5dd0802eaf0c1f373d806016.translatedText: Police arrested 241 suspects related to drug smuggling in Tucson during a two-week sweep along Interstate 10 in the western mountains. A total of seven units participated in Operation Silver Bell, including Border Patrol, Transit Police, Oro Valley Police, Marana Police Department, Pima County Sheriff's Office, Immigration, Gila River Police, and Eli Police. Focus on searching Silver Bell and the Sawtooth Mountains to find smuggling channels and disrupt transnational criminal organizations. As of February 11, the joint operation had arrested 241 people and seized nearly 4,000 pounds of marijuana, 19 vehicles, and 5 weapons.

9611dce79dade5b48769c2da52955ff6f869b645.sourceText: 据张唐文稿、王聪中文翻译来稿：旨在服务于广大华裔社区及大凤凰城区市民的2012年中华文化周，取得圆满成功。 今年是亚利桑那建州一百周年，作为建州百年庆祝活动的一部分，今年的文化周活动又具有特殊的意义。 于一月底举行的为期三天的文化周活动，可视为建州100周年的序幕。 （2月14日是亚利桑那州的建州日。1912年2月14日塔夫总统正式签署法律承认亚利桑那州加入联邦。州政府的百年庆典活动将于2月12至14日在州议会大楼 附近举行） 在1月23日举行的新闻发布会上，新当选的凤凰城副市长迈克约翰逊和前任副市长、市议员威廉斯的致辞共同揭开了此次文化周的序幕，他-们谈及 长期以来参与到中华文化周活动，并对这种活动感到由衷的赞赏。 在1月27日举行的2012中华文化周的开幕式上，新当选的凤凰城市长格雷史坦顿也同样表达了对文化周活动的满意。 当天，有几所学校参加了开幕式并演出。 总的来说，此次文化周已达到了相当的水平。 当然，亚利桑那著名的冬季气候和温暖的阳光是提升参与人数和满意度的因素。 虽然还有更多可以提供给销售商的货摊，还有更多的时间可以表演更多的节目，主办单位欢迎更多的商家和表演人员可以参与2013年的中华文化周。 今年的答谢晚宴在六福酒家举行。 近两百人在此共进晚餐，热闹非凡，充满节日的喜庆。 不仅如此，在晚宴上武术队还表演了非常受欢迎的舞龙。 由于室内的舞台空间有限，舞龙队把龙拉到室外演演，那天晚上的舞龙表演显得更自然、更流畅。 在晚宴上，史坦顿市长表示，这不是他第一次参加中华文化周活动，他在还是市议员的时候已多次参与。 他坦言市政厅是中华文化周忠实的赞助者，并将一如既往地支持这个活动。 史坦顿市长指出，凤凰城现已融入全球的经济，因此必需放眼世界。 他还指出，在艰难的时把自己封闭起来会是一个错误。 他说，有人主张削减友好城市项目的预算，并称这是简单的”软”节约方案，但这是个错误的方案。 晚宴上，来自凤凰城友好城市成都的陈志刚先生表演了变脸，并成为了整晚的高潮。 变脸是四川当地传统歌剧表演，是川剧的一部分。 变脸只传授给男人（因为女人出嫁后可能把秘密透露给别人）。 2012年凤凰城中华文化周无疑是一个巨大的成功，特别是领导及组委会成员面临过渡的种种困难。 面对任何渡期间的挑战，本届组委会有信心去完成它、超越它，使中华文化周活动达到一个新的境界。
9611dce79dade5b48769c2da52955ff6f869b645.translatedText: According to the manuscript by Zhang Tang and the Chinese translation by Wang Cong: The 2012 Chinese Culture Week, which aims to serve the Chinese community and the citizens of the greater Phoenix area, was a complete success. This year marks the 100th anniversary of Arizona's statehood. As part of the 100th anniversary celebration, this year's Cultural Week has special significance. The three-day cultural week held at the end of January can be regarded as the prelude to the 100th anniversary of the founding of the state. (February 14 is Arizona’s statehood day. On February 14, 1912, President Taft officially signed the law recognizing Arizona’s admission to the Union. The state government’s centennial celebration will be held near the State Capitol from February 12 to 14) At a press conference on January 23, the newly elected Phoenix Vice Mayor Mike Johnson and the former deputy mayor and city councilor Williams opened the cultural week with their speeches. They talked about I have participated in Chinese Culture Week activities for a long time and sincerely appreciate this kind of activity. At the opening ceremony of the 2012 Chinese Culture Week held on January 27, newly elected Phoenix Mayor Gray Stanton also expressed his satisfaction with the cultural week activities. On that day, several schools participated in the opening ceremony and performed. Overall, this cultural week has reached a considerable level. Of course, Arizona's famous winter weather and warm sunshine are factors that boost attendance and satisfaction. Although there are more stalls available for vendors and more time for more performances, the organizers welcome more merchants and performers to participate in the 2013 Chinese Culture Week. This year's appreciation dinner was held at Luk Fook Restaurant. Nearly two hundred people had dinner here, which was very lively and full of festive joy. Not only that, the martial arts team also performed the very popular dragon dance at the dinner. Due to the limited indoor stage space, the dragon dance team took the dragon to perform outdoors. The dragon dance performance that night seemed more natural and smooth. At the dinner, Mayor Stanton said that this was not his first time to participate in Chinese Culture Week activities. He had participated many times when he was a city councilor. He admitted that the City Hall was a loyal sponsor of Chinese Culture Week and would continue to support this event. Mayor Stanton pointed out that Phoenix is ​​now integrated into the global economy, so it must look to the world. He also points out that closing yourself off when times are tough would be a mistake. He said some people advocate cutting the budget of sister city projects and calling it a simple "soft" savings plan, but this is the wrong plan. At the dinner, Mr. Chen Zhigang from Phoenix's sister city Chengdu performed a face-changing performance, which became the climax of the whole night. Face Changing is a local traditional opera performance in Sichuan and is a part of Sichuan Opera. Face-changing is only taught to men (because women may reveal their secrets to others after getting married). The 2012 Phoenix Chinese Culture Week was undoubtedly a huge success, especially since the leadership and organizing committee members faced various transition difficulties. Facing any challenges during the transition period, this organizing committee is confident to complete it, surpass it, and bring the Chinese Culture Week activities to a new level.

7f2e32a9982399527a33f834443b83ffcaaa0077.sourceText: 《占领华尔街》强调美国经济的不平等，各地的示威者也标榜着自己是社会上的99%，引起公众的注意，事实上，财富的差异一直存在，美国各州也试图以再分配资源，通过 教育方面的支出，失业救济，医疗保健，福利和其他途径，达到公平竞争的水平。 《24/7华尔街》研究各州政府的开支，以确定那些地区为居民提供最少的金钱和福利分析发现，为了资助这些项目，该地区也负担更高的税收压力。 当所有居民的收入水平，受益于政府的协助，穷人得到更多福利，医疗，保险和失业保险等，经济不公平的情况就会更加减少吗？ 全美州政府吝惜度排行：第十位德克萨斯州，第九位佛罗里达州，第八位印地安那州，第七位南卡罗来纳州，第六位亚利桑那州，第五位阿拉巴马州 ，第四位俄克拉何马州，第三位爱达荷州，第二位田纳西州，第一位阿肯色州。 其中，亚利桑那州平均退休金的福利：$19,056美元，每名学生的平均支出：$7,813美元，受益人的医疗补助金：$4,701美元，每周失业救济金的比率：26.2%，家庭短暂援助金的申请 月份总数：35.4月，家庭短暂援助金的每月平均现金：$270美元。 虽然本州的州和地方的税收负担，明显低于全国平均水平，在多个不同领域内，其花费不到全国平均水平。 以教育为例，州政府每年对每名学生的支助，是全美第三最低的。 最近，州参议院削减2亿美元的K-12教育经费。 州政府为失业人士提供的每周工资援助，也是相对较少，平均每周失业救济金是213美元，是全美第四最低的。
7f2e32a9982399527a33f834443b83ffcaaa0077.translatedText: "Occupy Wall Street" emphasizes the inequality of the American economy, and demonstrators from all over the world also flaunt themselves as the 99% of society, attracting public attention. In fact, wealth differences have always existed, and American states are also trying to redistribute resources through education expenditures, unemployment benefits, health care, welfare and other means to achieve a level of fair competition. 24/7 Wall Street looked at state government spending to determine which areas provide the least money and benefits to residents. The analysis found that areas also bear higher tax burdens to fund these projects. When all residents of all income levels benefit from government assistance, and the poor receive more benefits, medical care, insurance, unemployment insurance, etc., will economic inequality be reduced even more? Ranking of state government stinginess in the United States: Texas is 10th, Florida is 9th, Indiana is 8th, South Carolina is 7th, Arizona is 6th, Alabama is 5th, Oklahoma is 4th, Idaho is 3rd, Tennessee is 2nd, and Arkansas is 1st. Among them, Arizona’s average pension benefits: $19,056, average spending per student: $7,813, Medicaid payments to beneficiaries: $4,701, weekly unemployment benefit rate: 26.2%, total monthly FTA applications: 35.4 months, average monthly FTA cash: $270. While the state's state and local tax burden is significantly lower than the national average, it spends less than the national average in a number of different areas. Taking education as an example, the state government's annual support per student is the third lowest in the United States. Recently, the state Senate cut $200 million in K-12 education funding. The state government also provides relatively little weekly wage assistance to the unemployed. The average weekly unemployment benefit is $213, the fourth lowest in the United States.

2a9cd85de2636858d013b76e7716ebe956b3d3ab.translatedText: The north slope of the Grand Canyon will be closed for winter (Alberta Times) There are not many days left to enter the Grand Canyon National Park from the north slope this year. The state Department of Transportation will…

fcd5c8138b7e269fd0ee9580569207d3b81db9bc.sourceText: 今年从北坡进入大峡谷国家公园的日子已为时不多了。 州交通部将于11月28日起关闭雅各湖和北坡之间的州属67号公路。 该路段在冬季常有大风雪出现，交通部也没有安排人手在此清除积雪。 大峡谷北坡预计于明年5月中旬重新开放。
fcd5c8138b7e269fd0ee9580569207d3b81db9bc.translatedText: Days are numbered this year to enter Grand Canyon National Park from the North Slope in November. The state Department of Transportation will close state Route 67 between Jacobs Lake and the North Slope starting Nov. 28. Heavy snowstorms often occur on this section of the road in winter, and the Ministry of Transportation has not arranged for manpower to clear the snow. The North Slope of the Grand Canyon is expected to reopen in mid-May next year.

41d581afc59e35c8a08288e9178ae95d51426b99.sourceText: 2012年1 月21日晚7点至9点，在钱德勒艺术中心，亚利桑那州龙年春节迎新晚会圆满落幕。此次晚会是由新东方艺术学校主办，asu孔子学院、图桑华声合唱团、亚省时报、太阳鸟亚利桑那华人网等多家华人媒体及华人社团联合协办。参加晚会演出的演员共有１３０多人，主要是新东方艺术学校的小学员们和一些活跃在亚省各文艺团体的资深艺术家们。现场观众达1500多人。晚会节目以歌舞为主，穿插有武术、变脸、气功表演，独唱和大合唱，以及钢琴、古筝等器乐演奏，等等。整个晚会气氛欢乐、祥和、喜庆、热闹！
41d581afc59e35c8a08288e9178ae95d51426b99.translatedText: 2012 1 From 7 to 9 pm on the 21st, at the Chandler Art Center, the Arizona Year of the Dragon Spring Festival Welcome Party concluded successfully. The party was hosted by the New Oriental Art School and co-organized by the ASU Confucius Institute, the Tucson Chinese Voice Chorus, the Alberta Times, the Sunbird Arizona Chinese Network and many other Chinese media and Chinese associations. There were more than 130 actors participating in the evening performance, mainly primary school students from New Oriental Art School and some senior artists active in various literary and art groups in Alberta. There were more than 1,500 spectators on site. The program of the party is mainly singing and dancing, interspersed with martial arts, face-changing, qigong performances, solo and chorus, as well as piano, guzheng and other instrumental music performances, etc. The atmosphere of the whole party was joyful, peaceful, festive and lively!

2ca746d22bbd1ffce68294789649f8ebed55a904.translatedText: I hope Chinese schools will participate in the 2012 Chinese Culture Week (pictures) [I hope Chinese schools Xie Xiaohong will contribute] The sound of firecrackers bid farewell to the old year, and the flying dragons and phoenixes welcome the new year...

9ffbfa58dfd926fc40a908d5f24ca1d05de58aa5.sourceText: 爆竹声声辞旧岁，龙飞凤舞迎新年。 一月二十九日星期日凤凰城的中国文化中心热闹非凡，活动中心聚集了许多参加活动的各族裔。 中华文化周的表演在金龙飞舞，醒狮贺春中拉开了序幕。 亚省希望中文学校的师生也作了精彩的表演。 希望中文学校的代表首先向各族裔观众拜年及介绍了希望中文学校。 介绍节目之后，第一个演出的节目是少儿舞蹈《开门红》。 一群天真可爱的小朋友,活泼欢快的表演，给观众带来新春的喜庆和祝福。
9ffbfa58dfd926fc40a908d5f24ca1d05de58aa5.translatedText: The sound of firecrackers bid farewell to the old year, and the flying dragons and phoenixes welcome the new year. The Chinese Cultural Center in Phoenix was bustling with activity on Sunday, January 29, with many ethnic groups participating in the event gathered in the activity center. The performance of the Chinese Culture Week kicked off with the golden dragon flying and the lion awakening to celebrate the Spring Festival. Teachers and students of the Alberta Hope Chinese School also gave wonderful performances. Representatives of Hope Chinese School first greeted the audience of various ethnic groups with New Year greetings and introduced Hope Chinese School. After the introduction of the program, the first program performed was the children's dance "A Good Start". A group of innocent and lovely children performed lively and cheerfully, bringing New Year's joy and blessings to the audience.

9e4115403496a201d5be92947455b12491fba636.sourceText: 《开门红》 接着，由去年美国中文歌曲比赛优胜者，夏天代表美国赛区到北京水立方表演的严捷娅高歌一曲《青藏高原》。 她嘹亮，优美的歌声响彻整个中国文化中心，把演出气氛推向高潮。
9e4115403496a201d5be92947455b12491fba636.translatedText: "A Good Start" Next, Yan Jieya, the winner of last year's American Chinese Song Contest and who represented the American region in the summer to perform at the Water Cube in Beijing, sang the song "Qinghai-Tibet Plateau". Her loud and beautiful singing voice resounded throughout the China Cultural Center, pushing the performance atmosphere to a climax.

d72db9b9338de0ec662197e902d65e53d74e8ee5.sourceText: 严捷娅高歌《青藏高原》 接下来，聂敬军老师表演了新疆舞蹈《牵起你的盖头来》，她精彩的表演，给观众带来阵阵惊喜。 让观众仿佛走进新疆，感受那热情风趣，同时又神秘别样的风情。 最后，陈卓婷和李维熙表演了黄梅戏舞蹈《天女散花》。 天女散花，人间吉祥。 她们优美的表演，为这次演出划上了完满的句号。 整个演出精彩纷呈，观众对希望中文学校师生的表演报以阵阵热情的掌声和喝彩。 陈卓婷，李维熙表演《天女散花》 当天，希望中文学校的展台也吸引了许多民众。 老师，家长和学生会的同学向游人介绍中国文化，中国书法和手工制作。 还有许多外国朋友带着小孩来到展台了解学校及学习中文的信息。 欢声笑语中，希望中文学校的师生，家长和各族朋友一起庆祝新春的同时，使各族朋友更进一步的了解中国，感受中国文化的魅力！ 想了解希望学校信息，请登网azhopechineseschool.org，或发邮件到： hopechineseschool@yahoo.com 。
d72db9b9338de0ec662197e902d65e53d74e8ee5.translatedText: > Yan Jieya sang "Qinghai-Tibet Plateau" Next, teacher Nie Jingjun performed the Xinjiang dance "Pick Up Your Hijab". Her wonderful performance brought surprises to the audience. It makes the audience feel as if they have entered Xinjiang and feel the warm, fun, mysterious and unique customs. Finally, Chen Zhuoting and Li Weixi performed the Huangmei Opera dance "The Goddess Scatters Flowers". The goddess scatters flowers, bringing good fortune to the world. Their beautiful performance brought the performance to a perfect conclusion. The whole performance was brilliant, and the audience responded with bursts of enthusiastic applause and cheers to the performance of the teachers and students of Hope Chinese School. Chen Zhuoting and Li Weixi performed "The Goddess Scattered Flowers". On that day, the booth of Hope Chinese School also attracted many people. Teachers, parents and students from the student union introduce Chinese culture, Chinese calligraphy and handicrafts to visitors. Many foreign friends came to the booth with their children to learn about schools and learning Chinese. Amidst the laughter, I hope that teachers, students, parents and friends of all ethnic groups in Chinese schools will celebrate the New Year together, and at the same time, friends of all ethnic groups will have a better understanding of China and feel the charm of Chinese culture! For information about Hope School, please visit azhopechineseschool.org, or send an email to: hopechineseschool@yahoo.com.

fff8e7ce623f17889e8af05931552b32a6b1669d.sourceText: 加州麦塞德（Merced）法拍屋过多 学生纷住豪华住宅 （亚省时报） 麥賽德加州大學(University of Califonia, Merced)的兩個女學生，剛考完期中考，拖著疲憊身軀回家，一個打算好好享受漫天星斗下美輪美奐的曲線游泳池，另一個則準備泡進名牌按摩浴缸裡，感受頂級沐浴體驗。 紐約時報報導，麥賽德加大附近豪宅林立，然而供過於求和過度炒作讓此地成為美國法拍屋最密集的地區之一，造就了窮學生低價租豪宅的奇特現象。 這些豪宅的租金低得驚人：住在校內學生宿舍大約年繳1萬3720元；校外一般房屋年租金約7000元；若幾個學生合租豪宅，不但每人擁有獨立套房和衛浴，而且依照設備豪華程度，只需月繳200到350元不等的租金。 大學生迪倫(Gurbir Dhillon)因此得以享受皇宮般的起居室，媲美宮廷的按摩浴缸，還有一個大型衣飾間，裡面堆滿棒球手套與T恤。他說：「當你去拜訪外校朋友，他們告訴你『今晚就打地鋪吧』，你就會覺得自己特別好命。」 2005年麥賽德加大首批新生入學，是40年來加大首開新校區，助長了當地房產投資風潮。大批新社區出現，供過於求加上房市泡沫破滅，使得這個人口7萬9000人的小城成為美國房屋法拍率最高的城市之一，上百間空屋乏人問津，所有權人乾脆用超低價租給學生。因此，幾個大學生合租校外房屋成了再划算不過的選擇。 不過，居住在空屋密集區還是有風險。麥賽德市警局犯罪研究專家艾伯指出，空屋容易吸引小偷光顧，例如最近就發生銅線竊盜案；遊民也容易以此為家。 在當地買房的住戶也對學生們可以低價租房有些不是滋味。失業的英語教師安格斯，幾年前以53萬元在麥賽德市新社區買下一戶，現在房價腰斬，他每月還要付3000元房貸，隔鄰的學生每月租金卻只要300元。 他酸溜溜的說，「他們是我遇過最幸運的學生」。
fff8e7ce623f17889e8af05931552b32a6b1669d.translatedText: There are too many foreclosures in Merced, California, and students are living in luxury housing (Alberta Times) University of California, Merced) Two female students in Merced had just finished their midterm exams and were dragging their exhausted bodies home. One planned to enjoy the beautiful curved swimming pool under the starry sky, and the other was ready to soak in the famous brand jacuzzi and experience the top bathing experience. The New York Times reported that there are many luxury houses near Merced, but oversupply and over-hyping have made this area one of the most densely populated areas in the United States, creating a strange phenomenon of poor students renting luxury houses at low prices. The rents for these luxury homes are astonishingly low: the annual rent for living in on-campus student dormitories is about 13,720 yuan; the annual rent for general housing off campus is about 7,000 yuan; if several students share a mansion, not only will each of them have an independent suite and bathroom, but also the monthly rent will only range from 200 to 350 yuan, depending on the level of equipment luxury. Dhillon was able to enjoy a palace-like living room, a jacuzzi that rivaled a palace, and a large dressing room filled with baseball gloves and T-shirts. He said: "When you go to visit your friends from other schools and they tell you, 'Let's just lay down on the floor tonight,' you feel very lucky." In 2005, the first batch of freshmen were admitted to UC Merced, which was the first time that UC Merced opened a new campus in 40 years. This spurred a wave of local real estate investment. The emergence of a large number of new communities, oversupply and the bursting of the housing market bubble made this small town with a population of 79,000 people have one of the highest housing foreclosure rates in the United States. Hundreds of empty houses were unavailable, and the owners simply rented them to students at super low prices. Therefore, it became a cost-effective option for several college students to rent out off-campus houses together. However, there are still risks in living in areas with densely populated empty houses. Eber, a crime researcher with the Merced City Police Department, pointed out that empty houses are easy to attract thieves, such as the recent copper wire theft case; homeless people are also easy to call them home. Residents who buy houses locally are also unhappy that students can rent at low prices. Angus, an unemployed English teacher, bought a house in a new community in Merced City for 530,000 yuan a few years ago. Now the house price has been halved. He still has to pay a monthly mortgage payment of 3,000 yuan, but the monthly rent of the students next door is only 300 yuan. He said sourly, "They are the luckiest students I have ever met."

099473b13f259369697b4e277eab2375f0bed17f.sourceText: 一名ASU学生在经历自家女婴猝死悲剧后，发明了母婴感应装置，希望拯救其他生命。 21岁的彼得西摩说：”在这个时代，我们周围有很对难以置信的技术，但居然没有一个传感器，可以防止这类事情的发生，真不可原谅。” 西摩得到ASU的资助，和​​一组志趣相投的同学研发一个微型传感器，像邮票大小，一方穿戴在婴儿身上，另一方连接在父母的手机或电脑上，当婴儿感到不适时，第一时间提醒 父母。 西摩的传感器正在测试阶段，将于12月向ASU提交最终产品。 他希望明年可以投放市场，预计价格为25至50美元左右
099473b13f259369697b4e277eab2375f0bed17f.translatedText: After experiencing the tragedy of the sudden death of his own baby girl, an ASU student invented a maternal and infant sensing device in the hope of saving other lives. 21-year-old Peter Seymour said: "In this day and age, we have a lot of incredible technology around us, but there is not a sensor that can prevent this kind of thing from happening. It's really inexcusable." Seymour received funding from ASU and developed a tiny sensor with a group of like-minded classmates, about the size of a postage stamp. One side is worn on the baby, and the other side is connected to the parent's mobile phone or computer. When the baby feels unwell, it will alert the parents immediately. Seymour's sensor is in the testing phase and a final product will be submitted to ASU in December. He hopes to have it on the market next year, with an estimated price of around $25 to $50.

ed64661f3cbe643057e7df388cc22f435e913b99.sourceText: 凤城侨社历史和人物故事《序3》人正‧人誠‧人和 肇鸿与今奇之友谊，已有二十馀载，我们之间之思想交流，不是通过餐厅酒市，而是在洒满墨香的字里行间。可以说今奇对肇鸿之文笔印象是立体的彩色结构而深化到黑白朴素的厚重造形。 每一位侨胞从祖国飘洋泊外都肩负着生活重担。肇鸿之运笔是在繁重之生活夹缝中，由心血浓缩之结晶。他是一位运笔勤奋，严肃，又视野宽宏之真诚作家。毫不夸张地说，肇鸿创作范围之广，篇幅之多，在鳯凰宝地佔有非常显着的地位。更可贵的是肇鸿用笔从不考虑回报，他心里装满了沙漠明珠，在他眼中的每一个侨胞都是一颗颗明珠，这些明珠都需要他适时托出而闪闪发光… 肇鸿曾任龙冈协会主席，他之用笔宗旨，正如龙冈之仁义诚厚，在他笔下谱成之每一支曲，都是真实之悦耳之侨胞讚歌。 今奇曾有一首致龙冈主席肇鸿君之七律： 挥笔洒脱曲云涛 虚名幻影古难消 不忘散珠当年忆 谁念陈酿味醇高 肇端坚靱挚诚意 鸿大远瞻励志骄 只缘时助艰辛友 心愿正大神消遥 肇鸿欣赏今奇之篆书 ‘龙’，因为’龙’也是龙冈之化身；他品味今奇推理小文”厚积薄发”因为文中的情感逻辑与他自己的着作情感逻辑相吻合。 肇鸿多年之文学创作经历，是他心理能量的释放。是阅历之积累；是学界之积累，是文化的积累；是印象记忆与情感记忆之积累。一个人，一个中华骄子能够多年不计回报，用心血付出，是何等高贵之精神释放！这就是龙的传人，在洋人国度中弘扬祖国文化之高尚释放！ 今奇五月七日 二零一一年
ed64661f3cbe643057e7df388cc22f435e913b99.translatedText: History and Character Stories of Fengcheng Overseas Chinese Community "Preface 3" Renzheng·rencheng·renhe Zhaohong and Jinqi have been friends for more than twenty years. The exchange of ideas between us is not through restaurants and wine shops, but between the lines of words filled with the fragrance of ink. It can be said that Jin Qi's impression of Zhao Hong's writing style is from the three-dimensional colorful structure to the simple and heavy shapes in black and white. Every overseas Chinese who has traveled abroad from their motherland shoulders the burden of life. Zhaohong's writing style is the result of his hard work in the midst of a heavy life. He is a diligent, serious and sincere writer with a broad vision. It is no exaggeration to say that Zhaohong's creative scope is wide and lengthy, and he occupies a very prominent position in Huanghuang Baodi. What's more valuable is that Zhaohong never considers rewards when using his pen. His heart is filled with pearls of the desert. In his eyes, every overseas Chinese is a pearl, and these pearls need him to hold them out at the right time to shine... Zhaohong was once the chairman of the Longgang Association. The purpose of his pen is just like Longgang's benevolence, justice and sincerity. Every song he composes is a true and pleasant hymn to the overseas Chinese. Jinqi once wrote a poem to the Chairman of Longgang, Zhao Hongjun, which contains seven verses: The pen is free and easy, and the clouds are flowing. The phantom of the false name is hard to disappear. Don’t forget the memories of the scattered beads. Who thinks that the aged wine has a mellow taste. The beginning is strong and sincere. The grand vision is inspirational and arrogant. I only want to help friends who are in hardship. I hope that the righteous god will disappear. Zhaohong appreciates Jinqi’s seal script. ‘Dragon’, because ‘Dragon’ is also the incarnation of Long Gang; he savors Jinqi’s reasoning essay “accumulates it deeply” because the emotional logic in the article is consistent with the emotional logic of his own writings. Zhaohong's years of literary creation experience were the release of his psychological energy. It is the accumulation of experience; it is the accumulation of academia, it is the accumulation of culture; it is the accumulation of impression memory and emotional memory. What a noble spiritual release it is for a person, a proud Chinese man, to dedicate his efforts for many years without expecting anything in return! This is the descendant of the dragon, the noble release of promoting the motherland's culture in a foreign country! Jinqi May 7, 2011

a20f4dfda496a9b50b6379138839890d1488ce14.sourceText: 中新网11月21日电 据美国《世界日报》报道，曾经轰动一时的华裔女星李斐莉雪(Felicia Lee)命案18日开庭，检察官向陪审团表示，李斐莉雪生前曾遭同居男友施暴并虐待致死。辩方律师坚称，李斐莉雪的死因是吸毒过量造成。
a20f4dfda496a9b50b6379138839890d1488ce14.translatedText: China News Service, November 21st According to the US "World Journal" report, the murder case of the once sensational Chinese-American actress Felicia Lee opened on the 18th. The prosecutor told the jury that Felicia Lee was violently tortured and tortured to death by her live-in boyfriend before her death. The defense lawyer insisted that Felix Li's death was caused by a drug overdose.

61c37795bafc97458bed6ef806b6fcf0c9ae9161.sourceText: 曾经客串演出《尖峰时刻2》、来自新加坡的李斐莉雪2009年9月11日被发现死于她的同居男友、当年45岁的白人蓝道(Brian Lee Randone)家中。蓝道当时以谋杀罪提起公诉，保释金200万元。
61c37795bafc97458bed6ef806b6fcf0c9ae9161.translatedText: Felix Lee from Singapore, who guest-starred in "Rush Hour 2", was found dead in the home of her live-in boyfriend, 45-year-old white man Brian Lee Randone, on September 11, 2009. Landau was prosecuted for murder and his bail was set at NT$2 million.

ce71ca7ac1b4cc275c105b5bca1633e6e5f70c83.sourceText: 负责此案的检察官Philip Wojdak向陪审团提出一张李斐莉雪受重伤的照片，表示验尸官在她身上验出约320处伤痕。”她不是死于吸毒过量，而是被蓝道痛打、施暴、虐待致死”。Wojdak表示，李斐莉雪生前是一名重度吸毒者，毒瘾很深，因此有很高的性抗药性，不可能是吸毒过量而死。Wojdak指出，她脸上的伤是典型窒息死亡造成。
ce71ca7ac1b4cc275c105b5bca1633e6e5f70c83.translatedText: Philip Wojdak, the prosecutor in charge of the case, presented to the jury a photo of Felix Li being seriously injured, saying that the coroner found about 320 injuries on her body. "She did not die of a drug overdose, but was beaten, beaten, and tortured to death by Randyll." Wojdak said that Li Feilixue was a heavy drug addict during her lifetime, and her drug addiction was very deep. Therefore, she was highly resistant to drug abuse and could not have died of a drug overdose. Wojdak said the injuries to her face were typical of suffocation.

3b70fb6eeeedc3957dcc80e78b3722f8c4bcd986.sourceText: 蓝道的辩护律师Ed Rucker表示，造成李斐莉雪停止呼吸的原因，是吸食过量含有非法的抗抑郁GHB(γ-羟基丁酸)药物。Rucker表示，根据医疗研究显示，此类药物会抑制人类呼吸，过度食用会造成昏眩、无法控制身体、四肢瘫痪等症状，根据她的友人声称，她可以一次喝完整瓶的液体GHB，而在她去世前的早晨曾大量服用此药物。
3b70fb6eeeedc3957dcc80e78b3722f8c4bcd986.translatedText: Ed Rucker, Randall's defense attorney, said that the reason Felix Li stopped breathing was due to an overdose of illegal antidepressant GHB (gamma-hydroxybutyric acid). Rucker said that according to medical research, such drugs can suppress human breathing, and excessive consumption can cause symptoms such as dizziness, inability to control the body, and quadriplegia. According to her friends, she could drink an entire bottle of liquid GHB at one time, and she took a large amount of this drug in the morning before her death.

f8b86c08bbd8d1ca476f1f11af3656659362c065.sourceText: Wojdak表示，不论让她呼吸停止的原因是什么，她脸上的血迹、包括眼睛、嘴角周围瘀青、鼻子及额头的伤口都是人为造成。
f8b86c08bbd8d1ca476f1f11af3656659362c065.translatedText: Wojdak said that no matter what caused her breathing to stop, the blood on her face, including the bruises around her eyes and mouth, and the wounds on her nose and forehead, were all caused by man.

76528239ee698d4ca624e374823395bf2d879ecc.sourceText: ”李斐莉雪身上的伤，是从楼梯跌下来所造成”，Rucker表示。蓝道坚称，李斐莉雪身上约320处伤痕都是她自己造成，他绝对没有对她施暴。为证明他的说词，蓝道指出在李斐莉雪身上的擦伤及瘀青都集中在四肢，而不是身体。
76528239ee698d4ca624e374823395bf2d879ecc.translatedText: "Felicity Li's injuries were caused by falling down the stairs," Rucker said. Landao insisted that the approximately 320 injuries on Li Felixue's body were all caused by her, and that he was absolutely not violent towards her. To prove his story, Landau pointed out that the scratches and bruises on Li Felixue's body were concentrated on the limbs, not the body.

4b22805850c09a09394d43a789f4be9d22475373.sourceText: Rucker向陪审团表示，一位心理变态的罪犯在折磨女人时，不会仅限于她的手脚、而是全身。Rucker强调，警方当时在搜索犯罪现场时，并没找到任何可疑的武器、或是遗留下死者血迹的凶器。在未来几周内的开庭，李斐莉雪的朋友及前夫将会出庭作证，指出她是一名GHB的重度食用者。
4b22805850c09a09394d43a789f4be9d22475373.translatedText: Rucker told the jury that a psychopathic criminal would not only torture a woman's hands and feet, but her whole body. Rucker emphasized that when police searched the crime scene, they did not find any suspicious weapons or weapons with blood stains on the deceased. At the trial in the next few weeks, Felix Lee's friends and ex-husband will testify that she is a heavy GHB consumer.

f874282c3685636803247383e4e0b3bf8eb9a0f2.sourceText: 根据法医Ajay Panchal的验尸报告，李斐莉雪是死于窒息。Panchal表示，有两种可能性，一是有东西覆盖在她脸上导致窒息、二是她的头撞某样东西，而造成无法呼吸，但是她身上的伤势证明曾遭受猛烈攻击，而不是吸毒过量而引起。如果她当时清醒，遭受到施暴时应该会反击、遗留伤痕，Panchal表示，在她身上没有类似的痕迹。
f874282c3685636803247383e4e0b3bf8eb9a0f2.translatedText: According to the autopsy report of forensic doctor Ajay Panchal, Felix Li died of suffocation. Panchal said that there were two possibilities. One was that something covered her face and caused suffocation. The other was that her head hit something and she was unable to breathe. However, the injuries on her body proved that she had been violently attacked and was not caused by a drug overdose. If she had been conscious at the time, she would have fought back and left scars when she was assaulted. Panchal said there were no similar marks on her body.

b0a0c71a4527c8ca5209f8694a861fd82ad4cd23.sourceText: CooperVision公司近日扩大了其召回行动，召回近已经售出的500万隐性眼镜，其中包括Avaira的第二种品牌，这些镜片可能被矽油（silicone oil）残留污染，并导致视物模糊 ，眼外伤和剧烈疼痛。 总部位于加州的CooperVision公司在新闻稿中表示，该公司周二将Avaira Sphere镜片加入召回名单，该公司八月时已经召回Avaira Toric隐形眼镜。 召回原因是部分批次因为油污残留，而未能达到质量标准。 公司发言人说，该生产线生产的660万Avaira Sphere镜片受召回影响，但实际出货的只有490万。 这一召回举措是在联邦食品和药物管理局（FDA）已发出对该产品的第一类（Class I）产品警告，并迫使该公司上个月加强向公众宣导其近78万Avaira Toric镜片 的召回后所作出的。 第一类产品召回是最严重的一种，涉及的问题可能导致严重的不良健康后果或死亡。 数十名Avaira Sphere用户报告了问题，包括视力模糊，疼痛和严重受伤，包括眼角膜受损，需要紧急送医。 公司官员被控在八月份进行一个”隐形召回”，使得许多消费者不知道其使用的产品存在问题。 公司官员指出，除上述两款外，其他产品线生产中并使用矽油。 该公司预计拨出900万美元作为扩大召回的成本储备。 总而言之，该公司预计召回将花费该公司2,320万美元。 召回有关的问题，消费者应联络该公司：1-855-526-6737。
b0a0c71a4527c8ca5209f8694a861fd82ad4cd23.translatedText: > CooperVision has recently expanded its recall operation, recalling nearly 5 million contact lenses that have been sold, including a second brand of Avaira, which may be contaminated by silicone oil (silicone) oil) residual contamination and cause blurred vision, eye trauma and severe pain. California-based CooperVision said in a news release that it added Avaira Sphere lenses to its recall list on Tuesday, following a recall of Avaira Toric contact lenses in August. The reason for the recall is that some batches failed to meet quality standards due to oil residue. A company spokesman said that 6.6 million Avaira Sphere lenses produced on the production line were affected by the recall, but only 4.9 million were actually shipped. The recall comes after the federal Food and Drug Administration (FDA) issued a Class I warning for the product, forcing the company last month to step up public communications about its recall of nearly 780,000 Avaira Toric lenses. Category 1 product recalls are the most serious and involve problems that could result in serious adverse health consequences or death. Dozens of Avaira Sphere users have reported problems including blurred vision, pain and serious injuries, including damage to the cornea of ​​the eye, requiring emergency medical attention. Company officials were accused of conducting a "stealth recall" in August that left many consumers unaware that the products they were using were defective. Company officials pointed out that in addition to the above two products, silicone oil is also used in the production of other product lines. The company expects to set aside $9 million as cost reserves to expand the recall. All told, the company expects the recall to cost the company $23.2 million. For questions about the recall, consumers should contact the company at: 1-855-526-6737.

81f2acc449e6dc1626351b1dd056b9e6fc9a7c3b.sourceText: 食髓知味 大凤凰城区提销售税 (亚省时报) 提高销售税收入，刺激消费者消费欲望，是近期凤凰城大都会各城市急切摆脱因经济衰退带来的财政困境的有效方法。 几乎每一个大都会城市在今年头8个月都得到销售税收入大幅度增加的甜头。凤凰城在2010年4月增加了食品税后，至今年9月，整体销售税增加了16.4%，其中零售税增长8.6%，来自餐馆的税增长了11.6%。 在吉尔伯特，7月至9月零售销售税的收入，已取代建筑税，第一次成为总销售税的最大部分。皮奥里亚享有坚实的零售增长则是因为汽车销售回升。在2010年底的强劲复苏后，汽车销售市场已回升。像这样的可喜的数字，也出现在斯格斯代，格兰代，钱德勒等周边城市。 美莎是全国各大中城市中少数的异类，整天税收只增长了2.2%，零售税下跌了2.7%。 销售税在各城市预算占很大作用，35%?5%的市政预算基金来自销售税。税收增长可帮助城市裁员和服务削减。 假日季节近在眼前，消费者为省钱而头痛，商家为打开客人钱包各出奇谋，各税收部门则张开口袋等着白花花的银子，好不热闹。
81f2acc449e6dc1626351b1dd056b9e6fc9a7c3b.translatedText: Eat the marrow and know the taste. The Greater Phoenix Area proposes sales tax (Alberta Times) Increasing sales tax revenue and stimulating consumers' desire to spend is an effective way for cities in the Phoenix metropolitan area to escape from the financial difficulties caused by the economic recession. Nearly every metropolitan city saw a significant increase in sales tax revenue during the first eight months of the year. After Phoenix increased its food tax in April 2010, as of September this year, the overall sales tax increased by 16.4%, of which retail taxes increased by 8.6% and taxes from restaurants increased by 11.6%. In Gilbert, retail sales tax revenue from July to September has replaced construction taxes as the largest portion of total sales tax for the first time. Peoria enjoyed solid retail growth as auto sales picked up. After a strong recovery at the end of 2010, the car sales market has picked up. Promising numbers like this also appear in surrounding cities such as Scottsdale, Grande, and Chandler. Mesa is one of the few outliers among large and medium-sized cities across the country. Its tax revenue increased by only 2.2% throughout the day, and its retail tax fell by 2.7%. Sales tax plays a large role in city budgets, with 35% to 5% of municipal budget funds coming from sales tax. The tax increase could help cities with layoffs and service cuts. The holiday season is just around the corner. Consumers are struggling to save money, businesses are trying their best to open customers' wallets, and tax authorities are opening their pockets to wait for the money. It's so exciting.
