415d973a6663c3f02942ec2ab145985dd89e8894.sourceText: 羊城晚报讯 记者林圳报道： 连日来，北京大学中文系教授孔庆东用三句粗话拒绝记者采访、并通过 微博 炫耀粗话的事件（简称”三妈的”事件），引起舆论哗然并持续发酵。 新华社 11 日发表评论，敦促北大解聘孔庆东。 围绕该不该解聘孔庆东？北大学生俨然分成两派，观点对垒，但以在 ”北大未名 BBS”网站上发帖数量计，”倒孔派”人数远大于”挺孔派”。
415d973a6663c3f02942ec2ab145985dd89e8894.translatedText: Yangcheng Evening News Reporter Lin Zhen reported: In the past few days, Kong Qingdong, a professor of the Chinese Department of Peking University, refused to be interviewed by reporters using three swear words and posted on Weibo The incident of showing off foul language (referred to as the "Three Mom's Incident") caused an uproar in public opinion and continued to ferment. Xinhua News Agency published a comment on the 11th, urging Peking University to fire Kong Qingdong. Regarding whether Kong Qingdong should be fired? Peking University students are divided into two factions with competing views. However, based on the number of posts on the "Peking University Weiming BBS" website, the number of "anti-Confucius" faction is much larger than the "pro-Confucius faction".

83da18e404b0a24c91083c1679d9c7aba44c3ca0.sourceText: 13 日凌晨零时多，北大博士生江姓同学给羊城晚报报料称： ”北大的学生这几天在发起辞退孔庆东的活动！ 我和几个同学把他在第一视频说的那些毫无人性的话发到校长信箱，希望校长能够辞退这个’五毛教授’。 ”他称，这封信的题目是”应惩 戒 公 开 宣 扬 暴 力 的 北 大 名 教 授 孔 庆东”，作者 demokratia （骑驴觅驴）是住在他隔壁的同学。
83da18e404b0a24c91083c1679d9c7aba44c3ca0.translatedText: At around midnight on the 13th, a Peking University doctoral student surnamed Jiang reported to the Yangcheng Evening News: "Students at Peking University have been launching a campaign to fire Kong Qingdong these days! Several classmates and I sent the inhumane words he said in the first video to the principal's mailbox, hoping that the principal can fire this '50-cent professor.'" He said that the title of the letter was "Public promotion of violence should be punished" "The famous Peking University professor Kong Qingdong", the author demokratia (riding a donkey to find a donkey) is a classmate who lives next door to him.

1cb0fd7d470ef49b9ce3d59abb9fc68f440113bd.sourceText: 记者按江姓博士生的指引， 登录北大未名 BBS， 找到这封信。 信中称：”北大中文系孔庆东教授爆粗口应受到谴责，但更严重的问题是他多次在公共领域宣扬暴力。 在第一视频（2011 年 5 月 31 日）他公开说：’这个人 （指网友棗?#35760;者注）的真名实姓查出来，直接干掉不就完了嘛。 ‘在评论不同观点持有者时也声称，如果美国鬼子到北京，他孔庆东今天晚上就持刀把带路人贺某等统统干掉，让他们活不到天亮。 孔庆东先生享有的宪法所保障的基本权利应受到尊重，但这种对其他公民赤裸裸的暴力威胁，已远远超出言论自由的范围，也违背教师基本伦理。 2009 年孔庆东的助理杨春刀捅《新京报》编辑钱烈宪，仅因钱曾写文章批评过孔庆东。 北大校委会应依据相关规定约束和惩戒孔庆东，以防止更严重事故的发生。 ”
1cb0fd7d470ef49b9ce3d59abb9fc68f440113bd.translatedText: The reporter followed the instructions of the doctoral student named Jiang and logged into the Peking University Weiming BBS to find this letter. The letter stated: "Professor Kong Qingdong of the Department of Chinese at Peking University should be condemned for his foul language, but the more serious problem is that he has repeatedly promoted violence in the public domain. In the first video (May 31, 2011), he publicly said: 'If this person (referring to netizen Zao?#35760; note)'s real name is found out, can't he be killed directly?" "When commenting on those who hold different views, he also claimed that if the American devils came to Beijing, he, Kong Qingdong, would kill the guide He and others tonight with a knife, so that they would not live until dawn. The basic rights guaranteed by the constitution of Mr. Kong Qingdong should be respected, but this naked threat of violence to other citizens goes far beyond the scope of freedom of speech and violates the basic ethics of teachers. 2009 Kong Qingdong’s assistant Yang Chundao stabbed Qian Liexian, editor of the Beijing News, just because Qian had written an article criticizing Kong Qingdong. The Peking University School Committee should restrain and punish Kong Qingdong in accordance with relevant regulations to prevent more serious incidents from happening. "

039d5f630256f363e72a26ce5f56db933e59326c.sourceText: 一石激起千层浪！在这封信后，有不少同学跟帖力挺”孔庆东”点。 记者看到一名叫 ”jmx”的北大同学这样写道：”孔庆东曾骂学生说：’别以为叫我一声老师，就可以掩盖你的龌龊心理。文革是人民的正义起义，要收拾但没收拾利索的，就是你这种王八蛋！ ”’接着，该同学继续揭批孔庆东曾诅咒中国公民 ”哭爹喊娘看美国大片”、”你还是人吗？ ”，”我不知道中国人为什么这么无耻”。 ”jmx”请教北大校长周其凤：”周校长，您觉得您能接受这样的话吗？您觉得这是属于言论自由的范围吗？ ”
039d5f630256f363e72a26ce5f56db933e59326c.translatedText: One stone caused thousands of waves! After this letter, many students commented in support of the "Kong Qingdong" point. The reporter saw a Peking University classmate named "jmx" writing this way: "Kong Qingdong once scolded a student and said: 'Don't think that calling me teacher can cover up your dirty mentality. The Cultural Revolution was a righteous uprising of the people, and those who wanted to be dealt with but failed to deal with it were bastards like you!"' Then, the classmate continued to expose and criticize Kong Qingdong for cursing Chinese citizens for "crying for father and mother while watching American blockbusters" and "Are you still a human being?" ”, “I don’t know why Chinese people are so shameless”. "jmx" asked Peking University President Zhou Qifeng: "President Zhou, do you think you can accept such words? Do you think this falls within the scope of freedom of speech?"

399230237311f0fd4048ab0f8c818fc3ca10777d.sourceText: 截至记者发稿时止， 北大管理层并未对同学们的这封信作出任何回应。
399230237311f0fd4048ab0f8c818fc3ca10777d.translatedText: As of the time of publication, Peking University management has not responded to the students' letter.

d4028fdafd25a2e05f0c7221ea276702938de1b6.sourceText: 与此同时，在北大未名 BBS，记者还发现了一条与这封信观点针锋相对的帖子《建议北大保护孔庆东教授棗?#24403;代的鲁迅》，作者 stonetree（小甜甜）。帖子写道：”孔庆东教授即使真的骂了《南方周末》（应为《南方人物周刊》棗?#35760;者注）， 也是应该的，因为他们欠骂。 他们采访孔庆东，是在没事找事…我们校友坚决支持孔庆东教授， 请校方充分考虑我们广大校友的爱校之心，全力保护孔庆东教授！ ”
d4028fdafd25a2e05f0c7221ea276702938de1b6.translatedText: At the same time, on Peking University's Weiming BBS, the reporter also found a post that was diametrically opposed to the views of this letter, "Suggesting that Peking University protect Professor Kong Qingdong's Lu Xun in the Zao Dynasty", written by stonetree (Xiao Tiantian). The post read: "Even if Professor Kong Qingdong really scolded "Southern Weekend" (it should be the author's note of "Southern People Weekly"), he should do it because they deserve the scolding. They interviewed Kong Qingdong and they were just looking for trouble... We alumni firmly support Professor Kong Qingdong and ask the school to fully consider the love of our alumni for the school and fully protect Professor Kong Qingdong! "

fc011f33693b16981ca39990f914183bbbc5d614.sourceText: 然而，此帖一出，板砖纷飞。 CNstar 同学反驳说：”一边儿去吧，你算哪棵葱哪棵蒜可以代表北大校友？ 我就认为北大应该严肃处理孔庆东。 ”methane 讥讽说：”建议楼主每天给当代鲁迅站岗放哨， 发帖灌水， 以自己的实际行动保护这个生灵活现的大宝贝！ ”而 IronBlood 更是指斥孔庆东所谓”当代鲁迅”的”做派”： ”当代鲁迅的做法， 就是随便写了一些无关痛痒的吐槽之后， 把鲁迅小说集的着者改成自己的名字再出版而已。”
fc011f33693b16981ca39990f914183bbbc5d614.translatedText: However, as soon as this post came out, there was a lot of criticism. A CNstar student retorted: "Let's go, which onion and garlic can represent the alumni of Peking University? I think Peking University should deal with Kong Qingdong seriously." Methane sarcastically said: "I suggest that the poster should stand guard for contemporary Lu Xun every day, post water, and protect this living treasure with his own practical actions!" IronBlood even criticized Kong Qingdong's so-called "contemporary Lu Xun" "style": "What contemporary Lu Xun does is just write some innocuous complaints and then change the author of Lu Xun's novels to his own name before publishing them."

e507fe2b535ffce6b3067d965b2e616c53e7e01f.sourceText: 报人老真：旅行随笔之一—-不枉此辈来美
e507fe2b535ffce6b3067d965b2e616c53e7e01f.translatedText: Reporter Lao Zhen: One of the travel essays - It is not in vain for this generation to come to the United States

31fddf52e9b52ec987afc0357ce590f3fa67f2ee.sourceText: 报人老真：旅行随笔之一—-不枉此辈来美 年来，椎骨手术、康复、疗养，折腾了几个月后，医生说，外…
31fddf52e9b52ec987afc0357ce590f3fa67f2ee.translatedText: Reporter Lao Zhen: One of the travel essays - It is not in vain for this generation to come to the United States After several months of vertebral surgery, rehabilitation, and recuperation over the past year, the doctor said...

4e8a8a77c1639f544af23dfebb6df7ca5e423519.sourceText: 年来，椎骨手术、康复、疗养，折腾了几个月后，医生说，外出走走，活动下筋骨，抖擞下精神吧。於是，六月起，自南美到北美，从美西到美东，走了一个大纵横，圆了半个”走遍美国之梦”。果然，不负医生所望，眼界开阔了，脑袋充实了。 沿途，持著手杖，步履蹣跚．或跟随旅行团，或借参加会议之便，穿过了好几个大城市。跑马看花，领略名闻遐邇的风光景色。风光这边独好，早已尽在文人骚客笔下，无需赘述。已為老态龙钟者，驻足时与在当地的好友乡亲聚旧，茶餘饭后谈天说地，犹觉乐趣。 最初，北到西雅图。驱车来接机的是四十多年前的”文友”某先生。见面时，他第一句话问：”怎麼老态成这麼样啦？与上一次见面，相差太远了！” 记得上次相见，是十三年前，我和内室来美十年后首次回乡探亲。那时，某先生是故乡某某市副市长。他领著司机，亲自到港口来接船。几天，他领我夫妇俩参观侨胞捐建的学校，让我感到欢欣鼓舞，上上落落，何曾用过手杖呢！ 我答：”跨越古稀多年了，仍在’捱世界’，近年折驣又多，岁月不饶人，’天老人更老’。怎比您’好世界’，’永不老辣’呢。” 其实，某先生退休来美多年，全职做家庭车伕。每日，接送妻子上班，女儿上学。其餘时间，留意房地產行情。在為自己购屋安居后，装修翻新些旧房子出租，平平稳稳过日子。十年过去了，妻子退休享颐年，女儿接受了高等教育，毕业后在当地的一个大公司任职经济师。 那天，某先生及女儿女婿，陪我去佳婿（工程师）上班的Microsoft公司参观。置身於世界一流的大企业，看企业的建设规模和优越环境，目不暇给，真是”大乡里出城，多见树木少见人伦”。听介绍员工的生活福利待遇，似觉应有尽有，无微不至，叫人心花怒放。不禁兴叹；现代化的企业，在引领著人们应用先进的科学技术，為人类创造财富的同时，也為跟随企业团队一起拼搏的人们获得良好的福祉。这是社会反馈企业吧。忘记了是谁说过，”资本”两字是血淋淋的！在现实面前，我想那样的时代似乎过去了。 回想当年，某先生退休来美，离开官场，”布衣”外域為异客。从公家配给专车和车伕，到自己给家人当车伕，身体力行為音育下一代尽责，好不容易呢！如今，面对后代的成长，就算遑论曾经付出的代价，相信是无可菲薄也! 旅途中，与好友乡亲会面，所见所闻，类似某先生的歷程，大同小异者，不乏其人。共同的语言是：这辈子来美，為的是下一代！捫心自问，子孙后代，但愿”天降人才必付以大用”，他日能在有如Microsoft公司如此这般的环境工作和生活，足以自慰吾生，百年瞑目矣！ 看官，是否有同感？
4e8a8a77c1639f544af23dfebb6df7ca5e423519.translatedText: After several months of vertebral surgery, rehabilitation, and recuperation over the past year, the doctor said, go out for a walk, stretch your muscles, and cheer up. So, starting in June, I traveled a long way from South America to North America, from the west to the east of the United States, and fulfilled half of the "dream of traveling across the United States." Sure enough, it lived up to the doctor's expectations. My horizons were broadened and my mind was enriched. Along the way, he was holding a cane and walking hobbled. Either following a tour group or taking advantage of attending a conference, I traveled through several big cities. Go horse racing and enjoy the famous scenery. The scenery here is unique and beautiful, and it has already been described in the writings of literati and poets, so there is no need to elaborate. For those who have grown old, it is still fun to catch up with friends and fellow villagers in the local area and chat after tea and dinner. Initially, north to Seattle. The person who drove to pick me up at the airport was a certain gentleman who was a "literary friend" more than 40 years ago. When we met, his first question was: "Why are you so old? It's so different from the last time we met!" I remember that the last time we met was thirteen years ago, when Uchimuro and I returned to our hometown to visit relatives for the first time ten years after we came to the United States. At that time, Mr. XX was the deputy mayor of XX city in his hometown. He led the driver and personally went to the port to pick up the ship. For a few days, he took me and my wife to visit a school donated by overseas Chinese. I felt so happy that I never used a cane when I was going up and down! I replied: "It's been many years since ancient times, and I'm still 'confronting the world.' In recent years, there have been many setbacks, and time is not forgiving. 'God is older'. How can I 'better the world' and 'never be old' than you." In fact, a certain gentleman retired and came to the United States for many years, and worked full-time as a family car driver. Every day, I take my wife to work and my daughter to school. During the rest of the time, pay attention to the real estate market. After buying a house for myself, I renovated some old houses and rented them out to live a stable life. Ten years have passed. My wife has retired and is enjoying her old age. My daughter has received higher education and worked as an economist in a large local company after graduation. That day, a certain husband and his daughter and son-in-law accompanied me to visit the Microsoft company where my husband-in-law (an engineer) worked. When you are in a world-class large enterprise, you will be overwhelmed by its construction scale and superior environment. It is true that "in a big country, there are many trees but few people outside the city." After listening to the introduction of the employees' living welfare benefits, it seems that they have everything they need and are taken care of in every possible way, which makes people happy. I can’t help but sigh; modern enterprises, while leading people to apply advanced science and technology and creating wealth for mankind, also obtain good benefits for the people who work hard together with the enterprise team. This is a social feedback company. I forgot who said that the word "capital" is bloody! In the face of reality, I think that era seems to have passed. Recalling the time when a certain gentleman retired and came to the United States, he left the officialdom and became a stranger in a foreign land. From the government allocating special cars and drivers to working as a driver for my family, I have devoted myself to educating the next generation. It’s not easy! Nowadays, facing the growth of future generations, even if we don’t consider the price we have paid, I believe it is nothing to belittle! During the journey, I met friends and fellow villagers, and what I saw and heard was similar to Mr. X’s journey. There are many people who are similar to him. The common language is: Come to the United States in this life for the next generation! Ask yourself, future generations, I hope that "talents sent from heaven must be put to great use". In the future, they can work and live in an environment like Microsoft's, which is enough to comfort them for the rest of their lives, and they can rest in peace for a hundred years! Officer, do you feel the same way?

44e9af15750548336ac0391e16fb7dcd01e426b5.translatedText: Phoenix City Yang Shiquan: Ode to Hawaii The blue sky embraces the blue sea, and the sun shines on the green island. The waves kiss the beach gently, and the coconut breeze blows refreshingly. Tourists are surfing in the water, couples are in pairs...

275d7dfa47ecdbce689561c97ca200dc413f5695.sourceText: 蓝天拥抱碧海， 阳光普照绿岛。 海浪轻吻沙滩， 椰风阵阵送爽。 游人双双在水中衝浪， 情侣对对在海滩徜徉。 高楼林立在绿茵中， 汽车穿梭在地平线上。 咖啡园中飘溢著醉人的芳香， 火山口上白烟裊裊向上。 珍珠港事件招示， 和平是人类的共同愿望。 美丽的夏威夷，令人神往！
275d7dfa47ecdbce689561c97ca200dc413f5695.translatedText: The blue sky embraces the blue sea, and the sun shines on the green island. The waves kiss the beach gently, and the coconut breeze blows refreshingly. Tourists are surfing in the water, and couples are wandering on the beach. High-rise buildings stand among the greenery, and cars drive across the horizon. The coffee garden is filled with intoxicating aroma, and white smoke curls upward from the crater. The Pearl Harbor incident reminded us that peace is the common aspiration of mankind. Beautiful Hawaii is fascinating!

c623ffe1c150bb8e4d0ced90952029a98edb790f.sourceText: 语言文字是人类沟通的工具。中文，当然是我们中国人最纯熟的工具了。 香港虽然曾经长期被外人统治，香港人始终还是中国人，大家都看中文报纸、听中文收音机、看中文电视。讲的话虽然是方言，广东以外的人或许听不懂，本地人就没有不懂之理。文字比较复杂一点，也许需要有点文化基础。不过文盲到底不多，因此也鲜有人看不懂中文的。我自己就是个例子，从小学中文，又是一名老香港，过去数十年，从不曾為语文问题伤过脑筋。可是移民美国之后，再回去，就发觉有点不对，而且越往后，问题就越多。 香港话本属广东话。在我们心目中，香港根本是广东的一部份。但由於香港长期华洋杂处，中英文并重，因而洋為中用、中英夹杂的情形在所不免，结果香港话自成一格，语汇要比本来的广东话丰富得多，像搭巴士呀、OK啦、我的FRIEND，诸如此类，都是从前所没有的。我们海外侨胞也搭巴士，也有许多FRIEND，自然也OK。可是，你知不知道「一球」是甚麼意思吗﹖与居港的小儿话家常，不时听到球、球声，竟不明所指。小子的广东话是跟老子学的，莫不是青出於蓝，老子现在反而落后了﹖ 一点也没错！老香港变成了新乡里，正是因為太老了！ 原来「一球」是「一旧」、「一撤 」、「一粒」的延伸，因為港币贬了值，物价涨了不少，一百元、一千元、一万元已不大济事，想做点什麼，动輒要以百万计，「一球」正是一百万元的意思呢！ 不少市井俚语、黑社会暗话，以及许许多多即兴创作的形容词、名词、短语和俏皮话，都成了香港人的口头禪，弄得我们这些新乡里目瞪口呆，一头雾水。乍听起来，香港话好像是更加生动活泼、更加丰富多彩了，但是同时，也好像是更加洋气、更加俗气了。 那晚电视台搞华裔小姐选美，司仪问一位从外国回来参加比赛的佳丽，下面几个词语之中，哪一句是与吃有关的。那是棗 照田鷄、茄哩菲、钓泥鯭、文雀、飞沙走石、卖老柚。 老香港想了老半天，终於恍然：「照田鷄」是指看相；「茄哩菲」是指不大重要的演员；「钓泥鯭」是指计程车司机一次兜揽几个散客；「文雀」是指小偷；「飞沙走石」棗炒哉！指的竟是喝咖啡不加奶不下糖，形容得多麼维妙维俏、生 动有趣！至於「卖老柚」，则始终知所云。问过比我们迟移民的朋友，也不明白。 类似的词语共有三组，分别向三位外来的佳丽发问，当然都交白卷。第二组是「走鬼」、「走鷄」与「走青」，也是问哪一句与吃有关。我知道「走鬼」是指无牌小贩走避警察，「走鷄」是指错失良机；那麼答「走青」大概就对，但还是要由司仪点明「免葱」，解释葱是青色的，才茅塞顿开。 第三组更妙，充份体现了香港话之中英并用、抵死古惑的特性。可惜又是由於不知所云，只顾得动脑筋，未能及时记录下来。 通过一些生动的形容，贴切的比喻，往往可使一句话更加形象化、更加动听，或者听起来更加亲切、更加有味道、更加抵死棗甚麼是抵死呢﹖此「抵死」可不是指至死不变主意的那个「抵死」。我也说不清楚，只知道有些原是广东话的电影，被译配成普通话之后，许多对白就不再那麼「抵死」，也不再那麼有味道了。方言确实是有其独特的地方色彩呢！ 文字是人造的，话也是人说出来的，有多丰富的生活，便有多丰富的语文。香港是世界上一个最特殊、最复杂的都市，因此她的语文也就必然比别的地方来得更為多姿多彩。这是毋庸置疑的。 中国有五大方言。為了交往上的便利，讲广东话、福建话、上海话、客家话或 潮州话的人，多学会了普通话；同样，南来香港的内陆人，也得学讲广东话。假若有个上海女人操着纯正的寧波话大駡老公，而她的广东老公，照样用他地道的台山话回敬她的话，那将会是多麼热闹，又多麼有趣！ 中国的文字 (汉字) 早就统一了。上海人依旧可以讲阿拉、儂，上海的报纸却只会刊出我或你。你可以听不懂上海话，但断然不会看不懂上海出版的报纸。香港却不然，正如这个城市的名称叫「特别行政区」一样的特别，有些报纸，不只上海人看不懂，连我这个给报纸写稿的老香港，居然也看不懂！ 「无线大细超，戳XXX唔抵！」 「XXX结婚，XXX娶妻，十吓十吓。」 这是某报两篇文章的标题，你懂吗﹖或者懂，但一定有人不懂，或者不全懂。可能这是强迫「外人」学广东话的好办法。不过假使人人坚持各说各的话，你说这是盐，我偏说是上味，只闻嘈吵一片，说了也是等於没说。 文字是给人看的，话是给人听的，要是所说、所写的别人都不懂，我们又何必多此一举呢！
c623ffe1c150bb8e4d0ced90952029a98edb790f.translatedText: Language is a tool for human communication. Chinese is, of course, the most proficient tool for us Chinese. Although Hong Kong has been ruled by outsiders for a long time, Hong Kong people have always been Chinese. Everyone reads Chinese newspapers, listens to Chinese radios, and watches Chinese TV. Although the words spoken are in dialect, people outside Guangdong may not understand them, but the locals have no reason to understand. The text is a little more complicated and may require some cultural foundation. However, there are not many illiterates, so there are very few people who cannot read Chinese. I am an example myself. I have learned Chinese since primary school and am an old Hong Konger. In the past few decades, I have never had to worry about language issues. But after immigrating to the United States, I realized something was wrong when I returned back, and the further I went back, the more problems there were. Hong Kong dialect is originally Cantonese. In our minds, Hong Kong is basically a part of Guangdong. However, because Hong Kong has long been a mixture of Chinese and foreign languages, both Chinese and English are valued equally, so it is inevitable that foreign languages ​​will be used in Chinese and Chinese and English will be mixed. As a result, Hong Kong dialect has its own style, with a much richer vocabulary than the original Cantonese, such as taking a bus, OK, my FRIEND, and so on, which have never existed before. We overseas Chinese also take the bus, and there are many friends there, so it’s naturally OK. But, do you know what "one goal" means? I talk to my children who live in Hong Kong. I hear the sound of a ball from time to time, but I don’t know what it means. The boy learned his Cantonese from me. Could it be that he was better than his master and now I am lagging behind? That’s absolutely right! Old Hong Kong has become Xinxiangli, precisely because it is too old! It turns out that "one goal" is an extension of "one old", "one withdrawal", and "one pill". Because the Hong Kong dollar has depreciated and prices have risen a lot, one hundred, one thousand, and ten thousand dollars are no longer of much help. If you want to do something, you often have to spend millions. "One goal" exactly means one million dollars! Many street slangs, underworld code words, and many improvised adjectives, nouns, phrases and witticisms have become the mantra of Hong Kong people, leaving us in Xinxiang stunned and confused. At first glance, Hong Kong dialect seems to be more lively and colorful, but at the same time, it also seems to be more foreign and tacky. That night, the TV station held a Miss Chinese beauty pageant. The host asked a beauty who had returned from abroad to participate in the competition, which of the following words was related to eating. Those are Zao Zhao Frog, Qie Lifei, Fishing for Niji, Wenque, Flying Sand and Stones, and Selling Old Pomelo. The old Hong Kong man thought about it for a long time, and finally it dawned on him: "Zhao Frog" refers to fortune telling; "Qie Lifei" refers to an actor who is not very important; "Diao Niji" refers to a taxi driver picking up a few individual tourists at a time; "Wenque" refers to a thief; "Flying Sand and Stone" is a jujube! It actually refers to drinking coffee without milk or sugar. What a vivid, lively and interesting description! As for "selling pomelo", I always know what I mean. I asked friends who immigrated later than us and they didn’t understand. There were three groups of similar words, and questions were asked to three foreign beauties respectively, and of course they all turned in blanks. The second group is "Zougui", "Zouchi" and "Zouqing", and we also ask which sentence is related to eating. I know that "walking away" refers to unlicensed hawkers avoiding the police, and "walking chicken" refers to missing an opportunity. So "walking green" is probably the right answer, but the master of ceremonies still has to point out "avoid green onions" and explain that green onions are green, and then the enlightenment suddenly comes. The third set is even better, fully embodying the characteristics of Hong Kong dialect that use both Chinese and English to overcome the confusion. It's a pity that because I didn't understand what was said, I was only thinking about it and couldn't record it in time. Through some vivid descriptions and appropriate metaphors, a sentence can often be made more vivid, more beautiful, or sound more friendly, more flavorful, and more satisfying. What is "defying death"? This "fighting against death" does not refer to the "fighting against death" that does not change one's mind until death. I can’t explain it clearly, I just know that after some movies that were originally in Cantonese were dubbed into Mandarin, many of the dialogues were no longer so “gritty” or interesting. Dialects indeed have their own unique local color! Words are man-made and words are spoken by people. The richer the life, the richer the language. Hong Kong is one of the most special and complex cities in the world, so its language must be more colorful than other places. There is no doubt about it. China has five major dialects. In order to facilitate communication, many people who speak Cantonese, Fujian, Shanghainese, Hakka or Teochew have learned Mandarin; similarly, inland people who come to Hong Kong from the south also have to learn to speak Cantonese. If a Shanghai woman curses her husband in pure Ningbo dialect, and her Cantonese husband replies in his authentic Taishan dialect, how lively and interesting it will be! Chinese writing (Hanzi) has long been unified. People in Shanghai can still talk about Allah and Nong, but Shanghai newspapers will only publish about me or you. You may not be able to understand Shanghainese, but you definitely won’t be unable to read newspapers published in Shanghai. This is not the case in Hong Kong. Just as the name of this city is "Special Administrative Region", some newspapers are not only incomprehensible to Shanghainese, but even I, an old Hong Konger who writes for newspapers, can't understand them! "Wireless large and small supermarkets, stamping XXX is not worth it!" "XXX gets married, XXX marries a wife, it's very scary." These are the titles of two articles in a certain newspaper, do you understand? Maybe they understand, but there must be people who don’t understand, or don’t fully understand. Maybe this is a good way to force "outsiders" to learn Cantonese. But if everyone insists on talking about it, you say it's salt, and I say it's flavorful, and all you hear is a lot of noise, and saying it means not saying anything. Words are for people to read and words are for people to listen to. If others don’t understand what we say or write, why should we bother with it!

a08a5bae7c429db076f8d1fba0144bb3845939cc.sourceText: 我这次登记加拿大洛磯山七日游，选择由西雅图进出，是準备完成旅程后，继续逗留三天，探访久别十多年的朋友。 十月三日清晨六时许，我夫妇乘坐阿拉斯加航空，由凤凰城飞抵西雅图，刚好超过九时，领取行李之后，贴上「黄金假期」的标记在胸襟，等待导游来迎接，大约十五分鐘左右，一个中年导游到来，自称姓谢，带我们到机场大楼出口的座位处集中，等待他逐一接应各地旅客，总共十四人，有两对越南夫妇，其餘是台湾、陆客与美国华人，十一时登上旅行车，展开七日游的行程。 第一站是西雅图市区观光，导游风趣地讲述此地為什麼叫西雅图 (Seattle)，有学识的人知道是纪念一个印地安酋长的名字，他排解了当地白人跟印地安人之间的纠纷。但我曾听说一个趣闻，西雅图的命名是误打误撞而来，当年英国人到此询问一位农夫，这裡是什麼地方，两人相隔较远，农夫以為客套式打个招呼，自己又要赶回家，遂边走边举手说：「See you tomorrow」（明天再见）英国人听不清楚，只听见一串Se – a – ttle声音，就叫西雅图。 导游却另有谐趣版本，指出西雅图是中文译音，传说有个华人家庭居住在西雅图外围，生育一个女儿，长大爱上了当地青年，父母的传统旧观念当然大加反对，其女不顾一切私奔了，父亲破口大骂「死丫头！」刚好有英国探险者经过，指著前面询问叫做什麼地方，他不懂英文，只见指著女儿出走的方向，餘怒未息地点头，大声说：「对呀！死丫头就是去了那裡呀！」因此，西雅图Seattle就是「死丫头」的译音。 不论说法如何，我们已身在西雅图，先到唐人街瀏览，同时用午餐，顺道接载两位在这裡登车的台湾团员，还有两位女客因班机迟误，全团不能久候，只好等下午让其自搭计程车归队。 旅行团在日本商场下车，导游介绍这裡购物方便，饮食便宜，我内心不安地滴咕著：為什麼要光顾日本商场，近来钓鱼台事件不是闹得气氛沸腾吗？选择这个地点有没有麻烦呢？但我顾虑多餘，只见所有华人同胞若无其事，毫无异议，大家拥入商场去，各适其适。我进去行走一圈，市场枉盛，似乎中日钓鱼台纠纷没有影响到这裡。商场裡面有多种餐馆，我照常喜欢嚐试越南风味，但望见对面的日本寿司料理，顾客排队等候，显然生意不俗，一片和谐。 午餐后，车子环绕市区，让大家坐车观景，导游不停讲述，指东指西，这裡是联合湖上的湖屋啦，那裡是阿拉斯加邮轮起程的海滨啦，前面是古老农业市场啦，高处是太空针塔啦，低处是鮭鱼迴游运河啦厖看来景点真不少，只不过时间所限，行色匆匆，仅仅表示曾经亲临胜地，到此一游而已。 这些景观，以太空针塔最具代表性，是西雅图的地标，五十年前世界博览会的雄伟建筑物，高度一百八十多公尺，塔楼是飞碟形状，设置迴旋餐厅和观景台，顶端中心建有长针指向太空，所以叫太空针塔，旅行团没有时间登上参观，只能在远处旁边公园观赏，拍摄高耸景象。 比较有趣的是古老农產派克市场（Pike Place Market），位於市中心区，只见这裡有许多商店和手工艺术家，也有各项街头表演，游客拥挤。最突出是一家卖鱼市场，售货员互相抛掷的技巧，有如玩魔术般，吸引最多游客聚集观看。再前去是星巴克咖啡始创的首间店舖，现仍维持经营，出售高质量的咖啡豆和咖啡器材，特别保留原来的商标，是长髮女郎裸露双乳的图像。 旅行团继续转往参观运河和水坝园区，这裡的特色是河床与湖泊水位高低不平，必须兴建水闸调节水位，让船隻顺利进出运河，又因水坝阻碍了鱼群迴游的路径，要建造鱼梯，设计复合式水池，提供鱼群迴游之用。据说鮭鱼成长后离开出生地，飘洋过海生活，四年后返回故里，產卵繁殖，老死家乡，所以有时看到数十万的鮭鱼顺著鱼梯往内陆迴游，非常壮观，但我们短暂的停留，只看见船隻进入运河，没有看到大量鮭鱼迴游过程，看不见鱼跃梯级奇景。 西雅图的名字与几个景点，都相当有趣，匆匆参观，也留下好印象，諶旅行团有个满意的开始。随后旅行车驶出五号高速公路，直向温哥华进发，在美加边境办理出入景手续，傍晚抵达目的地，先去一家中餐馆用过晚餐，然后到机场海岸旅馆(Coast Vancouver Airport Hotel)住宿，结束第一日旅程。
a08a5bae7c429db076f8d1fba0144bb3845939cc.translatedText: This time I signed up for a seven-day tour of the Canadian Rockies and chose to enter and exit from Seattle. I planned to stay for three days after completing the trip to visit friends I had not seen for more than ten years. At about 6 a.m. on October 3rd, my husband and I took the Alaska Airlines flight from Phoenix to Seattle. It was just past 9 a.m. After collecting our luggage, we put a "Golden Vacation" label on our chests and waited for the tour guide to greet us. About fifteen minutes later, a middle-aged tour guide, who introduced himself as Xie, took us to the seats at the exit of the airport building to gather and wait for him to pick up the passengers one by one. There were 14 people in total, including two Vietnamese couples, and the rest were Taiwanese, Mainland Chinese and Chinese Americans. At 11 o'clock, we boarded the station wagon and started the seven-day tour. The first stop was a city tour of Seattle. The tour guide interestingly explained why this place is called Seattle. Knowledgeable people know that it is to commemorate the name of an Indian chief who resolved disputes between local whites and Indians. But I once heard an interesting anecdote. Seattle was named by accident. At that time, an Englishman came here and asked a farmer where this place was. The two were far apart. The farmer thought it was a polite greeting and he had to rush home. So he raised his hand and said, "See you tomorrow" as he walked. The Englishman could not hear clearly. He only heard a string of Se-a-ttle sounds, which was called Seattle. The tour guide had another humorous version, pointing out that "Seattle" is the Chinese transliteration. Legend has it that there was a Chinese family living outside Seattle who gave birth to a daughter. She grew up and fell in love with a local youth. Of course her parents were very opposed to the traditional ideas. The daughter eloped regardless of everything, and the father yelled, "Damn girl!" Fortunately, a British explorer passed by and pointed to the front and asked what the place was called. He didn't know English, so he pointed in the direction where his daughter had left. He nodded angrily and said loudly: "That's right! That's where the dead girl went!" Therefore, Seattle is the transliteration of "Dead Girl". No matter what the story is, we are already in Seattle. We visited Chinatown first and had lunch at the same time. We also picked up two Taiwanese group members who were boarding the bus here. There were also two female passengers because their flights were delayed. The whole group could not wait for long, so we had to wait until the afternoon to let them take a taxi back to the group. The tour group got off the bus at a Japanese shopping mall. The tour guide said that shopping here is convenient and the food is cheap. I thought uneasily in my heart: Why should I visit a Japanese shopping mall? Didn’t the Diaoyutai incident make the atmosphere boiling over recently? Was there any trouble choosing this location? But my worries were unnecessary. I saw all the Chinese compatriots as if nothing had happened and no objections. They all crowded into the mall and everyone was doing what they wanted. I went in and walked around. The market was in vain. It seemed that the Sino-Japanese Diaoyutai dispute had not affected this place. There are a variety of restaurants in the mall. I usually like to try Vietnamese food, but when I saw the Japanese sushi restaurant opposite, customers were queuing up. It was obvious that the business was good and the atmosphere was harmonious. After lunch, the car circled the city and allowed everyone to take a look at the scenery. The tour guide kept telling us, pointing east and west, that this is the lake house on Lake Union, that is the seaside where the Alaskan cruise ship departs, in front is the ancient agricultural market, at the top is the Space Needle, and at the bottom is the salmon canal. It seems that there are really many attractions, but the time is limited and the trip is in a hurry. It just means that I have been to the resort in person and have visited here. Among these landscapes, the Space Needle is the most representative and is a landmark of Seattle. It was a majestic building built at the World Exposition fifty years ago, with a height of more than 180 meters. The tower is shaped like a flying saucer, with a revolving restaurant and an observation deck. There is a long needle in the center of the top pointing toward space, so it is called the Space Needle. The tour group does not have time to climb up and visit, so they can only watch it in the nearby park in the distance and take photos of the towering scene. What is more interesting is the ancient Pike Place Market, located in the city center. There are many shops and handicraft artists here, as well as various street performances, and it is crowded with tourists. The most outstanding one is a fish market, where the salespeople's throwing skills are like magic tricks, attracting the most tourists to gather and watch. Going back is the first store founded by Starbucks Coffee. It is still in operation and sells high-quality coffee beans and coffee equipment. It especially retains the original trademark, which is an image of a long-haired girl with exposed breasts. The tour group continued to visit the canal and dam park. The characteristic here is that the water levels of the riverbed and lakes are uneven. Sluices must be built to regulate the water level to allow ships to enter and exit the canal smoothly. Also, because the dams hinder the migration paths of fish, fish ladders must be built and composite pools must be designed to provide for the migration of fish. It is said that after salmon grow up, they leave their birthplace and live across the ocean. After four years, they return to their hometown, lay eggs and reproduce, and die in their hometown. Therefore, sometimes hundreds of thousands of salmon are seen swimming back inland along the fish ladder, which is very spectacular. However, during our short stay, we only saw ships entering the canal. We did not see a large number of salmon migrating back, and we could not see the spectacle of fish jumping up the ladder. Seattle's name and several attractions are quite interesting. A quick visit left a good impression, and Chen's tour group got off to a satisfactory start. The tour bus then exited Highway 5 and headed straight to Vancouver. It went through the entry and exit procedures at the US-Canada border. It arrived at its destination in the evening. It went to a Chinese restaurant for dinner and then stayed at the Coast Vancouver Airport Hotel to end the first day of the journey.

ff98ce2800d2d1cbf2373079d144ffc75a07157f.sourceText: 劫iPhone祸延全美 用户当心
ff98ce2800d2d1cbf2373079d144ffc75a07157f.translatedText: iPhone robberies are spreading across the United States. Users beware.

86216248e5faeac8accc300fb5dce5e34159080f.sourceText: 劫iPhone祸延全美 用户当心 从美东纽约市到美西旧金山、洛杉矶市，大胆抢手机的罪行已在全美迅速蔓延，像…
86216248e5faeac8accc300fb5dce5e34159080f.translatedText: iPhone robberies are spreading across the United States. Users beware. From New York City in the east of the United States to San Francisco and Los Angeles in the west, the crime of bold cell phone snatching has spread rapidly across the United States, like...

14d4ec2d8a5c20df6d7c60e930371660a5e66b13.sourceText: 劫iPhone祸延全美 用户当心 从美东纽约市到美西旧金山、洛杉矶市，大胆抢手机的罪行已在全美迅速蔓延，像过去的「抢钱包」一样司空见惯。 抢匪最中意的目标，是抢手的iPhone，做案手法包括神不知鬼不觉抄走、用武力硬夺，甚至掏枪硬抢。 旧金山警方报称，全市今年所有的抢案，将近半数与手机有关，而且大多数发生在捷运系统。 纽约市警方也表示，全市将近40%的抢案与手机有关。 在洛杉矶市，手机抢案占全市所有抢案的四分之一以上，比去年增加了27%。 抢匪的手法包括在巴士上坐在毫无戒心的受害人旁边，趁对方下车时从后面猛抢，数秒之内就得手。 还有一名抢匪在巴士女乘客仍在通话时即抢走她的iPhone。 加州屋仑市17日更发生令人感到讽刺的抢案。 市议员候选人凯尔布刚参加完社区反犯罪会议，就在枪口下被人抢走iPhone。 旧金山高级警官贾瑞蒂说，警方大约两年前发现这个趋势。 他说：「很多年轻人几乎一辈子都靠这种昂贵的电子装置过日子。」 偷、抢手机(尤其是昂贵的无所不能的智慧手机)已使消费者损失数以百万计的金钱，执法机构和全国的无线通讯公司都在设法研究手机防盗防抢对策。 智慧手机内除了使用者的照片、音乐档案，还有机密的私人电邮帐户和银行帐户资料，风险更大。 旧金山警方的做法包括在捷运系统派出便衣警察，加强宣​​导，警告人们「聪明使用您的智慧手机」。 在纽约市，最新的iPhone 5手机上市后，警方鼓励买主向警方登记手机序号，以便追踪。 圣路易市则从防止销赃下手，准备下令转售手机者取得二手手机交易商执照，转售者需要提供手机辨识号码、搜集卖主的姓名、住址及一份驾照影本，甚至大拇指指纹。
14d4ec2d8a5c20df6d7c60e930371660a5e66b13.translatedText: iPhone robberies are spreading across the United States. Users beware. From New York City in the east to San Francisco and Los Angeles in the west, the crime of bold cell phone snatching has spread rapidly across the United States, becoming as commonplace as "wallet snatching" in the past. The favorite target of robbers is the sought-after iPhone. Their modus operandi includes stealing it without anyone noticing, using force to seize it, and even grabbing it with a gun. San Francisco police reported that nearly half of all robberies in the city this year were related to mobile phones, and most of them occurred on the rapid transit system. The New York City police also stated that nearly 40% of robberies in the city were related to mobile phones. In Los Angeles, cell phone robberies accounted for more than a quarter of all robberies in the city, a 27% increase from last year. The robber's tactics include sitting next to an unsuspecting victim on a bus and grabbing him from behind as he exits the bus, killing him within seconds. Another robber snatched a female bus passenger’s iPhone while she was still talking on the phone. An ironic robbery occurred in Oakland, California on the 17th. Kalb, a candidate for city council, had just finished attending a community anti-crime meeting when his iPhone was robbed at gunpoint. San Francisco Senior Sergeant Jarrity said police discovered the trend about two years ago. He said: "Many young people have lived almost their entire lives on this expensive electronic device." Theft and robbery of mobile phones (especially expensive, all-powerful smartphones) have cost consumers millions of dollars, and law enforcement agencies and wireless communication companies across the country are trying to develop anti-theft and anti-robbery countermeasures for mobile phones. In addition to the user's photos and music files, smartphones also contain confidential personal email account and bank account information, posing greater risks. The San Francisco police's approach includes dispatching plainclothes officers to the rapid transit system, stepping up publicity, and warning people to "use your smartphone smartly." In New York City, after the latest iPhone 5 mobile phone was launched, the police encouraged buyers to register the phone's serial number with the police for tracking. In order to prevent the sale of stolen goods, the city of St. Louis is planning to order those who resell mobile phones to obtain a second-hand mobile phone dealer license. The reseller needs to provide the mobile phone identification number, collect the seller's name, address, a copy of the driver's license, and even thumbprints.

4253b5a701c6ee53867868e9f7a1f56a3d69eeb9.sourceText: 南方报和新华社呼吁勿解聘孔庆东
4253b5a701c6ee53867868e9f7a1f56a3d69eeb9.translatedText: Nanfang Daily and Xinhua News Agency appealed not to fire Kong Qingdong

9caffdd43c1bac7f33bf13d33b80de436a1f0363.sourceText: 南方报和新华社呼吁勿解聘孔庆东 北京大学教授孔庆东用三句粗话拒绝南方报系《南方人物周刊》记者采访，并通过微博…
9caffdd43c1bac7f33bf13d33b80de436a1f0363.translatedText: Nanfang Daily and Xinhua News Agency appealed not to fire Kong Qingdong Kong Qingdong, a professor at Peking University, refused an interview with a reporter from Southern People Weekly, a newspaper affiliated with the Southern News, using three foul words, and posted the incident on Weibo...

fa2c0bc89ad8db682eafa1a117d4191f81d3db81.sourceText: 北京大学教授孔庆东用三句粗话拒绝南方报系《南方人物周刊》记者采访，并通过微博炫耀粗话的事件，引起舆论哗然并持续发酵。新华社11月10日发表评论敦促北大解聘孔庆东，南方报系《南方都市报》与全国媒体一道，掀起倒孔潮。但在北大学生呼吁校长辞退孔庆东之后，《南方都市报》和新华社态度出现逆转，呼吁北大刀下留人。
fa2c0bc89ad8db682eafa1a117d4191f81d3db81.translatedText: Kong Qingdong, a professor at Peking University, refused an interview with a reporter from Southern People Weekly, a southern newspaper, with three foul words, and showed off the foul language through Weibo, which caused an uproar in public opinion and continued to ferment. Xinhua News Agency published a comment on November 10 urging Peking University to fire Kong Qingdong, and Nanfang Daily and Southern Metropolis Daily joined the national media to start a wave of dismissal of Kong Qingdong. However, after Peking University students called on the president to fire Kong Qingdong, Southern Metropolis Daily and Xinhua News Agency reversed their attitude and called on Peking University to retain him.

eac9b0d529c691de373ca2342b38d50b42a451b9.sourceText: 《南方都市报》11月15日评论说，要是看到孔庆东的言论，大概谁都会觉得他在宣扬暴力。比如他总挂在嘴边的”汉奸”、”带路党”是有所指的，甚至有明确所指的就是他在北大的一位同事。两人观点不同，孔庆东居然就假设了一个场景：如果美国鬼子到北京，他孔庆东今天晚上就持刀把带路人某某某等统统干掉，让他们活不到天亮棗这种言论的荒谬在于，不但假设了一个美国进攻中国、与中国大国崛起形象完全不符的场景，还假设别人要去为美军带路，这种威胁本身就显得像一种既无知又猥琐的自我标榜的伟大了。但这些所谓宣扬暴力也只不过是嘴上说说罢了，孔庆东本人绝对不会真有这种胆量与执行力的。这些话说出来不过相当于语气助词，加强旁观者印象、凸显出自己的高大形象罢了，说不上真的有什么暴力威胁。估计孔庆东在现实生活里，看见厉害点儿的京巴都会绕着走。
eac9b0d529c691de373ca2342b38d50b42a451b9.translatedText: "Southern Metropolis Daily" commented on November 15 that if they saw Kong Qingdong's remarks, everyone would probably think that he was advocating violence. For example, the "traitors" and "leaders" he always talks about are referring to something, and he even clearly refers to one of his colleagues at Peking University. The two people had different views. Kong Qingdong actually hypothesized a scenario: If the American devils came to Beijing, he, Kong Qingdong, would kill all the guides tonight with a knife, so that they would not live until dawn. The absurdity of this statement is that it not only assumes a scenario in which the United States attacks China, which is completely inconsistent with the image of China's rise as a great power, but also assumes that others will lead the way for the US military. This threat itself seems like a self-proclaimed greatness that is both ignorant and obscene. But these so-called promotions of violence are just words. Kong Qingdong himself will never really have the courage and execution ability. These words are nothing more than modal particles to enhance the impression of onlookers and highlight his tall image. There is no real threat of violence. It is estimated that in real life, Kong Qingdong would walk away from the more powerful Jingba.

02684f6b5db4dec66f1fa3c6b358eab3724f66c3.sourceText: 评论说，在一个正常的社会里，包容异端不但是异端本身应该具有的权利，也是其他社会成员的一种义务。大学就更应该如此，当初大学的建立本身就是一种异端，把知识传授给普罗大众而不是垄断在僧侣、祭司的手中，这本身就是一种异端的行为，颠覆了整个知识的传承方式。所以，包容孔庆东以及他的那些语气助词，并不是包容真正的暴力，而是延续一种精神的力量，这种力量在早期的北大曾经是一种共识，现在也不该绝了这血脉。
02684f6b5db4dec66f1fa3c6b358eab3724f66c3.translatedText: commented that in a normal society, tolerance of heretics is not only a right that the heretics themselves should have, but also an obligation of other members of society. This is especially true for universities. The establishment of universities was itself a heresy. Teaching knowledge to the general public instead of monopolizing it in the hands of monks and priests was a heretical act in itself, subverting the entire way of inheritance of knowledge. Therefore, tolerating Kong Qingdong and his modal particles is not to tolerate real violence, but to continue a spiritual power. This power was once a consensus in the early Peking University, and this bloodline should not be extinguished now.

886bc4586576dfda168f5fd14f2a9d43cf6d83b9.sourceText: 另外，打响解聘孔庆东第一枪的新华社的立场也开始转软。11月16日，新华网转载《沈阳晚报》文章《孔庆东事件，不劳权力干预》说，高校是对教授负有管理之责，但这管理也并不能及于八小时之外。当年即便是有所谓”政治问题”者，如旧帝制派的辜鸿铭、新帝制派的刘师培，只要不把宣扬帝制带进校园，带上课堂，北大都是可以宽容的。这也是曾有传统的。当然，受侮辱记者完全可以提起诉讼，交由法院来裁夺。完全可以诉诸法律谋求解决的事，动辄就诉诸权力，呼吁权力在握者出手干预，实在不是一件好事情。
886bc4586576dfda168f5fd14f2a9d43cf6d83b9.translatedText: In addition, the position of Xinhua News Agency, which fired the first shot at dismissing Kong Qingdong, has also begun to soften. On November 16, Xinhuanet reprinted the Shenyang Evening News article "Kong Qingdong Incident, No Power Intervention" saying that universities are responsible for the management of professors, but this management cannot extend beyond eight hours. Even those who had so-called "political problems" at that time, such as Gu Hongming of the old imperialist school and Liu Shipei of the new imperialist school, were tolerated by Peking University as long as they did not bring the promotion of imperialism to the campus and into the classroom. This was also a tradition. Of course, reporters who are insulted can file a lawsuit and let the court decide. It is really not a good thing to resort to power at every turn and call on those in power to intervene when it is entirely possible to seek legal solutions.

eb2c99e51a405272cced26d093591450a623d943.sourceText: 在北大学生发起倒孔运动之前，《南方都市报》连续批评孔庆东，认为孔庆东理应承担责任。11月13日，该报刊文《给”姿势分子”孔庆东上堂说理课》说，对于孔庆东的漫骂似乎也就没有必要责备太过，因为孔庆东1964年出生，小学基本是在”文革”度过的，想想看，在批斗会、大字报、打砸抢的氛围里长大的孩子，能接受到像样的公共说理教育吗？从本质上说，孔教授的粗口或许只是没吐干净”狼奶”的表现罢了。
eb2c99e51a405272cced26d093591450a623d943.translatedText: Before Peking University students launched the hole-removing movement, "Southern Metropolis Daily" continuously criticized Kong Qingdong and believed that Kong Qingdong should bear responsibility. On November 13, the newspaper published an article "Giving a Reasoning Class to the "Potentialist" Kong Qingdong". It seems that there is no need to blame Kong Qingdong too much for the abuse, because Kong Qingdong was born in 1964 and basically spent his elementary school during the "Cultural Revolution." Think about it, can children who grow up in an atmosphere of criticism meetings, big-character posters, and beatings, smashing, and looting receive a decent public reasoning education? In essence, Professor Kong's foul language may just be a manifestation of not spitting out the "wolf's milk".

f7a01d9a5935aad6dc7aee50e300b7688dbc2f51.sourceText: 紧接着，《南方都市报》又在14日发表《网络的门槛有多高？》称，对于现实社会中的公众人物，网络像现实世界一样，具有更高的底线。在意见质量上必须高于普通网民，同时还得远离假丑恶，确保不逾越现实社会底线。从这个角度讲，孔庆东的骂人行为，不是高于普通网民，而是低于普通网民，不仅自毁网络公众人物形象，而且违反了教授的职业道德，逾越了社会底线，理当承担与其公共职务相应的责任。
f7a01d9a5935aad6dc7aee50e300b7688dbc2f51.translatedText: Immediately afterwards, "Southern Metropolis Daily" published "How High is the Internet Threshold?" on the 14th. " said that for public figures in real society, the Internet, like the real world, has a higher bottom line. The quality of opinions must be higher than that of ordinary netizens, and at the same time, they must stay away from falsehood and ugliness to ensure that they do not cross the bottom line of real society. From this perspective, Kong Qingdong’s swearing behavior is not higher than that of ordinary netizens, but lower than that of ordinary netizens. It not only destroys his image as a public figure on the Internet, but also violates the professional ethics of professors and crosses the social bottom line. He should bear the responsibilities corresponding to his public position.

9915fb625d83626b354a6e583ba87d6a21810a64.sourceText: 北大学生俨然分成两派，观点对垒，但以在”北大未名BBS”网站上发帖数量计，”倒孔派”人数远大于”挺孔派”。13日凌晨零时多，北大博士生江姓同学报料称：”北大的学生这几天在发起辞退孔庆东的活动！我和几个同学把他在第一视频说的那些毫无人性的话发到校长信箱，希望校长能够辞退这个’五毛教授’。”他称，这封信的题目是”应惩戒公开宣扬暴力的北大名教授孔庆东”。
9915fb625d83626b354a6e583ba87d6a21810a64.translatedText: Peking University students are divided into two factions with competing views. However, based on the number of posts on the "Peking University Weiming BBS" website, the number of "anti-Confucius" faction is much larger than the "pro-Confucius faction". At around midnight on the 13th, a student named Jiang, a doctoral student at Peking University, reported: "Students at Peking University have launched a campaign to fire Kong Qingdong these days! Several classmates and I sent the inhumane words he said in the first video to the principal's mailbox, hoping that the principal can fire this '50-cent professor.'" He said the title of the letter was "Kong Qingdong, a famous professor at Peking University who openly promotes violence, should be punished."

65c69083e283dc99d8354d99e2ff3983438a70e7.sourceText: 孔庆东11月7日发微博说：”一分钟前，《南方人物周刊》电话骚扰要采访我，态度很和气，语言很阴险。孔和尚斩钉截铁答复了一个排比句：去你妈的！滚你妈的！操你妈的！” 激起众多网民的愤怒。恰逢次日是中国记者节，引来全国媒体”炮轰”。中共北大党委宣传部回应称，已经找孔庆东调查。
65c69083e283dc99d8354d99e2ff3983438a70e7.translatedText: Kong Qingdong posted on Weibo on November 7, saying: "One minute ago, Southern People Weekly called me to harass me and asked for an interview. The attitude was very gentle and the language was very sinister. Monk Kong gave an unequivocal reply with a parallel sentence: Fuck you! Get out of here! Fuck you!" This aroused the anger of many netizens. The next day happened to be China Journalists' Day, which attracted "bombardment" from the national media. The Propaganda Department of the Peking University Party Committee of the Communist Party of China responded that it had asked Kong Qingdong to investigate.

fe5b8305297401ca57a737e54331f6501dae488f.sourceText: 新华社10日连续发表两篇重磅文章，痛斥孔庆东已丧失了作为教师的基本道德底线，严重影响到高校教师的形象，敦促北大解聘孔庆东。孔庆东在他的第一视频阵地上，毫无顾忌地破口大骂新华社”带头制作虚假新闻”，?#33073;离党中央的领导，公然给’南方汉奸报’做走狗”。暗示得到”党和国家领导人”以及北大领导支持。著名左派网站乌有之乡以及重庆媒体则为孔庆东撑腰，掀起新一场左右之争。
fe5b8305297401ca57a737e54331f6501dae488f.translatedText: Xinhua News Agency published two blockbuster articles on the 10th, denounced Kong Qingdong for having lost his basic moral bottom line as a teacher, which has seriously affected the image of university teachers, and urged Peking University to fire Kong Qingdong. In his first video position, Kong Qingdong unscrupulously cursed Xinhua News Agency for "taking the lead in producing fake news", leaving the leadership of the Party Central Committee and openly working as a lackey for the "Southern Traitor Newspaper". He hinted that he was supported by "party and state leaders" and leaders of Peking University. The famous leftist website Utopia and Chongqing media supported Kong Qingdong, setting off a new trend.

d73ab8d54fad1ee3fd432ff9c58db91022972905.sourceText: 沉默数天后，遭孔庆东辱骂的南方报系《南方人物周刊》记者曹林华14日接受山东《济南时报》专访。曹林华表示，孔庆东编造脏话，”三妈的”都是他意淫的。在微博”炫骂”两分钟后，孔庆东发短信请求谅解。
d73ab8d54fad1ee3fd432ff9c58db91022972905.translatedText: After several days of silence, Cao Linhua, a reporter from the Southern People's Weekly who was insulted by Kong Qingdong, accepted an exclusive interview with Shandong's "Jinan Times" on the 14th. Cao Linhua said that Kong Qingdong made up the dirty words and "three mothers" because of his obscenity. After two minutes of "swearing" on Weibo, Kong Qingdong sent a text message to ask for forgiveness.

414400d83501e271dd93a616c25db9f7258f2689.sourceText: 此物惹人爱 濒危松鼠繁殖迅速 (亚省时报) 主管野生动物官员说，已经濒危的山区格拉汉姆红松鼠在亚利桑那州东南部得到繁殖，数量上升了12%。 据亚利桑那州的游戏与鱼类部门资料，目前有240只红松鼠活动在皮诺里那山区，比去年多了26只。 格拉汉姆红松鼠的数量曾在1990代飙升至550只左右，但通常只在200至300只。它们的栖息地已被山火、虫害和干旱所破坏。
414400d83501e271dd93a616c25db9f7258f2689.translatedText: The endangered squirrel is reproducing rapidly (Alberta Times) The already endangered mountain Graham's red squirrel is reproducing in southeastern Arizona, with its population increasing by 12 percent, wildlife officials say. According to the Arizona Game and Fish Department, there are currently 240 red squirrels in the Pinolina Mountains, 26 more than last year. The population of Graham's red squirrels soared to about 550 in the 1990s, but usually only numbers 200 to 300. Their habitat has been destroyed by wildfires, insect infestations and drought.

9e1cf430775ffe432370cd482da3e9a51f21cef1.sourceText: 香蕉船防晒喷雾剂召回 制造香蕉船防晒油(Banana Boat sunscreen)的厂商，正召回大约50万瓶喷雾剂，因为有人喷上防晒油后，接触到火焰居然着火。 Energizer控股公司19日说，由于这些防晒产品接触到火焰有危险，它正从商店货架召回23种UltraMist防晒油，包括UltraMist Sport、UltraMist Ultra Defense和UltraMist Kids。 公司发言人说，UltraMist产品在2010年推出，迄今已卖出超过2000万瓶，而去年出现五件有人使用这些防晒油后被烧伤的报告，其中四件发生在美国，一件在加拿大。 该公司发表声明说，问题似乎出在UltraMist的喷雾控制阀喷出的防晒油太多，因此得花更多时间才能干透，造成著火风险。 声明中说：「如果消费者在皮肤上的防晒油完全干透之前接触到火焰或火花，产品可能起火。」 近年来喷雾式防晒油很流行，因为这比擦传统的防晒乳液方便省时。 UltraMist的标签上警告使用者「远离火源，请勿抽烟」，可是皮肤科医生表示，大多数人根本不看标签。 纽约大学皮肤科教授瑞格指出，喷发胶和喷雾式止汗除臭剂等许多喷雾产品，都有酒精之类的易燃成分，而使用任用喷雾产品都应该避免接近有火的地方。
9e1cf430775ffe432370cd482da3e9a51f21cef1.translatedText: Banana Boat Sunscreen Spray Recall The manufacturer of Banana Boat sunscreen is recalling about 500,000 bottles of spray because someone sprayed the sunscreen and caught fire when exposed to flames. Energizer Holdings said on the 19th that it was recalling 23 UltraMist sunscreen oils, including UltraMist Sport, UltraMist Ultra Defense and UltraMist Kids, from store shelves due to the danger of these sunscreen products coming into contact with flames. A company spokesman said UltraMist products were launched in 2010 and have sold more than 20 million bottles so far, and there were five reports last year of people being burned after using the oils, four of which occurred in the United States and one in Canada. The company said in a statement that the problem appeared to be that UltraMist's spray control valve sprayed too much sunscreen, which took longer to dry, posing a fire risk. "If consumers are exposed to flames or sparks before the sunscreen is completely dry on their skin, the product may catch fire," the statement said. Spray-on sunscreen has become popular in recent years because it is more convenient and time-consuming than applying traditional sunscreen lotion. UltraMist's label warns users to "keep away from sources of fire and do not smoke." But dermatologists say most people don't read the label at all. Rieger, a professor of dermatology at New York University, pointed out that many spray products, such as hair sprays and spray antiperspirants and deodorants, contain flammable ingredients such as alcohol, and the use of any spray products should avoid places close to fire.

d1326ca6cdbb1a9c8fa6f975319e591fc253010d.sourceText: 杨桐：全美Top100的微创脊椎名医(图) （谢成彦报道）11月15日晚6时30分，就职于亚利桑那微创脊柱研究所的知名华裔骨外科专家杨桐邀请亚省时报社长甄硕钦，主编邓凌捷在龙广楼餐厅迎接来自中国复旦大学中山医院的访问学者顾宇彤医生。 杨桐首创了杨氏椎间孔镜下椎间盘髓核摘除术（Yeung Endoscopic Spine System）在国际上享有盛誉。与传统椎间盘髓核摘除术相比，杨氏（YESS）技术通过椎间孔入路摘除突出髓核，解除神经根压迫，创伤小、出血少、恢复快，而且还可用于腰椎管狭窄的治疗。该技术得到了FDA的批准，受惠于全世界脊柱疾病患者。杨桐医生经常到世界各地的医学院所讲学，发表了70多篇医学专业论文。多次到中国大陆进行学术交流。2011年在凤凰城杂志举办评选活动中，被行业内选为2011最佳医生。同时也被医疗行业杂志评选为”百名最佳脊椎医生和专家”之一。 2008年到2011年杨桐医生成爲微创脊椎手术和技术世界大会的主席，他不仅在脊椎微创手术技术上精益求精，不断创新，也不遗余力培养年轻的医生。顾宇彤就是从中国来的年轻访问学者之一。顾宇彤已经有丰富的临床经验，本次来美参加北美脊柱外科年会，并到凤凰城向杨桐医生学习杨氏椎间孔镜下椎间盘髓核摘除术。将先进的技术带回中国。同为华裔，杨桐医生不仅给顾宇彤找了很多的材料，在生活工作上，也给予了细致的照顾。 杨桐医生作为典型在海外生长的华裔，不仅在美国社会展示了他了精湛的技艺和才华，同时也竭力为中美医疗技术的交流做出了贡献。 顾宇彤 博士，硕士生导师 复旦大学中山医院骨科副主任医师，曾在法国学习，到摩洛哥援外行医，撰写了四十多篇专业论文，拥有三项专利，出版了书籍《我在摩洛哥当医生》。擅长于脊柱外伤、退变、肿瘤及侧弯、后凸畸形的诊断和手术治疗，特别是用微创的方法治疗颈椎病、腰椎间盘突出症、脊柱骨折等常见的脊柱伤病。 杨桐医生夫妇（左）和顾宇彤医生
d1326ca6cdbb1a9c8fa6f975319e591fc253010d.translatedText: Yang Tong: The top 100 minimally invasive spine doctors in the United States (pictures) (Reported by Xie Chengyan) At 6:30 pm on November 15, Yang Tong, a well-known Chinese orthopedic surgeon who works at the Arizona Minimally Invasive Spine Institute, invited the president of the Alberta Times, Zhen Shuoqin, and the editor-in-chief Deng Lingjie to welcome Dr. Gu Yutong, a visiting scholar from Zhongshan Hospital of Fudan University in China, at the Longguanglou restaurant. Yang Tong pioneered the Yeung Endoscopic Spine System, which is internationally renowned. Compared with traditional disc nucleectomy, Yang's (YESS) technology removes the herniated nucleus pulposus through the intervertebral foraminal approach, relieves nerve root compression, has less trauma, less bleeding, and faster recovery. It can also be used to treat lumbar spinal stenosis. This technology has been approved by the FDA and will benefit spinal disease patients around the world. Dr. Yang Tong often lectures at medical schools around the world and has published more than 70 medical professional papers. He has visited mainland China many times for academic exchanges. In 2011, he was selected as the 2011 Best Doctor in the industry in the selection event held by Phoenix Magazine. He was also selected as one of the "Top 100 Chiropractic Doctors and Experts" by a medical industry magazine. From 2008 to 2011, Dr. Yang Tong became the chairman of the World Congress of Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery and Technology. He not only strived for excellence and innovation in minimally invasive spinal surgery technology, but also spared no effort to train young doctors. Gu Yutong is one of the young visiting scholars from China. Gu Yutong already has rich clinical experience. This time she came to the United States to attend the North American Spine Surgery Annual Meeting and went to Phoenix to learn from Dr. Yang Tong Yang's transforaminal endoscopic disc nucleectomy. Bring advanced technology back to China. As both Chinese Americans, Dr. Yang Tong not only found a lot of materials for Gu Yutong, but also gave her meticulous care in life and work. As a typical Chinese-American who grew up overseas, Dr. Yang Tong not only demonstrated his superb skills and talents in American society, but also made every effort to contribute to the exchange of medical technology between China and the United States. Dr. Gu Yutong, master's tutor, is the deputy chief physician of the Department of Orthopedics, Zhongshan Hospital of Fudan University. He studied in France and went to Morocco to practice medicine. He has written more than 40 professional papers, holds three patents, and published the book "I am a Doctor in Morocco". He specializes in the diagnosis and surgical treatment of spinal trauma, degeneration, tumors, scoliosis, and kyphosis, especially the use of minimally invasive methods to treat common spinal injuries such as cervical spondylosis, lumbar disc herniation, and spinal fractures. The kitten jumped off the cactus after 3 days (picture) (Alberta Times) They say curiosity killed the cat, but the recent behavior of a little black cat has made people even more curious: How did it get up to the 30.0-foot-tall cactus? Firefighters were called by local residents after a domestic cat climbed onto the top of a cactus in Saguaro Lake and stayed without food or water for three days. Unexpectedly, the firefighters were also helpless with the kitten. Experts said that rescuing the cat was quite dangerous and it was better to wait for it to come down on its own. Finally, three days later, the kitten seemed to have a change of heart and carefully climbed down the cactus. After examination, the kitten was in good health except for puncture wounds on its claws. It’s not unusual for cats to climb trees. Hey, cats in Arizona can climb cactus. It’s not that common in other places, right?

4e2df70a12a79eddf1183848ec34fd40f3448446.sourceText: 在美两州发生意外4中国留学生丧生 编者按：据美国《世界日报》报道，美国俄亥俄州及堪萨斯州中国留学生近来分别传出因车祸起火及在租屋处失火逃生不及致死的意外，在迈入雪季及圣诞新年日即将来临之际，中国驻芝加哥及纽约总领事馆，均特别提醒留学生务必注意安全。 两名来自中国大陆、就读俄亥俄州德顿大学(University of Dayton)的留学生，6日清晨在俄州蒙哥马利郡(Montgomery County)河滨路发生车祸，车子迅速起火，两人困在车内逃生不及，当援救人员接报赶抵现场时，两人已不幸烧死在车内。 根据蒙哥马利县警长办公室初步调查报告显示，当时这辆车正在北行，偏离到道路右侧，然后撞上一棵大树，引起车身起火燃烧，分别为19岁、18岁的两名留学生受困车中，未能及时逃出车外，救护人员抵达时，虽然立即把他们送院抢救，但仍不治。两人所就读的德顿大学国际学生中心主任安德森(Amy Anderson)对这起意外表示非常遗憾，她表示，校方将尽一切能力，提供学生相关辅导咨询服务，并给予死亡学生家属帮助。 德顿大学指出，学生罹难消息已通知他们在中国大陆的亲属，校长柯然(Daniel J. Curran)并透过电邮呼吁全校师生给死亡学生的亲友最大支持及为他们祷告。德顿大学目前约有500名来自中国大陆的留学生，人数高居该校的外国学生之冠。 另外，据驻芝加哥中领馆领事周子亦表示，就读堪萨斯州安保立亚州立大学(Emporia State University)两名来自中国辽宁的留学生，日前因租住房子火灾，逃生不及丧生火场。 周子亦与教育组领事李长华才刚从堪州探访不幸罹难学生及家属返回芝加哥。他指出，两名死亡学生都是研究所一年级学生。10月20日凌晨1时，他们租住的独栋屋厨房发生火灾，两人未逃出，一学生当场死亡，另一学生第二天转送大医院途中也不幸死亡。 驻芝加哥中领馆侨务组组长宋剑鸣提醒留学生，岁末年节假日来临，各种派对活动频繁，出门在外务必注意自身安全，尤其是使用火烛，开车上路，一定要留意。 中国驻纽约总领事馆侨务领事王帮富10日表示，在俄州中国留学生车祸发生后，中领馆在第一时间和校方、警方取得联络表示关切，确定遇难者为中国公民。纽约中领馆与遇难者在中国的亲属取得联络，并透过外交渠道帮助家属申请赴美签证。两名遇难学生的中国同学，日前在车祸地点依照中国习俗举行了敬酒、上香、献花的追思仪式。
4e2df70a12a79eddf1183848ec34fd40f3448446.translatedText: 4 Chinese students died in accidents in two states in the United States. Editor's note: According to the US "World Journal" report, there have been recent reports of Chinese students in Ohio and Kansas dying due to car accidents and fires and failing to escape in fires in rental houses. As the snow season and Christmas and New Year are approaching, the Chinese Consulate General in Chicago and New York have specially reminded international students to pay attention to safety. Two international students from mainland China who were studying at the University of Dayton in Ohio were involved in a car accident on Riverside Road in Montgomery County, Ohio, in the early morning of the 6th. The car quickly caught fire and the two were trapped in the car and could not escape. When rescuers arrived at the scene, they were unfortunately burned to death in the car. According to the preliminary investigation report of the Montgomery County Sheriff's Office, the car was traveling northbound, deviated to the right side of the road, and then hit a large tree, causing the car body to catch fire. Two international students, aged 19 and 18, were trapped in the car and could not escape from the car in time. When ambulance personnel arrived, although they were immediately sent to the hospital for rescue, they still died. Amy Anderson, director of the International Student Center at Deton University where the two were studying, expressed great regret for the accident. She said that the school will do everything it can to provide student-related counseling services and provide help to the families of the deceased students. Dayton University stated that news of the student's death has been notified to their relatives in mainland China. President Daniel J. Curran also called on all teachers and students of the school to provide maximum support and prayers to the relatives and friends of the deceased students through an email. There are currently about 500 international students from mainland China at the University of Dayton, ranking first among the number of foreign students at the school. In addition, according to Zhou Zi, the consul of the Chinese Consulate in Chicago, two international students from Liaoning, China, who were studying at Emporia State University in Kansas, died in a fire in their rental house a few days ago and were unable to escape the fire. Zhou Ziyi and Education Consul Li Changhua had just returned to Chicago from Kanzhou to visit the students and their families who were unfortunately killed. He pointed out that the two students who died were both first-year graduate students. At 1 a.m. on October 20, a fire broke out in the kitchen of the single-family house they rented. The two students did not escape. One student died on the spot, and the other student died on the way to a large hospital the next day. Song Jianming, head of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Section of the Chinese Consulate in Chicago, reminded international students that as the year-end and New Year holidays come, various parties and activities are frequent. They must pay attention to their own safety when going out, especially when using candles and driving. Wang Bangfu, the Overseas Chinese Consul of the Chinese Consulate General in New York, said on the 10th that after the car accident involving a Chinese student in Oklahoma, the Chinese Consulate immediately contacted the school and the police to express concern and determined that the victim was a Chinese citizen. The Chinese Consulate in New York contacted the victims’ relatives in China and helped them apply for visas to the United States through diplomatic channels. The Chinese classmates of the two students who died recently held a memorial ceremony in accordance with Chinese customs at the site of the car accident to toast, burn incense and lay flowers.

984b232460eeeb56f08fec56735bb41c63cba772.translatedText: The number of bankruptcies has dropped to its lowest level since the spring of 2009 Jinxin Real Estate According to a report from Arizona State University's Carey School of Business, the share of bankruptcies is at its lowest level since the spring of 2009. As of October, bankruptcies accounted for 26% of existing transactions in Phoenix, and in September they accounted for 29%. Today, bankrupt housing transactions accounted for 43% in January. The price of a bankrupt house is relatively favorable, so many buyers hope to find a good price for a bankrupt house. It is not so easy to buy a bankrupt house now. There are also many positive factors in the housing loan market, and loan interest rates have been falling. These have not yet completely stimulated potential purchases, because we cannot say that the real estate market is healthy now. Housing sales in Greater Phoenix were 8,000 in September and 7,200 in October. The median price of a home fell from $135,000 to $125,000 this time last year. For more real estate questions, please contact 480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com.

a54b5b692b57c237c20fba901fb0ffbd833e5e46.sourceText: 凤凰大学(University of Phoenix）关115个校区 由于利润大幅下滑，全美规模最大的营利大学─凤凰大学(University of Phoenix)本周宣布，它将关闭115个校区，影响约1万3000名学生。 凤凰大学母公司阿波罗集团公司(Apollo Group Inc.)的这项宣布除了代表公司将关闭旗下约半数的实体大学，也显示，曾爆炸性成长数年的营利大学，受到四年前经济衰退的重创 ，规模迅速缩减。 关闭这么多校区，也将使市面突然出现大批靠近公路交叉点的商用房地产。 就短期看，这对营利大学不是好消息，但从长远看，此种现象是否对营利大学、就读学生和经济有利，要视对象而定。 政府上周公布的数据显示，2011年秋天全国高等学府的招生总人数，15年来首次下跌。 全盘招生人数下跌率仅0.2%，但下跌的主要部分是营利大学，其招生人数减少了2.9%(营利大学的招生人数占所有招生人数的大约11%)，抵销了非营利大学招生增加。 阿波罗公司宣布关闭校区时，尽量使自己看起来「体面一些」，表示此举是因为选择网路上课的学生日渐增多，并宣称受影响的学生只占4%，现有学生将可完成其 课业。 但该公司无法掩饰招生大减的事实：目前修学位的学生为32万8000人，低于去年的38万1000人，更难与2010年高峰期的47万5000人相比。
a54b5b692b57c237c20fba901fb0ffbd833e5e46.translatedText: University of Phoenix is closing 115 campuses. Due to a sharp decline in profits, the University of Phoenix, the largest for-profit university in the United States, is closing 115 campuses. Phoenix announced this week that it would close 115 campuses, affecting about 13,000 students. The announcement by Apollo Group Inc., the parent company of the University of Phoenix, not only means that the company will close about half of its brick-and-mortar universities, but also shows that for-profit universities that have grown explosively for several years have been hit hard by the economic recession four years ago and are rapidly shrinking in size. Closing so many campuses will also suddenly create a flood of commercial real estate near highway intersections. In the short term, this is not good news for for-profit universities, but in the long term, whether this phenomenon is beneficial to for-profit universities, students and the economy depends on the target. Government data released last week showed that in the fall of 2011, total enrollment in higher education institutions across the country fell for the first time in 15 years. Overall enrollment fell by just 0.2%, but the bulk of the decline was at for-profit colleges, which saw a 2.9% decline in enrollment (for-profit colleges account for about 11% of all enrollment), offsetting increases in enrollment at nonprofit colleges. When Apollo announced the closure of the campus, it tried to make itself look "respectable", saying that the move was due to the increasing number of students choosing to attend classes online, and claimed that only 4% of the students were affected, and existing students would be able to complete their courses. But the company cannot hide the fact that enrollment has dropped significantly: There are currently 328,000 degree-seeking students, down from 381,000 last year and even harder to compare with the 475,000 students at the peak in 2010.

8c9e9edcb9197834ff4084696c6b3e3602237657.sourceText: 总部设在德州欧文的Kimberly-Cark旗下Kotex女性用品卫生棉条可能感染细菌，公司决定召回这批产品。 这批名为Kotex Natural Balance Security Unscented Tampons Regular Aborbency的女性卫生棉条（内置型）发给包括亚利桑那州在内的8个州，在Walmart，Fry’s和Smith’s均有售，分别为18只和36只 装，SKU编号为15063和15068之间，生产日期为10月29日和11月2日。 Kimberly-Cark公司说，公司在卫生棉条中检验检测出细菌阪崎肠肝菌，可能会导致包括阴道感染，尿路感染，盆腔炎或其它可能危及生命的感染。 消费者若购买了此批产品应立即停止使用，欢迎致电Kimberly-Cark消费办公室1-800-335-6839。 任何人使用该产品并出现不寻常的阴道分泌物，头痛，皮疹，发烧，呕吐或腹部疼痛，请即与医生联系。
8c9e9edcb9197834ff4084696c6b3e3602237657.translatedText: Kimberly-Cark's Kotex feminine products tampons, headquartered in Irving, Texas, may be contaminated with bacteria, and the company has decided to recall these products. This batch of feminine tampons (built-in type) called Kotex Natural Balance Security Unscented Tampons Regular Aborbency were distributed to 8 states, including Arizona. They are available at Walmart, Fry’s and Smith’s, in packages of 18 and 36 respectively, with SKU numbers between 15063 and 15068, and production dates of October 29 and November 2. Kimberly-Cark said the bacteria it tested in its tampons tested positive for Enterococcus sakazakii, which can cause vaginal infections, urinary tract infections, pelvic inflammatory disease or other potentially life-threatening infections. Consumers who have purchased this batch of products should stop using them immediately and are welcome to call the Kimberly-Cark Consumer Office at 1-800-335-6839. Anyone using this product and experiencing unusual vaginal discharge, headache, rash, fever, vomiting, or abdominal pain should contact their doctor immediately.

042af7f8d0714d7966715133586e5f4abecfa325.sourceText: 最毒女人心 男子遭刺300刀 (亚省时报) 威斯康辛州密尔瓦基市惊传两名搞「撒旦崇拜」的女子，在与一名男子性交后，将对方禁锢两天，并割了他数百刀的骇人案件。 这名18岁受害男子向警方报案，导致女嫌犯22岁的蕊贝卡钱德勒及20岁的瑞雯赖拉比被捕，预料数天后正式控罪。 受害的18岁男子经由网路认识嫌犯之一，后来从凤凰城前来密尔瓦基，结果被这两名女子扣留在公寓两天，而且身上被割300余刀。 警方据报抵达公寓后，钱德勒主动表示，警方要找的人是她。 她说，这名男子与她发生性关系，双方同意过程中包括刀割，但情势后来失控。 她说，刀割主要由她的室友赖拉比动手，与「撒旦崇拜」或撒旦教活动有关。 受害男子的背部、脸部、手臂、脚部、颈部都有刀伤，共300余处，已送往医院治疗。 警方对钱德勒和赖拉比的公寓进行搜查，发现刀子、胶布、带血迹的绳子，以及与撒旦崇拜有关的书籍及文件，包括书名为「狼人复生指南」的巫术仪式书籍。
042af7f8d0714d7966715133586e5f4abecfa325.translatedText: The most poisonous woman has a heart, a man was stabbed 300 times (Alberta Times) A shocking case was reported in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, about two women who engaged in "Satan worship". After having sex with a man, they imprisoned him for two days and cut him hundreds of times. The 18-year-old victim reported the crime to the police, which led to the arrest of the female suspects Rebecca Chandler, 22, and Raven Laibi, 20, and they are expected to be formally charged in a few days. The victim, an 18-year-old man, met one of the suspects through the Internet and later came to Milwaukee from Phoenix. As a result, he was detained in the apartment by the two women for two days and had more than 300 cuts on his body. After police reportedly arrived at the apartment, Chandler volunteered that she was the person they were looking for. She said the man had sex with her in a consensual process that included cutting her, but the situation spiraled out of control. She said the stabbings were mainly carried out by her roommate Lailabi and were related to "Satan worship" or Satanic activities. The victim suffered more than 300 stab wounds on his back, face, arms, feet, and neck, and was sent to the hospital for treatment. Police searched Chandler and Laraby's apartment and found knives, tape, bloody rope, and books and documents related to Satanism, including a book on witchcraft rituals titled "The Werewolf's Guide to Resurrection."

After receiving an unknown amount of cash, the robber fled westward on foot, seemingly calm. The police described the robber as thin, 20-21 years old, about 6.1 to 2 feet tall, with obvious freckles on his face. He was wearing a gray Aeropostale sweatshirt and a Hurley hat. He looked dirty and was not ruled out as homeless. At about 12:30 noon on Monday, a black man with a beard walked into the Bank of America on Center Street in Phoenix, demanded money from the teller, and took away an unknown amount of cash. The suspect is described as approximately 20-30 years old, 6 feet tall, 180 pounds, wearing a Zou Baba short-sleeved white T-shirt, blue jeans and sunglasses. Anyone with the above information is asked to contact the FBI Bank Robbery Task Force's Phoenix office at 602-279-5511 or go to www.BanditTrackerArizona.com. (This department is composed of elites from the Phoenix Police Department, Maricopa County Sheriff's Office and Mesa Police Department)

d8989056390623b4715a7f283c2efa1a4e4fcb16.sourceText: 妖怪牌能量饮料或致5死 市场份额39% FDA调查 联邦食品医药局22日称，正在调查可能同妖怪饮料公司（Monster Beverage Corp）能量饮料相关的5起死亡报告。 一名14岁女孩的家人起诉妖怪公司说，那名女孩24小时之内引用2罐妖怪牌能量之后死亡。 妖怪公司说，它不相信自己的饮料对那名女孩的死亡有任何责任。公司发表声明说，妖怪不了解任何死亡会是它的饮料引起的。它说要在法庭为自己强烈辩护。安乃斯福尼尔的家人星期五控告妖怪公司说，它没有警告那种产品的危险性。 已递交河滨加州最高法院的那份诉讼说，福尼尔两天饮用2罐24盎司的妖怪牌饮料之后，心脏骤停。她于几天之后的2011年12月23日死亡，诉状说她是因为咖啡因中毒引起的严重心律失常，加剧她原来已有的心脏病而死亡。 联邦食品医药局女发言人博格斯周一说，从2009年到今年6月，该机构已经收到同妖怪牌能量饮料相关的5份死亡报告和一份心脏病发作报告。 该局调查它收到的任何死亡或伤害报告。该局数据库中负面事件的通知不等于已经证实某种产品有风险。 妖怪牌是美国最主要的能量饮料，占这一市场的39%，但奥地利红牛牌（Red Bull）饮料收入最高，因为它价格较高。 今年7月，纽约州总检察长对三家能量饮料公司发出传票–妖怪、百事（PepsiCo）和精华（Living Essentials LLC ）–要求公司提供其推销和广告信息。 百事生产AMP能量饮料，精华生产5小时能量（5-Hour Energy）饮料。
d8989056390623b4715a7f283c2efa1a4e4fcb16.translatedText: Monster brand energy drink may cause 5 deaths, market share 39% FDA investigation The federal Food and Drug Administration said on the 22nd that it was investigating five reports of deaths that may be related to Monster Beverage Corp.'s energy drinks. The family of a 14-year-old girl sued Monster Beverage Corp., saying the girl died after consuming two cans of Monster Beverage Energy within 24 hours. Monster said it did not believe its drink was responsible for the girl's death. The company issued a statement saying Monster had no knowledge of any of the deaths being caused by its drink. It said it would vigorously defend itself in court against the company, saying it failed to warn of the dangers of the product. The lawsuit, filed in California Supreme Court in Riverside, says Fournier went into cardiac arrest a few days later on Dec. 23, 2011, after drinking two 24-ounce cans of Monster. The agency has received five reports of deaths and one report of a heart attack related to Monster energy drinks from 2009 to June of this year, the agency said on Monday. Notifications of negative events in the agency's database do not constitute confirmation that a product poses a risk. Monster is the dominant energy drink in the United States, accounting for 39% of the market, but Austria's Red Bull drinks generate the most revenue because of its higher price. In July, the New York State Attorney General issued subpoenas against three energy drink companies – Monster, PepsiCo, and Living Essentials LLC – requesting the companies to provide information about their marketing and advertising. PepsiCo, which makes AMP Energy Drink, and Living Essentials LLC, which makes 5-Hour Energy.

aaca01441c199fa760804c2799947f63096b2b48.sourceText: 余风采堂郊游联欢 老少同乐 （亚省时报） 联欢现场 １１月６日上午１２时，余风采堂在玛格丽特昂斯公园(Margaret Hance Park)举办了余氏宗亲、亲戚，朋友的郊游联欢会。现场来了200多余氏宗亲及友人，相当热闹。世界与风采堂名誉顾问余文劲，亚省时报社长甄硕钦，大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会主席邓朝驹，副主席余长全，张华芳都到现场一起聚会。 侨领合影 余风采堂每年一度的郊游活动准备得非常充分，余风采堂的横幅挂在最显眼的地方，四周挂满了各色的气球，美食，饮料摆得公园的餐桌满满的，无论是中式的还是西式的都应有尽有，感觉就像一个盛大的节日。皮球，橄榄球，篮球，芭比娃娃可爱的玩具摆得一大桌。参加联欢的小朋友，都争先恐后领取奖券，希望能抽奖获得一个大玩具。BBQ烤出的热狗和汉堡肉饼，冒着浓浓的香味，几个参加活动的志愿者，全程为大家提供热热的美食。 快乐的为大家服务的BBQ”大师” 余风采堂组织郊游联欢已经有很长一段时间了，每年都给亲戚，朋友提供一个大聚会的机会，不仅大人们聊得开心，小朋友也有机会认识更多的朋友，共同享受温暖的秋季阳光。
aaca01441c199fa760804c2799947f63096b2b48.translatedText: Yu Fengcaitang held an outing party for all ages (Alberta Times) Party scene At 12:00 am on November 6, Yu Fengcaitang held an outing party for Yu family members, relatives and friends at Margaret Hance Park. More than 200 family members and friends came to the scene, which was quite lively. Honorary consultant Yu Wenjin of the World and Style Hall, Zhen Shuoqin, president of the Alberta Times, Deng Chaoju, chairman of the Greater Phoenix Chinese Overseas Chinese Association, Yu Changquan, vice chairman, and Zhang Huafang all came to the scene to gather together. Group photo of overseas Chinese leaders. Yu Fengcaitang’s annual outing is very well prepared. Yu Fengcaitang’s banner is hung in the most conspicuous place, surrounded by balloons of various colors. The tables in the park are filled with delicious food and drinks, both Chinese and Western. It feels like a grand festival. Balls, rugby balls, basketballs, and lovely Barbie toys were spread out on a large table. The children who participated in the party were all rushing to collect the lottery tickets, hoping to win a big toy in the lottery. The hot dogs and hamburger patties grilled by the BBQ are full of fragrance, and several volunteers participating in the event provide hot food for everyone throughout the process. Yu Fengcaitang, the BBQ "master" who happily serves everyone, has been organizing outings and parties for a long time. Every year, it provides an opportunity for relatives and friends to have a big gathering. Not only do the adults have a happy chat, but the children also have the opportunity to make more friends and enjoy the warm autumn sunshine together.

c6645cacf920508bc8c0773276ce5ed2c843cf3e.sourceText: 凤凰选出新市长：斯坦顿 （亚省时报） 周二选出的还有凤凰城新市长。民主党格雷格斯坦顿（Greg Stanton）击败共和党韦斯古雷，代替到期卸任的戈登，成为全美第六大城市棗凤凰城的新市长。 斯坦顿是一名律师，曾担任市议员9年，2009年辞职接受州总检察官办公室高级官员工作。参选凤凰城市长后已离开总检察长办公室。 凤凰城是受美国住房危机打击最严重的城市之一，全市房价比4年前最低点还低，失业率一直徘徊在8%。 斯坦顿说他上任后首先解决的问题包括提高幼儿教育经费，开设课后学习计划。他还提出使全市经济更加多元化，将技术和医疗保健工作作重点。 这次参加登记投票的选民约占全市人口的27%，周二有16万人投了票，打破1989年15万4千人的记录。
c6645cacf920508bc8c0773276ce5ed2c843cf3e.translatedText: Phoenix elects new mayor: Stanton (Alberta Times) A ​​new mayor was also elected in Phoenix on Tuesday. Democrat Greg Stanton defeated Republican Wes Guray and became the new mayor of Phoenix, the sixth largest city in the United States, replacing Gordon, who was retiring when his term expired. Stanton is a lawyer who served as a city council member for nine years before resigning in 2009 to accept a job as a senior official in the State Attorney's Office. He has left the attorney general's office after running for Phoenix mayor. Phoenix is ​​one of the cities hardest hit by the housing crisis in the United States. Housing prices in the city are still lower than the lowest point four years ago, and the unemployment rate has been hovering at 8%. Stanton said his first issues after taking office include increasing funding for early childhood education and establishing after-school learning programs. He also proposed diversifying the city's economy, focusing on technology and health care. Voters registered to vote this time accounted for about 27% of the city's population, and 160,000 people voted on Tuesday, breaking the record of 154,000 in 1989.

b98407ed077cd017f2ebed7640eb5f3f895f2018.sourceText: 令人难忘的侨联首届社群联谊野餐会 11月12日凤凰城华人侨团联合总会（侨联）举办的首届社群联谊野餐活动，在凤凰城TEMPE KIWANIS PARK隆重举办。凤凰城华人侨团联合总会下属的18个侨团代表，亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会，开平同乡会，以及其社区团体，众多的华人家庭，一共240多人参加了活动，真可称得上热闹非凡。 美味的烧烤，家庭小菜，让所有的来宾都能吃得饱饱的参加各种活动，唱卡拉OK，折纸，猜谜，踢毽子，滚轮，还有排球和棒球，好玩的东西真让人目不暇接。 ＢＢＱ美食 共振游戏 滚轮游戏 卡拉Ok不仅有喜欢粤剧的耆英会的老票友，还有喜欢中文歌曲的美国小女孩。不仅有领唱的，还有伴舞的，把现场气氛其乐隆隆。 卡拉OK 伴舞 还有教小朋友中文的户外课堂，可以交流中文，还可以认识很多新朋友。要获得健康知识的，当然可以到健康知识咨询台问问题，特别是日常生活中的营养补充，咨询人员会根据个例推荐非常适合现在身体状况的保健品。最激烈的活动就要数棒球了，侨联主席邓朝驹，科工专主席徐强等人都聚集在了那里，还有众多第一次参加棒球活动的菜鸟级选手。 全力合作 小试牛刀 下午三点左右，本次社群联谊活动圆满结束，大家是美食运动两得意，纷纷表示这样的活动应该经常举办。 快乐的志愿者们
b98407ed077cd017f2ebed7640eb5f3f895f2018.translatedText: The unforgettable first community picnic event of the Overseas Chinese Federation. On November 12, the first community picnic event organized by the Federation of Chinese Overseas Chinese Leagues in Phoenix City (Overseas Chinese Federation) was grandly held at TEMPE KIWANIS PARK in Phoenix City. A total of more than 240 people participated in the event, including representatives from 18 overseas Chinese groups affiliated to the Phoenix Chinese Federation, the Arizona Chinese Federation, the Kaiping Association, and other community groups, as well as numerous Chinese families. It was truly a lively event. Delicious barbecue and family dishes kept all the guests well-fed and participated in various activities, including karaoke, origami, quizzes, shuttlecock, rollerball, volleyball and baseball. There were so many fun things to see. BBQ Food, Resonance Game, Rolling Wheel Game, Karaoke not only has old fans from the Youth Club who like Cantonese opera, but also American little girls who like Chinese songs. There are not only lead singers, but also backup dancers, making the atmosphere lively and lively. Karaoke, dancing, and outdoor classes for teaching Chinese to children, where they can communicate in Chinese and make many new friends. If you want to gain health knowledge, of course you can go to the health knowledge consultation desk to ask questions, especially about nutritional supplements in daily life. Consultants will recommend health products that are very suitable for your current physical condition based on individual cases. The most intense activity was baseball. Deng Chaoju, chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, Xu Qiang, chairman of the Science and Engineering College, and others gathered there, as well as many rookie players who participated in baseball activities for the first time. Full cooperation and a small test of skills. At around three o'clock in the afternoon, this community networking event ended successfully. Everyone was proud of the food movement and said that such events should be held more often. Happy volunteers

b396c1ee29d86ffa8f73bb1d235acb25052289b1.sourceText: 凤凰大都会 全美第8脏都市 （亚省时报） 根据Forbes.com上周五文章，凤凰城大都会被称为全美第8脏城市。 当日，沙尘暴吞噬了凤凰城-美莎-格兰岱地区。福布斯说：热气加上汽车尾气，时不时的沙尘暴，让人无法忍受。 几个加州城市排名前20位，洛杉矶排名第2，圣地亚哥排第9，贝克斯菲尔德排第1。 该文数据取自美国肺脏协会的2011年空气报告，根据这个报告，美国有一半人生活在空气污染到不宜居住的地区。看来不用等到2149年，穿越到Terra Nova指日可待了。
b396c1ee29d86ffa8f73bb1d235acb25052289b1.translatedText: Metro Phoenix is ​​the 8th dirtiest city in the United States (Alberta Times) According to a Forbes.com article last Friday, the Phoenix metropolitan area was dubbed the 8th dirtiest city in the United States. On that day, a sandstorm engulfed the Phoenix-Mesa-Glendai area. Forbes said: The heat, car exhaust, and occasional sandstorms are unbearable. Several California cities ranked in the top 20, with Los Angeles at No. 2, San Diego at No. 9, and Bakersfield at No. 1. The data in this article are taken from the American Lung Association's 2011 Air Report. According to this report, half of the people in the United States live in areas with air pollution that is uninhabitable. It seems that there is no need to wait until 2149, traveling to Terra Nova is just around the corner.

8f333dab3d451e9ecb856fc418428ce45d508049.sourceText: 尤马截获7名毒品背包客 （亚省时报） 周二上午，美国边境巡逻人员在尤马，逮捕了一组用背包走私毒品的毒贩。 被华尔登站巡逻哨兵发现时这7人正穿越亚利桑那州西南部的沙漠，每个人身上背包里装着大麻，共约245磅，估值超过12万美元。 7名嫌疑人承认走私大麻，被移交马利科巴郡警长办公室。
8f333dab3d451e9ecb856fc418428ce45d508049.translatedText: 7 drug backpackers intercepted in Yuma (Alberta Times) On Tuesday morning, U.S. Border Patrol agents arrested a group of drug smugglers in Yuma who were smuggling drugs in backpacks. The seven men were crossing the desert in southwestern Arizona when they were discovered by a Walden Station patrol sentry. Each of them had a backpack containing about 245 pounds of marijuana, valued at more than $120,000. Seven suspects admitted to smuggling marijuana and were turned over to the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office.
