564ab3df899ada43e2655fc47765fe251f33d325.sourceText: 我在异国它乡，以崇敬地心情阅读张肇鸿先生写的凤凰城华人史和现实文化观念的文章，每翻阅一页，每一段文字，甚至每一个字，我地心都在颤动，也有难以表述 地感慨，昔日华人走的是茫茫沧桑路；今日的华人是其乐融融亲亲情，我的心情也从沉重转向喜悦和庆幸。 张先生带着使命感，苦心追逐老华侨的足迹，不停寻阅旧书报，但是其记载都极其有限。 在走访中却发现散落在民间的事迹非常丰厚，华人事迹像散落在大漠里的珍珠，于是一粒一粒地捡回来，形成一部文字和图片相结合的史书。 他是一位做过奉献的人，再把这些著作奉献给这里的华人社会，我特别敬佩他的奉献精神！ 我只能用寥寥数语表示对侨胞们的敬意！ 百年前动荡的中国社会，民难以聊生，求生难，一批批中国人，告别亲友远离家乡，闯进美国西部荒原大漠，求生为家。 当时在不承认中国人价值及排华的情况下，在长期拼搏中的华人寻找到了自救的方法。 以宗族为体系实行互帮互助，保护人身和经济利益，建立起了”邓高密公所”、”余风采堂”、”黄氏宗亲会”、”龙冈公所”、”华商总会”等组织， 到以后更成立了”斐匿侨团联合总会”。这些团体具有鲜明的家族特点，在长期居住国的磨练中，它们又是家族向社会发展的前奏，打破了独立的个人和家庭界限 ，成为华人整体社会的群体。 凤凰城华人由早期的二百人到今天已有十万人，在沙漠、炎热不利的自然条件下，同时在国家与国家存在差距的情况下，带着儒家思想来到这里，不断吸收西方多元文化 ，在中西文化影响下，从来都把自己看成是民族的、国家的、世界的，他们对”有福同享，有难同当”的理解，不把”行善”和”作善事”简单化， 身居美国凤凰城的华侨们，已经把”善”字融入到为别人承担责任高尚情操中，而且成为参加社会活动精神支柱。 全世界华人都一样，身兼双重任务，既为自己创造生存财富；也要所在国人民创造财富，所以很需要给自己创造一个好的社会环境。 凤凰城的华人社会在老华侨的带领下，侨民不惜捐献金钱和全力支持，经过多年的艰苦努力，实现了几个大目标，有了由几代人所创造起来的业绩： 少有所教。 后继有人是事业发展不可缺少的重要条件，培养人才首先抓好教育，老华侨抓中文学校建立，师资培养，资金筹集，校舍选择，按照海外实际境况确定教育方针，孩子从幼年受到”双语”教育 ，这就是凤凰城教育人才优势。 老有所养。 对老人的关怀不仅仅是家庭的事情，侨社也同家庭一起共同挑起这个重担。 ” 康宁大厦”和”康乐大厦”的兴建，告诉侨民放心度好晚年，将来逐渐达到老有所养，老有所居，老有所乐，老有所医。 让老人身心健康，享受到人权和尊严。 人有所乐。 老一辈华侨大都有一把辛酸泪史，为了能得到欢乐，他们几代人经过长期奋争从大漠荒原走出来了。 今天大凤凰城无论老华侨或新华侨，或者是来自世界任何地方的华人，努力地互相包容，相融相亲。 用各种节日形式，传诵欢乐的歌声、笑声、心声。 过春节从年三十到第二年三月，大、中、小规模都有，把年过地红红火火。 凡是中国传统节，有多少过多少，国庆节大家过得也是非常隆重。 平时社团侨领号召，举办旅游观光、摄影、选美、讲座、访问、会议等活动，自愿选项、自愿赞助、自愿参加，自娱自乐。 凤凰城的侨社的人们，无论组织者或是参加者，在各种活动中大多数人不从中谋取任何利益，”自愿义务”是他们最高原则，这种约定俗成的社会风尚，才是事业发展的 精神支柱。 逝者有所安。 凤凰城华侨墓地的建立，是生者对故者的思念和尊爱，让已故者在九天之上得到安魂；同时告诉生者要缅怀他们的业绩，继承前人的精神。 凤凰城的新老侨民，把长年在艰苦劳动中挣来的钱，一部分捐给国际国内受灾人民；一部分拿来建设大家的共同家园。 大凤凰城华人侨胞精神将会永世相传！
564ab3df899ada43e2655fc47765fe251f33d325.translatedText: I was in a foreign country, and I read Mr. Zhang Zhaohong's article on the history of Chinese people in Phoenix City and realistic cultural concepts with reverence. Every page I turned, every paragraph of text, and even every word, my heart was shaking, and there were also things that were difficult to express. I feel deeply that the Chinese people in the past walked a road full of vicissitudes; today the Chinese people are happy and harmonious with family members, and my mood has also changed from heavy to joyful and fortunate. With a sense of mission, Mr. Zhang painstakingly followed the footsteps of the old overseas Chinese and kept looking for old books and newspapers, but the records were extremely limited. During the visit, I found that there were a lot of deeds scattered among the people. The deeds of the Chinese were like pearls scattered in the desert, so I picked them up one by one to form a history book that combines words and pictures. He is a dedicated person, and he dedicates these works to the Chinese society here. I particularly admire his dedication! I can only express my respect to the overseas Chinese in a few words! In the turbulent Chinese society a hundred years ago, it was difficult for the people to make a living and survive. Groups of Chinese people bid farewell to their relatives and friends, stayed away from their hometowns, and broke into the wilderness and desert of the American West to survive and make a home. At that time, without recognizing the value of the Chinese people and excluding China, the Chinese people, who had been struggling for a long time, found ways to save themselves. Based on the clan system, we implemented mutual help and protected personal and economic interests, and established organizations such as "Deng Gaomi Office", "Yu Fengcaitang", "Huang Clan Association", "Longgang Office", "Chinese Business Association", and later the "Fei Ni Overseas Chinese Federation". These groups have distinct family characteristics. After being tempered by the country of long-term residence, they are the prelude to the development of the family into society, breaking the boundaries between independent individuals and families, and becoming a group of the Chinese society as a whole. The Chinese in Phoenix City have grown from 200 people in the early days to 100,000 today. They came here with Confucianism under the desert, hot and unfavorable natural conditions, and the gap between countries. They continue to absorb Western multiculturalism. Under the influence of Chinese and Western cultures, they have always regarded themselves as belonging to the nation, the country and the world. Their understanding of "sharing blessings and sharing hardships" does not simplify "doing good" and "doing good deeds". The overseas Chinese living in Phoenix, USA, have integrated the word "kindness" into the noble sentiment of taking responsibility for others, and have become the spiritual pillar of participating in social activities. Chinese people all over the world are the same. They have dual tasks, not only to create survival wealth for themselves, but also to create wealth for the people of the host country, so they need to create a good social environment for themselves. The Chinese community in Phoenix City, under the leadership of veteran overseas Chinese, has spared no effort in donating money and providing full support. After years of hard work, it has achieved several major goals and achieved achievements created by several generations: Few are educated. Successors are an indispensable and important condition for career development. To cultivate talents, we must first focus on education. Old overseas Chinese focus on the establishment of Chinese schools, teacher training, fund raising, school building selection, and determining educational policies based on the actual overseas situation. Children receive "bilingual" education from an early age. This is Phoenix's educational talent advantage. Have something to support you in old age. Caring for the elderly is not only a family matter, overseas Chinese communities also shoulder this burden together with families. The construction of "Kang Ning Building" and "Kangle Building" tells the overseas Chinese to spend their old age with peace of mind, and in the future they will gradually achieve the goal of being provided for, having a place to live, having fun, and having medical care. Let the elderly be healthy physically and mentally and enjoy human rights and dignity. People enjoy themselves. Most of the older generation of overseas Chinese have a history of bitter tears. In order to be happy, several generations of them came out of the desert wasteland after long-term struggle. Today in Greater Phoenix, old and new overseas Chinese, or Chinese from anywhere in the world, work hard to tolerate each other and live in harmony with each other. Use various festival forms to spread joyful songs, laughter, and heartfelt messages. The Spring Festival is celebrated from New Year's Eve to March of the following year. There are large, medium and small scales, making the New Year a prosperous one. There are as many traditional Chinese festivals as there are celebrations, and the National Day is also celebrated with great grandeur. In ordinary times, overseas Chinese leaders of associations call for activities such as tourism, photography, beauty pageants, lectures, visits, conferences, etc., with voluntary options, voluntary sponsorship, voluntary participation, and self-entertainment. Most people in the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix, whether organizers or participants, do not seek any benefits from various activities. "Voluntary obligation" is their highest principle. This established social custom is the spiritual pillar of career development. The deceased are at peace. The establishment of the Overseas Chinese Cemetery in Phoenix City is a symbol of the living's longing and respect for the deceased, allowing the deceased to rest in peace in the heavens; at the same time, it tells the living to remember their achievements and inherit the spirit of their predecessors. New and old overseas Chinese in Phoenix donated part of the money they earned through years of hard work to people affected by disasters at home and abroad; part of it was used to build our common home. The spirit of the Chinese overseas Chinese in Greater Phoenix will be passed down forever!

aa6031e76d6b2d046de0703daf17d2edc793d611.sourceText: 乔纳森罗斯柴德当选图森市长 （亚省时报） 乔纳森罗斯柴德(Jonathan Rothschild)当选图森市新市长，将接替离任的沃尔德。 民主党的罗斯柴德已55%的选票大比例抛离对手，共和党的瑞克格林内尔和绿党的玛丽德堪布。 这是自1999年以来，民主党第一次执政图森市。 罗斯柴德当选前是一名律师。他承诺在上任180天内推出商业利益讨论，建立小企业与市长办公室联络小组。 市政府竞选委员会官员说，今年的投票率约38%。最高的投票率在1999年，41%。 市长换届的还有惊喜城（Surprise），莎朗沃尔科特（WOLCOTT, SHARON）当选。
aa6031e76d6b2d046de0703daf17d2edc793d611.translatedText: Jonathan Rothschild elected mayor of Tucson (Alberta Times) Jonathan Rothschild has been elected as the new mayor of Tucson and will replace the departing Wald. Rothschild of the Democratic Party has lost 55% of the votes to his opponents, Republican Rick Grinnell and the Green Party's Married Kemp. This is the first time since 1999 that a Democratic Party has governed Tucson. Rothschild was a lawyer before his election. He promised to launch a discussion on business interests and establish a liaison group between small businesses and the mayor's office within his first 180 days in office. City campaign committee officials said turnout this year was about 38%. The highest turnout was in 1999, 41%. Also changing mayors was Surprise, where WOLCOTT, SHARON was elected.

b8b9fa9b03ac0e6609b5eaca925f35be05a9af6d.sourceText: （太阳鸟特约记者王帅报道）身处海外的华人，无论是旅居多年已经扎根美利坚的华侨，还是刚刚踏上北美大陆的广大留学生群体。最令人怀念的，同时也是最难以令人适应的就是饮食了。
b8b9fa9b03ac0e6609b5eaca925f35be05a9af6d.translatedText: (Reported by Sunbird Special Correspondent Wang Shuai) Chinese overseas, whether they are overseas Chinese who have lived in the United States for many years and have taken root in the United States, or the vast group of international students who have just set foot on the North American continent. The most nostalgic thing, but also the most difficult to adapt to, is the diet.

1a1dc2d29e57d003536fe7fe239473bf3df02553.sourceText: 中华饮食博大精深之处自不必说，单是烹调手法上就要比西方饮食精细许多，更不用说源远流长，百花齐放的各大菜系了。在美洲大地入乡随俗的中华饮食，一是在流派上限制许多，主要以最广泛的川菜为主；二是口味上有所变化，以适应美国人偏甜偏油的口味。同胞们想要吃到正宗的中华美食，可得正经费一番脑筋。
1a1dc2d29e57d003536fe7fe239473bf3df02553.translatedText: Needless to say, the Chinese cuisine is extensive and profound. The cooking techniques alone are much more sophisticated than those of Western cuisine, not to mention the various major cuisines that have a long history and are in full bloom. The Chinese food that follows the local customs in America is, firstly, very restrictive in terms of genres, mainly Sichuan cuisine, which is the most widespread; secondly, the taste has changed to adapt to the sweet and oily tastes of Americans. Compatriots who want to eat authentic Chinese food have to spend a lot of money.

c52391211b27943944edb22bddf70537f0261a66.sourceText: 而我们今天要介绍的，正是在菲尼克斯都会区颇有名气的一家广式茶餐厅，以地道，传统的广粤早茶 (dim-sum) 而著称。这就是位于 chandler 的蓝天餐馆 ( China king restaurant) 。
c52391211b27943944edb22bddf70537f0261a66.translatedText: What we are going to introduce today is a famous Cantonese tea restaurant in the Phoenix metropolitan area, famous for its authentic and traditional Cantonese morning tea (dim-sum). This is the China king restaurant located in Chandler.

b15ab671a3a4bb468159428b8e5c343782af481d.sourceText: 早茶是一种非常具有广东香港地区特色的饮食。相传是在清朝咸丰年间兴起的，茶馆在当时几乎是社交场所的同义词。一开始他们只是提供简单的茶点作为点缀，后来茶馆经营者发现茶点更受欢迎，也就越做越多，越做越精致了。
b15ab671a3a4bb468159428b8e5c343782af481d.translatedText: Morning tea is a kind of food with special characteristics of Guangdong and Hong Kong. According to legend, it emerged during the Xianfeng period of the Qing Dynasty. Teahouses were almost synonymous with social places at that time. At first they only provided simple tea snacks as decorations. Later, teahouse operators found that tea snacks were more popular, so they made more and more exquisite tea snacks.

c14eaa4633bfd47fc316d374376591ed9a3641a6.sourceText: 早茶茶水的种类主要有普洱，菊花，乌龙，铁观音等等润肺养胃之选。而早茶茶点主要分为干湿两种：干的就是指诸如糕点，蒸饺，包子等等。而湿则是指粥类，豆腐花，以及卤味等等。作为一家以早茶出名的中餐馆，蓝天餐厅都有许多经典的菜式可供选择，比如菠萝包就是其中十分受欢迎的一款糕点。
c14eaa4633bfd47fc316d374376591ed9a3641a6.translatedText: The main types of morning tea include Pu'er, chrysanthemum, oolong, Tieguanyin, etc., which are suitable for nourishing the lungs and nourishing the stomach. Morning tea snacks are mainly divided into dry and wet ones: dry ones refer to pastries, steamed dumplings, steamed buns, etc. Wet refers to porridge, tofu curd, braised food, etc. As a Chinese restaurant famous for its morning tea, Blue Sky Restaurant has many classic dishes to choose from, such as pineapple buns, which is a very popular pastry.

ea551874918d55da456a77aa8b01baaee6e3eeb1.sourceText: 其面包外胚烘培地极为蓬松，而里面的椰蓉馅则是香滑无比，最令人称道的是甜度掌握得恰到好处，使得这款甜点吃起来本身没有过分腻人，如果赶上刚出炉的热气尚有松软无比的菠萝包，再佐以一壶菊花茶或者皮蛋瘦肉粥及第粥之类的粥点。细细品尝，可能也就容易理解为什么广东人愿意在茶楼一坐就是几个时辰的奥妙所在了。
ea551874918d55da456a77aa8b01baaee6e3eeb1.translatedText: The outside of the bread is baked to be extremely fluffy, while the coconut filling inside is extremely smooth. The most commendable thing is that the sweetness is just right, making this dessert not too greasy. If you catch the heat of the oven, there will still be extremely soft pineapple buns, and then accompany it with a pot of chrysanthemum tea or preserved egg lean meat porridge and porridge. After tasting it carefully, it may be easy to understand why Cantonese people are willing to sit in the teahouse for several hours.

f715cb748c47b5967112881989552e47ec00b2a8.sourceText: 除了地道传统的茶点，蓝天餐馆也有一些适应了美国人口味而推出的创新作品，比如油炸茄子与油炸虾球。如果想在传统的茶点之外尝尝新鲜，这种富有”美国特色”的小吃不妨一试。
f715cb748c47b5967112881989552e47ec00b2a8.translatedText: In addition to authentic traditional refreshments, Blue Sky Restaurant also has some innovative creations adapted to American tastes, such as fried eggplant and fried shrimp balls. If you want to try something new besides traditional tea snacks, you might as well give this snack with "American characteristics" a try.

125c9db793ca929217e03505b7e50516a03f88e8.sourceText: 整个餐厅在装修上都是统一的中式风格，服务员也大多是华人，甚至还能见到年纪颇大的阿姨热情地忙碌着。如果吃腻了美式食物和改良的中国菜系，这种传统的中式早茶应该会是怀念中华美食的人们的一个好的选择。
125c9db793ca929217e03505b7e50516a03f88e8.translatedText: The entire restaurant is decorated in a unified Chinese style, and most of the waiters are Chinese, and you can even see older aunties working enthusiastically. If you are tired of eating American food and modified Chinese cuisine, this traditional Chinese morning tea should be a good choice for people who miss Chinese food.

7038af296e93a728f36a202c5505d80e949e12eb.sourceText: 在各界人士的积极倡导下，在新东方艺术学校的大力赞助下，美中文化艺术协会将定期地，系统地，广泛地举办有关美中文化艺术的讲座和介绍。其中包括对绘画，书法，音乐，舞蹈，文学，语言文字，历史，饮食，以及传统保健和风土人情等不同领域的介绍，演练和讨论。近期将举办的是由著名中国画画家李成先生和著名中国书法家陈普博士联手的 ”中国画浅谈及学习”和”中国书法浅谈及学习”的系列讲座。李成先生的”天马”图曾入围2010上海世博会，陈普博士的书法作品也多次在中国书法比赛和福建省书法比赛获奖。热烈欢迎所有对中国画和中国书法有兴趣的各界人士和朋友参加本次讲座, 并诚挚地希望大家对美中文化艺术交流活动提出宝贵的意见和建议。愿美中文化艺术交流系列活动成为广大专家，学者和爱好者交流学习的平台。 时间：2011年11月19日，週六，下午4点30分-6点 地点：新东方艺术学校第二教室 1100 North Alma School Rd, Room #18, Chandler, AZ 85224 （Alma School/Ray西北角）
7038af296e93a728f36a202c5505d80e949e12eb.translatedText: With the active advocacy of people from all walks of life and the strong sponsorship of New Oriental Art School, the U.S.-China Culture and Art Association will regularly, systematically and extensively hold lectures and introductions on U.S.-China culture and art. These include introductions, exercises and discussions in different fields such as painting, calligraphy, music, dance, literature, language, history, food, as well as traditional health care and local customs. What will be held in the near future is a series of lectures on "A Brief Introduction to Chinese Painting and Learning" and "A Brief Introduction to Chinese Calligraphy" jointly held by the famous Chinese painting painter Mr. Li Cheng and the famous Chinese calligrapher Dr. Chen Pu. Mr. Li Cheng's "Pegasus" picture was shortlisted for the 2010 Shanghai World Expo. Dr. Chen Pu's calligraphy works have also won many awards in the Chinese Calligraphy Competition and the Fujian Provincial Calligraphy Competition. We warmly welcome all people and friends from all walks of life who are interested in Chinese painting and Chinese calligraphy to attend this lecture, and sincerely hope that everyone can provide valuable opinions and suggestions on the cultural and artistic exchange activities between the United States and China. We hope that the series of cultural and artistic exchange activities between the United States and China will become a platform for experts, scholars and enthusiasts to exchange and learn. Time: November 19, 2011, Saturday, 4:30pm-6:00pm Location: Classroom 2, New Oriental Art School 1100 North Alma School Rd, Room #18, Chandler, AZ 85224 (Northwest corner of Alma School/Ray)

01ce4f76fbae545f1cdda1995e5a4d3983503b15.sourceText: 美国务院严查限制J-1签证计划 美国中文网报道，美国国务院出台新政策限制备受争议的J-1交流签证计划，暂停新增签证支持雇主，该签证帮助数以千计的外籍学生来美做从事临时工作。 据美联社报道，国务院周一（11月7日）公布新规定。当局出台对J?1签证的限制政策，源于多家媒体报道，该签证支持的众多外籍学生被逼在脱衣舞俱乐部工作，或从事每小时1美元的低级粗活。 持有该临时签证的学生被要求必须有工作，他们经常在度假村和餐馆打工。 J-1签证发展迅速，在1996年的大约2万名学生参与，在2008年达到超过15万学生的高峰期，在过去十年，大约有100万外籍大专院校学生参与了这项签证计划。 该签证计划原是为了促进美国和他国学生之间的文化交流和增强理解。但随着项目的发展壮大，问题也不断，接到大量投诉。国务院已经在今夏修订规则， 要求官方指定的53个签证支持机构承担更多的责任。 国务院周一表示：”然而，尽管这些新规定，投诉数量还是高得令人无法接受，其中包括不适当的工作岗位、欺诈性工作，参加者抵达美国后工作被无辜取消，不适当工作小时，还涉及住房和交通等问题。” ”为了确保这些问题得到妥善解决，国务院正在继续严格审查暑期工作计划和管理规定。” 最明显的投诉发生在今年8月，在宾夕法尼亚州赫西巧克力工厂工作的几十名持有该签证的工人抗议工作条件恶劣和盘剥，从事过重的体力劳动和获取极少的薪酬。 此类问题已经出现多年，但随着美国经济疲软，外籍学生受到的盘剥更加严重，赚取的薪酬还不够他们支付中介来美的费用。 媒体报道，做糟糕的情况还包括一名女学生被告知在弗吉尼亚州的一个餐厅工作，但来美后，遭殴打和强逼在底特律作脱衣舞舞女。 该签证项目吸引了数以百万计的签证支持商和第三方劳工招聘中介。美国当地商业聘请外籍学生可以节省8％的劳工成本，因为他们不用支付医疗保险，社会保障和失业税。许多企业表示，他们需要季节性劳工，以满足旅游旺季的需求。
01ce4f76fbae545f1cdda1995e5a4d3983503b15.translatedText: The U.S. State Department strictly investigates and restricts the J-1 visa program. The U.S. Chinese website reported that the U.S. State Department has introduced new policies to restrict the controversial J-1 exchange visa program and suspend new visas to support employers. This visa helps thousands of foreign students come to the United States to do temporary work. According to the Associated Press, the State Council announced new regulations on Monday (November 7). The authorities introduced restrictive policies on J1 visas due to multiple media reports that many foreign students supported by this visa were forced to work in strip clubs or engage in low-level menial jobs for $1 an hour. Students holding this temporary visa are required to have a job, and they often work in resorts and restaurants. The J-1 visa has grown rapidly, with approximately 20,000 students participating in 1996, reaching a peak of more than 150,000 students in 2008. In the past decade, approximately 1 million foreign college and university students have participated in this visa program. The visa program was originally intended to promote cultural exchange and enhance understanding between students from the United States and other countries. But as the project grew, problems continued, and a large number of complaints were received. The State Department has revised its rules this summer to require more responsibility from the 53 officially designated visa support agencies. "However, despite these new rules, the number of complaints remains unacceptably high, including inappropriate job placements, fraudulent employment, job cancellations upon participants' arrival in the United States, inappropriate work hours, and housing and transportation issues," the State Department said Monday. "To ensure these issues are appropriately addressed, the State Department is continuing to rigorously review the summer jobs program and administrative regulations." The most visible complaint came in August, when dozens of workers on this visa working at a Hersey chocolate factory in Pennsylvania protested poor and exploitative working conditions, excessive physical labor and minimal pay. Such problems have been occurring for many years, but as the U.S. economy weakens, foreign students are being exploited even more seriously, and the salaries they earn are not enough to pay for agents to come to the United States. Media reports include a female student who was told to work at a restaurant in Virginia, but after coming to the United States, she was beaten and forced to work as a stripper in Detroit. The visa program attracts millions of visa sponsors and third-party labor recruitment agencies. Local businesses in the United States can save 8% on labor costs by hiring foreign students because they do not have to pay health insurance, Social Security and unemployment taxes. Many businesses say they need seasonal labor to meet demand during the peak tourist season.

be2596f928234e94e6d0c7a6f3eeb8887402fb16.sourceText: 2012年中国舞蹈春令特色营（大连）全美招募营员 由中国国务院侨务办公室主办，全美中华青年联合会海外承办的”2012国侨办海外华裔青少年中国寻根之旅”大连春令营活动现已正式开始接受报名，欢迎年龄在16岁至23岁的全美各地、对中国舞蹈有兴趣的华裔青少年踊跃参加。将在辽宁省大连市举办的中国舞蹈春令营时间为 2012年4月10日 – 2012年4月23日。 这次春令营的主办单位辽宁师范大学国际教育学院介绍，希望营员们通过参加这次春令营的学习，参观和实地培训，华人华侨子女们可以学习中国舞蹈基础和经典民族舞蹈，并了解中华民族几千年的文明史。在游教结合、参观当地历史文化名胜及和当地学生联谊交流等活动中，来自世界各地的120名华裔青少年精英相互交流学习各国文化习俗，使这些长期生活在国外的第二代华人华侨子女，更加深刻了解中华民族的精髓所在。 现将全美中华青年联合会、中国寻根之旅夏（冬）令营美国营员联谊会提供的这次特色春令营招募营员的具体信息公布如下：?学员组成：年龄在16岁至23岁的华裔青少年。(需对舞蹈学习有兴趣)?报名人数: 全美10人(名额有限,预报从速)?春令营时间： 2012年4月10日 – 2012年4月23日。?活动内容: 1)安排中国舞蹈基础和经典民族舞蹈学习； 2)安排汉语知识、中国历史、传统剪纸、中华礼仪的学习等； 3)安排四条旅游线路全景体验中国文化；?活动费用：国务院侨办负责在辽宁大连春令营活动期间的吃，住，行，以及参观学习费用；其它费用如：国际机票、签证费、报名费等由学员自行承担。?报名时间：报名即日起，结束时间为2012年03月15日。?报名联系人：佘 军 Tel:626-617-8608 e-mail:junsheusa@gmail.com; 朱冰峰 Tel:626-320-2201 Fax: 888-634-9357?报名注意事项： 1) 报名时提供营员与家长的护照或绿卡复印件及联系电话;缴纳报名费(不接受信用卡) 2) 报名截至日期是3/15/2012。 已经确认正式参加春令营的成员，须在3/18/2011之前，向春令营活动联系人提供你的已订机票复印件。以便确定具体参团人数。（AACYF洛杉矶讯）
be2596f928234e94e6d0c7a6f3eeb8887402fb16.translatedText: The 2012 Chinese Dance Spring Festival Special Camp (Dalian) is recruiting campers across the United States. Sponsored by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council of the People's Republic of China and hosted by the National Chinese Youth Federation, the "2012 Overseas Chinese Youth Overseas Chinese Youth Journey to China" Dalian Spring Camp is now officially open for registration. Chinese youths from all over the United States aged 16 to 23 who are interested in Chinese dance are welcome to actively participate. The Chinese Dance Spring Camp will be held in Dalian City, Liaoning Province from April 10, 2012 to April 23, 2012. According to the School of International Education of Liaoning Normal University, the organizer of this spring camp, it is hoped that by participating in the study, visits and field training of this spring camp, the children of overseas Chinese can learn the basics of Chinese dance and classic folk dances, and understand the thousands of years of civilization history of the Chinese nation. Through activities such as traveling and education, visiting local historical and cultural attractions, and socializing with local students, 120 Chinese young elites from all over the world communicated with each other and learned the cultural customs of various countries, allowing these second-generation Chinese children who have lived abroad for a long time to have a deeper understanding of the essence of the Chinese nation. The specific information on recruiting campers for this special spring camp provided by the National Chinese Youth Federation and the China Roots Journey Summer (Winter) Camp American Campers Association is now announced as follows: ?Student composition: Chinese teenagers aged 16 to 23 years old. (Need to be interested in dance learning)? Number of applicants: 10 people from the United States (limited places, please register as soon as possible)? Spring camp time: April 10, 2012 – April 23, 2012. Activities content: 1) Arrange for learning the basics of Chinese dance and classic folk dances; 2) Arrange for learning Chinese knowledge, Chinese history, traditional paper-cutting, Chinese etiquette, etc.; 3) Arrange four tourist routes to experience Chinese culture in a panoramic manner; Activities expenses: The Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council is responsible for food, accommodation, transportation, and visiting and learning expenses during the Spring Camp in Dalian, Liaoning; other expenses such as international air tickets, visa fees, registration fees, etc. are borne by the students themselves. ?Registration time: Registration starts today and ends on March 15, 2012. ?Registration contact: She Jun Tel: 626-617-8608 e-mail: junsheusa@gmail.com; Zhu Bingfeng Tel: 626-320-2201 Fax: 888-634-9357 ?Registration notes: 1) Provide copies of passports or green cards and contact numbers of campers and parents when registering; pay the registration fee (credit cards are not accepted) 2) Registration deadline is 3/15/2012. Members who have confirmed to officially participate in the spring camp must provide a copy of your booked air ticket to the spring camp contact person before 3/18/2011. In order to determine the specific number of participants. (AACYF Los Angeles News)

f393e14685fcfffc56dbac3dd91f4c2cc65ac230.translatedText: Ten thousand people’s blind date party has "booked" half of the town, and will be held in Songjiang New Town on November 11. Consultations continue after the registration deadline 3,300 couples made reservations today?#33073;光?/FONT>

fe13611da34a662c8cd34f75ea948840c172d99c.sourceText: 2011年11月11日，这一天极有可能成为今年上海结婚人数最多的一天。昨日，上海市民政局公布统计数据，共有3300对新人已在网上预约”脱光”。而更为庞大的”脱光”军团还将在明后天集体涌入松江泰晤士小镇的万人相亲大会。
fe13611da34a662c8cd34f75ea948840c172d99c.translatedText: November 11, 2011. This day is very likely to become the day with the largest number of weddings in Shanghai this year. Yesterday, the Shanghai Municipal Civil Affairs Bureau released statistics showing that a total of 3,300 newlyweds had made online reservations to "take off their clothes." And an even larger army of "stripped naked" will flock to Songjiang Thames Town for a blind date meeting of thousands of people tomorrow and the day after tomorrow.

9967c7ad15b5346a852bb13415766efcfa01318b.sourceText: 预约人数逼近今年纪录
9967c7ad15b5346a852bb13415766efcfa01318b.translatedText: The number of reservations is close to this year's record

478a7359bbdcadcbcfe52873412faa71f991db69.sourceText: 3300对的预约数量着实不容小觑，截至目前，今年上海结婚人数最多的一天是8月6日七夕，共有3342对新人领证。
478a7359bbdcadcbcfe52873412faa71f991db69.translatedText: The number of reservations of 3,300 couples should not be underestimated. So far, the day with the largest number of weddings in Shanghai this year is August 6th, Chinese Valentine's Day, with a total of 3,342 couples receiving certificates.

54203e3c043fb824eb5b784536cd3e5f5ab66534.sourceText: 按照以往经验，实际登记的人数往往要比预约时多出几倍。譬如，今年七夕的预约登记人数就只有810对。因此3300对的预约人数几乎已经意味着明天将成为今年沪上登记人数最多的一天。
54203e3c043fb824eb5b784536cd3e5f5ab66534.translatedText: According to past experience, the actual number of people registered is often several times more than the number of reservations. For example, there are only 810 couples registered for this year’s Chinese Valentine’s Day. Therefore, the 3,300 pairs of reservations almost means that tomorrow will be the day with the largest number of registrations in Shanghai this year.

adbe4feac920c73f153c35a8612d8ea3859cf963.sourceText: 但明天是否能够打破2010年10月10日10150对新人同日结婚的最高纪录，上海市民政局工作人员称尚不能下断言。
adbe4feac920c73f153c35a8612d8ea3859cf963.translatedText: But whether tomorrow can break the record of 10,150 couples getting married on the same day on October 10, 2010, staff from the Shanghai Civil Affairs Bureau said they could not yet make a conclusion.

a0eeed213db1c2caecfee45942a3f6f38a1e2f85.sourceText: 在光棍节后的周末，希望”脱光”的青年男女们继续忙碌。昨日早报记者在松江泰晤士小镇看到，本周末将在这里举办的”万人相亲大会”上海市首届婚恋博览会正在紧锣密鼓地准备。
a0eeed213db1c2caecfee45942a3f6f38a1e2f85.translatedText: On the weekend after Singles' Day, young men and women who want to "take off their clothes" will continue to be busy. Yesterday Morning Post reporters saw in Songjiang Thames Town that preparations for Shanghai's first Love and Marriage Expo, a "Dating Conference for Thousands of People" to be held here this weekend, are in full swing.

2e114d2f88868db17fe7858c2c51fb654c83183f.sourceText: 记者了解到，本次博览会分为5个区：A区教堂广场将进行开幕式和大型户外演艺活动。B区是活动主会场，一楼为婚恋用品展示展销大厅，二楼分布着40余家婚姻介绍所的展位。
2e114d2f88868db17fe7858c2c51fb654c83183f.translatedText: The reporter learned that this expo is divided into 5 areas: Area A Church Square will hold an opening ceremony and large-scale outdoor performing arts activities. Area B is the main venue of the event. The first floor is the exhibition and sales hall for marriage and love products, and the second floor is dotted with the booths of more than 40 marriage agencies.

e7ac126d328114d8b9b04d55753190342b0f14b0.sourceText: 在C、D两个区域，若干面一人多高的”寻缘墙”上贴着5000多个单身男女的”缘分卡片”，上面列着包括年龄、性别、身高、体重、学历、工作收入以及对另一半的要求等详细信息。
e7ac126d328114d8b9b04d55753190342b0f14b0.translatedText: In areas C and D, there are several "fate-seeking walls" as tall as one person, with more than 5,000 "fate cards" of single men and women posted on them, which list detailed information including age, gender, height, weight, education, work income, and requirements for their partner.

eee16275a5f904e0c53fda38e9611f977f4f3f3d.sourceText: 记者昨天还发现一些心急的爸妈已来到尚未布置完工的现场，透过玻璃窗张望”寻缘墙”上的信息，希望早点为自己的儿女物色合适对象。
eee16275a5f904e0c53fda38e9611f977f4f3f3d.translatedText: The reporter also discovered yesterday that some anxious parents had come to the unfinished site and looked through the glass windows at the information on the "Fate-seeking Wall", hoping to find a suitable partner for their children as soon as possible.

5e195586b7844ee3c6817c9c89d39bdf0102ec02.sourceText: ”虽然我们对人数做了提前控制，但现场到底会来多少人真的很难预计。”活动主办方之一的上海市婚介机构管理协会会长周珏珉称。
5e195586b7844ee3c6817c9c89d39bdf0102ec02.translatedText: "Although we have controlled the number of people in advance, it is really difficult to predict how many people will come to the scene." Zhou Juemin, president of the Shanghai Matchmaking Agency Management Association, one of the organizers of the event, said.

b7adb05b5af75b3c24109542a138b9cfe3a336a8.sourceText: 周珏珉透露，原本计划的活动场地在室内，大约有1万平方米。但在报名截止后，前来电话咨询的人依然源源不断，”我们已经把室内互动场从一个扩大到了三个，相亲大会的活动范围也从室内扩展到了室外，现在半个泰晤士小镇都被’包’下来了。”
b7adb05b5af75b3c24109542a138b9cfe3a336a8.translatedText: Zhou Juemin revealed that the originally planned event venue was indoors, covering approximately 10,000 square meters. But after the registration deadline, there was still a steady stream of people calling for consultation, "We have expanded the indoor interactive venue from one to three, and the scope of the blind date conference has also expanded from indoor to outdoor. Now half of Thames Town is 'covered'."

617bdf2f53e911876edb3dcabd17b8a80165802f.sourceText: 按照计划，万人相亲大会将在明天上午10点30分开幕，11点11分正式吹响”爱情集结号”。
617bdf2f53e911876edb3dcabd17b8a80165802f.translatedText: According to the plan, the 10,000-person blind date conference will open at 10:30 tomorrow morning, and the "Love Rally" will officially sound at 11:11.

f41301217ee9d933f528ed4cdf3e15ea930d5bc6.translatedText: The third Chinese Character Recognition Competition of Phoenix City Chinese School was successfully held (picture) Written by Chen Huiling and Qiu Liyi Phoenix Chinese School held the third Chinese character recognition competition on the afternoon of November 6th...

aff10524162fbc3045527b81663a321196163c64.sourceText: 陈慧玲、邱立仪 撰稿 凤凰城中文学校于十一月六日下午举办第三届认字比赛，学校举办认字比赛的宗旨是让每一位参加的同学藉由游戏中学习中文和团队合作。在比赛开始之前，首先由主持人 ─ 凤凰城中文学校校长程秀玲致词，并且讲解认字比赛规则，好让每一位学生能充分了解比赛规则。
aff10524162fbc3045527b81663a321196163c64.translatedText: Written by Chen Huiling and Qiu Liyi Phoenix Chinese School held its third Chinese Character Recognition Competition on the afternoon of November 6. The purpose of the school's Chinese Character Recognition Competition was to allow every participating student to learn Chinese and work as a team through the game. Before the competition started, the host, Cheng Xiuling, the principal of Phoenix Chinese School, delivered a speech and explained the rules of the word recognition competition so that every student could fully understand the rules of the competition.

147645cbf85c38e6e7fd4068a3270d5e27e4d80a.translatedText: The Chinese character recognition competition has begun

40fec8ffb61f51c0c827242773313e0111417401.sourceText: 本届认字比赛是将五到十一年级学生平均分为六组【红黄蓝绿紫白】，每一组约8人，组员按照抽籤号码回答问题；每人至少有四次答题机会。校方在本届认字比赛的出题方式也做了一番革新。今年则改採用Jeopardy的游戏方式，同学们可选择属于自己年级的题目，因此更能发挥出自己应有的水准。另外，改採用电脑记分，省去人力计算成绩的麻烦。 在出题方面，除了生字、成语之外，多加了趣味问答。在比赛过程中，每一位组员都谨慎选择题目和答题。其中白队和红队在成语抢答时最为激烈，而且在用成语造句子时，也造出许多有趣的句子来。蓝队、黄队、绿队和紫队也相继在趣味问题答题中，让家长看到这些同学不仅仅认识中文字而已，还懂得历史、民俗文化、古诗、和生活趣味等等。最后，校长也出特别题， 让同学以”中文翻译英文”抢答，从学生抢答中，看出学生融合了解中英文的能力和学习成果。
40fec8ffb61f51c0c827242773313e0111417401.translatedText: This Chinese character recognition competition divides students from fifth to eleventh grade into six groups [red, yellow, blue, green, purple and white], with about 8 people in each group. The group members answer questions according to the lottery numbers; each person has at least four opportunities to answer questions. The school has also made some innovations in the way of setting questions for this year’s word recognition competition. This year, the Jeopardy game method is adopted. Students can choose questions that belong to their own grade, so they can better demonstrate their own level. In addition, computer scoring is used to save the trouble of manual calculation of scores. In terms of questions, in addition to new words and idioms, more interesting questions and answers are added. During the competition, each team member carefully selected the questions and answers. Among them, the white team and the red team were the most intense in answering idioms, and they also created many interesting sentences when using idioms to make sentences. The blue team, yellow team, green team and purple team also answered interesting questions one after another, allowing parents to see that these students not only know Chinese characters, but also understand history, folk culture, ancient poetry, and life interests, etc. Finally, the principal also asked the students to answer a special question using "Chinese to English". From the students' answers, we can see the students' ability to integrate Chinese and English and their learning achievements.

17b41d8e1b68eeb63abcd2bcd5898737d4422c39.sourceText: 踊跃抢答 最后在经过长达两个小时比赛，终于分出高下，由白队获胜。不过学校基于鼓励学生参与重于名次，除了白队的每一位同学有一份奖品和奖状之外，其他参与的同学皆获得一份奖品，以兹鼓励。希望藉由认字比赛的方式，结合寓教娱乐，激发学生广泛得学习中文。
17b41d8e1b68eeb63abcd2bcd5898737d4422c39.translatedText: The answer was enthusiastically answered. Finally, after two hours of competition, the game was finally decided and the white team won. However, the school encourages students to participate more than ranking. In addition to each student in the white team receiving a prize and a certificate, all other participating students received a prize as an encouragement. It is hoped that through the method of word recognition competition, combined with educational entertainment, it can inspire students to learn Chinese extensively.

28aee72cea8c9d41989b49a43c3527f159de922a.translatedText: A group photo of the winning students

06e2a3e32126aeb674757a512f7f21b0c28041e6.sourceText: 校方也特别感谢五至十一年级的六位老师，在比赛前利用各式各样的方法，让同学们努力地複习已学过得中文字或成语。尤其是五B班同学，生长在非华语家庭，每週可能只有来中文学校的两个小时才能有机会说华语，但他们第一次参赛的表现丝毫不输给A班 (说华语家庭) 的同学，赢得大家称讚的眼光。学中文的路是漫长而艰辛的，希望在同学、老师和校方三方面共同的努力，就像同学们回答成语造句时说的 ”我们要【再接再厉】学中文”， 让我们一起沉浸在中文的薰陶中。 如果您想多认识凤凰城中文学校，或是想加入这个大家庭，请与校长程秀玲联络(480-620-1982) 或参观学校网页(http://clsphoenix.org/)。
06e2a3e32126aeb674757a512f7f21b0c28041e6.translatedText: The school also expresses special thanks to the six teachers from grades 5 to 11 for using a variety of methods to help the students review Chinese characters or idioms they have learned before the competition. Especially the students in Class 5B, who grew up in non-Chinese-speaking families, may only have the opportunity to speak Chinese for two hours a week when they come to the Chinese school. However, their performance in the first competition was not inferior to the students in Class A (from Chinese-speaking families), and they won everyone's praise. The road to learning Chinese is long and arduous. I hope that with the joint efforts of classmates, teachers and the school, just like the students said when answering the idioms and sentences, "We must [keep up our efforts] to learn Chinese", let us immerse ourselves in the influence of Chinese together. If you want to know more about Phoenix Chinese School or want to join this big family, please contact the principal Cheng Xiuling (480-620-1982) or visit the school website (http://clsphoenix.org/).

a6b128c4800278110eb7218bacea66654d718e95.translatedText: Bankruptcy filings fell in the Phoenix area. According to data from the Phoenix Division of the U.S. Bankruptcy Court, although bankruptcy filings in the greater Phoenix area increased slightly in October compared with September, and...

0829134c39f68088c4f02dd7abfcee44b86e42ad.sourceText: 凤凰城地区破产申请下降 据美国破产法庭凤凰城分庭数据，虽然大凤凰地区10月份的破产申请比9月有些微上升，与去年同期相比，下降了22%。今年头10个月同比下降13%。整个亚利桑那州破产申请，10月下跌了23%，同样趋势明显。 10月有2074例申请，其中有85%是按破产条例第7章申请，就是允许债务人将非豁免资产出售以偿还债务人。破产条例第13章，功能是由法院监督的债务还款计划，债务人资产将所剩无几。 根据美国破产研究所和国家破产研究中心资料，在全国范围内，从2010年10月破产者下降了20%。 以上数据不意味着消费者和企业的财政状况有了很好的改进，调查显示最近几个月消费者信心下降。
0829134c39f68088c4f02dd7abfcee44b86e42ad.translatedText: Bankruptcy filings in the Phoenix area fell. In the first 10 months of this year, it fell 13% year-on-year. Bankruptcy filings across Arizona fell 23% in October, a similar trend. There were 2,074 filings in October, 85% of which were filed under Chapter 7 of the Bankruptcy Ordinance, which allows debtors to sell non-exempt assets to repay the debtor. Chapter 13 Bankruptcy functions as a court-supervised debt repayment plan in which the debtor will have very few assets left. Nationwide, bankruptcies have dropped 20 percent since October 2010, according to the American Bankruptcy Institute and the National Bankruptcy Research Center. The above data does not mean that the financial situation of consumers and businesses has improved greatly. Surveys show that consumer confidence has declined in recent months.

74d6b293c38437549a956d26dd92bfe7ea3e9717.sourceText: 2012亲情中华春节晚会””全家福””照片有奖征集活动细则 一、活动概述 春节是全球华人共同欢庆的传统节日，2012亲情中华春晚面向海外侨胞和国内归侨侨眷隆重推出全家福图片故事的有奖征集活动，让我们用全家福的方式，见证家庭的温馨与和谐吧！全家福不仅记录了一个家庭的完美幸福，更是每一个家庭成员值得珍藏一生、代代相传的精神财富。把您最温馨最感人的影像发给我们，让全球华人一起分享这些幸福与快乐。 二、征集要求 1. ”家庭成员”可以是亲属关系，也可以是体现社会大家庭和谐关系的特定群体。我们鼓励参与者提交多张不同年代本家庭的照片，便于呈现一个家庭的变迁故事。 2. 建议您为每幅作品配上文字说明，讲述与照片相关的温馨回忆，字数不限。 3. 请将照片翻拍或扫描为JPG格式，单个文件大小不超过2兆。 4. 照片版权归属参与者或作者所有，活动主办方拥有入选作品在晚会及相关活动中的使权。作品涉及的肖像权问题由参与者解决。只要参与者以任何方式发送图片至本组委会，都视作同意并接受本约定。 5. 任何第三方使用这些活动图片，需事先征得本组委会与投稿人的同意。 三、评选方法 1. a.网友投票选举 b.评审专家审定 本次活动设特等奖一名，”金龙”奖两名，”银龙”奖三名，另外还将评出一百名优秀作品奖。?nbsp; 特等奖：获奖照片的家庭将获邀参加”2012亲情中华春晚”节目现场的录制。?nbsp; ”金龙”奖： iPhone4S一台。?nbsp; ”银龙”奖：iPad2一台。?nbsp; 优秀作品奖：2012亲情中华春晚实录DVD一张。?nbsp; 所有符合评审要求的照片都将出现在晚会现场及春晚官方网站上。 2. 专家评审团组成： 中华全国归国华侨联合会、春晚组委会、国内媒体代表和摄影专业人士等。 3. 征集时间：即日起至2011年12月15日 四、参与方式 1. 填写附件中的参选表格，与投稿照片的电子文档一起，通过邮件方式发送至亲情中华春晚组委会专用邮箱: qqzhcw@gmail.com 或者qqzhcw@163.com 2. 或将照片与参选表格刻录成光盘，邮寄至组委会（地址：北京市朝阳区朝阳北路99号朝悦大厦1单元1601室，邮编100123），光盘恕不奉还，请自留备份。 咨询电话：（+86）010-8580-9804 本活动最终解释权归属亲情中华春节晚会组委会
74d6b293c38437549a956d26dd92bfe7ea3e9717.translatedText: 2012 Family China Spring Festival Gala "Family Portrait" photo prize collection event Details of the event 1. Activity Overview The Spring Festival is a traditional festival celebrated by Chinese people all over the world. The 2012 Family Chinese Spring Festival Gala grandly launches a prize-winning collection of family portraits and stories for overseas Chinese and domestic returned overseas Chinese. Let us use family portraits to witness the warmth and harmony of the family! Family portraits not only record the perfect happiness of a family, but are also spiritual wealth that every family member should treasure for a lifetime and be passed down from generation to generation. Send us your warmest and most touching images, so that Chinese people around the world can share these happiness and happiness. 2. Solicitation requirements 1. “Family members” can be relatives or specific groups that embody the harmonious relationship of a large social family. Participants are encouraged to submit multiple photos of their families from different eras to help present a family's story of change. 2. It is recommended that you add a text description to each work to describe the warm memories related to the photo. There is no limit to the number of words. 3. Please copy or scan the photos into JPG format, and the size of a single file should not exceed 2 MB. 4. The copyright of the photos belongs to the participants or authors, and the event organizer has the right to use the selected works in the party and related activities. The issue of portrait rights involved in the work will be resolved by the participants. As long as participants send pictures to the organizing committee in any way, they will be deemed to agree and accept this agreement. 5. Any third party using these event images must obtain the prior consent of the organizing committee and the contributor. 3. Selection method 1. a. Voting by netizens b. Determination by review experts This event will award one special prize, two "Golden Dragon" awards, and three "Silver Dragon" awards. e583c1876bb8df1b5ca4d7a326c6a1480e4e8da3.sourceText: 海外资产逾5万美元须申报 针对华人中炒得沸沸扬扬的「肥咖条款」，会计师李新忠在北美华人会计师协会29日举行年终税务讲座上指出，该条款其实就是美国政府去年通过的「外国资产帐户税务遵守法桉」（Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act，简称FATCA）。 该法桉由于国外阻力颇多，已将凡在美投资的海外金融机构须向美政府申报海外美国人帐户的生效时间，由2013年延后至2014年。但仍要求明年4月15日所得税申报截止日时，若海外帐户及资产超过5万美元，须与税表一起申报。 李新忠说，国税局曾制订出这项申报要求的8938表格草本，虽非最后版本，仍具参考价值，因符合要求者可开始蒐集资料。根据草桉，凡住美国的单身或已婚但分开申报所得税者，12月31日年底时若海外帐户及资产超过5万元，或一整年某个时间海外帐户及资产超过10万元，须申报8938表。定居国外的同样纳税人年底时海外帐户及资产超过20万元，或一整年某个时间超过40万元，也须申报。 已婚且共同申报所得税的人，若住美国且年底时海外帐户及资产超过10万元，或一整年某个时间超过20万元，若定居国外，则是年底时资产超过40万元，或一整年某个时间超过60万元，也须申报。 李新忠说，肥咖条款与1970年代生效的「外国财务帐户申报法桉」（Foreign Bank & Financial Account Report Act ，简称FBAR）不同。后者规定只要纳税人前一年在海外银行或证券公司的财务帐户最高总值超过1万元，须于次年6月30日前另填TDF90-22.1表， 向财政部申报。 肥咖条款规定须申报的海外资产范围则比FBAR广，尚包括海外公司股分、合伙利得、纳税人为受益人的海外信託帐户或遗产信託等，唯未包括房地产。 对依照肥咖条款申报8938表格的纳税人，在某些情形下很可能仍要申报TDF90-22.1表。如纳税人在台湾的银行年底时存款超过11万元，两个表格就都要申报。 北美华人会计师协会会长施启祥指出，肥咖条款包括在去年3月18日欧巴马总统签署生效的「僱用诱因法桉」（Hiring Incentives to Restore Employment，简称HIRE）内。由于实施僱用诱因法桉处处要用钱，政府于是另订肥咖条款增加税收。国税局最聪明之处在于试图逃过主权争议，避开与外国政府的外交部、财政部打交道，直接与在美国有投资的金融机构交涉。但从各种迹像看来，外国政府似乎并不愿意配合。 但施启祥说，外国的金融机构若想在美国做生意很难不买帐，否则就在美投资所生利息、股息等收入，将被预扣30%。
e583c1876bb8df1b5ca4d7a326c6a1480e4e8da3.translatedText: Overseas assets exceeding US$50,000 must be declared. Regarding the "fat coffee clause" that has become a hot topic among Chinese people, accountant Li Xinzhong pointed out at the year-end tax lecture held by the Chinese Accountants Association of North America on the 29th that this clause is actually the "Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act" (FATCA) passed by the US government last year. Due to considerable foreign resistance, this law has postponed the effective date for all overseas financial institutions investing in the United States to report overseas American accounts to the U.S. government from 2013 to 2014. However, it is still required that when the income tax filing deadline is April 15 next year, if overseas accounts and assets exceed US$50,000, they must be reported together with the tax form. Li Xinzhong said that the IRS has developed a draft form 8938 for this reporting requirement. Although it is not the final version, it is still of reference value because those who meet the requirements can start collecting information. According to the draft, all single or married individuals who live in the United States but file income taxes separately must file Form 8938 if their overseas accounts and assets exceed $50,000 at the end of December 31, or if their overseas accounts and assets exceed $100,000 at any time throughout the year. The same taxpayers who live abroad must also report if their overseas accounts and assets exceed 200,000 yuan at the end of the year, or if they exceed 400,000 yuan at a certain time throughout the year. Married people who file income taxes jointly must also declare if they live in the United States and their overseas accounts and assets exceed $100,000 at the end of the year, or exceed $200,000 at some time throughout the year. If they live abroad, their assets exceed $400,000 at the end of the year, or exceed $600,000 at some time throughout the year. Li Xinzhong said that the fat coffee provisions are different from the Foreign Bank & Financial Account Report Act (FBAR) that took effect in the 1970s. The latter stipulates that as long as the maximum total value of a taxpayer's financial account in an overseas bank or securities company in the previous year exceeds 10,000 yuan, he must fill out another form TDF90-22.1 and report to the Ministry of Finance before June 30 of the following year. The scope of overseas assets that must be reported under the FAQ provisions is wider than that of FBAR, including overseas company shares, partnership gains, overseas trust accounts or inheritance trusts in which taxpayers are beneficiaries, but does not include real estate. For taxpayers who file Form 8938 under the FAQ provisions, it is likely that they will still need to file Form TDF90-22.1 under certain circumstances. If a taxpayer's deposit in a bank in Taiwan exceeds 110,000 yuan at the end of the year, both forms must be reported. Shi Qixiang, president of the Chinese Accountants Association of North America, pointed out that the fat coffee clause is included in the Hiring Incentives to Restore Employment (HIRE) signed into law by President Obama on March 18 last year. Since the implementation of the Employment Incentive Law requires money, the government has made additional provisions to increase tax revenue. The smartest thing about the IRS is that it tries to avoid sovereignty disputes, avoids dealing with foreign governments’ ministries of foreign affairs and ministries of finance, and directly negotiates with financial institutions that have investments in the United States. But from various indications, foreign governments seem unwilling to cooperate. However, Shi Qixiang said that if foreign financial institutions want to do business in the United States, it is difficult not to buy into it, otherwise 30% of the interest, dividends and other income generated from investments in the United States will be withheld.

733f6555f1db9507894fe98784028f20646526b2.sourceText: 2011年11月10日，美国国务院公布了2011年12月最新的移民签证排期。
733f6555f1db9507894fe98784028f20646526b2.translatedText: On November 10, 2011, the U.S. State Department announced the latest immigrant visa schedule for December 2011.

a46ab3725902c96fe209f527e414c532e3b84862.sourceText: 与2011年11月相比，EB-2签证的截止日期和我们的推测一致，继续大幅向前推进，中国大陆出生的申请人的截止日期从11月的2007年11月1日前进到2008年3月15日，推进了4个半月。印度出生的申请人的EB-2截止日期也前进到2008年3月15日。
a46ab3725902c96fe209f527e414c532e3b84862.translatedText: Compared with November 2011, the deadline for EB-2 visas is consistent with our speculation and continues to advance significantly. The deadline for applicants born in mainland China has advanced by four and a half months from November 1, 2007 to March 15, 2008. The EB-2 deadline for Indian-born applicants has also been advanced to March 15, 2008.

daec3249042800b0bf9640a4e79f39f10d8b460e.sourceText: EB-1签证依然一如既往的全世界均有名额。而EB-3依然进程较为缓慢，大陆出生的申请人的截止日期较上个月仅仅推进了半个月，从2004年8月22日前进到2004年9月8日。
daec3249042800b0bf9640a4e79f39f10d8b460e.translatedText: EB-1 visa is still available all over the world as always. The EB-3 process is still relatively slow. The deadline for applicants born in mainland China has only been advanced by half a month compared with last month, from August 22, 2004 to September 8, 2004.

57ddab157ef8eef64f3d3a99560624953ab7ecfb.sourceText: 基于EB-3的审理进度缓慢，并且对于中国出生的申请人，截止日期比EB-2慢了两年有余。因此我们建议已经递交EB-3申请并获批正在等待排期的申请人，如果具有EB-2的条件（拥有硕士以上学历或学士并拥有五年以上工作经验），可以考虑再申请EB-2，这样，之前的EB-3的优先日可以用到EB-2的申请上，如此一来可以大大缩短等待排期的时间。同理，EB-2获批正在等待排期的申请人也可以再递交EB-1申请。
57ddab157ef8eef64f3d3a99560624953ab7ecfb.translatedText: The review process based on EB-3 is slow, and for Chinese-born applicants, the deadline is more than two years later than that of EB-2. Therefore, we recommend that applicants who have submitted an EB-3 application and been approved and are waiting for the EB-2 application can consider applying for EB-2 again if they meet the conditions of EB-2 (possessing a master's degree or above or a bachelor's degree and more than five years of work experience). In this way, the priority date of the previous EB-3 can be used for the EB-2 application, which can greatly shorten the waiting time for the EB-2 application. In the same way, applicants who have been approved for EB-2 and are waiting to be scheduled can also submit an EB-1 application.

2ee79681ca8c44981b353a5733378ce7f15af4e1.sourceText: 目前在中国较为流行的EB-5投资移民，虽然近年来申请人数显著上升，但目前也尚有名额。对于有经济条件的申请人也是不错的选择。
2ee79681ca8c44981b353a5733378ce7f15af4e1.translatedText: EB-5 investment immigration, which is currently more popular in China, although the number of applicants has increased significantly in recent years, there are still places available. It is also a good choice for applicants with financial resources.

82b553312a4040dc1550b513bc31ede3a57a878f.sourceText: 2011 年1月到9月， 我们事务所有188个NIW案件获得批准。此外，在此期间，我们所还有150个EB-1申请顺利获得批准。
82b553312a4040dc1550b513bc31ede3a57a878f.translatedText: From January to September 2011, our firm had 188 NIW cases approved. In addition, during this period, our firm successfully approved 150 EB-1 applications.

954b6e7449b2a4703980fbeefcb91095bda5760f.sourceText: 在您开始申请之前，咨询一位训练有素的法律专家是非常有必要的， 尤其是移民局在2010年8月18日出台了一个备忘录，已经开始更加严格地审核EB-1申请。从本质上说，该备忘录将EB-1评估过程分为两部分：1） 评估申请者是否符合移民申请类别的标准底线，以及2）决定申请者的证据是否证明申请者达到了移民类别所要求的高水平专业资格。在第2部分审核程序中，移民局将评估全部证据，从整体上看是否能够证明申请者在其领域内是最顶尖的。通俗来说，对于第一步审核，移民局官员着重看申请人在单纯的”量”上是否符合要求，在第二步审核中，移民局官员着重看申请人在总体的”质”上是否符合要求，”量”符合要求了不一定意味着”质”符合要求。
954b6e7449b2a4703980fbeefcb91095bda5760f.translatedText: Before you start your application, it is very necessary to consult a trained legal expert, especially since the USCIS issued a memorandum on August 18, 2010 and has begun to review EB-1 applications more strictly. Essentially, the memorandum breaks down the EB-1 evaluation process into two parts: 1) evaluating whether the applicant meets the standard baseline for the immigration category for which the petition was filed, and 2) determining whether the applicant’s evidence demonstrates that the applicant has achieved the high level of professional qualifications required for the immigration category. In Part 2 of the review process, USCIS will evaluate all evidence to see whether, taken as a whole, the applicant is the best in his or her field. Generally speaking, for the first step of review, the immigration officials focus on whether the applicant meets the requirements in terms of pure "quantity". In the second step of review, the immigration officials focus on whether the applicant meets the requirements on the overall "quality". Meeting the requirements in "quantity" does not necessarily mean that the requirements are met in "quality".

eb9c57aa92133fddb10ef5abb35ca402513c2a7a.translatedText: Maricopa County searches for illegal immigrants (Alberta Times) The Maricopa County Sheriff's Office said it arrested 10 illegal immigrants after raiding a printing plant south of Phoenix. The Sheriff's Supervisory Employer/Illegal Immigration Unit said some employees of PRISMA Imaging used fake IDs for employment. Investigation revealed that the Social Security number presented by an employee actually belonged to a 14-year-old girl. The employees were also found to have misappropriated credit card information and government health benefits. The printing company argued that it had used E-Verify for background checks when recruiting workers and found no suspicious identity of the arrested person.

1623e12f989cbd8c645d3ce92c68fc155895677d.translatedText: Half of Americans receive government benefits in record numbers Bloomberg News reported that Congress’s inability to curb the U.S. budget deficit is often blamed on political dysfunction, but more...

0d4645edbc9dc21d00163879ac8123dac2a19323.sourceText: 彭博新闻社报导说，国会无力遏制美国的预算赤字，经常被怪罪于政治机能失常，不过更大的障碍可能来自美国民众。 人口普查局指出，现在有创纪录的49%美国人(总数大约1亿4700万人)，家裡有人领取至少一种政府福利。 白宫预算局估计，今年所有联邦开支，有63%是用于付钱给目前未向政府提供任何服务的人。1940年这种比率只有18%，1975年为46%。 未来几年这些数字还会继续提高。总数高达7500万人的婴儿潮世代，现在才开始陆续退休，而欧巴马总统的健保改革，还要向超过3000万人提供健康保险福利。 仰赖联邦安全网的民众急遽增加，国会超级委员会却必须在感恩节之前，提出把联邦预算削减1兆5000亿元的计画，否则内政和国防开支将自动全面削减1兆2000亿元。 超级委员会12名成员中的参议员凯尔(Jon Kyl)说，接受福利的人激增非常麻烦，因为这表示有很多人「赖定了政府」(hooked on government)，反对任何削减。 福利人口增加是各种因素共同造成的，而最重要的就是经济。失业率已连续30个月维持9%左右，使得失业福利、粮食券和医疗补助需求大增。 光是领粮食券的人过去五年就增加了72%，达到创纪录的4530万人，今年这种花费预计将达到800亿元，比大多数联邦部会的预算还多。 伊拉克和阿富汗战争的开支也很惊人，而且超过200万名曾参战的军人已开始使用政府保证的医疗和教育福利。 此外，第一批婴儿潮世代三年前就可以开始领取社会安全金，今年可以开始参加联邦医疗保险。再加上政府近年来一再扩大各种福利，使得「赖定政府」的人愈来愈多，福利水闸一开却很难关上。 民众不肯牺牲福利，又不同意加税，政治人物为了讨好选民也不敢造次，甚至继续慷公家之慨大作人情，使政府难为无米之炊。
0d4645edbc9dc21d00163879ac8123dac2a19323.translatedText: Bloomberg News reported that Congress’s inability to curb the U.S. budget deficit is often blamed on political dysfunction, but the bigger obstacle may come from the American people. The Census Bureau noted that a record 49% of Americans (a total of approximately 147 million people) now have someone in their household receiving at least one government benefit. The White House Budget Office estimates that 63% of all federal spending this year will be used to pay people who currently do not provide any services to the government. In 1940 this ratio was only 18% and in 1975 it was 46%. These numbers will continue to increase in the coming years. The baby boomers, a total of 75 million people, are just now beginning to retire, and President Obama's health insurance reform will provide health insurance benefits to more than 30 million people. The number of people relying on the federal safety net has increased rapidly, but the congressional super committee must propose a plan to reduce the federal budget by 1.5 trillion yuan before Thanksgiving. Otherwise, interior and defense spending will automatically be cut across the board by 1.2 trillion yuan. Sen. Jon Kyl, a member of the 12-member super committee, said the surge in welfare recipients was troubling because it meant many people were "hooked on the government" and opposed any cuts. The increase in the welfare population is caused by a combination of factors, the most important of which is the economy. The unemployment rate has remained around 9% for 30 consecutive months, which has greatly increased the demand for unemployment benefits, food stamps and Medicaid. The number of people receiving food stamps alone has increased by 72% in the past five years, reaching a record 45.3 million people. This year, the cost of food stamps is expected to reach 80 billion yuan, which is more than the budget of most federal departments. The costs of the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan are also staggering, and more than 2 million former service members have begun using government-guaranteed health and education benefits. In addition, the first baby boomers began collecting Social Security benefits three years ago and can begin enrolling in Medicare this year. In addition, the government has repeatedly expanded various welfare benefits in recent years, causing more and more people to "depend on the government". Once the welfare gate is opened, it is difficult to close it. The people are unwilling to sacrifice welfare and do not agree to raise taxes. Politicians do not dare to make mistakes in order to please voters, and even continue to use public generosity to do favors, making it difficult for the government to make a living without rice.

0580bd22aa8672967653aabbddc74b0f2945cf0e.translatedText: The United States is no longer the world's most powerful country. The only report compiled by a reporter from Wanwei Reader Network: A column published by Reuters said, "The United States...

c9436af30de7001580f53cb5f85840b6a58e4a66.sourceText: 从这两份报告来看，美国人心目中的”美国第一”概念是名不副实的。 今年四月Fox News的 民意调查显示，有84%的美国人认为美国是世界上最伟大的国家。70%的人说他们永远都不会离开美国去别的地方生活，只有19%的人愿意为了更好的赚钱机会和安全性而离开美国。虽然有2/3的人认为美国比五年前要弱，但仍然是世界上最好的国家。 也许美国人认为美国最伟大是因为美国的军事力量。诚然，美国在军事上面的花费巨大，比世界其它国家加在一起都多。即使军费减半，也比现在公布出来的数字高。目前美国的保卫本土的军费是自二战以来最高。
c9436af30de7001580f53cb5f85840b6a58e4a66.translatedText: Judging from these two reports, the concept of "America First" in the minds of Americans is not worthy of the name. Fox News in April this year Polls show that 84% of Americans think the United States is the greatest country in the world. 70% say they would never leave the United States to live elsewhere, and only 19% are willing to leave the United States for better earning opportunities and security. Although 2/3 think the United States is weaker than it was five years ago, it is still the best country in the world. Perhaps Americans think that the United States is the greatest because of its military power. It is true that the United States spends more on military than all other countries in the world combined. Even if the military expenditure is reduced by half, it is still higher than the current figures.

43a55cd4b124d53610db80712581a46d2c9c3e58.sourceText: 那么，美国的高昂军事消费与美国社会的不公正程度是否有一定的联系呢？这是值争论的问题。
43a55cd4b124d53610db80712581a46d2c9c3e58.translatedText: So, is there a certain connection between the high military consumption of the United States and the degree of injustice in American society? This is a question worthy of debate.

a0f1c8e93391704d32b6e6b81bd935880d724a41.sourceText: 州长任命儿童安全专责小组 （亚省时报） 周二（１１月１日），亚利桑那州儿童安全专责小组正式成立，布鲁尔州长任命小组成员。 小组的职责是检讨儿童安全政策，监督本州儿童健康成长，调查受虐待和被忽视的潜在案件。 专责小组成员包括马利科巴郡检察长，州最高法院大法官，马利科巴郡最高法院法官，州经济安全部主任，儿童救助中心总管，ASU社会工作学院教授，州参议员，学生代表，社区领袖，志愿者，父母代表等19人。马利科巴郡检察长蒙哥马利为主席，州经济安全部主任为副主席。 到12月31日前，专责小组将举办至少两次公开听证会，听取儿童保护服务调查和管理，执法调查专家的证词，法院，社会服务，寄养服务，危机庇护所和儿童之家，儿童福利宣传的行政办公室各方面的意见，提供专业报告给州长。
a0f1c8e93391704d32b6e6b81bd935880d724a41.translatedText: The governor appointed a child safety task force (Alberta Times) On Tuesday (November 1), Arizona's child safety task force was formally established, and Governor Brewer appointed members of the team. The panel's responsibilities are to review child safety policies, monitor the healthy development of the state's children, and investigate potential cases of abuse and neglect. Members of the task force include 19 people including the Maricopa County Attorney, the state Supreme Court justice, the Maricopa County Supreme Court judge, the director of the state Department of Economic Security, the director of the Children's Aid Center, a professor at the ASU School of Social Work, a state senator, student representatives, community leaders, volunteers, and parent representatives. Maricopa County Attorney General Montgomery is the chairman, and the director of the state Department of Economic Security is the vice chairman. The task force will hold at least two public hearings through Dec. 31 to hear testimony from experts on child protective services investigations and management, law enforcement investigations, the courts, social services, foster care services, crisis shelters and children's homes, and the Executive Office of Child Welfare Advocacy, and provide a professional report to the governor.

665c1fe53492e3e81b8a7d1965c608a3f33c8c2f.sourceText: 亚省现代中文学校Kiwanis 2011秋季活动纪实（图） 校报及学生会记者鲁灼华报道 摄影：林苏 2011年十月二十九日下午一点半到五点半，现代中文学校像往年一样在KIWANIS 公园的波浪池举行秋季活动。 今年我们学生会已经很有经验了，熊炜，安琪，凯林，朱丽和我先帮着收票，给小朋友和大人的手腕上戴入场带。为安全起见，七岁以下的小朋友戴黄色的，七岁以上的带绿色的，以便于工作人员分辨。有时我们不太确定小朋友的年龄，就笑眯眯地问小朋友几岁了，有的小朋友一脸茫然，歪着头想半天才嗲声嗲气地说出来，特别可爱。 现代中文学校秋季水上运动 忙完进门的事之后，学生会就帮着发学校为大家准备好的瓶水，土豆片，水果卷之类的小吃。 发了一阵，善解人意的叔叔阿姨们就把这活儿接过来，让我们解放了。 最热闹的地方当然是波浪池。浅水区有许多小朋友由爸爸妈妈带着玩。深水区是高年级的学生。他们成群结伴，在水里嬉笑打闹。每次起波浪时，池子里是一片叫喊声。岸上的家长们帮着看东西，一边愉快地聊天。时间过得很快，转眼就快到闭馆时间了。有些小朋友仍然不愿离去，坚决等最后一次波浪到来后才肯罢休。 篮球场上的两个场地都有紧张激烈的比赛同时进行。一场是杨洁阿姨带着我们几个小朋友比赛。我们的年龄身高相差甚远，因为还不时地有人加入或退出，所以队员不断调整。不过每个人都很努力，抢球投篮绝不含糊。有的没什么经验的小孩儿加入了比赛以后，也非常投入地猛给自己的团队抢球。另一场是几位叔叔和几个高年级学生进行的比赛，他们就正规多了。比赛也更加激烈。几位叔叔身手矫健，远看分不出哪个是大人哪个是小孩。不过一走近观察，那大汗淋漓，气喘吁吁者，某同学之爹也。 现代中文学校秋季篮球赛 我第一次来此是十年前，那时上二年级。当时和小朋友戏水的情景还历历在目。如今好些我熟悉的大哥哥大姐姐都毕业离开，有些同伴也搬到了别的城市。不过不断地有新朋友进来。现代中文学校一年一度的KIWANIS秋季活动已成为经典，每次活动都凝聚着许多叔叔阿姨的辛勤劳动。虽然物是人非，依旧的涛声年年给我们带来很多快乐。 （来自亚省时报）
665c1fe53492e3e81b8a7d1965c608a3f33c8c2f.translatedText: Documentary of the 2011 Autumn Activities of Kiwanis, a modern Chinese school in Alberta (pictures) Reported by school newspaper and student union reporter Lu Zhuohua Photography: Lin Su From 1:30 to 5:30 pm on October 29, 2011, Modern Chinese School held autumn activities in the wave pool of Kiwanis Park as in previous years. Our student union is very experienced this year. Xiong Wei, An Qi, Kailin, Zhu Li and I first helped collect tickets and put admission bands on the wrists of children and adults. For safety reasons, children under seven years old wear yellow ones, and those over seven years old wear green ones to make it easier for staff to distinguish. Sometimes we are not sure about the age of the children, so we ask them with a smile how old they are. Some children have a blank look on their faces and tilt their heads to think for a long time before they say it out loud, which is very cute. Modern Chinese School Autumn Water Sports After finishing the work of getting in, the student union helped distribute bottles of water, potato chips, fruit roll-ups and other snacks prepared by the school. After a while, the considerate uncles and aunts took over the work and freed us. The most popular place is of course the wave pool. There are many children playing in the shallow water area with their parents. Deepwater is the senior class. They were in groups, laughing and playing in the water. Every time there was a wave, the pool was filled with shouts. The parents on the shore helped to see things and chatted happily. Time passed quickly, and it was almost closing time in a blink of an eye. Some children are still unwilling to leave and are determined to wait until the last wave arrives before giving up. There are intense games going on at the same time on both sides of the basketball court. In one game, Aunt Yang Jie took a few of us children to compete. We are very different in age and height, and the team members are constantly being adjusted because people join or drop out from time to time. But everyone worked hard, and there was no ambiguity in grabbing the ball and shooting. Some children with little experience joined the game and became very involved in grabbing the ball for their team. The other game was between a few uncles and a few senior students, and they were much more formal. The competition is also more intense. The uncles were so skilled that from a distance it was impossible to tell who was an adult and who was a child. However, upon closer inspection, the man sweating profusely and panting was the father of a certain classmate. Modern Chinese School Autumn Basketball Game The first time I came here was ten years ago, when I was in second grade. The scene of playing in the water with the children at that time is still vivid in my mind. Nowadays, many of the big brothers and sisters I know well have graduated and left, and some of my friends have also moved to other cities. But new friends keep coming in. The annual KIWANIS autumn event of Modern Chinese School has become a classic, and each event embodies the hard work of many uncles and aunts. Although things and people have changed, the sound of the waves still brings us a lot of happiness every year. (via The Alberta Times)

c1f2b3042320f071b49b90f662757cf4550ff8ee.sourceText: 羊城晚报讯 关于央企高管的薪酬，一直是外界关注的热点。今年3月，武钢集团总经理邓崎琳在参加网络访谈时层表示，认为中国央企高管的工资薪酬水平和同类岗位相比低得多。实际情况是怎样的？从上市央企高管的薪酬水平或可见一斑。
c1f2b3042320f071b49b90f662757cf4550ff8ee.translatedText: Yangcheng Evening News Regarding the remuneration of state-owned enterprise executives, it has always been a hot topic of attention from the outside world. In March this year, Deng Qilin, general manager of Wuhan Iron and Steel Group, said in an online interview that she believed the salary level of executives of China's central enterprises was much lower than similar positions. What is the actual situation? This may be evident from the salary levels of executives of listed central enterprises.

85743ef505931ef048727c5171322cfce764f160.sourceText: 由于半年报和三季报并不涉及高管薪酬数据，根据2010年的年报显示，在纳入巨灵数据统计44家国资委所属央企中，国资央企高管平均薪酬为32.78万元，在所有五大企业属性分类中列第二，其中最高的飞亚达平均薪酬达139万元，保利地产也达130万元。另外，有27家国资央企高管在企业中持股，占比61%，持股平均市值中位数在25万元左右。
85743ef505931ef048727c5171322cfce764f160.translatedText: Since the semi-annual report and the third quarterly report do not involve executive salary data, according to the 2010 annual report, among the 44 central enterprises affiliated to the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission included in the Juling data statistics, the average salary of state-owned central enterprise executives was 327,800 yuan, ranking second among all five major enterprise attribute categories. Among them, Fiyta, the highest, had an average salary of 1.39 million yuan, and Poly Real Estate also had an average salary of 1.3 million yuan. In addition, there are 27 state-owned central enterprise executives holding shares in the company, accounting for 61%, and the average market value of the shares held is about 250,000 yuan.

1a7813d3b0102193509da83a7dcbb01071f5ebc9.sourceText: 至于央企高管个人薪酬排行方面，去年中国银行的詹伟坚以1101万的年薪夺得冠军，中国平安的张子鑫以1067万紧随其后，排名第十的建设银行投资理财总监毛裕民收入也有476万。
1a7813d3b0102193509da83a7dcbb01071f5ebc9.translatedText: As for the personal salary ranking of central enterprise executives, Zhan Weijian of Bank of China won the championship last year with an annual salary of 11.01 million, followed by Zhang Zixin of Ping An of China with 10.67 million, and Mao Yumin, investment and financial director of China Construction Bank, who ranked tenth, also earned 4.76 million.

77ae16a5b36e81bb72b19f389721d048ccfb93b4.sourceText: 央企一把手薪酬多不公开
77ae16a5b36e81bb72b19f389721d048ccfb93b4.translatedText: The salaries of the top leaders of central enterprises are not disclosed

bf326e119cd706ed7fb200f418993b5eb0822900.sourceText: 据《京华时报》报道，央企年报中最令人遗憾的缺失莫过于多数央企”一把手”的薪酬未予披露。
bf326e119cd706ed7fb200f418993b5eb0822900.translatedText: According to the Beijing Times, the most regrettable omission in the annual reports of central enterprises is that the salaries of the “top leaders” of most central enterprises are not disclosed.

0a9dd470e911364d7b8234af00b0a4ca4340cea3.sourceText: 按上市公司信息披露相关规定，在上市公司领薪的高管薪酬必须明示。但一些央企何以未披露董事长的薪酬呢？主要原因在于这些央企的”一把手”董事长不在上市公司领取薪酬，而在关联公司领薪。
0a9dd470e911364d7b8234af00b0a4ca4340cea3.translatedText: According to the relevant regulations on information disclosure of listed companies, the remuneration of senior executives who are paid in listed companies must be clearly stated. But why do some central enterprises fail to disclose the remuneration of their chairman? The main reason is that the "top leaders" chairman of these central enterprises do not receive salary from listed companies, but from affiliated companies.

0ecef5c3c218634901e904d3aa74367b0dc37e0d.sourceText: 对于”为何有的老总从上市公司领薪、薪酬公开，有的却从关联公司领取”的疑问，国航某高管给媒体的解释是，”从国航来看，孔栋虽为国航股份董事长，但并不是执行董事，因此不从上市公司领薪”。事实上，除了董事长薪酬信息不透明之外，年报中未披露薪酬的高管也大有人在。仅以央企中的三大航为例，88名高管中有30人未披露薪酬，占比高达34.1%。
0ecef5c3c218634901e904d3aa74367b0dc37e0d.translatedText: Regarding the question of "why some CEOs receive their salaries from listed companies and their salaries are disclosed, while others receive their salaries from affiliated companies," an Air China executive explained to the media that "from Air China's perspective, although Kong Dong is the chairman of Air China, he is not an executive director, so he does not receive his salary from a listed company." In fact, in addition to the opacity of information on the chairman's remuneration, there are also many executives whose remuneration is not disclosed in the annual report. Taking the three major airlines among state-owned enterprises as an example, 30 of the 88 senior executives have not disclosed their salaries, accounting for 34.1%.

f09407a6a3a1cf64356362d2e193d8f6a7026fa8.sourceText: 国资委相关人士向记者表示，央企上市公司年报是否披露高管薪酬、披露到什么程度，国资委方面没有要求，由各央企根据上市公司信息披露的相关法规执行。
f09407a6a3a1cf64356362d2e193d8f6a7026fa8.translatedText: Relevant sources from the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission told reporters that there is no requirement from the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission whether or to what extent executive compensation should be disclosed in the annual reports of listed companies under the central government, and it is up to the state-owned enterprises to implement it in accordance with relevant laws and regulations on information disclosure by listed companies.

ea26fe1bb05960fc2090282a64ce0e2590ccda73.sourceText: 东航董事长刘绍勇今年两会期间参加一场国企主题的在线访谈时曾被问及薪酬，他的答复是”可不可以不回答，这个问题太敏感”。
ea26fe1bb05960fc2090282a64ce0e2590ccda73.translatedText: China Eastern Airlines Chairman Liu Shaoyong was asked about salary when he participated in an online interview on the theme of state-owned enterprises during the two sessions this year. His reply was "Can I not answer this question? This question is too sensitive."

3e94d9cb05714ea636440a2ae243e8ce1593727d.sourceText: 美国银行（Bank of America）上周二表示，将取消九月份宣布，自明年初开始向用借记卡（debit card）购物的用户收取5美元月费的计划。 美银营运长达内尔表示，在听取客户反馈后，银行决定取消原先的决定。在这之前，美银曾一度试图通过为用户提供一些可以避免该项收费的途径，包括直接存款或 维持最低余额等。但是在几个主要竞争对手先后宣布不会征收类似的费用后，最终被迫取消这项收费。 上周，大通（Chase）和富国银行 （Wells Fargo）各自宣布取消在某些州向借记卡用户收取月费的所谓试点方案。本周一，总部设在亚特兰大的大型区域性银行太阳信托银行（SunTrust）宣 布，自周三起不再收取借记卡月费。随后总部设在阿拉巴马州的?#22320;区银行?#65288;Regions Bank）也做出取消收取4美元月费的决定。
3e94d9cb05714ea636440a2ae243e8ce1593727d.translatedText: Bank of America said on Tuesday it would cancel a plan announced in September to charge a $5 monthly fee for debit card purchases starting early next year. Bank of America operating officer Darnell said that after listening to customer feedback, the bank decided to cancel the original decision. Prior to this, Bank of America had tried to provide users with some ways to avoid the fee, including direct deposit or maintaining a minimum balance. However, after several major competitors announced that they would not levy similar fees, they were eventually forced to cancel the fee. Last week, Chase and Wells Fargo each announced they were canceling so-called pilot programs in some states that had charged debit card users monthly fees. On Monday, SunTrust, a large regional bank headquartered in Atlanta, announced that it would no longer charge monthly debit card fees starting Wednesday. Subsequently, Regions Bank, headquartered in Alabama, also made the decision to cancel the $4 monthly fee.

045ccc3774df8286beec67b9d9213d3cd2842b6d.sourceText: 一个名为”野生地球守护者”环保组织向联邦政府请求，减少西部8州的空气污染。 该组织在请愿书中呼吁亚利桑那、科罗拉多、蒙大拿、内华达、新墨西哥、俄克荷马、犹他和怀俄明等州的环保局应遵守”清洁空气法案”。 请愿书将本州的图森和其他州14个城市列为不达标地区，诺加拉斯、保罗斯堡/道格拉斯和尤马，与新墨西哥州的安东尼，犹他州盐湖城等为中度至严重不达标地区。
045ccc3774df8286beec67b9d9213d3cd2842b6d.translatedText: An environmental group called Wild Earth Guardians is petitioning the federal government to reduce air pollution in eight western states. The group's petition calls on EPAs in Arizona, Colorado, Montana, Nevada, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Utah and Wyoming to comply with the Clean Air Act. The petition lists Tucson in the state and 14 cities in other states as non-attainment areas. Nogalas, Paulsburg/Douglas and Yuma, Anthony, New Mexico, Salt Lake City, Utah, etc. are classified as moderately to severely non-attainment areas.

7c8f0b6a5b0a4c05a03f6cd701b9dee5b3006212.sourceText: US Airways增加本地工作机会 （亚省时报） 总部设在坦佩的美国航空公司周三宣布为凤凰城的预订中心带来150个工作岗位。 该工作原本外包给一个海外呼叫中心，根据合约，11月1日起航空公司将预订中心搬回美国。此举为北卡州带来200个职位，50个在内华达的里诺。 美国航空公司在英国的利物浦还有一个国际预订中心。这家公司每年处理的电话超过1800万个。
7c8f0b6a5b0a4c05a03f6cd701b9dee5b3006212.translatedText: US Airways adds local jobs (Alberta Times) Tempe-based American Airlines announced Wednesday it is bringing 150 jobs to its reservations center in Phoenix. The work was originally outsourced to an overseas call center. According to the contract, the airline will move the reservation center back to the United States starting on November 1. The move brings 200 jobs to North Carolina and 50 in Reno, Nevada. American Airlines also has an international reservations center in Liverpool, England. The company handles more than 18 million calls annually.

2071f41e1ce35e9c907c039a725ed7b39ce7e7e7.sourceText: 据美联社报道，全国目前已经有259人登记参加2012年美国总统竞选。除了奥巴马和罗穆尼等”大腕”之外，更多的则是一些”无名小卒”。 若是想参加总统竞选，您只需填写一份联邦选举委员会2号表(FEC Form 2)，即《候选声明书》(Statement of Candicacy)，向FEC登记。 有趣的是，这张表格上问的问题比麦当劳工作申请表上的问题还少。但单单这份FEC 2号表并不能把登记者的名字印上选票，登记者还需向各州提出更多文件。 在2008年大选期间，就有365人向FEC登记，但是在新罕布夏州的初选中，只有42个名字。而在普选中，24个名字出现在至少一个州中。 今年的登记者包括许多不满政府和美国两党政治体制的人，还有不少”怪人”。 宾州绿党的巴兰泰恩(Mike Ballantine)在自我放逐越南多年后，因为不满美国政府，特别是美国攻击利比亚，决定回国参选. 还有弗吉尼亚的独立派人士格瑞莫(Ken Grammer)因不满华府的政治僵局，和百万富翁职业政客对中低收入者的忧虑漠不关心而参选。不过因面对许多困难，他已在9月停止竞选活动。 登记参选者需向FEC申报他们是否已为竞选募款，或花费了5000元，大多数人都离此标准很远。 例如纽约州Poughkeepsie的独立候选人巴内特(Andre Barnett)今年5月起宣布参选，但到这个月为止才募集到20美元。
2071f41e1ce35e9c907c039a725ed7b39ce7e7e7.translatedText: According to the Associated Press, 259 people across the country have registered to run for the 2012 US presidential election. In addition to "big names" such as Obama and Romney, there are more "nobodies". If you want to run for president, you only need to fill out an FEC Form 2 (Statement of Candicacy) and register with the FEC. Interestingly, this form asks fewer questions than the McDonald's job application form. However, this FEC Form 2 alone cannot put the registrant's name on the ballot, and the registrant needs to submit more documents to the states. During the 2008 election, 365 people registered with the FEC, but in New Hampshire's primary, there were only 42 names. In the general election, 24 names appeared in at least one state. This year's registrants include many people who are dissatisfied with the government and the two-party political system in the United States, as well as many "weirdos." Mike Ballantine of the Pennsylvania Green Party decided to return to his country to run after years of self-imposed exile in Vietnam because he was dissatisfied with the U.S. government, especially the U.S. attack on Libya. Ken Grammer, an independent from Virginia, ran because he was dissatisfied with the political deadlock in Washington and the indifference of millionaire career politicians to the concerns of low- and middle-income people. However, he stopped campaigning in September due to many difficulties. Registered candidates are required to declare to the FEC whether they have raised money for the campaign or spent $5,000, and most people are far from this standard. For example, independent candidate Andre Barnett of Poughkeepsie, New York, announced his candidacy in May this year, but has only raised $20 as of this month.

0b849b8df36c34d6d52612f747d9dcfa802bbd34.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学“省亲”游行成功举办 （太阳鸟特约记者王帅） 11月27日上午，作为持续一周的亚州州立大学 Homecoming week(11月21日-11月29日)的重头戏，也是最高潮部分-2011 Homecoming 游行在University Drive Tempe校区完美举办。而这一活动也预示着一年一度传统项目-Homecoming接近尾声。 Homecoming是美国大学特有的一项传统活动，主要目的是欢迎各届校友返校。在华人文化圈，”省亲” 一词的意思与其较为对应。由于美国人对于High school 和college level的生活经历极为看重和珍惜，所以Homecoming week往往也是学校每年最大最隆重的活动。其一般包括了各种文化，体育活动以及老校友拜访老师教授等等。 今天的parade也是一如既往地热闹。尽管游行11：30才开始举行，但是有许多院系及社会团体早早来到University Drive两旁的草坪上，搭起凉棚，摆上桌子。热情的志愿者接待各届老校友，有的摊位还提供小游戏之类的丰富多彩的活动，宛如一个大嘉年华一样。有几个院系的活动颇具特色。比如在school of international studies的摊位上，志愿者准备了许多写有各国语言的板子，然后邀请来自世界不同国家和地区的校友和游客用他们的语言说出板子上的内容，集合在一起作为一个小的献礼给母校。 记者遇到了带着中文帽子的大叔，他热情地用流利的中文像我们问好，当我们问他是否知道帽子上的”拆”的意思，他笑着说他可是知道关于中国的好多知识，这个不在话下。在英语系的摊位上，则是举办了填词小竞赛，只要猜出一个，就可以得到一份精美的小礼品。 Parade在11：30时候准时开始。学校和Tempe市政府早早将University Drive封闭起来，所以说平时十分忙碌的街道难得可以一眼望到远方。热情的拉拉队员与军乐队引导着游行前进。由于欢迎老校友是Homecoming的主题，所以一开始行进的几个队伍都是过去著名校友，以及著名的Football成员。接下来则是获得各项荣誉的教授，校友的队伍。学生和社会团体也可以报名参加游行，所以可以逐渐看到丰富多彩的内容。比如对于希腊神话场景的再现，或者是老爷车的队伍，或者就根本没有特定的主题，上去参与这个类似大party的一样的活动。 今日天公也十分作美，和煦阳光伴着徐徐微风。所以许多人也是带着一家老小，顺便享受野餐时光。在游行结束后，体育方面也有场重头戏：Homecoming match。许多人在参加完游行之后就向主体育场方向行进。由于下周一是美国另外一个重要的节日-万圣节，所以说本周末Tempe市的活动真是异彩纷呈,也欢迎读者查阅我们的信息发布页面获取更多信息 http://www.sunbirdarizona.com/News-Detail.asp?keyno=1547 。 游行即将开始 游行队伍 游行花车 会讲中文的大叔 来自某院系热情的志愿者
0b849b8df36c34d6d52612f747d9dcfa802bbd34.translatedText: Arizona State University's "promote relatives" parade was successfully held (Sunbird special reporter Wang Shuai) On the morning of November 27, as a week-long Asian State University Homecoming The highlight and climax of the week (November 21st - November 29th) - the 2011 Homecoming parade was perfectly held at the University Drive Tempe campus. This event also heralds the end of the annual traditional project - Homecoming. Homecoming is a traditional event unique to American universities. Its main purpose is to welcome alumni from all walks of life back to school. In the Chinese cultural circle, the meaning of the word "province relatives" is relatively corresponding to this. Because Americans attach great importance to and cherish the life experience of high school and college level, Homecoming week is often the largest and most solemn event of the school every year. It generally includes various cultural and sports activities, as well as old alumni visiting teachers and professors, etc. Today's parade is as lively as ever. Although the parade only started at 11:30, many departments and social groups came to the lawns on both sides of University Drive early to set up arbors and set up tables. Enthusiastic volunteers welcomed old alumni, and some booths also provided colorful activities such as games, just like a big carnival. The activities of several departments are quite distinctive. For example, at the school of international studies booth, volunteers prepared many boards with writing in various languages, and then invited alumni and tourists from different countries and regions around the world to speak out the contents on the boards in their languages, and gathered them together as a small gift to their alma mater. The reporter met an uncle wearing a Chinese hat. He greeted us enthusiastically and in fluent Chinese. When we asked him if he knew the meaning of "dismantle" on the hat, he smiled and said that he knew a lot about China, and this was not a problem. At the booth of the English Department, a word-writing competition was held. Anyone who guessed one word could get a small exquisite gift. The Parade starts on time at 11:30. The school and the Tempe city government closed University Drive early, so it was rare to see the distance from the normally busy street. Enthusiastic cheerleaders and marching bands led the parade. Since welcoming old alumni is the theme of Homecoming, the first few teams marching were famous alumni and famous Football members. Next is the team of professors and alumni who have won various honors. Students and social groups can also sign up to participate in the parade, so you can gradually see colorful content. For example, there is a re-enactment of scenes from Greek mythology, or a procession of classic cars, or there is no specific theme at all. Go up and participate in this activity that is similar to a big party. The weather is also very beautiful today, with warm sunshine and gentle breeze. Therefore, many people also bring their families and enjoy the picnic time. After the parade, there is also a highlight in sports: the Homecoming match. Many people marched towards the main stadium after participating in the parade. Since next Monday is another important holiday in the United States - Halloween, the activities in Tempe City this weekend are really colorful. Readers are also welcome to check our information release page for more information http://www.sunbirdarizona.com/News-Detail.asp?keyno=1547. The parade is about to start. Parade team. Parade floats. Uncles who can speak Chinese. Enthusiastic volunteers from a certain department.
