90e4b5f2705ae09472ea4797c3e80766b94f58d2.sourceText: 一年一度的好莱坞中美电影节在中国广电总局电影局、中国驻洛杉矶总领馆和美国电影协会的大力支持下，已经成为中美电影业界交流的年度盛会。日前，主办单位美国鹰龙传媒在美国亚太博物馆召开第七届中美电影节的首次新闻发布会，中美电影节主席、美国鹰龙传媒总裁苏彦韬、电影节共同主席、制作奥斯卡电影《教父》和《百万宝贝》的美国鲁迪摩根电影集团总裁安德鲁摩根、电影节共同主席、洛杉矶郡长夫人胡惠玲、中国驻洛杉矶总领馆文化参赞车兆和、文化领事李冰、美国亚太博物馆馆长查理梅森、中美电影节荣誉赞助商华美银行资深副总裁王国兰、大会指定航空公司中国国际航空洛杉矶副总经理杨睿，以及多位电影节组委会成员和多部参展影片的剧组代表出席并在活动上致词。 中美电影节主席苏彦韬表示，本届电影节荣幸地邀请到了中国国家电影局童刚局长率领的中国电影代表团亲临现场。本届电影节在展映影片和参加的中国电影公司方面也创下了历届之最，目前已经参加的包括：中国电影集团、中国电影合作制片公司、华夏电影集团、天津北方电影集团、珠江电影集团、中国新闻电影集团、华谊兄弟电影集团、保利博纳电影集团、上海美术电影制片厂、云南电影集团、北方联合影视集团、DMG电影公司、阳光传媒集团、IDG集团等十多家电影公司，以及中国电影家协会和澳门电影协会等都将参加本届的中美电影节。除了中国电影公司，美国电影协会、福克斯、迪斯尼、索尼、梦工厂等好莱坞各大电影集团，以及众多独立制片公司也都热情地参与了本届的中美电影节。本届电影节组委会主席团除了美国电影市场协会主席、奥斯卡影片《英国病人》制片人麦克莱恩、美国凤凰电影总裁、奥斯卡影片《黑天鹅》、《与狼共舞》、《洛基》等的制片人麦克德奥伊等好莱坞重量级人士担任外，今届电影节还邀请了美国奥斯卡前主席、前环球电影董事长席格格纳斯加入了主席团的阵容中。 新闻发布会上，中美电影节组委会公布了首批的电影，许多在北美首映和过去一年来在中美电影市场创下佳绩和口碑的优秀影片将联袂与美国的观众见面。其中包括了：《大武生》、《英雄喋血》、《大太阳》、《雪花秘扇》、《秋之白华》、《钢的琴》、《夏日乐悠悠》、《我的野蛮女友2》、 《非诚勿扰2》、《爱出色》、《十月围城》、《兔侠传奇》、《奥戈》、《还有一星期》、《飞天》、《将爱情进行到底》、《狄仁杰之通天帝国》、《跟踪孔令学》、《守护童年》、《西藏往事》、《碧罗雪山》、《犹太女孩在上海》、《桃姐》、《郭明义》、《永生羊》、《守望天山》 、《我的少女时代》、《雷神索尔》(Thor)、《X战警前传：第一课》(X-Man: First Class)、《伴娘》(Bridesmaids)、《危情时速》(Unstoppable )等近百部优秀中美电影将在本届中美电影的展映期间绚丽亮相！ 当天参加新闻发布会的中美电影节委员会成员还包括：奥斯卡得主、制作《拆弹部队》、《蜘蛛侠》、《2012》等大片的音效大师保罗、发行《超人》的电影发行公司总裁欧玛卡斯玛切、为《功夫熊猫》等多部好莱坞大片演奏二胡的华裔音乐家韩华奇、艾美奖得主迪诺赫门、好莱坞知名华裔影星张宇基、《融入美利坚》等电影的华裔导演蓝伯儒、主演《唐人街》的华裔电影演员和制作人胡雪莲、美国多媒体集团总裁谢麦克、哥伦比亚好莱坞电影学院前校长罗兴华、洛杉矶学院教授廖茂俊等。 中美电影节组委会在新闻发布会上公布了首批电影的名单和本届中美电影节的主要活动日程。第七届中美电影节将在十月二十七日至十一月三十日期间在美国好莱坞、洛杉矶、旧金山举办为期一个月十多场各具特色的大型电影专场和研讨活动和二百多场次的影片展映活动。本届电影节的开幕式将在十月二十七日于好莱坞美国导演公会总部隆重举行，二十八日中美电影人交流研讨，二十九日中美电影节时尚之夜，三十日旧金山分会场开幕式，十一月初开始将在好莱坞、洛杉矶和旧金山等地超过二十个场地展映近百部的优秀中美电影。 有兴趣支持2011好莱坞中美电影节和购买电影节套票的朋友欢迎致电1-626-856-3889或者登陆www.cafilmfestival.org 查询详情。
90e4b5f2705ae09472ea4797c3e80766b94f58d2.translatedText: With the strong support of the Film Bureau of the China State Administration of Radio, Film and Television, the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles and the American Film Association, the annual Hollywood Chinese American Film Festival has become an annual event for exchanges between the Chinese and American film industries. A few days ago, the organizer of the American Eagle Dragon Media held the first press conference of the 7th China-American Film Festival at the Asia-Pacific Museum in the United States. Su Yantao, chairman of the China-American Film Festival and president of the American Eagle Dragon Media, Andrew Morgan, co-chairman of the film festival and president of the American Rudy Morgan Film Group, which produced the Oscar-winning films "The Godfather" and "Million Dollar Baby," co-chairman of the film festival and wife of the Los Angeles County Sheriff, Hu Hui Ling, Cultural Counselor of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles Che Zhaohe, Cultural Consul Li Bing, Charlie Mason, Director of the Asia Pacific Museum of the United States, Wang Guolan, Senior Vice President of East West Bank, the honorary sponsor of the Chinese American Film Festival, Yang Rui, Deputy General Manager of Air China Los Angeles, the designated airline of the conference, as well as many members of the film festival organizing committee and crew representatives of many participating films attended and delivered speeches at the event. Su Yantao, chairman of the China-American Film Festival, said that this year's film festival is honored to invite a Chinese film delegation led by Director Tong Gang of the National Film Administration of China to the scene. This film festival has also set a record in terms of films screened and Chinese film companies participating. Currently participating include: China Film Group, China Film Co-Production Company, Huaxia Film Group, Tianjin Northern Film Group, Pearl River Film Group, China News Film Group, Huayi Brothers Film Group, Poly Bona Film Group, Shanghai Fine Arts Film Studio, Yunnan Film Group, Northern United Film and Television Group, DMG Film Company, Sunshine Media Group, IDG Group and more than ten film companies, as well as the China Film Association and the Macau Film Association will participate in this China-US Film Festival. In addition to Chinese film companies, the American Film Institute, Fox, Disney, Sony, DreamWorks and other major Hollywood film groups, as well as many independent production companies, also enthusiastically participated in this China-US Film Festival. In addition to Hollywood heavyweights such as MacLean, chairman of the American Film Market Association and producer of the Oscar-winning film "The English Patient," and Mike Deoy, the president of Phoenix Films and producer of Oscar-winning films such as "Black Swan," "Dances with Wolves," and "Rocky," the bureau of the organizing committee of this year's film festival also invites the former chairman of the Oscars in the United States and former chairman of Universal Pictures to join the bureau. At the press conference, the China-US Film Festival Organizing Committee announced the first batch of films. Many excellent films that premiered in North America and have achieved great success and reputation in the Chinese and American film markets over the past year will join hands with American audiences. These include: "Da Wu Sheng", "Hero's Blood", "Big Sun", "Snowflake Secret Fan", "White Flowers of Autumn", "Gang Piano", "Summer Fun", "My Sassy Girl 2", "If You Are the One 2", "Love is Excellent", "October Siege", "Legend of the Rabbit Man", "Ogo", "One Week More", "Flying", "Love to the End", "Detective Dee: The Empire of Heaven", "Following Kong Lingxue", "Guarding Childhood", "Once Upon a Time in Tibet", "Bi Luo Snow Mountain", "Jewish Girl in Shanghai", "Sister Tao", "Guo Mingyi", "Eternal Sheep", "Watching the Sky Mountain" , "My Girlhood", "Thor" (Thor), "X-Man: First Class" (X-Man: First Class), "Bridesmaids" (Bridesmaids), "Unstoppable" (Unstoppable) and nearly a hundred outstanding Chinese and American films will make a brilliant appearance during this year's Chinese and American film screenings! Members of the China-US Film Festival committee who attended the press conference that day also included: Paul, the Oscar winner and sound effects master who produced blockbusters such as "The Hurt Locker", "Spider-Man" and "2012"; Omar Kasmacher, the president of the film distribution company that released "Superman"; Han, a Chinese musician who played the erhu for many Hollywood blockbusters such as "Kung Fu Panda" Huaqi, Emmy Award winner Dino Herman, well-known Hollywood Chinese movie star Zhang Yuji, Chinese director Lan Boru of movies such as "Into America", Chinese movie actor and producer Hu Xuelian starring in "Chinatown", American Multimedia Group President Michael Xie, former president of Columbia Hollywood Film School Luo Xinghua, Los Angeles College professor Liao Maojun, etc. The China-American Film Festival Organizing Committee announced the list of the first batch of films and the main event schedule of this year's China-American Film Festival at a press conference. The 7th China-American Film Festival will hold more than ten unique large-scale film special events and seminars and more than 200 film screenings for a month from October 27 to November 30 in Hollywood, Los Angeles, and San Francisco. The opening ceremony of this film festival will be held grandly at the Directors Guild of America headquarters in Hollywood on October 27th. On the 28th, there will be an exchange and discussion between Chinese and American filmmakers. On the 29th, the Chinese American Film Festival Fashion Night will be held. On the 30th, the opening ceremony of the San Francisco branch will be held. Starting from the beginning of November, nearly 100 excellent Chinese and American films will be screened in more than 20 venues in Hollywood, Los Angeles and San Francisco. Friends who are interested in supporting the 2011 Hollywood Chinese American Film Festival and purchasing film festival tickets are welcome to call 1-626-856-3889 or log on to www.cafilmfestival.org for details.

789202438d2862db743eafa18e2e80bd0a7c7e3d.sourceText: 三藩市长候选人辩移民议题：余胤良等支持“庇护无证移民” 【侨报记者三藩市报道】选举日益临近，辩论天天上演。16日，在西裔民众聚集的米慎区举行了一场针对”移民议题”的市长辩论会，候选人纷纷表态支持”庇护无证移民”政策，并抬出自己的移民后代身份来贴近到场民众。 由移民权益团体SFOP主办的候选人辩论会在圣彼得大教堂举行，大批西裔民众到场，艾华乐和阿斯卡伦（Cesar Ascarruna）利用自己的西语优势，直接用西语辩答，另外一些候选人则都强调自己的移民后裔背景。 三岁随家人移民来美的余胤良说，自己了解移民打拼的艰辛，一个城市的执政者要保障执法团队不会做出让家庭骨肉分离的事情，不会给扫荡移民官员丝毫协助来追捕移民家庭与子女。作为第二代移民，邱信福表示要让民众信任司法部门，庇护城市政策就是为此实施，而移民工人也是旧金山经济恢复和发展的重要组成部分。 候选人现场还回答了关于”可负担房屋”、”多语种服务”、”家庭回归旧金山”、”为移民社区提供法律援助”等问题。霍尔观点鲜明提出：一要建造半价甚至1/3价格的廉价住房，二是要增加工作机会，让更多人买得起房。邱信福表示自己担任议员前后，都曾协助低收入、耆英和移民社区民众争取可负担房屋，这也是他获得《旧金山纪事报》背书的重要原因。 艾华乐指出，当联邦执法机构压迫移民社区时，我们需要有经验丰富的律师为他们提供帮助。余胤良指出自己在担任议员期间就对一些加深普通民众对移民社区抱有歧见的法案提出过强烈批评。达菲则回忆自己在1996年曾与时任市长布朗为民众争取建造低价房屋，同时关注的还包括”学生住屋”。
789202438d2862db743eafa18e2e80bd0a7c7e3d.translatedText: > San Francisco mayoral candidate debates immigration issues: Yu Yinliang and others support "protecting undocumented immigrants" [Reported by Overseas Chinese News reporter in San Francisco] The election is approaching, and debates are taking place every day. On the 16th, a mayoral debate on "immigration issues" was held in Mission District, where Hispanic people gather. Candidates expressed their support for the policy of "protecting undocumented immigrants" and brought up their identities as descendants of immigrants to get closer to the people present. The candidate debate hosted by the immigrant rights group SFOP was held in St. Peter's Basilica. A large number of Hispanic people attended. Avale and Cesar Ascarruna used their Spanish language advantages to directly defend their answers in Spanish. Some other candidates emphasized their immigrant backgrounds. Yu Yinliang, who immigrated to the United States with his family when he was three years old, said that he understands the hardships of immigrants. A city's rulers must ensure that the law enforcement team will not do anything to separate family members, and will not give any assistance to immigration officials to hunt down immigrant families and children. As a second-generation immigrant, Qiu Xinfu said that the sanctuary city policy is implemented to make people trust the judicial department, and immigrant workers are also an important part of San Francisco's economic recovery and development. The candidates also answered questions on the spot about "affordable housing," "multilingual services," "returning families to San Francisco," and "providing legal aid to immigrant communities." Hall has a clear point of view: first, we must build low-cost housing at half or even one-third the price; second, we must increase job opportunities so that more people can afford housing. Qiu Xinfu said that before and after he became a congressman, he had assisted people in low-income, elderly and immigrant communities to fight for affordable housing. This was also an important reason why he was endorsed by the San Francisco Chronicle. "When federal law enforcement oppresses immigrant communities, we need experienced attorneys to help them," Avale said. Yu Yinliang pointed out that when he was a member of the parliament, he had strongly criticized some bills that deepened ordinary people's prejudice against immigrant communities. Duffy recalled that in 1996, he and then-Mayor Brown fought for the construction of low-cost housing for the people, and also focused on "student housing."

7c3febcda333655407e66db2d16a408237a15e43.sourceText: 周末天 边境运毒忙 14日，诺加拉斯海关与边境保护官员在美墨边境发现隐藏在木炭麻袋内的198捆大麻，重量超过2630磅，价值130万美元。 事件中，逮捕一名56岁的男子，办案人员相信此人将毒品从墨西哥的索诺拉运到诺加拉斯。疑犯已移交美国移民和海关执法部门调查。 15日早上，边境巡逻人员在图森截停一可疑车辆，从中查获1250磅大麻，估值100万美元。同日下午，拘捕一名非法入境者，在其车辆上搜出611磅毒品，价值超30万美元。
7c3febcda333655407e66db2d16a408237a15e43.translatedText: The border is busy with drug transportation on weekends. On the 14th, Nogalas Customs and Border Protection officers discovered 198 bundles of marijuana hidden in charcoal sacks at the U.S.-Mexico border, weighing more than 2,630 pounds and worth $1.3 million. During the incident, a 56-year-old man was arrested, who investigators believe was transporting drugs from Sonora, Mexico, to Nogalas. The suspect has been turned over to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement for investigation. On the morning of the 15th, Border Patrol agents stopped a suspicious vehicle in Tucson and seized 1,250 pounds of marijuana with an estimated value of $1 million. On the afternoon of the same day, an illegal immigrant was arrested and 611 pounds of drugs worth more than $300,000 were found in his vehicle.

ae27c95d2f77de6f348a2c573012739c206b50aa.sourceText: 于宁：美丽的安娜- 悼念尊敬的陈卓眉大姐（图） 左一于宁 右一安娜 (亚省时报) 得知安娜去世的消息，我和社区里所有的中国人一样，都很难受。虽然没能亲自与安娜大姐道别，但这可能更好，让我的记忆里永远只留下安娜生气勃勃，靓丽婉约的形象。她气质优雅，平易近人；她热爱中国，爱憎分明；她从不服输，坚韧坚强，她的美丽已然成为了一种永恒。 与安娜大姐邂逅源自于1998年，建造中国文化中心时，在安娜大姐的积极支持下，我们成功地把”中国周”活动从凤凰城市中心移到中国文化中心来举行。13年来，在工作上我们有许多合作与沟通，在兴趣爱好上有深入的探讨和切磋。我们互诉心事，无所不谈，她的行为，处事，作风打动我，影响我，鼓励我，尽管是和我母亲相近的年龄，但她更像是我的姐姐，我更愿意称她为我亲爱的安娜大姐。 安娜是热心公益和传扬中国文化的使者。众所周知，她是”中国周”活动的创办人之一，她对中国文化的热爱，对华人社区的贡献人尽皆知。70年代，当海外很多人对中国大陆还知之甚少，甚至有抵触的情绪时，安娜大姐却不随波逐流，因为在她眼里，自己一直都是中国的一部分，从未曾离开过。她出钱出力，接待早期从中国大陆来的代表团和留学生；她亲力亲为宣传中国文化，创办了”中国周”。她是传播中华民族文化，促进华人社区团结的功臣。 安娜大姐是一位有天分，有造诣的画家。她师从曹今奇老师，在近60岁时才开始学画画。天资聪颖，又勤奋好学的她有一股不服输的精神，选择了精臻细腻的工笔画，挑战了40岁以后不画工笔画的常规。她的画细腻清润，在追求严谨和逼真的同时，创造意境。她笔下的凤凰和嫦娥一如她本人一样飘逸灵动，完美秀丽。 安娜大姐也是生活中的胜利者。她出生在香港，早年由于父亲投资失败，家道中落，她没有办法象其他的孩子一样走进学校接受教育，但是她选择自己自学，刻苦认真，不屈不挠；1950年安娜大姐嫁给先生邓子祯，从繁华的香港来到小镇Coolidge生活。作为第一代移民，生活的艰辛，种族的偏见，没有能摧垮她，她努力劳作，勤俭持家，相夫教子。在她的影响和教育下，她的儿女都学有所成，分别成为了州法官，律师和医生。 左五安娜 招待来宾 安娜大姐虽然离开了我们，但是她的音容笑貌却永远留在我们心里。我忘不了她的温柔随和，忘不了她的勤奋努力，忘不了她的爱憎分明，忘不了她的坚韧不拔。她不骄傲，不邀功，不放弃，不言败 – 这就是永远在我记忆里的安娜大姐。在此，我还要感谢岑嘉儿大姐,她不仅在过去的15年里默默地同安娜一起为社区服务，同时还精心的陪伴和照料了安娜，直到安娜生命的最后一刻！这里，我要替安娜大姐，向您说一声谢谢。 安娜大姐，就像她的中文名字卓眉一样，是巾帼不让须眉的英雄。 安娜大姐，一路走好，愿您在天堂里安息！ 于宁 2011年10月13日 写于凤凰城
ae27c95d2f77de6f348a2c573012739c206b50aa.translatedText: Yu Ning: Beautiful Anna - In memory of the respected elder sister Chen Zhuomei (picture) Yu Ning on the left and Anna on the right (Alberta Times) When I heard the news of Anna's death, like all the Chinese people in the community, I was very sad. Although I couldn't say goodbye to my elder sister Anna in person, it might be better to leave only Anna's lively, beautiful and graceful image in my memory forever. She has an elegant temperament and is approachable; she loves China and has a clear distinction between love and hate; she never admits defeat, is tenacious and strong, and her beauty has become an eternity. The encounter with Sister Anna originated in 1998. When the Chinese Cultural Center was being built, with the active support of Sister Anna, we successfully moved the "China Week" event from downtown Phoenix to the Chinese Cultural Center. Over the past 13 years, we have had a lot of cooperation and communication at work, and had in-depth discussions and discussions on hobbies. We confided in each other and talked about everything. Her behavior, dealings, and style moved me, influenced me, and encouraged me. Although she is of a similar age to my mother, she is more like my sister. I prefer to call her my dear sister Anna. Anna is an envoy who is enthusiastic about public welfare and promotes Chinese culture. As we all know, she is one of the founders of the "China Week" event. Her love for Chinese culture and her contribution to the Chinese community are well known. In the 1970s, when many people overseas knew little about mainland China and were even resistant to it, Sister Anna did not follow the crowd, because in her eyes, she had always been a part of China and had never left. She contributed money and effort to receive early delegations and international students from mainland China; she personally promoted Chinese culture and founded "China Week". She is a hero in spreading Chinese culture and promoting unity in the Chinese community. Sister Anna is a talented and accomplished painter. She studied under teacher Cao Jinqi and began to learn painting when she was nearly 60 years old. Talented, diligent and eager to learn, she has an unyielding spirit and chooses exquisite gongbi painting, challenging the convention of not painting gongbi after the age of 40. Her paintings are delicate and clear, and she creates artistic conception while pursuing rigor and verisimilitude. The phoenix and Chang'e in her paintings are as elegant, agile, and beautiful as herself. Sister Anna is also a winner in life. She was born in Hong Kong. In her early years, due to the failure of her father's investment, her family was in ruins. She was unable to go to school to receive education like other children, but she chose to study on her own, working hard and perseveringly. In 1950, eldest sister Anna married her husband, Deng Zizhen, and came to live in the small town of Coolidge from prosperous Hong Kong. As a first-generation immigrant, the hardships of life and racial prejudice could not break her. She worked hard, was thrifty, took care of her family, and supported her husband and children. Under her influence and education, her sons and daughters all became successful in their studies and became state judges, lawyers and doctors respectively. Anna, fifth from left, entertaining guests. Although Sister Anna has left us, her voice and smile will remain in our hearts forever. I will never forget her gentleness and easy-going, her hard work, her clear distinction between love and hate, and her perseverance. She is not proud, does not ask for credit, does not give up, and never gives up - this is the sister Anna who will always be in my memory. Here, I would also like to thank Sister Cen Jiaer, who not only quietly served the community with Anna in the past 15 years, but also carefully accompanied and cared for Anna until the last moment of Anna's life! Here, I would like to say thank you to you on behalf of Sister Anna. Sister Anna, just like her Chinese name Zhuo Mei, is a hero who is not inferior to women. Sister Anna, have a good journey and may you rest in peace in heaven! Yu Ning wrote in Phoenix on October 13, 2011

5af888d7f5d89e7dd87a2dea2a1c43cdad49fc06.sourceText: 杨济群：病中有感 这是第二次写”病中有感”。 ”疾病纒身”是人们常说的一句话，人老了，什么病都会找上门来，人体就像一台机器，随着日月的增长，机器的磨损处也会愈来愈多，修好 这里，那里又出了问题，再修再补，周而复始，直到去见上帝的那一天。 近来因为两下肢动脉闭塞症，又再作了一次手术，术后二月余又先后作了两眼白内障，美国医术先进，手术都很顺利，只是苦了家人，女婿不断带着我这个麻烦的 老太婆出入医院，毫无怨言，儿女和外孙不停到家中探望，嘘寒问暖，病中的慰问让我感到温暖，加上左邻右舍邻居们的关怀，使得病中的我倍感人间真情，静养 期间，常常从今天的晚年生活回顾到以往的岁月，儿时与小伙伴们嬉戏，玩耍，踢毽子跳绳捉迷藏，欢乐无比。 少时下河捉鱼，摸虾，岸边玩五颜六色的小石子，其乐无穷。 到了青年少年时，充满活力，燥动，梦幻般的理想和志趣，手捧一本充满浪漫情才的书，与同伴们在一起畅谈各自的响往和理想，编织着一个个美好的梦， 无忧无虑，觉得世界充满阳光，缤纷五彩。 到了成年以后才懂得人生除了理想，志趣和欢愉外，还肩负着责任和义务，生活并不都是一帆风顺的，充满艰辛和意想不到的困难，上对父母，下对手足，儿女，责任重大 ，除了每日忙碌的工作外，要照顾好所有的亲人，有时压得自己喘不过气来，加上政治运动一个接一个，搞得人颠三倒四，是非难分，精神压力之大让你吃 不下饭，睡不着觉，直到大陆改革开放才大松一口气，一家人移民来到美国，更是感慨多多，从万里晴空的大环境到这里的人们的礼仪待人，服务态度，乐于助人， 义工奉献等等，无不使我赞赏，特别是政府对移民的各种照顾，使我们没有收入的老人能够过上衣食无忧的生活，”老有所养，老有所依”在这里体现得 真真切切，我的感激是由衷的，特别是来美后我多次住院，六次手术，全部是医疗保险负责，如果让我的孩子们负担，那真是倾家荡产也难以支撑，这样 的待遇，让我从心里感到生活在这里的安全感，病中的我不断为这些想法，这些感慨温暖着，心情舒畅，不以病为病，不以病为忧，这就是我多次大小 疾病中的感怀。 当然，我们中国人，特别是语言不通的老年朋友，在看病问题上还存在不少困难，但那毕竟是不难解决的问题，老年人大都有子女在身边，儿女们有责任和义务带父母 去就医，因此，我仍然认为我们的晚年能在这里度过是幸运的。 朋友们！ 让我们以平和的心态给自己多留点时间享受自由自在的生活，享受人人都会珍惜的天伦之乐，安度咱们的晚年吧！ 2011.10.16 鳯凰城
5af888d7f5d89e7dd87a2dea2a1c43cdad49fc06.translatedText: Yang Jiqun: Feelings in illness This is the second time I write "feelings in illness". "Disease clears the body" is a saying that people often say. When people get old, any disease will come to their door. The human body is like a machine. As the days and months go by, the wear and tear of the machine will become more and more. Repair it Here and there something went wrong again, and it was repaired again and again, until the day I went to see God. Recently, I had another operation due to arterial occlusion in both lower limbs. Two months after the operation, I had cataracts in both eyes. The United States has advanced medical skills and the operations went smoothly. It is just a pain for my family and my son-in-law keeps having this troublesome thing like me. The old woman went in and out of the hospital without any complaints, and her children and grandchildren kept visiting her home to ask for her welfare. The condolences during my illness made me feel warm, and the care of my neighbors made me feel the true love of the world. During the period of rest, I often looked back on the past years from today's later life. When I was a child, I played with my friends, played shuttlecock, skipped rope and played hide-and-seek. I was extremely happy. When I was young, I would go to the river to catch fish, touch shrimps, and play with colorful pebbles on the shore. I had endless fun. When I was a teenager, I was full of vitality, excitement, and dreamlike ideals and interests. I held a book full of romantic talents and talked about my past and ideals with my companions, weaving beautiful dreams one after another. I felt carefree and felt that the world was full of sunshine and colorful. Only after adulthood do we understand that in addition to ideals, aspirations and joys, life also shoulders responsibilities and obligations. Life is not always smooth sailing, and is full of hardships and unexpected difficulties. We have great responsibilities for our parents, siblings, and children. In addition to the daily busy work, we have to take care of all our relatives, which sometimes makes us breathless. In addition, political movements come one after another, which makes people confused and difficult to distinguish between right and wrong. The mental pressure is so great that you eat it. I couldn't eat, couldn't sleep, and it wasn't until the reform and opening up in the mainland that I breathed a sigh of relief. When my family immigrated to the United States, I was filled with emotion. From the beautiful environment with clear skies to the etiquette, service attitude, willingness to help others, volunteer dedication, etc., I admire everything. Especially the government's various care for immigrants, so that our elderly people with no income can live a life without worries about food and clothing. "The old age is provided for and supported" is reflected here. I am truly grateful. I am sincerely grateful, especially since I came to the United States. I have been hospitalized many times and had six surgeries, all of which were covered by medical insurance. If my children were to bear the burden, it would be bankrupt and difficult to support. Such treatment made me feel a sense of security living here from the bottom of my heart. I was constantly warmed by these thoughts and feelings during my illness. Of course, we Chinese, especially the elderly friends who do not understand the language, still have many difficulties in medical treatment, but it is not a difficult problem to solve after all. Most elderly people have children around them, and children have the responsibility and obligation to take their parents to medical treatment. Therefore, I still think that we are lucky to spend our later years here. Friends! Let us leave more time for ourselves to enjoy a free life with a peaceful mind, enjoy the family happiness that everyone will cherish, and spend our later years in peace! 2011.10.16 Phoenix City

fec2c7a7e6949e36f1d1a1169c6504a86f1f901f.sourceText: 亚省警方在16日分别在两个独立支持占领华尔街行动中逮捕了近100人。 上周六，为占领华尔街行动助威和支持，全国多个地方出现一系列对金融机构的和平抗议，亚省也不例外。当天警方在图森逮捕了45人，凤凰城拘留了53人。 凤凰城的示威游行从周六中午起，人数最多时超过1000人。傍晚时，抗议人士从凤凰城市中心的Cesar Chavez广场游行至Margaret T. Hance公园，公园原定10：30关门，而这些示威者不肯离开，警方动用100多名防暴员警，在11:30左右带走了53人。 在图森的活动有500人参加，天黑后人潮逐渐散去，剩下的人集结在军事广场公园。警方清场时带走45人。被捕人士在周日晚获释。示威人士称，占领行动在亚省不会中断，本周末的游行示威继续。
fec2c7a7e6949e36f1d1a1169c6504a86f1f901f.translatedText: The police in Alberta arrested nearly 100 people in two separate actions to support Occupy Wall Street on the 16th. Last Saturday, a series of peaceful protests against financial institutions took place in many places across the country to cheer and support the Occupy Wall Street movement, and Alberta was no exception. That day, police arrested 45 people in Tucson and detained 53 people in Phoenix. The demonstration in Phoenix started at noon on Saturday, with the largest number of people exceeding 1,000 people. In the evening, protesters marched from Cesar Chavez Square in downtown Phoenix to Margaret T. Hance Park. The park was scheduled to close at 10:30, but these demonstrators refused to leave. The police used more than 100 riot police officers and took away 53 people around 11:30. The event in Tucson was attended by 500 people, and the crowd gradually dispersed after dark, with the remaining people gathering at Military Plaza Park. The police took away 45 people when they cleared the area. Those arrested were released Sunday night. Demonstrators say the occupation will not be interrupted in Alberta and demonstrations will continue this weekend.

11dfaef8c0b5c426c19862ed8ca5287df2306707.sourceText: 由于利息低和新法规，银行难以用传统的方式赚钱，如贷款给个人和企业，许多银行开始收取新法规未管制​​的费用，如ATM卡(debit card)月费、支票帐户月费等。消费者指责这些收费是在金融危机时接受纾困的银行，在此经济困难、失业率高时，做出的无情回应。 由于现在利率为历史新低，使银行难以对贷款定出高利率，新法规又取消或降低多种传统的收费，如支票帐户透支费、信用卡还款迟缴罚款等，联邦法规也把银行就消费者使用销帐卡交易向商家收取的费用减少，银行为弥补其收入损失，即开始收取新的费用。 美国商业银行(Bank of America)宣布将对使用销帐卡的客户收取月费五元，引起消费者的愤怒，也成为”占领华尔街”运动抗议的项目之一，甚至欧巴马总统都批评银行的这种措施。消费者联盟18日说，如果银行拒绝取消这种收费，消费者应该转换到其他银行，或信用合作社。 各银行计画提出的新收费包括： ●花旗银行(Citibank)定12月起对支票、储蓄和投资帐户总结余不到1万5000元的客户，收取月费20元。 ●富国银行(Wells Fargo)定21日起，在新墨西哥、内华达、俄勒冈、华盛顿和乔治亚州试行对销帐卡收取月费3元。 ●摩根大通银行(JP Morgan Chase)定明年2月起，在威斯康辛和乔治亚州试行对销帐卡收取月费3元。 ●乔治亚州SunTrust银行定明年6月起，对开设基本支票帐户的客户使用销帐卡，收取月费5元。 ●阿拉巴马州Regions Financal银行定10月起，对销帐卡收取月费4元。 NAB研究公司银行分析师南西‧布希说，过去一年大多数大银行已经取消了免费支票帐户，又对从寄发月结单到使用自动提款机层层收费，加上计画中的新收费，实在太过分了，已经伤害了银行的公共形象。
11dfaef8c0b5c426c19862ed8ca5287df2306707.translatedText: Due to low interest rates and new regulations, it is difficult for banks to make money in traditional ways, such as lending to individuals and businesses. Many banks have begun to charge fees that are not controlled by new regulations, such as ATM cards (debit). card) monthly fees, checking account monthly fees, etc. Consumers blame the charges as a callous response by banks that were bailed out during the financial crisis to a time of economic hardship and high unemployment. Since interest rates are now at record lows, it is difficult for banks to set high interest rates on loans. The new regulations have eliminated or reduced many traditional charges, such as checking account overdraft fees, late payment penalties for credit card payments, etc. Federal regulations have also reduced the fees banks charge merchants for consumers using charge card transactions. In order to make up for their revenue losses, banks have begun to charge new fees. Bank of America announced that it would charge a monthly fee of five yuan to customers who use debit cards, which aroused the anger of consumers and became one of the items protested by the "Occupy Wall Street" movement. Even President Obama criticized the bank's measure. Consumers Union said on the 18th that if banks refuse to cancel such charges, consumers should switch to other banks or credit unions. The new fees planned by banks include: ●Citibank will charge a monthly fee of $20 from December for customers with a total balance of less than $15,000 in their checking, savings and investment accounts. ●Wells Fargo plans to trial charging a monthly fee of $3 for its charge card in New Mexico, Nevada, Oregon, Washington and Georgia starting on the 21st. ●JP Morgan Chase plans to trial a $3 monthly fee for its charge card in Wisconsin and Georgia starting in February next year. ●SunTrust Bank in Georgia plans to charge a monthly fee of $5 for customers who open a basic checking account to use a debit card starting in June next year. ●Regions Financial Bank in Alabama plans to charge a monthly fee of $4 for charge-off cards starting in October. NAB Research bank analyst Nancy Busch said that in the past year, most major banks have eliminated free checking accounts, and added layer upon layer of fees for everything from sending monthly statements to using ATMs, plus planned new fees. This is too much and has hurt the banks' public image.

74ea283138777de867164dfc32625a99e20c03cd.sourceText: 金秋十月 新东方艺术学校与罗德斯初中联合演出精彩纷呈 太阳鸟网站特约记者王帅 10月22日晚，由亚利桑那新东方艺术学校与罗德斯初中主办，亚省州立大学孔子学院协办的金秋十月中国舞汇演在罗德斯高中礼堂成功举办。本次活动也到了菲尼克斯地区华人华侨联合会，美西报的大力协助。 新东方”全家福” 胡秋子总监： ‘ 我们会为大家奉献更多更好的演出 ‘ 作为本次中国舞汇演的艺术总监，胡秋子感概颇多。”我们新东方艺术学校的老师和孩子们为这次演出付出了很多心血。”参加演出的主体是新东方艺术学校数个舞蹈班的学员，年龄范围则是从3岁到17岁。”我们在排练中遇到的一个困难就是好多孩子有大有小，从学前班到高中都有。所以说我们老师和孩子得充分利用暑假时间和平时的空闲时间来进行练习。” 本次汇演不光是新东方艺术学校的一次教学成果的阶段性演出，也是为明年的亚省春节晚会的预热。胡总监这次还特 意带来了由她指导的原创藏族舞蹈，”卓玛神香”。卓玛神香最近参加了在chandler举办的欢迎中国成都艺术代表团来访的演出，获得了高度好评。”卓玛神香是我指导的一个原创节目，我们艺术学校希望不光能够在平时培养训练学员的基本功，更希望能够培养大家的艺术欣赏能力，能够有一些原创节目。”胡秋子总监介绍到。”我们希望能够将此次汇演作为明年亚省华人春节晚会的一次预热，到时候我们会有更多更精彩的节目。”她笑着提前为明年的春节联欢晚会打广告。 Madeline Spring:” 希望能够有更多的人来学习中文，了解中国文化” 本次活动的另外一个协办方则是亚州州立大学孔子学院(Confucius Insitute of Arizona State University)与 位于梅萨(Mesa)的罗德斯初中(Rhodes Junior High World Studies Academy).这也是本次活动与传统的华人社区活动不同的地方：不仅仅是地道的中国文化的汇演，也是华人社区与西方文化的一次交流，融合。当记者准备用英文采访Dr. Spring 女士的时候，她却笑着主动用流利的中文和记者聊起来，”来说中文吧。” Dr.Spring的名片上还有一个颇有神韵的中文名字：”司马德琳”。 孔子学院是 中国大陆政府 为了向世界推广 汉语 ，增进世界各国对中国的了解而设立的官方机构。 通过在各国开办孔子学院，使其作为海外学习汉语的教学基地，为海外汉语提供零距离的教学服务。用以提高当地中华语言文化的水平，提供更多汉语进修的渠道，并协助整合和统筹当地现有的汉语教学以及民间的文化活动 (来自维基百科) 。然而孔子学院属于college level，如何能够和当地的高中的学习生活结合在一起呢？ Dr. Spring 介绍到这是他们孔子学院的一个项目，希望能够不仅在大学阶段对那些有兴趣的人开展汉语及中国文化教育，而更是希望能够在初中，高中阶段就开始开办”孔子课堂”，教授汉语，学习中国的文化传统，进而从小培养学生的国际化视野。而这，也正与Rhodes Junior High School的理念’world studies academy’不谋而合。Rhodes Junior High School也是mesa地区第一家开设孔子课堂的学校，来自这个学校孔子课堂的学生则为观众们奉献了两首精彩的中文歌曲，博得阵阵掌声。 孔子学院司马德琳院长 传统与现代，东方与西方 虽然是一场传统的中国舞汇报演出，但是我们也可以从中体会到现代因素的影响，以及西方文化与东方文化交流和融合。演出的学员基本上是在美国本土出生长大的华裔，成长沁浸在西方文化和社会环境中。可是无论是藏族单人独舞《祝福》，还是古典中国舞《雨霖铃》，都可以从中体会到强烈的中国元素与神韵。而在汇报演出《欢庆》和《花木兰》中，也可以看到金发碧眼的小姑娘穿起中式舞蹈服，认认真真地跳起来。Rhodes Junior High School 孔子课堂的学生肤色可异，宛如一个小世界村。然而他们却能精彩地演绎诸如《不得不爱》，《super star》这样的中文流行歌曲。语言和文化的不同并没有成为障碍，反而成为交流，融合的绝好机会。短短一个半小时的演出浓缩了许多精彩，在结束之后，演员们和他们的家长们开心地合影留念，而落幕时经久不息的掌声，应该是对他们的付出最好的回报。 新东方教学表演 藏族独舞 祝福 Angela Zhang 独舞 雨霖铃 Jinnie Xie 罗德斯初中 合唱 Super Star 群舞 羌情 热闹的后台
74ea283138777de867164dfc32625a99e20c03cd.translatedText: In the Golden Autumn October, New Oriental Art School and Rhodes Junior High School jointly performed brilliantly. Sunbird website special reporter Wang Shuai. On the evening of October 22, the Golden Autumn October Chinese Dance Performance, hosted by Arizona New Oriental Art School and Rhodes Junior High School and co-organized by the Confucius Institute at Alberta State University, was successfully held in the auditorium of Rhodes High School. This event also received great assistance from the Phoenix Area Overseas Chinese Association and the American Western Newspaper. New Oriental “Family Portrait” Director Hu Qiuzi: ‘We will provide you with more and better performances.’ As the artistic director of this Chinese dance performance, Hu Qiuzi has a lot of feelings. "Our teachers and children at New Oriental Art School have put a lot of effort into this performance." The main participants in the performance were students from several dance classes at New Oriental Art School, ranging in age from 3 to 17 years old. "One of the difficulties we encountered during the rehearsal is that there are many children, ranging from preschool to high school. Therefore, our teachers and children have to make full use of summer vacation time and free time to practice." This performance is not only a staged performance of the teaching achievements of New Oriental Art School, but also a warm-up for next year's Alberta Spring Festival Gala. Director Hu also specially brought an original Tibetan dance directed by her this time, "Dolma Divine Fragrance". Zhuoma Shenxiang recently participated in a performance held at Chandler to welcome the visiting art delegation from Chengdu, China, and received high praise. "Dolma Shenxiang is an original program directed by me. Our art school hopes to not only cultivate students' basic skills in daily life, but also cultivate everyone's art appreciation ability and have some original programs." Director Hu Qiuzi introduced. "We hope to use this performance as a warm-up for next year's Chinese New Year Gala in Alberta. By then we will have more and more exciting programs." She smiled and advertised next year's Spring Festival Gala in advance. Madeline Spring: "I hope more people will learn Chinese and understand Chinese culture." The other co-organizers of this event are the Confucius Insitute of Arizona State University and the Rhodes Junior High World Studies Academy in Mesa. This is where this event differs from traditional Chinese community activities: it is not only a performance of authentic Chinese culture, but also an exchange and integration of the Chinese community and Western culture. When the reporter was about to interview Ms. Dr. Spring in English, she smiled and took the initiative to chat with the reporter in fluent Chinese, "Let's talk Chinese." There is also a charming Chinese name on Dr. Spring's business card: "Sima Delin." The Confucius Institute is an official institution established by the Chinese mainland government to promote the Chinese language to the world and enhance the understanding of China by countries around the world. By opening Confucius Institutes in various countries, they serve as teaching bases for overseas Chinese learning and provide zero-distance teaching services for overseas Chinese. It is used to improve the level of local Chinese language and culture, provide more channels for Chinese language learning, and help integrate and coordinate existing local Chinese language teaching and folk cultural activities (from Wikipedia). However, the Confucius Institute is at the college level. How can it be integrated with the study and life of local high schools? Dr. Spring introduced that this is a project of their Confucius Institute. They hope to not only provide Chinese language and Chinese culture education to those who are interested in college, but also hope to start opening "Confucius Classrooms" in junior high schools and high schools to teach Chinese and learn Chinese cultural traditions, so as to cultivate students' international perspective from an early age. And this coincides with Rhodes Junior High School’s concept of ‘world studies academy’. Rhodes Junior High School is also the first school in Mesa to open a Confucius Classroom. Students from the Confucius Classroom at this school performed two wonderful Chinese songs for the audience, winning rounds of applause. Sima Delin, Director of the Confucius Institute Tradition and Modernity, East and West Although it is a traditional Chinese dance report performance, we can also experience the influence of modern factors, as well as the exchange and integration of Western culture and Eastern culture. The students who perform are basically Chinese-Americans who were born and raised in the United States. They grew up immersed in Western culture and social environment. However, whether it is the Tibetan solo dance "Blessing" or the classical Chinese dance "Yulin Ling", you can experience the strong Chinese elements and charm. In the report performances "Celebration" and "Mulan", you can also see the blond girl wearing Chinese dance clothes and dancing seriously. The students in the Confucius Classroom at Rhodes Junior High School have different skin colors, just like a small world village. However, they can perform Chinese pop songs such as "Have to Love" and "Super Star" wonderfully. Differences in language and culture have not become obstacles, but have become excellent opportunities for communication and integration. The one-and-a-half-hour performance condensed a lot of excitement. After the performance, the actors and their parents happily took photos together, and the long-lasting applause at the end should be the best reward for their efforts. 318aee188e0d4b566a9a9d347135d2286b60aa9d.sourceText: １０ 月２３日下午２时２０分，美中高层次人才交流协会在亚利桑那州立大学ＭＵ举办了２０１２第二届赢在２１世纪北美高层次人才创业大赛凤凰城推介会。ＡＳＵ学生学者联谊会，亚利桑那清华校友会，华美半导体协会凤凰城分会，旅美科学家工程师专业人士协会凤凰城分会代表以及当地工程师，２０多人参加了会议。浙江清华长三角研究院硅谷创新创业基地主任于江涛 ，创业大赛组织工作负责人之一胡海涛工程师为现场来宾详细介绍了比赛的赛程并回答了来宾的提问。 胡海涛工程师首先介绍了2011年创业大赛在北美举办的盛况，有150多个项目参赛，最后在硅谷进行的总决赛迎来了上千人的参与。第一届比赛的冠军清洁煤技术，以高燃烧率，低污染收到青睐，一年来项目进展非常顺利。本次比赛除了填写报名表格，还要准备一个10页左右PPT，来介绍自己创业产品。浙江清华长三角研究院硅谷创新创业基地主任于江涛就近年来做得美中创业考察活动做了介绍，并以自己实际经验，谈了很多想法。第一，PPT中最好多介绍产品的市场，以及效益，对于技术本身的介绍，主办方会尽全力来保护参赛者的知识产权，但是参赛者本人也要有自我保护意识。第二，需要适应国内创业的环境，因为国内有完全不同的创业文化和规则。第三，创业不能停留在想上，一定要行动起来。 现场来宾提问很积极，特别是敏感的知识产权问题。有的来宾甚至是带着自己完整的创业计划书，来到现场，也讲了自己参加其他创业大赛时，他们解决知识产权问题的方式。凤凰城工程师们创业的积极性很高，两位嘉宾都提到本次创业大赛机会很多，有的甚至只要有新颖的想法就有机会，因为该活动的目标就是集合人才和项目的平台，努力成为北美高科技人士成功创业的孵化器。
318aee188e0d4b566a9a9d347135d2286b60aa9d.translatedText: >10 At 2:20 pm on September 23, the US-China High-Level Talent Exchange Association held the 2012 Second North American High-Level Talent Entrepreneurship Competition to Win in the 21st Century Phoenix Promotion Conference at MU, Arizona State University. More than 20 people attended the meeting, including representatives from the ASU Student and Scholar Association, Arizona Tsinghua Alumni Association, Phoenix Branch of the China-American Semiconductor Association, Phoenix Branch of the Association of Scientists and Engineers Professionals in the United States, and local engineers. Yu Jiangtao, director of the Silicon Valley Innovation and Entrepreneurship Base of the Yangtze River Delta Research Institute of Zhejiang Tsinghua University, and engineer Hu Haitao, one of the organizers of the entrepreneurship competition, introduced the competition schedule to the guests in detail and answered their questions. Engineer Hu Haitao first introduced the grand occasion of the 2011 Entrepreneurship Competition held in North America. More than 150 projects participated, and the finals in Silicon Valley welcomed thousands of participants. The clean coal technology that won the first competition was favored for its high combustion rate and low pollution. The project has been progressing very smoothly over the past year. In addition to filling out the registration form for this competition, you also need to prepare a PPT of about 10 pages to introduce your entrepreneurial products. Yu Jiangtao, director of the Silicon Valley Innovation and Entrepreneurship Base of the Yangtze River Delta Research Institute of Tsinghua University in Zhejiang, introduced the U.S.-China entrepreneurship inspection activities conducted in recent years and shared many ideas based on his own practical experience. First, it is best to introduce the market and benefits of the product in the PPT. Regarding the introduction of the technology itself, the organizer will do its best to protect the intellectual property rights of the contestants, but the contestants themselves must also have a sense of self-protection. Second, you need to adapt to the domestic entrepreneurial environment, because the domestic entrepreneurial culture and rules are completely different. Third, starting a business cannot stop at thinking, you must take action. Guests were very active in asking questions, especially sensitive intellectual property issues. Some guests even came to the event with their complete business plans and talked about how they solved intellectual property issues when they participated in other entrepreneurial competitions. Engineers in Phoenix are very motivated to start a business. Both guests mentioned that there are many opportunities in this entrepreneurial competition, and some even have opportunities as long as they have novel ideas, because the goal of this event is to gather talents and projects as a platform, and strive to become an incubator for North American high-tech people to successfully start businesses.

3fa1ba9f504ea740affadae13d7bcd7b926a7dfb.sourceText: 希望中文学校2011秋季运动会 （亚省时报 可可报道） 秋高气爽，又到凤凰城最迷人的季节，全家人到户外走走是件非常愜意的事情。2011年秋季运动会就于10月30日，在钱德勒的野草公园隆重拉开序幕。 与受过传统中国校园式的运动会大大不同的就是，中国校园式运动会，从各班级调出运动最好的学生参加，其他人都是啦啦队，这里的运动会可是全民式的参与，全校的小朋友都是运动员，还包括家长。 看看学前班孙婷老师带来的迷你话剧《拔萝卜》，可是把家长们笑翻了。小朋友们纯正的中文，把小故事表现的活灵活现。马立平中文一年级的同学一边大声的背儿歌，一边排起队表演千手观音。三年级史敬嵬老师班上的小马过河，小马跑的欢，而且中文特别地道，穿着红色旗袍负责诵读故事的旁白小美女，把故事讲得生动有趣。这边小朋友表演得热闹，那边学生会发出通知游戏活动开始了，三只腿赛跑，木乃伊接力，还有万圣节的服饰大比拼，不仅是小朋友都跑来了，连爸爸妈妈也加入了比赛的队伍，而且只要参与个个都有奖品。组织者们用手纸当成是裹木乃伊的布，一个被裹得像白粽子似的选手，摇头晃脑的奋力奔跑，让小选手们感受到了运动会的快乐。拔河是所有人的最爱，大家都可以参与，这次有43个小朋友，参加了最后的拔河活动，老师家长们安置好这些好胜的小老虎们，可是不容易呀，老师董斌拿着小喇叭不停地维护秩序，把绳子中间标识固定在中间，众多的家长站在旁边给小选手们传授拔河的技巧，还要”警惕”是否有小朋友或家长准备来”帮忙”。只听到一声”开始”，小家伙们憋红着脸，小手抓着远远超过他们比例的粗绳子，使劲拔，不到一分钟，就见分晓了….胜者一窝蜂，冲向了发奖券者…不是只有小朋友跑跑跳跳，看大大的乘凉亭下面也响起了超酷的动感音乐，小朋友，老师，家长都跟着学校的健美操老师姜漫热舞起来，青春，充满活力气息，弥漫在整个运动会的现场… 看到几年来中文学校有了很大的变化，例如学习中文的方法越来越丰富多彩，只要能学进中文，老师家长就愿意掏出时间和孩子们一起”玩”。校长赵彩虹表示孩子学中文进步快，老师很重要，但是家长的配合和关注要排第一，她感谢老师和家长们的共同努力，大家才能看到现在孩子丰盛的学习成果。还例如学生会开始在希望中文学校发挥重要的作用，学生会主席李鸿镜说，他们不仅能在运动会中给小朋友带来精彩，参与性强的游戏，在平时上课时，还负责监督教室卫生，并参与学校活动的组织和管理。才艺组负责人谢小红老师说以前老师家长管得太全，太多，学校应该有一些空间来发挥他们自己的组织管理的能力。 相关新闻： 图片新闻：希望中文学校运动会 快乐 健康跟我来！（一） 图片新闻：希望中文学校运动会 快乐 健康跟我来！（二）
3fa1ba9f504ea740affadae13d7bcd7b926a7dfb.translatedText: > Hope Chinese School 2011 Autumn Sports Meet (Alberta Times Coco Report) The air is crisp in autumn and it is the most charming season in Phoenix. It is very pleasant for the whole family to take a walk outdoors. The 2011 Autumn Sports Games kicked off grandly on October 30th at Chandler's Wild Grass Park. What is very different from the traditional Chinese campus sports games is that the best students from each class are selected to participate in the Chinese campus sports games, and the others are cheerleaders. The sports games here are participated by all the people, and all the children in the school are athletes, including parents. Take a look at the mini drama "Pull the Carrot" presented by the preschool teacher Sun Ting, which made the parents laugh. The children’s pure Chinese made the story come alive. Ma Liping's first-grade Chinese students recited children's songs loudly and lined up to perform the Thousand-Hand Guanyin. The pony in the third grade teacher Shi Jingwei's class ran happily across the river, and her Chinese was particularly authentic. The little beauty narrator who was wearing a red cheongsam and was responsible for reading the story told the story vividly and interestingly. The children here performed lively, and the student union over there announced the start of game activities, including a three-legged race, a mummy relay, and a Halloween costume competition. Not only did the children come, but even their parents also joined the competition team, and everyone who participated would win prizes. The organizers used tissue paper as a mummy wrapping cloth, and a player who was wrapped like a white rice dumpling was running hard and shaking his head, making the young players feel the joy of the sports meeting. Tug-of-war is everyone’s favorite, and everyone can participate. This time, 43 children participated in the final tug-of-war activity. Teachers and parents arranged for these competitive little tigers, but it was not easy. Teacher Dong Bin kept maintaining order with a small speaker and fixed the middle mark of the rope in the middle. Many parents stood by to teach the young players the tug-of-war skills, and were "wary" to see if any children or parents were ready to "help." Just hearing the sound of "go", the little ones suppressed their blushes and grabbed the thick rope that was far larger than their size with their little hands. They pulled hard. In less than a minute, the result was revealed... The winner swarmed towards the person who gave out the lottery tickets... It was not just the children. Running and jumping, cool dynamic music was playing under the big pavilion. Children, teachers, and parents all danced to the school's aerobics teacher Jiang Man. The youthful and energetic atmosphere permeated the entire sports meeting... I have seen great changes in Chinese schools in the past few years. For example, the methods of learning Chinese are becoming more and more colorful. As long as they can learn Chinese, teachers and parents are willing to spend time to "play" with their children. Principal Zhao Caihong said that children make rapid progress in learning Chinese, and teachers are very important, but parents’ cooperation and attention should come first. She thanked teachers and parents for their joint efforts, so that everyone can see the rich learning achievements of children now. For example, the student union has begun to play an important role in Hope Chinese School. Student Union Chairman Li Hongjing said that not only can they bring exciting and participatory games to children during sports meets, but they are also responsible for supervising classroom hygiene during class and participating in the organization and management of school activities. Teacher Xie Xiaohong, head of the talent group, said that in the past, teachers and parents had too much control, and the school should have some space to exert their own organizational and management capabilities. 39c426eb2839fd33b72a4bc038332fabc88896e3.sourceText: 2011全球十大怪新闻 1.美国女子誓言吃成世界最胖 8月份，美国女子苏姗妮 艾曼（Susanne Eman）宣布了一个雄心勃勃的计划，要成为世界上最胖的女人。艾曼本身已经330公斤重，为了达到730公斤的目标，她每天要吃2万卡路里食物。 2.英国空军基地发现狗幽灵 11月份，一个超自然调查组宣称，他们在英国斯坎普顿（Scampton）空军基地发现了一个”狗幽灵”，甚至与其进行了交流。这只狗的主人是二战中领导丹巴斯特奇袭（Dambusters raids）任务的英国英雄飞行指挥官盖伊‧吉布森（Guy Gibson）。 3.”世界最辣辣椒挑战赛”导致2人入院 10月份，在英国爱丁堡举行的吃辣椒比赛”世界最辣辣椒挑战赛”上，两名参赛者被辣得不醒人事后被送入医院抢救。 4.瑞士”喷气飞人”翱翔阿尔卑斯山 11月份，瑞士冒险家伊夫 罗希（Yves Rossy）震惊世界，他身穿特制的”喷气服”翱翔在阿尔卑斯山上空。 5.幸运猫继承千万欧元遗产 12月份，意大利一只被寡居女主人从罗马街头捡回来的黑猫成为世界上最幸运的猫，它继承了主人高达1000万欧元（约合8299万元人民币）的巨额财富，包括现金、股票以及地产等。 6.麋鹿发”酒疯”卡在树上 9月份，瑞典南部一头麋鹿因为贪吃把自己弄得酩酊大醉，发了一阵”酒疯”后卡在一棵苹果树上难以动弹，最后被消防员解救。 7.女子割掉丈夫阴茎扔进垃圾堆 7月份，美国加州女子凯瑟琳贝克（Catherine Kieu Becker）与丈夫争吵后在丈夫饭菜中下药，趁其昏迷时将其阴茎割掉扔进垃圾堆。 8. 伦敦禁售人乳冰淇淋 3月份，英国伦敦一家冰淇淋店被禁止出售”Baby Gaga”冰淇淋，因为它是由人乳做成的。尽管店主称这种冰淇淋很受欢迎，但当地官员取样检测后，要求其立即停止出售。 9.英国电工被压缩空气”吹胀” 8月份，英国电工加雷斯 达伦特（Gareth Durrant）在工作时被失控的压缩空气管射中臀部，险些被吹胀丧命。医生在抢救达伦特时发现他的肠子上有一条15厘米长的伤口，经过几个小时的紧急手术，达伦特的命才保住。 10.意大利男子打喷嚏喷出子弹 1月份，意大利男子达寇 桑格马诺（Darco Sangermano）在与女友参加新年庆祝活动时，脑部被飞来子弹击中。子弹从脑右侧射入，最后停在鼻腔中。在等待医生救治时，他打了个喷嚏，将子弹喷出。
39c426eb2839fd33b72a4bc038332fabc88896e3.translatedText: Top Ten Weird News in the World in 2011 1. American woman vows to eat to become the fattest woman in the world. In August, American woman Susanne Eman announced an ambitious plan to become the fattest woman in the world. Aiman ​​already weighs 330 kilograms. In order to reach her goal of 730 kilograms, she needs to eat 20,000 calories a day. 2. Dog ghost discovered at British Air Force Base In November, a paranormal investigation team claimed that they had discovered a "dog ghost" at Scampton Air Force Base in the United Kingdom and even communicated with it. The dog's owner is Guy Gibson, the heroic British flight commander who led the Dambusters raids in World War II. 3. The "World's Hottest Chili Challenge" resulted in two people being hospitalized. In October, at the "World's Hottest Chili Challenge", a chili-eating competition held in Edinburgh, England, two contestants were so spicy that they lost consciousness and were sent to the hospital for emergency treatment. 4. Swiss "jet suit" soared over the Alps In November, Swiss adventurer Yves Rossy shocked the world when he soared over the Alps wearing a special "jet suit". 5. Lucky cat inherits tens of millions of euros. In December, an Italian black cat picked up from the streets of Rome by its widowed mistress became the luckiest cat in the world. It inherited its owner’s huge wealth of up to 10 million euros (approximately 82.99 million yuan), including cash, stocks and real estate. 6. The elk got "drunk" and got stuck in a tree. In September, an elk in southern Sweden got drunk due to gluttony and became "drunk" for a while. Then it got stuck in an apple tree and was unable to move. It was finally rescued by firefighters. 7. Woman cut off her husband’s penis and threw it into the trash. In July, a California woman, Catherine Kieu Becker, drugged her husband’s food after an argument. She cut off his penis and threw it into the trash while he was unconscious. 8. London bans sale of human milk ice cream In March, an ice cream shop in London, England, was banned from selling "Baby Gaga" ice cream because it was made from human milk. Although the store owner said the ice cream was popular, local officials ordered it to stop selling it immediately after taking samples for testing. 9. British electrician was "inflated" by compressed air. In August, British electrician Gareth Durrant was shot in the buttocks by an out-of-control compressed air pipe while working. He was almost inflated to death. When doctors were rescuing Darent, they found a 15-centimeter long wound on his intestines. After several hours of emergency surgery, Darent's life was saved. 10. Italian man sneezes and spits out bullets In January, Italian man Darco Sangermano was hit in the brain by a flying bullet while attending a New Year celebration with his girlfriend. The bullet entered from the right side of the brain and finally lodged in the nasal cavity. While waiting for medical attention, he sneezed and expelled the bullet.

59d2a20ac0b2678ad90f853f0302450455b933de.sourceText: 连月来民众抱怨洛杉矶国际机场（LAX）「运作效率牛步」、「通关时间长」、「检查气氛太沉重」，洛杉矶国际机场表示，已增加入关移民检查窗口和行李物品检查犬加快通关 ，即将到来的圣诞和新年客流高峰期会进一步增加人手，但对入关旅客及携带物品的安全检查不会放松。 LAX同时增设快速进关通道，100元快速通关，效期五年。 机场工作人员表示，近期LAX工作人员并没有减少，工作量也没有增加，如果遇到各地航班因晚点而造成著陆「撞机」，旅客通关就会出现堵塞，引起民怨。 此外，近期旅客入关行李抽查率增加，也使旅客通关时间增长。 LAX 近期通关效率牛步，已遭到多位联邦议员炮轰。 日前，联署联邦海关与边境保护委员会要求增加LAX海关人手，包括将现有的60个移民入关检查口增加到81个，不能虚设无人作业，海关行李检查也希望提高效率。 为加快民众快速通关，LAX设立快速通关口，目前只限美国公民和绿卡持有人。 据机场海关华裔官员解释，快速通关口费用100元，可以使用五年，航班抵达后使用机器扫描护照和绿卡，通关时间可减少一半以上。 当然，如果海关怀疑通关者行李异常，依然可要求开箱检查。
59d2a20ac0b2678ad90f853f0302450455b933de.translatedText: For months, people have complained about Los Angeles International Airport (LAX)'s "unremarkable operational efficiency," "long customs clearance times," and "too heavy an atmosphere of inspection." Los Angeles International Airport said it has added immigration inspection windows and baggage inspection dogs to speed up customs clearance. During the upcoming peak passenger flow periods of Christmas and New Year, manpower will be further increased, but security inspections of incoming passengers and their belongings will not be relaxed. LAX has also added a fast-track customs clearance channel, which costs 100 yuan to quickly clear customs and is valid for five years. Airport staff said that LAX staff has not been reduced recently, and the workload has not increased. If flights from various places are delayed and cause landing "collision", passenger clearance will be blocked, causing public complaints. In addition, the recent increase in the rate of spot checks on passengers entering customs has also increased the time required for passengers to clear customs. LAX's recent improvement in customs clearance efficiency has been criticized by many federal lawmakers. A few days ago, the federal Customs and Border Protection Commission jointly requested to increase the manpower of LAX Customs, including increasing the existing 60 immigration inspection gates to 81. Unmanned operations cannot be done in vain, and customs baggage inspection also hopes to improve efficiency. In order to speed up the customs clearance for people, LAX has set up a rapid customs clearance gate, which is currently only available to U.S. citizens and green card holders. According to an explanation from a Chinese official at the airport customs, the express customs clearance gate costs 100 yuan and can be used for five years. After the flight arrives, a machine is used to scan the passport and green card, which can reduce the customs clearance time by more than half. Of course, if the customs suspects that the luggage of a person passing through customs is abnormal, they can still require the luggage to be opened for inspection.

7f1c4692b1a2b3c3142cfe5bf619d79ec1b5f6f8.sourceText: 在接受调查的海外华人中，有69%受访者为移民或持工作签证，与2010年同期的调查结果相比，上升了6%，较比前年的调查结果上升了近16%。而相应的，留学生占受访华人比例下降了10.5%，较比前年的44.4%，更是下降了26.7%，这是最近两年来，受调查的海外华人身份比例发生的显著变化。
7f1c4692b1a2b3c3142cfe5bf619d79ec1b5f6f8.translatedText: Among the overseas Chinese surveyed, 69% of the respondents were immigrants or held work visas, an increase of 6% compared with the survey results of the same period in 2010, and an increase of nearly 16% compared with the survey results of the previous year. Correspondingly, the proportion of overseas Chinese surveyed dropped by 10.5%, a drop of 26.7% from 44.4% the year before. This is a significant change in the proportion of overseas Chinese surveyed in the past two years.

2c82a0f80cd7226d9593a71649a7ef1d1a15f5b0.sourceText: 根据调查显示，已出国5至10年的海外华人所占比重最大，基本与上一年的41.5%持平，但，在海外居住超过10年的受访者比例则由2009年的10.3%上升到今年的34.3%，较比去年也上升了14.5%.已在海外居住3至5年的受访者比例下降了7.2%，已在海外居住1至3年的受访者比例下降了6.5%。而出国不到一年的受访网友和在海外出生的网友比例基本没有变化。可见，中期和长期定居海外的网友群体在显著增加。
2c82a0f80cd7226d9593a71649a7ef1d1a15f5b0.translatedText: According to the survey, overseas Chinese who have been abroad for 5 to 10 years account for the largest proportion, which is basically the same as the 41.5% of the previous year. However, those who have lived abroad for more than 1 year The proportion of respondents in 2009 increased from 10.3% in 2009 to 34.3% this year, an increase of 14.5% from last year. The proportion of respondents who have lived overseas for 3 to 5 years decreased by 7.2%, and the proportion of respondents who have lived overseas for 1 to 3 years decreased by 6.5%. The proportion of interviewed netizens who have been abroad for less than a year and those who were born overseas has basically remained unchanged. It can be seen that the number of netizens who have settled overseas in the medium and long term is increasing significantly.

9e09593ffad36eddf2863f98d7620480a1dad570.sourceText: 根据调查显示，接受本次调查的受访群体中有42%华人处于未婚状态，较比去年下降5%，这同前年的64%相比，更是大幅度下降。而海外华人已婚群体比重达到54.4%，比去年上升了近6%，2009年已婚人群比例还不到3成。单身无情侣的受访网友比例从去年的3成，下降了近6%，意味着?#33073;光?#32593;友的比例明显上升。而已婚有子女的受访海外华人比例从去年的32.9%上升了6.6%达到39.5%.
9e09593ffad36eddf2863f98d7620480a1dad570.translatedText: According to the survey, 42% of the Chinese respondents to this survey are unmarried, a decrease of 5% from last year. This is a significant decrease compared with 64% of the year before. The proportion of married overseas Chinese reached 54.4%, an increase of nearly 6% from last year. In 2009, the proportion of married people was less than 30%. The proportion of surveyed netizens who are single and not in a relationship has dropped by nearly 6% from 30% last year, which means that the proportion of casual friends has increased significantly. The proportion of overseas Chinese respondents who are married and have children increased by 6.6% from 32.9% last year to 39.5%.

d6fe279474cd4615fae0555e3072542d9483e04d.sourceText: 在关于剩男剩女的两性话题调查中，有21.7%的海外华人受访者自己承认是剩男或剩女。这一比例较比去年增加了7%.可见，”恨嫁”，渴望结婚的海外华人比例明显增多，这一点，跟目前婚恋话题成为社会热点的现象相呼应。对于单身的海外华人来说，他们更加容易接受的结交配偶方式是朋友和生活社交。两者比例较去年分别上升了8.6%和6.5%，而接受相亲的比例也上升了近2%.接受调查的海外网友中，有固定情侣或稳定夫妻生活的比例占大多数，达到62.7%，较比去年上升了19.5%.
d6fe279474cd4615fae0555e3072542d9483e04d.translatedText: In the gender topic survey on leftover men and leftover women, 21.7% of overseas Chinese respondents admitted that they were leftover men or leftover women. This proportion increased by 7% compared with last year. It can be seen that the proportion of overseas Chinese who "hate marriage" and are eager to get married has increased significantly. This echoes the current phenomenon that the topic of marriage and love has become a hot topic in society.对于单身的海外华人来说，他们更加容易接受的结交配偶方式是朋友和生活社交。 The proportions of the two increased by 8.6% and 6.5% respectively compared with last year, and the proportion of accepting blind dates also increased by nearly 2%. Among the overseas netizens surveyed, the majority had a fixed couple or a stable married life, reaching 62.7%, an increase of 19.5% from last year.

38faed4da6e2f42e801a0442ab5dda50331f86ba.sourceText: 金融危机席卷全球3年来，海外华人的就业问题也成为值得关注的焦点。参与调查的海外华人就业者比重从去年的61.8%上升到今年的68.1%，较比前年更是上升了24.5%，足可见海外华人的就业形势还是有了大幅度改观的。失业待业无业的网友比例下降了4.3%，令人欣慰。根据调查显示，自认收入处于当地国家收入水平中上等的受访网友比例总和为63.7%，较比去年的45.8%上升了17.9%.受访的海外华人认为收入足够其开支的群体比重从去年同期的75.2%上升到今年的84%，比前年更是上涨了20.8%，可见，海外华人总体生活质量偏向明显的好转。
38faed4da6e2f42e801a0442ab5dda50331f86ba.translatedText: In the three years since the financial crisis swept the world, the employment issue of overseas Chinese has also become a focus of attention. The proportion of overseas Chinese employees who participated in the survey increased from 61.8% last year to 68.1% this year, an increase of 24.5% from the previous year. This shows that the employment situation of overseas Chinese has greatly improved. The proportion of unemployed netizens dropped by 4.3%, which is gratifying. According to the survey, the proportion of interviewed netizens who consider themselves to be in the upper-middle income level of the local country is 63.7%, an increase of 17.9% from 45.8% last year. The proportion of overseas Chinese respondents who believe that their income is sufficient for their expenses has increased from 75.2% in the same period last year to 84% this year, an increase of 20.8% from the previous year. It can be seen that the overall quality of life of overseas Chinese has improved significantly.

224e9e84dcabc5ea245aab47170e7ee033255795.sourceText: 在海外生活的压力和困难
224e9e84dcabc5ea245aab47170e7ee033255795.translatedText: The pressure and difficulties of living overseas

137fb0056f045a20186709d14e2931b9ee702d20.sourceText: 海外华人网友收入方面有所好转，让海外华人的经济压力有了明显改善。有经济压力的受访者比重从前年的27.1%下降到今年的24%，较比去年也下降了1.4%。但，在子女教育方面的压力变大，较比去年上升了1.6%，与前年相比，更是上升了6.6%。因此，类似美国”虎妈””虎爸”等子女教育类的新闻才会越来越受海外华人家庭的关注，进而成为社会热点话题。
137fb0056f045a20186709d14e2931b9ee702d20.translatedText: The income of overseas Chinese netizens has improved, which has significantly improved the economic pressure of overseas Chinese. The proportion of respondents experiencing financial pressure dropped from 27.1% the year before to 24% this year, which was also a decrease of 1.4% from last year. However, the pressure on children's education has increased, with an increase of 1.6% compared to last year, and an even higher increase of 6.6% compared with the year before. Therefore, news about children’s education, such as “Tiger Moms” and “Tiger Dads” in the United States, will attract more and more attention from overseas Chinese families and become a hot topic in society.

33c3cfc72dd7385ae3eea3d55c53aef9f896111c.sourceText: 在受访者中，选择上网排解压力的海外网友比例从2010年的32.5%上升到2010年的43.3%，较比2009年的18.7%，更是上涨了24.6%。互联网在海外华人生活中的作用更加举足轻重。是海外华人排解压力解闷的主要途径和方式。
33c3cfc72dd7385ae3eea3d55c53aef9f896111c.translatedText: Among the respondents, the proportion of overseas netizens who choose to go online to relieve stress increased from 32.5% in 2010 to 43.3% in 2010, an increase of 24.6% compared with 18.7% in 2009. The Internet plays an even more important role in the lives of overseas Chinese. It is the main way and way for overseas Chinese to relieve stress and relieve boredom.

438651958ed33365e11fbf3e7045818c1d565f37.sourceText: 在受访者中，对所在国家文化感觉不适应，无法融入当地主流社会的受访网友比重上升了6.9%，即使较比前年，也增加了2.8%。因无法赡养父母而苦恼的海外华人比重从前年的12.5%逐年上升，直到今年达到20.3%。因远居海外，不能赡养父母的纠结心态在海外华人中有了越来越多的共鸣。
438651958ed33365e11fbf3e7045818c1d565f37.translatedText: Among the respondents, the proportion of netizens who felt uncomfortable with the culture of their country and unable to integrate into the local mainstream society increased by 6.9%. Even compared with the previous year, it also increased by 2.8%. The proportion of overseas Chinese who are distressed by being unable to support their parents has increased year by year from 12.5% ​​the year before to 20.3% this year. The tangled mentality of being unable to support their parents because they live overseas has become more and more common among overseas Chinese.

90cf59616c62e444f78c5f172cce98cf236960a3.sourceText: 在海外工作升迁的困难

c9695759326a53426c60b618ea89305b33585b6b.sourceText: 对于已工作或计划在海外工作的华人来说，工作升迁存在瓶颈，影响因素有很多。在海外华人心中，语言沟通问题是最大的障碍。本次调查中超过35.4%的华人认为语言困难影响其事业发展，较比去年增加了6.6%。而越来越多的海外华人认为，在海外事业发展的影响因素中，人脉关系更加重要，持此观点的受访海外华人网友比例较比去年增加了2.1%.
c9695759326a53426c60b618ea89305b33585b6b.translatedText: For Chinese people who have worked or plan to work overseas, there are bottlenecks in job promotion, and there are many influencing factors. In the minds of overseas Chinese, language communication is the biggest obstacle. More than 35.4% of Chinese in this survey believe that language difficulties affect their career development, an increase of 6.6% from last year. More and more overseas Chinese believe that among the factors that influence the development of overseas careers, personal connections are more important. The proportion of overseas Chinese netizens surveyed who hold this view has increased by 2.1% compared with last year.

652c686b36f0cd14c9e131085711648667f7d0af.sourceText: 令人担忧的是，有超过一成的海外华人外语水平很不好。这一比例较比去年上升了6.1%，而在海外能够掌握外语应用自如的受访网友不到3成，较比去年还下降了3.6%.
652c686b36f0cd14c9e131085711648667f7d0af.translatedText: What is worrying is that more than 10% of overseas Chinese have very poor foreign language proficiency. This proportion has increased by 6.1% compared to last year, while less than 30% of the surveyed netizens who can master foreign languages ​​​​overseas have dropped by 3.6% from last year.

b37b60b804fc66c141be11f43e8fd7d54fda401c.sourceText: 根据调查显示，不到3成的受访海外网友有回国的计划，较比去年大幅度下降了31.3%。而持观望态度，不能确定回国计划的海外华人大幅度上升至47.3%，较比去年增加了21.7%.。
b37b60b804fc66c141be11f43e8fd7d54fda401c.translatedText: According to the survey, less than 30% of the surveyed overseas netizens have plans to return to China, which is a significant decrease of 31.3% from last year. The number of overseas Chinese who hold a wait-and-see attitude and are unsure about their plans to return home increased sharply to 47.3%, an increase of 21.7% from last year.

1afbe8ec14c98bc9c4a9e0302633a2581f0171aa.sourceText: 近期，国内富豪大批移民或有意向移民海外的新闻报道日趋增多，再加上越来越多国内负面的社会新闻屡屡被曝光，一些中国社会的阴暗面报道相信一定程度上影响了海外华人的回国热情。
1afbe8ec14c98bc9c4a9e0302633a2581f0171aa.translatedText: Recently, there have been an increasing number of news reports about a large number of domestic wealthy people immigrating or intending to immigrate overseas. In addition, more and more negative domestic social news have been repeatedly exposed. Some reports on the dark side of Chinese society are believed to have affected the enthusiasm of overseas Chinese to return to the country to a certain extent.

b3e33010c92340ac138669ac64fbfa02bae6acc6.sourceText: 面对”海归”，大部分华人都很忌惮国内日益恶化的自然环境和饮食安全，并对国内的不良社会风气非常排斥。而国内不完善的社保体系也令很多海外华人望而却步。
b3e33010c92340ac138669ac64fbfa02bae6acc6.translatedText: Faced with "returnees", most Chinese are wary of the country's deteriorating natural environment and food safety, and are very repulsive to the country's bad social customs. The imperfect social security system in China also discourages many overseas Chinese.

f712397b1bc6142ba82e2444d116b579a0c11730.sourceText: 随着李连杰，巩俐等名人加入外国籍的新闻日益增多，越来越多的海外华人也开始考虑这个问题。近五成的海外华人受访者肯定的认为，如果将来有条件，机会允许的话，自己会选择加入外国国籍。这一比例比去年增加了6.5%。只有21.2%的受访者表示肯定不加入外国籍，这一比例较去年下降了3.5%。可见，外国国籍的诱惑正在显著增强。
f712397b1bc6142ba82e2444d116b579a0c11730.translatedText: With the increasing news of celebrities such as Jet Li and Gong Li becoming foreign nationalities, more and more overseas Chinese are beginning to consider this issue. Nearly 50% of overseas Chinese respondents definitely believe that if conditions and opportunities allow in the future, they will choose to become a foreign national. This proportion increased by 6.5% from last year. Only 21.2% of the respondents said they would definitely not become a foreign national, a decrease of 3.5% from last year. It can be seen that the temptation of foreign nationality is significantly increasing.

bfd6e77dd19b1ea1010bedfff4760a636c4693ad.sourceText: 而对于大部分海外华人受访者来说，最大的入籍原因就是为了出入国境自由方便，其次就是认为入外国籍可以享受到更好的福利。还有近一成的受访海外华人是因为意识形态的原因，打算加入外国国籍。
bfd6e77dd19b1ea1010bedfff4760a636c4693ad.translatedText: For most overseas Chinese interviewees, the biggest reason for naturalization is for the freedom and convenience of entering and exiting the country. The second reason is that they can enjoy better benefits by becoming a foreign national. Nearly 10% of the overseas Chinese surveyed plan to become foreign nationals due to ideological reasons.

63db4772e558050902027c7e3a6299de34b05f7a.sourceText: 海外华人的刑事案件每年其实也在不断发生，人身安全自然成为最受关注的话题之一。不过，值得乐观的是，近94%接受调查的海外华人网民认为自己居住地或国家的治安水平安全。绝大部分海外华人对所在国的治安感到满意。
63db4772e558050902027c7e3a6299de34b05f7a.translatedText: Criminal cases involving overseas Chinese continue to occur every year, and personal safety has naturally become one of the topics of greatest concern. However, what is cause for optimism is that nearly 94% of overseas Chinese netizens surveyed believe that the security level of their place of residence or country is safe. The vast majority of overseas Chinese are satisfied with the security of their host country.

43358d8f267202c513f388884b2088c4cb267ab7.sourceText: 近期，国内”小悦悦””彭宇案”等社会热点新闻也同样牵动着海外华人的心，有35.4%的受访海外华人表示，如果他们在国内遇到老人摔倒的情况，不会出手相救。这一比例，跟表态”一定会救”的海外华人网友比例大致相当。而对于”小悦悦”被反复碾压18名路人见死不救的情况，绝大多数海外华人网友在他们当地国家显有耳闻。
43358d8f267202c513f388884b2088c4cb267ab7.translatedText: Recently, domestic hot social news such as the "Little Yueyue" and "Peng Yu cases" have also affected the hearts of overseas Chinese. 35.4% of the overseas Chinese surveyed said that if they encountered an elderly person falling in China, they would not come to rescue him. This proportion is roughly the same as the proportion of overseas Chinese netizens who said they would "definitely save them." As for the situation where "Little Yueyue" was repeatedly run over and 18 passers-by refused to save her, the vast majority of overseas Chinese netizens have heard about it in their local countries.

260422d67da6054f35977878250286bb1c7f70d1.sourceText: 其他调查结果如下所示

3c35fb31239b1e0ec5b9622b030719781ca956f8.sourceText: 根据调查显示，在海外生活中，自称没有遇到过歧视，感觉当地国家人很友善的网友比例增加了6.5%，达到35.1%。
3c35fb31239b1e0ec5b9622b030719781ca956f8.translatedText: According to the survey, the proportion of netizens who claimed to have never encountered discrimination while living overseas and who felt that the local people were friendly increased by 6.5% to 35.1%.

3ca5c0aee01b68ad6d4375009deae1609f55a9e5.sourceText: 受访的海外华人网友中，仅有4.2%对自己的海外生活不满意，这一比例较比去年下降了2%。对海外生活状态表示无奈，感觉不尽如人意比例也较比去年下降了3.4%。可见，越来越多的海外华人对海外生活现状感到满意。
3ca5c0aee01b68ad6d4375009deae1609f55a9e5.translatedText: Only 4.2% of the overseas Chinese netizens surveyed were dissatisfied with their overseas life, a 2% decrease from last year. The proportion of those who expressed helplessness and felt unsatisfactory about their living conditions overseas also dropped by 3.4% compared to last year. It can be seen that more and more overseas Chinese are satisfied with the current situation of life overseas.

ae64c11ee2f27c3535fa35a4fdb198d9f02521b7.translatedText: The Asian population in the United States surged by 46% in 10 years

bcfee5b6acf2aab2466788b5b9749449643f8935.sourceText: 美国亚裔人口猛增 10年46% 上周三由美国亚裔相关组织联合公布的一份报告显示，亚裔人口在2000年至20…
bcfee5b6acf2aab2466788b5b9749449643f8935.translatedText: The Asian population in the United States surged by 46% in 10 years. A report jointly released by Asian-American related organizations last Wednesday showed that the Asian population increased from 2000 to 2020...

45e814f1bc316d9dfa8e068671a46eb9e17e8ff2.sourceText: 美国亚裔人口猛增 10年46% 上周三由美国亚裔相关组织联合公布的一份报告显示，亚裔人口在2000年至2010年的10年间迅速增长，增幅达46%。亚裔人口增加的地区不仅限于加州和纽约州等沿海地区，在美国西南部的内华达州增长过倍，在亚利桑那州增长95％。德州的亚裔人口增长了72%， 总数超过110万人，比夏威夷州的亚裔人口还多。 几项因素造成美国部份社区亚裔人口的迅速增长﹕第一是到当地工作的移民，第二是寻求与在美家庭成员团聚的新移民，第三是几十年前父辈移民来此的后代。 加州、纽约州和夏威夷州仍是亚裔聚集的重地，这些地区的许多亚裔美国人参与地方事务，便于亚裔融入社会。以前不常见到亚裔美国人的社区，现在将发现亚裔美国人不是只居住在洛杉矶或纽约唐人街的外国人，而是就居住在附近。 以下是亚裔美国人人数排名前三名的州﹕加利福尼亚州：560万；纽约：150万；德州：110万。 从2000年至2010年亚裔美国人口增长比例前三名的州：内华达州：116％，至24万2,916；亚利桑那州：95％，至23万907；北卡罗莱纳州85％，至25万2,585。
45e814f1bc316d9dfa8e068671a46eb9e17e8ff2.translatedText: The Asian population in the United States surged by 46% in 10 years. A report jointly released by Asian-American organizations last Wednesday showed that the Asian population grew rapidly in the 10 years from 2000 to 2010, with an increase of 46%. The increase in the Asian population is not limited to coastal areas such as California and New York. It has more than doubled in Nevada in the southwestern United States and increased by 95% in Arizona. The Asian population in Texas has grown by 72%, totaling more than 1.1 million people, which is larger than the Asian population in Hawaii. Several factors have contributed to the rapid growth of the Asian population in some communities in the United States: first, immigrants coming to work there, second, new immigrants seeking to reunite with family members in the United States, and third, descendants of their parents who immigrated here decades ago. California, New York and Hawaii are still areas where Asians gather. Many Asian Americans in these areas participate in local affairs, making it easier for Asians to integrate into society. Neighborhoods where it was not common to see Asian Americans before will now find Asian Americans not just foreigners living in Los Angeles or New York's Chinatown, but living nearby. Here are the top three states with the largest number of Asian Americans: California: 5.6 million; New York: 1.5 million; Texas: 1.1 million. The top three states with the highest Asian American population growth from 2000 to 2010: Nevada: 116% to 242,916; Arizona: 95% to 230,907; North Carolina: 85% to 252,585.

5df856a4b6026115ff7ded3e10fef33e9d2b70cd.sourceText: 侨务委员会 新闻稿 侨务委员会为协助侨胞学习制作西式糕点，并经营相关事业，于2012年4月16日至27日开办「2012年西式糕点制作班」，由台中弘光科技大学承办，本研习班规划在国际比赛获奖 无数的赖晓梅、文世成、陈清海及陈抚洸等业学界名师，教授如黑森林慕斯蛋糕、法式马卡龙、巧克力布朗尼、提拉米苏、水果鲜奶酪及健康低脂起司蛋糕 等西式糕点亦加入菠萝与红豆等台式四大天王面包制作，另并安排观摩相关知名业者及进行经营经验分享交流等。 研习课程之教材、师资、场地及材料等学杂费用由侨务委员会负担，学员自付由侨居地往返之交通费用、研习期间之膳宿费，有意报名者请于2012年3月21日前径洽 橙县华侨文教服务中心714-754-999谢小姐。
5df856a4b6026115ff7ded3e10fef33e9d2b70cd.translatedText: Overseas Chinese Affairs Council Press Release In order to help overseas Chinese learn to make Western-style pastries and run related businesses, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council launched the "2012 Western-style Pastry Making Class" from April 16 to 27, 2012. It was hosted by Taichung Hong Kong University of Science and Technology. This workshop was planned to win an award in an international competition. Numerous famous teachers from the industry and academia, such as Lai Xiaomei, Wen Shicheng, Chen Qinghai and Chen Fuyu, teach Western pastries such as Black Forest mousse cake, French macarons, chocolate brownie, tiramisu, fruit fresh cheese and healthy low-fat cheese cake. They also add pineapple and red bean and other Taiwanese Four Heavenly Kings breads to make. In addition, we will arrange visits to relevant well-known industries and share business experience. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Council will bear the tuition and fees for the study courses, including teaching materials, teachers, venues, and materials. Students will have to pay for their own transportation costs to and from their place of residence, as well as board and lodging expenses during the study period. Those who are interested in registering please contact Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center at 714-754-999, Ms. Xie, before March 21, 2012.

eb591133cff0d798759760f672c8291d0e3defc9.sourceText: 美国历史上首位华裔女众议员赵美心于10月18日在南加州华人聚居的圣盖博市举办晚宴，宣布将于明年参加连任竞选、期盼获得华裔社区的大力支持、可以成功换区连任加州27选区的国会众议员。250位华裔民选官员、社区领袖参加了当晚的活动，他们表示将力挺赵美心连任，确保华裔在美国国会的代表。加州众议员伍国庆主持了当晚的活动。
eb591133cff0d798759760f672c8291d0e3defc9.translatedText: Meixin Zhao, the first Chinese-American female congresswoman in the history of the United States, held a dinner in San Gabriel, a city where Chinese people live in Southern California, on October 18th. She announced that she will run for re-election next year. She hopes to gain strong support from the Chinese-American community and can successfully change districts and be re-elected as a member of Congress in California's 27th district. 250 Chinese-American elected officials and community leaders attended the event that night. They expressed their support for Zhao Meixin's re-election and ensured the representation of Chinese-Americans in the U.S. Congress. California Representative Joseph Ng hosted the evening's event.
