93e5ce2a6b8f2e2fe8ba7ee17e6a9ee8bebabf4d.sourceText: 10月18日上午11时，美国新媒体就亚利桑那国会议员选取的新地图在凤凰城第七街SEIU大楼举行了少数族裔媒体新闻发布会。有近二十家少数族裔媒体， 亚省时报作为唯一一家中文媒体被邀请参加。 在新闻发布会上亚利桑那选区划分委员会（AIRC）副主席乔斯（Jose Herrera）首先发言，他介绍了这次选区的划分情况，根据2010年人口普查的结果，国会选举亚利桑那分为9个选区，同时 也把划分选区的程序都详细介绍，希望在会议上获得更多的建议。 亚利桑那宣传网的执行总监琳达（Linda Brown）说表示希望通过媒体的力量让最多的不同族裔的人到听证会上，保障最多人的利益。 奥斯卡（Oscar Tillman）玛丽库帕有色人种全国委员会主席，讲述了少数族裔应该利用好这次选区划分的机会，这将直接影响到未来10年选民的利益。 第一个西班牙裔的民主党领袖，约翰（John A. Loredo）以及印第安人里奥纳德（Leonard Gorman）都从自身的感受来谈他们对新地图的看法。 华裔作为移民增长较快的一支族裔，也很关心这次选取划分，因为1070移民法案的发展，城市法令的建设，都将于这次地图划分有密切关系，华裔希望能够在全州范围内兼顾到 少数族裔的比例，公平划分选区。 也希望划分委员会能提供沟通平台，让更多华裔参与意见的反馈。 第二轮的公众听证会正在进行中，华裔朋友可以打电话或者到网络参与讨论，保障华裔的利益。 参与讨论方式：（602）542-5236 或者登陆 http://azredistricting.org/public-input.asp 。
93e5ce2a6b8f2e2fe8ba7ee17e6a9ee8bebabf4d.translatedText: At 11 a.m. on October 18, American New Media held a press conference for minority media on the new map selected by Arizona congressmen at the SEIU building on Seventh Street in Phoenix. There are nearly twenty ethnic media outlets, and the Alberta Times was the only Chinese-language media invited to participate. At the press conference, Jose Herrera, Vice Chairman of the Arizona District Drawing Commission (AIRC), spoke first. He introduced the division of districts. According to the results of the 2010 census, Arizona was divided into nine districts for congressional elections. He also introduced the procedures for dividing districts in detail, hoping to get more suggestions at the meeting. Linda Brown, executive director of the Arizona Advocacy Network, said she hopes to use the power of the media to bring the most people of different ethnic groups to the hearing to protect the interests of the most people. Oscar Tillman, chairman of the National Committee of Colored People of Mary Cooper, said that minorities should take advantage of this gerrymandering opportunity, which will directly affect the interests of voters in the next 10 years. John A. Loredo, the first Hispanic Democratic leader, and Leonard Gorman, an Indian, both expressed their views on the new map from their own experiences. As an ethnic group with rapid immigration growth, Chinese Americans are also very concerned about this selection and demarcation, because the development of the 1070 Immigration Act and the construction of city ordinances will be closely related to this map demarcation. Chinese Americans hope that the proportion of ethnic minorities can be taken into account across the state and the electoral districts can be divided fairly. We also hope that the demarcation committee can provide a communication platform to allow more Chinese Americans to participate in providing feedback. The second round of public hearings is underway. Chinese friends can call or go online to participate in discussions to protect the interests of Chinese Americans. To participate in the discussion: (602) 542-5236 or http://azredistricting.org/public-input.asp.

f24a6a84c53857e8b87c0c80e2fe015caebe29d7.sourceText: 今年美国投资移民申请量增多 将达4000个以上 2010年全年美国投资移民EB－5项目的I－526申请量为1955个，今年前3个季度申请案件已达2608个，接近去年的1．5倍，预计今年全年申请量将达4000个以上。 2010年全年美国投资移民EB－5项目的I－526申请量为1955个，今年前3个季度申请案件已达2608个，接近去年的1．5倍，预计今年全年申请量将达4000个以上，按照一个家庭3个家庭成员算，即有1．2万个申请人，已经超出每年EB－5美国投资移民签证1万个的配额。移民专家表示，以目前不断累积的申请来看，移民局将有可能对现行政策做出调整，以保证审批效率。 近期，美国移民局给美国各区域中心召开会议决定在EB－5的优先快速审理服务未实施期间(称为过渡期间)，美国移民局将尝试使用各种新的方法来加快EB5－案件的处理速度；美国移民局将继续培训更多的移民申请审理员，参与I－526批准的审理工作；对I－526的批准审理周期进行相应的调整和改革；美国移民局在对新项目审理的过程中，增加商业分析环节。 现有投资移民法案将于2012年9月30日正式到期。目前，美国移民局通常需要6个月的时间受理申请，按此时间预估，申请人必须在2012年3月1日之前全部完成递件工作。眼下在不少国家和地区提高移民门槛、投资额上涨的同时，美元的贬值使得移民美国相对更便宜。 目前美国经济发展减缓，为复苏经济，增加就业率，美国政府将宣布一系列核心思想为”平衡”的新政，这对美国投资移民申请者来说是有利的消息。
f24a6a84c53857e8b87c0c80e2fe015caebe29d7.translatedText: The number of U.S. investment immigration applications will increase this year and will reach more than 4,000. In 2010, the number of I-526 applications for the U.S. investment immigration EB-5 project was 1,955. In the first three quarters of this year, the number of applications has reached 2,608, nearly 1.5 times that of last year. It is expected that the number of applications for the entire year this year will reach more than 4,000. In 2010, the number of I-526 applications for the U.S. investment immigration EB-5 project was 1,955. In the first three quarters of this year, the number of applications has reached 2,608, nearly 1.5 times that of last year. It is expected that the number of applications this year will reach more than 4,000. Based on three family members in a family, there are 12,000 applicants, which has exceeded the annual EB-5 U.S. investment immigration visa quota of 10,000. Immigration experts said that judging from the current accumulation of applications, the Immigration Bureau will likely make adjustments to current policies to ensure efficiency in review and approval. Recently, the USCIS held a meeting for regional centers in the United States and decided that during the period when the EB-5 priority expedited processing service is not implemented (called the transition period), the USCIS will try to use various new methods to speed up the processing of EB5-cases; the USCIS will continue to train more immigration application reviewers to participate in the I-526 approval review; make corresponding adjustments and reforms to the I-526 approval review cycle; the USCIS will add a business analysis link in the process of reviewing new projects. The existing investment immigration bill will officially expire on September 30, 2012. Currently, the US Immigration Service usually takes 6 months to process an application. Based on this estimated time, applicants must complete all submissions before March 1, 2012. At present, while many countries and regions are raising immigration thresholds and increasing investment amounts, the depreciation of the US dollar has made it relatively cheaper to immigrate to the United States. The U.S. economy is currently slowing down. In order to revive the economy and increase employment, the U.S. government will announce a series of new policies with the core idea of ​​"balance", which is good news for U.S. investment immigration applicants.

15bf73ed3a52f5631ab748f1f0f651ec685b32ce.sourceText: 就地取材 太阳城使用太阳能 一个贸易集团代表发出调查报告，亚利桑那州有超过4700从事太​​阳能有关工作，也就是说，亚省太阳能使用率，仅次于加州和科罗拉多州，位于全国前茅。 本周出炉的太阳能基金会的报告指出，4786人中有36%从事太阳能安装，27%在制作业，12%在研究和开发。这项调查是在康奈尔大学和LMI咨询公司帮助下完成。 为此，布鲁尔州长说，亚利桑那州日照充足，凤凰城素有太阳城美称。丰富的可再生能源，低税收和训练有素的员工队伍就造了这行业在本州的高速发展。州长说，三个大型的可再生资源专案正在亚利桑那州建设中，为本州带来数百个工作岗位。
15bf73ed3a52f5631ab748f1f0f651ec685b32ce.translatedText: Local materials Solar City uses solar energy A trade group representative issued a survey report that more than 4,700 people are engaged in solar energy-related jobs in Arizona. In other words, the solar energy utilization rate in Arizona is second only to California and Colorado, ranking first in the country. A report from the Solar Energy Foundation, released this week, found that 36% of the 4,786 people working in solar installations, 27% in manufacturing and 12% in research and development. The survey was conducted with help from Cornell University and LMI Consulting. For this reason, Governor Brewer said that Arizona has abundant sunshine and Phoenix is ​​known as the Sun City. Abundant renewable energy, low taxes and a well-trained workforce have contributed to the rapid growth of this industry in the state. The governor said three large renewable energy projects are under construction in Arizona, bringing hundreds of jobs to the state.

941d872032d5dce6a7791eb75f0fd8d30504a0f0.sourceText: 2012第二届“赢在21世纪”北美高层次人才创业大赛－凤凰城推介会(更新) 内容 ：介绍２０１２第二届赢在２１世纪北美高层次人才创业大赛，包括其目的，宗旨，日程安排，去年首届大赛情况，成功项目和团队，申请材料的准备及注意事项。并进行现场问题解答。最后将有现场抽奖活动。 时间： 2011年10月23日 （星期天）下午2时至4时 地点 ：ASU Memory Union 220 主办： 美中高层次人才交流协会( http://www.ucahp.org) 清华企业家协会天使基金( http://www.teec-angel.com ) 协办： ASU学生学者联谊会 亚利桑那清华校友会 华美半导体协会凤凰城分会 旅美科学家工程师专业人士协会凤凰城分会 主讲人： 于江涛 （浙江清华长三角研究院硅谷创新创业基地主任） 胡海涛（创业大赛组织工作负责人之一） 联系人： 姚小寅，(480)471-8628, ucahp.phoenix@gmail.com 由于此次推介会在凤凰城地区引起了很高的期望，美中高层次人才交流协会(UCAHP)决定增派于江涛博士主讲这次推介会。以下是于江涛博士的简介。 于江涛，现任浙江清华长三角研究院硅谷创新创业基地主任。于博士于2010年3月在美国硅谷创立了Golden Bridge Consulting公司，任总裁，作为浙江清华长三角研究院硅谷创新创业基地在北美的运作载体；于2011年8月创立浙江海合创业投资管理有限公司，任董事总经理，专注于早期项目的孵化和投资。于江涛毕业于清华大学生物系，获学士（1997）和硕士（1999）学位；毕业于美国康奈尔大学分子生物遗传系，获博士（2005）学位。于博士曾任美国英特尔公司数字健康部、英特尔投资、英特尔未来科技研究室资深科学家，专业领域主要集中于生物科技与其他行业的交叉领域，例如生物芯片、生物半导体、生物能源等等，在高科技领域拥有多年的研发、管理和投资的经验。于江涛博士是美中高层次人才交流协会的现任理事，同时也是该协会的创会领导人之一。 创业大赛简介 ： 北美高层次人才创业大赛是海外华人最高层次创业大赛，技术、人才、市场、资本对接的峰会。由美国联邦注册之非营利机构、美中高层次人才交流协会（ www.ucahp.org, UCAHP），清华企业家协会天使基金（TEEC Angel Fund, www.teec-angel.com）主办，是海外第一个华人系列创业大赛， 第一个针对中国机会、拓展中国市场的创业投资和园区对接论坛。大赛的目的是建立一个平台，以此帮助北美的创业团队和国内的投资及各地创业园联系起来，获得园区支持，得到风险投资，开拓中国市场。本着公平、保密的原则，所有项目均按领域有专门小组接受、保存和评审。评审原则完全按商业原则，从项目本身的团队、市场、可行性、可扩展性、产品化和退出机制等诸方面，衡量、评估。60个优秀团队，优先与中国园区的负责人在美进行一对一对接。决赛获胜项目将有机会获得投资人的总数100万美金以上的投资。复赛10个获胜团队，将有机会与成功企业家、CEO、VC合伙人进行面对面的交流。第一届北美创业大赛已有40 项目在苏州、张江、宜兴、杭州、南京等地落户，找到投资。
941d872032d5dce6a7791eb75f0fd8d30504a0f0.translatedText: 2012 Second "Win in the 21st Century" North American High-level Talent Entrepreneurship Competition - Phoenix Promotion Conference (Updated) Content: Introducing the 2012 Second "Win in the 21st Century" North American High-Level Talent Entrepreneurship Competition, including its purpose, purpose, schedule, last year's first competition situation, successful projects and teams, preparation of application materials and precautions. and answer questions on-site. There will be a live raffle at the end. Time: October 23, 2011 (Sunday) 2:00 pm to 4:00 pm Venue: ASU Memory Union 220 Sponsor: U.S.-China High-Level Talent Exchange Association (http://www.ucahp.org) Tsinghua Entrepreneur Association Angel Fund (http://www.teec-angel.com) Co-organizer: ASU Student and Scholar Association Arizona Tsinghua Alumni Association Phoenix Chapter of China-American Semiconductor Association Phoenix Chapter of the Association of American Scientists and Engineers Professionals Speakers: Yu Jiangtao (Director of the Silicon Valley Innovation and Entrepreneurship Base of the Yangtze River Delta Research Institute of Tsinghua University in Zhejiang) Hu Haitao (one of the organizers of the Entrepreneurship Competition) Contact person: Yao Xiaoyin, (480) 471-8628, ucahp.phoenix@gmail.com Since this promotion conference has aroused high expectations in the Phoenix area, the U.S.-China Association for Exchange of High-Level Talents (UCAHP) decided to send Dr. Yu Jiangtao to speak at this promotion conference. The following is the introduction of Dr. Yu Jiangtao. Yu Jiangtao is currently the director of the Silicon Valley Innovation and Entrepreneurship Base of the Yangtze River Delta Research Institute of Tsinghua University in Zhejiang. Dr. Yu founded Golden Bridge Consulting in March 2010 in Silicon Valley, USA, and served as president. It serves as the operational carrier of Zhejiang Tsinghua Yangtze River Delta Research Institute's Silicon Valley Innovation and Entrepreneurship Base in North America. In August 2011, he founded Zhejiang Haihe Venture Investment Management Co., Ltd. and served as managing director, focusing on the incubation and investment of early-stage projects. Yu Jiangtao graduated from the Department of Biology of Tsinghua University with a bachelor's degree (1997) and a master's degree (1999); he graduated from the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics of Cornell University in the United States and received a doctorate (2005). Dr. Yu has served as a senior scientist in the Digital Health Department, Intel Capital, and Intel Future Technology Laboratory of Intel Corporation in the United States. His professional fields are mainly focused on the intersection of biotechnology and other industries, such as biochips, biosemiconductors, bioenergy, etc. He has many years of experience in R&D, management, and investment in high-tech fields. Dr. Yu Jiangtao is the current director of the US-China High-level Talent Exchange Association and one of the founding leaders of the association. Introduction to the Entrepreneurship Competition: The North American High-Level Talent Entrepreneurship Competition is the highest-level entrepreneurial competition for overseas Chinese and a summit for the docking of technology, talent, market, and capital. Hosted by the U.S. federally registered non-profit organization, the U.S.-China High-Level Talent Exchange Association (www.ucahp.org, UCAHP), and the Tsinghua Entrepreneurs Association Angel Fund (TEEC Angel Fund, www.teec-angel.com), it is the first overseas Chinese series entrepreneurship competition and the first venture capital and park docking forum targeting Chinese opportunities and expanding the Chinese market. The purpose of the competition is to establish a platform to help North American entrepreneurial teams connect with domestic investment and entrepreneurial parks in various places, obtain support from the parks, obtain venture capital, and explore the Chinese market. Based on the principles of fairness and confidentiality, all projects are accepted, saved and reviewed by specialized teams in each field. The review principle is entirely based on business principles, measuring and evaluating the project itself from various aspects such as team, market, feasibility, scalability, productization and exit mechanism. 60 outstanding teams are given priority to have one-on-one docking with the heads of Chinese parks in the United States. The winning project in the finals will have the opportunity to receive a total investment of more than US$1 million from investors. The 10 winning teams in the semi-finals will have the opportunity to have face-to-face communication with successful entrepreneurs, CEOs, and VC partners. The first North American Entrepreneurship Competition has already seen 40 projects settle in Suzhou, Zhangjiang, Yixing, Hangzhou, Nanjing and other places and have found investment.

6fe6502baedc1fb0aae35a58af7b05d76f0acb31.sourceText: 网上购物、付帐小心遇「骇」 维护网上购物和付帐安全的技术，正面临骇客、犯罪帮派和情报机构日益严峻的挑战，威胁到全球每年总额达6800亿元的电子商务市场。 安全专家说，网路浏览器上的锁头符号，是标志网路连接安全无虞的安全套接层(Secure Sockets Layer，SSL)，但消费者可能很快失去对SSL的信任，意味着他们可能不再对上网购物与付帐有信心。 SSL是电子商务的支柱，在用户上网购物和付帐时，可保证他们的登录资讯与密码、信用卡和银行帐户等资料的安全。 SSL依靠安全网站获颁的特殊电子许可，但每个网路浏览器是以不同的方式，认证特殊电子许可的有效性。思科公司(Cisco)的安全专家玛丽．兰德斯曼说﹕”普通用户几乎无法验证伺服器的许可是否真正有效，及该网址是否有效。” 全球有数千家公司颁发SSL许可，今年初，一名支持伊朗的骇客至少闯入两家安全公司的电脑系统。 骇客控制了公司的电脑系统后，给数十个网址发出假许可，其中包括Google、Yahoo、AOL、脸书、Skype等公司，和中央情报局(CIA)、英国情报机构M16，和以色列情报局Mossad等情报部门。 这起骇客攻击上月曝光，导致假冒许可被吊销。但没被发现前，伪造的网路安全许可证可能已被用来模仿真正的网站，让电脑系统显得仍安全无虞，使骇客可窃取遭到入侵的电脑系统的通讯资料和登录资讯 与 密码。
6fe6502baedc1fb0aae35a58af7b05d76f0acb31.translatedText: Beware of "hacking" when shopping and paying online. The technology that maintains the security of online shopping and payment is facing increasingly severe challenges from hackers, criminal gangs and intelligence agencies, threatening the global e-commerce market totaling 680 billion yuan each year. Security experts say that the lock symbol on Internet browsers is a symbol of Secure Sockets Layer (SSL), which is a secure network connection. But consumers may soon lose trust in SSL, which means they may no longer have confidence in shopping and paying bills online. SSL is the backbone of e-commerce, ensuring the security of users' login information and passwords, credit card and bank account information when they shop online and pay bills. SSL relies on a special electronic license issued to a secure website, but each web browser verifies the validity of the special electronic license in a different way. Cisco security expert Mary. "It's almost impossible for an average user to verify that the server's license is actually valid and that the URL is valid," Landesman said. Thousands of companies around the world issue SSL licenses, and earlier this year, an Iranian-backed hacker broke into the computer systems of at least two security companies. After hackers took control of the company's computer system, they issued false permissions to dozens of websites, including Google, Yahoo, AOL, Facebook, Skype and other companies, as well as intelligence agencies such as the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA), the British intelligence agency M16, and the Israeli intelligence agency Mossad. The hack, which came to light last month, resulted in the fake license being revoked. But before being discovered, the fake Internet security license may have been used to imitate the real website, making the computer system appear to be safe, allowing hackers to steal the communication data and login information and passwords of the compromised computer system.

2d96f9ece5adecfb4398cef264ea9f48f9defa79.sourceText: （本报记者甄松伟洛杉矶报导） 庆祝中华民国建国100年，千多侨民与主流政要参加中华民国驻洛杉矶台北经济文化办事处举办的建国百年国庆酒会，是日洛杉矶影城希尔顿酒店宴会大厅佈置得热闹辉煌，大门前伫立着点缀着青天白日旗的”100”大型冰凋，会场内巨幅青天白日旗格外醒目，金色的”100”象徵中华 民国一百岁了。 出席酒会有洛杉矶县政委员安东诺维奇，加州主计长江俊辉，西裔联邦众议员桑切斯（Livda Sanchez)以及驻洛杉矶台北经济文化办事处处长龚中诚，中华民国前行政院院长唐飞等，龚中诚处长致辞表示，中华民国100年来的努力，国父孙中山先生的理念，能透过中华民国来实现。接着，龚中诚处长与嘉宾一起切”100年的青天白日旗”蛋糕。
2d96f9ece5adecfb4398cef264ea9f48f9defa79.translatedText: (reported by our reporter Zhen Songwei in Los Angeles) To celebrate the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Republic of China, more than a thousand expats and mainstream dignitaries attended the Centenary National Day reception hosted by the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office of the Republic of China in Los Angeles. The banquet hall of the Hilton Hotel in Los Angeles Studios was lively and brilliant. In front of the door stood a large "100" ice sculpture decorated with the blue sky and white sun flag. The huge blue sky and white sun flag in the venue was particularly eye-catching. The golden "100" symbolized the 100th anniversary of the Republic of China. Attending the reception were Los Angeles County Supervisor Antonovich, California Comptroller Jiang Junhui, Spanish-American Congressman Livda Sanchez, and Director of the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Los Angeles Gong Zhongcheng, former Executive Yuan President of the Republic of China Tang Fei, etc. Director Gong Zhongcheng said in his speech that the 100 years of efforts of the Republic of China and the ideas of Sun Yat-sen, the founding father, can be realized through the Republic of China. Then, Director Gong Zhongcheng and the guests cut the "100-Year Blue Sky and White Sun Flag" cake.

0d785794420d32b7f9e546517f27df6aeda1a15e.sourceText: 10月8日由加州台湾同乡联谊会主办，传统侨社参加的双十中华民国国庆升旗典礼。典礼在洛杉矶蒙特利公园市巴恩斯公园隆重举行，上午10时10分，全场观众在中华会馆主席陈健邦，前主席伍竞群，副主席马国威等领唱国旗歌声中，青天白日满地红国旗冉冉升起，与美国国庆一同飘扬在南加州上空，跟着，由美国华人飞行协会李立扬，侯敏中，卜君力，应天华等四人驾驶介寿号教练机以分列式飞过巴恩斯公园上空。 人们挥舞着国旗，欢声雷动。
0d785794420d32b7f9e546517f27df6aeda1a15e.translatedText: On October 8th, the Double Ten National Day flag-raising ceremony of the Republic of China was hosted by the California Taiwanese Friendship Association and attended by traditional overseas Chinese communities. The ceremony was grandly held at Barnes Park in Monterey Park, Los Angeles. At 10:10 a.m., the entire audience saw the national flag singing led by Chairman Chen Jianbang of the Chinese Association, former Chairman Wu Jingqun, Vice Chairman Ma Guowei and others. The sky was blue and the ground was red. The national flag slowly rose and flew over Southern California together with the National Day of the United States. Then, four people including Li Liyang, Hou Minzhong, Bu Junli, and Ying Tianhua from the American Chinese Flying Association flew the Jieshou trainer aircraft in a column over Barnes Park. People waved national flags and cheered.

e7d5228cd360a8b152f37ded93c65c9b941b708b.sourceText: 驻洛杉矶台北经济文化办事处处长龚中诚夫妇，联邦众议员赵美心，加州众议员伍国庆等民选官员以及传统侨社代表共同在舞台上切下百年国庆蛋糕。龚中诚在致辞时指出，南加州今年举办的一系列庆祝百年活动，包括升旗典礼，”璀璨一百”演唱会，国庆酒会等都创记录。参加出场表演的有三军旗队，空军子弟学校美加校友联谊会，北一女校友会仪队，中国大专院校联合校友会，台湾大学校友会等。
e7d5228cd360a8b152f37ded93c65c9b941b708b.translatedText: Director of the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Los Angeles Gong Zhongcheng and his wife, federal Congressman Zhao Meixin, California Congressman Wu Guoqing and other elected officials as well as representatives of traditional overseas Chinese communities cut the Centennial National Day cake on the stage. In his speech, Gong Zhongcheng pointed out that a series of centennial celebration events held in Southern California this year, including the flag-raising ceremony, the "Brilliant 100" concert, and the National Day reception, all set records. Participating in the performance were the flag corps of the three armed services, the American and Canadian Alumni Association of Air Force Children's School, the ceremonial parade of Beiyi Female Alumni, the China Joint Alumni Association of Colleges and Universities, the National Taiwan University Alumni Association, etc.

c34ae38a74d36c7c9acef7c07e4cad41eed2bd9b.sourceText: 凤凰城市房地产市场数据分析 这些数据包括了２０１１年前八个月，与２０１０年和前些年相比较。凤凰城市价格比２０１０年下降了２０％，销售下降了２５％。与过去五年相比，下降的更为明显。按照邮政编码来划分，邮编为８５０３２的地区，价格比２００６年下降了５７.７％。邮编为８５０２７的地区下降了６２.９％。凤凰城中部的８５０１７地区，价格降了８１.３％。也就是说２００６年以十万美元买的房子，现在转卖价格为１８７００美元。新房正在兴建的唯一地区是南凤凰岭和Laveen，沿17号州际公路和北101高速路，并沿环路101的西部边缘。即使在这些地区，新屋销售的价格也只相当于上世纪50年代。相比之下，钱德勒，吉尔伯特，等南部新开发区，由于新移民，新工业的发展2011年前八个月房地产市场恢复的相当顺利。更多房地长问题，请咨询Tinna Xie 480-287-0180 goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
c34ae38a74d36c7c9acef7c07e4cad41eed2bd9b.translatedText: >Phoenix City Real Estate Market Data Analysis These data cover the first eight months of 2011, compared with 2010 and previous years. Prices in Phoenix dropped by 20% compared to 2010, and sales dropped by 25%. The decline is more pronounced than in the past five years. Divided by postal code, in the area with postal code 85032, prices dropped by 57.7% compared to 2006. The zip code 85027 saw a 62.9% decrease. In the 85017 area of ​​central Phoenix, prices dropped 81.3%. In other words, a house bought for US$100,000 in 2006 is now resold for US$18,700. The only areas where new homes are being built are in South Phoenix Ridge and Laveen, along Interstate 17 and North Highway 101, and along the western edge of Loop 101. Even in these areas, new home sales are priced as they were in the 1950s. In contrast, the real estate market in Chandler, Gilbert, and other southern new development areas recovered quite smoothly in the first eight months of 2011 due to the development of new immigrants and new industries. For more questions about real estate developers, please contact Tinna Xie 480-287-0180 goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

36f947011ddceaaf0a3022e9e60bdeb93909b4c8.sourceText: 占领华尔街？占领凤凰城! （亚省时报） ”占领华尔街”运动已进入第四个星期，抗议地点也从纽约曼哈顿下城扩散到美国其他城市，如凤凰城。 近日，有人在网上提出”占领凤凰城”，时间是10月15日中午，地点在Cesar Chavez Plaza。 尽管没有直接领导，没有具体消息，大多数人认为，政府和金融部门高层应作出一些具体改变。 抗议团体已经转向，来表达他们对昂贵的医疗保健，失业率上升，企业的贪婪的方面的不满，他们认为政客不能代表宪法。各路人马提出形形色色的诉求，使这项运动越来越含糊。
36f947011ddceaaf0a3022e9e60bdeb93909b4c8.translatedText: Occupy Wall Street? Occupy Phoenix! (Alberta Times) The "Occupy Wall Street" movement has entered its fourth week, and protest locations have spread from Lower Manhattan, New York, to other cities in the United States, such as Phoenix. Recently, someone proposed "Occupy Phoenix" online at noon on October 15th at Cesar Chavez Plaza. Although there is no direct leadership and no concrete news, most people believe that some concrete changes should be made at the top of the government and financial sector. Protest groups have turned to expressing their dissatisfaction with expensive health care, rising unemployment, corporate greed and what they see as politicians failing to represent the Constitution. Various demands have been made, making the movement increasingly ambiguous.

ca0d13dbd3200d8934bb09bcd0065f538526e429.sourceText: 斯格茨岱尔女子起诉Facebook 一名斯格茨岱尔女子对Facebook提出联邦诉讼，声称这个社交媒体违法跟踪用户的网上活动。 莎朗贝蒂和她的律师，前亚利桑那州总检察长格兰伍兹，周五在联邦法院提出诉讼。 贝蒂状告Facebook，在未经原告同意的情况下，出售用户信息给第三方。 此外，状词还说Facebook使用cookies来追踪用户的活动，即使他们已经注销了Facebook网站。 贝蒂的诉讼使她成为全国第5个起诉Facebook的人。 有几个正在寻求集体诉讼的可能。 专家说，贝蒂和其他原告面临一场艰苦的维权，因为法院已经驳回类似窃听侵权的诉讼。 在提起诉讼的案件，原告往往无法证明任何金钱伤害。 ”Facebook已经成为很好抵御诉讼，尤其是跟踪并没有损坏原告，法官可能会问，’为什么我们在这里？’ ”一网民如是说。 Facebook的官员说，他们有固定的cookie，使它们不再跟踪已注销的用户。 贝蒂和伍兹周一并没有对此事发表评论。
ca0d13dbd3200d8934bb09bcd0065f538526e429.translatedText: Scottsdale woman sues Facebook A Scottsdale woman has filed a federal lawsuit against Facebook, claiming the social media company illegally tracks users' online activities. Sharon Beatty and her attorney, former Arizona Attorney General Glen Woods, filed the lawsuit in federal court on Friday. Betty sued Facebook for selling user information to third parties without the plaintiff’s consent. In addition, the complaint says Facebook uses cookies to track users' activities even if they have logged out of the site. Betty's lawsuit makes her the fifth person in the country to sue Facebook. Several are pursuing the possibility of class action lawsuits. Experts say Beatty and other plaintiffs face an uphill battle now that courts have dismissed similar wiretapping tort claims. In cases where lawsuits are filed, plaintiffs often cannot prove any monetary harm. "Facebook has become very well defended against lawsuits, especially since the tracking did not harm the plaintiff, and the judge may ask, 'Why are we here?'" one netizen said. Facebook officials said they have fixed cookies so they no longer track users who have logged out. Beatty and Woods did not comment on Monday.

a6565ee83138fe8b339f985504d3857f0f382a2f.sourceText: 亚利桑那州学校新评估单出炉 最新本州中小学学校评估报告已经出炉，这是自去年立法以来，第一次使用字母A桭表现学校的等级。 新的字母等级制度需要排列”performing”和”excelling”两项标准，用来衡量一所学校的表现。 主要评估依据是学生每年的AIMS成绩，另外还考虑到其他因素，如辍学率，毕业率以及英语学习者的补习率等。 这里是每个字母等级分类：”A”的学校表现出优良的性能水平。 ” B”的学校表现出的性能高于平均水平。 ” C”的学校表现出的性能平均水平。 ” D”类学校表现出的业绩低于平均水平。 ” F”的学校是那些作为一个”D”的学校，排名连续三年。 ” F”的学校放在由亚利桑那州教育部门根据学校改善过程中，使他们能够获得额外的支持和资源。 如需了解你的孩子所在学校的成绩，请登录：http://www.abc15.com/dpp/news/state/new-report-cards-for-arizona-schools-give-letter-grades
a6565ee83138fe8b339f985504d3857f0f382a2f.translatedText: > A new assessment sheet for schools in Arizona has been released. The latest school assessment report for primary and secondary schools in the state has been released. This is the first time since the legislation last year that the letter A 歭 has been used to express the grade of a school. The new letter grade system will align the two criteria of "performing" and "excelling" to measure a school's performance. The main assessment is based on students' annual AIMS scores, and other factors are also taken into consideration, such as dropout rates, graduation rates and remedial rates for English learners. Here is a breakdown of each letter grade: "A" schools demonstrate excellent performance levels. Schools with a "B" demonstrate above-average performance. "C" schools exhibit average performance. "D" schools exhibit below-average performance. "F" schools are those that have been ranked as a "D" school for three consecutive years. "F" schools are placed under the school improvement process by the Arizona Department of Education, allowing them to receive additional support and resources. To find out your child's school's grades, log in to: http://www.abc15.com/dpp/news/state/new-report-cards-for-arizona-schools-give-letter-grades

2a013d062f5af223ca98ac1bc3cf79b20ad6baa1.translatedText: Focus | The U.S. Senate approves the use of Bitcoin to pay taxes in Arizona, what does it mean! According to Finance Magnates, Arizona, USA...

7548fee501c14e182e154901c1a0f8476a52d03a.sourceText: 据Finance Magnates报道，美国亚利桑那州似将成为美国下一个虚拟货币发展基站，目前美国参议院已经通过一项条例允许该州纳税人以比特币方式支付，未来这一数字货币可接受付款的币种范围或将有所扩大。
7548fee501c14e182e154901c1a0f8476a52d03a.translatedText: According to Finance Magnates, Arizona, USA, seems to be the next base station for the development of virtual currencies in the United States. Currently, the U.S. Senate has passed a regulation allowing taxpayers in the state to pay in Bitcoin. In the future, the range of acceptable payment currencies for this digital currency may be expanded.

7b00f43722a46b93183f839b7a50641977be4c81.sourceText: 虽然整个推进过程仍在进行当中，但目前已进入最后的审批过程。据悉，这份新的条例，附在参议院法案1091下，于2018年1月引入法案，1月24日以4：3的投票结果获参议院金融委员会审批通过；之后于2月8日以16：13的投票结果获参议院正式通过，其中有一名委员投弃权，但并无影响结果。
7b00f43722a46b93183f839b7a50641977be4c81.translatedText: Although the entire promotion process is still in progress, it has now entered the final approval process. It is reported that this new regulation is attached to Senate Bill 1091 and was introduced in January 2018. It was approved by the Senate Finance Committee with a vote of 4:3 on January 24. It was then officially passed by the Senate with a vote of 16:13 on February 8. One member abstained, but it did not affect the result.

41629cb42163e63d07fed66b28bcba1a1ecec123.sourceText: 伴随这一条例的通过，料企业以虚拟货币方式支付税款的途径将在2020年前大面积采用。亚利桑那州的税务局届时在收到虚拟货币付款的24小时内负责将这些币与美元价值进行兑换。当然由于虚拟货币价格偏向不稳定，因此政府方面一旦接受虚拟货币，就需要承担价格缩水的风险。
41629cb42163e63d07fed66b28bcba1a1ecec123.translatedText: With the passage of this regulation, it is expected that companies will use virtual currency to pay taxes on a large scale by 2020. The Arizona Department of Revenue will then be responsible for converting the coins to U.S. dollar value within 24 hours of receiving the virtual currency payment. Of course, since the price of virtual currency tends to be unstable, once the government accepts virtual currency, it needs to bear the risk of price shrinkage.

cc41453746698fc5892ab5d317591c6c41fd59d5.sourceText: 对此亚利桑那州共和党代表，同时也是支持这一条例的人士Jeff Weninger认为此举将使得美国在区块链技术革新上有所推进，通过这一措施是向美国，向全世界发出信号，亚利桑那州将是未来区块链和数字货币发展的家园。
cc41453746698fc5892ab5d317591c6c41fd59d5.translatedText: Jeff Weninger, a Republican representative from Arizona and a supporter of this regulation, believes that this move will make the United States advance in blockchain technology innovation. This measure will send a signal to the United States and the world that Arizona will be the home of future blockchain and digital currency development.

744a56713e807c6898495147d69c24c1e68d8a39.sourceText: 当然，除了亚利桑那州，其他国家的一些地方也很早就开始了类似措施，如2015年英国马恩岛就类似的推进了以比特币支付税收的做法。
744a56713e807c6898495147d69c24c1e68d8a39.translatedText: Of course, in addition to Arizona, some places in other countries have also started similar measures very early. For example, in 2015, the Isle of Man in the United Kingdom similarly promoted the practice of paying taxes in Bitcoin.

cc0471ce82bc9d93c9f5c3206336bd7995d537d1.sourceText: 上周美国芝加哥商品期货交易委员会CFTC的主席Christopher Giancarlo也支持虚拟货币市场的发展，并表示年轻的下一代目前是这类资产的主要投资者。而在芝加哥的两大交易所上市的比特币期货交易产品也标志着美国开始将这一产品纳入主流金融市场。
cc0471ce82bc9d93c9f5c3206336bd7995d537d1.translatedText: Last week, Christopher Giancarlo, chairman of the Chicago Commodity Futures Trading Commission CFTC, also supported the development of the virtual currency market and said that the young next generation is currently the main investor in such assets. The listing of Bitcoin futures trading products on Chicago's two major exchanges also marks the beginning of the United States' inclusion of this product into the mainstream financial market.

46bf4257aaef073caba9bc2c2ce84deedd3bfd57.sourceText: 虽然美国的立法者倾向于接受比特币和其他虚拟货币，但中国方面对虚拟货币交易的网站建设的禁令，则表达了相反的态度。
46bf4257aaef073caba9bc2c2ce84deedd3bfd57.translatedText: Although U.S. lawmakers tend to accept Bitcoin and other virtual currencies, China’s ban on the construction of websites for virtual currency transactions expresses the opposite attitude.

c7f208453c7ca714a3c479cf35d051d8e1d73429.sourceText: 上周，印度方面也加强了其在该领域立法的进程。
c7f208453c7ca714a3c479cf35d051d8e1d73429.translatedText: Last week, India also stepped up its legislative process in this field.

ac351352dc79bca2d633c114181930c3afc83e53.sourceText: ( 亚省现代中文学校供稿 ) 2 月 4 日恰逢立春之日，亚省现代中文学校的 部分校长们欢聚一堂，畅叙友情，回顾共同努力的时光。大家对学校将来的发展献计献策，并提出了许多宝贵的建议。
ac351352dc79bca2d633c114181930c3afc83e53.translatedText: (Contributed by the Alberta Modern Chinese School) February 4th coincides with the beginning of spring, and the Alberta Modern Chinese School's Some of the principals gathered together to talk about friendship and review the time of working together. Everyone offered suggestions for the future development of the school and put forward many valuable suggestions.

4bae96b199dcf8f745a0eb55b1b0caf0d2cae601.sourceText: 亚省现代中文学校成立于 1996 年，由当初的 20 几位注册学生发展到今天拥有 500 多位注册学生的学校，并被中国国务院侨务办公室和中国海外交流协会评为海外”华文教育示范学校”。回首 20 多年走过的路，每一步都刻满了众多志愿者们的无私奉献，老师们的辛勤耕耘，以及家长朋友们的鼎立支持，特别是校长们的坚持不懈。学校的今天离不开各位校长的心血，也离不开每一位义工的辛劳。亚省现代中文学校不会忘记他们为学校的发展所付出的艰辛！
4bae96b199dcf8f745a0eb55b1b0caf0d2cae601.translatedText: >Alberta Modern Chinese School was established in 1996 and has grown from a few registered students to more than 500 registered students today. It has been rated as an overseas "Chinese Education Model School" by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council and the China Overseas Exchange Association. Every step of the way we have traveled over the years is engraved with the selfless dedication of many volunteers, the hard work of teachers, and the strong support of parents and friends, especially the perseverance of the principals. The school today cannot be separated from the efforts of the principals and the hard work of every volunteer. Modern Chinese School will not forget the hard work they have put in for the development of the school!

c5fe64beef693b5ab10682005dd87292ed5361ed.sourceText: 亚省现代中文学校不忘初心，与时俱进，求真务实，开拓创新，始终将学生和家长的需求放在首位。考虑到学生们的不同年龄，不同层次，和不同文化背景的因素，学校除继续使用中国暨南大学中文教材和马立平中文教材外，还采用双双中文教材。同时，低年级的班级开展亲子阅读活动，高年级的班级增设中国历史文化课程，使亚省现代中文学校的中文课程设置独树一帜。此次聚会，更加确定了学校将来的发展方向。亚省现代中文学校将继续秉承为社区服务的宗旨，在注重教学质量的同时，将学校办成一个学生和家长喜 爱的大家庭！
c5fe64beef693b5ab10682005dd87292ed5361ed.translatedText: Modern Chinese School in Alberta will not forget its original aspirations, keep pace with the times, be truthful and pragmatic, pioneer and innovative, and always put the needs of students and parents first. Considering the different ages, levels, and cultural backgrounds of the children, the school not only continues to use the Chinese textbooks of Jinan University of China and Ma Liping Chinese textbooks, but also uses both Chinese textbooks. At the same time, the lower grade classes carry out parent-child reading activities, and the upper grade classes add Chinese history textbooks. The Chinese curriculum of Alberta Modern Chinese School is unique. This gathering has further determined the future development direction of the school. While focusing on teaching quality, Alberta Modern Chinese School will continue to uphold the purpose of serving the community and build a school that is loved by students and parents. Dear family!

cf5c043b3919ad6aefd9417c730a14ce53b52f63.sourceText: ASU校长预计明年学费继续攀升 ASU校长迈克尔克劳期望州政府不再裁减下一财政年度的预算，他与他的同仁一起正在努力稳定目前的学费。 亚利桑那州联合立法预算委员会上月公布的一份报告显示，2010年州税的总收入同比超过8.5%，也即是15.3亿美元，迄今为止收集了7960万。 委员会预计，2010-2011财政年度结束比预期有更多收入，盈余达30亿美元。 克劳说，大学已作出改进，已应对本年度9千万美元拨款裁减。 （三所州立大学共被裁减1.98亿美元经费）这些改进包括去年春季解雇190名教员，终止承包私营清洁公司服务。 亚利桑那州学生协会董事会主席丹菲茨吉本说，学生游说团体希望大学从中受益的3亿美元的盈余。 克劳说，大学官员计划，以不增加学费为最终目标，就算增加，也尽量不超过3%。 大学收费增加，最终受害的还是本州学生。 2010棗2011学年，本州学生学费增加了18%，从$5410飙升至$9208。 州政府从2008财政年度开始削减大学经费，当年的学费是$5410。
cf5c043b3919ad6aefd9417c730a14ce53b52f63.translatedText: ASU President expects tuition to continue to climb next year ASU President Michael Crow expects no more state budget cuts next fiscal year, and he, along with his colleagues, is working to stabilize current tuition. A report released last month by the Arizona Joint Legislative Budget Committee showed that total state tax revenue in 2010 exceeded 8.5% year-over-year, or $1.53 billion, with $79.6 million collected so far. The committee expects to end the 2010-2011 fiscal year with more revenue than expected, with a surplus of $3 billion. Crowe said the university has made improvements to cope with this year's $90 million funding cut. (Three state universities have been cut by a combined $198 million.) Those improvements include laying off 190 faculty members last spring and ending contracts with private cleaning companies. Arizona Student Association board president Dan Fitzgibbon said the student lobby group wants the university to benefit from a $300 million surplus. Crowe said university officials plan to have an ultimate goal of not increasing tuition, and even if it does, try to limit it to no more than 3 percent. When college fees increase, in-state students ultimately suffer. Between 2010 and 2011, tuition for in-state students increased by 18%, from $5,410 to $9,208. The state government began cutting college funding in fiscal year 2008, and tuition that year was $5,410.

e59dc6d2547e8ad21338d6cf7bcee350cbca01a8.sourceText: 亚利桑那智能手机新功能2：助你好眠 （亚省时报） 一款改善睡眠品质的新应用程式，使用脑波追踪人们在睡眠不同阶段所花的时间。 这个名为睡眠管理员（Sleep Manager，暂译）的新应用程式与软性感测器头带同步运作，而头带测量浅度睡眠、深度睡眠及快速动眼期（REM）的脑部、眼部活动及其他讯号。 这个应用程式的开发商Zeo表示：”睡的好不好不只是看你睡了多久，而是与睡眠品质有关。” 厂商表示：”一般而言，你要尽可能处于快速动眼及深度睡眠状态。”软性感测器头带测量脑波活动、肌肉张力及眼部活动。专业的睡眠实验室也会测量上述讯号，但这个程式是提供给消费者使用。 这些信号透过蓝芽传输到使用者的iPhone、iPad或Android智慧型手机上，接着上传到Zeo的网站上。 厂商表示，睡眠追踪只是个开始。检测完睡眠品质后，厂商会利用这份资料来指导使用者如何睡眠。 研究显示，当人们在轻度睡眠阶段醒过来，精神会比较好，所以这个应用程式也能够在这个阶段唤醒使用者。
e59dc6d2547e8ad21338d6cf7bcee350cbca01a8.translatedText: > Arizona smartphone new feature 2: Help you sleep well (Alberta Times) A ​​new app to improve sleep quality uses brain waves to track the time people spend in different stages of sleep. The new app, called Sleep Manager, works in sync with a soft sensor headband that measures brain, eye activity and other signals during light, deep and rapid eye movement (REM) sleep. Zeo, the developer of this app, said: "Sleeping well is not just about how long you sleep, but the quality of sleep." The manufacturer said: "Generally speaking, you want to be in rapid eye movement and deep sleep as much as possible." The soft sensor headband measures brain wave activity, muscle tone and eye movement. Professional sleep laboratories also measure the above signals, but this program is available to consumers. These signals are transmitted via Bluetooth to the user's iPhone, iPad or Android smartphone, and then uploaded to Zeo's website. Manufacturers say sleep tracking is just the beginning. After testing sleep quality, manufacturers will use this information to guide users on how to sleep. Research shows that people feel better when they wake up during light sleep, so this app can wake users up during this stage as well.

034372ab3e9bdf5243c36c3d92070768a239b029.sourceText: 广东各界在中山纪念堂纪念辛亥革命100周年 （本报广州特约记者杨绮薇报道）2011年10月8日,广东各界在广州中山纪念堂举行了盛大的纪念辛亥革命100周年大会。中共中央政治局委员、广东省委书记汪洋在会上发表讲话称，行动是最好的纪念，发展是最好的继承。 汪洋在讲话中说，广东是辛亥革命的故乡，是重要的策源地。孙中山和辛亥革命先驱建立的功绩彪炳千秋，牺牲的志士永远值得我们纪念。在辛亥革命100周年之际，回顾历史，缅怀先烈，对激励海内外中华儿女奋发图强，实现中华民族伟大复兴意义重大，影响深远。汪洋说，祖国统一是孙中山的遗愿，是中华民族的根本利益所在，是海内外中华儿女共同心愿。他在讲话中谈到，广东台湾地缘相近，人文相亲。在广州的台湾籍流动人口超过20万，注册的台资企业2万余家，在促进两岸共同发展，和平统一的实践中，广东肩负巨大责任。广东各界要进一步加强海峡两岸交流，扩大粤台各项往来，共同遏制”台独”势力，实现两岸共同繁荣。汪洋还说，辛亥革命的爆发是近代中国的大势所趋，使民主共和理念深入人心，代表了潮流的方向。
034372ab3e9bdf5243c36c3d92070768a239b029.translatedText: All walks of life in Guangdong commemorated the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911 at the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall. (Reported by Yang Qiwei, our special correspondent in Guangzhou) On October 8, 2011, all walks of life in Guangdong held a grand meeting to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911 at the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall in Guangzhou. Wang Yang, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Guangdong Provincial Party Committee, delivered a speech at the meeting, saying that action is the best commemoration and development is the best inheritance. Wang Yang said in his speech that Guangdong is the hometown of the Revolution of 1911 and an important source of inspiration. The achievements of Sun Yat-sen and the pioneers of the Revolution of 1911 will last forever, and the sacrifices of the patriots are always worthy of our remembrance. On the occasion of the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911, reviewing history and remembering the martyrs is of great significance and far-reaching influence in inspiring Chinese people at home and abroad to work hard and realize the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. Wang Yang said that the reunification of the motherland is Sun Yat-sen's last wish, is the fundamental interest of the Chinese nation, and is the common aspiration of the Chinese people at home and abroad. In his speech, he mentioned that Guangdong and Taiwan are geographically close and have close cultural ties. The Taiwanese floating population in Guangzhou exceeds 200,000, and there are more than 20,000 registered Taiwan-funded enterprises. Guangdong shoulders a huge responsibility in promoting the common development and peaceful reunification of both sides of the Taiwan Strait. All walks of life in Guangdong should further strengthen cross-strait exchanges, expand various exchanges between Guangdong and Taiwan, jointly curb the "Taiwan independence" forces, and achieve common prosperity on both sides of the strait. Wang Yang also said that the outbreak of the Revolution of 1911 was the general trend of modern China, which made the concept of democracy and republic deeply rooted in the hearts of the people and represented the direction of the trend.

eedd3ade22b1eb385154b2b31890e9b25601d7ac.sourceText: 美通社亚洲新竹2011年10月13日电 全球领先的显示器与太阳能解决方桉供应商友达光电，今(13日)宣佈该公司为台湾高雄应用大学研发的”阿波罗六号”太阳能车主要赞助企业之一，并提供其所生产的高效率太阳能电池。”阿波罗六号”车体覆盖友达光电所赞助的高效率太阳能电池，能生产超过1200瓦的电力，最高时速每小时可达120公里。这辆全新设计的太阳能车将参加10月16日在澳洲举行的”2011世界太阳能车挑战赛”，与来自全球的39个车队共同于全长3021公里的赛程中竞技。
eedd3ade22b1eb385154b2b31890e9b25601d7ac.translatedText: PR Newswire Asia, Hsinchu, October 13, 2011 AU Optronics, the world's leading supplier of displays and solar solutions, announced today (13th) that the company is one of the main sponsors of the "Apollo 6" solar car developed by Taiwan's Kaohsiung University of Technology and will provide high-efficiency solar cells produced by it. The "Apollo 6" car body is covered with high-efficiency solar cells sponsored by AU Optronics, which can produce more than 1,200 watts of electricity and can reach a top speed of 120 kilometers per hour. This newly designed solar car will participate in the "2011 World Solar Car Challenge" to be held in Australia on October 16, competing with 39 teams from around the world on a 3,021-kilometer race.

f494c6eda9400858b1f40afd46474087e9fb42a3.sourceText: ”友达不但提供创新与高效率的太阳能解决方桉，也持续坚守我们的绿色承诺，”友达光电太阳能事业群副总经理陈建斌表示，”为协助’阿波罗六号’参加世界太阳能车挑战赛，友达赞助由马来西亚 AUO SunPower 生产的高效率背接触式单晶太阳能电池，其转换效率最高达23%，我们预祝’阿波罗六号’能在比赛中获得佳绩。同时，友达也藉此鼓励年轻人创造更多的环保设计与科技，为人类打造绿色生活。”
f494c6eda9400858b1f40afd46474087e9fb42a3.translatedText: "AUO not only provides innovative and high-efficiency solar solutions, but also continues to adhere to our green commitments," said Chen Jianbin, deputy general manager of AUO's solar business group. "To help 'Apollo 6' participate in the World Solar Car Challenge, AUO sponsored AUO SunPower of Malaysia. 生产的高效率背接触式单晶太阳能电池，其转换效率最高达23%，我们预祝’阿波罗六号’能在比赛中获得佳绩。同时，友达也借此鼓励年轻人创造更多的环保设计与科技，为人类打造绿色生活。”

0679d13baa8e904bfacb5f19d265c4a83a855fd0.sourceText: ”阿波罗六”太阳能车全长4.7米、宽1.8米、高1.1米，不含驾驶及蓄电池重量约130多公斤，全车覆盖由友达提供的高效率背接触式单晶太阳能电池，面积为6平方公尺，平均每公里耗电20瓦，平均时速为80公里，最高时速可达120公里。
0679d13baa8e904bfacb5f19d265c4a83a855fd0.translatedText: ”阿波罗The six-inch solar car is 4.7 meters long, 1.8 meters wide and 1.1 meters high. It weighs about 130 kilograms without the driver and battery. The entire car is covered with high-efficiency back-contact monocrystalline solar cells provided by AUO. It has an area of 6 square meters, an average power consumption of 20 watts per kilometer, an average speed of 80 kilometers per hour, and a maximum speed of 120 kilometers per hour.

5c05cb0ffc5352ad78090fe1f5fd43b811baf921.sourceText: 阿波罗太阳能车队是由20名台湾高雄应用科技大学的学生组成，该车队于1998年成立并打造第一座太阳能车，其后参与多项国际太阳能车赛事。2007年阿波罗太阳能车队曾在”世界太阳能车挑战赛”中获得冒险组亚军的佳绩。
5c05cb0ffc5352ad78090fe1f5fd43b811baf921.translatedText: Apollo Solar Team is composed of 20 students from Kaohsiung University of Applied Science and Technology in Taiwan. The team was established in 1998 and built its first solar car. It has since participated in many international solar car competitions. In 2007, the Apollo Solar Team won the second place in the adventure category in the "World Solar Car Challenge".

16fa29d58bb7a7ee4ffa0bd30018f3cb6634ecae.sourceText: 谷歌发大招，对手们应该颤抖吗？
16fa29d58bb7a7ee4ffa0bd30018f3cb6634ecae.translatedText: When Google launches a big move, should opponents tremble?

298ae41448071b41b26c3b594f4b9f3c4ca64fc7.sourceText: 谷歌发大招，对手们应该颤抖吗？ 谷歌无人驾驶项目无论成败，都表明无人驾驶系统商业化提速已经非常明显。做2025…
298ae41448071b41b26c3b594f4b9f3c4ca64fc7.translatedText: Google launches a big move, should opponents tremble? Regardless of the success or failure of Google's self-driving project, it shows that the commercialization of self-driving systems has accelerated significantly. Do 2025...

9d1cad05f01363c367d547da28f4cc7e5b38c3a9.sourceText: 谷歌无人驾驶项目无论成败，都表明无人驾驶系统商业化提速已经非常明显。做2025、甚至2030无人驾驶规划的企业，可以把规划书扔到废纸篓里了。不肯放弃此前生产线投资和技术积累，想榨取有人驾驶技术的最后一点利润，只能败亡。而钉上最后一根钉子的，未必是谷歌，它只是掘墓人而已。
9d1cad05f01363c367d547da28f4cc7e5b38c3a9.translatedText: Regardless of the success or failure of Google’s driverless project, it shows that the commercialization of driverless systems has accelerated significantly. Companies that are planning for autonomous driving in 2025 or even 2030 can throw their plans into the wastebasket. Reluctant to give up previous investment in production lines and technology accumulation, and trying to squeeze out the last bit of profits from manned driving technology, will only fail. And it’s not necessarily Google that drives the final nail in. It’s just the gravedigger.

b03fe19cfed257c6c7cb65bcd0c56feb25da48e2.sourceText: 北京时间2月2日，谷歌发布了2017年Q4财报和全年财报。全年照例是盈利，但Q4财季因”资金回归美国税”录得亏损，虽在情理之中，但在意料之外。也许为了平衡投资者的心态，谷歌透露，将在今年商业化其无人驾驶出租车业务。
b03fe19cfed257c6c7cb65bcd0c56feb25da48e2.translatedText: On February 2, Beijing time, Google released its 2017 Q4 financial report and full-year financial report. As usual, the company was profitable throughout the year, but in the Q4 fiscal quarter, it recorded a loss due to the "tax on funds returning to the United States." Although this is reasonable, it is unexpected. Perhaps in order to balance the mentality of investors, Google revealed that it will commercialize its driverless taxi business this year.

12070d7217a28e4683ed2ddb436b4076701432a6.sourceText: 这不是新消息。2017年晚些时候，谷歌旗下Waymo已经在亚利桑那州凤凰城钱德勒市投入了600辆无人驾驶出租车试运营，这些车辆均为FCA提供的克莱斯勒七座大捷龙改装。
12070d7217a28e4683ed2ddb436b4076701432a6.translatedText: >This is not new news. Later in 2017, Waymo, a subsidiary of Google, put 600 driverless taxis into trial operation in Chandler, Phoenix, Arizona. These vehicles were all modified Chrysler seven-seat Grand Voyager provided by FCA.

4c4a115adcd48b7cd691cb94589583b526ddd603.sourceText: Waymo CEO约翰.克拉夫西克（John Krafcik）虽然称”这是我们发明的最先进的无人驾驶技术”，但此事并未引起舆论圈的注意。进行无人驾驶技术试运营的车企和科技公司，有若干家。虽然Waymo投入的规模稍大，并实现在全美25个城市的路试，但仍被归类为技术测试。谷歌投入无人驾驶技术最早，但试运营并不是最早的，因此被嘲笑”永远在测试”。
4c4a115adcd48b7cd691cb94589583b526ddd603.translatedText: Although Waymo CEO John Krafcik said that "this is the most advanced driverless technology we have ever invented," this matter did not attract the attention of the public opinion circle. There are several car companies and technology companies conducting trial operations of autonomous driving technology. Although Waymo has invested a slightly larger scale and implemented road tests in 25 cities across the United States, it is still classified as a technical test. Google was the first to invest in driverless technology, but it was not the first to conduct trial operations, so it was ridiculed as "always testing."

da08b933d97b04e5f112fc42eb81ac1e24a54110.sourceText: 现在600辆变成数千辆，而且”试运营”字样被去掉，Waymo公关发言人强尼.卢（Johny Luu）将其定义为无人驾驶商业化的开端，并且自豪地称：”我们准备好了。”
da08b933d97b04e5f112fc42eb81ac1e24a54110.translatedText: Now 600 vehicles have become thousands, and the word "trial operation" has been removed. Waymo public relations spokesman Johny Luu defined it as the beginning of driverless commercialization and proudly said: "We are ready."

4123205bbbb090f011394510c03dfc99d0dfd380.sourceText: 这下舆论圈炸裂，谷歌再次抢到发令枪，有可能重塑汽车行业格局。简单说，一个新时代到来了。
4123205bbbb090f011394510c03dfc99d0dfd380.translatedText: Now the public opinion circle exploded, and Google once again grabbed the starting gun, which may reshape the pattern of the automobile industry. Simply put, a new era has arrived.

fa86c0d15f70422047aeca7ea9124f966dcd86a8.sourceText: 我们先假定谷歌已经破关功成，那么的确无可挽回。指望海关、法律和技术壁垒阻挡新技术的骇人步伐，注定自身被吞噬。如果谷歌的无人驾驶技术能够席卷美国，到中国来（无论有什么样的阻碍）也不过是两三年的光景。在”用过都说爽”的大洋彼岸群众呼声之下，任何人为壁垒都必然土崩瓦解。
fa86c0d15f70422047aeca7ea9124f966dcd86a8.translatedText: Let us first assume that Google has successfully broken through, then there is indeed no way to recover. Counting on customs, legal and technical barriers to stop the terrifying pace of new technologies is dooming itself to being swallowed up. If Google's self-driving technology can sweep the United States, it will only take two or three years to reach China (no matter what obstacles there are). Under the voice of the people on the other side of the ocean that "everyone who has used it says it's great", any artificial barriers will inevitably collapse.

99dda00a7d01e1177e8c39508300ca184d93fe49.sourceText: 其他对手们将不可能继续获得慷慨的融资支持。要么依附于谷歌，要么依附于谷歌仅存的对手棗人们仍不相信谷歌一家将垄断未来公路交通。
99dda00a7d01e1177e8c39508300ca184d93fe49.translatedText: Other rivals will no longer be able to receive generous financing support. Either rely on Google, or rely on Google's only remaining rival - people still do not believe that Google alone will monopolize the future of highway transportation.

95cc112755d3a8d026ad6f09cb7af7e4d5bb7d65.sourceText: 这样一来，谷歌会毁了整个汽车行业。无论处于技术弱势的他们顺从皈依，还是起来抵抗，都无济于事。消费者的选择，会将看似强大的企业碾成齑粉。
95cc112755d3a8d026ad6f09cb7af7e4d5bb7d65.translatedText: In this way, Google will destroy the entire automobile industry. No matter they are technically weak and surrender, or they resist, it will be of no use. Consumer choices can crush seemingly strong companies into powder.

1e8ae3ec5f2ced79c27f8b65c398093601f4bd8c.sourceText: 如果超级寡头局面形成，甚至对于给Waymo做配套的FCA，都将面临末日审判。问题在于，一切都已经尘埃落定了吗？
1e8ae3ec5f2ced79c27f8b65c398093601f4bd8c.translatedText: If a super oligopoly situation is formed, even FCA, which supports Waymo, will face doomsday judgment. The question is, has everything been settled?

36f3c4d181220b16b68473f750f6bceb01d0ef14.translatedText: I'm afraid that's not the case.

0beda3009d18bdcccee4bd9bbae67047fd2571a9.translatedText: Google does not rule the world

8487282f92cccb921dd7c42aa5b08c3cee765cb2.sourceText: 首先，Waymo对其技术并不像其宣称的那样有信心。
8487282f92cccb921dd7c42aa5b08c3cee765cb2.translatedText: First of all, Waymo is not as confident in its technology as it claims.

26cf9bda33c791f17f1edc6952e1dc5e897eef91.sourceText: 凤凰城钱德勒市是一个建在沙漠里的城市，面积虽有150平方公里，人口却只有24万。即便在白天，宽阔的马路两侧，行人也很稀少。而且，这个城市几乎没有复杂立交桥等立体交通。不用说，谷歌无人出租车在这里不会遇到像样的挑战。
26cf9bda33c791f17f1edc6952e1dc5e897eef91.translatedText: Phoenix Chandler is a city built in the desert. Although it covers an area of ​​150 square kilometers, it has a population of only 240,000. Even during the day, there are very few pedestrians on both sides of the wide road. Moreover, there are almost no three-dimensional transportation such as complex overpasses in this city. Needless to say, Google’s self-driving taxis won’t face a decent challenge here.

98a0c86658256c4d81d4c0fb6d65f12d892d8d75.sourceText: 谷歌将商业运营的首站放在这里，固然因为亚利桑那州的法律对自动驾驶技术宽松，但更主要的是，在这里投入商业运营，基本上不会出大娄子。对于一个24万人口、几乎人手一辆车的城市，数千辆召之即来的APP网约车，运能似乎有点过剩。
98a0c86658256c4d81d4c0fb6d65f12d892d8d75.translatedText: Google will put its first stop for commercial operations here. Although Arizona’s laws are loose on autonomous driving technology, more importantly, there will basically be no big trouble if it puts into commercial operations here. For a city with a population of 240,000 and almost every person having one car, the transportation capacity seems to be a bit excessive with thousands of APP-based ride-hailing vehicles available on demand.

48e43d2e8bc8172b07888d7c0a4cfd615c551fcf.sourceText: 这样的路况，对中心城市运营有多大参考价值和说服力，恐怕很难讲。
48e43d2e8bc8172b07888d7c0a4cfd615c551fcf.translatedText: It is difficult to say how much reference value and persuasiveness such road conditions have for central city operations.

d2bb0f4e01462c88d655fa3197dd4f9e28a1acb7.sourceText: 其次，平台成本尚未达到要求。
d2bb0f4e01462c88d655fa3197dd4f9e28a1acb7.translatedText: Secondly, the platform cost has not yet reached the requirements.

4ac160dbb994d45bbd14334f34a48fb018dabd60.sourceText: 大捷龙平台本身在美售价约为4万美元，考虑到复杂的搭载设备（特别是价格高昂的64线扫描式激光雷达），中产阶级消费不起，谷歌也不存在透过网约车赚钱的可能，纯属赔本赚吆喝的炫技展示。
4ac160dbb994d45bbd14334f34a48fb018dabd60.translatedText: The Dajielong platform itself sells for about US$40,000 in the United States. Considering the complex equipment (especially the expensive 64-line scanning lidar), the middle class cannot afford it, and there is no possibility for Google to make money through online ride-hailing. It is purely a display of skills to make money at a loss.

5d0ab6c13baf6399ec2d0368f4238673d7373e7c.sourceText: 克拉夫西克称，已经将顶置激光雷达成本降到7000美元。不过，达到固体激光雷达的水平（目前200美元左右），短期内可能性不大。因此，谷歌选择了和其他企业一样的商业化路径，在网约车上落地，而非直接售卖给个人消费者。
5d0ab6c13baf6399ec2d0368f4238673d7373e7c.translatedText: Krafcik said that the cost of overhead lidar has been reduced to US$7,000. However, reaching the level of solid-state lidar (currently around US$200) is unlikely in the short term. Therefore, Google chose the same commercialization path as other companies, landing on online ride-hailing instead of selling directly to individual consumers.

4e2909a4431f7febb150439171d7c8ce77cc6dbe.sourceText: 除了成本原因，网约车企业理论上是一家公司，掌握在谷歌手里。假如售卖给个人，如果产品质量带来的法律风险将很难控制。这也同样印证了无人驾驶技术尚未成熟。
4e2909a4431f7febb150439171d7c8ce77cc6dbe.translatedText: In addition to cost reasons, online ride-hailing companies are theoretically one company and are controlled by Google. If sold to individuals, the legal risks arising from product quality will be difficult to control. This also confirms that driverless technology is not yet mature.

a290bc266a3a271aba066311ffecd9f2bf59a554.sourceText: 再次，谷歌一直走本地AI的技术路线，从未尝试过V2X（车对车信息交换）方案。
a290bc266a3a271aba066311ffecd9f2bf59a554.translatedText: Again, Google has always followed the technical route of local AI and has never tried a V2X (vehicle-to-vehicle information exchange) solution.

426643cfc29927306d724b7be6a085400d5298fe.sourceText: 世界上第一个5G高速商用网络最早在2019年才会投入使用（不是美国），谷歌也不掌握这方面的知识产权。实际上，V2X不是谷歌的长项。后者需要与芯片制造商、通讯运营商、零部件供应商、以及交通管理部门的紧密配合。
426643cfc29927306d724b7be6a085400d5298fe.translatedText: The world's first 5G high-speed commercial network will not be put into use until 2019 at the earliest (not in the United States), and Google does not control the intellectual property rights in this area. In fact, V2X is not Google’s strong point. The latter requires close cooperation with chip manufacturers, communication operators, component suppliers, and traffic management departments.

6278405ea89d95deb523366dd6291d14a3c15785.sourceText: Waymo从未试图建立广泛的技术联盟，搭建V2X。谷歌搭建了远程指挥系统，但需要人工在后台提供技术支援，还需要坐在汽车后座的技术人员现场解决故障和事故等，但和V2X系统风马牛不相及。
6278405ea89d95deb523366dd6291d14a3c15785.translatedText: Waymo has never attempted to establish a broad technical alliance to build V2X. Google has built a remote command system, but it requires manual technical support in the background, and technicians sitting in the back seat of the car to solve faults and accidents on site, but it has nothing to do with the V2X system.

e14ccb70624ded13e6beff1010a302505a2af2f7.sourceText: 谷歌尚无能力宣布V2X方案死刑。在V2X道路上探索的企业仍有时间。时间的多少，仍取决于谷歌已经宣称的胜利有多远。
e14ccb70624ded13e6beff1010a302505a2af2f7.translatedText: Google is not yet capable of declaring the death penalty for the V2X solution. Enterprises exploring the V2X road still have time. The amount of time still depends on how far Google has claimed victory.

9e4be995ea7c76eee937f78b040f0a305771dec7.sourceText: 不过，等待谷歌的商业化项目扑街，是消极而不道德的。谷歌无人驾驶项目无论成败，都表明无人驾驶系统商业化提速已经非常明显。做2025、甚至2030无人驾驶规划的企业，可以把规划书扔到废纸篓里了。不肯放弃此前生产线投资和技术积累，想榨取有人驾驶技术的最后一点利润，只能败亡。而钉上最后一根钉子的，未必是谷歌，它只是掘墓人而已。 （《汽车人》记者/黄耀鹏 ） 【版权声明】 本文系《汽车人》独家原创稿件，版权为《汽车人》所有。如需转载，转载方必须与”汽车人传媒”（邮箱： qcr007@126.com 或电话：010-63135250）联系，获得同意取得转载授权，否则必将追究法律责任 。敬请关注”汽车人传媒”公众号（qcr0505）
9e4be995ea7c76eee937f78b040f0a305771dec7.translatedText: However, waiting for Google's commercialization project to be launched is negative and immoral. Regardless of the success or failure of Google's self-driving project, it shows that the commercialization of self-driving systems has accelerated significantly. Companies that are planning for autonomous driving in 2025 or even 2030 can throw their plans into the wastebasket. Reluctant to give up previous investment in production lines and technology accumulation, and trying to squeeze out the last bit of profits from manned driving technology, will only fail. And it’s not necessarily Google that drives the final nail in. It’s just the gravedigger.
