1f742b7e132f26af8344da803f4a47324b16162c.sourceText: 9月27日晚,凤凰城华人耆英会和大华府地区华美老人协会共赴加拿大和美东旅游的行程结束,就要回到首都华盛顿.温馨的秋风迎面扑来,华美老年协会的朋友们为 迎接我们的回访，就像为家里人出外旅行归来一样, 己经邦我们订好了盒饭晚餐，送到我们住宿的Holliday Inn旅馆. 大家对这份盒饭赞不绝口，5块钱的盒饭，又 有肉又有蛋和蔬菜, 味道十分正宗,份量也很足。 一问才知道这是按他们会员每天午餐的标准由饭店提供的。
1f742b7e132f26af8344da803f4a47324b16162c.translatedText: On the evening of September 27th, the Phoenix Chinese Senior Citizens Association and the Greater Washington Area China-American Senior Citizens Association ended their trip to Canada and the Eastern United States and were about to return to the capital, Washington. The warm autumn wind blew against our faces, and friends from the China-American Senior Citizens Association expressed their gratitude. In order to welcome our return visit, it was like preparing for a family returning from a trip. We ordered a lunch box dinner and delivered it to the Holliday Inn hotel where we stayed. Everyone praised the lunch box. The 5 yuan box lunch included meat, eggs and vegetables. The taste was very authentic and the portion was generous. After asking, I found out that this was provided by the hotel according to their members' daily lunch standards.

f690a9ba34989053ef8a9dc3b65e28e739f1a1d2.sourceText: 28日，秋高气爽，气候宜人，但不时会有短暂的雷阵雨。 早上七时，华美协会的副会长张凌和另一位义工会员枫琴就带着一辆大巴士来接我们,参观的第一站原定去阿林顿国家公墓，不料，突然下起了 大雨，于是就改为直驶白宫。 过去,白宫只要排队就可以进去参观,自从九一一事件发生后,毎个进白宫众参观的人都要经所在地参、众议员介绍并经白宫批准就才能入内参观。 我们耆英会参观团一行40人是在三个月前请邓朝驹先生邦助办理的，有两位后来参加旅行的团员直到27日下仍没有收到白宫的批复，不能一起参观白宫。 张副会长专门陪他俩参观了白宫展览馆。 其实那里的介绍比参观白宫还丰富，只是缺乏身临其境的感覚。 接着，我们又参观了林肯纪念堂、越战和韩战纪念碑，参观了航天博物馆、美术馆、自然博物馆，在国会大厦前照了集体照留念。 下午五点，来到了名为万福来的活动中心。 这是一栋能住一百五十多人的老人公寓，三分之二是中国人，很有点像我们的纪念大厦。 这里也是他们老年协会的活动塲所之一。 像这样的活动点他们一共有二十三处。 上午，老人们在这里活动，中午由歺馆把订好的营养午歺送来。 这是协会依照政府颁布的老年法向政府申请的。 当我们进入大楼时，一批华人朋友热情地接待了我们，其中包括张蕙蕙会长，查理?#29579;副会长和一些访问过凤凰城的朋友。 他们是从清晨就来到这里为迎接我们作准备，自己动手为我们准备了丰盛的晚歺。 华盛顿盛产青蟹，主人为我们摆设了螃蟹宴，平时我们吃螃蟹是论＂只＂，这次确是论筐，一下就端上了四筐螃蟹，大约有300只，还做了凉面、烧 鸡、凉拌黄瓜葫芦卜等，最后，甜点和水果实在吃不下了，只好带回旅馆去享用。 因为吃螃蟹用了太多时间，原来按排的唱卡拉ok和跳舞只能临时取消，播放了我们的耆英会之歌大家欣赏。 他们的会长对这首歌非常赞赏，她要我们转告曲作者，她己是他的粉丝，并希望有机会请他去华盛顿演唱，并为他们老年协会也写一首歌。
f690a9ba34989053ef8a9dc3b65e28e739f1a1d2.translatedText: On the 28th, the autumn air was crisp and the weather was pleasant, but there were brief thunderstorms from time to time. At 7 o'clock in the morning, Zhang Ling, the vice president of the Chinese American Association, and Feng Qin, another volunteer member, brought us a big bus to pick us up. The first stop of the tour was originally scheduled to be Arlington National Cemetery. Unexpectedly, it suddenly started to rain heavily, so we drove directly to the White House instead. In the past, you only had to queue up to visit the White House. Since the September 11th incident, everyone who visits the White House must be introduced by the local senators and congressmen and approved by the White House before entering. We, a group of 40 people from the Senior Citizens Association, asked Mr. Deng Chaoju to help us arrange the trip three months ago. Two members of the group who later participated in the trip had not received approval from the White House until the afternoon of the 27th and could not visit the White House together. Vice President Zhang specially accompanied them to visit the White House Exhibition Hall. In fact, the introduction there is richer than visiting the White House, but it lacks the immersive experience. Then, we visited the Lincoln Memorial, the Vietnam and Korean War Memorials, the Aerospace Museum, the Art Museum, the Natural History Museum, and took a group photo in front of the Capitol. At five o'clock in the afternoon, we arrived at the activity center called Wanfulai. This is an apartment for the elderly that can accommodate more than 150 people, two-thirds of whom are Chinese. It is a bit like our memorial building. This is also one of the activity centers of their senior citizen association. They have a total of twenty-three such activity points. In the morning, the elderly have activities here, and at noon, the nutritious lunch ordered by the restaurant is delivered to them. This is an application made by the association to the government in accordance with the Elderly Law promulgated by the government. When we entered the building, a group of Chinese friends warmly received us, including President Zhang Huihui, Vice President Charlie and some friends who had visited Phoenix. They came here early in the morning to prepare for us, and prepared a sumptuous dinner for us. Washington is rich in green crabs, so the host arranged a crab feast for us. Usually we eat only "one" crab, but this time it was indeed a basket. Four baskets of crabs were served at once, about 300 crabs. We also made cold noodles, roasted chicken, cold cucumber and gourd carrots, etc. In the end, we couldn't eat any more desserts and fruits, so we had to take them back to the hotel to enjoy. Because eating crabs took too much time, the scheduled karaoke singing and dancing had to be temporarily canceled, and our Senior Citizens Association song was played for everyone to enjoy. Their president admired the song very much. She asked us to tell the songwriter that she was a fan of his and hoped to have the opportunity to invite him to sing in Washington and write a song for their senior citizen association.

24e475ec5c226f44e98d7d5693cfe59437135d0e.sourceText: 第二天，他们的两位张会长一起来陪我们参观。 先参观了杰佛森纪念堂，又去参观了珍藏着世界各国艺术品的smissson 艺术馆，在这里，张会长通过馆领导，专门提前请了两位会讲国语和广东话讲解员，为我们解说 中国的古代器皿和名画，使我们受益匪浅，特别是对珍藏在馆内的几幅慈禧太后的生活照和宫廷画，引起了我们极大的兴致。 随后，我们又去参观了美国历史博物馆、五角大厦和阿灵顿公墓。 下午五点，带我们来到了竹园歺馆吃布菲，这里是他们每月开庆生会的地方。 他们会里来了几位职员，有讲普通话的，也有讲广东话的，大家边吃边谈，互相交流,直到七点钟，才依依惜别。 还应该提到的是他们为我们请了一位黄老师作我们这两天的导游，他是一位对美国历史非常熟悉的老人，这次专程为我们免费讲解了许多知识，临别时大家和他 留影以作纪念。
24e475ec5c226f44e98d7d5693cfe59437135d0e.translatedText: The next day, their two presidents Zhang came to visit with us. We first visited the Jefferson Memorial Hall and then the Smissson Art Museum, which collects artworks from all over the world. Here, President Zhang, through the museum leaders, specially invited two commentators who can speak Mandarin and Cantonese to explain to us Chinese ancient utensils and famous paintings. We benefited a lot, especially the several life photos and palace paintings of Empress Dowager Cixi collected in the museum, which aroused our great interest. Later, we visited the Museum of American History, the Pentagon, and Arlington Cemetery. At five o'clock in the afternoon, they took us to Zhuyuan Restaurant to eat buffet. This is where they hold monthly birthday parties. Several staff members came to their meeting, some who spoke Mandarin and some who spoke Cantonese. Everyone talked and interacted with each other while eating, and they didn't say goodbye until seven o'clock. It should also be mentioned that they hired Mr. Huang to be our tour guide for these two days. He is an old man who is very familiar with American history. He made a special trip to explain a lot of knowledge to us for free. We took photos with him as a souvenir before leaving.

f3bb67d6148ad8131f64cb95724d703847df5a30.sourceText: 两天的华盛顿之行，开濶了我们的眼界，使我们对美国的历史有了进一步的了解。 和华盛顿老年协会接触，更多的了解到他们如何全心全意帮助老年华人的精神和做法，有许多地方值得我们借鉴。 正是由于他们始终把会员的需要作为工作中心，裸得了社会的信任。 他们的会员从六年前创建时的35人，到去年底上升到一千八百多人，现在己拥有二千一百多名会员。 他们靠的就是两百多名义工在二十三个活动中心无私的奉献。
f3bb67d6148ad8131f64cb95724d703847df5a30.translatedText: The two-day trip to Washington opened our horizons and gave us a better understanding of the history of the United States. After contacting the Washington Senior Citizens Association, we learned more about their spirit and practice of helping the elderly Chinese wholeheartedly. There are many things we can learn from. It is precisely because they always put the needs of members as the center of their work that they have won the trust of society. Their membership has increased from 35 when it was founded six years ago to more than 1,800 by the end of last year, and now has more than 2,110 members. They rely on the selfless dedication of more than 200 volunteers in 23 activity centers.

ca9d10e8a243e7c18f3fdd6f3673ae737171d707.sourceText: 让我们诚摰地感谢华美老年协会给我们一行的精心安排和欵待，也祝福他们的协会越办越好。
ca9d10e8a243e7c18f3fdd6f3673ae737171d707.translatedText: Let us sincerely thank the Chinese and American Senior Citizens Association for their careful arrangements and hospitality, and wish their association better and better.

9ffd48a5e88e247d2b0284b1d25569a4002d0eaa.sourceText: 伊利诺州国会参议员德宾(Dick Durbin)30日在一家超市召开记者会，表示10月1日起生效的新银行法规让小商家将不会因顾客使用销帐卡付款，而被银行 抽取费用。 但批评此法规的人表示，这会让银行将费用转嫁到消费者身上。 继29日宣布将对销帐卡(debit card)收取五元月费之后，美国商业银行(Bank of America)30日受到投资人和用户的猛烈抨击，他们在网路简讯和社群媒体上发誓 要改换门庭，到其他银行开户。 美商银的网站30日下午2时许出现了爆堵现象，但原因尚不清楚。 福斯(Fox)商业网路的葛蕊． 威利斯29日晚在节目中，掏出她的美商银销帐卡当场用剪刀绞断，说「我现在就向美商银表明对他们收费的态度」。 她忿忿地说：「五元月费可能并不高，但这是原则问题，意味着他们将从我的荷包掏出更多。」 美商银说，他们决定对销帐卡收费，是国会参议员德宾的提案引发的，因为银行从消费者在商店刷卡的收益减少。 但德宾参议员29日发表声明说：「美商银是试图寻找新的借口，以便从用户身上攫取利润。他们的这种意图很明显，也很不公正，希望消费者能做出最终判断 。」 美商银是全国吸纳存款最多的银行，如今是数十亿元的房贷诉讼缠身，银行的股票今年迄今下跌56%。 美商银上月宣布将削减3万个工作，并将对高层进行重组。 为了增强消费者的信心，美商银不断表示不需要提高银行的资金额，银行出售了部分高价值资产，今年8月从投资大亨巴菲特获得50亿元投资。 美商银定明​​年开始，将向基本支票帐户的销帐卡收取使用费，但只限于用销帐卡购物活动，而不适用于在自动取款机提款、网上付帐或手机转帐等交易 。
9ffd48a5e88e247d2b0284b1d25569a4002d0eaa.translatedText: Illinois Congressman Dick Durbin Durbin held a press conference in a supermarket on the 30th, saying that new banking regulations that will take effect on October 1 will mean that small merchants will not be charged fees by banks because customers use debit cards to pay. But critics of the regulation say it would allow banks to pass fees onto consumers. After announcing on the 29th that it would charge a monthly fee of 5 yuan for debit cards, Bank of America came under fierce criticism from investors and users on the 30th. They vowed to change banks and open accounts at other banks in online text messages and social media. The website of Bank of America was blocked at about 2 pm on the 30th, but the reason is still unclear. Rui Rui from Fox Business Network. On the evening of the 29th, Willis took out her American Commercial Bank debit card and cut it with scissors on the spot, saying, "I will make clear to American Commercial Bank my attitude towards their charges now." She said angrily: "The monthly fee of five yuan may not be high, but it is a matter of principle, which means they will take more out of my pocket." Bank of America said that their decision to charge for debit cards was triggered by Senator Durbin's proposal because the bank's revenue from consumers swiping their cards in stores has decreased. However, Senator Durbin issued a statement on the 29th, saying: "Bank of America is trying to find new excuses in order to extract profits from users. Their intention is obvious and unfair. We hope consumers can make the final judgment." Bank of America is the bank that absorbs the largest deposits in the country. It is now entangled in billions of dollars in mortgage litigation, and the bank's stock has fallen 56% so far this year. Bank of America announced last month that it would cut 30,000 jobs and reorganize its top management. In order to enhance consumer confidence, Bank of America has continuously stated that it does not need to increase the bank's capital. The bank has sold some high-value assets and received a 5 billion yuan investment from investment tycoon Buffett in August this year. Bank of America plans to start charging debit card usage fees for basic checking accounts starting next year, but it will only apply to purchases using the debit card, and will not apply to transactions such as cash withdrawals at ATMs, online payments, or mobile phone transfers.

I was very happy. The centenary of the Republic of China is worthy of cheering...

56246043eaec16ca34b2517e7ed844eb14e2fb19.sourceText: 气如虹：生活随笔 双十国庆 我从越南返回凤凰城，有幸参加庆祝双十节的表演节目，非常高兴。民国百年，值得欢呼，来自台湾的无双女子乐团，由各大学的国乐系美女组成，只见十二美女使用不同乐器，乐曲风情万种，果然精彩，加上「春丽舞啦啦」的四 美人相伴，洋溢青春活力，的确璀璨一百，乐扬凤城，令人鼓掌不绝！ 我虽然有幸参加这些庞大的庆祝活动，也感谢侨团各界的努力组织，毕竟中华民国一百年了，一个世纪呀，风风雨雨走过来，并不容易；但我在高兴过后，离开现场，回复 现实的社会，冷眼旁观，觉得目前中华民国的地位与形势，并不乐观，内心百感交集，不免唏嘘叹息。 我有此感触，因为热爱中华，正确地说是热爱中华民国。 可能由于我生长在越南堤岸，从小到长大受中华民国教育的薰陶，「南京是我国的首都．山川雄壮，风景美丽，」这些课文深入脑海；伟大的革命家、国父孙中山的名字早已铭记在心 ；辛亥革命的先烈成功史迹让我敬仰；在各项典礼仪式，唱国歌，诵读总理遗嘱，是当时的惯例，习以为常；就连〈美哉中华〉​​的歌曲：”美哉美哉，中华民国，太平洋滨， 亚细亚陆；大江盘旋，高山起伏….”，我现在还可以随口哼唱几句。 我的青少年时代，多次参加双十庆典，那时的庆典一定是在十月十日当天举办，或在戏院，或在学校礼堂，充满国庆隆重意义，不像凤凰城这里，有时迟有时 早，循例举办。 我最早懂得双十节，应该是抗战胜利后那年，越南华侨举办盛大游行庆祝国庆，地点在堤岸的水兵街（今名陈兴道大道），依稀记得沿途人山人海挤迫站立观看，父亲牵着哥哥， 叫我「骑膊马」，即是托着我在其肩膀上，游行花样多，有舞狮，有廾形的灯笼，敲锣打鼓…，同行者还把小国旗插入我的口袋里；那时 我只有几岁，其实不懂什么，只因每年双十节来临，先父反覆重提旧事，所以存有模糊朦胧的印象。 不过，在越南参与双十庆典或在报纸写作祝贺的，都是我卅五岁以前的事，卅五岁以后，即是一九七五年，越南局势全面改变，双十国庆典礼已消声 匿迹。 一直等到移民美国，我才再在这凤凰城正式参与庆祝，但中华民国的声誉，与前大不相同，几乎被台湾两字覆盖，而在联合国，是使用中华人民共和国的旗帜，不见青天白日满 地红了。 因为这种环境转变，往事让人回味，怀旧情绪容易产生。 每年双十节到来，我总会回忆起数十年前的一次双十节，越南亚洲日报发表的一篇社论，题目是〈含笑庆双十，垂泪望山河〉，社论代表报社立场，不 署名，但知情者晓得是主笔方中格撰述，内容指出当年国父孙中山和先烈们是多么的辛劳，才能在辛亥革命取得成功，缔造中华民国，十月十日光辉灿烂的国庆，是用鲜血换来 的，中华儿女不好好珍惜，不加以维护，还另立党派出来斗争夺权，河山分裂，令人难过，伤心流泪。 该社论在当时是道出海外华人庆祝双十国庆的心声，剖白侨胞的渴望，祈求青天白日满地红旗，在全球放射光辉，随风飘扬，而联合国的永久常任理事国席位，依然是中华民国的 名义，华侨曾以此为傲。 但在国共相争，斗个你死我活的年代，就互不相让，这边绝不容许亲共，那边也不容许反共，这位以笔锋锐利立论的报人，最后难逃被枪杀身亡 的命运，此事轰动整个越华侨社，一度令华人新闻从业员如惊弓之鸟，惶惶不可终日。 那时越华晚报姚景新编辑劝阻我不要进入报社任职，叫我在外围活动就好，原因在此。 时光不再，往昔已逝，今日国际时局大事转变，形势比人强，中华民国逐渐失去强劲，不要说外国的邦交，单单在海外侨团中都明显的看到。 因此，提起十月十日的双十国庆，即使爱护中华民国的侨胞竭力组织大会庆祝，就好像那晚的庆祝演出，呼声四起，热烈鼓舞，最后的一首〈中华民国颂〉，歌词充满豪气，「 中华民国，中华民国，千秋万世，直到永远！」但散场后，离开那热情高升的剧院，冷静不来，仔细思量外面真实的社会环境，让我失去往昔的兴奋情怀！
56246043eaec16ca34b2517e7ed844eb14e2fb19.translatedText: Qi Ruhong: Life Essays Double Ten National Day I returned to Phoenix from Vietnam and was lucky enough to participate in a performance celebrating the Double Ten Day. I was very happy. The centenary of the Republic of China is worthy of cheering. The unparalleled women's band from Taiwan is composed of beauties from the Chinese music department of various universities. There are only twelve beauties using different instruments. The music has a variety of styles. It is indeed wonderful. In addition, the four beauties of "Chun Li Dance" are accompanied by them. They are full of youthful vitality. They are indeed dazzling and joyful in Fengcheng. It makes people applaud endlessly! Although I was lucky enough to participate in these huge celebrations, I am also grateful for the hard work of all walks of life in the overseas Chinese community. After all, the Republic of China has been a hundred years, and it has not been easy to go through ups and downs in a century. But after I was happy, I left the scene and returned to the real society. I watched with a cold eye and felt that the current status and situation of the Republic of China was not optimistic. I had mixed feelings in my heart and could not help but sigh. I feel this way because I love China, or to be precise, I love the Republic of China. Perhaps because I grew up in Vietnam, and was influenced by the education of the Republic of China from a young age, "Nanjing is the capital of our country. The mountains and rivers are majestic, and the scenery is beautiful." These texts are deeply rooted in my mind; the name of the great revolutionary and founding father Sun Yat-sen has long been engraved in my mind. I admire the successful history of the martyrs of the Revolution of 1911; singing the national anthem and reciting the Prime Minister's will at various ceremonies were common practice at that time; even the song "Beautiful China": "Beautiful, the Republic of China, the Pacific Ocean, the Asia continent; the rivers are circling, the mountains are undulating...", I can still hum a few words casually. When I was a teenager, I participated in many Double Ten celebrations. At that time, the celebrations were always held on October 10th, either in the theater or in the school auditorium, full of the solemn significance of the National Day. Unlike here in Phoenix, they were held as usual, sometimes later and sometimes earlier. I first learned about the Double Ten Festival in the year after the victory of the Anti-Japanese War. The overseas Chinese in Vietnam held a grand parade to celebrate the National Day. The venue was on Sailor Street (now known as Tran Hung Dao Avenue) on the embankment. I vaguely remember that there were huge crowds of people standing and watching along the way. My father held his brother’s hand. Calling me "riding a horse" means holding me on his shoulders. There were many parades, including lion dances, twisted lanterns, gongs and drums... and the fellow travelers also inserted small flags into my pockets. I was only a few years old at the time, and I didn't really know much. I only had a vague impression of it because my father kept mentioning old events when Double Ten Day came every year. However, those who participated in the Double Ten celebrations in Vietnam or wrote congratulations in newspapers were all before I turned thirty-five. After I turned thirty-five, that is, in 1975, the situation in Vietnam completely changed, and the Double Ten celebrations disappeared. It wasn't until I immigrated to the United States that I officially participated in the celebration in Phoenix. However, the reputation of the Republic of China is very different from before. It is almost covered by the word "Taiwan". However, in the United Nations, the flag of the People's Republic of China is used, and the sky is no longer blue and the ground is red. Because of this change in environment, memories of the past are recalled, and nostalgia is easy to arise. Every year when the Double Ten Festival comes, I always recall an editorial published by Vietnam Asia Daily on the Double Ten Festival decades ago. The title was "Celebrating Double Ten with a smile, looking at the mountains and rivers with tears." The editorial represents the position of the newspaper, not Signed, but insiders know that it was written by the main author Fang Zhongge. The content points out how hard the founding father Sun Yat-sen and the martyrs worked so hard to succeed in the Revolution of 1911 and create the Republic of China. The glorious National Day on October 10 was bought with blood. The Chinese people did not cherish it and protect it. Instead, they established another party to fight for power. The country was divided. It was sad and sad to shed tears. At that time, the editorial expressed the sentiments of overseas Chinese celebrating the National Day, expressed the desire of the overseas Chinese, and prayed for the blue sky and white sun to fill the ground with red flags, shining brightly around the world and fluttering in the wind. The permanent seat of the United Nations Security Council was still in the name of the Republic of China, and the overseas Chinese were once proud of it. But in the era when the Kuomintang and the Communist Party were fighting each other to the death, they would not give in to each other. Pro-Communism was not allowed here, and anti-Communism was not allowed there. This reporter, who made sharp arguments with his pen, could not escape the fate of being shot to death. This incident shocked the entire Vietnamese overseas Chinese community, and once made Chinese journalists feel frightened and terrified all day long. At that time, the editor of the Yuehua Evening News, Yao Jingxin, discouraged me from joining the newspaper and told me to just work on the periphery. This is why. Time is gone, the past is gone. Today's international situation is changing. The situation is stronger than the people. The Republic of China is gradually losing its strength. Not to mention the diplomatic relations with foreign countries, it can be clearly seen among the overseas Chinese groups. Therefore, when it comes to the Double Ten National Day on October 10, even if the overseas Chinese who love the Republic of China try their best to organize a general meeting to celebrate, just like the celebration performance that night, there are cheers and enthusiastic encouragement. The lyrics of the last song "Ode to the Republic of China" are full of heroic, " The Republic of China, the Republic of China, forever and ever!" But after the show, I left the enthusiastic theater and couldn't calm down. I carefully considered the real social environment outside, which made me lose the excitement I had in the past!

0ccfe9acd5a7d2723426a5d4f0db12c81c3bc75f.sourceText: 美联邦拟严打滥用福利移民 民众盼出标准条例

262f364cc9cfe355743aad2fd86f3f8764ad0f73.translatedText: The U.S. federal government plans to crack down on immigrants who abuse welfare, and people hope for standard regulations China News Service, February 11 (Xinhua) According to the United States' "World Journal" report, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security drafted a new law...

dcc1a975968a3e8dc735e6dfd41719e25e8aeb98.sourceText: 中新网2月11日电 据美国《世界日报》报道，美国国土安全部草拟新法规，准许移民官审查移民使用某些公共福利的情况，以决定他们是否能获得永久居留权。这一话题当地时间2月9日在纽约华人小区引发热议，移民律师和民众皆表示，滥用福利确实是一个棘手的问题，但更重要的是政府出台明确条例，告诉民众哪些是可享受的社会福利，哪些算是滥用，才能让福利系统更好的运行，保证有需民众的生活。
dcc1a975968a3e8dc735e6dfd41719e25e8aeb98.translatedText: China News Service, February 11 (Xinhua) According to the US "World Journal" report, the US Department of Homeland Security is drafting new regulations to allow immigration officers to review immigrants' use of certain public benefits to determine whether they can obtain permanent residency. This topic sparked a heated discussion in the Chinese community in New York on February 9, local time. Immigration lawyers and the public said that abuse of welfare is indeed a thorny issue, but more importantly, the government issues clear regulations to tell the public which social welfare is available and which is considered abuse, so that the welfare system can operate better and ensure the lives of people in need.

bf0ab886ca7b0432fbc1a0fc4c705d9216231d38.sourceText: 移民律师刘汝华解释，申请绿卡表格中，是否使用福利一栏一直存在，但大家一直以来对哪些福利被视为公共福利并不了解，如很多华裔由于收入较低、申请健保时就自动归入医疗补助计划(Medicaid)，而医疗补助计划到底算不算政府福利？原则上并不算，但如果是拿粮食券、奶票等就应该算作公共福利。刘汝华认为，政府若能在福利定义方面做出更清晰条例，这样大家为了今后申请绿卡就不会去申请这些社会福利，不会因为使用了福利导致自己绿卡申请被拒。
bf0ab886ca7b0432fbc1a0fc4c705d9216231d38.translatedText: Immigration lawyer Liu Ruhua explained that in the green card application form, the column for whether to use benefits has always existed, but everyone has not understood which benefits are considered public benefits. For example, due to their low income, many Chinese people are automatically included in the Medicaid program when they apply for health insurance. Does the Medicaid program count as a government benefit? In principle, it does not count, but if you receive food stamps, milk stamps, etc., it should be counted as public welfare. Liu Ruhua believes that if the government can make clearer regulations on the definition of benefits, people will not apply for these social benefits in order to apply for green cards in the future, and their green card applications will not be rejected because of using the benefits.

c791a2aacfa1f0491fc26da7c2187b829a726661.sourceText: 刘汝华提到，很多纽约民众拿着工资单，去任何一个医疗单位，都很容易拿到福利，这种政府批准的福利是合法的，然而此前特朗普政府将滥用福利列入执法逮捕的优先类别，令很多人不敢去看病或申请任何资源补助，这种信息的不一致，导致符合条件的人不敢去申请，”要有法可依，相关问题也就更好解决。”
c791a2aacfa1f0491fc26da7c2187b829a726661.translatedText: Liu Ruhua mentioned that many New Yorkers can easily get benefits by going to any medical unit with their pay stubs. Such government-approved benefits are legal. However, the Trump administration previously listed abuse of benefits as a priority category for law enforcement arrests, which made many people afraid to go to the doctor or apply for any resource subsidies. This This kind of inconsistency in information prevents qualified people from applying. "If there is a law to follow, related problems will be easier to solve."

95e2146ae1233d6d7edf29c933aec17d964c46ca.sourceText: 美国福州侨联总会主席陈键榕表示，以往大家对福利的界限不关心、政府也未追究，但他认为要移民美国，就要遵守美国法律。陈键榕认为，政府如果要严打移民使用某些公共福利的情况，来决定他们是否会成为公共负担，对整个社会来说是件好事。但要给出具体的规章条例，让大家了解具体的福利申请要求以及怎样才被定义为”过度使用”以保证大家之后能更好遵守法律。
95e2146ae1233d6d7edf29c933aec17d964c46ca.translatedText: Chen Jianrong, chairman of the Fuzhou Overseas Chinese Federation of the United States, said that in the past, people did not care about the boundaries of benefits and the government did not pursue them. However, he believes that if you want to immigrate to the United States, you must abide by U.S. laws. Chen Jianrong believes that it would be a good thing for the entire society if the government wants to strictly crack down on immigrants' use of certain public benefits to determine whether they will become public charges. However, specific rules and regulations should be given to let everyone understand the specific welfare application requirements and what is defined as "excessive use" to ensure that everyone can better comply with the law in the future.

7e2756d536044eb70cd2b3a0e5c1f2c04a7cadde.sourceText: 鲜花绽放——— 2012年亚省春节晚会 ( 杨济群供稿)一年一度的亚省春节晚会，总是给人带来清新鲜活的印象，让人享受一次浓郁的祖国文化艺术的表演，令人心旷神怡。 笔者从可靠方面得悉，2012年一月二十一日（农历29日）亚省春晚又将在Chandler Center For The Arts隆重举行。 这次的晚会将由新东方艺术学校，ASU孔子学院，图桑华声合唱团，美西侨报等单位联合主办，阵容庞大，节目新颖，是献给亚省华人欢度中国最隆重的传统节日—–春节的文艺大餐。 为了这次演出，主办单位经过了近半年的精心准备，力图以全新的剧目奉献给观众。新东方艺术学校以百名演员的阵容集汉族，藏族，羌族，傣族，彝族，等中国民族舞蹈参演。为了营造欢欢乐乐过新年的节日气氛，整台晚会融入了大合唱，独唱，童声合唱，器乐，等等节目，组成一台璀璨的中国文化艺术盛宴。 曾记得去年的春节晚会上，新东方艺术学校的独舞演员陈思，以优美的舞蹈《雀之灵》将我们带到遥远的西双版纳竹林苍松翠柏中， 似乎让我们看到美丽的俪江江畔翩跃翔舞的惊艳孔雀。今年的春节晚会上，她又将著名舞蹈家杨丽萍的《月光》搬上舞台。 新东方艺术学校从小学习中国舞蹈的几名优秀学生Angela Zhang, Tina Peng, Jinnie Xie, Sophie Lu等将以单人，双人，三人舞的形式，奉献给观众耳目一新的优美舞姿。 观众们也许还记得，新东方艺术学校成人舞蹈班的多次演出，她们整齐划一的舞步，成熟优美的表演，给观众留下了深刻的印象，这次她们挑战自己，将表演难度较大的汉族舞蹈展现舞台。更让人出其不意的是男生成人班的加入，他们首次登台，到时将给您一个惊喜，让我们拭目以待。 朋友们，我们在异国他乡，不能在家乡欢度我们最隆重的传统节日—春节，有机会阖家欢聚一起，观赏我们中国人自己的春节晚会，真是一次难得的机会。让我们开开心心，热热闹闹的过一个愉快的春节。 请记住： 2012亚省春节晚会 时间： 2012年1月21日 （ 星期六） 地点： Chandler Center For The Arts 250 N Arizona Ave Chandler AZ 85225 售票联系： 新东方艺术学校 1100 N Alma School Rd #18 ( 蓝天餐馆同一广场) Chandler AZ 85224
7e2756d536044eb70cd2b3a0e5c1f2c04a7cadde.translatedText: Flowers bloom——2012 Alberta Spring Festival Gala (contributed by Yang Jiqun) The annual Alberta Spring Festival Gala always brings a fresh and lively impression to people, allowing them to enjoy a rich cultural and artistic performance of the motherland, which is refreshing and refreshing. The author has learned from reliable sources that on January 21, 2012 (the 29th of the lunar calendar), the Alberta Spring Festival Gala will be held again at the Chandler Center For The Arts. This evening party will be jointly hosted by the New Oriental School of the Arts, the ASU Confucius Institute, the Tucson Chinese Voice Choir, the Spanish American Overseas Chinese Newspaper and other units. It has a large lineup and novel programs. It is a literary and artistic feast dedicated to Chinese people in Alberta to celebrate the most solemn traditional festival in China - the Spring Festival. For this performance, the organizer has made careful preparations for nearly half a year and strives to present a brand-new play to the audience. New Oriental Art School has a lineup of hundreds of actors from Han, Tibetan, Qiang, Dai, Yi, and other Chinese ethnic dances. In order to create a festive atmosphere for a joyful New Year, the entire party incorporated chorus, solo singing, children's chorus, instrumental music, and other programs to form a dazzling Chinese culture and art feast. I remember that at last year’s Spring Festival Gala, Chen Si, a solo dancer from the New Oriental Art School, took us to the distant bamboo forest of Xishuangbanna among the green pines and cypresses with his beautiful dance "The Spirit of the Bird", which seemed to allow us to see the stunning peacocks dancing by the beautiful Lijiang River. At this year's Spring Festival Gala, she put on stage "Moonlight" by famous dancer Yang Liping. Angela Zhang, Tina Peng, Jinnie Xie, Sophie Lu, etc., several outstanding students of the New Oriental Art School who have studied Chinese dance since childhood, will present the audience with refreshing and graceful dances in the form of singles, pairs, and trios. The audience may still remember the many performances of the adult dance class of the New Oriental Art School. Their uniform dance steps and mature and graceful performances left a deep impression on the audience. This time they challenged themselves to perform the more difficult Han dance on the stage. What is even more surprising is the addition of the male adult class. They will be on stage for the first time and will give you a surprise. Let us wait and see. Friends, we are in a foreign country and cannot celebrate our most solemn traditional festival, the Spring Festival, in our hometown. It is a rare opportunity to have the opportunity to get together as a family and watch our own Chinese Spring Festival Gala. Let us be happy and lively and have a happy Spring Festival. Please remember: 2012 Alberta Spring Festival Gala Time: January 21, 2012 (Saturday) Location: Chandler Center For The Arts 250 N Arizona Ave Chandler AZ 85225 Ticketing Contact: New Oriental Art School 1100 N Alma School Rd #18 (same square as Blue Sky Restaurant) Chandler AZ 85224

c2cfc1564ca5c3c274debb59d2cb112289aa91a2.sourceText: 在全美华人和亚裔欢庆农历新年之际，美国邮政总局定于2012年1月23日（农历大年初一）发行龙年生肖邮票，首发仪式将在旧金山中国城内举办。设立于洛杉矶的中美集邮中心也将在同日发行庆祝农历新年首日封。美国邮政在发出的新邮公报中表示，”在龙年出生的人受人尊敬，有强壮的精力和无法压抑的创新能力”’。
c2cfc1564ca5c3c274debb59d2cb112289aa91a2.translatedText: As Chinese and Asian Americans across the U.S. celebrate the Lunar New Year, the U.S. Postal Service is scheduled to issue Year of the Dragon zodiac stamps on January 23, 2012 (the first day of the Lunar New Year). The launch ceremony will be held in San Francisco's Chinatown. The China-US Philatelic Center established in Los Angeles will also issue a first-day cover to celebrate the Lunar New Year on the same day. The United States Postal Service stated in a new postal bulletin that "people born in the Year of the Dragon are respected, have strong energy and irrepressible innovation ability."

53a929d6f3b6d78149aee1b06b45e9dd15a76d2b.sourceText: 今年的艺术节将集中于，在中国人民共和国四川省省会成都，和菲尼克斯姐妹城市。在2012年的其他特殊方面，将重点放在华裔美国人在亚利桑那州的悠久历史。1912年2月14日，第48团队，加入联盟，开始亚利桑那州标志性的里程碑。 中国的文化不仅是现在尚存古代文化，5000多年来还在蓬勃发展，许多丰富的文化遗产，以及不同区域的美食在传统新年的活动中将会为您倾情准备。 免费入场。停车费5.00元/车。 有关详细信息，请咨询 www.phoenixchineseweek.org 或电子邮件： phoenixchineseweek@gmail.com
53a929d6f3b6d78149aee1b06b45e9dd15a76d2b.translatedText: This year’s festival will focus on Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province in the People’s Republic of China, and the sister city of Phoenix. Among other special aspects in 2012, there will be a focus on the long history of Chinese Americans in Arizona. On February 14, 1912, the 48th team joined the league and began Arizona's iconic milestone. Chinese culture is not only ancient culture that still exists today, but has also been vigorously developing for more than 5,000 years. Many rich cultural heritages and delicacies from different regions will be prepared for you during traditional New Year activities. Free admission. Parking fee is 5.00 yuan/car. For more information please consult www.phoenixchineseweek.org or email: phoenixchineseweek@gmail.com

6186bd87fccd169503f7d5a8dc0d9158349d7414.sourceText: 专栏作家汪静玉:兰干武的写字艺术 由于职业的关系，我最初接触的是兰干武先生的文字，几年前他送我一本文集《隔…
6186bd87fccd169503f7d5a8dc0d9158349d7414.translatedText: Columnist Wang Jingyu: Lan Qianwu’s writing art Due to my professional relationship, the first thing I came into contact with was Mr. Lan Qianwu’s writings. A few years ago, he gave me a collection of essays called "Separation...

c87176feef92749189c3c51ddfb61bff98983ca7.sourceText: 由于职业的关系，我最初接触的是兰干武先生的文字，几年前他送我一本文集《隔岸琵琶》，由于题目是我一向欣赏的古典韵味，我把里面我文字仔仔细细地读了一遍，应该说，他的文字质朴，感情细腻而且结构缜密。我从他质朴的文字里却读到了他对现实生活的认真和热爱，这种热爱致使他对我国的传统书法艺术作出了孜孜不倦的追求。后来，兰干武先生又送我一本《临帖与创作》，我才发现自己对他认识不足，兰干武先生其实一直在专攻书法，精钻书艺，而且其书艺水准已经达到了一定的高度，文学是他的另一种爱好，两种爱好并不相悖，他在传统书法的历史与现当代文化之间找到了一个最佳契合点，使之达到某些精神融合，并在此基础上有了新的发现新的创造。
c87176feef92749189c3c51ddfb61bff98983ca7.translatedText: " As for writing, a few years ago he gave me a collection of essays called "Pipa on the Other Shore". Since the title has a classical charm that I have always admired, I read the words in it carefully. It should be said that his writing is simple, emotionally delicate and well-structured. From his simple words, I read his seriousness and love for real life. This love led him to pursue tirelessly the traditional art of calligraphy in my country. Later, Mr. Lan Qianwu gave me a copy of "Preparation and Creation", and I realized that I didn't know enough about him. Mr. Lan Qianwu has actually been specializing in calligraphy and refined calligraphy, and his calligraphy level has reached a certain height. Literature is another hobby of his, and the two hobbies are not inconsistent. He found an optimal fit between the history of traditional calligraphy and modern and contemporary culture, achieving some spiritual fusion, and based on this, he made new discoveries and creations.

9a2c4006992b3cf661089a207a7de11b1241b05a.sourceText: 让我深感意外的是，他的文风和书法特点却大相径庭，一个代表细腻的情怀，一个代表粗犷的情感，他个人的审美体验在这两种不同的艺术领域里得到了比较完美的发挥，这种发挥使得他的书法有了一定的造诣，从而他的书艺逐渐成为欣赏者群体的审美活动。
9a2c4006992b3cf661089a207a7de11b1241b05a.translatedText: What surprises me deeply is that his writing style and calligraphy characteristics are very different. One represents delicate feelings, and the other represents rough emotions. His personal aesthetic experience has been perfectly displayed in these two different artistic fields. This kind of display has made his calligraphy have certain attainments, and his calligraphy has gradually become an aesthetic activity for the appreciators.

af2d9095c84bdf3e6dae0a4a299723a65ade8a16.sourceText: 由于书法其自身的特点棗书法的艺术品位与人的精神品位的统一性。书法家要从文字中发展其精湛的艺术，并发挥自己独有的个性和审美情趣，这之中要付出孜孜不倦的努力。在书法实践上，兰干武先生的狂草最能代表他写字的艺术，他的狂草不拘一格，笔势连绵奔突，字形诡谲变化，丝毫看不到他散文和诗歌里面温文尔雅的文风，而是极具龙飞蛇舞之致。可以想像，他在书写时充满激情，完全处于一种极其亢奋的状态下完成的，有一种自我解脱和自我完善的淋漓之美，完全摒弃了庙堂之气而承袭了”二王”书家的特点，且又朝着简约、凝重、狂放、浑厚和雄强的方向发展自己独特的风格。
af2d9095c84bdf3e6dae0a4a299723a65ade8a16.translatedText: Due to the unique characteristics of calligraphy, the unity of the artistic taste of calligraphy and people's spiritual taste. Calligraphers must develop their exquisite art from words and exert their own unique personality and aesthetic taste, which requires tireless efforts. In the practice of calligraphy, Mr. Lan Qianwu's wild cursive writing best represents his art of writing. His wild cursive writing is eclectic, with continuous and rushing strokes and strange changes in character shapes. There is no trace of the gentle and elegant writing style in his prose and poetry, but it is very like a dragon flying and a snake dancing. It can be imagined that he was full of passion when writing and completed it in an extremely excited state. It has a dripping beauty of self-liberation and self-improvement. He completely abandoned the temple atmosphere and inherited the characteristics of the "two kings" calligraphers, and developed his own unique style in the direction of simplicity, dignity, wildness, richness and strength.

a07caabf5cf3a5ebeffa81986ded458444fcd0e0.sourceText: 兰干武先生的书法创作是真诚的，一个人的生活经历和文化涵养之所以能在书法里得以体现，主要是和书法家的审美情趣和艺术感觉有很大关联。
a07caabf5cf3a5ebeffa81986ded458444fcd0e0.translatedText: > Mr. Lan Qianwu's calligraphy creation is sincere. The reason why a person's life experience and cultural accomplishment can be reflected in calligraphy is mainly related to the calligrapher's aesthetic taste and artistic feeling.

ecfea79113376ba9e8f9782e59a0a36f5bd28812.sourceText: 在当今社会，坚持书法创作的人实在不多了。在这个电子化、数字化的时代，作为我国传统艺术造型之一的文字艺术逐渐显出了它弥足珍贵的一面，书法艺术在表达传统与现代之间搭起了一座桥梁，成为中国传统文化的活化石，成为人的精神产品，为当代艺术提供独特的思考和贡献。兰干武先生在这条寂寞的小道上默默地耕耘着，他租了一套简易的房间，房间四壁摆满了古典文献和他的书法作品。他深谙，要坚持传统书法的笔墨，必须和诗文内容和古典文化要完美结合，这样才能构成完整的中国古典艺术氛围，也只有这样，书法艺术才能彰显出自己独特的魅力，它特有的文化特色和艺术精神能为当代人类精神急需的品质中注入一股清新的古典的优雅之风。最近兰干武先生却做了一个大胆的尝试，当然这得益于他自身的文字天赋，他将自己写的现代诗用另一种文字艺术，即书法表达出来，这一直是他的梦想，这个梦想是他在书法界和文学界经过了二十多年的艺术实践后才开始付诸实施，这种尝试在现代书法界似乎不常见。
ecfea79113376ba9e8f9782e59a0a36f5bd28812.translatedText: In today's society, there are really not many people who insist on creating calligraphy. In this era of electronics and digitization, the art of writing, as one of my country's traditional artistic forms, has gradually shown its precious side. The art of calligraphy has built a bridge between the expression of tradition and modernity, becoming a living fossil of Chinese traditional culture and a spiritual product of people, providing unique thinking and contributions to contemporary art. Mr. Lan Qianwu worked silently on this lonely path. He rented a simple room, and the walls of the room were filled with classical documents and his calligraphy works. He understands well that in order to adhere to the traditional calligraphy pen and ink, it must be perfectly integrated with the poetic content and classical culture, so as to form a complete Chinese classical artistic atmosphere. Only in this way can the art of calligraphy show its unique charm. Its unique cultural characteristics and artistic spirit can inject a fresh classical elegance into the qualities urgently needed by the contemporary human spirit. Recently, Mr. Lang Ganwu made a bold attempt, which of course benefited from his own writing talent. He expressed the modern poems he wrote in another writing art, that is, calligraphy. This has always been his dream. This dream was only started to be implemented after more than 20 years of artistic practice in the calligraphy and literary circles. This kind of attempt seems to be uncommon in the modern calligraphy world.

3d86ab9d34826f5f19043b37f77d0d8a022a1ceb.sourceText: 在此，我将李斯先生在书法上论”用笔”一段话来形容他，李斯说”夫用笔之法，先急回，后疾下，如鹰望鹏逝，信之自然，不得重改。送脚，若游鱼得水；舞笔，如景山兴云。或卷或舒，乍轻乍重，善深思之，理当自见矣。”在书法艺术上，他”鹰望鹏逝”、”景山兴云”或”或卷或舒”。他依靠自己的才能在两种艺术之间畅快地游弋，将两者”善深思之”如”游鱼得水”地结合起来。当然，前方的路还很长，需要书写者不懈的努力才能到达更高的艺术殿堂。对此，我们将拭目以待。
3d86ab9d34826f5f19043b37f77d0d8a022a1ceb.translatedText: Here, I will describe Mr. Li Si’s words about “using the pen” in calligraphy. Li Si said, “The way I use the pen is to return quickly first, then to move quickly, like an eagle looking at the passing peng, trusting it is natural, and I can’t believe it.” It needs to be revised again. The movement of the feet is like a fish swimming in the water; the dance of the pen is like the scenery of the mountain and the clouds. It is sometimes light and sometimes heavy. If you are good at thinking about it, you should see it yourself." He relies on his own talents to swim freely between the two arts, combining them like a fish swimming in water. Of course, there is still a long road ahead, and it requires unremitting efforts by writers to reach a higher artistic palace. We'll have to wait and see.

4362082a28b6d51534c5b8fe5be6839043c72520.sourceText: 图桑慧明：COACH 包的困惑 太太准备回国，知道消息的国内七姑八姨，同学朋友纷纷来电来信，能否给我和我们带一个美国的名牌包，最好是COACH的？ COACH？我还真不明白该怎样翻成中文。你看”奔驰””马自达”翻得多匹配，要音有音，要意有意。可COACH不行，翻作”够吃”太寒酸，有钱买名牌想必早能糊口，见天说”吃”太脱贫了；说”抠虱”吧，又太肮脏，那是花果山猴儿们的勾当，本小姐挎包像当年挎个盒子炮那般神气，这名字太损包主人形象。而且，这两个译名都有发音不完美之处。 取COACH字的原意吧，那叫”教练”，想想也不妥。好端端的妙龄少女背个装臭袜子脏鞋子的训练包，是什么形象？所以思想再三，还是以”蔻翅”最为妥帖，”蔻”有可可动人之韵，”翅”有如虎添翼之义。让女人上街若不挎那包，连手都不知道往哪搁，这才叫名牌哪。 好，名正则言顺，言顺则归正传。那么，我们小心翼翼地发问，你们准备买怎样的包呢？众人审美观念不同，但国人财大气粗的回答大约是差不多的:五、六千人民币，一万以下的都行。我小抽一口冷气，一万人民币折合美元大约1200元，在美国可以买个旧车了，这国内的姐们买了就挂在身上啦？ 别看满街的女人挎着包，走起路来，踌躇满志，左顾右盼，很有小资作派，其实呢，那包里都没装什么。那堂堂的美国国务卿希拉里算是女人中的豪杰了，那包让人给泄密了，说是为了保持精神亢奋，包里最常见的是辣椒粉胡椒粉之类的东西。所以又问朋友，不就是个包吗？要那么讲究吗？ 你不懂呀，年龄尚轻的小辈朋友尊敬地开导着我们，现在中国（女人）没有这种包，就OUT了！我们虽然年长几岁，出国几年，可心里向往着梦想和年轻，最怕人家年轻人说你落伍、OUT了。所以赶紧点头再点头。 不过，我还想补充一下，这里（美国）已经不像过去，几乎所有的产品包括高档产品都是中国产的，最贵的”蔻翅”也是Made in China，买个国货回去，怕人家说你吗？ 嗨呀，你老土了，年轻人在电话里笑了，我的包背在身上，谁会来翻标签呀！再讲了，不是熟悉的人还寻不到中国制造的记号呢。我感到受到年轻人的表扬，信心一下变得满满的—-我也是陪伴太太购包，打发无聊才在包内部某个角落发现的。那堂堂的”Made in China”的国家标志竟然躲藏在包底的褶皱处！给人家制造了东西，帮人家赚钱，还低声下气地藏着名声，国内商人的涵养真不错。 时代果真是不同了。过去朋友托你带东西，要捡那美国的便宜买，现在有钱了气粗了，要个包还要最好的。那mall里的营业员喜笑颜开地给我们拿了一个又一个”蔻翅”，现在经济不好，大概她也好久没有这样开怀地畅笑了。 我们也高兴，总算为拉动美国经济做了一回大款。 然而喜悦没有持续很久。 待我们整理好行李准备休息时，隔壁美国邻居敲门了。这位是按摩师，老公又是搞医疗器械的，收入还不错。 你回国了，她对着太太遮遮掩掩地请求，可以帮我从中国带个COACH包回来吗？ 什么，什么？我们几乎被问糊涂了，今天是”蔻翅”节了？美国有这么多COACH，为什么要到中国买”蔻翅”呢？ 我的朋友最近从中国买了COACH，只有80美金，她补充道。 我们一下开窍了，美国人一向抨击中国不尊重知识产权，对盗版深恶痛绝，可这位实在舍不得花上千美金去买个包，宁肯放下身价，到中国去买个盗版水货来。美国人一向实用得很，有个挂名的名牌挂在肩上装东西也不错，何必太讲究呢。何况经济大环境已经这样了，没钱讲究只能将就了。 一天之内又一个年轻姑娘教育我们，不同的是这次是美国姑娘。我又一次赶紧点头，那是，那是，能用就好。并同时用方言对太太说，回来到七浦路（上海的小商品市场）帮她淘一个便宜货来。 对我们而言，不过是买个包而已，顺带拉动一下两地经济。但心里困惑还是有的，为什么国人有了钱就要到美国买中国制造的COACH，而不就地买中国的”蔻翅”呢？ 我想，就像中国买美国的国债一样，买了就不OUT了吧。
4362082a28b6d51534c5b8fe5be6839043c72520.translatedText: Tusang Huiming: Confusion about COACH bags My wife is preparing to return to China. My aunts, classmates and friends in China who know the news have called and written me. Can you bring me and us an American brand-name bag, preferably from COACH? COACH? I really don't understand how to translate it into Chinese. You see, "Mercedes-Benz" and "Mazda" are translated in many ways. The words must have a sound and a meaningful meaning. But COACH is not good. The translation of "enough to eat" is too shabby. If you have money to buy famous brands, you must be able to make a living. If you say "eat" to the sky, it is too poor; let's say "picking lice", it is too dirty. That is the activity of the monkeys in Huaguo Mountain. This lady's bag has the air of carrying a cannon in the past. This name is too damaging to the image of the owner of the bag. Moreover, both translations have imperfections in pronunciation. Let’s take the original meaning of the word COACH. It’s not appropriate to call it “coach”. What image does a good-looking young girl look like carrying a training bag containing smelly socks and dirty shoes? Therefore, after much thought, the most appropriate choice is "妞锛". "馋" has a touching rhyme, and "還" means like a tiger adding wings to its wings. If a woman goes out on the street without carrying that bag, she won't even know where to put her hands. This is called a famous brand. Well, if the name is correct, then the words will be correct, and if the words are correct, then the story will be true. So, we carefully ask, what kind of bag are you going to buy? Everyone has different aesthetic concepts, but the answer from wealthy Chinese people is roughly the same: five to six thousand yuan, anything less than ten thousand yuan will do. I took a breath of air-conditioning. Ten thousand yuan is equivalent to about 1,200 yuan in US dollars. You can buy a used car in the United States. Do the ladies in China just buy it and hang it on them? Even though the women on the street are walking with bags on their shoulders, looking complacent and looking around, in a very bourgeois manner, in fact, there is nothing in their bags. The dignified US Secretary of State Hillary is considered a hero among women. Someone leaked the bag, saying that it was to keep her spirits high. The most common things in the bag were chili powder and pepper. So I asked my friend again, isn’t it just a bag? Do you have to be that particular? You don’t understand. Our younger friends taught us respectfully. Now that Chinese (women) don’t have this kind of bag, they are out! Although we are a few years older and have been abroad for a few years, we yearn for dreams and youth in our hearts. We are most afraid that young people will say that we are behind the times or out. So nod quickly and nod again. However, I would also like to add that here (the United States) is no longer like the past. Almost all products, including high-end products, are made in China. The most expensive "Coco Wings" are also Made in China. If you buy a domestic product back home, are you afraid of being criticized? Hey, you are old-fashioned, the young man laughed on the phone, I have my bag on my back, who will look through the labels! Besides, people who are not familiar with it will not be able to find the mark of Made in China. I felt praised by the young people, and my confidence suddenly became full - I also accompanied my wife to buy bags, and I found it in a corner inside the bag to kill the boredom. The majestic “Made in China” national logo is actually hidden in the folds at the bottom of the bag! He made things for others, helped them make money, and hid his reputation in a humble manner. The domestic businessmen were really well-educated. Times are indeed different. In the past, when your friends asked you to bring things with you, they wanted to buy them cheaply from the United States. Now that you have money, you are angry and want a bag of the best quality. The salesperson in the mall brought us one "cow wings" after another with a smile on her face. Now that the economy is not good, she probably hasn't laughed like this for a long time. We are also happy that we have finally made a big investment in stimulating the US economy. However, the joy did not last long. When we packed our bags and were ready to rest, our American neighbor next door knocked on the door. This person is a masseur, and her husband is a medical device manufacturer, and his income is pretty good. You have returned to China. She asked her wife covertly, "Can you help me bring a COACH bag back from China?" What, what? We were almost confused by the question, is today the "Kuo Chi" Festival? There are so many COACHs in the United States, why should we go to China to buy "Coach Wings"? My friend recently bought COACH from China for only $80, she added. We suddenly understood. Americans have always criticized China for not respecting intellectual property rights and abhorring piracy, but this person really couldn't bear to spend thousands of dollars to buy a bag. He would rather put down his wealth and go to China to buy a pirated parallel import. Americans have always been very practical. It's nice to have a name tag hanging on your shoulder to carry things, so why be too particular about it. What's more, the economic environment is already like this. If you don't have money, you can only make do with it. Within a day, another young girl taught us. The difference was that this time it was an American girl. I nodded quickly again, that's right, that's right, as long as it works. At the same time, he told his wife in dialect that he would come back to Qipu Road (a small commodity market in Shanghai) and help her find a bargain. For us, it is just a package purchase, which will stimulate the economies of the two places. But I still have some confusion. Why do Chinese people go to the United States to buy Chinese-made COACH when they have money, instead of buying Chinese "Coach" locally? I think it's like China buying U.S. Treasury bonds. If you buy them, you won't be OUT.

a98864405975e76938c6a3c58e037d073f532441.sourceText: 金秋十月绚丽多姿，金秋十月硕果累累，在秋高气爽的十月二十二日（星期六）晚７点，新东方艺术学校和Rhodes Junior High School共同举办《金秋十月》中国舞汇演。 此次演出汇集了两个学校的学生一年勤奋学习的成果，凝聚了老师和家长辛勤耕耘的希望。为举办这次演出，新东方艺术学校经过数月的苦练，向观众们奉献上近百名演员的强大演出阵容。日前演出的准备工作已经到了最后的冲刺阶段。此次演出荟萃中国舞的基本功，舞蹈技巧集锦展示等精彩内容，力图为观众们带来更精彩的视觉享受和中国艺术的盛宴。 特别感谢ASU孔子学院，Mesa Community College, 美西侨报，Mesa Sister Cities Association等单位的大力支持和帮助。 演出时间：十月二十二日 （星期六）晚7:00点 October 22nd 2011, 7:00pm 演出地点：Rhodes Junior High School 1860 S Longmore, Mesa, AZ 85202
a98864405975e76938c6a3c58e037d073f532441.translatedText: The golden October is gorgeous, and the golden October is fruitful. On October 22nd (Saturday), at 7 pm in the crisp autumn air, New Oriental Art School and Rhodes Junior High School jointly held the "Golden Autumn October" Chinese dance performance. This performance brought together the results of a year of diligent study by students from the two schools, and embodies the hard work of teachers and parents. In order to hold this performance, New Oriental Art School has worked hard for several months to present a strong performance lineup of nearly a hundred actors to the audience. Preparations for the recent performance have reached the final sprint stage. This performance brings together the basic skills of Chinese dance, a collection of dance skills and other exciting content, striving to bring more exciting visual enjoyment and a feast of Chinese art to the audience. Special thanks to the ASU Confucius Institute, Mesa Community College, American Overseas Chinese Newspaper, Mesa Sister Cities Association and other units for their strong support and help. Performance time: October 22nd 2011, 7:00pm Performance location: Rhodes Junior High School 1860 S Longmore, Mesa, AZ 85202

ccc3adf955a9b4e85c655cd53418a2872426da15.sourceText: 金秋十月，上周六（10月1日），凤城著名川剧”变脸王” 陈志钢先生一行四人代表美中文化艺术交流协会参加了在​​Herberger 艺术中心举办的艺术表演节。 坐落在凤凰城市中心的Herberger艺术中心，精美别致，在华丽的西堂坐满了各个族裔的观众, 人们兴高釆烈地观看着各个族裔带耒的精釆表演, 当主持人介绍下面一场 将是凤城华人艺术家陈志钢, 张心志, 范融和杜松林给我们带来精采的中华艺术表演时，场内爆起一片热烈的掌声。 在观众满怀期盼中, 随着高昂的川剧唱腔和豉乐声中, 首先亮相的是一身中国古代武将盛装的’变脸王’陈志钢先生。 陈先生的每一个优美的台步,每一个亮相动作都引起了台下观众的赞叹声。 突然间’变脸王’手向脸上一抹, 瞬间变了面孔, 引起了观众一片惊叫声, 接着又是一片热烈的掌声。 一次次的变脸, 一次次的高潮, 观众的掌声和欢呼声已盖过了川剧的鼓乐声。 观众报以”变脸王”经久不息的掌声。 刚一静下来, 年青艺术家杜松林先生给大家送上一曲优美动人的二胡名曲《欢乐彝寨》使观众沉浸在甜美幽雅的气氛之中。 接着’春江花月夜’的乐声悠扬柔慢地升起, 著名武术家张心志先生踏着乐声给观众献上一套精粹的太极拳, 赢得了一片长长的掌声。 这时画家李成先生(范融)已在台上一边用短短的20分钟现场泼墨挥毫一气呵成完成了一幅的气势傍薄的奔马图。 当他和帮忙的二位观众一起把大作呈献给观众并祝大家”马到成功, 吉祥如意”时, 观众报以一阵又一阵热烈的掌声。 四位艺术家在如雷掌声中谢幕。 观众意犹未尽, 许多人涌到台下询问何时何地下一次演出, 怎样学习中华才艺, 可否买台上骏马图, 如何订购等, 大家对中华文化艺术表现了极大的热情和浓厚的兴趣。
ccc3adf955a9b4e85c655cd53418a2872426da15.translatedText: In the golden autumn of October, last Saturday (October 1), Mr. Chen Zhigang, the famous Sichuan Opera "King of Changing Faces" in Fengcheng, and a group of four people represented the US-China Culture and Art Exchange Association to participate in the art performance festival held at the Herberger Art Center. The Herberger Art Center, located in the center of Phoenix City, is exquisite and unique. The gorgeous west hall is filled with audiences of all ethnic groups. People are happily watching the wonderful performances of various ethnic groups. When the host introduces the next show, which will be Fengcheng Chinese artists Chen Zhigang, Zhang Xinzhi, Fan Rong and Du Songlin, who will give us a wonderful Chinese art performance, the venue burst into warm applause. With the audience full of expectations, accompanied by the high-pitched Sichuan Opera singing and black bean music, the first person to appear was Mr. Chen Zhigang, the "King of Changing Faces" dressed in the costume of an ancient Chinese military commander. Every graceful stage step and every appearance of Mr. Chen aroused admiration from the audience. Suddenly, the 'Face Changing King' touched his face with his hand and instantly changed his face, causing the audience to scream, followed by warm applause. With each change of face and climax again and again, the audience's applause and cheers overshadowed the drumming of Sichuan Opera. The audience gave "The King of Faces" endless applause. As soon as it calmed down, young artist Mr. Du Songlin played a beautiful and moving erhu famous song "Happy Yi Village", which immersed the audience in a sweet and elegant atmosphere. Then the music of "Spring River Flower Moonlight Night" rose melodiously and slowly, and the famous martial artist Mr. Zhang Xinzhi performed a set of quintessential Tai Chi to the audience to the music, winning a long round of applause. At this time, the painter Mr. Li Cheng (Fan Rong) had already completed an imposing galloping horse painting on the stage in just 20 minutes by splashing ink on the spot. When he and the two helpers presented the masterpiece to the audience and wished everyone "immediate success and good luck", the audience responded with bursts of warm applause. The four artists took their final bow amidst thunderous applause. The audience was still interested. Many people rushed to the stage to ask when and where the next performance would be, how to learn Chinese talents, whether they could buy the picture of the horse on stage, how to order it, etc. Everyone showed great enthusiasm and interest in Chinese culture and art.

7441b80ba0064ebf71e66f46fb51a597fe0d2c3a.sourceText: 《时代》评年度影响世界人物 布鲁尔不上榜 （亚省时报） 近日，《时代》杂志评选”2012年最有影响力100人”，曾在预选名单上的亚利桑那州州长珍布鲁尔最终没有进入最后一轮名单，未能成为”2012年影响世界100人”。 亚利桑那州在共和党人珍布鲁尔的领导下，2010年通过引起全美争议的移民法，挑战联邦政府，也引来拉丁美裔族群的强烈不满。 《时代》杂志在网上评选?012年最有影响力100人”，珍布鲁尔因在全美率先签署反移民法案，导致全美数州效仿而列入候选名单。投票结果已经出来，只有26,174人支持珍布鲁尔，26,603投票否决她。负责此项评选的编辑说她还不够突出。 ”2012年最有影响力100人”上榜的公众人物包括总统奥巴马，总统候选人罗恩保罗，歌手阿黛尔，一夜间成为全美少数族裔偶像的篮球新星林书豪。 加布里埃尔吉福兹去年因被枪击而成为2011年名单上的一员。
7441b80ba0064ebf71e66f46fb51a597fe0d2c3a.translatedText: "Time" named annual influential people in the world, but Brewer did not make the list (Alberta Times) Recently, "Time" magazine selected "The 100 Most Influential People in 2012". Arizona Governor Jane Brewer, who was on the pre-selection list, did not make it to the final round of the list and failed to become the "100 Most Influential People in the World in 2012." Arizona, led by Republican Jen Brewer, challenged the federal government by passing immigration laws in 2010 that sparked national controversy and drew strong dissatisfaction among Hispanics. "Time" magazine selected Jane Brewer online as one of the "100 Most Influential People in 2012" because she was the first to sign an anti-immigration bill in the United States, leading several states across the country to follow suit. The voting results have come out. Only 26,174 people supported Jane Brewer and 26,603 voted against her. The editor responsible for this selection said she is not outstanding enough. Public figures on the "100 Most Influential People of 2012" list include President Obama, presidential candidate Ron Paul, singer Adele, and rising basketball star Jeremy Lin who became a national minority idol overnight. Gabrielle Giffords was a member of the 2011 list after being shot last year.

07ddb5e6cc0ee750a602f042566dc971bc3c00a5.sourceText: 房地产网站RentCafe研究了全美最大的100城市，发现不少城市都是租房人口超过了买房人口；这种只租不买的新观念，在房价特别高的湾区，更成为了一种新常态。
07ddb5e6cc0ee750a602f042566dc971bc3c00a5.translatedText: The real estate website RentCafe studied the 100 largest cities in the United States and found that in many cities, the number of people renting exceeds the number of people buying. This new concept of renting but not buying has become a new normal in the Bay Area, where housing prices are particularly high.

27cc8a4f6ceeeca348d70edf50eca9cb6cc37645.sourceText: 除了房价高，使租房变成为唯一的选择，千禧世代不愿被长期房贷所限制，以致只租不买，也是导致不少城市成为租房城市的原因。
27cc8a4f6ceeeca348d70edf50eca9cb6cc37645.translatedText: In addition to high housing prices, which make renting the only option, millennials do not want to be restricted by long-term mortgage loans, so they only rent rather than buy, which is also the reason why many cities have become rental cities.

7d1229532dcd25ced00a4e8d7c557132a08b935e.sourceText: 屋仑59%的人都是租客，而不是房东，成为湾区租房最高比例的城市；旧金山也是租客占多数的城市，所占比例是56%；圣荷西的租客占了42%，屋主则占了58%；佛利蒙是42%，但由2006年至2016年，租房者的比例增加了31%，是全美第6大的租客增幅。
7d1229532dcd25ced00a4e8d7c557132a08b935e.translatedText: 59% of people in Oakland are renters, not landlords, making it the city with the highest proportion of renters in the Bay Area; San Francisco is also a city where renters make up the majority, with a proportion of 56 %; in San Jose, renters accounted for 42%, and homeowners accounted for 58%; in Fremont, it was 42%, but from 2006 to 2016, the proportion of renters increased by 31%, which is the sixth largest increase in renters in the United States.

b6a49d61599432e5ffa0f02e480a38ccf9d74cbe.sourceText: 房地产网站Apartment List的宾纳特(Sydney Bennet)说，2008年房市泡沬破灭后，湾区很多人的房子都被查封和拍卖，不少人都没有再买房；接着，在2009年经济衰退时期中毕业的新生代，因为不能储钱，所以至今都没有买房。
b6a49d61599432e5ffa0f02e480a38ccf9d74cbe.translatedText: Sydney Bennet of the real estate website Apartment List said that after the housing market bubble burst in 2008, many people's houses in the Bay Area were seized and auctioned, and many people stopped buying houses. Then, the new generation who graduated during the economic recession in 2009 have not bought a house yet because they cannot save money.

ad47e6871969bb094cec4a286abe1a1e663c1384.sourceText: 在圣荷西，年轻人要买中间价位的房子，要31年才能储够买房所需的头款；旧金山则要28年。
ad47e6871969bb094cec4a286abe1a1e663c1384.translatedText: In San Jose, it takes 31 years for young people to save the down payment required to buy a house in the middle price range; in San Francisco, it takes 28 years.

822660d482d42063410137029e02c5b48e996a4a.sourceText: 应广东省侨办邀请，本报派出记者参加“海外华媒看广东”活动 （亚省时报广州特约记者杨绮薇报道） 在辛亥革命100周年纪念日即将到来之际，《亚省时报》应邀派出记者，与来自全球五大洲23个国家和地区的58家华文媒体共83名高层和记者一起，参加了广东省侨办 9月20?4日组织举办的”海外华媒看广东”活动。 广东是辛亥革命的发源地，海外华侨与辛亥革命息息相关，孙中山先生曾多次赞誉”华侨为革命之母”。本次”海外华媒看广东”活动以纪念辛亥百年为主题，把辛亥革命作为今年海外华媒采访报道的重点。9月20-21日，全体花文媒体代表怀着虔诚的心参观了黄埔军校、广东华侨博物馆、大元帅府等历史遗迹，深入了解广东华侨华人发展史和辛亥革命史，缅怀华侨华人先烈们在辛亥革命中的光荣事迹和特殊贡献。同时，还游览观赏了花城广场、广州塔,并一起来到黄花岗烈士陵园，给七十二烈士敬献花圈，共同祭拜在黄花岗起义中牺牲的烈士。 21日上午，80多位华媒代表，还与省侨办全体工作人员一起，进行了一次热烈的海外华文媒体与广东侨务工作的交流与研讨。同时，全体华文媒体代表还出席广东华侨博物馆举行的《辛亥百年 华侨丰碑展》开幕仪式并参观了展览。展览利用历史图片、文物、文献资料及文字说明，展示了辛亥革命时期，海外华侨建立革命组织、创办报刊、筹措经费、参加起义等历史事实，再现了华侨在辛亥革命时期做出的伟大贡献。 22-24日，全体华文媒体代表在省侨办组织下，分两条线路到中山、韶关和惠州、河源等地采风考察，了解辛亥革命历史与海外侨胞对祖国和广东的巨大贡献，亲身感受广东加快转型升级、建设幸福广东的成果。《亚省时报》记者与60多名华媒代表组成的采风团，在省侨办副主任林琳的率领下，前往中山、韶关采风。代表们乘坐高铁和轻轨，一路欢声笑语，既感受了城际轻轨对珠江西岸交通一体化所起的重要作用，又体验了大珠三角地区同城化”一小时生活圈”的便捷。通过参观孙中山故居、中国乡镇之星小榄镇，考察了解小榄镇的民生工程建设情况，和参观韶关城市规划馆、沐溪工业园、保障房小区、北伐战争纪念馆以及丹霞山景区等，了解广东侨乡经济建设的步伐与速度。
822660d482d42063410137029e02c5b48e996a4a.translatedText: At the invitation of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Guangdong Province, this newspaper sent reporters to participate in the "Overseas Chinese Media See Guangdong" event (Reported by Yang Qiwei, Special Correspondent of the Alberta Times in Guangzhou) As the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911 is approaching, the "Alberta Times" was invited to send reporters to participate in the "Overseas Chinese Media Watch Guangdong" event organized by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Guangdong Province on September 20-4, together with a total of 83 senior executives and reporters from 58 Chinese-language media in 23 countries and regions on five continents. Guangdong is the birthplace of the Revolution of 1911. Overseas Chinese are closely related to the Revolution of 1911. Mr. Sun Yat-sen has repeatedly praised "overseas Chinese as the mother of the revolution." The theme of this "Overseas Chinese Media Viewing Guangdong" event is to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911, and the Revolution of 1911 will be the focus of overseas Chinese media interviews and reports this year. From September 20th to 21st, all Huawen media representatives visited the Whampoa Military Academy, the Guangdong Overseas Chinese Museum, the Generalissimo's Mansion and other historical sites with piety to gain an in-depth understanding of the development history of the overseas Chinese in Guangdong and the history of the Revolution of 1911, and to commemorate the glorious deeds and special contributions of the overseas Chinese martyrs in the Revolution of 1911. At the same time, they also visited Huacheng Square and Canton Tower, and went to the Huanghuagang Martyrs Cemetery to lay wreaths to the 72 martyrs and jointly worship the martyrs who died in the Huanghuagang Uprising. On the morning of the 21st, more than 80 Chinese media representatives, together with all staff of the Provincial Overseas Chinese Affairs Office, conducted a lively exchange and discussion between overseas Chinese media and Guangdong overseas Chinese affairs. At the same time, all Chinese media representatives also attended the opening ceremony of the "100 Years of Xinhai Overseas Chinese Monument Exhibition" held by the Guangdong Overseas Chinese Museum and visited the exhibition. The exhibition uses historical pictures, cultural relics, documents and text descriptions to show the historical facts such as the establishment of revolutionary organizations, founding newspapers and periodicals, raising funds, and participation in uprisings by overseas Chinese during the Revolution of 1911, and reproduces the great contributions made by overseas Chinese during the Revolution of 1911. From the 22nd to the 24th, all Chinese media representatives, organized by the Provincial Overseas Chinese Affairs Office, visited Zhongshan, Shaoguan, Huizhou, Heyuan and other places in two routes to learn about the history of the Revolution of 1911 and the huge contributions of overseas Chinese to the motherland and Guangdong. They also experienced first-hand the results of Guangdong’s accelerated transformation and upgrading and the construction of a happy Guangdong. A team of reporters from the "Alberta Times" and more than 60 Chinese media representatives, led by Lin Lin, deputy director of the Provincial Overseas Chinese Affairs Office, went to Zhongshan and Shaoguan to collect news. The delegates took the high-speed rail and light rail, laughing and laughing all the way. They not only felt the important role of the intercity light rail in the transportation integration on the west bank of the Pearl River, but also experienced the convenience of the "one-hour living circle" of the Greater Pearl River Delta region's integrated city. By visiting the former residence of Sun Yat-sen and Xiaolan Town, the Star of Chinese Townships, we inspected and understood the construction of livelihood projects in Xiaolan Town, and visited the Shaoguan City Planning Museum, Muxi Industrial Park, affordable housing community, Northern Expedition War Memorial Hall, and Danxia Mountain Scenic Area, etc., to understand the pace and speed of economic construction in the hometown of overseas Chinese in Guangdong.

d4bded2077b9b4d51cd0e2e79683104d124471fe.sourceText: 储蓄创新高 银行低利赶客户 美国人对于经济二度衰退的恐惧加深，纷纷将现金存入金融帐户，储蓄金额已创下近10…
d4bded2077b9b4d51cd0e2e79683104d124471fe.translatedText: Savings hit new highs, banks drive away customers with low interest rates Americans' fear of a second economic recession has deepened, and they have deposited cash in financial accounts, with savings amounts reaching a record high of nearly 10 trillion yuan...

2d239a2dd8789b83cceb1045588e66969ca8909d.sourceText: 储蓄创新高 银行低利赶客户 美国人对于经济二度衰退的恐惧加深，纷纷将现金存入金融帐户，储蓄金额已创下近10兆元新高。 由于银行不需要这么多资金，只好祭出低利率促使客户消念。 这波储蓄潮毫无降温迹象，过去三个月来美国商业银行的帐户金额已激增4290亿元，增幅为10%，几乎是去年整年的两倍。 问题是，银行并不需要这些钱。 有银行业顾问表示，银行与信用合作社尽可能摆脱这些现金，只希望增加贷款。 他说，银行拒绝以更高利率让客户更新定存，并向只开设支票帐户的存款人收取手续费，希望打消客户存款念头，连赚钱的金融机构也不例外。 富国银行(Wells Fargo)已将一年期定存利率腰斩至0.1%，而2009年定存利率订在2%的花旗(Citigroup)，也将利率砍至0.3%。 纽约美隆银行(BNY Mellon)甚至向大型存款客户收取费用，规定存户的单一帐户存款若超过5000万美元就要付费。 低存款利率对于退休者与仰赖利息过活的民众是项惩罚，根据美国经济分析局(BEA)的资料，去年存款利息金额已下滑至5460亿元，远低于2008年的9030亿元。 联准会允诺2013年中旬前将利率维持在近乎零的历史低点不变，存款人想必更加痛苦，也迫使银行严格对待新存款。
2d239a2dd8789b83cceb1045588e66969ca8909d.translatedText: Savings have hit new highs, banks have low interest rates and drive away customers. Americans' fear of a second economic recession has deepened, and they have deposited cash in financial accounts. The amount of savings has hit a new high of nearly 10 trillion yuan. Since banks don't need so much money, they have no choice but to offer low interest rates to discourage customers. This wave of savings shows no sign of cooling down. In the past three months, the amount of accounts in U.S. commercial banks has surged by 429 billion yuan, an increase of 10%, almost double the amount in all of last year. The problem is, the bank doesn't need the money. Banking industry consultants say banks and credit unions are trying to get rid of as much cash as possible and just hope to increase lending. He said that banks refuse to allow customers to renew their time deposits at higher interest rates and charge handling fees to depositors who only open checking accounts, hoping to discourage customers from depositing, even financial institutions that make money are no exception. Wells Fargo has cut its one-year time deposit interest rate in half to 0.1%, while Citigroup, which set the time deposit interest rate at 2% in 2009, has also cut its interest rate to 0.3%. Bank of New York Mellon (BNY Mellon) even charges large deposit customers a fee if their deposits exceed $50 million in a single account. Low deposit interest rates are a punishment for retirees and people who rely on interest. According to the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), the amount of deposit interest fell to 546 billion yuan last year, far lower than 903 billion yuan in 2008. The Federal Reserve has promised to keep interest rates at a record low of nearly zero until mid-2013, which will surely make depositors more miserable and force banks to treat new deposits strictly.

5ebea525454c7a9c8311a90b660a03ed6eac8ee8.translatedText: Immigration Enforcement Bureau arrests illegal immigrants in Los Angeles [Reported by Sasa, compiled by Qiaobao.com on February 14] Federal Immigration Enforcement officials said on Wednesday (14th) that they had arrested...

cb657a56044835e2e0511aad0a70eb976e3ce954.sourceText: 【侨报网编译萨萨2月14日报道】联邦移民执法局官员周三（14日）说，他们已经逮捕了几个违反移民法的人，这是周日（11日）在洛杉矶地区开始的正在进行的执法行动的一部分。
cb657a56044835e2e0511aad0a70eb976e3ce954.translatedText: [Reported by Sasa, compiled by Qiaobao.com on February 14th] Federal Immigration Enforcement officials said on Wednesday (14th) that they had arrested several people who violated immigration laws as part of an ongoing enforcement operation that began in the Los Angeles area on Sunday (11th).

c711ff723719a4e0563137cf05119513c88ee9f3.sourceText: 据圣盖博论坛新闻网报道，联邦移民和海关执法局（U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement，简称ICE）官员说，他们关注的是”对国家安全、对公共安全和边境安全构成威胁的个人”。
c711ff723719a4e0563137cf05119513c88ee9f3.translatedText: According to the San Gabriel Tribune News Network, federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officials said they are concerned about "individuals who pose a threat to national security, public safety and border security."

dcefcbe55e870c05fca88849261ac2b332eb67ac.sourceText: ICE官员在一份声明中说:”这意味着，理想状态下，我们会与当地警察和县监狱合作，从这些机构中鉴定那些对公共安全构成威胁的个人，这些人也存在于非法入境和被驱逐的人当中。”
dcefcbe55e870c05fca88849261ac2b332eb67ac.translatedText: ICE officials said in a statement: "This means that, ideally, we would work with local police and county jails to identify individuals from these facilities who pose a threat to public safety and who are also present in the illegal entry system." "

a9e630504b58126ccd77baff568ad95f7ef6f90c.sourceText: 不过，ICE官员补充道，在像洛杉矶这样的”不太配合的司法管辖区”，他们被迫要”集中更多的资源，在社区内进行大规模逮捕行动”。
a9e630504b58126ccd77baff568ad95f7ef6f90c.translatedText: However, ICE officials added that in "less cooperative jurisdictions" like Los Angeles, they are forced to "focus more resources on conducting large-scale arrests in the community."

f250b86fc1fab4b773b5db49711a1b6149b05619.sourceText: ICE官员还表示，他们已不再遵循优先逮捕标准，因此”所有违反移民法的人都可能会遭到逮捕、拘留，最终将被驱逐出美国。
f250b86fc1fab4b773b5db49711a1b6149b05619.translatedText: ICE officials also stated that they no longer follow priority arrest standards, so "all persons who violate immigration laws may be arrested, detained, and ultimately deported from the United States."

b7677cfffc243b931eeed561330df5459c919e81.sourceText: 据《华尔街日报》周二（13日）消息，自周日以来，联邦官员已经逮捕了100多人，这一行动跨越南加州7个县。ICE官员正在搜寻多达400名可能面临驱逐出境的移民。ICE官员在接受《华尔街日报》采访时表示，这些人中的大多数人都有犯罪记录。
b7677cfffc243b931eeed561330df5459c919e81.translatedText: According to the "Wall Street Journal" on Tuesday (13th), federal officials have arrested more than 100 people since Sunday, an operation that spans ICE officials are searching for up to 400 immigrants who may face deportation in 7 counties in Vietnam. ICE officials said in an interview with the Wall Street Journal that most of these people have criminal records.

7df68f65e7ed9f130ebdc52897a2ee65b17c048a.translatedText: The ICE Los Angeles Regional Operations team includes: Los Angeles, Orange County, Riverside County, San Bernardino (San Bernardino). Bernardino, Ventura, Santa Barbara, San Luis Obispo County

0d5e4dec53c0482959c4c527565c277c7b08d4ac.sourceText: “变迁的中国：机遇和挑战”为主题的讲座在ASU成功举行 （ 曹志斌报导） ２０１１年９月２４日下午，由华美半导体协会凤凰城分会，旅美科学家工程师专业人士协会凤凰城分会以及ASU学生学者联谊会主办的以”变迁的中国：机遇和挑战”为主题的讲座在ASU MU230成功举行。这次讲座特邀商特邀ASU凯瑞(W. P. Carey)商学院副院长，凯瑞商学院MBA中国项目主任贝克伟博士进行主题演讲。 贝教授从中国经济数据分析讲到产业结构调整、区域发展挑战，再到中国教育问题和发展，最后结合十二五规划对中国未来的发展与挑战进行了全面透彻的分析讲解。贝教授的精彩的讲解和具体分析得到现场听众的高度认可。演讲提供了细致全面的分析，给予听众大量信息，同时教授和听众进行多次互动，深入并仔细探讨了大家的问题，让此次讲座成为思想的宴会。三个小时的演讲很快就过去，会后依然有不少听众就相关话题与贝教授继续讨论。最后在大家的热烈掌声中主题讲座成功结束，华美半导体协会凤凰城分会主席Sam赠予贝教授感谢信以表达贝教授对当地华人华侨社区的支持。 ”国事家事天下事，事事关心”，这次演讲让我们了解更多，也增强了我们在当地进行更深入全面讨论的信心，期望广大有志有识的朋友们更多支持我们以后的活动，一起推动共同探讨学习的气氛。
0d5e4dec53c0482959c4c527565c277c7b08d4ac.translatedText: Reported by Cao Zhibin) On the afternoon of September 24, 2011, a lecture with the theme of "Changing China: Opportunities and Challenges" hosted by the Phoenix Chapter of the China-American Semiconductor Association, the Phoenix Chapter of the Association of Scientists and Engineers Professionals in the United States, and the ASU Students and Scholars Association was successfully held in ASU MU230. The special guest for this lecture invited Dr. Beckwei, deputy dean of ASU W. P. Carey Business School and director of the MBA China Program of Carey Business School, to give a keynote speech. Professor Bei started from the analysis of China's economic data, to industrial structure adjustment, regional development challenges, to China's education issues and development, and finally gave a comprehensive and thorough analysis of China's future development and challenges based on the 12th Five-Year Plan. Professor Bei's wonderful explanation and specific analysis were highly recognized by the audience. The lecture provided a detailed and comprehensive analysis and gave the audience a lot of information. At the same time, the professor and the audience had many interactions and discussed everyone's questions in depth and carefully, making this lecture a banquet of ideas. The three-hour speech passed quickly, and many audience members continued to discuss relevant topics with Professor Bei after the meeting. Finally, the theme lecture ended successfully with everyone's warm applause. Sam, chairman of the Phoenix Branch of the China-American Semiconductor Association, presented Professor Bei with a letter of thanks to express Professor Bei's support for the local Chinese community. "National affairs, family affairs, and world affairs, we care about everything." This speech allowed us to understand more and strengthened our confidence in conducting more in-depth and comprehensive discussions locally. We hope that the vast number of knowledgeable friends will support our future activities and promote an atmosphere of joint discussion and learning.

f8617e3e40eb780b3e41da51724b1ea7c0d022ee.sourceText: 大峡谷观光直升机坠毁 3死4伤 美联社消息，一架观光直升飞机10日下午5点30分左右在亚利桑那州境内的大峡谷坠…
f8617e3e40eb780b3e41da51724b1ea7c0d022ee.translatedText: Grand Canyon sightseeing helicopter crashed, 3 killed and 4 injured. According to the Associated Press, a sightseeing helicopter crashed in the Grand Canyon in Arizona at about 5:30 pm on the 10th...

67c35d91ad51aed3bf45b1b1f5291340cba1efa7.sourceText: 美联社消息，一架观光直升飞机10日下午5点30分左右在亚利桑那州境内的大峡谷坠毁。当地华来派(Hualapai)部落警察局局长布兰得利表示，该事故造成3人死亡，4人重伤，救援还在进行。
67c35d91ad51aed3bf45b1b1f5291340cba1efa7.translatedText: According to the Associated Press, a sightseeing helicopter crashed in the Grand Canyon in Arizona at around 5:30 pm on the 10th. Bradley, the local police chief of the Hualapai tribe, said that the accident resulted in 3 deaths and 4 serious injuries, and rescue operations are still ongoing.

026cbd350aebd188991e390385115fbefe112d2d.sourceText: 当时飞机上有7人在该区域进行观光旅行，包括6名旅客和1名飞行员，坠机造成3人死亡，另有4人受伤。事发时目击者第一时间前往查看，但是直升机已经坠落在600英尺深的峡谷中了。
026cbd350aebd188991e390385115fbefe112d2d.translatedText: There were 7 people on the plane on a sightseeing trip in the area at the time, including 6 passengers and 1 pilot. The crash resulted in 3 deaths and 4 injuries. When the incident occurred, witnesses immediately went to check, but the helicopter had already crashed into a 600-foot-deep canyon.

203bf842d0e7041f583256f01a704a7ceb795ba9.sourceText: 摄影师藤本当时正在大峡景区内帮人拍婚纱照，坠机发生后他和人们一起跑过去查看，看到峡谷中的直升机已经起火冒烟。他看到两个女孩还活着，但是峡谷太深了，有人试着爬下去救人，但是地形非常危险。他说，急救部门大约十分钟赶到，但是那是大部分火已经熄灭了。
203bf842d0e7041f583256f01a704a7ceb795ba9.translatedText: >Photographer Fujimoto was taking wedding photos for people in the Grand Canyon Scenic Area. After the crash, he ran over with people to check and saw that the helicopter in the canyon was on fire and smoking. He saw that the two girls were still alive, but the canyon was too deep. Some people tried to climb down to rescue people, but the terrain was very dangerous. Emergency services arrived in about ten minutes, but by that time most of the fire had been extinguished, he said.

4f184a9dbd41aff561201799ac0e9baeaf6e26c7.sourceText: 他说，当时场面一片混乱，有人尖叫，从来没有见过这样的场景。
4f184a9dbd41aff561201799ac0e9baeaf6e26c7.translatedText: He said that the scene was chaotic and some people were screaming. He had never seen such a scene before.

511234ab79d713301ab851a217dca504de428890.sourceText: 坠机地点位于亚利桑那州皮奇斯普林斯（Peach Springs）西北方向60英里处。救援人员正在大峡谷中对幸存者展开营救。
511234ab79d713301ab851a217dca504de428890.translatedText: The crash site is 60 miles northwest of Peach Springs, Arizona. Rescuers are rescuing survivors in the Grand Canyon.

c5672e7d702433c757b44b23ef687ec5459d2880.sourceText: 美国联邦航空管理局通讯处的Kenitzer称，目前尚不清楚坠机的原因。他表示，该坠毁的直升机为欧洲直升机公司的EC130。
c5672e7d702433c757b44b23ef687ec5459d2880.translatedText: Kenitzer of the Federal Aviation Administration's Communications Office said the cause of the crash was still unclear. He said the crashed helicopter was a Eurocopter EC130.

5f17cfb1505613599e5ce2f8a44fd00f49b0a84a.sourceText: 美国联邦航空管理局和美国国家运输安全委员会已经在事故现场展开调查。
5f17cfb1505613599e5ce2f8a44fd00f49b0a84a.translatedText: The Federal Aviation Administration and the National Transportation Safety Board have launched investigations at the scene of the accident.

9a1b9296081cc674e85629bacb4946dc7367a523.sourceText: 六名乘客都来自英国，英国外交和联邦事务部证实了这一点。
9a1b9296081cc674e85629bacb4946dc7367a523.translatedText: All six passengers were from the UK, the Foreign and Commonwealth Office confirmed.

58493ad50ac0ea388a3ec726ac2901ff70ac6142.sourceText: 这架直升机所述的观光旅游公司 Papillon 公司在网站上自称是”全球最大的空中观光公司，游览大峡谷的唯一通道”，2001年8月，该公司直升机在Meadview附近坠毁燃烧，飞行员和五名乘客丧生。2004年NTSB报告中指责飞行员决定降落太快太接近景区大悬崖。
58493ad50ac0ea388a3ec726ac2901ff70ac6142.translatedText: The sightseeing tour company Papillon described in this helicopter claims on its website to be "the world's largest aerial tour company and the only way to visit the Grand Canyon." In August 2001, the company's helicopter crashed and burned near Meadview, killing the pilot and five passengers. A 2004 NTSB report blamed the pilot's decision to land too quickly and too close to the scenic cliff.
