60294a1cfa819631e7368ea73a30e97e890f65a3.sourceText: 亚省中國餐馆协会举辦「历史文化之旅」 亚省中國餐馆协会举辦「历史文化之旅」 （亞省中國餐館協會通訊）二月十一日，亚省中国餐馆协会举办了一次「历史文化之旅」，有近四十位的会员和朋友参加了这次活動。 這次行程，首先去了圖森市的南部，參觀有著「沙漠白鴿」美譽的Mission San Xavier Del Bac天主教堂參觀（五星级景點）。參觀完后，便前往有厚重人文历史的”墓碑镇”（Tombstone），去探訪亚利桑那西部最著名的牛仔城，以及早期亞利桑那中國先民中的奇葩，”中國瑪麗”的傳奇。”中國瑪麗”的故事全美揚名，在報章雜誌有過不少的報道，鳳凰衛視還拍過特輯。這次中國餐館協會組團前往，讓大家感到格外的高興！ 在墓碑鎮第一個停留的地方，是當年鎮上的一間法院。在法院大樓的上面，刻有「1882」的字樣。1882年，是美國通過”排華法案”的一年。從1882年那時開始到1943年，在美華人飽受種族歧視，中國人不能來美，由美國回中國的華人也不能返美，至使60余年来，在美國的華人不断地減少，是做成今天在美國的華人数量占人口總數不到百分之二的主要原因。 而在1880年代，卻是墓碑鎮的繁華時期，因為發現了銀礦，所以四面八方各式各樣的人群便湧入到這個小鎮，當時全鎮有五千人，華人也有數百。 墓碑镇自建立以來至今， 已有130 余年的歷史。此地的老金德斯利马厩（O.K. Corral）曾发生过著名的枪战。有「绝命终结者」之称，这是美國闻名的牛仔城，數十部荷李活電影在此取景和拍攝，每年到此旅遊的人群絡繹不絕。 墓碑镇的另一个传奇，是当年在鎮上被人稱為”中國瑪麗”（China Mary)的中國奇女子，沒有人知道她的真實姓名，只知道她是廣東中山人氏。「中國瑪麗」是以”阿龍的妻子”身份出現墓碑鎮上。她身材豐滿、健美，經常穿著繡著考究的圖案、以絲綢錦緞為多的唐裝，華麗出眾，穿戴著很多與眾不同的珍奇珠寶。”中國瑪麗”辦事手法利落，當年唐人街各行各業都由她經手，身份、契約、找工作、薪水、船費全都由她過目、介紹批準，沒有”中國瑪麗”聯絡搭線，華人很難找到工作。她和舊金山的六大華人會館(有譯成6大公司Six Companie) 有良好的密切關系。那時候大部份的華人都居住在墓碑鎮第三街和第五街一帶。”中國瑪麗”和先生阿龍除了經營自己《坎坎餐廳》 (Can-Can Restaurant)外，還有禮品店、職業介紹所、批發買賣生意，也兼營鴉片館、紅燈區的營業權，夫婦倆的財產非常可觀。白人眼中的”中國瑪麗”就像一個女王一樣，唐人街上的芝麻大小事她都管。是當時唐人街的掌權”大姐大”。直到現在，她的事跡還被人們津津樂道。 在小鎮上，中餐館會成員和到來的朋友們一起欣賞小鎮各式各樣的人文風貌，觀賞了著名的牛仔城槍戰表演，還專門尋訪到”中國瑪麗”原來的故居，並集體拍照留念。在離開墓碑鎮之前，大家還去了建于1870 年代的”鞋山公墓”。這個紀念墓園因當年有很多死于槍戰的牛仔，在埋葬時還穿著高筒的皮鞋而聞名。在這公墓中，有著一些中國先民的墳墓，有些墓碑以商店和餐館名號為墓葬者的姓名，如”福记”（Foo KEE）纪念册上说明：”He owned a grocery store and died from ptomaine poisoning”, 也有一个叫”Quong KEE”的墓碑 。此外，还有二百来个其他族裔人的墳墓，很多墓碑干脆就写着”未知”（unkong )。墓碑上有名字的反而不多，而找到的”中國瑪麗”和她丈夫”阿龍”（AH LNM)的墳墓，墓碑名文也很清楚。”中國瑪麗”是以”阿龍夫人”（Mrs. AH LNM)之名立碑的，去世時67 歲。大家一起向這位”作千秋雄鬼死不還家”的女漢子鞠躬致敬！ 这次由亞省中国餐馆协会組織举辦的”历史文化之旅”，是鳳凰城第一次，华人以团体名誉去墓碑镇探访亚省华人先民历史的旅程，是一次很意义的活动。（張肇鴻報導）
60294a1cfa819631e7368ea73a30e97e890f65a3.translatedText: The Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association held a "Historical and Cultural Tour" The Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association held a "Historical and Cultural Tour" (Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association Newsletter) On February 11, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association held a "Historical and Cultural Tour". Nearly forty members and friends participated in this event. On this trip, we first went to the south of Tucson to visit the Mission San Xavier Del Bac Catholic Church (a five-star attraction) known as the "White Dove of the Desert". After the visit, we headed to Tombstone, a town with rich cultural history, to explore the most famous cowboy town in western Arizona, as well as the legend of "Chinese Mary", a wonder among the early Chinese ancestors of Arizona. The story of "Chinese Mary" became famous across the United States, with many reports in newspapers and magazines, and even a special episode on Phoenix TV. This time the Chinese Restaurant Association organized a group trip, which made everyone feel particularly happy! The first place I stopped in Tombstone was a courthouse in the town. On the top of the court building is the inscription "1882". 1882 was the year the United States passed the Chinese Exclusion Act. From 1882 to 1943, Chinese people in the United States suffered from racial discrimination. Chinese people could not come to the United States, and Chinese people who returned to China from the United States could not return to the United States. As a result, the number of Chinese people in the United States has continued to decrease over the past 60 years. This is the main reason why the number of Chinese people in the United States today accounts for less than 2% of the total population. In the 1880s, it was the prosperous period of Tombstone. Because of the discovery of silver mines, various people from all directions poured into this town. At that time, there were 5,000 people in the town, including hundreds of Chinese. Tombstone has a history of more than 130 years since its establishment. The famous gun battle took place at the Old Kindersley Stables (O.K. Corral) here. Known as the "Terminator", this is a famous cowboy town in the United States. Dozens of Hollywood movies have been filmed here. There is an endless stream of people traveling here every year. Another legend in Tombstone is the strange Chinese woman who was called "China Mary" in the town. No one knows her real name, only that she is from Zhongshan, Guangdong. "Chinese Mary" appears in Tombstone Town as "Aaron's wife". She is plump and muscular. She often wears Tang suits with elaborate embroidery patterns and mostly silk brocades. She is gorgeous and outstanding, and wears many unique and rare jewelry. "China Mary" had a neat way of doing things. At that time, she handled all walks of life in Chinatown. Identity, contract, job search, salary, and shipping fare were all reviewed, introduced and approved by her. Without "China Mary" to contact and connect, it would be difficult for Chinese people to find jobs. She has a good and close relationship with the Six Chinese Associations in San Francisco (translated into Six Companie). At that time, most Chinese people lived in the area of ​​Third Street and Fifth Street in Tombstone. In addition to running their own "Can-Can Restaurant" (Can-Can Restaurant), "China Mary" and her husband Aaron also run a gift shop, an employment agency, a wholesale trading business, and also run the business rights of opium dens and red light districts. The couple's property is very considerable. In the eyes of white people, "China Mary" is like a queen, taking care of everything in Chinatown. She was the "eldest sister" in power in Chinatown at that time. To this day, her deeds are still talked about. In the town, members of the Chinese restaurant club and visiting friends enjoyed the various cultural features of the town, watched the famous Cowboy Town shootout show, and even visited the original home of "China Mary" and took group photos. Before leaving Tombstone, everyone also went to Shoe Hill Cemetery, which was built in the 1870s. This memorial cemetery is famous for the fact that many cowboys who died in gun battles were buried wearing high-top leather shoes. In this cemetery, there are the tombs of some Chinese ancestors. Some of the tombstones have the names of the tombstones with the names of shops and restaurants. For example, the "Foo KEE" memorial book states: "He owned a grocery store and died from ptomaine poisoning", and there is also a tombstone called "Quong KEE". In addition, there are about 200 graves of people of other ethnic groups. Many of the tombstones simply read "unkong". There are not many tombstones with names on them, but the tombstones of "Chinese Mary" and her husband "Alon" (AH LNM) were found, and the inscriptions on the tombstones are also very clear. "Chinese Mary" was erected in the name of "Mrs. AH LNM", who died at the age of 67. Let's bow together to pay tribute to this man who "will never return home until he is dead"! This "Historical and Cultural Tour" organized by the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta is the first time in Phoenix that Chinese people have gone to Tombstone as a group to explore the history of Chinese ancestors in Alberta. It is a very meaningful event. (Reported by Zhang Zhaohong)

010d1c298ec4254100346c0c43a0a6813762f291.sourceText: 虚惊一场 空军基地一度禁闭 因接到”不明身份者潜入基地”的报告，图森戴维斯-蒙森空军基地16日一度进入一级防范禁闭状态。但随后证实系虚惊一场。 戴维斯-蒙森空军基地位于本州图森地区，是美国空军第355战斗机联队驻地。当地时间16日上午，基地接到报告，称一名不明身份枪手潜入基地一栋办公楼藏匿，”形迹可疑”。 当地媒体报道，基地随后进入一级防范紧闭状态，所有交通工具禁止出入，特别武器和战术小组以及拆弹小组到达基地，联邦调查局探员也出现在现场。 军方与当地执法人员合力逐层逐屋排查基地设施。大约5小时后，军方声明，没有发现枪手和武器，一切设施安全，事件系虚惊。
010d1c298ec4254100346c0c43a0a6813762f291.translatedText: A false alarm. The Air Force base was temporarily closed. Due to a report of "unidentified persons sneaking into the base," Tucson's Davis-Monthan Air Force Base briefly entered a first-level precautionary lockdown on the 16th. But it later turned out to be a false alarm. Davis-Monthan Air Force Base is located in the Tucson area of ​​the state and is the home of the U.S. Air Force's 355th Fighter Wing. On the morning of the 16th local time, the base received a report that an unidentified gunman had sneaked into an office building at the base and hid in a "suspicious manner." Local media reported that the base subsequently entered a level 1 lockdown, with all transportation prohibited from entering and exiting. The Special Weapons and Tactics Team and the Bomb Disposal Team arrived at the base, and FBI agents also appeared at the scene. The military and local law enforcement officers worked together to inspect the base facilities floor by floor and house by house. About five hours later, the military stated that no gunmen or weapons were found, all facilities were safe, and the incident was a false alarm.

4cd198125612778ba912cbc268269c0d77ed2f18.sourceText: 甄夫人余藹蓉女士行狀 （亚省时报） 甄夫人余藹蓉女士，開平縣三埠鎮人氏，1936年2月16日出生於中國廣州。不幸於今年九月十三日在醫院去世，積閏享受七十八歲。 甄夫人一九六二年與甄碩欽先生結婚，夫妻恩愛，相敬如賓，隨後育有兩女，逐漸長成，家庭和樂美滿。 甄夫人天資聰穎，求學勤奮，每試名列前茅。曾先後入讀新昌中心學校(小學)，風采中學等，後因熱心教育，故選擇投入長沙師範學院深造。於1955年畢業後開始教書生涯，為人師表。後在達德小學（又稱新昌小學），東河中學（曾稱風采中學初中部）及長沙中學任教。慈母嚴師，深獲學生尊敬。栽培學子，為國家造就人才。經過三十三年教育工作，桃李芬芳，遍及國內和海外，寫下她最有意義的人生歷史。 甄夫人一九八八年移民來美，由於甄氏夫婦在國內從事文化工作，所以一九九一年在本地創立《亞省時報》，擔任總編輯，時報面世，一紙​​風行，為推動華人經濟繁榮，促進僑社和諧進步作出很大貢獻。 甄夫人的才幹受到全美余風采堂的賞識，聘請為全美余風采堂主辦《風采季刊》總編輯，從一九九三年開始，到一九九八年季刊停辦，為余族服務五年，工作卓著。 甄夫人為人誠懇，剛直豪爽，辦事果斷。但她內助賢能，勤儉持家，克盡婦道，庭訓有方。對孫子晚輩非常愛護，無微不至。家庭上下和睦，樂也融融。她系一位賢妻良母。 甄夫人身體健康，後因工作過勞，遂患頑疾，多年纏綿病榻，與病魔抗爭。由於甄太求生意志堅強，曾三次過鬼門關而不入。這可以說，不是閻羅王操縱甄太壽命，而係甄太戲弄閻羅王，不由你不信。 甄夫人一生從事文化教育事業，為社會人群造福，萬代流芳。
4cd198125612778ba912cbc268269c0d77ed2f18.translatedText: Mrs. Zhen’s family history (Alberta Times) Mrs. Zhen, Ms. Yu Airong, was born in Sanbu Town, Kaiping County on February 16, 1936 in Guangzhou, China. Unfortunately, he passed away in the hospital on September 13 this year, at the age of 78. Mrs. Zhen married Mr. Zhen Shuoqin in 1962. The couple loved each other and respected each other as guests. Later, they had two daughters, who gradually grew up and their family was harmonious and happy. Mrs. Zhen is talented, diligent in her studies, and ranks among the best in every exam. He attended Xinchang Central School (primary school), Fengcai Middle School, etc. Later, because of his enthusiasm for education, he chose to study in Changsha Normal University. After graduating in 1955, he began his teaching career and served as a role model for others. Later, he taught at Dade Primary School (also known as Xinchang Primary School), Donghe Middle School (formerly known as the junior high school of Fengcai Middle School) and Changsha Middle School. A loving mother and a strict teacher, she is deeply respected by her students. Cultivate students and create talents for the country. After thirty-three years of education work, Tao Li Fenfang has traveled all over the country and overseas, writing her most meaningful life history. Mrs. Zhen immigrated to the United States in 1988. Since the Zhens were engaged in cultural work in China, they founded the "Alberta Times" locally in 1991 and served as editor-in-chief. The Times was launched and became a hit, making great contributions to promoting the economic prosperity of the Chinese and promoting the harmonious progress of the overseas Chinese community. Mrs. Zhen's talents were appreciated by Yu Fengcai Hall across the United States, and she was hired as the chief editor of "Fengcai Quarterly" sponsored by Yu Fengcai Hall across the country. From 1993 to the closure of the quarterly in 1998, she served the Yu family for five years with outstanding work. Mrs. Zhen is sincere, upright and decisive. However, she is capable of helping the virtuous, diligent and thrifty in housekeeping, restrains herself to women's ethics, and has good court training. He loves his grandchildren very much and takes great care of them. The family is harmonious and happy. She is a good wife and mother. Mrs. Zhen was in good health. Later, due to overwork, she contracted a stubborn illness. She stayed in bed for many years, fighting against the illness. Due to Mrs. Zhen's strong will to survive, she had to pass through the gates of hell three times but failed to enter. It can be said that it is not King Yama who manipulates Mrs. Zhen’s life span, but Mrs. Zhen teasing King Yama. You can’t help but believe it. Mrs. Zhen has been engaged in cultural and educational undertakings throughout her life, benefiting the society and making her famous for generations to come.

c9c355ac94ba8a3e26beeffab9055cf1a6bba5f5.sourceText: 悼念藹蓉 藹儀 你、我是两姊妹嗎？ 不是，不是！ 相貌不同，高矮不一！ 可為什么你們的姓名如此接近相像？ 因為你的父母與我的父母對女兒有相同的祝愿吧！ 藹蓉與藹儀就這樣被老師和同學們認定是姊妹俩了。 那是1949年小學六年级。 我們經歷过土改、反右、公社化等政治风云变幻的場面， 還有我們忍受着只能吃得半飽、饑腸如鸣的肚子， 可是我們相信新中国的明天會更好！ 所以還經常哼着”解放區的天，是晴朗的天”的歌， 你和我就是在這些矛盾現实中悄悄地交換自己的 痛苦，疑慮與希望之中一起成長！ 我們终於操一技之長，走入社会， 為人民服务了！ 你，是教師，當年被誉為人类灵魂的工程師！ 你以孜孜不倦，循循善誘的精神與愛心 把無數頑劣兒童改造成優秀學生！ 家長們感謝您，學生們更感謝你！ 我欣賞你的愛心與敬業精神！ 你，墮入情纲了， 也許周圍的人並不支持你，理解你， 但你堅信你的至爱是一块未被人們注意的璞玉， 你勇敢地衝破了階级、地位、金錢與世俗偏見的藩篱， 與他結合了！ 我，敬佩你的勇氣和慧眼識英雄的選擇！ 史無前例的文化大革命來了！ 以千鈞之力衝击着所有的人，尤其是知識份子！ 你們夫婦都不能幸免， 你，陪伴着他住進”牛棚”， 你，與他並肩被推上街頭示眾遊行， 那時你們的小女兒出生了才两、三個月！ 因為你堅信他，你的丈夫是無顧的、清白的！ 我，敬佩你力頂風暴的無畏精神和對丈夫不离不棄的真摯情感！ 移民美國了，來到了這長着仙人掌的沙漠之地， 你們已經年過半百还要從零開始？ 是的，蒼山如碧，夕陽如血，從頭越！ 你俩以堅忍不拔的精神，细緻敏銳的目光和無限的智慧， 你俩以開荒牛的蠻勁， 以辛勤的汗水， 在異國他鄉， 澆灌了沙漠的一片綠洲！终於開創一塊属於你們栽培的新天地！ 我，為你們高興！為你們驕傲！ 由於長年累月的奋斗， 過度的劳累，食無定量，睡不準時， 你累壞了身體，耗尽了精力， 你病倒了。 藹蓉：我的摯友！我的好姊妹！你聽到我的呼喚嗎？你看到了我寫給你的這封信嗎？ 藹儀寫於2009年3月16日深夜 藹蓉：你醒過來了嗎？ 你要醒過來看見杰仔頭載方帽，手執大學畢業文憑 奔向社会！ 你要醒過來聽見杰思帶領弟妹們 朗頌詩歌！ 你要醒過來欣賞前院盛開的 萬紫千红的芬芳玟瑰花！ 你要醒過來親手摘下後園的 香甜的橙果！ 你要醒過來與你至愛的丈夫 執子之手，與子偕老啊！ 藹蓉、藹蓉：親愛的姊妹，你醒过來吧！ 藹儀2009年6月4日清晨 硕欽友：很久沒問候你們了，每於午夜或清晨經常思念，我不知怎樣表達我的感情。三月份當小女方向、方式去鳳凰誠之前我寫了前面的一段，後來我决定親自去一趟鳳凰誠見見你俩。這一趟，我後天又要出發到夏威夷小女方圆家去協助哄孫，心裡又記掛你們，難過的是我幫不了你們，所以又寫了這么一小段，我不会寫詩，只是胡乱在紙上寫幾行字，表達我的感情，萬望見諒！ 秀儒於五月底返大陸参加祖居逸農盧歷史展覽的開幕式，現尚未回來，順及。 希你多多保重！ 藹儀2009年6月4日 二零一一年九月十三日清晨接到杰仔打來的电话: 外婆今晨去世了!!! 藹蓉: 你真的走了嗎? 你卧病在床已經幾年了 數不尽的-醫藥針刺; 捱不尽的手術割痛; 听不尽的急救車震耳欲聾呼嘯; 聞不尽的病房的怪味; 啊, 姊妹: 這一切都己过去了. 你, 终於從肉体的痛苦中解脫出來了! 我衷心恳切地祈求: 天主賜你永福! 天使迎你升天! 痛失良朋淚滿襟, 天涯何處尋芳踪? 寄望天使迎你歸, 他日云端又相逢! 藹儀拜泣2011年9月15日晨4:30
c9c355ac94ba8a3e26beeffab9055cf1a6bba5f5.translatedText: In memory of Airong Aiyi, are you and I two sisters? No, no! Different looks, different heights! But why are your names so similar? Because your parents and my parents have the same wishes for their daughter! In this way, Airong and Aiyi were recognized as sisters by their teachers and classmates. It was the sixth grade of elementary school in 1949. We have experienced political changes such as land reform, anti-rightism, communeization, etc., and we have endured half-full and hungry stomachs, but we believe that the future of New China will be better! So I often hum the song "The sky in the liberated areas is sunny". You and I quietly exchange our pain, doubts and hopes and grow together in these contradictory realities! We finally used our skills to enter the society and serve the people! You are a teacher, who was known as the engineer of the human soul back then! With your tireless, persuasive spirit and love, you have transformed countless naughty children into outstanding students! Parents thank you, students thank you even more! I appreciate your love and professionalism! You have fallen in love. Maybe the people around you do not support you or understand you, but you firmly believe that your beloved is a piece of rough jade that has not been noticed by people. You bravely break through the barriers of class, status, money and secular prejudice, and combine with him! I admire your courage and your choice to recognize heroes! The unprecedented Cultural Revolution is coming! It impacts everyone with great force, especially intellectuals! You and your wife were not spared. You accompanied him to live in the "cow shed", and you were pushed side by side with him on the streets for public demonstrations. At that time, your little daughter was only two or three months old! Because you firmly believe in him, your husband is careless and innocent! I admire your fearless spirit in weathering the storm and your sincere love for your husband! You immigrated to the United States and came to this desert land with cacti. You are already over fifty and you still have to start from scratch? Yes, the Cangshan Mountain is as green and the setting sun is like blood, crossing from the beginning! With your perseverance, meticulous and keen vision, and infinite wisdom, with the brute strength of pioneering cattle, and with your hard work, you watered an oasis in the desert in a foreign country! Finally create a new world for your cultivation! I'm happy for you! So proud of you! Due to years of hard work, overwork, insufficient food, and failure to sleep on time, your body is exhausted, your energy is exhausted, and you fall ill. Airong: My dear friend! My good sister! Do you hear my call? Have you seen this letter I wrote to you? Ai Yi wrote in the middle of the night on March 16, 2009 Ai Rong: Are you awake? You want to wake up and see Jacky heading towards society with a square hat on his head and a college diploma in his hand! You have to wake up and hear Jiesi leading his brothers and sisters in reciting poetry! You have to wake up and enjoy the colorful and fragrant roses blooming in the front yard! You have to wake up and pick the sweet orange fruits in the backyard with your own hands! You have to wake up and hold hands with your beloved husband and grow old together! Airong, Airong: Dear sister, wake up! Ai Yi Early morning of June 4, 2009 Shuo Qinyou: I haven’t greeted you for a long time. I miss you all the time at midnight or early in the morning. I don’t know how to express my feelings. I wrote the previous paragraph before I went to Fenghuangcheng as a little girl in March. Later, I decided to go to Fenghuangcheng in person to meet you two. On this trip, the day after tomorrow, I will set off to my little girl Fangyuan's house in Hawaii to help coax my grandson. I am thinking about you again. Unfortunately, I can't help you, so I wrote this short paragraph. I can't write poetry, I just scribbled a few lines on the paper to express my feelings. Please forgive me! Xiu Ru returned to the mainland at the end of May to attend the opening ceremony of the historical exhibition of his ancestral home in Yinonglu, but he has not returned yet. By the way. I hope you take good care of yourself! Ai Yi June 4, 2009 I received a call from Jie Zi in the early morning of September 13, 2011: Grandma passed away this morning!!! Ai Rong: Are you really gone? You have been bedridden for several years. Countless medical acupunctures; endless surgical cuts; the deafening roar of ambulances that can’t be heard; the strange smell of the ward that can’t be smelled; ah, sister: all of this has passed. You, Finally freed from physical pain! I sincerely pray: God bless you forever! Angels will welcome you to heaven! I am filled with tears after losing a good friend. Where can I find her trace at the end of the world? I hope that angels will welcome you back and we will meet again in the clouds one day! Aiyi weeps at 4:30 am on September 15, 2011.

67f8d679158b23a7a4b4ec0320167eaf0db01641.sourceText: 雷霆行动 警方摧毁贩毒集团 上周四，在一个由移民与海关执法局、国土安全局和皮纳尔郡警方等多方联合行动中，六名男子被捕，警方相信其中一名28岁墨裔疑犯为毒品组织首领。 当天的行动从清晨开始，执法人员手持七个搜查令，在钱德勒、美莎等玛利科巴郡地区搜查，共搜出10支非法收藏枪械和两件防弹背心。 警方二月已经开始对该贩毒集团调查。 ”种种迹象表明，这个组织一直在墨西哥和凤凰城之间走私毒品，”行动的负责人马特说。”本次行动已经揭露并摧毁了这个贩毒网络。” 六名疑犯将面临亚利桑那州和联邦毒品走私和私藏武器等罪名检控。
67f8d679158b23a7a4b4ec0320167eaf0db01641.translatedText: Operation Thunder Police Dismantled Drug Cartel Last Thursday, in a joint operation involving Immigration and Customs Enforcement, Homeland Security and Pinal County police, six men were arrested. Police believed that one of the 28-year-old Mexican suspects was the leader of a drug organization. The day's operation began in the early morning. Law enforcement officers armed with seven search warrants searched in Chandler, Mesa and other areas of Maricopa County, and found a total of 10 illegally collected firearms and two bulletproof vests. Police began investigating the drug syndicate in February. "There is every indication that this organization has been smuggling drugs between Mexico and Phoenix," said Matt, who led the operation. "This operation has exposed and dismantled this drug trafficking network." The six suspects will face Arizona and federal prosecutions for drug trafficking and concealed weapons.

b1a7be51c26ad901f70ad2873b106cedd0528d6e.sourceText: 广州今年首批经适房首日售出234套 本报广州特约记者杨绮薇报道）2011年9月17日，广州今年首批经济适用房开始现场认购，首日共有234户居民认购到”心水房”，有16户家庭弃购。 广州今年首批推出的3824套经济适用房主要集中在广氮花园、安厦花园，还有120套散落于6大成熟小区内。这批经适房中，以两房一厅的中小户型为主，除了零星房源之外，其他面积都在70平方米以下，基准价为2470?445元/平方米。房屋总价最高为30万元左右，最低为20万元左右。 9月17日一早，数百名符合条件的住房困难家庭市民前来排队认购，好多人焦急地围挤在销售中心房源信息看板前，争相选房，场面相当火爆。排在77号的曾女士激动得连样板房都没看就直接过来选房，她挑了一套位于广氮花园、建筑面积约68平方米的三房一厅，并当场交了1万元的定金。”我已经排了3年，等急了”她说。认购队列中坐在轮椅上的50岁残疾人周志辉尤其引人注意，他选购了一套聚德花园的经适房，主要看中其临近地铁，交通方便。”我的经适房总价46万元，首付13.8万元，都是靠向亲戚和朋友东凑西借才勉强应付，但月供相当吃力，几乎将我的月收入全部抵上了。”周志辉希望能找到一家银行提供更优惠的利率，但他现场接连咨询了多家银行，得到的答复都是没有折扣或者没有更低利率。”我只能咬紧牙解决月供问题了。”与周志辉一样，许多低收入的住房困难家庭都期待，购买经济适用房时能降低首付成数和提高利率优惠。 短短一天内，已有234户挑到了”心水房”，实现了自己的安居梦。但也有16户居民放弃了认购权。据悉，如果累计3次弃购，申购者的购房资格将被取消。
b1a7be51c26ad901f70ad2873b106cedd0528d6e.translatedText: > The first batch of affordable housing in Guangzhou sold 234 units on the first day this year. Reported by Yang Qiwei, our special reporter in Guangzhou) On September 17, 2011, the first batch of affordable housing in Guangzhou this year began to be purchased on-site. On the first day, a total of 234 households subscribed to the "favorite housing", and 16 households gave up the purchase. The first batch of 3,824 affordable housing units launched in Guangzhou this year are mainly concentrated in Guangni Garden and Anxia Garden, with 120 units scattered in six mature communities. This batch of affordable housing is mainly small and medium-sized units with two bedrooms and one living room. Except for sporadic housing, the other areas are less than 70 square meters, and the base price is 2,470 to 445 yuan/square meter. The highest total price of a house is about 300,000 yuan, and the lowest is about 200,000 yuan. On the morning of September 17, hundreds of eligible citizens from families with housing difficulties came to line up to subscribe. Many people crowded anxiously in front of the housing information board in the sales center, vying to choose a house. The scene was quite heated. Ms. Zeng, who was ranked No. 77, was so excited that she came directly to choose a house without even looking at the model house. She chose a three-bedroom, one-living house located in Guangniu Garden with a construction area of ​​about 68 square meters, and paid a deposit of 10,000 yuan on the spot. "I have been waiting for three years and am impatient," she said. Zhou Zhihui, a 50-year-old disabled person in a wheelchair who was in the subscription queue, particularly attracted attention. He chose an affordable apartment in Jude Garden because of its proximity to the subway and convenient transportation. "The total price of my affordable house is 460,000 yuan, and the down payment is 138,000 yuan. I can barely make it through borrowing from relatives and friends, but the monthly payment is very difficult, which almost covers all of my monthly income." Zhou Zhihui hoped to find a bank to provide a more favorable interest rate, but he consulted several banks on the spot, and the answers he received were that there was no discount or no lower interest rate. "I can only bite the bullet and solve the monthly payment problem." Like Zhou Zhihui, many low-income families with housing difficulties are looking forward to lower down payment ratios and higher interest rate discounts when purchasing affordable housing. In just one day, 234 households have selected their "favorite housing" and realized their dream of housing in peace. However, 16 residents gave up their subscription rights. It is reported that if a total of three abandoned purchases are made, the applicant's qualifications for home purchase will be cancelled.

95c343875099cd06e2c0d730a5d1838943711bab.sourceText: 为庆祝凤凰城和成都建立友好城市２５周年，凤凰城友城协会特邀成都大学艺术院和成都川剧院来凤凰城作友好访问演出。 成都的艺术家们将于１０月１４日，１５日在本地世界级的乐器博物馆献上三场精彩绝妙的演出。 节目包括了民族歌曲，舞蹈，器乐，原声歌曲，魔术，以及川剧演唱及其绝活川剧变脸。 这台节目一定会让大家赏心悦目，在充满传统中华民族和巴蜀风味的文艺表演中度过一个愉快的时光。 同时，大家还可以尽情地观赏一下MIM这座刚开馆不到一年的世界级乐器博物馆。 请大家尽快与MIM联系购票。
95c343875099cd06e2c0d730a5d1838943711bab.translatedText: To celebrate the 25th anniversary of the establishment of sister cities between Phoenix and Chengdu, the Phoenix Sister Cities Association specially invited the Art Academy of Chengdu University and the Chengdu Sichuan Opera House to perform in Phoenix for a friendly visit. Artists from Chengdu will present three wonderful performances at the local world-class musical instrument museum on October 14th and 15th. The program includes ethnic songs, dances, instrumental music, original songs, magic, as well as Sichuan Opera singing and its unique Sichuan Opera face-changing. This show will surely please everyone, and they will have a pleasant time in the cultural performance full of traditional Chinese and Bashu flavor. At the same time, everyone can also enjoy MIM, a world-class musical instrument museum that just opened less than a year ago. Please contact MIM as soon as possible to purchase tickets.

38018cfd0c06ac452c6bbd562ebdee8def56f9ae.sourceText: 答: 欧巴马政府最近宣布的暂缓遣返非法移民新准则,并非是大赦可拿绿卡的新政策,而是国土安全部宣布，政府将检讨联邦移民法院待处理的大约30万个遣返案，行使 「检查裁量权」(prosecutorial discretion)，让没有暴力或犯罪案底等危险因素的非法移民暂缓遣返. ​​特别是对于受虐者报案,并不会因为报案后因为没身份而被移民局逮捕或被拘留 ，如果是且没有案底的大学生也可以争取撤销遣返。 不过目前尚不清楚新准则在各地的影响有多广。 全美各地的移民律师表示，他们希望联邦官员打电话通知移民律师争取撤销遣返的事例能更加普遍。 新准则引起共和党人士狠批欧巴马政府意图「开后门大赦」(backdoor amnesty)非法移民，但国土安全部长辩称，此举将「提升公共安全」，因为政府把人力和物力专用于遣返那些 对国家安全构成威胁的非法移民，暂缓遣返对国家安全和公共安全不构成威胁的移民。 根据新准则，符合「梦想法案」(DREAM Act)建议案规定的许多年轻非法移民，都可暂缓遣返，甚至寻求豁免。
38018cfd0c06ac452c6bbd562ebdee8def56f9ae.translatedText: Answer: The new guidelines for the moratorium on deportation of illegal immigrants recently announced by the Obama administration are not a new policy of amnesty for those who can get a green card. Instead, the Department of Homeland Security announced that the government will review about 300,000 deportation cases pending in the federal immigration courts and exercise "prosecutorial discretion" to allow illegal immigrants who do not have dangerous factors such as violence or criminal records to defer deportation. Especially for those who report abuse, they will not be arrested or detained by the Immigration Bureau due to lack of status after reporting the crime. , if you are a college student without a criminal record, you can also seek to cancel the deportation. But it's unclear how widespread the new guidelines will be across the country. Immigration lawyers across the country say they hope it will become more common for federal officials to call immigration lawyers to try to reverse deportations. The new guidelines have caused Republicans to criticize the Obama administration for its intention to provide "backdoor amnesty" to illegal immigrants. However, the Secretary of Homeland Security argued that this move will "enhance public safety" because the government will dedicate manpower and material resources to deporting illegal immigrants who pose a threat to national security and suspend the deportation of immigrants who do not pose a threat to national security and public safety. Under the new guidelines, many young illegal immigrants who meet the requirements of the DREAM Act proposals could be deferred from deportation or even seek exemptions.

a1240a25543690e3961a5556d21a848cd706af02.sourceText: 国土安全部长表示，将对包括「梦想学生」在内的约30万名在联邦移民法院中面对遣返的非法移民，进行个案审查，对没有犯罪纪录者将无限期延后遣返，并对他们 提供申请工卡的机会。 这项政策改变将着重于遣返被定罪，和可能威胁国家及公安的非法移民。 今年6月移民与海关执法局长莫顿对探员发出一项备忘录，指示他们对移民案如何加以裁量，这些指示适用于符合「梦想法案」规定的年轻非法移民。 莫顿的备忘录建议探员考虑该非法移民待在美国有多久、其配偶或子女是否为美国公民，以及是否有犯罪纪录。 政府官员强调，无限期延后遣返没有犯罪纪录的非法移民，将可加速优先遣返犯下重罪的非法移民。 但无限期延后遣返，也不会使非法移民成为合法移民，可是会将让他们申请工作许可。 「按照法律，他们可以获得工卡，那基本上是纳税人身分识别卡(tax payer ID card)，但是否发给工卡将根据个案来决定。」这位官员说，此政策改变将让当局 有机会使一些案件根本不进入法院系统，新政策对移民探员发出的信息是「你不需要把经手的每一个人送入法院系统」
a1240a25543690e3961a5556d21a848cd706af02.translatedText: The Secretary of Homeland Security stated that approximately 300,000 illegal immigrants, including "Dream Students", who face deportation in federal immigration courts will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis, and deportation will be postponed indefinitely for those without criminal records, and they will be provided with the opportunity to apply for work cards. This policy change will focus on deporting illegal immigrants who have been convicted of crimes and may threaten the country and public security. In June of this year, Immigration and Customs Enforcement Director Morton issued a memo to agents instructing them on how to handle immigration cases. These instructions apply to young illegal immigrants who qualify for the "Dream Act". Morton's memo advises agents to consider how long the illegal immigrant has been in the United States, whether his spouse or children are U.S. citizens and whether he has a criminal record. Government officials emphasized that indefinitely delaying the deportation of illegal immigrants without criminal records will speed up the priority deportation of illegal immigrants who have committed serious crimes. However, indefinitely delaying deportation will not turn illegal immigrants into legal immigrants, but will allow them to apply for work permits. "By law, they can get an employment card, which is basically a tax payer ID card, but whether they are issued an employment card will be decided on a case-by-case basis." The official said that this policy change will give authorities the opportunity to prevent some cases from entering the court system at all. The message of the new policy to immigration agents is that "you don't need to send everyone you handle into the court system."

269c66adef8d0ba00019a13010d9eb663d487627.translatedText: Russian experts: It will take at most 15 years for the RMB to become the main currency for international settlements. Sina US Stock News, Beijing time on the 16th. Russian Satellite Network reported that the Russian Academy of Sciences...

88d49631fe536f0641675cf31b8c4eebe3c24484.sourceText: 新浪美股讯 北京时间16日 俄罗斯卫星网报道，俄罗斯科学院远东研究所副所长安德烈.奥斯特洛夫斯基表示，人民币需要10年至15年的时间，作为国际结算主要货币排挤美元和欧元的地位。
88d49631fe536f0641675cf31b8c4eebe3c24484.translatedText: Sina US Stock News, Beijing time on the 16th. Russian Sputnik reported that Andrei Ostrovsky, deputy director of the Institute of Far Eastern Studies of the Russian Academy of Sciences, said that it will take 10 to 15 years for the RMB to become the main currency for international settlements to crowd out the U.S. dollar and the euro.

0460fcbfb4bdbe35650399a2bf277a25f23cb6a5.sourceText: 环球同业银行金融电讯协会（SWIFT）早些时候发布报告称，2017年人民币国际支付占比达到1.6%。
0460fcbfb4bdbe35650399a2bf277a25f23cb6a5.translatedText: The Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) earlier released a report stating that the proportion of RMB international payments in 2017 reached 1.6%.

10431968f07669441c124d3164d9547dda86a878.sourceText: 奥斯特洛夫斯基认为，人民币全球交易使用量排名较低的原因是，大众还没有习惯使用人民币作为国际交易货币。
10431968f07669441c124d3164d9547dda86a878.translatedText: Ostrovsky believes that the reason why the RMB’s global transaction usage ranks low is that the public has not yet become accustomed to using the RMB as an international transaction currency.

b666ec1d3ea514ac569cecfee347937371e6a4ab.sourceText: 他说：”暂时所有人都习惯使用美元和欧元。东方习惯用美元，欧洲是欧元。随着中国经济发展和经贸关系的扩大，人民币将找到自己的位置。起码在东南亚地区和东南亚国家联盟，人民币已经找到位置。”
b666ec1d3ea514ac569cecfee347937371e6a4ab.translatedText: He said: "For the time being, everyone is accustomed to using U.S. dollars and euros. The East is accustomed to using U.S. dollars, and Europe is using Euros. With China's economic development and the expansion of economic and trade relations, the RMB will find its place. At least in Southeast Asia and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, the RMB has already found its place."

23c93b913f58443d182072576f1cce12c1185f72.sourceText: 他表示，中国人民币需要至少10年时间，才能在全球支付货币的排名名列前茅。
23c93b913f58443d182072576f1cce12c1185f72.translatedText: He said that it will take at least 10 years for China's RMB to be at the top of the global payment currency rankings.

20a607960d7ab08af8170e23bc6711d43703587a.sourceText: 他说：”我认为，需要等10年至15年时间，人民币才能在国际支付中达到一个较大的比例。为此，人民币应当从美元和欧元那里夺取份额。中国将逐步占领东南亚和非洲的金融市场。但在拉美国家，人民币的作为有限，因为那里是美元的世袭领地。”
20a607960d7ab08af8170e23bc6711d43703587a.translatedText: He said: "I think it will take 10 to 15 years for the RMB to reach a larger proportion in international payments. To this end, the RMB should seize share from the US dollar and the euro. China will gradually occupy the Southeast Financial markets in Asia and Africa. But in Latin American countries, the role of the RMB is limited because it is the hereditary territory of the US dollar. "

05ef0645dc522216c6dd1a2ed938fb68c2dfadd6.sourceText: SWIFT发布的报告还指出，人民币在俄罗斯的使用率达到0.12%。奥斯特洛夫斯基表示，俄商业界应更积极使用人民币。
05ef0645dc522216c6dd1a2ed938fb68c2dfadd6.translatedText: The report released by SWIFT also pointed out that the usage rate of the RMB in Russia reached 0.12%. Ostrovsky said that the Russian business community should be more active in using the renminbi.

3af9955d9296cf51e3df5b19daca959674902a01.sourceText: 他说：”俄商业还没有使用人民币，这对于俄罗斯来说是一个负面的情况。我们谈到，中国是我们的伙伴和盟友，但我们通过美元在交易，这使我们都受损失。我们应当和中国使用人民币进行贸易，我们拥有共同的边界和一系列合作项目。”
3af9955d9296cf51e3df5b19daca959674902a01.translatedText: He said: "Russian business has not yet used RMB, which is a negative situation for Russia. We talked about China as our partner and ally, but we trade through US dollars, which makes us all suffer losses. We should use RMB to trade with China. We have a common border and a series of cooperation projects."

7c4c341eaadddba7255e67dcdd7cf9b5143d5fe1.sourceText: 奥斯特洛夫斯基还表示，俄中双边贸易增长能够使人民币支付的占比上升。
7c4c341eaadddba7255e67dcdd7cf9b5143d5fe1.translatedText: Ostrovsky also said that the growth of bilateral trade between Russia and China can increase the proportion of RMB payments.

ade0f41fee9bfeb2cfbbbb2ba240168f0396c88d.sourceText: 俄中2017年贸易额同比增长20.8%，达到840亿美元。
ade0f41fee9bfeb2cfbbbb2ba240168f0396c88d.translatedText: The trade volume between Russia and China in 2017 increased by 20.8% year-on-year, reaching US$84 billion.

3675f24b95d6c871adff65d46014dd84e93977fa.sourceText: 2016年10月1日，人民币正式加入国际货币基金组织（IMF）特别提款权（SDR）货币篮子。SDR货币篮子相应扩大至美元、欧元、人民币、日元、英镑5种货币，人民币在其中的权重为10.92%，美元、欧元、日元和英镑的权重分别为41.73%、30.93%、8.33%和8.09%。
3675f24b95d6c871adff65d46014dd84e93977fa.translatedText: On October 1, 2016, the RMB officially joined the International Monetary Fund (IMF) Special Drawing Rights (SDR) currency basket. The SDR currency basket was accordingly expanded to include five currencies: the US dollar, the euro, the renminbi, the Japanese yen, and the pound sterling. The RMB's weight in it is 10.92%, and the weights of the US dollar, the euro, the yen, and the pound sterling are 41.73%, 30.93%, 8.33%, and 8.09% respectively.

b8e5271adc499b722d60448873d00344c81ee963.sourceText: 第28届凤凰城中国周即将开幕 亚利桑那的华人有谁没有去过中国週的吧？每逢中国春节，凤凰城的中国周，28年来陪伴着我们这些海外侨胞，与数以万计的亚利桑那民众一起，为大家带来了一场历时三天，喜气洋洋，欢声笑语，莺歌燕舞的春节大联欢。
b8e5271adc499b722d60448873d00344c81ee963.translatedText: The 28th Phoenix China Week is about to open. Is there any Chinese in Arizona who hasn’t been to China Week? Every Chinese New Year, China Week in Phoenix has accompanied us overseas Chinese for 28 years, and together with tens of thousands of Arizonans, has brought everyone a three-day Spring Festival celebration filled with joy, laughter, singing and dancing.

c6012e534c81ac4af994efc7ec3bc901dbb132ab.sourceText: 那些美妙民族歌舞，精深的绘画、书法艺术、手工制作，精细的民间剪纸工艺、多彩的民族服饰、精湛的茶道、威武的武术和风趣的舞狮．…。
c6012e534c81ac4af994efc7ec3bc901dbb132ab.translatedText: Those wonderful folk songs and dances, exquisite paintings, calligraphy arts, hand-made crafts, fine folk paper-cutting crafts, colorful national costumes, exquisite tea ceremonies, mighty martial arts and interesting lion dances. ….

529bb47f51c8e68d428d2e3af90fd0028548da66.sourceText: 在罕见的人山人海之中，您会感到中华文化的悠久和灿烂。一种民族自豪感会从您的心底，透闪出那掩不住的微笑。中国人在异国他乡仍可感受到过年的喜庆和欢乐！
529bb47f51c8e68d428d2e3af90fd0028548da66.translatedText: In the rare sea of ​​​​people, you will feel the longevity and splendidness of Chinese culture. A sense of national pride will shine through your unconcealable smile from the bottom of your heart. Chinese people can still feel the celebration and joy of the New Year in a foreign country!

cf99e3705c63195690f178e7301d2ab0fdb1a46c.sourceText: 凤凰城中国周委员会组织举办的第28届庆祝中国新春佳节2018 农历新年，”狗年”的中国周活动将于2月16日周五早晨九点拉开帷幕。中国周历时三天，于周日2月18日下午五点结束。
cf99e3705c63195690f178e7301d2ab0fdb1a46c.translatedText: The 28th China Week event organized by the Phoenix China Week Committee to celebrate the 2018 Chinese New Year, the "Year of the Dog", will kick off at 9 a.m. on Friday, February 16th. China Week lasts for three days and ends at 5pm on Sunday, February 18th.

d243ba25f51df71225a345aea6b0c76253ceebb7.sourceText: 中国周地址：凤凰城 Margaret T Hance Park East, 1202 N Third Street, Phoenix AZ 85004.
d243ba25f51df71225a345aea6b0c76253ceebb7.translatedText: >China Week Address: Margaret T Hance Park East, 1202 N Third Street, Phoenix AZ 85004.

f4da5818cbc4cf7e6c0773c941c4df02d52ca4cb.sourceText: 今年的中国周活动有瑞龙醒狮表演；有中国武术示范；民间传统舞蹈和民族乐器表演；还有新增加的中国茶道表演；更有经典的麻将摊位；儿童手工艺制作；文化历史展览；传统服装拍照亭子和学用筷子亭子。
f4da5818cbc4cf7e6c0773c941c4df02d52ca4cb.translatedText: This year’s China Week activities include a dragon and lion dance performance; Chinese martial arts demonstrations; traditional folk dances and ethnic musical instrument performances; and a newly added Chinese tea ceremony performance; there are also classic mahjong stalls; children’s handicrafts; cultural and historical exhibitions; traditional costume photo booths and learning chopsticks booths.

af1d3bb6b3f40fbbcfb1851ef25e715ee196d494.sourceText: 还有绘画美术展览。还会给中国周绘画比赛获奖的小朋友们举行发奖仪式。
af1d3bb6b3f40fbbcfb1851ef25e715ee196d494.translatedText: There is also a painting and art exhibition. A prize distribution ceremony will also be held for the children who won the China Week Painting Competition.

d6b68e1eae81ee30eb9499735567beef8d890237.sourceText: 一年又一年，凤凰城中国周，为一批又一批学生提供了了解和学习中国文化的实习课堂。
d6b68e1eae81ee30eb9499735567beef8d890237.translatedText: Year after year, Phoenix China Week provides batch after batch of students with internship classes to understand and learn Chinese culture.

1afb67ed2417ff855d4ac8c4dd9e3b10c01fa0f6.sourceText: 一年又一年，凤凰城中国周已成为凤凰城家喻户晓的传统节日。
1afb67ed2417ff855d4ac8c4dd9e3b10c01fa0f6.translatedText: Year after year, Phoenix China Week has become a well-known traditional festival in Phoenix.

3cb907cf4264ca2bd5d72bbd926405bc6fddf19e.sourceText: 一年又一年，中国周看着孩子们成长。
3cb907cf4264ca2bd5d72bbd926405bc6fddf19e.translatedText: Year after year, China Zhou watched the children grow.

7b0cf6aa18bfa307ac83b28092291467b497cace.sourceText: 一年又一年，中国周使无数亚利桑那人更了解中国文化。
7b0cf6aa18bfa307ac83b28092291467b497cace.translatedText: Year after year, China Week helps countless Arizonans better understand Chinese culture.

11b5c49b51e8294881252e5464c2ffba7f533bdd.sourceText: 一年又一年，数不清的社区义工们，空前团结，无私奉献。
11b5c49b51e8294881252e5464c2ffba7f533bdd.translatedText: Year after year, countless community volunteers show unprecedented unity and selfless dedication.

4e656f5476a9e79b47b74b5d47badfb1d7833029.sourceText: 今年 中国周活动中保护中国城的捐款活动会在现场进行。宣传，义卖希望有更多的朋友加入其中。
4e656f5476a9e79b47b74b5d47badfb1d7833029.translatedText: Donation activities to protect Chinatown during this year’s China Week will be held on site. Publicity and charity sale hope more friends will join us.

b2f777481b462d015dd6e7c597cd1480a900e8f6.sourceText: 中国城精美双年挂历（2018-2019）义卖 为纪念凤凰城的中国文化中心，我们特制作的这一批精美的中国城的双年挂历（月历）。目的是为了更好的宣传中国城的优美传统中国建筑，同时也为了支持保护中国城的筹款举动。现爱心义卖，凡捐款$20，送中国城双年挂历一本，建议义卖价$15 /本。所筹款项将用于保护中国城的费用支出中。对于您的爱心捐款，我们鞠躬致谢.

3e875199a924f024886d65c47dd095c6f34377e3.sourceText: 每逢佳节倍思亲，海外华人对于八月十五有着更加深刻的体会。 中秋佳节象征着团圆，除了亲人，团圆的还有自己身边的朋友。 九 月十日晚六时三十分由凤凰城亚省开平同乡会、美中文化交流协会、亚省笔会、亚省作家协会、亚省时报社、亚美报社、清华校友会、川渝同乡会 ，凤城大酒家，亚省中华文化交流协会十团体，在凤城大酒家举办了盛大的中秋联欢晚会。 资深侨领余文劲，开平同乡会会长甄硕钦，开平美莎姐妹市代表以及各社团的负责人，４００多位嘉宾来到现场观看节目，品美食，赏明月。 下午6时，上千尺的凤城酒家，几乎坐无虚席，有年长的老人，也有四处嬉戏的孩子，俨然一个大家庭。 张灯结彩，晚会就要开始了，只看到几个穿着汉族民服的小朋友，欢天喜地的跑上台，伴着热闹的音乐，拉开了晚会的序幕。 凤凰武术学会带来汉族扇子舞，傣族孔雀舞等一个名为《月光下的仙子》民族舞蹈大连串，吸引住了来宾的目光。 主持人张华芳，关兆峰走上舞台，告诉大家”今天没有大段的演讲，也没有长长的VIP嘉宾的介绍，因为今天所有的来宾都是VIP。”美中文化艺术交流协会的古雅瑜 女士，是娱乐节目的嘉宾主持。 她带来了凤凰城的成人合唱团。 一曲《半个月亮爬上来》，男声部浑厚有力，女声部悠远深邃，带来最切时宜的声乐享受。 新东方艺术学校带的舞蹈《卓玛神香》，把观众带到了神秘而辽阔的西藏，彭天悦，谢知知，鲁叶臻三位学习舞蹈多年的小演员把卓玛演绎的活灵活现，时而 溪边嬉戏，时而雪山放歌！ 凤城华人基督教会的舞蹈《茉莉花》则体现了另一种柔美，由舞蹈老师何春玲带领的三位舞者，手拿古典的纸伞，将茉莉花开放的含蓄，表现得淋漓精致，他们都是 生活中热爱舞蹈的朋友，每个星期都花两个小时进行训练，舞蹈已经成为他们生活的一部分，如今就将他们的训练成果奉献给社区的活动。 清华校友会选送的《妈呀，中国》《飞向梦想》唤起了浓浓的爱国情怀，全场嘉宾鼓掌，轻轻和唱。 川渝同乡会会长陈志钢的《变脸》成了晚会的压轴戏，瞬间的变脸，就在观众眼前完成，谁也看不出破绽，只能心服口服地热烈欢呼。 当地书画，武术，戏剧界的人士，画家李成，太极拳老师张心志，票友聂敬君，余江英，周桂卿都现场献艺。 奖品丰富的现场抽奖，也让活动变得高潮迭起，由关宗任先生提供的十个银元奖品更是让抽奖环节惊喜连连。 整个晚会有吃，有玩，也有拿！ 美月佳肴给来宾带来了一个令人神往的中秋之夜。 特别鸣谢(此为部分赞助单位，疏漏部分，下期补登)： 关宗任 胡寿柏 凤城酒家 长城海鲜公司 恒丰贸易有限公司 金隆珠宝行 六福酒家 中华语文学院 U.S Food Service Pho Van Golden Salon Imperial Foot Spa Logistical Cooling & Heating Jack In the Box Super L Market Red Wok 布斐餐厅 Gils Boja肉食公司 BOBA奶茶
3e875199a924f024886d65c47dd095c6f34377e3.translatedText: During the festival, overseas Chinese have a deeper understanding of August 15th. The Mid-Autumn Festival symbolizes reunion. In addition to family members, friends around us are also reunited. At 6:30 pm on September 10th, ten groups including the Phoenix Kaiping Association of Alberta, the U.S.-China Cultural Exchange Association, the Alberta PEN Club, the Alberta Writers Association, the Alberta Times, the Asian American Newspaper, the Tsinghua Alumni Association, the Sichuan and Chongqing Association, the Fengcheng Restaurant, and the Alberta Chinese Cultural Exchange Association held a grand Mid-Autumn Festival Gala at the Fengcheng Restaurant. More than 400 guests, including Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader, Zhen Shuoqin, president of the Kaiping Hometown Association, representatives from Kaiping Meisha sister cities and heads of various associations, came to watch the show, taste delicious food and admire the bright moon. At 6 o'clock in the afternoon, the thousands-square-foot Fengcheng Restaurant was almost full, with elderly people and children playing around, just like a big family. The lanterns were decorated, and the party was about to begin. I saw only a few children wearing Han folk costumes, happily running onto the stage, accompanied by lively music, kicking off the party. The Phoenix Martial Arts Society brought Han fan dance, Dai peacock dance and other ethnic dance series called "Fairy under the Moonlight", which attracted the attention of the guests. Hosts Zhang Huafang and Guan Zhaofeng walked onto the stage and told everyone, "There will be no long speeches or long introductions of VIP guests today, because all the guests today are VIPs." Ms. Gu Yayu from the US-China Culture and Art Exchange Association is the guest host of the entertainment program. She brought in Phoenix's adult choir. In the song "Half Moon Climbs Up", the male voice is strong and powerful, and the female voice is far-reaching and profound, bringing you the most timely vocal enjoyment. The dance "The Divine Fragrance of Dolma" presented by New Oriental Art School brought the audience to the mysterious and vast Tibet. Three young actors, Peng Tianyue, Xie Zhizhi, and Lu Yezhen, who have studied dance for many years, brought Dolma to life, sometimes playing by the stream, and sometimes singing in the snow-capped mountains! The dance "Jasmine" performed by Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church embodies another kind of softness. The three dancers, led by dance teacher He Chunling, held classical paper umbrellas and expressed the subtle and exquisite expression of the blooming jasmine. They are all friends who love dance in life. They spend two hours training every week. Dance has become a part of their lives, and now they dedicate their training results to community activities. "Mom, China" and "Flying to the Dream" selected by the Tsinghua Alumni Association evoked strong patriotic feelings. All the guests applauded and sang softly. "Changing Face" by Chen Zhigang, president of the Sichuan and Chongqing Association, became the finale of the party. The instant face change was completed in front of the audience. No one could see the flaw and could only cheer enthusiastically with conviction. Local people from the painting, calligraphy, martial arts, and theater circles, including painter Li Cheng, Tai Chi teacher Zhang Xinzhi, and fans Nie Jingjun, Yu Jiangying, and Zhou Guiqing all performed on the spot. The on-site lottery with rich prizes also made the event climax. The ten silver dollar prizes provided by Mr. Guan Zongren made the lottery a surprise. There will be food, fun, and food throughout the party! The beautiful moon delicacies brought the guests a fascinating Mid-Autumn Festival night. 82b3c904c7c71ad24d8857d581d25db19d15d67c.sourceText: IRA将调涨2012年社保金 3年来首次 美国老年公民预计将获得两年内首次社会保障福利金的增加。社会安全署近日宣布，退休老年人将自明年一月开始领到生活费用调整约3.5%至3.7%。政府通常依据通胀指数来调整社保福利的生活费用调整（COLA）。 由于通货膨胀近年来已经非常低，2009年以来受益者没有看到生活费用调整的增加，2009当年他们收到了5.8%的提高。 然而，大多数老年人可能不会获得全额生活费用调整的增加，因为可以预见的医疗保险保费的加息将吃掉部分的提高。医疗保险费的涨幅可能达到两位数，具体会在下月公布。 社保福利在保持老年人正常生活方面起着至关重要的作用。近5,500万美国人得到实惠，平均每月近1,200美元的支票。生活费用调整的增加，会转化为每月增加大约41美元。据社会安全署的统计，社保福利约占老人收入的41%。但对22%的已婚夫妇和43%的单身人士，社保福利占其每月收入的90%。
82b3c904c7c71ad24d8857d581d25db19d15d67c.translatedText: IRA to increase 2012 Social Security benefits for first time in 3 years Senior citizens in the United States are expected to receive the first increase in Social Security benefits in two years. The Social Security Administration recently announced that retired seniors will receive a cost-of-living adjustment of approximately 3.5% to 3.7% starting in January next year. The government usually adjusts the cost of living adjustment (COLA) of Social Security benefits based on an inflation index. Because inflation has been very low in recent years, beneficiaries have not seen a cost-of-living adjustment increase since 2009, when they received a 5.8% increase. However, most seniors likely won't receive the full cost-of-living adjustment increase because foreseeable interest rate increases in Medicare premiums will eat up part of the increase. Health insurance premium increases could reach double digits, with details to be announced next month. Social security benefits play a vital role in maintaining a normal life for the elderly. Nearly 55 million Americans received benefits, averaging nearly $1,200 a month in checks. The increase in cost-of-living adjustments translates into an increase of approximately $41 per month. According to statistics from the Social Security Administration, social security benefits account for approximately 41% of an elderly person's income. But for 22% of married couples and 43% of singles, Social Security benefits account for 90% of their monthly income.

fcc743e5c3d6ccc1d55d590a8b7056ba13b9178a.translatedText: What diseases can be caused by crossing one's legs for more than 15 minutes

39616c3c95bb00ce7ea69277b57a008316fed61c.sourceText: 跷二郎腿超15分钟会引起哪些病 翘起”二郎腿”大家会感觉腿部有个支撑力度，很舒服，…
39616c3c95bb00ce7ea69277b57a008316fed61c.translatedText: What diseases can be caused by crossing one's legs for more than 15 minutes When you raise your legs, you will feel that your legs are supported and very comfortable...

688e2adfb67de37de431cb434b64100cde102644.sourceText: 翘起”二郎腿”大家会感觉腿部有个支撑力度，很舒服，但是长期翘起”二郎腿”对身体不仅没有益处反而还会给自己的身体健康造成威胁。建议大家还是避免长期跷”二郎腿”。
688e2adfb67de37de431cb434b64100cde102644.translatedText: When you raise your legs, you will feel that your legs are supported and comfortable. However, raising your legs for a long time is not only not beneficial to your body, but also poses a threat to your health. It is recommended that you avoid crossing your legs for a long time.

5bc3951dbcda36f259b68824daabd20acd4ebf09.translatedText: Crossing your legs for less than 15 minutes

108d90c62cc51abc877ba5918d42696b744804b7.sourceText: 武汉市普爱医院骨关节科主任程文俊介绍，从理论上说，跷二郎腿时一条腿的膝关节顶在另一条腿的腿窝里，从而对腿窝形成压迫。由于其内部是血管、静脉和动脉，所以如果长时间压迫，可能会阻断静脉血流，引起静脉血栓。但是，从临床上看，因为跷二郎腿而导致静脉曲张和血栓塞的病人还从来没接诊过。因为跷二郎腿是人们为了追求放松及舒适感，任何人都不会几小时连续保持同一姿势，往往会两腿轮换着，这样也有助于避免出现静脉血栓。所以，偶尔跷跷二郎腿并无害处，对放松心情，舒缓压力有所帮助，但每次的时间最好不要超过15分钟。
108d90c62cc51abc877ba5918d42696b744804b7.translatedText: Cheng Wenjun, director of the Orthopedics and Joints Department of Wuhan Puai Hospital, said that theoretically speaking, when you cross your legs, the knee joint of one leg presses into the leg socket of the other leg, thus compressing the leg socket. Because there are blood vessels, veins and arteries inside it, if it is compressed for a long time, it may block the venous blood flow and cause venous thrombosis. However, from a clinical point of view, patients with varicose veins and thromboembolism caused by crossing their legs have never been seen. Because people cross their legs in order to pursue relaxation and comfort. No one will keep the same posture for several hours, and they often rotate their legs. This also helps to avoid venous thrombosis. Therefore, it is not harmful to cross your legs occasionally. It is helpful to relax your mood and relieve stress, but it is best not to exceed 15 minutes at a time.

3518f124ed8131af3af954a47acd5f83130e22d3.sourceText: 那么跷二郎腿会造成哪些危害呢？当然，这些危害都是在长期有长时间跷二郎腿习惯的人来说的。
3518f124ed8131af3af954a47acd5f83130e22d3.translatedText: So what harm will crossing one's legs cause? Of course, these hazards only apply to people who have the habit of crossing their legs for long periods of time.

927dc957195f0e49586305634f1dc767a967db5f.sourceText: 1。时间太长可致腿部静脉曲张
927dc957195f0e49586305634f1dc767a967db5f.translatedText: 1. If the time is too long, it can cause varicose veins in the legs

1ce2478e541b974e7ddeae0e2c7c11b263f23467.sourceText: 跷着”二郎腿”久坐，由于双腿互相交叠，还会妨碍腿部血液循环，久而久之易造成腿部静脉曲张，严重的会造成腿部血液回流不畅、青筋暴突、溃疡、静脉炎、出血等其他疾病。
1ce2478e541b974e7ddeae0e2c7c11b263f23467.translatedText: > Sitting with legs crossed for a long time. Because the legs overlap each other, it will also hinder the blood circulation in the legs. Over time, it is easy to cause varicose veins in the legs. In severe cases, it can cause poor blood return in the legs, bulging veins, ulcers, phlebitis, bleeding and other diseases.

f472ebb222d055d1b8d8d7b3397d7977b4925f2f.translatedText: 2. Causing gynecological diseases such as vaginitis

282c36649cc4f5e8e05420ac80580f5cd60a90c8.sourceText: 女性跷二郎腿也会导致局部温度升高，这样在会阴处形成温暖潮湿的环境，可引起致病菌大量繁殖，从而引起外阴炎或者阴道炎。久跷二郎腿，容易造成盆腔内气血循环不畅，引起附件发炎，如果病原体经生殖道上行感染并扩散，有可能影响整个盆腔。另外，有痛经史者，久跷二郎腿还可能加重痛经。
282c36649cc4f5e8e05420ac80580f5cd60a90c8.translatedText: > Women crossing their legs can also cause local temperature to rise. This creates a warm and humid environment in the perineum, which can cause pathogenic bacteria to multiply in large numbers, thus causing vulvitis or vaginitis. Crossing the legs for a long time can easily cause poor blood circulation in the pelvic cavity and cause inflammation of the appendages. If the pathogen ascends through the reproductive tract and is infected and spreads, it may affect the entire pelvic cavity. In addition, if you have a history of dysmenorrhea, crossing your legs for a long time may aggravate the dysmenorrhea.

4a828b3ccbac1e04ae1dc98c89ac85f17b668e03.sourceText: ”养成跷二郎腿的习惯，对生殖健康很不利。”中医专家说，跷二郎腿时，两腿通常会夹得过紧，使大腿内侧及生殖器周围温度升高。对男性来说，这种高温会损伤精子，长期如此，可能影响生育。为此，中医专家建议，跷二郎腿最好别超过10分钟，两腿切忌交叉过紧，如果感觉大腿内侧有汗渍渗出，最好在通风处走一会儿，以尽快散热。
4a828b3ccbac1e04ae1dc98c89ac85f17b668e03.translatedText: "Developing the habit of crossing one's legs is very detrimental to reproductive health." Traditional Chinese medicine experts say that when crossing one's legs, the legs are usually clamped too tightly, which increases the temperature of the inner thighs and around the genitals. For men, this high temperature can damage sperm, which may affect fertility in the long term. For this reason, Chinese medicine experts suggest that it is best not to cross your legs for more than 10 minutes, and avoid crossing your legs too tightly. If you feel sweat oozing out from your inner thighs, it is best to walk in a ventilated area for a while to dissipate heat as quickly as possible.

117e490dc6e7f3c1f53441e141f6ad058f1cff6a.sourceText: 跷二郎腿会导致血液上行不畅，使回流心脏和大脑的血液量减少或速度减慢。这会影响大脑和心脏功能，也容易诱发高血压、心脏病等疾病。
117e490dc6e7f3c1f53441e141f6ad058f1cff6a.translatedText: > Crossing the legs will cause the blood to not flow smoothly, reducing the amount of blood returning to the heart and brain or slowing down the speed. This will affect brain and heart function, and can easily induce diseases such as high blood pressure and heart disease.

88606d060d085819b24ac6d0afb4b1eb846af300.translatedText: 5. It is easy to injure the spine

cf83952272fc3b4067f2602a792881df92efca13.sourceText: 久跷”二郎腿”极易造成腰椎与胸椎压力分布不均，引起脊柱变形，有的则会导致腰椎间盘突出，形成慢性腰背痛。这些习惯都会让人体的力量侧压在脊椎上，脊椎长时间弯曲容易劳损。
cf83952272fc3b4067f2602a792881df92efca13.translatedText: > Lifting your legs for a long time can easily cause uneven pressure distribution on the lumbar and thoracic vertebrae, causing spinal deformation. Some may lead to lumbar disc herniation, resulting in chronic low back pain. These habits will put the body's force on the spine, and the spine will be easily strained if it is bent for a long time.

4023a529de516ea40424aa1cd8e796f8a7d01cf3.sourceText: 大家一定要坚持多运动，避免过久地跷”二郎腿”在电脑前办公。
4023a529de516ea40424aa1cd8e796f8a7d01cf3.translatedText: Everyone must insist on exercising more and avoid working in front of the computer with your legs crossed for too long.

67a8778a0b76329de82c1979c4db88b8f0f58161.sourceText: 美国运输安全局（TSA）人员表示，1架由纽约飞往凤凰城的全美航空（US Airways）班机，因3名乘客的可疑行为，今天迫降密苏里州。 TSA表示，班机于格林威治时间1250降落在密苏里州圣路易市后，警方将这3名乘客带下飞机。 TSA在声明中表示：?#22240;3名乘客出现可疑行为，应机组人员要求，这架全美航空457号班机迫降圣路易兰伯特国际机场。这架客机由甘迺迪国际机场起飞​​，目的地是凤凰城 空港国际机场。?BR> TSA表示，这架客机经过清查后继续航行。 TSA发言人拒绝提供3名乘客受讯问的进一步细节。
67a8778a0b76329de82c1979c4db88b8f0f58161.translatedText: US Transportation Security Administration (TSA) personnel said that a US Airways (US Airways) flight from New York to Phoenix Airways flight made an emergency landing in Missouri today due to the suspicious behavior of three passengers. The TSA said the three passengers were taken off the plane after the flight landed in St. Louis, Missouri, at 1250 GMT. TSA said in a statement: US Airways Flight 457 made an emergency landing at St. Louis Lambert International Airport at the request of the crew after three passengers behaved suspiciously. The plane took off from Kennedy International Airport and was destined for Phoenix Airport International Airport. ?BR> TSA stated that the passenger plane continued to sail after being cleared. A TSA spokesman declined to provide further details about the questioning of the three passengers.
