c23f26af1de9145348756cb9fc44e486308f496a.sourceText: 4月1日，斐匿黄氏宗亲会举行了春宴联欢活动，这一天对于全体斐匿黄氏宗亲来说是值得兴奋的大日子，因为当天迎来了全美黄氏宗亲会的黄志刚总长伉俪、黄惠聪副总长伉俪、黄立辉副总长；全美黄氏总会副主席黄荣达、全美元老团主席黄景彬伉俪、全美黄氏元老黄尧政伉俪、全美黄氏元老黄邦麟、全美黄氏顾问黄柏健、黄氏总会顾问黄惠喜、黄氏总会顾问黄宇豪、全美黄氏总会中文书记黄楚文伉俪、屋崙黄氏宗亲会中文书记黄悦添伉俪；以及黄氏宗亲总会、屋仑、罗省、波士顿黄氏宗亲会的首长、宗亲一行共二十多人。 当天还有一位重要人物：中华民国驻洛杉矶橙县文化中心高家富主任，他特地从洛杉矶赶来参加黄氏宗亲会的春宴活动。 以上嘉宾的莅临，令斐匿黄氏宗亲会春宴联欢活动增光不浅，同时在凤凰城侨界引起了轰动。本埠侨团的春宴活动能有这麽多外埠嘉宾出席的可谓数黄氏为之最了。 是日中午，高家富主任刚下飞机就风尘僕僕，和来自外埠的总长、元老、顾问以及宗亲们，来到16街黄氏宗亲会会所举行祭祖活动。 祭祖活动中的亮点是三头大金猪，这三头金猪分别是由中华民国谘询顾问尹衍桓；国民党亚利桑那直属分部常委、中华民国侨务顾问王玮王亭伉俪；以及全美黄氏宗亲会四位总长（黄志刚、黄显扬、黄惠聪、黄立辉）赞助。 晚上7时在黄雄大酒家举行晚宴，侨社领导以及各界人士出席，热闹非常，晚会由黄定邦嫂担任司仪，先由斐匿黄氏宗亲会主席黄震捷致欢迎词，他表示今年对于黄氏宗亲会来说是非常重要的一年，因为8月下旬全美黄氏恳请大会将在凤凰城举行，接待的任务相当艰巨，但斐匿黄氏的宗亲们一定会团结起来，努力将恳请大会的接待工作做好。 接下来高家富主任致词，他说很高兴来到凤凰城参加黄氏宗亲会的春宴联欢活动，并祝福大家龙年健康吉祥。 黄志刚总长与全美元老团主席黄景彬先后致词，他们都说每年来凤凰城参加春宴，都要发言，说自己已经江郎才尽了。。。。。他们幽默风趣的言辞令晚会气氛更显轻鬆愉快。 全美元老黄定江介绍到场嘉宾以及该会的职员，席间，所有职员向宾客敬酒祝贺新春大吉。 两位优秀子弟获得奖学金，其中黄震宇学生是斐匿黄氏宗亲会顾问黄允文伉俪的孙子，另一位学生是黄氏宗亲会会员黄雄相的儿子黄山河。 晚会在一派喜气洋洋的气氛中结束，大家握手道别，相约明年再聚。
c23f26af1de9145348756cb9fc44e486308f496a.translatedText: On April 1st, the Feinihuang Clan Association held a spring banquet. This day was a great day for all the Feinihuang Clan members. It is a big day worthy of excitement, because that day we welcomed the president and his wife Huang Zhigang, vice presidents Huang Huicong and his wife, and vice president Huang Lihui of the National Huang Clan Association; Huang Rongda, vice chairman of the National Huang Clan Association, and the All-American Veterans Association Chairman Huang Jingbin and his wife, Huang Yaozheng and his wife, the veterans of the National Huang Family, Huang Banglin, the veteran of the National Huang Family, Huang Baijian, the consultant of the National Huang Family, Huang Huixi, the consultant of the Huang Family Association, Huang Yuhao, the consultant of the Huang Family Association, Huang Yuhao, the consultant of the National Huang Family Mr. and Mrs. Huang Chuwen, the Chinese secretary of the Huang Clan Association, and Mr. and Mrs. Huang Yuetian, the Chinese secretary of the Wolun Huang Clan Association; as well as the heads and clan members of the Huang Clan Association, Wolun, Luo Province, and Boston Huang Clan Association, a total of more than 20 people. There was another important person that day: Gao Jiafu, director of the Orange County Cultural Center of the Republic of China in Los Angeles, who came all the way from Los Angeles to attend the spring banquet of the Huang Clan Association. The presence of the above guests added great splendor to the Feini Huang Clan Spring Banquet and caused a sensation in the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix. Huang was the first person to have so many guests from other places attend the spring banquet held by the local overseas Chinese group. At noon that day, Director Gao Jiafu had just gotten off the plane and was already in the dust. He and the president, elders, advisors and clan members from other places came to the Huang Clan Association on 16th Street to hold an ancestor worship event. The highlight of the ancestor worship activity were three large golden pigs, which were sponsored by Yin Yanhuan, consultant of the Republic of China; Wang Wei and Wang Ting, members of the Standing Committee of the Arizona Branch of the Kuomintang and overseas Chinese affairs adviser of the Republic of China; and the four presidents of the National Huang Clan Association (Huang Zhigang, Huang Xianyang, Huang Huicong, Huang Lihui). At 7 o'clock in the evening, a dinner was held at Huangxiong Restaurant. Leaders of the overseas Chinese community and people from all walks of life attended the dinner. The party was very lively. The party was hosted by Huang Dingbang's sister-in-law. First, Huang Zhenjie, chairman of the Fei Ni Huang Clan Association, gave a welcome speech. He said that this year is a very important year for the Huang Clan Association, because the National Huang Clan Appeal Conference will be held in Phoenix in late August. The task of reception is quite arduous, but the Fei Ni Huang Clan Association will definitely unite and work hard to host the conference. Next, Director Gao Jiafu delivered a speech. He said that he was very happy to come to Phoenix to participate in the Spring Banquet of the Huang Clan Association, and wished everyone good health and good fortune in the Year of the Dragon. President Huang Zhigang and Chairman of the All-US Veterans League Huang Jingbin delivered speeches one after another. They both said that every year they come to Phoenix for the Spring Banquet, they have to give speeches and say that they have exhausted their talents. . . . . Their humorous remarks made the atmosphere of the party more relaxed and cheerful. Mr. Huang Dingjiang of the American Association introduced the guests and the staff of the association. During the dinner, all the staff toasted to the guests and wished them a happy New Year. Two outstanding students received scholarships. Among them, Huang Zhenyu is the grandson of Mr. and Mrs. Huang Yunwen, the consultant of the Huang Clan Association in Feini, and the other student is Huang Shanhe, the son of Huang Xiongxiang, a member of the Huang Clan Association. The party ended in a joyful atmosphere. Everyone shook hands and said goodbye, hoping to meet again next year.

4d91902cdd0cec4b5d53835c2137dab4c93a0b84.sourceText: 温家宝总理在记者会上意外地提到”文革”问题，以此为转折点，这一场因”薄王事件”而起的政治风波，顺势进入了第二阶段。就像是围城部队终于找到了突破口。进了薄熙来这道门后面是文革这个禁区，而进了文革这个禁区后面是中国共产党的历史功过和执政合法性这座禁城。中国知识界一直以来最想要进入但始终不得而入、没机会进入的封锁地带，就这样突然敞开了一个口子。而且，不是外面的人强攻下来的缺口，恰恰是内部的人自己推开了城门?BR> 薄熙来的结局如何已经不是最重要的了，王立军的处理决定几乎没人关心了，虽然还没形成蜂拥潮涌，但精明之辈已经嗅到了味道，听到了鼓角，原来以为此生无望的故地重游，居然有了一朝梦圆的可能！自文革开始算起四十六年了，自毛泽东去世算起三十六年了，人生几何啊！想当年，大家一个不拉全都在那座角斗场里，每一个人都是角斗士，每一个人都只能成为角斗士，胜者一逞嚣张，败者转乎沟壑。整整十年的生死锤炼，思想改造，灵魂革命，凡是在里面折腾过别人或者被别人折腾过的人，谁敢说自己的思想和灵魂没有一点文革的痕迹？ 整整十年。如果说文革是泥潭，那么十年时间足以让所有人都里里外外一身泥；如果说文革是染缸，那么十年时间足以使没有任何人还留有任何一点洁白。毕竟，那是一场由国家领袖发动的、关上国门动用整个国家机器强力进行的、包括了各种暴力手段的、以全体人民为对象的空前绝后的社会工程！在这个意义上，所有经历过文革的人，无论当时是整人的还是被整的，也无论今天是批判文革的还是拥护文革的，实际上都可以被称为”文革人”！ 作为一场政治运动的文革，随毛泽东的去世而结束。但其实这只不过意味着那个最高指挥者没有了，新的领导人不再继续这场运动了，而文革角斗场还在，数以亿计的”文革人”还在，文革的思维方式、语言方式、行为方式统统还盛行于世，一场整整十年几乎可以把羊变成狼的改造工程，怎么可能说结束就结束？就算是”头狼”不在了，狼群就能自动变回成羊群吗？对于文革结束后的这个形势，可以相信，当年的邓小平是看得最清楚的人。凭着他的铁腕，通过两个措施解了这个困局。一是搞市场经济，像一幕现代版的”出埃及记”一样把只会互相斗争其他什么都不会的亿万中国人民都带出角斗场，投入到市场的海洋中去自我解救，自我淘洗，自立自足；二是在政治领域宣布”不争论”，犹如一把大锁封死了角斗场的大门，谁也不许再回去。 文革这个禁区，就是这样形成的。然而，由于这是近乎于强迫性的措施，虽然表面上文革角斗场已经人去楼空，但一股根深蒂固的”文革情结”，也就此深深埋藏了下来。 文革人就是文革人，虽然后来也都去做生意了，而且也没有机会再谈文革、论文革、搞文革了，但并不意味着人们就再也不是文革人了。毕竟在那个角斗场里生生死死了十年，毕竟头脑中和灵魂中的东西大多是在那里形成的，那里才是真正的精神故乡，文化家园。只要一提政治，一提主义，一整套文革话语就会自我衍生，自动生成。别说重庆的”唱红打黑”是文革，知识界的批判话语、意识形态话语、简单化公式化广场化的话语，哪一套不是文革？近一个月来，就像是有意要做一场实际测验一样，以温家宝关于文革的一番话为刺激信号，一场意料之中的反应在中国社会中突然迸发。无论是哪一派，所谓的左派还是所谓的右派，所谓的中左、所谓的中右，只要看看那些最激烈的言论，最激烈的方式，无一例外，大家还是文革人！温家宝本人到底是否充分意识到再提文革意味着什么，难以猜想。
4d91902cdd0cec4b5d53835c2137dab4c93a0b84.translatedText: Premier Wen Jiabao unexpectedly mentioned the "Cultural Revolution" issue at a press conference. Taking this as a turning point, the political turmoil caused by the "Bo Wang Incident" entered its second stage. It was like the siege troops had finally found a breakthrough. Behind the gate of Bo Xilai is the forbidden area of ​​the Cultural Revolution, and behind the forbidden area of ​​the Cultural Revolution is the forbidden city of the Chinese Communist Party's historical merits and demerits and the legitimacy of its governance. The blocked zone that China's intelligentsia has always wanted to enter but has never been able to enter has suddenly opened up. Moreover, it was not the breach that was forced by outsiders, but the people inside who pushed open the city gate themselves? BR> Bo Xilai’s outcome is no longer the most important, and almost no one cares about Wang Lijun’s decision. Although there has not yet been a swarm, the smart people have smelled the smell and heard the drums. It is possible to revisit the old place that they thought was hopeless in this life, but it is actually possible to realize their dreams! It has been forty-six years since the Cultural Revolution began, and thirty-six years since Mao Zedong’s death. What a life! I remember back then, everyone was in that arena, everyone was a gladiator, and everyone could only become a gladiator. The winner would show off his arrogance, while the loser would fall into the ditch. After ten years of tempering in life and death, thought remolding, and soul revolution, anyone who has tormented others or been tormented by others, who dares to say that there is no trace of the Cultural Revolution in his or her thoughts and souls? A whole decade. If the Cultural Revolution was a quagmire, then ten years would be enough time for everyone to be covered in mud inside and out; if the Cultural Revolution was a dye vat, then ten years would be enough time for no one to be left with any trace of purity. After all, it was an unprecedented social project launched by national leaders, closed the country and used the entire state machinery to forcefully carry out, including various violent means, targeting the entire people! In this sense, all people who experienced the Cultural Revolution, whether they were persecuted or persecuted at the time, and whether they criticize or support the Cultural Revolution today, can actually be called "Cultural Revolution people"! The Cultural Revolution, as a political movement, ended with the death of Mao Zedong. But in fact, this just means that the top commander is gone and the new leaders will no longer continue the movement. However, the Cultural Revolution Arena is still there, and hundreds of millions of "Cultural Revolutionaries" are still there. The Cultural Revolution's way of thinking, language, and behavior are all still prevalent in the world. How can a transformation project that can almost turn sheep into wolves for a full decade end just as soon as it is over? Even if the "alpha wolf" is gone, can the wolves automatically turn back into a flock of sheep? Regarding the situation after the Cultural Revolution, we can believe that Deng Xiaoping was the person who saw it most clearly. With his iron fist, he solved this dilemma through two measures. The first is to engage in a market economy, which is like a modern version of the "Exodus", taking hundreds of millions of Chinese people who know nothing but fighting against each other out of the arena and into the ocean of the market to save themselves, wash themselves out, and become self-sufficient; the second is to declare "no debate" in the political field, which is like a big lock sealing the door of the arena, and no one is allowed to go back. This is how the restricted area of ​​the Cultural Revolution was formed. However, since this was an almost coercive measure, although on the surface the Cultural Revolution arena was empty, a deep-rooted "Cultural Revolution complex" was deeply buried. People in the Cultural Revolution were people in the Cultural Revolution. Although they later went into business and no longer had the opportunity to talk about the Cultural Revolution, write about the Cultural Revolution, or engage in the Cultural Revolution, it does not mean that people are no longer Cultural Revolution people. After all, I lived and died in that arena for ten years. After all, most of the things in my mind and soul were formed there. It is the true spiritual home and cultural home. As long as politics and doctrine are mentioned, a whole set of Cultural Revolution discourse will be self-derived and automatically generated. Not to mention Chongqing’s “singing reds and cracking down on gangsters” was the Cultural Revolution. The critical discourse, ideological discourse, and simplistic, formulaic, and square-oriented discourse in the intellectual circles, which one is not the Cultural Revolution? In the past month, as if a practical test was intended, an unexpected reaction suddenly broke out in Chinese society, using Wen Jiabao's words about the Cultural Revolution as a stimulus. No matter which faction you belong to, the so-called left or the so-called right, the so-called center-left or the so-called center-right, just look at the most intense speeches and the most intense methods. Without exception, everyone is still a member of the Cultural Revolution! It is difficult to guess whether Wen Jiabao himself is fully aware of the implications of mentioning the Cultural Revolution again.

ee189f7f73ccbeadc61b3f484038430f215113e3.sourceText: 但在我看来，任何人如果指望当今中国社会通过一场政治争论来解决文革问题，甚至更大的政治改革、政治路线问题，很可能会犯下重大的判断失误。邓小平当年凭他的权威立下”不争论”的规矩，一方面的含义当然是一心一意搞经济建设，另一方面的含义很可能是：在他眼中，处在文革影响下、几乎人人都是文革人的中国知识界，不仅没有能力将中国政治问题争论清楚，反而只会越吵越乱，毫无结果。现在看来，今天也是一样。文革远没有过去，角斗场的大门随时可以重新打开。而且几乎可以肯定，第一批冲回到文革角斗场的人，并不一定是怀念文革的所谓左派，反而会是那些多年来一直在痛骂文革、痛骂毛泽东、痛骂中国政府的所谓自由派。道理很简单，文革其实主要不是政治立场观点的问题，更多的是病态的思维方式、语言方式、展开政治活动的行为方式问题。而这些”文革病”，在这个阵营中保留得极为完整，表现得极为突出。重回文革，当前中国最大的政治危险之一，已在这个春天里隐然出现。
ee189f7f73ccbeadc61b3f484038430f215113e3.translatedText: But in my opinion, anyone who expects today’s Chinese society to solve the Cultural Revolution issue, or even larger political reform and political line issues, through a political debate is likely to make a major error in judgment. Deng Xiaoping relied on his authority to establish the "no debate" rule. On the one hand, it certainly meant that he was committed to economic construction. On the other hand, it probably meant that in his eyes, the Chinese intelligentsia, which was under the influence of the Cultural Revolution and almost everyone was a member of the Cultural Revolution, was not only incapable of debating China's political issues clearly, but instead only became more noisy and chaotic, with no results. It seems that it is the same today. The Cultural Revolution is far from over, and the door to the arena can be reopened at any time. And it is almost certain that the first batch of people to rush back to the arena of the Cultural Revolution will not necessarily be the so-called leftists who miss the Cultural Revolution. Instead, they will be the so-called liberals who have been criticizing the Cultural Revolution, Mao Zedong, and the Chinese government for many years. The reason is very simple. In fact, the Cultural Revolution was not primarily a matter of political stances and views, but more of a pathological way of thinking, language, and behavior in carrying out political activities. And these "Cultural Revolution diseases" are extremely intact in this camp and manifest themselves extremely prominently. Returning to the Cultural Revolution, one of China's greatest political dangers has loomed large this spring.

a5f38c8bcf1bcf2b7df6ee0b4c5860c209f36065.sourceText: 中国中医科学院糖尿病专家下月到访凤凰城 中国中医科学院专家来凤凰城 ——-谈糖尿病的防治 【主办单位】长城中医院中美医学文化交流部 亚省长城中医院是中国中医科学院中国针灸研究所唯一一家在美国的培训代理机构，为了促进中国中医学文化在中美两国之间的交流，致力于中医知识的普及和推广。更好的推动美国替代医学医生到中国去培训学习，并邀请中国中医科学院的权威专家来美国交流，直接为美国在职医师进行再教育培训的同时，还可以让中美医学文化交流项目为美国人民，特别是为亚省的华人提供更广泛的社区服务。 【协办单位】本次活动属非盈利性质。1. 急需义工5人。2. 特别需要懂中英学英语的义工5人。3. 邀请本省中医师参与讲座后30分钟糖尿病义诊活动。4. 欢迎各界人士及商家为本次社区活动提供赞助（茶点，饮料和奖品等支持）。 【讲座对象】所有华人，可容纳120人。请各华侨社团来电预留贵宾座位！ 【讲座收益】中文讲座。细致和全面的指导糖尿病的预防和控制，特别是华人饮食和生活习惯中所存在的诱发患糖尿病的潜在隐患，更好地了解糖尿病患者血糖监控及用药的相关知识、生活调理以及长期糖尿病患者会引发的一系列健康问题。 【特聘专家】王宏才 教授 王宏才教授 中国中医科学院针灸研究所博士生导师，主任医师，世界中医药学会联合会糖尿病专业委员会副秘书长，原世界针灸学会联合会副秘书长，中国北京国际针灸培训中心副主任。王教授从事20余年中西医临床及研究工作，擅长内分泌、代谢等疾病的防治。主持国家多项重点研究，其中包括：”针药结合对糖尿病神经病变的临床和机理研究”，”不同参数电针对糖尿病相关指标影响研究”，”糖耐量受损患者早期干预”等。现已发表学术论文40余篇，其《糖尿病康复之路》，《糖尿病及并发症中西医诊治学》，《糖尿病的根源与应对策略》，《糖尿病专家新见解》等专著享有盛名。多次完成外交部及国家中医药管理局重大医疗任务。项目广州已应邀赴40多个国家和地区去医疗或讲学。 【讲座内容】 一． 糖尿病的发病率及西医治疗（高危人群，血糖监测，降糖药物的运用） 二．糖尿病的中医治疗及主要并发症（中医中药针灸的辅助治疗，对疲劳，视力影响，手脚麻木，皮肤病，多尿，性功能障碍，以及后期并发症的防治） 三．中医养身对糖尿病认识（四季食疗，运动，家庭关爱对糖尿病患者的帮助） 【讲座形式】可供120人免费入座,请来电预留座位，提供茶点和抽奖，将有中西医师及营养师参与会后糖尿病30 分钟义诊咨询活动。 【讲座时间】 2012年5月26号 下午4:00–5:30 【讲座地点】Scottsdale Mustang Library Auditorium Address: 10101 North 90th Street Scottsdale, AZ 85258 【活动亮点】 一等奖：10名，王宏才教授 专家义诊。 二等奖：10名 欢迎各界人士及商家提供 三等奖：10名 欢迎各界人士及商家提供 【联系方式】英文留言： Tel:480-382-5599 Email:ce@chinesedrs.org 中文咨询：Tel: 480-429-8881 Fax: 480-429-8882 【专家特诊】2012 年5月28日,29日两天 8:30-4:30 诊费：$120(请大家提前挂号预约) Tel: 480-429-8881 【义诊时间】2012 年5月28日上午：8:30-12:30(一等奖获得者) 【义诊地点】长城中医院 Great Wall Chinese Medicine肖青松医生也将协助王教授义诊 3337 North Miller Road Suite103 Scottsdale AZ 85251 www.chinesedrs.com
a5f38c8bcf1bcf2b7df6ee0b4c5860c209f36065.translatedText: Diabetes experts from the Chinese Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences will visit Phoenix next month. Experts from the Chinese Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences come to Phoenix to talk about the prevention and treatment of diabetes. [Sponsor] Great Wall Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Sino-US Medical and Cultural Exchange Department. The Great Wall Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital of Alberta is the only training agency in the United States for the Chinese Acupuncture Institute of the Chinese Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences. In order to promote the exchange of Chinese traditional Chinese medicine culture between China and the United States, it is committed to the popularization and promotion of traditional Chinese medicine knowledge. It is better to promote American alternative medicine doctors to go to China for training and study, and invite authoritative experts from the China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences to come to the United States for exchanges. While directly re-education and training for American in-service doctors, the Sino-US medical cultural exchange project can also provide broader community services for the American people, especially the Chinese in Alberta. [Co-organizer] This event is non-profit in nature. 1. Urgent need of 5 volunteers. 2. There is a special need for 5 volunteers who can learn Chinese and English. 3. Invite local Chinese medicine practitioners to participate in the 30-minute free diabetes clinic after the lecture. 4. People and businesses from all walks of life are welcome to provide sponsorship (support for refreshments, drinks, prizes, etc.) for this community event. [Lecture Audience] All Chinese, can accommodate 120 people. Please call all overseas Chinese associations to reserve VIP seats! 【Lecture Profit】Chinese Lecture. Detailed and comprehensive guidance on the prevention and control of diabetes, especially the potential risks of diabetes in Chinese people's diet and living habits, and a better understanding of blood sugar monitoring and medication related knowledge of diabetic patients, lifestyle adjustments, and a series of health problems caused by long-term diabetic patients. [Distinguished Expert] Professor Wang Hongcai Professor Wang Hongcai is a doctoral supervisor and chief physician of the Institute of Acupuncture and Moxibustion, China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences, deputy secretary-general of the Diabetes Professional Committee of the World Federation of Chinese Medicine Societies, former deputy secretary-general of the World Federation of Acupuncture Societies, and deputy director of the International Acupuncture Training Center in Beijing, China. Professor Wang has been engaged in clinical and research work of traditional Chinese and Western medicine for more than 20 years, and is good at the prevention and treatment of endocrine, metabolic and other diseases. Hosted a number of national key research studies, including: "Clinical and Mechanistic Research on Diabetic Neuropathy by Combination of Acupuncture and Drugs", "Study on the Effects of Different Parameters of Electroacupuncture on Diabetes Related Indicators", "Early Intervention for Patients with Impaired Glucose Tolerance", etc. He has published more than 40 academic papers, and his monographs such as "The Road to Recovery from Diabetes", "Diagnosis and Treatment of Diabetes and Complications with Traditional Chinese and Western Medicine", "The Roots and Coping Strategies of Diabetes", and "New Insights from Diabetes Experts" are well-known. It has completed many major medical tasks of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine. Project Guangzhou has been invited to more than 40 countries and regions for medical treatment or lectures. 【Lecture content】 1. The incidence of diabetes and Western medicine treatment (high-risk groups, blood sugar monitoring, use of hypoglycemic drugs) 2. Traditional Chinese medicine treatment of diabetes and its main complications (auxiliary treatment with traditional Chinese medicine and acupuncture, prevention and treatment of fatigue, visual effects, numbness of hands and feet, skin diseases, polyuria, sexual dysfunction, and later complications) 3. Understanding of diabetes from traditional Chinese medicine health care (four-season diet, exercise, and family care can help diabetic patients) [Lecture format] Free seating for 120 people. Please call to reserve a seat. Refreshments and draws will be provided. Chinese and Western physicians and nutritionists will participate in a 30-minute free diabetes consultation after the meeting. [Lecture time] May 26, 2012 4:00–5:30 pm [Lecture location] Scottsdale Mustang Library Auditorium Address: 10101 North 90th Street Scottsdale, AZ 85258 [Activity highlights] First prize: 10, Professor Wang Hongcai’s expert free clinic. Second Prize: 10 people from all walks of life and businesses are welcome to provide Third Prize: 10 people from all walks of life and businesses are welcome to provide [Contact Information] English message: Tel: 480-382-5599 Email: ce@chinesedrs.org Chinese consultation: Tel: 480-429-8881 Fax: 480-429-8882 [Expert Special Clinic] 2012 May 28 and 29, 2012, 8:30-4:30 Clinic fee: $120 (please register in advance to make an appointment) Tel: 480-429-8881 [Free clinic time] May 28, 2012 morning: 8:30-12:30 (first prize winner) [Free clinic location] Great Wall Chinese Medicine Dr. Xiao Qingsong will also assist Professor Wang in the free clinic 3337 North Miller Road Suite103 Scottsdale AZ 85251 www.chinesedrs.com

42184a90c1c68f2b36cbad37dba00b2263595217.sourceText: 李玲麟来稿 由洛杉矶经济文化办事处新闻组所提供的台湾科技图片与台湾风情图片展览于四月二日上午十时三十分在亚利桑那州政府博物馆Historic Senate Room举行隆重成功的开幕与剪綵典礼.洛杉矶经济文化办事处新闻组组长李大块特别由洛杉机前来主持开幕,侨委会橙县文教中心主任高家富亦到场祝贺,亚利桑那州州务卿Ken Bennett,州议员Kimberly Yee,凤凰城市议员Thelda Williams,亚利桑那州政府博物馆馆长Joan Clark,凤凰城第一学区督学长Myriam Roa,与Magnet Traditional School校长Adrian Walker与多位老师带领七十五位学生参加,凤凰城姊妹会副主任委员Rick Gerrard,亚省时报社长甄硕钦,美西报社长,中华民国侨务谘讯委员高志中,台湾侨领台美人传统州主席张晴玲,亚利桑那州台湾同乡联谊会会长王瑞瑾,世华工商妇女会会长韩玉华,凤凰城台湾同乡会会长万培杰,中华总会会长邱顺雄,侨社代表周琼华,以及台北姊妹市代表李美麟,巴布拉杨,和来自法国的朋友Aurore 和Romand等多人参加共襄盛举. 幕典礼是由亚利桑那州妙龄小姐花漫野Laetitia Hua担任司仪,邱文琪介绍来宾,凤凰城姊妹会台北姊妹市委员会主席李玲麟致开幕辞,新闻组李大块主任致欢迎词,州务卿Ken Bennett,州议员Kimberly Yee,博物馆馆长Joan Clark,凤凰城市议员Thelda Williams,督学长Myriam Roa致贺辞,同时各位贵宾共同剪綵,典礼中亚利桑那州州长Jan Brewer及亚利桑那州参议长Steve Pierce特别致贺函给李大块主任与主办人李玲麟,开幕典礼隆重热闹圆满成功. 在开幕典礼后,橙县文教中心高家富主任赠送一百多套华语书藉给凤凰城第一学区图书馆,并赠送一千字学华语给参加的主流贵宾,同时颁发奖牌给我爱台湾绘图比赛得奖的七十五位美国主流学生及赠送书包给三位特优奖学生. 台湾科技图片与台湾风情图片展览是由凤凰城姊妹会台北姊妹市委员会与亚省中华语文学院与洛杉矶经济文化办事处新闻组共同主办,台湾科技图片是介绍台湾的先进与高科技技术达到超国际水准,并与世界接轨,台湾的风情图片是宣传台湾文化与民俗艺术,及促进多元文化交流.展出时间为四月一日至四月十五日在亚利桑那州博物馆三楼展出,五月十六日,十七日,与十八日在凤凰城科技与经贸展览会场展出,六月一日至六月十五日在凤凰城市政府大厅一楼展出,七月一日至七月三十一日在凤凰城中央图书馆二楼展出,欢迎大家参观欣赏.有关展览请洽李玲麟与邱文琪602-418-8895,或电子邮件 azcmca@hotmail.com 或新闻组Amy Wang 323-782-8765 x 204.
42184a90c1c68f2b36cbad37dba00b2263595217.translatedText: Contributed by Li Linglin The exhibition of Taiwanese science and technology pictures and Taiwanese customs pictures provided by the Los Angeles Economic and Cultural Office News Team held a grand and successful opening and ribbon-cutting ceremony at 10:30 a.m. on April 2 in the Historic Senate Room of the Arizona State Museum. Li Dadai, leader of the Los Angeles Economic and Cultural Office News Team, came from Los Angeles to preside over the opening. Gao Jiafu, director of the Orange County Cultural and Educational Center of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council, was also present to congratulate, Arizona Secretary of State Ken Bennett, and State Assemblyman Kimberly Yee, Phoenix City Councilmember Thelda Williams, Arizona State Government Museum Director Joan Clark, Phoenix School District 1 Superintendent Myriam Roa, Magnet Traditional School Principal Adrian Walker and many teachers led 75 students to participate, Phoenix Sisterhood Deputy Director Rick Gerrard, President of the Alberta Times Zhen Shuoqin, President of the American Western Newspaper, Gao Zhizhong, Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee Member of the Republic of China, Taiwanese Overseas Chinese Leader Zhang Qingling, Chairman of the Taiwan Beauty Tradition State, President of the Taiwanese Association of Arizona Wang Ruijin, Shihua Han Yuhua, president of the Business Women's Association, Wan Peijie, president of the Taiwanese Association of Phoenix City, Qiu Shunxiong, president of the Chinese Association, Zhou Qionghua, representative of the overseas Chinese community, and representatives of Taipei sister cities Li Meilin, Barbra Yang, and friend Aurore from France and Romand and many others participated in the grand event. The opening ceremony was hosted by Miss Arizona Laetitia Hua as the emcee. Qiu Wenqi introduced the guests. Li Linglin, Chairman of the Taipei Sister City Committee of the Phoenix City Sisters Association, gave the opening speech. Director Li Chuan of the News Group gave the welcome speech. State Secretary Ken Bennett, State Assemblymember Kimberly Yee, Museum Director Joan Clark, Phoenix City Assemblymember Thelda Williams, Superintendent Myriam Roa delivered a congratulatory speech, and all distinguished guests cut the ribbon together. During the ceremony, Arizona Governor Jan Brewer and Arizona Senate President Steve Pierce sent special congratulatory letters to Director Li Dachuan and organizer Li Linglin. The opening ceremony was grand and lively and a complete success. After the opening ceremony, Director Gao Jiafu of the Orange County Cultural and Educational Center presented more than 100 sets of Chinese books to the Phoenix School District No. 1 library, and presented 1,000 Chinese words to the participating mainstream guests. At the same time, medals were awarded to the 75 American mainstream students who won the I Love Taiwan Drawing Competition and school bags were given to three outstanding students. The Taiwan Science and Technology Pictures and Taiwan Customs Pictures Exhibition is co-sponsored by the Taipei Sister City Committee of the Phoenix Sisterhood, the Chinese Language Institute of Alberta, and the Los Angeles Economic and Cultural Office News Group. The Taiwan Science and Technology Pictures introduce Taiwan's advanced and high-tech technologies to super-international standards and are in line with the world. The Taiwan Customs Pictures promote Taiwanese culture and folk art, and promote multicultural exchanges. The exhibition period is from April 1 to April. It will be on display on the third floor of the Arizona Museum on the 15th, on May 16th, 17th, and 18th at the Phoenix Technology and Economic and Trade Exhibition Center, on the first floor of the Phoenix City Hall from June 1st to June 15th, and on the second floor of the Phoenix Central Library from July 1st to July 31st. Everyone is welcome to visit and appreciate it. For information about the exhibition, please contact Li Linglin and Qiu Wenqi at 602-418-8895, or email azcmca@hotmail.com or news group Amy Wang 323-782-8765 x 204.

1c1917fed99b66cde5a14ac51f53039985c06fc7.sourceText: （侨联来稿） 为了吸引广大华人青少年积极参加庆祝美国国庆日活动，并鼓励他们进一步提高中文写作水平和艺术绘画能力，也帮助青少年更好的认知美国，增强华人融入美国主流社会的意识和能力，凤凰城华人华侨社团联合总会决定在今年国庆前夕，举办迎国庆作文，绘画比赛。具体办法如下：
1c1917fed99b66cde5a14ac51f53039985c06fc7.translatedText: (Contributed by the Federation of Overseas Chinese) In order to attract the majority of Chinese teenagers to actively participate in the celebration of the United States National Day, and encourage them to further improve their Chinese writing and artistic painting skills, and also help teenagers better understand the United States, and enhance the awareness and ability of Chinese people to integrate into mainstream American society, the Phoenix Federation of Overseas Chinese Associations decided to hold a composition and painting competition to celebrate the National Day on the eve of this year’s National Day. The specific methods are as follows:

cb91b8cbc01b60762bad1cd835ae8963419ec387.sourceText: 1） 参赛资格：年龄在17岁以下的华人青少年 2） 参赛题目：围绕庆祝美国国庆自选题目，最好能反映华人视角 3） 作品提交时间：从现在起到五月三十一日止 4） 作品评选：邀请5-7名教育界，文化界人士组成评审委员会评选。 作文评选不分年龄段，评选出优秀作文和获奖作文 绘画作品不分年龄组评选出优秀作品 5） 作文用中文，字数在1200字以内。绘画作品无绘画风格限制，画幅尺寸不小于9X9inch，不大于20X20inch，请注明作者姓名和年龄。 6） 表彰与奖励：。优秀作文和获奖作文在七月四日下午四点，举行迎国庆优秀作文报告会，由作者朗诵优秀作品。优秀绘画作品在七月四日庆祝国庆晚会会场前展出，供大家欣赏。并推荐给相关的报刊和杂志上选登。 评选出的优秀作文和绘画作品在国庆晚会上颁发纪念品，获奖作文颁发奖状 和奖学金（数量待定） 欢迎本地华人 青少年积极报名参加。 参赛作品请送交 新东方艺术学校，1100 N.Alma School Rd.Suite18 Chandler，AZ 85255
cb91b8cbc01b60762bad1cd835ae8963419ec387.translatedText: 1) Eligibility: Chinese teenagers under the age of 17 2) Entry topic: A self-selected topic surrounding the celebration of the National Day of the United States, preferably reflecting the Chinese perspective 3) Work submission time: from now to May 31st 4) Work selection: Invite 5-7 people from the education and cultural circles to form a review committee for selection. The composition selection will be conducted regardless of age groups, and outstanding compositions and award-winning compositions will be selected. The painting works will be selected regardless of age groups. Excellent works will be selected. 5) The composition should be in Chinese and the number of words should be within 1,200 words. There is no restriction on painting style. The size of the painting should be no less than 9X9inch and no larger than 20X20inch. Please indicate the author’s name and age. 6) Recognition and rewards:. For outstanding essays and award-winning essays, a report meeting on outstanding essays to celebrate the National Day will be held at 4 p.m. on July 4th, with the authors reciting outstanding works. Excellent paintings were displayed in front of the Fourth of July National Day Gala for everyone to enjoy. And recommend it to relevant newspapers and magazines for selection. The selected outstanding compositions and paintings will be awarded souvenirs at the National Day Gala, and the winning compositions will be awarded certificates and scholarships (number to be determined). Local Chinese teenagers are welcome to actively sign up. Please send entries to New Oriental School of the Arts, 1100 N. Alma School Rd. Suite 18 Chandler, AZ 85255

68d0e997a7e715a42ddbacde7be5287d939ae66d.sourceText: 秋后算账 Wallow大火嫌疑人过堂
68d0e997a7e715a42ddbacde7be5287d939ae66d.translatedText: After the fall, the Wallow fire suspects will appear in court

b4a5c1df666fccd9ac0087572728e5089b1d85ba.sourceText: 秋后算账 Wallow大火嫌疑人过堂 今夏造成亚利桑那州有史以来最大火灾的wallow大火的两名嫌疑人，日…
b4a5c1df666fccd9ac0087572728e5089b1d85ba.translatedText: After the fall, the Wallow fire suspects will appear in court. Two suspects in the Wallow fire, which caused the largest fire in Arizona's history this summer,...

c3c649529bc5537973dcf74eae9bc860971f674d.sourceText: 秋后算账 Wallow大火嫌疑人过堂 今夏造成亚利桑那州有史以来最大火灾的wallow大火的两名嫌疑人，日前在旗杆埠法院过堂。 检控方指马波夫堂兄弟两人，在Apache Sitgreaves国家森林露营时点燃篝火，导致了这场森林大火，大火燃烧53.8万英亩，32家住宅，36座室外建筑，直接损失超过79万美元。 法庭上，男子不认罪。法官下令他们在等待审批期间禁止接近国家森林， Wallow大火今夏5月29日爆发，直至7月8日，季风降雨最终熄灭了火焰。 马波夫兄弟告诉调查人员，他们认为已经熄灭他们点燃煮早餐的篝火才去爬山。但调查人员发现大卫马波夫投掷的糖果包装没有融化。 兄弟俩与当局合作，重组当天露营之旅。林务局调查发现，马波夫没有尝试清除易燃材料，他们也没有用泥土掩埋燃烧过的灰烬。 马波夫兄弟被控五项罪名，包括离开篝火无人值守，未能维持国家森林并导致火灾等。如果罪名成立，他们都面临三年牢狱，罚款2500美元，如果受灾民宅房主提出告诉，还将面临民事诉讼。 下一轮审批将从12月13日开始。
c3c649529bc5537973dcf74eae9bc860971f674d.translatedText: After the fall, the Wallow fire suspects will appear in court. The two suspects in the Wallow fire, which caused the largest fire in Arizona's history this summer, recently appeared in Flagstaff Court. Prosecutors allege that the Mapov cousins ​​lit a campfire while camping in the Apache Sitgreaves National Forest, causing the forest fire. The fire burned 538,000 acres, 32 homes, and 36 outdoor structures, causing direct losses of more than $790,000. In court, the man pleaded not guilty. A judge ordered them to stay off the national forest while they awaited approval, and the Wallow Fire broke out on May 29 this summer until July 8, when monsoon rains finally extinguished the flames. The Mapov brothers told investigators they went hiking thinking they had extinguished the bonfire they had lit to cook breakfast. But investigators found that the candy wrapper David Mapov threw did not melt. The brothers worked with authorities to reorganize the camping trip for the day. A Forest Service investigation found that Mapov made no attempt to remove the flammable material, nor did they bury the burnt ashes with soil. The Mapov brothers were charged with five counts, including leaving a campfire unattended and failing to maintain a national forest and causing a fire. If convicted, they all face three years in prison, a $2,500 fine, and civil lawsuits if the homeowners sue. The next round of approvals will begin on December 13.

354ab463d7a0578e36ddf82c3ea1bdd481154ec7.sourceText: CDC说疫苗有效性不明显 亚省已有450+人殁于流感
354ab463d7a0578e36ddf82c3ea1bdd481154ec7.translatedText: CDC says the vaccine is not obviously effective and 450+ people have died from the flu in Alberta

fc14ddc5089d60a83ac88f9574b5a81197aca123.sourceText: CDC说疫苗有效性不明显 亚省已有450+人殁于流感 美国今年的流感疫苗有效性不到四成，但医学专家指注射疫苗仍…
fc14ddc5089d60a83ac88f9574b5a81197aca123.translatedText: CDC says the vaccine is not obviously effective and 450+ people have died from the flu in Alberta This year's flu vaccine in the United States is less than 40% effective, but medical experts say the vaccine is still...

f3efb3f936fb189354fd55c5a4007f235072ae89.sourceText: 美国今年的流感疫苗有效性不到四成，但医学专家指注射疫苗仍有价值，并呼吁民众尽快注射疫苗，尤其是儿童及时注射、降低流感感染概率。
f3efb3f936fb189354fd55c5a4007f235072ae89.translatedText: The effectiveness of this year's flu vaccine in the United States is less than 40%, but medical experts say the vaccine is still valuable and call on the public to get vaccinated as soon as possible, especially children, to reduce the probability of influenza infection.

36d9189e5821da762d2167c47bb01c37705b67d1.sourceText: 美国疾病控制和预防中心（CDC）周四（2月15日）报告说，2017?018年流感疫苗的有效性初步评估结果是流感疫苗可减少约三分之一（36%）感染流感的概率，但对甲型流感病毒只有25%的有效性。
36d9189e5821da762d2167c47bb01c37705b67d1.translatedText: The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) reported on Thursday (February 15) that a preliminary evaluation of the effectiveness of the 2017-2018 influenza vaccine showed that the influenza vaccine can reduce the probability of influenza infection by about one-third (36%), but is only 25% effective against influenza A viruses.

80dd39f42be48fc69d0700252b84a594707f39db.sourceText: 多位流行病专家表示，今年的流感季是近年来最严重的一次。根据疾控中心之前公布的信息，本季流感的循环病毒株主要是甲型病毒，包括B株（Yamagata和Victoria）、H1N1和H3N2。
80dd39f42be48fc69d0700252b84a594707f39db.translatedText: Many epidemiological experts have said that this year’s flu season is the most serious in recent years. According to information previously released by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the circulating virus strains of influenza this season are mainly type A viruses, including B strains (Yamagata and Victoria), H1N1 and H3N2.

6625e83d23682336a5d40ebab36d7a264afb6c77.sourceText: 其中，H3N2病毒导致了本季迄今为止四分之三的流感发病病例。H3N2病毒是历史上多次流感季的”糟糕肇事者”，会引发更多的并发症、住院和死亡。
6625e83d23682336a5d40ebab36d7a264afb6c77.translatedText: Among them, the H3N2 virus has caused three-quarters of influenza cases so far this season. The H3N2 virus has been a "bad perpetrator" of many flu seasons throughout history, causing more complications, hospitalizations and deaths.

d1d8d27753e7fb3a7cdf64fc14254b160b00d16a.sourceText: 在典型的流感季，疫苗可防止40%至60%的流感病症，使患者不至于严重到要送医就诊。
d1d8d27753e7fb3a7cdf64fc14254b160b00d16a.translatedText: During a typical flu season, the vaccine prevents 40% to 60% of flu illnesses that may become severe enough to require medical attention.

6403cb454dd844349554fcdad53622d548519e6b.sourceText: 对今年流感疫苗不足40%的有效性（36%），且对H3N2病毒有效性仅25%，医学专家表示不必吃惊，并建议民众在目前情况下，选择注射疫苗更好。
6403cb454dd844349554fcdad53622d548519e6b.translatedText: This year's influenza vaccine is less than 40% effective (36%) and only 25% effective against the H3N2 virus. Medical experts say there is no need to be surprised and recommend that people choose to get vaccinated under the current circumstances.

9ee890be15f72901a4bae676803c5e44b6ad3da2.sourceText: ”我们有一个好的疫苗，但不是一个绝佳的，它的效果不明显。”密歇根大学流行病学教授、疾控中心报告作者之一蒙托（Arnold Monto）说。该报告是基于4,562名流感患者的临床数据分析而来的。
9ee890be15f72901a4bae676803c5e44b6ad3da2.translatedText: "We have a good vaccine, but not a great one, and its effect is not obvious." said Arnold Monto, a professor of epidemiology at the University of Michigan and one of the authors of the CDC report. The report is based on an analysis of clinical data from 4,562 influenza patients.

5685cbc94318fcbae39a4e85bbf53505235932a6.sourceText: 蒙托指，相对之前澳大利亚报告的本季流感疫苗只有10%的有效性，美国对H3N2有25%的有效性，已高于澳洲。此外，加拿大研究人员估计该国的流感疫苗有效性也只有17%。
5685cbc94318fcbae39a4e85bbf53505235932a6.translatedText: Monto pointed out that compared with Australia's previous report of only 10% effectiveness of this season's influenza vaccine, the United States has 25% effectiveness against H3N2, which is higher than Australia. In addition, Canadian researchers estimate that the country's flu vaccine is only 17% effective.

9cba7b38d566509b036dfd46fa743841a20a5086.sourceText: 同时，临床数据还包含一个新的亮点：在六个月至八岁的儿童中，疫苗的有效性较高，总体可达到59%。
9cba7b38d566509b036dfd46fa743841a20a5086.translatedText: At the same time, the clinical data also contains a new highlight: among children aged six months to eight years old, the vaccine is more effective, reaching an overall effectiveness of 59%.

97923ed1f6a3245af09b96745e93edd020ba0705.sourceText: 专家表示，即便跟2014?015年度的流感季相比，今年的流感疫苗预防率也更高。2014-2015年度的流感季被医学界定为”中度严重”，被用来比照、参照历年的流感爆发情况，当年CDC发现疫苗有效率仅19%，原因是疫苗中的病毒株与引起疾病的病毒株不匹配。
97923ed1f6a3245af09b96745e93edd020ba0705.translatedText: Experts said that even compared with the 2014-015 flu season, this year's flu vaccine prevention rate is higher. The 2014-2015 flu season was medically defined as "moderately severe" and was used to compare and refer to previous flu outbreaks. That year, the CDC found that the vaccine was only 19% effective because the virus strain in the vaccine did not match the virus strain that caused the disease.

f641cd97d8470f96ef434fe2dc1321f853c01822.sourceText: 蒙托说，完全预防流感并不是接种疫苗的唯一目标，因为更多人接种可以减轻患病人群的流感症状严重程度。
f641cd97d8470f96ef434fe2dc1321f853c01822.translatedText: Complete prevention of the flu is not the only goal of vaccination, as more people vaccinated can reduce the severity of flu symptoms in those who are sick, Monto said.

0e30f881b4cac65b396b9f688014f0d76b7ba7b8.sourceText: 截至2月2日，疾控中心报告10月以来儿童因流感致死的人数已达到53人，共收到12.6万例流感病例报告。这些统计数字不包括所有感染流感的病例，因为许多人生病时没有选择去看医生。
0e30f881b4cac65b396b9f688014f0d76b7ba7b8.translatedText: As of February 2, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported that the number of deaths among children due to influenza since October had reached 53, and a total of 126,000 influenza case reports had been received. These statistics do not include all cases of influenza infection because many people do not choose to see a doctor when they become sick.

599cfb9e901c39e77aa0ad72942f90d165611db4.sourceText: 纽约南纳苏郡社区医院医学系主任格莱特（Aaron Glatt）也表示，甚至是不完美的疫苗，选择注射也很有价值。
599cfb9e901c39e77aa0ad72942f90d165611db4.translatedText: Aaron Glatt, director of the Department of Medicine at South Nassau County Community Hospital in New York, also said that even with imperfect vaccines, it is valuable to choose to inject them.

16749992b6558fe52c1d7329596bf38b2b5d57a9.sourceText: 作为美国传染病协会的发言人，格莱特表示，根据最新的报告，近年来因流感死亡的儿童中，有70%都没有接种疫苗。
16749992b6558fe52c1d7329596bf38b2b5d57a9.translatedText: As a spokesman for the Infectious Diseases Society of America, Greit said that according to the latest reports, 70% of children who died from influenza in recent years were not vaccinated.

e6d92d9de6469564c2ce173ba0167fe4e4d50cc5.sourceText: 医学界仍期待流感疫苗能更有效，而美国疾控中心一直呼吁民众尽快注射流感疫苗，并继续监控和评估现有疫苗的有效性。
e6d92d9de6469564c2ce173ba0167fe4e4d50cc5.translatedText: The medical community still hopes that the flu vaccine will be more effective, and the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has been calling on the public to get the flu vaccine as soon as possible and continue to monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of existing vaccines.

7178e241e363bab2a3196649a6ae80e586179069.sourceText: 在亚利桑那州，据官方资料，截止于2月14日，已录得超过23000例流感，其中461人因流感死亡。其中65岁以上老年人病例占30%，另外25%是18岁或以下的儿童。
7178e241e363bab2a3196649a6ae80e586179069.translatedText: In Arizona, according to official data, as of February 14, more than 23,000 cases of influenza have been recorded, including 461 deaths due to influenza. Among them, 30% of the cases are in people over 65 years old, and the other 25% are children 18 years old or younger.

cb8711ec301c8b41b9f9d1e340bc1d946a444b4a.sourceText: 亚利桑那州卫生厅官员说，前段时间甲型流感较多，但最近B型流感病例有所增加。相比之下，B型流感较A型流感症状较轻，但疲劳、疼痛、流鼻涕免不了。
cb8711ec301c8b41b9f9d1e340bc1d946a444b4a.translatedText: Arizona Department of Health officials said there were more influenza A some time ago, but cases of influenza B have increased recently. In contrast, influenza B has milder symptoms than influenza A, but fatigue, pain, and runny nose are inevitable.

b9974b76316da74789b75b72ee2bac05b45b1a49.sourceText: 卫生厅官员建议那些担心流感的人，如果还没有接种疫苗的话就应该接种疫苗，而那些生病的人应该呆在家里避免传染疾病。
b9974b76316da74789b75b72ee2bac05b45b1a49.translatedText: Health officials recommend that those concerned about the flu should get vaccinated if they haven't already, and that those who are sick should stay home to avoid spreading the disease.

22e1d96a131bb94776e7c90568557c4aece957b6.sourceText: 美墨三州大停电影响600万人 核电站停摆
22e1d96a131bb94776e7c90568557c4aece957b6.translatedText: A blackout in three states in the United States and Mexico affects 6 million people, and nuclear power plants are shut down

5c4ec4581e9e7c0e79f96e57ea4bd48ca2e19341.sourceText: 美墨三州大停电影响600万人 核电站停摆 （亚省时报） 美国西岸的南加州、亚利桑纳州部分地区和墨西哥北部，…
5c4ec4581e9e7c0e79f96e57ea4bd48ca2e19341.translatedText: A blackout in three states in the United States and Mexico affects 6 million people, and nuclear power plants are shut down (Alberta Times) Southern California, parts of Arizona, and northern Mexico on the west coast of the United States...

c6a0cc4ba83909f246473a93bc9b351989c95872.sourceText: 美国西岸的南加州、亚利桑纳州部分地区和墨西哥北部，8日发生大规模停电，总计有600万人无电可用，这起大停电还迫使南加州的圣欧诺福核电厂，一度当机 ，当局紧急召开记者会表示，核电厂停摆不会造成核安危机。 这起大停电的起因，是亚利桑纳州供电给加州用户的输电线，可能因为负载过大而发生异常跳电，受害地区当中以南加州的圣地牙哥最严重。 APS表示，1名员工在近亚利桑那州尤马的分电厂执行1道”手续”，引发停电。 之后安全防护系统也未能停止问题扩散。 发言人葛罗斯表示：”看起来是有2起错误。分别是人工和系统错误。我们会处理这2件问题。” 民生用电停摆，整个停电地区一片漆黑，虽然已经是夏末，但天气还是相当燠热，气温高达摄氏37.7度，有民众受不了，干脆把车开出门吹冷气，但路上的交通号志也一路 失灵，不管是汽车、铁公路，全部乱成一团，行动电话基地台停摆，手机根本无法通话，而航空班机也一度受影响，全面暂时停飞，最可怕的是南加州的圣欧诺福 核电厂，有两个机组也发生了停电。 不过，当局也马上公开安抚民众​​不要惊慌，停电并不会导致任何核安危险，这起大停电，也让民众知道平日省电的重要，以免再度发生用电激增的跳电事故。
c6a0cc4ba83909f246473a93bc9b351989c95872.translatedText: A large-scale power outage occurred on the 8th in Southern California, parts of Arizona, and northern Mexico on the west coast of the United States. A total of 6 million people were without power. This blackout also forced the St. Onofrio Nuclear Power Plant in Southern California to shut down for a time. The authorities held an emergency press conference and stated that the shutdown of the nuclear power plant would not cause a nuclear safety crisis. The cause of this major blackout was that the transmission lines from Arizona to California users may have experienced abnormal power outages due to excessive load. Among the affected areas, San Diego in Southern California was the most severely affected. APS said an employee performed a "procedure" at a power plant near Yuma, Arizona, which triggered the outage. Later, the security system failed to stop the problem from spreading. Spokesman Gross said: "It seems that there were two errors. They were manual and system errors. We will deal with these two problems." The power supply for people's livelihood was shut down, and the entire blackout area was dark. Although it was late summer, the weather was still quite hot, with the temperature as high as 37.7 degrees Celsius. Some people couldn't stand it and simply drove out to blow the air conditioner, but the traffic signals on the road were also all over the place. The malfunction caused everything from cars to railways and roads to become a mess. Mobile phone base stations were shut down, making it impossible to make calls on mobile phones. Air flights were also affected for a time and were temporarily grounded. The most terrifying thing was the St. Onofrio Nuclear Power Plant in Southern California, where two units also experienced a power outage. However, the authorities immediately publicly reassured the public not to panic. The power outage would not cause any nuclear safety hazards. This major blackout also let the public know the importance of saving electricity on weekdays to avoid another power outage accident caused by a surge in electricity consumption.

4d39a111b577c8415ebc0b92ead4e79b6f806e2b.sourceText: Costco烤鸡卖得很火 有何秘诀？
4d39a111b577c8415ebc0b92ead4e79b6f806e2b.translatedText: Costco's roasted chicken is selling like hotcakes. What's the secret?

fa60dd4ba40a3cc59e5c647577917316e163b403.sourceText: Costco烤鸡卖得很火 有何秘诀？ 超市烤鸡美味又便宜，为省成本，多数超市会在烤鸡重量上做文章。thisis…
fa60dd4ba40a3cc59e5c647577917316e163b403.translatedText: Costco’s roast chicken is selling like hotcakes. What’s the secret? Roasted chicken in supermarkets is delicious and cheap. In order to save costs, most supermarkets will make a fuss about the weight of the roasted chicken. thisis…

2b90fabfd89e2e6b9ad43110ff37878cdf82e683.sourceText: 超市烤鸡美味又便宜，为省成本，多数超市会在烤鸡重量上做文章。thisisinsider.com网站报导，《华尔街日报》的报告显示，多数超市的烤鸡价格在5～7元之间，Costco烤鸡也是这个价格。两者唯一的区别是，Costco烤鸡至少重3磅，是其它超市烤鸡1.5磅的至少2倍。除去这一点外，Costco烤鸡还有什么特别之处让大家非买不可呢？
2b90fabfd89e2e6b9ad43110ff37878cdf82e683.translatedText: Supermarket roast chicken is delicious and cheap. In order to save costs, most supermarkets will make a fuss about the weight of the roast chicken. The thisisinsider.com website reported that a report from the Wall Street Journal showed that the price of roasted chicken in most supermarkets is between 5 and 7 yuan, and Costco’s roasted chicken is also the same price. The only difference between the two is that the Costco rotisserie chicken weighs at least 3 pounds, which is at least twice as much as the 1.5-pound rotisserie chicken from other supermarkets. Apart from this, what else is special about Costco’s roasted chicken that makes everyone want to buy it?

4144bda0488e00689455c75d2ad0b6d486a13b2f.sourceText: Costco每天平均卖出15.7万只烤鸡，仅去年一年就卖出了8700万只。卖这么多，应该赚很多钱吧！错！
4144bda0488e00689455c75d2ad0b6d486a13b2f.translatedText: Costco sells an average of 157,000 roasted chickens every day, and 87 million were sold last year alone. If you sell so many, you should make a lot of money! wrong!

df6cea806daa8665bd35ff39311e7e49791742e6.sourceText: Costco首席财务官透露，公司每年的烤鸡业务亏损在3000万～4000万之间。即便如此，Costco仍坚持不涨价，认为现在的定价才是一只烤鸡的真正价值。这种不在一只烤鸡上与消费者斤斤计较的大气，吸引了大量客流，带动其它商品的销量，真正受益的还是Costco。
df6cea806daa8665bd35ff39311e7e49791742e6.translatedText: Costco’s chief financial officer revealed that the company’s annual roast chicken business losses range from 30 million to 40 million. Even so, Costco still insists on not raising prices, believing that the current price is the true value of a roast chicken. This atmosphere of not fussing with consumers over a roasted chicken has attracted a large number of customers and boosted sales of other products. The real beneficiary is Costco.

9adcafa6af3fdfc59a0db101e49c354ba2c7cb83.sourceText: 吃过Costco烤鸡的人，都知道它其实非常咸，但因为Costco在鸡肉中注入一种特别的盐水以提味，味虽咸却超级美味。经测量，每只烤鸡中含纳量高达460毫克。
9adcafa6af3fdfc59a0db101e49c354ba2c7cb83.translatedText: Anyone who has eaten Costco roasted chicken knows that it is actually very salty, but because Costco injects a special brine into the chicken to enhance the taste, it is salty but super delicious. It has been measured that each roast chicken contains up to 460 mg of sodium.

b161b345116c69ca64d23d4993840c44d66ba701.sourceText: Costco烤鸡其实没什么奇怪的成分。烤鸡在运往门店前，一般已经调好味了，因此才有加工食品这一称号。即便如此，美国《奥兹博士秀》（The Dr. Oz Show）仍向观众推荐说，Costco的烤鸡是市场上最健康的加工食品之一，去皮后的烤鸡会更健康。
b161b345116c69ca64d23d4993840c44d66ba701.translatedText: Costco roasted chicken actually has no weird ingredients. Roast chicken is usually seasoned before being shipped to the store, hence the title of processed food. Even so, the American "Dr. Oz Show" (The Dr. Oz Show) still recommends to viewers that Costco's roasted chicken is one of the healthiest processed foods on the market, and the skinless roasted chicken will be healthier.

38fba3b667c83b4dfdbfc9a2bd196dfac0094abf.sourceText: Costco烤鸡还有专门的脸书粉丝网页，有一万多名粉丝追随。
38fba3b667c83b4dfdbfc9a2bd196dfac0094abf.translatedText: Costco Roast Chicken also has a dedicated Facebook fan page, with more than 10,000 fans following it.

d5445ef79c9a10f3252c69443aa3b72b920fa1ff.sourceText: 最后说一句，大家请放心，Costco烤鸡不仅美味，还绝对健康！
d5445ef79c9a10f3252c69443aa3b72b920fa1ff.translatedText: Finally, please rest assured that Costco roasted chicken is not only delicious, but also absolutely healthy!

da6a430486085d4e4de44d45538261de2d1ebe4f.sourceText: 唱唱吹吹彈彈踢踢 圖桑慶中秋 亞利桑那州台灣同鄉聯誼會於九月三日十二時，假城東的浸信會教堂，慶祝中秋節。今年是２０１１年，中華民國精彩一百的中秋節。各人帶來美食甜點水果，歡聚一堂，喜樂融融。 節目非常豐富，由王瑞瑾與杜老師主持。我們很榮幸的邀請到世界知名的法裔口琴家畢艾爾(Pierre)，用大小不同的口琴，吹奏名曲多首。古箏名家梁正鏘彈奏林沖夜奔，用音樂很生動地來表達這位好漢, 被逼而投奔梁山的故事. 表演太極拳, 動作柔和美妙. 胡耿豪及他的好友Tim示範跆拳道, 且做了詳細的解說, 並在表演以後, 施展真功夫, 一拳打裂疊著的六塊磚, 觀眾齊聲驚呼. 杜老師與James 合唱 – 友情 為同樂會揭開序幕 Mr. Larry Leung古箏表演 太極拳老師表演 胡耿豪的跆拳道 接著是卡拉OK節目. 有多位先生女士引亢高歌. 除國語外, 尚有台語, 粵語和英語的歌曲. 友情, 月滿西樓, 但願人長久, 草原情歌, 高山青, 月亮代表我的心, 梅花及中華民國頌等, 讓人有繞樑三日之感. 至五時始盡興而散. 每人並獲贈月餅一枚, 回家品嚐. 主辦單位還贈送建國百年圍巾給表演嘉賓以表謝意. 與杜老師, 梁正鏘, 王瑞瑾及包教授合影
da6a430486085d4e4de44d45538261de2d1ebe4f.translatedText: Sing, play, play and kick Tusang to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. The Taiwanese Association of Arizona held a ceremony at the Baptist Church in the east of the city at 12:00 on September 3 to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. This year is 2011, the wonderful Mid-Autumn Festival of the Republic of China. Everyone brought delicious desserts and fruits, and gathered together happily. The program is very rich and hosted by Wang Ruijin and Teacher Du. We are honored to invite the world-renowned French harmonica player Pierre to play many famous songs on harmonicas of different sizes. Guzheng master Liang Zhengqiang played Lin Chong Ye Ben, and used music to vividly express the story of this hero who was forced to defect to Liangshan. He performed Tai Chi with soft and beautiful movements. Hu Genghao and his friend Tim demonstrated Taekwondo and gave detailed explanations. After the performance, they displayed real kung fu and cracked six stacked bricks with one punch. The audience exclaimed in unison. Teacher Du and James sang in chorus - Friendship kicked off the concert with a guzheng performance by Mr. Larry Leung, a Tai Chi teacher's performance, Hu Genghao's taekwondo, and then a karaoke program. Many gentlemen and ladies sang. In addition to Mandarin, there were also songs in Taiwanese, Cantonese and English. Friendship, Full Moon on the West Tower, May Life Be Long, Prairie Love Song, Mountain Green, The Moon Represents My Heart, Plum Blossoms and Ode to the Republic of China, etc. It made people feel like they had been around for three days. They dispersed at five o'clock. Each person was given a moon cake to taste at home. The organizer also presented a century-old scarf to the performers as a token of gratitude. Take a group photo with Teacher Du, Liang Zhengqiang, Wang Ruijin and Professor Bao

2358733dcec61b0a678b2354d61a5aee08e3f752.sourceText: 亚利桑那创业前景落后全美 内布拉斯加大学刚推出一项新的研究，对全美各州的经济前景和吸引企业家的能力做了详细评估。 当谈到创业，亚利桑那州排名在全美倒数第二。 大凤凰城经济委员会主席巴里布鲁姆说，这些研究令人失望，但不奇怪。 据布鲁姆说，亚利桑那州的小型企业家不足，直接关系到本州的住房、旅游、娱乐和建筑行业。 此外，州立法机关还大大削减高等教育的资助。 ”有些政府开支是为发展良好的经济，而有些不是，”布鲁姆说。” 布鲁姆说，在立法委员花钱去比较哪所州立大学更好的同时，越来越少企业家关注亚利桑那州的投资环境，不足为奇。 纽约是全美最吸引企业家的州。 南卡排亚利桑那州后面，全美第50。
2358733dcec61b0a678b2354d61a5aee08e3f752.translatedText: Arizona's entrepreneurial prospects lag behind those of the United States The University of Nebraska has just launched a new study that provides a detailed assessment of the economic prospects and ability of states across the country to attract entrepreneurs. When it comes to starting a business, Arizona ranks second to last in the nation. Barry Bloom, president of the Greater Phoenix Economic Council, said the studies are disappointing but not surprising. According to Blum, Arizona’s lack of small entrepreneurs is directly related to the state’s housing, tourism, entertainment and construction industries. In addition, state legislatures have drastically cut funding for higher education. "Some government spending is about developing a good economy, and some is not," Bloom said. Bloom said that while legislators spend money to compare which state universities are better, it is not surprising that fewer and fewer entrepreneurs are paying attention to Arizona's investment environment. New York is the most attractive state for entrepreneurs in the United States. South Carolina ranks 50th in the United States, behind Arizona.

ec237e727f94df66d4ea92e2943a33c8d57f7ee9.translatedText: Invest in diversified bond funds Today's bond investors can make short, medium and long-term investment portfolios according to their own investment purposes. These portfolios can include investment-grade companies...

57bf770a3c5071a0f14121021681d631172353ed.sourceText: 投资多元化债券基金 现在的债券投资人可依自己的投资目的，做短、中、长期的投资组合，这些组合可以包括投资级企业债、高收益或垃圾债券、房贷抵押担保债券、由外国政府或国内政府发行 的公债。 据消费者报导杂志指出，其实投资人不需要自行选择投资组合，可以直接投资多元化债券（Multi-Sector Bond）基金，管理这些基金的经理人可以以他们的专业判断，投资他们认为有前途的 领域，或是减少他们认为已经开始走下坡的部位，在过去这些年来，债券的收益率普遍偏低的时后，有些多元化债券基金的回报率表现相对亮眼。 例如，Loomis Sayles Bond Retail Fund一年的整体的获利率为16.1%，不过长期追踪多元化债券基金的晨星公司（Morningstar）分析师杨（Kathryn Young）表示，虽然透过投资组合来分散风险是个不错的 意见，但投资人还是要先做足功课，再来决定投资那一档多元化债券基金。 由于这些基金拥有分散的债券投资组合，所以同时他们也暴露在各种不同程度的风险之下，例如基金经理人选择垃圾债券所冒的风险就比选择投资级公司债高得多。 如果经理人选择投资海外债券，就要冒着汇率损失的风险。 而不同的多元化债券基金，对经理人的规定也宽松不一，财务顾问蔻儿（Jennifer Cole）表示，有些基金给经理人很大的弹性空间，经理人可以选择任何他想要的投资标的 ，甚至可能采用一些非常复杂的避险策略，有些基金对经理人的管理较严，经理人操作的弹性不大。 投资人在选择基金前，可以先阅读基金的公开说明书，以明了该基金的操作策略。 而谈到基金最重要的还是大家耳熟能详的那句话「过去的绩效并不等于未来的绩效」，由于这些基金往往包山包海，所以很难去衡量他们的绩效，一个多元化的投资组合 可能融合了新兴市场债、垃圾债券、投资级公司债与房贷抵押担保债券，这样多样的投资组合可能无法用任何一项指数做为相对的衡量标准。 晨星公司常常使用同类基金的平均绩效做为衡量标准，杨补充说，就算这样的评断方式也不是很客观。 蔻儿则表示，如何以客观的指数评量多元化债券的绩效，对她来说不重要，「在大盘牛气冲天时投资组合逊于大盘，或是大盘进入熊市时投资组合绩效优于大盘 」，她都会很高兴。 如果无法以任何指数来衡量多元化债券基金，在选择这些投资组合的时后该考虑那些因素？ 当然基金经理人的经验很重要，但是更要注意的是经理人背后的研究团队，蔻儿表示，「我要一个知道自己在作什么的研究团队，因为一人乐团不可能专精所有事。」 这意谓着投资人需要一个较大型的基金公司，大的基金公司才有可能包含各种专业的成员。 虽然蔻儿偏爱大型基金公司强而有力的研究能力，但是她却避免选择规模最大的多元化债券基金，她认为大型基金的投资标地过于广泛，无法做足够的信用品质判断。 杨则建议以2008年的基金绩效做为检验标准，2008年对大多数债券都是非常惨澹的一年，「如果你无法接受当年的基金绩效，就表示这档基金不适合你。」
57bf770a3c5071a0f14121021681d631172353ed.translatedText: Invest in diversified bond funds Today's bond investors can build short-, medium-, and long-term investment portfolios based on their own investment purposes. These portfolios can include investment-grade corporate bonds, high-yield or junk bonds, mortgage-backed bonds, and public bonds issued by foreign or domestic governments. According to Consumer Reports magazine, in fact, investors do not need to choose their own investment portfolios and can invest directly in Multi-Sector Bond funds. Managers who manage these funds can use their professional judgment to invest in areas they think are promising, or reduce positions they think have begun to decline. In the past few years, when bond yields have generally been low, the return performance of some diversified bond funds has been relatively bright. For example, the Loomis Sayles Bond Retail Fund's overall one-year return rate is 16.1%. However, Morningstar analyst Kathryn Young, who has long tracked diversified bond funds, said that although it is a good idea to diversify risks through investment portfolios, investors still need to do their homework before deciding which diversified bond fund to invest in. Because these funds have diversified bond portfolios, they are also exposed to varying degrees of risk. For example, fund managers taking on junk bonds take much higher risks than investing in investment-grade corporate bonds. If managers choose to invest in overseas bonds, they run the risk of exchange rate losses. Different diversified bond funds also have looser regulations on managers. Financial consultant Jennifer Cole said that some funds give managers a lot of flexibility. The manager can choose any investment target he wants, and may even adopt some very complex hedging strategies. Some funds have stricter management of managers and less flexibility in manager operations. Before choosing a fund, investors can read the fund's prospectus to understand the fund's operating strategy. When it comes to funds, the most important thing is the familiar saying "past performance does not equal future performance." Since these funds are often all-encompassing, it is difficult to measure their performance. A diversified investment portfolio may include emerging market bonds, junk bonds, investment-grade corporate bonds and mortgage-backed bonds. Such a diverse investment portfolio may not be able to use any index as a relative measurement standard. Morningstar often uses the average performance of similar funds as its metric, and even that approach is not very objective, Yang added. Kerr said that it is not important to her how to use an objective index to evaluate the performance of diversified bonds. "She will be happy if the portfolio underperforms the market when the market is bullish, or if the portfolio performs better than the market when the market enters a bear market." If diversified bond funds cannot be measured against any index, what factors should be considered when selecting these portfolios? Of course, the experience of a fund manager is important, but more attention should be paid to the research team behind the manager. Kerr said, "I want a research team that knows what it is doing, because a one-person team cannot specialize in everything." This means that investors need a larger fund company, and only a large fund company may include members from various professions. Although Kerr prefers the strong research capabilities of large fund companies, she avoids choosing the largest diversified bond funds. She believes that the investment targets of large funds are too broad and cannot make sufficient judgments on credit quality. Yang suggested using the fund performance in 2008 as a test standard. 2008 was a very miserable year for most bonds. "If you cannot accept the fund performance that year, it means that this fund is not suitable for you."

b344e594b6d8f6b5c030641cd7e82871ac8644a9.sourceText: 美国首位华裔女众议员赵美心以美国国会亚太裔小组主席的身份率国会代表团访问中国8天，在走访了北京、南京、上海、广州、深圳、香港等地后。并在阔别21年后，于9月3日，再次回到故乡广东江门新会省亲、进行私人访问，拜会父母的家乡江门市及新会区领导。江门市委常委旷仁山、副市长陈杭，以及江门市外侨局梁富鸣局长等会见了赵美心一行。
b344e594b6d8f6b5c030641cd7e82871ac8644a9.translatedText: The first Chinese-American congresswoman in the United States, Meixin Chao, as the chairperson of the Asian and Pacific Islander Caucus in the U.S. Congress, led a congressional delegation to visit China for 8 days. After visiting Beijing, Nanjing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Hong Kong and other places. After an absence of 21 years, on September 3, he returned to his hometown of Xinhui, Jiangmen, Guangdong, to visit relatives and pay a private visit. He also visited his parents’ hometown of Jiangmen City and the leaders of Xinhui District. Kuang Renshan, member of the Standing Committee of the Jiangmen Municipal Party Committee, Vice Mayor Chen Hang, and Director Liang Fuming of the Jiangmen Overseas Chinese Bureau met with Zhao Meixin and her delegation.

e9af53bcfb784cbc167447577c002707d845fbc7.sourceText: 赵美心回到家乡， 赵美心（左 5 ）与江门市副市长陈杭、副秘书长梁启华、市外侨局局长梁富鸣等合影 赵美心祖籍新会古井，曾于1990年担任蒙特利公园市市长期间回过家乡。此次赴江门访问主要是前往祖籍地新会古井、沙堆等地省亲，并在陈杭副市长的陪同下，参观了华侨博物馆。她指出，展览反映在美国发展的各个阶段，华侨们的艰苦旅途，承受的苦难以及受到的盘剥。赵美心表示，此次访问，使她掌握了更多更充分的资源，将来会去促使美国国会就排华法案进行公开道歉。
e9af53bcfb784cbc167447577c002707d845fbc7.translatedText: Zhao Meixin returned to her hometown. Zhao Meixin (5th from left) took a group photo with Jiangmen City Vice Mayor Chen Hang, Deputy Secretary-General Liang Qihua, Director of the Municipal Overseas Chinese Bureau Liang Fuming, etc. Zhao Meixin was originally from Gujing, Xinhui, and returned to her hometown in 1990 when she was the mayor of Monterey Park. This visit to Jiangmen was mainly to visit relatives in Xinhui Gujing, Shadui and other places where his ancestral home is. He also visited the Overseas Chinese Museum accompanied by Vice Mayor Chen Hang. She pointed out that the exhibition reflected the arduous journey, suffering and exploitation of the overseas Chinese at various stages of the development of the United States. Zhao Meixin said that this visit has given her more and more sufficient resources, and in the future she will urge the U.S. Congress to issue a public apology for the Chinese Exclusion Act.

f0fdd177aba9b572aa0f7d05284694452861049d.sourceText: 当天下午，赵美心乘车前往新会古井镇霞路乡五福里，参观了赵家祖屋和赵氏祠堂。当车队到达五福里村牌坊时，该村乡亲以及赵氏宗亲们敲锣打鼓，点放鞭炮，迎接赵美心的到来。村里老人们拍着手高兴地说着：”欢迎回家！”
f0fdd177aba9b572aa0f7d05284694452861049d.translatedText: In the afternoon, Zhao Meixin drove to Wufuli, Xialu Township, Xinhui Gujing Town, and visited the Zhao family's ancestral house and Zhao's ancestral hall. When the motorcade arrived at the archway of Wufuli Village, the villagers and the Zhao family members beat gongs and drums and lit firecrackers to welcome Zhao Meixin's arrival. The old people in the village clapped their hands and said happily: "Welcome home!"

6f35008b07871a2884dccb1fc3c28019541f45e9.sourceText: 受到乡亲们的热烈欢迎
6f35008b07871a2884dccb1fc3c28019541f45e9.translatedText: was warmly welcomed by the villagers

14ceba5f33e7e9f29b6795d464d7c53b82062eb1.sourceText: 在赵氏祖屋，赵美心按照习俗，三鞠躬给自己的先人上香。祖屋里，有赵氏宗亲悬挂起来的赵美心在参选美国国会联邦众议员时的竞选照片。看到这些照片，赵美心十分高兴，连声说”好”。在祖屋里，五福里村赵姓村长拿出了赵美心家用过的碗，并把碗送给了赵美心。
14ceba5f33e7e9f29b6795d464d7c53b82062eb1.translatedText: In Zhao's ancestral house, Zhao Meixin bowed three times to offer incense to her ancestors in accordance with the custom. In the ancestral house, there is a campaign photo of Zhao Meixin when she was running for the U.S. House of Representatives hung up by the Zhao clan. Seeing these photos, Zhao Meixin was very happy and said "ok" repeatedly. In the ancestral house, the village chief surnamed Zhao of Wufuli Village took out the bowl used by Zhao Meixin's family and gave the bowl to Zhao Meixin.

3d6a67647ea9416f2c73d1c97ad0ba5ba2419567.sourceText: 赵美心在新会古井霞路乡 9月3日晚，在为她而举行的晚宴开始前，古井的乡亲们送来了题字本，请她写几个字，作为留念，不会写汉字的她的用尽心力，像个专注的小学生一样，给家乡父老留下了”古树根深 井水乡甜”个字，以表心声。
3d6a67647ea9416f2c73d1c97ad0ba5ba2419567.translatedText: Zhao Meixin in Xialu Township, Gujing, Xinhui On the evening of September 3, before the dinner held in her honor, the folks from Gujing sent an inscription book and asked her to write a few words as a souvenir. She, who could not write Chinese characters, worked hard, like a dedicated primary school student, and left the words "The roots of the ancient trees are deep and the town of Jingshui is sweet" to the elders in her hometown to express her feelings.

94af659e02528aa72b25ac70d45682b7caf6887f.sourceText: 在晚宴中，她站起来，深情地向所有人致谢，赵美心表示，此次回到江门，让她印象十分深刻。”江门这20年变化惊人，路修得很好，还有先进的城轨。我为父母的家乡感到自豪，在这里真有回家的感觉，将来有机会会更多地回来。”(AACYF讯）
94af659e02528aa72b25ac70d45682b7caf6887f.translatedText: During the dinner, she stood up and thanked everyone affectionately. Zhao Meixin said that she was very impressed by her return to Jiangmen this time. "Jiangmen has undergone amazing changes in the past 20 years. The roads are well built and there is advanced urban rail. I am proud of my parents' hometown. I really feel like going home here. I will come back more in the future if I have the opportunity." (AACYF News)

f1650c8eaa37aba30d90e814d71c4c093eb3f0a1.sourceText: 飞机乘客没关电话被捕 9月5日，一名男子从凤凰城乘坐西南航空班机飞往德州途中，因拒绝关闭手机而被捕。 西南航空发言人说，该名男子在飞机降落德州艾尔帕所时，没有听从空乘人员劝阻，打开手机，飞机着陆后，被艾尔帕所警方在机舱口带走。 信息没有公布该名男子姓名和其他细节。 那些习惯在飞机降落而指示灯未灭前就开机的朋友，切记：为了你的和其他人的安全，请缓开手机。
f1650c8eaa37aba30d90e814d71c4c093eb3f0a1.translatedText: Passenger was arrested for not turning off his phone. On September 5, a man was arrested for refusing to turn off his phone on a Southwest Airlines flight from Phoenix to Texas. A spokesman for Southwest Airlines said that when the plane landed in El Pago, Texas, the man ignored the flight attendant's dissuasion and turned on his cell phone. After the plane landed, he was taken away by El Pago police at the cabin door. The man's name and other details were not released. For those of you who are used to turning on your phone before the light goes out before the plane lands, please remember: For your own safety and the safety of others, please turn on your phone slowly.

29dab832502db2fe802cab62bfb52b9fea41603a.sourceText: 加州议会通过法案 禁止鱼翅交易 9月6日，加州参议院以25-9的票数通过一项议案，禁止在加州买卖、交易和拥有鱼翅，该议案待由州长签署成法律。如果该议案被签署成法律，将在明年元旦开始生效，而现有库存鱼翅仍可继续出售一年。 该议案由华裔众议员方文忠起草，虽然从小食用鱼翅，但几年前看过一部鱼翅交易记录篇后，方文忠开始改变对鱼翅的认识与态度。 他在今年5月的一份新闻稿中曾表示，因为鱼翅昂贵，所以导致鲨鱼滥杀，而世界上没有足够的鲨鱼来维持这种鱼翅交易。 鱼翅每磅售价可高达6百美元，一碗鱼翅卖价可达80美元。 方文忠受访时表示，身为中国人自己感到骄傲，但如此交易将导致鲨鱼绝种，海洋生态也将失去平衡，而没有鱼翅中国文化仍将继续得以流传。 参议院禁止鱼翅议案，得到了包括刘璇卿在内的半数亚裔议员们的支持。 支持者表示，估计有7千3百万条鲨鱼因鱼翅交易而死，被割除鱼翅后的鲨鱼被扔回海里等死，这尤其残忍。 南加州参议员Christine Kehoe表示，除亚洲外，加州是世界最大鱼翅消费场所，估计85%的出口干鱼翅抵达加州，她认为加州消费加剧了鲨鱼被杀。 科学家认为鱼翅危及了海洋生态平衡。 有媒体报导，今年8月一澳大利亚海洋科学组织曾向美国海洋捕鱼服务机构致函，呼吁美国政府为保护正在数量减少的鲨鱼，禁止从15个对鲨鱼保护不足的国家，进口鱼翅等鲨鱼产品 。 15个国家中包括中国、台北、南韩、澳大利亚、新西兰、巴西、​​加拿大、墨西哥、巴拿马、秘鲁、西班牙等。 参议院议案在议论时，得到了议会左右人士的支持。 除政府官员外，该议案还得到了保护动物协会，和电影明星宝黛丽及篮球明星姚明等的支持。 众议院禁止鱼翅法案，已在今年5月以65-8通过。 除加州外，夏威夷、俄勒冈州和华盛顿州也都已经通过类似禁止鱼翅法律。 加州参议员夏乐柏、刘云平和余胤良对此法案提出反对意见。 他们表示，因为鱼翅是亚裔的佳肴，而且除鱼翅外鲨鱼肉和鲨鱼皮并不禁止，所以此议案带有歧视。 余胤良表示，据美国海洋捕鱼服务报告，全美进出口鱼翅只占不到全世界的1%。
29dab832502db2fe802cab62bfb52b9fea41603a.translatedText: The California Assembly passed a bill to ban the trade of shark fins. On September 6, the California Senate passed a bill by a vote of 25-9 to ban the sale, trade and possession of shark fins in California. The bill needs to be signed into law by the governor. If the bill is signed into law, it would take effect on New Year's Day next year, and existing stocks of shark fins could continue to be sold for another year. The bill was drafted by Chinese-American Congressman Fang Wenzhong. Although he had been eating shark fins since he was a child, Fang Wenzhong began to change his understanding and attitude towards shark fins after reading a record of shark fin trade a few years ago. He said in a press release in May this year that because shark fins are expensive, sharks are killed indiscriminately, and there are not enough sharks in the world to sustain this shark fin trade. Shark fins can sell for up to $600 per pound, and a bowl of shark fins can cost up to $80. Fang Wenzhong said in an interview that he is proud to be Chinese, but such a trade will lead to the extinction of sharks and the imbalance of marine ecology. Without shark fins, Chinese culture will continue to be spread. The Senate bill to ban shark fin is supported by half of Asian-American lawmakers, including Liu Xuanqing. Supporters say it is particularly cruel that an estimated 73 million sharks are killed as a result of the shark fin trade, and that sharks whose fins are removed are thrown back into the sea to die. Southern California Senator Christine Kehoe said that after Asia, California is the world's largest consumer of shark fins. An estimated 85% of exported dried shark fins arrive in California. She believes that California consumption has exacerbated shark killings. Scientists believe shark fins threaten the ecological balance of the ocean. According to media reports, in August this year, an Australian marine science organization sent a letter to the U.S. Marine Fishing Service, calling on the U.S. government to protect the declining shark population by banning the import of shark fins and other shark products from 15 countries that have insufficient shark protection. The 15 countries include China, Taipei, South Korea, Australia, New Zealand, Brazil, Canada, Mexico, Panama, Peru, Spain, etc. While the Senate bill was being debated, it received support from people on the left and right of the chamber. In addition to government officials, the bill also received support from the Animal Protection Association, movie star Bao Daili and basketball star Yao Ming. The House of Representatives passed the shark fin ban bill 65-8 in May this year. In addition to California, Hawaii, Oregon and Washington state have also passed similar laws banning shark fins. California Senators Xia Lebo, Liu Yunping and Yu Yinliang raised objections to this bill. They said that because shark fin is a delicacy of Asians and shark meat and shark skin are not prohibited except for shark fin, this bill is discriminatory. Yu Yinliang said that according to the US Marine Fishing Service report, the import and export of shark fins in the United States only accounts for less than 1% of the world's total.

64914d3cc2e5ebb437e6dfe3408508e69163148a.sourceText: 空港机场拟提停车费 凤凰城市政府正在讨论一项新动议，就是将提高空港机场的停车费。 估计这项涨价会影响到场外停车设施，出租车和豪华轿车服务，附近的酒店和租车服务。 蓝天机场停车场的老板大卫沃伦说，根据新提案，在他使用他的面包车送人到机场时，将不得不每次支付6美元停车费。 一年费用估计超过50万美元，超过他全年的收入。 ”对于我们这种小本经营者确实非常困难，” 沃伦说。 ” 为了消化成本，维持业务，唯一的选择就是将这笔费用转嫁到顾客身上。”? 虽然，航空副主任麦科斯基说，市政府没有做出最后决定，但他们已准备好向运输公司收费。 麦科斯基说，最近一项研究表明，地面运输公司车辆在各航站楼进出频繁，对机场附近交通疏导起很大作用。 如果他们对机场基础设施，道路改进，提供些资助，再好不过。 ”我们对机场内营运的小企业发放的消息是，我们非常希望与你们做生意。但机场有一段时间一直在资助这些操作，并在适当的时机，每个人都应支付他们应付的服务费用。 ” 麦科斯基说，这项收费不会在近几个月内施行。 这项动议需要凤凰城市政府通过。
64914d3cc2e5ebb437e6dfe3408508e69163148a.translatedText: Airport proposes to raise parking fees. The Phoenix City Government is discussing a new initiative that will increase parking fees at the airport. The increase is expected to affect off-site parking facilities, taxi and limousine services, nearby hotels and car rental services. David Warren, owner of Blue Sky Airport Car Park, said under the new proposals he would have to pay $6 each time he uses his van to drop people off at the airport. The annual cost is estimated to be more than $500,000, more than his annual income. "It's really difficult for small businesses like us," Warren said. "In order to absorb costs and maintain business, the only option is to pass this cost on to customers." Although, Deputy Director of Aviation Mycoskey said that the city government has not made a final decision, but they are ready to charge transportation companies. McCoskey said that a recent study showed that ground transportation company vehicles frequently enter and leave the terminals, which plays a significant role in smoothing traffic near the airport. It would be great if they provided some funding for airport infrastructure and road improvements. "Our message to the small businesses operating within the airport is that we very much want to do business with you. But the airport has been funding these operations for some time, and when the time comes, everyone will be expected to pay their share of the service." McCosky said the charge would not be implemented in the coming months. The motion needs to be passed by Phoenix city government.

bb48e54e73b478c9f62aa9c9a0c27f5dd43335a3.sourceText: 在国会减赤委员会寻觅大幅削减开支办法之际，预料欧巴马总统将建议删减联邦医疗保险计画(Medicare)和医疗补助计画(Medicaid)数千亿元经费，共和党人对此「 兴高采烈」，而许多民主党人则担忧，欧巴马的建议将导致这两项计画的经费遭进一步缩水。 欧巴马上周在国会两院联席会议上演讲时明确表示，他提出一项计画以创造就业机会，振兴美国经济，但不同意某些民主党人反对改革Medicare和Medicaid的立场。 纽约时报报导，几乎没有任何民主党人反对改革这两项福利计画。 但许多民主党人表示，如果欧巴马下周提出建议，在十年内把这两项计画的经费削减3000至5000亿元，该建议将为国会新成立的减赤委员会更大幅度削减 两项计画经费铺平道路。 他们表示，许多共和党国会议员支持一项预算案，为参加民营健保计画者提供补助，大幅修改Medicare内容，民主党人希望在2012年大选中利用Medicare问题抨击共和党人。 而欧巴马的建议，将削弱民主党人打击共和党人的能力。 民主党众议员克里夫(Emanuel Cleaver II，密苏里州)表示：「我们跟总统提出的Medicare和Medicaid计画有某些分歧，我们宁愿提高税收而不愿削减这些计画的经费。」 克里夫还说，欧巴马的建议，使民主党人无法利用这两项计画问题来打击共和党人。卫生政策专家和游说界人士亦持类似看法。
bb48e54e73b478c9f62aa9c9a0c27f5dd43335a3.translatedText: As the Congressional Deficit Reduction Committee looks for ways to drastically cut spending, President Obama is expected to propose hundreds of billions of dollars in cuts to the federal Medicare and Medicaid programs. Republicans are "elated" about this, while many Democrats are worried that Obama's proposals will lead to further reductions in funding for these two programs. Obama made it clear in a speech to a joint session of Congress last week that he proposed a plan to create jobs and revitalize the U.S. economy, but disagreed with some Democrats' opposition to reforming Medicare and Medicaid. The New York Times reports that almost no Democrats oppose reforming the two welfare programs. But many Democrats say that if Obama puts forward a proposal next week to cut funding for the two programs by 300 to 500 billion dollars over ten years, the proposal will pave the way for even deeper cuts in the two programs by Congress's newly established deficit reduction committee. They said that many Republican members of Congress support a budget bill that would provide subsidies for those enrolled in private health insurance plans and significantly modify the content of Medicare. Democrats hope to use the Medicare issue to attack Republicans in the 2012 election. Obama's proposal will weaken the Democrats' ability to attack Republicans. Democratic Rep. Emanuel Cleaver II (Mo.) said: "We have some differences with the Medicare and Medicaid plans proposed by the president, and we would rather raise taxes than cut funding for these programs." Cleaver also said that Obama's proposal prevents Democrats from using these two program issues to attack Republicans. Health policy experts and lobbyists share similar views.

957b26db11a8d21b2872d284938b17ebf54bb49e.sourceText: 不少人都听说过通过EB5或是投资移民签证可成功获得公民身份。 本文章将依照2011年3月17日在加州区域中心举行的美国公民及移民服务会议的内容，提供最新关于EB5的消息。 关于EB-5的基本认识 很多人不太了解EB-5以及其各项规定。 EB-5包括两种投资金额：一种是50万美金，而另一种则是100万美金。 这两种都是通过区域中心及个别申请来完成。 90%-95%的EB5移民案要通过区域中心申请。 区域中心指的是由美国公民及移民服务局（USCIS）批准的在美国境内一个特定的地理区域成立的实体组织或代理机构。 然而这不意味着区域中心就相对比较安全。 事实上，不少区域中心都没有退还回早先的投资资金。 区域中心有其相应的风险；投资者通常没有投资资金的控制权，而一旦有状况发生，投资者唯一可以做的也只有是提出诉讼。 对于很多人而言，申请EB5要用掉自己的毕生存款，因此在申请前一定要三思而后行。 目标就业地区 很显然，大家都希望可以尽可能缩减投资的金额。 EB5的投资金额有两种：一种是50万美金，另一种是100万美金。 如何知道哪一种投资金额更加适合您？ 不少人有一个误区，认为只有针对区域中心才可以申请到50万美金的投资金额，这是不正确的。 决定投资金额的多少幷不取决于是否在区域中心投资，而是投资的对像是否是目标就业地区（TEA）。 目标就业地区（TEA）通常是指失业率大概在比全国平均失业率高出1.5倍(150%)的地区。 由此，投资者则可投资50万美金，而不需投资在区域中心。 ”有条件移民签证”名额 美国每年有一万个”有条件移民签证”名额，而且名额从来没有用尽过。 这意味着什么？ 第一，EB-5幷不容易申请到。 否则一万个名额很快就会用尽。 第二，EB-5的申请审查极为严谨，幷且所有的申请条件必须在提交前就具备。 常见拒签的主要原因有： a. 无法证明申请人的投资款项为合法收入；b. 申请人无法证明投资项目可创造10个就业机会；d. 申请人无法证明投资对象为目标就业 地区。 第三，根据每年的申请名额，如果符合EB-5的申请要求，将成为投资者取得签证的最佳途径。 两年”?有条件签证?? 获得有条件的签证幷不保证获得真正的签证。 美国公民及移民局（USCIS）要求投资者保持两年的有条件签证。 只有在21个月后，两年届满之际，投资人才可向移民局提出解除有条件移民签证的申请。 2010年有17%的有条件移民签证者遭到拒绝，投资人甚至以及其家人会被要求进入驱逐出境的程式。 而这一数字目前已上升到38%。 要了解EB-5是一个许诺，是投资者向美国公民及移民服务局做出在美国境内投资的承诺。 申请人一旦食言，可能会面临被驱逐出境的可能。 EB-5并非唯一途径 很多人被欺骗，认为EB-5是唯一一个可以申请来美的途径。 我不同意。 申请EB-5是否适合您，取决于很多原因。 在决定申请之前，建议申请人多向有经验的律师进行咨询了解。 2010年度有关数据 以下是美国公民及移民服务局提供的与EB-5有关的一些相应数据： 2010年度区域中心申请数：110 最初申请通过率：55% 2010 年度EB-5申请人数：1955 EB-5通过者：89% 2010 年度EB-5解除有条件签证被拒者：17%
957b26db11a8d21b2872d284938b17ebf54bb49e.translatedText: Many people have heard that citizenship can be successfully obtained through EB5 or investment immigration visa. This article will provide the latest news on EB5 based on the content of the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services Conference held at the California Regional Center on March 17, 2011. Basic understanding of EB-5 Many people do not know much about EB-5 and its various regulations. EB-5 includes two investment amounts: one is US$500,000, and the other is US$1 million. Both are done through regional centers and on individual applications. 90%-95% of EB5 immigration cases are applied through regional centers. A regional center refers to an entity or agency approved by the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) to be established in a specific geographic area within the United States. However, this does not mean that regional centers are relatively safe. In fact, many regional centers have not refunded their earlier investment funds. Regional centers have their own risks; investors usually have no control over the invested funds, and if something goes wrong, the only thing investors can do is file a lawsuit. For many people, applying for EB5 will require their lifetime savings, so they must think twice before applying. Target employment areas Obviously, everyone wants to reduce the amount of investment as much as possible. There are two types of investment amounts for EB5: one is US$500,000 and the other is US$1 million. How to know which investment amount is more suitable for you? Many people have a misunderstanding that only regional centers can apply for an investment amount of US$500,000. This is incorrect. Determining the amount of investment does not depend on whether the investment is in a regional center, but whether the investment is in a Targeted Employment Area (TEA). Target employment areas (TEAs) generally refer to areas where the unemployment rate is approximately 1.5 times (150%) higher than the national average unemployment rate. Thus, investors can invest US$500,000 without having to invest in a regional center. "Conditional Immigrant Visa" Quota The United States has a quota of 10,000 "Conditional Immigrant Visa" quotas every year, and the quota has never been exhausted. what does that mean? First, EB-5 is not easy to apply for. Otherwise the 10,000 places will be exhausted quickly. Second, EB-5 application review is extremely rigorous, and all application conditions must be met before submission. The main reasons for common visa rejections are: a. The applicant cannot prove that the investment amount is legal income; b. The applicant cannot prove that the investment project can create 10 job opportunities; d. The applicant cannot prove that the investment object is a target employment area. Third, according to the annual application quota, if you meet the application requirements of EB-5, it will become the best way for investors to obtain a visa. "Two years"? Conditional visa? Obtaining a conditional visa does not guarantee obtaining a real visa. The United States Citizenship and Immigration Service (USCIS) requires investors to maintain a two-year conditional visa. Only after 21 months, when the two years expire, investors can apply to the USCIS to cancel the conditional immigrant visa. In 2010, 17% of conditional immigrant visa holders were rejected, and the investor and his or her family members were even asked to enter the deportation process. This number has now increased to 38%. It is important to understand that EB-5 is a promise made by the investor to invest in the United States. Once the applicant breaks his promise, he may face the possibility of deportation. EB-5 is not the only way. Many people are deceived into thinking that EB-5 is the only way to apply for it. It depends on many reasons. Before deciding to apply, it is recommended that applicants consult with an experienced lawyer. Relevant data for 2010 The following are some corresponding data related to EB-5 provided by the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services: Number of regional center applications in 2010: 110 Initial application approval rate: 55% Number of EB-5 applicants in 2010: 1,955 EB-5 applicants: 89% EB-5 conditional visa release denials in 2010: 17%
