a65d5f0c7883be5af552dcbf1c9abd23468b1673.sourceText: 数字显示，由州政府和联邦政府共同资助的贫困家庭青少年医疗保险（又称KidCare，下称儿童健保)受益人数，已从2008年最高峰66317人，骤减到本月的16662人，是1999 年以来的最低水平。 与这个数字相比，需求却是空前的。 7月，有超过10万儿童在轮候儿童健保。 早在2010年，因财政拨款短缺，州政府不再接受儿童健保新申请。 事实上，州立法者近年多次削减儿童健保资金，从2009年的100万美元减到2012财政年度的3600万美元，可谓减无可减。 由于冻结新申请，州府官员说，有”足够的拨款，以满足目前参保的需求。”但也承认覆盖水平下降是”不明智的决定”，将为贫困儿童健康带来隐患。 儿童健保是一种优质医疗儿童保健计划，家庭收入在贫困线的一至二倍都可以申请。 按目前的家贫线，一个四口之家每年收入22350美元，低于这一水平，这个家庭有资格享受医疗补助，和州/联邦的健保计划，包括专为青少年儿童设计的儿童健保。 2010年3月，立法机关试图完全取消儿童健保，但在联邦法保护下儿童健保得以延续，立法者转而冻结新申请。 目前，亚利桑那州是全美唯一一个冻结新儿童健保申请的州。 州府声称，不再接受新申请是为了保护已有儿童健保得益人的利益。 但冻结实施以来，有近3万名儿童遭儿童健保除名。 有部分病童因得不到适当的医疗照顾而失去生命。 联邦政府要求各州协调医疗补助和儿童医保方案，应考虑到家庭收入可能会发生变化，如失业或重新找到工作等。 本州贫困线下的家庭，仍可申请并享受医疗补助，但不包含儿童健保。 数据链接： *儿童健保成立于1998年，当年有三分之一的贫困家庭儿童没有医保。 这个水平已经下降到去年的22%。 到2008年，儿童健保涵盖率达到最高峰。 *从1999年正式接受申请，到2011年覆盖人数分别为：5283,27765,42875,55687,48681,49897,48083,55996,58617,63530,51838,30445,17649。
a65d5f0c7883be5af552dcbf1c9abd23468b1673.translatedText: Figures show that the number of beneficiaries of the Youth Medical Insurance for Poor Families (also known as KidCare, hereinafter referred to as Children's Health Insurance), which is jointly funded by the state and federal governments, has plummeted from a peak of 66,317 in 2008 to 16,662 this month, which is the lowest level since 1999. Compared to this number, demand is unprecedented. In July, there were more than 100,000 children on the waiting list for Child Health Insurance. As early as 2010, due to a shortage of financial allocations, the state government no longer accepted new applications for children's health insurance. In fact, state lawmakers have repeatedly cut funding for Children's Health Care in recent years, from $1 million in 2009 to $36 million in fiscal year 2012. As a result of the freeze on new applications, state officials said there are "sufficient allocations to meet current enrollment needs." But they also acknowledged that the reduction in coverage levels was an "unwise decision" and will bring hidden health risks to poor children. Children's Health Insurance is a high-quality medical children's health care program available to families with incomes between one and two times the poverty level. According to the current poverty line, a family of four earns $22,350 per year. Below this level, the family is eligible for Medicaid and state/federal health insurance programs, including Children's Health Insurance designed specifically for adolescents and children. In March 2010, the Legislature attempted to eliminate Children's Health Care altogether, but while Children's Health Care continues under federal law, lawmakers instead froze new applications. Currently, Arizona is the only state in the nation to freeze new Children's Health Care applications. The state said it stopped accepting new applications to protect the interests of existing Children's Health Insurance recipients. However, since the freeze was implemented, nearly 30,000 children have been excluded from children's health insurance. Some sick children lose their lives because they do not receive proper medical care. The federal government requires states to coordinate Medicaid and Children's Medicare programs to take into account possible changes in family income, such as losing a job or finding a new job. Families below the state's poverty level can still apply for and receive Medicaid, but Children's Health Insurance is not included. Data link: *Children's health insurance was established in 1998. At that time, one-third of children from poor families did not have medical insurance. This level has dropped to 22% last year. By 2008, children's health insurance coverage reached its peak. *From the official acceptance of applications in 1999 to the number of people covered in 2011: 5283, 27765, 42875, 55687, 48681, 49897, 48083, 55996, 58617, 63530, 51838, 30445, 17649.

dcbd97b29cd0ca214efdc2b99af2eec2d73e0ad2.sourceText: 《理財》迷惘的股市 （亚省时报） 8月初股市的大跌與其說是投資人的恐慌性拋售，更確切的應該是買者的罷工。當市場只有賣家時，價位當然短暫時間內可一落千丈。華爾街痛恨且害怕不確定性，有此情況時沒人願承接股票，股票在手的人可能認為先賣了再說。現在股市就像一葉扁舟駛在茫茫雲霧之中，不知方向在哪，不知何時會來個大浪，也不知何時才得見一片晴朗天空。此時投資人為什麼要擁有股票？ 本世紀以來的股市崩盤各有特色，都是前所未見。第一次是網路科技泡沫的破滅，加上九一一使狀況更複雜更驚恐。第二次來自地產市場的泡沫化和殃及全球大家未曾聽過的次級房貸風暴。現在美國國債差點違約，信評被降級乃史上第一遭。 1917年「舉債上限」這個法律本就無稽，政府每年開支不是已由國會控制？還要不時通過上限額度，不但多此一舉也是自找麻煩，國會低能與功能不彰時就會出事。國會要不要通過舉債上限等於問美國欠債要不要還錢。當然要﹗ 過去50年舉債上限通過了74次。如果歐巴瑪在去年12月中民主黨還是眾院多數時悄悄地把「舉債上限」綁在布希減稅與失業救濟延長的法案一起通過的話，今天可能不會有這個危機。也許那就不會觸動史坦普降級的作為。對美國主權債有評比似乎不必要，三個、兩個或一個A現在看來好像不重要。14兆的聯邦債遍及天下，9.5兆可隨時交易。世上沒有如此「龐大「與「流通「的交易物。因此美國債信品質雖差了，大家一時緊張反倒把資金搶進聯邦債。 媒體的報導與街談巷議使美國債信評比降級成為信心危機，大家忙拋售股票，自己嚇自己。事實上股票的崩跌根本原因在經濟。我們的經濟前半年才成長0.8%，整年的成長也會比過去的期待還低。投資人抓不準經濟會保持微溫還是再次陷入衰退，股市當然找不到方向而陷入迷惘。 8月9日，聯儲會聲明將保持特殊低率直到2013年中。歷史上聯儲會從來不會也無法告訴你一定期間內它利率的態度，可見經濟是如何的嚴峻。聯儲會都告訴你近兩年內經濟熱不起來，你對股市還要有什麼樣的期待？經濟既然這麼差，又盼不到三次量化寬鬆政策大家當然不滿意，然而低利率環境對經濟必竟有利。頓時投資人拋開國債降級的恐懼，心想危機已過，經濟就走著瞧看著辦，道瓊日間從底部回竄600點。 眾多的問題、許多的擔憂使股市自5月以來找不到方向，史坦普五百指數鎖在1250與1350 的箱型圖形中。8月4日終於下破1250而繼續崩落多日，此時出現技術崩盤之勢，股市由正型轉為斜型，因為不但支撐點1250被破，必需死守的兩百天平均線也失守了。 同時，兩年多來一路漲揚的幾個波中，前時3月日本地震造成的低點為1256。這點不保，根據道瓊理論，股市主趨勢在8月2日後已由「漲勢」轉為「跌勢」，根據那理論股市已進熊市。如果史坦普指數不像跌下來那麼快的儘速回到1250點之上，股市可能已預料到前面的衰退。 短期內突上突下的市場仍將得見。前面三兩個月股市仍將不穩，最好的情況就是慢慢再形成一個交易距而鎖在其中。我們擔心的不是幾天內千點的上下，也不是短期危機，而是經濟長期的失落。 很有可能多年間經濟缺乏動力，高失業率持續，利率低落，美元不振，股市房市低迷。消費者不消費不投資，經濟就死氣沉沉。儲蓄的人幾乎拿不到利息，無端受到處罰。失落的20年好像經濟強國最後都要走的路。股市暫時也迷茫，不知我們是否也走這條路。(作者為投資顧問)
dcbd97b29cd0ca214efdc2b99af2eec2d73e0ad2.translatedText: "Financial Management" Confused Stock Market (Alberta Times) The sharp drop in the stock market in early August was not so much panic selling by investors, but more accurately a buyer's strike. When there are only sellers in the market, prices can of course plummet in a short period of time. Wall Street hates and is afraid of uncertainty. When this happens, no one is willing to take over the stock. Those who hold the stock may think that they should sell it first. Now the stock market is like a small boat sailing in the vast clouds and mist. I don't know where it is going, when there will be a big wave, and I don't know when we will see a clear sky. Why should investors own stocks at this time? The stock market crashes of this century have had their own characteristics, and all have been unprecedented. The first time was the bursting of the Internet technology bubble. Coupled with 9/11, the situation became more complicated and frightening. The second bubble came from the real estate market and caused a subprime mortgage crisis that everyone around the world had never heard of. The U.S. government is now on the verge of defaulting on its national debt, and its credit rating has been downgraded for the first time in history. The 1917 "debt ceiling" law is nonsense. Isn't the annual government expenditure already controlled by Congress? It is necessary to pass caps from time to time, which is not only unnecessary but also asking for trouble. Problems will arise when Congress is incompetent and ineffective. Whether Congress should pass a debt ceiling is equivalent to asking whether the United States should repay its debt. Of course! The debt ceiling has been passed 74 times in the past 50 years. If Obama had quietly tied the debt limit to the Bush bill to cut taxes and extend unemployment benefits in mid-December when the Democrats were still in the majority in the House of Representatives, there might not have been this crisis today. Maybe that wouldn't trigger Stamper's demotion. It seems unnecessary to have a rating for U.S. sovereign debt. Three, two, or one A's seem unimportant now. 14 trillion in federal debt is spread all over the world, and 9.5 trillion can be traded at any time. There is no such "large" and "circulating" transaction in the world. Therefore, although the credit quality of the US debt is poor, everyone is temporarily nervous and rushes funds into federal debt. Media reports and street talk have turned the downgrade of the U.S. debt rating into a crisis of confidence, and everyone is selling stocks to scare themselves. In fact, the root cause of the stock crash is the economy. Our economy only grew 0.8% in the first half of the year, and the full-year growth will be lower than expected in the past. Investors are not sure whether the economy will remain tepid or fall into recession again, and the stock market of course cannot find its direction and is confused. On August 9, the Federal Reserve announced that it would keep interest rates at a particularly low level until mid-2013. Historically, the Federal Reserve has never and cannot tell you its attitude towards interest rates within a certain period of time. This shows how severe the economy is. The Federal Reserve has told you that the economy will not heat up in the past two years, so what should you expect from the stock market. Since the economy is so bad and there are no three quantitative easing policies, of course everyone is not satisfied. However, the low interest rate environment will be beneficial to the economy. Suddenly, investors put aside the fear of the national debt downgrade and thought that the crisis was over and the economy would just wait and see. The Dow Jones retreated 600 points from the bottom during the day. Numerous problems and concerns have caused the stock market to find no direction since May. The S&P 500 index was locked in the box pattern of 1250 and 1350. On August 4, it finally broke below 1250 and continued to collapse for several days. At this time, a technical collapse appeared, and the stock market turned from a positive trend to a diagonal trend, because not only the support point of 1250 was broken, but also the 200-day moving average that must be defended fell. At the same time, in the several waves that have been rising for more than two years, the low point caused by the Japanese earthquake in March was 1256. This is not guaranteed. According to the Dow Jones theory, the main trend of the stock market has changed from "upward" to "downward" after August 2. According to that theory, the stock market has entered a bear market. If the S&P index does not return to 1250 as quickly as it fell, the stock market may have anticipated the recession ahead. The market will still see sudden ups and downs in the short term. The stock market will still be unstable in the first three or two months. The best situation is to slowly form a trading gap and be locked in it. What we are worried about is not the rise and fall of a thousand points in a few days, nor the short-term crisis, but the long-term economic loss. It is possible that the economy will lack momentum for many years, with continued high unemployment, low interest rates, a weak dollar, and depressed stock and housing markets. If consumers don't consume or invest, the economy will be dead. Those who saved received almost no interest and were punished for no reason. The lost 20 years seem to be the final path for all economically powerful countries. The stock market is also confused for the time being, and I wonder if we will follow this path. (The author is an investment consultant)

After 89 days of arduous hiking, he traveled across 13 states in the continental United States, covering a total distance of more than 3,000 miles. Arriving at the Venice Beach Pier in Los Angeles on the west coast of the United States at 12:35 pm on September 4, 2011, he became the first Chinese in history to complete a walk across the United States. The local Chinese and overseas Chinese in Southern California and the major news media in Southern California witnessed this historical moment together.

7b6757591c598219fcdc0571b1b0eb28f539c508.sourceText: 皮纳尔郡警长公款旅游惹争议 （亚省新闻） 本州中南部皮纳尔郡警长办公室，今年夏天花了超过53000元送25人去圣路易斯参加为期一周的会议，为得奖的警长助威。 记录显示，费用的一半是警长办公室，以提高郡监狱法庭费用为由领出支付，另一半是来自缴获不法现金和财产所组成的基金。 警察局的官员称他们是在合法使用这笔资金。但批评者认为宾布警长一边用打击贩毒集团名义进行筹款，一边用公款去缴付25人的会议费用，有点矛盾。 超过7%的全国各郡警长参加了今年六月的年会。马利科巴郡警长办公室派出警长私人助理参加，花费了近1700美元。皮马郡没有代表参加。 宾布警长在这次会议上获得2011年警长奖，表彰他在该地区打击非法移民和阻击墨西哥毒品流行方面的贡献。 但公众却发现宾布警长用公款支付出租车到一个啤酒厂参观费用，资料管理员也用公款支付妻子和儿子的额外行李费等。 警长办公室发出声明说：”此次圣路易斯之旅没有花费纳税人的一分一毫，”宾布说：”我很自豪，用缴获犯罪的金钱和监狱提高资金支付所有的费用，包括培训、旅游和食宿。” 警长解释说，这笔简称为RICO的基金是用来打击帮派活动和药物滥用，保证证人，在任何联邦法律允许下，用于包括训练、加班工资和毒品案件中使用的设备。 ”不管这些钱来自何处，它是公帑，”皮纳尔郡主管皮特里奥斯说。”花那种钱，拉一队人去观看他获奖，我觉得宾布警长应该给皮纳尔郡选民一个合理交代。”
7b6757591c598219fcdc0571b1b0eb28f539c508.translatedText: The Pinal County Sheriff's publicly funded trip sparked controversy (Alberta News) The Pinal County Sheriff's Office in the south-central part of the state spent more than $53,000 this summer to send 25 people to St. Louis for a week-long conference to cheer for the winning sheriff. Records show that half of the cost was paid by the Sheriff's Office in exchange for raising county jail court fees, and the other half came from a fund made up of seized illicit cash and property. Police department officials said they were using the funds legally. However, critics believe that it is a bit contradictory that Sheriff Bimbu raised funds in the name of fighting drug gangs and at the same time used public funds to pay for the meeting of 25 people. More than 7% of county sheriffs across the country attended this year’s annual meeting in June. The Maricopa County Sheriff's Office sent the Sheriff's Personal Assistant to attend, which cost nearly $1,700. Pima County was not represented. Sheriff Bimbu received the 2011 Sheriff's Award at this meeting in recognition of his contribution to combating illegal immigration and combating the Mexican drug epidemic in the region. However, the public discovered that Sheriff Bimbu used public funds to pay for a taxi to visit a brewery, and the data administrator also used public funds to pay for extra luggage for his wife and son. "This trip to St. Louis did not cost taxpayers a cent," the Sheriff's Office said in a statement. "I am proud to use crime seizure money and jail enhancement funds to pay for all expenses, including training, travel and room and board." The Sheriff explained that the fund, known as RICO for short, is used to combat gang activity and drug abuse, secure witnesses, and include training, overtime pay and equipment used in drug cases, as permitted by any federal law. "No matter where the money comes from, it's public money," said Pinal County Supervisor Pete Rios. "For spending that kind of money to bring a group of people to watch him win the award, I think Sheriff Bimbu should give a reasonable explanation to the voters of Pinal County."

4c9b45580c7fa6c44f18d01ceb4e8a2f6e5854eb.sourceText: 流感提前到 打针要趁早 （亚省新闻） 马利科巴郡卫生官员证实，本州一名儿童因流感死亡。今夏共有三个流感病例发生，其中两宗涉及成年人。 根据美国疾病控制中心报告，流感是一种全年的疾病，流感季节一般在每年10月至5月下旬。但今年本州的流感来得早，公共卫生人员建议大家提早接种流感疫苗，以防不需。 基于患者隐私法，有关方面并没有公布死亡儿童具体细节。官员只透露该名儿童住在马利科巴郡。 一般情况下，医生建议六个月以上的儿童和老年人，以及常年得流感患者接种疫苗。 今年的疫苗已经出厂，请大家联系自己的家庭医生接种，或致电602-324-2814（凤凰城地区），1-877-764-2670（本州其他地区）。
4c9b45580c7fa6c44f18d01ceb4e8a2f6e5854eb.translatedText: Flu arrives early, get vaccinated early (Alberta News) Maricopa County health officials confirmed that a child in the state died due to influenza. There have been three cases of influenza this summer, two of which involved adults. According to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control, influenza is a year-round disease, and flu season generally runs from October to late May each year. But the flu is coming early in the state this year, and public health officials recommend that everyone get a flu shot early to prevent it from being needed. Due to patient privacy laws, specific details of the deceased children were not released. Officials said only that the child lived in Maricopa County. In general, doctors recommend that children over six months old and the elderly, as well as those who suffer from influenza all year round, get vaccinated. This year’s vaccine has already left the factory. Please contact your family doctor to get vaccinated, or call 602-324-2814 (Phoenix area) or 1-877-764-2670 (other areas of the state).

ac20df541b7e74df590f9cc18f41ad56b72ec686.sourceText: 观鸟胜地 生气蓬勃 美国本州南部有140种鸟类，从沙丘鹤到红面莺等各种鸟吸引来自世界各地的观鸟爱鸟者。超过鸟类保护协会(American Bird Conservancy)的Davit Pashley表示：”亚利桑那州南部是全世界数一数二的观鸟胜地，观鸟成为亚利桑那州独特的旅游项目。” 本州各地区全年举办各种各样观鸟节，包括南部的尤马和北部的佛谷(Verde Valley)，其中最有名的观鸟地点可能要算东南部城市塞拉利昂(Sierra Vista)，举办的「 西南赏鸟与自然节」今年已进入第20个年头。 塞拉利昂位于纵横交错的峡谷间，高山、树木、河流和湖泊随处可见，自然生态复杂而优美，圣佩德罗河(San Pedro River)和科罗拉多州国家纪念公园吸引游客，而品种繁多的鸟类也成为 一道自然风景。 州游乐和鱼业项目协调员Joe Yarchin表示，人们习惯于将亚利桑那州与象征着死亡和荒凉的沙漠联系起来，不会想到这里却是鸟类的「绿洲」。 塞拉利昂拥有十多种全美独有的蜂鸟(Hummingbirds)，被称为「蜂鸟之都」。 由于与墨西哥临界，这里还「引进」许多墨西哥鸟种。 「西南赏鸟与自然节」组织者之一Gordon Lewis表示，今年6月在塞拉利昂附近发生的野火吞噬周围47平方哩的土地，烧毁57所民居，但对栖居于此的鸟类影响较小。 美国鸟类保护协会的Pashley也表示，多数野火有助于自然生态重新平衡，而因野火流离失所的鸟儿生存能力很强，它们会寻找和适应新的生存环境，而夏季属于多雨季节，被野火燃烧 的植被森林会很快绿起来。 据美国鱼类核野生动物服务局2006年调查显示，全美观鸟爱好者用于观鸟旅行、器材的费用达到120亿元，当年吸引约130万观鸟爱好者，相关旅游创收约12亿元。 亚利桑那州其他观鸟资讯可查询网站 http://www.arizonaguide.com/things-to-do/nature/birding – wildlife/arizona-birding，西南赏鸟与自然节」网址为http://www. swwings.org/。
ac20df541b7e74df590f9cc18f41ad56b72ec686.translatedText: Vibrant bird watching destination Southern Honshu is home to 140 species of birds, ranging from sandhill cranes to red-faced warblers, attracting birdwatchers from all over the world. Davit Pashley of the American Bird Conservancy said: "Southern Arizona is one of the best bird watching destinations in the world, and bird watching has become a unique tourism project in Arizona." Various bird watching festivals are held throughout the year in various regions of the state, including Yuma in the south and Verde Valley in the north. The most famous bird watching location may be the southeastern city of Sierra Vista. The Southwest Bird Watching and Nature Festival is now in its 20th year. Sierra Leone is located among criss-crossing canyons, with mountains, trees, rivers and lakes everywhere. The natural ecology is complex and beautiful. The San Pedro River (San Pedro River) and the Colorado National Monument attract tourists, and a wide variety of birds have become a natural scenery. Joe Yarchin, state recreation and fish program coordinator, said people are used to associating Arizona with the desert, which symbolizes death and desolation, but they don't expect it to be an "oasis" for birds. Sierra Leone is home to more than a dozen species of hummingbirds that are unique to the United States and is known as the "Hummingbird Capital." Due to its border with Mexico, many Mexican bird species have been "introduced" here. Gordon Lewis, one of the organizers of the Southwest Birding and Nature Festival, said that the wildfire that broke out near Sierra Leone in June this year engulfed 47 square miles of surrounding land and burned 57 homes, but it had little impact on the birds that live here. Pashley of the American Bird Conservancy also said that most wildfires help rebalance the natural ecology, and birds displaced by wildfires have a strong ability to survive. They will find and adapt to new living environments. Summer is the rainy season, and vegetation forests burned by wildfires will quickly turn green. According to a 2006 survey by the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, bird-watching enthusiasts across the country spent 12 billion yuan on bird-watching trips and equipment. It attracted about 1.3 million bird-watching enthusiasts that year and generated about 1.2 billion yuan in revenue from related tourism. Other birding information in Arizona can be found at http://www.arizonaguide.com/things-to-do/nature/birding-wildlife/arizona-birding, and the Southwest Birding and Nature Festival website is http://www.swwings.org/.

92b986d1c4aba119b32c28e37ae647457394de68.sourceText: 华美银行窃案 行方依法恐不赔 （亚省时报） 华美银行保险箱遇窃后，已加强安保措施，门前增设保全人员。 slideshow 华美银行罗兰冈分行顾客保险箱遭窃案震惊华裔小区，很多华裔顾客12日到银行了解自己保险箱的情况。该行发言人王国兰表示，案件正在联邦调查局（FBI）调查中，银行正与受影响的顾客联系，了解受损状况，目前还有一些无主财物等待失主认领。 王国兰说，被盗和打开的保险箱约几十个，目前银行正在与受害客户一一面谈。她表示，按照美国法律，银行并不知晓客户所存物品，所以需要顾客列出物品清单，以便确认损失。银行与客户签订使用合同时已告知顾客，对所存物品，必须自行为其购买保险，或将其包含在自己的住房保险中。不过银行出于对顾客的歉意，对接待的每位受损顾客都奉上500元慰问金。 对公众对银行安全性的质疑，王国兰表示，该行的安保措施符合银行业安全标准，而且银行也无意逃避责任，案件还在FBI调查中，如果是银行方面的问题，他们不会回避。 按照使用要求，客户不允许储存现金和违禁品。该行保险箱使用费为小型保险箱每年30元，大型每年50元。 事件发生后，银行增强安保措施，门前有保全负责为顾客开门。12日早上并没有出现人头攒动景象，秩序良好。一对华裔夫妇了解自己的保险箱虽然被打开但财物无损后，走出银行后互相拥抱。他们表示，虽然自己很幸运，但有朋友确实损失惨重。而且盗贼很「专业」，只带走黄金和钻石等物品，华人青睐的玉器却乏兴趣问津。 她还表示，银行还没有对善后处理作出任何决定，让人失望。虽然没有丢失财物，但心理压力大，不知道今后还能相信谁。 而另一位顾客表示，她是当天看报纸才得知盗窃案，虽然她的物品完好，但银行至少应向顾客通知此事。她专程请假来检查自己的保险箱，因此院误工作和事件的损失银行是否应承担？ 王国兰表示，近期华裔小区盗窃案频发，很多顾客都愿意租保险箱保存金银等细软和各种文档，个别分行甚至要排队等候。但她表示，银行努力为客户提供安全环境，但并不能保证绝对安全，银行也是受害者，希望顾客能理解。 （记者张越）
92b986d1c4aba119b32c28e37ae647457394de68.translatedText: The East West Bank theft case, the bank may not compensate according to the law (Alberta Times) After the East West Bank safe was stolen, security measures have been strengthened and security personnel have been added in front of the door. slideshow The theft of customer safes at the Rowland Heights branch of East West Bank shocked the Chinese community. Many Chinese customers went to the bank on the 12th to learn about the situation of their safes. Bank spokesperson Wang Guolan said that the case is under investigation by the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), and the bank is contacting affected customers to understand the damage situation. There are still some unowned properties waiting to be claimed by their owners. Wang Guolan said that about dozens of safe deposit boxes were stolen and opened, and the bank is currently interviewing the victim customers one by one. She said that according to U.S. law, banks do not know the items deposited by customers, so they need customers to list the items in order to confirm the loss. When the bank signs a use contract with the customer, it has informed the customer that the deposited items must be insured by themselves or included in their own housing insurance. However, out of apology to its customers, the bank offered a 500 yuan condolence payment to every damaged customer it received. Regarding the public's doubts about the bank's security, Wang Guolan said that the bank's security measures comply with banking industry security standards, and the bank has no intention to evade responsibility. The case is still under investigation by the FBI. If it is a bank issue, they will not evade it. In accordance with usage requirements, customers are not allowed to store cash and contraband. The bank's safe usage fee is 30 yuan per year for small safes and 50 yuan per year for large safes. After the incident, the bank strengthened security measures and had a security guard in front of the door to open the door for customers. There was no crowding on the morning of the 12th, and order was good. A Chinese couple hugged each other after walking out of the bank after learning that their safe had been opened but their belongings were intact. They said that while they were lucky, they had friends who had suffered heavy losses. Moreover, the thieves were very "professional" and only took away items such as gold and diamonds, but there was little interest in the jade items favored by the Chinese. She also said it was disappointing that the bank had not made any decision on the aftermath. Although no property was lost, I was under great psychological pressure and I didn’t know who I could trust in the future. Another customer said that she only learned about the theft after reading the newspaper that day. Although her belongings were intact, the bank should at least notify the customer of the incident. She took time off to check her safe, so should the bank bear the losses caused by the hospital's missed work and incident? Wang Guolan said that thefts in Chinese communities have been frequent recently, and many customers are willing to rent safes to store gold, silver and other valuables and various documents. Some branches even have to wait in line. However, she said that banks strive to provide customers with a safe environment, but they cannot guarantee absolute safety. Banks are also victims and hope customers can understand. (Reporter Zhang Yue)

196fd0762589d7ef487301ba955659ba0d4ff77e.sourceText: 禁泡沫飯盒 加州跑第一 （亚省时报） 加州參議會提出法案，將禁止餐館和商店用保麗龍(Styrofoam，又稱發泡膠)餐盒包裝食品，從2016年開始執行。全州現有50多個縣市頒布了禁用規定，如果提案簽署為州法，加州將創全國先河，首次在全州範圍禁用可污染環保的餐盒。 但法案規定，全州各學區和各市、縣如果採取環保措施，保麗龍餐盒的回收率逾60%，就仍可繼續使用。 提議立法的州民主黨參議員婁文斯說，丟棄的保麗龍餐盒，是城市街道、下水道和海灘最多的垃圾種類之一，「保麗龍餐盒無法被生物分解和化成肥料，如果長時間被水浸泡，會分解成可存在數千年的微粒。在海灘清除耗資數百萬元」。 舊金山2007年便禁用保麗龍餐盒，目的是強調環保。全國禁用保麗龍餐盒的地區，還有紐約長島的蘇福克郡和緬因州的自由港市等地。 餐館業主哈尼卡特說，他的餐館一直用保麗龍餐盒包裝外賣食品，州議會推動禁用的法案，將使餐館成本增加數千元，導致本來就是薄利經營的餐館雪上加霜。 反對者說，提案沒有強調餐盒隨處丟棄的根本原因，是沒有環保意識的人的行為，無論是保麗龍還是可生物分解的紙盒，他們都會隨手亂丟。Dart Container公司的回收主管魏斯特費德說：「他們才不管丟的是什麼材料製成的包裝盒。」 作為兩家生產保麗龍產品的廠商之一，Dart公司在加州約雇用600人。加州商會認為，婁文斯的提案是扼殺加州的就業機會，既威脅製造業的工作，也增加餐館的成本。 衛生與福利部今年6月的報告說，有理由認為，製作保麗龍的化學成分苯乙烯是致癌物質。但聯邦部門的專家說，苯乙烯外釋的可能性很低，致癌機率不大，不值得擔憂。
196fd0762589d7ef487301ba955659ba0d4ff77e.translatedText: California is the first to ban foam lunch boxes (Alberta Times) The California Senate has proposed a bill that would ban restaurants and stores from using Styrofoam (also known as styrofoam) lunch boxes to package food. It will be implemented in 2016. More than 50 counties and cities across the state have enacted bans. If the proposal is signed into state law, California will be the first in the country to ban food containers that can pollute the environment. However, the bill stipulates that if school districts and cities and counties across the state adopt environmental protection measures and the recycling rate of Styrofoam lunch boxes exceeds 60%, they can still be used. State Democratic Senator Lou Vince, who proposed the legislation, said that discarded Styrofoam lunch boxes are one of the most common types of garbage in urban streets, sewers and beaches. "Styrofoam lunch boxes cannot be biodegraded and turned into fertilizers. If soaked in water for a long time, they will break down into particles that can last for thousands of years. It costs millions to clean up at the beach." San Francisco banned Styrofoam lunch boxes in 2007 to emphasize environmental protection. Restaurant owner Honeycutt said that his restaurant has been using Styrofoam lunch boxes to package take-out food, and the ban on Styrofoam lunch boxes across the country has made restaurants that are already operating on thin margins even worse. Opponents say that the proposal does not address the fundamental reason why lunch boxes are thrown away everywhere. It is the behavior of people who are not environmentally aware. They will just throw away whether it is Styrofoam or biodegradable cartons. "They don't care what material the packaging boxes are made of," said Westerfeld, recycling director at Dart Container. As one of the two manufacturers of Styrofoam products, Dart employs about 600 people in California. The California Chamber of Commerce believes that Lowes' proposal will not only threaten manufacturing jobs but also increase the cost of restaurants. The Department of Health and Welfare reported in June this year that there is reason to believe that styrene, the chemical component of Styrofoam, is a carcinogen. However, experts from the federal department said that the possibility of styrene being released is very low and the probability of causing cancer is not worthy of concern.

60de41a039466170b85cf519af55da77e7f5960c.sourceText: 博客评选：亚利桑那州成全美最烂的州之一 （亚省时报） 凤凰城的热，恶名远扬的SB1070，这些都成为美国人攻击亚利桑那州的目标。 近日，一个左倾新闻和八卦博客，Gawker.com，的一项评比中，将亚利桑那州列为全美最烂的州。 事实上，该网站称大峡谷州为一个响尾蛇坑边的愤怒老白人，布鲁尔州长被戏称为”眼睛精灵的精神病患”，而警长阿派奥是一个疯狂的牛仔崇拜者。 ”我只是有点老，只想做好我的工作。”阿派奥说。 理查德罗森是这个网站的工作人员。”我认为现在这是大家发泄对政治事件不满的一种体现.”罗森说其实他挺喜欢亚利桑那，而且来过多次。 ”我们不想冒犯任何人，它只是一个愚蠢的方式（评选）来谈论一个疯狂的国家。” 排在亚利桑那后面的，还有阿拉巴马州，犹他州，新泽西州和密西西比州。 罗森说，是12名工作人员共同决定这一评比。 Gawker.com的总部在纽约，因此纽约被选为全国最佳的州。
60de41a039466170b85cf519af55da77e7f5960c.translatedText: Blog selection: Arizona has become one of the worst states in the United States (Alberta Times) The heat in Phoenix, the infamous SB1070, these have all become targets for Americans to attack Arizona. Recently, Gawker.com, a left-leaning news and gossip blog, ranked Arizona as the worst state in the country. In fact, the website refers to the Grand Canyon State as an angry old white man at a rattlesnake pit, with Governor Brewer dubbed a "elf-eyed psychopath" and Sheriff Arpaio a crazed cowboy wannabe. "I'm just a little old and just want to do my job," Arpaio said. Richard Rosen is a staff member on this site. "I think this is now a manifestation of people venting their dissatisfaction with political events." Rosen said that he actually likes Arizona and has been there many times. "We don't want to offend anyone, it's just a stupid way to talk about a crazy country." Behind Arizona, there are Alabama, Utah, New Jersey and Mississippi State. Rosen said that 12 staff members jointly decided on this selection. Gawker.com is headquartered in New York, so New York was voted the best state in the country.

12c0c475547cb1fa4acdafb68c5187137db340a2.sourceText: 中国亿万富豪 8成送儿女留洋 （亚省时报） ”2011胡润少壮派富豪榜”中，共有56位年龄在40岁以下的亿万富豪上榜，其中有一半人在欧美受过教育，并且五分之四的人表示，他们会考虑把孩子送到国外接受更好的教育。 据华尔街日报报导，国际教育协会(Institute of International Education)发布的报告显示，去年有12万8000名中国人到美国留学，中国是向美国输出海外留学生最多的国家。美国的中国在校大学生增加了50%，至4万人，是2005年的四倍多。 中国在美留学生激增，其中一个原因是中国富人日益增多，对很多人来说，到海外留学变得更容易实现。 不过，有钱并非中国父母把孩子送到国外读书的唯一原因。虽然表面看来，中国正在经历一个中学教育的繁荣期，但中国教育体系长期以来举步维艰。批评者说，这种教育体系十分脆弱，它依赖的是死记硬背和僵化的考试内容。可能有越来越多的中国人正在为学历而读书，但他们接受的并不是分析性和创造性的思维训练。同时中国教育总是为经费短缺、城乡不平衡及农民工子女受限等问题所困扰。 中国已在酝酿教育改革。当局去年提出了一项提高教育质量的十年计画，有些学校已开始推动学生的多样性和独立思考。 但这一迟来的改革已不能说服当代的少壮派亿万富豪让孩子留在国内读书，越来越多的人把小孩送到国外念书。
12c0c475547cb1fa4acdafb68c5187137db340a2.translatedText: 80% of Chinese billionaires send their children to study abroad (Alberta Times) In the "2011 Hurun Young Rich List", a total of 56 billionaires under the age of 40 were on the list. Half of them were educated in Europe and the United States, and four-fifths said they would consider sending their children abroad to receive a better education. According to the Wall Street Journal, a report released by the Institute of International Education showed that 128,000 Chinese went to the United States to study last year, and China was the country that sent the largest number of overseas students to the United States. The number of Chinese college students in the United States increased by 50% to 40,000, more than four times the number in 2005. One of the reasons for the surge in Chinese students studying in the United States is that the number of wealthy Chinese is increasing. For many people, studying abroad has become easier to achieve. However, money is not the only reason why Chinese parents send their children to study abroad. Although on the surface it appears that China is experiencing a boom in secondary education, the Chinese education system has long struggled. Critics say the education system is fragile and relies on rote learning and rigid exam content. There may be more and more Chinese people studying for academic qualifications, but what they receive is not training in analytical and creative thinking. At the same time, China's education has always been troubled by problems such as funding shortages, urban-rural imbalance, and restrictions on the children of migrant workers. China is already brewing education reforms. The authorities last year proposed a ten-year plan to improve the quality of education, and some schools have begun promoting diversity and independent thinking among their students. But this belated reform can no longer persuade today's young billionaires to let their children stay in China to study. More and more people are sending their children to study abroad.

ddb104b2e9d8858cca229214615b0f88151f0fa2.sourceText: IRS海外帐户特赦 截止日延至9月9日 （亚省时报） 虽然飓风艾琳对许多美国人来说是个坏消息，但对还没拿定主意参加国税局（IRS）海外帐户特赦计划的人来说，可是个好消息。该计划原本将于8月31日终止，因为飓风艾琳搅局，IRS已宣布延长期限至9月9日。 据外电报导，许多参加”资产自愿批露计划”（offshore Voluntary Disclosure Initiative，OVDI）的纳税人拼命收集文件，好赶在大赦期限前提交给国税局。现在，至少有一点喘息余地。新期限适用于那些已递交申报书但要延期的申请人，也适用于新申请人。 想要参加的纳税人，IRS的自愿申报信（voluntary disclosures letter）提供了一个良好的起点，合格的税务律师可以帮助您完成整个程序。对于那些已经提交文件的申请人来说，若需要更多时间收集银行记录，准备 2003至2010年修正后的税额，以及原始或修正后的海外帐户FBAR表格TD F90-22.1，再度延期至2011年11月29日仍有可能。 IRS此前曾宣布，如果申请人要求延期，必须在8月31日前提交一些关键文件，完成若干步骤的程序。现在，新期限9月9日所需的正式步骤似乎减少了，这真是个好消息，要参加的纳税人，可得赶紧把握机会。 这是IRS的第二次海外帐户特赦计划。纳税人若持有外国银行帐户但未申报，又不参加2011年特赦计划，可能面临巨额罚款及民事处罚，甚至遭受刑事诉讼。
ddb104b2e9d8858cca229214615b0f88151f0fa2.translatedText: IRS foreign account amnesty deadline extended to September 9 (Alberta Times) While Hurricane Irene is bad news for many Americans, it is good news for those who have not yet made up their minds about participating in the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) foreign account amnesty program. The program was originally set to end on August 31, but due to disruptions caused by Hurricane Irene, the IRS has announced an extension to September 9. According to foreign reports, many taxpayers participating in the Offshore Voluntary Disclosure Initiative (OVDI) are desperately collecting documents in order to submit them to the IRS before the amnesty deadline. Now, at least there's a little room to breathe. The new deadline applies to applicants who have already submitted a declaration but want an extension, as well as to new applicants. For taxpayers who want to participate, the IRS's voluntary disclosures letter provides a good starting point, and a qualified tax attorney can help you through the entire process. For those applicants who have already submitted documents and need more time to collect bank records, prepare revised tax amounts for 2003 to 2010, and original or revised foreign account FBAR Form TD F90-22.1, another extension to November 29, 2011 is still possible. The IRS has previously announced that if applicants request an extension, they must submit some key documents and complete a number of steps by August 31. Now, the formal steps required for the new deadline of September 9 appear to have been reduced, which is great news and taxpayers who want to participate should hurry up and seize the opportunity. This is the IRS’s second foreign account amnesty program. Taxpayers who hold foreign bank accounts but fail to declare them and do not participate in the 2011 amnesty program may face huge fines, civil penalties, or even criminal prosecution.

839a1d03350f72a460a9bb30466020e7f77d62b2.sourceText: 8月31日下午6时在亚利桑那州立大学（ASU）MU246教室举办了一场Ascend社团迎接新团员活动。 来自中国内地，台湾，日本，韩国的近40位学生都参加了这次活动，也让更多的人了解到了一个协助亚裔学生发展的新社团。
839a1d03350f72a460a9bb30466020e7f77d62b2.translatedText: On August 31st, at 6 pm, the Ascend Club held an event to welcome new members in the MU246 classroom of Arizona State University (ASU). Nearly 40 students from mainland China, Taiwan, Japan, and South Korea participated in this event, which also made more people aware of a new club that assists the development of Asian students.

bd4a19c8b1e1084fb161c84d5e24a0102b5c0444.sourceText: Ascend社团学生负责人杰夫，是一个亚裔，会非常简单的中文，他热情地为新会员们讲述了Ascend社团的主要职责，就是帮助亚裔同学学习到更多商业交往的技能。 社团内有非常具体的培训项目，例如写简历，邀请函，感谢信等。 ９月１４日晚６时到７时在MU２４６教室，就有”完善个人简历”的活动。 当天的会议上，为了打破亚裔同学含蓄的交流气氛，组织者还想出了小游戏，让大家有机会相互认识和了解。 其中还有一些美国学生，他们都是致力于以后要开辟亚洲市场，都一些到中国学习或者生活的经历。 他们的加入让整个组织变得更加多元化。
bd4a19c8b1e1084fb161c84d5e24a0102b5c0444.translatedText: > Jeff, the student leader of the Ascend Club, is an Asian and can speak very simple Chinese. He enthusiastically told the new members about the main responsibility of the Ascend Club, which is to help Asian students learn more business communication skills. eb7f9ee1757babed5da141299ebdfc8ec8dbeb24.sourceText: 强化良好的人际关系 圣荷西 蔡佩芬 有许多人完全被自己的情绪和感受所控制，导致与人的关系十分不健康，一个人格成熟的人应该可以观察自己的感受，管理和保持良好情绪。当别人对我们有负面的情绪，我们要特别小心，不让别人的情绪操纵我们的感受。一个人若是不管理自己的情绪，就会变得很不健康，甚至受自己的不良欲望牵制，因为他们只知道自己的感觉和自己的愿望，而不知道如何观察管理自己情绪， 一般而言，在健康家庭长大的人比其他人更容易信任人，因为他们自己的家庭生活安全可靠、彼此表达出情谊，他们的生活可以预期，所以他们进入成年人世界时能够信赖别人。只是有时候他们会太过信任，甚至吃亏上当。在健康家庭长大的人还学会如何管理情绪。与一个关心你、对你有兴趣的人谈谈，情绪就可以得到疏解。他们发现痛苦的情感会随时间而消逝，并且他们一次又一次地经历到这一点，成为本能意识的一部分。所以他们每次都寻求与别人谈话来消除情绪上的苦恼，让负面的情绪随着时间消散而去，这就学会在难过的时候不是耐心忍受，而是要想办法消解。来自健康家庭的人知道如何安慰别人及接受安慰，别人安慰他们时他们也比较容易受安慰。 其实，好的人际关系是一个健康成长的自然结果。好的人际关系始于对自己有好的自我观，会处理自己的情绪，也了解周遭人的情绪。一个好领袖的必要条件是能了解人，能与人建立好的关系，鼓舞团队的士气，同心达成目标。一个不了解自己情绪的人，常选择压抑情绪，而情绪就会在你最意想不到的时刻，用最意想不到的强度爆炸出来，造成关系的伤害。缺乏情感智慧常疏忽别人的情感，也就是缺乏同理心(Empathy)的表现，这种人很难和别人建立好的关系。 罗杰姬（ Gail Rodgers ）是一位从事妇女事工的资深牧师，她从自己的人生经历中总结出以下的经验，告诉您她是如何建立及 维护一个健全的团队， 以及如何强化 良好人际关系 ： 步骤一： 责任归属 良好人际关系是 每人对发生在自身范围的部份负责。持续检讨自己的态度。如看见别人不足或缺失时，不要因此而萌生优越感。不要动不动就拿自己和别人比。请看守自己的内心，并随时让自己有颗受教的心。 步骤二： 负起责任 良好人际关系是 每人负起本身缺失的责任。不要光说：「没办法，我就是这个样子！」来搪塞自身不足或别人「网中的破口」，请诚实地面对自己，并邀请上帝来到你的缺口中。总之要竭力负起属于自己部份的责任。假如需要协助，不要害怕，鼓起勇气来向外寻求。 步骤三： 彼此建造 良好人际关系是 每人互相鼓励。看到别人的优点，要见贤思齐，也不吝于分享自己成长和学习经验。在工作中彼此联 结。如有事情需要提出讨论，也必须用一种建设性的态度来向对方说明。如果有人向你指出缺点，务必保持开放胸襟。必要时，特别在事态恶化前、而非恶化后找来 第三者居间协调。谨守良好的人际关系，特别是那种对你以及对整个团体影响重大的那种。 步骤四： 抉择问题 良好人际关系是 每人正确对待别人的缺点，虽然这并非易事?#65292;我们的情绪通常会从中作梗。而正确看待自身的缺点、诚心地邀请上帝参与我们的改造、进而成为我们的力量都是同样的困难。但是上帝仍满心希望我们选择祂的方式来建立良好的人系。这样的决定，无视于砂纸边缘的 磨擦，将会带来良好的果效。你现在就可以帮助所属的团队日后的收获为何。 步骤五： 互相代祷 良好人际关系是 每人为彼此代祷。当你看见团队中有破口或磨擦时，不要忙着向其他团员转述、而是先在祷告中禀明。每当看见彼此的缺点，首要之务便是带到祷告当中。只要求告，神的大能便会透过这样破口进入当事人。而我们就成了彼此的恩典管道了。 步骤六： 彼此祝福 良好人际关系是 每人只要有机会，尽量肯定他人，善待他人，不吝美言。多使用正面的方式来影响别人的生命。 真正的力量在于兼容并蓄。 太多小事动不动就让我们呈现虚耗，进而演变成争执或拆伙的原因。把握机会与你所属的团体一同成长，无论是婚姻上的组合或是商场上的营销团队。 在这繁忙纷扰的世界里，开始支取从神来的智慧与人建立良好的关系是必要的，神是唯一足以「修补任何网中破洞」的力量，一种真正的力量，我们的人生要怎么过是自己的选择，这个世界变化万千，我们需要的是不断的成长和调适，成为人际关系的赢家。
eb7f9ee1757babed5da141299ebdfc8ec8dbeb24.translatedText: Strengthen good interpersonal relationships San Jose Cai Peifen Many people are completely controlled by their own emotions and feelings, resulting in very unhealthy relationships with others. A person with a mature personality should be able to observe his own feelings, manage and maintain good emotions. When others have negative emotions towards us, we must be especially careful not to let other people's emotions control our feelings. If a person does not manage their emotions, they will become very unhealthy and even be controlled by their own bad desires, because they only know their own feelings and their own wishes, but do not know how to observe and manage their emotions. Generally speaking, people who grow up in healthy families are more likely to trust people than others because their own family life is safe and reliable, they express friendship with each other, and their lives are predictable, so they can trust others when they enter the adult world. It’s just that sometimes they trust too much and even get cheated. People who grow up in healthy families also learn how to manage their emotions. Talking to someone who cares about you and is interested in you can relieve your emotions. They find that painful emotions fade over time, and they experience this again and again, becoming part of their instinctive awareness. Therefore, they seek to talk to others every time to eliminate their emotional distress and let the negative emotions dissipate over time. In this way, they learn not to endure patiently when they are sad, but to find ways to resolve it. People who come from healthy families know how to comfort others and receive comfort. They are more likely to be comforted when others comfort them. In fact, good interpersonal relationships are a natural result of healthy growth. Good interpersonal relationships start with having a good view of yourself, being able to handle your own emotions, and understanding the emotions of those around you. The necessary conditions for a good leader are to be able to understand people, establish good relationships with them, inspire team morale, and achieve goals together. A person who does not understand his emotions often chooses to suppress his emotions, and his emotions will explode with the most unexpected intensity at the most unexpected moment, causing damage to the relationship. Lack of emotional intelligence often ignores the emotions of others, which is a manifestation of lack of empathy. It is difficult for such people to establish good relationships with others. Gail Rodgers is a senior pastor engaged in women's ministry. She summed up the following experience from her own life experience to tell you how she builds and maintains a sound team and how to strengthen good interpersonal relationships: Step 1: Attribution of Responsibility Good interpersonal relationships mean that everyone is responsible for what happens within their own scope. Keep reviewing your attitude. If you see other people's shortcomings or deficiencies, don't develop a sense of superiority because of it. Don't always compare yourself with others. Please guard your heart and keep yourself teachable at all times. Step 2: Take Responsibility Good interpersonal relationships require everyone to take responsibility for their own shortcomings. Don’t just say, “I can’t help it, that’s just how I am!” to cover up your own shortcomings or the “gaps in someone else’s web.” Be honest with yourself and invite God to come into your gaps. In short, we must try our best to shoulder our own part of the responsibility. If you need help, don't be afraid, have the courage to seek it out. Step 3: Build each other up Good relationships are when everyone encourages each other. See the good in others, think about others' talents, and be willing to share your own growth and learning experiences. Connect with each other at work. If something needs to be discussed, it must be explained to the other party in a constructive manner. If someone points out a shortcoming to you, always keep an open mind. When necessary, find a third party to mediate, especially before the situation deteriorates, not after it deteriorates. Be careful about good relationships, especially those that have a significant impact on you and the group as a whole. Step 4: Choose a question Good interpersonal relationships are when each person correctly treats the shortcomings of others, although this is not easy? #65292; Our emotions usually get in the way. It is equally difficult to correctly view our own shortcomings and sincerely invite God to participate in our transformation and then become our strength. But God still fully expects us to choose His way to build good relationships. This decision, regardless of the friction on the edges of the sandpaper, will produce good results. You can help your team now and reap the rewards later. Step 5: Pray for each other Good relationships are when everyone prays for each other. When you see a gap or friction in your team, don’t rush to report it to other team members. Instead, report it first in prayer. Whenever we see each other's shortcomings, the first thing to do is to bring them to prayer. Just ask for a complaint, and the power of God will enter the person through this breach. And we become channels of grace to each other. Step 6: Bless each other. Good interpersonal relationships mean that as long as everyone has the opportunity, try to acknowledge others, be kind to others, and speak kind words without hesitation. Use more positive ways to impact other people's lives. The real power lies in inclusiveness. Too many little things can easily cause us to feel wasted, and then turn into the cause of disputes or breakups. Take the opportunity to grow with the group you belong to, whether it's a marriage partnership or a marketing team in a business. In this busy and troubled world, it is necessary to begin to draw on the wisdom from God to establish good relationships with people. God is the only power that can "repair the holes in any network." It is a real power. How we live our lives is our own choice. The world is ever-changing, and what we need is constant growth and adjustment to become winners in interpersonal relationships.

80e5f01fa391fc8ac9b114180f9c7fe42177d614.sourceText: 世报教育展洛加大录取审核员讲诀窍 （亚省时报） 世界日报27日将于罗斯密西来大学举办秋季教育展，邀请四位教育人士演讲。其中一名主讲是洛杉矶加大的韩裔录取审核员Ben Kwak，届时将主讲加大系统的录取须知。 加大录取标准今年有变化，除特定科系外，入学新生不必参加SAT-II考试，洛杉矶加大除工程系规定须出示SAT-II考试，其他系均已取消规定。学生应在申请前了解相关信息，决定是否需要参加考试。另外，过去加州高中前4%的学生能保证进入加大系统，今年提高到前9%。 虽然加州大学的录取标准透明，仍有学生和家长听信流言而误解。许多学生认为，被柏克莱加大录取就不会被洛杉矶加大录取。Ben Kwak 表示，加大各分校虽属同一系统，但录取决定绝对独立，从不互相干扰。 亚裔学生通常认为，亚裔学生成绩较好导致竞争过大，对自己不利。Ben Kwak称这是最普遍的误解，「我们在浏览申请书时，根本看不到学生的性别或种族。」加大录取办公室所有审核员每年定期培训，保证不以种族或性别衡量学生，公平对待每份申请书。亚裔学术方面强，录取率相对较高，现在是洛杉矶加大人数最多的种族，占总人数近40%，其中华裔比例最高。2011年有8253名华裔学生申请洛加大，录取2733名，其中899名决定就读。 Ben Kwak指出，外界所说大学有种族比例的硬性规定并不正确，「我们完全没有种族配额压力。」 每份大学申请书至少经两位录取工作人员审核，过程俗称「盲读」 (Blind Read)，即审核员相互并不知道其他审核员是谁，以求公平。学校有时请接受过相同培训的校外教育人士参加审核，以同样标准审核申请书。 Ben Kwak今年招生期间审核1000多份申请书。谈到录取标准，Ben Kwak指出，洛杉矶加大注重学术，GPA比SAT成绩更重要，GPA需要高中四年维持，而SAT可靠短期冲刺。「我们更愿意看到有责任心且持之以恒的学生。」课外活动同样重质不重量，四年持续参加同一学生组织或体育项目更吸引注意。 申请书中的「个人陈述」（Personal Statement），Ben Kwak表示，是让学生绽放自我的轻松环节，不必觉得压力太大。站在审核员角度，申请书前半交代学生的成绩和课外活动，个人陈述应阐述兴趣爱好。近几年洛杉矶加大申请者成绩傲人，有时一篇好的个人陈述更吸引审核员。 Ben Kwak建议学生把个人陈述至少给两个人阅读。完成草稿后，先自行校对，修改不当的文法及措词。随后请一到两个熟悉自己的朋友或家人阅读，以防漏掉讯息。学生应至少请一位不太熟悉自己的人，譬如老师或辅导员第三次阅读。「记住，审核员也不熟悉你。所以请一位跟你不熟的人帮你看看，有时事半功倍。」 审核员最不喜欢学生编造故事，「我们读了这么多个人陈述，一眼就看得出是真是假。」也不应只讨论自己的困难，审核员希望看到学生克服困难和决心，哪怕只是小问题，而不是讨论困难的程度。相较惊天动地的故事，审核员更欣赏诚恳的陈述。 政府教育预算删减对加大影响大，洛加大今年扩招国际学生及外州学生以增加收入。Ben Kwak表示，加州学生不必担心，他们不取代加州学生，也不影响本州岛学生录取率，加大系统不存在容量问题。 今年初洛加大发生白人女学生华勒斯（Alexandra wallace）「反亚裔视频事件」，Ben Kwak表示，学校正努力建造多元化校园，招收更多外州及国际留学生，并鼓励在学生出国领略外国文化。 亚裔学生及家长通常以学校排名为标准选大学，Ben Kwak认为一生只有一次大学经验，应选择适合自己的学校，他建议学生及家长利用高中二、三年级实地考察理想学校再定夺。如果未被洛加大录取，也没必要灰心，Ben Kwak建议至少申请四所加大，并考虑私立大学。
80e5f01fa391fc8ac9b114180f9c7fe42177d614.translatedText: World Journal Education Exhibition, University of California, Los Angeles admission reviewers share tips (Alberta Times) World Journal will hold an autumn education exhibition at Rosemont University on the 27th and invite four educators to give speeches. One of the speakers is Ben Kwak, a Korean admissions reviewer at the University of California, Los Angeles, who will give a lecture on the admissions instructions of the UC system. The admission standards of UCLA have changed this year. Except for specific departments, incoming freshmen do not need to take the SAT-II test. Except for the engineering department of UCLA, which requires the SAT-II test, other departments have canceled the requirement. Students should obtain relevant information before applying and decide whether they need to take the exam. In addition, in the past, the top 4% of California high school students were guaranteed to enter the UC system, but this year it was increased to the top 9%. Although the admission standards of the University of California are transparent, there are still students and parents who believe in rumors and misunderstand them. Many students believe that if they are admitted to UC Berkeley, they will not be admitted to UCLA. Ben Kwak said that although all UC campuses belong to the same system, their admission decisions are absolutely independent and never interfere with each other. Asian students generally believe that the higher academic performance of Asian students leads to excessive competition, which is detrimental to them. Ben Kwak said this is the most common misunderstanding, "When we look at the applications, we can't see the gender or race of the students at all." All reviewers in the UC Admissions Office are trained regularly every year to ensure that students are not measured based on race or gender and that every application is treated fairly. Asians are academically strong and have a relatively high admission rate. They are now the race with the largest enrollment in Los Angeles, accounting for nearly 40% of the total enrollment, with Chinese Americans having the highest proportion. In 2011, 8,253 Chinese students applied to UCLA, 2,733 were admitted, and 899 of them decided to attend. Ben Kwak pointed out that it is not correct for outsiders to say that universities have hard and fast rules on racial ratios. "We have no pressure on racial quotas at all." Each university application is reviewed by at least two admissions staff. The process is commonly known as "Blind Read", that is, the reviewers do not know who the other reviewers are to ensure fairness. The school sometimes invites off-campus educators who have received the same training to participate in the review and review the application with the same standards. Ben Kwak reviewed more than 1,000 applications during this year's admissions period. When it comes to admission standards, Ben Kwak pointed out that UCLA focuses on academics, and GPA is more important than SAT scores. GPA needs to be maintained for four years of high school, while SAT is reliable in a short period of time. "We prefer to see students who are responsible and persistent." Extracurricular activities also focus on quality rather than quantity. Participating in the same student organization or sports event for four years attracts more attention. Ben Kwak said that the "Personal Statement" in the application is a relaxing part for students to express themselves without feeling too stressed. From the auditor's perspective, the first half of the application should explain the student's grades and extracurricular activities, and the personal statement should describe interests and hobbies. In recent years, the scores of applicants to the University of California in Los Angeles have been impressive, and sometimes a good personal statement is more attractive to reviewers. Ben Kwak recommends that students give their personal statement to at least two people to read. After completing the draft, proofread it yourself to correct inappropriate grammar and wording. Then ask one or two friends or family members who know you well to read it to avoid missing any information. Students should have at least a third reading from someone who does not know them well, such as a teacher or counselor. "Remember, the auditor is not familiar with you either. So ask someone who is not familiar with you to help you take a look. Sometimes you can get twice the result with half the effort." Auditors don't like students to make up stories. "We have read so many personal statements and can tell at a glance whether they are true or false." You should not just discuss your own difficulties. Auditors want to see students overcoming difficulties and determination, even if it is just a small problem, rather than discussing the degree of difficulty. Auditors appreciate honest statements more than earth-shattering stories. The government's education budget cuts have a great impact on UCLA. This year, UCLA will expand its enrollment of international students and out-of-state students to increase revenue. Ben Kwak said that California students do not need to worry. They do not replace California students, nor do they affect the admission rate of students from the state. There is no capacity problem in the UC system. Earlier this year, the "anti-Asian video incident" of white female student Alexandra Wallace occurred at the University of California, Los Angeles. Ben Kwak said that the school is working hard to build a diversified campus, recruit more out-of-state and international students, and encourage students to go abroad to appreciate foreign cultures. Asian students and parents usually choose universities based on school rankings. Ben Kwak believes that you only have one college experience in your life, and you should choose a school that suits you. He suggested that students and parents use their second and third years of high school to visit their ideal school on the spot before making a decision. If you are not admitted to UCLA, there is no need to be discouraged. Ben Kwak recommends applying to at least four UCLA schools and considering private universities.

On the afternoon of August 27, the Karaoke Competition was held at August Love Song KTV. There were 11 contestants in total, and many fans watched the competition. In addition to those from Taiwan, the contestants also come from Shanghai, Xi'an and other places in mainland China.

d87014a24dba2e54da345718b0be7f2b62f7c770.sourceText: 参赛选手正在演唱 比赛中，参选选手选择的歌曲是百花齐放，有英文的，中文的，粤语的，台语的。 西安选手李睿英是刚刚到ASU上大一的学生，因为初次来到这里，希望认识更多的朋友，于是走路40多分钟，才到达了比赛现场，给大家带来了精彩的表演。 经过初赛，她成为进入决赛的五名选手之一。 主办方原计划从进入决赛的选手中选出两名参加9月28日台湾百年双十庆祝晚会，可是进入决赛的选手比分相当接近，有两名选手竟然得分完全相同。 经过评审的再三斟酌，最后决定，前三名为Leona Huang 李睿英刘协书三位同学，他们将一起进入总决赛。所有参赛选手都获得了由中华商会邱顺雄夫妇赞助的美味餐券。 总决赛可是奖品多多，冠军将获得奖学金$300，亚军获得奖学金$200季军为$100。 这些大奖最终将被谁最后获得，敬请关注9月28日晚6：00在Arcadia High School举办的双十庆祝晚会。
d87014a24dba2e54da345718b0be7f2b62f7c770.translatedText: Contestants are singing. Li Ruiying, a contestant from Xi'an, was a freshman at ASU. Because she came here for the first time and wanted to make more friends, she walked for more than 40 minutes to arrive at the competition site and gave everyone a wonderful performance. After preliminary rounds, she became one of the five finalists. The organizers originally planned to select two finalists to participate in the Taiwan Centennial Double Ten Celebration Party on September 28. However, the scores of the finalists were very close, and two players actually scored exactly the same. After repeated deliberation by the judges, it was finally decided that the top three students were Leona Huang, Li Ruiying and Liu Xieshu, and they will enter the finals together. All contestants received delicious meal coupons sponsored by the Chinese Chamber of Commerce Qiu Shunxiong and his wife. There are many prizes in the finals. The champion will receive a scholarship of $300, the runner-up will receive a scholarship of $200, and the third runner-up will receive a scholarship of $100. Who will win these grand prizes? Stay tuned for the Double Ten celebration party held at Arcadia High School at 6:00 pm on September 28th.

792a2a3ea14e73f892267b5a2df8788e21f65db2.sourceText: 六年级学生扎克格伦没想到会这么容易，扎克和他的同学在斯格思岱尔学校选修基础汉语课程。 这是斯格思岱尔联合学区提供给下属3所初中和5所高中的课程。学区在2009年秋季发给家长的问卷调查结果显示，汉语是家长们最希望孩子们学到的语言。 吉尔纽坎波斯，学区语言计划负责人，说：”过去几十年来，我们一直专注欧洲语言，但如今，我们都知道，世界经济重心转移到东方。” ”去年，三周的课程后，学生们可以说普通话了，”吉尔纽坎波斯补充说，”孩子们对中国大陆和台湾文化有了较深的了解。”学生们也接受一个生长在不同文化，讲不同语言的老师。 八年级学生现在可以选修汉语课程作为高中学分，并允许他们在高四参加汉语AP考试。
792a2a3ea14e73f892267b5a2df8788e21f65db2.translatedText: Sixth grader Zach Glenn didn't expect it to be so easy. Zach and his classmates took a basic Chinese course at Scottsdale School. This is a curriculum provided by the Scottsdale Unified School District to its three junior high schools and five high schools. The results of a questionnaire survey sent to parents by the school district in the fall of 2009 showed that Chinese is the language that parents most want their children to learn. Gil New Campos, head of the school district's language program, said: "For the past few decades, we have focused on European languages, but now, as we all know, the center of the world's economic center has shifted to the East." "Last year, after three weeks of classes, the students could speak Mandarin," Gil New Campos added. "The children had a deeper understanding of Chinese and Taiwanese cultures." The students also received a teacher who grew up in a different culture and spoke a different language. Eighth-grade students can now take Chinese courses as high school credits and are allowed to take the Chinese AP exam in their senior year.

45a4b5590452fbf6dfd9094e4061904ad7ed3bc7.sourceText: 从10月中旬开始，美国运营商Sprint Nextel将开始销售iPhone 5。 Sprint是美国第三大运营商，它将成为苹果的新合作伙伴。两位消息人士说，美国第一大运营商Verizon Wireless和第二大运营商AT&T同样也会在10月中销售iPhone 5。到二季度末，Sprint拥有超过5200万用户，而Verizon有1.06亿，AT&T有9900万。 新iPhone预期会与现有iPhone 4相似，但会更轻薄，摄像头提升，配有更复杂的系统。苹果6月曾表示，新版操作系统会在今年秋天推出；许多分析师相信苹果会同时升级iPhone。 手机业务已经大受热门智能手机的拉动，它也变得更复杂更昂贵。苹果iPhone平均售价超过650美元。运营商手机零售价为199美元或者299美元，并给予补贴。 对于Sprint来说，获得iPhone是一个大胜利。二季度，Sprint将合同用户数下滑归咎于竞争激烈，主要是所有主要竞争对手都提供iPhone。一位知情人士透露说，Sprint会同时推出iPhone 4。 2007年推出iPhone时，苹果与运营商签订独家销售协议；最近几年，苹果改变了战略，在全球许多国家与多家运营商签订协议。 今年二月，Verizon开始销售iPhone 4，AT&T更是从2007年就一直销售iPhone。2011年上半年，AT&T销售了720万台苹果iPhone；而Verizon通信销售了450万台。
45a4b5590452fbf6dfd9094e4061904ad7ed3bc7.translatedText: Starting in mid-October, US operator Sprint Nextel will start selling iPhone 5. Sprint is the third largest carrier in the United States and will become Apple's new partner. Verizon Wireless, the largest carrier in the United States, and AT&T, the second largest carrier, will also sell iPhone 5 in mid-October, two sources said. By the end of the second quarter, Sprint had more than 52 million customers, while Verizon had 106 million and AT&T had 99 million. The new iPhone is expected to be similar to the existing iPhone 4, but will be thinner and lighter, with improved cameras and more complex systems. Apple said in June that a new version of its operating system would be launched this fall; many analysts believe Apple will upgrade the iPhone at the same time. The mobile phone business, already driven by popular smartphones, has become more complex and expensive. The average selling price of Apple's iPhone exceeds $650. The retail price of the operator's mobile phone is US$199 or US$299, and subsidies are provided. For Sprint, getting the iPhone is a big win. In the second quarter, Sprint attributed the decline in contract users to fierce competition, mainly because all major competitors offer iPhones. A person familiar with the matter revealed that Sprint will launch iPhone 4 at the same time. When the iPhone was launched in 2007, Apple signed exclusive sales agreements with operators; in recent years, Apple has changed its strategy and signed agreements with multiple operators in many countries around the world. In February this year, Verizon began selling iPhone 4, and AT&T has been selling iPhones since 2007. In the first half of 2011, AT&T sold 7.2 million Apple iPhones; Verizon Communications sold 4.5 million.

1c4df1cf4d07ed6b5ce68ba452c386dfafab8abd.sourceText: 凤凰城警方正调查过去两周内发生在北凤凰城地区学校附近的三个企图绑架案。 据报导，三个单独报告发生在Shea和Cholla，28街至32街附近。 Desert Cove小学和Shadow Mountain高中的家长过去两周内都接到来自学校的报告，学校附近有危险的陌生人出现，注意自家小孩安全。 第一起事件发生在上周，30街和Cholla，一高中男孩走路去练足球，当他走近一辆米色丰田花冠车时，两名40至50岁白人男子试图将他拉进车，男孩设法逃脱。 然后是周一，一个Desert Cove小学男生步行回家，被一粗壮男人抓住肩膀，说,”你不记得我吗？我是罗伯特。你妈妈让我来接你” 男孩也成功逃离。 同样在周一，一女孩在Shadow Mountain高中附近的32街和Shea附近报警，说一名男子试图引诱她上车。所幸三起事件没有孩子受伤，警方说，但他们不能确定接二连三的事件是否有关联。警方呼吁家长与子女讨论”与陌生人接触的危险性” 并帮他们制定逃脱的办法。任何人有企图绑架信息，请致电602-292-6151凤凰城警方，或无声证人480-WITNESS、480-TESTIGO。
1c4df1cf4d07ed6b5ce68ba452c386dfafab8abd.translatedText: Phoenix police are investigating three attempted kidnappings that occurred near north Phoenix-area schools in the past two weeks. Three separate reports were reported at Shea and Cholla, near 28th Street to 32nd Street. Parents at Desert Cove Elementary School and Shadow Mountain High School have received reports from their schools over the past two weeks that dangerous strangers have appeared near the schools and they need to pay attention to the safety of their children. The first incident occurred last week at 30th Street and Cholla. A high school boy was walking to football practice. When he approached a beige Toyota Corolla, two white men aged 40 to 50 tried to pull him into the car. The boy managed to escape. Then on Monday, a Desert Cove Elementary School boy was walking home when a thick man grabbed his shoulder and said, "Don't you remember me? I'm Robert. Your mother asked me to pick you up." The boy also managed to escape. Also on Monday, a girl called police near 32nd Street and Shea near Shadow Mountain High School to say a man was trying to lure her into a car. Fortunately, no children were injured in the three incidents, police said, but they were not sure whether the back-to-back incidents were related. Police are urging parents to discuss "the dangers of contact with strangers" with their children and help them plan ways to escape. Anyone with information about the attempted kidnapping is asked to call Phoenix police at 602-292-6151 or Silent Witness at 480-WITNESS or 480-TESTIGO.

eff3a2fe272d71b1aacf07bf1f9106ad7d0b769f.sourceText: 致公党爱国宣言 旧金山五洲洪门致公总堂为纪念辛亥百年所筹办的《洪门筹饷风云实录》展览，将于本月26日在五洲洪门致公总堂会址（洪门筹饷局原址）内展出。在8月18日五洲洪门致公总堂为展览举办的媒体见面会上，周国祥会长表示，在纪念辛亥革命100周年之际，真实再现洪门筹饷史实，是洪门后人不可推卸的责任。这次展览的展品全部是五洲洪门致公总堂?#21407;汁原味?#30340;自有收藏品，有些文件和照片是从未在史料中提及、也从未向公众展示过的珍贵历史文献。
eff3a2fe272d71b1aacf07bf1f9106ad7d0b769f.translatedText: A patriotic declaration to the public party The "Records of Hongmen's Salary Raising Storm" exhibition organized by the Wuzhou Hongmen Zhigong General Hall in San Francisco to commemorate the centenary of 1911 will be on display at the site of the Wuzhou Hongmen Zhigong General Hall (the original site of the Hongmen Salary Raising Bureau) on the 26th of this month. At a media meeting held for the exhibition at the Wuzhou Hongmen Zhigong Hall on August 18, President Zhou Guoxiang said that on the occasion of commemorating the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911, it is an unshirkable responsibility for Hongmen descendants to truly reproduce the historical facts of Hongmen’s payment. The exhibits in this exhibition are all from the Wuzhou Hongmen Zhigong Hall’s own collection. Some documents and photos are precious historical documents that have never been mentioned in historical materials and have never been shown to the public.

ceefb412eed83423238ac5210c373ebf586e4dda.sourceText: 100年前美洲华侨支持辛亥革命的筹饷风云，正是在这次展览大厅内掀起并逐步在北美各地展开。这次展览所呈现出的文件、信扎，全部都是当年寄到这同一地址的原件。其珍贵的地方不在于”陈年”的古董价值，而是展品本身所诉说的许多从未为世人所知、哪些令人肃然起敬、荡气回肠的故事。 墨西哥分堂捐款名单
ceefb412eed83423238ac5210c373ebf586e4dda.translatedText: >100 years ago, the fundraising storm of overseas Chinese in America supporting the Revolution of 1911 was set off in this exhibition hall and gradually spread across North America. The documents and letters presented in this exhibition are all originals that were sent to the same address that year. Its preciousness lies not in its "aged" antique value, but in the many awe-inspiring and soul-stirring stories told by the exhibits themselves that have never been known to the world. The donation list of the Mexico branch

d4210089c735f5615892fe135a29e5ebb6e50fc6.sourceText: 展出包括：洪门筹饷局当年成立的章程、捐款收条、书信来往、图片、当年报导筹款和革命的中英文报纸，还有革命成功后，民国政府官员赠送的大批字画、要求支持和感谢的函件。
d4210089c735f5615892fe135a29e5ebb6e50fc6.translatedText: is on display including: the charter of the Hongmen Salary Bureau, donation receipts, correspondence, pictures, Chinese and English newspapers that reported on fundraising and the revolution, as well as a large number of calligraphy and paintings presented by the Republic of China government officials after the success of the revolution, and letters requesting support and thanks.

6e61c8d28002d7fbad13c3d7552934e9eb7f3286.sourceText: 从这次展览的展品中记载的原始文字证据中可以发现，旧金山致公总堂从一九０四年五月，孙中山先生踏足旧金山第一天开始，就始筹款资助革命。一九一一年五月，因应黄花岗起义事败，发起成立”洪门筹饷局”。一九一二年三月，改名”国民救济局”，为新成立的民国政府筹措建设经费。一九一五年，改名”革命筹饷局” （民国总公会），应孙中山要求，为北伐讨袁筹军饷。一九二五年在旧金山筹饷局内成立致公党。而从现存的大量史料中不难发现南北美洲各埠洪门山堂当年为祖国革命的捐献是?#26080;偿?#30340;。
6e61c8d28002d7fbad13c3d7552934e9eb7f3286.translatedText: From the original written evidence recorded in the exhibits in this exhibition, we can find that the Zhigong Hall in San Francisco began to raise funds to support the revolution from the first day Dr. Sun Yat-sen set foot in San Francisco in May 1904. In May 1911, in response to the failure of the Huanghuagang Uprising, the "Hongmen Salary Raising Bureau" was initiated. In March 1912, it was renamed "National Relief Bureau" to raise construction funds for the newly established government of the Republic of China. In 1915, the name was changed to the "Revolutionary Pay Bureau" (General Association of the Republic of China). At the request of Sun Yat-sen, it raised military pay for Yuan's Northern Expedition. In 1925, the Zhi Gong Party was established within the San Francisco Rate Board. From the large amount of existing historical materials, it is not difficult to find out how much the Hongmen Temple in North and South America contributed to the motherland's revolution.

f84aa96f21d79530508c61e62a95224affb4dcea.sourceText: 五洲洪门致公总堂盟长赵炳贤表示，堂内珍藏着的珍贵文物，是历代洪门兄弟保护的成果。因为条件局限，展览的内容也只是沧海一粟，希望将来条件成熟，能将更多的珍贵文献公之于世。书记长司徒仲珊介绍，展览主要按照年份和内容两大线索，如：黄三德陪同孙中山在美国筹款的历史、致公党从成立到宣誓的过程等。他说，为筹办这次展览五洲洪门致公总堂安排专人负责整理、修缮工作，并已全都拍摄后入册登记。
f84aa96f21d79530508c61e62a95224affb4dcea.translatedText: Zhao Bingxian, leader of the Wuzhou Hongmen Zhigong General Hall, said that the precious cultural relics collected in the hall are the results of the protection of Hongmen brothers in the past generations. Due to limited conditions, the content of the exhibition is only a drop in the ocean. I hope that in the future, when conditions are ripe, more precious documents can be made public to the world. Secretary-General Situ Zhongshan said that the exhibition is mainly based on two major clues: year and content, such as: the history of Huang Sande accompanying Sun Yat-sen in fundraising in the United States, the process of the Zhi Gong Party from its establishment to its oath, etc. He said that in order to prepare for this exhibition, the Wuzhou Hongmen Zhigong Hall has assigned special personnel to organize and repair the works, and all of them have been photographed and registered.

213146c23461420d6d22dcd4755f3409c053d8e2.sourceText: 分堂发给总堂的信件 周国祥表示，展览内容出自洪门，但历史属于人民。举办这个展览会除了纪念为辛亥革命作出贡献的英雄烈士外，更是向当年的洪门先贤们致敬，向一生献给洪门、献给革命的五洲洪门致公总堂第三任堂主黄三德致敬。周国祥说，致公堂已演变成一种文化，每位手足，都是爱国爱民族的一分子。希望通过展览，让海外年轻一代的华人瞭解过去，把民族精神承担起来，传承下去。
213146c23461420d6d22dcd4755f3409c053d8e2.translatedText: A letter sent from the branch church to the main church Zhou Guoxiang said that the content of the exhibition comes from Hongmen, but history belongs to the people. In addition to commemorating the heroes and martyrs who contributed to the Revolution of 1911, this exhibition also pays tribute to the Hongmen ancestors of the year and to Huang Sande, the third head of the Wuzhou Hongmen Zhigong Hall who dedicated his life to Hongmen and the revolution. Zhou Guoxiang said that Zhi Gong Tang has evolved into a culture, and every brother is a member of the patriotism and the nation. It is hoped that through the exhibition, the younger generation of overseas Chinese will understand the past, take up the national spirit and pass it on.

25d6a7f56b9a25e3600501f0c5ace142117c3e96.sourceText: “新台湾之光100”值得珍藏 参加9.28双十国庆晚会 （亚省时报） 凤凰城侨委会咨询顾问尹衍桓从台北传来好消息。知名文学杂志”远见”赞助五套”新台湾之光100”附DVD，为９月２８日台湾百年双十晚会助兴。 去年远见杂志看到了愈来愈多台湾人在国际上得到奖项与肯定，从获得世界面包冠军吴宝春，服装设计师吴季刚，菜贩慈善家陈树菊到品牌打进全世界企业代表宏达电周永明等，报导他们站上世界舞台奋斗的故事，希望从这些人的故事，彰显此刻台湾人的奋斗精神，以及探讨台湾这块地地到底具备那些养份，可以孕育出这么多台湾之光？ 这本”台湾之光”正是各地庆祝建国百年的精神内涵，也是中华民国进入下一个百年的文化底蕴。 9月28日亚省双十国庆晚会上将与大家分享这些故事。目前赞助卷仅五元，并可抽出百件名贵奖品，剩票不多，请速至欣欣超市，六福，蓝天及康乐大厦购票。
25d6a7f56b9a25e3600501f0c5ace142117c3e96.translatedText: "New Taiwan's Light 100" is worth cherishing. Attending the September 28th National Day Gala (Alberta Times) Yin Yanhuan, consultant of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Affairs Council, received good news from Taipei. The well-known literary magazine "Vision" sponsored five sets of "New Taiwan's Light 100" with DVDs to cheer for Taiwan's Centennial Double Ten Party on September 28. Last year, Vision Magazine saw more and more Taiwanese people receiving awards and recognition from the international community, including world bread champion Wu Baochun, fashion designer Jason Wu, vegetable vendor and philanthropist Chen Shuju, and HTC representative Zhou Yongming, who represents companies that have entered the global market. The magazine reported on their stories of struggle on the world stage. It hopes that through the stories of these people, it can highlight the fighting spirit of Taiwanese people at this moment, and explore what nutrients Taiwan has to give birth to so much light of Taiwan? This "Light of Taiwan" is the spiritual connotation of various places celebrating the centenary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, and it is also the cultural heritage of the Republic of China as it enters the next centenary. These stories will be shared with everyone at the Alberta National Day Gala on September 28. The current sponsorship coupon is only NT$5, and you can draw hundreds of valuable prizes. There are not many tickets left, so please go to Xinxin Supermarket, Luk Fook, Blue Sky and Connaught Building to buy tickets.

93ccbe56fd5dfbb8fa30cd1123f05b9c6fbc87c3.sourceText: 据台湾”今日新闻”消息，锋芝发出的离婚联合声明中，表示将共同抚养两儿，一切以小孩的的幸福成长为主要考虑因素，亦希望大家给予他们两人及小孩宁静的生活空间，让其快乐成长，并表示，将对媒体对锋芝婚变报道不准的部分，保留法律追诉权，也强调未来将不再对离婚一事做出回应。
93ccbe56fd5dfbb8fa30cd1123f05b9c6fbc87c3.translatedText: According to Taiwan's "Today's News", Fengzhi issued a joint divorce statement stating that they will raise their two children together, with the children's happy growth as the main consideration. They also hope that everyone will give them and their children a peaceful living space so that they can grow up happily. They also stated that they will reserve the right to pursue legal action for the inaccurate media reports on Fengzhi's marriage change, and also emphasized that they will no longer respond to the divorce in the future.

e4aad5580eb4882d1692ca1a7f5d3f80db0db9e0.sourceText: 锋芝协商离婚，一度紧张的关系也舒缓下来，今日两人都在内地赶拍电影，霆锋所属英皇经纪人霍汶希(微博)表示：”霆锋心情很平静，他短期内都要开工，没时间回香港。”而张柏芝也有向好友范玮琪(微博)透露：”我很好，不用担心。”
e4aad5580eb4882d1692ca1a7f5d3f80db0db9e0.translatedText: Feng Zhi negotiated for divorce, and the once tense relationship has eased. Today, the two of them rushed to shoot a movie in the mainland. Ting Fung's agent Fok Wenxi (Weibo) said: "Ting Fung is in a very calm mood. He has to start work in the short term and has no time to return to Hong Kong." Cecilia Cheung also expressed her gratitude to her friend Weiqi Fan (Weibo) ) revealed: "I'm fine, don't worry."

059b155ef23921e63c337f0f6b79dfccfadf3144.sourceText: 至于离婚所需支付的赡养费，据香港法律条文，双方拥有的家产，包括房产、股票、现金等，大多一人一半，赡养费则是由有能力的一方每月支付给对方，不一定是男方给女方。
059b155ef23921e63c337f0f6b79dfccfadf3144.translatedText: As for the alimony required for divorce, according to Hong Kong legal provisions, most of the family property owned by both parties, including real estate, stocks, cash, etc., is half for each person. The alimony is paid monthly by the capable party to the other party, not necessarily from the man to the woman.

c60f82d560de7766a1ea928fe707d9031acd212b.sourceText: 据悉，谢霆锋家产虽高达台币22亿元，但张柏芝复出拍戏后，荷包进账2.8亿新台币，更以18亿新台币给新经纪公司，财力雄厚，但传谢霆锋仍须年付440万新台币的生活费。
c60f82d560de7766a1ea928fe707d9031acd212b.translatedText: It is reported that although Nicholas Tse's family fortune is as high as NT$2.2 billion, after Cecilia Cheung returned to filming, she pocketed NT$280 million, and even gave NT$1.8 billion to a new agency. She has strong financial resources, but it is said that Nicholas Tse still has to pay NT$4.4 million in annual living expenses.

074ce30c4caf96818c40ceaca2cfddb9760a6683.sourceText: 反非法移民苛法被否州长上诉联邦最高法院 （亚省时报） 布鲁尔州长周三(10日)向联邦最高法院提出上诉，希望推翻之前令本州岛的SB1040关键条款暂缓执行的裁决。 布鲁尔在法院判决的最后期限前提出上诉。布鲁尔在4月的第一次上诉中落败，联邦第九巡回上诉法庭的3人法官小组驳回了她的要求，禁止警方向怀疑是非法移民的人查问移民身份。联邦最高法院可酌情决定是否审理她的上诉。 布鲁尔的律师要求法院审理上诉，并认为亚利桑那的边界问题在美国首当其冲，而且第九巡回的决定与最高法院的先例有冲突。 布鲁尔说，长久以来，联邦政府对非法移民问题视而不见，而现在这个问题在亚省已反映到房价下跌及小区罪案上升方面。亚省通过法律表明，亚利桑那州不愿再耐心等待联邦政府采取行动，如果联邦政府不执行移民法的话，将由他们来执行。司法部没有就此立即发表评论。 起诉亚利桑那州的联邦政府辩称，亚省的法律侵犯了联邦政府规管移民的专属权力，破坏了美国和墨西哥之间的关系，阻碍州和联邦官员合作，以及加重了合法移​​民的负担。 在反非法移民法2010年7月生效的前一天，亚州联邦地方法院法官博尔顿裁决阻止该法中的关键条款生效，这些条款包括警方可向怀疑是非法移民的人查问移民身份、要求移民要拥有并携带登记文件。但博尔顿允许法律的其它部分如禁止非法移民在寻找散工时阻碍交通。 亚利桑那在向联邦政府投诉未获足够援助多年后，在2010年4月自行通过反非法移民法。亚利桑那是全美最繁忙的非法入境黑点，并存在边境安全问题。该法引发不少抗议，有人提讼要求推翻该法，并对该法会否导致种族相貌歧视进行辩论。
074ce30c4caf96818c40ceaca2cfddb9760a6683.translatedText: The governor appealed to the Federal Supreme Court after being denied the harsh anti-illegal immigration law (Alberta Times) Governor Brewer appealed to the Federal Supreme Court on Wednesday (10th), hoping to overturn the previous ruling that suspended the implementation of key provisions of SB1040 on the island of the state. Brewer met the deadline for the court's decision to appeal. Brewer lost her first appeal in April, when a three-judge panel of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit rejected her request to prohibit police from questioning the immigration status of people suspected of being illegal immigrants. The Supreme Court has the discretion to hear her appeal. Brewer's attorneys asked the court to hear the appeal, arguing that Arizona's border issue bears the brunt of the U.S. and that the Ninth Circuit's decision conflicts with Supreme Court precedent. Brewer said that for too long, the federal government has turned a blind eye to the problem of illegal immigration, which is now reflected in falling housing prices and rising crime in communities in Alberta. The passing of the law by Alberta shows that Arizona is no longer willing to wait patiently for the federal government to take action. If the federal government does not enforce immigration laws, it will be enforced by them. The Justice Department had no immediate comment. The federal government suing Arizona argued that the province's law violated the federal government's exclusive authority to regulate immigration, undermined relations between the United States and Mexico, hindered cooperation between state and federal officials, and increased the burden on legal immigrants. The day before the Anti-Illegal Immigration Act took effect in July 2010, Judge Bolton of the federal district court in Asia ruled to prevent key provisions of the law from taking effect. These provisions include that the police can ask people suspected of being illegal immigrants about their immigration status and require immigrants to have and carry registration documents. But Bolton allowed other parts of the law, such as prohibiting illegal immigrants from blocking traffic in search of day laborers. Arizona passed its own anti-illegal immigration law in April 2010, after complaining to the federal government for years about not receiving adequate aid. Arizona is the nation's busiest black spot for illegal immigration and has border security issues. The law sparked a lot of protests, lawsuits were filed to overturn it, and there was debate over whether the law would lead to racial profiling.

d84536a09da2f707aa8d47cb985f7365f7a60286.translatedText: Giants are selling off The “pie” war in the Chinese market intensifies

071763166fa995226e680ed9048cab5bcf24509c.sourceText: 昨日，苹果公司下调16GB和32GB WiFi版翻新iPad 1价格，其中16GBiPad 1翻新机比6月份的售价低30美元。而惠普在宣布放弃PC业务之后，旗下的平板电脑TouchPad开始抛售，其中16GB版TouchPad大幅降300美元。
071763166fa995226e680ed9048cab5bcf24509c.translatedText: Yesterday, Apple lowered the price of the 16GB and 32GB WiFi versions of refurbished iPad 1, with the 16GB iPad 1 refurbished $30 lower than the price in June. After HP announced that it would give up its PC business, its tablet TouchPad began to sell off, with the 16GB version of TouchPad slashed by $300.

a8f8e7228577e467062bc35393149727b8fe8dba.sourceText: 业内人士昨日表示，一旦大量的苹果翻新机以及惠普的TouchPad进入中国市场，国内企业的平板电脑或面临冲击。
a8f8e7228577e467062bc35393149727b8fe8dba.translatedText: Industry insiders said yesterday that once a large number of refurbished Apple machines and HP TouchPads enter the Chinese market, tablet computers of domestic companies may face an impact.

25f41a589d346fdcaf47471d417c3f1982a2033d.translatedText: Apple: Selling refurbished machines at reduced prices

24b959c1d03d365778094bbcdf7ba61aaec24d58.sourceText: 据悉，苹果昨日已经将第一代16GB和32G的WiFi版iPad翻新机售价同时调低。其中16GB的iPad调低至299美元，比同型号翻新iPad 6月份的售价低30美元，比新机最低售价低184美元，而苹果同时将第一代32GB WiFi版翻新iPad（型号为MB293LL/A）的售价下调至399美元。
24b959c1d03d365778094bbcdf7ba61aaec24d58.translatedText: It is reported that Apple yesterday lowered the prices of refurbished machines of the first-generation 16GB and 32G WiFi versions of the iPad at the same time. Among them, the 16GB iPad has been reduced to US$299, which is US$30 lower than the June price of the same model of refurbished iPad and US$184 lower than the lowest price of a new model. Apple has also lowered the price of the first-generation 32GB WiFi version of the refurbished iPad (model MB293LL/A) to US$399.

ca84eb1f2fb68456ada369c8b7b66f1667940993.sourceText: 据悉，这两款翻新机与新机一样，享受1年保修服务。
ca84eb1f2fb68456ada369c8b7b66f1667940993.translatedText: It is reported that these two refurbished machines enjoy a one-year warranty service just like the new ones.

b5f76958c0481230962bac2a9588084ef6c00422.sourceText: 据了解，16GB的苹果翻新iPad在调低到299美元后，没过多久就销售一空，在补充货源后再次卖完。
b5f76958c0481230962bac2a9588084ef6c00422.translatedText: It is understood that the 16GB Apple refurbished iPad was sold out soon after it was reduced to US$299, and was sold out again after replenishing supplies.

6787d190c652f32b24bd1df88e7739ef12057d22.sourceText: 几日前，惠普宣布放弃PC业务。随后，开始大量清货刚刚上市不久的平板电脑TouchPad。
6787d190c652f32b24bd1df88e7739ef12057d22.translatedText: A few days ago, HP announced that it would abandon the PC business. Subsequently, large quantities of the TouchPad tablet computer, which had just been launched, began to be cleared in large quantities.

f877b80fc0966d82198bbc76d4b5aef4df48f518.sourceText: 根据百思买的消息，惠普已经将16GB的WiFi版的TouchPad从原来的399.99美元大幅降低到99.99美元，将32GB版TouchPad从原来的499.99美元降价至149.99美元，降幅高达或超过70%。
f877b80fc0966d82198bbc76d4b5aef4df48f518.translatedText: According to Best Buy, HP has significantly reduced the price of the 16GB WiFi version of TouchPad from the original $399.99 to $99.99, and the price of the 32GB version of the TouchPad from the original $499.99 to $149.99, a reduction of up to or more than 70%.

a88297eafbc77960f1d5a1013f8a7379aa1b22d1.sourceText: 据悉，TouchPad是惠普公司为了应对目前的平板电脑热而在7月2日推出的一款产品，当时TouchPad16GB/32GB两个容量版本的售价分别为499.99美元和599.99美元，定价和iPad 2相差无几。但由于其后销售业绩不佳，惠普在8月12日曾宣布，将TouchPad平板电脑售价均下调100美元。
a88297eafbc77960f1d5a1013f8a7379aa1b22d1.translatedText: It is reported that TouchPad is a product launched by HP on July 2 in response to the current tablet computer craze. At that time, the two capacity versions of TouchPad 16GB/32GB were priced at US$499.99 and US$599.99 respectively. The pricing was almost the same as that of iPad 2. However, due to subsequent poor sales performance, HP announced on August 12 that it would lower the prices of TouchPad tablets by US$100.

50faa0a08d2eb1e7d440c02008384fa9b42b6b2c.sourceText: 记者昨日走访广州多家IT卖场，发现各品牌平板电脑价格并未出现异常。
50faa0a08d2eb1e7d440c02008384fa9b42b6b2c.translatedText: Reporters visited a number of IT stores in Guangzhou yesterday and found that there was no abnormality in the prices of tablet computers of various brands.

b25eac72f47ccf64b6d200da8d71aa59fd00c72b.sourceText: 记者从摩托罗拉渠道商处获悉，目前摩托罗拉将XOOM从原来的4998元降至3998元。
b25eac72f47ccf64b6d200da8d71aa59fd00c72b.translatedText: The reporter learned from Motorola’s channel dealer that Motorola has reduced XOOM from the original 4,998 yuan to 3,998 yuan.

e8cd4932488f1ff254ea98fd027e9dbab252d68d.sourceText: 在三星官网，记者发现，三星目前大力推广其即将上市的几款新的平板电脑。而华银公司则主推iPad所没有的办公功能，并与中国电信、 中国联通 进行联合定制战略。同时，为争夺2800元以下的市场，联想公司在8月推出了一款7英寸的乐Pad A1平板，目前官方售价为2499元。
e8cd4932488f1ff254ea98fd027e9dbab252d68d.translatedText: On Samsung's official website, reporters found that Samsung is currently vigorously promoting several new tablet computers it will soon launch. Huayin Company, on the other hand, focuses on promoting office functions that the iPad does not have, and has jointly customized strategies with China Telecom and China Unicom. At the same time, in order to compete for the market below 2,800 yuan, Lenovo launched a 7-inch LePad A1 tablet in August. The current official price is 2,499 yuan.

eae4625c7c29f9b643d5d326356e67f77eac3cae.sourceText: 深圳渠道商陆桥表示，苹果公司官方的翻新机质量应该有保证，如果大量低价的iPad 1翻新机进入中国市场，加上惠普的TouchPad以更低价进来，中国市场的”派”战将加剧。目前一些深圳的手机渠道商开始筹集资金，准备进货。 (来源：广州日报)
eae4625c7c29f9b643d5d326356e67f77eac3cae.translatedText: Shenzhen channel dealer Lu Qiao said that the quality of Apple's official refurbished machines should be guaranteed. If a large number of low-priced iPad 1 refurbished machines enter the Chinese market, and HP's TouchPad comes in at a lower price, the "pie" war in the Chinese market will intensify. At present, some mobile phone channel dealers in Shenzhen have begun to raise funds and prepare to purchase goods. (Source: Guangzhou Daily)
