7f0dc2194903fbda4f3d95edb26a297761f3bf85.sourceText: 图为苹果前COO库克(左)和乔布斯(右)在一起。
7f0dc2194903fbda4f3d95edb26a297761f3bf85.translatedText: The picture shows Apple's former COO Cook (left) and Steve Jobs (right) together.

33ede898b83ca794d6b4219c5be0a42cfdddb11d.sourceText: 新浪科技讯 北京时间8月25日早间消息，苹果董事会今天宣布，苹果CEO史蒂夫 乔布斯(Steve Jobs)辞职，董事会已任命前苹果COO蒂姆 库克(Tim Cook)接任苹果CEO一职。乔布斯被选为董事会主席，库克将加入董事会，立即生效。
33ede898b83ca794d6b4219c5be0a42cfdddb11d.translatedText: Sina Technology News Early morning news on August 25, Beijing time, Apple’s board of directors announced today that Apple CEO Steve Jobs has resigned, and the board of directors has appointed former Apple COO Tim Cook to take over as Apple’s CEO. Jobs was elected chairman of the board and Cook will join the board, effective immediately.

9e0adfa7d2b8e130d9d5b81bf03d7455fe299eab.sourceText: 乔布斯今天向苹果董事会递交了辞呈，并强烈推荐前苹果COO蒂姆 库克(Tim Cook)接任苹果CEO一职。
9e0adfa7d2b8e130d9d5b81bf03d7455fe299eab.translatedText: Jobs submitted his resignation to Apple's board of directors today and strongly recommended former Apple COO Tim Cook to take over as Apple CEO.

10ce6cc81d5884f43aee1ab721dc39d161805201.sourceText: 今年1月，乔布斯再度宣布病休。这位56岁的苹果掌门人在病休期间仍然担任CEO，积极参与公司业务和各项活动。此后，他将公司日常运营交由COO蒂姆 库克(Tim Cook)处理。
10ce6cc81d5884f43aee1ab721dc39d161805201.translatedText: In January this year, Jobs once again announced his medical leave. The 56-year-old Apple leader continued to serve as CEO during his medical leave and was actively involved in the company's business and various activities. Since then, he has handed over the day-to-day operations of the company to COO Tim Cook.

b638b7b33e8871bb4530d220920bf83c1ea154e2.sourceText: 乔布斯的病休曾一度导致苹果股价暴跌，投资者认为此举增添了苹果未来前景的不确定性。不过此后，乔布斯并未从公众视线中消失。他不仅前去苹果总部工作，还出席了美国总统奥巴马举行的硅谷宴会，并主持了iPad 2发布会和苹果2011年全球开发者大会。
b638b7b33e8871bb4530d220920bf83c1ea154e2.translatedText: Jobs' medical leave once caused Apple's stock price to plummet. Investors believed that this move increased the uncertainty of Apple's future prospects. But since then, Jobs has not disappeared from the public eye. Not only did he go to work at Apple's headquarters, he also attended the Silicon Valley banquet held by US President Obama, and hosted the iPad 2 launch conference and Apple's 2011 Worldwide Developers Conference.

88d0e416522a7d94f9ead093c41d5bc2701fa0b5.sourceText: 库克今年50岁，在乔布斯离开期间通常由他负责公司运营。熟悉苹果日常运营的人士称，与其他资深高管一样，库克理解乔布斯的想法，并设定了未来几年间的产品路线图。
88d0e416522a7d94f9ead093c41d5bc2701fa0b5.translatedText: Cook, 50, is usually in charge of company operations during Jobs' absence. People familiar with Apple's day-to-day operations said that Cook, like other senior executives, understood Jobs's thinking and set the product roadmap for the next few years.

3e759db5c0bbed75d4495fe35092876a53a1d2e9.sourceText: 新任CEO将不得不肩负起乔布斯目前承担的责任，如高管退休问题。由于苹果股价在过去5年间上涨近7倍，许多高管已成富豪，有可能选择离职变现，如何维持团队的完整性是CEO面临的一大难题。从去年11月至今，苹果零售主管罗 恩 约翰逊(Ron Johnson)、营销传播副总裁埃里森 约翰逊(Allison Johnson)和Mac软件工程主管伯特兰德 塞莱特(Bertrand Serlet)先后离职。(新轶)
3e759db5c0bbed75d4495fe35092876a53a1d2e9.translatedText: The new CEO will have to shoulder the responsibilities that Jobs currently holds, such as executive retirement issues. Since Apple's stock price has increased nearly seven times in the past five years, many senior executives have become rich and may choose to leave their jobs to cash out. How to maintain the integrity of the team is a major problem facing the CEO. Since November last year, Apple’s retail chief Ron Johnson, vice president of marketing communications Allison Johnson and Mac software engineering chief Bertrand Serlet have resigned. (Xinyi)

49a7af77c46639cc0147d0e0fa1ff574aeae3bab.sourceText: ASU小组角逐年度大学生企业家奖 （亚省时报） 由《企业家》杂志举办的2011年大学生企业家大奖，有五个小组入围，其中三个小组来自ASU，Ellens Technologies、G3Box和Boson Inc.。 G3Box是一个由集装箱改装的医疗诊所。小组负责人说，希望建成后能改善非洲等落后地方的生育条件。 Boson Inc.创造了新的3D技术，如眼睛软件等，可以适应于各行业。 Ellens Technologies发明了一种医用应用程序在动物体内，以帮助人们诊断疾病。成功后希望能在人体使用。 投票在九月结束。获胜者将获《企业家》杂志专题文章介绍，和奖学金5000元。
49a7af77c46639cc0147d0e0fa1ff574aeae3bab.translatedText: ASU team competes for the Annual Student Entrepreneur Award (Alberta Times) There are five finalists for the 2011 Student Entrepreneur Award organized by Entrepreneur magazine, three of which are from ASU, Ellens Technologies, G3Box and Boson Inc. G3Box is a medical clinic converted from shipping containers. The leader of the team said that he hoped that after completion, it would improve fertility conditions in backward places such as Africa. Boson Inc. creates new 3D technologies, such as eye software, that can be adapted to various industries. Ellens Technologies has invented a medical application in animals to help people diagnose diseases. After success, it is hoped that it can be used in humans. Voting closes in September. The winner will receive a feature article in Entrepreneur magazine and a scholarship of 5,000 yuan.

43ba22e475286a64898fb5cf14ffaa6e61846564.sourceText: SB1070影响深远 各州移民法大量出台 （亚省时报） 据跨党派研究组织美国州议会会议近日公布的一份报告，今年各州立法者推出了创记录数目的移民相关法案，凸显了他们对联邦政府关于移民法案无所作为的无奈。 据外媒报导，该组织发现，在6月30日截止的2011年度，全美50个州和波多黎各共推出了1592项移民法案。 该组织移民政策项目总监安．莫斯说，其中40个州的立法者制定了151项法律，主要针对执法、身份证明和就业问题。此外还有5项法案被州长否决。 有5个州棗阿拉巴马、乔治亚、印第安纳、南卡罗来那和犹他州棗推出了类似亚利桑那州的移民法，即SB 1070，该法律要求执法机构在怀疑有人是非法移民时可审查其移民身份。所有这5州的移民法律均在联邦法庭受到挑战。 莫斯说，2005年州移民立法开始增加，当时300项法案被提出，38条法律被制定。至2007年超过1500项州立法案被提出，其中240个被签署成法律。 总计有10个州通过立法，要求雇主使用电子验证（E-Verify），一种使用联邦数据库来审查雇员是否合法进入美国及被授权工作的查验手续。 在马里兰和康涅狄格州，新的法律将允许非法移民学生享有州内学费。加州州长布朗则签署了州版本”梦想法案”（Dream Act），为非法移民大学生打开了获得财务援助的大门。 《CNN》报导，专家认为，移民相关法律的不断出笼，显示了各州的无奈。 但这份报告发现，尽管各州不断推出移民法案，但没有导致制定的法律数量创下记录。 2011年上半年40个州共制定了150项法律，相比之下，2010年为208项，2009年为222项。 大量法案提出后从未制定成法律，它们被州立法者搁置，因为他们正等待联邦法庭对当前移民法律的裁决。
43ba22e475286a64898fb5cf14ffaa6e61846564.translatedText: SB1070 has far-reaching impact and states have introduced a large number of immigration laws (Alberta Times) According to a report recently released by the American Conference of State Legislatures, a bipartisan research organization, state legislators have introduced a record number of immigration-related bills this year, highlighting their frustration with the federal government’s inaction on immigration bills. According to foreign media reports, the organization found that in 2011, which ended on June 30, a total of 1,592 immigration bills were introduced in 50 states and Puerto Rico. Ann., director of the organization's immigration policy program. Lawmakers in 40 of those states have enacted 151 laws, Moss said, focusing on law enforcement, identification and employment issues. In addition, five bills were vetoed by the governor. Five states - Alabama, Georgia, Indiana, South Carolina and Utah - have introduced an immigration law similar to Arizona's, known as SB 1070, which requires law enforcement agencies to review someone's immigration status when they suspect they are illegal immigrants. All five states' immigration laws are being challenged in federal court. Moss said state immigration legislation began to increase in 2005, when 300 bills were introduced and 38 laws were enacted. By 2007, more than 1,500 state bills had been introduced, 240 of which had been signed into law. A total of 10 states have passed legislation requiring employers to use E-Verify, a verification process that uses a federal database to verify whether employees are legally in the United States and authorized to work. In Maryland and Connecticut, new laws would allow illegal immigrant students to have in-state tuition. California Governor Brown signed the state version of the "Dream Act", opening the door to financial aid for illegal immigrant college students. "CNN" reported that experts believe that the continuous introduction of immigration-related laws shows the helplessness of states. But the report found that while states have continued to introduce immigration bills, they have not resulted in a record number of laws being enacted. A total of 150 laws were enacted in 40 states in the first half of 2011, compared with 208 in 2010 and 222 in 2009. A slew of bills were introduced and never became law, languishing among state lawmakers as they await federal court rulings on current immigration laws.

7c72a2985f1c4736a9ccf1d562b0f1ff57eb098e.sourceText: 医师钱景看好 大投资划算否？ （亚省时报） 医学院申请启动日，从初审、复审到有机会获医学院面试、到尘埃落定，常是近一年后的事。即使进入医学院，从上课到赴医院不同部门见习，到申请大医院做住院医师（Residence），到在专科学习（Fellowship ），又是「历经煎熬」的漫漫长路。不少人30岁才能赚到人生第一桶金，「读医学院是否值得」常在有志者及鼓励他们的父母脑海盘旋。 暑假后升上大四的洛杉矶加大化学系学生谢杰夫，已完成医学院入学考MCAT及医学院预科课业，一放暑假就忙着申请医学院。「虽然每个医学院申请截止日不同，但过来人建议愈早申请愈好」。 谢杰夫说，申请医学院可透过「美国医学院申请服务」（简称AMCAS）网站填表，一次申请多所学校，主要提供GPA 、MCAT成绩、自传及课外小区活动等资料。每个学校均需申请费，约80至130元，若申请十所，平均1000元。 收到第二关复审通知又要缴申请费，也是80至130元。他发现有些学校根本在发「申请财」，如芝加哥大学等私立大学，他前一天才寄出申请表，第二天就收到进入第二关回函，猜测对方根本未看过其申请文件。 「第二关提出的文件须更精确，此时大部分医学院要求五封介绍信，包括两封科学、一封人文教授，及两封课外活动，如研究或义工等主管的推荐信。」 将升上四年级的洛杉矶加大医学院学生严苏珊指出，医学院申请过程繁琐又冗长，没有足够毅力及决心对抗竞争，只有放弃。进医学院后头两年是上课，第三年开始到医院不同部门见习，同时须准备申请到大医院担任住院医师的考试，很少有时间玩乐。 在外州知名医院担任内科住院医师的王彼得说，要争取到有名医院，一样要靠GPA、住院医师入学考成绩及推荐信等，总之一路都在竞争。由于放射科、眼科、皮肤科及麻醉科被认为是「钱」景看好、风险却较小的专科，这几科住院医师职位竞争也较激烈。 住院医师并因未来专攻领域不同，有不同服务年限，如内科医师三年、麻醉医师四年等。住院医师起薪4万、5万元，且每年调薪，但工作时间长，平均下来相当于最低时薪。 王彼得说，内科医师尚细分为心脏、肠胃或风湿关节等不同专科。有些人结束住院医师训练后，又前往专科担任医师（Fellowship），至少多花一年才可能开业。 虽然家庭科医师起薪10几万元，专科医师起薪20几万元，比一般人高，仍有不少家长及当事人质疑这类投资是否值得，「我每年花在医学院孩子身上的学杂费等开销超过5万元，若将这笔钱投资在他处，说不定可孳生更多财富。」不少家长如此感叹。 「做医师虽辛苦，但环顾各种职业，最后我还是鼓励孩子学医。」家庭科医师蔡隆卫则如是说。
7c72a2985f1c4736a9ccf1d562b0f1ff57eb098e.translatedText: Doctor Qian Jing is optimistic about whether a large investment is worthwhile? (Alberta Times) The start of the medical school application process, from the initial review and re-examination to the opportunity to get an interview with a medical school, to the final decision, often takes nearly a year. Even after entering medical school, it is a long journey from taking classes to internships in different departments of the hospital, to applying for residency in a large hospital, to studying in a specialty (fellowship). Many people only earn their first pot of gold at the age of 30. "Is it worth going to medical school?" often hovers in the minds of aspiring students and their parents who encourage them. Jeff Xie, a chemistry student at the University of California, Los Angeles, who became a senior after the summer vacation, has completed the medical school admission test MCAT and medical school preparatory coursework, and is busy applying to medical schools as soon as the summer vacation comes. "Although the application deadline for each medical school is different, people who have experienced it suggest that the sooner you apply, the better." Jeff Xie said that to apply for medical school, you can fill out the form through the American Medical College Application Service (AMCAS) website and apply to multiple schools at one time. It mainly provides information such as GPA, MCAT scores, autobiography and extracurricular community activities. Each school requires an application fee, which is about 80 to 130 yuan. If you apply to ten schools, the average fee is 1,000 yuan. After receiving the second review notice, you have to pay an application fee, which is also 80 to 130 yuan. He found that some schools were offering "application bonuses", such as the University of Chicago and other private universities. He only sent the application form the day before, and received a reply to the second step the next day. He guessed that the other party had not read his application documents at all. "The documents submitted in the second step must be more precise. At this time, most medical schools require five letters of recommendation, including two letters of recommendation from science professors, one from humanities professors, and two letters of recommendation from supervisors of extracurricular activities such as research or volunteering." Susan Yan, a student at UCLA Medical School who will be entering her fourth year, pointed out that the medical school application process is cumbersome and lengthy, and she does not have enough perseverance and determination to fight against competition, so she has to give up. After entering medical school, I spent the first two years attending classes. In the third year, I started working as an intern in different departments of the hospital. I also had to prepare for the exam to apply for a residency in a large hospital. There was little time for fun. Wang Peter, who works as an internal medicine resident in a well-known hospital out of state, said that to get a well-known hospital, you also need to rely on GPA, residency entrance examination scores and letters of recommendation. In short, there is competition all the way. Since radiology, ophthalmology, dermatology and anesthesiology are considered to be specialties with good financial prospects but low risks, the competition for resident physician positions in these specialties is also fierce. Resident doctors have different service years depending on their future specialization fields, such as three years for internal medicine physicians, four years for anesthesiologists, etc. The starting salary of a resident physician is 40,000 to 50,000 yuan, and the salary increases every year, but the working hours are long, which is equivalent to the minimum hourly wage on average. Peter Wang said that physicians are still subdivided into different specialties such as heart, gastroenterology or rheumatism and joints. After completing their residency training, some people go on to work as fellowships in specialists, and it takes at least one more year before they can practice medicine. Although the starting salary of a family physician is over 100,000 yuan, and that of a specialist is over 200,000 yuan, which is higher than the average person, many parents and clients still question whether this type of investment is worthwhile. "I spend more than 50,000 yuan on tuition and miscellaneous fees for my children in medical school every year. If I invest this money elsewhere, I might be able to generate more wealth." Many parents lamented. "Although being a doctor is hard work, looking at various professions, I still encourage my children to study medicine." Cai Longwei, a family physician, said.

100cf197457abe5f1969d909ab7933fcf9986003.sourceText: 凤凰城十团体第三次中秋联欢筹备会议 （亚省时报） 八月十四日中午，凤凰城中秋联欢晚会的十个团体于红锅布斐餐厅第三次召开筹备会议。到会十 个团体的联络人近三十人, 又一起具体讨论了赏月晚宴、文娱节目、抽奖与舞会活动的安排。经过讨论，与会者分工明确，纷纷表示将同心协力把各项活动工作落到实处，共同欢度一个温馨快乐的美好佳节。 会议由开平同乡会副会长关兆峰主持，开平同乡会会长、亚省时报社社长老真提出了讨论的活动四项具体内容：赏月晚宴、文娱节目、抽奖与舞会。 第一项，赏月晚宴，凤城酒家已表示 推出最好的夏日清凉大餐。每位餐费标准20元, 个人只交15元，另外5元由各团体补 贴。团体不足补贴者, 由十团体和几位热心人士所献出的筹备费中补贴。这笔经费除支付月饼和组织演出的必要会议费用外，不足的话, 将再请热心人士和团体赞助。每席餐位以10位成年人为计, 席中如有携带12岁以下小孩参加, 一席中不超过三、四位, 不加收费, 月饼及菜式不变, 互助互让解决。 第二项，文艺演出节目。分工由亚省美中文化交流协会负责人古雅瑜具体组织 。她透露，将会特别节目丰富多彩 ，有京剧、粤曲、流行歌曲、合唱、独唱、舞蹈、武术，四川绝活变脸， 画家现场作画表演, 等等。 担任舞台监督的陈志钢表示, 要能尽可能地用专戏职业灯光来打造布景，营造气氛。而且也希望尽可能地化最少的钱来做出最棒的节目, 力求接近专业水平。 第三项，幸运抽奖。开平同乡会名誉会长关宗任, 献出十个银元．作为贵重礼物。另外、张华芳、何恭柏等除了带头捐出免费餐券，关兆峰和何贵森等还积极地向好朋友们募集奖品。相信这次的奖品将会既贵重又多，很具吸引力。 最后一项，交谊舞会。将由交谊舞爱好者司徒贤黄焕胜夫妇、朱家佑王玮婷夫妇负责组织，爱跳舞的人既是温馨，也是舒畅。 最后，新东方艺术学校校长吕丽华说，我们很喜欢参加这项大众的文化娱乐活动，要为晚会送上精彩的节目。到会各团代表寄希望，这次由十个群众团体联合发起, 首次共同筹办的中秋晚会, 能有许许多多的侨胞乡亲踊跃参加，使之成为华人大众所喜闻乐见的一次佳节大欢聚，办得美妙，办得圆满。
100cf197457abe5f1969d909ab7933fcf9986003.translatedText: Preparatory meeting for the third Mid-Autumn Festival Gala of ten groups in Phoenix City (Alberta Times) At noon on August 14, ten groups of the Phoenix Mid-Autumn Festival Gala held their third preparatory meeting at the Red Pot Buffy Restaurant. Nearly thirty contact persons from ten groups attended the meeting, and they discussed in detail the arrangements for the moon-viewing dinner, entertainment programs, raffles, and dance activities. After discussion, the division of labor was clear among the participants, and they all expressed their willingness to work together to implement various activities and celebrate a warm and happy holiday together. The meeting was chaired by Guan Zhaofeng, vice president of the Kaiping Association. Elder Zhen, president of the Kaiping Association and editor of the Alberta Times, proposed four specific contents of the activities to be discussed: moon appreciation dinner, entertainment program, lottery and dance. The first item is the moon viewing dinner. Fengcheng Restaurant has said that it will launch the best summer refreshing meal. The standard meal fee per person is 20 yuan. Individuals only pay 15 yuan, and the other 5 yuan is subsidized by each group. If the group is unable to subsidize the event, it will be subsidized from the preparation fees donated by ten groups and several enthusiastic individuals. This fund will not only cover the moon cakes and necessary meeting expenses for organizing the performance, but if it is insufficient, we will ask enthusiastic people and groups to sponsor it. Each table is based on 10 adults. If there are children under 12 years old attending the table, there will be no more than three or four people per table. There will be no extra charge. The mooncakes and dishes will remain the same. It will be a matter of mutual help and give-and-take. The second item is theatrical performances. The division of labor was specifically organized by Gu Yayu, head of the Alberta U.S.-China Cultural Exchange Association. She revealed that there will be a variety of special programs, including Peking opera, Cantonese opera, pop songs, chorus, solo singing, dance, martial arts, Sichuan's unique face-changing skills, live painting performances by painters, etc. Chen Zhigang, who serves as the stage manager, said that professional theater lighting should be used as much as possible to create the scenery and atmosphere. And I also hope to spend the least amount of money as possible to produce the best program, and strive to be close to professional level. The third item is lucky draw. Guan Zongren, honorary president of the Kaiping Association, donated ten silver coins. As a valuable gift. In addition, Zhang Huafang, He Gongbai and others not only took the lead in donating free meal coupons, but Guan Zhaofeng and He Guisen also actively collected prizes from good friends. I believe the prizes this time will be valuable, plentiful and very attractive. The last item, the ballroom dance. It will be organized by ballroom dancing enthusiasts Situ Xian, Huang Huansheng and his wife, and Zhu Jiayou and Wang Weiting. It will be warm and comfortable for those who love dancing. Representatives of all the delegations present at the meeting expressed their hope that this Mid-Autumn Festival Gala, jointly sponsored by ten mass organizations and jointly organized for the first time, would be actively attended by many overseas Chinese and folks, making it a festive gathering that the Chinese people love to see, and it would be wonderful and successful.

5deae9f00cebcb6572c91a5780a102790156b264.sourceText: ”辛亥革命对北美华人社会的影响”专题学术研讨会于8月14日在洛杉矶罗省秉公堂礼堂内举办，应邀来参加这场研讨会的中国致公党山东省委副主委肖培树、山东省海外联谊会副会长牟强等5名学者与南加州侨学界代表，从北美华人的民族意识、爱国情结、侨社团结以及文化教育等方面，共同探讨和研究辛亥革命对北美华人社会所产生的深远影响。
5deae9f00cebcb6572c91a5780a102790156b264.translatedText: The special academic seminar on "The Impact of the Revolution of 1911 on the Chinese Society in North America" was held on August 14th at the Bing Gong Hall Auditorium in Los Angeles. The Chinese who were invited to participate in this seminar Five scholars, including Xiao Peishu, deputy chairman of the Shandong Provincial Committee of the Guozhi Gong Party, Mou Qiang, vice president of the Shandong Overseas Friendship Association, and representatives of the overseas Chinese community in Southern California, jointly discussed and studied the profound impact of the Revolution of 1911 on the Chinese society in North America from the aspects of the national consciousness, patriotism, unity of overseas Chinese communities, and cultural education of the Chinese in North America.

986f7dfff468bb0320172fa6bdec844f1564ae95.sourceText: 中国致公党山东省委副主委肖培树指出，孙中山先生曾在辛亥革命前，多次到访海外，广泛寻求海外华人的支持及宣传其革命理念。孙中山先生一方面鼓动了北美华人的革命热忱。在另一方面，北美华人在参与支持辛亥革命的过程中，对中国政治发展的关心也相应提升，不经意地激发了北美华人的政治、民权与民族意识。
986f7dfff468bb0320172fa6bdec844f1564ae95.translatedText: > Xiao Peishu, deputy chairman of the Shandong Provincial Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party, pointed out that Mr. Sun Yat-sen visited overseas many times before the Revolution of 1911, extensively seeking support from overseas Chinese and promoting his revolutionary ideas. On the one hand, Mr. Sun Yat-sen inspired the revolutionary enthusiasm of the Chinese in North America. On the other hand, as the Chinese in North America participated in and supported the Revolution of 1911, their concern for China's political development also increased accordingly, inadvertently stimulating the political, civil rights, and national consciousness of the Chinese in North America.

8120243b8407533799948b07e2fc9fa2654fe0a2.sourceText: 山东省海外联谊会副会长牟强在发言中认为，海外华人对祖藉国具有强烈的爱国情结。这种爱国情结始于19世纪末、20世纪初的辛亥革命前后期。1911年的辛亥革命将海外华人的爱国情结推向高潮。辛亥革命后海外华人都期盼着中国能成为一个独立而强大的国家。二十世纪初北美华人抵制美国排华政策的运动是海外华人爱国情结在辛亥革命成功后的早期体现。
8120243b8407533799948b07e2fc9fa2654fe0a2.translatedText: Mou Qiang, vice president of the Shandong Overseas Friendship Association, said in his speech that overseas Chinese have a strong patriotic complex towards their ancestral country. This patriotic complex began in the late 1911 and early 20th centuries during the Revolution of 1911. The 1911 Revolution of 1911 pushed the patriotism of overseas Chinese to a climax. After the Revolution of 1911, overseas Chinese all looked forward to China becoming an independent and powerful country. The movement of North American Chinese to resist the U.S. anti-Chinese policy in the early 20th century was an early manifestation of the patriotism of overseas Chinese after the success of the Revolution of 1911.

a994f8683b443586159145e6884d2599bd4e5709.sourceText: 罗省秉公堂主席马培道表示，北美华人接受孙中山先生民族思想的影响，在投入支持辛亥革命的同时，减少了华人社会帮派和籍贯的斗争，促成了华人社团之间的联合与团结。通过华人社团之间的良性互动，北美华人的团结精神和国民意识逐渐被加强和发展起来。成为海外华人华侨融入当地社会的原动力之初始。
a994f8683b443586159145e6884d2599bd4e5709.translatedText: > Ma Peidao, chairman of Luo Province Beng Gong Tang, said that the Chinese in North America accepted the influence of Dr. Sun Yat-sen’s national thoughts and invested in supporting the Revolution of 1911. At the same time, they reduced the struggle between gangs and origins in Chinese society and promoted the alliance and unity among Chinese communities. Through positive interactions among Chinese communities, the spirit of unity and national awareness among Chinese in North America has gradually been strengthened and developed. It has become the initial driving force for overseas Chinese to integrate into local society.

f6498b2465e8591563296b3719097fb26923a9b6.sourceText: 全美中华青年联合会会长任向东在发言中指出，辛亥革命也推动了北美华人的文化教育事业。辛亥革命为北美华人带来的新思潮，废除了许多华人社会中的封建陋习。华侨学校也随之在北美各地开始进入规模成长的快速阶段，从以往使用的方言教学，逐步过渡到使用标准华语，使不同籍贯的华人间有了共同的媒介语。新式教材、各种华文书籍和报刊的发行增加，对提高北美华人的文化水平有非常重要的作用。
f6498b2465e8591563296b3719097fb26923a9b6.translatedText: Ren Xiangdong, president of the National Chinese Youth Federation, pointed out in his speech that the Revolution of 1911 also promoted the cultural and educational undertakings of Chinese in North America. The Revolution of 1911 brought new trends of thought to the Chinese in North America and abolished many bad feudal habits in Chinese society. Overseas Chinese schools across North America also began to enter a rapid stage of growth. They gradually transitioned from the dialect teaching used in the past to the use of standard Chinese, giving Chinese people of different origins a common medium. The increased distribution of new textbooks, various Chinese books and newspapers and periodicals has played a very important role in improving the cultural level of Chinese in North America.

18ef9995ca86e3c776eca55d8cdf3707ebfa6624.sourceText: 领略中华烹饪之博精饮食文化之渊源——图桑中秋宴现代“满汉全席” （亚省时报 胡鐞报道） 在美国要吃到地道的中餐很不容易，要说中国的国宴似乎就更不可能。可是今年中秋您也许就有机会，品尝一下国宴的味道。 9月6日-12日图桑裕丰餐厅的老板娘张蔓琳特地在全球中餐协会活动中邀请到了国宴大师吴永东（Tony Wu），他将到图桑裕丰餐厅举办”满汉全席”庆中秋餐会，一展中华美食之精华。 在美国从事餐饮业11年的张蔓琳说，在美国大部分都认为中餐便宜，吃来吃去就是那么几个家常菜，以为”中餐”不过如此。当2008年世界奥林匹克运动会在中国北京召开的时候，全世界才刚刚看到现在中国原来如此不同。这时候张蔓琳告诉自己，时间到了，也应该是让美国的食客看看什么才是真正的中餐。 高档的中国菜与西餐一样是集视觉，听觉，味觉于一体，雅俗共赏的盛宴。今年中秋的”满汉全席”一共由十一道菜组成。他们分别是沙律棒棒鸡，玉子XO锦箱腐，太极海皇金汤羹，叱诧风云龙虾皇，蜜椒香煎澳羊架，乌龙茶熏北京鸭，蟹肉珍珠鲑鱼卷，御扇金蔬，榄菜小炒饭，大锅炒拉面，宫廷御点。沙律棒棒鸡是将尚好的新鲜鸡肉，碾成肉酱，蔬菜也根据不同的颜色榨成酱，所以第一份上来的沙律一定会让食客耳目一新。整个沙律的造形就像一个滋润凉爽的冰淇凌。这十一道菜，不仅用料新鲜名贵，而且制作技艺精湛。乌龙茶熏北京鸭就是一个典范。乌龙茶熏北京鸭要皮脆肉嫩，香而不腻。关键的处理就是鸭皮和鸭肉之间的油脂。既要让油脂的香味渗透到鸭肉里，又不能有油腻的感觉。烤鸭在制作过程中，吴师傅会在最适当的温度和时间，将烤脆的皮和鸭肉之间的油脂剥离出来，这个工艺在时间温度的控制，和剔除脂肪的手法都非常考究，有任何闪失，整个烤鸭的制作都将前功尽弃。每份的烤鸭的份量不大，他们有薄脆的印度飞饼包裹。一口咬下去，香脆的薄饼，包裹着正中的北京烤鸭，加上乌龙茶悠远的清香，会在同一个时间在嘴，鼻中萦绕，让人真正体会到中式皇家菜肴的美味。 味道绝佳的菜肴，只是”满汉全席”的一部分。在主宴之前，先会有小的酒会，”满汉全席”的专业酒师，首先会根据菜肴的特点，为食客选好几款搭配食物的美酒，装饰精致的餐前小点。沙律棒棒鸡，玉子XO锦箱腐，太极海皇金汤羹等，几个菜上过以后，现场将会有精彩的绝技表演。保持6项吉尼斯世界纪录的吴永东，将现场为食客表演手工拉面绝活，他将蒙眼拉出1.6万根龙丝面。他风趣幽默的表演，和精湛的拉面技术早是业内的知名品牌。 9月的”满汉全席”将会聚集北美中餐行业众多行家的目光，更多的惊喜会在宴会上陆续登场，让北美食客喝到如痴如醉，看到拍案叫绝，品到梦回清宫皇家盛宴。 吴永东简历 24岁时破格成为中国最年轻的特级厨师 1988年被国家旅游总局派到日本学习烹饪 泰国，被当地同仁堂御膳厅聘用7年。 90年代中期，吴永东举家移民加拿大，当时定居多伦多 2004年在广州举行第五届世界中餐烹饪大赛吴永东连夺3块金牌，由当时的联邦国务部长陈卓愉颁奖，并被命名为”全面厨神”。
18ef9995ca86e3c776eca55d8cdf3707ebfa6624.translatedText: Appreciate the origins of Chinese cooking and the exquisite food culture - the modern "Manchu-Han Banquet" at the Tucson Mid-Autumn Festival Banquet (reported by Hu Qian of the Alberta Times) It is not easy to eat authentic Chinese food in the United States, and it seems even more impossible to talk about China's state banquet. But this Mid-Autumn Festival, you may have the opportunity to taste the taste of a state banquet. From September 6th to 12th, Zhang Manlin, the proprietress of Yufeng Restaurant in Tucson, specially invited Tony Wu, the master of state banquets, at the Global Chinese Food Association event. He will hold a "Manchu-Han Banquet" to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival at Yufeng Restaurant in Tucson, showcasing the essence of Chinese cuisine. Zhang Manlin, who has been engaged in the catering industry in the United States for 11 years, said that most people in the United States think that Chinese food is cheap, and they only eat a few home-cooked dishes, thinking that "Chinese food" is nothing more than that. When the 2008 World Olympic Games were held in Beijing, China, the world had just seen how different China is now. At this time, Zhang Manlin told herself that the time had come, and it was time to let American diners see what real Chinese food was. High-end Chinese food, like Western food, is a feast that integrates sight, hearing, and taste, and is a feast for both refined and popular tastes. This year's Mid-Autumn Festival "Manchu-Han Banquet" consists of eleven dishes. They are Salad Bangbang Chicken, Yuzi The Bangbang Chicken Salad is made from fresh chicken that is still good and is ground into a meat sauce. The vegetables are also pressed into sauce according to different colors, so the first salad served will definitely be refreshing to diners. The whole salad is shaped like a moist and cool ice cream. These eleven dishes not only use fresh and expensive ingredients, but are also made with exquisite craftsmanship. Oolong tea-smoked Peking duck is a perfect example. Oolong tea-smoked Peking duck has crispy skin and tender meat, which is fragrant but not greasy. The key treatment is the fat between the duck skin and duck meat. It is necessary to let the aroma of fat penetrate into the duck meat without feeling greasy. During the process of making roast duck, Master Wu will peel off the fat between the crispy skin and duck meat at the most appropriate temperature and time. This process is very sophisticated in terms of time and temperature control and fat removal techniques. If there is any mistake, the entire roast duck production will be wasted. The portions of roast duck are not big and they have thin crispy roti wraps. When you bite into it, the crispy pancake wraps the Peking duck in the center, and the distant fragrance of oolong tea lingers in your mouth and nose at the same time, making people truly appreciate the deliciousness of Chinese royal cuisine. Delicious dishes are only part of the "Man-Han Banquet". Before the main banquet, there will be a small wine reception. The professional sommelier of the "Man-Han Banquet" will first select several wines to match the food for the diners based on the characteristics of the dishes, and decorate exquisite pre-dinner snacks. Salad Bangbang chicken, Tamago Wu Yongdong, who holds six Guinness world records, will perform a unique handmade noodle trick for diners on the spot. He will pull out 16,000 dragon noodles while blindfolded. His humorous performances and superb ramen skills have long made him a well-known brand in the industry. The "Manchu-Han banquet" in September will attract the attention of many experts in the Chinese food industry in North America. More surprises will appear at the banquet one after another, making the North American food guests drunkenly drunk, wowed by the sight, and dreaming back to the royal banquet of the Qing Dynasty. Wu Yongdong's resume: At the age of 24, he became the youngest special chef in China. In 1988, he was sent to Japan to learn cooking by the National Tourism Administration. In Thailand, he was employed by the local Tongrentang Imperial Dining Hall for 7 years. In the mid-1990s, Wu Yongdong immigrated to Canada with his family and settled in Toronto at that time. In 2004, the Fifth World Chinese Culinary Competition was held in Guangzhou. Wu Yongdong won three gold medals in a row. The award was presented by the then federal minister of state, Chen Zhuoyu, and he was named the "Total Chef God".

0f445534d7f35ca035bb293af615c91a347d749a.sourceText: 中文夏令营 日发30元说英文扣5元 （亚省时报） 南加州中文学校联合会2011 Startalk中学生语言文化夏令营6日闭幕。72名华人学生分为两期，在一周中文环境学习、运用中文，进步显著。 总召集人许笑浓表示，与过去安排教师利用六周暑假时间教授主流社会中文零起点的学生不同，今年Startalk进行重大改革，对象为掌握中等程度以上中文水平、今秋即将升入六至九年级的华人学生。 今年夏令营要求学员一律住宿，进行中文自由阅读、中文会话、用中文打字书写阅读感想及文学创作。 许笑浓强调，目前中文学校缺乏适合华人学生的读物。此次Startalk夏令营特别为高年级学生提供创作平台，他们尽情发挥想象力编写文学故事，并配以插图说明。所有优秀作品将有机会出版成册，这不仅是对学生自身中文能力的肯定，也是不可多得的中文学校教材。 许笑浓说，为鼓励孩子更多运用中文，每天早晨起床时每位学员都可得到30元，一旦发现说英文便扣五元。办法非常有效，几乎听不到学员间用英文交流。
0f445534d7f35ca035bb293af615c91a347d749a.translatedText: Chinese Summer Camp, a daily fee of 30 yuan, you will get a 5 dollar deduction for speaking English (Alberta Times) Southern California Chinese School Association 2011 Startalk language and culture summer camp for middle school students concluded on the 6th. 72 Chinese students were divided into two phases. They learned and used Chinese in a Chinese environment for a week and made remarkable progress. General convener Xu Xiaonong said that unlike in the past, where teachers were assigned to use their six-week summer vacation to teach Chinese students from the mainstream society, this year Startalk has undergone major reforms, targeting Chinese students who have mastered an intermediate level of Chinese and are about to enter sixth to ninth grade this fall. This year’s summer camp requires all students to stay in accommodation and conduct free Chinese reading, Chinese conversation, writing reading reflections and literary creation in Chinese typing. Xu Xiaonong emphasized that Chinese schools currently lack reading materials suitable for Chinese students. This Startalk summer camp specially provides a creative platform for senior students. They use their imagination to write literary stories and illustrate them. All outstanding works will have the opportunity to be published in volumes. This is not only an affirmation of students' own Chinese abilities, but also a rare Chinese school teaching material. Xu Xiaonong said that in order to encourage children to use Chinese more, each student will receive 30 yuan when they get up every morning. If they are found to speak English, they will deduct 5 yuan. The method is so effective that you can hardly hear students communicating in English.

c4cb30bb526b5a260ce8ddeb743865409a7f9e2c.sourceText: 美CNN网站：全球50佳美食 北京烤鸭列第五 世界各地食物琳琅满目，有些美食不容错过。据香港《文汇报》22日报道，美国有线新闻网旗下的旅游网站CNNGo评选出全球50种最美味食物，泰国马沙文咖喱被评为”万食之王”，荣登首位。皮脆肉香的北京烤鸭则位列第5，成为排名最高的中国美食，中国香港地道特色蛋挞和西多士分别打入第16位和38位。 CNNGo搜罗全球各地食品，经精挑细选后得出最后50强，让网民选出各自心目中至爱。CNNGo指出，排首位的泰国马沙文咖喱把辛辣、香甜等味道融为一体，”比泰国选举更有特色”，就算是从超市购买的马沙文咖喱，也能炮制出”米芝莲”餐厅美食的滋味。 北京烤鸭吸引食家的秘密，则是其甜美而光泽鲜明的脆皮，用薄饼皮夹着来吃，配以葱段和海鲜酱或甜酱，令人爱不释口。 对于香港人常吃的蛋挞，CNNGo指它把软滑蛋浆和松脆挞皮两种截然不同的质料，糅合得天衣无缝，并建议蛋挞最好趁热食，一啖咬落甜上心头，再三回味。同样榜上有名的港式西多士，是茶餐厅下午茶必然选择，但CNNGo认为西多士卡路里偏高，不宜多食。 日本寿司则排第4，被CNNGo形容为”最美丽食物”，指它虽然成分简单，只有鱼和米饭，但两者巧妙地结合在一起，成为情侣首次约会的最佳菜式。另一引人注目的是排第45位的新加坡海南鸡饭，新鲜嫩滑的鸡肉，加上香味十足的油饭，佐以豉油和姜蓉，食过耐人寻味
c4cb30bb526b5a260ce8ddeb743865409a7f9e2c.translatedText: US CNN website: The world's 50 best delicacies, Beijing roast duck ranks fifth. There are a dazzling array of foods from all over the world, and some delicacies are not to be missed. According to Hong Kong's "Wen Wei Po" report on the 22nd, CNNGo, a travel website affiliated with CNN, selected the 50 most delicious foods in the world. Thai Massaman Curry was named the "King of Foods" and topped the list. Peking duck with crispy skin and fragrant meat ranked fifth, becoming the highest-ranked Chinese delicacy. Hong Kong's authentic egg tarts and western toast ranked 16th and 38th respectively. CNNGo searched for foods from all over the world and carefully selected the top 50, allowing netizens to choose their favorites. CNNGo pointed out that the top-ranked Thai massaman curry combines spicy, sweet and other flavors and is "more distinctive than the Thai election." Even the massaman curry purchased from the supermarket can produce the taste of "Michelin" restaurant cuisine. The secret of Peking duck that attracts gourmets is its sweet and shiny crispy skin. It is eaten with a thin pancake skin and served with scallions and hoisin sauce or sweet sauce. It is an addictive dish. Regarding the egg tart that is commonly eaten by Hong Kong people, CNNGo pointed out that it perfectly blends two completely different materials, soft egg batter and crispy tart crust, and suggested that the egg tart is best eaten while it is hot, so that the sweetness will hit your heart with one bite and you will savor it again and again. Hong Kong-style Western toast, also on the list, is the inevitable choice for afternoon tea in tea restaurants. However, CNNGo believes that Western toast is high in calories and should not be eaten in large quantities. Japanese sushi ranked fourth and was described by CNNGo as "the most beautiful food". Although it has simple ingredients, only fish and rice, the two are cleverly combined to become the best dish for couples on their first date. Another eye-catching item is Singapore’s Hainanese Chicken Rice, ranked 45th. The fresh and tender chicken is paired with fragrant fried rice, served with soy sauce and minced ginger. It’s an intriguing meal.

6dd18d20e73ab1961d3bb41724e3a66d7357207b.sourceText: 为梦想加油！——2011ASU中国学生会秋季迎新晚会（组图） 又是一年一度的新生入学之际，为了更好的让新生融入ASU的学习生活，结识更多的朋友，美国亚利桑那州立大学中国学生学者联谊会（CSSA）于8月20号晚举行了隆重的CSSA 2011秋季迎新晚会。今年秋季有超过300个中国留学生到ASU就读，迎新晚会空前盛大。 ＡＳＵ台湾梦乐团 晚上6时40分，迎新晚会正式开始。来自宝岛台湾的梦乐团用自创的歌曲《莫斯科的夜晚》为迎新晚会拉开了序幕。两位靓丽的主持人，走上台，对２０１１年秋季的新同学表示热烈欢迎。中国学生学者联合会主席黄麟雯，ＡＳＵ学生会代表都上台发言表示祝贺，并希望大家踊跃加入学生会的组织，为同学服务。 ASU中国学生学者联合会主席 黄麟雯 一个家乡话游戏，让现场气氛活跃起来。因为都是来自中国各地的留学生，自然忘不了乡音，东北学生爱说”咱那旮答，冈冈地厖”上海人当然是”我爱侬”，游戏中需要朗读的词都是流行歌曲的歌词，用家乡话读起来，别有风味，全场笑声不断。勇敢的男生总是踊跃举手，女生总是”被举手”。说得溜的乡音当然是迎来片片笑声和掌声，还有非常给力的敲桌子的声音，只要开口说了，都能得到美丽礼仪小姐手中的纪念品。 游戏过后，就是抽奖时间，本次迎新晚会的奖品丰富多彩，有打印机，蛋糕机，面包机，咖啡机以及各种小礼品。五位幸运者率先拿到了第一轮抽奖的奖品。 首批幸运者 不仅有拿，还有吃，丰盛的晚宴，诱人的匹萨都在等着大家。当晚的迎新”盛宴”，最丰盛的当然不仅是菜，更吸引新生的是和老生们的交谈，认识一些新的朋友。对于刚到ＡＳＵ的新同学来说，对很多东西都很新奇，例如驾照，购车，采购，出去游玩等各种信息。学生会非常细心的给新生们准备了入学手册，里面详细介绍了在国外留学生活的注意事项。 晚饭后，老生们准备了很多精彩的表演，超级大奖”纽约双人跨年倒数7天6夜游”也隆重送出。 现场盛况
6dd18d20e73ab1961d3bb41724e3a66d7357207b.translatedText: Go for the dream! ——2011 ASU Chinese Students Association Autumn Orientation Party (photo) It is the time for freshmen to enter the school again. In order to better integrate the freshmen into the study life of ASU and make more friends, the Chinese Students and Scholars Association (CSSA) of Arizona State University held a grand CSSA 2011 Autumn Orientation Party on the evening of August 20th. This fall, more than 300 Chinese students will study at ASU, and the orientation party will be unprecedentedly grand. ASU Taiwan Dream Band At 6:40 pm, the New Year Party officially started. The Dream Band from Taiwan kicked off the New Year Party with their self-composed song "Moscow Night". Two beautiful hosts came on stage to express their warm welcome to the new students in the fall of 2011. Huang Linwen, president of the Chinese Students and Scholars Association, and representatives of the ASU Student Union all came to the stage to express their congratulations and hoped that everyone would actively join the student union organization and serve their classmates. Huang Linwen, President of the ASU Chinese Students and Scholars Association, played a native dialect game to liven up the atmosphere. Because they are all international students from all over China, they naturally cannot forget the local accent. Northeastern students like to say "Zana Na Da, Gang Gang Di Pang" and Shanghainese of course "I love Nong". The words that need to be read aloud in the game are the lyrics of popular songs. When read in the hometown dialect, it has a unique flavor and the whole audience laughs constantly. Brave boys always raise their hands enthusiastically, while girls always get their hands raised. Of course, her fluent local accent was greeted with laughter and applause, as well as her powerful knocking on the table. As long as she spoke, she would get souvenirs from the hands of the beautiful etiquette lady. After the game, it’s time for the draw. The prizes at this welcome party are rich and colorful, including printers, cake machines, bread machines, coffee machines and various small gifts. Five lucky people were the first to get the first round prizes. The first batch of lucky people not only get it, but also eat it. A sumptuous dinner and tempting pizza are waiting for everyone. In the welcoming "feast" that night, the most sumptuous thing was of course not only the food, but what also attracted the new students was the conversation with the old students and making some new friends. For new students who have just arrived at ASU, they are very new to many things, such as driver's licenses, car purchases, purchases, outings and other information. The student union has very carefully prepared an admission handbook for the new students, which details the precautions for studying abroad. After dinner, the old students prepared many wonderful performances, and the super grand prize "New York New Year's Countdown 7-day and 6-night tour for two people" was also grandly given away. grand occasion

c0d28569a5eea3fba9a6ef8b8046177bc8ce11f1.sourceText: 8月19日晚6点40分，在Villas小区听见一声巨响，两个从safeway回来的中国学生，亲眼目睹了一辆卡车，穿墙而过，从broadway上的一个洗车铺开到Jentilly Road上的小商业店前面。大卡车不仅穿过了墙，还把一个棕榈树拦腰则断，对面商业屋得玻璃和墙面，也被撞飞的墙砖打破。几分钟后两辆消防车和一辆治安车到达现场。据目击者介绍，该辆卡车从洗车铺旁边的酒吧开到Broadway向西行驶，试图要在Jentilly Ln进行U Turn 可是方向一转径直开进洗车铺，由南向北直冲到墙上，幸好没有人员伤亡。司机一直被锁在车内，由于车门撞变形，而无法出来，直到消防人员到达，用器具打开车门，司机被安全救出。
c0d28569a5eea3fba9a6ef8b8046177bc8ce11f1.translatedText: At 6:40 pm on August 19th, I heard a loud noise in the Villas community. Two Chinese students returning from Safeway witnessed a truck passing through the wall and rolling out from a car wash on Broadway to the front of a small commercial store on Jentilly Road. The big truck not only passed through the wall, but also broke a palm tree in half. The glass and wall of the commercial building opposite were also broken by the flying wall bricks. Two fire engines and a security vehicle arrived at the scene minutes later. According to eyewitnesses, the truck drove from the bar next to the car wash shop to Broadway and headed west, trying to make a U-turn on Jentilly Ln. However, it changed direction and drove straight into the car wash shop, crashing into the wall from south to north. Fortunately, no one was injured. The driver was locked in the car and was unable to get out due to the deformation of the door. Until firefighters arrived and used tools to open the door, the driver was safely rescued.

4101bd6ca9e740d7e151ad478a21dc4e61b75d7e.sourceText: 逾时加入联邦医保 终身罚款 （亚省时报） 婴儿潮人口逐渐老化，愈来愈多华人符合领取联邦医疗保险（Medicare）的65岁，但有些人长住国外，以为未来返美定居时再参加该项保险就好，也有人为了省钱，暂时不买其中的部分保险，没想到后来参加才发现面临终身罚款，且不是想参加就参加，须在法定时间加入才行。 66岁的刘老先生自认身体健康，去年65岁生日前向联邦社安署申请「联邦医疗保险」时，故意不买要自付费用看医师的B部分保险，只参加不必自掏腰包的A部分上医院保险，以便节省每月百余元保费。没想到后因身体不适打算补买B部分保险时，才知道这类保险须在法定时间购买。今年法定购买时间提前至10月15日，他届时购买除保费，尚面临政府每年10%罚款，且只要他活着，每年都须给付这笔罚款。 王姓保险经纪指出，华人多半不知道联邦医疗保险架构，在选择健保计划时「人云亦云」，未依照个人健康状况量身选择。不少华人并将联邦医疗保险视为救济计划，未想过这其实是个互助计划，即曾在美工作年满65岁固有资格申请，也须分摊B及D部分拿药保费。这也是为什么延后参加保险的退休耆老，补买这部分保险面临罚款。 以D部分处方药保险为例，申请人今年有资格买该部分保险却未买，等到两年后有需要才买，届时将以每个月1%保费乘以有多少个月未付该部分保费计算罚款，即1% x 24个月，且只要活着，每年都要缴这笔罚款。 保险经纪刘雷玲芳说，年届65岁且仍在上班，若公司提供健保，可暂时不必申请联邦医疗保险，也不必担心罚款。但新移民小区普遍存在的问题是：年满65岁的退休人士或因台湾有健保有恃无恐，或因不知道生日前三个月即有资格参加联邦医疗保险，等到后来想到要加入，才发现竟有罚款。投保人普遍也不知道有多种健保计划可选择。 前年年满65岁的退休族李芳音，看到报上针对耆老刊登的医疗网广告，宣称提供的HMO计划门诊挂号、听力、视力、X光检查等服务都不要钱，就兴冲冲地参加，没想到该计划并不适合她的情况。原来常往外州探望子女的她，有三次在外州临时生病，保险公司却不偿付医疗费。后来才知道HMO健保计划是有区域限制，不能随便看外州医师，且若看专科医师，须家庭医师同意。但要更换健保计划却要在一年后的规定时间内才能申请，让她吃了不少苦头。
4101bd6ca9e740d7e151ad478a21dc4e61b75d7e.translatedText: A lifetime fine for late enrollment in federal health insurance (Alberta Times) The baby boomer population is gradually aging, and more and more Chinese are eligible to receive Medicare (Medicare) at the age of 65. However, some people have lived abroad for a long time and think that they can only sign up for this insurance when they return to the United States to settle down in the future. Some people do not buy some of the insurance for the time being in order to save money. Unexpectedly, they later found out that they would face a lifetime penalty when they signed up. Moreover, they did not sign up just because they wanted to, but had to sign up within the legal time. Mr. Liu, 66, considers himself to be in good health. When he applied for Medicare from the Social Security Administration last year before his 65th birthday, he deliberately did not buy Part B insurance, which requires out-of-pocket medical treatment, and only purchased Part A hospital insurance, which did not require out-of-pocket payments, in order to save more than a hundred dollars in monthly premiums. When I thought about buying Part B insurance later because I was feeling unwell, I learned that this type of insurance must be purchased within the legal time. This year, the legal purchase time has been advanced to October 15. If he purchases it by then, he will face an annual 10% penalty from the government, and he will have to pay this penalty every year as long as he lives. The insurance broker surnamed Wang pointed out that most Chinese people do not know the structure of the federal health insurance. When choosing a health insurance plan, they follow everyone's opinions and do not choose according to their personal health conditions. Many Chinese regard the federal health insurance as a relief plan, but they have not thought that it is actually a mutual aid plan. Even those who have worked in the United States and are over 65 years old have to share the drug premiums for Parts B and D. This is why retired seniors who delay participating in insurance face penalties for purchasing this part of the insurance. Take Part D prescription drug insurance as an example. If the applicant is eligible to buy this part of the insurance this year but does not buy it, and waits until he needs it two years later to buy it, then the penalty will be calculated as 1% of the monthly premium multiplied by the number of months that the premium has not been paid, that is, 1% x 24 months. This penalty must be paid every year as long as he is alive. Insurance broker Liu Lei Lingfang said that if the company provides health insurance, you do not need to apply for federal health insurance for the time being, and you do not have to worry about fines. However, a common problem in new immigrant communities is that retired people over 65 years old may be confident because they have health insurance in Taiwan, or they do not know that they are eligible for federal health insurance three months before their birthdays. They only discover that there are penalties when they think about joining. Insurance policyholders generally do not know that there are many health insurance plans to choose from. Li Fangyin, a retiree who turned 65 the year before last, saw a newspaper advertisement for a medical website targeting the elderly, claiming that it provided HMO plan outpatient registration, hearing, vision, X-ray examination and other services for free, so she enthusiastically joined the plan. She did not expect that the plan was not suitable for her because she often traveled to other states to visit her children. Three times she fell ill temporarily out of state, but the insurance company did not reimburse her medical expenses. Later she learned that the HMO health insurance plan had regional restrictions, and she could not see a doctor from outside the state at will, and if she wanted to see a specialist, she needed the consent of her family doctor. However, she had to apply for a change of health insurance plan within a specified period of one year, which made her suffer a lot.

94d23d2b8cf3f7e61ea331d4e8812185c8a44165.sourceText: 美联储本周二承诺保持低贷款利率至少两年时间。 趋近于0的基准利率至少会到2013年的年中。 房地产行业的很多人士都认为美联储的承诺是个大的利好消息，让购房者更多的时间享受低利率带来的贷款优惠。 美联储在周二的声明中说，美国整体经济增长缓慢，消费者的消费能力也一同减低。 美国经济学家认为这是一个双底衰退期。 经济分析员分析，美联储长达两年保持低利率是前所未有的举措。 他们预计经济增长在下半年会温和回升，低利率也会促进消费，美联储将会最大利益的让利给贷款者。 房地产小新闻 斯科茨代尔购物中心以$16.1million的价格出售，该中心的出租率达90%，大部分租户仍然保持。 斯科茨代尔一高尔夫球场附近的房屋卖出了近几个星期最高的价格220万美元。 该房屋占地4381英尺建于2007年。
94d23d2b8cf3f7e61ea331d4e8812185c8a44165.translatedText: The Federal Reserve promised on Tuesday to keep lending rates low for at least two years. The benchmark interest rate will be close to 0 until at least mid-2013. Many people in the real estate industry believe that the Federal Reserve's commitment is great news, allowing home buyers more time to enjoy the loan benefits brought by low interest rates. The Federal Reserve said in a statement on Tuesday that the overall U.S. economy is growing slowly and consumers' spending power has also been reduced. American economists believe this is a double-dip recession. Economic analysts analyzed that the Federal Reserve's decision to keep interest rates low for two years is an unprecedented move. They expect economic growth to pick up moderately in the second half of the year, low interest rates to boost consumption, and the Federal Reserve to maximize benefits to lenders. REAL ESTATE NEWS Scottsdale Mall sold for $16.1 million, the center is 90% occupied with the majority of tenants remaining. A Scottsdale home near a golf course sold for the highest price in recent weeks, $2.2 million. The home is built in 2007 on a 4381 sq. ft. lot.

The punishment measures in it will make everyone laugh: it may be a simulated romantic confession to the sweetheart, or it may be a passionate kiss with the table for 10 seconds... Of course, it is not only the friends who follow the event, but also many businesses who also give strong support to the bachelor party. Various prizes in the event are provided by them, including Xinxin Supermarket vouchers, Red Pot Restaurant sponsorship rights, glamor styling beauty coupons, bicycles provided by the "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese Community Network and August Love Song KTV, super cute bears, USBs, restaurant meal vouchers, etc.

815cac71ae7256db1c429e035f072e21c0aee7d0.sourceText: 侨务委员会2011年海外侨商文化创意(花艺与茶艺)研习班开始报名 侨务委员会为协助海外侨胞学习花艺、荼艺及结合文化创意理念创业，特举办「2011年海外侨商文化创意(花艺与茶艺)研习班」，由实践大学承办，邀请国内知名专家学者教授花茶艺之实务与应用及文化创意微型创业课程。 研习班日期为2011年11 月14日至25日，即日起至本年9 月9 日报名，课程内容包括东方花艺插作与应用、茶艺介绍与品析、花器茶具择选、台湾制茶及擂茶体验、文化创业与营销及实地观摩相关企业。 研习课程之教材、师资及材料等学杂费用由侨务委员会负担，参加学员自付由侨居地往返之机票交通费用、研习期间之膳宿及其他个人费用，有意报名者请洽:橙县华侨文教服务中心(714)754-9999。
815cac71ae7256db1c429e035f072e21c0aee7d0.translatedText: Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission’s 2011 Overseas Chinese Businessmen Cultural Creativity (Flower Art and Tea Art) Workshop has begun registration In order to help overseas Chinese learn flower art, tea art and start businesses based on cultural and creative concepts, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council has organized the "2011 Overseas Chinese Businessmen Cultural Creativity (Floral Art and Tea Art) Workshop", which is hosted by Shih Shih University and invites well-known domestic experts and scholars to teach the practice and application of flower tea art and cultural and creative micro-entrepreneurship courses. The workshop dates are from November 14 to 25, 2011, and registration is open from now until September 9 this year. The course contents include oriental flower arrangement and application, introduction and analysis of tea art, selection of flower utensils and tea sets, Taiwanese tea making and Leicha experience, cultural entrepreneurship and marketing, and on-site observation of related enterprises. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Council will bear the tuition and fees for the study courses, teachers and materials. Participants will have to pay for round-trip air tickets and transportation from their place of residence, as well as board and lodging and other personal expenses during the study period. If you are interested in registering, please contact: Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center (714) 754-9999.

cdd7965a707e285fe2b9ef1957029ddd0eb4c600.sourceText: 第六届世界华文传媒论坛9月在重庆举行 [ 亚省时报] 第六届”世界华文传媒论坛”将于今年9月17日至19日在重庆召开。届时，五大洲约50个国家和地区近400家华文媒体的高层人士、中央主要新闻机构及部分国内各地有影响力的媒体负责人, 共500余人将汇聚这一全球华文媒体的高层峰会。 据了解，此次盛会由国务院侨办、重庆市人民政府和中国新闻社共同主办，论坛届时将呈现四大亮点：一是规模大，邀请的范围 广，参会人数众多；二是传媒类别齐全，报纸、杂志、电台、电视台、网络媒体等一应俱全；三是层次高，与会的均是华文媒的 董事长、总裁、社长、总编等；四是地区分布广泛，世界上有华文媒体的国家和地区均有 代表参会。 本报社长甄硕钦、总主笔少君(特邀代表), 己接获由驻洛杉矶总领事馆转送来的[邀请函], 甄硕钦及家眷由于身体条件原因, 已申报改派副社长甄凯婴赴重庆参加. 在重庆论坛之后海外代表赴各地考察, 广东省侨办特邀亚省时报的参加”海外华媒看广东”的活动。甄硕钦表示, 届时视身体状况才决定行程。
cdd7965a707e285fe2b9ef1957029ddd0eb4c600.translatedText: The 6th World Chinese Media Forum will be held in Chongqing in September [Alberta Times] The 6th "World Chinese Media Forum" will be held in Chongqing from September 17th to 19th this year. By then, more than 500 people, including senior figures from nearly 400 Chinese-language media from about 50 countries and regions on five continents, major central news organizations and some influential media leaders from various parts of the country, will gather at this global high-level summit of Chinese-language media. It is understood that this grand event is co-sponsored by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council, the Chongqing Municipal People's Government and the China News Service. The forum will present four major highlights: First, it is large in scale, with a wide range of invitations and a large number of participants; second, it has a complete range of media categories, including newspapers, magazines, radio stations, TV stations, online media, etc.; third, it is high-level, with all attendees being the chairman, president, president, and editor-in-chief of Chinese-language media; fourth, it is widely distributed in countries and regions with Chinese-language media in the world. Representatives attend the meeting. Our newspaper’s president, Zhen Shuoqin, and chief writer, Shaojun (specially invited representatives), have received [invitation letters] from the Consulate General in Los Angeles. Due to physical reasons, Zhen Shuoqin and his family members have applied to reassign deputy president Zhen Kaiying to Chongqing to participate. After the Chongqing Forum, overseas representatives went to various places to inspect, and the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Guangdong Province specially invited the Alberta Times to participate in the "Overseas Chinese Media Look at Guangdong" event. Zhen Shuoqin said that the itinerary will be decided based on physical condition.

8b3354fe5cdce4993cecfc2239f581381dbab44e.sourceText: 800元飞北京 年底机票超低价 民众消费保守，各大航空公司加强促销，中华、长荣、国航、东方、AA、UA等多家航空公司全面展开价格大战，争夺年底机票市场，今年9月至年底圣诞节期间飞往台北、北京及上海多条航线大特价，800元起跳，1000元成行，云霄飞车式价格，让正值旺季的旅游业跌破眼镜。 每年12月9日至23日是美国全年机票票价尖峰时段，通常从洛杉矶飞台北来回至少1500元，有时甚至高达1800、1900元仍一票难求。不过目前各大航空公司推出的年底价格，纷纷大幅下调。 万象旅游票务经理Wendy王表示，今年到目前为止，几乎所有航空公司洛杉矶前往台北的机票都没有低过1000元。不过不少航空公司最新推出的促销价格，1000元出头就可以出门。比如中华航空本周刚刚推出的廉价机票，票面价为1030元，加税250元，总价1280元。长荣从洛杉矶至台北的含税机票也调降为1395元。 12月24日至1月4日期间的机票将再度下调，长荣和华航票面价都在800元左右，税后双程机票为1060元左右。 旅游业者表示，美国经济持续不景气，让航空公司始料未及。资深业者透露，今年3、4月，各大航空公司一度预计美国经济好转，所以将机票价格提高，至5、6月冲到最高峰，结果吓坏大批民众，许多人能不走就不走，至7、8月暑期开始，航空公司被迫下调机票。 商家表示，与中国大陆和台湾相比，美国今年的出国旅游「逊色很多」。在中国大陆和台湾旅行团、夏令营、游学团潮水般涌进南加州的同时，洛杉矶出国旅游总数保守估计下降20%。 为争夺年底市场，各大航空公司目前各显神通，纷纷降价吸引买气。 除长荣和中华航空之外，中国国际、东方、AA、UA从洛杉矶往返北京和上海的航班价格
8b3354fe5cdce4993cecfc2239f581381dbab44e.translatedText: 800 yuan to fly to Beijing. Air tickets are super low at the end of the year. People's consumption is conservative, and major airlines have stepped up promotions. China, Evergreen, Air China, China Eastern, AA, UA and many other airlines have launched a price war to compete for the year-end air ticket market. From September to the end of the year and Christmas this year, many routes to Taipei, Beijing and Shanghai have special discounts. The starting price is 800 yuan, and the trip is 1,000 yuan. The roller coaster-like prices have shocked the tourism industry during the peak season. Every year, December 9 to 23 is the peak period for air ticket prices in the United States. A round trip from Los Angeles to Taipei usually costs at least 1,500 yuan, and sometimes even as high as 1,800 or 1,900 yuan. It is still difficult to get a ticket. However, the year-end prices launched by major airlines have been significantly reduced. Wendy Wang, Vientiane Tourism Ticketing Manager, said that so far this year, the air tickets from Los Angeles to Taipei on almost all airlines have not been lower than 1,000 yuan. However, many airlines have recently launched promotional prices, and you can go out for just over 1,000 yuan. For example, China Airlines just launched a low-cost ticket this week, with a nominal price of 1,030 yuan, plus tax of 250 yuan, for a total price of 1,280 yuan. Evergreen’s tax-included air ticket from Los Angeles to Taipei has also been reduced to 1,395 yuan. Air tickets from December 24 to January 4 will be reduced again. The face price of EVA and China Airlines tickets is around 800 yuan, and the round-trip ticket after tax is about 1,060 yuan. Travel industry operators said that the continued recession in the U.S. economy has caught airlines by surprise. Senior industry insiders revealed that in March and April this year, major airlines expected the U.S. economy to improve, so they raised air ticket prices, reaching their peak in May and June. As a result, a large number of people were frightened, and many people refused to leave if they could. By the beginning of the summer vacation in July and August, airlines were forced to lower air tickets. Merchants said that compared with mainland China and Taiwan, the United States' overseas travel this year is "much inferior." While tour groups, summer camps, and study tour groups from China and Taiwan are flooding into Southern California, the total number of overseas trips to Los Angeles is conservatively estimated to have dropped by 20%. In order to compete for the end-of-year market, major airlines are currently showing off their unique skills and cutting prices to attract buyers. bade4de7ae189fc455e1fe4bb8e98848c320af5d.sourceText: 台湾“双十”活动精彩 大奖连排（图） （从左到右）邓朝驹 余文劲 尹衍桓 高志中 亚利桑那”精彩一百”十筹备第三次会议于8月4日晚六时在凤凰城康乐大厦举行。侨务咨询顾问余文劲、尹衍桓，大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会（侨联）主席邓朝驹，侨务委员高志中，侨务顾问王玮婷、 李玲麟，侨务促进委员王淑英以及筹备活动的义工们都参加了会议。 筹备会现场 ”精彩一百”台湾双十庆典活动已经基本确定。第一部分是8月14日上午10点在康乐大厦将举办”蒋经国军旅生活图片展”这次图片展由荣光会（台湾海外退役老兵协会）承办。从台湾带来了一百张”两蒋”时期照片，反映出1949年到1970年代，蒋经国参加的各种重要军事活动，也包括了他在金门、妈祖的生活照片。其中，很多图片是第一次向公众展出的，是一次难能可贵的了解历史的好机会。活动当天康乐大厦将举办一个剪彩仪式，活动主办方还准备了100个精美纪念品，送给前去参观的前一百位朋友。 第二个主要活动是9月28日晚6:00，台湾著名中华国乐团将在凤凰城Arcadia High School举办”’璀璨100，乐扬四海”的晚会。乐团一共24人，17人参加演出。所有演出人员都是台湾知名的歌手和表演者。晚会组负责人邱顺雄，接待组王玮婷，酒会组李玲麟 王瑞瑾做了汇报，准备工作都在有条不紊的进行当中。ASU台湾学生会，还会将2011年卡拉OK比赛中成绩最好的两位选手请到现场为晚会做热身表演。他们将现场PK，选出2011年ASU台湾学生卡拉OK比赛的总冠军。晚会还有奖品丰盛的抽奖活动。一等奖是洛杉矶到台北的往返机票，还有DVD家电等多项昂贵礼品。当晚侨务顾问张晴玲率先捐出”汉玉镜框”，”Yes I do”捐出手工量制的旗袍一件。同时圣地亚哥侨委黄莉莉传家康表示赞助精美礼物一件。只要有票的朋友都有机会赢得大奖。 本次演出分为VIP票和普通票。VIP票价$100，VIP观众不仅可以在演出的时候，坐到最好的位置，还可以在演出之前参加一个贵宾小茶会。普通票只需要5元的活动赞助费就可以领取到。活动票正在热销当中，有希望参加活动的朋友可以与以上提到的主办人员购买，也可以发邮件到本网站购买Email： sunbirdarizona@gmail.com 。 特别鸣谢：双十筹备会义工柯琼华给与会人员带来了美味的晚餐，余文劲和义工”余妈妈”带来了可口的甜点。
bade4de7ae189fc455e1fe4bb8e98848c320af5d.translatedText: Taiwan's "Double Ten" activities are wonderful, and the grand prizes are lined up (pictures) (from left to right) Deng Chaoju, Yu Wenjin, Yin Yanhuan, Gao Zhizhong The third Arizona "Wonderful 100" preparatory meeting was held at 6 pm on August 4 at the Recreation Building in Phoenix. Overseas Chinese affairs consultants Yu Wenjin and Yin Yanhuan, Chairman of the Federation of Chinese Overseas Chinese Leagues in Greater Phoenix City (Overseas Chinese Federation) Deng Chaoju, Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee member Gao Zhizhong, Overseas Chinese Affairs consultants Wang Weiting and Li Linglin, Overseas Chinese Affairs Promotion Committee Wang Shuying, and volunteers who prepared the event all attended the meeting. The "Wonderful 100" Taiwan Double Ten celebration activities at the preparatory meeting have been basically confirmed. The first part is the "Chiang Ching-kuo Military Life Photo Exhibition" which will be held at 10 a.m. on August 14th at the Kang Le Building. This photo exhibition is hosted by the Honor Society (Taiwan Overseas Veterans Association). One hundred photos from the "Two Chiangs" period were brought from Taiwan, reflecting the various important military activities Chiang Ching-kuo participated in from 1949 to the 1970s, including photos of his life in Kinmen and Mazu. Among them, many pictures are displayed to the public for the first time, which is a rare and good opportunity to understand history. On the day of the event, a ribbon-cutting ceremony will be held at the Kangle Building. The event organizers have also prepared 100 exquisite souvenirs to give to the first 100 friends who come to visit. The second major event is at 6:00 pm on September 28. Taiwan’s famous Chinese Orchestra will hold the “Brilliant 100, Music Spreading Around the World” party at Arcadia High School in Phoenix. The orchestra has a total of 24 people, and 17 people participated in the performance. All performers are well-known singers and performers in Taiwan. Qiu Shunxiong, the person in charge of the party group, Wang Weiting of the reception group, Li Linglin and Wang Ruijin of the reception group made reports, and the preparations were all in progress. The ASU Taiwan Student Association will also invite the two contestants with the best scores in the 2011 Karaoke Competition to perform warm-up performances for the party. They will compete on the spot to select the overall champion of the 2011 ASU Taiwan Student Karaoke Competition. There will also be a raffle with generous prizes at the party. The first prize is a round-trip air ticket from Los Angeles to Taipei, as well as DVDs and home appliances and many other expensive gifts. Anyone who has a ticket has a chance to win the grand prize. This performance is divided into VIP tickets and ordinary tickets. VIP tickets are $100. d59b7e87f849c7d4e52b04724a666245dbf163ea.sourceText: 受凤凰卫视邀请，凤凰城2011年选美活动主席张华芳、副主席张肇鸿等一行四人，应邀出席观赏第六届《中华小姐环球大赛》美洲赛区的总决赛。 八月五日晚，洛杉矶环球影城希尔顿大酒店内贵宾云集，一同欣赏由北美地区200位参赛选拔出来的16位佳丽再次群芳竞艳总决赛。 佳丽之中不乏毕业于哈佛、哥伦比亚、伯克箂等大学以及国内著名大学的高材生，她们大都高挑美丽，相貌娟好，口齿伶俐。 一番较量之后，由多伦多的郭薇获得冠军，亚军由毕业于北京舞蹈学院的张梦获得，冠、亚军的身高都是5呎10吋，身材骄人，而夺得季军的施凯西是个 芭蕾舞者，曾是中国浙江卫视的节目主持人。 希尔顿大酒店贵宾大厅只可容纳五、六百人，T字型的舞台，震撼的音响，专业的摄制媒体，打造出了一个时尚的选美氛围。 十六位佳丽身穿白色制服，以充满刚阳之气的队列之舞拉开了序幕，继而身穿中国大红色旗袍，配合欢庆的音乐逐一亮相和自我介绍。 在泳装环节中，佳丽穿上豹纹比基尼，野性中又带出了温柔，最后是亮丽的晚礼服装秀。 全程环节紧扣，流水行云，一气呵成，令人印象深刻。 这次中华小姐环球选美大赛有不少值得学习和借鉴的地方，对凤凰城今后的选美活动有着新派和创意的启迪作用。
d59b7e87f849c7d4e52b04724a666245dbf163ea.translatedText: Invited by Phoenix Satellite TV, Phoenix 2011 Beauty Pageant Chairman Zhang Huafang, Vice Chairman Zhang Zhaohong and other four people were invited to attend the finals of the 6th "Miss Chinese Universe Contest" in the Americas. On the evening of August 5th, distinguished guests gathered at the Hilton Hotel in Universal City, Los Angeles, to watch the 16 beauties selected from 200 contestants from North America once again compete in the finals. Among the beauties there are many top students who graduated from Harvard, Columbia, Berkshire and other universities as well as famous universities in China. Most of them are tall, beautiful, good-looking and articulate. After a battle, Guo Wei from Toronto won the championship, and the runner-up was won by Zhang Meng, who graduated from the Beijing Dance Academy. The champion and runner-up are both 5 feet 10 inches tall and have impressive figures. The third runner-up, Shi Kaisi, is a ballet dancer and a former host of China's Zhejiang Satellite TV. The VIP hall of Hilton Hotel can only accommodate five to six hundred people. The T-shaped stage, shocking sound, and professional filming media create a fashionable beauty pageant atmosphere. The sixteen beauties, dressed in white uniforms, kicked off the event with a masculine line dance. Then they wore Chinese red cheongsam and appeared and introduced themselves one by one to the celebratory music. In the swimsuit segment, the contestants put on leopard print bikinis, bringing out the wildness but also gentleness. Finally, there was a bright evening dress show. The whole process is closely linked, flowing and flowing, and it is completed in one go, which is impressive. There are many things worthy of learning and reference from this Miss China Global Pageant, which will inspire new styles and creativity for future beauty pageants in Phoenix.

885f0efb6133c70aa982a27f3122bd9a8cc44f89.sourceText: 课程内容，讲员简介及个人照片 ：
885f0efb6133c70aa982a27f3122bd9a8cc44f89.translatedText: Course content, lecturer profile and personal photos:

f67a0ae54b442f217802eb164562fcac2b6f6a49.sourceText: ”小学语文教学法” 杜朝晖，华中师大附小高级教师. 武汉市优秀青年教师。人民教育出版社义务教育课程实验教科书培训教师。国家课程标准版湘教版小学语文教科书编委。 在《小学语文教学》《小学语文教师》《小学语文教学论坛》等中文核心期刊发表教学论文三十多篇。
f67a0ae54b442f217802eb164562fcac2b6f6a49.translatedText: "Primary School Chinese Teaching Method" Du Zhaohui, senior teacher at the Primary School Affiliated to Central China Normal University. Outstanding young teacher in Wuhan. People's Education Press trains teachers on experimental textbooks for compulsory education courses. Editorial board member of the National Curriculum Standard Edition and the Hunan Education Edition primary school Chinese textbook. He has published more than 30 teaching papers in core Chinese journals such as "Primary School Chinese Teaching", "Primary School Chinese Teacher", and "Primary School Chinese Teaching Forum".

6bfe5bfd410e480949733d5596870d9b36578eb2.sourceText: ”中国文化专题 – 中华文化与其它文化的交流”王晓路，四川大学教授. 文学博士，四川大学文学与新闻学院、外语学院教授，博士生导师；海外教育学院教授委员会主任。享受国务院政府特殊津贴，四川省学术带头人，获四川省教学名师、全国模范教师称号。
6bfe5bfd410e480949733d5596870d9b36578eb2.translatedText: "Chinese Culture Special Topic - Exchanges between Chinese Culture and Other Cultures" Wang Xiaolu, professor at Sichuan University. Doctor of Literature, professor at the School of Literature and Journalism and School of Foreign Languages, Sichuan University, doctoral supervisor; director of the Professor Committee of the Overseas Education School. Enjoys special government allowances from the State Council, is an academic leader in Sichuan Province, and has been awarded the title of Sichuan Provincial Famous Teacher and National Model Teacher.

86cb337104d99f167bf798a6e21a5e372355bb8b.sourceText: ”手工制作（剪纸、中国结）” 李明，济南市市中区教育局教研室高级教师. 中学高级教师、美术教研员，山东省青年书法家协会会员。专长油画、雕塑、书法、篆刻，热爱传统文化，广泛涉猎民间美术，擅长手工制作。从事教师工作21年，研究美术教育，深刻认识美术教育的文化内涵和美术活动对人的审美素养和智慧开发具有重要作用，多年以来，指导中、小学美术教师的教育教学工作，致力于美术教育深层开发。
86cb337104d99f167bf798a6e21a5e372355bb8b.translatedText: "Handmade (paper-cut, Chinese knot)" Li Ming, senior teacher in the Teaching and Research Section of Jinan Shizhong District Education Bureau. Senior middle school teacher, art teaching and researcher, member of Shandong Young Calligraphers Association. Specializing in oil painting, sculpture, calligraphy, and seal cutting, he loves traditional culture, extensively dabbles in folk art, and is good at handcrafting. I have been working as a teacher for 21 years. I have studied art education and have a deep understanding of the cultural connotation of art education and the important role that art activities play in people's aesthetic literacy and intellectual development. For many years, I have guided the education and teaching work of art teachers in primary and secondary schools, and are committed to the in-depth development of art education.

2526bb23fd2c952b1573efcfceedd98533284f5b.sourceText: 侨务委员会「2011年海外侨商文化创意(花艺与茶艺)研习班」开始报名 侨务委员会为协助海外侨胞学习花艺、荼艺及结合文化创意理念创业，特举办「2011年海外侨商文化创意(花艺与茶艺)研习班」，由实践大学承办，邀请国内知名专家学者教授花茶艺之实务与应用及文化创意微型创业课程。 研习班日期为2011年11 月14日至25日，即日起至本年9 月9 日报名，课程内容包括东方花艺插作与应用、茶艺介绍与品析、花器茶具择选、台湾制茶及擂茶体验、文化创业与营销及实地观摩相关企业。 研习课程之教材、师资及材料等学杂费用由侨务委员会负担，参加学员自付由侨居地往返之机票交通费用、研习期间之膳宿及其他个人费用，有意报名者请洽:橙县华侨文教服务中心(714)754-9999。
2526bb23fd2c952b1573efcfceedd98533284f5b.translatedText: The Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission's "2011 Overseas Chinese Businessmen's Cultural Creativity (Floral Art and Tea Art) Workshop" has started to register. In order to help overseas Chinese learn floral art, tea art and start businesses based on cultural and creative concepts, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council has specially organized the "2011 Overseas Chinese Businessmen's Cultural Creativity (Floral Art and Tea Art) Workshop". It is hosted by Shih Shih University and invites well-known domestic experts and scholars to teach the practice and application of floral tea art and cultural and creative micro-entrepreneurship courses. The workshop dates are from November 14 to 25, 2011, and registration is open from now until September 9 this year. The course contents include oriental flower arrangement and application, introduction and analysis of tea art, selection of flower utensils and tea sets, Taiwanese tea making and Leicha experience, cultural entrepreneurship and marketing, and on-site observation of related enterprises. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Council will bear the tuition and fees for the study courses, teachers and materials. Participants will have to pay for round-trip air tickets and transportation from their place of residence, as well as board and lodging and other personal expenses during the study period. If you are interested in registering, please contact: Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center (714) 754-9999.

c9abf487d517a84d643658b13de5c7e197f8355a.sourceText: 劳工移民排期 2011年8 月份美国劳工移民 排期 优先排期 第一优先 全世界,有名额. 中国大陆:有名额 第二优先 全世界,有名额. 中国大陆: 04/15/2007 第三优先 全世界,11/01/2005. 中国大陆: 07/08/2004 第四优先 全世界,有名额. 中国大陆:有名额 第五优先 全世界,有名额. 中国大陆:有名额 全世界不包印度,墨西哥,菲律宾 注： 第一优先为杰出人才，跨国公司主管，优秀研究人员和教授等； 第二优先为拥有硕士或以上高学位人士或特殊人才等； 第三优先为有技能工人，专业人士和其它工人； 第四优先为一些特殊移民； 第五优先为投资移民和工作机会创造者。 2011年8 月份美国 亲属 移民 排期 优先排期 第一优先 全世界,05/01/2004 中国大陆:05/01/2004 第二优先A 全世界,07/22/2008. 中国大陆:07/22/2008 第二优先B 全世界,07/1/2003. 中国大陆:07/1/2003 第三优先 全世界,08/22/2001. 中国大陆:08/22/2001 第四优先 全世界,04/08/2000. 中国大陆:04/08/2000 全世界不包印度,墨西哥,菲律宾 注： 第一优先为美国公民之未婚子女； 第二A优先为美国永久居民之配偶与子女； 第二B优先为美国永久居民之21岁以上未婚子女； 第三优先为美国公民之已婚子女； 第四优先为美国公民之兄弟姐妹。 我有一个朋友在2006年辨了绿卡来美国，当时已有65岁，不懂英文，因此找不到好工作，只能做临时工，不但工资少，而且收入不稳定。不过勉强能生活下去，还交了税(自雇社安税)，至今已经缴了5年，共获得20个工点。请问﹕这20个工点有没有用？将来有没有效？如果无用的话，那么他要办些什么手续才能证明有效？缴了自雇税后可以申请什么福利吗？如果缴交了自雇税得到的工点没有任何用处，可否申请退税？ 答﹕ 一般来说，你的朋友只有获得40个工作点后，他在退休后才能获得政府发给他与他家人的社安退休金 (Social Security Payment)。他的退税率与他累积的工作点没有关系。一个人每年的退税率是根据他当年所得来决定的。如果他在储满40点之前不能再工作了，他可以申请老人福利，如社会福利金 (SSI)、粮食券(Food Stamp)及老人住房补贴(Section 8)等政府补助，但政府不会因为他过去曾交过税而主动退税给他。

Note: First priority is for outstanding talents, executives of multinational companies, outstanding researchers and professors, etc.; The second priority is for people with a master's degree or above or special talents; the third priority is for skilled workers, professionals and other workers; the fourth priority is for some special immigrants; the fifth priority is for investment immigrants and job creators. Mainland China: 07/22/2008 Second Priority B Worldwide, 07/1/2003. Mainland China: 07/1/2003 Third Priority Worldwide, 08/22/2001. Mainland China: 08/22/2001 Fourth priority Worldwide, 04/08/2000. Mainland China: 04/08/2000 Worldwide excluding India, Mexico, and the Philippines Note: First priority is the unmarried children of U.S. citizens; Second A priority is the spouse and children of U.S. permanent residents; Second B priority is the unmarried children of U.S. permanent residents over 21 years old; Third priority is the married children of U.S. citizens; Fourth preference is given to brothers and sisters who are U.S. citizens. A friend of mine obtained a green card and came to the United States in 2006. He was 65 years old at the time and did not understand English. Therefore, he could not find a good job and could only work as a temporary worker. Not only was the salary low, but his income was unstable. But I can barely live on, and I still pay taxes (self-employment social security taxes). I have paid them for 5 years now, and have received a total of 20 work points. I would like to ask: Are these 20 work points useful? Will it be effective in the future? If it is useless, what procedures does he have to go through to prove it is effective? Can I apply for any benefits after paying self-employment tax? If the work points obtained after paying self-employment tax are of no use, can I apply for a tax refund? Answer: Generally speaking, your friend can only receive the Social Security Payment (Social Security Payment) from the government to him and his family after retirement after he has obtained 40 working points. His tax refund rate has no bearing on the work points he accrues. A person's annual tax refund rate is determined based on his income that year. If he can no longer work before his savings reaches 40 points, he can apply for elderly benefits, such as Social Security Income (SSI), Food Stamps (Food Stamp), Senior Housing Subsidy (Section 8) and other government subsidies, but the government will not actively refund him because he has paid taxes in the past.

69078897d8a51a214845acaad99b703d38710c82.sourceText: 耆英會主席崔先生給華人社區的一封信 崔增祁 我1999年參加鳳凰城華人耆英會，迄今已12年。這裡的老人們愉快地生活在一起，用同樣的語言，交流着人生經歷，探討和學習在美國的新生活，學英語，申辦醫療和福利。他們互相關愛，互相幫助，唱歌跳舞，打麻將下象棋，練氣功打乒乓，學英語練書法，有時還組織短期旅遊，盡享無憂無慮的金色晚年。耆英會是老人們的歡樂家園。 每當我們享受這些幸福時，總會飲水思源，想到老華僑們為創辦耆英會曾付出的艱辛努力。我十分敬佩老華僑們的團結奉獻精神，他們團結一心，有錢出錢，有力出力，建起了耆英會會所。在耆英會會所的牆壁上，至今仍懸掛著1982年和1995-1997年新建和擴建耆英會會所捐贈現金和實物的芳名錄。這些老華僑為耆英會留下了寶貴的物質財富和精神財富。 自從我擔任耆英會主席以來，有一個問題一直在我的腦海中思考着。耆英會是政府批准的非營利團體，是一個老年人的弱勢群體，需要得到社會各界不斷的廣泛贊助和支持。過去，許多從事餐館業和雜貨業的老華僑，是捐贈的主力。依照俗成，逢婚喪嫁娶或生日，他們也有捐贈，表達對老年人的關愛。他們的捐贈也可以得到政府相應的免稅優惠。近年來，華僑的組成已發生了很大的變化，耆英會的成員也隨之發生着變化。許多新華僑的父母來到了耆英會，他們的子女在美國的大型公司或政府任職，或從事高科技，醫師，律師，教師等職業。他們中間有的也通過做義工或通過United Way，AmericanExpress Gift Program, Discover Financial Serve,Trust Distrubution等給各種渠道提供贊助，但對耆英會卻了解不多。我希望通過網絡聯通新僑和耆英會的渠道，希望耆英會能得到新僑們更多的關心和幫助。 我們有許多事情要想去做，例如，給老人們增加幾台上網的電腦，換一台數字化的大電視，改善音響系統，利用太陽能技術節省電費，以及和年輕人一起辦些交誼活動等。我不太懂得對你們來說，用什麼方式幫助我們最好，怎樣才能使我們聯繫起來。有了太陽鳥亞省華人社區網，給我們提供了交流的條件。我想提出我的想法，希望大家能通過討論，探討出更多的切實可行的幫助和關愛耆英會的途徑。請在社區網發表您的意見或Email給華人耆英會郵箱： CPCSCA@yahoo.com
69078897d8a51a214845acaad99b703d38710c82.translatedText: >A letter from Mr. Cui, chairman of the Senior Citizens Association, to the Chinese community Cui Zengqi I joined the Phoenix Chinese Senior Citizens Association in 1999 and it has been 12 years now. The old people here live happily together, using the same language, exchanging life experiences, discussing and learning about their new life in the United States, learning English, and applying for medical care and welfare. They love each other, help each other, sing and dance, play mahjong and chess, practice qigong and table tennis, learn English and practice calligraphy, and sometimes organize short-term trips to enjoy a carefree golden old age. The Senior Citizen Club is a happy home for the elderly. Whenever we enjoy these blessings, we always drink water and think about the source, and think of the hard work that the old overseas Chinese have put in to establish the Senior Citizens Association. I greatly admire the spirit of unity and dedication of the old overseas Chinese. They united as one, contributed money and efforts when they had the money, and built the Senior Citizens Club. On the wall of the Senior Citizen Club, there are still hanging lists of cash and in-kind donations for the new and expanded Senior Citizen Club in 1982 and 1995-1997. These old overseas Chinese have left precious material and spiritual wealth to the Senior Citizens Association. There is a question that has been on my mind since I became Chairman of the Senior Citizens Association. The Senior Citizens Association is a non-profit organization approved by the government. It is a vulnerable group of the elderly and needs continuous and extensive sponsorship and support from all walks of life. In the past, many old overseas Chinese working in the restaurant and grocery industries were the main contributors to donations. According to custom, they also make donations during weddings, funerals or birthdays to express their care for the elderly. Their donations can also receive corresponding tax exemptions from the government. In recent years, the composition of overseas Chinese has undergone great changes, and the members of the Senior Citizens Association have also changed accordingly. Many parents of new overseas Chinese came to the Senior Citizens Association, and their children worked in large companies or governments in the United States, or were engaged in high technology, doctors, lawyers, teachers and other professions. Some of them also provide sponsorship through various channels through volunteer work or through United Way, AmericanExpress Gift Program, Discover Financial Serve, Trust Distrubution, etc., but they don’t know much about the Senior Citizens Association. I hope to connect the New Overseas Chinese and the Senior Citizen Association through the Internet, and hope that the Senior Citizen Association can get more care and help from the New Overseas Chinese. We have many things we want to do, such as adding a few computers with Internet access for the elderly, replacing them with a large digital TV, improving the sound system, using solar energy technology to save electricity bills, and organizing some social activities with young people. I don't quite understand what's the best way for you to help us, how to connect us. The Sunbird Alberta Chinese Community Network provides us with the conditions for communication. I would like to put forward my ideas and hope that through discussion, everyone can explore more practical ways to help and care for the Elderly Association. Please express your opinions on the community website or email the Chinese Senior Citizens Association: CPCSCA@yahoo.com
