2892f4293f7602759f3c13eab54d6547610d0759.sourceText: 治粤八年南天王—传奇人物陈济棠 余玉书 （六）失先机满盘皆落索（下） 一九三六年一月胡汉民自欧洲归来，但见国事蜩螗未见起色，忧愤交集，无以自遣。五月九日饭后与友人对奕，先胜后负，突然右侧脑溢血，延至十二日逝世。 陈济棠眼见较自己资格老的党国元老：胡汉民病逝；汪精卫与蒋介石重拾旧欢，跑到南京去当行政院长；许崇智拿了他的二十万大洋准备到福建去号召旧部，不料长子在上海被亲蒋的帮会中人绑票，只好将活动费拿去做赎金，从此不问政事，于是在幕僚怂恿下又跃跃欲试，意图问鼎中原。不过他为人谨慎，先派其兄陈维周前往南京谒蒋试探口风，蒋要其转告陈不要与桂系李白过份接近，陈当然明白这是离间之计。遂全力说服李宗仁，两广采取联合行动，共组”抗日救国军”准备北伐反蒋。 可是陈是一个迷信风水及占卜的人，相信是受了陈维周的影响，据说不惜代价将花县芙蓉嶂太平天国洪秀全的祖坟掘开，移入其母骨，想藉风水的神秘力量而称王天下。在出兵伐蒋之前，曾向广州某著名术士问卜，求得一签为”机不可失”，认为天赐良机，立即下令出兵。六月十一日陈、李、白联合致电蒋，公开表示其抗日反蒋救国的态度。可是老谋深算，擅长策动分化，不战而屈人之兵的老蒋，不动声色，即将尚未交战的”抗日救国军”瓦解于无声无色之中。 原本陈除了十五万陆军之外，还拥有一支配有新式欧美战机的航空队；这批粤籍驾驶员大部份是当年由杨仙逸、林森自美洲招聘回来的以航空报国的爱国青年，其中包括恩平籍的岑泽流、陈庆云、林伟成、张惠长和黄光锐等。七月初黄光锐与队友黄志刚、黄居谷、胡佐龙等借练习飞行为名，直飞南昌投奔中央。 同一时间陈的大将已贵为军长的余汉谋及李汉魂，突然阵前起义，通电拥护中央。广西李、白势孤，九月二人分别接受了中央的任命，分别就任广西绥靖主任及军事委员会常务委员。陈眼见大势已去，急走香港暂避，未几化装只身乘轮返回湛江。陈个子矮小，本来不起眼，但仍被船上一名管事认出，幸而此人是其以前手下的排长，对他说：”总司令不必担心，一切有我”。果然安全返抵防城老家，后来老蒋也没有为难他，还给了他一笔钱到欧洲考察，这也是老蒋对付政敌的一贯手法。 一九五〇年十二月陈再度被蒋起用为海南岛行政长官，共军林彪”四野”两个师千帆并举，渡海来袭，他的第十子陈树柏上尉亲率警备连一百五十名新兵拼死力战，掩护陈安全登上专机从海口机场前往台湾。一九五四年十一月三日病逝台北。 亚省时报
2892f4293f7602759f3c13eab54d6547610d0759.translatedText: The Southern King of Guangdong for eight years - the legendary Chen Jitang and Yu Yushu (6) Losing the opportunity and losing everything (Part 2) Hu Hanmin returned from Europe in January 1936, but saw that the state affairs had not improved, and he was filled with worry and anger, unable to relieve himself. After dinner on May 9th, I played against Yi with my friends. We won first and then lost. Suddenly, he suffered a cerebral hemorrhage on his right side and his death was delayed until the 12th. Chen Jitang saw party and state elders who were older than him: Hu Hanmin died of illness; Wang Jingwei regained his old love with Chiang Kai-shek and ran to Nanjing to become the executive president; Xu Chongzhi took his 200,000 yuan and prepared to go to Fujian He went to summon his old subordinates, but unexpectedly his eldest son was kidnapped by a gang member close to Chiang Kai-shek in Shanghai. He had to use the activity fees as a ransom and never got involved in political affairs. So, encouraged by his staff, he was eager to try again, intending to aspire to the Central Plains. However, he was cautious and first sent his brother Chen Weizhou to Nanjing to visit Chiang to test his tone. Chiang asked him to tell Chen not to get too close to Li Bai of the Guangxi faction. Of course Chen understood that this was a estrangement plan. So he tried his best to persuade Li Zongren, and Guangdong and Guangxi took joint actions to form the "Anti-Japanese National Salvation Army" to prepare for the Northern Expedition against Chiang Kai-shek. However, Chen was a superstitious person of Feng Shui and divination. It is believed that he was influenced by Chen Weizhou. It is said that he dug up the ancestral grave of Hong Xiuquan of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom in Furongzhang, Huaxian County at all costs, and moved his mother's bones into it, hoping to use the mysterious power of Feng Shui to rule the world. Before sending troops to attack Chiang Kai-shek, he asked a famous magician in Guangzhou for divination and got a fortune teller saying "opportunity cannot be missed". He thought it was a God-given opportunity and immediately ordered the dispatch of troops. On June 11, Chen, Li, and Bai jointly called Chiang and publicly stated their attitude of resisting Japan and Chiang to save the country. However, Chiang Kai-shek, who was wily and scheming, good at instigating divisions and subjugating troops without fighting, quietly disintegrated the "Anti-Japanese National Salvation Army" that had not yet engaged in battle. Originally, in addition to an army of 150,000 soldiers, Chen also had an aviation fleet equipped with new European and American fighters. Most of these Cantonese pilots were patriotic young men recruited from the Americas by Yang Xianyi and Lin Sen to serve the country with aviation. They included Cen Zeliu, Chen Qingyun, Lin Weicheng, Zhang Huichang and Huang Guangrui from Enping. In early July, Huang Guangrui and his teammates Huang Zhigang, Huang Jugu, Hu Zuolong and others flew directly to Nanchang to defect to the Central Committee in the name of practicing flying. At the same time, Chen's generals Yu Hanmou and Li Hanhun, who had become army commanders, suddenly revolted in front of the battle line and energized the Central Committee. Guangxi Li and Bai Shigu respectively accepted appointments from the central government in September and took office as Director of Guangxi Appeasement and Standing Committee Member of the Military Commission respectively. Seeing that the situation was over, Chen hurried to Hong Kong for temporary refuge. Soon he disguised himself and took a boat back to Zhanjiang. Chen was short and inconspicuous, but he was still recognized by a steward on the ship. Fortunately, this person was his former platoon leader, who said to him: "Commander-in-Chief, don't worry, I have everything under control." Sure enough, he returned to his hometown in Fangcheng safely. Later, Chiang Kai-shek did not embarrass him and gave him a sum of money to study in Europe. This was also Chiang Kai-shek's usual method of dealing with political opponents. In December 1950, Chen was once again appointed Chief Executive of Hainan Island by Chiang Kai-shek. Lin Biao's "Four Fields" divisions of the Communist Army crossed the sea and attacked. His tenth son, Captain Chen Shubai, personally led a security company of 150 recruits to fight desperately to cover Chen's safe boarding of a special plane from Haikou Airport to Taiwan. He died of illness in Taipei on November 3, 1954. alberta times

063bdd778f676fbe0ca34bf9348d78ee2bf3a266.sourceText: 轮椅大盗抢银行 劫走7万美元 据警方消息，7月28日，一位坐在轮椅上的劫匪进入银行，持枪劫走了7万美元。目前警方正在搜捕这名用轮椅作为伪装的持枪歹徒。 据悉，这家位于凤凰城的AmTrust银行的闭路电视已经拍下了歹徒进入室内的画面。顾客离开后，劫匪用枪指着出纳员索取现金。出纳员被迫取出现金，然后歹徒将钱放入一个疑似笔记本计算机包的袋子。之后，劫匪离开轮椅，逃离银行，消失于录像画面中。”他让妇女们用胶布缠住男雇员的双手。”凤凰城警察局局长汤米汤普森说。警方透露，现场目击者说劫匪可能进入一辆新的红色福特Taurus模型车，然后驾车逃离。他身着一件细条纹长袖衬衣，头戴一顶黄褐色镶有红蓝条纹的软毡帽，下身是牛仔裤和黑色的靴子。嫌疑犯被描述成一名西班牙裔男子，身高大约在5英尺7英寸（约1.70米）至5英尺9英寸（约1.75米）之间，体型较瘦，大约重180磅（约81.6公斤），年龄在25-35之间。
063bdd778f676fbe0ca34bf9348d78ee2bf3a266.translatedText: Wheelchair robber robs bank and steals US$70,000 According to police sources, on July 28, a robber in a wheelchair entered the bank and took away US$70,000 at gunpoint. Police are currently searching for the gunman who used a wheelchair as a disguise. It is reported that the CCTV footage of the AmTrust Bank in Phoenix captured the criminals entering the room. After the customer left, the robber held the teller at gunpoint and demanded cash. The teller was forced to withdraw the cash, which was then placed into a bag that appeared to be a laptop bag. Afterwards, the robber got out of the wheelchair, fled the bank, and disappeared from the video. "He had the women wrap duct tape around the hands of the male employees," Phoenix Police Chief Tommy Thompson said. Police revealed that witnesses at the scene said the robbers may have entered a new red Ford Taurus model car and then drove away. He was wearing a pinstriped long-sleeved shirt, a tan soft felt hat with red and blue stripes on his head, jeans and black boots. The suspect is described as a Hispanic man, approximately 5 feet 7 inches (approximately 1.70 meters) to 5 feet 9 inches (approximately 1.75 meters) tall, with a slim build, approximately 180 pounds (approximately 81.6 kilograms), and between 25-35 years old.

943e1b099a1cc307c87896f600ea6bc6ec81dbfd.sourceText: 1996年第五十三届威尼斯电影节，诞生了史上最年轻的影后，也是整个世界电影史上的最年轻的影后。她就是年仅4岁的小演员维克托埃尔-基维索尔，她在《小孤星：波奈特》(ponette)中的精彩表演，折服评委，拿下最佳女主角奖项。
943e1b099a1cc307c87896f600ea6bc6ec81dbfd.translatedText: In 1996, at the 53rd Venice Film Festival, the youngest actress in history was born, and she was also the youngest actress in the entire world film history. She is the 4-year-old actor Victor El-Kivesol. Her wonderful performance in "Ponette" impressed the judges and won the Best Actress award.

269d1d3b5f4559a17f8ff51feb3689aefc6afb73.sourceText: 李小璐影后头衔：金马奖影后得奖芳龄：17岁现今的李小璐是内地人气很旺的女演员，她低调不张扬甚少有绯闻，而且工作努力又涉足歌坛，是一位非常难得的女艺人。
269d1d3b5f4559a17f8ff51feb3689aefc6afb73.translatedText: Li Xiaolu’s title as Best Actress: Golden Horse Award-winning Best Actress. Age: 17 years old. Today, Li Xiaolu is a very popular actress in the Mainland. She is low-key and unassuming with few scandals. She works hard and is involved in the music industry. She is a very rare female artist.

114e490e3daeb1d90721133e5b86eabb709676fe.sourceText: 对于她的演技实力，出生于1982年的她，2岁开始演戏，累积了较多的表演经验，终于在1998年凭借《天苑获得?#31532;35届台湾金马奖?#26368;佳女主角，也是金马奖史上最年轻的影后。另外，李小璐还凭借《天苑获得过?#27861;国水城首届亚洲电影节?#26368;佳女演员。
114e490e3daeb1d90721133e5b86eabb709676fe.translatedText: Regarding her acting skills, she was born in 1982. She started acting at the age of 2 and accumulated a lot of acting experience. Finally, in 1998, she won the Best Actress at the 35th Taiwan Golden Horse Awards for "Tian Yuan" and was the youngest Best Actress in the history of the Golden Horse Awards. In addition, Li Xiaolu also won the best actress at the first Asian Film Festival in Guoshuicheng for "Tian Yuan".

dcddbe9cf8ea2bf2ea4ee638fa67742a93c3bac0.sourceText: 林碧琪影后头衔：金像奖影后得奖芳龄：17岁
dcddbe9cf8ea2bf2ea4ee638fa67742a93c3bac0.translatedText: Queen Lam's title: Academy Award for Best Actress, age: 17 years old

97cf437e154ec7780aa27134951ce16e6fb36152.sourceText: 她是第二届香港金像奖最佳女主角得主，也是最年轻的影后，获奖时年仅17岁，同时又是一生只有一部戏的超实力派演员。
97cf437e154ec7780aa27134951ce16e6fb36152.translatedText: She is the Best Actress winner at the 2nd Hong Kong Film Awards, and is also the youngest actress. She was only 17 years old when she won the award, and she is also a super-powerful actor who only has one movie in her life.

48db35629b0cf972f997217658f7fe0c71daf16f.sourceText: 郭柯宇影后头衔：百花奖、上海国际、平壤国际影后得奖芳龄：17岁
48db35629b0cf972f997217658f7fe0c71daf16f.translatedText: >Guo Keyu Best Actress Title: Hundred Flowers Award, Shanghai International, Pyongyang International Best Actress Award-winning age: 17 years old

34e333befaef8000ef9d1771fcb39c66d76129ac.sourceText: 内地首位最年轻的影后是郭柯宇，相信很多人会对她的名字感到陌生，但是她却是一名非常有实力的演员。17岁时因在电影《红樱桃》中扮演楚楚，夺得了百花奖?#26368;佳女演员?#31216;号。除了百花奖，她还曾在1995年因电影《红樱桃》荣获上海国际电影节女演员、1997年因电影《红樱桃》荣获平壤国际电影节最佳女演员。
34e333befaef8000ef9d1771fcb39c66d76129ac.translatedText: The first and youngest Best Actress in Mainland China is Guo Keyu. I believe many people will be unfamiliar with her name, but she is a very capable actor. At the age of 17, she won the Hundred Flowers Award for Best Actress for her role as Chu Chu in the movie "Red Cherry". In addition to the Hundred Flowers Award, she also won the Best Actress at the Shanghai International Film Festival in 1995 for the movie "Red Cherry" and the Best Actress at the Pyongyang International Film Festival in 1997 for the movie "Red Cherry".

dc3681a6579239f2123be987d992ec74f0b7f26b.sourceText: 梁洛施影后头衔：葡萄牙国际影后得奖芳龄：18岁
dc3681a6579239f2123be987d992ec74f0b7f26b.translatedText: Liang Luo Shi's title as the best actress: Portuguese International Best Actress Award-winning age: 18 years old

3df19e72c6c4c8f9859807a7e78d427c260a1654.sourceText: 梁洛施现在的身份是一位妈妈，而她之前闯荡娱乐圈还有一个最重要的成绩，这个成绩不是参演好莱坞电影《木乃伊3》，也不是玉女形象，而是她获得的2006年第27届葡萄牙国际电影节最佳女主角。因为在电影《伊莎贝拉》的精彩表演，出生于1988年的梁洛施，18岁摘下国际影后桂冠。
3df19e72c6c4c8f9859807a7e78d427c260a1654.translatedText: Liang Luo Shi is now a mother, and her previous career in the entertainment industry had one of the most important achievements. This achievement was not her participation in the Hollywood movie "The Mummy 3" or her image as a pretty girl, but the Best Actress she won at the 27th Portuguese International Film Festival in 2006. Because of her wonderful performance in the movie "Isabella", Liang Luoshi, who was born in 1988, won the International Best Actress crown at the age of 18.

afdf386ba941b4c5f303e55e481b782749504178.sourceText: 陈秋霞影后头衔：金马奖影后得奖芳龄：19岁
afdf386ba941b4c5f303e55e481b782749504178.translatedText: >Chen Qiuxia Best Actress Title: Golden Horse Award-winning Best Actress Age: 19 years old

a57b29b27e91a0df5b1a63a6511e67eb28149b11.sourceText: 对于很多人来说，陈秋霞的名字或许比较陌生，但是搜索一下她却发现她可是曾经的当红女明星。她是七十年代少见的香港女创作歌手，曾得过流行歌曲创作邀请赛冠军，也为不少歌手写过歌曲。除了音乐，当年陈秋霞也是影歌双栖的玉女掌门人，当年她凭借电影《秋霞》成为第十四届台湾电影金马奖的最佳女主角，芳龄19岁。
a57b29b27e91a0df5b1a63a6511e67eb28149b11.translatedText: >Chen Qiuxia's name may be unfamiliar to many people, but a search for her revealed that she was once a popular female star. She was a rare Hong Kong female singer-songwriter in the 1970s. She once won the popular song composition invitational competition and wrote songs for many singers. In addition to music, Chen Qiuxia was also the head of the beautiful girl who lived both in film and music. She won the Best Actress at the 14th Taiwan Golden Horse Film Awards for her movie "Qiuxia" at the age of 19.

f588c8dd57aa44053c6f842e8d26d367a5f9b37a.sourceText: 杨红卫（资料图） 据新华社电中共云南省委常委会2日决定，对楚雄彝族自治州原州长杨红卫、云南省地方税务局原局长王南昆、省住房和城乡建设厅原副厅长陈锡诚给予开除党籍处分，对涉嫌违法犯罪问题移送司法机关依法处理。 经查，杨红卫的主要违纪事实有：一、2006年至2011年，杨红卫在担任楚雄州委副书记、州长期间，先后收受贿赂人民币1011.09万元、美元13.8万元、港币3万元、澳元3万元、贵重物品折合人民币95.98万元；二、巨额财产来源不明，经查，杨红卫、余赛英夫妇在昆明、个旧、弥勒、建水、大理有房产17套，在澳大利亚墨尔本有房产6套；三、在姚安县地震恢复重建工作中失职，对灾后重建房屋质量问题负有重要领导责任，对云南德胜钢铁有限公司技改项目违规、土地使用违法问题负主要领导责任；四、妨害社会管理秩序，吸食毒品；五、违反社会主义道德，与多名女性发生不正当两性关系；六、违反廉洁自律规定，收受礼金人民币35万元。王南昆的主要违纪事实有：1995年12月至2010年10月，王南昆在任德宏州委副书记、书记和省地税局党组书记、局长期间，先后收受贿赂价值人民币476万元的房产三套（栋）和现金人民币20万元；违反廉洁自律规定，收受礼金人民币254万元及榧木桌椅、红豆杉根雕坐椅、檀香木观音雕像等贵重物品，使用超标车辆。 陈锡诚的主要违纪事实有：一、1999年至2011年，陈锡诚在担任省住建厅党组成员、副厅长期间，先后收受贿赂人民币108.5万元、港元2万元、价值1.3万元的欧米茄男式手表一只；二、贪污公款人民币16.98万元；三、在云南省城乡建设综合开发公司改制和保障性住房、流动人口出租房、花果山安居工程等项目中不能正确履行职责，工作失职，造成重大经济损失；四、违反廉洁自律规定，收受礼金人民币90万元，购买使用超标车；五、违反财经纪律，滥发钱物，陈锡诚本人以各种名义领取钱物价值共计人民币30万元；六、妨害社会管理秩序，参与赌博。 云南楚雄原州长杨红卫曾边开会边吸毒 2011年4月27日晚，云南楚雄州政府的书记办公会现场，正主持会议的州委副书记、州长杨红卫被突然到来的云南省纪委宣布”双规”5月1日，云南省纪委、省监察厅通过媒体向外界披露，杨红卫任职楚雄州州委副书记、州长期间，涉嫌违反组织纪律、失职渎职、吸食毒品、收受他人巨额贿赂等严重违纪违法问题。 其中尤以吸毒最引人关注。消息惊爆网络后，作为目前所知落马厅级官员中涉嫌吸毒的第一人，杨红卫很快被冠以”吸毒州长”名号。
f588c8dd57aa44053c6f842e8d26d367a5f9b37a.translatedText: Yang Hongwei (data picture) According to Xinhua News Agency, the Standing Committee of the Yunnan Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China decided on the 2nd to expel Yang Hongwei, the former governor of Chuxiong Yi Autonomous Prefecture, Wang Nankun, the former director of the Yunnan Provincial Local Taxation Bureau, and Chen Xicheng, the former deputy director of the Provincial Department of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, and transfer suspected illegal and criminal issues to the judicial authorities for handling in accordance with the law. After investigation, the main disciplinary violations committed by Yang Hongwei are as follows: 1. From 2006 to 2011, when Yang Hongwei served as deputy secretary of the Chuxiong Prefecture Party Committee and governor, he successively accepted bribes of RMB 10.1109 million and US$138,000. , Hong Kong dollars 30,000, Australian dollars 30,000, valuables equivalent to RMB 959,800; 2. The source of the huge property is unknown. After investigation, Yang Hongwei and Yu Saiying owned 17 properties in Kunming, Gejiu, Maitreya, Jianshui, and Dali. There are 6 houses in Melbourne, Australia; 3. Neglect of duty during the earthquake recovery and reconstruction work in Yao'an County, and he has important leadership responsibility for the quality of the houses reconstructed after the disaster, and has the main leadership responsibility for Yunnan Desheng Iron and Steel Co., Ltd.'s technical transformation project violations and illegal land use; 4. Obstructing social management order and taking drugs; 5. Violating socialist ethics and having improper sexual relations with multiple women; 6. Violating integrity and self-discipline regulations by accepting gifts of RMB 350,000. Wang Nankun’s main disciplinary violations include: From December 1995 to October 2010, while serving as deputy secretary and secretary of the Dehong Prefecture Party Committee and secretary and director of the Party Leadership Group of the Provincial Local Taxation Bureau, Wang Nankun accepted bribes worth RMB 4.76 million. Three houses (buildings) worth RMB 200,000 in cash and RMB 200,000 in cash; in violation of the integrity and self-discipline regulations, he accepted gifts of RMB 2.54 million and valuables such as torreya tables and chairs, yew root-carved seats, and sandalwood Guanyin statues, and used vehicles that exceeded the standard. Chen Xicheng’s main disciplinary violations include: 1. From 1999 to 2011, while serving as a member of the Party Leadership Group and Deputy Director of the Provincial Department of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Chen Xicheng successively accepted bribes of RMB 1.085 million, HKD 20,000, and an Omega men’s watch worth 13,000 yuan; 2. Embezzled RMB 169,800 of public funds; 3. Restructured and provided affordable housing in the Yunnan Provincial Urban and Rural Construction Comprehensive Development Company , migrant population rental housing, Huaguoshan housing project and other projects were unable to perform their duties correctly and were derelict in their work, causing significant economic losses; 4. Violating the rules of integrity and self-discipline, accepting gifts of RMB 900,000, and purchasing and using over-standard cars; 5. Violating financial disciplines and distributing money and materials indiscriminately, Chen Xicheng himself received money and materials worth a total of 300,000 yuan in various names; 6. Obstructing social management order and participating in gambling. Yang Hongwei, the former governor of Chuxiong, Yunnan, once took drugs while attending a meeting On the evening of April 27, 2011, at the Chuxiong Prefecture Government’s secretary’s office meeting in Yunnan, Yang Hongwei, the deputy secretary of the state party committee and governor who was presiding over the meeting, was declared “double-regulated” by the Yunnan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection who suddenly arrived. On May 1, the Yunnan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and the Provincial Supervision Department disclosed to the outside world through the media that during his tenure as deputy secretary of the Chuxiong Prefecture State Party Committee and governor, Yang Hongwei was suspected of violating organizational disciplines, dereliction of duty, taking drugs, accepting huge bribes from others, and other serious violations of discipline and law. Among them, drug abuse attracts the most attention. After the news broke on the Internet, Yang Hongwei was quickly dubbed the "drug-taking governor" as the first person known to have been dismissed from office for drug abuse.

32cbffd865ab62de4d536929638221d35e82fbe3.sourceText: 一边开会，一边吸毒 在”毒名”远扬之前，杨红卫在楚雄官场素以酒量著称。据称杨平常最喜饮酒，且酒量”深不可测”。去年云南大旱，杨红卫正宴请宾客，突然接到电话，下面某县开始下雨，杨大喜，倒满一整杯白酒一饮而尽。是夜，7个县下雨，杨红卫连干7杯，足有4斤之巨。 此外，杨红卫喜欢抽彝族的水筒烟，烟筒几乎从不离手。而据记者多方调查证实，杨红卫所吸毒品，是一种以鸦片为主、多种中草药加工的混合物，名为”卡苦”。其成品形状类似烟丝，恰好常用水烟筒吸食。”卡苦”主要泛滥于中缅边境的云南德宏、临沧一带，又谓”卡古”或”朵把”。当地吸食者甚众，其犯瘾症状和海洛因相似，但较海洛因轻微。”卡苦”价贵，故多在社会富裕阶层流行。据测算，瘾癖大者每日需人民币约200元，月需6000元。在边境一带，吸食卡苦甚至被作为身份地位的一种标志。一个细节能够说明，杨红卫对于吸食”卡苦”颇为招摇。楚雄州前政协主席杨成彪介绍，杨红卫出事前，有公安人员在一次会议上发现杨居然边开会边吸”卡苦”，并报告了时任州政法委书记王兴明。而王兴明对此不置可否。杨出事后，王兴明由楚雄州政法委书记改任德宏州政协副主席。 多种迹象表明，杨吸毒与叱咤楚雄当地政商圈子的一人有关。此人名李洪先，公开身份是”楚雄市经济开发区经济发展总公司”法定代表人，系开发区下面一名公务员。他曾借公司名义炒地圈钱，曾向银行重复抵押骗取3000万却成功”跳脱”;因在楚雄金融界声名狼藉，而被称为”金融壁虱”。李洪先在此次官场地震中也被批捕。
32cbffd865ab62de4d536929638221d35e82fbe3.translatedText: Taking drugs while attending meetings Before his "drug reputation" spread far and wide, Yang Hongwei was known as a drunkard in Chuxiong officialdom. It is said that Yang Pingfan likes to drink the most, and his drinking capacity is "unfathomable". Last year, there was a severe drought in Yunnan. Yang Hongwei was entertaining guests when he suddenly received a call that it started to rain in a county below. Yang was overjoyed and filled a whole glass of white wine and drank it in one gulp. It was raining in seven counties that night, and Yang Hongwei drank seven cups in a row, weighing four kilograms. In addition, Yang Hongwei likes to smoke Yi water pipe tobacco, and the pipe almost never leaves his hand. According to various investigations by reporters, the drug Yang Hongwei took was a mixture of opium and various Chinese herbal medicines, called "Ka Ku". The shape of the finished product is similar to cut tobacco, so it happens to be commonly smoked from hookahs. "Kaku" is mainly prevalent in the Dehong and Lincang areas of Yunnan on the China-Myanmar border, and is also called "Kagu" or "Duoba". There are many local drug addicts, and their addiction symptoms are similar to heroin, but milder than heroin. "Ka Ku" is expensive, so it is mostly popular among the wealthy classes of society. According to estimates, a person with severe addiction needs about 200 yuan per day and 6,000 yuan per month. In the border areas, smoking khat is even used as a symbol of status. One detail can show that Yang Hongwei is quite arrogant about taking "Ka Ku". Yang Chengbiao, former chairman of the CPPCC Chuxiong Prefecture, said that before Yang Hongwei's accident, a public security officer discovered that Yang was smoking "stuck" during a meeting and reported it to Wang Xingming, then secretary of the state Political and Legal Committee. Wang Xingming was noncommittal about this. After Yang's accident, Wang Xingming was changed from secretary of the Chuxiong Prefecture Political and Legal Committee to vice chairman of the Dehong Prefecture CPPCC. There are various indications that Yang’s drug use is related to a person in Chuxiong’s local political and business circles. This person's name is Li Hongxian, and his public identity is the legal representative of the "Chuxiong Economic Development Zone Economic Development Corporation" and a civil servant under the development zone. He once used the name of his company to speculate in land and make money, and once repeatedly mortgaged to a bank to defraud 30 million but successfully "escaped"; because of his notorious reputation in Chuxiong's financial circles, he was called a "financial tick." Li Hongxian was also arrested during this earthquake in official circles.

4a45974e01d9f968e97a2435da22161babd8a0c0.sourceText: 在老城斯科茨代尔领略美国西部文化艺术气息 位于美国亚利桑纳州中南部的Old Town Scottsdale（老城斯科茨代尔）是一个时尚之都，在《亚省时报》社社长甄石钦先生和美女主编邓凌夫妇的热情陪同下，我们有幸游览了这个设计奢华的老城，在这个处处充满浓厚艺术气息的Old Town艺术区，我们初次领略了美国西部的文化艺术气息。 行走在Old Town Scottsdale的街道上，一路所见，几乎都是画廊和精致的艺术品店、沙龙和酒吧。西部文化在这里散发出最灿烂的光彩。所有的路边雕塑、店里的绘画、艺术品，甚至橱窗里的布景，都是以印第安人或者牛仔为主题，或是描绘美国西部壮丽的地貌风情。 斯科茨代尔一直以艺术而闻名，从1971年开始，这里每年三月都会举办为期3天的斯科茨代尔艺术节，来自美国各地的著名油画家、版画家、雕塑家、吹制和珠宝商等，都荟萃一堂，向慕名而来的游客展示自己的艺术造诣和非凡作品。每年的艺术节都盛况空前，成千上万的人汇聚在斯科茨代尔文娱中心商场，分享各种艺术、手工艺、音乐和美食，不亦乐乎。 甄先生告诉我们，斯科茨代尔市与我国的海口市是友好城市。今年4月5日-30日，斯科茨代尔市还首次举办了”丁孟芳、陈学博油画雕塑艺术展”，共展出丁孟芳油画30幅、陈学博雕塑20幅。这些油画以海南岛美丽的自然风光和深厚的地域人文作为创作素材，从历史与人文的角度讴歌海南的大地、大海。 在东道主热情的引领下，我们徜徉在这个都市绿洲花园般的街区，从容欣赏着各种五颜六色的雕塑、绘画作品、玻璃制品，摄影和手工艺品，尽享西方文化艺术氛围。
4a45974e01d9f968e97a2435da22161babd8a0c0.translatedText: Appreciate the cultural and artistic atmosphere of the Western United States in the Old Town of Scottsdale. Old Town, located in the south-central part of Arizona, United States. Scottsdale (Old Town Scottsdale) is a fashionable city. Accompanied enthusiastically by Mr. Zhen Shiqin, the president of the "Alberta Times" and the beautiful editor-in-chief Deng Ling and his wife, we were fortunate to visit this luxuriously designed old town. In this Old Town Art District, which is full of strong artistic atmosphere, we experienced the culture and art of the western United States for the first time. Walking on the streets of Old Town Scottsdale, you will see almost all galleries and exquisite art shops, salons and bars. Western culture shines most brilliantly here. All the roadside sculptures, paintings, artworks in the store, and even the scenery in the windows are themed on Indians or cowboys, or depict the magnificent landforms of the American West. Scottsdale has always been famous for art. Since 1971, the three-day Scottsdale Art Festival has been held here every March. Famous oil painters, printmakers, sculptors, blowers and jewelers from all over the United States have gathered together to showcase their artistic attainments and extraordinary works to the tourists who come here. The annual Arts Festival is an unprecedented event, with thousands of people gathering at the Scottsdale Civic Center Mall to share a variety of arts, crafts, music and food, and have a great time. Mr. Zhen told us that Scottsdale and Haikou City in my country are sister cities. From April 5th to 30th this year, Scottsdale also held the "Ding Mengfang and Chen Xuebo Oil Painting and Sculpture Art Exhibition" for the first time, with a total of 30 oil paintings by Ding Mengfang and 20 sculptures by Chen Xuebo on display. These oil paintings use the beautiful natural scenery and profound regional culture of Hainan Island as creative materials, praising the land and sea of ​​Hainan from the perspective of history and culture. Under the enthusiastic guidance of the host, we wandered in this urban oasis garden-like neighborhood, calmly admiring various colorful sculptures, paintings, glass products, photography and handicrafts, and enjoying the atmosphere of Western culture and art.

22a0fe7a926f09c0a7e4f38839aedb9108c5cd1a.translatedText: Fewer schools in Chandler have passed the state's annual assessment this year. The number of schools across the country that meet the federal standard teaching goals has shown a downward trend. Similarly,...

5329d5637169d7f685d508b425823f192d1e7393.sourceText: 全国满足联邦规定的标准教学目标的学校数量出现了下降的趋势，与此相同，钱德勒满足全国标准教学目标的学校也从去年的35所，下降到25所。钱德勒一共有41所的学校，相关负责人表示，这个下降，与每年测试项目不断增加有关系。在区内的高中Perry和Basha满足了联邦的测量标准，Hamilton和Chandler则没有。 这个标准教学年度测量（Adequate Yearly Progress）比较影响一类学校（Title 1 School）,如果没有满足要求，他们会被警告整改完善。
5329d5637169d7f685d508b425823f192d1e7393.translatedText: The number of schools nationwide that meet the federal standard teaching goals has shown a downward trend. Similarly, the number of schools in Chandler that meet the national standard teaching goals has also dropped from 35 last year to 25. There are a total of 41 schools in Chandler. The relevant person in charge said that this decline is related to the increasing number of testing projects every year. Perry and Basha, the district's high schools, meet federal measurement standards; Hamilton and Chandler do not. This standard teaching annual measurement (Adequate Yearly Progress) affects Title 1 schools more. If they do not meet the requirements, they will be warned to make corrections.

9dd86726ff48db689333b99dd3105b72db42eda2.sourceText: 关注乙肝 传递爱心——亚太健康促进会乙肝筛查（图） 2011年7月30日上午九时亚太健康促进会在越南社区中心进行了乙肝免费筛查的活动。本次活动一共来了40多人，志愿者给前来筛查的人采取了血样，并将血样送到实验室进行检查，会在一周内将血液的检查结果寄送给被检查者。 本次前来筛查的人员中越南裔占大部分，华裔占少部分。记者在现场遇到了一位前来检查的越南朋友，他们表示很了解乙肝病毒携带者在亚裔人群中比例比较高，也正是因为如此他们来参加筛查。他们在越南的时候，身边也有朋友是乙肝病毒携带者。 志愿者与受检者在咨询 本次活动中记者有幸遇到了亚太健康促进会的创始人徐凯莱以及执行总监道格平野（Doug Hirano）。他们告诉记者这样的一个筛查活动如果找私人医生，每个人大约要500美元。亚太健康促进会完全免费给亚裔提供了这样的机会，不仅如此，在检查结果出来后，如果有发现乙肝病毒携带者，他们如果是属于低收入人群，还可以通过亚太健康促进会申请到免费的抑制乙肝病毒的两种有效药物，这些药物市价也是非常昂贵。这些免费的健康筛查活动，并不要求有绿卡或者美国身份，从中国或者亚太地区来的探亲的人也都可以参加。 亚太健康促进会是一个关注亚裔健康的非盈利慈善组织。他们根据亚裔的体质，提供了很多免费健康服务。目前因为美国政府财政预算紧缩，提供给慈善组织的费用都停止了。为了继续给亚裔提供健康服务，亚太健康促进会的创始人徐凯莱以及执行总监道格平野Doug Hirano四处募款，申请经费，现在给亚裔提供免费医疗服务的所有费用，都是亚太健康促进会筹集的善款。 更多有关亚太健康促进会情况请点击： http://www.apcaaz.org/index.htm 参与服务的工作人员与志愿者（左一道格平野Doug Hirano，左七徐凯莱） 精彩瞬间 在采访的过程中，无意中从亚太健康促进会的创始人徐凯莱得知了有关举办这次活动的场地提供者越南社区中心的小故事。 越南社区中心一墙之隔有一家牙医诊所。越南社区中心的场地是由这个牙科诊所的医生提供。他是越南裔，在租用诊所的时候，就多租了这个地方专门给越南裔的小朋友来上课，老年朋友来组织活动，这个小小的空间给越南裔的朋友带来了很多快乐。尽管是星期六，隔壁的诊所依然在营业。记者来到门口，看到待诊的病人还很多。为了不打搅主人，记者没有进入诊所。只是给这个慈善的品牌拍了个照片。 爱心牙科诊所
9dd86726ff48db689333b99dd3105b72db42eda2.translatedText: Pay attention to hepatitis B and spread love - Hepatitis B screening by Asia Pacific Health Promotion Association (picture) At 9 a.m. on July 30, 2011, the Asia Pacific Health Promotion Association conducted a free hepatitis B screening event at the Vietnam Community Center. A total of more than 40 people came to this event. Volunteers took blood samples from people who came for screening and sent the blood samples to the laboratory for examination. The blood test results will be sent to the subjects within a week. Among the people who came for screening this time, most of them were Vietnamese, and a small number were Chinese. The reporter met a Vietnamese friend who came for the test at the scene. They said they knew that the proportion of hepatitis B virus carriers was relatively high among Asians, and it was precisely because of this that they came to participate in the screening. When they were in Vietnam, they also had friends who were hepatitis B virus carriers. Volunteers and subjects were consulting. During this event, the reporter was fortunate enough to meet Xu Kailai, the founder of the Asia-Pacific Health Promotion Association, and Doug Hirano, the executive director. They told reporters that such a screening activity would cost about $500 per person if a private doctor was hired. The Asia-Pacific Health Promotion Association provides this opportunity to Asians completely free of charge. Not only that, after the test results come out, if hepatitis B virus carriers are found and they belong to low-income groups, they can also apply for free two effective drugs to suppress hepatitis B virus through the Asia-Pacific Health Promotion Association. The market price of these drugs is also very expensive. These free health screening activities do not require a green card or U.S. identity, and people visiting relatives from China or the Asia-Pacific region can also participate. The Asian Pacific Health Promotion Association is a non-profit charitable organization focusing on Asian health. They provide many free health services based on Asian physiques. Currently, due to budget constraints in the U.S. government, funding to charitable organizations has stopped. In order to continue to provide health services to Asians, the founder of the Asia-Pacific Health Promotion Association, Xu Kailai, and the executive director, Doug Hirano, raised funds and applied for funds. All the expenses for providing free medical services to Asians are now raised by the Asia-Pacific Health Promotion Association. For more information about the Asia Pacific Health Promotion Association, please click: http://www.apcaaz.org/index.htm Staff and volunteers participating in the service (Doug Hirano, left, Xu Kailai, seventh left) Highlights During the interview, I accidentally learned a short story about the Vietnam Community Center, the venue provider for the event, from Xu Kailai, the founder of the Asia Pacific Health Promotion Association. There is a dental clinic across the wall from the Vietnamese Community Center. The space at the Vietnamese Community Center is provided by the doctors of this dental clinic. He is of Vietnamese origin. When he rented the clinic, he rented this space specifically for Vietnamese children to attend classes and for elderly friends to organize activities. This small space brought a lot of happiness to the Vietnamese friends. Even though it was a Saturday, the clinic next door was still open. The reporter came to the door and saw that there were many patients waiting for treatment. In order not to disturb the owner, the reporter did not enter the clinic. I just took a photo of this charitable brand. Love Dental Clinic

042f2eae7ac7514b2567ec86041794bc2a2dd2d4.sourceText: 帕克斯学习中心学生 Shohan Khan 在六月 16 至 19 号去华盛顿 DC 参加世界儿童节. 身为 2011 年国际儿童艺术奥林匹克赛亚利桑那州决赛选手，他人的艺术品也同时在该场合被展览。
042f2eae7ac7514b2567ec86041794bc2a2dd2d4.translatedText: Parks Learning Center student Shohan Khan went to Washington, DC from June 16 to 19 to participate in World Children’s Day. As an Arizona finalist in the 2011 International Children’s Art Olympiad, other people’s artworks were also displayed on the occasion.

8aae526b149ea4d914cc820ce920fc9dbb64f20c.sourceText: 今年第四届世界儿童节是在国家大草地举办。其他世界历史上教育或跟娱乐有关的项目与该节目不能相比。世界儿童节总代表都是第四届艺术奥林匹克赛（美国奥林匹克委员会所主办的）来自世界各个国家的 8-12 岁的儿童﹔ DC 公立学校经过艺术奥林匹克赛竞选的” DC 大使”﹔还有被网民或杰出陪审团选出的 6-16 岁大的音乐家等表演者。世界儿童节的教育项目都是使用国际儿童艺术基金会”经过艺术达到和平”的方法论。
8aae526b149ea4d914cc820ce920fc9dbb64f20c.translatedText: This year’s fourth World Children’s Day was held at the National Mall. No other educational or entertainment-related program in world history can compare to this show. The general representatives of World Children's Day are children aged 8-12 from various countries in the 4th Art Olympiad (sponsored by the United States Olympic Committee); "DC Ambassadors" selected by DC public schools through the Art Olympiad; and musicians and other performers aged 6-16 who were selected by netizens or outstanding juries. Education projects for World Children's Day all use the International Children's Art Foundation's "Peace through Art" methodology.

0d004593fb0ddf8ce09c0cdf88dd722a30fba955.sourceText: 第四届国际儿童艺术奥林匹克赛是国际儿童艺术基金会每四年举办的国际艺术比赛。每届，世界各个 8-11 岁的孩子会登记 15000 多不同的艺术品。从这些艺术品中，裁判者会选出 100 名决赛选手： 50 位来自美国（每州一位）另外 50 位来自世界各国。这几名学生的艺术品并在世界儿童日在美国华盛顿 DC 展览。
0d004593fb0ddf8ce09c0cdf88dd722a30fba955.translatedText: The 4th International Children's Art Olympiad is an international art competition organized by the International Children's Art Foundation every four years. Each year, children aged 8-11 from around the world register more than 15,000 different artworks. From these artworks, judges will select 100 finalists: 50 from the United States (one from each state) and 50 from countries around the world. The students' artwork was exhibited in Washington, DC, USA on World Children's Day.

bf257a2369a376387229c25cd3fad5875b4080e9.sourceText: 今年前半年，帕克斯学习中心的”未来城市”（ Future City ）中学队也不久前在”未来城市全州比赛”荣获了两个奖。这三人队的城市” Heartville” 得了总体优秀奖以及 Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) 发表的最佳运输系统奖。 ITS 后来邀请了三位中学生 Mustafa Bouanani, Iman Bouanani 与 Kiram Tung 参加一次午宴。
bf257a2369a376387229c25cd3fad5875b4080e9.translatedText: In the first half of this year, Parks Learning Center’s “Future City” middle school team recently won two awards in the “Future City Statewide Competition”. The trio's city, "Heartville," received an overall excellence award as well as an award for best transportation system from the Intelligent Transportation System (ITS). ITS later invited three middle school students Mustafa Bouanani, Iman Bouanani and Kiram Tung to attend a luncheon.

21675b3dd6e29718cd7442d2f7c9dfe5ae09d36e.sourceText: 凤凰城台北姊妹市欢迎台北青年大使(图) （亚省时报） 凤凰城国际姊妹会每年均举办国际学生文化交流活动,与各姊妹城市做为期三周的青年大使交换学生,进行姊妹市的互动与宣传多元文化. 今年凤凰城姊妹会选出到台北的青年大使是 Zach Webb and Kelly Mittendorf,台北市选出到凤凰城的两位青年大使是张芷瑄与谢玮涵,四位均十分杰出与优秀,能充分发挥才华,配合姊妹市的各项活动,很成功的进行多元文化交流与圆满的促进国民外交. 凤凰城台北姊妹市委员会特别至机场迎接台北青年大使;参与青年大使与凤凰城副市长会面;举办欢迎青年大使活动;及举行晚宴欢迎台北青年大使,同时感谢本地数字夏令营青年领导与义工们,大家与台北青年大使共同联谊聚会,并享受丰盛的晚餐. 青年大使活动是提供青年很好的文化教育活动,多年来李玲麟与邱文齐全力支持与参与青年大使活动,义务提供指导凤凰城青年大使赴台北前的台湾台北介绍,文化风俗,地理环境,气候温度,观光名胜,货币交换,游览需知,及语文练习等,让凤凰城青年大使在到达台北前有很充分的心理准备;同时在台北青年大使到达凤凰城时给予最热心的接待,照顾,与欢迎. 有关凤凰城姊妹会青年大使活动是接受高二与高三学生报名参加,详情请洽凤凰城姊妹会. 照片: 欢迎台北青年大使与夏令营青年领导联谊合影
21675b3dd6e29718cd7442d2f7c9dfe5ae09d36e.translatedText: Phoenix City Taipei sister city welcomes Taipei youth ambassador (photo) (Alberta Times) The Phoenix International Sisters holds international student cultural exchange activities every year, and exchanges students with sister cities for three weeks as youth ambassadors to interact with the sister cities and promote multiculturalism. This year, the Phoenix Sisters elected the youth ambassadors to Taipei to be Zach Webb and Kelly Mittendorf, the two young ambassadors selected by Taipei City to Phoenix City are Zhang Zhixuan and Xie Weihan. All four are very outstanding and outstanding. They can give full play to their talents and cooperate with various activities of the sister city to successfully conduct multicultural exchanges and successfully promote national diplomacy. The Phoenix City Taipei Sister City Committee specially went to the airport to welcome the Taipei Youth Ambassadors; participated in the meeting between the Youth Ambassadors and the Vice Mayor of Phoenix City; held a welcome event for the Youth Ambassadors; and held a dinner to welcome the Taipei Youth Ambassadors, and also thanked the youth leaders and volunteers of the local digital summer camp. Everyone had a social gathering with the Taipei Youth Ambassadors and enjoyed a sumptuous dinner. The Youth Ambassador activity is a good cultural and educational activity for young people. Over the years, Li Linglin and Qiu Wenqin have fully supported and participated in the Youth Ambassador activity. They have voluntarily provided guidance to the Phoenix Youth Ambassadors before going to Taipei to introduce Taipei, Taiwan, cultural customs, geographical environment, climate temperature, tourist attractions, currency exchange, tourist information, and language exercises, etc., so that the Phoenix Youth Ambassadors can have full psychological preparation before arriving in Taipei. At the same time, they have given the most enthusiastic reception, care, and welcome to the Taipei Youth Ambassadors when they arrive in Phoenix. The Phoenix City Sisters Youth Ambassador activity is open to high school sophomores and seniors. For details, please contact the Phoenix Sisters. Photo: Welcome Taipei Youth Ambassadors and take a group photo with the youth leaders of the summer camp

dc6f13699f4bade66d3d2de68876171061b2281a.sourceText: 高教衰退 加州正走下坡路 一项于20日发表的调查报告显示，加州高等教育系统正在衰退。能够负担大学的学生人数越来越少、入学率降低、州政府提供的支持也不断缩减。 由沙加缅度州大「高等领导及政策研究中心」提出的报告「忽略的后果」（Consequences of Neglect）指出，曾以三层公立大学系统（three-tiered system）傲视全国的加州，已失去可负担学费、高中毕业生升学预备、上大学率与高等教育投资等领域的领先地位。 报告说：「这份报告显示，加州停留在过去的荣誉，不改变过去的政策，以及因此带来的后果。根据全国教育领袖十年来追踪纪录的高等教育表现，加州距离领袖地位已非常遥远。我们充其量只能算一般，并正在走下坡路。」 报告还发现，加州由州政府提供给大学生的人均拨款位居全国最低。学费与其他收费的涨幅则超过全国平均。高中毕业生的上大学率在2003至2007年间由53%增长至58%，但在2009年又跌回53%。 加州在每100名高中生毕业六年后获得大学学士学位的人数，位居全国第41位。 最令人担忧的是，加州每一代的工作人口，所受的教育程度都比前下降，这一趋势将带来灾难性后果。报告的共同撰写人柯琳．摩尔说：「我们必须认识高等教育是具有公益性的。如果我们未能认识到这一点，将来愿意到加州发展的高科技公司便会越来越少，民众收入越低，税收也就越低。这些将对社会整体造成巨大的负面影响。」
dc6f13699f4bade66d3d2de68876171061b2281a.translatedText: Higher education is declining. California is in decline. A survey report published on the 20th showed that California's higher education system is in decline. Fewer students can afford college, enrollment is declining, and support from state governments is shrinking. The report "Consequences of Neglect" produced by the Center for Advanced Leadership and Policy Research at Sacramento State University points out that California, which once dominated the country with its three-tiered public university system, has lost its leading position in areas such as affordable tuition, high school graduate preparation, college attendance rates and investment in higher education. "This report shows that California is resting on its past laurels and unchanging past policies, and the consequences," the report said. "California is far from leadership in higher education performance, which has been tracked for a decade by national education leaders. We are average at best and on the decline." The report also found that California has the lowest per-student state funding for college students in the nation. Tuition and other fees have increased faster than the national average. The college-going rate among high school graduates increased from 53% to 58% between 2003 and 2007, but fell back to 53% in 2009. California ranks 41st in the nation in the number of college bachelor's degrees earned by every 100 high school students six years after graduation. Most worryingly, each generation of California’s working population is becoming less educated than the one before it, a trend that will have catastrophic consequences. Report co-author Colin. Moore said: "We must realize that higher education is a public good. If we fail to realize this, fewer and fewer high-tech companies will be willing to develop in California in the future. The lower the income of the people, the lower the taxes. These will have a huge negative impact on society as a whole."

2a3293eb6c7920074bead3b1025d5ca9d7a49b8f.sourceText: 中国海外交流协会赴美讲学团将到凤城 8月21日在ASU为华文教师培训 【全美中文学校协会来稿】经全美中文学校协会联系，中国海外交流协会今年派出讲学团到美国为华文教师培训。 讲学团是第一次到亚利桑那为华文教师培训。将由现代中文学校，希望中文学校，图桑祖荀中文学校，图桑国语教会中文学校承办当地的培训活动，这次培训活动也对其它华文教师开放。ASU孔子学院赞助和支持在凤凰城地区的教师培训活动。 所有参加培训的人员将获得国侨办证书。 凤凰城地区培训定在8月21日，星期天。 地点: Memorial Union, 亚利桑那州立大学Memorial Union Mohave Room 23 Map: http://www.asu.edu/map/interactive/?campus=tempe&building=MU 时间:10:00 am?5:00 pm 课程内容及讲员简介 ”小学语文教学法” 杜朝晖老师，华中师大附小高级教师. 武汉市优秀青年教师。人民教育出版社义务教育课程实验教科书培训教师。国家课程标准版湘教版小学语文教科书编委。 在《小学语文教学》《小学语文教师》《小学语文教学论坛》等中文核心期刊发表教学论文三十多篇。 ”中国文化专题 – 中华文化与其它文化的交流” 王晓路，四川大学教授. 文学博士，四川大学文学与新闻学院、外语学院教授，博士生导师；海外教育学院教授委员会主任。享受国务院政府特殊津贴，四川省学术带头人，获四川省教学名师、全国模范教师称号。 ”手工制作（剪纸、中国结）” 李明，济南市市中区教育局教研室高级教师. 中学高级教师、美术教研员，山东省青年书法家协会会员。专长油画、雕塑、书法、篆刻，热爱传统文化，广泛涉猎民间美术，擅长手工制作。从事教师工作21年，研究美术教育，深刻认识美术教育的文化内涵和美术活动对人的审美素养和智慧开发具有重要作用，多年以来，指导中、小学美术教师的教育教学工作，致力于美术教育深层开发。 备注：讲课当天提供早餐和午餐，每位参加培训的人员交费$10,用于部分餐费，其余部分由孔子学院赞助 报名参加的人员请于8月10日前用电子邮件报名，特别注明中文名字，以便颁发证书。因受场地人数限制，按报名日期优先接受。联系人：帅致若（全美中文学校协会副会长） maryshuai99@yahoo.com
2a3293eb6c7920074bead3b1025d5ca9d7a49b8f.translatedText: The China Overseas Exchange Association's lecture group to the United States will come to Fengcheng Training for Chinese teachers at ASU on August 21 [Contribution from the National Association of Chinese Schools] After contacting the National Association of Chinese Schools, the China Overseas Exchange Association sent a lecture group to the United States this year to train Chinese teachers. This is the first time that the lecture group has come to Arizona to train Chinese teachers. The local training activities will be hosted by Modern Chinese School, Hope Chinese School, Tucson Zuxun Chinese School, and Tucson Mandarin Church Chinese School. This training activity is also open to other Chinese teachers. The ASU Confucius Institute sponsors and supports teacher training activities in the Phoenix area. All participants in the training will receive a certificate from the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council. The Phoenix area training is scheduled for Sunday, August 21st. Location: Memorial Union, Arizona State University Memorial Union Mohave Room 23 Map: http://www.asu.edu/map/interactive/?campus=tempe&building=MU Time: 10:00 am?5:00 pm Course content and lecturer introduction "Primary School Chinese Teaching Method" Mr. Du Zhaohui, senior teacher of the Primary School Affiliated to Central China Normal University. Outstanding young teacher in Wuhan City. People's Education Press trains teachers on experimental textbooks for compulsory education courses. Editorial board member of the National Curriculum Standard Edition and the Hunan Education Edition primary school Chinese textbook. He has published more than 30 teaching papers in core Chinese journals such as "Primary School Chinese Teaching", "Primary School Chinese Teacher", and "Primary School Chinese Teaching Forum". "Chinese Culture Special Topic - Exchanges between Chinese Culture and Other Cultures" Wang Xiaolu, professor at Sichuan University. Doctor of Literature, professor at the School of Literature and Journalism and School of Foreign Languages, Sichuan University, doctoral supervisor; director of the Professor Committee of the Overseas Education School. Enjoys special government allowances from the State Council, is an academic leader in Sichuan Province, and has been awarded the title of Sichuan Provincial Famous Teacher and National Model Teacher. "Handmade (paper-cutting, Chinese knots)" Li Ming, senior teacher in the Teaching and Research Section of Jinan Shizhong District Education Bureau. Senior teacher in middle school, art teaching researcher, and member of Shandong Young Calligraphers Association. Specializing in oil painting, sculpture, calligraphy, and seal cutting, he loves traditional culture, extensively dabbles in folk art, and is good at handcrafting. I have been working as a teacher for 21 years. I have studied art education and have a deep understanding of the cultural connotation of art education and the important role that art activities play in people's aesthetic literacy and intellectual development. For many years, I have guided the education and teaching work of art teachers in primary and secondary schools, and are committed to the in-depth development of art education. Note: Breakfast and lunch will be provided on the day of the lecture. Each training participant pays $10, which will be used for part of the meal expenses, and the rest will be sponsored by the Confucius Institute. Those who wish to participate should register by email before August 10th, and indicate their Chinese name in particular so that the certificate can be issued. Due to the limited number of people in the venue, priority will be accepted based on the registration date. Contact: Shuai Zhiruo (Vice President of the National Association of Chinese Schools) maryshuai99@yahoo.com

fd0c3de8cf610b041b9052232d7fed8438a421ff.sourceText: MBA生最爱雇主 谷歌连霸五年 亚省时报 美国商学院毕业生喜欢去哪里工作？当然是谷歌！据研究公司Universum统计，过去5年来， 前100名雇用MBA的雇主中，谷歌始终排名第一。 《CNN金钱网站》报导，Universum公司区域经理哈梭史特隆说，总体而言，今年最理想的雇主是那些能提供一个具有挑战性工作的环境，而且早已脱离全球金融危机阴霾的公司。此外，今年的MBA毕业生，对技术和工程公司的职位较有兴趣， 他们大多不愿去金融机构。 在谷歌排名下面，苹果公司今年的排名攀升两名至第3名，今年还有一个杰出的新公司挤进了前10名。哈梭史特隆说，”脸书”（FACEBOOK）排名在第7位，对一家新公司来说，这是相当高的排名，原因是毕业生们觉得，具有挑战性的工作和有威信的公司，都是十分重要的。 他还说，今年MBA学生的职业目标，是要有智力竞争性的工作。去年，他们要求的则是一个平衡的工作与生活。 在经济衰退后的复苏期间，对于刚毕业的大学生来说，工作保障和机会也是非常重要的。传统的谘询公司，例如麦肯锡（在第2位）的工作，也十分抢手，因为这公司有广泛的培训机会，可以作为一个长期而丰厚的职业生涯的跳板。 哈梭史特隆指出:”全球金融危机造成经济衰退之后，银行和金融机构整体的吸引力下降。他们的排名也下降了许多。”虽然今年银行的排名下降，但中坚分子如高盛、摩根大通和摩根士丹利等公司仍挂在前15名。 下面是MBA学生今年选出的前十名最爱的雇主：1.谷歌(Google) 2.麦肯锡公司(McKinsey & Company) 3.苹果(Apple) 4.高盛集团(Goldman Sachs Group) 5.波士顿谘询集团(The Boston Consulting Group) 6.贝恩私募基金(Bain & Company) 7.脸书(Facebook) 8.亚马逊(Amazon.com) 9.摩根大通(J.P. Morgan) 10. 耐克 (Nike)
fd0c3de8cf610b041b9052232d7fed8438a421ff.translatedText: MBA students’ favorite employer: Google has dominated the competition for five consecutive years. The Alberta Times: Where do American business school graduates like to work? Of course Google! According to research firm Universum, Google has consistently ranked first among the top 100 employers hiring MBAs over the past five years. "CNN Money" reported that Universum regional manager Hassel Strom said that overall, the most ideal employers this year are companies that can provide a challenging work environment and have long since emerged from the haze of the global financial crisis. In addition, this year's MBA graduates are more interested in positions in technology and engineering companies, and most of them are unwilling to go to financial institutions. Beneath Google, Apple climbed two spots to No. 3 this year, with an outstanding new company cracking the top 10 this year. Hasselstrom said that Facebook ranked 7th, which is a very high ranking for a new company. The reason is that graduates think that challenging jobs and prestigious companies are very important. He also said that the career goal of this year's MBA students is to have intellectually competitive jobs. Last year, what they asked for was a work-life balance. Job security and opportunity are also important for recent graduates during the post-recession recovery. Jobs at traditional consulting firms such as McKinsey (at No. 2) are also highly sought-after because they offer extensive training opportunities and can serve as a springboard to a long and rewarding career. "After the recession caused by the global financial crisis, banks and financial institutions overall have become less attractive. Their rankings have also dropped a lot," Hasselstrom pointed out. Although banks' rankings have dropped this year, stalwarts such as Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan Chase and Morgan Stanley remain in the top 15. Here are the top ten favorite employers selected by MBA students this year: 1. Google 2. McKinsey & Company 3. Apple 4. Goldman Sachs Group 5. The Boston Consulting Group 6. Bain & Company 7. Facebook 8. Amazon.com 9. J.P. Morgan Morgan 10. Nike

1b54f1c63269b8dd0392235aacd4d654334cb49f.sourceText: 增加苹果 麦当劳9月改善儿童餐 （亚省时报） 快餐业巨擘麦当劳公司26日宣布，将改善儿童餐的营养，把「快乐餐」(Happy Meals)的薯条数量减到一半以下，并将苹果列为快乐餐中的标准食物项目。此外，这家全球最大的快餐店计划在2015年将食物中的钠减少15%，该连锁店也宣布在2020年前，进一步减少食物中糖、饱和脂肪、盐和卡路里含量。 麦当劳表示，这项改变将自9月开始，到2012年第一季末，麦当劳全国1万4000个店都将提供加苹果的「快乐餐」。 麦当劳现在提供的「快乐餐」配套包括一份3.1盎斯苹果片佐以焦糖浆。9月开始，苹果片份量将改为1.2盎斯，不提供糖或其他沾浆。该公司表示，新的「快乐 餐」热量将比现在的「快乐餐」少20卡路里，而其总热量不超过600卡。新「快乐餐」价格不变，每套「快乐餐」附赠的玩具也维持不变。新「快乐餐」的薯条将由2.4盎斯减到1.1盎斯，所含热量为100卡。 第一夫人米雪儿欧巴马26日表示，麦当劳快餐店决定在儿童「快乐餐」中增加苹果，是解决儿童肥胖问题积极的一步。米雪儿最近呼吁全国快餐店正视儿童肥胖问题。包括沃尔玛在内的零售商，最近宣布将于五年内增加或扩张1500个店面，提供新鲜蔬果及健康食品。 加州旧金山和圣他克拉拉县(Santa Clara)最近通过的法律规定，不准食物不符合营养规定的快餐店提供免费玩具给儿童。为符合旧金山和圣他克拉拉县的法规，麦当劳不得不改善儿童餐的菜单。 旧金山要求儿童餐中要包括蔬菜，麦当劳尚未达到此标准。该公司总经理珍‧费尔德说，未来很可能再把蔬菜增加到菜单中。
1b54f1c63269b8dd0392235aacd4d654334cb49f.translatedText: Increase Apple McDonald's will improve children's meals in September (Alberta Times) Fast food giant McDonald's announced on the 26th that it will improve the nutrition of children's meals, reduce the number of French fries in "Happy Meals" to less than half, and include apples as a standard food item in Happy Meals. In addition, the world's largest fast food restaurant plans to reduce sodium in food by 15% in 2015. The chain also announced that it will further reduce sugar, saturated fat, salt and calorie content in food by 2020. McDonald's said the change will begin in September and by the end of the first quarter of 2012, all 14,000 McDonald's stores across the country will offer "Happy Meals" with apples. McDonald's now offers a "Happy Meal" package that includes a 3.1-ounce apple slice with caramel syrup. Starting in September, the portion size of apple slices will be changed to 1.2 ounces, and no sugar or other dipping sauce will be provided. The company said the new "Happy Meal" will have 20 fewer calories than the current "Happy Meal" and its total calories will not exceed 600 calories. The price of the new "Happy Meal" remains unchanged, and the toys included with each set of "Happy Meal" also remain unchanged. The new "Happy Meal" fries will be reduced from 2.4 ounces to 1.1 ounces and contain 100 calories. First Lady Michelle Obama said on the 26th that McDonald's fast food restaurant's decision to add apples to children's "Happy Meals" is a positive step in solving the problem of childhood obesity. Michelle recently called on fast food restaurants across the country to address the issue of childhood obesity. Retailers, including Walmart, recently announced that they will add or expand 1,500 stores within five years to provide fresh fruits, vegetables and healthy foods. San Francisco and Santa Clara counties in California recently passed laws prohibiting fast food restaurants whose food does not meet nutritional requirements from providing free toys to children. McDonald's had to revamp its children's meal menu to comply with regulations in San Francisco and Santa Clara counties. San Francisco requires that children's meals include vegetables, a standard McDonald's has yet to meet. The company's general manager, Jane Feld, said vegetables are likely to be added to the menu in the future.

e3173318fbd7b97fd832f3065784b9fbd38ad9f3.sourceText: 筑墙防偷渡 州议会决募5000万 州议会决定成立私募边境围墙基金，经费用来兴建围墙，全面隔离本州岛和墨西哥之间的边境，以阻绝非法移民进入本州岛。州议会设定的募款目标为5000万元，要达到该目标，州议会还需要大量捐款。 批评者认为，此计划堪称「有勇无谋」，只让参与的人「感到愉快」，其实对遏阻非法移民闯入美国，效果有限。管理该基金的州议会表示，许多民众对国会处理非法移民问题的无能，感到愤怒，这项努力让民众有机会参与遏止非法移民闯入美国的行为。 曾任本州岛州长的国内安全部长珍妮纳波利塔诺，2005年国会提出建筑边境围墙构想时，她就抱质疑态度。她说：「你建一堵50呎高的围墙，就有51呎高的梯子。」 她认为，围墙功能有限，要彻底解决偷渡问题，必须要加强边境巡逻和科技监控技术。欧巴马政府大幅增加边境巡逻人员，也用无人飞机监控边境状况，但因遭遇技术瓶颈和预算超支，政府去年暂停「虚拟围墙」计划。 尽管有人赞成围墙计划，但高山环保会大峡谷分会主任珊蒂巴尔表示：「这项州政府主导的计划荒唐可笑。州议会该正视的问题反而不去解决。」 根据国会审计处2009年的报告，边境围墙每哩成本为100万到300万元。本州岛和墨西哥间的边境长388哩，尚有82哩没有围墙。
e3173318fbd7b97fd832f3065784b9fbd38ad9f3.translatedText: To build a wall to prevent smuggling. The State Assembly decided to raise 50 million. The state Legislature decided to establish a private border wall fund to fund the construction of a wall to completely isolate the border between the state island and Mexico to prevent illegal immigrants from entering the state island. The state Legislature has set a fundraising goal of $50 million, and to reach that goal, the state Legislature will need a large amount of donations. Critics believe that this plan is "cowardless" and only makes those participating "feel happy". In fact, it has limited effect in deterring illegal immigrants from entering the United States. State legislators who administer the fund said the effort gives citizens an opportunity to participate in stemming the flow of illegal immigrants into the United States, as many people are angry about Congress' inability to deal with illegal immigration. Internal Security Minister Jeanne Napolitano, a former governor of the island, was skeptical when Congress proposed the idea of ​​building a border wall in 2005. She said: "If you build a 50-foot-tall wall, there will be a 51-foot-tall ladder." She believes that the function of the wall is limited, and to completely solve the problem of smuggling, border patrols and technological surveillance technology must be strengthened. The Obama administration significantly increased border patrol personnel and used drones to monitor border conditions. However, the government suspended the "virtual wall" plan last year due to technical bottlenecks and budget overruns. Although there is support for the wall plan, Sandy Barr, director of the Grand Canyon Chapter of the Mountain Conservation Association, said: "This state-led plan is ridiculous. The state Legislature is not solving the problem that should be faced up to." According to a 2009 report by the Congressional Audit Office, the border wall cost $1 million to $3 million per mile. The border between Honshu and Mexico is 388 miles long, of which 82 miles are unfenced.

d8dcdaaac69a51ff0795be81eb1251729fbd487f.sourceText: （亚省华联供稿）《凤凰之夜》庆祝中华人民共和国成立62周年国庆招待会暨中秋佳节将于2011年9月18日在亚利桑那州立大学隆重举行。 为了筹办这次活动，亚利桑那州华人华侨联合总会会长费健于七月二十四日召集了第一次筹备会议，副会长董斌主持了会议。 二十多名各界代表参加了本次会议。 费健会长首先向大家介绍了《凤凰之夜》筹备进展情况和初步活动安排。 会议开得热烈有序，大家畅所欲言，集思广益，初步勾画出了一幅弘扬中国文化、促进中美友谊的活动蓝图。 届时亚利桑那州侨学界将举办一系列相关庆祝活动，其中包括：中美文化论坛、国庆招待会、中秋联谊舞会和青少年绘画展览。
d8dcdaaac69a51ff0795be81eb1251729fbd487f.translatedText: (Contributed by Alberta Hualian) "Phoenix Night" celebrates the 62nd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China. The National Day reception and Mid-Autumn Festival will be held grandly at Arizona State University on September 18, 2011. In order to prepare for this event, Fei Jian, president of the Arizona Overseas Chinese Federation, convened the first preparatory meeting on July 24, and Vice President Dong Bin presided over the meeting. More than 20 representatives from all walks of life participated in this meeting. Chairman Fei Jian first introduced the preparation progress and preliminary activity arrangements of "Phoenix Night" to everyone. The meeting was held in a lively and orderly manner. Everyone spoke freely, brainstormed, and initially sketched out a blueprint for activities to promote Chinese culture and promote Sino-US friendship. At that time, the overseas Chinese community in Arizona will hold a series of related celebration activities, including: Sino-US Cultural Forum, National Day Reception, Mid-Autumn Festival Dance and Youth Painting Exhibition.

2174c6debdad2507701b866d30c401f15a710c82.sourceText: 7月25日，来京参加”水立方杯”海外华裔青少年中文歌曲大赛的参赛选手在媒体镜头前小试身手，选手们不俗的表现赢得了现场观众的掌声和欢呼声。
2174c6debdad2507701b866d30c401f15a710c82.translatedText: On July 25, the contestants who came to Beijing to participate in the "Water Cube Cup" Overseas Chinese Youth Chinese Song Competition tried their skills in front of the media cameras. The outstanding performance of the contestants won the applause and cheers of the audience.

7b5e745d1c5d9824eaf9dcf41888537d6c633163.sourceText: 来自亚利桑那州的严婕娅，今年刚刚15岁，虽然因为年龄的原因，个头还没有发育完全，但她一曲嘹亮而高亢的《青藏高原》，一下子就让整个会场安静了下来。来自加拿大的杨子翾，是一个很时尚的小帅哥，面对镜头，他用一段激情四射的热舞，展示出了青春与梦想迷人的魅力。来自澳大利亚的闫景绮不认识汉字，他在发言稿上标满了汉语拼音，用不太流利的中文表达了选手们共同的心声：获奖只是个别人的荣耀，但奋斗的过程是每一个人的财富。无论比赛结果如何，我们都将用最好的表现，庆祝和纪念北京奥运会申办成功十周年和举办成功三周年。
7b5e745d1c5d9824eaf9dcf41888537d6c633163.translatedText: Yan Jieya from Arizona is just 15 years old this year. Although her height is not fully developed due to her age, her loud and high-pitched song "Qinghai-Tibet Plateau" immediately silenced the entire venue. Yang Ziyi from Canada is a very fashionable and handsome boy. Facing the camera, he used a passionate dance to show the charming charm of youth and dreams. Yan Jingqi from Australia did not know Chinese characters. His speech was marked with Chinese pinyin, and he expressed the common aspirations of the contestants in less fluent Chinese: Winning the prize is only an individual's glory, but the process of struggle is everyone's wealth. Regardless of the outcome of the competition, we will use our best performance to celebrate and commemorate the tenth anniversary of the successful bid for the Beijing Olympics and the third anniversary of its successful hosting.

64ee62f5bcb8241531637a5a3947f6bc13637926.sourceText: 北京市政府侨办副主任、新闻发言人初世敏在接受媒体采访时表示，”水立方杯”海外华裔青少年中文歌曲大赛吸引了广大海外华裔青少年的积极参与，这体现了海外华裔青少年的”民族情”、”奥运情”。来京参加复赛和决赛的29名优胜选手都有不俗的才艺，他们将在接下来的比赛中全方位展现。
64ee62f5bcb8241531637a5a3947f6bc13637926.translatedText: Chu Shimin, deputy director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the Beijing Municipal Government and spokesperson, said in an interview with the media that the "Water Cube Cup" Overseas Chinese Youth Chinese Song Contest has attracted the active participation of overseas Chinese teenagers, which reflects the "national sentiment" and "Olympic sentiment" of overseas Chinese teenagers. The 29 winners who came to Beijing to participate in the semi-finals and finals all have great talents, and they will be fully displayed in the following competitions.

799f58ebc3141cb5fe2ef9205ea5f7bcc70d1482.sourceText: ”水立方杯”海外华裔青少年中文歌曲大赛吸引了海内外媒体的广泛关注。CCTV-4、人民日报海外版、新华社、中新社、中国日报、中国国际广播电台、香港凤凰卫视、香港文汇报、北京电视台、北京日报、北京青年报、北京晨报、新京报、首都之窗等20余家媒体参加了25日召开的新闻发布会。CCTV-4、北京电视台等媒体已派摄制组进驻选手驻地，全程跟踪采访，展现选手风采。(北京侨办供稿)
799f58ebc3141cb5fe2ef9205ea5f7bcc70d1482.translatedText: "Water Cube Cup" Overseas Chinese Youth Chinese Song Contest has attracted widespread attention from domestic and foreign media. More than 20 media including CCTV-4, People's Daily Overseas Edition, Xinhua News Agency, China News Service, China Daily, China Radio International, Hong Kong Phoenix TV, Hong Kong Wen Wei Po, Beijing Television, Beijing Daily, Beijing Youth Daily, Beijing Morning Post, Beijing News, and Capital Window participated in the press conference held on the 25th. CCTV-4, Beijing TV and other media have sent camera crews to the contestants' residence to follow and interview them throughout the process to showcase the contestants' style. (Contributed by Beijing Overseas Chinese Affairs Office)

74367dce60049e74cd028584eabc957e67207466.sourceText: 美1/8青年滥用止痛药 （亚省时报） 根据7日公布的新调查，美国每8名年纪较长青少年，就有1人是在没有处方笺下使用强力止痛药，其中许多人在16岁或17岁就开始滥用，比先前预估的年龄还要早。 调查结果是根据2个国内调查，询问青少年最近或是截至目前使用处方止痛药的情形，其中包括容易上瘾的奥施康定 （oxycontin）与可待因（codeine）。研究刊登于”小儿及青少年医学月刊”。 安亚伯（Ann Arbor）密西根大的麦凯比 （Sean Esteban McCabe）领导其中1份新研究，他和研究团队从2007年至2009年调查7400名、135所公私立高中高年级生，发现有13%将处方止痛药用于非 医药用途，像是为了获得快感或是未在医师监督下舒缓疼痛。 研究人员表示，全美这类类鸦片药物的医疗与娱乐使用在过去20年逐渐增加，止痛药过量致死案件也上升。这项新调查显示，教育滥用止痛药危险性的计划应从高中开始。 未参与研究的纽约罗彻斯特大学医学中心小儿科医师佛杜纳表示：”青少年将管制药物用于非医药用途，几乎已凌驾大麻以外所有毒品，我们必须对这个趋势有所警觉。” 美国疾病管制暨预防中心估计，2008年有1万4800名美国人死于止痛药过量，人数是20年前的3倍。
74367dce60049e74cd028584eabc957e67207466.translatedText: 1/8 young people in the United States abuse painkillers (Alberta Times) According to a new survey released on the 7th, one in eight older teenagers in the United States uses powerful painkillers without a prescription, and many of them begin abusing them at the age of 16 or 17, earlier than previously estimated. The findings are based on two domestic surveys that asked teenagers about their recent or current use of prescription painkillers, including the highly addictive drugs OxyContin and codeine. The study was published in the Journal of Pediatric and Adolescent Medicine. One of the new studies was led by Sean Esteban McCabe of the University of Michigan in Ann Arbor. He and his research team surveyed 7,400 seniors from 135 public and private high schools from 2007 to 2009 and found that 13% used prescription painkillers for non-medical purposes, such as to get pleasure or to relieve pain without medical supervision. Researchers say that medical and recreational use of these opioids has gradually increased in the United States over the past two decades, and deaths from painkiller overdoses have also increased. This new survey shows that programs to educate about the dangers of painkiller abuse should start in high schools. "Adolescents are using controlled substances for non-medical purposes, almost surpassing all drugs except marijuana, and we must be alert to this trend," said Forduna, a pediatrician at the University of Rochester Medical Center in New York who was not involved in the study. The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention estimates that 14,800 Americans died from painkiller overdoses in 2008, three times the number 20 years ago.

cce80dfe149d051b045a9a20b4fb96232612a8cb.sourceText: 求职失败的五大心理症结 你知道你求职失败的原因吗?专家认为现在的大学毕业生在求职中存在着很多误区，而这些都是直接导致自己求职失败的心理原因。 对企业一无所知 很多毕业生应聘企业很随意，在一次招聘会上，一家化妆品公司的招聘主管让应聘大学生说出几款该公司代理的品牌名字，没想到求职者一个都答不出来。这位招聘主管说：”对公司这么陌生，在求职前不去了解该公司，很难想像他对自己的职业生涯有所规划。这样不负责的人，我们肯定不会用。”记者了解到，这种情况招聘单位遇到很多。 自以为是 对于一些大学生而言，并非找不到任何工作，而是由于对工作的期望值过高，对一些低档次的工作不屑一顾，盲目地追求一些脱离自身实际的”高工资、高待遇”的理想工作。这种”半吊子”型的人才，在就业压力日益增大的今天必然要走向失业。 应聘太盲目 不少大学生并不知道某个职位的职责分工是什么，只会从字面上去理解。一家公司?#33829;业服务部?#19979;属的商品企划室招聘人，结果许多大学生看到”服务”二字，就以为是做服务工作无人应聘。而当公司把”服务”两字去掉后，马上就有很多人投简历。人事主管告诫说，如果对职位不明白可以询问用人单位，不要单从字面上去片面理解，这样很可能会错过一个好机会。 不愿到基层去吃苦 大学生刚刚踏入社会，刚进入企业，很难立刻进入角色。一些公司规定所有新参加工作的大学生都要到一线去锻炼一年，有的同学一看不能马上搞设计、搞管理工作，要”吃一年的苦”，就打退堂鼓不愿意干了，白白丢掉了很好的工作。 独立性欠缺 许多大学生在学习中只知死啃书本，没有足够的社会实践，每次应聘都要父母参与求职，自己则缺乏主见。还有的毕业生笔试、面试通过后，在与公司签约的时候，父母到场与用人单位说长道短谈条件。对于这种行为，多家公司的人事主管都表示反感。”找工作的前提是，你是一个独立的人，有自己的判断能力，能对自己负责。”一位人事经理说。
cce80dfe149d051b045a9a20b4fb96232612a8cb.translatedText: Five major psychological reasons why you fail to apply for a job Do you know the reasons why you fail to apply for a job? Experts believe that there are many misunderstandings for college graduates today when applying for a job, and these are the psychological reasons that directly lead to their failure to apply for a job. Know nothing about companies. Many graduates apply for companies very casually. At a job fair, the recruiting director of a cosmetics company asked college applicants to name several brands represented by the company. Unexpectedly, the job seekers could not answer any of them. The recruitment director said: "He is so unfamiliar with the company. If he doesn't understand the company before applying for a job, it is difficult to imagine that he has plans for his career. We will definitely not use such irresponsible people." The reporter learned that recruitment units encounter this situation many times. Self-righteousness For some college students, it is not that they cannot find any job, but that they have too high expectations for work and disdain some low-level jobs, blindly pursuing some ideal jobs with "high wages and high benefits" that are divorced from their own reality. This kind of "half-baked" talent will inevitably become unemployed in today's era of increasing employment pressure. Applying too blindly: Many college students do not know what the division of responsibilities of a certain position is, and they only understand it literally. A company's product planning office affiliated with the industrial service department was recruiting people. As a result, many college students saw the word "service" and thought they were doing service jobs and no one was applying. And when the company removed the word "service", many people immediately submitted resumes. The HR director warned that if you don't understand the position, you can ask the employer. Don't just interpret it literally, as you may miss a good opportunity. Unwilling to endure hardship at the grassroots level. College students have just entered society and companies, and it is difficult for them to enter their roles immediately. Some companies stipulate that all new college students who join the workforce must go to the front line for a year of training. Some students give up when they see that they cannot immediately engage in design or management work and will have to "suffer a year of hardship", and they lose a good job in vain. Lack of independence. Many college students only study books and do not have enough social practice. Every time they apply for a job, their parents must participate in the job search, but they lack independent opinions. After some graduates pass the written examination and interview, when signing a contract with a company, their parents come to discuss the conditions with the employer. HR directors at many companies expressed disgust at this behavior. "The prerequisite for finding a job is that you are an independent person with the ability to make your own judgment and be responsible for yourself," said an HR manager.

6315c6fd85eedfe5fde8ae04546967d1ef615822.sourceText: 联邦医疗保险 开放登记时间10月15日至12月7日 本訊息由「美國衛生與人類服務部」為您提供 您的健康需求每一年都會改變。而且，您的健康保險計劃每一年也都可能改變福利和費用。因此，每年評估您的「聯邦醫療保險」選項非常重要。「開放登記」（Open Enrollment）是「聯邦醫療保險」每年提供一次的機會，讓所有「聯邦醫療保險」受保人了解「聯邦醫療保險」有哪些新福利，並更改自己的承保範圍。 現在是了解聯邦醫療保險承保範圍的最好時候。不論您選擇原有「聯邦醫療保險」（Original Medicare）還是「聯邦醫療保險」優勢計劃（Medicare Advantage），所有「聯邦醫療保險」受保人都可享有一些新的福利，包括更低的處方費用、健康體檢和預防護理。好好利用「開放登記」，您就可能省錢或獲得更好的承保範圍，甚至兩者兼得。 登記期間提前有什麼好處？ 從今年起，「開放登記」提前到10月15日開始，而且時間延長（整整持續7週），讓 您 有足夠時間審查並更改您的承保範圍。不過，同樣是從今年開始，您將必須在12月7日之前就完成最後的選擇，決定您來年的「聯邦醫療保險」承保範圍。這項改變是為了確保 「聯邦醫療保險」 有充裕的時間處理您的選擇，好讓您的承保範圍能夠在1月1日無中斷地生效。 花時間審查並做比較是值得的，但是您不必獨力完成。如果您通常都利用12月的假期來和家人或朋友討論醫療護理的選項，現在請提早開始。還有，請記住，「聯邦醫療保險」隨時都能提供協助。 a. 造訪網站 www.medicare.gov/find-a-plan ，將您現有的承保內容與在您所居住地區擁有的選項做比較；如果您決定要做更改，就登記一個新的保險計劃。 b. 請致電（1-800-633-4227），每天24小時/每週7天，隨時查詢您的承保範圍選項。聽覺及語言有障人士請致電 （1-877-486-2048）。如您需要英語或西班牙語以外的其他語言幫助，隨時說「Agent」，即可與客戶服務代表交談。 c. 查閱「 聯邦醫療保險與您?201 2 年」（ M edicare & You 2012 ） 手冊，已在九月份寄給了所有「聯邦醫療保險」受保人。 d. 您可以從「州健康保險援助計劃」（State Health Insurance Assistance Program，SHIP）得到一對一服務。請致電１-800-633-4227或上網站 www.medicare.gov/contacts 查詢電話號碼。 e. 要接受華語幫助，請致電「全美亞太裔耆老中心」（NAPCA）（1-800-582-4218）。
6315c6fd85eedfe5fde8ae04546967d1ef615822.translatedText: Medicare enrollment is open from October 15 to December 7. This information is provided to you by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. Your health needs change every year. Also, your health insurance plan may change benefits and costs from year to year. Therefore, it is important to evaluate your Medicare options each year. "Open Enrollment" is an opportunity provided by Medicare once a year for all Medicare insured persons to learn about the new benefits of Medicare and to change their coverage. There's never been a better time to learn about Medicare coverage. Whether you choose Original Medicare or a Medicare Advantage plan, new benefits are available to all Medicare recipients, including lower prescription costs, wellness exams and preventive care. Take advantage of open enrollment and you might save money, get better coverage, or even both. What are the benefits of registering in advance? Starting this year, Open Enrollment begins earlier than October 15th and is extended (lasts a full 7 weeks), giving you enough time to review and make changes to your coverage. However, starting this year as well, you will have to make your final choices before December 7 to determine your "Medicare" coverage for the coming year. This change is to ensure that Medicare has ample time to process your choices so that your coverage can take effect without interruption on January 1. It's worth taking the time to review and compare, but you don't have to do it alone. If you typically use the December holidays to discuss health care options with family or friends, start early now. And, remember, Medicare is always here to help. a. Visit www.medicare.gov/find-a-plan to compare your current coverage with the options available where you live; if you decide you want to make a change, sign up for a new plan. b. Call (1-800-633-4227) 24 hours a day/7 days a week to inquire about your coverage options. People with hearing and speech impairments should call (1-877-486-2048). If you need help in a language other than English or Spanish, say "Agent" at any time to speak with a customer service representative. c. Review the Medicare & You 2012 brochure, which was mailed to all Medicare recipients in September. d. You can get one-on-one service from the State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP). Please call 1-800-633-4227 or go to www.medicare.gov/contacts for phone numbers. e. To receive assistance in Chinese, please call the National Center for Asian and Pacific American Aging (NAPCA) (1-800-582-4218).

d52089d7b1759f6c086fbb8f295d46a389d287ba.sourceText: B型肝炎，亚裔美籍人士的当地危机 2011年7月14日亚利桑那州凤凰城──世界健康组织已订7月28日为世界肝炎日。 然而对亚太小区促进会的执行长Doug Hirano而言，我们并不因全球注目才发现B型肝炎感染的危机。 Hirano先生说：”亚利桑那州健康服务部的数据显示，在玛瑞科帕郡的美籍亚裔过去五年内在已有纪录的慢性B型肝炎病例中占有40%，而亚裔人口仅占总人口的3%，这是一个警示。” 以全国性而言，每12位亚裔即有一位是终身感染B型肝炎，这是一种滤过性病毒侵害肝脏。对其他族裔的美国人口，感染慢性B型肝炎的比例一千人中仅有一人，没有医药的监测及治疗，慢性B型肝炎的人有25％将会得肝硬化或肝癌。疾病防治管制中心预估感染B型肝炎的人口中有25％对他们已经感染毫无所知。 Hirano先生表示，”全国性资料告知未诊断是否感染B型肝炎的亚裔人口比未诊断是否感染艾滋病的全美人口还要多。”他并指出，和艾滋病比较，对亚裔慢性B型肝炎问题的关注实在少得可怜，哪怕一项简单的抽血检测即可诊断是否感染，而一项疫苗亦可防治感染; 我们需要散播这些讯息使所有亚裔人口将可得到检测及注射疫苗。 对世界肝炎日的认知，亚太小区促进会，这个本地的非营利组织，将于7月30日（星期六）上午九时至下午一时举办一项免费B型肝炎检测及教育讲座，地点在越裔小区中心（2051 W. Warner Road, Suite 22, Chandler)。会场中并提供一些协助无健保的人士可申请公共基金健保计划或其他可提供医疗照顾的信息。 如需更多的讯息，请电 （602）265－4598 亚太小区促进会或上网 www.apcaaz.org 。 连络Doug Hirano先生， 请电邮 doug@apcaaz.org 或电（480）516－5038。
d52089d7b1759f6c086fbb8f295d46a389d287ba.translatedText: Hepatitis B, a local crisis for Asian Americans July 14, 2011 Phoenix, Arizona─The World Health Organization has designated July 28 as World Hepatitis Day. But for Doug Hirano, CEO of the Asia Pacific Community Initiative, the hepatitis B infection crisis didn't come to light because of global attention. "Data from the Arizona Department of Health Services shows that Asian Americans accounted for 40 percent of the chronic hepatitis B cases recorded in Maricopa County over the past five years, yet Asian Americans make up only 3 percent of the population," Mr. Hirano said. "This is a warning." Nationwide, one in 12 Asians has a lifelong infection with hepatitis B, a viral infection of the liver. For the American population of other ethnic groups, only one in 1,000 people are infected with chronic hepatitis B. Without medical monitoring and treatment, 25% of people with chronic hepatitis B will develop cirrhosis or liver cancer. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention estimates that 25% of people infected with hepatitis B are unaware that they are infected. Mr. Hirano said, "National data indicate that more Asians are undiagnosed with hepatitis B than are undiagnosed with HIV." He also pointed out that compared with HIV, attention to the problem of chronic hepatitis B in Asians is pitiful. Even a simple blood test can diagnose the infection, and a vaccine can prevent the infection; we need to disseminate this information so that all Asians will be able to get tested and vaccinated. In recognition of World Hepatitis Day, the Asian Pacific Community Initiative, a local non-profit organization, will host a free hepatitis B testing and education seminar on Saturday, July 30, from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the Vietnamese Community Center (2051 W. Warner Road, Suite 22, Chandler). Information will be provided at the venue to help people without health insurance apply for publicly funded health insurance plans or other medical care options. For more information, call the Asia Pacific Community Advancement Association at (602) 265-4598 or go to www.apcaaz.org. To contact Mr. Doug Hirano, please email doug@apcaaz.org or call (480) 516-5038.
