20e356567dc7ae848a118839286d71bf356064eb.translatedText: The smoke has cleared in the 2012 London Olympics badminton men’s singles final, Chinese superstar Lin Dan He defeated the Malaysian brother Lee Chong Wei 2-1 and became the first player in the history of the Olympics to win the men's singles championship in a row. "Super Grand Slam" Lin Dan has 50 career championships, 510 wins and 17 world championships. He is worthy of being the greatest men's singles player in history!

d6e51b35fb4b45dc751232babc0ac88d56af52bd.sourceText: 第一：林丹职业生涯50个大赛男单金牌历史第一。林丹年仅19岁的时候就在2002年韩国公开赛赢得第一个冠军头衔，其后10年来一发不可收，拿金牌拿到手软，奥运会、世锦赛、世界杯、亚运会、亚锦赛、总决赛这些金牌都是”必须的”，而各种公开赛林丹也不放过，什么韩国赛、全英赛、中国赛、日本赛、丹麦赛、法国赛、香港赛、德国赛、泰国赛、瑞士赛都拿了个遍。 Mitbbs.com 要知道，林丹这50个冠军都是男单冠军，不包括团体赛的冠军，完全靠一己之力缔造了羽毛球历史奇迹。大马一哥李宗伟号称”劳模”，他的参赛频率多得惊人，至少比林丹高两倍，但他职业生涯总共获得42个男单冠军，并没有林丹多。印尼天王出道比林丹早好几年，但男单冠军数只有25个，正好是林丹的一半。
d6e51b35fb4b45dc751232babc0ac88d56af52bd.translatedText: First: Lin Dan ranks first in the history of men's singles gold medals in 50 major competitions in his career. Lin Dan won his first championship title at the 2002 Korean Open when he was only 19 years old. Over the next 10 years, he never stopped winning gold medals. Gold medals in the Olympics, World Championships, World Cup, Asian Games, Asian Championships, and the finals were all "must haves." Mitbbs.com You must know that Lin Dan's 50 championships are all men's singles championships, excluding team championships. He created a miracle in badminton history entirely by himself. The first Malaysian brother, Lee Chong Wei, is known as a "model worker". He participates in astonishingly many competitions, at least twice as much as Lin Dan. However, he has won a total of 42 men's singles championships in his career, not as many as Lin Dan. The Indonesian king debuted several years earlier than Lin Dan, but he only has 25 men's singles championships, which is exactly half of Lin Dan's.

ea2d534fbd15f5b1fd9464878c16a5ddb24f1d53.sourceText: 第二：林丹羽联赛事510胜，历史胜率第一。林丹职业生涯总共打了510场比赛，510战447胜63负，净胜 384场，成为净胜场最多的现役男单球手，也以88%的胜率成为胜率最高的现役男单球手。作为史上唯一的全满贯，林丹的成就远在陶菲克、李宗伟、盖德等人之上。要是考虑到林丹不愿意冒着伤病加剧的危险参赛，在一些场次选择中途退赛（特别是与队友不必拼个鱼死网破），超级丹的数据可能会更加华丽！
ea2d534fbd15f5b1fd9464878c16a5ddb24f1d53.translatedText: Second: Lin Dan won 510 Badminton League matches, ranking first in historical winning rate. Lin Dan has played a total of 510 games in his career, with 447 wins and 63 losses in 510 games, with a net win of 384 games. He has become the active men's singles player with the largest net win rate and the highest winning rate of 88%. As the only Grand Slam in history, Lin Dan's achievements are far above those of Taufik, Lee Chong Wei, Gade and others. If we take into account that Lin Dan is not willing to take the risk of aggravating injuries and chooses to retire midway through some games (especially if he does not have to fight to the death with his teammates), Super Dan's data may be even more gorgeous!

dad04ee07d3d766c3e57e1a2c10f3624926d06aa.sourceText: 就算是追溯历史，林丹也是净胜场最高的，因为过去羽联承认的正式赛事远不及现在多，比赛安排也没有如今这样紧密。且不说林丹恩师 汤仙虎因政治原因基本没怎么参加过羽联的比赛，就是四大天王杨阳、赵剑华、苏吉亚托、弗罗斯特净胜场也不如林丹，丹麦的弗罗斯特曾经200多场连胜，但那些绝大部分不是羽联承认的顶级赛事。 Mitbbs.com 第三：林丹17个世界冠军历史第一。林丹职业生涯已经累计17个世界冠军，分别是：2008、2012年奥运冠军，2006、2007、2009、2011年世锦赛冠军，2005、2006年世界杯冠军，2005、2007、2009、2011年苏杯冠军，2004、2006、2008、2010年、2012年汤杯冠军。超级丹位列国羽世界冠军榜的第一位，这不但是国羽的纪录，也是世界羽坛的纪录，超级丹成为羽球历史上拥有世界冠军奖杯最多的球员。 Mitbbs.com 林丹仅仅靠一个单项就赢得17个世界冠军，简直堪称神话！羽球女皇李玲蔚拥有13个世界冠军，这其中包括双打金牌，并非全部来源于单打。高崚（15冠）、葛菲（13冠）都是出任女双和混双，李玲蔚是单双兼顾。印尼羽球天王陶菲克迄今只取得过4个世界冠军，分别是2004年奥运会冠军、2005年世锦赛冠军、2000、2002年汤杯冠军，可以说陶菲克的辉煌程度不到林丹的1/4！而大马一哥李宗伟的境况就更惨了，他从来没尝到过世界冠军的滋味 Mitbbs.com 第四：林丹是羽毛球历史上唯一的男单”超级全满贯”球手。奥运冠军、世锦赛冠军、世界杯冠军、全英赛冠军、苏迪曼杯冠军、汤姆斯杯冠军，亚运会冠军、亚锦赛冠军、总决赛冠军所有重量级大赛的金牌林丹都有斩获，这是任何人都难以企及的荣耀。陶菲克一直因拿不到苏杯、全英赛和世界杯冠军耿耿于怀，就连 汤仙虎、梁海量、林水镜等羽球标志性人物，也由于历史特殊年代等种种原因冠军欠收。 Mitbbs.com 第五：林丹成奥运会卫冕历史第一人。羽毛球1992年才正式被列入奥运比赛项目，1992年印尼的魏仁芳夺得冠军，1996年丹麦的拉尔森击败中国的董炯夺冠，2000年中国的吉新鹏大爆冷门摘金，2004年印尼的陶菲克登顶，而2008年、2012年奥运会林丹在决赛两次击败 李宗伟，成为了奥运男单卫冕第一人，也是双冠第一人。 Mitbbs.c
dad04ee07d3d766c3e57e1a2c10f3624926d06aa.translatedText: Even if we look back on history, Lin Dan still has the highest game margin, because in the past, the Badminton Federation recognized far fewer official events than now, and the competition arrangement was not as tight as it is now. Not to mention Lin Dan’s mentor, Tang Xianhu, has rarely participated in Badminton Federation competitions due to political reasons. Even the four kings Yang Yang, Zhao Jianhua, Sugiarto, and Frost’s game winning margin is not as good as Lin Dan. Denmark’s Frost once won more than 200 consecutive games, but most of those are not top events recognized by the Badminton Federation. Mitbbs.com Third: Lin Dan ranks first in history with 17 world championships. Lin Dan has accumulated 17 world championships in his career, including: 2008 and 2012 Olympic champions, 2006, 2007, 2009, 2011 world championships, 2005 , 2006 World Cup champion, 2005, 2007, 2009, 2011 Soviet Cup champion, 2004, 2006, 2008, 2010, 2012 Thomas Cup champion. Super Dan ranks first in the national badminton world championship list. This is not only a record for the national badminton team, but also a record for the world badminton world. Super Dan has become the player with the most world championship trophies in the history of badminton. Mitbbs.com Lin Dan won 17 world championships in just one event, which is simply a myth! Badminton queen Li Lingwei has 13 world championships, including doubles gold medals, not all of which come from singles. Gao Ling (15th crown) and Ge Fei (13th crown) both played women's doubles and mixed doubles, while Li Lingwei played both singles and doubles. Indonesian badminton king Taufik has only won 4 world championships so far, namely the 2004 Olympic champion, the 2005 World Championship champion, and the 2000 and 2002 Thomas Cup champions. It can be said that Taufik's glory is less than 1/4 of Lin Dan! The situation of Malaysian brother Lee Chong Wei is even worse. He has never tasted the taste of a world championship. Mitbbs.com Fourth: Lin Dan is the only men's singles "Super Grand Slam" player in the history of badminton. Lin Dan has won gold medals in all heavyweight competitions, including Olympic champion, World Championship champion, World Cup champion, All England champion, Sudirman Cup champion, Thomas Cup champion, Asian Games champion, Asian Championship champion, and Finals champion. This is an honor that is difficult for anyone to achieve. Taufik has always been brooding over his failure to win the Soviet Cup, All England and World Cup titles. Even iconic badminton figures such as Tang Xianhu, Liang Hailiang and Lin Shuijing have failed to win championships due to various reasons such as the special era in history. Mitbbs.com Fifth: Lin Dan becomes the first person in Olympic history to defend the title. Badminton was only officially included in the Olympic Games in 1992. In 1992, Indonesia's Wei Renfang won the championship. In 1996, Denmark's Larsson defeated China's Dong Jiong to win the championship. In 2000, China's Ji Xinpeng won the gold in an upset. In 2004, Indonesia's Taufik reached the top. In the 2008 and 2012 Olympic Games, Lin Dan defeated Lee Chong Wei twice in the finals, becoming the first person to defend the Olympic men's singles title and the first person to double crown. Mitbbs.c

dfeb9bb4df8b05aed5a6ec685e7867f6c71e3a19.sourceText: 向林丹致敬!卫冕第1人 羽坛霸主背后多少艰辛 Mitbbs.com
dfeb9bb4df8b05aed5a6ec685e7867f6c71e3a19.translatedText: Salute to Lin Dan! The first man to defend the title, how much hardship is behind the badminton hegemony Mitbbs.com

23dae0c60f90940392e397e5ddc8da46b5248d5a.sourceText: 北京时间8月5日，伦敦奥运会羽毛球男子单打决赛决出最后胜者，中国羽毛球王牌运动员林丹战胜了老对手李宗伟，获得了这枚含金量极高的奥运金牌，从而缔造奥运男单卫冕第一人传奇。 Mitbbs.com 在这场超级强强对话中，林丹不仅捍卫了中国羽毛球的荣誉，更是再次证明了自己世界第一的霸主地位，向林丹致敬，向”超级丹”敬礼。让我们走进林丹的世界，看看他有那些故事，看看他故事背后又有那些鲜为人知的艰辛和苦辣。 Mitbbs.com
23dae0c60f90940392e397e5ddc8da46b5248d5a.translatedText: On August 5, Beijing time, the final winner was decided in the badminton men's singles final of the London Olympics. Chinese badminton ace Lin Dan defeated his old rival Lee Chong Wei and won this highly valuable Olympic gold medal, thereby creating the legend of the first man to defend the Olympic men's singles title. Mitbbs.com In this super-powerful dialogue, Lin Dan not only defended the honor of Chinese badminton, but also once again proved his dominance as the world's number one. He paid tribute to Lin Dan and saluted "Super Dan". Let's step into Lin Dan's world, see what stories he has, and see the little-known hardships and hardships behind his stories. Mitbbs.com

783b3e1a92c31a919651a85c0400d4878f7c21fd.sourceText: 希望棗5岁爱上羽毛球，19岁称霸世界 Mitbbs.com 林丹生长在一个体育气氛浓厚的家庭，爸爸和妈妈都都非常喜欢体育，也经常出去打比赛，这算是林丹能走上羽毛球这条道路的一个铺垫。有一天，林丹随着父母去体育馆锻炼，那是他第一次见到羽毛球，看着小朋友在球场上跑来跑去，潇洒的挥拍，巧妙的街球，这些景象深深了林丹，那年林丹仅仅5岁。 Mitbbs.com 随后，林丹很快的就参加了业余培训班，一个中国羽毛球的领军人物就这样诞生了。随着林丹在羽毛球的道路上节节升高，进入国家队也是理所当然。 Mitbbs.com 2002年8月22日，这是一个值得林丹记住的日子，那天不满19岁的林丹登上了国际羽联第一的宝座，虽然只是保持了一周的时间，但这足够让世界为之惊呼：世界羽毛球界出现了一个绝世天才！而从2004年到2008年，林丹几乎占据了男单世界第一的宝座，林丹也被人们赋予了”超级丹”的称号。 Mitbbs.com 2012年，林丹在伦敦奥运会上，背负着国人的期望战胜宿敌李宗伟，拿到了这枚意义重大的男单金牌，这也是这届奥运会中国羽毛球队含金量最高的一枚金牌。”超级丹”征服了伦敦，也征服了世界。 itbbs.com 如今的林丹是一个帅气的男子汉，英俊的面庞和强壮的身体，让无数女性球迷迷恋。但鲜为人知的是，林丹小时候是被当成女孩养的。小时候，林妈妈总是把胖乎乎的林丹当成女孩来打扮，林丹的脸被妈妈抹红也是家常便饭。自然，林丹父母是不想让儿子打球的，但生性活泼的林丹还是在五岁那年走上了羽毛球这条道路，而一走就是20多年。 Mitbbs.com
783b3e1a92c31a919651a85c0400d4878f7c21fd.translatedText: I hope Zao will fall in love with badminton at the age of 5 and dominate the world at the age of 19. Mitbbs.com Lin Dan grew up in a family with a strong sports atmosphere. Both his father and mother like sports very much and often go out to play games. This can be regarded as a pavement for Lin Dan to embark on the path of badminton. One day, Lin Dan went to the gym to exercise with his parents. It was the first time he saw badminton. Watching the children running around on the court, swinging the racket gracefully, and playing clever streetball, these scenes deeply impressed Lin Dan. Lin Dan was only 5 years old at that time. Mitbbs.com Subsequently, Lin Dan quickly participated in amateur training classes, and a leading figure in Chinese badminton was born. As Lin Dan continues to improve in badminton, it is natural for him to enter the national team. Mitbbs.com August 22, 2002, is a day worth remembering for Lin Dan. On that day, Lin Dan, who was under 19 years old, ascended to the number one spot in the International Badminton Federation. Although it only lasted for a week, it was enough for the world to exclaim: A peerless genius has appeared in the world of badminton! From 2004 to 2008, Lin Dan almost occupied the world's number one spot in men's singles, and Lin Dan was also given the title of "Super Dan". Mitbbs.com In 2012, at the London Olympics, Lin Dan, carrying the expectations of the Chinese people, defeated his old enemy Lee Chong Wei and won this significant men's singles gold medal. This was also the gold medal with the highest gold content for the Chinese badminton team in this Olympic Games. "Super Dan" conquered London and the world. itbbs.com Today, Lin Dan is a handsome man, with a handsome face and a strong body, which has fascinated countless female fans. But what is less known is that Lin Dan was raised as a girl when she was a child. When she was a child, Lin's mother always dressed up chubby Lin Dan as a girl, and it was common for Lin Dan's face to be wiped red by her mother. Naturally, Lin Dan's parents did not want their son to play basketball, but Lin Dan, who is lively by nature, still embarked on the path of badminton when he was five years old, and he has been doing so for more than 20 years. Mitbbs.com

95bc2220d21752e69b10ede2452c231608e9eb50.sourceText: 梦想从”奇思妙想”开始 Mitbbs.com ”好样的林丹！世界冠军！”开启了林丹传奇的羽毛球生涯，这还是林丹小时候在家，自己看中国女排比赛时候的故事。当林丹的启蒙教练到林丹家里的时候，发现林丹正在手舞足蹈的激情”解说”。 Mitbbs.com 原来林丹把电视机中宋世雄说的郎平都统统换成了自己，小林丹正在幻想着自己成为世界冠军……可正也是这种”奇思妙想”，让林丹能够在同龄人中显得出类拔萃，与众不同。 Mitbbs.com 可林丹想要成为一名”世界冠军”，他也要经受和其他运动员一样的”痛苦”磨练。从小天生左撇子的林丹，确实在练球的过程中拥有不可忽视的优势，但我们仍然不能抹杀林丹的付出，一分耕耘一分收获。相信人们很难想象得到，刚到体校练球的时候，林丹一天都会哭一次。1992年，9岁的林丹进入福建省体校，第一次离家的他很不适应，几乎每天都要哭，一天写一封信催爸爸妈妈来看他。直到今天，林丹妈妈还保留着其中的一些信。度过最初的适应期后，林丹要强好胜的一面才逐渐表现出来厖 Mitbbs.com 好强的林丹每个周日都要跑步，冬天林丹怕耽误”训练”。就向妈妈提了一个小要求，：”妈妈，你4点半先叫醒我，然后让我多睡半小时，再叫醒我，行么？”听到这句话的林妈妈，眼睛瞬间就湿润了。那时候林丹才5岁，一个5岁的孩子能说出这样的话，怎能不让人感动。 Mitbbs.com
95bc2220d21752e69b10ede2452c231608e9eb50.translatedText: Dreams start with "wonderful ideas" Mitbbs.com "Well done Lin Dan! World champion!" started Lin Dan's legendary badminton career. This was the story of Lin Dan when he was watching the Chinese women's volleyball match at home when he was a child. When Lin Dan's first coach came to Lin Dan's home, he found Lin Dan dancing and passionately "explaining". Mitbbs.com It turns out that Lin Dan replaced Lang Ping who was mentioned by Song Shixiong on the TV with himself. Young Lin Dan was fantasizing about becoming a world champion... But it was this kind of "fantasy" that made Lin Dan outstanding and different among his peers. Mitbbs.com But if Lin Dan wants to become a "world champion", he also has to undergo the same "painful" training as other athletes. Lin Dan, who has been born left-handed since he was a child, does have an advantage that cannot be ignored in the process of practicing football, but we still cannot deny Lin Dan's efforts. Every effort is rewarded. I believe it is hard for people to imagine that when he first arrived at the sports school to practice, Lin Dan would cry once a day. In 1992, 9-year-old Lin Dan entered the Fujian Provincial Sports School. He was very uncomfortable with leaving home for the first time. He cried almost every day and wrote a letter every day urging his parents to come see him. To this day, Lin Dan’s mother still keeps some of the letters. After the initial adaptation period, Lin Dan's competitive side gradually emerged. Mitbbs.com Lin Dan, who is so strong, has to run every Sunday. In winter, Lin Dan is afraid of delaying his "training". I made a small request to my mother: "Mom, please wake me up at 4:30, then let me sleep for half an hour more, and then wake me up again, okay?" After hearing this, Mother Lin's eyes instantly became moist. Lin Dan was only 5 years old at that time. How could a 5-year-old child not be moved by such words? Mitbbs.com

796579f1d94646c5ddc51fe60f372fea148da1e5.sourceText: 军旅生活让林丹成熟 Mitbbs.com
796579f1d94646c5ddc51fe60f372fea148da1e5.translatedText: Military life made Lin Dan mature Mitbbs.com

c0eae9a722c0468577c18ac1cfe16987548cbf9c.sourceText: 如果说对林丹性格影响最大的是哪个成长阶段，那么一定要说他在八一队的那段时间。1995年，获得了全国青少年比赛的男单冠军的林丹，被八一队相中。随后林丹也成了一名军人，不过脾气极其不好的林丹在八一队的日子可十分不好过。常常因为球打得不好，林丹冲动起来不是摔拍子就是骂脏话。因此林丹被教练罚跑步是一件再正常不过的事情，可这一切从1997年开始有了改变，一次随队到部队体验了军旅生后，林丹开始意识到，作为军人他还很不够格，从那以后林丹开始了严格要求自己。 Mitbbs.com
c0eae9a722c0468577c18ac1cfe16987548cbf9c.translatedText: If there is a growth stage that has the greatest impact on Lin Dan’s character, then it must be his time in the Bayi team. In 1995, Lin Dan, who won the men's singles championship in the national youth competition, was chosen by the Bayi team. Later, Lin Dan also became a soldier, but Lin Dan, who had an extremely bad temper, had a very difficult time in the Bayi Team. Often because Lin Dan doesn't play well, he will either throw his racket or curse when he gets impulsive. Therefore, it was normal for Lin Dan to be punished by the coach for running. But all this began to change in 1997. After experiencing military training in the army with the team, Lin Dan began to realize that he was not qualified as a soldier. From then on, Lin Dan began to strictly demand himself. Mitbbs.com

0461f3f74170a678d56ad637255d8137d67e1671.sourceText: 曾经错过没关系 浪子回头金不换 Mitbbs.
0461f3f74170a678d56ad637255d8137d67e1671.translatedText: It doesn't matter if you missed it once. The prodigal son returns with gold. Mitbbs.

dbd3af4cda65c3e2b37c45deecf8f8f539a3a5d1.sourceText: 要说最能体现林丹心高气傲的片段是什么，那么那句”当我结束运动生涯时，没有人能够超过我的纪录。”最合适不过了，林丹一直在努力，他想用强悍的实力去掌控自己的人生。无论是比赛，训练，还是什么，林丹都要争做第一。 Mitbbs.com 一次林丹代表八一队去成都参加一个比赛，林丹拿到了第一名。赛后吃饭的时候，输球的一方挑衅林丹，”你打羽毛球可以拿第一名，吃辣椒行么？要不比一比，看看谁可以拿第一。”对方这一举动可把好胜的林丹那内心的小宇宙激发了出来，林丹当场就应战了。后果就是当晚，林丹犯了急性阑尾炎，被送进了医院…… Mitbbs.com 1998年，林丹开始了自己国字号的经历，在国字号林丹有三次挫折，一是1999年因为训练贪玩、比赛随意曾被国青开除，二是曾经一年不胜，三就是雅典首轮输球了。 Mitbbs.com 如果说两次的挫折对于林丹没有什么警醒，那么雅典遭遇滑铁卢，则是林丹人生转变的一次。回国后，林丹一次坐出租车被司机认了出来，没想到这位司机是个羽毛球迷，路上司机开始开导林丹，告诉他要怎么对付国外高手……这也成了羽毛球队中的一个经典笑话。另一个故事就是，林丹爬山的时候，球迷对林丹喊：”加油，不要再输给陶菲克！”正是在林丹困难时候，有了球迷的支持，林丹才真正的成熟，走过了那段低谷。至今，林丹也能回忆出当时的感觉：”我暗下决心，一定要换种活法，不能让大家再失望
dbd3af4cda65c3e2b37c45deecf8f8f539a3a5d1.translatedText: If you want to say what is the clip that best reflects Lin Dan's arrogance, then the sentence "When I end my sports career, no one can surpass my record." is the most appropriate. Lin Dan has been working hard, and he wants to use his strong strength to control his life. Whether it's competition, training, or anything else, Lin Dan must strive to be the first. Mitbbs.com Once Lin Dan went to Chengdu to participate in a competition on behalf of the Bayi team, and Lin Dan won first place. When eating after the game, the losing side challenged Lin Dan, "You can get first place in badminton, how about eating chili peppers? Why don't we compete and see who can get first place." This move of the other party brought out the inner universe of the competitive Lin Dan, and Lin Dan accepted the challenge on the spot. The consequence was that that night, Lin Dan suffered from acute appendicitis and was sent to the hospital... Mitbbs.com In 1998, Lin Dan began his experience as a national champion. Lin Dan had three setbacks during his time as a national champion. First, he was expelled from the National Youth League in 1999 because of his playfulness in training and haphazard play. Second, he had been winless for a year, and third, he lost in the first round in Athens. Mitbbs.com If the two setbacks did not serve as a warning to Lin Dan, then the Waterloo encounter in Athens was a change in Lin Dan's life. After returning to China, Lin Dan was recognized by a driver in a taxi. Unexpectedly, the driver was a badminton fan. On the way, the driver began to enlighten Lin Dan and told him how to deal with foreign masters... This has become a classic joke among badminton teams. Another story is that when Lin Dan was climbing the mountain, the fans shouted to Lin Dan: "Come on, don't lose to Taufik again!" It was during Lin Dan's difficult time, with the support of the fans, that Lin Dan truly matured and passed through that trough. To this day, Lin Dan can still recall the feeling at that time: "I secretly made up my mind to change my life and not let everyone down again

b4f48babe9cef87018b202022469cb22fb1646b2.sourceText: 小林丹爱上大姐姐 执著追求中获芳心 Mitb
b4f48babe9cef87018b202022469cb22fb1646b2.translatedText: Little Lin Dan fell in love with his elder sister and won her heart through persistent pursuit. Mitb

65274a1d93af47c08bfcd31f5cdfca2c4ed31977.sourceText: 林丹和谢杏芳的那段爱情，虽然如今已经早已有了硕果。但它仍然是一段流传在人们生活中的一段佳话。中国版”小贝和辣妹”的恋情，开始时候并非是那么顺利…… Mitbbs.com 2002年，一次羽毛球队混合训练，林丹和谢杏芳分在了一起，林丹被谢杏芳深深迷住了，看着比他还高的谢杏芳，迷人的酒窝和白皙的皮肤，林丹开始喜欢上了谢杏芳。而那场比赛林丹被谢杏芳2-0横扫，这也气得场边的教练直骂：”你怎么搞的啊，连个女队员都不能打下来，你还怎么成为世界第一！” itbbs.com 输了球的林丹回到宿舍，他并没有发脾气，而是变得魂不守舍，同屋的鲍春来看出了林丹的心事，打趣的说：”兄弟，没戏啊。你比人家还矮一截，视觉效果就不行，人家看不上你的。”可看到林丹这次是来真的，好兄弟鲍春来就给他支招，想帮不好意思的林丹去表白。但林丹就噎住鲍春来，”是我爱他，你帮什么忙啊。我要自己去表白！” Mitbbs.com 之后，林丹就频频约谢杏芳打球，时间久了谢杏芳就看出了问题，并且也明确的拒绝了林丹，可林丹还是不依不饶的，再一次训练中，林丹又和谢杏芳分在一起，每扣一次球的时候，林丹就喊一句：”谢杏芳！”这让在众目睽睽之下的谢杏芳，委屈的扔下球拍就跑了。从那之后，谢杏芳就躲着林丹，在她眼中，年龄和身高成了一种无形的压力….. Mitbbs.com 林丹没有因为这些就放弃追求自己的爱情，而是”变本加厉”的展开攻势，终于经过漫长的追求，两人在一起了，随后的事情就是大家都已经熟知的经典爱情佳话。不过，人们不知道的是，这段爱情起初，羽毛球队的教练李永波并不支持，还找过林丹谈话，让他不要耽误谢杏芳的发展，可林丹一句：”教练你放心，我谈恋爱肯定不会影响训练和比赛。我除了自己拿世界冠军之外，还保证帮助小芳拿世界冠军！”，让李永波把不放心都收回去，这是一个男人的承诺，它不需要任何载体来记载。 Mitbbs.com 我们可以看到林丹内心对荣誉的渴望，原谅他年少的放荡不羁，年轻谁不曾错过，那段岁月笑过，哭过，但也是最值得回味的一个人生阶段。 Mitbbs.com
65274a1d93af47c08bfcd31f5cdfca2c4ed31977.translatedText: >The love between Lin Dan and Xie Xingfang has already achieved fruitful results, but it is still a good story that is spread in people's lives. The relationship between the Chinese version of "Xiao Bei and the Spice Girl" was not so smooth at the beginning... Mitbbs.com. In 2002, during a badminton team mixed training, Lin Dan and Xie Xingfang were together. Lin Dan was deeply fascinated by Xie Xingfang. Looking at Xie Xingfang, who was taller than him, with charming dimples and fair skin, Lin Dan began to like Xie Xingfang. In that game, Lin Dan was swept by Xie Xingfang 2-0. This made the coach on the sidelines scolded: "How did you do it? You can't even defeat a female player, how can you become the number one in the world!" " itbbs.com After losing the game, Lin Dan returned to the dormitory. He did not lose his temper, but became distraught. Bao Chunlai, who lived in the same room, saw Lin Dan's thoughts and joked: "Brother, it's no good." If you are a bit shorter than others, your visual effect is not good, and others will look down on you. "But seeing that Lin Dan was serious this time, his good brother Bao Chunlai gave him some advice and wanted to help the embarrassed Lin Dan confess his love. But Lin Dan choked Bao Chunlai, "I love him, why are you helping me?" I want to confess it myself! " Mitbbs.com After that, Lin Dan frequently asked Xie Xingfang to play. After a while, Xie Xingfang saw the problem and clearly rejected Lin Dan. However, Lin Dan was still reluctant. During another training, Lin Dan and Xie Xingfang were together again. Every time he spiked the ball, Lin Dan shouted: "Xie Xingfang!" "This made Xie Xingfang, who was in full view of the public, throw down the racket and run away in grievance. Since then, Xie Xingfang has been avoiding Lin Dan. In her eyes, age and height have become an invisible pressure... Mitbbs.com Lin Dan did not give up pursuing his love because of this, but launched an "intensified" offensive. Finally, after a long pursuit, the two got together. What happened next is a classic love story that everyone is already familiar with. However, what people don't know is that at first, the badminton team coach Li Yongbo did not support this love. He also talked to Lin Dan and asked him not to delay Xie Xingfang's development, but Lin Dan said: "Coach, don't worry, my falling in love will definitely not affect training and competition." In addition to winning the world championship myself, I also promise to help Xiaofang win the world championship! "Let Li Yongbo take back all his worries. This is a man's promise, which does not need any carrier to record. Mitbbs.com We can see Lin Dan's inner desire for honor, and forgive him for his youthful bohemianism. Who has never missed being young? Those years have laughed and cried, but it is also the most memorable stage of life. Mitbbs.com

1b1ee044605f2cfa58f0f50049bd6520bdb5d003.sourceText: 三十年固定利率为4.52% 大额贷款费用超低 根据最新的经济与房屋数据提供的数据，最近30年固定贷款利率平均为4.52%，15年固定贷款利率为3.66%。 截止到7月21日，三十年的房屋贷款固定利率变为4.52%，比前一周上调了0.01%，与去年统一时期相比低了0.04%。15年的固定利率低得更多，比去年同一时期低了0.37%。五年和一年的贷款利率也下降了很多。因为低利率，很多高端房屋的销售市场也开始启动。贷款额度在百万以上的房子，在6月，7月销售开始启动。百万以上的大额贷款得到低利率的优惠，所付利息几乎是近十年来的低点，天堂谷多个两百万以上的房子都成功卖出。房地产业内人士对凤凰城市场复苏充满信心。
1b1ee044605f2cfa58f0f50049bd6520bdb5d003.translatedText: Thirty-year fixed interest rates are 4.52% for large loans. According to the latest economic and housing data, the average 30-year fixed loan interest rate is 4.52%, and the 15-year fixed loan interest rate is 3.66%. As of July 21, the thirty-year fixed interest rate for home loans was 4.52%, an increase of 0.01% from the previous week and 0.04% lower than the same period last year. The 15-year fixed rate is even lower, 0.37% lower than this time last year. Five-year and one-year loan rates have also dropped significantly. Because of low interest rates, the sales market for many high-end homes has also begun. Sales of houses with a loan amount of more than one million start in June and July. Large loans of more than one million yuan received discounted interest rates, and the interest paid was almost the lowest in the past decade. Many houses worth more than two million yuan in Paradise Valley were successfully sold. Real estate industry insiders are confident about the recovery of the Phoenix market.

264588f3b1f281c26d45d3c0da6da1e12629a8c3.sourceText: 司威立与西餐厨艺教育 图桑 嘉霖 当年唐德刚教授说，因为旅美华人中作教授者的人数之多、质量之高，”无湘不成军”的老话可以移植到美国学术界来，变作”无华不成军”。也就是说”无华人不成学校”。笔者作为学界的芸芸华人中之一员，如今却对另外一句老话感慨系之，那就是”三百六十行，行行出状元。” 早就听到美国主流西厨界杰出人士司威立(司宛春；Bill Sy) 先生的大名。美国的中餐界，杰出的厨艺大师多得不可胜数，而司教授是公认的全美西餐界一百位顶级大师(master chef) 之一，也是点将录上惟一的华裔。 司先生与我同在台湾长大、受教育，同在60年代来美读书，又同为《亚省时报》写作,有时拙文的一侧就是司先生写的有关厨艺的专栏,但却一直缘悭一面。直到今年五月，才在台湾同乡联谊会的表演会上见到他。承司先生邀请，我与我的博士生刘晓艺得以参观由他所主持的图桑艺术学院厨艺学校。 图桑艺术学院（Art Institute of Tucson）坐落于东格兰大街，内分几个主要教育领域：烹饪艺术、设计、服装、和媒体艺术。走进气派整洁的学院大楼内，我们被导入厨艺管理学院所在的南厢。有一排展示橱窗介绍西餐流派和科目，其中一个挂满司宛春在欧美厨艺比赛中获得的金牌和照片，琳琅满目。 司教授已担任亚利桑那州厨艺协会主席多年。两年前，司教授应图桑艺术学院之聘，由凤凰城来图桑主持新成立的厨艺学院。第一年学生仅有七人，而两年后的今天，在此学厨艺的学生已有一百五十人，发展之迅速，都是司教授苦心经营的成果。 厨艺学校的学生中有各行各业的人，甚至有外科医生。我们问道：”医生不好好地行医，在百忙中还来厨艺学校上课，这是欠了哪根筋？”司先生笑答说，”俗话说：’吃一行，怨一行’。这外科医生平素在医院诊所看到的是生老病死，说这个高压的行业，钱是赚得多，生命的耗损也很可观。因此他退休后要去做厨师?#36825;才是他的爱好。记得这儿有位学药学的华裔，忽然不做药剂师了，要去开中餐馆。问他为什么？他说，抓药给病人，一个个都是苦着脸，看了难过极了；而炒出来的菜，客人吃了高高兴兴的，自己也就越做越高兴了。” 司教授本人的经历也同样多姿多彩。他祖籍山东，因父亲经商侨寓于韩国而生于韩国，大陆变色，韩战发生，一家人有国难归，于是在他童年时辗转来到台湾。他在台湾师范大学毕业后留美，在旧金山念工商管理，那时为筹学费，进入五星级的费尔蒙酒店做事。获顶级大厨的赏识，又蒙他悉心指点，因此得以学到酒店管埋与西餐厨艺的精髓。建国中学时代学得的奋斗精神，无时或忘。在不断努力之下，百尺竿头更进一步，青出于蓝而胜于蓝，终于奠定他在西餐界的杰出地位。 司教授拥有工商管理硕士学位，又进修教育领导学，将获博士学位。他向我们介绍说，厨艺学院的课程，并非只针对一般性厨师的培养，它的教学兼及烘焙学、民族厨艺、酒食匹配和厨艺管理,又包括世界级的餐饮酒店管理，饮食服务等。即将学成前实习的项目就是在图桑艺术学院餐厅实际操作以做好进入业界工作的准备。 图桑艺术学院丛去年七月开始，设立了附属餐厅(Art Institute Bistro) ，每星期有三天中午对外营业，必须预先电话定位。我们品尝的是烤立鱼，配以凯撒色拉，和尾食烤阿拉斯加。果然名师出高徒，每一道都是色香味俱属上乘，精心制作的艺术品。试吃以后，回味无穷。住在图桑的人有口福了。 司教授是美国唯一的一位亚裔国际厨艺大赛亚太区合格评委。证照是由世界厨艺协会所核发。司教授说- 做评委有机会向年轻后进学习，是吸收新知织，新理念的好一机会，获益良多。
264588f3b1f281c26d45d3c0da6da1e12629a8c3.translatedText: Swillie and Western Culinary Arts Education Tucson Jialin At that time, Professor Tang Degang said that because of the large number and high quality of Chinese professors in the United States, the old saying "Without Hunan, you cannot form an army" could be transplanted to the American academic community and become "Without China, you cannot form an army." In other words, "there is no school without Chinese people." As one of the Chinese people in the academic world, the author is now deeply moved by another old saying, that is, "Three hundred and sixty years of practice will lead to a top scholar." I have long heard the name of Mr. Bill Sy, an outstanding figure in the mainstream Western culinary industry in the United States. There are countless outstanding culinary masters in the Chinese food industry in the United States, and Professor Si is recognized as one of the top 100 master chefs in the American Western food industry, and he is also the only Chinese-American on the Dianjiang list. Mr. Si and I both grew up and were educated in Taiwan. We both came to the United States to study in the 1960s, and we both wrote for the "Alberta Times." Sometimes, one side of my articles is a column about cooking by Mr. Si, but we have always been side by side. It wasn't until May this year that I met him at a Taiwanese Association performance. At the invitation of Mr. Cheng Si, my doctoral student Liu Xiaoyi and I were able to visit the Culinary Arts School of Tucson Academy of the Arts, which he directed. The Art Institute of Tucson is located on East Grand Street and has several major educational areas: culinary arts, design, costume, and media arts. Walking into the elegant and tidy college building, we were led into the south wing where the School of Culinary Arts Management is located. There is a row of display windows introducing Western food genres and subjects. One of them is filled with gold medals and photos that Si Wanchun won in European and American cooking competitions. Professor Si has served as the president of the Arizona Culinary Arts Association for many years. Two years ago, Professor Si was hired by the Tucson Art Institute to come to Tucson from Phoenix to preside over the newly established Culinary Arts Institute. There were only seven students in the first year, but today, two years later, there are 150 students studying cooking here. The rapid development is the result of Professor Si's hard work. Among the students at the culinary school are people from all walks of life, even surgeons. We asked: "Does a doctor not practice medicine well and come to a culinary school to take classes even though he is busy?" Mr. Si replied with a smile, "As the saying goes: 'Eat what you do, blame what you do'. This surgeon usually saw life, old age, illness and death in hospitals and clinics. He said that in this high-pressure industry, he made a lot of money and the loss of life was also considerable. So he retired. He wanted to be a chef in the future. I remember there was a Chinese who studied medicine but suddenly stopped working as a pharmacist and wanted to open a Chinese restaurant. When I asked him why, he said that when he gave the medicine to the patients, everyone looked sad. But when the guests ate the dishes, he became even happier. " Professor Si’s own experience is equally colorful. His ancestral home is Shandong, and he was born in South Korea because his father was a businessman living in South Korea. The situation in the mainland changed, and the Korean War broke out. The family was in trouble and it was difficult to return, so he came to Taiwan when he was a child. After graduating from Taiwan Normal University, he stayed in the United States and studied business administration in San Francisco. At that time, to raise tuition, he worked at the five-star Fairmont Hotel. He was appreciated by top chefs and received his careful guidance, so he was able to learn the essence of hotel management and Western cooking skills. The fighting spirit I learned in Jianguo Middle School will never be forgotten. With continuous efforts, he made further progress and became better than his master, finally establishing his outstanding position in the Western food industry. Professor Si holds a master's degree in business administration and has further studied educational leadership and will receive a doctorate. He introduced to us that the curriculum of the Culinary Arts Institute is not just for the training of general chefs. Its teaching also covers baking, ethnic cooking, wine and food matching and cooking management, as well as world-class catering and hotel management, catering services, etc. The pre-completion internship project is to work in the restaurant of Tucson Art Institute to prepare for working in the industry. Tucson Art Institute has established an affiliated restaurant (Art Institute Bistro) since July last year. It is open to the public at noon three days a week. You must call in advance to make a reservation. We tasted the grilled fish with Caesar salad and the grilled Alaskan tail. As expected, famous teachers give birth to great disciples, and every dish is a carefully crafted work of art that is of the highest quality in color, fragrance, and taste. After trying it, I had endless aftertaste. Those who live in Tucson are in luck. Professor Si is the only Asian qualified judge in the Asia-Pacific region of the International Culinary Competition in the United States. The license is issued by the World Culinary Association. Professor Si said - Being a judge gives you the opportunity to learn from young talents. It is a good opportunity to absorb new knowledge and ideas, and you will benefit a lot.

59cb5f6fbab8f876ee6efc3ed3c555f58aa7aee9.sourceText: 亚利桑那云丝路周日发生地震 3.1级 （亚省时报） 美国地质勘探局报告周日在本州云丝路（ Winslow ）发生里氏 3.1 级地震。 地质勘探局，地震发生在下午 12:11 ，云丝路的西南约 21 英里，凤凰城东北约 113 英里。 震源在离地面超过 3 英里的深度，这场地震相对较浅。 谷歌地球显示震中之间出现小的休眠火山。震中位于科罗拉多高原和莫高兰山脉之间的南部。 谷歌地球也表现了陨石群离震中不远。流星陨石坑是这个星球上最知名的陨石撞击坑之一，在云丝路西部 20 英里 处。
59cb5f6fbab8f876ee6efc3ed3c555f58aa7aee9.translatedText: An earthquake of magnitude 3.1 hit Winslow, Arizona on Sunday (Alberta Times) The United States Geological Survey reported that a magnitude 3.1 earthquake hit Winslow, Arizona on Sunday. A magnitude 3.1 earthquake. The quake struck at 12:11 p.m., about 21 miles southwest of Cloud Silk Road and about 113 miles northeast of Phoenix, according to the U.S. Geological Survey. With the epicenter at a depth of more than 3 miles above the surface, the earthquake was relatively shallow. Google Earth shows small dormant volcanoes emerging between the epicenters. The epicenter was in the south between the Colorado Plateau and the Mogolan Mountains. Google Earth also shows meteorite clusters not far from the epicenter. Meteor Crater is one of the most famous meteorite impact craters on the planet, located 20 miles west of Cloud Silk Road.

1130cf324214f98b48d624b7b9689bc6ff2e1b76.sourceText: 马利科巴郡治安官上周五搜查两家本地餐馆，拘捕七名涉嫌盗用他人身份的非法移民。 警方接获线报，声称美莎市和钱德勒市的两家墨西哥餐厅雇用14名使用虚假身份在美国工作的非法移民，于是出动两个搜查令，成功拘捕七名嫌疑人。 ”?盗用他人身份是一个四级重罪，非常严重的犯罪。??阿派奥警长事后说，??而且雇主也会受到重罚。?? ”随着经济不景，失业率高居不下，雇主应聘请合法美国公民，而非那些廉价、非法劳动力。”阿派奥警长说。 这是郡治安办公室捕获的第53起盗用他人身份案。 事实上，联邦政府严查非法移民，稽查雇主对员工身份核实的行动早已开始。 美国移民律师协会提醒雇主应立即重整员工I-9档案，如果有案底遗失或未建档的情况，雇主需立即亡羊补牢，但不能伪造过去的立案日期。 法律没有要求雇主保存员工受雇时提供的工作资格证件样本，但如果内部重新登录时发现明显的伪造证件证据，最好立即召回员工重新核对文件。 雇主可使用I-9表格的电子版，但联邦并不强制电子建档。 除有正式人事部门的公司外，所有常规性雇用其他劳动力的人都应建立员工的I-9档案，包括一般小型业主和定期上班的家庭保姆等。 另外，透过承包商(sub-contractor)雇人，也应查看受雇人员的工作资格，否则在法律上可能被视为违规雇人的雇主。
1130cf324214f98b48d624b7b9689bc6ff2e1b76.translatedText: > The Maricopa County Sheriff raided two local restaurants last Friday and arrested seven illegal immigrants suspected of stealing other people's identities. The police received a tip claiming that two Mexican restaurants in Mesa and Chandler employed 14 illegal immigrants using false identities to work in the United States, so they launched two search warrants and successfully arrested seven suspects. "Stealing another person's identity is a fourth-degree felony, a very serious crime." Sheriff Arpaio said afterwards, "And employers will also be subject to heavy fines." With the economic downturn and high unemployment, employers should hire legal American citizens instead of cheap, illegal labor. " Sheriff Apao said. This is the 53rd case of identity theft captured by the County Sheriff's Office. In fact, the federal government is strictly investigating illegal immigrants and inspecting employers' identity verification of employees has already begun. The American Immigration Lawyers Association reminds employers to immediately reorganize employee I-9 files. If there is a case where the record is lost or has not been filed, the employer must make up for it immediately, but cannot falsify the date of filing the case in the past. The law does not require employers to keep samples of the work qualification documents provided by employees when they are hired, but if obvious evidence of forged documents is found during internal re-login, it is best to recall the employee immediately to re-check the documents. Employers can use electronic versions of the I-9 forms, but the federal government does not mandate electronic filing. In addition to companies with formal personnel departments, all people who regularly employ other labor should establish I-9 files for employees, including general small business owners and family caregivers who work regularly. In addition, when hiring people through a sub-contractor, you should also check the work qualifications of the employees. Otherwise, you may be considered an employer who hires people illegally.

b10bcd47f0345029da2013fca481a49de5b3f42d.sourceText: 航空公司减班 票价一年涨9.5% 燃油价格上涨，加上经济前景不佳，美国各家航空公司将进一步大幅减班因应。专家提醒，消费者恐怕再也无法买到便宜的国内线机票，也无法再享受到没有坐满的客舱空间。 达美航空自今年起，10月到12月国内线将较去年同期减少5％的坐位，明年同期则将更进一步减少2％至3％的坐位。此外，美国航空在 今年的最后3个月内，将进一步减少约0.5％的国内线坐位。已整并的联合航空及大陆航空，则有可能减少2％至3％的国内线航班。 减班虽然提供消费者更少的选择，但对各家航空公司的营运带来正面效果，不但票价提高，订位也有显著增加，载客率达到八到九成。 根据美国劳工统计局的资料，今年以来，全美国内线机票价格一直呈现上涨的趋势，8月份涨价1.1％，创下今年3月以来最大涨幅。去年9月到今年8月的票价，较前年9月到去年8月的票价，涨幅已超过9.5％。
b10bcd47f0345029da2013fca481a49de5b3f42d.translatedText: Airlines reduce flights and fares rise 9.5% in a year. In response to rising fuel prices and poor economic prospects, U.S. airlines will further reduce flights significantly. Experts warn that consumers may no longer be able to buy cheap domestic air tickets, nor can they enjoy unfilled cabin space. Starting this year, Delta Air Lines will reduce domestic seats by 5% from October to December compared with the same period last year, and will further reduce seats by 2% to 3% during the same period next year. In addition, American Airlines will further reduce domestic seats by approximately 0.5% in the last three months of this year. United Airlines and Continental Airlines, which have been integrated, may reduce domestic flights by 2% to 3%. Although reducing flights provides consumers with fewer choices, it has brought positive effects to the operations of various airlines. Not only have fares increased, but bookings have also increased significantly, with load factors reaching 80 to 90%. According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, domestic air ticket prices across the United States have been on an upward trend this year. In August, prices increased by 1.1%, the largest increase since March this year. The fares from September last year to August this year have increased by more than 9.5% compared with the fares from September last year to August last year.

08d017d15fd56a6dfaaf2d59ebe80ebe64ccc770.sourceText: 2月8日晚签署的49州与五大银行贷款和解案中，亚利桑那州得到了1.6亿美元，以协助付不出房贷的屋主能重新融资，减低贷款，企图为低迷不振的房市注入 生机。 参与和解协议的美国商业银行、大通银行、富国银行、花旗银行和Ally金融公司五大银行、联邦政府，以及除了奥克拉荷马州之外的49个州，同意协助主要是「溺水屋」屋主 减少房贷债务、避免倒债，或对房屋未循适当程序遭到查封的屋主给予补偿。 这项措施是政府解决2008年以来爆发房贷危机，造成金融海啸的解套方案之一。 但政府同时表示，这并不表示这些放款的银行已逃脱当年提供不实房贷的刑事责任，政府还会继续追查。 根据各方达成的协议，银行将提供至少170亿元，为拖欠贷款或很可能即将付不出贷款的屋主，降低贷款本金；用30亿元协助房贷额已高于房价的溺水 屋屋主；提供15亿元补偿房屋在2008到2011年遭到查封的屋主，其余将分配给各州，亚利桑那州得到了1.6亿美元。 亚利桑那州总检察长赫尔上周四上午宣布了这一调解案。 其中1.3亿作为本金减少的补偿，860万给贷款者重新贷款，在银行遗失文件，以及未遵循适当程序签署文件的乱局中失去房子的一些人提供估计得到1500至2000美元补偿。 虽然部分人士认为，这桩和解案对拯救数百万受害屋主只是杯水车薪，但在国会不愿批准额外支出来提振房市的情况下，银行支付的罚金将为市场开辟新的房贷融资管道 。 此外，也张彰显政府要​​求银行业者为不法行为付出代价的决心。
08d017d15fd56a6dfaaf2d59ebe80ebe64ccc770.translatedText: In the loan settlement between 49 states and the five major banks signed on the evening of February 8, Arizona received US$160 million to help homeowners who cannot pay their mortgages refinance and reduce their loans in an attempt to inject life into the sluggish housing market. The five major banks participating in the settlement agreement, including Commercial Bank of America, Chase, Wells Fargo, Citibank and Ally Financial, the federal government, and 49 states except Oklahoma, agreed to assist owners, mainly "drowning houses," to reduce their mortgage debt, avoid debt repayments, or compensate owners whose houses were seized without following due procedures. This measure is one of the government's solutions to the financial tsunami caused by the housing loan crisis that broke out in 2008. However, the government also stated that this does not mean that these lending banks have escaped criminal responsibility for providing false housing loans back then, and the government will continue to pursue them. According to the agreement reached by all parties, the bank will provide at least 17 billion yuan to reduce the loan principal of homeowners who have defaulted on their loans or are likely to be unable to pay their loans; 3 billion yuan will be used to assist homeowners whose mortgages are higher than the house prices; 1.5 billion yuan will be provided to compensate homeowners whose houses were seized from 2008 to 2011, and the rest will be distributed to states. Arizona received $160 million. Arizona Attorney General Hull announced the settlement last Thursday morning. Of that amount, $130 million was provided as compensation for principal reductions, and $8.6 million was provided to borrowers to refinance their loans, and some who lost their homes in a mess where the bank lost documents and failed to follow proper procedures to sign documents, providing an estimated $1,500 to $2,000 in compensation. Although some people believe that this settlement will do little to save millions of injured homeowners, the fines paid by the banks will open up new mortgage financing channels in the market at a time when Congress is unwilling to approve additional spending to boost the housing market. In addition, it also demonstrates the government's determination to require bankers to pay the price for illegal activities.

bd348dff8afbe9c23afbd1e77d17e2d57e079e81.sourceText: 默多克的”传媒帝国大厦”新闻集团因窃听丑闻似乎正在变成一栋”危房”,其子公司新闻国际公司原CEO因窃听丑闻辞职后又被英国警方逮捕。英国《经济学人》（The Economist）杂志评论称一个曾经几乎人人都畏其三分的巨人似乎变成了舞台上被嘘声包围的”哑剧小丑”。和过往几十年在世界各地”攻城拔寨”相比，如今已经80岁的默多克或许正在思考着下一个人生课题：如何守住他的传媒江山。
bd348dff8afbe9c23afbd1e77d17e2d57e079e81.translatedText: Murdoch's "Media Empire State Building" News Corporation seems to be turning into a "dangerous building" due to the wiretapping scandal. The former CEO of its subsidiary News International resigned due to the wiretapping scandal and was arrested by the British police. The British "Economist" magazine commented that a giant who was once feared by almost everyone seemed to have become a "mime clown" surrounded by boos on the stage. Compared with "attacking cities and fortresses" around the world in the past few decades, Murdoch, now 80 years old, may be thinking about the next life issue: how to hold on to his media empire.

948c658701311c4cfd2fab6ea2c2dcbc1f90aa4e.sourceText: 当地时间19日下午，英国议会下院文化、媒体和体育委员会专门就《世界新闻报》窃听丑闻举行听证会，包括默多克及其儿子詹姆斯、新闻国际前首席执行官等人接受质询。这是当天最受瞩目的听证会。默多克的妻子邓文迪则坐在丈夫的侧后方。考虑到此事的公众影响力，听证会进行了现场直播。就是在这样对外现场直播的场合，邓文迪很猛，在听证会上为保护她老公打了抗议者耳光，声音清脆响亮！事情的经过是怎样的？目前还没有相应的中文报道。散粉思考者根据英文的新闻报道，给大家描素一下这个过程。
948c658701311c4cfd2fab6ea2c2dcbc1f90aa4e.translatedText: On the afternoon of the 19th local time, the Culture, Media and Sport Committee of the House of Commons of the British Parliament held a hearing specifically on the "News of the World" wiretapping scandal. Murdoch, his son James, and the former CEO of News International were questioned. This was the most high-profile hearing of the day. Murdoch's wife Wendi Deng sat behind her husband. Given the publicity of the matter, the hearing was broadcast live. It was in such a live broadcast that Wendi Deng was so fierce that she slapped a protester to protect her husband at the hearing, her voice was clear and loud! What happened? There are currently no corresponding reports in Chinese. The loose powder thinker describes this process for everyone based on English news reports.

5e7387a01ee7e4efd89274bcf82f71304abe8d28.sourceText: 在听证会快结束的时候，出现了戏剧性的一幕。一个抗议者扑来，他拿着一盘像剃须泡沫的东西，想往默克多身上抹。坐在后侧面的默克多妻子邓文迪，一跃而起，捍卫她的80岁的丈夫免受攻击，她甚至打到了他的头，清脆的声音可以听到。听证会因此暂停约10分钟后，抗议者被拘留。默多克被泡沫打在脸上，他擦了外套，完成了听证会。一个喜剧演员和自称”维权者”的Jonnie Marbles在Twitter上声称为泡沫攻击负责。在扑向默克多的时候，他叫喊默克多是一个贪婪的亿万富翁。
5e7387a01ee7e4efd89274bcf82f71304abe8d28.translatedText: At the end of the hearing, a dramatic scene occurred. A protester rushed over with a tray of what looked like shaving foam and tried to rub it on Murdoch. Murdoch's wife Wendi Deng, who was sitting on the back side, jumped up and defended her 80-year-old husband from the attack. She even hit him on the head, and a clear sound could be heard. The hearing was suspended for about 10 minutes before the protesters were detained. Murdoch was hit in the face with foam, wiped off his coat and finished the hearing. Comedian and self-proclaimed "activist" Jonnie Marbles claimed responsibility for the bubble attack on Twitter. As he pounced on Murdoch, he called him a greedy billionaire.

9280b06e0ae123f9415704f3167d0c252720f838.sourceText: 邓文迪在关键时刻跃起保护老公，颇显中国女人的泼辣，很给力。外国”淑女”断然在公众面前做不出来。默多克娶了年轻妻子也有好处，在关键时刻还能保护他。邓文迪不仅有耶鲁MBA，脑筋动得超级快，身手也动得超级快。比坐老默右边的儿子，她的表现很”英勇”。散粉思考者看邓文迪的做法虽然有点稍显泼妇，不泼辣的女人还真做不出来，但是是出于本能保护亲人，还是可以值得原谅和赞许的。这一巴掌的效果其实还是很大的，让外国人对中国和中国女人改观。在西方男人眼里东方女性柔弱顺从。现场直播让大家看到中国女人就是彪悍！比什么航母出航还要长国人的威慑。美国的微博（Twitter）关于邓打人的消息迅速向世界传播。题目从”Go Wendi”（文迪加油） 到 ”Wendi Deng. Tiger Wife!”（邓文迪，虎妻）都有。
9280b06e0ae123f9415704f3167d0c252720f838.translatedText: Wendi Deng jumped up to protect her husband at the critical moment, which shows the fierceness of Chinese women and is very powerful. Foreign "ladies" absolutely cannot behave in public. Murdoch also has the advantage of marrying a young wife, who can protect him at critical moments. Wendi Deng not only has a Yale MBA, but also has a super fast mind and a super fast body. Compared with the son sitting on the right side of Lao Mo, her performance was very "brave". Fans think that although Wendi Deng's behavior is a bit shrewish, and a woman who is not shrewish really can't do it, but she protects her loved ones out of instinct, which is still worthy of forgiveness and praise. The effect of this slap is actually very great, changing foreigners' views on China and Chinese women. In the eyes of Western men, Eastern women are weak and submissive. The live broadcast lets everyone see that Chinese women are tough! It is more of a deterrent to the Chinese than any aircraft carrier going out to sea. The news about Deng Daren spread quickly to the world on Twitter in the United States. The topics range from "Go Wendi" to "Wendi Deng. Tiger Wife!"

16f4202e0c34130bc557651f3996a84d545dd005.sourceText: 东谷六企业荣登2012年财富500强 《财富》杂志近日发布美国500强排行榜，去年排名第二的石油巨头埃克森美孚以4529.26亿美元收入力压群雄，夺回被沃尔玛霸占两年的榜首宝座，沃尔玛以4469.5亿美元屈居亚军。亚利桑那州有六家企业上榜，而且总部都不约而同地设在东谷区。 六家企业包括：总部设在坦佩，谣传被并购的全美航空公司，排名208，洞察企业（总部也在坦佩），排名460，其他还有：安富利(108)，自由港麦克莫兰铜和黄金(135)，共和服务(314)，和宠物商店(400)。 部分总部不在本州，但在东谷有设施的上榜企业包括：波音公司(39，美莎)，英特尔(51，钱德勒)，精神（航空）捷运(60，坦佩)，潘世奇汽车集团(222，坦佩)，易趣(228，钱德勒)等，零售业巨头沃尔玛(2)和美国银行(13)，大通银行(16)和富国银行(26)在东谷也有分部。
16f4202e0c34130bc557651f3996a84d545dd005.translatedText: Six companies in the East Valley are listed on the Fortune 500 in 2012 "Fortune" magazine recently released a list of the top 500 companies in the United States. Exxon Mobil, the oil giant that ranked second last year, beat the pack with revenue of US$452.926 billion, regaining the top spot that Walmart had occupied for two years. Wal-Mart ranked second with US$446.95 billion. Arizona has six companies on the list, all of which are headquartered in the East Valley. The six companies include: US Airways, which is headquartered in Tempe and is rumored to be acquired, ranked 208, Insight Enterprises (also headquartered in Tempe), ranked 460, and others include: Avnet (108), Freeport-McMoRan Copper and Gold (135), Republic Services (314), and Pet Stores (400). Some companies on the list that are not headquartered in the state but have facilities in the East Valley include: Boeing (39, Mesa), Intel (51, Chandler), Spirit (60, Tempe), Penske Automotive Group (222, Tempe), eBay (228, Chandler), etc. Retail giants Walmart (2) and Bank of America (13), Chase Bank (16) and Wells Fargo (26) also have branches in the East Valley.

1868f55652d931506bafc21abf585c7a98d3ce8f.sourceText: 「中国妈妈」需要鼓励 凤凰城 庄芷 妈！这是送给妳的礼物！上了大学的儿子，放春假从学校回来，才进家门就迫不急待地从书包里抓出一本书递给我。 「哇！好可爱喔！」我高兴的惊呼着，忍不住抱了抱他。 嘿！真有意思！儿子送我的是一本儿童书。 我开着玩笑的说：「哈！儿子啊！你『反』啦？十几年前是我这个妈妈买儿童书给你，是不是现在该你来讲故事给我听喽？」 「妈！我知道你喜欢看书，而且我猜妳一定会喜欢这本书的。」儿子腼腆地笑说。 这还用说？儿子送的书怎么会不喜欢？况且书名是 I Love You More (我更爱你)，是作者劳拉答柯斯塔 (Laura Duksta) 的成名作品，曾被列在纽约时报畅销书排行榜上、并且得过好几项大奖，书中的内容是母子之间甜蜜的对话，结论是妈妈和儿子都彼此对说「我更爱你」。 我慎重地把这本书摆在专放「贵重物品」的架子上，然后放置在客厅的摆设台，倒不是想要小题大作，而是心中对儿子的「鼓励」充满感激。 然而我这做妈妈的，仍旧忍不住给他来一段机会教育：「儿子啊！或许你不知道送我这本书，对我来说意义有多么大，但我最高兴的是你能用行动『把爱说出来』，这是咱们中国人比较缺乏的，所以将来等你结了婚、有了孩子，还要多加强这方面的表达啊！」 儿子搂着我的肩笑着说：「妈！其实我和妹妹都觉得我们很幸运，就是因为妳比较不像『中国妈妈』耶！」 什么意思嘛！ 这话到底是褒、还是贬呢？ 唉！说来也真可悲，听说这些年来，在美国的校园中，孩子们口中的「中国妈妈」(Chinese Mom)，已成了一个特定的专有名词，用来形容爱强迫孩子学才艺、爱计较孩子的分数、爱攀比、爱包揽的妈妈。 虽然咱们这些中国妈妈们，有时候会表现出一些格外争强好胜、积极进取的行为，但不可否认的，中国妈妈们肩头上的压力却也的确不小啊！在外工作的妈妈们，不但要在职场上奋力拼搏，回家后还要照料孩子、打点家务，辛苦自然不在话下；而留在家中的家庭主妇们，不少都是顶着学位却无用武之地，常常在生活烦琐的沉闷、以及自我价值的探索中徘徊挣扎。 最可怜的是当有些孩子的学业成绩没不够亮丽、才艺表现不够出色、或是行为出现问题时，妈妈们总是第一个被遭到质疑，在外工作的妈妈马上被人询问：「是不是太专注工作而忽略了孩子？」而家庭主妇则是更残酷的被问说：「妳到底在家做什么？」 当社会或媒体用嘲弄、讽刺的表情，把咱们这些「中国妈妈」们看成是某种程度的「异类」时，是否也能仁慈的肯定我们即使没有功劳、也有苦劳啊！同时也能体谅我们侨居海外的中国妈妈，大多都是从「万般皆下品、唯有读书高」的教育环境中长大，咱们所受的教导就是「用功、用功、再用功；努力、努力、再努力」的叮咛，所以我们现在也正努力地、认真地要做一个好妈妈呢！ 当然在美国的环境中，想教导出仍能保有中国传统美德的孩子很不容易，然而每个中国妈妈们仍然不畏艰难的努力适应、努力调整、努力改进，这种精神与毅力怎不让人感佩？ 所以咱们何不多给「中国妈妈」们一些鼓励呢？.
1868f55652d931506bafc21abf585c7a98d3ce8f.translatedText: "Chinese Mom" ​​needs encouragement Phoenix Zhuang Zhi Mom! This is a gift for you! My son, who is in college, came back from school during spring break. As soon as he entered the house, he eagerly grabbed a book from his schoolbag and handed it to me. "Wow! So cute!" I exclaimed happily and couldn't help hugging him. Hey! How interesting! My son gave me a children's book. I jokingly said, "Ha! Son! Are you going against it? It was me, the mother, who bought you children's books more than ten years ago. Isn't it your turn to tell me stories now?" "Mom! I know you like reading, and I guess you will like this book." My son said with a shy smile. Needless to say? How could you not like the books your son gave you? Moreover, the title of the book is I Love You More, a famous work by the author Laura Duksta. It has been listed on the New York Times bestseller list and has won several awards. The content of the book is a sweet dialogue between mother and son. The conclusion is that both mother and son say "I love you more" to each other. I carefully placed this book on the shelf dedicated to "valuable items" and then placed it on the display table in the living room. It was not that I wanted to make a fuss about it, but I was grateful for my son's "encouragement." However, as a mother, I still couldn't help but give him a chance to educate him: "Son! Maybe you don't know how much it means to me to give you this book, but what I'm most happy about is that you can "express your love" with actions. This is something we Chinese people lack, so in the future, when you get married and have children, you will have to strengthen your expression in this aspect!" My son put his arms around my shoulders and said with a smile, "Mom! Actually, my sister and I think we are very lucky because you don't look like a 'Chinese mother'!" What do you mean? Is this a compliment or a criticism? well! It’s really sad to say that over the years, I heard that in American schools, what children call “Chinese Mom” has become a specific term used to describe mothers who love to force their children to learn talents, care about their children’s scores, love to compare, and love to do everything. Although we Chinese mothers sometimes show some particularly competitive and aggressive behaviors, it is undeniable that the pressure on Chinese mothers’ shoulders is indeed not small! Mothers who work outside the home not only have to work hard in the workplace, but also have to take care of their children and take care of housework when they return home. The hard work is not to mention; while many of the housewives who stay at home have degrees that are of no use and often struggle in the boring and boring life and the exploration of self-worth. The most pitiful thing is that when some children's academic performance is not bright enough, their talents are not outstanding enough, or their behavior problems appear, mothers are always the first to be questioned. Mothers who work outside the home are immediately asked: "Are you too focused on work and neglecting your children?" And housewives are asked even more cruelly: "What on earth are you doing at home?" When the society or the media regards us "Chinese mothers" as "others" to some extent with mocking and sarcastic expressions, can they also kindly affirm that even if we have no merit, we still have hard work! At the same time, we can also understand that most of our Chinese mothers living overseas grew up in an educational environment where "everything is inferior except for reading." The instruction we received is to "study, study, study again; work hard, work hard, work hard again." So now we are working hard and seriously to be a good mother! Of course, in the American environment, it is not easy to educate children who can still retain traditional Chinese virtues. However, every Chinese mother still works hard to adapt, adjust, and improve without fear of hardship. How can we not admire this spirit and perseverance? So why don’t we give more encouragement to “Chinese mothers”? .

d5cd2cea6335db979ba4c95d26a98f8eae0ddf0f.sourceText: 亚裔华人社区支持克劳德马托克斯参选凤凰城市长(图) 亚省时报谢成彦 今年有6位候选人参选凤凰城市长竞选，其中一位是经常在华人社区活动中见到的克劳德马托克斯先生(Claude Mattox)。7月13日下午6点，在斐匿市汤姆士路红锅餐厅举行了一个克劳德马托克斯助选会。资深侨领余文劲、大凤凰城华人侨团总会主席邓朝驹、副主席张华芳、侨务委员高志中、中餐馆会副主席梅树德、理事陆少明、亚省开平同乡会副会长关兆峰、华人华侨联合总会会长费健、华人者英会主席崔增祁、中华总会主席邱顺雄夫妇、川渝同乡会会长陈志钢、余风采堂代表余文泽、亚裔房地产协会主席张圣仪、台湾传统周主席张晴玲及华联顾问吕梅兰夫妇，亚省时报社新闻主管谢成彦, 等等, 二十多个华人社团的负责人，以及越南、菲律宾的朋友都参加了这次助选会，他们将成为亚裔助选团的主力。 在会上, 克劳德马托克斯介绍自己在凤凰城11年的社区服务经验。他上任后将致力于安全的社区建设，促进学校的提高，为市民创造高薪职位，有效的运行城市的政府职能，为凤凰城的市民提供高质量的服务。现场除了克劳德马托克斯自我介绍以外，最精彩的就要数现场嘉宾的提问了。邓朝驹提问: 在美国经济困难的今天，他上任后怎样改善社区的投资环境?克劳德马托克斯说, 提供最好的投资政策是政府首先考虑的事情,我会努力争取州政府的支持，在税收，投资手续等各个方面进行改进。他还提出了德克萨斯州的一些非常优惠的政策，并表示会努力向他们学习。华联主席费健问,与其他的竞选者相比, 他有什么优势？克劳德马托克斯说, 其中的几个候选人都有过在政府任职的经历，他自己的经历是善始善终的完成了自己的工作，可以说给市民了一个很好的交代。当然自己的工作经验也是最大的财富。他在政府财政困难的时期任过职，在大大降低政府财政预算的前提下，怎样来做关键的抉择? 为了保证凤凰城老年人活动中心的正常运作，他不得不支持政府加食品税收。他知道任何决定都会有得有失，但是在重大的决定面前 怎样做取舍，保证收益的最大化是决策的重要部分。还有人提出移民政策，外籍投资项目的洽谈等问题。克劳德马托克斯都非常直接的给大家带来了一个满意的回答。 在短短的三个小时里,朋友们看到克劳德马托克斯市长候选人的处事风格，干净利落，不回避敏感问题，能切实为市民利益着想的服务意识。现场嘉宾, 都表示会支持克劳德马托克斯参选。 会议通过: 7月26日在六福酒家举行亚裔华人助选募款宴会。 届时欢迎支持克劳德马托克斯的朋友踊跃参加, 期待能选出市民心目中最合适的市长。募款宴会餐费每个人35元，其中20元将做克劳德马托克斯参选基金。据记者所知, 选举法规定, 每位选民对一位候选人捐款项的上限为430美元，不能超越。
d5cd2cea6335db979ba4c95d26a98f8eae0ddf0f.translatedText: The Asian-Chinese community supports Claude Mattox’s candidacy for Phoenix mayor (picture) Alberta Times Xie Chengyan There are six candidates running for mayor of Phoenix this year, one of whom is Mr. Claude Mattox, who is often seen at Chinese community events. At 6 pm on July 13, a Claude Mattox election support meeting was held at the Red Pot Restaurant on Thomas Road, Phenomenal City. Senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin, Chairman of Greater Phoenix Overseas Chinese Association Deng Chaoju, Vice Chairman Zhang Huafang, Overseas Chinese Affairs Councilor Gao Zhizhong, Vice Chairman of the Chinese Restaurant Association Mei Shude, Director Lu Shaoming, Vice President of the Kaiping Association of Alberta Guan Zhaofeng, President of the Overseas Chinese Federation Fei Jian, Chinese Zheying Association Chairman Cui Zengqi, Chairman of the Chinese Federation Qiu Shunxiong and his wife, Sichuan and Chongqing Association President Chen Zhigang, Yu Fengcaitang representative Yu Wenze, Asian Real Estate Association Chairman Zhang Shengyi, Taiwan Heritage Week Chairman Zhang Qingling and Hualien consultant Lu Meilan and his wife, Asia Times News Director Xie Chengyan, Wait, more than 20 heads of Chinese associations, as well as friends from Vietnam and the Philippines, have participated in this election campaign. They will become the main force of the Asian campaign team. At the meeting, Claude Mattox introduced his 11 years of community service experience in Phoenix. After taking office, he will be committed to building safe communities, promoting school improvement, creating high-paying jobs for citizens, effectively running the city's government functions, and providing high-quality services to the citizens of Phoenix. In addition to Claude Mattox's self-introduction, the most exciting part of the scene was the questions asked by the guests. Deng Chaoju asked: In today's difficult economic situation in the United States, how will he improve the investment environment in the community after taking office? Claude Mattox said that providing the best investment policy is the government's first consideration. I will work hard to win the support of the state government and improve various aspects such as taxation and investment procedures. He also proposed some very favorable policies in Texas and said he would work hard to learn from them. Fei Jian, chairman of Hualian, asked, what advantages does he have compared with other candidates? Claude Mattox said that several of the candidates have had experience in serving in the government. His own experience was that he completed his work well from beginning to end, which can be said to be a good explanation to the citizens. Of course, your own work experience is also your greatest asset. He served during a period of government financial difficulties. How to make key decisions under the premise of greatly reducing the government's financial budget? In order to ensure the normal operation of the Phoenix Elderly Activity Center, he had to support the government in increasing food taxes. He knows that there will be gains and losses in any decision, but how to make trade-offs in the face of major decisions and to ensure maximization of returns is an important part of the decision-making. Others raised issues such as immigration policy and negotiation of foreign investment projects. Claude Mattox gave everyone a satisfactory answer very directly. In just three hours, friends saw the handling style of mayoral candidate Claude Mattox, who is clean and tidy, does not avoid sensitive issues, and has a sense of service that truly considers the interests of the citizens. Guests present expressed their support for Claude Mattox's candidacy. The meeting approved: A fundraising banquet for Asian Chinese to support the election will be held at Luk Fook Restaurant on July 26. Friends who support Claude Mattox are welcome to attend and we look forward to electing the most suitable mayor in the minds of the citizens. The fundraising banquet costs $35 per person, $20 of which will go to the Claude Mattox campaign fund. As far as the reporter knows, the election law stipulates that the upper limit of each voter's donation to a candidate is US$430, which cannot be exceeded.

cd3fb2babb6d2c931ad37b816e66ab3d78c9a641.sourceText: 等同每加仑118英里 本田Fit EV获美最高评级 本田（Honda）汽车公司周三宣布，其2013年超小型纯电动汽车Fit EV获得美国环保局最高燃油效率评级棗每加仑燃料所行英里数达118 mpg。 环保局在计算电动汽车的效率时，是以33.7千瓦小时能量相当于一加仑汽油的方法来估计的。以Fit EV为例，它的锂离子电池能储存20千瓦小时能量，只相当于0.6加仑汽油。但是根据环保局的测试，它在下一次充电前平均可以跑82英里。经过换算，你就 可以发现它的每加仑英里数相当于118mpg。 预定在2013年夏天限量上市的Fit EV是本田公司二十年来推出的第一个电动汽车。目前大多数主要的汽车制造商以及一些后起之秀（如加州的Tesla Motors）都在争着进入电动汽车这个新兴市场。 和其他厂商的电动车相比，118mpg的评级让本田把三菱i-MiEV（112 mpg），福特Focus（105mpg)，日产Leaf(99mpg)都甩在了后面。 除效率外，在一次充电总英里数上本田Fit EV也超过其他电动车棗福特Focus最多能跑76英里，日产Leaf能跑73英里，三菱i-MiEV只能跑62英里。 和燃油汽车相比，电动车体积一般都比较小，而本田Fit EV又几乎是除三菱i-MiEV外所有电动车里最小型的一款。本田公司的官员也强调：为了增加里程数，他们减轻车的体重并将重点放在改善FitEV的空气动力特性上。 本田公司还宣称，Fit EV充电时间只有3小时，当然是在220伏电压和足够的电流强度基础上。 Fit EV的三档驱动系统能产生124的最大马力和189磅英尺扭矩。用本田环境商务办公室副总裁史蒂夫‧山特的话来说，开这辆车”绝对带劲”。 电动汽车的马达有瞬时加速的优点，但是当跑到每小时30英里的速度时就失去劲头了。如果开的太快、加上空调或者暖气，电池很快就会耗尽。 本田去年11月在洛杉矶汽车展上首次推出Fit EV，只计划限量出售。今后几个月会先在加州和俄勒冈州上市，明年才轮到美国东海岸。
cd3fb2babb6d2c931ad37b816e66ab3d78c9a641.translatedText: Equivalent to 118 miles per gallon, Honda Fit EV received the highest rating in the United States Honda Motor Co. announced Wednesday that its 2013 Fit EV subcompact electric vehicle earned the highest fuel efficiency rating from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, achieving 118 mpg. When the EPA calculates the efficiency of electric vehicles, it estimates it as 33.7 kilowatt hours of energy equivalent to one gallon of gasoline. Take the Fit EV as an example. Its lithium-ion battery can store 20 kilowatt hours of energy, which is equivalent to only 0.6 gallons of gasoline. But according to EPA testing, it can travel an average of 82 miles before its next charge. After conversion, you can find that its miles per gallon is equivalent to 118mpg. Scheduled for limited release in the summer of 2013, the Fit EV is Honda's first electric vehicle in two decades. Most of the major automakers, as well as some upstarts such as California's Tesla Motors, are rushing to enter the emerging market for electric vehicles. Compared with other manufacturers' electric vehicles, Honda's 118mpg rating puts Honda behind the Mitsubishi i-MiEV (112 mpg), Ford Focus (105mpg), and Nissan Leaf (99mpg). In addition to efficiency, the Honda Fit EV also exceeds other electric vehicles in terms of total mileage on a single charge: the Ford Focus can run up to 76 miles, the Nissan Leaf can run 73 miles, and the Mitsubishi i-MiEV can only run 62 miles. Compared with fuel vehicles, electric vehicles are generally smaller in size, and Honda Fit EV is almost the smallest of all electric vehicles except Mitsubishi i-MiEV. Honda officials also emphasized that in order to increase mileage, they are reducing the weight of the car and focusing on improving the aerodynamic characteristics of the FitEV. Honda also claims that the Fit EV charging time is only 3 hours, of course based on 220 volts and sufficient amperage. Fit EV's three-speed drive system produces 124 maximum horsepower and 189 pound-feet of torque. In the words of Steve Shante, vice president of Honda's Environmental Business Office, driving this car is "absolutely exciting." Electric car motors have the advantage of instantaneous acceleration, but they lose steam at 30 miles per hour. If you drive it too fast, add air conditioning or heating, the battery will drain quickly. Honda first launched the Fit EV at the Los Angeles Auto Show last November and only plans to sell it in limited quantities. It will be launched in California and Oregon in the next few months, and it will be the East Coast of the United States next year.

614e74ac36473a2afcbe3faf1ece9b4b6751262f.sourceText: 警官突击检查 在Mesa一面包工厂逮捕28人 2011年7月14日周四上午11点左右，至少28人在Mesa的面包厂被马里科帕县执行紧急搜查令时逮捕。 官员说，31人被怀疑非法入境，他们使用虚假的身份证明文件，主要是社会保障卡，在Country Club和Southern交界的面包厂就业。突击检查负责人说:”这些提供虚假身份的人，这是一个4级重罪。”当突袭检查进行时，约50至60名员工正在面包厂里工作。下午3:00时，警长证实其中28名被逮捕。警长办公室仍在调查，认定其中 26人是非法入境。被捕的另外两个是美国公民，但尚未证实。警长的办公室在过去的两个半月， 调查的负责人不予置评机构如何通风报信工厂。该机构的突击检查已经引起亚利桑那州各地的公民褒贬不一的评论。 负责人重申了行动的目标是打击身份欺诈，并否认他是​​种族貌相来判断目标。”我们是全国第一，在打击虚假身份的案件里” ”我要做的就是执法，我们已经证明雇主知道充分的情况并心甘情愿地聘请他们。” 目前，还不清楚是否在面包公司的雇主将面临什么指控。 本次行动的办公室只有三个雇员，在过去三年进行了48次的突击检查。行动负责人说”我觉得我在为总统和和恢复经济做事情，因为我们失业的人太多了。” 目前，被捕人士个人情况还未被最后确定。 （新闻来自The Arizona Republic）
614e74ac36473a2afcbe3faf1ece9b4b6751262f.translatedText: > Police officers raided a Mesa bakery and arrested 28 people. At approximately 11 a.m. Thursday, July 14, 2011, at least 28 people were arrested when Maricopa County executed an emergency search warrant at a bakery in Mesa. Officials said 31 people are suspected of entering the country illegally and using false identification documents, mainly social security cards, to gain employment at the bakery on the border of Country Club and Southern. "These people who provided false identities, this is a level 4 felony," said the person in charge of the raid. About 50 to 60 employees were working in the bakery when the raid was conducted. At 3:00 p.m., the Sheriff confirmed that 28 of them had been arrested. The Sheriff's Office is still investigating and has determined that 26 of the people were in the country illegally. Two others arrested were U.S. citizens, but this has not yet been confirmed. The Sheriff's Office has not commented for the past two and a half months on how the agency's investigators tipped off the mill. The agency's raids have drawn mixed reviews from citizens across Arizona. The man in charge reiterated the aim of the operation was to combat identity fraud and denied he was being targeted by racial profiling. "We are number one in the country in cracking down on false identity cases." "All I have to do is enforce the law and we have proven that the employer knew full facts and willingly hired them." It is unclear what charges the employer at the bakery will face. The operation's office has only three employees and has conducted 48 surprise inspections in the past three years. The person in charge of the operation said, "I feel like I am doing something for the president and to restore the economy, because we have too many people who are unemployed." At present, the personal circumstances of the arrested persons have not been finalized. (News from The Arizona Republic)

e058b9fe52468e9d25402a7a11598cb213886e64.translatedText: Is it possible to get a loan if my down payment (Down Payment) is not big? Most buyers need to take out a loan to buy a house in the United States, so the buyer has to come up with a loan...

f8f603d081266799eb10fbb9555b43da921dcdc6.sourceText: 在美国买房多数买主都要办贷款, 那么买主就要自己拿出一部份钱做为头期款。一般情况下, 买主放5%-20%的头期款。若是政府补助的低息贷款(FHA Loan), 则头期款可低至3.5%, 如果是复员军人贷款(VA Loan), 可以免交头期款。对于一般性政府贷款的情况, 只要贷款人存够了5%的头期款就行了。许多人放20%的头期款是为了避免付贷款保险 (Mortgage Insurance), 因为银行规定, 贷款额若超过房子买价的80%, 则要买贷款保险。为此, 有一个变通的办法可以免掉这笔无意义的保险, 就是再申请一笔贷款, 第一笔贷款是80%, 第二笔贷款(Second Trust)加上头期款共20%, 这样就解决问题了。当然, 第二贷款(也叫第二顺位贷款)的利率比较高, 大约在7.0%-9.5%之间, 这就是你所指的”额外多交钱”, 其实并没有多交多少, 这比付贷款保险要少, 而且灵活性比较大。也就是说, 买主可以在短期之内, 比如: 一,二年内, 将这笔贷款付清。如果一个30万的房子, 头期款3万(10%), 第二贷款3万 (10%), 第一贷款24万(80%), 那么两年后, 如果贷款人攒了3万, 则可一次付清, 当然也可每月多付一点。另外, 如果房价在上涨, 如果贷款人的房子每年涨5%, 那么两年涨了10％以上, 两年后, 贷款人可以办重新贷款(Re-Finance), 则新的贷款额与房价比只剩了不到80%, 这样没有多交钱就解决了问题。当然这是要有前提的: 房价上涨,利率下降,才有可能去办重新贷款。
f8f603d081266799eb10fbb9555b43da921dcdc6.translatedText: Most buyers have to take out a loan to buy a house in the United States, so the buyer has to take out part of the money as a down payment. Generally, buyers put down a down payment of 5%-20%. If it is a government-subsidized low-interest loan (FHA Loan), the down payment can be as low as 3.5%. If it is a VA Loan, the down payment can be waived. For general government loans, as long as the borrower deposits enough 5% of the down payment. Many people put down 20% to avoid paying mortgage insurance, because bank regulations require that if the loan amount exceeds 80% of the purchase price of the house, mortgage insurance must be purchased. For this reason, there is a workaround to get rid of this meaningless insurance, which is to apply for another loan. The first loan is 80%, and the second loan (Second Trust) plus the down payment totals 20%. This solves the problem. Of course, the interest rate of the second loan (also called the second loan) is relatively high, about 7.0%-9.5%. This is what you refer to as "paying extra money". In fact, it is not much more. It is less than paying loan insurance, and it is more flexible. In other words, the buyer can pay off the loan in a short period of time, such as one or two years. For a 300,000 house, the down payment is 30,000 (10%), the second loan is 30,000 (10%), and the first loan is 240,000 (80%). After two years, if the borrower saves 30,000, he can pay it off in one lump sum, or of course he can pay more every month. In addition, if house prices are rising, if the borrower's house increases by 5% every year, then it has increased by more than 10% in two years, and after two years, the lender can refinance (Re-Finance), then the ratio of the new loan amount to the house price will be less than 80%, thus solving the problem without paying more. Of course, this requires a premise: when housing prices rise and interest rates fall, it is possible to apply for a refinance.

b12dd58ef92611bbae30a4fef0d55b95f31afb0c.sourceText: 黄慧莉：2012年9月份美國勞工移民排期 2012年9 月份美國勞工移民 排期 優先排期 第一優先 全世界,有名額. 中國大陸: 有名額 第二優先 全世界,01/01/2009. 中國大陸: 沒有名額無法送件 第三優先 全世界,10/01/2006. 中國大陸: 12/15/2005 第四優先 全世界,有名額. 中國大陸:有名額 第五優先 全世界,有名額. 中國大陸:有名額 全世界不包印度,墨西哥,菲律賓 2012年9 月份美國 親屬 移民 排期 優先排期 第一優先 全世界,10/01/2005 中國大陸:10/01/2005 第二優先A 全世界,05/08/2010. 中國大陸:05/08/2010 第二優先B 全世界,09/15/2004. 中國大陸:09/15/2004 第三優先 全世界,05/15/2002. 中國大陸:05/15/2002 第四優先 全世界,03/08/2001. 中國大陸:01/22/2001 問： 我的父親現住美國，年齡相當大，他很擔心?#26127;迷插管三個月，子女兩難?#30340;情況在他身上發生，再三叮嚀絕對不插管，請問在美國，我們要怎樣處理這個問題呢？ 答： 你的父親年事已高，他擔心一旦生病住院，該如何處理不必要的急救，如氣切、插管等。 在美國，因應個人獨立的社會風氣，一般父母都未與子女同住，所以，有關高齡父母的疾病照料，一般都及早做妥善規畫。 普遍而言，基本上每個家庭、個人都會立遺囑，除了財產遺囑，交代有關財產分配及支配外，每個人也應立一份「Living Will」。 Living Will就是所謂的生命遺囑，當事人可要求醫生及家屬，在個人已處於生命末期時，在兩位專科醫師認為無法挽救﹐不再做任何不必要的醫療救治措施。 因此，你的父親在他的生命遺囑裡，除了病重時，要求不再做任何不必要的醫療措施外，也可以很明確的註明：其不必要的醫療措施，包括：氣切、插管、電擊等比較激烈的急救措施。 一般在美國，可能需要及早準備這份文件，因為普遍而言，醫院看到病人時，通常都會要求家屬出示Living Will。

Mainland China: 01/22/2001 Question: My father now lives in the United States. He is quite old. He is very worried about what happened to him. He was intubated for three months and his children were in a dilemma. He was repeatedly told not to be intubated. How should we deal with this problem in the United States? Answer: Your father is old and he is worried about how to deal with unnecessary first aid, such as tracheotomy, intubation, etc. once he is sick and hospitalized. In the United States, due to the social trend of individual independence, most parents do not live with their children. Therefore, the care of elderly parents' illness is generally planned early and properly. Generally speaking, basically every family and individual will make a will. In addition to a property will, which explains the distribution and management of the property, everyone should also make a "Living Will". Living Will is the so-called life will. The person concerned can request doctors and family members not to perform any unnecessary medical treatment when the individual is at the end of life and two specialists believe that it is impossible to save the individual. Therefore, in his life will, in addition to requesting that no unnecessary medical measures be taken when he is seriously ill, your father can also clearly indicate that unnecessary medical measures include: tracheotomy, intubation, electric shock and other more drastic first aid measures. Generally in the United States, you may need to prepare this document early, because generally speaking, when hospitals see patients, they usually ask family members to present a Living Will.

767be9e4bd9d6ba4253254e014b973d3fbf1e249.sourceText: 第八届亚利桑那亚裔小姐 首届亚裔夫人选美大赛拉开帷幕（图） 不同年纪的女性，总是能展示出不同的魅力，20岁的青涩，30岁的成熟，40岁的优雅，50岁的稳重，都是一种吸引人的力量。第八届亚利桑那亚裔小姐选美大赛，首次推出了最美的太太和夫人选美比赛。现在参赛选手正在征集当中。 参赛者的要求： 亚利桑那亚裔小姐：17-28岁，无婚史，无小孩 亚利桑那亚裔太太：25岁到55岁，已婚，或离异 亚利桑那亚裔夫人：55岁以上，已婚，或离异 参选者至少有四分之一亚裔血统，亚洲大陆或者太平洋岛国。 身心健康，有吸引人的个性 必须是亚利桑那的居民 报名时间截止到2011年8月1日，更多的信息请联系：（602）509-9019 或者 www.missasiaarizona.com ２０１１年亚利桑那亚裔小姐选美开始 ２０１１首届亚利桑那亚裔太太和夫人选美大赛开始

The 8th Miss Asian Arizona Pageant, for the first time, launched the Most Beautiful Mrs. and Mrs. Pageant. Contestants are now being recruited. Requirements for contestants: Miss Asian Arizona: 17-28 years old, unmarried, no children. Mrs. Asian Arizona: 25 to 55 years old, married, or divorced. Mrs. Asian Arizona: 55 years or older, married, or divorced. Candidates must be at least one-quarter Asian, from mainland Asia or the Pacific Islands. Be physically and mentally healthy with an attractive personality. Must be an Arizona resident. Registration deadline is August 1, 2011.
