a896f0e2b8196d9b8a9b8ce4abcf26f1939aaed2.sourceText: 森林大火持续延烧 本州岛东部发生当地有史以来，最大一起森林火灾，山区度假胜地备受威胁，浓密黑烟迅速扩散，波及300公里外的新墨西哥州。 这起森林大火起源于5月29日，到6日规模增加一倍，迫使2200人疏散，幸无人受伤。据称这场野火是一周前未妥善处理的废弃营火引起，火势迅速蔓延，迄今范围已达将近39万英亩，新墨西哥、科罗拉多、内布拉斯加、堪萨斯，爱阿华州等州都可看到浓烟。预料强风和闪电暴风雨将使野火更加凶险。 布鲁尔州长宣布位在白山的阿帕契和格林利郡2个郡进入紧急状态。大约2500名消防队员投入对抗野火的作业，有些来自西部数州，远至东岸纽约的消防队队员也驰援助阵。鉴于火势凶猛，消防队员把这场野火称为「纵情之火」(Wallow Fire)。州政府官员6日上午表示，火势完全无法控制。这场大火在凤凰城东北部约250公里肆虐，延烧至亚利桑那与新墨西哥州交界处，是亚利桑那州有纪录以来规模第2的大火。 这起森林大火已经延烧多日，许多木造建筑被焚毁，不少山区度假胜地备受威胁，位在阿帕契国家森林公园因大火威胁已经关闭，暂不对外开放。附近医院基于安全考虑，也已将病患先转移到安全地点。
a896f0e2b8196d9b8a9b8ce4abcf26f1939aaed2.translatedText: Forest fires continue to burn. The largest forest fire in local history broke out in the eastern part of Honshu Island, threatening the mountain resort. Thick black smoke quickly spread and spread to New Mexico 300 kilometers away. The forest fire originated on May 29 and doubled in size by May 6, forcing 2,200 people to evacuate. Fortunately, no one was injured. The wildfire is said to have been caused by an abandoned campfire that was not properly handled a week ago. The fire spread rapidly and has now reached nearly 390,000 acres. Thick smoke can be seen in New Mexico, Colorado, Nebraska, Kansas, Iowa and other states. Strong winds and lightning storms are expected to make wildfires more dangerous. Governor Brewer declared a state of emergency in Apache and Greenlee counties in the White Mountains. About 2,500 firefighters were involved in fighting the wildfires, some from several western states and as far away as New York on the East Coast. Due to the ferocity of the fire, firefighters called the wildfire the "Wallow Fire." State government officials stated on the morning of the 6th that the fire was completely out of control. The fire raged about 250 kilometers northeast of Phoenix and spread to the border of Arizona and New Mexico. It was the second-largest fire on record in Arizona. This forest fire has been burning for many days, many wooden buildings have been burned, and many mountain resorts are under threat. The Apache National Forest Park has been closed to the public due to the threat of fire. For safety reasons, nearby hospitals have also moved patients to safe locations.

93795457abbac389d47c8f22fac4123b3b59db38.sourceText: 舍生取义 王 斋 先 孟子说：”生，亦我所欲也；义，亦我所欲也。二者不可得兼，舍生而取义者也。”可是，儒家大贤，程子曾说：”仲尼只说一个仁字，孟子开口便说：仁义。”殊不知孟子开篇所说的，亦有仁义而已矣。其源头仍出于孔子。因在周易第二章，就说：”立人之道曰仁与义。”孟子开口就讲义，乃本乎此。孔子将立人之道，以仁义两字提纲执领是多么的好，由此可称谓他们是我们中华民族的先知。 儒家的哲学精义勉励我们为人要舍生以殉道，不要舍道以得生。今天在我们暂居的人生中，如何才算是真正的舍生取义呢？ 我们要讲舍生取义，就当先明白”义”是什么？依据辞汇的解释”义”就是公正合宜的言语和行动。而不义就是没有公正合宜的言语和行动。使徒保罗对这不义的事曾说：”他们既然故意不认识上帝，上帝就任凭他们存邪恶的心，行那些不合理的事，装满了各样不义、邪恶、贪婪、恶毒，满心是忌妒、凶杀、竞争、诡诈、毒恨，又是谗毁的，捏造恶事的，违背父母的，无知的，背约的，不怜悯人的。他们虽知道神判定行这些事的人是是当死的。然而，他们不但自己去行还喜欢别人去行。（罗一：28-32）不义的人在个人渺小的生命中，只知道作恶逞欲，出卖灵命；他们不知道也不思想，人生当行的事是什么？当然的对于称”义”的事就漠不关心，更不要说”舍生取义”了。 那么，谁是义人呢？真正能称为义人的，必须有宇宙独一耶稣基督称为”义人”。这才算得上是名正言顺的义人，如果世上人所称的义人那种称义是值得考虑的，在上帝眼中的义人是什么样的义人呢？使徒保罗告诉我们说：”世人都犯了罪，亏缺了神的荣耀。如今却蒙神的恩典，因基督耶稣白白的称义为我们作挽回祭，是凭着他的血籍着人的信，要显明神的义，因为他用忍耐的心宽容人先前所犯的罪，好在今时显明他的义，使人知道他自己为义，也称信信他的人为义。伯拉罕信神这就算为他的义。戴维在称行为以外，蒙神算为义的人是有福的算他为义的这句话不是单为他写的，也是为我们将来得算称义的人写的，就是我们这信神，使我们的主耶稣从死里复活的人。因为耶稣被交给人，是为我们的过犯死在十字架，是为叫我们称义。就如罪作王叫人死，照样恩典也籍着义作王，叫人因我们的主耶稣基督得永生。（罗三：23-26）我们从保罗的话中，可以知道一个不义的人，要成为神眼中的义人，必须要相信耶稣，靠着主的宝血，罪得到赦免，然后才能被神称为义。 我们在圣灵里，蒙神称义，奉神的差遣，与神同行，就负有传扬义道的责任。（创六：9）这传义道的神圣工作，有时必须要舍命牺牲为主。舍生救义的精神，才能胜任愉快。然后，是谁激我们要有这种舍生取义的精神呢？他就是耶稣基督，因为经上说：”为义人死，是少有的，为仁人死或者有敢作的，惟有基督在我们还作罪人的时候，为我们死，神的爱就在此向我们显明了。（罗五：7-8）又云：”我已经与基督同钉十字架，现在活着，不在是我活着，是因信神的儿子而活，他是爱我为我舍己。”（加二，20） 古圣徒为主舍命传扬义道，他们都是因为深深体会到基督的爱是何等的大。世间任何事物都不能使他们与神的爱隔绝的。除了神的爱，激励他们舍生取义以外，就是主耶稣告诉他们在天上有一个美好的家乡，是神为他们所预备的，到了时候还要再来迎接他们。（约十四1-4）由于他们都能明白方生方死，方死方生的生死之道，知道人生恰似出来如花，飞去如影，生为暂寄，死为大归的真理。为主殉道，使能在神羔羊生命册上，永留英名，得神称义。 亲爱的兄弟姐妹长执同工们，我们都是属灵属神国度忠心仆人，也是神州大地的国民，是神从各国各族各方用宝血买来的，归于神，执掌地上王权，跨骑白马，手握灵剑，英雄争战，又是像飞鹰似传扬真道，为耶稣作见证，忍耐患难敬畏神名的人。为主殉道，舍生取义的义人。 论语曰：”自古有死，民无信不立。””有杀身以成仁，母求生以害仁。”司马迁云：”死有重于泰山，有轻于鸿毛。”主耶稣训勉：”我实实在在告诉你们，一粒麦子不落在地里死了，仍旧是一粒。若是死了，就结出许多子粒来。爱惜自己生命的，就丧失生命，在这世上，恨恶自己生命的，就要保守生命到永生。”（约十二：22-25）泰山与鸿毛，舍生取义或弃义偷生，任君明择，但祈能荣神益人，不负此生，愿共勉之，阿门。
93795457abbac389d47c8f22fac4123b3b59db38.translatedText: Sacrificing life for righteousness Wang Zhai Xian Mencius said: "Life is what I want; righteousness is also what I want. You can't have both, and one who sacrifices life for righteousness is the one who sacrifices life for righteousness." However, Cheng Zi, a great Confucian sage, once said: "Zhongni only said one word for benevolence, and Mencius said: benevolence and righteousness." However, what Mencius said at the beginning is that there is only benevolence and righteousness. Its origin still comes from Confucius. Because in the second chapter of the Book of Changes, it is said: "The way to establish a person is benevolence and righteousness." Mencius started talking about righteousness, which is the basis of this. It is so good that Confucius guided the way of building people with the two words of benevolence and righteousness. From this, we can call them the prophets of our Chinese nation. The essence of Confucian philosophy encourages us to sacrifice our lives in order to be martyred, and not to sacrifice our lives in order to survive. In our temporary life today, how can we truly sacrifice our lives for righteousness? If we want to talk about sacrificing our lives for righteousness, we must first understand what "righteousness" is? According to the interpretation of the vocabulary, "meaning" means fair and appropriate words and actions. And unrighteousness means not having fair and appropriate words and actions. The apostle Paul once said about this unrighteousness: "Since they deliberately did not know God, God gave them over to an evil heart to do unreasonable things, full of all unrighteousness, wickedness, greed, malice, full of envy, murder, emulation, deceit, malice, slanderers, fabricators of evil, disobedient to parents, ignorant, covenant breakers, unmerciful. Even though they knew God has judged that those who do these things deserve to die. However, they not only do it themselves but also like others to do it. In their small lives, unrighteous people only know how to do evil and sell their spiritual lives. They do not know or think about what they should do in life. Of course, they are indifferent to the matter of "justification", let alone "sacrifice their lives for righteousness". So, who is a righteous person? Those who can truly be called righteous must be called "righteous" by the only person in the universe. Only then can they be regarded as legitimate righteous people. If the kind of justification that people in the world call righteous people is worthy of consideration, what kind of righteous people are in the eyes of God? The apostle Paul tells us: "Everyone in the world has sinned and fallen short of the glory of God." But now we are justified by God's grace, through Christ Jesus, who is a propitiation for us free by faith through his blood, to demonstrate the righteousness of God, because in his longsuffering he endures former sins, so that he can demonstrate his righteousness in this present time, so that he himself is righteous and the justifier of those who believe in him. Abraham believed God and this was accounted to him as righteousness. David said, “Blessed is he who is imputed righteous by God. He is imputed righteous.” This sentence was written not only for him, but also for those of us who will be imputed righteous in the future, that is, those of us who believe in God and raised our Lord Jesus from the dead. Because Jesus was handed over to die on the cross for our sins so that we might be justified. Just as sin reigned in death, so grace reigns through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord. (Romans 3:23-26) From Paul’s words, we can know that an unrighteous person, in order to become a righteous person in the eyes of God, must believe in Jesus and rely on the precious blood of the Lord to have his sins forgiven before he can be justified by God. We are justified by God in the Holy Spirit, sent by God, and walk with God, and we have the responsibility to preach the way of righteousness. (Genesis 6:9) This sacred work of preaching righteousness sometimes requires the sacrifice of life for the Lord. Only the spirit of sacrificing one's life to save righteousness can lead to happiness. Then, who inspires us to have this spirit of sacrificing our lives for righteousness? He is Jesus Christ, because the Scripture says: "It is rare to die for a righteous man, but no one dares to die for a righteous man. But God demonstrates his love for us in that, while we were still sinners, Christ died for us." (Romans 5:7-8) He also says, "I have been crucified with Christ, and the life I live now is not that I live, but that I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me." ” (Gal. 2, 20) The ancient saints laid down their lives for the Lord to preach righteousness because they deeply realized how great the love of Christ is. Nothing in the world can separate them from God's love. Except for God's love that inspired them to sacrifice their lives for righteousness, the Lord Jesus told them that there was a wonderful hometown in heaven that God had prepared for them. , and will come again to greet them when the time comes. (John 14:1-4) Because they can understand the way of life and death that they are born before they die, and they know that life is just like a flower that comes out and flies away like a shadow, life is a temporary stay, and death is a great return. By being martyred for the Lord, they can stay forever in the Book of Life of the Lamb of God and be justified by God. Dear brothers, sisters, elders and co-workers, we are all loyal servants of the spiritual kingdom of God and citizens of the land of China. We are bought by God with precious blood from all nations, tribes and peoples, and belong to God. We hold the kingship of the earth, ride on white horses, hold spiritual swords in our hands, fight heroes, and spread the truth like flying eagles, testify for Jesus, endure hardships and fear God’s name. Righteous people who are martyred for the Lord and sacrifice their lives for righteousness. The Analects of Confucius says: "Since ancient times, there has been death, and people cannot stand without faith. "Some people kill themselves to achieve benevolence, and mothers seek life to harm benevolence." Sima Qian said: "Death is heavier than Mount Tai, and lighter than a feather." The Lord Jesus exhorted: “Truly, truly, I say to you, unless a grain of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a single grain.” If it dies, it will bear much fruit. He who loves his life will lose it; but whoever hates his life in this world will keep it for eternity. "(John 12:22-25) Taishan and Hongmao, sacrifice your life for righteousness or abandon righteousness and live a secret life, it is your choice, but I pray that you can glorify God and benefit people, and live up to this life. I am willing to encourage each other, Amen.

31cb2d3603827365077df905a37980abbc9da8de.sourceText: 庆中秋迎国庆举办联谊活动 新侨老侨将欢聚一堂共度佳节 亚省时报 本报记者报道, 据华联, 侨联共同消息：即将到来的欢度中秋传统佳节和迎接中国国庆活动，将由亚利桑那州华人华侨联合总会和亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院主办，大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会协办，亚省中国餐传馆协会，亚省中华文化交流会，亚省开平同乡会，等等团体积极参与赞助．这项活动将成为亚利桑那广大华人侨胞一起参加的一次最大规模的庆祝活动，将充份显现出当地侨社的和谐气氛。 欢度中秋迎国庆活动筹备工作正在展开，主办方得到广大新侨老侨的热烈拥护和支持。对于如何筹备一系列丰富多彩的活动，当地一批深资侨领，如余文劲，邓朝驹，甄硕钦，关宗任，杨振刚，徐国富，张华芳，梅树德，陆少明，关兆锋，崔增祺，等等， 献计献策，表示愿意出钱出力。因为正值暑假，主办方也正在和亚利桑那州立大学中国学生学者联谊会负责人联络，他们也非常有可能加入主办行列，为欢庆华人节日出力。 目前，据华联和孔子初步拟定的活动计划是：于2011年9月18日（星期日），在亚利桑那州立大学的纪念联盟，举办主题论坛，中秋国庆招待会，舞会等活动。具体时间安排如下： 这次论坛的主题是”在全球市场中连手中国”迎华人朋友广泛参与讨论。 一 3:00-5:00论坛在全球市场中来连手中国，地点； Turquoise 二 5:00-7:00中秋国庆招待会 亚利桑那宴会厅 Arizona Ballroom 三 7:00-9:00舞会 /表演 亚利桑那宴会厅 Arizona Ballroom 四 5:00-9:00摄影展览或者相关比赛 亚利桑那宴会厅 Arizona Ballroom 具体计划实施正在征求意见之中，希望能在得到大众的宝贵的意见，井将召集会议，组成筹备委员会，同心协力来做好各方面的准备工作． 目前，活动联系人是: 亚利桑那州华人华侨联合总会（ACUA）， 费健会长 480-241-7263 董斌副会长 480-252-4644 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院 徐智萍副院长480-965 – 7179 大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会（GPCUA） 邓朝驹会长 亚省中华文化交流协会， 张华芳 623-202-1032 2011年中秋国庆活动更多精彩，还在策划中，本报将第一时间给你带来相关报导。
31cb2d3603827365077df905a37980abbc9da8de.translatedText: Social activities will be held to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival and the National Day. New and old overseas Chinese will gather together to celebrate the festival. A reporter from the Alberta Times reported that according to Hualian, Common news from the Federation of Overseas Chinese: The upcoming activities to celebrate the traditional Mid-Autumn Festival and welcome the National Day of China will be hosted by the Arizona Overseas Chinese Federation and the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, co-organized by the Greater Phoenix Federation of Chinese Overseas Chinese Associations, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association, the Alberta Chinese Cultural Exchange Association, the Kaiping Association of Kaiping, and other groups will actively participate in the sponsorship. This event will be the largest celebration attended by the Chinese overseas Chinese in Arizona, and will fully demonstrate the harmonious atmosphere of the local overseas Chinese community. Preparations for the activities to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival and welcome the National Day are underway, and the organizers have received enthusiastic support from the vast number of new and old overseas Chinese. Regarding how to prepare a series of colorful activities, a group of senior local overseas Chinese leaders, such as Yu Wenjin, Deng Chaoju, Zhen Shuoqin, Guan Zongren, Yang Zhengang, Xu Guofu, Zhang Huafang, Mei Shude, Lu Shaoming, Guan Zhaofeng, Cui Zengqi, etc., offered suggestions and expressed their willingness to contribute money and efforts. Because it is the summer vacation, the organizer is also in contact with the person in charge of the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of Arizona State University. They are also very likely to join the ranks of the organizers and contribute to celebrating the Chinese festival. At present, according to the preliminary activity plan drawn up by Hualian and Confucius, the theme forum, Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day reception, dance and other activities will be held on September 18, 2011 (Sunday) at the Memorial Union of Arizona State University. The specific schedule is as follows: The theme of this forum is "Connecting with China in the Global Market" and welcomes Chinese friends to participate in the discussion extensively. One 3:00-5:00 Forum to join forces with China in the global market, location; Turquoise Two 5:00-7:00 Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day reception Arizona Ballroom Three 7:00-9:00 Dance/performance Arizona Ballroom Four 5:00-9:00 Photography exhibition or related competition Arizona Ballroom Arizona Ballroom The implementation of the specific plan is currently soliciting opinions. We hope to get valuable opinions from the public. We will convene a meeting and form a preparatory committee to work together to make preparations in all aspects. 521b636b4fd5c25e3a74bd31118a6167e13cea14.sourceText: 治粤八年南天王——传奇人物陈济棠 余玉书 （四）倡经教育惹风浪（中） 陈济棠在文胆智囊团的建议下，选择了《孝经》作为复兴中国固有文化的第一部书。虽然百行孝为先，殊不知《孝经》却是一部伪书。《四书》是《大学》、《中庸》、《孟子》及《论语》；《五经》是《诗》、《书》、《易》、《礼》及《春秋》（加上失传的《乐经》则凑成六经）都没有把《孝经》列入其中。查看胡适博士的《中国古代哲学史》第四篇《孔子》第一章”孔子传略”,”厖此外还有许多书，名为是孔子作的，其实都是后人依托的。例如一部孝经；称孔子为仲尼，称曾参为曾子，又夹许多诗云子曰，可见决不是孔子做的。’孝经钩命诀’说’吾志在春秋行在孝经’，也是汉人假做的诳语，决不可信。” 可是陈济棠及其文胆智囊团，不知是闻所未闻，还是不屑新派学人之言，以”尊孔读经，阐扬国粹”由其兄长陈维周所主持的学术团体”明德社”大事宣传，未几又创办了”学海书院”聘张君励为院长，张东荪等为教授，主要课程均为四书五经，不但为陈济棠培养文武接班人，而且还想进一步将读经运动推广到全省的各级学校中去，广东一时读经之风大盛，各种版本的四书五经，一时为之洛阳纸贵。 ”广东军事政治学校”（前黄埔军校）秘书卢允衡为了讨其所好，花了不少心血编纂了一部《孝经新诂》想核定之为各级学校的指定范本。虽然大学的课程由教育局自行决定，只要一纸命令即可通行。当时广东省主席林云陔兼任”广东军事政治学校”副校长，照理应该顺利通过，但林毕竟是官场老手，不想为此事负上全责，于是在申请公文上批注：”转呈国民政府西南政务委员会核定”。所谓”西南政务委员会”是由广东、广西两省联合组成的权力咨询机构，有联省显示实力的作用，卢疏通了会中的桂系、胡系及粤系的委员，《孝经新诂》终获通过，议决转交广东省政府办理。 于是此案便移交广东省委员会，由挂着广东省委员虚衔的两位教育家许崇清和金曾澄负责审核，在陈济棠及卢允衡看来，只不过例行公事，但结果却令二人大跌眼镜。 原来许崇清并非等闲之辈，曾任中山大学校长和广东省教育厅长，是第二任粤军总司令许崇智的堂弟，曾留学日本东京帝国大学，后与国民党元老廖仲恺的侄女廖六薇结婚，在李济深、陈铭枢主粤时期，曾任民政厅长，一度暂代广东省主席，素具清誉威望，”九一八”事变，中山大学同学发动全国学生抗日运动，许被”西南政务委员会”以”控制不力”而免职。
521b636b4fd5c25e3a74bd31118a6167e13cea14.translatedText: The Southern Heavenly King who ruled Guangdong for eight years - the legendary Chen Jitang Yu Yushu (4) Promoting economic education caused trouble (middle) At the suggestion of the Literary Think Tank, Chen Jitang chose "The Classic of Filial Piety" as the first book to revive China's inherent culture. Although filial piety is the first thing to do, everyone knows that "The Classic of Filial Piety" is a fake book. The "Four Books" are "The Great Learning", "The Doctrine of the Mean", "Mencius" and "The Analects of Confucius"; the "Five Classics" are the "Poetry", "Book", "Yi", "Li" and "Spring and Autumn" (plus the lost "Yue Jing", the Six Classics are not included in the "Filial Piety Classic". Check out Dr. Hu Shi's "History of Ancient Chinese Philosophy" Chapter 1 "Confucius" Chapter 1 "Biography of Confucius", "There are also many books titled "Confucius", which are actually relied on by later generations. For example, a "Book of Filial Piety"; Calling Confucius Zhongni, calling Zeng Shen Zengzi, and including many poems saying "The Book of Filial Piety" is definitely not done by Confucius. It is also a lie made by the Han people. " However, Chen Jitang and his literary and courageous think tank either had not heard of it or were disdainful of the words of the new scholars. They promoted the academic group "Mingde Society" chaired by his brother Chen Weizhou with the idea of "respecting Confucius, reading scriptures and expounding the quintessence of China". Soon they founded the "Xuehai Academy" and appointed Zhang Junli as the dean. , Zhang Dongsun and others were professors, and their main courses were the Four Books and Five Classics. They not only cultivated civil and military successors for Chen Jitang, but also wanted to further promote the Bible-reading movement to schools at all levels across the province. Bible-reading was very popular in Guangdong, and various versions of the Four Books and Five Classics were expensive in Luoyang. In order to please him, Lu Yunheng, secretary of the "Guangdong Military and Political School" (formerly Whampoa Military Academy), spent a lot of effort compiling a "New Exegesis of the Classic of Filial Piety" to be approved as a designated model for schools at all levels. Although the university's curriculum is determined by the Education Bureau, only an order is required. At that time, the Chairman of Guangdong Province, Lin Yunye, was also the vice-principal of the "Guangdong Military and Political School", so it should have passed smoothly. However, Lin was a veteran in officialdom after all and did not want to take full responsibility for the matter, so he wrote on the official application document: "Forward to the Southwest Political Affairs Committee of the National Government for approval." The so-called "Southwestern Political Affairs Committee" is a power advisory body jointly formed by Guangdong and Guangxi provinces. It has the function of linking the provinces to show their strength. Lu dredged up the members of the Guangxi, Hu and Cantonese factions in the committee. The "New Exegesis of Xiao Jing" was finally passed, and the resolution was transferred to the Guangdong Provincial Government for processing. So the case was handed over to the Guangdong Provincial Committee, and two educators, Xu Chongqing and Jin Zengcheng, who had the false title of Guangdong Provincial Committee, were responsible for the review. In the eyes of Chen Jitang and Lu Yunheng, it was just a routine matter, but the result surprised them. It turns out that Xu Chongqing is not an idle person. He once served as the president of Sun Yat-sen University and the Education Department of Guangdong Province. He is the cousin of Xu Chongzhi, the second commander-in-chief of the Guangdong Army. He studied at Tokyo Imperial University in Japan and later married Liao Liuwei, the niece of the Kuomintang veteran Liao Zhongkai. During the period when Chen Mingshu was in charge of Guangdong, he served as the director of the Department of Civil Affairs and temporarily acted as the chairman of Guangdong Province. He was well-known and prestigious. During the "September 18th" incident, his classmates at Sun Yat-sen University launched the national student anti-Japanese movement. Xu was dismissed by the "Southwestern Political Affairs Committee" for "inadequate control."

cc02572e5e9fc34a8982cb7488ed31320fce11ef.sourceText: 尤马连环枪击案 五死一伤 尤马市2日发生连环枪击案，一名73岁男子因对他的离婚案件不满，在不同地点连续枪杀包括律师在内的五人、射伤一人后自尽。 凶案的详情尚不完全明朗，该市市长克里格表示，凶案发生在育马数个不同的地点，凶嫌早上6时就先开枪射死一名妇女，约9时左右，到律师办公室枪杀律师薛利(Jerrold Shelley)，再转往他处行凶。其他受害者为凶嫌的亲友。一名重伤者被送往凤凰城区的医院。 枪击案发生在当地时间上午9时许，警方在9时30分接到报案电话，约11时30分，尤马郡副警长发现凶嫌戴斯(Carey Hal Dyess)死于育马市外的乡间。 枪击案发生后，警方封闭市区一条街，关闭尤马郡法院和附近数间学校。法院和学校无人受伤，警方约两小时后重新开放学校和法院。 法院文件显示，凶嫌涉及两件民事案，一件在尤马，另一件在附近的威尔顿(Wellton)。法院书记官说，2006年法官发出保护令，命令凶嫌不得接近他的妻子，当时他的妻子要求和他离婚。 克里格说：「这是一件悲剧。」他说，五个月来，本州岛发生数件枪击案，造成六人死亡，13人受伤，包括在图桑市遭枪击的国会众议员嘉贝丽吉福兹。他说：「我们不希望发生这样的悲剧，这不是我们的生活方式。」
cc02572e5e9fc34a8982cb7488ed31320fce11ef.translatedText: Serial shootings in Yuma, five dead and one injured A series of shootings occurred in Yuma on the 2nd. A 73-year-old man, dissatisfied with his divorce case, shot five people, including a lawyer, in different locations, shot and wounded one person, and then committed suicide. The details of the murder are not yet completely clear. The mayor of the city, Krieger, said that the murder occurred in several different locations in Yuma. The suspect shot and killed a woman at 6 a.m., and about 9 a.m., he went to the lawyer's office and shot lawyer Jerrold Shelley before moving to another location to commit the murder. The other victims were relatives and friends of the suspect. One person was taken to a Phoenix-area hospital with serious injuries. The shooting occurred at about 9 a.m. local time. The police received a report call at 9:30 a.m. At about 11:30 a.m., a Yuma County deputy sheriff found the suspect, Carey Hal Dyess, dead in the countryside outside Yuma City. After the shooting, police closed a street in the city and closed the Yuma County Courthouse and several nearby schools. No one was injured at the courthouse or school, and police reopened the school and courthouse about two hours later. Court documents show the suspect was involved in two civil cases, one in Yuma and another in nearby Wellton. The court clerk said that in 2006, a judge issued a protection order ordering the suspect not to approach his wife, who at that time asked for a divorce from him. "This is a tragedy," Krieger said. He said that in the past five months, several shootings have occurred on the island, leaving six people dead and 13 injured, including Congresswoman Gabrielle Giffords, who was shot in Tucson. "We don't want a tragedy like this to happen, this is not our way of life," he said.

1f212b57d6ffb6c01b0caddb12a360fcf062c378.sourceText: 中国西藏珠峰地区实现刷卡消费 中国银联联合中国农业银行等金融机构，日前在珠穆朗玛峰所在的西藏日喀则定日县布放ＰＯＳ机。这意味西藏银联受理网络跨越崇山峻岭，延伸至被誉为”地球之巅”的珠峰地区。 西藏日喀则地区的定日县位于喜马拉雅山脉中段北麓珠穆朗玛峰脚下，也是从中国境内攀登珠穆朗玛峰的必经之地，全县平均海拔４３００米，县域平均海拔５０００米以上，３１８国道贯穿全县，境内有珠穆朗玛峰、卓奥友峰等４座海拔８０００米以上的高峰，以及嘎玛沟山谷、绒辖森林等著名景点，每年吸引大批国内外登山爱好者和游客前往这里登山、旅游。但由于海拔较高、资源匮乏，定日县长期以来均以现金交易为支付结算方式，无法满足人们便捷、安全的支付需求。 ”今后到珠峰地区登山、旅游，不需要带上大量的现金，只要带上银联卡就可以轻松实现刷卡消费，”中国银联股份有限公司西藏分公司综合部经理林卫东介绍，只要是银联标准卡、银联标识卡均可在定日县实现刷卡消费。 近年来，随着西藏经济社会的快速发展，尤其是青藏铁路全线通车后，带动了旅游业全面发展。中国银联不断优化西藏的银联卡受理环境。 截至２０１０年底，西藏联网商户、ＰＯＳ和ＡＴＭ数量分别达到２００９年底的１．６倍、１．５倍和１．２倍，基本覆盖旅游、餐饮、零售、酒店等与民生密切相关的行业领域。
1f212b57d6ffb6c01b0caddb12a360fcf062c378.translatedText: Card consumption has been enabled in the Everest region of Tibet, China China UnionPay, together with the Agricultural Bank of China and other financial institutions, recently deployed POS machines in Dingri County, Xigaze, Tibet, where Mount Everest is located. This means that the Tibet UnionPay acceptance network spans across the mountains and extends to the Mount Everest region, known as the “Top of the Earth”. Dingri County in the Shigatse Prefecture of Tibet is located at the foot of Mount Everest at the northern foot of the middle section of the Himalayas. It is also the only place to climb Mount Everest from China. The average altitude of the county is 4,300 meters, and the average altitude of the county is more than 5,000 meters, 318 The national highway runs through the entire county. There are four peaks above 8,000 meters above sea level, including Mount Everest and Cho Oyu Peak, as well as famous scenic spots such as Karmagou Valley and Rongha Forest. Every year, a large number of domestic and foreign mountaineering enthusiasts and tourists are attracted here to climb and travel. However, due to the high altitude and lack of resources, Dingri County has long used cash transactions as the payment settlement method, which cannot meet people's convenient and safe payment needs. “In the future, when you go hiking or traveling in the Mount Everest region, you don’t need to bring a large amount of cash. You can easily make purchases with a UnionPay card,” said Lin Weidong, general manager of the Tibet Branch of China UnionPay Co., Ltd. UnionPay standard cards and UnionPay logo cards can be used to make purchases in Tingri County. In recent years, with the rapid economic and social development of Tibet, especially after the Qinghai-Tibet Railway was opened to traffic, the tourism industry has developed in an all-round way. China UnionPay continues to optimize the UnionPay card acceptance environment in Tibet. By the end of 2010, the number of online merchants, POS and ATMs in Tibet had reached 1.6 times, 1.5 times and 1.2 times respectively as at the end of 2009, basically covering tourism, catering, retail, hotels and other industries closely related to people's livelihood.

e5abf2902a3bf8df7f3deb7a8f12af232b8837e6.sourceText: 预付款手机增长超过后付款手机 美国手机业一直被传统的后付款的手机占据大部份市场。但是从最近三年来看，后付款的手机的市场发展越来越缓慢，而预付款的手机却呈现上升趋势。2009年第四个季度，预付款的手机增长首次超过后付款手机。未来预测这一差距 将会扩大。 传统的后付款方式是，当一个用户在这一个月过后，根据这个月手机使用的时间长短而付费。一般来说手机营运商会向客户确认两件事情： 查询客户的信用记录。好的信用记录可以相对来说保证客户会按时付款。 和客户签一个一年或两年的合约。在合约到期前客户如果要终止手机服务的话，客户需要付提前解约费，一般来说150美元以上。 预付款的手机运作就不一样了。客户的信用记录不会被查，也不需要签两年合约。客户只需要预先把钱存进手机账户里，然后根据手机营运商定好的收费标准收费，例如一分钟十美分，或者1000分钟100美元，等等。普遍来说，对于一个不 经常使用手机的用户，预付款手机的电话费要便宜。 实际上预付款的手机在欧洲比在美国还要流行。例如2009第三个季度，英国预付款的手机占全部手机的66%，德国预付款的手机占全部手机的55%。 2010年11月在美国Deloitte公司做了一个市场调查，五分之一的后付款的手机用户表示，在接下来的六个月内，他们有可能会转到预付款的手机。 最近几年智能手机蓬勃发展。智能手机的价钱越来越便宜。手机营运商也推出各种各样的预付款智能手机吸引客户。这将促使美国预付款手机增长更加超过后付款手机。
e5abf2902a3bf8df7f3deb7a8f12af232b8837e6.translatedText: The growth of pre-paid mobile phones exceeds that of post-paid mobile phones. The US mobile phone industry has always been dominated by traditional post-paid mobile phones occupying most of the market. However, judging from the past three years, the market development of postpaid mobile phones has become slower and slower, while the prepaid mobile phone market has shown an upward trend. In the fourth quarter of 2009, the growth of prepaid mobile phones exceeded that of postpaid mobile phones for the first time. This gap is predicted to widen in the future. The traditional post-payment method is that after a month, a user pays according to the length of time the mobile phone is used in the month. Generally speaking, mobile phone operators will confirm two things with customers: Check the customer's credit record. A good credit history is a relative guarantee that customers will pay on time. Sign a one- or two-year contract with the client. If the customer wants to terminate the mobile phone service before the contract expires, the customer needs to pay an early termination fee, which is generally more than 150 US dollars. Prepaid cell phones work differently. Customers' credit records will not be checked and there is no need to sign a two-year contract. Customers only need to deposit money into their mobile phone account in advance, and then charge according to the charging standards set by the mobile phone operator, such as ten cents per minute, or US$100 for 1,000 minutes, etc. Generally speaking, for a user who does not use a mobile phone frequently, the phone bill for a prepaid mobile phone is cheaper. Prepaid cell phones are actually more popular in Europe than in the United States. For example, in the third quarter of 2009, prepaid mobile phones in the UK accounted for 66% of all mobile phones, and prepaid mobile phones in Germany accounted for 55% of all mobile phones. In a market survey conducted by Deloitte in the United States in November 2010, one-fifth of postpaid mobile phone users said that they are likely to switch to a prepaid mobile phone within the next six months. Smartphones have boomed in recent years. Smartphones are getting cheaper and cheaper. Mobile phone operators are also launching a variety of prepaid smartphones to attract customers. This will push US prepaid mobile phone growth to outpace postpaid mobile phone growth.

e8ffe6c7b107c449eaca1bc219e523b0a1d0d48b.sourceText: 北京上海深圳位列中国离婚率前三位 近日公布的全国民政事业统计数据显示，今年一季度，中国共有４６．５万对夫妻办理了离婚登记，平均每天有５０００多个家庭解体，有关资料显示，北京、上海及深圳位列离婚率前三甲。 日前公布的２０１１年一季度全国民政事业统计数据显示，今年一季度，中国共有３１７．６万对夫妻办理了结婚登记，但离婚率也达１４．６％，中国离婚率连续７年递增。 数据显示，２００７年离婚登记数为３２０．４万对，而２００８年至2０１０年三年间的离婚登记数分别为３５６．１万对、４０４．７万对、４５１．６万对。 值得注意的是，离婚症候群在北京、上海等一线城市表现得更为突出。据２００９年第三季度民政统计季报显示，北京、上海当季度离婚率分别达２０．６％、２３．９％。 复旦大学历史系教授顾晓鸣认为，随着财富成为衡量成功与否的主要标志，无论是事业有成的还是正在为事业奋斗的，都在忙于工作及应酬，而忽略了与伴侣必要的沟通和交流，这才是家庭解体的”最大隐形杀手”。 ”不要说一线城市，在内地，人们的婚姻观都在发生变化，也促使着离婚由以往的被动式向主动式转变，”江西省南昌市妇女联合会权益部专家邹细生说，”现在的夫妻越来越注重感情，而不是为了孩子或生存非要凑合着过下去。” 有专家则认为，在婚姻观转变的过程中，组织及社会舆论等传统约束逐渐丧失，而新的责任和约束又没有很好地建立，是造成中国社会离婚率不断攀升的症结。同时，离婚成本低也会促使离婚时的轻率。 目前，兰州、上海已在试点”离婚劝和”机制，”婚姻家庭咨询师”已在多个城市开展业务，这都是婚姻家庭社会救疗的有力探索。 法律救济也是社会救疗的重要途径。有学者建议，《婚姻法》要进一步加强对弱势方以及无过错方的权益保护，如明确对无过错方的财产及子女抚养等问题上的偏向救济，变模糊的标准为明确可操作的标准。
e8ffe6c7b107c449eaca1bc219e523b0a1d0d48b.translatedText: Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen rank among the top three divorce rates in China. Recently released national civil affairs statistics show that in the first quarter of this year, a total of 465,000 couples in China registered for divorce, with an average of more than 5,000 families disintegrating every day. Relevant data show that Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen rank among the top three divorce rates. The recently released national civil affairs statistics for the first quarter of 2011 show that in the first quarter of this year, a total of 3.176 million couples registered for marriage in China, but the divorce rate also reached 14.6%. China's divorce rate has increased for seven consecutive years. Data show that the number of divorce registrations in 2007 was 3.204 million pairs, while the number of divorce registrations in the three years from 2008 to 2010 was 3.561 million pairs, 4.047 million pairs, and 4.516 million pairs respectively. It is worth noting that divorce syndrome is more prominent in first-tier cities such as Beijing and Shanghai. According to the Civil Affairs Statistics Quarterly Report for the third quarter of 2009, the divorce rates in Beijing and Shanghai reached 20.6% and 23.9% respectively. Gu Xiaoming, a professor at the Department of History at Fudan University, believes that as wealth has become the main indicator of success, both those who are successful in their careers and those who are struggling for their careers are busy with work and socializing, and ignore the necessary communication and communication with their partners. This is the "biggest invisible killer" of family disintegration. "Not to mention first-tier cities, in the mainland, people's views on marriage are changing, which is also prompting divorce to change from passive to active in the past," said Zou Xisheng, an expert in the rights department of the Women's Federation of Nanchang City, Jiangxi Province. "Today's couples are paying more and more attention to their relationships, rather than having to make do for children or survival." Some experts believe that in the process of changing views on marriage, traditional constraints such as organizations and public opinion are gradually lost, and new responsibilities and constraints are not well established, which is the crux of the rising divorce rate in Chinese society. At the same time, the low cost of divorce can also encourage imprudent divorce. At present, Lanzhou and Shanghai have piloted the "divorce reconciliation" mechanism, and "marriage and family counselors" have begun operations in many cities. These are powerful explorations of social treatment for marriage and family. Legal relief is also an important way of social treatment. Some scholars suggest that the Marriage Law should further strengthen the protection of the rights and interests of the vulnerable party and the non-fault party, such as clarifying the preferential relief for the non-fault party on issues such as property and child support, and changing vague standards into clear and operable standards.

d64ddea8a69b1b0e7c3df34848a4cc58d6064cad.sourceText: 领养中国儿童家庭欢聚总领馆共庆六一儿童节暨端午节(图) 亚省时报 6月5日中午，中国驻洛杉矶总领馆大厅热闹非凡，不时传来小孩的欢笑声和热烈掌声。中国驻洛杉矶总领馆与家庭联谊组织”家有中国小孩”（Families with Children from China)举行联欢， 邀请30多个在中国领养儿童的家庭前来参加，活动为分散各地的中国孩子领养家庭提供了难得的聚会机会。 总领馆邱绍芳总领事寄语孩子们，希望他们在美国茁壮成长，积极学习中文，了解中国的历史文化，成为中美两国文化交流的桥梁，中美友谊的小使者。 领养组织协会主席欧森（AL-Bert olson)对中领馆关心领养儿童深表感谢，他表示，这些小天使是美中两国的共同财富和希望，领养组织协会将继续努力，让孩子们熟悉美国文化的同时，更多了解中国文化。 此次活动也专门设计了相关节目，让在美国成长的中国娃娃们对母国文化有基本了解，活动播放了中国国家 形象宣传片，举行中国历史地理人文基本知识有奖问答，中国少数民族舞蹈，中国功夫表演，还与孩子们做了中 国传统的”击鼓传花”，”抢凳子”游戏，孩子们玩得不亦乐乎，兴致勃勃。在有奖问答节目里，稚气可爱的孩子们五花八门，天真无邪的回答让人鼓掌称赞，有时又让人忍俊不禁，笑翻全场。 记者还注意到，孩子们与养父母之间已是鱼水情深，你看那腼腆的小女孩想参加游戏，硬拉着妈妈陪她去；有的偎依在妈妈的怀里撒娇；有的打开奖品给爸爸看，有好几个家庭还领养了一大一小两个，特别的还有长得一模一样的三胞胎女孩手拉手跟着父母。 总领馆为每位小朋友赠送了中国书籍和迷你生肖兔等有中国特色的小礼物，还准备了精致的午餐和小粽子，让来宾们感受到端午节吃粽子的特殊意味。 邱绍芳总领事寄语孩子们茁壮成长 母女情深
d64ddea8a69b1b0e7c3df34848a4cc58d6064cad.translatedText: Families adopting Chinese children gathered at the consulate general to celebrate Children's Day and the Dragon Boat Festival (photo) Alberta Times At noon on June 5th, the hall of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles was bustling, with children's laughter and warm applause coming from time to time. The Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles held a party with the family networking organization "Families with Children from China" and invited more than 30 families who adopted children in China to participate. The event provided a rare gathering opportunity for families who have adopted children from China. Consul General Qiu Shaofang of the Consulate General sent a message to the children, hoping that they would thrive in the United States, actively learn Chinese, understand Chinese history and culture, and become a bridge for cultural exchanges between China and the United States and little ambassadors of Sino-US friendship. AL-Bert Olson, chairman of the Adoption Organization Association, expressed his deep gratitude to the Chinese Consulate for caring about adopted children. He said that these little angels are the common wealth and hope of the United States and China. The Adoption Organization Association will continue to work hard to familiarize children with American culture and learn more about Chinese culture. This event also specially designed related programs to allow Chinese dolls who grew up in the United States to have a basic understanding of the culture of their mother country. The event played a promotional video on China's national image, held prize-winning quizzes on basic knowledge of Chinese history, geography and humanities, Chinese ethnic minority dances, Chinese kung fu performances, and also played traditional Chinese "drum-passing flowers" and "scramble for the stool" games with the children. The children had a great time playing and were very interested. In the quiz show with prizes, there are all kinds of childish and cute children, and their innocent answers make people applaud and praise them. Sometimes they make people laugh and make the whole audience laugh. The reporter also noticed that the children had a close relationship with their adoptive parents. You see, the shy little girl wanted to participate in the game and forced her mother to accompany her; some snuggled in her mother's arms and acted coquettishly; some opened the prizes to show their fathers. Several families adopted two children, one older and one younger. In particular, there were triplets who looked exactly the same and followed their parents hand in hand. The Consulate General presented each child with small gifts with Chinese characteristics such as Chinese books and mini zodiac rabbits. It also prepared exquisite lunches and small rice dumplings to let the guests feel the special meaning of eating rice dumplings during the Dragon Boat Festival. Consul General Qiu Shaofang sent a message to the children to thrive and the deep love between mother and daughter

98b0050e973b6c942df89c4b30d9a395a232bfbe.sourceText: 吴冠中《狮子林》1.15亿成交 创现当代艺术纪录 保利拍卖”现当代中国艺术夜场棗吴冠中重要绘画作品”专场3日晚间在京举行，吴冠中的《狮子林》以1.15亿元人民币成交，创造了中国现当代艺术的新纪录，这也是画家个人作品拍卖最新纪录。 本场25件作品全部成交，除1件拍品过亿外，还有14件拍品过千万，总成交额达5亿元人民币。这些作品分别来自全球十余位藏家，既反映了吴冠中艺术在全球的认可程度，又代表了画家个人的最高水平。 尺幅达144cm?97cm的《狮子林》是吴冠中点、线色彩系列中留存民间的最大尺幅作品。该拍品以5000万元开槌，经过数十轮竞逐，最终以1亿元落槌，加佣金成交额达1.15亿元，刷新了中国现当代艺术的拍卖纪录。 吴冠中早期油画代表作《木槿》以6325万元成交。另一幅江南主题的代表作《双燕》以4600万元成交，描绘青岛风光的《青岛》拍出4025万元，风景力作《玉龙山》以3450万元易主，与《交河故城》等同系列的《峭壁》成交价为2990万元。 此外，《树与牛》、《山间水田》、《香港中环夜景》、《江南园林鱼之乐》、《双松》、《海滨石》、《大昭寺》、《太湖泊舟》等不同题材作品均以千万以上价位成交。 北京保利拍卖执行董事赵旭表示，经过本次专场拍卖，吴冠中成为中国大陆第一位单件拍品过亿的现当代艺术家，这必将掀起中国现当代艺术的新一轮热潮。
98b0050e973b6c942df89c4b30d9a395a232bfbe.translatedText: Wu Guanzhong's "Lion Grove" was sold for 115 million, setting a record for modern and contemporary art. Poly Auction's "Modern and Contemporary Chinese Art Night Show: Important Paintings by Wu Guanzhong" special event was held in Beijing on the evening of the 3rd. Wu Guanzhong's "Lion Grove" was sold for 115 million yuan, setting a new record for Chinese modern and contemporary art. This is also the latest auction record for the painter's personal works. All 25 works in this auction were sold, with one auction exceeding RMB 10 million and 14 other auctions exceeding RMB 10 million, with a total transaction volume of RMB 500 million. These works come from more than ten collectors around the world, which not only reflects the global recognition of Wu Guanzhong's art, but also represents the highest level of the painter. Measuring 144cm x 97cm, "Lion Grove" is the largest private work among Wu Guan's dot and line color series. The auction opened with an auction price of 50 million yuan. After dozens of rounds of competition, it finally sold for 100 million yuan. The transaction amount including commissions reached 115 million yuan, setting a new auction record for Chinese modern and contemporary art. Wu Guanzhong's early oil painting "Hibiscus" was sold for 63.25 million yuan. Another Jiangnan-themed masterpiece "Two Swallows" was sold for 46 million yuan. "Qingdao" depicting the scenery of Qingdao was sold for 40.25 million yuan. The landscape masterpiece "Yulong Mountain" changed hands for 34.5 million yuan. The price of "Cliff" in the same series as "Jiaohe Ancient City" was 29.9 million yuan. In addition, works with different themes such as "Tree and Cow", "Paddy Field in the Mountains", "Hong Kong Central Night Scene", "Fish Joy in Jiangnan Garden", "Two Pines", "Seaside Stone", "Jokhang Temple", "Taihu Lake Boat", etc. were all sold for prices exceeding tens of millions. Zhao Xu, executive director of Beijing Poly Auction, said that after this special auction, Wu Guanzhong became the first modern and contemporary artist in mainland China to have a single auction item exceed 100 million, which will surely set off a new wave of Chinese modern and contemporary art.

ee3e259fabdd672a9408cb15e943e53a05c78465.sourceText: 香港支持采用互联网规约版本6 香港特区政府资讯科技总监办公室发言人６日表示，特区政府支持采用互联网规约版本６（ＩＰｖ６），并鼓励资讯及通讯科技业的机构及早使其服务能支援这一版本。 据介绍，连接互联网的电脑、流动电话、电子装置和感应器均需要一个独一无二的互联网规约（ＩＰ）地址，用以识别身份和互通信息。目前互联网上的ＩＰ地址主要使用被称为互联网规约版本４（ＩＰｖ４）的通讯标准，而这标准可供分派的地址数目已达到上限。 新开发的互联网服务将逐步采用被称为ＩＰｖ６的新通讯标准，ＩＰｖ６标准理论上可提供的ＩＰ地址远较ＩＰｖ４多，预期公众以此新标准使用未来互联网服务的需求势将增加。 发言人表示，特区政府已经采用ＩＰｖ６标准，并推动香港逐步由ＩＰｖ４过渡至ＩＰｖ６。目前香港的互联网基础建设已经支援ＩＰｖ６，市场上也开始提供商用的ＩＰｖ６相关服务。特区政府已在其主要互联网基础建设启动ＩＰｖ６支援，公众可使用该标准登入已支援ＩＰｖ６的政府网站，并向特区政府以该标准收发电子邮件。 为推动资讯及通讯科技业界测试他们是否已准备就绪从ＩＰｖ４过渡至ＩＰｖ６，国际性非牟利组织互联网协会将今年６月８日订为?#19990;界ＩＰｖ６日?#65292;旨在测试ＩＰｖ６准备情况的全球性活动。 一些主要的互联网服务供应商、内容供应商和相关业界将于香港时间６月８日早上８时至６月９日早上８时的２４小时内，在他们的主网站启动ＩＰｖ６功能。测试期间，预计大部分互联网用户的服务将没有大影响，但极少数用户可能会遇到速度减慢或连线中断的情况。
ee3e259fabdd672a9408cb15e943e53a05c78465.translatedText: Hong Kong supports the adoption of Internet Protocol version 6 A spokesperson for the Office of the Chief Information Officer of the Hong Kong SAR Government stated on the 6th that the SAR Government supports the adoption of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) and encourages organizations in the information and communications technology industry to enable their services to support this version as soon as possible. According to reports, computers, mobile phones, electronic devices and sensors connected to the Internet all need a unique Internet Protocol (IP) address to identify identities and exchange information. Currently, IP addresses on the Internet mainly use the communication standard called Internet Protocol Version 4 (IPv4), and the number of addresses that can be allocated by this standard has reached its upper limit. Newly developed Internet services will gradually adopt a new communication standard called IPv6. The IPv6 standard can theoretically provide far more IP addresses than IPv4. It is expected that the public's demand for future Internet services using this new standard will increase. The spokesman said that the SAR government has adopted the IPv6 standard and is promoting Hong Kong's gradual transition from IPv4 to IPv6. At present, Hong Kong's Internet infrastructure already supports IPv6, and commercial IPv6-related services have begun to be provided on the market. The SAR government has launched IPv6 support in its main Internet infrastructure. The public can use this standard to log in to government websites that support IPv6, and send and receive emails to the SAR government using this standard. In order to promote the information and communication technology industry to test whether they are ready to transition from IPv4 to IPv6, the Internet Society, an international non-profit organization, has designated June 8 this year as World IPv6 Day. A global event aimed at testing IPv6 readiness. Some major Internet service providers, content providers and related industries will activate IPv6 functions on their main websites within 24 hours from 8 am on June 8 to 8 am on June 9, Hong Kong time. During the test period, it is expected that most Internet users will have no major impact on service, but a very small number of users may experience slowdowns or connection interruptions.

9ed0ee2fa8b98e65e64d4c03c0e998fabe3e4d6e.sourceText: 英特尔钱德勒芯片厂爆炸 7人受伤 英特尔 (US-INTC) 位在钱德勒市的Octotillo&Dobson附近微芯片制造厂，周二发生爆炸，人员即时疏散，有7名员工受伤，初步预计损失达4千万美元。 钱德勒市消防队长米勒表示，英特尔当地园区的一座建筑物，下午 2 时过后不久发生爆炸，原因待查。英特尔证实这项消息，但强调生产不受影响。 英特尔发言人考得表示，事发的建筑物，与兴建中的大型芯片厂毗邻，这类建筑通常负责后勤，储存许多用于芯片生产的化学原料和气体。 位于钱德勒市的英特尔设有二座大型园区，米勒向媒体表示，4 名受伤员工已送往当地医院，伤势包括脑震荡以及遭爆炸火势所伤，另 3 名伤势较轻者，已在现场接受治疗，米勒说，爆炸起点初步分析是化学库房，火势迅速扑灭，损失还有待评估知。 据悉，爆炸后，该微芯片制造厂的 700 名员工已全数疏散，为调查原因，厂房将无限期关闭，园区内其它建筑则不受影响，根据英特尔官网，亚利桑那州的厂房，主要生产奔腾系列的处理器产品。
9ed0ee2fa8b98e65e64d4c03c0e998fabe3e4d6e.translatedText: Intel's Chandler chip plant exploded, 7 people were injured Intel (US-INTC) An explosion occurred at a microchip manufacturing plant near Octotillo & Dobson in Chandler on Tuesday, prompting an immediate evacuation. Seven employees were injured, and losses were initially estimated at $40 million. Chandler Fire Chief Miller said an explosion occurred at a building on Intel's local campus shortly after 2 p.m. The cause is yet to be determined. Intel confirmed the news but stressed that production would not be affected. Intel spokesman Kaude said that the building where the incident occurred is adjacent to a large chip factory under construction. Such buildings are usually responsible for logistics and store many chemical raw materials and gases used in chip production. Intel, which is located in Chandler, has two large campuses. Miller told the media that four injured employees have been sent to local hospitals with injuries including concussions and explosion fires. The other three with minor injuries have been treated at the scene. Miller said that the initial analysis of the starting point of the explosion was a chemical warehouse, and the fire was quickly extinguished. The damage has yet to be assessed. It is reported that after the explosion, all 700 employees of the microchip manufacturing plant have been evacuated. To investigate the cause, the plant will be closed indefinitely. Other buildings in the park will not be affected. According to Intel's official website, the Arizona plant mainly produces Pentium series processor products.

2c7cc719a64d03f5c7266cf46ee15378f7a7e4a9.sourceText: E-Verify 拟全美硬性执行 联邦最高法院在5月26日判决亚利桑那州胜诉的一项移民法裁定，使全美离全面实施「员工身分电子查证系统」(E-Verify)的硬性规定，更近了一步。 本州岛硬性规定雇主必须使用E-Verify，以确认雇员具有合法工作资格。众院司法委员会主席史密斯(Lamar Smith，共和党，德州)赞扬最高法院的裁决，并计划提出硬性规定全国执行E-Verify的法案。而亚利桑那州移民法的原告美国商会，正与史密斯协商法案内容。 史密斯强调采用「员工身分电子查证系统」，是解决美国失业率的秘诀。 路透曾根据人口普查数据和劳工局的统计，指出过去两年美国有100多万个外籍工人找到新工作，其中约三分之一是非法劳工。而同一时期内，共有200万美国人失业。 史密斯说，现在总共有26万美国人失业或待业，这是真正的悲剧。他强调工作机会应先由美国人取得。史密斯也驳斥非法劳工所从事的，是美国人不愿从事的工作的说法。 E-Verify的试行期，将于2012年届满。电子身分认证系统，是由雇主将新聘员工的证件及资料，上政府网站与社安号码及联邦国内安全部数据库比对，以确认该员工有资格合法在美国工作。 国会预算处(CBO)估计，如果硬性规定全国雇主使用E-Verify，未来10年总共将耗资180亿元。 全国移民法律中心政策主任泰乐．莫然指出，有54%的非法移民员工，未获电子身分认证系统检测出来。她反对硬性规定雇主使用联邦电子身分认证系统。 预计史密斯案将在众院过关。而一直打「梦想法案」牌的参院多数党领袖雷德，建议将「梦想法案」和全美全面实施「员工身分电子查证系统」案绑在一起过关。相信反对大赦的史密斯不会同意。 「梦想法案」允许上大学或从军的无证高中毕业生取得合法身分。当事人须不满32岁，在16岁以前来美，并于过去五年连续在美居住。 史密斯曾任司法委员会移民事务小组委员会多年。有史密斯把关，国会极不可能通过全面移民改革案。而国会参院明年也变天后，将对移民更不友善。届时通过硬性全面实施「员工身分电子查证系统」，将轻而易举，就看欧巴马总统会不会签署了。
2c7cc719a64d03f5c7266cf46ee15378f7a7e4a9.translatedText: E-Verify is intended to be enforced across the United States On May 26, the federal Supreme Court ruled in favor of Arizona on an immigration law, bringing the United States one step closer to fully implementing the mandatory E-Verify system. This state mandates that employers use E-Verify to confirm that employees are legally eligible to work. House Judiciary Committee Chairman Lamar Smith (R-Texas) praised the Supreme Court's ruling and plans to introduce a bill that would mandate the nationwide implementation of E-Verify. The U.S. Chamber of Commerce, the plaintiff in Arizona’s immigration law, is negotiating with Smith on the content of the bill. Smith emphasized that the use of an "electronic employee identity verification system" is the secret to solving the unemployment rate in the United States. According to Reuters, based on census data and Bureau of Labor Statistics, more than 1 million foreign workers have found new jobs in the United States in the past two years, about one-third of whom are illegal workers. During the same period, a total of 2 million Americans were unemployed. Smith said that a total of 260,000 Americans are now unemployed or unemployed, which is a real tragedy. He emphasized that jobs should come to Americans first. Smith also dismissed the idea that illegal workers are doing jobs that Americans don't want to do. The trial period of E-Verify will expire in 2012. The electronic identity authentication system allows employers to compare newly hired employees' documents and information on government websites with their Social Security numbers and the federal Department of Homeland Security database to confirm that the employee is eligible to work in the United States legally. The Congressional Budget Office (CBO) estimates that mandating that employers across the country use E-Verify would cost a total of $18 billion over the next 10 years. Taylor., policy director of the National Immigration Law Center. Mo Ran pointed out that 54% of illegal immigrant employees were not detected by the electronic identity authentication system. She opposes mandatory requirements for employers to use the federal electronic ID system. Smith's case is expected to pass the House. Senate Majority Leader Reid, who has been playing the "Dream Act" card, suggested tying the "Dream Act" to the full implementation of the "Electronic Employee Identity Verification System" across the United States. I believe Smith, who opposes amnesty, would disagree. The Dream Act allows undocumented high school graduates who attend college or serve in the military to obtain legal status. The person concerned must be under 32 years old, came to the United States before the age of 16, and has lived in the United States continuously for the past five years. Smith served for many years as a member of the Judiciary Committee's Immigration Subcommittee. With Smith on guard, it is extremely unlikely that Congress will pass a comprehensive immigration reform bill. The Senate will also become a queen next year and will be even more unfriendly to immigrants. By then, it will be easy to fully implement the "Electronic Employee Identity Verification System". It depends on whether President Obama will sign it.

c513e645ad231440d213d10ff08453b953d9ac5d.sourceText: 秦始皇陵“百戏俑坑”博物馆将于10月1日开放 秦始皇陵博物院日前启动”百戏俑坑’考古发掘，但受制于遗址保护大厅建设进度，真正展开考古发掘要到７月份，普通游人参观则需等到今年１０月１日博物馆正式开馆。 根据考古勘探情况，考古学家目前在秦始皇陵附近已发现各种陪葬坑１８０多座，其中比较重要的有铜车马坑、珍禽异兽坑、百戏俑坑、石铠甲坑以及各种内涵不同的府藏坑等。”百戏俑坑”因发现于１９９９年被编号为Ｋ９９０１陪葬坑，位于秦陵东南部的内外城之间。 主持考古发掘工作的秦陵博物院副院长曹玮介绍说，这次发掘百戏俑坑是一个常年的任务。将来百戏俑坑的遗址大厅盖好后，就跟秦兵马俑一号坑的发掘是一样的，即边开放边发掘，游客可以近距离观看考古过程，开放的时间是今年１０月１日。 据了解，百戏俑坑是与秦兵马俑一、二、三号坑出土的俑完全不一样的一种陪葬坑。它们既不穿战袍也不披铠甲，而是上身赤裸，下身着裳。他们有单手托举的，有双手扭物的，有臂间有隙似插杆而舞的展现出百戏杂耍的形象，让人不难窥察秦人娱乐时的情景。
c513e645ad231440d213d10ff08453b953d9ac5d.translatedText: The "Pit of Hundred Opera Terracotta Warriors" museum at the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor will open on October 1 The Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum Museum has recently launched the archaeological excavation of the "Hundred Opera Terracotta Pit". However, due to the construction progress of the site protection hall, the actual archaeological excavation will not start until July, and ordinary tourists will have to wait until the official opening of the museum on October 1 this year. According to archaeological exploration, archaeologists have discovered more than 180 burial pits of various types near the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor, among which the more important ones include pits for bronze chariots and horses, pits for rare birds and animals, pits for 100 opera figurines, stone armor pits, and various Tibetan pits with different connotations. The "Hundred Opera Terracotta Pit" was discovered in 1999 and was numbered K9901 as a burial pit. It is located between the inner and outer city in the southeast of the Qin Mausoleum. Cao Wei, deputy director of Qinling Museum, who is in charge of the archaeological excavation, said that the excavation of the pit of Baixi Terracotta Warriors is a perennial task. In the future, after the relics hall of the Baixi Pit is built, it will be the same as the excavation of the Qin Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit No. 1, that is, it will be opened and excavated at the same time. Visitors can watch the archaeological process up close. The opening time is October 1 this year. It is understood that the Baixi Terracotta Warriors Pit is a completely different type of burial pit than the figurines unearthed from the Qin Terracotta Warriors and Horses Pit No. 1, 2 and 3. They wear neither battle robes nor armor, but are naked on the upper body and clothed on the lower body. Some of them are holding things up with one hand, some are twisting things with both hands, and some are dancing with poles between their arms, showing the image of a variety of acrobats. It is not difficult to get a glimpse of the Qin people's entertainment scene.

5eef7f25d77bd0976d4a040180a89bed9aca51fb.sourceText: 开平乡里喜， 开平之友乐！ 莺歌燕舞狮恭贺， 孔雀开屏放光彩， 妙哉妙哉， 美点裹粽配， 金仔银圆彩券在， 望您中奖好运来。（唷嗬！） （开平夹房歌） 锣鼓响，醒獳舞。6月5日下午，在三百多人参加，在凤城酒家举行的庆祝开平同乡互助会成立活动拉开帷幕时，该会会长，老文化人甄硕钦用开平话唱出这首民歌作为致欢迎词荣誉会长，八十多岁的关宗任在致词时向这次活动献礼：捐献十个大圆，供抽奖该会名誉顾问，资深侨领，高龄长者余文劲上台时，擎起一颗粽子，以粽叶，粽米和粽饀来比喻勖勉愿该会领导人，理事会和会员要和谐团结。该会顾问，凤凰城侨团联合总会主席，开平乡亲邓朝驹上台演讲，期望该会作为当地华人侨社中一支出色团体，在侨社活动中发挥领头作用。
5eef7f25d77bd0976d4a040180a89bed9aca51fb.translatedText: Happy Kaiping Township, happy friends of Kaiping! The singing and dancing lions congratulate you, the peacock opens its tail and shines, how wonderful it is, the delicious snacks are wrapped in rice dumplings, the gold and silver round lottery tickets are here, I hope you win and good luck. (Hoo ho!) (Kaiping Jiafang Song) The gongs and drums sound, and the dance begins. On the afternoon of June 5, when more than 300 people attended the event held at Fengcheng Restaurant to celebrate the establishment of the Kaiping Mutual Aid Association, the president of the association, the old cultural man Zhen Shuoqin, sang this folk song in Kaiping dialect as a welcome speech. The honorary president, Guan Zongren, who is in his 80s, was in During his speech, he presented a gift to this event: donated ten large yuan for the lottery. When Yu Wenjin, the honorary advisor of the association, a senior overseas Chinese leader, took the stage, he held up a rice dumpling and used rice dumpling leaves, rice dumplings and rice dumplings as metaphors to express his wish for the leaders, board of directors and members of the association to be harmonious and united. Deng Chaoju, consultant of the association, chairman of the Phoenix Federation of Overseas Chinese Associations and a native of Kaiping, gave a speech on the stage. He hoped that the association would serve as an outstanding group among local Chinese overseas Chinese associations and play a leading role in the activities of overseas Chinese associations.

b1b3da48cafbf3cd9880d05c21e9bd0dc83b4c37.sourceText: 贵州望谟县发生”6.6”特大洪涝灾害，截至记者７日晚２０时３０分发稿，据统计已造成２１人死亡，３１人失踪，直接经济损失约１３．４亿元。
b1b3da48cafbf3cd9880d05c21e9bd0dc83b4c37.translatedText: The "6.6" catastrophic flood occurred in Wangmo County, Guizhou. As of the press release at 20:30 on the evening of the 7th, according to statistics, 21 people were killed, 31 people were missing, and direct economic losses were about 1.34 billion yuan.

ab7a83bfee7167a364ad0476e5cd394afa49ef03.sourceText: ７日１８时３０分，望谟县举行新闻通气会。望谟县副县长农文海介绍，最新统计，截至６月７日下午１４时，全县受灾人口８万人，紧急转移人口４．５３８万人，其中投亲靠友４．２万人，借住房屋３３８０人；死亡２１人，失踪３１人。
ab7a83bfee7167a364ad0476e5cd394afa49ef03.translatedText: At 18:30 on the 7th, Wangmo County held a press briefing. Nong Wenhai, deputy head of Wangmo County, said that according to the latest statistics, as of 14:00 on June 7, the county's disaster-stricken population was 80,000, and 45,380 people had to be evacuated urgently, including 42,000 relatives and friends, and 3,380 people renting houses; 21 people died and 31 were missing.

662b858c5292d08c2e36dc074a9d1b09c2e45ae6.sourceText: 农文海解释道，原统计的５２名失踪人员中，有些系到外村走亲戚或在外打工等，各乡镇经过排查核实后，有１４人已找到。
662b858c5292d08c2e36dc074a9d1b09c2e45ae6.translatedText: Nong Wenhai explained that among the 52 missing persons originally counted, some were visiting relatives in other villages or working outside. After investigation and verification in each township, 14 people had been found.

30436e1e755253f313100b71d7f4497ec85c31f0.sourceText: 据不完全统计，此次洪灾共造成直接经济损失约１３．４亿元。
30436e1e755253f313100b71d7f4497ec85c31f0.translatedText: According to incomplete statistics, the flood caused a total direct economic loss of approximately 1.34 billion yuan.

b326f5b899d342620487de876420413610e071db.translatedText: Kitchen Drama Where is the safety?

b38c65ab4802be1462165c3c475240d15ac5589d.sourceText: 厨房戏谈 何处是安全呢？ 佳叔 俗语有句”三个女人一个圩”，言下的意思是女人讲话多…
b38c65ab4802be1462165c3c475240d15ac5589d.translatedText: Kitchen Talk Where is safety? Uncle Jia There is a saying, "Three women in a fair", which implicitly means that women talk a lot...

e5a04ae0edf44fb700709639c4f774191e3e6ab6.sourceText: 俗语有句”三个女人一个圩”，言下的意思是女人讲话多夹大声（可似方姑娘般）三个女人行埋一个圩（街市），其实三个厨房佬聚埋亦一个圩。
e5a04ae0edf44fb700709639c4f774191e3e6ab6.translatedText: There is a saying, "Three women in a fair," which implicitly means that women talk loudly (like Miss Fang). Three women go to a fair (market), but in fact, three kitchen guys gather in a fair.

fc0f015ab37a9967161b61a08c31123f99149da0.sourceText: 佳叔昨星期在某茶楼饮茶，因为当时距离餐期尚早，几个厨房佬很闲，大家在厨房大声吵噪，声震楼面，我们以为他们在吵架（骂）或讲女人经（厨房佬专题），但细听之下，原来他们在大谈着世界恐怖大亨宾.拉登被击毙事。
fc0f015ab37a9967161b61a08c31123f99149da0.translatedText: Uncle Jia was drinking tea in a teahouse last week. Because it was still early for dinner, a few kitchen guys were free. Everyone was making loud noises in the kitchen, which shook the floor. We thought they were quarreling (cursing) or talking about women (Kitchen Guys special topic), but after listening carefully, it turned out that they were talking about the killing of bin Laden, the world's terrorist tycoon.

4be994bbcbfaa3fa18adf6e360e41af8c51b3c77.sourceText: 厨房甲说：宾拉注销身大户门第，身价数十亿美元，家财万贯，身贵肉重，风华正茂时，本可安逸取女星，玩模特的年纪。但他为着自己信仰，不满美国对外政策，毅然放弃豪华社会，循入阿富汗沙漠深山野岭，训练基地激进份子，专与欧美对抗，魔爪伸延各国，四处恐怖袭击，最不该做的是当年9.11袭击纽约世贸和五角大厦，激发美国出兵，每年动用400多亿美元军费，被中情局悬红2500万缉拿归案。这个被美国称为头号恐怖份子，十年来东藏西躲逃亡，许多情报消息以为他隐藏阿富汗境内深山野洞，不问人间烟火，原来他却躲在巴基斯坦境内豪宅，地广田阔，种植养鸡，过了七年自由自在生活，其豪宅还是与巴基斯坦军校咫尺之隔。最危险的地方才是最安全。
4be994bbcbfaa3fa18adf6e360e41af8c51b3c77.translatedText: Kitchen A said: Binla was born in a wealthy family, worth billions of dollars, rich in wealth, rich in body, and in his prime, at an age when he could have been an actress and model. However, for his own beliefs and dissatisfaction with U.S. foreign policy, he resolutely gave up the luxurious society and went into the deep mountains and wild mountains of the Afghan desert to train radicals in the base. He specialized in confronting Europe and the United States. He extended his claws to various countries and carried out terrorist attacks everywhere. The last thing he should have done was the 9.11 attacks on the World Trade Center and the Pentagon in New York, which inspired the United States to send troops and spend more than 40 billion U.S. dollars in military expenditures every year. The CIA offered a reward of 25 million for his arrest. This man, who is called the number one terrorist by the United States, has been hiding in Tibet for ten years. Many intelligence sources thought that he was hiding in caves in the mountains and wilds of Afghanistan, ignoring the fireworks of the world. It turned out that he was hiding in a mansion in Pakistan, with a vast land, planting chickens and raising chickens. After seven years of living freely, his mansion is still a stone's throw away from the Pakistan Military Academy. The most dangerous place is the safest.

788485ca0aec2b5b79ecc73007877677eb4255bf.sourceText: 可是宾拉凳终被美军在巴基斯坦击毙.消息传回,在纽约时报广场聚集许多人,狂欢庆祝拉登的死亡。
788485ca0aec2b5b79ecc73007877677eb4255bf.translatedText: However, Bin Laden was eventually killed by the US military in Pakistan. When the news came back, many people gathered in Times Square in New York to celebrate bin Laden's death.

f65cca165fd93dee11b4bf28d04e9c8348ee0fb4.sourceText: 厨房乙说：这有什么可庆祝的呢？死了一个拉登，又一个拉注销来，贼死贼翻生，基地还有五千多个激进份子，个个都是视死如归本色英雄，他们比宾. 拉登还恐怖，过了一个时期，他们会卷土重来，到处袭击，世界永无安静日子了。
f65cca165fd93dee11b4bf28d04e9c8348ee0fb4.translatedText: Kitchen B said: What is there to celebrate? One bin Laden died, another bin Laden came, and the dead and thieves came back to life. There are still more than 5,000 radicals in the base, all of them are true heroes who regard death as home. They are more terrifying than Bin Laden. After a period of time, they will come back and attack everywhere, and the world will never have peace.

0961da28563901589e85ac86abb17fa399616cea.sourceText: 厨房丙说：系啦！世界到处打战，爆炸袭击加上近年来频频天灾祸难，有汶川地震，印度尼西亚海啸，台湾台风，南美洪涝，美国密州水灾，肯州龙卷风，今年日本的地震，造成福岛核炉泄漏，辐射四处，走无可走，避无可避。讲起来还是我们凤凰城最安全。这里没有地震，没有海啸，没有水灾，风灾， 龙卷风，又没有恐怖袭击， 正所谓”任从天下乱，本地永无忧”。
0961da28563901589e85ac86abb17fa399616cea.translatedText: Kitchen C said: Yes! The world is at war, and bomb attacks have been coupled with frequent natural disasters in recent years, including the Wenchuan earthquake, the Indonesian tsunami, the Taiwan typhoon, the South American floods, the Mississippi floods in the United States, the Kentucky tornado, and this year's earthquake in Japan, which caused the Fukushima nuclear reactor to leak and spread radiation everywhere. There is no way to go and no way to avoid it. Speaking of which, Phoenix is ​​the safest city. There are no earthquakes, no tsunamis, no floods, wind disasters, tornadoes, and no terrorist attacks. As the saying goes, "If the world is in chaos, the local area will never have to worry."

cb5648b9c316d8dc7408a026a043082cf505620f.sourceText: 厨房甲说：所以我早年就从加州搬来这里
cb5648b9c316d8dc7408a026a043082cf505620f.translatedText: Kitchen A said: That’s why I moved here from California in my early years

d5dcac748fa586d665b07276b40f607f311209e6.sourceText: 厨房乙未等厨房甲说完就加把口说，他素来说话危言耸听，立即指出北韩现在的飞弹射程五千多米，可达美国境内。如果美国对他们SANCTION太甚，赶狗入穷巷时，他们的飞弹分分钟会落我们厨房哩！
d5dcac748fa586d665b07276b40f607f311209e6.translatedText: Kitchen B added something more before Kitchen A finished speaking. He has always been an alarmist and immediately pointed out that North Korea’s current missiles have a range of more than 5,000 meters and can reach the United States. If the United States goes too far with their SANCTION and drives their dogs into the back alleys, their missiles will land in our kitchens in a minute!

29ddc83525e4621dc58966b3032666bfe8385730.sourceText: 这时企台女霞姊听到，花容失色，问佳叔是不是这么势利，我说六十年前我在韩国打战时，几个朝鲜仔用的是打鸟枪，射程不过二百码，二百码外是安全，现在就不得知了。
29ddc83525e4621dc58966b3032666bfe8385730.translatedText: At this time, Sister Xia, a girl from Qitai, lost her beauty when she heard this. She asked Uncle Jia if he was so snobbish. I said that when I was fighting in Korea sixty years ago, some Korean boys used shotguns. The range was only 200 yards. It was safe to go beyond 200 yards. I don’t know now.

0959d7d0b7ec28cccada19134d166d1340b40e08.sourceText: “传统佳节 寄乡情”亚利桑那开平同乡互助会成立（图） 切生日蛋糕庆开平同乡互助会成立 2011年6月5日，在美国凤凰城的凤城酒家宾客满堂，近三百嘉宾参加了亚利桑那开平同乡互助会的成立庆典。这是凤凰城历史上最隆重的老乡庆典聚会活动之一。 会长甄硕钦，荣誉会长关宗任，资深侨领，开平同乡互助会名誉顾问余文劲，顾问邓朝驹等嘉宾一同庆祝了这特别的时刻。加强老乡的联系和团结，共同为当地华人社区做服务是互助会的重要任务。整个成立大会，相当热闹，从下午2时半开始，一直延续到晚上近7时，开平同乡们仍然意犹未尽。侨联副主席张华芳主持了整个成立大会。开平老乡中能人智士非常多，他们纷纷登台献才献艺。合唱，独唱，粤剧，粤曲，古筝独奏，BanJo琴表演，舞蹈表演好戏连台，给现场嘉宾带来了一个难忘的下午。现场除了有精彩的节目，还有让人心动的大奖，最大奖金兔，吸引的很多眼球，最后由凤城酒家的小主人获得。现场还派发出了近百件奖品，最有特色的还是人人都能够获得的，有开平特色的小吃”裹粽”。侨领余文劲用粽子的比喻，精辟地说出了，开平同乡互助会团结一心的伟大意义。 开平是著名的侨乡，以中西特色相结合的碉楼而闻名。凤凰城早期的华人移民大多是来自开平，90年代初开平就与凤凰城美莎市建立了姐妹城市关系，一直保持至今。美莎姐妹市代表也出席了亚利桑那开平同乡互助会成立大会。在端午节来临之际，开平乡亲们以这种特殊的，具有重要意义的老乡聚会来表达思乡之情。
0959d7d0b7ec28cccada19134d166d1340b40e08.translatedText: "Traditional festival, send hometown feelings" Arizona Kaiping Mutual Aid Association was established (picture) Cutting birthday cake to celebrate the establishment of the Kaiping Mutual Aid Association. On June 5, 2011, the Fengcheng Restaurant in Phoenix, USA, was full of guests. Nearly 300 guests attended the establishment celebration of the Kaiping Mutual Aid Association in Arizona. This is one of the most grand hometown celebration gatherings in the history of Phoenix. President Zhen Shuoqin, honorary president Guan Zongren, senior overseas Chinese leaders, Kaiping Mutual Aid Association honorary advisor Yu Wenjin, advisor Deng Chaoju and other guests celebrated this special moment together. Strengthening the connections and unity among fellow villagers and jointly serving the local Chinese community are important tasks of the mutual aid association. The entire founding meeting was quite lively, starting at 2:30 p.m. and lasting until nearly 7 p.m., and the Kaiping fellow citizens were still not satisfied. Zhang Huafang, vice chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, presided over the entire founding meeting. There are many talented people and wise men among the fellow villagers in Kaiping, and they all take the stage to show off their talents. There were chorus, solo, Cantonese opera, Cantonese opera, guzheng solo, BanJo performance, and dance performances, which brought an unforgettable afternoon to the guests. In addition to the exciting programs, there was also an exciting grand prize, the biggest bonus rabbit, which attracted a lot of attention, and was finally won by the young owner of Fengcheng Restaurant. Nearly a hundred prizes were also distributed on site. The most distinctive one was the Kaiping-specific snack “Zong Dumpling” that everyone could win. Overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin used the metaphor of rice dumplings to express the great significance of the unity of the Kaiping Mutual Aid Association. Kaiping is a famous hometown of overseas Chinese and is famous for its watchtowers that combine Chinese and Western characteristics. Most of the early Chinese immigrants in Phoenix came from Kaiping. In the early 1990s, Kaiping established a sister city relationship with Mesa City in Phoenix, which has been maintained to this day. Representatives from the sister cities of Mesa also attended the founding meeting of the Arizona Kaiping Mutual Aid Association. On the occasion of the Dragon Boat Festival, the folks in Kaiping expressed their homesickness with this special and important gathering of fellow villagers.

d7faaeb0810e17679b333a1be7a981979e7a660c.sourceText: 3月房价大跌 专家：年底前再跌5% 在法拍屋充斥、待售房屋众多以及人们缺乏意愿或者没能力购屋等诸多因素下，全美3月份房价大幅下跌，为自从2002年来的低点，凸显房市仍然在困境中挣扎。 史坦普／席勒20都会区房价指数显示，全美大都会区房价指数跌至九年新低，20个都会区中，多达18区3月份房价下跌，而且其中12个地区的房价跌至2006年房市泡沫化以来最低点。经济学家预估，年底前至少还会再下跌5%。 目前共有12个都会区房价跌至将近四年新低，包括纽约、明尼亚波利斯、亚特兰大、芝加哥、底特律、拉斯韦加斯、迈阿密、凤凰城等；其中，明尼亚波利斯市情况 最糟糕，房价下跌3.7%，其次依序是夏洛特和芝加哥2.4%、底特律2%。有些地区不跌反涨，包括西雅图上涨0.1%、华盛顿地区1.1%。华盛顿地区 是过去一年中，房价唯一上升的大都会。 据该调查，全美房价指数已连续第八个月下跌，从房市泡沫以来的房价跌势更甚经济大萧条时期，而在经济大萧条时期过后，房市大约花了19年才真正复元。 去年夏季在政府鼓励购屋的税赋优惠下，房价暂时反弹回升，但从优惠方案退场后又开始跌价。史坦普公司指数委员会主席贝利兹认为，最新报告显示，全美多数地区房价已经「二次衰退」。经通货膨胀因素调整后，房价指数更跌至1999年以来最低纪录。 许多经济学家认为，全美房价年底前至少还会再下跌5%，在待售法拍屋存量减少、雇主开始更大量的召募员工、银行放宽借贷门坎以及潜在房屋买主有信心认为购屋是明智的投资之前，房价不太可能停止下跌。 富国银行(Wells Fargo)资深经济学家威奈尔说，人们取得房贷困难重重，也许明年初房价才会落底。 根据该报告，凤凰城进入美国今年第一季度独力房价格跌到新低的10个城市排名中，以下是这10个城市的排名： ★明尼苏达州的明尼阿波利斯（Minneapolis）跌幅为10%； ★亚利桑那州的凤凰城（Phoenix）下跌8.4%； ★伊利诺伊州的芝加哥（Chicago）下跌7.6%； ★俄勒冈州的波特兰（Portland）下跌7.6%； ★佛州的坦帕（Tampa）下跌6.9%； ★北卡罗来纳州的夏洛特（Charlotte）下跌6.8%； ★俄亥俄州的克利夫兰（Cleveland）下跌6.3%； ★佛州的迈阿密下跌6.1%； ★内华达州的拉斯维加斯下跌5.3%； ★乔治亚州的亚特兰大（Atlanta）下跌5.2 %。
d7faaeb0810e17679b333a1be7a981979e7a660c.translatedText: House prices dropped sharply in March. Experts: another 5% drop before the end of the year. Due to many factors such as a flood of foreclosures, a large number of homes for sale and people's lack of willingness or ability to buy a home, home prices across the United States fell sharply in March, reaching the lowest level since 2002, highlighting that the housing market is still struggling. The S&P/Shiller 20 metropolitan area housing price index shows that the home price index in metropolitan areas across the United States fell to a nine-year low. Among the 20 metropolitan areas, as many as 18 areas fell in March, and in 12 of them, housing prices fell to the lowest since the housing market bubble in 2006. Economists predict it will fall by at least another 5% before the end of the year. Currently, housing prices in 12 metropolitan areas have fallen to a new low in nearly four years, including New York, Minneapolis, Atlanta, Chicago, Detroit, Las Vegas, Miami, Phoenix, etc. Among them, Minneapolis has the worst situation, with housing prices falling by 3.7%, followed by Charlotte and Chicago by 2.4%, and Detroit by 2%. Some areas rose instead of falling, including Seattle, which rose 0.1%, and the Washington area, which rose 1.1%. The Washington area was the only metropolitan area to see home prices increase over the past year. According to the survey, the national housing price index has fallen for the eighth consecutive month. The decline in housing prices since the housing bubble has been even worse than during the Great Depression. After the Great Depression, it took about 19 years for the housing market to truly recover. Last summer, housing prices temporarily rebounded under the government's tax incentives to encourage home purchases, but prices began to fall again after the incentives were withdrawn. Belize, chairman of the S&P Index Committee, believes that the latest report shows that housing prices in most areas of the United States have already entered a "second recession." After adjusting for inflation, the house price index fell to its lowest level since 1999. Many economists believe that U.S. home prices will fall at least another 5% before the end of the year. The decline in home prices is unlikely to stop until the inventory of foreclosed homes for sale decreases, employers begin to recruit employees in greater numbers, banks relax their lending thresholds, and potential home buyers gain confidence that buying a home is a wise investment. Wynell, a senior economist at Wells Fargo, said people are having difficulty getting mortgages and housing prices may not bottom out until early next year. According to the report, Phoenix entered the ranking of the 10 cities in the United States where single-family home prices fell to new lows in the first quarter of this year. The following is the ranking of these 10 cities: ★Minneapolis, Minnesota, fell by 10%; ★Phoenix, Arizona, fell by 8.4%; ★Chicago, Illinois, fell by 7.6%; ★Portland, Oregon, fell by 7.6%; ★Tampa, Florida fell 6.9%; ★Charlotte, North Carolina fell 6.8%; ★Cleveland, Ohio fell 6.3%; ★Miami, Florida fell 6.1%; ★Las Vegas, Nevada fell 5.3%; ★Atlanta, Georgia fell 5.2%.

8a6298e51094af73d6f05da1944b43009d88325d.sourceText: 治粤八年南天王——传奇人物陈济棠 余玉书 （四）倡经教育惹风浪（上） 陈济棠和一般地区性的军事领袖的不同之处，除了靠军事力量来维持安定之外，还要主导军民的思想。因为他知道单靠武力是不行的，军人的思想如不加以善导鼓励，将如童子操刀，是一件很危险的事情。中共军队以俄为师，崇拜马列主义，豪情澎湃，不怕牺牲，可是此路不通。西北军的冯玉祥有基督将军之称，不知其对圣经有多深，不过曾经下令一天之内整师官兵接受洗礼昄依基督教。其实一般农村出身的士兵，可能连耶稣是谁都弄不清楚，就接受了洗礼，似乎太儿戏了点。 陈在十九岁时由邓铿介绍加入了孙中山的”同盟会”，当然是三民主义的信徙，可是他自己心中所想的，与其说是孙中山的”统”（统一中国），不如说是较接近当时他的顶头上司陈炯明的”独”（独立广东），那就是联省自治，独善其身，管他内地争夺地盘，一穷二白，先搅好广东的经济与教育再说。对于北伐中原兴趣不大，因此自然也不会叫做用三民主义去统一中国的口号。 陈济棠当上了广东省绥靖主任后，不但拥兵十五万之众，而且麾下谋臣如雨，猛将如云；文官有林翼中、黄麟书、沈演公、张绍芹及其兄陈维周，武将则有李敬扬、李汉魂、余汉谋、香翰屏等，其中以林翼中为文胆，以李敬扬为武胆，至于他在文治思想方法所用的方法与所走的路线又与别人不同。 陈炯明政变失败下野后，陈济棠改投李济深，北伐时李任第四军军长，陈则在其麾下任第十一师师长。友军第十师师长陈铭枢表面上拥蒋，但骨子里早已与左派眉来眼去，后来在福州起义成立中国第一个”人民政府”，不但拖了李济深落水，甚至连在淞沪战役抗日名震中外的十九路军事后也被蒋介石下令解散，部份则由陈济棠接收，改编为独立第三旅。 其实陈铭枢在采取军事行动之前，早已在文化思想方面下了功夫；一九三〇年陈铭枢担任广东省主席时，即以四十万巨款收购了以左翼作家为主的”神州国光社”，重用左派文人王礼锡，大量翻译共产主义书籍，及出版左翼作家作品，甚至后来在福州起义的檄文，都是由王礼锡及后来弃”暗”投”明”的胡秋原所执笔。陈济棠本人出身乡塾，对固有文化颇有涉猎，而他的文胆智囊亦多老师宿儒辈，认为共党理论之盛行，乃由新文化运动之冲击，由于孔家店被打倒，西方异端邪说乘虚而入所致，所以提倡复兴固有文化，当务之急，便由读经开始。
8a6298e51094af73d6f05da1944b43009d88325d.translatedText: The Southern Heavenly King who ruled Guangdong for eight years - the legendary Chen Jitang and Yu Yushu (4) Promoting economic education caused turmoil (Part 1) The difference between Chen Jitang and other regional military leaders was that in addition to relying on military power to maintain stability, he also had to dominate the thinking of the military and civilians. Because he knows that force alone is not enough. Without good guidance and encouragement, a soldier's mind will be like a child's sword, which is a very dangerous thing. The CCP army takes Russia as its division, worships Marxism-Leninism, is full of pride, and is not afraid of sacrifice, but this road is blocked. Feng Yuxiang of the Northwest Army is known as the Christian General. I don't know how deep he is about the Bible, but he once ordered the entire division of officers and soldiers to be baptized and converted to Christianity within one day. In fact, ordinary soldiers from rural areas may not even know who Jesus is, so they received baptism, which seems a bit ridiculous. When Chen was 19, he was introduced to Sun Yat-sen's "Tongmenghui" by Deng Keng. Of course, he was a believer in the Three People's Principles. However, what he had in mind was not so much Sun Yat-sen's "unification" (unification of China) as it was closer to the "independence" (independent Guangdong) of his immediate boss Chen Jiongming at the time. There is not much interest in the Northern Expedition to the Central Plains, so naturally it will not be called the slogan of using the Three People's Principles to unify China. After Chen Jitang became the director of appeasement in Guangdong Province, he not only had an army of 150,000, but also had a rain of advisers and fierce generals under his command; the civil servants included Lin Yizhong, Huang Linshu, Shen Yangong, Zhang Shaoqin and his brother Chen Weizhou, Wu The generals included Li Jingyang, Li Hanhun, Yu Hanmou, Xiang Hanping, etc. Among them, Lin Yizhong was the literary bolder, and Li Jingyang was the martial arts bolder. As for the methods he used and the routes he took in literary and political thought, he was different from others. After Chen Jiongming failed in the coup and resigned, Chen Jitang switched to Li Jishen. During the Northern Expedition, Li served as commander of the Fourth Army, and Chen Ze served as commander of the 11th Division under him. Chen Mingshu, the commander of the 10th Allied Division, supported Chiang on the surface, but in his heart he had already had an affair with the leftists. Later, he established China's first "People's Government" during the Fuzhou Uprising. This not only dragged Li Jishen into trouble, but even the 19th Route Army, which was famous both at home and abroad for its anti-Japanese campaign in the Songhu Battle, was ordered to be disbanded by Chiang Kai-shek. Some of them were taken over by Chen Jitang and reorganized into the Third Independent Brigade. In fact, before Chen Mingshu took military action, he had already made great efforts in cultural and ideological aspects. When Chen Mingshu was the chairman of Guangdong Province in 1930, he spent a huge sum of 400,000 to acquire the "Shenzhou Guoguang Society", which was mainly composed of left-wing writers. He reused the left-wing scholar Wang Lixi, translated a large number of communist books, and published the works of left-wing writers. Even the later slogans for the Fuzhou Uprising were all written by Wang Lixi and Hu Qiuyuan, who later abandoned "secret" and turned to "ming". Chen Jitang himself was born in a rural school and was quite involved in traditional culture. Many of his intellectual and intellectual teachers were Confucian scholars. He believed that the popularity of Communist Party theory was due to the impact of the New Culture Movement, the overthrow of the Confucian family and the intrusion of Western heresies. Therefore, when advocating the revival of traditional culture, the most urgent task was to start with reading the Bible.

c953d5ed3e2f03e89da12ebcc7a30b0019ce5188.sourceText: 本次的候选佳丽共计7名，她们有凤凰城土生土长的ABC，也有新移民和留学生，她们代表了新一代华裔的面貌。 请在网站上选择你喜欢的候选佳丽，点击照片下的”投票支持”，为候选人投票。网络投票截止时间为7月2日11:59pm，届时得票最多者将获得本次比赛的网络最受欢迎奖。网络投票结果将占最后比赛结果的20%。 24小时内系统只允许同一个IP投一次票，24小时之后IP解锁，再可以投票，直到投票截止时间。投票IP不限于Arizona地区，世界各地均可投票。组委会将在比赛现场，从选中本届比赛冠军的投票者中，随机抽取三名幸运投票者进行奖励，最高奖项为柯达数码相机。

The deadline for online voting is 11:59pm on July 2, and the person with the most votes will win the most popular online award in this competition. After 24 hours, the IP will be unlocked and you can vote again until the voting deadline. Voting IP is not limited to Arizona, and can be voted from all over the world. The organizing committee will randomly select three lucky voters at the competition site to reward them. The highest award will be a Kodak digital camera.

25d24a3f5101d0b79968ef8264c4d82ef130080b.sourceText: 世界“五一”劳动节的由来 1886年5月1日，美国工人发动争取工作八小时的制度，获得胜利。后来世界各国都以5月1日为《劳动纪念日》。又叫《5.1节》。 《5.1劳动节》之前，美国工人，工作超时，薪金低，受到不平等待遇，饱受痛苦和虐待！ 美国在立国初期建筑火车铁路，引进大量外国移民工人，其中很多是华工，进入美国工作。当时，他们只靠落后工具，[开山劈地]，食宿山头，饱受冷热煎熬！不知多少工人客死异乡！ 句[可怜荒野 忠，铁路功成万骨枯]！回忆往事，铁路工人对国家的贡献，流尽血汗！付出生命！使人感恩无限，更令人肃然起敬。 美国是一个移民多元化的国家，长期开放，吸取外国移民,,, 进入美国，他们在长期努力下，才创造今日繁荣富强的美国。工人对国家的贡献 。 但是，今日美国的工人，仍然未受到重视，尤其是对有色人种，少数民族，受到歧视，工作困难，薪金少，生活不安定，终日过着惶恐的生活！ 今日的美国，是世界有名的,, 的国家之一，必须要重视对国家有伟大贡献的工人，增加就业，改善待遇，维持合理权益，让他们能过着 的生活。
25d24a3f5101d0b79968ef8264c4d82ef130080b.translatedText: The origin of the world's "May Day" Labor Day. On May 1, 1886, American workers launched a fight for the eight-hour working system and won. Later, all countries in the world regarded May 1 as "Labor Day". Also called "Section 5.1". Before "May 1 Labor Day", American workers worked overtime, received low wages, received unequal treatment, and suffered pain and abuse! In the early days of its founding, the United States built trains and railways and introduced a large number of foreign immigrant workers, many of whom were Chinese, to work in the United States. At that time, they only relied on backward tools to [crack the mountains and split the ground], eat and sleep on the mountains, and suffered from cold and heat! I don’t know how many workers died in a foreign land! Sentence [Pity the wilderness and loyalty, the railway has made thousands of bones withered]! Looking back on the past, railway workers’ contribution to the country was made with all their blood and sweat! Give your life! It makes people grateful and even more awe-inspiring. The United States is a country with diverse immigrants. It has been open for a long time and attracted foreign immigrants to enter the United States. Through their long-term efforts, they have created the prosperous and powerful United States today. Workers’ contribution to the country. However, workers in the United States today are still not taken seriously, especially people of color and ethnic minorities. They are discriminated against, have difficulty working, have low wages, live an unstable life, and live in fear all day long! Today's United States is one of the most famous countries in the world. It must pay attention to workers who have made great contributions to the country, increase employment, improve treatment, maintain reasonable rights and interests, and allow them to live a better life.
