1d469ff28aeb308b99f9a605e3bc539a6482cbe1.sourceText: 香港特区政府财经事务及库务局局长陈家强29日表示，全球金融危机之后，中国和亚洲新兴市场快速发展，全球经济的重心正从西方转移到亚太地区，国际经济秩序正在发生转变，人民币国际化有助国家在全球增强影响力和话语权。
1d469ff28aeb308b99f9a605e3bc539a6482cbe1.translatedText: Chan Ka-keung, Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury of the Hong Kong SAR Government, said on the 29th that after the global financial crisis, China and emerging markets in Asia have developed rapidly, and the center of gravity of the global economy is shifting from the West to the Asia-Pacific region. The international economic order is changing, and the internationalization of the RMB will help the country enhance its influence and voice around the world.

72eff9a515f253ef4233985d5e03a8b725b5ccea.sourceText: 陈家强当天发表题为《亚洲联合”路演”见港沪互补合拍》的网文，回顾从本月23日至26日他与上海市金融服务办公室主任方星海带领访问团，赴印尼和马来西亚举行人民币国际化联合路演时座无虚席的景象。
72eff9a515f253ef4233985d5e03a8b725b5ccea.translatedText: Chen Jiaqiang published an online article on the same day titled "Asian Joint "Roadshow" Sees Hong Kong and Shanghai Complementary Co-production", recalling the scene of full houses when he and Fang Xinghai, director of the Shanghai Municipal Financial Services Office, led a delegation to Indonesia and Malaysia to hold a joint roadshow on RMB internationalization from the 23rd to the 26th of this month.

54dd5bdef7ab666f0699a349d0bfc422f8501806.sourceText: 陈家强说，从经济角度看，使用人民币结算可以降低因使用其他币值结算所带来的资金成本、汇率波动所引起的风险，以及结汇过程涉及的高成本。长远来说，以人民币结算也可进一步拓展中国与其他国家的双边贸易。
54dd5bdef7ab666f0699a349d0bfc422f8501806.translatedText: Chen Jiaqiang said that from an economic point of view, using RMB for settlement can reduce the capital costs caused by using other currencies for settlement, risks caused by exchange rate fluctuations, and the high costs involved in the foreign exchange settlement process. In the long run, settlement in RMB can also further expand bilateral trade between China and other countries.

08d2a08552df866c8a40cc3fb8173588e523a6a5.sourceText: 陈家强认为，在东盟国家中，印尼和马来西亚与中国的双边贸易频繁，发展人民币结算市场的潜力很大。当然，要从采用其他外币计价改为使用人民币结算，过程并不简单，市场也需要一段调整的适应期，包括要逐步改变贸易双方绝大部分以 美元 进行支付和结算的商贸习惯。
08d2a08552df866c8a40cc3fb8173588e523a6a5.translatedText: Chen Jiaqiang believes that among ASEAN countries, Indonesia and Malaysia have frequent bilateral trade with China and have great potential to develop the RMB settlement market. Of course, the process of changing from using other foreign currencies for pricing to using RMB for settlement is not simple. The market also needs a period of adjustment and adaptation, including gradually changing the business habits of most trading parties for payment and settlement in US dollars.

5f0d4f2e8789bfe6162f5181330ac286b312644e.sourceText: 陈家强说，希望随着人民币贸易的扩大和香港人民币结算机制的日渐成熟，香港能为东南亚的贸易公司及投资者提供更好的服务。
5f0d4f2e8789bfe6162f5181330ac286b312644e.translatedText: Chan Ka-keung said he hopes that with the expansion of RMB trade and the maturation of Hong Kong's RMB settlement mechanism, Hong Kong can provide better services to trading companies and investors in Southeast Asia.

3c8e862708ecb915f5362d11094b5e8d488474e1.sourceText: 奥巴马更动移民法 外国留学生留美机会增加 近日奥巴马政府修改移民法规，使得更多以签证来美学习的外国学生得以在毕业后继续留美，并在他们的专业区域得到实习的机会。 奥巴马政府增加科学、科技、工程及数学学位的列表，允许获得这些学位的外国学生毕业后可以在美国停留 17 个月。在等待 H-1B 签证的期间他们可以做实习生或去工作。 H-1B 是给高技术的劳工的签证，可以让他们留在美国 6 年。 奥巴马在访问德州，于 El Paso 发表有关移民法规的演说后公布这项变更的。移民及海关官员认为奥巴马增加学位列表有助于修整破损的移民系统。 赞成移民者和拉丁裔的议员们曾经要求奥巴马调整移民法规，停止将违法入境的年青人和没有严重犯罪，对公众不造成危害的人遣送回国。 去年，奥巴马政府遣回大约 393,000 位移民，同时国会还没有开始改革移民法，给约 1 千 1 百万非法移民中的一些人提供合法的身份。奥巴马说他无法选择两项法规之一加以强制执行，但是赞成移民者反驳说，法律中有足够的空间可以让他帮助移民。 数年以来，高科技公司一直在要求改进外国学生毕业后的职业训练项目，以便将有才华的外国学生留在美国。美国前总统布什于 2008 年四月将训练的时间由 12 个月延长到 17 个月，商业和教育机构也跟着要求延长学位列表。 工业界人士说，美国大约有 50 ％的电子工程硕士和 65 ％的电子工程博士是外国学生。新的移民法规不适用于非法进入美国的外国学生。
3c8e862708ecb915f5362d11094b5e8d488474e1.translatedText: Obama changes the immigration law, increasing the opportunities for foreign students to study in the United States. Recently, the Obama administration has revised immigration regulations, allowing more foreign students who come to the United States to study with visas to stay in the United States after graduation and get internship opportunities in their professional areas. The Obama administration expanded the list of science, technology, engineering and mathematics degrees that would allow foreign students with those degrees to stay in the United States for 17 months after graduation. They can work as interns or go to work while waiting for their H-1B visas. H-1B is a visa for highly skilled workers that allows them to stay in the United States for 6 years. Obama announced the changes after a visit to Texas to deliver a speech on immigration regulations in El Paso. Immigration and Customs officials believe Obama's addition to the degree list will help fix a broken immigration system. Pro-immigration and Latino lawmakers have asked Obama to adjust immigration laws and stop deporting young people who entered the country illegally and those who have committed no serious crimes and pose no danger to the public. The Obama administration deported about 393,000 immigrants last year, even before Congress began reforming immigration laws to give legal status to some of the roughly 11 million illegal immigrants. Obama said he couldn't choose one of the two regulations to enforce, but pro-immigration advocates countered that there was enough room in the law for him to help immigrants. For several years, high-tech companies have been demanding improvements in job training programs for foreign students after graduation to keep talented foreign students in the United States. Former US President Bush extended the training period from 12 months to 17 months in April 2008, and business and educational institutions followed suit by requesting an extension of the degree list. Industry sources say that about 50% of electrical engineering master's degrees and 65% of electrical engineering Ph.D.s in the United States are foreign students. The new immigration rules do not apply to foreign students who enter the United States illegally.

ee91671c25e0463ac2d1bf2149766050c05ee95b.sourceText: 美国经济成长过分乐观 美股涨势 可能反转 市场愈来愈担心，美股股价走高是因为对经济成长过分乐观。近来商品价格大跌，暗示美股涨势可能在未来数月反转。(美联社) slideshow 市场愈来愈担心，美股股价走高是因为对经济成长过分乐观。多位策略分析师认为，油价及金属价格回调是出脱高风险资产的讯号，建议投资人避开首次公开上市（IPO）的中国网络股，并抱牢波动较小的股票，例如公用事业股。 近日商品价格大跌，股市投资人转向医疗照护等防御型类股，暗示美股涨势可能在未来数月反转。此外，追踪基金业者的新兴组合基金研究全球公司（EPFR）说，上周全球股票基金出现资金净流出，是3月中以来首见。 高盛集团（Goldman Sachs）及瑞士信贷（Credit Suisse）策略师预料，与经济周期关联性较低的个股，未来表现会比较强。瑞信首席美股策略师克里格特说：「乐观大胆看待经济成长的选股策略已成过去。」 目前为止，市场对金、银、石油等商品价格最近重挫有两种看法：一是联邦准备理事会（Fed）的6000亿元收购公债计划，使投资人的资金先前流向商品和股票，创造出资产泡沫，现在要开始破灭；另一种看法是经济即将走弱。被视为经济指标的铜价已跌至五个月低点。 市场对投机性投资的兴趣降低，也可从防御性类股上涨的态势中看出来，后者与经济好坏较无关联。史坦普500指数的医疗照护及公用事业类股上月涨幅领先，分别走高2.9%和2.6%。 通常在股市走强时领涨的小型股和中型股，近来涨幅与大型股的差距缩小。许多动能指针显示，史坦普500指数上涨力道开始减弱。 另有一些迹象透露，IPO市场也出现疲态。中国婚恋网站世纪佳缘网（Jiayuan.com）那斯达克上市当天，股价就走跌。人人网号称中国的Facebook，股价也已跌破承销价。 高盛说，股价上涨已超过经济基本面因素，对股市近期表现的信心大为降低，正出脱美国的银行股，并买进与基本民生用品有关的工业股。瑞士信贷建议出脱金融股，买进医疗保健股，同时做多基本民生用品，放空非必需性消费产业。（世界新闻网）
ee91671c25e0463ac2d1bf2149766050c05ee95b.translatedText: U.S. economic growth is overly optimistic, and the U.S. stock market rally may reverse. The market is increasingly worried that U.S. stock prices are rising because of overoptimism about economic growth. Commodity prices have fallen sharply recently, suggesting that the rally in U.S. stocks may reverse in the coming months. (Associated Press) slideshow The market is increasingly worried that U.S. stock prices are rising because of excessive optimism about economic growth. Many strategists believe that the correction in oil and metal prices is a signal to sell high-risk assets, and recommend that investors avoid initial public listings (IPOs) of Chinese Internet stocks and hold on to less volatile stocks, such as utility stocks. Commodity prices have plummeted in recent days, and stock market investors have turned to defensive stocks such as medical care, suggesting that the rise in U.S. stocks may reverse in the coming months. In addition, Emerging Fund Research Global (EPFR), which tracks fund players, said global equity funds experienced net outflows last week, the first time since mid-March. Strategists at Goldman Sachs and Credit Suisse expect that stocks with lower correlation with the economic cycle will perform better in the future. Credit Suisse's chief U.S. stock strategist, Kriegert, said: "The stock-picking strategy of being optimistic and bold about economic growth is a thing of the past." So far, the market has two views on the recent plunge in gold, silver, oil and other commodity prices: One is that the Federal Reserve's (Fed) 600 billion yuan purchase of government bonds plan caused investors' funds to flow into commodities and stocks, creating an asset bubble that is now beginning to burst; the other is that the economy is about to weaken. Copper prices, considered an economic indicator, have fallen to a five-month low. The market's reduced interest in speculative investing can also be seen in the rise in defensive stocks, which have less to do with the performance of the economy. Healthcare and utilities stocks in the S&P 500 led the gains last month, rising 2.9% and 2.6% respectively. Small-cap and mid-cap stocks, which typically lead gains when stocks are strong, have recently narrowed their gains compared to large-cap stocks. Many momentum indicators show that the S&P 500's gains are beginning to weaken. There are also some signs that the IPO market is also showing weakness. The share price of Chinese dating website Jiayuan.com fell on the day it went public on Nasdaq. Renren is known as the Facebook of China, and its stock price has also fallen below the underwriting price. Goldman Sachs said that the rise in stock prices has exceeded economic fundamentals, and its confidence in the recent performance of the stock market has been greatly reduced. It is selling U.S. bank stocks and buying industrial stocks related to basic livelihood necessities. Credit Suisse recommends selling financial stocks and buying health care stocks, while going long on basic necessities and shorting discretionary consumer industries. (World News Network)

Georgetown University in Washington released a research report on the 23rd and pointed out that the major subjects of college students are related to their future income...

5303fb971128c7499ecf05fb57244e7f8106a185.sourceText: 大学主修数学、计算机薪水高 华盛顿的乔治敦大学23日公布研究报告指出，大学生的主修科目与其未来的收入有关切关系，经济价值最高科目的薪水比经济价值最低科目的薪水多三倍，石油工程、数学、计算机等科目经济价值较高，咨商心理学、幼儿教育经济价值较低。 此外，不同族裔和性别的大学生，主修科目和未来的收入也非常不同，主修计算机和数学的学生，亚裔最多，占16%。大多数主修领域中的白人男性拥有较高的中间收入；亚裔的中间收入较低，在法律和公共政策领域的年薪为5万5000元，在心理学和社会​​工作领域的年薪为4万8000元，在生物学和生命科学领域的年薪为5万3000元。 这项由乔治敦大学教育与劳动力中心进行的研究称为「大学主修科目的经济价值」，该研究分析了首次询问大学主修科目的2009年人口普查数据「美国小区调查」。研究发现，大学毕业生整体来说，终生收入比高中毕业生多84%，大学171个主修科目的修读学生，未来的中间收入也大不相同。 主修石油工程者的年薪是12万元，而主修咨商心理学者的年薪是2万9000元；主修数学和计算机者的年薪是9万8000元而主修幼儿教育者的年薪是3万6000元。研究也发现，在收入最高的主修科系中，白人男生最多；女生则集中于收入最低的主修科系，如教育、艺术和社会工作。 这个研究把171个主修科目分为15个领域，结果发现，主修法律和公共政策的学生中，有43%从事公共行政工作，主修社会科学者中只有13%从事公职，却有更多人从事金融工作。 大学中最受欢迎的主修科目是商业，主修商业者在全部大学生中占25%；在农业和自然资源领域中白人最多(占90%)，在计算机和数学领域中亚裔占16% ，在法律和公共政策领域中，非洲裔占14%，西语裔占10%。在地质与地球物理工程、军事科技、药剂和学校学生辅导领域攻读的学生，几乎都能找到工作；而失业率最高的领域(从16%到11%)是社会心理学、核子工程、教育行政与监督。
5303fb971128c7499ecf05fb57244e7f8106a185.translatedText: Those who major in mathematics and computers in college have higher salaries. A research report released by Georgetown University in Washington on the 23rd pointed out that the major subjects of college students are closely related to their future income. The salary of the subjects with the highest economic value is three times higher than the salary of the subjects with the lowest economic value. Petroleum engineering, mathematics, computer and other subjects have higher economic value, while counseling psychology and early childhood education have lower economic value. In addition, the major subjects and future income of college students of different ethnicities and genders are also very different. Among students majoring in computer and mathematics, Asians account for the most, accounting for 16%. White men in most major fields had higher median earnings; Asians had lower median earnings, with salaries in law and public policy at $55,000, psychology and social work at $48,000, and biology and life sciences at $53,000. The study, "The Economic Value of a College Major," conducted by Georgetown University's Center on Education and the Workforce, analyzed data from the 2009 American Community Survey, which was the first to ask about college majors. The study found that college graduates as a whole have 84% more lifetime income than high school graduates, and that the future median income of students who major in 171 college subjects is also very different. Those majoring in petroleum engineering earn $120,000, while those majoring in counseling psychology earn $29,000. Those majoring in mathematics and computer science earn $98,000, while those majoring in early childhood education earn $36,000. The study also found that the majority of white boys are in majors with the highest income, while female students are concentrated in majors with the lowest income, such as education, art and social work. This study divided 171 major subjects into 15 fields and found that 43% of students majoring in law and public policy were engaged in public administration, while only 13% of those majoring in social sciences were engaged in public service, but more were engaged in finance. The most popular major in college is business, with 25% of all college students majoring in business; the majority of whites are white (90%) in the field of agriculture and natural resources, 16% are Asian in the field of computer and mathematics, and 14% are African-American and 10% are Hispanic in the field of law and public policy. Students studying in the fields of geological and geophysical engineering, military science and technology, pharmacy and school student guidance can almost always find a job; the fields with the highest unemployment rates (from 16% to 11%) are social psychology, nuclear engineering, and educational administration and supervision.

9c19b7b94dbc7b60b44ae102ae3a57e3634ff77f.sourceText: 移民问答:2011年5月绿卡抽签结果作废;配偶去世 退休金相关事宜 1 我是台湾人,收到国务院的通知说我抽到绿卡,但又说公布的绿卡抽签结果不算?为什么呢? 我需要重新提出一份新的绿卡抽签申请吗? 来自国务院的消息指出﹐由于计算机系统的故障﹐从2011 年5月起在国务院公布的绿卡抽签结果宣布作废。国务院正在处理重新抽签的相关措施﹐预计在2011年7月15日前后﹐才能发布正确的绿卡抽签名单。国务院表示﹐由于计算机系统的出现问题﹐绿卡抽签的程序并没有按照随机取样来执行﹐不符合移民法的要求﹐2011 年5月起在国务院网站公布的绿卡抽签结果宣布作废。也就是说﹐即使你在5月的第一个星期起在国务院网站查询你的绿卡抽签发现你被抽中了﹐抽中结果也不算。如果你在 October 5, 2010 至 November 3, 2010 在国务院网站提出绿卡抽签的申请﹐你的申请仍然有效﹐但是要经由国务院重新抽签后才能算数。国务院正在处理重新抽签的相关措施﹐预计在2011年7月15日前后﹐才能发布正确的绿卡抽签名单。 国务院并没有发现计算机系统被攻击的情况﹐这只是计算机系统发生故障所导致的随机抽样不公情况发生你之前输入的个人资料应该是安全的。 2. 我于2005年以探亲签证来美国，2006年6月嫁给美国公民的丈夫。但丈夫因病于2010年2月去世，此后我全靠领取他的退休金维持生活。我现已69岁，绿卡身分，即将考公民入籍。我可以再婚吗？再婚后是否会影响领取去世丈夫退休金的资格？如果对方是大陆人，我可以申请他移民美国吗？需要等多久？来后可以替他申请社会安全生活补助金 (SSI)吗？ 答： 对于社安福利或养老金的法律, 我建议你找社安人员或这方面的专家查询,就此我只能提供你一般概念，如果你从私人公司的退休金(pension)账户领取未亡人福利，如果再婚，你可能会失去它，因为很多私人退休金计划对这种情况没有给予保护，而且很少公司这么做。另一方面，向社安局领取的未亡人福利可能会受到保障，就如社安局的文章「社安在线：寡妇、鳏夫和其他未亡人的资格和申请」可以参照社安局的网站（www.ssa.gov/survivorplan）。如果你于60岁后再婚（残废人则为50岁），你仍然可以从你前配偶的账户领取福利。如果你嫁给一位大陆人，你可以申请他移民来美。通常美国公民担保的案件需要大约一年的时间，绿卡持有人则要三-四年左右。移民美国后五年内是不允许申请社会安全生活补助金 (SSI)的。即使在那之后，他所领取的社会安全生活补助金 (SSI)的金额，政府都有资格从你的收入及填写过经济担保书（I-864）答应经济担保的副担保人的收入中扣回。亲属案件的经济担保责任一直会持续有效，直到被担保人成为美国公民、或工作40个季度（10年）、永久离开美国或去世。
9c19b7b94dbc7b60b44ae102ae3a57e3634ff77f.translatedText: Immigration Q&A: The result of the green card lottery in May 2011 is invalid; the spouse dies, pension-related matters 1 I am a Taiwanese. I received a notice from the State Council saying that I was awarded a green card, but it also said that the announced green card lottery results did not count? Why? Do I need to submit a new green card lottery application? News from the State Council pointed out that due to a computer system failure, the green card lottery results announced by the State Council since May 2011 were declared invalid. The State Council is processing relevant measures for the re-lottery, and it is expected that the correct green card lottery will be released around July 15, 2011. The State Council stated that due to problems with the computer system, the green card lottery process was not carried out according to random sampling and did not comply with the requirements of the immigration law. The green card lottery results published on the State Council website since May 2011 were declared invalid. In other words, even if you check your green card lottery on the State Council website from the first week of May and find that you were selected, the result of the lottery will not be counted. If you applied for the green card lottery on the State Council website from October 5, 2010 to November 3, 2010, your application is still valid, but it will not be counted until it is re-drawn by the State Council. The State Council is processing relevant measures for the re-lottery, and it is expected that the correct green card lottery will be released around July 15, 2011. The State Department has not discovered that the computer system has been attacked. This is just an unfair random sampling caused by a computer system failure. The personal information you entered before should be safe. 2. I came to the United States on a family visit visa in 2005 and married my husband, a U.S. citizen, in June 2006. However, my husband passed away due to illness in February 2010. Since then, I have relied solely on receiving his pension to support my life. I am 69 years old, have a green card, and am about to take the naturalization test. Can I remarry? Will remarriage affect my eligibility for my deceased husband’s pension? If the other person is from Mainland China, can I apply for him to immigrate to the United States? How long do I need to wait? Can I apply for Social Security Income (SSI) on his behalf after arriving? Answer: As for the laws on Social Security benefits or pensions, I suggest you check with Social Security personnel or experts in this field. I can only give you a general idea. If you receive survivor benefits from a private company's pension account, you may lose it if you remarry, because many private pension plans do not provide protection for this situation, and few companies do this. On the other hand, survivor benefits received from the Social Security Administration may be protected. For example, the Social Security Administration's article "Social Security Online: Eligibility and Application for Widows, Widowers, and Other Survivors" can be found on the Social Security Administration's website (www.ssa.gov/survivorplan). If you remarry after age 60 (50 if disabled), you can still receive benefits from your ex-spouse's account. If you marry a mainlander, you can apply for him to immigrate to the United States. Usually, a case sponsored by a U.S. citizen takes about one year, and a green card holder takes about three to four years. You are not allowed to apply for Social Security Income (SSI) within five years of immigrating to the United States. Even after that, the government is eligible to deduct the amount of Social Security Income (SSI) he receives from your income and the income of the sub-sponsor who filled out the financial support form (I-864) and promised financial support. The financial sponsorship obligation in a relative case will remain in effect until the sponsored person becomes a U.S. citizen, has worked for 40 quarters (10 years), permanently leaves the United States, or dies.

92e10723a14e1d6b384916e811b90f8c2b33acaa.sourceText: 富豪人瑞修葛特辞世 晚年孑然一身 年仅19岁时，她每月零用钱换算当今币值约120万美元，21岁则继承了庞大财产。谜样般的美国富豪人瑞修葛特克拉克晚年却独自在医院渡过，她在今晨辞世，享年104岁。 修葛特克拉克（Huguette Clark）的律师今天发表简短声明，证实她的死讯，但未透露她的死亡原因，仅表示修葛特克拉克是依照自己的意愿走完人生的最后一程，”在维持着尊严并且保有个人隐私的情况下，离开人世”。再过2周，原本她就要在6月9日届满105岁。 2010年2月，微软国家广播公司（MSNBC）网站推出修葛特．克拉克特别报导专辑，引起全美各界高度回响，也让许多读者对于80多年不曾公开露面的这位谜样人物特别感到好奇。 根据MSNBC报导，修葛特克拉克虽然住在聘有全职护士专门照料的医院，过着低调且与世隔绝的日子，但她闲置在全美各地的豪宅，累计价值却相当惊人，包括加州圣巴巴拉海边一栋价值约一亿美元的别墅，康乃狄克州新肯南价值约2300万美元的一栋农庄，以及纽约第五大道上拥有42个房间、价值一亿美元的超大公寓。这些豪宅都派有专人管理、维护，纽约的豪华公寓还放有昂贵的名画与家具。但是，身为这些豪宅屋主的修葛特克拉克，为了躲避外界注意，多年来以假名登记，住在纽约市某家医院的隔离病房当中。连她的律师要找她，20年来都只能隔着门和她对谈。 修葛特克拉克的父亲克拉克（William Andrews Clark）是美国历史上有名的铜矿大王，并于1901年至1907年间担任蒙大拿州民主党籍联邦参议员。 克拉克靠着在蒙大拿州、亚利桑那州开采铜矿起家，事业版图横跨银行、铁路、报纸、制糖、茶、原木、房地产等项目，《纽约时报》曾报导克拉克是全美国最有钱或第2有钱的人，财力与洛克斐勒不相上下。 修葛特克拉克是克拉克与第2任妻子所生的女儿，1925年克拉克去世，庞大遗产由子女均分，当时年仅19岁的修葛特克拉克每个月可领到7500美元的零用钱，换算今日币值约120万美元。 据估计，克拉克身后留下的遗产换算今日币值约36亿美元，修葛特克拉克在她21岁那年，继承了父亲遗产的1/5。22岁那年，她嫁给在家族企业里任职的一名法律系高材生，但新婚不到两年就离婚，接下来她一直与母亲安娜同住，直到安娜在1963年过世为止。 MSNBC 在2010年夏天的调查报导当中指出，修葛特克拉克的律师与会计师可能涉嫌侵占她的财产，纽约检警同时展开侦查，除了清查她银行帐户汇出款项，也调查原本她名下一把史特拉第瓦里小提琴以600万美元卖出、一幅雷诺瓦名画以 2350万美元卖出等交易的详情，律师则辩称所有交易都是根据修葛特克拉克的指示办理。 修葛特克拉克虽然已经不在人世，但相关调查目前仍在进行中。
92e10723a14e1d6b384916e811b90f8c2b33acaa.translatedText: The rich person Rachel Gert passed away and was alone in her later years. When she was only 19 years old, her monthly pocket money was worth approximately US$1.2 million in today's currency. At the age of 21, she inherited a huge fortune. The enigmatic American millionaire Richard Clark spent her final years alone in the hospital. She passed away this morning at the age of 104. Huguette Clark's lawyer issued a brief statement today to confirm her death, but did not disclose the cause of her death. They only said that Huguette Clark completed the last step of her life in accordance with her own wishes and "passed away while maintaining dignity and maintaining personal privacy." In two weeks, she would have turned 105 on June 9. In February 2010, the MSNBC website launched Shuget. Clark's special report album has aroused high response from all walks of life across the United States, and also made many readers particularly curious about this mysterious figure who has not appeared in public for more than 80 years. According to MSNBC, although Huget Clark lives in a hospital with full-time nurses for dedicated care, living a low-key and isolated life, the accumulated value of her idle luxury homes across the United States is quite astonishing, including a villa on the beach in Santa Barbara, California, worth about $100 million, a farmhouse in New Kenan, Connecticut, worth about $23 million, and a 42-room apartment on Fifth Avenue in New York, worth $100 million. These mansions are managed and maintained by dedicated personnel. The luxury apartments in New York are also equipped with expensive paintings and furniture. However, Huget Clark, the owner of these mansions, has been registered under a false name for many years and lived in an isolation ward of a hospital in New York City in order to avoid outside attention. Even her lawyer has been able to talk to her through the door for 20 years. Huget Clark's father, William Andrews Clark, was a famous copper mining magnate in American history and served as the Democratic U.S. Senator from Montana from 1901 to 1907. Clark started his career by mining copper mines in Montana and Arizona. His business spans banking, railways, newspapers, sugar, tea, logs, real estate and other projects. The New York Times once reported that Clark is the richest or second richest person in the United States, with financial resources on par with Rockefeller. Huget Clark was the daughter of Clark and his second wife. Clark died in 1925, and the huge inheritance was divided equally among the children. Huget Clark, who was only 19 years old at the time, could receive a monthly allowance of US$7,500, which is worth about US$1.2 million in today's currency. It is estimated that the estate left behind by Clark is worth about US$3.6 billion in today's currency. When she was 21 years old, Sugar Clark inherited 1/5 of her father's estate. At the age of 22, she married a top law student who worked in the family business, but they divorced less than two years after their marriage. She lived with her mother Anna until Anna passed away in 1963. MSNBC's investigative report in the summer of 2010 pointed out that Hugart Clark's lawyers and accountants may have been suspected of embezzling her property. The New York prosecutors also launched an investigation. In addition to checking the remittances from her bank account, they also investigated the details of the original transactions such as the sale of a Stradivari violin in her name for US$6 million and a Renoir painting for US$23.5 million. The lawyer argued that all transactions were conducted according to the instructions of Hugart Clark. Although Huggart Clark is no longer alive, the relevant investigation is still ongoing.

9547246c609fee5cdb7a641544ae92db1916184d.sourceText: 钱德勒马术比赛因病毒恐慌取消 一种高度传染性病毒正在本州传开，有关部门提醒马主采取措施保护自己的爱驹。 为阻止病毒传播，钱德勒的 Vaqueros Saddle俱乐部已取消上周六原本举行的马术比赛。 ”这令人十分失望，”俱乐部主管艾莉森海尔说。”很多人辛勤工作了一年，马匹也准备好，就是为了这次比赛。但为了保护大家的爱驹，没有办法。” 这种疱疹病毒被发现在亚利桑那和犹他州，呈现像马流感症状，可以变成一种神经疾病，可能是致命的。马可将是一个没有出现症状的载体。
9547246c609fee5cdb7a641544ae92db1916184d.translatedText: Chandler Rodeo canceled due to virus scare A highly contagious virus is spreading across the state, and authorities are reminding horse owners to take steps to protect their horses. The Vaqueros Saddle Club in Chandler has canceled last Saturday's equestrian event to prevent the spread of the virus. "It's very disappointing," club director Alison Hale said. "A lot of people have worked hard for a year and the horses are ready just for this race. But there is no way to protect everyone's horses." The herpes virus, found in Arizona and Utah, presents symptoms like equine flu and can turn into a neurological disease that can be fatal. Marco will be an asymptomatic carrier.

0e16316ad099c6b8c6977324bb2245f516fd6bc9.translatedText: Summer intensive classes at Enopi Learning Center have begun enrollment. Studies have shown that many children will forget a lot of what they learned last semester after a long summer vacation of nearly two months. If you don't practice for one day, your hands and feet will be slow, if you don't practice for two days, half will be lost, and if you don't practice for three days, you will be a layman. Many schools do not assign summer homework to children. If the entire summer vacation is wasted, some of the knowledge they have just learned will be forgotten by the children. Especially mathematics, a subject that requires long-term practice. So what can you do to ensure that this doesn't happen to your child? Enopi is here to help your child during the summer! ! The Enopi Learning Center in Chandler offers summer intensive classes for children over 3 years old, with courses including math, English and science. Among them, mathematical skills training and logical thinking training will help children pass the school district Gifted Programs exam. The summer intensive class tuition will be provided with a special discount price of 33% off, and 2 free trial classes and proficiency tests will be provided. Enopi Learning Center has more than 3 million students around the world. It enhances children's interest in learning and promotes active learning by cultivating children's self-confidence. Enopi tutors will understand the learning needs of different students, teach students in accordance with their aptitude and learning progress, and provide the most suitable guidance, so that students can make the greatest progress. Enopi students have participated in many mathematics competitions organized by AMC (American Mathematics Competition), AIME (American Invitational Mathematics Examination), USAMO (United States of America Mathematical Olympiad) and Math Kangaroo, and achieved excellent results. The learning center also specially established two teams to participate in the Harvard and MIT mathematics circuit competitions. For more information, please contact Tel: 480-269-0023, or visit www.enopiaz.com

e42e9e868a989dbf9ac4fcea2ebf991c3da07fa0.sourceText: 亚省油价终于松动 $3.72还能维持多久？ 本州各地汽油正在下降。但会持续多久？没人知道。 AAA官员上周说，本州的无铅汽油平均为$3.72/加仑，比五月第二周下降4.1美分。第三周的全国平均每加仑3.90美元，下跌了7.9美分的最后一周。图森已在每加仑3.61美元，而旗杆镇是3.85美元，为本州的最高价格。怀俄明州平均每加仑3.67美元，是在美国大陆州最低价，最高价在加利福尼亚州，每加仑4.17美元。
e42e9e868a989dbf9ac4fcea2ebf991c3da07fa0.translatedText: Alberta gas prices finally loosen up, how long can $3.72 last? Gasoline is dropping across the state. But how long will it last? No one knows. AAA officials said last week that unleaded gasoline in the state averaged $3.72 a gallon, down 4.1 cents from the second week of May. The national average for the third week was $3.90 per gallon, down 7.9 cents from the last week. Tucson has the highest price in the state at $3.61 per gallon, while Flagstaff is at $3.85. Wyoming's average price per gallon is $3.67, the lowest price in the continental United States, and the highest price is in California, which is $4.17 per gallon.

d08064339b85ce4949c0ab62371caed6f60f7175.sourceText: 恶意破坏公共建筑 3少年被捕 普雷斯科特警察近日逮捕三名青少年，涉嫌恶意破坏民宅。 警方说，嫌犯在Granada, Scout and Silver drives一带投掷硬物，用绿色和粉色油漆毁坏汽车、民宅和邮箱。有十个建筑物受损，初步估计损失$5,000至$10,000.他们还往北Tonto公园张贴淫秽图片和讲脏话。 巡逻人员很快发现他们的身份和所读学校。主要有三个少年，一名14岁女孩，一名13岁男童和15岁男子。三个少年无目的，通常选择在深夜和清晨行动。 三人面临多项刑事毁坏指控。因他们未成年，警方没有公布疑犯名字。 警方呼吁，各大中小学暑假到了，家长应看好自己家未成年孩子，教育他们切勿因无聊而触犯法律。
d08064339b85ce4949c0ab62371caed6f60f7175.translatedText: 3 teenagers were arrested Prescott police recently arrested three teenagers on suspicion of maliciously damaging a residence. Police said the suspects threw hard objects and used green and pink paint to damage cars, homes and mailboxes in the area of ​​Granada, Scout and Silver drives. Ten buildings were damaged, with preliminary estimates of damage ranging from $5,000 to $10,000. They also posted obscene images and used profanity in North Tonto Park. Patrol officers soon discovered their identities and the schools they attended. There are mainly three teenagers, a 14-year-old girl, a 13-year-old boy and a 15-year-old man. The three teenagers are aimless and usually choose to act late at night and early in the morning. Three people face multiple charges of criminal damage. Because they are minors, police have not released the names of the suspects. The police appealed to all primary and secondary schools that as the summer vacation is approaching, parents should take good care of their underage children and educate them not to break the law out of boredom.

65ac6752e3a35bfe41e384b45ab2e5bdc0244dd2.sourceText: Smucker包装咖啡再涨价 已涨3.5% 习惯至超市购买大包装咖啡的民众，荷包又要失血了，因为美国咖啡大厂 JM Smucker 食品公司 24 日宣布，将把富吉士 (Folgers) 和 Dunkin’ Donuts 甜甜圈店两种牌子的咖啡售价平均提高 11% 。这是该公司今年第二波两位数涨幅的涨价行动。 Smucker 食品公司把持续调涨的原因归咎于生咖啡的成本不断攀升。该公司表示，大部分美国咖啡产品均将涨价。 咖啡业者和分析师指出，虽然新兴市场的需求增加，以及部分主要产地因恶劣气候，导致供应锐减，但投机炒作可能是造成涨价的主因。生咖啡价格在去年即骤增 77% 。 Smucker 食品公司指出，这次涨价的产品包括 Smucker’s Millsotne 和 Folgers Gourmet Selections 的包装咖啡。而 Dunkin’ Donuts 牌的咖啡则只限杂货店、俱乐部、药房和大型量贩店出售的包装咖啡受影响。 全美各地当肯甜甜圈店连锁店所出售的杯装咖啡，并非 Smucker 食品公司供应的产品，因此与这次涨价无关。 总部设在俄亥俄州奥尔维尔的 Smucker 食品公司，从去年至今已四次宣布调涨，分别是去年 5 月提高 4% 、 8 月提高 9% ，以及今年 2 月初提高 10% 。 另外，全球最大咖啡连锁店星巴克，早在 3 月即因成本增加，已把售给零售店的 Starbucks 和 Seattle’s Best 包装咖啡调涨 12% 。 劳工部表示，消费者支付的咖啡价格，在 3 月已上涨了 3.5% 。
65ac6752e3a35bfe41e384b45ab2e5bdc0244dd2.translatedText: The price of Smucker packaged coffee has increased again. It has increased by 3.5%. People who are accustomed to buying large packaged coffee in supermarkets are about to lose money again, because JM Smucker Food Company, a major American coffee manufacturer, announced on the 24th that it will increase the prices of two brands of coffee at Folgers and Dunkin’ Donuts donut shops by an average of 11%. This is the company's second wave of double-digit price increases this year. Smucker Foods blamed the rising cost of green coffee for the continued increases. The company said most U.S. coffee products will see price increases. Coffee industry players and analysts pointed out that although demand in emerging markets has increased and supply has dropped sharply due to bad weather in some major producing areas, speculation may be the main reason for the price increase. Green coffee prices surged 77% last year. Smucker Foods noted that the price increases include packaged coffee from Smucker’s Millsotne and Folgers Gourmet Selections. Dunkin’ Donuts brand coffee is only affected by packaged coffee sold in grocery stores, clubs, pharmacies and mass merchandisers. Cups of coffee sold at Dunkin’ Donuts chains across the country are not products supplied by Smucker Foods and therefore have nothing to do with the price increase. Smucker Foods, headquartered in Orrville, Ohio, has announced four increases since last year, including a 4% increase in May last year, a 9% increase in August, and a 10% increase in early February this year. In addition, Starbucks, the world’s largest coffee chain, had raised its price for Starbucks and Seattle’s Best packaged coffee sold to retail stores by 12% as early as March due to increased costs. The Labor Department said the price consumers paid for coffee rose 3.5% in March.

1d06b1e742528827ff7ae3f7773d3bddfb8a1320.sourceText: 10月31日清晨我被妈妈呼唤爸爸的叫声惊醒，我的心在狂跳，预感不祥，立即冲过去爸爸的房间，只见爸爸身体已经冰冷，无论我们怎样呼唤，他再也醒 不来，就这样走了，我们的声音嘶哑了，泪水流干了，无法形容那种揪心的巨痛，爸爸走得如此突然，没有留下一句话，这感觉真让人难以接受。 今年初爸爸因冠心病突发，心血管严重堵塞，在广州被送医院抢救，当时以为无望了，我们都从凤凰城赶回广州，后来经过近一个月中西医结合的治疗，他的心 血管通过药物被打通了，居然奇迹般地活了下来。 为此，在九月下旬爸妈决定跟随我回到了凤凰城，从此与儿女一起在这里安居，本以为一家人在一起快乐相聚、共享天伦了，但万万没有想到回来凤凰城刚好一个月零几 天，爸爸却突然不辞而别了… 虽然我们忍受极大的痛苦，并且依依不舍，但从另一个角度想，人生终须一别，看到父亲走得如此安详，毫无痛楚，这是令我们最感欣慰的，也是爸爸 一生中最大的福报。 爸爸生前常说他希望自己能够在睡觉的时候走，这样就不用辛苦，也不会拖累家人。 爸爸一生为人忠厚正直，心地善良，与人为善，生性乐观，也许好人有好报，也许是爸爸前世或今生修来的福，他的愿望达成了，他走得很舒服，很 安详，很自在。 。 。 爸爸您放心，这个家就交给我们了，我们会代你照顾好妈妈的，您安息吧，一路走好！ 您的音容笑貌是如此清晰的在我们记忆中， 虽然您享受着天堂的喜悦， 但我们知道你的爱并没有远离， 每天，我们深深感恩，默默地祈祷， 借清风，寄明月， 送上我们对您的爱与思念！
1d06b1e742528827ff7ae3f7773d3bddfb8a1320.translatedText: In the early morning of October 31st, I was awakened by my mother calling for my father. My heart was beating wildly and I had an ominous premonition. I rushed to my father's room and saw that my father's body was already cold. No matter how we called, he would never wake up and just left. Our voices were hoarse and our tears ran dry. It is indescribable to describe the heart-wrenching pain. Dad left so suddenly without leaving a word. This feeling is really unacceptable. At the beginning of this year, my father suffered from a sudden coronary heart attack and severe cardiovascular blockage. He was sent to the hospital for emergency treatment in Guangzhou. At that time, he thought there was no hope, so we all rushed back to Guangzhou from Phoenix. Later, after nearly a month of treatment with a combination of traditional Chinese and Western medicine, his cardiovascular system was opened up with drugs, and he miraculously survived. For this reason, in late September, my parents decided to follow me back to Phoenix City and live here with our children. We thought that we would be happily together as a family and share our family, but we never expected that just a month and a few days after returning to Phoenix City, my father would suddenly leave without saying goodbye... Although we endured great pain and were reluctant to leave, from another perspective, we must say goodbye in life. Seeing my father pass away so peacefully and without any pain was the most gratifying to us and the greatest blessing in my father's life. During his lifetime, my father often said that he wished he could leave while sleeping, so that he would not have to work hard and would not be a drag on his family. Dad has been loyal and upright throughout his life, kind-hearted, kind to others, and optimistic by nature. Maybe good people are rewarded, or maybe it is the blessing that Dad has gained in his previous life or this life. His wish came true, and he walked very comfortably, peacefully, and at ease. . . Don't worry, dad, this family will be left to us, and we will take good care of mom on your behalf. Rest in peace and have a safe journey! Your voice and smile are so clear in our memory. Although you are enjoying the joy of heaven, we know that your love is not far away. Every day, we are deeply grateful and pray silently. We send our love and thoughts to you through the breeze and the bright moon!

48179309f1542867263186b5f62b714770adf347.sourceText: 你知道华尔街的最大秘密吗？ 华尔街有众多共同基金想卖给你，它们或是”绝对回报”基金，或是”中型股混合”基金，还有可能是”小型股增长”基金。 许多经纪商、理财顾问和销售员都会对你说，只有将所有这些基金按适当比例混合持有，你才能构建出合理的投资组合，使其回报与你的”风险承受能力”做到完美匹配。 一派胡言。 在你投入真金白银前，不妨听听鲍勃.豪根（Bob Haugen）的高见。 曾担任金融学教授的他花费了半生时间来研究股票市场。他撰写过众多书籍和论文，还与人合写了Case Closed这篇非凡的分析文章。 他在文中不厌其烦地详细分析了在1963年至2007年近半个世纪时间内那些表现最好（以及表现最差）股票的特征。 他发现了什么？ 大多数所谓”时尚”股票都不值得投资。而那种要获得更多回报就得承受更大”风险”的说法则是彻头彻尾的谎言。 豪根说，股票市场其实有一个巨大秘密。 他说，几十年来，”那些有着最高风险的股票创造了最低的回报，而那些有着最低风险的股票则创造了最高的回报。”换句话说，股票的风险与回报应该成反比才对……从他对45年间股市表现的研究看，市场对风险的回报一向是为负的。 你不会因为自己承受风险而获得回报，却会因选择不承受风险而获得回报。 所有那些迷人而性感的”增长型”股票，所有那些你在不顾一切追求高回报过程中承受的额外波动性，都不是什么好东西。 如果你当初把资金投入那些似乎只能让你保本微利的低风险”价值型”股票，你的投资收益其实会好得多。 在时间检验中胜出的是那些综合考虑每股净资产值、收益、现金流和派息等因素后价格显得低廉的股票。发行这些股票的公司目前就有数额巨大且不断增长的利润，这些股票不属于那些将幸福一股脑寄希望于未来10年的公司。它们还常常能从股市近期的增长动力中获益。 虽然豪根说，很难找到堪称”完美”的个股，但你依然能够找到表现良好的股票来构建投资组合。 投资价值型股票可以获得良好回报。豪根和Case Closed一文的另一位作者纳丁.贝克（Nardin Baker）写道：有强大证据显示，与所有那些有关预期回报的复杂理论相比，简单的直觉更为靠谱。 简单的直觉事实上会让你更轻松地赚更多的钱。即使是在计算进交易成本后，凭直觉进行投资的策略也能奏效。 这一发现也并非只适用于美国。豪根还研究了英国、法国、德国和日本股市的历史数据。 结果是一样的。波动性较低的股票带来了较高的回报。简直是免费午餐嘛。 很多专业投资者已经知道这一点，但有太多的人不知道。而知道的人当中，又有很多人不断忘记，一次又一次地急着追捧那些昂贵的”潜力股”。最近的情况就是这样。 华尔街也不会过于广泛地向公众散播这种宝贵的信息。跟客户解释起来是很困难的。而且，如果客户知道有一个以更低风险获取更高回报的简便方法，他们还需要基金经理干吗呢？ 不只豪根一人做出了这样的分析。反向投资者多年来强调的数据显示，在任何一个较长时间段内，”价值型”股票总能跑赢”增长型”股票。 投资公司GMO的知名策略师蒙迪埃(James Montier)曾经证明，日本过去20年的大熊市完全是缘于”魅力”股的下跌。他发现，这期间如果你持有日本的价值股，同时做空这些魅力股，你实际上会赚到钱。 这种免费午餐证明，市场远远谈不上完全”有效”。豪根说，这个事实对有效市场假说堪称致命一击。 就连一些狂热崇拜有效市场假说的人也都被迫部分承认了这类观点。他们几十年来坚持认为，要获得更高回报，你就得承受更大波动或曰”风险”。回过头来看数据时，他们才意识到实际情况并不全是这样。他们承认，小公司的表现比大公司好，价值型股票的表现比增长型股票好──尽管它们含有的风险更低。 哦，原来就是这样有效啊。 这对今天的你来说意味着什么？ 碰巧，过去两年股市反弹期间增长型股票出现了大幅上涨。于是投资者再次任由自己幻想未来的辉煌，而不是紧盯今天的利润。FactSet的数据显示，从2009年年初开始，增长型股票的表现比价值型股票好20%。这令人难以置信。小盘增长型股票表现最好。所有股票中最安全的大盘价值股表现最差。 如果历史可为镜鉴，这种现象将会是一时的，它对聪明的长线投资者来说是一次机会。显而易见的结论是，现在就该抛售增长型股票、买入价值股或价值股基金。虽然我对处于目前水平的整个股市持谨慎态度，但如果要买股票的话，我会买进一只低估值的大盘价值股基金。
48179309f1542867263186b5f62b714770adf347.translatedText: Do you know Wall Street’s biggest secret? There are a lot of mutual funds on Wall Street trying to sell you, whether they're "absolute return" funds, or "mid-cap blend" funds, or maybe "small-cap growth" funds. Many brokers, financial advisors, and salespeople will tell you that only by mixing all these funds in the right proportions can you construct a portfolio that perfectly matches your "risk tolerance." What nonsense. Before you invest real money, listen to Bob Haugen's advice. The former finance professor has spent half his life studying the stock market. He is the author of numerous books and papers, and co-authored Case Closed, an extraordinary analysis. In the article, he painstakingly analyzes in detail the characteristics of the best-performing (and worst-performing) stocks over nearly half a century from 1963 to 2007. What did he find? Most so-called "fashion" stocks are not worth investing in. And the idea that you have to take more "risk" to get more returns is a complete lie. Haugen said that the stock market actually has a huge secret. He said that for decades, "the stocks with the highest risk have created the lowest returns, and those stocks with the lowest risk have created the highest returns." In other words, the risk and return of stocks should be inversely proportional... From his study of stock market performance over a 45-year period, the market's return to risk has always been negative. You won't be rewarded for taking the risk yourself, but you will be rewarded for choosing not to take the risk. All those glamorous and sexy "growth" stocks, all that extra volatility you endure in the desperate pursuit of high returns, is not a good thing. If you had invested your money in low-risk "value" stocks that seemed to only allow you to maintain capital and make a small profit, your investment returns would actually be much better. The stocks that win out in the test of time are those that appear cheap when considering factors such as net asset value per share, earnings, cash flow and dividends. The companies issuing these stocks are currently making huge and growing profits, and these stocks do not belong to companies that are betting their happiness solely on the next 10 years. They also often benefit from recent growth momentum in the stock market. While Haugen says it's hard to find "perfect" stocks, you can still find stocks that perform well to build a portfolio. Investing in value stocks can yield good returns. Haugen and Case Closed co-author Nardin Baker wrote: There is strong evidence that simple intuition is more reliable than all those complex theories about expected returns. Simple intuition will actually make it easier for you to make more money. The strategy of investing based on your gut can work even after accounting for transaction costs. This finding isn't exclusive to the United States, either. Haugen also looked at historical data on UK, French, German and Japanese stock markets. The result is the same. Stocks with lower volatility deliver higher returns. It's literally a free lunch. Many professional investors already know this, but too many don’t. And among those who know it, many people keep forgetting it and rush to pursue those expensive "potential stocks" again and again. That's been the case recently. Nor will Wall Street disseminate this valuable information to the public too broadly. It is difficult to explain to customers. And if clients knew there was an easy way to get higher returns with lower risk, why would they need a fund manager? Haugen is not alone in making this analysis. Contrarian investors have highlighted data for years showing that "value" stocks consistently outperform "growth" stocks over any extended period of time. James Montier, a well-known strategist at the investment company GMO, once proved that Japan's great bear market in the past 20 years was entirely due to the decline of "charm" stocks. He found that if you held Japanese value stocks during this period and shorted these glamor stocks, you actually made money. This free lunch proves that the market is far from completely "efficient." This fact, Haugen says, is a fatal blow to the efficient market hypothesis. Even some ardent believers in the efficient market hypothesis are forced to partially admit this view. They have maintained for decades that to get higher returns, you have to accept more volatility, or "risk." When they looked back at the data, they realized that wasn't necessarily the case. They acknowledge that smaller companies perform better than larger companies and that value stocks perform better than growth stocks -- even though they involve less risk. Oh, so it works like this. What does this mean to you today? As it happens, growth stocks have seen big gains during the stock market rebound over the past two years. So investors once again allowed themselves to fantasize about future glory instead of focusing on today's profits. According to FactSet data, since the beginning of 2009, growth stocks have performed 20% better than value stocks. It's unbelievable. Small-cap growth stocks performed best. Large-cap value stocks, the safest of all stocks, fared the worst. If history is any guide, this phenomenon will be temporary and an opportunity for smart long-term investors. The obvious conclusion is that now is the time to sell growth stocks and buy value stocks or value funds. While I'm cautious about the overall stock market at current levels, if I were buying stocks, I would buy a low-valuation large-cap value stock fund.

4d62268f1b4f128425056f046e04653ebdc3fe01.sourceText: 中国教育部副部长鲁昕女士率团访问亚利桑州（图） 中国教育部副部长鲁昕与亚利桑那州教育厅官员和ASU负责人会谈 11月14日，应美国教育部的邀请，中国国家教育部副部长鲁昕女士率国际合作与交流司长张秀琴，国际司美大处处长杨军等10人的代表团访问亚利桑那州教育厅和州立大学，凤凰城大学。鲁昕部长积极评价美中两国在职业教育领域开展的务实合作。她表示，职业教育合作是中国教育对外交流的重要内容。我们很高兴看到，双方根据各自职业教育发展的现状和需求共同确定了多个领域作为未来合作的重点。中方希望与美方特别是亚利桑那州立大学和凤凰城大学积极磋商，将合作设想尽快转变为具体行动。鲁昕还对中美职教,远程网络合作具体行动计划提出了建议。 亚利桑那州教育厅和州立大学校长迈克尔. 克罗赞赏中方大力发展职业教育和远程网络的战略眼光，对中方重视对美开展职教合作表示感谢。并积极回应鲁昕关于美中职教合作行动计划的建议，表示美方将与中方共同努力，推动落实。 会谈结束后，鲁昕副部长在校方有关人员的陪同下参观了ASU及凤凰城大学的网络管理中心与当地学生亲切交谈，同时对中华人民共和国驻洛杉矶总领事馆，亚利桑那州华人华侨总会，美国凤凰国际旅行社在访问当中的大力支持与协助表示感谢。代表团将继续前往西雅图，华盛顿进行访问交流。 ASU校长迈克尔克罗（中）在州立大学俱乐部礼堂宴请鲁昕副部长一行 总领事馆许翠英领事，亚利桑那州华人华侨总会杨文田陪同代表团考察网络教育示范
4d62268f1b4f128425056f046e04653ebdc3fe01.translatedText: Ms. Lu Xin, Vice Minister of the Chinese Ministry of Education, led a delegation to visit Arizona (picture) Chinese Vice Minister of Education Lu Xin held talks with Arizona Department of Education officials and ASU leaders. On November 14, at the invitation of the U.S. Department of Education, Ms. Lu Xin, Vice Minister of the Chinese Ministry of Education, led a 10-member delegation including Zhang Xiuqin, Director of the Department of International Cooperation and Exchange, and Yang Jun, Director of the Division of International and American Studies, to visit the Arizona Department of Education and state universities, including the University of Phoenix. Minister Lu Xin spoke positively of the pragmatic cooperation between the United States and China in the field of vocational education. She said that cooperation in vocational education is an important part of China’s education foreign exchanges. We are pleased to see that both parties have jointly identified multiple areas as the focus of future cooperation based on the current status and needs of their respective vocational education development. China hopes to actively consult with the United States, especially Arizona State University and the University of Phoenix, to turn cooperation ideas into concrete actions as soon as possible. Lu Xin also made suggestions on specific action plans for Sino-US vocational education and remote network cooperation. Arizona Department of Education and State University President Michael Crow appreciated China's strategic vision of vigorously developing vocational education and distance networks, and expressed his gratitude to China for attaching great importance to vocational education cooperation with the United States. He also actively responded to Lu Xin’s suggestion on the U.S.-China vocational education cooperation action plan, saying that the United States will work with China to promote its implementation. After the meeting, Vice Minister Lu Xin, accompanied by relevant school personnel, visited the network management center of ASU and the University of Phoenix and had cordial conversations with local students. At the same time, he expressed his gratitude to the Consulate General of the People's Republic of China in Los Angeles, the Arizona Overseas Chinese Association, and Phoenix International Travel Agency for their strong support and assistance during the visit. The delegation will continue to Seattle, Washington for visits and exchanges. ASU President Michael Crow (middle) hosted a banquet for Vice Minister Lu Xin and his delegation at the State University Club Auditorium. Consul Xu Cuiying of the Consulate General and Yang Wentian of the Arizona Overseas Chinese Association accompanied the delegation to inspect the online education demonstration

0bd2f90cf86dab915ba5d167b491036a0eeeaf8d.sourceText: 在歌厅或茶座人们常听到某些男​​人一兴奋便会得意地向朋友宣扬自己的风流艳史,不过许多吹嘘自己如何如何的人，都没跳出在数量上强调自己业绩的俗套。 其实真正优秀的男人一般是不会去风月场所的，他们追求的是最高情操。 有男人说”情”很麻烦很累，而”泄”简单干脆。 这也倒是实话，可问题是男女之事不麻烦不累仅简单和干脆，那种掏心掏肺的韵味和感觉又怎能体现呢? 往往去风月场所的男人通常都是性压抑或性饥渴者，他们是用消耗体力的方式来满足生理需求。 而优秀的男人与女人交往却重在一个情字上，他们追求的是质量；假优秀的男人则只为一个泄字，追求的是数量。 现在有些男人，他们花钱去玩女人，然后还很得意地标榜自己是”沟女”高手，是经历过很多女人的情圣。 谁都知道花钱找的女人根本不是完整的女人，她们除了给你肉体，很统一的特征是没有真情。 古今中外的嫖客与妓女都只是一种商业关系，甚至很多被逼做妓女的女性还会从骨子里蔑视嫖客。 在这种男女关系中，很难体会到相爱的那种心跳，因而也无法对心灵形成抚慰。 也许有些男人在市场竞争的挣扎中，已掏空了自己的全部精力，可能他们会说：我没有更多的时间儿女情长，所以也不想和女人讲什么真​​情！ 这的确是当今社会很严重的现象，男人的”忙”从字面上解是心死。 即使某些男人还没有忙死，但也几乎忙得失去了爱的能力。 幸好目前男人还没有完全失去对女人的兴趣，极忙的男人也能在壮阳药的支持下浮起性的渴望。 这种用钱消磨体力和满足性欲的行为已经不是风流韵事，这种人如果再标榜自己是情圣，那真的是脸厚和可笑至之。 真正优秀的男人往往在情场上并不张扬，他们喜欢不露声色地与优秀的女人交往。 很从容地去赏识自已心爱的女人，有一种让人不容易发现的淡定。 他们非常明白与什么样的女人可以碰出火花，有时甚至根本不说一个爱字也能使女人心动不已。 这种男人看上去很自然，很优秀,仿佛很透明，同时能洞察各种女性微妙的情绪变化。 这种男人能将女人心中散乱的感觉进行重组，会在突然间让女人看到自己从未发现的优势。 许多女人会感到他身上有发光的引力，会在一种难言的状态中让自己的心随他而颤动。 这种很成熟的男人往往非常简单，他们像孩子似的单纯，甚至可以与对路的陌生女人碰撞时，也能在瞬间制造疯狂和浪漫。 所以说优秀男人的最高境界是一种与自然合拍的完美组合体，这是很多假优秀的附庸者无法达到的层面。 因此这种男人深受女人赏识。
0bd2f90cf86dab915ba5d167b491036a0eeeaf8d.translatedText: In karaoke bars or teahouses, people often hear that some men will proudly advertise their romantic histories to their friends when they are excited. However, many people who brag about how great they are do not jump out of the cliché of emphasizing their achievements in terms of quantity. In fact, truly outstanding men generally do not go to romantic places. What they pursue is the highest sentiment. Some men say that "love" is troublesome and tiring, but "letting out" is simple and straightforward. This is true, but the problem is that things between men and women are not troublesome, not tiring, and are simple and straightforward. How can the heart-wrenching charm and feeling be reflected? Men who often go to erotic places are usually sexually repressed or sexually hungry. They use physical energy to satisfy their physiological needs. However, the relationship between excellent men and women focuses on the word "love", and what they pursue is quality; the fake excellent men only care about the word "love", and what they pursue is quantity. Nowadays, some men spend money to play with women, and then proudly flaunt themselves as masters of "ditch girl" and love saints who have experienced many women. Everyone knows that the women you spend money to find are not complete women at all. Apart from giving you their bodies, their common characteristic is that they have no true feelings. The relationship between clients and prostitutes in ancient and modern times is just a commercial relationship. Even many women who are forced to be prostitutes despise their clients from the bottom of their hearts. In this kind of relationship between a man and a woman, it is difficult to feel the heartbeat of love, and therefore it cannot soothe the soul. Maybe some men have exhausted all their energy in the struggle of market competition. Maybe they will say: I don’t have more time to love my children, so I don’t want to tell the truth to women! This is indeed a very serious phenomenon in today's society. A man's "busyness" literally means he is desperate. Even if some men are not too busy to death, they are almost so busy that they have lost the ability to love. Fortunately, men have not completely lost interest in women, and extremely busy men can still have sexual desires with the support of aphrodisiacs. This kind of behavior of using money to kill physical strength and satisfy sexual desire is no longer a romantic affair. If this kind of person continues to flaunt himself as a lover, it is really shameless and ridiculous. Really good men are often not showy in love. They like to interact with good women in a discreet way. He appreciates the woman he loves very calmly, and there is a calmness that is hard to find. They know very well what kind of women they can create sparks with, and sometimes they can make a woman's heart flutter even without saying a word of love at all. This kind of man looks very natural, excellent, and seems to be very transparent. At the same time, he can understand the subtle emotional changes of various women. This kind of man can reorganize the scattered feelings in a woman's heart, and suddenly let the woman see advantages that she has never discovered. Many women will feel the luminous gravity on his body and will let their hearts tremble with him in an unspeakable state. This kind of very mature men are often very simple. They are as innocent as children. They can even create madness and romance in an instant when they collide with a strange woman on the right road. Therefore, the highest state of an excellent man is a perfect combination in tune with nature. This is a level that many fake excellent followers cannot achieve. Therefore, this kind of man is deeply appreciated by women.

e2aa9a89800627b6aaa20e98ad56e90a7af78e15.sourceText: 凤凰城凤鸣：回国探亲的一路见闻与感恩（三） 三 见证主的一路保守与感恩 这次回国看病，就是因为腿关节炎复发，走路和上下楼都很困难，女儿家住五楼还没有电梯，一路上坐飞机还发愁，在内心不注地诪告，祈求神的怜悯，为我打开这电梯之门。当我見到女儿时，女儿面帶神秘的微笑对我说：妈妈您真有福，四楼的房子电梯一直没有开，今天您要到，上午〝务业〞就通知，让去拿电梯卡，您今天就可以住新装修好的四楼，而且电梯是入户的，打開电梯门就是咱们自已家，由于您的到来，才帶给我们这福份。这四楼是在女儿的小区附近，是女儿、女婿给他们父母买的，早已装修好，就是因为没有开电梯，才一直没过来住，因为我要回去，她(他) 们又托人找关系，就在我要到的当天上午，才开通了电梯，让我住进了有电梯、又装修好，一切都齐全，女儿的公婆还没入住，倒是我先住了她(他) 们的新房子。感谢主，怜悯我，听了我的恳求的诪告，为我打開了电梯之门，觧决了我上下楼的困难。神是听诪告的神，只要将一切所求所想交托仰望神，神就会为你开路！ 两年多没回国探亲，这次好不容易回去了，却不能遂人心愿的去探亲访友，在江西的大姐和在烟台的二哥家，由于时间紧、路途远、行动又不方便，都不能前去探访和看望，感觉心里很不平安，经过商议决定，我们都在济南集中，然后一起去老家给父母扫墓，这真是一个两全其美的好主意。我们兄弟姊妹都年令大了，集中一次不容易，这次能在济南見面，又能为父母扫墓，也了却了我们多年的心愿。他(她) 们来到济南，刚好可以同我住在有电梯的新房子里，叙说童年趣事和几年分别来的变化与思念，这真是主为我们而预备。 扫墓的这一天，一大早女儿开车，载我们兄弟姊妹姑姪五位老人向城郊出发。由于城郊变化很大，路是修得很宽阔，但是村庄都改变了模样。村民的住宅区都翻了新，并在村庄和山地之间，開辟了一条宽阔的柏油马路，我们憑着记忆寻找上山的小路，走了二十多分钟的羊肠小道，也没有寻找到墓地，正在我们疲惫不堪、不知所措时，山下来了一位拾柴的老人，仔细相看，原来竞是我们的一個远房亲戚，这不是神差遣来的天使吗！在他的帶领下，很快找到了墓地。原来是山地都包给个人种上桃树，每一块山崖地都置上篱笆墙，没人帶领真得不好找。还好父母的墓地没有被篱笆墙围住，只是被许多乱树枝所挡，兄弟姊妹姑姪几人一起，清扫的清扫，把墓碑擦拭干净，摆上鲜花，寄托我们的哀思！了却我们多年的心愿。 在回城的路上已是十一点多，女儿帶我们吃了午饭，送我们回四楼休息。真的年令不饶人，上得楼来，个个都累得坐下就不想再动，我劝他（她）们干脆躺下来睡一小觉，恢复一下体力，只听他（她）们不一小会就发出了甜美的鼾声。 这次扫墓，大哥的女儿我的姪女和我们一起去扫墓，等大家都休息恢复体力后，她邀请我们这些叔叔姑姑们，到她家作客，我们都欣然前往。她住的社区名称叫做”领袖城”，这個名称也夠大气得。她家的楼是二十一层楼的建筑，帶二层地下室和地下车库，她家在五层还不算高，从宽敞的窗前往外观看，一幢幢二十多层的高楼大厦，像树林一样拔地而起，南面依山，风景如画。她给我看她最近手钩的手提袖珍包和手机包，看后非常欣赏和喜欢，当即提出要再向她学习这手艺。我姪女非常热心教授於我，并在我回来以前，为我购买了五光十色的漂亮线团。真得感谢她的好施乐教。上次回国，她教我做丝网花，并送我许多做丝网花的材料，这次又送我许多钩包的漂亮花色的线团。我们俩虽然是姑姪的辈分，实际上我们俩年令相差不大，从小就像姊妹一样，一起玩一块长大。人真得是活到老学到老，没想到都是退休后闲负在家，又学习起做新潮的艺术品，心情大好，有一种被艺术升华的感觉。真的从心灵深处感谢 神，在我们年岁一天天增加时，你不丢弃我们，还让我们学习一些造就人的艺术，来陶冶情操。就像圣經诗篇94:15所述：”我正说我失了脚，耶和华啊！那时你的慈爱扶助我。”我们衷心地歌唱：”天属你，地属你，世界和其中所充满的，都为你所建立。”(詩篇89:11）让我们把一切荣耀和讚美，都归给创造宇宙万物的 神！ （未完待续）
e2aa9a89800627b6aaa20e98ad56e90a7af78e15.translatedText: Feng Ming from Phoenix City: Experiences and Gratitude on the Journey Back to China to Visit Relatives (3) 3 Witnessing the Lord’s Protection and Gratitude Along the Way This time I returned to China to see a doctor because of the recurrence of arthritis in my legs. It was difficult to walk and go up and down stairs. My daughter’s house did not have an elevator on the fifth floor. I was worried about the flight all the way. I secretly confessed in my heart and prayed for God’s mercy to open the elevator door for me. When I saw my daughter, she said to me with a mysterious smile: Mom, you are so lucky. The elevator in the house on the fourth floor has not been opened. You have to arrive today, and the "Business Department" will notify you in the morning to get the elevator card. You can live in the newly renovated fourth floor today, and the elevator is for home use. When you open the elevator door, you will be our own home. Your arrival has brought us this blessing. This fourth floor is near my daughter's community. It was bought by my daughter and son-in-law for their parents. It has been renovated for a long time. However, because there is no elevator, I have never come here to live in it. Because I want to go back, they asked someone to find a connection. On the morning of my arrival, the elevator was opened and I was allowed to move in. There is an elevator and it is well-decorated and everything is complete. My daughter's parents-in-law have not moved in yet, but I live in their new house first. Thank you Lord for having mercy on me, listening to my pleas and confessions, opening the elevator door for me, and solving my difficulty in going up and down the stairs. God is a God who listens to accusations. As long as you trust God with all your requests and thoughts, God will open a way for you! I haven’t been back to China to visit relatives for more than two years. This time I finally went back, but I couldn’t visit relatives and friends as I wanted. My eldest sister in Jiangxi and my second brother in Yantai couldn’t go to visit due to time constraints, long distances, and inconvenient movement. I felt very uneasy. After discussion, we decided that we would all gather in Jinan, and then go to our hometown to visit our parents’ graves together. This is really a good idea to get the best of both worlds. We brothers and sisters are all very old, so it is not easy to gather together. This time we can meet in Jinan and visit our parents' graves, which fulfills our long-cherished wish. When they came to Jinan, they were able to live with me in a new house with an elevator and talk about interesting childhood stories and the changes and misses in the past few years. This was truly prepared by the Lord for us. On the day of the tomb-sweeping day, my daughter drove early in the morning and took us, five old people, my brothers, sisters, and aunts, to the outskirts of the city. Because the suburbs of the city have changed a lot, the roads have been built wider, but the villages have changed their appearance. The residential areas of the villagers were renovated, and a wide asphalt road was opened between the village and the mountain. We searched for the path up the mountain based on our memory. We walked on the winding path for more than 20 minutes, but we could not find the cemetery. When we were exhausted and at a loss, an old man collecting firewood came down the mountain. After a closer look, he turned out to be a distant relative of ours. Isn't this an angel sent by God? Under his leadership, the cemetery was quickly found. It turns out that the mountainous areas are contracted to individuals to plant peach trees, and every piece of cliff land is covered with fences. It is really difficult to find them without someone to guide them. Fortunately, my parents' cemetery was not surrounded by a fence, but was blocked by many branches. My brothers, sisters, and aunts worked together to clean the gravestones, wipe them clean, and put flowers on them to express our condolences! It fulfilled our long-cherished wish. It was past eleven o'clock on the way back to the city. My daughter took us to lunch and sent us back to the fourth floor to rest. Age is really not forgiving. After going upstairs, everyone was so tired that they didn’t want to move anymore after sitting down. I advised them to just lie down and take a nap to regain their strength. I only heard them snoring sweetly after a while. This time, my eldest brother’s daughter and my niece went with us to sweep the grave. After everyone rested and recovered their strength, she invited us uncles and aunts to visit her home, and we all went happily. The name of the community where she lives is called "Leader City", which is quite impressive. Her house is a twenty-one-story building with a two-story basement and an underground garage. Her house is not very high on the fifth floor. From the spacious window, you can see tall buildings with more than 20 floors rising from the ground like a forest. The scenery is picturesque with mountains to the south. She showed me the handbags and mobile phone bags that she had recently hand-crocheted. After seeing them, I admired them very much and immediately offered to learn this craft from her again. My niece was very enthusiastic about teaching me, and before I came back, she bought me beautiful balls of thread in various colors. I really have to thank her for her good Xerox teaching. When I returned to China last time, she taught me how to make silk screen flowers and gave me a lot of materials for making silk screen flowers. This time she also gave me a lot of beautiful crochet threads. Although we are aunts, we are actually about the same age. We have been like sisters since childhood, playing together and growing up. People really live and learn. Unexpectedly, after retirement, I was idle at home, and started to learn to make trendy art. I was in a good mood, and I felt like I was sublimated by art. I really thank God from the bottom of my heart. As we grow older, you do not abandon us, but also allow us to learn some arts of building up people to cultivate our sentiments. Just as the Bible Psalm 94:15 says: "I was saying that I had stumbled, O Lord! Then your love sustained me." We sing heartily: "The heavens are yours, the earth is yours, for you established the world and everything in it." (Psalm 89:11) Let us give all glory and praise to God, who created the universe! (To be continued)

ea0ebe332c802549579c9d2ae5956dc3dceb998d.sourceText: 亚利桑那州不再需要等待联邦政府来完成建设沿墨西哥边境围墙。 7 月 20 日生效的一项新法律，允许州府建设围栏，只要能筹集到足够的私人捐款，并说服公众和私营业主，使他们允许州府在他们的土地架设铁丝网。 目前还没有其他州尝试这样的方式设边境围栏。该法的推动者，来自马利科巴郡的参议员史提夫史密斯，将与州长讨论如何实施这一法律。 亚利桑那州边界大部分属联邦或印第安保留地，小部分属于私人土地拥有者。史密斯说，他将与州长的人商讨如何获取联邦政府土地上 60 英尺沿边土地使用权，来建立围栏。 南部边境约 370 英里长，三分之一在本州岛西部的尤马和诺格拉斯之间。众所周知，诺格拉斯是美国西南地区最大非法移民和毒品入口地，仅靠边境巡逻员是不足以阻挡这些。 史密斯议员是州政府联合边境安全咨询委员会主任。他解释，在没有增加足够的雷达和巡逻人手的情况下，围栏成为一个最好的障碍。 布鲁尔的发言人马修本森说，州长支持这个法律。 ”法 律的实施牵涉甚广, 如果有足够的私人捐款就好办多了。” 如果不能使用联邦土地，史密斯说，他将开始与私人牧场主谈判，请求他们允许州府使用他们的土地。 史密斯说他目前尚未有确切的预算，但造价可以控制在 5000 万美元的范围内。根据 2009 年美国政府报告 ​​ ，一英里围栏花费 300 万美元。但史密斯说，亚利桑那州的最终成本将取决于用什么样的篱笆，和州府是否得到私人公司捐赠。州议员也表示，他们将利用服刑人劳动来来减少开支。
ea0ebe332c802549579c9d2ae5956dc3dceb998d.translatedText: that takes effect July 20th Arizona no longer has to wait for the federal government to finish building a wall along the Mexican border. A new law that took effect on July 20 allows states to build fences as long as they can raise enough private donations and convince the public and private property owners to allow the state to erect barbed wire on their land. No other state has yet attempted such an approach to border fencing. The law's sponsor, Sen. Steve Smith, R-Maricopa County, will discuss with the governor how to implement the law. Most of Arizona's borders are federal or Indian reservation lands, with a small portion owned by private landowners. Smith said he will talk to the governor's people about acquiring land rights along a 60-foot edge on federal land to build the fence. The southern border is about 370 miles long, one-third of which is between Yuma and Nograss on the western side of Honshu. As we all know, Noglala is the largest entry point for illegal immigrants and drugs in the southwest of the United States. Border Patrol agents alone are not enough to stop these. Councilor Smith is the Director of the State Government's Joint Border Security Advisory Committee. He explained that without adding enough radar and patrol manpower, the fence became the best obstacle. Brewer's spokesman Matthew Benson said the governor supports the law. "Enforcement of the law is very involved, and it would be much easier if there were enough private donations." If federal land cannot be used, Smith said he will begin negotiations with private ranchers to ask them to allow the state to use their land. Smith said he doesn't have an exact budget yet, but the cost could be in the $50 million range. According to a 2009 U.S. government report, one mile of fencing costs $3 million. But Smith said the final cost to Arizona will depend on what kind of fence is used and whether the state gets donations from private companies. State lawmakers also said they would use inmate labor to reduce costs.

69bbdb87545dc5e6204fd6ee653d03ebd529fba6.sourceText: 凤凰城中心城区翻新工程启动 老早有人提议改造州府附近的街道，以作为 2012 年庆祝亚利桑那州成立 100 周年庆祝活动的基调。但随着那个纷扰多时的财政预算出台，两党为削减项目大吵大闹，如减无可减的教育和健康保健，百年庆典，显得渺小得多。 然而，亚利桑那加入联邦 100 周年怎么说也是件门面大事，至少对政客如是。本周二，州长等人出席奠基仪式，启动凤城中心城区街道翻新工程。本次翻新的工程将包括华盛顿街的人行道装饰，设立新的人行横道，自行车道等。其他项目包括修缮博物馆，收集一分硬币以支付清理旧州府大厦的铜园顶。
69bbdb87545dc5e6204fd6ee653d03ebd529fba6.translatedText: Renovation project in downtown Phoenix begins. Renovating the streets near the state capital has long been proposed as a keynote to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the founding of Arizona in 2012. But with the introduction of that troubled fiscal budget, the two parties are clamoring for cuts in programs, such as education and health care, which cannot be reduced. The centennial celebration looks much smaller. Yet the 100th anniversary of Arizona's admission to the Union is by no means a cosmetic event, at least for politicians. On Tuesday this week, the governor and others attended the groundbreaking ceremony to launch the street renovation project in central Fengcheng. The renovation project will include sidewalk decorations on Washington Street, the establishment of new crosswalks, bicycle lanes, etc. Other projects include renovating the museum and collecting pennies to pay for the cleaning of the copper roof of the old State House.

8314947c4ad0f60210dd69414b854c3b953a93db.sourceText: 2011年速算数学比赛, 让大人与小孩一起较劲（图） 亚省时报 小朋友的成长过程中包括一连串的成功与失败、骄傲与挫折，能从胜不骄、败不馁的道理中学习到每一次的挑战与竞赛皆是让自己能更茁壮与成熟，才能让小朋友了解到成功绝对不是偶然，而是努力以赴后的果实，更要让小朋友意识到比赛的结束只是现阶段挑战的完成且是下一次挑选的开始。 由美国心算联会 (U.S. Mental Math Federation) 主办的年度速算数学比赛，旨在于鼓励孩子学习，积极面对挑战，及累积考试经验，学习应试技巧。今年2011 Speedy Math Competition 于五月二十一日在Chandler 市的Tumbleweed Recreation Center举办且圆满结束。此项比赛不只是让许多小朋友每年期待，今年更有十二位家长报名参加，与小孩一起较劲。此项「速算数学」比赛已渐成了大人小孩一起来的较劲赛！当比赛开始后，只见个个聚精会神，有的运笔如飞，连每一个参赛的大人都全神贯注，丝毫不敢大意。主办单位表示，今年成人的参与其实除了有趣之外，比赛结果将会提供非常有意义的研究资料，对于数学教育将会有很好的启示。 此项比赛会受到如此欢迎，也要归功于许多热心单位及厂商大力赞助。主办单位要感谢Chandler 市政府、IQ 数学及语文学校、亚省时报、IKEA赞助，让每一位小朋友高高兴兴地抱着大包小包的奖品和奖杯或奖状回家。 本次参赛者依年龄分为四组：A组为六岁及以下，B组为九岁及以下，C组为十二岁及以下，D组开放给任何年龄。考试科目包括加减、乘算、及除算。在一连串的竞赛后，获奖者已由计算机统计准确而快速地于当天揭晓。 今年A组的Erica Jiang锐不可当，以高分囊括了冠军！Abigail Goon 与Yali Brown初试啼声，第一次参加便得了第三名。B组，竞争最激烈，Agustya Matheth成了B组的冠军，而Kevin Tang，Daniel Hsu与Siddharth Jagtap则占据第二名。高阶的C组再一次由Bronson Wu拿走大奖冠军，而Javen Ho，Enoch Chou与Victoria Lim则占据第二名。D组是Melody Yeh得第一，第二、三名则而Cindy Wu，Jacky Chen与Ester Cheng获得。 据记者深入了解，以上得奖者几乎全是在「IQ数学及语文学校」学习的学生，该校所培育出的学生计算能力快速且准确，且个个都是在校的资优模范生，自信而活泼，令人印象深刻。详细的比赛结果及照片请上网查询 http://www.USMentalMath.org/events 美国心算联会 (U.S. Mental Math Federation) 主办的「速算数学比赛」固定于每年四、五月左右举行，详情将会公布于亚省时报。 比赛进行中 ，参赛者一点点聚精会神地回答问题 小朋友们对于大会准备的数学脑力激荡题目非常有趣
8314947c4ad0f60210dd69414b854c3b953a93db.translatedText: The 2011 Speed Mathematics Competition allows adults and children to compete together (Picture) Alberta Times The growth process of children includes a series of successes and failures, pride and setbacks. From the principle of not being arrogant in victory and not being discouraged in defeat, children can learn that every challenge and competition is to make themselves stronger and more mature. Only then can children understand that success is definitely not an accident, but the fruit of hard work. Children should also realize that the end of the competition is only the completion of the current challenge and the beginning of the next choice. The annual speed mathematics competition organized by the U.S. Mental Math Federation aims to encourage children to learn, actively face challenges, accumulate test experience, and learn test-taking skills. This year's 2011 Speedy Math Competition was held on May 21st at the Tumbleweed Recreation Center in Chandler and concluded successfully. This competition is not only something that many children look forward to every year, but this year twelve parents also signed up to compete with their children. This "quick math" competition has gradually become a competition for adults and children alike! When the competition started, everyone was attentive and some were writing like flying. Even every adult participating in the competition was fully focused and did not dare to be careless at all. The organizer said that in addition to being interesting for adults to participate this year, the results of the competition will provide very meaningful research information and will have great inspiration for mathematics education. This competition is so popular thanks to the strong sponsorship from many enthusiastic organizations and manufacturers. The organizer would like to thank the Chandler Municipal Government, IQ Mathematics and Chinese School, the Alberta Times, and IKEA for sponsoring this event, allowing every child to go home happily holding bags of prizes, trophies, or certificates. This time the contestants are divided into four groups according to age: Group A is for six years old and below, Group B is for nine years and below, Group C is for twelve years and below, and Group D is open to any age. Test subjects include addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. After a series of competitions, the winners were accurately and quickly announced by computer statistics on the same day. Erica Jiang from Group A this year was unstoppable and won the championship with high scores! Abigail Goon and Yali Brown made their debut and came in third place on their first try. Group B was the most competitive. Agustya Matheth became the champion of Group B, while Kevin Tang, Daniel Hsu and Siddharth Jagtap occupied the second place. In the high-level Group C, Bronson Wu once again won the grand prize, while Javen Ho, Enoch Chou and Victoria Lim occupied the second place. In Group D, Melody Yeh won the first place, while Cindy Wu, Jacky Chen and Ester Cheng won the second and third places. According to the reporter's in-depth understanding, almost all of the above award winners are students studying at the "IQ Mathematics and Chinese School". The students cultivated by this school have fast and accurate calculation skills, and all of them are gifted model students in the school. They are confident and lively, which is impressive. For detailed competition results and photos, please check online at http://www.USMentalMath.org/events The "Speed ​​Mathematics Competition" organized by the U.S. Mental Math Federation is held regularly around April and May every year. Details will be announced in the Alberta Times. During the competition, the contestants answered the questions attentively. The children were very interested in the mathematical brainstorming questions prepared for the conference.

aa30ca2b0923676034a8a4c1694b76bb807173f6.translatedText: You will receive 25% less pension, and you will lose more if you are married, at 62. As many as 75 million post-war baby boomers have gradually entered the legal door to receive Social Security pensions at the age of 62...

c5fd54a5e968805db83ecd6141d935e84d5d7a15.sourceText: 62岁领退休金少25% 已婚亏更多 多达7500万的战后婴儿潮人口，相继迈入62岁法定可领取社安退休金的门坎。投资理财专家建议，最好工作至70岁才退休，以领取最高额社安退休金。之前若缺钱，可支领401(k)退休帐户存款，好过提早领取社安金。 财经网站Kiplinger.com最近推出如何可领到最多退休金教战守则，不建议当事人62岁即申领社安退休金。因为将导致比届龄退休的社安金少25%，已婚者的损失可能更多。至于70岁才退休者，每迟一年退休，退休金增加8%，外加生活成本指数调涨。 举例说，一名62岁男子若现在退休，每月可领取社安退休金1125元。但他若70岁才退休，每月可领1980元社安退休金，八年每月差额多达855元。社安金的计算方式以当事人退休前收入最高的35年为基准。某一年若没有收入，当年即以零计算，再除以35。 延迟申领社安退休金对已婚夫妇最有利。收入低的一方年满62岁即可申领，如果收入高的另一半也开始领社安退休金，收入低的一方年满66岁时还可选择申领另一 半50%的社安金。但收入较低的一方若未达66岁即领取配偶的社安金，配偶社安金会被调降。如果收入较低一方先拿自己的社安金，后来再改领配偶社安金，配偶社安金也会减少。 当事人若有退休金账户，更应延后领取社安退休金。因为退休账户里的钱不随通膨调涨，且59岁半即可动用，犯不着在62岁时急着拿社安退休金。再者，社安退休金享有对抗通膨的好处，因它会随着通膨逐年调升。 如果工作最后几年的收入会窜升，更应延后申领社安金。因为社安金计算方式为收入最高35年的平均值，那也代表延后退休社安金还会增加。 如果你申领社安金后仍在工作，多数专家更不建议提早申领社安退休金。因为社安署会扣下部分薪资做为社安金，变成倒扣。 根据2011年规定，已退休但仍工作的人，年收入若超过1万4160元上限，每赚两元即损失一元。举例来说，年收入若为3万元，62岁退休申领社安金 每月1500元，由于3万元年收入超过上限1万5840元，会被扣7920元社安金，配偶与未亡人社安金同样也会被倒扣7920元。 如你年满退休年龄才领社安金，那年生日那个月之前年收入超过3万7680元，每赚三元就损失一元。从生日当月之后，即不再倒扣。 如果你开始领社安金却又无预期地重回职场，应尽快让社安署知道。一旦个人所得税表显示当事人有收入，会引发社安金被削减，届时必须一次偿还超领的社安金，或日后社安金被倒扣。 因工作被倒扣的社安退休金并不会永远消失，当你年满退休年龄后社安署会补还给你。但若你62岁即申领社安金，损失的正常社安金却永远不会补发，这也是专家与社安署皆不鼓励提早领社安金的另一个原因。 如你年满退休年龄开始领社安金后又重回职场，可暂停领取社安金。比如你原先打算70岁申领退休金，但年满退休年龄之前即被裁员而开始领取社安金，等年满退休年龄又找到工作，你可暂停领取社安金。当70岁再申领时，社安金会根据原先减少的给付，逐年增加8%。
c5fd54a5e968805db83ecd6141d935e84d5d7a15.translatedText: Receive 25% less pension at 62, and you will lose more if you are married. As many as 75 million post-war baby boomers have reached the legal threshold of 62 years old to receive Social Security pensions. Investment and financial management experts suggest that it is best to work until the age of 70 before retiring in order to receive the maximum social security pension. If you are short of money before, you can withdraw your 401(k) retirement account savings, which is better than taking Social Security benefits early. The financial website Kiplinger.com recently launched a guide on how to receive the maximum pension, and does not recommend that individuals apply for Social Security pensions at the age of 62. Because it will result in Social Security benefits that are 25% less than the retirement age, married people may suffer more losses. For those who retire after the age of 70, their pension will increase by 8% for every year they retire, plus the cost of living index will increase. For example, if a 62-year-old man retires now, he can receive a monthly Social Security pension of $1,125. But if he retires at the age of 70, he will receive a monthly Social Security pension of 1,980 yuan, a monthly difference of as much as 855 yuan for eight years. Social Security benefits are calculated based on the highest 35 years of income before retirement. If there is no income in a certain year, it will be calculated as zero for that year and then divided by 35. Delaying claims for Social Security benefits is most beneficial to married couples. The lower-income spouse can apply for it when he or she reaches the age of 62. If the higher-income spouse also starts receiving social security pensions, the lower-income spouse can also choose to apply for 50% of the other half's social security pension when he reaches 66 years old. However, if the spouse with the lower income receives the spouse’s Social Security benefits before reaching the age of 66, the spouse’s Social Security benefits will be reduced. If the person with the lower income first takes his or her own Social Security benefit and later changes his or her spouse's Social Security benefit, the spouse's Social Security benefit will also be reduced. If the person concerned has a pension account, he should delay receiving his Social Security pension. Because the money in the retirement account does not increase with inflation and can be accessed at the age of 59 and a half, there is no need to rush to collect the Social Security pension at the age of 62. Furthermore, Social Security pension benefits have the benefit of fighting inflation because they will increase year by year with inflation. If your income will rise sharply in the last few years of your working life, you should delay applying for social security benefits. Because Social Security benefits are calculated based on the average of the highest 35 years of income, that also means that Social Security benefits will increase in delayed retirement. If you are still working after applying for Social Security benefits, most experts do not recommend applying for Social Security retirement benefits early. Because the Social Security Administration will withhold part of your salary as social security benefits, it becomes a deduction. Under the 2011 regulations, retired people who are still working and whose annual income exceeds the upper limit of $14,160 will lose one dollar for every two dollars they earn. For example, if the annual income is 30,000 yuan and the social security benefit for retirement at the age of 62 is 1,500 yuan per month, because the annual income of 30,000 yuan exceeds the upper limit of 15,840 yuan, the social security benefit will be deducted by 7,920 yuan, and the social security benefits of the spouse and widow will also be deducted by 7,920 yuan. If you receive Social Security benefits after reaching retirement age, and your annual income exceeds $37,680 before the month of your birthday that year, you will lose one dollar for every three dollars you earn. There will be no further deductions from the birthday month onwards. If you start receiving Social Security benefits and unexpectedly return to work, you should let the Social Security Administration know as soon as possible. Once the personal income tax form shows that the person has income, the social security benefit will be reduced. At that time, the overpaid social security benefit must be repaid in one go, or the social security benefit may be deducted in the future. The Social Security pension that has been deducted due to work will not disappear forever. The Social Security Administration will repay it to you when you reach retirement age. However, if you apply for Social Security benefits at age 62, the lost normal Social Security benefits will never be replaced. This is another reason why experts and the Social Security Administration do not encourage claiming Social Security benefits early. If you reach retirement age and start receiving Social Security benefits and then return to work, you can suspend receiving Social Security benefits. For example, if you originally planned to apply for a pension at the age of 70, but you were laid off before reaching retirement age and began to receive Social Security benefits, you can suspend receiving Social Security benefits when you reach retirement age and find a job. When you apply again at age 70, Social Security benefits will increase by 8% year by year based on the original reduced benefits.

9e3039fe273e1a8dec223fcd6b16d42ac33d1afe.sourceText: 查税问答:报税高于50万或低于1万5的家庭易被查 我最近收到国税局查税通知,我另一个朋友也收到,美国是不是最近查税很多?怎样的情形最容易被查 答:目前似乎有种驱势, 报税家庭年收入(Adjusted Gross Income)超过50万元或低于1万5000元而接受政府补助者，遭受稽查的比率已达历史新高。由于国库亏空，联邦、州、市均债台高筑，因此低收入带孩子家庭享受政府补助受到稽查的比率直线上升。在2010年(2009 年报税年度)，收入超过50万元的稽查比率比2009年提高21.4%，而年收入超过100万元的家庭(约占总人口比率的0.3%)遭受稽查的比率是年收入超过50万元家庭的2.5倍(8.36%)。国税局之所以会这样不遗余力，是因为查富人有利可图，2010年因加强稽查而增加的税收超过570亿元，比前一年增加18%。 另外政府的动向是严查1099表，不仅是散工1099表，而且扩展到一般拿公司佣金的1099表。政府对散工或佣金持有人的稽查比率，比W-2员工要高得多。 现在美国经济不景气,就像抓交通违规的罚款单也多了起来,总之不管哪种情况,大家还是奉公守法就不会出事
9e3039fe273e1a8dec223fcd6b16d42ac33d1afe.translatedText: Tax Inspection Questions and Answers: Families with tax returns higher than 500,000 or less than 15,000 are likely to be inspected. I recently received a tax audit notice from the Internal Revenue Service, and another friend of mine also received one. Are there a lot of tax audits in the United States recently? What kind of situations are most likely to be audited? Answer: There seems to be a trend at the moment. The rate of audits for those who file tax returns with an annual income (Adjusted Gross Income) of more than 500,000 yuan or less than 15,000 yuan and receive government subsidies has reached a record high. As the national treasury is in deficit and federal, state, and municipal debts are high, the rate at which low-income families with children receiving government subsidies are subject to audits has skyrocketed. In 2010 (tax filing year 2009), the audit rate for those with an annual income of more than 500,000 yuan increased by 21.4% compared with 2009. The audit rate for households with an annual income of more than 1 million yuan (about 0.3% of the total population) was 2.5 times (8.36%) that of households with an annual income of more than 500,000 yuan. The reason why the IRS spares no effort is because it is profitable to investigate the rich. In 2010, the tax revenue increased by more than 57 billion yuan due to strengthened inspections, an increase of 18% over the previous year. In addition, the government's trend is to strictly inspect the 1099 forms, not only the 1099 forms of casual workers, but also extended to the 1099 forms of general company commissions. Government audit rates are much higher for casual workers or commission holders than for W-2 workers. Now that the U.S. economy is in recession, there are more and more fines for traffic violations. In short, no matter what the situation is, if everyone just abides by the law, nothing will happen.
