907dc7b3be13525d364bff8b1234fc8a1eda6548.sourceText: 一群试图由墨西哥进入美国的移民在夜晚穿越本州岛南部沙漠向北前行时，其中一人的手机收到了一条短讯：” 小心，前面有危险，躲到树丛中。” 《纽约时报》报导，这条短讯意思是前面出现了边境巡逻队员，必须小心防范。短讯是由通过望远镜查看这群人的踪影的人口走私犯发出的，他正躲在墨西哥与美国交界的边境线的山坡上。边境官员和移民活动人士说，这是非法穿越边境的新型趋势，利用” 网络土狼” （ cybercoyote ）进行人口走私。 官员说，边境加强执法使入境美国更为困难。而行动中抓到的惯犯通常会受到重判，这使人口走私犯更为警惕，使用手机以避开抓捕成为新趋势。 活动人士和边境巡逻员称，在一群非法移民穿越边境时可能有向导伴随。这些向导与同谋保持无线电联络，他们发出前面有危险的警告。但边境巡逻队图桑办公室发言人埃斯卡兰特说，边境巡逻队留意到已有移民独自穿越边境，但与向导保持手机联系。 手机在墨西哥非常普及﹔很多移民认为手机以及坚固的鞋子和水瓶都是穿越边境时的必需工具。而现在，手机除了是与家人通报现状的工具外，一些非法移民还依靠它们躲避当局的搜捕。 这些短讯通常在移民向北前行的第一个小时左右发出。如果能安全抵达那里，非法移民随后就在美国一侧的边境线与另一边向导会合，向导会帮助他们再向北前行到等待的车辆那里。 有很多人参与这一过程，他们在瞭望点监控南亚利桑那州的沙漠，帮助引导移民并警告避开当局的检查。 资深边境巡逻员说，走私犯不断地创新手法来避开当局。 ” 他们经常发明聪明的新办法来躲避我们。” 全国边境巡逻委员会前任会长邦那说。 这群 13 个人的非法移民在周二晚出发前往亚利桑那，他们发现这套手机监控系统有着严重的局限性。 这群人被向导带往皮马郡的一个偏远的边境区，向导匆匆记下他们的手机号，并指导他们如何能把手机服务从墨西哥的 Telcel 电讯公司转到美国的 AT&T 。 这些移民说，穿越边境的费用为 2000 至 3500 美元，一些人已预先付款，还有些人付了一部份，在穿越边境后再付余额。 一名向导帮助他们爬过诺加利斯西面几英里处的边境围栏，随后引导他们通过一条破旧的小路往北面的谢拉维斯塔（ Sierra Vista ）前行。在接下来的一个小时还会有短讯来指导他们如何做。 但在最后一个短讯警告他们前面有危险后，他们被边境巡逻员发现，被带到拘留所，随后被递解出境。 处于困境中的移民也可用手机寻求帮助。在去年的一个例子中，边境巡逻员的搜救队收到了一个来自南加州山区的 911 电话。队员在直升机中看见手机上的微弱灯光，找到了一名无法行走的移民。当然，手机不仅帮助移民穿越边境，也帮助巡逻人员搜捕他们。 2010 年一名牧场主在边境被杀害的案件引起全美国瞩目，至今仍未侦破。 1 月 8 日被枪击受伤的众议员吉福德曾推动提高手机在该地区的覆盖率。在她受伤后，另一名众议员特德．珀提出立法，利用联邦拨款帮助加强边境线的通讯。
907dc7b3be13525d364bff8b1234fc8a1eda6548.translatedText: When a group of immigrants trying to enter the United States from Mexico walked north through the desert in the southern part of Honshu Island at night, one of them received a text message on his mobile phone: " Be careful, there is danger ahead, hide in the bushes.” The New York Times reported that this message meant that there were Border Patrol agents ahead and you must be careful. The message was sent by a people smuggler who was looking through binoculars to see if the group was hiding on a hillside along the Mexican-U.S. border. Border officials and immigration activists say this is a new trend in people crossing the border illegally, using "cybercoyotes" for human smuggling. Officials say increased border enforcement is making it more difficult to enter the United States. Repeat offenders caught during operations usually receive heavy sentences, which makes human smugglers more vigilant. Using mobile phones to avoid capture has become a new trend. Activists and Border Patrol agents say a group of illegal immigrants may be accompanied by a guide as they cross the border. The guides maintained radio contact with their accomplices, who issued warnings of danger ahead. But Escalante, spokesman for the Border Patrol's Tucson office, said the Border Patrol is aware of migrants crossing the border alone but maintaining cellphone contact with their guides. Cell phones are ubiquitous in Mexico; many migrants consider them essential tools for crossing the border, along with sturdy shoes and a water bottle. Now, in addition to being a tool for communicating with family members, some illegal immigrants also rely on mobile phones to evade authorities. The text messages are usually sent during the first hour or so of migrants' journey north. If they can get there safely, illegal immigrants then meet guides on the U.S. side of the border who help them travel further north to waiting vehicles. Many people are involved in the process, monitoring the southern Arizona desert from lookout points, helping to guide migrants and warn against detection by authorities. Veteran Border Patrol agents say smugglers are constantly inventing new ways to evade authorities. "They're constantly inventing clever new ways to evade us," said Bonner, the former president of the National Border Patrol Council. The group of 13 illegal immigrants who set out for Arizona on Tuesday night discovered that the cellphone surveillance system had serious limitations. The group was taken to a remote border area in Pima County by a guide who jotted down their cellphone numbers and instructed them on how to switch their service from Telcel in Mexico to AT&T in the United States. The migrants said it costs $2,000 to $3,500 to cross the border, with some paying up front and others paying part and paying the balance after crossing. A guide helped them climb a border fence a few miles west of Nogales, then guided them north through a well-worn path to Sierra Vista. There will also be text messages over the next hour instructing them on what to do. But after a final text message warned them of danger ahead, they were spotted by Border Patrol agents, taken to a detention facility and then deported. Migrants in distress can also use their mobile phones to seek help. In one instance last year, a Border Patrol search and rescue team received a 911 call from the mountains of Southern California. The team members saw the faint light on a mobile phone in the helicopter and found a migrant who was unable to walk. Of course, cellphones not only help migrants cross the border but also help patrols hunt for them. The 2010 murder of a rancher at the border captured national attention and remains unsolved. Rep. Giffords, who was shot and wounded on Jan. 8, had pushed for increased cellphone coverage in the district. After she was injured, another Congressman, Ted. Pere introduced legislation to use federal funding to help strengthen communications along the border.

f208703729234eb9d403a132d70cce31270d359f.sourceText: 美国公民及移民局（ USCIS ）最近修改了雇主雇用外国工人的某些工作申请规定。其中一个修改是除了表格 I – 129 外，还需一个认证要求。该认证的目的是为了防止未经授权的释放敏感技术、技术数据和软件给外国公民，以免对国家安全和外交政策产生不良影响。此举使得在美持 H 、 L 和 O 类的外国学生学者多了一道安全检查程序，所有大学、研究机构、公司等都必须遵守。 去年 12 月 USCIS 要求为外籍雇员申请 H, 、 L 和 O 类非移民工作签证的雇主，需要对该雇员可以接触敏感技术资料进行认证，并于 2011 年 2 月 10 日生效。根据《出口管理条例》（ Export Administration Regulations ）和《国际武器贸易条例》（ International Traffic in Arms Regulations ），雇用外籍工人的雇主不得不应对复杂的认证手续。 根据《出口管理条例》，在美国允许外国公民接触敏感技术或技术数据 被视为 要将此类货物出口到该外国公民的母国，这需要许可证后才可放行。同样，《国际武器贸易条例》在军火清单中也有关于管制的国防物品或技术数据出口需要许可证的规定。 新附加的认证，要求公司表明它已阅读了《出口管理条例》和《国际武器贸易条例》，并决定（ i ）该外国工人不需要发放技术或技术数据出口许可，或（ ii ）需要许可。但公司在得到许可前将防止该外国公民访问这些信息。不遵守出口法律造成的后果可能是很严重的，包括每个案例高达 50 万美元的民事罚款，高达 100 万美元的刑事罚款和最多 10 年的徒刑，不给出口特许和不给政府合同等处罚。 对于视同于出口许可证的的认证，根据工作申请表的完整性，该外籍工人的背景检查和以前的记录，许可证的平均申请时间约为 40 天。超过 40 天的，可以致电商业部热线查询。
f208703729234eb9d403a132d70cce31270d359f.translatedText: The United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) has recently revised certain job application regulations for employers to hire foreign workers. One of the modifications is a certification requirement in addition to Form I – 129. The purpose of this certification is to prevent the unauthorized release of sensitive technology, technical data and software to foreign citizens, so as to avoid adverse effects on national security and foreign policy. This move adds an additional security check procedure for foreign students and scholars holding H, L and O categories in the United States, which all universities, research institutions, companies, etc. must comply with. Last December, USCIS required employers applying for H, L, and O nonimmigrant work visas for foreign employees to certify that the employees have access to sensitive technical information, effective February 10, 2011. Under the Export Administration Regulations and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations, employers hiring foreign workers have to deal with complex certification procedures. Under the Export Administration Regulations, allowing a foreign citizen to have access to sensitive technology or technical data in the United States is considered an export of such goods to the foreign citizen's home country, which requires a license. Similarly, the International Traffic in Arms Regulations also has provisions in the arms list regarding the need for licenses for the export of controlled defense articles or technical data. The new additional certification requires a company to show that it has read the Export Administration Regulations and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations and determined that (i) the foreign worker does not need to be issued a license to export technology or technical data, or (ii) a license is required. But the company will prevent the foreign national from accessing the information until permission is obtained. The consequences of failure to comply with export laws can be severe, including civil fines of up to $500,000 per case, criminal fines of up to $1 million and up to 10 years in prison, denial of export licenses and denial of government contracts, among other penalties. For certification equivalent to an export license, the average application time for a license is approximately 40 days, based on the completeness of the job application form, background check and previous record of the foreign worker. If it exceeds 40 days, you can call the Ministry of Commerce hotline to inquire.

d2d6b3b1f21b59a5ad286aec2d5ec40a39eb9f25.sourceText: 出口要求 分析和决定是否需要认证是复杂和繁琐的。它首先要决定外国公民将会接触到的技术类型或技术数据。这需要与公司了解该产品设计和用途的官员，以及熟悉软件应用的信息技术人员咨询。 其次，公司必须决定这些技术或技术数据将用于出口用途的划分。首先考虑的是该产品是否在美国商务部工业和安全管理局（ US Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security ）下发的美国商务部控制 ​​ 清单上。该产品的技术特点和产品功能决定了该产品是否属于受管制的的 10 类产品之一（例如，信息安全是其中一类），以及产品是否具有出口控制分类编号（ Export Control Classification Number ），该编号描述了被控制产品及任何相关的出口限制的技术特征。如果一个产品属于列表中的管制产品，那么公司必须考虑该外国工人的国籍。可到商务部查询此类信息，以确定出口该产品是否需要许可证。 美国国务院国防贸易管理局颁布的《国际武器贸易条例》军火技术列表上的产品指定为控制军需物品，均需许可证。
d2d6b3b1f21b59a5ad286aec2d5ec40a39eb9f25.translatedText: Export Requirements Analysis and decision whether certification is required is complex and cumbersome. It begins with determining the type of technology or technical data that foreign citizens will be exposed to. This requires consultation with company officials who understand the design and use of the product, as well as information technology personnel familiar with software applications. Second, the company must decide how the technology or technical data will be exported. The first consideration is whether the product is on the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Control List issued by the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security. The technical characteristics and product functions of the product determine whether the product belongs to one of the 10 categories of controlled products (for example, information security is one of the categories), and whether the product has an Export Control Classification Number (Export Control Classification Number), which describes the technical characteristics of the controlled product and any related export restrictions. If a product is on the list of controlled products, the company must consider the nationality of the foreign worker. This information can be obtained from the Ministry of Commerce to determine whether a license is required to export the product. Products on the arms technology list of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations promulgated by the U.S. Department of State’s Defense Trade Administration are designated as controlled munitions items and require a license.

df45e42f7d59817404daeae8e0d19e2f5742c3dc.sourceText: 注意事项 虽然大多数技术不属于出口控制产品，但公司应进行分析，以确认该外国公民不需要许可证。对参与研究和开发工作中会接触到技术、数据或软件的外籍员工，外国学生和学者的情况应仔细检查。需要向国外技术转让许可证的技术往往是军民两用的技术，并涉及到关键控制领域，如国家安全、核扩散、导弹技术、化学和生物战。 ” 公开” 的技术不属于《出口管理条例》和《国际武器贸易条例》的限制。这些包括已经出版或将予以公布的技术和软件，但加密的软件和产品控制技术除外。 如有疑问，可浏览美国商务部网站 www.bis.doc.gov ，其中有对申请许可证或产品分类的分步说明。此外，美国商务部工业和安全管理局提供出口管理顾问指导。联系电话： 202-482-4811 或 949-660-0144 。
df45e42f7d59817404daeae8e0d19e2f5742c3dc.translatedText: Considerations While most technologies are not export-controlled products, companies should conduct an analysis to confirm that the foreign national does not require a license. The situation of foreign employees, foreign students and academics involved in research and development work that involves exposure to technology, data or software should be carefully scrutinized. Technologies that require technology transfer licenses to foreign countries are often dual-use technologies and involve key areas of control, such as national security, nuclear proliferation, missile technology, chemical and biological warfare. "Public" technology is not subject to the Export Administration Regulations and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations. These include technology and software that have been published or will be published, except for encrypted software and product control technology. If you have questions, you can visit the U.S. Department of Commerce website at www.bis.doc.gov, which provides step-by-step instructions for applying for a license or product classification. In addition, the U.S. Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security provides export management advisory guidance. Contact number: 202-482-4811 or 949-660-0144.

53c024e9c40a4022fdbe2ce81173ab2a8560c01d.translatedText: Swiss Jet Man challenges to fly over the Grand Canyon Yves Rossy, a Swiss explorer who is known as "Jet Man"...

b5ec27588e1ac79fd8ccc0f8f93bda6373beae34.sourceText: 瑞士喷射人 挑战飞越美大峡谷 享有” 喷射人” （ Jet Man ）称号的瑞士探险家罗西（ Yves Rossy ） 5 月 6 日挑战飞越大峡谷，成为美国史上第一人。 3 年前他也曾跨越英、法之间的英吉利海峡，飞出世界纪录。 罗西在举世知名的美国地标大峡谷上空跳下直升机，仅靠装了翅膀的喷射推进器表演空中翻跟斗，再按照计划降落。 和 2008 年从法国飞到英国的不同之处在于，现年 51 岁的罗西不光只是从大峡谷的一端飞到另外一端，而是在飞越大峡谷的同时，花 15 分钟耍空中杂技。他去年 11 月在瑞士的佛德（ Vaud ）峡谷玩过类似花招。 罗西将在当地时间上午 9 时，从大峡谷西侧蝙蝠洞（ Guano Point ）之上的 1300 公尺高空处跳下直升机，翻几个跟斗之后以降落伞着地。
b5ec27588e1ac79fd8ccc0f8f93bda6373beae34.translatedText: Swiss Jet Man challenges to fly over the Grand Canyon Yves Rossy, a Swiss explorer who is known as "Jet Man" May 6 Japan challenged to fly over the Grand Canyon and became the first person in American history. Three years ago he also crossed the English Channel between England and France, setting a world record. Rossi jumped out of a helicopter over the Grand Canyon, a world-famous American landmark, performed somersaults in the air using only jet thrusters equipped with wings, and then landed as planned. The difference from flying from France to England in 2008 is that the 51-year-old Rossi didn't just fly from one end of the Grand Canyon to the other, but spent 15 minutes performing aerial acrobatics while flying over the Grand Canyon. He pulled a similar trick last November in the Vaud Gorge in Switzerland. Rossi will jump out of a helicopter at an altitude of 1,300 meters above Guano Point on the west side of the Grand Canyon at 9 a.m. local time, do some somersaults and then land with a parachute.

15ff9cda9888c67cc1e3b9d7c909f33af5d8c958.sourceText: 沙门氏菌污染美数十州召回西红柿及色拉 佛罗里达州的一家西红柿种植公司在沙门氏菌测试显示阳性后，主动召回卖出的葡萄西红柿（ grape tomatoe ）。截至 4 月 29 日，该公司尚未发现与此次召回有关的生病报告。 这家名为 Six L’s Packing 的西红柿公司表示，被召回的产品是在 4 月 11 日包装，包装代码是 DW-H 。这些西红柿卖到加州、北卡、南卡、阿拉巴马、佛罗里达、新泽西、纽约、密歇根、宾夕法尼亚和乔治亚等州，甚至外销至加拿大。 据悉，沙门氏菌感染是由一名纽约州美国农业部检查员发现的。被污染的西红柿源于佛州的一个农场。 加州特雷西（ Tracy ）市的泰勒农场太平洋公司（ Taylor Farms Pacific ）用这些西红柿制作熟食色拉。该公司已于周一召回这些色拉产品。 这些色拉被包装在塑料盒中，在整个美西和部分中西部州的艾伯森（ Albertsons ）、 雷利（ Raley’s ）、 Safeway 、 Savemart 、山姆会员店（ Sam’s Club ）和沃尔玛等超级市场的熟食柜台售出。 受影响的州包括亚利桑那、俄勒冈、加利福尼亚、内华达、华盛顿、新墨西哥、爱达荷、蒙大拿、内布拉斯加、南达科他、怀俄明、科罗拉多和犹他等州。该公司要求客户退还召回的产品到购买原地以取得退款。 沙门氏菌会导致年幼的孩子、老人和免疫力较弱的人生病，有时甚至会致命。感染症状包括发烧、腹泻、恶心、呕吐和腹痛。
15ff9cda9888c67cc1e3b9d7c909f33af5d8c958.translatedText: Dozens of U.S. states recalled tomatoes and salad due to salmonella contamination. A tomato growing company in Florida voluntarily recalled the grape tomatoes it sold after testing positive for salmonella. ). As of April 29, the company was aware of no reports of illnesses related to the recall. The tomato company, Six L’s Packing, said the recalled products were packaged on April 11 and have a packaging code of DW-H. These tomatoes are sold to California, North Carolina, South Carolina, Alabama, Florida, New Jersey, New York, Michigan, Pennsylvania and Georgia, and even exported to Canada. It is reported that the salmonella infection was discovered by a New York State USDA inspector. The contaminated tomatoes originated from a farm in Florida. Taylor Farms Pacific in Tracy, Calif., uses the tomatoes to make deli salads. The company recalled the salad products on Monday. The salads are packaged in plastic boxes and sold at deli counters at supermarkets such as Albertsons, Raley’s, Safeway, Savemart, Sam’s Club and Walmart throughout the Western United States and some Midwestern states. Affected states include Arizona, Oregon, California, Nevada, Washington, New Mexico, Idaho, Montana, Nebraska, South Dakota, Wyoming, Colorado and Utah. The company is asking customers to return recalled products to the place of purchase for a refund. Salmonella can make young children, the elderly and people with weakened immune systems sick and sometimes fatal. Symptoms of infection include fever, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting and abdominal pain.

5472f9912975e2a257a0a2daebc9a18ff53a1d9e.sourceText: 联邦140万美元建房援助无家可归者 马里科巴郡政府近日获得联邦政府三项拨款，共 140 万美元，为无家可归人群兴建住房。 这些拨款来自联邦住房和城市发展部。郡政府说，这笔钱将提供 52 个单位给本地区无家可归者的永久住房。总体而言，联邦将提供超过 2.19 亿美元给马利科巴郡，通过建造过渡住房，永久性住房等 56 个项目使无家可归者回归正常家庭生活。
5472f9912975e2a257a0a2daebc9a18ff53a1d9e.translatedText: > Federal $1.4 million to build housing to aid the homeless The Maricopa County Government recently received three federal grants, totaling $1.4 million, to build housing for the homeless. The grants come from the federal Department of Housing and Urban Development. The money will provide 52 units of permanent housing for the region's homeless, the county said. Overall, the federal government will provide more than $219 million to Maricopa County to help homeless people return to normal family life through the construction of transitional housing, permanent housing and other 56 projects.

7d9fe89dd704f76bc33bfda09bfa71da67d4a16d.sourceText: 美短缺211种药物 病患治疗风险大增 在美国，目前医疗药品短缺的问题很严重，医生、医院和联邦监管机构不得不设法解决这个问题，以免危害癌症、心脏病、事故幸存者等病患的生命安全。 《华盛顿邮报》近期报导，在 2010 年，共有 211 种药物奇缺，种类为 2006 年的三倍，而且在今年三月底，至少又有 89 个新药短缺，更让全美药物缺乏的问题雪上加霜。 由于药物缺乏，一些医疗中心已被迫进行药物配给 ( 例如白血病患者迫切需要的药品 ) 、延迟手术、使用其他替代照顾，或采用替代品。不过，替代品可能不太有效，或有更多的副作用，反而可能提高用药过量的风险，有时可能还造成致命的错误。 美国麻醉医师学会会长马克．华纳描述说，在过去一年里，因药物短缺而导致了两个灾难事件。其一是一名 16 岁男孩的大脑受到了损伤，原因是医生在处理复杂的下颚手术时，没有所需的肌肉放松药物。另一件是，一名中年女子成了永久性的植物人，原因是她在经历复杂的心脏手术之后，医生没有肾上腺素的药物。 在处理突发事件时，医生和护士浪费了许多宝贵时间，因为他们必须使用不熟悉的替代品或重新计算药剂量，如此增加了可能过量或药量不足的机会。最大的问题之一是，缺少一个预先准备好的定量注射器。 许多医院都重新调整电子药物的给药系统，或者提前准备有正确剂量的，以便用于急诊室，尽量减少失误。不过，报导中还是出现了相当多的错误和虚惊事件，当事者包括一些急需紧急医治才能得救的病患。 据报导，因为缺乏吗啡，至少有两名病患者，因使用了过量的氢吗啡酮而死亡。今年在亚拉巴马州，由于药物缺乏，至少有 19 件造成病情加重，以及九人死亡的案例。起因是他用了一新的替代用的喂食管，但却受到了细菌污染。 短缺的药物中，许多是行之多年且便宜的处方药，它的利润较低，导致许多公司停止生产。多数这些药物是” 无菌注射” 药物，生产程比复杂，因此更容易造成问题。此外，制药公司越来越依靠从其他国家进口原料，也是容易造成短缺的一个原因。 受影响的药物，许多是医疗保健上用的止痛药，如吗啡、去甲肾上腺素等急诊室常用的药物，以及常用于加护室病人的电解质。此外，许多不同类别的药物也都短缺，包括抗生素和许多癌症的药物，导致肿瘤学家不得不推迟或改变已悉心排定了的化疗时间。 不相同的药物，有不同的短缺原因，但专家们举出了一系列共同因素：在制药行业整合之后，能生产低利润旧药的厂家已经很少了，也就是说，当原材料短缺时，只要设备发生故障或政府监管机进行取缔，都可能造成短缺的问题恶化。 去年，美国食品和药物管理局 (FDA) 允许外国进口短缺的麻醉用异丙酚。今年，该局又批准引进一些其他药物，其中包括两种癌症的用药。 国会目前已开始立法，试图解决药品短缺的问题。例如，法案将要求制药公司必须事先通知美国食品和药物管理局 (FDA) 任何可能导致短缺的原因，并给予该局新增的权力，以便设法纾解短缺的困境。
7d9fe89dd704f76bc33bfda09bfa71da67d4a16d.translatedText: There is a shortage of 211 drugs in the United States, which greatly increases the risk of patient treatment. The current shortage of medical drugs in the United States is so severe that doctors, hospitals and federal regulators are having to grapple with it before jeopardizing the lives of patients with cancer, heart disease, accident survivors and more. The Washington Post recently reported that in 2010, a total of 211 drugs were in short supply, three times the number in 2006. At the end of March this year, at least 89 new drugs were in short supply, making the problem of drug shortages even worse across the United States. Due to lack of drugs, some medical centers have been forced to ration drugs (such as those desperately needed by leukemia patients), delay surgeries, use other alternative care, or use substitutes. However, alternatives may be less effective or have more side effects, which may increase the risk of overdose and sometimes lead to fatal errors. Mark., President of the American Society of Anesthesiologists. Warner described two catastrophic events over the past year as a result of drug shortages. In one, a 16-year-old boy suffered brain damage because doctors did not have the muscle-relaxing medication they needed while performing complex jaw surgery. In another case, a middle-aged woman became a permanent vegetative state because her doctors did not have access to epinephrine medication after undergoing complex heart surgery. Doctors and nurses waste valuable time when dealing with emergencies because they have to use unfamiliar substitutes or recalculate medication doses, thus increasing the chance of a possible overdose or underdosing. One of the biggest problems is the lack of a pre-prepared dosing syringe. Many hospitals are retooling electronic drug delivery systems or preparing correct doses in advance for emergency room use to minimize errors. However, there were still quite a few errors and false alarms in the reports, including some patients who were in urgent need of emergency treatment. According to reports, at least two patients died from overdoses of hydromorphone due to a lack of morphine. In Alabama this year, there have been at least 19 cases of illness worsening and nine deaths due to a lack of medication. The cause was that he was using a new replacement feeding tube, which became contaminated with bacteria. Many of the drugs in shortage are long-established, cheaper prescription drugs that are less profitable, causing many companies to halt production. Most of these drugs are "sterile injectable" drugs, and the production process is more complicated, so they are more likely to cause problems. In addition, pharmaceutical companies increasingly rely on imported raw materials from other countries, which is also a reason for shortages. Many of the affected drugs are painkillers used in health care, such as morphine, norepinephrine and other drugs commonly used in emergency rooms, as well as electrolytes commonly used in intensive care unit patients. Additionally, there are shortages of many different classes of drugs, including antibiotics and many cancer drugs, causing oncologists to postpone or change carefully scheduled chemotherapy treatments. Different drugs have different reasons for shortages, but experts cite a series of common factors: After the consolidation of the pharmaceutical industry, there are few manufacturers that can produce low-profit old drugs. That is to say, when raw materials are in short supply, as long as equipment fails or government regulators clamp down, the shortage problem may worsen. Last year, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) allowed foreign countries to import shortages of propofol for anesthesia. This year, the agency approved the introduction of a number of other drugs, including two cancer treatments. Congress has now begun legislation to try to address drug shortages. For example, the bill would require pharmaceutical companies to notify the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in advance of any possible causes of shortages and give the agency new powers to try to alleviate shortages.

4dbb63aefdba2349dde0c86dd2be970b846b8ae3.sourceText: 5月22日亚省华联大选拉开帷幕 2011年5月22日（星期天）下午2时到4时，亚省华人华侨联合总会（华联）将在钱德勒市图书馆库珀房间举行华联会员年度大会。本次大会的重要议题就是华联将换届选举。 华联会员将有权参加本次大会的选举活动。他们将根据华联的工作总则，选举产生华联的新主席。主要程序如下，首先是会员提名候选名单，第二介绍候选人的基本情况，选出三个选举监督员。第四唱票，签字确认选举结果 第五公布选举结果，新主席的自我介绍，第五新董事会任命选举出 的华联新主席。华联是亚利桑那州华人都很关心的一个社团，他们的变化牵动着很多华人的心，除了本次选举外，在会议上华联主席陶世诚将就本年度的工作向所有会员做一个汇报，同时财务也将华联的财务状况做汇报。 会议时间： 2011年5月22日（星期天）下午2时到4时 会议地点： Chandler Downtown Library Copper Room (2nd Floor) 22 S Delaware St, Chandler, AZ 85225 http://www.chandlerlibrary.org/contacts.htm
4dbb63aefdba2349dde0c86dd2be970b846b8ae3.translatedText: On May 22, the provincial Hualian general election kicked off On May 22, 2011 (Sunday) from 2:00 pm to 4:00 pm, the Overseas Chinese Federation of Alberta (Hualian) will hold the annual general meeting of Hualien members in the Cooper Room of the Chandler City Library. The important topic of this conference is the general election of Hualien. Hualian members will have the right to participate in the election activities of this conference. They will elect a new chairman of the Hualian based on the general working principles of the Hualian. The main procedures are as follows. The first is for members to nominate a candidate list. The second is to introduce the basic information of the candidates and select three election supervisors. The fourth is to count votes and sign to confirm the election results. The fifth is to announce the election results, introduce the self of the new chairman, and the fifth is to appoint the new chairman of Hualian elected by the new board of directors. Hualian is a society that Chinese people in Arizona are very concerned about. Their changes have affected the hearts of many Chinese. In addition to this election, at the meeting, Hualian Chairman Tao Shicheng will make a report to all members on this year's work. At the same time, the finance department will also report on Hualian's financial status. Meeting time: May 22, 2011 (Sunday) 2:00 pm to 4:00 pm Meeting location: Chandler Downtown Library Copper Room (2nd Floor) 22 S Delaware St, Chandler, AZ 85225 http://www.chandlerlibrary.org/contacts.htm

5734bf9fbbaa483a47150dbe5cbb4b09f6e78fd8.sourceText: 低保金被挥霍在娱乐场所 本地一家电视台长达四个月的追踪调查表明，部分领取政府低收入保障金的人，有可能把钱花在纹身店，酒水铺，脱衣舞俱乐部，甚至赌场。政府根据调查结果正着手改革这个漏洞。 亚利桑那州有19000个家庭接受联邦政府为低收入家庭提供的临时援助计划（TANF,俗称低保金）。根据规定，低保金用于基本生活开支，如支付房租、食品、水电费、公共交通、基本服装、尿布、个人护理和卫生用品。政府每月将低保金转账到领取人的ATM卡。 ABC15电视台从去年10月开始跟踪调查，发现至少100次的低保金领取卡在酒水铺交易。2010年11月，尤马一个酒水铺接受低保金卡交易超过一千二百美元。2010年12月，坦佩脱衣舞俱乐部，祖桑的性用品店自动提款机都有低保卡交易的记录。超过五千七百美元在钱特勒的赌场提款机提取。甚至还有人在拉斯维加斯和夏威夷用低保卡结账。 虽然，自动提款机有存款的功能，但在娱乐场所的自动提款机交易，未免令人匪夷所思。以上种种表明，纳税人的钱某些不法之人被挥霍在花天酒地。 亚省社安部对此表示无法控制。亚省社安部低保金计划主管卡特说，低保金转账到领取人的卡里，没有规定哪些提款机可用，哪些提款机不可用，更没有一个完善监督制度。有议员提议进一步严格审核低保申请人资格为首要目标。
5734bf9fbbaa483a47150dbe5cbb4b09f6e78fd8.translatedText: The subsistence allowance is squandered in entertainment venues. A four-month follow-up investigation by a local TV station showed that some people receiving government low-income security payments may spend their money at tattoo parlors, liquor stores, strip clubs and even casinos. The government is moving to reform the loophole based on the findings. There are 19,000 families in Arizona receiving the federal government's Temporary Assistance for Low-income Families program (TANF, commonly known as Dilima). According to regulations, the subsistence allowance is used for basic living expenses, such as paying rent, food, utility bills, public transportation, basic clothing, diapers, personal care and hygiene products. The government transfers the subsistence allowance to the recipient's ATM card every month. ABC15 TV station started a follow-up investigation in October last year and found that at least 100 minimum living security payment cards were traded at liquor stores. In November 2010, a liquor store in Yuma accepted transactions for more than $1,200 in minimum guarantee gold cards. In December 2010, ATMs at Tempe strip clubs and Zusan's sex shop all had records of subsistence card transactions. More than $5,700 was withdrawn from a casino cash machine in Chandler. There are even people using low-security cards to pay in Las Vegas and Hawaii. Although ATMs have the function of depositing money, transactions at ATMs in entertainment venues are somewhat bizarre. All the above show that taxpayers' money is being squandered by some unscrupulous people. Alberta Social Security says it has no control over this. Carter, director of the subsistence allowance program of the Alberta Department of Social Security, said that when the subsistence allowance is transferred to the recipient's card, there is no regulation on which ATMs are available and which are not, and there is no perfect supervision system. Some members proposed that further strict review of the qualifications of minimum living allowance applicants should be the primary goal.

c6b36b3523946b50256a64ad486241d2cbf91a15.sourceText: 新领养法引发争议 亚利桑那州最近通过一项限制同性恋领养的法律，使同性恋领养问题再次成为人们关注和辩论的议题之一。 布鲁尔州长最近签署了一项法律，使已婚夫妇在由州政府安排的领养方面比单身具有决胜优先权。根据这项法律，在所有其它条件平等的情况下，领养机构必须给予已婚夫妇领养的优先权。州政府还将把孩子交由亲属领养的可能性，预期领养家庭能否满足孩子的需要以及12岁以上孩子的个人意愿等因素考虑在内。 同性恋权益组织”亚利桑那平等”公共关系主任山姆霍尔尊批评说，这个法律对同性伴侣和未婚者构成了歧视，而且拉长了在州政府监护下暂时寄养在一个家庭中的孩子等待永久领养的时间。 霍尔尊说：”我们的州长和州议会因为推动这个领养政策，而把政治置于孩子的最佳利益之上，这个法律除了设置障碍和产生一种寒蝉效应，不让单身和同性伴侣领养孩子之外，没有产生任何好的效果。有很多孩子等待被关爱他们的家庭领养，但却没有足够的领养和寄养父母给他们。因此，没有理由再通过一个设置领养障碍的法律。” 但是，保守派组织”妇女关心美国”的主席温迪·莱特指出，历史、常识以及科学研究都显示，孩子在一个有父母的家庭中发育最佳，而来自单亲和破碎家庭的孩子往往有学业和行为等各种问题。莱特分析了亚利桑那州通过这项法律的原因。 莱特说：”社会工作者有时会把个人的喜好或政治压力作为优先考虑的因素。美国同性恋活动人士在政治上非常强大。在允许同性恋婚姻的麻萨诸塞州，出现过社会工作者给予同性配偶，而不是异性配偶领养优先权的情况。领养机构仅仅因为政治上的压力，就不顾寄养父母的意愿，而把寄养在他们家庭中的孩子抓去送给同性配偶领养。” 福克斯广播公司的报导说，亚利桑那州不是美国唯一对同性恋领养实施限制的州。密西西 比州和犹它州同样给予已婚夫妇优先权，禁止未婚伴侣领养孩子。北达科它州允许领养机构基于宗教或道德原因拒绝同性恋领养。佛罗里达州一直禁止同性恋领养孩子，直到去年一个法庭推翻了这方面的法律为止。阿肯色州也一直禁止未婚伴侣领养，但该州最高法院四月推翻了这个法律。 福克斯广播公司的新闻报导还介绍说，前不久，伊利诺伊州一个参议院委员会否决了一项议案。该议案允许宗教组织拒绝同性恋伴侣领养孩子，并拒绝向他们提供寄养服务。不过，最近几年，禁止同性恋伴侣领养的法律在田纳西、肯塔基和俄亥俄等州都没有成功。根据同性恋组织估计，由同性恋扶养的孩子在美国预计大约有25万人。
c6b36b3523946b50256a64ad486241d2cbf91a15.translatedText: New adoption law sparks controversy Arizona recently passed a law restricting gay adoption, making the issue of gay adoption once again a subject of concern and debate. Governor Brewer recently signed a law giving married couples run-off priority over singles in state-arranged adoptions. Under this law, all other things being equal, adoption agencies must give married couples priority for adoption. The state will also take into account factors such as the likelihood that the child will be placed for adoption by a relative, the ability of the prospective adoptive family to meet the child's needs and the personal wishes of the child over 12 years old. Sam Holzon, public relations director for the gay rights group Equality Arizona, criticized the law as discriminating against same-sex couples and unmarried people and lengthening the time for children temporarily placed in foster care with a family under state custody to wait for permanent adoption. "Our governor and state Legislature are putting politics ahead of the best interests of children by pushing this adoption policy," Holzon said. "This law has done nothing good except create barriers and create a chilling effect on singles and same-sex couples from adopting. There are many children waiting to be adopted into caring families, but there are not enough adoptive and foster parents for them. Therefore, there is no reason to pass another law that creates barriers to adoption." However, Wendy Wright, president of the conservative organization Women Concerned America, pointed out that history, common sense, and scientific research all show that children develop best in a family with two parents, while children from single-parent and broken families often have various academic and behavioral problems. Wright breaks down why Arizona passed the law. Wright said: "Social workers sometimes prioritize personal preferences or political pressure. Gay activists in the United States are very powerful politically. In Massachusetts, which allows gay marriage, there have been cases where social workers have given adoption priority to same-sex couples instead of opposite-sex couples. Adoption agencies have ignored the wishes of foster parents simply because of political pressure, and have taken children fostered in their families and given them to same-sex couples for adoption." Fox Broadcasting Company reported that Arizona is not the only state in the United States to impose restrictions on gay adoption. Mississippi and Utah also give priority to married couples and prohibit unmarried couples from adopting children. North Dakota allows adoption agencies to deny gay adoptions on religious or moral grounds. Florida banned gay adoption until a court overturned the law last year. Arkansas has also banned adoptions by unmarried couples, but the state's Supreme Court overturned that law in April. Fox Broadcasting Company’s news report also said that not long ago, an Illinois Senate committee rejected a bill. The bill would allow religious organizations to deny adoption to same-sex couples and deny them foster care. In recent years, however, laws banning adoption by gay couples have failed in states such as Tennessee, Kentucky and Ohio. According to estimates by gay and lesbian organizations, there are an estimated 250,000 children raised by gays in the United States.

a15877e9939af61b622b9704f86162ed62b9efe3.translatedText: Oil prices may rise to $5/gallon A former Shell Oil company president is about to teach a class at ASU, and he has some dire predictions about oil prices and U.S. oil supplies. "The current gasoline price is not the highest yet. At some point from this year to next year, the price will reach $5/gallon." John Hofmeister said. He said demand for oil from developing countries such as China and India would lead to a shortage of U.S. oil. "If we don't develop drilling quickly, there will be a serious oil shortage within four years." Since leaving Shell Oil, Hofmeister has become an advocate for increasing domestic oil development. He testified six times before the congressional petroleum committee, claiming that politicians had blocked oil exploration claims. This week, Republicans announced a push for legislation that would allow more oil drilling companies to obtain licenses. Meanwhile, Democrats are also pushing legislation to cut tax breaks for oil companies.

77b3af08593f6a366fb001d8c37bcae33b672846.sourceText: 母亲节统计数字 美工作母亲61% 你知道母亲节的由来吗﹖母亲节发起人是安娜贾维斯（ Anna Jarvis ）， 1908 年 5 月 10 日她在美国西维吉尼亚州格拉夫顿（ Grafton ）和费 城举办了母亲节庆祝活动。之后，随着每年的庆祝活动，母亲节的理念传播至全美国，贾维斯请求国会议员成立一个特别节日来表彰所有的母亲。她在 1914 年获得了成功，国会于当年指定五月的第二个星期日为母亲节。以下是关于美国母亲节的一些统计数据。 -2008 年全美共有约 8540 万位母亲。 -2008 年 15 岁至 44 岁的女性中有 54% 身为母亲。 - 至 2008 年， 40 岁至 44 岁的女性中有 82% 已产子， 1976 年这一数据是 90% 。 -2009 年美国的新生儿为 413 万，其中 45 岁至 54 岁的母亲为 7934 人。 -2008 年美国第一次生产的母亲的平均年龄为 25.1 岁，高于 2006 年和 2007 年的 25 岁。 七月为出生人数最多的一个月， 2008 年的数字是 37 万 5,384 人。 2009 年最流行的新生儿名字，男孩为雅各布布（ Jacob ），女孩为伊莎贝拉（ Isabella ）。 2010 年美国有 500 万留在家中的全职母亲，低于 2009 年的 510 万和 2008 年的 530 万，（但是 2010 年和 2009 年的估计数字没有统计学上的差异）。在 2010 年，有着 15 岁以下孩子的已婚夫妇家庭中， 23% 有一个留在家中的全职母亲，高于 2000 年的 21% 。在经济衰退前的 2007 年，有着 15 岁以下孩子的已婚夫妇家庭中， 24% 有一个留在家中的全职母亲。 2007 年的留在家中的全职母亲有以下特点： * 更年轻， 44% 年龄低于 35 岁，而职场中的母亲平均年龄为 38 。 * 西班牙裔较多，占 27% ，﹑而职场中的母亲为 16% 。 * 外国出生的较多，占 34% ，职场中母亲为 19% 。 * 与学龄前儿童一同居住的较多， 57% ，职场中母亲为 43% 。 * 没有高中文凭较多， 19% ，职场中母亲为 8% 。 工作母亲（包括准妈妈）为 61% 。 职场中新近产子的母亲比例从 2006 年的 57% 上升至 2008 年的 61% 。 单身母亲的人数为 990 万人， 2010 年与 18 岁以下儿童一同居住的单身母亲人数达 990 万，多于 1970 年的 340 万。
77b3af08593f6a366fb001d8c37bcae33b672846.translatedText: Mother’s Day statistics: 61% of working mothers in the United States Do you know the origin of Mother’s Day? The initiator of Mother's Day was Anna Jarvis, who held Mother's Day celebrations in Grafton, West Virginia, and Philadelphia on May 10, 1908. Later, as the idea of ​​Mother's Day spread throughout the United States with annual celebrations, Jarvis asked members of Congress to establish a special day to honor all mothers. She succeeded in 1914, when Congress designated the second Sunday in May as Mother's Day. Here are some statistics about Mother’s Day in the United States. -There were approximately 85.4 million mothers in the United States in 2008. -54% of women aged 15 to 44 were mothers in 2008. - By 2008, 82% of women aged 40 to 44 had given birth, up from 90% in 1976. -There were 4.13 million births in the United States in 2009, of which 7,934 were to mothers aged 45 to 54 years. -The average age of first-time mothers in the United States was 25.1 years in 2008, up from 25 years in 2006 and 2007. July is the month with the highest number of births, with 375,384 births in 2008. The most popular newborn names in 2009 were Jacob for boys and Isabella for girls. There were 5 million stay-at-home mothers in the United States in 2010, down from 5.1 million in 2009 and 5.3 million in 2008, (but the 2010 and 2009 estimates were not statistically different). In 2010, 23% of married couples with children under 15 had a stay-at-home mother, up from 21% in 2000. In 2007, before the recession, 24 percent of married couples with children under 15 had a stay-at-home mother. Stay-at-home mothers in 2007 were: * Younger, with 44% under age 35, compared with the average age of working mothers, who were 38. * There are more Hispanics, accounting for 27%, compared with 16% of working mothers. * There are more foreign-born people, accounting for 34%, and 19% of working mothers. * Most of them live with preschool children, 57%, and 43% of working mothers. * There are more people without a high school diploma, 19%, and working mothers, 8%. For working mothers (including expectant mothers) it was 61%. The proportion of working mothers who recently gave birth increased from 57% in 2006 to 61% in 2008. There were 9.9 million single mothers living with children under 18 in 2010, up from 3.4 million in 1970.

9812a3a50a8915fb4acfffe475c678ccce2d0c9f.sourceText: 侨务委员会举办[生产线管理E化观摩班]及[[网络店面营销实务班] 侨务委员会为协助侨营事业提升经营能力，特委由社团法人中华民国中小企业协会办理2011年「生产线管理E化观摩班」及「网络店面营销实务班」，办理时间及课程内容如下： （一）生产线管理E化观摩班 1. 时间：2011年7月4日至7月15日。 2. 报名截止日期：2011年5月31日。 3. 培训对象：经营传统产业及制造业之工厂负责人或从业人员。 ４. 课程内容：生产线计算机化控制及制造流程客制化之规划等课程，包含：导入E化概念、网络对企业之冲击与变革、产销协调及生产排程、现场改善之手法。并安排实地观摩导入人机接口、自动化机器及弹性生产等生产线E化成功之国内标竿企业。 （二）网络店面营销实务班 1. 时间：2011年7月25日至8月5日。 2. 报名截止日期：2011年6月14日。 3. 培训对象：计划发展以网络贩卖及营销之侨营事业或创业侨胞。 4. 课程内容：网络营销趋势、网络开店、营销手法、社群网站营销攻略、网络开店注意事项、网站与企业品牌、数字消费者营销、顾客关系管理等，并安排观摩国内网络营销企业及网络开店成功案例之分享。 研习活动之课程费用及研习期间学员膳宿费由侨务委员会负担，至参加学员由侨居地往返之机票交通费用及其他个人费用则需自理，有意报名者请洽橙县华侨文教服务中心714-754-9999。
9812a3a50a8915fb4acfffe475c678ccce2d0c9f.translatedText: The Overseas Chinese Affairs Council organized the [Production Line Management E-based Observation Class] and the [[Online Store Marketing Practical Class]. In order to help overseas Chinese businesses improve their operational capabilities, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council specially commissioned the Small and Medium Enterprises Association of the Republic of China to organize the 2011 "Production Line Management E-based Observation Class" and "Online Store Marketing Practical Class". The processing time and course content are as follows: (1) Production Line Management E-based Observation Class 1. Time: July 4 to July 15, 2011. 2. Deadline for registration: May 31, 2011. 3. Training target: Factory managers or employees operating traditional industries and manufacturing industries. 4. Course content: Courses such as computerized control of production lines and customized planning of manufacturing processes, including: the introduction of E-technology concepts, the impact and transformation of the Internet on enterprises, production and marketing coordination and production scheduling, and on-site improvement techniques. We will also arrange on-site visits to domestic benchmark companies that have successfully introduced human-machine interfaces, automated machines, and flexible production lines into E-enabled production lines. (2) Online Store Marketing Practical Class 1. Time: July 25 to August 5, 2011. 2. Deadline for registration: June 14, 2011. 3. Training target: Overseas Chinese businesses or entrepreneurial overseas Chinese who plan to develop online sales and marketing. 4. Course content: Internet marketing trends, online store opening, marketing techniques, social website marketing strategies, online store opening precautions, website and corporate branding, digital consumer marketing, customer relationship management, etc., and arrangements will be made to observe domestic online marketing companies and share successful cases of online store opening. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Council will bear the course fees for the study activities and the students’ board and lodging expenses during the study period. Participants must bear their own air tickets and transportation expenses to and from their place of residence and other personal expenses. Those interested in registering please contact the Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center at 714-754-9999.

3fc80be43a5dbba544d4291afa0087f45171ae8c.sourceText: 司威立教授荣获2011年度[最佳教授奖]（图） 亚省时报 图桑艺术大学厨艺餐饮服务管理学院院长司威立教授荣获2011年度「最佳教授奖」(Education of The Year)。颁奖仪式是在美国厨艺协会(American Culinary Federation)本年度西海岸年会中举行。其他五位候选人均是美国各大学餐饮、饭店管理或服务管理学院的院长、系主任或教授。学历均达博士学位或厨艺大师。司教授以唯一的亚洲人和来自台湾的教授荣获这项殊誉，是台湾的光荣，是亚洲人在美国此专业领域的荣幸。 司教授同时获得美国厨艺学院2011年度成就奖，以表扬他对美国年轻学子在专业教育上的贡献和促进国际厨艺文化交流的成就。美国厨艺学院仅有院士八百人，分居全美各地，是厨艺专业的最高荣誉机构。

13ed744ff58be1f9db4cd235b8f82aed20ed5868.sourceText: 高科技人才会亮相凤凰城 500多个佳位待聘 亚省时报 2011硅谷-凤凰城高科技人才招聘会，于5月1日在凤凰城Fiesta Resort Conference Center成功举办。本次招聘会由华美半导体协会 (CASPA)/SEMI主办。继4月30日硅谷人才招聘会后，INTEL, MAVELL, Lenovo, TSMC, ON SEMI, MAXIM 6家全球知名企业，继而转战凤凰城，带来近百个招聘职位。 协会招才会主席锺俞平表示，从两个招聘会超过500个职位来看，半导体行业的人才招募特点呈现出全球性和全面性的特点，因此今年也是各层次的高科技人才发展职业生涯的黄金时期。 今年的招聘职位，也并非拘泥于地区和领域，职位所在地包括凤凰城地区、硅谷地区，美国其它地区，以及亚太地区，这不仅为就业者带来更多的机会，也为企业跨区域、跨领域招聘带来更多人才选择。 Global Foundries公司副总裁Jon Carvill表示，地域不再是局限，找到人才才是重点。 Marvell人力资深经理Alice Young表示，半导体企业多进入生产系统产品方向，因此对软件人才的需求也日渐强劲，软硬件职位从原来的二八开变成目前的四六开。 随着凤凰城电子行业的迅速崛起，许多半导体行业的知名企业将重心转向凤凰城，也有更多新的高科技行业入驻凤凰城，这无疑为凤凰城电子行业带来新的机遇。此次招聘会上凤凰城地区的职位需求以及职位层级就往年相比，有着大幅提升。 协会凤凰城分会会长施晟指出凤凰城在美国甚至全球电子行业中的地位日渐重要，凤凰城得天独厚的自然条件使得电子行业在凤凰城飞速发展，也希望能通过招聘会吸引更多行业菁英落户凤凰城，成就此地电子行业的进一步发展。 华美半导体协会在过去16年在硅谷举办了15届年度人才招聘会。凤凰城分会从2003 年起，在凤凰城地区多次主办了人才招聘会。华美半导体协会凤凰城分会，作为CASPA在phoenix的分支机构，协会将长期致力于为会员公司和会员提供一个交流和发展平台，旨在促进会员联谊，研讨专业知识，关注会员利益，促进会员福利，以及交换全球的创业与就业资讯。协会凤凰城分会副会长周浩华表示协会将不定期举办更多专业讲座、行业趋势研讨会、人才招聘会等活动，一如既往的发挥中美公司之间，会员之间的桥梁作用。
13ed744ff58be1f9db4cd235b8f82aed20ed5868.translatedText: High-tech talents will appear in Phoenix, with more than 500 good jobs available. The 2011 Silicon Valley-Phoenix High-tech Talents Job Fair was successfully held on May 1 at the Fiesta Resort Conference Center in Phoenix. This job fair is hosted by China-American Semiconductor Association (CASPA)/SEMI. Following the Silicon Valley Job Fair on April 30, six world-renowned companies including INTEL, MAVELL, Lenovo, TSMC, ON SEMI, and MAXIM moved to Phoenix, bringing nearly a hundred recruitment positions. Zhong Yuping, chairman of the recruitment association of the association, said that judging from the more than 500 positions in the two job fairs, the talent recruitment characteristics of the semiconductor industry are global and comprehensive, so this year is also a golden period for high-tech talents at all levels to develop their careers. This year's recruitment positions are not limited to regions and fields. The locations of the positions include the Phoenix area, Silicon Valley area, other regions in the United States, and the Asia-Pacific region. This not only brings more opportunities for employees, but also brings more talent choices for companies to recruit across regions and fields. Jon Carvill, vice president of Global Foundries, said that geography is no longer a limitation, finding talent is the key. Alice Young, senior manager of human resources at Marvell, said that semiconductor companies are mostly moving into the production of system products, so the demand for software talents is becoming increasingly strong. The number of software and hardware positions has changed from the original 28-percent opening to the current 40-60 opening. With the rapid rise of Phoenix's electronics industry, many well-known companies in the semiconductor industry have shifted their focus to Phoenix, and more new high-tech industries have settled in Phoenix. This will undoubtedly bring new opportunities to Phoenix's electronics industry. At this job fair, the job demand and job levels in the Phoenix area have increased significantly compared with previous years. Shi Sheng, president of the association's Phoenix branch, pointed out that Phoenix's position in the electronics industry in the United States and even the world is becoming increasingly important. Phoenix's unique natural conditions have enabled the electronics industry to develop rapidly in Phoenix. He also hopes to attract more industry elites to settle in Phoenix through the job fair and achieve further development of the electronics industry here. The China-American Semiconductor Association has held 15 annual job fairs in Silicon Valley in the past 16 years. The Phoenix Chapter has hosted many job fairs in the Phoenix area since 2003. The Phoenix Chapter of the China-American Semiconductor Association, as a branch of CASPA in phoenix, will be committed to providing a communication and development platform for member companies and members in the long term, aiming to promote member networking, discuss professional knowledge, pay attention to member interests, promote member welfare, and exchange global entrepreneurship and employment information. Zhou Haohua, vice president of the Phoenix branch of the association, said that the association will hold more professional lectures, industry trend seminars, talent recruitment fairs and other activities from time to time, and will continue to play a bridge role between Chinese and American companies and members.

9c7a5041192d83ca3a09b5bdf2b8d1ae984782df.sourceText: 2011年凤凰城中文学校毕业典礼隆重举行 7位毕业生感动现场 五月一日凤凰城中文学校在梅莎小区大学举行了2011 年的毕业典礼。主持人郑弘先生感谢大家的光临之后，便欢迎程秀玲校长致词，此时突然播出了Indiana Jones 的主题音乐，主持人幽默得解释要担任凤凰城中文学校的校长就像Indiana Jones一样十八班武艺样样精通，困难重重，却能过关斩将。 程校长感谢各位贵宾以及家长参加这个对毕业生有着特别意义的典礼，接着便欢迎今年的七位毕业生，他们是柯桂儿、麦智健、李嘉玲、简玮佳 (在纽约不克出席)、黄琪欣、李宇轩及陆瑞贤。毕业生在号角乐声中缓缓步入会场，此时全场响起了热烈的掌声。程校长鼓励毕业生虽然从中文学校毕业了，还是要时时刻刻使用并继续充实中文。 今年凤凰城中文学校邀请的贵宾是中华民国侨务委员会咨询委员尹衍桓女士，尹女士不疾不徐的以中英文交叉演说，她代表侨委会肯定凤凰城中文学校创校三十年对侨界的贡献，并以挚亲般的心情勉励毕业生让中文成为他们未来学习及事业竞争的利器。典礼中尹女士代表侨委会向学校捐赠三部计算机投影机以促进数字华文教学，更将庆祝建国百年的圣火以蜡烛分传给毕业同学，象征中华文化的薪火相传。 接着由毕业班导师卢贞玲老师主持毕业生感言，卢老师说为了验收成果，要从她的班上毕业必须会念古诗，还要会唱中文歌。卢老师以深厚的文学底子，在每位毕业生吟诗之前，以极其幽默的口吻细说诗词的背景与描述的意境，并附上相片解说，让在座的来宾彷佛穿越了时空隧道，回到当时诗中的情景。 接着毕业生说出他们的感言，这也是整个典礼最感人的时刻。卢老师在介绍毕业生时，投影机放出了毕业生从小到大的生活照。柯桂儿不仅参加学校的弦乐团，同时也是学校的排球校队，更荣获梅莎市年度最佳学生获奖学金五百元。她感谢爸妈送她到中文学校来学习这美丽的语言，让她能和外公聊天，到中国餐馆会点菜，还能到中国城买东西时讨价还价。开朗的麦智健来自一个广东家庭，但父母亲认为普通话势必成为世界潮流，因此麦智健七岁时来上中文学校，经过十年的学习，到北京去玩时他都听得懂大家在说什么，他好高兴，虽然起步晚但他很认真学习，因为他知道中文的重要性。从中文学校毕业的同时也将进入哈佛开始他的大学生涯。 善解人意的李嘉玲有无数次想放弃学中文，但在父母亲的坚持下不仅在中文学校待了十五年，还当上学生代联会的会长，为学校、同学服务，得到很多书本上学不到的经验，更交了许多好朋友，如今要毕业了却有点依依不舍。简玮佳是唯一不在现场的毕业生，因为就读的美国学校有活动必须远赴纽约。玮佳小学三年级时全家从台湾移民美国，因为中文底子强因此八岁就念中文学校六年级，如今十三岁就从中文学校毕业了，虽然她不能来参加毕业典礼，她还是把她该念的诗用iPod录音下来，在现场播放，就是怕卢老师不让她毕业。 爱笑的黄琪欣喜欢服装设计，即将就读美西首屈一指的服装设计学校FIDM。她的设计作品为她赢得了一年全额学费奖学金，她说完毕业感言后深深一鞠躬，谢谢阿妈(闽南语祖母)、爸妈、姑姑还有教过她的老师们，全场为之动容。李宇轩看似腼腆却是一个幽默风趣的大男孩，他说他今年十七岁却已在中文学校待了十八年，原来他还在妈妈肚子里时就来中文学校接受熏陶了。他的母亲正是在中文学校热心服务近二十年的程秀玲校长。蕙质兰心的陆瑞贤在中文学校有十四年之久，她记得刚上中文学校时，班上有二十几个学生，许多同学在中途就放弃了，她也曾经信心动摇过，但很庆幸自己能坚持到最后，终于能说写一口(手)流利的中文。毕业生的感言、诗词、照片交织成一片温馨感人的乐章，感动了现场的每一位来宾! 毕业生感言之后在键盘伴奏下唱了三首中文歌献给大家，接着学校颁发毕业证书与刻上毕业生名字的礼物。尹衍桓女士也加赠每位毕业生一份Apple礼券，尹女士并以即席 接词的方式期勉毕生〝欲穷千里目，更上一层楼〞。典礼尾声中在校生在吉他社同学伴奏下唱起了〝朋友〞欢送毕业生。〝朋友 一生一起走?#19968;句话 一辈子 一生情 一杯酒〞，看着毕业生离情依依的离开现场，一场感人的毕业典礼也徐徐落幕了。(凤凰城中文学校网址 http://www.clsphoenix.org, 校长程秀玲 480-620-1982 )
9c7a5041192d83ca3a09b5bdf2b8d1ae984782df.translatedText: The 2011 Phoenix Chinese School Graduation Ceremony was held grandly. Seven graduates were moved. On May 1st, Phoenix Chinese School held its 2011 graduation ceremony at Mesa Community College. After the host, Mr. Zheng Hong, thanked everyone for coming, he welcomed Principal Cheng Xiuling to give a speech. At this time, the theme music of Indiana Jones suddenly played. The host humorously explained that being the principal of Phoenix Chinese School is like Indiana Jones, who is proficient in all kinds of martial arts in class 18, has many difficulties, but can overcome all obstacles. Principal Cheng thanked all the distinguished guests and parents for attending this ceremony, which is of special significance to the graduates, and then welcomed this year's seven graduates, namely Ke Guier, Mak Chi-kin, Li Jialing, Kan Weijia (who was unable to attend in New York), Huang Qixin, Li Yuxuan and Luk Shuixian. The graduates slowly walked into the venue amidst the sound of trumpets, and the audience burst into warm applause. Principal Cheng encouraged the graduates to use and continue to enrich their Chinese language at all times even though they have graduated from a Chinese language school. This year, the guest of honor invited by Phoenix Chinese School was Ms. Yin Yanhuan, an advisory member of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission of the Republic of China. Ms. Yin delivered a speech in both Chinese and English. On behalf of the Overseas Chinese Committee, she affirmed the contribution of Phoenix Chinese School to the overseas Chinese community in the past 30 years since its establishment. She encouraged the graduates with a dearly loved attitude to make Chinese a tool for their future study and career competition. During the ceremony, Ms. Yin, on behalf of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council, donated three computer projectors to the school to promote digital Chinese teaching. She also distributed the torch celebrating the centenary of the founding of the People's Republic of China to the graduating students with candles, symbolizing the passing on of Chinese culture. Then the graduating class tutor, Ms. Lu Zhenling, gave a speech to the graduates. Ms. Lu said that in order to accept the results, those who graduate from her class must be able to recite ancient poems and sing Chinese songs. With a profound foundation in literature, Teacher Lu explained the background and artistic conception of the poem in an extremely humorous tone before each graduate recited the poem, and attached photo explanations, making the guests feel as if they had traveled through a time tunnel and returned to the scene in the poem at that time. The graduates then gave their speeches, which was also the most touching moment of the entire ceremony. When Teacher Lu introduced the graduates, the projector showed photos of the graduates’ life from childhood to adulthood. Ke Guier not only participated in the school's string band, but also was on the school's volleyball team. She also won the Mesa City Student of the Year and received a scholarship of 500 yuan. She thanked her parents for sending her to Chinese school to learn this beautiful language, so that she could chat with her grandfather, order food in Chinese restaurants, and bargain when shopping in Chinatown. The cheerful Mak Chi Kin comes from a Cantonese family, but his parents believed that Mandarin would definitely become a global trend, so Mak Chi Kin came to a Chinese school when he was seven years old. After ten years of study, he could understand what everyone was saying when he went to Beijing to play. He was so happy. Although he started late, he studied seriously because he knew the importance of Chinese. After graduating from Chinese school, he will also enter Harvard to start his college career. The considerate Li Jialing wanted to give up learning Chinese countless times, but with the persistence of her parents, she not only stayed in the Chinese school for fifteen years, but also became the president of the Student Representative Association, serving the school and classmates. She gained a lot of experience that could not be learned in books, and made many good friends. Now that she is about to graduate, she is a little reluctant to leave. Jian Weijia was the only graduate who was not present because the American school she attended had events and she had to go to New York. When Wei Jia was in the third grade of elementary school, her family immigrated to the United States from Taiwan. Because of her strong Chinese proficiency, she entered the sixth grade of a Chinese school at the age of eight. Now she graduated from the Chinese school at the age of thirteen. Although she could not attend the graduation ceremony, she still recorded the poems she was supposed to read on her iPod and played them on the spot, just because she was afraid that Teacher Lu would not let her graduate. Huang Qixin, who loves to laugh, loves fashion design and will soon attend FIDM, the premier fashion design school in the Western United States. Her design work won her a one-year full-tuition scholarship. After she finished her graduation speech, she bowed deeply and thanked her grandma (a Hokkien-speaking grandmother), parents, aunts and teachers who taught her. The whole audience was moved. Li Yuxuan looks shy but is a humorous big boy. He said that he is 17 years old but has been in Chinese school for 18 years. It turns out that he came to Chinese school to receive education when he was still in his mother's womb. His mother is the principal Cheng Xiuling who has served the Chinese school enthusiastically for nearly twenty years. Lu Ruixian, who is very kind and sincere, has been in Chinese school for 14 years. She remembers that when she first entered Chinese school, there were more than 20 students in the class, and many students gave up midway. She also had her confidence wavered, but she was glad that she persisted until the end and was finally able to speak and write fluent Chinese. The graduates' speeches, poems, and photos were intertwined into a warm and touching piece of music, which moved every guest at the scene! After the graduates' speeches, three Chinese songs were sung to everyone with keyboard accompaniment, and then the school issued graduation certificates and gifts engraved with the graduates' names. Ms. Yin Yanhuan also presented each graduate with an Apple gift certificate. Ms. Yin also used an impromptu speech to encourage her to "seek further and reach higher" throughout her life. At the end of the ceremony, current students sang "Friends" accompanied by guitar club students to send off the graduates. "Friends, walk together for a lifetime?" In one sentence, a lifetime, a lifetime of love, a glass of wine." Watching the graduates leaving the scene, a touching graduation ceremony slowly came to an end. (Phoenix Chinese School website http://www.clsphoenix.org, Principal Cheng Xiuling 480-620-1982)

210bf3ea48a3258dd177e05926a4aef6855c3513.sourceText: 凤凰城法拍屋逐步下降 根据ASU最新研究报告指出，三月份，凤凰城地区的法拍屋有轻微下降的趋势。 从事房地产研究的州立大学教授巴特勒每月报告中，法拍屋占房屋销售率，从一月的43%，二月的38%，一直呈下降形势。三月份房屋销售有11000家，其中4100家是法拍屋。 巴特勒说，目前尚不清楚是否银行政策的改变导致法拍屋数量减少。 2010年，超过4%的凤凰城大都会家庭因还不清银行贷款而导致居屋被银行收回。银行将这些房屋投放市场，是为法拍屋。 3月份的法拍屋中间价为12.5万美元。
210bf3ea48a3258dd177e05926a4aef6855c3513.translatedText: Phoenix City foreclosures are gradually declining. According to the latest ASU research report, in March, there was a slight downward trend in foreclosures in the Phoenix area. Butler, a professor at State University who is engaged in real estate research, reported in his monthly report that foreclosures accounted for 38% of home sales in February, from 43% in January to 38% in January. There were 11,000 home sales in March, of which 4,100 were foreclosures. Butler said it's unclear whether changes in bank policy are causing the decline in foreclosures. In 2010, more than 4% of metro Phoenix households had their HOS homes repossessed by banks because they were unable to repay their bank loans. The banks put these houses on the market as foreclosures. The median foreclosure sale price in March was $125,000.

3dd886b0ed53ed39d062caa831ec2e398371f70f.sourceText: 联航取消国内行李费折扣 总部在芝加哥的联合大陆航空公司 (United Continental Holdings Inc.) 已取消早先提供的预付行李费折扣。此种折扣让网上预付 ( 不是到机场柜台再付 ) 行李费的国内班机旅客，第一件托运行李省二元，第二件托运行李优惠三元。 此种改变从 3 月 9 日售出的机票开始，取消折扣后，无论何时、何地缴付行李费，第一件托运行李一律收费 25 元，第二件收费 35 元。原先折扣的用意在于鼓励旅客于抵达机场前付费。 达美航空公司 (Delta Air Lines Inc.) 仍提供类似折扣，其他航空公司像是美国航空公司 (American Airlines) 则从未提供差别价格。西南航空公司 (Southwest Airlines Co.) 最「大方」，继续让旅客免费托运两件行李。
3dd886b0ed53ed39d062caa831ec2e398371f70f.translatedText: United Airlines cancels domestic baggage fee discounts Chicago-based United Continental Holdings Inc. has canceled its earlier offer of prepaid baggage fee discounts. This discount allows online prepayment (instead of paying at the airport counter) Passengers on domestic flights will save $2 on the first checked bag and $3 on the second checked bag. Starting from March 9, after the discount is eliminated, the first checked bag will be charged $25 and the second checked bag will be charged $35 regardless of when and where. The original discount was intended to encourage passengers to pay before arriving at the airport. Delta Air Lines Inc. still offers similar discounts, and other airlines such as American Airlines American Airlines has never offered differential prices. Southwest Airlines Co. is the most "generous" and continues to allow passengers to check in two bags for free.

22727303e356be4983a29d966729d9899165fa2f.sourceText: Mesa第五届水上安全活动 美莎市第五届水上安全步行活动，于本周六上午8时至11时举行，目的是提高对市民水上活动安全意识，防止溺水。 美莎市消防局提醒市民，夏天到了，学校中小学也快放暑假了，家中有儿童的家庭要特别注意水上活动安全，特别注意几点：一，当孩子们在玩水时，一定要有成人监督。二，有泳池的家庭一定要加装护栏和有锁的大门，使孩子与泳池保持距离。三，在学会游泳之前，不要让孩子下游泳池玩耍。四，成人应接受心肺复苏急救训练，以应付危急事件发生。 周六将有消防员和志愿者挨家挨户分发有关水安全的基础知识材料。
22727303e356be4983a29d966729d9899165fa2f.translatedText: Mesa's fifth water safety event Mesa's fifth water safety walk will be held from 8 a.m. to 11 a.m. this Saturday, with the purpose of raising citizens' awareness of water safety and preventing drowning. The Mesa City Fire Department reminds citizens that summer is here, and schools and primary and secondary schools are about to go out for summer vacation. Families with children at home should pay special attention to the safety of water activities. Pay special attention to the following points: 1. When children are playing in the water, they must be supervised by adults. Second, families with swimming pools must install guardrails and locked gates to keep children away from the swimming pool. Third, do not let your children play in the swimming pool before they learn to swim. 4. Adults should receive cardiopulmonary resuscitation first aid training to cope with critical incidents. Firefighters and volunteers will be going door-to-door on Saturday to hand out materials on the basics of water safety.

df1e5727764e91dabc3d873eae6adf7f82a5c4f1.sourceText: 打击民航三大顽疾 晚点4小时须赔2.7万美元 美国运输部20日出台新版民航服务管理条例，重拳出击民航服务业现有三大顽疾：丢包、晚点和超售。 按处罚标准计，这是最严厉的民航服务管理条例。按新版条例，假设一架空客A380客机在满员状况下晚点4小时，航空运营商可能需向乘客赔付1000万美元。 运输部部长雷拉胡德20日说，新版条例将于今年8月底正式投入使用。 新版条例着重打击现有航空运营商时常出现的三大顽疾，包括托运行李丢失，飞机长时间起飞延误，超售机票致使乘客无法获得座位。 延误上限4小时 新条例去年讨论期间，原设定延误上限为3小时。去年12月北美遭遇雪灾，部分机场大批客机延误，纽约约翰肯尼迪国际机场部分国际航线飞机延误10小时以上。新条例随后放宽标准，将3小时延长至4小时。 尽管尺度放宽，但处罚力度不减。按新版条例，国际航班乘客登机后，不论何种原因，飞机在停机坪上等候4小时以上的航空公司必须向每位乘客赔付2.7万美元。 超售最高要赔＄1330 去年一年，美国航空公司总计发生托运行李处置不当事故200万起，包括行李丢失、箱包破损、延误运送等情况。 先前条例规定，航空公司在搞丢乘客行李后需向乘客赔偿合理费用，但新规定附加一条，航空公司须返还乘客行李托运费和行李检查费。 超售是许多航空公司的营销伎俩。通常情况下，超售机票的航空公司在乘客登机时有两种选择，一是请求乘客转成下一趟航班，二是直接向乘客支付小额”爽约费”。 旧版条例规定，乘客可按被延误时间的长短向超售航空公司索赔400美元至800美元的补偿费；新版条例将这一补偿力度提升至650美元至1330美元。
df1e5727764e91dabc3d873eae6adf7f82a5c4f1.translatedText: To combat the three major chronic problems of civil aviation, a 4-hour delay will result in a compensation of US$27,000. The U.S. Department of Transportation issued a new version of the Civil Aviation Service Management Regulations on the 20th to crack down on the three major chronic problems of the civil aviation service industry: packet loss, delays, and overbooking. In terms of penalty standards, this is the most stringent civil aviation service management regulation. According to the new regulations, if an Airbus A380 passenger plane is delayed by four hours when it is full, the air operator may have to pay passengers US$10 million in compensation. Transportation Minister Leila Hood said on the 20th that the new version of the regulations will be officially put into use by the end of August this year. The new version of the regulations focuses on combating three major problems that often occur with existing air operators, including lost checked baggage, long departure delays, and overbooking of tickets that prevent passengers from getting seats. Delay upper limit of 4 hours. During the discussion of the new regulations last year, the original delay limit was set at 3 hours. North America was hit by a snowstorm in December last year, which delayed a large number of passenger flights at some airports. Flights on some international routes at New York's John F. Kennedy International Airport were delayed for more than 10 hours. The new regulations subsequently relaxed the standard and extended it from 3 hours to 4 hours. Although the standards have been relaxed, the penalties have not been reduced. According to the new regulations, airlines that wait on the tarmac for more than four hours for any reason after boarding an international flight must pay each passenger US$27,000. Overbooking can result in compensation of up to $1,330. Last year, US airlines had a total of 2 million incidents of improper handling of checked baggage, including lost baggage, damaged bags, delayed delivery, etc. Previous regulations stipulated that airlines must compensate passengers for reasonable expenses after losing their luggage, but the new regulations include an additional provision that airlines must refund passengers' baggage check fees and baggage inspection fees. Overbooking is a marketing tactic used by many airlines. Usually, airlines with overbooked tickets have two options when passengers board the plane. One is to ask the passengers to transfer to the next flight, and the other is to pay the passengers a small "no-show fee" directly. The old version of the regulations stipulates that passengers can claim compensation from overbooked airlines ranging from US$400 to US$800 depending on the length of the delay; the new version of the regulations increases this compensation to US$650 to US$1,330.

1912b23208fe39f5d091c5468b4da56859f65a3b.sourceText: 7种铁饭碗 不受景气影响 擁有一個不受經濟景氣影響的穩定工作，並非遙不可及的夢想。網站有500萬個工作機會供使用者瀏覽的SimplyHired.com人事主管休斯指出，雖然十多年來就業市場有些變化，但還是有許多穩定的工作。以下即為七種穩定的工作： 1. 法律助理（平均年薪5萬80元） 許多公司為節省開銷雇用法律助理取代律師。法律助理的工作包括準備出庭文件、擬合約草稿、為客戶設立信託基金、調查案件的關鍵事項、作筆錄等。 勞工部預估，2008至2018年法律助理的需求成長28%。休斯指出，法律助理工作不會因時代變遷而遭淘汰，且法律案件的複雜使雇主難以將工作轉移至海外。 成為法律助理，可到社區學院修個法律助理副學士。如果已有大學學位，可參加短期密集課程，幾個月即可取得法律助理證書。如果所參加的短期課程能提供實習機會，更可獲得寶貴的實際工作經驗。 2. 會計（平均年薪6萬7430元）：無論經濟好壞，企業都需要會計人員記帳。會計工作包括每日進出帳、報稅、財務投資規畫等。某些會計甚至與檢警單位合作，調查金融犯罪。 無論企業、政府單位、非營利機構或個人，都需要會計幫助處理財務問題，因此會計的需求短期內不會降低。根據全美大學與雇主協會資料顯示，2011年前的大學畢業生，會計系畢業生獲得的工作機會最多。 要從事會計工作一般都需有大學會計或相關科系學位。 3. 護士（平均年薪6萬6530元） 人口老化和預防醫療興起，都使護士的工作更穩定。有照護士每天需與醫師和病人密切配合，工作包括服藥、檢驗、幫病人復健、給病人和家屬醫療或精神建議。 美國勞工部資料顯示，2008至2018年護士需求增加22%，且在未來30年內持續有強勁需求。 要成為護士需有護理副學士 (AND)或理學士 (BSN)學位。如果已有大學學位，可參加12至18個月的速成課程取得護理理學士。 4. 警察（平均年薪5萬5180元） 無論經濟如何，治安仍是許多社區關注的重點。警察的工作包括開罰單、處理報案、追捕罪犯等。由於可能需要出庭作證、寫報告，作紀錄等也是工作重點。 警察是維持治安的關鍵，永遠不會改變。儘管各州和地方政府預算緊縮，但人口成長使警察的需求不致減少。擔任警察需高中畢業，有時需大學副學士或學士學位，如有刑事法相關學位更佳。此外，警察需有敏捷強健的身手，因此體能也是重要條件之一。 5. 教師（平均年薪5萬3150元至5萬5150元） 教師在引領孩童邁向未來扮演極重要角色。教師的工作包括規畫課程、批改作業和考卷、和家長學校討論學生的課業表現，甚至使用新科技媒介使課程更生動。 學生人數不斷增加及教師退休，使學校不時需要增聘新教師。如果暫不考慮政府預算問題，勞工部預估未來十年將有大批教師退休，且西南各州的學生人數將快速增加。 擔任教師至少需有學士學位。如果志在成為高中教師，在大學主修的科系最好與未來希望教學的科目相同。許多教師培訓課程也包含實習，可藉此從有經驗的教師身上學到寶貴的教學經驗。 6. 稅務員（平均年薪5萬3800元） 儘管有人痛恨稅務員，但收稅員的職位不會消失。稅務員工作包括催討逾期未付稅款、審查稅表、與納稅人溝通解決欠稅債務。 常言說得好，每個人一生在劫難逃的只有兩件事：死亡和納稅。只要稅制存在，政府就需要稅務員。勞工部也預估，2008至2018年稅務員需求將增加13%。現在政府鬧窮，抓逃漏稅並追討稅款將愈來愈熱門。 擔任州政府和地方政府稅務員，只需有大學商業、金融、會計或刑事法相關科系副學士學位，但為國稅局工作則需學士學位。 7. 預算分析師（平均年薪6萬9240元） 不管經濟景氣好壞，平衡預算是每個企業極重要的一環。預算分析師為公司作有效率的財務規畫運用、研擬並執行預算計畫、研究經濟動向對公司的影響、製作預算報告和摘要。 近幾年的經濟蕭條使企業更注重經營效率，對預算運用的審查要求更嚴格，因而預算分析師的角色更為重要。勞工部估計，隨著企業多元化和專業化，2008至2018 年預算分析師的需求將增加15%。 一般企業的預算分析師職位需有大學學士學位，有些公司更要求碩士學位，最好主修會計、財政、企管、經濟等相關科系。
1912b23208fe39f5d091c5468b4da56859f65a3b.translatedText: 7 types of iron rice bowls that are not affected by the recession. Having a stable job that is not affected by the economic boom is not an unattainable dream. Hughes, director of personnel at SimplyHired.com, which has 5 million job opportunities for users to browse, pointed out that although the job market has changed over the past decade, there are still many stable jobs. The following are seven stable jobs: 1. Legal assistant (average annual salary of 50,800 yuan). Many companies hire legal assistants to replace lawyers to save costs. The work of a legal assistant includes preparing court documents, drafting contracts, setting up trust funds for clients, investigating key matters in the case, taking notes, etc. The Department of Labor estimates that the demand for legal assistants will grow by 28% from 2008 to 2018. Hughes noted that paralegal jobs are not going away due to changing times, and the complexity of legal cases makes it difficult for employers to move jobs overseas. To become a legal assistant, you can go to a community college and earn an associate degree in legal assistant. If you already have a college degree, you can take a short, intensive course and earn a paralegal certification in a few months. If the short-term courses you attend provide internship opportunities, you can also gain valuable practical work experience. 2. Accountant (average annual salary: NT$67,430): Regardless of whether the economy is good or bad, companies need accountants to keep accounts. Accounting work includes daily accounting, tax filing, financial investment planning, etc. Some accountants even work with prosecutors to investigate financial crimes. Regardless of businesses, government units, non-profit organizations or individuals, all need accountants to help deal with financial issues, so the demand for accountants will not decrease in the short term. According to data from the National Association of Colleges and Employers, among college graduates before 2011, accounting graduates have the most job opportunities. To engage in accounting work, you generally need a university degree in accounting or a related discipline. 3. Nurse (average annual salary: NT$66,530) The aging population and the rise of preventive medicine have made nurses’ jobs more stable. Licensed nurses need to work closely with doctors and patients every day. Their work includes taking medications, testing, helping patients recover, and giving medical or psychiatric advice to patients and their families. According to data from the U.S. Department of Labor, the demand for nurses increased by 22% from 2008 to 2018, and there will continue to be strong demand in the next 30 years. Becoming a nurse requires an associate of nursing (AND) or bachelor of science (BSN) degree. If you already have a college degree, you can take an accelerated 12- to 18-month course to earn a Bachelor of Science in Nursing. 4. Police (average annual salary: $55,180) Regardless of the economy, law and order remains a key concern for many communities. Police duties include issuing tickets, handling crime reports, and chasing criminals. Since you may need to appear in court to testify, write reports, and keep records, etc. are also important tasks. Police are the key to maintaining law and order and that will never change. Despite tightening state and local government budgets, population growth keeps the need for police officers from declining. Working as a police officer requires a high school diploma and sometimes an associate's or bachelor's degree from college, preferably a degree in criminal law. In addition, police officers need to be agile and strong, so physical fitness is also one of the important requirements. 5. Teachers (average annual salary: NT$53,150 to NT$55,150) Teachers play an extremely important role in leading children into the future. Teachers' work includes planning lessons, grading homework and examination papers, discussing students' academic performance with parents and schools, and even using new technological media to make lessons more vivid. The increasing number of students and the retirement of teachers require schools to recruit new teachers from time to time. Putting aside government budget concerns for a moment, the Labor Department projects that teachers will retire in droves over the next decade and student numbers will grow rapidly in southwestern states. Teaching as a teacher requires at least a bachelor's degree. If you are aiming to become a high school teacher, it is best to major in the same subject in college as the subject you hope to teach in the future. Many teacher training courses also include internships, where you can learn valuable teaching experience from experienced teachers. 6. Tax collector (average annual salary: $53,800) Although some people hate tax collectors, the position of tax collector will not disappear. The duties of a tax collector include collecting overdue taxes, reviewing tax returns, and communicating with taxpayers to resolve tax debts. As the saying goes, there are only two things that everyone is inevitable with in life: death and paying taxes. As long as the tax system exists, governments will need tax collectors. The Department of Labor also estimates that the demand for tax collectors will increase by 13% from 2008 to 2018. Now that the government is in poverty, catching tax evaders and recovering taxes will become increasingly popular. Working as a state and local tax collector requires only an associate's degree from a college in a business, finance, accounting or criminal law field, but working for the Internal Revenue Service requires a bachelor's degree. 7. Budget Analyst (average annual salary: $69,240) No matter whether the economy is good or bad, balancing the budget is an extremely important part of every business. Budget analysts make efficient financial planning applications for the company, develop and execute budget plans, study the impact of economic trends on the company, and produce budget reports and summaries. The economic recession in recent years has made companies pay more attention to operating efficiency and require stricter review of budget utilization, so the role of budget analysts has become more important. The Department of Labor estimates that demand for budget analysts will increase 15% from 2008 to 2018 as businesses diversify and specialize. Budget analyst positions in general companies require a bachelor's degree, and some companies require a master's degree. It is best to major in accounting, finance, business management, economics and other related disciplines.

cefc6b8b046d47e2a1b7d9ba5ca3cb7322b1e2ec.sourceText: 闹市现野狼 2岁女童被咬伤 上周五晚上，一名2岁女童在23rd Ave和雷鸟路交界的Cave Creek游乐区被野狼咬伤。 据目击证人说，一只狼快速跑出操场，从背面咬住小女孩。”女孩似乎是狼的唯一目标，”霍恩说。”非常可怕。” 当时女孩和家人朋友在烧烤，狼可能闻到肉香味而来。人们惊慌大叫，拿东西砸向它，野狼虽然放下女童，并没有离开。后警员和渔猎部到场将其制服。女童被送医院注射狂犬病针液。 亚利桑那州渔猎部工作人员事后说，野生动物在闹市出现并攻击人类很不寻常，”不在这头狼是否饿坏脑子。” 渔猎部当晚在该地区搜捕了六头野狼，并对执行它们注射死亡，狼尸被送检测是否有狂犬症，检测可能需要一个星期。 附近居民说，事发现场原是郊区荒地，近年开发成居民住宅区，野狼在此出现不足为奇。
cefc6b8b046d47e2a1b7d9ba5ca3cb7322b1e2ec.translatedText: Wild wolf found in downtown, 2-year-old girl bitten Last Friday night, a 2-year-old girl was bitten by a wild wolf at the Cave Creek Recreation Area at the junction of 23rd Avenue and Thunderbird Road. According to witnesses, a wolf quickly ran out of the playground and bit the little girl from the back. "Girls seemed to be the only targets of the wolves," Horn said. "It's very scary." The girl was having a barbecue with her family and friends at the time, and the wolf may have come smelling the scent of meat. People screamed in panic and threw things at it. Although the wild wolf put the girl down, it did not leave. Later, police officers and the Department of Fish and Game arrived and subdued him. The girl was sent to the hospital for rabies injections. Arizona Department of Fish and Game staff said afterwards that it was unusual for wild animals to appear and attack humans in a busy city. "It's not a matter of whether the wolf was starving and had lost its brain." The Department of Fish and Game captured six wild wolves in the area that night and injected them to death. The wolf carcasses were sent to be tested for rabies. The test may take a week. Neighboring residents said that the scene of the incident was originally a suburban wasteland, but has been developed into a residential area in recent years. It is not surprising for wild wolves to appear here.

5e5a840754125907eec703e3ed246160f6758750.sourceText: 4月23日上午11时，本届凤凰城华裔小姐的候选佳丽到新东方艺术学校与本次选美活动的艺术总监见面并开始了第一次的形体培训，”太阳鸟”成为凤凰城华裔小姐选美的唯一网络合作伙伴。 八位候选佳丽中的七位准时来来到培训地点，在形体指导胡秋子的带领下，佳丽们先进行了基本的形体训练，其中包括舞蹈手位，体位的学习，身体柔韧性的训练。从训练中可以看出，这次候选佳丽的身材条件都很优秀，身高方面有好几位身高都超过170cm, 身材比例很好。大部分佳丽都有音乐方面的特长，音乐的领悟性强，节奏感好，形体训练非常顺利。在形体训练结束后，艺术总监Hodgie Jo, 对佳丽们进行了面试，了解佳丽的参赛计划以及特长表演的内容。艺术总监将根据佳丽的个人特点来安排比赛的才艺表演环节。艺术总监Hodgie Jo表示，今年的选美在舞台灯光和音响效果方面与去年相比会有全方位的改善，他们力求给凤凰城的中国观众带来一场前所未有的视听盛宴。本届候选佳丽的照片计划将在月底与观众见面。 ”太阳鸟”负责人与侨联主席邓朝驹和副主席张华芳见面座谈，洽谈网络的代理项目。2011年凤凰城华裔小姐的所有资料都有望第一时间在”太阳鸟”亚利桑那华人社区披露。他们将建立一个专区，每一个网友都可以在”太阳鸟”网站了来支持自己喜欢的候选佳丽。
5e5a840754125907eec703e3ed246160f6758750.translatedText: At 11 a.m. on April 23, the candidates for this year’s Miss Chinese Phoenix went to New Oriental Art School to meet with the artistic director of the pageant and started their first physical training. “Sunbird” became the only online partner of the Miss Chinese Phoenix pageant. Seven of the eight candidate beauties came to the training location on time. Under the leadership of physical instructor Hu Qiuzi, the beauties first underwent basic physical training, including learning dance hand positions, postures, and body flexibility training. It can be seen from the training that the body conditions of the contestants this time are all excellent. In terms of height, several of them are over 170cm and have good body proportions. Most of the beauties have specialties in music. They have a strong musical understanding, a good sense of rhythm, and their physical training is very smooth. After the physical training, artistic director Hodgie Jo conducted interviews with the contestants to learn about their competition plans and their specialty performances. The artistic director will arrange the talent show part of the competition based on the personal characteristics of the contestants. Artistic Director Hodgie Jo said that this year's pageant will have all-round improvements in stage lighting and sound effects compared with last year, and they strive to bring an unprecedented audio-visual feast to the Chinese audience in Phoenix. Photos of this year's beauties will be released to the audience at the end of the month. The person in charge of "Sunbird" met with Chairman Deng Chaoju and Vice Chairman Zhang Huafang of the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese to discuss network agency projects. All information about Miss Chinese Phoenix 2011 is expected to be disclosed in the "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese community as soon as possible. They will set up a special area where every netizen can support their favorite beauties on the "Sunbird" website.

a9603fe00c78f61fdbeb0629ac797a32e1d821a1.sourceText: 新东方艺术学校在下周四（4月28日）为社区的美女开了新课程。她们专门邀请到了有执照的Zumba老师开课。Zumba是一种糅合了热辣、性感的拉丁舞蹈，有节奏的有氧运动，它通过动态的运动形式实现了节奏性。Zumba引入了”锻炼”，这个”锻炼”是在音乐的灵感下、发自内心的快乐的传播基础上进行的。它结合了南美火爆、热辣的拉丁舞蹈体系，包括SALSA舞、MERENUE舞、 CUMBIA舞、SAMBA舞和REGGAETON舞，并且简单易学，降低了学习的高度。
a9603fe00c78f61fdbeb0629ac797a32e1d821a1.translatedText: New Oriental Art School will open a new course for beauties in the community next Thursday (April 28). They specially invited licensed Zumba teachers to give classes. Zumba is a combination of hot and sexy Latin dance and rhythmic aerobic exercise. It achieves rhythm through dynamic movement forms. Zumba introduces "exercise", which is based on the spread of inner happiness inspired by music. It combines the popular and hot Latin dance system of South America, including SALSA dance, MERENUE dance, CUMBIA dance, SAMBA dance and REGGAETON dance, and is simple and easy to learn, reducing the height of learning.

Kempton's lewd behavior was as ridiculous as her nude photos, which spread throughout the campus within a few months. Some students couldn't bear to report it to the principal, and she was finally arrested on the 24th of last month.
