f6e82b94b9e0f5ba81f12b162f50c0b9d433db01.sourceText: 中国牛奶和饮用水尚未检测到放射性物质 菠菜清洗后无害 菠菜清洗后食用对健康无碍 中国疾控中心辐射防护与核安全医学所所长、卫生部核事故医学应急中心主任苏旭11日说，目前我国牛奶和饮用水中尚未检测到放射性物质，检测到放射性物质的菠菜经过清洗后食用不会影响公众健康。 苏旭在卫生部例行新闻发布会上说，只要在我国境内的环境和空气中能检测到放射性物质，对食品和饮用水的检测就会继续下去。广东、江苏、辽宁等沿海地区还布置检测海鲜产品。 近来，国内在一些蔬菜上检测出了放射性物质。吃了这些蔬菜对身体有无影响？针对这一问题，苏旭回答说，最近的一个实验显示，把检测到放射性碘-131的菠菜放到水中浸泡10分钟左右，再清洗一次之后就检测不到碘-131了。微量的情况下清洗一次，能够清洗掉50%左右，清洗三次就可以降低90%以下。 ”目前是很微量的污染，并且可以清洗掉，大家不必要恐慌。”他说，因为含量极微量，所以大家洗菜时也没有什么影响。 苏旭说，目前进行抽检的蔬菜主要是大叶的、表面绒毛的蔬菜。北京地区主要检测菠菜、荠菜、莴苣叶。中国疾控中心共有三台机器可检测放射性物质，蔬菜、饮用水和牛奶各检测一种。因为含量低，检测一个样本要20多个小时，如果含量高几个小时就能检测出来。 苏旭说，环保部公布的数据，空气当中有微量的放射性物质碘-131存在，由于空气当中的放射性物质沉降到地面，会污染地面上露天生长的蔬菜。雨雪天气会加速沉降，相当于把空气中的放射性物质”洗”下来了。因此，在我国部分省区市一些地区菠菜、莴苣叶等一些蔬菜在检测当中有微量的放射性碘-131。 苏旭指出，由于空气当中的放射性物质是极其微量的，因此自然沉降，或是雨雪加速沉降下来的也是极微量的。现在检测到蔬菜表面沾染的放射性物质是非常微弱的。每天食用一公斤这样的蔬菜，产生的辐射剂量负担相当于天然辐射本底一天量的千分之一到千分之三左右。 苏旭还告诉记者，我国已经禁止从日本的12个县进口食品、食用农产品及饲料，日本受污染的食品很难进入国内。 另外，苏旭在回答记者提问时还指出，据专家分析，目前日本福岛核电站附近海洋受核放射物污染比较重，但到目前为止对我国近海没有影响。海洋里的放射性物质扩散比较缓慢，而且海洋的海水量很大，扩散过程中随海水上下涌动，也会不断沉降。
f6e82b94b9e0f5ba81f12b162f50c0b9d433db01.translatedText: Radioactive substances have not been detected in China's milk and drinking water. Spinach is harmless after cleaning. Spinach is harmless to health when eaten after cleaning. Su Xu, director of the Institute of Radiation Protection and Nuclear Safety Medicine at the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention and director of the Nuclear Accident Medical Emergency Center of the Ministry of Health, said on the 11th that radioactive substances have not yet been detected in milk and drinking water in my country. Spinach with detected radioactive substances will not affect public health after being washed and eaten. Su Xu said at a regular press conference of the Ministry of Health that as long as radioactive materials can be detected in the environment and air within our country, testing of food and drinking water will continue. Guangdong, Jiangsu, Liaoning and other coastal areas have also arranged to inspect seafood products. Recently, radioactive substances have been detected in some vegetables in China. Does eating these vegetables have any impact on your body? In response to this question, Su Xu replied that a recent experiment showed that if spinach with radioactive iodine-131 was soaked in water for about 10 minutes, and then washed again, iodine-131 could no longer be detected. In the case of trace amounts, cleaning once can remove about 50%, and cleaning three times can reduce it to less than 90%. "Currently, the contamination is very trace and can be washed away. There is no need to panic." He said that because the content is extremely trace, it will not have any impact when washing vegetables. Su Xu said that the vegetables currently being sampled are mainly large-leaf vegetables with a velvety surface. In Beijing, spinach, shepherd's purse, and lettuce leaves are mainly tested. The Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention has three machines that can detect radioactive substances, one each for vegetables, drinking water and milk. Because the content is low, it takes more than 20 hours to detect a sample. If the content is high, it can be detected in a few hours. Su Xu said that according to data released by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, trace amounts of the radioactive substance iodine-131 are present in the air. Because radioactive substances in the air settle to the ground, they will contaminate vegetables growing in the open air on the ground. Rain and snow will accelerate sedimentation, which is equivalent to "washing" radioactive materials in the air. Therefore, in some provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities in my country, some vegetables such as spinach and lettuce leaves have been tested for trace amounts of radioactive iodine-131. Su Xu pointed out that since the amount of radioactive material in the air is extremely small, the amount that falls naturally or is accelerated by rain and snow is also very small. The radioactive substances detected on the surface of vegetables are very weak. Eating one kilogram of these vegetables every day will produce a radiation dose burden equivalent to about one thousandth to three thousandths of the daily amount of natural radiation background. Su Xu also told reporters that my country has banned the import of food, edible agricultural products and feed from 12 counties in Japan, making it difficult for Japanese contaminated food to enter the country. In addition, when answering reporters' questions, Su Xu also pointed out that according to expert analysis, the ocean near Japan's Fukushima nuclear power plant is currently relatively heavily polluted by nuclear radiation, but so far it has had no impact on my country's offshore waters. Radioactive materials in the ocean diffuse relatively slowly, and the ocean contains a large amount of seawater. During the diffusion process, it will continue to settle as the seawater surges up and down.

be756ed71a8222f1273682d23b9f47c550ffcce1.translatedText: The Chinese Students Association of the University of Arizona (AU) has a karaoke club, which is an entertainment world for Chinese students. At present, KTV Club mainly has two KTV rooms and a chess and card room. In addition, in the living room, there is an entertainment table for students to play Texas Solitaire, Killing Game, Three Kingdoms, online games, etc.; and a multimedia audio and video corner that integrates Wii, Xbox, and movies. The size of each KTV room is approximately equal to that of domestic KTVs; the capacity of each room is approximately 6 to 10 people; the equipment in the KTV is all professional-grade, and the song request system and sound effects are as good as those of domestic cash box KTVs. The chess and card room is about 10 square meters and provides poker, mahjong and various chess games for everyone to play. In the living room, KTV Club provides props, tables and chairs for playing Texas Solitaire and Three Kingdoms. The multimedia audio-visual corner has a large screen, surround speakers, Wii, Xbox and other equipment, giving it a cinematic feel. In addition, all rooms are covered with high-speed WiFi. KTV Club is a non-profit organization and the purpose of charging fees is only to cover operating costs. KTV Club adopts a membership system. Only members are entitled to use all facilities in the club at preferential prices; non-members are required to pay full price if necessary. The only condition for becoming a KTV Club member is that you must be a Chinese student. The Chinese students here include students from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan, as well as foreign Chinese who can speak Chinese. If you meet the conditions, you only need to apply for a KTV Club membership card to become a member. Opening hours: Thursday ~ Sunday

8902425955c96469c8a1f020a126a3c68d79fc5e.sourceText: 2011年ASU中国学生会选举开始了 从4月20日网上11：59分开始到4月23日晚11：59分，ASU中国学生会选举就开始了。本届参选主席的候选人共有三位，名单如下（排名不分先后，依照姓氏拼音排列，候选人履历表及竞选大纲请见链接）： http://www.asucssa.com/news/2010%e5%b9%b4%e4%b8%ad%e5%9b%bd%e5%ad%a6%e7%94%9f%e5%ad%a6%e8%80%85%e8%81%94%e8%b0%8a%e4%bc%9a%ef%bc%88cssa%ef%bc%89%e9%80%89%e4%b8%be%e5%85%ac%e5%91%8a-2/ 黄麟雯 Huang Linwen（女） 李昊 Li Hao（男） 王德轩 Wang Dexuan（男） 请大家详细阅读每位候选人的履历表，并认真投出您的选票。 投票人资格: ASU 所有在读中国学生和中国学者，ASU现任中国教职人员，ASU中国校友均可参加投票 投票具体办法: 确定你心目中的理想人选后，请用你的asu.edu 邮箱发送邮件到 asucssa@gmail.com 邮件主题写上: CSSA Election 邮件内容必须包括: 1) 所投侯选人的名字 2) 投票人ASU 学生卡号码 (10位数字)?注意: 此号码我们只交予ASU核实投票人并予以保密，缺不对外公开！绝无其他用途！公布投票结果时，我们保密所有投票人的名字，只显示学生卡后4位数字 3) 投票人名字 有效票: 不符合以下条件中任何一个的条件的邮件，视为无效票 (1) 必须以asu.edu 邮件信箱发送 (2) 必须提供投票人ASU学生证10位数字号码(1000xxxxxx) (3) 必须提供投票人姓名 (4) 必须在投票时间内发送邮件每封发送到asucssa邮箱的邮件，计算为一张选票；每位投票人只能投票给一位候选人。发送邮件后，CSSA工作人员将会在24小时内回复，如未收到回复邮件，即表明投票不符合有效票的条件。 当选条件：投票截止后，统计出全体有效票中，获得票数最多的候选人当选下任主席。 竞选结果公布时间： 2011年4月25日 星期一
8902425955c96469c8a1f020a126a3c68d79fc5e.translatedText: The 2011 ASU Chinese Student Union election has begun. From 11:59 on April 20th to 11:59pm on April 23rd, the ASU Chinese Student Union election will begin. There are three candidates running for president this year, and the list is as follows (ranked in no particular order, in alphabetical order by surname. Please see the link for candidate resumes and campaign outlines): http://www.asucssa.com/news/2010%e5%b9%b4%e4%b8%ad%e5%9b%bd%e5%ad%a6%e7%94%9f%e5%ad%a6%e8%8 0%85%e8%81%94%e8%b0%8a%e4%bc%9a%ef%bc%88cssa%ef%bc%89%e9%80%89%e4%b8%be%e5%85%ac%e5%91%8a-2/ Huang Linwen (female) Li Hao Li Hao (male) Wang Dexuan Wang Dexuan (male) Please read the resume of each candidate in detail and cast your vote carefully. Voter qualifications: All current Chinese students and scholars at ASU, current Chinese faculty at ASU, and ASU Chinese alumni can vote. Specific voting methods: After determining your ideal candidate, please use your asu.edu email address to send an email to asucssa@gmail.com. Write the subject of the email: CSSA Election. The content of the email must include: 1) The name of the candidate you voted for 2) The voter’s ASU student card number (10 digits)? Note: We only give this number to ASU to verify the voter and keep it confidential and will not disclose it to the public! No other uses! When announcing the voting results, we keep the names of all voters confidential and only show the last 4 digits of the student card 3) Voter's name Valid votes: Emails that do not meet any of the following conditions will be deemed invalid votes (1) Must be sent to the asu.edu email address (2) The voter's 10-digit ASU student ID number (1000xxxxxx) must be provided (3) The voter's name must be provided (4) Emails must be sent during voting hours. Each email sent to the asucssa mailbox counts as one vote; each voter can only vote for one candidate. After sending the email, CSSA staff will reply within 24 hours. If no reply email is received, it means that the vote does not meet the conditions of a valid vote. Conditions for election: After the voting closes, the candidate with the most votes among all valid votes will be counted and elected as the next chairman. Election results announcement time: Monday, April 25, 2011

76462577a6bedc541d5bbf798354b0434e9cf25f.sourceText: 新东方艺术学校正式开学啦(图) 新东方艺术学校 (Eastern Art Academy) 校舍经过三个多月的紧张装修，现已正式投入使用。为此，学校特在四月二日在新校舍举行了开学派对，欢庆这一令人兴奋的喜讯。盼望孩子们尽快入学的家长们兴高采烈，纷纷来到学校参观新校舍，争先恐后给自己的孩子注册课程。老朋友和新朋友们也在这里欢聚一堂，并加入到交谊舞，卡拉OK，扑克牌等各种娱乐游戏的行列中，尽情尽兴，不亦乐乎！ 新东方艺术学校(EAA)位于Chandler市中心，在Ray Road and Alma School Road交叉口的西北角，蓝天中餐馆的北面。新校舍有六千多平方英尺，三个宽敞明亮的舞蹈教室，六间教室和办公室，两个洗手间，一个休息室，可供多种课程同时上课。学校网站为： www.azeaa.com, 电话: (602) 490-8613. EAA目前设有多种儿童和成人课程，其中包括：中国舞，现代舞，美术，儿童合唱，瑜伽，太极和双语幼儿园等。儿童课程按程度和年龄分班，由浅入深。舞蹈课主要学习中国古典舞，民族民间舞和现代舞的基本功和形体训练及舞蹈表演技巧，每学年都将学习1-2舞蹈作品，并有机会参加大型表演。美术课主要引导孩子如何认识和欣赏大自然中的美，并将这种美通过自己的双手表现出来。儿童合唱引导孩子们热爱音乐，懂得欣赏和声效果的美妙，同时培他们的养集体主义精神。双语幼儿园除了照顾好孩子们的生活外，更重要的是通过简捷和有趣的方式对他们进行中国语言和文化的启蒙教育，使他们了解并热爱中国文化。除了儿童课程外，EAA也为家长和成人设立了许多课程，比如舞蹈，美术，瑜伽和太极等。 从四月份开始，学校隆重推出交谊舞俱乐部项目，每周六晚6:30学校开办交谊舞活动，第一个小时由专业的交谊舞老师教授各种交谊舞的步伐技巧，之后舞会开始。望大家踊跃报名，积极参加。详情请登陆EAA网站查询。 为了使孩子们度过一个丰富多彩的夏天，EAA将从今年六月开始举办学龄儿童夏令营。夏令营活动丰富多彩，有中文，儿童合唱，健身操/舞，儿童表演，美术等。这样既丰富了他们的生活，也学到了很多知识。同时，家长们也可以安心工作，不必为孩子假期安排而操心。详情也请登陆EAA网站查询。
76462577a6bedc541d5bbf798354b0434e9cf25f.translatedText: New Oriental Art School has officially opened (picture) After more than three months of intense renovation, the New Oriental Art Academy building has been officially put into use. To this end, the school held a opening party in the new school building on April 2 to celebrate this exciting news. Parents who are looking forward to their children enrolling in school as soon as possible are excited and come to the school to visit the new building and rush to register their children for courses. Old friends and new friends also gather here and join in the ranks of ballroom dancing, karaoke, poker and other entertainment games, having a great time! The New Oriental Art School (EAA) is located in downtown Chandler, at the northwest corner of the intersection of Ray Road and Alma School Road, north of the Blue Sky Chinese Restaurant. The new school building has more than 6,000 square feet, three spacious and bright dance studios, six classrooms and offices, two restrooms, and a lounge, which can accommodate a variety of courses at the same time. The school website is: www.azeaa.com, phone: (602) 490-8613. EAA currently offers a variety of children and adult courses, including: Chinese dance, modern dance, art, children's chorus, yoga, Tai Chi and bilingual kindergarten, etc. Children's courses are divided into classes according to level and age, from easy to advanced. Dance classes focus on learning the basic skills of Chinese classical dance, folk dance and modern dance, as well as physical training and dance performance skills. Each school year, students will learn 1-2 dance works and have the opportunity to participate in large-scale performances. Art classes mainly guide children how to understand and appreciate the beauty in nature and express this beauty through their own hands. Children's chorus guides children to love music and appreciate the beauty of harmonies, while cultivating their collective spirit. In addition to taking good care of children's lives, bilingual kindergartens also provide them with enlightenment education on Chinese language and culture in a simple and interesting way, so that they can understand and love Chinese culture. In addition to children's courses, EAA also offers many courses for parents and adults, such as dance, art, yoga and Tai Chi. Starting from April, the school has launched a ballroom dance club project. The school will hold ballroom dance activities at 6:30 every Saturday night. In the first hour, professional ballroom dance teachers will teach various ballroom dance steps and techniques, and then the dance will begin. We hope everyone will sign up and participate actively. Please log on to the EAA website for details. In order to enable children to spend a colorful summer, EAA will hold summer camps for school-age children starting from June this year. The summer camp activities are rich and colorful, including Chinese, children's chorus, aerobics/dance, children's performances, art, etc. This not only enriched their lives, but also learned a lot of knowledge. At the same time, parents can work without worrying about their children's holiday arrangements. Please also visit the EAA website for details.

07974e931fbe7a6ce6c5a32c0ea4ec4f976ebe78.sourceText: 在台北市信义区，１０１大楼是许多大陆游客必到的景点。针对个人游带来的大量消费能力颇强的高端客户，喜达屋酒店集团旗下的Ｗ酒店和艾美酒店３月底先后在１０１大楼附近开业，台北晶华酒店则计划从下半年起陆续改装５００多间客房，还安排十多位主管假扮普通客人，每周随机试住两间客房以抽查服务品质。
07974e931fbe7a6ce6c5a32c0ea4ec4f976ebe78.translatedText: In Taipei City's Xinyi District, the 101 Building is a must-visit attraction for many mainland tourists. In response to the large number of high-end customers with strong spending power brought by individual travel, Starwood Hotel Group's W Hotel and Le Méridien Hotel opened near the 101 Building at the end of March. Taipei Regent Hotel plans to gradually renovate more than 500 rooms starting from the second half of the year. It also arranged for more than a dozen supervisors to pretend to be ordinary guests and randomly check in two rooms every week to randomly check the service quality.

ec4c2dc771b9f862bdf7f0b6d78324b88bc8c081.sourceText: 在零售业方面，台湾最大的两家连锁超商统一超商和”全家”，已经开始卡位竞争，争夺大陆个人游旅客商机。统一超商率先抢驻桃园机场第二航站楼，全家则在上月进驻松山机场第二航站楼。统一超商投资的药妆连锁店”康是美”，也在全台３００多家店面加装银联卡刷卡机。据统计，去年”康是美”银联刷卡金额达近亿元新台币，较前年增长数倍。
ec4c2dc771b9f862bdf7f0b6d78324b88bc8c081.translatedText: In the retail industry, Taiwan's two largest supermarket chains, Uni-President Supermarket and FamilyMart, have begun competing for card slots to compete for business opportunities from mainland individual tourists. Uni-President Supermarket took the lead in locating in the Terminal 2 of Taoyuan Airport, and FamilyMart entered the Terminal 2 of Songshan Airport last month. Cosmed, a drugstore chain invested by Uni-President Supermarket, has also installed UnionPay card swiping machines in more than 300 stores across Taiwan. According to statistics, last year, the amount swiped by "Cosmed" UnionPay cards reached nearly NT$100 million, an increase of several times compared with the previous year.

15ea5b3120a4bb7aa7854e34c88d3b2b4d5f3131.sourceText: “中国国新办”正式亮相苹果iPad 境内外网民反响热烈(图) 来源:新华网 国务院新闻办公室近日正式亮相苹果平板电脑ｉＰａｄ。由国务院新闻办公室推出的”中国国新办”应用程序已经在苹果软件商店（ＡｐｐＳｔｏｒｅ）上线，境内外网民反响热烈。 中国国新办应用程序包括三部分内容：一是政府白皮书电子书，目前提供从２００５年至２０１０年的２５本白皮书的电子版。白皮书采用ｉＰａｄ电子书格式，中英文双语，支持文字、图片、图表，阅读体验好。二是新闻发布会视频，目前提供从２００９年至２０１１年国务院新闻办举行的十几场新闻发布会的视频资料，既可以点播观看，也可搜索、收藏特定的视频资料。三是国家形象片视频，提供”人物篇”和”角度篇”两个中国国家形象片，英文旁白，中文字幕，方便国内外观众观看。此前，中国国家形象片曾在纽约时代广场大屏幕及ＣＮＮ、ＢＢＣ等西方主流媒体播出。 据了解，国务院新闻办是第一家在ｉＰａｄ上亮相的中国政府部门。自上线以来，”中国国新办”程序连续多日排在苹果软件商店（中国）”畅销榜首”近期下载量最多的程序前１５名，在新闻类程序下载排名居首位，受到国内外用户的广泛好评。”中国国新办”应用程序上线仅三天，即收到苹果用户的４０份评价，其中８０％以上的用户给予了五星满分评价，并普遍赞赏政府发布这一应用程序。有网民说，”让ｉＰａｄ小小屏幕成为宣传中国的大窗口，这主意挺好”。还有网民说，”中国的宣传要多样化，让世界正面了解中国，不要让他们从歪门邪道的渠道曲解中国，当然中国还有不尽如人意的地方，但是相信中国人民会自己逐步处理好的”。有网民赞叹国家形象片拍摄得很漂亮。也有用户建议，”是个好的开端，希望以后多有一些中国元素在上面”。 据国务院新闻办有关负责人介绍，在苹果软件商店平台上推出”中国国新办”应用程序，主要目的是为了让国内外更多的人了解国务院新闻办新闻发布会、政府白皮书等有关内容，更好地向世界介绍中国，提升中国国际形象。”中国国新办”应用程序相关内容还在不断更新和丰富。
15ea5b3120a4bb7aa7854e34c88d3b2b4d5f3131.translatedText: "China's State Council Information Office" officially debuted on Apple iPad, and netizens at home and abroad responded enthusiastically (picture) Source: Xinhuanet The State Council Information Office recently officially unveiled the Apple tablet computer iPad. The "China Information Office" application launched by the State Council Information Office has been launched on the Apple Software Store (AppStore), and has received enthusiastic response from netizens at home and abroad. The China State Council Information Office application includes three parts: First, the government white paper e-book, which currently provides electronic versions of 25 white papers from 2005 to 2010. The white paper is in iPad e-book format, bilingual in Chinese and English, and supports text, pictures, and charts, providing a good reading experience. The second is press conference videos, which currently provide video materials of more than a dozen press conferences held by the State Council Information Office from 2009 to 2011. You can watch them on demand, and you can also search and collect specific video materials. The third is the national image film video, which provides two Chinese national image films, "Characters" and "Angle", with English narration and Chinese subtitles, making it convenient for domestic and foreign audiences to watch. Previously, China's national image films have been broadcast on the big screen in Times Square in New York and on Western mainstream media such as CNN and BBC. It is understood that the State Council Information Office is the first Chinese government department to debut on iPad. Since its launch, the "China State Council Information Office" program has been ranked among the top 15 most downloaded programs in the "Best Sellers List" of the Apple Software Store (China) for many days in a row. It ranks first in the download ranking of news programs and has been widely praised by users at home and abroad. Just three days after the "China State Council Information Office" application was launched, it received 40 reviews from Apple users, of which more than 80% gave a five-star rating and generally appreciated the government's release of the application. Some netizens said, "It's a good idea to make the iPad's small screen a big window to promote China." Some netizens said, "China's propaganda should be diversified, so that the world can understand China in a positive way and not let them misunderstand China through crooked channels. Of course, China still has some unsatisfactory aspects, but I believe the Chinese people will gradually deal with it themselves." Some netizens praised the national image film for being beautifully shot. Some users also suggested, "This is a good start. I hope there will be more Chinese elements on it in the future." According to the relevant person in charge of the State Council Information Office, the main purpose of launching the "China Information Office" application on the Apple Software Store platform is to let more people at home and abroad understand the State Council Information Office press conferences, government white papers and other relevant content, better introduce China to the world, and enhance China's international image. The relevant content of the "China State Council Information Office" application is constantly being updated and enriched.

02c97bba7092f5abc98a488cfefc9331a225e620.sourceText: 青翠墓园—清明节感伤 過去一連三個星期，我在鳳凰城都有不同的活動，先是去美莎參拜為世界和平的玉佛像，顯得一片祥和，坦蕩祈福。跟著是去格欄岱參觀戰機展覽，空中飛翔表演，充滿戰鬥精神，都是轟炸殺戮的氣勢。 上個星期則去天庇市，觀看競渡勝負的龍舟比賽，原是慶祝端午節的助興項目，如今成為一種新的體育活動，呼嘯叫囂，鼓舞歡欣，勁力推進。 這個星期日，却有另一種活動，就是陪同家人與親戚，進行清明節掃墓，緬懷亡故的先人，有些哀傷，有點感慨，比較消極，而且洩氣。 清明節是農曆廿四個節氣之一，春季的第五個節氣，正常在三月，遇閏月時下一年就會在二月出現，日期不準確在哪一天；但根據《故事瓊林》記載：「冬至百六是清明」，即是冬至節過後一百零六日就是清明節。如果換算陽曆，反而較有定期，必然是每年的四月五日，閏年則提前在四月四日。 中國古代是個農業社會，春天氣候最溫和，插秧種田的農耕開始，到三月正好是清新明朗的氣候，人們稍事休憩，趁勢春遊踏青，便順到祖先墓前祭祀，鋤草打掃一番，稱為掃墓。明朝時期，皇帝在清明日舉行祭陵大典，正式詔令這一天為掃墓日，清明節拜山祭墳習俗就是這樣相傳下來。 今年清明節在星期二，鳳凰城這個地方，大家照常上班，太座建議不如趁著星期假日，各人有空，提早兩天去拜祭。意見最佳，立即獲得通過，親戚間互相通報，約定祭禮在週日下午五時進行，購買三牲果餅等祭品，各自處理，豐儉隨意。 雖然這樣，週日還是各有所忙，家人與親戚到來掃墓的仍未算齊全，我家五口，老襟三人，妻的表弟妹兩家六個，總共十四人在一起，算是難得的集合，承傳慎終追遠美德，遵行清明掃墓習俗，聚集在格欄岱市北方路西段的那青翠墳場，入口不遠處，接近鐘樓地方，是岳母那豎立的墓碑，再隔一個路段是妻的大姨丈平躺的碑誌，擺好三牲果餅，插好鮮花，焚香叩首，拜祭先靈。 鳳凰城天氣開始炎熱，接近黃昏的太陽仍猛烈，空曠的墓地遍佈陽光，我們為了遮陽擋曬，頭戴帽子，身穿長袖衣服，加上墨鏡護目，才易抵受。近來各地氣候失常，變化毫無規則，此地也受影響，熱力來得早，剛剛四月初，氣溫上昇華氏九十幾度了。幸好還有陣陣涼風吹來，熄滅了蠟燭，減輕了溫度，拜祭起來倒也不覺酷熱。 在拜祭前後，我佇立遙望青草滿園的墳地，空曠廣闊的墓園，到處是各種豎立或平臥的墓碑，死亡的標記，別有一番黯然神傷！每每憶起岳母，我也滿懷感慨，她老人家一直渴望能與我們團聚生活，誰料一九九七年四月底，我舉家才能移民成功，搬遷過這鳳凰城時又徬徨於適應新環境中，之後才從阿肯色州接她過來同住，三代人共敘天倫，可惜未久竟疾病纏身，不幸於同年十一月逝世，長眠在這個青翠墓園。 唉，人，畢竟難逃生老病死的規律，無論貧富，無論英雄豪傑或販夫走卒，最終的歸宿就是平等地葬身於青翠墓園中。 每次到這墓園，即使青翠，我還是感慨萬千；總會記起三十多年前兩副墓園不朽對聯，鑲嵌在越南堤岸廣肇墳場的永別亭上，前後兩柱，是「永別」與「義祠」的鶴頂格聯句，道盡性命死亡的無奈，令無數人閱後欷歔感嘆不已： 永無富貴能常，世事等浮雲，到此方為真結局， 別謂繁華可久，人生如朝露，從前都是假排場！ 義地闢他鄉，葬者葬，移者移，寸土幾經前過客； 祠堂環古木，風而風，雨而雨，千秋猶蔭後來人。
02c97bba7092f5abc98a488cfefc9331a225e620.translatedText: > Verdant Cemetery - Sentimental Tomb Sweeping Day In the past three weeks, I have had different activities in Phoenix. First, I went to Mesa to pay homage to the Jade Buddha Statue for World Peace, which seemed peaceful and magnanimous. Then we went to Gelundai to visit the fighter aircraft exhibition and aerial flying performances, full of fighting spirit, all with the momentum of bombing and killing. Last week, I went to Tianbi City to watch the dragon boat race. It was originally a fun event to celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival, but now it has become a new sports activity, roaring, cheering, and pushing forward vigorously. This Sunday, there is another kind of activity, which is to accompany family and relatives to sweep the tombs of the Qingming Festival to remember the deceased ancestors. It is a bit sad, a bit emotional, relatively negative, and discouraged. Tomb-sweeping Festival is one of the 24 solar terms in the lunar calendar. It is the fifth solar term in spring. It usually occurs in March. If it encounters a leap month, it will appear in February the next year. The date is not accurate. However, according to the record of "Story Qionglin": "The 16th winter solstice is the Qingming Festival." That is, the Qingming Festival is the 106th day after the winter solstice. If converted to the Gregorian calendar, it is more regular, and it must be April 5th every year. In leap years, it will be April 4th earlier. Ancient China was an agricultural society. The climate was the mildest in spring, when rice planting and farming began. By March, the weather was fresh and clear. People took a break and took advantage of spring outings. They stopped by the tombs of their ancestors to offer sacrifices and hoe and clean them, which is called tomb sweeping. During the Ming Dynasty, the emperor held a tomb-sweeping ceremony on Tomb-Sweeping Day and officially designated this day as tomb-sweeping day. This is how the custom of worshiping mountains and tombs during the Tomb-Sweeping Day has been passed down from generation to generation. Tomb-sweeping Day falls on Tuesday this year. In Phoenix, everyone goes to work as usual. Taizu suggested that we take advantage of the holiday and go to worship two days early when everyone is free. The best opinion was approved immediately. Relatives notified each other and agreed that the sacrifice would be held on Sunday at five o'clock in the afternoon. They purchased three animal fruit cakes and other sacrifices and handled them individually. They were as frugal as they wanted. Even so, everyone was busy on Sunday, and not all family members and relatives came to visit the tomb. My family of five, including three husbands and six of my wife’s cousins, made a total of fourteen people together. It was a rare gathering to inherit the virtue of being prudent and pursuing the future, and to observe the custom of sweeping tombs during the Qingming Festival. People gather in the green cemetery in the west section of North Road in Glendai City. Not far from the entrance, close to the bell tower, is the erected tombstone of the mother-in-law. Another section of the road is the inscription of the wife's great-uncle lying down. Three animal fruit cakes are laid out, flowers are inserted, incense is burned and kowtows are made to pay homage to the ancestors. The weather in Phoenix has begun to get hot, and the sun is still fierce near dusk. The empty cemetery is full of sunlight. To protect ourselves from the sun, we wear hats, long-sleeved clothes, and sunglasses to protect our eyes, which makes it easier to withstand it. The climate in various places has been abnormal recently, with irregular changes, and this place has also been affected. The heat has come early. In early April, the temperature has risen to more than 90 degrees Fahrenheit. Fortunately, there were still gusts of cool breeze blowing, extinguishing the candles and reducing the temperature, so I didn't feel too hot during the worship ceremony. Before and after the worship ceremony, I stood and looked at the grassy cemetery. The vast and empty cemetery was filled with all kinds of upright or lying tombstones, signs of death. I felt very sad! Every time I think about my mother-in-law, I am filled with emotion. She has always longed to live with us again. Unexpectedly, at the end of April 1997, my family would be able to successfully immigrate. When we moved to Phoenix, we were hesitant to adapt to the new environment. Then I brought her over from Arkansas to live with her. We had a family together for three generations. Unfortunately, she soon became ill and passed away in November of the same year. She is buried in this green cemetery. Alas, people, after all, cannot escape the law of life, old age, illness and death. No matter rich or poor, no matter heroes or traffickers, the final destination is to be buried equally in the green cemetery. Every time I visit this cemetery, even though it is green, I am still filled with emotions; I always remember the two immortal couplets in the cemetery more than 30 years ago, which were inlaid on the farewell pavilion of Guangzhao Cemetery in Vietnam's embankment. Don't say that prosperity lasts forever, life is like morning dew, it was all fake pomp in the past! The righteous land is opened to a foreign land, those who are buried are buried, those who are moved are moved, and the passers-by pass by several times; the ancestral hall is surrounded by ancient trees, which are still shaded by the wind and rain, and the generations that come after thousands of years.

d5ded636129ea5d6d3653735c802cd90070b28b4.sourceText: 职业四月放飞中国学生的美国梦 “无老板公司”助你成功 （莉香 冯海燕报道） 4月3日下午1点到3点，在亚利桑那州立大学（ASU）MU楼236室，一场名为’回国创业专题’的讲座成功举行。演讲嘉宾廉绵弟先生与ASU一众中国学子分享了他的创业经历与心得。’给自己当老板已成为了不可避免的趋势。’ 廉绵弟说道。 作为国内半导体集成电路专家和美国AD器件在我国推广应用的最早开拓者，廉先生提出的’无老板公司’模式引发了台下中国学子的热烈提问。无老板公司将为新创业者提供一个公司的外壳，加入者只要拥有自己的技术，加入’无老板公司’后，就能获得一些老前辈的咨询，找到开拓市场的路，公司还会给加入的成员提供公司名，办公地址，基本办公设施，财务人员等支持，帮助新创业者解决很多技术之外的琐碎问题。 ”无老板公司是个很有意思的概念，”ASU材料工程二年级本科生王德轩说道，”虽然我目前还不大清楚它的可行性，不过我愿意多花点时间了解它。” 主讲人廉绵弟将自己的创业经历写成《蜕变》一书，并在亚省时报连载刊出。他的”无老板公司”、”知本家”、”知本论”等很多新概念都在书中详细阐述。 本次讲座，连同前一天4月2号举办的”职业招聘与面试专题”讲座，同为ASU中国学生学者联谊会（CSSA）”职业四月”活动的一部分。此次活动旨在帮助中国学子充实课外生活，开拓眼界，提前对未来时行规划。嘉宾们都是在美打拼多年，来自半导体、IT等各行各业的前辈。 ASU机械工程一年级研究生，CSSA组织部部长梁煜表示学生会举办这次活动就是希望能帮助中国学生熟悉在美国找工作的流程，希望大家能提前有所准备。 5月1日CSSA更将隆重推出由半导体协会主办的亚利桑那职业招聘会，参展单位众多，主要以招聘华人学生为主，助中国学子圆”美国梦”。
d5ded636129ea5d6d3653735c802cd90070b28b4.translatedText: Career April will release the American dream of Chinese students with "bossless companies" to help you succeed (reported by Lixiang Feng Haiyan) From 1 to 3 pm on April 3, in Room 236, MU Building, Arizona State University (ASU), a lecture titled "Returning to China to Entrepreneurship" was successfully held. Guest speaker Mr. Lian Miandi shared his entrepreneurial experience and insights with a group of Chinese students from ASU. ’ Being your own boss has become an inevitable trend. ’ Lian Miandi said. As a domestic semiconductor integrated circuit expert and the earliest pioneer in the promotion and application of American AD devices in my country, Mr. Lian’s ‘bossless company’ model triggered heated questions from the Chinese students in the audience. The bossless company will provide a company shell for new entrepreneurs. As long as the participants have their own technology, after joining the "bossless company", they will be able to get consultation from some seniors and find ways to expand the market. The company will also provide the members with company name, office address, basic office facilities, financial personnel and other support to help new entrepreneurs solve many trivial problems other than technology. "The bossless company is a very interesting concept," said Wang Dexuan, a second-year undergraduate materials engineering student at ASU. "Although I don't know its feasibility yet, I am willing to spend more time to understand it." The speaker, Lian Miandi, wrote his entrepreneurial experience in the book "Transformation" and published it serially in the Alberta Times. Many of his new concepts such as "bossless company", "knowing one's family" and "knowing one's roots" are all elaborated in the book. This lecture, together with the "Career Recruitment and Interview Special Topic" lecture held on April 2 the day before, is part of the "Career April" activities of the ASU Chinese Students and Scholars Association (CSSA). This event aims to help Chinese students enrich their extracurricular life, broaden their horizons, and plan for the future in advance. The guests are all seniors from various industries such as semiconductor and IT who have worked in the United States for many years. Liang Yu, a first-year graduate student in mechanical engineering at ASU and director of the CSSA Organization Department, said that the student union hopes to organize this event to help Chinese students become familiar with the process of finding a job in the United States, and hopes that everyone can prepare in advance. On May 1, CSSA will grandly launch the Arizona Career Fair sponsored by the Semiconductor Association. There will be many exhibitors, mainly recruiting Chinese students, to help Chinese students realize the "American Dream."

1d229b227c0581cdb94b3f1c8210ec65f2f6638c.sourceText: 4月8日晚6点亚利桑那Diamondback棒球队在凤凰城市中心的体育馆拉开了2011年的首个主场比赛的序幕，这算是凤凰城棒球迷的一件大事。天空中轰鸣的战机，绚丽的烟火，把这一晚装点得像盛大的节日。Diamondback也不负球迷们的众望，首场比赛13-2大获全胜。当然这一天也与我们华人有关，因为台湾慈善组织慈济的师兄师姐们也穿梭在棒球迷中间。这一天也是慈济为日本地震募捐的大获全胜的日子。 几天前，慈济凤凰城联络处与Diamondback棒球队负责人联系，准备与他们一起合作慈善募捐活动。对方非常的乐意，在Diamondback球队每年募捐的几千万慈善基金中，很少和亚裔的合作，所以这次慈善活动合作意向很快就落实了。4月8日是2011年首个主场比赛，球队表示观众会比较多，是慈济宣传慈善的非常好的时机。慈济凤凰城联络处也迅速反应，策划出了50/50活动计划，就是慈济在比赛现场卖抽奖券，所得费用，一半给球队，一半由慈济捐给日本 灾区。球队如果赢了比赛，奖券购买者不仅可以获得抽奖奖品，还可以拿回购买奖券的现金。奖券买得相当顺利，比赛还没有正式开始，有些师兄手里的所有奖票都卖光了。比赛正式开始，主办方在大屏幕上播出了慈济筹款捐助日本地震的消息，很多球迷都主动找到慈济销售现场要求买奖券。大约在8点左右所有的奖券都销售一空，很多慈善大德买不到奖票，就直接把钱放到了募捐箱。 八点多慈济的志工们凯旋而归，当晚共募捐到$2700。为日本筹集善款的活动还在进行中，目前一位华裔大德捐出了2.56克拉的钻石（架F – VVS1-正方形有GIA的证书。）给慈济，计划义卖募得35000美金。有意义买的大德请与慈济凤凰城联络480-838-6556。
1d229b227c0581cdb94b3f1c8210ec65f2f6638c.translatedText: At 6 pm on April 8th, the Arizona Diamondback baseball team kicked off its first home game in 2011 at the stadium in downtown Phoenix. This is a big event for Phoenix baseball fans. The roaring fighter planes and gorgeous fireworks in the sky decorated the night like a grand festival. Diamondback also lived up to the expectations of the fans, winning the first game 13-2. Of course, this day is also related to us Chinese, because brothers and sisters from the Taiwanese charity organization Tzu Chi are also among baseball fans. This day was also a great success for Tzu Chi in raising funds for the earthquake in Japan. A few days ago, the Tzu Chi Phoenix Liaison Office contacted the head of the Diamondback baseball team and prepared to work with them on a charity fundraising event. The other party was very happy. Among the tens of millions of charitable funds raised by the Diamondback team every year, there are very few cooperation with Asians, so the intention to cooperate in this charity event was quickly implemented. April 8 is the first home game in 2011. The team said there will be a large number of spectators and it is a very good opportunity for Tzu Chi to promote charity. The Tzu Chi Phoenix Liaison Office also responded quickly and planned a 50/50 event plan, in which Tzu Chi sold raffle tickets at the game site, with half of the proceeds going to the team and half donated by Tzu Chi to the disaster-stricken areas in Japan. If the team wins the game, the ticket purchaser not only receives raffle prizes, but also gets back the cash used to purchase the tickets. The lottery ticket purchase went very smoothly. The competition has not officially started yet, and all the lottery tickets in the hands of some senior brothers have been sold out. The competition officially started, and the organizer broadcast the news about Tzu Chi’s fundraising efforts to donate to the earthquake in Japan on the big screen. Many fans took the initiative to approach Tzu Chi’s sales site and asked to buy raffle tickets. All the raffle tickets were sold out around 8 o'clock. Many philanthropists couldn't buy the raffle tickets, so they just put their money in the donation box. Tzu Chi volunteers returned home in triumph at around 8 o'clock and raised a total of $2,700 that night. The activity to raise funds for Japan is still in progress. Currently, a Chinese eminent person has donated a 2.56-carat diamond (F – VVS1-square with GIA certificate.) to Tzu Chi. The charity sale is planned to raise US$35,000. If you are interested in purchasing, please contact Tzu Chi Phoenix at 480-838-6556.

According to McDonald's data, there are 14,000 chain stores in the United States, more than 90% of which are independently operated franchise stores. 75% of restaurant managers and 50% of shop owners work behind the counter. There are 277 McDonald's chains in the state and more than 12,700 employees. This recruitment offers part-time and full-time positions. Applicants can submit their resume directly to the local McDonald's or apply online: McDonalds.com.

6f449c3261049d001c9dc35f67633a045d6635d7.sourceText: 邱文琪荣获南加州杰出模范优秀青年奖 中華會館暨南加州全僑各界為慶祝中華民國建國百年青年節,特別舉辦2011年南加州傑出模範優秀青年表揚大會,南加州一共選出二十五位各行各業的青年模範與精英,共同表彰,獎勵,肯定,及重視模範青年對社會的服務,成就,與貢獻. 鳳凰城國際姊妹會台北姊妹市委員會主席邱文琪榮獲南加州傑出模範優秀青年獎,是由南加州中文學校聯合會推薦與提名,是唯一來自亞利桑那州鳳凰城的青年得獎人.頒獎典禮熱鬧隆重,是在三月二十五日下午七時在洛杉磯市中心金龍大酒店舉行,全南加州各社團負責人及代表六百多人均參加此盛會.出席這項大會的主要籌備委員會與貴賓中有中華會館主席陳健邦,籌備會主任委員馬國城,副主任委員李榮傑,聶澤英,泛美中華聯誼會秘書長黃金泉,僑務委員及籌備會總幹事張自豪,幹事文光華,加州眾議員伍國慶,蒙特利市長趙譚美生,洛杉磯經文處副處長劉克裕,洛杉磯僑務中心主任簡許邦,副主任丘昌生及南加州全僑各界僑團領導等. 邱文琪榮獲南加州傑出模範優秀青年獎是因為她多年來獻身義工,熱心公益,努力宣傳與發揚中華文化,結合與融入美國主流社會,積極進行多元文化交流,全力推動國民外交,並做為加強,維護,聯絡和協助亞利桑那州鳳凰城與台灣台北市友誼與友好關係的橋樑,對促進鳳凰城市與台北市,兩市的文化,教育,藝術,經貿,與科技交流有很卓越的貢獻. 邱文琪獲得南加州傑出模範優秀青年獎牌外,又獲得另外三張獎狀,包含蒙特利市長趙譚美生Betty Tom Chu市長頒發的市長,副市長與三位議員聯合共同肯定與簽名的City of Monterey Park表揚模範優秀青年獎狀,及加州國會議員Judy Chu的Certificate of Congressional Recognition肯定邱文琪為華人社會所付出的貢獻,以及加州眾議員伍國慶Mike Eng代表加州參眾議會所頒發的California Legislature Certificate of Recognition表揚傑出優秀青年獎狀. 邱文琪表示很感謝也很榮幸能獲得中華會館及南加州全僑各界慶祝中華民國建國百年青年節舉行表揚優秀青年大會,所共同給予她的2011年傑出模範優秀青年獎,這份殊榮,意義與認可是鼓勵她去做更多更有意義的事,繼續做全職義工,宣傳中華文化,促進國民外交,協助鳳凰城市與台北市的友好關係與各項交流活動,及服務奉獻社會.她希望藉此機會能帶引青年朋友們一起來做義工,為國家社會盡一份心力,藉著義工與服務的機會為自己帶來學習,進步,成長,與寶貴的經驗.上週邱文琪為鳳凰城台北姊妹市又再度贏得第一名城市獎,是她為鳳凰城台北姊妹市2009年,2010年與2011年連續三年獲得第一名城市,本週她又代表亞利桑那鳳凰城獲得南加州傑出模範優秀青年獎,真是雙喜臨門,為鳳凰城台北姊妹市又增添榮耀,喜悅,與光彩.
6f449c3261049d001c9dc35f67633a045d6635d7.translatedText: Qiu Wenqi won the Southern California Outstanding Model and Outstanding Youth Award. In order to celebrate the Centennial Youth Day of the founding of the Republic of China, the Chung Hwa Association and all overseas Chinese in Southern California held the 2011 Southern California Outstanding Model Youth Commendation Conference. Southern California selected a total of 25 young models and elites from all walks of life to jointly commend, reward, affirm, and value the service, achievements, and contributions of model youths to society. Chiu Wenqi, Chairman of the Taipei Sister City Committee of the Phoenix International Sisterhood, won the Southern California Outstanding Model Outstanding Youth Award. She was recommended and nominated by the Southern California Chinese School Association and is the only young awardee from Phoenix, Arizona. The awards ceremony was a lively and grand ceremony, which was held at 7:00 pm on March 25 at the Golden Dragon Hotel in downtown Los Angeles. More than 600 leaders and representatives of various societies in Southern California attended this event. The guests who attended the conference Among the important guests of the preparatory committee were Chen Jianbang, chairman of the Chinese Association, Ma Guocheng, chairman of the preparatory committee, Li Rongjie, deputy chairman, Nie Zeying, Huang Huangquan, secretary-general of the Pan-American Chinese Friendship Association, Zhang Zi, the overseas Chinese affairs committee member and director-general of the preparatory committee. Hao, Secretary Wen Guanghua, California Representative Wu Guoqing, Monterey Mayor Zhao Tamsheng, Deputy Director of the Los Angeles Cultural Affairs Office Liu Keyu, Director of the Los Angeles Overseas Chinese Affairs Center Jian Xubang, Deputy Director Qiu Changsheng and leaders of overseas Chinese organizations from all walks of life in Southern California, etc. Qiu Wenqi won the Southern California Outstanding Model Outstanding Youth Award because she has been dedicated to volunteer work for many years, is enthusiastic about public welfare, strives to promote and promote Chinese culture, integrates and integrates into mainstream American society, actively engages in multicultural exchanges, promotes national diplomacy, and serves as a bridge to strengthen, maintain, contact and assist the friendship and friendly relations between Phoenix, Arizona and Taipei, Taiwan. She has made outstanding contributions to the promotion of culture, education, art, economics, trade, and scientific and technological exchanges between Phoenix, Arizona and Taipei, Taiwan. In addition to receiving the Southern California Outstanding Model and Outstanding Youth Medal, Qiu Wenqi also received three other certificates, including the City of Monterey Park Certificate of Commendation for Model and Outstanding Youth jointly recognized and signed by the Mayor of Monterey, Mayor Betty Tom Chu, the Vice Mayor and three council members, and the Certificate of Congressional Recognition from California Congressman Judy Chu in recognition of Qiu Wenqi's contribution to the Chinese society, and the California Congressman Mike Wu Eng represents the California Legislature Certificate of Recognition issued by the California State Senate in recognition of outstanding young people. Qiu Wenqi expressed her gratitude and honor to receive the 2011 Outstanding Model Youth Award jointly given to her by the Chinese Association of Chinese Associations and the Southern California Chinese Association of Southern California Youth Day to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Republic of China. Encourage her to do more meaningful things, continue to be a full-time volunteer, promote Chinese culture, promote national diplomacy, assist in the friendly relations and various exchange activities between Phoenix City and Taipei City, and serve and contribute to society. She hopes to take this opportunity to bring young friends together Become a volunteer and do your part for the country and society. Use the opportunities of volunteering and service to bring learning, progress, growth, and valuable experience to yourself. Last week, Qiu Wenqi once again won the first city award for Phoenix Taipei Sister City 2. She won the first place city for three consecutive years in 2009, 2010 and 2011. This week she won the Southern California Outstanding Model Outstanding Youth Award on behalf of Phoenix, Arizona. This is a double blessing, adding glory, joy, and brilliance to Phoenix, Taipei's sister city.

3abbbfb50e6ac4f528765781a342d214ec969bb2.sourceText: 亚省统一税草案第一次闯关失败 众议会通过参议会否决 备受争议的统一税草案大幅简化亚利桑那州的州所得税提案，在本届议会闯关失败。提案人说明年再次尝试。 共和党籍众议院史提夫科特告诉媒体，虽然结果出乎意料，他还有很多问题与会计师商讨，需要找出更多的理由说服两会议员。该法案将减去标准扣除、供养豁免和扣除等五项州所得税税率简化成一项。 立法预算工作人员分析发现，在收入低于10万美元的纳税人多缴税款，而收入高于10万的纳税人将少缴税。 州众议会上周通过了草案，参议会则否决 票占多出局。
3abbbfb50e6ac4f528765781a342d214ec969bb2.translatedText: The Alberta flat tax bill failed to pass the first hurdle and was rejected by the Senate. The controversial flat tax bill significantly simplified Arizona's state income tax proposal and failed in the current Congress. The proposer said he would try again next year. Republican House of Representatives Steve Cote told the media that although the results were unexpected, he still had many issues to discuss with accountants and needed to find more reasons to convince members of the two chambers. The bill simplifies five state income tax rates, minus the standard deduction, support exemption and deduction, into one. A legislative budget staff analysis found that taxpayers making less than $100,000 will pay more in taxes, while taxpayers making more than $100,000 will pay less. The state House of Representatives passed the bill last week, but the Senate rejected it with a majority of votes.

79327d85f6612ca4390642bd3d0678089195eaf8.sourceText: 华美半导体协会凤凰城分会选出2011届理事会(图) 华美半导体协会凤凰城分会（CASPA_PHOENIX）于2011年3月5日在Shangri-la举行了年度酒会，几位CASPA的顾问和理事会成员聚集一堂，愉快的品味了中国美食，席间交流一年来的心得和收获。酒会后，在主席施晟的主持下召开了理事会，会上回顾了CASPA凤凰城分会的历史，对今年的工作做了规划。 今年是 CASPA成立20周年(1991 to 2011), CASPA将有Job Fair和一系列的讲座 服务 于大家。 会上对5月1日星期天下午在Fiesta Resort (2100 South Priest Dr., Tempe, AZ 85282) 举行的CASPA 硅谷凤凰城高科技人才招聘会进行了分工和安排. 华美半导体协会凤凰城分会将继续秉承促进中美间半导体行业交流的桥梁和为本会成员的职业发展提供平台的作用,同时和亚省华人工商联合总会，科工专，高科技协会，清华校友会等一起活跃凤凰城地区的华人活动，更好的服务社区。 会上公布了新的一届理事，名单如下： 施晟 周浩华 王乐军 吴宁 冯晓欣 邹粤林，李新华，谢洪,谢强华等CASPA 前几任会长, 到会对新理事会表示祝贺，并预祝人才招聘会的成功, 会后大家一块合影留念. 前排左起： 施晟 王乐军 周浩华 冯晓欣 后排左起：谢强华 李新华 邹粤林 谢洪 吴宁 华美半导体协会感谢大家的支持，欢迎大家参加即将召开的招聘会和有关的讲座，具体情况请点击 http:// www. caspa. com / node /773
79327d85f6612ca4390642bd3d0678089195eaf8.translatedText: The Phoenix Chapter of the China and America Semiconductor Association elected the 2011 Board of Directors (Picture) The Phoenix Chapter of the Chinese and American Semiconductor Association (CASPA_PHOENIX) held its annual cocktail party in Shangri-la on March 5, 2011. Several CASPA consultants and board members gathered together to enjoy Chinese food and exchange experiences and gains over the past year. After the cocktail party, the Board of Directors was held under the chairmanship of Chairman Shi Sheng. At the meeting, the history of the CASPA Phoenix Chapter was reviewed and work planned for this year was made. This year is the 20th anniversary of CASPA (1991 to 2011). CASPA will have a Job Fair and a series of lectures to serve everyone. At the meeting, the division of labor and arrangements were made for the CASPA Silicon Valley Phoenix High-tech Talent Recruitment Fair to be held on the afternoon of Sunday, May 1 at Fiesta Resort (2100 South Priest Dr., Tempe, AZ 85282). The Phoenix Chapter of the China-American Semiconductor Association will continue to uphold its role of promoting exchanges in the semiconductor industry between China and the United States and providing a platform for the career development of its members. At the same time, it will work with the Alberta Chinese Chamber of Commerce, the Science and Engineering College, the High-Tech Association, the Tsinghua Alumni Association, etc. to activate Chinese activities in the Phoenix area and better serve the community. The new board of directors was announced at the meeting, and the list is as follows: Shi Sheng, Zhou Haohua, Wang Lejun, Wu Ning, Feng Xiaoxin, Zou Yuelin, Li Xinhua, Xie Hong, Xie Qianghua and other past CASPA presidents attended the meeting to congratulate the new board of directors and wish the success of the talent recruitment fair. After the meeting, everyone took a group photo together. Front row from left: Shi Sheng, Wang Lejun, Zhou Haohua, Feng Xiaoxin Back row from left: Xie Qianghua, Li Xinhua, Zou Yuelin, Xie Hong, Wu Ning. Huamei Semiconductor Association thanks everyone for your support. Everyone is welcome to attend the upcoming job fair and related lectures. For details, please click http://www.caspa.com/node/773

da8d6f3d6a793bc502b923e83bccd69cb1c17157.sourceText: 董事会否決1月16日“新董事会”议案 呼欲华人加入华联参加选举 ３月27日下午2時，亞利桑那華人華僑聯合總會（華聯）在錢德勒圖書關舉行擴大會議。到會人員近二十人，大部分是華聯的董事和會員。在會議上，主席陶世誠向與會人員公佈了董事會的決議。經投票表決，10位董事會成員同意否決1月16日成立華聯新董事會的決議。新董事會的任命也為無效。華聯按社團章程，籌備5月新董事會和新主席的選舉。 華聯副主席廖峰給與會者宣讀了華聯會員的基本資格要求：華聯的社團宗旨是傳播中華文化，服務於華人社區，支持當地的中文學校，組織文化活動，促進中國與亞利桑那的經濟文化交流。只要是尊重，支持華聯社團宗旨的自然人都可以申請加入華聯。申請人可以與華聯，現代中文學校，希望中文學校，耆英會（華人老年活動社團）負責人聯繫，程序非常的簡單，入會後有資格參加5月份的選舉。
da8d6f3d6a793bc502b923e83bccd69cb1c17157.translatedText: The board of directors vetoed the "new board of directors" motion on January 16, calling for Chinese people to join Hualian and participate in the election. At 2 p.m. on March 27, the Arizona Chinese Federation (Hualian) held an enlarged meeting at Chandler Library. There were nearly twenty people present, most of whom were directors and members of Hualian. At the meeting, Chairman Tao Shicheng announced the board of directors' resolution to the participants. After voting, 10 board members agreed to veto the resolution on January 16 to establish a new board of directors of Hualian. The appointment of the new board of directors is also invalid. According to the association's articles of association, Hualian is preparing for the election of a new board of directors and a new chairman in May. Hualian Vice Chairman Liao Feng read out the basic qualification requirements for Hualian members to the attendees: The purpose of Hualian's association is to spread Chinese culture, serve the Chinese community, support local Chinese schools, organize cultural activities, and promote economic and cultural exchanges between China and Arizona. As long as they respect and support the purpose of Hualian Association, any natural person can apply to join Hualian. Applicants can contact the person in charge of Hualian, Modern Chinese School, Hope Chinese School, and Senior Citizens Association (Chinese Senior Activity Association). The procedure is very simple. After joining the association, you will be eligible to participate in the May election.

b2524a9772965cb97c742253b1912c9e4e993deb.sourceText: 实施移民苛法 亚省损失1.4亿 鳳凰城市長高登28日表示，亚利桑那州針對打擊非法移民的SB1070法案，不僅對該州經濟產生負面影響，亦衝擊公共安全和教育。 福斯新聞報導，葛登表示，該州持續遭受去年SB1070法案通過後，各方發動經濟抵制的影響，許多大型會議和學術研討會紛紛取消在該州舉行。他在土桑市亞利桑那大學演說時表示：「這些取消讓西語裔和非西語裔的企業，受到同樣的影響。」 根據華府美國進步中心的分析，亞利桑那州已因遭受抵制，損失逾1億4000萬元。 高登表示，該法已造成民眾對警察的信任大幅降低，並不會讓社區更加安全。他說：「我相信有很多移民，特別是西語裔，不敢再向警方檢舉社區中的罪犯，因為他們擔心被逮捕和盤問移民身分。」 高登指出，反對非法移民的人士，經常批評非法移民對美國公共服務和教育耗用的成本，卻不談這些移民也有繳稅。 SB1070法案對本州的後遺症，也可顯現在許多新屋已滯銷好幾個月，這個骨牌效應亦傷害所有的企業，不論大、小型公司均流失許多客戶。 高登說，目前本州面臨最大的挑戰，在於形象問題，某些公司只是因為不想捲入移民的爭議，而與該州保持距離。 另外，高登表示，聯邦當局未能通過全面移民改革法案，對無身分學生的影響最大。他指出：「如果無法達成全面移民改革，夢想法案的通過就更為迫切。」讓有心貢獻社會的優秀年輕人，至少可獲得合法身分。
b2524a9772965cb97c742253b1912c9e4e993deb.translatedText: Implementing harsh immigration laws, costing Alberta a loss of 140 million Phoenix Mayor Gordon Gordon said on the 28th that Arizona's SB1070 bill to combat illegal immigration not only has a negative impact on the state's economy, but also affects public safety and education. Fox News reported that Gordon said that the state continues to be affected by the economic boycott launched by various parties after the passage of SB1070 last year, and many large conferences and academic seminars have been canceled in the state. "These cancellations have affected Hispanic and non-Hispanic businesses equally," he said in a speech at the University of Arizona in Tucson. According to an analysis by the Center for American Progress in Washington, Arizona has lost more than $140 million due to the boycott. Gordon said the law has caused a significant loss of public trust in the police and will not make communities safer. He said: "I believe that many immigrants, especially Hispanics, are no longer afraid to report criminals in the community to the police because they are worried about being arrested and questioned about their immigration status." Gordon pointed out that opponents of illegal immigration often criticize the cost of illegal immigrants on U.S. public services and education, but do not mention that these immigrants also pay taxes. The consequences of the SB1070 bill for the state can also be seen in the fact that many new homes have been unsold for several months. This domino effect has also hurt all businesses, both large and small companies have lost many customers. Gordon said the biggest challenge facing the state right now is its image, with some companies simply distancing themselves from the state because they don't want to get involved in the immigration controversy. In addition, Gordon said the failure of federal authorities to pass a comprehensive immigration reform bill will have the greatest impact on undocumented students. He pointed out: "If comprehensive immigration reform cannot be achieved, the passage of the Dream Act will be even more urgent." This allows outstanding young people who are determined to contribute to society to at least obtain legal status.

1a136a9d2ea66fa50a8bad791e52c698765c1ed6.sourceText: 霍恩hit-and-run辩称无罪 （亚省时报） 亚利桑那州总检察长汤姆霍恩撞车逃逸一案，11月2日在凤凰城法院提审，霍恩被指控一项碰撞无人看管车辆后离开现场，三等轻罪。 马利科巴郡检察长比尔蒙哥马利宣读FBI10月1日发表的调查报告，涉及霍恩非法筹集竞选资金和车祸信息。 霍恩说，（三月二十七日）车祸发生时，他因为没有注意到停车场有任何车辆损坏后才离开的。没想到他当时的一举一动全落在监视他的联邦调查探员眼里。 霍恩的代表律师辩称霍恩无罪。
1a136a9d2ea66fa50a8bad791e52c698765c1ed6.translatedText: Horn's hit-and-run pleads innocence (Alberta Times) The hit-and-run case of Arizona Attorney General Tom Horn was arraigned in a Phoenix court on November 2. Horn was charged with one count of leaving the scene after colliding with an unattended vehicle, a third-degree misdemeanor. Maricopa County Attorney Bill Montgomery read out the FBI's investigative report released on October 1, which involved Horn's illegal fundraising of campaign funds and information about the car accident. Horn said that when the car accident occurred (March 27), he left because he did not notice any damage to any vehicles in the parking lot. Unexpectedly, his every move at that time fell into the eyes of the federal investigators who were monitoring him. Horn's attorney argued that Horn was not guilty.

5e8d6057dd9db4bc6e729b2e5c3bce2191a199a5.sourceText: 图森男因Chick-fil-A事件遭解雇 (亚省时报)全美第二大炸鸡店Chick-fil-A公司总裁日前提出反对同性婚姻的言论，遭到全国各地同性恋支持者的示威抗议，并带来一串连锁反应。 日前，任职图森一家医疗用品公司高层的亚当斯史密斯，在网上发布了一段视频，咒骂Chick-fil-A公司总裁。虽然，史密斯不久就将视频删除，但他也很快辞去Vante公司首席财务总监的职务。 Vante总裁罗杰沃格尔承认，史密斯下台跟他的不当言论有直接关系。
5e8d6057dd9db4bc6e729b2e5c3bce2191a199a5.translatedText: > Tucson man fired over Chick-fil-A incident (Alberta Times) The president of Chick-fil-A, the second-largest fried chicken restaurant in the United States, recently expressed his opposition to same-sex marriage, which was met with demonstrations and protests by gay supporters across the country, causing a series of chain reactions. A few days ago, Adams Smith, who works as a senior executive for a medical supplies company in Tucson, posted a video online cursing the president of Chick-fil-A. Although Smith soon deleted the video, he also quickly resigned from his position as Vante's chief financial director. Vante president Roger Vogel admitted that Smith's ouster was directly related to his inappropriate remarks.

01235c37760e99b82b43652876fc7bcdbefa37c6.sourceText: 总检察长麻烦大 带着小三Hit and Run （亚省时报） 亚利桑那州总检察长汤姆霍恩流年不利，今年三月二十七日发生的车祸逃逸案一直被人揪住不放。FBI就本案调查报告指出，霍恩当日逃逸，是因为他车上还有一名乘客，那名乘客正是他的情人。 联邦调查局特工说，霍恩当日在一个停车场，驾驶一辆黑色的车，倒车驶离停车位时碰到一辆白色揽胜，导致揽胜车头保险杠凹陷和脱色，而他驾驶的黑色车也有伤痕。车祸发生后，他们亲眼目睹霍恩和他的乘客在车上坐了10秒钟，没有人下车，没有人检查被撞车辆是否有损伤，然后驾车离开。 调查报告指出，事故发生地点是霍恩婚外情人香奈女士所住的公寓停车场，当时香奈正在车上，霍恩驾驶的车也是香奈的，霍恩不想他的婚外情曝光，所以驾车逃离现场。 其实，霍恩与香奈的婚外情在检察院已不是秘密。他们的婚外情可以追溯到霍恩担任州教育总监时代，霍恩当选总监察长后，更将她带到检察院工作，并给她超过10万美元年薪。 评：别以为养小三包二奶是中国官员做的事，美国官员也学了。
01235c37760e99b82b43652876fc7bcdbefa37c6.translatedText: The Attorney General is in big trouble, and he is with his mistress Hit and Run (Alberta Times) Arizona Attorney General Tom Horn is having a bad time, and people have been holding on to the car accident that occurred on March 27 this year. The FBI investigation report on this case pointed out that Horn escaped that day because there was another passenger in his car, and that passenger was his lover. FBI agents said that Horn was driving a black car in a parking lot that day. When he was reversing out of the parking space, he hit a white Range Rover, causing the Range Rover's front bumper to be dented and discolored, and the black car he was driving also had scratches. After the accident, they witnessed Horne and his passengers sitting in the car for 10 seconds. No one got out of the car, no one checked whether the hit vehicle was damaged, and then drove away. The investigation report pointed out that the accident occurred in the parking lot of the apartment where Horn's extramarital lover Ms. Chanel lived. Chanel was in the car at the time. The car driven by Horn also belonged to Chanel. Horn did not want his extramarital affair to be exposed, so he drove away from the scene. In fact, Horn and Chanel's extramarital affair is no longer a secret in the prosecutor's office. Their extramarital affair can be traced back to when Horn was the state education director. After Horn was elected inspector general, he brought her to work in the prosecutor's office and gave her an annual salary of more than $100,000. Comment: Don’t think that raising mistresses is something Chinese officials do. American officials have also learned it.

fb227b61cd1d9cdaf83a8d5635cd7d92b462e1ce.sourceText: 健身塑形好去处，时尚快乐zumba舞 —-何春玲老师ZUMBA健身舞免费公开课在新东方艺术学校举行 2013新年伊始，新东方艺术学校就为社区奉献了一堂ZUMBA健身舞的免费公开课。1月9号晚上，资深ZUMBA健身教练何春玲老师带领二十多位学员共同体验了Zumba健身舞对身体所产生的神奇效果。 在一个小时的时间里，学员们跟随春玲老师在热情奔放的拉丁音乐中，自由舒展、放松心情、挥汗如雨、释放热量。一堂健身课下来，来健身的姐妹们无论以前有没有接触过Zumba，都觉得Zumba是一种让人快乐的舞蹈。学员们共同的感受是舒服尽兴，有的当场就和春玲老师约下了下次上课的时间。 春玲老师告诉大家，在哥伦比亚语中的意思是”快速有趣的运动”，它将热情、奔放、活力、动感的拉丁音乐与独特的舞步结合，让所有Zumba的参与者在舞蹈的时候可以毫无顾忌，自由发挥。春玲老师在教学中遵循”轻松、快乐、运动”的原则，将塑身的动作与简单的舞步结合在一起，加入中国古典舞的元素，使得没有任何舞蹈基础和健身经验的学员也能在这一个小时的时间里跟随音乐自由舞动，实现最大卡路里消耗，燃烧脂肪与全身均衡发展。 新年的来临，使我们每个人对生活和理想都充满了新的希望。健康的身体无疑将会是幸福生活的第一保障，如果你正在选择一种适合自己的健身方式。那么，何不就让我们来新东方艺术学校体验一下春玲老师的快乐健身舞呢！ 何春玲老师在给大家讲解 学员们跟随春玲老师学习Zumba舞 何春玲老师简介： 职业ZUMBA健身教练，拥有ZUMBA教练执照。自小学习中国舞。春玲老师成为ZUMBA的职业教练后，凭借自身深厚的中国舞蹈功底，将拉丁风格的ZUMBA结合中国古典舞和中国民族民间舞，独创了风格迥异的ZUMBA健身舞。春玲老师的ZUMBA健身舞，既保持了ZUNBA拉丁舞热情奔放的风格，又融入了中国舞蹈幽雅细腻的中国元素。在春玲老师的ZUMBA健身舞里，既可看见SALSA、 CHACHA、SAMBA、 CUBIA、FLEMINGO、 MERENGE、HIPHOP和其他各种南美舞蹈的特点，也能看到包括 中东舞蹈，肚皮舞， 印度的BOLLYWOOD舞蹈，甚至中国的秧歌的影子。这使得春玲老师的学员在跳健身舞的同时 不只身体得到锻炼、曲线得到塑造， 也能充分享受舞蹈本身的美感。
fb227b61cd1d9cdaf83a8d5635cd7d92b462e1ce.translatedText: A good place for fitness and shaping, fashionable and happy zumba dance—-Teacher He Chunling’s free ZUMBA fitness dance open class was held at New Oriental Art School At the beginning of the new year of 2013, New Oriental Art School offered a free open class of ZUMBA fitness dance to the community. On the evening of January 9th, senior ZUMBA fitness instructor He Chunling led more than 20 students to experience the magical effects of Zumba fitness dance on the body. For one hour, the students followed Teacher Chunling to stretch freely, relax, sweat like rain, and release heat in the passionate Latin music. After a fitness class, all the sisters who came to exercise felt that Zumba was a dance that made people happy, regardless of whether they had been exposed to Zumba before. The common feeling among the students was that they felt comfortable and happy, and some made an appointment with Teacher Chunling on the spot for the next class. Teacher Chunling told everyone that Zumba means "fast and fun movement" in Colombian. It combines passionate, unrestrained, energetic and dynamic Latin music with unique dance steps, allowing all Zumba participants to dance freely and freely. Teacher Chunling follows the principle of "relaxation, happiness, and movement" in her teaching, combining body-shaping movements with simple dance steps, and adding elements of Chinese classical dance, so that students without any dance foundation or fitness experience can dance freely to the music in this one-hour period, achieving maximum calorie consumption, burning fat and balanced development of the whole body. The arrival of the New Year makes each of us full of new hope for life and ideals. A healthy body will undoubtedly be the first guarantee for a happy life, if you are choosing a fitness method that suits you. So, why not let us come to New Oriental Art School to experience Teacher Chunling’s happy fitness dance! Teacher He Chunling is explaining to everyone. Students learn Zumba dance with Teacher Chunling. Introduction to Teacher He Chunling: Professional ZUMBA fitness coach with ZUMBA coaching license. I have been learning Chinese dance since I was a child. After Teacher Chunling became a professional coach of ZUMBA, she relied on her profound Chinese dance skills to combine Latin-style ZUMBA with Chinese classical dance and Chinese folk dance to create a unique ZUMBA fitness dance. Teacher Chunling’s ZUMBA fitness dance not only maintains the passionate and unrestrained style of ZUMBA Latin dance, but also incorporates the elegant and delicate Chinese elements of Chinese dance. In Teacher Chunling’s ZUMBA fitness dance, you can see not only the characteristics of SALSA, CHACHA, SAMBA, CUBIA, FLEMINGO, MERENGE, HIPHOP and other South American dances, but also the shadows of Middle Eastern dance, belly dance, Indian BOLLYWOOD dance, and even Chinese Yangko. This allows Ms. Chunling’s students to not only exercise their bodies and shape their curves while dancing fitness dance, but also fully enjoy the beauty of the dance itself.

9d197b12794503843c760af78b09f176f4eec2f2.sourceText: ”巧妆靓颜”化妆讲座—-高级造型师Cindy现场进行妆容示范 1月19日晚上，在新东方艺术学校内举行了一场主题为”巧妆靓颜”的化妆讲座。高级造型师Cindy在两个小时的时间里为二十几位来宾讲解了化妆的步骤、化妆工具的用法、化妆品的作用，并且现场请了两位不同年龄的嘉宾做模特为大家进行妆容示范。 Cindy首先为大家介绍了多款化妆工具的使用和化妆品的不同功效。通过她的讲解，来宾们对各种化妆工具的使用方法先有了一个全面的了解。接着Cindy又给大家介绍了各种粉底、眼影、眉粉、腮红等化妆品的用法。 讲座的第二个步骤是请现场佳宾做模特，由Cindy 来为大家做妆容示范。第一位模特是一位年轻的孩子妈妈，Cindy为她化了一个简单明了的生活妆。Cindy首先分析了她的脸型和肤色，然后为她选择了一款颜色中性的粉底，用眉粉修饰了眉型；紧接着又为大家示范了夹睫毛和上睫毛膏的方法，接下来就是腮红和口红的选择的涂法。在整个过程中，不断有佳宾提问，Cindy都 非常耐心地为大家做了解答。化妆之后的女嘉宾妆容清新，非常得体。 如果说对第一位模特的妆容示范让大家学到了非常实用的化妆技巧，那么第二位模特的妆容示范给大家带来的更多的是美的欣赏。这是一位二十多岁的年轻女孩，天生丽质，长得十分清新雅致。Cindy为她化了一个晚妆之后，女孩子则又呈现出明艳华贵的动人姿态。可见不同的妆容的选择，对人的外表影响很大。Cindy告诉大家，晚妆或者酒会妆的化妆过程和生活妆基本差不多，只是在颜色和造型的选择上有所不同。 讲座在嘉宾的不断提问中结束。朋友们围着Cindy询问自己关心的各种问题。”什么样的粉底最适合我？”；”唇型长得不是很满意怎么办？”；”怎么使脸型显得长一点？”；”两眼的距离太窄了怎么办？”厖面对大家的提问，Cindy都一一做了解答，最后她说：”诸如此类的问题，其实是我们每一个普通人都很关心的，通过化妆的确可以掩饰很多缺陷，但是大家一定要根据场合选择适合的妆容，否则就会弄巧成拙。” 主讲人简介：Cindy Wong 黄欣明，高级造型师。于2008年毕业于 International Academy of Hair Design，并于同年考得亚利桑那高级美容师（Cosmetologist）执照，随后即于国际著名发型机构 Toni & Guy 工作并接受深造培训。于2010年创办魅力造型 Beauty by Cindy，曾多次为州际选美、婚纱秀选手进行化妆造型。高中毕业于广州美术高中的她，对色彩、造型有着独特的触觉。总能根据各人不同的脸型、身高、职业、发质设计出不同的造型。耐心、细心的她在顾客中留有良好的口碑！ 更多详情请点击： http://www.beautybycindy.net/
9d197b12794503843c760af78b09f176f4eec2f2.translatedText: "Skilled Makeup and Beautiful Face" Makeup Lecture - Senior Stylist Cindy gives a makeup demonstration on the spot On the evening of January 19, a makeup lecture with the theme of "Smart Makeup for Beautiful Face" was held in New Oriental Art School. In two hours, senior stylist Cindy explained the steps of makeup, the use of makeup tools, and the functions of cosmetics to more than 20 guests. She also invited two guests of different ages to act as models to demonstrate makeup for everyone. Cindy first introduced everyone to the use of various makeup tools and the different effects of cosmetics. Through her explanation, the guests had a comprehensive understanding of how to use various makeup tools. Then Cindy introduced everyone to the use of various foundations, eye shadows, eyebrow powders, blushes and other cosmetics. The second step of the lecture is to invite the guests on site to act as models, and Cindy will give a makeup demonstration for everyone. The first model is a young mother of a child, and Cindy put on a simple and clear lifestyle makeup for her. Cindy first analyzed her face shape and skin color, then chose a neutral-colored foundation for her, and used eyebrow powder to modify her eyebrow shape. Then she demonstrated how to curl eyelashes and apply mascara, and then how to choose blush and lipstick. During the whole process, guests kept asking questions, and Cindy answered them patiently. After makeup, the female guest's makeup was fresh and very decent. If the first model's makeup demonstration taught everyone very practical makeup skills, then the second model's makeup demonstration brought everyone more appreciation of beauty. This is a young girl in her twenties, naturally beautiful, very fresh and elegant. After Cindy put on her evening makeup, the girl once again showed a bright and luxurious appearance. It can be seen that the choice of different makeup has a great impact on a person's appearance. Cindy tells everyone that the makeup process for evening makeup or cocktail makeup is basically the same as daily makeup, except for the selection of colors and styles. The lecture ended with continuous questions from the guests. Friends gathered around Cindy and asked various questions they cared about. "What kind of foundation is best for me?"; "What should I do if I am not satisfied with the shape of my lips?"; "How can I make my face look longer?"; "What should I do if the distance between my eyes is too narrow?" Cindy answered everyone's questions one by one. Finally, she said: "Questions like these are actually of great concern to every one of us ordinary people. We can indeed cover up many flaws through makeup, but we must choose the right makeup according to the occasion, otherwise it will be self-defeating." Introduction to the speaker: Cindy Wong, senior stylist. Graduated from the International Academy of Hair Design in 2008 and obtained the Arizona Cosmetologist license in the same year. Later, she worked at the internationally renowned hairstyling agency Toni & Guy and received advanced training. She founded the glamor styling company Beauty by Cindy in 2010 and has done makeup and styling for interstate beauty pageants and wedding show contestants many times. She graduated from Guangzhou Fine Arts High School and has a unique sense of color and shape. Different styles can always be designed according to different face shapes, heights, occupations, and hair textures of each person. She is patient and attentive and has a good reputation among customers! For more details, please click: http://www.beautybycindy.net/

c6ae8acbee04217f9a8fdfadf3cb5153016611a6.sourceText: 劳动节长周末我们一起爬山(Hiking)一起”睡觉”(Camping)(图) 山水相间的神秘谷 借用８月７日参加中国科学家工程师协会亚利桑那分会（科工专）组织的金水湖之旅的朋友开的玩笑，下次活动建议大家”’一起爬山一起睡觉”’，这回真的要成行了。 ９月４日劳动节长周末，科工专组织大家进行露营爬山活动。目的地在Cave Spring Campground, Sedona。建议大家在中午之前到达，以确保有露营的位置。详细情况请看下面链接： http://www.go-arizona.com/Cave-Springs-and-Pine-Flat-Campgrounds/ ９月５日在塞多纳的神秘谷爬山（Secret Canyon, Sedona），早上１０点出发，景区出发点集合。希望拼车的朋友请于早上８点在１０１高速和17号高速交界处西南角的Target碰面。下面是爬山的具体路线图： Secret Hiking Trail: http://www.americansouthwest.net … /secret_canyon.html Map and direction: http://www.americansouthwest.net/arizona/sedona/map.html 爬山当天的午餐下午１点在神秘谷。科工专提供餐具饮料和水果，每个人２美元，会员免费。 大家可以选择只参加任意一天的活动，也可以两天活动都参加，准备好了吗？赶紧发邮件报名吧！Amoy Yang (email: amoy_y@yahoo.com ) Camping/Hiking at Sedona (Labor Day: 9/4-9/5) Hope all or most enjoyed gold-water lake hiking on 8/7. Now we are planning to have another FUN activity during labor-day long weekend. 9/4(Sunday): Camping/Short-hiking/Swimming/BBQ, etc. at Cave Spring Campground, Sedona. Suggest arriving there before noon to ensure camp site (will be further confirmed). Check detail at the link below: http://www.go-arizona.com/Cave-Springs-and-Pine-Flat-Campgrounds/ 9/5(Monday, labor-day): Hiking at Secret Canyon, Sedona. We will meet at trail start-point at 10:00 AM. And for those who prefer/need car-pool, please meet at parking lot of Target Store at 8:00 AM (SW corner of 101-loop and I-17). Hiking info is enclosed below: Secret Hiking Trail: http://www.americansouthwest.net … /secret_canyon.html Map and direction: http://www.americansouthwest.net/arizona/sedona/map.html Pot-luck picnic for lunch (around 1:00 PM) at Secret Canyon after hiking. Please respond to this email ASAP – whether you will participate camping, hiking or BOTH! Thanks for your supporting and hope to see you soon! Amoy Yang (email: amoy_y@yahoo.com ) ACSE Phoenix
c6ae8acbee04217f9a8fdfadf3cb5153016611a6.translatedText: During the Labor Day long weekend, we hiked together and "camped" together (photo). The mysterious valley with alternating mountains and rivers. Borrowing a joke from a friend who participated in the Jinshui Lake trip organized by the Arizona Branch of the Chinese Association of Scientists and Engineers (Science and Engineering College) on August 7, I suggest that everyone "hiking together and sleeping together" for the next event, and this time it will really happen. During the Labor Day long weekend on September 4th, the Science and Technology College organized everyone to have camping and mountain climbing activities. 323b7acd641c913df222cfd672921b0d4e5af651.sourceText: 苏智瑛：艺术作品欣赏——–回顾国庆绘画比赛（组图） 艺术作品不仅是一副优美的图画，它还是沟通心灵的桥梁以引导观赏者的感受，想像，与深思。我们今天欣赏的不是艺术大师是作品，而是成长在我们身边可爱的孩子们的。他们一副副生动感人的画面让我们聆听到了孩子们的心声。 自4月初得知这次比赛后， 每一个小苏画室的学生都自发地要求参加这个可以用自己的才华来谱写他们心声的艺术比赛。看到孩子们的激情和奋发向上，做为老师我也很想把他们的创作过程来和大家分享。 从生性活泼的六岁女孩Katie Tian说起，年龄虽小但酷爱绘画，从选题到创意她提了很多的想法，她想绘出最美的烟火，但最后还是在她搜集的一堆照片中发现了一张站在海边的她带着灿烂的微笑。仅六岁的她，让我有点担心，她能画出这样高难度的肖像画吗？可这个疑问在第一次看到她大胆的构图时就消失了。Katie不仅有绘画天份还有一颗坚持不懈的心，每次遇到画得不满意的时候她总要修改到她认为的完美。她的作品「自由国土」反映了Katie无拘无束的大胆手笔，以酷似印象派的手法来恰切地表现了光线和色彩。Connie Zhu 是一为温文尔雅的15岁高中生，在她认真努力的绘画过程中不仅仅为她的作品「礼花下的城市｣带来高品质的效果，还影响着周围其他孩子，孩子们都说Connie 姐姐很优秀。Rina Li和 Kana Li姐妹俩多才多艺各创作了一副「跨越」和「幸福的家」都体现了俩姐妹对美国的爱，姐姐Rina 喜欢马，她的作品以轻柔的背景来衬托跨越障碍的奔马。妹妹Kana 选了全家福，再配上亚省的著名风光，浓厚的西部画风在小Kana的手笔下表现的淋漓尽致，八岁Emily Lei 的「独立宣言」似乎把我们穿越到了两百多年前的1776年7月4号，她手拿星条旗，在静静地聆听着震撼世界的’独立宣言?#12290;十三岁的Ada Qu以她娴熟的画技创作了「伟人」作品，再现了美国著名画家和雕塑家格桑.博格勒姆的壮观雕塑巨作，以纪念这四位功勋卓著的前总统。Kevin Tang和Khristopher Luo俩位男孩活泼中带着一点稚气，可就因为这种个性使他们的作品大气而不拘小节。观察力和想像力丰富的Lena Han以自由女神，石鹰，和她本人为主题描绘了不同质感而意境突出的「塑造」。 每一位学生都通过自己的观察理解来创作每一幅作品。当一张张白纸在学生们描绘刻画逐渐呈现出一幅幅感人的画面时，学生及家长们也都相互欣赏赞美，画室里充满了一片温馨和谐的气氛。 篇幅所限不能在此描述更多的优秀作品。
323b7acd641c913df222cfd672921b0d4e5af651.translatedText: Su Zhiying: Appreciation of works of art——Reviewing the National Day Painting Competition (Photos) A work of art is not only a beautiful picture, but also a bridge to communicate with the soul to guide the viewer's feelings, imagination, and deep thoughts. What we appreciate today is not the works of art masters, but the lovely children who grow up around us. Their vivid and touching pictures allowed us to hear the children's voices. Since learning about this competition in early April, every student in Xiaosu Studio has spontaneously requested to participate in this art competition where they can use their talents to write their own voices. Seeing the children's passion and hard work, as a teacher I also want to share their creative process with everyone. Let’s start with Katie Tian, ​​a lively six-year-old girl who loves painting even though she is young. She put forward many ideas from topic selection to creativity. She wanted to draw the most beautiful fireworks, but in the end she found a picture of her standing on the beach with a bright smile among a bunch of photos she collected. She is only six years old, which makes me a little worried. Can she draw such a difficult portrait? But this doubt disappeared the first time I saw her bold composition. Katie not only has a talent for painting but also has a perseverant heart. Whenever she encounters a painting that is not satisfactory, she always has to modify it until she thinks it is perfect. Her work "Freeland" reflects Katie's unfettered boldness, using an Impressionist approach to express light and color. Connie Zhu is a gentle and elegant 15-year-old high school student. In her diligent painting process, she not only brought high-quality effects to her work "City Under Fireworks", but also influenced other children around her. The children all said that Sister Connie was excellent. The multi-talented sisters Rina Li and Kana Li each created "Leap" and "Happy Home", both of which reflect the two sisters' love for the United States. The elder sister Rina likes horses, and her works use a soft background to set off the galloping horses that cross obstacles. My younger sister Kana chose a family portrait, coupled with the famous scenery of Alberta. The strong western painting style is vividly expressed in little Kana's handwriting. Eight-year-old Emily Lei's "Declaration of Independence" seems to take us back to more than two hundred years ago on July 4, 1776. She holds the Stars and Stripes in her hand and quietly listens to the world-shaking 'Declaration of Independence? #12290; Thirteen-year-old Ada Qu used her skillful painting skills to create the "Great Man" work, which reproduces the spectacular sculpture masterpiece of the famous American painter and sculptor Kelsang Borglum to commemorate these four outstanding former presidents. Kevin Tang and Khristopher Luo are two boys who are lively and a little childish, but because of this personality, their works are grand and informal. Lena Han, who is rich in observation and imagination, uses the Statue of Liberty, the Stone Eagle, and herself as themes to depict "shaping" with different textures and outstanding artistic conception. Each student creates each piece through their own observation and understanding. As the students drew and painted on pieces of white paper, touching pictures gradually emerged. Students and parents also admired and praised each other, and the studio was filled with a warm and harmonious atmosphere. Space limitations prevent us from describing more excellent works here.

d4b445a5418ddd7863f5d51c68076c16bee5234e.sourceText: 2011ASU中国留学生卡拉OK大赛：缪莹和音乐的故事（组图） 缪 莹 缪莹2010年进入ASU学习企业营销，去年就参加ASU卡拉OK比赛并取得了第二名的好成绩，今年她又来了！缪莹说再次参加比赛，能得奖最好，不得奖也会开心。因为从小到大，她就与音乐有很多很多的故事。8岁的时候，缪莹和家人到伯伯开的KTV唱歌，爸爸突然发现女儿的乐感，音准都很好。爸爸年轻时就是个音乐爱好者，还当过乐队的主唱，所以家中的小公主得到了自己的遗传，也颇得意。 喜欢音乐的一家人 缪莹初三开始学习美声，在学校，市，省都获得过歌唱比赛的奖项，如今就唱到了美国的亚利桑那。海外的业余生活并不像国内那么丰富多彩，问到缪莹，在美国最难忘的事情有什么？她说是今年年初，好朋友们给她度过的人生第21个生日。朋友们在车上用荧光棒摆出很多漂亮的图案和文字，在夜光里闪烁，她和朋友们一起歌唱，一起放烟花，特别感动。音乐是她生活中非常重要的部分，她很期待10月22日晚，和朋友们一起分享快乐的歌声。 周末音乐盛宴 不见不散
d4b445a5418ddd7863f5d51c68076c16bee5234e.translatedText: 2011 ASU Chinese International Students Karaoke Competition: Miao Ying and Music’s Story (Photo) Miao Ying Miao Ying entered ASU to study corporate marketing in 2010. Last year she participated in the ASU Karaoke Competition and achieved second place. This year she is here again! Miao Ying said that participating in the competition again would be the best if she could win a prize, and she would be happy if she didn't win. Because she has had many, many stories with music since she was a child. When she was 8 years old, Miao Ying and her family went to sing at the KTV owned by her uncle. Her father suddenly discovered that her daughter had a good sense of music and intonation. My father was a music lover when he was young and was the lead singer of a band, so the little princess in the family got her inheritance and was quite proud of it. A family who loves music Miao Ying started learning Bel Canto in the third year of junior high school. She has won awards in singing competitions at school, city and province, and now she can sing in Arizona, USA. Amateur life overseas is not as colorful as at home. I asked Miao Ying, what is the most unforgettable thing in the United States? She said that it was her 21st birthday that her good friends celebrated at the beginning of this year. Her friends used fluorescent sticks to place many beautiful patterns and words on the car, which flashed in the night light. She sang and set off fireworks with her friends, which was particularly touching. Music is a very important part of her life, and she is looking forward to sharing happy singing with her friends on the evening of October 22nd. Weekend music feast, see you there or not

4e4c7628d45384dca1c32cb5cdb4ed8c16e80650.sourceText: 本田召回55万辆CR-V和Pilots车款 （亚省时报） 由于大灯可能丧失照明功能，本田汽车（Honda）正召回55万台CR-V小型跨界休旅车（Compact Crossover）以及Pilot运动型多功能（SUV）车种。 该公司表示，由于线路问题导致车头灯束光失灵并进而丧失照明功用。而根据美联社消息指出此次本田车种的线路问题是在于连结车前灯开关的线路不太牢靠而导致过一段时间后线路可能因此松脱。 召回的型号分别是：2002-2004年份的CR-V车型与2003年出厂的Pilots车款。 本田于官网上表示，到现在为止尚无任何关于此项问题的车祸或损伤事件报告发生。 拥有此类型号的车主将于四月底前收到回厂检修通知单。若你想要知道您的爱车是否在召回行列的更快信息，请上本田官网（ www.recalls.honda.com ）或拨打800-999-1009转分机4查询。
4e4c7628d45384dca1c32cb5cdb4ed8c16e80650.translatedText: Honda recalls 550,000 CR-V and Pilots models (Alberta Times) Honda is recalling 550,000 CR-V compact crossover and Pilot sport utility (SUV) models due to possible loss of lighting function in the headlights. The company said that due to wiring problems, the headlight beam failed and thus lost its lighting function. According to the Associated Press, the wiring problem in Honda models this time is that the wiring connecting the headlight switch is not reliable, which may cause the wiring to loosen after a period of time. The recalled models are: 2002-2004 CR-V models and 2003 Pilots models. Honda stated on its official website that there have been no reports of accidents or injuries related to this issue so far. Owners of such models will receive a factory inspection notice before the end of April. If you want faster information to know whether your car is under recall, please go to Honda's official website (www.recalls.honda.com) or call 800-999-1009 extension 4 to inquire.
