1d75a98c31785605f6cb14cbfb68311b87ec0d54.sourceText: 不上火，营养好，去VOLCANO 火锅吧! 秋意见凉。这个季节，对于爱好美食的人来说是惬意的，尤其是火锅。虽然依旧期盼冬天的造访，呼一口冷气，摩拳擦掌，喝着冰水吃着火锅，尽情体会那种冰火两重天的刺激；但也终于不再有夏天闷热的鼓噪，烈日当头，浑汗淋漓却时不时禁不起的诱惑 。 今秋伊始，有幸来到了一个VOLCANO火锅店麻辣药材火锅。得知此店，是因为多位朋友推荐这里的火锅与众不同－不上火。这对于日渐注重健康美食的人来说，尤其爱美的女士，是一块不可多得的福地。 火锅，对于中国人来说，难以抗拒。不仅仅在于它的美味儿，更在于它所传达的一种文化棗和谐。 能凑成一桌围在一个锅子吃火锅的人，很少是还处于应酬级别的关系，要么是三五成群的知己好友、同学同事，要么是一大家子，更有热恋中的情侣，守着一个火锅，多少呢喃细语，柔情蜜意，尽融在锅中袅袅腾起的热气中。而在这种和谐中，少去了会上火、新鲜健康食品，更让人享受无穷。VOLCANO火锅便给人们提供了一个难得全身心放松的悠闲之地。 吃火锅的过程也是感情催化的一个过程。最重要的第一步就是选锅底。辣汤锅底是免不了的，火锅的魅力就在于那股浓厚香韵的辣味能够让食物瞬间凝聚齐所有的美味的精髓，刺激起你的味蕾。VOLCANO火锅底料里加入了十多种清热降火的中草药配方料来平衡花椒，辣椒的燥火，在保留药膳的功效和麻辣鲜香的同时，也克服了一般药膳味太浓的弊端，同时也达到了好吃不上火的目的，堪称火锅底料中的极品。 接着是选菜，餐馆里火锅自助台上面所列生鲜菜式品种花样是越来越多，也越来越令人食指大动。亲朋好友这时可以随心所欲，每人挑几样自己可心的品种，看看其他人拿的，也不赖，有时也可藉着拿菜，了解身边人的性格爱好。 奇脆五花肉鲜和脆，下锅轻涮几秒钟，便可见五花肉十足的脆劲儿，没有过分的打弯，涮久了也不会变的面腻，很有嚼劲，让人回味无穷。奇火涮油条是VOLCAON火锅的特色，在锅里涮几番，吃起来浓浓汤汁，让人吃了又想吃。肥羊肉，水晶牛肉、秘制牛小排这些肉食，是火锅的必点经典菜系，更是VOLCANO火锅的经典菜系，VOLCANO火锅非常注重菜品，这些食材都是他跟同事到全国各地考察之后精挑细选出来的，绝对保证口感和正宗。 终于，火旺了，汤底也开了，水花从锅的中心向上沸起，这时候是吃火锅的过程中最快乐的一刻，各人抄起自己最爱吃的菜，迫不及待地投入欢快扑腾着的锅中，稍待一会儿，左右涮一涮，提起来再放入事先早已拌好的调料碗中，然后入口大嚼。VOLCANO的小料按着口感和喜好相互调伴，这种过程也是一种享受。 VOLCANO主旨就是开心、快乐、喜欢、喜悦，再加上中药食材的底料，堪称”吃了不上火的快乐火锅”。 火锅，演变至今，已有百年的历史。悠久历史下蕴含了深邃的文化，更是中国人骨子里热情、团结、开朗、豁达的最好诠释。要将这种文化继续延续和发扬下去，并不断地充实它、丰富它、美化它，这种过程，也是一种积淀.
1d75a98c31785605f6cb14cbfb68311b87ec0d54.translatedText: It won’t cause internal heat and is nutritious. Let’s go to VOLCANO hot pot! It’s cool in autumn. This season is pleasant for people who love food, especially hot pot. Although I still look forward to visiting in the winter, taking a breath of air-conditioning, gearing up, drinking ice water and eating hot pot, and fully experiencing the excitement of the two worlds of ice and fire; but finally there is no longer the sultry noise of summer, the scorching sun, dripping with sweat, but the temptation that can't be resisted from time to time. At the beginning of this autumn, I was lucky enough to visit a VOLCANO hotpot restaurant called Spicy Herbal Hotpot. I learned about this restaurant because many friends recommended the hotpot here to be unique - not overly hot. This is a rare blessing for people who are increasingly paying attention to healthy food, especially women who love beauty. Hot pot is irresistible to Chinese people. Not only because of its delicious taste, but also because of the cultural harmony it conveys. Those who can sit together at a table and eat hot pot in a pot are rarely on a social level. They are either small groups of close friends, classmates and colleagues, or a large family, or even a couple in love, guarding a hot pot, with many whispers and tenderness, all melting into the steam rising from the pot. In this kind of harmony, there are fewer sources of irritation and fresh and healthy food, which makes people enjoy endless enjoyment. VOLCANO hot pot provides people with a rare and leisurely place to relax wholeheartedly. The process of eating hot pot is also a process catalyzed by emotion. The most important first step is to choose the pot base. Spicy soup base is inevitable. The charm of hot pot is that the strong spicy flavor can condense all the delicious essence of the food in an instant, stimulating your taste buds. VOLCANO hot pot base contains more than ten kinds of heat-clearing and fire-reducing Chinese herbal formula ingredients to balance the dryness of Sichuan peppercorns and chili peppers. While retaining the efficacy of medicinal food and the spicy and delicious flavor, it also overcomes the shortcomings of general medicinal food being too strong. At the same time, it also achieves the purpose of being delicious but not irritating. It can be called the best hot pot base. Next comes the choice of dishes. There are more and more varieties of fresh dishes listed on the hot pot buffet table in the restaurant, and they are becoming more and more exciting. Relatives and friends can do whatever they want at this time. Each person can choose a few varieties that they like and see what others are getting. It’s not bad. Sometimes, you can also get to know the personalities and hobbies of the people around you by picking up the dishes. The crispy pork belly is fresh and crispy. After simmering it for a few seconds, you can see how crispy the pork belly is. There is no excessive bending. It will not become greasy after being simmered for a long time. It is very chewy and makes people have endless aftertaste. Qihuo-shabu fried dough sticks is a specialty of VOLCAON hot pot. After shabu-shabu several times in the pot, it tastes thick and thick, making people want to eat it again and again. Meats such as fat lamb, crystal beef, and secret beef short ribs are must-try classic dishes for hot pot, and they are also classic dishes for VOLCANO hot pot. VOLCANO hot pot attaches great importance to the dishes. These ingredients are carefully selected by him and his colleagues after inspecting all over the country, and the taste is absolutely guaranteed to be authentic. Finally, the fire is high, the soup base is boiling, and the water is boiling upward from the center of the pot. This is the happiest moment in the process of eating hot pot. Everyone picks up their favorite dishes and can’t wait to throw them into the cheerful pot. Wait for a while, rinse them from side to side, lift them up and put them into the seasoning bowl that has been mixed in advance, and then eat them in your mouth. VOLCANO's ingredients are mixed with each other according to taste and preference. This process is also a kind of enjoyment. The main theme of VOLCANO is happiness, joy, love and joy. Coupled with the base of traditional Chinese medicine ingredients, it can be called "a happy hotpot that doesn't get angry". Hot pot has a history of hundreds of years since its evolution. The long history contains profound culture, which is the best interpretation of the enthusiasm, unity, cheerfulness and open-mindedness of the Chinese people. We must continue and carry forward this culture, and constantly enrich, enrich and beautify it. This process is also a kind of accumulation.

0d7e4f2d3975045e55b8ffe3d6008aa9503bfa48.sourceText: 吉尔伯特市（Gilbert）房地产信息 （亚省时报） 吉尔伯特市（Gilbert）是全美发展最快的城市之一…
0d7e4f2d3975045e55b8ffe3d6008aa9503bfa48.translatedText: Gilbert Real Estate Information (Alberta Times) Gilbert is one of the fastest growing cities in the United States...

ec59f9ac69079a33b15fddb8b3527480049246ba.sourceText: 吉尔伯特市（ Gilbert ）是全美发展最快的城市之一。与钱德勒（ Chandler ）高科技区相邻, 并有多个教育水平很好的学校，新区发展的配套设施完备而受到购房者的亲睐。从 2011 年 1 月到 5 月以来吉尔伯特市每月的房屋销售量都在 1000 个交易以上，每平方尺的价格在 84 美元。五月份以后由于房源数量明显下降，所以销售大约在每月 700 个房屋交易，每平方英尺的价格也由 84 美元逐步上升至 85-86 美元。 2011 年 11 月到 12 月，平均价格已经达到每平方英尺 88 美元。 2012 年 1 月目前的房屋销售量达到 594 个交易，每平方尺的价格依然会比较平稳的保持在原位。更多房地产信息请咨询金信地产 Tinna (480)-287-0180 E-mail:goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
ec59f9ac69079a33b15fddb8b3527480049246ba.translatedText: Gilbert is one of the fastest growing cities in the United States. It is adjacent to the Chandler high-tech district and has many schools with excellent educational standards. The new area has complete supporting facilities and is favored by home buyers. Home sales in Gilbert City have been above 1,000 transactions per month from January to May 2011, with prices per square foot at $84. Since May, the number of listings has dropped significantly, so sales have been around 700 housing transactions per month, and the price per square foot has gradually increased from $84 to $85-86. Between November and December 2011, the average price had reached $88 per square foot. Home sales currently stand at 594 transactions in January 2012, and prices per square foot will remain relatively stable. For more real estate information, please contact Gold Trust Realty Tinna (480)-287-0180 E-mail:goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

619268ac2ee3a4306cd559a3ce506715726566f4.translatedText: The 2012 Global Chinese Golf Club Cup Championship was held in Huangshan, China in October.

18460ad4e0c73368e7ab555229c26447acf9db6e.translatedText: The 2012 Global Chinese Golf Club Cup Championship was held in Huangshan, China in October. In order to promote the global Chinese golf movement and gather the strength of overseas Chinese...

e6f3a5f09737537037a818606b5b5fe7572c8454.sourceText: 为促进全球华人高尔夫球运动的，凝聚海外华侨的力量，由全球华人高尔夫球协会、美国泛太平洋商会及多个海内外球会团体联合承办的全球华人高尔夫锦标赛将于今年10月31日至11月2日，中国安徽黄山开打。大赛现正式开始接受报名，即诚邀高尔夫爱好者参加。
e6f3a5f09737537037a818606b5b5fe7572c8454.translatedText: In order to promote the global Chinese golf movement and gather the strength of overseas Chinese, the Global Chinese Golf Championship, jointly organized by the Global Chinese Golf Association, the American Pan-Pacific Chamber of Commerce and a number of golf club groups at home and abroad, will be held from October 31st to November 2nd this year in Huangshan, Anhui, China. The competition is now officially open for registration, and golf enthusiasts are sincerely invited to participate.

e90dadf37dcca233f5bd202d04d73617e19cbadd.sourceText: 首次在中国举办的全球华人高尔夫球会杯锦标赛为期3天，比赛地点位于中国风景绮丽，有”天下第一奇山”之称的中国黄山风景区内的屯溪松柏国际乡村高尔夫俱乐部举行,场地36洞.届时，将有来自世界各地的华人高尔夫球手组队共襄盛会，切磋球技。大赛分为团体组、个人总杆组、个人净杆组、个人长青组等，组别设置万元奖金。
e90dadf37dcca233f5bd202d04d73617e19cbadd.translatedText: The Global Chinese Golf Club Cup Championship held for the first time in China lasts for 3 days. The competition venue is located at the Tunxi Songbai International Country Golf Club in the Huangshan Scenic Area of ​​China, which is known as the "No. 1 Wonderful Mountain in the World" with beautiful scenery. The venue is 36 holes. At that time, Chinese golfers from all over the world will form teams to participate in the event and compete in golf skills. The competition is divided into team group, individual gross group, individual net group, individual evergreen group, etc. Each group has a bonus of 10,000 yuan.

4ff91f4e58d1ec13b38866e9028a816663ec8d77.sourceText: 赛事主席江启光表示，本次比赛吸引到大批来自海外的华裔高尔夫球爱好者参加,赛事举办的目的是搭起体育之桥，促进全球华人华侨体育人士与中国的高球爱好者交流球技，以球会友。历次比赛专业性,挑战性强,参赛选手水平在70杆-90杆之间的业余爱好者,在华人世界中产生了很大的影响力，2010,2011届比赛在美国南加州洛杉矶举行,今年的比赛移师中国黄山,旨在让全球华人了解中国的高尔夫运动发展状况,本次比赛预计邀请到来自全球各地的200名海内外华裔选手参加,中国的选手则来自20几个不同的省市,是一场高尔夫盛会,热况可期。
4ff91f4e58d1ec13b38866e9028a816663ec8d77.translatedText: Tournament chairman Jiang Qiguang said that this tournament has attracted a large number of Chinese golf enthusiasts from overseas to participate. The purpose of the tournament is to build a sports bridge and promote the exchange of skills between overseas Chinese sports people around the world and Chinese golf enthusiasts, and to make friends through golf. Previous competitions were professional and challenging, with amateur players ranging from 70 to 90. They had a great influence on the Chinese world. The 2010 and 2011 competitions were held in Los Angeles, Southern California, the United States. This year's competition moved to China Huang. Mountain, aiming to let Chinese people around the world understand the development of golf in China. This competition is expected to invite 200 Chinese players from all over the world to participate. Chinese players come from more than 20 different provinces and cities. It is a golf event that can be expected to be popular.

03f76c77c9481b33601f4ed31f0f4dcd8206a05f.sourceText: 南加州的美国职业高尔夫协会(SCPGA)名誉会长Jason Tyler已允诺派员参加,并举行,免费为高尔夫行业业者传授高球管理经验,同时多位国际知名的高尔夫教练将组队参加,并将免费做现场指导.
03f76c77c9481b33601f4ed31f0f4dcd8206a05f.translatedText: Jason Tyler, honorary president of the Professional Golf Association of America (SCPGA) in Southern California, has promised to send personnel to attend and hold the event to teach golf management experience to golf industry players for free. At the same time, many internationally renowned golf coaches will form teams and provide free on-site guidance.

c17b80b626fc8c60d1bfb82daa260bad42e2ed93.sourceText: 即日起，只要您是高尔夫球爱好者，年龄在25岁以上 (无年龄上限)，且在过去三年中,未曾参加职业比赛者,即可报名参加；没有中国签证，请最少提前1个月报名。
c17b80b626fc8c60d1bfb82daa260bad42e2ed93.translatedText: From now on, as long as you are a golf enthusiast and are over 25 years old (There is no upper age limit) and those who have not participated in professional competitions in the past three years can register to participate; if you do not have a Chinese visa, please register at least one month in advance.

055c0188c81b16eaccc96b67711eef9bce93ca03.sourceText: 北京情思~相约凤凰城—-2013 迎 新 春 综 艺 联 欢 会 〔亚省华联供稿〕在中华民族的传统节日春节来临之际，为传播中华优秀文化，增进北京市侨联和亚省华侨华人与侨界社团的联系和交往，应 亚省华人华侨联合总会 〔亚省华联〕的邀请，中国侨联副主席、北京市人大常委会副主任、北京市侨联主席李昭玲将率北京市侨联艺术团于春节期间前来凤凰城为当地侨胞进行慰问演出。这是北京市侨联首次组派艺术团来凤凰城进行春节慰问演出。 11月中旬，李昭玲主席在京会见了来自美国华盛顿、亚特兰大和凤凰城的海外侨领；亚省华联 费健会长 在回京探亲期间，也应邀出席了座谈会。会谈中，李昭玲主席向海外侨领们介绍了北京市侨联长期开展海外慰问演出的情况。她介绍说，北京市侨联艺术团春节海外慰问演出至今已进行了11年，走遍了五大洲20多个国家和地区60多个城市，演出100余场，目前已经形成了以”北京情思”为主题的具有浓郁京腔京韵的文化品牌，深受海外侨胞的欢迎和喜爱。 12月中旬，费健会长向 亚省华联 和社区侨团负责人通报了北京市侨联艺术团来凤凰城进行春节慰问演出的最新进展，并介绍了艺术团成员的情况。本次来凤凰城慰问演出的艺术团成员由来自中国的一流艺术家组成。演出节目丰富多彩，艺术团阵容强，规格高，无疑将为当地华侨华人带来精彩纷呈的文化艺术盛宴，增添节日的欢乐与喜庆。 此次”北京情思~相约凤凰城”2013迎新春综艺联欢会由北京市侨联和 亚省华联 共同主办。联欢会将于2013年2月15日(正月初六) 在 Mesa Arts Center 举行。最新消息和详情请浏览亚省华联网站： www.chineseaz.org. 李昭玲主席(左5)和费健会长(左6)以及其它海外侨领合影留念
055c0188c81b16eaccc96b67711eef9bce93ca03.translatedText: Love in Beijing~Meet in Phoenix—2013 New Year’s Variety Show Gala [Contributed by the Overseas Chinese Federation of Alberta] On the occasion of the Spring Festival, the traditional festival of the Chinese nation, in order to spread the excellent Chinese culture and enhance the connections and exchanges between the Beijing Federation of Overseas Chinese and the overseas Chinese in Alberta and overseas Chinese associations, the Alberta Chinese Federation At the invitation of the [Alberta Overseas Chinese Federation], Li Zhaoling, Vice Chairman of the Chinese Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, Deputy Director of the Standing Committee of the Beijing Municipal People's Congress, and Chairman of the Beijing Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, will lead the Beijing Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese Art Troupe to perform in Phoenix during the Spring Festival to perform condolences for the local overseas Chinese. This is the first time that the Beijing Overseas Chinese Federation has sent an art troupe to Phoenix to perform during the Spring Festival. In mid-November, Chairman Li Zhaoling met with overseas Chinese leaders from Washington, Atlanta and Phoenix in the United States in Beijing; President Fei Jian of the Alberta Hualian was also invited to attend the symposium when he returned to Beijing to visit relatives. During the meeting, Chairman Li Zhaoling introduced to the overseas Chinese leaders the long-term overseas condolences performances carried out by the Beijing Overseas Chinese Federation. She said that the Beijing Overseas Chinese Federation Art Troupe has been performing overseas condolences performances during the Spring Festival for 11 years, traveling to more than 60 cities in more than 20 countries and regions on five continents and performing more than 100 performances. It has now formed a cultural brand with a strong Beijing accent and Beijing accent with the theme of "Beijing Feelings", and is deeply welcomed and loved by overseas Chinese. In mid-December, President Fei Jian informed the Overseas Chinese Federation of Alberta and the leaders of the community overseas Chinese troupe on the latest progress of the Beijing Overseas Chinese Federation Art Troupe’s performance in Phoenix for the Spring Festival, and introduced the members of the art troupe. The members of the art troupe that came to Phoenix to perform this condolences are composed of first-class artists from China. The performances are rich and colorful, the art troupe has a strong lineup, and the standards are high. It will undoubtedly bring a wonderful cultural and artistic feast to the local overseas Chinese and add to the joy and celebration of the festival. The "Beijing Love~Meet in Phoenix" 2013 New Year Variety Show was co-sponsored by the Beijing Overseas Chinese Federation and the Hualian Federation of Asia. The party will be held on February 15, 2013 (the sixth day of the first lunar month) at the Mesa Arts Center. For the latest news and details, please visit the Hualian Association of Alberta website: www.chineseaz.org. Chairman Li Zhaoling (5th from left), President Fei Jian (6th from left) and other overseas Chinese leaders took a group photo

b04a4448e059447278fb9d7d7418bffa9d3f1500.sourceText: 12月19日，在美国拉斯韦加斯，来自美国的佳丽奥利维娅 卡波尔（Olivia Culpo）摘得桂冠后接受媒体采访。当日，2012”环球小姐”全球总决赛在美国拉斯韦加斯举行，来自美国的奥利维娅 卡波尔夺冠。

86d6c2c84ca70901015b2477476593bfa66b83be.sourceText: （本网讯） 6月18日至22日晚在曼哈顿音乐学院举行的第六届纽约国际钢琴比赛中，来自亚利桑那州的华裔 韩安娜 从22位来自世界各地的优秀青年钢琴选手中脱颖而出，荣获冠军。
86d6c2c84ca70901015b2477476593bfa66b83be.translatedText: (news from this website) In the 6th New York International Piano Competition held at the Manhattan School of Music from the evening of June 18th to 22nd, Anna Han, a Chinese from Arizona, stood out from 22 outstanding young pianists from all over the world and won the championship.

f4fce4b1b5b7b2b01a176391baf6d1291a6a9535.sourceText: 本次比赛组委会从全世界选送的音乐带中挑选出22位选手，到 曼哈顿音乐学院 现场举行比赛。选手一共参加四轮比赛，以综合成绩裁决名次。韩安娜以 海顿，弗朗茨 的 E 大调第四十六奏鸣曲 等曲目获得了本次比赛的最好成绩。
f4fce4b1b5b7b2b01a176391baf6d1291a6a9535.translatedText: The organizing committee of this competition selected 22 contestants from music tapes sent from all over the world and held the competition on-site at the Manhattan School of Music. Players participated in a total of four rounds, and their rankings were determined based on their overall results. Han Anna won the best result in this competition with pieces such as Haydn and Franz's Sonata No. 46 in E major.

8c69540bc579297ae2072d47d5c9adfd048bff22.sourceText: 韩安娜今年16岁，她从4岁开始学习钢琴，师从许飞老师，擅长演奏巴赫，莫扎特，肖邦，海顿经典的钢琴曲目，获得很多国际钢琴比赛的大奖。

1ef523a5dfd47d23b1a5cd68ff3fdf115b254c0c.sourceText: 纽约” 思戴科和 霍罗维兹 基金会’;创办人是纽曼 豪罗维兹和麦尔文 ‧ 斯蒂切先生。从 1960年至1999 年，他们长期致力于音乐教育39年。 1999年他们开始举办纽约钢琴比赛，每两年一次，鼓励年轻人投身音乐。2009年起开始接受外国选手参赛，并改名为纽约国际钢琴比赛，接受的选手年龄在 16至21岁之间。纽曼霍 罗维兹先生表示﹕”纽约钢琴比赛与众不同，比赛不采用淘汰制，所有选手全程参加所有比赛，最后综合评比裁判。”参加比赛的选手要经过四轮比赛，之后还有大师班授课和讲座，比赛奖金总额 $40,000。获奖者会赢得在美国不同地方举办音乐会的表演合同。
1ef523a5dfd47d23b1a5cd68ff3fdf115b254c0c.translatedText: New York’s “Stadeko and Horovitz Foundation’; founders are Mr. Newman Horowitz and Melvin Sticher. From 1960 to 1999, they have been committed to music education for 39 years. In 1999, they began to hold the New York Piano Competition every two years to encourage young people to devote themselves to music. In 2009, they began to accept foreign contestants and renamed it the New York International Piano Competition. The accepted contestants are between the ages of 16 and 21. Mr. Newman Holowitz said: "The New York Piano Competition does not use an elimination system. All contestants participate in all competitions and are judged at the end. ” Competitors go through four rounds of competition, followed by master classes and lectures, for a total prize of $40,000. Winners win performance contracts for concerts in various locations across the United States.

b32206dc4692481c529944453f758abd2112e73c.translatedText: 2012 started at 0:00am on June 16th. Phoenix Chinese escort, started for half a month. As of 0:00 p.m. on June 29, the top vote-getter was Contestant No. 7 Chen Jiaqi with 3,520 votes, followed by Contestant No. 5 Kuang Yanfen with 3,299 votes, and Contestant No. 2 Jing Xiaomi with 1,031 votes. Currently, the one with the highest popularity index is No. 7 Chen Jiaqi with nearly 32,000 visitors, No. 2 Jing Xiaomi ranked second with nearly 25,000 visitors, and No. 5 beauty Kuang Yanfen ranked third with nearly 20,000 visitors. In the first two weeks, the votes of No. 5 and No. 7 alternately led and tied many times, giving many participants the feeling of watching the "Champions League." Beauty No. 5 Kuang Yanfen posted a post on the beauty pageant forum, "Come and vote for me~~~~~~~~~~" (http://bbs.sunbirdarizona.com/viewthread.php?tid=2489). The post lasted for more than 20 pages, with a click-through rate of more than 2,300. Netizens carefully recorded multiple draws in the forum, raising suspense. Fans of Contestant No. 7 Chen Jiaqi also created their own support thread on the forum named "Contestant No. 7 Chen Jiaqi Support Team!" ( http://bbs.sunbirdarizona.com/viewthread.php?tid=2523&extra=page%3D1 ) The popularity of both contestants is quite high!

62f889918d00e1dd506fd74d02b6ea3638c7658e.sourceText: ７时晚宴正式开始。2013年亚太社区促进会评选出了三位杰出亚裔女性。她们分别是Candace Lew医生，Ethel Luzario房地产经纪，华裔大法官邓周雅定。亚太社区促进会用视频讲述了三位亚裔女性的动人事迹。华裔大法官邓周雅定小时候最大的愿望就是成为一名老师，当她本科毕业后，父亲要求她继续修法律课程成为律师，在专业上的努力让她成为了凤凰城市政法庭(Phoenix Municipal Court)首席女法官（Chief Presiding Judge）。也许大家都以为没有走上讲台的她，一定放弃了老师梦想。其实并没有，她几乎每天都邀请学校的学生到法庭来了解法律的程序，体验法律的精神，鼓励他们好好学习，追逐自己的梦想。她不仅成为了法律界的杰出代表，更是实现了教育年轻一代的梦想。
62f889918d00e1dd506fd74d02b6ea3638c7658e.translatedText: The dinner officially started at 7 o'clock. In 2013, the Asia Pacific Community Advancement Association selected three outstanding Asian women. They are Dr. Candace Lew, real estate agent Ethel Luzario, and Chinese-American Justice Deng Zhou Yading. The Asian Pacific Community Advancement Association used a video to tell the touching stories of three Asian women. Chinese-American Justice Deng Zhouyading's biggest wish when she was a child was to become a teacher. After she graduated from the undergraduate program, her father asked her to continue taking law courses to become a lawyer. Her professional efforts allowed her to become the Chief Presiding Judge of the Phoenix Municipal Court. Maybe everyone thought that she must have given up on her dream of being a teacher before she stepped onto the podium. In fact, she does not. She invites students from the school to the court almost every day to understand the legal procedures, experience the spirit of the law, and encourages them to study hard and pursue their dreams. Not only has she become an outstanding representative in the legal profession, but she has also realized her dream of educating the younger generation.

17488e6093312b61fb4e5414e20f0206934951d2.sourceText: 亚太社区促进会募款晚宴是在亚利桑那级别很高的亚裔募款晚宴之一。亚裔的成功商人，医生，政客都非常支持这一组织。亚太社区促进会是由华裔医生徐凯莱创立。在过去的十年当中，亚太社区促进会为成千上万的亚利桑那民众提供了乙肝测试，疫苗接种，感冒疫苗接种，糖尿病筛查，癌症教育以及医疗转诊。当然除此这些日常的健康筛查工作以外，还有很多针对少数族裔的特别的项目在进行。
17488e6093312b61fb4e5414e20f0206934951d2.translatedText: The Asian Pacific Community Promotion Association fundraising dinner is one of the highest-level Asian fundraising dinners in Arizona. Successful Asian businessmen, doctors, and politicians all support this organization. The Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association was founded by Chinese-American doctor Xu Kailai. Over the past decade, APCA has provided hepatitis B testing, vaccinations, cold shots, diabetes screenings, cancer education and medical referrals to thousands of Arizonans. Of course, in addition to these daily health screenings, there are also many special projects for ethnic minorities.

361d40d7074b82da05b72deaeea3a06b5fe72d2b.sourceText: (侨联通讯) 2013年度凤凰城华裔小姐选美的8位佳丽已经就位，经过抽签，她们有了自己的编号，分别是：１号叶安萍 Diana Diep；２号文矜莤 lacey Wen；3号张安琦 Angela Zhang；4号贝茵竹Lisa Baer；5号国金金 Jennifer Price-Smmith；6号梁宇晨 Yuchen Liang；7号李乐观 Serrena Lee；8号黄翠玲 Kaylee Wong。近来的每个周未，她们已经在新东方艺术学校进行艺能训练了。
361d40d7074b82da05b72deaeea3a06b5fe72d2b.translatedText: (Overseas Chinese Communications) The eight beauties of the 2013 Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant are already in place. After drawing lots, they have their own numbers, namely: No. 1 Diana Diep; No. 2 Lacey Wen; No. 3 Angela Zhang; No. 4 Lisa Baer; No. 5 Jennifer Price-Smmith; No. 6 Yuchen Liang; No. 7 Serrena Lee; No. 8 Kaylee Huang. Wong. Every weekend these days, they have been undergoing art training at the New Oriental Art School.

58246652e3f0418f0edaa1002eb262c06c5cce29.sourceText: 4号贝茵竹Lisa Baer 自从新东方艺术学校开办后，三年来，为凤凰城侨联总会的选美佳丽提供了一个良好训练的场所，学校有专业的老师，有正规的练舞场地，还有会议室方便义工开会和评选作品，在这个多功能的平台上，聚集着一批无偿付出的义工，在百忙之中来抽时间来为华人社区作服务。新东方艺术学校的吕丽华校长的热心支持，胡秋子艺术总的监言传身教，选美Chair闻玲琳的统筹管理、总后勤余妈妈等的悉心照料，为新一届佳丽打造出一个艺能培训的温馨场所。 爱美是人类天性，女孩子坐在梳妆台前可以涂涂抹抹老半天而不觉得累，况且今天是第一次到专业化粧间去妆扮和试镜！虽然今年佳丽的素质不错，但”Yes Ido婚纱摄影” ( www.yesidobride.com ) 的专业化妆师可是美玉精雕，为每位佳丽花上两个小时妆扮和拍照，于是乎，红粧倩影俏少女，锦秀霓裳丽美人。你看，佳丽们雀跃的心情都写上了脸上！
58246652e3f0418f0edaa1002eb262c06c5cce29.translatedText: No. 4 Bei Yinzhu Lisa Baer Since the opening of the New Oriental Art School, in the past three years, it has provided a good training place for the beauty pageants of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation. The school has professional teachers, formal dance practice venues, and conference rooms for volunteers to hold meetings and select works. On this multi-functional platform, a group of volunteers have gathered for free, taking time out of their busy schedules to serve the Chinese community. The enthusiastic support of Principal Lu Lihua from the New Oriental Art School, the words and deeds of the Artistic Director Hu Qiuzi, the overall management of the pageant chair Wen Linglin, and the careful care of the general logistics mother Yu have created a warm place for performance training for the new beauties. It is human nature to love beauty. Girls can sit in front of the dressing table and apply makeup for a long time without feeling tired. Moreover, today is the first time to go to a professional dressing room to dress up and audition! Although the quality of this year's contestants is good, the professional makeup artists of "Yes Ido Wedding Photography" ( www.yesidobride.com ) are extremely skilled. They spent two hours dressing up and taking photos for each contestant. As a result, pretty girls with red makeup and beautiful women show off their beautiful clothes. You see, the joy of the beauties is written on their faces!

4ebd982fa380bde5d8d15e151c65a8bf9ce83d93.sourceText: 每年举办庆祝国庆和华裔小姐选美活动，是凤凰城侨联总会数十年来义不容辞的任务，今年，在主席张华芳的带动下，董事们分工合作，近来忙于设计、印制和派发国庆与选美的广告，筹划和开展各项文化艺术活动，举办”邓赵仲汶青少年艺术比赛”及”亚省之美摄影比赛”等。侨联从1970年举办首届凤凰城华裔小姐选美到今年已有43年的历史，新的一年新任务，老骥伏枥再一程。
4ebd982fa380bde5d8d15e151c65a8bf9ce83d93.translatedText: Held celebrations of National Day and the Miss Chinese Beauty Pageant every year has been the obligatory task of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation for decades. This year, under the leadership of Chairman Zhang Huafang, the directors have worked together and have been busy designing, printing and distributing advertisements for the National Day and the beauty pageant, planning and carrying out various cultural and artistic activities, and organizing the "Deng Zhao Zhongwen Youth Art Competition" and "Alberta Beauty Photography Competition". The Overseas Chinese Federation held the first Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant in 1970 and this year has a history of 43 years. With the new year and new tasks, we are ready to start again.

4728f57a8a84e94524ee63e7a3015fca0b824af0.sourceText: 每年对选美佳丽的培训都是从多方面进行的，参加选美佳丽所得到的名次固然重要，能在培训期间学到的各种智识和快速成长更是一种收获，每个人的人生中都会有亮点，我们祝福这一届的佳丽能在选美培训过程中学习进步提高，在七月四日的国庆日华丽转身，以最大限度发挥自己的潜质，在选美中有亮丽的表现！ 历年来，侨联总会的庆国庆办选美活动都得到广大侨胞的大力支持，目前8位佳丽中已有5位得到社会贤达和的赞助，我们期望能有更多的善者仁翁慷慨解囊，给侨联国庆选美活动增添动力活力，让美好的事物能在我们华人社区继续得到延续和发扬光大。 我们感谢”邓赵仲汶家庭”赞助青少年艺术比赛，让中华文化艺术结出硕果！我们感谢”亚省亚裔摄影协会”和侨联一起合办”亚省之美”摄影比赛，让美景美事定格于天地之间。亚省亚裔摄影协会多年来一直为我们华人社区作出贡献，无偿地为众多社区活动留下了见証。资深侨领余文劲、余文伟夫人、余明德夫人、亚省开平同乡会会长关宗任、龙冈公所副主席刘全知，董事关昆容，及筹办人张肇鸿等，为支持亚省之美摄影比赛出钱出力，为此项目筹到了活动资金。 温馨提示：如要参加”亚省之美”摄影比赛，请上亚省亚裔摄影协会网站 http://www.azapc.org/ 参看具体细则，另外，别忘记”邓赵仲汶青少年艺术比赛”及”亚省之美摄影比赛”投稿的截止日期是5月28日。
4728f57a8a84e94524ee63e7a3015fca0b824af0.translatedText: The training for beauty pageants is carried out in many aspects every year. The ranking obtained by participating in the beauty pageant is of course important, and the various knowledge and rapid growth learned during the training are even more rewarding. There will be highlights in everyone's life. We wish this year's beauties to learn and improve during the beauty pageant training process, and turn around beautifully on the National Day on July 4th to maximize their potential and perform brilliantly in the beauty pageant! Over the years, the National Day Beauty Pageant held by the Federation of Overseas Chinese has received strong support from the vast number of overseas Chinese. Currently, 5 of the 8 beauties have been sponsored by social celebrities and celebrities. We hope that more benevolent people will donate generously to add momentum and vitality to the National Day beauty pageant of the Federation of Overseas Chinese, so that beautiful things can continue and be carried forward in our Chinese community. We thank the "Deng Zhao Zhongwen Family" for sponsoring the Youth Art Competition, allowing Chinese culture and art to bear fruit! We are grateful to the "Alberta Asian Photography Association" and the Overseas Chinese Federation for co-organizing the "Beauty of Alberta" photography competition, allowing the beautiful scenery to be captured between heaven and earth. The Asian Photography Association of Alberta has been making contributions to our Chinese community for many years and has left witness to many community activities free of charge. Senior overseas Chinese leaders Yu Wenjin, Mrs. Yu Wenwei, Mrs. Yu Mingde, President of the Kaiping Association of Alberta, Guan Zongren, Vice Chairman of the Longgang Office, Liu Quanzhi, Director Guan Kunrong, and organizer Zhang Zhaohong, etc. have contributed money and efforts to support the Beauty of Alberta Photography Competition and raised funds for this project. Warm reminder: If you want to participate in the "Beauty of Alberta" Photography Competition, please visit the Asian Asian Photography Association website at http://www.azapc.org/ for specific details. In addition, don't forget that the deadline for submission of the "Deng Zhaozhongwen Youth Art Competition" and "Beauty of Alberta Photography Competition" is May 28.

3a8d77c9a8f8faba5e7557ff5a8cfcb4f8f15db4.sourceText: 美国人体重 12年来均增15磅 在美国人于感恩节大啖美食之际，盖勒普民调机构却「扫兴地」公布一项民调，指出美国人一年四季都喜欢大吃大喝，所以越来越胖。调查显示，从1990年到2012年仅仅12年间，美国人身上平均就多了15磅赘肉。 盖勒普估计，62%美国人体重高于标准，其中36%超重，26%属于肥胖。根据目前的趋势，除非社会文化转变，包括更注重营养和运动，否则下一代可能更肥胖。 调查发现，美国男性2012年的平均体重是196磅，比1990年重16磅。同一时期，女性的平均体重增加了14磅，从142磅「进步」到156磅。 如想获得理想的体重，就要大幅减少饮食，但在美国人日渐放纵饮食的事实下，瘦身变成了幻想，也导致美国不论男女都把理想体重标准降低。男士现在把他们的理想 体重定为185磅，为历来最高，比1990增加了14磅。女士亦把理想体重，由1990年的129磅增至现在的140磅。总体而言，59%男性和69%女性的体重超过自己的理想。仅有六分之一美国人达到自己的理想体重标准。 此外，美国有将近2600万名糖尿病患，而每年有超过1万5000名儿童和1万5000名成人诊断出得第一型糖尿病，也就是每天平均大约80人。如果目前儿童体重超重和缺少运动的趋势持续下去，现在出生的儿童，估计有三分之一日后会得第二型糖尿病。
3a8d77c9a8f8faba5e7557ff5a8cfcb4f8f15db4.translatedText: >The weight of Americans has increased by an average of 15 pounds in the past 12 years. While Americans are feasting on delicious food on Thanksgiving, the Gallup polling agency has "disappointingly" released a poll that points out that Americans like to eat and drink heavily all year round, so they are getting fatter. Surveys show that in just 12 years from 1990 to 2012, Americans gained an average of 15 pounds of extra fat. Gallup estimates that 62% of Americans are overweight, with 36% overweight and 26% obese. Based on current trends, the next generation is likely to be more obese unless socio-cultural shifts include a greater focus on nutrition and exercise. The survey found that the average weight of American men in 2012 was 196 pounds, 16 pounds heavier than in 1990. During the same period, the average weight of women increased by 14 pounds, from 142 pounds to 156 pounds. If you want to gain an ideal weight, you need to significantly reduce your diet. However, as Americans increasingly indulge in eating, losing weight has become a fantasy, which has also led to both men and women in the United States lowering their ideal weight standards. Men now set their ideal weight at 185 pounds, the highest ever and an increase of 14 pounds since 1990. Women have also increased their ideal weight from 129 pounds in 1990 to 140 pounds now. Overall, 59% of men and 69% of women weighed more than their ideal weight. Only one in six Americans reaches their ideal weight. In addition, there are nearly 26 million people with diabetes in the United States, and more than 15,000 children and 15,000 adults are diagnosed with type 1 diabetes every year, which is an average of about 80 people every day. If current trends in overweight and inactive children continue, an estimated one-third of children born today will develop type 2 diabetes later in life.

12a4e35b7f6e7c05522532526d3d36d4a2aea55a.sourceText: 2013亚利桑那中国春节文化盛宴——亚省春晚 （亚省时报讯 默默报道） 彩绸，鲜花，灯笼，在亮闪闪的中国红中，九十多位舞者在钱德勒中心的舞台上以群舞《金蛇狂舞》揭开了2013亚利桑那春晚的序幕。钱德勒市长 杰伊 缇博雪兰妮（Jay Tibshraeny）资深侨领余文劲，前白宫亚太裔事务委员会委员邓朝驹，前众议院黄仕均，亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院院长玛德琳斯布林（Madeline Spring），MESA社区大学校长潘寿安，大凤凰城华人侨团总会会长张华芳，亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会会长费健到现场同庆中国年。主办方新东方艺术学校院长吕丽华 孔子学院院长玛丽琳向亚省华人表示新春的祝贺，同时也感谢社区各界对传播中华文化工作的鼎力支持！ 经过半年的筹备，由新东方艺术学校学员，亚省各文艺团体的资深艺术家，钱德勒儿童合唱团一共二百三十多人组成的强大演出阵容，为到场的一千五百名观众送上了一台高质量，高品位，重年味儿的晚会。晚会节目以歌舞为主，穿插武术，气功，独唱，合唱，以及小提琴，二胡等器乐演奏。新东方艺术学校的古典舞蹈《飞天》，舞姿曼妙,灵动飘逸,仿佛敦煌莫高窟飞天传说再现。经典舞蹈《风筝》，更是将海外华人对家乡的思念放飞！钱德勒童声合唱团，金发碧眼的孩子唱出了中文歌《喜迎春 》，为新年祈福。舞蹈，歌唱，还有少林功夫，延倾师傅的气功，瞬间击碎一个铁棒，威震全场。全场最具特色的节目要数滑稽舞蹈《纤夫的爱》，去年这些演员就以《天鹅湖》亮相全凤凰城。今年男演员增至六位。他们拉着纤绳，扮演着纤夫走出舞台，当音乐唱到”小妹妹，坐船头，哥哥你在岸上走”，六位纤夫一转身就成了六个娇媚可人的小妹妹。全场观众顿时哄堂大笑！《纤夫的爱》一个演员扮演两个角色，演得眉目传情，惟妙惟肖，不得大赞导演的独特设计。 歌声，笑声，祝福声，2013年亚利桑那春节联欢晚会圆满落下帷幕，华人们在这里放飞新年的梦想和祝福：”祝亚省华人，新年快乐，万事如意！” 更多详情请看： 图片新闻：亚省春晚，蛇年圣宴，东方艺术，精彩呈现
12a4e35b7f6e7c05522532526d3d36d4a2aea55a.translatedText: 2013 Arizona Chinese New Year Cultural Feast—Alberta Spring Festival Gala (Alberta Times reported silently) Colorful silks, flowers, lanterns, in the shining Chinese red, more than 90 dancers kicked off the 2013 Arizona Spring Festival Gala with the group dance "Dance of the Golden Snake" on the stage of the Chandler Center. Chandler Mayor Jay Tibshraeny, senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin, former White House Asian and Pacific American Affairs Committee member Deng Chaoju, former House of Representatives Huang Shijun, Director of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University Madeline Spring, MESA Community College President Pan Shou'an, Greater Phoenix Chinese Overseas Chinese Association President Zhang Huafang, and Arizona Chinese Federation President Fei Jian came to celebrate the Chinese New Year. Lv Lihua, the director of the organizer New Oriental Art School, and Marilyn, the director of the Confucius Institute, expressed their New Year congratulations to the Chinese people in Alberta, and also thanked all sectors of the community for their strong support in spreading Chinese culture! After half a year of preparations, a strong performance lineup of more than 230 people, including students from New Oriental Art School, senior artists from various literary and art groups in Alberta, and the Chandler Children's Choir, presented a high-quality, high-grade, New Year's-style party to the 1,500 spectators present. The program of the party is mainly singing and dancing, interspersed with martial arts, qigong, solo singing, chorus, as well as violin, erhu and other instrumental music performances. The classical dance "Flying Apsara" performed by New Oriental Art School is graceful, agile and elegant, as if the legend of Flying Apsara from Dunhuang Mogao Grottoes is reappearing. The classic dance "Kite" releases overseas Chinese's longing for their hometown! Chandler Children's Choir, the blond children sang the Chinese song "Happy Spring" to pray for the New Year. Dance, singing, and Shaolin Kung Fu. Master Yan Qing's Qigong can instantly shatter an iron rod and shock the entire audience. The most distinctive show of the whole show is the comic dance tracker's love. Last year, these actors made their debut in Phoenix with "Swan Lake". This year the number of male actors has increased to six. They pulled the rope and walked out of the stage as trackers. When the music sang "Little sister, sit on the bow, brother, you walk on the shore", the six trackers turned around and turned into six charming little sisters. The whole audience burst into laughter! In "Tracker's Love", one actor plays two roles, and the performance is very expressive and lifelike. I cannot but praise the director's unique design. With singing, laughter and blessings, the 2013 Arizona Spring Festival Gala came to a successful conclusion. Chinese people here let go of their New Year’s dreams and blessings: “I wish the Chinese in Alberta a happy New Year and all the best!” For more details, please see: Photo News: Alberta Spring Festival Gala, Year of the Snake Feast, Oriental Art, wonderful presentations

e003ad1e76871a7d21ae81660c29c6b5f0e607fb.sourceText: 一个小故事——–2012独立日获奖作文选登（三等奖） （作者：贾可，十一岁）我感到有人在我脸旁喘气，我张开半只眼看到妹妹的脸就在我面前”你醒了，太好了！烟火！烧烤！快起来！”妹妹的蓝白红的裙子在太阳光下摆动着，不醒都不行了，我起床进到浴室刷牙。 ”什么时侯天黑，我要看烟火！” 妹妹跳着跟在旁边说， ”妹，这才是早上，要等12个小时天才会黑。”我不耐烦地回答道，”12小时很长吗？”妹妹的眼睛里有一些失望的样子。我知到妹妹这一天要问我一百遍同样的问题，就是天黑了吗？拉着妹妹的手下楼，妈妈已经做好了早餐。妹妹嚼着面包问什么时候天黑？妈妈问是谁嘴里有食物还讲话？妹妹就摇头说不是她。我和妈妈都摇摇头笑了，妈妈刚要再说妹妹，我说妈妈让我给妹妹讲一个故事。妹妹一听高兴的问是不是芭比娃娃的，我说比那个更好。 我和妹妹坐到沙发上，我开始了我的故事。在两百多年前，有一个乔治的男孩，他住在一个美丽农场，他的爸爸有一个美丽的果园，有苹果树、桃树、樱桃树。有一棵樱桃树是他爸爸最喜欢的，因为是从很远的地方买到的树，他爸爸自己种到园子里，每天都去浇水照顾。春天到了，这棵樱桃树长的很好，开了很多好看的白花，有很多蜜蜂和蝴蝶在树边飞。乔治的爸爸很高兴，想一定会结很多果子，不让别人去碰它。有一天乔治起床，去吃早饭，他先谢谢妈妈为他做的饭，然后轻轻的切开面包擦黄油，很小块放进嘴里，慢慢的嚼，没有声音。他妈妈说今天会有朋友来看他，乔治吃完嘴里的饭才问妈妈是谁？这时坐在我旁边大口吃着苹果的妹妹把嘴闭上了，变小口了，我笑了笑，继续讲。。。乔治的妈妈说是邻居。邻居后来教给乔治一些种田的好方法还送给他了一把很亮的斧子。乔治非常喜欢这把斧子，他拿着它砍树枝玩，来到果园边儿，举起斧头就砍向那棵樱桃树。树皮很软，乔治没一会儿把树砍倒了。接着他又去别的地方玩了。晚上，爸爸回家看了樱桃树被砍，他问了所有人，但谁都说不知道。”乔治，你知道是谁把我的樱桃树给砍死了吗？” 父亲生气的问，”我不能说谎，爸爸，”他说，”是我用斧子砍的，真对不起。”可是他爸爸说”树死了我很难过，但我也很高兴，因为你说了真话。你一定要记住, 我更高兴有一个诚实孩子。”乔治记住了，他长大后一直像小时侯一样诚实，成了独立战争的总司令，他和托马斯.杰弗逊、詹姆斯.迈迪逊成为美国的独立最重要的人。他就是美国之父乔治.华盛顿。今天7月4号，第一要敲响的是费城自由钟，有彩车游行，烟火，吃烧烤，也是我们要记得和感谢历史中的人。 ”哇！我也想成为很重要的人。”妹妹跳着说。”可以，你要多读历史书，你会感觉历史里的人会像你的朋友教你很多东西。妹，今天的故事你学了什么？我笑着说。妹妹想了一会儿，跑到妈妈那里，她笑着说”妈，刚刚是我嘴里有饭又说话，对不起。” 我给妹妹拍手，”妹，你真棒，想做重要的人，就要把小事做好。来，姐姐教你做千纸鹤，我们用红白蓝国旗颜色的纸来做。””为什么做千纸鹤”妹妹问。”我们中国人做千纸鹤希望带来幸福和好运，我希望在美国的每个人都幸福和好运。”妹妹再次蹦着跳着，她红白蓝的裙子和她黑色的头发也上下跳着，不过这次她嘴里喊的不光是烟火和烧烤了，新的词语从她嘴里说出来，”美国之父，乔治.华盛顿、独立日。” 我们全家人都笑了。
e003ad1e76871a7d21ae81660c29c6b5f0e607fb.translatedText: A short story——–A selection of award-winning essays on Independence Day 2012 (third prize) (Author: Jia Ke, eleven years old) I felt someone gasping next to my face. I opened half of my eyes and saw my sister's face right in front of me. "You're awake, great! Fireworks! BBQ! Get up!" My sister's blue, white and red skirt was swinging in the sun. I couldn't help but wake up. "When will it get dark? I want to watch the fireworks!" My sister jumped and said next to me. "Sister, it's morning, it won't get dark until 12 hours." I replied impatiently, "Is 12 hours long?" There was a look of disappointment in my sister's eyes. I knew my sister would ask me the same question a hundred times that day, is it going to get dark? My mother had already made breakfast. My sister was chewing bread and asked when it would get dark. My mother asked who was still talking with food in her mouth. My mother and I shook our heads and laughed. When my mother was about to talk about my sister, I said she asked me to tell her a story. I said it was better than that. My sister and I sat on the sofa, and I started my story. More than two hundred years ago, there was a boy called George. He lived on a beautiful farm. His father had a beautiful orchard with apple trees, peach trees, and cherry trees. There was a cherry tree that his father liked the most because it was bought from far away. His father planted it in the garden himself and watered it every day. Take care of it. Spring is here, and the cherry tree is growing well, with many beautiful white flowers blooming, and there are many bees and butterflies flying around the tree. George's father is very happy, thinking that it will bear a lot of fruit, and will not let others touch it. One day, George got up and went to eat breakfast. He first thanked his mother for cooking, then gently cut the bread and rubbed the butter, and slowly put it into his mouth. Chewing, there was no sound. His mother said that a friend would come to see him today. After George finished eating, he asked his mother. Then the sister who was eating the apple closed her mouth and continued talking. George's mother later taught him some good farming methods and gave him a very bright ax. He liked the ax and played with it cutting branches. He came to the edge of the orchard and struck the cherry tree with the axe. The bark was very soft and George chopped down the tree. Then he went to play elsewhere. In the evening, his father went home and saw the cherry tree being chopped down. He asked everyone, "George, do you know who chopped down my cherry tree?" The father asked angrily, "I can't lie, Dad," he said, "I chopped it with an axe. I'm so sorry." But his father said, "I'm sad that the tree died, but I'm also very happy because you told the truth. You must remember, I am more happy to have an honest child. "George remembered that he was as honest as he was when he was a child, and became the commander-in-chief of the Revolutionary War. He, Thomas Jefferson, and James Madison became the most important people in the independence of the United States. He is the father of the United States, George Washington. Today, July 4th, the first thing to ring is the Liberty Bell in Philadelphia, with floats, parades, fireworks, and barbecues. This is also a person in history that we must remember and thank. "Wow! I also want to be an important person." My sister jumped and said. "Yes, you should read more history books, and you will feel that the people in history will teach you a lot like your friends. Sister, what did you learn from today's story? I said with a smile. My sister thought for a while and ran to her mother. She smiled and said, "Mom, I was talking while I had food in my mouth. I'm sorry." I clapped my hands to my sister, "Sister, you are awesome. If you want to be an important person, you have to do small things well. Come on, sister will teach you how to make paper cranes. We use paper with red, white and blue national flag colors to make them." "Why do we make paper cranes?" my sister asked. "We Chinese people make paper cranes to bring happiness and good luck. I hope." Everyone in America is happy and good luck." The sister jumped up and down again, her red, white and blue dress and her black hair jumping up and down, but this time she was not just shouting about fireworks and barbecue, new words came out of her mouth, "Father of the United States, George Washington, Independence Day." Our whole family laughed.

758bb20e4e04d58d5b81715c05aa282cb9ba44cb.sourceText: 美交通死亡人数降到1949年来最低点 美国交通事故死亡人数继续大幅下降，达到了自1949年以来的最低水平。据全国公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）的估计，在2011年，死于交通事故的人数是32,310，比去年同期下降了1.7％。这是连续第七年死亡率有所下降。 NHTSA表示，自2005年以来交通死亡人数已下降了逾25%，车行每一英里的平均死亡人数也降到了自1921年有记录以来的最低水平。 虽然联邦政府官员拒绝指向特定的因素，专家认为，急剧下降的背后有几个原因。包括对酒后驾车的打击、增加使用安全带、改进汽车设计和要求严格遵守联邦安全规则。在刚刚过去的几年中，NHTSA要求所有新车，安装电子稳定控制系统，并要有更强的车顶设计。 一些专家还指出，经济衰退已使得美国民众大幅减少每年驾车的里程数。NHTSA的初步研究显示，在2011年美国人驾车的里程数比前一年少了357亿里，下降了1.2％。随着经济的复苏，一些观察家警告说，死亡人数可能还会上升，因为车行的里程数会加多。 不过，即使调整到同样的里程数，死亡率还是下降了，在2011年每车行一亿英里的死亡人数是1.09，这一数字在2010年是1.11。在其最高峰时期，这数字接近7.0。 2005年交通事故导致包括行人在内的43,510名美国民众死亡。 各地区的下降率不同，新英格兰的下降幅度最大，比去年少了7.2％。在美国的中心地带，包括堪萨斯州，密苏里州和内布拉斯加州，死亡人数下降了5.3％。但有三个地区，包括亚利桑那州和夏威夷，加利福尼亚州，死亡人数比去年反而加多了3.3％。 虽然整体死亡人数下滑了，运输部长拉胡德曾多次表示，交通事故死亡率仍然太高，他要求作进一步的努力，使其下降更多。该机构是在准备新的规则来解决拉胡德认为是一种”流行病”的驾驶分心开车所导致的死亡。
758bb20e4e04d58d5b81715c05aa282cb9ba44cb.translatedText: The number of traffic fatalities in the United States fell to the lowest level since 1949. The number of traffic fatalities in the United States continued to decline sharply, reaching the lowest level since 1949. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) estimates that 32,310 people died in traffic crashes in 2011, a 1.7 percent decrease from the same period last year. This is the seventh consecutive year the death rate has declined. NHTSA said traffic fatalities have dropped by more than 25% since 2005, and the average number of fatalities per mile traveled has fallen to its lowest level since records began in 1921. While federal officials declined to point to specific factors, experts believe there are several reasons behind the sharp decline. They include cracking down on drunk driving, increasing seat belt use, improving car design and requiring strict compliance with federal safety rules. In just the past few years, NHTSA has required all new cars to install electronic stability control systems and have stronger roof designs. Some experts also point out that the recession has caused Americans to significantly reduce the number of miles they drive each year. NHTSA's preliminary research shows that Americans drove 35.7 billion fewer miles in 2011 than the previous year, a 1.2 percent decrease. As the economy recovers, some observers warn the death toll may rise as more miles are driven. However, even after adjusting for the same mileage, the death rate still dropped, with 1.09 fatalities per 100 million miles traveled in 2011, compared with 1.11 in 2010. At its peak, this number was close to 7.0. Traffic accidents killed 43,510 Americans, including pedestrians, in 2005. The rate of decline varied by region, with New England experiencing the largest decline, which was 7.2% less than last year. In America's heartland, which includes Kansas, Missouri and Nebraska, deaths fell 5.3%. But in three regions, including Arizona, Hawaii, and California, the number of deaths increased by 3.3% compared with last year. Although the overall death toll has fallen, Transportation Secretary Lahoud has repeatedly said that traffic fatalities are still too high and he has called for further efforts to bring them down even more. The agency is preparing new rules to address what LaHood calls an "epidemic" of distracted driving deaths.

In order to encourage overseas Chinese to start their own businesses in the form of franchising and to assist...

08e491e8f6e847b54d423c3dca7a6865f77690a9.sourceText: 侨务委员会为鼓励海外侨胞以连锁加盟方式创业，并协助国内绩优连锁加盟品牌至海​​外展店，特于2012年8月26日至31日举办「2012年侨商连锁加盟创业观摩团」活动。
08e491e8f6e847b54d423c3dca7a6865f77690a9.translatedText: In order to encourage overseas Chinese to start their own businesses in the form of franchising and to assist domestic outstanding chain and franchise brands to open stores overseas, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission specially organized the "2012 Overseas Chinese Businessmen Chain and Franchise Entrepreneurship Observation Group" from August 26 to 31, 2012.

af1e2404a838bf3721d952804484b3a60965553e.sourceText: 活动内容包括连锁加盟创业专业课程(含全球连锁加盟趋势、连锁加盟要项及品牌、进入加盟多项准备、加盟成功关键因素、店面经营管理业务等)、导览参观「2012年台北连锁加盟大展」 、参访连锁企业及商机洽谈会等。 侨务委员会负担活动规划费、课程暨场地费、交通费、餐费；学员除自付由侨居地往返之交通费、活动期间膳宿费(或可由承办厂商代订)，并需于报到时缴交报名费新台币3,000元(或美金100元，费用含「2012年台北连锁加盟大展」门票、研习课程暨企业参访之餐费及保险费)等。有意报名者请于2012年7月30日前径洽橙县华侨文教服务中心714-754-9999或洛杉矶华侨文教服务中心626-443-9999。
af1e2404a838bf3721d952804484b3a60965553e.translatedText: The activities include professional courses on chain franchising entrepreneurship (including global chain franchising trends, chain franchising essentials and brands, various preparations for entering the franchise, key factors for successful franchising, store operation and management business, etc.), guided tours of the "2012 Taipei Franchise Exhibition", visits to chain enterprises and business opportunities negotiation meetings, etc. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Council is responsible for event planning fees, course and venue fees, transportation fees, and meals. In addition to paying for transportation to and from the place of residence, and room and board during the event (or can be booked by the organizer), students are required to pay a registration fee of NT$3,000 (or US$100) upon registration. The fee includes tickets to the "2012 Taipei Franchise Exhibition", meals and insurance for study courses and corporate visits, etc. Those interested in registering should contact the Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center at 714-754-9999 or the Los Angeles Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center at 626-443-9999 before July 30, 2012.

2511641e587a9dbbf9f64caf0f113f2ab730ec28.sourceText: 州参议院1070议案抗议者承认封堵凤凰城接到有罪 （亚省时报） 9名于四月因封堵中央大道(Central Avenue)被逮捕并遭起诉抗议者当中的五位已于本周三承认自己犯有 行为不当的罪行。 据其中一位抗议者说，他们的刑期到已服刑期时即刑满。第六位抗议则被法官判定有罪，刑期未定。大约有 500名抗议者于四月二十五日最高法院争论亚利桑那移民法，即SB1070，时封堵中央大道长达半个小时。 九人 当中的六人于抗议前已做好被逮捕准备，另外三位则因不服从警察命令而被逮捕。
2511641e587a9dbbf9f64caf0f113f2ab730ec28.translatedText: Protesters of State Senate Bill 1070 pleaded guilty to blocking traffic in Phoenix (Alberta Times) Nine people were found guilty of blocking Central Avenue in April (Alberta Times) Five of the protesters who were arrested and charged on Wednesday pleaded guilty to misconduct, and were serving their sentences, according to one of the protesters. A judge convicted a sixth protester, whose prison sentence has yet to be determined. About 500 protesters blocked Central Avenue for half an hour on April 25 as the Supreme Court debated the Arizona immigration law, known as SB 1070. Six of them were prepared to be arrested before the protest, while the other three were arrested for disobeying police orders.

a9f85cd3c76aebbac5df7c3a24e2162d2827c2dc.sourceText: 身在天涯，心系华夏。同一轮明月，同一条血脉。又是中秋，亲人团聚的日子，又是国庆， 同胞举杯的日子。亚省华人华侨联合会(亚省华联 UCAA)和亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院主领，大凤凰城各界华人华侨团体，包括大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会，亚利桑那州立大学中国学生学者联谊会，亚省现代中文学校，亚省希望中文学校，《亚省时报》报社及各族各界民众热情参与，共同举办了第七届”凤凰之夜”-亚省华人华侨庆祝国庆暨中秋佳节系列活动。经过主办方和志愿者的精心准备，各项活动安排的细致周到，井然有序。第七届《凤凰之夜》中秋、国庆系列庆典活动在大家的积极参与和鼎力支持下取得了圆满成功！
a9f85cd3c76aebbac5df7c3a24e2162d2827c2dc.translatedText: He is at the end of the world, but his heart is in China. The same bright moon, the same bloodline. It’s Mid-Autumn Festival again, a day for family reunions, and it’s National Day, a day for compatriots to raise glasses. The Chinese Association of Chinese and Overseas Chinese in Alberta (UCAA) and the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University led the Chinese and overseas Chinese groups from all walks of life in Greater Phoenix, including the Greater Phoenix Chinese Overseas Chinese Association, the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of Arizona State University, the Alberta Modern Chinese School, the Alberta Hope Chinese School, the "Alberta Times" newspaper and people of all ethnic groups and all walks of life enthusiastically participated in the seventh "Phoenix Night" - a series of activities for Chinese and overseas Chinese in Alberta to celebrate the National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival. After careful preparation by the organizers and volunteers, all activities were arranged thoughtfully and orderly. The seventh "Phoenix Night" Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day celebrations were a complete success with everyone's active participation and full support!

b030e8ab3c5333d9edca41c04e5c23560fa62e46.sourceText: 2013年9月22日 摄于亚利桑那州立大学，第七届”凤凰之夜” (摄影 Anthony Kong, 叶萌, 林原)
b030e8ab3c5333d9edca41c04e5c23560fa62e46.translatedText: Taken at Arizona State University on September 22, 2013, the 7th "Phoenix Night" (photographed by Anthony Kong, Ye Meng, Lin Yuan)

d0f40c2e31aaeac74d9a27f8fff6bac924b83336.sourceText: 9月22日下午3点，亚利桑那州华人华侨，以及其他各族裔的友人们涌入Arizona State University 的 Memorial Union，共度2013欢庆中秋国庆的”凤凰之夜”。亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院院长Dr. Madeline K. Spring主持了《中美合作面面观》论坛。中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆车兆和文化参赞为中美文化论坛的开幕式致辞并发表了热情洋溢的演讲。他在致辞中自豪地谈到，建国以后的64年，中国在政治经济文化各领域创造出了不起的成就，中国的国际力量举足轻重，蒸蒸日上。他特别和大家分享了中共中央总书记习近平所提出的”中国梦”。中国梦就是人民幸福，民族复兴，世界和谐。中国梦和美国梦，其关系如同兄弟姐妹，互补互益。他衷心地感谢海外华人华侨海外留学生为祖国繁荣发展所作出的巨大努力，支持和贡献。
d0f40c2e31aaeac74d9a27f8fff6bac924b83336.translatedText: At 3 pm on September 22, Arizona Chinese and overseas Chinese, as well as friends of other ethnic groups, poured into the Memorial Union of Arizona State University to celebrate the 2013 "Phoenix Night" to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day. Dr. Madeline K. Spring, Director of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, hosted the forum "Aspects of Sino-US Cooperation". Che Zhaohe, Cultural Counselor of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, addressed the opening ceremony of the China-US Cultural Forum and delivered a passionate speech. In his speech, he proudly said that in the 64 years since the founding of the People's Republic of China, China has created remarkable achievements in various fields of politics, economy and culture, and China's international power is of great importance and is growing day by day. He especially shared with everyone the "Chinese Dream" proposed by Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. The Chinese dream is the happiness of the people, the rejuvenation of the nation, and the harmony of the world. The Chinese Dream and the American Dream are like brothers and sisters, complementary and beneficial to each other. He sincerely thanked overseas Chinese students for their tremendous efforts, support and contributions to the prosperity and development of the motherland.

7794b94412e0837a327219043b76155e08a1e6dc.sourceText: 代表亚利桑那州第五区的美国国会议员Matt Salmon先生是唯一能流畅说中文的美国国会议员，当日因需要继续留在ＤＣ参加国会对国家经费预算的讨论，他派第五区的工作总监Chuck Gray先生在中美文化论坛上发表了题为”中国，战略伙伴还是经济竞争对手”的演讲辞。Matt Salmon先生强调：在国际舞台上，中国和美国既是竞争对手也是合作伙伴，互相依存，并且具有共同的世界经济和安全利益。今年7月，奥巴马总统和习近平总书记的会晤取得了令人欣喜的进展。中国是一个日益强大的超级世界力量，中美在经济和安全各方面的 相互依赖程度，要求中美能够和平友好，共同努力，加强合作对话，促进世界稳定和经济繁荣。
7794b94412e0837a327219043b76155e08a1e6dc.translatedText: Mr. Matt Salmon, the U.S. Congressman representing Arizona's Fifth District, is the only U.S. Congressman who can speak Chinese fluently. Because he needed to stay in DC to participate in the Congressional discussion of the national budget that day, he sent Mr. Chuck Gray, the working director of the Fifth District, to deliver a speech titled "China, Strategic Partner or Economic Competitor" at the Sino-US Cultural Forum. Mr. Matt Salmon emphasized: On the international stage, China and the United States are both competitors and partners, interdependent, and have common world economic and security interests. In July this year, the meeting between President Obama and General Secretary Xi Jinping made gratifying progress. China is an increasingly powerful super world power. The degree of interdependence between China and the United States in all aspects of economy and security requires that China and the United States can be peaceful and friendly, work together, strengthen cooperation and dialogue, and promote world stability and economic prosperity.

5a4c4c492128a9c7dc3c8458a9a307f405665072.sourceText: Briand Greer先生，国际航空业的顶尖公司Honeywell的亚太航空部主席，也在中美文化论坛上讲述”商业航空在中国：一个特写视角”。在过去5年中，中国的GDP 增长超过了其他8个主要发展国家的总和。中国的商业航空业才刚刚起步，他预计，未来几十年，中国的商业航空业都将以两位数字增长。中国航空业的市场前景不可限量！
5a4c4c492128a9c7dc3c8458a9a307f405665072.translatedText: Mr. Briand Greer, Chairman of the Asia Pacific Aviation Department of Honeywell, a top company in the international aviation industry, also spoke about "Commercial Aviation in China: A Close-up Perspective" at the Sino-US Cultural Forum. Over the past five years, China's GDP growth has exceeded that of the other eight major developing countries combined. China's commercial aviation industry has just started. He predicts that China's commercial aviation industry will grow at double digits in the next few decades. The market prospects of China’s aviation industry are limitless!

3210b45dff427c7b44d490d72dfe16f9a57c55d2.sourceText: Steven Tu先生，Intel的移动生产线总设计师，则描述了”Intel 的下一步转折点：移动在中国”。他以翔实的数据分析向大家展现移动通讯在中国发展的巨大前景，仅以智能手机为例，其用户增长速度最快的国家是中国，占31%，而第二位的是美国，占28%；全球pc消费最大的 国家，在2010年，是美国，而在2011年，是中国。他的演说向 人们展示了Intel这位高科技公司巨头向中国发展移动通讯事业的战略构想和前景。
3210b45dff427c7b44d490d72dfe16f9a57c55d2.translatedText: Mr. Steven Tu, the chief designer of Intel's mobile production line, described "Intel's next turning point: mobile in China." He used detailed data analysis to show everyone the huge prospects for the development of mobile communications in China. Taking smartphones as an example, the country with the fastest user growth is China, accounting for 31%, and the second place is the United States, accounting for 28%; the country with the largest PC consumption in the world was the United States in 2010, and in 2011, it was China. His speech showed people the strategic vision and prospects of Intel, a high-tech giant, in developing mobile communications in China.

428d4b18e3179b468a1c4b6b910099579c62c039.sourceText: 下午5点举办的国庆招待会，自始至终充满了热烈欢快、喜庆祥和的节日气氛。活动现场灯火通明，四周布展了参加亚省青少年摄影比赛和海报设计比赛的学生们的获奖作品。国庆招待会及青少年摄影比赛和海报设计比赛颁奖典礼由林欣女士和廖丰先生共同主持。国庆招待会在雄壮的美中两国国歌声中开始。亚省华联 UCAA 会长王惟咨博士和亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院院长 Dr. Madeline K. Spring 先后上台致欢迎词。中华人民共和国驻洛杉矶总领事馆车兆和文化参赞代表中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆在招待会上致辞，向亚省广大华人华侨以及中国留学生致以诚挚的节日祝贺。接着，特邀嘉宾一一上台致词。亚利桑那州参议员Kimberly Yee (余艳芬)向组委会发来了贺函，预祝庆祝活动取得圆满成功。
428d4b18e3179b468a1c4b6b910099579c62c039.translatedText: The National Day reception held at 5 pm was filled with a warm, cheerful, festive and peaceful festival atmosphere from beginning to end. The event site was brightly lit, and the winning works of students who participated in the Alberta Youth Photography Competition and Poster Design Competition were displayed around it. The National Day reception and the awards ceremony for the Youth Photography Competition and Poster Design Competition were co-hosted by Ms. Lin Xin and Mr. Liao Feng. The National Day reception began with the majestic national anthems of the United States and China. Dr. Wang Weizi, President of UCAA, and Dr. Madeline K. Spring, Director of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, took the stage to deliver welcome speeches. Che Zhaohe, Cultural Counselor of the Consulate General of the People's Republic of China in Los Angeles, delivered a speech at the reception on behalf of the Consulate General of the People's Republic of China in Los Angeles, extending his sincere holiday congratulations to the vast number of overseas Chinese in Alberta and Chinese students studying abroad. Then, the special guests came on stage one by one to deliver speeches. Arizona State Senator Kimberly Yee sent a congratulatory letter to the organizing committee, wishing the celebration a complete success.

aaed3cec604a5a410ffb8c11f9fd775035cfa5e7.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院青少年摄影比赛和海报设计比赛评选日前已揭晓。人们徜徉在一排排获奖的作品中间，真的很惊叹这些海外的孩子们竟能如此精妙地用画笔用镜头捕捉到那么多中华文化之美。
aaed3cec604a5a410ffb8c11f9fd775035cfa5e7.translatedText: >The selection for the Youth Photography Competition and Poster Design Competition of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University has been announced recently. People wandered among the rows of award-winning works and were really amazed that these overseas children could capture so much of the beauty of Chinese culture with their brushes and lenses.

6ae1cbb65cab49f605bfbe65763acba41dcf2164.sourceText: 佳节庆典，美馔佳肴，轻歌曼舞。Chandler市少年儿童合唱团歌声悠扬，带来了亚利桑那州各族裔的祝福；ASU学生一曲”月亮代表我的心””弯弯的月亮”，唱出海外华人华侨”但愿人长久，千里共婵娟”的 乡情；老年舞蹈带给人生命不老的活力；而新东方艺术学校的孩子们先舞一出”情深意长”，再舞一出”彩云追月”，让人仿佛置身故土乡亲的缱绻深情。
6ae1cbb65cab49f605bfbe65763acba41dcf2164.translatedText: Festive celebrations, delicious food, singing and dancing. The melodious singing of the Chandler City Children's Chorus brought blessings from all ethnic groups in Arizona; ASU students sang "The Moon Represents My Heart" and "The Curved Moon", singing the sentiments of overseas Chinese "I hope we will live long and share the beauty of the moon thousands of miles apart" Nostalgia; the elderly dance brings people eternal vitality; and the children of the New Oriental Art School first danced "Long Love" and then danced "Colorful Clouds Chasing the Moon", making people feel like they are in the affectionate and affectionate atmosphere of the hometown folks.

237ff7df8804ac09b05d1b0268be9012a1fc681f.sourceText: 7点，夜色降临，夜色中的 音乐更加欢快，这是舞会时分了。人潮涌动，新朋老友相聚，个个欢声笑语，对对翩翩起舞，整个大厅就化成了一片欢乐的海洋。
237ff7df8804ac09b05d1b0268be9012a1fc681f.translatedText: At 7 o'clock, night fell, and the music in the night became more cheerful. It was dance time. The crowd was surging, new and old friends gathered together, everyone laughed and danced with each other, and the whole hall turned into a sea of ​​joy.

05e12feae09aeb7a695a59550a5f585bc88e8c08.sourceText: 在此，特别感谢为系列庆祝活动在财力上给予鼎力相助的亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院。感谢大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会，廖丰先生，《亚省时报》报社， 亚省现代中文学校，屈宁女士，等单位和个人的大力赞助。感谢所有参与系列庆祝活动的志愿者、捐款者、演员、团体和个人。感谢亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院副院长谭徐智萍女士为本次活动所做的大量工作。感谢亚利桑那州立大学中国学生学者联谊会的大力协助。感谢周圭珍女士，何梦白小姐花费大量心血，连续七年无偿为”凤凰之夜”设计精美的海报，特此鸣谢。正是由于大家齐心协力和无私奉献，才使得此次系列庆祝活动取得了圆满成功。亚省华联 UCAA衷心期望在日后的社区活动中，继续得到大家的鼓励和支持。让我们携起手来，一起踏踏实实地为丰富社区华人华侨的业余生活做点儿实事。获到各社会团体和社区各界人士广泛认同的亚利桑那第七届”凤凰之夜”中秋国庆系列庆典活动，在社区的共同努力和参与下，终于圆满落幕。最新消息和详情请浏览亚省华联网站： www.chineseaz.org.
05e12feae09aeb7a695a59550a5f585bc88e8c08.translatedText: Here, special thanks go to the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University for its financial support for the series of celebrations. Thanks to the Federation of Chinese Overseas Chinese in Greater Phoenix, Mr. Liao Feng, the "Alberta Times" newspaper, the Alberta Modern Chinese School, Ms. Qu Ning, and other organizations and individuals for their strong sponsorship. Thank you to all volunteers, donors, actors, groups and individuals who participated in the series of celebrations. Thanks to Ms. Tan Xu Zhiping, Associate Director of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, for her extensive work on this event. Thanks to the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of Arizona State University for their great assistance. Thanks to Ms. Zhou Guizhen and Ms. He Mengbai for spending a lot of effort and designing exquisite posters for "Phoenix Night" free of charge for seven consecutive years. It is precisely because of everyone's concerted efforts and selfless dedication that this series of celebrations was a complete success. UCAA sincerely hopes to continue to receive everyone’s encouragement and support in future community activities. Let us join hands and do something practical to enrich the spare time life of the Chinese and overseas Chinese in the community. Arizona's seventh "Phoenix Night" Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day celebration series, which has been widely recognized by various social groups and people from all walks of life in the community, finally came to a successful conclusion with the joint efforts and participation of the community. For the latest news and details, please visit the Alberta Hualian website: www.chineseaz.org.

5223be0116b6d795064c83fdfa8457198521e5f0.sourceText: 大凤凰城，全美第六大都会，这座以高科技驰名，朝气蓬勃的年轻城市，活跃着十几万华裔子孙。亚省的华裔子孙们在高等学府，高科技公司，联邦州市各级政府，商业，教育等等各个领域，以他们的睿智勤奋服务社区，为当地社区做出了杰出贡献，成为当地文化中的一道亮丽风景。亚省的华裔子孙们心系祖国，纷纷回国创业讲学，投资捐助，跨国经商，跨国交流文化教育，融会中美文化的精华，向西方传播东方的精华，向东方传播西方的精华，努力着，期待着那一天，中国梦，美国梦，梦想相通相连，共同实现东西方文明汇流奔腾向前，世界文明和谐繁荣的同一个人类之梦。
5223be0116b6d795064c83fdfa8457198521e5f0.translatedText: Greater Phoenix is ​​the sixth largest city in the United States. This vibrant young city is famous for its high technology and is home to hundreds of thousands of descendants of Chinese descent. The descendants of Chinese Americans in Alberta serve the community with their wisdom and diligence in various fields such as institutions of higher learning, high-tech companies, federal, state and city governments, business, education, etc., making outstanding contributions to the local community and becoming a beautiful scenery in the local culture. The descendants of Chinese Americans in Alberta care deeply about their motherland, and have returned home to start businesses, give lectures, invest and donate, do business across borders, exchange cultural education across borders, integrate the essence of Chinese and American cultures, spread the essence of the East to the West, and spread the essence of the West to the East. They are working hard and looking forward to the day when the Chinese dream and the American dream are interlinked, and together we can realize the same human dream of the convergence of Eastern and Western civilizations, and the harmonious prosperity of world civilizations.

41498b5882039204fb5f3c33cdc0ed0d263211ee.sourceText: 相约凤凰城，年年今宵，相聚”凤凰之夜”。愿祖国国运昌盛，国泰民安！
41498b5882039204fb5f3c33cdc0ed0d263211ee.translatedText: Meet in Phoenix, tonight every year, gather for "Phoenix Night". May the motherland be prosperous, the country peaceful and the people safe!

ced46887a03c0e295e1ad74189c6dc0b9abc4772.sourceText: 据台湾媒体报道，35岁的吴建豪（Van Ness）与31岁的石贞善（Arissa）8月9日七夕情人节在新加坡提出结婚申请，正式终结单身！小俩口15日（下周五）将在洛杉矶纽波特海滩的The Resort at Pelican Hill五星级饭店举办婚礼，该饭店还有全加州最大、直径41公尺的圆形游泳池，亲友近日陆续收到喜帖，婚礼主题为”摇滚朋克风”，被邀是黑色领带喝喜酒；他的好友萧亚轩（ELVA）将担任婚礼歌手献唱。
ced46887a03c0e295e1ad74189c6dc0b9abc4772.translatedText: According to Taiwan media reports, 35-year-old Wu Jianhao (Van Ness) Ness) and 31-year-old Shi Zhenshan (Arissa) filed for marriage in Singapore on Chinese Valentine's Day on August 9th, officially ending their single life! The couple will hold their wedding on the 15th (next Friday) at The Resort at Pelican Hill, a five-star hotel in Newport Beach, Los Angeles. The hotel also has the largest circular swimming pool in California with a diameter of 41 meters. Relatives and friends have recently received wedding invitations. The theme of the wedding is "rock and punk style". They are invited to wear black tie and drink wedding wine; his friend Elva Hsiao (Elva) will be the wedding singer.

bce32dde521de177a089c1284c576af85c04c1b0.sourceText: 吴建豪与Arissa是在2006年合作他MV《我的王国》相恋，2人曾因聚少离多分手，复合后传出因他信上帝婚前禁欲誓言，感情再度触礁，2人后来复合，感情急速升温稳定，情牵至今7年，终于在8月开花结果，决定步入礼堂。
bce32dde521de177a089c1284c576af85c04c1b0.translatedText: > Wu Jianhao and Arissa fell in love when they collaborated on his MV "My Kingdom" in 2006. The two had been separated for a long time. After getting back together, it was rumored that they believed in God and vowed abstinence before marriage.

e4a45b8fff5f1f76f85f05dab579b1732e1343cc.sourceText: Arissa家族在新加坡从事棕榈油事业，身家估达100亿元台币，她与2个弟弟都在美国求学，2001年趁申请大学的空档来台，曾演出《吐司男之吻2》、《甜柠檬之恋》，也上过《康熙来了》，目前已淡出娱乐圈，在新加坡经营CARTE BLANCHE X购物网。依据新加坡规定，新人提出结婚申请需3个月审核期，他们8月9日提出申请，换句话说，明（9日）将正式成为新加坡法律上的夫妻。
e4a45b8fff5f1f76f85f05dab579b1732e1343cc.translatedText: Arissa's family is engaged in the palm oil business in Singapore. Her net worth is estimated to be NT$10 billion. She and her two brothers are studying in the United States. In 2001, she came to Taiwan while applying for college. She has performed in "Toast Man Kiss 2", "Sweet Lemon Love", and also appeared in "Kangxi Is Coming". She has now retired from the entertainment industry and operates CARTE in Singapore. BLANCHE X shopping network. According to Singapore regulations, a couple's application for marriage requires a three-month review period. They applied on August 9. In other words, they will officially become a legal couple in Singapore tomorrow (9th).

fb998747b9767fee3f44a4ed435d2db6b58b73ab.sourceText: 他们婚礼将在洛杉矶近郊的The Resort at Pelican Hill饭店举行，该饭店位于南加州纽波特海滩，拥有高尔夫球场、别墅Villa，还有全加州最大、直径41公尺的圆形游泳池，一般房间每晚要价1.2万到3万元台币，Villa房型则要9万元台币。婚礼场地正对太平洋，海景美不胜收，周围铺满白玫瑰，依照美国习俗，15日当天下午3点将举行基督教的婚礼仪式，5点宴请亲友享用美式自助吧餐点，晚上则是派对。
fb998747b9767fee3f44a4ed435d2db6b58b73ab.translatedText: Their wedding will be held at The Resort at Pelican Hill Hotel in the suburbs of Los Angeles. The hotel is located in Newport Beach, Southern California. It has a golf course, a villa, and the largest round swimming pool in California with a diameter of 41 meters. General rooms cost NT$12,000 to NT$30,000 per night, and Villa rooms cost NT$90,000. The wedding venue faces the Pacific Ocean. The sea view is breathtaking and surrounded by white roses. According to American customs, a Christian wedding ceremony will be held at 3 p.m. on the 15th. At 5 p.m., relatives and friends will be invited to enjoy American buffet meals, and there will be a party in the evening.

d3426ae5801cc3dd6706cdb73d5e15203644d773.sourceText: 2013年优秀华裔大学生文化参访团 通 知 一、活动宗旨 进一步增进海内外优秀华裔大学生之间的文化交流和感情沟通，共同探寻文化根，民族魂，中华梦的丰富内涵，共创民族振兴的美好未来。 二、主办单位 中国华文教育基金会 上海市海外交流协会 三、活动时间 7月10日 上海报到(9:00-17:00) 7月10日-7月19日 上海活动 7月19日 上海飞台北(MU5007 12:30-14:00) 7月19日-7月29日 台湾活动 7月29日 台北飞上海(MU5008 15:00-16:40)，散团 四、参加对象 18至25周岁在著名高校就读的优秀华裔大学生（包括海外及港澳台、上海本地著名高校的学生），共70人。 五、日程安排 （可能略作调整） 1、主题论坛及开（闭）幕式、青年圆桌会议等 2、名家讲座 3、企业参访 4、社区考察 5、公益活动 6、交流座谈 7、文化体验 六、事项说明 1、为方便管理，保障安全，活动期间全体营员的食宿、交通、参观、游览等活动均由主办方统一安排。主办方将免费提供统一制作的活动服装及证件等，活动期间全体成员请按要求着装和佩带证件。 2、赴台手续请自行办理。 3、请于2013年5月10日前将活动报名表（附后，请不要修改表格格式！）发往主办方电子邮箱： wxc@overseas.sh.cn 。 4、全体营员请于7月10日自行前往住宿地报到（地址另行通知），7月29日活动结束后自行离营。 5、活动期间请全体营员带好学生证。 6、活动期间将举行联欢和才艺表演，如有需要请自备乐器和道具。 7、全体营员请将有个人签名的?#33829;员须知?#65288;附后），于报到当天交给主办方工作人员。 8、关于费用 （1）全体营员抵离上海的机票及相关税费、上海至台北的往返机票及相关税费、提前抵达或推迟离开发生的费用及其他个人费用自理。 （2）活动期间的住宿、用餐、交通、参观、旅游意外保险等费用均由主办方承担。 （3）如需代购7月19日、7月29日上海至台北的往返机票，每位营员需交纳7151元；如需代购7月19日上海至台北的单程机票，每位营员需交纳4234元（如有机票折扣将退还多余款项）。 （4）7月29日抵达上海后，如需停留一晚离沪，请提前告知，以便安排住宿。 （5）费用仅限人民币，并请于5月31日前汇款至下列帐号： 上海市人民政府侨务办公室 1001255329226403868 022553-工行静安寺支行 （汇款时请注明: 2013年优秀华裔大学生文化参访团） 联 系 人： 韩 流 邹 芳 电 话： 0086-21-62491713，0086-13671524691（韩） 传 真： 0086-21-62482940 电子信箱：wxc@overseas.sh.cn 上海市海外交流协会 2013年4月15日
d3426ae5801cc3dd6706cdb73d5e15203644d773.translatedText: 2013 Cultural Visiting Group of Outstanding Chinese College Students Notice 1. Purpose of the Activity To further enhance cultural exchanges and emotional communication between outstanding Chinese college students at home and abroad, jointly explore the cultural roots, national soul, and the rich connotation of the Chinese Dream, and jointly create a better future for national revitalization. 2. Organizer China Chinese Education Foundation Shanghai Overseas Exchange Association 3. Event time July 10 Shanghai arrival (9:00-17:00) July 10-July 19 Shanghai event July 19 Shanghai to Taipei (MU5007 12:30-14:00) July 19-July 29 Taiwan event July 29 Taipei to Shanghai (MU5008 15:00-16:40), group disbanded 4. Participants: 70 outstanding Chinese college students aged 18 to 25 years old studying in famous universities (including students from overseas, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan and famous local universities in Shanghai). 5. Schedule (may be slightly adjusted) 1. Theme forums, opening (closing) ceremonies, youth roundtables, etc. 2. Lectures by famous experts 3. Corporate visits 4. Community inspections 5. Public welfare activities 6. Exchange discussions 7. Cultural experience 6. Description of matters 1. In order to facilitate management and ensure safety, the food and accommodation, transportation, visits, sightseeing and other activities of all campers during the event will be arranged by the organizer. The organizer will provide uniformly produced event clothing and IDs for free. During the event, all members are required to dress and wear IDs as required. 2. Please handle the procedures for traveling to Taiwan by yourself. 3. Please send the event registration form (attached, please do not modify the form format!) to the organizer’s email address: wxc@overseas.sh.cn before May 10, 2013. 4. All campers are required to report to their accommodation on July 10 (the address will be notified separately) and leave the camp on their own after the activity ends on July 29. 5. During the activity, all campers are asked to bring their student ID cards. 6. There will be a party and talent show during the event. Please bring your own musical instruments and props if necessary. 7. All campers please submit the personally signed "Instructions for Campers" (attached) to the organizer's staff on the day of registration. 8. 1750801ed09da68fd9f255231774217354c0a8c4.sourceText: 1990年代本田、丰田 偷车贼最爱 （亚省时报） 全国保险犯罪局(NICB)20日说，窃贼最爱偷1990年代的本田和丰田汽车，因为他们可以把这些汽车解体出售零件，其价值高于车价。 不过，现在新车失窃案也在增加。 哥伦比亚广播公司(CBS)报导说，NICB的报告表示新车型窃案有增加趋势，虽然这些车型采用精密的钥匙密码科技，理论上比较难偷。 NICB说，这种科技必须使用正确的钥匙，否则引擎不能启动，可是罪犯会设法取得特定车辆的钥匙密码，并配制替代钥匙。 去年失窃最多的车型是1994年份的本田Accord和1998年份的本田Civic，其次是2006年份的福特小货车，1991年份的丰田Camry排名第四。 最容易失窃的车型依次是2000年份道奇Caravan、1994年份Acura Integra、1999年份雪佛兰小货车、2004年份道奇小货车、2002年份福特Explorer、1994年份日产Sentra。 如窃贼拿到替代钥匙，要防止汽车失窃很难。 不过，这类窃案在所有窃车案中只占很小的比率。 NICB对汽车防盗提供下列建议： 为汽车上锁。 许多专业和业余的窃车贼专门找容易下手的目标，因此他们会放过似乎无法很快搞定的汽车。 花大约50元买个锁方向盘的拐杖锁，或花大约80元买个锁轮胎的「胎爪」(tire claw)，就可以让窃贼知难而退。 安装警报器。 花200元到300元安装汽车警报器，如有人企图不用钥匙开车门，警报器会大鸣。 在车窗上用贴纸标示装有警报器。 刺耳的警报声或许无法遏止所有窃贼，不过可能让他们决定不自找麻烦。 安装追踪器。 新车特别值得这样做。 花大约700元安装Lo-Jack之类的追踪器，一旦启动它会向警方通报汽车的确实所在。 即使窃贼有汽车钥匙，追踪器可能在汽车被转售或解体前迅速找回来。
1750801ed09da68fd9f255231774217354c0a8c4.translatedText: Honda and Toyota were the favorites of car thieves in the 1990s (Alberta Times) The National Insurance Crime Bureau (NICB) said on the 20th that thieves like to steal Honda and Toyota cars from the 1990s because they can dismantle these cars and sell the parts, which are worth more than the price of the car. However, new car thefts are also on the rise. CBS reported that the NICB report indicated that thefts of new car models are on the rise, although these models use sophisticated key code technology and are theoretically more difficult to steal. The NICB said this technology requires the correct key to be used, otherwise the engine will not start, but criminals will try to obtain the key code of a specific vehicle and prepare a replacement key. The most stolen models last year were the 1994 Honda Accord and the 1998 Honda Civic, followed by the 2006 Ford minivan and the 1991 Toyota Camry in fourth place. The most commonly stolen vehicles are the 2000 Dodge Caravan, the 1994 Acura Integra, the 1999 Chevrolet pickup truck, the 2004 Dodge pickup truck, the 2002 Ford Explorer, and the 1994 Nissan Sentra. If a thief obtains a replacement key, it will be difficult to prevent the car from being stolen. However, these types of thefts account for only a small percentage of all car thefts. The NICB offers the following recommendations for car theft prevention: Lock your car. Many professional and amateur car thieves specialize in looking for easy targets, so they'll let go of cars that they don't seem to be able to take down quickly. Spend about 50 yuan to buy a crutch lock to lock the steering wheel, or spend about 80 yuan to buy a "tire claw" to lock the tires, which can deter thieves. Install sirens. Spend 200 to 300 yuan to install a car alarm. If someone tries to open the door without a key, the alarm will sound. Use a sticker on your car window to indicate the presence of a siren. A blaring siren may not deter all thieves, but it may make them decide not to cause trouble. Install the tracker. New cars are especially worth doing. It costs about $700 to install a tracker like Lo-Jack, which once activated will notify police of the car's exact location. Even if a thief has the car keys, the tracker can quickly recover the car before it is resold or dismantled.

6954aec77a15bf8f2133ea2887e3b5ee2cb1ff60.sourceText: 我们的国庆节—2012独立日获奖作文选登（一等奖） （作者：王慧琳） 爸爸和妈妈刚到美国是三月份。那时，他们什么也听不懂，家人和朋友都在中国，每天都想家，真的是很悲哀。那年的七月四日，邻居们都在庆祝美国的国庆节。父母那时很穷，住的公寓不太好。隔壁的美国人也很穷，国庆节就烧烤，吃鸡腿儿、鸡翅膀、喝啤酒，放音乐。烧烤的香味伴着音乐，一直飘到爸爸和妈妈那寂寞的家中。从他们的公寓，可以听见隔壁那家的笑声，我妈妈就想起自己的家，想起以前在中国庆祝的国庆节，真感觉很悲伤。在她心里：美国不是我的家，这也不是我的节日。 第二年父母攒了些钱，美国的独立日又到了。这次他们也学邻居，买了个烧烤炉子，又买了些鸡腿儿、鸡翅膀、啤酒，请来几个新朋友，也要烧烤。那年他们虽然也在学美国人，可是却没有那庆祝节日的感觉。国庆节对这些远离家乡的人来说是那么的遥远。 这样的国庆节，爸爸和妈妈在美国过了好多个。六七年内，已经搬过七八个公寓，每一个给父母的感觉都像个旅店，真正的家还在中国呢。每年，父母都要庆祝一些中国节日，美国的国庆节也就是父母可以休息的一天。后来，终于搬到了一个两层楼的房子。那时，爸爸和妈妈已经生了我。几年后，又生了我妹妹，家里就有两个孩子。我和妹妹从小跟邻居的美国孩子一起长大，美国的习俗就是我们的习俗，美国的语言就是我们的语言，美国的节日就是我们的节日。 我们住的社区里，每年的国庆节，大家都会在门外插个国旗，那天早晨我就能从窗子看见大家的旗子在天空里飘扬着，真优美。妈妈和爸爸看别人每年插个国旗，又看我和妹妹是真想显示我们的爱国精神，就也买了个美国国旗。社区有个活动，每到独立日，总有人组织小孩儿骑自行车，在社区里走一圈。骑自行车的孩子都穿着有美国国旗颜色的衣服，连自行车也装饰上国旗的颜色。我七岁那年，妹妹才三岁，我们姐俩真想参加这个活动。为了让我们参与这个，妈妈特意给我们买了一些戴蓝色、红色、和白色的衣服和裙子。那年的国庆节，我们也跟着大家骑着自行车，穿着漂亮的小裙子，心里真自豪。 慢慢的，爸爸和妈妈开始习惯美国，和我们一起尝美国食品，穿美国衣服，庆祝美国的节日。这一年，国庆节又要来了， 父母特意安排那周去游览首都华盛顿特区。终于等到了国庆节的那个星期，我们全家都装好了包，开车去美国首都玩儿。在华盛顿特区，我们看到了许多惊人的纪念碑，学到了很多关于美国历史的学问。国庆节那天，我们早早的起来，去看华盛顿最著名的游行！我们在街道旁等了好久，终于看到了我们等待的游行。哇！太神奇了！游行队伍有各种各样的人！有军乐队演奏乐器，还有军队里的士兵，打扮成山姆大叔，挥舞着美国国旗，也有人唱歌、跳舞，又有好多花车。我们马路上的观众都穿着爱国服装，欢呼游行队伍，真的能看出我们观众和游行队员的爱国主义精神。 现在，我和妹妹都长大了，我们姐妹每年庆祝的国庆节，慢慢地成了我们一家每年都要庆祝的节日。妈妈说，我们在哪儿，哪儿就是我们的家 — Home is where we are. 独立日作文比赛颁奖现场
6954aec77a15bf8f2133ea2887e3b5ee2cb1ff60.translatedText: Our National Day - A selection of winning essays on Independence Day 2012 (first prize) (Author: Wang Huilin) It was March when my father and mother first arrived in the United States. At that time, they didn't understand anything. Their family and friends were all in China, and they missed home every day. It was really sad. On the Fourth of July that year, neighbors were celebrating America's Fourth of July. My parents were very poor at the time and the apartment they lived in was not very good. The Americans next door are also very poor. On National Day, they have barbecues, eat chicken legs and wings, drink beer, and play music. The aroma of barbecue, accompanied by music, floated all the way to the lonely home of my father and mother. From their apartment, you could hear the laughter of the family next door, and my mother thought of her own home and the National Day celebrations she used to celebrate in China, and she felt really sad. In her mind: America is not my home, and this is not my holiday. The next year, my parents saved some money, and America’s Independence Day came again. This time they also followed the example of their neighbors and bought a barbecue stove, some chicken legs, chicken wings, and beer. They also invited some new friends to have a barbecue. Although they were learning from Americans that year, they didn't have the feeling of celebrating a holiday. National Day is so far away for these people who are far away from home. My father and mother have spent many National Days like this in the United States. In the past six or seven years, I have moved to seven or eight apartments, and each one feels like a hotel to my parents. Their real home is still in China. Every year, parents celebrate some Chinese festivals, and the National Day in the United States is a day when parents can take a break. Later, I finally moved to a two-story house. At that time, my father and mother had already given birth to me. A few years later, my sister was born, and there were two children in the family. My sister and I grew up with the American children in our neighborhood. American customs are our customs, American language is our language, and American holidays are our holidays. In the community where we live, every National Day, everyone will plant a national flag outside the door. That morning I could see everyone’s flag flying in the sky from the window. It was so beautiful. My mother and father saw others planting national flags every year, and seeing that my sister and I really wanted to show our patriotism, they bought an American flag too. There is an activity in the community. Every Independence Day, someone always organizes children to ride bicycles and walk around the community. The kids riding the bikes all wore clothes in the colors of the American flag, and even the bikes were decorated in the colors of the flag. When I was seven years old and my sister was only three years old, we really wanted to participate in this event. In order for us to participate in this, my mother bought us some blue, red, and white clothes and skirts. On the National Day that year, we rode bicycles with everyone and wore beautiful little skirts. We felt so proud. Slowly, my father and mother began to get used to the United States. They tasted American food, wore American clothes, and celebrated American festivals with us. This year, the National Day is coming again, and my parents specially arranged to visit the capital, Washington, D.C. that week. Finally, during the week of the Fourth of July, our family packed our bags and drove to the capital of the United States. In Washington, D.C., we saw many amazing monuments and learned a lot about American history. On National Day, we got up early to watch the most famous parade in Washington! We waited along the street for a long time and finally saw the parade we were waiting for. Wow! It's amazing! There were all kinds of people in the parade! There were military bands playing instruments, soldiers from the army dressed as Uncle Sam, waving American flags, people singing and dancing, and many floats. The spectators on our street were all dressed in patriotic costumes and cheering for the parade. You can really see the patriotic spirit of our spectators and the parade members. Now that my sister and I have grown up, the National Day that our sisters celebrate every year has slowly become a holiday that our family celebrates every year. Mom said, wherever we are, that is our home — Home is where we are. Award ceremony for the Independence Day Essay Contest
