0819279b818984fd9461a6f654bbce43b4534843.sourceText: 2月23日上午9时，在慈济凤凰城联络处热闹非凡，大人，小孩，还有老人都来到这里，这次他们来不是领取食品，都是来进行免费 体检。 慈济路易斯师兄介绍，凤凰城当地十二位医生，四位护士，还有他们带来的助理以及学生，近四十人的医护队伍自愿免费来为大家义诊。 他们中有儿科，内科，眼科，中医科，皮肤科，妇科等。 同时当日，也有近四十位的志工到现场帮忙。 来咨询的人有序的被安排在候诊区，轮流在导诊人员的带领下填写自己的基本信息，健康状况和咨询科目。 从填写资料开始就有懂得英文，西班牙文，中文的志工在帮忙，帮助来咨询的朋友填写表格。 进到静思大厅，几个护士就给咨询者测量血压，脉搏，以及身高和体重。 然后分散到各个他们需要咨询的科室。 在所有科室当中最忙的就要数传统中医科。 二楼搭建的八个简易针灸治疗区，总是排得长长的队伍，因为有东南诊疗中心的针灸科主任邓勇带着他的弟子们一起来给患者诊疗。 普通针灸，电针，拔罐都有使用。 一位59岁的女士，手臂运动受伤，疼痛近四个月，当日到现场，邓医生与学生利用针灸，电针，拔罐相结合的治疗，二十分钟后，该女士的疼痛明显有改善， 说手臂轻松了很多。 来体检的人中有不同的种族和年龄，他们中有的是常年腰酸背痛的老人，由于运动拉伤的年轻人，还有平时压力过大的白领。 经过二十分钟左右的治疗后，患者都非常惊叹于中国针灸的神奇功效。 他们也表示以后会争取长期做针灸治疗。 截止到下午整个咨询活动结束，近一百二十人接受了免费体检服务。 大家对慈济提供的免费体检活动非常满意。 慈济在凤凰城的免费体检活动一年有两次，这是2013年的第一次，第二次咨询活动预计将会在下半年举行。
0819279b818984fd9461a6f654bbce43b4534843.translatedText: At 9 a.m. on February 23, the Tzu Chi Phoenix City Liaison Office was bustling with activity. Adults, children, and the elderly came here. This time they came not to receive food, but to receive free physical examinations. Brother Lewis of Tzu Chi introduced that a medical team of nearly 40 people, including twelve local doctors, four nurses, and their assistants and students from Phoenix City, volunteered to provide free clinics for everyone. Among them are pediatrics, internal medicine, ophthalmology, traditional Chinese medicine, dermatology, gynecology, etc. At the same time, nearly 40 volunteers came to the scene to help. People who come for consultation are arranged in the waiting area in an orderly manner, and take turns filling in their basic information, health status and consultation subjects under the guidance of the medical guide. From the beginning of filling in the information, there are volunteers who can speak English, Spanish, and Chinese to help, helping friends who come to consult to fill in the forms. Entering the meditation hall, several nurses measured the consultant's blood pressure, pulse, height and weight. Then dispersed to various departments where they need consultation. The busiest among all departments is the Department of Traditional Chinese Medicine. There are always long queues in the eight simple acupuncture treatment areas set up on the second floor, because Deng Yong, director of the acupuncture department of the Southeast Diagnostic and Treatment Center, brings his disciples to diagnose and treat patients. Ordinary acupuncture, electroacupuncture, and cupping are all used. A 59-year-old woman suffered a sports injury in her arm and had pain for nearly four months. When she arrived at the scene that day, Dr. Deng and her students used a combination of acupuncture, electroacupuncture, and cupping for treatment. Twenty minutes later, the woman’s pain improved significantly and she said her arm felt much more relaxed. People who come for physical examinations are of different races and ages. Some of them are old people with chronic back pain, young people with strain due to sports, and white-collar workers who are usually too stressed. After about twenty minutes of treatment, the patients were all amazed by the magical effects of Chinese acupuncture. They also expressed that they would strive for long-term acupuncture treatment in the future. By the end of the entire consultation activity in the afternoon, nearly 120 people had received free physical examination services. Everyone is very satisfied with the free physical examination provided by Tzu Chi. Tzu Chi offers free physical examinations twice a year in Phoenix. This is the first time in 2013, and the second consultation event is expected to be held in the second half of the year.

35f4bc7c4c7f926bf62e91d5e5a038e73a6ecd04.sourceText: 延迟召回问题车 丰田被罚1735万美元 （亚省时报） 丰田汽车周二接受美国政府的一个创纪录罚款1,735万美元，因为该公司没有及时向美国政府报告汽车的安全缺陷，同时坚持它没有做错任何事。 在六月，丰田宣布召回154,036辆2010年份的雷克萨斯RX 350和RX450h的车，因为地垫松动后，可能会压低油门踏板。 联邦运输部表示，提高罚款是因为丰田没有及时主动回收。 从2009年年底到2011年年初，某些型号的丰田车，有意外暴冲加速的风险，引起了全球范围内召回近1,900万辆车。 国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）说，因为车主们提出了许多有关地垫的问题，所以在五月份便通知了丰田。一个月后丰田告诉政府监管机构说，它知道有63个有关事件，并表示将进行召回。联邦法律要求汽车制造商在确定有安全缺陷后，在五个工作日内通知政府监管机构，并进行召回。 在2010年对丰田处理汽车召回，政府做了三次独立的调查，丰田一共被罚了4,880万美元。对于所发生的安全问题，从一开始丰田便认为是地垫影响了油门踏板，而不是一种电子系统问题。在2011年年初，交通运输部部长拉胡德表示，一项联邦调查的结果，基本上与丰田一致。 美国汽车安全监管机构，在今年四月宣布了一项建议，要求在所有客车及卡车中安装刹车优先系统，如果油门踏板被卡住的话，仍然可以将车辆停下来，该计划很可能自2015年的车型开始。
35f4bc7c4c7f926bf62e91d5e5a038e73a6ecd04.translatedText: Toyota was fined $17.35 million for delaying the recall of problematic cars (Alberta Times) Toyota Motor Corp on Tuesday accepted a record $17.35 million fine from the U.S. government for failing to promptly report safety defects in its vehicles to the U.S. government, while insisting it did nothing wrong. In June, Toyota announced a recall of 154,036 2010 Lexus RX 350 and RX450h vehicles because loose floor mats could depress the accelerator pedal. The Federal Ministry of Transport stated that the increase in fines was due to Toyota's failure to proactively take back the vehicles in a timely manner. From the end of 2009 to the beginning of 2011, certain models of Toyota vehicles were at risk of unexpected acceleration, resulting in the recall of nearly 19 million vehicles worldwide. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said it notified Toyota in May because owners had raised numerous concerns about the floor mats. A month later Toyota told government regulators it was aware of 63 incidents and said it would issue a recall. Federal law requires automakers to notify government regulators and initiate recalls within five business days of identifying a safety defect. In 2010, the government conducted three separate investigations into Toyota's handling of car recalls, and Toyota was fined a total of $48.8 million. Regarding the safety issues that occurred, Toyota believed from the beginning that the floor mat affected the accelerator pedal, rather than an electronic system problem. In early 2011, Transportation Secretary LaHood said the findings of a federal investigation were generally consistent with Toyota's. U.S. auto safety regulators announced a recommendation in April this year to install brake override systems in all passenger cars and trucks that can still stop the vehicle if the accelerator pedal becomes stuck, likely starting with 2015 model years.

101f566d0a2664a3196e1251b679d7539bf120a8.sourceText: 2012年2月10日下午4点至6点，期待已久的亚省蛇年春节晚会终于在在钱德勒艺术中心圆满落幕。一千五百多名观众在蛇年的大年初一观看了这场演出。此次晚会由ASU孔子学院和新东方艺术学校联合主办。参加晚会演出的演员共有二百三十多人，除了新东方艺术学校的小学员和成人班学员外，还有一些活跃在亚省各文艺团体的资深艺术家们。此外，还有CHANDLER儿童合唱团的八十名孩子参加了演出。晚会节目以歌舞为主，穿插有武术、气功表演，独唱和合唱，以及小提琴、二胡等器乐演奏，等等。整个晚会气氛欢乐、祥和、喜庆、热闹！
101f566d0a2664a3196e1251b679d7539bf120a8.translatedText: From 4 to 6 pm on February 10, 2012, the long-awaited Alberta Year of the Snake Spring Festival Gala finally concluded successfully at the Chandler Arts Center. More than 1,500 spectators watched this performance on the first day of the Lunar New Year in the Year of the Snake. The party was jointly hosted by the ASU Confucius Institute and New Oriental Art School. There were more than 230 actors participating in the evening performance. In addition to primary school students and adult class students from New Oriental Art School, there were also some senior artists active in various literary and art groups in Alberta. In addition, eighty children from the CHANDLER Children's Choir participated in the performance. The program of the party was mainly singing and dancing, interspersed with martial arts and qigong performances, solo and chorus performances, as well as violin, erhu and other instrumental music performances, etc. The atmosphere of the whole party was joyful, peaceful, festive and lively!

The Chinese Correspondence School of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council has long been promoting overseas Chinese language and technical and vocational education, and has cooperated with the National Chung Cheng University to promote correspondence school affairs. Starting from 2013, it will offer 9 subjects including "Chinese Language Teaching Subject", and add 6 new courses such as "Class Management", with a total of 90 courses for overseas Chinese to choose from. Registration will be accepted from January 10 to March 15, 2013. In addition, in order to serve those who are interested in teaching Chinese language, the "Chinese Language Teacher Subject" online course "On-demand" service has been added in the 2013 school year. If you have not registered by March 15, 2013, you can still register for the "Chinese Language Teacher Subject" online course at any time from March 16 to October 31, 2013, and study this subject course online. Courses in all disciplines will start on April 1, 2013. Please refer to the admission brochure for details. Interested students can go to the "Chinese Correspondence School Distance Learning Network" (http//chcs-opencourse.org) to download the admissions brochure and course list, or directly register online, or contact the Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center at 714-754-9999 or the Los Angeles Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center at 626-443-9999. China Correspondence School admissions service hotline: 886-5-2721311; email: chcs@ccu.edu.tw or ccuchcs@gmail.com.

209977dc1b1e23e127958aad713a8f574b1fbf10.sourceText: 州长简布鲁尔与亚省华人共庆2013新春（组图） （亚省时报讯 谢成彦报道）1月31日，凤凰城六福酒家张灯结彩，装饰一新，弥漫着浓浓的春节气氛，当晚迎来了400多华人共庆2013中国蛇年新春。亚利桑那州长简布鲁尔（Jan Brewer），州务卿本尼特 肯（ Ken Bennett ），首位华裔女州参议员余艳芬（Kimberly Yee）以及很多亚利桑那政要都亲临活动现场恭贺新春。华裔代表著名脊椎外科医生杨桐，以华裔移民的身份就移民政策问题做了详细的介绍。 当地华人画家范融向州长赠画 （左到右）黄仕钧 费健 余文劲 简布鲁尔 尹衍桓 张华芳 范融 邓朝驹 前亚利桑那州众议院黄仕钧主持了晚宴。本次活动的主办方大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会主席张华芳，首先代表华裔社区热烈欢迎州长的到来。这是州长首次参加侨联春宴。州长简布鲁尔上台发言，感谢华裔社区对亚利桑那经济作出的贡献，也感谢大家多年来的支持。 州长简布鲁尔在春宴上发言 州长简布鲁尔与华裔州参议员余艳芬合影 成功企业家杨桐医生，以自己家族的移民经历，以及事业的奋斗历程，讲述了移民对美国经济的贡献。由此总结移民政策改革应该从四个方面进行考虑：1移民都很努力工作，并靠勤奋智慧获得应有的报酬。2移民促进了经济的发展，他们充实了美国需要的科学家，企业家。3寻找合法的方法进行改革，以有利于美国发展的方式进行改革 。4 提供更多的机会促进移民的成功，让他们能为国家贡献更大的力量。对于移民政策，华裔的确非常有发言权，希望州长能够设身处地的从移民的角度来考虑问题，让移民政策更加人性化，科学化。 华裔杨桐医生（左二）被授予专业突出贡献奖 资深侨领余文劲，尹衍桓，邓朝驹，费健更是成为了社区的大家长，老早就开始为社区准备这顿年夜饭，六福酒家端出了制作精良的拿手好菜，新东方艺术学校带来有中国味的民族舞蹈，美中文化艺术交流协会唱响动听的歌曲，画家范融将一匹奔驰的骏马国画送给了州长。歌舞升平，共商国策，2013的侨联春宴将成为亚省华裔社区史上有代表意义的一页。 民族舞表演者Ｔｉｎａ Ｔａｎｇ ２０１２凤凰城华裔小姐荆小迷向州长献花 民族舞蹈：彝族姑娘 Ｔｉｎａ Ｔａｎｇ
209977dc1b1e23e127958aad713a8f574b1fbf10.translatedText: Governor Jane Brewer celebrated the 2013 New Year with Chinese people in Alberta (photo) (Alberta Times News Reported by Xie Chengyan) On January 31, Luk Fook Restaurant in Phoenix City was decorated with lights and colorful decorations, filled with a strong Spring Festival atmosphere. More than 400 Chinese people were welcomed that night to celebrate the 2013 Chinese Year of the Snake. Arizona Governor Jan Brewer, Secretary of State Ken Bennett, the first Chinese-American female state senator Kimberly Yee, and many Arizona dignitaries attended the event to congratulate them on the New Year. The Chinese representative, Yang Tong, a famous spinal surgeon, gave a detailed introduction on immigration policy issues as a Chinese immigrant. Local Chinese painter Fan Rong presented paintings to the governor (left to right) Huang Shijun, Fei Jian, Yu Wenjin, Jane Brewer, Yin Yanhuan, Zhang Huafang, Fan Rong, Deng Chaoju. Former Arizona House of Representatives Huang Shijun hosted the dinner. Zhang Huafang, chairman of the Greater Phoenix Chinese Overseas Chinese Association, the organizer of this event, first warmly welcomed the governor on behalf of the Chinese community. This is the first time for the governor to attend the Spring Banquet of the Overseas Chinese Federation. Governor Jane Brewer took the stage to speak, thanking the Chinese American community for its contribution to the Arizona economy and thanking everyone for their support over the years. Governor Jane Brewer spoke at the Spring Banquet. Governor Jane Brewer took a photo with Chinese-American State Senator Yu Yanfen. Dr. Yang Tong, a successful entrepreneur, talked about the contribution of immigrants to the U.S. economy based on his family’s immigration experience and career struggle. From this summary, immigration policy reform should be considered from four aspects: 1. Immigrants work hard and receive due rewards for their diligence and wisdom. 2. Immigration promotes economic development, and they enrich the scientists and entrepreneurs that the United States needs. 3. Find legal ways to carry out reforms and carry out reforms in a way that is beneficial to the development of the United States. 4 Provide more opportunities to promote the success of immigrants so that they can contribute more to the country. Regarding immigration policy, Chinese Americans do have a strong say. I hope the governor can consider issues from the perspective of immigrants and make immigration policy more humane and scientific. Chinese-American Dr. Yang Tong (second from left) was awarded the Outstanding Professional Contribution Award. Senior overseas Chinese leaders Yu Wenjin, Yin Yanhuan, Deng Chaoju, and Fei Jian have become the elders of the community. They started preparing the New Year's Eve dinner for the community early. Luk Fook Restaurant served well-made specialties, New Oriental Art School brought Chinese-flavored folk dances, the U.S.-China Cultural and Art Exchange Association sang beautiful songs, and painter Fan Rong presented a traditional Chinese painting of a galloping horse to the governor. With singing and dancing and discussion of national policies, the 2013 Overseas Chinese Federation Spring Banquet will become a representative page in the history of the Chinese community in Alberta. Folk dance performer Tina Tang 2012 Miss Chinese Phoenix Jing Xiaomi presented flowers to the governor Folk dance: Yi girl Tina Tang

45ce5735148ae6eb1d3bdb011fcf04e0ad52cc9a.sourceText: 大量新版百元美钞被窃 预计2013年发行 联邦调查局（FBI）近日透露，”’很大数量”的新设计的100美元钞票在运往美联储位于新泽西的储存地点的途中被小偷偷走。 这些钞票周四上午10点20分左右自达拉斯运到费城的机场，然后在下午2点左右抵达美联储在新泽西州的储存地点，负责运送这些钞票到运输公司向当局报告，部份钞票失踪。据信这些钞票是在抵达费城机场后被窃。 柏顿拒绝评论被窃钞票的价值，但表示数量很大。 这些失窃的钞票是新设计的百元美钞，原本预计在明年才会在市场上流通。这些新设计钞票的背面有一个很大的金色100图案，正面有一个橙色的方块，内有模糊的自由钟（Liberty Bell）图案。
45ce5735148ae6eb1d3bdb011fcf04e0ad52cc9a.translatedText: A large number of new hundred-dollar bills have been stolen and are expected to be issued in 2013. The FBI recently revealed that a "large number" of newly designed $100 bills were stolen by thieves on their way to the Federal Reserve's storage location in New Jersey. The bills were transported from Dallas to the Philadelphia airport around 10:20 a.m. on Thursday, and then arrived at the Federal Reserve's storage location in New Jersey around 2 p.m. The company responsible for transporting the bills reported to authorities that some of the bills were missing. It is believed that the bills were stolen after arriving at the Philadelphia airport. Burton declined to comment on the value of the stolen bills, but said the number was large. The stolen bills were newly designed $100 bills that were not expected to be in circulation until next year. The new design bills have a large gold 100 pattern on the back and an orange square with a faint Liberty Bell inside.

ae9431488ed0c256cfbbea052a5624a00abc699e.sourceText: （侨联通讯）大凤凰城侨联总会于3月14日召开全体侨团代表会议，选举出2013年度新一届的领导班子，侨联主席由去年的主席张华芳女士连任。
ae9431488ed0c256cfbbea052a5624a00abc699e.translatedText: (Overseas Chinese Federation News) The Overseas Chinese Federation of Greater Phoenix City convened a meeting of all overseas Chinese delegation representatives on March 14 to elect a new leadership team for 2013. The chairman of the Federation of Overseas Chinese was re-elected by last year’s chairperson Ms. Zhang Huafang.

166d92e502adc826e0472ab77a4d906ec71b9a2e.sourceText: 张华芳 侨联总会目前由有十八个侨团组成，分别是邓心平退伍军人会、科工专协会、凤凰城同源会、华美专业协会、中华商会、亚省中餐馆会、沙漠玉妇女会、鳯凰城龙冈公所、邓高密公所、海外华人妇女会、华人耆英会、华人福利会、荣光会、台湾同乡联谊会、黄氏宗亲会、余风采堂、英端工商会，还有今年新加入的中国週委员会。侨联总会每年年初举行侨团大会，以每个团体委派两位代表参加投票，共同推选出新一年度的主席和其它董事局的成员。 今年选举通过新的领导班子成员大多数由上一届连任，部分工作出色的董事局成员因身体和其它情况引退而留出的空缺，亦由新的候选人递补上位：新的中文书记由徐强接任，财政由郑永强接任。徐强在侨联服务多年，经验丰富，工作积极；郑永强从去年开始已逐渐掌管侨联财政，工作认真负责。 2013年度大凤凰城侨联总会领导成员的名单如下: 主席：张华芳 副主席：余文泽 崔增祁 张肇鸿 财政：郑永强 英文书记：余文焯 中文书记：徐强 通讯：Brenda Fung 主席张华芳去年工作成效显着，得到大家的赞许和拥护，再次成为本年度的侨联主席。她在发言中对去年的工作进行了总结，感谢大家过去一年中所作出的努力，并对今后的工作作出了规划和安排。 新的一年新开始，侨联迎国庆办选美的工作已拉开惟幕，目前已有三位佳丽报名参加选美，记得提醒大家，今年佳丽报名的截止日期是4月10日。
166d92e502adc826e0472ab77a4d906ec71b9a2e.translatedText: >Zhang Huafang The Overseas Chinese Federation currently consists of eighteen overseas Chinese groups, namely Deng Xinping Veterans Association, Association of Science and Engineering Professionals, Phoenix City Homology Association, Chinese American Professional Association, Chinese Chamber of Commerce, Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association, Desert Jade Women's Association, Phoenix City Longgang Office, Deng Gaomi Office, Overseas Chinese Women's Association, Chinese Seniors Association, Chinese Welfare Association, Rongguang Association, Taiwan Fellowship Association, Huang Clan Association, Yu Fengcaitang, Yingduan Chamber of Commerce and Industry, as well as the newly joined China Week Committee this year. The Overseas Chinese Federation holds a general meeting of overseas Chinese groups at the beginning of each year. Each group appoints two representatives to participate in the voting and jointly elect the chairman and other board members for the new year. Most of the members of the new leadership team elected this year were re-elected in the previous term. The vacancies left by the retirement of some outstanding board members due to health or other circumstances were also filled by new candidates: Xu Qiang took over as the new Chinese Secretary, and Zheng Yongqiang took over as the Finance Secretary. Xu Qiang has served in the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese for many years and is experienced and active in his work; Zheng Yongqiang has gradually taken charge of the finance of the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese since last year and works seriously and responsibly. The list of leading members of the Greater Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation in 2013 is as follows: Chairman: Zhang Huafang Vice Chairman: Yu Wenze Cui Zengqi Zhang Zhaohong Finance: Zheng Yongqiang English Secretary: Yu Wenzhuo Chinese Secretary: Xu Qiang Correspondence: Brenda Fung Chairman Zhang Huafang achieved remarkable results in his work last year and received everyone's praise and support. He once again became the Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation this year. In her speech, she summarized last year's work, thanked everyone for their efforts in the past year, and made plans and arrangements for future work. With the new year and a new beginning, the beauty pageant held by the Overseas Chinese Federation to welcome the National Day has begun. Currently, three beauties have signed up to participate in the beauty pageant. Remember to remind everyone that the deadline for beauty registration this year is April 10th.

23674a9d3b6b60f7cec3508c983d4a5d91df7b68.sourceText: ２０１３年中国周乒乓球比赛，１月２７日在凤凰城乒乓球俱乐部落下帷幕，共有８４名选手参赛。八个组别的比赛顺利完成。这是一个为期１５年的中国周传统比赛项目，受到了亚利桑那乒乓球爱好者的喜爱。从比赛结果可以看出，获奖者不仅有华裔，还有美国的朋友，不仅有八十多岁的老人，还有十来岁的小朋友，还有很多人因为乒乓球这个共同的爱好，找到了异族情愿。下面是２０１３年中国周乒乓球比赛的最后结果。
23674a9d3b6b60f7cec3508c983d4a5d91df7b68.translatedText: The 2013 China Week Table Tennis Competition concluded on January 27 at the Phoenix Table Tennis Club. A total of 84 players participated. The eight categories of competitions were successfully completed. This is a 15-year traditional competition event of China Week, which is loved by Arizona table tennis enthusiasts. It can be seen from the results of the competition that the winners include not only Chinese Americans, but also American friends, not only elderly people in their eighties, but also children in their teens. There are also many people who have found interracial love because of the common hobby of table tennis. Below are the final results of the 2013 China Week table tennis competition.

114ded6b040ceb0d2c690639d92db2b1a6d1e029.sourceText: 周六周日班级1月26日与1月27日开学 （亚省中华语文学院供稿）亚省中华语文学院2013年春季各班级招生,周六各班级1月26日开学,周日各班级1月27日开学,开学日当天注册与开始上课. 亚省中华语文学院为方便学生与家长,每星期提供周六与周日两日中文课程,周六又有两个时段课程,同时是采取小班学习制度,每班平均八人至十二人,在课堂上让学生都能完全得到老师的关注,并让学生在上课时都有公平学习与练习的机会. 亚省中华语文学院应家长要求在校外时间与地点开设中文班级,让周六与周日有其他课程冲突的学生在平日也能学习中文.中文教学的目的是在鼓励与启发下一代学习中文,将中文融入日常生活中,与孩子们一同成长和进步. 中华语文学院也和数家美国主流学校合作开设学习中文与中华文化各班级,将中文与中华文化结合主流,共同有效的推广,这是中华语文学院与众不同的特色. 同时,亚省中华语文学院经常应邀至美国主流大学,中学,小学各学校推广中文,宣传中华文化,缔结国际友谊,增进国民外交,与促进多元文化交流. 亚省中华语文学院2013年元月春季班招生,请洽李玲麟校长602-548-8398,602-418-8895或azcmca@hotmail.com
114ded6b040ceb0d2c690639d92db2b1a6d1e029.translatedText: Saturday and Sunday classes will start on January 26th and January 27th. (Contributed by the Chinese Language and Literature College of Alberta) The enrollment of all classes in the spring of 2013 at the Chinese Language and Literature College of Alberta. All classes on Saturdays will start on January 26th, and all classes on Sundays will start on January 27th. Registration and classes will begin on the opening day. For the convenience of students and parents, the Chinese Language Institute of Alberta provides Chinese courses on Saturdays and Sundays every week, and there are two classes on Saturdays. At the same time, it adopts a small class learning system, with an average of eight to twelve people per class. In the classroom, students can fully get the teacher's attention, and students have fair opportunities to learn and practice during class. At the request of parents, the Chinese Language Academy of Alberta offers Chinese classes at off-campus times and locations, so that students who have conflicts with other classes on Saturdays and Sundays can also learn Chinese on weekdays. The purpose of Chinese teaching is to encourage and inspire the next generation to learn Chinese, integrate Chinese into daily life, and grow and progress with the children. The School of Chinese Language and Literature has also cooperated with several mainstream schools in the United States to set up classes for learning Chinese and Chinese culture, integrating Chinese and Chinese culture into the mainstream, and jointly and effectively promoting them. This is the unique feature of the School of Chinese Language and Literature. At the same time, the School of Chinese Language and Literature in Alberta is often invited to mainstream universities, middle schools, and elementary schools in the United States to promote Chinese, publicize Chinese culture, forge international friendships, enhance national diplomacy, and promote multicultural exchanges. For admissions to the January 2013 Spring Class of the Alberta Chinese Language and Literature College, please contact Principal Li Linglin at 602-548-8398, 602-418-8895 or azcmca@hotmail.com

73e7196e432b3138b4fcc3581a982eceeaf9a5a7.sourceText: 亚省希望中文学校创立于1995年，是一个完全非营利的公益教育组织。经过十几年的积累，已拥有了一支优秀的教师队伍。学校教授简体字中文和中华文化，实行小班教学制。 每周六下午十二点至五点共开设中文、数学、SAT、AP、才艺等六十多个班级。 马立平教材中文班一至六年级，实行小班教学，学费 $90每学期。同时开设暨南大学教材班一至十二年级。 为低龄儿童开设4个中文幼儿班、双语幼儿班，中文学前班，实行小班教学。 为非华语背景学生开设四个层次的双语中文课程班。 开设中文AP，中文SAT。学生在全美AP统考中均获5分成绩， 在SAT统考获满分或接近满分。 Math Counts数学竞赛班被美国一数学协会授名”gold Level School” 新建学生乐队，由蔡善皋老师指挥。 开设SAT英文词汇、文法、阅读、写作课程。 连续第三年为高中生开设”申请大学英文作文”课程。 围棋、国际象棋班学生连年在各类比赛中获奖、晋级。 新增”儿童声乐”程，由本地音乐学院教师任教。 为家长开设有健美操，合唱等课程以及多种讲座
73e7196e432b3138b4fcc3581a982eceeaf9a5a7.translatedText: >Alberta Hope Chinese School was founded in 1995 and is a completely non-profit public welfare education organization. After more than ten years of accumulation, we have an excellent team of teachers. The school teaches simplified Chinese and Chinese culture and implements a small class teaching system. There are more than 60 classes in Chinese, mathematics, SAT, AP, and talent classes every Saturday from 12 pm to 5 pm. Ma Liping’s Chinese language class is for grades one to six, with small class teaching, and the tuition is $90 per semester. At the same time, Jinan University textbook classes are opened for grades one to twelve. There are 4 Chinese kindergarten classes, bilingual kindergarten classes, and Chinese preschool classes for young children, implementing small class teaching. Four levels of bilingual Chinese courses are offered to students from non-Chinese speaking backgrounds. Chinese AP and Chinese SAT are offered. Students all received 5 points in the national AP examination and full or close to full scores in the SAT examination. The Math Counts mathematics competition class was awarded the title of "gold Level School" by the American Mathematical Association and has a new student band, directed by teacher Cai Shangao. SAT English vocabulary, grammar, reading, and writing courses are offered. For the third consecutive year, the "English Composition for College Application" course has been offered to high school students. Students in the Go and chess classes have won awards and advanced in various competitions year after year. A new "Children's Vocal Music" course is added, taught by teachers from local music schools. It offers aerobics, chorus and other courses as well as various lectures for parents

e3f04cb33a60496f8d1aa349f46db56d81040176.sourceText: 凤城华人基督教会2012年度退休会 【凤凰城凤鸣報道】 2012年 5月第4个周末，因着美国陣亡烈士记念日(Memorial Day)是長周末，凤城华人基督教会都会利用这長周末，到松石营地( Camp Pinerock at Prescott) 举行一年一度的退休会。今年的退休会，中、英文部共有313人参加，包括大人、小孩和青少年。我们一行5人由俞姊妹开车载我们，下午3:00pm从Gilbert出发，汽车上按了GPS导航，一路很顺利到达松石营地的宿营地，報到领了各人的身份卡片、找到大会为我们予备的房间。这次对我们長青团契的姊妹特別照顧，我们被分配在一幢小木房内，共有三个房间，五个单人上下铺、两张双人床，按排7人住整好，大家都不用睡上铺，7个姊妹又都是比较熟悉的好姊妹。安顿好住处，我们拿出各自准备的晚餐，桂香姊妹准备的大蒸包、俞姊妹准备了一大盒炒米粉、我准备了芝麻酱烧饼和五香花生。很快把多出来的食品送到報道处，因为有弟兄姊妹是下班后直接趕往营地，我们多出来的食品可供他(她) 们食用。 晚饭后我们三人走出小木房，一阵北风吹来，还真有些寒意，多亏余姊妹提前通知我，帶了只有冬天才穿的外套预寒。离开了繁华喧啸的城市，来到深山松林之中，虽然天气寒冷，空气却特別清爽，多了一份清醒和享受。周围环境优美而不嬌妍，在花池内有精心栽种的红色、黄色、白色等漂亮的玫瑰花，风儿一吹飘来阵阵花香。高大的松树矗立於高低不平的山上，真不愧称为松石营地。晚8:00～8:15有一简短的开幕礼，然后中、英文部分开主题信息讲道。 凤城华人基督教会2012年度退休会，特別邀请吕绍昌牧师做主题讲员，呂绍昌牧师是正道福音学院旧约副教授，ph.D.&Th.M, 科主任，他对圣經与神学、建立教会、培育领袖、神学教育、写作文字等事奉多有负担。他为香港天道书楼撰写的《以赛亚书注释卷一》可望於今年出版，卷二正在写作中。这次为退休会宣讲的主题是〝蒙召到荣耀〞，主题信息分四个部分，(一)从蒙召开始：与上帝相遇的蒙召、被上帝炼净的生命、得时不得时的事奉；(二) 再委身吧，委身与托付、委身与代价、委身与专注；(三) 求用我家：神的慈爱激励我们委身、神的圣洁催逼我们委身、神的慈爱圣洁督促我们行动；(四) 直到荣耀国：属神的生命在基督里的渴慕；属神的生命在生活中的操练；属神的生命进入神国的丰富等等。四堂课讲下来，吕牧师用以赛亚的蒙召献身事奉，从蒙召开始、委身、求用我家至直到荣耀国，为我们用一条线貫串起来，明明白白教导我们应该怎样做，挑旺了我们委身的热情和挚着，既是有所失败，只要你愿意，上帝一定邦助你，与你同行、与你同工，直至进入荣耀丰富的国。 星期六下午是休息 Break、 有球類比赛、Ball Game、登山、遊画展。我们一行7人，由余姊妹开车帶我们去湖边游玩，湖很近，十多分钟就到。这个湖真美，镶嵌在山峦之中，深兰色的湖水像一面明镜，却深不可测，年青人和孩子们在岩石上攀爬，好想爬上高高的岩顶，但总是不行，陡峭的岩石让人望而生畏，更有一块硕大的园石，端放在岩顶，好似隨时能坠落下来，我们在美丽的湖边留影纪念。晚上8:15 有中英文的群星会，各个團契都表演了精彩的节目：有话剧、歌午、独唱，节目中穿插有奖猜迷，礼堂里充满了欢声笑语，几百人欢聚一堂。 星期日早上是主日，是圣餐礼拜。”爱你不渝”，贯串退休会始终。在大人聚會听道时，有同工们在专心照看小朋友，感谢他(她) 们無私奉献，才能使孩子的父母得以安心听道，感谢会务人员，为大会设立了医疗急救同工、及物理治疗师，使这次退休会，平安、顺利进行。 我们大眾以讥渴慕义的心上山，三天后圣灵充满我们，饱饱足足下山，被挑旺的委身热情和挚着，帶领我们谦卑自己，做合神心意的器皿。彼得后书1:3～11这样教导我们：〝神的神能已将一切关乎生命和虔敬的事赐給我们，皆因我们认识那用自己荣耀和美德召我们的主。因此，他已将又宝贵又极大的应许赐給我们，叫我们既脱离世上从情欲来的败坏，就得与 神的性情有分。正因这缘故，你们要分外地殷勤：有了信心，又要加上德行；有了德行，又要加上知识；有了知识，又要加上节制；有了节制，又要加上忍耐；有了忍耐，又要加上虔敬；有了虔敬，又要加上爱弟兄的心；有了爱弟兄的心，又要加上爱众人的心。你们若充充足足地有这几样，就必使你们在认识我们的主耶稣基督上不至于闲懒不结果子。人若没有这几样，就是眼瞎，只看見近处的，忘了他旧日的罪已經得了洁净。所以弟兄们，应当更加殷勤，使你们所蒙的恩召和拣选坚定不移。你们若行这几样，就永不失脚。这样，必叫你们丰丰富富地得以进入我们主救主耶稣基督永远的國。〞阿们！ 吕绍昌牧师讲道 会场听众 小组敬拜 小组讨论会
e3f04cb33a60496f8d1aa349f46db56d81040176.translatedText: Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church’s 2012 Annual Retirement Meeting [Phoenix Fengming Report] On the fourth weekend of May 2012, as Memorial Day is a long weekend, Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church will use this long weekend to hold its annual retirement meeting at Camp Pinerock at Prescott. This year's retirement party was attended by 313 people from the Chinese and English departments, including adults, children and teenagers. Sister Yu drove us, a group of 5 of us, and set off from Gilbert at 3:00 pm. We clicked on the GPS navigation in the car and arrived at the campsite at Songshi Camp smoothly. We checked in, received everyone's ID cards, and found the room prepared for us by the conference. This time, we, the sisters of the Evergreen Fellowship, were given special care. We were assigned to a small wooden house with three rooms, five single bunk beds and two double beds, arranged in rows for 7 people. No one needed to sleep on the upper bunk, and the 7 sisters were all good and familiar sisters. After settling in, we took out the dinners we had prepared each. Sister Guixiang prepared large steamed buns, Sister Yu prepared a large box of fried rice noodles, and I prepared sesame sauce pancakes and five-spice peanuts. We quickly delivered the extra food to the reporting office, because some brothers and sisters rushed directly to the camp after work, and the extra food we had was available for them to eat. After dinner, the three of us walked out of the small wooden house. A gust of north wind blew, and it was really chilly. Thanks to Sister Yu who notified me in advance and brought a jacket that is only worn in winter to prepare for the cold. Leaving the bustling and noisy city, we came to the deep mountains and pine forests. Although the weather was cold, the air was particularly refreshing, giving us a sense of sobriety and enjoyment. The surrounding environment is beautiful but not delicate. There are beautiful red, yellow, white and other roses carefully planted in the flower pond. The wind blows the fragrance of the flowers. Tall pine trees stand on the rugged mountains. It really deserves to be called Pine Rock Camp. There will be a brief opening ceremony from 8:00 to 8:15 p.m., and then the Chinese and English sections will deliver sermons on different themes. The Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church’s 2012 annual retirement meeting specially invited Pastor Lu Shaochang to be the keynote speaker. Pastor Lu Shaochang is an associate professor of Old Testament at Zhengdao Evangelical College, ph.D.&Th.M, and director of the department. He has many responsibilities in Bible and theology, church establishment, leader training, theological education, writing and other ministries. The "Commentary on Isaiah Volume 1" written by him for Tiandao Library in Hong Kong is expected to be published this year, and Volume 2 is currently being written. The theme preached for the retirement meeting this time is "Called to Glory". The theme message is divided into four parts, (1) starting with the calling: the call to encounter God, the life refined by God, service in season and out of season; (2) Commitment again, commitment and entrustment, commitment and price, commitment and concentration; (3) Please use my family: God’s love inspires us to commit, God’s holiness urges us to commit, God’s love and holiness urges us to act; (4) Until the kingdom of glory: the desire of God’s life in Christ; the practice of God’s life in life; the God’s life entering the riches of the Kingdom of God, etc. After four lessons, Pastor Lu used Isaiah’s call to dedicate himself to service, from the beginning of the call, to commitment, to asking for use in my family, to the kingdom of glory, connecting us with a line, clearly teaching us what to do, and stimulating our enthusiasm and sincerity for commitment. Even if you fail, as long as you are willing, God will definitely help you, walk with you, and work with you until you enter the kingdom of glory and abundance. Saturday afternoon is a break, with ball games, mountain climbing, and art exhibitions. There were 7 of us, and Sister Yu drove us to the lake. The lake is very close and can be reached in just over ten minutes. This lake is so beautiful. It is embedded in the mountains. The dark blue lake is like a bright mirror, but it is unfathomable. Young people and children are climbing on the rocks, trying to climb to the top of the high rock, but they can't. The steep rocks are daunting. There is also a huge garden stone placed on the top of the rock, as if it could fall down at any time. We took photos by the beautiful lake as a souvenir. At 8:15 p.m., there was a Chinese and English star party, and each fellowship performed wonderful programs: drama, song lunch, and solo singing. The program was interspersed with prizes for guessing. The auditorium was filled with laughter and laughter, and hundreds of people gathered together. Sunday morning is the Lord's Day and is the Eucharist service. "I love you forever" will last throughout retirement. While the adults were gathering to listen to the sermon, there were co-workers who were taking care of the children attentively. Thanks to their selfless dedication, the parents of the children could listen to the sermon with peace of mind. Thanks to the conference staff for setting up medical first aid co-workers and physical therapists for the conference, so that this retirement meeting was conducted safely and smoothly. We all went up the mountain with hearts that were ridiculed and thirsty for righteousness. After three days, we were filled with the Holy Spirit and came down the mountain full. We were stirred up with enthusiasm and enthusiasm for commitment, leading us to humble ourselves and become vessels in line with God’s heart. 2 Peter 1:3-11 teaches us this: "For God's divine power has given to us all things that belong to life and godliness through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue. For this reason he has given to us great and precious promises, so that, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust, God is a partaker of the nature. For this very reason, add to your faith virtue; to virtue, knowledge; to knowledge, self-control; to self-control, patience; to godliness, brotherly love; and to brotherly love, love for all men. If you have these in abundance, you will have them. Do not be idle and unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ. Anyone who does not have these things is blind and has forgotten that he has been cleansed from his old sins. Therefore, brothers, be more diligent in making your calling and election sure. If you do these things, you will never fail. "Amen! Pastor Lu Shaochang’s sermon, audience at the venue, group worship, group discussion

4a0d6bf6a51988de6f7a2aafe988d7cdff055998.translatedText: A 22-year-old Chinese man in the United States wins the World Series of Poker and receives a bonus of 650,000 According to the US "Overseas Chinese News" report, recently, a 22-year-old Chinese man named Henry Lu, who lives in Bincheng Market, New York...

28abff6f06a7d3bc5cf99ea3a48a58472a17d343.sourceText: 据美国《侨报》报道，近日，居住在纽约宾臣墟的22岁华裔男子Henry卢在拉斯维加斯一举夺得了某项世界级扑克牌大赛的冠军，并捧回了65万元的诱人奖金，令业界惊叹不已。
28abff6f06a7d3bc5cf99ea3a48a58472a17d343.translatedText: According to the US "Overseas Chinese Newspaper" report, recently, Henry Lu, a 22-year-old Chinese man living in Bincheng Market, New York, won the championship of a world-class poker competition in Las Vegas and took home an attractive bonus of 650,000 yuan, which amazed the industry.

a23e9a8766ba319c57832c31e51ec1ca47cf256d.sourceText: 据英文媒体消息，令Henry卢名利双收的这项赛事叫做”世界扑克牌系列锦标赛(World Series of Poker Tournament)”，近期刚刚在拉斯维加斯落下帷幕。
a23e9a8766ba319c57832c31e51ec1ca47cf256d.translatedText: According to English media reports, the event that brought Henry Lu both fame and fortune is called the "World Series of Poker Tournament" and it just concluded in Las Vegas recently.

6a1e648603a7b3a721a3099f70cf3c66e544a38b.sourceText: 业界公认，Henry卢本次夺冠并非偶然，过程更不是一帆风顺。他是在击败了总计约3000名竞争者之后脱颖而出的，其中包括一些着名的牌场老千。在总决赛对阵老谋深算的英国扑克牌冠军、45岁的Neil Channing时，Henry卢的点数曾经下降到只差1分就要被淘汰出局，但他却不可思议的反败为胜，实现了惊天大逆转。
6a1e648603a7b3a721a3099f70cf3c66e544a38b.translatedText: It is recognized by the industry that Henry Lu’s victory this time was no accident, and the process was not smooth sailing. He was selected after beating a total of about 3,000 competitors, including some well-known card dealers. In the finals against the wily British Poker Champion, 45-year-old Neil Channing, Henry Lu's points dropped to just 1 point away from being eliminated, but he made an incredible comeback and achieved a shocking reversal.

20f52636d1bfae9f3a9ca2366188e037d97f4fd6.sourceText: Henry卢在获胜后告诉《纽约每日新闻》说，拿到这项冠军，堪称每一位牌手职业生涯的巅峰。而趁自己还年轻时就能实现这一梦想，更是妙不可言。
20f52636d1bfae9f3a9ca2366188e037d97f4fd6.translatedText: Henry Lu told the New York Daily News after winning that winning this championship is the pinnacle of every poker player's career. And it is even more wonderful to be able to realize this dream while I am still young.

c92618f7a7487532b7174ae0f9c992babf454917.sourceText: Henry 卢是在米德屋高中(Midwood High School)就读时开始喜欢上玩扑克牌的。后来当他进入雪城大学(Syracuse University)主修生物学期间，牌技开始突飞勐进。很明显，他对于生物学专业的兴趣一般，但却成了在线扑克牌游戏的高手。所有见过他打牌的人都说，他的水平高得不可思议。
c92618f7a7487532b7174ae0f9c992babf454917.translatedText: Henry Lu started to like playing cards when he was a student at Midwood High School. Later, when he entered Syracuse University (Syracuse University) and majored in biology, his poker skills began to improve by leaps and bounds. Apparently, he was an average biology major but became a master at online poker. Everyone who saw him play said he was incredibly good.

b0ea9ea1e3e471cae7b4a6bd0829721622e7d5af.sourceText: 但他最终仍然成功的从雪城大学毕业，然后从纽约移居到了加拿大的多伦多，因为后者的所有网络扑克牌游戏都是完全合法的，包括涉及金钱的。目前，Henry卢的一半时间在多伦多度过，另一半就呆在纽约的宾臣墟棗这个生他养他的地方。
b0ea9ea1e3e471cae7b4a6bd0829721622e7d5af.translatedText: But he still managed to graduate from Syracuse University and then moved from New York to Toronto, Canada, because all online poker games in the latter are completely legal, including those involving money. Currently, Henry Lu spends half of his time in Toronto and the other half in Benson Street, New York, the place where he was born and raised.

9ae317257feec582be15173e8886db35a54b954c.sourceText: 记者16时从江苏省政府有关部门了解到，22日上午，沿江高速公路宁太线1公里处发生的重大道路交通事故，造成13人死亡，21人受伤，目前事故原因正在调查中。
9ae317257feec582be15173e8886db35a54b954c.translatedText: Reporters learned from relevant departments of the Jiangsu Provincial Government at 16:00 that on the morning of the 22nd, a major road traffic accident occurred 1 kilometer away from the Ningtai Line of the Yanjiang Expressway, killing 13 people and injuring 21 others. The cause of the accident is currently under investigation.

613ddb54502fbf988b601c5f8af9412228fe7b67.sourceText: 22日9时25分，由上海人民广场始发的上海南汇区益流汽车出租服务公司一辆车号为沪BL1290大客车，行至宁太线1公里处，突然冲过中间隔离护栏，与隔栏对面正常行驶的车号为苏ED1655的货车相撞，致使两车侧翻，造成多人伤亡。
613ddb54502fbf988b601c5f8af9412228fe7b67.translatedText: At 9:25 on the 22nd, a bus numbered Shanghai BL1290 from Yiliu Car Rental Service Company in Nanhui District, Shanghai, departing from Shanghai People's Square, traveling to 1 kilometer away from the Ningtai Line, suddenly rushed through the middle isolation barrier and collided with a truck numbered Su ED1655 that was traveling normally on the opposite side of the barrier, causing the two vehicles to roll over and causing many casualties.

fa00d4510e51f528b4eb77e40d93a95f37e8e6fc.sourceText: 接报后，江苏省委、省政府主要领导高度重视，立即作出批示，要求全力抢救伤员，妥善处理善后。省政府分管领导，省公安厅、安监局、交通运输厅、交通控股公司，苏州市、常熟市领导立即赶赴现场，指挥有关方面迅速开展现场处置和救援工作。受伤人员已于第一时间分别送往当地3家医院救治。
fa00d4510e51f528b4eb77e40d93a95f37e8e6fc.translatedText: After receiving the report, the main leaders of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee and Provincial Government attached great importance to it and immediately issued instructions, requiring all efforts to rescue the injured and properly handle the aftermath. The leaders in charge of the provincial government, the Provincial Public Security Department, the Work Safety Supervision Bureau, the Transportation Department, the Transportation Holding Company, Suzhou City, and Changshu City leaders rushed to the scene immediately and directed relevant parties to quickly carry out on-site disposal and rescue work. The injured persons were immediately sent to three local hospitals for treatment.

6ba3c4d97e5fa689e5c25bf743aaeef032063449.sourceText: 记者采访了解到，大客车荷载37人，实载33人。事故中，大客车有6人当场死亡，6人经抢救无效死亡；货车驾驶员当场死亡。目前，尚有21名伤者在院治疗，其中4人伤势较重。江苏省政府已成立事故调查组，事故原因正在调查之中。
6ba3c4d97e5fa689e5c25bf743aaeef032063449.translatedText: The reporter learned from the interview that the bus had a load of 37 people and an actual capacity of 33 people. In the accident, 6 people in the bus died on the spot, and 6 people died after rescue efforts failed; the driver of the truck died on the spot. Currently, there are 21 injured people being treated in the hospital, 4 of whom are seriously injured. The Jiangsu Provincial Government has established an accident investigation team and the cause of the accident is under investigation.

7f2f1019c6701d093c744449da339b4767054ec7.sourceText: （希望中文学校供稿）2013年5月5日，希望中文学校在Tumbleweed Park Recreation Center举行了一场隆重的毕业颁奖典礼。典礼现场座无虚席，学校全体师生和家长齐聚一堂，热烈的气氛盖过凤凰城的炎炎酷暑。 本次典礼学校很荣幸地请到了潘寿安教授, 美莎社区大学校长，Patricia Esparza,美莎社区大学社区合作伙伴负责人和全美中文学校协会会长帅致若女士。学校特别感谢Mesa Community College长期以来对希望中文学校的支持和合作。 学校对已经连任三年即将离任的校长赵彩虹女士和学校董事长黄双双女士表示了衷心的感谢，感谢她们在过去的三年里，在学校教学和各项事务上作出的努力和贡献，正是她们义无反顾的付出，才使得学校平稳有序地展开各项教学活动。她们在发言总结了各自的工作后，也对新的校长和董事长寄寓了无限期望和鼓励。 大家推选出的新一届校长和董事长是谢小红女士和何世江先生。他们将接过这支中华文化教育的接力棒，继续服务于全校的师生和家长。谢小红校长多年来一直参与学校的校务活动，去年担任教学校长。何世江董事长也在学校义务服务多年，并参与校委会工作。相信在他们以及新一届的董事会和校委会成员的带领下，希望中文学校一定会更加发展壮大。 今年的中文、才艺表演不只是单纯的朗诵和歌舞，同学们在这些表演形式里更注重加入了中华文化的元素。比如汤可老师率领的中文舞剧表演班带来的《说唱脸谱》，为大家普及了国粹京剧的脸谱知识；何春玲老师编排的《草原母亲》让大家领略了祖国草原的风情；黄利荣老师率领的武术班表演的《五步拳》，让台下的观众热血沸腾，恨不能一起上台切磋一番。为了庆祝即将到来的母亲节，大家也把对妈妈的爱和感激融入在表演里。吴盛佳老师执教的儿歌《妈妈你别说我小》，蒋琳老师编排的舞蹈《妈妈的爱》都表达了稚嫩的娃娃们对妈妈的感情，让在场的妈妈们无不动容。当然其他班级的中文表演也都非常出色，比如邵英老师执教的《中文问答》、杨京生老师编排的小品《小猴子下山》、朱雪薇老师执教的儿歌《落叶》、《小蜘蛛》，都展示了孩子们的学习成果。 除了孩子们的表演，成人也不甘示弱，蔡善皋老师带领指导的成人合唱团带来了动听的歌曲《鼓浪屿之歌》、《大海啊故乡》，中级吉它班的孩子们还为合唱团伴奏。成人舞蹈班带来了优美的舞蹈《傣族姑娘在水边》，执教老师何春玲和董事长黄双双还亲自上阵，赢得一片喝彩叫好！在希望的校园里不只是孩子们在学习和成长，我们的家长也在一起学习，共同成长，并完善自己的人生。 精彩的表演中，学校还穿插着给优秀的学生颁发了各个奖项。这一年里，希望的学生在中文和中华文化的学习上取得了重大的成绩。在全美”青少年中华文化大赛”中，希望中文学校的陈飞羽，陈叶晟，朱恩达，李龙飞，谢知知脱颖而出，取得优异成绩。学校还表彰了在Community Service里有杰出表现的学生：陈卓婷，高安妮 ，高如碧，Weixi Li，Michael Wu。在学校的识字比赛、写作比赛、棋类比赛中，各班也涌现出不少佼佼者，学校为这些获奖学生一一颁发了奖杯奖牌。金光闪闪的奖杯奖牌映衬着孩子们的笑脸，分外灿烂。 学校也对本年度杰出教师杨京生、蔡善皋、何春玲、Julian Wu以及其他每位教师、义工, 家长,和学生的 辛勤付出以及对学校各项活动的支持表示十分的感谢。让我们共同努力, 迎接充满希望充满挑战的新学年。 2013年秋季学期8/17开始。 具体课程和注册正在准备中, 到时会及时通知。详情请登录学校网站http://www.azhopechineseschool.org/查询或或发邮件到 hopechineseschool@yahoo.com 。
7f2f1019c6701d093c744449da339b4767054ec7.translatedText: (Contributed by Hope Chinese School) On May 5, 2013, Hope Chinese School held a grand graduation award ceremony at Tumbleweed Park Recreation Center. The ceremony was packed with all the teachers, students and parents of the school gathered together, and the warm atmosphere overshadowed the scorching heat of Phoenix. For this ceremony, the school is honored to invite Professor Pan Shou'an, President of Mesa Community College, Patricia Esparza, Head of Community Partnership of Mesa Community College and Ms. Shuai Zhiruo, President of the National Association of Chinese Schools. The school would like to express special thanks to Mesa Community College for its long-term support and cooperation with Hope Chinese School. The school expresses its heartfelt thanks to the retiring principal Ms. Zhao Caihong and the school chairman Ms. Huang Shuangshuang who have been re-elected for three years. Thank them for their efforts and contributions to school teaching and various affairs in the past three years. It is their unremitting efforts that enable the school to carry out various teaching activities smoothly and orderly. After summarizing their respective work in their speeches, they also expressed unlimited expectations and encouragement for the new principal and chairman. The new president and chairman of the board of directors elected by everyone are Ms. Xie Xiaohong and Mr. He Shijiang. They will take over the baton of Chinese cultural education and continue to serve the teachers, students and parents of the whole school. Principal Xie Xiaohong has been involved in school affairs for many years and served as the teaching principal last year. Chairman He Shijiang has also served the school voluntarily for many years and participated in the work of the school committee. I believe that under the leadership of them and the new board of directors and school committee members, Hope Chinese School will develop even more. This year's Chinese language and talent performances are not just simple recitations, singing and dancing, the students paid more attention to adding elements of Chinese culture to these performances. For example, the Chinese dance drama performance class led by Teacher Tang Ke brought "Rap Face Makeup", which popularized the knowledge of facial makeup in Peking Opera, the quintessence of Chinese culture; the "Prairie Mother" choreographed by Teacher He Chunling allowed everyone to appreciate the style of the grassland of the motherland; the martial arts class led by Teacher Huang Lirong performed "Five Steps Fist", which made the audience excited and wanted to go on stage to compete together. In order to celebrate the upcoming Mother's Day, everyone also integrated their love and gratitude for their mothers into the performance. The children's song "Mom, Don't Say I'm Young" taught by teacher Wu Shengjia, and the dance "Mother's Love" choreographed by teacher Jiang Lin both expressed the tender children's feelings for their mothers, making all the mothers present moved. Of course, the Chinese performances of other classes were also excellent, such as "Chinese Questions and Answers" taught by teacher Shao Ying, the sketch "Little Monkey Descends the Mountain" arranged by teacher Yang Jingsheng, and the children's songs "Falling Leaves" and "Little Spider" taught by teacher Zhu Xuewei, all showing the children's learning achievements. In addition to the children's performances, adults were not to be outdone. The adult choir led by teacher Cai Shangao performed beautiful songs "Song of Gulangyu Island" and "Ocean, My Hometown". Children in the intermediate guitar class also accompanied the choir. The adult dance class presented the beautiful dance "Dai Girl at the Waterside". The teacher He Chunling and the chairman Huang Shuangshuang also performed in person, which won a lot of applause! In Hope's campus, not only the children are learning and growing, but our parents are also learning together, growing together, and improving their lives. During the wonderful performances, the school also awarded various awards to outstanding students. During this year, Hope students have made significant achievements in learning Chinese and Chinese culture. In the National Youth Chinese Culture Competition, Chen Feiyu, Chen Yesheng, Zhu Enda, Li Longfei, and Xie Zhizhi from Hope Chinese School stood out and achieved excellent results. The school also commended students with outstanding performance in Community Service: Chen Zhuoting, Gao Anni, Gao Rubi, Weixi Li, and Michael Wu. In the school's literacy competitions, writing competitions, and chess competitions, many outstanding students emerged from each class. The school awarded trophies and medals to these winning students one by one. The glittering trophies and medals reflected the children's smiling faces, which were particularly bright. The school also expresses its deep gratitude to this year’s outstanding teachers Yang Jingsheng, Cai Shangao, He Chunling, Julian Wu, and every other teacher, volunteer, parent, and student for their hard work and support for various school activities. Let us work together to welcome a new school year full of hope and challenges. The fall semester of 2013 starts on 8/17. Specific courses and registration are being prepared and will be notified in time. For details, please log on to the school website http://www.azhopechineseschool.org/ or send an email to hopechineseschool@yahoo.com.

0bba8eab50bad3167264dbd68283de4dc760376e.sourceText: 2011年 道路交通事故死亡人数增加 （亚省时报） 日前，州交通部公布2011年道路交通事故死亡人数，经历了2010年的下降后，这数字在2011年又骤然上升，令人担忧。 据交通部数据。道路交通事故死亡人数从2005年的1193人下降到2010年758人。但2011年增长了9%，死亡人数达825人。 除人员伤亡外，交通部估计，机动车事故导致了本州经济损失达2亿9千万美元。 根据美国公路交通安全管理局数据，2011年，全美有32310人死于交通意外，比2010年低了2%，比2005年少了26%。 交通部官员说，酒驾、分心和疲劳驾驶，不系安全带是产生意外的主要原因。有些人开车收发短信，导致追尾、偏离车道，意外因此发生。另外，本州与全美38个州一样，没有法律规定摩托车骑手必须佩带头盔，也导致了摩托车骑手死亡人数上升。2011年，摩托车骑手交通意外死亡人数132人，比2010年上涨了55%。 交通部官员提醒驾车人士：珍惜生命，小心驾驶。
0bba8eab50bad3167264dbd68283de4dc760376e.translatedText: The death toll in road traffic accidents increased in 2011 (Alberta Times) Recently, the state Department of Transportation announced the number of road traffic accident fatalities in 2011. After a decline in 2010, this number rose sharply in 2011, which is worrying. According to data from the Ministry of Transportation. Road traffic fatalities dropped from 1,193 in 2005 to 758 in 2010. But in 2011 it increased by 9%, with 825 deaths. In addition to casualties, the Department of Transportation estimates that motor vehicle accidents cost the state's economy $290 million. According to data from the U.S. Highway Traffic Safety Administration, 32,310 people died in traffic accidents in the United States in 2011, which was 2% lower than in 2010 and 26% lower than in 2005. Transport ministry officials say drunk driving, distracted and fatigued driving, and failure to wear seat belts are the main causes of accidents. Some people send and receive text messages while driving, resulting in rear-end collisions and lane departures, and accidents occur as a result. In addition, this state, like 38 states in the United States, has no law requiring motorcycle riders to wear helmets, which has also led to an increase in the death toll of motorcycle riders. In 2011, 132 motorcycle riders died in traffic accidents, an increase of 55% from 2010. Officials from the Ministry of Transportation remind motorists: Cherish life and drive carefully.

In addition to domestic experts teaching online store opening practices, marketing strategy planning and application, practical case analysis, industry success techniques and experience sharing, etc., it also arranges visits to domestic companies with excellent application of Internet marketing. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee will bear the expenses related to the study courses and visits, as well as the board and lodging expenses of the participants during the study period. Participants will be responsible for the round-trip air tickets and transportation costs from their place of residence and other personal expenses. Those who are interested in registering please contact the Chengcheng Overseas Chinese Center at 714-754-9999 or the Luo Overseas Chinese Center at 626-443-9999 before October 17, 2012.

d07335c32d9ca4942aa8f9c52e6c884db6080ee7.sourceText: 中国作家富豪榜公布 奇幻作家2550万元成首富 备受各界关注的”2013第八届中国作家富豪榜主榜”由华西都市报全国独家发布！长江后浪推前浪，去年排名第五的36岁幻想文学作家江南”咸鱼翻身”，以2550万元的年度版税收入成为万众瞩目的中国作家新首富；文坛老将莫言依然以2400万元的版税收入稳占榜眼位置；去年首富郑渊洁则以1800万全年版税收入位居第三。此外，2012第七届中国作家富豪榜榜单的30名席位在今年扩充到60位，这60位上榜作家去年一共吸金3.4亿元。中国作家富豪榜品牌创始人吴怀尧说，”如果从图书定价来算，这60位作家一年创造了30多亿的财富，在丰富亿万读者精神生活的同时，为社会创造了大量就业机会。” 幻想文学跻身主流 江南、刘慈欣榜上有名 江南是目前中国奇幻文学的当红炸子鸡，他成为今年中国作家富豪榜新首富其实也是对文坛发出一个重要信号，幻想文学现在已经成为通俗文学的主流。上榜的60人中，不少作家都是幻想文学的领军者，比如以1780万年度版税位居第4的湖南籍作家雷欧幻像，就擅长写儿童奇幻冒险小说，他的《查理九世》等作品目前累计畅销千万册；排名21的成都美女作家裟椤双树创作的是古风动漫幻想大作《浮生物语》；北京作家刘慈欣今年首次荣登中国作家富豪榜，正是因为他的科幻小说《三体》在中国拥有成千上万的读者…… 历数上千年的中国传统文化，幻想小说一直都是其中不可分割的板块，从最早的《山海经》开始，到后来的《搜神记》、《聊斋志异》以及《西游记》等。在西方，幻想小说早就属于主流文学，《魔戒》、《哈利?#27874;特》、《冰与火之歌》等小说全球销量都不低于千万册。 江南在接受华西都市报记者采访时说：”在奇幻这个题材上，这些年的创作比较平淡，目前看来我们还没有组建起足够有力的远征军去摘取奇幻桂冠上的宝石。奇幻小说的成功对本国神话传统的理解和再造我想是有关的，我们有很好的传统，但缺乏有效的理解、分析和再造。” 谁的青春不迷茫？刘同、陆琪成”黑马” 中国作家富豪榜自2006年创立至今走到第八届，以写作青春小说成名的郭敬明每年都是榜单前几名。2007年、2008年和2011年，郭敬明分别以1100万元、1300万元、2450万元的版税三次位列中国作家富豪榜榜首，成为”中国作家富豪榜畅销书之王”。去年，郭敬明以1400万元的版税收入仅列第4位，今年更是下滑明显，跌至第8位，这是因为在第八届中国作家富豪榜数据采集截止期之前，他还没有重磅力作出炉，而把写作的精力转移到拍电影上面，不过他的《小时代》系列依然畅销，年度版税收入只比去年低100万。 虽然郭敬明榜单名次”低迷”，但今年的上榜作家中，青春文学作家依然比比皆是。中国新生代作家，青春励志小说代表性人物刘同凭借作品《谁的青春不迷茫》，销量突破百万册，创造了近年来青春励志类文学作品的纪录，同时也以715万元的年度版税收入荣登第14名，这是他首次进入中国作家富豪榜，堪称本届中国作家富豪榜的黑马作家。此外，情感类文学作品也在今年书市大为热销，陆琪的《婚姻是女人一辈子的事》让这位”情感老爸”首次上榜，写出《真爱没那么累，幸福没那么贵》的苏芩也是第一次上榜。值得关注的是，无论是青春小说还是情感读物，他们的作者都是很年轻的80后，刘同32岁、陆琪30岁、苏芩32岁，年轻作家的异军突起无疑给创办八年的中国作家富豪榜吹来一股清新之风。 影视名人扎堆出书冯小刚当上”作家富豪” 柴静也是本届中国作家富豪榜的”新人”，拥有无数粉丝的这位著名女主持人，她的十年主持生涯的自传作品《看见》使得她排名第十，1150万的超高版税令她成为另一匹黑马作家。早在今年8月公布的《2013上半年中国图书零售市场报告》中，《看见》就是虚构类、非虚构类、少儿类三大榜单综合数据中的销售冠军。而像柴静这样的影视名人跨界出书，在本届中国作家富豪榜中，比比皆是。 近几年火起来的主持人乐嘉写了《爱难猜》让他以560万版税的收入排名第十七，而通过征婚节目《非诚勿扰》走红的孟非也凭《随遇而安》排名第十九。资深电视人杨澜继《凭海临风》和《一问一世界》之后又写出《幸福要回答》，一年来销量不俗，使得她排名第三十六。笔耕不辍的名嘴白岩松同样也和杨澜一样拿”幸福”说事，他的《幸福了吗》让他进账180万。 据吴怀尧透露，这次将在第八届中国作家富豪榜文化盛典期间担任”易中天对话吴思”现场主持的著名主持人李蕾，也即将出版自己的长篇小说处女作。就连著名导演冯小刚（微博）也赶上了今年影视名人出书的风潮，在他拍摄新片和执导春晚之余也抽空完成随笔集《不省心》，这本书使这位”中国导演富豪”首次当上了”中国作家富豪”。
d07335c32d9ca4942aa8f9c52e6c884db6080ee7.translatedText: China's Richest Writers List Announced Fantasy Writer Becomes Richest with 25.5 Million Yuan The "2013 Eighth Main List of China's Richest Writers", which has attracted much attention from all walks of life, is exclusively released nationwide by West China Metropolis Daily! The waves behind the Yangtze River push the waves ahead. The 36-year-old fantasy writer Jiang Nan, who ranked fifth last year, has become the new richest Chinese writer with an annual royalty income of 25.5 million yuan. Literary veteran Mo Yan still ranks second with a royalty income of 24 million yuan. Zheng Yuanjie, the richest man last year, ranked third with a full-year royalty income of 18 million yuan. In addition, the 30 seats on the 2012 Seventh China Rich Writers List expanded to 60 this year. These 60 writers on the list earned a total of 340 million yuan last year. Wu Huaiyao, founder of the Chinese Writers Rich List brand, said, "If we look at book pricing, these 60 writers have created more than 3 billion in wealth a year, enriching the spiritual lives of hundreds of millions of readers and creating a large number of employment opportunities for society." Fantasy literature has entered the mainstream Jiangnan and Liu Cixin are on the list Jiang Nan is currently a popular figure in Chinese fantasy literature. His becoming the new richest man in this year's list of richest Chinese writers actually sends an important signal to the literary world. Fantasy literature has now become the mainstream of popular literature. Among the 60 people on the list, many writers are leaders in fantasy literature. For example, Hunan writer Leo Phantom, who ranks fourth with 17.8 million annual royalties, is good at writing children's fantasy adventure novels. His works such as "Charlie IX" have sold tens of millions of copies. ; The 21st-ranked Chengdu beauty writer Chuan Chenshuangshu created the ancient animation fantasy masterpiece "The Tale of Plankton"; Beijing writer Liu Cixin made the list of the richest Chinese writers for the first time this year precisely because his science fiction novel "The Three-Body Problem" has thousands of readers in China... Fantasy novels have always been an inseparable part of Chinese traditional culture that has lasted for thousands of years, starting from the earliest "The Classic of Mountains and Seas" to later "Sou Shen Ji", "Strange Stories from a Chinese Studio" and "Journey to the West". In the West, fantasy novels have long been mainstream literature. Novels such as "The Lord of the Rings", "Harry Potter" and "A Song of Ice and Fire" have sold no less than 10 million copies worldwide. In an interview with a reporter from West China Metropolis Daily, Jiang Nan said: "On the subject of fantasy, the creations in recent years have been relatively mediocre. It seems that we have not yet formed a strong enough expeditionary force to pick up the gems on the fantasy laurel. I think the success of fantasy novels is related to the understanding and reconstruction of the country's mythological tradition. We have a good tradition, but lack effective understanding, analysis and reconstruction." Who is not confused in their youth? Liu Tong and Lu Qicheng are "dark horses". The Rich List of Chinese Writers has been in its eighth edition since its inception in 2006. Guo Jingming, who is famous for his youth novels, has been at the top of the list every year. In 2007, 2008 and 2011, Guo Jingming topped the list of the richest writers in China three times with royalties of 11 million yuan, 13 million yuan and 24.5 million yuan respectively, becoming the "King of Bestsellers on the Rich List of Chinese Writers". Last year, Guo Jingming only ranked 4th with a royalty income of 14 million yuan. This year, he dropped significantly, falling to 8th. This is because he has not released any major works before the data collection deadline of the 8th China Rich Writers List, and has transferred his writing energy to making movies. However, his "Tiny Times" series is still a best-seller, and his annual royalty income is only 1 million lower than last year. Although Guo Jingming's ranking on the list is "sluggish", there are still many youth literature writers among the writers on this year's list. Liu Tong, a new generation writer in China and a representative figure of youth inspirational novels, has sold more than one million copies with his work "Whose Youth Is Not Confused", setting a record for youth inspirational literature in recent years. He also ranked 14th with an annual royalty income of 7.15 million yuan. This is the first time that he has entered the rich list of Chinese writers, and he can be called a dark horse writer in this year's rich list of Chinese writers. In addition, emotional literary works are also very popular in this year's book market. Lu Qi's "Marriage is a lifetime affair for a woman" makes this "emotional dad" appear on the list for the first time. Su Qin, who wrote "True Love Is Not So Tiring, Happiness Is Not So Expensive", is also on the list for the first time. It is worth noting that whether they are youth novels or emotional readings, their authors are all very young, born in the 1980s. Liu Tong is 32 years old, Lu Qi is 30 years old, and Su Qin is 32 years old. The sudden rise of young writers has undoubtedly brought a breath of fresh air to the eight-year-old Chinese Writers Rich List. Film and television celebrities gathered together to publish books. Feng Xiaogang became a "rich writer". Chai Jing is also a "newcomer" in this year's rich list of Chinese writers. This famous female host has countless fans. Her autobiographical work "Seeing" during her ten-year hosting career ranked her tenth. The ultra-high royalties of 11.5 million made her another dark horse writer. As early as August this year, in the "China Book Retail Market Report for the First Half of 2013", "Seeing" was the sales champion in the comprehensive data of the three major lists of fiction, non-fiction and children. There are many film and television celebrities like Chai Jing who have crossed over to publish books in this year's list of the richest Chinese writers. Host Le Jia, who has become popular in recent years, wrote "Love Is Hard to Guess", ranking him 17th with a royalty income of 5.6 million, while Meng Fei, who became popular through the marriage show "If You Are the One", also ranked 19th with "Let It Happen". Senior TV personality Yang Lan wrote "Happiness Wants an Answer" after "Bing Hai Lin Feng" and "Ask the World". Sales have been good over the past year, making her ranked 36th. Bai Yansong, a well-known writer who is constantly writing, also talks about "happiness" like Yang Lan. His "Are You Happy" earned him 1.8 million yuan. According to Wu Huaiyao, the famous host Li Lei, who will serve as the live host of "Yi Zhongtian Dialogue with Wu Si" during the 8th China Writers Rich List Cultural Festival, will also publish his debut novel. Even the famous director Feng Xiaogang (Weibo) has caught up with this year's trend of film and television celebrities publishing books. While filming new films and directing the Spring Festival Gala, he also found time to complete the essay collection "Not Worrying". This book made this "rich Chinese director" become a "rich Chinese writer" for the first time.

2fa4bc5113d14ce1d293aad883c049f3b4a9dfca.sourceText: 2012年美国最佳高中排名 《新闻周刊》每年都会列出美国最佳高中排行榜, 今年，位于肯塔基州博林格林的盖顿科数学校（Gatton Academy of Mathematics and Science in Kentucky，Bowling Green）夺冠 。本州两家高中上榜。历年在榜上排二、三名的本州图森基础学校，滑落到第五，斯格思岱尔的基础学校第一次上榜，一举取得第五名。 排行榜的评分标准由六部份组成：毕业率（占25％），大学入学率（占25％），参加AP/IB/AICE ）考试的学生比例（占25％）， SAT/ACT考试的平均分数（占10％），AP/IB/AICE考试成绩（占10％），以及供学生选择的AP课程的数量（占5％）。这个评比不仅仅是对 一个学校绝对学术水平的排名，而是也包含了学校给学生提供的教育机会多少。 AP是Advanced Placement?#39640;级课程?#30340;缩写，即高中生在读高中时就可以修大学的课程。这是给少数优异的学生提供提前修大学课程的机会。许多科目都有AP考试，考试通过后进入大学可以免修相应课程。IB是 International Baccalaureate”国际文凭”的缩写。AICE是Advanced International Certificate of Education?#39640;级国际教育证书?#30340;缩写， 于1994年由剑桥大学率先引用。IB和AICE是给世界各地的精英学子开设的国际学校的考试，水平甚高，享有和AP类似的待遇。由于目前进入美国常青藤大学的竞争越来越激烈， AP 、IB 或AICE的考试成绩就显得尤为重要。 2012年美国最佳高中排名前十名的学校如下： 1 盖顿科数学校，博林格林，肯塔基州 The Gatton Academy of Mathematics and Science in Kentucky Bowling Green KY 2 天才永磁学校，达拉斯，德克萨斯州 The School for the Talented and Gifted Magnet Dallas TX 3 斯科茨代尔基础学校，斯科茨代尔，亚利桑那州 Basis Scottsdale Scottsdale AZ 4 理工永磁学校，达拉斯，德州 School of Science and Engineering Magnet Dallas TX 5 图森基础学校， 图森，亚利桑那州 Basis Tucson Tucson AZ 6 杰斐逊郡IBS 高中， 伯明翰，亚拉巴马州 Jefferson County International Baccalaureate School Birmingham AL 7 西格内彻中学，埃文斯维尔，印第安纳州 Signature School Evansville IN 8 斯坦顿大学预科学校， 杰克逊维尔，佛罗里达州 Stanton College Preparatory School Jacksonville FL 9 阳光海岸社区高中， 里维埃拉，佛罗里达州 Suncoast Community Riviera Beach FL 10 托马斯?#26480;斐逊科技学校 ，亚历山大，弗吉尼亚州 Thomas Jefferson for Science and Technology Alexandria VA 11 城市荣誉中学，水牛城，纽约州 City Honors School at Fosdick-Masten Park Buffalo NY 12 高级研究学校，迈阿密，佛罗里达州 School for Advanced Studies Miami FL 13 安德鲁?#21345;内基先锋学校， 休斯敦， 德克萨斯州 Andrew Carnegie Vanguard Houston TX 14 北山教育预备学校， 欧文，德克萨斯州 Uplift Education North Hills Preparatory School Irving TX 15 松景学校，奥斯普瑞，佛罗里达州 Pine View School Osprey FL 欲了解美国各高中的详细排名，请访问以下网站： http://www.thedailybeast.com/newsweek/2012/05/20/america-s-best-high-schools.html 亚利桑那州高中排名榜详情： http://www.usnews.com/education/best-high-schools/arizona/rankings
2fa4bc5113d14ce1d293aad883c049f3b4a9dfca.translatedText: 2012 Ranking of the Best High Schools in the United States Newsweek lists the best high schools in the United States every year. This year, Gatton Academy of Mathematics and Science in Bowling Green, Kentucky, won the championship. Two high schools in the state made the list. The state's Tucson Basic School, which has been ranked second and third on the list over the years, slipped to fifth place. Scottsdale's Basic School made the list for the first time and took fifth place in one fell swoop. The scoring criteria for the rankings consist of six components: graduation rate (25%), college enrollment rate (25%), proportion of students taking AP/IB/AICE exams (25%), average SAT/ACT test score (10%), AP/IB/AICE test scores (10%), and the number of AP courses for students to choose from (5%). This evaluation is not just a ranking of a school's absolute academic level, but also includes the educational opportunities the school provides students. AP is the abbreviation of Advanced Placement?#39640;level course?#30340;that is, high school students can take college courses while still in high school. This is an opportunity for a small number of outstanding students to take college courses in advance. Many subjects have AP exams. After passing the exam, you can be exempted from taking the corresponding courses when entering college. IB is the abbreviation of International Baccalaureate. AICE is the abbreviation of Advanced International Certificate of Education?#39640; Level International Education Certificate?#30340;, which was first cited by the University of Cambridge in 1994. IB and AICE are international school examinations offered to elite students from all over the world. They are of very high level and enjoy similar treatment to AP. As the competition to enter the Ivy League universities in the United States is becoming increasingly fierce, the test scores of AP, IB or AICE are particularly important. The top ten schools in the 2012 Best High Schools in America are as follows: 1 The Gatton Academy of Mathematics and Science in Kentucky Bowling Green KY 2 The School for the Talented and Gifted Magnet Dallas TX 3 Basis Scottsdale Scottsdale AZ 4 School of Science and Engineering Magnet Dallas TX 5 Basis Tucson Tucson AZ 6 Jefferson County IBS High School, Birmingham, AL Jefferson County International Baccalaureate School Birmingham AL 7 Signature School Evansville IN 8 Stanton College Preparatory School Jacksonville FL 9 Suncoast Community High School, Riviera, FL Suncoast Community Riviera Beach FL 10 Thomas Jefferson for Science and Technology Alexandria VA 11 City Honors School at Fosdick-Masten Park Buffalo NY 12 School for Advanced Studies Miami FL 13 Andrew Neck Pioneer School, Houston, Andrew Carnegie Vanguard Houston TX 14 Uplift Education North Hills Preparatory School Irving TX 15 Pine View School Osprey FL For detailed rankings of high schools in the United States, visit the following website: http://www.thedailybeast.com/newsweek/2012/05/20/america-s-best-high-schools.html Details of Arizona high school rankings: http://www.usnews.com/education/best-high-schools/arizona/rankings

7f5c4aaaab9d1d55b604712d471cf6b7f9ead5a2.sourceText: （张肇鸿报导）1月5日，凤凰城龙冈公所召开会议，新旧主席进行交接形式。大家对上一任主席张华芳会务工作表示赞扬，凤凰城龙冈勇于接办美洲龙冈2016年恳亲大会在凤凰城举办，将为本公所的会务和影响带上一个新的平台，全体成员将发扬龙冈团队的精神, 克己尽责去完成任务。2014年新上任主席刘全知感谢大家的信任，将努力做好今年工作。
7f5c4aaaab9d1d55b604712d471cf6b7f9ead5a2.translatedText: (Reported by Zhang Zhaohong) On January 5, Phoenix City Longgang Office held a meeting to hand over the new and old chairman. Everyone praised the previous chairman Zhang Huafang for his conference affairs work. Phoenix Longgang had the courage to take over the 2016 American Longgang Friendship Conference in Phoenix, which will bring a new platform to the firm's conference affairs and influence. All members will carry forward the Longgang team spirit and complete the task with self-restraint and responsibility. Liu Quanzhi, the newly appointed chairman in 2014, thanked everyone for their trust and will work hard to do a good job this year.

d264540bef3d20a7b749771eb865b5803a979e74.sourceText: 凤凰城龙冈公所的21届恳亲大会的筹备已展开工作。筹备会荣誉主席关宗任和筹委成员张肇鸿，到过两间赌场酒店实地观察，看是否适合作恳亲会场和旅馆，另一间近机场的Marriott大旅馆亦有过接洽。将在美洲龙冈亲义总公所首长到凤凰城参加春宴时，一同前往作初步视察。
d264540bef3d20a7b749771eb865b5803a979e74.translatedText: Preparations for the 21st Qinqin Conference of Longgang Office in Phoenix City have begun. Guan Zongren, honorary chairman of the preparatory committee, and Zhang Zhaohong, member of the preparatory committee, visited two casino hotels for on-site observation to see if they were suitable venues and hotels for weddings. They also contacted another Marriott hotel near the airport. When the head of the American Ryugang Chenyi General Office comes to Phoenix to attend the spring banquet, he will go there with him for a preliminary inspection.

25b39cbc2886cab613914564648a839fc2f7d219.sourceText: 美洲龙冈总公所于3月30日在三藩市举办春宴。凤凰城龙冈将由新任主席刘全知带队参加，目前已有多人报名。凤凰城龙冈春宴定于4月13日(星期日)在六福酒家举行，美洲龙冈总公所首长们将前来出席春宴。

Phoenix Longgang will be led by the new chairman Liu Quanzhi to participate, and many people have already signed up. The Longgang Spring Banquet in Phoenix City is scheduled to be held at Luk Fook Restaurant on April 13 (Sunday). Heads of the American Longgang Headquarters will come to attend the Spring Banquet.

7d9410cd066fe4d5506279cb971b739396f23fa9.sourceText: 文扬：2012 环太军演：美国把想说的都说了 包括了22个国家共计2万5千多海军人员参加的”环太平洋”RIMPAC军演，此时正在夏威夷周围海域热热闹闹地进行。 偌大一个”海军大联欢”，没中国什么事，连观察员都不是。国防部发言人耿雁生回应说：”坦率地说，我们不认为这是一个多么大的事，不值得大惊小怪。” 这么说也没错。”环太平洋”军演的确不是新鲜事，一个例行军演，每两年一次，已进行了四十多年，说是老一套也行。 邀请多国海军参加也不是新鲜事，从1971年刚开始就是美英加澳新5个英语国家，而后日本、韩国、法国、泰国、新加坡等”友邦”都曾陆续加入，2008年增加到10国，2010年是14国，今年是22国。也可以说是老一套。 但我宁肯相信，无论中国怎么说，在美国方面，却一定是把此次军演当作一件大事，甚至是特大事项来办的。这件大事，如果有个名字的话，就叫做把”重返亚太”战略从口号落实到行动上，并且把这个战略的核心内涵明明白白、准确无误地宣示出来，不留模糊余地。 其一，之所以将今年的军演扩大成”史上最大”的”世界级”军演，是因为美国想要借此表示：美国”重返亚太”不是一个地区性的战略转移，将60%的海军军力部署到太平洋，并不是一个普通的跨战区调防，而是一个全球战略重心调整。也就是说，美国未来在亚太地区所展开的行动，不会是局部性的，一定是全球性的，因为这个战略调整所要对付的对手，将是一个全球性的大国！ 其二，之所以破天荒地邀请曾经是主要假想敌的俄罗斯海军参加，是因为美国想要指出这一点：”重返亚太”战略并不意味着重回冷战，当年的老对手俄罗斯也不妨以”友军”的身份参加。换句话说，”重返亚太”战略主要不是针对俄罗斯，而是另有一个新兴的、与当年俄罗斯的威胁等级相当的主要假想敌！ 其三，之所以非常刻意又非常显著地将个别”环太平洋”大国排除在外，是因为美国想要借此让世界都知道：”重返亚太”战略不是为了一般意义上的海上安全，环太军演也无意搞什么海上搜救、护航护渔、人道主义救援等花架子，而是真正的军事战略，不可能没有假想敌，不可能全都邀请进来你好我好他也好。虽然没说所有未被邀请者都是假想敌，但谁都知道，假想敌就是其中之一！ 其四，之所以把亚太地区一众中小国家尽可能多地拉进来，是因为美国想要通过这一空前规模的军演，一次性地让这些对美国的决心和能力心存怀疑、还在盘算要不要选边站队的机会主义者们树立起对美国的信心，让他们清楚地知道在太平洋谁是”我们”，谁是”他们”，要懂政治，不要犯糊涂！ 此次军演，美国海军为了营造声势，不惜做成史上最大，承受了来自预算方面的压力；为了逼近实战，坚持要击沉报废军舰，承受了来自环保团体的压力；为了追求效应，将二十多国生拉硬扯在一起，承受了来自外交、商业等多方面的压力；如果不是要办大事，战略性的大事，费这么大劲干什么？ 在我看来，中国故意淡看环太军演，以”不值得大惊小怪”回应，作为一步外交策略是对的，甚至很英明，颇有羽扇纶巾笑看强虏的孔明遗风。但在军事策略上，如果继续误判形势，对美国”重返亚太”战略到底剑指哪里仍然心存幻想，不能及时制定出正确的战略因应，将会酿成大错。 2012年7月1日
7d9410cd066fe4d5506279cb971b739396f23fa9.translatedText: Wen Yang: 2012 Rim of the Pacific Military Exercise: the United States said everything it wanted to say. The "Rim of the Pacific" military exercise, which includes the participation of more than 25,000 naval personnel from 22 countries, is currently being carried out in the waters around Hawaii. Such a "naval party" has nothing to do with China, and it is not even an observer. Frankly speaking, we do not think this is such a big thing and it is not worth making a fuss about. "That's right. The "Pacific Rim" military exercise is indeed nothing new. It is a routine military exercise that has been held every two years for more than 40 years. It can be said that it is an old routine. Inviting navies from multiple countries to participate is not new. In 1971, the United States, Britain, Canada, Australia and New Zealand were the five English-speaking countries. Later, Japan, South Korea, France, Thailand, Singapore and other "friendly countries" successively joined. In 2008, the number increased to 10 countries, in 2010 it was 14 countries, and this year it is 22 countries. But I would rather believe that no matter what China says, the United States must treat this military exercise as a major event, even a very important event. If this major event has a name, it is called the implementation of the "Return to the Asia-Pacific" strategy from slogans to actions, and the core connotation of this strategy is clearly and accurately declared, leaving no room for ambiguity. First, the reason why this year’s military exercise was expanded into the “largest” and “world-class” military exercise in history is because the United States wanted to express that the United States’ “return to the Asia-Pacific” is not a regional strategic shift, and deploying 60% of its naval forces to the Pacific is not a general move. It is a cross-theater defense adjustment, but a global strategic focus adjustment. In other words, the future actions of the United States in the Asia-Pacific region will not be local, but must be global, because the opponent this strategic adjustment must deal with will be a global power! Second, the reason why the Russian Navy, which was once the main imaginary enemy, was invited to participate for the first time is because the United States wants to point out that the "return to the Asia-Pacific" strategy does not mean a return to the Cold War. Russia, its old rival at the time, may also participate as a "friendly force." In other words, the "return to the Asia-Pacific" strategy is not mainly aimed at Russia, but another emerging major imaginary enemy with a threat level comparable to Russia's back then! Third, the reason why certain "Pacific Rim" powers are very deliberately and obviously excluded is because the United States wants to let the world know that the "Return to Asia-Pacific" strategy is not for maritime security in the general sense, and the Rim-Pacific military exercise does not intend to engage in maritime search and rescue. It is a real military strategy. It is impossible not to have imaginary enemies. It is impossible to invite everyone in. Although it is not said that all the uninvited people are imaginary enemies, everyone knows that imaginary enemies are one of them! Fourth, the reason why it brings in as many small and medium-sized countries in the Asia-Pacific region as possible is because the United States wants to use this unprecedented scale military exercise to once and for all opportunists who have doubts about the determination and capabilities of the United States and are still thinking about whether to choose a side to build confidence in the United States, so that they can clearly understand who is "us" and who is "them" in the Pacific. They must understand politics and not be confused! For this military exercise, in order to build momentum, the U.S. Navy did not hesitate to make it the largest in history, and endured pressure from the budget; in order to get closer to actual combat, it insisted on sinking scrapped warships, and endured pressure from environmental groups; in order to pursue effects, it dragged more than 20 national students together, and endured pressure from many aspects such as diplomacy and commerce; if it was not to do big things, strategic things, why would it be spending so much effort? In my opinion, China deliberately downplayed the RIM-Pacific military exercises and responded with "not worth making a fuss about". As a diplomatic strategy, it is correct and even wise. It has the legacy of Kong Ming who laughed at the enemy. However, in terms of military strategy, if it continues to misjudge the situation and still has illusions about where the US "pivot to the Asia-Pacific" strategy is, and fails to formulate a correct strategic response in time, it will lead to a big mistake on July 1, 2012.

d9cfaf4e4d201ca90e94cfe2762d9c3e33ed8b90.sourceText: 州长签署2013财政预算 令参众两会纷扰多时的2013财政预算案，终于在周一被州长签署成法律。 从7月1日起到明年6月30日，州府预算开支总额为8.6亿美元，比本财政年度多出5000万元。教育、公共安全和健保等方面都有增加，还用4.5亿美元设立一个名为”雨天基金”，用作紧急用途。 预算法恢复了3900万拨款给严重精神病患作补助；共5000万，为期两年，为增加高安全级别监狱床位，1600万作增加私人监狱床位1000个经费；8000万，为期两年，替换州府落后的统计电脑系统；4000万给小学提高学生阅读技巧，2100万作大学经费。 趁布鲁尔签署预算案之时，两会已将上周通过的10个法案上呈，希望州长尽快签署。
d9cfaf4e4d201ca90e94cfe2762d9c3e33ed8b90.translatedText: The governor signed the 2013 fiscal budget. The 2013 fiscal budget bill, which had caused turmoil in the House and Senate for a long time, was finally signed into law by the governor on Monday. From July 1 to June 30 next year, state budget spending totals $860 million, $50 million more than this fiscal year. There have been increases in education, public safety and health care, and a US$450 million fund called the "Rainy Day Fund" has been set up for emergency purposes. The budget law restores $39 million in funding for severely mentally ill patients; $50 million for two years to increase beds in high-security prisons; $16 million to add 1,000 beds in private prisons; $80 million for two years to replace the state's outdated statistical computer system; $40 million for elementary schools to improve students' reading skills; and $21 million for college funding. While Brewer was signing the budget bill, the two congresses had already submitted 10 bills passed last week and hoped that the governor would sign them as soon as possible.

ca3bf42ed79c6f52a89572d0f384018806002524.sourceText: 美国家庭财富已接近2007年高位 美联储周四公布数据显示，美国家庭净财富在第三季度明显提升，目前水平接近2007年晚些时候的峰值。这也被视作美国消费开支会在近期出现增长的一个有利迹象。 美联储周四的报告指出，美国家庭净财富在2012年第三季度中增加1.72万亿美元至64.77万亿美元，相比2007年第四季度，也就是最近一次严重经济衰退出现之前的水平仅有约1.2万亿美元的差距。美国家庭财富的近期峰值是2007年第三季度时的67.3万亿美元。 美联储指出，房价的回升帮助了家庭财富在最近一个季度的增长：当季家庭持有的房地产价值增加了3000亿美元。同期家庭持有的股票价值提高了约5200亿美元。 家庭财富的增长有望使消费者更有信心进行花费，很多经济学家认为美国民众在危机爆发之后仅仅愿意将每一美元收入中的几分钱拿出来消费。 美联储周四公布的季度资金流报告也指出，美国民众的债务负担也延续了长达四年的减少走势。家庭债务在第三季度中减少了2%，是2011年第三季度以来的最大季度降幅。以美元金额计算的家庭债务在当季减少655亿美元至12.87万亿美元，逆转了之前三个季度连续出现了小幅增长。 过去十年中，房地产市场泡沫导致美国家庭债务水平在前五年持续增长，占据家庭收入的比例在2007年出现峰值。在2006年房地产市场泡沫开始破裂后，美国经历了大衰退以来的最严重经济衰退，家庭债务水平从2008年开始减少。 2012年第三季度中，美国家庭总债务占税后收入比重从之前一个季度的113.4%降至112.7%，是2003年以来的最低水平。但是经济学家在家庭债务削减到底应该到何种程度才有最好效果的看法不一。有学者指出，继续减少债务意味着用于开支的钱减少，对整体经济会有拖累。 虽然总债务水平占据收入的比例还是接近历史高位，但是美联储追踪的另一个指标，即月度债务还款占收入比重在2012年第二季度中跌至了1993年以来的最低水平。
ca3bf42ed79c6f52a89572d0f384018806002524.translatedText: U.S. household wealth is close to the 2007 high. The Federal Reserve released data on Thursday showing that U.S. household net wealth increased significantly in the third quarter, and the current level is close to the peak in late 2007. This is also seen as a favorable sign that U.S. consumer spending will grow in the near future. The Federal Reserve reported Thursday that U.S. household net wealth increased by $1.72 trillion to $64.77 trillion in the third quarter of 2012, a gap of only about $1.2 trillion from the fourth quarter of 2007, before the latest severe recession. The most recent peak of U.S. household wealth was $67.3 trillion in the third quarter of 2007. The Fed noted that a rebound in home prices helped increase household wealth in the latest quarter: the value of real estate held by households increased by $300 billion in the quarter. The value of stocks held by households increased by about $520 billion during the same period. The growth in household wealth is expected to make consumers more confident in spending, and many economists believe that Americans are only willing to spend a few cents of every dollar of income after the crisis. The Federal Reserve's quarterly funds flow report released on Thursday also pointed out that the debt burden of the American people has also continued its four-year downward trend. Household debt fell 2% in the third quarter, the largest quarterly decline since the third quarter of 2011. Household debt in dollar terms fell by $65.5 billion to $12.87 trillion in the quarter, reversing three consecutive quarters of modest increases. In the past decade, the housing market bubble caused U.S. household debt levels to continue to grow in the first five years, with the proportion of household income peaking in 2007. After the housing market bubble began to burst in 2006, the United States experienced its worst recession since the Great Recession, and household debt levels began to decrease in 2008. In the third quarter of 2012, the total debt of U.S. households as a percentage of after-tax income fell to 112.7% from 113.4% in the previous quarter, the lowest level since 2003. But economists are divided on how far household debt reduction should go to have the best effect. Some scholars pointed out that continuing to reduce debt means less money for spending, which will be a drag on the overall economy. While total debt levels as a share of income remain near historic highs, another measure tracked by the Fed, monthly debt payments as a share of income, fell in the second quarter of 2012 to its lowest level since 1993.
