ca3aae3aaf25f6dfa1f34ad52a3dfe19dc29b63b.sourceText: 凤凰城 ELLEN：戏说中美文化的差异 在人类唯一能生存的地球东西两端正相对处，有两片大小、形状相似的陆地，一个叫中国、一个叫美国。当一方处于白昼，人的大头向上活动时，另一方正相反。这或许造就了诸多不同的思维和文化习俗。这种差异无所谓谁是谁非，各有各的形成原因和存在道理。下面就本人来美几年的体验和观察戏说一点个人管见，意在增进人民间的相互了解与勾通，或许能引起我们的思考及借鉴。 1．中国人写信封地址时，总是先国家、再省市地区、居所、最后是个人；美国人的习惯正相反。莫非中国人思维文化是先国家、再集体、后自己；美国人先个人？ 2．中国的股市上涨是红色标志，下跌是绿色的；美国的股市色标正相反。也许在某一方不幸运的事，到了另一方就幸运了，呵呵。 3．中国人的分享与分担是两个词及词义；美英语中的这两个词是同一个单词share。当某个美国人说与你分享时，你要小心掂量你的小钱包了，呵呵。 4．中国文化习俗中父母、子女、孙（外孙）子女永远是一家人，一家亲，亲友间大事小情帮忙随礼；美国式思维文化的父母只在子女18岁前是一家人，以后子女独立或有自己的伴侣就不是一家人了，亲友间经济利益等都要分清了。 5．中国男人一辈子可能很难对妻子说句”我爱你”，但辛苦赚钱是会给妻子持家养育孩子的；美国男人可以每天对妻子说”我爱你”几次，但自己赚钱一般是不给妻子的， 要双方把收入放在一个帐户上 。 6．中国父母管教打骂子女以致打骂妻子可以是合乎习俗可以理解的；美国人打孩子打妻子是违法的行为。 7．中国孩子从小要努力学习文化知识，玩耍是不务正业的奢侈；美国孩子更重视学习社会礼仪（如不乱丢垃圾、不在公共场所大声喧哗、爱护环境、遵守交通规则等），尽情玩耍是儿童正当的权力。 8．中国医院先交钱后看病给药，医疗保险部门控制医生不过多开药、医院不过分医疗；美国医院是先看病后寄帐单，这帐单高得离谱，简直就是给医药保险公司和患者的大闷棍，哼。 9．中国人对任何陌生人总是一脸冷漠；美国人对迎面的陌生人常面带微笑。 10．中国式的工作提升或录用要权衡交情和关系；美国式的提拔及录用大多看才能和个人personality棗人格特征适合与否。 11．中国人有枪是违法的，闯红灯是不犯法的；美国人有枪是合法的，违交规是要被抓的。 12．中国人吃饭大家共享一桌，有说有笑，喝酒抽烟；美国人聚会分餐，即便是儿童也自己点自己的菜，小声交谈，烟酒不沾。 13．中国的公共交通发达便民；美国的私人小车及停车场普及。 14．中国的消费在向第一世界最高水平攀登，收入与第三世界相比；美国的情况在向相反方向发展。 15．中国人的文化观念是只允许拥有一个国藉， 有其他国藉就意味着不爱自己的国家了；美国人可以拥有几个国藉，只要你工作生活合法、方便就行，这是你个人的自由，与爱国与否无关。
ca3aae3aaf25f6dfa1f34ad52a3dfe19dc29b63b.translatedText: Phoenix ELLEN: Joking about the differences between Chinese and American cultures Directly opposite each other at the east and west ends of the earth, the only place where humans can survive, there are two landmasses of similar size and shape, one called China and the other called the United States. When one side is in daylight and the person's head moves upward, the other side is doing the opposite. This may have resulted in many different thinking and cultural practices. This difference does not matter who is right or wrong, each has its own reasons and reasons for existence. Below I will share some personal opinions based on my experiences and observations during my several years in the United States. It is intended to enhance mutual understanding and communication among the people, and may arouse our thinking and reference. 1. When Chinese people address an envelope, they always put the country first, then the province, city, region, residence, and finally the individual; Americans have the opposite habit. Could it be that the Chinese people’s thinking and culture puts the country first, then the collective, and then the self, while Americans put the individual first? 2． China's stock market has red signs for rising prices and green signs for falling prices; the color code for the U.S. stock market is exactly the opposite. Maybe what is unlucky in one party will be lucky in another party, haha. 3． Sharing and sharing in Chinese are two words and their meanings; these two words in American English are the same word share. When an American says to share with you, you have to weigh your little wallet carefully, haha. 4． In Chinese culture and customs, parents, children, and grandchildren are always a family, and relatives and friends help each other with gifts and gifts in both big and small matters. In American thinking and culture, parents are only a family until their children are 18 years old. After that, their children become independent or have their own partners. They are no longer a family, and the economic interests among relatives and friends must be clearly distinguished. 5. It may be difficult for a Chinese man to say "I love you" to his wife throughout his life, but the hard-earned money will be used by his wife to run the house and raise children. American men can say "I love you" to their wives several times a day, but generally they will not give it to their wives when they make money. Both parties must put their income in the same account. 6． It is understandable and customary for Chinese parents to discipline their children and even beat their wives; it is illegal for Americans to beat their children and wives. 7. Chinese children have to work hard to learn cultural knowledge from an early age, and playing is a luxury that is not done properly. American children pay more attention to learning social etiquette (such as not littering, not making loud noises in public places, caring for the environment, obeying traffic rules, etc.). Playing to their heart's content is a child's legitimate right. 8． Chinese hospitals pay first and then treat patients and administer medicines. The medical insurance department controls doctors not to prescribe too much medicine and hospitals not to provide excessive medical treatment. American hospitals treat patients first and then send bills. The bills are ridiculously high. It is simply a big sap for medical insurance companies and patients, huh. 9. Chinese people always have a cold face towards any stranger; Americans always smile towards strangers they meet. 10. Chinese-style job promotion or hiring requires weighing friendships and relationships; American-style promotion and hiring mostly depends on the suitability of talents and personal personality - personality traits. 11. It is illegal for Chinese people to own guns, but it is not illegal to run a red light; it is legal for Americans to own guns, but they will be caught for violating traffic regulations. 12. Chinese people share a table when eating, talking, laughing, drinking and smoking; Americans share meals when they get together, even children order their own dishes, talk quietly, and do not smoke or drink. 13. China's public transportation is developed and convenient for people; private cars and parking lots are popular in the United States. 14. China's consumption is climbing to the highest level in the first world, and its income is compared with that of the third world; the situation in the United States is developing in the opposite direction. 15. Chinese people's cultural concept is that they are only allowed to have one country. Having other countries means that they do not love their country. Americans can have several countries, as long as your work and life are legal and convenient. This is your personal freedom and has nothing to do with being patriotic or not.

ae3edac14c117bae66ebbe11b06b5b6cab70e369.sourceText: 李一阳， ASU双语教育研二， 是2011年ASU中国留学生卡拉OK大赛（八月恋歌KTV独家赞助）中，最受大家关注的原创歌手。弹着吉他，唱着歌，多少会让人想起异国他乡的流浪。他在自己创作的歌曲中用这样一句歌词来总结一年多的留学生活”我用力的去挥霍，我用力的去遗憾”,多少能看出那种在不同状态下的矛盾和挣扎。
ae3edac14c117bae66ebbe11b06b5b6cab70e369.translatedText: Li Yiyang, a second-year bilingual education graduate student at ASU, is the most popular original singer in the 2011 ASU Chinese International Student Karaoke Competition (exclusively sponsored by August Love Song KTV). Playing the guitar and singing songs will remind people of wandering in a foreign country. In the song he composed, he used the lyrics to summarize his life of studying abroad for more than a year, "I try my best to squander, and I try my best to regret." This can somewhat reveal the contradictions and struggles in different situations.

1ea6ab9252593090fab512d631cf0ced558ac466.sourceText: 是在图书馆的角落，欣赏音乐吗？ 说起参加这次ASU卡拉OK大赛，李一阳说准备唱完一首就被淘汰，开心第一！因为两个曾经跟他大学在一起组建乐团的两个挚友，天天给他的祝福就是：”你别上台给我们丢人了，凑个热闹，就赶紧下来吧!” 他早习惯了挚友的这种损劲儿。因为这样的方式，会让比赛变成一个轻松的游戏。
1ea6ab9252593090fab512d631cf0ced558ac466.translatedText: Are you enjoying music in the corner of the library? Speaking of participating in this ASU Karaoke Competition, Li Yiyang said that he was prepared to be eliminated after singing one song, and he was happy first! Because two close friends who formed a band with him in college, their daily blessing to him is: "Don't embarrass us by going on stage, join in the fun, and come down quickly!" He has long been used to this kind of destructive attitude from his close friends. Because this method will make the game an easy game.

5ff2a344c53e335f17d096fb3d8d3c1637cac0ba.sourceText: 2010年4月在毕业前夕，他和挚友一起开了个告别校园的演唱会。2011年4月，三个好友已经分别在中国，英国，美国生活。为了回顾那段共同度过的快乐时光，他们仨又重新开始创作，编曲，配乐，演唱，录制视频等等，忙得不亦乐乎，在不长的时间里，就在三地共同完成一首MTV。不管什么时候，什么地方，音乐都把他们联系在一起。 李一阳说他是个特别爱胡思乱想的人，音乐是他诠释生活的一种方式。
5ff2a344c53e335f17d096fb3d8d3c1637cac0ba.translatedText: In April 2010, on the eve of graduation, he and his best friends held a farewell concert on campus. In April 2011, the three friends were already living in China, the United Kingdom, and the United States. In order to review the happy time they spent together, the three of them started composing, arranging, scoring, singing, recording videos, etc. They were very busy, and in a short period of time, they completed an MTV together in three places. No matter when or where, music connects them. Li Yiyang said that he is a very thought-provoking person, and music is a way for him to interpret life.

e9129658963c365fc70710387e7eeed5c4319173.sourceText: 中央民族大学十佳歌手 三星公司和easy杂志主办大学生音乐节北方赛区7名 学生会文艺部长 艺术团学生负责人 曾经组创乐队 ”擦干泪水，站上梦想舞台正中央，而我却更渴望，世界为了你鼓掌…”刘维哲唱起2011年亚利桑那州立大学第三届卡拉OK大赛的主题曲。 仅仅两个多月的海外生活，就读于MBA专业的刘维哲不仅感受到了课业的压力，留学生活的枯燥，也重新体会到了社团活动，结交新朋友，那些熟悉的大学时光。刘维哲说，上周末，十位参加决赛的选手一起参加了活动主题曲《你们是我的星光》的录制。十位爱好音乐的年轻人各显神通，演艺自己主唱的部分。集体合唱是非常难的合作过程，既要求保持个性，又讲究配合。经过几次的训练，当录音师大喊”通过”的时候，现场一片欢呼!!刘维哲说那是这两个多月最难忘的时刻，十位选手不仅是竞争的对手，更是朋友。
e9129658963c365fc70710387e7eeed5c4319173.translatedText: Top ten singers of Minzu University of China, 7 students in the Northern Division of the College Student Music Festival hosted by Samsung and easy magazine. Minister of Literature and Art of the Student Union. Student leader of the art troupe. He once formed a band. "Wipe away my tears and stand in the center of the dream stage, but I am even more eager that the world applauds for you..." Liu Weizhe sang the theme song of the 3rd Arizona State University Karaoke Competition in 2011. After living overseas for just over two months, Liu Weizhe, an MBA major, not only felt the pressure of course work and the boring life of studying abroad, but also re-experienced club activities, making new friends, and those familiar college days. Liu Weizhe said that last weekend, ten finalists participated in the recording of the theme song "You Are My Starlight". Ten young people who love music each show their talents and perform their own lead vocals. Group singing is a very difficult collaborative process that requires both individuality and coordination. After several training sessions, when the sound engineer shouted "passed", the audience cheered!! Liu Weizhe said that was the most unforgettable moment in these two months. The ten players were not only competitors, but also friends.

b50ff21be0782eb25c89dd4b9db8679116e6fdd8.sourceText: 2011年8月，刘维哲从中央民族大学来到美国亚利桑那州立大学就读MBA。在北京曾经多次参加歌唱比赛并屡获佳绩的刘维哲说，原来还跟朋友们壮语豪言，夸下了海口，要拿个好名次。参加了预赛才知道ASU中国留学生里真是藏龙卧虎，不仅有CCTV青年歌手大奖赛通俗组的获奖选手，还有非常有才华的原创歌手。即使是参加过上届卡拉OK大赛的选手都感叹，这次是有史以来实力最强的一次比赛。
b50ff21be0782eb25c89dd4b9db8679116e6fdd8.translatedText: In August 2011, Liu Weizhe came to Arizona State University from the Minzu University of China to study for an MBA. Liu Weizhe, who has participated in many singing competitions in Beijing and won many good results, said that he used to talk eloquently to his friends and boasted about Haikou and wanted to get a good ranking. After participating in the preliminaries, I realized that there are really hidden dragons and crouching tigers among the Chinese students at ASU. There are not only the winners of the popular category of the CCTV Young Singer Grand Prix, but also very talented original singers. Even the contestants who participated in the last karaoke competition lamented that this was the strongest competition ever.

d699dbe432de5517d5edcf20b6eb510fe11d17c0.sourceText: 如今的刘维哲非常谦虚的说，这次比赛有参加过歌唱训练的正规军，他纯属”杂牌军”但是他会打足精神，精心备战。
d699dbe432de5517d5edcf20b6eb510fe11d17c0.translatedText: Today Liu Weizhe said very modestly that there are regular soldiers who have participated in singing training in this competition. He is purely a "miscellaneous army", but he will be energetic and prepare carefully.

c6c64cc62083770a102f0b2d53523c1b9cf72eab.sourceText: Trader Joe’s牛油鸡肉涉菌召回 近日，著名食品公司Trader Joe’s旗下一款冷冻牛油鸡肉产品，被加拿大食品检验局等部门检验出问题而召回，怀疑被李斯特菌污染，美国农业部食品安全及检验局已经介入，向公众发布此项召回批号和产品的出货量。 这次问题产品是Trader Joe’s旗下的一款名为牛油鸡肉与巴斯马蹄米(Trader Joe’s Butter Chicken with Basmati Rice)，12.5安士盒装，出产日期是2012-10-31，很多代码30512，多已发送至代销商手上。 据UPI网站称，Trader Joe’s这款产品主要送往纽约，马萨诸塞州，弗吉尼亚州，新泽西州，宾夕法尼亚州，马里兰州，北卡罗来纳州，康涅狄格州，佛罗里达州，新罕布什尔州，南卡罗来纳州，特拉华州，哥伦比亚特区，缅因州和罗得岛。庆幸的是，Trader Joe’s代销商不包括亚利桑那州。
c6c64cc62083770a102f0b2d53523c1b9cf72eab.translatedText: > Trader Joe’s Butter Chicken Recalled Recently, the famous food company Trader A frozen butter chicken product of Joe’s was recalled due to inspection problems by the Canadian Food Inspection Agency and other departments. It was suspected to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes. The Food Safety and Inspection Service of the United States Department of Agriculture has intervened and released the recall batch number and product shipments to the public. The product in question this time is Trader Joe’s Butter Chicken with Basmati Rice. It comes in a 12.5-ounce box. The production date is 2012-10-31. Many codes are 30512, and many of them have been sent to resellers. According to the UPI website, Trader Joe’s mainly ships to New York, Massachusetts, Virginia, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Maryland, North Carolina, Connecticut, Florida, New Hampshire, South Carolina, Delaware, the District of Columbia, Maine and Rhode Island. Thankfully, Trader Joe’s resellers do not include Arizona.

7e2a2875a3a62b762c2b91f28b7ecd184fcc9a3e.sourceText: 谁有资格申请? 亚利桑那州的KidsCare II为以下人士提供健康保险: 十八岁以下没有保险的人士 家庭年收入在四万美元以内(或者超过一些)的孩童 美国公民或是合格的非公民(父母亲的移民身份不会影响孩子的申请资格， 申请KidsCare II时不需要父母亲的社会安全号码) 什么是KidsCare II? KidsCare II 是亚利桑那州为孩童提供的低廉健康保险， 有了KidsCare II您的孩子能接受完整的医疗照顾，包括: 看医生 牙齿保健 眼部护理 到医院就诊 处方药物
7e2a2875a3a62b762c2b91f28b7ecd184fcc9a3e.translatedText: Who is eligible to apply? KidsCare II in Arizona provides health insurance to the following people: Uninsured people under the age of 18 Children whose annual household income is less than $40,000 (or more) U.S. citizens or qualified non-citizens (the immigration status of parents does not affect the child’s eligibility, and parents’ Social Security numbers are not required to apply for KidsCare II) What is KidsCare II? KidsCare II is Arizona’s low-cost health insurance for children. With KidsCare II Your child receives complete medical care, including: Doctor visits Dental care Eye care Hospital visits Prescription medications

e244c8ecd4141ba4f926fc5a09a7a97dc25bff35.sourceText: KidsCare II的费用是多少? KidsCare II的费用每个月不超过四十元–可能更少–如果只有一个孩子。 不论家里有几个孩子， 每个月月费都不会超过六十元。 我如何知道我的孩子是否符合申请资格? 请致电您当地的社区机构，询问有关免费的协助，帮助您一对一的申请KidsCare II 免费西班牙语和英语协助申请KidsCare II， 请致电 Kids Health Link 1-800-235-9678 Your Health Hotline 1-800-311-0627 华语，请致电亚太社区促进会: 480-452-5771 KidsCare II 现在就可以申请吗? 是的，从现在至二零一三年十二日三十一曰止，人数有限， 为您的孩子获得全面而低廉的医疗保险非常重要,请尽快采取行动。 KidsCare II到期后，我们将协助您的孩子转换至Health Insurance Exchange，在新的健康照顾法律之下运作。
e244c8ecd4141ba4f926fc5a09a7a97dc25bff35.translatedText: How much does KidsCare II cost? KidsCare II costs no more than forty dollars a month – possibly less – if there is only one child. No matter how many children there are in the family, the monthly fee will not exceed 60 yuan. How do I know if my child is eligible? Call your local community agency and ask about free one-on-one assistance applying for KidsCare II. For free Spanish and English assistance applying for KidsCare II, call Kids Health Link 1-800-235-9678 Your Health Hotline 1-800-311-0627 For Chinese, call Asia Pacific Community Advancement: 480-452-5771 KidsCare II Can I apply now? Yes, from now until December 31, 2013, the number of people is limited. It is very important to get comprehensive and low-cost medical insurance for your children. Please act as soon as possible. After KidsCare II expires, we will assist your child in switching to the Health Insurance Exchange, which operates under the new health care laws.

8848075c8065ff9c78913c2f54ab922b20e01be2.sourceText: 潜在起火危险 本田召回62.5万辆轿车 （亚省时报） 本田汽车似乎将成为今年召回车辆最多的汽车制造商。该公司周一宣布，将召回逾62.5万辆雅阁（Accord ）和讴歌（Acura）TL轿车，原因是有潜在的火灾危险。 这次的召回实际上是扩大前次的召回。当时本田召回52,613辆在2007年和2008年售出的讴歌车型。现在又加多了573,147 辆在2003年至2007年配备V-6发动机的雅阁车型。 据美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）资料显示，这些车辆的动力转向软管可能过早变质，导致液 体泄漏。如果液体接触到高温的发动机部份，例如催化转化器，液体可能会引发火灾。 联邦监管机构表示，到目前为止他们已收到一份有关车辆起火的报告，但这事件并没有造成人员受伤。 中型雅阁和讴歌TL拥有许多共同的零件，往往会导致召回涉及多个不同品牌的车。在美国雅阁是排名第二最畅销的轿车，最近本田已推出2013年一个全新的雅阁款式。 本田预计在本月通知车主召回一事，车主不需付维修费。但是由于需要大量的更换零件，可能要到2013年初的某个时候，才能完成所有的维修。要了解更多有关本田召回车辆之事，车主可以打热线800-999-1009或NHTSA888-327-4236询问。
8848075c8065ff9c78913c2f54ab922b20e01be2.translatedText: Potential fire hazard Honda recalls 625,000 cars (Alberta Times) Honda looks set to become the automaker that recalls the most vehicles this year. The company announced on Monday that it would recall more than 625,000 Accord and Acura TL sedans due to potential fire hazards. This recall is actually an expansion of the previous recall. At that time, Honda recalled 52,613 Acura models sold in 2007 and 2008. That now adds 573,147 Accord models equipped with V-6 engines from 2003 through 2007. According to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), the power steering hoses in these vehicles may deteriorate prematurely, causing fluid leaks. If the fluid comes into contact with hot engine parts, such as the catalytic converter, the fluid may cause a fire. Federal regulators say they have received one report of a vehicle fire so far, but no injuries were reported in the incident. The midsize Accord and Acura TL share many parts, often resulting in recalls involving multiple different brands of vehicles. The Accord is the second best-selling sedan in the United States. Recently, Honda has launched a new Accord model for 2013. Honda is expected to notify vehicle owners of the recall this month, and owners will not need to pay repair fees. But due to the large number of replacement parts required, it may not be until sometime in early 2013 that all repairs are completed. To learn more about Honda's vehicle recall, owners can call the hotline at 800-999-1009 or NHTSA at 888-327-4236.

9a83968903f086d25d0240145f04d73f20b9895d.sourceText: AT&T悬赏抓贼 AT&T电话公司提供数千元花红，悬赏捉拿盗窃坦佩手机天线塔铜线的小偷。 公司的发言人杰里富恩特斯说，AT&T在凤凰城地区有超过1000个手机信号塔。今年到目前为止，已经有20多个信号塔受到不同程度破坏，贼人攻击的目标相当明确，拆除电缆中的铜线，直接影响AT&T公司的手机用户。 ”这种作案方法最近比较流行，”坦佩警察局长汤姆瑞夫说。”这些贼人一次又一次盗窃相同的物品，相信是瘾君子所为，卖掉铜线用来换取毒品。” 最近一次发案地点在坦佩的Broadway和 Priest交界。 现在，AT&T公司提供花红，凡抓住偷铜线贼人，或知其下落者，可获5000美元奖励。报案电话： 1-800-807-4205。
9a83968903f086d25d0240145f04d73f20b9895d.translatedText: >AT&T Offers Reward for Caught Thief AT&T Telephone Company is offering reward of thousands of dollars to catch the thief who stole copper wire from Tempe cell phone tower. AT&T has more than 1,000 cell towers in the Phoenix area, company spokesman Jerry Fuentes said. So far this year, more than 20 signal towers have been damaged to varying degrees. The targets of the thieves' attacks are quite clear: removing the copper wires in the cables will directly affect AT&T's mobile phone users. "This method of committing crimes has become more popular recently," said Tempe Police Chief Tom Reiff. "These thieves stole the same items again and again. They are believed to be drug addicts and sold the copper wire in exchange for drugs." The latest crime occurred at the intersection of Broadway and Priest in Tempe. Now, AT&T is offering a bonus of $5,000 to anyone who catches a copper wire thief or knows his whereabouts. Report phone number: 1-800-807-4205.

78b13a9f508a4941257ac3a56363e3e7d8013d85.sourceText: AT&T公司近日推出一项计划，将允许智能收集用户每年都可以进行手机升级。
78b13a9f508a4941257ac3a56363e3e7d8013d85.translatedText: >AT&T recently launched a plan that will allow smart network users to upgrade their mobile phones every year.

76b649032317e8ebe9e6de11b2d649d620502b1e.sourceText: 这项名为AT&T Next的计划将允许智能收集或者平板电脑用户每年都可以无额外费用升级至新款设备。 该计划将允许用户以分期付款的方式购买手机，并在1年之后升级新设备。但如果用户决定继续保留手机，那么就需要继续付8个月的费用。 分期付款费用依据设备不同每月15-50不等，比如16G的iPhone5正价是649.99美元，每月分期付款为32.5美元。 该新计划将从7月26日开始实施。
76b649032317e8ebe9e6de11b2d649d620502b1e.translatedText: The program, called AT&T Next, will allow smart phone or tablet users to upgrade to newer devices every year at no additional cost. The plan will allow users to purchase the phone in installments and upgrade to a new device after one year. But if the user decides to keep the phone, he will need to continue paying for 8 months. The installment fee ranges from RMB 15-50 per month depending on the device. For example, the regular price of the 16G iPhone 5 is US$649.99, and the monthly installment payment is US$32.50. The new plan will be implemented from July 26.

91f29868a2fc619733c5de78a96fa91a5aa89f49.translatedText: General Motors recalls 475,000 Chevy Cruzes. The Chevrolet Cruze sedan produced by General Motors may have an engine misfire problem...

81aff9720b6be8d1e928ccbe2acab4fd77946b1e.sourceText: 通用汽车公司生产的雪佛兰Cruze小轿车可能有引擎失火的问题，通用22日宣布，召回这款曾经帮该公司赢回许多消费者的小型车。
81aff9720b6be8d1e928ccbe2acab4fd77946b1e.translatedText: The Chevrolet Cruze sedan produced by General Motors may have an engine misfire problem. General Motors announced on the 22nd that it is recalling this small car that has helped the company win back many consumers.

1b1fd35954386c705e164221f915db7dc97edaee.sourceText: 这项召回行动将影响2010年9月到2012年5月制造的47万5000辆小轿车。这款车上市以来，这是第五次召回，令消费者质疑这款车的可靠度。
1b1fd35954386c705e164221f915db7dc97edaee.translatedText: This recall will affect 475,000 cars manufactured from September 2010 to May 2012. This is the fifth recall since the car was launched, causing consumers to question the reliability of the car.

c4111a84d1fc0815a3734cf2091ce0d9b751f197.sourceText: 该公司表示，如果液体或机油滴到引擎下的热塑胶护盖，可能引起引擎失火的问题，通常溢出的机油如果没有擦干净，可能造成此问题。
c4111a84d1fc0815a3734cf2091ce0d9b751f197.translatedText: The company stated that if liquid or oil drips onto the thermoplastic cover under the engine, it may cause engine fire problems. Usually spilled engine oil may cause this problem if it is not wiped clean.

014a9332f5de2189146e3eb8d3acd648000421bf.sourceText: 通用汽车将于7月11日起通知车主，到经销商免费修理，修理仅需30分钟。该公司说，手排档的Cruze小轿车如果传动系统磨损，也可能发生此问题，但发生的概率很少。 通用召回的另一批Cruze小轿车是因为有油箱架松脱的问题。有6万1000辆Cruze车因为此问题而需召回。该公司说，已发现249辆Cruze车的油箱架焊接不良，如果汽车碰撞，油箱会松动，可能造成漏油或起火燃烧。经销商将修好有问题的车辆。这个问题是通用汽车在内部安全检查时所发现。Cruze车2010年9月上市，在其他同时上市的新车种中，Cruze召回的次数最多。
014a9332f5de2189146e3eb8d3acd648000421bf.translatedText: General Motors will notify car owners starting from July 11 that they can go to the dealer for free repairs, which will only take 30 minutes. The company says the problem may also occur in manual transmission Cruze sedans if the transmission system wears out, but is less likely to occur. GM is recalling another batch of Cruze sedans because of a loose fuel tank bracket. 61,000 Cruze vehicles are subject to recall due to this problem. The company said it had discovered that 249 Cruze vehicles had poorly welded fuel tank frames, which could cause the tanks to loosen if the cars collide, potentially causing oil leaks or fires. The dealer will repair the defective vehicle. The problem was discovered during GM's internal safety inspection. Cruze was launched in September 2010. Among other new models launched at the same time, Cruze has the most recalls.

e3d8be080114766196a56ed406578989be220eb4.sourceText: 凤凰城 周智毅 老年人与维他命D （作者周智毅是原广州中山医科大学内科学讲师） 在最近出版的《欧洲临床营养》杂志上，发表了美国俄勒冈洲立大学的一篇研究报告。这个研究报告显示，维生素的水平低的老年人比维生素水平高的老年人，其死亡的风险至少上升30%。 更值得注意的是，维生素D水平低又伴有体质虚弱的老年人。其死亡率比正常老年人的死亡率翻了三倍，这个结果是研究人通过对4,300例60岁以上老年人的调查而得到的。 对于这样的一个结果，医学家认识到：对老年人进行维生素D水平的筛查，了解和改善老年人的维生素D水平，对降低老年人的死亡率，延长老年人的寿命，有着非常重要的意义。 调查发现,全世界约有10亿人的维生素D水平处于不足的状态下。维生素D的缺乏和不足已是一个日益严重的全球性问题。美国最新的研究显示，90% 以上的有色人种，以及75%的白人均有维生素D的缺乏。最近，上海的一项调查显示，在上海市民中不论男性还是女性，也不论年龄的高低，普遍存在维生素D的缺乏和不足。他们检测了452名健康成年人的血清25?#32671;维生素D-3的水平，发现88.9%的男性和90.7%的女性，存在维生素D缺乏和不足。也有学者报告，泰国和马来西亚绝经后的妇女，其维生素D不足的发生率为50%。而日本和韩国由于纬度较高，其维生素D不足的发生率更高达90%。 大家已经知道，老年男性及绝经后的中老年妇女，一般都有骨质疏 松症的风险。骨质疏松症的发生除与钙的摄入量有关外，还与体内维生素D的水平有着密切的关系。现在，世界各国的研究已经表明，维生素D的缺乏还与心脑血管疾病，高血压，糖尿病，自身免疫性疾病（如类风湿），多发性硬化以及恶性肿瘤等有着相当的关系。医生对维生素D的研究现在已从骨骼扩展到更广泛的全身机能领域，越来越多的证据表明，足够的维生素D的摄入在慢性疾病的防治方面，可能具有重要的作用，对维生素D的骨骼外效应，已受到人们广泛注意。 人类获取维生素D的来源主要是阳光的照射，其次是从食物中摄取。人的皮肤中有一种称为7-脱氧胆固醇的物质。当它经过紫外线的照射就能转化为维生素D-3。皮肤中的维生素D-3通过血流输送到肝脏进行转化后再运输到肾脏和单核巨 细胞系统，最后成为具有生物活性的维生素D。 人体皮肤合成维生素D的过程主要在阳光强烈的夏季进行，而在冬春季主要是动物体内的维生素D储备。这对于生活在高玮度地区的人群来说更是如此。这也说明，人体内维生素D的水平有着明显的季节波动，秋季水平最高，春季最低。其时，单从理论的角度，成年人每周脸部和手部暴露于阳光下2小时，或婴儿每周只穿尿布暴露阳光下30分钟，就可摄取人体所需要的维生素D。学者认为人体所需要的维他命D 80-90 % 要来自太阳紫外线的照射，而从食物中摄取的维生素D不超过其总需要量的20%。食物中维生素D的来源很有限，常吃含脂肪较高的海鱼，可以提供一定量的维生素D-3。某些酵母发酵的食物以及蘑菇等具有自植物中，也含有少量的维生素D-2。至于在制做过程中加入一定量维生素D的所谓?#24378;化食物?#65292;如牛奶，果汁，面包和植物黄油等也可以提供一定量的维生素D。 对于老年人，由于体力的下降室外活动的减少，消化吸收能力的下降，以及利用日光照射方式合成维生素D能力的逐年下降，常常有维生素D的缺乏。 近年来，随着对维生素D与健康关系研究的不断深入，世界各国的医学家和有关的医学组织，对维生素D缺乏的研究评估、治疗和预防方面都有了新的认识。 现在认为，人体维生素D的正常水平应在30-100ng/ml之间，既然是通过食物摄入维生素D数量非常有限，而适度的阳光照射对于改善维生素D的营养状况就显得非常重要。值得指出的是，通过阳光照射皮肤来合成的维生素D具有自限性，也就不会造成维生素D的过量。学者指出，由于城市空气及微粒的污染，人种肤色（如黑皮肤），人类的着装复盖和气候（如冬季）等原因，人体通过暴露于阳光所摄取的维生素D，就有所减少。从对人群的维生素D的水平来分析，为满足身体对维生素D的需求，特别是对于老人、孕妇及儿童，服用和补充一定量的维生素D就有其必要性了。 美国医学会于2010年提出了新的维生素D的每日摄入量，50-70岁以上的老年人每日推荐的摄入量为600至800IU（国际单位），最大摄入量可达每日4,000IU。当然,维生素D中毒也很少见，其中毒症状包括胃口差，恶心呕吐，便秘，虚弱，眩晕及体重下降等。 学者认为，对于老年人来说，每日补充1,000或2000IU的维生素D是有必要的，一般也不会出现过量和中毒的副作用。同时也可以根据血液检测到维生素D的水平，来调节补充维生素D。
e3d8be080114766196a56ed406578989be220eb4.translatedText: Phoenix Zhou Zhiyi The elderly and vitamin D (The author Zhou Zhiyi is a former lecturer of internal medicine at Guangzhou Sun Yat-sen Medical University) In the recently published "European Clinical Nutrition" magazine, a research report from Oregon State University in the United States was published. This research report shows that elderly people with low vitamin levels have at least a 30% increased risk of death than those with high vitamin levels. What is even more noteworthy is the elderly with low vitamin D levels and frailty. The mortality rate is three times higher than that of normal elderly people. This result was obtained by researchers through a survey of 4,300 elderly people over the age of 60. Regarding such a result, medical scientists realize that screening vitamin D levels in the elderly, understanding and improving their vitamin D levels, is of great significance in reducing the mortality of the elderly and extending their life span. Surveys have found that about 1 billion people around the world have insufficient vitamin D levels. Vitamin D deficiency and insufficiency is an increasingly serious global problem. The latest research in the United States shows that more than 90% of people of color and 75% of white people are vitamin D deficient. Recently, a survey in Shanghai showed that there is widespread vitamin D deficiency and insufficiency among Shanghai residents, regardless of their age, whether they are male or female. They tested the serum 25?#32671; vitamin D-3 levels of 452 healthy adults and found that 88.9% of men and 90.7% of women had vitamin D deficiency and insufficiency. Some scholars have also reported that the incidence of vitamin D deficiency among postmenopausal women in Thailand and Malaysia is 50%. In Japan and South Korea, due to their high latitudes, the incidence of vitamin D deficiency is as high as 90%. Everyone already knows that elderly men and postmenopausal middle-aged and elderly women are generally at risk of osteoporosis. The occurrence of osteoporosis is not only related to calcium intake, but also closely related to the level of vitamin D in the body. Now, research from various countries around the world has shown that vitamin D deficiency is also closely related to cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases, hypertension, diabetes, autoimmune diseases (such as rheumatoid), multiple sclerosis and malignant tumors. Doctors' research on vitamin D has now expanded from bones to a wider range of systemic functions. More and more evidence shows that adequate vitamin D intake may play an important role in the prevention and treatment of chronic diseases. The extraskeletal effects of vitamin D have attracted widespread attention. The main source of vitamin D for humans is sunlight exposure, followed by food intake. There is a substance called 7-deoxycholesterol in human skin. When it is exposed to ultraviolet rays, it can be converted into vitamin D-3. Vitamin D-3 in the skin is transported to the liver through the blood stream for conversion, and then transported to the kidneys and monocyte giant cell system, and finally becomes biologically active vitamin D. The process of synthesizing vitamin D in human skin is mainly carried out in summer when the sun is strong, while in winter and spring it is mainly the vitamin D reserve in animals. This is especially true for people living in high-definition areas. This also shows that the level of vitamin D in the human body has obvious seasonal fluctuations, with the highest level in autumn and the lowest in spring. At that time, from a theoretical point of view, adults could get the vitamin D they needed by exposing their faces and hands to the sun for 2 hours a week, or babies wearing diapers and being exposed to the sun for 30 minutes a week. Scholars believe that 80-90% of the vitamin D needed by the human body comes from ultraviolet rays from the sun, and vitamin D intake from food should not exceed 20% of the total requirement. Sources of vitamin D in food are very limited. Regular consumption of fatty sea fish can provide a certain amount of vitamin D-3. Some yeast-fermented foods and mushrooms, which are derived from plants, also contain small amounts of vitamin D-2. As for the so-called "chemical foods" that add a certain amount of vitamin D during the preparation process, such as milk, juice, bread and vegetable butter, they can also provide a certain amount of vitamin D. For the elderly, vitamin D deficiency often occurs due to the decline in physical strength, the reduction in outdoor activities, the decline in digestion and absorption capabilities, and the year-by-year decline in the ability to synthesize vitamin D through sunlight exposure. In recent years, with the continuous deepening of research on the relationship between vitamin D and health, medical scientists and relevant medical organizations around the world have gained new understandings of the research, evaluation, treatment and prevention of vitamin D deficiency. It is now believed that the normal level of vitamin D in the human body should be between 30-100ng/ml. Since the amount of vitamin D ingested through food is very limited, moderate sunlight exposure is very important for improving the nutritional status of vitamin D. It is worth pointing out that vitamin D synthesized through sunlight exposure to the skin is self-limiting and will not cause an overdose of vitamin D. Scholars point out that due to urban air and particulate pollution, human skin color (such as dark skin), human clothing coverage and climate (such as winter), the vitamin D absorbed by the human body through exposure to sunlight has been reduced. From the analysis of the vitamin D levels of the population, in order to meet the body's demand for vitamin D, especially for the elderly, pregnant women and children, it is necessary to take and supplement a certain amount of vitamin D. The American Medical Association proposed a new daily intake of vitamin D in 2010. The recommended daily intake for seniors over 50-70 years old is 600 to 800IU (international units), and the maximum intake can reach 4,000IU per day. Of course, vitamin D poisoning is also rare, and its symptoms include poor appetite, nausea and vomiting, constipation, weakness, dizziness and weight loss. Scholars believe that for the elderly, daily supplementation of 1,000 or 2,000 IU of vitamin D is necessary, and generally there will be no side effects of overdose and poisoning. At the same time, vitamin D supplementation can also be adjusted based on the level of vitamin D detected in the blood.

9bb8e11256190065ab633f8bbd5ac4b6f56cdb72.sourceText: 据台湾媒体报道，昨日大小S的父亲徐坚进行遗体火化，大S与小S现身殡仪馆，神情平静送父亲走完人生最后一程。大小S的父亲徐坚23日下午因肝癌病逝，享年59岁，虽然徐爸与徐妈离异，但大小S与父亲的感情并没有受到影响，小S与大S结婚时，徐爸仍是重要的座上嘉宾，足以见得徐爸在姐妹俩心中的重要地位。
9bb8e11256190065ab633f8bbd5ac4b6f56cdb72.translatedText: According to Taiwanese media reports, yesterday S's father Xu Jian was cremated. S and S appeared at the funeral parlor, looking calm as they watched their father finish his last journey in life. Little S's father, Xu Jian, died of liver cancer on the afternoon of the 23rd at the age of 59. Although Xu's father and Xu's mother divorced, the relationship between Little S and his father was not affected. When Little S and Big S got married, Xu's father was still an important guest, which shows the important status of Xu's father in the hearts of the two sisters.

4794041020cad8995c84d71d6231e41e47bc6bca.sourceText: 27日，徐爸爸遗体在台北第二殡仪馆火化入殓。除了大小S之外，甚少抛头露面的大姐徐熙娴也与两个妹妹一起戴口罩到场。大小S的夫婿汪小菲与许雅钧更是全程陪同。大小S均素颜现身，虽然戴着口罩，但仍可见二人心情低落，略显憔悴。面对在场的媒体，她们一言不发，显然还未走出丧父之痛。 而在当天早晨，小S还在微博留言，曝出父亲临终嘱托大小S姐妹”要好好照顾奶奶照顾妈妈，要快乐的过每一天”，更呼吁珍惜眼前人，失去至亲的悲痛心情可见一斑。
4794041020cad8995c84d71d6231e41e47bc6bca.translatedText: On the 27th, Xu’s father’s body was cremated and enshrined at Taipei No. 2 Funeral Home. In addition to Big S, the eldest sister Xu Xixian, who rarely appears in public, also attended the event wearing masks with her two younger sisters. Big S's husbands Wang Xiaofei and Xu Yajun were with them throughout the whole process. Both the big and small S appeared without makeup. Although they were wearing masks, they could still be seen in a depressed mood and looked slightly haggard. Facing the media present, they remained silent, obviously not over the pain of losing their father. In the morning of the same day, Little S left a message on Weibo, revealing that her father had told her sisters before his death to "take good care of grandma and mother, and live a happy life every day." He also called for cherishing the people in front of you, which showed the grief of losing a loved one.

125a630adb4661828d6d08c5cca5e7c57b573494.sourceText: 2012年10月24日讯，据台湾《联合报》报道，艺人大小S父亲徐坚罹患肝癌，23日下午约5时30分病逝，大小S随侍在侧。据了解，徐坚过去一直在治疗肝癌，但一个月前情况恶化、住院治疗，徐坚住单人房，大小S十分孝顺，几乎每天都到医院探视，但对于父亲住院一事非常低调。
125a630adb4661828d6d08c5cca5e7c57b573494.translatedText: On October 24, 2012, according to Taiwan's "United Daily News", artist Big S's father, Xu Jian, suffered from liver cancer and passed away at about 5:30 pm on the 23rd. Big S was by his side. It is understood that Xu Jian has been undergoing treatment for liver cancer in the past, but his condition worsened and he was hospitalized a month ago. Xu Jian lives in a single room. His wife is very filial and visits the hospital almost every day, but she keeps a low profile about her father's hospitalization.

7cfc1cf08f1751d5c21a8f42720cf5aded0258e7.sourceText: 近日，大小S姐妹的父亲徐坚生病住院的消息一直牵动着粉丝们的心。小S临时取消大陆活动，大S也从北京急急返回台湾，连一向扮演发言人的S妈都吞吐说：”住院治疗中，希望奇迹可以出现。”徐家人的心情都不免有些沉重。10月20日晚，大S再次发布微博，报告父亲病情，并对大家的祝福和关心表示感谢。大小S爸妈虽然离婚多年，姐妹三人的从小生活起居多由S妈张罗，但大小S姐妹与父亲的感情依旧很深厚。孝顺的女儿们更是每月给父亲一笔大额的生活费，让徐爸爸倍感温暖。近日，一组大小S与父亲的温馨合照在网上曝光。
7cfc1cf08f1751d5c21a8f42720cf5aded0258e7.translatedText: Recently, the news that the father of the big and small S sisters, Xu Jian, is ill and hospitalized has been affecting the hearts of fans. Little S temporarily canceled activities in mainland China, and Big S also rushed back to Taiwan from Beijing. Even S's mother, who always acted as a spokesperson, hesitated and said: "I am in the hospital for treatment. I hope a miracle can happen." The Xu family couldn't help but feel a little heavy. On the evening of October 20, Big S posted on Weibo again to report his father's condition and express his gratitude for everyone's blessings and concern. Although S's parents have been divorced for many years, and S's mother took care of most of the three sisters' daily lives since they were young, the relationship between the sisters and their father is still very deep. The filial daughters even gave their father a large amount of living expenses every month, which made Father Xu feel warmer. Recently, a group of heartwarming photos of S and her father were exposed online.

2e2844ab9b327708c134feb497046156a445f984.sourceText: 「消费者报导」公布今年最有价值的车型，本田(Honda)小车Fit夺冠 （亚省时报） 该杂志这次共分析逾200辆车，以评比何种车型可提供驾驶人最高的价值，最后由可靠、性能佳，价格又实惠的小型省油车，获得最高评价。 纽约邮报报导，该杂志把近200辆车按价值排名，评比项目包括行驶五年的成本、车子可靠度以及耗油量。这项评比也纳入读者的票选。 在家庭房车(Family Sedan)方面，日产(Nissan)Altima(2.5S)被评为最佳；凌志(Lexus)ES350车型则被评为最佳豪华房车；由BMW产制的Mini Cooper则获评选为最佳跑车(手排)；小型多功能车则由丰田RAV 4夺冠；最佳中型多功能车则为丰田Highlander(6缸)；最佳迷你厢型车也落入丰田之手，被Sienna LE(4缸)夺下。 有些车型可能在某方面获得极高评比，却在其他表现远远落后，因此每哩成本成绩最高的车型，也会因道路测试的表现令人失望，而遭淘汰。 结果显示，小型、可靠和省油的车型，获得最高评价，豪华轿车和大型多功能车的得分则普遍偏低。 该杂志指出，售价1万6650元的Fit是物超所值。行驶一哩的成本仅44分钱，因此被列为最可靠和最省油车型之一。对比之下，捷豹(Jaguar)XJL因引擎耗油、可靠度低，价格又高达8万1575元，因此行驶一哩的成本也高达1.58元， 不过，该杂志编辑保罗(Rik Paul)强调：「真正的价值不尽然在于花费的成本，而是获得的价值。」 保罗指出：「​​并非售价较低的车型，即可获得好价值。便宜的车型最后可能让车主花更多钱，或是性能令人失望」。
2e2844ab9b327708c134feb497046156a445f984.translatedText: "Consumer Reports" announced this year's most valuable car model, the Honda (Honda) small car Fit won the championship (Alberta Times) The magazine analyzed more than 200 vehicles this time to evaluate which models can provide the best value to drivers. In the end, small fuel-efficient cars with reliable performance, good performance and affordable prices received the highest evaluation. The New York Post reported that the magazine ranked nearly 200 vehicles by value, including the cost of driving for five years, vehicle reliability and fuel consumption. Readers' votes were also included in this competition. In terms of Family Sedan, the Nissan Altima (2.5S) was rated the best; the Lexus ES350 model was rated the best luxury sedan; the Mini Cooper produced by BMW was rated the best sports car (manual transmission); the small utility vehicle was won by Toyota RAV 4; the best mid-size utility vehicle was the Toyota Highlander (6-cylinder); the best minivan also fell into the hands of Toyota, and was won by the Sienna. LE(4 cylinder) won. Some models may score extremely well in one area but lag far behind in others, so even the models with the highest cost-per-mile scores may be eliminated due to disappointing road test performance. The results showed that small, reliable and fuel-efficient models received the highest ratings, while luxury sedans and large utility vehicles generally received lower scores. The magazine pointed out that the Fit, priced at NT$16,650, is a great value for money. The cost per mile is only 44 cents, making it one of the most reliable and fuel-efficient vehicles. In comparison, the Jaguar XJL has a fuel consumption and low reliability, and the price is as high as 81,575 yuan. Therefore, the cost of driving one mile is also as high as 1.58 yuan. However, the magazine's editor Rik Paul emphasized: "The real value does not necessarily lie in the cost spent, but in the value obtained." Paul pointed out: "It is not the lower-priced models that provide good value. Cheaper models may end up costing car owners more money, or their performance may be disappointing."

5434368a79676a6111cf2aeafaadee2d33c7e9e4.sourceText: 亚省中文戒烟热线（800）838-8917（图） (唯唯报道)8 月3日亚太社区促进会在凤城酒家举办少数族裔戒烟热线开通仪式。促进会的执行总监道格 平野（Doug Hirano）埃尔伯特 郭（Elbert Y. Kuo）医生以艳（Yen Nguyen）项目负责人都到活动的现场为来宾做演讲，这项活动受到亚裔社区的欢迎。 （左至右）道格 平野（Doug Hirano）埃尔伯特 郭（Elbert Y. Kuo）医生以艳（Yen Nguyen） 在亚利桑那很早就有了英文和西班牙文的戒烟热线，如果吸烟者是少数族裔就很难寻找到可以用中文，韩语，越南语的直接帮助。道格说从当天开始，在亚利桑那他们就开通了少数族裔的热线。项目负责人艳表示这个热线会给吸烟者提供戒烟专业辅导，辅导老师会教他们戒烟的方法。同时这个热线也是为吸烟者身边的朋友准备的，吸烟者身边的朋友可以与热线连线，专职辅导老师则会根据他们提供的信息直接跟吸烟者联系，提供相应的健康指导。埃尔伯特医生是肺癌筛查的医生，他亲眼目睹了很多因为吸烟导致疾病的案例，他给大家介绍吸烟的危害，并告诉大家怎样早发现这些因吸烟导致的健康问题。他说即使是肺癌患者，早发现早治疗依然可以保证健康的生活。 到场的来宾在讨论中也很热烈，华裔钱德勒市政委员候选人黄馨民表示，十几年前自己也是个烟民，自己戒烟戒了无数次都没有成功，后来结婚了，太太很快有了宝宝，为了太太和宝宝的健康，终于戒烟成功。他的例子告诉大家找到心爱的人也是戒烟的有效办法。 当然还有很多朋友建议到教会做一些宣传，在那里可以接触到更多的人等等。 你身边有吸烟的朋友吗？那就拨打热线，让我们一起远离烟草！ 中文（800）838-8917 韩语 （800）556-5564 越南话 （800）778-8440
5434368a79676a6111cf2aeafaadee2d33c7e9e4.translatedText: Chinese Quit Hotline (800) 838-8917 (Picture) (Weiwei Report) On August 3, the Asia-Pacific Community Promotion Association held an opening ceremony for the ethnic minority smoking cessation hotline at Fengcheng Restaurant. The executive director of the association, Doug Hirano, Dr. Elbert Y. Kuo, and project leader Yen Nguyen all came to the event to give speeches to the guests. This event was welcomed by the Asian community. (Left to right) Doug Hirano, Elbert Y. Kuo, Dr. Yen Nguyen Arizona has long had smoking cessation hotlines in English and Spanish. If smokers are minorities, it will be difficult to find direct help in Chinese, Korean, and Vietnamese. Doug said that starting from that day, they opened a hotline for minorities in Arizona. Project leader Yan said that this hotline will provide smokers with professional counseling on quitting smoking, and the counselors will teach them how to quit smoking. At the same time, this hotline is also prepared for friends around smokers. Friends around smokers can connect to the hotline, and full-time tutors will directly contact the smokers based on the information they provide to provide corresponding health guidance. Dr. Elbert is a lung cancer screening doctor. He has witnessed many cases of diseases caused by smoking. He introduces the dangers of smoking to everyone and tells everyone how to detect these health problems caused by smoking early. He said that even for lung cancer patients, early detection and early treatment can still ensure a healthy life. The guests present were also very lively in the discussion. Huang Xinmin, a Chinese-American Chandler City Council candidate, said that he was a smoker more than ten years ago and tried to quit smoking countless times without success. Later he got married and his wife soon had a baby. For the health of his wife and baby, he finally quit smoking successfully. His example tells everyone that finding a loved one is also an effective way to quit smoking. Of course, many friends suggested going to the church to do some publicity, where you can reach more people and so on. Do you have any friends who smoke? Then call the hotline and let us stay away from tobacco together! Chinese (800) 838-8917 Korean (800) 556-5564 Vietnamese (800) 778-8440

596bf98e3d4d60ce2c3fa7587dfe5ca8fc9c9b2a.sourceText: 周二下午凤凰城17岁男孩被枪杀身亡 （本网讯）今天下午（3月19日）一个17岁的男孩被他的朋友意外枪杀。 据凤凰城警官报道，时间发生在89 Ave和Buckeye交界处。当警察到达时，一个邻居正在为这个男孩做心肺复苏。 男孩名叫Trent Crump,17岁，和一个15岁的女孩，16岁的男孩在附近偷走了一些武器。15岁的女孩 在清理偷来的物品时，她拿起一只枪。她想她已经清理的武器，他指向17岁男孩的胸口，扣动了扳机。警察说17岁的男孩，受伤后身亡。 15岁女孩被控涉嫌枪杀罪，盗窃罪被扣留。16岁犯罪嫌疑人被控盗窃被扣留。
596bf98e3d4d60ce2c3fa7587dfe5ca8fc9c9b2a.translatedText: A 17-year-old boy was shot and killed in Phoenix on Tuesday afternoon (News from this website) A 17-year-old boy was accidentally shot and killed by his friend this afternoon (March 19). According to Phoenix police reports, the incident occurred at the intersection of 89 Avenue and Buckeye. When police arrived, a neighbor was performing CPR on the boy. The boy, Trent Crump, 17, and a 15-year-old girl, the 16-year-old boy, stole some weapons nearby. The 15-year-old girl was cleaning up stolen items when she picked up a gun. As she thought she had cleared the weapon, he pointed it at the 17-year-old boy's chest and pulled the trigger. Police said the 17-year-old boy died from his injuries. The 15-year-old girl was charged with shooting and theft and was detained. The 16-year-old suspect was charged with theft and detained.

8851d3adbd5e104ae3bf109781795089878e3312.sourceText: 新浪娱乐讯 北京时间8月20日消息，据香港东方日报报道，”’锋芝婚变”风波扰攘超过3个月，终于有突破性发展。据悉，谢霆锋、张柏芝经过通宵16小时的谈判，终于就离婚达成协议，并将进入司法程序。
8851d3adbd5e104ae3bf109781795089878e3312.translatedText: Sina Entertainment News Beijing time on August 20, according to Hong Kong Oriental Daily, the "Fengzhi marriage scandal" has been turbulent for more than three months, and finally there is a breakthrough. It is reported that Nicholas Tse and Cecilia Cheung finally reached an agreement on divorce after 16 hours of overnight negotiations and will enter the judicial process.

5530617333461d5698e1c3d5680238219266656b.sourceText: 媒体来源：新浪娱乐 前天谢霆锋由北京回港，在律师陪同下前往张柏芝入住的阳明山庄，与张柏芝谈判。2人从下午2点开始会面，直到第二天清晨6点，经过通宵16小时谈判后，双方终就2名儿子Lucas、Quintus的抚养权及财产分配等问题达成共识，但为免节外生枝，双方协议封口，倘若任何一方泄露离婚协议内容，将要负上责任。
5530617333461d5698e1c3d5680238219266656b.translatedText: Media source: Sina Entertainment Nicholas Tse returned to Hong Kong from Beijing the day before yesterday. Accompanied by his lawyer, he went to Yangmingshan Villa where Cecilia Cheung was staying to negotiate with Cecilia Cheung. The two met from 2 p.m. to 6 a.m. the next morning. After 16 hours of overnight negotiations, the two parties finally reached a consensus on the custody of their two sons, Lucas and Quintus, and property distribution. However, in order to avoid unnecessary complications, the two parties agreed to keep it secret. If either party leaks the contents of the divorce agreement, they will be held responsible.

df242c665fe95c66ae6172417324c02068287cb7.sourceText: 据知，双方稍后将正式对外公布离婚事宜。谢霆锋昨天下午已飞往浙江温州工作，张柏芝昨晚则亮相时装秀，但大会事前已表明张柏芝不会受访。(苗菲)
df242c665fe95c66ae6172417324c02068287cb7.translatedText: It is known that the two parties will officially announce the divorce later. Nicholas Tse flew to Wenzhou, Zhejiang for work yesterday afternoon, and Cecilia Cheung appeared in a fashion show last night. However, the conference had stated in advance that Cecilia Cheung would not be interviewed. (Miao Fei)

f189312076bcffa07f31ee9da85da6992554bfaf.sourceText: 据联合国人口基金会(UNFPA)估计，世界人口在31日突破70亿人大关，这名第70亿名新生儿31日在菲律宾马尼拉一家医院诞生，来到这个联合国秘书长潘基文所称的「 矛盾世界」。 世上每秒都有两名以上的新生儿呱呱坠地，各机构对全球人口何时突破70亿大关也众说纷纭，不过根据UNFPA的估算，全球人口31日将突破70亿，到2100年时更将突破100 亿。 这位名叫戴妮卡． 梅伊． 卡马丘(Danica May Camacho)的女婴，31日午夜过不久在欢声雷动中于马尼拉一家公立医院诞生，成为全球「第70亿」人口的宝宝之一。 戴妮卡的母亲达露拉(Camille Dalura)将小女婴拥入怀中喃喃地说道：「我无法相信她是全球第70亿人口。」 驻菲律宾的联合国高阶官员也来探访这对夫妻和戴妮卡，并送小饼干给这个小女婴。 全球第60亿宝宝盖瓦拉(Lorrize Mae Guevarra)也见证这个指标性的事件。 盖瓦拉出生于1999年，现已12岁，就读小学六年级。 世界各国都将挑选国内具象征意义的新生儿，并举办各类活动迎接这个里程碑，包括尚比亚将举办歌唱大赛，越南将举行演唱会，俄罗斯将致赠礼物给特定新生儿。 不过潘基文认为，全球人口突破70亿并不值得庆贺，这位第70亿名新生儿可能进入一个「矛盾的世界」，他说：「世上有许多食物，却有10亿人每天饥肠辘辘 ；许多人享受奢华生活，也有许多人落入赤贫困境。」 潘基文说，第70亿名新生儿的诞生，应被视为「发起行动的号角」，全球70亿人都需要足够的食物和能源，拥有良好的就业与教育机会，还必须享有权利和自由 。 根据联合国资料，目前全球14岁以下人口占26.3%、15至64岁占65.9%、65岁占7.9%，每100名女性相对有101.7名男性。 全球人口最多的前三个国家依序为中国(13.7亿)、印度(12.1亿)和美国(3.124亿)，而未来人口成长最多的地区将在开发程度较低的地区，即便未来出生率降低， 全球人口也将以每年8000万人的速度成长。 联合国预测，印度人口将在2050年前达到近15亿人，超越中国、跃居全球人口最多的国家。 专家说，全世界将面临贫穷和环保等重大挑战。 非政府组织「人口至关重要」(Population Matters)主席马丁(Roger Martin)在英国卫报撰文指出，全球人口过剩，环境受害最大。 马丁指出，人口愈来愈多，环境问题最终不可能解决。 马丁指出，人类有足够的食物、水和其他民生必需品，供70亿人口健康生活。 但如今全球七个人就有一人挨饿，原因是全世界生产的粮食有一半浪费掉，不是在田里烂掉，就是在市场和冰箱里腐坏。 专家指出，人口本身不会对地球造成压力，人类的生产和消费才会。 例如有人担心肯亚人口成长快速，问题很大，但肯亚的3000多万人口，并未成为全球的负担，因为肯亚人消费极少资源。 每个美国人的消费是肯亚人32倍，美国有3亿人，是肯亚人口的十倍，因此，美国的消费是肯亚的320倍。
f189312076bcffa07f31ee9da85da6992554bfaf.translatedText: According to estimates by the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA), the world's population exceeded 7 billion on the 31st. The 7 billionth newborn was born in a hospital in Manila, Philippines on the 31st, entering what the United Nations Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon called "a world of contradictions." More than two newborns are born every second in the world. Various organizations have different opinions on when the global population will exceed 7 billion. However, according to UNFPA estimates, the global population will exceed 7 billion on the 31st and will exceed 10 billion by 2100. This person’s name is Danika. May. Danica May Camacho's baby girl was born to great joy shortly after midnight on the 31st at a public hospital in Manila, becoming one of the "seven billionth" babies born to the world's population. Danika's mother, Camille Dalura, held the baby girl in her arms and murmured, "I can't believe she is the 7 billionth person in the world." Senior United Nations officials in the Philippines also came to visit the couple and Danika, and sent cookies to the baby girl. The world's 6 billionth baby, Lorrize Mae Guevarra, also witnessed this landmark event. Gaevara was born in 1999. He is now 12 years old and studying in the sixth grade of primary school. Countries around the world will select their own symbolic newborns and hold various activities to celebrate this milestone, including a singing contest in Zambia, a concert in Vietnam, and gifts to specific newborns in Russia. However, Ban Ki-moon believes that the global population exceeding 7 billion is not worthy of celebration. The 7 billionth newborn may enter a "contradictory world." He said: "There is a lot of food in the world, but 1 billion people are hungry every day; many people enjoy a luxurious life, and many people fall into abject poverty." Ban Ki-moon said that the birth of the 7 billionth newborn should be regarded as a "clarion call for action." The 7 billion people in the world need enough food and energy, have good employment and education opportunities, and must also enjoy rights and freedoms. According to the United Nations, currently 26.3% of the global population is under 14 years old, 65.9% is between 15 and 64 years old, and 7.9% is under 65 years old. For every 100 women, there are 101.7 men. The top three most populous countries in the world are China (1.37 billion), India (1.21 billion) and the United States (312.4 million). The areas with the largest population growth in the future will be in less developed areas. Even if the birth rate decreases in the future, the global population will grow at a rate of 80 million people per year. The United Nations predicts that India's population will reach nearly 1.5 billion by 2050, surpassing China and becoming the most populous country in the world. Experts say the world will face major challenges such as poverty and environmental protection. Roger Martin, chairman of the non-governmental organization Population Matters, wrote an article in the British Guardian stating that global overpopulation has harmed the environment the most. Martin pointed out that as the population grows, environmental problems will ultimately become impossible to solve. Martin pointed out that mankind has enough food, water and other necessities for people's livelihood to support a healthy life for 7 billion people. But today one in seven people in the world is hungry because half of the food produced in the world is wasted, either rotting in the fields or rotting in markets and refrigerators. Experts point out that population itself does not put pressure on the planet, but human production and consumption does. For example, some people worry that Kenya's population is growing rapidly and is a huge problem. However, Kenya's population of more than 30 million has not become a burden to the world because Kenyans consume very few resources. The consumption of each American is 32 times that of Kenyans. There are 300 million people in the United States, which is ten times the population of Kenya. Therefore, the consumption of the United States is 320 times that of Kenya.

f90e6c0e1a910ba02d52e61378522da80c0df7fc.sourceText: 机场安检 75岁旅客将放宽 （亚省时报） 政府将放宽机场对年满75岁旅客的安全检查程序，新规定推出时机恰逢阵亡将士纪念日长周末之前。 年满75岁的长者将不需要在纽约三大国际机场的安检关卡脱鞋、解下腰带或脱去外套。 运输安全局首席发言人卡斯特维特说：”放宽75岁以上旅客安检的规定将逐步施行，旅客会从夏季开始慢慢见到这项新规定落实。”他说，目前没有明确的时间表，不过纽约三大机场预期会在三天长周末推行这项新规定。 美国夏天的旅游季将自阵亡将士纪念日长周末非正式开启。 这项新规定曾在芝加哥、丹佛、奥兰多和波特兰机场试验成功。
f90e6c0e1a910ba02d52e61378522da80c0df7fc.translatedText: Airport security checks will be relaxed for passengers aged 75 (Alberta Times) The government will relax airport security screening procedures for passengers aged 75 and over, and the new rules will be introduced just before the Memorial Day long weekend. Seniors over the age of 75 will no longer be required to take off their shoes, belts or jackets at security checkpoints at New York's three major international airports. "The relaxation of security checks for passengers over 75 years old will be implemented gradually, and passengers will slowly see the implementation of this new rule starting in the summer," said Castleveit, chief spokesman of the Transportation Security Administration. He said there is currently no clear timetable, but New York's three major airports are expected to implement this new rule during the three-day long weekend. The U.S. summer travel season will unofficially kick off over the Memorial Day weekend. The new rule has been successfully tested at Chicago, Denver, Orlando and Portland airports.

5612c162d4a72db1fb9fd28d9bc3bad1beb8591a.sourceText: 据森提尔研究公司的分析，2012年6月全美家庭收入的中位数为50,964美元，比3年前53,508美元下降了4.8%。若与经济衰退前2007年12月的数值相比则减少了7.2%，情况显得更糟。 除了年龄因素，收入的增减幅度与教育程度相关。中等教育程度的人群收入下降幅度最大，教育程度最低及教育程度最高的二个人群，收入减少的幅度最小。
5612c162d4a72db1fb9fd28d9bc3bad1beb8591a.translatedText: According to analysis by Sentier Research, the median household income in the United States was $50,964 in June 2012, a decrease of 4.8% from $53,508 three years ago. If compared with the value in December 2007 before the recession, the situation appears to be even worse. In addition to age factors, the increase or decrease in income is related to education. The income of people with secondary education has the largest decrease, and the income of the two groups with the lowest and highest education has the smallest decrease.

dbcfe607a493e1db44353696fd7dd402db9f02b6.sourceText: 美国总统奥巴马 24 日向国会发表国情咨文，创造就业机会与税务改革为演说重点，国际关系未占特别篇幅，奥巴马全篇演说着眼于创造公平的经济环境及提高美国竞争力。 奥巴马在企业税务改革方面指出，海外工作外包的美国企业将无法获得税务减免，美国公司不应因为工作外包及海外获利，在国内却无须缴交相同的营业税率。所有美国跨国企业都必须缴交基本营业税。政府多出的税款，将支持创造就业机会的税务减免。 另外选择留在美国的制造业者，将获得大幅减税优惠，高科技业如果在美国制造产品，减税优惠将可加倍。奥巴马表示，” 新制度相当简单，将工作由海外内包回美国本土的业者获得奖励，工作外包的企业税务优惠将取消。” 至于极负争议的富人税措施，将依照股神巴菲特提出的定律，年收入超过百万美元的美国首富阶级，无论所得来自何处，税率不得低于 30% ，政府不应继续对富人税务减免或补助。 98% 年收入低于 25 万美元者，包括广大中产及劳动阶层家庭，税率不该提高。 股神巴菲特曾表示，自己缴的税比秘书还要低，美国富人税务负担并不合理。巴菲特的说法成为奥巴马税改的基础。 奥巴马强调，美国不会因别人成功赚大钱感到不安，大部分美国人谈到应缴税款，并不是忌妒有钱人赚得多，而是富人不需要这些税务优惠，国家也无法负担优惠造成的整体税项短缺。 奥巴马说，美国民众将认为这是正确的做法，有钱人过去成功累积财富，来自于前辈们对国家未来与相互扶持的认知，美国生活基础必须建立在相同的意识，国家发展才有未来。 奥巴马同时提及将设立贸易调查与金融犯罪小组，对不公平贸易与华尔街不当行为进行调查，把美国经济导入正轨。
dbcfe607a493e1db44353696fd7dd402db9f02b6.translatedText: U.S. President Obama 24 In his State of the Union address to Congress, Obama focused on job creation and tax reform. International relations did not occupy a special space. Obama's entire speech focused on creating a fair economic environment and improving U.S. competitiveness. In terms of corporate tax reform, Obama pointed out that American companies that outsource work overseas will not be able to obtain tax exemptions. American companies should not have to pay the same business tax rate at home just because they outsource work and make profits overseas. All U.S. multinational corporations must pay basic business taxes. The extra tax dollars from the government will support tax breaks that create jobs. In addition, manufacturers who choose to stay in the United States will receive substantial tax breaks. If high-tech industries manufacture products in the United States, the tax breaks will be doubled. Obama said, "The new system is quite simple. Businesses who outsource jobs from overseas to the United States will be rewarded, and corporate tax incentives for outsourcing jobs will be cancelled." As for the extremely controversial wealth tax measures, it will be based on the law proposed by stock investor Warren Buffett. The richest class in the United States with an annual income of more than one million US dollars, regardless of where the income comes from, the tax rate must not be lower than 30%. The government should not continue to provide tax relief or subsidies to the rich. Tax rates should not be raised for the 98% of people whose annual income is less than $250,000, including the majority of middle-class and working-class families. Stock god Buffett once said that the tax he pays is lower than that of his secretary, and that the tax burden on wealthy Americans is unreasonable. Buffett's remarks became the basis for Obama's tax reform. Obama emphasized that the United States will not be upset when others successfully make a lot of money. When most Americans talk about the taxes they should pay, they are not jealous of the rich people who earn more, but because the rich do not need these tax incentives, and the country cannot afford the overall tax shortage caused by the incentives. Obama said that the American people will think that this is the right thing to do. The successful accumulation of wealth by rich people in the past comes from the understanding of the future of the country and mutual support by the predecessors. The foundation of American life must be based on the same awareness, so that national development can have a future. Obama also mentioned that he would set up a trade investigation and financial crimes team to investigate unfair trade and Wall Street misconduct to put the U.S. economy on the right track.

dd6c88d5c7fbc3b35d25b4d718dea11f9e997fee.sourceText: 去年车祸死亡人数 62年新低 全国公路交通安全管理署(NHTSA)10日公布报告显示，全国去年的交通死亡人数降至1949年以来最低，但骑自行车者和大卡车乘客的死亡人数大幅上升，骑车人增多8.7%，大卡车的乘客猛增20%。 NHTSA报告是分析去年各类交通死亡的结果。全国去年的交通死亡者是3万2367人，比2010年减少1.9%。与此同时，驾车人去年的行驶哩程也减少1.2%。 在去年的车辆行驶哩程中，每行驶1亿哩死亡1.1人，少于2010年的1.11人。 州长公路安全理事会副会长艾金斯认为，骑自行车死亡者之所以增多，可能是因为越来越的民众选择骑车上下班和休闲。 以华盛顿特区为例，全市上午和晚间交通尖峰时刻的自行车骑士，2004年以来增加175%。同一时期，华盛顿市的自行车车道也增多三倍。 艾金斯说：「美国的交通文化开始出现变化，从开汽车转向更健康和更环保的交通方式。我们要满足各种交通方式的安全需要。」 但大卡车乘客死亡人数增多却令人不解，艾金斯说，可能是经济出现好转，导致更多卡车上路行驶的缘故，「仍有许多问题没有找到答案」。NHTSA表示，他们正与联邦汽车运输管理局合作，以便得到更多信息，找出大卡车乘客死亡人数增多的原因。 摩托车的死亡人数去年也出现上升，升幅2.1%。过去14年，摩托车的死亡者持续增多，去年的死亡人数为14年中第13次增加。
dd6c88d5c7fbc3b35d25b4d718dea11f9e997fee.translatedText: The number of fatalities in car accidents last year hit a new low in 62 years. A report released by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) on the 10th showed that the number of traffic fatalities in the country last year dropped to the lowest since 1949, but the number of deaths of cyclists and passengers of large trucks increased significantly. The number of cyclists increased by 8.7%, and the number of passengers of large trucks surged by 20%. The NHTSA report is the result of an analysis of various types of traffic fatalities last year. The number of traffic fatalities nationwide last year was 32,367, a decrease of 1.9% from 2010. At the same time, the miles traveled by drivers also decreased by 1.2% last year. Last year, there were 1.1 deaths per 100 million vehicle miles traveled, down from 1.11 in 2010. Akins, vice president of the Governor's Highway Safety Council, believes that the increase in bicycling deaths may be because more and more people are choosing to ride bicycles for commuting to get off work and for leisure. Taking Washington, D.C., as an example, the number of cyclists during morning and evening rush hours in the city has increased by 175% since 2004. During the same period, the city of Washington also tripled its number of bike lanes. Akins said: "The transportation culture in the United States is beginning to change, from driving cars to healthier and more environmentally friendly modes of transportation. We need to meet the safety needs of all modes of transportation." However, the increase in the number of fatalities among large truck passengers is puzzling. Akins said that it may be because the economy has improved and more trucks are on the road. "There are still many questions that have not been answered." NHTSA said it is working with the Federal Motor Carrier Administration to get more information and find out why the number of passenger deaths in large trucks has increased. Motorcycle fatalities also rose last year, by 2.1%. Deaths from motorcycles have continued to increase over the past 14 years, and last year's death toll increased for the 13th time in 14 years.

55966d476be46524ba4b37922f493a2714c8a2ca.translatedText: > Glendale mall fire engulfs 14 stores A fire broke out in a Glendale mall early Saturday morning. It took more than 60 firefighters an hour to control the fire. 14 shops were damaged to varying degrees. The fire scene was at the intersection of 65 and Glendale Avenue. Witnesses said that the fire was very high and the flames and smoke at the scene were very scary. Firefighters arrived at the scene quickly and did not leave until 4:30 a.m. The fire caused varying degrees of damage to 14 shops. At least three were destroyed and seven others were seriously damaged.

5dbec9bb2fabe8b7ae80726b0f4e292f8b05934e.sourceText: 10样东西不要放包包里 抢案频传，窃案更是不胜枚举，令民众防不慎防。专家表示，许多民众常带些自以为必要，实际上却不需要的东西。这些看似不值钱的东西，被偷时造成的损失常远超出想象。专家建议民众，以下十样物品最好留在家中，不要放在随身包内。 社安卡 一般民众常把社安卡当作备用身分证使用，这是错误作法。由于社安卡上没有照片，便于小偷盗用，像申请信用卡、贷款等，一旦遗失，后果不堪设想。专家建议，社安号应记在脑中，不要带出门。 护照 对出国旅行民众，应把护照留在旅馆，游玩时带复印件即可。专家表示，护照不用随身携带，如在美国内旅行，带驾驶执照就好。 写有密码的纸条 虽然密码设定只有四位数，但对一些比较谨慎或健忘的人，还是会习惯写下放在钱包中。不论写的是提款卡密码或家中警报器号码，对偷到钱包的人来说都是天赐的礼物。专家呼吁民众，千万不要在皮夹内放写有密码的纸条，如怕忘记，应存在加密的手机中。 未加密的手机 时下的智能型手机带给许多人前所未有的便利，像储存重要讯息和上网看账单等。人们过于依赖它，常忽略手机遗失带来的危险。专家表示，虽然设定加密使用较不方便，但多一道防护就多一分保障。 支票本 许多使用支票本的人，不知支票上的银行帐户号码、家里地址、还有残留的签名印，都是给小偷第二次犯罪的好资料。专家表示，平时在钱包留一到两张空白支票就好，除非事先知道需要开多张支票，否则不要带整本支票出门。 过多的信用卡 很多人逛街时喜欢把所有信用卡带在身上，但如果一次失去所有信用卡，意味的不只浪费时间报失，还面临新卡补发前没卡可消费的困境。专家建议，出门时带一、两张卡常用卡就好，家里最好留有信用卡两面复印件，万一被偷，可在最快的时间内取消账户，避免被过度盗刷。 巨额现金 这是大家都有的基本常识，但却不是每个人都有的日常习惯。专家表示，出门带现金以个人可接受损失的标准为原则，免得被偷时后悔不已。 礼物卡 礼物卡和现金一样，对小偷而言，礼物卡最方便，且在使用时没有风险。专家表示，把礼物卡留在家中是必要的，确定要去特定的店消费时再带出门。 珠宝和随身碟 带珠宝出门乍听之下会觉得不可思议，但对参加晚宴的女士来说，忘了把换下来的耳环或手饰拿出来是可能的。随身碟虽然感觉不值钱，但里面可能存有机密文件或写了很久的作业。专家说，每个人都要时时保持皮包被偷的警觉，不论家传珠宝或存有期末考报告的随身碟，记得要放在家里，免得被偷时后悔莫及。 收据 很多人常把收据当作垃圾，或累积在皮夹内不整理，殊不知上面有信用卡信息和签名，是提供小偷们做更多坏事的信息。此外，收据也是记账、退货、报账的重要依据。专家说，养成整理收据的好习惯，把它们留在家里会比放在包包安全，也可避免造成不必要的损失。
5dbec9bb2fabe8b7ae80726b0f4e292f8b05934e.translatedText: > 10 things not to put in bags Frequent robberies and numerous thefts make people careless. Experts say that many people often bring things they think they need but actually don’t need. These seemingly worthless items often cause far more damage when stolen than imagined. Experts suggest that the following ten items are best left at home rather than in your carry-on bag. Social Security Card: Ordinary people often use their Social Security Card as a backup ID card, which is a mistake. Since there is no photo on the Social Security card, it is easy for thieves to use it to apply for credit cards, loans, etc. Once lost, the consequences will be disastrous. Experts recommend that you keep your Social Security number in your mind and never take it out with you. Passports For people traveling abroad, they should leave their passports in the hotel and bring a copy with them when traveling. Experts say that you don’t need to carry your passport with you. If you are traveling within the United States, just bring your driver’s license. A slip of paper with a password written on it. Although the password is only set to four digits, some people who are more cautious or forgetful will still be used to writing it down and putting it in their wallet. Whether it's an ATM card PIN or a home alarm number, it's a godsend to anyone who steals a wallet. Experts urge the public to never put a note with a password on it in their wallet. If they are afraid of forgetting it, they should store it in an encrypted mobile phone. Unencrypted Cell Phones Today's smartphones bring unprecedented convenience to many people, such as storing important information and checking bills online. People rely too much on it and often ignore the dangers of losing their mobile phones. Experts said that although it is more inconvenient to set up encryption and use it, the additional protection will provide more protection. Check Book Many people who use check books do not know that the bank account number, home address, and residual signature stamp on the check are good information for thieves to commit a second crime. Experts say it's best to keep one or two blank checks in your wallet. Unless you know in advance that you need to write multiple checks, don't take the entire check book with you. Too Many Credit Cards Many people like to carry all their credit cards with them when they go shopping. However, if they lose all their credit cards at once, it means not only a waste of time in reporting the loss, but also the dilemma of having no cards to spend before a new card is issued. Experts suggest that you just bring one or two commonly used cards with you when you go out. It is best to keep copies of both sides of your credit card at home. If it is stolen, you can cancel the account as quickly as possible to avoid excessive theft. Huge amounts of cash This is basic common sense that everyone has, but it is not a daily habit that everyone has. Experts say that when carrying cash when going out, it should be based on the standard of personal acceptable loss, so as to avoid regret when it is stolen. Gift Cards Gift cards, like cash, are the most convenient for thieves and can be used without risk. Experts say it's important to keep gift cards at home and only take them out when you're sure you're going to a specific store. Jewelry and Flash Drives It may seem unbelievable at first to go out with jewelry, but for women attending a dinner party, it is possible to forget to take out the earrings or jewelry that you changed. Although the flash drive may seem worthless, it may contain confidential documents or homework that has been written for a long time. Experts say that everyone should always be alert to theft of their wallets. Regardless of family heirloom jewelry or a flash drive with final exam reports, remember to keep it at home to avoid regrets if it is stolen. Receipts Many people often treat receipts as rubbish, or accumulate them in their wallets without sorting them out. Little do they know that they contain credit card information and signatures, which provide information for thieves to do more bad things. In addition, receipts are also an important basis for accounting, returns, and reimbursement. Experts say that developing a good habit of organizing receipts, leaving them at home will be safer than putting them in your bag, and can also avoid unnecessary losses.

1edf54589c88e223f3d974234335468e9c518dd3.sourceText: 研究：84％鱼类汞含量达危险水平 不能多吃 缅因州”生物多样性研究中心”的调查发现，84％的鱼类汞含量超标。这对人类健康造成威胁，超过了某些鱼类每月不可食用超过一次的规定。 吃鱼是得汞中毒的主要途径，金枪鱼和剑鱼含汞量最高。汞能对大脑和肾脏造成永久性地损害。由于汞污染是全球性的，没有任何一个国家可以摆脱这种对粮食供应的污染。 上周在日内瓦的联合国会议上，减少汞污染将是一个讨论议题，预计将完成一条美国支持的条约，以减少鱼类含汞的问题。拟议中的联合国条约要求：过滤燃烧煤排放出来的汞，禁止开采金矿时使用汞，减少在制造电子开关和电池时使用汞。 在美国吃的鱼，75%是进口的，许多都来自中国南海，这就是每天进入到我们的罐头和食物架的汞污染。
1edf54589c88e223f3d974234335468e9c518dd3.translatedText: Research: 84% of fish contain dangerous levels of mercury. Don’t eat more. A survey by Maine’s “Biological Diversity Research Center” found that 84% of fish contain excessive mercury levels. This poses a risk to human health, exceeding regulations that prohibit certain fish species from being eaten more than once a month. Eating fish is the main way to get mercury poisoning, with tuna and swordfish containing the highest levels of mercury. Mercury can cause permanent damage to the brain and kidneys. Because mercury contamination is global, no country can escape this contamination of its food supply. Reducing mercury pollution will be a topic of discussion at a United Nations conference in Geneva last week, where a U.S.-backed treaty to reduce mercury in fish is expected to be finalized. The proposed U.N. treaty calls for: filtering mercury emissions from burning coal, banning its use in gold mining and reducing its use in making electronic switches and batteries. 75% of the fish eaten in the United States is imported, many from the South China Sea, which accounts for the mercury contamination that enters our cans and food shelves every day.

2537c754f98449515f16daf268f5b79033b6e06c.translatedText: After three battles in Huashan, I am still number one. Phoenix Martial Arts Academy has won 45 medals. Phoenix Martial Arts Academy is the 30th "Martial Arts Master" in the academy...

75796015f7dd4831a950fb7c30e85ccd3bd05b75.sourceText: 凤凰武术学院卅位” 武林高手” 在院长符钰晶及何师父率领下，于八月三日参加了一年一度在赌城举办的世界武术大赛。
75796015f7dd4831a950fb7c30e85ccd3bd05b75.translatedText: Phoenix Martial Arts Academy is the 30th "Martial Arts Master" Under the leadership of Dean Fu Yujing and Master He, we participated in the annual World Martial Arts Competition held in the casino on August 3rd.

c3016fa099c7cbe7cd9583232ad679187c32df5e.sourceText: 获奖选手合影 这是凤凰武术学院成立三年，也是第三次参加华山论剑一一赌城世界武术大赛，卅位小选手在衆家长陪伴下，这支大军超过百人分乘大巴及多辆小车于八月二日上午从凤凰武术学院出发，浩浩荡荡奔赴会场。 大战前夕，会埸谍影重重，凤凰何家军团选择最晚时段进埸，在何师父督军下，一丝不苟全军操演，临 埸的震撼预习，让何家军熟悉与适应比赛环境，奠定了隔日的胜机。
c3016fa099c7cbe7cd9583232ad679187c32df5e.translatedText: A group photo of the award-winning contestants. This is the third year since Phoenix Martial Arts Academy was founded, and it is also the third time that Phoenix Martial Arts Academy has participated in the Huashan World Martial Arts Competition. Accompanied by their parents, the thirty young contestants and an army of more than 100 people departed from Phoenix Martial Arts Academy on the morning of August 2nd in buses and multiple cars and rushed to the venue in a mighty manner. On the eve of the war, the venue was full of spies. The Phoenix He Army Corps chose the latest time to enter the venue. Under the supervision of Master He, the entire army conducted meticulous drills. The shocking preview before the battle allowed the He Army to become familiar with and adapt to the competition environment, which laid a chance for victory the next day.

f30c2575d8b66b3382995a65e22aca70cc2b613c.sourceText: 教练合影 今年赛程相当坚困，一开始就与极负盛名的圣地亚哥队全面开战，何家军兵分二路在二个不同级的战场跟对手火拼。 上了战场，小选手看不出有多紧张，但几十位家长的心全挂在脸上，严峻的挤不出一丝笑容，彷佛他们才是正牌的参赛选手。 虽説天下武术源出少林，但狮分南北，拳也有长短。何家军擅打长拳，小将陈志威的长桥大马打得虎虎生风，在四位高手环伺中，杀出重围，拿下首面金牌，何家军士气大振，在大师姊何乐华带头冲阵下，遇强更强过关斩将，打退了强手圣地亚哥队，一举攻下45面奬牌，大获全胜，共计廿二面金牌，十四面银牌，九面铜牌，成绩赢过前二届。
f30c2575d8b66b3382995a65e22aca70cc2b613c.translatedText: Coach's photo This year's schedule is quite difficult. From the very beginning, the team started an all-out battle with the highly prestigious San Diego team. The He family's troops were divided into two teams to compete with their opponents on two battlefields of different levels. On the battlefield, the little contestants couldn't tell how nervous they were, but the dozens of parents' hearts were all on their faces, and they were too serious to squeeze out a smile, as if they were real contestants. Although the world's martial arts originated from Shaolin, lions are divided into north and south, and boxing also has its own length. He Jiajun is good at long boxing. Young general Chen Zhiwei's long bridge horse played vigorously. Surrounded by four masters, he broke out of the siege and won his first gold medal. He Jiajun's morale was greatly boosted. He took the lead in the charge with his senior sister He Lehua. After the battle, he was able to overcome the strong opponents and defeat the strong San Diego team. He won 45 medals in one fell swoop and won a great victory. A total of 22 gold medals, 14 silver medals, and 9 bronze medals were achieved, which was better than the previous two competitions.

b18fd638ca6d0f362bc96f29e3cea3a52432ba39.sourceText: 现场图片 凤凰武术学院三年苦修，终极目标就是打入美国国家奥运代表队。 明年四月在三藩市的武林大会就是国家代表队的甄选比赛，杰出的优秀选手将有机会直接进入国家奥运代表队，何家军衆小将豪气冲天，明年必将跃马中原，挥军北上挑战奥运国家代表队。 凤凰武术学院院长符钰晶表示，三年的尘战，孩子们是在汗水中成长学习经验，每次比赛都録下了战果，不仅纠正自已的缺点，更学习对手的经验，孩子们的付出与努力，做家长看了又感动又心疼，但孩子在学校练过功夫后，最大的收获是培养了团队精神与荣誉，连在家里都脱胎换骨，增进了亲子之情。
b18fd638ca6d0f362bc96f29e3cea3a52432ba39.translatedText: On-site pictures After three years of hard training at Phoenix Martial Arts Academy, the ultimate goal is to make the U.S. National Olympic Team. The martial arts conference in San Francisco next April will be the selection competition for the national team. Outstanding athletes will have the opportunity to directly enter the national Olympic team. The young generals of He Jiajun are so heroic that they will surely gallop across the Central Plains next year and march north to challenge the national Olympic team. Fu Yujing, director of the Phoenix Martial Arts Academy, said that during the three years of fighting, the children grew up and learned through sweat. The results of each competition were recorded. They not only corrected their own shortcomings, but also learned from the experience of their opponents. Parents were touched and distressed by the dedication and efforts of the children. However, after the children practiced kung fu in school, the biggest gain was the cultivation of team spirit and honor. Even at home, they were reborn and the bond between parents and children was enhanced.

7dc63bfbc1b4c81fe33a76576bdea78831ed9172.sourceText: 凤凰武术学院不仅习武，更重要的是练心。符钰晶语气很坚定! 每年新年期间推出的”木兰功夫舞台剧”是凤凰武术学院另一个品牌，演出年年爆满一票难求，可説是金字招牌。 明年元月份”木兰功夫舞台剧”移师凤城市中心的 Orpheum Theater 国家剧院隆重推出，一流的灯光音效设备，近二千座席，不仅方便更满足了全城华人的需求。 一场盛会，预祝凤凰武术学院再创辉煌!
7dc63bfbc1b4c81fe33a76576bdea78831ed9172.translatedText: Phoenix Martial Arts Academy not only practices martial arts, but more importantly, trains the mind. Fu Yujing's tone was very firm! The "Mulan Kung Fu Stage Play" launched every year during the New Year is another brand of Phoenix Martial Arts Academy. The performances are sold out every year and can be said to be a golden signature. In January next year, "Mulan Kung Fu Stage Play" will be moved to the Orpheum Theater in the center of Fengcheng City for grand launch. It has first-class lighting and sound equipment and nearly 2,000 seats. It is not only convenient but also meets the needs of the Chinese people in the city. A grand event, I wish Phoenix Martial Arts Academy to achieve greater glory!

c9891211b99f4adae592456fa9e9cc9edb74f8f9.translatedText: Peanut butter recall expands to 76 varieties (Alberta Times) Trader Joe&#8 involves 18 states, causing 29 people to be infected with salmonella...

95430c976f432b162b072c960188be6d0f817243.sourceText: 涉及18州，导致29人感染沙门氏菌的Trader Joe’s花生酱召回事件扩大，联邦食品及药物管理局和疾病防控中心两部门再次确认该品牌下属产品受污染多达76种。 Trader Joe’s由新墨西哥州的太阳园(Sunland)公司生产，除花生酱外，尚有杏仁酱、腰果酱、芝麻酱和脱皮花生、坚果等产品，全美很多连锁食品店都有销售，本州居民可以在Trader Joe’s, Sprouts, Fresh & Easy, Harry & David and Safeway旗下Open Nature买到上述产品。 这次召回的产品生产日期是5月1日至9月24日。 一名太阳园发言人说，没有证据证明其他产品被污染。 但制造商为了预防同类事件发生，将同一生产线出品的产品全部收回。 6月11日至9月2日，全美有18个州29人被证实感染沙门氏菌，他们有一个共同点，就是食用过该牌子的同一种花生酱。 据资料，马利科巴郡有一名居民近日感染沙门氏菌感染，本州卫生健康部门正试图接触此人，看看是否与花生酱有关。 沙门氏菌感染症状包括腹痛，发烧，腹泻，恶心和呕吐，儿童、老年人和免疫系统受损的人情况可能更严重，甚至有生命危险。
95430c976f432b162b072c960188be6d0f817243.translatedText: Trader involves 18 states, causing 29 people to be infected with salmonella The recall of Joe’s peanut butter has expanded, with the Federal Food and Drug Administration and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention confirming that the brand’s products are contaminated with as many as 76 types of contaminants. Trader Joe’s is produced by Sunland Company in New Mexico. In addition to peanut butter, it also has almond butter, cashew butter, tahini butter, peeled peanuts, nuts and other products. They are sold in many chain food stores across the United States. Residents of this state can buy the above products at Trader Joe’s, Sprouts, Fresh & Easy, Harry & David and Safeway’s Open Nature. The products under this recall were produced between May 1st and September 24th. A Sun Park spokesman said there was no evidence that other products were contaminated. However, in order to prevent similar incidents from happening, the manufacturer recalled all products produced on the same production line. From June 11 to September 2, 29 people in 18 states across the United States were confirmed to be infected with Salmonella. One thing they have in common is that they have eaten the same peanut butter of this brand. According to information, a resident of Maricopa County recently contracted salmonella infection, and the state health department is trying to contact this person to see if it is related to peanut butter. Symptoms of salmonella infection include abdominal pain, fever, diarrhea, nausea and vomiting, and may be more serious or life-threatening in children, the elderly and people with compromised immune systems.

8de713cbbf895ddca53c44db55aefc946d752ae2.translatedText: 45% of the burned area of ​​the Arizona forest fire in the United States has been under control. As of July 3, 45% of the burned area of ​​the Arizona forest fire in the United States has been under control...

c76d34b4d048c07867b111cadd320ce255d8f67a.sourceText: 7月3日当天，大约600名消防队员参与了这场残酷的战役。当时已有13平方英里的森林遭到火噬。政府希望在7月12日前完全控制灾情，以便让附近居民尽快返回住所。
c76d34b4d048c07867b111cadd320ce255d8f67a.translatedText: On July 3, about 600 firefighters participated in this cruel battle. At that time, 13 square miles of forest had been burned. The government hopes to completely control the disaster by July 12 so that nearby residents can return to their homes as soon as possible.

3fc453ffa617438be329d0c5c71db7965075d905.sourceText: 当地消防队上尉Jeff Newnum透露：”局部地区风速高达每小时41英里，火势借着干燥的林木在20分钟内蔓延了4公里。过火地面一片焦黑，而烧焦的松树就像插在上坡上的一根根牙签。”
3fc453ffa617438be329d0c5c71db7965075d905.translatedText: Local fire brigade Captain Jeff Newnum revealed: "The wind speed in some areas was as high as 41 miles per hour, and the fire spread 4 kilometers in 20 minutes through the dry forest. The ground after the fire was scorched black, and the charred pine trees were like toothpicks inserted on the uphill slope."

041b2040e5454c40092c1505ccf2c979bfd7d85f.sourceText: 民宅私养27动物 遭清理并罚款 （亚省时报） 周二上午，亚利桑那州动物保护协会官员从斯格斯代尔一所民宅中清理出 27 只不同种类的动物，房主可能面临动物囤积罚款。 警员在周一晚处理房主和她分居丈夫之间的纠纷时，发现大量动物生活在恶劣的环境下，粪便和尿液满屋都是，气味难闻。 警员通知了消防处，消防处派员评估该家庭的生活条件后，周二上午将这些动物清理出这所房子。 27 只动物大多是小型犬，还包括一些蛇和龟。 警方没有公布房主姓名，但她将面临忽视和虐待动物等指控。
041b2040e5454c40092c1505ccf2c979bfd7d85f.translatedText: 27 animals kept in private house cleared and fined (Alberta Times) Arizona SPCA officers removed 27 animals of different species from a house in Scottsdale on Tuesday morning, and the homeowner may face animal hoarding fines. Officers responding to a dispute between a homeowner and her estranged husband on Monday night discovered a large number of animals living in deplorable conditions, with feces and urine strewn throughout the house and a foul smell. Officers notified the Fire Department, who removed the animals from the house Tuesday morning after dispatching crews to assess the family's living conditions. The 27 animals were mostly small dogs, but also included some snakes and turtles. Police have not released the name of the homeowner, but she faces charges of neglect and animal cruelty.

aa509a968a94b34909aac0f9d724a6ac952065b1.sourceText: 皮马社区学院被讹诈$27万 （亚省时报） 外州骗子利用互联网申请，以皮马社区学院在线学生身份花去近27万美元的联邦助学金。 类似的案件在全国范围内已超过100起。骗子往往利用远程学生身份，不需要在课堂上课的弱点进行诈骗。皮马发言人卡拉马金说，71名假学生都来自密西西比州。所幸发现还算及时，要不损失更大。为此，皮马社区学院已改变联邦助学金的收取程序。 皮马的财政援助助理署长说，往常他们没有深度核实网 上申请者的身份和信息，才让不法分子有机可乘。
aa509a968a94b34909aac0f9d724a6ac952065b1.translatedText: Pima Community College was extorted from $270,000 (Alberta Times) An out-of-state scammer used the Internet to apply and spend nearly $270,000 in federal financial aid as an online student at Pima Community College. There have been more than 100 similar cases nationwide. Scammers often exploit the vulnerability of remote students who do not need to be in class to defraud. Pima spokesman Kalamakin said the 71 fake students were all from Mississippi. Fortunately, it was discovered in time, otherwise the loss would have been greater. To this end, Pima Community College has changed the process for collecting federal financial aid. Pima's assistant director of financial aid said that usually they do not thoroughly verify the identity and information of online applicants, which allows criminals to take advantage.
