527d6caee051bada6f27e5b82ade9393b219d03c.sourceText: 亚省汽油价格连续12周下调 （亚省时报） 上周，AAA亚利桑那州分部发言人说，亚省汽油价格已经连续12周下调。上周四，全州无铅普通汽油的平均价格是每加仑3.46美元，比前一周低7美分。 上周全国油价平均价为每加仑3.36美元，比前一周低10美分。南卡州均价为2.95美元，全美最低，加州油价最高，每加仑3.79美元。在本州，图森油价是全州最低的，均价每加仑为3.38美元，旗杆埠为全州最高，每加仑3.66美元。 AAA说，亚利桑那州的汽油价格最低点在四月。
527d6caee051bada6f27e5b82ade9393b219d03c.translatedText: Gasoline prices in Alberta have been falling for 12 consecutive weeks (Alberta Times) Last week, a spokesperson for the AAA Arizona branch said that gasoline prices in Alberta have been falling for 12 consecutive weeks. The statewide average price for unleaded regular gasoline was $3.46 a gallon Thursday, 7 cents lower than the previous week. The national average gas price last week was $3.36 per gallon, 10 cents lower than the previous week. South Carolina has the lowest average price in the country at $2.95, while California has the highest price at $3.79 per gallon. In the state, Tucson has the lowest gas prices in the state, with an average price of $3.38 per gallon, and Flagstaff has the highest price in the state, with an average price of $3.66 per gallon. AAA says gas prices in Arizona were at their lowest in April.

e8b3be6765220a7c7f6b9c3bcf3df3021ed97d6e.translatedText: Approved to defer immigration, 17 states have issued driver's licenses Currently, only three states in the country issue driver's licenses to illegal immigrants, after the Obama administration began to implement the policy of deferred deportation of young illegal immigrants...

1e4ae5c2ee616130bd1c11b066cace3c9057dc21.sourceText: 获准缓遣移民 17州决发驾照 全国目前仅三个州给非法移民发驾照，在欧巴马政府开始实施暂缓遣返年轻非法移民政策后，又有17个州决定给符合条件的年轻非法移民发驾照。但部分非法移民问题严重的州，仍拒绝他们申请驾照。 丕优中心所属的stateline.org说，各州近年来很少讨论给非法移民发驾照问题，都在等候联邦政府采取行动。但随着明年1月15日执行联邦政府真身分证法(Real ID)期限的逼近，非法移民驾照的问题重新浮上台面。 将允许符合联邦暂缓遣返条件的非法移民申请驾照的州，包括加州、康州、德拉瓦、佛罗里达、乔治亚、伊利诺、印第安纳、麻州、马里兰、内华达、新墨西哥、田纳西、德州、犹他、维吉尼亚、华盛顿和威斯康星州。 但亚利桑那、阿肯色、堪萨斯、密西根、密西西比和内布拉斯加六个州宣布，将拒绝获准免遣的非法移民申请驾照。 联邦政府迄今同意暂缓遣返5万3000名年轻非法移民。移民政策研究估计，全国有176万人符合缓遣条件。 全国移民研究中心的律师贾尼丝柯帕特认为，暂缓遣返非法移民和发给他们驾照，是破坏真身分证法，因为真身分证法的宗旨是从严管理驾照。她说，非法移民需在联邦移民数据库登记，没在数据库核查移民身分的各州，就是不遵守真身分证法，可能涉嫌身分诈骗。 联邦政府迄今并未说明暂缓遣返年轻非法移民的政策，是否意味着授权各州给他们发放驾照，也没说明真身分证法是否禁止给非法移民发驾照。 布鲁尔州长宣布，亚利桑那州不允许免遭遣返获在美工作许可者申请驾照。本州岛法律规定，申请驾照的人必须出示在美居住的有效证明。
1e4ae5c2ee616130bd1c11b066cace3c9057dc21.translatedText: Approved to defer immigration, 17 states have issued driver's licenses Currently, only three states in the country issue driver's licenses to illegal immigrants. After the Obama administration began to implement the policy of suspending the deportation of young illegal immigrants, 17 more states decided to issue driver's licenses to qualified young illegal immigrants. However, some states with serious illegal immigration problems still refuse them to apply for driver's licenses. Stateline.org, which belongs to the Piyou Center, said that states have rarely discussed the issue of issuing driver's licenses to illegal immigrants in recent years, and they are all waiting for the federal government to take action. But as the January 15 next year deadline for implementing the federal government’s Real ID law approaches, the issue of illegal immigrant driver’s licenses has resurfaced. States that will allow illegal immigrants who qualify for the federal moratorium on deportation to apply for driver's licenses include California, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Massachusetts, Maryland, Nevada, New Mexico, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington and Wisconsin. However, six states - Arizona, Arkansas, Kansas, Michigan, Mississippi and Nebraska - announced that they would deny driver's license applications to illegal immigrants who have been exempted from deportation. The federal government has so far agreed to suspend the deportation of 53,000 young illegal immigrants. Immigration Policy Research estimates that 1.76 million people across the country are eligible for deferred action. Janice Kopat, an attorney at the National Center for Immigration Studies, believes that suspending deportations and issuing driver's licenses to illegal immigrants undermines the REAL ID law, which is designed to strictly regulate driver's licenses. She said that illegal immigrants need to register in the federal immigration database, and states that do not verify their immigration status in the database are not complying with the REAL ID law and may be involved in identity fraud. The federal government has so far not clarified whether the moratorium on deportation for young illegal immigrants will authorize states to issue them driver's licenses, nor whether the REAL ID law prohibits issuing driver's licenses to illegal immigrants. Governor Brewer announced that Arizona will not allow people who are exempt from deportation to work in the United States to apply for driver's licenses. According to the laws of this state island, people applying for a driver's license must present valid proof of residence in the United States.

918f9e327d8f70e8c53f6b66ab1cac72117ab959.sourceText: 美国科技网站CNET报导，这台Apple 1是1976年，苹果共同创办人佛尼亚克（Steve Wozniak）在贾伯斯（Steve Jobs）父母家的车库内组装。电脑和原版使用者手册，及贾伯斯给原买家哈特斐德（Fred Hatfield）的签名函件一起拍卖。
918f9e327d8f70e8c53f6b66ab1cac72117ab959.translatedText: The American technology website CNET reported that this Apple 1 was sold in 1976 by Apple co-founder Steve Wozniak at Steve Jobs Jobs) assembled it in his parents' garage. The computer was auctioned along with the original user manual and a signed letter from Jobs to the original buyer, Fred Hatfield.

3c6bbeba52d02cd21fe40d583ab037ac4fcca390.sourceText: 德国拍卖公司Breker去年12月也拍卖1台Apple 1电脑，当时成交价为64万美元，远高于苏富比（Sotheby’s）去年6月纽约拍卖会的落槌价37万4500美元。
3c6bbeba52d02cd21fe40d583ab037ac4fcca390.translatedText: German auction company Breker also auctioned an Apple 1 computer in December last year. The price at that time was US$640,000, which was much higher than the hammer price of US$374,500 at Sotheby’s New York auction in June last year.

43a175133a38398add4cee5b28ee901c69425507.sourceText: 根据「纽约时报」Bits部落格，拍卖商布瑞克（Uwe Breker）说：”这是美国梦的终极象徵。” ”加州2名大学中辍生追求1个构想和梦想，这个梦想最后变成全球最受景仰、最成功且最有价值的企业。”
43a175133a38398add4cee5b28ee901c69425507.translatedText: According to the "New York Times" Bits blog, auctioneer Uwe Breker said: "This is the ultimate symbol of the American dream." "Two college dropouts in California pursued an idea and a dream that eventually turned into the most admired, successful and valuable company in the world."

6f949145037244377e470f058a598437b987c612.translatedText: Skynet Huihui, Liang Shangjun was finally arrested after 17 years. The Maricopa County Sheriff's Office and Maricopa County Attorney Bill held a press conference on May 27 to announce...

6589c705da5f202987b28326fd3712d1ce166414.sourceText: 天网恢恢 梁上君子17年后终被捕 马利科巴郡警长办公室和马利科巴郡检察长比尔5月27日召开记者招待会，公布惯偷罗伯特詹姆斯尼西落案的消息。 58岁的尼西，被认为在斯克斯代尔、天堂谷等地区偷窃作案超过400次，历时17年之久，涉及10万美元的珠宝和现金。他通往客厅或卧室的窗口扔一块大石头，好以进入屋内作案，因此被称为”石头窃贼”。 过去三年来，马利科巴郡警方将”石头窃贼”作案地区锁定在天堂谷一带，涉及60次爆窃案，终于在上周五将他一举擒获。
6589c705da5f202987b28326fd3712d1ce166414.translatedText: Skynet Huihui, Liang Shangjun was finally arrested after 17 years. The Maricopa County Sheriff's Office and Maricopa County Attorney Bill held a press conference on May 27 to announce the arrest of habitual thief Robert James Nessie. Nissi, 58, is believed to have committed more than 400 thefts in areas such as Sksdale and Paradise Valley over a period of 17 years, involving $100,000 in jewelry and cash. He threw a large stone through the window leading to the living room or bedroom so that he could enter the house and commit crimes, so he was called the "stone thief." In the past three years, Maricopa County police have targeted the "Stone Thief" in the Paradise Valley area, involving 60 burglaries, and finally captured him last Friday.

6f9d2ea4494f318361b6cb242a03ece3e1c51c2d.translatedText: A rich man in Fujian opened a store and gave away 350,000 steamed buns a year without revealing his identity (picture) Last year, a mysterious rich boss opened a steamed bun shop in Shishi City, Fujian Province...

e68c1f560c98b632c9f8e420ae0d47ba7acb1936.sourceText: 去年，有位神秘的富豪老板，在福建省石狮市开了一家馒头店，并且打出醒目的招牌：”本店所有馒头免费送给各种贫困人群，不对外售卖，请谅解。如果您是生活困难的下岗职工、收入低微的贫寒家庭、正在为找工作奔波的毕业生、无助老人、流浪者、拾荒者，欢迎您来免费食用。”本周，多家媒体聚焦这家爱心馒头店，却依然未能揭开老板的神秘面纱。
e68c1f560c98b632c9f8e420ae0d47ba7acb1936.translatedText: Last year, a mysterious rich boss opened a steamed bun shop in Shishi City, Fujian Province, and put up an eye-catching sign: "All the steamed buns in our store are given to various poor people for free. It is not for sale to the public, please understand. If you are a laid-off worker with a difficult life, a poor family with a low income, a graduate looking for a job, a helpless elderly person, a homeless person, or a scavenger, you are welcome to eat for free." This week, many media focused on this caring steamed bun shop, but still failed to reveal the mystery of the owner.

beec96c79a52f3b331f349a4328ba92fb106c8c4.sourceText: 这家去年8月开张的爱心馒头店，只有两位员工，每天要免费送出1000余个馒头，除去春节期间停业的10来天外，过去一年差不多送出去了35万个馒头，花销达40万元。馒头店的工作人员说，做馒头的设备和原料都是高档货，费用及店租成本全由一位不愿透露姓名、至今还隐在幕后的老板承担。从开业至今，各路记者都在寻觅这位神秘富豪的踪迹，可至今都没有人知道他姓甚名谁。 m
beec96c79a52f3b331f349a4328ba92fb106c8c4.translatedText: This love steamed bun shop, which opened in August last year, has only two employees and delivers more than 1,000 steamed buns for free every day. Except for the 10 days it was closed during the Spring Festival, it gave away almost 350,000 steamed buns in the past year, spending 400,000 yuan. The staff of the steamed bun shop said that the equipment and raw materials for making steamed buns are all high-end goods, and the expenses and store rental costs are all borne by an owner who wishes to remain anonymous and is still hidden behind the scenes. From the opening to the present, reporters from all walks of life have been looking for traces of this mysterious rich man, but no one knows his name so far. m

6d3008c15d90a88db8e91427d30566f94e1a169e.sourceText: 虽然偶尔有人冒充穷人前来贪小便宜，但爱心馒头店已经基本有了相对稳定的资助对象，两位店员在一年中结交了两百来个身份各异的”穷亲戚”，给他们艰苦的生活带去了些许的温暖。令人感到欣慰的是，免费馒头的故事被媒体报道之后，有人写信表示感谢，有人从远处赶来”捧场”，也有人要捐款赞助，还有人想来这里做义工。但由于老板事先有交代，他们暂时没有接受外界的帮助，就连收到的感谢信也都藏在柜中不打算示人。
6d3008c15d90a88db8e91427d30566f94e1a169e.translatedText: Although occasionally there are people pretending to be poor to come and take advantage of small things, the Love Steamed Bun Shop has basically had relatively stable funding targets. The two shop assistants have made friends with more than 200 "poor relatives" of different identities in one year, bringing some warmth to their difficult lives. What is gratifying is that after the story of free steamed buns was reported by the media, some people wrote letters to express their gratitude, some came from afar to "support", some wanted to donate money, and some wanted to come here to volunteer. However, due to the boss's prior explanation, they have not accepted help from outside for the time being, and even the thank-you letters they received have been hidden in the cabinet and not intended to be shown to anyone.

75172df8fb1f36128089e6377b9b0fcf003c83bf.sourceText: 然而，时至今日，仍有一些人对免费馒头店持怀疑态度，认为免费赠送馒头是炒作或作秀，甚至摆出一副等着看它倒闭的姿态。其实，这些质疑者不明白的是，并不是所有的慈善人士都想成为高调的”陈光标”，有一种善举叫沉默的善举，当事人并不想被过度关注，只想力所能及地做事，求的是心灵慰藉。尽管有争议，馒头店的老板却依然没有现身回应的打算，他唯一准备做的，是再开一家分店，让更多的弱势群体能够吃上免费的馒头。
75172df8fb1f36128089e6377b9b0fcf003c83bf.translatedText: However, to this day, there are still some people who are skeptical about free steamed bun shops, thinking that giving away free steamed buns is hype or a show, and even pretend to wait to see it go bankrupt. In fact, what these doubters don't understand is that not all philanthropists want to be high-profile "Chen Guangbiao". There is a kind of charity called silent charity. The person involved does not want to be overly noticed, but just wants to do what he can, and seeks spiritual comfort. Despite the controversy, the owner of the steamed bun shop still has no plans to show up to respond. The only thing he plans to do is to open another branch so that more disadvantaged groups can eat free steamed buns.

f09dbf056a6e2e595cce566f3f1d375e6ae6a491.sourceText: 第16届哈佛中国论坛闭幕：中国创业热 海归机遇多 4 月14日，第16届哈佛中国论坛落下帷幕。在为期三天的论坛上，关于企业、文化、媒体等热门话题无不围绕中国的迅速发展所带来的种种机会。 过去一年，中美两国领导人的换届让两国关系进入新的发展时期。在闭幕致辞上，真格基金创始人徐小平说，中国是创业的热土，他也总结了各种创业的方式，鼓励创业。 哈佛大学费正清研究中心主任柯伟林在闭幕致辞中表示，中国在经济、军事、教育等方面发展很快，有世界主导地位的趋势，这样的论坛正为中美精英人才提供了互相了解的平台。 不少与会者表示从论坛中受到了很大启发，对自己的事业发展方向更加明晰。
f09dbf056a6e2e595cce566f3f1d375e6ae6a491.translatedText: The 16th Harvard China Forum Concludes: China’s Entrepreneurship Fever and Many Opportunities for Returnees On April 14, the 16th Harvard China Forum came to an end. During the three-day forum, hot topics such as business, culture, and media all centered around the opportunities brought about by China's rapid development. In the past year, the changes in leadership between China and the United States have brought relations between the two countries into a new period of development. In the closing speech, Xu Xiaoping, founder of ZhenFund, said that China is a hot spot for entrepreneurship. He also summarized various ways to start a business and encouraged entrepreneurship. Ke Weilin, director of the Fairbank Center at Harvard University, said in his closing speech that China is developing rapidly in economy, military, education and other aspects, and has a tendency to dominate the world. Forums like this provide a platform for Chinese and American elites to understand each other. Many participants said they were greatly inspired by the forum and became clearer about their career development direction.

7e5372200210ac439fa831d83bef2f0ced2aff3c.translatedText: A paradise for crime? Murders in Alberta increased by 16% year-on-year. The latest statistics from the FBI show that there are signs of decrease in murders across the United States, but murders in Arizona...

08f5942c045cf20a28beb925e7579cdbd8975bcc.sourceText: 犯罪天堂？ 亚省谋杀案同比增长16% 联邦调查局最新统计数字显示，全美谋杀案有减少迹象，但亚利桑那州谋杀案与去年同期相比增加了16%。 周一发布的犯罪报告显示，2010年，本州共有409宗谋杀和非过失误杀，相比2009年的354，增加了15.5%。 本州的城市，谋杀案明显上升的有图森市，2009年有35宗，2010年有51宗，增加46%。 全国范围内，根据FBI的报告，谋杀和非疏忽误杀，去年下跌了4.2%，整体暴力罪案下降6%，连续第四年同比下降。 财产罪案在全国范围内也下降了2.7%。 在本州，暴力犯罪整体下跌3.1%，财产犯罪下降3.7%。
08f5942c045cf20a28beb925e7579cdbd8975bcc.translatedText: A crime paradise? Murders in Alberta increased by 16% year-on-year. The latest FBI statistics show that murders across the United States are showing signs of decreasing, but murders in Arizona increased by 16% compared with the same period last year. A crime report released Monday showed there were 409 murders and non-negligent manslaughters in the state in 2010, up from 354 in 2009, an increase of 15.5 percent. Among the cities in the state, Tucson saw a significant increase in murders, with 35 cases in 2009 and 51 cases in 2010, an increase of 46%. Nationwide, according to the FBI report, murder and non-negligent manslaughter fell 4.2% last year, and overall violent crime fell 6%, marking the fourth consecutive year-over-year decline. Property crime also fell by 2.7% nationally. In the state, violent crime fell 3.1% overall and property crime dropped 3.7%.

cdf84a3a721ea84d955a297788de565e39e5072b.sourceText: 编者按：美国有四分之三(76%)的华裔成年人不是在美国出生，而七成(69%)华裔成年人已是美国公民。”丕优研究中心”19日根据人口局资料公布的”亚裔兴起”报告并显示，华裔成年人有一半以上(52%)英语流利，低于一般亚裔。一般亚裔美国人英语流利者占总数63%。 成年华裔的平均年龄为43岁，略高于成年亚裔的41岁，但是比全国年龄中位数45岁为低。婚姻状况方面，有59%的成年华裔已婚。而成年美国人则有51%已婚。教育程度方面，25岁及以上华裔，超过一半(51%)已取得学士学位，远高于全国的28%，但是不及印度裔。 报告显示，印度裔的收入及学历都是最高的，25岁以上的印度裔人士有七成具有学士学位。而华韩日菲裔则只有约半数大学毕业。 收入方面，华裔个人年收入是50000元，比一般亚裔人均年收入48000元和美国人总体平均收入40000元都高。而家庭收入来说，华裔家庭的年收入中位数65050元，略低于亚裔平均的66000元，但比美国家庭中位数的49800元高。 房产方面，62%华裔拥有住宅。一般亚裔则有58%拥有自宅。而拥有自宅的美国人有65%。 将近一半的成年华裔(49%)住在西部。而住在西部的美国亚裔占47%。西部的美国人口占全国总数只有23%。14%成年的华裔处于贫困状态，略高于亚裔的12%，和全国的13%。 1860年加州的人口普查，首度列出”华人”类。其它州则于十年后跟进。受”排华法”影响，当年的华人，大多数是打算工作几年后，就回中国的年轻单身男性。
cdf84a3a721ea84d955a297788de565e39e5072b.translatedText: Editor's note: Three-quarters (76%) of Chinese-American adults in the United States were not born in the United States, and 70% (69%) of Chinese-American adults are already American citizens. The "Rise of Asians" report released by the "Piyou Research Center" on the 19th based on data from the Population Bureau showed that more than half (52%) of Chinese adults are fluent in English, which is lower than the average Asian. Generally, 63% of Asian Americans are fluent in English. The average age of Chinese adults is 43, slightly higher than the 41 years of Asian adults, but lower than the national median age of 45. In terms of marital status, 59% of Chinese adults are married. And 51% of adult Americans are married. In terms of educational attainment, more than half (51%) of Chinese Americans aged 25 and above have obtained a bachelor's degree, which is much higher than the national figure of 28%, but not as good as that of Indians. The report shows that Indians have the highest income and education, with 70% of Indians over 25 having a bachelor's degree. Only about half of Chinese, Korean, Japanese and Filipino Americans have graduated from college. In terms of income, the annual income of Chinese Americans is 50,000 yuan, which is higher than the average annual income of Asians of 48,000 yuan and the overall average income of Americans of 40,000 yuan. In terms of family income, the median annual income of Chinese-American families is 65,050 yuan, which is slightly lower than the average Asian family income of 66,000 yuan, but higher than the median income of American families of 49,800 yuan. In terms of real estate, 62% of Chinese Americans own residences. In general, 58% of Asians own their own homes. And 65% of Americans own their own homes. Nearly half of Chinese adults (49%) live in the West. Asian Americans living in the West account for 47%. The American population in the West accounts for only 23% of the country's total. 14% of Chinese adults are in poverty, slightly higher than the 12% of Asians and 13% of the country. The 1860 California census listed the "Chinese" category for the first time. Other states followed a decade later. Affected by the Chinese Exclusion Act, most of the Chinese at that time were young single men who planned to return to China after working for a few years.

0ec3511657406a42ab24e08c9220282edeaa3255.sourceText: 4月25日，火灾现场一片狼藉。当日1时13分，北京市119指挥中心接群众报警，大兴区旧宫镇小街一四层楼房发生火灾。经初步核实，事故造成17人死亡，24人受伤，30余人被安全疏散救出。 新华社记者 罗晓光 摄
0ec3511657406a42ab24e08c9220282edeaa3255.translatedText: April 25, the fire scene was in a mess. At 1:13 that day, the Beijing 119 command center received a call from the masses that a fire broke out in a four-story building on a small street in Jiugong Town, Daxing District. After preliminary verification, the accident resulted in 17 deaths and 24 injuries. More than 30 people were safely evacuated and rescued. Photo by Xinhua News Agency reporter Luo Xiaoguang

7f23cc4ae6324001fb1a36ffb330c0afd78cb5c8.sourceText: 新华网北京４月２５日电（记者黄海、程义峰、卢国强）记者从北京大兴区火灾事故处理指挥部了解到，旧宫镇火灾事故伤者增至２５人，其中男１７人、女８人，包括２名儿童。据指挥部从医院获得的最新信息，有部分伤员仍存在生命危险。
7f23cc4ae6324001fb1a36ffb330c0afd78cb5c8.translatedText: Xinhuanet, Beijing, April 25 (Reporters Huang Hai, Cheng Yifeng, Lu Guoqiang) The reporter learned from the Beijing Daxing District Fire Accident Management Headquarters that the number of injured in the Jiugong Town fire accident increased to 25, including 17 men and 8 women, including 2 children. According to the latest information obtained by the command from the hospital, some of the injured are still in danger of life.

4f1a63504b68ad901cafdd4a6da25f3e73fc3025.sourceText: 据了解，增加的１名３９岁男性伤者是２５日１１点多自行到医院求诊的，其子也因伤在医院救治。
4f1a63504b68ad901cafdd4a6da25f3e73fc3025.translatedText: It is understood that the additional injured person, a 39-year-old male, went to the hospital on his own at around 11 o'clock on the 25th. His son was also treated in the hospital for injuries.

9352818185f9327a223c712d5dbc40164f3bb45b.sourceText: 据介绍，除１名女孩在儿童医院救治，其他伤者目前均在积水潭医院救治。
9352818185f9327a223c712d5dbc40164f3bb45b.translatedText: According to reports, except for one girl who is being treated at the Children's Hospital, the other injured are currently being treated at Jishuitan Hospital.

0808f992fcecaf5d4c6fc36c5199aaaba71d2884.sourceText: 据大兴区相关负责人介绍，目前２５名伤者中仍有１人没有确认身份，此人气管已被切开；１７名死者目前仍有４人不能确认身份。
0808f992fcecaf5d4c6fc36c5199aaaba71d2884.translatedText: According to the relevant person in charge of Daxing District, one of the 25 injured is still unidentified, and his trachea has been cut open; 4 of the 17 deceased are still unidentified.

b273d98cddcda7c8ad9c0e02d9eacc4ca106b5f7.translatedText: Uranium mining ban in Grand Canyon area extended for 20 years (Alberta Times) The federal government announced on the 9th that in order to protect important natural wonders and scenic spots and "national treasures", the government...

a485ee609e92417c179ce3977752ccfa9a7dcf94.sourceText: 联邦政府9日宣布，为了维护重要的天然奇景观光区和「国家宝藏」，政府决定禁止在大峡谷周围100馀万英亩地区开採铀矿，为期20年。 内政部长萨拉查在华府一项活动上做此宣布。此一决定显示联邦政府没有理会来自共和党国会议员及开矿业者的压力。批评人士辩称，这个地区蕴藏大量高级铀矿，应予以开放开採。 萨拉查说，欧巴马政府已两度执行暂时禁止开採令。他说，铀矿仍是美国广泛能源策略的重要部分，但大峡谷是美国的国家宝藏，必须加以保护。 位于亚利桑那州东北部的广阔峡谷区，每年吸引来自美国各地和全球的观光客400馀万人，带来价值约35亿元的经济活动。凤凰城、洛杉矶等大城市数以百万计的居民，依赖科罗拉多河的乾淨饮水。 萨拉查强调：「为了保护美国这片无价的天然奇景，禁止採矿是正确的做法。人民委託我们照顾和维护美国宝贵的环境和文化资源，我们选择负责任的做法，以维护后世子孙的利益。」 丕优环保团体(Pew Environment Group)发言人珍‧丹诺维兹说，这项宣布表示，美国民众今天可以庆祝大峡谷受到妥善保护，后世子孙仍有福观赏此一自然瑰宝。 採矿业者团体则反对这个决定，宣称这是「大政府」伤害消费者的行动。
a485ee609e92417c179ce3977752ccfa9a7dcf94.translatedText: The federal government announced on the 9th that in order to protect important natural wonders and scenic spots and "national treasures", the government decided to ban uranium mining in more than 1 million acres around the Grand Canyon for 20 years. Interior Secretary Salazar made the announcement at an event in Washington. The decision shows the federal government is ignoring pressure from Republican members of Congress and mining companies. Critics argue that the area contains large amounts of high-grade uranium ore and should be opened to mining. Salazar said the Obama administration has implemented temporary mining bans twice. He said uranium mining remains an important part of the United States' broad energy strategy, but the Grand Canyon is a national treasure of the United States and must be protected. The vast canyon area located in northeastern Arizona attracts more than 4 million tourists from all over the United States and the world every year, bringing economic activity worth approximately $3.5 billion. Millions of residents in major cities such as Phoenix and Los Angeles rely on clean drinking water from the Colorado River. Salazar emphasized: "In order to protect this priceless natural wonder in the United States, banning mining is the right thing to do. The people entrust us to care for and maintain America's precious environmental and cultural resources, and we choose to act responsibly to protect the interests of future generations." Jane Danowitz, spokesperson for the Pew Environment Group, said that this announcement means that the American people can celebrate today that the Grand Canyon is properly protected, and future generations will still be able to enjoy this natural treasure. Mining industry groups opposed the decision, calling it a "big government" move to hurt consumers.

791f19d6342cf4a09569f90cb0e44cd0efe39810.sourceText: 大凤凰城房地产价格比去年上涨20% 美整体房地产市场稳定 美国商务部数据显示，6月份美国新屋销量环比下降8.4%至35万幢，创5个月来新低，降幅达去年2月以来最大；6月份新屋价格中值同比下降3.2%；7月份经季节 调整的新屋开建数量年化值环比下降1.1%至74.6万幢，低于预期的75.7万幢。 美国房地产经纪商协会数据显示， 6月份美国二手房签销指数意外下降1.4%至99.3，不及增长0.2%的市场预期。 美国楼市已走出谷底阶段，特别是大凤凰城地区比去年同期价格上涨了20%；更多就业新机会，继续进驻。 当然在政府方面还有很多刺激房市的政策：一是美国政府通过持续巨量购买抵押证券和国债等手段压低市场利率。 据房地美披露，7月底，美国30年期固定按揭利率已由3.53%降至3.49%，15年期固定按揭利率则从2.83%降至2.8%；二是美国就业市场持续好转使得购房队伍 壮大成为可能。 虽然7月份美国失业率小幅回升至8.3%，但仍较2009年峰值低1.7个百分点。 7月份新增非农就业16.3万人，创今​​年2月以来最大增幅。 更多房地产信息请咨询金信地产Tinna480287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com。
791f19d6342cf4a09569f90cb0e44cd0efe39810.translatedText: Real estate prices in Greater Phoenix rose 20% over last year and the overall U.S. real estate market is stable Data from the U.S. Department of Commerce showed that U.S. new home sales fell 8.4% month-on-month to 350,000 in June, a five-month low and the largest drop since February last year; the median price of new homes in June fell 3.2% year-on-year; the seasonally adjusted annualized number of new home construction in July fell 1.1% month-on-month to 746,000, lower than the expected 757,000. Data from the National Association of Realtors showed that the U.S. second-hand home sales index unexpectedly fell 1.4% to 99.3 in June, falling short of market expectations for a 0.2% increase. The U.S. real estate market has come out of the bottom stage, especially in the greater Phoenix area, where prices have increased by 20% compared with the same period last year; more new employment opportunities continue to arrive. Of course, there are many government policies to stimulate the housing market: First, the U.S. government has continued to lower market interest rates through massive purchases of mortgage securities and treasury bonds. According to Freddie Mac, by the end of July, the 30-year fixed mortgage interest rate in the United States had dropped from 3.53% to 3.49%, and the 15-year fixed mortgage interest rate had dropped from 2.83% to 2.8%. Second, the continued improvement of the U.S. job market has made it possible for the homebuying team to grow. Although the U.S. unemployment rate rebounded slightly to 8.3% in July, it was still 1.7 percentage points below the 2009 peak. There were 163,000 new non-farm jobs added in July, the largest increase since February this year. b05e9e7fdeedb5f7129c9262673234941eb66424.sourceText: 亚州野火 19消防员丧命（图）
b05e9e7fdeedb5f7129c9262673234941eb66424.translatedText: 19 firefighters died in wildfires in Asia (pictures)

0fff96360f8c7cde79ff035b9a0d329d9ebcf218.sourceText: 亚州野火 19消防员丧命（图） 亚利桑纳州19名消防员30日在扑救野火时，不幸丧生火场。亚州林业部门说，丧…
0fff96360f8c7cde79ff035b9a0d329d9ebcf218.translatedText: 19 firefighters died in wildfires in Asia (pictures) Nineteen firefighters in Arizona died while fighting wildfires on the 30th. The Asian Forestry Department said that...

c2b2ac22344104429756e36304d1994dbd43cc8b.sourceText: 亚利桑纳州19名消防员30日在扑救野火时，不幸丧生火场。亚州林业部门说，丧生的消防员是在亚州中部地区的小镇亚内尔(Yarnell)救火期间，在挖掘防止野火蔓延的防火沟与清逃路径时，被突然迅速扑来的野火围困，不幸被吞噬。 州警说，捐躯的消防员是「紧急救火队」(hotshot)的精选成员，他们当时在挖掘防火沟和准备逃生的路径时，大火迅速扑来将他们围住，走避不及。亚州Prescott消防局说，死者中多数是Prescott消防局的消防员。
c2b2ac22344104429756e36304d1994dbd43cc8b.translatedText: > 19 Arizona firefighters were unfortunately killed while fighting wildfires on the 30th. The Asian Forestry Department said that the firefighter who died was fighting a fire in the small town of Yarnell in central Asia. While digging a fire ditch and an escape route to prevent the spread of wildfires, he was surrounded by a sudden and rapid wildfire and was unfortunately swallowed up. State police said that the firefighters who died were selected members of the "hotshot" team. When they were digging fire trenches and preparing escape routes, the fire quickly came and surrounded them, making them unable to escape. The Prescott Fire Department said most of the deceased were Prescott Fire Department firefighters.

1ee4843c337f9b989f86ef453560f1dc57efbfc4.sourceText: 州警莫利森说﹕「通常在挖防火沟时，消防员要确保他们的逃生路径，设出安全区。遗憾的是，显然这次他们的安全区做得不够大，结果被勐烈的火苗完全吞噬。」
1ee4843c337f9b989f86ef453560f1dc57efbfc4.translatedText: State Police Morrison said: "Usually when digging fire trenches, firefighters have to ensure their escape routes and set up a safe zone. Unfortunately, this time their safe zone was obviously not big enough, and the fire was completely engulfed."

00d4333426ea6a334acfa4924f1bcc579766215f.sourceText: 不算这19人，亚州在今年因救火捐躯的消防人员已高达43人，损失惨重。
00d4333426ea6a334acfa4924f1bcc579766215f.translatedText: Not counting these 19 people, 43 firefighters died fighting fires in Asia this year, a heavy loss.

c9c73d5d6854e037cc922ac8f0c0459895861ab1.sourceText: 这19名消防人员捐躯的消息传开，各界惊呼。当天晚上在「脸书」上已成立弔唁网页，许多人立即上网表示敬佩与哀思。
c9c73d5d6854e037cc922ac8f0c0459895861ab1.translatedText: The news of the death of these 19 firefighters spread, and people from all walks of life exclaimed. A condolence page was set up on Facebook that evening, and many people immediately went online to express their admiration and condolences.

7237c4724c6cb8bdc9cf6af9165bf3d187b6785f.sourceText: 亚内尔镇的野火起于28日，当局称是由于打雷闪电所引起。但近日来在高温和湿度低的天气和强风的作用下，火势异常凶勐。亚内尔镇位于凤凰城的西北约85哩处，野火迅勐来临时，消防员曾撑起类似帐蓬装置的防火棚，以防烈焰和热浪的侵袭。
7237c4724c6cb8bdc9cf6af9165bf3d187b6785f.translatedText: The wildfire in Yarnell Town started on the 28th. The authorities said it was caused by thunder and lightning. But in recent days, the fires have become extremely fierce due to high temperatures, low humidity and strong winds. The town of Yarnell is located about 85 miles northwest of Phoenix. When wildfires broke out quickly, firefighters set up fire shelters similar to tents to protect them from the flames and heat waves.

b15158a74723cb8a94841f9dbec2e0399e888ccc.sourceText: 参加野火扑救的消防员约200人，此外，130名消防员、救火直升机和运输机正在兼程赶来，协助救火。
b15158a74723cb8a94841f9dbec2e0399e888ccc.translatedText: About 200 firefighters are participating in fighting the wildfire. In addition, 130 firefighters, firefighting helicopters and transport planes are arriving all the way to assist in fighting the fire.

84c93361607bcd56647fce82e8e44fc0425c6d7a.sourceText: 面积达2000英亩的野火导致附近部分社区的50户家庭被疏散，30日傍晚时分，Yavapai郡警长办公室进一步扩大了疏散范围，亚内尔镇内的部分居民已撤往安全地带。Glenisle社区的许多房屋被烧毁，但没有人员伤亡的报导。
84c93361607bcd56647fce82e8e44fc0425c6d7a.translatedText: A wildfire covering an area of ​​2,000 acres caused 50 households in some nearby communities to be evacuated. On the evening of the 30th, the Yavapai County Sheriff's Office further expanded the evacuation scope, and some residents in the town of Yarnell have evacuated to safety. Many homes in the Glenisle community were burned, but no injuries were reported.

e6b5d6837100ab3641feee97f549efa87c91746b.sourceText: 野火导致亚州89号公路的部分路段被关闭，州府公路部门没说将关闭多久，但告诫开车人要转往93号公路和17号公路行驶。
e6b5d6837100ab3641feee97f549efa87c91746b.translatedText: Wildfires have closed part of Highway 89 in Asia. The state highway department did not say how long it will be closed, but it warned motorists to divert to Highway 93 and Highway 17.

d6bb737f8dea2a8a719c73df1b952e726e2aa2de.sourceText: 亚州林业部门发言人说，州府已向联邦请求协助扑救野火。Wickenburg社区医院发言人说，他们已接到将有伤员送来的通知，红十字会在Yavapai学院开设了接待站。
d6bb737f8dea2a8a719c73df1b952e726e2aa2de.translatedText: A spokesman for the state forestry department said the state has requested federal assistance in fighting wildfires. A spokesman for Wickenburg Community Hospital said they had been notified of the incoming casualties and the Red Cross had opened a reception station at Yavapai College.

e7941583e8f0c7697516a8f9c041a241788c6cac.sourceText: 亚州凤凰城以北30日森林野火，一发不可收势，狂噬无数民宅，更夺去19位消防队员的性命。
e7941583e8f0c7697516a8f9c041a241788c6cac.translatedText: On the 30th, a forest wildfire north of Phoenix, Asia, got out of hand, devouring countless homes and claiming the lives of 19 firefighters.

9ebbc132daf6649541b9eff80d16ffc561939517.sourceText: 大打中国牌罗奥二次辩论20次提中国
9ebbc132daf6649541b9eff80d16ffc561939517.translatedText: Playing the China Card. Roo mentioned China 20 times in the second debate.

de0413c634b681351e1c00c02018ddc9327f5d96.sourceText: 大打中国牌罗奥二次辩论20次提中国 罗姆尼在辩论中将美国就业和制造业不景气归咎于中国，再次重申要将中国列为…
de0413c634b681351e1c00c02018ddc9327f5d96.translatedText: Playing the China Card. Romney mentioned China 20 times in the second debate. In the debate, Romney blamed China for the downturn in employment and manufacturing in the United States, and reiterated that China would be listed...

fe5462d5d376a0b03b5f6206ec1b6f34f042f3cd.sourceText: 罗姆尼还攻击中国侵害知识产权。罗姆尼意图靠打”中国牌”取得辩论中的优势地位，捞取选票。但奥巴马的猛烈回击让他的”中国牌”以失效告终。
fe5462d5d376a0b03b5f6206ec1b6f34f042f3cd.translatedText: Romney also attacked China for infringing on intellectual property rights. Romney intends to gain an advantageous position in the debate and gain votes by playing the "China card". But Obama's fierce counterattack made his "China card" ineffective.

f3b1f8bb8856952e5a28bbc9e20bb8595d00e499.sourceText: 奥巴马在人民币汇率问题上说，自他就任总统以来，人民币对美元已累计升值11%。他将人民币升值归因于美方，与事实不符，但也明确指出了罗姆尼对人民币的大幅升值视而不见。
f3b1f8bb8856952e5a28bbc9e20bb8595d00e499.translatedText: On the issue of RMB exchange rate, Obama said that since he took office as president, the RMB has appreciated by 11% against the US dollar. He attributed the appreciation of the RMB to the United States, which was inconsistent with the facts, but he also clearly pointed out that Romney turned a blind eye to the sharp appreciation of the RMB.

1cdeaecfd4fcff3c47c74658019faed8e35ea701.sourceText: 奥巴马还在辩论中咬住罗姆尼投资中国的具体事例，以图表明罗姆尼的口是心非，虽然口头上大骂中国，背后却和中国积极做生意。奥巴马直截了当地告诉罗姆尼，他是”最没有资格对中国持强硬立场的人”。
1cdeaecfd4fcff3c47c74658019faed8e35ea701.translatedText: During the debate, Obama also pointed to specific examples of Romney's investment in China in an attempt to show that Romney was duplicitous. Although he verbally cursed China, he was actively doing business with China behind the scenes. Obama bluntly told Romney that he was "the least qualified person to take a tough stance on China."

2ccd6577c8f0e447e73309cd261b62b8189a25c4.sourceText: 罗姆尼和奥巴马在这场辩论中提到中国的次数多达20次，其中大部分是在谈到经济和贸易议题上涉及的。由于美国经济目前依然疲软，中国变成了两位总统候选人推脱责任、转移矛盾的靶子。
2ccd6577c8f0e447e73309cd261b62b8189a25c4.translatedText: Romney and Obama mentioned China as many as 20 times in this debate, most of which were related to economic and trade issues. As the U.S. economy is still weak, China has become a target for the two presidential candidates to shirk responsibility and deflect conflicts.

f38b18b6fefbc3da1938574f60f926f99d4608a8.sourceText: 奥巴马在辩论中也表现出对华强硬的一面。他最近还以实际行动展示”对华强硬”的姿态，包括宣布向世贸组织指控中国对汽车及其零部件出口进行补贴等。
f38b18b6fefbc3da1938574f60f926f99d4608a8.translatedText: Obama also showed a tough side towards China during the debate. He has also recently demonstrated his "tough stance against China" with practical actions, including announcing that he would accuse China of subsidizing the export of automobiles and parts to the WTO.

6c915380007021db5dcbc04f8f0991cae09b2c10.sourceText: 第二场总统辩论结束后，CNN/ORC International所做的全国民调显示，观看这场辩论的选民中，45%认为，奥巴马胜出，39%认为，罗姆尼表现更好。
6c915380007021db5dcbc04f8f0991cae09b2c10.translatedText: After the second presidential debate, a national poll conducted by CNN/ORC International showed that 45% of voters who watched the debate believed that Obama won, and 39% believed that Romney performed better.

4031497b3d6069ee3b2d0c87b6d3e2754960c644.sourceText: 在现场观众的支持率上，奥巴马获得7个百分点的优势。但民调也显示，在经济问题上，罗姆尼表现更好。在辩论是否影响选民投票决定方面，两名候选人打平手。一半受访者表示，辩论不会使他们更有可能将票投给某个候选人。
4031497b3d6069ee3b2d0c87b6d3e2754960c644.translatedText: In terms of the support rate of the live audience, Obama gained a 7 percentage point advantage. But polls also show Romney performs better on economic issues. The two candidates were tied on whether the debate affected voters' voting decisions. Half of those surveyed said the debates would not make them more likely to vote for a particular candidate.

319ff956293913732ce7cfff11436efff0b5d0a8.translatedText: According to a British media poll, 98% of netizens support an apology to Ye Shiwen

14e90b6d59ed5fbf31d8fca51706c5f542033751.translatedText: A British media poll shows that 98% of netizens support an apology to Ye Shiwen After Ye Shiwen won the women's 400-meter medley gold medal, American swimming coach Leonard publicly questioned Ye Shiwen...

0bf85b6f567e61a31afa1a2d734dc65e83f0d2c1.sourceText: 叶诗文夺得女子400米混合泳金牌后，美国游泳教练伦纳德对叶诗文公开表示质疑，怀疑叶诗文是服用禁药才有上佳表现。然而叶诗文最终通过了赛后的药检，此时中国的支持者却愤怒了，包括叶诗文的父亲强烈抨击西方的狂妄自负。今天，英国《卫报》针对此事作出调查，”伦纳德是否该向叶诗文道歉？”目前为止，参与投票的网友中98%都投给了”需要道歉”，关于叶诗文一事也是各抒已见发表自己的看法。 M
0bf85b6f567e61a31afa1a2d734dc65e83f0d2c1.translatedText: After Ye Shiwen won the women's 400-meter medley gold medal, American swimming coach Leonard publicly expressed doubts about Ye Shiwen, suspecting that Ye Shiwen had taken banned drugs to perform well. However, Ye Shiwen finally passed the post-match drug test. At this time, Chinese supporters were angry, including Ye Shiwen's father, who strongly criticized the West's arrogance. Today, the British "Guardian" conducted an investigation on this matter, "Should Leonard apologize to Ye Shiwen?" So far, 98% of the netizens who participated in the vote voted for "need to apologize". Regarding Ye Shiwen, everyone has expressed their own opinions. M

442f647881c977ea92328e5d5cdc270117c2c3cc.sourceText: 一名叫”Albalha”表示站在叶诗文一边，他的看法是：”澳大利亚选手索普曾经解释说自己在15-16岁期间，能把自己最好的成绩提高到5秒，因此叶诗文破400米纪录是一种很正常的现象，所以我想说伦纳德的道歉是非常必要的。”有位”legaff”网友表示叶诗文被怀疑是因为当初中国游泳界不强大，现在现在不同了。他说：”中国近10年对游泳非常重视，孙杨就是一个例子。叶诗文也是中国重视游泳的结果，难以置信的锻炼以及科学系统的选拔。叶诗文的表现应该值得掌声而不是质疑。如果她不是中国人，我不确定伦纳德还会在公共场合做出此番言论。” Mitbbs.com 但也有一帮网友一如既往提出质疑，有人说：”既然考虑到是中国游泳队牵涉进去，再度涉及到兴奋剂事件，所以叶诗文被怀疑也不是毫无根据，虽然她现在一度被查出”无罪”，但并不代表她是清白的，她可能尝试的一种药剂比较高明，而现在的技术却不能检测出来。”
442f647881c977ea92328e5d5cdc270117c2c3cc.translatedText: >A person named "Albalha" expressed his support for Ye Shiwen. His opinion is: "Australian player Thorpe once explained that he was able to improve his best score to 5 when he was 15-16 years old. Seconds, so it is normal for Ye Shiwen to break the 400-meter record, so I want to say that Leonard’s apology is very necessary. "A "legaff" netizen said that Ye Shiwen was suspected because the Chinese swimming community was not strong at the time, but it is different now. He said: "China has attached great importance to swimming in the past 10 years, and Sun Yang is an example. Ye Shiwen is also the result of China's emphasis on swimming, incredible training and scientific and systematic selection. Ye Shiwen's performance should deserve applause rather than questioning. If she were not Chinese, I am not sure Leonard would still make such remarks in public." Mitbbs.com However, there are also a group of netizens who raised questions as always. Some said: "Since the Chinese swimming team is involved and is involved in a doping incident again, the suspicion of Ye Shiwen is not unfounded. Although she has been found "not guilty" for a time, it does not mean that she is innocent. She may have tried a more sophisticated drug, but current technology cannot detect it."

fda8ccee224c81b80af7611b6f9615fdb90e72d9.sourceText: 当此番质疑一出，大部分网友觉得该言论带有极度的歧视性。有人回复说：”就是因为有你们这样的言论，中国人才感到不满的。叶诗文她通过了药检，有人却暗示她使用了一种尚未被了解的药物。不管是否是这样，在没有明确证据之前，请尊重每一个选手。假以时日有明确证据证明她的确使用了药物，再来一次这种民意调查，我相信即便是中国人也会投票让她公开道歉。既然没有这种事情发生，请不要公开发出这样的质疑。请不要忘了，每位选手都是经历了无数的努力才走上奥运赛场的，请尊重每一个人在你们看不到的地方所作出的努力与奋斗。”
fda8ccee224c81b80af7611b6f9615fdb90e72d9.translatedText: When this question came out, most netizens felt that the statement was extremely discriminatory. Someone replied: "It is because of remarks like yours that Chinese people are dissatisfied. Ye Shiwen passed the drug test, but some people suggested that she used a drug that has not yet been understood. Regardless of whether this is the case, until there is no clear evidence, please respect every player. As time goes by, there is clear evidence that she did use drugs. After such a poll, I believe that even the Chinese will vote for her to publicly apologize. Since this has not happened, please do not publicly raise such questions. Please don’t forget that every athlete has gone through countless efforts to enter the Olympics. Please respect everyone’s efforts and struggles that you can’t see.”

77bb7b642d07f248e71246bc535a2b2642520c12.sourceText: 逾55岁老烟枪 应每年筛检肺癌 美国癌症协会(American Cancer Society)11日公布新准则，表示已有足够的证据建议55至74岁的老烟枪，在接受肺癌筛检的危险性和益处咨询后，每年做肺癌筛检。 这个研究只包括过去30年每天吸一包香烟的年长者，或有相等吸烟量者，如过去15年每天吸两包香烟者。至于筛检是否能帮助其他人并不清楚，所以该协会并未对其他人做此建议。 肺癌是全球最致命的癌症，癌协是根据2011年的一项大规模研究结果，提出这项准则。这个研究发现每年做低剂量的电脑断层扫描(CT Scan)，可降低肺癌死亡率20%，降低任何其他原因的死亡率7%。 美国防癌协会准则制定小组的领导者、费城汤玛斯杰佛逊大学家庭医学主任温德说：「我们试图确定把筛检可能有的伤害降至最低，如非必要的切片、筛检错误显示有癌症后的跟进手术等。」温德说，55岁以下者很少患肺癌，所以55岁以下者做筛检益处不大。 温德也是美国防癌协会的前任会长，在准则制定委员会的20名委员中，有三人与癌症药厂或造影产品公司有密切关系。肺癌筛检的费用为100至400元，联邦医疗保险(Medicare)和私人保险都不支付。温德说，保险公司应对正确的人，而非每一个人，支付肺癌筛检费用。 美国每年有超过16万人死于肺癌，大多数患者是在癌症已扩散后才被诊断出。近年来癌症筛检引发极大的争议，特别是对妇女乳癌筛检，和男性摄护腺特异抗原(PSA)检验的开始时间和频率。 美国政府指定的预防服务专案小组自2004年起就没有考虑肺癌筛检，该小组说，没有足够的证据来建议或反对做肺癌筛检。美国防癌协会曾建议做胸部X光检查，但在1980年取消此建议，此后电脑断层扫描即被广泛用来筛检肺癌。
77bb7b642d07f248e71246bc535a2b2642520c12.translatedText: Smokers over 55 years old should be screened for lung cancer every year American Cancer Society (American Cancer) Society) announced new guidelines on the 11th, stating that there is sufficient evidence to recommend that regular smokers aged 55 to 74 undergo annual lung cancer screening after receiving counseling on the risks and benefits of lung cancer screening. The study only included older adults who had smoked one pack of cigarettes a day in the past 30 years, or an equivalent amount, such as two packs a day in the past 15 years. It's not clear whether screening can help other people, so the association isn't recommending it for others. Lung cancer is the deadliest cancer in the world. The Cancer Society proposed this guideline based on the results of a large-scale study in 2011. This study found that annual low-dose computed tomography scans (CT Scans) can reduce lung cancer mortality by 20% and mortality from any other cause by 7%. "We try to make sure we minimize the harm that screening can cause, such as unnecessary biopsies, follow-up surgeries after a screening test mistakenly shows cancer," said Wind, who leads the American Cancer Society's guideline-setting group and is director of family medicine at Thomas Jefferson University in Philadelphia. People under 55 rarely get lung cancer, so there is little benefit from screening for those younger than 55, Wind said. Wind is also the former president of the American Cancer Society. Among the 20 members of the standard-setting committee, three have close relationships with cancer drug companies or imaging product companies. Lung cancer screening costs $100 to $400 and is not covered by Medicare or private insurance. Insurers should pay for lung cancer screenings for the right people, not everyone, Wind said. More than 160,000 people die from lung cancer in the United States each year, and most patients are diagnosed after the cancer has spread. In recent years, cancer screening has caused great controversy, especially for women's breast cancer screening and the start time and frequency of male prostate-specific antigen (PSA) testing. The U.S. government-appointed Preventive Services Task Force has not considered lung cancer screening since 2004, saying there is insufficient evidence to recommend for or against lung cancer screening. The American Cancer Society once recommended chest X-rays, but this recommendation was withdrawn in 1980. Since then, computed tomography scans have been widely used to screen for lung cancer.

8d6ffd2b47448a4344e735f5f3ff34572e76ba30.sourceText: 上海地铁10号线发生两车追尾 昨天（9月27日）14时许，上海地铁10号线豫园站至老西门站下行区间发生两车追尾事故。截至昨晚9时，事故伤员总数达到271人，其中20多人伤势较重。 从初步情况看，事故是由于新天地站信号故障，10号线改采用人工调度所致。有关方面已经成立事故调查组着手调查具体原因。 近几个月来，大大小小的地铁故障事件频频进入公众视野。北京和深圳分别于7月5日和10日发生扶梯设备故障，前者甚至造成1人死亡。仅就此次事故的发生地上海来看，从7月到事故发生前已发生3次故障。 事实上，10号线7月曾有过列车开错方向的情况，地铁运营方把问题同样归为信号系统故障，所幸彼时没有酿成事故。在舆论关注淡去后，有关该故障的进一步说明亦不了了之。 作为现代城市必备的大众交通工具，地铁发挥着不可估量的作用。一般而言，它是百万人流的中转站，在一些地下利用率极高的国家，它还是各地下”王国”的连通要塞。地铁日益成为与大多数人相关的场所，这也意味着地铁安全不容忽视。 在地铁故障频出的同时，全国许多城市还在马不停蹄地建设自己的城市地铁。可以说，地铁安全是一个既指向过去，又指向未来的问题。 此次事故仍然始于问题多发的信号设备，由于现实不允许地铁停运来更换信号系统，对于已经拥有地铁的城市，只能通过增加维修和保养的频率降低隐患系数，而对于尚在建设中的地铁工程，有必要借此机会从源头审查安全。 另一方面，人工调度是目前知悉的又一事故发生因素。应当说，人工调度与追尾事故没有必然联系，在正常情况下，人工调度本该有效补充智能调度的不足，本次事故无疑也暴露出了地铁运营中的管理漏洞。 地铁是现代城市运转的有机组成，也是大众生活交集的一部分，维持其安全运行，是城市生活正常开展的需要，更是公众对公共安全寄予的基本信赖。确保地铁每一个环节的安全，尽可能降低危险，维系社会良性发展的信赖才可延续。截至晚上１９点３０分，因地铁追尾事故前往医疗机构就医的人数超过２６０人，其中有约２０人伤情较重，７人进入重症监护室治疗，但均无生命危险。４名在事故中伤势轻微的外籍人士已得到了及时治疗。截至１９点３０分，共有５０余人留院治疗，６０余人离开医院，其他伤者仍在诊断和治疗中。
8d6ffd2b47448a4344e735f5f3ff34572e76ba30.translatedText: A two-vehicle collision occurred on Shanghai Metro Line 10. Yesterday (September 27) at about 14:00, a rear-end collision occurred between two vehicles in the downbound section of Shanghai Metro Line 10 from Yuyuan Station to Laoximen Station. As of 9 o'clock last night, the total number of casualties in the accident reached 271, of which more than 20 were seriously injured. Judging from the preliminary situation, the accident was caused by a signal failure at Xintiandi Station and Line 10 was switched to manual dispatch. Relevant parties have set up an accident investigation team to investigate the specific causes. In recent months, large and small subway failures have frequently come into public view. Escalator equipment failures occurred in Beijing and Shenzhen on July 5 and 10 respectively, with the former even causing one death. Looking only at Shanghai, where the accident occurred, there had been three failures from July to before the accident. In fact, a train on Line 10 ran in the wrong direction in July. The subway operator also attributed the problem to a signaling system failure. Fortunately, no accident occurred at that time. After the public attention faded, no further explanation of the fault was released. As an essential mass transportation system in modern cities, the subway plays an immeasurable role. Generally speaking, it is a transfer station for millions of people. In some countries with extremely high underground utilization rates, it is also a connecting fortress for various underground "kingdoms". The subway is increasingly becoming a place relevant to most people, which also means that subway safety cannot be ignored. While subway failures occur frequently, many cities across the country are still building their own urban subways non-stop. It can be said that subway safety is an issue that points to both the past and the future. This accident still started with the problem-prone signaling equipment. Since reality does not allow the subway to be shut down to replace the signaling system, cities that already have subways can only reduce the hidden danger coefficient by increasing the frequency of repairs and maintenance. For subway projects that are still under construction, it is necessary to take this opportunity to review safety from the source. On the other hand, manual dispatch is another known factor in accidents. It should be said that there is no necessary connection between manual dispatch and rear-end collision accidents. Under normal circumstances, manual dispatch should effectively supplement the deficiencies of intelligent dispatch. This accident undoubtedly exposed management loopholes in subway operations. The subway is an integral part of the operation of modern cities and a part of the intersection of public life. Maintaining its safe operation is a need for the normal development of urban life, and it is also the basic trust placed by the public in public safety. Only by ensuring the safety of every aspect of the subway and reducing risks as much as possible can the trust that maintains the healthy development of society be sustained. As of 19:30 pm, more than 260 people had gone to medical institutions for treatment due to subway rear-end collisions. About 20 of them were seriously injured, and 7 were admitted to the intensive care unit for treatment, but none of them were life-threatening. Four foreigners who were slightly injured in the accident have received prompt treatment. As of 19:30, more than 50 people were hospitalized for treatment, more than 60 people had left the hospital, and other injured people were still being diagnosed and treated.

580b46f451c7cc48d486791df9674d7c36ad7a14.sourceText: 蛇舞迎新春 图桑春晚2月3日隆重登场 Tucson华声合唱团 屈宁 为迎接2013年中国新春蛇年的到来，由亚利桑那大学孔子学院（CIUA）主办、Tucson（图桑）华声合唱团承办，将再次与社区各团体合作，定于二月三日在亚利桑那大学 (U of A) 的Centennial Hall音乐厅，共同举办庆祝中国新年的春节晚会，以一种别具特色的方式，隆重热烈地拉开当地海外华人和美国当地民众共同欢庆中国春节的喜庆大幕。 这已是Tucson连续第六年成功举办庆祝中国春节的联欢晚会。 图桑华人社区，活跃着许许多多的华人社团，除了创立于2005年的 Tucson华人文化中心和两所中文学校，还有颇具社区影响力的”华夏”系列团队， 包括华声合唱团、华姿舞蹈团、夏雷民乐团、华夏武术队和华健太极队等。每年的图桑春晚，不仅有华人社区各个团体的积极参与，我们还会邀请多家美国当地专业及业余艺术团体的加盟，同时，这一社区活动持续得到当地主流媒体的广泛关注和报道，也因此吸引了越来越多的美国观众。使得华人社区单纯自娱自乐的庆祝party，升华成为一道文化大餐、一场社区各族裔共享的文化盛宴，真正做到了业余与专业相结合、华人社区与主流社区相结合、中国与美国相结合。如今，Tucson春晚不仅成为当地华人社区欢庆中国春节的一项年度品牌和文化盛事，更被视为一次向当地民众介绍中国文化，让尽可能多的美国民众更多、更直接地了解和感受中国传统文化魅力的极好机会；同时，也成为一次难得的促进中美文化艺术交流合作的契机。 图桑2013蛇年春晚，期待您的光临和观看！
580b46f451c7cc48d486791df9674d7c36ad7a14.translatedText: Snake Dance welcomes the New Year. In order to welcome the arrival of the Chinese New Year in 2013, the Year of the Snake, the Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona (CIUA) and the Tucson Huasheng Choir will once again cooperate with various community groups to jointly hold a Spring Festival Gala to celebrate the Chinese New Year at the Centennial Hall Concert Hall of the University of Arizona (U of A) on February 3. In a unique way, it will grandly and warmly kick off the celebration of the Chinese New Year for local overseas Chinese and local people in the United States. This is the sixth consecutive year that Tucson has successfully hosted a gala to celebrate the Chinese New Year. There are many Chinese associations active in the Tucson Chinese community. In addition to the Tucson Chinese Cultural Center and two Chinese schools founded in 2005, there are also a series of "Huaxia" teams with great community influence, including Huasheng Choir, Huazi Dance Troupe, Xia Lei Folk Orchestra, Huaxia Wushu Team and Huajian Tai Chi Team. Every year, the Tucson Spring Festival Gala not only has the active participation of various groups in the Chinese community, but we also invite a number of local American professional and amateur art groups to join us. At the same time, this community event continues to receive widespread attention and reports from local mainstream media, and thus attracts more and more American audiences. The celebration party that the Chinese community simply entertained itself has been sublimated into a cultural feast, a cultural feast shared by all ethnic groups in the community, truly combining amateurism with professionalism, the Chinese community with the mainstream community, and China with the United States. Today, the Tucson Spring Festival Gala has not only become an annual brand and cultural event for the local Chinese community to celebrate the Chinese New Year, it is also regarded as an excellent opportunity to introduce Chinese culture to the local people and allow as many Americans as possible to understand and feel the charm of traditional Chinese culture more directly. At the same time, it has also become a rare opportunity to promote cultural exchanges and cooperation between China and the United States. Tucson 2013 Year of the Snake Spring Festival Gala, looking forward to your visit and viewing!

3e997b65dbbb4042bbfabb49b5969d4a382913be.sourceText: 亚利桑那边境逮捕人数下降40%(图) 诺加拉斯边境墙 尽管官方数字要等几个星期之后才会公布，海关和边境保护局局长贝尔辛上周日与国土安全部长纳波利塔诺及边境特工一道，星期天骑马巡视边境后说，图森地区上一财年逮捕的人数下降到12.3万人，其中图森地区最大的部门诺加尔斯站逮捕人数为1.8万人，下降43%。 贝尔辛称赞那些边境特工说，他们正在从事具有历史意义的事业。被逮捕人数下降显示非法移民不再通过那里进入美国，如果他们要那么做就会被逮捕。 图森地区逮捕12.3万人是自1993年以来的最低的数字，也是该地区明显好转的一年。贝尔辛说，那个地区几年之前还处于失控。 贝尔辛说，”我们当时是对偷渡客做出反应，那就是失控。…..今年，他们要对我们做出反应。” 奥巴马政府部署了国民卫队，新添新边境墙和技术设备，增加边境特工，让非法过境更加困难。联邦政府也加强了移民执法。在2011财年，递解出境人数创下历史最高。这些因素加上美国就业市场萧条，大幅减少边境被逮捕人数。 亚利桑那州立大学北美越境研究中心副主任埃里克 李说，去年增长幅度高达5%的墨西哥经济繁荣也降低了美国对非法移民的吸引力。 亚利桑那州，尤其是图森地区，多年来都是最受偷渡客欢迎的秘密越境大门，也是全国非法移民争论的焦点，而政治家一再要求在那里加强边境安全。 亚利桑那州共和党籍参议员麦凯恩强烈抨击奥巴马政府的边境政策，但他也承认政府已经取得某些积极成果。他仍然说政府应当采取更多措施。他说，总的来说，美国政府的措施不能 适应边境另一边的暴力升级，那对美国构成威胁。他还说，边境墙和技术设备都不够，更多国民卫队应当部署在边境地区。 总统奥巴马一再指出，边境巡逻部门逮捕人数下降证实他已经加强边境安全。 弗吉尼亚大学政治中心主任萨巴托说，在大选中，毫无疑问总统奥巴马将提到他的政策正在发挥作用。但有人会反驳说，你的经济太差导致边境被逮捕人数下降。 在共和党的几场辩论中，总统参选人都指责奥巴马没有充分加强边境安全，都保证自己将加强边境执法。参选人之一、明尼苏达州众议员巴赫曼今年10月保证要加强边境安全。另一参选人、皮萨公司前主管凯恩呼吁建立电网威慑偷越边境者，但那种说法引起强烈批评和抗议之后，他又声称是开玩笑。
3e997b65dbbb4042bbfabb49b5969d4a382913be.translatedText: Arizona border apprehensions drop 40% (photo) Nogalas border wall Although official numbers won't be released for several weeks, Customs and Border Protection Director Bersin said after a horseback tour of the border with Homeland Security Secretary Napolitano and border agents on Sunday that the number of arrests in the Tucson area fell to 123,000 in the last fiscal year, with arrests at the Nogales Station, Tucson's largest department, falling to 18,000, a 43% drop. Bersin praised those border agents, saying they were doing something historic. The decline in apprehensions shows that illegal immigrants are no longer entering the United States through there and would be apprehended if they did. The 123,000 arrests in Tucson were the lowest number since 1993, a marked improvement for the region. Bersin said that area was out of control just a few years ago. Bersin said, "We were reacting to smugglers, and that was out of control. ... This year, they are reacting to us." The Obama administration deployed the National Guard, added new border walls and technical equipment, and increased border agents to make illegal crossings more difficult. The federal government has also stepped up immigration enforcement. In fiscal year 2011, deportations hit an all-time high. These factors, combined with a depressed U.S. job market, have significantly reduced the number of border apprehensions. Eric Lee, associate director of the Center for North American Cross-Border Studies at Arizona State University, said the Mexican economic boom, which grew by as much as 5% last year, has also made the United States less attractive to illegal immigrants. Arizona, and particularly the Tucson area, has for years been a popular clandestine border crossing for smugglers and a focus of the national debate over illegal immigration, where politicians have repeatedly called for greater border security. Arizona Republican Senator John McCain strongly criticized the Obama administration's border policies, but he also acknowledged that the administration has achieved some positive results. Still, he said the government should do more. He said that, in general, the U.S. government's measures are not adapted to the escalation of violence on the other side of the border, which poses a threat to the United States. He also said that the border wall and technical equipment are not enough, and more National Guard troops should be deployed in the border area. President Obama has repeatedly pointed to the decline in Border Patrol apprehensions as confirmation that he has tightened border security. Sabato, director of the Center for Politics at the University of Virginia, said that in the general election, there is no doubt that President Obama will mention that his policies are working. But some would counter that your economy is so bad that apprehensions at the border are down. In several Republican debates, presidential candidates accused Obama of not adequately strengthening border security and promised that they would strengthen border enforcement. One of the candidates, Representative Bachmann of Minnesota, pledged to strengthen border security in October this year. Another candidate, Cain, a former CEO of Pizza Company, called for the establishment of an electric grid to deter border crossers, but after that statement aroused strong criticism and protests, he claimed that he was joking.

a96c2237a22d846d84c15402928ca9fac90ab1b3.sourceText: 天才少女15岁大专毕业 （亚省时报） 住在卡萨格兰德的天才少女，最近作出高中和大专同时毕业的壮举。 金伯莉蔻芙12岁起就在中央亚利桑那学院修课，那时她还是卡萨格兰德高中的学生。上周六，她从学院毕业，几个星期后高中毕业。 皮纳尔郡有100多名高中生和金伯莉一样在中央亚利桑那学院修课。许多家长认为自家孩子又能力比同龄人走得更快，此举既省钱又省时间，是绩优学生的好选择。 蔻芙在大专的平均成绩是4.0，她已准备好秋天进入ASU的新闻与传播学院。她计划18岁生日前取得硕士学位。
a96c2237a22d846d84c15402928ca9fac90ab1b3.translatedText: Genius girl graduated from junior college at 15 years old (Alberta Times) A ​​genius girl living in Casa Grande recently achieved the feat of graduating from high school and junior college at the same time. Kimberly Cove has been taking classes at Central Arizona College since she was 12 years old, when she was a student at Casa Grande High School. She graduated from the academy last Saturday and graduates from high school in a few weeks. More than 100 high school students in Pinal County are taking classes at Central Arizona College like Kimberly. Many parents believe that their children can walk faster than their peers. This method saves money and time, and is a good choice for outstanding students. With a 4.0 grade-point average in college, Cove is ready to attend ASU's School of Journalism and Communications in the fall. She plans to obtain a master's degree before her 18th birthday.

c1bd2211b9d92273dbe1bf40fd136d937d3d5c46.sourceText: 55岁以上求职者 受职场欢迎 劳工统计局的数据显示，2009年至2012年9月，55岁以上的上班族增加了350万人，在所有420万名16岁以上的上班族中占绝大多数。华尔街日报22日报导，日益增加的年龄较长成年人惊喜发现，职场开始欢迎他们。 年龄较长的上班族增加，有两个原因：一、人口学因素。到今年7月為止的三年中，25岁至69岁的人口增加，86%落在55岁至69岁这个年龄层。二、雇主态度改变。更多雇主了解，年龄较长的成年人技能和经验比较成熟、丰富，有助於增加公司盈利。 但是，这个现象未必全是好消息。分析指出，年龄较长的成年人失业率虽较低，一旦失业，他们的失业期较长，中位数字是35周，高於较年轻失业者的26周。 职场分析师指出，年龄较大的求职者在以下四个领域比较容易找到工作：一、12年级学校改革计画可能导致教师需求增加，特别有利於年龄较大者。二、金融服务业。银行与保险公司对年龄较大的上班族有前瞻性看法，一旦决定录用，愿意给他们更大弹性，减少他们的工时。三、医疗业。这个行业工作人手短缺，正向55岁 以上的求职者招手。四、需要专业知识的諮询业。分析师指出，在諮询和顾问这个行业，经验非常重要，对年龄较长者有利。 专家也提醒50岁以上求职者，勿犯以下三个常见错误：一、要求薪酬太高。二、对能力和经验过度自信。三、暗示或坚持自己的工作方式和工作时间。
c1bd2211b9d92273dbe1bf40fd136d937d3d5c46.translatedText: Job seekers over 55 years old are popular in the workplace. Data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics show that from 2009 to September 2012, the number of office workers over the age of 55 increased by 3.5 million, accounting for the vast majority of the 4.2 million office workers over the age of 16. The Wall Street Journal reported on the 22nd that an increasing number of older adults are surprised to find that the workplace is beginning to welcome them. There are two reasons for the increase in older office workers: 1. Demographic factors. In the three years to July this year, the number of people aged 25 to 69 increased, with 86% falling in the 55 to 69 age group. 2. Changes in employer attitudes. More employers understand that older adults have more mature and rich skills and experience, which can help increase company profits. However, this phenomenon may not be all good news. The analysis pointed out that although the unemployment rate is lower for older adults, once they lose their jobs, their unemployment period is longer, with a median of 35 weeks, which is higher than the 26 weeks for younger unemployed people. Workplace analysts pointed out that older job seekers are more likely to find jobs in the following four areas: 1. The 12th-grade school reform plan may lead to an increase in the demand for teachers, which is particularly beneficial to older people. 2. Financial services industry. Banks and insurance companies have a forward-looking view of older office workers and are willing to give them greater flexibility and reduce their working hours once they decide to hire them. 3. Medical industry. There is a shortage of jobs in this industry and it is looking for job seekers over the age of 55. 4. Consulting industry that requires professional knowledge. Analysts pointed out that in the consulting and consulting industry, experience is very important, which favors those who are older. Experts also remind job seekers over the age of 50 not to make the following three common mistakes: 1. Ask for too high a salary. 2. Overconfidence in abilities and experience. 3. Hint or insist on your own working methods and working hours.

c3b8bfd4e013fbc0ea24098febc3031de2bccb8e.sourceText: 最近，教育新闻及研究出版《教育週》公布第17年度调查，查看美国50个州的教育状况。该报告基于6个关键指标，包括K-12的成绩，教学标准，考核，教师专业程度，学校资金，学生长期成功的机会比例。马里兰州连续第五年排名第一，获得B +，南达科他州排名最后一位，分数为D +。基于《教育週》2012年的调查，《24/7华尔街》找出美国最佳和最差教育系统的地方。EPE研究中心的艾米海托华(Amy Hightower)表示，各州必须有一个基本的教育开支，但是，具有良好的资金并不能保证学生有良好的教育计划。其中一个重要的元素是学生承接阶段的调整，用来衡量学校使用的程序和资源，以帮助他们的学生从学前班转换到幼儿园，初中，高中，高中到大学或就业等。七间排名最高的州，处理学生的转换升级的措施最为理想的。
c3b8bfd4e013fbc0ea24098febc3031de2bccb8e.translatedText: Recently, the education news and research publication "Education Week" released its 17th annual survey, looking at the education status of the 50 states in the United States. The report is based on six key indicators, including K-12 achievement, teaching standards, assessments, teacher professionalism, school funding, and student long-term chances of success. Maryland ranked first for the fifth consecutive year with a B+, and South Dakota ranked last with a D+. Based on Education Week's 2012 survey, 24/7 Wall Street identifies the best and worst places in America's education system. Amy Hightower of the EPE Research Center said states must have a basic education budget, but having good funding does not guarantee a good education program for students. An important element of this is transitional adjustments, which measure the programs and resources schools use to help their students transition from preschool to kindergarten, middle school, high school, and high school to college or employment. The seven highest-ranked states have the best practices for handling student transitions.

bba7c81e0aaf58256ef8dc62d45e44ffbf8ac0b8.sourceText: 海托华解释说：”10年前，这并不是探讨的话题，但是，教育政策制定者最终认识到给孩子们一致的信息的重要，孩子需要建立目标，了解他们未来学习的教育和意义。这是为孩子建立桥樑。”当然，教育系统最好的10个州，其学生的测验成绩更好，毕业率也往往更高。《24/7华尔街》根据2012年教育质量计数报告，找出以下10个最差教育系统的州。
bba7c81e0aaf58256ef8dc62d45e44ffbf8ac0b8.translatedText: Hightower explained: "Ten years ago, this was not a topic of discussion, but education policymakers are finally realizing the importance of giving children consistent messages. Children need to establish goals and understand the education and meaning of their future learning. It is about building bridges for children." Of course, students in the 10 states with the best education systems have better test scores and tend to have higher graduation rates. "24/7 Wall Street" identified the following 10 states with the worst education systems based on the 2012 Education Quality Count report.

The statewide average price was $3.349, 13.2 cents higher than the previous week. Statewide gas prices were 31.5 cents higher in January than in December.

ef8b0b8d1358f65538b60f053b3eef17325e9e8d.translatedText: Influenza has spread in 47 states, and the epidemic situation has dropped in many states. The federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) released an influenza observation report on the 11th, pointing out that 47 states have reported influenza spread...

ed72a43cf6b4ba6ac74dd6b1e4239072ea95b83b.sourceText: 流感蔓延47州 多州疫情降 联邦疾病防治中心(CDC)11日公布流感观察报告指出，目前已有47州报告流感蔓延，比9日的估计多了三州，因流感而死亡的儿童也增加两名，总数达20人。 CDC公布的每周发病率与死亡率报告指出，根据1155名成人和儿童的资料，该局发现今年流感疫苗的有效性为62%。 CDC主任11日也证实，对流感疫苗的高度需求使一些地方发生疫苗缺货，一些地方也报告流感治疗药物克流感(Tamiflu)的儿童版缺货。 CDC 的最新报告涵盖去年12月31日至今年1月5日，报告指出，24州和纽约市有流感大规模蔓延，包括亚利桑那在内的16州有中度蔓延，目前只有加州、佛罗里达和夏威夷州没有报告流感蔓延。 CDC上周的报告显示，有29州发生流感大规模蔓延，CDC希望这代表一些州已经渡过了流感高峰期和病例已经下降。 不过费和平表示，在节日期间很难预测疫情趋势，因为节日期间人们较不可能看医生。 CDC官员指出，西岸未显示大规模的流感蔓延，疫情有可能正在扩大，而在最早报告疫情的南部和东南部，流感蔓延可能已达巅峰，现在资料显示，其病例下降。 从去年10月1日到此报告出炉，估计每10万人中有13.3人因流感而住院，最易患流感的是65岁以上的长者，有其他疾病的成人，如糖尿病、心脏病、肥胖和肺部疾病(不包括气喘)患者更可能因流感住院。有气喘、神经疾病和使免疫力减弱疾病的儿童较可能住院，但儿童中有40%的人没有这些疾病。 纽约市Lenox Hill医院的急诊内科医生葛莱特说，病人的病情今年比去年严重，许多病人因呼吸困难，需要人工呼吸器，许多五岁以下的儿童也有严重的症状，如肌肉疼痛和呕吐。 CDC说，今年的疫苗与病毒菌株的吻​​合性是90%，年龄在6个月以上的人都应该接种疫苗。
ed72a43cf6b4ba6ac74dd6b1e4239072ea95b83b.translatedText: Influenza spreads in 47 states, and the epidemic situation has dropped in many states. The federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) released an influenza observation report on the 11th stating that 47 states have reported the spread of influenza, three more states than the estimate on the 9th, and two more children have died due to influenza, bringing the total to 20. The CDC's weekly morbidity and mortality report states that based on data from 1,155 adults and children, the agency found this year's flu vaccine to be 62% effective. The director of the CDC also confirmed on the 11th that the high demand for influenza vaccines has caused vaccine shortages in some places. Some places also reported shortages of the children's version of the influenza treatment drug Tamiflu. The CDC's latest report covers the period from December 31 last year to January 5 this year. The report states that 24 states and New York City have large-scale influenza spread, and 16 states, including Arizona, have moderate spread. Currently, only California, Florida and Hawaii have not reported influenza spread. The CDC reported last week that 29 states are experiencing large-scale influenza spread, which the CDC hopes means that some states have passed the peak of the flu and cases have declined. However, Fei Heping said that it is difficult to predict the epidemic trend during the holidays because people are less likely to see a doctor during the holidays. CDC officials pointed out that the West Coast did not show large-scale influenza spread, and the epidemic may be expanding. In the south and southeast, where the epidemic was first reported, the spread of influenza may have reached its peak, and now data shows that its cases are declining. From October 1 last year to the release of this report, an estimated 13.3 people per 100,000 people were hospitalized due to influenza. Those most vulnerable to influenza were those over the age of 65. Adults with other medical conditions, such as diabetes, heart disease, obesity and lung disease (excluding asthma), were more likely to be hospitalized due to influenza. Children with asthma, neurological conditions and immune-weakening conditions were more likely to be hospitalized, but 40% of children did not have these conditions. Dr. Greiter, an emergency medicine physician at Lenox Hill Hospital in New York City, said that the condition of patients this year is more serious than last year. Many patients need artificial respirators due to difficulty breathing. Many children under the age of five also have severe symptoms such as muscle pain and vomiting. The CDC says this year's vaccine is 90% consistent with the virus strain, and everyone over the age of 6 months should get the vaccine.

e9ffa33cf7363836cae9f112317c2406109d01ad.translatedText: The 20th General Assembly of the American Longgang General Office of Friendship and Friendship was held in Houston

a78cd204478458ea078699d7992e861565d11e33.sourceText: （张肇鸿来稿） 美洲龙冈亲义总公所创会65周年庆暨第20届恳亲代表大会，首度在美南休士顿召开，于10月31日至11月3日为期四天。
a78cd204478458ea078699d7992e861565d11e33.translatedText: (Contributed by Zhang Zhaohong) The 65th Anniversary Celebration of the Founding of the American Longgang Friendship Association and the 20th Annual General Assembly were held for the first time in South Houston, the United States, for four days from October 31st to November 3rd.

c22b48a0bcfd68c42cbeef724d85b5a622601b80.sourceText: 美洲龙冈第一届预备大会于1928年在罗省举行。1948年在纽约正式定名为「美洲龙冈亲义总公所」。以后每届的恳亲活动，各地公所代表、世谊与眷属齐聚一堂，藉此敦睦情谊和共商会务发展。龙冈团体以忠、义、仁、勇的精神发扬光大，并深得世人认可。龙冈团体业绩昭着，世代传承已65年，在全美洲华埠传统侨社具有影响力。
c22b48a0bcfd68c42cbeef724d85b5a622601b80.translatedText: The first preparatory conference of Longgang America was held in Luo Province in 1928. In 1948, it was officially named the "American Ryoka Chi-yi General Office" in New York. At each subsequent visit, representatives from various offices, friends, and family members will gather together to build friendship and discuss business development. The Longgang Group has carried forward the spirit of loyalty, righteousness, benevolence and courage and has been recognized by the world. The Longgang Group has outstanding achievements and has been passed down from generation to generation for 65 years. It is influential in traditional overseas Chinese communities in Chinatown across America.

2530f9cd7690e85ef7ce8feab9c46a3ba4f68913.sourceText: 本届承办单位休士顿龙冈亲义公所热烈地迎接来自美国、加拿大、墨西哥、秘鲁、及台湾各龙冈公所的的贵客，并提供令人满意的联谊互动平台。
2530f9cd7690e85ef7ce8feab9c46a3ba4f68913.translatedText: The organizer of this year's event, the Houston Longgang Qinyi Office, warmly welcomes distinguished guests from Longgang offices in the United States, Canada, Mexico, Peru, and Taiwan, and provides a satisfactory platform for networking and interaction.

8b140041e241fa8837812ff974650c088afdbfe6.sourceText: 美洲龙冈亲义总公所关健中主席报告三年来的会务进展，世界龙冈亲义总会主席张锦辉向大家报告世总的重要活动，各地分公所在会中讨论提桉，最后选出以张国钦为下一任的主席的新一届领导班子。侨务委员会陈委员长士魁在百忙之中抵休士顿与各公所交流沟通，他以服务到位的精神感动大家，深得侨心广受喝彩。 各地四姓世谊在恳亲会中互相交流，活动温馨亲切。 凤凰城龙冈亲义公所在本届主席张华芳带领下，代表及眷属一行十二人参加了第20届恳亲代表大会。张华芳向大会作了会务报告，并在全体代表的一致决定下，全体上台接受举办下届恳亲大会的授权仪式，将于2016年在美国凤凰城举办美洲龙冈第21届恳亲代表大会。
8b140041e241fa8837812ff974650c088afdbfe6.translatedText: Chairman Guan Jianzhong of the American Longgang Friendship Association reported on the progress of the conference in the past three years. Zhang Jinhui, chairman of the World Longgang Friendship Association, reported to everyone the important activities of the World Association. Branch offices in various places discussed and proposed proposals at the meeting, and finally elected a new leadership team with Zhang Guoqin as the next chairman. Chen Shikui, Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission, came to Houston to communicate with various offices despite his busy schedule. His spirit of service and service moved everyone, and he was widely praised by overseas Chinese. The four surnames from all over the world communicated with each other in the intimate gathering, and the event was warm and cordial. Under the leadership of Zhang Huafang, the current chairman of Longgang Qinyi Office in Phoenix City, twelve representatives and their families attended the 20th Qinqin Representative Conference. Zhang Huafang made a conference report to the conference, and with the unanimous decision of all delegates, they all came to the stage to accept the authorization ceremony for holding the next Qinqin Conference. The 21st Longgang Qinqin Congress of the Americas will be held in Phoenix, USA in 2016.

Representatives and their families visited the city of Houston and the United States Space Agency. Most of them also took a cruise after the conference and went to the world-famous Mayan temple, Chichén Itzá in Mexico, in search of the oldest civilization in mankind.

64f83859f97bcb926af553bec79daa9112e2c278.sourceText: 周三，视察新泽西灾情的奥巴马提醒民众救灾工作需要时间，但承诺联邦政府会提供快速救援。”当前，我们的重点放在新泽西和纽约的重建上，但是我们也非常担心康涅狄格州和西弗吉尼亚州的情况，这四个州是飓风的重灾区。” 支持共和党总统候选人罗姆尼的新泽西州长克里斯蒂一向是共和党批评奥巴马的领军人物，但这次他却对奥巴马应对飓风的表现进行了热情洋溢的赞扬。”我对奥巴马个人对新泽西州人民安危的关心表示衷心的感谢。”奥巴马对克里斯蒂的抗灾努力也提出表扬，”克里斯蒂全身心的投入到抗灾中去，这一精神，值得我们学习。”
64f83859f97bcb926af553bec79daa9112e2c278.translatedText: On Wednesday, Obama, who inspected the disaster situation in New Jersey, reminded the public that disaster relief work will take time, but promised that the federal government will provide rapid relief. "Currently, our focus is on the reconstruction of New Jersey and New York, but we are also very worried about the situation in Connecticut and West Virginia. These four states are the hardest hit by the hurricane." New Jersey Governor Christie, who supports Republican presidential candidate Mitt Romney, has always been a leader in Republican criticism of Obama, but this time he enthusiastically praised Obama's performance in handling the hurricane. "I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Obama for his personal concern for the safety of the people of New Jersey." Obama also praised Christie's efforts in disaster relief, "Christie devoted himself wholeheartedly to disaster relief. This spirit is worth learning from."

89b4203588dd281c4ec21fbfd49257f24a80edea.translatedText: The worst drought in decades has affected 48 states. A drought tracking organization recently stated that the United States has experienced the worst drought in decades, with 4 states including Arizona...

aeae6a2ddf0adbdf9bace8cd233965bbc1246f3e.sourceText: 遇几十年最严重干旱 48州受灾 一个干旱追踪组织近日表示，美国发生数十年来最严重的干旱，包括亚利桑那州在内的48州中有60%的土地遭遇旱灾。除了缺雨之外，科学家正在寻找其它原因。 今夏以来美国一半以上的陆地遭遇了干旱，9月底以来随着暴雨的出现而逐渐缓和。但21日发表的每周?#32654;国干旱监测报告?#26174;示，全国越来越多的地区遭受干旱而且情况严重。 报告称，至20日为止，较南方的48州中有60.1% 遭受了某种程度的干旱，高于前一周的58.8%。遭遇极度干旱或异常干旱这两种最遭情况的土地面积，从18.3%上升至19.04%。 报告指出，全国中央及德州和东南部的部分地区，是干旱情况最严重的地区。这些地区被其它情况不太严重的州包围，只有西北部、佛州和从新英格兰南部至密西西比的狭长带没有受灾。 全国海洋和大气管理局下属的国家气候数据中心气象专家海姆表示，关于干旱为什么持续发生，或预计将持续多久，没有科学上的明确解释。引发这种天气的因素很多。 少雨的天气影响了农作物。近四分之一冬小麦的发芽条件很差或非常差，这比上周上升了2%，比2011年同期上升8%。42%的种植物被形容为情况较差，与上周相同。 在这种情况下，仍可能照常灌溉的农场主担心河流和水库出现低水位，很多人希望下雪来缓解困境，但这需要很多雪。
aeae6a2ddf0adbdf9bace8cd233965bbc1246f3e.translatedText: The worst drought in decades has affected 48 states. A drought tracking organization recently stated that the United States is experiencing the worst drought in decades, with 60% of the land in 48 states, including Arizona, suffering from drought. Scientists are looking for other reasons besides lack of rain. Since this summer, more than half of the landmass in the United States has experienced drought, which has gradually eased with the occurrence of heavy rains since the end of September. However, the weekly national drought monitoring report released on the 21st showed that more and more areas across the country are suffering from drought and the situation is serious. The report stated that as of the 20th, 60.1% of the 48 southern states had suffered some degree of drought, up from 58.8% the previous week. The area of ​​land experiencing extreme drought or abnormal drought, the two worst-case scenarios, increased from 18.3% to 19.04%. The report pointed out that the central part of the country and parts of Texas and the Southeast are the areas with the most serious drought conditions. These areas were surrounded by other less severe states, with the exception of the Northwest, Florida, and the panhandle from southern New England to the Mississippi. There's no clear scientific explanation for why droughts continue to occur or how long they're expected to last, said Heim, a meteorologist at the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration's National Climatology Data Center. There are many factors that cause this weather. The lack of rain affected crops. Nearly a quarter of the winter wheat crop has poor or very poor germination conditions, which is a 2 percent increase from last week and an 8 percent increase from the same period in 2011. 42% of species were described as in poor condition, the same as last week. In this case, farmers who may still be able to irrigate as usual are worried about low water levels in rivers and reservoirs, and many are hoping for snow to alleviate their difficulties, but this will require a lot of snow.

6245c6b66d6ab585f30b4cb270f8c01bbf6e74ca.translatedText: Americans are expected to have to work a few more years, and the retirement age will be extended to 67 years old (Alberta Times) The Great Recession of 2007 to 2009 has upended...

fa7095df825a7a1b7af67d6d860243c9f358a853.sourceText: 2007 年至 2009 年经济大衰退已经颠覆了美国人对退休的期待。根据盖洛普最新民意调查，自上世纪 90 年代中期以来，美国人平均期待退休的年龄已逐步往后延，目前已延到 67 岁。这比起 1996 年时人们预计 60 岁退休，有了显著的变化。
fa7095df825a7a1b7af67d6d860243c9f358a853.translatedText: The Great Recession of 2007 to 2009 has upended Americans' expectations for retirement. Since the mid-1990s, the average age at which Americans expect to retire has been gradually pushed back to 67, according to a new Gallup poll. This is a significant change from 1996, when people were expected to retire at age 60.

8970c096164692535e9ce1e2a4dd6b3ac7b92d60.sourceText: 这项调查与近来其他研究结果一致：由于经济衰退、金融危机、高失业率和房地产泡沫破灭后，美国人的退休计划已受到重大打击。
8970c096164692535e9ce1e2a4dd6b3ac7b92d60.translatedText: The survey is consistent with other recent research: Americans' retirement plans have taken a major hit due to the recession, financial crisis, high unemployment and the aftermath of the housing bubble.

b11524d88f793f8b2e841255d652b2bf072ea75e.sourceText: 据雇员福利研究机构 EBRI 的退休年度调查， 5 年前，只有 16 ％的美国人表示，将推迟至 70 岁或以后退休；现在有 26 ％的受访者如是说。
b11524d88f793f8b2e841255d652b2bf072ea75e.translatedText: Five years ago, only 16% of Americans said they would delay retirement until age 70 or later; now 26% say the same.

6fcaf186d5b2bf5a9236292dcfa287335bda9ba8.sourceText: EBRI 做这项调查已有 22 年历史了，它发现推迟退休最普遍提及的原因，是经济不景气、对社会保障制度缺乏信心，以及就业形势的变化。
6fcaf186d5b2bf5a9236292dcfa287335bda9ba8.translatedText: EBRI, which has been conducting this survey for 22 years, found that the most commonly cited reasons for delaying retirement were the economic downturn, lack of confidence in the social security system, and changes in the employment situation.

af0bc6e5ad50e7a726d1c1748789a7beaa736eca.sourceText: 在这项调查中， 50% 受访者期待 65 岁能退休，只有 8% 认为 60 岁之前可以享有较休闲的退休生活。这在 1991 年时，相同调查比例却各是 84% 和 19% 。
af0bc6e5ad50e7a726d1c1748789a7beaa736eca.translatedText: In this survey, 50% of the respondents expected to retire at the age of 65, and only 8% believed that they could enjoy a more leisurely retirement life before the age of 60. In 1991, the same survey proportions were 84% and 19% respectively.

82c2de79c7b07ba28412731fe04bb0a96085d1de.sourceText: 尽管如此，年轻的打工族比他们年长的同行更为乐观。
82c2de79c7b07ba28412731fe04bb0a96085d1de.translatedText: Still, young workers are more optimistic than their older counterparts.

edf7eb3e3603e1d40654d4dc0377dcb8bbb9c74a.sourceText: 盖洛普 4 月中旬进行的年度” 经济和个人财务” 调查中，目前 40 岁以下的人，希望在 65 岁退休。 40 岁及以上还未退休的，则估计 68 岁退休。
edf7eb3e3603e1d40654d4dc0377dcb8bbb9c74a.translatedText: According to Gallup's annual "Economy and Personal Finance" survey conducted in mid-April, people under the age of 40 currently hope to retire by the age of 65. If you are 40 years old or above and have not yet retired, you are expected to retire at 68 years old.

4bd679c8bcd2b7f9e8dcdce6151f2acaeaff8f13.sourceText: 不过，如很多事情一样，事与愿违。盖洛普发现，自 2004 年以来，退休年龄大约在 60 岁左右，虽然自上世纪 90 年代初的 57 岁已经有所延后了。
4bd679c8bcd2b7f9e8dcdce6151f2acaeaff8f13.translatedText: However, like many things, it backfired. Gallup found that since 2004, the retirement age has been around 60, although it has been pushed back from 57 in the early 1990s.

f5612b402f49b7393e6ea1cfd37914600cd3d64e.sourceText: 尽管如此，平均退休年龄，预计在未来几年内还会往后延。一个主要的罪魁祸首似乎是钱。超过一半尚未退休的人不认为他们将有足够的钱，退休后可以过得舒适。
f5612b402f49b7393e6ea1cfd37914600cd3d64e.translatedText: Despite this, the average retirement age is expected to be extended in the next few years. One major culprit seems to be money. More than half of people who have not yet retired do not believe they will have enough money to live comfortably in retirement.

c583e1a611c573796c001580336d7c35517b486d.sourceText: 现在美国人平均寿命是 78 岁。即使延后退休时间，应该仍然能够享受一些黄金岁月。
c583e1a611c573796c001580336d7c35517b486d.translatedText: The average life expectancy in the United States is now 78 years. Even if you delay retirement, you should still be able to enjoy some of your golden years.
