b8a97308bb75766e313f06ed05fc347007c77279.sourceText: 《投资理财》掌握投资10招 今年赚饱 （亚省时报） 去年史坦普500指数几乎以平盘作收，道琼工业指数则上涨5.5%，表现相对出色，投资10档道琼狗股（Dogs of the Dow）的投资人更远胜大盘。 今年在欧债危机和全球经济成长减缓的威胁下，MarketWatch网站提出十项建议，希望协助投资人在市场出奇制胜。 ●紧抱2011年的赢家。 今年投资人面临的挑战和2011年类似，这意味去年的赢家今年将延续气势。 因此，「道琼狗股」仍是投资首选。 他们包括AT&T、威瑞森（Verizon）、默克（Merck）、辉瑞、奇异（GE）、杜邦、娇生、英特尔、宝硷（P&G）和卡夫（Kraft）。 其中又以AT&T的股利收益率最高。 ●持有防御股。 今年先进国家将持续去杠杆化，投资人应注意保本和维持现金流，同时布局防御股，典型的防御股包括必需消费类股、医疗和公营事业类股。 其中，史坦普（S&P）旗下Capital IQ公司分析师首推必需消费类股。 ●买进景气循环股。 Capital IQ在研究报告中说：「在市况动荡下，平衡布局景气循环股和防御股是最佳策略。」因此，投资人可买进去年表现落后的类股，包括原物料、工业、能源和 科技等。 共同基金业者Leuthold集团投资长莱姆锡说：「部份超跌的景气循环股将会卷土重来。」他推荐铁路、化学、工业和原物料公司的股票。 ●紧抱配息的成长型股票。 美国企业的资产负债表大致上很稳健，但在成长减速的环境下，顶尖企业拥有最多优势。 他们的特色是对经济较不敏感大型股、事业多元化、现金流强劲，以及善用资本进行并购、实施​​库藏股与固定发放高股息等。 Gluskin Sheff&Associates投资公司操盘手罗森伯格表示，股利收益率超越美国公债的优质企业包括AT&T、3M、艾克森美孚、爱默生电器（Emerson Electric）、麦当劳、娇生、高露洁和沃尔玛 等。 其他高收益防御股则有宝硷和微软等。 ●考虑买进小型股。 去年以大型股为主的罗素1000指数上涨1.5%，但小型股组成的罗素2000指数下跌4.2%。 李察伯恩斯坦投顾公司执行长伯恩斯坦认为，今年情况可能逆转，「全球股市最安全的投资标的是美国小型股」。 美银美林公司策略师德桑克蒂说，小型股的优势之一是对国际市场曝险不高，较不受美元升值冲击。 他推荐公司规模较大的优质小型股，理由是并购市场热络将使他们受惠。 ●考虑优质欧股。 欧元区经济可能已陷入衰退，美银美林全球股市策略师哈奈特建议买进「最优质且严重超跌」的股票。 他说：「欧股相对于美股被超卖的程度创20年来最大，趁现在买进获利强劲、资产负债表稳健与毛利率坚挺的个股。」他推荐西班牙电信（Telefonica）、道达尔石油 （Total）和英国石油（BP）等。 ●美元为王。 市场普遍预料，今年欧元将会进一步走贬，BBH公司甚至断言第二季欧元汇价将跌到1欧元兑1.2美元。 倘若成真，美元将成为最大受益者。 美元指数已从去年一路涨到今年初；德银美元指数多头指数基金去年下半年也劲扬6%。 A.Gary Shilling投顾公司总裁席林指出，除了欧元，今年美元也兑澳元、加元和墨西哥披索等商品货币也将走升。 ●紧抱黄金。 美银美林策略师哈奈特预期，今年欧洲和其他国家央行将印更多钞票来解决债务危机，有利黄金上攻。 他说：「黄金仍是因应全球债务去杠杆的冲击的最佳工具。」史坦普析师也看好黄金后市，预估今年底前金价将冲上每盎斯1900元。 ●买进总统大选概念股。 从历史经验来看，每个选举年美股平均上涨6%，表现最突出的类股包括必需消费、能源和工业股；但科技、原物料与公营事业类股表现低于平均水准。 股票交易员年鉴的则资料显示，现任总统连任有利选举年的美股上涨。 ●市场动荡，安全与稳定收益至上。 今年市况预料将维持动荡，基金操盘手罗森伯格建议投资人采取稳健、弹性的策略，可考虑买进优质股票和债券、收益型石油与天然气合资事业，以及不动产投资信托基金等。 此外，贵金属也是理想的标的。
b8a97308bb75766e313f06ed05fc347007c77279.translatedText: "Investment and Finance" Master 10 Investment Tips to Make a Lot of Money This Year (Alberta Times) Last year, the S&P 500 Index almost ended at a flat level, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 5.5%, a relatively outstanding performance. Investors who invested in the 10 Dogs of the Dow outperformed the broader market. This year, under the threat of the European debt crisis and slowing global economic growth, the MarketWatch website has put forward ten suggestions, hoping to help investors win unexpectedly in the market. ●Hold on to the 2011 winners. The challenges faced by investors this year are similar to those in 2011, which means last year's winners will continue their momentum this year. Therefore, "Dow Jones Dog Stocks" are still the first choice for investment. They include AT&T, Verizon, Merck, Pfizer, GE, DuPont, Johnson & Johnson, Intel, P&G and Kraft. Among them, AT&T has the highest dividend yield. ●Hold defensive stocks. This year, advanced countries will continue to deleverage. Investors should pay attention to capital preservation and cash flow maintenance, while arranging defensive stocks. Typical defensive stocks include consumer staples stocks, medical and public utility stocks. Among them, analysts from Capital IQ, a subsidiary of S&P, first recommended consumer staples stocks. ●Buy cyclical stocks. Capital IQ said in a research report: "Under turbulent market conditions, a balanced layout of cyclical stocks and defensive stocks is the best strategy." Therefore, investors can buy stocks that underperformed last year, including raw materials, industrials, energy and technology. "Some oversold cyclical stocks will make a comeback," said Leuthold Group Chief Investment Officer Leuthold Group, which recommends stocks in railroads, chemicals, industrials and raw materials companies. ●Growth stocks that cling to dividends. U.S. corporate balance sheets are generally strong, but in an environment of slowing growth, top companies have the most advantages. Their characteristics are large-cap stocks that are less sensitive to the economy, business diversification, strong cash flow, and good use of capital for mergers and acquisitions, implementation of treasury shares, and fixed high dividends. Rosenberg, a trader at Gluskin Sheff & Associates Investment Company, said that high-quality companies with dividend yields exceeding U.S. Treasury bonds include AT&T, 3M, Exxon Mobil, Emerson Electric, McDonald's, Johnson & Johnson, Colgate and Walmart. Other high-yield defensive stocks include Pauline and Microsoft. ●Consider buying small-cap stocks. The large-cap Russell 1000 index rose 1.5% last year, but the small-cap Russell 2000 index fell 4.2%. Bernstein, CEO of Richard Bernstein Investment Consulting, believes that the situation may be reversed this year. "The safest investment target in the global stock market is U.S. small-cap stocks." De Sankti, a strategist at Bank of America Merrill Lynch, said that one of the advantages of small-cap stocks is that they are less exposed to the international market and are less affected by the appreciation of the U.S. dollar. He recommends high-quality small-cap stocks with larger companies, arguing that they will benefit from the hot merger and acquisition market. ●Consider high-quality European stocks. The euro zone economy may have fallen into recession, and Bank of America Merrill Lynch global equity strategist Hartnett recommends buying "the best quality and severely oversold" stocks. He said: "European stocks are the most oversold relative to U.S. stocks in 20 years. Take advantage now to buy stocks with strong profits, solid balance sheets and strong gross profit margins." He recommended Telefonica, Total and BP. ●The dollar is king. The market generally expects that the euro will further depreciate this year, and BBH even asserted that the euro exchange rate will fall to 1 euro to 1.2 U.S. dollars in the second quarter. If this comes true, the U.S. dollar will be the biggest beneficiary. The US dollar index has risen all the way from last year to the beginning of this year; the Deutsche Bank US dollar index long index fund also rose by 6% in the second half of last year. Shilling, president of A.Gary Shilling Investment Consulting, pointed out that in addition to the euro, the U.S. dollar will also rise against commodity currencies such as the Australian dollar, Canadian dollar and Mexican peso this year. ●Embrace gold. Bank of America Merrill Lynch strategist Hartnett expects that central banks in Europe and other countries will print more money this year to solve the debt crisis, which will benefit gold. He said: "Gold is still the best tool to cope with the impact of global debt deleveraging." Analysts at S&P are also optimistic about the future of gold, predicting that the price of gold will reach 1,900 yuan per ounce before the end of this year. ●Buy presidential election concept stocks. Judging from historical experience, U.S. stocks rose by an average of 6% in each election year, with the most outstanding performing stocks including consumer staples, energy and industrial stocks; however, technology, raw materials and public utility stocks performed below average. According to data from the Stock Trader's Almanac, the re-election of the current president is beneficial to the rise of U.S. stocks in the election year. ●The market is turbulent, safety and stable income are paramount. Market conditions are expected to remain volatile this year. Fund trader Rosenberg recommends that investors adopt a prudent and flexible strategy and consider buying high-quality stocks and bonds, income-generating oil and gas joint ventures, and real estate investment trust funds. In addition, precious metals are also ideal targets.

3c60402ffa5f176a4b6236e9bc1558b404693538.sourceText: 9月24日，是本州启用安博警报系统十周年纪念日。 安博警报系统，AMBER Alert system，全称美国失踪人员紧急广播响应系统，1996年1月13日，安博哈格曼被绑架案被杀案发生后，美国司法部在1996年建立此系统，用以拯救 失踪儿童，时至今日，已有490多名儿童因此获救，全美50个州都有自己的安博警报系统。 亚利桑那州自2002年启用以来，共发出过70个安博警报，最近一次使用在九岁格兰岱女童杰西肖克利失踪案。 州公共安全部将失踪儿童的信息和六个月内的近照，通过当地电视台、电台、运输部门，向公众密集发布。 除了近照，失踪者的家长或监护人必须有提交一个书面说明，说明失踪者的头发颜色、眼睛颜色、身高、体重、出生日期和独特的身体特征，如眼睛，牙套，耳洞等，和出生 证明，国家儿童失踪中心建议每个家长和监护人都应保持自家儿童以上识别信息，以防万一。
3c60402ffa5f176a4b6236e9bc1558b404693538.translatedText: September 24 is the tenth anniversary of the launch of the Amber Alert system in this state. AMBER Alert system, the full name of the American Missing Persons Emergency Broadcast Response System, was established by the U.S. Department of Justice in 1996 after the kidnapping and murder of Amber Hagerman on January 13, 1996 to rescue missing children. To date, more than 490 children have been rescued, and all 50 states in the United States have their own AMBER Alert systems. A total of 70 AMBER Alerts have been issued in Arizona since its inception in 2002, most recently in the case of the disappearance of nine-year-old Glendale girl Jesse Shockley. The state Department of Public Safety intensively releases information and recent photos of missing children to the public through local television stations, radio stations, and transportation departments. In addition to a recent photo, the parent or guardian of the missing child must submit a written statement describing the missing person’s hair color, eye color, height, weight, date of birth and unique physical characteristics such as eyes, braces, ear piercings, etc., and a birth certificate. The National Center for Missing Children recommends that every parent and guardian keep the above identifying information for their child as a precaution.

b27ff4f52e12f284c012481f3d7adf2a35461d79.sourceText: 亚利桑那大学生债务惊人 五年上涨26% 《亚省时报》 近日公布一项研究显示，亚省大学本科学生离校时平均有22,178美元的学费贷款债务，比五年前增加了26%，而研究生毕业时平均有学费债务47,803美元，比2007年增长了40%。以上数字还不包括学生从父母亲友中得到的资助。 尽管亚利桑那州三所州立大学的学生贷款债务低于全国平均水平，但教育和金融专家说，越来越多的债务将迫使众多大学生一毕业即陷入还贷的困境中，加上经济不景，就业市场疲软，使得不少人叫苦不迭。 《纽约时报》报道说，在获得学士学位的美国大学生中，有2/3学生是通过借钱来支付高等教育费用的。相比之下，1993年的时候这个比例还只是45%。 调查发现，2011年美国大学毕业生平均负债23800美元，其中10%的大学生负债超过54000美元，3%的大学毕业生负债超过10万美元，目前大学生贷款债务的总额已经突破1万亿美元，超过了信用卡债务的总量，成为美国第一大债务负担。 在本州，自2007年以来，ASU学费上涨了96%，UA涨了99%，NAU的新本科生涨了92%。前不久，在立法者、家长和学生与州大学管理委员会达成协议，未来四年内，三所州立大学学费暂停上涨。这是本州20年来首次冻结学费增长。 一直以来，亚利桑那州的州立大学系统以低学费吸引不少莘莘学子。根据大学委员会2011年数据，本州大学生欠债21,158美元，相对低于全国平均数的23,800美元。全国公立大学中有57%本科学生欠债，而亚利桑那州有54%。 根据美国法律，绿卡持有者和公民上大学都可以申请联邦政府斯塔夫的助学贷款，年利率只有3.4%，但是四年本科的限额为2.3万美元，只相当于总学费的1/6，许多学生就只好再求助于高息的商业教育贷款。 今年国会为了延长学生低息贷款，其代价大约要60亿美元，在国会两党缠斗到6月29日的最后一刻才夺冠。奥巴马政府要求地方政府要多出力保证教育的支出，同时威胁削减联邦政府支付给地方的教育拨款，这也是国会两党日吵夜吵的财政悬崖议题之一。 在亚利桑那州，一旦国会两党谈崩，州政府将失去每年428万联邦拨款。州大学委员会宣称，到时唯有推翻上述冻结学费上涨条例，提高学费50%来纾解财政困境。
b27ff4f52e12f284c012481f3d7adf2a35461d79.translatedText: The debt of Arizona college students is staggering, rising by 26% in five years. "Alberta Times" A study released recently showed that the average undergraduate student at an Alberta university left school with a tuition loan debt of $22,178, an increase of 26% from five years ago, while the average graduate student graduated with a tuition debt of $47,803, an increase of 40% from 2007. The above figures do not include the financial support students receive from parents, relatives and friends. Although student loan debt at Arizona's three state universities is below the national average, education and financial experts say growing debt will force many college students into the dilemma of repaying loans as soon as they graduate. Coupled with the economic downturn and weak job market, many people are complaining. The New York Times reported that two-thirds of American college students who received a bachelor's degree borrowed money to pay for higher education. By comparison, in 1993 this proportion was only 45%. The survey found that the average debt of American college graduates in 2011 was US$23,800, of which 10% had debts of more than US$54,000, and 3% of college graduates had debts of more than US$100,000. Currently, the total amount of college loan debt has exceeded US$1 trillion, exceeding the total amount of credit card debt and becoming the largest debt burden in the United States. In-state, since 2007, tuition has increased by 96% at ASU, 99% at UA, and 92% for new undergraduate students at NAU. Not long ago, three state universities suspended tuition increases for the next four years after lawmakers, parents and students reached an agreement with the state university governing board. This is the first time in 20 years that the state has frozen tuition increases. Arizona's state university system has always attracted many students with low tuition fees. According to 2011 data from the College Board, state college students owe $21,158 in debt, which is relatively lower than the national average of $23,800. Fifty-seven percent of undergraduate students at public universities nationwide have debt, and 54% in Arizona. According to U.S. law, green card holders and citizens can apply for student loans from the federal government when going to college. The annual interest rate is only 3.4%. However, the limit for a four-year undergraduate degree is US$23,000, which is only equivalent to 1/6 of the total tuition. Many students have to resort to high-interest commercial education loans. This year, Congress spent about $6 billion to extend low-interest student loans. The two parties in Congress fought until the last minute on June 29 to win the victory. The Obama administration requires local governments to spend more on education and threatens to cut federal funding for local education. This is one of the fiscal cliff issues that the two parties in Congress are arguing about day and night. In Arizona, once the two parties in Congress collapse, the state government will lose $4.28 million in annual federal funding. The State College Board declared that the only way to relieve the financial difficulties would be to overturn the above-mentioned freeze on tuition increases and raise tuition by 50%.

7579352ef0c05589e4bd3067f6ba513ecb35d5c0.sourceText: 24岁华裔女子惨遭刺死 白人男友落网 （亚省时报） 定居圣塔芭芭拉的24岁华裔女生唐乔斯（Alexandra Joyce Tang，译音），1日在拉古纳冈男友居住的民宅被刺死。25岁男友宾斯基（Derek Pinski）当晚在本州美莎被逮捕，将面临谋杀控罪。 橙县警局报告显示，1日上午近11时15分，警方及消防人员据报赶到Caminito Tasquillo22000街区的一栋民宅，发现屋主正对一名女子做心肺复甦术。医疗人员接手，但仍回天乏术。 警方之后确认，死者是定居圣塔芭芭拉的唐乔斯，全身有多处被刺伤口，与宾斯基是男女朋友关系。 九小时后、即1日晚间近8时半，宾斯基在350哩以外的亚利桑纳州逮捕。橙县警局已赶往搜集证据。 据瞭解，宾斯基案发后逃离现场，将接受谋杀控罪。 命案发生在拉古纳冈北边入口写着「拉古纳村」（Laguna Village）社区内，社区拥有900多栋集合住宅。命案发生的Caminito Tasquillo22000街区都是一层楼。由于每户紧紧相连，照说案发时若有人尖叫，恐怕难逃邻居耳朵。 三名邻居指称，社区有住家协会管理，一向安全，对发生兇案感到震惊。他们并称，不远处停着的一辆大型厢形车，是警方派来清理命案现场的工作车，唯工作人员以「无可奉告」回答记者提问，也不愿确认面对的民宅就是日昨发生命案的民宅。 民宅则无人应门，左邻右舍也无人应门。一位邻居说，该栋民宅由一名妇女和她的儿子住，但与这名妇女不熟，只是昨天突然间看到很多警车及消防车在附近进出。 另一名推着婴儿车与妻子走在附近的男士山姆说，嫌犯的妈妈曾提及嫌犯就读于圣塔芭芭拉加大。 根据嫌犯在最大的专业网站Linkedin所称，他曾就读橙县海岸社区学院心理系，之后转学到圣塔芭芭拉加大心理系，2011年毕业，拥有心理学学士学位。嫌犯今年5月起服务于Whole Food Market。 嫌犯身高六呎三吋，为棕髮棕眼的白人。
7579352ef0c05589e4bd3067f6ba513ecb35d5c0.translatedText: A 24-year-old Chinese woman was stabbed to death and her white boyfriend was arrested (Alberta Times) Alexandra Joyce Tang, a 24-year-old Chinese girl who lives in Santa Barbara, was stabbed to death at the home where her boyfriend lived in Laguna Hills on the 1st. Her 25-year-old boyfriend Derek Pinski was arrested in Mesa, this state, and will face murder charges. The Orange County Police Department reported that at nearly 11:15 a.m. on the 1st, police and firefighters arrived at Caminito. The owner of a house in the 22000 block of Tasquillo was found performing cardiopulmonary resuscitation on a woman. Medical personnel took over, but she was still unable to survive. The police later confirmed that the deceased was Don José, who had multiple stab wounds all over his body. He was a boyfriend and girlfriend. Nine hours later, at nearly 8:30 pm on the 1st, Binski was arrested in Arizona, 350 miles away. The Orange County Police Department rushed to collect evidence. It is understood that Binski fled the scene after the incident and will be charged with murder. The murder occurred in the community of "Laguna Village" at the north entrance of Laguna. The community has more than 900 residential buildings. Since the houses in the 22000 block of Caminito Tasquillo where the murder occurred are all one-story, it is said that if someone screamed at the time of the incident, they would not be able to escape the ears of the neighbors. Three neighbors claimed that the community is managed by a housing association and has always been safe, and they were shocked by the murder. They also said that a large van parked not far away was a work vehicle sent by the police to clean up the murder scene. However, the staff responded with "no comment" and refused to confirm that the house they faced was the one where the murder occurred yesterday. No one answered the door of the house, and no one answered the door of the neighbors. A neighbor said that the house was occupied by a woman and her son, but he was not familiar with the woman, but suddenly saw many police cars and fire trucks coming in and out of the neighborhood yesterday. Another man, Sam, who was walking with his wife in a stroller, said that the suspect's mother had mentioned that the suspect was studying at the University of California, Santa Barbara. According to the suspect's statement on Linkedin, the largest professional website, he studied in the Department of Psychology at Orange County Coast Community College and then transferred to the Department of Psychology at the University of California, Santa Barbara. He graduated in 2011 with a bachelor's degree in psychology. The suspect has been working at Whole Food Market since May this year. He is a white man with brown hair and brown eyes.

61ebac21e78bc8e56b0c4f936292f505862da82f.sourceText: 新式麦酒饮料 17州促停产 CNN报导，17个州与美国属地的司法厅长正敦促Pabst酿造公司停止生产由饶舌歌手Snoop Dogg宣传的新式麦酒饮料，也不要再向年轻人营销这种产品。 这种采用鲜艳图案的23.5盎斯罐装饮料，猛一看像汽水，其实酒精含量高达12%，比普通啤酒还烈。马里兰州司法厅长甘斯勒(Douglas Gansler)致函Pabst公司说，该公司的’Blast’ by Colt 45系列饮料是鼓励年轻人酗酒的罐装产品。 亚利桑那、加州、康乃狄克、关岛、爱达荷、爱阿华、伊利诺、肯塔基、缅因、麻州、新墨西哥、俄亥俄、俄克拉荷马、田纳西、犹他和华盛顿州的司法厅长，以及旧金山市司法主管，都加入甘斯勒的行列。 维权团体和政治人士质疑Pabst公司的宣传广告方式，使这家制造掺杂果汁饮料的企业成为众矢之的。 马里兰州司法厅说：「他们用每一罐就是一份饮料的方式推销这种产品，其实一罐就有五杯的份量。我们希望他们能够做个良好的企业公民。」 媒体观察组织「企业之耳」(Industry Ears)说，Colt 45的厂商把原已经很高的6%酒精含量提高到12%，并用嘻哈主题和棒棒糖口味吸引年轻人，在儿童之间推广市场。 面对外界批评，Pabst公司营销主管说：「Blast是为已达到法定饮酒年龄的人制造的产品。就像Pabst所有产品一样，Blast的营销方式致力于传达用负责的态度饮酒的信息，Blast的包装上也明白标示其酒精含量。」
61ebac21e78bc8e56b0c4f936292f505862da82f.translatedText: New ale drink 17 states push to stop production CNN reported that the attorneys general of 17 states and U.S. territories are urging Pabst Brewing Company to stop producing a new ale drink promoted by rapper Snoop Dogg and stop marketing the product to young people. This 23.5-ounce canned drink with bright patterns looks like soda at first glance, but it actually contains 12% alcohol, which is stronger than ordinary beer. Maryland Attorney General Douglas Gansler sent a letter to Pabst, saying the company's 'Blast' by Colt 45 series of canned drinks encourage young people to engage in alcohol abuse. Gansler was joined by the attorneys general of Arizona, California, Connecticut, Guam, Idaho, Iowa, Illinois, Kentucky, Maine, Massachusetts, New Mexico, Ohio, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Utah and Washington, as well as the city of San Francisco's attorney general. Advocacy groups and politicians have questioned Pabst's advertising methods, putting the maker of adulterated juice drinks in the crosshairs. The Maryland Department of Justice said: "They market this product by saying that each can is one drink, when in fact there are five drinks in one can. We hope they can be a good corporate citizen." Media observation organization "Industry Ears" said that the manufacturer of Colt 45 increased the already high alcohol content of 6% to 12%, and used hip-hop themes and lollipop flavors to attract young people and promote the market among children. In the face of external criticism, Pabst's marketing director said: "Blast is a product made for people who have reached the legal drinking age. Like all Pabst products, Blast's marketing method is committed to conveying the message of drinking responsibly, and Blast's packaging also clearly states its alcohol content."

fae9b3a84bfd54b62dd6907d2fc6df20ca7f3ef7.sourceText: 芝加哥40名学生从中国买假驾照被捕 【侨报编译旭明7月22日报道】 芝加哥地区的40名中学生和大学生因为通过互联网从中国购买假驾照，被当地警方逮捕。 据美联社报道，伊利诺伊州库克县司法长官达特22日说，这40名学生是过去几周被指控行为不当而被捕的。警方是由芝加哥奥海尔国际机场今年早些时候查获从中国来的1700张假驾照，顺藤摸瓜查获这些学生的。 达特透露，这些驾照是藏在要运往芝加哥许多地方的珠宝、玩具和网络摄像头的盒子里，每个学生们付了75到100美元，假驾照几乎到了以假乱真的程度。 被捕的学生年龄在17岁到20岁之间，因为他们没有更改姓名、地址、生日等，所以很容易就被警方查到。有些人甚至购买了假的外州驾照。 这些学生本来被控以重罪，但达特说，最后他们被控以试图获得假驾照的行为不当，被罚社区服务25小时，有的还被罚款。 警方说，其实这只是他们付出的最小代价，他们还可能因为透露个人信息而面临身份盗窃，家庭财产损失的代价。达特说，一些小孩只因为想通过假证件而喝上酒而放弃一切。 达特表示，产自中国的假驾照过去几个月迅速增加，预期还会继续增加，因为很难让网站负责任地运营，也无法关闭处于海外的网站。
fae9b3a84bfd54b62dd6907d2fc6df20ca7f3ef7.translatedText: > 40 students in Chicago were arrested for buying fake driver's licenses from China [reported by Xuming compiled by Qiaobao on July 22] Forty middle school and college students in the Chicago area were arrested by local police for purchasing fake driver's licenses from China through the Internet. According to the Associated Press, Cook County Sheriff Dart in Illinois said on the 22nd that the 40 students were arrested in the past few weeks on charges of misconduct. Police found the students after they seized 1,700 fake driver's licenses from China at Chicago's O'Hare International Airport earlier this year. Dart revealed that these driver's licenses were hidden in boxes of jewelry, toys and webcams that were shipped to many places in Chicago. Each student paid $75 to $100, and the fake driver's licenses were almost as fake as real ones. The arrested students were aged between 17 and 20 years old. Because they did not change their names, addresses, birthdays, etc., they were easily traced by the police. Some people even purchase fake out-of-state driver's licenses. The students were originally charged with felonies, but Dart said they ended up being charged with misconduct for trying to obtain a fake driver's license and were fined 25 hours of community service and some were fined. The police said that in fact, this is only the minimum price they pay. They may also face identity theft and loss of family property for disclosing personal information. Dart said some kids give up everything just because they want to get drunk on fake documents. Dart said the number of fake driver's licenses produced in China has increased rapidly in the past few months and is expected to continue to increase because it is difficult to make websites operate responsibly, and it is impossible to shut down websites located overseas.

7e9ae0aaa920e1a8ac1c9251134d1950cc242c77.sourceText: 通用因变速箱问题 召回47万辆车 通用汽车公司(General Motors)21日宣布召回近47万4000辆三种品牌的车，以修复可能导致车辆意外滑动的变速箱问题。 召回的汽车包括2007至2010年款的Chevrolet Malibu、Pontiac G6和Saturn Aura车，全部为四速的自动传动。这批车除了在美国、加拿大和墨西哥市场销售外，还有少量出口到其他国家。 通用公司说，部分车的传动缆线会发生断裂，造成变速箱出现一种假象，排档明明处于停车位置，但实际上却仍挂在档上。公司说，这种问题已造成四起车祸，但没有人受伤。但联邦政府去年开始调查七起撞车事故报告，其中一起造成一人受伤。 车行维修时，将在传动缆线的底端安装一个加固装置，或是更换新缆线。车主将会接到何时去车行检修的通知。 联邦政府对通用汽车发生的此类问题进行了调查，通用公司向政府提供了资料，发现了车的传动缆线问题。
7e9ae0aaa920e1a8ac1c9251134d1950cc242c77.translatedText: General Motors recalls 470,000 vehicles due to gearbox problems General Motors (General Motors) announced on the 21st that it is recalling nearly 474,000 vehicles of three brands to repair transmission problems that may cause the vehicles to slide unexpectedly. The recalled vehicles include Chevrolet Malibu, Pontiac G6 and Saturn Aura vehicles from model years 2007 to 2010, all with four-speed automatic transmissions. In addition to being sold in the United States, Canada and Mexico, these vehicles are also exported to other countries in small quantities. General Motors said that the transmission cables in some vehicles will break, causing the transmission to appear as if the gear is in the park position, but in fact it is still in gear. The company says the problem has caused four crashes but no injuries. But the federal government last year began investigating reports of seven crashes, one of which injured one person. When the car is repaired, a reinforcement device will be installed on the bottom end of the transmission cable, or a new cable will be replaced. The car owner will be notified when to go to the dealership for maintenance. The federal government investigated such problems at General Motors, and General Motors provided information to the government and discovered problems with the vehicle's transmission cables.

d81387dd86dc31dcbdf58013f89b19385c7964fa.sourceText: 为免于死刑 图森枪击案凶嫌承认19项罪行 2011年在图桑市大开杀戒、涉嫌杀害美国民主党联邦众议员吉佛兹未遂的枪手杰瑞德．李．拉夫纳，7日向法庭认罪，承认他去年在图森市开枪打死6人、打伤13人，以此换取免于死刑的刑罚。 检方在图桑联邦法院的听证会上解释，23岁的拉夫纳因认罪而免除死刑，但将面临终生监禁、没有假释机会。 经过1年治疗，他被联邦法官伯恩斯认定精神上有能力接受审判。随即，拉夫纳进入了认罪程序。 拉夫纳被控的19项重罪包括谋杀、谋杀未遂、试图暗杀吉弗兹。最初，联邦检察官指控洛克纳49项重罪，但在案件审理过程中，检察官撤销了30项重罪指控。 在与检方达成的认罪协议中，拉夫纳承认当时他带着格洛克19型手枪和60多发子弹计划暗杀吉弗兹。 法庭定于11月15日宣布对拉夫纳的量刑。他有可能被判7个终身监禁、不得保释。 吉弗兹的丈夫马克?#20975;利说，在拉夫纳向法庭认罪之前，他们夫妻俩一直与检察官保持着联系，对拉夫纳向法庭认罪的安排表示满意。
d81387dd86dc31dcbdf58013f89b19385c7964fa.translatedText: In order to avoid the death penalty, the suspect in the Tucson shooting admitted to 19 crimes. Jared Giffords, the gunman who went on a killing spree in Tucson in 2011 and was suspected of trying to kill Democratic U.S. Representative Giffords. plum. Loughner pleaded guilty to the court on the 7th, admitting that he shot and killed 6 people and injured 13 others in Tucson last year in exchange for avoiding the death penalty. Prosecutors explained at a hearing in federal court in Tucson that Loughner, 23, was spared the death penalty because of his guilty plea, but faces life in prison without the chance of parole. After a year of treatment, he was found mentally competent to stand trial by Federal Judge Burns. Immediately, Loughner entered the plea process. Loughner was charged with 19 felonies including murder, attempted murder, and attempted assassination of Giffords. Federal prosecutors initially charged Lochner with 49 felony counts, but during the course of the case, prosecutors dropped 30 felony charges. In the plea agreement reached with prosecutors, Loughner admitted that he was armed with a Glock 19 pistol and more than 60 rounds of ammunition at the time and planned to assassinate Giffords. The court is scheduled to announce Loughner's sentencing on November 15. He could be sentenced to seven life sentences without parole. Mark Leigh, Giffords' husband, said the couple had been in contact with prosecutors before Loughner pleaded guilty in court and were satisfied with the arrangement for Loughner's plea to the court.

fa5d7c61bea81828aa8ebc3ecf67d83713068a54.sourceText: 南部边境缴获30磅可卡因 周二，联邦当局拘捕一名从本州南部圣路易斯海关入境的墨西哥男子，涉嫌携带超过30磅可卡因。 美国海关和边境保护局官员表示，52岁的内斯特马丁内斯诺列加开着他的卡车企图通过圣路易斯海关，被缉毒犬发现藏有毒品，随即收缴毒品并扣留车辆。估计这批可卡因价值275000美元。 涉案人已被移交海关与边境保护局的国土安全局调查。
fa5d7c61bea81828aa8ebc3ecf67d83713068a54.translatedText: 30 pounds of cocaine seized at Southern Border Federal authorities arrested a Mexican man entering through Customs in St. Louis, in the southern part of the state, on Tuesday, suspected of carrying more than 30 pounds of cocaine. U.S. Customs and Border Protection officials said 52-year-old Nestor Martinez Noriega was trying to drive his truck through customs in St. Louis when a drug-sniffing dog discovered he was hiding the drugs. The drugs were seized and the vehicle was impounded, U.S. Customs and Border Protection officials said. The cocaine was estimated to be worth $275,000. The person involved has been turned over to Customs and Border Protection’s Homeland Security Division for investigation.

32e810df768f1164d25d3b2cc962d680f9201341.sourceText: 美国人最讨厌的10个行业 （亚省时报） 盖洛普进行的一项最新民调显示，美国人怎样看全国25个最大的行业之一，分别是正面，中性或负面。 大约73%的受访者认为电脑工作是最正面的行业。另一方面，只有22%的美国人认为银行是正面的行业，超过60%的美国人讨厌银行业。 盖洛普调查的各大行业中，大多数涉及非必需品的开支。其中四个最积极回应的行业，分别是互联网，餐厅，零售和电脑，几乎是所有美国人主要用于休閒的活动。 相反，获得最消极回应的行业，却是被认为是必需品的，例如银行业，石油和天然气，制药行业。 许多的行业，例如石油和天然气，制药业和法律领域，在美国人的心中，均有一个负面的形象。近几年，医疗保健的行业却有改变，从2011年的27%正面回感，增加至2012年的42%。 此列表的其他行业，例如银行和房地产，并不总是有一个强大的负面形象，但是，最近几年却越来越被讨厌，这可能主要是次贷危机的影响。银行的负面形象，是近几年最大的增长，从2001年的23%，增加至2012年的53%。 美国人最讨厌的10个行业分别为：第十位广告与公共关系，第九位电影业，第八位电视和广播行业，第七位法律领域，第六位电力与天然气公用事业，第五位医药业，第四位房地产，第三位医疗保健，第二位银行，第一位石油和天然气。
32e810df768f1164d25d3b2cc962d680f9201341.translatedText: The 10 most hated industries among Americans (Alberta Times) A new poll conducted by Gallup shows how Americans view one of the nation's 25 largest industries, whether positively, neutrally or negatively. About 73% of respondents considered computer work to be the most positive industry. On the other hand, only 22% of Americans view banking as a positive industry, and more than 60% of Americans dislike banking. Most of the major industries surveyed by Gallup involve spending on discretionary items. Four of the industries that responded most positively were the Internet, restaurants, retail and computers, activities that nearly all Americans use primarily for leisure. Conversely, the industries that received the most negative responses were those considered essential, such as banking, oil and gas, and pharmaceuticals. Many industries, such as oil and gas, pharmaceuticals and the legal field, have a negative image in the American mind. In recent years, the healthcare industry has changed, with positive feedback increasing from 27% in 2011 to 42% in 2012. Other industries on this list, such as banking and real estate, have not always had a strong negative image, however, have become increasingly disliked in recent years, probably primarily as a result of the subprime mortgage crisis. The negative image of banks has been the largest increase in recent years, from 23% in 2001 to 53% in 2012. The 10 most hated industries by Americans are: No. 10 advertising and public relations, No. 9 film industry, No. 8 television and radio industry, No. 7 legal field, No. 6 electric and natural gas utilities, No. 5 pharmaceutical industry, No. 4 real estate, No. 3 health care, No. 2 banking, No. 1 oil and gas.

1c3a6575e83db594dea5b965e707aa41a0e556bb.sourceText: 中国环境保护部7日公布，环保部与全国31个省(区、市)已签署《大气污染防治目标责任书》，为各地PM2.5或PM10年均浓度设定下降目标，国务院将每年对此进行考核。其中，京津冀PM2.5年均浓度下降目标为25%。
1c3a6575e83db594dea5b965e707aa41a0e556bb.translatedText: The Ministry of Environmental Protection of China announced on the 7th that the Ministry of Environmental Protection and 31 provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities) across the country have signed the "Responsibility Letter for Air Pollution Prevention and Control Targets" to set reduction targets for the average annual concentration of PM2.5 or PM10 in various places. The State Council will assess this every year. Among them, the annual average concentration reduction target of PM2.5 in Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei is 25%.

d382a63ad432d5032cdce9c631f7ee464c22fd2a.sourceText: 国务院去年9月印发治霾总指南棗大气污染防治?#22269;十条?#65292;其中为中国设定了治霾时间表：到2017年，中国地级及以上城市可吸入颗粒物浓度比2012年下降10%以上。
d382a63ad432d5032cdce9c631f7ee464c22fd2a.translatedText: In September last year, the State Council issued the General Guidelines for Haze Control, Ten Articles on Air Pollution Prevention and Control, which set a timetable for haze control in China: by 2017, the concentration of respirable particulate matter in cities at prefecture level and above in China will drop by more than 10% compared to 2012.

cbc5781116f90d1bfe331a872422d44be97f0dd5.sourceText: 为此，环保部与31个省、区、市(以下简称省)签订责任书，详细设定了各地空气质量改善目标。其中京津冀、长三角、珠三角等地的10省及重庆市，将重点考核PM2.5(细颗粒物)年均浓度下降情况；其他20省重点考核PM10(可吸入颗粒物)年均浓度下降情况。
cbc5781116f90d1bfe331a872422d44be97f0dd5.translatedText: To this end, the Ministry of Environmental Protection signed a letter of responsibility with 31 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities (hereinafter referred to as provinces), setting detailed air quality improvement targets for each region. Among them, 10 provinces in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, the Yangtze River Delta, the Pearl River Delta and Chongqing City will focus on assessing the decline in the annual average concentration of PM2.5 (fine particulate matter); the other 20 provinces will focus on assessing the decline in the annual average concentration of PM10 (respirable particulate matter).

d3193d4ae808746d0cfb71830aa38fb25c2f31d9.sourceText: 对PM2.5设定目标的地区中，北京、天津、河北确定了下降25%的目标，山西、山东、上海、江苏、浙江下降20%，广东、重庆下降15%，内蒙古下降10%。
d3193d4ae808746d0cfb71830aa38fb25c2f31d9.translatedText: Among the regions that have set targets for PM2.5, Beijing, Tianjin, and Hebei have set targets for a 25% reduction, Shanxi, Shandong, Shanghai, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang have set a 20% reduction, Guangdong and Chongqing have a 15% reduction, and Inner Mongolia has a 10% reduction.

ec0e336ebad3534979745b2de408ace4db2d83c8.sourceText: 对PM10设定目标的地区，根据当地环境质量，又将目标划分为五档：海南、西藏、云南等PM10年均浓度远低于国标的地区，持续改善即可；其他地区根据PM10年均浓度接近或超标程度，分别下降5%(如广西、福建)、10%(如辽宁、四川)、12%(如甘肃、湖北)、15%(如青海、新疆)。
ec0e336ebad3534979745b2de408ace4db2d83c8.translatedText: Areas that have set PM10 targets are divided into five levels based on local environmental quality: Hainan, Tibet, Yunnan and other areas where the annual average concentration of PM10 is far lower than the national standard will continue to Improvement is enough; in other regions, according to the degree to which the annual average concentration of PM10 is close to or exceeds the standard, it will decrease by 5% (such as Guangxi, Fujian), 10% (such as Liaoning, Sichuan), 12% (such as Gansu, Hubei), and 15% (such as Qinghai, Xinjiang).

a9f804c401f5e47852acd0e52f6c45103e06d850.sourceText: 此外，责任书还特别针对京津冀及周边的山西、内蒙古、山东，设定了削减煤炭，淘汰落后产能，以及锅炉、机动车、扬尘治理的年度量化目标。
a9f804c401f5e47852acd0e52f6c45103e06d850.translatedText: In addition, the responsibility letter also specifically targets the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and surrounding Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, and Shandong, setting annual quantitative targets for coal reduction, elimination of backward production capacity, and boiler, motor vehicle, and dust control.

ad1e8129690a3ddd10dcd1d9cba5cfedb28f5985.sourceText: 这份责任书的行动力来自于有效监督。记者从环保部获悉，中国国务院将每年对各地目标、任务完成情况进行考核。对未通过考核的地区，环保部将会同组织部门、监察部门通报批评，并约谈负责人，提出限期整改意见。
ad1e8129690a3ddd10dcd1d9cba5cfedb28f5985.translatedText: The action of this responsibility letter comes from effective supervision. The reporter learned from the Ministry of Environmental Protection that the State Council of China will assess the completion of goals and tasks in various regions every year. For areas that fail the assessment, the Ministry of Environmental Protection will notify the organization department and supervisory department of criticism, interview the person in charge, and propose rectification suggestions within a time limit.

b4254c28643f08d98da7e874566e6c5c5ad53ab6.sourceText: 87号公路佩森路段因油车侧翻封闭 州公共安全部官员说，一辆油罐车周二上午在州道87公路佩森路段侧翻，当局紧急关闭该路段。 事故发生在周二上午11时半左右，离佩森南部30英里附近，肇事车辆装有沥青油，事故原因据说是司机转弯太快，导致货车侧翻，2000加仑乳化沥青倾斜在公路上。司机没有生命危险。 安全部关闭了87号公路的南线进行道路清理，并于周三凌晨重开该路段。
b4254c28643f08d98da7e874566e6c5c5ad53ab6.translatedText: Highway 87 in Payson is closed due to a tanker rollover. Officials with the state Department of Public Safety said a tanker truck rolled over on State Route 87 in Payson Tuesday morning, prompting an emergency closure of the section. The accident occurred around 11:30 a.m. on Tuesday, 30 miles south of Payson. The vehicle involved was filled with asphalt oil. The cause of the accident is said to be that the driver turned too fast, causing the truck to roll over and 2,000 gallons of emulsified asphalt to tilt on the road. The driver's injuries were not life-threatening. The Department of Safety closed the southern portion of Highway 87 for road clearing and reopened the section early Wednesday morning.

c58bad6d233c04dcfae5eb86f4d7fc57c7ded439.sourceText: 台湾图片展览庆祝凤凰城与台北市33周年姊妹市 凤凰城市长史丹顿亲临观赏并强调两市坚固友谊 凤凰城台北姊妹市供稿 台湾高科技与风情图片展览于七月一日起至八月七日止在凤凰城中央图书馆展出,庆祝凤凰城市与台北市缔结33周年友好姊妹城市,及庆祝亚利桑那州建州百年,图片 展览一切顺利圆满完成. 凤凰城市长格雷格史丹顿接受凤凰城台北姊妹市主席李玲麟的邀请,亲临参观台湾展览,并由凤凰城台北姊妹市主席李玲麟与邱文琪陪同,特别为史丹顿市长导览与解说,史丹 顿市长很专注与仔细的观看每一幅台湾图片,时时问及图片的背景与历史.史丹顿市长表示很高兴凤凰城有那么先进和美丽的台北姊妹市;凤凰城也很荣幸与台北 市缔结33年姊妹城市,史丹顿市长特别强调两市坚固永恒的美好关系与友谊.同时史丹顿市长也称赞凤凰城台北姊妹市持续不断的为增进凤凰城与台北市友好关系,及促进 凤凰城与台北市两市的文教,艺术,科技,与经贸交流所付出的种种努力与贡献. 凤凰城台北姊妹市主席李玲麟代表台北姊妹市赠送史丹顿市长台湾和台北市的宣传品与纪念品,并邀请市长带领凤凰城台北姊妹市一同访问台北台湾,庆祝凤凰城与台北市的友情永固. 台湾高科技与风情图片展览自四月一日至十五日在亚利桑那州州政府博物馆展出两星期,五月十六日至十八日在凤凰城市政府展览会馆展出三天,六月一 日至十五日在凤凰城市政府大厅展出两星期,七月一日至八月七日在凤凰城中央图书馆展出五个星期,台湾展览在所有场地展出都吸引满满大众人潮, 以及各学校师生家长组团参观,非常杰出成功. 台湾高科技与风情图片展览是由洛杉矶经济文化办事处所提供,由凤凰城台北姊妹市与亚​​省中华语文学院,中华书院所主办,十分感谢所有义工的协助,华人媒体与美国主流媒体的宣传与 报导,和大家的支持,使本次的数场展览都能如期举行,顺利进行,和圆满成功。
c58bad6d233c04dcfae5eb86f4d7fc57c7ded439.translatedText: Taiwan photo exhibition celebrates the 33rd anniversary of the sister city of Phoenix and Taipei City Phoenix City Mayor Stanton visited in person to see and emphasize the strong friendship between the two cities Contributed by Phoenix Taipei Sister City The Taiwan High-Tech and Customs Photo Exhibition was on display at the Phoenix Central Library from July 1st to August 7th to celebrate the 33rd anniversary of the establishment of sister cities between Phoenix and Taipei, as well as the centenary of the founding of Arizona. The photo exhibition was successfully completed. Phoenix Mayor Greg Stanton accepted the invitation from Phoenix Taipei Sister City Chairman Li Linglin to visit the Taiwan exhibition in person. He was accompanied by Phoenix Taipei Sister City Chairman Li Linglin and Qiu Wenqi, who gave a special tour and explanation for Mayor Stanton. Mayor Stanton looked at every picture of Taiwan attentively and carefully, and always asked about the background and history of the picture. Mayor Stanton said that he was very happy that Phoenix City has such an advanced and beautiful sister city of Taipei. Phoenix City was also honored to have established a sister city with Taipei City for 33 years. Mayor Stanton particularly emphasized the strong and eternal beautiful relationship and friendship between the two cities. At the same time, Mayor Stanton also praised Phoenix Taipei Sister City for its continuous efforts to enhance the friendly relations between Phoenix City and Taipei City, and promote The various efforts and contributions made by Phoenix City and Taipei City in the cultural, educational, artistic, technological, and economic and trade exchanges between Phoenix City and Taipei City. On behalf of Taipei Sister City, Phoenix Taipei Sister City Chairman Li Linglin presented Mayor Stanton with promotional materials and souvenirs of Taiwan and Taipei City, and invited the mayor to lead Phoenix City Taipei Sister City to visit Taipei, Taiwan, to celebrate the eternal friendship between Phoenix City and Taipei City. The Taiwan High-Tech and Customs Photo Exhibition was on display at the Arizona State Government Museum for two weeks from April 1 to 15, three days at the Phoenix City Government Exhibition Hall from May 16 to 18, two weeks at the Phoenix City Hall from June 1 to 15, and five weeks at the Phoenix Central Library from July 1 to August 7. The Taiwan Exhibition attracted huge crowds in all venues, as well as groups of teachers, students and parents from schools. It was an outstanding success. The Taiwan High-tech and Customs Photo Exhibition is provided by the Los Angeles Economic and Cultural Office, and is organized by the sister city of Phoenix Taipei, the Chinese Language Institute of Alberta, and the Chung Hwa Academy. We are very grateful to all the volunteers for their assistance, the Chinese media and American mainstream media for their publicity and reporting, and everyone's support, so that this exhibition can be held as scheduled, go smoothly, and be a complete success.

481cd14b115d6f87416721f96189d3c9e6874bac.sourceText: 凤凰城等20个大中城市平均房价继续下跌 房地产复苏动力不足 美国标准普尔公司29日发布的凯斯－席勒房价指数显示，今年1月份美国20个大中城市平均房价继续下跌，表明美国房地产复苏依旧面临压力。 数据显示，1月份，美国20个大中城市房价环比下跌1.0%，同比下降3.1%。当月，在美国20个大中城市中，仅有首都华盛顿地区房价同比上涨 3.6%，圣迭戈地区的房价同比微增0.1%，其余18个城市及其周边地区的房价皆下探，其中11个城市房价再创2006至2007年峰值以来新低。 分析人士认为，受失业率居高不下、前期购房优惠政策到期、住房止赎率高企等因素影响，美国房地产复苏动力不足，目前仍延续着价跌量滞的弱势局面。 凯斯－席勒房价指数反映美国20个大中城市独栋房屋售价的变动情况，是衡量美国房地产价格的一项重要指标。该指数涵盖美国20个大中城市及其周边地区的房价，包括凤凰城、洛杉矶、圣迭戈、旧金山、丹佛、华盛顿、迈阿密、坦帕、亚特兰大、芝加哥、波士顿、 底特律、明尼阿波利斯、夏洛特、拉斯韦加斯、纽约、克里夫兰、波特兰、达拉斯和西雅图。
481cd14b115d6f87416721f96189d3c9e6874bac.translatedText: The average house price in 20 large and medium-sized cities, including Phoenix, continues to fall, and there is insufficient power for real estate recovery. The Case-Shiller House Price Index released by Standard & Poor's on the 29th showed that the average house price in 20 large and medium-sized cities in the United States continued to fall in January this year, indicating that the U.S. real estate recovery is still under pressure. Data show that in January, house prices in 20 large and medium-sized cities in the United States fell by 1.0% month-on-month and 3.1% year-on-year. In that month, among the 20 large and medium-sized cities in the United States, only the capital Washington area saw housing prices rise by 3.6% year-on-year, and the San Diego area saw a slight increase of 0.1% year-on-year. Housing prices in the remaining 18 cities and their surrounding areas all dropped, with 11 of them hitting new lows since the peak in 2006-2007. Analysts believe that due to factors such as the high unemployment rate, the expiration of preferential home purchase policies, and the high housing foreclosure rate, the U.S. real estate recovery lacks momentum and currently continues to be in a weak situation of falling prices and stagnant volumes. The Case-Shiller House Price Index reflects changes in selling prices of single-family homes in 20 large and medium-sized cities in the United States and is an important indicator of real estate prices in the United States. The index covers housing prices in 20 large and medium-sized cities in the United States and their surrounding areas, including Phoenix, Los Angeles, San Diego, San Francisco, Denver, Washington, Miami, Tampa, Atlanta, Chicago, Boston, Detroit, Minneapolis, Charlotte, Las Vegas, New York, Cleveland, Portland, Dallas and Seattle.

6eb1196dd329e9f1271eaba3254aa74c3c85ff83.sourceText: (中央社记者吴静君台北15日电)综合所得税结算申报期间至31日止，财政部国税局今天估计，已经约有3成5的民众已经完成申报，也就是说，约有6成5的民众尚未完成申报。

891105ca6d30420b3d1580404d82631c34f1dab8.sourceText: 根据国税局估计，现在全国约有3成5的民众已经完成申报综所税，还有6成5、约370万申报户尚未报税， 提醒民众，税额试算服务、网路缴税皆非常方便，最好能及早缴税，不要等到5月的最后几天才完成报税。
891105ca6d30420b3d1580404d82631c34f1dab8.translatedText: According to the estimates of the National Taxation Bureau, about 35% of the people nationwide have completed the comprehensive income tax declaration, and there are still 65%, or about 3.7 million taxpayers, who have not yet filed the tax. The public is reminded that the tax calculation service and online tax payment are very convenient. It is best to pay the tax as early as possible, and do not wait until the last few days of May to complete the tax return.

ddebdff376e5c185d74f7262a43600c09e2292b7.sourceText: 大凤凰城地区12月份房屋销售情况 （亚省时报） 大凤凰城12月独立屋销售已经超过了$800，000.每平方英尺的价格高于去年同期。房屋的储备量也在继续下降。超过40万美元的房屋市场依然比较薄弱。银行屋的市场份额依然在减少。短首屋已经比较少了，正常销售的房屋赢得了大部分市场。 从总体销售来看，11月和12月最直接的变化就是房屋储备量大量减少。供应量下降最多的就是10万以下的房子。 20万到40万之间的房子情况不错，40万以上的房子在销售上仍让有较大的问题。变化量最大的房子是10万元以下的房子，2011年2月创下了每平方米最低的价格后，在接下来的近一年的时间里，已经上涨了7%。随着供应量的下降，业内估计春季，大多数购房者的选择会减少，好的房子会有比较激烈的竞争。更多房地产资讯请咨询金信地产Tinna 480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
ddebdff376e5c185d74f7262a43600c09e2292b7.translatedText: Home sales in the greater Phoenix area in December (Alberta Times) Single-family home sales in the greater Phoenix area in December have exceeded $800,000. The price per square foot is higher than the same period last year. The inventory of homes also continues to decline. The market for homes over $400,000 remains relatively weak. The market share of bank housing is still decreasing. There are already relatively few short-term houses, and houses that are sold normally have won most of the market. From the perspective of overall sales, the most direct change in November and December is the substantial reduction in housing reserves. The biggest decline in supply is for houses under $100,000. Houses between 200,000 and 400,000 are in good condition, but houses above 400,000 still have major sales problems. The houses with the largest change were those below 100,000 yuan. After hitting the lowest price per square meter in February 2011, it has risen by 7% in the following nearly a year. As the supply decreases, the industry estimates that most home buyers will have fewer choices in the spring, and there will be fierce competition for good houses. b04976e7ecb2916d2d2343986d63636c40d7e106.sourceText: 在失业率居高不下、法拍屋创纪录、税收锐减和赤字扩大的情况下，许多州政府都透过重新包装乐透奖券，以及改善赌博业的方式，筹措教育和环保所需的经费。有17个州的乐透销售额在上个会计年度创下纪录，增加州政府的收入。 对于每年赤字达30亿元的亚利桑那州，改善乐透为州政府赚钱的方式。为扩大乐透奖券收入，州政府举办焦点团体研讨会，增加新游戏，印刷更精美的彩票，招募新的零售商，增加彩金，利用社交媒体广为宣传，并把广告费用增加50%。 州政府增加的赌注的结果：2010年乐透奖券销售成长14%，是全国成长最高的州。根据乐透研究公司La Fleur’s，截至6月30日为止的前12个月，亚省乐透销售金额成长6%，达到5亿8400万元的新纪录。 全国43个州有乐透彩业务，在上个会计年度，26个州乐透彩传统游戏均有成长，总销售金额达560亿元，成长率为3%。有17个州乐透奖券销售创纪录。有数个州今年将破过去最高纪录。 许多州政府拟扩大赌博业。麻州州长派区克(Deval Patrick)11月22日签署新法桉，授权新开三家观光区赌场。乔治亚和佛罗里达州考虑跟进。 虽然联邦政府禁止跨州网路赌博，但华盛顿特区和其他行政区考虑在行政区内准许网路赌博。自2008年以来，28个州考虑以乐透或有关赌博的法桉，弥补赤字。
b04976e7ecb2916d2d2343986d63636c40d7e106.translatedText: With unemployment remaining high, foreclosures hitting records, tax revenues plummeting, and deficits widening, many state governments are raising funds for education and environmental protection by repackaging lottery tickets and improving the gambling industry. Seventeen states had record lottery sales last fiscal year, boosting state government revenue. For Arizona, which has an annual deficit of $3 billion, improving the lottery is a way for the state to make money. To expand Lotto revenue, the state government held focus group workshops, added new games, printed more attractive tickets, recruited new retailers, increased jackpots, used social media to promote the lottery, and increased advertising costs by 50%. The result of the state's increased stakes: Lotto ticket sales grew 14 percent in 2010, the highest growth in the nation. According to lottery research firm La Fleur’s, in the 12 months ended June 30, Alberta Lotto sales grew 6 per cent to a new record of $584 million. There are lottery businesses in 43 states across the country. In the last fiscal year, traditional lottery games in 26 states grew, with total sales reaching 56 billion yuan, a growth rate of 3%. There were 17 states with record lotto ticket sales. Several states are set to break past records this year. Many state governments intend to expand gambling. Massachusetts Governor Deval Patrick signed a new law on November 22, authorizing the opening of three new tourist area casinos. Georgia and Florida are considering following suit. Although the federal government bans online gambling across state lines, Washington, D.C., and other boroughs are considering allowing online gambling within their own jurisdictions. Since 2008, 28 states have considered lottery or gambling-related laws to offset deficits.

98a58a0691dbaf62026b43e95b29a54c197d19a0.sourceText: 坦佩小学学区因年龄歧视需付15万赔款 （亚省时报） 坦佩小学学区因违反了一项联邦法律，必须支付超过14万8千的赔偿款给49名在2008年退休的教职员工。 诉讼书说，学区给提早退休的员工更多的好处，允许60岁以上教职员，用原工资的43%买断教龄，60岁以下的教职员用原工资的52%买断教龄，使之提前退休。事件被揭露后，被美国平等就业机会委员会告上地区法庭，败诉后获判赔款。 坦佩小学学区总监克里斯布希承认，学区委员会在作出决定前知道可能涉及歧视，但学区按他们的年龄加上年假计算工龄，是为学区节省财政开支。 地区检察官玛丽乔奥尼尔则说，坦佩小学学区的做法是鼓励提前退休。根据学区原来的规定，提早退休的员工，可以提早报销医疗费用。
98a58a0691dbaf62026b43e95b29a54c197d19a0.translatedText: The Tempe Elementary School District has to pay $150,000 in compensation for age discrimination (Alberta Times) The Tempe Elementary School District violated a federal law and must pay more than $148,000 to 49 teachers and staff who retired in 2008. The lawsuit states that the school district gives more benefits to employees who retire early, allowing teachers over 60 years old to use 43% of their original salary to buy out their teaching experience, and teachers under 60 years old to use 52% of their original salary to buy out their teaching experience and retire early. After the incident was exposed, he was sued by the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission in a district court. After losing the case, he was awarded compensation. Tempe Elementary School Superintendent Chris Busch admitted that the school district board knew that discrimination may be involved before making the decision, but the district calculated seniority based on their age plus annual leave to save the district financial expenses. District Attorney Mary Jo O'Neill said the Tempe Elementary School District's approach is to encourage early retirement. According to the school district’s original regulations, employees who retire early can have their medical expenses reimbursed early.

71430096dc24cfdea46ded5271a35acbea472980.sourceText: 近日一个研究报告显示，尽管本州失业率从最高峰的10.8%降到目前的8.3%，工薪族收入整体增长了15%，年薪的中位数是$34000美元，相对周边的西部各州，薪资还是相当低的。 内华达州，科罗拉多州和华盛顿州的工资中位数分别为$32656美元，$37065美元，$40144美元。 ASU经济学家李麦菲特说，过去四年内，亚省平均工资增加了几乎$5500美元，看似不错，但同一时期，亚省有数十万低工资劳工失去工作。”低于中位数的工作流失，使得工资中位数拉升至现在的效果，”麦菲特说。 虽然数据显示本州的就业市场缓慢回升，从2010年5月至2011年5月，管理、电脑、教育和医疗保健等就业岗位增加。但是，房屋价格不断上升，许多家庭为十多万美元贷款节衣缩食。食品、教育、医疗保健和燃油成本不断上升，给每个居民带来沉重负担。 州长在2011年签署了一系列救市法律，其中包括企业分阶段减税，建立一个公私商业主管部门，为吸引更多资金到州和私人企业投资。一年过去了，成效初见。 经济衰退的四年间，亚省失去了30万就业岗位，而2012财政年，州政府帮助下，只有5610个岗位诞生，杯水车薪。 ”但我相信，我们已经做出了正确的决定，为亚利桑那带来更多更高薪的工作机会，”布鲁尔州长说。 州政府希望未来五年内，在航空航天和国防半导体、光学、生物科学和能源领域，创造75000个高薪工作，年薪在$63000美元至$104000美元之间。 地方政府也着重开放高薪就业市场。大凤凰城经济委员会在过去的财政年度，协助36家公司扩充或迁移至本地。其中14个企业的平均年薪超过四万美元。今年，GPEC带来四千个就业岗位，其中，超过1300个职位平均年薪约$65000美元。例如加州的硅谷银行在坦佩开设分公司，预计将雇用250名员工，平均年薪$88000美元。 截止于今年三月，本州恢复了大约四分之一在经济衰退期间失去的工作。 ”尽管吸引高工资工作很困难，但不是不可能，”州长说，亚利桑那必须与德州和犹他等邻近州竞争。 ”我们近期的政策已经取得一些成效，绝对有帮助，”大凤凰城经济委员会首席执行官巴里•布鲁姆说，”我们将继续朝这方面努力。”
71430096dc24cfdea46ded5271a35acbea472980.translatedText: A recent research report shows that although the state's unemployment rate has dropped from its peak of 10.8% to the current 8.3%, the overall income of wage earners has increased by 15%. The median annual salary is US$34,000. Compared with surrounding western states, wages are still quite low. The median wages in Nevada, Colorado and Washington are $32,656, $37,065 and $40,144 respectively. ASU economist Lee McPheet said that in the past four years, the average wage in Alberta has increased by almost $5,500, which seems good, but during the same period, hundreds of thousands of low-wage workers in Alberta have lost their jobs. "The job losses below the median have had the effect of pushing the median wage up to where it is now," McPheet said. Although data shows the state's job market is slowly recovering, from May 2010 to May 2011, there were gains in management, computer, education and health care jobs. However, home prices continue to rise, and many families are scrimping for loans of more than $100,000. Rising food, education, health care and fuel costs place a heavy burden on every resident. The governor signed a series of bailout laws in 2011, including phased tax cuts for businesses and the establishment of a public-private business authority to attract more capital to the state and private enterprise investment. A year has passed and the results are beginning to show. During the four years of the economic recession, Alberta lost 300,000 jobs. In fiscal year 2012, with the help of the state government, only 5,610 jobs were created, a drop in the bucket. "But I believe we have made the right decision to bring more higher-paying jobs to Arizona," Governor Brewer said. The state government hopes to create 75,000 high-paying jobs over the next five years in aerospace and defense semiconductors, optics, biosciences and energy, with annual salaries ranging from $63,000 to $104,000. Local governments also focus on opening up the high-paying job market. The Greater Phoenix Economic Council assisted 36 companies in expanding or relocating locally this past fiscal year. The average annual salary of 14 of them exceeds US$40,000. This year, GPEC has created 4,000 jobs, of which more than 1,300 positions have an average annual salary of approximately $65,000. For example, California-based Silicon Valley Bank has opened a branch in Tempe and is expected to employ 250 employees with an average annual salary of $88,000. As of March, the state had regained about a quarter of the jobs lost during the recession. "While attracting high-wage jobs is difficult, it's not impossible," the governor said, as Arizona must compete with neighboring states like Texas and Utah. "Our recent policies have had some results and are definitely helping," said Barry Bloom, CEO of the Greater Phoenix Economic Council. "We will continue to work on this."

01cd2a36c5d8d5b612558427cbe7231c81d5ab83.sourceText: 8月2日 儿童增高座位法生效 (亚省时报) 亚利桑那州的驾车人留意了，本栏上月提及过，本州新的交通安全法8月2日生效，主要涉及儿童安全座椅。 新法规定，四岁以下儿童乘车必须使用约束座位(Car Seat)，七岁以下儿童，低于4英尺9英寸的，必须使用增高座位，也就是booster seat。如若违反此法，将获罚款50美元。
01cd2a36c5d8d5b612558427cbe7231c81d5ab83.translatedText: August 2, the child booster seat law came into effect (Alberta Times) Attention Arizona motorists, as this column mentioned last month, the state’s new traffic safety law takes effect on August 2, mainly involving child safety seats. The new law stipulates that children under four years old must use a restrained seat (Car Seat) when riding in a car, and children under seven years old and under 4 feet 9 inches must use a booster seat, also known as a booster seat. Violations of this law will result in a $50 fine.

118cd5766d240c3ad1ee27bc6c700e776b75b307.sourceText: 到底美国人最喜欢瀏览哪些网站？
118cd5766d240c3ad1ee27bc6c700e776b75b307.translatedText: What websites do Americans like to browse the most?

37791d1d6861aa34781a2c0324b24eb391e12927.sourceText: 过去一年，很多网站的瀏览人数大幅增加，主要是移动设备的普及，例如平板电脑和智能手机的兴起。2012年12月，排名前25位的网站中，透过手机的瀏览次数增加了29%。相比一年前， ESPN的网上瀏览次数更增加高达56%。手机瀏览人数的增长，对于互联网的公司来说，并不一定是好消息。
37791d1d6861aa34781a2c0324b24eb391e12927.translatedText: Over the past year, the number of visitors to many websites has increased significantly, mainly due to the popularity of mobile devices, such as tablets and smartphones. In December 2012, the number of visits via mobile phones increased by 29% among the top 25 websites. Compared to a year ago, ESPN's online views increased by as much as 56%. The growth in the number of mobile browsers is not necessarily good news for Internet companies.

8eaa67ec94c4325ecf5690d3579167a16b4ca6a9.sourceText: 分析公司的高级市场经理卡梅拉阿基诺(Carmela Aquino)说，虽然瀏览人数肯定转移到手机的用户上，但是，仍然不能取代个人电脑的用户。两者的广告对象和收费也不一样，因而不断改变市场的策略，以迎合用户的需求。美国很多网站也越来越重视手机视频的广告宣传，造成广告价格上升。 例如，雅虎和AOL等网站也推出视频内容比赛，加倍投资雅虎财经的直播节目和”赫芬顿邮报”的现场报道节目，以高质素的视频来增加广告收入和效益。利普斯曼说：”过去10年，互联网的发展和进步，亦将会是未来几年，手机上网的发展蓝图。”
8eaa67ec94c4325ecf5690d3579167a16b4ca6a9.translatedText: Carmela Aquino, senior marketing manager of the analysis company, said that although the number of viewers has definitely shifted to mobile phone users, it still cannot replace personal computer users. The advertising objects and charges of the two are also different, so the market strategies are constantly changing to cater to the needs of users. Many websites in the United States are also paying more and more attention to mobile video advertising, causing advertising prices to rise. For example, websites such as Yahoo and AOL have also launched video content competitions and doubled down on Yahoo Finance's live broadcasts and Huffington Post's live reporting programs to increase advertising revenue and effectiveness with high-quality videos. Lipsman said: "The development and progress of the Internet in the past 10 years will also be the blueprint for the development of mobile Internet in the next few years."

557130c4f286e8fab38f4fcebb6a8d71da91e636.sourceText: 有些网站为了吸引容户，提出个人化的设计，例如雅虎，让客户根据自己的搜索历史和社会媒体共享的资料，来设定个人用户的内容，使网站吸引更多的用户。此外，由于整体网上零售的增长，2012年的第四季度，eBay的销售相比前一年增长了18%，亚马逊Amazon的销售额增长35%。基于comScore的数据，《24/7华尔街》找出10个最受美国人欢迎的网站。
557130c4f286e8fab38f4fcebb6a8d71da91e636.translatedText: In order to attract users, some websites propose personalized designs, such as Yahoo, which allows customers to set personal user content based on their search history and data shared on social media, so that the website can attract more users. In addition, due to the growth of overall online retail, in the fourth quarter of 2012, eBay's sales increased by 18% compared with the previous year, and Amazon's sales increased by 35%. Based on comScore data, "24/7 Wall Street" identified the 10 most popular websites among Americans.

c7aa09462fed66068dd50c606d46d2fdff876186.sourceText: 绞火鸡肉 26州沙菌中毒元凶 联邦疾病防治中心(CDC)表示，美国已有26州爆发沙门氏菌中毒事件，已造成一人死亡，76人罹病就医。 CDC说，事件的元凶可能是遭沙门氏菌污染的绞火鸡肉。 CDC1日晚间发布声明说：「自3月1日到8月1日以来，77人感染沙门氏菌(Salmonella Heidelberg)。绞火鸡肉可能是病源。」CDC表示，数十年前已发现这种致命的病菌，「这种病菌对一般抗生素有抗药性，因此，遭感染者须住院治疗，治疗也可能无效」。 联邦农业部没有公布产制此产品的厂商，也没有发出召回通知。 CDC也没有透露死者生前居住在哪一州，也没有发布有关死者的其他细节。 疾病防治中心3月已经知道绞火鸡肉遭沙门氏菌污染的病例，3月7日到6月27日间，CDC对四个零售点的产品做细菌培养测试，发现三个样品出自同一家生产厂商，但该中心没有透露生产厂商和零售商的名称。 管控肉品安全为农业部的职责，如果肉品需要召回，须由农业部下令。农业部上周末发出警告，要民众把火鸡肉彻底煮熟再食用，但未发布有关污染源的消息。 此次感染的病例几乎散布全国，病例最多的是密西根和俄亥俄州，各有十个病例，德州有九名病例，伊利诺有七个，加州六个、宾州五个；有一到三名病例的州包括阿拉巴马、亚利桑那、乔治亚、爱阿华、印第安纳、肯塔基、刘易斯安纳、麻州、明尼苏达、密苏里、密西西比、北卡罗来纳、内布拉斯加、内华达、俄克拉荷马、俄勒冈、南卡罗来纳、田纳西和威斯康星州。
c7aa09462fed66068dd50c606d46d2fdff876186.translatedText: Ground turkey meat is the culprit of sand bacteria poisoning in 26 states. The federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) stated that salmonella poisoning incidents have occurred in 26 states in the United States, resulting in one death and 76 people seeking medical treatment for illness. The CDC said the possible culprit was ground turkey contaminated with salmonella. The CDC issued a statement on the evening of the 1st, saying: "Since March 1 to August 1, 77 people have been infected with Salmonella Heidelberg. Ground turkey may be the source of the disease." The CDC stated that this deadly bacteria was discovered decades ago. "This bacteria is resistant to common antibiotics. Therefore, infected people must be hospitalized and treatment may not be effective." The federal Department of Agriculture has not named the manufacturer of the product and has not issued a recall notice. The CDC did not disclose the state in which the deceased lived, nor did it release other details about the deceased. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention was aware of cases of salmonella contamination of ground turkey in March. Between March 7 and June 27, the CDC conducted bacterial culture tests on products at four retail locations and found that three samples came from the same manufacturer, but the center did not disclose the names of the manufacturer and retailer. It is the responsibility of the Ministry of Agriculture to control meat safety. If meat needs to be recalled, it must be ordered by the Ministry of Agriculture. The Department of Agriculture issued a warning over the weekend asking people to cook turkey meat thoroughly before eating it, but did not release any information on the source of the contamination. Cases of this infection are almost scattered across the country. The most cases are in Michigan and Ohio, with ten cases each, Texas has nine cases, Illinois has seven, California has six, and Pennsylvania has five. States with one to three cases include Alabama, Arizona, Georgia, Iowa, Indiana, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Missouri, Mississippi, North Carolina, Nebraska, Nevada, Oklahoma, Oregon, South Carolina, Tennessee and Wisconsin.

591e18d91d9e963c9d0d3a9f726f5981517199d0.sourceText: 中央大学三月三十日将同时颁授美国亚利桑那州立(（Arizona State University，简称ASU）大学校长Dr. Michael Crow和工业技术研究院董事长蔡清彦名誉博士，表彰两人在全球化的快速变动下，分别在教育改革、产业创新上，均发挥极大的社会影响力，开创新典范，为下一代树立学习标竿。 中央大学近几年陆续由地球科学学院颁授台达电子创办人郑崇华董事长、前日本首相海部俊树名誉博士，今年再添两位标竿人物，显示中大在追求人文关怀、环境永续上跨国界、跨领域之视野，对卓越贡献者之推崇与肯定。
591e18d91d9e963c9d0d3a9f726f5981517199d0.translatedText: On March 30, Central University will also award Dr. Michael, President of Arizona State University (ASU) in the United States. Crow and Industrial Technology Research Institute Chairman Cai Qingyan, honorary doctors, commended the two for exerting great social influence in education reform and industrial innovation respectively under the rapid changes of globalization, creating new models and setting learning standards for the next generation. In recent years, Central University has successively awarded honorary doctorates to Delta Electronics founder Zheng Chonghua and former Japanese Prime Minister Toshiki Kaifu from the School of Earth Sciences. This year, two more benchmark figures have been awarded, showing the cross-border and cross-field vision of CUHK in the pursuit of humanistic care and environmental sustainability, and the respect and recognition of outstanding contributors

daab544b5c7565f479f5a724a460420c894769d0.sourceText: Michael M. Crow名誉博士 「新美国大学」的开创者 Michael M. Crow 校长自2002年担任ASU校长长达十年。他带领ASU转型，使该大学成为美国都市型大学中领先的研究型大学之一，并直接参与该地区的经济、社会和文化生命力等活动，产生极大的社会影响力，成功打造「新美国大学（New American University）」模范，2009年被《TIME》杂志选为全美十位最好的大学校长之一。 Michael M. Crow校长秉持「开放、广纳」的态度推展校务，该校2012年的研究经费计约3.85亿美元，为10年前的三倍之多。他主张广纳学生入学就读，降低大一辍学率至10%，提升大学生毕业率至75%到80%。同时推广线上及远距教学，以吸引更多学生。他促进各学院优质教学，让每个学院至少一个系所成为全美学术领衔，排名达全美前5%到10%。积极推动ASU在2020年前成为全球跨领域研究重镇，在社会科学、艺术和人文领域方面的学术研究亦居领导地位。他也不忘强化与地方性、全国性非营利团体，以及政府部门和私人企业的合作，拓展大学对社会的影响力。 他以十年时间让ASU脱胎换骨，「坚持愿景，不畏挑战」，成为一所创新与改革的学校。在国内各大学面临转型之际，提供一个学习典范。
daab544b5c7565f479f5a724a460420c894769d0.translatedText: Michael M. Crow Honorary Doctorate Michael M. Crow, the founder of "New American University" The president has served as the president of ASU for ten years since 2002. He has led the transformation of ASU and made the university one of the leading research universities among American urban universities. He has directly participated in the economic, social and cultural vitality of the region, exerted great social influence, and successfully created a model of "New American University". In 2009, Michael M. was selected as one of the ten best university presidents in the United States by TIME magazine. President Crow promotes school affairs with an "open and inclusive" attitude. The school's research funding in 2012 was approximately US$385 million, three times that of 10 years ago. He advocated inclusive enrollment, reducing the first-year dropout rate to 10%, and increasing the graduation rate of college students to 75% to 80%. He also promoted online and distance teaching to attract more students. At least one department in each college has become an academic leader in the United States, ranking among the top 5% to 10% in the United States. He actively promotes ASU to become a global cross-disciplinary research center by 2020, and also takes a leading position in academic research in the fields of social sciences, arts and humanities. He also forgets to strengthen cooperation with local and national non-profit groups, as well as government departments and private enterprises to expand the university's influence on society. He spent ten years transforming ASU, "adhering to its vision and not being afraid of challenges", to become an innovative and reforming school, providing a model for learning when domestic universities are facing transformation.

8bc2b9d2f6c12dcc0ed3284f5f23df728ea34d04.sourceText: 蔡清彦名誉博士 气象预报、产业创新的开路先锋 工业技术研究院蔡清彦董事长，美国犹他大学大气科学博士，归国后在台大任教长达十五年，后从学界转战公部门，担任中央气象局局长、民航局局长、国科会副主委、行政院政务委员兼科技顾问组副召集人、总统府国策顾问等重要职务，是政府相当仰赖的科技政策推动者。 蔡清彦在大气科学领域鑽研近三十年，早期的气象预报由于无先进科技辅助，预测误差较高，他引进数值天气预报系统，奠定现今气象预测准度与现代化的基础；此外，更积极培育人才，带领团队赴美学习最新预报技术，每回颱风来袭时，中央气象局能提早做出警示，归功于其当年培育人才、引进最新科技之远见。 当全球产业板块剧烈位移，蔡清彦洞悉产业发展现况与未来转型机会，主张台湾须走向「创新型经济体制」持续不断地创新，在担任工研院董事长期间，带领工研院以创新科技屡屡在美国百大科技研发奖和华尔街日报科技创新奖中获得傲人成绩，并建立连美国白宫科技顾问委员会都为之讚誉的创新体系，积极实践为产业创造价值的使命。 此外，力促台湾社会重塑创业文化，发挥以新创事业带动产业结构转型的火车头效应，鼓励同仁创业以扶植更多优秀的创业家，让前瞻科技转化为新创公司，带动产业动能与发展，为台湾年轻人及产业找到创新与创业的新出口。 他也致力于节能减碳与再生能源领域之发展，以前瞻科技建构产业链，期许台湾在绿能产业登上全球舞台；此外更长期推动台日双边合作，发挥国际影响力，获日本各界广大迴响与重视，并促成「台日中新黄金三角」中，台日「特别伙伴关係」的实质内涵，媒合台日企业交流合作与签署备忘录等重要里程碑，为产业开拓新路，贡献非凡。 蔡清彦长期耕耘台湾高科技、大气科学并鼓励创新创业，尽一生力量，追求国家社会之进步，对台湾产业及环境永续贡献宏大，实为新一代之典范。
8bc2b9d2f6c12dcc0ed3284f5f23df728ea34d04.translatedText: Honorary Dr. Tsai Ching-yen, a pioneer in weather forecasting and industrial innovation. Chairman of the Institute of Industrial Technology, Tsai Ching-yen, holds a Ph.D. in atmospheric sciences from the University of Utah. After returning to China, he taught at National Taiwan University for fifteen years. Later, he moved from academia to the public sector, serving as director of the Central Meteorological Administration, director of the Civil Aviation Administration, deputy chairman of the National Science Council, political affairs committee member of the Executive Yuan and deputy convener of the Science and Technology Advisory Group, and national policy adviser to the Presidential Office. He is a science and technology policy promoter that the government relies on. Cai Qingyan has been studying in the field of atmospheric science for nearly 30 years. Early weather forecasts had high prediction errors due to the lack of advanced technology. He introduced numerical weather forecasting systems, laying the foundation for the accuracy and modernization of today's weather forecasts. In addition, he actively cultivated talents and led his team to the United States to learn the latest forecasting technology. Every time a typhoon hits, the Central Meteorological Administration is able to issue early warnings, which is attributed to its foresight in cultivating talents and introducing the latest technology. When global industrial sectors are undergoing drastic shifts, Tsai Ching-yen has an insight into the current status of industrial development and future transformation opportunities, and advocates that Taiwan must move towards an "innovative economic system" and continue to innovate. During his tenure as the chairman of ITRI, he led ITRI to repeatedly win impressive results in the Top 100 U.S. Technology R&D Awards and the Wall Street Journal Technology Innovation Award with innovative technologies. He also established an innovation system that was praised by even the White House Science and Technology Advisory Committee, and actively implemented its mission of creating value for industry. In addition, we urge Taiwanese society to reshape the entrepreneurial culture, leverage the locomotive effect of new ventures to drive industrial structural transformation, encourage colleagues to start businesses to support more outstanding entrepreneurs, transform forward-looking technologies into new startups, drive industrial momentum and development, and find new outlets for innovation and entrepreneurship for Taiwanese young people and industries. He is also committed to the development of energy conservation, carbon reduction and renewable energy, building an industrial chain with forward-looking technology, and hopes that Taiwan will enter the global stage in the green energy industry. In addition, he will promote bilateral cooperation between Taiwan and Japan in the long term, exert international influence, and gain widespread response and attention from all walks of life in Japan. He has also contributed to the substantive connotation of the "Special Partnership" between Taiwan and Japan in the "Taiwan-Japan-China-New Golden Triangle", mediating exchanges and cooperation between Taiwan and Japan enterprises and signing memorandums and other important milestones, opening up new paths for the industry and making extraordinary contributions. Tsai Ching-yen has been cultivating Taiwan's high technology and atmospheric sciences for a long time and encouraged innovation and entrepreneurship. He has devoted his life to pursuing the progress of the country and society, and has made great contributions to the sustainability of Taiwan's industry and environment. He is truly a model for the new generation.

910a34637131f3156a17d80fd4e07727f821e718.sourceText: 凤凰城科工专报道：三月九日，凤凰城科工专召开了 2013 年度工作总结会议，在过去一年中，科工专多次组织会员和朋友们参加了登山，郊游，野餐的活动，活动安排周密， 组织井井有条，促进了会员之间的沟通联谊，得到了广泛的好评。希望在新的一年中能组织更多大家喜闻乐见，健康和乐的各项活动。
910a34637131f3156a17d80fd4e07727f821e718.translatedText: Phoenix College of Science and Technology reported: On March 9, Phoenix College of Science and Technology held its 2013 annual work meeting (picture) Annual work summary meeting. In the past year, the College of Science and Technology organized members and friends to participate in mountain climbing, outings, and picnics many times. The activities were carefully arranged and well organized, which promoted communication and friendship among members and received widespread praise. I hope that in the new year we can organize more activities that are enjoyable, healthy and enjoyable for everyone.

e1afdfee6e35958a1a3f3c1a4e54e2643cef79b3.sourceText: 2012 年，科工专还与 ASU 中国学生联谊会联合接待了来自云南的高科技招聘团，这次活动向许多愿意去中国发展的科工专会员以及中国留学生提供了一个难得的双向沟通的机会。期待 2013 年科工专将组织更多专业讲座，以及丰富多彩的文娱活动。
e1afdfee6e35958a1a3f3c1a4e54e2643cef79b3.translatedText: In 2012, the College of Science and Technology and the ASU Chinese Student Association jointly hosted a high-tech recruitment group from Yunnan. This event provided a rare two-way communication opportunity for many members of the College of Science and Technology and Chinese students who are willing to develop in China. We look forward to organizing more professional lectures and colorful cultural and entertainment activities in 2013.

7e381a4de59e48c496e0ab531faded079ace8930.sourceText: 新的一年中，当地知名工程师李江将加入到理事会中，协调和组织各项活动的开展。另外，科工专秘书李雨的关于数据库方面的专业书籍将于今年八月出版，届时，将举办讲座与大家分享。
7e381a4de59e48c496e0ab531faded079ace8930.translatedText: In the new year, Li Jiang, a well-known local engineer, will join the council to coordinate and organize the development of various activities. In addition, a professional book on databases by Li Yu, secretary of the College of Science and Engineering, will be published in August this year. At that time, a lecture will be held to share it with everyone.

af18c539c06955051f8ebe116d288ecde7ddf5d8.sourceText: 科工专特别感谢杨文田的赞助，以及其他会员和朋友们在时间，专业和经济上的付出，使得各项活动得以顺利开展。
af18c539c06955051f8ebe116d288ecde7ddf5d8.translatedText: The College of Science and Technology would like to express special thanks to Yang Wentian for his sponsorship, as well as other members and friends for their time, professional and financial contributions, which enabled the smooth development of various activities.

08fa25af386e7560302c799e33421fc37578ab0d.sourceText: （新东方艺术学校 供稿） 马年将至，2014马年春晚将再次于新年之后与您相约在CHANDLER艺术中心。本场晚会由新东方艺术学校与ASU孔子学院联合主办，并且获得了华人社区各界最广泛的支持与认可。
08fa25af386e7560302c799e33421fc37578ab0d.translatedText: (contributed by New Oriental Art School) The Year of the Horse is approaching, and the 2014 Year of the Horse Spring Festival Gala will meet you again after the New Year at the CHANDLER Art Center. This evening party was jointly organized by New Oriental Art School and the ASU Confucius Institute, and has received the widest support and recognition from all walks of life in the Chinese community.

4a70a53dacae3c797b80b85adac89055ba5ac97f.sourceText: 本场春晚的亮点之一，将是著名的小提琴演奏家曾晶女士的无偿演出。曾晶将在本场春晚中进行小提琴独奏。不久前，曾晶出演的消息一经公布，很多人纷纷打电话订票，她的加盟使得春晚门票更加炙手可热。如今，曾晶正在为她的春晚独奏曲积极准备着，观众将在春晚舞台上一瞩她的风采。
4a70a53dacae3c797b80b85adac89055ba5ac97f.translatedText: One of the highlights of this Spring Festival Gala will be the free performance of the famous violinist Ms. Zeng Jing. Zeng Jing will perform a violin solo in this Spring Festival Gala. Not long ago, as soon as the news of Zeng Jing's appearance was announced, many people called to book tickets. Her joining made the Spring Festival Gala tickets even more popular. Now, Zeng Jing is actively preparing for her Spring Festival Gala solo, and the audience will catch a glimpse of her grace on the Spring Festival Gala stage.

58910f6f3b3b4c739b3e6c6e78d4c0c5b5343624.sourceText: 曾晶毕业于美国著名的克里夫兰音乐学院。自24岁起就任职于凤凰城交响乐团第一小提琴师，近十年来，她一直是团中最年轻的乐师。作为华裔，曾晶以如此低的年龄和相当高超的技艺，跻身于以美国白人为主流的职业交响乐团，在美国本土乃至全世界，都属罕见。她所在的凤凰城交响乐团每年有二百多场演出，演出的门票价格高昂。
58910f6f3b3b4c739b3e6c6e78d4c0c5b5343624.translatedText: Zeng Jing graduated from the famous Cleveland Institute of Music in the United States. She has been the first violinist of the Phoenix Symphony Orchestra since she was 24 years old. For the past ten years, she has been the youngest musician in the orchestra. As a Chinese-American, Zeng Jing has joined a professional symphony orchestra dominated by white Americans at such a young age and with such superb skills, which is rare in the United States and even around the world. The Phoenix Symphony Orchestra she belongs to performs more than 200 performances every year, and the tickets for the performances are expensive.

543a7c78b484c14a71adab0575a8ce218b92e295.sourceText: 曾晶多次在美国及世界上许多国家演出，与众多世界知名的音乐家和指挥家同台献艺。她也曾与大提琴家马友友、钢琴家李云迪和郎朗等世界知名的华裔演奏家合作。不久前，曾晶所在的凤凰城交响乐团与著名电影导演斯庇尔伯格、电影音乐大师约翰 廉姆斯合作上演多场音乐会，轰动了整个凤凰城，而曾晶作为乐团一名出色的乐师，也参与了每一场演出。她的演奏水平及她与众多世界级音乐大师的多次合作，使得她在亚利桑那州的华人社区中极富盛名。
543a7c78b484c14a71adab0575a8ce218b92e295.translatedText: Zeng Jing has performed many times in the United States and many countries around the world, sharing the stage with many world-renowned musicians and conductors. She has also collaborated with world-renowned Chinese performers such as cellist Yo-Yo Ma and pianists Yundi Li and Lang Lang. Not long ago, Zeng Jing's Phoenix Symphony Orchestra collaborated with famous film director Spielberg and film music master John Williams to perform many concerts, which caused a sensation in the entire Phoenix City. Zeng Jing, as an outstanding musician of the orchestra, also participated in every performance. Her performance level and her many collaborations with many world-class music masters have made her very famous in the Chinese community in Arizona.

abaed73071920665cf394380f9b834ae3aff3277.sourceText: 亚省时报记者邓凌报导：由亚省华人保龄球协会主办的2012年度保龄球大赛圆满结束，于5月21日晚在红锅自助餐厅举行庆功宴会。 ”亚省中餐馆协会第二队”获得本年度大赛的总冠军。 今年赞助保龄球赛的单位有：亚省中餐馆协会（两队）、六福酒家、算盘酒家、余氏快餐等。
abaed73071920665cf394380f9b834ae3aff3277.translatedText: Alberta Times reporter Deng Ling reported: The 2012 annual bowling competition hosted by the Alberta Chinese Bowling Association came to a successful conclusion, and a celebration banquet was held at the Red Pot Cafeteria on the evening of May 21st. "Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association Second Team" won the overall championship of this year's competition. This year's sponsors of the bowling game include: Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association (two teams), Luk Fook Restaurant, Abacus Restaurant, Yu's Fast Food, etc.

4acd4847390ca786fd780e8432d917b0d98f6941.translatedText: "The Second Team of the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association" won the overall championship of this year's competition. From left, Ray Tran, Wu Yizhao, Deng Chaoju, Yang Zhengang, Lai Jiayi, Zhu Qihua and Zhou Jinfang.

5ef4e769c84037c695fff231f6c8f40c6a1b1f16.sourceText: ”凤凰城华人保龄球会”于五十多年前创办，当时本埠的华人很少，文娱活动很缺乏，保龄球会的成立令大家在工馀时间可相聚打球，彼此联络感情之馀又可舒缓工作压力，受到侨胞的欢迎，同时也得到很多商家及中餐馆的支持和赞助，数十年来如一日，保龄球会都坚持每星期一晚在固定的保龄球场馆举行比赛训练，球员来自各行各业，其中任职餐馆的人士佔大多数，故此，亚省中餐馆协会长期鼓励会员的员工在工馀时间参加打球，既为娱乐活动又强身健体，一举两得。 暑假6-8月期间，每逢星期一晚上九时后，亚省华人保龄球协会将在19Ave Bethany Home Rd的保龄球场馆举行训练班，并会有专人指导新学员，欢迎有兴趣的朋友参加，详情请电巫宜钊：623-341-5032.
5ef4e769c84037c695fff231f6c8f40c6a1b1f16.translatedText: "Phoenix Chinese Bowling Club" was founded more than 50 years ago. At that time, there were very few Chinese in the city and there was a lack of recreational activities. The establishment of the bowling club allowed everyone to get together to play ball in their spare time, connect with each other and relieve work pressure. It was welcomed by overseas Chinese, and was also welcomed by many businesses and Chinese restaurants. With the support and sponsorship of the bowling alley, the bowling club has insisted on holding competition training every Monday night at a fixed bowling alley for decades. Players come from all walks of life, and most of them work in restaurants. Therefore, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association has long encouraged employees of members to participate in bowling in their spare time, which is both entertainment and physical fitness. It kills two birds with one stone. During the summer vacation from June to August, every Monday after 9 pm, the Chinese Bowling Association of Alberta will hold a training class at the bowling alley at 19 Ave Bethany Home Rd. There will be dedicated personnel to guide new students. Interested friends are welcome to participate. For details, please call Wu Yizhao: 623-341-5032.
