7e288f7ea7083931e876e789b2957672da45c70e.sourceText: 2013年8月15日,中国海外交流协会和各省市的”海外交流协会”主办的”中国寻根之旅”夏令营圆满落下帷幕。全美中文学校协会承办了夏令营在美国的报名和组织工作。今年，协会在上百个” 中国寻根之旅”夏 令营中选择了十个夏令营, 它们分别是上海营、上海舞蹈营、常州营、南京-北京营、四川营、四川-北京营、辽宁-北京营、两个北京营和在北京的”中华文化知识竞赛”优胜者营。在协会精选的10位领队老师的带领下, 共有122名学生参加了这十个夏令营。他们中年龄最大的为18岁?年龄最小的10岁。
7e288f7ea7083931e876e789b2957672da45c70e.translatedText: On August 15, 2013, the "China Roots Journey" summer camp hosted by the China Overseas Exchange Association and the "Overseas Exchange Associations" of various provinces and cities came to a successful conclusion. The National Association of Chinese Schools undertook the registration and organization of summer camps in the United States. This year, the association selected ten summer camps among hundreds of "China Roots Journey" summer camps, which are Shanghai Camp, Shanghai Dance Camp, Changzhou Camp, Nanjing-Beijing Camp, Sichuan Camp, Sichuan-Beijing Camp, Liaoning-Beijing Camp, two Beijing camps and the "Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition" Winners' Camp in Beijing. Under the leadership of 10 leading teachers selected by the association, a total of 122 students participated in these ten summer camps. The oldest among them is 18 years old and the youngest is 10 years old.

44e6f41412e3839f1851c3e433b32e911e6b1cc9.sourceText: 2013年2月，全美中文学校协会开始筹备组织协会范围内中文学校的学生参加 ”中国寻根之旅”夏令营。会长帅致若女士和副会长郑良根先生开始协调与联络，分别与夏令营各相关主办方联系，得到了多种多样的夏令营报名机会。特别重要的是，协会与中国海外交流协会相关部门联系，将前两年”中华文化知识大赛”获胜者的夏令营落实到北京市内举办，成为今年各个夏令营项目中的一大亮点。
44e6f41412e3839f1851c3e433b32e911e6b1cc9.translatedText: In February 2013, the National Association of Chinese Schools began preparations to organize students from Chinese schools within the association to participate in the "China Roots Journey" summer camp. The president, Ms. Shuai Zhiruo, and the vice president, Mr. Zheng Lianggen, began to coordinate and communicate with relevant summer camp organizers respectively, and obtained a variety of summer camp registration opportunities. What is particularly important is that the association contacted the relevant departments of the China Overseas Exchange Association to organize the summer camps of the winners of the "Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition" in the previous two years to be held in Beijing, which became a highlight of various summer camp projects this year.

9103e4e2059bbfceb944d43362c8b51008b1e986.sourceText: 相应地，协会”大型项目部”立即组成了夏令营工作组，人员包括协会理事张星钰先生﹑协会执委会江江先生和倪黎松先生。工作组继续跟国内各地相关部门联系，具体落实每一个营地，每一所学校，每一名学生的报名手续。处理了来自全美40多所中文学校的200多名学生的报名申请。在夏令营开始前，”大型项目部”主任张星钰理事主持召开了全体领队参加的行前准备会, 郑良根副会长向领队们分享了以前领队工作的经验, 大家在会上讨论了相关问题。工作组还希望领队老师能够通过协会的脸书（Facebook）实时或及时报告各地夏令营的情况。
9103e4e2059bbfceb944d43362c8b51008b1e986.translatedText: Accordingly, the association's "Large Project Department" immediately formed a summer camp working group, including association director Mr. Zhang Xingyu, association executive committee members Mr. Jiang Jiang and Mr. Ni Lisong. The working group continues to contact relevant departments across the country to implement the registration procedures for each camp, each school and each student. Processed registration applications from more than 200 students from more than 40 Chinese schools across the United States. Before the start of the summer camp, Director Zhang Xingyu of the "Large Project Department" presided over a pre-departure preparation meeting attended by all team leaders. Vice President Zheng Lianggen shared his previous team leadership experience with the team leaders, and everyone discussed relevant issues at the meeting. The working group also hopes that the leading teachers can report the situation of summer camps in various places in real time or in a timely manner through the association’s Facebook.

fc192bab9182be89e061d853fa6c6630048378f8.sourceText: ”中国寻根之旅”夏令营，已经在国内连续举办多年，不论是在教学和活动内容方面上，还是安全措施和生活安排方面，都是第一流的。这次协会团队的领队老师和学生，多数都是第一次参加这个夏令营。丰富多彩的文化和语言的课堂教学；各具特色的传统艺术和工艺的手工实践；闻名遐迩的名胜古迹和日新月异的现代都市的参观游览；琳琅满目的传统佳肴和各种美食美味的品尝，给他们带来了一个个的惊叹、欢乐和满足。
fc192bab9182be89e061d853fa6c6630048378f8.translatedText: The "China Roots Journey" summer camp has been held continuously in China for many years. It is first-class in terms of teaching and activity content, as well as safety measures and living arrangements. Most of the leading teachers and students of the association team participated in this summer camp for the first time. The classroom teaching of rich and colorful culture and languages; the handicraft practice of unique traditional arts and crafts; the visits to famous scenic spots and historic sites and the ever-changing modern cities; the dazzling array of traditional delicacies and the tasting of various delicacies brought them wonder, joy and satisfaction one by one.

f96be3d421a81dbf9baf8257260b93fa592bf45c.sourceText: 我们的领队们肩负重任，不但要认真管理好自己的队伍，照顾好孩子们的学习和生活起居，还要及时将情况向协会、学校、以及家长们通报。领队们有的每天记日记，有的每天传邮件给中文学校和营员家长，有的及时把日记和照片发到协会脸书上。对此，营员的家长很满意，他们通过邮件等形式向领队们表示谢意。协会理事会成员、夏令营工作组成员、各学校负责人和营员的家长，对领队们的认真负责、细致周到、不辞劳苦的工作态度都有很正面的评价，并表示由衷的感谢。领队的名单如下：南京-北京营：依慧(兼协会夏令营总领队)，上海一地营：张挺、江虹，常州一地营：陆平，四川一地营：谢卫华、邓红，四川-北京营：陆江，北京营：唐维珂，”中华文化竞赛”优胜营（北京）：谢敦贤、陈霞。
f96be3d421a81dbf9baf8257260b93fa592bf45c.translatedText: Our team leaders shoulder the heavy responsibility. They must not only manage their team carefully and take good care of the children's study and daily life, but also report the situation to the association, school, and parents in a timely manner. Some team leaders keep diaries every day, some send emails to Chinese schools and campers’ parents every day, and some promptly post diaries and photos to the association’s Facebook page. The parents of the campers were very satisfied with this, and they expressed their gratitude to the team leaders through emails and other forms. Members of the association's board of directors, members of the summer camp working group, school leaders and parents of campers all spoke positively of the team leaders' serious, responsible, meticulous and hard-working attitude and expressed their sincere gratitude. The list of team leaders is as follows: Nanjing-Beijing camp: Yi Hui (also the general leader of the association’s summer camp), Shanghai camp 1: Zhang Ting, Jiang Hong, Changzhou camp: Lu Ping, Sichuan camp: Xie Weihua, Deng Hong, Sichuan-Beijing camp: Lu Jiang, Beijing camp: Tang Weike, “Chinese Culture Competition” winning camp (Beijing): Xie Dunxian, Chen Xia.

2fca299930ca7541261b1a079aa98b9eeab6f5e8.sourceText: 值得一提的是，在各夏令营推选营员发言代表的过程中，经过协会和江苏省海外交流协会的选拔推荐，由副会长郑良根全程指导申报，并且协助四易讲稿，来自于北卡州教堂山中文学校的尹卡同学，从10多名候选人中脱颖而出， 最终中选。在夏令营期间，经过总领队依慧老师的精心指导，尹卡同学作为四千多营员的代表，在北京人民大会堂举行的大型集结营开营式上发言。思远同学在上海一地营获优秀营员奖；郑方达同学在北京优胜营的闭营仪式上代表营员讲了话；郭聆风同学（亚省现代中文学校）获常州一地营征文比赛二等奖；郭斯原同学（亚省现代中文学校）获常州一地营摄影比赛二等奖；郭斯原同学还被推选为常州一地夏令营闭幕式节目主持人；依慧老师在江苏夏令营作为领队代表发言；陆平老师（亚省现代中文学校）在常州一地营的开幕式上作为领队代表发言，结营时获常州一地营优秀领队奖。邓红领队作为领队代表在四川一地营闭营式上发言。
2fca299930ca7541261b1a079aa98b9eeab6f5e8.translatedText: It is worth mentioning that in the process of selecting camper speech representatives from each summer camp, after being recommended by the association and the Jiangsu Overseas Exchange Association, Vice President Zheng Lianggen guided the application throughout the process and assisted Siyi's speech. Yinka, a student from Chapel Hill Chinese School in North Carolina, stood out from more than 10 candidates and was finally selected. During the summer camp, under the careful guidance of the team leader Yi Hui, Yin Ka, as a representative of more than 4,000 campers, spoke at the opening ceremony of the large-scale camp held in the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. Student Siyuan won the Outstanding Camper Award in Shanghai First Camp; classmate Zheng Fangda spoke on behalf of the campers at the closing ceremony of the winning camp in Beijing; student Guo Lingfeng (Asia Modern Chinese School) won the second prize in the Changzhou First Camp Essay Competition; and student Guo Siyuan (Alia Modern Chinese School) won the second prize in the Changzhou First Camp Photography Competition. First prize; Guo Siyuan was also selected as the host of the closing ceremony of the Changzhou Summer Camp; Teacher Yi Hui spoke as the leader representative at the Jiangsu Summer Camp; Teacher Lu Ping (Asia Modern Chinese School) spoke as the leader representative at the opening ceremony of the Changzhou First Camp, and won the Changzhou First Camp Outstanding Leader Award at the end of the camp. Team leader Deng Hong, as the team leader’s representative, spoke at the closing ceremony of a camp in Sichuan.

260fedb27dbc9ec9a2f4757358db313ca5ccb535.sourceText: ”中华文化知识竞赛”优胜营还进行了汉语口语水平测试，协会的19名营员全部参加，7名取得高等成绩，12名取得中等，没有一名落榜。成绩公布后，皆大欢喜，每个人都拿到了主办方颁发的证书，真正显示了协会营员的汉语听说实力
260fedb27dbc9ec9a2f4757358db313ca5ccb535.translatedText: The winning camp of the "Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition" also conducted a Chinese oral proficiency test. All 19 campers from the association participated, 7 achieved advanced results, 12 achieved intermediate results, and no one failed. After the results were announced, everyone was happy. Everyone got a certificate issued by the organizer, which truly showed the Chinese listening and speaking skills of the campers of the association

04bd717a831d06ecfc2ce4af0a8b4a4cda13e9ea.sourceText: 协会的领队们和全体营员在夏令营中收获满满，他们代表全美中文学校协会的团队，在各项活动中取得了优异的成绩，展现了华裔青少年的风貌。我们收到了很多主办方和承办单位发来的表扬信和感谢信，对协会各夏令营的领队和营员们给予了很好的评价和赞扬。
04bd717a831d06ecfc2ce4af0a8b4a4cda13e9ea.translatedText: The team leaders and all the campers of the association gained a lot from the summer camp. They represented the team of the National Association of Chinese Schools and achieved excellent results in various activities, showing the style of Chinese teenagers. We have received many letters of commendation and thanks from the organizers and organizers, and they have given good comments and praise to the team leaders and campers of the association’s summer camps.

64fa81d4ac4083875be3413db7244a4b433a3dfa.sourceText: （美西中国美术家协会来稿）上周日（10月27日）下午，80多位美术爱好者在TEMPE 的Painted with oil 画廊欢聚，共同观赏美西中国美术家协会主办的华人美术作品展，观赏画廊里来自中国大芬村的美术作品以及美西地区富有特色的美术家的作品。
64fa81d4ac4083875be3413db7244a4b433a3dfa.translatedText: (Committed by the Western American Chinese Artists Association) Last Sunday (October 27th) afternoon, more than 80 art lovers gathered at the Painted with oil gallery in TEMPE to watch the Chinese art exhibition hosted by the Western American Chinese Artists Association, and appreciate the art works from Dafen Village in China and the works of distinctive artists from the Western American region.

f8fd05157962309fbff0b52fc739102d6bef57a7.sourceText: 本次画展共有51位华人、60幅的作品参展。画展评委会由协会秘书长梁 美燕画家、书法家陈普博士、画家林萱、以及协会理事李明良先生组成。评委们在对所有作品观摩和研讨后， 投票选举出9幅杰出美术作品和11幅优秀美术作品。参展的作品绘画题材丰富，汇集和闪耀着中西文化艺术的特色。充分展示了亚省华人对中华艺术的热爱和追崇；展示了亚省华人的绘画技能和艺术天赋。
f8fd05157962309fbff0b52fc739102d6bef57a7.translatedText: A total of 51 Chinese people and 60 works participated in this exhibition. The jury for the art exhibition is composed of painter Liang Meiyan, secretary-general of the association, calligrapher Dr. Chen Pu, painter Lin Xuan, and association director Mr. Li Mingliang. After observing and discussing all the works, the judges voted to select 9 outstanding art works and 11 outstanding art works. The exhibited paintings have rich themes, bringing together and shining the characteristics of Chinese and Western culture and art. It fully demonstrates the love and admiration of Chinese art by Chinese people in Alberta; it also demonstrates the painting skills and artistic talent of Chinese people in Alberta.

e27cf0082fe759a2ed0b0ab176e2d629bcd82028.sourceText: 在当天下午的画展结束颁奖典礼上，协会主席林峰画家首先感谢Painted with oil 为亚省华人的画展提供专业的画廊， 感谢太阳鸟亚利桑那华人网、凤凰网、亚省时报以及现代和希望中文学校为本次画展活动提供了及时连续的信息传播。
e27cf0082fe759a2ed0b0ab176e2d629bcd82028.translatedText: At the award ceremony at the end of the art exhibition that afternoon, Painted with Oil, Chairman of the Association, Lin Feng, first thanked Painted with oil for providing a professional gallery for the Chinese art exhibition in Alberta. He also thanked Sunbird Arizona Chinese Network, Phoenix.com, the Alberta Times, and Modern and Hope Chinese School for providing timely and continuous information dissemination for this art exhibition.

eb8fd6bda20db4515cc818eba24e4f0d755e7bd3.sourceText: 林峰画家对主要参展作品进行了分类点评，让大家充分感受水墨画，水彩画，油彩画，丙烯画等不同绘画材质所创造出的不同绘画艺术效果。艺术的创作应该根据自己设定的目标，选择最佳表现力的美术材料，从构图设计到色彩应用，展示自己的绘画技术和创意，给人以美的艺术享受。
eb8fd6bda20db4515cc818eba24e4f0d755e7bd3.translatedText: Painter Lin Feng gave a classified review of the main exhibition works, allowing everyone to fully experience the different artistic effects created by different painting materials such as ink painting, watercolor painting, oil painting, and acrylic painting. Art creation should be based on the goals you set, choose art materials with the best expressiveness, from composition design to color application, show your painting skills and creativity, and give people beautiful artistic enjoyment.

c9143f6a25bdd3bd1ab3aa4741f8c9a86c437cb2.sourceText: 在浓烈厚重的西洋画廊艺术中，获得杰出奖的11岁安雅的白描花卉，11岁黄美达线描的乡村农舍和流水，没有华丽的色彩，只有简朴的线条勾画，仿佛是一股清泉，一股清新的空气流淌在画廊中。中国画的菊花和熊猫，水墨的韵味和笔趣，散发出中国传统的文化和艺术的气息。青少年们对中华艺术文化的学习和理解，实在难能可贵。 Kaitlyn 的 Cowgirl 和Jason 的西部晚归的绘画，应用了丰富的色彩对比，大胆的艺术绘画笔触，展示了西部晚霞的绚烂多彩，男孩女孩对劳动生活的喜悦。作品有强烈的艺术感染力。
c9143f6a25bdd3bd1ab3aa4741f8c9a86c437cb2.translatedText: Among the strong and heavy Western gallery art, 11-year-old Anya's line drawings of flowers, which won the Outstanding Award, and 11-year-old Huang Meida's line drawings of rural farmhouses and flowing water, have no gorgeous colors, only simple line drawings, as if they are a clear spring and a fresh air flowing in the gallery. The chrysanthemums and pandas in Chinese paintings, the charm and interest of ink and wash, exude the atmosphere of traditional Chinese culture and art. It is really valuable for young people to learn and understand Chinese art and culture. The paintings of Kaitlyn's Cowgirl and Jason's Late Return from the West use rich color contrasts and bold artistic painting strokes to show the gorgeous sunset in the West and the joy of boys and girls in working life. The works have strong artistic appeal.

025f980bcb20c5a69123aa874837dbe716d1e003.sourceText: 15岁Rucky 绘画的水鸭素描，造型优美准确，素描明暗和空间感都十分到位，水鸭羽毛的刻画恓恓如生。11岁CABDY 的风景素描，前景的树木刻画略有些呆板和沉闷，对树叶的疏松密度，远景和近景绘画技巧处理有待进一步提高。ERIC, JUSTIN 的等几位11岁以下孩子的线描水彩画，充分展示了他们对透视比例关系的学习和理解，并大胆地应用到学习和生活中。
025f980bcb20c5a69123aa874837dbe716d1e003.translatedText: The sketch of the teal drawn by 15-year-old Rucky is beautiful and accurate in shape, the light and shade and the sense of space in the sketch are perfect, and the depiction of the teal's feathers is as vivid as life. In the landscape sketch of 11-year-old CABDY, the depiction of trees in the foreground is a bit dull and boring. The loose density of leaves, and the handling of distant and close-up painting skills need to be further improved. The line drawing watercolor paintings of ERIC, JUSTIN and several other children under the age of 11 fully demonstrate their learning and understanding of the relationship between perspective and proportion, and they boldly apply it to study and life.

77675674e2f455eaa1aecca93205653489f0d7e4.sourceText: Color pencil 绘画在美国受到中小学生的喜爱。几位15岁左右孩子的动物绘画，造型优美、逼真，细节刻画微妙微巧。充分展示了他们对color PENCIL 的绘画技术的熟练掌握。然而Wolf 作品把远处山峦和岩石画的的过大，且色彩和用笔过重, 使画面主题不能突出。夕阳下奔跑的烈马与牛仔相比，人物画的过大等等问题，说明对绘画比例和透视的学习，今后亟待进一步的提高。
77675674e2f455eaa1aecca93205653489f0d7e4.translatedText: Color pencil painting is loved by primary and secondary school students in the United States. The animal paintings by several children around 15 years old are graceful and lifelike, with subtle details. It fully demonstrates their proficiency in color PENCIL's painting techniques. However, in Wolf's works, the mountains and rocks in the distance are too large, and the colors and brushstrokes are too heavy, so that the theme of the picture cannot be highlighted. Compared with the cowboys and the horses running in the sunset, the figures are too large, which shows that the learning of painting proportions and perspective needs to be further improved in the future.

bc9767f5717081968bcfb1a285dc7f740823a9c7.sourceText: 林峰画家指出，Color pencil 画动物一种十分有趣的绘画学习，其刻画出的效果犹如现实中的活生生的动物。 他提醒艺术爱好者: 这种绘画学习要防止走入临摹画照片的境地， 削弱自身的绘画艺术创造力。 为此，林峰特别向大家展示了多次在全美动物绘画比赛中获头奖的Adam Grimm画家的鸭邮画， 逼真的写实主义和古典艺术主义相结合。
bc9767f5717081968bcfb1a285dc7f740823a9c7.translatedText: Painter Lin Feng pointed out that drawing animals with Color pencil is a very interesting way to learn painting, and the effect of its depiction is like a living animal in reality. He reminded art lovers: This kind of painting learning should prevent them from copying photos and weakening their own painting artistic creativity. For this reason, Lin Feng specially showed you the duck stamp paintings of Adam Grimm, a painter who has won the first prize in the National Animal Painting Competition many times. It combines realistic realism and classical art.

40489f621c8416a9b64e2dcebcac81b330fab403.sourceText: 书法家陈普博士向大家介绍了中国书法艺术。 他说书法的 ”书”即文字、写字、记录。就书法而言，书写的主要内容为文学作品。”法”即法度、方法。就书法而言，”法”主要指规则和楷模。 书法的功用是高层次大艺术创作活动，是一种抽象的艺术形式。书法贯穿了数千年的中国文化进程。除了一般的实用功能之外，书法还有修养的功能。书法的修养包括了修心养性，陶冶情操，文艺涵养，养身健康等许多方面。在介绍书法的欣赏时，陈普博士告诉大家，好的书法作品可以用一个”正”字来概括，即心正，笔正，态势正。
40489f621c8416a9b64e2dcebcac81b330fab403.translatedText: Calligrapher Dr. Chen Pu introduced the art of Chinese calligraphy to everyone. He said that the "book" of calligraphy refers to words, writing, and recording. As far as calligraphy is concerned, the main content of writing is literary works. "Dharma" refers to laws and methods. As far as calligraphy is concerned, "law" mainly refers to rules and models. The function of calligraphy is a high-level artistic creation activity and an abstract art form. Calligraphy has run through the course of Chinese culture for thousands of years. In addition to its general practical functions, calligraphy also has a cultivation function. The cultivation of calligraphy includes many aspects such as cultivating the mind and character, cultivating sentiments, cultivating literature and art, and maintaining health. When introducing the appreciation of calligraphy, Dr. Chen Pu told everyone that good calligraphy works can be summarized by the word "zheng", that is, the heart is right, the pen is right, and the posture is right.

9a5146344c51d47d450443f0ff3700ec8f8a8db2.sourceText: 最后，画廊经理Rober、陈普和林峰为本次杰出美术作品和优秀美术作品以及所有参加本次美术作品展的作者颁发了证书和奖品。 特别令大家为之惊呀的是美西画家协会特意从中国购买一批魔力书法水写布贴，用水来学习写书法，可使用上数千次。即方便又卫生。避免了在美国难以买到墨水和宣纸。
9a5146344c51d47d450443f0ff3700ec8f8a8db2.translatedText: Finally, gallery managers Rober, Chen Pu and Lin Feng awarded certificates and prizes to the outstanding and excellent art works and all the authors participating in this art exhibition. What particularly surprised everyone was that the American Painters Association specially purchased a batch of magic calligraphy water stickers from China. They can use water to learn calligraphy and can be used thousands of times. It is convenient and hygienic. Avoiding the difficulty of purchasing ink and rice paper in the United States.

3554f603cd637d7a9fcf0bca5a8553d1927127f8.sourceText: 2012学年希望中文学校学生会选举 （希望中文学校供稿）2012年11月17日，希望中文学校的学生们迎来了又一次的学生会选举。此次选举已经是第七届了。随着前六年学生会成员的努力，学校的学生会活动被办的有声有色，理所当然的，学生会选举也吸引了更多的学生加入进来。 选举当天，学校最大的阶梯教室济济一堂。五年级以上的学生都汇聚在此，摩拳擦掌准备投下他们庄严而神圣的一票。 在本次选举指导老师吴涛简单讲解了选举的流程和投票规则后，每位竞选者都依次上台发表了自己的演说。依稀记得第一、二年的选举，学生的竞选演讲还是那么生涩和稚嫩，如今放眼望去，只见每个竞选者都盛装打扮，男生不乏衬衫领带，女生也是套装或者漂亮的裙子，更有因为忙于其他事情而不能赶到现场的竞选者，发来事先录好的演说视频，对于参选的重视程度可见一斑。他们带来了自己精心制作的竞选海报，陈述了自己竞选的意愿，表明了自己的能力和心意，以及如果竞选成功能够为大家所作的事情。一个个竞选者，有的声音平和，仿佛和大家聊天；有的抑扬顿挫充满激情，颇有政客的风采。一次次喝彩声在礼堂中想起。 不少竞选者坦言，之所以来参选，是因为受到前几届成员的影响，从而走上”政坛”的。确实，上几届的学生会成员不但协助学校管理日常学校的事务，维持学校秩序，清洁学校环境，更是积极组织了学校运动会，还为各地灾区募集捐款。他们的这些行为深深感动和影响了身边的同学们，于是更多的人立志投身到学生会的工作中。 在所有的竞选者发表了自己的演说后，每个在场的投票者都深思熟虑，权衡良久，然后勾选了心目中的候选人。 本次选举的最终结果如下： President of HCSSC：Michael Wu Vice President HCSSC：Lisa Zou President of Elementary Student Society：David Wu Secretary：Simon Zeng Treasurer：Hannah Li Webmaster of Student Council：Azalea Phan President of Student Sports Club：Jeffrey Liu President of Student Art and Music Club：Allison Chen President of Student Chinese Education Club：Justin Zhu 学校董事会和校委会对这些成员的当选表示热烈的祝贺，并期望他们能够尽快接过上一届成员的接力棒，继续更好的为所有同学服务。
3554f603cd637d7a9fcf0bca5a8553d1927127f8.translatedText: > Hope Chinese School Student Union Election 2012 School Year (Contributed by Hope Chinese School) On November 17, 2012, students of Hope Chinese School ushered in another student union election. This election is already the seventh. With the efforts of the student union members in the past six years, the school's student union activities have been successfully organized. Of course, the student union elections have also attracted more students to join. On the day of the election, the school’s largest lecture theater was packed with people. Students in fifth grade and above gathered here, gearing up to cast their solemn and sacred vote. After the election instructor Wu Tao briefly explained the election process and voting rules, each candidate took the stage and delivered his or her speech. I vaguely remember the elections in the first and second years. The students’ campaign speeches were still so raw and immature. Now, looking around, I can see that every candidate is dressed up. The boys are wearing shirts and ties, and the girls are wearing suits or beautiful skirts. Candidates who can’t make it to the scene because they are busy with other things have sent pre-recorded speech videos, which shows how seriously they attach importance to their candidacy. They brought their carefully crafted campaign posters, stating their intention to run, their abilities and intentions, and what they could do for everyone if the campaign was successful. Each candidate has a calm voice, as if chatting with everyone; some are full of passion and have the style of a politician. The cheers echoed in the auditorium again and again. Many candidates admitted that they came to run for office because they were influenced by previous members and entered the "political arena." Indeed, members of the previous student unions not only assisted the school in managing daily school affairs, maintaining school order, and cleaning the school environment, they also actively organized school sports meets and raised donations for disaster areas in various places. Their actions deeply moved and affected the students around them, so more and more people decided to devote themselves to the work of the student union. After all the candidates gave their speeches, every voter present thought carefully, weighed for a long time, and then checked the candidate in their mind. The final results of this election are as follows: President of HCSSC: Michael Wu Vice President HCSSC: Lisa Zou President of Elementary Student Society: David Wu Secretary: Simon Zeng Treasurer: Hannah Li Webmaster of Student Council: Azalea Phan President of Student Sports Club: Jeffrey Liu President of Student Art and Music Club: Allison Chen President of Student Chinese Education Club: Justin Zhu The School Board of Directors and the School Committee warmly congratulate these members on their election and hope that they can take over the baton from the previous members as soon as possible and continue to better serve all students.

428c1dbbe49b5a41f601670d15a6a24e7e95cb17.sourceText: 太平洋两岸，我们与天同庆—2012独立日获奖作文选登（二等奖） （作者：曾梧欣，１４岁） 欢乐的笑声，交织着我复杂的心情。美国国庆，作为华侨的我又能做些什么呢？ 我，今年14岁，两年前的今天，我踏上了这片混合着花香的土地并且展开了我全新的生活。我带着对未来的憧憬来到了这里，也是这片土地给了我未来的希望。妈妈常对我说，做人别忘本，别忘了你生在那里、是从那里来。是，我的祖国是中国，她就是我的母亲养育了我12年，我爱我的家乡，我更爱我的母亲。可是正当我想家，埋怨这个地方的时候，我不得不承认我在这儿已经埋下了未来的种子。中国就像我心底的那澈清水，安静而舒适，是我思恋的她。恰恰相反的是，美国就像波澜起伏的惊涛骇浪，等着我去闯、去冲刺。 因此，我感谢培育我和给予我知识与未来的美国。 美国国庆，又名’独立纪念日’，顾名思义，每年的7月4日，这个日子是美国国民们纪念1776年7月4日大陆会议在费城正式通过《独立宣言》。 它标志着英国在北美的殖民地和英国正式分开，走向独立建国的道路，更象征着美国的自由和自主。说到美国国庆，我不得不说到当年美国勇士们的勇于抗战的精神。在历史课上，当老师眉飞色舞地讲起美国人民的改革道路，我听地入神了，那一篇篇生动的画面就仿佛在我眼前上演着栩栩如生的历史纪录片。我被这些爱国者的坚强不屈所折服了，身为一位新移民我感到自豪，而更多的是为它感到欢喜与感动。 美国人对自由、平等的渴望与最求让我领悟到了另一种文化的背景和成长。国人思想的核心是个人主义。过去，我以为个人主义就是自私自利，而这完全是误解。个人主义与自私自利是完全不同的两个概念。我明白了个人主义就是要努力实现自己的人生价值。人就只有一次的生命，与其庸庸碌碌的度过一生，为何不让自己成为一位有用的人并且对这个社会做出贡献？美国人追求自由和平等。他们追求的是起点平等、机会平等，而不是结果平等。这一点给了我这新移民很大的启发棗即时我从初中才来到了这里，但我和普通的同龄人有着同样的机会和条件。所以不需要感到自卑或抬不起头，因为只要有付出，就会有收获。 我也懂得了美国人始终乐观进取。他们总是乐观的、进取的。我的老师总是对我说，’别灰心，在努力一次，你一定会做得很好’。美国老师们乐观、积极向上的态度总能给我无比强大的自信心，让我在激流中勇进，不轻言放弃。 美国人也非常崇尚工作和劳动。孩子成人以后，很少和父母住在一起，也很少需要父母的资助。这一点和中国的孩子有很大的反差，中国的父母亲总是盲目的认为，孩子学习是关键，所以中国孩子就是家长们的手中宝。这就导致了大学毕业的学生们却找不到一份工作。在美国就不相同了，满16岁的高中生都能出来打工，为自己的生活和大学学费出份力。大学生普遍都是半工半读，所谓学习挣钱两不误。美国的这个文化特点是彻彻底底地改变了我和我家庭的古老观念。我开始学会帮妈妈做事、打工并且展开了自己的’小资生活。’ 在美国国庆即将到来的这个日子里，我仿佛深深的理解到了《独立宣言》的真正含义。是拥有着一颗独立的心，独立的思想，崇尚自由并且乐观进取。时刻记在心里，我们都是勇士，而不是懦夫。身为华侨的我们，我们坚持自己的理想，并且实现自己的理想！最后，无论你是太平洋一岸的华侨，甚至是另一岸的中国黄儿，都让我们举杯为美国的国庆节而欢呼吧！
428c1dbbe49b5a41f601670d15a6a24e7e95cb17.translatedText: On both sides of the Pacific, we celebrate together with heaven - Selected essays for the 2012 Independence Day (Second Prize) (Author: Zeng Wuxin, 14 years old) The joyful laughter intertwined with my complicated emotions. On the National Day of the United States, what can I do as an overseas Chinese? I am 14 years old this year. Two years ago today, I set foot on this land mixed with the fragrance of flowers and started my new life. I came here with a vision for the future, and this land gave me hope for the future. My mother often told me, as a human being, don’t forget your roots, don’t forget where you were born and where you come from. Yes, my motherland is China. She is my mother who has raised me for 12 years. I love my hometown and I love my mother even more. But just when I miss home and complain about this place, I have to admit that I have planted the seeds of my future here. China is like the clear water in my heart, quiet and comfortable, it is her that I miss. On the contrary, the United States is like a turbulent wave, waiting for me to break through and sprint. Therefore, I am grateful to the United States for nurturing me and giving me knowledge and a future. The National Day of the United States, also known as Independence Day, as the name suggests, is held on July 4 every year. This day is when American citizens commemorate the formal adoption of the Declaration of Independence by the Continental Congress in Philadelphia on July 4, 1776. It marks the formal separation of the British colonies in North America from the United Kingdom and the path to independent nation-building. It also symbolizes the freedom and independence of the United States. Speaking of the National Day of the United States, I have to talk about the courageous spirit of the American warriors in the war. In the history class, when the teacher talked about the reform path of the American people with great excitement, I listened with rapt attention. The vivid pictures seemed to be staged in front of my eyes like a vivid historical documentary. I was impressed by the tenacity of these patriots. As a new immigrant, I felt proud, and more importantly, I felt happy and moved by them. Americans’ desire and pursuit for freedom and equality allowed me to understand the background and growth of another culture. The core of Chinese people's thinking is individualism. In the past, I thought individualism meant selfishness, but this was a complete misunderstanding. Individualism and selfishness are two completely different concepts. I understand that individualism means working hard to realize your own life value. You only have one life. Instead of living it in a mediocre way, why not become a useful person and contribute to this society? Americans pursue freedom and equality. What they pursue is equality of starting points and equal opportunities, not equality of results. This has given me a lot of inspiration as a new immigrant. Even though I have only arrived here since junior high school, I have the same opportunities and conditions as ordinary peers. So there is no need to feel inferior or unable to hold your head high, because as long as you pay, you will gain. I also learned that Americans are always optimistic and enterprising. They are always optimistic and enterprising. My teacher always said to me, 'Don't be discouraged, try hard once and you will do well'. The optimistic and positive attitude of American teachers always gives me extremely strong self-confidence, allowing me to forge ahead bravely in the rapids and never give up easily. Americans also value work and labor very much. When children become adults, they rarely live with their parents and rarely need support from their parents. This is in great contrast with Chinese children. Chinese parents always blindly believe that children's learning is the key, so Chinese children are the treasures of parents. As a result, college graduates cannot find a job. It's different in the United States. High school students over the age of 16 can go out to work and contribute to their own lives and college tuition. College students generally work-study part-time, so-called studying and earning money. This cultural characteristic of the United States has completely changed the ancient concepts of me and my family. I began to learn to help my mother do things, work part-time, and started my own petty bourgeoisie life. ’ As the National Day of the United States approaches, I seem to deeply understand the true meaning of the Declaration of Independence. He has an independent heart and independent thoughts, advocates freedom and is optimistic and enterprising. Always remember that we are all warriors, not cowards. As overseas Chinese, we adhere to our ideals and realize our ideals! Finally, whether you are an overseas Chinese on one side of the Pacific or even a Chinese Huang on the other side, let us raise a glass and cheer for the National Day of the United States!

477e38e3314971113a67fd38b1489bffca937ac1.sourceText: 为促进全球华人高尔夫球运动，让海外华人了解和享受中国高尔夫球场，由全球华人高尔夫俱乐部、美国泛太平洋商会及北美多个球会团体联合承办的” 全球华人高尔夫邀请赛” 将于今年 10 月 15 日至 10 月 17 日，在中国云南昆明举行。截止目前，北美地区已有 70 名选手报名参加 ， 是历年来组团到中国参与高尔夫运动人数最多的一次 。
477e38e3314971113a67fd38b1489bffca937ac1.translatedText: In order to promote global Chinese golf and let overseas Chinese understand and enjoy Chinese golf courses, the "Global Chinese Golf Invitational" jointly organized by Global Chinese Golf Club, the American Pan-Pacific Chamber of Commerce and several golf club groups in North America will be held in Kunming, Yunnan, China from October 15th to October 17th this year. So far, 70 players from North America have signed up to participate, which is the largest number of people who have organized a group to participate in golf in China in the past years.

808c3d2542443d345f00f9fd5b015cfe66ffd342.sourceText: 加州参议员 夏乐柏 将亲自带队参加这次赛事，并将在 18 日与昆明当地商界举办” 中美企业论坛” 宣传投资加州的有关信息。南加州橡树谷学院著名教练汪志毅、多位国际知名的高尔夫教练将现场免费为高尔夫爱好者传授经验 、 并举办青少年培训讲座。
808c3d2542443d345f00f9fd5b015cfe66ffd342.translatedText: California Senator Xia Lebo will personally lead the team to participate in this event, and will hold a "China-US Business Forum" with the local business community in Kunming on the 18th to promote information about investing in California. Wang Zhiyi, the famous coach of Oak Valley College in Southern California, and many internationally renowned golf coaches will teach golf enthusiasts free experience and hold youth training lectures on site.

fdc3ad258811c3e68fdb167dc8420b394ac6ee94.sourceText: 这项高尔夫赛事从 2010 年在南加州由泛太平洋商会创办，去年 11 月首次落地中国黄山举行，参赛者十分踊跃，被中国高尔夫月刊成为”中国最大的国际性业余高尔夫赛事”。 2013 年度的全球华人高尔夫邀请赛地点位于风景绮丽，四季如春的云南昆明春城高尔夫俱乐部，该球场连续多年荣获亚洲 10 大球场, 分” 山景” 及” 湖景” 球场，各 18 洞, 比赛为期两天. 届时 ， 将有来自世界各地的华人高尔夫球手组队共襄盛会。本次比赛分为团体组、个人总杆组、个人净杆组、个人长青组等，奖品丰厚。
fdc3ad258811c3e68fdb167dc8420b394ac6ee94.translatedText: This golf tournament was founded by the Pan Pacific Chamber of Commerce in Southern California in 2010. It was held in Huangshan, China for the first time in November last year. The participants were very enthusiastic and it was called "China's largest international amateur golf tournament" by China Golf Monthly. The 2013 Global Chinese Golf Invitational Tournament will be held at Spring City Golf Club in Kunming, Yunnan, which has beautiful scenery and spring-like weather all year round. This course has been ranked among the top 10 golf courses in Asia for many years in a row. It is divided into "Mountain View" and "Lake View" courses, each with 18 holes. The competition lasts for two days. At that time, Chinese golfers from all over the world will form teams to participate in the event. This competition is divided into team group, individual gross group, individual net group, individual evergreen group, etc., with rich prizes.

3f08c52d16ecc6c849876c6896ffe43804c9cf0c.sourceText: 全球华人高尔夫邀请赛主席江启光表示，本次比赛吸引到大批来自世界不同地区的华裔高尔夫球爱好者参加。显示华人对高尔夫运动的热爱逐年增加，本赛事举办的目的是搭起体育之桥，促进全球华人华侨体育人士与中国的高球爱好者交流球技，以球会友。历次比赛专业性 、 挑战性强 、 参赛选手水平在 70 杆 –100 杆之间的业余爱好者，在全球华人高尔夫界获得巨大回响 。 2012 年在中国黄山的比赛取得了空前成功 ， 中央电视台特地派记者前往采访报道 。 今年的比赛移师中国昆明 ， 旨在让全球华人体验在中国的高尔夫乐趣，及順道畅游西南美景。本次比赛预计邀请到来自全球各地的 200 名海内外华裔选手参加 。 中国的选手则来自 20 几个不同的省市, 是一场胜况可期高尔夫盛会 。
3f08c52d16ecc6c849876c6896ffe43804c9cf0c.translatedText: Jiang Qiguang, chairman of the Global Chinese Golf Invitational Tournament, said that this tournament attracted a large number of Chinese golf enthusiasts from different regions of the world. It shows that the Chinese people's love for golf is increasing year by year. The purpose of this event is to build a sports bridge, promote the exchange of skills between overseas Chinese sports people around the world and Chinese golf enthusiasts, and make friends through golf. Previous competitions have been professional and challenging, with amateurs with players ranging in level from 70 to 100, and have received great repercussions in the global Chinese golf community. The 2012 competition in Huangshan, China achieved unprecedented success, and CCTV specially sent reporters to cover it. This year's competition moved to Kunming, China, aiming to allow Chinese people around the world to experience the fun of golf in China and enjoy the beautiful scenery of the southwest. This competition is expected to invite 200 Chinese players from all over the world to participate. Players from China come from more than 20 different provinces and cities, making it a golf event where success is expected.

c8aac04dc4319ed1c763dd39a110417ca0202923.sourceText: 南加州参加本次高尔夫赛事的主要球会包括：阳光、万年青及威龙等三大球會。他們还将赞助云南省青少年好手，免费参加 19 日在昆明滇池高尔夫俱乐部的一场青少年比賽，冠亚军可免费来美接受专业培训一周。
c8aac04dc4319ed1c763dd39a110417ca0202923.translatedText: The main golf clubs in Southern California participating in this golf tournament include: Sunshine, Evergreen and Dragon. They will also sponsor young athletes from Yunnan Province to participate in a youth competition at the Dianchi Golf Club in Kunming on the 19th for free. The champion and runner-up can come to the United States for free for a week to receive professional training.

42b661e437bb8795a7add505ef5247f0c8ffe93e.sourceText: 亚利桑那州总检察长汤姆霍恩周一召开新闻发布会，公开州府如何使用5700万美元房贷和解资金。 今年2月9日，亚利桑那州和全美48州政府、联邦政府和美国五家大型银行达成250亿美元协议，由银行提供170亿美元，其中美国银行和解款1000万美元，用于减少房贷本金 回收，为面临法拍的欠款人修改贷款，30亿美元帮助积欠房贷比房屋本身价值还高的借款人。 这项号称史上最大的州政府和联邦政府携手合作协议，使约75万2008年至2011年住房被法拍的房贷屋主，每人得到2000美元赔偿。 全美只有奥克拉荷马州没有参加。 协议也将让美国银行(Bank of America Corp)、富国银行(Wells Fargo & Co)、摩根大通集团(JPMorgan Chase & Co)、花旗集团(Citigroup Inc)和Ally Financial Inc等5间银行摆脱政府提出的 民事诉讼。 以上银行因法拍过程有问题，以及对贷款修正的要求处理不当遭诉。 2010年底浮现的证据显示，各银行以”机器人签署”(robo-signed)手法，未经适当审查就签署成千法拍文件。 亚利桑那州在这次和解案中得到5700万资金，霍恩检察长宣布，将用4100万美元来帮助面临法拍房主保住家园，和重新贷款。 其他款项将用于住房咨询，法律援助和宣传，让更多的合格贷款者了解这项和解基金的使用程序。
42b661e437bb8795a7add505ef5247f0c8ffe93e.translatedText: Arizona Attorney General Tom Horn held a press conference on Monday to disclose how the state used $57 million in mortgage settlement funds. On February 9 this year, Arizona, 48 state governments, the federal government, and five large U.S. banks reached a $25 billion agreement, with the banks providing $17 billion, including $10 million in settlement payments from Bank of America, which will be used to reduce mortgage principal recovery, modify loans for debtors facing foreclosure, and $3 billion to help borrowers whose mortgage debts are higher than the value of their homes. This is known as the largest joint cooperation agreement between the state and federal governments in history, allowing approximately 750,000 homeowners whose homes were foreclosed from 2008 to 2011 to receive $2,000 in compensation each. Only Oklahoma did not participate. The agreement will also allow five banks including Bank of America Corp, Wells Fargo & Co, JPMorgan Chase & Co, Citigroup Inc and Ally Financial Inc to escape civil lawsuits filed by the government. The above banks have been sued over problematic foreclosure processes and mishandling of loan modification requests. Evidence emerged in late 2010 that banks were using "robo-signed" techniques to sign thousands of foreclosure documents without proper review. Arizona received $57 million from this settlement, and Attorney General Horn announced that $41 million would be used to help homeowners facing foreclosure keep their homes and refinance their loans. Other funds will be used for housing counseling, legal assistance and publicity to make more qualified borrowers aware of the settlement fund's use process.

d0908f02ab52fba2785b73f0e574a3f7f5e48fb2.sourceText: 2013年慈济四十七周年庆凤凰城联络处浴佛典礼 (本网讯) 每年五月的第二个周末，是佛诞节，母亲节，更是全球慈济日，三节合一的大好日子。5月18日下午1时，近百大德来到慈济凤凰城联络处，以”’静思法脉勤行道、慈济宗门人间路’简朴增长慈悲心 真善涵养智慧爱”为主题，举行了隆重的浴佛典礼仪式。 浴佛仪式现场（一） 浴佛仪式现场（二） 主持人陈慈雨师姐和连義亮师兄向大德们介绍浴佛仪式的象征意义。浴佛者要内心虔诚期待五浊恶世里的凡夫，能以佛法除众生的无明烦恼，使众生增长智慧。了解了浴佛的意义后，浴佛仪式正式开始。在慈济师兄师姐的带领下，所有大德合掌唱诵，在悠扬的音乐声中，大家有序排队，慢慢步入浴佛台，祈求家家平安，天下无灾。大约到两点半，浴佛仪式圆满结束。 来自台湾的佛主首次亮相活动 慈济凤凰城联络处负责人蔡慈滔师姐告诉记者，本次浴佛台的佛主是从台湾请回来的，是首次在慈济的重大活动中亮相，很多大德都纷纷拍照留念。活动干事杨宝钏为了本次活动筹划了两个多月，在所有师兄师姐志工的努力下共同完成。 慈济是一个面向全球的慈善组织。慈济凤凰城联络处每天都向当地经济困难的市民发放食物，每年为没有保险的人提供免一至两次的免费体检，更是引导市民提倡环保，食素保健康等理念。
d0908f02ab52fba2785b73f0e574a3f7f5e48fb2.translatedText: Tzu Chi’s 47th Anniversary Phoenix Liaison Office’s 2013 Buddha Bathing Ceremony (This website’s news) The second weekend of May every year is Buddha’s Birthday, Mother’s Day, and Global Tzu Chi Day, three festivals in one. At 1:00 pm on May 18, nearly 100 great virtues came to the Tzu Chi Phoenix Liaison Office and held a grand Buddha Bathing Ceremony with the theme of "Quiet Meditation, Diligent Practice of the Dharma, and Tzu Chi Sect's Human Path. Simplicity Increases Compassion, True Kindness Cultivates Wisdom and Love." Buddha Bathing Ceremony Site (1) Buddha Bathing Ceremony Site (2) The hosts, Senior Sister Chen Ciyu and Senior Brother Lian Yiliang, introduced the symbolic meaning of the Buddha Bathing Ceremony to the eminent men. Those who bathe in the Buddha should sincerely hope that ordinary people in the evil world of five turbidities can use Buddhism to eliminate the ignorance and troubles of all living beings and make them increase their wisdom. After understanding the meaning of Buddha bathing, the Buddha bathing ceremony officially began. Under the leadership of Tzu Chi brothers and sisters, all the great saints clasped their hands and chanted. Amidst the melodious music, everyone lined up in an orderly manner and slowly walked into the Buddha bathing platform to pray for the safety of their families and the world's peace of mind. At about 2:30, the Buddha bathing ceremony came to a successful conclusion. A Buddha from Taiwan makes his first appearance at an event. Senior Sister Cai Citao, head of Tzu Chi’s Phoenix City Liaison Office, told reporters that the Buddha at the Buddha bathing platform was invited back from Taiwan and made his first appearance at a major Tzu Chi event. Many eminent monks took photos as a souvenir. Activity Officer Yang Baochuan planned this event for more than two months, and it was completed with the efforts of all brothers, sisters and volunteers. Tzu Chi is a global charity organization. The Tzu Chi Phoenix Liaison Office distributes food to local citizens with financial difficulties every day, provides one or two free medical examinations to those without insurance every year, and guides citizens to promote concepts such as environmental protection and vegetarianism to maintain health.

710fa5bc2284cb5338d1ce1be73bead876b78704.translatedText: Canada's Cochrane won the silver medal in 14 minutes, 39 seconds and 63 seconds. Tunisia's Mailouli won the bronze medal in 14 minutes, 40 seconds and 31 seconds

2f1e328798473c89ef7091ef140f0a8c0bf30f24.sourceText: 伦敦奥运会游泳比赛，男子1500米自由泳决赛，400米自由泳冠军孙杨，以14分31秒02夺冠并打破自己保持的世界纪录，夺取本届奥运会个人第二金。加拿大名将科克伦和卫冕冠军、突尼斯的迈卢利，分别以14分39秒63和14分40秒31获得银牌和铜牌，韩国名将朴泰桓以14分50秒61排在第四。
2f1e328798473c89ef7091ef140f0a8c0bf30f24.translatedText: London Olympic swimming competition, men's 1500 meters freestyle final, 400 meters freestyle champion Sun Yang won the championship in 14 minutes, 31 seconds and 02 seconds and broke his own world record, winning the second individual gold medal of this Olympic Games. Canada's Cochrane and the defending champion, Tunisia's Mailouli, won the silver and bronze medals in 14:39.63 and 14:40.31 respectively. South Korea's Park Tae-hwan ranked fourth in 14:50.61.

c4d348cd973b945bbf698a860acb3760d0e5d6a0.sourceText: 孙杨本届奥运会创造中国男子游泳的历史，首日就在400米自由泳中力压卫冕冠军朴泰桓获得冠军，夺取中国男子游泳奥运历史上第一金。此后孙杨又与朴泰桓并列获得200米自由泳亚军，领衔中国男子4?00米自由泳接力获得铜牌。
c4d348cd973b945bbf698a860acb3760d0e5d6a0.translatedText: Sun Yang created Chinese men's swimming history at this Olympics. On the first day, he defeated defending champion Park Tae-hwan in the 400-meter freestyle and won the championship, winning the first gold medal in Chinese men's swimming Olympic history. Since then, Sun Yang and Park Tae-hwan tied for runner-up in the 200-meter freestyle, and led the Chinese men's 4.00-meter freestyle relay to win the bronze medal.

229e4550077bb9c5d8e2873b5a1f19dec85299bd.sourceText: 1500米自由泳，孙杨将冲击个人本届奥运会的第二金。预赛时孙杨以14分43秒25获得小组第一，卫冕冠军、突尼斯的迈卢利14分46秒23获得小组第二。另外一个小组，加拿大名将科克伦14分49秒31小组第一，朴泰桓14分56秒89紧随其后。另外一位中国选手戴骏游出15分13秒90，小组只列第六。预赛总排名，孙杨高居第一，迈卢利第二，科克伦第三，意大利选手帕尔蒂里尼里和英国的福格列第四和第五，朴泰桓仅居第六，戴骏出局。
229e4550077bb9c5d8e2873b5a1f19dec85299bd.translatedText: >In the 1500-meter freestyle, Sun Yang will hit his second gold medal in this Olympics. In the preliminaries, Sun Yang won the first place in the group with a time of 14 minutes, 43 seconds and 25 seconds. The defending champion, Tunisia's Mailouli, finished second in the group with a time of 14 minutes, 46 seconds and 23 seconds. In another group, Canadian star Cochrane topped the group with 14 minutes, 49 seconds and 31 seconds, followed by Park Tae-hwan with 14 minutes, 56 seconds and 89 seconds. Another Chinese player, Dai Jun, swam in 15 minutes, 13 seconds and 90 seconds, ranking sixth in the group. In the overall ranking of the preliminaries, Sun Yang ranked first, Mailuli second, Cochrane third, Italy's Partilini and Britain's Fogle fourth and fifth, Park Tae-hwan ranked sixth, and Dai Jun was eliminated.

c9d1b547a0bf14a5ea59d7f135e4d1c0a7759f51.sourceText: 决赛孙杨在第四道，迈卢利第五道，科克伦第三道，朴泰桓第七道。各就位后发令枪没有响，孙杨跃入水中，重新出发后孙杨顺利入水，到50米时朴泰桓处在第一，孙杨紧随其后，科克伦排在第三，游至100米孙杨就超到第一，朴泰桓紧随其后，自此孙杨就开始领游，200米领先朴泰桓0.69秒。
c9d1b547a0bf14a5ea59d7f135e4d1c0a7759f51.translatedText: In the final, Sun Yang was in lane 4, Mailuli was in lane 5, Cochran was in lane 3, and Park Tae-hwan was in lane 7. After everyone was in position, the starting gun did not go off. Sun Yang jumped into the water. After restarting, Sun Yang entered the water smoothly. At 50 meters, Park Tae-hwan was in the first place, Sun Yang followed closely, and Cochrane was third. When he swam to 100 meters, Sun Yang passed the first place, followed by Park Tae-hwan. From then on, Sun Yang began to lead the swim, leading Park Tae-hwan by 0.69 seconds in 200 meters.

8cac88f1a5df2f7e10d6cf89a01f1e5f79289020.sourceText: 孙杨按照自己的节奏，逐渐扩大优势，将自己世界纪录的黄线压在身后，到300米时领先朴泰桓1.04秒，科克伦依旧处在第三。400米时孙杨依旧领先朴泰桓0.77秒，游的很平稳，前三名的位置没有给发生变化，至500米孙杨又将优势扩大到1秒以上。
8cac88f1a5df2f7e10d6cf89a01f1e5f79289020.translatedText: Sun Yang gradually expanded his advantage according to his own rhythm, pressing the yellow line of his world record behind him. By the 300 meters, he was 1.04 seconds ahead of Park Tae-hwan, while Cochrane was still in third place. At 400 meters, Sun Yang still led Park Tae-hwan by 0.77 seconds. He swam very smoothly and the positions of the top three did not change. At 500 meters, Sun Yang expanded his advantage to more than 1 second.

2f6124ab90fa40881c90647527f05ca32c2d3e90.sourceText: 随着比赛的深入，孙杨的优势愈发明显，到600米处领先朴泰桓已经到2秒以上，抛离将近一个半身位，700米时领先朴泰桓3.55秒。750米半程，科克伦升至第二，不过孙杨已经遥遥领先。
2f6124ab90fa40881c90647527f05ca32c2d3e90.translatedText: As the game progressed, Sun Yang's advantage became more and more obvious. At 600 meters, he was leading Park Tae-hwan by more than 2 seconds, nearly a half-length away, and at 700 meters, he was 3.55 seconds ahead of Park Tae-hwan. At the half-way mark of 750 meters, Cochrane rose to second place, but Sun Yang was already far ahead.

be7dbcf4f975635c9e5bf265a4335b8a477bde3f.sourceText: 游至900米时，孙杨领先科克伦4.22秒，领先优势已经不可动摇。进入后半程，孙杨更加不可阻挡，朴泰桓已经跌至第四，迈卢利升至第三。孙杨一个人游在最前面，将所有对手都远远抛离，一直将世界纪录黄线压在身后。对孙杨而言，夺冠早已不是问题，唯一的悬念是能否打破自己的世界纪录。
be7dbcf4f975635c9e5bf265a4335b8a477bde3f.translatedText: When swimming to 900 meters, Sun Yang was 4.22 seconds ahead of Cochrane, and the lead was unshakable. Entering the second half, Sun Yang became even more unstoppable, Park Taihwan had fallen to fourth, and Mailuli rose to third. Sun Yang swam alone at the front, leaving all his opponents far away, keeping the world record yellow line behind him. For Sun Yang, winning the championship is no longer a problem. The only suspense is whether he can break his own world record.

f48c07a491c87d303a0c1a3fbf74d0b0f0309350.sourceText: 进入最后100米，孙杨开始提速，世界纪录线已经追不上他的速度。孙杨拼命游进，全力冲刺，节奏保持的依然很好。打破世界纪录并夺冠，孙杨最终的成绩为14分31秒02，夺取本届奥运会个人第二金。科克伦和迈卢利，分别以14分39秒63和14分40秒31获得亚军和季军，朴泰桓只以14分50秒61排在第四。
f48c07a491c87d303a0c1a3fbf74d0b0f0309350.translatedText: Entering the last 100 meters, Sun Yang began to increase his speed, and the world record line could no longer catch up with his speed. Sun Yang swam in desperately and sprinted with all his strength, still maintaining a good rhythm. Breaking the world record and winning the championship, Sun Yang's final time was 14 minutes, 31 seconds and 02 seconds, winning his second individual gold medal in this Olympic Games. Cochrane and Mailuli won the runner-up and third place respectively in 14 minutes, 39 seconds and 14 minutes, 40 seconds and 31 seconds respectively. Park Tae-hwan only ranked fourth in 14 minutes, 50 seconds and 61 seconds.

2af26c3313972cf1f27920c17dfa8e3f04c82a37.sourceText: 2012年6月30日晚6时，大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会（侨联）在凤城酒家举办近五十人的小型餐会。让参加2012年凤凰城华裔小姐的八位候选佳丽与5位评审面对面。侨联主席张华芳隆重介绍了当晚出席活动的嘉宾。他们是前侨联主席邓朝驹，侨联现任委员，八位候选佳丽，一直参与组织活动的志愿者，以及赞助商。
2af26c3313972cf1f27920c17dfa8e3f04c82a37.translatedText: At 6:00 pm on June 30, 2012, the Greater Phoenix Chinese Overseas Chinese Association (Overseas Chinese Federation) held a small dinner party for nearly fifty people at Fengcheng Restaurant. Let the eight candidates for Miss Chinese Phoenix 2012 face to face with the five judges. Zhang Huafang, Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, solemnly introduced the guests attending the event that night. They are former Overseas Chinese Federation Chairman Deng Chaoju, current members of the Overseas Chinese Federation, eight beauties, volunteers who have been involved in organizing activities, and sponsors.

8a6c08856f8af0af489f80b7c4714b7b7d91b108.sourceText: 当晚，八位佳丽首次与评审见面，每个人有十分钟单独回答评审提出的问题。虽然候选佳丽都经过了一段时间的培训，但是真正与评审见面时，大部分佳丽还是略显紧张。评审会根据当晚的问题，对佳丽们有一定的了解。摄影师们则根据佳丽们的表现，投票选出”最佳上镜奖小姐”。善于处理人际关系的”亲善小姐”也会于当晚选出。７月１日晚所有佳丽们将进行最后的彩排。
8a6c08856f8af0af489f80b7c4714b7b7d91b108.translatedText: That night, the eight beauties met the judges for the first time, and each one had ten minutes to answer questions raised by the judges alone. Although the contestants have gone through a period of training, most of the contestants were still slightly nervous when they actually met with the judges. The judges will have a certain understanding of the beauties based on the questions asked that night. The photographers voted for the "Miss Photogenic Award" based on the performance of the beauties. "Miss Friendly" who is good at handling interpersonal relationships will also be selected that night. On the evening of July 1, all beauties will have their final rehearsal.

78fa70c5fed924e3a37d0dbabee2cf725ed7ddbb.sourceText: 19岁美国男子携48磅大麻毒品试图越境进入墨西哥被击毙 州司法部门女发言人28日称，上星期一名试图越境进入墨西哥境内的男子被美国边防巡逻队哨兵开枪射杀。 科奇斯县司法部女发言人卡帕斯说，21日，边防军打死了19岁的美国男子马德里德(Carlos La Madrid)，当时他驾驶一辆装运48磅大麻的卡车来到边界线，然后试图用一个梯子翻过围栏进入墨西哥。 据称美国边防军先用石块砸中了这名男子，然后将其开枪击毙。
78fa70c5fed924e3a37d0dbabee2cf725ed7ddbb.translatedText: A state justice department spokeswoman said on the 28th that a man who tried to cross the border into Mexico last week was shot and killed by a U.S. Border Patrol sentry. Cochise County Justice Department spokeswoman Capas said that on the 21st, border guards killed 19-year-old American man Carlos La Madrid when he drove a truck carrying 48 pounds of marijuana to the border line and then tried to use a ladder to climb over the fence into Mexico. U.S. border guards allegedly hit the man with rocks and then shot him to death.

e44378378ddd54704576118dc45a21af4b662992.sourceText: 1。 我哥哥的政治庇护6个月前在纽约批准﹐但他的律师最近被抓﹐请问会影响他的案子吗﹖ 他还没申请绿卡﹖ 答﹕对于最近26个被告(其中有6个律师)被抓﹐造成很多人的案子受影响﹐主要是﹐这些案子中很多都是造假的故事及文件﹐你哥哥的申请虽然已批准﹐但 有可能会被检方重新开案﹐也可能被翻案﹐但一般检方也必须有证据﹐ 目前他也不需做什么﹐只能被通知出庭时﹐提出真实的证明及证词再说。
e44378378ddd54704576118dc45a21af4b662992.translatedText: 1. My brother's political asylum was approved in New York 6 months ago, but his lawyer was recently arrested. Will this affect his case? He hasn’t applied for a green card yet? Answer: The recent arrest of 26 defendants (including 6 lawyers) has affected many people's cases. The main reason is that many of these cases are based on false stories and documents. Although your brother's application has been approved, the prosecutor may reopen the case or the case may be overturned. However, generally the prosecutor must also have evidence. At present, he does not need to do anything. He can only be notified to present true proof and testimony when he appears in court.

49d7406dcfc06545792fb02b68e3739f8d416c75.sourceText: 2。 请问2013年是否我们的税就会全面增加﹐请问内容为何﹖ 答﹕ 为避免坠入「悬崖」，欧巴马要给高收入2%的富裕家庭大幅增税，具体提案包括：一、个人收入税率从现有的33%-35%提高为36%-39.6%，如果 再加上2013年起开始实行的医疗投资附加税3.8%，则最高税率为42.4%；二、长期资本利得税率从现有的15%增加到23.8%，普通红利税率也将循个人税率从最高35 %上升为42.4%，而合格红利(Qualified Dividends)税率将从现有的15%同样升为42.4%；三、遗产赠与税将从2012年的512万元豁免额剧降为2013年的100万元 豁免额，而超出豁免额的税率将从2012年的35%上升为2013年的55%。 共和党人现在感兴趣的，仅仅是限制逐项扣减，取消抵减等减少开支而不触动增加开支项目，而逐项扣减及抵减的取消必然会伤害低收入和中产阶级。 欧巴马续任四年能否扭转乾坤，先看他与众院共和党在财政悬崖边缘的这场谈判交易，能否让明年1月开始的5000亿元减支增税措施而避免重陷 衰退﹐请大家拭目以待
49d7406dcfc06545792fb02b68e3739f8d416c75.translatedText: 2. May I ask whether our taxes will increase across the board in 2013? What is the content? Answer: To avoid falling off the "cliff", Obama wants to significantly increase taxes on the top 2% of wealthy households. Specific proposals include: 1. Increase the personal income tax rate from the existing 33%-35% to 36%-39.6%. If Coupled with the 3.8% medical investment surtax that has been implemented since 2013, the highest tax rate is 42.4%; 2. The long-term capital gains tax rate will increase from the existing 15% to 23.8%, and the ordinary dividend tax rate will also increase from the highest personal tax rate of 35% to 42.4%, while qualified dividends (Qualified dividends) Dividends) tax rate will also rise from the existing 15% to 42.4%; 3. The inheritance gift tax will drop sharply from the exemption amount of 5.12 million yuan in 2012 to the exemption amount of 1 million yuan in 2013, and the tax rate exceeding the exemption amount will increase from 35% in 2012 to 55% in 2013. What Republicans are now interested in is simply limiting itemized deductions and eliminating deductions to reduce spending without touching increases in spending items. The elimination of itemized deductions and deductions will inevitably hurt low-income and middle-class people. Whether Obama can turn things around for another four years depends on whether the negotiations between him and the House Republicans on the edge of the fiscal cliff can prevent the 500 billion yuan in spending cuts and tax increases starting in January next year from falling back into recession. Please wait and see.

40dc5a57f8c696d6fa190fff5f848439702ed104.sourceText: 美国贫困率达到自1965年以来最高水平
40dc5a57f8c696d6fa190fff5f848439702ed104.translatedText: The poverty rate in the United States has reached its highest level since 1965

f0fd8fa0db9ea8014a9a8be4d84e6eced9c215e9.sourceText: 美国贫困率达到自1965年以来最高水平 经济学家、学者和智库人士都预计，人口普查局在今年11月发布2011…
f0fd8fa0db9ea8014a9a8be4d84e6eced9c215e9.translatedText: The poverty rate in the United States has reached its highest level since 1965. Economists, scholars and think tankers all expect that the Census Bureau will release the 2011...

4f03c42c5b864c459929671358aeae82b90fb606.sourceText: 美国贫困率达到自1965年以来最高水平 经济学家、学者和智库人士都预计，人口普查局在今年11月发布2011年的美国官方贫困率时，此率将上升到自1965年以来的最高水平。 自由派、无党派和保守派专家们都认为贫困率以2010年的15.1％为起点，最高可上升到15.7％。如果贫困率只增加到15.2％，那就和1983年的贫困率一样，也是自1965年以来最高的贫困率。有史以来最高的贫困率纪录22.4%是在1959年创下的。 2010年的贫困水平对一个四口之家是22,314美元，对个人是11,139美元。这只包括税前的现金收入。它不包括资本收益或积累的财富，如自置居所及非现金援助，如食品券和税收抵免。根据奥巴马总统的经济刺激计划，税收抵免已大幅扩大。 今年一月，印第安纳大学的研究预测，美国的贫困人口数量将继续上升，部分原因是旧的工作正在被更换成新的较低工资的工作，而且各州正在削减他们的福利预算。
4f03c42c5b864c459929671358aeae82b90fb606.translatedText: The poverty rate in the United States has reached its highest level since 1965 in November this year Economists, academics and think tankers expect the official U.S. poverty rate for 2011 to rise to its highest level since 1965 when the Census Bureau releases it in November. Liberal, independent, and conservative experts all agree that the poverty rate will start at 15.1 percent in 2010 and rise to as high as 15.7 percent. If the poverty rate only increased to 15.2%, it would be the same as the poverty rate in 1983 and the highest poverty rate since 1965. The highest poverty rate ever recorded was 22.4%, set in 1959. The poverty level in 2010 was $22,314 for a family of four and $11,139 for an individual. This only includes cash receipts before taxes. It does not include capital gains or accumulated wealth, such as home ownership, and non-cash assistance, such as food stamps and tax credits. Tax credits have been significantly expanded under President Obama's economic stimulus plan. In January, research from Indiana University predicted that poverty in the United States would continue to rise, in part because old jobs are being replaced by new, lower-wage ones and because states are cutting their welfare budgets.

9216a872748c2b8ffbdfe815a6b7fd79550fe2a1.sourceText: 云南彝良地震80人遇难经济损失35亿元（图）
9216a872748c2b8ffbdfe815a6b7fd79550fe2a1.translatedText: The earthquake in Yiliang, Yunnan killed 80 people and caused an economic loss of 3.5 billion yuan (picture)

8452664f98263495fcd9be66ce3c4515cc5852cb.sourceText: 云南彝良地震80人遇难经济损失35亿元（图） 截至美东时间9月7日下午2点10分，地震造成…
8452664f98263495fcd9be66ce3c4515cc5852cb.translatedText: The earthquake in Yiliang, Yunnan killed 80 people and caused an economic loss of 3.5 billion yuan (picture) As of 2:10 pm ET on September 7, the earthquake caused...

23808a9d79de46b758f2fe25a7342484a057a4e6.sourceText: 截至美东时间9月7日下午2点10分，地震造成彝良县、昭阳区和大关县3县24个乡镇，74.4万人受灾，80人死亡（彝良县79人，昭通阳区1人），731人受 伤；房屋倒塌1900户6650间，严重损坏3.7万户12.2万间，一般损坏13.3万户30.8万间，需紧急转移安置人口20.1万人，直接经济损失35亿元。灾情仍在进一步统计中。
23808a9d79de46b758f2fe25a7342484a057a4e6.translatedText: As of 2:10 pm ET on September 7, the earthquake affected 24 towns and villages in 3 counties: Yiliang County, Zhaoyang District and Daguan County, 744,000 people were affected, and 80 people died (79 people in Yiliang County, 1 person in Zhaotongyang District), and 731 people were affected. Injury; 1,900 households with 6,650 houses collapsed, 37,000 households with 122,000 houses were seriously damaged, 133,000 households with 308,000 houses were moderately damaged, 201,000 people needed emergency relocation, and direct economic losses were 3.5 billion yuan. The extent of the disaster is still being estimated.

f4c5dd8948e4b38519f611cb35d2e3eee900a54d.sourceText: 7日11时19分，云南彝良县发生5.7级地震，震源深度14公里。12时16分又发生5.6级地震，震源深度10公里。据云南省地震局局长皇甫岗介绍，此次地震类型初步认定为震群型，截至7日18时，已经发生60多次余震。
f4c5dd8948e4b38519f611cb35d2e3eee900a54d.translatedText: At 11:19 on the 7th, a magnitude 5.7 earthquake occurred in Yiliang County, Yunnan, with a focal depth of 14 kilometers. Another earthquake with a magnitude of 5.6 occurred at 12:16, with a focal depth of 10 kilometers. According to Huangfugang, director of the Yunnan Provincial Seismological Bureau, the earthquake type was initially identified as a swarm type. As of 18:00 on the 7th, more than 60 aftershocks had occurred.

a5af16fe46383efc9d6bae112771d11c60a575e5.sourceText: 余震不断 天多阴雨 救援难度大
a5af16fe46383efc9d6bae112771d11c60a575e5.translatedText: Continuous aftershocks make rescue difficult due to rainy weather

40e0f8df9e7c8285334647caac3a5d4313083b39.sourceText: 据中国地震台网测定，9月7日11时19分，云南省昭通市彝良县与贵州省毕节地区威宁彝族回族苗族自治县交界发生5.7级地震，震源深度14公里。12时16分，昭通市彝良县又发生5.6级地震，震源深度10公里。随后又发生多次余震。
40e0f8df9e7c8285334647caac3a5d4313083b39.translatedText: According to the China Seismological Network, at 11:19 on September 7, a magnitude 5.7 earthquake occurred at the junction of Yiliang County, Zhaotong City, Yunnan Province and Weining Yi, Hui and Miao Autonomous County, Bijie District, Guizhou Province, with a focal depth of 14 kilometers. At 12:16, another earthquake with a magnitude of 5.6 occurred in Yiliang County, Zhaotong City, with a focal depth of 10 kilometers. Many aftershocks followed.

2da5932da73c647f35051f1019318b2c248e4556.sourceText: 当前，地震已经造成受灾人口达45万人以上，房屋倒塌3961间、严重损坏13876间，畜圈倒塌3455间、受损11633间，牲畜死亡4384头(匹、只)。当前彝良全县救灾抢险、灾情核查等工作正在紧张有序开展。
2da5932da73c647f35051f1019318b2c248e4556.translatedText: Currently, the earthquake has affected more than 450,000 people, 3,961 houses have collapsed, 13,876 have been seriously damaged, 3,455 livestock pens have collapsed, 11,633 have been damaged, and 4,384 livestock have died. Currently, disaster relief and disaster verification work in Yiliang County is being carried out in an intense and orderly manner.

59d0118f968c412844407c553d036a2876078146.sourceText: 中央气象台预计，未来三天震区多阴雨天气，对救援工作不利，需做好震区群众和救援人员的防雨工作；同时震区为地质灾害脆弱区，降雨将使山区滑坡、泥石流灾害发生的可能性增大，需加强防范。
59d0118f968c412844407c553d036a2876078146.translatedText: The Central Meteorological Observatory predicts that there will be rainy weather in the earthquake area in the next three days, which will be unfavorable to the rescue work. People in the earthquake area and rescue workers need to do a good job in rain protection. At the same time, the earthquake area is a geological hazard-vulnerable area, and rainfall will increase the possibility of landslides and debris flow disasters in mountainous areas, so prevention needs to be strengthened.

ab4d0371188e03ce80ea68805b14aef00931be2e.sourceText: 中国地震台网中心地震预报部主任刘杰在接受中新网采访时称，此次地震属于震群型地震，未来几天余震将继续发生，应特别注意滑坡滚石等次生灾害。
ab4d0371188e03ce80ea68805b14aef00931be2e.translatedText: Liu Jie, director of the Earthquake Forecasting Department of the China Seismological Network Center, said in an interview with China News Service that this earthquake is a swarm type earthquake and aftershocks will continue to occur in the next few days. Special attention should be paid to secondary disasters such as landslides and rolling rocks.

d5be3641c41b79569561f7a060a2d6b09481e2b0.translatedText: >Wen Jiabao rushed to the disaster area

302f87acfe582cf3400f7279d40f0577190458a9.sourceText: 地震发生后，正在俄罗斯出席APEC峰会的中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席胡锦涛立即作出重要指示，要求有关方面迅速组织力量投入抗震救灾，确保灾区人民生命财产安全。中共中央政治局常委、国务院总理温家宝已赶赴灾区。中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理回良玉也做出批示。
302f87acfe582cf3400f7279d40f0577190458a9.translatedText: After the earthquake, Hu Jintao, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the State, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, who was attending the APEC Summit in Russia, immediately issued important instructions, requiring relevant parties to quickly organize forces to invest in earthquake relief and ensure the safety of people's lives and property in the disaster area. Wen Jiabao, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, has rushed to the disaster area. Hui Liangyu, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, also gave instructions.

3bc1ee7da1f07ca1cd455e242ce1cabbeab45095.sourceText: 中国地震局已启动地震应急Ⅲ级应急响应。国家减灾委、民政部也于16时将14时启动的国家四级救灾应急响应提升至三级。
3bc1ee7da1f07ca1cd455e242ce1cabbeab45095.translatedText: >The China Earthquake Administration has launched an earthquake emergency level III emergency response. The National Disaster Reduction Commission and the Ministry of Civil Affairs also upgraded the national level four disaster relief emergency response launched at 14:00 to level three at 16:00.

864035c506d3499a4d998d445e0a920fac7d464d.sourceText: 民政部副部长姜力率领由国家发改委、教育部、民政部、财政部、国土资源部、住房城乡建设部、交通运输部、卫生部、地震局等部门组成的国家减灾委工作组，赶赴灾区，查看灾情，慰问受灾群众，协助开展救灾工作。
864035c506d3499a4d998d445e0a920fac7d464d.translatedText: > Vice Minister of the Ministry of Civil Affairs Jiang Li led a working group of the National Disaster Reduction Commission composed of the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Land and Resources, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Transport, the Ministry of Health, the Earthquake Administration and other departments to rush to the disaster area to inspect the disaster situation, express condolences to the victims, and assist in disaster relief work.

3755337a3995c56f2c869c86b32c5d481d28e556.sourceText: 云南省多部门联动调动人力物资驰援灾区
3755337a3995c56f2c869c86b32c5d481d28e556.translatedText: >Multiple departments in Yunnan Province jointly mobilized manpower and materials to assist the disaster area

6bbe0b909ca4dffbd51aadfd3df96abda8738ea4.sourceText: 地震发生后，云南省地震局迅速启动地震应急预案二级响应。在震后一小时以内，派出以副局长陈勤带队的由30人组成的地震现场工作队分两批赶往灾区指导抗震救灾，进行现场地震监测预报。
6bbe0b909ca4dffbd51aadfd3df96abda8738ea4.translatedText: After the earthquake, the Yunnan Provincial Seismological Bureau quickly launched the second level response of the earthquake emergency plan. Within one hour after the earthquake, a 30-person earthquake on-site team led by Deputy Director Chen Qin was dispatched to the disaster area in two batches to guide earthquake relief and conduct on-site earthquake monitoring and forecasting.

3b8af4cc0fe89a148b0d6dcbc1d15d6be2d5bfe9.sourceText: 同时，解放军和武警救援队分别派出30人和20人组成的两个救援分队赶往灾区进行救援。云南昭通彝良县消防大队立即出动3车17人赶往现场救援。与此同时，武警云南总队紧急出动220余名官兵赶赴彝良地震灾区进行抢险救灾。
3b8af4cc0fe89a148b0d6dcbc1d15d6be2d5bfe9.translatedText: At the same time, the People's Liberation Army and the Armed Police Rescue Team sent two rescue teams of 30 and 20 people respectively to the disaster area for rescue. The fire brigade of Yiliang County, Zhaotong, Yunnan Province immediately dispatched 3 vehicles and 17 people to the scene for rescue. At the same time, the Yunnan Armed Police Corps dispatched more than 220 officers and soldiers to the Yiliang earthquake-stricken area for emergency rescue and disaster relief.

68e48067f6c1fd2a62a145ed1e80ef0ad050f3e6.sourceText: 灾情发生后，云南省委、省政府高度重视，为帮助灾区做好抗灾救灾工作，妥善安排好灾民生活，省财政厅下拔救灾补助资金1000万元，其中：应急补助经费800万元，统筹用于灾区应急抢险、灾民生活安置和遇难人员家属抚慰等；工作经费200万元，用于抗震救灾工作补助。
68e48067f6c1fd2a62a145ed1e80ef0ad050f3e6.translatedText: After the disaster, the Yunnan Provincial Party Committee and the Provincial Government attached great importance to it. In order to help the disaster area do disaster relief work and properly arrange the lives of the victims, the Provincial Department of Finance allocated 10 million yuan in disaster relief subsidies, including: 8 million yuan in emergency subsidy funds, which were used for emergency rescue in the disaster area, resettlement of victims, and comfort for the families of the victims; 2 million yuan in working funds were used for earthquake relief subsidies.

70db71c2034dce02e1b7a0aafbc385a6d690f0f9.sourceText: 截至23时30分，各级民政部门共发放矿泉水120件、优酸乳85件、饼子12件、食品(包括饼干、蛋黄派等)509斤、应急电筒62把、大米80袋(每袋50斤)、菜籽油80桶。
70db71c2034dce02e1b7a0aafbc385a6d690f0f9.translatedText: As of 23:30, civil affairs departments at all levels had distributed a total of 120 pieces of mineral water, 85 pieces of high-quality yogurt, 12 pieces of pancakes, 509 kilograms of food (including biscuits, egg yolk pies, etc.), 62 emergency flashlights, 80 bags of rice (50 kilograms each), and 80 barrels of rapeseed oil.

1b4b1da62f6823b01792126d4c08ea6b7097d412.sourceText: 此外，云南省卫生厅也已启动应急预案，派出以卫生厅副厅长徐和平为组长，昆医附医院、省中医院附属医院相关专家组成的工作组正赶赴灾区。
1b4b1da62f6823b01792126d4c08ea6b7097d412.translatedText: In addition, the Yunnan Provincial Department of Health has also launched an emergency plan and dispatched a working group headed by Xu Heping, deputy director of the Department of Health, and composed of relevant experts from Kunming Medical University Affiliated Hospital and the Provincial Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine Affiliated Hospital to the disaster area.

5534a8fe48f2f5827aa576133a92209443291a94.sourceText: 当前，云南省民政厅、省减灾委办公室已将救灾应急响应提升至1级，省委书记秦光荣、省长李纪恒率队赶赴彝良地震灾区。
5534a8fe48f2f5827aa576133a92209443291a94.translatedText: Currently, the Yunnan Provincial Department of Civil Affairs and the Provincial Disaster Reduction Committee Office have upgraded the disaster relief emergency response to level 1. Provincial Party Committee Secretary Qin Guangrong and Governor Li Jiheng led a team to the Yiliang earthquake-stricken area.

e367d917381c58dd2622252b8726fae1258cfe76.sourceText: 此外，地震发生后，成都军区迅速组织1100余名部队官兵和民兵预备役人员投入抗震救灾。
e367d917381c58dd2622252b8726fae1258cfe76.translatedText: In addition, after the earthquake, the Chengdu Military Region quickly organized more than 1,100 army officers, soldiers and militia reservists to participate in earthquake relief.

7e3a7719ed3de0c7189b0ef78d77e9feeeade69e.sourceText: 当地时间9月7日12时16分，在云南省昭通市彝良县（北纬27.6,东经104.0）发生5.6级地震，震源深度10公里。这是该地一所学校的宿舍区，2楼有2人，直接从楼上跳下去了。
7e3a7719ed3de0c7189b0ef78d77e9feeeade69e.translatedText: At 12:16 local time on September 7, a magnitude 5.6 earthquake occurred in Yiliang County, Zhaotong City, Yunnan Province (27.6 north latitude, 104.0 east longitude), with a focal depth of 10 kilometers. This is the dormitory area of ​​a school there. There were two people on the second floor and they jumped directly from the upstairs.

91b2a96feb9ceb11fccbb6e95c3a77442d078d6d.sourceText: 本次彝良5.7、5.6级已构成双震活动
91b2a96feb9ceb11fccbb6e95c3a77442d078d6d.translatedText: >The magnitude 5.7 and 5.6 events in Yiliang have constituted a double earthquake event

d39f613d2c6e662d960febc1c8949a2f0d4ab93e.sourceText: 中国地震信息网消息，本次彝良5.7、5.6级已构成双震活动，该区域附近历史上5级地震活跃。
d39f613d2c6e662d960febc1c8949a2f0d4ab93e.translatedText: China Seismological Information Network reported that the magnitude 5.7 and 5.6 events in Yiliang have constituted a twin earthquake event. Historically, magnitude 5 earthquakes have been active near this area.

e730abf8fd81836b61451482fe512a2e84b1514b.sourceText: 据中国地震台网测定，9月7日11时19分，云南省昭通市彝良县、贵州省毕节地区威宁彝族回族苗族自治县(北纬27.5度，东经104.0度)交界发生5.7级地震，震源深度14公里。12时16分，昭通市彝良县又发生5.6级地震，震源深度10公里。彝良-威宁5.7、5.6级地震震中距离彝良县城约15公里、距离大关30公里，距离昭通市33公里、距离鲁甸56公里，距昆明市约300公里。
e730abf8fd81836b61451482fe512a2e84b1514b.translatedText: According to the China Seismological Network, at 11:19 on September 7, a magnitude 5.7 earthquake occurred at the junction of Yiliang County, Zhaotong City, Yunnan Province, and Weining Yi, Hui and Miao Autonomous County (27.5 degrees north latitude, 104.0 degrees east longitude) in Bijie District, Guizhou Province, with a focal depth of 14 kilometers. At 12:16, another earthquake with a magnitude of 5.6 occurred in Yiliang County, Zhaotong City, with a focal depth of 10 kilometers. The epicenter of the Yiliang-Weining earthquake with magnitudes 5.7 and 5.6 is about 15 kilometers away from Yiliang County, 30 kilometers away from Daguan, 33 kilometers away from Zhaotong City, 56 kilometers away from Ludian, and about 300 kilometers away from Kunming City.

81ebd88b839f133159f8ac033e8f52c7abe0f7a7.sourceText: 本次地震发生在川滇菱形块体东侧，发育NE向活动断裂，本次地震发震构造为西鱼河断裂及昭通断裂附近，震源机制是为走滑型。截止到2012年09月07日13时，震区共发生3级以上地震10次，其中3.0-3.9级地震6次，4.0-4.9级地震2次，5.0-5.9级地震2次。本次彝良5.7、5.6级已构成双震活动。
81ebd88b839f133159f8ac033e8f52c7abe0f7a7.translatedText: This earthquake occurred on the east side of the Sichuan-Yunnan rhombus block, with NE-trending active faults. The seismogenic structures of this earthquake were near the Xiyuhe Fault and Zhaotong Fault, and the focal mechanism was strike-slip. As of 13:00 on September 7, 2012, a total of 10 earthquakes of magnitude 3 or above had occurred in the earthquake area, including 6 earthquakes of magnitude 3.0-3.9, 2 earthquakes of magnitude 4.0-4.9, and 2 earthquakes of magnitude 5.0-5.9. The magnitude 5.7 and 5.6 events in Yiliang this time have constituted a double earthquake event.

6bb0e131e184fb5a94b337025b6411ba25222dbd.sourceText: 该区域附近历史上5级地震活跃，1900年以来震区50公里范围发生5级以上地震8次，最大地震为1948年10月09日贵州和1948年10月10日大关2次5.8级地震，距离本次地震分别为11公里和23公里。震区附近100公里范围内1948年以来共发生5级以上地震28次，最大为1974年大关7.1级地震，与此次地震相距78公里。
6bb0e131e184fb5a94b337025b6411ba25222dbd.translatedText: The area has historically been active in magnitude 5 earthquakes. Since 1900, 8 earthquakes of magnitude 5 or above have occurred within 50 kilometers of the earthquake zone. The largest earthquakes were two magnitude 5.8 earthquakes in Guizhou on October 9, 1948 and Daguan on October 10, 1948. They were 11 kilometers and 23 kilometers away from this earthquake respectively. A total of 28 earthquakes of magnitude 5 or above have occurred within 100 kilometers of the earthquake area since 1948. The largest earthquake was the 7.1 magnitude earthquake in 1974, which was 78 kilometers away from this earthquake.

9a0af007b1889243373171f2a9cad51875c62374.sourceText: 从震区附近历史地震类型来看，地震类型较为复杂，主震余震型和双震型均有。1900年震中50公里范围发生8组11次5级以上地震，主震余震型5组，占63%。但2000年以来大多数5级以上地震均为双震型或震群型活动，如2003年11月15日、26日在其南部鲁甸发生5.6级震群，2006年7月22日、8月25日在其北部盐津发生5.1级震群。
9a0af007b1889243373171f2a9cad51875c62374.translatedText: Judging from the historical earthquake types near the earthquake area, the earthquake types are relatively complex, including main shock, aftershock types and double earthquake types. In 1900, 8 groups of 11 earthquakes of magnitude 5 or above occurred within 50 kilometers of the epicenter, including 5 groups of mainshock and aftershock types, accounting for 63%. However, since 2000, most earthquakes with magnitudes above 5 have been double-shock or swarm-type activities. For example, a 5.6-magnitude earthquake swarm occurred in Ludian in the south on November 15 and 26, 2003, and a 5.1-magnitude earthquake swarm occurred in Yanjin in the north on July 22 and August 25, 2006.

af05ce8aafdd9b28d974ef6fdde796a4face7950.sourceText: 由大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会举办的迎国庆青少年作文绘画比赛，通过评审委员陈普，唐孝先，秋香，谭薇薇，林萱，杨惠琼等认真公正的讨论和比较，圆满地完成了评选工作。对所有获奖的青少年，将在今年七月四日举行的国庆选美晚会上颁奖。获奖的绘画作品将在国庆晚会上展出，在征得作者和家长同意后将选送相关报纸和刊物刊登。这次参赛作品用中华文化反映出华人青少年对庆祝美国国庆的欢乐心情和对美好生活的向往，也反映出他们在创作过程中的认真和求实的态度。这一切也是和家长和指导老师们的努力分不开的。
af05ce8aafdd9b28d974ef6fdde796a4face7950.translatedText: The composition and painting competition for Youth to Welcome the National Day, organized by the Federation of Chinese Overseas Chinese League in Greater Phoenix City, successfully completed the selection work through careful and fair discussion and comparison by the judges Chen Pu, Tang Xiaoxian, Qiu Xiang, Tan Weiwei, Lin Xuan, Yang Huiqiong, etc. All winners will be awarded at the National Day Pageant held on July 4 this year. The winning paintings will be exhibited at the National Day Gala, and will be selected and published in relevant newspapers and publications with the consent of the author and parents. The entries this time use Chinese culture to reflect the joyful mood of Chinese teenagers celebrating the National Day and their yearning for a better life. It also reflects their serious and realistic attitude in the creative process. All of this is inseparable from the efforts of parents and instructors.

5c11ecfe318eca41008a327e3efc954192a9a94f.sourceText: 5700万资金援助亚省业主 出现房屋破产潮可能再次降低 随着亚利桑那州房屋价格持续上扬，亚利桑那州总检察长汤姆霍恩在周一的记者招待会上发布了新的好消息。亚利桑那 州获得了5700万的资金，直接帮助陷入困境的业主，用实际行动缓解房屋压力，减少了再次出现大量破产屋的可能性。 全国有25亿美元来自美国四大银行的资金被用于援助房地产泡沫破灭的危机。亚省获得了9770万美元。亚省试图会把5700万美元用于对面临破产危机的业主，另一半放到州政府的预算中。但亚省房屋联盟，公共事务中心以及司法研究所正在试图推翻玛丽库帕最高法院的这一决定。 霍恩表示这些钱将会从明年初开始，对困难的业主进行援助。方法有以下几种： 4100万直接给业主，帮助那些退伍军人，老人，失业者，或者有严重医疗负担的业主。这会通过多种渠道来减少他们的按揭。 消费者协会还会将这些钱用于贷款公司服务投诉里，帮助业主获得公平的贷款裁决。对于与贷款公司有不公平借贷关系的业主，也将受到援助。更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的Tinna (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
5c11ecfe318eca41008a327e3efc954192a9a94f.translatedText: 57 million funds to assist Alberta homeowners, the wave of housing bankruptcies may decrease again. As Arizona home prices continue to rise, Arizona Attorney General Tom Horn delivered new good news during a press conference on Monday. Arizona received $57 million in funding to directly help distressed homeowners, taking practical actions to alleviate housing pressure and reduce the possibility of a large number of bankruptcies again. Nationwide, $2.5 billion in funds from the four largest U.S. banks was used to aid the crisis when the real estate bubble burst. Alberta received $97.7 million. The province is trying to allocate $57 million to help homeowners facing bankruptcy and put the other half into the state budget. But the Alberta Housing Alliance, the Center for Public Affairs and the Institute for Justice are seeking to overturn the Mariecoopa Supreme Court decision. Horn said the money will be available to assist struggling property owners starting early next year. There are several methods: 41 million will be given directly to owners to help those veterans, the elderly, the unemployed, or those with serious medical burdens. This will reduce their mortgage payments through a variety of channels. The consumer association will also use the money to file complaints about loan company service and help homeowners obtain fair loan decisions. Assistance will also be provided to property owners who have unfair lending relationships with loan companies. For more information about real estate, please contact Tinna of Goldtrust Realty (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
