983144d7c7c3b4f185f60693abd427c8e8c475db.sourceText: 2013年美国最好和最差的工作 美国求职招聘网站CareerCast结合收入、工作环境、工作压力、生理需求…
983144d7c7c3b4f185f60693abd427c8e8c475db.translatedText: The best and worst jobs in the United States in 2013 The American job recruitment website CareerCast combines income, working environment, work pressure, physical needs...

33c274b4ffa975329a454f9188ec98fad5482153.sourceText: 对罗西(Pete Rossi)来说，这一年里有多少周工作超过50小时用一只手就能数得过来。而余下时间里，美国国防部精算师这个工作让他能以极小的压力过着高品质的生活。
33c274b4ffa975329a454f9188ec98fad5482153.translatedText: For Pete Rossi, he can count on one hand the number of weeks he worked more than 50 hours this year. For the rest of the time, his job as an actuary for the U.S. Department of Defense allowed him to live a high-quality life with minimal pressure.

05154ad887982aef9c6af3e748e5889d5accb70d.sourceText: 这也是精算师高居美国最佳工作榜首的原因之一。这是求职网站CareerCast.com最新调查结果，调查报告于周二发布。生物医学工程师排名第二位，2012年高居榜首的软件工程师如今排名第三。排名垫底的工作包括现役军人、伐木工人和报社记者。
05154ad887982aef9c6af3e748e5889d5accb70d.translatedText: This is one of the reasons why actuaries top the list of the best jobs in America. That's the result of the latest survey from job search website CareerCast.com, which was released on Tuesday. Biomedical engineers ranked second, and software engineers, who topped the list in 2012, are now ranked third. Jobs at the bottom of the list include active-duty military, lumberjacks and newspaper reporters.

46c1bfc4a4d281c431f7cb364ac44bad7a7811d3.sourceText: CareerCast.com是Adicio Inc.旗下的求职网站。该网站基于体能要求、工作环境、收入、工作压力和职业前景这五项因素，对200种职业进行了先后排名。在确定排名次序时，网站采用的是美国劳工统计局(Bureau of Labor Statistics)等政府部门的数据。与前些年一样，之所以选择这200个职业，是因为考虑到它们在当前劳动力市场的需求程度以及是否能获得相关可靠数据。
46c1bfc4a4d281c431f7cb364ac44bad7a7811d3.translatedText: CareerCast.com is a job search website owned by Adicio Inc. The website ranked 200 occupations based on five factors: physical requirements, work environment, income, work pressure and career prospects. In determining the ranking order, the website uses data from government departments such as the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. As in previous years, these 200 occupations were selected based on their level of demand in the current labor market and the availability of reliable data.

bf27fcb0af1fd017021525789759449e0ab04c50.sourceText: 精算师的工作是对风险给出一个经济数值。例如，飓风摧毁一幢临海别墅的可能性，或某养老制度的长期负债。CareerCast.com的出版人托尼 李(Tony Lee)说，在一个充满各种自然和人为风险的世界，精算行业正蓬勃发展。他还说，精算师人才目前有很大缺口，所以其薪资还在不断上涨。(据美国劳工部统计，2010年精算师的薪资中值为87,650美元。)
bf27fcb0af1fd017021525789759449e0ab04c50.translatedText: The job of an actuary is to give an economic value to risk. For example, the possibility of a hurricane destroying an oceanfront villa, or the long-term liabilities of a pension system. Tony Lee, publisher of CareerCast.com, said the actuarial profession is booming in a world filled with risks, both natural and man-made. He also said that there is currently a huge talent gap for actuaries, so their salaries are still rising. (According to the U.S. Department of Labor, the median salary for actuaries in 2010 was $87,650.)

03c58a574d82983015c39df82e1b3afcbf798c23.sourceText: 31岁的罗西每天的工作就是计算五角大楼在养老、医疗和教育福利方面未来的成本。但他说，这份工作不仅仅是鼓捣电子表格数据。他还要与其它政府部门进行沟通，并就金融模型与同事举行头脑风暴会议。
03c58a574d82983015c39df82e1b3afcbf798c23.translatedText: Rossi, 31, spends his days calculating the Pentagon’s future costs in pension, medical and education benefits. But he said the job involves more than just tinkering with spreadsheet data. He also communicates with other government departments and holds brainstorming sessions with colleagues on financial models.

baa1be09887aad42cb2fd59cbffaad83279e0c1d.sourceText: 李说，今年有好几个服务于老龄化人口金融和医疗需求的工作挤进了前10名，包括听力矫治专家、理财规划师和理疗师。
baa1be09887aad42cb2fd59cbffaad83279e0c1d.translatedText: Several jobs that serve the financial and medical needs of the aging population have made it into the top 10 this year, including audiologists, financial planners and physical therapists, Li said.

33e13f64d4dbd873b32eea0c653496f69c779af2.sourceText: 想知道2013年的最差工作是哪些吗？报社记者以其令人尴尬的特质，取代伐木工人成为今年的最差工作。
33e13f64d4dbd873b32eea0c653496f69c779af2.translatedText: Want to know what the worst jobs of 2013 are? Newspaper reporter, with his embarrassing traits, has replaced lumberjack as the worst job of the year.

dff9170c1104f323a2c2282775535baa3761ea0a.sourceText: 李说，记者职业排名靠后已经有一段时间了(去年在200个职业中排名第196位)。他说，这次被挤到最后一位很可能是因为有些情况更糟了，如职业前景变差、平均薪资继续下滑、工作时间持续增加等，而且这些因素也让记者的压力更大。
dff9170c1104f323a2c2282775535baa3761ea0a.translatedText: Li said the journalist profession has been ranked low for some time (ranked 196th out of 200 professions last year). He said that being pushed to the bottom this time was probably due to some worsening conditions, such as deteriorating career prospects, continued decline in average salary, and continued increase in working hours. Moreover, these factors also made journalists more stressed.

a9efe35f2ebff03401db3958769bc7c05ea9b11b.sourceText: 但并非所有记者──比如笔者本人──都认同这个最终评估结果。
a9efe35f2ebff03401db3958769bc7c05ea9b11b.translatedText: But not all reporters, such as the author myself, agree with this final assessment.

e9b425892f816c82784fc5ad00e024377f8c1336.sourceText: 拉杜卡(Rocco LaDuca)是纽约州尤蒂卡市(Utica)《观察家快报》(Observer-Dispatch)报道犯罪和法院新闻的记者。他说，之所以选择做记者，一定程度上是源于他和祖母读报的美好记忆。
e9b425892f816c82784fc5ad00e024377f8c1336.translatedText: Rocco LaDuca is a crime and courts reporter for the Observer-Dispatch in Utica, New York. He said that he chose to be a reporter partly because of his fond memories of reading newspapers with his grandmother.

f26a4610b6d69bb7aa242cf43de057d78c17b302.sourceText: 他说，薪酬是个问题（2010年记者的年薪中值为3.6万美元）。他不知道自己能否靠做记者的薪水供养家庭并送孩子上大学。而且还有一点没错，记者的压力和工作时间可能会令人感到精疲力竭。但他说，我不确定自己换个工作是否会开心，也想不出任何一个工作会像做记者这样让我觉得兴奋或有成就感。
f26a4610b6d69bb7aa242cf43de057d78c17b302.translatedText: Pay is an issue, he said (the median annual salary for journalists was $36,000 in 2010). He didn't know if he could support his family and send his children to college on a reporter's salary. And it’s also true that the stress and hours of a journalist can be exhausting. But he said, "I'm not sure if I would be happy if I changed my job, and I can't think of any job that would make me feel as excited or as fulfilling as being a reporter."

03c588076ecd9f4d99971c47e750f4ecd1d8f02a.translatedText: Bo Xilai's love letter to Li Danyu in 1975

05913518bded17095a78c1ae10a352f8de4ee663.sourceText: 1975年薄熙来致李丹宇的情书 下面是倒台的中国官员及共产党元老之子薄熙来写给李丹宇的信和诗，长达11页。李丹…
05913518bded17095a78c1ae10a352f8de4ee663.translatedText: Bo Xilai's love letter to Li Danyu in 1975 The following is an 11-page letter and poem written by Bo Xilai, the son of a fallen Chinese official and Communist Party veteran, to Li Danyu. Li Dan...

9e7142c6aaba94a27cf1e311be6d286b4072b09d.sourceText: 下面是倒台的中国官员及共产党元老之子薄熙来写给李丹宇的信和诗，长达11页。李丹宇是一名军医，也是一位共产党高官之女。信件的日期是1975年7月14日，以科举考试的”八股文”形式写成。1975年，文化大革命逐渐接近尾声，薄熙来和李丹宇的爱情故事就是从那一年开始的。当时，他们两人住在不同的城市。李丹宇说，他们每隔三天就会给对方写信。两人于1976年9月结婚，次年生下了一个儿子。四年后，他们在痛苦中分手，薄熙来又与将军之女谷开来结婚。今年8月20日，谷开来因投毒杀害英国商人尼尔?#28023;伍德(Neil Heywood)而被判处死缓。9月，共产党宣布，薄熙来已被开除党籍，并将面临一系列刑事指控。李丹宇在采访中说：”薄熙来曾是个勤奋的年轻人，想法很多，而且很有才华。他政治生涯结束的方式让我感到非常惋惜。他已经上了年纪，我只希望他能安享晚年。”
9e7142c6aaba94a27cf1e311be6d286b4072b09d.translatedText: >The following is an 11-page letter and poem written by Bo Xilai, the son of the fallen Chinese official and Communist Party veteran, to Li Danyu. Li Danyu is a military doctor and the daughter of a senior Communist Party official. The letter was dated July 14, 1975, and was written in the form of the "eight-legged essay" used in the imperial examination. In 1975, the Cultural Revolution was coming to an end, and the love story between Bo Xilai and Li Danyu began in that year. At the time, the two of them lived in different cities. Li Danyu said that they write to each other every three days. The two got married in September 1976 and gave birth to a son the following year. They broke up bitterly four years later, and Bo married Gu Kailai, the daughter of a general. On August 20 this year, Gu Kailai was sentenced to death with a suspended death sentence for poisoning and killing British businessman Neil Heywood. In September, the Communist Party announced that Bo Xilai had been expelled from the party and would face a series of criminal charges. Li Danyu said in the interview: "Bo Xilai was a hard-working young man with many ideas and talent. I feel very sorry for the way his political career ended. He is already old, and I just hope that he can enjoy his old age."

ab3cd65b806dbb908d062805a742f36ee4730fbc.sourceText: 小矛【小矛是李丹宇的小名–编者注】：
ab3cd65b806dbb908d062805a742f36ee4730fbc.translatedText: >Xiao Mao [Xiao Mao is Li Danyu Nickname - Editor's Note]:

97d20796e4448a07cbf9f0618bf7d4afdc664c1e.sourceText: 我首先应该向你声明，此信这样的字大行稀，并非为了偷懒或应付差使，只是因为我习惯了较大的字，写起来舒服一些，只要看了我后面的篇幅，就可以证明我的勤勉了。
97d20796e4448a07cbf9f0618bf7d4afdc664c1e.translatedText: First of all, I should declare to you that the use of large and sparse characters in this letter is not to be lazy or to cope with the errand, but because I am used to larger characters and it is more comfortable to write. Just read the following pages, which will prove my diligence.

bfe20402b3bcff92d8cf8b345f4d9dd613953b3a.sourceText: 今天给你写信，大可以随便一些，因为一年里边这样的机会十分有限，所以我要尽情的利用它，时间是11:20，在这之前我一直在看你的信，并审视我的照片。这是我奉命在生日那天照的，光秃秃的一个大脑袋，真没意思。但自惭形秽是不对的，不管他许多，还是给你寄去，由你耻笑吧。以下我想谈谈对几个问题的看法，和你讨论讨论，就来篇八股文吧。
bfe20402b3bcff92d8cf8b345f4d9dd613953b3a.translatedText: When I write to you today, you can feel free to do so, because such opportunities are very limited in a year, so I have to make the most of it. The time is 11:20. Before that, I have been reading your letter and looking at my photos. I was ordered to take this photo on my birthday. It’s a big, bald head. It’s really boring. But it is wrong to feel ashamed of oneself. No matter how many there are, I will still send them to you and let you laugh at them. Now I want to talk about my views on several issues and discuss them with you, so let’s write an eight-legged essay.

468dc5965c010d320590c96455edc476d1cf0aad.sourceText: 从你的信中我觉察到，你挺爱琢磨人的形象，这倒十分象纳赛尔，他就常常把别人的照片放在桌子上呆呆地看上半小时，据说凭着这个古怪的办法就可以得出一个人的基本印象，”八九不离十”了。这并不是全无道理，而且十分有趣，你可能就受了他的影响。形象在实际中确是客观存在的，在某种程度上反映着人们的内心世界，包括思想、品质、性格这些东西。虽然有人言行不一，很能克制，”不行于色”，但伪善者演正派人物总是不大象的，伪装终究是要剥去的，怪不得捷尔任斯基总爱用他那双敏锐的眼睛去注视一个个的”形象”。在交往中，人们既注意观察自己朋友的形象，也珍视自己留给朋友的形象，而且越亲近的人就越重视这一点。人们总不希望自己在别人心目中是无足轻重的，除非这个人我们本身就讨厌他，希望他快些忘掉自己，省的被缠住。对于你的形象，有时我能心满意足的回味，尤其是临别前你从小妹家回来后说的一两句话，我是非常动心的，连当时的表情、姿势我都十分清楚；可有时也不免模糊，这是感情不够好吗？未必，因为我主观上总是希望有一个你的清晰的形象。形象与感情有联系，但并不成正比；形象固然重要，但还以自然为妙。随随便便，自由自在，就是使人最舒服的形象。尽管我留给你的形象并不高大，也不稳重，甚至有些使你别扭的地方，但保持了自然的本色，我也就满足了。我深信在自然的发展中，能日益加深了解，树立起一个真正的，而不是臆想的形象。如果把你的大脑比做一个剧院，现在也许已经’座无虚席’了，早被那些”冠心病”、”动脉硬化”、”胆固醇”、”心电图”之类的医学名词占满了，我这个迟到者自然没有座位。但只要有耐心，”功夫不负有心人”，我想双方都会找到座位的。
468dc5965c010d320590c96455edc476d1cf0aad.translatedText: From your letter, I noticed that you love to think about people's images, which is very similar to Nasser. He often put other people's photos on the table and stared at them for half an hour. It is said that with this weird method, you can get a basic impression of a person, which is "almost the same." It's not entirely unreasonable, it's interesting, and you may have been influenced by it. Image does exist objectively in reality, and to some extent reflects people's inner world, including thoughts, quality, and personality. Although there are people who are inconsistent in their words and deeds, and are very restrained and "not limited by sex," hypocrites always act like upright people, and the disguise must be peeled off after all. No wonder Dzerzhinsky always likes to use his keen eyes to watch each "image". In interactions, people not only pay attention to observing the image of their friends, but also cherish the image they leave to their friends, and the closer people are, the more they value this. People don't always want to be insignificant in the minds of others, unless we hate this person ourselves, and hope that he will forget about himself quickly and avoid being entangled. Sometimes I can reminisce about your image with satisfaction, especially the one or two words you said after you came back from my sister's house before leaving. I was very moved. I even knew your expression and posture at that time; but sometimes I can't help but feel vague. Is this because the emotion is not enough? Not necessarily, because subjectively I always hope to have a clear image of you. Image and emotion are related, but not directly proportional; image is important, but nature is better. Being casual and free is the image that makes people most comfortable. Although the image I leave you is not tall, nor stable, and may even make you awkward, but I am satisfied if I maintain my natural character. I firmly believe that in the development of nature, we can deepen our understanding day by day and establish a real, not imaginary, image. If you compare your brain to a theater, the seats may already be packed by medical terms such as "coronary heart disease," "arteriosclerosis," "cholesterol," and "electrocardiogram." Naturally, I, a latecomer, don't have a seat. But as long as you have patience and "hard work pays off," I think both parties will find seats.

3873ce4e2969bc23fd0d0af1bde1863cf140f941.sourceText: 我们并不是单凭”形象”所激发起来的热情而生活，更重要的是在理智的、精神与物质的互助中前进。毕竟，”形象”还只是入门的向导。
3873ce4e2969bc23fd0d0af1bde1863cf140f941.translatedText: We do not live solely by the enthusiasm inspired by "image", but more importantly, we move forward in the mutual help of reason, spirit and material. After all, "image" is just a guide to get started.

cbfd373bd5adb55ee2ec81e2179c4b805fd019b9.sourceText: 人们往往爱表现自己，而在言语上又故作谦虚，把自己说的这也不行，那也不好的。在朋友的接触中这种情况更是经常。即使有人是真实地谦虚 ，于事也是无益的。因为朋友嘛，就是为了互相帮助，就是要互相了解。隐讳自己的长处既不能加深相互的了解，更不能促进对方前进，很多满好的事就是被这种小资产阶级的虚荣心毁了的。事物总有两个方面，认识自己的缺点是必要的，看到自己的长处，由此鼓起勇气也是必要的。向别人讲述坦白自己的弱点是诚恳的，向别人介绍自己的优点也是自然而坦率的。谦虚固然是人之美德，实事求是确是我更为珍视的。我们即不应有庸人对一得之功的沾沾自喜，也不应有那种故意表现谦虚风度的做作。既然是朋友，了解就应该是完全彻底。在这里，不必顾虑一般人所说的”面子”，表扬自己又何尝不可呢？说心里话，当我看到你讲自己在呼啸的北风中长跑，在学习困倦时咬指，只在黑夜里听凭吟吟泪水的流淌，我是很感动的，而且也极喜欢你这样对我讲述自己的情况。这丝毫没有炫耀的意思，你是真情实感的表达。希望今后也是如此，哪怕你讲自己如何”棒”，如何做出成绩，我也只会把这当作你促进我前进的意思来理解的。当然，我也在同样要求自己。
cbfd373bd5adb55ee2ec81e2179c4b805fd019b9.translatedText: >People often like to express themselves, and they pretend to be modest in their words. It is not good to say this or that. This happens even more frequently among friends. Even if someone is truly humble, it will not help matters. Because friends are meant to help each other and understand each other. Concealing one's own strengths can neither deepen mutual understanding nor promote each other's progress. Many good things are ruined by this kind of petty bourgeois vanity. There are always two sides to things. It is necessary to recognize your own shortcomings, and it is also necessary to see your own strengths and have the courage to do so. It is sincere to tell others about your weaknesses, and it is also natural and candid to introduce your strengths to others. Although humility is a human virtue, seeking truth from facts is indeed what I value more. We should not have the mediocre complacency of one-time success, nor should we have the affectation of deliberately showing modesty. Since we are friends, we should understand each other completely. Here, there is no need to worry about what most people call "face". Why not praise yourself? To be honest, when I saw you talking about long-distance running in the howling north wind, biting your fingers when you were sleepy while studying, and just listening to the flow of tears in the dark night, I was very moved, and I also liked how you told me about your situation. This is not meant to show off at all, you are expressing your true feelings. I hope this will be the case in the future. Even if you talk about how "great" you are and how you have achieved results, I will only understand it as your intention to promote my progress. Of course, I am also demanding the same of myself.

ed914c40002a0605d6f632b647c4bc03217f4f69.sourceText: 上次给你的信中给你戴上多愁善感的帽子，请不要生气，那里50%是在开玩笑，并不是我对你的定见。”多愁善感”要一分为二，我不喜欢”多愁”，但喜欢”善感”。象你信中所描写的”轻风戏动的树叶，如血残阳的余辉，敲打窗子的雨声，及那静夜星空厖” 这样”善感”我是喜欢的。一个人不应该思想呆板，沉溺于老套，除了学习业务以外就没有其他。生活浪漫一些好，思想活跃一些好，感情深沉一些好。许多革命的跃进，【此处字迹难以辨认】的成绩，都是带有一些浪漫色彩的。总按常规走路是不行的。而回想那些革命的大师们，工作中思想中常是严谨与浪漫二者同时存在。所以”触景生情，遇事善感”，我认为还是一种美德。至于”多愁”，我就不喜欢了。而坦白地讲，我最担心的也就是你不要染上那种知识分子的通病–遇事多愁。当然，以你目前的处境和经历过的事情是有理由多愁的。但多愁必定伤身而且无补于事，愁是愁不出办法来的。而正因为我和你的经历极相近，所以更不愿总是发愁，而希望有一个乐观的、坚定的、对生活充满信心的人和我在一起。我从正面与侧面都了解到你是具备这些品质的，因而我十分快慰。只愿你今后遇到不愉快的事，想到伤心的地方，多往开阔处想。”天空任鸟飞，海阔从鱼跃”。马克思讲”反晦过去，莫如发愤未来”，我们应引以为共勉。
ed914c40002a0605d6f632b647c4bc03217f4f69.translatedText: I put a sentimental hat on you in my last letter to you. Please don't be angry. 50% of it was a joke and not my opinion of you. "Sentimentality" should be divided into two parts. I don't like "sentimentality", but I like "sentimentality". I like the "kindness" described in your letter, "the leaves swaying in the breeze, the afterglow of the setting sun, the sound of rain beating on the window, and the starry sky in the quiet night." One should not be rigid-minded, addicted to old-fashioned ideas, and do nothing more than learn the business. It is better to live a more romantic life, to be more active in thinking, and to have deep feelings. Many revolutionary leaps forward and [the handwriting is illegible here] achievements are somewhat romantic. It’s not enough to always walk according to routine. Looking back on those revolutionary masters, both rigor and romance often coexisted in their work and thoughts. Therefore, I think it is still a virtue to be "emotional when you are struck by a scene and feel good when things happen". As for "sadness", I don't like it. Frankly speaking, what I worry about the most is that you don’t suffer from that common disease among intellectuals – being anxious when things happen. Of course, given your current situation and what you have experienced, there is reason to be sad. But being too worried will definitely hurt your health and will not help. There is no way out of being worried. And precisely because my experiences are very similar to yours, I don’t want to worry all the time, but I hope to have an optimistic, determined, and confident person with me. I know from the front and side that you have these qualities, so I am very happy. I only hope that when you encounter unpleasant things in the future and think of sad places, you can think more broadly. "The sky is open for birds to fly, and the sea is open for fish to leap." Marx said, "It is better to work hard for the future than to dwell on the past." We should all take this as our encouragement.

657dc1ab195503a690209387ac9e121ff0614e60.sourceText: 这是我对朋友的原则，希望你也能这样。我接受了第一次的教训，我以为对朋友一定要”严格”，就是说，看到有什么缺点，一定及时提出来。知无不言，言无不尽，没什么可保留的，有了矛盾就让它在萌芽时解决，不要一味迁就。同时鼓励对方去努力奋斗，监督对方去实行自己的计划。我远不是一个意志坚定、一丝不苟的人，所以还特别需要这种”鞭策”。而且不管你怎么要求，则这种好意【原文”好意”下方用小圆圈强调–编者注】我都是能够理解的。（比如车的事）
657dc1ab195503a690209387ac9e121ff0614e60.translatedText: This is my principle for friends, I hope you can do the same. I learned the first lesson, and I thought that I must be "strict" to my friends, that is, if I see any shortcomings, I must point them out in time. Tell everything you know, say everything, and hold nothing back. If there is a conflict, let it be resolved at the budding stage. Don't just give in. At the same time, encourage the other party to work hard and supervise the other party to implement their own plans. I am far from a strong-willed and meticulous person, so I particularly need this kind of "nudge". And no matter what you ask for, I can understand this kind of kindness [emphasis on the small circle under the original text "good intention" - editor's note]. (such as car matters)

65a5bc22d4eb6f2a6a7c6a063eb5f4b122ab0f7f.sourceText: 另一方面，也应该有谅解对方缺点、错误的心胸和气量。俗话说：”人无十全，瓜无滚圆”。每个人都有他的弱点，要求没有缺点的朋友等于没有朋友。道理很简单，但遇到具体的事情就容易糊涂。尤其是相爱的人，他把对方想的是碧玉无暇、完美绝伦，因而一旦发现什么缺点就大惊小怪耿耿于怀，结果反把事情弄糟。世界上的事情没有纯粹的，任何人都要有不足之处，连马克思也爱引用”人所具有的（缺点）我都具有”这句格言。所以，我们只有真正领会了辩证的思想，才会有真正容人的胸怀。我们已经看到了那么多，谁有点问题有什么可大惊小怪呢？我有改造自己的决心，我有不断前进的勇气，但远不是一个完美的人，这点必须提请你的注意。我希望你能毫不含糊地批评我任何一个缺点（甚至涉及本质），但我也希望你不要象一般的知识分子那样过于细腻、敏感。（我现在并不觉的你是这样，只是预防）很多事都要想的开，不要过于拘谨，不要按一般的风气、见解来要求。我们各自的经历决定了我们采取的方法和思路。我指仅这些在今后是可以彼此了解和互有启发的，而且基本点是一致的。
65a5bc22d4eb6f2a6a7c6a063eb5f4b122ab0f7f.translatedText: On the other hand, you should also have the heart and tolerance to understand each other's shortcomings and mistakes. As the saying goes: "No one is perfect, and no melon is perfect." Everyone has his weaknesses, and asking for friends without shortcomings means having no friends. The principle is very simple, but it is easy to get confused when encountering specific things. Especially for people who love each other, they think that the other person is flawless and perfect, so once they find any shortcomings, they will make a fuss and worry about it, which will make things worse. Nothing in the world is pure, and everyone has shortcomings. Even Marx liked to quote the motto "I have all the (shortcomings) that people have." Therefore, only when we truly understand dialectical thinking can we have a truly tolerant mind. We've seen so much, who has a problem and what's the fuss about? I have the determination to transform myself, and I have the courage to keep moving forward, but I am far from a perfect person, and this must be brought to your attention. I hope you can unequivocally criticize any of my shortcomings (even the essence), but I also hope you will not be too delicate and sensitive like ordinary intellectuals. (I don’t think you are like this now, I’m just taking precautions.) You have to think openly about many things, don’t be too rigid, and don’t make demands based on general customs and opinions. Our respective experiences determine the methods and ideas we adopt. I mean that only these can understand and inspire each other in the future, and the basic points are the same.

1a7603ab3e65c7089a21f0b205cdbc24944c94e9.sourceText: 前几天我抄完了那些你所需要的”格言”之类。我很高兴，因为你需要的，也是我格外喜欢的，使我不由的想起古人说的”英雄所见略同”。我曾反复回味过主席的那些话。
1a7603ab3e65c7089a21f0b205cdbc24944c94e9.translatedText: A few days ago I finished copying the "mottos" and the like that you need. I'm very happy, because what you need is also what I particularly like. It reminds me of the ancient saying that "heroes think alike." I have thought about the Chairman's words over and over again.

66a4c09a391acf240e396e0b6d024f5db6d6c72e.sourceText: ”聪明的人往往出在地位低、被人看不起、受过侮辱而且年轻的人中。社会主义社会也不例外。”真是有道理啊！
66a4c09a391acf240e396e0b6d024f5db6d6c72e.translatedText: "Smart people often come from low status, looked down upon, insulted and young people. Socialist society is no exception." It makes sense!

55ac72b25e14d0903bae8b46de09ea286942eb13.sourceText: 我现在就有这个习惯，看到好东西就想摘录下来，否则日后就找不到了。日积月累，这些东西都是极为宝贵的。过了几个月后再翻一次，实在又有新鲜的感觉，”如见故人”。今后有机会我也挺想看看你摘录的本子。
55ac72b25e14d0903bae8b46de09ea286942eb13.translatedText: I have this habit now. When I see something good, I want to excerpt it, otherwise I won’t find it in the future. Over time, these things become extremely valuable. After a few months, I read it again, and it felt fresh again, "like meeting an old friend." I would also like to read the excerpts from your book if I have the opportunity in the future.

f2448fe646ea7c3c1021d6e9ff720ffce01e80ba.sourceText: 原来我是不大爱写日记的，现在亦如此。但生活中许多大事、感想，丢掉又十分可惜。最近我想出一个好办法，就是我订期给你写的信，望你保存起来。今后合到一块，就是一本完整的日记，省的我再另开篇幅了。这些既是思想，又是生活，既是经验的总结，又是行动的考虑。反正是啥都有了，积累起来是有益的。当然我也会给你的信同等待遇的。我很喜爱你抄来的那些格言：一个人如果没有坚韧性、果断性、向目的锐进的志向和毅力，那么，他的劳动就不可能是有成效的。”锐进”二字极好。
f2448fe646ea7c3c1021d6e9ff720ffce01e80ba.translatedText: Originally I didn’t like keeping diaries, and that’s still the case now. But it would be a pity to throw away many important events and feelings in life. Recently I came up with a good idea, that is, I write you letters regularly and hope you keep them. From now on, when put together, it will be a complete diary, which will save me the trouble of opening another chapter. These are both thoughts and life, both a summary of experience and considerations for action. Anyway, we have everything, and it is beneficial to accumulate it. Of course I will give your letter the same treatment. I really like the aphorisms you copied: If a person does not have tenacity, decisiveness, ambition and perseverance to advance towards the goal, then his labor cannot be effective. The word "Ruijin" is very good.

7bf30f5a812200d1754eb1089d8c6b64916ad209.sourceText: 问题就写到这里吧，也许你已经烦透了，但只要你不给我扣上”烂婆娘的裹脚布，又臭又长”这歇后语就行了。无论如何，我是写的”肺腑之言、真实感受”，且这么晚，我也困的有些迷糊了。
7bf30f5a812200d1754eb1089d8c6b64916ad209.translatedText: Let’s just write the question here. Maybe you are tired of it, but as long as you don’t give me the excuse of “a rotten woman’s foot wrap, smelly and long”, it will be fine. In any case, I wrote "from the bottom of my heart and my true feelings", and it was so late that I was sleepy and a little confused.

a2724a395db2ca82f19aa40253413db7e509bb12.sourceText: 还忘了告你，为了对你有个”全面了解”，我专门去小航那里采访了一下你的”好人好事”，收获不小。她也是准备好了一、二、三、四地给我讲，从工作、学习到生活、锻炼，倒是都讲到了，就是实例还不多，未能满足我的要求。但这也大有补益，比如说我工作能够有机会早回家的时候，就想起你是怎样向雷锋叔叔学习、主动值班的情景，于是坚持到下班，还受到师傅的好评。自然我也忧心忡忡地问到她你是否爱生气？回答是满意的。
a2724a395db2ca82f19aa40253413db7e509bb12.translatedText: I also forgot to sue you. In order to have a "comprehensive understanding" of you, I went to Xiaohang to interview you about your "good people and good deeds", and I gained a lot. She was also ready to talk to me one, two, three, or four times, covering everything from work, study, life, and exercise, but there were not many examples to meet my requirements. But it is also very beneficial. For example, when I have the opportunity to go home early from work, I remember how you learned from Uncle Lei Feng and took the initiative to be on duty, so I persisted until get off work, and was praised by the master. Naturally, I also asked her worriedly: Do you like to be angry? The answer is satisfactory.

dce41ad4461b26737b1b53fe4af99a9d25403d69.sourceText: 这次托她带给你的三件”礼物”，都是傻乎乎的小东西，你可别以为我是在取笑你。它们各有一个函义：小铁盒上的小朋友代表纯洁，帽娃娃代表健康，而那小熊猫抱着球若有所思的样子，就让它代表深沉吧。另外买了打信封，小鸭、小象的怪好玩，就请它们经常鼓励你快乐点儿吧！
dce41ad4461b26737b1b53fe4af99a9d25403d69.translatedText: The three "gifts" I asked her to bring you this time are all silly little things. Don't think I'm making fun of you. They each have a meaning: the child on the small iron box represents purity, the hat doll represents health, and the little panda holding the ball thoughtfully, let it represent depth. I also bought some envelopes. The ducklings and elephants are so fun, just ask them to encourage you to be happy!

1831eb09e44051c1dc39ccb7ecaa2126261ed011.sourceText: 至于此信，是我最费劲的，可也许我一本正经地说了半天，你在我看不见的地方却一再摇头，认为是谬论连篇。那也不要紧，写信批判好了，我向来是很有兴趣辩论的。你说的对我就服输，有几件事我不是已经向你”投降”了么？你的逻辑性还是较为严密，并能说出一些令人信服的道理的。不过社会经验也不怎么样，比我强不了多少，所以你对周围的人与事还是没下一番功夫的，否则有一天你的心跳也会从40多/分下，追上我的。
1831eb09e44051c1dc39ccb7ecaa2126261ed011.translatedText: As for this letter, it was the most laborious for me, but maybe I said it seriously for a long time, but you shook your head again and again out of sight of me, thinking it was a series of fallacies. That doesn't matter, just write a letter to criticize. I've always been very interested in debating. If you're right, I'll give in. Haven't I already "surrendered" to you on a few things? Your logic is quite strict and you can express some convincing reasons. However, your social experience is not very good, not much better than mine, so you still haven’t put much effort into the people and things around you, otherwise one day your heartbeat will drop from over 40/min to catch up with mine.

227e7b53b7299e451a43329dc0cd4692cd0dd435.sourceText: 买到了《简明心电图》，只有精装一种，平装有价而无书，所以买了。但我还是有”节俭”的意识的。
227e7b53b7299e451a43329dc0cd4692cd0dd435.translatedText: I bought "Concise Electrocardiogram". There is only one hardcover version. The paperback version was pricey but there was no book, so I bought it. But I still have a sense of "frugality".

29eef3cbd5fb8e2bf70515d787b8970d664ac12c.sourceText: 最后”正告”你一句，今后写信千万不要太费时间了，从6点写到1点，尽管断断续续，也太影响工作了。久而久之，是要毁身体的。咱们又不是搞”接力赛”，不必过于紧张，”频率”大可以放慢一点。虽然我是在故作宽宏大量地”违心”地劝告你，但还是应关心关心你，确实要自重身体！”惩病克寿，矜壮死暴”，你可别自恃强壮而一意孤行啊。
29eef3cbd5fb8e2bf70515d787b8970d664ac12c.translatedText: Finally, a "warning" to you, don't waste too much time writing letters in the future. Writing from 6 o'clock to 1 o'clock, even if it is intermittent, will affect your work too much. Over time, it will destroy the body. We are not engaging in a "relay race", so there is no need to be too nervous. The "frequency" can be slowed down a bit. Although I am pretending to be magnanimous and advising you "against your will", I should still care about you and really respect your body! "Sickness will bring longevity, but strength will lead to death." Don't rely on your own strength and insist on going your own way.

4437b9760bdaaa253b61db8731e1a62f0a4f50b6.sourceText: 我也把笔记本上的第一句话抄给你：
4437b9760bdaaa253b61db8731e1a62f0a4f50b6.translatedText: > I will also copy the first sentence in my notebook to you:

e59eacc5ccdf1e73af2a2f414ca644e22b888306.sourceText: 言长纸短，难以尽述；友人之心，如在吾庐；
e59eacc5ccdf1e73af2a2f414ca644e22b888306.translatedText: Words are long and paper is short, it is difficult to describe them all; the hearts of friends are as if they were in my house;

ad6586090378b78adb60eaaf67c1806373e81d59.sourceText: 香山恨低，何惧险路；来日方长，志上征途。
ad6586090378b78adb60eaaf67c1806373e81d59.translatedText: Fragrant mountains hate low places, so why be afraid of dangerous roads; the future is long, and we are determined to go on a journey.

185cb11bc91a8913aab875ca9e238afa13f869b0.translatedText: the heart of remembrance is strong.

6279ee45c228e252a7c61ae91ebbec72a9dbd5f1.translatedText: the strong grass along the river,

40d59283b7977136021a4edd5f90691292ab5518.translatedText: awe-inspiring and proud of the Central Plains.

4d05b61698bd7ca33003ec0467211355ad1ce3be.translatedText: Read the history and ask the Chinese people,

fba6be25cc526319dd8e75d57e0604784ee397ec.translatedText: Today, the two hegemons are fighting for supremacy,

d83eb4fab67683b140e5fbd341c32f3a38ce252a.translatedText: and a dark storm is brewing all over the world.

0b9319ba7751e038f995907219a771eaab1b1662.translatedText: Best friends share the same virtue,

e26d3445f2bb34f508e9c26dbf64b8de7634c58e.translatedText: Hearts are as hot as fire,

8726a1b1bcb0f4af196f2724c0ab137fe39e070a.translatedText: looks at Danyu with a smile,

c191ae8a3663e9230fe512bb11704cb1d9a7ec7c.sourceText: 911简讯服务 明年开始部署 （亚省时报） 联邦通讯委员会(FCC)7日宣布，美国四家最大的无线通讯公司已同意开办一项新服务，让客户在遇到危难时，可发简讯到911紧急中心求助。 目前，民众只可以打911作紧急求救，这项改变特别能够帮助有听觉或语言障碍的人。 FCC在一份声明中说，AT&T、威瑞森(Verizon)、史普林(Sprint)和T-Mobile已应允提供911简讯服务，并将于2013年进行部署，到2014年5月1日，这项服务将遍及全国。 这四家电讯公司承诺2013年6月30日前开始911简讯回复服务，用户会收到一个自动「回复」信息，请他们打911语音电话，直至服务开通为止。
c191ae8a3663e9230fe512bb11704cb1d9a7ec7c.translatedText: 911 SMS service will be deployed next year (Alberta Times) The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) announced on the 7th that the four largest wireless communication companies in the United States have agreed to launch a new service that allows customers to send text messages to the 911 emergency center for help when they are in danger. Currently, people can only call 911 for emergency help. This change will especially help people with hearing or speech impairments. The FCC said in a statement that AT&T, Verizon, Sprint and T-Mobile have agreed to provide 911 text messaging services and will deploy them in 2013. By May 1, 2014, the service will be nationwide. The four telecommunications companies promised to start 911 text message reply services before June 30, 2013. Users will receive an automatic "reply" message asking them to make a 911 voice call until the service is activated.

52e3367cf915a38a8bca0fddbabac53859c2fdf3.sourceText: 百年“雙十”9月28日紀念活動籌備會（图） （亚省时报） （本报讯 可可）9月21日晚6時在康樂大廈，舉行了9月28日台灣百年”雙十”活動最後一次籌備會議。籌備會主席，僑委會諮詢顧問尹衍桓女士主持了會議，僑委會諮詢顧問余文勁，以及活動的各項負責人二十多人參加了會議。從接待，酒會，票務等各項準備工作都已就緒。最重要的是在會議上，大家搶鮮看到了9月28日的節目單，有很多耳熟能詳的經典歌曲都將在晚會上進行演唱，例如《感恩的心》《梅花》 《雨夜花》《白牡丹》等等。活動中精彩的部分還有豐盛的抽獎獎品，目前已超過百份，就等待嘉賓來拿。另外當地傳統僑社，還準備了超過40桌的盛大歡迎晚宴，歡迎演出團的到來。目前，活動的票賣得相當不錯，如果你希望參加這次活動，那就趕緊與鳳凰城僑委會成員聯絡。 筹备会现场

Many familiar classic songs will be sung at the party, such as "Grateful Heart", "Plum Blossom", "Rainy Night Flower", "White Peony" and so on. At present, the tickets for the event are selling quite well. If you want to participate in this event, please contact the members of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Committee as soon as possible. 079cae7f26e414d38eba49d72c1730504576be23.sourceText: 新的报税季已经展开，为了吓阻不法之徒利用身分盗窃诈骗退税，国税局31日宣布，上周在23州对身分盗窃和退税诈欺犯进行大规模扫荡，成果丰硕，一举逮捕105 人。 国税局透露，这项扫荡行动由阿拉斯加延伸到佛罗里达州，提控了80个违法案，以及58项逮捕行动，有些触法者已认罪或判刑。 过去数月、甚至数年，国税局展开调查案件后，司法部税务部门、邮政局和地方检查官办公室均配合办案。 国税局去年发现26万件退税案是使用盗来的身分，因而拒绝退税，节省了14亿元公帑。 国税局表示，这类诈骗案日渐增多，歹徒主要是窃取社安卡号，不实地申报退税。 国税局副局长米勒表示：「国税局希望在报税季开始之际，对外发出讯息，希望民众正确报税。」米勒说，社安号码盗用事件常发生于学校和医院。 国税局官员透露，这些案件包括三名俄亥俄州德顿女性被控盗用残障者身分诈领退税。 一名阿拉巴马州蒙哥马利女性安全警卫利用职务的方便，盗用州政府所服务民众的身分诈领退税款。 一名科罗拉多州男子盗取一家倒闭公司客户的身分诈领退税。 过去一周，国税局官员访查150家金融服务业者，稽查他们是否涉及身分盗窃和退税诈欺案。 包括亚特兰大、阿拉巴马州伯明罕、芝加哥、洛杉矶、迈阿密、纽约、凤凰城、坦帕、华盛顿特区等高危险的大都会区是调查重点。 此外，国税局在全美查核逾250家支票兑换机构，以查缉身分盗窃活动。 米勒说，国税局已在电脑系统安装新的筛选软体，查缉身分盗窃案，以免退税给诈欺犯。 米勒表示，对于今年已经报税者，这项作业导致退税作业延缓一周，但很快将改善。
079cae7f26e414d38eba49d72c1730504576be23.translatedText: The new tax filing season has begun. In order to deter criminals from using identity theft to defraud tax refunds, the IRS announced on the 31st that it conducted a large-scale raid on identity theft and tax refund fraud in 23 states last week, with fruitful results, including the arrest of 105 people. The IRS revealed that the sweep extended from Alaska to Florida and resulted in the prosecution of 80 violations and 58 arrests. Some of the offenders have pleaded guilty or been sentenced. Over the past few months and even years, the IRS has investigated cases that have been joined by the Department of Justice's tax division, the Postal Service and the district attorney's office. Last year, the IRS discovered that 260,000 tax refunds were filed using stolen identities and refused to refund them, saving $1.4 billion in public funds. The IRS said this type of fraud is increasing day by day, with criminals mainly stealing Social Security card numbers and falsely filing tax refunds. IRS Deputy Commissioner Miller said: "The IRS hopes to send out a message at the beginning of the tax filing season, hoping that people will file their taxes correctly." Miller said that Social Security number theft often occurs in schools and hospitals. The cases include three Dayton, Ohio, women accused of using their disability status to fraudulently claim tax refunds, IRS officials said. A female security guard in Montgomery, Alabama, took advantage of her position to fraudulently claim tax refunds by using the identities of the people the state government serves. A Colorado man stole the identities of clients of a failed company to fraudulently claim tax refunds. Over the past week, IRS officials visited 150 financial services companies to investigate whether they were involved in identity theft and tax refund fraud. High-risk metropolitan areas including Atlanta, Birmingham, Alabama, Chicago, Los Angeles, Miami, New York, Phoenix, Tampa, Washington, D.C., are the focus of the investigation. In addition, the Internal Revenue Service inspected more than 250 check cashing agencies across the United States to detect identity theft. Miller said the IRS has installed new screening software on its computer systems to detect cases of identity theft and prevent tax refunds from being given to fraudsters. Miller said that for those who have already filed taxes this year, this operation has caused a one-week delay in refund processing, but it will soon improve.

797c6953b906d93defcd4b6a9e30f27e3d07678c.sourceText: 华盛顿移民研究中心主要根据最新人口普查数据于6日推出的研究报告显示，中国是全球赴美移民第二多的国家，现有定居美国但出生于中国大陆、台湾和港澳的第一代移民216.7万，仅次于墨西哥的1171万。中国移民数量比10年前增加近65万，比20年前增加124万多人。随后的移民输出大国是印度、菲律宾、越南、萨尔瓦多、古巴、韩国，其在美移民也都在100万以上。
797c6953b906d93defcd4b6a9e30f27e3d07678c.translatedText: A research report released on the 6th by the Washington Immigration Research Center, which is mainly based on the latest census data, shows that China is the country with the second largest number of immigrants to the United States in the world. There are currently 2.167 million first-generation immigrants who have settled in the United States but were born in mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macao, second only to Mexico’s 11.71 million. The number of Chinese immigrants has increased by nearly 650,000 compared with 10 years ago, and by more than 1.24 million compared with 20 years ago. The subsequent major immigrant exporting countries are India, the Philippines, Vietnam, El Salvador, Cuba, and South Korea, all of which have more than 1 million immigrants in the United States.

e49a782da047af966bb5af1f6f58359f80c67f77.sourceText: 这份报告说，相较于1990年到2000年美国工作机会增加2000万而移民只增长1320万，过去10年美国就业机会减少40万，但移民增量却创1390万的历史新高。现在旅美外国移民数量是1990年的两倍，1980年的3倍，1970年的4倍。
e49a782da047af966bb5af1f6f58359f80c67f77.translatedText: This report said that compared with 1990 to 2000, when U.S. job opportunities increased by 20 million and immigrants only increased by 13.2 million, U.S. job opportunities decreased by 400,000 in the past 10 years, but the number of immigrants increased by 13.9 million, a record high. The number of foreign immigrants in the United States is now twice that of 1990, three times that of 1980, and four times that of 1970.

8d1ad86584be5dca551d7fbd2ad2e1584eb1a287.sourceText: 扣除移民外迁和死亡者，过去十年美国移民人口净增880万，从而使移民总量达4千万。尽管如此，美国移民占总人口的比重还不足1成3，不如90年前移民比例最高时的1成5。
8d1ad86584be5dca551d7fbd2ad2e1584eb1a287.translatedText: Excluding out-migration and deaths, the U.S. immigrant population has a net increase of 8.8 million in the past ten years, bringing the total number of immigrants to 40 million. Despite this, immigrants in the United States account for less than 13% of the total population, down from 15% when the proportion of immigrants was at its peak 90 years ago.

61d7081037f695bdae2822b2677f5fc95aa0e560.sourceText: 报告称，移民人口增长主要是由合法移民大量流入推动的，大约四分之三的移民是合法赴美的。拉丁裔移民是移民增加的主力，10年增加747万，亚裔是第二大主力，10年增加409万。
61d7081037f695bdae2822b2677f5fc95aa0e560.translatedText: The report stated that the growth of the immigrant population is mainly driven by the large inflow of legal immigrants, and about three-quarters of immigrants come to the United States legally. Latino immigrants are the main force in the increase in immigrants, with an increase of 7.47 million in 10 years, and Asians are the second largest force, with an increase of 4.09 million in 10 years.

c1f841bfdb6f9467c9b23600ce4b03ef3443dedf.sourceText: 研究发现，移民赴美落脚点更加分散，移民最密集的6个州占移民人口总数的比例从1990年的73%下降到2010年65%。移民增长最快的州多在中南部地区，亚拉巴马、南卡和田纳西等州移民数量10年增加8到9成；与20年前相比，北卡、佐治亚、阿肯色等州移民人口增加3.3到4.3倍。
c1f841bfdb6f9467c9b23600ce4b03ef3443dedf.translatedText: The study found that the destinations of immigrants to the United States are more dispersed, and the proportion of the total immigrant population in the six states with the highest concentration of immigrants dropped from 73% in 1990 to 65% in 2010. The states with the fastest growth in immigrants are mostly in the central and southern regions. The number of immigrants in states such as Alabama, South Carolina and Tennessee has increased by 80 to 90% in 10 years. Compared with 20 years ago, the immigrant population in states such as North Carolina, Georgia and Arkansas has increased by 3.3 to 4.3 times.

c5612dad96be8a3ad322a645d244e60064f1005b.sourceText: 移民总量增加最多的依然是加州、德州、佛罗里达、纽约、新泽西等传统移民聚居州。目前移民人口最多的是加州(1015万)、纽约(430万)、德州(414万)、佛罗里达(366万)、新泽西(184万)、伊利诺伊(176万)。
c5612dad96be8a3ad322a645d244e60064f1005b.translatedText: The largest increase in the total number of immigrants is still in the traditional immigrant-populated states such as California, Texas, Florida, New York, and New Jersey. Currently, the largest immigrant populations are in California (10.15 million), New York (4.3 million), Texas (4.14 million), Florida (3.66 million), New Jersey (1.84 million), and Illinois (1.76 million).

2eb916ba9d60bb0cac641a9c103aa587903638da.translatedText: Shanghai enters its hottest day in 140 years The temperature in Shanghai, which is suffering from high fever, hit a record high on the 26th. At 13:36, the highest temperature in Shanghai reached 40.6℃...

7b6a94f0b485aa809ede01b8f867e638e3c48af1.sourceText: 当天也是上海今年7月出现的第20个高温日，这一数值亦打破了2003年和2007年7月19个高温日的纪录，成近30年来上海最热的7月。
7b6a94f0b485aa809ede01b8f867e638e3c48af1.translatedText: That day was also the 20th high temperature day in Shanghai in July this year. This value also broke the record of 19 high temperature days in July 2003 and 2007, making it the hottest July in Shanghai in the past 30 years.

89a1efd42d61a97e127a72670bf8e5c3380d3c9c.sourceText: 上海中心气象台今天一早发出高温橙色预警，烈日的曝晒之下，气温节节快速飙升，11点15分发出今年第2次高温红色预警，也是有示警制度以来的第三次高温”红牌”。
89a1efd42d61a97e127a72670bf8e5c3380d3c9c.translatedText: The Shanghai Central Meteorological Observatory issued an orange warning for high temperatures this morning. Under the scorching sun, the temperature soared rapidly. At 11:15, it issued the second red warning for high temperatures this year. It was also the third high temperature "red card" since the warning system was established.

ec93b52c568524c36a519e47f81fb3c6a4fa3051.sourceText: 根据上海中心气象台的发布的最新信息，到13时36分，上海气温的标准监测点徐家汇气温高达40.6℃，这是徐家汇站有气象记录以来最高气温的历史极值，而当天最高温仍有上升的趋势。
ec93b52c568524c36a519e47f81fb3c6a4fa3051.translatedText: According to the latest information released by the Shanghai Central Meteorological Observatory, as of 13:36, the temperature at Xujiahui, the standard monitoring point for temperature in Shanghai, was as high as 40.6°C. This is the historical extreme value of the highest temperature since Xujiahui station has meteorological records, and the highest temperature that day is still on the rise.

a3f21fe2fcefdf7443dafb48ef25417fb0e60846.sourceText: 五年间561名儿童死于枪下 控枪任重道远 《亚省时报》 根据联邦调查局现有的最新《统一犯罪报告》，从2006年到2010年，全美561名12岁以下的少年儿童死于枪击。每年死亡数字相当接近：2006年120名，2007年115 名，2008年116名，2009年114名，2010年96名。但FBI的数字不包括当局裁定为事故遭枪击死亡的儿童数字。 总统奥巴马在安抚康州纽敦镇受害者家人时说，美国不能接受儿童死于这种暴力的情况。但是，数百名儿童因为有意或偶然的枪击而死亡，显示这种情况普遍存在。 约翰霍普金斯枪支政策研究中心主任韦伯斯特说，实际上儿童更有可能在家或街头死于枪击。他们到了学校更为安全。康州纽敦镇惨案之前，美联社分析61例儿童死亡没有一例是发生在学校里。 根据维基百科的世界各国拥枪排行榜，美国独占鳌头，每百人有88.8把枪，美国平民拥有的枪支总量多达2.83亿支，每年新枪销量达450万支。 自12月14日康州校园枪杀案后，奥巴马责成副总统拜登牵头跨部门工作组，下月提出综合考虑法律、教育、心理健康等因素的控枪对策。有人认为，总统很可能作出收缴民间枪支的决定。传言一出，许多民众蜂拥购枪，很多枪支销售商和拥枪人士表示坚决不会让政府没收枪支。 在美国枪械保有量最大的佛罗里达州，持枪许可证数量本周再创新高，在这个大约1900万居民的州，持枪证数量超过100万。 马盖普军事工业公司主管皮特布劳内尔在一个枪械互联网论坛上说，过去72小时，这家全球最大枪械生产企业的塑料弹匣需求量为过去3年半总和。 登记在册的合法拥有手枪的纽约州居民约几百万人，然而合法拥有半自动突击步枪的居民却没有准确的数字，因为法律并不要这些购买者进行登记。而半自动突击步枪在纽约州合法销售已近30年，许多打猎者、枪支收藏者家中都会备有几把这样的手枪。 控枪一直是全美社会一大敏感议题，民意呈现巨大分歧，而反对一方也颇具影响力。民主党的总统奥巴马自上任以来并未在控枪方面着力推动新举措或取得任何实质成果。康州枪杀案可以说是个契机，奥巴马能否在这方面比他的民主党前辈总统做得更多？还是个未知之数。
a3f21fe2fcefdf7443dafb48ef25417fb0e60846.translatedText: 561 children have been killed by guns in five years. There is a long way to go to control guns. "Alberta Times" According to the FBI's most recent Uniform Crime Report, from 2006 to 2010, 561 children under the age of 12 were killed by gunshots in the United States. The numbers of deaths each year are quite similar: 120 in 2006, 115 in 2007, 116 in 2008, 114 in 2009 and 96 in 2010. But the FBI figures do not include the number of children who authorities determined were shot dead in accidents. President Obama comforted the families of the victims in Newtown, Conn., and said the United States cannot accept the death of children from such violence. But hundreds of children have died as a result of intentional or accidental shootings, showing how widespread the situation is. Webster, director of the Johns Hopkins Center for Gun Policy Research, said children are actually more likely to be killed by gunshots at home or on the streets. They are safer at school. Before the massacre in Newtown, Connecticut, the Associated Press analyzed 61 child deaths, none of which occurred in schools. According to Wikipedia's gun ownership rankings of countries around the world, the United States leads the way, with 88.8 guns per 100 people. The total number of guns owned by American civilians reaches 283 million, and new gun sales reach 4.5 million every year. After the Connecticut school shooting on December 14, Obama tasked Vice President Biden to lead an interagency working group to propose gun control countermeasures next month that comprehensively consider legal, educational, mental health and other factors. Some people believe that the president is likely to make a decision to confiscate private firearms. As soon as the rumors came out, many people rushed to buy guns, and many gun sellers and gun advocates expressed their determination not to let the government confiscate guns. In Florida, which has the largest number of firearms in the United States, the number of gun licenses reached a new high this week. In this state of about 19 million residents, the number of gun licenses exceeded 1 million. Pete Brownell, director of Magap Military Industries, told a firearms Internet forum that the demand for plastic magazines from the world's largest firearms manufacturer in the past 72 hours was as much as the total demand for plastic magazines in the past three and a half years. There are approximately several million registered New York State residents who legally own handguns, but there is no accurate number of residents who legally own semi-automatic assault rifles because the law does not require these buyers to register. Semi-automatic assault rifles have been legally sold in New York State for nearly 30 years, and many hunters and gun collectors have several such pistols at home. Gun control has always been a sensitive issue in American society. There are huge differences in public opinion, and the opposing side is also quite influential. Democratic President Obama has not pushed for new measures or achieved any substantial results on gun control since taking office. The Connecticut shooting can be said to be an opportunity. Can Obama do more in this regard than his Democratic predecessors? Still an unknown number.

af4fe5dc30c5c624a29e15e2400ba32299e953b6.translatedText: Voters refused to increase taxes and Proposition 204 failed (Alberta Times) Voters in this state rejected Proposition 204, which made the temporary sales tax of 1% a permanent tax...

e01dbaeef02d954c83fca2209eb1b88ab7b44d28.sourceText: 选民拒绝再加税 204提案失败 （亚省时报） 本州选民拒绝204提案，也就是将临时销售税1%设为永久性税收提案。 选民们在2010年投票通过州府临时增加1%销售税，所得款项用来增加教育、公路和社会发展项目。临时增税法至2013年年中到期。 支持者说，加税是为立法机关所忽视的优先事项提供资金，而反对者说，加税没必要，只是增加纳税人负担，对经济复苏没有帮助。 另一个不获通过的提案是所谓的”前二名”选举，提案批准将意味着改变本州的选举现状，撤销初选。每个党可推举两名候选人参加选举，代替现在的各党初选后，推举一名候选人。支持者称，该提案将产生更多跨党派候选人，批评者则说，这将削弱政党影响力。
e01dbaeef02d954c83fca2209eb1b88ab7b44d28.translatedText: Voters refused to increase taxes and Proposition 204 failed (Alberta Times) Voters in this state rejected Proposition 204, which made the temporary sales tax of 1% a permanent tax. Voters approved a temporary 1% sales tax increase in 2010, with the proceeds used to increase education, highways and social development projects. The temporary tax increase law expires in mid-2013. Supporters say the tax increases fund priorities that the Legislature has neglected, while opponents say the tax increases are unnecessary and only increase the burden on taxpayers and do not help the economic recovery. Another proposal that failed was the so-called "top two" election. Approval of the proposal would mean changing the state's electoral status quo and canceling the primary election. Each party can nominate two candidates to participate in the election, instead of nominating one candidate after the current primaries of each party. Supporters said the proposal would create more bipartisan candidates, while critics said it would weaken political parties.

e90e0578e470c52b82e2f7dac5a4152b0b75ebb7.sourceText: 全美僑界支持馬英九吳敦義大會師活動8月27日舉行（圖） （亞省時報） 在8月27日一場盛大的全美僑界支持馬英九吳敦義大會師活動，號召來自美國各地及加拿大地區共四十多個馬吳後援會組織齊聚西雅圖參與造勢，中國國民黨副秘書長林德瑞特別飛到美國擔任授旗官，現場國旗黨旗飛舞，場面熱烈感人，堪稱是海外代表擴及範圍最廣的一場海外造勢活動。 亞利桑那直屬分部所組成的亞利桑那州馬吳後援會由常委王瑋(王亭)領軍，包括朱家佑，蔡昌，鄧凱蒂，鄧凱莉，谷音等多位團員參加，同時特別帶了印有中華民國國旗的後援會橫幅，相當亮眼。 大會師在播放競選主題影片中展開，主持人高亢的口號隨即把現場氣氛炒熱，「 團結才有力量，凝聚就有希望」，國民黨副秘書長林德瑞對現場這群來自北美地區，40多個後援會的近兩百位支持馬吳的海外鄉親代表表達了深切期許，大家回台助選，更要投下神聖一票，同時也為各地馬吳後援會負責人授旗。 隨後由谷音，王瑋(王亭)常委更率全體後援會高唱愛國歌曲，瞬間激起眾人愛國熱情。許多僑界代表紛紛上台表達團結重要性，期盼回到各僑居地後將選舉的熱情傳送給每一個關心台灣熱愛中華民國的僑胞。
e90e0578e470c52b82e2f7dac5a4152b0b75ebb7.translatedText: The National Overseas Chinese Community Supports Ma Ying-jeou and Wu Dunyi General Assembly event was held on August 27 (photo) (Alberta Times) On August 27, a grand general meeting of the overseas Chinese community across the United States to support Ma Ying-jeou and Wu Dunyi called on more than 40 Ma Ying-jeou support organizations from all over the United States and Canada to gather in Seattle to participate in the campaign. Lin Derui, deputy secretary-general of the Chinese Kuomintang, flew to the United States to serve as the flag presenter. The national flag and party flags were flying at the scene. The scene was warm and touching. It can be said to be an overseas campaign with the widest scope of overseas representatives. The Arizona Ma-Wu Support Association, which is directly under the Arizona branch, is led by standing committee member Wang Wei (Wang Ting), and includes Zhu Jiayou, Cai Chang, Deng Kaiyi, Deng Kaili, Gu Yin and many other members. At the same time, they brought a banner with the national flag of the Republic of China, which was quite eye-catching. The grandmaster started playing the campaign-themed video, and the host's high-pitched slogan immediately heated up the atmosphere. "Unity brings strength, and unity brings hope." Lin Derui, deputy secretary-general of the Kuomintang, expressed his deep expectations to the nearly 200 overseas representatives of more than 40 support associations from North America who support Ma Wu. Everyone returned to Taiwan to support the election, and they must cast a sacred vote. At the same time, they also presented flags to the heads of Ma Wu support associations in various places. Later, Gu Yin and Wang Wei (Wang Ting), members of the Standing Committee, led the entire support group to sing patriotic songs, which instantly aroused everyone's patriotic enthusiasm. Many representatives of the overseas Chinese community took to the stage to express the importance of unity, hoping to convey their enthusiasm for the election to every overseas Chinese who cares about Taiwan and loves the Republic of China when they return to their respective places of residence.

This year's 100 figures are divided into five groups: Giant Group, Leader Group, Artist Group, Pioneer Group and Idol Group. 1d85d96ed3beece8d78c27086ba80d2f958c3b99.translatedText: > American Time Magazine's list of the 100 most influential people in 2013 and their introduction

4d71f7133b58a6dd5d837b1d2e0e6c0932460bc4.sourceText: 杰斯(Jay-Z)：42岁，说唱乐手兼企业家
4d71f7133b58a6dd5d837b1d2e0e6c0932460bc4.translatedText: Ja y-Z): 42 years old, rapper and entrepreneur

36998a6f783c6c8b267ed6f02032512f198018e2.sourceText: 他诠释了土生土长纽约人的典型风格：生于大众人家，长于寻常街巷，怀揣梦想而不堕，追求突破而不息。他以自己的经历，证明了”美国梦”的活力。
36998a6f783c6c8b267ed6f02032512f198018e2.translatedText: He interprets the typical style of a native New Yorker: born in a popular family, raised in ordinary streets, carrying dreams without giving up, and pursuing breakthroughs endlessly. He used his own experience to prove the vitality of the "American Dream".

0c64198c3892670cf1207f7ee9a8ccbf55e6c282.sourceText: 瓦莱丽-贾勒特(Valerie Jarrett)：56岁，奥巴马总统顾问
0c64198c3892670cf1207f7ee9a8ccbf55e6c282.translatedText: Valerie Jarrett: 56 years old, advisor to President Obama

8f6123a39980a52f1701be4f72f8181184e5d740.sourceText: 她既是奥巴马总统好友，又是其可信赖的战略顾问。善于在巨大压力下综合各方面情况开展工作，具备坚定信念与胆魄，最突出的品质是忠诚。
8f6123a39980a52f1701be4f72f8181184e5d740.translatedText: She is not only a good friend of President Obama, but also his trusted strategic advisor. He is good at working under great pressure and comprehensively integrates all aspects of the situation, and has firm belief and courage. The most outstanding quality is loyalty.

5b67f1d1302d6f5da1470f3f63b0ced54846b68a.sourceText: 权五铉(Oh-Hyun Kwon)：60岁，韩国三星电子首席执行官
5b67f1d1302d6f5da1470f3f63b0ced54846b68a.translatedText: Oh-Hyun Kwon: 60 years old, CEO of Samsung Electronics, South Korea

e9608ede74ffea9e1bf4dddfd1dbc7c3c96793ac.sourceText: 产品设计、市场营销、供应链管理是消费电子产品赖以成功的三大要素，而他领导的团队很好地把握了这些要素。他治下推出的Galax系列产品，更是将三星送进了世界电子巨头行列。
e9608ede74ffea9e1bf4dddfd1dbc7c3c96793ac.translatedText: Product design, marketing, and supply chain management are the three major elements for the success of consumer electronics products, and the team he leads has mastered these elements well. The Galaxy series of products launched under his leadership put Samsung into the ranks of the world's electronics giants.

080f27182c71902712bf9396ac82af88b0433b12.sourceText: 艾龙-马斯科(Elon Musk)：41岁，美国太空探索科技公司SpaceX和电动汽车公司Tesla的创始人
080f27182c71902712bf9396ac82af88b0433b12.translatedText: Elon Musk: 41 years old, founder of the American space exploration technology company SpaceX and the electric car company Tesla

97cee8f0179345369e3e921ed226e45df9af9288.sourceText: 他的私营太空探索科技为太空探索打开了新视界，将过去人们认为不可能的事付诸实践。他具备同时预见许多事物的超常眼光。
97cee8f0179345369e3e921ed226e45df9af9288.translatedText: His private space exploration technology has opened up new horizons for space exploration and put into practice what people thought was impossible in the past. He had the extraordinary ability to foresee many things at the same time.

b31318b7e20d022b9cc02a6aeaf9251c4e70c657.sourceText: 斯库特-布劳恩(Scooter Braun)31岁，经纪人

d16e2b4ba21790e362ce8e58b02f295a45b97260.sourceText: 他能看到常人所看不到的东西，具有发现人才的独到眼光和做成生意的深刻悟性。他是贾斯汀 比伯、”鸟叔”朴载相等娱乐巨星的经纪人。
d16e2b4ba21790e362ce8e58b02f295a45b97260.translatedText: He can see things that ordinary people cannot, and has a unique vision for discovering talents and a profound understanding of doing business. He is the agent of entertainment superstars such as Justin Bieber and Park Jae-hyang.

32f096e941cc3f5a83d1682da498e88de77f026b.sourceText: 凯文-塞特罗姆(Kevin Systrom)：29岁，图片社交网站Instagram联合创始人
32f096e941cc3f5a83d1682da498e88de77f026b.translatedText: Kevin Systrom: 29 years old, co-founder of the photo social network Instagram

86ed9cc4f7420d86a1e316f078db6cf9311dc62a.sourceText: 他创立的图片社交网络平台精确诠释了”一图胜千言”的涵义，永久改变了网络社交的方式。Instagram如今已拥有1亿注册用户，共分享了50亿张照片。
86ed9cc4f7420d86a1e316f078db6cf9311dc62a.translatedText: The photo social network platform he founded accurately interpreted the meaning of "a picture is worth a thousand words" and forever changed the way of social networking on the Internet. Instagram now has 100 million registered users, with a total of 5 billion photos shared.

10a0a8d40feb8b954866e62da7d209b198751498.sourceText: 迈克-柯尔(Michael Kors)：53岁，时装设计师
10a0a8d40feb8b954866e62da7d209b198751498.translatedText: Michael Kors: 53 years old, fashion designer

86237892f4518803ec747d399ada051f43bf19ea.sourceText: 他将爱、生活与文化融汇于时装设计。他继承了美国运动装的精髓并将其推向未来，转化为国际流行元素。
86237892f4518803ec747d399ada051f43bf19ea.translatedText: He integrates love, life and culture into fashion design. He inherited the essence of American sportswear and pushed it into the future, transforming it into an internationally popular element.

a94c9a2981d9c7c887345f6f8e05fc97d4d1aff4.sourceText: 帕拉尼亚潘-齐丹巴南(Palaniappan Chidambaram)：67岁，印度财政部长
a94c9a2981d9c7c887345f6f8e05fc97d4d1aff4.translatedText: Palaniappan Chidambaram: 67 years old, Finance Minister of India

6a10ec89aa24264fc2ef3b32500e9fea0afd9a5e.sourceText: 在拖沓、糊涂的印度政界风气中，他是一个主动细节、兢兢业业又善于做成事情的官员。但他也有傲慢的脾气，以致挫伤不少同僚，令政府团结出现问题。
6a10ec89aa24264fc2ef3b32500e9fea0afd9a5e.translatedText: In the procrastinating and confused Indian political atmosphere, he is an official who is proactive in details, conscientious and good at getting things done. But he also has an arrogant temper, which has frustrated many colleagues and caused problems in government unity.

06d9e38ec6f152ca42caa371b57712028649e1e2.sourceText: 任正非：69岁，中国华为电子创始人兼首席执行官
06d9e38ec6f152ca42caa371b57712028649e1e2.translatedText: Ren Zhengfei: 69 years old, founder and CEO of Huawei Electronics in China

12810fe9f22e9fe506dc7e78598c0967a7161a86.sourceText: 他是世界上最富争议的企业家：在国内业界，他是可与国际同行业一比高下的通信巨头的掌门人；在国外批评者眼中，他的公司是潜在的安全威胁。有人评说：”他的神秘如同他的不凡。”
12810fe9f22e9fe506dc7e78598c0967a7161a86.translatedText: He is the most controversial entrepreneur in the world: in the domestic industry, he is the head of a communications giant that can compete with international peers; in the eyes of foreign critics, his company is a potential security threat. Someone commented: "He is as mysterious as he is extraordinary."

12cc02456e75c06bbcf353c661d665eefa189fe6.sourceText: 泰德-沙兰多(Ted Sarandos)：48岁，全球知名视频网站Netflix首席内容官
12cc02456e75c06bbcf353c661d665eefa189fe6.translatedText: > Ted Sarandos: 48 years old, chief content officer of Netflix, a world-renowned video website

df8821cb782ee85f3ff8e357f4aae0f6cd7300a9.sourceText: 他参与创建了娱乐业的未来。他影响了许多年轻艺术家，使他们有机会将自己的作品呈现到网上。
df8821cb782ee85f3ff8e357f4aae0f6cd7300a9.translatedText: He participated in creating the future of the entertainment industry. He has influenced many young artists, giving them the opportunity to present their work online.

cee8d25b4deb6e28340ab498d1d3632f218857bb.sourceText: 吉娜-莱赫特(Gina Rinehart)：59岁，铁矿业主、澳大利亚女首富
cee8d25b4deb6e28340ab498d1d3632f218857bb.translatedText: Gina Rinehart: 59 years old, iron ore owner, Australia's richest woman

f4cd5b30fb209e8d5c8c77a3c5b9bc24982dfca9.sourceText: 她有一句名言：美即铁矿。她也放言：矿业将使资源丰富的澳大利亚免于崩溃。自1992年从父亲那里继承产业后，其财富已不断翻番。
f4cd5b30fb209e8d5c8c77a3c5b9bc24982dfca9.translatedText: She has a famous saying: Beauty is iron ore. She also said that mining will save resource-rich Australia from collapse. Since inheriting the property from his father in 1992, his wealth has continuously doubled.

5a3fed1822ae2ae3c589389f1a703bb1cb2649d9.sourceText: 马库斯-佩尔森(Markus Persson)和珍斯-伯根斯坦(Jens Bergensten)：均33岁，《挖矿争霸》(MineCraft)游戏开发者
5a3fed1822ae2ae3c589389f1a703bb1cb2649d9.translatedText: Markus Persson and Jens Bergensten: both 33 years old, developers of the game "MineCraft"

121fdef48ccad619aa8832d09048acb8ee478bd3.sourceText: 他们开发的这款网络游戏令人全然沉浸其中，成为一个积极学习和相互发现的社区。
121fdef48ccad619aa8832d09048acb8ee478bd3.translatedText: The online game they developed is completely immersive and becomes a community of active learning and mutual discovery.

b9af937e69376204f6c8d8f5ec72cda19ea478ac.sourceText: 伊戈尔-谢欣(Igor Sechin)：52岁，俄罗斯石油公司董事长
b9af937e69376204f6c8d8f5ec72cda19ea478ac.translatedText: Igor Sechin: 52 years old, chairman of Rosneft

2dd2dbfd1bc2154221aaba448e2c59d7736ac26b.sourceText: 他是俄罗斯总统普京圈内的”扩张主义者”。这个曾经的克格勃官员领导俄统治集团中”人民力量”派别，其影响力无人可与匹敌。
2dd2dbfd1bc2154221aaba448e2c59d7736ac26b.translatedText: He is an "expansionist" in Russian President Vladimir Putin's circle. This former KGB officer leads the "People Power" faction of the Russian ruling group, and his influence is unrivaled.

e829bc219a25fa5676008a843f53918f9ee9deba.sourceText: 柳井正(Tadashi Yanai)：64岁，日本服装品牌优衣库(Uniqlo)首席执行官
e829bc219a25fa5676008a843f53918f9ee9deba.translatedText: Tadashi Yanai: 64 years old, CEO of Japanese clothing brand Uniqlo

57fae01f04928fc380d130d77ad651844402efc4.sourceText: 他是一个鼓舞人心的引领者，他放手让设计师尽显艺术个性，对优质的产品和合理的价格孜孜以求。
57fae01f04928fc380d130d77ad651844402efc4.translatedText: He is an inspiring leader. He lets designers show their artistic personality and pursues high-quality products and reasonable prices.

19cb01db4024bcca15780d9fb0c2fb73d3a4b2e8.sourceText: 萨姆-亚根(Sam Yagan)：36岁，全球最大交友网站首席执行官
19cb01db4024bcca15780d9fb0c2fb73d3a4b2e8.translatedText: Sam Yagan: 36 years old, CEO of the world's largest dating website

c544886baa9a2023268957c14ec2ea75a1f134cd.sourceText: 他的名言是：你给我们信息，我们给你约会。
c544886baa9a2023268957c14ec2ea75a1f134cd.translatedText: His famous saying is: You give us information, and we give you dates.

f3ff116b042dac7d4044d3ff627028f8838ffed6.sourceText: 桑德-莱姆斯(Shonda Rhimes)：43岁，编剧

08fa77a2081730a387bccdac6880e99482f30d8e.sourceText: 她是我们这个时代的故事讲述者。她以她的故事，告诉我们全部关于人类的失败与恐惧、孤独与死亡、胜利与喜悦。
08fa77a2081730a387bccdac6880e99482f30d8e.translatedText: She is a storyteller of our time. With her story, she tells us all about human failure and fear, loneliness and death, victory and joy.

b198dea79fac2d360580e8a4daa69574457fd3b8.sourceText: 黎布朗-詹姆斯(LeBron James)：NBA球星

91b122bf484df1efba6c9364031882ae9ec81482.sourceText: 他从不懈怠。只要在球场上，不管比分如何，他总是全力以赴。
91b122bf484df1efba6c9364031882ae9ec81482.translatedText: He never slacks off. As long as he is on the court, no matter what the score is, he always gives his best.

25e9e30482e732a14ff33e10135be4b7b3a843df.sourceText: 大卫-艾因霍恩(David Einhorn)：44岁，对冲基金绿光资本(Greenlight Capital)基金董事长
25e9e30482e732a14ff33e10135be4b7b3a843df.translatedText: David Einhorn: 44 years old, chairman of the hedge fund Greenlight Capital

5a788fa93c1fe65700842408b24b3cc963d45d67.sourceText: 他善于短期思维、快速行动。
5a788fa93c1fe65700842408b24b3cc963d45d67.translatedText: He is good at short-term thinking and quick action.

ae470ea4766f769e092ae94963e506d5d482be0a.sourceText: 马格努斯-卡尔森(Magnus Carlsen)：22岁，挪威国际象棋神童
ae470ea4766f769e092ae94963e506d5d482be0a.translatedText: Magnus Carlsen: 22 years old, Norwegian chess prodigy

b53ca4846a8eee33e763ccfc5f4bcc6ccf2e2af1.sourceText: 他的直觉力诠释了象棋的神秘性，他的魅力和独立与他的才能同样突出。
b53ca4846a8eee33e763ccfc5f4bcc6ccf2e2af1.translatedText: His intuition interprets the mystery of chess, and his charm and independence are as outstanding as his talent.

3ee90dc810da0370f6c28086cf92b1560cdd88c1.sourceText: 雪莉-桑德伯格(Sheryl Sandberg)：43岁，知名社交网站Facebook首席运营官
3ee90dc810da0370f6c28086cf92b1560cdd88c1.translatedText: Sheryl Sandberg: 43 years old, chief operating officer of Facebook, a well-known social networking site

785d72534f410bc5f05eb14cd4cba843dede058f.sourceText: 她反对一切源于内心或设于外部的男女不平等。她最为激进的看法是：如果一个女人想要孩子，她最重要的事业抉择也就是选择一个什么样的伴侣；如果男方想要孩子，他尽可以自己抚养孩子。
785d72534f410bc5f05eb14cd4cba843dede058f.translatedText: She opposes all inequality between men and women that originates from within or is external. Her most radical view is: if a woman wants to have children, her most important career decision is to choose a partner; if a man wants to have children, he can raise the children by himself.

0e22b42e644891d0ce378bc27520ab341eb6dd28.sourceText: 兰德-保罗(Rand Paul)：50岁，美国参议员
0e22b42e644891d0ce378bc27520ab341eb6dd28.translatedText: Rand Paul: 50 years old, U.S. Senator

05f39428efcd428140764ec81375f83ac43b71bb.sourceText: 他发出了理性的声音，唤醒公众行动起来重建美国的繁荣，并为后代保全自由。
05f39428efcd428140764ec81375f83ac43b71bb.translatedText: He has issued a voice of reason, awakening the public to take action to rebuild American prosperity and preserve freedom for future generations.

b282f3306475aa06e158662af84a69d0c1e573da.sourceText: 阿基诺三世(Noynoy Aquino)：53岁，菲律宾总统
b282f3306475aa06e158662af84a69d0c1e573da.translatedText: >Noynoy Aquino III (Noynoy Aquino): 53 years old, President of the Philippines

a97e3a0e6780c6e210cf07d6d6c0d1f4f3fbff43.sourceText: 他在地区问题上与中国政府的对抗所产生的长远影响，至今还无从获知。
a97e3a0e6780c6e210cf07d6d6c0d1f4f3fbff43.translatedText: The long-term impact of his confrontation with the Chinese government on regional issues is still unknown.

749f8ad7c789d138c60c402bc876aa228de35997.sourceText: 巴拉克-奥巴马(Barack Obama)：51岁，美国总统
749f8ad7c789d138c60c402bc876aa228de35997.translatedText: Barack Obama: 51 years old, President of the United States

80b8b8172e5b75328240d2d891a69cc0e190823c.sourceText: 他的当选是美国梦实现的一个例证。如今他正致力于梦想的拓展：在国内创建更大的繁荣，在海外提升本国竞争力。
80b8b8172e5b75328240d2d891a69cc0e190823c.translatedText: His election is an example of the realization of the American dream. Now he is working on expanding his dream: creating greater prosperity at home and improving the country's competitiveness overseas.

44fbfe46e78dc97922da3ab5bf2806116242255b.sourceText: 克里斯-克里斯蒂(Chris Christie)：50岁，新泽西州州长
44fbfe46e78dc97922da3ab5bf2806116242255b.translatedText: Chris Christie: 50 years old, Governor of New Jersey

2abe4603f550060a1eb09dd51bb8b9a5bea431d3.sourceText: 哈桑-谢赫-默罕默德(Hassan Sheik Mohamud)：57岁，索马里总统
2abe4603f550060a1eb09dd51bb8b9a5bea431d3.translatedText: Hassan Sheik Mohamud: 57 years old, President of Somalia

26888161c98429cb656baef17eaa3ebdce319de6.sourceText: 他是20年来索马里首位民选总统，是这个饱受战乱的国家摆脱冲突走向稳定和繁荣的象征。
26888161c98429cb656baef17eaa3ebdce319de6.translatedText: He is the first democratically elected president of Somalia in 20 years, and is a symbol of this war-torn country's transition from conflict to stability and prosperity.

e9b7e9900aaf157b2b3372b94a8ffa9f6a4494cf.sourceText: 约翰-布伦南(John Brennan)：57岁，美国中央情报局局长
e9b7e9900aaf157b2b3372b94a8ffa9f6a4494cf.translatedText: John Brennan: 57 years old, Director of the CIA

68a523cbbbf9d6e788d176e9d23a5bd116613bb0.sourceText: 他深受总统信赖，他知道中央情报局能够以及应该做的事情，他将坚定的保卫国家。
68a523cbbbf9d6e788d176e9d23a5bd116613bb0.translatedText: He is deeply trusted by the president. He knows what the CIA can and should do, and he will firmly defend the country.

32b652d4dbc4a26dba34ce11e11a5590e075c786.sourceText: 朴槿惠(Park Geun-hye)：61岁，韩国总统
32b652d4dbc4a26dba34ce11e11a5590e075c786.translatedText: Park Geun-hye: 61 years old, President of South Korea

d9979cb7bba18a637f86d0e8bf4659e774e6cb39.sourceText: 她面临着考验是：将一个希望和幸福的时代带给韩国人民，促进朝鲜半岛的稳定与繁荣。
d9979cb7bba18a637f86d0e8bf4659e774e6cb39.translatedText: The test she faces is: bringing an era of hope and happiness to the South Korean people and promoting stability and prosperity on the Korean Peninsula.

44ae0df92bbdd89719c89659fdd8ee5b6884eeb6.sourceText: 亚伊尔-拉皮德(Yair Lapid)：49岁，以色列财政部长
44ae0df92bbdd89719c89659fdd8ee5b6884eeb6.translatedText: Yair Lapid: 49 years old, Israel’s Finance Minister

59f18332407563be74fc5b3a7a4df21a7ea7a772.sourceText: 他是以色列下届政府总理的有力竞争者
59f18332407563be74fc5b3a7a4df21a7ea7a772.translatedText: He is a strong contender for the next prime minister of Israel’s government

9474109bcc329ce7d25ca71a7608c3a4a08c3a3f.sourceText: 韦恩-拉皮埃尔(Wayne LaPierre)：63岁，美国全国步枪协会主席
9474109bcc329ce7d25ca71a7608c3a4a08c3a3f.translatedText: Wayne Lapid LaPierre): 63 years old, Chairman of the National Rifle Association of the United States

33491d4658c3f4b079de6105d12dacb3585c906a.sourceText: 他的声音是响彻世界的枪声
33491d4658c3f4b079de6105d12dacb3585c906a.translatedText: His voice is the sound of guns ringing around the world

74b08d801a8322c009e7a41ad841566672679e1d.sourceText: 卡玛拉-哈里斯(Kamala Harris)：48岁，美国总检察长
74b08d801a8322c009e7a41ad841566672679e1d.translatedText: Kamala Harris: 48 years old, Attorney General of the United States

3158f5e91e0cf563037dfb7749362721be4a0aef.sourceText: 在美国民权运动的氛围中长大的她，如今将引领人们为平等而奋斗。
3158f5e91e0cf563037dfb7749362721be4a0aef.translatedText: Having grown up in the atmosphere of the American civil rights movement, she will now lead people in the fight for equality.

f8c8c901943aae4b194ef71b59a7ec31f90762af.sourceText: 法士拉-葛兰(Fethullah Gulen)，71岁，土耳其教育家、伊斯兰教学者
f8c8c901943aae4b194ef71b59a7ec31f90762af.translatedText: Fethullah Gulen, 71 years old, Turkish educator and Islamic scholar

6f210efe64fd27d9282d81faa963d13cbe09c5b9.sourceText: 他是当今世界最受人关注的宗教领袖之一，他所倡导的容忍精神为他赢得了信徒。
6f210efe64fd27d9282d81faa963d13cbe09c5b9.translatedText: He is one of the most watched religious leaders in the world today. The spirit of tolerance he advocates has won him followers.

37e9830ed92249d9b134022e34afe287748e9ac1.sourceText: 习近平：59岁，中国国家主席
37e9830ed92249d9b134022e34afe287748e9ac1.translatedText: Xi Jinping: 59 years old, President of China

13462bdc3ac8067c41df41480fc97f5f1ffe35d6.sourceText: 他是中国新一轮革新的中心人物。在”文化大革命”中下放农村的7年间，他经历了生活的坎坷。他深信，这一代人的苦难给了他们直面挑战的力量，必将能够带领中国走向成功。
13462bdc3ac8067c41df41480fc97f5f1ffe35d6.translatedText: He is the central figure in China's new round of innovation. During the seven years when he was transferred to the countryside during the "Cultural Revolution", he experienced the ups and downs of life. He firmly believes that the suffering of this generation has given them the strength to face challenges head-on and will surely lead China to success.

868d4c5d47d37589018eb7a77dcc4d0039b26467.sourceText: 在外交政策上，他面临着的问题是：中美两个同样伟大但存在竞争的国家，能否化冲突为合作？而这个问题的答案，将决定世界的未来。
868d4c5d47d37589018eb7a77dcc4d0039b26467.translatedText: In terms of foreign policy, the question he faces is: Can China and the United States, two equally great but competing countries, turn conflict into cooperation? The answer to this question will determine the future of the world.

28dd586ca563f1abc2e071c78ef7bc1411e24dbd.sourceText: 维尔弗雷-迪黑苏斯(Wilfredo De Jes鷖)：48岁，牧师
28dd586ca563f1abc2e071c78ef7bc1411e24dbd.translatedText: > Wilfredo De Jesús: 48 years old, pastor

71f9ebfe1f9d5193bd3dda33285f1021f5fc5b04.sourceText: 汤姆-考博(Tom Coburn)：65岁，美国参议员
71f9ebfe1f9d5193bd3dda33285f1021f5fc5b04.translatedText: Tom Coburn: 65 years old, U.S. Senator

d4fc0e378c3465f541e53392c9dd4a02da2db940.sourceText: 他直抒胸臆、坚持原则，忠实于他的选民。
d4fc0e378c3465f541e53392c9dd4a02da2db940.translatedText: He speaks his mind, adheres to principles, and is loyal to his constituents.

9df2582ab8f8ebbbde5042feeb324782f5a870b3.sourceText: 金正恩(Kim Jong Un)：30岁，朝鲜最高领导人
9df2582ab8f8ebbbde5042feeb324782f5a870b3.translatedText: Kim Jong Un: 30 years old, the supreme leader of North Korea

9364bb1e5a55a95690b375f1d60921b2bb96960f.sourceText: 他是世界上最年轻的国家领导人
9364bb1e5a55a95690b375f1d60921b2bb96960f.translatedText: He is the youngest national leader in the world

78423916f8ea2af22be7c48e79b8a167159bb1f0.sourceText: 阿卜杜拉-奥贾兰(Abdullah Ocalan)：65岁，土耳其库尔德工人党领袖
78423916f8ea2af22be7c48e79b8a167159bb1f0.translatedText: Abdullah Ocalan Ocalan): 65 years old, leader of Turkey's PKK

6a1dfb112a474925ebf65fb2eefb11df06fbe513.sourceText: 恩里克-培尼亚-涅托(Enrique Pe?a Nieto)：46岁，墨西哥总统
6a1dfb112a474925ebf65fb2eefb11df06fbe513.translatedText: Enrique Peña Nieto: 46 years old, President of Mexico

3d0fda6b9f45ecc66902fcaff92486394c162241.sourceText: 他融合了里根的魅力、奥巴马的智力和克林顿的政治手腕。他是个值得关注的领导人。
3d0fda6b9f45ecc66902fcaff92486394c162241.translatedText: He combines Reagan's charm, Obama's intelligence and Clinton's political skills. He is a leader to watch.

befdb8fe0def3dcb5139c38237ffe9c0300fba0c.sourceText: 艾琳娜-卡根(Elena Kagan)：52岁，美国最高法院法官
befdb8fe0def3dcb5139c38237ffe9c0300fba0c.translatedText: Elena Kagan: 52 years old, U.S. Supreme Court Justice

de281f281f77cf4dc861072bf12ff1a72913e418.sourceText: 她已证明自己是个深刻的法律思想者。她也是个以轻松、直接风格著称的杰出沟通者。
de281f281f77cf4dc861072bf12ff1a72913e418.translatedText: She has proven herself to be a profound legal thinker. She is also an outstanding communicator known for her relaxed, direct style.

8525cd52df6f6f6906c6bd4d394135f854f58683.sourceText: 乔-拜登(Joe Biden)：70岁，美国副总统
8525cd52df6f6f6906c6bd4d394135f854f58683.translatedText: Joe Biden: 70 years old, Vice President of the United States

4f10f8bfb34e8972dc247d63da19f4a10fe50c72.sourceText: 他待人友善、尊重，跟人谈话诚恳、坦率，这使他善于团结众人解决问题。
4f10f8bfb34e8972dc247d63da19f4a10fe50c72.translatedText: > He treats people with kindness and respect, and talks with people sincerely and frankly, which makes him good at uniting people to solve problems.

50e72ea357da8871bab97d81e72d20e5f7006425.sourceText: 苏珊娜-马汀内兹(Susana Martinez)：53岁，新墨西哥州州长
50e72ea357da8871bab97d81e72d20e5f7006425.translatedText: > Susana Martinez: 53 years old, Governor of New Mexico

3e84827df4f2374ab07b4b2e3bdcae53b6b9bad9.sourceText: 马里奥-德拉吉(Mario Draghi)：65岁，欧洲银行行长
3e84827df4f2374ab07b4b2e3bdcae53b6b9bad9.translatedText: Mario Draghi: 65 years old, President of the European Bank

cac3451913a7c6cb9847dd3286f1f4659fff8832.sourceText: 他虽未赢得欧元区拯救战的最终胜利，但他已经赢了几场战役。他是欧洲最有办法的技术官僚之一。
cac3451913a7c6cb9847dd3286f1f4659fff8832.translatedText: Although he has not won the final victory in the euro zone rescue battle, he has won several battles. He is one of Europe's most resourceful technocrats.

4255bfd15552e6b669981f04c154875f8ba413da.sourceText: 乔伊斯-班达(Joyce Banda)：63岁，马拉维总统
4255bfd15552e6b669981f04c154875f8ba413da.translatedText: Joyce Banda: 63 years old, President of Malawi

4e1a4e32169e00c685914c24a085b8fb6c976874.sourceText: 她是马拉维首任总统，也是非洲国家中第一位女性总统。她将致力于改善本国乃至整个非洲的妇女生活条件。
4e1a4e32169e00c685914c24a085b8fb6c976874.translatedText: She is the first president of Malawi and the first female president of an African country. She will work to improve the living conditions of women in her country and across Africa.

0ae8a059dc0455ce1e717e841da4d765081fa5b6.sourceText: 詹妮弗-劳伦斯 (Jennifer Lawrence) ：22岁，好莱坞演员
0ae8a059dc0455ce1e717e841da4d765081fa5b6.translatedText: Jennifer Lawrence: 22 years old, Hollywood actor

e5adfa743a3002ca63615e25e7e3d43f13c56539.sourceText: 克里斯蒂娜-阿奎莱拉(Christina Aguilera)：32岁，美国歌手
e5adfa743a3002ca63615e25e7e3d43f13c56539.translatedText: Christina Aguilera: 32 years old, American singer

c966d8c84539e00070ea53452e074975a63df32e.sourceText: 一名29岁三个孩子的母亲（艾丽丝.琼斯）AliceJones，周日因今年的流感病毒而死在医院。而这也是今年达拉斯第17个流感病毒导致的死亡病例。琼斯的整个发病时间只有4天。
c966d8c84539e00070ea53452e074975a63df32e.translatedText: A 29-year-old mother of three children (Alice Jones) Alice Jones died in the hospital on Sunday due to this year's influenza virus. This is also the 17th death caused by the influenza virus in Dallas this year. Jones' entire illness lasted only four days.

dfcb97feb48560ef82a92715417927346bc04fd9.sourceText: 家人说琼斯是个非常努力工作的护士，她一向身体健康。她与先生有3个孩子分别是10岁，7岁和3岁。而她的先生刚刚从阿富汗战场服役回来不到一个月。
dfcb97feb48560ef82a92715417927346bc04fd9.translatedText: The family said Jones was a very hard-working nurse and she had always been in good health. She and her husband have three children, aged 10, 7 and 3 years old. Her husband had just returned from serving in Afghanistan less than a month ago.

21caf0632be7c54ffcb55083ffee901a28bce26c.sourceText: 上个星期二，他和妻子都有感冒症状，到了周末他感觉好了很多，但是琼斯依旧发烧并且喉咙痛，头疼欲裂，她去附近药店买了一些非处方药，但是周六感觉依旧不好，于是去了附医院的急诊室，医生给了她很多药物，周日，她开始感觉呼吸急促，当时家人认为有可能是流感让她感到焦虑造成的。
21caf0632be7c54ffcb55083ffee901a28bce26c.translatedText: Last Tuesday, both he and his wife had cold symptoms. By the weekend, he felt much better, but Jones still had a fever, sore throat, and splitting headache. She went to a nearby pharmacy to buy some over-the-counter medicines, but she still felt bad on Saturday, so she went to the emergency room of the affiliated hospital. The doctor gave her a lot of medicine. On Sunday, she started to feel short of breath. At that time, her family thought it might be caused by the anxiety caused by the flu.

aba6336d964126fad740b0cf4365cf72e3f538a9.sourceText: 他们感到医院想去做ct，但是一切都太晚了。医生坚持要求三个孩子做流感测试，结果发现其中一个男孩的测试为阳性。这位痛心的丈夫表示，如果没有妻子的死也许我儿子也会死掉。
aba6336d964126fad740b0cf4365cf72e3f538a9.translatedText: They felt that the hospital wanted to do CT, but it was too late. The doctor insisted that the three children be tested for the flu, and it turned out that one of the boys tested positive. The grieving husband said that if his wife had not died, maybe my son would also have died.

72d2f4562532f127dd9fd2ed69ed86a31ca58d34.sourceText: 现在，他建议所有还没有流感疫苗的民众尽快接种。流感每年爆发于十月到四月，而峰值在每年的一月和二月。
72d2f4562532f127dd9fd2ed69ed86a31ca58d34.translatedText: Now, he recommends that all people who don’t have a flu vaccine get one as soon as possible. Influenza outbreaks occur every year from October to April, with peak levels in January and February.

b0463d3f02279ed91d20a3a1462b5235c8cfec93.sourceText: 截止到1月上旬为止，全美20多州传出H1N1新型流感肆虐，除了达拉斯病情告急外，俄勒冈州多家大型医院为了防止流感疫情扩散，宣布限制访客出入等最新规定。普罗维登斯医疗服务中心（ProvidenceHealth&Services）8日宣布，位于俄勒冈州的8家分院，从今天起将有限制访客规定，访客必须是病患的近亲，而且必须年满18岁以上，才能进入探视；生育中心、小儿科及加护病房，访客必须年满18岁才能进入，每名病患每次只能接受两名访客探视。
b0463d3f02279ed91d20a3a1462b5235c8cfec93.translatedText: As of early January, the H1N1 new influenza was reported to be raging in more than 20 states across the United States. In addition to the emergency situation in Dallas, many large hospitals in Oregon have announced the latest regulations such as restricting the entry and exit of visitors to prevent the spread of the influenza epidemic. Providence Health & Services announced on the 8th that eight branches in Oregon will have visitor restrictions starting today. Visitors must be close relatives of patients and must be over 18 years old before they can enter; visitors must be over 18 years old before entering the fertility center, pediatrics and intensive care unit, and each patient can only accept two visitors at a time.

96883022e06b020e08bdbfd6ba33be2eb2aafed2.sourceText: 亚省时报副社长参加5.12 四川大地震三周年悼念仪式（图） 5月12日下午2时28分， 全国各地的群众来到四川汶川县映秀镇地震遗址献花悼念，纪念”5.12汶川大地震三周年”。亚省时报副社长甄凯婴，新闻主管谢成彦与世界华文媒体联盟的其他25位来自世界各国的媒体同仁一起参加了此次活动，并献上了黄色菊花，祭奠长眠于此的遇难者。 在地震纪念碑的后面，是当年映秀镇漩口中学的地震遗址，垮塌，倾斜的楼房，依然清晰告诉我们三年前可怕的灾难。世界华文媒体联盟在悼念仪式结束后，到映秀漩口中学和新秀小学遗址走访。如今学校只留下鲜红的国旗厖，当时中小学的伤亡达到了四分之三。所有来自海外的媒体都很关注，如今的校舍怎样了，幸存下得孩子都在哪里上学。 ”5.12”汶川特大地震严重摧毁汶川教育设施﹐全县83所学校校舍全部受损﹐万余名师生被迫转移至异地过渡复课。震后﹐阿坝州把住房﹑学校﹑医院恢复重建等民生项目摆在优先位置。汶川县更是紧抓灾后重建契机﹐整合教育资源﹐原本的86所学校被撤并为25所﹐建设面积达23.1万平方米﹐建设资金达114079万元。仅2009年8月27日广东援建汶川的16所中小学总建筑面积就达222550平方米﹐比震前汶川县原有的83所基础教育学校扩大了67543平方米﹐增加了1000多个学位。如今四川最安全的​​就是学校，可以达到9度抗震，确保”小震不坏、中震可修、大震不倒”。华侨捐资的工程被命名为”侨爱工程”，受震地区已经完成100个侨爱医院，100个侨爱学校的建设。亚利桑那捐赠的美元善款，如今已经让孩子们住进了明亮的教室。 映秀漩口中学 北川中学 大爱无疆
96883022e06b020e08bdbfd6ba33be2eb2aafed2.translatedText: The vice president of the Alberta Times attended the 5.12 Memorial Ceremony for the Third Anniversary of the Sichuan Earthquake (Photo) At 2:28 pm on May 12, people from all over the country came to the earthquake site in Yingxiu Town, Wenchuan County, Sichuan to lay flowers to commemorate the "Three Anniversary of the 5.12 Wenchuan Earthquake". Alberta Times deputy president Zhen Kaiying, news director Xie Chengyan and 25 other media colleagues from around the world from the World Chinese Media Alliance participated in the event and presented yellow chrysanthemums in memory of the victims who were buried here. Behind the earthquake monument is the earthquake site of Xuankou Middle School in Yingxiu Town. The collapsed and tilted buildings still clearly tell us about the terrible disaster three years ago. After the memorial ceremony, the World Chinese Media Alliance visited the ruins of Yingxiu Xuankou Middle School and Xinxiu Primary School. Today, only the bright red national flag is left in the school. At that time, the casualties in primary and secondary schools reached three-quarters. All the media from overseas are paying close attention to what is happening with the school buildings today and where are the surviving children going to school. The "5.12" Wenchuan earthquake severely destroyed Wenchuan's educational facilities. All 83 school buildings in the county were damaged, and more than 10,000 teachers and students were forced to move to other places to resume classes. After the earthquake, Aba Prefecture gave priority to livelihood projects such as the restoration and reconstruction of housing, schools, and hospitals. Wenchuan County seized the opportunity of post-disaster reconstruction and integrated educational resources. The original 86 schools were consolidated into 25, with a construction area of ​​231,000 square meters and construction funds of 1.14079 million yuan. On August 27, 2009 alone, the total construction area of ​​the 16 primary and secondary schools assisted by Guangdong in Wenchuan reached 222,550 square meters, which was 67,543 square meters larger than the original 83 basic education schools in Wenchuan County before the earthquake, and added more than 1,000 places. Nowadays, the safest thing in Sichuan is the school, which can withstand earthquakes up to 9 degrees, ensuring that "it will not be damaged by a small earthquake, repairable by a moderate earthquake, and will not collapse by a large earthquake." The project donated by overseas Chinese was named the "Overseas Chinese Love Project". The construction of 100 overseas Chinese love hospitals and 100 overseas Chinese love schools has been completed in the earthquake-stricken areas. The dollars donated by Arizona have now put children in bright classrooms. Yingxiu Xuankou Middle School Beichuan Middle School Love without borders

Let’s take a look at rental prices in several cities: The median rental price in Peoria in January last year was $1,195. In January this year it was $1,019. Last year it was $1,300 in Chandler, and this year it was $1,250. Rent in Tempe has increased. Rents in Surprise, Mesa and Cave Creek remained stable. The rental rate of houses in Paradise Valley has increased significantly, 12.6%. The average rent in high-end neighborhoods was $3,800 per month in January this year.
