dd0f72e1203256400bfe6625270a23a59b49438a.sourceText: 荔湾喜听龙舟鼓（多图） 蔷薇花开 ”五月五，过端午，划龙舟，敲锣鼓。” 6月23日是农历五月初五端午节正日，一早，广州荔枝湾涌便热闹起来，为期一周的五月五，龙船鼓荔湾区端午龙舟文化节在端午节正日拉开帷幕。 今年端午节前后，广州接连下了几场大雨，江河湖涌，潮水上涨，汛情汹涌。宽阔的荔枝湾湖面，碧波翻涌，水涨船高，荔湾湖两岸，鼙鼓隆隆，令人振奋，28条龙舟集结在这里巡游竞渡，桨起棹落之间，号声铿锵，碧波影彩，金鼓齐鸣，荔湾湖畔，观者如堵，人声鼎沸。天公犹嫌不过瘾，骤然加大声威，将密雨急切地砸向水面，将惊雷狂躁地炸响半空，妄图吓退竞渡的艄公。然而，龙舟上众男儿将雷电当成激励的鼓点，将猛雨当作加油的掌声，斗志反被刺激得更加高涨！ 竞渡场面，热闹非常。满眼彩旗飘飘，充耳锣鼓声声，铿锵、铿锵、咚咚咚，震得人心沸腾。湖面艘艘龙舟，一排林列，龙头交颈，龙尾欢摆。一声响锣，宣示比赛正式开始，各路”英豪”驾着七彩龙舟，桨落浪起，锣鼓喧天，舟衔碧波，如梭如箭。水上声嘶奋勇向前，岸上观众声声呐喊助威。那种浓烈的欢乐喜庆的氛围，让人激情澎湃，无法自已，就连湖边树枝上的蝉儿，也欢娱地鼓噪起来。 赛龙舟的传统习俗，相传源于古时的楚人，因不舍贤臣屈原投江死去。楚人借划龙舟驱散江中之鱼，以免鱼食屈子之身。现代人开展的赛龙舟活动，发展地传承了端午习俗的别样情趣。在你追我赶中，振奋精神，凝聚力量，增强自信，在阵阵高亢喝彩中忘却烦忧，忘却芥蒂，忘却疲劳，选手们在水面上劈波斩浪，挥桨向前，展示了一种力与美的雄浑。 自从有了屈原，中国的端午节变得厚重而亮丽起来，有了屈原，沉香的艾叶与玲珑的米粽才有了哀伤之后的美丽。我站在荔湾湖边，耳边都是众艄公团结有力的划桨声，整齐嘹亮的呐喊声，雷霆万钧的奋进声，还有观众一浪高于一浪的呐喊声—-那是从对一个高尚的人的死亡悼念中勃发出来的生机和希望。龙舟，端午节的龙舟，已经飞渡了两千多年的龙舟，还会继续飞渡下去，永远地飞渡下去的。 铿锵、铿锵、咚咚咚，在震耳的锣鼓声中，长龙击水，群情激昂。此刻，我却异乎寻常地平静起来，有一个声音仿佛从古老的岁月里，从遥远的水中缓缓飘来。这声音贴着水面，沙沙的，悠悠的，由远而近，由小到大，由缓而急，由轻而重，有力的节拍，汹涌澎湃的气势，穿透我的耳郭，强烈地撼动着我的心灵。渐渐，我听清了，那是一种浸透了忧伤的歌声：”长太息以掩涕兮，哀民生之艰！”《离骚》之歌在时空里弥漫，一如骤雨疾风，捶响我的心鼓。铿锵、铿锵、咚咚咚，铿锵、铿锵、咚咚咚….
dd0f72e1203256400bfe6625270a23a59b49438a.translatedText: Liwan enjoys listening to dragon boat drums (more pictures) rose flowers bloom "On May 5th, celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival, row dragon boats and beat gongs and drums." June 23 is the official day of the Dragon Boat Festival, the fifth day of the fifth lunar month. Guangzhou's Lizhiwan District becomes lively early in the morning. The week-long Dragon Boat Festival in Liwan District on May 5th kicks off on the official day of the Dragon Boat Festival. Around the Dragon Boat Festival this year, several heavy rains occurred in Guangzhou, causing rivers and lakes to surge, tides to rise, and flood conditions to surge. On the broad Liwan Lake, blue waves surge, and the water rises. On both sides of Liwan Lake, drums and drums rumble, which is exciting. 28 dragon boats gather here for a parade. During the ups and downs of the oars, the trumpets are sonorous, the blue waves are colorful, and the golden drums are singing. The banks of Liwan Lake are crowded with spectators and the sound of people is buzzing. The God of Heaven felt that it was not enough, and suddenly increased his power, slamming the dense rain onto the water surface eagerly, and blasting the thunder in the air manically, in an attempt to scare away the boatmen racing the ferry. However, the men on the dragon boat regarded the thunder and lightning as motivational drums and the heavy rain as cheering applause, and their fighting spirit was stimulated even higher! The boat racing scene was very lively. Eyes full of colorful flags fluttering, ears filled with the sound of gongs and drums, sonorous, sonorous, dong dong dong, making people's hearts boil. There are rows of dragon boats on the lake, with dragon heads crossing their necks and dragon tails swinging happily. A sound of gongs announced the official start of the competition. "Heroes" from all walks of life rode colorful dragon boats. The oars fell and the waves rose. The gongs and drums were noisy. The boats held the blue waves like shuttles and arrows. People on the water moved forward bravely, and the audience on the shore cheered and cheered. The strong joyful and festive atmosphere makes people passionate and unable to control themselves. Even the cicadas on the branches by the lake started making a happy noise. The traditional custom of dragon boat racing is said to have originated from the Chu people in ancient times. Qu Yuan, the virtuous minister, threw himself into the river because of his unwillingness to abandon him. The people of Chu used dragon boats to drive away the fish in the river to prevent them from eating Qu Zi's body. The dragon boat racing activities carried out by modern people have inherited the unique flavor of the Dragon Boat Festival customs. In the pursuit of each other, they inspired their spirits, gathered strength, and enhanced their self-confidence. In the bursts of high-pitched cheers, they forgot their worries, grudges, and fatigue. The contestants cut through the waves on the water and waved their oars forward, demonstrating a kind of majesty of strength and beauty. Since Qu Yuan, China's Dragon Boat Festival has become more solemn and brighter. With Qu Yuan, the agarwood leaves and exquisite rice dumplings have become beautiful after sadness. I stood by the Liwan Lake, and in my ears I could hear the sound of the boatmen's united and powerful rowing, the neat and loud shouts, the thunderous forge ahead, and the roar of the audience, which was the vitality and hope that emerged from the mourning of the death of a noble man. Dragon boats, the dragon boats of the Dragon Boat Festival, have been flying for more than two thousand years, and they will continue to fly forever. 铿锵、铿锵、咚咚咚，在震耳的锣鼓声中，长龙击水，群情激昂。 At this moment, I felt unusually calm. There was a voice that seemed to float slowly from the ancient times and from the distant water. The sound was close to the water, rustling and leisurely, from far to near, from small to loud, from slow to fast, from light to heavy. The powerful beat and surging momentum penetrated my ears and shook my soul strongly. Gradually, I heard it clearly. It was a song soaked in sadness: "I take a long breath to cover my tears, and mourn the hardships of the people's livelihood!" The song "Li Sao" filled the air in time and space, like a sudden rain and strong wind, beating my heart drum. Clang, clang, dong dong dong, clang, clang, dong dong dong….

95cda97584486b525e0dbad09ca8730266518f98.sourceText: 老妇家养40猫遭罚款 （亚省时报） 当局说，牛头市一名妇人可能因在自家移动房屋中饲养超过40只猫而被罚款。 城市动物控制部门在上周五搜查74岁的海伦弗林特的家，他们猫只生活在极其恶劣的条件下。大部分生病，有些被实施安乐死。动物管制人员在房子后面的垃圾箱还发现9只被分解的死猫。 当局说，自2004年以来，弗林特常被人投诉关于猫的问题。她将被控为动物疏忽管理，公害，猫执照，以及宠物过量等罪名，被送至牛头市检查院审查办公室。 根据该市法律，每户最多允许养猫三只。
95cda97584486b525e0dbad09ca8730266518f98.translatedText: Old woman fined for keeping 40 cats (Alberta Times) A ​​Cowhead woman may be fined for keeping more than 40 cats in her mobile home, authorities said. City Animal Control searched the home of 74-year-old Helen Flint on Friday, where her cats were living in extremely poor conditions. Most fell ill and some were euthanized. Animal control officers also found nine decomposed dead cats in a dumpster behind the house. Authorities say Flint has been the subject of frequent complaints about cats since 2004. She will be charged with animal neglect, public nuisance, cat licensing, and pet overdose, and will be sent to the Niutou City Prosecutor's Office. Under city law, a maximum of three cats are allowed per household.

c1431e3f0740e7e22b6a4507d84d778396463e0e.translatedText: I hope you don’t think that I am relying on my old age to show off my old age.

2b70faed847bae14af9d4ff3727f6e1f95499c04.sourceText: 昨天听到有言论说是年轻人没有结婚的条件比如是没有房子云云，初听惊讶，但后来一 想，又好像是现在很多人的想法。什么时候开始我们要”一切稳定下来”才能想结婚的 事情呢？要有房子，工作，身份等，好像结了婚就会阻碍了实现这些目标似的。或者是 有更大的追求，无论是怕家庭生活分心还是隐约觉得眼前人并配不上将来的自己，总之 ，年轻人不大想commit。
2b70faed847bae14af9d4ff3727f6e1f95499c04.translatedText: Yesterday I heard some comments saying that young people are not eligible for marriage, such as not having a house. I was surprised at first, but then I thought about it, and it seems to be what many people think now. When did we start to think that "everything has stabilized" before we can think about getting married? To have a house, a job, an identity, etc., it seems that getting married will hinder the realization of these goals. Or they have greater pursuits, whether they are afraid of being distracted by family life or they vaguely feel that the person in front of them is not worthy of their future self. In short, young people don’t want to commit.

fa8488c3eda53f3ca8797cd1501ef3f4ad756584.sourceText: 但很多时候并不需要怕的，我有幸认识一些比较年长的朋友，都是20多年前只拎着两只 箱子，几百美金来美国的，有些是算着能不能熬到第一次发TA人工。很多人都是穷学生 的时候结婚，结婚前身无长物，结婚戒指也是省下来几十元邮购的。但现在大家都身份 无忧，生活安定，子女很多都上精英大学了。回忆起来并不是没有风雨，但一般人都是 兵来将挡，都能熬过去的。而且，很多人回忆起来，就是恰恰是因为有这家庭责任，能 够给他们无比的勇气熬过去的。可能是单身的话就会放弃回国了（当然，也未必不好） 。他们周围认识的，也没有因为有家庭负累而太潦倒落魄的人。
fa8488c3eda53f3ca8797cd1501ef3f4ad756584.translatedText: But in many cases, there is no need to be afraid. I am fortunate to know some older friends who came to the United States more than 20 years ago with only two boxes and a few hundred dollars. Some of them were counting on whether they could survive until their first labor payment. Many people get married when they are poor students. They have nothing to offer before getting married, so they save tens of dollars to buy wedding rings by mail. But now everyone has no worries about their status, their lives are stable, and many of their children have gone to elite universities. In retrospect, it is not without wind and rain, but most people can get through it with soldiers coming to stop them. Moreover, many people recall that it was precisely because of their family responsibilities that they had the incomparable courage to get through it. Maybe if you are single, you will give up and return to your country (of course, this may not be a bad thing). There was no one they knew who was too down and out because of family burdens.

e738f8ec8d3a4014b1a53204d71b1ca0dc336eaf.sourceText: 而至于很大的追求，年轻人有锐气是好事情。这个锐气并不是为了你真的可以爬的多高 ，而是年轻时锐气进取，是学习的动力，而学习能收获的并不一定是世俗定义的成功， 阅历本身就能丰富了一个人的人生了。但对绝大部分的普通人而言，我们最后还是要接 受自己平庸的事实，而对这些人，家庭的幸福是幸福感的最大来源之一，如果不是最大 的来源。很多人年纪越大，就越感觉这一点。所以你的对象并不是蛮不讲理high maintenance的话，进取到要牺牲家庭的程度，其实可以停下来，想一想，是否值得。 尤其是最好审视一下自己的进取心是否仅仅因为虚荣心而来的，如果是这样，其实在美 华人留学生出身的，绝大部分最终停留的社会经济阶层是一个非常窄的谱系，其实谁不 比谁强到了多少。当然人的追求不是单一的，有人的确能够终身追求和进取，但到了要 为事业牺牲家庭的程度，要知道自己是什么样的人，要知道自己放弃的是什么。
e738f8ec8d3a4014b1a53204d71b1ca0dc336eaf.translatedText: As for big pursuits, it is a good thing for young people to be energetic. This energy is not about how high you can really climb, but the energy and enterprising spirit when you are young. It is the motivation for learning. What you can gain from learning is not necessarily the worldly definition of success. Experience itself can enrich a person's life. But for most ordinary people, we still have to accept the fact that we are mediocre in the end, and for these people, family happiness is one of the biggest sources of happiness, if not the biggest source. The older many people get, the more they feel this. So if your partner is not unreasonable and high-maintenance, or aggressive to the point of sacrificing your family, you can actually stop and think about whether it is worth it. In particular, it is best to examine whether your enterprising spirit comes only from vanity. If so, in fact, the socioeconomic class in which most Chinese international students in the United States end up staying is in a very narrow spectrum. In fact, no one is much better than the other. Of course, people's pursuits are not single. Some people can indeed pursue and make progress throughout their lives. But when it comes to sacrificing family for career, you need to know what kind of person you are and what you are giving up.

9eeb76b8e4099608c6d6cfb9b5c961e423b85692.sourceText: 至于觉得自己始终会有大成就的，觉得现在的眼前人不过是expedience，那种我都不怎 么想说了，除了两点：人容易高估了自己，而且靠外在成就吸引的感情是根基很浮。
9eeb76b8e4099608c6d6cfb9b5c961e423b85692.translatedText: As for those who feel that they will always achieve great achievements, and that the people in front of them are just expedience, I don’t have much to say about that, except for two points: people tend to overestimate themselves, and the feelings attracted by external achievements are very superficial.

961a3f9c4ea3e3ebd4d82027b732f7c90d22c2bc.sourceText: 人生是没有回头路的，有时有些东西错过了，就是永远错过的了。少年夫妻的福分就是 这些东西之一。婚姻感情根基最好的是在双方都年轻有热情的时候。过了这个时候，就 是过了。之后再怎么找怎么折腾，都是sub-optimal的半路夫妻。其实年少时，有感情 根基，价值观无大分歧，双方都是愿意沟通改进的人，双方家人都是讲道理的，已经是 足够结婚的条件了。双方都能够有足够信念坚持在一起，捍卫家庭的完整，磨合过后， 心可能会更加定，而且，如果人有信心，知道无论多么潦倒自己也不是孤零零地去面对 ，始终这个世界上是有个角落，无论全世界都抛弃你，都会对你张开温暖的怀抱，有着 这样的心理支持，比起一直在寻寻觅觅的单身人士可能更容易专注于奋斗，也更坚定自 信，未必真的是拖了后腿。单身人士可能看起来时间是多了，但是，也会寂寞，也会分 神。
961a3f9c4ea3e3ebd4d82027b732f7c90d22c2bc.translatedText: There is no turning back in life. Sometimes if you miss something, you will miss it forever. The blessing of young couples is one of these things. The best foundation for a marriage is when both parties are young and passionate. Once this time has passed, it is past. No matter how hard you try after that, you will always be a sub-optimal half-way couple. In fact, when we were young, we had a strong relationship, no big differences in values, both parties were willing to communicate and improve, and their families were reasonable, which were enough conditions for marriage. Both parties can have enough faith to stay together and defend the integrity of the family. After getting along, the heart may become more stable. Moreover, if a person has confidence and knows that no matter how down and out he is, he will not face it alone. There will always be a corner of the world. No matter if the whole world abandons you, it will open a warm embrace to you. With such psychological support, it may be easier to focus on struggle and be more confident than a single person who has been looking for it, which may not really be a hindrance. Single people may seem to have a lot of time, but they can also be lonely and distracted.

df698d15ca11a12a70478f68dfacbb0eaea82d79.sourceText: 大家齐心，该有的始终都会有。就趁年轻大家快快commit吧。很多时，是做了几十年人 ，才发现世事变幻，很多时以前那些很牢固的物质根基（比如N年前的国有企业普通工 人）其实都是虚的。现在可能很多人执着的东西，在家庭生活中其实可能是最后无足轻 重。
df698d15ca11a12a70478f68dfacbb0eaea82d79.translatedText: If everyone works together, what should be there will always be there. Let’s commit as soon as possible while we are still young. Many times, it takes decades of working as a person to realize that things have changed, and many times those solid material foundations in the past (such as ordinary workers in state-owned enterprises N years ago) are actually false. The things that many people may be obsessed with now may actually end up being insignificant in family life.

dcc5466013a752c8387c3fcf843075afaf38984c.sourceText: 或者你们可以看作是一个错过了少年夫妻的福分的中女在发牢骚吧。少年夫妻的福分错 过了，希望白头到老的福分还来得及吧？ — 世事静方见，人情淡始长
dcc5466013a752c8387c3fcf843075afaf38984c.translatedText: Or you can think of it as a middle-aged girl complaining about missing out on the blessing of a teenage couple. The blessing of a young couple has been missed, but it is still not too late to hope for the blessing of growing old together, right? - Only when the world is quiet can we see things, but when people are calm can we grow up.

97d9458ad825e8038331d082a3f474cdf94c109d.translatedText: Brewer signed a bill on the 16th to outlaw the drug "bath salts" Governor Brewer signed an emergency bill on the 16th that will be used to manufacture "bath salts"...

73bb5c8c4ebcfe92f463c60058f63ab8592725ab.sourceText: 布鲁尔16日签署法案 取缔“浴盐”药物 布鲁尔州长16日签署紧急法案，将用于制造”沐浴盐”的七种化学品列为州危险药物。 该药物已在商店柜台和网上合法出售，它有类似甲基安非他命或可卡因的副作用。这种别名为象牙，象牙雪波，海洋，冰雪，香草的天空，紫色波2，扩大范围，红色的鸽子，希望赶及疤痕的药物，目前得到30多个州禁止使用。任何人拥有，生产，销售或运输将等同运毒或藏毒罪行。 本项法案15日完成立法，州长16日签署立即生效。这是州长签署的本年度第一项法案。
73bb5c8c4ebcfe92f463c60058f63ab8592725ab.translatedText: Brewer signed a bill on the 16th to outlaw the drug "bath salts" Governor Brewer signed an emergency bill on the 16th to classify seven chemicals used in the manufacture of "bath salts" as state dangerous drugs. The drug has been legally sold over the counter in stores and online, and it has side effects similar to methamphetamine or cocaine. This drug, also known as Ivory, Ivory Snow Wave, Ocean, Ice Snow, Vanilla Sky, Purple Wave 2, Red Dove, Hope Catch Scar, is currently banned in more than 30 states. Anyone who possesses, produces, sells or transports it will be guilty of drug trafficking or possession. This bill was completed on the 15th and signed by the governor on the 16th to take effect immediately. This is the first bill signed by the governor this year.

96daf056b663a0f576cdcef70c77eb2394cf4abc.sourceText: 国税局退税支票 延迟21天 传统思维是，越早报税越快收到退税，但今年却不适用，早报税的纳税人反倒延后收到国税局(IRS)寄出的退税支票。国税局上月说，由于国税局在更新电脑系统，最早报税的人将晚一周才会收到退税支票。但报税专家说，多数退税可能要晚10到21天才会收到。 国税局更新电脑系统，是为了在寄出退税支票前查出可能的身分诈欺。但国税局说，1月26日以后报税的人，将会及时收到退税支票。 税务专家说，国税局寄出的退税支票仍持续延后，部分原因是早期报税积压得太多。 国税局说，今年报税季开始以来，他们向数百万纳税人寄出了退税支票。国税局还说，採用电子报税和选择退税款直接存入帐户的纳税人，可在10到21天看到退税入帐，部分纳税人会更快地收到退税。 国税局还说，国税局网站最近出现的问题已解决。部分纳税人在国税局网站点击「何处可查退税」(Where’s My Refund)时，遇到的却是「我们没有相关的退税资讯」。国税局说﹕「这一问题只是暂时现象，事实上几乎所有问题都已解决。」 纳税人在国税局网站访问「何处可查退税」，可大致知道收到退税的时间。
96daf056b663a0f576cdcef70c77eb2394cf4abc.translatedText: IRS tax refund checks are delayed for 21 days. Traditional thinking is that the earlier you file your taxes, the sooner you will receive your tax refund, but this does not apply this year. Taxpayers who file their taxes early will instead receive their tax refund checks from the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) later. The IRS said last month that the earliest taxpayers to file would be a week late in receiving their refund checks as the agency updates its computer systems. But tax filing experts say most refunds may take 10 to 21 days to arrive. The Internal Revenue Service is updating its computer system to detect possible identity fraud before tax refund checks are sent out. But the IRS said that people who file taxes after January 26 will receive their tax refund checks in a timely manner. Tax experts say the IRS continues to be delayed in sending refund checks, in part because of a backlog of early returns. The Internal Revenue Service says it has sent refund checks to millions of taxpayers since the beginning of this year's tax filing season. The IRS also said that taxpayers who file electronically and choose to have their refunds deposited directly into their accounts can see their refunds credited in 10 to 21 days, and some taxpayers will receive their refunds sooner. The IRS also said recent issues with the IRS website have been resolved. When some taxpayers click on “Where’s My Refund” on the IRS website, they encounter the message “We have no relevant tax refund information.” The IRS said: "This problem is only a temporary phenomenon. In fact, almost all problems have been resolved." Taxpayers can roughly know when to receive their tax refunds by visiting "Where to Check for Tax Refunds" on the IRS website.

cecd19033f48c82b864a051777de627ad8f37d97.sourceText: 退休者协会：老人常用药价格涨26％ （亚省时报） 美国非营利组织退休者协会（AARP）3月6日发出一份报告称，从2005年到2009年，美国老年人最广泛使用的药物价格上涨了近26％，几乎是通胀率的两倍。 报告发现，在这些药物价格飞速上涨的同时，绝大多数处方药近几年来的价格却在下跌，甚至连仿制药的价格都在下降。美国药品研究与制造商、产业贸易与游说团体，6日在一份 声明中说，近几年来仿制药使用范围扩大，减缓了药品价格的增长。 AARP的报告，审查了514个医疗保险者使用最广泛的药物品牌和仿制药的零售价格，据此得知，从2005年至2009年，仿制药的价格下跌了近31％。但与此同时，知名品牌药物价格增长了近41％，专科用药价格上升超过48％。相反，通胀率同期只增长了13％多一点。 很少人不认同名牌药品的价格正在升高的事实。追踪药品价格管理的巴克莱资本股票研究总监马什表示，制药业的通货膨胀确实存在。制药公司一直在提高那些专利期即将结束的药品价格，目的是在仿制药的出现失去市场份额之前尽可能的赚取利 润。 该报告作者之一珀维斯说，名牌药品的价格也会抬高保险费，并且把退休人员更快地推到医疗照顾处方药品保险计划（Medicare Part D）的承保缺口中。 梅森斯说，这与AARP的会员密切相关。由于会员年纪越来越大，有可能失业或者很难找到一份工作，这时他们可能更需要处方药。 AARP是美国成立时间最长且最大、为老年人呼吁倡议的群体。其成员为50岁及以上老人，其中大约有三分之一的会员仍在工作。
cecd19033f48c82b864a051777de627ad8f37d97.translatedText: Association of Retired Persons: Prices of commonly used drugs for the elderly have increased by 26% (Alberta Times) The American Association of Retired Persons (AARP), a non-profit organization, issued a report on March 6 stating that from 2005 to 2009, the price of the most widely used drugs for the elderly in the United States increased by nearly 26%, almost twice the inflation rate. The report found that while the prices of these drugs have been rising rapidly, the prices of most prescription drugs have fallen in recent years, and even the prices of generic drugs have fallen. The American Pharmaceutical Research and Manufacturers, industry trade and lobbying groups said in a statement on the 6th that the expansion of the use of generic drugs in recent years has slowed the growth of drug prices. The AARP report, which examined 514 retail prices of the most widely used brand-name and generic drugs by Medicare, found that from 2005 to 2009, generic drug prices fell nearly 31 percent. But at the same time, the price of well-known brand drugs has increased by nearly 41%, and the price of specialty drugs has increased by more than 48%. In contrast, inflation increased by just over 13% over the same period. Few would disagree that the prices of brand-name drugs are rising. Marsh, director of equity research at Barclays Capital, which tracks drug price management, said inflation in the pharmaceutical industry is real. Pharmaceutical companies have been raising prices for drugs that are nearing the end of their patent life, with the goal of making as much profit as possible before generic drugs emerge and lose market share. Purvis, one of the report's authors, said the price of brand-name drugs would also drive up insurance premiums and push retirees more quickly into the Medicare Part D coverage gap. Masons said this goes hand in hand with AARP's membership. As members get older, may be unemployed or have difficulty finding a job, they may need prescription drugs more. AARP is the oldest and largest advocacy group for older adults in the United States. Its members are people aged 50 and above, about one-third of whom are still working.

9cddc0f57cce4eec4a5c052528c04446f66d286b.sourceText: 96岁的前亚利桑那州长卡斯卓(Raul Castro)6月12日在诺加拉斯美墨边界的检查站，因体内装置的心律调整器触动辐射感应器，被边界巡逻探员在近100度 的高温中，留置超过半小时。 海关与边界保护局已为此道歉，并辩称只留置卡斯卓十分钟。 曾担任美国驻多个国家大使的卡斯卓，5日接受访问时表示，他了解探员们有其职责，他并未受到虐待，也不记恨，但一旦他的身分和年龄被确认，以及 他说明自己前一天接受医疗后，探员们应对他的年龄和身体状况更为敏感一些。 卡斯卓从1964年起历任美国驻萨尔瓦多、玻利维亚和阿根廷大使，并在1975至1977年担任亚利桑那州州长。 6月12日他由边界镇诺加拉斯前镇长杜安的女儿、现任亚利桑那大学教授的安杜安开车，从所住的诺格里斯前往图桑出席庆祝他96岁生日的午宴。 他们的汽车在边界北方24哩的19号州际公路检查站因为触动了一个辐射感应器而被拦截，卡斯卓认为是他前一天装了心律调整器触动感应器。 杜安说，探员要卡斯卓到一个帐篷区接受二度检查，当时气温接近100度，卡斯卓又身穿西装，杜安请求让卡斯卓坐在有冷气的汽车内，但探 员不准，表示帐篷内有电风扇。 杜安说，探员向卡斯卓问了一系列问题，拿出一个文件要他签，然后用一个侦察仪器对他再度全身扫描，才让他们离去，当他们在炎阳下走回汽车 时，探员又要看卡斯卓的身分证，这时他已因天热非常不舒服，把身分证掉在地下，但坚持自己捡起来。 他们总共被留置了超过30分钟。 杜安说：「我觉得他们持续羞辱他，我是驾驶，他们从未问我的名字和要看我的身分证，如果此车有核子威胁，他们为什么不查问我？」 海关与边界保护局发表声明，对此延误造成的不便感到遗憾。
9cddc0f57cce4eec4a5c052528c04446f66d286b.translatedText: The 96-year-old former Arizona Governor Raul Castro Castro was detained at the U.S.-Mexico border checkpoint in Nogalas on June 12 for more than half an hour in a temperature of nearly 100 degrees because the heart rate regulator installed in his body triggered a radiation sensor. Customs and Border Protection has apologized and argued that Castro was only detained for ten minutes. Castro, who has served as the U.S. ambassador to many countries, said in an interview on the 5th that he understands that the agents have their responsibilities. He has not been abused and does not hold a grudge. However, once his identity and age are confirmed and he explains that he received medical treatment the day before, the agents should be more sensitive to his age and physical condition. Castro has served as U.S. ambassador to El Salvador, Bolivia and Argentina since 1964, and as governor of Arizona from 1975 to 1977. On June 12, he was driven from Nogales, where he lived, to Tucson to attend a luncheon celebrating his 96th birthday, driven by Duane, the daughter of Duane, the former mayor of the border town of Nogalas and now a professor at the University of Arizona. Their car was stopped at an Interstate 19 checkpoint 24 miles north of the border because it triggered a radiation sensor that Castro believed was triggered by the pacemaker he had installed the day before. Duane said that the agent asked Castro to go to a tent area for a second inspection. The temperature at the time was nearly 100 degrees and Castro was wearing a suit. Duane asked that Castro sit in an air-conditioned car, but the agent refused and said that there was an electric fan in the tent. Duane said that the agents asked Castro a series of questions, took out a document and asked him to sign it, and then used a reconnaissance device to scan his whole body again before letting them leave. When they walked back to the car under the scorching sun, the agents asked Castro to see his ID card. By this time, he was very uncomfortable due to the heat and dropped the ID card on the ground, but insisted on picking it up himself. In total, they were detained for more than 30 minutes. "I felt like they continued to humiliate him," Duane said. "I was the driver. They never asked for my name or asked for my ID. If there was a nuclear threat in this car, why didn't they question me?" Customs and Border Protection issued a statement regretting the inconvenience caused by the delay.

602c65a50f5fd5555740c586437b71d68c47c26b.sourceText: 三月二十四日在纽约举行的 2012 年全美钢琴大赛中，本州十一岁的少女贾可可 (Katrina Jia) 以生动的表演和精湛的技巧摘下初中组的桂冠。同时她也获得了肖邦基金会今年在比赛中设立的最佳肖邦作品演奏奖。由全美音乐教师协会主办的一年一度的全国钢琴大赛是美国唯一的全国钢琴比赛。参赛选手要所在的州和全国七个区的比赛中获得第一名才能取得进入全国决赛的资格。初中组的年龄段是十一岁到十四岁。这就大大增加了入选的难度。贾可可是代表西南区参加决赛的，是本届比赛中年龄最小的参赛者。比赛选手中包括很多来美国求学的外藉学生，其中有很多都在各种国际比赛中获奖。贾可可参赛的六首曲目代表了所有重要音乐历史时期的风格。她把这些作品表演的层次分明，音色多变，情感入微，风格恪到好处。她对音乐的成熟的理解和发自内心的演奏得到了评委一致的高度赞赏。她在七个决赛选手中脱颖而出，今人信服地获得了第一名。
602c65a50f5fd5555740c586437b71d68c47c26b.translatedText: The 2012 held in New York on March 24 In the 2016 National Piano Competition, Katrina Jia, an 11-year-old girl from the state, won the junior high school category with her vivid performance and superb skills. At the same time, she also won the Best Chopin Performance Award established by the Chopin Foundation in this year's competition. The annual National Piano Competition, sponsored by the National Association of Music Teachers, is the only national piano competition in the United States. To qualify for the national finals, contestants must place first in their state and seven regional competitions across the country. The age group for the junior high school group is eleven to fourteen years old. This greatly increases the difficulty of selection. Jia Keke represented the Southwest District in the finals and was the youngest contestant in this competition. Contestants include many foreign students who come to the United States to study, and many of them have won awards in various international competitions. The six pieces that Jia Keke participated in represented the styles of all important musical historical periods. She performed these works with clear layers, varied timbres, subtle emotions, and a perfect style. Her mature understanding of music and heartfelt performance were highly praised by the judges. She stood out among seven finalists and convincingly won first place.

41dc9aaa9e66673d30adac3a1c9c971f1dc41296.sourceText: 贾可可五岁开始跟全美知名的钢琴教育家学许飞老师学习钢琴，一年后就主办了三场家庭独奏会，很早就显示了音乐方面的才能和潜力。在她父母支持和严格要求下，她在练习中非常努力地追求高质和完美的演奏。这些年不断的在亚省各种重要钢琴比赛中获奖增加了可可的自信心和演奏经验，为参加此次重大的比赛奠定了基础。
41dc9aaa9e66673d30adac3a1c9c971f1dc41296.translatedText: Jia Keke started learning piano from the nationally renowned piano educator Mr. Xu Fei at the age of five. One year later, he hosted three family recitals, showing his musical talent and potential very early. With the support and strict requirements of her parents, she worked very hard to pursue high quality and perfect playing in practice. Continuously winning awards in various important piano competitions in Alberta over the years has increased Coco's self-confidence and playing experience, laying the foundation for participating in this major competition.

872ed0c7d671fa015a06bb19a309a72c64f33feb.sourceText: 由许飞和朱虹老师执教的新世纪音乐学校近十年来培养出了许多优秀学生，在国内和国际钢琴比赛中频频获奖夺冠。在近八年中，五年有学生代表西南区进入全美钢琴大赛的决赛，三次获得全国冠军。
872ed0c7d671fa015a06bb19a309a72c64f33feb.translatedText: New Century Music School, taught by teachers Xu Fei and Zhu Hong, has cultivated many outstanding students in the past ten years, and has frequently won awards in domestic and international piano competitions. In the past eight years, students have represented the Southwest Region in five of the finals of the National Piano Competition and won the national championship three times.

7f7e21e7b8a2399ef65b5590bb7b929d74bf2a2d.sourceText: 欠赡养费福利全没 27万男性恐陷困境 数以千计依赖联邦福利维生的贫穷和残障男性，明年起将失去唯一的收入，因为财政部新规定，让州府可由积欠子女赡养费的州民，没收所有的联邦福利。 在旧规定中，州府仅可由选择发放支票的民众没收65%给付。权益人士估计，修法后可能造成27万5000人陷入困境。 这项担忧是财政部当初决定把所有福利的发放，包括社安福利、残障和退伍军人福利，自明年起全部改採电 子化给付后，始料未及的结果。 鑑于财政部去年5月已通过另一项规定，让州府有权对领取联邦福利和积欠子女赡养费的受益人，冻结其银行帐户。州府未来若再没收剩馀的35%给付，将造成数以千计穷人失去唯一的收入。 许多积欠子女赡养费的桉例中，是几十年的陈年旧帐，子女早已长大成人，所欠的钱大多为欠款人因残障、至勒戒所或入监服刑，无力支付而不断累积的利息和费用。 此外，专家指出，当局目前由福利给付没收的钱，主要是收缴公库，而非发还需要抚养的子女，因为州府可把没收的钱，视为过去提供给儿童福利的补偿。 专门协助穷人的芝加哥律师海兰德表示：「财政部的规定无视一项事实，亦即没收的钱大多为利息，并且是缴给州府；需要抚养的子女通常早已成年，此举只会让被追缴的民众一贫如洗。」
7f7e21e7b8a2399ef65b5590bb7b929d74bf2a2d.translatedText: Thousands of poor and disabled men who rely on federal benefits will lose their only income starting next year because of a new Treasury Department rule that allows states to confiscate all federal benefits from people who owe child support. Under the old rules, states could only confiscate 65% of benefits from people who chose to issue checks. Rights activists estimate that 275,000 people may be in trouble after the law is revised. The concern is an unexpected result of the Treasury Department's decision to make all benefits, including Social Security, disability and veterans' benefits, electronic starting next year. In view of the fact that the Treasury Department passed another rule in May last year, giving the state the power to freeze the bank accounts of beneficiaries who receive federal benefits and owe child support. If the state government confiscates the remaining 35% of benefits in the future, thousands of poor people will lose their only income. In many cases where child support is owed, it is an old debt that is decades old. The children have long since grown up. Most of the money owed is interest and fees that have been accumulated due to the debtor's inability to pay due to disability, rehab, or prison. In addition, experts pointed out that the money currently confiscated from welfare payments by the authorities is mainly collected into the public treasury rather than returned to dependent children, because the state can regard the confiscated money as compensation for the welfare provided to children in the past. Hyland, a Chicago attorney who specializes in assisting the poor, said: "The Treasury Department's regulations ignore the fact that most of the forfeited money is interest and is paid to the state; the dependent children are often already adults. This will only leave the people who are being recovered impoverished."

0cfc4f01e567d7b7e88c37d1c29d836beba5cf23.sourceText: 由于室内晒肤设备可能增加罹患皮肤癌的机率，根据全国州议会会议的议程，已有18个州考虑採取措施，禁止未满18岁的少年使用室内日光浴设备；另外五个州则拟加强监管，规定要得到家长同意。 美国皮肤病学会透露，每年大约3000万人使用室内日光浴设备，其中230万是少年人。使用这类设备确实增加患皮肤癌的风险，包括最致命的黑色素瘤在内，年幼时开始使用的人影响更严重。 亚利桑那州和大多数州一样，规定18岁一下青少年需得父母同意，才可使用日光浴床。并规定操作人员必须限定曝光时间，以制造商建议为前提，为使用者提供眼睛防护罩。十个州限制使用的最低年龄，由13岁到16岁半不等。只有加州全面禁止未成年人使用室内日光浴设备，今年1月1日生效。Ron Moy说：「今年是大力推动禁令的一年。」 马里兰州州参议员拉斯金说，加州成功立法后，促使各州推动类似禁令。 禁令反对者认为，这些建议容许政府进行太多干预，将使有关行业失去数千个职位。 俄亥俄州的连锁日光浴室TANPRO的老闆奎因说，2010年的联邦卫生保健法，向日光浴服务课税10%后，该州的小型日光浴室就开始萎缩。 反对者同时说，紫外线辐射对健康的好处胜于风险，它能使身体产生天然维他命D。他们说，少年人在海滩上被晒伤皮肤的机会，比在日光浴床大。 爱达荷州州众议会少数党领袖和儿科医生鲁西查建议禁止18岁以下的少年使用日光浴设备。
0cfc4f01e567d7b7e88c37d1c29d836beba5cf23.translatedText: Because indoor tanning equipment may increase the chance of skin cancer, according to the agenda of the National Conference of State Legislatures, 18 states have considered taking measures to prohibit teenagers under the age of 18 from using indoor tanning equipment; another five states plan to strengthen supervision and require parental consent. The American Academy of Dermatology revealed that approximately 30 million people use indoor tanning equipment each year, of which 2.3 million are teenagers. Using such devices does increase the risk of skin cancer, including the deadliest form of melanoma, with the effects being more severe in people who start using them at a young age. Arizona, like most states, requires teenagers under the age of 18 to obtain parental consent before using tanning beds. It also stipulates that operators must limit exposure time, based on manufacturer's recommendations, and provide users with eye protection. The minimum age for use in ten states ranges from 13 to 16 and a half years old. Only California has completely banned the use of indoor tanning equipment by minors, which took effect on January 1 this year. Ron Moy said: "This is a year of vigorous promotion of bans." Maryland State Senator Raskin said that the successful legislation in California has prompted states to promote similar bans. Opponents of the ban say the proposals allow too much government intervention and will cost thousands of jobs in the industry. Quinn, the owner of Tanpro, an Ohio tanning room chain, said the state's small tanning business began to shrink after the 2010 federal health care law imposed a 10 percent tax on tanning services. Opponents also say the health benefits of UV radiation outweigh the risks, as it causes the body to produce natural vitamin D. They say teenagers are more likely to get sunburned on the beach than on a sunbed. Idaho State House Minority Leader and pediatrician Rusicha has proposed banning the use of tanning equipment by teenagers under the age of 18.

0cac28587caa7c08a8b84abe3cdd6314f6d765c6.sourceText: 法律市场萎缩 报考法学院人数降16%
0cac28587caa7c08a8b84abe3cdd6314f6d765c6.translatedText: The legal market is shrinking, with the number of people applying for law school falling by 16%

5720eb9fcec332eeb797dac0199d3c599dd22b1a.sourceText: 法律市场萎缩 报考法学院人数降16% （亚省新闻） 据”法学院入学考试”（Law …
5720eb9fcec332eeb797dac0199d3c599dd22b1a.translatedText: The legal market is shrinking, with the number of people applying for law school falling by 16% (Alberta News) According to the "Law School Admission Test" (Law...

758f091c889ecc11c6d975d1cb6b1b69f94b80a1.sourceText: 据”法学院入学考试”（Law School Admission Test，简称LSAT）背后的组织–法学院入学考试委员会报告，今年参加这项考试的人数下降超过16%，降幅创下十几年来最大一次。 报告说，2011~12学年有129,925人次参加LSAT考试，不但低于一年前的155,050人次，也远低于两年前的171,514人次。总的来说，参加考试的人数在过去两年内已下降了近25%。 人数的下降反映了美国的法律服务市场处境堪忧，也将很难吸收未来三年内约45,000名的各家法学院毕业生。此一性统性问题可能很严重。 很多律师和法学教授近年来争论说，随着科技进步，使越来越多的低端法律工作可在海外解决，以及公司要求他们的法律事务所提供更具成本效益的收费安排，法律服务市场将停滞不前或萎缩。 这些争论，加上关于太多新律师陷入巨大债务的负面新闻，已改变了本科生对法学院的看法。许多人认为，法学院不再是经济衰退时的安全选择(这是人们多年来的信仰)，而在一个中上的学校中获得优异成绩也不能保证毕业后能获得一份六位数年薪的法律事务所工作。 过去一两年来，法学院也遭受了衰退的压力。一些博客（多数由失业或半失业的毕业生所写）指控法学院用黑幕数据(shady data)吸引学生。人们的注意力都集中在一个关键的统计上：学生在毕业九个月后受聘的百分比。 近几个月来已有十多家法学院被提出集体诉讼，指控他们利用大量欺诈和夸大的毕业后就业数据诓骗学生入学。即使法学院能胜诉(很多法学家也认为他们能)，媒体的关注程度已开始急剧上升。
758f091c889ecc11c6d975d1cb6b1b69f94b80a1.translatedText: According to the "Law School Admission Test") The Law School Admission Test Board, the organization behind the LSAT, reported that the number of people taking the test fell by more than 16% this year, the largest drop in more than a decade. The report said that 129,925 people took the LSAT in the 2011-12 school year, which was not only down from 155,050 people a year ago, but also far lower than the 171,514 people two years ago. Overall, the number of people taking the test has dropped by nearly 25% in the past two years. The decline reflects a troubled U.S. legal services market that will struggle to absorb the estimated 45,000 law schools that will graduate over the next three years. Many lawyers and law professors have argued in recent years that the legal services market will stagnate or shrink as technological advances allow more and more low-end legal work to be handled overseas and companies demand more cost-effective fee arrangements from their law firms. These controversies, coupled with negative news about too many new lawyers falling into huge debts, have changed how undergraduates view law school. Many believe that law school is no longer a safe choice in a recession (as has been the belief for years), and that getting good grades at an upper-middle-class school does not guarantee a six-figure law firm job after graduation. Law schools have also suffered from recessionary pressures in the past year or two. Some blogs (mostly written by unemployed or semi-unemployed graduates) have accused law schools of using shady data. Attention is focused on one key statistic: the percentage of students who are employed nine months after graduation. Class-action lawsuits have been filed against more than a dozen law schools in recent months alleging that they used massive amounts of fraudulent and inflated post-graduation employment data to defraud students. Even if the law schools win the lawsuits (and many legal experts think they can), media attention has begun to increase sharply.

da58740ad3b07faf9f6df450e3a0dcf25c76b062.sourceText: 何谓产权保险(Title Insurance)? 买卖房屋时都会购买产权保险，透过购买产权保险可以让您在产…
da58740ad3b07faf9f6df450e3a0dcf25c76b062.translatedText: What is Title Insurance? Title insurance is purchased when buying and selling a house. By purchasing title insurance, you can protect your rights and interests when the property...

157e6ea95000061ca79b2c10ffab22022c381e26.sourceText: 买卖房屋时都会购买产权保险，透过购买产权保险可以让您在产权发生问题时还能保障自己的权益。房地产的产权为什么会有问题? 有几个原因: 可能是从前产权过户时没有处理好(Defects in the chain of Title)、该房地产曾经有未清偿的抵押借款(Mortgages)、曾经被扣押(liens) ，或是有地役权(Easements)，所谓的地役权，指的是土地所有人对他人土地可行使之权利。这些产权的问题，有些是不容易被察觉的，例如: 诈欺行为、产权转让程序错误等，有些比较容易被察觉，但是不容易或不可能将它移除，像是: 被扣押、有地役权等等。
157e6ea95000061ca79b2c10ffab22022c381e26.translatedText: Title insurance is purchased when buying and selling a house. By purchasing title insurance, you can protect your rights and interests when there is a problem with the title. Why are there problems with the property rights of real estate? There are several reasons: Defects in the chain of Title may not have been handled properly during the transfer of property rights, the property may have had unpaid mortgages, liens, or easements. The so-called easements refer to the rights that the land owner can exercise over other people's land. Some of these property rights problems are not easy to detect, such as: fraud, errors in property transfer procedures, etc. Some are easier to detect, but it is not easy or impossible to remove them, such as: being seized, having an easement, etc.

0ea27ef5864f3e81d1c412a45202dfa0a4becfd4.sourceText: 所以产权保险是为了保障房地产购买者，不会因为购买到产权有问题的房地产而遭受损失，您如果是贷款买房地产，贷款银行也会为了保障自身的权益，而要求您购买产权保险，因此产权保险有两种，一种是产权人保单(Owner’s Policy)、它保障您的权益，通常由卖方付保费，另一种是银行保单(Lender’s Policy)、在保障银行的权益，传统上由贷款人付保费，可视为贷款费用的一部份。
0ea27ef5864f3e81d1c412a45202dfa0a4becfd4.translatedText: Therefore, title insurance is to protect real estate buyers from suffering losses due to the purchase of real estate with questionable title. If you buy real estate with a loan, the lending bank will also require you to purchase title insurance in order to protect its own rights and interests. Therefore, there are two types of title insurance. One is the owner’s policy, which protects your rights and interests. The seller usually pays the premium, and the other is the bank policy (Lender’s policy). Policy), in order to protect the interests of the bank, the lender traditionally pays the premium, which can be regarded as part of the loan fee.

e5c5023d9b8f80144be043f15b1d17f5c9e53ad0.sourceText: 以上简单说明产权保险的重要性，如果您有任何房地产方面的问题，非常欢迎您打电话到我的专线(480) 612-4545 或email至Rich@RichLiao.com
e5c5023d9b8f80144be043f15b1d17f5c9e53ad0.translatedText: The above briefly explains the importance of title insurance. If you have any questions about real estate, you are very welcome to call my hotline (480) 612-4545 or email to Rich@RichLiao.com

4aca9b439179936fe1ce1a18cba1ce621df9240e.sourceText: iPhone 5的中国伙伴们 刚刚发布的iPhone 5可以说是”最有中国色彩”的…
4aca9b439179936fe1ce1a18cba1ce621df9240e.translatedText: Chinese partners of iPhone 5 The just-released iPhone 5 can be said to be the “most Chinese”…

a1004010b1aebc237d62742b78e6a6b10f129110.sourceText: 刚刚发布的iPhone 5可以说是”最有中国色彩”的一款苹果产品。这表现在苹果特别为中国用户选择了更多本地的服务提供商，合作伙伴中出现了一系列中国公司的名字。
a1004010b1aebc237d62742b78e6a6b10f129110.translatedText: The just-released iPhone 5 can be said to be the “most Chinese” Apple product. This is reflected in the fact that Apple has chosen more local service providers specifically for Chinese users, and a series of Chinese company names have appeared among its partners.

4fe29d74f047cdca105e614fddbb65f6390308d5.sourceText: iPhone 5的全球版与Facebook、Twitter绑定，中国版则选择与新浪微博和优酷土豆绑定；iOS 6预装的地图服务，苹果在欧美的合作方是老牌荷兰数字地图公司TomTom，中国合作方则是高德导航。默认搜索引擎由谷歌(Google)改成了百度；Siri也将支持普通话和广东话。
4fe29d74f047cdca105e614fddbb65f6390308d5.translatedText: The global version of iPhone 5 is bound to Facebook and Twitter, while the Chinese version chooses to be bound to Sina Weibo and Youku Tudou; for iOS 6’s pre-installed map service, Apple’s partner in Europe and the United States is the old Dutch digital map company TomTom, and its Chinese partner is AutoNavi. The default search engine has been changed from Google to Baidu; Siri will also support Mandarin and Cantonese.

4fbd7c0e49b05e48c8bb6eb9584c9d30ffdd5394.sourceText: 对于绝大多数中国iPhone用户来说，iOS 6中国版这样的安排的确更方便现有用户：优酷土豆是国内网民最常使用的视频分享网站，易观国际发布的去年四季度食品行业收入市场份额，合并前的优酷和土豆分别占到21.8%和13.7%的份额，位居市场前两位。
4fbd7c0e49b05e48c8bb6eb9584c9d30ffdd5394.translatedText: For the vast majority of Chinese iPhone users, the arrangement of the iOS 6 Chinese version is indeed more convenient for existing users: Youku Tudou is the most commonly used video sharing website among domestic netizens. Analysys International released the food industry revenue market share in the fourth quarter of last year. Before the merger, Youku and Tudou accounted for 21.8% and 13.7% respectively, ranking the top two in the market.

9ab22df0573e5933d7f617ab933a0a60432166ff.sourceText: 新浪微博则是除了QQ空间以外国内网民最常使用的社交网站。新浪微博事业部副总经理芦义今年5月曾发布数据称，新浪微博每天更新1亿条微博；移动终端活跃用户比例大约为60%，其中iPhone占比28.7%。也就是说在新浪微博的活跃用户中，iPhone用户占到了17.2%，每天大约发布1700万条微博。而中文Twitter活跃用户数大约不会超过10万；Facebook的中文活跃用户则更少。
9ab22df0573e5933d7f617ab933a0a60432166ff.translatedText: Sina Weibo is the most commonly used social networking site among domestic netizens besides QQ Space. Lu Yi, deputy general manager of Sina Weibo Business Department, released data in May this year that Sina Weibo updates 100 million Weibo posts every day; the proportion of active users on mobile terminals is approximately 60%, of which iPhone accounts for 28.7%. In other words, among the active users of Sina Weibo, iPhone users account for 17.2%, and approximately 17 million Weibo messages are posted every day. The number of active Chinese Twitter users probably does not exceed 100,000; the number of Chinese active Facebook users is even less.

bb2f9c939c7aede630d487ad412b6979c3060596.sourceText: 中国合作伙伴们或许应该感谢网络防火墙的存在，使中国大陆用户无法通过iOS6绑定的Facebook和Twitter收发信息。而苹果的默认搜索引擎从谷歌(Google)换成百度搜索后，将不会再频繁碰到?#36830;接被重置?#30340;现象。
bb2f9c939c7aede630d487ad412b6979c3060596.translatedText: Chinese partners may be grateful for the existence of the network firewall, which prevents mainland Chinese users from sending and receiving information through Facebook and Twitter bound to iOS6. After Apple's default search engine is changed from Google to Baidu search, the phenomenon of "connections being reset" will no longer be encountered frequently.

133733b6a59147edd5cb42ea52b46f082890fb02.sourceText: 高德软件之所以入选苹果在大陆新的地图服务提供商，是因为高德导航在国内智能手机用户中最受欢迎。根据易观国际发布的2012年中国手机地图客户端市场数据监测报告显示：2012年第一季度中国地图服务市场的前四甲分别为高德地图、谷歌地图、百度地图和诺基亚地图；到今年二季度，谷歌地图的市场份额大幅下跌，而诺基亚地图的市场排名则跌倒了第七位。
133733b6a59147edd5cb42ea52b46f082890fb02.translatedText: The reason why AutoNavi was selected as Apple’s new map service provider in mainland China is because AutoNavi is the most popular among domestic smartphone users. According to the 2012 China Mobile Map Client Market Data Monitoring Report released by Analysys International, the top four players in China's map service market in the first quarter of 2012 were Amap, Google Maps, Baidu Maps and Nokia Maps. By the second quarter of this year, Google Maps' market share had dropped significantly, while Nokia Maps' market ranking fell to seventh place.

c36917369f096d7ececc57a98a921124ea3f51d7.sourceText: 与苹果合作后，高德地图或将继续拉开与其它竞争者的差距。就像苹果成功帮助中国联通在3G领域与中国移动抗衡一样。根据三大运营商公布的2011年度3G用户数量，中国联通（上海交易所代码：600050）、中国移动（香港交易所代码：00941）和中国电信的3G市场份额分别为31%、40%和29%。而在2G时代，中国移动独占80%以上的市场份额。
c36917369f096d7ececc57a98a921124ea3f51d7.translatedText: After cooperating with Apple, Amap may continue to widen the gap with other competitors. Just like Apple successfully helped China Unicom compete with China Mobile in the 3G field. According to the number of 3G users announced by the three major operators in 2011, the 3G market shares of China Unicom (Shanghai Stock Exchange Code: 600050), China Mobile (Hong Kong Stock Exchange Code: 00941) and China Telecom were 31%, 40% and 29% respectively. In the 2G era, China Mobile held more than 80% of the market share.

96deacb6c7f3f8a882305b06341f5edea1762e33.sourceText: 高德入选也得益于中国政府对地图业务的准入限制。根据国家测绘地理信息局等发布的相关法规规定：由于地图涉及国家安全，若外资企业要在中国开展地图业务，需要将数据服务器设在中国大陆、接受国家测绘地理信息局的监管；需要获得互联网服务运营资质牌照；还需要与中国本土有资质的地图数据供应商合作。这样严苛的规定，基本上断送了外国数字地图公司在中国大范围开展业务的可能。2011年11月，谷歌地图就提出了申请，但根据公开报告截止2012年7月其依然未能获得相关资质。
96deacb6c7f3f8a882305b06341f5edea1762e33.translatedText: Amap’s selection also benefited from the Chinese government’s access restrictions on the map business. According to relevant regulations issued by the National Bureau of Surveying, Mapping and Geographic Information, etc.: Since maps involve national security, if foreign-funded enterprises want to conduct map services in China, they need to set up their data servers in mainland China and accept the supervision of the National Bureau of Surveying, Mapping and Geographic Information; they need to obtain an Internet service operation qualification license; they also need to cooperate with local qualified map data suppliers in China. Such stringent regulations have basically eliminated the possibility for foreign digital map companies to conduct business on a large scale in China. Google Maps applied for it in November 2011, but according to public reports, it still failed to obtain the relevant qualifications as of July 2012.

a91993189b143445595013f744c4efab10639083.sourceText: 但有人欢喜，也有人失落。笔者认为，在选择中国合作伙伴上，苹果也秉承了它的”全球标准”：即拒绝与具有强大垄断性优势、以及和核心业务存在可能冲突的公司合作。
a91993189b143445595013f744c4efab10639083.translatedText: But some people are happy and some are disappointed. The author believes that when selecting Chinese partners, Apple has also adhered to its "global standards": that is, it refuses to cooperate with companies that have strong monopoly advantages and may conflict with its core business.

1bdde77ff93e24d00f76247528236d5e4d5e08b9.sourceText: 财经博客PingEast曾援引可靠人士的信息称，在iOS 6发布之前几个月，腾讯在加州帕罗 阿尔图(Palo Alto)办事处的工作人员曾积极与苹果接触，希望能在iOS 6中深度整合腾讯的服务，但结果令腾讯失望。这一信息未得到腾讯确认。
1bdde77ff93e24d00f76247528236d5e4d5e08b9.translatedText: Financial blog PingEast once quoted reliable sources as saying that a few months before the release of iOS 6, staff at Tencent’s Palo Alto office in California had actively contacted Apple in the hope of deeply integrating Tencent’s services in iOS 6, but the results disappointed Tencent. This information has not been confirmed by Tencent.

1256e7b6fde1302da734960425dfd862213aed83.sourceText: 商业谈判的不成功，或许出于双方对合作前景的理解不同。若单从数据上看，腾讯的QQ空间比新浪微博的用户群更广。
1256e7b6fde1302da734960425dfd862213aed83.translatedText: The failure of business negotiations may be due to the different understanding of the prospects of cooperation between the two parties. If you look at the data alone, Tencent’s QQ Zone has a wider user base than Sina Weibo.

3b6dd1e74ca798a468f0dce247e15388aa99f64f.sourceText: 根据国内最大的社交分享工具提供商JiaThis发布的《2012年上半年国内社会化媒体分享数据排行报告》，国内用户使用分享最多的是QQ空间，其次才是新浪微博，分别占分享百分比的13.26%和9.79%；而腾讯的另一个社交平台腾讯微博的分享百分比为8.37%，仅比新浪微博低了1.5个百分点。QQ空间的回点百分比（回点百分比是指某一社会化媒体中所分享的网页链接浏览次数占所有社会化媒体中所分享的网页链接浏览次数总和的百分比）高达47.14%，新浪微博仅为18.44%，在QQ空间分享链接的效果是新浪微博的2.5倍。
3b6dd1e74ca798a468f0dce247e15388aa99f64f.translatedText: According to the "Domestic Social Media Sharing Data Ranking Report for the First Half of 2012" released by JiaThis, the largest provider of social sharing tools in China, QQ Zone is the most shared by domestic users, followed by Sina Weibo, accounting for 13.26% and 9.79% of the sharing percentage respectively; while the sharing percentage of Tencent's other social platform Tencent Weibo is 8.37%, which is only 1.5 percentage points lower than Sina Weibo. The percentage of clickbacks in QQ Space (the percentage of clickbacks refers to the number of page link views shared in a certain social media as a percentage of the total number of page link views shared in all social media) is as high as 47.14%, while that of Sina Weibo is only 18.44%. The effect of link sharing in QQ Space is 2.5 times that of Sina Weibo.

7390d81add02668fc730eccac5d51f20d4643a17.sourceText: 同样被苹果拒之门外的还有科大讯飞（深圳交易所代码：002030），这是国内一家专业从事智能语音及语言技术研究的软件企业。据科大讯飞副总裁江涛介绍，他们于6月21日将讯飞语点提交到iOS App Store，正常情况下7－10天就能完成申请。但对语点的审核去迟至7月3日才开始，迄今这款中文语音助理产品都未能通过苹果的审核。
7390d81add02668fc730eccac5d51f20d4643a17.translatedText: Also rejected by Apple is iFlytek (Shenzhen Stock Exchange Code: 002030), a domestic software company specializing in intelligent voice and language technology research. According to Jiang Tao, vice president of iFlytek, they submitted iFlytek to the iOS App Store on June 21. Under normal circumstances, the application can be completed in 7-10 days. However, the review of Yudian did not start until July 3, and so far this Chinese voice assistant product has failed to pass Apple’s review.

e40c804973cd95d64602795241aa775ac268e19b.sourceText: 江涛曾在一次私人会面时告诉笔者，苹果给出的拒绝理由是没有产品介绍视频。业内诸多人都认为这是一个非常有趣的理由。这或许只是苹果的官方借口，根本原因恐怕是其害怕讯飞语点对Siri造成的可能冲击。Siri是iOS中唯一一款仍处于测试版的产品，虽然讯飞语点的智能性、实用性都算不上有多好，但苹果显然不愿意看到本地语音公司从它并不完善的测试版产品手里抢夺用户。
e40c804973cd95d64602795241aa775ac268e19b.translatedText: Jiang Tao once told the author in a private meeting that the reason given by Apple for rejection was that there was no product introduction video. Many people in the industry think this is a very interesting reason. This may just be Apple's official excuse. The root cause may be that it is afraid of the possible impact that iFlytek Voice Point may have on Siri. Siri is the only product in iOS that is still in beta. Although the intelligence and practicality of iFlytek Voice Point are not very good, Apple is obviously not willing to see local voice companies snatch users from its imperfect beta products.

ea8ae8c6e78a2ed88919c3aa34b924b5d51e9201.sourceText: 被苹果拒绝了的科大讯飞在上个月选择接受中国移动的投资，占股高达15%；它的投资人也同样也遭到了苹果的拒绝，其在中国大陆选择了另一家电信运营商中国联通。远在加州的腾讯员工或许仍在努力尝试接洽苹果。
ea8ae8c6e78a2ed88919c3aa34b924b5d51e9201.translatedText: iFlytek, which was rejected by Apple, chose to accept investment from China Mobile last month, accounting for 15% of the shares; its investors were also rejected by Apple, and it chose China Unicom, another telecom operator in mainland China. Tencent employees in California may still be trying hard to contact Apple.

202c96d3ed092a091d005370b1140278d9e8ccf7.sourceText: 对于这些合作伙伴，苹果有把控力，无论是说还是说不。但对于另外一些更”倚赖”苹果的人群，苹果却无计可施。深圳的制造商正将他们提前造好的iPhone 5保护壳运往香港和美国；淘宝上的代购卖家们正发动所有能发动的资源，赶在iPhone 5在国内上市前通过倒卖大赚一笔；还有苹果专门店门口随时准备推销iPhone的黄牛。
202c96d3ed092a091d005370b1140278d9e8ccf7.translatedText: Apple has control over these partners, whether they say yes or no. But for other people who are more "reliant" on Apple, Apple has nothing to do. Manufacturers in Shenzhen are shipping their pre-made iPhone 5 protective cases to Hong Kong and the United States; purchasing agents on Taobao are mobilizing all available resources to make a fortune by reselling iPhone 5 before it is launched in China; there are also scalpers at the entrance of Apple stores ready to promote iPhones.

33b62450c4e2b85823adeb74739914f9eceb7aa7.translatedText: Shi Beichen is a researcher on the value of unlisted technology companies and a technology columnist.

638338f303743fd3c203235810b17115591d967d.sourceText: H-1B及申请SSI问答 1. 问今年的H-1B 名额会不会很快用完?我的OPT 即将到期，申请了H-1B 之后可以延期我的OPT 吗? 移民局对雇主的最低要求是什么? 有没有员工人数及营业额的要求?新成立的公司可以为员工申请H-1B 吗? 答：以目前H-1B 的使用状况，FY-2012 H-1B 新名额到今年年底之前都不会有用完的情况。原则上移民局对于雇主并没有明文要求，但是坊间流传着移民局的内部对于H-1B 雇主有以下几点基本要求：公司成立10年以上，年营业额超过1000 万美金，以及有超过25个人以上的员工。这个资料大约是去年年初流出来的，但是也不是移民局审理的唯一标准。 大公司的批准率当然比小公司来的大的多， 因为成立时间较久以及营业额较高公司比起刚起步的公司的信任度来得高，也就比较容易获得批准。但是新成立的公司也不是没有获批的可能。只不过这家新成立的公司要提供足够的证据像是商业计划，资金来源，客户来源，研究发展方面等相关文件来证明这家公司有发展而且能够正常营运。 目前的移民法规，允许特定的学生在特定的情况下，只要该学生的FY-2012 的H-1B 申请获得批准或等待审理期间，都可以延期F-1 或OPT.只要你要求的H-1B 开始工作时间是10月1日(只能是10月1日)，在你F-1 的有效时间内提出了H-1B 的申请，就符合Cap-Gap 延期的要求。F-1 有效时间包括：你的 F-1 学生是在duration of status (D/S) 的时间内，并保留有效的学生身分，你在OPT 的有效时间内，及OPT 到期后60天内”宽限期”内。 一旦你在F-1 有效时间内提出H-1B 的申请，并要求在美国转换身分，你的Cap-Gap 就自动延期。如果你的H-1B 批准了，你的Cap-Gap 就自动延长至9月30日，如果不幸H-1B 申请被撤销、取消、或拒绝，在H-1B 被拒绝通知日起或你的原始身分到期日起(以最晚的日起为主)， 有60 天的宽限期。如果你的H-1B 之后被拒，撤销或取消，从移民局发出的通知日起有60天的宽限期让你准备回国。 2. 问：我的母亲享有联邦医疗保险(Medicare)、州医疗补助计划(Medicaid)、社会安全生活补助金 (SSI)和食物券。当她申请SSI时，我已透露她和我们居住，她无需付租金但付膳食费和水电费。假如我购买一所房子给她，并用她的名字登记，这是否会影响她目前享有的福利和是否需要通知社安局？另一办法，我买一所较大的房子，加入我母亲的名字但她仍然与我们一起住，这是否会影响她目前享有的福利以及我是否应通知社安局？ 答：不管您买一所房子给您母亲或是买一间较大的房子加入她的名字，只要她仍在该房子居住而其他资格没有更改，这对她目前享有的福利应没有影响。但您母亲应通知社安局资产和地址都有更改。 只有SSI、Medicaid和Food Stamps受到资产和收入限制。Medicare(联邦医疗保险)没有这些限制。换言之，即使令慈的收入或资产超过限额，她会失去SSI，医疗补助和食物券，但她仍然可以继续保持她的Medicare。然而，由于她失去了 Medicaid，她可能需要付Medicare月费及其他Medicare费用，例如预付额(Deductibles)和共付保险(Coinsurance)。
638338f303743fd3c203235810b17115591d967d.translatedText: H-1B and applying for SSI Q&A 1. Question: Will this year’s H-1B quota be used up soon? My OPT is about to expire, so I applied for H-1B Can I extend my OPT later? What are the minimum requirements for employers by the Immigration Bureau? Are there any requirements on the number of employees and turnover? Can a newly established company apply for H-1B for employees? Answer: Based on the current use of H-1B, the new FY-2012 H-1B quota will not be used up before the end of this year. In principle, the Immigration Bureau has no explicit requirements for employers, but it is rumored that the Immigration Bureau has the following basic requirements for H-1B employers: the company has been established for more than 10 years, the annual turnover exceeds 10 million US dollars, and there are more than 25 employees. This information leaked out around the beginning of last year, but it is not the only criterion for the Immigration Bureau’s review. Of course, the approval rate of large companies is much higher than that of small companies. Because companies with longer establishment times and higher turnover have higher trust than companies that have just started, it is easier to obtain approval. However, it is not impossible for newly established companies to obtain approval. However, the newly established company must provide sufficient evidence such as business plan, funding sources, customer sources, research and development and other relevant documents to prove that the company has developed and can operate normally. Current immigration regulations allow specific students to extend F-1 or OPT under certain circumstances as long as the student's H-1B application for FY-2012 is approved or pending. As long as the H-1B start date you require is October 1st (can only be October 1st), and you file an H-1B application within the validity period of your F-1, you will meet the requirements for Cap-Gap extension. The validity period of F-1 includes: your F-1 student is in duration of status (D/S) and retains valid student status, you are within the validity period of OPT, and the "grace period" within 60 days after the expiration of OPT. Once you file an H-1B application within the F-1 validity period and request a change of status in the United States, your Cap-Gap will be automatically extended. If your H-1B is approved, your Cap-Gap will be automatically extended to September 30. If unfortunately the H-1B application is revoked, canceled, or denied, there will be a 60-day grace period from the date of the H-1B denial notification or the expiration date of your original status (whichever is the latest). If your H-1B is later denied, revoked, or canceled, you have a 60-day grace period from the date of notification by the USCIS to prepare to return to your home country. 2. Question: My mother receives Medicare, Medicaid, SSI, and food stamps. When she applied for SSI, I disclosed that she was living with us and that she would not have to pay rent but would pay for meals and utilities. If I buy a house for her and register it in her name, will this affect her current benefits and will she need to notify Social Security? Alternatively, if I buy a larger house and add my mother's name but she still lives with us, will this affect her current benefits and should I notify Social Security? Answer: Whether you buy a house for your mother or buy a larger house and add her name to it, as long as she is still living in the house and her other qualifications have not changed, this should have no impact on the benefits she currently enjoys. However, your mother should notify Social Security of the change in assets and address. Only SSI, Medicaid and Food Stamps are subject to asset and income limits. Medicare does not have these restrictions. In other words, even if Lingci's income or assets exceed the limit and she loses SSI, Medicaid, and food stamps, she can still keep her Medicare. However, since she loses Medicaid, she may have to pay Medicare monthly fees and other Medicare costs, such as deductibles and coinsurance.

1e62379d8ee70af0ac52c5ec6d699bd6c4ba1b8d.sourceText: 中国官媒社论：继续忍耐 世界新闻网 中国官方媒体14日纷以社论方式表达对越南「继续忍耐」的态度。「人民日报」旗下的「环球时报」社评以「在南海较力未必是越菲的长项」为题，说明「中国作为大国，在南海的行动无法受任何国家的牵制和诱导，自己的原则必须十分清晰、稳定」； 「解放军报」在「激化矛盾无助于南海问题」的社论中指出「(南海)争端必须由当事双方通过友好协商以和平方式解决，中国坚决反对与南海问题无关的国家插手南海争议，反对将南海问题国际化、多边化、扩大化」。 「环球时报」指出，南海向来平静，是美国宣布介入南海事务后，整个地区出现奇妙化学反应，越南、菲律宾冲动表态，成为美国的提线木偶，美国永远做操盘手，但不会为建这座围堵中国的墙真正花钱埋单。 社评称，美国与中国这样的大国直接军事对抗，后果完全非南海能装得下。美国可能在南海给中国制造点麻烦，但中美关系较力是整个世界舞台，不是南海这样的角落。河内和马尼拉应该清楚，它们行为正在把南海从讲理、讲妥协的地方变成一个讲谁实力强、谁盟友多的地方。「而较力未必是它们的长项」。 社评称，中国与美国长期斗而不破，与小国要有同样耐心和豁达。中国要走向世界，一定会处理好周边边麻烦。 「解放军报」社论则指出，越南军演这些渲染争端、激化矛盾的做法，无助于南海问题的解决。这需要各方拿出诚意与耐心，以合作的姿态、通过沟通和协商妥善处理。这也是中方一贯的态度。 社论指，这种争端须由当事双方通过友好协商以和平方式解决，坚决反对与南海问题无关的国家插手南海争议，反对将南海问题国际化、多边化、扩大化，否则历史证明， 只会把事情越弄越糟。
1e62379d8ee70af0ac52c5ec6d699bd6c4ba1b8d.translatedText: Chinese official media editorial: Continue to be patient. World News Network Chinese official media expressed their attitude towards Vietnam in editorials on the 14th to "continue to be patient." An editorial in the Global Times, a subsidiary of the People's Daily, titled "Strength in the South China Sea may not be Vietnam and the Philippines' strengths," explains that "as a major country, China's actions in the South China Sea cannot be constrained or induced by any country, and its own principles must be very clear and stable." The People's Liberation Army Daily stated in an editorial that "intensifying conflicts will not help the South China Sea issue" that "(South China Sea) disputes must be resolved peacefully through friendly consultations between the parties concerned. China firmly opposes the intervention of countries that have nothing to do with the South China Sea issue in the South China Sea dispute, and opposes the internationalization, multilateralization, and expansion of the South China Sea issue." "Global Times" pointed out that the South China Sea has always been peaceful. It was after the United States announced its intervention in the South China Sea affairs that a wonderful chemical reaction occurred in the entire region. Vietnam and the Philippines made impulsive statements and became the puppets of the United States. The United States will always be the operator, but will not actually pay for the construction of this wall to contain China. The editorial stated that the consequences of a direct military confrontation between the United States and a major country like China would be completely unbearable in the South China Sea. The United States may cause some trouble for China in the South China Sea, but the competition between China and the United States is on the entire world stage, not in corners like the South China Sea. Hanoi and Manila should know that their actions are turning the South China Sea from a place of reason and compromise into a place of who is more powerful and has more allies. "And competition may not be their strong point." The editorial said that China and the United States have been fighting for a long time without breaking up, and they must be as patient and open-minded as small countries. If China wants to go global, it must deal with its surrounding problems. The "Liberation Army Daily" editorial pointed out that Vietnam's military exercises, which exaggerate disputes and intensify conflicts, are not conducive to the resolution of the South China Sea issue. This requires all parties to show sincerity and patience, adopt a cooperative attitude, and properly handle it through communication and negotiation. This is also China's consistent attitude. The editorial stated that such disputes must be resolved peacefully through friendly consultations between the parties concerned. We firmly oppose the intervention of countries that have nothing to do with the South China Sea issue and the internationalization, multilateralization and expansion of the South China Sea issue. Otherwise, history has proven that it will only make things worse.

ebe89eb29aa3f4294207cf556b9da2ac7f82ac10.sourceText: 前CVS主管印儿童色情图片获刑15年 （亚省时报） 凤凰城居民，前CVS药店主管，因印刷数百张儿童色情图片，被判处15年徒刑。 迈克尔布朗曾任喷泉山一家CVS药店主管，被一名雇员发现上班期间利用药店的照片印刷机冲印年轻女孩的裸照。雇员报警将其拘留。 布朗认罪后称，曾印刷过数百张未满14岁女孩的全身裸或半身裸照片。法官康妮康思提判处其15年徒刑，并一生接受性犯罪监管。
ebe89eb29aa3f4294207cf556b9da2ac7f82ac10.translatedText: Former CVS executive was sentenced to 15 years in prison for printing child pornographic images (Alberta Times) Phoenix resident and former CVS pharmacy supervisor was sentenced to 15 years in prison for printing hundreds of child pornography images. Michael Brown, a former supervisor at a CVS pharmacy in Fountain Hills, was caught by an employee using the store's photo printing machine to develop nude photos of young girls while on the job. Employees called police to take him into custody. After Brown pleaded guilty, he said he had printed hundreds of nude or partially nude photos of girls under the age of 14. Judge Connie Consti sentenced him to 15 years in prison and a lifetime of sexual offender supervision.

65f1c05c402cb565a60799999c06d0362f86d14a.sourceText: （本网编译）凤凰城的空中列车线路，昨天（2013年4月8日）正式开通运行。这个线路是指44街与华盛顿街交界轻轨站，到机场四号站台。乘客乘坐这段轻轨完全免费，而且是24小时运行。在高峰时段，大约每三分钟就有轻轨到站运送客人。从44街与华盛顿街交界轻轨站到站台只需5分钟时间。下面我们就来了解一下线路上各种便民服务。
65f1c05c402cb565a60799999c06d0362f86d14a.translatedText: (Compiled by this website) Phoenix's sky train line was officially opened for operation yesterday (April 8, 2013). This line refers to the light rail station at the intersection of 44th Street and Washington Street, to the Airport Platform 4. It is completely free for passengers to ride this light rail, and it operates 24 hours a day. During peak hours, light rail will arrive approximately every three minutes to transport passengers. It only takes 5 minutes from the 44th Street and Washington Street light rail station to the platform. Let’s take a look at the various convenient services on the line.

b6d5b5670539eef40c50e822c6e02b31ccc907f8.sourceText: 在44街与华盛顿街交界轻轨站：（Station Amenities 44th Street & Washington ） 可以在到站台之前就打印好登机牌 西南航空和US Airways的乘客可以提前托运行李 到达后可以购买轻轨票，转乘到凤凰城各地（购票点在二楼）。 这里有免费停车乘客接站点（车辆停留不可超过半小时） 有宠物存放处 喂食处 东边的停车点（East Economy ） 可以在到站台之前就打印好登机牌 西南航空和US Airways的乘客可以提前托运行李 将会有循环车将乘客运从停车处运送到轻轨站 这里有付费停车的乘客接站点 有宠物存放处 喂食处 在上轻轨时，请核对需要前往的站台，注意轻轨行驶方向，这里有两个方向的轻轨
b6d5b5670539eef40c50e822c6e02b31ccc907f8.translatedText: At the light rail station at the junction of 44th Street and Washington Street: (Station Amenities 44th Street & Washington) You can print your boarding pass before arriving at the platform. Passengers of Southwest Airlines and US Airways can check in their luggage in advance. After arriving, you can buy light rail tickets and transfer to various places in Phoenix (the ticket purchase point is on the second floor). There is a free parking passenger pick-up point here (vehicles cannot stay for more than half an hour). There is a pet storage area and a feeding area. There is a parking spot on the east side (East Economy). You can print your boarding pass before arriving at the platform. Passengers of Southwest Airlines and US Airways can check their luggage in advance. There will be a circulating car to transport passengers from the parking area to the light rail station. There is a paid parking passenger pick-up area. There is a pet storage area and a feeding area. When boarding the light rail, please check the platform you need to go to and pay attention to the direction of the light rail. There are light rails in two directions

5d5d61c345531524cb8fdafd29aa674711d6454c.sourceText: 4号站台 到了4号站台，乘客将在三楼下轻轨，可以步行到各自的站台达乘航班。
5d5d61c345531524cb8fdafd29aa674711d6454c.translatedText: Platform 4. At Platform 4, passengers will get off the light rail on the third floor and can walk to their respective platforms to catch their flights.

7f6b2183e11c37e684f0a5c288288af6bbfa10e7.sourceText: I-10两辆汽车相撞事故 致7人死亡 凤凰城附近29日发生两辆汽车相撞事故，造成7人死亡。 此次事故发生在10号公路上，位于凤凰城以西约60英里的一个路段，一辆半拖车越过高速公路的中间线，与一辆货车迎头相撞，后均起火燃烧。 死者均是货车内的乘客。半拖车的司机与其妻子受伤，已被送到医院。 被撞货车上载有至少7人，死者的身份及籍贯还没有确认。
7f6b2183e11c37e684f0a5c288288af6bbfa10e7.translatedText: Two cars collided on I-10, killing 7 people. Two cars collided near Phoenix on the 29th, killing 7 people. The accident occurred on Highway 10, about 60 miles west of Phoenix. A semi-trailer crossed the center line of the highway and collided head-on with a truck, both of which burst into flames. The deceased were all passengers in the truck. The driver of the semitrailer and his wife were injured and taken to the hospital. The truck that was hit was carrying at least seven people. The identity and place of origin of the deceased have not yet been confirmed.

a57c6175af94e4ac9fb84dba5c6b6bd6609c3e33.translatedText: > First place: Niagara Falls, N.Y., New York. The average listing price of a four-bedroom, two-bathroom home in the area is US$60,820 (equivalent to approximately RMB 394,000).

24881df43659664a054fb0a456ca746927aa4896.sourceText: （Celia Lee 供稿 Barry Wong提供照片）十一月四日选举之夜，共和党大胜民主党，在参、众议院皆赢得多数。在共和党选举之夜庆祝派对上，许多共和党的国会代表，亚利桑那州参、众议员及州政府重要职务胜选人，都上台发表对未来上任的选民期许与身负重任。
24881df43659664a054fb0a456ca746927aa4896.translatedText: (Contributed by Celia Lee Barry Photo provided by Wong) On November 4th, the Republican Party defeated the Democratic Party and won the majority in both the Senate and the House of Representatives. At the Republican election night celebration party, many Republican congressional representatives, Arizona senators, representatives and candidates for important state government positions took the stage to express their expectations for future voters and their heavy responsibilities.

98c3469744839f04d072ac54893b9d561214db71.sourceText: 庆祝晚会高潮当属于亚利桑那新任州长–Doug Ducey，, 在现任州长Jan Brewer 及新任州长夫人Mrs. Angela Ducey的介绍致词后，Doug Ducey 在支持者的欢呼中发表胜利演说。他说: ”我当选后必将致力于创造亚利桑那州成为充满机会之地；” 并说: ”我将确保亚利桑那不会成为高税收州政府及避免乱无目的的政府支出。”他也说: ”我将成为为全民服务的州长，就如同我竞选的承诺与愿景– 广集众议，结合人民。”
98c3469744839f04d072ac54893b9d561214db71.translatedText: The climax of the celebration party was undoubtedly the new governor of Arizona – Doug Ducey, with the current governor Jan Brewer and the new governor’s wife Mrs. Angela. After Ducey's introduction, Doug Ducey delivered a victory speech amid cheers from supporters. He said: "After I am elected, I will be committed to making Arizona a land of opportunity;" and said: "I will ensure that Arizona does not become a high-tax state and avoid random government spending." He also said: "I will be a governor who serves all people, just like the promises and vision of my campaign- Gather public opinions and unite the people."

6f6a53c77e6c95ce638069c6da8ebf9eb18ab5e4.translatedText: Doug Ducey is not only a successful entrepreneur (who established the "Cold Stone" Cold Stone Creamery ice cream kingdom), but also an outstanding current state treasurer. The Chinese community held a grand fundraising breakfast to support Doug Ducey. Chinese media introduced Doug Ducey’s background information and his outstanding achievements in politics over the years. His election is a great honor for the Chinese supporters who helped raise funds! Ducey will take office in January next year. He will use practical actions to prove that our Chinese community is the right choice.

c0b4de7a87f8eed7a2d8ba4f8376d8c68d1c6974.sourceText: 参院推增H1B取消绿卡限额法案 两党参议员计划下周提出高科技移民议案，提议包括大幅增加面向高技能外籍专才的H-1B签证额度等一系列对高科技移民有利的措施。国会山新闻网站The Hill报道，两位共和党籍参议员，犹他州的哈奇和佛州的卢比奥，联同两位民主党籍参议员，德拉瓦州的库恩斯和明尼苏达州的克罗巴卡，一起提出这个「移民创新法案」（Immigration Innovation Act）。 议案提议，将H-1B的签证额从现时的6.5万大幅增加至11.5万；建立「以市场为基准的H-1B签证额调整机制」，如果H-1B签证额在具体某一年很快就满额，签证额将可以增加，但一年最多不超过30万；取消高学历人士H-1B的签证限额，这个给硕士或以上学历外国毕业生的签证额现时为2万个。 特别惹人注意的是，议案还授权H-1B签证持有人的配偶可以在美国工作。这个问题多年来一直是一个棘手的问题。 议案还希望减少绿卡积压，允许特定人群不受工作绿卡配额限制，免受配额制约的人包括工作绿卡持有人的扶养人、杰出教授与研究员、拥有美国大学数学、科学和工程专业高等学历的外国毕业生。同时取消对每个国家工作绿卡的限额。 此外，议案还主张增加僱主申请H-1B签证的费用和工作绿卡申请费。这些增加的收入将用于推动在科学、技术、工程和数学领域教育的计划，以及在各州层面的再培训。 据预期，这一议案将获得科技界的支持。多年来，科技界一直呼吁华盛顿进行高科技移民改革。 类似微软和英特尔等科技公司一直声称，由于缺乏合格的申请人，他们在填补工程和研究方面的空缺方面一直有困难。 他们还声称，现时的移民规定导致外籍高科技工人流失到外国竞争对手那边。科技业高度依赖H-1B计划聘用外国僱员，担任科学家、工程师及电脑程序员等高学历科技人才的工作。 白宫25日宣布，奥巴马总统计划29日前往拉斯韦加斯举行活动，正式开始推动移民政策改革。 白宫在奥巴马及部分高级官员当天上午与国会拉美裔党团成员就移民政策改革问题会晤后发表声明说，奥巴马在会晤中重申，移民政策改革应是立法重点，不容延误，他本人将继续在移民政策改革议题上担当主要推动者，并在29日拉斯韦加斯之行中大力推进改善现有移民体系的努力。 白宫还在声明中说，奥巴马和国会拉美裔党团成员就部分改革举措达成共识，一致认为移民政策改革方案应涉及部分非法移民获得公民身份的程序问题。 当天参加会晤的众议院民主党党团主席泽维尔?#36125;塞拉发表声明说，奥巴马在会晤中强调推动全面移民政策改革刻不容缓，表达出改变移民体系长期以来问题重重的决心。 奥巴马在2012年谋求连任的总统竞选中一直承诺将推行移民政策改革。他在自己首个任期内并未推动从立法层面改革现有移民政策，但在去年竞选白热化阶段通过行政手段暂缓遣返部分年轻非法移民。在此前两度总统竞选中，拉美裔选民均成为支持奥巴马的重要票仓，而移民政策改革问题是他们最关注的议题之一。 非法移民问题一直是美国社会热点问题，成因复杂，牵涉面广。据估计，美国现有超过1000万非法移民，大部分来自墨西哥等拉美国家，如何有效解决非法移民问题困扰美国各届政府已久。随着族群规模不断扩大，拉美裔选民对选情的影响力也令两大政党不得不对移民问题高度重视。
c0b4de7a87f8eed7a2d8ba4f8376d8c68d1c6974.translatedText: The Senate pushes forward a bill to eliminate the green card quota for H1B. Senators from both parties plan to introduce a high-tech immigration bill next week, proposing a series of measures that are beneficial to high-tech immigrants, including a substantial increase in the H-1B visa quota for high-skilled foreign professionals. The Hill news website The Hill reported that two Republican senators, Hatch of Utah and Rubio of Florida, and two Democratic senators, Coons of Delaware and Klobacka of Minnesota, jointly proposed the "Immigration Innovation Act." The bill proposes to significantly increase the H-1B visa quota from the current 65,000 to 115,000; to establish a "market-based H-1B visa quota adjustment mechanism". If the H-1B visa quota is full soon in a specific year, the visa quota will be increased, but not to exceed 300,000 per year; and to cancel the H-1B visa quota for highly educated people. The visa quota for foreign graduates with a master's degree or above is currently 20,000. What is particularly eye-catching is that the bill also authorizes spouses of H-1B visa holders to work in the United States. This question has been a thorny one for years. The bill also hopes to reduce the green card backlog and allow certain groups of people to be exempted from employment-based green card quotas. Those exempted from quotas include dependents of employment-based green card holders, outstanding professors and researchers, and foreign graduates with advanced degrees in mathematics, science, and engineering from American universities. At the same time, the limit on green cards for work in each country will be lifted. In addition, the bill also advocates increasing the fees for employers to apply for H-1B visas and employment green card application fees. These increased revenues will be used to promote programs in education in science, technology, engineering and mathematics fields, as well as retraining at the state level. It is expected that this bill will gain support from the technology community. The tech community has been calling on Washington for years to enact high-tech immigration reform. Tech companies like Microsoft and Intel have claimed they have had trouble filling engineering and research vacancies due to a lack of qualified applicants. They also claim that current immigration rules result in the loss of foreign high-tech workers to foreign competitors. The technology industry relies heavily on the H-1B program to hire foreign employees to serve as highly educated technology professionals such as scientists, engineers and computer programmers. The White House announced on the 25th that President Obama plans to go to Las Vegas to hold an event on the 29th to officially start promoting immigration policy reform. The White House issued a statement after Obama and some senior officials met with members of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus on immigration policy reform that morning. During the meeting, Obama reiterated that immigration policy reform should be a legislative priority and cannot be delayed. He himself will continue to be the main promoter on the issue of immigration policy reform and vigorously promote efforts to improve the existing immigration system during his trip to Las Vegas on the 29th. The White House also said in a statement that Obama and members of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus reached consensus on some reform measures and agreed that the immigration policy reform plan should involve some procedural issues for illegal immigrants to obtain citizenship. House Democratic Caucus Chairman Xavier Serra, who attended the meeting that day, issued a statement saying that during the meeting, Obama emphasized the urgency of promoting comprehensive immigration policy reform and expressed his determination to change the long-standing problems in the immigration system. During his 2012 re-election campaign, Obama promised to reform immigration policy. During his first term, he did not promote legislative reform of existing immigration policies, but during the heat of the campaign last year, he used administrative means to suspend the deportation of some young illegal immigrants. In the previous two presidential elections, Hispanic voters became an important vote base supporting Obama, and immigration policy reform was one of their top concerns. The issue of illegal immigration has always been a hot issue in American society, with complex causes and wide implications. It is estimated that there are more than 10 million illegal immigrants in the United States, most of whom come from Latin American countries such as Mexico. How to effectively solve the problem of illegal immigration has troubled various U.S. governments for a long time. As the size of the ethnic group continues to expand, the influence of Hispanic voters on the election has also forced the two major political parties to attach great importance to the immigration issue.

3927fefdb9867cdc338a311d77630c4ebc4e29ff.sourceText: J1暑期工作签证重大修正 在外国大学生暑期打工旅游计划(Summer Work and Travel Program)接连爆出弊端后，国务院4日宣布，这项计划的J1签证规定，将做重大修正，旨在加强保护外国学生，让他们受到适当对待，从事与美国人有互动、接触美国文化的工作，不得被迫做”奴工”。 有些新规定立即生效，其它规定将在11月实施，包括一条重要条款：禁止参加此一计划的外国学生在制造业、建筑工地、农业等领域工作，也不准外国学生在深夜10时至凌晨6时的时段工作。 副助理国务卿洛宾勒纳在声明中表示：”暑期打工旅游计划的新改革，重点在于加强维护参加学生的健康、安全和福祉，并使这个计划回到主要宗旨：让国际学生体验美国文化。” J1签证每年暑期引进约10万名外国学生来美生活及打工，他们最多可停留四个月。美联社调查发现，某些外国学生竟在脱衣舞俱乐部打工；有的被迫从事不愿做的工作；还有一些外国学生工作情况如同奴工。 J1签证是根据1961年傅尔布莱特─海斯法(Fulbright-Hays Act)设立，用意良好，但多年来这个计划被滥用，发生弊端，美联社去年揭发后，国务卿希拉里‧克林顿下令彻底检讨。 调查发现，问题主要出在缺乏管制的第三方─中介。这些中介负责与学生打交道。最严重的滥用案例是一名女生原被告知在维吉尼亚州做女侍，结果遭殴打、强暴，然 后被迫在底特律跳脱衣舞；去年8月，数十名学生在宾州好时(Hershey)巧克力公司的包装工厂抗议，抱怨工作过于劳苦，薪水还要扣除房租，赚的钱太少。
3927fefdb9867cdc338a311d77630c4ebc4e29ff.translatedText: Major revisions to the J1 summer work visa Major revisions to the summer work and travel program for foreign college students (Summer Work and Travel Program), the State Department announced on the 4th that major revisions will be made to the J1 visa regulations of this program, aiming to strengthen the protection of foreign students, so that they can be treated appropriately, engage in jobs that interact with Americans, and are exposed to American culture, and must not be forced to do "slave labor." Some new regulations will take effect immediately, and other regulations will be implemented in November, including an important clause: foreign students participating in this program are prohibited from working in manufacturing, construction sites, agriculture and other fields, and foreign students are not allowed to work between 10 o'clock in the evening and 6 o'clock in the morning. Deputy Assistant Secretary Robin Lerner said in a statement: "The new reforms to the summer working travel program focus on strengthening the health, safety and welfare of participating students and returning the program to its main purpose: allowing international students to experience American culture." J1 visas bring in about 100,000 foreign students to live and work in the United States each summer, and they can stay for up to four months. The Associated Press investigation found that some foreign students actually work in strip clubs; some are forced to do jobs they do not want to do; and some foreign students work like slave labor. The J1 visa was created under the Fulbright-Hays Act of 1961 and was well-intentioned, but the program has been abused and abused for years. After the Associated Press exposed it last year, Secretary of State Hillary Clinton ordered a thorough review. The investigation found that the problem mainly lies in the lack of regulation of the third-party agencies responsible for dealing with students. The most serious abuse case was a girl who was told to work as a waitress in Virginia and was beaten and raped. He was later forced to perform striptease in Detroit; last August, dozens of students protested at the Hershey chocolate company's packaging plant in Pennsylvania, complaining that the work was too hard, rent was deducted from their salary, and they earned too little money.

204f1db0b2c13dedbe540dbc8375778ba09e07f8.translatedText: New changes to the L-type visa for U.S. citizens traveling to China starting in August. The Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles has new changes to the L-type tourist visa for applications to visit relatives in China and to travel to China starting in August. Recently, many expatriates and American citizens who want to go to China do not know the details, which makes it inconvenient to apply for visas. L-type visa requirements for visiting relatives and traveling: Foreigners (including Chinese) holding U.S. passports must provide "travel invitation letters issued by authorized tourism units" or "invitation letters from various companies, business units or individuals in China. Invitation letters issued by individuals in China must be accompanied by a copy of the inviter's personal identity document?" "round-trip air ticket order and hotel order." The invitation letter must list the name, gender, date of birth, purpose of visit to China, date of arrival and departure, place of visit, relationship with the inviter and source of expenses. The letter must also list the name of the inviting unit or individual, contact number, address, unit seal, signature of the legal representative, and other information. Chinese citizens’ foreign spouses and children and Chinese Americans whose passports are born in China (including Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao), as well as their spouses and children, can apply for a long-term multiple-entry visa, but they must be provided when applying. Invitation letter issued by relatives in China and a copy of the inviter's ID card, marriage certificate, birth certificate and other documents proving the relationship between spouse and children.
