f681c99c876897d5311a5767a4f9a63cc7ee21b4.sourceText: 中美文化论坛、国庆招待会和联谊舞会将于9月23日在ASU隆重举行 （亚省华联供稿） 中美文化论坛、国庆招待会和中秋联谊舞会 将于 9 月 23 日在 ASU 隆重举行 第六届《凤凰之夜》庆祝中华人民共和国成立63周年国庆招待会暨中秋佳节将于2012年9月23日在亚利桑那州立大学隆重举行。为了筹办这次活动，亚省华人华侨联合总会( 亚省华联 )会长费健于9月9日主持召开了第二次筹备会议。 费健在向大家报告活动准备情况 在会议中，各项活动负责人向与会人员汇报了各项工作的准备情况。首先由会长费健向大家汇报了此次系列活动的最新进展，以及各项活动筹备和落实的详细情况。徐智萍汇报了中美文化论坛、青少年摄影比赛和海报比赛活动安排的进展，并邀请到了三位嘉宾在中美文化论坛上做主题演讲。会长费健还向与会人员说明了国庆招待会的具体事项，并介绍了由当地艺术家魏怡平、李国华、蒋铁兵和新东方艺术学校表演节目的落实情况。今年，凤凰城华人耆英会老年模特队也将在双庆活动现场为大家表演时装秀，这些模特队的成员都是年过花甲的长辈。在此，让我们向这些老妈妈们道一声谢谢，并预祝她们表演成功。林欣、吕丽华向大家汇报了中秋联谊舞会的准备情况，并号召大家积极邀请亲朋好友，参加于9月23日晚七点至九点，在ASU Memorial Union Arizona Ballroom 举行的大型中秋联谊舞会。目前青少年摄影比赛和海报比赛的评选工作也在进行之中。具体活动安排如下: 1) 中美文化论坛：3:00 PM – 5:00 PM, ASU Memorial Union Turquoise Room 220。 2) 国庆招待会：5:00 PM – 7:00 PM, ASU Memorial Union Arizona Ballroom。 3) 青少年摄影和海报比赛颁奖典礼：5:00 PM – 7:00 PM, ASU Memorial Union Arizona Ballroom。 4) 中秋联谊舞会：7:00 PM – 9:00 PM, ASU Memorial Union Arizona Ballroom。 具体事宜请与亚省华联会长费健( jian6351@yahoo.com )，ASU孔子学院( ci@asu.edu )联系。 孔子学院的负责人徐智萍汇报中美文化论坛、青少年摄影比赛和海报比赛活动安排的进展 此次”凤凰之夜”大型系列庆祝活动，由 亚省华联 和亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院共同主办，并由大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会协办。组织者都是义务志愿者，他们白天工作，晚上和周末挤出个人的休息时间来参与庆祝活动的筹备工作。在筹备过程中，得到了许多社会团体、志愿者的积极参与和大力支持。大家唯一的心愿就是努力把这次迎中秋庆国庆系列活动办好，给社区和华人华侨交上一份满意的答卷！ 欢迎大家着正装出席于9月23日星期日举行的中美文化论坛、国庆招待会和中秋联谊舞会。组委会也希望带小孩来参加活动的家长朋友们，在活动期间，照看好您自己的小孩。谢谢大家的参与和支持！最新消息和详情请浏览亚省华联网站： www.chineseaz.org.
f681c99c876897d5311a5767a4f9a63cc7ee21b4.translatedText: The Sino-US Cultural Forum, National Day Reception and Dance will be held grandly at ASU on September 23 (Contributed by the Alberta Hualian) Sino-US Cultural Forum, National Day Reception and Mid-Autumn Festival Dance will be held grandly at ASU on September 23 The 6th "Phoenix Night" celebration of the 63rd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China and the Mid-Autumn Festival will be held grandly at Arizona State University on September 23, 2012. In order to prepare for this event, Fei Jian, president of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Alberta (Alberta Overseas Chinese Federation), hosted the second preparatory meeting on September 9. Fei Jian was reporting on the preparations for the activities. During the meeting, the person in charge of each activity reported on the preparations for various tasks to the participants. First, President Fei Jian reported to everyone the latest progress of this series of activities, as well as the details of the preparation and implementation of various activities. Xu Zhiping reported on the progress of the Sino-US Cultural Forum, Youth Photography Competition and Poster Competition, and invited three guests to give keynote speeches at the Sino-US Cultural Forum. President Fei Jian also explained the specific matters of the National Day reception to the participants, and introduced the implementation of performances by local artists Wei Yiping, Li Guohua, Jiang Tiebing and New Oriental Art School. This year, the Phoenix Chinese Senior Model Team will also perform a fashion show for everyone at the Double Celebration event. The members of these model teams are all elders who are over 60 years old. Here, let us say thank you to these old mothers and wish them success in their performances. Lin Xin and Lu Lihua reported to everyone the preparations for the Mid-Autumn Festival Ball, and called on everyone to actively invite relatives and friends to participate in the large-scale Mid-Autumn Ball held at the ASU Memorial Union Arizona Ballroom from 7 to 9 pm on September 23. The selection process for the Youth Photography Competition and Poster Competition is also in progress. The specific event schedule is as follows: 1) Sino-US Cultural Forum: 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM, ASU Memorial Union Turquoise Room 220. 2) National Day Reception: 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM, ASU Memorial Union Arizona Ballroom. 3) Youth Photography and Poster Contest Awards Ceremony: 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM, ASU Memorial Union Arizona Ballroom. 4) Mid-Autumn Festival Dance: 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM, ASU Memorial Union Arizona Ballroom. For specific matters, please contact Fei Jian (jian6351@yahoo.com), President of the Chinese Federation of Alberta, and the Confucius Institute at ASU (ci@asu.edu). Xu Zhiping, the director of the Confucius Institute, reported on the progress of the Sino-US Cultural Forum, Youth Photography Competition and Poster Competition. This large-scale "Phoenix Night" series of celebrations was co-sponsored by the Hualian Federation of Alberta and the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, and co-organized by the Greater Phoenix Chinese Overseas Chinese Association. The organizers are all volunteers who work during the day and squeeze out their personal breaks in the evenings and weekends to participate in the preparations for the celebrations. During the preparation process, many social groups and volunteers received active participation and strong support. Our only wish is to work hard to successfully organize this series of activities to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day, and provide a satisfactory answer to the community and overseas Chinese! Everyone is welcome to wear formal attire to attend the Sino-US Cultural Forum, National Day Reception and Mid-Autumn Festival Dance to be held on Sunday, September 23. The organizing committee also hopes that parents who bring their children to participate in the event will take care of their children during the event. Thank you all for your participation and support! For the latest news and details, please visit the Alberta Hualien website: www.chineseaz.org.

a33b99bf6c1b952dcc56ffee8ce3cca16ef6d64c.sourceText: 2013年亚利桑那州立大学（ASU）孔子学院中文夏令营报名将与4月5日结束，希望参加的同学请赶紧报名。
a33b99bf6c1b952dcc56ffee8ce3cca16ef6d64c.translatedText: Registration for the 2013 Arizona State University (ASU) Confucius Institute Chinese Summer Camp will end on April 5. Students who wish to participate should register quickly.

25c60dc035b0480366c971d94853d4620b3e6116.sourceText: 本次夏令营将于6月9日至6月23日在ASU Tempe校区举行。夏令营一共15天住校生活，给学生提供用中文以及中国文化拓展知识的机会。活动有非常鲜明而且具有建设性的主题，以及课程。在活动中学生能够学习到中文，并参与到有趣的文化活动。 整个夏令营将会以生活化的环境，进行学习和参与，学生们可以感受到大学生的生活。在夏令营后，也可以继续申请中文学习。 本次夏令营招收8到12年级的高中生，他们可以是完全没有中文基础的，或者是中级中文水平。学费，住宿，餐费以及学习材料，全免费，由Startalk计划来承担。活动只需要150美元不能返还的注册费。如果您对中文有兴趣，并且希望提高中文，就欢迎报名！报名时间截止到2012年4月5日。 报名材料请到下面链接 http://asu.edu/clas/silc/startalk.
25c60dc035b0480366c971d94853d4620b3e6116.translatedText: This summer camp will be held at the ASU Tempe campus from June 9th to June 23rd. The summer camp has a total of 15 days of living on campus, providing students with the opportunity to expand their knowledge in Chinese and Chinese culture. The activities have very distinct and constructive themes and courses. During the activities, students can learn Chinese and participate in interesting cultural activities. The entire summer camp will be conducted in a living environment for learning and participation, and students can feel the life of college students. After the summer camp, you can also continue to apply for Chinese language learning. This summer camp recruits high school students from grades 8 to 12. They can have no Chinese foundation at all or have an intermediate level of Chinese. Tuition, accommodation, meals and study materials are all free of charge and will be borne by the Startalk plan. The event only requires a $150 non-refundable registration fee. If you are interested in Chinese and want to improve your Chinese, you are welcome to sign up! Registration deadline is April 5, 2012. Please go to the following link for registration materials: http://asu.edu/clas/silc/startalk.

246e379939fbbcd33c1861b3097e447a71c061f9.sourceText: 亚省参议员余艳芬当选全国女议员委员会的立委 （亚省时报） 华盛顿特区消息，刚当选亚利桑那参议员华裔余艳芬被全国历史最悠久的组织”全国女议员委员会”选中为2013年的领导，为妇女参政提供服务。 最近，余艳芬当选为两党联合的女议员委员会立委。她是 the National Order of Women Legislators (NOWL)选出的代表。NOWL成立于1938年是全美女议员基金会the National Foundation for Women Legislators (NFWL)的重要成员。2012年在亚特兰大举行的年会中，余艳芬当选。 亚利桑那参议员华裔余艳芬 余艳芬表示她非常荣幸来自全国各地的同事将她选为基金会的领导。 她很渴望与各州的女性建立良好的关系，共同在全美女议员基金会的各项重要活动中合作。 数百名当选的女性于2012年11月15日到19日相聚在亚特兰大NFWL的年度会议上，为国家面临的最紧迫的问题，献计献策。NFWL提供了一个无党派的环境，鼓励对话，分享信息和经验。作为女性领导者能够建立联盟，分享选民们关注的问题，并为社区面临的问题提出解决方案。NFWL首席执行官罗宾如德说，他为余艳芬以及她所作的一切感到自豪。他说我们非常期待看到余艳芬在基金会中领导能力的精彩体现。我知道她将会让接下去一年成为NFWL历史上最让人激动，而且有建树的一年。 余艳芬即将走马上任，在她就职的2013年秋天也是NFWL年会第75周年的年庆。 亚利桑那州参议员余艳芬是共和党，她代表第20区，覆盖北凤凰城区域。她是亚利桑那州历史上首位女华裔参议员。 全国女议员基金会（NFWL） 通过每年的的教育和交际活动，来支持女性参政议政。 作为一个非盈利和非党派组织，NFWL在公共政策事务上不担任具体的职务，是一个交流信息与经验的女议员论坛。www.womenlegislators.org
246e379939fbbcd33c1861b3097e447a71c061f9.translatedText: Arizona Senator Yu Yanfen was elected as a legislator of the National Committee of Women in Congress (Alberta Times) According to Washington, DC news, the Chinese-American Yu Yanfen, who was just elected to the Arizona Senate, was selected by the National Committee of Women in Congress, the oldest organization in the country, to serve as a leader in 2013 to provide services for women in politics. Recently, Yanfen Yu was elected as a legislator on the bipartisan Committee on Women. She is an elected representative of the National Order of Women Legislators (NOWL). NOWL was founded in 1938 and is an important member of the National Foundation for Women Legislators (NFWL). At the 2012 annual meeting in Atlanta, Yu Yanfen was elected. Arizona Senator Yu Yanfen said she was honored that her colleagues from across the country selected her to lead the foundation. She is eager to build relationships with women in each state and work together on important events for the National Women’s Congressional Foundation. Hundreds of elected women gathered at the NFLL's annual conference in Atlanta from November 15-19, 2012, to contribute ideas on the most pressing issues facing the country. NFWL provides a nonpartisan environment that encourages dialogue and the sharing of information and experiences. Being a female leader enables you to build coalitions, share the concerns of your constituents, and propose solutions to problems facing your community. NFWL CEO Robin Rudd said he was proud of Yu Yanfen and everything she has done. He said that we are very much looking forward to seeing Yu Yanfen’s wonderful leadership in the foundation. I know she's going to make the next year one of the most exciting and productive in NFL history. Yu Yanfen is about to take office, and the fall of 2013 when she takes office will also be the 75th anniversary of the NFWL annual meeting. Arizona State Senator Yu Yanfen is a Republican. She represents the 20th District, covering the northern Phoenix area. She is the first Chinese-American female senator in Arizona's history. The National Foundation for Women Legislators (NFWL) supports women in politics through annual educational and networking events. As a nonprofit and nonpartisan organization, the NFWL holds no specific position on public policy matters and serves as a forum for female legislators to exchange information and experiences. www.womenlegislators.org

98cc9b27906c5614579259a8aa884841dc147332.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院, 亚利桑那州立大学国际与文学院将和亚省华人华侨联合会合作，举办一年一度的中美合作论坛。今年的论坛主题为”中美合作面面观”。本次论坛内将于2013年9月22日在亚利桑那州立大学MU Turquoise会议厅隆重举行。面对日益加强的两国间的合作，越来越多亚利桑那州的企业家，跨国公司高层主管及民间文化艺术团体频繁地往返于中美两地。针对这种了解双边经贸合作与文化的需求，亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院与亚省华人华侨联合会已是第五年举行此类大型活动。 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院院长司马德林教授表示：”由亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院承办的一年一度的中美合作论坛，为当地社区和学术界的成员提供了一个很好的机会，大家利用这个机会可以更好地了解中美合作的各项事宜。论坛中的演讲者和大家分享他们对中美合作的深刻理解，这些理解包括他们的亲身经历，也包括在21世纪保持和发展中美合作的複杂性。” 届时，国会众议员Matt Salmon 先生，Honeywell（霍尼韦尔）公司的Briand Greer先生和Intel(英特尔)公司的Steven Tu 先生将作为主讲嘉宾出席本次论坛。中国驻洛杉矶领事馆领事将出席论坛并为论坛的开幕式致辞。随后，亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院院长司马德琳教授将向来宾们介绍各位主讲嘉宾和论坛流程。与会期间，主讲嘉宾将会和听众分享以及讨论如何在中美双边贸易中开展合併与交易的战略。 作为国会中唯一一位能说流利中文的众议员并且在国际关係委员会的身居要职，众议员Salmon先生多次率领代表团访问中文。他将发表题为”战略伙伴还是经济对手”的主题演说并和大家讨论在中国的合作机会。 Briand Greer先生，作为霍尼韦尔公司航空亚洲－太平洋区域的主席，居住在中国上海并负责整个亚洲－太平洋地区的业务。霍尼韦尔公司是中国国内经济型飞机C919的主要供应商。鑑于中国希望和美国和欧洲一样，成为全球航空製造业中的支柱成员，Greer先生将会分享他对在中国经营航空製造业的挑战和机遇的见解。同时，他也会和大家分享他在中国工作的个人经历。 Steven Tu先生，英特尔公司手机产品的总设计师，为了使英特尔公司扩张其在对亚洲－太平洋地区以及全球的手机产品业务，正努力定义和发展下一代的系统芯片。 屠先生表示：”在过去的十年裡，中国奇蹟般地促进了因特尔电脑商务的发展。随着网络技术的继续，手机产业正在世界范围内迅勐发展，在中国尤为突出。这种势头正在迫使一种从电脑到手机的模式转换。我的演讲会给大家呈现手机在中国的发展趋势，因特尔产品的发展和製造业想手机产业的转换，中国经济体係对新的计算模式的影响以及在中国，手机产业对因特尔尤为重要的原因。” 下午5点论坛结束后，亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院，亚利桑那州立大学国际文学院与亚省华人华侨联合会将为与会来宾们举办招待会。该招待会是庆祝中秋国庆系列庆典活动之一，将会于下午5点到7点在Memorial Union的亚利桑那宴会厅举行。中国驻洛杉矶领事馆领事，亚利桑那州政府代表及各界华人华侨领袖将出席招待会，与亚利桑那州的民众共同迎国庆，庆中秋。当天，亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院还将为亚利桑那州中小学海报比赛及亚利桑那州高中生及大学生摄影比赛的获奖选手举行隆重的颁奖典礼。这两项比赛为亚利桑那州大中小学生而设。目前，比赛正在如火如荼的进行中。 以上所有的活动将对公众免费开放。本届中美合作论坛委员会联合主席Tony Tam先生表示：”本次论坛对与会者来说是一个能够从专家处了解中国商务，接触到中国领事馆的代表们以及发展和本地企业社团领导者们的关係网的绝佳机会。千万不要错过这个特殊的机遇。” 由于场地座位有限，请即日登陆以下网站报名参加”中美合作面面观”论坛： http://confuciusins ​​titute.asu.edu/portal/chinaforum2013 如需了解其他活动详情，请浏览亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院网站：http://confuciusins​​titute.asu.edu/portal/ 或者https://international.clas.asu.edu/events/china-forum-working-china -global-market
98cc9b27906c5614579259a8aa884841dc147332.translatedText: The Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, the College of International and Liberal Arts at Arizona State University, and the Alberta Chinese Federation will host the annual China-U.S. Cooperation Forum. The theme of this year’s forum is “Aspects of Sino-US Cooperation.” This forum will be held on September 22, 2013 at the MU Turquoise Conference Hall of Arizona State University. In the face of increasingly strengthened cooperation between the two countries, more and more Arizona entrepreneurs, senior executives of multinational companies and folk cultural and art groups frequently travel between China and the United States. In response to this need to understand bilateral economic and trade cooperation and culture, this is the fifth year that the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University and the Overseas Chinese Federation of Alberta have held such a large-scale event. Professor Sima Delin, Director of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, said: "The annual China-U.S. Cooperation Forum hosted by the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University provides members of the local community and academia with a great opportunity to better understand various matters of Sino-U.S. cooperation. The speakers at the forum shared their deep understanding of Sino-U.S. cooperation, including their personal experiences, as well as the complexity of maintaining and developing Sino-U.S. cooperation in the 21st century." At that time, Congressman Matt Salmon Sir, Mr. Briand Greer from Honeywell and Mr. Steven Tu from Intel will attend this forum as keynote speakers. The Consul of the Chinese Consulate in Los Angeles will attend the forum and deliver a speech at the opening ceremony of the forum. Afterwards, Professor Smadelin, Director of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, will introduce the guest speakers and the forum process to the guests. During the conference, the keynote speakers will share and discuss with the audience strategies on how to carry out mergers and transactions in Sino-US bilateral trade. As the only congressman in Congress who can speak fluent Chinese and holds an important position in the International Relations Committee, Congressman Mr. Salmon has led delegations to visit China many times. He will deliver a keynote speech titled "Strategic Partner or Economic Rival" and discuss cooperation opportunities in China. Mr. Briand Greer, as Chairman of Honeywell Aviation Asia-Pacific Region, lives in Shanghai, China and is responsible for the entire Asia-Pacific region. Honeywell is China's main supplier of economical aircraft C919. Mr. Greer will share his insights on the challenges and opportunities of operating aerospace manufacturing in China, as China hopes to join the United States and Europe in becoming a backbone member of the global aviation manufacturing industry. At the same time, he will also share with you his personal experience of working in China. Mr. Steven Tu, chief architect of Intel's mobile phone products, is working hard to define and develop the next generation of system chips in order for Intel to expand its mobile phone product business in the Asia-Pacific region and globally. Mr. Tu said: "In the past ten years, China has miraculously promoted the development of Intel computer business. As network technology continues, the mobile phone industry is developing rapidly around the world, especially in China. This momentum is forcing a paradigm shift from computers to mobile phones. My speech will show you the development trend of mobile phones in China, the development of Intel products and the transformation of manufacturing and mobile phone industries, the impact of China's economic system on new computing models and the reasons why the mobile phone industry is particularly important to Intel in China." After the forum ends at 5 p.m., the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, the College of International Liberal Arts at Arizona State University and the Chinese Federation of Alberta will host a reception for the guests. The reception, part of a series of events celebrating the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day, will be held from 5 to 7 p.m. in the Arizona Ballroom of the Memorial Union. Consuls from the Chinese Consulate in Los Angeles, representatives of the Arizona government and overseas Chinese leaders from all walks of life will attend the reception to welcome the National Day and celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival with the people of Arizona. On the same day, the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University will also hold a grand award ceremony for the winners of the Arizona Primary and Secondary School Poster Competition and the Arizona High School and College Student Photography Competition. Both competitions are for Arizona college, middle and elementary school students. Currently, the competition is in full swing. All of the above activities will be free and open to the public. Mr. Tony Tam, co-chairman of the China-US Cooperation Forum Committee, said: "This forum is an excellent opportunity for participants to learn about Chinese business from experts, meet representatives from the Chinese consulate, and develop relationships with leaders of local business communities. Don't miss this special opportunity." Due to limited seating, please log on to the following website today to register for the "Aspects of China-US Cooperation" forum: http://confuciusins ​​titute.asu.edu/portal/chinaforum2013 For details about other activities, please visit the website of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University: http://confuciusins​​titute.asu.edu/portal/ or https://international.clas.asu.edu/events/china-forum-working-china-global-market

e9b1aabe5978e14b02df619d6b0c6b61d5a49b63.sourceText: 2011年的秋季，对于Tucson华声合唱团来说，可谓是一个繁忙而丰收的季节。在刚刚参加完金秋十月举办的一年一度 的Tucson_Meet_Yourself文化节；在享受了合唱团自产美味月饼的中秋佳节；在参与了合唱团的年度品牌?#31179;日叶正红?的集体郊游后，合唱团便为参加2011年秋SASO(Southern_Arizona_Symphony_Orchestra)音乐会而开始了紧张的准备。 经过数周密集排练，通过整整两天的紧张彩排，经历上周末11月19日、20日的两场SASO音乐会，我们终于为Tucson华声合 唱团2011之秋的合唱季画上了一个完满的句号。SASO音乐会的完美和震撼，尤其是交响乐作品《陆游与唐婉》带给美国观 众、包括我们自己的感动，相信一定远远超出了我们很多人的预期。
e9b1aabe5978e14b02df619d6b0c6b61d5a49b63.translatedText: The autumn of 2011, for the Tucson Huasheng Chorus, can be described as a busy and fruitful season. After just participating in the annual Tucson_Meet_Yourself cultural festival held in the golden autumn of October; after enjoying the Mid-Autumn Festival with delicious mooncakes produced by the choir; and after participating in the collective outing of the choir's annual brand? After weeks of intensive rehearsals, two full days of intense rehearsals, and two SASO concerts last weekend on November 19th and 20th, we finally brought the Tucson Huasheng Choir’s autumn 2011 choir season to a successful conclusion. The perfection and shock of the SASO concert, especially the symphony work "Lu You and Tang Wan", moved the American audience, including ourselves, far beyond the expectations of many of us.

44e9ce8f27e6f31980646259825057327325a95e.sourceText: 很想说的一句话是：这份温暖和感动的感觉真好！
44e9ce8f27e6f31980646259825057327325a95e.translatedText: What I want to say is: This feeling of warmth and touch is so good!

c7efe469374fab594ab50bbe2dfb2f01bfd006b6.sourceText: 我们合唱团的卓俪影，用下述文字表达了她作为现场听众的感受：”你们站在舞台上唱，虽然很兴奋，但还会有遗憾。 因为，你们都不知道自己唱得有多好。还是我幸运，第一次坐台下欣赏俺们的演唱。我确确实实、狠狠地被你们的歌声打动 了，fall_in慴eautiful_song抮iver，差点被淹死啦。一个字:’美’！人美，服装美，歌声更美。美，美，美?.没 听够，春晚，我们再演唱一次吧!”
c7efe469374fab594ab50bbe2dfb2f01bfd006b6.translatedText: Zhuo Liying from our choir expressed her feelings as a live audience in the following words: "Although you are very excited to sing on the stage, you will still have regrets. Because you don't know how good you are at singing. I am lucky enough to sit on the stage and appreciate our singing for the first time. I am truly and deeply moved by your singing. Oh, fall_in beautiful_song抮iver, almost drowned. One word: 'Beautiful'! Beautiful people, beautiful clothes, beautiful singing. No. Enough, Spring Festival Gala, let’s sing again!”

d47374eb4aeb2d67782041a5af1e93d9a63a5c34.sourceText: 诚如梁先生感慨：”这次音乐会称得上是Tucson华声合唱团的一个里程碑！”
d47374eb4aeb2d67782041a5af1e93d9a63a5c34.translatedText: As Mr. Liang lamented: “This concert can be regarded as a milestone for the Tucson Huasheng Choir!”

6e43b2160c8fe27a510a0aafec899f49773172f0.sourceText: 亦如郎导所言：”这种提高只有在好的作品，严格的排练，和相对高水准的观众氛围中才可以得到”。
6e43b2160c8fe27a510a0aafec899f49773172f0.translatedText: As Director Lang said: “This kind of improvement can only be achieved with good works, strict rehearsals, and a relatively high-level audience atmosphere.”

3c6831f24ba723e807cd20b4ed64bdf779fef15c.sourceText: 的确如此，我个人感觉，这次SASO音乐会，是我们华声成立近五年来，第一次真正意义上参与的、将一部完整的中国交 响乐作品，在美国交响乐团的完美演绎中，呈现在一台听众全部是美国观众的音乐会上。当这部长达15分钟、由著名作曲家 、《梁祝》曲作家何占豪所创作的另一交响乐力作《陆游与唐婉》，在古筝演奏者梁正锵先生那充满激情的休止符戛然而止 的静默片刻；当全场观众起立长时间地鼓掌致意；当雷鸣般的掌声经久不息….， 他们所传递出的，无疑是美国观众对这部中国作品的理解和感动；是对梁先生古筝精湛演技的由衷的赞叹；同时，他们也一 定能从咱Marcia那声情并茂、韵味十足的SOLO中，更凭添一份对这部作品的喜爱。当然，我们合唱团在整部作品的演绎中 ，虽可能不是主角，但我们一定是这部作品的一段华彩乐章，是整部作品不可或缺的一个重要组成部分，因着我们合唱的加 入，更给作品注入的了一种唯美的意境。
3c6831f24ba723e807cd20b4ed64bdf779fef15c.translatedText: This is indeed the case. I personally feel that this SASO concert is the first time in the nearly five years since the establishment of Huasheng that we have truly participated in a complete Chinese symphony work, perfectly performed by an American symphony orchestra, and presented it in a concert with an entire American audience. When this 15-minute long symphonic masterpiece "Lu You and Tang Wan" composed by the famous composer and "Butterfly Lovers" composer He Zhanhao suddenly ended in a moment of silence with the passionate rest of the guzheng player Mr. Liang Zhengqiang; when the entire audience stood up and applauded for a long time; when the thunderous applause lasted for a long time..., What they conveyed is undoubtedly the American audience’s understanding and emotion of this Chinese work; it is their sincere admiration for Mr. Liang’s superb guzheng acting skills; at the same time, they will definitely be able to gain more love for this work from Marcia’s soulful and charming SOLO. Of course, although our choir may not be the protagonist in the performance of the entire work, we must be a cadenza movement of this work and an indispensable and important part of the entire work. Because of the addition of our chorus, we inject a beautiful artistic conception into the work.

7e898d1fb338a41304c986d33c041b0a4dba4057.sourceText: 近段时间，大家为准备并参与这场音乐会，都克服了诸多困难，付出了无数努力，想要飘扬的感动巨多。特别值得一提 的是陈益，虽八甲身孕在身，依然出现在舞台上，站在合唱的行列中。这份纯美、这份参与，成为音乐会上一抹最温馨的影 像。
7e898d1fb338a41304c986d33c041b0a4dba4057.translatedText: In recent times, everyone has overcome many difficulties and put in countless efforts to prepare for and participate in this concert, and I am deeply moved. It is particularly worth mentioning that Chen Yi, even though Bajia was pregnant, still appeared on the stage and stood in the chorus line. This pure beauty and participation became the most heartwarming image at the concert.

0088d63f063552e1a63bd328f5c7ce21af0e9745.sourceText: 点点滴滴，大家有目共睹；细数家珍，我们铭记在心！
0088d63f063552e1a63bd328f5c7ce21af0e9745.translatedText: Every detail is visible to all; every detail of our family treasures will be remembered by us!

78bdb489a2694192dbb4a77ff674798c6e30624f.sourceText: 享受合唱，重在参与。Tucson华人社区，正是由无数这样的团队、由众多朋友的热心参与，才带来社区文化生活的不 断繁荣；而正是这些丰富多彩的文化生活，构成了我们远离故乡的海外华人社区一道亮丽的人文风景线。
78bdb489a2694192dbb4a77ff674798c6e30624f.translatedText: Enjoy the chorus, the most important thing is to participate. It is the Tucson Chinese community, thanks to countless such teams and the enthusiastic participation of many friends, that has brought about the continuous prosperity of community cultural life; and it is these rich and colorful cultural lives that constitute a beautiful cultural landscape of our overseas Chinese community far away from home.

d5fac32ec2c37d4944e418d2a60e600612c6ab53.sourceText: 稍息片刻，华声合唱团将投入2012年Tucson春晚的合唱曲目排练。在2012春晚上，将有由Tucson华声合唱团、South ern Arizona Symphony Orchestra (SASO)、 UA Faculty & Staff Choir、Sons of Orpheus (Men’s Chorus)、Southern Arizona Women’s Chorus、CFHS Chorus and Tucson Boy Choir组成的?#36229;级合唱团?#65292; 共同参与并完成中美两国的中英文合唱作品。届时，猜想，交响乐作品《陆游与唐婉》将被再度搬上舞台。
d5fac32ec2c37d4944e418d2a60e600612c6ab53.translatedText: After a short break, the Huasheng Choir will start rehearsing the chorus for the 2012 Tucson Spring Festival Gala. In the 2012 Spring Festival Gala, there will be top-notch choirs composed of Tucson Huasheng Choir, Southern Arizona Symphony Orchestra (SASO), UA Faculty & Staff Choir, Sons of Orpheus (Men’s Chorus), Southern Arizona Women’s Chorus, CFHS Chorus and Tucson Boy Choir to jointly participate in and complete Chinese and English choral works from China and the United States. By then, it is speculated that the symphony work "Lu You and Tang Wan" will be put on the stage again.

9a217063844be4d8efd107d11c1e99bd3db6c417.translatedText: Will Medicare age increase to avoid falling off a cliff at the expense of the elderly?

4985dc43a1e1c128ac27758053a2d5aae836754f.sourceText: Medicare年龄提高 避坠崖牺牲老人？ （亚省时报） 美国人的寿命延长了，共和党人在避免财政悬崖的…
4985dc43a1e1c128ac27758053a2d5aae836754f.translatedText: Medicare age increases, will the elderly be sacrificed to avoid falling off a cliff? (Alberta Times) Americans are living longer, and Republicans are trying to avoid the fiscal cliff...

befa5646d5fb01e2db03903b2372e5e18ba0071a.sourceText: Medicare年龄提高 避坠崖牺牲老人？ （亚省时报） 美国人的寿命延长了，共和党人在避免财政悬崖的预算谈判中，要把享有联邦医疗保险(Medicare)的年龄提高，以减少政府巨额的赤字，但这个听来明智 的牺牲，在美国老化的社会，可能会造成Medicare受益人保费提高等的意外后果，受到维护老人权益组织「美国中老年人协会」(AARP)的反对。 不像增税引起党派性的强烈争议，把享有Medicare的年龄从现在的65岁提高到67岁，有助于白宫和共和党达成妥协，因为欧巴马总统先前曾表示愿意考虑此构想，共和党人也把此构想做为首要建议。 忧心忡忡的AARP已经开始大做广告，反对用这个将造成长期问题的构想，做为对赤字的快速解决之道。 把享有Medicare的年龄提高到67岁，每年可以减少支出5%，多年下来复合累积的节约将达数千亿元，但凯瑟家庭基金会的Medicare专家崔西亚纽曼说，此构想说来简单，但接后果严重，该基金会的研究发现其后果包括： ●享有Medicare耆老的每月保险费将提高。由于把较健康的65和66岁老人排除于纳保人之外，其它人的保费将提高，当提高年龄充分执行后，保费将上涨3%。 ●私人健保保费昂贵。耆老在享有Medicare之前，根据健改法必须多参与私人健保两年，与年轻人相比，他们的健保成本更高，保费将昂贵。 ●增加雇主的成本，因为老年雇员将试图留在公司的健保计划内。 ●延后享有Medicare者中，三分之二的医疗自付费将提高。 美国人的寿命自1965年Medicare创立后，已经延长了八岁，在1980年代，里根总统和民主党国会领袖同意，逐渐把领取全额社安福利的年龄从65岁 提高为67岁，但是不碰Medicare。其后许多专家主张把享有Medicare的年龄，与社安同步，2010年共和党赢得众院后，这个构想受到共和党 领袖的支持，欧巴马总统在2011年在与共和党谈判预算时，表示对此构想持开放态度，但他很快即反悔，表示除非共和党同意对富人增税，否则他不会加以考虑。
befa5646d5fb01e2db03903b2372e5e18ba0071a.translatedText: Raise the Medicare age to avoid falling off the cliff and sacrifice the elderly? (Alberta Times) Americans are living longer. In budget negotiations to avoid the fiscal cliff, Republicans want to raise the Medicare eligibility age to reduce the government's huge deficit. However, this sacrifice, which sounds sensible, may lead to unintended consequences such as higher premiums for Medicare beneficiaries in the aging society of the United States. It is opposed by the American Association for the Elderly (AARP), an organization that advocates for the elderly. Unlike tax increases, which cause intense partisan controversy, raising the Medicare eligibility age from the current 65 to 67 would help the White House and Republicans reach a compromise because President Obama has previously expressed a willingness to consider this idea, and Republicans have made this idea their top recommendation. A worried AARP has begun advertising heavily against this idea as a quick fix to the deficit, which will cause long-term problems. Raising the Medicare eligibility age to 67 can reduce expenditures by 5% each year, and the compound savings over the years will reach hundreds of billions. However, Tricia Newman, a Medicare expert at the Kaiser Family Foundation, said that this idea is simple to say, but the consequences are serious. The foundation's research found that its consequences include: ●The monthly insurance premiums for seniors with Medicare will increase. Since the healthier 65 and 66-year-olds are excluded from the policy holders, the premiums for other people will increase. When the age increase is fully implemented, the premiums will increase by 3%. ●Private health insurance premiums are expensive. According to the health reform law, the elderly must participate in private health insurance for two more years before they can enjoy Medicare. Compared with young people, the cost of their health insurance will be higher, and the premiums will be expensive. ● Increased costs for employers as older employees will try to stay on company health insurance plans. ●Among those who defer their Medicare coverage, two-thirds will see their medical out-of-pocket payments increase. The life span of Americans has been extended by eight years since the creation of Medicare in 1965. In the 1980s, President Reagan and Democratic congressional leaders agreed to gradually raise the age for receiving full social security benefits from 65 to 67, but did not touch Medicare. Later, many experts advocated synchronizing the Medicare eligibility age with Social Security. After the Republicans won the House of Representatives in 2010, this idea was supported by Republican leaders. President Obama expressed an openness to this idea when negotiating the budget with the Republicans in 2011, but he quickly reneged and said that he would not consider it unless the Republicans agreed to increase taxes on the rich.

71989f8e377aaca551dd8bcc3be24ff26e7386da.sourceText: (亚省华联供稿) 近日，联邦众议员 Matt Salmon在他的办公室召开了亚太裔顾问委员会联席会议。各亚太裔侨领出席了会议。新任亚太裔顾问委员会委员、亚省华联王惟咨会长和李健副会长也应邀出席了会议。亚太裔顾问委员会旨在为促进亚洲、太平洋地区与美文化、经济、和科技的广泛交流提供建设性意见，供政府参考。会议上，就如何将 Mesa Williams Gateway 变成国际商用机场的可行性进行了深入的探讨。下次会议计划于今年九月召开。
71989f8e377aaca551dd8bcc3be24ff26e7386da.translatedText: (contributed by the Alberta Hualian) Recently, Congressman Matt Salmon convened a joint meeting of the Asian and Pacific Islander Advisory Committee in his office. Leaders of various Asian and Pacific Islander communities attended the meeting. The newly appointed members of the Asian Pacific American Advisory Committee, President Wang Weizi and Vice President Li Jian of the Hualian Association of Alberta were also invited to attend the meeting. The Asian and Pacific Islander Advisory Committee aims to provide constructive advice for the government to promote extensive cultural, economic, and technological exchanges between Asia and the Pacific and the United States. At the meeting, the feasibility of turning the Mesa Williams Gateway into an international commercial airport was discussed in depth. The next meeting is planned for September this year.

c01f4ace159d96828c76f8287efbc58114031c15.sourceText: 从下周二开始，AirTran的航空公司从3号航站楼迁往凤凰城国际机场的第4号航站楼，在他的新东家西南航空公司的旁边。双方将使用单独售票柜台和大门，因为他们还尚未完全合并。 AirTran航空公司每日只有三个航班出凤凰城。前往亚特兰大和密尔沃基。相比之下，西南地区，每日有近200个航班，比任何航空公司运送的本地乘客都多，包括总部设在坦佩的美国航空公司。
c01f4ace159d96828c76f8287efbc58114031c15.translatedText: Starting next Tuesday, AirTran will move from Terminal 3 to Terminal 4 at Phoenix International Airport, next to its new owner, Southwest Airlines. Both sides will use separate ticket counters and gates as they are not yet fully integrated. AirTran only has three flights out of Phoenix daily. Heading to Atlanta and Milwaukee. By comparison, Southwest, with nearly 200 daily flights, carries more local passengers than any airline, including Tempe-based American Airlines.

871d4e69c848e14a96338f388bfb798b29c8cec7.translatedText: AirTran's Terminal 4 gates are at C14 and C16, Southwest Airlines said. Phoenix is ​​the seventh city where AirTran and Southwest Airlines began sharing facilities after the merger.

fab6c0093039bc47034d7c75cf185ac28e6ad6f8.sourceText: 日前，亚省政府部门官员Jan Brewer 发言宣布：亚利桑那准备加入以德州为首的反奥巴马移民新政的队伍，此前德州以及其他17个州都已经签署了反对议案。
fab6c0093039bc47034d7c75cf185ac28e6ad6f8.translatedText: A few days ago, Jan Brewer, an official of the Alberta government department, announced that Arizona is ready to join the team led by Texas in opposing Obama's new immigration policy. Texas and 17 other states have previously signed the opposition bill.

e14266ca4625092ea423e183baee7ffa1571e487.sourceText: 许多高层的共和党员已经谴责过奥巴马的决策太多轻浮，新政将导致超过5百万的非法移民滞留美国，不必担心被驱逐出境。
e14266ca4625092ea423e183baee7ffa1571e487.translatedText: Many senior Republicans have condemned Obama's decision-making as too frivolous. The new deal will result in more than 5 million illegal immigrants staying in the United States without fear of deportation.

8f93f00629466e49ce025388deaba080bc789c40.sourceText: 这项反对议案由德州主要发起，据当地长官Greg Abbott介绍，奥巴马此修改移民法的举动，使议会对他失去信任，且新政被议会投票通过的希望也十分渺茫。
8f93f00629466e49ce025388deaba080bc789c40.translatedText: This opposition motion was mainly initiated by Texas. According to local governor Greg Abbott, Obama's move to amend the immigration law has caused Congress to lose trust in him, and the hope that the new deal will be voted by Congress is also very slim.

158a1e85eea60d32d25d1b76cd3cbe0a57d1e923.sourceText: 以下是亚省政府官员 Jan Brewer 的发言节选：
158a1e85eea60d32d25d1b76cd3cbe0a57d1e923.translatedText: >The following is Jan Brewer, an official of the Alberta Government Excerpts from his speech:

960e33e61936f22dbe86ef67dbf327cf6477e1b0.sourceText: ”亚省以能加入反对奥巴马政府草率决策的队伍而骄傲。作为一个边境州，一直以来我们都承受着非法移民现象的压力和冲击。而日前，奥巴马政府的草率的移民新政改革，更是加重了我州和我州民的强烈反感。奥巴马政府借重新定义了宪法和联邦法律巩固自己的权利，同时故意忽视美国人民的意愿。这种权利的越界不能被容忍。”
960e33e61936f22dbe86ef67dbf327cf6477e1b0.translatedText: "Alberta is proud to join the team that opposes the Obama administration's hasty decisions. As a border state, we have always been under the pressure and impact of illegal immigration. Recently, the Obama administration's hasty immigration reform has aggravated the strong resentment of our state and our people. The Obama administration has redefined the Constitution and federal laws to consolidate its own rights, while deliberately ignoring the wishes of the American people. This kind of transgression of rights cannot be tolerated."

26957b95863d5bfe892456636fa74f217de75310.sourceText: BESTBUY週六宣布，今年年底之前，将关闭50家门店。这些倒闭门店包括7家在加州，6家在伊利诺州和6家在明尼苏达州，其中两家在本州。 本州皮奥里亚和卡萨格兰德两家门店的员工在周六上午获悉关闭消息。两家门店週六没有营业，週日重开作最终倾销活动。 BESTBUY上个月表示关闭一些所谓的”大箱子”商店，裁员400人和削减成本800万美元，以100个更小，更紧凑的移动电信商店取代之。面对网购公司，如亚马逊的挑战，BESTBUY正试图避免走Circuit City的老路，后者在2009年歇业。 BESTBUY在美国有1400家门店，今年已关闭了两家，一家在密苏里州，一家在本州。 50家门店部分将在5月12日关闭，最迟在今夏完成。 BESTBUY说，门店关闭后，员工将分流到该公司的其他部门。 上週二，BESTBUY的CEO布莱恩邓恩辞职后，董事会开始调查他的”个人行为”。该公司在最近一季度亏了1.7亿美元，部门原因是由于重组成本。
26957b95863d5bfe892456636fa74f217de75310.translatedText: BESTBUY announced on Saturday that it will close 50 stores before the end of this year. These closures include seven in California, six in Illinois and six in Minnesota, two of which are in the state. Employees at the state's two stores in Peoria and Casa Grande learned of the closures Saturday morning. Both stores were closed on Saturday and reopened on Sunday for final sales. BESTBUY said last month it would close some of its so-called "big box" stores, laying off 400 people and cutting costs by $8 million, and replace them with 100 smaller, more compact mobile telecom stores. Faced with challenges from online shopping companies such as Amazon, BESTBUY is trying to avoid following the path of Circuit City, which went out of business in 2009. BESTBUY has 1,400 stores in the United States, and has closed two this year, one in Missouri and one in this state. Some of the 50 stores will be closed on May 12, and will be completed by this summer at the latest. BESTBUY said that after the store is closed, employees will be transferred to other departments of the company. Last Tuesday, after BESTBUY CEO Brian Dunn resigned, the board of directors began investigating his "personal conduct." The company lost $170 million in its most recent quarter, in part due to restructuring costs.

9c23138b5ba8dfd50d2e00f6079174808096bdca.translatedText: Microsoft officially bids farewell to Hotmail Outlook users, reaching 400 million Microsoft officially bids farewell to the Hotmail era. Microsoft announced on Friday...

ded7e3258ad4299f87a65ccb946ee47f9bef5b0a.sourceText: 微软正式挥别Hotmail Outlook用户达4亿 微软正式向Hotmail时代挥手告别。微软公司周五宣布，他们已经完成了所有Hotmail用户向Outlook的转移，目前Outlook拥有用户4亿。微软周四还表示，在现有的4亿用户中，1.25亿Outlook.com用户可以通过移动设备登录。 负责Outlook的项目经理Dick Craddock表示，为了确保用户的积极体验，他们正在广泛听取用户的意见。 新版Outlook在原有的Hotmail基础上升级了不少功能，包括升级版的日历、应用软件和与云服务的融合等。微软目前已经启动改进版Skydrive与Outlook.com的整合工作，而新的Outlook.com服务还将推出SMTP发送功能，并与云存储服务SkyDrive进行整合。 今年2月，微软曾宣称Outlook.com有帐户6000万，当时，微软已经关闭Hotmail，正将用户转向Outlook.com。 现有Hotmail用户仍然可以继续使用原邮箱地址，但也可以申请开通Outlook账号。
ded7e3258ad4299f87a65ccb946ee47f9bef5b0a.translatedText: Microsoft officially waved goodbye to Hotmail. Outlook users reached 400 million. Microsoft officially waved goodbye to the Hotmail era. Microsoft announced on Friday that it has completed the migration of all Hotmail users to Outlook, which currently has 400 million users. Microsoft also said Thursday that of the 400 million existing users, 125 million Outlook.com users can log in via mobile devices. Dick Craddock, the project manager responsible for Outlook, said that in order to ensure a positive user experience, they are listening to users' opinions extensively. The new version of Outlook has upgraded many functions based on the original Hotmail, including upgraded calendars, application software and integration with cloud services. Microsoft has already started integrating the improved version of Skydrive with Outlook.com, and the new Outlook.com service will also launch SMTP sending functions and integrate with the cloud storage service SkyDrive. In February this year, Microsoft claimed that Outlook.com had 60 million accounts. At that time, Microsoft had closed Hotmail and was switching users to Outlook.com. Existing Hotmail users can still use their original email addresses, but they can also apply to open an Outlook account.

f89225ad376e8205aaf5a9dfc2fe10ba6b5c81df.translatedText: Discover card overcharges, reimburse customers $200 million (Alberta Times) The Federal Consumer Financial Protection Bureau announced on the 24th that Discover Bank...

d3220b2be8d6e5417371a17bb0fe895580c1ca3e.sourceText: 联邦消费者金融保护局24日宣布，发现银行(Discover)根据和解协议，将向全国350多万持有发现信用卡者退赔2亿元，和支付1400万元罚金。 全国第六大发卡业者发现银行，因迫使持卡人购买昂贵的外加服务，如付款保护与信用监督等，而受到消费者金融保护局和联邦存款保险公司的调查指控。 该信用卡公司的电话服务中心不经持卡人同意，便将他们纳入收费的服务计画。 这是消费者金融保护局自2010年成立以来，第三次采取的金融执法行动。 第一资本金融公司(Capital One)和美国运通公司(American Express)曾因滥收费受罚。 发现卡强行推销的服务有付款保护、信用分数追踪、身分盗窃保护等，2007年12月1日至2011年8月31日期间参加上述计画的任何人，都将退赔至少90天的服务费 ，约200万人的收费将全部退赔。 发现卡同意修改电子营销手段，和聘请独立的审计部门，以监督执行金融保护局的命令。
d3220b2be8d6e5417371a17bb0fe895580c1ca3e.translatedText: > The Federal Consumer Financial Protection Bureau announced on the 24th that Discover Bank (Discover) will refund 200 million yuan to more than 3.5 million Discover credit card holders across the country and pay a fine of 14 million yuan in accordance with the settlement agreement. Discovery Bank, the nation's sixth-largest card issuer, is under investigation by the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau and the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation for forcing cardholders to buy expensive add-on services such as payment protection and credit monitoring. The credit card company's call center included cardholders in fee-based service plans without their consent. This is the third financial enforcement action taken by the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau since its establishment in 2010. Capital One and American Express have been fined for overcharging. The services that Discovery Card forcibly promotes include payment protection, credit score tracking, identity theft protection, etc. Anyone who participated in the above-mentioned programs between December 1, 2007 and August 31, 2011 will have at least 90 days of service fees refunded. About 2 million people will have all their fees refunded. Discover Card agreed to revamp its electronic marketing practices and hire an independent auditor to monitor compliance with the Financial Protection Bureau's order.

748f07f64c79e3adbc0f65fba29694ac5f0f186f.sourceText: 人民币兑美元匯率昨日收市报6.2949，为匯改以来首次升破6.30兑1美元，迈向6.20水平。自本月中市传央行及四大行入市撑匯率以来，半个月内累升约1.25%，完全扭转了11月以来连日下挫的弱势。
748f07f64c79e3adbc0f65fba29694ac5f0f186f.translatedText: The RMB exchange rate against the U.S. dollar closed at 6.2949 yesterday, which was the first time since the exchange reform that it rose above 6.30 to 1 U.S. dollar, heading towards the 6.20 level. Since it was rumored in the middle of this month that the central bank and the four major banks have stepped in to support the exchange rate, the exchange rate has risen by about 1.25% in half a month, completely reversing the weakness of consecutive days of decline since November.

16e9b2a21cba0a90cc9aa0d701b5c2beb115eaa2.sourceText: 2005年央行宣布匯改，打破人民币紧盯美元的机制，由此人民币开始单边上升，至昨日人民币兑美元累计升值近24%。
16e9b2a21cba0a90cc9aa0d701b5c2beb115eaa2.translatedText: In 2005, the central bank announced exchange rate reforms, breaking the mechanism of RMB being closely pegged to the U.S. dollar. As a result, the RMB began to rise unilaterally, and as of yesterday, the RMB had appreciated by nearly 24% against the U.S. dollar.

57816317c0a8904e46361888fb085592a5993544.sourceText: 劲球奖券当局27日公布的奖券销售收入达7亿1400万元，预期到28日开奖前，销售额可能超过10亿元。单一的中奖人如选择一次领取现金，可获得税前超过3亿2700万元。
57816317c0a8904e46361888fb085592a5993544.translatedText: The Powerball Lottery Authority announced on the 27th that lottery ticket sales revenue reached 714 million yuan, and it is expected that sales may exceed 1 billion yuan before the lottery draw on the 28th. If a single lottery winner chooses to receive cash at once, he can receive more than 327 million yuan before tax.

19da168e74276b803b9a24161f7ad917b63bd6aa.sourceText: 主办劲球奖的爱阿华州奖券局发言人玛莉 纽包尔说，自24日开奖没有人中奖后，奖券热销使奖金暴增1亿7500万元，”此刻真是前所未见，全国的奖券销售冲破屋顶，因此很难准确估计奖金到底会冲到多高”。
19da168e74276b803b9a24161f7ad917b63bd6aa.translatedText: Mary Newbauer, a spokesperson for the Iowa Lottery Bureau, which organizes the Powerball Awards, said that since no one won the lottery on the 24th, the hot sales of lottery tickets have increased the prize money by 175 million yuan. "It is really unprecedented at this moment. The sales of lottery tickets across the country have gone through the roof, so it is difficult to accurately estimate how high the prize money will be."

0e7edebdcfcc7819355f8f31af612f12f9afebf0.sourceText: 纽包尔说，这个奖金吸引了全世界的人，奖券局官员收到在美国以外的人打来的电话或发的电邮，询问他们是否可以从外国购买劲球奖券。纽包尔说，那是不可能的，人们必须在发行劲球奖券的42州和华府及美属维京群岛购买。
0e7edebdcfcc7819355f8f31af612f12f9afebf0.translatedText: Newbauer said the prize attracted people from all over the world, and lottery officials received calls or emails from people outside the United States asking if they could buy Powerball tickets from abroad. That's not possible, Newbauer said, and people would have to buy it in the 42 states that issue Powerball tickets, as well as Washington and the U.S. Virgin Islands.

d346a5c4a9992b14d1efbac84a0905d1cc7e15f3.sourceText: 先前最高的劲球奖金是2006年的3亿6500万元，由内布拉斯加科纳葛拉屠宰场的一群雇员中奖。今年3月，美国历来最高额的兆彩(Mega Millions)奖券奖金6亿5600万元，由三人共同中奖。
d346a5c4a9992b14d1efbac84a0905d1cc7e15f3.translatedText: The previous largest Powerball jackpot was $365 million in 2006, won by a group of employees at a Conagra, Nebraska, slaughterhouse. In March this year, three people won the largest Mega Millions lottery prize ever in the United States, worth $656 million.

d34fdc609d81db39e3054c2d14b615360b9e5777.sourceText: 这次的劲球奖券自10月6日以来就没有人中奖，当奖金累积越高时，购买的人也越多，在17日奖金累积至1亿元后，接下来的四天奖券销售为7000万元；在24日奖金累积超过3亿元后，接下来的四天奖券销售超过1亿4000万元。
d34fdc609d81db39e3054c2d14b615360b9e5777.translatedText: No one has won this Powerball lottery since October 6. When the bonus accumulation is higher, the more people buy it. After the bonus reached 100 million yuan on the 17th, the sales of lottery tickets in the next four days were 70 million yuan; after the bonus accumulation exceeded 300 million yuan on the 24th, the sales of lottery tickets in the next four days exceeded 140 million yuan.

bfbaa8ce39a776fa63e54d6a86c1275b63d19816.sourceText: 爱阿华州奖券局执行长瑞奇说，约有1亿元的奖券是那些偶尔买奖券的人成群回到店中购买的。他说，工人和其他人揪团集资购买奖券的情形日益增加。
bfbaa8ce39a776fa63e54d6a86c1275b63d19816.translatedText: > Iowa Lottery Bureau CEO Ricky said that about 100 million yuan in lottery tickets were bought by those who occasionally bought lottery tickets in droves back to the store. He said there was an increase in the number of workers and others pooling funds into groups to buy lottery tickets.

0d157cce438d4dbeb6a7463358bc3e1f0a19e0c0.sourceText: 5.5亿劲球 亚省密州卖出 （亚省时报） 一连16次「杠龟」的威力球(Powerball)28日晚上11时开奖，威力球奖官员29日凌晨说，价值5亿5000万元的中奖奖券在亚利桑那和密苏里两州卖出，而中了小奖的人数高达890万人。 这次的头奖奖金累积至美国历来第二高的奖额5亿5000万元，令全美民众疯狂抢购，以每分钟出售13万张劲球奖的速度，让全美便利商店、熟食店、杂货店、加油站的奖券贩卖机，响个不停，不断吐出彩券，「买了奖券没有？」成了见面的问候语。 美国历来最高的彩券奖金是今年3月兆彩彩券(Mega Millions)开出的6亿5600万元。一连16次没有人中大奖的劲球彩券，急起直追，奖金28日已累积到令人咋舌的5亿5000万元。 密苏里州的得奖者周四已出面验证奖票，亚省获奖奖票证实在喷泉山卖出，到11月30日上午止，尚未出面验证奖票。不过，根据博彩法，获奖得主可以在开票后180天内兑现奖票。
0d157cce438d4dbeb6a7463358bc3e1f0a19e0c0.translatedText: 550 million Powerballs sold in Michigan, Alberta (Alberta Times) The 16th consecutive Powerball lottery draw of the "Bar Turtle" was held at 11 pm on the 28th. Powerball lottery officials said in the early morning of the 29th that winning tickets worth 550 million yuan were sold in Arizona and Missouri, and as many as 8.9 million people won small prizes. This time the jackpot prize has accumulated to the second highest prize amount in the history of the United States, 550 million yuan, causing people across the United States to rush to buy the lottery tickets at a rate of 130,000 Powerball prizes per minute. The lottery vending machines in convenience stores, delis, grocery stores, and gas stations across the United States kept ringing and spitting out lottery tickets. "Have you bought the lottery tickets?" became a greeting when meeting. The largest lottery prize ever in the United States was $656 million from the Mega Millions lottery in March this year. The Powerball lottery, which has not won the jackpot for 16 consecutive times, is catching up. The prize money has accumulated to a staggering 550 million yuan on the 28th. The Missouri winner came forward to verify the winning ticket on Thursday, and the winning ticket in Alberta was confirmed to have been sold in Fountain Hill. As of the morning of November 30, no one had yet come forward to verify the winning ticket. However, according to gambling laws, winners can cash in their winning tickets within 180 days of the issuance of the ticket.

0be71d9f912ca1c013cb5150c1eee7d52bea0db9.sourceText: 医改逼近 AHCCCS临抉择 （亚省时报） 随着奥巴马成功连任，曾经模糊的联邦医改方案有了新解释。11月20日,美国卫生与公共服务部公布了一份长达331页的医改新规,主要包括3个方面:其一,要求医疗保险公司为所有投保者提供服务,不得以先天 和慢性疾病为由对顾客采取歧视做法；其二,列明医保交易所必须涵盖的保险服务项目,并要求各州政府在2014年之前为医保市场制定一份”基准医保计划”； 其三,要求企业雇主在为员工提供的医保福利中,增加促进员工”健康”的内容。 全民医改将于2014年开始正式实施,根据新规,医保交易所和网上医保市场必须在2013年10月1日前投入运营,顾客届时可从中选择适合自己的医保产品,并确定是否适用税收抵免或享受医疗补助计划。 新规主要界定了医保公司、企业雇主和各州政府在推行”全民医改”方面的责任和义务。数据显示,全美约有1.29亿民众存在先天疾病问题,新规规定此类病患不得受到医保公司的”歧视”。不仅如此,新规还禁止”性别歧视”,规定医保公司不得对女性投保者收取高于男性投保者的费用。对医保公司基于顾客年龄、居住环境、家庭规模和是否吸 烟等因素收取的额外费用,新规给出了限制标准。新规还要求医保公司确保每年延续对顾客提供的医保服。 新规规定,医保交易所必须明确列明提供的服务类别,包括应急服务、住院、母性保健、开处方药和预防治疗等10种情形。新规还要求医保公司提出具体的服务方案,向消费者证明它们能够为其担负年度医保费用60%的支出。 在企业雇主的责任方面,新规要求雇主必须同时推进员工的”健康计划”。对成功戒烟和减肥以及降低身体胆固醇的员工,雇主需提供医保折扣奖励。雇主不得以员工未能达到上述健康指标为由,而在医保费用比例上采取歧视做法。 医改新规虽受到支持者的欢迎,但也面临共和党的强烈抵制。在本州，布鲁尔州长也有自己的医改版本，而立法者在亚利桑那卫生保健成本控制系统(AHCCCS)上将面临一个重大的抉择棗全有或全没有。 全有的意思是如奥巴马总统的医疗保健法，将扩大医疗补助受惠面，包括实施强制性人人买保险政策，这将使本州30万人在2013-2014财政年度享受联邦政府医疗补助。这种情况下，AHCCCS将关闭。 全没有的意思则是不参加联邦医疗改革，保持原有的本州医疗补助系统棗AHCCCS，州政府在此增加拨款，但不多，最多在原有受惠人数的基础上增加13万人。 AHCCCS是亚利桑那州政府提供给本州居民的医疗补助计划，受惠者必须符合低收入家庭或儿童、65岁及以上耆老、身体残疾，意外怀孕等条件，在本州覆盖面达五分之一，占州府的预算的16.2%（10年前是9.9%）。 州长近年来每年都与立法两会就AHCCCS增款或削款争吵不休。这次，州长的发言人马修本森说，牵涉的数目达3亿美元。按医改新规，联邦政府补贴貌似增多，但州政府的预算也要增加，然后又是财政短缺的老问题………. 假如玛雅人的预言靠谱，12月21日不是世界末日而是新世纪的开端，大家就看立法者怎样去摆平这争端。
0be71d9f912ca1c013cb5150c1eee7d52bea0db9.translatedText: Health care reform is approaching, AHCCCS is making a decision (Alberta Times) With Obama's successful re-election, the once vague federal health care reform plan has a new interpretation. On November 20, the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services announced a 331-page new medical reform regulation, which mainly includes three aspects: first, requiring medical insurance companies to provide services to all insured persons and not discriminating against customers on the basis of congenital and chronic diseases; second, listing the insurance services that must be covered by medical insurance exchanges, and requiring state governments to develop a "benchmark medical insurance plan" for the medical insurance market before 2014; Third, employers are required to add content that promotes employees’ “health” into the medical insurance benefits they provide to their employees. National medical reform will be officially implemented in 2014. According to the new regulations, the medical insurance exchange and online medical insurance market must be put into operation before October 1, 2013. Customers can then choose the medical insurance products that suit them and determine whether they are eligible for tax credits or receive medical subsidy plans. The new regulations mainly define the responsibilities and obligations of medical insurance companies, corporate employers and state governments in implementing "universal health care reform." Data shows that about 129 million people in the United States have congenital diseases. The new regulations stipulate that such patients shall not be "discriminated" by medical insurance companies. Not only that, the new regulations also prohibit "gender discrimination" and stipulate that medical insurance companies must not charge female insured higher fees than male insured. The new regulations set limits on the additional fees that medical insurance companies can charge based on factors such as the customer's age, living environment, family size, and whether they smoke. The new regulations also require medical insurance companies to ensure that the medical insurance services provided to customers are continued every year. The new regulations stipulate that medical insurance exchanges must clearly list the types of services provided, including emergency services, hospitalization, maternal health care, prescription drugs and preventive treatment in 10 situations. The new regulations also require medical insurance companies to propose specific service plans to prove to consumers that they can afford 60% of their annual medical insurance expenses. In terms of employer responsibilities, the new regulations require employers to simultaneously promote employee “health plans.” Employers are required to provide discounts on medical insurance to employees who successfully quit smoking, lose weight, and lower their cholesterol. Employers are not allowed to discriminate in the proportion of medical insurance expenses on the grounds that employees fail to meet the above-mentioned health indicators. Although the new health care reform regulations are welcomed by supporters, they also face strong resistance from the Republican Party. Back home, Governor Brewer has his own version of health care reform, and lawmakers will face a big decision -- all or nothing -- on the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS). What all means is that President Obama's health care law will expand Medicaid benefits, including the implementation of a mandatory insurance policy for everyone, which will enable 300,000 people in the state to enjoy federal government Medicaid in the 2013-2014 fiscal year. In this case, AHCCCS will be shut down. None means not participating in the federal health care reform and maintaining the original state Medicaid system called AHCCCS. The state government will increase funding here, but not much. At most, it will increase by 130,000 people on the basis of the original number of beneficiaries. AHCCCS is a Medicaid program provided by the Arizona government to residents of the state. Recipients must meet conditions such as low-income families or children, seniors aged 65 and over, physical disabilities, and unwanted pregnancies. It covers one fifth of the state and accounts for 16.2% of the state budget (9.9% 10 years ago). The governor has argued with the Legislature every year in recent years over whether to increase or reduce funding for AHCCCS. This time, the governor's spokesman Matthew Benson said the amount involved was $300 million. According to the new medical reform regulations, federal subsidies seem to increase, but state government budgets will also increase, and then there is the old problem of financial shortages... If the Mayan predictions are reliable, and December 21 is not the end of the world but the beginning of a new century, everyone will have to wait and see how legislators resolve this dispute.

b7f762a2057709727fa7eccfa8f5d0ceab4ccf01.sourceText: 亚裔退休老人养老面临诸多障碍 1/3不能领取社安金 据波士顿网站Bay State Banner报道，全美将有近400万老人无法获得社安金，其中1/3为少数族裔。事实上，根据美国人口普查局的数据显示，大约1/6的非裔、1/5的拉丁裔和1/3的亚裔老人将无法享受联邦养老金福利。 不符合社安金领取标准的比例在移民群体当中较高。据悉，大概一半的拉丁裔老人和80%的亚裔老人都没有社会安全保障。根据美国法律，非法移民是不符合美国福利保障要求的，但是对于那些有合法移民身份的人来说，由于没有足够的工作记录，他们也无法获得福利保障。 而对于亚裔退休老人来说，想要达到收支平衡并不容易。根据2011年Insight Center所做的报告显示，有资格领取社安金支票的人每年大概能拿到2000美元，相比全美退休老人的平均收入约少1万3066美元。而太平洋岛民能够领取的更少。 这份报告的作者还称，由于文化语言等其他方面的障碍，造成亚裔和其他族裔移民很难了解关于社保项目的相关知识。另外，亚裔退休老人还面临很多障碍，诸如文化层面上对于官僚机构的抵触心理、经济独立的自豪感和对政府的恐惧心理都会造成他们申请社安金时的犹豫心理。 而令人感到讽刺的是，社会安全保障局称2010年非法移民对社安信托基金贡献了120亿美元，但是非法移民同时也诈骗了10亿美元的社安金。很多非法移民在工作过程中都使用假的社安卡来缴纳社安金，但是他们却永远拿不到养老金。
b7f762a2057709727fa7eccfa8f5d0ceab4ccf01.translatedText: Asian retired seniors face many obstacles in providing for their retirement. One third of them cannot receive Social Security benefits. According to the Boston website Bay State Banner, Banner reported that nearly 4 million elderly people in the United States will not be able to receive Social Security benefits, and 1/3 of them are ethnic minorities. In fact, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau, approximately 1/6 of African Americans, 1/5 of Latinos, and 1/3 of Asian elderly people will not be able to enjoy federal pension benefits. The proportion of immigrants who do not meet the criteria for receiving social security benefits is higher among immigrant groups. It is reported that about half of Latino elderly people and 80% of Asian elderly people do not have social security protection. According to U.S. law, illegal immigrants are not eligible for U.S. welfare protection, but for those with legal immigration status, they are unable to obtain welfare protection because they do not have sufficient work records. For Asian retirees, it is not easy to balance their income and expenses. According to a 2011 Insight Center report, people who are eligible to receive Social Security checks can receive about $2,000 per year, which is about $13,066 less than the average income of retired seniors in the United States. And Pacific Islanders receive even less. The authors of the report also said that cultural, language and other barriers make it difficult for immigrants of Asian and other ethnic origins to understand relevant knowledge about social security programs. In addition, Asian retirees also face many obstacles, such as cultural resistance to bureaucracy, pride in financial independence, and fear of the government, which all cause their hesitation when applying for social security benefits. Ironically, the Social Security Administration said illegal immigrants contributed $12 billion to the Social Security trust fund in 2010, but illegal immigrants also defrauded $1 billion in Social Security benefits. Many illegal immigrants use fake Social Security cards to pay Social Security benefits while working, but they never receive their pensions.

c0b8594fdaf76c8c1301cf222c732b5952ad5138.sourceText: 立法会让亚利桑那州选民决定是否应要求2/3票数加税 （亚省新闻） 2月6日亚利桑那州的选民可以是否应要求2/3票数決定税收的变化。 在6-3表决，众议院筹款委员会批准了一项計劃，需要显示在投票批准任何新税种的三分之二表决的提案。這個制度将是必要上调现行税率或减少或消除现有减税，免税或信贷。 追溯到以往，有效地撤销以前批准的任何税，没有获得所需的三分之二票数。这几乎意味着所有：在2010年批准在该州销售税上调1%，只有65％的通过率。 但众议员戴维史蒂文斯的R-谢拉维斯塔说，当HCR 2043法案裡，他会删除该语言。 民主党人的表示反对。但太阳城，众议员里克格雷说，這個決議比較難實現，除非那些在即将到来的 换届选举投票的多数给予批准。 众议员特德格特，R森指出，三分之二的批准的要求，选民对国会议员施加自己，才可以加息税或消除税收抵免。 沃格特表示选民会同意，结合自己的双手，当谈到未来的增税，人們应该有发言权。
c0b8594fdaf76c8c1301cf222c732b5952ad5138.translatedText: Legislation will let Arizona voters decide whether a 2/3 vote tax increase should be required (Alberta News) On February 6, Arizona voters can decide whether the tax changes should require a 2/3 vote. In a 6-3 vote, the House Ways and Means Committee approved a plan that would require a two-thirds vote to appear on the ballot to approve any new taxes. This system would be necessary to increase current tax rates or to reduce or eliminate existing tax breaks, exemptions or credits. Retroactively, effectively revoking any tax previously approved, without the required two-thirds vote. That means almost everything: A 1 percent sales tax increase in the state was approved in 2010, with only a 65 percent passing rate. But Rep. David Stevens, R-Sierra Vista, said he would remove that language when HCR 2043 is introduced into the bill. Democrats objected. But Rep. Rick Gray of Sun City said the resolution would be difficult to achieve unless a majority of those voting in the upcoming general election give it approval. Rep. Ted Gert, R-Sen., noted the two-thirds approval requirement that voters impose on members of Congress before they can raise taxes or eliminate tax credits. Vogt said voters will agree, by combining their hands, that people should have a say when it comes to future tax increases.

05c319d315a9e9d4d91845ec2ef9857b4db3e6d2.sourceText: 吉伯特初中在2014-15学年关闭 （亚省时报） 吉伯特公立学校理事会日前投票通过，在2014-15学年内，关闭吉伯特初中。 吉伯特古典学院将搬入现在的吉伯特初中校址，目前在校的吉伯特初中学生将分流到校区的其他学校。理事会表决成立一个特别委员会，以帮助学校过渡，帮助学生转校。 校区总监戴夫艾莉森会后告诉居民，吉伯特初中是因为入学率历年下降而关闭。代替它的吉伯特古典学院将采取抽奖方式录取学生。
05c319d315a9e9d4d91845ec2ef9857b4db3e6d2.translatedText: > Gilbert Junior High School will close in the 2014-15 school year (Alberta Times) The Gilbert Public School Board of Trustees recently voted to close Gilbert Junior High School during the 2014-15 school year. Gilbert Classical Academy will move into the current location of Gilbert Junior High School, and current Gilbert Junior High students will be transferred to other schools in the campus. The board of trustees voted to form a special committee to help the school transition and help students transfer. Superintendent Dave Allison told residents after the meeting that Gilbert Junior High School was closed due to declining enrollment over the years. In its place, Gilbert Classical College will admit students on a lottery basis.

d69a978e0005936ee3e2ad762a8230e8a930c0e9.sourceText: 报道说，由于此次是习近平接任后的首次公开讲话，因此也被视为是他的「就职演说」。习近平的讲话中出现次数最多的词语是「人民」，形容「人民是伟大的人民」，「人民是历史的创造者」，并先后两次表示，中国共产党应是「全心全意为人民服务的」。他还强调「人民对美好生活的嚮往」就是中共奋斗的目标。
d69a978e0005936ee3e2ad762a8230e8a930c0e9.translatedText: reported that since this was Xi Jinping's first public speech after taking over, it was also regarded as his "inaugural speech." The word that appears most frequently in Xi Jinping's speeches is "people", describing "the people as the great people" and "the people as the creators of history." He has twice stated that the Communist Party of China should "serve the people wholeheartedly." He also emphasized that "the people's yearning for a better life" is the goal of the CCP.

4b4ac7a695e8e16e18dc20343cced9427ae73254.sourceText: 他在讲话中也承认，中共「面临着许多严峻挑战」，「存在着许多亟待解决的问题」，并提到「一些党员干部中发生的贪污腐败、脱离群众、形式主义、官僚主义等问题」，表示「必须下大气力解决」，而且要「从严治党」，「切实解决自身存在的突出问题」。
4b4ac7a695e8e16e18dc20343cced9427ae73254.translatedText: In his speech, he also admitted that the CCP "faces many severe challenges" and "there are many problems that need to be solved urgently", and mentioned "problems such as corruption, isolation from the masses, formalism, bureaucracy and other problems that have occurred among some party members and cadres", saying that "they must make great efforts to solve them", and that they must "strictly govern the party" and "effectively solve their own outstanding problems."

e71faecb4faf8b3ba4e89dd13870a3f940d161b6.sourceText: 报道还说，习近平当天的讲话没有提到政治口号，使用的语言也非常平实和通俗。香港大学学者钱钢对习近平的讲话做出积极评价，认为这次讲话「很正面」、「很亲切」、「很实在」。
e71faecb4faf8b3ba4e89dd13870a3f940d161b6.translatedText: The report also said that Xi Jinping’s speech that day did not mention political slogans, and the language he used was very plain and popular. Qian Gang, a scholar at the University of Hong Kong, made a positive evaluation of Xi Jinping's speech, saying that the speech was "very positive", "very cordial" and "very practical".

6de05a38552ab672097ee60366ff34d00bf53f34.sourceText: 「还值得注意的是他讲话中的历史包袱不见，马克思主义，列宁主义，毛泽东思想不见了，邓小平理论和三个代表，都不见了，倒不是说他有意要放弃这些东西，而是作为一篇讲话，他不需要背这麽沉重的包袱。我注意的政治术语裡他只用了中国特色的社会主义。其他那些空的大的，他都没有讲，」 钱钢说。
6de05a38552ab672097ee60366ff34d00bf53f34.translatedText: "It is also worth noting that the historical baggage in his speech is gone. Marxism, Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, Deng Xiaoping Theory and Three Represents are all gone. It is not that he intends to give up these things, but as a speech, he does not need to carry such a heavy baggage. Among the political terms I noticed, he only used socialism with Chinese characteristics. He did not talk about other empty and big ones," Qian Gang said.

a0ba86dfbbe44b8cd99cdd779137543047083eb3.sourceText: 消费者报告：防晒霜No-Ad最宜买 炎热的夏季即将来临，也到了买防晒霜的时候了。那么到底买哪一款比较适宜呢？美国权威杂志《消费者报告》（ Consumer Reports ）对 18 个很受大众欢迎的防晒霜品牌进行测试并公布结果，或许对各位爱美人士会有些启发。 杂志的测试结果发现，最合适的并不一定是最贵的。该测试包括四大方面：生活紫外线（ UVA ）和户外紫外线（ UVB ）防护性、入水后 UVB 防护性还有 着色剂构造，满分为 100 分。受测品牌产品没有一个在这四方面都表现出色。 All Terrain Aqua 运动防晒霜以 88 分获得第一名，另有 13 个产品得分为 70 分或 70 分以上。 评出的 ” 最宜买” 产品为 No-Ad 芦荟维生素 E 防晒霜， SPF 为 45 ；还有沃尔格林（ Walgreens ）持效运动喷雾防晒霜， SPF 为 50 。 SPF 值是指产品对 UVB 辐射的防护。 UVA 能导致皮肤老化和皮肤癌， UVB 会招致晒伤。《消费者报告》建议人们使用 SPF 至少 30 以上的抗水防晒霜。 美国食品和药物管理局（ FDA ）将实行新规则，要求制造商证明其产品的功效跟所宣称的一样，能够阻挡紫外线照射，有?/FONT> 广谱防护?/FONT> （ broad- spectrum protection ）功效。不过新规则的实施将推迟到 12 月份。 《消费者报告》在其评估报告中，也对这些产品的 ” 临界波” （ critical wave ）进行了测试。 在受测的防晒霜中，发现其中” 7 种阻挡 UVA 效果良好，且阻挡 UVB 效果极佳，即使浸在水中 80 分钟也一样” 。但其中两款产品 棗SPF 为 45 的 Alba Botanica 天然润肤运动防晒霜和 SPF 为 50 以上的香蕉船儿童无泪防叮防晒霜（ Banana Boat Kids Tear-Free Sting-Free ），没有通过测试。两者都能有效阻挡 UVB ，但对 UVA 的防护很差。 FDA 要求新标签和测试结果必须贴在产品表面，并需告诉消费者，标有” 广谱” 和 SPF 15 或更高的防晒霜可以防止晒斑，并减少患皮肤癌和早期皮肤老化的风险。
a0ba86dfbbe44b8cd99cdd779137543047083eb3.translatedText: Consumer Report: Sunscreen No-Ad is the best to buy. The hot summer is coming, and it’s time to buy sunscreen. So which one is more suitable to buy? The authoritative American magazine "Consumer Reports" tested 18 popular sunscreen brands and published the results, which may provide some inspiration to all beauty lovers. The magazine's tests found that the most suitable isn't necessarily the most expensive. The test includes four major aspects: daily ultraviolet (UVA) and outdoor ultraviolet (UVB) protection, UVB protection after entering water, and colorant construction, with a full score of 100 points. None of the brand products tested performed well in all four areas. All Terrain Aqua Sports Sunscreen took first place with a score of 88, with 13 other products scoring 70 or above. The “Best Buy” products were No-Ad Aloe Vitamin E Sunscreen with SPF 45 and Walgreens Long Lasting Sports Spray Sunscreen with SPF 50. The SPF value refers to a product’s protection against UVB radiation. UVA can cause skin aging and skin cancer, and UVB can cause sunburn. Consumer Reports recommends people use a water-resistant sunscreen with an SPF of at least 30. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) will implement new rules that require manufacturers to prove that their products are as effective as claimed and can block ultraviolet radiation and have broad-spectrum protection. However, implementation of the new rules will be delayed until December. Consumer Reports also tested the "critical wave" of these products in its evaluation report. Of the sunscreens tested, "7 were found to be very effective at blocking UVA and extremely effective at blocking UVB, even when immersed in water for 80 minutes." But two of the products, Alba Botanica Natural Emollient Sports Sunscreen with SPF 45 and Banana Boat Kids Tear-Free Sting-Free with SPF 50+, failed the test. Both effectively block UVB but offer poor protection against UVA. The FDA requires new labels and test results to be affixed to products and tell consumers that sunscreens labeled "broad spectrum" and SPF 15 or higher can prevent sun spots and reduce the risk of skin cancer and early skin aging.

84eb0192d5e924562fc61fd34102bd6220d20c79.sourceText: 庆祝中华民国101年双十国庆文化访问团 9月起巡回美加地区26城市 侨务委员会新闻稿 侨务委员会为庆祝中华民国101年双十国庆，特于9月中旬遴派「本安文化剧团」及「玩声乐团」筹组国庆文化访问团，分赴美国及加拿大26个城市巡回访演， 以具传统文化及台湾新创音乐特色之文化飨宴，与海外侨胞及主流人士欢度中华民国国庆，进而让世界看到台湾生命力与文化活力。 「本安文化剧团」巡回城市包括波士顿、纽约、纽泽西、华府、达拉斯、波特兰、西雅图、圣地牙哥、洛杉矶及凤凰城等地，演出10场次，「玩声乐团」巡回城市 包括加拿大温哥华、爱城、多伦多、美国芝加哥、底特律、明州双子城、奥兰多、华府、亚特兰大、北卡洛丽、圣路易、堪萨斯市、丹佛、盐湖城、沙加缅度、旧金山及 檀香山等地，演出17场次。 「本安文化剧团」演出人员有台湾知名艺人陆一婵、方芳、陈凯伦、郎祖筠、苏霈，以及今年甫获得金曲奖最佳台语男歌手奖的荒山亮等人，以「群星舞动庆双十」 为节目主题，安排经典歌曲「热情的沙漠」、「站在高冈上」，清新悦耳的小调「西湖盼」、「满场飞」，脍炙人口的台语歌曲「内山姑娘要出嫁」、「干 一杯」，耳熟能详的粤语歌曲「上海滩」，以及饶富趣味的One-Man Talk Show等，以老干新枝之表演团队，具体展现台湾多元文化，让心系故乡的海外侨胞们，感受中华民国 国庆普天同庆的欢乐气氛。 「玩声乐团」为亚洲首屈一指的人声乐团，本年节目除安排华语、台语、客语、粤语及英语等横跨老中青三代，大家耳熟能详之歌曲外，并以爵士、流行、抒情及 动感等不同类型曲风，演唱「邓丽君经典组曲」、民歌系列，以及「十八姑娘」、「天空落水」及「追」等客语及粤语歌曲；同时也安排了「Las Vegas」、「Change the world」、「Born this way」等具代表性英文歌曲，期以丰富活泼的和声、热情洋溢的舞台魅力，展现台湾表演艺术丰沛的创意与内涵。 侨务委员会与美国26城市主办侨团诚挚邀请侨胞偕旧雨、携新知共同欢度中华民国101年双十国庆，详细演出时间、地点及参与方式，可洽各华侨文教服务中心或驻外馆处。
84eb0192d5e924562fc61fd34102bd6220d20c79.translatedText: > The cultural delegation to celebrate the 101st National Day of the Republic of China. Touring 26 cities in the United States and Canada starting in September. Overseas Chinese Affairs Council press release. In order to celebrate the 101st National Day of the Republic of China, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council specially selected "Ben'an Cultural Theater" and "Wansheng Ensemble" to form a National Day cultural tour group in mid-September, which will tour 26 cities in the United States and Canada. Celebrate the National Day of the Republic of China with overseas Chinese and mainstream people with a cultural feast featuring traditional culture and Taiwan's new music, and let the world see Taiwan's vitality and cultural vitality. "Ben An Cultural Theater" toured cities including Boston, New York, New Jersey, Washington, Dallas, Portland, Seattle, San Diego, Los Angeles and Phoenix, etc., performing 10 performances. "Playing Sound Ensemble" toured cities including Vancouver, Edmonton, Toronto, Canada, Chicago, Detroit, Minnesota Twin Cities, Orlando, Washington, Atlanta, North Carolina, St. Louis, Kansas City, Denver, Salt Lake City, Sacramento, San Francisco and Honolulu, etc., performing 17 performances. The performers of "Ben'an Cultural Theater" include well-known Taiwanese artists Lu Yichan, Fang Fang, Chen Karen, Lang Zujun, Su Pei, as well as Ryo Arayama, who just won the Golden Melody Award for Best Taiwanese Male Singer this year, and others to celebrate Double Ten with "Dancing Stars" For the theme of the program, the classic songs "Passionate Desert" and "Standing on the High Hill", the fresh and melodious ditty "West Lake Hope" and "Flying Over the Field", the popular Taiwanese songs "The Uchiyama Girl is Getting Married" and "Cheers", the familiar Cantonese song "Shanghai Beach", and the interesting One-Man Talk Show, etc., with the performance team of Laogan and Xinzhi, concretely demonstrate Taiwan's diverse culture, allowing overseas Chinese who care about their hometown to feel the joyful atmosphere of the National Day celebrations of the Republic of China. "Playing Voice Ensemble" is Asia's leading vocal ensemble. In addition to familiar songs in Chinese, Taiwanese, Hakka, Cantonese and English across the three generations of old, middle and young people, the program also features "Teresa Teng's Classic Suite", a folk song series, Hakka and Cantonese songs such as "Eighteen Girls", "The Sky Falls" and "Chasing" in different genres such as jazz, pop, lyrical and dynamic. "Las" is also arranged. Vegas", "Change the world", "Born this way" and other representative English songs, hoping to showcase the rich creativity and connotation of Taiwan's performing arts with rich and lively harmonies and passionate stage charm. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Council and the overseas Chinese groups hosted by 26 cities in the United States sincerely invite overseas Chinese to celebrate the 101st National Day of the Republic of China with old friends and new knowledge. For detailed performance time, location and participation methods, please contact the overseas Chinese cultural and educational service centers or overseas embassy offices.

b4a70bd3e52172b760c04e7d526338352615fe96.sourceText: 10月增就业17万失业率至7.9% 劳工部周五宣布，10月失业率为7.9%。据彭博社调查，此前经济学家对此的平均预期为7.9%。比9月失业率7.8%略升。就业增失业率反而上升，是因为失业率统计数据是根据找工作的人数决定的，说明10月份有更多人寻找就业岗位。 10月非农就业数据新增就业岗位17.1万个，好于9月份的11.4万个；但就业岗位增幅不足以显著拉低失业率，10月失业率从9月的7.8%小幅升至7.9%。 作为大选前发布的最重要经济数据，非农就业数据的表现不但将影响市场情绪，还可能左右美国总统选举结果。奥本海默基金首席经济学家魏博曼指出，摇摆不定的选民们很容易受到与自己切身相关的就业市场表现的影响，?#29305;别好或者特别差的就业数据都将令那些犹豫不决的选民很快做出决定?#12290; 眼下距离选举投票截止日只有四天，选情仍然焦灼。最新NPR新闻调查结果显示，在12个主要”摇摆”州，奥巴马的支持率为50%，领先罗姆尼4个百分点，但从全国调查来看，罗姆尼领先奥巴马一个百分点，支持率为48%。 美国广播公司/华盛顿邮报对8个主要”摇摆”州的最新民调结果显示，奥巴马的支持率为49%，领先于罗姆尼的48%。
b4a70bd3e52172b760c04e7d526338352615fe96.translatedText: >In October, 170,000 jobs were added and the unemployment rate reached 7.9%. The Labor Department announced on Friday that the unemployment rate was 7.9% in October. According to a Bloomberg survey, economists had previously expected an average of 7.9%. The unemployment rate was slightly higher than September's 7.8%. The reason why the unemployment rate increased while employment increased is because the unemployment rate statistics are based on the number of people looking for work, indicating that more people were looking for jobs in October. Non-farm employment data in October showed 171,000 new jobs, which was better than the 114,000 in September. However, the increase in jobs was not enough to significantly lower the unemployment rate. The unemployment rate rose slightly to 7.9% in October from 7.8% in September. As the most important economic data released before the election, the performance of non-farm employment data will not only affect market sentiment, but may also influence the outcome of the US presidential election. Wei Boman, chief economist of the Oppenheimer Fund, pointed out that swing voters are easily affected by the performance of the job market that is closely related to them. Bad or particularly bad employment data will make those undecided voters make a decision quickly. Now there are only four days before the election voting deadline, and the election situation is still anxious. The latest NPR news survey results show that in 12 major "swing" states, Obama's approval rate is 50%, leading Romney by 4 percentage points. However, from the national survey, Romney leads Obama by one percentage point, with an approval rate of 48%. The latest ABC/Washington Post poll of eight major "swing" states shows that Obama's support rate is 49%, ahead of Romney's 48%.

b1fd407ab77b8f8688fe0e1f0b93071b6be83c0a.sourceText: 根据亚利桑那州公司委员会的公开记录，于2007年5月注册登记的前亚利桑那州(亚省)华人联合总会，英文名ARIZONA CHINESE UNITED ASSOCIATION，已经于2012年10月17日被亚利桑那州公司委员会解散。 Per Arizona Corporation Commission抯 public record, the previous Arizona Chinese United Association, which was incorporated in May 2007, was dissolved by Arizona Corporation Commission on 10/17/2012. 另根据美国国家税务局的公开记录，前（2007年5月注册成立，并在2012年10月被解散）的亚利桑那州华人华侨联合会，国家税务局所允准的501(c)(3) 免税资格已于2011年6月9 日被撤销。 Per IRS抯 public record, 501(c)(3) exemption status of the previous Arizona Chinese United Association (incorporated in May 2007 and dissolved in Oct 2012) was revoked by IRS on 6/9/2011. 现在新的ARIZONA CHINESE UNITED ASSOCIATION（亚利桑那州(亚省)华人华侨联合总会，简称亚省华联或华联，英文简称ACUA），已经由王盛君等在亚利桑那州合法注册，并于2013年5月24日获得州政府批准正式成立。 新的ARIZONA CHINESE UNITED ASSOCIATION正式声明，自公布之日起，任何个人或者组织，未经现 ARIZONA CHINESE UNITED ASSOCIATION（亚利桑那州(亚省)华人华侨联合总会，简称亚省华联或华联，英文简称ACUA，以下统称”亚省华联”）董事会批准或者授权，不得在公开场合和各类媒体包括文书、报纸、杂志、互联网、电子邮件等使用亚省华联名字（包括中英文全称和简称）发表文章、发布任何信息或者开展任何活动。亚省华联董事会保留追究法律责任的权利。
b1fd407ab77b8f8688fe0e1f0b93071b6be83c0a.translatedText: According to the public records of the Arizona Corporation Commission, the former Arizona (Alberta) Chinese United Association was registered in May 2007, with the English name ARIZONA CHINESE UNITED ASSOCIATION, was dissolved by the Arizona Corporation Commission on October 17, 2012. Per Arizona Corporation Commission's public record, the previous Arizona Chinese United Association, which was incorporated in May 2007, was dissolved by Arizona Corporation Commission on 10/17/2012. The tax exemption status was revoked on June 9, 2011. Per IRS' public record, 501(c)(3) exemption status of the previous Arizona Chinese United Association (incorporated in May 2007 and dissolved in Oct 2012) was revoked by IRS on 6/9/2011. Now the new ARIZONA CHINESE UNITED ASSOCIATION (Arizona (Arizona) Overseas Chinese Federation, referred to as Arizona Hualian or Hualian, English abbreviation ACUA) has been legally registered in Arizona by Wang Shengjun and others, and was officially established with the approval of the state government on May 24, 2013. The new ARIZONA CHINESE UNITED ASSOCIATION officially declares that since the date of announcement, no individual or organization has appeared in the ARIZONA CHINESE UNITED ASSOCIATION (Arizona (Arizona) Overseas Chinese Federation, abbreviated as ACUA in English, hereinafter collectively referred to as "Arizona Hualien") has approved or authorized the board of directors and shall not use the name of the Arizona Hualian (including the full name and abbreviation in Chinese and English) to publish articles, publish any information or carry out any activities in public places and in various media including documents, newspapers, magazines, Internet, emails, etc. The Board of Directors of Alberta Hualian reserves the right to pursue legal liability.
