9c6fe7b3eb8d9940b44c61ac0da5238437672caa.sourceText: 凤凰城一个11月大孩子的母亲被控 摇晃孩子 致其病危 根据凤凰城警察局警探的消息，一个11月大的凤凰城女孩生命垂危，怀疑是因为她的母亲，玛丽亚答里维拉，摇晃她，而造成的严重伤害。警方之所以怀疑21岁的母亲玛丽亚答里维拉，是因为在事后一个多小时，她才送孩子到医院就医。大约是星期二晚上9时，医院的工作人员打电话报了警，因为孩子受的伤和母亲的解释不一致。巡逻人员立刻回应，联络侦探调查。官员说，里维拉被关在马里科帕县监狱，可能将被控两项虐儿罪名。里维拉的另外两个孩子，1个月岁和2岁，将被给予儿童保护服务。警方说，第三个孩子，里维拉的妹妹的孩子，被里维拉的母亲保管，也采取了保护儿童服务。
9c6fe7b3eb8d9940b44c61ac0da5238437672caa.translatedText: Phoenix mother of 11-month-old child accused of shaking child to critical condition An 11-month-old Phoenix girl is in critical condition and is suspected to have suffered serious injuries because her mother, Maria A. Rivera, shook her, according to detectives with the Phoenix Police Department. The reason why the police suspected the 21-year-old mother Maria Rivera was because she did not send her child to the hospital for medical treatment more than an hour after the incident. At about 9pm on Tuesday, hospital staff called the police because the child's injuries were inconsistent with the mother's explanation. Patrol officers responded immediately and contacted detectives to investigate. Rivera is being held in the Maricopa County Jail and will likely be charged with two counts of child abuse, officials said. Rivera's other two children, ages 1 month and 2 years old, will be referred to child protective services. Police said a third child, the child of Rivera's sister, was being taken into the custody of Rivera's mother and child protective services were also taken into custody.

9dc557ee1a3d9ea238807abc352f7e6e2cd944f8.sourceText: 问：最近几周以来，市场一直处于上下大幅震荡。 现在是否该选择离场观望，还是有更好的应对方法？ 答：过去几周绝对是最好的考验投资者是否有能力应对股价大幅下滑，市场波动性骤增的最好机会。 在急剧波动的市场中，最佳应对措施，或许就是避免恐慌！ 当然要处惊不乱，绝对是说比做容易。 尤其是在资讯高度发达，投资者迅速对各类消息作出反应的环境中，会更不容易。 情绪化的抛售已经成为市场不稳定的一大原因。 但如果有足够的耐心，能够继续关注长期性投资目标的话，今后几年里一定能看到坚定投资所带来的丰厚回报。 从未来发展看，还有很多不利因素，这就注定股市不可能单边向上发展。 从历史看，股市下跌10%左右的行情属于正常的市场调整。 很多专业投资顾问都建议不要因此急于套现，但同时市场提供了一个买入的机会。 投资者都知道要「低买高卖」的道理。 更大幅度的下跌自然也会发生。 但幸运的是通常不会持续太久，通常股价上涨时期都会比下跌时期更为长久。 虽然在过去20年里股市起起伏伏，但是史坦普500指数依然提供正面的回报，加上配息的再投资，累积回报已达到16倍。 在2000年3月的网路泡沫破灭，到2002年9月史坦普500指数下跌约47%，但之前的牛市始于1987年11月累积涨幅818%。 也就是两年半的下跌，对应的是超过12年的上涨。 包括所有市场大起大落，如果长期坚持呆在市场中，那么回报有多少？ 从1926年以来，史坦普500指数加上股息再投资，平均年回报率为9.9%，在2009年股市降至底部时，回报率降至9%，但到2010年12月，回报率又 获得大幅提升。 不论市场如何变化，最佳的方式就保持健康的耐心。 抵抗住任何急于将股票套现的欲望，保持继续投资。 没人知道市场何时会重新上扬。 当然这也不是说一辈子都不要去调整仓位。 个人财务状况会有变化，对于风险承受能力也会有所不同。 这都需要对投资进行调整。 保持每个月坚持投资，最终可以在低价处购入一些股票，用以弥补在今后市场下跌造成的损失。 同样在市场回升时，也无须紧张是否会踏空行情。 很少有投资者能真正把握住最低处入市。 记住，投资者需要关注的是长期回报，而不是市场每天的波动。
9dc557ee1a3d9ea238807abc352f7e6e2cd944f8.translatedText: Q: The market has been swinging wildly up and down in recent weeks. Is it time to stay on the sidelines now, or is there a better way to deal with it? A: The past few weeks have been the absolute best opportunity to test investors’ ability to cope with a sharp decline in stock prices and a sudden increase in market volatility. In a volatile market, the best response may be to avoid panic! Of course, staying calm is definitely easier said than done. Especially in an environment where information is highly developed and investors react quickly to all kinds of news, it will be even more difficult. Emotional selling has become a major cause of market instability. But if you have enough patience and can continue to focus on long-term investment goals, you will definitely see the generous returns from your determined investment in the next few years. From the perspective of future development, there are still many unfavorable factors, which means that the stock market cannot develop unilaterally upward. Historically, a stock market drop of about 10% is a normal market adjustment. Many professional investment advisors advise against rushing to cash out, but at the same time the market provides a buying opportunity. Investors all know the principle of "buy low, sell high." A larger decline will naturally occur. But fortunately, it usually doesn't last long. Periods of rising stock prices usually last longer than periods of falling stock prices. Although the stock market has had its ups and downs over the past 20 years, the S&P 500 Index has still provided positive returns, and with the reinvestment of dividends, the cumulative return has reached 16 times. After the dot-com bubble burst in March 2000, the S&P 500 index fell by approximately 47% by September 2002, but the previous bull market began in November 1987 with a cumulative increase of 818%. That is, two and a half years of decline corresponds to more than 12 years of rise. Including all market ups and downs, if you stick to the market for a long time, what will be the return? Since 1926, the S&P 500 Index plus dividend reinvestment has averaged an annual return of 9.9%. When the stock market bottomed out in 2009, the return fell to 9%, but by December 2010, the return had improved significantly. No matter how the market changes, the best way is to maintain a healthy patience. Resist any urge to cash out your stocks and stay invested. No one knows when the market will rise again. Of course, this does not mean that you should never adjust your positions throughout your life. Personal financial situations will change, and so will your risk tolerance. This all requires adjustments to investment. Keep investing every month, and eventually you can buy some stocks at low prices to make up for losses caused by future market declines. Similarly, when the market rebounds, there is no need to worry about whether the market will go short. Few investors can truly seize the lowest point to enter the market. Remember, investors need to focus on long-term returns, not daily fluctuations in the market.

e7b11f5d29eb6c0b99b74bc6e9ffdcab4832fc47.translatedText: The number of immigration laws passed by states in the United States soared by 83%

b62d433079c31f2a1eb356c091f8a58ab3580745.sourceText: 美各州通过移民法规猛增83% 全美各州今年上半年通过的移民法规比去年同期猛增83%。全国州议会大会星期三发…
b62d433079c31f2a1eb356c091f8a58ab3580745.translatedText: The number of immigration laws passed by states in the United States surged by 83% in the first half of this year compared with the same period last year. The National Conference of State Legislatures issued a statement on Wednesday...

106c8d82f962a2e867684589f40a62327e8712ea.sourceText: 全美各州今年上半年通过的移民法规比去年同期猛增83%。全国州议会大会星期三发表的报告显示，美国最高法院对亚利桑那州打击移民法律做出的裁决，刺激多州制订相关法规的步伐。
106c8d82f962a2e867684589f40a62327e8712ea.translatedText: Immigration regulations passed by states across the United States in the first half of this year soared by 83% compared with the same period last year. A report released Wednesday by the National Conference of State Legislatures showed that the U.S. Supreme Court's ruling on Arizona's anti-immigration law has spurred many states to enact related laws.

52a97ed7eed54dca5f7d39e54caf20de60694a97.sourceText: 据路透社报道，43州和哥伦比亚特区议员上半年通过146部移民法律和231个决议，而去年同期为206部法律和决议。
52a97ed7eed54dca5f7d39e54caf20de60694a97.translatedText: According to Reuters, lawmakers in 43 states and the District of Columbia passed 146 immigration laws and 231 resolutions in the first half of the year, compared with 206 laws and resolutions in the same period last year.

6dc782b021dca01d4a57e44c9b4c0982f072d535.sourceText: 各州移民法规猛增首先是因为最高法院去年6月裁决的刺激。那一裁决支持亚利桑那州2010年移民法律最具争议的部分–要求警察拦路盘查时检查移民身份；尽管裁决否定了那部法律的另外三个条款。
6dc782b021dca01d4a57e44c9b4c0982f072d535.translatedText: The surge in immigration regulations in various states was first stimulated by the Supreme Court's ruling last June. That ruling upheld the most controversial part of Arizona's 2010 immigration law -- requiring police to check immigration status during traffic stops -- although it struck down three other provisions of that law.

bfc92d84beeec8aaad891ca852103e15ce37b08b.sourceText: 造成各州移民法规猛增的另一因素是政府推迟递解儿童时期入境者项目，那个项目给予部分年轻无证移民临时合法身份。
bfc92d84beeec8aaad891ca852103e15ce37b08b.translatedText: Another factor in the surge in state immigration regulations is the government's Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals program, which gives temporary legal status to some young undocumented immigrants.

111fca131144005a6bab9fcc2567eded45e691bb.sourceText: 全国州议会大会在新闻稿中说，最高法院的决定和推迟递解政策刺激各州今年采取行动。
111fca131144005a6bab9fcc2567eded45e691bb.translatedText: The National Conference of State Legislatures said in a news release that the Supreme Court decision and the deferred deportation policy spurred states to take action this year.

5980002fa0f59cd3882ed82b6328430af2ab9597.sourceText: 身份文件法规占大多数：20个州通过34部法规，规定获取州颁发身份证或驾照的条件。
5980002fa0f59cd3882ed82b6328430af2ab9597.translatedText: Identity document regulations account for the majority: 20 states have passed 34 regulations stipulating the conditions for obtaining a state-issued ID card or driver's license.

bca059383d1acc29077e327e08f61fcc2571ffb7.sourceText: 推迟递解政策出台之后，14个州通过法律，允许无证件学生按照本州居民规定交学费。
bca059383d1acc29077e327e08f61fcc2571ffb7.translatedText: After the deferred deportation policy was introduced, 14 states passed laws allowing undocumented students to pay tuition according to the regulations for residents of the state.

4c49cbafbe6cbdeca14c5bbdef363e962180be9a.sourceText: 各州通过的其它相关法规包括移民执法拨款、资助英语和入籍培训班、流动民工和难民项目。
4c49cbafbe6cbdeca14c5bbdef363e962180be9a.translatedText: Other relevant legislation passed by states includes funding for immigration enforcement, funding for English and naturalization training classes, and migrant worker and refugee programs.

666abeee706264ed0dee42c65e3a3503c2b49ab8.sourceText: 英母亲抚养11子女 每天像指挥军事行动 (亚省时报) 将一个孩子培养成人对一个母亲来说已经不容易，而英国肯特郡一名37岁的母亲竟在抚养11个孩子！虽然每天为了照顾宝贝们的起居，自己的生活变得很忙碌辛苦，但是她却乐在其中，而且为了打消别人的閒话棗”不工作靠生孩子挣政府津贴”，她毅然决然地拒绝享受政府的有关福利。 据英国《每日邮报》报道，这位母亲叫塔尼亚 沙利文，她的丈夫是38岁的迈克尔。迈克尔的上一段婚姻已育有两个孩子棗18岁的本和17岁的斯特凡妮，而他与沙利文结合后又生了9个孩子，分别是12岁的凯特琳、8岁的哈里、7岁的埃迪、6岁的锡德、4岁的帕特里克、2岁的奥利弗、1岁的约瑟夫，还有去年10月刚出生的双胞胎女婴伊丽莎白和安娜。 为了照顾这些孩子，沙利文付出了不少精力和时间，在第6个孩子出生后，她就放弃了招聘顾问的工作。”经营像我们这样的大家庭就像指挥一个军事行动。很幸运的是，这些孩子晚上睡觉后很安静，不会让我一直熬着，不过我还是没多少休息的时间，早上5点前就要起床，开始干琐碎而繁重的家务活，如果晚起一点都有负罪感。” ”等到孩子们都起床后，我便开始清洗打扫和做早餐等工作。我们家每周都要消耗掉20条面包和50品脱的牛奶。如今为了满足一家人出行和生活需要，我们不得不购置了一辆小巴，家里面有时乱糟糟的，但我无论如何不会去改变这一切。” 沙利文与丈夫是在学校认识的，那时两人才10多岁，后来因为某种原因而分手，在丈夫结束第一段婚姻后，两人再次相遇。他们从未想过会拥有一个这麽大的家庭，起初只是打算要两三个孩子。”但经历了几次让人伤心欲绝的流产后，我明白了孩子是多麽的珍贵、拥有他们是何等的福气厖当听到有人误会我们生孩子是为了享受政府给予的津贴时，我就非常生气，因为事实并非如此，”沙利文解释说。
666abeee706264ed0dee42c65e3a3503c2b49ab8.translatedText: British mother raises 11 children, and every day it is like commanding military operations (Alberta Times) It is no longer easy for a mother to raise a child to adulthood, but a 37-year-old mother in Kent, England, is actually raising 11 children! Although her life has become very busy and hard to take care of her babies every day, she enjoys it. In order to dispel other people's gossip that "I earn government subsidies by having children without working", she resolutely refuses to enjoy the relevant government benefits. According to the British "Daily Mail" report, the mother's name is Tania Sullivan, and her husband is 38-year-old Michael. Michael already had two children from his previous marriage, 18-year-old Ben and 17-year-old Stephanie. After his union with Sullivan, he gave birth to nine more children, namely Caitlin, 12, Harry, 8, Eddie, 7, Sid, 6, Patrick, 4, Oliver, 2, Joseph, 1, as well as twin baby girls Elizabeth and Anna who were born in October last year. In order to take care of these children, Sullivan devoted a lot of energy and time. After the birth of her sixth child, she gave up her job as a recruitment consultant. "Running a big family like ours is like commanding a military operation. Fortunately, these children are very quiet after going to bed at night and will not keep me up all the time. However, I still don't have much time to rest. I have to get up before 5 a.m. to start doing trivial and heavy housework. I feel guilty if I get up late." "After the children get up, I start cleaning and making breakfast. Our family consumes 20 loaves of bread and 50 pints of milk every week. Now, in order to meet the family's travel and living needs, we have to buy a minibus. The house is sometimes messy, but I will not change it anyway." Sullivan and her husband met in school, when they were just over 10 years old. Later, they broke up for some reason, and they met again after her husband ended his first marriage. They never expected to have such a large family and initially planned to have only two or three children. "But after experiencing several heartbreaking miscarriages, I learned how precious children are and what a blessing it is to have them. It makes me very angry when I hear people mistakenly believe that we have children in order to receive government subsidies, because that is not the case," Sullivan explained.

88cb53f5cbf13a0844cb66c738819acfaa5927bb.sourceText: 中新网1月1日电 据外媒报道，美国加利福尼亚州首府萨克拉门托市一名叫”麻烦”的猫咪被吉尼斯世界纪录列为世界上最高的猫。它是非洲野猫与家猫杂交的后代，现在身高48釐米。 ”麻烦”是在三年前被主人主人黛比 马拉斯宾那收养的。黛比说，她一直只觉得自己的猫很大，直到后来有朋友告诉她她的猫可能是世界上最高的猫。于是黛比递交了”麻烦”的资料，去年11月，”麻烦”被正式认证为世界最高的猫。 黛比说，儘管”麻烦”是世界最高的猫，但它并不胖，仅重9公斤。而且”麻烦”并不製造麻烦，它性情慵懒，非常宅，仅有一个挑食的”缺点”。
88cb53f5cbf13a0844cb66c738819acfaa5927bb.translatedText: China News Service, January 1 (Xinhua) According to foreign media reports, a cat named "Trouble" in Sacramento, the capital of California, has been listed as the tallest cat in the world by Guinness World Records. It is the offspring of a cross between an African wild cat and a domestic cat, and is now 48 centimeters tall. Trouble was adopted by owner Debbie Malaspina three years ago. Debbie said she always thought her cat was big until a friend told her her cat might be the tallest cat in the world. So Debbie submitted the information about "Trouble", and in November last year, "Trouble" was officially certified as the world's tallest cat. Debbie said that despite being the tallest cat in the world, Trouble is not fat and only weighs 9kg. Moreover, "Trouble" does not cause trouble. It has a lazy temperament, is very homely, and has only one "flaw" of being picky about food.

ce8cdfa687eae2afd99b7f7d61bc84f7ed7312b1.sourceText: 东部山火成史上最大 20万公顷土地被毁 本州岛岛南部及东部的森林大火在强风助长下，再次猛烈延烧，阻碍了消防人员的救火行动。 据悉，亚利桑那州东部的国家森林公园已遭大火波及，同时，靠近边界的新墨西哥州城镇鲁纳也备受大火威胁。 鉴于火势越烧越猛，在亚利桑那州南部，当局原本建议民众准备撤离的指示已更改为强制疏散，以策安全。 报道指，这起森林大火已烧毁20多万公顷的林地，当局出动3500多名消防人员救火。不过，火势猛烈延烧，范围已超越2002年的火灾，成为亚利桑那州有史以来最大的一场森林大火。 火上加油的是，国家气象台官员19日指出，中部与西南部7个州有”极端火灾风险”。强风助长野火越过公路，亚利桑那州尤其危险。当局已经下令亚利桑那州大火路径上2个小镇、至少6000人撤离。这场大火是亚利桑那州史上之最，部分民房已付之一炬，不过尚未传出重大伤亡。 据消防局最新消息，东部大火有58%在周三凌晨得到控制。部分撤离居民获准回家，但电力尚未恢复。
ce8cdfa687eae2afd99b7f7d61bc84f7ed7312b1.translatedText: The eastern wildfire is the largest in history, with 200,000 hectares of land destroyed. Fueled by strong winds, forest fires in southern and eastern Honshu have spread violently again, hampering firefighters' efforts to put out the fires. It is reported that the National Forest Park in eastern Arizona has been affected by fires. At the same time, the New Mexico town of Luna, near the border, is also threatened by fires. In view of the increasingly fierce fires, in southern Arizona, the authorities' original advice to prepare for evacuation has been changed to mandatory evacuation for safety. According to reports, the forest fire has burned more than 200,000 hectares of forest land, and the authorities dispatched more than 3,500 firefighters to fight the fire. However, the fire spread so violently that it surpassed the 2002 fire and became the largest forest fire in Arizona's history. To add fuel to the fire, officials from the National Meteorological Observatory pointed out on the 19th that seven states in the central and southwestern states have "extreme fire risks." Arizona is particularly at risk as strong winds fan wildfires across roads. Authorities have ordered the evacuation of at least 6,000 people in two small towns in the path of the Arizona fire. The fire was the largest in Arizona's history, and some homes were burned to the ground, but there were no reports of major casualties. According to the latest news from the fire department, 58% of the eastern fire was under control in the early hours of Wednesday morning. Some evacuated residents were allowed to return home, but power has not yet been restored.

679be5b9f3c2ebce0d73974d3125ccaf159004eb.translatedText: > Fire restrictions are in effect for 15 counties across the state. As the entire state of Arizona is in a period of high forest fires, the state government has extended fire restrictions to all 15 counties in the state...

bfe15bfa729c7b823dc2af901f72bae9caee3eb0.sourceText: 全州15郡消防限火令生效 由于整个亚利桑那州处于森林野火高发期，州政府将限火令扩展至全州15个郡的所有州属土地。 本月早些时候，州政府颁布的限火令只限于东南六个州属土地。从18日上午起，所有州属土地将禁止营火、燃烧木炭设备或其他明火火炬。在州属土地户外吸烟也被禁止，除非在封闭的车辆或建筑物里，野 营后必须清除所有易燃材料。禁止燃放烟花。 以上这些限制使用于全州范围内所有州属土地，游戏、鱼类和野生动物保护区，以及州立公园。 州属公园野营区将保持开放，但在禁火令范围内。
bfe15bfa729c7b823dc2af901f72bae9caee3eb0.translatedText: Fire restrictions are in effect for 15 counties across the state. As the entire state of Arizona is in a period of high wildfire risk, the state government has extended fire restrictions to all state lands in 15 counties across the state. Earlier this month, state government fire restrictions were limited to six state lands in the southeast. Starting on the morning of the 18th, campfires, charcoal-burning devices or other open flames will be prohibited on all state lands. Smoking outdoors on state land is also prohibited except in an enclosed vehicle or building, and all flammable materials must be removed after camping. Fireworks are prohibited. These restrictions apply statewide to all state lands, game, fish and wildlife refuges, and state parks. State park camping areas will remain open but are subject to fire bans.

a87c4bd3518421a76a9bbbaa33e625776aa4c141.translatedText: Guangzhou’s 2018 Spring Festival Fireworks Gala is canceled. How to fill the “loneliness” of the city’s Spring Festival?

e25aaed3d36c5882fff352a1a547fcd3c26248c3.translatedText: Guangzhou’s 2018 Spring Festival Fireworks Party is canceled. How to fill the city’s “loneliness” during the Spring Festival? Xinhuanet, Guangzhou, February 12 (Reporter Wang Pan) On the night of the first day of the Lunar New Year...

c7c088084a1bd514e788ec8a00a206977c40680a.sourceText: 和北京等其他大城市不同，长期以来，广州一直严格执行”禁鞭令”。在一些城市鼓励”限鞭”受到相当部分市民认可、赞同的时候，告别了 烟花 晚会的广州却从此与春节烟花彻底”无缘”。一些网民贴出了以往绚烂的烟花晚会图片，在追忆风华的同时也向城市管理者提出疑问：城市生活与传统民俗碰撞的缺口究竟该怎么填补？
c7c088084a1bd514e788ec8a00a206977c40680a.translatedText: Unlike other big cities such as Beijing, Guangzhou has been strictly enforcing the "whip ban" for a long time. While some cities are encouraging "whip limits" and are recognized and approved by a considerable number of citizens, Guangzhou, which bids farewell to the fireworks party, has completely missed the Spring Festival fireworks. Some netizens posted pictures of gorgeous fireworks parties in the past. While reminiscing about the glory, they also raised questions to city managers: How to fill the gap between urban life and traditional folk customs?

bb278ff39371c2ec776a6a3cc2052bf92f48c321.sourceText: １８年烟花晚会停办后，不少广州市民上网发帖”追忆”曾经照亮羊城夜空、给无数人带来欢乐的璀璨 焰火 。”记得第一次去琶洲燃放点看焰火时，相当激动。””一轮轮烟花在天空燃放，江边一阵阵惊呼，操着各地口音的人都在感叹，突然一下子觉得这个城市挺好。””现在突然停办了，你是觉得开心还是可惜呢？””小幽”等网民这样抒发自己的心情。
bb278ff39371c2ec776a6a3cc2052bf92f48c321.translatedText: After the 2018 fireworks show was suspended, many Guangzhou citizens posted online to "reminisce" about the bright fireworks that once illuminated the night sky of Guangzhou and brought joy to countless people. "I remember that I was very excited when I went to Pazhou to watch the fireworks for the first time." "A round of fireworks was set off in the sky, and there were exclaims along the river. People with accents from all over the country were sighing, and suddenly I felt that this city was very good." "Now that it has been suddenly stopped, do you feel happy or a pity?" "Xiaoyou" and other netizens expressed their feelings this way.

04db7e3a9071aadf7c7c5b6f1782ad644efead97.sourceText: 自１９９５年起，广州春节焰火晚会已成为很多市民熟悉的”新年俗”。每到年初一，来自各地的市民，全家出动拥至珠江岸边，翘首以待。２０１２年，尽管室外气温仅有５摄氏度，但仍有５１万市民到现场观看。
04db7e3a9071aadf7c7c5b6f1782ad644efead97.translatedText: Since 1995, the Guangzhou Spring Festival Fireworks Party has become a “New Year custom” that many citizens are familiar with. Every New Year's Day, citizens from all over the country and their whole families flock to the banks of the Pearl River to wait eagerly. In 2012, 510,000 citizens came to watch the event even though the outdoor temperature was only 5 degrees Celsius.

c524c98384ef9dec197ac1a8ddfb72887ebc6f08.sourceText: 广州市政府在发布相关决定时曾表示，取消烟火晚会一是为避免燃放焰火对广州城区大气环境的影响，二是节约。据了解，２０１２年燃放烟花开支高达１０００万元，接近广州市政府办公厅年度总预算的１０％。
c524c98384ef9dec197ac1a8ddfb72887ebc6f08.translatedText: When issuing the relevant decision, the Guangzhou Municipal Government stated that the cancellation of the fireworks show was firstly to avoid the impact of fireworks on the urban atmospheric environment in Guangzhou, and secondly to save money. It is understood that the cost of setting off fireworks in 2012 was as high as 10 million yuan, close to 10% of the total annual budget of the Guangzhou Municipal Government Office.

05dd7e6e159d7783849502fb7c898c074425fc99.sourceText: 一方念念情深，一方有理有据，停办引发不少人赞同，也有不少网民坚持认为”省钱不是这么个省法””环保为何先拿群众喜闻乐见的活动开刀？”。１０日晚，流连在珠江之畔的一些广州市民也为看不到焰火而遗憾，感觉”这是多少年的传统，取消了多可惜！”
05dd7e6e159d7783849502fb7c898c074425fc99.translatedText: One side has deep feelings and the other side has good reasons. Many people agree with the suspension, and many netizens insist that "saving money is not such a way to save money." On the evening of the 10th, some Guangzhou citizens lingering on the banks of the Pearl River also regretted not being able to see the fireworks. They felt, "This has been a tradition for many years. What a pity it is to cancel it!"

baeb7740aa69e6e4abbafbe441c6c930033ebe8d.sourceText: 城市生活和传统民俗的碰撞
baeb7740aa69e6e4abbafbe441c6c930033ebe8d.translatedText: Urban life and traditional folk customs Collision

b86fa596304c2e6f6589314b57bd248945ef1084.sourceText: 由于广州长期”禁鞭”，在告别焰火晚会后，蛇年春节全城首次彻底与烟花无缘，城市生活和传统民俗间的碰撞让不少网民非常纠结。
b86fa596304c2e6f6589314b57bd248945ef1084.translatedText: Due to the long-term "whip ban" in Guangzhou, after bidding farewell to the fireworks show, for the first time during the Spring Festival in the Year of the Snake, the city was completely without fireworks. The collision between urban life and traditional folk customs has left many netizens very entangled.

417302ea0e22bca89fb466c72530757a53ed0879.sourceText: ”民俗传承有两个特性，一是偏远地区比中心地区容易保存，二是经济越发达，越有延续传统民俗的期望，这两者间有时互相促进，有时则产生冲突，矛盾如何处理，是对 城市管理 者的考验。”长期研究民俗课题的中山大学教授叶春生说。
417302ea0e22bca89fb466c72530757a53ed0879.translatedText: "Folklore inheritance has two characteristics. First, remote areas are easier to preserve than central areas. Second, the more developed the economy, the greater the expectation to continue traditional folk customs. The two sometimes promote each other, and sometimes conflict. How to deal with conflicts is a test for urban managers." said Ye Chunsheng, a professor at Sun Yat-sen University who has long studied folk customs.

73b27bf49f4a247e9fd58ca72689ee07bca6f5e3.sourceText: 对大多数中国人来说，放鞭炮是春节习俗中最容易被记忆的一项，但对于大中城市而言，这一习俗的保留受限越来越多。广州此次在”禁鞭”之后进一步停办焰火晚会，主要因为烟花会对城区大气环境影响较大。
73b27bf49f4a247e9fd58ca72689ee07bca6f5e3.translatedText: For most Chinese people, setting off firecrackers is the most memorable Spring Festival custom, but for large and medium-sized cities, the retention of this custom is increasingly restricted. Guangzhou has further suspended fireworks shows this time after the "whip ban", mainly because fireworks will have a greater impact on the urban atmospheric environment.

79ad6b2dc7c779234e2b83af65025c5adf51730b.sourceText: ”问题在于，当旧民俗已很难维系时，城市生活仍要继续，人们依然对民俗活动保持很高的需求，这中间就会有空白，需要形成符合时代特征的’新民俗’来填补，如果只是一味地取消、禁止，也不符合社会发展需要。”叶春生说。
79ad6b2dc7c779234e2b83af65025c5adf51730b.translatedText: "The problem is that when old folk customs are difficult to maintain, urban life will still continue, and people will still maintain a high demand for folk custom activities. There will be a gap in the gap, which needs to be filled by forming a 'new folk custom' that conforms to the characteristics of the times. If it is just canceled or banned blindly, it will not meet the needs of social development." Ye Chunsheng said.

4bfb0ef0de0c2a1bd9d64efcc31b3d3c448c49f0.sourceText: 填补空白需城市管理”新智慧”
4bfb0ef0de0c2a1bd9d64efcc31b3d3c448c49f0.translatedText: Filling the gap requires "new wisdom" in urban management

c5f3a891adc6fbedca675778dfa50a3540596a68.sourceText: 事实上，叶春生等专家的忧虑也是不少网民的争议所在。眼下，随着北京进一步鼓励”限鞭”、广州停办焰火晚会，不少网民发出疑问：当烟花爆竹需要逐渐退出时，我们该用什么来填补？
c5f3a891adc6fbedca675778dfa50a3540596a68.translatedText: In fact, the concerns of experts such as Ye Chunsheng are also the source of controversy among many netizens. Now, as Beijing further encourages "whip restrictions" and Guangzhou suspends fireworks shows, many netizens are asking: When fireworks and firecrackers need to be gradually withdrawn, what should we use to fill them?

4a5b07b65c66d8a19840e91f1b364e7f9044ff5e.sourceText: ”原来是不让个人放烟花，现在政府集中燃放也被取消，都在感叹年味淡了，难道没有什么其他可以做的吗？”有广州网民这样表示。
4a5b07b65c66d8a19840e91f1b364e7f9044ff5e.translatedText: "Originally, individuals were not allowed to set off fireworks, but now the centralized fireworks set off by the government have also been cancelled. Everyone is lamenting that the New Year has lost its flavor. Is there nothing else that can be done?" said a Guangzhou netizen.

76ca38360a67cd00cf9bd6ab01318f2a099bf924.sourceText: 在一些民俗学者看来，春节年俗本身具有鲜明的农耕传统特征，也形成有特色的节日消费特点和习惯，这里面既有宝贵的精神财富，也随着时代发展而逐渐显现缺陷和不足，不少习俗能够在乡土之地继续保存延续的同时，形成适合城市聚居生活的新做法、新模式，才是当前值得探讨的重点所在。
76ca38360a67cd00cf9bd6ab01318f2a099bf924.translatedText: According to some folklore scholars, the Spring Festival customs themselves have distinctive characteristics of farming traditions, and have also formed unique holiday consumption characteristics and habits. They contain valuable spiritual wealth, but also gradually show flaws and deficiencies with the development of the times. The ability of many customs to continue to be preserved and extended in rural areas while forming new practices and new models suitable for urban settlement life is the current focus worthy of discussion.

87430e8b5a91a06a811121090b99946c4bc55f31.sourceText: 在今年的停放焰火之后，广州市采取了加强其他特色年俗活动、开设新活动的办法加以补偿。１０日晚，当焰火不再升起时，总高度达６００米的广州塔上举行的灯光秀吸引了市民的眼球。同时，花灯展示、游园灯会、综艺演出、动漫表演和民俗表演等文体活动也在进一步开展，让市民”年有所乐”。
87430e8b5a91a06a811121090b99946c4bc55f31.translatedText: After this year’s fireworks display, Guangzhou took steps to compensate by strengthening other special annual activities and opening new activities. On the evening of the 10th, when the fireworks stopped rising, the light show held on the 600-meter-high Canton Tower attracted the attention of citizens. At the same time, cultural and sports activities such as lantern displays, garden lantern shows, variety shows, animation performances, and folk performances are also being further carried out to allow citizens to "have fun in the New Year."

d948aab4ae17ad54c55edd0a1f2636a7fc74dff1.sourceText: ”年俗从来不是一成不变的，关键在于城市管理者对此要有更加清醒的认识，不能只堵不疏，能否为公众提供既保留传统底蕴又节俭、环保的年俗方式，才是真正的考验。”叶春生说。
d948aab4ae17ad54c55edd0a1f2636a7fc74dff1.translatedText: "New Year's customs are never static. The key is that city managers must have a clearer understanding of this. They cannot just block things but not omit them. The real test is whether they can provide the public with a way of doing New Year's customs that not only retains traditional heritage but is also frugal and environmentally friendly." Ye Chunsheng said.

2d99f72a4b8189b0005188392097dcda70893bc1.sourceText: 凤城少年烧伤全身75% （亚省时报） 周一下午，一名13岁男孩全身烧伤75%被送医院。 他的父母约下午5:30回家看到可怕的一幕。 ”他们听到爆炸声，发现男孩被火焚烧，”凤凰城消防队上校豪尔赫恩里克斯说。 ”但我们不知道火是怎么烧起来的，是男孩点火还是其他意外原因。” 消防员把男孩送往玛利科巴郡医疗中心。男孩的头顶、躯干和胳膊、腿都受到不同程度的烧伤，都在二度和三度之间。 消防员提醒人们注意：在凤凰城，私人燃烧垃圾活动是非法的。

His parents came home about 5:30pm and saw the horrific scene. "They heard an explosion and found the boy in flames," Phoenix Fire Department Capt. Jorge Henriquez said. "But we don't know how the fire started, whether it was the boy who started it or some other accidental cause." Firefighters took the boy to Maricopa County Medical Center. The boy's head, torso, arms and legs all suffered varying degrees of burns, all ranging from second to third degree. Firefighters are reminding people that private trash burning is illegal in Phoenix.

f4f9933c91b6dcef9d2c85953f8fadf190815827.sourceText: 85%大学毕业生搬回家住 如今的大学毕业生在沉重的债务负担和失业的影响下，变成了新一代的社会贫困阶层。许多人在毕业后生活窘迫，今年约八成的大学生被迫在毕业后搬回家中，与父母同住。 纽约邮报报导，泛德堡大学的学生霍夫曼毕业后曾住亚特兰大，一年来一直靠他的大学服务公司维持生计，如今仍希望在纽约市找到一份收入好的技术工作。 但如今的失业率下降趋势，并没使更多大学毕业生的就业前景得到舒缓。刚刚搬到纽约市布碌仑居住的霍夫曼说：「现在毕业生的失业率很高，我的一些同学两年前便已毕业，到现在还没找到工作。」 今年预期有300万年轻人走出大学校门。据研究机构的调查，随着年轻人失业率已接近两位数字，85%的大学毕业生将先搬回家与父母同住，高于2006年的67%。
f4f9933c91b6dcef9d2c85953f8fadf190815827.translatedText: >85% of college graduates move back home. Under the influence of heavy debt burden and unemployment, today's college graduates have become a new generation of poor people in society. Many people live in embarrassment after graduation. This year, about 80% of college students were forced to move back home and live with their parents after graduation. The New York Post reports that Huffman, a student at Vanguard University who lived in Atlanta after graduation and has been relying on his university services company to make ends meet for a year, is still hoping to find a well-paying technology job in New York City. However, the current downward trend in unemployment rate has not eased the employment prospects of more college graduates. Hoffman, who just moved to Brooklyn, New York City, said: "The unemployment rate among graduates is very high now. Some of my classmates graduated two years ago and have not found a job yet." This year, 3 million young people are expected to graduate from college. According to a survey by a research institute, as the youth unemployment rate approaches double digits, 85% of college graduates will first move back home to live with their parents, up from 67% in 2006.

f9a875785563d960bfcaf460278a0b6eacbb5c89.sourceText: 庆祝凤城华人基督教会成立30周年 【 凤凰城凤鸣報道】 凤城华人基督教会30週年庆会，於2月19日上午10:30在教会大堂如期举行，这一庆典是由中、英文联合崇拜。本来原订於10:30開始的聚会，参加庆典的人，从10点开始就源源不断地入场，我们也是为了在主会场观礼，提前半小时到达，入场后看到已有三分之一的座位坐满了人，我们找了一个在中间又靠前的座位坐下，这时看到，教会负责媒体部的同工们，在忙碌地架设摄像机，教会派出4部车，将住在老人公寓的父、伯母们接来，很快人们陆续到达，晚到的人只好在第二、第三会场观看电视转播。 10:30庆典崇拜准时开始，由英文青年牧师主持，以庄严、热情又欢快的诗歌開场，歌颂伟大的神，大家互相道贺和问侯，欢乐的气氛笼罩整个会场。紧接着播放教会历史综览。崇拜中分别由关牧师和楊牧师证道。关牧师証道的题目是，”数算教会30年的恩典”，30年前由几家学生的查經班开始，组建了一个被神看顾的教会，在30年的成長和壮大中，都彰显神的荣耀和恩典。楊牧师证道的题目：”看主要我们看的”，提醒和呼召我们教会和会眾，在30年的成绩面前，要看清主要我们看的，做主让我们做的。我们是被救赎的儿女，要活出羔羊新妇的职分，我们深信主给我们教会的托付，乃是要藉着不断的建造忠诚的信徒来荣耀神。主给我们教会的願景是，持续建造忠诚信徒，持续的植堂传讲福音。在过去的30年，神一直信实的保守也供应教会各样的需要，使许多人因着教会认识主，得著救恩和造就。現在神已广开福音的门，也提供丰富的资源，让我们忠心信实的，看主要我们看的，做主要我们做的，我们今后的任务还是任重道远，继续信实的彰显神的荣耀，扩展神的国度。在两位牧师的证道中间，串插了唱诗班的献诗和会眾的见证分享视频，不同的家庭和个人，都分别述说了，他〔她〕们在凤城华人教会，这个充满了爱的大家庭中的成長和喜乐，充满了神的大爱。这次庆典崇拜，还有不少新慕道友參加。 崇拜结束后，会眾都集中在会堂南面的草坪上，拍了30週年记念照，三位摄影师站在高高的升降机上，为大家拍摄了近千人的合影，留下了终生难忘的纪念。 拍照结束后，眾人向东草坪和交谊厅散去，那里有同工们早已为大家准备好了免费午餐和茶水、甜点，教会还为庆祝30週年，而为大家准备了精美的纪念礼品，一时间教会的草坪，交誼厅等各个角落，坐满了高高兴兴的大人和小朋友，一面享受着美食，一面分享着各自喜乐、感恩的心情。在一点钟的时候，在交谊厅由同工们切蛋糕，将三層一米多高的蛋糕，切成無数小块，传送到每个人的手中。香甜可口的蛋糕，吃在口中甜在心里，思量着要为今后教会发展前程，尽一份当尽的力量，为教会继续信实的彰显神的荣耀，扩展神的国度而努力奋斗！
f9a875785563d960bfcaf460278a0b6eacbb5c89.translatedText: > Celebrate the 30th anniversary of the founding of the Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church [Reported by Phoenix Fengming] The 30th anniversary celebration of Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church was held as scheduled at 10:30 am on February 19th in the church lobby. This celebration was jointly worshiped in Chinese and English. The party was originally scheduled to start at 10:30. People attending the celebration started arriving at 10 o'clock. We also arrived half an hour early to watch the ceremony at the main venue. After entering, we saw that one-third of the seats were full, so we found a seat in the middle. I sat down in the front seat and saw that the church’s colleagues in charge of the media department were busy setting up cameras. The church sent four cars to pick up the parents and aunts who lived in the elderly apartment. Soon people arrived one after another, and those who arrived late had to watch the TV broadcast in the second and third venues. The celebration service started on time at 10:30, hosted by an English-speaking youth pastor. He opened with a solemn, enthusiastic and cheerful hymn, praising the great God. Everyone congratulated and greeted each other, and a joyful atmosphere enveloped the entire venue. This is followed by an overview of church history. During the service, Pastor Guan and Pastor Yang preached. The title of Pastor Guan’s sermon was, “Counting the Grace of the Church in 30 Years.” Thirty years ago, several students’ Bible study classes started a church that was cared for by God. During the 30 years of growth and expansion, it has demonstrated God’s glory and grace. The title of Pastor Yang's sermon: "See what the Lord wants us to see" reminds and calls our church and congregation to see clearly what the Lord wants us to see and do what the Lord wants us to do in the face of the achievements of the past 30 years. We are redeemed children who must live out the office of the bride of the Lamb. We firmly believe that the Lord’s commission to our church is to glorify God through the continuous building up of loyal believers. The vision the Lord has given our church is to continue to build loyal believers and continue to plant churches to preach the gospel. In the past 30 years, God has been faithful to protect and provide for the church’s various needs, allowing many people to know the Lord and receive salvation and edification through the church. Now that God has opened the door to the gospel widely and provided abundant resources, let us be faithful and faithful, see what He wants us to see, and do what He wants us to do. Our future tasks are still long and arduous, and we will continue to faithfully demonstrate the glory of God and expand the kingdom of God. The sermons of the two pastors were interspersed with hymns from the choir and testimonial sharing videos from the congregation. Different families and individuals all described their growth and joy in the Fengcheng Chinese Church, a big family full of love, full of God's great love. Many new catechumens also participated in this celebration and worship. After the service, the congregation gathered on the lawn in the south of the auditorium and took photos to commemorate the 30th anniversary. Three photographers stood on a high lift and took photos of nearly a thousand people, leaving an unforgettable memory for everyone. After the photos were taken, everyone dispersed to the east lawn and the saloon, where co-workers had already prepared free lunch, tea, and desserts for everyone. The church also prepared exquisite commemorative gifts for everyone to celebrate its 30th anniversary. All of a sudden, the lawn, saloon and other corners of the church were filled with happy adults and children, enjoying the food while sharing their joy and gratitude. At one o'clock, the co-workers cut the cake in the lobby. The three-layer cake, which was more than one meter high, was cut into countless small pieces and delivered to everyone's hands. The sweet and delicious cake is sweet in the mouth and in the heart. I think about doing my part for the future development of the church, and working hard for the church to continue to faithfully display the glory of God and expand the kingdom of God!

b8b9240e672cb478ae2e71160d34f2e4c80f384a.translatedText: >Credit rating downgraded, 51% of voters opposed Obama's re-election. After the White House and Congress reached a deadlock in debt limit negotiations, which also led to the downgrade of the US credit rating, two latest polls reflect...

371c6de9bff3c26791323994e67b52c7f928615f.sourceText: 信评降级 51%选民反欧巴马连任 在白宫与国会陷入债限谈判僵局，还导致美国信评被降级后，两份最新民调反映，选民认为，现职国会议员都没有资格连任，如果这种情绪看法持续，可能影响到两党2012的势力消长。 「今日美国报/盖洛普民调」最新结果显示，受访的民众只有24%认为，大多数国会议员值得连任，这是该民调1991年开始提出此问题以来「最低的数字」，现职国会议员不应该连任的看法达到20年来最高峰，此现象可能成为2012年选举的风向指标。 今日美国报报导，上述数字和1994、2006、2010年选举前的数字类似。1994年，共和党取得参众院控制权。2006年，民主党囊括参众院控制权。2010年，共和党取得众院控制权。 不过，这份民调也有吊诡之处，56%选民认为，他们所支持的国会议员值得连任。 这份民调也显示，欧巴马总统的位置不稳。51%选民认为，欧巴马总统不值得连任；47%选民则认为，欧巴马应该连任。如果欧巴马的竞选对手是一位尚未确定的共和党总统参选人，其得票率为49%比45%，欧巴马得票率仍不超过50%。 有线电视新闻网(CNN)/ORC国际民调机构进行的民调则显示，只有41%受调选民认为代表他们选区的国会议员值得再度连任，这是该民调进行至今，首度低于50%。49%选民则不支持选区的民意代表连任。 今日美国报的民调显示，前麻州州长罗穆尼在共和党总统参选人中，支持率领先其他参选人；紧追其后的共和党总统参选人为德州州长培里(Rick Perry，17%)。培里可能在14日宣布参选。 德州国会众议员保罗(Ron Paul)所获的支持率为14%，排名第三；明尼苏达州国会众议员蜜雪巴克曼所获支持率为13%，排名第四。 CNN民调则说，共和党虽然在最近的国债谈判似乎占上风，但却失去许多选民的支持。选民对于共和党的「不支持率」达到最高峰；59%选民表示，他们对共和党「印象不佳」，这是1992年以来的最高峰。
371c6de9bff3c26791323994e67b52c7f928615f.translatedText: >Credit rating downgraded, 51% of voters opposed Obama's re-election. After the debt limit negotiations between the White House and Congress reached a deadlock, which resulted in the downgrade of the U.S. credit rating, two latest polls showed that voters believe that current members of Congress are not eligible for re-election. If this sentiment persists, it may affect the growth and decline of the two parties in 2012. The latest results of the "USA Today/Gallup Poll" show that only 24% of the people surveyed believe that most members of Congress deserve re-election, which is the "lowest number" since the poll began asking this question in 1991. The view that current members of Congress should not be re-elected has reached its highest peak in 20 years. This phenomenon may become a trend indicator in the 2012 election. USA Today reported that the above-mentioned figures are similar to those before the 1994, 2006, and 2010 elections. In 1994, the Republicans gained control of the House of Representatives. In 2006, the Democratic Party captured control of the House of Representatives and the Senate. In 2010, the Republicans gained control of the House of Representatives. However, this poll is also paradoxical. 56% of voters believe that the congressman they support deserves re-election. This poll also shows that President Obama's position is unstable. 51% of voters believe that President Obama does not deserve to be re-elected; 47% of voters believe that Obama should be re-elected. If Obama were to run against an undecided Republican presidential candidate, his vote share would be 49% to 45%, leaving Obama with less than 50% of the vote. A poll conducted by the CNN/ORC international polling agency showed that only 41% of voters surveyed believed that the members of Congress representing their districts were worthy of re-election. This was the first time that the poll was below 50%. 49% of voters do not support the re-election of the constituency’s public opinion representative. A USA Today poll shows that former Massachusetts Governor Romney leads other Republican presidential candidates in support; closely followed by Texas Governor Rick Perry (17%). Perry may announce his candidacy on the 14th. Texas Congressman Ron Paul received an approval rating of 14%, ranking third; Minnesota Congresswoman Michelle Buckman received an approval rating of 13%, ranking fourth. A CNN poll said that although the Republican Party seems to have the upper hand in recent national debt negotiations, it has lost the support of many voters. Voters' "disapproval rate" for the Republican Party reached its highest peak; 59% of voters said they had a "poor impression" of the Republican Party, the highest level since 1992.

58f27d62959bcf8bb064ef166fea99a71e0454ef.sourceText: 圣诞季全美商店失窃将达89亿元
58f27d62959bcf8bb064ef166fea99a71e0454ef.translatedText: Thefts from U.S. stores during the Christmas season will total $8.9 billion

80b3221da7cafbb029a319fa3b5986a67165afc2.sourceText: 圣诞季全美商店失窃将达89亿元 Checkpoint系统公司近日公布研究显示，在今年的圣诞销售季节…
80b3221da7cafbb029a319fa3b5986a67165afc2.translatedText: Thefts from U.S. stores during the Christmas season will total $8.9 billion Checkpoint Systems recently released research showing that during this year’s Christmas sales season...

1d7f0989f8ba5367f39218ad851beea18981d453.sourceText: Checkpoint系统公司近日公布研究显示，在今年的圣诞销售季节，商店失窃的损失预计将达创纪录的89亿元，而这笔庞大的折损金额最终仍将转嫁到消费者身上，每户家庭平均分摊98元。
1d7f0989f8ba5367f39218ad851beea18981d453.translatedText: Checkpoint Systems recently released research showing that during this year’s Christmas sales season, store theft losses are expected to reach a record high of 8.9 billion yuan, and this huge amount of losses will eventually be passed on to consumers, with an average share of 98 yuan per household.

3f4eb129dc18d098634747d811ad27791c511ccc.sourceText: 今年预计的89亿元失窃损失比去年增加4%，酒类、女性服装和玩具将成为窃贼下手的主要目标。此外，香水、电子用品、游戏机、手表与珠宝、巧克力和糖果等，也受到窃贼青睐。
3f4eb129dc18d098634747d811ad27791c511ccc.translatedText: This year's estimated theft losses of 8.9 billion yuan increased by 4% compared with last year. Alcohol, women's clothing and toys will become the main targets of thieves. In addition, perfumes, electronic products, game consoles, watches and jewelry, chocolates and candies are also favored by thieves.

9c9e07ac014e2745bc0ef1cab05c051676bc0f58.sourceText: 零售研究中心主任班费德说：「商店的损失必须要从某个地方得到补偿，从而成为罪犯强加给消费者的一种课税。」
9c9e07ac014e2745bc0ef1cab05c051676bc0f58.translatedText: Director of the Retail Research Center Banfield said: "The loss of the store must be compensated from somewhere, thus becoming a tax imposed by criminals on consumers."

68409cb87b43a023f926ef1cd25e373d906cef4b.sourceText: 商店受损后要采取降低成本措施，如提高商品价格和裁减员工等。投资人认为，失窃损失也会影响到零售商的股票。
68409cb87b43a023f926ef1cd25e373d906cef4b.translatedText: After the store is damaged, cost reduction measures must be taken, such as increasing product prices and laying off employees. Investors believe theft losses will also impact retailers' stocks.

bdf0ab8143b4e26353dd0fb504f188dbb4446bfb.sourceText: 班费德说，由于经济复苏疲软，许多人把偷窃当成财源渠道。还有许多消费者的警惕性不高，没有意识到购买的商品会被窃贼盯上。
bdf0ab8143b4e26353dd0fb504f188dbb4446bfb.translatedText: Banfeld said that due to the weak economic recovery, many people use theft as a source of income. There are also many consumers who are not very vigilant and do not realize that the goods they buy will be targeted by thieves.

3359eddd43361066f7df086cf0b0332d6434e035.sourceText: 圣诞购物季节是窃贼作案的黄金时期，因为店内的消费者熙熙攘攘，琳琅满目的节日商品也使盗贼垂涎三尺。
3359eddd43361066f7df086cf0b0332d6434e035.translatedText: The Christmas shopping season is a prime time for thieves to commit crimes because the stores are bustling with consumers and the dazzling array of holiday merchandise makes thieves salivate.

71ea7e24047696dc96e8d22a2d7fd0e091fd16cb.sourceText: 节日盗贼究竟主要是谁，并非人们想象得那样简单。消费者顺手牵羊将造成38亿元损失，而店员监守自盗将损失47亿元。
71ea7e24047696dc96e8d22a2d7fd0e091fd16cb.translatedText: Who the main festival thieves are is not as simple as people think. Consumers who steal goods will cause a loss of 3.8 billion yuan, while store employees who cheat and steal will cause a loss of 4.7 billion yuan.

773148b2a0f3d454d523dfe9f2b2d51be27129ce.sourceText: 在节日商品失窃损失中，有组织的犯罪团伙将占有重大比重，他们主要是盗窃大宗商品，目的是为了销赃获利。班费德说：「有组织的盗窃犯罪是商家的主要担忧，他们盗窃的数量比普通窃贼要多得多。
773148b2a0f3d454d523dfe9f2b2d51be27129ce.translatedText: Organized criminal gangs will account for a significant proportion of the losses caused by theft of holiday goods. They mainly steal bulk goods in order to sell the stolen goods for profit. "Organized theft is a major concern for businesses, and they steal far more than the average thief," Banfield said.

ffb5e1b69579fe3199f0db00cde7fe97028c67fc.sourceText: 中国富豪年龄平均36岁 在亚洲仅大于日本 （亚省时报） [本报综合讯]据美国彭博社9月19日报道，汇丰控股有限公司19日发表报告称，中国富豪平均年龄是亚洲除日本以外最年轻的，他们的数量将毫无疑问地超过亚洲的发达国家。 报告称，在中国，拥有至少50万元流动资产的人的平均年龄为36岁，低于香港的48岁和印度尼西亚的38岁。这份报告的调查对象包括澳大利亚、中国大陆、印度、印尼、香港、马来西亚、新加坡和台湾的富豪。 汇丰银行亚太财富管理业务负责人李锦荣(Bruno Lee)18日在香港接受采访时说：”他们（中国富豪）都30多岁，处于财富积累阶段。看着这群人的数量变得越来越大，你是不会觉得吃惊的。某种程度上来说，他们的数量将可能超过其他（亚洲）成熟市场。”
ffb5e1b69579fe3199f0db00cde7fe97028c67fc.translatedText: The average age of China's richest people is 36, which is only older than Japan in Asia (Alberta Times) [Comprehensive news from this newspaper] According to a report by Bloomberg on September 19, HSBC Holdings Co., Ltd. issued a report on the 19th saying that the average age of China's richest people is the youngest in Asia except Japan, and their number will undoubtedly exceed that of developed countries in Asia. In China, the average age of people with at least 500,000 yuan in liquid assets is 36, lower than Hong Kong's 48 and Indonesia's 38, the report said. The report surveyed wealthy individuals in Australia, China, India, Indonesia, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Singapore and Taiwan. Bruno Lee, head of HSBC's Asia-Pacific wealth management business, said in an interview in Hong Kong on the 18th: "They (Chinese wealthy people) are all in their 30s and in the stage of wealth accumulation. You will not be surprised to see the number of this group of people becoming larger and larger. To some extent, their number will likely exceed other (Asia) mature markets."

5e61be11576327369da91476c5a51d5bdddec226.sourceText: 近日，石油巨头英国石油公司(BP)全球首席经济学家克里斯多夫?#40065;尔博士在北京发布2012年《BP世界能源统计年鉴》(下称《年鉴》)，用数据概述了2011年的能源大背景：2011年石油价格大幅增长，即期布伦特原油价格年均上涨40%；全球石油储量可用54年，而去年全球所有能源净增长均来自新兴经济体。化石燃料以87%的市场份额继续主导着全球能源消费，可再生能源虽然增长迅速，但仍只占全球消费的2%。
5e61be11576327369da91476c5a51d5bdddec226.translatedText: Recently, the oil giant British Petroleum (BP) global chief economist Dr. Christopher? Fossil fuels continue to dominate global energy consumption with an 87% market share. Although renewable energy is growing rapidly, it still only accounts for 2% of global consumption.

0c4841f7a920010215df7ed61e402ee1fbea4890.sourceText: 去年，全球石油产量也增长1.3%，或110万桶/天，其中沙特、阿联酋、卡塔尔石油产量创出新高。沙特去年石油产量高达每天1116.1万桶，依然雄踞全球石油产量最高的国家榜首。 每天消费石油8800万桶
0c4841f7a920010215df7ed61e402ee1fbea4890.translatedText: Last year, global oil production also increased by 1.3%, or 1.1 million barrels per day, with oil production in Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Qatar hitting new highs. Saudi Arabia's oil production reached 11.161 million barrels per day last year, still ranking first among the countries with the highest oil production in the world. 88 million barrels of oil are consumed every day

3ba8a6cc00fa7d668644d4d5db8d1a822a06535a.sourceText: 根据《年鉴》，截至2011年年底，全球石油储量约为1.653万亿桶，全球石油储量可用54年。去年，英国石油公司报告的2010年年底世界石油储量为1.526万亿桶。若按照现在全球每天非常非常保守0.8亿桶的消耗速度来看，当前的世界石油储量可供全球消费54年。
3ba8a6cc00fa7d668644d4d5db8d1a822a06535a.translatedText: According to the Yearbook, as of the end of 2011, global oil reserves were approximately 1.653 trillion barrels, and global oil reserves are available for 54 years. Last year, BP reported world oil reserves at the end of 2010 at 1.526 trillion barrels. If we look at the current global consumption rate of 80 million barrels per day, which is very conservative, the current world oil reserves can last for 54 years.

6678c3962087bbc84ca20e363ccae58aaa68d3ad.sourceText: 值得注意的是，在全球石油储量的分布中，2011年，委内瑞拉超过沙特阿拉伯，成为全球探明石油储量最多的国家，达2965亿桶，占全球18%；沙特阿拉伯紧随其后，以2645亿桶的探明储量位居全球第二，占比16%；加拿大排名第三，其探明石油储量为1752亿桶，占比11%。
6678c3962087bbc84ca20e363ccae58aaa68d3ad.translatedText: It is worth noting that in the distribution of global oil reserves, in 2011, Venezuela surpassed Saudi Arabia and became the country with the largest proven oil reserves in the world, reaching 296.5 billion barrels, accounting for 18% of the world; Saudi Arabia followed closely, ranking second in the world with proven reserves of 264.5 billion barrels, accounting for 16%; Canada ranked third, with proven oil reserves of 175.2 billion barrels, accounting for 11%.

5045d8b2a38de93ef41639c269b9756ba60ffa83.sourceText: 可再生能源发展喜忧参半
5045d8b2a38de93ef41639c269b9756ba60ffa83.translatedText: The development of renewable energy has been mixed

5f44869825a4a3decffeceeb3e2dde3f10b4e5e8.sourceText: 去年，可再生能源的发展喜忧参半。全球生物燃料生产出现停滞，增幅仅为0.7%，即每日1万桶油当量，创下2000年以来的最低年增长速度。由于汽油中的乙醇燃料比例已达到?#25530;混瓶颈?#65292;美国的可再生能源发展速度放缓(增速为10.9%，即5.5万桶油当量/日)。由于甘蔗歉收，巴西生物燃料产量出现了我们统计数据历史上最大幅度下滑(降低15.3%，即减少5万桶油当量/日)。与此形成鲜明对比的是，可再生能源发电量增长17%，超过历史平均水平，而风电增长独领风骚(增长25.8%)，在可再生能源发电中所占比例首次超过了一半。
5f44869825a4a3decffeceeb3e2dde3f10b4e5e8.translatedText: Last year, the development of renewable energy has been mixed. Global biofuel production has stagnated, growing at just 0.7%, or 10,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day, the lowest annual growth rate since 2000. Because the proportion of ethanol fuel in gasoline has reached the #25530; mixing bottleneck? #65292; the development of renewable energy in the United States has slowed down (the growth rate is 10.9%, or 55,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day). Due to the poor sugarcane harvest, Brazilian biofuel production experienced the largest decline in the history of our statistics (a decrease of 15.3%, or a decrease of 50,000 boe/d). In sharp contrast, renewable energy power generation increased by 17%, exceeding the historical average, while wind power growth led the way (up 25.8%), accounting for more than half of renewable energy power generation for the first time.

b496c9db0980e2ffa0aa35a53f7b0ce72784cb59.sourceText: 记者从第十三届海交会组委会办公室获悉，将于5月18日在福州举行的第十三届海峡两岸经贸交易会将安排16场主要活动。
b496c9db0980e2ffa0aa35a53f7b0ce72784cb59.translatedText: reporters learned from the Office of the Organizing Committee of the 13th China Maritime Fair that the 13th Cross-Strait Economic and Trade Fair to be held in Fuzhou on May 18 will arrange 16 major activities.

88071360fac4444eff4efc570b62b793ddfbea94.sourceText: 据介绍，今年海交会的活动安排已基本确定，包括海峡两岸广告高峰论坛、ECFA实务研讨会、海峡两岸品牌文化高峰论坛、海峡设计创意高峰论坛、第十三届海交会重点项目签约仪式、第二届中国福州海峡版权（创意）产业精品博览交易会、第十三届海交会采购洽谈会暨签约仪式、第八届商交会跨国采购对接洽谈会、第八届商交会中泰合作交流会等16场主要活动，此外还有”游闽江观焰火看民俗”、第十三届海交会海峡两岸少年儿童美术大展等配套活动。
88071360fac4444eff4efc570b62b793ddfbea94.translatedText: According to reports, the activities of this year's China Maritime Fair have been basically determined, including the Cross-Strait Advertising Summit Forum, ECFA Practical Seminar, Cross-Strait Brand Culture Summit Forum, Strait Design Creativity Summit Forum, the 13th China Maritime Fair Key Project Signing Ceremony, the Second China Fuzhou Strait Copyright There are 16 major events including the (Creative) Industry Expo and Trade Fair, the 13th China International Trade Fair Procurement Negotiation and Signing Ceremony, the 8th China International Trade Fair Transnational Procurement Matchmaking Conference, and the 8th China Fair China-Thailand Cooperation and Exchange Meeting. In addition, there are supporting activities such as "Tour the Minjiang River to Watch Fireworks and Folklore", and the 13th China International Trade Fair Cross-Strait Children's Art Exhibition.

a27eaf35657b5d03607f27311ce3ba9eb636aa86.sourceText: 组委会表示，本届海交会加大了邀请专业采购商的力度，目前英中贸易协会、土耳其中国工商业协会、香港贸发局、高雄市世贸会展协会、中华亚太中小企业经济合作促进会等境外专业团体已确定组团参会。此外，俄罗斯、马来西亚、印尼、澳大利亚、韩国、日本、美国等28个国家和地区的200多个专业客商通过网站和传真等多种形式报名参会，预计本届海交会将有超过1000名专业客商参会。
a27eaf35657b5d03607f27311ce3ba9eb636aa86.translatedText: The organizing committee stated that this year's Maritime Fair has increased its efforts to invite professional buyers. At present, overseas professional groups such as the China-Britain Business Council, the Turkey-China Industry and Commerce Association, the Hong Kong Trade Development Council, the Kaohsiung World Trade Exhibition Association, and the China Asia-Pacific Small and Medium Enterprises Economic Cooperation Promotion Association have decided to organize groups to participate in the conference. In addition, more than 200 professional merchants from 28 countries and regions including Russia, Malaysia, Indonesia, Australia, South Korea, Japan, and the United States have registered to participate in the fair through various methods such as the website and fax. It is expected that more than 1,000 professional merchants will participate in this fair.

f70fc47db6dedebd20684da1aae4ee20bfae4831.sourceText: 海交会由国台办、中国贸促会、海关总署、国家质检总局和福建省政府等联合主办，今年的展会将持续到22日。
f70fc47db6dedebd20684da1aae4ee20bfae4831.translatedText: The Overseas Trade Fair is jointly sponsored by the Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council, the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade, the General Administration of Customs, the General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, and the Fujian Provincial Government. This year's exhibition will last until the 22nd.

fb73f6c007d296c710006b03cdd485bff85ccb0d.sourceText: 44岁的郑伊健一直抱着不婚主义，但近两年态度软化，去年在陈小春的婚礼上表示有结婚的计划，此后婚讯频传，但每次郑伊健都大卖关子，曾称”世界末日之前结婚”。
fb73f6c007d296c710006b03cdd485bff85ccb0d.translatedText: The 44-year-old Ekin Cheng has always held a non-marriage policy, but his attitude has softened in the past two years. Last year, he expressed his plan to get married at Jordan Chan's wedding. Since then, there have been frequent rumors of marriage, but every time Ekin Cheng makes a big deal, once saying "get married before the end of the world."

6ed14d620980da7ed7b9b4e7c9fd722ab78d85f9.sourceText: 但37岁蒙嘉慧一直未等到郑伊健有所行动，知情人表示”蒙嘉慧一心以为好事将近，谁知道郑伊健完全没有表示，反而老人家同朋友一直问她何时结婚，早年前蒙嘉慧逼婚不成还和他大吵，因此现在急也要装作不急。”
6ed14d620980da7ed7b9b4e7c9fd722ab78d85f9.translatedText: But 37-year-old Meng Jiahui never waited for Ekin Cheng to take action. An insider said, "Meng Jiahui thought that something good was coming, but Ekin Zheng didn't say anything at all. Instead, the old man and her friends kept asking her when she would get married. Meng Jiahui had a big fight with him earlier when she couldn't force the marriage, so now she has to pretend not to be anxious."

2635d3cbdeeba02ace964dc74729ad423e0e963f.sourceText: 非法下载 警報系統3月1日启动 在網路上非法分享音樂、電影或電視節目的用戶，很快將會收到五大網路服務供應商(ISP)發出違反著作權的警告，接獲六次警告仍不改善者，可能面臨網路速度變慢48小時。自認未侵權的用戶可提出抗議，但需繳費。 這項由ISP與音樂和電影等業者在去年協議完成的「著作權警報系統」(Copyright Alert System)，將在本周啟動，並會鎖定使用「點對點」(Peer to Peer)傳輸軟體的網路用戶。 加入新系統的ISP業者，包括美國電報電話公司(AT&T)、威瑞森(Verizon)、通訊廣播公司(Comcast)、有線電視公司(Cablevision)和時代華納有線公司。 該系統會通知ISP向違反著作權的用戶，以電子郵件發出偵測違規的通知。第一次通知預期將屬於規勸的教育性質，第三次和第四次通知則開始要求用戶必須承認已收到警告，並了解行為違法。 用戶在收到六次通知後若仍未改善，ISP將以更強硬方式，亦即採取「緩和措施」(mitigation measures)，包括讓用戶網路速度暫時變慢，或把用戶導向其他登入頁面，以顯示有關著作權法的教育資訊。 堅持未違反著作權的消費者，必須繳交35元才可提出申訴，但若勝訴可獲退款。 專家表示，著作權警報系統僅對一般民眾具有教育意味；參與這項計畫的官員也指出，該系統將不可能遏止著作權的違規大戶。
2635d3cbdeeba02ace964dc74729ad423e0e963f.translatedText: Illegal downloading alert system will be activated on March 1st Users who illegally share music, movies or TV shows on the Internet will soon receive copyright violation warnings from the five major Internet Service Providers (ISPs). Those who do not improve after six warnings may face slowdowns in network speeds for 48 hours. Users who believe that there is no infringement may lodge a protest, but must pay a fee. This "Copyright Alert System" (Copyright Alert System), which was completed last year through an agreement between ISPs and music and film industries, will be launched this week and will target Internet users who use "Peer to Peer" transmission software. ISPs joining the new system include AT&T, Verizon, Comcast, Cablevision and Time Warner Cable. The system will notify ISPs to send notifications via email to users who violate copyrights to detect violations. The first notification is expected to be of an educational nature, while the third and fourth notifications will require users to acknowledge receipt of the warning and understand that the behavior is illegal. If the user still does not improve after receiving six notifications, the ISP will take a tougher approach, that is, take "mitigation measures", including temporarily slowing down the user's network speed, or directing the user to another login page to display educational information about copyright law. Consumers who insist that there is no copyright infringement must pay 35 yuan to file a complaint, but if they win the appeal, they will receive a refund. Experts say the copyright alert system is only educational for the general public; officials involved in the project also point out that the system will not be able to deter major copyright violators.

e24d6fd080e84b197b2e2131e78bdb3b29514b78.sourceText: 洛杉矶环球影城希尔顿大酒店宴会大厅灯火 通明，冠盖云集，衣香鬓影。 中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆在这里举办盛大的国庆招待会， 庆祝中华人民共和国成立６２周年，联邦众议员赵美心，洛杉矶市市长维拉莱构沙，洛 杉矶县政委员安东诺维奇等众多的民选官员，以及侨界各侨团代表，留学生，中资企 业等代表千多人出席致贺，场面喜庆热烈。 招待会在中美两国国歌声中开始，中领馆邱绍芳总领事致辞，他用英文介绍了中 国建国62年来的主要成就，经济发展，社会稳定，国家富强。 邱绍芳表示，中国正在逐 步建立覆盖城乡居民的社会保障体系，和平发展是中国实现现代化和富民强国，为世 界文明作出更大贡献的战略抉择，中国在未来发展以及国际交往中，将坚持这一战略 邱绍芳指出，在当前的国际形势下，中美双方不是零和竞争关系，而应该是平等合作 同舟共济的颗伴关系，这不仅造福两国人民，也有利于世界和平稳定与繁荣。 他说很高兴看到今年领区内各级政府与中国保持密切交往，国会众议员赵美心， 亚利桑那州州长布鲁尔，夏威夷州副州长沙茨相继访华，洛杉矶市市长维拉莱构沙和 夏威夷州州长阿伯克隆等也将在年内访华，中国也有相当数量的省市代表团来访，他 认为，中美两国应像走亲戚一样常来往，只有这样才能不断增进彼此了解与互信，从 而推动中美关系的发展。 洛杉矶市市长维拉莱构沙致辞表示，美中关系的发展，推动了两国的经贸发展和 人员往来，中国游客把美国作为出国旅游的第一目的地国家，洛杉矶作为到美国的第 一目的地城市，他还高度评价了华裔社区对洛杉矶以至美国的经济发展做出的重大贡 献。 国会众议员赵美心，洛杉矶县政委员安东诺维奇则分别介绍了他们最近访问中国 的感受，称赞中国取得的巨大成就，强调美中关系对于美中乃之世界的重要性。
e24d6fd080e84b197b2e2131e78bdb3b29514b78.translatedText: The banquet hall of the Hilton Hotel in Universal Studios Los Angeles was lit. It is bright, the crowns and covers are gathered together, and the clothes are fragrant and the hair is shadowed. The Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles held a grand National Day reception here to celebrate the 62nd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China. Congresswoman Zhao Meixin, Los Angeles Mayor Villaraigosa, Los Angeles County Supervisor Antonovich and many other elected officials, as well as representatives of various overseas Chinese groups, overseas students, Chinese-funded enterprises and other representatives attended the celebration. More than a thousand people attended to express their congratulations. The scene was festive and warm. The reception started with the national anthems of China and the United States. Consul General Qiu Shaofang of the Chinese Consulate delivered a speech. He introduced in English the main achievements of China in the past 62 years since its founding, including economic development, social stability, and national prosperity. Qiu Shaofang said that China is gradually establishing a social security system covering both urban and rural residents. Peaceful development is a strategic choice for China to modernize, enrich its people and strengthen the country, and make greater contributions to world civilization. China will adhere to this strategy in its future development and international exchanges. Qiu Shaofang pointed out that under the current international situation, China and the United States are not in a zero-sum competition relationship, but should cooperate on an equal footing. A partnership that helps each other not only benefits the two peoples, but also contributes to world peace, stability and prosperity. He said he was very happy to see that governments at all levels in the consular district have maintained close exchanges with China this year. Congresswoman Zhao Meixin, Arizona Governor Brewer, and Hawaii Lieutenant Governor Schatz have visited China one after another. Los Angeles Mayor Villaraigosa and Hawaii Governor Abercron will also visit China within the year. China also has a considerable number of provincial and municipal delegations visiting. He believes that China and the United States should visit each other as often as relatives. Only in this way can mutual understanding and mutual trust be continuously enhanced, thereby promoting the development of Sino-US relations. Los Angeles Mayor Villaraigosa said in his speech that the development of U.S.-China relations has promoted economic and trade development and personnel exchanges between the two countries. Chinese tourists regard the United States as the first destination for overseas travel, and Los Angeles as the first destination city to the United States. He also spoke highly of the Chinese community's significant contribution to the economic development of Los Angeles and the United States. Congresswoman Zhao Meixin and Los Angeles County Supervisor Antonovich respectively introduced their feelings about their recent visit to China, praised China's great achievements, and emphasized the importance of U.S.-China relations to the world between the United States and China.

3947c4a5f7473c87844c8ae32d77ca8dbeead4fd.sourceText: 退税支票已经陆续寄达，今日美国报报导，有些民众用退税款购买高科技产品或度假，但也有超过20万家庭用退税款申请破产。 根据全国经济研究所(National Bureau of Economic Research)最新调查，因为破产申请费和律师费上涨，一些财务状况不佳的家庭，不得不在领到退税款后，才申请破产。 处理破产桉律师长久以来所熟悉的状况是，每年初民众领到退税款后，申请个人破产的桉件会激增，这个情况在2005年破产法修正后特别显着。 申请破产的律师费和行政费在2005年为921元，但在破产法修正两年后，费用涨到1477元。上涨的费用大部分为律师费，因为破产法修正后，律师要确认更多破产申请者的相关资讯，才能完成破产申请手续。 破产法修法目的是为要防止申请破产太浮滥。修法前，主张修法者认为，许多无法还债的人利用申请破产逃避还债。修法后，申请破产的桉件减少，但并不一定代表破产浮滥的情况改善。
3947c4a5f7473c87844c8ae32d77ca8dbeead4fd.translatedText: Tax refund checks have been arriving one after another. USA Today reported that some people used their tax refunds to buy high-tech products or go on vacation, but more than 200,000 families also used their tax refunds to file for bankruptcy. According to the latest survey from the National Bureau of Economic Research, due to rising bankruptcy filing fees and attorney fees, some families with poor financial conditions have to wait until they receive tax refunds before filing for bankruptcy. A situation that bankruptcy lawyers have long been familiar with is that after people receive their tax refunds at the beginning of each year, there will be a surge in filing for personal bankruptcy. This situation has been particularly significant after the bankruptcy law was revised in 2005. The attorney fees and administrative fees for filing for bankruptcy were 921 yuan in 2005, but two years after the bankruptcy law was revised, the fees rose to 1,477 yuan. Most of the increased costs are attorney fees, because after the bankruptcy law was revised, lawyers have to confirm more relevant information about bankruptcy applicants before they can complete the bankruptcy application procedures. The purpose of amending the bankruptcy law is to prevent filing for bankruptcy from being too frivolous. Before the law was revised, those who advocated the law believed that many people who could not repay their debts used to file for bankruptcy to avoid repaying their debts. After the law was revised, the number of bankruptcy applications decreased, but this does not necessarily mean that the situation of bankruptcy has improved.

21aa59061f30048ae4d8766901d1519548257825.sourceText: 昨日，本报报道了美国北达科他州狄克森州立大学被曝光”极度缺乏控制和监管”，大学录取了数百名不具备入学资格的外国学生，并在没有完成课程的情况下授予学位。 今晨，《法制晚报》记者从发布审查报告的北达科他州大学系统处获悉，狄克森州立大学今年春天新入学的27名中国学生中，有21名”英语水平达不到所需水平，这部分学生将会被送回国”。 该校教育、商业及应用科学学院院长道格 普兰特已自杀。
21aa59061f30048ae4d8766901d1519548257825.translatedText: Yesterday, this newspaper reported that Dickson State University in North Dakota, USA, was exposed as having an "extreme lack of control and supervision". The university admitted hundreds of foreign students who did not meet the admission qualifications and awarded degrees without completing the courses. This morning, a reporter from the "Legal Evening News" learned from the University of North Dakota System, which released the review report, that among the 27 new Chinese students admitted to Dickson State University this spring, 21 "their English proficiency does not meet the required level, and these students will be sent back home." Doug Plante, dean of the school's School of Education, Business and Applied Sciences, has committed suicide.

761e39642f37cba22b62116866b02d6dac3a2bfa.sourceText: 如何处理 大部分不合格学生学位已撤销 北达科他州大学系统的负责人威廉 茨称，目前，大部分不合格学生学位已撤销，不过他们仍将有机会获取合格的学位。 北达科他州大学系统负责管理6个4年制大学和5个两年制院校，共约4.9万名学生。 审查报告指出，狄克森州立大学可能因违反学生签证的相关规定而面临来自多方面的处罚，包括美国国务院、教育部、国土安全部和位于芝加哥的认证机构高等教育委员会。 今晨，美国高等教育委员会相关负责人John Hausaman接受《法制晚报》记者采访时表示，该委员会已与校方取得联系，将继续监控该校处理此事的进展。 参与该校双学位项目者 95%是中国人 狄克森州立大学双学位项目的操作方式是要求学生先在国内学校读，然后来北达科他州读一年，再返回国内学校结束学位。而审查报告显示，该校甚至没有大部分学生在国内学校的成绩单，仅仅到狄克森州立大学上一年学，便能获得该校学位。 此外报告指出，学生们得到承诺说，他们可以在结束国内学校课程之前就获得狄克森州立大学的学位，这也违反了双学位课程的相关条款。 威廉 茨称，狄克森州立大学与127所国际学校签署了协议，授予其学生双学位。其中的很多协议没有到大学办公室正确注册，协议中没有具体的执行计划。 北达科他州大学系统建议该校取消所有的协议，终止通过外部招募学生的合作。 审查报告主要涉及2003年以后入校的学生，涉及的合作主要是双学位项目。而参与该双学位项目的学生有95%是中国人，剩下的5%是俄罗斯人。 狄克森州立大学位于美国北达科他州狄克森市，是一所公立综合性大学。目前，该校拥有约2700名本科生 北京落点 首经贸有8名学生在读 记者从与狄克森州立大学有合作项目的首都经济贸易大学了解到，该校目前有8位学生仍在狄克森州立大学就读，校方已经与他们取得联系，首经贸相关领导也与狄克森州立大学进行了接洽，以确保学生的利益得到保护。 据首经贸宣传部相关负责人表示，狄克森州立大学是我国教育部认可的美国学校，学校资质也经过了严格的考核。 据悉，今年是首经贸与狄克森州立大学合作的第二年，总计有十几名学生去狄克森州立大学学习，其中第一批已经返校。 教育部 已联系驻美使馆 正在核查情况 记者从教育部获悉，狄克森州立大学确实在教育部公布的、获得美国官方认证的美国正规高校名单中。 上午，本报记者从教育部获悉，目前教育部有关部门已与驻美使馆教育处取得联系，正在调查了解此事。该部门表示，目前尚未确认网上信息的准确性，正在核实。如果确认，教育部教育涉外监管部门将会采取相应措施。 此外，已考入这所学校的中国学生，如果有具体问题，可向驻美使馆教育处(组)联系咨询。教育部教育涉外监管信息网上有驻美使馆教育处的咨询联系方式。
761e39642f37cba22b62116866b02d6dac3a2bfa.translatedText: How to deal with the majority of unqualified students' degrees that have been revoked. William Z, the director of the North Dakota University System, said that currently, most of the unqualified students' degrees have been revoked, but they will still have the opportunity to obtain qualified degrees. The University of North Dakota system manages six four-year colleges and five two-year colleges, with a total of approximately 49,000 students. The review noted that Dickson State University could face penalties from multiple sources, including the U.S. Department of State, the Department of Education, the Department of Homeland Security and the Higher Education Commission, a Chicago-based accrediting agency, for violating student visa regulations. This morning, John Hausaman, the relevant person in charge of the American Higher Education Commission, said in an interview with a reporter from the Legal Evening News that the commission has contacted the school and will continue to monitor the school’s progress in handling the matter. 95% of those participating in the school's dual-degree program are Chinese. The operation method of Dickson State University's dual-degree program requires students to first study at a domestic school, then come to North Dakota to study for a year, and then return to the domestic school to complete the degree. The review report shows that the school does not even have the transcripts of most students from domestic schools, and they can obtain a degree from Dickson State University after just one year of schooling. In addition, the report states, students were promised that they could earn a degree from Dickson State before completing their studies at home, which also violated the terms of the dual-degree program. William Ts said that Dickson State University has signed agreements with 127 international schools to grant dual degrees to its students. Many of these agreements were not properly registered with the university office, and there was no specific implementation plan in the agreement. The University System of North Dakota recommended that the school cancel all agreements and end cooperation with externally recruiting students. The review report mainly involves students who entered the school after 2003, and the cooperation involved is mainly double degree projects. 95% of the students participating in the dual degree program are Chinese, and the remaining 5% are Russian. Dickson State University is a public comprehensive university located in Dickson, North Dakota, United States. Currently, the school has about 2,700 undergraduates. There are 8 students enrolled in Capital University of Economics and Business in Beijing. The reporter learned from Capital University of Economics and Business, which has a cooperative project with Dickson State University, that there are currently 8 students in the school who are still studying at Dickson State University. The school has contacted them, and relevant leaders of Capital University of Economics and Trade have also contacted Dickson State University to ensure that the interests of students are protected. According to the relevant person in charge of the Capital Economic and Trade Publicity Department, Dickson State University is an American school recognized by the Ministry of Education of my country, and the school qualifications have also undergone strict assessment. It is reported that this year is the second year of cooperation between Beijing Economic and Trade University and Dickson State University. A total of more than a dozen students have gone to Dickson State University to study, and the first batch of them has returned to school. The Ministry of Education has contacted the Embassy in the United States and is verifying the situation. The reporter learned from the Ministry of Education that Dickson State University is indeed on the list of regular American universities announced by the Ministry of Education and officially certified by the United States. In the morning, our reporter learned from the Ministry of Education that the relevant departments of the Ministry of Education have contacted the Education Section of the Embassy in the United States and are investigating the matter. The department said it has not yet confirmed the accuracy of the online information and is verifying it. If confirmed, the education foreign-related supervision department of the Ministry of Education will take corresponding measures. In addition, if Chinese students who have been admitted to this school have specific questions, they can contact the Education Section (Group) of the Embassy in the United States for consultation. The Ministry of Education’s foreign-related supervision information website provides consultation contact information for the Education Office of the Embassy in the United States.

cfd49c8819cc7e0fd9c9e8acf42af7fdb89b7ca9.sourceText: 报告显示未来中国流动迁移人口将保持2亿至3亿规模
cfd49c8819cc7e0fd9c9e8acf42af7fdb89b7ca9.translatedText: The report shows that China's migrant population will remain at 200 million to 300 million in the future

d4871a38153cbc60cc678795d8c9d24e1e908c3c.translatedText: The report shows that China's migrant population will remain at 200 million to 300 million in the future Xinhuanet The "China Urban Development Report" released by the China Mayors Association in Beijing on the 30th...

69049c71533f4f3ede68e664145f5377f8064a7a.sourceText: 中国市长协会３０日在北京发布的《中国城市发展报告》２０１０年卷指出，未来二三十年，中国的流动迁移人口将保持２亿至３亿的规模，其分布、结构、素质的复杂变化，对国家战略规划、政府社会管理和公共服务提出了严峻挑战。
69049c71533f4f3ede68e664145f5377f8064a7a.translatedText: The 2010 Volume of the "China Urban Development Report" released by the China Mayors Association in Beijing on the 30th pointed out that in the next 20 to 30 years, China's migrant population will remain at a scale of 200 million to 300 million. The complex changes in its distribution, structure, and quality pose severe challenges to national strategic planning, government social management, and public services.

96f88e64f0301533333a99ba4564c7ef8bbe9bc6.sourceText: 中国市长协会每年发布一次的《中国城市发展报告》是目前国内较为权威的系统研究中国城市发展的综合性年度报告，汇集了中国科学院、中国工程院、国际欧亚科学院诸多知名院士的研究成果。２０１０年卷的主题是”城市，让生活更美好”。
96f88e64f0301533333a99ba4564c7ef8bbe9bc6.translatedText: The "China Urban Development Report" released annually by the China Mayors Association is currently a relatively authoritative comprehensive annual report on the systematic study of China's urban development. It brings together the research results of many well-known academicians of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, the Chinese Academy of Engineering, and the International Eurasian Academy of Sciences. The theme of the 2010 volume is "Better City, Better Life".

a4e4c7b18499f67a19f9a5cba10285c5cc7573ec.sourceText: 报告显示，中国未来人口流动将呈现流以下态势：流动人口规模不断增加，但增速逐步放缓；流动人口分布将逐步形成以东部沿海城市带为重心，以内陆城市群为中轴，以西部中心城市为集聚点的流动人口分布格局；人口流动由生存型向发展性转变。
a4e4c7b18499f67a19f9a5cba10285c5cc7573ec.translatedText: The report shows that China's future population mobility will show the following trends: the size of the floating population will continue to increase, but the growth rate will gradually slow down; the distribution of the floating population will gradually form a distribution pattern with the eastern coastal urban belt as the center of gravity, the inland urban agglomerations as the central axis, and the western central cities as the gathering points; population mobility will change from survival to development.

5fa21be1a7f126f62d80c20f6b1949838a72290c.sourceText: 中国国际经济交流中心理事长曾培炎在报告中指出，到２０１５年，中国将从一个以农村人口为主的国家，转型为一个以城市人口为主的国家。中国城镇化将成为中国经济增长的新引擎，也会为拉动全球经济稳定增长做出贡献。
5fa21be1a7f126f62d80c20f6b1949838a72290c.translatedText: Zeng Peiyan, chairman of the China Center for International Economic Exchanges, pointed out in the report that by 2015, China will transform from a country with a mainly rural population to a country with a mainly urban population. China's urbanization will become a new engine for China's economic growth and will also contribute to the stable growth of the global economy.

41472b72f7577839197dc59a974c9b9a6f360737.sourceText: 清华大学建筑学院副院长毛其智说：”城镇化是中国未来经济发展最大的市场需求，也是解决中国目前三农问题的出路。但随着我国城镇化发展加速，很多矛盾和困惑需要引起重视，如高房价、交通拥堵、生态环境恶化、城市基础设施不完善等问题。”
41472b72f7577839197dc59a974c9b9a6f360737.translatedText: > Mao Qizhi, deputy dean of the School of Architecture at Tsinghua University, said: "Urbanization is the biggest market demand for China's future economic development and is also the way to solve China's current problems of rural areas and farmers. However, as my country's urbanization accelerates, many contradictions and confusions require attention, such as high housing prices, traffic congestion, ecological environment deterioration, and imperfect urban infrastructure."

076c4dcb56ba4f4f211240e600cd546ecad0613b.sourceText: 报告指出，中国国城市经济发展出现过度依赖土地出让收入的现象。多数地方热衷于利用土地创造财政收入、进行融资以推动城市发展，进而不断扩大土地经营。
076c4dcb56ba4f4f211240e600cd546ecad0613b.translatedText: The report points out that the economic development of Chinese cities is overly dependent on land transfer revenue. Most localities are keen to use land to generate fiscal revenue and raise financing to promote urban development, and then continue to expand land management.

1597d1711b6e4fef3d114f45ae01f347ad795c98.sourceText: 对此报告同时认为，当前政府兼有管理主体、产权主体和受益主体的多重身份，其经营与管理职能目标相悖，效益与公平难以兼顾。
1597d1711b6e4fef3d114f45ae01f347ad795c98.translatedText: This report also believes that the current government has multiple identities as management subject, property rights subject and beneficiary subject. Its business and management functional objectives are inconsistent, and it is difficult to balance efficiency and fairness.
