e73ff7f0ec9d60300c308dbf49f57cbf1c119bca.translatedText: The Chinese Welfare Association contacted Greenwood Cemetery Company to sell Shoudi to save overseas Chinese 30,000 to 40,000 yuan Zhang Zhaohong Mr. Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader, has recently discussed cooperation with the management of Greenwood Cemetery...

7c2289347cbbebbe61d34d0883c63c5729f72788.sourceText: 资深侨领余文劲先生，近日和绿木墓园管理层商议合作，以斐匿华人福利会的名义，向华人出售优惠价格墓地，已有数十位侨民受惠，节省了数万元的寿地等 费用开支。 5月12日，85岁高龄的余文劲先生提早来​​到康乐大厦，还带来部分瓶装水和甜点，等候侨众前来办理购买墓地手续。 一早来到的还有绿木墓园公司的karla Gottry等三位工作人员，来自华人福利会作服务工作的有邓情芬、方慧贤、张华芳等三位顾问、福利会主席张肇鸿、侨联董事 Brenda Fung以及司徒全、余富强等。 华人福利会4月就在本地各间报馆上刊登广告，让广大侨众得知消息，在一个多月的时间里，邓情芬、方慧贤已接到数十通询问和登记的电话。 上午九时至中午十二时，购买寿地的侨胞鱼贯而来，他们纷纷询问有关寿地、材套和墓碑等方面的问题(相片1)，义工们耐心地讲解墓地的位置和价格，材 套、墓碑等方面折扣(相片2) ，并向不谙英文的侨民提供翻译(相片3) ，协助墓园公司工作人员更方便地填写表格，办理好付款手续等，也让侨胞心里明白， 买得安心。
7c2289347cbbebbe61d34d0883c63c5729f72788.translatedText: Senior overseas Chinese leader Mr. Yu Wenjin has recently discussed cooperation with the management of Greenwood Cemetery to sell cemeteries at preferential prices to Chinese people in the name of the Chinese Welfare Association. Dozens of overseas Chinese have benefited, saving tens of thousands of yuan in expenses such as longevity land and other expenses. On May 12, 85-year-old Mr. Yu Wenjin came to the Kangle Building early and brought some bottled water and desserts, waiting for overseas Chinese to come and go through the procedures for purchasing a cemetery. Also arriving early in the morning were Karla Gottry and other three staff members from the Greenwood Cemetery Company. Three consultants from the Chinese Welfare Association, including Deng Qingfen, Fang Huixian and Zhang Huafang, Welfare Association Chairman Zhang Zhaohong, Overseas Chinese Federation Director Brenda Fung, Situ Quan and Yu Fuqiang, etc. The Chinese Welfare Association published advertisements in various local newspapers in April to let the overseas Chinese know the news. In more than a month, Deng Qingfen and Fang Huixian have received dozens of inquiries and registration calls. From 9 a.m. to 12 noon, overseas Chinese who purchased Shoudi came in droves. They asked questions about Shoudi, materials, tombstones, etc. (Photo 1). The volunteers patiently explained the location and price of the cemetery, discounts on materials, tombstones, etc. (Photo 2), and provided translations to the overseas Chinese who did not speak English (Photo 3). They assisted the staff of the cemetery company to fill out the forms more conveniently, handle the payment procedures, etc., and also made the overseas Chinese understand that Buy with peace of mind.

93e60c8485ea4ea4660752809eb616db5a37adb4.sourceText: 自从1992年余文劲先生开辟华人墓园以来，每隔三数年，华人福利会就联系墓园公司，以相对低廉的价格出售墓地，二十年来粗略估计为侨胞省下了近廿万元。 而今次共出售墓地53幅，以及材套和墓碑等八折收费等优惠，再为侨胞节省了3、4万元，成绩也是近年来最好的一次。 绿木墓园公司主管Ed Steklenski还亲自来到现场视察，十分高兴地和余文劲先生等交谈并拍照(相片4)，售地工作完毕后，又和员工、义工们一起拍照留念(相片5)。
93e60c8485ea4ea4660752809eb616db5a37adb4.translatedText: Since Mr. Yu Wenjin opened the Chinese cemetery in 1992, the Chinese Welfare Association has contacted the cemetery company every three years to sell the cemetery at a relatively low price. In the past twenty years, it is roughly estimated that it has saved the overseas Chinese nearly 200,000 yuan. A total of 53 cemeteries were sold this time, as well as 20% off on materials, tombstones, etc., which saved overseas Chinese another 30,000 to 40,000 yuan. The results are also the best in recent years. Ed Steklenski, the director of Greenwood Cemetery Company, also came to the site for inspection. He was very happy to talk and take photos with Mr. Yu Wenjin and others (Photo 4). After the land sales work was completed, he took photos with employees and volunteers (Photo 5).

94ca6659ef8a5be2997e8f4cd2c307dae1e6fef1.sourceText: 墓地不似房地产有起有落，而是年年涨价，从最初每幅495元升至现在的3295元，涨幅近7倍，数年后达到每幅4000元以上不足为奇，今次 墓地的优惠价是2695元，4幅联购每幅还可再降至为2517元， 53幅墓地及其它附件预购为侨胞省下了数万元。 墓园公司一般只对在生的预购者提供价格优惠，所购的墓地有转让权，生前购买优惠价格的墓地其实也是一种省钱和保值的方法。 另外，绿木墓园中的华人墓地也是一种有限的土地资源，在联络墓地优惠价格方面，斐匿华人福利会日后将继续为侨民服务。
94ca6659ef8a5be2997e8f4cd2c307dae1e6fef1.translatedText: Graveyards are not like the ups and downs of real estate. Instead, the price of cemeteries increases every year, from the initial 495 yuan per lot to the current 3295 yuan, an increase of nearly 7 times. A few years later, it is not surprising that it has reached more than 4,000 yuan per lot. This time The preferential price of the cemetery is 2,695 yuan, and the combined purchase of 4 plots can be further reduced to 2,517 yuan each. The pre-ordering of 53 cemeteries and other accessories has saved the overseas Chinese tens of thousands of yuan. Cemetery companies generally only provide price discounts to living pre-orderers, and the purchased cemetery has the right to transfer. Purchasing a cemetery at a discounted price during your lifetime is actually a way to save money and preserve value. In addition, the Chinese cemetery in Greenwood Cemetery is also a limited land resource. In terms of liaising with the cemetery for preferential prices, the Chinese Welfare Association will continue to serve expatriates in the future.

704e1e364f830685414eefb41060a49e763b6f76.sourceText: 10个迹象 金融衰退潮又来了？ 很多美国人怀疑金融海啸从未退潮，经济学家从十个迹象判断，二度衰退已经展开，尽管不像前一波严重，却可能延续好几季。 1.通货膨胀 没什么比物价飞涨更易侵蚀消费者信心。星巴克最近才将咖啡调涨百分之十七；棉花去年翻涨近一半，导致夏季成衣售价调涨两成。糖、肉和玉米制食品，无一幸免。 2.投资报酬 道琼指数从两年多前的低谷涨至一万两千点，许多股票也几乎从谷底翻涨一倍。然而股市上季大跌，金价浮现疲态，各种投资收益都在下滑。 3.汽车产业 美国浴火重生的汽车业营收年增率直到四月前都在攀升，但五月营收在高油价和日震冲击产能下开始停滞，要是经济再衰退，好不容易恢复的聘雇需求可能再次停摆。 4.油价 油价持续攀升到每桶一百美元，已占去民众大部份预算，也重创零售和航空等产业。 5.联邦预算 联邦预算赤字居高不下，扼杀再次推出刺激方案的空间。随着撙节支出声浪升高，工会和州政府间为了就业和福利问题杠上，已经见怪不怪。 6.中国经济 中国经济降温后果有二：中国对能源和商品需求减缓；中产阶级减少，商品和服务的需求降低。过去十年美国出口中国总额暴增百分之四百六十八，仰赖中国带动成长的企业，想必不乐见中国经济降温。 7.失业 失业引发两个立即问题：失业者不花钱，冲击成长；失业补助金增加，财政恶化。六十五岁以上民众眼见房屋价格暴跌、医疗福利被削减，宁愿继续工作，连带剥夺年轻人就业机会。廿多岁世代只得接受较低的薪资，黄金消费年龄延到卅多岁，复苏跟着迟到十年。 8.举债上限 削减赤字伴随着增税，福利服务简化更提高此需求。增税常拖累成长，经济可能连几年零成长，企业获利下滑，采购和聘雇需求受阻；个人消费减少，房贷和信用卡偿债利率高。 9.融资需求 融资紧俏重伤个人和小企业的经济活动。金融机构不愿贷款给小企业，消费者也发现信用卡偿债利率高于百分之廿。有意购屋者如今得支付多达两成的头期款，也大大抑制购屋意愿。 10.房市 房市过去两个月持续恶化。价格暴跌让购屋者付不出贷款，更重伤数百万人的资产负债表，连带打击消费和复苏。由于有意进场者担心房价可能续跌，短期展望仍不容乐观。
704e1e364f830685414eefb41060a49e763b6f76.translatedText: 10 signs that another financial recession is coming? Many Americans doubt that the financial tsunami has never subsided. Economists judge from ten signs that a second recession has begun. Although not as severe as the previous wave, it may last for several quarters. 1. Inflation Nothing erodes consumer confidence more easily than soaring prices. Starbucks only recently raised its coffee prices by 17%; cotton prices rose by nearly half last year, resulting in a 20% increase in summer clothing prices. Sugar, meat and corn-based foods were not spared. 2. Investment returns: The Dow Jones Index has risen from the trough more than two years ago to 12,000 points, and many stocks have almost doubled from the trough. However, the stock market plummeted last quarter, gold prices showed signs of weakness, and various investment incomes declined. 3. Automobile industry The annual revenue growth rate of the reborn automobile industry in the United States was rising until April. However, revenue in May began to stagnate due to high oil prices and the impact of solar earthquakes on production capacity. If the economy declines again, the hiring demand that has finally recovered may be stalled again. 4. Oil prices: Oil prices continue to climb to US$100 per barrel, which has taken up most of people's budgets and has also severely damaged industries such as retail and aviation. 5. Federal budget The federal budget deficit remains high, killing the space for another stimulus package. With calls for spending cuts rising, it is no surprise that unions and state governments are at loggerheads over employment and welfare issues. 6. China's economy There are two consequences of the cooling of China's economy: China's demand for energy and goods has slowed down; the middle class has shrunk, and demand for goods and services has dropped. The total amount of U.S. exports to China has surged by 468% in the past ten years. Companies that rely on China to drive growth must not be happy to see China's economy cool down. 7. Unemployment Unemployment causes two immediate problems: unemployed people do not spend money, which affects growth; unemployment benefits increase and fiscal deterioration occurs. Seeing housing prices plummeting and medical benefits being cut, people over the age of 65 prefer to continue working, depriving young people of employment opportunities. The generation in their twenties has no choice but to accept lower wages. The prime consumption age has been extended to their thirties, and recovery has been delayed by ten years. 8. Debt ceiling. Deficit reduction is accompanied by tax increases, and the simplification of welfare services further increases this demand. Tax increases often drag down growth, and the economy may experience zero growth for several years. Corporate profits decline, and demand for purchases and hiring is hindered. Personal consumption decreases, and mortgage and credit card debt repayment rates are high. 9. Financing needs The financing crunch has seriously hurt the economic activities of individuals and small businesses. Financial institutions are reluctant to lend to small businesses, and consumers are finding that interest rates on credit card debt are higher than 20 percent. Potential home buyers now have to pay as much as 20% of the down payment, which greatly inhibits their willingness to buy a home. 10. Housing market The housing market has continued to deteriorate over the past two months. The collapse in prices has left homebuyers unable to pay their mortgages, severely damaged the balance sheets of millions of people, and hit consumption and recovery. As potential investors are concerned that housing prices may continue to fall, the short-term outlook is still not optimistic.

d7b358acd7e5648a5ccc10f7e057234394ffa855.sourceText: 凤凰城房屋价值过去一年上涨22% 通常凤凰城夏天的房地产交易都会冷下来，然而根据本周二的最新数据，现在它依然占据全国第一的位置。 亚利桑那8月包括破产屋和短售屋在内房屋价格比去年同期，一共上涨了18.2%。 8月大凤凰城房屋价值比去年涨了21.8%。 今年8月比7月上涨了1.4%。根据全国的数据，大凤凰城区房屋价值上涨了22%，休斯顿第二上涨了6.3%，达拉斯，洛杉矶分别上涨了4.8%，4.3%，4%。 8月全国房屋价格平均上站了4.6%。全国仅有六个州比去年下降，他们分别是：Alabama, Connecticut, Illinois, Kentucky, New Jersey and Rhode Island。 据CNNMoney对经济学家所作的一份调查显示，美国房市在经历了漫长的萧条期后，终现回暖迹象。 被访的14名经济学家中，9名经济学家相信房价已经回升或在今年晚些时候回升。另外，新房开工数量和现房、新房的销售数量皆有所上升。更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的Tinna (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
d7b358acd7e5648a5ccc10f7e057234394ffa855.translatedText: Phoenix home values ​​have risen 22% in the past year. Usually, Phoenix real estate transactions will cool down in the summer, but according to the latest data on Tuesday, it still occupies the first position in the country. Arizona home prices, including bankruptcies and short-sale homes, rose 18.2% in August compared with the same period last year. Greater Phoenix home values ​​increased 21.8% in August compared with last year. August this year increased by 1.4% compared with July. According to national data, home values ​​in the greater Phoenix area increased by 22%, followed by Houston at 6.3%, Dallas at 4.8%, and Los Angeles at 4.3% and 4% respectively. In August, national housing prices rose by an average of 4.6%. Only six states in the country saw declines from last year: Alabama, Connecticut, Illinois, Kentucky, New Jersey and Rhode Island. According to a CNNMoney survey of economists, the U.S. housing market is finally showing signs of recovery after a long period of depression. Nine of the 14 economists interviewed believe that house prices have already rebounded or will rebound later this year. In addition, the number of new housing starts and the sales of existing and new homes have both increased. 3a08ef8eb92a33c7bd1835cd8c687d51ce0aa213.sourceText: 美15年固定贷款利率达历史低点 总体下降 据抵押贷款担保巨头周四公布按周统计数据显示，美30年期固定贷款利率均值在截至于4月25日结束的一周中下跌至3.4%，较上周3.41%有所下降，较去年同期的3.88%有大幅下降。 同一份报告也显示，十五年期固定利率抵押贷款均值在同一周内达到了该项目有记录以来最低水平的2.61%，之前一周则为2.64%。 房地美首席经济学家弗兰克诺萨福特（Frank Nothaft）在报告中指出，?#22266;定贷款利率下降至接近历史低点将促进房市市场。?/FONT> 数据显示，今年第一季度现房销售总额达490万美元，达自2009年第一季度来最高点。 今年第一季度新房销售量总额达42.4万，达自2008年第三季度以来最高点。
3a08ef8eb92a33c7bd1835cd8c687d51ce0aa213.translatedText: The U.S. 15-year fixed loan interest rate reached a historical low, with an overall decline. According to weekly statistics released by the mortgage guarantee giant on Thursday, the average U.S. 30-year fixed loan interest rate fell to 3.4% in the week ending April 25, down from 3.41% last week and down significantly from 3.88% in the same period last year. The same report also showed that the average 15-year fixed-rate mortgage reached its lowest level on record during the same week at 2.61%, down from 2.64% the week before. Frank Nothaft, chief economist of Freddie Mac, pointed out in the report that the drop in mortgage rates to near historical lows will boost the housing market. ?/FONT> Data show that existing home sales totaled $4.9 million in the first quarter of this year, reaching the highest point since the first quarter of 2009. New home sales in the first quarter of this year totaled 424,000, the highest level since the third quarter of 2008.

46fe0d875b07ecf8fd72d7aa973f4f27be1e57d7.sourceText: 23州沙门氏菌爆发 疑木瓜是病源 （亚省时报） 美国FDA（食品和药物管理局）警告消费者，污染的木瓜似乎是在23个州爆发沙门氏菌疫情的源头。 FDA说，由得克萨斯州麦卡伦的Agromod农产品公司（Agromod Produce Inc.）经销的从墨西哥进口的木瓜，可能是97例戈纳沙门氏菌病例的源头。迄今为止已经有10人住院治疗，但没有死亡报告。Agromod农产品公司已 自愿召回7月23日前售出的所有木瓜。 病例报告时间从1月1日至7月18日，地点在阿肯色州、亚利桑那州、加利福尼亚州、科罗拉多州、佐 治亚州、伊利诺伊州、路易斯安那州、马萨诸塞州、明尼苏达州、密苏里州、内布拉斯加州、内华达州、新泽西州、新墨西哥州、纽约州、俄亥俄州、俄克拉荷马 州、宾夕法尼亚州、田纳西州、得克萨斯、弗吉尼亚、华盛顿和威斯康星州。 患者年龄从1岁至91岁，平均年龄为20岁。半数以上患者是女性。得克萨斯州有患者最多，25人因此生病。 据疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）介绍，戈纳沙门氏菌是2,000种沙门氏菌株中的一种。症状通常出现在感染后12至72小时，可长达七天。每年在美国大约有4万例沙门氏菌病例报告。 FDA告诉消费者，购买水果之前应检查新鲜木瓜上的品牌贴纸是否是Agromod。存有Agromod品牌木瓜的消费者和零售商应该把木瓜放在密封的容器里再丢弃，让动物也不能吃到。怀疑自己吃木瓜后生病的人应该去看医生。 该品牌木瓜可能已在全美和加拿大有销售。美国食品药物管理局和疾病预防控制中心正与国家公共卫生官员确定更多病例。
46fe0d875b07ecf8fd72d7aa973f4f27be1e57d7.translatedText: Salmonella outbreaks in 23 states, papayas suspected to be source of disease (Alberta Times) The US FDA (Food and Drug Administration) is warning consumers that contaminated papayas appear to be the source of salmonella outbreaks in 23 states. The FDA said papayas imported from Mexico and distributed by Agromod Produce Inc. of McAllen, Texas, were the likely source of 97 cases of Salmonella Gona. Ten people have been hospitalized so far, but no deaths have been reported. Agromod Produce Company has voluntarily recalled all papayas sold before July 23. Cases were reported from January 1 to July 18 in Arkansas, Arizona, California, Colorado, Georgia, Illinois, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, Nevada, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington and Wisconsin. Patient ages ranged from 1 to 91 years old, with an average age of 20 years. More than half of the patients are women. Texas has the most cases, with 25 people sickened. Salmonella gona is one of 2,000 strains of salmonella, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Symptoms usually appear 12 to 72 hours after infection and can last up to seven days. Approximately 40,000 cases of salmonella are reported in the United States each year. The FDA tells consumers to check the brand sticker on fresh papaya to see if it is Agromod before purchasing the fruit. Consumers and retailers stocking Agromod brand papayas should place them in sealed containers before discarding them so that animals cannot eat them. People who suspect they have become ill after eating papaya should see a doctor. This brand of papaya may already be available throughout the United States and Canada. The FDA and CDC are working with state public health officials to identify additional cases.

b4b5099514ad9f5bbc5bde6f1d96660ae0eec186.sourceText: 曾夺得北京奥运会冠军、在世锦赛实现五连冠的中国体操男团，这次在伦 敦遭遇严重伤病，资格赛中仅列第六。然而，就在这样的”绝处”，中国队在决赛中以”零失误”完成六个项目１８人次的比赛。 两周前还因半月板撕裂而躺在北爱尔兰训练营的床上哭泣的队长陈一冰说，这肯定是我经历过的最艰难的一场胜利。队员们说，要把 金牌 也送给赛前因伤离开的滕海斌，”这枚金牌有他的一份。”
b4b5099514ad9f5bbc5bde6f1d96660ae0eec186.translatedText: The Chinese men's gymnastics team, which has won the Beijing Olympics and won five consecutive world championships, suffered serious injuries in London this time and only ranked sixth in the qualifying round. However, in such a "desperate" situation, the Chinese team completed the 18-person competition in six events with "zero mistakes" in the finals. Captain Chen Yibing, who was crying on his bed at the Northern Ireland training camp two weeks ago after suffering a torn meniscus, said, "This must be the toughest victory I have ever experienced." The team members said that they wanted to give the gold medal to Teng Haibin, who left due to injury before the game. "This gold medal belongs to him."

9f11096f31bd6eacd02d1e73a22a9ada89202de8.sourceText: 中国军团当天获得的另外２块金牌来自跳水和女举。 曹缘和张雁全获得男子双人１０米跳台金牌 ， 李雪英夺得女子举 重５８公斤级冠军 。此外， 孙杨在男子２００米自由泳决赛中与韩国名将朴泰桓并列亚军 ，世界排名第一的２０岁小将孙玉洁在女子重剑个人赛中获得铜牌。
9f11096f31bd6eacd02d1e73a22a9ada89202de8.translatedText: The other two gold medals won by the Chinese Army that day came from diving and women's weightlifting. Cao Yuan and Zhang Yanquan won the men's synchronized 10-meter platform gold medal, and Li Xueying won the women's 58kg weightlifting championship. In addition, Sun Yang tied for runner-up with South Korean star Park Tae-hwan in the men's 200-meter freestyle final, and the world's number one 20-year-old Sun Yujie won the bronze medal in the women's epee individual event.

27d7300804ea1b9eac25517e11df0d7dba5d9da1.sourceText: ３０日， 伦敦 奥运会决出１２块金牌，中国军团获得３金１银１铜后，以９金５银３铜的成绩排在金牌榜第一。
27d7300804ea1b9eac25517e11df0d7dba5d9da1.translatedText: On the 30th, 12 gold medals were decided at the London Olympics. After the Chinese Legion won 3 golds, 1 silver and 1 bronze, it ranked first in the gold medal list with 9 golds, 5 silvers and 3 bronzes.

7c9d6e0b952ea69c438dcee877186fa36a5ef32a.sourceText: 尽管各自在传统优势项目”丢掉”一些金牌，但是来自东亚的几个代表团，在伦敦奥运会开幕前几天的比赛中，总体算是取得良好开局。
7c9d6e0b952ea69c438dcee877186fa36a5ef32a.translatedText: Although each "lost" some gold medals in their traditional advantageous events, several delegations from East Asia generally made a good start in the competition a few days before the opening of the London Olympics.

f04f05c62d3f3e890d7582d24dbcc3a4873232cf.sourceText: 除了一直排名第一的中国代表团，朝鲜代表团目前以３金成绩排在金牌榜第四。当天，金恩国在男子 举重 ６２公斤级比赛中获得冠军，并以３２７公斤打破总成绩世界纪录。日本柔道也终于”开和”，名将松本薰在女子５７公斤级比赛中打破他们在”国技”项目屡屡翻船的怪圈，为日本夺得柔道队、也是代表团的第一块金牌，目前是中美之外唯一奖牌上两位数的代表团。此外，韩国目前也以２金成绩名列第六。
f04f05c62d3f3e890d7582d24dbcc3a4873232cf.translatedText: In addition to the Chinese delegation, which has always been ranked first, the North Korean delegation is currently ranked fourth in the gold medal list with 3 gold medals. On the same day, Kim Eun-guk won the championship in the men's 62kg weightlifting competition and broke the world record for total score with 327kg. Japan’s judo has finally reached a draw. In the women’s 57kg competition, the famous star Kaoru Matsumoto broke the vicious cycle of repeated capsizing in the “national skill” event, winning the first gold medal for Japan’s judo team and the delegation. Currently, they are the only delegation outside China and the United States to have double-digit medals. In addition, South Korea currently ranks sixth with 2 gold medals.

3a46b6ef4f5b8f5f73be2fb68d90a89921ff64f0.sourceText: 在 金牌榜 上排名第二的美国，奖牌数和中国同为１７枚，但金牌少了４块。美国当天获得的２块金牌全部来自游泳赛场，老将格里夫斯和”女菲鱼”富兰克林分别在男、女１００米仰泳比赛中拿下金牌。
3a46b6ef4f5b8f5f73be2fb68d90a89921ff64f0.translatedText: The United States, which ranks second on the gold medal list, has the same number of 17 medals as China, but has 4 fewer gold medals. The two gold medals won by the United States that day all came from swimming. Veteran Greaves and "Female Fish" Franklin won gold medals in the men's and women's 100-meter backstroke events respectively.

2a37d8ea2064342306672f6fe75208960f026e8a.sourceText: 在３０日的其他决赛中，俄罗斯选手伊萨耶夫获得男子７３公斤级柔道金牌。 名不见经传的１５岁立陶宛小将鲁塔?#26757;卢提特获得女子１００米蛙泳金牌 。法国名将阿涅尔夺得男子２００米自由泳金牌。乌克兰美女舍米亚金娜获得女子重剑个人赛冠军。罗马尼亚选手莫尔多韦亚努获得男子１０米气步枪金牌。
2a37d8ea2064342306672f6fe75208960f026e8a.translatedText: In other finals on the 30th, Russian player Isayev won the men's 73kg judo gold medal. The little-known 15-year-old Lithuanian teenager Ruta Luti won the women's 100-meter breaststroke gold medal. France's Asniel won the men's 200-meter freestyle gold medal. Ukrainian beauty Shemyakina won the women's epee individual championship. Romania's Mordoveanu won the men's 10-meter air rifle gold medal.

adc22ba75215daada9b43535dcbc7e672aeb327c.sourceText: 令人遗憾的是，伦敦奥运会这两天出现了一点”杂音”。有外国媒体质疑，中国游泳选手的神奇表现”或与兴奋剂有关”。国际奥委会医务委员会主席永奎斯特３０日在这里表示，兴奋剂检测覆盖奥运会所有奖牌选手，目前没有任何证据支持这一猜测。他说：”对这两天游泳比赛是否感觉可疑？我的回答是’没有’。就我个人而言，除了想鼓掌叫好外，我没有其他想法，除非接下来我又有新的发现。”中国代表团负责反兴奋剂工作的蒋志学也介绍，中国运动员已接受近１００例兴奋剂检测，游泳队更是受到特别”关照”，人数是各项目之首。
adc22ba75215daada9b43535dcbc7e672aeb327c.translatedText: Regrettably, there has been a little "noise" in the past two days of the London Olympics. Some foreign media questioned that the miraculous performance of Chinese swimmers "may be related to doping." Jonqvist, chairman of the International Olympic Committee's Medical Commission, said here on the 30th that doping testing covers all Olympic medalists and there is currently no evidence to support this speculation. He said: "Do you feel suspicious about these two days of swimming competition? My answer is 'no'. Personally, I have no other idea except applauding, unless I make new discoveries." Jiang Zhixue, who is responsible for anti-doping work of the Chinese delegation, also said that Chinese athletes have undergone nearly 100 doping tests, and the swimming team has received special "care", with the number of people ranking first among all events.

9f0d0b9de957870bfba23f787809245f9f308084.sourceText: 中国运动员在当天的球类比赛中总体顺利。中国女排以３：１战胜”黑马”土耳其队，中国女篮也以８３：５８战胜欧洲劲旅克罗地亚队，两支队伍取得两连胜后，基本锁定八强席位。此外，主攻双打的中国网球也取得明显效果， 在女单全部出局的情况下，郑洁／彭帅闯入赛事八强，第一次配对的李娜／张帅也晋级次轮。
9f0d0b9de957870bfba23f787809245f9f308084.translatedText: Chinese athletes generally had a smooth performance in the day's ball games. The Chinese women's volleyball team defeated the "dark horse" Turkish team 3:1, and the Chinese women's basketball team also defeated the European powerhouse Croatia 83:58. After the two teams won two consecutive games, they basically locked in the top eight. In addition, Chinese tennis, which focuses on doubles, has also achieved significant results. With all women's singles eliminated, Zheng Jie/Peng Shuai broke into the quarterfinals of the tournament, and Li Na/Zhang Shuai, who were paired for the first time, also advanced to the second round.

a38d21b43e821dfa62f885a22a91f019979176e8.sourceText: 中国男子举重在力保金牌的两个小级别都未能夺金，多少有点让人意外。在当天的男子举重６２公斤级比赛中，世界冠军张杰在抓举、挺举各３次试举中都只成功一次，以４年来的个人最低成绩排名第四。”他赛前减了６公斤体重不太好。”男队总教练陈文斌说，”我们回去要好好总结，比好接下来的比赛。”
a38d21b43e821dfa62f885a22a91f019979176e8.translatedText: It is somewhat surprising that the Chinese men's weightlifting failed to win gold in the two minor categories where they were trying to secure gold medals. In the men's 62kg weightlifting competition that day, world champion Zhang Jie only succeeded once in three attempts each in the snatch and clean and jerk, ranking fourth with his lowest personal score in four years. "It's not good that he lost 6 kilograms before the game." Chen Wenbin, head coach of the men's team, said, "We have to make a good summary when we go back to prepare for the next game."

7d7c08d0ff6d6a4e1656756cb59c44ad94b00d41.sourceText: 网民注意：12日起将严查盗版下载行为！
7d7c08d0ff6d6a4e1656756cb59c44ad94b00d41.translatedText: Attention netizens: Starting from the 12th, pirated downloads will be strictly investigated!

d754aa96051ed17bf226db054b3c53b87fb8f9b9.sourceText: 网民注意：12日起将严查盗版下载行为！ 喜欢下载美国剧集和电影的民众要提高警觉，各大网路服务供应商将从12…
d754aa96051ed17bf226db054b3c53b87fb8f9b9.translatedText: Attention netizens: Starting from the 12th, pirated downloads will be strictly investigated! People who like to download American dramas and movies should be alert. Major Internet service providers will be on guard from December 12...

33c65e66db2fde45158e304b91d26300b2387d85.sourceText: 喜欢下载美国剧集和电影的民众要提高警觉，各大网路服务供应商将从 12 日起，加强监控网路下载盗版行为，对非法下载用户提出警告，甚至下调网速直至暂停服务等惩罚措施。
33c65e66db2fde45158e304b91d26300b2387d85.translatedText: People who like to download American dramas and movies should be on alert. Starting from the 12th, major Internet service providers will strengthen monitoring of online download piracy, issue warnings to users who download illegally, and even reduce network speeds or even suspend services and other punitive measures.

987a11dac87b0edc30c20f6dcbcb7c693e3d0b9d.sourceText: 全美录影工业联合会 12 日起将联合各网路服务商共同反盗版行动。包括威瑞森（ Verizon ）、时代华纳（ Time Warner ）等。反盗版包括音乐、电影及软体等。根据联合会与营运商的协议，每家营运商要根据自己网路结构设立自动跟踪系统，并建立非法下载用户的数据库。
987a11dac87b0edc30c20f6dcbcb7c693e3d0b9d.translatedText: The National Video Industry Federation will join forces with various Internet service providers to jointly fight against piracy from the 12th. Including Verizon, Time Warner, etc. Anti-piracy includes music, movies, software, etc. According to the agreement between the federation and the operators, each operator must set up an automatic tracking system based on its own network structure and establish a database of illegal downloading users.

d2676daeb5d60dbbaf2ba079c094c35adeb60c56.sourceText: 被认定非法下载的用户，网路服务商首先会发一至两封警告信，警告用户非法下载行为已被发现，并要求其删除。如果用户继续下载，将收到一封确认信，确认用户确实收到前两次警告。如果用户依然我行我素，可能会遭降低网路速度，甚至暂停服务的处罚。
d2676daeb5d60dbbaf2ba079c094c35adeb60c56.translatedText: For users who are found to have downloaded illegally, the network service provider will first send one or two warning letters to warn the user that the illegal downloading behavior has been discovered and ask them to delete it. If the user continues with the download, they will receive a confirmation letter confirming that they indeed received the first two warnings. If users still go their own way, they may be punished by reducing network speed or even suspending service.

afe8dffe495bc91e5e54a54812e5699a3e08c802.sourceText: 目前华人中较流行的网路下载工具包括电驴、 BT 以及迅雷等。网路工程师李奥然表示，这些网路下载工具的特点是，下载同时也在上传，可能会招来双重惩罚，下载要小心。
afe8dffe495bc91e5e54a54812e5699a3e08c802.translatedText: Currently, the more popular online download tools among Chinese include eDonkey, BT and Thunder. Network engineer Li Aoran said that the characteristic of these online download tools is that they are downloading and uploading at the same time, which may incur double punishment, so be careful when downloading.

1818720e8ff55c45adbc3752018a6221d1432a48.sourceText: 对观看在线视频网站的电影，李敖然表示，如果是使用浏览器观看视频，比如 YouTube 、大陆的土豆网、优酷等网站，则完全没有问题，因为绝大多数视频都有版权，且观看时也没有下载行为产生。而对一些视频观看软体，诸如 PPS 、风行等，原理和 BT 一样，只是在后台下载，而且也不是完全下载。这种行为是否属非法下载目前不得而知，不过通常责任可能在软体供应商方面。
1818720e8ff55c45adbc3752018a6221d1432a48.translatedText: Regarding watching movies on online video websites, Li Aoran said that if you use a browser to watch videos, such as YouTube, mainland China's Tudou, Youku and other websites, there is no problem at all, because most videos have copyrights and there is no downloading behavior when watching. For some video viewing software, such as PPS, Fengxing, etc., the principle is the same as BT, but it only downloads in the background, and it is not a complete download. It is unknown whether this behavior is illegal downloading, but the responsibility may usually lie with the software provider.

dc016489a4756f65faa70f00aa1165af2caaabc5.sourceText: 华人区普遍使用的网路供应商 AT&T 是否也加入这一行动，目前还不确定，截至发稿，记者没有收到 AT&T 的回覆。
dc016489a4756f65faa70f00aa1165af2caaabc5.translatedText: Whether AT&T, the network provider commonly used in Chinese areas, will also join this action is still uncertain. As of press time, the reporter has not received a reply from AT&T.

092f248b5eb1293438d8642cc87312b90fc90eb9.sourceText: 线路故障 宝马召回57万辆汽车 （亚省时报） 由于电池线缆连接器可能出现故障并造成引擎熄火，宝马汽车公司（BMW）正在北美召回大约57万辆汽车，包括美国的50.4万辆和加拿大的6.5万辆。 美国国家公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）在16日于其网站上公布的文件中说，被召回车辆中的电池线缆连接器和车内一个保险丝盒终端，会随时间的推移发生老化，可能导致位于行李箱附近的电池和前端保险丝盒之间的电路连接中断。如果发生这种情况，车辆将失去电力，导致引擎意外熄火。 这次召回的车辆包括广受欢迎的2007年款至2011年款的3系列（3-Series）轿车、旅行车、敞篷车和双门轿跑车，也包括2008年款至2012年款（1系列）的双门跑车和敞篷车，以及2009年款至2011年款的Z4跑车。 宝马公司说，经销商将免费更换电池线缆连接器。他们将从3月开始通知车主。该公司了解到在加拿大这一故障导致了一起轻微碰撞，但没有人受伤。如果车主有问题，可拨打(800) 525-7417的电话向宝马公司询问。
092f248b5eb1293438d8642cc87312b90fc90eb9.translatedText: Line failure BMW recalls 570,000 vehicles (Alberta Times) BMW is recalling about 570,000 vehicles in North America, including 504,000 in the United States and 65,000 in Canada, because a battery cable connector could fail and cause the engine to stall. The U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said in a document posted on its website on the 16th that the battery cable connector and a fuse box terminal in the recalled vehicle will age over time, which may cause the circuit connection between the battery and the front-end fuse box located near the trunk to be interrupted. If this occurs, the vehicle will lose power, causing the engine to stall unexpectedly. The recall includes the popular 3-Series sedan, wagon, convertible and coupe from 2007 through 2011, as well as the 1 Series coupe and convertible from 2008 through 2012, and the Z4 coupe from 2009 through 2011. BMW said dealers will replace the battery cable connector for free. They will notify owners starting in March. The company is aware of a minor collision in Canada, but no one was injured. If you have questions, you can call BMW at (800) 525-7417.

bfe337b13429b3ae117304cb3195d7e33e582f17.sourceText: 凤城中区14岁女孩失而复得 上周五晚报称失踪的一名14岁女孩已经找到。 警员说，洛丽塔卡罗特只是贪玩未及时回家，在周六凌晨3点左右后被寻获。她的家人告诉警方，周五放学后女孩并未像往常一样3点左右到家，于是家人在凤城中心区女孩学校附近寻找，5小时后报警。警方出动至少60名探员到14街和Roeser一带搜查，甚至出动特种队和直升机。 事后警方解释这样大规模的搜查行动源于一个连环强奸犯在该区出现过。 周一，一名17岁的女生在步行到南山中学的路上被一名男子绑架至一空屋，殴打 并强暴她。这种案件在过去六个月内发生不只一次。 警方呼吁年轻女子，特别是学童，尽量减少在该区单独步行，上学放学应由家人接送，不要跟陌生人上车。
bfe337b13429b3ae117304cb3195d7e33e582f17.translatedText: 14-year-old girl found in Fengcheng Central District A 14-year-old girl reported missing last Friday evening has been found. Police said Lolita Carrot was just having fun and did not return home in time, and was found after about 3 a.m. on Saturday. Her family told the police that the girl did not arrive home at around 3 o'clock as usual after school on Friday, so the family searched near the girls' school in Fengcheng Central District and called the police five hours later.警方出动至少60名探员到14街和Roeser一带搜查，甚至出动特种队和直升机。 Later, the police explained that such a large-scale search operation was due to the appearance of a serial rapist in the area. On Monday, a 17-year-old girl was kidnapped by a man into an empty house while walking to Nanshan Middle School, where he beat and raped her. Such cases have occurred more than once in the past six months. The police appeal to young women, especially schoolchildren, to avoid walking alone in the area as much as possible. They should be picked up by family members when going to and from school, and not get into cars with strangers.

b82f19a14add0d838934033cb983395278a446ef.sourceText: 全球最佳大学出炉 中国占16席 英国国际高等教育及人力资源研究机构QS公司(Quacquarelli Symonds)今晨公布了2011年全球最佳大学排行榜(前300名)，中国共有16所大学上榜。 香港首次同时有6所大学打入前300强，其中香港大学再次力压东京大学，蝉联”亚洲第一”。中国内地有8所大学上榜，北京大学和清华大学分别位列46及47名。此外还有2所台湾大学上榜。 这项由国际知名教育咨询机构QS公司进行的全球高等学府排名调查，规模涵盖全球主要的大学，是申请就读大学学生的重要参考。 排名主要依据是学术表现、雇主评价、师生国际化程度、论文引用情况等六项指标。 QS公司指出，这项全球最佳大学排行榜调查，是通过对全球逾16000名雇主及32000名学术人员的访问得出的结果。 今年的排行榜中前十大被美国大学占了6席，英国则占了4席。数据显示，剑桥大学已经连续两年力压哈佛大学荣登榜首。 中国上榜的16所大学中，除北大和清华以及三所香港大学名列前50名、复旦大学名列第91名，内地的上海交通大学、南京大学、中国科技大学、浙江大学、北京师范大学，以及香港的城市大学、理工大学、浸会大学和台湾的清华大学、成大，排名均在百名之外。 全球前十名大学 排名大学 学费 1英国剑桥大学 约2.2万美元/年(约合人民币14万) 2美国哈佛大学 约3.8万美元/年(约合人民币24.2万) 3麻省理工学院 约4.2万美元/年(约合人民币26.8万) 4美国耶鲁大学 约3.4万美元/年(约合人民币21.7万) 5英国牛津大学 约2.2万美元/年(约合人民币14万) 6英国伦敦帝国学院 约3.4万美元/年(约合人民币21.7万) 7英国伦敦大学学院 约2.6万美元/年(约合人民币16.6万) 8美国芝加哥大学 约4.4万美元/年(约合人民币28万) 9美国宾夕法尼亚大学约2.8万美元/年(约合人民币17.8万) 10美国哥伦比亚大学 约4万美元/年(约合人民币25.5万) 名列前50名的亚洲大学 22香港大学 约1.6万美元/年(约合人民币10.2万) 25东京大学 约8000美元/年(约合人民币5.1万) 37香港中文大学 约1.4万美元/年(约合人民币8.9万) 40香港科技大学 约1万美元/年(约合人民币6.5万) 46北京大学 约5300元/年 47清华大学 约5000元/年 北京大学今年的排名较去年上升1位，而清华大学则上升了7位。 QS公司分析称，最近几年北京大学虽然仍然把重点放在基础科学上，但该大学的进步在于，也开始特别关注应用科学的发展，并将重大科学问题的研究与高水平专业人员的培训紧密结合起来。而清华大学也致力于基础科学和应用科学双研究。 QS公司相关负责人表示，今年亚洲地区大学的表现仍很强劲，激烈的竞争带动了亚洲地区高等教育的质量，加上当地政府也提供丰厚资源，都对大学教育的整体表现有很大帮助。
b82f19a14add0d838934033cb983395278a446ef.translatedText: The world's best universities are released. China accounts for 16 places. QS (Quacquarelli Symonds), a British international higher education and human resources research institution, announced this morning the 2011 world's best universities rankings (top 300). A total of 16 Chinese universities are on the list. For the first time, six universities in Hong Kong have entered the top 300 at the same time. Among them, the University of Hong Kong once again defeated the University of Tokyo and retained the title of "No. 1 in Asia". There are 8 universities in mainland China on the list, with Peking University and Tsinghua University ranking 46th and 47th respectively. In addition, two Taiwanese universities are on the list. This global higher education ranking survey, conducted by QS, an internationally renowned educational consulting organization, covers major universities around the world and is an important reference for students applying to study in universities. The ranking is mainly based on six indicators including academic performance, employer evaluation, internationalization of teachers and students, and citations of papers. QS pointed out that the survey of the world's best universities is based on interviews with more than 16,000 employers and 32,000 academic staff around the world. In this year's rankings, 6 of the top ten universities are occupied by American universities, and 4 are occupied by British universities. Data shows that Cambridge University has topped Harvard University for two consecutive years. Among the 16 Chinese universities on the list, in addition to Peking University, Tsinghua University and three Hong Kong universities, Fudan University ranked 91st, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Nanjing University, University of Science and Technology of China, Zhejiang University, Beijing Normal University in the Mainland, as well as Hong Kong's City University, Polytechnic University, Baptist University and Taiwan's Tsinghua University and National Cheng Kung University were all ranked outside the top 100. Top Ten Universities in the World Ranked Universities Tuition Fees 1 Cambridge University, UK, approximately US$ 22,000/year (approximately RMB 140,000) 2 Harvard University, US, approximately US$ 38,000/year (approximately RMB 242,000) 3 Massachusetts Institute of Technology, approximately US$ 42,000/year (approximately RMB 268,000) 4 Yale University, US, approximately US$ 34,000/year (approximately RMB 217,000) 5 Oxford University, UK About US$22,000/year (approximately RMB 140,000) 6 Imperial College London, UK About US$34,000/year (approximately RMB 217,000) 7 University College London, UK About US$26,000/year (approximately RMB 166,000) 8 University of Chicago, USA About US$44,000/year (approximately RMB 280,000) 9 University of Pennsylvania, USA About US$28,000/year (approximately RMB 178,000) 10 Columbia University, USA About US$40,000/year (approximately RMB 255,000) Among the top 50 Asian universities 22 University of Hong Kong About US$16,000/year (approximately RMB 102,000) 25 University of Tokyo About US$8,000/year (approximately RMB 51,000) 37 Chinese University of Hong Kong About US$14,000/year (approximately RMB 89,000) 40 Hong Kong University of Science and Technology About US$10,000/year (approximately RMB 65,000) 46 Peking University About 5,300 yuan/year 47 Tsinghua University About 5,000 yuan/year Peking University’s ranking this year has increased by 1 place compared with last year, while Tsinghua University has increased by 7 places. QS company analysis said that although Peking University still focuses on basic science in recent years, the university's progress is that it has also begun to pay special attention to the development of applied science and closely integrates the research of major scientific issues with the training of high-level professionals. Tsinghua University is also committed to dual research in basic science and applied science. The relevant person in charge of QS Company said that the performance of universities in Asia this year is still very strong. Fierce competition has driven the quality of higher education in Asia, and local governments also provide abundant resources, which are of great help to the overall performance of university education.

0e745049bbe5ac5f97af39f7598c194833890932.translatedText: This summer in the United States is the hottest in 75 years

b7ea50f47a080bf6bf926fa3eda013d8dc35dc46.sourceText: ７５年来美国今年夏天最热 （亚省时报） 美国今年夏天创下史上第二炎热的记录，是近７５年来最热的一年。路易斯…
b7ea50f47a080bf6bf926fa3eda013d8dc35dc46.translatedText: This summer in the United States is the hottest in 75 years (Alberta Times) This summer in the United States has been the second hottest in history, making it the hottest year in the past 75 years. Louis...

2e6e9a38959d25d4fd0a742c654e58911208c04e.sourceText: 美国今年夏天创下史上第二炎热的记录，是近７５年来最热的一年。路易斯安纳、新墨西哥、及德州均经历了前所未有的高温。 国家气象局统计，今年六月至八月间，至少有22人死于热浪。 亚利桑那、克罗拉多、路易斯安纳、新墨西哥、俄克拉荷马和德州等南方及西南方的地区，八月均温都创下历史新高。 新墨西哥州和俄克拉荷马州分别经历了他们第二和第三干燥的夏季，而新泽西州及加州则完全相反，是夏天最潮湿的一年。 全美最热最干的地区是德州，平均温度达华氏86.8度，平均雨量只有2.44英吋，比过去最少的雨量记录还低1英吋多。 达拉斯的居民甚至有连续40天处在气温超过华氏100度的热浪下。 俄克拉荷马州的平均温度达华氏86.5度，也创下了当地的高温新记录。 高温相对带来了能源需求，今年夏天的电力能源了比过去多22%，这是能源需求有记录的一百多年以来增加最多的一次。 气象学家们预测南方各州炎热少雨的情况还不会结束，美国海洋暨大气总署（NOAA）已宣布热带太平洋地区出现反圣婴现象，根据今年上半年的气候情况预测，德州、新墨西哥及俄 克拉荷马州的干旱还会持续下去。 德州因为干旱，在过去几天以来有180多处地方出现火灾，奥斯丁已有1,400间房屋被烧毁。
2e6e9a38959d25d4fd0a742c654e58911208c04e.translatedText: This summer in the United States set the second hottest record in history, making it the hottest year in the past 75 years. Louisiana, New Mexico, and Texas all experienced unprecedented high temperatures. According to the National Weather Service, at least 22 people died from heat waves between June and August this year. In the south and southwest, including Arizona, Colorado, Louisiana, New Mexico, Oklahoma, and Texas, average temperatures in August all hit record highs. New Mexico and Oklahoma experienced their second and third driest summers, respectively, while New Jersey and California were the complete opposite, having their wettest summers of the year. The hottest and driest region in the United States is Texas, with an average temperature of 86.8 degrees Fahrenheit and an average rainfall of only 2.44 inches, more than 1 inch lower than the lowest rainfall record in the past. Dallas residents even experienced 40 consecutive days of a heat wave with temperatures exceeding 100 degrees Fahrenheit. Oklahoma's average temperature reached 86.5 degrees Fahrenheit, setting a new local high temperature record. The high temperatures have brought about energy demand, and this summer's electricity consumption is 22% more than in the past. This is the largest increase in energy demand in more than 100 years of records. Meteorologists predict that the hot and dry conditions in southern states will not end. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) has announced the occurrence of an anti-El Niño phenomenon in the tropical Pacific. According to climate forecasts for the first half of this year, droughts in Texas, New Mexico and Oklahoma will continue. Due to drought in Texas, fires have broken out in more than 180 places in the past few days, and 1,400 homes have been burned in Austin.

57f307892bfb8e869f6beb192b0e795097b64f11.sourceText: 尤马市一名自来水公司技工梅森，日前在工作时被一棵几公尺高的大型仙人掌压倒在地，身体多处被刺伤，情况危及，所幸经手术治疗后，已逐渐复原。
57f307892bfb8e869f6beb192b0e795097b64f11.translatedText: Mason, a Yuma water company technician, was knocked to the ground by a large cactus several meters high while working. He was stabbed in many places on his body and was in critical condition. Fortunately, he has gradually recovered after surgical treatment.

aa868c27f518d7c312902ad5e594f16f3f2a861f.sourceText: 现年40岁的梅森6月19日与其他工作人员前往某地维修漏水管线，不料附近一棵16英尺高的巨柱仙人掌（Saguaro Cactus）倒下，将他压倒在地，导致他身体多处受伤。梅森随后被送往尤马地区医学中心，并于21日接受手术治疗。 梅森的岳母阿西里表示，倒下的仙人掌弄伤了梅森的背部、腿部和手臂。他还有内伤和发烧。到21日晚间为止，医生已经从他身上拔出146根刺，有一些刺还留在身上。
aa868c27f518d7c312902ad5e594f16f3f2a861f.translatedText: On June 19, 40-year-old Mason and other workers went to a certain location to repair a leaking pipeline. Unexpectedly, a nearby 16-foot-tall Saguaro Cactus fell and crushed him to the ground, causing multiple injuries to his body. Mason was subsequently sent to Yuma Regional Medical Center and underwent surgery on the 21st. Mason's mother-in-law, Asiri, said the fallen cactus injured Mason's back, legs and arms. He also had internal injuries and a fever. As of the evening of the 21st, doctors had pulled out 146 thorns from his body, and some thorns were still left on his body.

82057b5d15922675b1dbf35c395c48d1b9590539.sourceText: 在手术结束后隔天（22日），梅森的妻子说，手术进行顺利，脊髓外科医生认为他没有伤到神经，应该会完全复原。她同时感谢亲友与同事们的协助，也感谢他们为梅森祈祷。
82057b5d15922675b1dbf35c395c48d1b9590539.translatedText: The day after the operation (22nd), Mason's wife said that the operation went smoothly and the spinal surgeon believed that he had not damaged his nerves and should make a full recovery. She also thanked her relatives, friends and colleagues for their assistance and for their prayers for Mason.

e9b0ea6ea939277593f6a67cfe88974cfddf699e.sourceText: 梅森一家人几个月前从阿肯色州搬到尤​​马市，梅森太太目前在YRMC工作。尤马市政府表示，仙人掌倒下造成梅森受伤的原因仍在调查中。市政府员工仍与梅森家保持联系，以表达关怀之意并提供必要的协助。巨柱仙人掌是美国最大的仙人掌，重量介于3,200磅至4,800磅之间。它们的根部仅有4英寸至6英寸深，而且主要靠较大的单一主根固定。
e9b0ea6ea939277593f6a67cfe88974cfddf699e.translatedText: The Mason family moved to Yuma from Arkansas a few months ago, and Mrs. Mason currently works at YRMC. The city of Yuma said the cause of Mason's injuries when the cactus fell remains under investigation. City employees remain in contact with the Mason family to express concern and provide necessary assistance. Saguaro saguaro is the largest cactus in the United States, weighing between 3,200 and 4,800 pounds. Their roots are only 4 to 6 inches deep and are anchored primarily by a single, larger taproot.

0a2a02730267cacdc057f950244184682951a051.translatedText: Wang Lijun was sentenced to 15 years in prison in the first trial

e0db2a87c89dc1898af59aedc5cf042607d1b8fb.sourceText: 王立军一审获刑15年 北京棗官方媒体新华社周一报道，中国法官今日宣判，原重庆市公安局局长王立军被指控的四项…
e0db2a87c89dc1898af59aedc5cf042607d1b8fb.translatedText: Wang Lijun was sentenced to 15 years in prison in the first trial Beijing Zao official media Xinhua News Agency reported on Monday that a Chinese judge today sentenced Wang Lijun, the former director of the Chongqing Municipal Public Security Bureau, to be guilty of all four charges...

608c2670616578a4c714d82584a82e7ed86d31c1.sourceText: 北京棗官方媒体新华社周一报道，中国法官今日宣判，原重庆市公安局局长王立军被指控的四项罪名均成立。今年2月，王立军逃到美国领事馆，并向美国外交官透露，中国一位高层政界人士的妻子谋杀了一名英国商人。
608c2670616578a4c714d82584a82e7ed86d31c1.translatedText: Beijing Zao official media Xinhua News Agency reported on Monday that a Chinese judge pronounced today that Wang Lijun, the former director of the Chongqing Municipal Public Security Bureau, was guilty of all four charges. In February this year, Wang Lijun fled to the U.S. consulate and revealed to U.S. diplomats that the wife of a top Chinese politician had murdered a British businessman.

88eb76f76b08fe3d70997df6a672a6a40e3d0ca9.sourceText: 52岁的王立军来自内蒙古，被判犯有叛逃、滥用职权、受贿及徇私枉法四项罪行。审判于上周在中国西南部省会城市成都进行，该市中级人民法院判处王立军有期徒刑15年，算是一个相对宽大的判决。中国刑事案件的判决经常都是预先决定的，涉及政治的判决更是如此。[据中国中央电视台，成都市中级人民法院以徇私枉法罪判处王立军7年有期徒刑，以叛逃罪判处有期徒刑2年，剥夺政治权利1年，以滥用职权罪判处有期徒刑2年，以受贿罪判处有期徒刑9年。数罪并罚决定执行有期徒刑15年，剥夺政治权利1年。王立军当庭表示不上诉。]
88eb76f76b08fe3d70997df6a672a6a40e3d0ca9.translatedText: Wang Lijun, 52, from Inner Mongolia, was found guilty of four crimes: defection, abuse of power, accepting bribes and bending the law for personal gain. The trial took place last week in Chengdu, the capital city of southwestern China, where the Intermediate People's Court sentenced Wang Lijun to 15 years in prison, a relatively lenient sentence. Judgments in Chinese criminal cases are often predetermined, especially those involving politics. [According to China Central Television, the Chengdu Intermediate People's Court sentenced Wang Lijun to seven years in prison for bending the law for personal gain, two years in prison for defection, deprivation of political rights for one year, two years in prison for abuse of power, and nine years in prison for accepting bribes. He was sentenced to 15 years in prison and deprived of political rights for one year. Wang Lijun expressed in court that he would not appeal. ]

ef7764301ddefff9564d9dda832fd6cb2e892917.sourceText: 王立军的妹妹王凤英得知判决后表示：”我感觉很绝望，这是一个无法接受但必须接受的现实。这个国家就是这样。” 王凤英未获准进入法庭旁听宣判。王凤英还说，王立军辩护律师王蕴采认为，判决比她想象的严重。
ef7764301ddefff9564d9dda832fd6cb2e892917.translatedText: Wang Lijun's sister Wang Fengying said after learning of the verdict: "I feel very desperate. This is an unacceptable but must-accept reality. This is the way this country is." Wang Fengying was not allowed to enter the court to observe the sentencing. Wang Fengying also said that Wang Lijun's defense lawyer Wang Yuncai believed that the sentence was more serious than she imagined.

7323a62e17c05c17322700e041ded0a6d043344c.sourceText: 王立军在美国驻成都领事馆逗留了将近36个小时，此举引发了中国近十年来最大的一桩政治丑闻。他向美国外交人员透露，中共领导人薄熙来的妻子在去年11月毒杀了英国人尼尔 海伍德(Neil Heywood)。第二天，王立军在国家安全局官员的押送之下离开了领事馆，据估计也将海伍德被害一事报告给了调查人员。3月，薄熙来被免去西南重镇重庆市市委书记一职，王立军曾任该市公安局局长，一个月后，薄熙来又被停止了中央政治局委员的职务。
7323a62e17c05c17322700e041ded0a6d043344c.translatedText: Wang Lijun stayed at the U.S. Consulate in Chengdu for nearly 36 hours, triggering China's biggest political scandal in the past decade. He revealed to U.S. diplomats that the wife of Chinese Communist Party leader Bo Xilai poisoned British Neil Heywood in November last year. The next day, Wang Lijun left the consulate under the escort of National Security Bureau officials and presumably reported Heywood's murder to investigators. In March, Bo Xilai was dismissed from his post as party secretary of Chongqing, a major southwestern town where Wang Lijun had served as director of the city's public security bureau. A month later, Bo Xilai was suspended from his position as a member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee.

e5ada0f314fbe920a7affbdb6581c3fcec2de7ce.sourceText: 上个月，谷开来因故意杀人罪被判处死刑，缓期两年执行，这意味着她可能受到长期监禁，但不会被处死。王立军一案审理结束后，薄熙来就成了唯一的一个尚未受到审判的丑闻主角。共产党计划于今年秋天进行10年一度的领导层换届，在此之前是否会有关于薄熙来命运的公开声明或者泄露消息，社会上存在大量猜测。
e5ada0f314fbe920a7affbdb6581c3fcec2de7ce.translatedText: Last month, Gu Kailai was sentenced to death with a two-year suspended sentence for intentional homicide, which means she may be jailed for a long time but will not be executed. After the trial of Wang Lijun's case ended, Bo Xilai became the only protagonist of the scandal who has not yet been tried. The Communist Party plans to hold its 10-year leadership change this fall, and there is a lot of speculation as to whether there will be any public statement or leaks about Bo Xilai's fate before then.

aba3d0cd28ab5639c0cf180be1b92a883b13374b.sourceText: 薄熙来正在因官方媒体所称的”严重违纪行为”接受调查，人们也在猜测，他面临的将会是犯罪指控还是党内处分。上周三，官方媒体新华通讯社发布了关于王立军审判的官方记录，其中的证言称，薄熙来在1月29号扇了王立军耳光，此前一天，王立军曾向薄熙来反映，他怀疑谷开来与海伍德被杀一事有关。官方公开宣布此事的举动说明，共产党可能决定以试图掩盖谋杀的刑事罪名对薄熙来进行审判。（新华社发布这一报告以前，美国官员已经表示，王立军曾告诉美国在成都的外交人员，薄熙来打过他。）
aba3d0cd28ab5639c0cf180be1b92a883b13374b.translatedText: Bo Xilai is under investigation for what state media calls "serious disciplinary violations," and people are also speculating whether he will face criminal charges or intra-party discipline. Last Wednesday, the state-run Xinhua News Agency released the official transcript of Wang Lijun's trial, which included testimony that Bo Xilai slapped Wang Lijun on January 29, a day after Wang Lijun reported to Bo that he suspected Gu Kailai was involved in Heywood's murder. The official public announcement suggests the Communist Party may decide to try Bo Xilai on criminal charges of trying to cover up the murder. (Before Xinhua News Agency released this report, U.S. officials had stated that Wang Lijun had told U.S. diplomats in Chengdu that Bo Xilai had hit him.)

8f71827e0ec3430332dd8b0c1a6402bce4cd5ec4.sourceText: 新华社的报道并未指名道姓地说扇王立军耳光的人就是薄熙来，但是，报道中使用的描述语句已经明确显示了打人者的身份。
8f71827e0ec3430332dd8b0c1a6402bce4cd5ec4.translatedText: The Xinhua News Agency report did not name the person who slapped Wang Lijun as Bo Xilai, but the description used in the report clearly showed the identity of the person who hit him.

ada220ecc67a137e1437e5c7039adee50c98ff53.sourceText: 官方的庭审记录还强调了控辩双方律师的发言内容，表明王立军可能会得到宽大处理。记录称，王立军配合官方调查了他人的违法行为。这明显是指谷开来一案，或许也暗示了王立军曾协助官方调查薄熙来。
ada220ecc67a137e1437e5c7039adee50c98ff53.translatedText: The official trial record also highlighted the content of speeches made by lawyers for both the prosecution and defense, indicating that Wang Lijun may receive leniency. Records say Wang Lijun cooperated with officials in investigating the illegal conduct of others. This obviously refers to the Gu Kailai case, and may also imply that Wang Lijun assisted the official investigation of Bo Xilai.

75380b449f7896f277cddd3f783f858362568e9a.sourceText: 法庭官员也指出了王立军在海伍德被杀案中扮演的角色。检方指控， 在谷开来把自己杀害海伍德的事情告诉王立军之后，王立军包庇了谷开来，同时正式指控王立军徇私枉法。法庭官员还称，在谋杀发生的前一天，王立军和谷开来讨论了海伍德一事，并同意对这名英国人进行监视。
75380b449f7896f277cddd3f783f858362568e9a.translatedText: Court officials also pointed to Wang Lijun's role in Heywood's murder. Prosecutors alleged that after Gu Kailai told Wang Lijun about her murder of Heywood, Wang Lijun protected Gu Kailai and formally accused Wang Lijun of bending the law for personal gain. Court officials also said Wang Lijun and Gu Kailai discussed Heywood the day before the murder and agreed to monitor the Briton.

5165b03dbe617f58a8c14809949c610091eeaede.sourceText: 在谷开来一案庭审中，法庭官员表示，谷开来谋杀海伍德，是因为她认为海伍德对其子薄瓜瓜构成了威胁，后者于今年夏天从哈佛大学硕士毕业。
5165b03dbe617f58a8c14809949c610091eeaede.translatedText: During Gu Kailai's trial, court officials said Gu Kailai murdered Heywood because she believed Heywood posed a threat to her son Bo Guagua, who graduated from Harvard University with a master's degree this summer.

6ad78db3ba662b0d5e686ea0fc179a130a01a747.sourceText: 王立军的庭审记录中有一段奇怪的描述，称某个晚上薄瓜瓜试图开车到重庆市外的一个城市和王立军见面，还差点出了车祸。记录中提到了这件事，意在表明，在谷开来杀害海伍德后的数星期内，她和王立军的矛盾不断加剧。
6ad78db3ba662b0d5e686ea0fc179a130a01a747.translatedText: There is a strange description in Wang Lijun's court trial record, saying that one night Bo Guagua tried to drive to a city outside Chongqing to meet Wang Lijun and almost got into a car accident. The incident was mentioned in the records to show that the conflict between Gu Kailai and Wang Lijun escalated in the weeks after she killed Heywood.

65e15d58e137fbfb64e506ab39c52fc72993b668.sourceText: 法庭记录称，薄熙来1月29号扇了王立军的耳光之后，王立军就命令他的公安亲信去收集谷开来涉嫌谋杀的证据。王立军让几名警官分别保管不同的证据，其中包括海伍德心脏血液的一份样本，以及谷开来向王立军讲述谋杀一事时他做的秘密录音。记录称，被当局带到北京后，王立军就让他的公安亲信李阳把血液样本交给调查人员。
65e15d58e137fbfb64e506ab39c52fc72993b668.translatedText: Court records stated that after Bo Xilai slapped Wang Lijun on January 29, Wang Lijun ordered his public security cronies to collect evidence of Gu Kailai's alleged murder. Wang Lijun asked several police officers to keep separate pieces of evidence, including a sample of Heywood's heart blood and a secret recording of Gu Kailai telling Wang Lijun about the murder. After being taken to Beijing by authorities, Wang Lijun asked his police confidant Li Yang to hand over blood samples to investigators, records said.

c08fca91a06240506817553391c1afc4fa3f1fc4.sourceText: 王立军的律师王蕴采（与王立军无亲属关系）表示，新华社刊发的庭审记录基本准确。但是，检方还指控王立军收受了和薄家关系密切的大商人徐明和前军事情报官员于俊世的贿赂，她对此提出了反对。
c08fca91a06240506817553391c1afc4fa3f1fc4.translatedText: Wang Lijun’s lawyer Wang Yuncai (no relation to Wang Lijun) said that the trial records published by Xinhua News Agency are basically accurate. But she objected to prosecutors also accusing Wang of accepting bribes from Xu Ming, a businessman with close ties to the Bo family, and Yu Junshi, a former military intelligence officer.

6524fbf3b7ad9d8cc7cee51d61e88b8e6b56b5c3.sourceText: 黄安伟 (Edward Wong)是《纽约时报》驻京记者。 Patrick Zuo自北京对本文有研究贡献。
6524fbf3b7ad9d8cc7cee51d61e88b8e6b56b5c3.translatedText: >Edward Wong is a Beijing correspondent for The New York Times. Patrick Zuo contributed research to this article from Beijing.

23c4d7f344bfc7bea8b8c8284f1bfc6e41133b94.sourceText: 政府关门闹剧无赢家 国会支持率落入10%谷底
23c4d7f344bfc7bea8b8c8284f1bfc6e41133b94.translatedText: There are no winners in the government shutdown farce, and the approval rate of Congress has dropped to the bottom of 10%

7c7008008910a838409f3e78fd4d3b89126147e5.sourceText: 政府关门闹剧无赢家 国会支持率落入10%谷底 就在国会两党为医改法问题而在预算上僵局难破并导致政府部分关门…
7c7008008910a838409f3e78fd4d3b89126147e5.translatedText: There are no winners in the government shutdown farce, and the approval rate of Congress has dropped to the bottom of 10% Just when the two parties in Congress are struggling to break the budget impasse over the health care reform law, leading to a partial government shutdown...

93b4c30146ca43c867e338c399832b6622366fdb.sourceText: 就在国会两党为医改法问题而在预算上僵局难破并导致政府部分关门之时，最新民调显示国会支持率陷入10%的谷底。
93b4c30146ca43c867e338c399832b6622366fdb.translatedText: Just as the two parties in Congress are struggling to break through the budget impasse over the health care reform law, leading to a partial government shutdown, the latest poll shows that congressional support has hit a trough of 10%.

f7b1837ebf058747c44560753024cd985a03ffba.sourceText: 据有线电视广播公司/ORC 国际（CNN/ORC International）星期一公布的的民调结果，不仅是国会及其领导人因为错误而在历史上留名，也让茶党、共和党和民主党全都长期背上不光彩的名声。
f7b1837ebf058747c44560753024cd985a03ffba.translatedText: According to the results of a CNN/ORC International poll released on Monday, not only did Congress and its leaders go down in history for their mistakes, but it also gave the Tea Party, Republicans and Democrats all a long-term and disgraceful reputation.

f83d87fabbb29a34d2b3297e3469098898bacdd7.sourceText: 根据民调结果，只有10%的美国人说他们赞成国会的做法，这为CNN民调的最低支持率。表示不赞成国会议员做法的民众高达87%，这一比例超过CNN历次民调。
f83d87fabbb29a34d2b3297e3469098898bacdd7.translatedText: According to the poll results, only 10% of Americans said they approved of Congress' actions, which was the lowest approval rate in the CNN poll. As many as 87% of people said they disapproved of the actions of members of Congress, which exceeded all previous CNN polls.

f65e8f018675af3b4cc9b058d5eb05a570d56924.sourceText: CNN周五到周日进行的最新民调结果显示，国会支持率比上月初的民调结果狂跌10个百分点。而87%的不赞成比例也比9月初的民调结果上升9个百分点。
f65e8f018675af3b4cc9b058d5eb05a570d56924.translatedText: CNN's latest poll results from Friday to Sunday showed that Congress' support rate plummeted by 10 percentage points from the poll results at the beginning of last month. The 87% disapproval rate also increased by 9 percentage points from the poll results in early September.

80bcebc16e36d14ecc6d7354e7b20f20164ba85d.sourceText: 尽管美国人对国会的支持率大跌，但总统奥巴马的支持率虽然不到50%，仍同月初的民调结果基本一致。
80bcebc16e36d14ecc6d7354e7b20f20164ba85d.translatedText: Although Americans' support for Congress has plummeted, President Obama's approval rating, although less than 50%, is still basically the same as the poll results at the beginning of the month.

061c2384c302c436f03838e1f5188e625bb3035f.sourceText: 接受民调的美国人当中，44%赞成奥巴马的做法，53%不赞成。而CNN月初的民调结果为45%的人赞成，52%不赞成，基本相同。
061c2384c302c436f03838e1f5188e625bb3035f.translatedText: Among Americans polled, 44% approved of Obama's approach and 53% disapproved. The CNN poll at the beginning of the month showed that 45% of people approved and 52% disapproved, which is basically the same.

82e21082372138a8bbbd9e8f99c5daeb1598d03e.sourceText: 尽管民主党的支持仍然高于共和党，但CNN民调显示，它的支持率自今年春季以来已经大幅下降。
82e21082372138a8bbbd9e8f99c5daeb1598d03e.translatedText: Although support among Democrats remains higher than among Republicans, CNN polls show that its support has dropped significantly since the spring.

c35c3a56c5938c3c997ccc0daa2b80fa3a080d2f.sourceText: 根据民调，43%的民众支持民主党，但52%的人不支持。而在今年5月的CNN民调中，两项比例相反。
c35c3a56c5938c3c997ccc0daa2b80fa3a080d2f.translatedText: According to polls, 43% of the people support the Democratic Party, but 52% do not support it. In a CNN poll in May this year, the two ratios were opposite.

d9666c90f01f28d649052debdf0fb0877f086737.sourceText: 在民主党的支持率下降9个百分点的时候，共和党的支持率也从35%下降到32%，而不支持共和党的民众超过60%。
d9666c90f01f28d649052debdf0fb0877f086737.translatedText: When the Democratic Party's support rate dropped by 9 percentage points, the Republican support rate also dropped from 35% to 32%, and more than 60% of the people did not support the Republican Party.

c886dae66ebc5a61c4292ce22ee13c2e97418f59.sourceText: 另据《纽约时报》报道，由于众议院、参议院和白宫星期一未能打破预算僵局，政府将近20年来的首次关门从星期二凌晨开始。大约80万名联邦雇员今天起将被迫放假，超过100万雇员将无薪上班。
c886dae66ebc5a61c4292ce22ee13c2e97418f59.translatedText: According to the New York Times, the first government shutdown in nearly 20 years began in the early hours of Tuesday morning as the House of Representatives, Senate and the White House failed to break the budget impasse on Monday. About 800,000 federal employees will be furloughed starting today, and more than 1 million employees will go to work without pay.

7ab2a1a9b5fca5530de8bc80cd2a95e410e7bffa.sourceText: 由于国会参众两院星期一经过一天的相互”踢球”没有达成任何协议，昨晚将近午夜管理和预算办公室发布命令，因为国会没有拨款，各机构要实施有秩序的关门计划。
7ab2a1a9b5fca5530de8bc80cd2a95e410e7bffa.translatedText: As the House and Senate failed to reach any agreement after a day of "kickball" with each other on Monday, the Office of Management and Budget issued an order at nearly midnight last night that agencies must implement an orderly shutdown plan because Congress has not appropriated funds.

162885f49e48837bbebc8ef6542b5cfb8d7475e2.sourceText: 元旦起，亚利桑那州与其他九个州上调最低工资标准，本州今年上涨 15 美分，最低工资提高到 $7.80/ 小时。
162885f49e48837bbebc8ef6542b5cfb8d7475e2.translatedText: Arizona joins nine other states in raising their minimum wage starting on New Year's Day, with our state increasing its minimum wage by 15 cents this year to $7.80 an hour.

f0c4e8d349c3be548110e0f74675f2a033d4b1a9.sourceText: 根据劳工统计局资料， 2011 年至 2012 年，本州生活成本指数增加了 1.7% 。
f0c4e8d349c3be548110e0f74675f2a033d4b1a9.translatedText: According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, the state's cost of living index increased 1.7% from 2011 to 2012.

679dd59968eea3d2c6208f3e8c5c15f738a6fee3.sourceText: 此外，科罗拉多州、佛罗里达州、密苏里州、蒙大拿州、俄亥俄州、俄勒冈州、罗德岛州、佛蒙特州和华盛顿州也在新年上调最低工资，其中罗德岛上涨最多，增加了 35 美分，上调后 时薪 最低 7.75 美元 。
679dd59968eea3d2c6208f3e8c5c15f738a6fee3.translatedText: In addition, Colorado, Florida, Missouri, Montana, Ohio, Oregon, Rhode Island, Vermont and Washington state also raised their minimum wages in the New Year, with Rhode Island increasing the most by 35 cents, bringing the minimum hourly wage to $7.75.

b8c9b3d3f592757470b637b7412f50c8787054af.sourceText: 联邦 2012 年 最低时薪标准为 7.25 美元，但实际上各州有自己的标准。以州为单位，全美最低工资在阿肯色州，时薪标准为 6.25 美元，华盛顿州最高， 2012 年时薪 9.04 美元，今年再调，成 9.19 美元 。以城市为单位，旧金山时薪最高， 2013 年最低时薪为 10.55 美元。
b8c9b3d3f592757470b637b7412f50c8787054af.translatedText: The federal 2012 minimum wage is $7.25 an hour, but each state has its own standard. On a state basis, the national minimum wage is in Arkansas, which is $6.25 an hour, and Washington state, which has the highest hourly wage of $9.04 in 2012. This year it was adjusted to $9.19. San Francisco has the highest hourly wages on a city-by-city basis, with a minimum wage of $10.55 an hour in 2013.

7af7911fda611ccde6800d31ed7cdd47ba01419d.translatedText: Air bag defect Hyundai Motor recalls more than 220,000 vehicles Due to potential problems with air bags, Hyundai Motor will recall more than 220,000 2007-200...

1639d0b741abec6b00def476ab7a96c01b98353f.sourceText: 安全气囊缺陷 现代汽车召回逾22万辆车 因为安全气囊的潜在问题，现代汽车将召回超过22万2007-2009年圣达菲（Santa Fe）SUV和索纳塔（Sonata）轿车。 由于车辆中的乘客分类系统问题，这些车辆的前排乘客安全气囊在撞车时可能不能启动，因为安全气囊是根据乘员的大小来决定是否应该启动。 联邦安全机构说，系统可能需要重新校准，检测到”身材较小的成年人。” 政府当局表示，现代公司也在召回逾22,000辆2012-2013年型的轿车。这些车的帘式侧面安全气囊，因为一个生产过程的错误可能会自动膨胀。 NHTSA表示，现代汽车经销商预计会通知车主，可以免费更换帘式侧面安全气囊。经销商也将免费更新越野车里的分类软件。
1639d0b741abec6b00def476ab7a96c01b98353f.translatedText: Air bag defect Hyundai Motor recalls more than 220,000 vehicles Hyundai is recalling more than 220,000 2007-2009 Santa Fe SUVs and Sonata sedans because of potential air bag problems. Due to an issue with the passenger classification system in the vehicle, the front passenger airbag in these vehicles may not activate in a crash, as the airbag determines whether it should activate based on the size of the occupant. The federal safety agency said the system may need to be recalibrated to detect "smaller adults." Hyundai Motor Co. is also recalling more than 22,000 sedans from the 2012-2013 model years, authorities said. The curtain side airbags in these cars may have automatically inflated due to a manufacturing error. NHTSA said Hyundai dealers are expected to notify owners that curtain side air bags can be replaced free of charge. Dealers will also update the classified software on the off-road vehicles for free.

1d2358cfc2ffcd3144b173387652e1e7878a6ce8.translatedText: Wildfires are raging in 11 states and thousands of people have been evacuated (pictures) According to CBS reports, due to high temperatures and dry weather, as of the evening of the 19th local time, the United States...

dc00c142f0b5cbd69d02c7dc4e17e82213ee8360.sourceText: 据CBS报道，由于气温高、天气干燥，截至当地时间19日晚，美国西部11个州都有山林大火在燃烧，共有49个大型火点，大风天气增加了灭火的难度。
dc00c142f0b5cbd69d02c7dc4e17e82213ee8360.translatedText: According to CBS reports, due to high temperatures and dry weather, as of the evening of the 19th local time, forest fires were burning in 11 states in the western United States, with a total of 49 large fire points. Windy weather increased the difficulty of putting out fires.

07622b4530ac6023b427066d396914d49718bfe7.sourceText: 在犹他州，雷电引发的山火已持续燃烧了近一个星期，目前仍在大量冒烟，几乎让相邻的爱达荷州看不到日出，数千人被迫疏散。
07622b4530ac6023b427066d396914d49718bfe7.translatedText: In Utah, wildfires triggered by lightning have been burning for nearly a week and are still smoking so much that the sunrise is almost invisible in neighboring Idaho, forcing thousands of people to evacuate.

ba613db6d09bea10f589004ce8eeb95319981580.sourceText: 19日，风速达到每小时30英里，促使大火逼近爱达荷州的凯奇姆(Ketchum)市。火势扩张速度迅猛，当地居民被告知随时做好疏散的准备。
ba613db6d09bea10f589004ce8eeb95319981580.translatedText: On the 19th, wind speeds reached 30 miles per hour, prompting the fire to approach the city of Ketchum, Idaho. The fire spread rapidly and local residents were told to be ready to evacuate at any time.

616dd2f5ea0a770bb3de3ca584ce66da93a2c314.sourceText: 在爱达荷州，过火面积已达10万多英亩。1800多栋住宅被疏散，其中很多住宅为度假屋。
616dd2f5ea0a770bb3de3ca584ce66da93a2c314.translatedText: In Idaho, more than 100,000 acres have been burned. More than 1,800 homes were evacuated, many of them vacation homes.

c128c4bd30af2fed5dc6428e00e5346975d75b3c.sourceText: 消防人员正在保护数百栋住宅。截至目前，仅有1栋住宅遭到焚烧，但其他房屋被烧的威胁还未解除。
c128c4bd30af2fed5dc6428e00e5346975d75b3c.translatedText: Firefighters are protecting hundreds of homes. So far, only one house has been burned, but the threat of other houses being burned has not been eliminated.

1555766346bca92332bbbd0f67b21c4afcd4af51.sourceText: 一些被迫疏散的民众已经于19日被允许回家，但是目前仅有8%的火势受到了控制。星期二(20日)的天气预报说有雷雨。这意味着雷电天气与风向不定的大风，使得火势更加难以控制。
1555766346bca92332bbbd0f67b21c4afcd4af51.translatedText: Some people who were forced to evacuate were allowed to go home on the 19th, but only 8% of the fires are currently under control. The weather forecast for Tuesday (20th) calls for thunderstorms. This means that thunder and lightning and strong winds make it more difficult to control the fire.

f497cf4b220d77a334fcea2452dfc8615f7b344b.translatedText: Rabbit ears design has hidden dangers. 260,000 Chinese-made children's water bottles have been recalled. The U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission announced on the 26th that it will recall 264,000 Chinese-made household...

2c338872fafe99e2bbbb43ae31e2ea19a34424de.sourceText: 美国消费品安全委员会表示，消费者应当马上停止使用这些水杯并联系经销商，以免遭受更多损失。
2c338872fafe99e2bbbb43ae31e2ea19a34424de.translatedText: The U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission said that consumers should stop using these water cups immediately and contact dealers to avoid further losses.

0b0d8479bb09770351d6f8a26c47cf3ca5441140.sourceText: 沈阳故宫展出99件台湾民间藏品 由沈阳故宫与台湾海峡两岸古文物研究发展协会共同举办的《海峡两岸古文物研究发展协会收藏特展》，日前开始在沈阳故宫举行，这是沈阳故宫第二次大规模展出民间收藏家的收藏珍品。 据介绍，《海峡两岸古文物研究发展协会收藏特展》在沈阳故宫飞龙阁、翔凤阁展出，展出时间为２０１１年６月２日至７月１５日。９９件艺术珍品精选了欧阳健中、陈冠伟、吕秀桂等８位台湾知名民间收藏家的精选藏品，展品以瓷器为主，还有部分珍贵的印章、玉器及鼻烟壶。 展出的瓷器多是以元、明、清时期的造型及施釉方式制作而成，它们造型别致、纹饰细腻，浑然天成，具有较高的收藏价值。 在沈阳故宫展厅的中心位置摆放的红色纹饰瓷罐吸引了许多参观者的目光。此器名为”釉里红鬼谷子下山带盖罐”，以铜红料绘纹饰，盖顶饰叶柄状钮，器皿上鬼谷子乘坐于虎豹拉的两轮车上，其旁配有卷草、莲瓣、牡丹等纹饰，其饱满的画面和分明的线条，构成了一幅优美的人物画卷。 主办方之一、海峡两岸古文物研究发展协会理事长欧阳健中表示，希望能够通过此次展览促进两岸文博界的交流，让大陆同胞进一步了解台湾民间收藏家的实力。 海峡两岸古文物研究发展协会是台湾一个长期致力于两岸文化交流的民间组织，热衷于中华民族优秀文化的传承，并收藏了大量精美艺术品。
0b0d8479bb09770351d6f8a26c47cf3ca5441140.translatedText: Shenyang National Palace Museum displays 99 pieces of Taiwanese folk collections. The "Cross-Strait Ancient Cultural Relics Research and Development Association Collection Special Exhibition" co-organized by the Shenyang National Palace Museum and the Taiwan Cross-Strait Ancient Cultural Relics Research and Development Association has recently begun to be held in the Shenyang National Palace Museum. This is the second large-scale exhibition of treasures collected by private collectors in the Shenyang National Palace Museum. According to reports, the "Special Exhibition of the Cross-Strait Ancient Cultural Relics Research and Development Association Collection" will be on display at the Feilong Pavilion and Xiangfeng Pavilion of the Forbidden City in Shenyang from June 2 to July 15, 2011. The 99 art treasures are selected from the collections of eight well-known Taiwanese private collectors, including Ouyang Jianzhong, Chen Guanwei, and Lu Xiugui. The exhibits are mainly porcelain, as well as some precious seals, jades, and snuff bottles. Most of the porcelains on display are made with shapes and glazing methods from the Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties. They have unique shapes, delicate patterns and are natural, making them highly valuable for collection. The red decorated porcelain jar placed in the center of the Shenyang Forbidden City exhibition hall attracted the attention of many visitors. This vessel is called "Glaze Red Guiguzi Down Mountain Jar with Lid". It is decorated with copper red material and has a petiole-shaped button on the top of the lid. On the vessel, Guiguzi rides on a two-wheeled cart pulled by a tiger and leopard. It is decorated with curly grass, lotus petals, peonies and other patterns. Its full picture and clear lines form a beautiful picture of characters. One of the organizers, Ouyang Jianzhong, chairman of the Cross-Strait Ancient Cultural Relics Research and Development Association, said he hopes that this exhibition can promote exchanges between the cultural and museum circles on both sides of the Taiwan Strait and allow mainland compatriots to further understand the strength of Taiwanese private collectors. The Cross-Strait Ancient Cultural Relics Research and Development Association is a non-governmental organization in Taiwan that has long been committed to cross-Strait cultural exchanges. It is keen on the inheritance of the excellent culture of the Chinese nation and has collected a large number of exquisite works of art.

d9567c254e381859118400568353277517d45aae.sourceText: 香港特区自5月1日起开始实施法定最低工资，最低工资水平定为每小时28港元。香港最大的工会团体香港工会联合会表示，香港实行最低工资后，将有31万基层雇员获得实质性加薪。
d9567c254e381859118400568353277517d45aae.translatedText: The Hong Kong SAR has implemented the statutory minimum wage since May 1, with the minimum wage level set at HK$28 per hour. The Hong Kong Federation of Trade Unions, Hong Kong's largest trade union group, said that after Hong Kong implements the minimum wage, 310,000 grassroots employees will receive a substantial salary increase.

b395cf55f5eb6eca5eae5d5b5438cca0c5aed93c.sourceText: 香港特区立法会于2010年7月17日通过了《最低工资条例》，这是香港首个法定最低工资制度条例，于2011年5月1日起实施。《最低工资条例》建立了法定最低工资制度，确定工资下限，目的是在防止工资过低、尽量减少低薪职位流失、维持香港经济发展及竞争力等方面，取得适当平衡。
b395cf55f5eb6eca5eae5d5b5438cca0c5aed93c.translatedText: The Legislative Council of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region passed the Minimum Wage Ordinance on July 17, 2010. This is Hong Kong's first statutory minimum wage system ordinance and came into effect on May 1, 2011. The Minimum Wage Ordinance establishes a statutory minimum wage system and determines a lower wage limit. The purpose is to achieve an appropriate balance in preventing excessively low wages, minimizing the loss of low-wage jobs, and maintaining Hong Kong's economic development and competitiveness.

4fcfe200ad5e88d718ebddecfe1960756278ceda.sourceText: 香港工会联合会权益委员会副主任叶伟明表示，《最低工资条例》是香港近10年来最重要的劳工法例之一。
4fcfe200ad5e88d718ebddecfe1960756278ceda.translatedText: Deputy Director of the Rights and Interests Committee of the Hong Kong Federation of Trade Unions, Yip Wai-ming, said that the Minimum Wage Ordinance is one of the most important labor laws in Hong Kong in the past 10 years.

badb92bc465f0defea1e487541524ab597268974.sourceText: 扬州花灯正式启运美国
badb92bc465f0defea1e487541524ab597268974.translatedText: Yangzhou lanterns were officially shipped to the United States

30fbedca77220d07a5d800c981580138b79f5951.sourceText: 昨天傍晚，市木偶研究所造型艺术制作中心门口，在现场负责人的指挥下，一组二龙戏珠花灯被慢慢地装上集装箱车。
30fbedca77220d07a5d800c981580138b79f5951.translatedText: Yesterday evening, at the entrance of the Plastic Art Production Center of the Municipal Puppetry Research Institute, under the command of the person in charge of the scene, a group of two-dragon lanterns with beads were slowly loaded onto a container truck.

acaec279248b21a5cb15152a2e77644879c45c44.sourceText: ”今天装车的是第一个集装箱，明天还有一个。”市木偶研究所所长戴荣华告诉记者，此次制作的花灯将分装进10多个集装箱，经上海从海上陆续发往美国。
acaec279248b21a5cb15152a2e77644879c45c44.translatedText: "The first container is loaded today, and there will be another one tomorrow." Dai Ronghua, director of the Municipal Puppet Research Institute, told reporters that the lanterns produced this time will be packed into more than 10 containers and shipped to the United States via Shanghai.

9320c2ffb3c887e10db214645f7680d7dcf8826a.sourceText: 记者了解到，明年是中美建交35周年，美国亚利桑那州将举办文化经贸旅游活动庆祝这一盛事，扬州灯彩应邀参加在该州喷泉山公园的庆祝活动。
9320c2ffb3c887e10db214645f7680d7dcf8826a.translatedText: The reporter learned that next year will be the 35th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and the United States. Arizona, the United States, will hold cultural, economic, trade and tourism activities to celebrate this event. Yangzhou Lanterns was invited to participate in the celebration at Fountain Mountain Park in the state.

53806698d8013d44839c256d8f045cbe338ecb98.sourceText: 市木偶研究所造型艺术制作中心在接到任务后，创作设计人员11月初就开始忙碌，为灯会设计了20组扬州传统花灯。
53806698d8013d44839c256d8f045cbe338ecb98.translatedText: After receiving the task from the Plastic Art Production Center of the Municipal Puppet Research Institute, the creative designers started busy in early November and designed 20 sets of Yangzhou traditional lanterns for the lantern festival.

d356f5900e1a85360b681fe40661d8bb06bcc3ea.sourceText: 花灯以民俗题材为主，题材多元，兼顾美国人的审美趣味。昨天，记者在制作现场看到，这里既有中国传统的福禄寿喜诸神，也有金发碧眼的白雪公主。
d356f5900e1a85360b681fe40661d8bb06bcc3ea.translatedText: The lanterns are mainly based on folk themes, with diverse themes, taking into account American aesthetic tastes. Yesterday, reporters saw at the production site that there were not only the traditional Chinese gods of happiness, wealth, longevity, and happiness, but also the blond Snow White.

8046f9b5959139b3c9d5bf92d2954f2463efad03.translatedText: More than 60 workers have been busy for more than 50 days

c3c5f4653e083803c77f56941f9dc27c2b5edef5.sourceText: 据了解，花灯的高度多在2.2米左右，最高的灯组达12米多，给打包运输也带来了诸多难题。所以，一些花灯在制作的时候便进行块状化设计，以方便运输。在花灯的材质上，则选用环保、节能的新型材料。
c3c5f4653e083803c77f56941f9dc27c2b5edef5.translatedText: It is understood that the height of the lanterns is mostly about 2.2 meters, and the highest lantern group is more than 12 meters, which also brings many difficulties to packaging and transportation. Therefore, some lanterns are designed in blocks during production to facilitate transportation. As for the material of the lanterns, new environmentally friendly and energy-saving materials are used.

ee5f205abf8692e73d8be378443b0962a501b7fe.sourceText: 花灯制作虽然是木偶研究所造型艺术制作中心的副业，但该中心历史上在花灯制作方面也曾取得过不俗的成绩。但此次赴美的花灯却是近些年来规模最大的一次。
ee5f205abf8692e73d8be378443b0962a501b7fe.translatedText: Although lantern production is a side job of the Plastic Arts Production Center of the Puppet Research Institute, the center has also achieved good results in lantern production in history. But this lantern trip to the United States is the largest in recent years.

The Federal Post Office, which is in financial distress, once again failed to pay the 5.6 billion yuan to the Ministry of Finance at midnight on the 30th. "Future retirement...

503e582bd982916e4ad06beb635033b646ca2730.sourceText: 再欠财政部56亿 邮局：不会关门 财务困窘的联邦邮政总局，30日午夜再次缴不出给财政部的56亿元「未来退休员工健保福利预存款」。 这将是数月来邮政总局第二次拖欠付款。 媒体指出，这显示邮局已用尽一切撙节方法，它能否生存下去，命运将由国会决定。 不过，邮政总局向商界和顾客保证，邮政服务不会因此中断。 邮局将照常运作，邮件递送如常，员工薪水照发，供应商将会得到付款。 邮政总局的运作经费完全依赖销售邮票和其他产品的营收，不使用纳税人的钱。 由于美国民众日益依赖电子邮件通讯，邮递量锐减，邮政总局目前每季亏损数十亿元。 多年来，邮政总局为缴付未来退休员工健保福利预存款，大费周章。 一年多以来，邮政总局一直要求国会立法，准许它停止周六送信，以节省开支，并减少或取消每年50亿元的未来员工退休健保福利预存款，但国会没有采取行动。 邮政总局和工会表示，国会需要处理它自己制造的「人为危机」，取消福利预存款将可除去大部分的亏损，并消除恐慌感。 但是，国会议员今年没有通过为邮政总局提供救济的法案，并已结束会期，离开华府，直到11月6日大选以后才会恢复议事。
503e582bd982916e4ad06beb635033b646ca2730.translatedText: owes another 5.6 billion yuan to the Ministry of Finance. The post office: it will not close. The Federal Postal Service, which is in financial distress, once again failed to pay the 5.6 billion yuan "future retired employee health insurance benefit advance deposit" to the Ministry of Finance at midnight on the 30th. This would be the second time in as many months that the Postal Service has missed a payment. The media pointed out that this shows that the post office has exhausted all means of saving. Whether it can survive will be decided by Congress. However, the Postal Service assured businesses and customers that postal services will not be interrupted. The post office will operate as normal, mail will be delivered as normal, employees will be paid as usual, and vendors will be paid. The Postal Service relies entirely on revenue from the sale of stamps and other products and does not use taxpayer dollars. As Americans increasingly rely on email communications, mail volume has plummeted, and the Postal Service is currently losing billions of dollars every quarter. Over the years, the Postal Service has spent a lot of money pre-paying the health insurance benefits of future retired employees. For more than a year, the Postal Service has asked Congress for legislation that would allow it to stop delivering mail on Saturdays to save money and reduce or eliminate the $5 billion in annual prepayments for future employee retirement health insurance benefits, but Congress has taken no action. The Postal Service and unions say Congress needs to deal with a "man-made crisis" of its own making, and that eliminating benefit deposits would wipe out much of the losses and eliminate panic. However, members of Congress failed to pass a bill to provide relief to the Postal Service this year and have ended the session and left Washington. They will not resume proceedings until after the November 6 election.

e4a74db04a3018b028970ced189301f9f11d58ec.sourceText: 投资移民 15天快速审批 公民及移民服务局(USCIS)将对投资移民项目(EB-5)的审理程序进行重大改革，包括提供15个工作日的快速审理服务、成立特别小组与投资移民区域中心的申请人联络、成立决策董事会裁决区域中心等。 移民局提升投资移民的审批效率，是基于欧巴马总统在当前因应经济困境与就业低迷的状况，以吸引全球投资者以投资移民的方式，为美国提供资金以及增加工作机会。简化投资移民的处理程序，不仅使移民法更趋完善，也能满足美国经济发展和国家安全的需要。 移民局表示，将加快审理那些已经充分规画并可以快速实施的投资移民创业项目，同时给投资移民申请人提供了优先快速审理服务(Premium Processing Service)，收取额外费用后，将在15个工作日内完成审理。 移民局将聘请精通经济分析和投资移民要求的专家组成特别小组，直接透过电子邮件等方式，与投资移民区域中心项目的申请人进行沟通，及时解答疑问，从而有效缩短审批的时间，提高效率。 移民局将成立一个由经济学家以及审裁专家组成的决策董事会，由专业律师协助，加快确定可行的投资移民区域项目，提供给投资移民申请人。 投资移民项目每年允许1万个投资移民进入美国，投资50万元(区域中心)以上、并创造至少10个美国本土就业机会，全家就可获得临时绿卡，两年后可申请永久绿卡。
e4a74db04a3018b028970ced189301f9f11d58ec.translatedText: Investment Immigration 15-day Fast Review and Approval The US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) will make major reforms to the review process of the investment immigration project (EB-5), including providing a 15-day fast review service, establishing a special team to liaise with applicants from the investment immigration regional center, and establishing a decision-making board to adjudicate the regional center. The Immigration Bureau's improvement in the efficiency of investment immigration approval is based on President Obama's response to the current economic difficulties and employment downturn in order to attract global investors to provide funds and increase job opportunities in the United States through investment immigration. Simplifying the procedures for investment immigration will not only improve immigration laws, but also meet the needs of U.S. economic development and national security. The Immigration Bureau stated that it will expedite the review of investment immigration entrepreneurial projects that have been fully planned and can be implemented quickly. At the same time, it provides priority processing service (Premium Processing Service) to investment immigration applicants. After charging additional fees, the review will be completed within 15 working days. The Immigration Bureau will hire a special team of experts who are proficient in economic analysis and investment immigration requirements to communicate directly with applicants for the investment immigration regional center project through emails and other methods to answer questions in a timely manner, thereby effectively shortening the approval time and improving efficiency. The Immigration Bureau will establish a decision-making board composed of economists and adjudication experts, assisted by professional lawyers, to speed up the identification of feasible investment immigration regional projects and provide them to investment immigration applicants. The investment immigration project allows 10,000 investment immigrants to enter the United States every year. If they invest more than 500,000 yuan (regional center) and create at least 10 American jobs, their whole family can obtain a temporary green card, and they can apply for a permanent green card after two years.

5339098d01730f23191dd19679e894a2387bdf2d.sourceText: 25年前谋杀案现判决 辩方称死刑不妥当 亚省最高法院周二对一宗发生在25年前的谋杀案做出审结，判处作案者死刑。 现年56岁的唐纳德爱德华贝提，1984年5月9日，在坦佩绑架了13岁女孩克里斯蒂富诺夫，两天后，人们在垃圾箱后面发现了她的尸首。警方说，当时的公寓维修工贝提绑架并杀害了女孩。贝提在1985年入狱服刑直至现在。 罪犯定于5月25日在佛罗伦斯州立监狱执行注射死刑。辩方律师认为死刑对贝提不妥当，原因是执行死刑的注射剂并非来自美国食品和药物管理局，是非法获得的。
5339098d01730f23191dd19679e894a2387bdf2d.translatedText: The Supreme Court of Alberta on Tuesday concluded a murder case that occurred 25 years ago and sentenced the perpetrator to death. Donald Edward Beatty, 56, kidnapped 13-year-old Kristy Furnov in Tempe on May 9, 1984. Her body was found behind a dumpster two days later. Police said Betty, then an apartment maintenance worker, kidnapped and killed the girl. Beatty was imprisoned in 1985 and remains in prison until now. The convict is scheduled to be executed by lethal injection at Florence State Prison on May 25. Defense attorneys argued that the death penalty was inappropriate because the lethal injection was obtained illegally and did not come from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
