32e42627ac81c8362c4bc573453dbcf05a283d75.sourceText: 钱德勒市议会通过 $ 835.7万美元的财政预算，不加税 上周四钱德勒市议会一致批准$ 835.7万元为2012-13年度财政预算，从7月1日开始使用。预算不包括增加物业税税率或水价，这一议案受到许多理事会成员称赞。钱德勒的主要物业税率仍然每评估值100美元交0.3292美元，其二级率仍然每100美元评估值交0.9422美元。预算没有包括图书馆和游泳课，原草案中有的费用。钱德勒的工作人员曾建议在五月初，居民支付每小时2元，使用市的图书馆自修室。工作人员也已提出了在全市开展拥有培训的费用增加1美元。根据理事会的建议，这些费用被移除。”这是一个漫长的过程，但钱德勒居民应该感到自豪。在过去的一年，我们已经能够找到办法解决。”市议员里克说。”这不是几年前的预算，它是一个非常严峻的预算。”虽然比本财年的有近25％的增长，城市的预算，至少反映了181万美元与英特尔50亿美元的扩张项目有关。钱德勒的2011-12年度财政预算为676.5万美元。英特尔将偿还大部分项目的钱给城市 – 即1.64亿美元扩建机场再造水设施 – 这些钱必须在预算中拨出。城市的税务约12至13％房产税。其余的上缴到马里科帕郡，学区和特别税区，市预算经理格雷格说。因为物业税税率将保持不变，但物业价值，已普遍下降，城市每年从财产税收集金额将减少，包括2012-13年财政年度。目前的预算将包括在其他方面的预期损失。钱德勒定于6月28日通过物业税的征收，纳入预算。在2012-13年度的预算允许提前还款$ 8.475亿美元的2003系列债券，这将避免将来无法还清城市债务的本息。”我很高兴（钱德勒）可以买到一些我们的债务”市议员凯文说。副市长杰夫还赞扬此举，并表示，他希望未来的市议会将达到一个点，可以并不总是借钱来支付这些项目。新批准的预算也增加了一个城市的储备基金，以维持基础设施约34.6万美元。官员估计，储备将支持约五年的维护资本项目，即重铺街道和维护公园。储备基金是指以抵消物业税值下降，弥补无法出售的债券的新项目。
32e42627ac81c8362c4bc573453dbcf05a283d75.translatedText: Chandler City Council passes $8.357 million budget, no tax increases The Chandler City Council on Thursday unanimously approved an $8.357 million budget for the 2012-13 fiscal year, beginning July 1. The budget does not include an increase in property tax rates or water rates, a bill that many council members praised. Chandler's primary property tax rate remains $0.3292 per $100 of assessed value, and its secondary rate remains $0.9422 per $100 of assessed value. The budget does not include library and swimming lessons, which were included in the original draft. Chandler staff had proposed that in early May, residents pay $2 an hour to use the city's library study rooms. Staff has also proposed a $1 increase in the cost of conducting ownership training throughout the city. Following the council's recommendation, these fees were removed. "This has been a long process, but Chandler residents should be proud. Over the past year, we have been able to find a solution," said Councilman Rick. "This is not the budget of a few years ago, it's a very grim budget." While a nearly 25 percent increase from this fiscal year, the city's budget reflects at least $1.81 million related to Intel's $5 billion expansion project. Chandler's 2011-12 fiscal year budget is $6.765 million. Intel will reimburse the city for most of the project money — namely a $164 million expansion of the airport's water reclamation facility — that must be allocated in the budget. City taxes are approximately 12 to 13% property tax. The rest goes to Maricopa County, school districts and special tax districts, said Gregg, the city budget manager. Because property tax rates will remain the same but property values ​​have generally declined, the amount the city collects from property taxes will decrease each year, including in fiscal year 2012-13. The current budget will include expected losses in other areas. Chandler is scheduled to pass the property tax levy into the budget on June 28. The 2012-13 budget allows for early repayment of $847.5 million in Series 2003 bonds, which will avoid future inability to pay off principal and interest on the city's debt. "I'm glad (Chandler) was able to buy some of our debt," Councilman Kevin said. Deputy Mayor Jeff also praised the move and said he hopes future councils will reach a point where they can't always borrow money to pay for these projects. The newly approved budget also increases a city reserve fund to maintain infrastructure by about $346,000. Officials estimate the reserve will support about five years of maintenance capital projects, namely repaving streets and maintaining parks. The reserve fund is a new program to offset the decline in property tax values ​​and cover bonds that cannot be sold.

26266d8ac25c26490b38ddebf6c0fe981a14baab.sourceText: 民调：美75%民众认为经济不佳 34%说经济与就业最重要 美国经济现况显得营养不良，它无法创造够多的工作机会，不能将美国失业率压低到百分之7以下。今年9月份美国只创造出14万8000个新的工作机会，这是美国经济衰退5年之後，仍处于淒凉景况。 美国广播公司电视新闻部（ABC News）和「华盛顿邮报」本周进行民调发现，美国民众百分之75认为经济「不太好」或者「很差」， 只有百分之2的人说经济情况良好，有人推断百分之2给予这样好评断的人，可能在华尔街工作，因为股市极佳，工作在这个环境的人便感染到乐观气氛。 选民将会理解美国经济的真实情况。共和党策略专家大卫?#28201;士顿说：”我曾经对若干个群体的人进行调查，他们只认一个数据，就是失业率，他们都对此十分熟悉，他们了解目前政府公布的失业率低估了实际情况，在职场的人却十分清楚。” 各项民调都诉说着相同的故事，那就是”激励选民”。哥伦比亚广播公司电视新闻（CBS News）和「纽约时报」所作的民调显示，有百分之34的美国人认为经济与就业是美国面对最重要的问题；相对的，只有百分之8的人认为健保重要，百分之6的人认为预算赤字和联邦债务重要。 但是，在华府活跃的政客们对就业机会不足的危机，并不那么关切；他们的精力都摆在两党斗争，他们在预算案与联邦债务上限，及「奥巴马健保」议题上，设法在意识形态上让对方惨败，并且采取”焦土战争策略”（scorched-earth wars）。政客们对真正需要他们认真立法的移民改革和全球气候变迁等议题上，却是等閒视之，不那么热中。 下周，参院与众院将开始新一轮的预算案谈判，这将是4年来第一次认真谈判预算案，并且探讨减少联邦赤字等议题。创造就业机会反而不是主要讨论的焦点议题。 当然，减少预算赤字是使经济更健康的关键；但是，美国经济成长全年只有百分之0.2，那对减少预算赤字与提高就业机会，都不会有什么帮助。
26266d8ac25c26490b38ddebf6c0fe981a14baab.translatedText: Poll: 75% of the people in the United States believe that the economy is poor, and 34% say that the economy and employment are the most important. The current situation of the U.S. economy appears malnourished. It cannot create enough job opportunities and cannot lower the U.S. unemployment rate below 7%. The United States created only 148,000 new jobs in September this year. Five years after the recession, the U.S. economy is still in a bleak situation. A poll conducted this week by ABC News and the Washington Post found that 75 percent of the American people think the economy is "not very good" or "very bad," and only 2 percent say the economy is good. Some people infer that the 2 percent who give such favorable judgments may work on Wall Street, because the stock market is excellent, and people who work in this environment are infected with an optimistic atmosphere. Voters will understand what's really going on with the U.S. economy. Republican strategist David Stone said: "I have conducted surveys among several groups of people, and they only recognize one data, which is the unemployment rate. They are all very familiar with it. They understand that the unemployment rate announced by the current government underestimates the actual situation, but people in the workplace know it very well." All polls tell the same story, which is to "motivate voters." A poll conducted by CBS News and the New York Times showed that 34% of Americans believe that the economy and employment are the most important issues facing the United States; in contrast, only 8% believe that health care is important, and 6% believe that the budget deficit and federal debt are important. However, politicians active in Washington are not that concerned about the crisis of insufficient employment opportunities; their energy is devoted to the struggle between the two parties. They try to defeat the other party ideologically on the budget, the federal debt ceiling, and "Obamacare" issues, and adopt "scorched-earth wars" tactics. Politicians are not so enthusiastic about issues such as immigration reform and global climate change that really require serious legislation. Next week, the Senate and the House of Representatives will begin a new round of budget negotiations. This will be the first serious budget negotiation in four years and will discuss issues such as reducing the federal deficit. Job creation is not the main focus of discussion. Of course, reducing the budget deficit is the key to making the economy healthier; however, the U.S. economy grew only 0.2% for the whole year, which will not help reduce the budget deficit or increase employment opportunities.

3e5f53c27a0a6c4b8f319298278812cd1bb43515.sourceText: 据福建省气象台消息，今年第23号台风”菲特”7日凌晨1点15分在福建福鼎沙埕镇登陆，登陆时强度为强台风，近中心最大风力14级（42米／秒），中心气压955百帕，未来将继续向偏西方移动，强度逐渐减弱。
3e5f53c27a0a6c4b8f319298278812cd1bb43515.translatedText: According to the Fujian Provincial Meteorological Observatory, Typhoon Fitt, the 23rd typhoon this year, made landfall in Shacheng Town, Fuding, Fujian Province at 1:15 a.m. on the 7th. When it landed, it was a strong typhoon with a maximum wind force of level 14 (42 meters/second) near the center and a central pressure of 955 hPa. It will continue to move westward and gradually weaken in intensity.

291b406145281cd19ab48ae9da3df81b94bc087b.translatedText: Fit attacked Wenzhou, Zhejiang Province today, killing 5 people and missing 4 people. One of the dead died in the line of duty. The city's affected population was 2.37 million, with direct economic losses of 1.93 billion.

62b1d0f8857a6c1328aec3c67d3dfc47fb2b775b.translatedText: The winds where "Feite" passed were strong. In the early morning of the 7th, strong winds of magnitude 10-12 and gusts of magnitude 13-15 occurred along the northern coast of Ningde. The maximum was 50.7 meters/second (level 15) at Xingzai Island in Fuding.

c92887e079387076dace8c212ac07e693d543e7e.sourceText: ”菲特”同时给福建部分地区带来了强降雨，从6日8时至7日1时，福建宁德北部出现暴雨和大暴雨，以福鼎佳阳160.7毫米为最大。
c92887e079387076dace8c212ac07e693d543e7e.translatedText: "Feite" also brought heavy rainfall to parts of Fujian. From 8:00 on the 6th to 1:00 on the 7th, heavy rains and heavy rains occurred in the northern part of Ningde, Fujian, with the maximum 160.7 mm in Jiayang, Fuding.

043f872c76c55aa000323e1f4887b9bcc5e500fa.sourceText: 据福建省气象台预计，”菲特”登陆后向偏西方向移动，将继续给福建中北部造成强风暴雨，预计7日福建中北部有中到大雨，宁德、南平两市部分地区有暴雨，局部大暴雨。福建省防汛办提醒，相关地区要注意防范由暴雨引发的城乡积涝、山洪泥石流和山体滑坡等自然灾害。
043f872c76c55aa000323e1f4887b9bcc5e500fa.translatedText: According to the Fujian Provincial Meteorological Observatory, "Fit" will move to the west after landing and will continue to cause strong winds and rains in central and northern Fujian. It is expected that there will be moderate to heavy rains in central and northern Fujian on the 7th, and there will be heavy rains and local heavy rains in parts of Ningde and Nanping. The Fujian Provincial Flood Control Office reminded that relevant areas should pay attention to preventing natural disasters such as urban and rural waterlogging, flash floods, mudslides, and landslides caused by heavy rains.

2c03f62f71019db20e1f14db5d9457e7011c0b03.sourceText: 福建省防汛办于6日22时启动防台风I级应急响应，全省共安全转移海上人员12.8万人，陆上危险区域已安全转移4.9万余人，在闽中、闽东海域作业的29412艘渔船已全部回港避风。
2c03f62f71019db20e1f14db5d9457e7011c0b03.translatedText: > The Fujian Provincial Flood Control Office launched a Level I emergency response for typhoon prevention at 22:00 on the 6th. 1f673a5b9741614a5e9ef3e150ffdff853b52703.sourceText: 由于”菲特”登陆正值国庆”黄金周”，福建省防指对该省北部地区部分景点适时进行关闭，对游客进行安全疏导转移，共关闭嵛山岛、三都澳等13个沿海景区，紧急疏导游客7126人。

e330bead48229ab8aa892d2a4b1b5d016550fffa.sourceText: 37州50万人闹独立 亚省不落后 总统奥巴马获得连任后仅仅一周，37个州50余万民众签署请愿书，请求白宫允许他们的州从联邦中分离出去并成立新的州政府。这么大的事情，怎能少了亚省人的参与？ 要求独立的各州已将请愿书发送到白宫”WethePeople”官方网站上，并附有支持者的所在城市、签名日期和签名编号。截至13日下午，已有37个州的50余万美国人签名要求脱离联邦。其中22个州在大选日选择支持共和党总统候选人罗姆尼，但一些选择了奥巴马的”摇摆州”及纽约州、罗德岛、新泽西州等”深蓝”的东北诸州也有民众响应。 大多数请愿书都引用了标志着美国从英国分离的《独立宣言》中的开场白，美国国父在宣言中阐明他们拥有”解散当今政体”并建立新国家的权力。 美国宪法中并没有允许各州离开联邦的条款。目前，白宫还没有对此做出回应。 亚利桑那州的分离请愿网站在11月10日发布，由一名名为尼古拉斯M的吉伯特居民发起，到14日止，网上已有7600多人签署”将亚利桑那和平独立于联邦，并成立新政府”的请愿。 亚省是共和党的大本营，罗姆尼在本州的得票数比奥巴马高出了12个百分点。即便如此，包括奥巴马的支持者，前亚利桑那州总检察长格兰特伍兹，和被认为反奥巴马的本州州长布鲁尔都不支持本州脱离联邦。 布鲁尔说：”我相信美国是世界上最好的国家，我相信亚利桑那州在联邦制管理下会有更好的发展。” 伍兹说，他宁愿看到人们把自己的精力放在提高本州的教育水平，或者提高自家生活质量，而不是纠结在这件事上。
e330bead48229ab8aa892d2a4b1b5d016550fffa.translatedText: 500,000 people in 37 states are fighting for independence, and Alberta will not fall behind. Just one week after President Obama was re-elected, more than 500,000 people in 37 states signed a petition asking the White House to allow their states to secede from the union and establish new state governments. How could such a big event not involve Albertans? States demanding independence have sent petitions to the White House's official "WethePeople" website, along with the supporters' cities, signature dates and signature numbers. As of the afternoon of the 13th, more than 500,000 Americans in 37 states had signed their petition to secede from the Union. Among them, 22 states chose to support Republican presidential candidate Mitt Romney on election day, but some "swing states" that chose Obama and "deep blue" northeastern states such as New York, Rhode Island, and New Jersey also had people respond. Most of the petitions cited the opening words of the Declaration of Independence, which marked America's separation from Britain, in which the Founding Fathers stated that they had the power to "dissolve the present body politic" and establish a new nation. There is no provision in the U.S. Constitution allowing states to leave the Union. Currently, the White House has not responded to this. The Arizona secession petition website was launched on November 10 and was initiated by a Gilbert resident named Nicholas M. As of the 14th, more than 7,600 people had signed the petition online to "make Arizona peacefully independent from the federal government and establish a new government." Alberta is a stronghold of the Republican Party, and Romney's vote share in this state was 12 percentage points higher than Obama's. Even so, neither Obama supporter, former Arizona Attorney General Grant Woods, nor the state's governor, Brewer, who is considered anti-Obama, support the state's secession from the Union. Brewer said: "I believe that the United States is the best country in the world, and I believe that Arizona will develop better under federal management." Woods said that he would rather see people focus on improving the education level of the state or improving the quality of life at home, rather than dwelling on this matter.

1ea54813c5e6180450267584c5604791b67273e9.sourceText: ASU再次入选派对大学前20 普林斯顿评论1日公布的全国大学调查显示，俄亥俄大学取代乔治亚大学，成为全美头号派对大学（party school），本州岛的ASU再次入选前20名。 位居派对大学第三至第五名的，分别是密西西比大学、爱阿华大学和圣塔芭芭拉加州大学。 普林斯顿评论的调查还包括其他61项排名，如最佳教授、最美校园、最佳校园餐厅、财务补助最满意等，分别由麻州的韦斯利学院、佛罗里达南方学院、伊利诺伊州的惠登学院，和宾州的史瓦斯摩学院夺得。犹他州的杨百翰大学是连续14年在不饮酒大学中排名首位。 长期深受派对大学名声困扰的俄亥俄大学校方，多年来采取严厉措施，以期减少学生的饮酒，如对新生加强不饮酒教育、对饮酒违规的学生严加处罚，和在万圣节派对期间加强监控等。 俄亥俄大学在最近几个学年，约60%的学生违规是与饮酒有关。 2010至2011学年共发生1213起饮酒投诉事件，占全部违规的59%。 学校允许举行万圣节狂欢，自1970年代以来，通常至少吸引2万名学生参加。派对期间发生的被捕与警告事件，近年来每年都超过200起，其中多数为饮酒和扰乱秩序。 2003年更发展到失控的地步，狂欢者甚至点燃沙发、斗殴，并向警员扔酒瓶。 在普林斯顿评论的其他排名上，俄亥俄大学还位居啤酒与烈性酒的消费、最佳体育设施、最美校园和校园联谊的前20名。 ASU曾在2002年此项评比中获第一派对大学，今年则排名17位。
1ea54813c5e6180450267584c5604791b67273e9.translatedText: ASU was once again selected in the top 20 party universities. A national college survey released by the Princeton Review on the 1st showed that Ohio University replaced the University of Georgia and became the number one party university in the United States (party university). school), Honshu’s ASU was once again selected into the top 20. Ranking third to fifth among party universities are the University of Mississippi, the University of Iowa and the University of California, Santa Barbara. The Princeton Review survey also included 61 other rankings, such as best professors, most beautiful campuses, best campus restaurants, most satisfied with financial aid, etc., which were won by Wesley College in Massachusetts, Florida Southern College, Whedon College in Illinois, and Swarthmore College in Pennsylvania. Brigham Young University in Utah ranks first among colleges that do not drink alcohol for 14 consecutive years. Ohio University, which has long been troubled by its reputation as a party university, has taken strict measures over the years in an effort to reduce students' drinking, such as strengthening non-drinking education for freshmen, imposing strict penalties on students who violate drinking rules, and increasing monitoring during Halloween parties. In recent academic years at Ohio University, about 60% of student infractions were related to drinking. A total of 1,213 drinking complaints occurred in the 2010-2011 school year, accounting for 59% of all violations. Schools have allowed Halloween bashes, which have typically attracted at least 20,000 students since the 1970s. The number of arrests and warnings that have occurred during parties has exceeded 200 each year in recent years, most of which are related to drinking and disorderly conduct. In 2003, the situation got out of control, with revelers setting sofas on fire, getting into fights, and throwing bottles at police officers. In other Princeton Review rankings, Ohio University also ranks in the top 20 for beer and liquor consumption, best athletic facilities, most beautiful campuses and campus networking. ASU was ranked the No. 1 university in this competition in 2002 and ranked 17th this year.

99a80e5e28f487401344d3d1e0577030886938dd.sourceText: 气囊缺陷 丰田召回30万辆SUV 丰田汽车公司(Toyota)21日宣布召回超过30万辆在美国出售的全功能车(SUV)RAV4和Highlander，以修理有缺陷的安全气囊传感器。 这项召修包括21万4000辆2007和2008年份的RAV4，以及9‧4万辆2008年份的Highlander与Highlander HV。这项召修不包括Lexus和Toyota的其他任何款式汽车。 Toyota 美国销售公司说，RAV4和Highlander的安全气囊传感器组合有两个侦察汽车侧倾角度的传感器，如果一个传感器失灵，警告灯就会亮起，造成侧倾侦察系统停止作用；如果两个传感器同时故障，预束式安全带和侧边帘式安全气囊可能被意外启动。这项传感器故障不会造成在撞车时安全气囊打不开。 Toyota公司一位发言人说，该公司收到一些与此缺陷有关的轻微受伤报告，包括3月一名驾车者的手被安全带割伤。该公司的经销商将免费为召修车辆更换新的传感器组合。 过去一年半Toyota因汽车的各种缺陷，包括出错的踏脚垫、卡住的加油踏板和煞车软件错误，在全球召修了超过1400万辆汽车。该公司因对三次召修的处理不当，付给美国政府破纪录的4880万元罚款，也面对数十起美国车主提出的控诉，包括驾驶人因这些汽车缺陷而丧生的指控。
99a80e5e28f487401344d3d1e0577030886938dd.translatedText: Air bag defect Toyota recalls 300,000 SUVs Toyota announced on the 21st that it would recall more than 300,000 RAV4 and Highlander SUVs sold in the United States to repair defective airbag sensors. The recall covers 214,000 2007 and 2008 RAV4 vehicles and 94,000 2008 Highlander and Highlander HV vehicles. The recall does not cover Lexus or any other Toyota vehicle model. Toyota U.S. Sales said that the RAV4 and Highlander's airbag sensor combination has two sensors that detect the car's roll angle. If one sensor fails, the warning light will come on, causing the roll detection system to stop functioning. If both sensors fail at the same time, the pre-belts and side curtain airbags may be accidentally activated. This sensor failure will not prevent the airbag from deploying in a crash. A Toyota spokesman said the company had received reports of minor injuries related to the defect, including a driver who cut his hand on a seat belt in March. The company's dealers will replace the recalled vehicles with new sensor combinations free of charge. Over the past year and a half, Toyota has recalled more than 14 million vehicles globally due to a variety of defects, including faulty floor mats, stuck gas pedals and faulty braking software. The company paid a record $48.8 million in fines to the U.S. government for mishandling three repair calls and faced dozens of lawsuits from U.S. car owners, including allegations that drivers died because of the defects in their cars.

93b824fb044e6a92fd3e527b5622094a27a6fa64.sourceText: 投资+避税 IRA10项须知 2010年全美个人退休储蓄账户(IRA)金额估计4.7兆元，占所有退休账户金额25%，拥有IRA退休账户的美国人有4900万人。 IRA账户该选择何种投资？该如何避税？都关系到未来的退休生活，因此对于IRA账户应有以下十项基本认识： 1. 是否延后缴税 50岁以下每人每年最多可存5000元至传统IRA账户，50岁以上可存入6000元。存入金额由该年所得中扣除，免缴所得税，等提领时本金与利息一并缴税。 罗斯IRA（Roth IRA）账户金额则不能从所得扣除，至少五年后提领时，本金与利息都无需再缴税。 2. 存款截止日期较401(k)迟 由雇主提供的401(k)退休帐户每年存款截止日期是12月31日，IRA账户截止日期则可等到报税截止。你可先报完税再将钱存入IRA账户，但一定要在报税截止前。 3. 多数钱从401(k)转入 根据2008年报告，IRA账户多由401(k)账户转存（rollover）而来。每人每年可存入IRA账户最高金额5000元或6000元，但如换工作或届退休年龄，由401(k)账户转存至IRA账户的金额则无上限。 4. 提领退休年龄较高 55岁退休人士由401(k)帐户提领存款没有任何罚款，但如将钱转存至IRA账户，则须等到59岁半提领才不会罚款。因此专家建议，55岁退休的人可将部分暂时不用的钱转存至IRA账户，将可能需要急用到的钱留在401(k)账户。 5. 提早提领免罚款规定 如果医疗费用超过全年所得的7.5%，提领IRA账户的钱不受59岁半以前提领需付10%罚款的规定限制。 此外，失业后买健保、残障、后备军人受征召服役时，提领IRA账户的钱也无罚金。IRA账户的钱还可用来支付高等教育学费，购买第一栋房子 (单身者不超过1万元，夫妻不超过2万元)。根据寿命预估支付年金，也无须缴10%罚金。 6. 自行负责选择投资 最受欢迎的IRA账户投资方式是股票和共同基金，其次为现金和债券。选择何种投资和如何转移投资，均由个人自行负责。年纪愈大，IRA帐户存款愈多，愈应该分散投资，规避风险。 7. 罗斯IRA渐受欢迎 原本由传统IRA转至罗斯IRA有收入不得超过10万元的限制，但这个限制2010年取消后，转存至罗斯IRA账户的金额大幅增加。 虽然将存款从IRA帐户提领出来转存罗斯IRA时需缴税，但退休提领时就无需缴税。专家认为，现在先缴税可免除对日后税率变动的疑虑。 8. 限期提领 传统IRA账户的钱不可以无限期延税，必须在70岁半以前提领，未按规定提领的金额须缴50%的税金。 按规定，年满71岁半后来年的4月1日前需提领第一笔钱，之后则须在每年12月31日前提领。因此，如果在4月1日前提领第一笔钱，同年的12月31日前又领第二笔钱。两笔钱可能使收入增加，税率提高。 9. 费用有差 相较于401(k)账户，IRA个人退休账户无法享有团体优惠，因此投资时所付的费用较高。因此需仔细比较每种投资费用，尽可能选择费用较低廉的类似投资。即使只差1%，数十年下来仍颇可观。 10. 高低收入者的税务优惠 已有大笔储蓄，在70岁半又必须从IRA账户提领第一笔钱，却用不到这笔钱的退休人士，若在2011年12月31日前将这笔钱捐出，即可免缴税金。捐赠金额以不超过10万元为限，且须由IRA账户直接转给合格的慈善机构。 在2011年调整后的税前总收入低于2万8250元 (夫妻低于5万6500元)者，如在IRA或401(k)退休账户存入退休金，每人可享有最多1000元的税金减免。
93b824fb044e6a92fd3e527b5622094a27a6fa64.translatedText: Investment + tax avoidance 10 things you need to know about IRA In 2010, the amount of individual retirement savings accounts (IRAs) in the United States was estimated at 4.7 trillion yuan, accounting for 25% of all retirement accounts. There are 49 million Americans with IRA retirement accounts. What investments should I choose for my IRA account? How to avoid taxes? They are all related to future retirement life, so you should have the following ten basic understandings of IRA accounts: 1. Whether to defer tax payment. Each person under the age of 50 can deposit up to 5,000 yuan per year into a traditional IRA account, and those over 50 can deposit 6,000 yuan. The amount deposited is deducted from the income for that year and income tax is exempted. When withdrawn, the principal and interest will be taxed together. The amount in a Roth IRA account cannot be deducted from income. When withdrawn after at least five years, the principal and interest will not be taxed. 2. The deposit deadline is later than that of 401(k). The annual deposit deadline for 401(k) retirement accounts provided by employers is December 31, while the deadline for IRA accounts can wait until the tax filing deadline. You can file your taxes first and then deposit the money into your IRA account, but you must do so before the tax filing deadline. 3. Most money is transferred from 401(k). According to the 2008 report, most IRA accounts are rolled over from 401(k) accounts. The maximum amount that each person can deposit into an IRA account per year is 5,000 yuan or 6,000 yuan. However, if you change jobs or reach retirement age, there is no upper limit on the amount that can be transferred from a 401(k) account to an IRA account. 4. The retirement age is higher. There is no penalty for a 55-year-old retiree to withdraw deposits from his 401(k) account. However, if he transfers the money to an IRA account, he must wait until the age of 59 and a half to withdraw the money without penalty. Therefore, experts suggest that people who retire at the age of 55 can transfer some of the temporarily unused money to an IRA account and leave money that may be needed urgently in a 401(k) account. 5. No penalty for early withdrawal If medical expenses exceed 7.5% of the annual income, the money withdrawn from the IRA account is not subject to the 10% penalty for withdrawal before the age of 59 and a half. In addition, there is no penalty for withdrawing money from an IRA account if you buy health insurance after losing your job, if you are disabled, or if you are a reserve soldier and are called to serve. The money in the IRA account can also be used to pay for higher education tuition and purchase the first house (no more than 10,000 yuan for a single person and 20,000 yuan for a couple). Annuities are paid based on life expectancy without paying a 10% penalty. 6. Choose your own investments The most popular ways to invest in IRA accounts are stocks and mutual funds, followed by cash and bonds. The choice of investments and how to transfer them is the sole responsibility of the individual. The older you get and the more savings you have in your IRA account, the more you should diversify your investments and avoid risks. 7. Roth IRA is becoming more and more popular. Originally, there was a limit on income that could not exceed $100,000 when transferring from a traditional IRA to a Roth IRA. However, after this restriction was lifted in 2010, the amount transferred to a Roth IRA account increased significantly. Although you are taxed when you withdraw money from an IRA account and roll it into a Roth IRA, you are not taxed when you withdraw money in retirement. Experts believe that paying taxes now can eliminate concerns about changes in tax rates later. 8. Withdrawal within a time limit. The money in a traditional IRA account cannot be tax-deferred indefinitely. It must be withdrawn before the age of 70 and a half. The amount not withdrawn in accordance with the regulations must pay 50% tax. According to regulations, after reaching the age of 71 and a half, the first payment must be withdrawn before April 1 of the next year, and thereafter before December 31 of each year. Therefore, if you withdraw the first payment before April 1, you will receive the second payment before December 31 of the same year. The two payments may result in an increase in income and a higher tax rate. 9. There is a difference in fees. Compared with 401(k) accounts, IRA individual retirement accounts do not enjoy group discounts, so the fees paid when investing are higher. Therefore, you need to carefully compare the fees of each investment and choose similar investments with lower fees whenever possible. Even if the difference is only 1%, it is still considerable over decades. 10. Tax benefits for high- and low-income people. Retirees who have a large amount of savings and need to withdraw the first amount of money from their IRA account at the age of 70 and a half, but do not need the money, can avoid paying taxes if they donate the money before December 31, 2011. The donation amount is limited to no more than $100,000 and must be transferred directly from the IRA account to a qualified charity. Those whose adjusted pre-tax gross income in 2011 was less than $28,250 (less than $56,500 for couples) can enjoy a tax deduction of up to $1,000 per person if they contribute retirement funds to an IRA or 401(k) retirement account.

4cd3ba609fcfa6420e9bf682e56388db4b5313a3.sourceText: 12名示威者在坦佩SRP大厦被捕 （亚省时报） 12月2日，警察局逮捕了涉嫌非法入侵SRP电力公司在坦佩行政大楼的12名示威者。 至少有75名示威者在周五上午10时30左右开始聚集在SRP大楼外的入口和人行道，抗议在亚利桑那州北部那瓦霍自治区大山开采煤矿计划，该计划由SRP和Peabody能源共同开发。示威者称开采煤矿会破坏当地的自然环境，为原住民带来健康问题。 Peabody能源是那瓦霍发电站的主要股东。
4cd3ba609fcfa6420e9bf682e56388db4b5313a3.translatedText: > 12 demonstrators were arrested at the SRP Building in Tempe (Alberta Times) On December 2, the Police Department arrested 12 demonstrators suspected of illegally invading SRP Electric Company’s Tempe administration building. At least 75 demonstrators began gathering at the entrance and sidewalk outside the SRP building around 10:30 a.m. on Friday to protest plans to mine coal in the mountains of Navajo Autonomous Region in northern Arizona, which is being developed by SRP and Peabody Energy. Demonstrators say coal mining will destroy the local natural environment and cause health problems for indigenous people. Peabody Energy is the majority shareholder of the Navajo Generating Station.

90a3acc2180be5aaccb6c4db40768af10fc4ccb3.sourceText: 今年最大的山火 葡萄藤火烧了19100亩 （亚省时报） 科罗纳国家森林发言人海蒂斯基瓦说，今年本州最大的山火，科罗纳国家森林的”葡萄藤”山火，在燃烧了19100英亩后，在7月3日已经被扑灭四分之三。 大火源于上周四的雷击，曾促使州公路266号部分关闭。目前还没有进一步威胁，因此也没有要求居民撤离，斯基瓦说。 科罗纳国家森林附近还有两个较小的山火，也是有雷击引起，已经得到控制。 以下是今年一部分关于野火的数据：迄今为止，全国已发生711个野火，烧毁超过1,988,257英亩，有135起野火因雷击引起，烧毁了1,025,769英亩，10个最大的野火烧毁了超过889378英亩。因417人的过失，有395,388英亩遭烧毁。 2012年全美最大的野火发生在科罗拉多州的金都峡谷，烧毁了超过17,827英亩，迫使疏散居民超过32000人，其中包括美国空军学院，并摧毁家园的人数不详。
90a3acc2180be5aaccb6c4db40768af10fc4ccb3.translatedText: The largest wildfire this year, the Grapevine Fire burned 19,100 acres (Alberta Times) The Grapevine Fire in the Corona National Forest, the state's largest wildfire this year, was three-quarters extinguished on July 3 after burning 19,100 acres, Corona National Forest spokesperson Heidi Skiva said. The fire, which stemmed from a lightning strike last Thursday, prompted a partial closure of State Route 266. There was no further threat and residents were not asked to evacuate, Schiva said. There are two smaller wildfires near the Corona National Forest that were also caused by lightning strikes and have been brought under control. Here is some data on wildfires this year: To date, there have been 711 wildfires across the country, burning more than 1,988,257 acres, 135 wildfires started by lightning strikes, burning 1,025,769 acres, and the 10 largest wildfires burning more than 889,378 acres. 395,388 acres burned due to the fault of 417 people. The nation's largest wildfire of 2012 occurred in Kinder Canyon, Colorado, burning more than 17,827 acres, forcing the evacuation of more than 32,000 residents, including the U.S. Air Force Academy, and destroying the homes of an unknown number of people.

f9347faccdb235ffe700d0b40b0a26360f731a4f.sourceText: MAVNI招兵计划 10周拿公民 军方宣布，29日重启「国家利益所需军方专业征才」(Military Accessions Vital to the National Interest，MAVNI)计画，效期将一直持续至2014年10月，这项计画旨在吸引 国际学生以及外籍技术人才，具合法身分的申请人可在十周内绕过绿卡直接成为公民，但需为军方服务五年。 移民律师高泰指出，中文作为一种战略性语言，被军方需要。 如果以语言为优势的申请者的身分都是合法的，可以考虑参军，十周便可以成为公民，但是未来五年必须为现役。 该计画主要是需要会讲英文以外41种外语或一些持有美国执照的医疗保健专业人才，中文被列入所需外语，而所需的医疗保健专业人才可选择现役或是后备役。 根据军方规定，符合资格的申请者包括持E、F、H、I、J、K、L、M、O、P、Q、R、S、T、TD、TN、U、V签证以及目前 为政治庇护、难民、「临时庇护身分」(Temporary Protected Status)身分的人。 军方所需现役的医疗保健专业包括：一般牙医、口腔外科医生、综合牙医、儿科医生、心理医生、内科、家庭服务、普通外科、急诊医学、核科学人员、昆虫学家、有执照的临床 社会工作者、有执照的临床心理师、精神科和麻醉护士。 军方所需后备役的医疗保健专业包括一般牙医、综合牙医、镶牙师、口腔外科医生、预防医学、泌尿外科、麻醉、眼科、耳鼻喉科医生、精神病学、家庭医生、普通外科、胸外科 医生、整形外科医生、急诊医学、昆虫学家、临床心理师、医生助理和有执照的精神科护士。 根据 www.goarmy.com 网站，申请者目前须以合法身分在美，必须在申请时提供护照、I-94卡(入境卡)、I-797卡(延期或转换身分批准书)或是其他政府 部门发出的证明合法身分的文件。
f9347faccdb235ffe700d0b40b0a26360f731a4f.translatedText: MAVNI recruitment plan to get citizens in 10 weeks The military announced that it will restart the "Military Accessions Vital to the National Interest (MAVNI) program will last until October 2014. This program is designed to attract international students and foreign technical talents. Applicants with legal status can directly become citizens within ten weeks, bypassing the green card, but they must serve in the military for five years. Immigration lawyer Gao Tai pointed out that Chinese is a strategic language and is needed by the military. If the status of applicants with language advantages is legal, they can consider joining the military, and they can become citizens in ten weeks, but they must serve in the military for the next five years. The program mainly requires health care professionals who can speak 41 foreign languages other than English or hold some U.S. licenses. Chinese is listed as a required foreign language, and the required health care professionals can choose to be on active duty or in the reserve force. According to military regulations, eligible applicants include those holding E, F, H, I, J, K, L, M, O, P, Q, R, S, T, TD, TN, U, V visas and those currently with political asylum, refugee, and "Temporary asylum status." Protected Status. Health care professions required by the military for active duty include: general dentist, oral surgeon, general dentist, pediatrician, psychologist, internal medicine, family services, general surgery, emergency medicine, nuclear science personnel, entomologist, licensed clinical social worker, licensed clinical psychologist, psychiatric and nurse anesthetist. Health care professions required in the military reserve include general dentists, general dentists, orthodontists, oral surgeons, preventive medicine, urology, anesthesia, ophthalmology, otolaryngologists, psychiatry, family physicians, general surgery, thoracic surgeons, plastic surgeons, emergency medicine, entomologists, clinical psychologists, physician assistants and licensed psychiatric nurses, according to www.goarmy.com. Website, applicants must currently be in the United States legally and must provide their passport, I-94 card (arrival card), I-797 card (extension or change of status approval letter) or other documents issued by government departments to prove their legal status when applying.

18cb7356a5707db69d4d3705820f68baa650e04f.sourceText: 墨国男子因非法再进美国获刑10年 一名墨西哥男子因再次非法进入美国国境被判在联邦监狱服刑10年，刑满后将被驱逐出境。 45岁的本杰明洛佩斯帕蒂诺，因偷渡被捕，三月在图森的联邦法院认罪，上周三被判刑。帕蒂诺在 2003年因同样罪名被定罪，被判处8年徒刑。 美国边境巡逻队员于去年9月在托火诺奥奥咸音印第安保留地将其捉捕。
18cb7356a5707db69d4d3705820f68baa650e04f.translatedText: Mexican man sentenced to 10 years in prison for illegally re-entering the United States A Mexican man was sentenced to 10 years in federal prison for illegally re-entering the United States and will be deported upon completion of his sentence. Benjamin Lopez-Patino, 45, was sentenced last Wednesday after he pleaded guilty in federal court in Tucson in March after being arrested for smuggling. Patino was convicted of the same crime in 2003 and sentenced to eight years in prison. U.S. Border Patrol agents captured him last September on the Tohono O'Hainian Indian Reservation.

cad0f572222f01ef663f5e2984fc91985b547258.sourceText: KSAZ-TV主持人为直播男子自杀画面道歉 美国四大电视网福克斯加盟电视台，也即本地10频道KSAZ-TV，就近日在直播节目中播出一名男子自杀的画面表示道歉。 9月28日中午，福克斯10新闻使用直升机航拍凤城警察追逐一名疑犯的过程。该名男子在离加州边境80英里附近将车停下来，跑进沙漠，用手枪对准自己的头开枪。KSAZ-TV的视频没有按惯例将自杀场面剪辑，而同步到新闻节目中。 凤城警方发言人汤米汤普森军士说，被追捕的男子涉嫌当天上午在凤凰城一餐馆外用枪指吓一对夫妇，并抢走他们的汽车。警察在追捕过程中与该名男子对驳数枪，然后在10号州际公路上追逐。不料男子突然下车自杀，并当场身亡。 福克斯10新闻节目主持人谢尔德史密斯，稍后对观看直播节目的观众表示道歉，称类似事件不应当上电视直播。
cad0f572222f01ef663f5e2984fc91985b547258.translatedText: KSAZ-TV host apologized for live broadcast of man's suicide scene At noon on September 28, Fox 10 News used a helicopter to take aerial footage of Fengcheng police chasing a suspect. The man stopped his car 80 miles from the California border, ran into the desert, put a handgun to his head and shot himself. KSAZ-TV's video did not edit the suicide scene as usual, but was synchronized with the news program. Fengcheng police spokesman Sergeant Tommy Thompson said the man being chased allegedly threatened a couple with a gun outside a Phoenix restaurant that morning and stole their car. Police exchanged shots with the man several times during the pursuit, which then led to a chase on Interstate 10. Unexpectedly, the man suddenly got out of the car and committed suicide and died on the spot. Fox 10 News host Sheldon Smith later apologized to viewers who watched the live show, saying that similar incidents should not be broadcast live on television.

4bea78b83d1f81f2d8bf2d4f99e899694a47c59e.sourceText: 菲尼克斯市议会批准30条公交车路线重新恢复 （亚省时报） 上周凤凰城议会批准公交车变更，接近30条巴士路线，在修改后，旨在节省超过4.3百万美元。 在全市范围内的变化会影响当地的公共汽车和快速通勤服务。据凤凰交通官员，这些变化包括：路线1，3，7，8，10，13，17，17A，19，27，29，35，41，43，50，51，52，59，60，67， 70，90和154。这些小的路线，往往涉及社区里的短途环线，但循环时间较长。这样的环线将被淘汰。 延长路线8和67往南，8号干线到欧几里德大街和67号线到Lower Buckeye路以南。 路线16和80的修订，以减前往的Sunnyslope运输中心的车。将保持在16街的16号干线，并加入北亚利桑那州51高速公路。 80号线，北，将延长至16街。 消除由于低载客量的I-17轨道快速的服务。 所有快速路线，因为较低的使用效率，上周五改变了周五时间表。 此外，在南部山区的一个新的快速服务，在180天的试行。它会从27大道和基线路（Baseline Rd ）到凤凰城市区。所有的变化7月23日生效。
4bea78b83d1f81f2d8bf2d4f99e899694a47c59e.translatedText: Phoenix City Council approves 30 bus routes to be reinstated (Alberta Times) Phoenix City Council approved bus changes last week to bring back nearly 30 bus routes, with modifications aimed at saving more than $4.3 million. The city-wide changes will affect local bus and express commuter services. According to Phoenix transit officials, the changes include: Routes 1, 3, 7, 8, 10, 13, 17, 17A, 19, 27, 29, 35, 41, 43, 50, 51, 52, 59, 60, 67, 70, 90 and 154. These small routes often involve short loops in the community, but the cycle time is longer. Such loops will be eliminated. Extend Routes 8 and 67 south, Route 8 to Euclid Avenue and Route 67 to Lower Buckeye Road south. Routes 16 and 80 were revised to reduce traffic to the Sunnyslope Transportation Center. Will remain on Route 16 at 16th Street and join the Northern Arizona Highway 51. Route 80, North, will be extended to 16th Street. Eliminate express service on I-17 tracks due to low ridership. All express routes had their Friday timetables changed last Friday due to lower usage. In addition, a new express service in the southern mountains is on a 180-day trial. It will run from 27th Avenue and Baseline Rd into downtown Phoenix. All changes take effect July 23.

87dbe2887b26c9cdd9255f649e8c7fe21eb12569.sourceText: 据英国《每日邮报》2月13日报道，美国北达科他州一名18岁女子怀孕5个月后患上一种怪病，每天要像驴子那样叫30多次。 这名女子名叫科迪‧哈格尔（Cody Hagel），她从14岁开始就患上一种名为”多发性抽动症”（Tourette’s syndrome）的怪病。 在过去4年中，她的腿脚或头要抽动10到20次，但从未发出过怪声。 可是自从5个月前怀孕后，她的家人惊讶地发现她开始像驴那样叫，一天要30多次。 哈格尔与父母一起生活在北达科他州农场中，他们有两头分别叫奥利弗（Oliver）和雷切尔（Rachel）的毛驴。 它们可能是造成哈格尔苦恼的原因。 哈格尔是第一次当母亲，她担心会将这种疾病传给孩子。 她说：”我被告知，如果父母一方患有这种抽搐症，孩子有50%的几率也会发病。”她还希望用自己的经历帮助别人。
87dbe2887b26c9cdd9255f649e8c7fe21eb12569.translatedText: According to the British "Daily Mail" report on February 13, an 18-year-old woman in North Dakota, USA, developed a strange disease five months into her pregnancy and had to bray like a donkey more than 30 times a day. The woman’s name is Cody Hagel. She has been suffering from a strange disease called Tourette’s syndrome since she was 14 years old. Over the past 4 years, her legs, feet or head have twitched 10 to 20 times, but she has never made any strange noises. But after she became pregnant five months ago, her family was surprised to find that she began to bray like a donkey, more than 30 times a day. Hagel lives with his parents on a farm in North Dakota, where they have two donkeys named Oliver and Rachel. They may be the cause of Hagel's distress. Hagel was a first-time mother and worried about passing the disease on to her children. She said: "I was told that if one parent suffers from this tic, there is a 50% chance that the child will also develop it." She also hopes to use her experience to help others.

6a92ba3c366fded777d0bedcfb4b72be4a781980.sourceText: 半个美国像「蒸笼」 13人热死 大半个美国的民众有如置身蒸笼。图为一个孩童18日在内布拉斯加州亨利多立(Henry Doorly)动物园的水雾前消暑。(美联社) 美国中部(主要是平原区及中西部较北地区)周末期间遭危险热浪侵袭，有如置身蒸笼中。现在这股热浪正向东移动。国家气象局18日说，今后一周，涵盖美东大部分地区的「半个美国」都将笼罩在热浪下，备受华氏100度以上高温和高湿度的「煎熬」，对人构成危险。 国家气象局已对18州发出酷热警报，密苏里州已证实两个与热浪有关的死亡事件，堪萨斯市地区可能已有九人热死。中西部热死的人数可能已达13人。 AccuWeather气象网站天气预报员狄格(Bill Deger)说，预料美东95号州际公路(Interstate 95)沿线「走廊地带」的大城市，本周将出现今夏迄今的最高气温，纽约、费城、华府的气温可能达到100度，感觉温度将更高。热浪短期内还不会消退，预料反常的高温将持续一、二周。40余州本周将出现90多度的气温。 国家气象局说，「祸首」是广大地区出现的高气压，它使中部和东部大部分地区笼罩在又热又湿的气流下。高温使平原区和中西部偏北地区的居民感到酷热难当，但偏南一点的俄克拉何马州，情况更糟。俄克拉荷马市一连28天气温达到三位数字，炎热使路面凸起，损坏车辆，一条重要州际公路已有两个车道被迫关闭；养家禽的农人忙着保护禽类，放置电扇或在屋顶浇水去暑。 美东新泽西州18日已感受到热浪来袭，纽瓦克市(Newark)下午气温冲到97度，北阿灵顿市(North Arlington)下午1时30分的感觉温度达103度。许多地方也已一连三天气温高于90度。
6a92ba3c366fded777d0bedcfb4b72be4a781980.translatedText: Half of the United States is like a "steamer". 13 people died from the heat. Most of the people in the United States feel like they are in a steamer. The picture shows a child cooling off in front of the mist at the Henry Doorly Zoo in Nebraska on the 18th. (Associated Press) The central United States (mainly the plains and the northern parts of the Midwest) was hit by a dangerous heat wave over the weekend, which was like being in a steamer. Now this heat wave is moving eastward. The National Weather Service said on the 18th that in the next week, "half of the United States" covering most of the eastern United States will be shrouded in a heat wave, suffering "suffering" from high temperatures above 100 degrees Fahrenheit and high humidity, posing dangers to people. The National Weather Service has issued heat warnings for 18 states, and two heat wave-related deaths have been confirmed in Missouri, and nine people may have died from heat in the Kansas City area. The number of heat-related deaths in the Midwest may have reached 13. Bill Deger, a weather forecaster at the AccuWeather weather website, said that large cities in the "corridor" along Interstate 95 in the east are expected to experience the highest temperatures so far this summer this week. Temperatures in New York, Philadelphia, and Washington may reach 100 degrees, and it will feel even hotter. The heat wave will not subside in the short term, and the abnormally high temperatures are expected to continue for another week or two. More than 40 states will see temperatures in the 90s this week. The National Weather Service said the culprit was high pressure over a wide area, which blanketed much of the central and eastern regions with hot and humid air. The high temperatures have made it sweltering for residents in the Plains and the upper Midwest, but further south in Oklahoma, the situation is even worse. The temperature in Oklahoma City has reached triple digits for 28 days in a row. The heat has caused bumps on the road, damaged vehicles, and forced the closure of two lanes of an important interstate highway. Poultry farmers are busy protecting their birds, placing fans or watering their roofs to combat the heat. The eastern state of New Jersey in the United States already felt the heat wave on the 18th. The temperature in Newark reached 97 degrees in the afternoon, and the temperature in North Arlington reached 103 degrees at 1:30 p.m. Temperatures have been above 90 degrees in many places for three consecutive days.

379221e731ab595cf0166b555221847222dd904a.sourceText: 明年邮资将再度涨价。联邦邮政总局18日宣布，将自明年1月22日起，调涨邮资，普通信件(first-class mail)邮资将由44分涨到45分钱，每增加一盎斯加20分钱，和目前加计费用一样。 其他上涨的项目包括：明信片涨3分为32分。到墨西哥和加拿大的邮费涨为85分钱(涨5分)。寄到其他国家的信件涨7分，涨为1.05元。广告、期刊和包裹费将上涨约2.1%。 不过，邮局也将增加新服务，包括提供三个月短期邮箱租用，以及部分包裹的投递确认将免费。 根据法律，邮资上涨不得超过目前2.1%的通货膨胀率，除非邮政总局获得独立机构邮政管理委员会(PRC)的同意。 PRC去年拒绝邮政总局此一要求。 邮政总局2010会计年度亏损80亿元，邮局下月底将公布2011年业绩，预计亏损可能更多。 44分邮票价格自2009年5月生效。 2009年后大部分发行的邮票都是「永久」邮票。过去购买的「永久」邮票还是可以用来寄普通邮件。但是明年邮资涨价后，购买新的「永久」邮票将更贵。明年邮资涨价后，重量一盎斯的普通邮件邮资为45分。 邮局亏损的原因是邮局需负担退休员工未来医疗福利费用、经济衰退和网路导致邮局业务量减少。不过，邮资涨价对弥补亏损只是杯水车薪，帮助甚微。 邮政局长唐纳休表示：”邮局迫切需要该改变经营模式，使财务回归平衡。”
379221e731ab595cf0166b555221847222dd904a.translatedText: Postage prices will increase again next year. The Federal Postal Service announced on the 18th that it will increase postage rates starting from January 22 next year. The postage rate for first-class mail will increase from 44 cents to 45 cents, with an additional 20 cents for each additional ounce, which is the same as the current additional fee. Other items that increased include: Postcards rose 3 points to 32 points. Postage to Mexico and Canada has increased to 85 cents (up 5 cents). Letters sent to other countries rose 7 cents to $1.05. Advertising, journal and package fees will rise by approximately 2.1%. However, the post office will also add new services, including providing short-term mailbox rentals for three months, and delivery confirmation for some packages will be free. By law, postage increases cannot exceed the current inflation rate of 2.1 percent unless the Postal Service obtains approval from the Postal Regulatory Commission (PRC), an independent agency. The PRC rejected the Postal Service's request last year. The Postal Service suffered a loss of 8 billion yuan in fiscal year 2010. The Post Office will announce its 2011 results at the end of next month, and it is expected that the loss may be even greater. The price of 44-cent stamps is effective from May 2009. Most stamps issued after 2009 are "forever" stamps. "Forever" stamps purchased in the past can still be used to send regular mail. But when postage prices increase next year, buying new "forever" stamps will be more expensive. When postage increases next year, the postage for one-ounce regular mail will be 45 cents. The reason for the post office's loss is that it needs to bear the future medical benefit expenses of retired employees, the economic recession and the Internet have reduced the post office business volume. However, postage price increases are only a drop in the bucket and have little help in making up for losses. Postmaster General Donahue said: "The Post Office urgently needs to change its operating model and return to financial balance."

649db41f27f638bf448a20e784cd640fda2d19cc.sourceText: 追查海外逃税 联邦政府50亿美元入帐 （亚省时报） 自国税局（IRS）自2009年开始自首计划后，IRS已经自这些利用海外帐户追回了逾50亿美元。 IRS的自首方案要求利用海外帐户逃税的美国公民提供其帐户信息，并要补交税款，但可以避免坐牢和减少处罚。第一个自首计划是在2009年推出的，第二个是在2011年。今年一月，该IRS推出了第三个自首计划。 周二IRS宣布，到目前为止，已有33,000名纳税人透过前两项自首计划，补交了50亿美元的税款、利息和罚款。 而今年一月公布的新自首计划也已吸引了1,500名纳税人，估计会为国税局带来更多的钱。今年一月， IRS宣布，已自前两个自首计划收到了44亿美元，这意味着自一月以来，这两项自首计划有6亿美元进帐。 目前最新的自首计划没有截止限期，但是可以随时关闭。透露国外帐户的纳税人须缴交相当于近八年帐户最高余额27.5％的罚款。在2011年时，当时的自首计划的罚款率是25％。 小帐户的纳税人，惩罚利率较低，范围在5％到12.5％。现在的自首计划与以前一样，纳税人可以避免坐牢。不过，目下的计划仍需要逃税者，补交长达8年的税款，利息及逾期手续费。 不愿披露国外帐户的逃税者一旦被国税局发现，会有监禁的风险和高达50％的惩罚利率，如果有诈欺行为，罚款率可能更高。
649db41f27f638bf448a20e784cd640fda2d19cc.translatedText: Pursuit of overseas tax evasion nets federal government $5 billion (Alberta Times) Since the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) began its surrender program in 2009, the IRS has recovered more than $5 billion from overseas accounts. The IRS's surrender program requires U.S. citizens who use overseas accounts to evade taxes to provide their account information and pay back taxes, but can avoid jail time and reduce penalties. The first surrender scheme was launched in 2009 and the second in 2011. In January of this year, the IRS launched its third surrender program. The IRS announced on Tuesday that so far, 33,000 taxpayers have paid $5 billion in back taxes, interest and penalties through the first two surrender programs. The new surrender program announced in January this year has attracted 1,500 taxpayers and is expected to bring more money to the IRS. In January of this year, the IRS announced that it had received $4.4 billion from the first two surrender programs, which means that since January, the two surrender programs have received $600 million. The latest surrender program currently has no deadline, but can be closed at any time. Taxpayers who disclose foreign accounts must pay a penalty equal to 27.5% of the highest account balance in the past eight years. In 2011, the fine rate for the surrender scheme was 25%. For taxpayers with small accounts, the penalty interest rate is lower, ranging from 5% to 12.5%. The surrender program is now the same as before and taxpayers can avoid jail time. However, the current plan still requires tax evaders to pay back taxes, interest and overdue fees for up to eight years. Tax evaders who are unwilling to disclose foreign accounts risk jail time and a penalty rate of up to 50% if discovered by the IRS. If there is fraud, the penalty rate may be higher.

af730a49304aa250e96f74dd24324838fed798be.sourceText: 选区重划召开26个听证会 亚利桑那州的选区重划委员会将在全州范围内举办26个听证会，收集公众意见，为本州的国会议员和州议员选举重新划分选区。 第一次听证会已于本周二在凤凰学院举行，接下来是佩森、旗杆埠等城市。 最后的听证会将于11月5日在绿谷举行。 本月早些时候，该委员会投票3-1批准9个国会议员选区，其中涉及5个根深蒂固的共和党与2个稳扎的民主党选区。 州长和其他共和党官员批评该草案不公平，只对民主党人有利。 民主党人则称布鲁尔故意打压委员会。
af730a49304aa250e96f74dd24324838fed798be.translatedText: 26 hearings were held for redistricting Arizona's Redistricting Commission will hold 26 hearings across the state to gather public input on redistricting for the state's congressional and state legislative elections. The first hearing was held at Phoenix College on Tuesday, followed by Payson, Flagstaff and other cities. The final hearing will be held on November 5 in Green Valley. Earlier this month, the committee voted 3-1 to approve nine congressional districts, involving five solidly Republican and two solidly Democratic districts. The governor and other Republican officials criticized the draft as unfair and only benefiting Democrats. Democrats said Brewer deliberately suppressed the committee.

80ef19eeb5c2ef0743e79fa525ae789d6f862db4.sourceText: 美加6日凌晨2点进入冬令时 11月6日凌晨2点开始，美国和加拿大将进入冬令时，届时需将时钟调慢1小时。打电话给美东和加拿大的朋友，记住哦。 目前全世界有近110个国家每年要实行夏令时。美国和加拿大的夏令时，都是从3月的第二个星期日开始，至11月的第一个星期日结束。而欧洲国家仍将在10月最后一周开始实施冬令时。 美国夏时制实行与否，完全由各州各郡自己决定。美国不实行夏令时的地区包括：亚利桑那州的大部份地区、夏威夷州、波多黎各和维京群岛美属萨摩亚、关岛和北马里亚纳群岛。 加拿大好几个处于时区边界的地区（包括萨斯喀彻温省大部份地区和其他几个较小地区）不实施夏时制。另外，加拿大除纽芬兰外各省都跟美国一样在02:00拨钟。
80ef19eeb5c2ef0743e79fa525ae789d6f862db4.translatedText: >The United States and Canada will enter winter time at 2 a.m. on the 6th. Starting at 2 a.m. on November 6, the United States and Canada will enter winter time, and the clocks will need to be set back one hour. Call your friends in the Eastern United States and Canada and remember. Currently, nearly 110 countries around the world implement daylight saving time every year. Daylight saving time in the United States and Canada begins on the second Sunday in March and ends on the first Sunday in November. European countries will still implement winter time in the last week of October. Whether or not to implement daylight saving time in the United States is entirely up to each state and county. Areas in the United States that do not observe daylight saving time include: most of Arizona, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, and the Virgin Islands, American Samoa, Guam, and the Northern Mariana Islands. Several areas in Canada that are on time zone boundaries (including most of Saskatchewan and several other smaller areas) do not observe daylight saving time. In addition, all Canadian provinces except Newfoundland set the clock at 02:00 like the United States.

d759dc434c586775a0a8dcf32de95b32bc3dd332.sourceText: 美国国家公园管理处周一宣布，它已批准了一项计划，在 30 日内停止一次性瓶装水出售。因為這些一次性罐子造成了园区约 20 ％和 30 ％的废物回收。 在水站，游客可以使用可持续灌水的容器，虽然该禁令不会阻止顧客攜帶一次性瓶子進入园区。 在 2010 年底，园区服务总监 Jon 贾维斯曾颁发，一次性容器在大峡谷的禁令。一个公园前院长提出了质疑，他质疑可口可乐有限公司和某一次性瓶子生产者，影响了公园的服务质量。但是，该机构和可口可乐否认这一质疑。 贾维斯最近公布一项政策，概述公园管理者如何制定一个禁令。
d759dc434c586775a0a8dcf32de95b32bc3dd332.translatedText: The U.S. National Park Service announced on Monday that it has approved a plan to stop the sale of single-use bottled water within 30 days. Because these single-use cans account for approximately 20% and 30% of the park’s waste recycling. At water stations, visitors can use sustainably filled containers, although the ban will not prevent patrons from bringing single-use bottles into the park. In late 2010, Park Services Director Jon Jarvis had issued a ban on single-use containers in the Grand Canyon. A former director of the park raised questions. He questioned Coca-Cola Co. and a certain disposable bottle manufacturer, which affected the quality of the park's service. However, the agency and Coca-Cola denied this challenge. Jarvis recently unveiled a policy outlining how park managers can enact a ban.

92293f36716776f682bd0f66d38b6d104ea67812.sourceText: 亚利桑那省10月失业率下降 10月，亚利桑那州的失业率略有下降，各行业新的就业机会都有增加，特别是医疗保健，零售和建筑方面。 据政府报告，10月的失业率为9.0%，下降了一个百分点，增加了15500个非农就业人数。其中教育和卫生服务就添加了3900个就业机会。其次是贸易，运输和公用事业部门，增加3000个工作岗位。建筑行业，受房市压抑影响多时，上个月是继9月后第二个月增长，有2300人获得工作。
92293f36716776f682bd0f66d38b6d104ea67812.translatedText: Arizona's unemployment rate fell in October Arizona's unemployment rate fell slightly in October, with new job creation increasing across all industries, especially health care, retail and construction. The government reported that the unemployment rate in October was 9.0%, down one percentage point, with an increase of 15,500 nonfarm payrolls. Among them, education and health services added 3,900 job opportunities. This was followed by the trade, transportation and utilities sector, which added 3,000 jobs. The construction industry, which has long suffered from a depressed housing market, grew last month for the second month after September, with 2,300 people gaining jobs.

6ad7648723e079dd17c5fa2cb5211431f57e3e34.sourceText: 领福利先药检 本州立法26州跟进 鑑於許多企業主抱怨，有些應徵的失業勞工因無法通過藥物檢驗，而無法雇用，全國州議會協會指出，目前全美有27個州考慮在今年立法，將要求接受政府失業福利等各種援助的受益人，必須通過藥物檢驗，但此舉將有違憲之虞。 今日美國報報導，南卡羅萊納州參議會勞工、商業和工業委員會主席皮勒今年2月即提出一項法案，將對無法通過藥物檢驗的失業勞工，停止發放失業救濟金。該法案上周由州眾議會通過後，已送交州參議會審議。不過，美國公民自由聯盟刑法改革計畫主任羅提表示，要求通過藥物檢驗，以做為發放政府福利條件的法律，將違反憲法。羅提指出，聯邦最高法院在1989年已裁定，包含隨機藥物檢驗的「非可疑搜查」，違反憲法第四修正案保障人民不受無理的搜索和扣押，除非有公共安全等特別需要。 然而，許多州仍在推動類似的法案。本州正在通過一項法案，要求所有接受政府福利的受益人，必須接受隨機藥物檢驗。 另外，佛羅里達州自3月以來，已提出三項類似的法案。該州共和黨州長史考特並表示：「他絕對支持藥物檢驗。」麻州也提出一項法案，要求接受政府援助的民眾接受隨機藥物檢驗，如果檢測結果為陽性反應，必須參加勒戒計畫。全國州議會協會公關主任梅根杜席表示，包括紐約州、康州和加州在內逾20個州，亦在考慮類似的立法。
6ad7648723e079dd17c5fa2cb5211431f57e3e34.translatedText: 26 states have followed suit in enacting drug tests before receiving benefits. In view of the complaints from many business owners that some unemployed workers cannot be hired because they cannot pass drug tests, the National Association of State Legislatures pointed out that 27 states in the United States are currently considering legislation this year that will require recipients of various assistance such as government unemployment benefits to pass drug tests. However, this move will be unconstitutional. USA Today reported that Peeler, chairman of the South Carolina Senate Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee, introduced a bill in February this year that would stop unemployment benefits for unemployed workers who cannot pass drug tests. The bill has been sent to the state Senate for consideration after being passed by the state House of Representatives last week. However, Roti, director of the American Civil Liberties Union's Criminal Law Reform Project, said that a law requiring passing a drug test as a condition for receiving government benefits would be unconstitutional. Roty pointed out that the Supreme Court ruled in 1989 that "non-suspicious searches" involving random drug testing violate the Fourth Amendment's protection against unreasonable searches and seizures, unless there is a special need for public safety. However, many states are still pushing for similar bills. The state is passing a bill that would require all recipients of government benefits to submit to random drug testing. In addition, Florida has introduced three similar bills since March. Scott, the state's Republican governor, also said: "He absolutely supports drug testing." Massachusetts has also proposed a bill that would require people receiving government assistance to undergo random drug testing. If the test result is positive, they must participate in a detoxification program. Meghan Douchy, communications director for the National Association of State Legislatures, said more than 20 states, including New York, Connecticut and California, are also considering similar legislation.

b8a6aed98fb8d4a28cb8266c91b53ca75dceaa21.sourceText: 星期二晚，一场罕见的巨大沙尘暴席卷了菲尼克斯地区，所过之处沙尘遮天蔽日，仿佛2012世界末日提前降临。 沙尘暴大约于晚7时30分形成。高达一英里，宽50英里的尘暴以时速30英里的速度刮过，致使凤凰城国际机场关闭一个小时。 强劲的沙尘暴甚至吹进了机场的行李领取区。 10号高速公路的能见度一度只有几个英尺。凤凰城消防队在沙尘暴期间收到多达700个求救电话。消防队的发言人 SCOTT WALKER队长说：”我们有所准备。当沙尘暴来临时，我们有一整套的应对措施”. 尘暴还引起部分地区电力供应中断。在TEMPE，警员们在失去电力的路口兢兢业业地疏导交通。尘暴还在RURAL和SOURTHEN交界引起火灾，不过被马上扑灭。在CHANDLER市CHANDLER路和ARIZONA路路口有九棵树被吹翻。警员们已用电锯和拖车将废墟清理干净。 据当地人反映，他们在这里住了30年，从没见过这么剧烈的沙尘暴。
b8a6aed98fb8d4a28cb8266c91b53ca75dceaa21.translatedText: >On Tuesday night, a rare and huge sandstorm swept through the Phoenix area. The sand and dust covered the sky and the sun in its path, as if the end of the world in 2012 had come early. The sandstorm formed around 7:30 p.m. A mile-high and 50-mile-wide dust devil blew through at 30 mph, shutting down Phoenix International Airport for an hour. The powerful sandstorm even blew into the baggage claim area of ​​the airport. Visibility on Highway 10 was down to a few feet at one point. The Phoenix Fire Department received as many as 700 calls for help during the dust storm. Fire brigade spokesman Captain SCOTT WALKER said: "We are prepared. When the dust storm comes, we have a complete set of response measures." The dust storm also caused power supply interruptions in some areas. In TEMPE, police officers worked diligently to divert traffic at intersections that lost power. The dust storm also caused a fire at the junction of RURAL and SOURTHEN, but it was put out immediately. Nine trees were blown down at the intersection of CHANDLER Road and ARIZONA Road in Chandler City. Officers used chainsaws and tow trucks to clear away the debris. According to local reports, they have lived here for 30 years and have never seen such a violent sandstorm.

b68c576fb251ee9ce2b41086571a3927fd783ea1.translatedText: At around 5:30 that day, the Yangmingtan Bridge in Harbin, which had been opened to traffic for less than a year, broke, causing four large trucks to fall from the bridge. According to the fire department, 3 people have been killed and 5 injured.

77b62d5a2fb748b3850bae31f78a85bc8b2d585e.sourceText: 据了解，阳明滩大桥是目前我国长江以北地区桥梁长度最长的超大型跨江桥，于2011年11月6日通车。它北起松北区三环路与世贸大道交叉口，南下跨越松花江航道与三环高架路衔接，全长15.42公里，桥宽41.5米，双向8车道，设计时速80公里，最大可满足高峰期每小时9800辆机动车通行。 (完)
77b62d5a2fb748b3850bae31f78a85bc8b2d585e.translatedText: It is understood that the Yangmingtan Bridge is currently the longest super-large cross-river bridge north of the Yangtze River in my country. It was opened to traffic on November 6, 2011. It starts from the intersection of the Third Ring Road and Shimao Avenue in Songbei District in the north, and crosses the Songhua River channel in the south to connect with the Third Ring Elevated Road. It has a total length of 15.42 kilometers, a bridge width of 41.5 meters, two-way eight lanes, and a design speed of 80 kilometers per hour. It can meet the maximum traffic of 9,800 motor vehicles per hour during peak periods. (over)

d5690325f464c55043376eb4f9dc281691661bf3.sourceText: 电子控制系统问题 克莱斯勒召回逾12万辆车 （亚省时报） 美国安全监管部门周一表示，克莱斯勒集团正在美国和加拿大召回127,350辆最新型的道奇（Dodge）Charger和克莱斯勒300S汽车，原因是电子稳定控制系统和防制动系统有潜在问题。 克莱斯勒的最大股东菲亚特车厂表示，至今并没有由于上述问题，造成任何意外事故，伤害或火灾。 公司向联邦公路交通安全管理局（NHTSA）提出的报告显示，此次召回影响了2011-2012年车型，这些车都是在2011年12月20日前生产。文件称，在车辆的配电中心里，有一保险丝可能会过热，因而导致失去控制，增加了造成意外的风险。 克莱斯勒汽车公司将免费解决这问题。召回通知将于本月发出。文件称，克莱斯勒在密西根州检测一辆警车时，发现了这问题，后来检查一般消费者用的汽车，也有同样问题。文件中表示，有问题的系统的制造商是全球汽车系统（Global Automotive Systems）。 估计召回影响在美国的119,072辆汽车，和在加拿大的8,274辆汽车。
d5690325f464c55043376eb4f9dc281691661bf3.translatedText: Electronic control system problems Chrysler recalled more than 120,000 vehicles (Alberta Times) Chrysler Group is recalling 127,350 late-model Dodge Charger and Chrysler 300S vehicles in the United States and Canada because of potential problems with electronic stability control and anti-braking systems, U.S. safety regulators said on Monday. Fiat, Chrysler's largest shareholder, said it has not yet seen any accidents, injuries or fires caused by the above problems. The company's report to the Federal Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) shows that the recall affects 2011-2012 model years, which were all manufactured before December 20, 2011. The document said a fuse in the vehicle's power distribution center could overheat, causing a loss of control and increasing the risk of an accident. Chrysler will fix the problem free of charge. The recall notice will be issued this month. The document said Chrysler discovered the problem when it inspected a police car in Michigan, and later inspected consumer cars and found the same problem. The manufacturer of the system in question is Global Automotive Systems, the filing said. The recall affects an estimated 119,072 vehicles in the United States and 8,274 vehicles in Canada.

9c529e6f471f427d2bf015d2daf305be1103e412.translatedText: More than 60 painters jointly painted "New Fuchun Mountain Residence" [Abstract] After many efforts, the "Remaining Mountains" and "Wuyongshi Volume" of "Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains" will be reunited for the first time since their separation at the National Palace Museum in Taipei in June this year...

249ca65468cf0549f41690698db1291dff6b6ccc.sourceText: 经过多方努力，《富春山居图》之《剩山图》与《无用师卷》，将于今年6月份，在台北故宫博物院，迎来它们分别后的首次重逢。

c845ea231feb262fad84779c06742fd4ffc2ea26.sourceText: 而一幅《新富春山居图》，更将永久合璧。
c845ea231feb262fad84779c06742fd4ffc2ea26.translatedText: And the "New Fuchun Mountain Dwelling" will be combined forever.

00cca587f7f1f9150aacafbcdf8f466329ed27e5.sourceText: 昨天，国务院参事室、中央文史研究馆等在桐庐举行新闻通报会说，来自海峡两岸及香港、澳门等地的60余位国内顶尖画家，将联手绘制一幅新版的《富春山居图》，这幅《新富春山居图》将于今年6月完成创作，9月份在北京国家博物馆进行首展后到台湾等地巡展。
00cca587f7f1f9150aacafbcdf8f466329ed27e5.translatedText: Yesterday, the Counselor's Office of the State Council and the Central Research Institute of Literature and History held a press briefing in Tonglu, saying that more than 60 top domestic painters from across the Taiwan Strait, Hong Kong, Macau and other places will join forces to draw a new version of "Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains". This "New Fuchun Mountain Dwelling" will be completed in June this year, and will be exhibited in Taiwan and other places after its first exhibition at the National Museum in Beijing in September.

4be08420f2c98fa0b5dab76f05065f8343eb6096.sourceText: 36米长 名家集体创作之最
4be08420f2c98fa0b5dab76f05065f8343eb6096.translatedText: 36 meters long The best collective creation by famous artists

703f6fddd4b0a7b25e42cb51d5e13560bee5e29c.sourceText: 中央文史研究馆馆员赵德润说，整个创作采风活动从去年11月中旬开始正式启动，规划创作的《新富春山居图》横3600厘米，意含烧成两段360年后再合璧；纵60厘米，取意于分藏两岸60年又合璧展出。
703f6fddd4b0a7b25e42cb51d5e13560bee5e29c.translatedText: Zhao Derun, a librarian of the Central Research Institute of Literature and History, said that the entire creative collection activity was officially launched in mid-November last year. The planned creation of "New Fuchun Mountain Dwelling" is 3600 centimeters in width, which means that it was fired in two parts and then reassembled after 360 years; and 60 centimeters in length, which means that it was collected and displayed on both sides of the Taiwan Strait after 60 years.

1533e4a827bc872b338035836de9e470de5bd8c3.sourceText: 据了解，这是当代最长的由名家集体创作的经典书画长卷。
1533e4a827bc872b338035836de9e470de5bd8c3.translatedText: It is understood that this is the longest classic calligraphy and painting scroll in contemporary times created by a collective of famous artists.

b9dabdc82fcb6f65a8fddb613b84e5020107bd2f.sourceText: 集体创作《新富春山居图》的60余位画家，名气都很大。全国政协委员、中央文史研究馆馆员、著名山水画家宋雨桂和改革开放后第一个到大陆举办画展的台湾画家江明贤，分别担任长卷的大陆主笔和台湾主笔。此外，李小可、李庚、陈佩秋、梁平波等，都是有代表性的画家。
b9dabdc82fcb6f65a8fddb613b84e5020107bd2f.translatedText: The more than 60 painters who collectively created "Dwelling in the Mountains in New Fuchun" are all very famous. Song Yugui, a member of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, a librarian of the Central Research Institute of Literature and History, and a famous landscape painter, and Jiang Mingxian, the first Taiwanese painter to hold an art exhibition in the mainland after the reform and opening up, served as the mainland and Taiwanese main writers of the long scroll respectively. In addition, Li Xiaoke, Li Geng, Chen Peiqiu, Liang Pingbo, etc. are all representative painters.

32724bdb5ee93d4b708f19cf4c90ed9b7ae2c9b2.sourceText: 从地区分布来看，目前表示参与的台湾画家有11人、港澳地区和海外7人、大陆各省市40多人，其中浙江最多，有10多人，如潘公凯、卓鹤君、姜宝林、张捷、陈向迅等。
32724bdb5ee93d4b708f19cf4c90ed9b7ae2c9b2.translatedText: From the perspective of regional distribution, there are currently 11 Taiwanese painters, 7 from Hong Kong, Macao and overseas, and more than 40 people from various provinces and cities in mainland China who have expressed participation. Among them, Zhejiang has the most with more than 10 people, such as Pan Gongkai, Zhuo Hejun, Jiang Baolin, Zhang Jie, Chen Xiangxun, etc.

cb0e364f73e7d14d67dd4545c414fb9212a3c71b.translatedText: is 70%~80% completed. The first exhibition in Beijing in September

b9bb88f11da3bb10498cb243a8eb5a964fb57aa5.sourceText: 发布会刚刚结束，记者赶紧拦住大陆主笔宋雨桂，记者问他，《新富春山居图》跟原版的《富春山居图》有什么关系，对方一听，先是卖了个关子：”既有关系，又没关系。”随后，他慢慢道来：这有关系说的是，描绘的都是富春山流域的美丽风景；没关系说的是，这幅画不是简单的临摹，毕竟现代的富春江已经跟黄公望创作时期的富春江有了质的变化，所以，新的创作将融入时代的精神，反映富春江的新景象，”内容会给人向上的感觉”，宋雨桂说。
b9bb88f11da3bb10498cb243a8eb5a964fb57aa5.translatedText: The press conference has just ended. The reporter quickly stopped Song Yugui, the main author from mainland China, and asked him what the relationship between "New Fuchun Mountain Dwelling" and the original "Fuchun Mountain Dwelling" was. Upon hearing this, the other party immediately sold it: "It is related, but it does not matter. "Then he slowly said: What matters is that it depicts the beautiful scenery of the Fuchun Mountain Basin; what matters is that this painting is not a simple copy. After all, the modern Fuchun River has undergone qualitative changes from the Fuchun River during Huang Gongwang's creation. Therefore, the new creation will incorporate the spirit of the times and reflect the new scene of the Fuchun River. "The content will give people an upward feeling," Song Yugui said.

4a890af4d15e60e6d13ba3a622f07778cbc7a7d2.sourceText: 宋雨桂还透露，目前，长卷的主体部分已经完成了70%~80%的创作。”参与这次创作的都是很有个性的画家，他们将根据采风的内容作画，最后融入到《新富春山居图》中。”
4a890af4d15e60e6d13ba3a622f07778cbc7a7d2.translatedText: Song Yugui also revealed that at present, 70% to 80% of the main part of the long scroll has been completed. "The painters who participated in this creation are all very individual painters. They will paint based on the content of the collection, and finally integrate it into the "New Fuchun Mountain Dwelling Picture"."

baf104e2ee1a2f1ca2fcbb38afb69e31bc1aefaf.sourceText: 昨天下午，画家们纷纷开始在桐庐富春江流域进行采风。在之前的采风中，有关部门还采取过租用直升飞机的方式组织画家沿富春江采风，让画家从不同的角度来看富春江。
baf104e2ee1a2f1ca2fcbb38afb69e31bc1aefaf.translatedText: Yesterday afternoon, the painters began to collect collections in the Fuchun River Basin in Tonglu. In previous collections, relevant departments also rented helicopters to organize painters to collect scenery along the Fuchun River, allowing the painters to see the Fuchun River from different angles.

867f82b0940a6fd74a3743b67b95d3b9651e2308.sourceText: 据了解，《新富春山居图》预计于今年6月完成创作，9月在北京国家博物馆举行首展，随后到台湾等地巡展。
867f82b0940a6fd74a3743b67b95d3b9651e2308.translatedText: It is understood that "Dwelling in the New Fuchun Mountains" is expected to be completed in June this year, and will have its first exhibition at the National Museum in Beijing in September, and will then tour to Taiwan and other places.

ae729de9c14bc252379534f089174fe5670b1fad.sourceText: 30架私人飞机 追踪偷渡走私 執法機構使用直升機和飛機從事空中偵察，不是新鮮事。但紐約時報15日報導，亞利桑納州以嚴厲對付非法移民著稱的馬里考帕郡警長阿帕約，擁有自己的「空軍」，籌組30架私人飛機加入「空中民團」，追蹤非法移民偷渡和毒品走私犯。 報導指出，這項代號為「沙漠天空作業」的行動已展開兩周，民間飛機的駕駛在本州中部的上空盤旋偵察，充當馬利科巴郡警長辦公室的耳目。目前，空中偵察尚未導致任何移民或毒販被捕，但阿帕約說，此種巡邏將有嚇阻作用。 儘管嚴苛對付非法移民的法律在法庭遭到挫敗，聯邦當局仍在針對阿帕約的執法作風進行兩項調查，稽核人員從本周公布的預算發現他濫用將近1億元，阿帕約依舊我行我素，繼續窮追非法移民並藉此做秀，絕不退縮。籌組「阿帕約空軍」生動刻畫了他的本色。 阿帕約用他一貫的粗率語氣告訴紐約時報：「大家又說，這是一個爭議性計畫，但我認為根本沒有爭議。該做就做。」 馬利科巴郡幅員廣大，面積跟某些州一樣大，全美第六大都市鳳凰城就在它的境內。該郡預算官員13日發現，阿帕約的部門把應用於管理監獄的將近1億元經費，挪做他用，包括支付幫他執行有爭議行動的副警長的薪資，像是調查人口偷渡和揭發貪腐。 阿帕約把稽核查出錯誤，歸咎於會計作業失誤，並指控批評人士企圖借題發揮。他拒絕出席預算聽證，而前往美沙市做秀，讓媒體看到他的副警長帶走六名被控使用不實身分找工作，因而違反州法的婦女。
ae729de9c14bc252379534f089174fe5670b1fad.translatedText: >30 private planes to track smuggling. The use of helicopters and aircraft for aerial reconnaissance by law enforcement agencies is not new. However, the New York Times reported on the 15th that Arizona’s Maricopa County Sheriff Arpaio, who is known for his harsh treatment of illegal immigrants, has his own “air force” and organized 30 private planes to join the “air militia” to track illegal immigrant smuggling and drug smugglers. Reports indicate that the operation, codenamed "Desert Sky Operations," has been underway for two weeks, with pilots of private aircraft circling and conducting reconnaissance over central parts of the state, acting as the eyes and ears of the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office. The aerial surveillance has not yet led to the arrest of any immigrants or drug traffickers, but Arpaio said such patrols would have a deterrent effect. Although strict laws against illegal immigration have been defeated in court, federal authorities are still conducting two investigations into Arpaio's law enforcement style. Auditors found from the budget released this week that he misused nearly 100 million yuan. Arpaio still goes his own way, continues to pursue illegal immigrants and use it as a show, and will not back down. Organizing the "Arpaio Air Force" vividly portrays his true character. Arpaio told the New York Times in his usual curt tone: "People say this is a controversial plan, but I don't think it is controversial at all. Just do it." Maricopa County is a vast area, as big as some states, and Phoenix, the sixth largest city in the United States, is within its borders. County budget officials discovered on the 13th that Arpaio's department diverted nearly $100 million in funds intended to run the jail for other purposes, including paying the salaries of deputy sheriffs who helped him carry out controversial operations, such as investigating human smuggling and exposing corruption. Arpaio blamed the audit errors on accounting errors and accused critics of trying to exploit the situation. He refused to attend a budget hearing and instead went to Mesa City to put on a show, allowing the media to watch as his deputy sheriffs took away six women accused of violating state law by using false identities to get jobs.

20c4ad63bc90b811a98f76284e1055a501defd7f.translatedText: Ranking of safe states in the United States, Maine ranks first, with 46 in Alberta (Alberta Times) The latest survey shows that Maine has become the safest state in the United States. According to reports, although Hollywood...

1e7e9fc68b869a0dbb3887aced0ac3c9b6c1f02f.sourceText: 最新调查显示，缅因州成为全美最安全的州。报道称，虽然好莱坞和新闻媒体往往将美国描绘成为一个帮派林立，犯罪猖獗的大熔炉。星期二，经济与和平研究所公布的和平指数却显示，如今的美国与20年前相比更安全。 研究称，过去20年内，直接暴力犯罪率大减，自1991年起，凶杀率减半。一些州的安全程度高于其他州，缅因州位于和平指数表之首，路易斯安那则最低，亚省46位。 执法部门每年花4600亿美元来遏制暴力活动的发生，关押罪犯所花每位纳税人的钱为3217美元。经济与和平研究所主任史蒂夫说：”这次研究确实表明，美国比大家想象的更安全。”他还表示，媒体在塑造美国的暴力形象方面，发挥着作用，”事情很复杂，一些主张采取强硬执法政策的政治人物，发现他们的计划和需要获得安全感的人们产生共鸣。” 其他上榜的安全州分别是佛蒙特州（第2位）紧随其后的是新罕布什尔州，明尼苏达，犹他州，北达科塔州，华盛顿，夏威夷，罗得岛和爱荷华。除了路易斯安那外，最不安全的州还有田纳西州，内华达州，佛罗里达州，亚利桑那州（46位），密苏里，德克萨斯，阿肯色州，南卡罗来纳州，密西西比州和阿拉巴马州。 亚利桑那州排名垫底，亚省的城市排名也不高，凤凰城-美莎-格兰岱大都会排在20，麻省的剑桥则是最和平的都会城市。 研究显示，地方的因素在很大程度上影响了该地的安全度，比如纽约和新泽西，这两个地方拥有大批的警力。南部地区是美国最不安全的地方，该地区暴力犯罪率最高，罪犯关押率最高，枪支拥有率也最高。
1e7e9fc68b869a0dbb3887aced0ac3c9b6c1f02f.translatedText: The latest survey shows that Maine has become the safest state in the United States. According to the report, although Hollywood and the news media often portray the United States as a melting pot filled with gangs and rampant crime. On Tuesday, the Peace Index released by the Institute for Economics and Peace showed that the United States is safer today than it was 20 years ago. According to the study, direct violent crime rates have dropped significantly over the past 20 years, with the homicide rate halving since 1991. Some states are safer than others, with Maine at the top of the Peace Index, Louisiana at the bottom, and Alberta at 46th. Law enforcement spends $460 billion each year to curb violence, and it costs each taxpayer $3,217 to lock up criminals. Steve, director of the Institute for Economics and Peace, said: "This study does show that the United States is safer than everyone thinks." He also said that the media plays a role in shaping the image of violence in the United States. "Things are complicated, and some politicians who advocate tough law enforcement policies find that their plans resonate with people who need to feel safe." The other safe states on the list are Vermont (No. 2), followed by New Hampshire, Minnesota, Utah, North Dakota, Washington, Hawaii, Rhode Island and Iowa. In addition to Louisiana, the least safe states are Tennessee, Nevada, Florida, Arizona (46th), Missouri, Texas, Arkansas, South Carolina, Mississippi and Alabama. Arizona ranks at the bottom, and cities in Alberta are not ranked high either. The Phoenix-Mesa-Glendale metropolitan area ranks 20th, and Cambridge, Massachusetts, is the most peaceful metropolitan city. Studies show that local factors, such as New York and New Jersey, which have large police presences, greatly influence safety. The South is the most unsafe place in the United States, with the highest rates of violent crime, the highest rates of criminal incarceration, and the highest gun ownership rates.

fd2211c51595756b4a08fad447035e403668ccc3.sourceText: 自8月份起，省时报报迈开报业发展的新一步，由每周一期增至每周两期，逢周三、周五出版。 二十年来，由半月报到周报，如今一周两报，逐步加版增期，不断加快见报的时间性，让报纸尽可能地适应飞跃发展的时势，这是本报稳健前进之路。 近两个月，不少读者来电来函来稿，表示支持这种识时势，认清当今华人社区多元化的结构的需要，重视广大数读者的对中文报纸的期盼，从而克服困难，为加版 增期创造条件，有力地促进中文媒体素质的提高，提升为当地华人社区服务的水准。 读者赞扬说，出版一周两期，都是读者所喜闻乐见的。 新发行的周三版，送达发行点，每期行销一空。 有的读者，从本地和外州寄订单来新订一周两报或加订周三版。 面对大众的鼓励和鞭策，我们都看成是要求把一周两报办好的推动力。 本报编辑部正在加强周三版下苦功。 近期，拟在原设有”国际”、”中国”、”港澳台湾”、”健康，养生”、”社区消息” 专版等基础，增加”亚省简明新闻”，加强”美西侨社动态” 等专欗，更好为当地华人侨胞服务。 为了让广大热爱本报的读者，共同享用一周两报社会效益，从1​​0月份起，特别赠送（加寄）每一长期订户一份周三出版报纸。 同时，热烈欢迎新订加订。 日后． 长期订户，均按一周寄二期，一年104期)计算，全年共$50。 零取报费，周五的一期25￠；周三的一期10 ￠。
fd2211c51595756b4a08fad447035e403668ccc3.translatedText: Since August, the Provincial Times has taken a new step in the development of the newspaper industry, increasing from one issue per week to two issues per week, published on Wednesdays and Fridays. Over the past 20 years, it has moved from semi-monthly newspapers to weekly newspapers, and now to twice-weekly newspapers, gradually increasing the number of pages and issues, constantly accelerating the timeliness of newspaper publication, and allowing the newspaper to adapt to the rapid development of the times as much as possible. This is the steady path forward for this newspaper. In the past two months, many readers have called and written articles, expressing their support for the need to understand the current situation, recognize the needs of the diversified structure of today's Chinese community, and pay attention to the expectations of the majority of digital readers for Chinese newspapers, thereby overcoming difficulties and creating conditions for additional editions and issues, effectively promoting the improvement of the quality of Chinese media and improving the level of service to the local Chinese community. Readers praise that the publication of two issues a week is very popular among readers. The newly released Wednesday edition is delivered to the distribution point and each issue is sold out. Some readers send orders from local and out-of-state places to order a new twice-weekly newspaper or an additional Wednesday edition. In the face of the public's encouragement and encouragement, we all regard it as the driving force to run a twice-weekly newspaper. The editorial department of this newspaper is working hard on Wednesday's edition. In the near future, it is planned to add "Alberta Concise News" and strengthen "American and Spanish Overseas Chinese Community Updates" to the original special pages of "International", "China", "Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan", "Health and Wellness", and "Community News" to better serve local Chinese and overseas Chinese. In order to allow readers who love this newspaper to enjoy the social benefits of having two newspapers a week, starting from October, each long-term subscriber will be given a copy of the Wednesday newspaper as a special gift (extra mail). At the same time, new and additional orders are warmly welcome. In the future. Long-term subscribers are calculated as sending two issues a week, 104 issues a year), a total of $50 for the whole year. The fee for withdrawing a quote at zero is 25￠ for one issue on Friday and 10￠ for one issue on Wednesday.

97e0bd9c9f451196bdfdacd9b8902f1fa6f50fa5.sourceText: 全国1日继续笼罩在有史以来的热浪高温中，20个州的天气有如火炉般炽热，国家气象局说，东南部大部分地区的气温超过华氏100度。 全国气象资料中心的数据显示，过去一周内全国打破了近1600个高温纪录。 火上浇油的是，部分地区自上周末出现的断电一直没有恢复，各地呼吁耆老和病患前往纳凉中心避暑。 纽约市是东北部地区面临高温天气的城市之一，华氏90多度的气温加上闷热和潮湿，使人感到像是100度。 芝加哥和华盛顿市1日的气温都是90多度甚至100度，气象预报表明，即使是气温在80多度和刚过90度的地区，没有空调也会产生中暑威胁。 CNN天气预报员说：「家中如果没有空调，居民应到当地的纳凉中心或有空调的场所，这对避免中暑极为必要。」 受到热浪袭击的各地城市都开放了纳凉中心和冲水设施，维吉尼亚州设立了35个纳凉中心。 俄亥俄州继29日的暴雨造成13人死亡和数百万人断电后，如今又出现难以忍受的高温天气。 州长凯西克说﹕「我极担忧断电和高温相加造成的严重后果。」截至1日下午3时15分，全州仍有逾45万户居民断电，州长说全州将需一周 时间，才能全面恢复供电。 他呼吁俄州国民兵检查和帮助需要协助的人，尤其是耆老和病患。 在受高温影响的东部各州，维吉尼亚州有38万5000户没有供电，马里兰州是28万5000户缺电，新泽西州13万2000户没有供电。 维州紧急部门报告，截至1日下午，全州四个郡有七人热死。 新州有两名儿童在一处州立公园搭建的帐篷里纳凉，结果被倒下的树砸中丧命。 维州州长麦唐纳说：「高温天气又面临断电，这不只是一天的威胁，而是多日的挑战。」
97e0bd9c9f451196bdfdacd9b8902f1fa6f50fa5.translatedText: The country continued to be shrouded in the hottest heat wave in history on the 1st, and the weather in 20 states was as hot as an oven. The National Weather Service said that the temperature in most parts of the Southeast exceeded 100 degrees Fahrenheit. Data from the National Meteorological Data Center shows that nearly 1,600 high temperature records were broken across the country in the past week. To add fuel to the fire, power outages in some areas have not been restored since last weekend. Elderly people and patients are being urged to go to cooling centers to escape the heat. New York City is one of the cities in the Northeast facing hot weather, with temperatures in the 90s combined with sweltering heat and humidity that can feel like 100 degrees. The temperatures in Chicago and Washington on the 1st were over 90 degrees or even 100 degrees. Weather forecasts showed that even in areas with temperatures in the 80s and just over 90 degrees, there would be a threat of heat stroke without air conditioning. The CNN weather forecaster said: "If there is no air conditioning at home, residents should go to local cooling centers or air-conditioned places. This is extremely necessary to avoid heat stroke." Cities hit by heat waves have opened cooling centers and flushing facilities, and Virginia has set up 35 cooling centers. After heavy rains on the 29th killed 13 people and caused millions of people to lose power, Ohio is now experiencing unbearable high temperatures. Governor Keswick said: "I am extremely worried about the serious consequences of the combination of power outages and high temperatures." As of 3:15 pm on the 1st, more than 450,000 residents across the state were still without power. The governor said that it will take a week for the entire state to fully restore power. He called on the Russian National Guard to check on and help those in need, especially the elderly and sick. In the eastern states affected by the high temperature, 385,000 households in Virginia were without power, 285,000 households in Maryland were without power, and 132,000 households in New Jersey were without power. The Victoria State Emergency Department reported that as of the afternoon of the 1st, seven people had died from heat in four counties across the state. Two children were killed after being struck by a falling tree while cooling off in a tent set up in a state park in New South Wales. Victoria Governor McDonald said: "High temperature weather and power outages are not just a one-day threat, but a multi-day challenge."

fa76d2682ae7f6ec4ae583c98b4ae4fe14a03545.sourceText: 圣诞节的惊喜!男孩送18万卡给海外美国兵 （亚省时报） 一个住在惊喜镇的11岁男孩完成了一个惊人的使命棗自己创造了18万张圣诞贺卡给美军部署在海外的士兵。 几十个纸箱堆在这家的车道上，裡头装满个性化的感谢卡。从去年开始，10岁的斯蒂芬古德曼想出这个计划。 ”我的祖父曾驻扎越南，他过节时没得到任何卡，让他感到被遗忘。所以我希望海外驻兵知道他们不会被忘记，无论家距离他们有多远。”斯蒂芬说。 促成他这个想法的是去年福克斯10电视台对他的採访。柯达彩印看了採访后给史蒂芬提供了10万张贺卡，加上男孩自家购买的8万张，史蒂夫和家人一共签署了18万张贺卡。然后送到卢克空军基地，然后被运往世界各地的美军基地。 ”我希望他们能够知道这裡有人关心他们。”史提芬说。
fa76d2682ae7f6ec4ae583c98b4ae4fe14a03545.translatedText: A Christmas surprise! A boy sent 180,000 cards to American soldiers overseas (Alberta Times) An 11-year-old boy from the town of Surprise accomplished an amazing mission - he created 180,000 Christmas cards to send to US troops deployed overseas. Dozens of cardboard boxes filled with personalized thank-you cards were stacked in the family's driveway. Starting last year, 10-year-old Stephen Goodman came up with the plan. "My grandfather was stationed in Vietnam and he didn't get any cards for the holidays, which made him feel forgotten. So I want our troops overseas to know that they will not be forgotten, no matter how far away from home they are," Stephen said. What prompted his idea was an interview with him last year on Fox 10. After reading the interview, Kodak Printing provided Stephen with 100,000 greeting cards. In addition to the 80,000 cards purchased by the boy's family, Steve and his family signed a total of 180,000 greeting cards. It was then sent to Luke Air Force Base and then shipped to U.S. military bases around the world. "I want them to know that there are people here who care about them," Stephen said.
