60d2dba198344efc79d009e7e93a054084f808f4.sourceText: 纽约果粉提前两周排队抢新iPhone 博客网站AllThingsD发布消息称，苹果公司将于9月10日举行一…
60d2dba198344efc79d009e7e93a054084f808f4.translatedText: Apple fans in New York lined up to grab the new iPhone two weeks in advance. Blog website AllThingsD announced that Apple will hold a conference on September 10th...

5e322a1070b6fc7545533ddfdc1c28e67b8ca959.sourceText: 苹果定于9月10日发布新版iPhone，将有着重要的意义。目前来看，尽管苹果能够从iPhone手机获取大量的收入，但是，从全球市场来看，由于低成本Android不断涌现而形成的冲击，再加上竞争对手三星带来的强大压力，苹果iPhone在全球智能手机市场的份额也出现下滑。
5e322a1070b6fc7545533ddfdc1c28e67b8ca959.translatedText: Apple is scheduled to release a new version of the iPhone on September 10th, which will be of great significance. At present, although Apple can obtain a large amount of revenue from iPhone mobile phones, from a global market perspective, due to the impact of the continuous emergence of low-cost Android, coupled with the strong pressure brought by competitor Samsung, Apple's iPhone's share of the global smartphone market has also declined.

6a95f723c2d9a631411c29bd2af46624a5e689d2.sourceText: 如果现在还在计划着跑去苹果店排队抢下首台新iPhone，那么你已经输在起跑线上了。有两位仁兄已经在位于纽约第五大道的苹果旗舰店外安营扎寨，排队等待新款iPhone上市了。
6a95f723c2d9a631411c29bd2af46624a5e689d2.translatedText: If you are still planning to go to the Apple store and queue up to grab the first new iPhone, then you have already lost at the starting line. Two guys have already camped outside the Apple flagship store on Fifth Avenue in New York, lining up to wait for the launch of the new iPhone.

40f0d92f255e97906eeb6ab47d3d18bfdef0054d.sourceText: 虽然距离9月10日的新品发布会还尚有些时日，而且新iPhone 5S和iPhone 5C正式铺货销售还要再等两周，但果粉们已经按捺不住热情。许多公司会通过这种方式进行品牌推广以及吸引媒体眼球，而且这两位排队的人士身着印有苹果产品二手交易网站Sell Your Mac字样的服装，有可能是该网站赞助或者是旗下员工。
40f0d92f255e97906eeb6ab47d3d18bfdef0054d.translatedText: Although there is still some time before the new product launch on September 10, and it will take another two weeks for the new iPhone 5S and iPhone 5C to be officially put on sale, Apple fans can no longer contain their enthusiasm. Many companies use this method to promote their brands and attract media attention, and the two people in line were wearing clothes with the words Sell Your Mac, a second-hand Apple product trading website, and may be sponsored by the website or are employees of the website.

aef1306927061ba989ce8cd28f5e3d005c80c8c5.sourceText: 从图片上看，两人装备精良：折叠座椅、生活必需品一应俱全。不过考虑到9月份纽约天气渐凉，晚上气温只有十几度，排队等都两周以上还是一件苦差事，而且最好祈祷不要下雨。
aef1306927061ba989ce8cd28f5e3d005c80c8c5.translatedText: Judging from the pictures, the two of them are well equipped: folding seats and daily necessities are all available. However, considering that the weather in New York is getting cooler in September, with temperatures in the teens at night, waiting in line for more than two weeks is still a chore, and it’s best to pray that it doesn’t rain.

2a225953adf1d144f33f3cf7cc6cd769dfa24b44.sourceText: Subway三明治尺度不符 网路上怨声四起
2a225953adf1d144f33f3cf7cc6cd769dfa24b44.translatedText: Subway sandwiches are not sized, and complaints are spreading on the Internet

d04c4cb610f7dfd0f1ba8905e84071fb7c032a73.sourceText: Subway三明治尺度不符 网路上怨声四起 （亚省时报） 美国三明治连锁店赛百味（Subway）出售的…
d04c4cb610f7dfd0f1ba8905e84071fb7c032a73.translatedText: >Subway sandwiches are not sized, and complaints are spreading on the Internet (Alberta Times) Sandwiches sold by the American sandwich chain Subway...

12fa1ef48cff9d4bfcaf5511e693673149ddc503.sourceText: 美国三明治连锁店赛百味（Subway）出售的三明治正面临消费者在网路上的强烈抗议。据洛杉矶时报（Los Angles Times）报导，当一名澳大利亚的顾客以照片为证，宣称该公司受欢迎之一英尺长（foot long）三明治名不符实后，恼怒的消费者开始群起抗议。
12fa1ef48cff9d4bfcaf5511e693673149ddc503.translatedText: Sandwiches sold by the American sandwich chain Subway are facing strong protests from consumers online. Angry consumers began protesting after an Australian customer claimed, using photos, that one of the company's popular foot-long sandwiches was misbranded, the Los Angles Times reported.

42a4a0b071bb8c53dacc00933ed1e9bb2daa4d3a.sourceText: 据这名顾客张贴在Subway脸书页面上的照片，他把大量的西红柿、洋葱、橄榄、面包与一把卷尺放在一起，图片显示三明治仅11英吋长，而不是一英尺长（11英吋）。照片上还附上了Subway”请回”?#30340;讯息。 三明治的尺寸大小对许多Subway的顾客很重要。成群的模仿者的照片已经出现在社交网站上，其中有一个人把三明治与穿了袜子的人脚（foot）相比。
42a4a0b071bb8c53dacc00933ed1e9bb2daa4d3a.translatedText: According to the photo posted by the customer on Subway's Facebook page, he put together a large amount of tomatoes, onions, olives, bread and a tape measure. The picture showed that the sandwich was only 11 inches long, not a foot long (11 inches). The photo was accompanied by a "Please come back" message from Subway. Sandwich size is important to many Subway customers. Photos of swarms of imitators have appeared on social networking sites, including one comparing a sandwich to a sock-wearing foot.

3e06b3bd5d3a2c390fdc46e65f2863e6d67eab1a.sourceText: 脸书用户大卫莫兰在Subway公司的简介上面写到：”我不会再回去Subway，直到你或在广告上放弃一英尺长（Foot Long）的字眼，或是在三明治上加一英吋。这个广告是虚假的。”
3e06b3bd5d3a2c390fdc46e65f2863e6d67eab1a.translatedText: Facebook user David Moran wrote on Subway's profile: "I will not go back to Subway until you either drop the word Foot Long or add an inch to the sandwich. This ad is false."

3bb6d7d9858919fdeed504fddcc16834d8917ec3.sourceText: 《纽约邮报》（New York Post）的记者在曼哈顿、布鲁克林和皇后区，买了七个”一英尺长”的三明治，发现有四个低于广告所标示的。
3bb6d7d9858919fdeed504fddcc16834d8917ec3.translatedText: "New York Post" Post reporters bought seven "foot-long" sandwiches in Manhattan, Brooklyn and Queens and found four were smaller than advertised.

c8b0575972d07b9b8caa71312c0ab4b94268aa62.sourceText: 一名自称曾在Subway工作过的脸书用户为这家连锁店辩护。她在公司的脸书上写到：”要把面包做得完美是不容易的。所以，请冷静。”
c8b0575972d07b9b8caa71312c0ab4b94268aa62.translatedText: A Facebook user who said he once worked at Subway defended the chain. She wrote on the company's Facebook: "It's not easy to make bread perfect. So, please calm down."

abdf5da6537b6c3e33c27bb3f7ac38bab7ef6dae.sourceText: 未来避免类似的抱怨，麦当劳在其网站上特别标注，”含奶酪之四分之一磅汉堡”（Quarter Pounder with Cheese）在”烹调前”重量为4盎司，（四分之一磅）。本周在其脸书，餐饮连锁店Applebee张贴其一道海鲜菜肴的图片，标题为”我们相信，低热量，不必一定要走捷径投机取巧。”明显地在开Subway的玩笑。有超过30,000人喜欢这个公告。
abdf5da6537b6c3e33c27bb3f7ac38bab7ef6dae.translatedText: To avoid similar complaints in the future, McDonald's specifically noted on its website that the "Quarter Pounder with Cheese" weighs 4 ounces "before cooking" (a quarter pound). On its Facebook this week, restaurant chain Applebee's posted a picture of one of its seafood dishes with the caption, "We believe low-calorie doesn't have to mean taking shortcuts." It's an obvious joke on Subway. More than 30,000 people liked this announcement.

24fdff77d49a883f2c7bf88f841e06be3f86dc47.sourceText: Covance关闭钱德勒药物实验室

d8f842c1dc22725d8fd63ed5356c63e33a85baf9.sourceText: Covance关闭钱德勒药物实验室 （亚省时报） 国际药物开发公司Covance上周三宣布，关闭其在钱…
d8f842c1dc22725d8fd63ed5356c63e33a85baf9.translatedText: >Covance closes Chandler drug laboratory (Alberta Times) International drug development company Covance announced last Wednesday that it will close its Chandler base...

ea58e601b05dcee266572df1b6425bea6f7de8e8.sourceText: Covance关闭钱德勒药物实验室 （亚省时报） 国际药物开发公司Covance上周三宣布，关闭其在钱德勒的基地。 Covance公司总部设在新泽西州的普林斯顿，2009年在钱特勒花费1.5亿元设立实验室。虽然公司在2012年第一季度净收入增长了5.7%，但Covance表示，关闭钱德勒实验室，将有助于每年节省两千万美元。 钱德勒实验室于2009年3月开业，有数十个员工。曾因使用动物试验遭人示威。Covance公司曾计划在钱德勒机场附近兴建27英亩，建筑面积超过28万平方英尺的基地，能容纳2000个工作岗位。可惜计划赶不上变化。
ea58e601b05dcee266572df1b6425bea6f7de8e8.translatedText: >Covance closes Chandler drug laboratory (Alberta Times) International drug development company Covance announced last Wednesday that it will close its base in Chandler. Covance, headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, spent $150 million to set up a laboratory in Chandler in 2009. While the company's net income grew 5.7% in the first quarter of 2012, Covance said closing the Chandler lab will help save $20 million annually. Chandler Labs opened in March 2009 and has dozens of employees. There have been protests over the use of animal testing. Covance had planned to build a 27-acre base near Chandler Airport with a construction area of ​​more than 280,000 square feet and could accommodate 2,000 jobs. It's a pity that the plan can't keep up with the changes.

39d8ab7ecce693edc982f4bee220431ab295a364.sourceText: 不上火，营养好，去VOLCANO 火锅吧! 亚利桑那的冬天，对于爱好美食的人来说是惬意的，尤其是火锅。虽然依旧期盼冬天的造访，呼一口冷气，摩拳擦掌，喝着冰水吃着火锅，尽情体会那种冰火两重天的刺激；但也终于不再有夏天闷热的鼓噪，烈日当头，浑汗淋漓却时不时禁不起的诱惑 。 今秋伊始，有幸来到了一个VOLCANO火锅店麻辣药材火锅。得知此店，是因为多位朋友推荐这里的火锅与众不同－不上火。这对于日渐注重健康美食的人来说，尤其爱美的女士，是一块不可多得的福地。 火锅，对于中国人来说，难以抗拒。不仅仅在于它的美味儿，更在于它所传达的一种文化棗和谐。 能凑成一桌围在一个锅子吃火锅的人，很少是还处于应酬级别的关系，要么是三五成群的知己好友、同学同事，要么是一大家子，更有热恋中的情侣，守着一个火锅，多少呢喃细语，柔情蜜意，尽融在锅中袅袅腾起的热气中。而在这种和谐中，少去了会上火、新鲜健康食品，更让人享受无穷。VOLCANO火锅便给人们提供了一个难得全身心放松的悠闲之地。 吃火锅的过程也是感情催化的一个过程。最重要的第一步就是选锅底。辣汤锅底是免不了的，火锅的魅力就在于那股浓厚香韵的辣味能够让食物瞬间凝聚齐所有的美味的精髓，刺激起你的味蕾。VOLCANO火锅底料里加入了十多种清热降火的中草药配方料来平衡花椒，辣椒的燥火，在保留药膳的功效和麻辣鲜香的同时，也克服了一般药膳味太浓的弊端，同时也达到了好吃不上火的目的，堪称火锅底料中的极品。 接着是选菜，餐馆里火锅自助台上面所列生鲜菜式品种花样是越来越多，也越来越令人食指大动。亲朋好友这时可以随心所欲，每人挑几样自己可心的品种，看看其他人拿的，也不赖，有时也可藉着拿菜，了解身边人的性格爱好。 奇脆五花肉鲜和脆，下锅轻涮几秒钟，便可见五花肉十足的脆劲儿，没有过分的打弯，涮久了也不会变的面腻，很有嚼劲，让人回味无穷。奇火涮油条是VOLCAON火锅的特色，在锅里涮几番，吃起来浓浓汤汁，让人吃了又想吃。肥羊肉，水晶牛肉、秘制牛小排这些肉食，是火锅的必点经典菜系，更是VOLCANO火锅的经典菜系，VOLCANO火锅非常注重菜品，这些食材都是他跟同事到全国各地考察之后精挑细选出来的，绝对保证口感和正宗。 终于，火旺了，汤底也开了，水花从锅的中心向上沸起，这时候是吃火锅的过程中最快乐的一刻，各人抄起自己最爱吃的菜，迫不及待地投入欢快扑腾着的锅中，稍待一会儿，左右涮一涮，提起来再放入事先早已拌好的调料碗中，然后入口大嚼。VOLCANO的小料按着口感和喜好相互调伴，这种过程也是一种享受。 VOLCANO主旨就是开心、快乐、喜欢、喜悦，再加上中药食材的底料，堪称”吃了不上火的快乐火锅”。 火锅，演变至今，已有百年的历史。悠久历史下蕴含了深邃的文化，更是中国人骨子里热情、团结、开朗、豁达的最好诠释。要将这种文化继续延续和发扬下去，并不断地充实它、丰富它、美化它，这种过程，也是一种积淀.
39d8ab7ecce693edc982f4bee220431ab295a364.translatedText: It won’t cause excessive heat and is nutritious. Go to VOLCANO hot pot! Winter in Arizona is pleasant for people who love food, especially hot pot. Although I still look forward to visiting in the winter, taking a breath of air-conditioning, gearing up, drinking ice water and eating hot pot, and fully experiencing the excitement of the two worlds of ice and fire; but finally there is no longer the sultry noise of summer, the scorching sun, dripping with sweat, but the temptation that can't be resisted from time to time. At the beginning of this autumn, I was lucky enough to visit a VOLCANO hotpot restaurant called Spicy Herbal Hotpot. I learned about this restaurant because many friends recommended the hotpot here to be unique - not overly hot. This is a rare blessing for people who are increasingly paying attention to healthy food, especially women who love beauty. Hot pot is irresistible to Chinese people. Not only because of its delicious taste, but also because of the cultural harmony it conveys. Those who can sit together at a table and eat hot pot in a pot are rarely on a social level. They are either small groups of close friends, classmates and colleagues, or a large family, or even a couple in love, guarding a hot pot, with many whispers and tenderness, all melting into the steam rising from the pot. In this kind of harmony, there are fewer sources of irritation and fresh and healthy food, which makes people enjoy endless enjoyment. VOLCANO hot pot provides people with a rare and leisurely place to relax wholeheartedly. The process of eating hot pot is also a process catalyzed by emotion. The most important first step is to choose the pot base. Spicy soup base is inevitable. The charm of hot pot is that the strong spicy flavor can condense all the delicious essence of the food in an instant, stimulating your taste buds. VOLCANO hot pot base contains more than ten kinds of heat-clearing and fire-reducing Chinese herbal formula ingredients to balance the dryness of Sichuan peppercorns and chili peppers. While retaining the efficacy of medicinal food and the spicy and delicious flavor, it also overcomes the shortcomings of general medicinal food being too strong. At the same time, it also achieves the purpose of being delicious but not irritating. It can be called the best hot pot base. Next comes the choice of dishes. There are more and more varieties of fresh dishes listed on the hot pot buffet table in the restaurant, and they are becoming more and more exciting. Relatives and friends can do whatever they want at this time. Each person can choose a few varieties that they like and see what others are getting. It’s not bad. Sometimes, you can also get to know the personalities and hobbies of the people around you by picking up the dishes. The crispy pork belly is fresh and crispy. After simmering it for a few seconds, you can see how crispy the pork belly is. There is no excessive bending. It will not become greasy after being simmered for a long time. It is very chewy and makes people have endless aftertaste. Qihuo-shabu fried dough sticks is a specialty of VOLCAON hot pot. After shabu-shabu several times in the pot, it tastes thick and thick, making people want to eat it again and again. Meats such as fat lamb, crystal beef, and secret beef short ribs are must-try classic dishes for hot pot, and they are also classic dishes for VOLCANO hot pot. VOLCANO hot pot attaches great importance to the dishes. These ingredients are carefully selected by him and his colleagues after inspecting all over the country, and the taste is absolutely guaranteed to be authentic. Finally, the fire is high, the soup base is boiling, and the water is boiling upward from the center of the pot. This is the happiest moment in the process of eating hot pot. Everyone picks up their favorite dishes and can’t wait to throw them into the cheerful pot. Wait for a while, rinse them from side to side, lift them up and put them into the seasoning bowl that has been mixed in advance, and then eat them in your mouth. VOLCANO's ingredients are mixed with each other according to taste and preference. This process is also a kind of enjoyment. The main theme of VOLCANO is happiness, joy, love and joy. Coupled with the base of traditional Chinese medicine ingredients, it can be called "a happy hotpot that doesn't get angry". Hot pot has a history of hundreds of years since its evolution. The long history contains profound culture, which is the best interpretation of the enthusiasm, unity, cheerfulness and open-mindedness of the Chinese people. We must continue and carry forward this culture, and constantly enrich, enrich and beautify it. This process is also a kind of accumulation.

0d9dde952cfa47b360cebadf8ba52b1414bad4ba.translatedText: Zhao Bing: An unforgettable Vanpool experience

3854a09eaa1596fc12b071038f7a50aac5e8aab0.sourceText: 赵兵：难忘的Vanpool经验 凤凰城 赵兵 我参加 vanpool 上下班有一年了。vanpool 就是…
3854a09eaa1596fc12b071038f7a50aac5e8aab0.translatedText: Zhao Bing: An unforgettable Vanpool experience Phoenix City Zhao Bing I have been commuting in vanpool for a year. vanpool is...

bed4134c7c30bd9300810eca24676737d14045f3.sourceText: 我参加 vanpool 上下班有一年了。vanpool 就是公司的几个同事一起租用一辆大型的麵包车用来上下班。每天一大早大家开着自己的车到停麵包车的停车场，然后坐麵包车上班。司机是大家轮流当的或着有两个固定的志愿者轮流开。麵包车的租金是市政府和工作所在单位出的，我们大家只要出汽油费。
bed4134c7c30bd9300810eca24676737d14045f3.translatedText: I have been commuting to vanpool for a year. A vanpool is when several colleagues in the company rent a large van to commute to and from get off work. Early every morning, everyone drives their cars to the parking lot where the van is parked, and then takes the van to work. Everyone takes turns being the driver, or there are two fixed volunteers who take turns driving. The rental of the van is paid by the city government and the employer where we work, and all of us only have to pay for the gas.

1229d371d22dd36e83a4a547cc88d1ca11be6c07.sourceText: vanpool 的好处是可以用 HOV 快车道，这样上下班时间可以减少一半，另外，由于是大家平分汽油钱，一年可以省下不少汽油钱，对我来说一年可以省下$2000左右，还有，还可以在车上闭目养神，看看报纸，上上网，休息休息。当然，由于大家只用一辆车，汽车排的废气就少了，对凤凰城的空气淨化也有所贡献，对节约能源有所帮组，所以说vanpool真是一个对别人和自己双赢的上下班交通工具。
1229d371d22dd36e83a4a547cc88d1ca11be6c07.translatedText: The advantage of vanpool is that you can use the HOV express lane, which can reduce your commuting time by half. In addition, since everyone shares the gas money equally, you can save a lot of gas money a year. For me, I can save about $2,000 a year. Also, you can close your eyes and relax in the car, read newspapers, surf the Internet, and rest. Of course, since everyone only uses one car, the car emits less exhaust gas, which also contributes to air purification in Phoenix and helps save energy. Therefore, the vanpool is really a win-win means of commuting to work for both others and yourself.

0ba71ab70af1a9ffd3b05bf9df9b2af484d72faa.sourceText: 当然，这vanpool也不是完美的，例如，上班要早，否则上下班时间晚了，HOV 快车道也会拥挤，另外，由于从坐上 van 到下班这段时间里，自己没有车，所以中午吃饭就不能出去吃了，需要用车时就显得不方便了。当然如遇到van上有人睡觉打呼说梦话的人就更不完美了。如果某天需要带小孩看病什麽的，一般就开自己的车上下班，不坐van了。今天，我就来讲讲一件发生在我身上一件vanpool的经验。
0ba71ab70af1a9ffd3b05bf9df9b2af484d72faa.translatedText: Of course, this vanpool is not perfect. For example, you have to go to get off work early, otherwise the commute will be late, and the HOV express lane will be crowded. In addition, since you don’t have a car from the time you get on the van to the time you get off work, you can’t go out for lunch, which makes it inconvenient when you need a car. Of course, it would be even less perfect if you encounter someone snoring and talking in their sleep in the van. If you need to take your child to see a doctor or something on a certain day, you usually drive your own car to get off work instead of taking a van. Today, I will talk about an experience that happened to me with Vanpool.

55025c2d2a098de14f26fe1dc0a7ca11ac4c7ea6.sourceText: 我vanpool坐了一年了，除了早起这个问题外，总的来说还满意，但最近由于来了一个新的人后，这vanpool的平静稍稍有点打破。这位新来的人叫汤姆，年龄大约接近六十岁，看上去还和善，但他有两个问题，一个问题是一上车就睡觉打呼，一路打到底，有时车还没开，他就呼呼起来了，偶尓还给大家来两句奇怪的梦话，让大家尤其是开车的司机惊吓不少。另一个问题是他喜欢抢好的座位，实际上，虽然座位是随意坐的，一般来说，先加入vanpool的人一般都是坐前面好的座位，几年下来，大家的座位基本都固定了，可汤姆不管，今天坐这个位置明天又坐另一个位置，大家也只好跟着他换位置，慢慢地他的位置从最后一排移到了最前排，经常坐在副驾驶的位置，这样，副驾驶的位置最近经常是呼声连连，对驾驶员约翰造成了极大的困扰，约翰私下对我们说由于汤姆的呼声太大，他开车时精力难以集中在路上，他担心这样下去会出车祸。
55025c2d2a098de14f26fe1dc0a7ca11ac4c7ea6.translatedText: I have been sitting in the vanpool for a year. Apart from the problem of getting up early, I am generally satisfied. However, recently, the calmness of the vanpool has been slightly broken due to the arrival of a new person. This newcomer is called Tom. He is about sixty years old and looks kind. However, he has two problems. One problem is that he sleeps and snores as soon as he gets in the car. Another problem is that he likes to grab good seats. In fact, although the seats are free to sit, generally speaking, the people who join the vanpool first usually sit in the good seats in the front. After a few years, everyone's seats are basically fixed, but Tom doesn't care. He takes this seat today and another seat tomorrow, so everyone has to change seats with him. , slowly moved his position from the last row to the front row, often sitting in the passenger seat. In this way, the passenger seat has been frequently called frequently recently, which has caused great trouble to the driver John. John privately told us that because Tom shouted so loudly, it was difficult for him to concentrate on the road while driving, and he was worried that if this continued, there would be an accident.

5a2b804a34c109bdc038b16cd7a01fa7717536ec.sourceText: 我们大家一听，就急了，因为约翰是我们当中开车最稳的。于是我们几个人决定轮流提前早到，在汤姆到停车场之前先把副驾驶的座位占下，这样汤姆就不能坐在约翰旁边肆无忌惮地做梦打呼了，这样我们的安全就得到保证了。
5a2b804a34c109bdc038b16cd7a01fa7717536ec.translatedText: We all became anxious when we heard this, because John is the most steady driver among us. So several of us decided to take turns to arrive early and occupy the passenger seat before Tom arrived in the parking lot, so that Tom could not sit next to John and sleep and snore unscrupulously, and our safety was guaranteed.

4dadf7b142defe964737031f88d93ae1cd377c3c.sourceText: 上週是轮到我早到抢占副驾驶的位置，本来我就是早上五点半起床，六点到达van的停车场，由于我要早到，于是礼拜一早上五点就起床了，到达van的时候大约五点四十五分，于是等汤姆六点来时我已经坐在副驾驶的位置上闭目养神了，他只好在后排打呼了。下班时，我也提前五分钟赶在汤姆之前先坐上副驾驶的位置。这样，礼拜一大家都安全度过了。
4dadf7b142defe964737031f88d93ae1cd377c3c.translatedText: Last week it was my turn to arrive early to seize the passenger seat. Originally, I got up at 5:30 in the morning and arrived at the parking lot of the van at 6 o'clock. Since I had to arrive early, I got up at 5 o'clock on Monday morning and arrived at the van at about 5:45. So when Tom came at 6 o'clock, I was already sitting in the passenger seat with my eyes closed and concentrating, and he had to snore in the back seat. When I got off work, I rushed five minutes early to get into the passenger seat before Tom. In this way, everyone spent Monday safely.

d9dacc6d7449c99084c9360bb974dff08f337e34.sourceText: 礼拜二，我又如法炮製，汤姆的呼声还是停留在后排，约翰的车还是开得那样的稳，约翰的嘴角不时还流露出一丝得意的微笑。
d9dacc6d7449c99084c9360bb974dff08f337e34.translatedText: On Tuesday, I did the same thing again. Tom's voice still stayed in the back row, John's car still drove so steadily, and John's mouth showed a proud smile from time to time.

dcdc9eff8393a80da4956d58ffb403295302cf9e.sourceText: 礼拜三，由于汤姆有所察觉，他早上比我早到，所以他先占据了副驾驶的位置，约翰只好在汤姆的打呼声中开车上班了，当他实在受不了时就来个小小的紧急刹车把汤姆从梦中惊醒。但下班我还是赶在汤姆下班前抢占了副驾驶的位置。
dcdc9eff8393a80da4956d58ffb403295302cf9e.translatedText: On Wednesday, because Tom was aware of it, he arrived earlier than me in the morning, so he took the passenger seat first. John had to drive to work amidst Tom's snoring. When he couldn't stand it anymore, he made a small emergency brake to wake Tom up from his dream. But I still rushed to seize the co-pilot's seat before Tom got off work.

8579a51d81b7bbb7814e3ec448deefe964bc3f82.sourceText: 礼拜四，我起得更早，五点半就坐在副驾驶位置上，汤姆五点三十五分也到了，他看着我已坐在副驾驶位置上脸上露出吃惊的样子，但他一坐上车后就开始打呼了，由于开车的时间是六点，所以我在车里被他的呼声折磨近三十分钟，在这漆黑的早上，那呼声显得特别的响，不过，我心裡还蛮佩服汤姆的快速入睡能力，心想，他一定是没有什麽烦恼的。但是那天下班时，由于我有一个会议拖久了，等我开完会匆忙赶到van时，汤姆早就坐在副驾驶位置上呼呼了，他的呼声好像在告诉我他赢了。我心想，明天下班我一定要第一个冲到车上。
8579a51d81b7bbb7814e3ec448deefe964bc3f82.translatedText: On Thursday, I got up earlier and sat in the passenger seat at 5:30. Tom also arrived at 5:35. He looked surprised when he saw that I was already sitting in the passenger seat, but he started snoring as soon as he got in the car. Since the driving time was six o'clock, I was tortured by his cry in the car for nearly 30 minutes. In this dark morning, the cry seemed particularly loud. However, I quite admired Tom's ability to fall asleep quickly and thought that he must have no worries. But when I got off work that day, because I had a long-delayed meeting, when I rushed to the van after the meeting, Tom was already sitting in the passenger seat and whirring, and his whistling seemed to tell me that he had won. I thought to myself, I must be the first to rush to the car after get off work tomorrow.

54f654044ffb9f67b642d4314633bb4169c03331.sourceText: 于是第二天我中饭也跳过，把一些下午的工作提前做了，另外我也把下午的一个会议时间提前了半个小时，会议一结束我就飞奔到车上，比汤姆早了10分钟，我稳坐在副驾驶的位置，看着汤姆失望的样子，我感到蛮得意的。
54f654044ffb9f67b642d4314633bb4169c03331.translatedText: So I skipped lunch the next day and did some afternoon work in advance. In addition, I also advanced the time of a meeting in the afternoon by half an hour. As soon as the meeting ended, I rushed to the car, 10 minutes earlier than Tom. I sat firmly in the passenger seat and looked at Tom's disappointed look. I felt quite proud.

d65d253309104805929f2e388031ab2fd26e8770.sourceText: 在从公司坐van回停车场的路上，我偶尔和约翰聊两句以免他开车睡着了，但基本上我是闭目养神，等到了停车场，我突然惊醒，原来我也睡着了，这也不能怪我，这几天和汤姆斗争太累了。到了停车场后，我和汤姆是最后两个离开van的，在我们从停van的地方走到我们各自汽车的停放点的路上，汤姆轻轻说：”你刚才在车上睡着了，还打呼说梦话呢。”
d65d253309104805929f2e388031ab2fd26e8770.translatedText: On the way back to the parking lot in the van from the company, I occasionally chatted with John to prevent him from falling asleep while driving, but basically I closed my eyes and rested my mind. When I got to the parking lot, I suddenly woke up and realized that I had fallen asleep too. You can’t blame me. I was too tired from fighting with Tom these days. After arriving at the parking lot, Tom and I were the last two to leave the van. On the way from where we parked the van to where our respective cars were parked, Tom said softly: "You just fell asleep in the car and were snoring and talking in your sleep."

2198e6b441b43ac289ba761b4e01f02d121b0e3f.sourceText: 我听他这麽说，心裡是又窘又气。他又继续说：”我看约翰开车开得还蛮紧张的，我真想把你叫醒。” 一分钟后，我们到了我们平常各自汽车的停放点，在汤姆鑽进他的汽车时，我突然发现我的汽车不在我平时停的地方，心想：不好，汽车被偷了，真是倒霉啊。我四处张望了一下，停车场只有汤姆一部汽车，汽车真的就这样不翼而飞了，我感到无比的绝望，汤姆看着我沮丧的样子，就问我需不需要他的帮助？要不要打电话给警察报警？顿时我感到汤姆是那空旷的停车场里我唯一的依靠。
2198e6b441b43ac289ba761b4e01f02d121b0e3f.translatedText: When I heard what he said, I felt embarrassed and angry. He continued: "I see John is quite nervous while driving. I really want to wake you up." A minute later, we arrived at the parking spot where our respective cars usually are. When Tom got into his car, I suddenly found that my car was not where I usually parked it. I thought: Oh no, the car has been stolen. What a bad luck. I looked around and saw that there was only Tom's car in the parking lot. The car really disappeared like this. I felt extremely desperate. Tom looked at my depressed look and asked me if I needed his help. Should I call the police? Suddenly I felt that Tom was my only support in the empty parking lot.

49fd0b9b08f8471c2c6363921a8bb8814a755b35.sourceText: 突然我的电话响了，原来是我太太打来提醒我等一下别忘了带儿子去看牙医，于是我告诉她我的车被偷了，现在要处理一下，所以不能带儿子看牙医，希望她带儿子去。
49fd0b9b08f8471c2c6363921a8bb8814a755b35.translatedText: Suddenly my phone rang. It was my wife who called me to remind me not to forget to take my son to the dentist later. So I told her that my car was stolen and I had to deal with it now, so I couldn't take my son to the dentist. I hoped she would take her son there.

d39d33f89673c812eb96373ee51f883860e11934.sourceText: 电话挂了后，我顿了一下，差点叫出声来，我对汤姆说：”汤姆，我现在很需要你的帮助，你能开车带我回我们的公司吗？”
d39d33f89673c812eb96373ee51f883860e11934.translatedText: After hanging up the phone, I paused and almost screamed. I said to Tom: "Tom, I really need your help now. Can you drive me back to our company?"

c1c18a0849a802d9fe168158e32b3f86f8baa8c0.sourceText: ”因为，今天要带儿子看牙医，没打算坐van, 所以我早上是开自己的车到公司上班的，我的车现在还停在公司！”
c1c18a0849a802d9fe168158e32b3f86f8baa8c0.translatedText: "Because I had to take my son to the dentist today and didn't plan to take a van, so I drove my own car to work at the company in the morning, and my car is still parked at the company!"

138362154d000e05d7a14969203bdd4882f1b717.sourceText: 中国去年出境人数超8300万 花1020亿美元 谁是当今全球旅游零售业中购买力最强的消费者？13日，对外经济贸易大学奢侈品研究中心、财富品质研究院发布的《2013中国免税报告》显示，由于服务、差价、安全性等多重因素的影响，中国旅客成为全球旅游零售领域中最大的消费群体，2012年其境外消费额达到1020亿美元。不过，随着全球经济一体化的发展，中国消费者最终出境购买的，将主要是那些在境内买不到的奢侈品。 现状 全球旅游零售中国人贡献最大 该报告中显示，近几年，中国出境人数逐年攀升，自2010年首次突破5000万人次后，一直保持每年约20%的速度递增，2012年中国出境人数已高达8300万人次。与此同时，中国游客的境外消费额也随之高涨，从2010年的540亿美元一跃攀升至2012年的1020亿美元，翻了将近一倍。 ”这在国内机场接待旅客的数量中，可以得到体现。”财富品质研究院院长周婷在接受记者采访时表示，去年，全国21家机场共接待旅客约5亿人次。周婷分析称，出境人数的逐渐增长，实际上，已带动中国游客成为全球旅游零售领域的最大消费群体，”甚至足以支撑欧洲本土奢侈品市场的半壁江山”。她举例称，在伦敦的希斯罗机场，中国游客约占全部游客的1%，但是却创造了25%的免税收益；巴宝莉在伦敦Hackney 地区开设的奥特莱斯店，在非周末的日子，约有3/4的顾客都是中国游客。 不仅在欧洲，在韩国，2012年中国旅客在仁川机场人均消费116美元，完胜人均消费70美元的日本旅客。此外，根据新加坡旅游局的数据显示，2011年中国游客人均在新加坡支出约1081美元，比2002年(约377美元)增长2倍多；在迪拜国际机场，中国旅客葡萄酒消费额约是1370~2500美元，并通常会购买3条以上爱马仕围巾。 特点 超4成消费者爱在港澳”下叉” 在选购奢侈品时，哪些国家或地区最受中国消费者青睐？最常去境外购买哪些商品？ ”但往年不同的是，今年以来港澳正成为消费者最爱购买奢侈品的地区。”周婷告诉记者，在2012年，中国消费者奢侈品购物决策地的重心偏向境外地区，除港澳地区(26%)外，欧洲是中国境外旅游消费的重心，达23%，其次是美国(10%)。2103年，港澳成为中国消费者最爱购买奢侈品的地区，比例高达44%，选择去欧洲的消费者与去年相比，下降了8%；在美国购买奢侈品牌的则上升了5%。 此外，中国消费者在境外的奢侈品消费主要集中在皮具、腕表与珠宝。但是由于资产状况的不同，普通消费者更倾向于购买香水、化妆品、皮具与服饰等初级奢侈品；而珠宝、腕表等顶级奢侈品则最受富豪消费者青睐。 ”有意思的是，由于境内外的价差，普通消费者境外购物时极爱皮具产品，特别是大牌的箱包。富豪消费者则更偏爱限量或者定制版的皮具。”周婷表示。 原因 内外价差成境外消费主因 为何境外消费会大幅攀升？该份报告中认为，由于境内外消费价差仍存在，这是刺激大部分普通消费者选择境外消费的主要原因。 ”导致价差的原因，一方面是由于奢侈品牌公司定价机制，另一方面是奢侈品进口关税、消费税以及流通环节各类税费。”周婷分析道。 ”此外，人民币汇率持续升值，也使得中国旅客更有经济实力进行境外消费。”这个说法得到市民刘薇的认可。刘薇在重庆一家金融企业工作，2005年到欧洲出差，曾花1500美元买了一款GUCCI的手提包，按照当时人民币对美元1∶8.27的汇率，需要支付12405元的人民币；而现在同样标价的包只需支出9183元就够了。 另外，该份报告亦显示，境内部分消费品的不安全性和部分商品供应不足，国人更愿意信赖境外商品的品质和享受购物体验。 趋势 旅游及文化体验类消费 越来越受欢迎 对于未来的趋势，该份报告中提到，旅游类消费会成为未来境外消费的一大特点；此外，到奢侈品原产地感受其品牌的文化和内涵，”体验之旅”将会越来越受中国消费者的欢迎。 该份报告中显示， 中国消费者的境外奢侈品消费大致分为三个阶段：第一阶段，改革开放初期到上世纪90年代中期，奢侈品消费80%以上是由境外实现的。第二阶段，上世纪90年代中期至今，奢侈品牌纷纷进入中国，甚至已经深入国内二三线城市。”现在中国消费者很容易在家门口购买到心仪的奢侈品。”周婷分析称，目前，中国奢侈品的境外消费基本稳定在40%左右。 该份报告预测称，随着物流、信息流的高度发达以及全球经济一体化的发展，境外消费的状况很快会进入第三阶段：最终国人出境购买的主要是那些在境内门店买不到的奢侈品，尤其是定制、限量以及小众设计师品牌。
138362154d000e05d7a14969203bdd4882f1b717.translatedText: Last year, more than 83 million Chinese people traveled abroad, spending US$102 billion. Who is the consumer with the strongest purchasing power in the global travel retail industry today? On the 13th, the "2013 China Duty Free Report" released by the Luxury Goods Research Center and the Wealth Quality Research Institute of the University of International Business and Economics showed that due to the impact of multiple factors such as service, price difference, and safety, Chinese tourists have become the largest consumer group in the global travel retail field, with their overseas consumption reaching US$102 billion in 2012. However, with the development of global economic integration, Chinese consumers will eventually go abroad to purchase luxury goods that cannot be purchased at home. Current situation: Chinese make the largest contribution to global travel retail. The report shows that in recent years, the number of Chinese outbound travelers has increased year by year. Since exceeding 50 million for the first time in 2010, it has maintained an annual growth rate of about 20%. In 2012, the number of Chinese outbound travelers has reached 83 million. At the same time, the overseas consumption of Chinese tourists has also surged, jumping from US$54 billion in 2010 to US$102 billion in 2012, nearly doubling. "This can be reflected in the number of passengers received by domestic airports." Zhou Ting, director of the Fortune Quality Research Institute, said in an interview with reporters that last year, 21 airports across the country received a total of about 500 million passengers. Zhou Ting analyzed that the gradual increase in the number of outbound tourists has actually led Chinese tourists to become the largest consumer group in the global travel retail field, "even enough to support half of the European local luxury goods market." For example, she said that at London's Heathrow Airport, Chinese tourists accounted for about 1% of all tourists, but they created 25% of duty-free revenue; at Burberry's outlet store in the Hackney area of ​​London, on non-weekend days, about three-quarters of its customers were Chinese tourists. Not only in Europe, but also in South Korea, Chinese tourists spent an average of US$116 at Incheon Airport in 2012, beating Japanese tourists who spent an average of US$70 per person. In addition, according to data from the Singapore Tourism Board, the per capita spending of Chinese tourists in Singapore in 2011 was approximately US$1,081, which was more than double that in 2002 (approximately US$377). At Dubai International Airport, Chinese tourists spent approximately US$1,370 to US$2,500 on wine, and usually purchased more than three Hermès scarves. Features: Over 40% of consumers prefer to visit Hong Kong and Macao. When purchasing luxury goods, which countries or regions are most favored by Chinese consumers? What products do you most often buy abroad? "But what is different from previous years is that this year, Hong Kong and Macao are becoming the most popular places for consumers to buy luxury goods." Zhou Ting told reporters that in 2012, the focus of Chinese consumers' luxury shopping decisions was overseas. In addition to Hong Kong and Macao (26%), Europe was the focus of China's overseas tourism consumption, accounting for 23%, followed by the United States (10%). In 2013, Hong Kong and Macao became the favorite place for Chinese consumers to buy luxury goods, with a proportion as high as 44%. Compared with last year, the number of consumers choosing to go to Europe dropped by 8%; the number of consumers buying luxury brands in the United States increased by 5%. In addition, Chinese consumers’ overseas luxury goods consumption mainly focuses on leather goods, watches and jewelry. However, due to different asset status, ordinary consumers are more inclined to buy low-level luxury goods such as perfumes, cosmetics, leather goods and clothing; while top-level luxury goods such as jewelry and watches are most favored by wealthy consumers. "Interestingly, due to the price difference between domestic and foreign markets, ordinary consumers love leather goods when shopping overseas, especially big-name bags. Rich consumers prefer limited edition or customized leather goods," Zhou Ting said. Reason: The price difference between domestic and foreign prices has become the main reason for overseas consumption. Why has overseas consumption increased significantly? The report believes that because the price difference between domestic and overseas consumption still exists, this is the main reason that stimulates most ordinary consumers to choose overseas consumption. "The reasons for the price difference are, on the one hand, the pricing mechanism of luxury brand companies, and on the other hand, luxury goods import duties, consumption taxes, and various taxes and fees in the circulation link." Zhou Ting analyzed. "In addition, the continued appreciation of the RMB exchange rate has also given Chinese tourists more financial strength to spend overseas." This statement was recognized by citizen Liu Wei. Liu Wei works in a financial company in Chongqing. In 2005, she went to Europe on a business trip and bought a GUCCI handbag for US$1,500. According to the exchange rate of RMB to US dollar at that time of 1:8.27, she had to pay RMB 12,405; but now she only needs to pay RMB 9,183 for a bag with the same price. In addition, the report also shows that some domestic consumer goods are unsafe and some goods are in short supply. Chinese people are more willing to trust the quality of overseas goods and enjoy the shopping experience. Trends Tourism and cultural experience consumption are becoming more and more popular. Regarding future trends, the report mentioned that tourism consumption will become a major feature of overseas consumption in the future; in addition, going to the origin of luxury goods to experience the culture and connotation of their brands, and "experience tours" will become increasingly popular among Chinese consumers. The report shows that Chinese consumers' overseas luxury goods consumption can be roughly divided into three stages: the first stage, from the early days of reform and opening up to the mid-1990s, more than 80% of luxury goods consumption was realized overseas. In the second stage, from the mid-1990s to the present, luxury brands have entered China one after another, and have even penetrated into second- and third-tier domestic cities. "Now it is easy for Chinese consumers to buy their favorite luxury goods at their doorsteps." Zhou Ting analyzed that at present, overseas consumption of Chinese luxury goods is basically stable at around 40%. The report predicts that with the highly developed logistics and information flow and the development of global economic integration, overseas consumption will soon enter the third stage: eventually, Chinese people will mainly buy luxury goods abroad that cannot be bought in domestic stores, especially customized, limited edition and niche designer brands.

7bd595f47aa57377014a54d7100a29af54dbe418.sourceText: 马利科巴郡警长办公室发言人周二说，他的同事在凤凰城破获一个冰毒制造点，起出50磅甲基苯丙胺（俗称冰毒），价值150万美元。 郡警在谢里登西街逮捕了两名男子，分别是23岁的罗祖尼加莱昂和35岁的亚历杭德罗门多萨恩里克斯。 从上述地点还查获二万五千美元，一支手枪，三辆汽车，和其他制毒化学品。 阿派奥警长的发言人说，禁毒小组收到可靠信息，才一举破获此案。
7bd595f47aa57377014a54d7100a29af54dbe418.translatedText: A spokesman for the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office said Tuesday that his colleagues busted a methamphetamine lab in Phoenix and recovered 50 pounds of methamphetamine, commonly known as methamphetamine, worth $1.5 million. County police arrested two men, 23-year-old Rozuni Galeon and 35-year-old Alejandro Mendoza Henriquez, on West Sheridan Street. Also seized from the above locations were $25,000, a handgun, three vehicles, and other narcotics-making chemicals. A spokesman for Sheriff Apao said the anti-narcotics team cracked the case after receiving reliable information.

791cb1718f720076253e3f0c633565ac8d72e9c9.sourceText: 美国航空AA与US Airways或本周达成合并
791cb1718f720076253e3f0c633565ac8d72e9c9.translatedText: American Airlines AA and US Airways may reach a merger this week

b5f01fcfe9b228b551680c3c8e7eddce2b3767ef.sourceText: 美国航空AA与US Airways或本周达成合并 美国航空公司（American Airlines）母公司…
b5f01fcfe9b228b551680c3c8e7eddce2b3767ef.translatedText: > American Airlines AA and US Airways may reach a merger this week American Airlines parent company...

aae5356e83c0adfa8c9e928716475352f7a01160.sourceText: 美国航空公司（American Airlines）母公司AMR Corp与US Airways Group Inc.已经进入了最后合并阶段，最早有望本周末公布。合并后的公司以收入来算将超过美国联合美国大陆控股有限公司（United Continental Holdings Inc.）及达美航空公司（Delta Airlines），占美国国内运载量的四分之一。
aae5356e83c0adfa8c9e928716475352f7a01160.translatedText: American Airlines parent company AMR Corp and US Airways Group Inc. have entered the final stage of merger and are expected to be announced as early as this weekend. The combined company would be larger than United Continental Holdings Inc. and Delta Airlines in terms of revenue and account for a quarter of U.S. domestic traffic.

e61c3938c5e6cea09133aa1a05f173a485e7113f.sourceText: 据路透社渡假报导，两家航空公司已经解决了估值及管理结构的争议。US Airways Group Inc.总裁道格 帕克（Doug Parker）将继续担任总裁，而AMR的总裁汤马斯 霍顿(Thomas W. Horton)将在2014年春季前担任董事会主席。在股份合并方面，AMR股东将获得新公司72%的所有权，而US Airways的股东将获得余下28%的所有权。
e61c3938c5e6cea09133aa1a05f173a485e7113f.translatedText: According to a Reuters holiday report, the two airlines have resolved disputes over valuation and management structures. US Airways Group Inc. President Doug Parker will continue to serve as president, while AMR President Thomas W. Horton will serve as chairman of the board until spring 2014. In terms of the share merger, AMR shareholders will receive 72% ownership of the new company, while US Airways shareholders will receive the remaining 28% ownership.

b2eb9f5d2809e6012d65a329f47e9acdbb777b72.sourceText: 据内部消息人士透露，两个航空公司董事会将在本周中对最后提案进行投票，可能在本周末宣布正式合并。不过由于谈判正在继续，也不排除延迟或者谈崩的可能性。周一（2月11日）AMR股东在纽约讨论并购计划。
b2eb9f5d2809e6012d65a329f47e9acdbb777b72.translatedText: According to internal sources, the two airline boards will vote on the final proposal in the middle of this week and may announce a formal merger by the end of this week. However, as negotiations are continuing, the possibility of delay or collapse cannot be ruled out. AMR shareholders discussed merger and acquisition plans in New York on Monday (February 11).

2623925cc78ee853ff7721d2816d30990a409d82.sourceText: 美国航空公司将执行去年与AMR工会制定的协议，两公司合并后总部将移到AMR总部所在的德克萨斯州沃思堡（Fort Worth）。目前US Airways总部位于亚利桑那州的坦佩（Tempe）。
2623925cc78ee853ff7721d2816d30990a409d82.translatedText: American Airlines will implement the agreement made with the AMR union last year. After the merger of the two companies, the headquarters will be moved to Fort Worth, Texas, where AMR is headquartered. US Airways is currently headquartered in Tempe, Arizona.

71a8a1f5907657c909238217948c9fab74240d54.sourceText: 自从2011年11月AMR申请破产后，这份交易已经经历了14个月的谈判。在达美航空和美国西北航空（Northwest Airlines）、联合航空公司（United Airlines）和大陆航空公司（Continental Airlines）合并后，这标志着美国传统航空业最后一个运营商并购案。
71a8a1f5907657c909238217948c9fab74240d54.translatedText: This deal has been negotiated for 14 months since AMR filed for bankruptcy in November 2011. After Delta merged with Northwest Airlines, United Airlines and Continental Airlines, this marked the last carrier merger in the traditional U.S. airline industry.

777466a42a265222b5a026b246193cf7aca3d366.sourceText: 原本26日开始执行SB1070州法中被最高法院25日认可的条款，该条款要求警员在例行拦检时，如果有「合理的缘由」怀疑某人可能是非法移民，要核查其移民身分。 但最高法院26日通知一家下级法院，亚州移民法要到7月20日才能生效。 如果欧巴马政府要求覆审此案，生效日期还可能推延。 州法要求警员在拦检时，应注意对方是否显现某些迹象，导致警员应该核查其身分。 这些迹象包括没有驾照、驾驶的汽车悬挂外国车牌、英语不好、见到警员惊慌失措等。 但警员核查身分的时间决不能超过「合理的」范围，询问时不能侵犯对方的权利。 布鲁尔州长表示，警员已经接受在执行新移民法时不能搞种族侦防的训练。 但图桑警察局长韦拉森诺表示，他担心许多人会控告警察局不当核查其身分或拘留时间过长。 韦拉森诺估计，根据新移民法，图桑警察局每年将向联邦政府多打约5万通核实身分的电话，警方还将拘押许多通常不会拘押的人，以核查其移民身分。 欧巴马政府一位官员25日表示，亚省打来大量核查身分的电话，将给联邦政府带来「运作上的挑战」，但联邦政府没有计画以任何方式改变这种局面。 他说：「我们不允许某个州决定我们的优先议题。」 如果警员打电话要求核实某人的移民身分，只有此人犯了重罪、最近偷渡美国或多次偷渡美国，联邦政府才会决定将其拘留。 如果联邦政府不想拘留此人，本州警方也提不出控罪，州府就只能释放此人。 欧巴马政府25日还终止与亚利桑那州签订的一项协议，该协议授权州府一些受过特别训练的警员执行联邦移民法。
777466a42a265222b5a026b246193cf7aca3d366.translatedText: The provisions of SB1070 state law, which was approved by the Supreme Court on the 25th, were originally implemented on the 26th. This provision requires police officers to check their immigration status if they have "reasonable grounds" to suspect that someone may be an illegal immigrant during a routine stop. But the Supreme Court informed a lower court on the 26th that the Asian immigration law will not take effect until July 20. If the Obama administration requests a review of the case, the effective date may be delayed. State law requires police officers to pay attention to whether the other party shows certain signs when stopping them, so the police should check their identity. These signs include not having a driver's license, driving a car with foreign license plates, poor English, and being panicked when seeing a police officer. However, the time the police officers use to verify identity must not exceed the "reasonable" range, and the rights of the other party cannot be infringed upon during questioning. Governor Brewer said police officers have been trained not to engage in racial detection when enforcing the new immigration law. But Tucson Police Chief Verasenno said he worries many people will sue the police department for improperly checking their identities or detaining them for too long. Verasenno estimated that under the new immigration law, the Tucson Police Department will make about 50,000 more identity verification calls to the federal government each year, and police will also detain many people who would not normally be detained to verify their immigration status. An Obama administration official said on the 25th that the large number of identity verification calls from Alberta will pose "operational challenges" to the federal government, but the federal government has no plans to change the situation in any way. "We will not allow one state to determine our priorities," he said. If a police officer calls to verify a person's immigration status, the federal government will only decide to detain the person if he or she has committed a felony, has recently crossed the border, or has crossed the border multiple times. If the federal government does not want to detain the person and the state police cannot bring charges, the state will have no choice but to release the person. The Obama administration also terminated an agreement with Arizona on the 25th that authorized some specially trained police officers in the state to enforce federal immigration laws.

f5ebf94d2525c16bdae7f9e491a740e858104a34.sourceText: IRS扩大协助欠税失业者 报税延期6个月 （亚省时报） 国税局（IRS）3月6日出台新计划，帮助那些因为失业或者收入大减导致无力支付税款的民众。新计划是早先所谓”从新出发”（Fresh Start）计划的扩增版，它是在2008年推出。本周国税局说他们将扩展这个计划以帮助更多收入减少的民众。 在扩增计划下，国税局将给予那些在2011年或2012年初失业至少30天的民众六个月的宽限期缴税，六个月内可以免除罚金。此外，因经济疲软而收入下降25%的自营企业主宽限时间。 但是也有一些限制。个人报税，纳税人的收入必须不超过10万美元，对夫妻联合报税，纳税人的收入必须不超过20万美元。另外，纳税人2011年必须不能欠税逾5万美元。 这一优惠有一个需要注意的细节：IRS将继续收取未付税款的利息。因为IRS无权免除这笔收费。 IRS也将扩大另外一个计划，允许人们分期付款缴税而不是一次性付款。对欠税不超过5万美元的民众，他们的还款期限将从60个月延长到72个月的人。 如果欠税逾五万美元，纳税人仍将必须填表报税，如果能先交付一部分税金，把欠款数额减少到五万以下，纳税人将得以合乎这个计划的要求资格。
f5ebf94d2525c16bdae7f9e491a740e858104a34.translatedText: IRS expands assistance to unemployed people with tax arrears, extending tax filing for six months (Alberta Times) The Internal Revenue Service (IRS) launched a new plan on March 6 to help people who are unable to pay their taxes due to unemployment or a significant loss of income. The new program is an expanded version of the earlier so-called Fresh Start program, which was launched in 2008. This week the IRS said it would expand the program to help more people who have experienced a loss of income. Under the expansion plan, the IRS will give those who were unemployed for at least 30 days in 2011 or early 2012 a six-month grace period to pay taxes and waive penalties for six months. In addition, self-employed business owners who have experienced a 25% drop in revenue due to the weak economy will have a grace period. But there are some limitations. For individuals filing a tax return, the taxpayer's income must not exceed $100,000, and for a married couple filing a joint tax return, the taxpayer's income must not exceed $200,000. In addition, taxpayers must not owe more than $50,000 in taxes for 2011. There's one caveat to this offer: The IRS will continue to charge interest on unpaid taxes. Because the IRS has no authority to waive this fee. The IRS is also expanding a program that allows people to pay their taxes in installments instead of a lump sum. For people who owe less than $50,000 in taxes, their repayment period will be extended from 60 months to 72 months. If the tax owed exceeds $50,000, the taxpayer will still have to file a tax return. If a portion of the tax can be paid first to reduce the amount owed to less than $50,000, the taxpayer will be eligible for this program.

b1fcc4328959ba250fea65705bebec9d6019369f.sourceText: 纳税人最讨厌被国税局(IRS)查税，因为既麻烦、又「可怕」，担心因此需要补税。如果询问稽查员为何被查税，多半得不到答桉。但福斯财务网(Fox Business)的专家大略提供了一些被查税的「线索」。除了随机抽出查税对象，国税局研发了一些找出可疑申报人的「法宝」，其中包括： 一、区别函数系统(Discriminant Function System，简称DIF)。电子报税使国税局很容易蒐集纳税人的资讯，它分析过去类似税表的资讯，用电脑计算DIF，改变分数高者就容易被查税，因为这表示纳税人可能有漏报所得的可能。 二、滥用避税交易。国税局根据抓到的主持滥用避税交易者提供的客户名单，很容易找到鑽漏洞的纳税人。如果发现某个避税交易「太好了」，最好请教一下报税专家是否安全。 三、以自僱业者(self-employment)身分报税的纳税人需要留意1099税表，自僱收入超过400元者，无论是否接到1099表，都需要申报。 四、每年针对某个行业查税。例如过去几年国税局挑中外国信託基金查税，希望抓到海外未申报所得。 五、 自动侦测少报所得计画及资讯对比。雇主、银行、交易经纪公司、独立包商的付款人，都向国税局提出申报，然后把同样的文件(1099表、W2表、1098 表、K-1表等)送交纳税人。如果报税人忽略申报任何一种税表上的所得，或申报的数额与税表上的不符，国税局就会找上门。 六、修改税表。修改税表上的申报数额，经常引起查税，尤其是报税人想增加扣除额所提供的资讯是在「红线区」(例如旅行开支、餐饮费、娱乐费、汽车开销等)。
b1fcc4328959ba250fea65705bebec9d6019369f.translatedText: Taxpayers hate being audited by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) because it is troublesome and "scary" and they worry that they will have to pay back taxes. If you ask an auditor why he was audited, you will probably not get an answer. But experts from Fox Business have roughly provided some "clues" to tax audits. In addition to randomly selecting tax inspection targets, the IRS has developed some "magic weapons" for identifying suspicious filers, including: 1. Discriminant Function System (DIF). Electronic tax filing makes it easy for the IRS to collect taxpayer information. It analyzes information from similar past tax returns and uses computers to calculate DIF. Those with higher change scores are more likely to be subject to tax audits, because this indicates that taxpayers may have underreported their income. 2. Abuse of tax avoidance transactions. The IRS can easily find taxpayers exploiting loopholes based on client lists provided by people caught hosting abusive tax avoidance transactions. If you find a tax-shelter deal that's "too good to be true," it's a good idea to ask a tax expert to see if it's safe. 3. Taxpayers who file taxes as self-employed need to pay attention to the 1099 tax form. Those whose self-employment income exceeds 400 yuan need to file a tax return regardless of whether they receive a 1099 form. 4. Conduct tax inspections for a certain industry every year. For example, in the past few years, the IRS has singled out foreign trust funds for tax audits, hoping to catch undeclared overseas income. 5. Automatically detect plans for underreporting income and compare information. Employers, banks, transaction brokers, and independent contractor payors all file returns with the IRS and then send the same documents (Form 1099, Form W2, Form 1098, Form K-1, etc.) to the taxpayer. If a tax filer neglects to declare any type of income on his or her tax return, or if the amount reported does not match the amount stated on the return, the IRS will come knocking. 6. Modify the tax form. Modifying the reported amount on the tax return often triggers tax audits, especially when the information provided by the tax filer who wants to increase the deduction amount is in the "red line area" (such as travel expenses, dining expenses, entertainment expenses, car expenses, etc.).

4fb760540e8ea4ec2866404f18804c82eab93390.sourceText: 慈济在11月10日及11日为美东「桑迪」街头募款，2 天共募到$2,883.00
4fb760540e8ea4ec2866404f18804c82eab93390.translatedText: Tzu Chi held a street fundraiser for Sandy in East America on November 10 and 11, and raised a total of $2,883.00 in two days

062f7704870aefa175cd776ea2a187bf81e61f15.sourceText: 慈济在11月10日及11日为美东「桑迪」街头募款，2 天共募到$2,883.00 慈济凤凰城联络处来稿：…
062f7704870aefa175cd776ea2a187bf81e61f15.translatedText: Tzu Chi raised funds on the streets of Sandy in East America on November 10 and 11, raising a total of $2,883.00 in two days. A letter from the Tzu Chi Phoenix Liaison Office: ...

74c56ebefc0165923ae03393d6551d9299840e93.sourceText: 慈济凤凰城联络处来稿：美东桑迪风灾，发生至今已近半个月，对美东的美国人而言，他们自己也可能没想到，这次的灾情会严重到这样，会影响这么多人及 时间这么长；这对世界而言，这是难以想像，且依美国的强大，就算有灾自己也有能力立即复原…. 然此刻实际的情况，真是如我们所想吗？ 美东灾民还深陷在淹水、没电、少油、天冷、没暖气，食物不足的困顿生活中；因着上人无强界承担的悲愿，至使全美慈济人，亦由一开始 对美东灾情看似还好，直到现在愈深入付出就愈感动，也发现灾区的广大及待援的迫切！ 上人今日慈示，全美慈济人此刻也似美国政府组成「联邦救难总署」（FEMA）般，全美慈济人总动员。 在美东志工已渐兵疲马困当的下，见证各地爱心接力的支持力量，不论是从美西或美中，许多勘灾、赈灾经验丰富的菩萨，皆已抵达或起程前往美东驰援； 而全美慈济人更于上周发动街头募心募爱活动及呼吁亲朋好友共同付出善心与善行。 本周六11月17日，慈济还会继续街头募款，请大众共襄盛举，为美东灾民付出一点绵力。
74c56ebefc0165923ae03393d6551d9299840e93.translatedText: A letter from the Tzu Chi Phoenix Liaison Office: It has been nearly half a month since the Sandy storm occurred in the East United States. For Americans in the East United States, they themselves may not have imagined that this disaster would be so serious and affect so many people and for such a long time. This is unimaginable for the world, and with the strength of the United States, even if there is a disaster, it will be able to recover immediately... But is the actual situation at this moment really what we think? The victims of the disaster in the East United States are still trapped in a difficult life of floods, no electricity, low gas, cold weather, no heating, and insufficient food. Because of the Lord’s compassionate wish to bear the burden, Tzu Chi people across the United States also seemed to be okay with the disaster in the East United States at the beginning. Until now, the more they pay in-depth, the more moved they are, and they realize the vastness of the disaster area and the urgent need for help! The Master lovingly indicated today that Tzu Chi workers across the United States are now mobilized just as the U.S. government formed the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA). As volunteers in the Eastern United States are gradually exhausted, we have witnessed the support of the relay of love from all over the world. Whether from the United States, the West or the United States, many Bodhisattvas with rich experience in disaster detection and disaster relief have arrived or set off to the Eastern United States to provide assistance; and Tzu Chi people across the United States launched a street fund-raising event last week and called on relatives and friends to join in charity and deeds. This Saturday, November 17, Tzu Chi will continue to raise funds on the street, and invites the public to participate in this grand event and contribute a little bit to the victims of the East American disaster.

b04f90c11a92ea9da3b86b1f51606090548e2035.sourceText: 亚省侨学界庆国庆迎中秋9月16日在ASU举行 活动准备就绪（图） 出席 筹备会的人员 为庆祝中华人民共和国成立63周年，亚利桑那州国庆中秋系列庆祝活动的筹备工作正在有条不紊地展开。国庆筹委会近日在凤凰城中国文化中心进行筹备分工和系列活动的安排进展情况通报会。 2012年国庆中秋系列活动将由中国云南人才招聘会、国庆招待会、中秋舞会三大部分组成。数十年来， 大凤凰城地区各华人华侨社团及学生学者组织每年都联合举办国庆系列庆祝活动。筹委会广泛邀请侨界名流、社团领袖、各界杰出人士、美国政界和商界友人及中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆官员等参加各项庆祝活动，今年中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆的卞立新副总领事、侨务领事白东石、教育领事许翠英将前来出席侨学界的中秋国庆系列活动并为大会致辞，特别一提的是，云南省政府代表团也将于当天飞抵凤凰城举办人才招聘会并参加国庆、中秋活动。系列活动是充分展示凤凰城地区华人社区团结向上的风貌，展示中国的进步和繁荣，加强中美两国的交流与合作。 今年的活动仪式的地点和往年一样，在亚利桑那州立大学举行，地点选在ASU MU Ballroom,下面是具体活动程序： 云南省人才招聘会：3:30 PM – 5:30 PM 国庆招待会：5:30 PM – 7:30 PM 中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆和美国侨报提供图片展 。 中秋联谊舞会：7:30 PM – 9:30 PM 每年的国庆中秋系列活动都是凤凰城华人社区规格最高，接触主流社会最为广泛的重大活动。从开始时只有少量人在当地中餐馆聚餐，发展成为如今参加人上千人次，参与人员涵盖当地政、商、侨、学、医、科各界精英的大聚会。 中华海外联谊会理事杨文田通报了中国国内各协侨单位对凤凰城国庆中秋活动的祝贺与期待并主持了筹备会议。 华总财务总监吴宁对财务情况作了简要说明，侨领吴亮祖、徐强等对筹备工作提出了指导性的建议。程序安排总策划陈志钢、古亚瑜对文艺节目安排征求了大家的想法。 亚省华总会长、活动执行主席王盛君、ASU中国学生会会长王德轩、AU中国学生会会长 仇玺源 、图桑华人代表雷洪等各界代表纷纷表示，随着中国在国际上的影响力日益增强，随着中美两国人员往来的日益频繁，有关中国和侨界的重大活动也日益受到凤凰城当地的重视。国庆中秋活动系列活动已经成为团结广大华人、弘扬中华文化、增进中美文化交流、加强两国人民友好往来的桥梁，也成为美西南地区社会、文化生活中的热点，必将成为充分展示中国人自豪和骄傲的舞台，表达海外华人华侨对祖国母亲生日和中美关系的美好祝愿。
b04f90c11a92ea9da3b86b1f51606090548e2035.translatedText: The Overseas Chinese and Overseas Chinese Community in Arizona celebrates the National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival on September 16th. The event is ready (picture). Personnel attending the preparatory meeting. In order to celebrate the 63rd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, preparations for a series of National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival celebrations in Arizona are underway in an orderly manner. The National Day Preparatory Committee recently held a briefing on the progress of the preparatory work division and arrangement of a series of activities at the Chinese Cultural Center in Phoenix. The 2012 National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival series of activities will consist of three parts: the China Yunnan Talent Recruitment Fair, the National Day Reception, and the Mid-Autumn Festival Dance. For decades, various overseas Chinese associations and student and scholar organizations in the greater Phoenix area have jointly held a series of National Day celebrations every year. The organizing committee has extensively invited celebrities from the overseas Chinese community, community leaders, outstanding figures from all walks of life, friends from the American political and business circles, and officials from the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles to participate in various celebration activities. This year, Bian Lixin, Deputy Consul General of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, and Overseas Chinese Affairs Officer Consul Bai Dongshi and Education Consul Xu Cuiying will come to attend the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day activities of the overseas Chinese academic community and deliver a speech at the conference. It is particularly worth mentioning that the Yunnan Provincial Government delegation will also fly to Phoenix on the same day to hold a talent recruitment fair and participate in National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival activities. The series of activities is to fully demonstrate the united and progressive style of the Chinese community in the Phoenix area, showcase China's progress and prosperity, and strengthen exchanges and cooperation between China and the United States. The location of this year's event ceremony is the same as in previous years, held at Arizona State University in the ASU MU Ballroom. The following is the specific event program: Yunnan Provincial Talent Recruitment Fair: 3:30 PM – 5:30 PM National Day Reception: 5:30 PM – 7:30 PM The Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles and the American Overseas Chinese Newspaper provide photo exhibitions. Mid-Autumn Festival Social Dance: 7:30 PM – 9:30 PM The annual National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival series of activities are the highest-level major events in the Phoenix Chinese community and the most extensive exposure to mainstream society. What started as a gathering of only a few people at a local Chinese restaurant has grown to include thousands of attendees, including elites from all walks of life including local politics, business, overseas Chinese, academia, medicine, and science. Yang Wentian, director of the China Overseas Friendship Association, reported the congratulations and expectations of various overseas Chinese organizations in China for the National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival activities in Phoenix and presided over the preparatory meeting. Wu Ning, the financial director of Huazhong, gave a brief explanation of the financial situation, and overseas Chinese leaders Wu Liangzu and Xu Qiang provided guiding suggestions on the preparatory work. Chief program planners Chen Zhigang and Gu Yayu solicited everyone’s ideas on the arrangement of cultural and artistic programs. Wang Shengjun, president of the Chinese Association of Alberta and executive chairman of the event, Wang Dexuan, president of the ASU Chinese Student Association, Qiu Xiyuan, president of the AU Chinese Student Association, and Lei Hong, a Chinese representative from Tucson, and other representatives from all walks of life said that with the increasing influence of China in the world and the increasingly frequent personnel exchanges between China and the United States, major activities related to China and the overseas Chinese community have also received increasing attention in Phoenix. The National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival series of activities have become a bridge to unite the Chinese people, promote Chinese culture, enhance cultural exchanges between China and the United States, and strengthen friendly exchanges between the two peoples. They have also become a hot spot in the social and cultural life of the southwestern United States. They will surely become a stage to fully demonstrate the pride and pride of the Chinese people and express the best wishes of overseas Chinese for the motherland’s birthday and China-U.S. relations.

a8b8c43d8822fe9eba150254b450f47fc6031ab9.sourceText: 中國新闻联播不敢播的俄罗斯现状 世界银行报告震撼 世界银行提供的报告中，有二份报告，极具震撼。第一份是世界银行专家在4月17日公布的关于俄罗斯经济状况的报告中指出，俄罗斯经济增长是符合穷人利益的经济增长。第二份是世界银行专家12月1日宣布的分析报告：在2001年至2003年间，中国经济以每年接近10%的速度增长，但13亿人口中最贫穷的10%人群实际收入却下降了2.4%。 第一份报告让人震撼，是让人们知道，有一种经济增长，叫”符合穷人利益的经济增长”。俄罗斯的经济增长，开始于1999年。从1999年至2006年，年均增长速度约6％，经济总量增加了70％。然而，俄罗斯的工资和人均收支却增加了500％，扣除通胀后，人均收入实际增长，超过了200％。 八年间，俄罗斯的人均实际工资和人均实际收入的增长速度，比人均GDP的增长速度，高出二倍。俄罗斯的老百姓，实实在在地分享了经济增长的成果。当下，俄罗斯人平均月工资10800卢布，约合人民币3650元。其中莫斯科人均工资最高，目前人均约2万卢布，折合人民币6700元；与中国接壤的远东地区最低，月均工资在9500至10000卢布(人民帀3200至3360元)之间。 实际工资增长大大超过GDP的增长速度，只是俄罗斯人分享经济增长成果的一个方面。另一个方面，就是俄罗斯联邦和各联邦主体、地方政府，将三分之一的财政支出，用于教育、医疗、救济等社会领域的。从而建立和维持了一套完善的社会福利体系。让退休、失业、儿童、学生等等弱势人群，也扎扎实实地分享到经济增长的成果。 随着经济增长，俄罗斯各地每一个季度都调整”人均最低生活标准”，也就是”贫困线”。最低生活标准每一季度由俄罗斯各联邦主体制定，用于评估居民生活水平以及作为制定补助金、补偿金及其它社保支付款项。莫斯科今年第三季度，人均最低生活标准为月5124卢布(折人民帀每月 1700元，北京市2006年7月1日起，基本生活费确定为每人每月448元，仅为莫斯科最低生活费标的26％)，有劳动能力的居民最低生活标准为 5795卢布，退休人员3533卢布，儿童是4381卢布。与中国东北接壤的滨海边疆区今年第二季度居民人均最低生活费标准定为月4362卢布(折人民帀每月1450元，与之接壤的黑龙江省哈尔滨市现行居民最低生活费保障标准是1997年制订的，市区每人每月200元，阿城市、尚志市、木兰县和延寿县为 117元)，有劳动能力的居民最低生活费指数为4687卢布，退休人员3383卢布，儿童4202卢布。由于?#36139;困线?#30340;标准特别高，全俄罗斯平均计算，相当于人均GDP的40％，而各级政府财政支出的最大一块，就用在医疗、教育、补贴、救济等社会保障体系上。以莫斯科市2007年预算儿童补贴项目为例，全市明年财政预算，用于有子女家庭社会支持款项总额360亿卢布(108亿人民币)，生育二胎及更多孩子的家庭所获一次性补助金额将增加4倍，从2000 至1万卢布不等；每个儿童的月津贴数额将增加1至1.5倍；多子女家庭的年度校服补贴从1000卢布增至5000卢布；因在家照顾3岁以下残障儿童而不能外出工作的父母将获得每月4500卢布(1300人民帀)；抚养三岁以下儿童的大学生家庭每月的食品补贴将增加两倍，从550卢布增至1650卢布；为预防社会孤儿出现及发展家庭教育方式，发放给监护人用于抚养被监护人的资金数额将从4500卢布提高到6000卢布。(注：最新汇率10卢布=2.9731 人民帀) 可以这样说，今日的俄罗斯，?#36139;穷?#26159;相对的，从绝对意义上，已经没有穷人了。民选的官员，拼命讨好选民，除免费医疗、免费教育之外，俄罗斯政府补贴，救济项目，共有几百项之多。这样情势下，在经济恢复了的俄罗斯，想当穷人，不容易做到。4月10日，俄罗斯财政部部长库德林宣布，根据俄罗斯2007～2009年三年预算计划，未来三年间，实际工资还将提高50%。俄罗斯宏观经济分析和短期预测中心《俄罗斯经济长期趋势》报告预测，2012年前俄可赶上韩国、西班牙、以色列的经济发展水平，2020年前，人均GDP可达29400美元。 我们再看看剧变后的东欧,到了2006年已经有两个国家人均GDP已经超过10000美元,其馀国家人均GDP全部超过5000美元,据世界银行预测,在2020年左右,东欧国家将全部进入高收入国家行列。
a8b8c43d8822fe9eba150254b450f47fc6031ab9.translatedText: The current situation in Russia that China News Network dare not broadcast. The World Bank report is shocking. Among the reports provided by the World Bank, there are two reports that are extremely shocking. The first is a report on Russia's economic conditions released by World Bank experts on April 17, stating that Russia's economic growth is economic growth that is in the interests of the poor. The second is an analysis report announced by experts from the World Bank on December 1: Between 2001 and 2003, China's economy grew at an annual rate of nearly 10%, but the real income of the poorest 10% of the 1.3 billion people fell by 2.4%. The first report is shocking because it lets people know that there is a kind of economic growth called "economic growth that is in the interests of the poor." Russia's economic growth began in 1999. From 1999 to 2006, the average annual growth rate was about 6%, and the total economic volume increased by 70%. However, Russia's wages and per capita income and expenditure increased by 500%, and after deducting inflation, per capita income actually increased by more than 200%. In the past eight years, Russia's per capita real wages and per capita real income have grown twice as fast as per capita GDP. The Russian people have truly shared the fruits of economic growth. At present, the average monthly salary of Russians is 10,800 rubles, which is approximately RMB 3,650. Among them, Moscow has the highest per capita salary, currently about 20,000 rubles, equivalent to RMB 6,700; the Far East region bordering China has the lowest, with average monthly wages ranging from 9,500 to 10,000 rubles (RMB 3,200 to 3,360 yuan). Real wage growth, which greatly exceeds the growth rate of GDP, is only one aspect in which Russians share the fruits of economic growth. On the other hand, the Russian Federation and its federal entities and local governments spend one-third of their fiscal expenditures on social fields such as education, medical care, and relief. Thus a complete social welfare system has been established and maintained. Let vulnerable groups such as retired people, unemployed people, children, students, etc., also share the fruits of economic growth in a down-to-earth manner. As the economy grows, Russia adjusts its "minimum living standards per capita", or "poverty line," every quarter. The minimum living standard is set by each Russian federal entity every quarter and is used to assess the living standards of residents and to formulate subsidies, compensation and other social security payments. In the third quarter of this year, the per capita minimum living standard in Moscow was 5,124 rubles per month (equivalent to 1,700 yuan in RMB per month. Starting from July 1, 2006, the basic living expenses in Beijing were set at 448 yuan per person per month, which is only 26% of Moscow’s minimum living standards). The minimum living standard for residents with the ability to work was 5,795 rubles, 3,533 rubles for retirees, and 4,381 rubles for children. The per capita minimum living standard for residents in Primorsky Krai, which borders Northeast China, was set at 4,362 rubles per month (equivalent to 1,450 yuan per month in RMB) in the second quarter of this year. The current minimum living standard for residents in Harbin City, Heilongjiang Province, which borders it, was formulated in 1997. It is 200 yuan per person per month in urban areas. Acheng City, Shangzhi City, Mulan County and Yanshou County are 117 yuan), the minimum living cost index for residents with working ability is 4687 rubles, for retirees 3383 rubles, and for children 4202 rubles. Because the "difficulty line" standard is extremely high, calculated on average across Russia, it is equivalent to 40% of per capita GDP, and the largest portion of fiscal expenditures by governments at all levels is spent on social security systems such as medical care, education, subsidies, and relief. Taking the child subsidy project in Moscow's 2007 budget as an example, the city's fiscal budget for next year will provide a total of 36 billion rubles (10.8 billion yuan) for social support for families with children. The one-time subsidy amount for families with a second child or more will increase fourfold, from 2000 to 2008. ranging from 10,000 rubles to 10,000 rubles; the amount of monthly allowance per child will be increased by 1 to 1.5 times; the annual school uniform subsidy for families with multiple children will be increased from 1,000 rubles to 5,000 rubles; parents who cannot go out to work because they take care of disabled children under 3 years old at home will receive 4,500 rubles (1,300 yuan) per month. ; The monthly food subsidy for college student families raising children under three years old will be tripled, from 550 rubles to 1,650 rubles; in order to prevent the emergence of social orphans and develop family education methods, the amount of funds distributed to guardians to support wards will be increased from 4,500 rubles to 6,000 rubles. (Note: The latest exchange rate is 10 rubles = 2.9731 yuan) It can be said that today's Russia is poor. Relatively speaking, in an absolute sense, there are no poor people anymore. Elected officials are desperately trying to please voters. In addition to free medical care and free education, there are hundreds of Russian government subsidies and relief projects. Under such circumstances, it is not easy to be poor in Russia, where the economy has recovered. On April 10, Russian Finance Minister Kudrin announced that according to Russia's three-year budget plan from 2007 to 2009, real wages will increase by 50% in the next three years. The Russian Center for Macroeconomic Analysis and Short-term Forecasting's "Long-term Trends in the Russian Economy" report predicts that Russia will catch up with the economic development level of South Korea, Spain, and Israel by 2012, and that by 2020, per capita GDP will reach US$29,400. Let’s look at Eastern Europe after the drastic changes. By 2006, the per capita GDP of two countries had exceeded US$10,000, and the per capita GDP of the rest of the countries had exceeded US$5,000. According to the World Bank’s prediction, around 2020, all Eastern European countries will enter the ranks of high-income countries.

94f34a84de1e062f26c74d4aac286917c8de5ed9.sourceText: （亚利桑那现代中文学校 唐南筠供稿）中国新年刚过， 趁大家还浓浓地感受着我们传统文化气息的同时， 现代中文学校请来了华文教育专家陈普先生， 为本校将参加今年 AP Chinese Exam 的同学们做了一次生动，有效的模拟教学， 旨在激发和鼓励同学们对中文学习的兴趣和热爱， 也强调了对中华文化的了解是掌握和运用语言的关键之一。 AP Chinese Exam 正是将中文语言和文化相结合的全面测试。 在模拟教学中， 陈普先生用AP Chinese Exam 的评分标准， 重点对同学们的”说”和”写作”作了详细点评和指导， 让大家意识到自身状况和目标间的距离，使师生们都受益非浅， 为以后的备考指明了方向。 最后， 陈普先生亲赋小诗一首结束了这次极有意义的AP Chinese Exam 的模拟教学。诗曰： 评罢 A P 心未空， 佳篇回味意难穷。 如花妙句我生笑， 别样奇思他自通。 错字方言趣有异， 古文白话理相同。 但教汉语能推广， 不枉师生熬苦功。
94f34a84de1e062f26c74d4aac286917c8de5ed9.translatedText: (contributed by Tang Nanyun of Arizona Modern Chinese School) The Chinese New Year has just passed, While everyone is still deeply feeling the atmosphere of our traditional culture, Modern Chinese School invited Mr. Chen Pu, an expert in Chinese education, to conduct a vivid and effective simulation teaching for the students of our school who will participate in this year's AP Chinese Exam. The purpose is to stimulate and encourage students' interest and love for Chinese learning, and also emphasizes that understanding of Chinese culture is one of the keys to mastering and using the language. The AP Chinese Exam is a comprehensive test that combines Chinese language and culture. During the simulation teaching, Mr. Chen Pu used the scoring standards of the AP Chinese Exam to give detailed comments and guidance on the students' "speaking" and "writing", making everyone aware of the distance between their own situation and goals, which benefited both teachers and students a lot and pointed out the direction for future exam preparations. Finally, Mr. Chen Pu composed a poem himself to end this very meaningful AP Chinese Exam simulation teaching. The poem says: After commenting, AP, my heart is not empty, and it is hard to run out of good memories. The wonderful words like flowers make me laugh, and other strange thoughts make him understand. The typos and dialects have different tastes, but the ancient Chinese vernacular has the same meaning. But teaching Chinese can promote it, and the hard work of teachers and students is not in vain.

cbb1868779acb4289bb95d90abedd9e34c09c4cc.translatedText: Beef prices increase, McDonald’s McDouble raises prices

78556914c39dc41e9beb355550506c3d0245e5ce.sourceText: 牛肉涨价 麦当劳McDouble调涨 （亚省时报） 麦当劳连锁速食店2008年推出的一元起士汉堡一直很受欢…
78556914c39dc41e9beb355550506c3d0245e5ce.translatedText: Beef prices increase, McDonald’s McDouble raises prices (Alberta Times) The one-dollar cheeseburger launched by the McDonald's fast-food chain in 2008 has always been very popular...

11bc789088b7e18c96e1b6d524211073748e3c54.sourceText: 麦当劳连锁速食店2008年推出的一元起士汉堡一直很受欢迎，可是随着牛肉涨价影响公司盈利，这种价廉物美的餐点愈来愈难以维持，许多加盟店已提高其售价，或根本不列在餐牌上。 麦当劳去年12月推出另一种一元烤洋葱起士堡，并为这种只有一块肉饼的新汉堡勐打广告，与夹两块肉饼的McDouble并列为宣传重点。 麦当劳的难题在于一元餐点中，McDouble原料成本最高，因此除非顾客附带购买炸薯条或汽水等利润较高的产品，餐馆可能无利可图。 麦当劳的许多加盟店已从一元餐点删除McDouble，或提高其售价。旧金山的McDouble定价1.09元，洛杉矶为1.19元，在阿拉斯加州Kodiak卖到1.80元，在纽约市更达到1.89元。 芝加哥和波士顿的麦当劳餐牌上都不列McDouble，如果顾客指定要求，价格分别是1.29元和1.49元。凤凰城、加州福瑞斯诺、丹佛、圣路易和华府的麦当劳，仍把McDouble列为一元餐点。 为了遏止在美国的1万4000家连锁店盈利连续两年下降，麦当劳正改变行销策略，同时进一步强调它着名的一元餐点，以吸引手头拮据的顾客，并对抗汉堡王和塔克钟等劲敌。 麦当劳向来会随着食品价格暴涨，调整一元餐点，现在也积极设法遏制牛肉价格上涨对盈利造成的损伤。去年夏天美国空前乾旱，严重影响食品供应系统，牛肉价格节节上涨，而且至少未来两年将居高不下。光是今年以来每磅牛绞肉已涨了六到八分钱。
11bc789088b7e18c96e1b6d524211073748e3c54.translatedText: The one-dollar cheeseburger launched by the McDonald's fast-food chain in 2008 has always been very popular. However, as the increase in beef prices affects the company's profits, it is increasingly difficult to maintain such cheap and delicious meals. Many franchise stores have increased their prices or not listed them on the menu at all. McDonald's launched another dollar grilled onion cheeseburger in December last year, and advertised this new burger with only one patty, alongside the McDouble with two patties. The problem for McDonald's is that McDouble ingredients cost the most among dollar meals, so unless customers buy higher-margin products such as French fries or soda as a side item, the restaurant may not be profitable. Many McDonald's franchisees have removed the McDouble from their one-dollar meals or increased their prices. The McDouble is priced at $1.09 in San Francisco, $1.19 in Los Angeles, $1.80 in Kodiak, Alaska, and $1.89 in New York City. McDonald's in Chicago and Boston do not list McDouble on their menus. If customers specifically request it, the price is 1.29 yuan and 1.49 yuan respectively. McDonald's stores in Phoenix, Fresno, Calif., Denver, St. Louis and Washington, D.C., still list the McDouble as a one-dollar meal. McDonald's is changing its marketing strategy to stem two consecutive years of declining profits at its 14,000 U.S. stores while further emphasizing its famous dollar meals to attract cash-strapped customers and compete with rivals such as Burger King and Taco Bell. McDonald's, which has a history of adjusting its one-dollar meals as food prices soar, is now actively trying to stem the damage to profits caused by rising beef prices. The unprecedented drought in the United States last summer seriously affected the food supply system. Beef prices have been rising and will remain high for at least the next two years. This year alone, ground beef prices have increased by six to eight cents per pound.

e476c1c1bbac184804fb081f575b56f5f075666d.translatedText: Real estate sales in Greater Phoenix in October 2011 (Alberta Times) There were 6,464 single-family homes sold in Greater Phoenix in October, double the number in 2007. There were 9,654 new homes listed, down about 20% from October 2010. The median home price in Greater Phoenix fell by $500, compared with $120,000 in September. According to statistics, the market for houses worth around 100,000 yuan is quite active, and most buyers are investors. The market for homes priced over 200,000 has shrunk slightly. The average price per square foot of houses under 200,000 yuan has increased, while the price of houses between 200,000 and 400,000 yuan has been stable. Houses with prices exceeding 400,000 are expected to be in great demand. The number of affordable bank homes is also falling sharply. 9660645213b07566e21518a9216a6786eeb80261.sourceText: （亚省时报广州特约记者杨绮薇报导）第111届广交会4月15日上午在广州琶洲会展中心拉开帷幕。在当前全球经济复甦乏力、世界各国需求放缓、出口面临诸多挑战的背景下，许多参展商表示，本届广交会的生意难做了，但他们对中国商品的竞争力仍然有信心。 上午8时许，琶洲周边已是熙熙攘攘，很多参展商早早到场。大批客商乘坐地铁参会，广州地铁8号线途经琶洲站，几乎成了广交会的”专列”。 本届广交会展览总面积达到116万平方米，展位总数59434个，比上届增加720个。境内外参展企业共24644家，比上届增加413家。进口展方面，本届继续在第一、三期设立进口展区，展览面积2万平方米，展位数888个，比上届增加10个。共吸引来自44个国家和地区的520家企业参展，企业数最多的国家为韩国。 广交会新闻发言人刘建军介绍，本届广交会的採购商邀请总量为111.8万户，比上届增长12.13%。刘建军说，当前，世界经济复甦乏力、複杂多变，生产要素价格波动不已，风险加剧。在这种情况下，有些国内中小企业选择放弃製造业，转而从事资本投资，但仍有许多出口企业尤其是中小企业迎难而上，希望藉助广交会这一出口平台应对危机和挑战。 ”他们对製造业的执着坚守，值得我们尊敬。”刘建军錶示，在欧盟地区的招商过程中，深感西方发达经济体着眼于扩大对华出口，希望以此重新振兴製造业并提升本国本地区的就业率。 ”这次广交会的进口展区就很受欢迎，一位难求。这表明外贸出口对经济增长的拉动作用极大，同时也说明广交会进口展区有极大的发展空间。?BR> 本届广交会将分三期举行。 4月15日开幕的是第一期，到19日结束。第二期和第三期将在4月23日和5月1日开幕。 为确保展会期间(4月15日-5月5日)出租车可及时疏运客商，市交通部门将在会期每天下午组织部分高峰出租车(俗称?#27225;的?前往琶洲展馆附近服务，并对服务情况进行考核。此外，也有普通出租车参与疏运工作。为杜绝以往广交会期间出现的”议价、拒载”问题，交通部门会在琶洲展馆、天河客运站、天河城及天河广百店、中华广场、北京路、上下九等多个繁华地段，安排开展出租车服务监督检查。
9660645213b07566e21518a9216a6786eeb80261.translatedText: (Reported by Yang Qiwei, Special Correspondent of the Alberta Times in Guangzhou) The 111th Canton Fair kicked off on the morning of April 15 at the Guangzhou Pazhou Convention and Exhibition Center. Against the backdrop of the current sluggish global economic recovery, slowing demand in various countries around the world, and many export challenges, many exhibitors said that business at this Canton Fair is difficult, but they still have confidence in the competitiveness of Chinese goods. At around 8 a.m., the area around Pazhou was already bustling with people, and many exhibitors arrived early. A large number of businessmen took the subway to attend the fair. Guangzhou Metro Line 8 passed through Pazhou Station and almost became a "special train" for the Canton Fair. The total exhibition area of ​​this Canton Fair reached 1.16 million square meters, with a total of 59,434 booths, 720 more than the previous session. A total of 24,644 domestic and foreign exhibitors participated, 413 more than the previous session. As for the import exhibition, this year’s import exhibition area will continue to be set up in the first and third phases, with an exhibition area of ​​20,000 square meters and 888 booths, 10 more than the previous session. A total of 520 companies from 44 countries and regions participated in the exhibition. The country with the largest number of companies is South Korea. Canton Fair spokesperson Liu Jianjun said that the total number of buyers invited for this Canton Fair was 1.118 million, an increase of 12.13% over the previous session. Liu Jianjun said that at present, the world economic recovery is sluggish, complex and volatile, the prices of production factors are fluctuating, and risks are intensifying. Under such circumstances, some domestic small and medium-sized enterprises have chosen to abandon manufacturing and engage in capital investment. However, there are still many export companies, especially small and medium-sized enterprises, who have risen to the challenge and hope to use the Canton Fair as an export platform to cope with crises and challenges. "Their persistence in manufacturing deserves our respect." Liu Jianjun said that during the investment promotion process in the EU region, he deeply felt that developed Western economies are focusing on expanding exports to China, hoping to revitalize the manufacturing industry and increase the employment rate in their own regions. "The import exhibition area of this Canton Fair is very popular and one is hard to find. This shows that foreign trade exports have a great driving effect on economic growth, and it also shows that the import exhibition area of the Canton Fair has great room for development.?BR> This Canton Fair will be held in three phases. The first phase will open on April 15 and end on the 19th. The second and third phases will open on April 23 and May 1. In order to ensure that taxis can transport passengers and merchants in a timely manner during the exhibition period (April 15th to May 5th), the municipal transportation department will organize some peak taxis (commonly known as? #27225;) to the vicinity of the Pazhou Complex every afternoon during the exhibition In addition, ordinary taxis are also involved in the transportation work. In order to eliminate the "bargaining and refusal of transportation" problems that occurred during the past Canton Fair, the transportation department will provide services at the Pazhou Exhibition Hall, Tianhe Passenger Terminal, and Tianhe City. Taxi service supervision and inspections have been arranged in Tianhe Guangbai Store, China Plaza, Beijing Road, Shangxiajiu and other busy areas.
