f7f6c76013f281e975e3abff36237e76e590aaf4.sourceText: 南加州2011年度华人社团10大新闻揭晓 注重自发活动 2012年新年来临之际，全美华裔青年新闻工作者联谊会、美华裔非政府组织(NGO)研究会、华文新媒体民调服务社等机构评选出南加州华人社团2011年度10大新闻。本次新闻评选以社区民调结合无记名投票的方式产生，强调和侧重于华人社团自发主办的社区活动新闻。 从评选结果可以看出，南加州华人社团在即将结束的2011年度，不论是在社区服务、文化交流和传承以及组织举办重大社区活动中，都扮演了非常重要的角色，同时对主流社会的影响也日渐增强。 按事件发生时间顺序，2011年度南加州华人社团10大新闻依次为： 1，2011年1月7日至9日，知名侨领戴锜将《宝岛一村》带到洛杉矶演出。这部被誉为”我们这个年代话剧舞台上的巅峰之作”在洛杉矶演出期间，获两岸侨民共鸣，场场爆满，每场演出闭幕后，全场观众起立鼓掌长达15分钟。 2，新党主席郁慕明2月9日在洛杉矶与华裔青年社团对话，探讨两岸青年之间交流的重要性，勉励海外青年社团传承优质的中国文化，将中国文化”和”的精髓在主流社会广泛传播。并就两岸青年交流对未来两岸关系的急迫性和重要性作了系统阐述。 3，五洲洪门致公总堂在罗省秉公堂主席、罗省中华会馆福地会主席马培道协助下，寻找到了辛亥革命功臣、五洲洪门致公总堂第三代盟主黄三德之墓，3月29日上午，五洲洪门致公总堂周国祥会长、黄三德长孙黄子迪一行近50人来到洛杉矶中华坟场，为黄三德扫墓并举行隆重的拜祭仪式。五洲洪门致公总堂重修黄三德墓碑于8月25日上午9点在洛杉矶中华坟场内举行隆重的謁碑典礼，重修工程为海外最大的辛亥百年纪念工程。 4，全球华裔青年社团缅怀黄花岗起义烈士殉难100周年，全美中华青年联合会邀集全球20多个国家和地区的华裔青年社团联署祭文。随后主办系列纪念辛亥百年专题活动6场。9月10日洛杉矶”三大会馆”与”三大堂口”百年来首次联手举办活动，纪念辛亥百年。 5，南加州罗省台山宁阳会馆顾问黄学林及夫人南加州潮境同乡会会长余锦梅为高中母校捐资100万建设的综合大楼落成庆典仪式4月15日在广东开平长师中学举行。综合大楼楼高5层，总建筑面积2768平方米。 6，首部进入北美市场的中国大陆主旋律电影《建党伟业》于6月24日在北美主流院线AMC全面公映。获美洲中华青年促统会、美中广东商会等联合支持。该片票房为2011年度全美华语电影之冠。 7，南加州各大知名院校中国留学新生剧增，华裔社区义工伸援手帮助接机，成为社区佳话。在7月份新生入学的高峰到来之际，南加大中国学生学者联谊会发出呼吁，希望迎接新同学的工作能得到南加州华裔社区的义工支援，获华裔社区青年社团积极回应，圆满完成接机任务。 8，中国留学生王玄6月8日从纽约出发，历时89天，徒步3000多英里，行经13个州，成功横穿美国大陆，于9月4日中午抵达美国西海岸的洛杉矶威尼斯海滩。成为徒步穿越美国大陆的第一位华裔。 9，中国特大型国有企业平煤神马集团与美国泰坦集团公司合作成立的”平煤神马美国有限公司”，11月17日晚在洛杉矶圣盖博市举行成立盛大揭牌仪式。中国平煤神马集团在地化方式进入美国市场成为今年南加州最引人注目的美中经济交流活动。 10，全美中华青年联合会11月初发起组织华裔青少年参加在中国青岛举办的冬令营，在短时间内完成组团，12月24日从洛杉矶出发。成为青岛冬令营基地建立五年以来，首个来自美国的团组。（AACYF洛杉矶讯）
f7f6c76013f281e975e3abff36237e76e590aaf4.translatedText: The top 10 news stories of the Chinese community in Southern California in 2011 were announced, focusing on spontaneous activities. On the occasion of the New Year of 2012, the National Association of Chinese Young Journalists, the Chinese American Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) Research Association, the Chinese New Media Polling Service and other organizations selected the top 10 news stories of the Chinese community in Southern California in 2011. This news selection is based on community polls combined with secret voting, emphasizing and focusing on news about community activities spontaneously sponsored by Chinese associations. It can be seen from the selection results that in the year 2011, which is about to end, Chinese associations in Southern California have played a very important role in community services, cultural exchanges and inheritance, and in organizing major community activities. At the same time, their influence on mainstream society is also increasing day by day. In chronological order of events, the top 10 news stories about Chinese communities in Southern California in 2011 are as follows: 1. From January 7 to 9, 2011, well-known overseas Chinese leader Dai Qi brought "Treasure Island Village" to Los Angeles for a performance. Known as "the pinnacle of drama on the stage of our time", this play resonated with the diaspora on both sides of the Taiwan Strait during its performance in Los Angeles. The venue was sold out. After each performance, the audience stood up and applauded for 15 minutes. 2. New Party Chairman Yu Muming held a dialogue with Chinese youth associations in Los Angeles on February 9 to discuss the importance of exchanges between cross-strait youth and encourage overseas youth associations to inherit high-quality Chinese culture and spread the essence of "harmony" in Chinese culture widely in mainstream society. He also systematically elaborated on the urgency and importance of cross-Strait youth exchanges to future cross-Strait relations. 3. With the help of Ma Peidao, chairman of the Luo Province Beng Gong Hall and chairman of the Fudi Association of the Luo Province Chinese Association, the Wuzhou Hongmen Zhigong General Hall found Huang Sande, a hero of the Revolution of 1911 and the third generation leader of the Wuzhou Hongmen Zhigong General Hall. Tomb, on the morning of March 29, nearly 50 people, including Zhou Guoxiang, president of Wuzhou Hongmen Zhigong Hall, and Huang Zidi, the eldest grandson of Huang Sande, came to the Chinese Cemetery in Los Angeles to sweep Huang Sande’s grave and hold a grand worship ceremony. The Wuzhou Hongmen Zhigong Main Hall renovated Huang Sande's tombstone. A grand memorial ceremony was held at the Chinese Cemetery in Los Angeles at 9 a.m. on August 25. The renovation project is the largest overseas Xinhai Centennial Commemoration Project. 4. Chinese youth associations around the world commemorate the 100th anniversary of the martyrs of the Huanghuagang Uprising. The National Chinese Youth Federation invites Chinese youth associations from more than 20 countries and regions around the world to sign a memorial commemoration. Then a series of 6 special events were held to commemorate the centenary of 1911. On September 10, the "Three Grand Halls" and "Three Grand Halls" in Los Angeles jointly held an event for the first time in a century to commemorate the centenary of the Xinhai Revolution. 5. Huang Xuelin, consultant of Taishan Ningyang Association in Southern California, and his wife Yu Jinmei, president of Southern California Chaojing Association, donated 1 million to the high school alma mater to build a comprehensive building. The completion ceremony was held on April 15 at Kaiping Changshi Middle School in Guangdong. The complex building is 5 stories high with a total construction area of ​​2768 square meters. 6. "The Founding of the Party", the first mainland Chinese theme movie to enter the North American market, was fully released on June 24 at the mainstream North American theater chain AMC. Received joint support from the American Youth Association for Promoting Reunification and the U.S.-China Guangdong Chamber of Commerce. The film's box office was the highest among Chinese-language films in the United States in 2011. 7. The number of Chinese students studying abroad in major well-known colleges and universities in Southern California has increased sharply, and Chinese community volunteers have extended a helping hand to help pick them up at the airport, which has become a good story in the community. As the peak enrollment period for new students arrives in July, the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of the University of Southern California issued an appeal, hoping that the work of welcoming new students would be supported by volunteers from the Chinese community in Southern California. The youth association of the Chinese community responded positively and successfully completed the pick-up task. 8. Wang Xuan, a Chinese international student, set out from New York on June 8. He walked for 89 days and more than 3,000 miles, traveled through 13 states, successfully crossed the American continent, and arrived at Venice Beach, Los Angeles, on the west coast of the United States at noon on September 4. Became the first Chinese-American to hike across the continental United States. 9. "Pingmei Shenma America Co., Ltd.", a joint venture between China's very large state-owned enterprise Pingmei Shenma Group and the American Titan Group Company, held a grand unveiling ceremony in San Gabriel, Los Angeles on the evening of November 17. China Pingmei Shenma Group’s localized entry into the U.S. market has become the most eye-catching U.S.-China economic exchange event in Southern California this year. 10. In early November, the National Chinese Youth Federation initiated the organization of Chinese teenagers to participate in a winter camp in Qingdao, China. The group was organized in a short period of time and set off from Los Angeles on December 24. It became the first group from the United States in the five years since the Qingdao Winter Camp Base was established. (AACYF Los Angeles News)

516ec20bd383b90eaf396b768b3e05adff30466f.sourceText: 联邦疾病防治中心(CDC)4日发布的最新流感疫情报告指出，今年的流行性感冒季不仅提早发威，而且来势汹汹，疫情继续扩大。仅12月23日至29日一周内，全美就有2257人因流感住院，18名儿童因流感有关併发症丧生。预期流感尚未达到高峰期，疫情将会继续恶化，半数以上的州将会病例大增。 CDC发言人史金纳说，到目前为止，作怪的流感菌株主要是「H3N2」，幼儿与老年人宜特别小心，应接种流感疫苗防御。 CDC说，目前已有29州与纽约市报称流感猖獗，12月22日为止的一周，只有16州和纽约市疫情猖獗。CDC并表示，目前41州流感疫情「普遍」，比早先的31州迅速增加，亚利桑那州疫情「中度」，没有出现病患不治报告。 一般流感期约12周，CDC表示，本流感期可能比一般长。史金纳说，流感季通常在1月底或 2月初达到高峰，但本季流感去年11月就开始于南部和东南部地区发威，疫情严重且普遍，颇不寻常。 史金纳说，上一季的流感比较温和，预料本季的流感菌种比较凶勐。CDC说，估计一个典型流感季将有3万6000人因流感和相关併发症丧生。最好的防御是，从六个月大的幼儿到老年人，人人都接种流感疫苗(打预防针)。 流感的症状包括发烧、咳嗽、疲倦、头痛、全身酸痛、流鼻涕等。专家表示，如果患了流感，应立即服用抗病毒药物。
516ec20bd383b90eaf396b768b3e05adff30466f.translatedText: The latest influenza epidemic report released by the Federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) on the 4th pointed out that this year’s influenza season not only started early, but also came fiercely, and the epidemic continued to expand. In the week of December 23 to 29 alone, 2,257 people were hospitalized due to influenza in the United States, and 18 children died from influenza-related complications. It is expected that the influenza epidemic has not yet reached its peak, the epidemic will continue to worsen, and more than half of the states will see a significant increase in cases. CDC spokesperson Skinner said that so far, the influenza strain responsible is mainly "H3N2". Young children and the elderly should be especially careful and should receive influenza vaccination for protection. The CDC said that 29 states and New York City have reported rampant influenza epidemics. In the week ending December 22, only 16 states and New York City had rampant epidemics. The CDC also stated that the current influenza epidemic is "common" in 41 states, which is more rapid than the previous 31 states. The epidemic in Arizona is "moderate" and there are no reports of deaths. The typical flu period lasts about 12 weeks, but the CDC says this flu period may be longer than usual. Skinner said the flu season usually peaks at the end of January or early February, but this season's flu began in the South and Southeast in November last year. The epidemic was severe and widespread, which is quite unusual. Skinner said last season's flu was relatively mild, and this season's flu strains are expected to be more virulent. The CDC says an estimated 36,000 people die from influenza and related complications during a typical flu season. The best defense is for everyone from children as young as six months to the elderly to get a flu shot (vaccinated). Symptoms of the flu include fever, cough, tiredness, headache, body aches, runny nose, etc. Experts say if you have the flu, you should take antiviral medication immediately.

4b231bcd24752a6e8c48d2bd985f02198260ea9f.translatedText: The Tucson School District is under investigation for its unfair treatment of Latinos (Alberta Times) Federal Department of Education investigators are probing the Tucson Unified School District for alleged unfair treatment of non-English-speaking Americans. The Department of Education confirmed it received a complaint last week alleging that the Unified School District restricted Latino participation in its school board meetings. The U.S. Department of Education promises that the government will treat all ethnic groups equally and ensure the rights and interests of citizens. After conducting a detailed investigation into the incident, no matter what the outcome is, an explanation will be given to the public. The Unified School District also agreed to cooperate with the Department of Education’s investigation.

1c6420d8bfb0d92e1e656b249c6eff6859f8a97b.sourceText: 美国就业形势低迷 留学生自叹求职难与本土生竞争 编者按：美国就业形势不好，就算名校毕业也很难加分。对于来自海外的留学生来说，就更加是”难上加难”。来自中国大陆的留学生表示，他们与美国本土的毕业生，根本不在”同一个水平线上”竞争，因为他们还要遭受H1-B签证的束缚，让他们更加找不到合适的工作机会。 资料显示，美国每年有150万的大学毕业生，而大学近几届毕业生(22岁至26岁)的失业率为8.9%，而高中近几届毕业生的失业率高达22.9%。已经从加州大学伯克利大学分校毕业3年的陈珍妮(化名)，依然找不到合适的工作。她毕业于洛杉矶地区著名的高中，以全额奖学金就读名校加州大学伯克利大学分校的生化专业，几乎没有人会想到她找不到工作。她告诉记者，在前2年的求职阶段，她几乎崩溃了，父母也跟着她一起着急。最后，在父母、亲友及教会义工的鼓励下，她用了1年的时间复习功课，报考了医学院，终于将在今年秋季重返校园。 即将走出校园的赵军(化名)，是来自中国大陆的留学生。他一直认为自己因为从小就在中国的英文学校上学，英文基础比美国人还好。同时，还精通中文有双语的优势，因此找工作应该不成问题。谁知，在一个面试的机会，他见到了比他早一年毕业的学长–一位在校时被众人誉为?#26999;模生?#30340;全优生，居然也在同一批的面试人士当中。 赵军告诉记者，有许多留学生，怀着想在美国”实习”、积累一点经验再回国”报效祖国”的想法。但是，即使是面对高喊着”平等就业”等口号的大公司，很多人最多也只能走到面试这一关。一旦到达公司的”人力资源部”，他们就要遭受H1-B签证的束缚，因为许多公司一见到需要申请H1-B签证的学生，就暗中挂起了”免谈旗帜”，让留学生更加找不到合适的工作机会。 根据预测，2012年6月开始，美国又将有150万名大学毕业生，他们面临的是就业市场的持续不景气，不得不与前几届师兄师姐们一起”抢饭碗”的局面。
1c6420d8bfb0d92e1e656b249c6eff6859f8a97b.translatedText: The employment situation in the United States is sluggish. International students lament that it is difficult to compete with local students for jobs. Editor's note: The employment situation in the United States is not good. Even if you graduate from a prestigious school, it is difficult to gain points. For international students from overseas, it is even more difficult. International students from mainland China say that they are not competing at the same level as graduates from the United States because they are still subject to H1-B visas, which makes it even harder for them to find suitable job opportunities. Data show that there are 1.5 million college graduates in the United States every year, and the unemployment rate for recent college graduates (22 to 26 years old) is 8.9%, while the unemployment rate for recent high school graduates is as high as 22.9%. Jenny Chen (pseudonym), who has graduated from the University of California, Berkeley, three years ago, still cannot find a suitable job. She graduated from a prestigious high school in the Los Angeles area and studied biochemistry at the prestigious University of California, Berkeley, with a full scholarship. Almost no one would have thought that she would not be able to find a job. She told reporters that during the job search phase in the first two years, she almost collapsed, and her parents were also anxious with her. Finally, with the encouragement of her parents, relatives, friends and church volunteers, she spent a year reviewing her homework and applied for medical school. She will finally return to school this fall. Zhao Jun (pseudonym), who is about to leave campus, is an international student from mainland China. He has always believed that because he attended an English school in China since he was a child, his English foundation is better than that of Americans. At the same time, being proficient in Chinese has the advantage of being bilingual, so finding a job should not be a problem. Unexpectedly, during an interview, he met his senior who graduated a year earlier than him - a student who was hailed as a "model student" by everyone at school. He was actually among the same batch of interviewees. Zhao Jun told reporters that there are many international students who want to "intern" in the United States, accumulate some experience and then return to China to "serve the motherland." However, even in the face of large companies that chant slogans such as "equal employment", many people can only go as far as the interview level. Once they arrive at the company's "human resources department", they will be subject to the constraints of the H1-B visa, because many companies secretly hang up the "no-negotiation flag" as soon as they see students who need to apply for H1-B visas, making it even harder for international students to find suitable job opportunities. According to predictions, starting in June 2012, there will be another 1.5 million college graduates in the United States. They are facing a continued recession in the job market and have to "grab for jobs" with their brothers and sisters from previous generations.

44f1c648dd0333f69b967a6efb4623a4b5c4405a.sourceText: 5月6日，风和日丽。 参加2012年凤凰城华裔选美的9位佳丽，来到浓娜工作室，展开化妆、美容和拍摄的准备工作。 专业摄影师柯国基及太太Joey(摄影/灯光) ，还有专业发型设计/化妆造型的黄欣明和Kitty ，成为今年选美佳丽的时尚天使，通过他们的艺术理念和灵巧的双手，将9位 参选姑娘来一个华丽转身，把美好的造型呈现到大家眼前。 目前佳丽的标准相正在修缉中，不久将可揭开面纱。
44f1c648dd0333f69b967a6efb4623a4b5c4405a.translatedText: On May 6, the weather was sunny and sunny. The nine beauties who participated in the 2012 Phoenix Chinese Beauty Pageant came to Nongna Studio to start preparations for makeup, beauty and photography. Professional photographer Ke Guoji and his wife Joey (photography/lighting), as well as professional hairstylists/makeup stylists Huang Xinming and Kitty, became the fashion angels of this year’s beauty pageant. Through their artistic ideas and dexterous hands, they gave the nine contestants a gorgeous turn and presented their beautiful looks to everyone. The standard photos of the beauties are currently being edited and will be unveiled soon.

e7b754c4a7d0cfbc736892858df2d377cceaba62.sourceText: 对于不少佳丽来说，来到这种专业的摄影沙龙还是第一次，在专业人士的指导下，在这长达8个小时的化妆和拍摄过程中，佳丽们通过全程的观摩和亲身参与， 学到了很多新知，受益匪浅。 同时，我们要为这几位相当专业而又默默付出的义工给予赞扬，在将来风光的庆典选美台前，在灿烂的佳丽笑容中，有着他们的光彩！ 发型设计/化妆造型的黄欣明和Kitty，是大家熟识的人物，而主办今次摄影的”浓娜工作室”(La Luna Photography) ，则是由柯国基(Kwok/亚国) 与太太Joey创办。 亚国毕业于西雅图艺术学院，拥有美术设计学位，自少与摄影结下不解之缘。 由90年代的菲林到现在的数码，亚国紧追日新月异的拍摄时代，从背景、灯光、造型等方面深下苦功，加上有太太Joey (化妆/美容专业) 的支持，和其它多方面的 协助，亚国伉俪在201​​2 年决定将他们对美术的一份热爱与执着，化为创业的动力，开办了浓娜工作室，主要提供时装，创意婚纱摄影，艺术写真，家庭外拍等，欢迎 浏览他们的网址， 这是一个相当专业又十分令人欣赏的艺术园地： www.lalunaphotos.com.
e7b754c4a7d0cfbc736892858df2d377cceaba62.translatedText: For many beauties, it was their first time to come to such a professional photography salon. Under the guidance of professionals, during the eight-hour makeup and shooting process, the beauties learned a lot of new knowledge and benefited a lot from observing and personally participating in the entire process. At the same time, we would like to commend these very professional and silently dedicated volunteers. They will shine brightly in the bright smiles of the beauties in front of the glorious celebration and beauty pageant in the future! Huang Xinming and Kitty, who are the hairstylists/makeup stylists, are familiar figures to everyone, and "La Luna Photography" (La Luna Photography), which hosted this photo shoot, was founded by Kwok (亚国) and his wife Joey. Yaguo graduated from the Seattle Art Institute with a degree in art design and has been closely associated with photography since childhood. From film in the 1990s to digital today, Yaguo has kept up with the ever-changing shooting era. He has worked hard on backgrounds, lighting, styling, etc. With the support of his wife Joey (makeup/beauty major) and assistance in many other aspects, Yaguo and his wife were in 2012 In 2006, they decided to turn their love and persistence in art into the motivation to start a business, and opened Laluna Studio, which mainly provides fashion, creative wedding photography, art portraits, family outdoor photography, etc. Welcome to browse their website, which is a very professional and very admirable art garden: www.lalunaphotos.com.

8563c83e755cba97d8edac8ac5e8d6f752405605.sourceText: 从无锡到杭州，汽车沿着太湖边疾驶，田园间佈满了四，五层高的各式新楼房，这裡就是人口稠密而又富有的杭嘉湖地区, 即便是冬天，田野里也是一片繁忙景象，一片片的塑料薄膜下，培育着各种秧苗；一座座玻璃棚内，人们在採摘新鲜果菜；拖拉机在远方土地耕耘着，正在为即将到来的春播作准备。如今这裡的农民，实行科学种田，一年四季已没有农閒与农忙之别，科技进步给农村带来了翻天覆地的变化，再加上养猪，养鸡，养鸭，养鱼虾螃蟹及多种副业，据说农民的年人均收入已达20万人民币以上，超过了城裡工人的收入，不少家庭有了自己的”桑塔纳”，这都是发生在最近10年的新变化。这些变化的发生主要在于政策的变化和人们思想的变化。 过去农民种地，工人做工，商人经商，当官（干部）的管老百姓，天经地义。如今，有了新的观念，做事以经济效益为中心，打破了行业界限，人们可以按照社会的需要去做你喜欢的事，不仅在中国，还可以从全球的角度去寻求发展。于是，给每个人都创造了无限的机会。
8563c83e755cba97d8edac8ac5e8d6f752405605.translatedText: From Wuxi to Hangzhou, cars are speeding along the Taihu Lake. The countryside is filled with four or five-story new buildings. This is the densely populated and wealthy Hangjiahu area. Even in winter, the fields are busy. Various seedlings are cultivated under pieces of plastic film; people are picking fresh fruits and vegetables in glass sheds; tractors are plowing the land in the distance in preparation for the upcoming spring sowing. Nowadays, farmers here practice scientific farming, and there is no difference between slack farming and busy farming throughout the year. Scientific and technological progress has brought earth-shaking changes to the countryside. Coupled with raising pigs, chickens, ducks, fish, shrimps, crabs and various side businesses, it is said that the annual per capita income of farmers has reached more than 200,000 yuan, exceeding the income of urban workers. Many families have their own "Santana". These are all new changes that have occurred in the past 10 years. These changes occur mainly due to changes in policies and changes in people's thinking. In the past, farmers cultivated the land, workers worked, merchants did business, and officials (cadres) took care of the people, which was natural and natural. Nowadays, with new concepts, doing things is centered on economic benefits, breaking industry boundaries. People can do what they like according to the needs of society, not only in China, but also from a global perspective to seek development. Thus, unlimited opportunities are created for everyone.

abeec2549d2e6062debe547be71371a2eb895ee6.sourceText: 杭州附近的新农村住宅 有一个普通的大学生，毕业后回到农村养鸡，后来又顺应市场需要改养鹌鹑，积累了资金后，又立足国内，涉足猪饲料行业，成为全国饲料大王.。之后，他又进军金融业，建立了银行，成为全国富人榜的前10名。这样的事例成百上千，这些人的富裕，不靠老子，不靠贪腐，靠的是智慧，幸劳和机遇。当然，他们都经历了苦难和风险，才获得了成功，我钦佩他们。这就是市场经济给中国人民带来的无限活力，就是中国为什麽过去那麽穷，如今那麽多人富裕起来的根本原因。回顾在我工作的计划经济为主导的年代裡，这些想法和做法都是不可能的。不是因为我们这一代人笨，主要是思想被束缚在一个圈子裡，听党的话，服从组织安排是做一个好人的准则，这就是有名的”驯服工具论”。过去认为这话有道理，现在想想，一个社会，人人都变成了工具，就像一个大工厂，周而复始地生产同样的产品，这个社会还会有什么生气，还会有什么步可言？ 现在看来，中国人在反封建的道路上还有很长的路要走。孙中山推翻满清封建王朝虽然已经100年了，但封建统治那一套思想体系对中国社会的的影响还十分深远。就当官的（各级领导人）和老百姓的关係而言，有的当官的懂得自己是人民的公僕，是老百姓的钱养活着他，应该多为百姓做事；而不少当官的把官位看作是上级的恩惠，于是对上阿谀奉承，对百姓疾苦问之甚少；有的甚至自认为是天子，百姓只是他的臣民。再看看中国的老百姓们的观念，县太爷，省衙门，天子皇上的意识仍然根深蒂固。正因于此，中国才会出现三呼万岁万万岁，个人崇拜发展到极致的时代。没有中国这样的社会基础，文化大革命是不可能出现的。我想起上世纪70 年代遇到的一件事。当时中国南方煤炭供应十分紧张，毛泽东主席提出要”扭转北煤南运”，于是，我们三个工程师去广东省调查研究，寻找可以建设煤矿的地方，广东省地方政府也十分重视和欢迎。有一个星期天，我们去广东阳山县调查研究，当我们从井下走出矿井的时候，当地群众和许多学生站在那裡高呼毛主席万岁，搞得我们三人不知所措，赶紧和学生们握手，从他们手中抢过扁担，和他们一起挑运煤炭。其实我们下矿井和毛主席万岁毫无关系，只是老百姓把北京来的人都看成是”天子”身边的人，是带着”皇上”的旨意来的，他们的思维方式还停留在过去的年代里。 40多年过去了，通过改革开放，人们的思想有了很大的进步，但谁又敢说人们头脑中的封建意识已经肃清了呢？我认为无论是领导人或是平民百姓，都还远没有摆脱掉封建文化残馀的影响。就以现在中国普遍流行的请客送礼以致发展到贪污腐化的恶习来说，老百姓为了想看个好医生或到政府部门好办事，就去请客送礼，送红包；基层单位到上级单位申请一个项目也是这样；这倒不一定是被送礼人的要求，可怜的是老百姓受封建文化的影响，不得不”自愿”（但又不情愿）作出这样的”奉献”。且不知，这种做法助长了那些不法之徒，危害了一些意志薄弱的人，更危害了整个社会风气，有的人还把这种坏风气带到了国外。我感到美国人在这些方面比中国要好得多，申请福利，看医生都不用请客送礼，工作人员大都笑脸相迎，笑得那麽真诚，使你感受到被尊重。他们知道做公务员不是对群众发号施令，而是为群众办事。他们都经过认真培训，不得对任何人以歧视，也不允许借办公事收受礼品，我在美国看到了实实在在的”为人民服务”。
abeec2549d2e6062debe547be71371a2eb895ee6.translatedText: There is an ordinary college student in a new rural residence near Hangzhou. After graduation, he returned to the countryside to raise chickens. Later, he changed to raising quails in response to market needs. After accumulating funds, he established his footing in China and got involved in the pig feed industry, becoming a national feed king. After that, he entered the financial industry and established a bank, becoming one of the top 10 richest people in the country. There are hundreds of such examples. The prosperity of these people does not depend on me or corruption, but on wisdom, hard work and opportunities. Of course, they all went through hardships and risks to achieve success, and I admire them. This is the infinite vitality that the market economy brings to the Chinese people, and it is the fundamental reason why China was so poor in the past and why so many people are now rich. Looking back on the planned economy-dominated era where I worked, these ideas and practices were impossible. It's not because our generation is stupid, it's mainly because our minds are bound in a circle. Listening to the party and obeying organizational arrangements are the rules for being a good person. This is the famous "taming of tools theory." I thought this made sense in the past, but now think about it, in a society where everyone has become a tool, like a big factory that produces the same products over and over again, how can this society be alive, and what progress can it make? Now it seems that the Chinese people still have a long way to go on the anti-feudal road. Although it has been 100 years since Sun Yat-sen overthrew the Manchu feudal dynasty, the ideological system of feudal rule still has a profound impact on Chinese society. As far as the relationship between officials (leaders at all levels) and the people is concerned, some officials understand that they are the people's servants, and they are supported by the people's money, so they should do more for the people; while many officials regard their official position as a favor from their superiors, so they flatter their superiors and ask little about the sufferings of the people; some even think that they are the emperor, and the people are just his subjects. Let’s look at the concepts of the Chinese people. The concepts of the county magistrate, the provincial government, and the emperor are still deeply ingrained. It is precisely because of this that there is an era in China where the cult of personality has developed to its extreme. Without a social foundation like China's, the Cultural Revolution would not have been possible. I'm reminded of an incident in the 1970s. At that time, the supply of coal in southern China was very tight, and Chairman Mao Zedong proposed to "reverse the transportation of coal from the north to the south." So, three of us engineers went to Guangdong Province to investigate and research, looking for places where coal mines could be built. The local government of Guangdong Province also attached great importance to and welcomed it. One Sunday, we went to Yangshan County, Guangdong for investigation and research. When we walked out of the mine, the local people and many students stood there and shouted long live Chairman Mao. The three of us were at a loss. We quickly shook hands with the students, grabbed the poles from their hands, and carried coal with them. In fact, our going down to the mines has nothing to do with Long Live Chairman Mao. It’s just that the common people regard people who come from Beijing as people around the "Emperor" and come with the will of the "Emperor". Their way of thinking is still stuck in the past era. More than 40 years have passed. Through reform and opening up, people's thinking has made great progress, but who dares to say that the feudal consciousness has been eliminated from people's minds? I think that both leaders and ordinary people are still far from getting rid of the residual influence of feudal culture. Take the bad habit of treating guests and giving gifts that is now widely popular in China and has developed into corruption. In order to see a good doctor or go to a government department to do things easily, ordinary people go to treat guests and give gifts and give red envelopes; the same is true for grassroots units to apply for a project at higher-level units; this is not necessarily the request of the person receiving the gifts. Unfortunately, the people are affected by the feudal culture and have to "voluntarily" (but reluctantly) make such "dedication." Little do they know that this practice encourages lawless people, harms some weak-willed people, and harms the entire social atmosphere. Some people even bring this bad atmosphere abroad. I feel that Americans are much better than China in these aspects. There is no need to treat guests or give gifts when applying for welfare or seeing a doctor. Most of the staff greet you with smiles and smile so sincerely that you feel respected. They know that being a civil servant is not about giving orders to the masses, but about doing things for the masses. They have all been carefully trained and are not allowed to discriminate against anyone, nor are they allowed to accept gifts in exchange for their work. I have seen real "service to the people" in the United States.

39657beb4035eb4ccd183b1a6883cbaf5d795b10.sourceText: 亚利桑那州长签署计生经费禁令 （亚省时报） 亚利桑那布鲁尔州长上周五签署一项法案，切断堕胎机构计划生育使用纳税人的钱进行堕胎服务。 州府之前已经通过数项反堕胎法案，包括妊娠期超过20周的孕妇，在没有证据证明胎儿影响孕妇生命的情况下，不得中止怀孕；除挽救孕妇生命外，禁止使用公共资金堕胎等。但反堕胎法案的立法者和其支持者说，需要更详细的法例来确保没有纳税人的钱间接支持堕胎服务。 ”我们最关心的是那些没有医保的人因此项法案所受到的影响。” 计划生育亚利桑那总裁兼CEO布莱恩霍华德说，”作为一个服务亚利桑那州78年的医疗机构，我们将继续致力为客户提供专业、非判断性和保密的保健，为不想生育和节育的贫困妇女提供服务。”
39657beb4035eb4ccd183b1a6883cbaf5d795b10.translatedText: Arizona Governor signed a ban on Planned Parenthood funding (Alberta Times) Arizona Governor Brewer signed a bill last Friday to cut off the use of taxpayer funds by Planned Parenthood for abortion services. The state government has previously passed several anti-abortion bills, including that pregnant women whose gestation period exceeds 20 weeks are not allowed to terminate the pregnancy without evidence that the fetus will affect the life of the pregnant woman; except to save the life of the pregnant woman, the use of public funds for abortion is prohibited. But lawmakers and supporters of the anti-abortion bill say more detailed legislation is needed to ensure no taxpayer dollars indirectly support abortion services. "Our greatest concern is the impact of this bill on those who do not have health insurance," said Brian Howard, president and CEO of Planned Parenthood Arizona. "As a health care organization that has served Arizona for 78 years, we remain committed to providing professional, non-judgmental and confidential care to needy women who do not want to have children and receive birth control."

The four dead included the gunman’s 47-year-old ex-wife Lisa, his 22-year-old daughter April Drews and her 16-month-old daughter Lily, and her 24-year-old boyfriend Jim. The baby girl was still alive when police arrived at the scene, but died after being taken to hospital. Neighbors told the media that such an incident had never happened here before and that everyone was shocked. Jason Dee, a known neo-Nazi, is a former U.S. Marine and founder of the border militia. 784282f9bb4da1e1a1d4a820c02a979799f4d680.sourceText: 1。 在海外投资房地产或房地产买卖是否需要在海外资产申报FBAR中申报？ 答﹕从2011税务年度起正式将海外金融资产申报（8938表）纳入个人申报（1040表）。 向国税局备案8938表，海外金融资产申报门槛（Threshold）5 万元，包括银行存款、股票、公司股份、合伙人持有资本、信托产业、版权等。 漏报8938表罚款为1万美元，如被国税局发现通知3个月后仍未申报，每个月增加1 万元罚款，最多不超过5万元。 自住或投资房地产都无需在8938表中申报，但国外遗赠房地产价值超过10万美元需在3520表中列入附载于8938表。 房地产买卖获利也无需在8938中申报，但自1997年后推行的自住房过去五年中住满三年夫妻可免资本利得50万（单身户主25万）则不适用于美国领土以外的 房屋买卖。
784282f9bb4da1e1a1d4a820c02a979799f4d680.translatedText: 1. Do investments in real estate or real estate transactions abroad need to be reported in the overseas asset declaration FBAR? Answer: Starting from the 2011 tax year, the declaration of overseas financial assets (Form 8938) will be officially included in the personal declaration (Form 1040). File Form 8938 with the Internal Revenue Service, with a declaration threshold of 50,000 yuan for overseas financial assets, including bank deposits, stocks, company shares, capital held by partners, trust properties, copyrights, etc. The penalty for failing to report Form 8938 is US$10,000. If the IRS discovers that the report has not been filed after 3 months of notification, the penalty will be increased by US$10,000 per month, up to a maximum of US$50,000. Neither self-occupied nor investment real estate needs to be reported on Form 8938, but foreign bequests of real estate worth more than $100,000 must be included in Form 3520 and attached to Form 8938. Profits from real estate transactions do not need to be reported in 8938, but the capital gains exemption of 500,000 for couples who have lived in the home for three years in the past five years (250,000 for single householders) implemented since 1997 does not apply to the sale of houses outside the United States.

825409ccd3fa658ba929fd7987d61eb2edabf9ad.sourceText: 2。 我和我丈夫都已80岁，在2003年7月收到为期十年的绿卡，将于2013年过期。 不过，我丈夫自2008年起一直生病，从2009年回中国后，他一直住在中国。 因为他的病，我大部分的时间也在中国陪他。 我试着每年在中国居住不超过6个月，但2011年我在中国住了10个月。 现在我丈夫的病情已经稳定，急着想回美国。 我们需要在机场请律师吗？ 即使我丈夫被允许入境美国，他可以保住他的绿卡吗？ 答﹕ 美国移民法普遍规定，绿卡持有人离开美国一年或一年以上而没有回美证，视为已放弃永久居留权。 除非无法长期居住美国的原因是永久居民自己无法控制的。 依你的情况，你可以去中国的美国大使馆或领事馆递交所有的证据，并要求签发一分特殊的移民签证。 一旦批准，你丈夫可以用永久居民的身分进入美国，而不必担心在机场有意外。 要是你丈夫试着以他的医疗纪录进入美国，并在机场向海关及边境保护局（CBP）解释他的情况，这也有好处，因为有些移民检查官员可能比领事馆官员较具同情心。 海关及边境保护局会告诉你，你是无权在机场由律师当代表的。 如果该局给予豁免并允许你丈夫进入美国，他们不会拿走他的绿卡。 如果海关及边境保护局拒绝给予你丈夫豁免，他有权向移民法官争取权利。 若是这样，海关及边境保护局可能会释放他，并给他一个上法庭的日期。 那时，他才有选择是否由律师陪同上法庭。
825409ccd3fa658ba929fd7987d61eb2edabf9ad.translatedText: 2. My husband and I, both 80 years old, received ten-year green cards in July 2003, expiring in 2013. However, my husband has been ill since 2008 and has been living in China since returning to China in 2009. Because of his illness, I spent most of my time with him in China. I try to live in China no more than 6 months a year, but in 2011 I lived in China for 10 months. Now that my husband's condition has stabilized, he is eager to return to the United States. Do we need a lawyer at the airport? Even if my husband is allowed into the United States, can he keep his green card? Answer: U.S. immigration law generally stipulates that if a green card holder leaves the United States for one year or more without a re-entry permit, he is deemed to have given up his right to permanent residence. Unless the reason for being unable to permanently reside in the United States is beyond the control of the permanent resident. Depending on your situation, you can go to the U.S. Embassy or Consulate in China, submit all the evidence, and request a special immigrant visa. Once approved, your husband can enter the United States as a permanent resident without having to worry about accidents at the airport. It would also be beneficial if your husband was trying to enter the United States with his medical records and explain his situation to Customs and Border Protection (CBP) at the airport, as some immigration officers may be more sympathetic than consulate officers. Customs and Border Protection will tell you that you do not have the right to be represented by an attorney at the airport. If the agency grants a waiver and allows your husband to enter the United States, they will not take away his green card. If Customs and Border Protection denies your husband a waiver, he has the right to pursue his rights with an immigration judge. If so, Customs and Border Protection may release him and give him a court date. Only then does he have the choice whether to be accompanied by a lawyer to court.

01d977794709fff105c295a9ce985fb20ab97348.sourceText: 5月12日凌晨4时，一辆红色法拉利跑车在新加坡市区一交叉路口超速闯红灯，与一辆出租车相撞，除法拉利车主当场死亡外，52岁的新加坡籍出租车司机和出租车内的一名日本乘客也在送医后不治身亡。新加坡《联合晚报》报道称，法拉利车主为马驰，31岁，四川人，事发时，法拉利车内载一名年轻女子。2008年到新加坡从事金融和投资活动，目前正在申请永久居留权。《海峡时报》称，肇事者驾驶的限量版法拉利价格在140万美元以上。
01d977794709fff105c295a9ce985fb20ab97348.translatedText: At 4 a.m. on May 12, a red Ferrari sports car speeded through a red light at an intersection in downtown Singapore and collided with a taxi. In addition to the Ferrari owner, who died on the spot, the 52-year-old Singaporean taxi driver and a Japanese passenger in the taxi also died after being sent to the hospital. Singapore’s Lianhe Wanbao reported that the owner of the Ferrari was Ma Chi, a 31-year-old native of Sichuan. At the time of the incident, there was a young woman inside the Ferrari. In 2008, he came to Singapore to engage in financial and investment activities and is currently applying for permanent residency. The Straits Times stated that the limited edition Ferrari driven by the perpetrator cost more than US$1.4 million.

987f6b3ad347d478c31f10d41adf7f6f4372f7f9.sourceText: 后面车辆拍到的片段显示，凌晨4时许路面亮着红灯，马驰驾驶的法拉利跑车以逾100公里的时速拦腰撞向的士，巨大的冲力令的士再撞向另一架电单车，引擎更飞脱至马路中央。图为男子遗体。
987f6b3ad347d478c31f10d41adf7f6f4372f7f9.translatedText: Footage captured by the vehicle behind showed that at about 4 a.m., the road was red with a red light, and the Ferrari sports car driven by Ma Chi hit the taxi at a speed of more than 100 kilometers per hour. The huge momentum caused the taxi to crash into another motorcycle, and the engine flew off to the center of the road. The picture shows the man's body.

9428a9cfffbb54b4b13b2ee6b21073211cd445c3.sourceText: 马驰妻子何婷婷是四川电视台前新闻主播，她怀有身孕，与4岁女儿认尸后伤痛欲绝。她透露丈夫在当日凌晨3时出门，想外出驾车”兜风”。她也不知道车上女乘客的身份，还追问记者：”她是谁？”图为马驰妻子拉着女儿眼眶泛红落泪。
9428a9cfffbb54b4b13b2ee6b21073211cd445c3.translatedText: Ma Chi’s wife He Tingting is a former news anchor at Sichuan TV. She was pregnant and was heartbroken after identifying the body of her 4-year-old daughter. She revealed that her husband went out at 3 a.m. that day and wanted to go out for a drive. She also did not know the identity of the female passenger in the car, and asked the reporter: "Who is she?" The picture shows Ma Chi's wife holding her daughter with red eyes and tears.

d5b4dd301df9778127a6b9013af1ceebd4ae28e3.translatedText: The accident involving the wealthy young man's luxury car angered Singapore, and netizens clamored to drive away the Chinese people

791ebc773deaf9e2681afd24e636bc25a3552f04.sourceText: 法新社14日报道称，近日震动新加坡的”法拉利撞车事件”余波难尽。在事故中丧命的中国籍法拉利”富少车主”被认定负有主要责任，新加坡民众的排外情绪因这场车祸而进一步点燃，社会舆论和互联网上”将中国人赶出新加坡”的声音此起彼伏。
791ebc773deaf9e2681afd24e636bc25a3552f04.translatedText: Agence France-Presse reported on the 14th that the aftermath of the "Ferrari crash" that shocked Singapore recently is unbearable. The "rich and young" Chinese Ferrari owner who died in the accident was found to be primarily responsible. The Singaporean people's xenophobic sentiments were further ignited by this car accident. Voices of "driving the Chinese out of Singapore" arose one after another in public opinion and on the Internet.

6a6b5b6d83537e5df442bd3e0dae74f36e0bf443.sourceText: 报道称，12日凌晨4时，一辆红色法拉利跑车在新加坡市区一交叉路口超速闯红灯，与一辆出租车相撞，除法拉利车主当场死亡外，52岁的新加坡籍出租车司机和出租车内的一名日本乘客也在送医后不治身亡。新加坡《联合晚报》报道称，死者是31岁的中国四川人，2008年到新加坡从事金融和投资活动，目前正在申请永久居留权。《海峡时报》称，肇事者驾驶的限量版法拉利价格在140万美元以上。
6a6b5b6d83537e5df442bd3e0dae74f36e0bf443.translatedText: According to reports, at 4 a.m. on the 12th, a red Ferrari sports car speeded through a red light at an intersection in downtown Singapore and collided with a taxi. In addition to the Ferrari owner who died on the spot, the 52-year-old Singaporean taxi driver and a Japanese passenger in the taxi also died after being sent to the hospital. Singapore’s Lianhe Wanbao reported that the deceased was a 31-year-old native of Sichuan, China. He came to Singapore to engage in financial and investment activities in 2008 and is currently applying for permanent residency. The Straits Times stated that the limited edition Ferrari driven by the perpetrator cost more than US$1.4 million.

58ea0cb250fdc6a3abc067f1e17e2e51f512beae.sourceText: 法新社称，目前，在新加坡有超过100万外国工人和技术人员，其中中国人占很大比例。事故发生后，不少社会团体攻击新加坡政府的移民政策，称目前的政策正在让新加坡”变得拥挤而危险”。14日，新加坡当地互联网论坛上大量涌现攻击中国侨民的帖子，甚至称其为”富豪蝗虫”。（卢昊）
58ea0cb250fdc6a3abc067f1e17e2e51f512beae.translatedText: Agence France-Presse stated that there are currently more than 1 million foreign workers and technicians in Singapore, of which Chinese account for a large proportion. After the accident, many social groups attacked the Singaporean government's immigration policy, saying that the current policy was making Singapore "congested and dangerous." On the 14th, a large number of posts attacking Chinese expatriates appeared on local Internet forums in Singapore, even calling them "rich locusts". (Lu Hao)

7ea72b7fbc7d30b7914a9dfecf65fc5057a5479c.sourceText: 金信地产新闻：调查显示买房比租房划算 根据房利美在全国进行的一项调查显示，33%的美国市民预测房子的价格在未来12月中持续上涨。最高的程度会高过去年的涨幅。 很多人说现在是很好的买房时机，即使是73%的房子价格都在上升，三月上升最快的达到了14%。同时越来越多的美国人预计明年房屋的租赁价格也会上升，可能增长4.1%。”这些因素结合起来，就会促使大家购买房屋”，房利美（Fannie Mae）的首席经济学家Doug Duncan先生表示。他还说”美国人对明年的租金价格预期继续上涨，本月达到创纪录的高水平，根据我们的调查。消费者的贷款利率和房价在未来12个月都有可能上涨，房屋租令变得更加昂贵，置业，购买房屋会变得更有价值”。更多有关房屋的信息请咨询金信地产Tinna E-mail： goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com. 电话：（480）287-0180
7ea72b7fbc7d30b7914a9dfecf65fc5057a5479c.translatedText: Jinxin Real Estate News: Survey shows that buying a house is more cost-effective than renting According to a national survey conducted by Fannie Mae, 33% of Americans predict that home prices will continue to rise in the next 12 months. The highest level will be higher than last year's increase. Many people say that now is a good time to buy a house, even though 73% of house prices are rising, with the fastest increase reaching 14% in March. At the same time, more and more Americans expect rental prices to rise next year, possibly by 4.1%. "The combination of these factors will encourage people to buy homes," said Doug Duncan, chief economist at Fannie Mae. He also said, "Americans' expectations for rent prices continue to rise next year, reaching a record high this month, according to our survey. Consumer loan rates and home prices are likely to rise over the next 12 months, making renting a home more expensive and buying a home more valuable." For more information about the house, please contact Tinna from Goldtrust Realty E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com. Tel: (480) 287-0180

35e082c182fc0913f6346066bb9fc6f6a369e444.sourceText: 5月13日上午9时30分，慈济凤凰城联络处举办了多达一百六十多人的浴佛仪式，同庆”慈济佛诞日，母亲节，全球慈 济日”。 上百大德来到慈济凤凰城联络处，大家安静整齐地站在静思堂。 「供灯烛、香汤、供花香厖」司仪声音宏量引导，慈济的师兄师姐向大德们演示了浴佛的基本程序。 合掌，９０度鞠躬，收沾智慧水，合掌起身，９０度鞠躬，手触花香，合掌起身。 师兄师姐们观想清净智慧水，止息杂虑，心专注于一境。 接着，大众以整齐划一的动作，以清净心供灯烛、香汤、供花香礼敬诸佛，虔诚合掌仰天祝祷，祈愿天下无灾无难，人心净化祥和。 当日正值母亲节，慈济儿童精进班的小朋友，走上静思台，为母亲们带来了精彩的手语歌表演。 把自己比作小虫子，把妈妈比作大树，赞颂妈妈无私的奉献。 浴佛身，净自心，庄严的浴佛大典，优雅的歌声中，慢慢接近尾声。 佛诞日，母亲节，全球慈济日，”三节”同庆，会众都获得慈济的随身水杯和漂亮的康乃馨，将节日的心情带回家。
35e082c182fc0913f6346066bb9fc6f6a369e444.translatedText: At 9:30 a.m. on May 13, Tzu Chi Phoenix Liaison Office held a Buddha bathing ceremony for more than 160 people to celebrate "Tzu Chi Buddha's Birthday, Mother's Day, and Global Tzu Chi Day." Hundreds of great virtues came to the Tzu Chi Phoenix Liaison Office, and everyone stood quietly and neatly in the Jing Si Hall. "Offer lamps and candles, offer incense soup, offer flowers and incense," the emcee's voice guided in a grand voice, and Tzu Chi's brothers and sisters demonstrated the basic procedures for bathing the Buddha to the eminent practitioners. Put your hands together, bow at 90 degrees, collect the water of wisdom, stand up with your hands together, bow at 90 degrees, touch the fragrance of flowers with your hands, and stand up with your hands together. Brothers and sisters, meditate on the pure water of wisdom to stop distracting worries and focus on one thing. Then, with uniform movements, the crowd offered lamps, candles, incense soup, and flower incense to pay homage to the Buddhas with a pure heart. They devoutly put their hands together and raised their heads to the sky to pray, hoping that the world would be free from disasters and that people's hearts would be purified and peaceful. It was Mother's Day, and the children from Tzu Chi's Children's Advanced Class took to the meditation stage to perform a wonderful sign language song performance for the mothers. Compare yourself to a little bug, compare your mother to a big tree, and praise your mother's selfless dedication. Bath the Buddha body and purify your mind. The solemn Buddha bathing ceremony slowly comes to an end amid elegant singing. Buddha’s Birthday, Mother’s Day, and Global Tzu Chi Day were all celebrated together. Congregants were given Tzu Chi portable water cups and beautiful carnations to take the festive mood home with them.

44a599ec57608592e98ec4bf9392aad87ea4732c.sourceText: 凤凰城百岁老人余黄瑞琴太夫人逝世 (亚省时报讯) 余黄瑞琴太夫人（即余永享夫人）系广东省，台山县，李边，鳯阳里人，生于一九一四年九月廿九日，痛于二０一二年五 月一日在疗养院逝世，积闰享寿一百岁。 一九三０年二月三日，与余永享先生在乡间结婚，夫妻情笃，相亲相爱，随后育有一男一女，家庭和乐。 一九四八年二月余太夫人合家获准移民来美，定居斐匿，从此夫妻团圆，天伦乐聚，开始一个美满幸福家庭。 余太夫人丈夫余永享先生，与人合伙开创一间Star Light大型西人货仓，余太夫人亦在店中协助工作，克勤克俭，善待顾客，经营有术，生意兴隆，财源滚滚，兴家创业， 卓有成就，直至一九五九年退休，生活优游，乐享晚年之福。 余太夫人品性仁慈，为人忠厚，和平处世，与人无争。 在家克尽妇道，勤俭持家，对儿孙家人爱护备至，上和下睦，乐也融融，她系一位好母亲，好祖母，和好亲人，确系一位典型贤妻良母。 余太夫人除日常料理家务外，又在货仓工作，内外兼助，勤劳能干，且欢喜煮餐、缝衣、旅游和种瓜种菜，丰收时分送给亲友共享。 一九八三年余太夫人洗礼，成为一个诚虔基督教徒，上帝保佑，长命百岁，儿孙满堂，福寿全归。 余太夫人丧礼，经于五月十二日上午十时，在西北华人教堂举行，由黄耀安牧师读经，鲜花满灵堂，参加执绋亲友三百余人，安葬于绿木墓园，备极哀荣 。 孝眷在六福酒家，设素餐招待参加殡礼亲友，以表谢意。 （文社供稿）
44a599ec57608592e98ec4bf9392aad87ea4732c.translatedText: Mrs. Yu Huang Ruiqin, a centenarian in Phoenix City, passed away (Alberta Times News) Mrs. Yu Huang Ruiqin (also known as Mrs. Yu Yongxiang) was born in Taishan County, Libian, and Nuoyangli, Guangdong Province. She was born on September 29, 1914. She died in a nursing home on May 1, 2012. She lived to be 100 years old. On February 3, 1930, she married Mr. Yu Yongxiang in the countryside. The couple was very affectionate and loved each other. Later, they had a son and a daughter, and the family was happy. In February 1948, Mrs. Yu and her family were allowed to immigrate to the United States and settled in Feini. From then on, the couple reunited, their family reunited, and they started a happy family. Mrs. Yu's husband, Mr. Yu Yongxiang, co-founded a large Western warehouse called Star Light. Mrs. Yu also assisted in the work in the store. She was diligent and frugal, treated customers well, and was skilled in management. The business was prosperous, and the wealth was abundant. Mrs. Yu is kind, loyal, peaceful, and has no disputes with others. She lived up to her duties as a woman at home, was diligent and thrifty in running the household, loved her children and grandchildren, lived in harmony with her subordinates, and was happy and harmonious. She was a good mother, a good grandmother, a harmonious family member, and indeed a typical good wife and mother. In addition to daily housework, Mrs. Yu also worked in the warehouse, helping both inside and outside. She was hardworking and capable. She also enjoyed cooking, sewing, traveling, and growing melons and vegetables to share with relatives and friends during the harvest. Mrs. Yu was baptized in 1983 and became a devout Christian. God blessed her with a long life, full of children and grandchildren, and full blessings. Mrs. Yu’s funeral was held at 10 a.m. on May 12 at the Northwest Chinese Church. Pastor Huang Yaoan read scriptures. The funeral hall was filled with flowers. More than 300 relatives and friends attended the ceremony. She was buried in Greenwood Cemetery with utmost mourning. The filial piety family hosted a vegetarian meal at Luk Fook Restaurant to entertain relatives and friends attending the funeral to express their gratitude. (Contributed by literary agency)

aec9e019b37ef2b79a6ef8c06b936ded5a75cdba.sourceText: （耆英会供稿） 五月四日，凤凰城华人耆英会老年模特队正式成立并开始训练。 老年模特训练是一 项有益于提高老年人身心健康，改善形体美，行动美和心灵美的活动。 本会特邀请 在中国大陆多次参加老年模特比赛并获奖的模特队员温聚臻女士担任教练，李桂 美女士任队长。 训练是在每星期五上午九点到十点半在华人耆英中心进行，欢迎有 兴趣的朋友前来参加。 性别，身高，体重和体态不限，通过坚持训练，你的体型和 健康水平都会得到改善和提高。
aec9e019b37ef2b79a6ef8c06b936ded5a75cdba.translatedText: (Contributed by the Senior Citizens Association) On May 4th, the Phoenix Chinese Senior Citizens Association’s senior model team was officially established and began training. Elderly model training is an activity that is beneficial to improving the physical and mental health of the elderly, and improving the beauty of body, movement and soul. The Association specially invites Ms. Wen Juzhen, a member of the model team who has participated in many senior model competitions and won awards in mainland China, as the coach, and Ms. Li Guimei as the team leader. Training is held every Friday morning from 9:00 to 10:30 at the Chinese Senior Citizens Center. Friends who are interested are welcome to participate. There are no restrictions on gender, height, weight and body shape. Through consistent training, your body shape and health level will be improved and improved.

189198d25bd1c843f89a4232c1bb4c0a1fb257a1.sourceText: 登山 烧烤 古筝声扬——科工专母亲节Sedona户外活动掠影 (科工专凤凰城分会报道) 适逢一年一度温馨的母亲节，科工专2012 年新当选主席杨厦与徐强等，策划组织了一场大型的户外活动，吸引了众多的新老会员参加，内容包括登山，烧烤，古筝欣赏等活动，让大家渡过了健康，快乐，充实的一天。 参加活动的朋友们 五月十三日，天气晴朗, 云淡风清, 约三十位科工专新老会员驱车两小时，来到凤凰城北的小镇Sedona。沿17号公路北上，起初周围还是一派沙漠景观，随着车子渐渐爬高，眼前豁然开朗，地势变得平缓，视野中开始出现宜人的绿色植物。当车驶进179 号公路，这里独特的红色巨石景观开始映入眼帘，从这里开始，Sedona的红土世界开始向我们展示着大自然的鬼斧神工。 一路上景点众多，我们来不及流连，追随着一道山涧小溪，车子贴着红石州立公园岩石边的林荫小径行驶一段，终于与登山的队伍汇合，此处已是绿树成荫，清凉宜人。照例我们是第二梯队，在主力部队直奔山顶，消失的无影无踪之后，我们这一队开始边欣赏风景，边慢慢地向前。Sedona曾被USA Today评为全美国最美的地方，我们似乎难以理解评价如此之高的理由，不过，能够吸引众多的艺术家移居此地，Sedona 的确有他不寻常的自然风貌。环顾周围那些形状各异的红色岩石，好像是被施了魔法的怪物，凝固在时空里，一任风吹日晒。脚边不知名的植物，花草星星点点; 移步间，走进一片被森林大火烧灼过的地方，树干都已烧得漆黑，依然直指蓝天，穿过这片好像消亡了的文明的废墟，山顶就在眼前，却又遥遥不可及地挂在半空之间，我们知难而退，回到山下的凉亭，等待登顶的队伍归来。 爬到山顶的两个小英雄 山下的公园里，很多人家都在烧烤野餐，但是我们这一组人数最多。不一会儿，我们这也肉香四溢，各种美味新鲜出炉，吃着烤肉，就着”李老吉凉茶”，十分惬意舒畅。当贺老师架起古筝，开始抚琴，彩云追月的旋律在山间流淌出来，惹来公园里其他人家也过来驻足欣赏，想来他们应该是第一次听到如此美妙的音律吧。一时间，让我们产生恍然置身万里之外故国家园的错觉。各种经典，怀旧的曲子在老师的手指间跳跃流动，会员中美声，民族歌手卧虎藏龙，一展歌喉。Sedona, 我们来过很多次了，能在此欣赏到好似大珠小珠落玉盘的古筝曲，这应该是绝无仅有的一次。 现场贺绿蒂老师曼妙的古筝演奏 暑假期间，科工专还有很多精彩的活动，包括神秘的农场之旅，欢迎大家踊跃参加。详情请洽：杨厦 Amoy_y@yahoo.com
189198d25bd1c843f89a4232c1bb4c0a1fb257a1.translatedText: Mountain climbing, barbecue, guzheng singing - a snapshot of outdoor activities in Sedona on Mother's Day in the College of Science and Engineering (Report from the Phoenix Branch of the Science and Technology College) On the occasion of the annual warm Mother's Day, Yang Xia and Xu Qiang, the newly elected presidents of the Science and Technology College in 2012, planned and organized a large-scale outdoor activity, attracting many new and old members to participate. The content included activities such as mountain climbing, barbecue, guzheng appreciation, etc., allowing everyone to spend a healthy, happy and fulfilling day. Friends who participated in the event. On May 13, the weather was sunny, the clouds were clear, and the wind was clear. About thirty new and old members of the Science and Engineering College drove two hours to Sedona, a small town north of Phoenix. Going north along Highway 17, the surroundings were still a desert landscape at first. As the car gradually climbed higher, the vision suddenly opened up, the terrain became gentle, and pleasant green plants began to appear in the field of vision. When the car enters Highway 179, the unique red boulder landscape here begins to come into view. From here on, the red earth world of Sedona begins to show us the uncanny workmanship of nature. There were many scenic spots along the way, and we didn't have time to linger. We followed a mountain stream and drove along the tree-lined path beside the rocks in Red Rock State Park for a while. Finally, we met up with the climbing team. The place was already shaded by trees and cool and pleasant. As usual, we were the second echelon. After the main force went straight to the top of the mountain and disappeared without a trace, our group began to slowly move forward while enjoying the scenery. Sedona was once rated as the most beautiful place in the United States by USA Today. It seems difficult for us to understand the reason for such a high rating. However, Sedona does have its unusual natural features that attract many artists to move here. Looking around, the red rocks of different shapes seem to be enchanted monsters, frozen in time and space, left to be blown by the wind and the sun. There were unknown plants and flowers at our feet; as we moved forward, we walked into a place that had been burned by forest fires. The trunks of the trees had been burnt black and still pointed straight into the blue sky. We passed through the ruins of a civilization that seemed to have died. The top of the mountain was right in front of us, but it hung far away in the air. We retreated and returned to the pavilion at the foot of the mountain to wait for the return of the team that climbed to the top. Two little heroes who climbed to the top of the mountain. In the park at the foot of the mountain, many people were having barbecues and picnics, but our group was the largest. After a while, the smell of meat was overflowing in our place, and all kinds of delicacies were freshly baked. We were eating barbecue and drinking "Li Laoji herbal tea", which was very comfortable and comfortable. When Teacher He set up the guzheng and started playing it, the melody of colorful clouds chasing the moon flowed out in the mountains, attracting other people in the park to stop and enjoy it. It must be the first time for them to hear such a beautiful melody. For a moment, we had the illusion that we were suddenly in our hometown thousands of miles away. Various classic and nostalgic tunes danced and flowed between the teacher's fingers. Among the members, bel canto and national singer Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon showed off their singing voices. Sedona, we have been here many times, and this must be the only time that we can enjoy the guzheng music here, which is like big beads and small beads falling on a jade plate. Teacher He Ludi's graceful guzheng performance was on site. During the summer vacation, there are many exciting activities at the College of Science and Technology, including the mysterious farm tour. Everyone is welcome to participate. For details, please contact: Yang Xia Amoy_y@yahoo.com

2028805018f60b4b8774a2bcb66caa4e5e034ac6.sourceText: 杨绮薇：广州今年招录964名公务员 应届硕士博士年龄放宽到40周岁以下 （亚省时报广州特约记者杨绮薇报道） 据广州市人力资源和社会保障局发布《广州市县级以上机关2012年考试录用公务员公告》，今年广州市计划招录964名县级以上机关公务员。笔试在6月2日上午举行。 本次广州市的公务员招录工作一共由市、区两级直属机关提供670个职位，共招录964人。招考对象为全日制普通高等院校2012年应届毕业生和社会上具有国家承认学历的本科毕业以上人员。非广州市常住户口（生源）报考者限全日制普通高等院校大学本科以上学历并取得学士以上学位的人员。 除2012年国内普通高等学校应届毕业生须于2012年9月30日前取得相应毕业证书、学位证书外，其他报考人员须于报名之日前取得相应毕业证书、学位证书。留学归国人员须取得教育部留学服务中心境外学历、学位认证函，并有我驻外使领馆开具的证明材料方可报考。 报考者年龄在18至35周岁（1976年5月9日至1994年5月9日期间出生），应届硕士、博士研究生（非在职）年龄可放宽到40周岁以下（即1971年5月9日以后出生）。 根据最新公布出来的招考职位表显示，随着各级公务员招录工作加强了对有基层工作经验人员的选拔，今年广州公务员市考的众多职位中明确要求有2年以上工作经验的占整个职位的20%以上。明确要求报考人员必须具备相应的基层和生产一线工作累计满2年的经历。基层工作经历计算截止日期为2012年5月9日。
2028805018f60b4b8774a2bcb66caa4e5e034ac6.translatedText: Yang Qiwei: Guangzhou is recruiting 964 civil servants this year. The age for graduates with master’s and doctorate degrees has been relaxed to under 40 years old (reported by Yang Qiwei, special correspondent for Guangzhou Times of the Alberta Times). According to the Guangzhou Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau’s “Announcement on the Recruitment of Civil Servants in the 2012 Examination for Government Agencies at County Level and Above in Guangzhou”, this year Guangzhou City plans to recruit 964 civil servants at agencies above county level. The written examination will be held on the morning of June 2. This time, Guangzhou's civil servant recruitment work has provided a total of 670 positions from municipal and district-level agencies, and a total of 964 people have been recruited. Recruitment targets are 2012 fresh graduates from full-time institutions of higher learning and those with a bachelor's degree or above with nationally recognized academic qualifications. Applicants with non-Guangzhou permanent residence (student source) are limited to those with a bachelor's degree or above from a full-time general institution of higher learning and a bachelor's degree or above. Except for the fresh graduates of domestic general colleges and universities in 2012 who must obtain the corresponding graduation certificates and degree certificates before September 30, 2012, other applicants must obtain the corresponding graduation certificates and degree certificates before the date of registration. Returnees who have studied abroad must obtain overseas academic qualifications and degree certification letters from the Ministry of Education’s Overseas Study Service Center, and have certification materials issued by our embassies and consulates abroad before they can apply. Applicants are between 18 and 35 years old (born between May 9, 1976 and May 9, 1994), and the age of fresh master's and doctoral candidates (non-employed) can be relaxed to under 40 years old (that is, born after May 9, 1971). According to the latest announcement of the recruitment position list, as the recruitment of civil servants at all levels has strengthened the selection of people with grassroots work experience, among the many positions in the Guangzhou Civil Service Examination this year, those with more than 2 years of work experience clearly require more than 20% of the total positions. It is clearly required that applicants must have corresponding grassroots and production front-line work experience for at least 2 years. The deadline for calculating grassroots work experience is May 9, 2012.

2373cebed5159f95af37d42ce098bbb3e5565354.translatedText: Two suspects were arrested for shooting two Chinese students at the University of Southern California. They are both African-Americans. Shooting vict...

2ab8d905d6c56244af4e6ef552bdc83124dce0ef.sourceText: 洛杉矶警察局长查理・贝克表示，两名嫌犯分别为19岁的哈维尔・博尔登和20岁的布赖恩・巴尔内斯，二人均不得保释。当天下午，巴尔内斯首先在南加大校园附近被捕。几个小时后，警方又在洛杉矶附近的帕姆代尔（又译棕榈谷）市逮捕了博尔登。
2ab8d905d6c56244af4e6ef552bdc83124dce0ef.translatedText: Los Angeles Police Chief Charlie Baker said that the two suspects are 19-year-old Javier Bolden and 20-year-old Brian Barnes. Neither of them will be granted bail. That afternoon, Barnes was first arrested near the USC campus. A few hours later, police arrested Bolden in Palmdale (also translated as Palmdale) near Los Angeles.

f9fb815d4d05fecdf79737a6f084e59af58611c3.sourceText: 贝克说，嫌疑犯的作案动机仍在调查之中，但现有证据”指向街头抢劫”。调查人员认为，两名中国留学生遇害事件属于洛杉矶一连串犯罪活动的一部分。
f9fb815d4d05fecdf79737a6f084e59af58611c3.translatedText: > Baker said the suspect's motive is still under investigation, but existing evidence "points to street robbery." Investigators believe the murders of two Chinese students were part of a series of criminal activities in Los Angeles.

78b1f157a7bea79428fb04a2dd1e737d4cb36a76.sourceText: 4月11日凌晨１时许，同为23岁的南加大工程学院电子工程专业中国留学生瞿某和吴某在校园附近的车中遭遇枪击，后经抢救无效不幸身亡。
78b1f157a7bea79428fb04a2dd1e737d4cb36a76.translatedText: At around 1:00 a.m. on April 11, Qu and Wu, both 23-year-old Chinese students majoring in electronic engineering at the School of Engineering at the University of Southern California, were shot in a car near the campus. They died after rescue efforts failed.

39b0d33ca523d62aac4ca426cc3f1a671e6c06ee.sourceText: 美国洛杉矶警察局18日宣布，警方当天抓获了枪杀南加州大学中国留学生的两名嫌犯。
39b0d33ca523d62aac4ca426cc3f1a671e6c06ee.translatedText: The Los Angeles Police Department announced on the 18th that the police arrested two suspects who shot and killed Chinese students at the University of Southern California.

1e0a4ef8aff8cb14ef6c3194ba27f07bb37b10e9.sourceText: 洛杉矶市长维拉莱戈萨和洛杉矶警察局局长贝克当天在警察局大楼召开的新闻发布会上说，警方于当地时间下午4时在洛杉矶南部抓获了一名叫做布赖恩巴恩斯的枪击案嫌疑人，现年20岁；几小时后，另一名涉嫌参与枪击案的疑犯杰维尔博尔登在洛杉矶北部羚羊谷地区遭拘，现年19岁。这两名男子均为非洲裔美国人。警方说，将于下周起诉这两名嫌犯。
1e0a4ef8aff8cb14ef6c3194ba27f07bb37b10e9.translatedText: Los Angeles Mayor Villaraigosa and Los Angeles Police Chief Baker said at a press conference held at the police station building that day that the police captured a shooting suspect named Brian Barnes, now 20, in south Los Angeles at 4 pm local time; a few hours later, another suspect Jewell Bolden, now 19, suspected of being involved in the shooting was arrested in the Antelope Valley area in northern Los Angeles. Both men are African American. Police said they will charge the two suspects next week.

ba39fce81210d85572416b5d7e031bf8fa7bbaf9.translatedText: The spokesperson of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles told Xinhua News Agency that the Consulate General is pleased with the progress in the case and hopes that the United States will bring the murderer to justice as soon as possible.

64038fa0af5679e96dc60268ae191010901c9bfc.sourceText: 4月11日凌晨1时左右，在美国洛杉矶南郊的南加大校园附近，中国留学生瞿某和吴某在车中遭枪击，被送到附近医院后经抢救无效死亡。两名留学生一男一女，均为23岁，是南加大工程学院电子工程专业二年级研究生。
64038fa0af5679e96dc60268ae191010901c9bfc.translatedText: At around 1 a.m. on April 11, near the campus of the University of Southern California in the southern suburbs of Los Angeles, Chinese international students Qu and Wu were shot in a car. They were taken to a nearby hospital and died after rescue efforts failed. The two international students, one male and one female, are both 23 years old and second-year graduate students majoring in electronic engineering at the School of Engineering at the University of Southern California.

161e5fd7b0732f900ba37c647e909b415a6bd32a.sourceText: 杨绮薇：广交会期间十余名外商中招被色诱至佛山 （亚省时报广州特约记者报道） 据南海警方通报，广交会期间，10多名外商被色诱至佛山黄岐后，被盗抢了随身财物，涉案金额达30多万元。日前，南海警方成功抓获6名犯罪嫌疑人。 4月22日晚7时许，36岁外商BLS在广州火车站附近遇到阿红、阿丽两姐妹。阿红以带事主去家里买鞋子为由，将BLS带到了位于黄岐华x新村的出租屋。看着漆黑的楼道，BLS心生疑虑，到3楼的出租屋门口时，他觉得危险，转身想走，但阿红抓住他的手臂把他往屋里拉。他甩开阿红，一口气跑下楼。预伏在附近的民警马上冲上楼，将阿红抓获。 当晚11点，阿丽也在顺德大良的出租屋内被抓获。23日凌晨3时，警方在广州白云区将他们的团伙成员赵某抓获。 原来，南海警方最近已接到10多宗报警，都是外商被骗到黄岐的出租屋后财物被盗或被抢，作案手法相似。 警方调查了解到，犯罪嫌疑人在黄岐华x新村租用了2间出租屋，把其中一间房内的衣柜进行改造，并将衣柜背后的墙体打穿。当事主被色诱进入出租屋后，嫌疑人或是叫事主洗澡，随后拿着事主的财物溜之大吉；或是与事主上床，让事主将衣物放进衣柜，另一名犯罪嫌疑人便从隔壁房间穿墙而过，将事主财物盗走。 犯罪嫌疑人共承认了15宗色抢案件。该案件的涉案金额已达30多万元，目前，该案件还在进一步审理当中。
161e5fd7b0732f900ba37c647e909b415a6bd32a.translatedText: >Yang Qiwei: During the Canton Fair, more than ten foreign businessmen were lured to Foshan (Alberta Times Guangzhou special correspondent reported) According to a report from the Nanhai police, during the Canton Fair, more than 10 foreign businessmen were lured to Huangqi, Foshan, and their personal belongings were stolen, with the amount involved amounting to more than 300,000 yuan. Recently, Nanhai police successfully arrested 6 suspects. At about 7 pm on April 22, BLS, a 36-year-old foreign businessman, met two sisters, A Hong and A Li, near Guangzhou Railway Station. On the pretext of taking the victim home to buy shoes, Ahong took BLS to a rental house in Huang Qihua x Xincun. Looking at the dark corridor, BLS felt suspicious. When he reached the door of the rental house on the third floor, he felt it was dangerous and turned around to leave, but Ahong grabbed his arm and pulled him into the house. He threw A Hong away and ran downstairs in one breath. The police who were waiting nearby rushed upstairs and captured A Hong. At 11 o'clock that night, Ali was also captured in a rental house in Daliang, Shunde. At 3 a.m. on the 23rd, the police captured their gang member Zhao in Baiyun District, Guangzhou. It turns out that the Nanhai police have received more than 10 reports recently, all of which were foreign businessmen who were deceived into Huangqi's rental house and had their property stolen or robbed. The modus operandi was similar. Police investigation revealed that the suspect rented two rental houses in Huang Qihua x Xincun, modified the wardrobe in one of the rooms, and punched through the wall behind the wardrobe. After the victim was lured into the rental house, the suspect either asked the victim to take a shower and then ran away with the victim's belongings; or he went to bed with the victim and asked the victim to put clothes in the closet. Another criminal suspect walked through the wall in the next room and stole the victim's belongings. The suspects admitted to a total of 15 sex robbery cases. The amount involved in the case has reached more than 300,000 yuan, and the case is currently under further review.

b9caf3514cd921622b0a9f81feba6c7432f15a8b.sourceText: 11月8日将投票产生新一任的凤凰城市长，有两位市长候选人维斯古力特（Wes Gullett）和格雷格斯坦顿（Greg Stanton）做最后的角逐。这是一次很重要的选举，将会影响到整个凤凰城市的下个十年或者更长的时间。 如果你是凤凰城市民，为什么你应该关注选举？市长将会制定城市发展方向和主旨。你是否要付更多的税收和费用？是否在乎警察消防队更加敏捷反应911的投诉？是否要在安全而清洁的街道上行驶？有很多重要的原因来参加市长投票选举。 10月26日下午5时30分到7时30分，亚利桑那前众议员黄仕钧和大凤凰城华人侨团总会主席邓朝驹将在六福酒家举行，市长候选人的辩论会。欢迎华裔社团和组织参加并赞助活动。每个位子35美元，可坐10人。参与团体请与黄仕钧联络602-850-4300或者 Barry@barrywong.com 欢迎公众报名参加，不收费用。 需要了解更多候选人的情况请点击网站：格雷格斯坦顿Greg Stanton?www.GregStantonforMayor.com; 维斯古力特Wes Gullett?www.WesGullett.com. Also visit the city of Phoenix website for more information on the election (how to request vote-by-mail or voting locations) http://phoenix.gov/ELECTION/voteidx.html.
b9caf3514cd921622b0a9f81feba6c7432f15a8b.translatedText: On November 8, a new mayor of Phoenix will be voted on, with two mayoral candidates, Wes Gullett and Greg Stanton, competing in the final round. This is an important election that will affect the entire city of Phoenix for the next decade or more. If you're a Phoenix citizen, why should you care about the election? The mayor will set the direction and themes of urban development. Will you pay more taxes and fees? Do you care about the police and fire departments being more responsive to 911 complaints? Want to drive on safe and clean streets? There are many great reasons to vote for mayor. On October 26, from 5:30 to 7:30 pm, former Arizona Representative Huang Shijun and Greater Phoenix Chinese Overseas Chinese Association Chairman Deng Chaoju will hold a debate for mayoral candidates at Luk Fook Restaurant. Chinese societies and organizations are welcome to participate in and sponsor the event. $35 per seat, seats 10 people. Participating groups please contact Huang Shijun at 602-850-4300 or Barry@barrywong.com. The public is welcome to sign up and there is no charge. Also visit the city of Phoenix website for more information on the election (how to request vote-by-mail or voting locations) http://phoenix.gov/ELECTION/voteidx.html.

f3e2f56f0b0b575f291f96154cd12a7d17c79444.sourceText: 亚太社区促进会 影带挑战－奖金250元 亚太社区促进会近日发布将展开”你的故事” 的影带挑战，目的是探究居住在亚利桑纳州的亚太裔青少年的个人故事。 我们希望这些青少年告诉大家他们如何在他们的社区与/或一般社会中做出改变，录影带中让我们了解： 对你而言，什么主题是重要的？ (例如艺术、移民、民权、健康或是教育等) 你会以何种方式或计划让你的社区有所改变？ 参赛者必须是二十一岁以下居住在亚利桑纳州的亚太裔，影带作品必须在三分钟以内并以YouTube 或Vimeo 方式提交，影带作品可以任何形式制作，包括音乐录影、公共服务广播 、短片、视频博客与访谈等呈现，作品在观念上应具创意、创新并富启发性且必须在二○一一年十一月十六日午夜十二时前提交亚太社区促进会网站( www.apcaaz.org) 。 我们将审查提交作品，并将获选佳作发布在亚太社区促进会网站。 首奖奖金250美元，此作品将在亚太社区促进会的?透过宣传带动健康?会议中首映，此会预定在二○一一年十二月三日在ASU城区部校园 举办。 提交作品，请浏览亚太社区促进会网站 www.apcaaz.org 。 如需更多讯息，请致电亚太社区促进会，电话：(602) 265-4598 或送电子邮件至Liza Merrill 女士 liza@apcaaz.org.
f3e2f56f0b0b575f291f96154cd12a7d17c79444.translatedText: Asia-Pacific Community Promotion Association Video Challenge - Prize 250 Yuan The Asia-Pacific Community Promotion Association recently announced that it will launch "Your Story" ’s video challenge explores the personal stories of Asian and Pacific Islander youth living in Arizona. We want these teenagers to tell you how they are making a difference in their communities and/or society in general. In the video, we learn: What topics are important to you? (For example, arts, immigration, civil rights, health or education, etc.) In what ways or plans will you make a difference in your community? Contestants must be of Asian and Pacific Islander descent under the age of 21 and living in Arizona. Videos must be submitted in less than three minutes via YouTube or Vimeo. Videos can be produced in any form, including music videos, public service broadcasts, short films, video blogs, interviews, etc. The works should be creative, innovative and inspiring in concept and must be submitted to the Asia Pacific Community Advancement Association website (www.apcaaz.org) before midnight on November 16, 2011. We will review the submitted works and publish the selected ones on the Asia Pacific Community Initiative website. The first prize is US$250. This work will premiere at the Asian Pacific Community Advancement Association's "Promoting Health through Advocacy" conference, which is scheduled to be held on December 3, 2011 at the ASU Urban Campus. To submit your work, please visit the Asia Pacific Community Advancement Association website www.apcaaz.org. For more information, please call APCA at (602) 265-4598 or email Liza Merrill at liza@apcaaz.org.

f0e4be0291dd9bc070441b28afe0a557e7d102bc.sourceText: “山谷热”在亚利桑那流行 不容忽视 （亚省时报） 山谷热病例在亚利桑那肆虐流行，亚利桑那大学医学院的加利亚诺博士说。 加利亚诺博士解释，从7月的大沙尘暴开始，感染山谷热的病例在增加。这种病与流感相似，病人会发烧，归咎原因是感染了孢子，一种来自索诺兰沙漠的真菌孢子。山谷热的医学名称为球孢子菌病。感染者通常导致肺炎。 据称，本州每年有10万人感染山谷热，大多数得不到治疗或误诊。 天堂谷退休商人密那汉在2009年感染了山谷热，体温上升至104度，因此在床上躺了9个月。密那汉病愈后与加利亚诺博士合作，创办山谷热中心，地点在St. Joseph医院，将于明年1月正式运作。
f0e4be0291dd9bc070441b28afe0a557e7d102bc.translatedText: "Valley Fever" is epidemic in Arizona and cannot be ignored (Alberta Times) Valley fever cases are raging in Arizona, said Dr. Galliano of the University of Arizona School of Medicine. Dr. Galliano explained that cases of valley fever have increased since the Great Dust Bowl in July. The disease, which is similar to the flu and causes a fever, is blamed on the infection, a type of fungal spore that comes from the Sonoran Desert. The medical name for valley fever is coccidioidomycosis. Infected individuals often develop pneumonia. It is said that 100,000 people in the state are infected with valley fever every year, and most of them go untreated or are misdiagnosed. Minahan, a retired Paradise Valley businessman, contracted Valley Fever in 2009. His temperature rose to 104 degrees and he was bedridden for nine months. After recovering from the illness, Minahan collaborated with Dr. Galliano to establish the Valley Fever Center, which will be located at St. Joseph Hospital and will be officially operational in January next year.

53f04dbaeeaa82b3f277d63ffe4e914a81ed3c63.sourceText: 超黑赶银 美车主最爱白色车 （亚省时报）美国颜料制造商必PPG Industries年度调查显示，白色已超越银色，成为世界最受欢迎的汽车颜色。 截至今年，银色在过去10年都是最受欢迎的车色，但PPG表示，2011年车款中有21%是白色，黑色与银色并列第2，各占20%。北美地区最受欢迎的车色是白色，欧洲是黑色，亚洲则是银色。PPG也即将在未来推出新色，如”桶金色”－带点金的淡绿色、”牛轧糖”－具有闪亮光泽的乳白色、”灵魂紫”－紫色调的蓝色。
53f04dbaeeaa82b3f277d63ffe4e914a81ed3c63.translatedText: Super black to chase silver, American car owners love white cars the most (Alberta Times) An annual survey by U.S. pigment manufacturer PPG Industries shows that white has surpassed silver to become the most popular car color in the world. As of this year, silver has been the most popular car color in the past 10 years, but PPG said that 21% of 2011 car models were white, with black and silver tied for second, each accounting for 20%. The most popular car color is white in North America, black in Europe, and silver in Asia. PPG is also about to launch new colors in the future, such as "Barrel Gold" - a light green with a touch of gold, "Nougat" - a milky white with a shiny luster, and "Soul Purple" - a blue with purple tones.

0bca2064009d82e7aac78615713742bb8c729037.translatedText: The Flagstaff Port police chief died while walking. The Flagstaff Port Police Department announced that its chief died while walking on October 10. Chief Cooper left home for a walk at 10 a.m. that day and did not return home for a long time. His family called the police for help. Police began an intensive ground and air search and found the man unconscious near Highway 89 and Purple Sage around 3 p.m. Medical personnel immediately tried to save Cooper, but they could not save him and he was pronounced dead at the scene. Cooper, 57, has served in the Flagstaff Police Department for more than 30 years and was promoted to chief in July 2006. Cooper's cause of death is unclear.

69e96ac7daa95baa312fec8766bb5b2493920c7f.sourceText: 广州辛亥革命纪念馆开馆首日火爆（图） （本报广州特约记者杨绮薇报道） 2011年10月8日下午，广州辛亥革命纪念馆在广州黄埔区长洲岛隆重开馆并正式对公众免费开放。 历时十年始建成的广州辛亥革命纪念馆总建筑面积为18000平方米，包括陈列区13200平方米，藏品库区1000平方米。主要功能布局包括陈列区、藏品库区、技术及业务用房、观众服务及配套设施。纪念馆项目总投资为31936万元，里面成功征得文物6602件（套）。 纪念馆里，邹容、陆皓东、蒋翊武、秋瑾、蔡元培、章炳麟、朱执信、廖仲恺、宋教仁、黄兴、孙中山厖一尊尊辛亥革命先驱者的铜像，引领参观者重新走进辛亥之路，重温辛亥革命这段壮烈的历史。 广东省省长黄华华在开馆仪式上称，广州是近现代革命的策源地，虽然辛亥革命并没有改变旧中国半封建半殖民地的社会性质，但为中国的文明进步打开了闸门，广州修建辛亥革命纪念馆对传承革命精神有现实意义。孙中山曾侄孙孙必达在致辞中表示，辛亥革命纪念馆为缅怀革命先烈、纪念革命先烈提供了重要的载体，更希望通过纪念馆可以促进国家和谐统一。 据了解，广州辛亥革命纪念馆开馆当日盛况空前。开放才一个小时，主展馆就接纳游客1320名，等待参观的市民在馆外排起了百余米的长龙。场面之火爆，出乎纪念馆负责人的意料之外。
69e96ac7daa95baa312fec8766bb5b2493920c7f.translatedText: The Guangzhou Xinhai Revolution Memorial Hall was a hit on the first day of its opening (pictures) (Reported by Yang Qiwei, our special correspondent in Guangzhou) On the afternoon of October 8, 2011, the Guangzhou Xinhai Revolution Memorial Hall was grandly opened on Changzhou Island, Huangpu District, Guangzhou and officially open to the public free of charge. The Guangzhou Xinhai Revolution Memorial Hall, which took ten years to build, has a total construction area of ​​18,000 square meters, including an exhibition area of ​​13,200 square meters and a collection storage area of ​​1,000 square meters. The main functional layout includes exhibition area, collection storage area, technical and business rooms, audience services and supporting facilities. The total investment in the memorial hall project was 319.36 million yuan, and 6,602 pieces (sets) of cultural relics were successfully acquired. In the memorial hall, bronze statues of Zou Rong, Lu Haodong, Jiang Yiwu, Qiu Jin, Cai Yuanpei, Zhang Binglin, Zhu Zhixin, Liao Zhongkai, Song Jiaoren, Huang Xing, Sun Yat-sen and Pang Yi, the pioneers of the Revolution of 1911, lead visitors to re-enter the Road of 1911 and relive the heroic history of the Revolution of 1911. Huang Huahua, governor of Guangdong Province, said at the opening ceremony that Guangzhou is the birthplace of the modern revolution. Although the Revolution of 1911 did not change the semi-feudal and semi-colonial nature of old China, it opened the door to China's civilization and progress. The construction of the 1911 Revolution Memorial Hall in Guangzhou has practical significance for inheriting the revolutionary spirit. Sun Bida, Sun Yat-sen's great-nephew, said in his speech that the 1911 Revolution Memorial Hall provides an important carrier to commemorate the revolutionary martyrs and commemorate the revolutionary martyrs. He also hopes that the memorial hall can promote national harmony and unity. It is understood that the opening of the Guangzhou Xinhai Revolution Memorial Hall was unprecedentedly grand. Only one hour after it opened, the main exhibition hall received 1,320 visitors, and citizens waiting to visit formed a queue of more than 100 meters outside the hall. The excitement of the scene was beyond the expectation of the person in charge of the memorial hall.

4843fd0167b9abf1e870a766a0daffa9e35e4175.sourceText: 州长启动儿童安全专责小组 鉴于过去六个月内，本州发生多起虐待儿童事件，州长决定成立儿童安全专责小组。 当局说，今年以来已有数十名儿童因父母或监护人过失而死亡和临近死亡。 八月，6岁的雅各布被父母打死的惨案让人不胜唏嘘。 事发前，儿童保护服务署已有雅各布受虐记录，可惜没有及时解决，导致悲剧发生。 ”虽然是几个可怕的个案，​​但也反映了其中的问题，”州长发言人本森说。 经济安全部负责儿童保护服务署已经提交一份报告，确定一些关键领域，如增加人手，减少积压案件等。 服务署调查一个案例通常需要178-203天，现希望能在40天内完成。 专责小组由专家组成，包括执法人员和专业医务人员。 专责小组将在年底前举行两次公开听证会，在12月31日前提出具体运作方案。
4843fd0167b9abf1e870a766a0daffa9e35e4175.translatedText: Governor launches Child Safety Task Force In light of numerous child abuse incidents in the state over the past six months, the Governor has decided to create a Child Safety Task Force. Authorities say dozens of children have died or been near death so far this year due to the negligence of their parents or guardians. In August, the tragedy of 6-year-old Jacob being beaten to death by his parents was deeply saddening. Before the incident, the Child Protective Services Department had a record of Jacob's abuse, but unfortunately it was not resolved in time, which led to the tragedy. "While these are a few horrific cases, they also reflect the problems," said Benson, the governor's spokesman. The Department of Economic Security's Child Protective Services Agency has submitted a report identifying key areas such as increasing staffing and reducing the backlog. It usually takes 178-203 days for the Service Department to investigate a case, but now it hopes to complete it within 40 days. The task force is made up of experts, including law enforcement and medical professionals. The task force will hold two public hearings before the end of the year and propose a specific operational plan before December 31.

65f404bd46abb709f14a170ec9c1a69663f9259e.sourceText: 冰雹损失一年未获赔偿 去年10月5日，突如其来的一场冰雹吓呆了许多久居沙漠的居民，也砸坏了不少屋顶和汽车。 可是一年过去了，还有好多人没有从保险公司那里得到这次意外之灾的应得赔偿。 钱德勒居民贝妮伯克就是其中一个。 伯克说，风暴掀了她家的屋顶，冰雹砸坏她的空调机。 当她提出赔偿诉求时，保险公司拒绝了。 亚利桑那州保险部的克鲁格女士说：”我们已经接到不少关于去年风暴拒赔的投诉电话。”保险公司拒赔的主要原因是无法确定损失是否由冰雹造成。 克鲁格女士说，就算得不到赔偿，仍然有机会。 坚持跟保险公司争取，你的申请会有批准的一天。
65f404bd46abb709f14a170ec9c1a69663f9259e.translatedText: No compensation for hail damage for a year. On October 5 last year, a sudden hailstorm shocked many residents who had lived in the desert for a long time, and also damaged many roofs and cars. But one year has passed, and many people still have not received the compensation they deserve from the insurance company for this accident. Chandler resident Beni Burke is one of them. Burke said the storm ripped off the roof of her home and damaged her air conditioning unit with hail. When she filed a claim for compensation, the insurance company refused. "We've been getting a lot of calls about denials from last year's storm," said Ms. Kruger of the Arizona Department of Insurance. The main reason insurance companies deny coverage is because they can't determine whether the damage was caused by hail. Ms Krueger said even if she didn't get compensation, there was still a chance. Keep fighting with the insurance company and your application will be approved one day.

ba03ab6c2cb299392537d2f31e181056961fc7ad.sourceText: 坦佩河滨公园音乐会为街民筹款 10月11日，4对当地乐队齐集坦佩河滨公园演出，为坦佩的无家可归者提供帮助。 当天的活动名为”Our House Tempe，World Homeless Day”，参加演出的本地乐队分别为沃尔特理查森，和平勇士，肖恩约翰逊，糖基贼达维斯。 音乐会免费入场，但主办单位要求观众带来物品捐赠给无家可归者，像袜子，内衣，牙膏和牙刷等。 我们的家园坦佩是伊芙琳罗斯霍尔曼基金帮助街民一系列活动中的一项，目的向第一次成为街民的人士提供临时庇护和帮助。 此外，我们的家园坦佩活动还将在12月21日举办”Homeless Persons Memorial Eve”和1月15日的马丁路德金生日纪念会。 *街民，又称无家可归者和无壳蜗牛，homeless是也。
ba03ab6c2cb299392537d2f31e181056961fc7ad.translatedText: Concert in Tempe Riverside Park raises money for street residents On October 11, 4 pairs of local bands gathered in Tempe Riverside Park to perform to help the homeless in Tempe. The event that day was called "Our House Tempe, World Homeless Day", and the local bands participating in the performance were Walter Richardson, Peace Warrior, Sean Johnson, and Sugar Thief Davis. Admission to the concert is free, but organizers ask audience members to bring items to donate to the homeless, such as socks, underwear, toothpaste and toothbrushes. Our Home Tempe is one of the Evelyn Rose Holman Foundation's initiatives to provide temporary shelter and assistance to first-time street residents. In addition, Our Home in Tempe will host Homeless Persons Memorial Eve on December 21st and the Martin Luther King Jr. Birthday Commemoration on January 15th. * Street dwellers, also known as homeless people and shellless snails, homeless are also called.
