fbe61c9c5145f0b1795fe77b3baf02c14e3b669f.translatedText: Wen Yang: A modern country in Chinese style From a historical perspective, the development of human society into today's world system with sovereign states as its unit is a gradual evolution...

8da9fac3986996395e774f152e9d254e6b7968ba.sourceText: 文扬：中国式的现代国家 从历史看，人类社会发展成为今天这样一个以主权国家为单元的世界体系，是一个渐进演变的过程。 虽然这个体系现在已基本成型，能建国的地方都已成立了统一制式的现代国家，大大小小近两百个国家共处一个地球。但关于现代国家的本质到底是什么，关于其内容、形式和应有的功能，还并不十分清晰，各个国家都各行其是地实践着各自的国家理念。 人们曾经相信，国家就是政治利益的集合体，只要确保政治制度实行民主化，实行全国普选、一人一票、政党轮替，其他问题都会自动得到解决。 源自于启蒙的这个观念，经过两三百年的实践，在今天已遭遇到了越来越多的质疑。 实行了民主的西方国家，对外却实行强权专制。资本的意志不受任何约束，贪婪无度的巧取豪夺令世界严重分化、四分五裂、冲突四起。当政治权力体现为对外霸权，以分权为本质的民主也就演变成了全民分赃。 而在非西方国家中，众多希望通过照搬西方式民主而实现富强的穷国，结果却适得其反。国家原本就积贫积弱、频遭外国侵犯，靠中央集权和精英治国尚且不能保证一定能够自立自强，移植了分权和民主制度后正好成全了外国势力的插手介入。原本应该体现本民族利益的主权国家，结果成了外国利益的总代理。 事情就是这样，全球范围愈演愈烈的贫富分化，令国家的本质受到质疑，令国家的功能遭遇挑战。再先进的政治制度，如果不能保障国家自立自强、免遭强国掠夺，就毫无意义。 而一个原本并不富强的国家，即使政治制度并不先进，只要找到了适合本国国情的发展之路，能够在激烈的国际竞争中不断取胜，逐步接近富强国家的水平，也就是一个成功的现代国家，也就等于是抓住了现代国家的本质。 这一点可以成为当今世界一个普遍的共识：在这个不平衡的、竞争性的、仍然遵从物竞天择规则的全球化时代，仅仅靠政治制度改革并不能解决国家发展的所有问题。而一旦放弃”政治挂帅”的迷信，丢掉意识形态的包袱，将虚幻的政治理想暂时搁置起来，反倒更容易看清楚一个国家所面对的真正问题是什么，更容易找出本国的道路在哪里，更容易快速地发展起来。 这个道理，有些国家完全懂得，但它们不说，因为让所有人都明白这一点并不符合他们自己的利益。例如那几个一直为现代世界提供思想资源和理论基础的西方国家。 而已经在实践这个道理的国家，也是不说，因为即使是在这个道理的指引下取得了初步的成功，也还远远没有达到可以总结出成熟理论的程度，更没有达到可以将其宣称为普遍真理的程度。例如今天的中国。 从辛亥革命算起一百周年，从中华人民共和国算起六十二周年，这其中一以贯之的中国近代历史主题就是：完全中国式的现代国家的建国、富国和强国。 国庆日前夕，我正好有机会走在中国大西北的土地上重新审看这个巨大的国家。从当年戈壁滩上”天当被子地当床”艰苦卓绝的屯垦戍边，到今天”乘清风以御阴阳”叱咤风云的天宫一号发射，中国人几乎从零开始的现代建国，已经堪称为一个史诗般的非凡伟业。 谨以此文庆祝中华人民共和国这个完全中国式的现代国家成立六十二周年。▊ 2011年9月30日
8da9fac3986996395e774f152e9d254e6b7968ba.translatedText: Wen Yang: A modern state in Chinese style From a historical perspective, the development of human society into today's world system with sovereign states as its unit is a process of gradual evolution. Although this system has now basically taken shape, modern countries with unified standards have been established in places where countries can be established. Nearly two hundred countries, large and small, coexist on the same earth. However, it is not very clear what the nature of a modern state is, as well as its content, form and proper functions. Each country implements its own national ideals in its own way. People once believed that the country was a collection of political interests. As long as the political system was democratized, universal suffrage, one person, one vote, and political party rotation were implemented, other problems would be solved automatically. This concept originated from the Enlightenment, and after two to three hundred years of practice, it has encountered more and more doubts today. Western countries that have implemented democracy practice power and autocracy externally. The will of capital is not subject to any restraint, and its greedy and unbridled plunder has caused the world to be severely divided, fragmented, and conflict-ridden. When political power is reflected as external hegemony, democracy with decentralization as its essence also evolves into sharing the spoils among all the people. Among non-Western countries, many poor countries hope to become rich and powerful by copying Western-style democracy, but the results are counterproductive. The country was originally poor and weak, and was frequently invaded by foreign countries. Relying on centralized power and elite governance could not guarantee that it would be self-reliant and self-reliant. The transplantation of decentralized and democratic systems just facilitated the intervention of foreign forces. The sovereign state that was supposed to reflect the interests of its own nation ended up becoming the general agent of foreign interests. That's the thing. The increasingly severe polarization between rich and poor around the world has questioned the nature of the country and challenged its functions. No matter how advanced a political system is, it is meaningless if it cannot ensure the country's self-reliance and self-reliance and protect it from plunder by powerful countries. And a country that is not originally rich and powerful, even if its political system is not advanced, as long as it finds a development path suitable for its national conditions, can continue to win in fierce international competition, and gradually approach the level of a rich and powerful country, that is, it will be a successful modern country, which is equivalent to grasping the essence of a modern country. This point can become a general consensus in today's world: in this unbalanced, competitive, and still abiding by the rules of natural selection globalization era, political system reform alone cannot solve all problems of national development. Once we give up the superstition of "politics in command", throw away the baggage of ideology, and temporarily shelve illusory political ideals, it will be easier to see clearly what the real problems a country faces are, to find out where the country is heading, and to develop quickly. Some countries fully understand this truth, but they do not say it because it is not in their own interests to let everyone understand this. For example, those Western countries have always provided ideological resources and theoretical foundations for the modern world. Countries that are already practicing this principle are not talking about it, because even if they have achieved initial success under the guidance of this principle, it is still far from the level where a mature theory can be summarized, let alone the level where it can be declared as a universal truth. Such as China today. Counting the 100th anniversary from the Revolution of 1911 and the 62nd anniversary from the People's Republic of China, the consistent theme of China's modern history is: the founding, enrichment and strength of a completely Chinese-style modern country. On the eve of National Day, I had the opportunity to walk in the northwest of China and re-examine this huge country. From the arduous cultivation and border garrisoning in the Gobi Desert, where the sky was used as a quilt and the ground was used as a bed, to today's all-powerful launch of Tiangong-1, which is "riding the breeze to control the yin and yang", the Chinese people's modern nation-building almost from scratch has been called an epic and extraordinary achievement. I would like to write this article to celebrate the 62nd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, a completely Chinese-style modern country. ▊ September 30, 2011

3065f9ffee3656993865a936b7b05a918f952ebb.translatedText: The Peoria fire chief resigned angrily due to dissatisfaction with the new pension system. The state retirement agency asked Solberg to enroll in a retirement security plan for state public safety employees, but Solberg declined, according to a city news release. c611eb7aacbc7b48805f760cf6af7a4c6c33b3f0.sourceText: 马利科巴郡房屋空置率冠全国 (亚省时报) 上周四出炉的数据显示，凤凰城大都会，不包括皮纳尔郡，自2000年以来，房屋空置率攀升了4.5%。 在马利科巴郡，几乎14%的房屋是空的。根据去年普查数据显示，227,696户住宅（包括独立屋、公寓）没人居住，比较图森市现拥有23万住宅单位，马利科巴郡的空置房屋面积竟达图森市大小的一座城市。 相对于10年前，马利科巴郡人口增长了24%，而住房存量增长了31%。 大多数经济学家和房产地观察家对这样的排名并不惊讶。早在三月的数据就显示空置率严重。在一些山谷城市，特别说较新的边缘郊区，房屋空置率几近马利科巴郡的一倍。 房地产分析师说，这些空置房屋多数建造在近年，与投机和人口数量膨胀有关。2004-06年就建成超过10座独立屋，至今大部分无人居住。此外，经济衰退带来的失业，SB1040出台导致大量拉丁裔撤离本州，使凤凰城法拍屋雪上加霜。
c611eb7aacbc7b48805f760cf6af7a4c6c33b3f0.translatedText: > Maricopa County has the highest vacancy rate in the country (Alberta Times) Data released Thursday showed that the vacancy rate in the Phoenix metropolitan area, excluding Pinal County, has climbed 4.5% since 2000. In Maricopa County, almost 14% of homes are empty. According to last year’s census data, 227,696 houses (including single-family homes and apartments) were unoccupied. Compared to Tucson, which now has 230,000 residential units, the area of ​​vacant houses in Maricopa County is as large as a city the size of Tucson. Relative to 10 years ago, Maricopa County's population has grown by 24%, while its housing stock has grown by 31%. Most economists and real estate observers are not surprised by this ranking. Data as early as March showed serious vacancy rates. In some Valley cities, particularly in newer fringe suburbs, the vacancy rate is nearly double that of Maricopa County. Real estate analysts say most of these vacant homes were built in recent years and are related to speculation and population expansion. More than 10 detached houses were built between 2004 and 2006, but most of them are still unoccupied. In addition, the unemployment caused by the economic recession and the introduction of SB1040 caused a large number of Latinos to leave the state, making foreclosures in Phoenix even worse.

f9f6433914c22bde560bd081ae44ec85eedc74cb.sourceText: Tempe青少年项目获得全美多元文化奖 (本网编译)Tempe多元文化办公室被全国城市联合委员会地方办公室授予2013年多元文化奖。3月11日在华盛顿举行的全国会议上被授予这个称号。Tempe被授予的项目是青少年建立一个更美好社区的对话。这个奖项是授予那些有创造性并有效地提高多元文化的项目。 Tempe多元文化办公室负责人说：”用最好的方式来拥抱我们的不同，来开始我们的对话。”他说：”Tempe是一个进步的城市，不仅在商业，技术以及区域问题，而且在多样性和包容性也是比较先进的。我希望这些十几岁的孩子，能认识人们的价值以及他们的不同，继续为Tempe这个城市服务。” Tempe多元文化办公室成立于2002年，致力于提高社区人群的平等和包容。
f9f6433914c22bde560bd081ae44ec85eedc74cb.translatedText: Tempe Youth Program Wins National Multicultural Award (Compiled by this website) The Tempe Multicultural Office was awarded the 2013 Multicultural Award by the local office of the National Joint Council of Cities. The title was awarded March 11 at a national conference in Washington. The project Tempe was awarded is a conversation among teenagers building a better community. This award is given to projects that creatively and effectively enhance multiculturalism. The head of the Tempe Multicultural Office said: "Embrace our differences in the best way to start our dialogue." He said: "Tempe is a progressive city, not only in business, technology and regional issues, but also in diversity and inclusion. I hope these teenagers can recognize the value of people and their differences and continue to serve the city of Tempe." The Tempe Multicultural Office was established in 2002 and is committed to improving equality and inclusion among the community.

3e926bb0afb0cf9caa93d65996bed5254eaaf4f9.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学(ASU)校长Michael Crow ，副校长及台亚科技交流学会理事长尹衍桓等一行在教育部长蒋伟宁陪同下，于四月一日上午九时在总统府晋见马英九总统。
3e926bb0afb0cf9caa93d65996bed5254eaaf4f9.translatedText: Arizona State University (ASU) President Michael Crow, Vice President and Chairman of the Taiwan-Asian Science and Technology Exchange Association Yin Yanhuan and others, accompanied by Education Minister Jiang Weining, met with President Ma Ying-jeou at the Presidential Palace at 9 a.m. on April 1.

80713c8e3702acb871a539af3a6d3a79b81f90dc.sourceText: 台湾工研院 ITRI董事长蔡清彦，尹衍桓， ASU 副校长DENIS SIMON,校长DR MICHAEL CROW,台湾马英九总统，台湾教育部长蒋伟宁，台湾总统府公共事务主任卜正珉，台湾中央大学校长周景扬，台湾教育部国际及两岸教育司长林文通,台湾中央大学国际长张元翰 这次透过国科会与台亚科技交流学会的安排，台湾中央大学颁发荣誉博士学位给Michael Crow 表彰他在学术研究与办学经验的成功，让亚利桑那州立大学从一个莫莫无名的大学变成全美最优前20的公立名校。 马英九总统在接见代表团时表示对Michael Crow 在短短时间内让一个大学脱胎换骨转换成一个名校表达了敬意，也对尹衍桓理事长促成与中央大学缔结姊妹校表示嘉许。 马英九总统希望台湾所有大学都能借重Michael Crow 的办学经验，在得知Micheal Crow 将搭飞机当日下午离台，特别吩咐教育部长蒋伟宁中午设宴款待并通知台湾大学等廿馀所大学校长出席，全程Micheal Crow 都在回答问题，除了一杯可乐，一口未进食。 会后在赶赴机场途中，尹衍桓向Micheal Crow 表示，今天的午餐只能以一杯可乐招待你，但请你接受我代表全台湾的年轻学生向你表达最诚挚的敬意，一杯可乐的感情将永远留在台湾。 亚利桑那州立大学在完成与台湾三所大学缔结姊妹校时，在中国的廿五所姊妹校也波澜壮观的登场。
80713c8e3702acb871a539af3a6d3a79b81f90dc.translatedText: Taiwan Industrial Research Institute ITRI Chairman Cai Qingyan, Yin Yanhuan, ASU Vice President Denis Simon, President DR MICHAEL CROW, Taiwan President Ma Ying-jeou, Taiwan Education Minister Chiang Wei-ning, Taiwan Presidential Office Public Affairs Director Bu Zhengmin, Taiwan National Central University President Zhou Jingyang, Taiwan Ministry of Education Director of International and Cross-Strait Education Lin Wentong, Taiwan National Central University International Dean Zhang Yuanhan This time through the arrangement of the National Science Council and the Taiwan-Asia Science and Technology Exchange Association, Taiwan Central University awarded an honorary doctorate to Michael Crow In recognition of his success in academic research and school running experience, Arizona State University has transformed from an unknown university into one of the top 20 public schools in the United States. When receiving the delegation, President Ma Ying-jeou expressed his respect for Michael Crow for transforming a university into a famous school in a short period of time, and commended Chairman Yin Yanhuan for promoting the establishment of a sister school with Central University. President Ma Ying-jeou hoped that all universities in Taiwan could learn from Michael Crow's experience in running schools. After learning that Michael Crow would leave Taiwan by plane that afternoon, he specially ordered Minister of Education Chiang Weining to host a banquet at noon and notified the presidents of more than 20 universities including National Taiwan University to attend. During the whole process, Michael Crow was answering questions and did not eat a single bite except for a glass of Coke. After the meeting, on the way to the airport, Yin Yanhuan told Micheal Crow that today’s lunch can only serve you with a glass of Coke, but please accept my sincere respect for you on behalf of all young students in Taiwan. The emotion of a glass of Coke will remain in Taiwan forever. When Arizona State University completed the establishment of sister schools with three universities in Taiwan, it also made a spectacular debut with 25 sister schools in China.

5094c068b8c0e81e3dc40443baab46f405f6ca4c.translatedText: (News from this website) Arizona State University (ASU) and National Central University of Taiwan officially signed a contract to become sister universities in Taipei on March 31 by the presidents of both parties, Dr. Michael Crow and Dr. Zhou Jingyang.

e72ba0d9fdbcd4c051206e04407e8dfcb70a8c68.sourceText: ＡＳＵ校长Dr Michael Crow（左）和台湾中央大学校长周景扬（右）正式签约缔结为姊妹大学 这是亚历桑那州立大学在台湾计划缔结三个姊妹学校之一，台湾大学与清华大学将陆续签约缔交。 台亚科技交流学会理事长尹衍桓表示，这次能促成两校缔结姊妹学校，非常感谢驻洛杉矶台北经文处龚中诚处长及张扬展组长所给予的支持协助，未来在台亚两地科技交流中，台亚科技交流学会将扮演更积极的推手角色。 资深侨领尹衍桓，目前也是亚历桑那州立大学基金会董事，这次全程随团访问台湾，并订于四月一日晋见马英九总统。 尹衍桓表示在今年暑假，台湾将有高规格的科技代表团访问美国，凤凰城将是首站。
e72ba0d9fdbcd4c051206e04407e8dfcb70a8c68.translatedText: ASU President Dr. Michael Crow (left) and Taiwan Central University President Zhou Jingyang (right) officially signed a contract to establish sister universities. This is one of the three sister schools Arizona State University plans to establish in Taiwan. National Taiwan University and Tsinghua University will sign contracts one after another. Yin Yanhuan, chairman of the Taiwan-Asia Science and Technology Exchange Society, said that this time it was possible to establish a sister school between the two schools. He was very grateful to Director Gong Zhongcheng and Team Leader Zhang Yangzhan of the Taipei Cultural Affairs Office in Los Angeles for their support and assistance. In the future, the Taiwan-Asia Science and Technology Exchange Society will play a more active role in promoting science and technology exchanges between Taiwan and Asia. Yin Yanhuan, a senior overseas Chinese leader and currently a director of the Arizona State University Foundation, will accompany the entire delegation to visit Taiwan and is scheduled to meet with President Ma Ying-jeou on April 1. Yin Yanhuan said that during this summer vacation, Taiwan will have a high-level technology delegation visit the United States, and Phoenix will be the first stop.

3c68e445121766193b7a96a9cdef21e9210090f5.sourceText: 凤凰城 崔增祁 我走进了当年生活的那块地方，这是一块”坝子”。云南人通常把一块平坦的髙地叫坝子，这坝子上是原资源委员会明良煤矿的员工的生活基地。我站在这块红土和石块凝成的土地上，往事涌上心头，艰苦但快乐的童年生活历历在目，那是一些永世也忘不了的故事。我的记忆中，两排长长的士坯堆砌的平房，住的都是由内地迁来的职员，房屋的西端尽头有一个销售生活用品的合作社和缝纫社，东端有一亇城堡式的大门，中间有一个烧开水的老虎灶和一个小歺厅，这是一个独立于当地居民之外的居住区。如今原来的房子都已不复存在，只有一户人家新盖了二层楼的房子住在这里。在我家住的地方只看到了那后边山坡上砌的石护墙，一眼看到那护墙上的石块，就觉得那么熟悉，似乎昨天才见过那样。人的大脑怎么会那样神奇，七十年了，怎么这几块石头的模样还会在脑海里，我従来没有像记英文单词那样去刻意地记过它。那石墙是我小时矦喜欢做冻豆腐的地方。每当冬季最冷的时矦，屋檐上挂起细细的冰柱，我就会在晚上把一块豆腐放在碗里，再加上一点水，第二天早上把一块冻豆腐交到妈妈手里。在这个坝子里，我还学会了生火炉，每天放学回家，第一件事就是拎起家里的炉子到老虎灶点燃几块煤，点着炉子后等妈妈回来做饭。为了改善生活，爸爸在对面的山坡上养了一隻羊，有时我还跟着爸爸去挤羊奶。我还曾在山坡上开垦了一块地学着种土豆，因为生物自然退化的原因，收成的土豆一年比一年小。这种田园式的生活堷养了我勤劳吃苦的精神，而坝子里的集体生活又给了我从小喜爱接触社会的特性。因为孩子不多，许多人是单身，我就成了社区的公共儿子，无论走到那里都受到叔叔阿姨的关心和爱抚，人们总是笑脸对着我，摸摸我的头，或是抱抱我，或是给我点吃的东西，我也时时以笑容相报，给大家带来快乐和欢笑。我爸妈很善待朋友，几个单身男人常常来我们家作客，妈妈的江南菜做得特别好吃，有一位叫胡伯恳的伯伯，几乎常在我们家吃晚饭，是我父母的挚友。在我工作以后，还受到父母的老友们给我的许多关照。童年时代的这段生活对我的性格的形成有着重要影响。我一直生活在一个欢乐平和的环境里，像一座不设防的城市，坦诚而纯真的对待周围发生的事。也许我父亲看到了我的弱点，在他离开人世前，留给我”害人之心不可有，防人之心不可无”的字幅。
3c68e445121766193b7a96a9cdef21e9210090f5.translatedText: Phoenix City Cui Zengqi I walked into the place where I lived. It was a "dam". Yunnan people usually call a flat piece of high land Bazi, which was the living base of the employees of the Mingliang Coal Mine of the former Resources Commission. I stood on this piece of land made of red soil and stones, and the past came to my mind. The hard but happy childhood life was vividly in my mind. They were stories that I will never forget. In my memory, there are two long rows of bungalows built with taxis, inhabited by employees who moved from the mainland. At the west end of the house there is a cooperative selling daily necessities and a sewing club. There is a castle-like gate at the east end. There is a tiger stove for boiling water and a small hall in the middle. This is a residential area independent of the local residents. Now the original houses no longer exist, and only one family has built a new two-story house to live here. Where I live, I only see a stone wall built on the hillside behind. When I first saw the stones on the wall, I felt so familiar, as if I had just seen them yesterday. How can the human brain be so magical? How come the images of these rocks are still in my mind after seventy years? I have never deliberately memorized them like English words. That stone wall is where I loved making frozen tofu when I was little. Whenever it was the coldest time in winter and thin icicles hung on the eaves, I would put a piece of tofu in a bowl at night, add a little water, and hand a piece of frozen tofu to my mother the next morning. In this Bazi, I also learned how to light a stove. When I came home from school every day, the first thing I did was to take the stove at home and light a few coals at Laohuzao. After lighting the stove, I waited for my mother to come back to cook. In order to improve life, my father raised a sheep on the opposite hillside. Sometimes I would follow him to milk the goat. I once opened a piece of land on a hillside and learned to grow potatoes. Due to the natural degradation of organisms, the harvested potatoes became smaller and smaller every year. This pastoral life has cultivated my spirit of hard work and hard work, and the collective life in Bazi has given me the characteristic of loving contact with society since I was a child. Because I don’t have many children and many people are single, I have become a public son in the community. I am cared for and caressed by uncles and aunts wherever I go. People always smile at me, touch my head, hug me, or give me something to eat. I always smile back, bringing happiness and laughter to everyone. My parents are very kind to their friends. Several single men often come to our house as guests. My mother’s Jiangnan cuisine is particularly delicious. There is an uncle named Hu Bochen who almost always has dinner at our house. He is a close friend of my parents. After I started working, I received a lot of care from my parents’ old friends. This period of my childhood had an important influence on the formation of my character. I have always lived in a happy and peaceful environment, like an undefended city, and I am honest and innocent about what happens around me. Maybe my father saw my weakness. Before he passed away, he left me the words "You must not have the intention of harming others, and you must have the intention of guarding against others."

7b624a062d6002010ed1fe64d37cab56d4446a6d.sourceText: 七十年前小狗和我在家门口的像片 战争时期山沟里的文化生活十分缺乏。那时还没有电视，也看不到电影，更不用说看演出了。于是矿里的职工组织了京剧社，我爸爸妈妈都是京剧社的票友，我也自然成了小票友了，每天淸晨我们都来到一座山谷里吊嗓子，听着山谷里的回音在耳边迴荡。我们一家人还全家出塲演出了”桑园寄子”。这些年到了耆英会合唱团，人们说我的嗓音不错，中气很足，问我是否受过专业训练，我无以为答，只说是爹妈给的，其实这根底可能受益于那个年代的吊嗓子。我现在能够哼唱的不那么准确但还能勉强入调的”借东风”和”武家坡”也源自那个时期。 我还想起了一件难忘的故事。当我七岁的时矦曾在这里自己举办了一次隆重的婚礼。一天，大人们都去上班了，我和邻居家比我大一岁的陆丽文（就是我上期提到的请云南省侨办邦助寻找的儿时的朋友）决定举行婚礼。于是我把妈妈平时用的化妆粉盒和胭脂口红都拿出来擦在她的脸上，擦得满脸红彤彤的，把家里办公桌下边的空间当作洞房，俩人蹲在底下举行了婚礼。我妈妈下班回来看到后，气得把我狠狠地责骂了一顿。其实我妈心里也挺喜欢这位”媳妇”的，只是心疼我把他的化𥺁品都用光了，而且办得太早。当我后来读郭沫若自传时，看到他寪到他在十三岁时摸着他嫂子的柔软的手, 心中顿时有一股异样的感觉，似乎从那时起，他有了对异性的要求。而我这次婚姻竟然比郭老提前了六年，实在是荒唐！不过那只是一塲儿童𨔼戏，真正对异性的感觉还是到了郭老说的年龄才出现的。
7b624a062d6002010ed1fe64d37cab56d4446a6d.translatedText: Photo of the puppy and me in front of our home seventy years ago. During the war, cultural life in the ravines was very lacking. There was no television then, and you couldn't see movies, let alone see shows. So the workers in the mine organized a Peking Opera club. My parents were both fans of the Peking Opera club, and I naturally became a fan. Every morning we would go to a valley to sing our voices, listening to the echoes in the valley echoing in our ears. Our family even went out to perform "Sang Yuan Ji Zi". In the past few years, when I joined the choir of the Senior Citizens Association, people said that I had a good voice and a strong voice. They asked me if I had received professional training. I had no answer. I just said that it was given by my parents. In fact, this foundation may have benefited from the bad voice of that era. The "Borrowing the East Wind" and "Wujia Slope" that I can hum not quite accurately but still manage to be in tune are also from that period. I also remembered an unforgettable story. When I was seven years old, I held a grand wedding here. One day, when the adults all went to work, my neighbor Lu Liwen and I, who was one year older than me (the childhood friend I mentioned in the last issue and asked the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Yunnan Province to help find), decided to hold a wedding. So I took out the makeup powder box and rouge lipstick that my mother usually used and rubbed them on her face until her face turned red. I used the space under the desk at home as a wedding room, and the two of them squatted under it and held the wedding. When my mother came back from get off work and saw it, she was so angry that she scolded me severely. In fact, my mother really likes this "daughter-in-law", but she feels sorry that I used up all his cosmetics and did it too early. When I later read Guo Moruo's autobiography, I saw that he touched his sister-in-law's soft hand when he was thirteen years old, and I suddenly felt a strange feeling in my heart. It seemed that from that time on, he had a desire for the opposite sex. And my marriage was six years earlier than Mr. Guo’s. It’s really ridiculous! But it was just a children's play, and the real feelings towards the opposite sex didn't appear until the age Guo Lao said.

ff8bfd2214fbb22702533d6726b273a552d19a7a.sourceText: （秋香报道 清宝编辑） 现居亚利桑那州的旅美华裔作家唐孝先(William Tang)先生，最近收到美国笔会(PEN Center USA)2013年3月26日的书面通知，被正式接纳为美国笔会的专业会员。
ff8bfd2214fbb22702533d6726b273a552d19a7a.translatedText: (Reported by Qiuxiang, edited by Qingbao) Mr. William Tang, a Chinese-American writer currently living in Arizona, recently received a written notice from PEN Center USA on March 26, 2013, and was officially admitted as a professional member of PEN Center USA.

1dd72e1abdddb00b2a23d2757212a3dbbb138ded.sourceText: 唐孝先 唐孝先约有50篇非小说类作品，在美国正式报刊上发表，其中最著名的作品就是《海明威在古巴》中文版。他将美国著名作家、诺贝尔文学奖得主海明威的传记英文原版翻译成中文版。这本著作由海明威侄女希拉里 海明威和女摄影家卡伦娜 布伦南所著。书里图文并茂，介绍了海明威在古巴的生活和创作，还首次披露海明威与卡斯特罗的友谊。该书问世后，各国竞相翻译出版。《海明威在古巴》中文版，2008年由宁夏人民出版社出版，唐孝先就是两位译者之一。因为几十年的不懈创作，唐孝先获此殊荣。 美国笔会，与世界闻名的国际笔会(International PEN,，总部设在英国伦敦)有协作关係，它由美国全国的诗人、小说类/非小说类作家、散文作家、新闻记者、评论家、翻译家、剧作家、电影剧本作家、电视剧剧本作家、编辑等共600多人组成，总部设在加州贝佛里山庄(Beverly Hills, CA)。
1dd72e1abdddb00b2a23d2757212a3dbbb138ded.translatedText: > Tang Xiaoxian Tang Xiaoxian has about 50 non-fiction works published in official newspapers and periodicals in the United States. Among them, the most famous work is the Chinese version of "Hemingway in Cuba". He translated the original English biography of the famous American writer and Nobel Prize winner Hemingway into Chinese. This book was written by Hilary Hemingway, Hemingway's niece, and photographer Karena Brennan. The book is filled with pictures and texts, introducing Hemingway's life and creation in Cuba, and also reveals the friendship between Hemingway and Castro for the first time. After the book came out, various countries competed to translate and publish it. The Chinese version of "Hemingway in Cuba" was published by Ningxia People's Publishing House in 2008. Tang Xiaoxian is one of the two translators. Tang Xiaoxian won this honor because of his unremitting creation for decades. PEN America has a cooperative relationship with the world-famous International PEN (headquartered in London, England). It is composed of more than 600 poets, fiction/non-fiction writers, essay writers, journalists, critics, translators, playwrights, film script writers, TV drama script writers, editors, etc. from all over the United States. It is headquartered in Beverly Hills, CA.

f793f48b31752365bf1d4fc685c3eb18eb2dc9ff.sourceText: (本网讯)３月２３日亚省摄影协会在休闲世界举办了摄影爱好者聚会。摄影家丁允衍老师和协会创始人之一黄一帆老师给五十多位摄影爱好者带来难忘的”中日镜头之旅”。林园和黄一帆搭建了一个临时的摄影棚，让所有来宾有机会体验室内人物摄影。靓丽的女模特陈思，不仅专业地为摄像师们摆摄像姿势，更是发挥自己的特长介绍Photoshop在图片设计上的魔力。
f793f48b31752365bf1d4fc685c3eb18eb2dc9ff.translatedText: (News from this website) On March 23, the Alberta Photography Association held a gathering for photography enthusiasts at Leisure World. Photographer Ding Yunyan and Huang Yifan, one of the founders of the association, brought an unforgettable "Sino-Japanese Lens Journey" to more than 50 photography enthusiasts. Lin Yuan and Huang Yifan set up a temporary studio to give all guests the opportunity to experience indoor portrait photography. The beautiful female model Chen Si not only posed professionally for the photographers, but also used her own expertise to introduce the magic of Photoshop in picture design.

8c06f56e8a37c07497a40c282b0bdbc3db23e76b.sourceText: 活动现场 摄影家丁允衍以”印象中国”为题，把他在中国走过的山山水水，以及当地的风土人情都用相机记录下来。记者对风土人情比较感兴趣，所以照片”脸谱”留下了深刻的印象。照片中有各种各样的脸谱，京剧中的黑脸，白脸的，色彩丰富，活灵活现。照片”脸谱”的妙处就在买脸谱小女孩的脸和其他脸谱混在一起。相同的都是脸，不同的是有些永远不变，有些却瞬间即变；有的是真的，有的是假的。一张照片可以联想到很多。像这样的经典瞬间举不胜举，例如两个穿着少数民族服饰的女孩在雨中奔跑，拍婚纱照的新娘不轻易间的回眸一笑，少数民族文字写的麦当劳的招牌，张张叫绝。他们真实地再现了现代中国的自然风景和人文风景。
8c06f56e8a37c07497a40c282b0bdbc3db23e76b.translatedText: At the event, photographer Ding Yunyan used his camera to record the mountains and rivers he traveled through in China, as well as the local customs and customs, with the theme of "Impression of China". The reporter is more interested in the local customs, so the "face" of the photo left a deep impression. There are various types of facial makeup in the photos, including black faces and white faces in Peking Opera, which are rich in color and vivid. The wonderful thing about the "Face Makeup" photo is that the face of the little girl who bought the Facebook Makeup is mixed in with the other faces. They are all faces that are the same, but the difference is that some never change and some change instantly; some are real and some are fake. A photo can be associated with a lot. There are countless classic moments like this, such as two girls wearing ethnic minority costumes running in the rain, the bride taking wedding photos looking back and smiling, and the McDonald's sign written in ethnic minority characters, which is amazing. They truly reproduce the natural and cultural scenery of modern China.

4255d7a706bf375fe006a02bc2e90333870f8018.sourceText: 黄一帆介绍花铺的照片 黄一帆的日本之行最经典地体现在他带来的一张照片上。就一个镜头把一个长长的花铺呈现出来，当把照片打印出来，来宾就能清楚地看到每一个位置，因光的不同，花的色彩的渐变关系，效果非常的微妙。
4255d7a706bf375fe006a02bc2e90333870f8018.translatedText: >Huang Yifan introduced the photo of the flower shop. Huang Yifan's trip to Japan is most classicly reflected in a photo he brought. Just one shot shows a long flower shop. When the photo is printed, the guests can clearly see every position. Due to the difference in light and the gradient of the color of the flowers, the effect is very subtle.

3ad54c2c98cc96d3058fd4eb1378ad024aae97f2.sourceText: 摄影示范与现场操作 参与性最强的活动摄影示范与现场操作是来宾的最爱。两盏灯，一个薄沙就搭建出个简易的室内摄影棚。模特陈思在灯光下按摄影师的要求摆姿势。喜欢摄影的朋友这下可欢了，找好位置拍下一张，然后马上跟身边的讨论，光线是否有问题，构图的位置怎样调整会更好。记者在平时的采访中就常常遇到拍照片光线过度的烦恼。 郑弘和謝健明两位老师 ，就给了个小妙招。因为拍摄条件的限制，在拍新闻事件时，常常使用外加的闪光灯，他们建议，不要将外加闪光灯的光线直接打到拍摄对象上，这样主体上的光线就过了，应该调整闪光灯的角度，让闪光灯的光线打到某一个物体上，例如墙，柱子，屋顶，然后反射到拍摄主体上，这样光线柔和很多，效果非常好。他们当场演示，让记者一看就明白了。 在凤凰城参与的聚会很多，大多都是吃饭，看节目，但是像这样又能享受美食，又能参与活动，共同分享兴趣爱好的聚会的确不多，很期待参加到摄影协会的下次活动中。
3ad54c2c98cc96d3058fd4eb1378ad024aae97f2.translatedText: Photography demonstration and on-site operation The most participatory event, photography demonstration and on-site operation is the favorite of the guests. Just two lights and a piece of sand can create a simple indoor photo studio. Model Chen Si poses according to the photographer's request under the lights. Friends who like photography will rejoice now. Find a good position to take a picture, and then immediately discuss with those around you whether there is a problem with the lighting and how to adjust the position of the composition to be better. Journalists often encounter the problem of excessive lighting when taking photos during daily interviews. Two teachers, Zheng Hong and Xie Jianming, gave a little trick. Due to the limitations of shooting conditions, when shooting news events, an external flash is often used. They suggest that the light of the external flash should not be directed to the subject, so that the light on the subject will pass through. The angle of the flash should be adjusted so that the light of the flash hits an object, such as a wall, pillar, or roof, and then is reflected to the subject. This way the light is much softer and the effect is very good. They demonstrated it on the spot so that reporters could understand it at a glance. There are many gatherings in Phoenix, mostly for eating and watching shows, but there are not many gatherings like this where you can enjoy delicious food, participate in activities, and share interests and hobbies. I am looking forward to participating in the next event of the Photography Association.

b2c9ff2dec9e403c6fe9a33e24a9103f15373797.sourceText: 坦佩警方确认一名致命枪击犯 （亚省时报） 坦佩警方已确定两名男子中一名的身份。他们说家庭破裂上周在撞毁一辆私家车之间，枪杀一个居民后，步行逃离。 何塞?#22467;尔南德斯，41岁，涉嫌谋杀52岁的查尔斯?#32599;塞利，地点在罗塞利位于坦佩东赫莫萨200号的公寓，该男子已经被逮捕，根据警长，杰夫?#26684;洛弗，坦佩警察署发言人的消息。 他说，侦探也与调查组联络，他目前面临与本案无关的控诉。”此人尚未被指控在这次关于凶杀案的调查，但在这段时间的调查资料基础上，侦探目前没有寻找其他的犯罪嫌疑人，”格洛弗在星期二时说。 事件始于5月8日下午11:30左右，他说，当埃尔南德斯和另一名男子踢开罗塞利的公寓，大声吵闹，最后开枪射击52岁的罗塞利。警方相信事件可能有药物有关儿引发。 格洛弗说，然后两人迅速扬长而去在赫莫萨东部上了一个白色的客运车辆，逃跑时，前失去对汽车的控制，在磨房大道直闯红灯。 犯罪嫌疑人，向东逃离，然后进入一个居民区，试图闯进几个房子。其中一人闯进第二个房子，格洛弗说，他获得第二个受害人的车钥匙。警方说，他们开着另一辆汽车逃离，但是撞到挡土墙后不久坠毁。”这是像右出一部电影，”格洛弗上周告诉共和报。 警方抓获埃尔南德斯后，他人受伤，被送往医院。据说在他身上搜出一支手枪。 罗塞利被送往医院，在上周五伤害致死。警方说，周一埃尔南德斯出院，面临多项指控，包括一级谋杀。
b2c9ff2dec9e403c6fe9a33e24a9103f15373797.translatedText: >Tempe police identify fatal shooter (Alberta Times) Tempe police have identified one of two men. They say the family broke up last week after crashing into a private car and shooting a resident before fleeing on foot. Jose Hernandez, 41, has been arrested on suspicion of murdering Charles Celli, 52, at Rosselli's apartment in the 200 block of East Hermosa in Tempe, according to Sheriff Jeff Lover, a spokesman for the Tempe Police Department. He said detectives have also been in contact with the investigation team and he is currently facing charges unrelated to this case. "This individual has not been charged in connection with this homicide investigation, but based on the information available during this period, detectives are not currently looking for additional suspects," Glover said Tuesday. The incident began around 11:30 p.m. on May 8, he said, when Hernandez and another man kicked their way out of Rosselli's apartment, made a lot of noise and eventually shot the 52-year-old Rosselli. Police believe the incident may have been drug-related. The two then sped away and got into a white passenger vehicle east of Hermosa, Glover said. As they fled, they lost control of the car and ran a red light on Mill Avenue. The suspect, who fled eastbound, then entered a residential area and attempted to break into several houses. One of the men broke into the second house, Glover said, and obtained the second victim's car keys. They fled in another car but crashed shortly after hitting a retaining wall, police said. "It's like right out of a movie," Glover told The Republic last week. After police captured Hernandez, others were injured and taken to the hospital. A pistol was said to have been found on him. Roselli was taken to hospital, where he died from injuries last Friday. Hernandez was released from the hospital on Monday and faces multiple charges, including first-degree murder, police said.

7da7d4a9810a36ea5d08358220b39b5ae3bceb25.sourceText: 杨绮薇：中国首座深水钻井平台将于9日在南海开钻 （亚省时报广州特约记者杨绮薇报道） 据中国海洋石油总公司称，5月9日，中国首座自主设计、建造的第六代深水半潜式钻井平台”海洋石油981”将在中国南海海域正式开钻。这将是中国石油公司首次独立进行深水油气勘探开发，标志着中国海洋石油工业的深水战略迈出了实质性的步伐。 据了解，此次开钻水域在中国南海水域距离香港东南320公里处，开钻井深1500米。 国际上一般将水深超过300米海域的油气资源定义为深水油气，1500米水深以上称为超深水。在丰富的海上油气资源中，深水、超深水的资源量占全部海洋资源量的30%至40%。近年来，在全球获得的重大勘探发现中，有50%来自海洋，主要是深水海域。深水海域已经成为国际上油气勘探开发的重要接替区域。 目前，中国海洋石油工业勘探开发的海上油田水深普遍小于300米，大于300米水深的油气勘探开发处于起步阶段。中国南海油气资源极为丰富，整个南海盆地群石油地质资源量约在230亿至300亿吨之间，天然气总地质资源量约为16万亿立方米，占中国油气总资源量的三分之一，其中70%蕴藏于153.7万平方公里的深海区域。
7da7d4a9810a36ea5d08358220b39b5ae3bceb25.translatedText: >Yang Qiwei: China's first deepwater drilling platform will start drilling in the South China Sea on the 9th (Reported by Yang Qiwei, Special Correspondent, Guangzhou, Alberta Times) According to China National Offshore Oil Corporation, on May 9, China's first independently designed and built sixth-generation deepwater semi-submersible drilling platform "Hai Yang Shiyou 981" will officially start drilling in the South China Sea. This will be the first time that a Chinese petroleum company independently conducts deepwater oil and gas exploration and development, marking a substantial step in the deepwater strategy of China's offshore oil industry. It is understood that the drilling waters this time are 320 kilometers southeast of Hong Kong in the waters of the South China Sea, and the drilling depth is 1,500 meters. Internationally, oil and gas resources in sea areas with a water depth of more than 300 meters are generally defined as deepwater oil and gas, and water depths above 1,500 meters are called ultra-deep water. Among the abundant offshore oil and gas resources, deep water and ultra-deep water resources account for 30% to 40% of all marine resources. In recent years, 50% of the major exploration discoveries made around the world have come from the ocean, mainly deep-water areas. Deepwater areas have become an important successor area for oil and gas exploration and development internationally. At present, the offshore oil fields explored and developed by China's offshore oil industry generally have water depths less than 300 meters, and oil and gas exploration and development with water depths greater than 300 meters are in their infancy. The South China Sea is extremely rich in oil and gas resources. The oil geological resources of the entire South China Sea basin group are about 23 billion to 30 billion tons. The total natural gas geological resources are about 16 trillion cubic meters, accounting for one-third of China's total oil and gas resources, 70% of which are contained in the deep sea area of ​​1.537 million square kilometers.

ee51441150634abfa89abccf8327d1ab26ed1ebf.sourceText: 洛杉矶古冬：丰美的怀石料理 日本是美丽的。 这美,不只来自庄严肃穆的名寺宝刹,不只来自整洁有序的街 巷市廛,也不只来自珠围翠绕、滴粉搓酥的东瀛美女。 美既必须出于自然,又要经过加工升华。 像赏花,盛开的荼薇虽然灿烂,却不如待放的冬梅含蓄清雅,满园的秋菊虽然缤纷,却不及折一枝插在瓶里鲜丽明艳。 泰戈尔说:「日本人从美中发现真理,又从真理中发现美。」我们何妨把话说明白一点:日本人善于将他们对大自然美好的追求贯穿在日常生活中,然后在日常 生活中再现大自然最美好的一面。 而这,也正是日本最美的一面了。 日本人生活的重心是什么呢?和我们一样,是吃。 于是自然而然地,餐桌成了他 们的画布,餐具成了他们的画笔,而美食也就成了他们抒发才情最广阔的园地了。 不同的是,中国是大国,沃野千里,气势磅礡,而日本是小国,只宜淡雅清简,精 琢细磨。 有幸是我们在饱餐丰腴充足的美食之余,也十分享受日本人的细腻与精巧。 不过话说回来,要我们来奉献一份完美的中国餐,倒是一项浩大的工程,比方说,如果没有足够的豪客,何来满汉盛筵!相反,只要有一个人进来,日本厨师也能 尽施所长。 分量少、数量多是日本餐的特色,在频密的更盏换酌过程中,厨师们的绝活也就一一展露了。 哪怕是一份最便宜的便当,都可能是一件精心的制作。 不过真正布置如画,能 给人留下无穷思索与回味空间的,还推怀石料理。 春花、秋月、夏雨、冬雪,一切能令人心情舒畅或激荡的大自然的美,尽收其中。 或者是一个幽远的淡淡的意境,或者是泼墨式淋漓尽致的铺叙, 俱能把你融进唯美的画境中,去接受一次美的薰陶。 下次到日本,请尽可能去伊豆半岛走一走,而在众多的温泉酒店之中,建议你 拣「吉春」。 一进门,那古老宽敞的大堂,就给你一份祥和安适的感觉。 人生几何,我们几乎每年冬天都去一趟,享受一下他们诚敬提供的来自大自然的美食,然后自己也投进大自然去,在弥漫的氤氲中,渡过一段恬美舒泰的时光。 每人一份的怀石料理,内容十分丰富,由头盘的先付(梅酒与开胃物),至尾台 的甘味(甜点),包括清酒、香茶、鱼生、渍物、煮物、炸物、烧物(有松阪牛肉、活鲍鱼、生龙虾和活带子等)共十三组数十样之多,分别 以不同的色彩,不同的造形,先后送到你面前来。 不妨先观赏一番再下箸,里面既见构图的功力, 又不乏调色的技巧,可谓五色、五味、五感俱全(日本料理的最高境界)。 因此以琳琅满目、美不胜收来形容,绝对不过分。 但近来发现,有些温泉酒店的水并非完全是活水,而是循环使用,不只不卫生,还可能有危险, 因而今年就没有再去「吉春」，而选了日本人认为最贵、最高级的皇族御用院宫别邸,即箱根的「强罗花坛」落脚,以为贵就一定好。 谁知除了环境较为雅洁一点之外,无论是美的感受,还是肚皮的实惠,都比「吉春」大为逊色。 原来最好的东西并非来自金钱，而是来自灵府, 也许只有淳朴勤恳的劳动者,才能领悟和体现大自然至美的意境。 其实也不一定非找温泉酒店不可, 不少有经验的怀石料理店,都可以为你提供一份丰美的饔飧。
ee51441150634abfa89abccf8327d1ab26ed1ebf.translatedText: Los Angeles Gudong: Rich Kaiseki Cuisine Japan is beautiful. This beauty comes not only from the solemn and famous temples and temples, not only from the neat and orderly streets and shops, but also not only from the Japanese beauties surrounded by green beads and dripping powder and baking cakes. Beauty must not only come from nature, but also must be processed and sublimated. It's like appreciating flowers. Although the roses in full bloom are brilliant, they are not as subtle and elegant as the winter plums waiting to bloom. Although the autumn chrysanthemums in the garden are colorful, they are not as bright and bright as breaking off a branch and putting it in a vase. Tagore said: "The Japanese discover truth in beauty, and beauty in truth." We might as well make it clearer: the Japanese are good at integrating their pursuit of the beauty of nature into their daily lives, and then reproducing the most beautiful aspects of nature in their daily lives. And this is the most beautiful side of Japan. What is the focus of Japanese life? Just like us, it is eating. So naturally, the dining table became their canvas, the tableware became their paintbrush, and food became the broadest place for them to express their talents. The difference is that China is a big country, with vast fertile fields and majestic momentum, while Japan is a small country and should only be elegant, simple and meticulous. Fortunately, we were able to enjoy the delicacy and sophistication of the Japanese people while feasting on the rich and abundant delicacies. But having said that, it is a huge project for us to present a perfect Chinese meal. For example, if there are not enough wealthy guests, there will be no Manchu-Han feast! On the contrary, as long as one person comes in, the Japanese chef can also do his best. Small portions and large quantities are the characteristics of Japanese food. In the process of frequent changing of dishes, the unique skills of the chefs are revealed one by one. Even the cheapest bento may be carefully crafted. But for a truly picturesque setting that leaves endless space for reflection and reflection, the Kaiseki cuisine is recommended. Spring flowers, autumn moon, summer rain, winter snow, all the beauty of nature that can make people feel comfortable or excited, are all included. Either a distant and light artistic conception, or a vivid and vivid narrative in the style of splashing ink, both can integrate you into the beautiful painting environment and accept the influence of beauty. Next time you go to Japan, please try your best to visit the Izu Peninsula. Among the many hot spring hotels, I recommend you choose "Yoshiharu". As soon as you enter the door, the ancient and spacious lobby will give you a peaceful and comfortable feeling. Throughout our lives, we have gone there almost every winter to enjoy the delicacies they sincerely provide from nature, and then plunge into nature ourselves, spending a peaceful and comfortable time in the diffuse mist. The Kaiseki cuisine for each person is very rich in content, from the starter (plum wine and appetizers) to the sweets (dessert) at the end, including sake, fragrant tea, sashimi, pickled food, boiled food, fried food, grilled food (including Matsusaka beef, live abalone, raw lobster, live scallops, etc.), a total of thirteen groups and dozens of items, each with different colors and different shapes, are delivered to you one after another. You might as well look at it first before eating it. You can see not only the skill of composition, but also the skill of color mixing. It can be said that the five colors, five flavors and five senses are all present (the highest state of Japanese cuisine). Therefore, it is definitely not an exaggeration to describe it as dazzling and beautiful. However, I recently discovered that the water in some hot spring hotels is not completely live water, but recycled water, which is not only unhygienic but may also be dangerous. Therefore, I did not go to "Yoshiharu" this year. Instead, I chose the "Gora Hanedan" in Hakone, which is considered the most expensive and high-end imperial palace villa in Japan, to stay, thinking that it is expensive and must be good. Unexpectedly, in addition to the more elegant and clean environment, both the feeling of beauty and the benefits of belly are far inferior to "Jichun". It turns out that the best things do not come from money, but from the soul. Perhaps only simple and diligent workers can understand and embody the most beautiful artistic conception of nature. In fact, you don’t have to find a hot spring hotel. Many experienced kaiseki restaurants can provide you with a delicious meal.

395c993be76f62a89be26e0c6f4e94fe9809ac5d.sourceText: 根据凤凰城警察署的消息，上星期天的晚上，在鳳凰城一個民居內，警察驱散了一個斗狗圈子，并拘捕九名觀看者。 凤凰军士特伦特克伦普说接到一個電話報警，說有鬥狗活動在進行，约晚上8:30警察來到現場，西南希里路約1800號。在进入屋子之前，警察说，他们可以听到从屋內傳來斗狗和欢呼声。當警察破門而入時，观众与两名受伤的狗四處逃串。 克伦普说，狗後來没有找到。 警方闻到了来自家的强烈的大麻气味，并获得搜查令后，克伦普说，他们发现了毒品，武器，金钱和被盗车輛。九人被逮捕，被控的罪行待定，调查正在进行中。
395c993be76f62a89be26e0c6f4e94fe9809ac5d.translatedText: According to the Phoenix Police Department, last Sunday night, the police broke up a dog fighting ring in a residence in Phoenix and arrested nine viewers. Phoenix Sgt. Trent Crump said police responded to the scene, about 1800 Southwest Cherry Road, about 8:30 p.m. after receiving a call about a dog fight in progress. Before entering the home, police said they could hear dog fighting and cheering coming from inside. As police broke down the door, spectators fled with two injured dogs. The dog was never found, Crump said. Police smelled a strong odor of marijuana coming from the home and after obtaining a search warrant, Crump said they found drugs, weapons, money and stolen vehicles. Nine people have been arrested, with charges pending and investigations ongoing.

9d3f9c0e17f13f3f20377711486346d121d1950e.sourceText: 美华裔看好钱途转战沙漠投资房产 美国南加州地区的房地产市场开始回暖，华裔聚居地区的房价领涨周边地区，投资起来成本很高。因此，不少手中有现金的华裔人士，已经将眼光盯准了距离圣盖博谷80英里左右的周边地区，甚至有人投向往东的沙漠地区。 根据最新的统计数字，南加州的房地产中间价格在4月份上升了3.6%，是自2010年以来的最大单月涨幅，目前的中间价为29万。分析人士表示，这次的价格上涨，主要是由于法拍屋的销售降低造成的。同时，从成交量来看，4月份成交量19284栋房屋，比3月份上涨5.1%。一些经纪人表示，越来越多的人在看房屋，一些条件好的地区，甚至已经出现了抢房的趋势。 加州房地产协会表示，近几周的房屋库存降低，待售屋仅相当于4个月的销售量。而通常来说，待售屋足够供应6到7个月，市场才算正常。 但是，从2010年以来，华裔聚居地区的房价领涨周边地区，让不少华裔的投资人士，将眼光投向了往东的沙漠地区。在BEAUMONT 地区购买了9套投资房的林静(化名)告诉记者，这个地区在60号高速公路与10号高速公路连接的地区，离华裔社区大约70英里。由于房价便宜，越来越多的人聚居在这里。但是，受到不景气的影响，房屋的价格已经降了很多，很多房屋低于100元一平方英尺。因此，是投资的好机会。 在一个朋友的帮助下，林静从2011年开始购进这个地区的房屋。她发现，房屋十分容易出租，1500平方英尺左右的房屋，租金在1200左右，投资回收期大约在6年左右。在她的带动下，她亲近的朋友，已经在BEAUMONT 地区购买了超过40套独立房屋及康斗。 林静告诉记者，现在他们一群投资者，轮流开车到这些沙漠地区去看房子，因为有”钱途”，大家也乐此不疲，美女们也丝毫不怕沙漠的太阳。 上周末到拉斯维加斯买房子的朋友，大叫辛苦，因为来回要9个小时。而BEAUMONT 地区，2小时就可以打来回，附近还有奥特来斯(OUTLETS)，可以满足购物的需求。 在钻石岗一带从事地产经纪8年的张先生告诉记者，从东区到BEAUMONT 地区的距离，与到圣盖博谷是一样的。但是，价格便宜到你不够付建筑成本的。因此，他的许多客人都长期关注往东地带的房屋。
9d3f9c0e17f13f3f20377711486346d121d1950e.translatedText: Chinese Americans are optimistic about the future of money and are investing in real estate in the desert. Therefore, many Chinese people with cash in hand have set their sights on the surrounding areas about 80 miles away from the San Gabriel Valley, and some have even invested in the desert areas to the east. According to the latest statistics, Southern California's median real estate price rose 3.6% in April, the largest monthly increase since 2010, and the median price currently stands at $290,000. Analysts said the price increase this time was mainly due to lower sales of foreclosed homes. At the same time, in terms of transaction volume, 19,284 houses were sold in April, an increase of 5.1% from March. Some agents said that more and more people are looking at houses, and in some areas with good conditions, there has even been a trend of grabbing houses. The California Real Estate Association said housing inventory has declined in recent weeks, with just four months' worth of homes for sale. Generally speaking, when there is enough housing for sale for 6 to 7 months, the market is considered normal. However, since 2010, housing prices in areas inhabited by Chinese Americans have led the rise in surrounding areas, causing many Chinese investors to turn their attention to the desert areas to the east. Lin Jing (pseudonym), who bought nine investment houses in the BEAUMONT area, told reporters that this area is located in the area connected by Highway 60 and Highway 10, about 70 miles away from the Chinese community. Because housing prices are cheap, more and more people are living here. However, affected by the recession, the price of houses has dropped a lot, and many houses are less than 100 yuan per square foot. Therefore, it is a good opportunity to invest. With the help of a friend, Lin Jing started buying houses in this area in 2011. She found that the house is very easy to rent. For a house of about 1,500 square feet, the rent is about 1,200, and the investment payback period is about 6 years. Under her leadership, her close friends have purchased more than 40 independent houses and condominiums in the BEAUMONT area. Lin Jing told reporters that now a group of investors take turns driving to these desert areas to view houses. Because they have a "money path", everyone enjoys it, and the beauties are not afraid of the desert sun at all. A friend who went to Las Vegas to buy a house last weekend said it was hard because it took 9 hours to go back and forth. In the BEAUMONT area, you can call back and forth in 2 hours, and there are OUTLETS nearby to meet your shopping needs. Mr. Zhang, who has been a real estate agent in the Diamond Heights area for 8 years, told reporters that the distance from the East District to the BEAUMONT area is the same as that to the San Gabriel Valley. However, the price is so cheap that you won’t be able to pay the construction cost. As a result, many of his clients have long-term interests in homes heading east.

82224d4c3e3c1eb3fd0b8937ea1e57f0fc62c640.sourceText: 和延倾师傅谈少林功夫 （一） 中国河南嵩山少林寺武僧教头释延倾师傅，12岁进入少林寺武术专修院习文练武，2009年受具足戒出家。他曾获”世界传统武术比赛”一等奖，”少林拳锦标赛”拳术，第一名，刀术，第三名，并于今年出访了德国，法国，奥地利，韩国，马来西亚，澳大利亚，等二十多个国家进行文化交流、表演和教学。现尊方丈（释永信）法旨在美国亚利桑那州做文化交流，传播少林功夫。 问：延倾师傅，少林武学在全世界范围内都甚有名气，但是我想知道您是如何理解少林武学的，从您个人的角度？ 延倾 ：少林功夫是在嵩山少林寺这一特定佛教文化环境中经历历史洗炼而积累形成的。少林功夫是以佛教信仰为基础，以历代少林寺僧人习武的传统为载体，通过武术的方式体现禅宗的智慧精髓。 问：一般观众从不同的渠道对少林功夫有一些个人的感受。像我就好奇：到底哪种拳，哪种门派才是正宗的少林武术呢？ 延倾：少 林功夫是一个立体的体系，不是一般意义上的某个”门派”或”拳种”。据少林寺流传下来的拳谱记载，历代传习的少林功夫套路有数百套之多，其中流传有序的拳械代表有数十种。 少林功夫以攻防格斗的人体动作为核心，以套路为基本单位。套路是由一组动作组合起来的，动作的设计和套路的组合，都是建立在中国医学对人体的认识之上?#23427;合乎人体运动的规律，动作和套路讲究动静结合，阴阳平衡，刚柔相济，神形兼备。 比如，核心原则之一的”六合”原则：手与足合，肘与膝合，肩与胯合，心与意合，意与气合，气与力合。这个我们可以在后面的漫谈中详细谈，但基本上它体现的是中国?#22825;人合一?#30340;思想认知。 （待续） 延倾师傅在 新东方艺术学校 设有多门青少年武术和成人养生功 -太极课堂。 有意者请电话询问： 602.490.8613
82224d4c3e3c1eb3fd0b8937ea1e57f0fc62c640.translatedText: Talking about Shaolin Kung Fu with Master Yan Qing (1) Master Shi Yanqing, the martial arts monk instructor of the Shaolin Temple in Songshan, Henan, China, entered the Shaolin Temple Martial Arts Academy to learn martial arts at the age of 12. In 2009, he received full ordination and became a monk. He has won the first prize in the "World Traditional Martial Arts Competition", the first prize in boxing and the third prize in swordsmanship in the "Shaolin Boxing Championship". This year he visited more than 20 countries including Germany, France, Austria, South Korea, Malaysia and Australia for cultural exchanges, performances and teaching. The current abbot (Shi Yongxin) aims to conduct cultural exchanges and spread Shaolin Kung Fu in Arizona, USA. Question: Master Yanqing, Shaolin Martial Arts is very famous all over the world, but I would like to know how you understand Shaolin Martial Arts from your personal perspective? Yanqing: Shaolin Kung Fu was accumulated and formed through historical refinement in the specific Buddhist cultural environment of Songshan Shaolin Temple. Shaolin Kung Fu is based on Buddhist beliefs and the tradition of martial arts practiced by Shaolin Temple monks in the past as its carrier. It embodies the essence of Zen wisdom through martial arts. Question: The general audience has some personal feelings about Shaolin Kung Fu from different channels. I am just curious: which boxing or sect is the authentic Shaolin martial arts? Yan Qing: Shaolin Kung Fu is a three-dimensional system, not a "sect" or "boxing type" in the general sense. According to the boxing records handed down from the Shaolin Temple, there are hundreds of sets of Shaolin Kung Fu routines passed down through the ages, among which there are dozens of representative boxing weapons that have been handed down in an orderly manner. Shaolin Kung Fu takes human body movements of offensive and defensive fighting as the core, and routines as the basic unit. Routines are composed of a set of movements. The design of the movements and the combination of the routines are based on Chinese medicine's understanding of the human body. They conform to the laws of human movement. The movements and routines emphasize the combination of movement and stillness, the balance of yin and yang, the balance of hardness and softness, and the balance of spirit and form. For example, one of the core principles is the "Liuhe" principle: hands and feet are combined, elbows and knees are combined, shoulders and hips are combined, heart and mind are combined, mind and Qi are combined, and Qi and force are combined. We can talk about this in detail later in the discussion, but basically it embodies the Chinese ideology and cognition of the unity of people. (To be continued) Master Yan Qing has a number of youth martial arts and adult health-preserving exercises - Tai Chi classes at New Oriental Art School. If interested, please call: 602.490.8613

b4526432b27b692c14c27f6edfb0cc0547c4a98d.sourceText: 编者按：国务院安全生产委员会办公室20日发出通知指出，19日发生在湖南的高速公路隧道爆炸事故和山东车辆追尾事故已造成30人死亡，国务院安委会已对两起事故的查处实行挂牌督办。
b4526432b27b692c14c27f6edfb0cc0547c4a98d.translatedText: Editor's note: The State Council Work Safety Commission issued a notice on the 20th stating that the highway tunnel explosion accident and the Shandong vehicle rear-end accident that occurred on the 19th had killed 30 people. The State Council Safety Committee has supervised the investigation and handling of the two accidents.

5a15f69f4dff08f32e75d28ddcb004c2b38b5295.sourceText: 根据通知，5月19日8时30分左右，湖南省株洲市炎陵县境内中铁三局集团第五工程有限公司承建的炎汝（炎陵至汝城）高速公路第十三合同段，一辆运送炸药和雷管的低速载货汽车，在八面山隧道内发生爆炸，造成20人死亡、2人受伤。 Mitbbs.com 5月19日0时15分，一辆个人所有的长安牌面包车（核载8人），载12名施工工人从山东省潍坊市青州市返回潍坊市区，在潍坊市潍城区宝通街拥军路路口西侧500米处，与山东山水水泥集团有限公司潍坊水泥厂的一辆无牌重型货车发生追尾事故，造成10人死亡、2人受伤。 Mitbbs.com 安委办要求，要严格落实企业安全生产主体责任，进一步加强施工现场安全管理。特别是对各种运输车辆、通勤班车等要制定专项管理办法，加强日常安全管理。严禁临时租用非营运的社会车辆（船舶等）用于运送工人、材料和民爆物品等生产经营活动的行为，杜绝人货混装等违规现象。
5a15f69f4dff08f32e75d28ddcb004c2b38b5295.translatedText: According to the notice, at about 8:30 on May 19, a low-speed truck transporting explosives and detonators exploded in the Bamianshan Tunnel on the 13th contract section of the Yanru (Yanling to Rucheng) Expressway constructed by China Railway Third Bureau Group Fifth Engineering Co., Ltd. in Yanling County, Zhuzhou City, Hunan Province, killing 20 people and injuring 2 people. Mitbbs.com At 0:15 on May 19, a personally owned Changan brand van (accommodating 8 people) carrying 12 construction workers from Qingzhou City, Weifang City, Shandong Province returned to Weifang City. It rear-ended an unlicensed heavy truck from the Weifang Cement Plant of Shandong Shanshui Cement Group Co., Ltd. 500 meters west of the intersection of Yongjun Road, Baotong Street, Weicheng District, Weifang City, killing 10 people and injuring 2 others. Mitbbs.com The Safety Committee Office requires that enterprises must strictly implement their main responsibilities for safety production and further strengthen construction site safety management. In particular, special management measures must be formulated for various transportation vehicles, commuter shuttles, etc. to strengthen daily safety management. It is strictly prohibited to temporarily rent non-operating social vehicles (ships, etc.) for transportation of workers, materials, civil explosives and other production and business activities, and to eliminate violations such as mixed loading of people and goods.

77f4d1586e640ad4ded43f935231435429ae13fa.sourceText: 通知还指出，各地要严厉打击机动车无牌无证营运行为。要严格执行7座以上客车?#36898;车必查?#21046;度，严查车况、驾驶人资质，了解掌握日常主要用途，对存在车况不良、驾驶人不具备资质非法营运的，要依法严肃处理并督促整改落实。此外，要严格事故查处，用事故教训推动安全生产工作。 Mitbbs.com 爆炸车炸药重量达288公斤 Mitbbs.com 据《北京晚报》报道，19日上午，在湖南省在建的炎汝（炎陵至汝城）高速公路炎陵县八面山隧道内，一辆载有炸药的车辆卸货时发生爆炸。据初步调查，该车载有288公斤炸药，目前已造成20人死亡2人受伤。 Mitbbs.com
77f4d1586e640ad4ded43f935231435429ae13fa.translatedText: The notice also pointed out that all localities must severely crack down on the operation of motor vehicles without license plates and licenses. It is necessary to strictly implement the inspection regulations for passenger cars with more than 7 seats, strictly check the condition of the vehicle and the qualification of the driver, and understand the main daily use. If the vehicle is in poor condition and the driver is not qualified to operate illegally, it must be seriously dealt with in accordance with the law and the rectification and implementation must be urged. In addition, it is necessary to strictly investigate and deal with accidents and use accident lessons to promote safe production. Mitbbs.com The explosive weight of the explosive vehicle reached 288 kilograms. Mitbbs.com According to the "Beijing Evening News" report, on the morning of the 19th, in the Bamianshan Tunnel of Yanling County, Yanling (Yanling to Rucheng) Expressway, which was under construction in Hunan Province, a vehicle carrying explosives exploded while unloading. According to preliminary investigation, the vehicle contained 288 kilograms of explosives and has killed 20 people and injured 2 others. Mitbbs.com

6f8789e337d62e2a09b0fd57dd9074ffd772c18b.sourceText: 事件通报 Mitbbs.com 车上装有12箱炸药 Mitbbs.com 据湖南官方对外通报，前日8时30分许，一辆载有炸药的车辆进入炎汝(炎陵至汝城)高速公路一在建隧道施工层面，在卸货时发生爆炸。 Mitbbs.com 昨日凌晨，记者抵达事故现场时，隧道口已经拉起警戒线。项目建设单位中铁三局新闻发言人董国斌在现场介绍，初步探明车上有12箱炸药，每箱24公斤。具体是何种炸药还不清楚，爆炸的具体位置和原因仍在调查中。 Mitbbs.com
6f8789e337d62e2a09b0fd57dd9074ffd772c18b.translatedText: Incident Report Mitbbs.com The vehicle contained 12 boxes of explosives Mitbbs.com According to Hunan official external notification, at about 8:30 the day before yesterday, a vehicle carrying explosives entered the construction level of a tunnel under construction on the Yanru (Yanling to Rucheng) Expressway and exploded while unloading. Mitbbs.com When reporters arrived at the accident scene early yesterday morning, a cordon had been put up at the entrance of the tunnel. Dong Guobin, spokesperson of the China Railway Third Bureau, the project construction unit, said at the scene that it was initially determined that there were 12 boxes of explosives on the vehicle, each box weighing 24 kilograms. The exact type of explosive was unclear, and the exact location and cause of the explosion are still under investigation. Mitbbs.com

4af21f9a0aac50ac28058073fdb184e1fc694cfe.sourceText: 凌晨发现遇难者遗体 Mitbbs.c
4af21f9a0aac50ac28058073fdb184e1fc694cfe.translatedText: The remains of the victims were found in the early morning. Mitbbs.c

9269acb7e46435f00b3b9e92e5de60750a3809d7.sourceText: 昨日凌晨1时，刚从隧道内部出来的救援者、炎陵县消防中队指导员杨军告诉记者，目前已发现1具遇难者遗体，确认为男性。此前，救援人员刚在隧道内部进行了6次生命探测，没有发现生命迹象。 Mitbbs.com 目前，灾难已经造成20人死亡、2人受伤。 Mitbbs.com
9269acb7e46435f00b3b9e92e5de60750a3809d7.translatedText: At 1 o'clock yesterday morning, Yang Jun, the rescuer who had just come out of the tunnel and the instructor of the Yanling County Fire Squadron, told reporters that the remains of one victim had been found and were confirmed to be male. Previously, rescuers had just conducted six life detections inside the tunnel and found no signs of life. Mitbbs.com At present, the disaster has caused 20 deaths and 2 injuries. Mitbbs.com

e07ea4acf2c4eac3046cb5a28535401ab259a62a.sourceText: 洞内漆黑空气质量差 Mitbbs.com
e07ea4acf2c4eac3046cb5a28535401ab259a62a.translatedText: It is dark inside the cave and the air quality is poor Mitbbs.com

ba0c89750399cf2b9c880a2c64a8b26f0ec57445.sourceText: 记者从湖南省炎陵消防中队获悉，前日炎陵消防中队接到当地公安局请求协助救援的电话，第一时间派出12名官兵乘坐1台救援车、1台水罐车前往现场救援，下午2点多到达爆炸现场后，小分队立即进入隧道展开搜救。 Mitbbs.com
ba0c89750399cf2b9c880a2c64a8b26f0ec57445.translatedText: The reporter learned from the Yanling Fire Squadron of Hunan Province that the day before yesterday, the Yanling Fire Squadron received a call from the local public security bureau requesting assistance in the rescue. They immediately dispatched 12 officers and soldiers on a rescue vehicle and a water tanker to the scene for rescue. After arriving at the explosion site at around 2 p.m., the team immediately entered the tunnel to carry out search and rescue operations. Mitbbs.com

2c9760e1979afb828f8afd8324f5c0dcb1f9b881.sourceText: 一名在现场参与救援的工作人员介绍，由于发生事故的隧道尚未贯通，事故现场一片漆黑，空气质量也很差，救援难度很大。 Mitbbs.com
2c9760e1979afb828f8afd8324f5c0dcb1f9b881.translatedText: A worker involved in the rescue at the scene said that because the tunnel where the accident occurred has not yet been connected, the accident site was dark and the air quality was very poor, making the rescue very difficult. Mitbbs.com

a699936a8dd4038fa9ad69fab918ca12b935408c.sourceText: 隧道口冒出蘑菇云 Mitbbs.com ”爆炸时声大如雷，隧道口冒出的烟雾就像蘑菇云！”云南民工刘关祥向记者描述隧道爆炸瞬间时，说”动静大得吓人”。 Mitbbs.com ”我当时正把钢架抬上车，也准备跟车进入隧道，还没来得及上车就听见轰隆隆的几声响。”回忆爆炸时的情景，刘关祥仍然显得心有余悸。他猛吸了几口烟后告诉记者，”爆炸声响了好几次，持续了好几分钟。””8点多刚要上班，我就听到了几声巨响，声响连续但偶有间隔，每次响声有2秒钟左右。”湖南民工胡谷安向记者说，爆炸一发生他们就想去救人，但”从隧道口冒出了大量的尘烟，有点像蘑菇云，呛得人直流眼泪，都无法进去。”
a699936a8dd4038fa9ad69fab918ca12b935408c.translatedText: A mushroom cloud emerged from the tunnel entrance Mitbbs.com "The explosion was as loud as thunder, and the smoke coming out of the tunnel entrance was like a mushroom cloud!" Liu Guanxiang, a migrant worker from Yunnan, described the moment of the tunnel explosion to reporters and said, "The noise was so loud that it was scary." Mitbbs.com "I was lifting the steel frame onto the car and preparing to follow the car into the tunnel. Before I could get on the car, I heard several rumbling sounds." Recalling the scene of the explosion, Liu Guanxiang still seemed to be frightened. After taking a few puffs of cigarette, he told reporters, "The explosion sounded several times and lasted for several minutes." "Just after 8 o'clock, I was about to go to work, and I heard several loud noises. The sounds were continuous but occasionally spaced, and each sound lasted about 2 seconds." Hu Gu'an, a migrant worker from Hunan, told reporters that they wanted to save people as soon as the explosion occurred, but "a large amount of dust and smoke came out of the tunnel entrance, a bit like a mushroom cloud, which made people cry and couldn't go in."

0535e3818c81154900dda1816c00c712f3f7e569.sourceText: 美国2/3地区成旱地 12年来最严重 亚省排第四
0535e3818c81154900dda1816c00c712f3f7e569.translatedText: Two-thirds of the United States has become dryland, the worst in the past 12 years, and Alberta ranks fourth

522c7ee2cbbda0d2596d066c19ac321d5f21c6da.sourceText: 美国2/3地区成旱地 12年来最严重 亚省排第四 （亚省时报） 联邦气候学家12日宣布，目前全美近三分之二…
522c7ee2cbbda0d2596d066c19ac321d5f21c6da.translatedText: Two-thirds of the United States has become dryland, the most serious in the past 12 years, and Alberta ranks fourth (Alberta Times) Federal climatologists announced on the 12th that nearly two-thirds of the United States...

ffd545c9b00021d9d0e0041d934a9824cf5ccd53.sourceText: 美国2/3地区成旱地 12年来最严重 亚省排第四 （亚省时报） 联邦气候学家12日宣布，目前全美近三分之二地区、约61％土地处于干旱状态，干旱比例为12年来最高。 美国干旱监测局表示，到目前为止，全美有12个州处于干旱或”异常干燥”（abnormally dry）状态；尽管全美已有许多州被列为异常干燥地区，但东北部地区仍未受到干旱影响。 除了遭受野火侵袭的西部地区早已光秃一片外，中西部地区的玉米田，更受到干旱的严重威胁；气象预测中心的气象学家称，中西部的18个主要的玉米种植州，有30％的作物生长状况很差或非常差。 印第安纳州首府印第安纳波利斯，目前处于104年以来持续最长的干旱期。该市市长已发布缺水警告，禁止草坪浇水，并限制其他非民生必需用水。 中西部地区在未来，想要解除旱况的机率也很渺茫。密西西比河附近及以西地区，预计下周的气温会飙升至摄氏38度左右，且空气湿度高，夜晚闷热，可能不会降雨或仅有小降雨量。 目前处于严重旱情的12个州分别为：内华达州、犹他州、科罗拉多州、亚利桑那州、新墨西哥州、阿肯色州、爱荷华州、伊利诺斯州、印第安纳州、俄亥俄州、肯塔基州和密苏里州。
ffd545c9b00021d9d0e0041d934a9824cf5ccd53.translatedText: Two-thirds of the United States has become dryland, the worst in 12 years, and Alberta ranks fourth (Alberta Times) Federal climatologists announced on the 12th that nearly two-thirds of the United States and about 61% of the land are currently in drought, with the drought rate being the highest in 12 years. The U.S. Drought Monitor said that so far, 12 states in the United States are in drought or "abnormally dry" conditions; although many states in the United States have been classified as abnormally dry areas, the Northeast has not been affected by drought. In addition to the western region that has been ravaged by wildfires, cornfields in the Midwest are also seriously threatened by drought. Meteorologists from the Weather Prediction Center said that 30% of the 18 major corn-growing states in the Midwest have poor or very poor crop growth conditions. Indianapolis, the capital of Indiana, is currently in the midst of its longest drought in 104 years. The city's mayor has issued a water shortage warning, prohibiting lawn watering and restricting other non-essential water use. In the future, the chances of the drought in the central and western regions being lifted are slim. In areas near and west of the Mississippi River, the temperature is expected to soar to around 38 degrees Celsius next week, with high air humidity and sultry nights. There may be no or only light rainfall. The 12 states currently in severe drought are: Nevada, Utah, Colorado, Arizona, New Mexico, Arkansas, Iowa, Illinois, Indiana, Ohio, Kentucky and Missouri.

b5e1e92f158cfdd5d8628ac5d2fb1b9a6d0e2980.translatedText: The 7th "Phoenix Night" will be officially held at ASU on September 22, 2013

01f8ba8834a109299edf544e80ad424848ee79d7.sourceText: 第七届“凤凰之夜”将于2013年9月22日在ASU正式举行 准备工作正在有条不紊…
01f8ba8834a109299edf544e80ad424848ee79d7.translatedText: The 7th "Phoenix Night" will be officially held at ASU on September 22, 2013. Preparations are in good order...

9a87ea77b24c5fc78483a00f53178d4f57373558.sourceText: 准备工作正在有条不紊地进行

34e467ae0c88cc4c97e0337a3d7bc14ddad27e94.sourceText: (亚省华联供稿) 第七届”凤凰之夜”庆祝中华人民共和国成立64周年国庆招待会暨中秋佳节将由亚省华人华侨联合会(亚省华联)和亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院共同主办，并由大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会、亚利桑那州立大学中国学生学者联谊会、亚省现代中文学校、亚省希望中文学校、以及《亚省时报》报社协办。同时，联合亚省其他华人华侨团体一道，共同庆祝中华人民共和国国庆和中秋传统佳节。庆典活动的准备工作正在有条不紊地进行。届时亚利桑那州侨学界将举办一系列相关庆祝活动，其中包括：中美文化论坛、国庆招待会、青少年摄影比赛和海报比赛及优秀作品展览、才艺表演和中秋联谊舞会。
34e467ae0c88cc4c97e0337a3d7bc14ddad27e94.translatedText: (Contributed by Hualian, Alberta) The 7th "Phoenix Night" celebration of the 64th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China National Day reception and Mid-Autumn Festival will be co-sponsored by the Chinese Overseas Chinese Federation of Alberta (Alberta Overseas Chinese Federation) and the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, and co-organized by the Chinese Federation of Greater Phoenix, the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of Arizona State University, the Alberta Modern Chinese School, the Alberta Hope Chinese School, and the "Alberta Times" newspaper. At the same time, we will join other overseas Chinese groups in Alberta to celebrate the National Day of the People's Republic of China and the traditional Mid-Autumn Festival. Preparations for the celebration are in progress. At that time, the overseas Chinese community in Arizona will hold a series of related celebration activities, including: Sino-US Cultural Forum, National Day Reception, Youth Photography Competition and Poster Competition, Excellent Works Exhibition, Talent Show and Mid-Autumn Festival Dance.

f24e2173825880751a30dfbdbb6a6b38d36a7780.sourceText: 第五届中美文化论坛”中美合作面面观”将于9月22日下午3点至5点在亚利桑那州立大学MU 220会议厅隆重举行。这是亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院和亚省华联连续第五年联手举行此类大型活动。多年的合作和努力，特别是亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院的辛勤工作，使中美文化论坛成为了当地庆中秋迎国庆系列活动的一个品牌。我们仅借媒体一角，向亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院、亚省其他华人华侨团体和个人连续多年对亚省华联开展社区活动给予的大力支持表示诚挚的谢意！
f24e2173825880751a30dfbdbb6a6b38d36a7780.translatedText: The fifth Sino-US Cultural Forum "Aspects of Sino-US Cooperation" will be held grandly in the MU 220 Conference Hall of Arizona State University from 3 to 5 pm on September 22. This is the fifth consecutive year that the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University and the Hualian Association of Alberta have jointly held such a large-scale event. Years of cooperation and efforts, especially the hard work of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, have made the Sino-US Cultural Forum a brand in the local series of activities to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival and the National Day. We would like to use the media to express our sincere gratitude to the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, other overseas Chinese groups and individuals in the province for their strong support to the community activities carried out by the Hualien Association of Alberta for many years!

bc21ae10660f144210cd93e52d4fa89f30aa5049.sourceText: 中华人民共和国驻洛杉矶总领事馆官员将为中美文化论坛的开幕式致辞。随后，亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院院长司马德琳教授将向来宾们介绍各位主讲嘉宾。应邀出席本次论坛的主讲嘉宾有来自 Intel Corporation 的 Steven Tu，Chief Architect of Mobile Product Line，有 Congressman Matt Salmon，United States Representative, 5th District of Arizona，还有来自 Honeywell International, Inc. 的 Briand Greer，President。
bc21ae10660f144210cd93e52d4fa89f30aa5049.translatedText: Officials from the Consulate General of the People's Republic of China in Los Angeles will deliver a speech at the opening ceremony of the China-US Cultural Forum. Afterwards, Professor Smadelin, Director of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, will introduce the guest speakers to the guests. The keynote speakers invited to attend this forum include Steven Tu from Intel Corporation, Chief Architect of Mobile Product Line, Congressman Matt Salmon, United States Representative, 5th District of Arizona, and Briand Greer from Honeywell International, Inc., President.

37266692a1a695eb3c356e79a030f931dc2586bc.sourceText: 之后，国庆招待会将于当日下午5点至7点在亚利桑那州立大学 MU Arizona Ballroom 大厅正式举行。中华人民共和国驻洛杉矶总领事馆官员，亚利桑那州政府代表，地方政要，及各界华人华侨社团组织的代表将出席招待会，与亚利桑那州的民众共渡佳节。在招待会上，亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院还将为亚利桑那州青少年海报比赛及摄影比赛的获奖选手举行隆重的颁奖典礼。获奖选手的作品将被放在国庆招待会大厅上向来宾展示。随后，才艺表演和中秋联谊舞会将于7点至9点在同一大厅举行。
37266692a1a695eb3c356e79a030f931dc2586bc.translatedText: After that, the National Day reception will be officially held in the MU Arizona Ballroom of Arizona State University from 5 to 7 pm that day. Officials from the Consulate General of the People's Republic of China in Los Angeles, representatives of the Arizona government, local dignitaries, and representatives of overseas Chinese organizations from all walks of life will attend the reception to celebrate the holiday with the people of Arizona. At the reception, the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University will also hold a grand award ceremony for the winners of the Arizona Youth Poster Contest and Photography Contest. The works of the winning contestants will be displayed to the guests in the National Day reception hall. Subsequently, the talent show and Mid-Autumn Festival Dance will be held in the same hall from 7 to 9 o'clock.

13c68e024c500575b250e9d9be25d6e4cb5c5f4e.sourceText: 以上所有的活动将对公众免费开放。在此，我们诚邀各界华人华侨朋友踊跃参加！最新消息和详情请浏览亚省华联网站： www.chineseaz.org.
13c68e024c500575b250e9d9be25d6e4cb5c5f4e.translatedText: All the above activities will be free and open to the public. Here, we sincerely invite Chinese and overseas Chinese friends from all walks of life to actively participate! For the latest news and details, please visit the Alberta Hualien website: www.chineseaz.org.

646c5e73dc9f177858bce20cc11e903a31f6f9a9.sourceText: 英特尔还设计出了一款采用其芯片、类似iPhone的Android设备原型机。
646c5e73dc9f177858bce20cc11e903a31f6f9a9.translatedText: Intel also designed a prototype iPhone-like Android device using its chips.

da6758ddb2dcec981d6fead8888c728637e7bd64.sourceText: 英特尔计划利用下月开幕的国际消费电子展(CES)宣布正式进军智能机芯片市场，并将在展会上详细阐述其智能机芯片计划。
da6758ddb2dcec981d6fead8888c728637e7bd64.translatedText: Intel plans to use the International Consumer Electronics Show (CES), which opens next month, to announce its official entry into the smartphone chip market, and will elaborate on its smartphone chip plans at the show.

c9c130965b23473c88026423cf493a6e4c0283ba.sourceText: 英特尔还设计出了一款采用其芯片、类似iPhone的Android设备原型机，该手机并不只是一款概念机，英特尔还计划将该手机的设计全部或部分免费授权给手机制造商。
c9c130965b23473c88026423cf493a6e4c0283ba.translatedText: Intel has also designed a prototype of an iPhone-like Android device using its chip. The phone is not just a concept phone. Intel also plans to license all or part of the phone's design to mobile phone manufacturers for free.

96c2f0f0f9f1b6ddf24287f276d913f835230a70.sourceText: ”明年上半年，你将看到众多使用该手机内核的英特尔客户产品投放到市场中，”英特尔CEO保罗?#27431;德宁(Paul Otellini)在上月的瑞士信贷投资者大会上表示，”我们还有更多计划将在CES上宣布。”
96c2f0f0f9f1b6ddf24287f276d913f835230a70.translatedText: "In the first half of next year, you will see many Intel customer products using this mobile phone core released to the market," Intel CEO Paul? #27431; Otellini said at the Credit Suisse investor conference last month, "We have more plans to announce at CES."

09f3cae28775919dbcc53d9e1cc66043b7ac09f9.sourceText: 欧德宁将在1月10日拉斯维加斯开幕的CES展会上进行主题演讲，所以他届时有可能利用该机会宣布新内容。CES开幕前一天，英特尔还将举行一场有关笔记本领域的新闻发布会。
09f3cae28775919dbcc53d9e1cc66043b7ac09f9.translatedText: Otellini will give a keynote speech at the CES show that opens in Las Vegas on January 10, so he may use the opportunity to announce new content. The day before CES opens, Intel will also hold a press conference on the notebook field.

1ac2d8af0eadd4de2e52083a15609f0be8d6dde1.sourceText: 科技网站Technology Review此前报道称，英特尔正在为智能机芯片市场而努力，并引用英特尔的话称，使用其芯片的智能机将在明年上半年上市。
1ac2d8af0eadd4de2e52083a15609f0be8d6dde1.translatedText: Technology website Technology Review previously reported that Intel is working hard for the smartphone chip market, and quoted Intel as saying that smartphones using its chips will be available in the first half of next year.

952a060c576797b6f7c4a7ab87450199b859e0fc.sourceText: 不过欧德宁暗示，他们的产品将会更早上市。他说：”我们将在明年一季度开始出货。”
952a060c576797b6f7c4a7ab87450199b859e0fc.translatedText: However, Otellini hinted that their products will be launched earlier. He said: "We will start shipping in the first quarter of next year."

8c1f75884c0cd228bcb7bd4e5cb5707decb4cc42.sourceText: 英特尔此前曾经在多个场合谈及其手机芯片计划，特别是针对Android手机。在9月份的英特尔开发者大会上，欧德宁邀请了谷歌Android主管安迪?#40065;宾(Andy Rubin)上台演讲，阐述了怎样借助谷歌的努力将英特尔的芯片打造成未来Android手机中的一流产品。
8c1f75884c0cd228bcb7bd4e5cb5707decb4cc42.translatedText: > Intel has previously talked about its mobile phone chip plans on many occasions, especially for Android phones. At the Intel Developer Conference in September, Otellini invited Google Android director Andy Rubin to give a speech on how to use Google's efforts to build Intel's chips into first-class products in future Android phones.

dfaab7eba4a6cc15fd1d161eb3ea95f35259dceb.sourceText: 不过英特尔进军手机芯片市场还需要面临诸多对手的竞争，这其中就包括现在业界的领导厂商–高通、德州仪器和Nvidia。博通也表示他们正在计划进军手机市场，特别是低端领域，该领域现在由联发科统治。
dfaab7eba4a6cc15fd1d161eb3ea95f35259dceb.translatedText: However, Intel still needs to face competition from many rivals when entering the mobile phone chip market, including the current industry leaders – Qualcomm, Texas Instruments and Nvidia. Broadcom has also stated that they are planning to enter the mobile phone market, especially the low-end segment, which is currently dominated by MediaTek.

5a03665a31daf6794d517899c04db3d71e952fc5.sourceText: 尽管意识到了竞争性，但英特尔称他们的测试显示，其手机参考设计不但在性能上具有可靠的竞争性，在极为重要的电池续航上也充满竞争力，很多人担忧英特尔芯片在电池续航指标上无法抗衡ARM架构处理器。
5a03665a31daf6794d517899c04db3d71e952fc5.translatedText: Although aware of competition, Intel said their tests showed that its mobile phone reference design is not only reliably competitive in performance, but also competitive in the all-important battery life. Many people are worried that Intel chips cannot compete with ARM architecture processors in terms of battery life indicators.

aa6c864fe5230b97b4c19aa1ca515ae617ab38d1.sourceText: 英特尔的移动芯片计划不单针对智能机市场，该芯片巨头已经感受到来自ARM和苹果在平板电脑领域的强力竞争。即便是配合Windows 8操作系统，英特尔也将面临PC领域的挑战。
aa6c864fe5230b97b4c19aa1ca515ae617ab38d1.translatedText: Intel's mobile chip plan is not only aimed at the smartphone market. The chip giant has already felt strong competition from ARM and Apple in the tablet computer field. Even with the Windows 8 operating system, Intel will face challenges in the PC field.

fef0779443e24e5bc76813c768458daa2ebe6206.sourceText: 科技改变世界，此言不假。科技不但改变我们的生活方式，还在潜移默化着改变着人与人之间的交接方式。3D打印机正在改变着制造业模式，并释放创新力。层出不穷的手机应用程序也正在改变着人们的消费习惯，而纳滤技术已经在悄然地改变着人们喝水的方式。而时下最热门的谷歌眼镜则将真正让互联网渗透到人们的生活中来。近日，Business Insider为我们盘点了15个注定要改变社会未来的新科技:
fef0779443e24e5bc76813c768458daa2ebe6206.translatedText: It is true that technology is changing the world. Technology not only changes our lifestyle, but also subtly changes the way people interact with each other. 3D printers are changing the manufacturing model and unleashing innovation. The endless emergence of mobile phone applications is also changing people's consumption habits, and nanofiltration technology has quietly changed the way people drink water. The most popular Google Glass nowadays will truly allow the Internet to penetrate into people's lives. Recently, Business Insider took stock of 15 new technologies that are destined to change the future of society:

8e79577fe252d868d491a31a75dcc6fd48b1f4be.sourceText: 谷歌眼镜将使得我们成为半机械人。谷歌眼镜是当下最令人兴奋的产品之一，原因正是其应用潜力巨大。它将使得我们能够更深层地感受日常活动，提升我们与周围 环境的交互。我们与互联网的连接性将达到前所未有的程度，我们将能够用谷歌眼镜浏览各种有用信息，如短信、新闻评论、推文和导航信息。有了谷歌眼镜，我们 还能够记录周围的点点滴滴，并将记录的东西存储在云端，从而可以保证自己不会遗忘生活中的珍贵时光。
8e79577fe252d868d491a31a75dcc6fd48b1f4be.translatedText: Google Glasses will make us cyborgs. Google Glass is one of the most exciting products right now because of its huge potential. It will allow us to experience daily activities on a deeper level and enhance our interaction with our surroundings. We will be more connected to the Internet than ever before, and we will be able to use Google Glass to browse all kinds of useful information, such as text messages, news comments, tweets and navigation information. With Google Glass, we can also record everything around us and store the recorded things in the cloud, thus ensuring that we will not forget the precious moments in life.

b2feda38406d9ef0d7ca304767b3c6219e470e83.sourceText: 机器人将引发劳动力变革。价格实惠的工业机器人正开始在美国出现，它们能够在人类旁边执行各种简单的任务，及安全工作。机器人公司Rethink Robotics的首个机器人产品Baxter能够处理材料，在传送带上装卸货，检查和测试零部件，进行简单的机器操作，及包装箱子和拆箱。Rethink Robotics希望通过打造低成本制造技术和工序，使得美国更具竞争力。如果一切如同计划顺利进行，Baxter应当能够在人类身边工作，并帮助美国更 好地与劳动力低廉的海外国家竞争。Baxter的终极目标是，完成更多困难的任务，如在电子组装线上装配零部件。Rethink Robotics还在致力于开发软件让Baxter与传送带及其它机器通讯。
b2feda38406d9ef0d7ca304767b3c6219e470e83.translatedText: >Robots will trigger changes in the workforce. Affordable industrial robots are starting to appear in the United States, capable of performing a variety of simple tasks and working safely alongside humans. Baxter, the first robot from robotics company Rethink Robotics, can handle materials, load and unload goods on conveyor belts, inspect and test parts, perform simple machine operations, and pack and unpack boxes. Rethink Robotics hopes to make the United States more competitive by creating low-cost manufacturing technologies and processes. If all goes according to plan, Baxter should be able to work alongside humans and help the United States better compete with overseas countries where labor is cheap. Baxter's ultimate goal is to complete more difficult tasks, such as assembling parts on electronics assembly lines. Rethink Robotics is also working on developing software to let Baxter communicate with conveyor belts and other machines.
