619ed66acb2fcfd659e6478c6b2c78d585b0b4ec.translatedText: Hong Kong ship collided, all 124 people fell into the sea, 38 died A rare ship collision occurred in Hong Kong on October 1. By the evening of the 2nd, the death toll increased to 38 people, and more than 100 people were injured...

d56149a9e545c6f1824241d1a7f5e38616f5f0e0.sourceText: 意外初步认定是香港回归以来最严重的一场海难，也是一九九六年嘉利大厦五级大火后，香港死伤最惨重的重大事故。 由于香港海上安全管理向来较严格，根据香港海事处的纪录，只有一九七一年香港驶往澳门的「佛山轮」事件可与之相比，因受台风侵袭，「佛山轮」锚链被 巨风扯断吹翻沉没，船上九十二人仅四人获救。
d56149a9e545c6f1824241d1a7f5e38616f5f0e0.translatedText: The accident was initially determined to be the most serious maritime disaster since Hong Kong's return to the motherland. It was also the deadliest major accident in Hong Kong after the five-level fire in the Garry Building in 1996. As Hong Kong's maritime safety management has always been strict, according to the records of the Hong Kong Marine Department, only the "Foshan Ship" incident from Hong Kong to Macau in 1971 can be compared. Due to the attack of a typhoon, the anchor chain of the "Foshan Ship" was torn off by strong winds and it capsized. Only four of the 92 people on board were rescued.

7705a354033130d625b84c96f6599dba2402f460.sourceText: 二日死亡人数不断更新，香港政府昨天晚间公布，死亡人数增至卅八人，当中卅人在现场证实死亡，八人送院后证实死亡。 事件中，共有一百零一人分别被送往五家医院，六十六人已经出院，有四人仍伤势严重或有生命危险。
7705a354033130d625b84c96f6599dba2402f460.translatedText: The death toll has been updated continuously over the past two days. The Hong Kong government announced yesterday evening that the death toll had increased to 38, of which 30 were confirmed dead at the scene and eight were confirmed dead after being sent to hospital. In the incident, a total of 101 people were sent to five hospitals, 66 people have been discharged, and four people are still seriously injured or have life-threatening injuries.

217f9f7c72f5595c17618cdc607b04cef58da7ad.sourceText: 香港政府全力救援，专门处理特大灾难的政府紧急事故监察及支援中心随即启动，指挥各部门全力抢救坠海伤者与搜索失踪人士。 警方、海事处、医院管理局均启动相应的紧急应变机制。
217f9f7c72f5595c17618cdc607b04cef58da7ad.translatedText: The Hong Kong government went all out to rescue, and the government's Emergency Monitoring and Support Center, which specializes in handling major disasters, was immediately activated to direct various departments to rescue the injured who fell into the sea and search for missing people. The Police, Marine Department, and Hospital Authority have all activated corresponding emergency response mechanisms.

f69b4b15672556991f0db3f0cb8c00d3375bcd97.sourceText: 港府保安局局长黎栋国说，事故后搜索范围已扩阔至南丫岛附近海面。 警方出动六百卅人前往救援。
f69b4b15672556991f0db3f0cb8c00d3375bcd97.translatedText: Secretary for Security of the Hong Kong Government, Lai Tung-kwok, said that after the accident, the search area had been expanded to the sea near Lamma Island. The police dispatched 600 people to the rescue.

2ba056979387043816230a5dd11460f9c3a655c8.sourceText: 香港特首梁振英事发两个半小时便赶至附近码头了解现场情况，他昨天下午并召开跨部门会议，决定将明天定为全港哀悼日，官员在当天中午到政府总部默哀三分钟。 而香港政府机关的特区区旗，将从周四起连续三天下半旗致哀，官员也会取消非必要活动。 全港十八区会在适当地点设置吊唁册，让市民吊唁。
2ba056979387043816230a5dd11460f9c3a655c8.translatedText: Hong Kong Chief Executive Leung Chun-ying rushed to a nearby pier to learn about the scene two and a half hours after the incident. He held an inter-departmental meeting yesterday afternoon and decided to designate tomorrow as a day of mourning for the whole territory. Officials went to the government headquarters to observe three minutes of silence at noon that day. The Hong Kong SAR regional flag will be flown at half-mast for three consecutive days starting from Thursday, and officials will also cancel non-essential activities. Condolence books will be set up at appropriate locations in all 18 districts in Hong Kong for citizens to express their condolences.

dd866887af474bd973d83b6bbe13f2c547d6b7ae.sourceText: 由于遇难者众，昨天南丫岛意外海域的小船上及码头，香烛处处，是亲友向海难死者致哀。
dd866887af474bd973d83b6bbe13f2c547d6b7ae.translatedText: Due to the large number of victims, incense and candles were everywhere on the boats and docks in the Lamma Island accident yesterday, as relatives and friends paid their respects to the victims of the shipwreck.

6ea68b761f9339ee2b7d121393df3ba702a3cc75.sourceText: 警方除派出水警总区重案组接手调查，更火速采取行动。 保安局长黎栋国说，警方已拘捕七名船员，其中两船船长均被捕。 香港警务处处长曾伟雄说，七名

Security chief Lai Tung-kuo said police had arrested seven crew members, including the captains of both ships. Hong Kong Police Commissioner Tsang Wai-hung said that seven

bd55e1a7c0f2ed278a680a32a8851c8eccefdf9a.sourceText: 大凤凰城近10年最高气温纪录：华氏118度 约4000个家庭停电，空调停转，正正是这样的一天，上周六，大凤凰城区温度飙升到118度，成为当天全美最热，也破了过去10年的最高纪录。 国家气象局说，季风活动云层可使地面温度达到120度，但他们说，118仍是全市迄今为止最热的一天。 夏季风暴带来的狂风掀翻了电缆线，使数千凤凰城郊区家庭停电。 马利科巴郡警长乔阿派奥下令运送数千冰袋到户外监狱供受刑人使用。
bd55e1a7c0f2ed278a680a32a8851c8eccefdf9a.translatedText: The highest temperature record in Greater Phoenix in the past 10 years: 118 degrees Fahrenheit. About 4,000 homes were without power and air conditioners stopped working. It was a day like this. Last Saturday, the temperature in the greater Phoenix area soared to 118 degrees, becoming the hottest day in the United States and breaking the highest record in the past 10 years. The National Weather Service said active monsoon clouds could bring ground temperatures to 120 degrees, but they said 118 was still the city's hottest day yet. High winds from a summer storm toppled power lines, leaving thousands of suburban Phoenix homes without power. Maricopa County Sheriff Joe Arpaio ordered thousands of ice packs to be shipped to outdoor jails for use by inmates.

efd737d248591b73169cbab3fbb105ad1a390a6b.sourceText: 据有线电视新闻网（CNN）报道，以提高快餐业工资为主要目标的罢工运动是去年从纽约市开始的，随后逐渐扩大。今年8月，60个城市的快餐业工人参加了罢工。
efd737d248591b73169cbab3fbb105ad1a390a6b.translatedText: According to Cable News Network (CNN), the strike movement with the main goal of raising wages in the fast food industry began in New York City last year and gradually expanded. In August this year, fast food workers in 60 cities went on strike.

d6c48a1986b84811ed78e22fa8f674f3e65688d6.sourceText: 全国餐馆协会（National Restaurant Association）声称，示威活动是”全国工会组织协调的公关运动，”过去的抗议实际上很少有餐馆工人参与。
d6c48a1986b84811ed78e22fa8f674f3e65688d6.translatedText: The National Restaurant Association claimed that the demonstrations were "a public relations campaign coordinated by national union organizations," and that past protests had actually involved few restaurant workers.

674f4bc49f709e3eeba681451115b73f94e83340.sourceText: 麦当劳公司一名女发言人说，星期四的事件”并不是罢工”，而是外部团体组织一批人前去麦当劳餐馆和其它地方举行集会。
674f4bc49f709e3eeba681451115b73f94e83340.translatedText: A McDonald's spokeswoman said Thursday's incident "was not a strike," but rather a group of people organized by outside groups to hold rallies at McDonald's restaurants and other locations.

9677eeff950cf53d241eb2c5940e73738eb39aa4.sourceText: 餐馆行业批评这场运动，声称增加起薪将影响就业并提高价格。
9677eeff950cf53d241eb2c5940e73738eb39aa4.translatedText: The restaurant industry criticized the movement, claiming that increasing starting wages would hurt employment and raise prices.

1104ebb0ccf5c403721869590d9a0a015b76c468.sourceText: 这场罢工运动得到国际服务业雇员工会（Service Employees International Union）的支持。MoveOn.org的请愿书得到5万人网络签名，呼吁将快餐业最低时薪提高到15美元，以便让美国人能维持生活。
1104ebb0ccf5c403721869590d9a0a015b76c468.translatedText: This strike movement is supported by the Service Employees International Union. The MoveOn.org petition, which has received 50,000 online signatures, calls for raising the minimum wage in the fast food industry to $15 an hour so that Americans can live a living.

af171b6917bd2835af3f882353648acbe2bf3c3f.sourceText: 国会53名议员星期三联名致函连锁快餐店麦当劳、温蒂（Wendy’s ）、多米诺披萨（Domino’s Pizza ）、汉堡王（Burger King ）和百胜餐饮（Yum! Brands ）、百胜客（Pizza Hut）和塔克贝尔（Taco Bell），支持为工人提高工资。
af171b6917bd2835af3f882353648acbe2bf3c3f.translatedText: Fifty-three members of Congress signed a letter on Wednesday to fast-food chains McDonald's, Wendy's, Domino's Pizza, Burger King and Yum! Brands, Pizza Hut and Taco Bell, supporting higher wages for workers.

7077ff2fe6a3859afdf9c81292f7702e285daade.sourceText: 那些议员在信中说，”我们骄傲的站在工人一边，他们继续为适合所有人的经济而斗争。”
7077ff2fe6a3859afdf9c81292f7702e285daade.translatedText: Those congressmen said in the letter, "We proudly stand with workers as they continue to fight for an economy that works for everyone."

9dfc86c27c53f7b21413b1dc087ce4f33cddc0c8.sourceText: 此前的报道说，全美大约100个城市的快餐店工人计划本周四罢工。组织者说，这将成为快餐业工人为提高工资采取的最大规模行动。
9dfc86c27c53f7b21413b1dc087ce4f33cddc0c8.translatedText: Previous reports said that fast food restaurant workers in about 100 cities across the United States plan to strike this Thursday. Organizers say it will be the largest-scale action by fast-food workers for higher wages.

bc8e65d1e842c72d06a9fe2f5a334a81fd456771.sourceText: 美国活过100岁的人多为白人女性 男性仅20% 据路透社报道，人们长期以来就知道，女性的寿命比男性要长，但如果说活到100岁或超过高100岁时，男女两性的差距则变得非常明显。在活到或超过100岁的美国人中，男性仅占20%。 据周一公布的一项美国人口统计局的报告显示，美国年龄在100岁或以上的人有5万3364位，其中超过80%为女性。 该部门的发现是基于2010年采集的人口普查资料。该报告还发现，那些年龄超过100岁的人中大多为美国东北部及中西部的城市白人居民。 人口统计研究人员写道：?#30001;于寿命长短存在着性别差异，人口中女性的比例会随着年龄的增加而增加。这一点在最老的年龄组中尤其是这样，因为在这一年龄组中，女性的百分比会出现急剧的增加。对每100位百岁女性来说，相对应的只有20.7位百岁男性。?/FONT> 尽管活到100岁的年龄已经不像数十年前那样会被大肆宣传，但公众仍然对那些人瑞的高寿感到惊叹。 吉尼斯世界纪录说，世界上寿命最长的活人曾经是贝丝-库珀。这位美国女性于上周在佐治亚州的一个疗养院中过世，享年116岁。她是在刚刚做完头发之后去世的。 吉尼斯在其网站上宣布，新的得到认证的最年长的人瑞是现年115岁的狄娜-曼弗莱蒂尼。她是来自意大利皮耶韦佩拉戈的移民，她自1920年以来一直居住在爱荷华州的得梅因。她比日本的木村仅仅年长15天。
bc8e65d1e842c72d06a9fe2f5a334a81fd456771.translatedText: Most people who have lived over 100 years old in the United States are white women, and only 20% are men. According to Reuters, it has long been known that women live longer than men, but when you live to 100 years old or beyond, the gap between men and women becomes very obvious. Only 20% of Americans who live to be 100 or older are men. According to a U.S. Census Bureau report released on Monday, there are 53,364 people in the United States aged 100 or older, and more than 80% of them are women. The department's findings are based on census data collected in 2010. The report also found that those over 100 were mostly white urban residents of the Northeast and Midwest. Demography researchers write: "There are gender differences in longevity, with the proportion of women in the population increasing with age." This is especially true in the oldest age group, where a sharp increase in the percentage of women occurs. For every 100 centenarian women, there are only 20.7 centenarian men. ?/FONT> Although reaching 100 years old is no longer the publicity it was a few decades ago, the public still marvels at the longevity of those who live to a remarkable age. Guinness World Records says the world's longest-lived living person was Beth Cooper. The American woman died last week in a nursing home in Georgia at the age of 116. She died just after having her hair done. Guinness announced on its website that the new oldest person certified is Dina Manfredini, 115. An immigrant from Pieve Pelago, Italy, she had lived in Des Moines, Iowa since 1920. She is only 15 days older than Japan's Kimura.

3b54fdd4bc5a343a8fffa2511655b2c24f950450.sourceText: 医保265万耆老 今年省15亿药费 （亚省时报） 「联邦医疗保险及医疗补助服务中心」(Center for Medicare and Medicaid Serivces)6日宣布，今年有逾265万名联邦医疗保险(Medicare)受益人，在处方药计画上共节省逾15亿元，平均每人省下569元，而且保费保持稳定。 原因在于健保法桉的条款，对于Medicare D部分计画的「甜甜圈洞缺口」(doughnut hole)处方药，提供半价折扣。 自从今年因健保法桉而修改规定后，截至11月底，已有逾2400万人、即约半数Medicare受益人已接受免费年度体检或其他筛检。 中心主任布兰姆说：「我们非常高兴有此成果，Medicare D部分计画的保费也一直维持稳定，虽然预期将在2012年调涨。」 不过，卫生与福利部已在8月宣布，明年Medicare处方药计画的保费每个月平均约30元，而今年则为30.76元。 自今年起，处方药福利陷入「甜甜圈洞缺口」的老年人，在处方药的品牌药可获得50%折扣；药商必须提供折扣，以加入处方药计画。而在健保法桉通过以前，Medicare涵盖缺口的处方药超额费用，均需由病患自费。 布兰姆指出，老年人已更加关切他们的医疗福利，当局并为这项改变大力宣导。卡托研究所健保政策研究主任卡侬表示，预防性的福利绝非免费，因为还是由纳税人负担，「天下没有白吃的午餐」。
3b54fdd4bc5a343a8fffa2511655b2c24f950450.translatedText: 2.65 million seniors covered by Medicare will save $1.5 billion in drug costs this year (Alberta Times) The Center for Medicare and Medicaid Services announced on the 6th that more than 2.65 million Medicare beneficiaries have saved more than $1.5 billion on prescription drug plans this year, with an average savings of $569 per person, and premiums have remained stable. The reason is that the health insurance law provides half-price discounts for "doughnut hole" prescription drugs in the Medicare Part D plan. Since the regulations were changed due to the health care law this year, as of the end of November, more than 24 million people, or about half of Medicare beneficiaries, have received free annual physical exams or other screenings, said center director Brahm. "We are very pleased with this outcome. Premiums for the Medicare Part D plan have remained stable despite expectations for increases in 2012." However, the Ministry of Health and Welfare announced in August that the monthly premium for the Medicare prescription drug plan will average about 30 yuan next year, compared with 30.76 yuan this year. Starting from this year, seniors who fall into the "donut hole gap" in prescription drug benefits will receive a 50% discount on brand-name prescription drugs; drug manufacturers must provide discounts to join the prescription drug plan. Before the health insurance law was passed, the excess cost of prescription drugs in the Medicare coverage gap had to be paid by the patient. Bram pointed out that the elderly have become more concerned about their medical benefits, and the authorities have vigorously promoted this change. Cannon, director of health care policy research at the Cato Institute, said that preventive benefits are by no means free because they are still borne by taxpayers, and "there is no free lunch."

64f180cb713d5ae5ae3ac1a4d8fd32dfeba4480f.sourceText: 据中央电视台新闻联播报道消息，11月22号凌晨2时许，青岛经济技术开发区中石化黄潍输油管线一输油管道发生原油泄漏。10时30分左右，在准备抢修过程中发生爆炸。爆炸波及到青岛市丽东化工厂部分设施。截至17时40分，事故已造成35人死亡，166人受伤。
64f180cb713d5ae5ae3ac1a4d8fd32dfeba4480f.translatedText: According to CCTV News, at about 2 a.m. on November 22, a crude oil leak occurred in the Sinopec Huangwei Oil Pipeline in Qingdao Economic and Technological Development Zone. Around 10:30, an explosion occurred during preparations for emergency repairs. The explosion affected some facilities of Qingdao Lidong Chemical Plant. As of 17:40, the accident had killed 35 people and injured 166 people.

891a6cd92a3f50e3e30c0cebfe4e1b8c641e0163.sourceText: 事故发生后，党中央国务院高度重视，中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平立即作出重要指示。要求山东省和有关方面组织力量，及时排除险情，千方百计搜救失踪受伤人员，并查明事故原因，总结事故教训，落实安全生产责任，强化安全生产措施，坚决杜绝此类事故。
891a6cd92a3f50e3e30c0cebfe4e1b8c641e0163.translatedText: After the accident, the Party Central Committee and the State Council attached great importance to it, and Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, State President, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, immediately issued important instructions. Shandong Province and relevant parties are required to organize forces to eliminate dangers in a timely manner, do everything possible to search and rescue missing and injured people, identify the cause of the accident, summarize the lessons learned from the accident, implement safety production responsibilities, strengthen safety production measures, and resolutely put an end to such accidents.

01499e803919b5589f54d86ba148f6ab1ac0d83c.sourceText: 中共中央政治局常委、国务院总理李克强作出批示，要求全力搜救失踪受伤人员，深入排除控制危险源，妥善做好各项善后工作。加强检查督查，严格落实安全生产责任。
01499e803919b5589f54d86ba148f6ab1ac0d83c.translatedText: Li Keqiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, issued instructions calling for all-out efforts to search and rescue missing and injured persons, in-depth elimination and control of dangerous sources, and proper follow-up work. Strengthen inspection and supervision and strictly implement safety production responsibilities.

52020675adf84b99fff1f25cea054ec24f010b3c.sourceText: 受习近平总书记，李克强总理委托，国务委员王勇已率有关部门负责同志紧急赶赴事故现场指导救援工作，看望慰问伤员。
52020675adf84b99fff1f25cea054ec24f010b3c.translatedText: Entrusted by General Secretary Xi Jinping and Premier Li Keqiang, State Councilor Wang Yong has led comrades in charge of relevant departments to rush to the accident site to guide the rescue work and visit the injured.

939dd97b03537456fe81305ce6b18946bb509e6e.sourceText: 事故发生后，山东省委省政府主要负责同志，国务院有关部门，中石化公司负责人也紧急赶赴事故现场指导抢险救援工作。目前，输油管道已关闭，起火点已全部扑灭，各项善后工作正在进行。有关地方和部门正按照中央领导同志重要指示精神，进一步采取措施，全力组织抢险救援工作。
939dd97b03537456fe81305ce6b18946bb509e6e.translatedText: After the accident, the main responsible comrades of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee and Provincial Government, relevant departments of the State Council, and the person in charge of Sinopec also rushed to the accident site to guide the rescue and rescue work. At present, the oil pipeline has been closed, all fire points have been extinguished, and various aftermath work is in progress. Relevant localities and departments are taking further measures in accordance with the important instructions of the central leaders and making every effort to organize rescue and rescue work.

3b40f556e68dc4c227ab5fd594b9fae9760acc6c.sourceText: 劳工部周五公布的数据显示，12月非农就业人数增长15.5万人，经济学家此前预期增长15.0万。11月非农就业人口增长14.6万。12月失业率为7.8%，此前经济学家预期为7.8%。11月失业率为7.7%，为2010年8月以来新高。
3b40f556e68dc4c227ab5fd594b9fae9760acc6c.translatedText: Data released by the Labor Department on Friday showed that non-farm payroll employment increased by 155,000 in December, while economists had expected an increase of 150,000. Nonfarm employment increased by 146,000 in November. The unemployment rate in December was 7.8%, while economists had expected 7.8%. The unemployment rate was 7.7% in November, the highest level since August 2010.

977f191e160a577bec8c1cfe991c0dfa3dc00649.sourceText: 此外，数据还显示，12月平均每小时工资月率上升0.3%，预期上升0.2%；年率上升2.1%，前值上升1.7%。12月平均每周工时34.5小时，预期34.4小时。
977f191e160a577bec8c1cfe991c0dfa3dc00649.translatedText: In addition, the data also showed that the average hourly wage increased by 0.3% monthly in December, which is expected to increase by 0.2%; the annual rate increased by 2.1%, and the previous value increased by 1.7%. The average weekly working hours in December was 34.5 hours, compared with the expected 34.4 hours.

098e16e5264052532684f8aece4abe44e7fdf941.sourceText: GM召回5.5万辆2013新车 通用汽车公司(GM)4日宣布，由于车主在停妥车辆后，车仍有可能滑动，因此将在全国召回约5万5000辆2013年份的新车。 通用表示，这项召回行动影响的车型包括：凯迪拉克的Escalade、Escalade EXT和Escalade ESV；雪佛兰(Chevrolet)的Express、Silverado、Tahoe和Suburban，以及GMC的Savana、Sierra、 Yukon和Yukon XL等货车 或休旅车车款。 根据GM呈交全国公路交通安全管理署(NHTSA)的文件，部分车子出现停车锁线缆有裂缝或方向盘锁变形，恐使车主在停妥取下钥匙或在「熄火」情况下，车子还是会移动 。 这是该公司在全球召回逾6万9000辆车的一部分，除了美国之外，加拿大占6310辆、墨西哥占670辆、其他国家占7084辆。 GM称，尚接到有关故障造成的车祸或受伤报告。 如果有必要，会免费为车主更换驾驶杆(steering column)。 召回将于22日开始，预计车主很快会收到通知信。
098e16e5264052532684f8aece4abe44e7fdf941.translatedText: GM recalls 55,000 2013 new cars General Motors (GM) announced on the 4th that it will recall about 55,000 new cars from the 2013 model nationwide because the car may still slide after the owner parked it. GM said the recall affects Cadillac's Escalade, Escalade EXT and Escalade ESV; Chevrolet's Express, Silverado, Tahoe and Suburban; and GMC's Savana, Sierra, Yukon and Yukon XL vans or SUVs. According to documents submitted by GM to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), some cars have cracks in the parking lock cable or deformed steering wheel locks, which may cause the car to move even after the owner removes the key or turns off the engine. This is part of the company's global recall of more than 69,000 vehicles. In addition to the United States, Canada accounts for 6,310 vehicles, Mexico accounts for 670 vehicles, and other countries account for 7,084 vehicles. GM said it has received reports of crashes or injuries caused by the malfunction. If necessary, the steering column will be replaced free of charge for the owner. The recall will begin on the 22nd, and car owners are expected to receive notification letters soon.

1de40ba93f931bd6882f50f9fea9fb2e4e7a6557.sourceText: 流感恶化 侵袭48州 29名儿童死亡 联邦卫生官员周五表示，一个已经很糟糕的流感季节继续在美国各地造成更多的灾害，其中老年人受害情况最重。美国疾病防治中心表示，已有29名儿童死于流感。 流感季节大约只过了一半，随着感染流感的民众出现并发症，最糟糕的结果是可能会继续恶化。CDC说，30个州出现高流感疫情，高于上周24个州出现疫情的情况。已经有逾5,000人病重得必须住院治疗。CDC在每周一次的流感报告中表示：”48个州通报了大范围的流感疫情。” 流感病例在某些地区还在不断增加，特别是在西部，但因类似流感病兆而就诊的病患人数在减少。 亚利桑那州在十二月底只有零星流感个案，到了1月12月止，流感报告在美国疾病防治中心报告上已显示为广泛流行。”广泛”意味着有超过50%的地区受到波及。这一描述仅仅论及的是其影响的范围，并非其严重程度。 CDC说，流感疫苗还很不完美，今年的流感疫苗有效性大约为62%。但这是最好的预防工具。
1de40ba93f931bd6882f50f9fea9fb2e4e7a6557.translatedText: Flu worsens, hitting 48 states, killing 29 children An already bad flu season continues to wreak havoc across the United States, with older adults hardest hit, federal health officials said Friday. The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention says 29 children have died from the flu. We're only about halfway through the flu season, and the worst outcomes are likely to continue to get worse as people who contract the flu develop complications. The CDC said 30 states are experiencing high influenza outbreaks, up from 24 states last week. More than 5,000 people have become seriously ill and have to be hospitalized. "Widespread influenza outbreaks have been reported in 48 states," the CDC said in its weekly flu report. Flu cases are increasing in some areas, particularly in the West, but the number of patients seeking medical attention with flu-like symptoms is declining. Arizona had only sporadic influenza cases in late December, and by January-December, influenza reports were classified as widespread by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. "Extensive" means that more than 50% of the area is affected. This description only addresses the scope of its impact, not its severity. The CDC says the flu vaccine is far from perfect, and this year's flu shot is about 62% effective. But it’s the best prevention tool.

8bf629ac6b7173c4d9efdc2f57f9325085263f11.sourceText: Tempe市长宣布本月为Tempe市美中美好月（图） [ACA, Tempe] 亚利桑那的华人华侨对凤凰城南部地区的天庇市并不陌生。每年春节期间的中国周活动、亚利桑那州立大学（ASU）的孔子学院的各种华教培训、与姊妹城市台北及成都的频繁文化交流等都已深入人心。近年来每逢国庆中秋之际天庇市侨学界举办的大型庆祝活动也逐渐形成定式。9月10日由亚利桑那华人华侨总会（Arizona Chinese Association, ACA）、州内三所大学（ASU、亚利桑那大学（UofA）、北亚利桑那大学（NAU））的中国学生学者联合会在ASU的Memorial Union共同举办的国庆中秋庆典”凤凰之秋”取得了园满成功。洛杉矶总领馆的张健参赞、州议员Kimberly Yee、天庇市市长Hugh Hallman、美国《侨报》舒岚主任及多位侨领到会并发表了热情洋溢的祝辞。当Hallman市长当场宣布把9月10日至10月9日定为天庇市的美中友好月时，全场一片欢呼，掌声雷动。市长这一令人振奋的宣言把整个庆典推到了高潮。 ”鉴于， 亚利桑那华人华侨总会致力于通过文化、教育、体育活动推动社会对华裔社区正面形象的进一步认识” 鉴于， 亚利桑那华人华侨总会致力于推动中美之间的文化、贸易、科学及通信领域的广泛交流； 鉴于， 亚利桑那华人华侨总会致力于支持美国的中文学校及中文教育； 鉴于， 亚利桑那华人华侨总会致力于推动华裔居民积极融入本地主流社会并参加选举活动； 鉴于， 亚利桑那华人华侨总会致力于庆祝2011年9月13日中国的传统节日－中秋节； 鉴于， 亚利桑那华人华侨总会致力于庆祝2011年10月1日中华人民共和国成立62周年； 并鉴于， 亚利桑那州天庇市被许多华裔居民称之为家。 我，天庇市市长Hugh Hallman，在此正式宣2011年9月10日至10月9日为亚利桑那州天庇市的美中友好月。” 市长的宣言再一次肯定了华人社区对本地经济、文化、政治等各方面的贡献。在美中友好月期间，ACA将联合《侨报》在天庇市各政府部门举办”中华全家福”大型画展，向各族裔观众展现中国各民族的美好生活及幸福明天。
8bf629ac6b7173c4d9efdc2f57f9325085263f11.translatedText: The Mayor of Tempe declares this month to be the United States and China Month in Tempe (picture) [ACA, Tempe] The Chinese diaspora in Arizona are no strangers to Tempe City in the southern area of Phoenix. The China Week activities during the Spring Festival every year, the various Chinese education training provided by the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University (ASU), and the frequent cultural exchanges with sister cities Taipei and Chengdu have become deeply rooted in the hearts of the people. In recent years, large-scale celebrations held by overseas Chinese and academic circles in Tianbi City on the occasion of National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival have gradually taken shape. On September 10, the National Day Mid-Autumn Festival celebration "Phoenix Autumn" co-organized by the Arizona Chinese Association (ACA) and the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of three universities in the state (ASU, University of Arizona (UofA), and Northern Arizona University (NAU)) at the Memorial Union of ASU was a complete success. Counselor Zhang Jian of the Consulate General in Los Angeles, state assemblyman Kimberly Yee, Tianbi City Mayor Hugh Hallman, director of the American Overseas Chinese Newspaper Shu Lan and many overseas Chinese leaders attended the meeting and delivered warm congratulatory speeches. When Mayor Hallman announced on the spot that September 10th to October 9th would be Tianbi City’s U.S.-China Friendship Month, the entire audience cheered and applauded thunderously. The mayor's exciting declaration pushed the entire celebration to a climax. "Whereas, the Arizona Chinese Association is committed to promoting society's further understanding of the positive image of the Chinese community through culture, education, and sports activities." Whereas, the Arizona Chinese Association is committed to promoting extensive exchanges in the fields of culture, trade, science, and communications between China and the United States; Whereas, the Arizona Chinese Association is committed to supporting Chinese schools and Chinese education in the United States; Whereas, the Arizona Chinese Association is committed to promoting Chinese residents to actively integrate into the local mainstream society and participate in electoral activities; Whereas, The Arizona Chinese Association is committed to celebrating the Mid-Autumn Festival, a traditional Chinese festival, on September 13, 2011; whereas, the Arizona Chinese Association is committed to celebrating the 62nd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China on October 1, 2011; and whereas, Tempi City, Arizona is called home by many Chinese residents. I, Mayor Hugh Hallman of Tempe, Arizona, hereby officially declare September 10 to October 9, 2011, as U.S.-China Friendship Month in Tempe, Arizona. " The mayor's declaration once again affirms the contribution of the Chinese community to the local economy, culture, politics and other aspects. During the US-China Friendship Month, ACA will join hands with the Overseas Chinese Newspaper to hold a large-scale "Chinese Family Portrait" exhibition in various government departments in Tianpi City to show audiences of all ethnic groups the beautiful lives and happy tomorrows of all ethnic groups in China.

39456c1bab47b9ca0c6ee5b2a3f3a4ad4ae0d0ae.sourceText: 福特Escape 马自达Tribute召回 由于油门踏板可能卡死而导致车祸，福特汽车公司26日宣布召回约48万5000辆2001至2004年份的小型多功能车Escape，进行检修。这个问题至今已导致至少一人死亡，九人受伤。 Escape小型多功能车也以Mavericks之名在欧洲销售，一周前，全国公路交通安全管理署(NHTSA)开始调查福特公司在欧洲召回的配置3升V6引擎、带定速器的Mavericks 。 NHTSA已经接到与这个问题有关的68起投诉，其中包括13起车祸，导致九人受伤，一人死亡。今年元月，一辆Escape在亚利桑那州发生车祸，造成一名少女罹难。 这是Escape在两周之内的第三次被召回。 Escape上月是美国销量最高的多功能车。一周之前，福特召回1万1500辆2013年份、1.6升引擎的Escape，因为燃油管可能裂缝漏油，引起火灾。在那次召回行动的数天前，福特召回1万辆Escape ，修理地毯可能干扰刹车的问题。 福特公司发言人玛西．兹维贝表示，2001-2004年份Escape的定速器缆线，可能卡在引擎顶部的塑料盖上，导致油门踏板卡住。兹维贝说，在召回修理前，车主可以先去经销商，暂时切断Escape的定速器缆线，以避免驾车发生问题。马自达汽车公司（Mazda）宣布，将在美国召修21万7500辆Tribute休旅车，主因这款车出现意外加速问题。 马自达Tribute和福特Escape共用多种零件，包括有瑕疵的巡航控制系统。这个瑕疵可以导致油门卡住，造成汽车失速。这次召修车款，是2001至2006年间以及2008年出厂的Tribute。.
39456c1bab47b9ca0c6ee5b2a3f3a4ad4ae0d0ae.translatedText: Ford Escape Mazda Tribute Recall Ford Motor Company announced on the 26th that it would recall about 485,000 Escape small utility vehicles from 2001 to 2004 for maintenance because the accelerator pedal may become stuck, causing a car accident. The problem has so far resulted in at least one death and nine injuries. The Escape small utility vehicle is also sold in Europe as Mavericks. A week ago, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) began investigating Ford's recall of Mavericks equipped with 3-liter V6 engines and fixed speeders in Europe. NHTSA has received 68 complaints related to the problem, including 13 crashes that resulted in nine injuries and one death. In January this year, an Escape crashed in Arizona, killing a girl. This is the third time in two weeks that the Escape has been recalled. The Escape was the top-selling utility vehicle in the United States last month. A week ago, Ford recalled 11,500 2013 Escape vehicles with 1.6-liter engines because fuel lines could crack and leak, causing a fire. That recall comes days after Ford recalled 10,000 Escape vehicles to fix a problem with carpeting that could interfere with brakes. Ford spokesperson Marcy. Zwiebe said the 2001-2004 Escape's speedometer cable may have become stuck on the plastic cover on top of the engine, causing the accelerator pedal to become stuck. Zwiebe said that before the recall is repaired, car owners can go to the dealer to temporarily cut the Escape's speedometer cable to avoid driving problems. Mazda Motor Company (Mazda) announced that it will recall 217,500 Tribute SUVs in the United States due to unintended acceleration problems. The Mazda Tribute and Ford Escape share a variety of parts, including faulty cruise control systems. This flaw can cause the accelerator to get stuck, causing the car to stall. The models being recalled this time are Tribute manufactured between 2001 and 2006 and in 2008. .

6981b49997dba7161f9d4b7511b0040ae9fc7e87.translatedText: On Tuesday, food safety incidents occurred at two schools in the Phoenix area. Several schoolchildren became ill after eating different foods.

75455c9117f41065c03782afc17b71c8fef23b4a.sourceText: 事件发生于固特异市范布伦街和Sarival大道交界的Incito特许学校，周二午餐时间，5名10-11岁学生被发现头晕目眩和肚子疼等症状。医务室护士发现，这些学童均有吞食橡皮软糖，学校即报警处理。
75455c9117f41065c03782afc17b71c8fef23b4a.translatedText: The incident occurred at Incito Charter School at the junction of Van Buren Street and Sarival Avenue in Goodyear. Five students aged 10 to 11 were found to have symptoms such as dizziness and stomachache during lunch time on Tuesday. The nurse in the infirmary discovered that these children had swallowed gummy candies, and the school immediately called the police.

7cd767abd0703d1a190c691c68b8c76d6a12510a.sourceText: 警局和消防急救队派员到场检查，没有人被送进医院。警方说大麻糖是一个学生分给同学吃的，但不清楚那学生是否明白这些糖果到底有什么害处。
7cd767abd0703d1a190c691c68b8c76d6a12510a.translatedText: The police station and the fire emergency brigade sent personnel to the scene to check, and no one was sent to the hospital. Police said the candies were given to classmates by a student, but it's unclear whether the student understood the harmful effects of the candies.

944525e06a8a383425807acac9c698e104f32417.sourceText: 学校当天给学童带信回家给家长，称这是一起”不幸，又孤立的事件”，将配合警方进一步调查，严防同类事情发生。
944525e06a8a383425807acac9c698e104f32417.translatedText: The school sent a letter home to the students and parents that day, saying that this was an "unfortunate and isolated incident" and that it would cooperate with the police in further investigation to prevent similar incidents from happening again.

06217063845612178c69a1692f66178073c86c94.sourceText: 食用大麻的反应因人而异，据美国疾病控制中心称，注射浓缩大麻油产品比吸入大麻烟风险大得多，儿童服用后的不良反应比成年人严重。
06217063845612178c69a1692f66178073c86c94.translatedText: Reactions to consuming cannabis vary from person to person. According to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control, injecting concentrated cannabis oil products is much riskier than inhaling cannabis smoke, and adverse reactions in children are more severe than in adults.

8bbf298c670cdb62a52d7a62a8e80f7c149e82d2.sourceText: 同一天，凤凰城Palo Verde初中有三名学生午餐时食用辣椒后不适，其中一名学生应父母的要求，被送往当地儿科医院进一步检查。另两位学生在学校检查后跟父母回家休息。

One of the students was sent to a local pediatric hospital for further examination at the request of his parents. The other two students went home with their parents to rest after school inspections.

af1f8e47493134583ee1efdaad0b4fb4c21839cb.sourceText: 中华文明，皮相可弃，筋骨不移 网上云：崖山之后无中国。这是日本为了侵略中国而炮制的言论，不必计较。但自古以来中华文明就具有强大的生命力，能够汲取外来的养料壮大自身，与时俱进，不断创新。我们不要问：中华文明如此善变，会不会把自己变没了，不再是中华文明？尤其是在西方文明大举入侵之时，这是每个中华儿女的隐忧。 《神鞭》中有句话说得好：鞭割了，神留着，到哪都是绝活。中华文明再怎么变，只要神不变，则中华文明不变。所有的变化，外在的表面都可以变，都可以抛弃，只有骨子里的精神不变就行了。这叫皮相可弃，筋骨不移。 什么是皮相？什么是筋骨？ 不同的人有不同的答案。 皮相是外在，筋骨是核心。 就像找对象，什么生活习惯、个人形象之类的，在一起生活之后都可以改变，都可以相互适应。唯一难变的核心就是人的三观。三观不同的人结合在一起是最痛苦的，不能凑合。 同样的，对中华文明来说，什么生活习惯，礼仪服饰之类的，都属于可以抛弃的皮相；而中华民族长期共同生活中凝聚出的共同意志，则是不能抛弃的核心。 这样的共同意志有不少。比如家国情怀，仁义精神等。有家国情怀，洋装西服穿在身，内心依然是中国心，念念不忘家国故乡。像大一统思想，先国后家的传统，先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐的抱负，都称得上是家国情怀。拾金不昧，拔刀相助等都算得上是仁义精神。也就是说，中华文明的传统三观中的精华不变，中华文明的核心传承就不变。 或许，中华文明到今天，可用二十四字来概括：富强、民主、文明、和谐，自由、平等、公正、法治，爱国、敬业、诚信、友善。对了，就是社会主义核心价值观。
af1f8e47493134583ee1efdaad0b4fb4c21839cb.translatedText: Chinese civilization, the skin can be discarded, but the bones and muscles cannot be moved. Online cloud: There is no China after Yashan. This is a statement concocted by Japan in order to invade China, so don't worry about it. However, since ancient times, Chinese civilization has had strong vitality and has been able to absorb external nutrients to strengthen itself, keep pace with the times, and continuously innovate. Let us not ask: If Chinese civilization is so fickle, will it make itself disappear and no longer be Chinese civilization? Especially when Western civilization invades on a large scale, this is the hidden worry of every Chinese son and daughter. There is a good saying in "The Divine Whip": The whip cuts, but the gods keep it, and you can have unique skills wherever you go. No matter how Chinese civilization changes, as long as God remains unchanged, Chinese civilization will remain unchanged. All changes, the external surface can be changed and abandoned, as long as the spirit in the heart remains unchanged. This is called the skin that can be discarded, but the muscles and bones cannot be moved. What is skin? What are muscles and bones? Different people have different answers. The skin is the outer appearance, and the muscles and bones are the core. Just like finding a partner, your living habits, personal image, etc. can all change after living together and they can all adapt to each other. The only hard-to-change core is people’s outlook. It is the most painful thing for people with different views to come together and they cannot make do. Similarly, for Chinese civilization, living habits, etiquette, clothing, etc., are all superficial aspects that can be discarded; while the common will condensed by the Chinese nation's long-term common life is the core that cannot be discarded. There are many such common wills. For example, the feelings of family and country, the spirit of benevolence and righteousness, etc. With feelings of family and country, wearing a suit and a suit, my heart is still Chinese, and I never forget my home, country, and hometown. Like the idea of ​​great unification, the tradition of putting the country before the family, the ambition to worry about the world's worries before the world's happiness, can all be called the feelings of family and country. Giving up money without being ignorant, drawing a sword to help, etc. can be regarded as the spirit of benevolence and righteousness. In other words, if the essence of the three traditional views of Chinese civilization remains unchanged, the core inheritance of Chinese civilization will remain unchanged. Perhaps, Chinese civilization today can be summarized in twenty-four words: prosperity, democracy, civilization, harmony, freedom, equality, justice, rule of law, patriotism, dedication, integrity, and friendliness. By the way, these are the core values ​​of socialism.

a851053e9e9f1b815a74d6b07459d9e7ffbcad8a.translatedText: Relevant agencies confirmed that her husband helped establish the first sleeper cell of "Al Qaeda" in the United States in an apartment building in Orange County, California.

8f65947b31cae07d51dac2a9721803b4dc0f6b63.sourceText: 这位妇女名为奥尔森，她的丈夫名为Hisham Diab。这位妇女称，她亲眼目睹她丈夫的组织把当地一个十几岁的少年亚当.加达恩转变成一个仇恨美国的狂热者，并说该少年就是10月底在巴基斯坦散布的一盘”基地”录像带中的蒙面人棗当时这位少年在录像带中声称要”用鲜血染红美国的街道”。奥尔森称：”我只是别人拿到绿卡的垫脚石，我嫁给了一个恐怖主义者，他不喜欢美国，同样也不喜欢美国人。”
8f65947b31cae07d51dac2a9721803b4dc0f6b63.translatedText: The woman's name is Olson and her husband's name is Hisham Diab. The woman said she witnessed her husband's organization turn a local teenager, Adam Gadahn, into a fanatic who hates the United States. She said the boy was the masked man in an "Al Qaeda" video that was distributed in Pakistan at the end of October. At that time, the teenager claimed in the video that he wanted to "stain the streets of America red with blood." Olson said: "I am just a stepping stone for others to get a green card. I married a terrorist. He doesn't like the United States and he doesn't like Americans."

92aefc85de4a80d48a2e973a1d9059e440144b5d.sourceText: 她说亚当.加达恩在当地一家清真寺中遇到了奥尔森的前夫。”加达恩是一个新手，很容易被别人控制。不仅如此，加达恩面相坦诚，可以为他们完成很多的任务，”奥尔森说。
92aefc85de4a80d48a2e973a1d9059e440144b5d.translatedText: She said Adam Gadahn met Olson's ex-husband in a local mosque. "Gardane is a newbie and can easily be controlled by others. Not only that, Gardarn is honest and can complete a lot of tasks for them," Olson said.

7f387c1afc27e3269ee5f81736b4e0111fbdb572.sourceText: 奥尔森称，录像带中自称是阿扎姆的美国人的声音、姿势和措词都让她感到特别熟悉，尤其是”用鲜血染红”这个短语。她说这个短语是其丈夫所属组织的口头禅。
7f387c1afc27e3269ee5f81736b4e0111fbdb572.translatedText: Olson said that the voice, posture and wording of the American who claimed to be Azzam in the video felt particularly familiar to her, especially the phrase "red with blood." She said the phrase was the mantra of her husband's organization.

b9f5b71b4bc8133464f178b285c49ca577618466.sourceText: 奥尔森说，在过去的三年里，本.拉登的一些高级助手曾经和她以及她的丈夫在一起待过，其中包括双目失明的拉合曼。后来拉合曼因为参与”基地”组织对美国恐怖袭击的策划被判处终身监禁。
b9f5b71b4bc8133464f178b285c49ca577618466.translatedText: Olson said some of bin Laden's top aides had spent time with her and her husband over the past three years, including Rahman, who is blind. Rahman was later sentenced to life imprisonment for participating in al-Qaeda's planning of terrorist attacks on the United States.

f26f4506520ef661ac537036062ae46ee777f656.sourceText: 奥尔森称她曾经竭尽全力使联邦调查局能对其丈夫的可疑行为有所察觉，但是联邦调查局一直没有重视她的提示。
f26f4506520ef661ac537036062ae46ee777f656.translatedText: Olson said she tried her best to make the FBI aware of her husband's suspicious behavior, but the FBI never took her tips seriously.

a300ca23db2cf4fa59eb00c33a089ea8977cb8dc.sourceText: 奥尔森回想起当她认出拉合曼涉及1993年世贸中心爆炸案时说：”当时我感觉自己处在了地狱中，我已经处在了地狱的中心，而且我将永远待在那里。我当时已经结婚7个月了，我给家里带来了一个恐怖主义者。”
a300ca23db2cf4fa59eb00c33a089ea8977cb8dc.translatedText: Olson recalled that when she recognized Rahman as part of the 1993 World Trade Center bombing, she said: "I felt like I was in hell. I was in the center of hell, and I will be there forever. There. I had been married for 7 months, and I brought a terrorist into the family."

b4cca6f8c3e82a6b2d2baadaca246bc5c0799246.sourceText: 奥尔森的丈夫结婚后顺利得到了绿卡，他于1998年突然离开了美国。现在美国当局正在对他进行追捕，据情报官员称，他现在很可能和其他的”基地”领导人一起藏身在巴基斯坦。
b4cca6f8c3e82a6b2d2baadaca246bc5c0799246.translatedText: Olson's husband successfully obtained a green card after getting married, and he suddenly left the United States in 1998. U.S. authorities are now hunting him, and intelligence officials say he is likely hiding in Pakistan with other al Qaeda leaders.

7c08eaecc638c0dd239a3c623e0dbdabc4cb8aab.sourceText: 奥尔森首次遇到她的丈夫是在13年前，当时她在一个当地的大学负责给外国学生发放签证的工作。她当时认为32岁的Diab有许多值得尊敬的志向。
7c08eaecc638c0dd239a3c623e0dbdabc4cb8aab.translatedText: Olson first met her husband 13 years ago when she was responsible for issuing visas to foreign students at a local university. She thought the 32-year-old Diab had many respectable ambitions at the time.

881b26982a8351155fbe5bfe86cda85e4d59e379.sourceText: ”我真的很爱她。当时我22岁，就这样坠入了爱河，”奥尔森说。
881b26982a8351155fbe5bfe86cda85e4d59e379.translatedText: "I really loved her. I was 22 and I just fell in love," Olson said.

bf2e4fd640979a367fcce642de9e1415b39540c9.sourceText: 奥尔森说，当时Diab介绍称自己是埃及人，由于签证过期需要更换签证。奥尔森说学校不能为他提供这方面的服务。奥尔森称：”他很愉快的接受了，然后就离开了。然而第二天他又回来了，问我是否愿意跟他约会。”
bf2e4fd640979a367fcce642de9e1415b39540c9.translatedText: Olson said that at that time, Diab introduced himself as an Egyptian and needed to change his visa because it had expired. Olson said the school couldn't provide him with that service. "He happily accepted and left," Olson said. "Then he came back the next day and asked me if I wanted to date him."

c4c8aa2ea205603d0c3fbfd67f1fb2237983c939.sourceText: 几个月过后，他们结婚了。奥尔森和她4岁的儿子也一起转信了伊斯兰教。但他们的蜜月结束的很快。因为奥尔森的丈夫坚持要她戴上虔诚穆斯林妇女戴的头巾，并且遵守其它严格的伊斯兰教条。
c4c8aa2ea205603d0c3fbfd67f1fb2237983c939.translatedText: A few months later, they got married. Olson and her 4-year-old son also converted to Islam. But their honeymoon ended quickly. Olson's husband insisted that she wear the hijab worn by devout Muslim women and abide by other strict Islamic rules.

5db2b97bc4f9dc08d263c479cd9f0e4e332ea867.sourceText: 接着，对她的殴打也开始了。奥尔森说对她的殴打是由于违反了丈夫严格的规定。这些规定包括不能和其他任何男性有身体接触。
5db2b97bc4f9dc08d263c479cd9f0e4e332ea867.translatedText: Then the beating began. Olson said the beating was a result of breaking her husband's strict rules. These rules include no physical contact with any other male.

3932dad5fbc1e4fe7378abdbc83dce58ce030758.sourceText: 她回忆说，结婚后仅仅几个星期，由于她不小心碰到了公寓楼的经理，她第一次受到了丈夫的殴打。
3932dad5fbc1e4fe7378abdbc83dce58ce030758.translatedText: She recalled that she was beaten for the first time by her husband just a few weeks after their marriage when she accidentally bumped into the manager of the apartment building.

a60bc83b1c0237c9e07e488d7108fd4290feaf0c.sourceText: 丈夫对她说：”你必须听我的话，我是你的上帝。你必须遵守这些规定。”
a60bc83b1c0237c9e07e488d7108fd4290feaf0c.translatedText: The husband said to her: "You must listen to me, I am your God. You must abide by these rules."

3e1b6d41067eab6cbb694e99e7b5951ebb1f690d.sourceText: 奥尔森的儿子还不到10岁，被迫学习阿拉伯语功课，由于学习不好，几乎每天受到殴打。
3e1b6d41067eab6cbb694e99e7b5951ebb1f690d.translatedText: Olson's son was less than 10 years old and was forced to learn Arabic lessons. Because he did not study well, he was beaten almost every day.

b44baf3a438e79175b0218572b8e8f5dce1515ac.sourceText: 美大城市房价年涨9.3%七年最高 周二，据史坦普/凯斯-席勒房价指数对美国20个大城市所做点差显示，美国2月份房价较一年前同期上涨9.3%，达7年来最高。 房屋需求增加，待售房屋库存量减少以及止赎房屋减少使得房屋供需不平衡，从而推高房价上涨。 根据该指数显示，全美20个大城市房价皆连续第二个月较去年同期上涨，其中亚特兰大房价上涨16.5%，为21年来最大涨幅，达拉斯则上涨7.1%，创12年来最大增幅。 较去年同期相比，凤凰城房价上涨23%，居各城市之首，紧随其后的分别是旧金山和拉斯维加斯，涨幅为19%和18%。 纽约、波士顿和芝加哥三个东部沿海城市较一年前同期相比涨幅最小。 但房地产信息网站Zillow的首席经济学家亨弗利Stan Humphries警告说，”这项房价指数并不能广泛地反映全美房市。”他认为，大城市房价的涨幅并不能有效反映全美房价状况，且法拍屋减少会使得房价增幅显得异常剧烈。 该指数共同创办人席勒Robert Shiller也说，”房价上涨的态势可能仅为短期现象，10年後的房价经通膨调整後会跟现在相去不远。”他认为，联准会每月收购850亿元的债券，将房贷利率维持低点，造成房市处於一种”异常经济。”席勒指出，目前房价涨幅最大的为多家庭住宅，而非一家庭独栋屋，反映整体趋势是从拥屋转为租屋。他建议，有意投资房产者应购买适合转做出租的房子。
b44baf3a438e79175b0218572b8e8f5dce1515ac.translatedText: House prices in major U.S. cities rose 9.3% annually, the highest in seven years. On Tuesday, according to the spread of the S&P/Case-Shiller House Price Index for 20 major U.S. cities, U.S. home prices rose 9.3% in February from the same period a year ago, reaching the highest level in seven years. Increased demand for homes, a reduction in the inventory of homes for sale and fewer foreclosures have created an imbalance between supply and demand for homes, pushing up home prices. According to the index, housing prices in 20 major cities in the United States have increased for the second consecutive month compared with the same period last year. Atlanta's housing prices rose 16.5%, the largest increase in 21 years, and Dallas's rose 7.1%, the largest increase in 12 years. Compared with the same period last year, Phoenix home prices increased by 23%, ranking first among cities, followed by San Francisco and Las Vegas, with increases of 19% and 18% respectively. Three Eastern seaboard cities, New York, Boston and Chicago, saw the smallest increases compared with the same period a year ago. But Stan Humphries, chief economist at Zillow, a real estate information website, warned that "this housing price index does not broadly reflect the U.S. housing market." He believes that the increase in housing prices in large cities does not effectively reflect the situation of U.S. housing prices, and the reduction in foreclosures will make the increase in housing prices appear unusually sharp. Robert Shiller, co-founder of the index, also said, "The upward trend in housing prices may only be a short-term phenomenon. After adjusting for inflation, housing prices in 10 years will not be far from what they are now." He believes that the Federal Reserve purchases 85 billion yuan in bonds every month to keep mortgage interest rates at a low level, causing the housing market to be in an "abnormal economy." Shiller pointed out that the largest increase in housing prices is currently for multi-family residences, not single-family houses, reflecting the overall trend of shifting from homeownership to renting. He suggested that those who intend to invest in real estate should buy a house that is suitable for conversion to rental.

0013d08fc9f94f79016cff5da3c22d35349ceec4.sourceText: 据有线电视新闻网财经频道（CNNMoney）报道，各州高等教育执行官协会（State Higher Education Executive Officers Association）发表的报告说，前一学年每个学生平均学费为4793美元。
0013d08fc9f94f79016cff5da3c22d35349ceec4.translatedText: According to CNNMoney, a report issued by the State Higher Education Executive Officers Association stated that the average tuition per student in the previous academic year was $4,793.

04a6d53ae00edae5bdc1335c360aae9d8d811c35.sourceText: 同时，各州和地方政府去年对高校的营运开支、研究和学生资助平均为5896美元，下降9%，也是25年来的最低水平。
04a6d53ae00edae5bdc1335c360aae9d8d811c35.translatedText: At the same time, state and local government spending on operating expenses, research and student aid to colleges and universities averaged $5,896 last year, a 9% decrease and the lowest level in 25 years.

020cb01bfb1a9403dddfb5a4aee8d6c524e0f15e.sourceText: 协会主席林根菲尔特（Paul Lingenfelter）说，各州资助跟不上招生增长步伐。
020cb01bfb1a9403dddfb5a4aee8d6c524e0f15e.translatedText: Paul Lingenfelter, president of the association, said state funding has not kept pace with enrollment growth.

d8911b9f325df2ce3c4ce19c853157fddb386ae1.sourceText: 公立高校招生过去十年来爆炸性增长，升幅超过30%。今天公立高校占所有高等教育机构学生人数的70%以上。
d8911b9f325df2ce3c4ce19c853157fddb386ae1.translatedText: Public college enrollment has grown explosively in the past decade, with an increase of more than 30%. Today public colleges and universities account for more than 70% of the student population in all higher education institutions.

f2fdc8a5af76ae4307722eed93d9129fce2c4f3a.sourceText: 随着各州资助下降，高校转向学费和其它收费来弥补资金不足。有些州学费急剧增长。例如，由于加州预算大幅削减，州立大学和学院去年平均学费提高将近50%。
f2fdc8a5af76ae4307722eed93d9129fce2c4f3a.translatedText: As state funding declines, colleges and universities are turning to tuition and other fees to make up for the shortfall. Some states have experienced steep tuition increases. For example, due to deep budget cuts in California, average tuition at state universities and colleges increased by nearly 50% last year.

d9699058558624c30e9615ac6c2ef66f3f5fdf49.sourceText: 林根菲尔特说，经济情况正在缓慢改善，31个州为本学年增加拨款。他说，我们希望看到复苏。但没有人可以低估我们所陷入的大洞有多深。
d9699058558624c30e9615ac6c2ef66f3f5fdf49.translatedText: Lingenfeldt said the economic situation is slowly improving, with 31 states increasing funding for this school year. 'We want to see a recovery,' he said. But no one can underestimate the depth of the hole we have fallen into.

0e1dc4e68c5418b5214c3ccef81457b5d4e30d2f.sourceText: 该协会的报告包括从社区学院到公立法学院在内的所有州立高校的学费数字。但那些数字不包括学生的食宿费等开支。
0e1dc4e68c5418b5214c3ccef81457b5d4e30d2f.translatedText: The association's report includes tuition figures for all state colleges and universities, from community colleges to public law schools. But those figures don’t include student expenses such as room and board.

50550a21103130f7632fb75c2bd20bb84ce60087.sourceText: (亚省现代中文学校供稿) 2月4日恰逢立春之日，亚省现代中文学校的部分校长们欢聚一堂，畅叙友情，回顾共同努力的时光。大家对学校将来的发展献计献策，并提出了许多宝贵的建议。
50550a21103130f7632fb75c2bd20bb84ce60087.translatedText: (Contributed by the Alberta Modern Chinese School) February 4th coincides with the beginning of spring. Some principals of the Alberta Modern Chinese School gathered together to talk about friendship and review the time of working together. Everyone made suggestions for the future development of the school and put forward many valuable suggestions.

235355c889c230c60c9c6225229966d7f42410e7.sourceText: 亚省现代中文学校成立于1996年，由当初的20几位注册学生发展到今天拥有500多位注册学生的学校，并被中国国务院侨务办公室和中国海外交流协会评为海外”华文教育示范学校”。回首20多年走过的路，每一步都刻满了众多志愿者们的无私奉献，老师们的辛勤耕耘，以及家长朋友们的鼎立支持，特别是校长们的坚持不懈。学校的今天离不开各位校长的心血，也离不开每一位义工的辛劳。亚省现代中文学校不会忘记他们为学校的发展所付出的艰辛！
235355c889c230c60c9c6225229966d7f42410e7.translatedText: The Alberta Modern Chinese School was established in 1996 and has grown from a few registered students to a school with more than 500 registered students today. And was rated as an overseas "Chinese Education Demonstration School" by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council and the China Overseas Exchange Association. Looking back on the road we have traveled over the past 20 years, every step has been engraved with the selfless dedication of many volunteers, the hard work of teachers, and the strong support of parents and friends, especially the perseverance of the principals. The school today is inseparable from the efforts of the principals and the hard work of every volunteer. The school will not forget their hard work for the development of the school!

8bf0b408cdac8553b4d9de75707272a460b9dbe1.sourceText: 亚省现代中文学校不忘初心，与时俱进，求真务实，开拓创新，始终将学生和家长的需求放在首位。考虑到学生们的不同年龄，不同层次，和不同文化背景的因素，学校除继续使用中国暨南大学中文教材和马立平中文教材外，还采用双双中文教材。同时，低年级的班级开展亲子阅读活动，高年级的班级增设中国历史文化课程，使亚省现代中文学校的中文课程设置独树一帜。此次聚会，更加确定了学校将来的发展方向。亚省现代中文学校将继续秉承为社区服务的宗旨，在注重教学质量的同时，将学校办成一个学生和家长喜爱的大家庭！
8bf0b408cdac8553b4d9de75707272a460b9dbe1.translatedText: Alberta Modern Chinese School remains true to its original aspirations, keeps pace with the times, is pragmatic, innovative, and always puts the needs of students and parents first. Taking into account the different ages, levels, and cultural backgrounds of the students, the school continues to use Chinese textbooks from Jinan University of China and Ma Liping Chinese textbooks. Both Chinese textbooks are used. At the same time, parent-child reading activities are carried out in the lower grade classes, and Chinese history and culture courses are added to the upper grade classes, making the Chinese curriculum of the Alberta Modern Chinese School unique. This gathering further determines the future development direction of the school. While focusing on the quality of teaching, the school will become a big family loved by students and parents!

de1212fe0666556d0a9ee7081a4468337deb4650.translatedText: Advantages of investing in real estate in Phoenix, Arizona Advantages of investing in real estate in Phoenix, Arizona Recently, housing prices in first-tier cities such as Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen have risen. In response to this, the United States...

0074590ab73b79671c6609a3e09290c1024b1a37.sourceText: 近期，中国北上深等一线城市房价攀升，对此美国前驻华大使骆家辉表示，中国投资者最近也在美国一线城市引发了房地产投资热、在他看来，中国投资者在美国现在更多把眼光放在美国的一线城市，像纽约、旧金山，但像美国的二线城市，比如圣地亚哥、凤凰城等这样的城市也是有很多机会的。
0074590ab73b79671c6609a3e09290c1024b1a37.translatedText: Recently, housing prices in first-tier cities such as Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen have risen. Former US Ambassador to China Gary Locke said that Chinese investors have recently triggered a real estate investment boom in first-tier cities in the United States. In his opinion, Chinese investors in the United States are now focusing more on first-tier cities in the United States, such as New York and San Francisco, but there are also many opportunities in second-tier cities in the United States, such as San Diego and Phoenix.

4d13c25bee08a0db4142a3f2b344f6022d8bb9a7.sourceText: 凤凰商贸城是美国政府扶植的救市项目之一，发展商考察了美国数十个城市，最后选择落户凤凰城和图桑之间的凯撒市，受到亚利桑那州、皮纳尔郡、凯撒城三级政府的欢迎和支持。州，郡，市各级政府官员都积极参与了此项目的规划和推进，并承诺过去三年中不仅没有受到经济危机的影响，财政收入还增加了3倍。项目的新闻发布会都是由凯撒市政府主持对外发布的，凯撒市政府对此项目拨款4000万美元，也是史无前例。政府在投资前对所有投资环境进行了估值监督，在资本创收以及成本节约方面与开发商达成了空前的共识。政府的全力支持是凤凰商贸城成功的保证。
4d13c25bee08a0db4142a3f2b344f6022d8bb9a7.translatedText: Phoenix Trade City is one of the rescue projects supported by the U.S. government. The developer inspected dozens of cities in the United States and finally chose to settle in Caesar City between Phoenix and Tucson. It was welcomed and supported by the governments of Arizona, Pinal County, and Caesar City. Government officials at state, county, and city levels have actively participated in the planning and promotion of this project, and have promised that not only has it not been affected by the economic crisis in the past three years, but its fiscal revenue has also increased threefold. The press conferences for the project were all hosted by the Caesars City Government, which allocated an unprecedented US$40 million to the project. The government has conducted valuation supervision on all investment environments before investment, and has reached an unprecedented consensus with developers in terms of capital income generation and cost savings. The full support of the government is the guarantee for the success of Phoenix Trade City.

ca0ce763bce37d58cc9cc97e7dcdecd22d72ab31.sourceText: 其实凤凰城只是别名，官方的名字是菲尼克斯（英文：Phoenix），是美国亚利桑那州的州府及最大的城市，也是美国最大的首府城市之一，人口超过其他州首府及美国首都华盛顿特区。凤凰城的面积居全美首府城市的第三位，仅次于阿拉斯加州首府朱诺和俄克拉荷马州首府俄克拉荷马市。美国城市是看都会区，而不是看city；我们通常提到的凤凰城，指的是凤凰城都会区。
ca0ce763bce37d58cc9cc97e7dcdecd22d72ab31.translatedText: In fact, Phoenix is ​​just an alias. The official name is Phoenix (English: Phoenix). It is the capital and largest city of the state of Arizona in the United States. It is also one of the largest capital cities in the United States. Its population exceeds that of other state capitals and the U.S. capital Washington, DC. Phoenix is ​​the third largest capital city in the United States, behind Juneau, Alaska, and Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. American cities are measured by metropolitan area, not by city; when we usually mention Phoenix, we refer to the Phoenix metropolitan area.

b48fd2208f27dfe08d9ed9f4508e279fb2bf7ba9.sourceText: 在《财富》杂志评选的”财富1000强”企业中，有三所总部位于凤凰城，电器公司Avnet，阿波罗集团（凤凰城大学由该公司运营）及矿业公Phelps Dodge Corporation。Honeywell在凤凰城有多家工厂生产军工级引擎，并设有公司网关。英特尔在凤凰城设有亚利桑那州最大的研发中心之一；美国运通的结算中心、客服中心和全部网站都位于凤凰城。此外，坦佩也是名列”财富500强”全美航空公司的总部所在地。
b48fd2208f27dfe08d9ed9f4508e279fb2bf7ba9.translatedText: >Among the "Fortune 1000" companies selected by Fortune magazine, three are headquartered in Phoenix, the electrical appliance company Avnet, the Apollo Group (the University of Phoenix is ​​operated by the company) and the mining company Phelps Dodge Corporation. Honeywell has several factories in Phoenix that produce military-grade engines and has a corporate gateway. Intel has one of Arizona's largest R&D centers in Phoenix; American Express's settlement center, customer service center and all websites are located in Phoenix. In addition, Tempe is also the headquarters of US Airways, a Fortune 500 company.

936a9eba35404614b51da80586c4500f790b0359.sourceText: 凤凰城的高等教育以亚利桑那州立大学为主，此外还有凤凰城大学、大峡谷学院等。亚利桑那州立大学（Arizona State University (ASU)），是全美最大的公立大学之一，其主校区位于坦佩，在凤凰城、Glendale和梅萨Mesa设有分校。亚利桑那州立大学的应届毕业生都有着不错的就业前景。据统计，亚利桑那州立大学在全美最受欢迎的大学就业排行中排名第5，其毕业生的就业率达到了87%。
936a9eba35404614b51da80586c4500f790b0359.translatedText: Higher education in Phoenix is ​​dominated by Arizona State University, in addition to the University of Phoenix, Grand Canyon College, etc. Arizona State University (ASU) is one of the largest public universities in the United States, with its main campus in Tempe and branch campuses in Phoenix, Glendale and Mesa. Arizona State University graduates have good employment prospects. According to statistics, Arizona State University ranks fifth among the most popular universities in the United States for employment, with an employment rate of 87% for its graduates.

f9ad6ad108b335f1a3e9f07ad061bd8a6d26d3ad.sourceText: 科罗拉多大峡谷（The Grand Canyon）是世界上最大的峡谷之一，也是地球上自然界七大奇景之一，全世界许多到过此地的人为之感叹：只有闻名遐迩的科罗拉多大峡谷才是美国真正的象征。科罗拉多河奔流不息，历时万年切割岩层，形成绵延 277 英里的科罗拉多大峡谷。峡谷蜿蜒曲折，两山壁立，一水中流，气势磅礴，雄伟壮观。在2014年美国最佳旅行城市的评选中，冠军和季军分别由亚利桑那州的塞多纳和凤凰城当选。每年成千上万的国内外游客到这里旅游，欣赏大自然的鬼斧神工，认识地球亿万年的神奇变化。自驾爱好者，一路驰骋在峡谷、沙漠和仙人掌中间，绝对是今生独一无二的体验。
f9ad6ad108b335f1a3e9f07ad061bd8a6d26d3ad.translatedText: The Grand Canyon is one of the largest canyons in the world and one of the seven wonders of nature on earth. Many people who have visited this place lament that only the famous Grand Canyon is the true symbol of the United States. The Colorado River has cut through rock formations over thousands of years to form the 277-mile-long Grand Canyon. The canyon is winding and winding, with two mountains standing on the wall and one water flowing, which is majestic and majestic. In the selection of the best travel cities in the United States in 2014, Sedona and Phoenix in Arizona were selected as the first and third place respectively. Thousands of domestic and foreign tourists travel here every year to appreciate the miraculous workmanship of nature and understand the magical changes of the earth over hundreds of millions of years. For self-driving enthusiasts, driving all the way through canyons, deserts and cacti is definitely a unique experience in this life.

f4bf0517a09718e1bc6549c9dd085d3a187ae747.sourceText: 亚利桑那州境内有40号、17号、10号及8号等四条州际高速公路，连接东西高速公路干线。两条横贯全美的铁路干线经过本州，南部为南太平洋干线，北部为圣塔菲干线。另有四条州内铁路连接各城市。位于凤凰城的天港国际机场是全美航空、西南航空的枢杻港，是亚利桑那州最大的机场，也是美国第八繁忙机场。亚利桑那州西接加利福利亚州和内华达州，从凤凰城乘坐飞机，1小时可以到达拉斯维加斯，1.5小时到达洛杉矶，2小时到达旧金山。
f4bf0517a09718e1bc6549c9dd085d3a187ae747.translatedText: There are four interstate highways in Arizona, namely No. 40, No. 17, No. 10 and No. 8, connecting the east-west highway trunk lines. Two major railroad lines across the United States pass through the state, the Southern Pacific Main Line in the south and the Santa Fe Main Line in the north. There are also four intrastate railways connecting various cities. Sky Harbor International Airport in Phoenix is ​​the hub for US Airways and Southwest Airlines. It is the largest airport in Arizona and the eighth busiest airport in the United States. Arizona borders California and Nevada to the west. From Phoenix, you can reach Las Vegas in 1 hour, Los Angeles in 1.5 hours, and San Francisco in 2 hours.

375bdd6fea41b456d479f48ed5d083c399ab6261.sourceText: 凤凰城都会区— 梅萨市

51ff1a69a39079f76f4dd6a2d80f401321fada85.sourceText: 提到凤凰城，我们不得不说说凤凰城都会区— 梅萨市。梅萨是亚利桑那州的第三大城市，位于都会区东部的”东部峡谷”（也称太阳谷）地区，距离凤凰城市中心和机场15分钟车程直达。梅萨是全美人口增长最快的城市之一，人口数超过了迈阿密和匹兹堡。梅萨是亚利桑那高科技集中地带，汇集了像可口可乐、波音、班纳医疗和英特尔这样的世界一流企业。亚利桑那州立大学在此设有分校。
51ff1a69a39079f76f4dd6a2d80f401321fada85.translatedText: When it comes to Phoenix, we have to talk about the Phoenix Metropolitan Area - Mesa. Mesa is the third largest city in Arizona. It is located in the "Eastern Canyon" (also known as Sun Valley) area in the eastern part of the metropolitan area. It is a 15-minute drive from downtown Phoenix and the airport. Mesa has one of the fastest-growing populations in the United States, surpassing Miami and Pittsburgh in population. Mesa is Arizona's high-tech hub, home to world-class companies like Coca-Cola, Boeing, Banner Healthcare and Intel. Arizona State University has a campus here.

d24e6ec0234c3f6f0124085d9e969fd8c92c73d7.sourceText: 根据房地长门户网站zillow的数据，凤凰城的房产 今年1月的中位数为 $217,400，较去年同期增长8.2%；今年1月租赁中位数为$1,253，较去年同期增长3.6% 。 与此同时，无论是从城市的建设、教育、旅游业的角度来看，凤凰城的房产都有很大的升值空间。
d24e6ec0234c3f6f0124085d9e969fd8c92c73d7.translatedText: According to data from real estate portal zillow, the median real estate price in Phoenix was $217,400 in January this year, an increase of 8.2% from the same period last year; the median rental price in January this year was $1,253, an increase of 3.6% from the same period last year. At the same time, whether from the perspective of urban construction, education, or tourism, real estate in Phoenix has great room for appreciation.

fc4982ef8fc09bb5d522d391b0cd459d31fa7e9b.sourceText: 亚利桑拉州，虔德乐市， TARWATER小学的四年级学生，龚欣然（Amanda Gong）在the Paws for Reading Scholastic Books Drawing/Photo Contest中获奖，龚欣然的参赛作品 >从全美两万余作品中脱颖而出，成TOP TEN获奖者。 龚欣然的参赛作品 >是一副炭笔素描画作品，画的一只狗正在阅读小猫故事书的情景。画面狗狗形象生动，构图简练，黑白对比鲜明，狗狗读书的画面，象童话一样充满神秘感，象漫画一样有着浪漫和幽默，是一幅难得的好作品。
fc4982ef8fc09bb5d522d391b0cd459d31fa7e9b.translatedText: Gong Xinran (Amanda), a fourth-grade student at TARWATER Elementary School in Qiandele City, Arizona Gong) won the award in the Paws for Reading Scholastic Books Drawing/Photo Contest. Gong Xinran’s entry stood out from more than 20,000 entries across the United States and became the TOP TEN winner. Gong Xinran's entry is a charcoal sketch of a dog reading a kitten storybook. The image of the dog in the picture is vivid, the composition is concise, and the contrast between black and white is sharp. The picture of the dog reading is full of mystery like a fairy tale, and has romance and humor like a comic. It is a rare and good work.

6d40ea61f79de0b19cf21c813f32d6f1ede6dbc3.sourceText: 龚欣然 举办者Scholastic 的绘画比赛奖品是200本精美的图画书籍，其中100本赠送给龚欣然所在学校，另外100本精美的图画书籍赠送给龚欣然本人收藏。龚欣然同学获奖绘画作品，不光为亚省的学校赢得荣誉，也是华人学生的骄傲。 龚欣然（Amanda Gong）虽然师从林萱老师学习画画只有一年时间，可她在体育，舞蹈，文学等方面广泛的爱好，让她有很好的形象观察能力，和领悟能力，我们祝贺龚欣然的参赛作品 >从全美TOP TEN获奖者. 也祝福和期待Amanda Gong有更多的作品让我们欣赏。
6d40ea61f79de0b19cf21c813f32d6f1ede6dbc3.translatedText: Gong Xinran The prize for the painting competition organized by Scholastic is 200 exquisite picture books, 100 of which are given to Gong Xinran’s school, and the other 100 exquisite picture books are given to Gong Xinran’s personal collection. Gong Xinran’s award-winning paintings not only win honors for schools in Alberta, but are also the pride of Chinese students. Although Amanda Gong has only been studying painting with teacher Lin Xuan for one year, her wide range of hobbies in sports, dance, literature, etc. have given her good image observation and comprehension abilities. We congratulate Gong Xinran on her entry > TOP TEN winner from the United States. We also wish and look forward to Amanda Gong having more works for us to appreciate.

98f72f7360bd729f6450dcbc4093a92295ab03c8.sourceText: 8张票转7次车才到家，他怎么想的？
98f72f7360bd729f6450dcbc4093a92295ab03c8.translatedText: It took 8 tickets and 7 train transfers to get home. What did he think?

bd6e7e82f9b209939334c3989bf1661a43a7ac66.sourceText: 换乘代替直达居然能省13个小时
bd6e7e82f9b209939334c3989bf1661a43a7ac66.translatedText: Transferring instead of going direct can actually save 13 hours

fbe046112ea6e128b3d454f483e7cf8878232570.sourceText: 从上海到四川德阳，横跨大半个中国，这趟家怎么回，先来看看”换乘达人”的路线：上海虹桥南京南；南京南（湖北）麻城北；麻城北汉口；汉口荆州；荆州宜昌东；宜昌东（四川）达州；达州成都东；成都德阳。如此折腾下来，一共买了8张票，要换乘7次。设计出这条路线的小王是一位27岁的小伙子，正在上海复旦大学攻读博士。
fbe046112ea6e128b3d454f483e7cf8878232570.translatedText: From Shanghai to Deyang, Sichuan, spanning more than half of China, how do you get home this time? , let’s first take a look at the routes of “Transfer Master”: Shanghai Hongqiao Nanjing South; Nanjing South (Hubei) Macheng North; Macheng North Hankou; Hankou Jingzhou; Jingzhou Yichang East; Yichang East (Sichuan) Dazhou; Dazhou Chengdu East; Chengdu Deyang. After all this hassle, I bought a total of 8 tickets and had to transfer 7 times. Xiao Wang, who designed this route, is a 27-year-old young man who is studying for a doctorate at Fudan University in Shanghai.

2d24580a06f7a2cb49246cd48c8b9d0867dfe066.sourceText: 一般情况下，从上海到四川，大多数人会选择乘坐上海到成都的直达车。为何小王选择多次换乘”曲线回家”呢？他告诉记者，他其实是个”吃货”，想去武汉买个鸭脖子，没想到后来就搞成了这个样子。另外这条路线看上去麻烦，但实际上速度更快。”以前从上海到成都，只有’K字头’的车，一趟要30多个小时，今年新开了’Z字头’的直达特快车，但也要29个小时。我这条路线，虽然7次换乘，但在车上的时间只有17个小时左右。”
2d24580a06f7a2cb49246cd48c8b9d0867dfe066.translatedText: Generally, from Shanghai to Sichuan, most people will choose to take the direct train from Shanghai to Chengdu. Why did Xiao Wang choose to transfer to the "curve home" multiple times? He told reporters that he was actually a "foodie" and wanted to buy a duck neck in Wuhan, but he didn't expect that it would end up like this. Plus this route looks cumbersome but is actually faster. "In the past, there were only trains starting with 'K' from Shanghai to Chengdu, and one trip took more than 30 hours. This year, a new direct express train started with 'Z' was opened, but it also took 29 hours. Although I changed trains 7 times on this route, I only spent 17 hours on the bus. About an hour. "

ca4ada5380715d7983957de129147be3afc202fa.sourceText: 根据小王晒出的火车票，他将在2月8日下午1点半从上海出发，到达成都时为次日上午10点多，路上一共节省了13个小时。小王回到德阳老家时，正好是大年三十的中午。这一路购买的8张车票一共640元，比”上海成都；成都德阳”的传统路线贵了100多元，不过在春运路上，一寸光阴一寸金，用小王的话说，”就是多花100元，换回了13个小时。”
ca4ada5380715d7983957de129147be3afc202fa.translatedText: According to the train ticket posted by Xiao Wang, he will depart from Shanghai at 1:30 pm on February 8 and arrive in Chengdu at around 10 am the next day, saving a total of 13 hours on the road. When Xiao Wang returned to his hometown in Deyang, it happened to be noon on New Year's Eve. The 8 tickets purchased along the way cost a total of 640 yuan, which is more than 100 yuan more expensive than the traditional route of "Shanghai to Chengdu; Chengdu to Deyang". However, on the Spring Festival transportation road, every inch of time is worth every inch of money. In Xiao Wang's words, "It is an extra 100 yuan spent in exchange for 13 hours."

7dee10ce78031ec62e5c573cb70ee7c6d43a2b05.sourceText: 小王还说，过年回家直通车票难买，转车买票就轻松很多，最近几年都转车回家。
7dee10ce78031ec62e5c573cb70ee7c6d43a2b05.translatedText: Xiao Wang also said that it is difficult to buy a direct ticket to go home during the New Year, so it is much easier to buy tickets by changing trains. In recent years, he has changed trains to go home.

7e7c8c2383e3f94cadd1e3ec53e4666882876842.sourceText: 转车越多风险越大，他不怕晚点吗？
7e7c8c2383e3f94cadd1e3ec53e4666882876842.translatedText: The more transfers there are, the greater the risk. Isn’t he afraid of delays?

cf86bfc2ca82474c5d802ba34a9057f2f958831f.sourceText: 他很有信心，用专业网站查看晚点概率
cf86bfc2ca82474c5d802ba34a9057f2f958831f.translatedText: He was very confident and used a professional website to check the probability of delays

45383089f368a0645a734b83df946c95ee3acfd6.sourceText: 今年2月1日，小王在微博上一口气”晒出”8张火车票，引来众多网友围观。网友在”膜拜”这位换乘达人的同时，也抛出了不少疑问。除了”曲线回家”的时间、花费，提及最多的就是购票问题以及这条路线的晚点风险。一些网友认为，换乘次数越多晚点风险越高。
45383089f368a0645a734b83df946c95ee3acfd6.translatedText: On February 1 this year, Xiao Wang "posted" 8 train tickets on Weibo, attracting many netizens to watch. While netizens "worshiped" this transfer expert, they also raised many questions. In addition to the time and cost of "going home in a curve", the most frequently mentioned issue is the issue of ticket purchase and the risk of delays on this route. Some netizens believe that the more transfers there are, the higher the risk of delays.

401244f277ddc2c3c843a02d6ce6409d2f0c7b9c.sourceText: 小王告诉记者，在购买”南京南麻城北”的这张票时，他专门在网上”蹲守”，一有票放出，就立刻行动，才成功到手。”此外，其他的七张票都比较’冷门’，很顺利就买到了。”而对于”晚点风险”的困惑，小王表示，其实现在90%的火车班次都不会晚点。他还向大家推荐一个技术达人制作的网站，收集火车班次的数据，分析出每一趟车的晚点概率，”我在购票前，都会登录该网站，这一路，选择的路线都是晚点概率极小的。”
401244f277ddc2c3c843a02d6ce6409d2f0c7b9c.translatedText: Xiao Wang told reporters that when buying the ticket for "Nanjing Nanmacheng North", he specifically "sited" online. As soon as the ticket was released, he acted immediately and successfully obtained it. "In addition, the other seven tickets were relatively 'unpopular' and I bought them easily." As for the confusion about the "risk of delays", Xiao Wang said that in fact, 90% of trains are now not late. He also recommended a website made by a technical expert to collect train schedule data and analyze the delay probability of each train. "I will log in to this website before buying tickets. Along the way, I will choose routes with extremely low probability of delay."

4635880bd1807c100ece2c8ad8f9c6fa49d67f9f.sourceText: 即将踏上回家旅途了，小王坦言有些”激动”。由于这次转车回家要经历5个客运段担当的列车，他在微博里@了这五个客运段”求保佑”，希望他们的列车都能准时准点到达，不要耽误他的行程。
4635880bd1807c100ece2c8ad8f9c6fa49d67f9f.translatedText: About to embark on the journey home, Xiao Wang admitted that he was a little "excited". Since he had to go through five passenger trains to transfer home this time, he @these five passenger trains on Weibo, "Please bless", hoping that their trains would arrive on time and not delay his trip.

aae4af41d209989cdbc8fc6947817ed26ff8c759.translatedText: Long-distance love forced him to design a route

2893078b81e928ddb87080f933378c07adc05dd5.sourceText: 小王透露，他在上海读书，而女友人在福建。每次两人相会，如果从上海坐直达车，就要花很长时间，而且都是晚上到。”为了两人尽快见面，我就开始研究通过换乘，减少路程时间。”为此，他会在前一天夜里出发，中途到浙江的杭州、金华、宁波，有时甚至转到江西。如此看上去虽然麻烦，但他第二天中午前后就能与女友见面了。从换乘中尝到”甜头”的小王前两年过年回家时，他就开始自己设计路线了。
2893078b81e928ddb87080f933378c07adc05dd5.translatedText: Xiao Wang revealed that he was studying in Shanghai and his girlfriend was in Fujian. Every time the two of them met, it would take a long time to take a direct train from Shanghai, and they would arrive at night. "In order for the two of us to meet as soon as possible, I began to study how to reduce the journey time by transferring." To this end, he would set off the night before, visiting Hangzhou, Jinhua, Ningbo, Zhejiang, and sometimes even transfer to Jiangxi. Although it seemed troublesome, he was able to meet his girlfriend around noon the next day. Xiao Wang, who has tasted the "sweetness" of transferring, began to design his own route when he returned home for the Chinese New Year two years ago.

c76192291b19068082ef0bbc4b99b6483cba907f.sourceText: 美国海关与边境保护署图森分局官员说，他们在一名墨西哥男子身上查获16万9千未申报美国货币。 12日，丹尼斯迪康西尼口岸检查人员随机检查一名带着小童过关的墨西哥男子。 检查人员发现他们的卡车扬声器被修改过，于是进一步搜查，结果发现19包现金，合共168,998美元。 这些未申报的现金和车辆被扣押处理，该名35岁男子被逮捕并移交美国移民和海关执法的国土安全局调查，小童被交给他的母亲，没有进一步被指控。
c76192291b19068082ef0bbc4b99b6483cba907f.translatedText: U.S. Customs and Border Protection Tucson branch officials said they seized 169,000 undeclared U.S. currency on a Mexican man. On the 12th, Dennis DiConcini port inspectors randomly inspected a Mexican man who was crossing the border with a child. Inspectors discovered their truck's speakers had been modified, and further searches revealed 19 packages of cash totaling $168,998. The undeclared cash and vehicle were seized and the 35-year-old man was arrested and turned over to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement's Homeland Security agency for investigation. The child was released to his mother without further charges.

cac3285ad6d686d8df3d3532cec9172cf23f8399.translatedText: Another 5 states have fallen, stink bugs are infesting 38 states

61d906363ab6c9dec7a469f3ab7324f9786626f4.sourceText: 又5州沦陷 臭屁虫肆虐38州 （亚省时报） 又到了臭龟子(stink bug，又称椿象虫或臭屁虫)登堂入…
61d906363ab6c9dec7a469f3ab7324f9786626f4.translatedText: > Another 5 states have been lost, stink bugs are infesting 38 states (Alberta Times) The stink bug (also known as stink bug or stink bug) has entered the country again...

c4950ecd897f4fbca8f683fafe16fea89284a785.sourceText: 又到了臭龟子(stink bug，又称椿象虫或臭屁虫)登堂入室的时候，每年入秋这种臭虫就开始爬进屋子里，让美国各地屋主感到无奈。 这种虫子喜欢藏在阁楼和墙里，受到惊吓或被压扁时会发出臭气，所以得名。 根据农业部的报告，美国已有38州发现臭龟子，多于去年的33州。 新「沦陷」的五州是密苏里、堪萨斯、新墨西哥、德州和爱达荷州。 专家说，臭龟子通常在9月底和10月初迁往室内，它们在冬天会进入冬眠，开春后恢复活动。 农业部的资料显示，濒临大西洋的美国东岸中部地区仍然是臭龟子的大本营，宾州、新泽西、德拉瓦、马里兰、西维吉尼亚、维吉尼亚和华府是重灾区。 华府即有59%居民表示遭遇过这种臭虫，远高于全国21%的平均值。 专家表示，今年开春后异常的长时间高温，使臭龟子得以繁衍两代。 全国害虫控制协会(NPMA)说：「濒临大西洋中部地带今夏长时间持续炎热，使臭龟子的数量比去年高出很多。现在天气变凉，也有更多臭龟子找地方过冬。」 NPMA说，臭龟子对屋主的财物或安全不会构成严重危害，不过臭虫大军入侵可能让人受不了，有些房子甚至出现几百只或几千只臭虫。 臭龟子对农作物为害更大。 农业部专家说，它们不挑嘴，苹果、桃子、玉米、青椒、蕃茄、葡萄、红莓和大豆，什么都吃。 因此农业部正参与消灭这种1990年代意外从亚洲进入美国的害虫。 在本州，分别在去年四月和今年八月发现有臭屁虫的踪迹。
c4950ecd897f4fbca8f683fafe16fea89284a785.translatedText: The stink bug has arrived again... Bugs, also known as stink bugs or stink bugs, begin crawling into homes every fall, leaving homeowners across the United States helpless. This bug likes to hide in attics and walls and emits a foul odor when frightened or squashed, hence its name. According to a report from the Department of Agriculture, stink bug beetles have been found in 38 states in the United States, up from 33 states last year. The five newly "fallen" states are Missouri, Kansas, New Mexico, Texas and Idaho. Experts say that stink turtle beetles usually move indoors at the end of September and early October. They hibernate in winter and resume activity in spring. According to data from the Department of Agriculture, the central area of ​​the East Coast of the United States on the Atlantic Ocean is still the stronghold of the stink bug, with Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, Maryland, West Virginia, Virginia and Washington being the hardest-hit areas. Fifty-nine percent of D.C. residents reported encountering bedbugs, much higher than the national average of 21%. Experts said that the unusually long period of high temperatures since the beginning of spring this year allowed the turtle beetles to reproduce for two generations. The National Pest Control Association (NPMA) said: "The prolonged hot weather in the mid-Atlantic region this summer has caused the number of stink bugs to be much higher than last year. Now that the weather is cooler, more stink bugs are looking for places to spend the winter." The NPMA said that stink bugs do not pose a serious hazard to homeowners' property or safety, but the infestation of bed bugs can be unbearable, and some houses even have hundreds or thousands of bed bugs. Stink turtle beetles are more harmful to crops. Experts from the Ministry of Agriculture said they are not picky and will eat everything from apples, peaches, corn, green peppers, tomatoes, grapes, cranberries and soybeans. So the Department of Agriculture is getting involved in eradicating the pest, which accidentally entered the United States from Asia in the 1990s. In the state, traces of stink bugs were discovered in April last year and August this year.

2a61423807e10369e719d7b5aedbee42a15c1899.sourceText: 三家信用卡涉诈欺 600万卡户将获退款 持有美国运通卡、发现卡（Discover Card）和第一资本金融公司(Capital One)信用卡的客户请注意：如果您发现月结单上有退款，请不要惊讶。 国消费者金融保护局（CFPB）发现这三家信用卡发行公司对卡户有欺骗行为，认为它们欠了600万名客户4.35亿美元，已下令发卡公司退款。消费者无须采取任何行动，退款将很快入帐，美国运通卡已于10月开始发放，其他卡户多数将在明年三月底之前收到。 金融保护局发现，美国运通附属公司有许多违法行为，包括收了高过法律允许的滞纳费，并承诺客户一些不存在的奖励金，因而要求它退还8,500万美元给约25万客户。 例如，联邦监管机构发现，顾客们收到通知说美国运通百夫长银行(Centurion Bank)有一个300美元奖金的”蓝天”信用卡计划，但是很多参加的客户，并没有收到那300美元。现在联邦监管机构要求美国运通，把这笔奖金退还给客户。 美国运通表示，其他的退款将由个别情况而定，客户是否符合条件，已经由监管机构确定。 今年7月金融保护局也下令要第一资本金融公司（Capital One）退还1.5亿美元给200万客户，因为它的第三方供应商施压和误导信用卡客户去购买其他产品或服务。第一资本金融公司表示，将在今年第一季度发出退款。 2010年8月至2012年1月参加第一资本金融公司的支付保障或信用监控产品，但还没有拿到退款的持卡人，应可获得退款。第一资本金融公司表示，由于客户参加的时间不同，因此发放给客户的退款会有差异，但预计平均将低于100美元。 Two months after it announced its crackdown on Capital One, the CFPB金融保护局调查了第一资本金融公司两个月后，下令该银行需要退还2亿美元给超过350万持卡人，因为从2007年12月至2011年8月，该局发现该银行通过电话，要求客户购买信誉保障产品。 此外，发现公司（Discover）表示，预计在新的一年开始就发送退款，2月中旬完成退款工作。 金融保护局说，发现公司的电话销售员以欺骗的语言，说服持卡人买一些产品，包括身份盗窃保护、信用评分跟踪、钱包保护和支付保障。大部分的产品费用，介于每月2.99美元至9.99美元之间。 金融保护局发言人说，如果您认为您应该得到退款，但没有收到，请先与发卡公司联系。然后才联系金融保护局。
2a61423807e10369e719d7b5aedbee42a15c1899.translatedText: Three credit cards involved in fraud, 6 million cardholders will receive refunds Holders of American Express, Discover Card and Capital One One) Credit card customers, please note: Don’t be surprised if you see a chargeback on your monthly statement. The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) found that these three credit card issuers had defrauded cardholders. It believed that they owed 6 million customers US$435 million and ordered the card issuers to refund the money. Consumers do not need to take any action, and refunds will be credited to their accounts soon. American Express cards will begin issuing them in October, and most other cardholders will receive them before the end of March next year. The Financial Protection Bureau found that American Express affiliates committed numerous violations, including charging late fees that were higher than allowed by law and promising customers nonexistent bonuses, and ordered it to refund $85 million to about 250,000 customers. For example, federal regulators found that customers were notified that American Express Centurion Bank had a "Blue Sky" credit card program with a $300 bonus, but many customers who participated did not receive the $300. Now federal regulators are asking American Express to return the bonuses to customers. American Express said other refunds will be made on a case-by-case basis and whether customers qualify will be determined by regulators. In July this year, the Financial Protection Bureau also ordered Capital One to refund $150 million to 2 million customers because its third-party vendors pressured and misled credit card customers to purchase other products or services. Capital One said it will issue refunds in the first quarter of this year. Cardholders who participated in Capital One's payment protection or credit monitoring products from August 2010 to January 2012 but have not yet received their refunds should be able to receive their refunds. Capital One Financial said refunds issued to customers will vary depending on when they participated, but it is expected to average less than $100. Two months after it announced its crackdown on Capital One, the CFPB's Financial Protection Bureau investigated Capital One and ordered the bank to refund $200 million to more than 3.5 million cardholders after it discovered that from December 2007 to August 2011, the bank asked customers to purchase credit protection products over the phone. In addition, Discover stated that it expects to send refunds at the beginning of the new year and complete the refund process in mid-February. The Financial Protection Bureau said it found that the company's telemarketers used deceptive language to persuade cardholders to buy a number of products, including identity theft protection, credit score tracking, wallet protection and payment protection. Most product fees range from $2.99 ​​to $9.99 per month. A spokesman for the Financial Protection Authority said if you think you are due a refund but haven't received one, contact your card company first. Only then contact the Financial Protection Bureau.
