c0ed91734e55e8b7a28baee200fdda3c790b87f6.translatedText: Video: United States: Trump will deliver the State of the Union address for the first time today Source: CCTV News

55d6fb8e115ee93dee7ac67fe9be2e0312381545.sourceText: 中新网1月31日电 综合报道，当地时间30日晚，美国总统特朗普在国会发表国情咨文，这是他任上首次国情咨文演说。在演讲中，特朗普重点谈及了自己的移民政策，提出了一项包括四个要点的移民计划。
55d6fb8e115ee93dee7ac67fe9be2e0312381545.translatedText: China News Service, January 31 (Xinhua) Comprehensive report, on the evening of the 30th local time, US President Trump delivered the State of the Union address in Congress. This was his first State of the Union address in office. In his speech, Trump focused on his immigration policy and proposed an immigration plan that included four key points.

06e55937f6ab5f0efe999dfdfa6161d9397f67ab.sourceText: 特朗普称，数十年来，开放的边界让毒品和帮派涌入美国最脆弱的社区，数以百万计的低薪工人与最贫穷的美国人竞争就业和工资。他提到2016年9月2名被帮派谋杀的女孩。他表示，这个帮派中的许多人是利用法律漏洞，作为非法、无人陪伴的未成年人进入美国的。
06e55937f6ab5f0efe999dfdfa6161d9397f67ab.translatedText: > Trump said that for decades, open borders have allowed drugs and gangs to pour into America's most vulnerable communities, with millions of low-wage workers competing with the poorest Americans for jobs and wages. He mentioned two girls who were murdered by gangs in September 2016. He said many in the gang took advantage of legal loopholes to enter the United States as illegal, unaccompanied minors.

a979557df0fe02e08d8f33b36e442a680cdd025d.sourceText: 当地时间2018年1月30日，美国华盛顿，美国总统特朗普发表国情咨文演说，这是他本年度最重大的演说，预计将吸引4000万美国人观看。
a979557df0fe02e08d8f33b36e442a680cdd025d.translatedText: On January 30, 2018, local time, in Washington, the United States, U.S. President Trump delivered the State of the Union address. This is his most important speech of the year and is expected to attract 40 million Americans.

cdbd622fa9832d1cd9ed25d3f4e003cea868d356.sourceText: 特朗普呼吁国会，关闭允许此类犯罪团伙进入美国的”致命漏洞”。他表示，提出了新的立法，将修正美国的移民法，并支持美国移民及海关执法局(ICE)以及边境巡逻机构。
cdbd622fa9832d1cd9ed25d3f4e003cea868d356.translatedText: Trump called on Congress to close the "fatal loopholes" that allow such criminal gangs to enter the United States. He said he has proposed new legislation that would amend U.S. immigration laws and support U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Border Patrol agencies.

37c2464c614b0b359f2e4abc9eff9bbf4151feff.sourceText: 他强调，美国是一个“富有同情心”的国际，他们帮助世界各地需要帮助的人。但作为美国总统，他的”最高忠诚”，他一直关心的，是美国的孩子，美国挣扎求生的工人和美国北遗忘的社区。特朗普称，他邀请民主党人和共和党人共同合作，保护美国公民，不论他们是何种背景、肤色和信仰。
37c2464c614b0b359f2e4abc9eff9bbf4151feff.translatedText: He emphasized that the United States is a "compassionate" international and they help people in need around the world. But as president of the United States, his "highest loyalty" and what he has always cared about are America's children, America's struggling workers and America's forgotten communities in the North. Trump said he invited Democrats and Republicans to work together to protect American citizens regardless of their background, color or creed.

0c6de6c6bf390ee7609f607f395201463a6d1ade.sourceText: 特朗普在演讲中提出了一项包括四个要点的移民计划。他表示，他的移民政策将帮助争取美国工人和美国家庭的最大利益，移民群体也将受益。
0c6de6c6bf390ee7609f607f395201463a6d1ade.translatedText: In his speech, Trump proposed an immigration plan that included four points. He said his immigration policies will help fight for the best interests of American workers and American families, and immigrant groups will also benefit.

1ce77a5954935a8d111491c3ff62f454cd84aec5.sourceText: 第一，为180万非法移民者提供入籍美国的途径，这些移民都是在年轻时被父母带到美国生活；
1ce77a5954935a8d111491c3ff62f454cd84aec5.translatedText: First, provide a path to naturalize in the United States for the 1.8 million illegal immigrants who were brought to the United States by their parents when they were young;

3a07049e531f58ca88836ce855f84b3481ce99e0.sourceText: 第二，充分保护美国边界，在美国南部边境建一堵墙，雇佣更多的国土安全特工来保护美国社区安全；
3a07049e531f58ca88836ce855f84b3481ce99e0.translatedText: Second, fully protect the U.S. border, build a wall on the southern border of the United States, and hire more Homeland Security agents to protect American communities;

9ee89a44731dad5a018f0283b353dee37daf3075.sourceText: 第三，结束签证抽奖。这个随机分发绿卡的程序，不考虑任何技能、优点或美国人民的安全；
9ee89a44731dad5a018f0283b353dee37daf3075.translatedText: Third, end the visa lottery. This program that randomly distributes green cards without regard to any skill, merit, or safety of the American people;

9e02a2e140d433b0d8540bd7f36bd63fe8a4acb6.sourceText: 第四，通过结束连锁移民来保护核心家庭。他表示，在目前的系统系，一名移民可以带来几乎不限数量的远亲移民，而现在则将重点放在直系亲属身上。
9e02a2e140d433b0d8540bd7f36bd63fe8a4acb6.translatedText: Fourth, protect the nuclear family by ending chain migration. He said that under the current system, an immigrant can bring an almost unlimited number of distant relatives, but now the focus is on immediate relatives.

05c3870bcecd733f4ca083d12bf2f2efcab0aae1.sourceText: 当地时间2018年1月30日，美国华盛顿，美国总统特朗普抵达国会，准备发表首次国情咨文。
05c3870bcecd733f4ca083d12bf2f2efcab0aae1.translatedText: On January 30, 2018, local time, in Washington, the United States, U.S. President Trump arrived at Congress to prepare for his first State of the Union address.

c40cc07ba7ad363526fc428e7abfb6d7b910b966.sourceText: 特朗普称，他和每个民选官员的职责就是捍卫美国人，保护他们的安全，他们的家庭，他们的社区，以及他们追求美国梦的权利。因为，”美国人也是梦想者”。
c40cc07ba7ad363526fc428e7abfb6d7b910b966.translatedText: Trump said it is his job and the job of every elected official to defend Americans and protect their safety, their families, their communities and their right to pursue the American dream. Because, "Americans are dreamers too."

52af547b5c834c2e86c9dc79bd2c234f123b1a72.sourceText: ”梦想者”法案是美国政府近日备受关注的立法争议之一。这一法案全称为”童年入境暂缓遣返”(DACA)由美国前总统奥巴马推出，允许2007年以前进入美国的16岁以下非法移民被暂缓遣返，并可获得两年工作许可。这一将近790万人的群体被称为”梦想者”。
52af547b5c834c2e86c9dc79bd2c234f123b1a72.translatedText: The "Dreamers" bill is one of the legislative controversies that has attracted much attention in the US government recently. The full name of this bill is "Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals" (DACA), which was introduced by former U.S. President Obama and allows illegal immigrants under the age of 16 who entered the United States before 2007 to be deferred and obtain a two-year work permit. This group of nearly 7.9 million people is called "Dreamers."

f91365dc0db529c6014578b735cf070ce1a1b96d.sourceText: 特朗普去年9月宣布，如果国会不采取行动，他计划在今年3月5日结束DACA项目。
f91365dc0db529c6014578b735cf070ce1a1b96d.translatedText: Trump announced in September last year that he planned to end the DACA program on March 5 this year if Congress did not take action.

c7d3cfc6f8388615d3773073744c78e254c91ef8.sourceText: （本网讯）凤凰城的空中列车线路，2013年4月8日正式开通运行。这个线路是指44街与华盛顿街交界轻轨站，到机场四号站台。乘客乘坐这段轻轨完全免费，而且是24小时运行。在高峰时段，大约每三分钟就有轻轨到站运送客人。从44街与华盛顿街交界轻轨站到站台只需5分钟时间。
c7d3cfc6f8388615d3773073744c78e254c91ef8.translatedText: (News from this website) The sky train line in Phoenix was officially put into operation on April 8, 2013. This line refers to the light rail station at the intersection of 44th Street and Washington Street, to the Airport Platform 4. It is completely free for passengers to ride this light rail, and it operates 24 hours a day. During peak hours, light rail will arrive approximately every three minutes to transport passengers. It only takes 5 minutes from the 44th Street and Washington Street light rail station to the platform.

17a122342db581fcffd71f343fc1bf75061773f8.sourceText: ４月２９日记者购买单程轻轨票１.７５美元。从ASU Tempe 校区做轻轨到达44街与华盛顿街交界轻轨站。这是到机场必须换成机场轻轨的站点。在二楼有西南航空和US Airways行李托运的服务处，如果是这两家航空公司的游客，就可以马上托运行李。在二楼免费上轻轨，轻轨开往四号站台。轻轨有两节车厢，车内的人很少。
17a122342db581fcffd71f343fc1bf75061773f8.translatedText: On April 29, the reporter purchased a one-way light rail ticket for US$1.75. Take the light rail from the ASU Tempe campus to the light rail station at the intersection of 44th Street and Washington Street. This is the stop where you must change to the Airport Light Rail to get to the airport. There are Southwest Airlines and US Airways luggage check-in services on the second floor. If you are a passenger of these two airlines, you can check your luggage immediately. Get on the light rail for free on the second floor, and the light rail goes to platform four. The light rail has two carriages and there are very few people inside.

61f0805922345d0744bd0ec42cbdad03ec722d7f.sourceText: 轻轨在East Economy停靠，开车到机场的朋友也可以到这里上轻轨，到达4号站台。这里的停车费大约$12一天。
61f0805922345d0744bd0ec42cbdad03ec722d7f.translatedText: The light rail stops at East Economy. Friends who drive to the airport can also take the light rail here and arrive at platform 4. Parking here costs about $12 a day.

04ec6de3c30312526a91467adb995cb21aa6868e.sourceText: 大约５分钟到达４号站台，需要到２号３号站台的，可以转乘机场内的Shuttle.
04ec6de3c30312526a91467adb995cb21aa6868e.translatedText: It takes about 5 minutes to reach platform 4. If you need to go to platform 2 or 3, you can transfer to the shuttle at the airport.

7e7ea80d7ba0eb855a154841788c36d38a8d9399.sourceText: 另外如果是开车到44街与华盛顿街交界轻轨站的朋友，也可以将车停在这里的停车场。费用大约9美元一天。
7e7ea80d7ba0eb855a154841788c36d38a8d9399.translatedText: In addition, if you drive to the light rail station at the junction of 44th Street and Washington Street, you can also park your car in the parking lot here. The cost is about $9 a day.

8202cebf485e1d14460e641d2f18340a331d8f4e.sourceText: 中国移民1.45亿元诈骗案开庭 芝加哥会议中心(A Chicago Convention Center，简称ACCC)涉嫌诈骗中国人投资移民案，日前在位于芝加哥的北伊州联邦法院首度开庭，法官当庭裁决冻结1亿4500万元的会议中心账户，同时要求中心负责人塞思限期提交1100万行政手续费用流向说明。 多达250名中国投资移民客户，在该案中遭到牵连。该案将在3月11日于芝加哥二度开庭。但移民律师指出，即使未来相关人士遭到判刑，这些受害的中国投资者未来申请移民都希望渺茫。 目前这件案子仍在针对资金方面进行民事审理，还没有进入涉嫌诈骗部分的刑事责任调查，而中国负责”芝加哥会议中心”的华人代理，并没有被控诉。中心至今仍继续营业。 联邦证券管理委员会(SEC)在此案中，是将塞思个人，以及他所属的芝加哥会议中心(ACCC)与芝加哥洲际区域中心信托(IRCTC)列为控诉对象，罪名主要为”以诈欺方式出售证券获取了1.45亿投资款及额外的1100万元行政手续费”，并”蓄意误导”和”提供不实讯息”骗取250多名中国投资人的资金，超过90%的行政手续费已被挥霍一空，1亿4500万元的投资款也面临被挪用风险。 塞思涉嫌欺骗中国投资者，谎称只要缴交50万元费用，就可以成为芝加哥会议中心投资芝加哥欧海尔机场附近五家大型酒店的股东，并因此取得投资移民的合法身分，都非事实。
8202cebf485e1d14460e641d2f18340a331d8f4e.translatedText: The 145 million yuan fraud case against Chinese immigrants begins at the Chicago Convention Center) Center (ACCC) is suspected of defrauding Chinese investment immigrants. The case was held for the first time in the Northern Illinois Federal Court in Chicago. The judge ruled in court to freeze the account of the conference center worth 145 million yuan. At the same time, Seth, the head of the center, was required to submit an explanation of the flow of administrative fees of 11 million yuan within a time limit. As many as 250 Chinese investment immigration clients have been implicated in this case. The case will be heard for the second time in Chicago. However, immigration lawyers pointed out that even if the relevant persons are sentenced in the future, these victimized Chinese investors have little hope of applying for immigration in the future. The case is still undergoing a civil trial for the alleged fraud, and the Chinese agent responsible for the "Chicago Convention Center" has not been charged. The center continues to operate. In this case, the Federal Securities Commission (SEC) listed Seth as an individual, as well as his affiliates, the Chicago Convention Center (ACCC) and the Intercontinental Regional Center Trust of Chicago (IRCTC). The main charges were "fraudulently selling securities to obtain 1.4 500 million investment funds and an additional 11 million yuan in administrative fees", and "deliberately misleading" and "providing false information" to defraud more than 250 Chinese investors. More than 90% of the administrative fees have been squandered, and 145 million yuan of investment funds are also at risk of being misappropriated. Seth is suspected of deceiving Chinese investors, falsely claiming that as long as he pays a fee of 500,000 yuan, he can become a shareholder of the Chicago Convention Center and invest in five large hotels near Chicago O'Hare Airport, and thus obtain legal status as an investment immigrant. This is not true.

d02e5ed97a308b4a3008267695d134b13588f30d.translatedText: >International students, please pay attention! China News Service, January 31 (China News Service, January 31) According to comprehensive US media reports, on January 27, local time, New Jersey, the United States...

7ec8af00fdccc6564c59b5e472ed159505ff1b58.sourceText: 中新网1月31日电 综合美媒报道，当地时间1月27日，美国新泽西州一位华裔女孩失踪，警方于当天晚上证实该女孩已死亡。对留学生来说，”安全”应该是2018年的年度主题之一。留学生在出国前，对海外社会的了解大多是建立在零碎的、二手信息之上的片面认识。很多时候，他们对自己身处的环境并没有正确判断。在此，小编整理出2018年新出的诈骗案，借此提醒广大留学生们，注意安全！
7ec8af00fdccc6564c59b5e472ed159505ff1b58.translatedText: For international students, "safety" should be one of the annual themes in 2018. Before international students go abroad, most of their understanding of overseas societies is a one-sided understanding based on fragmented and second-hand information. Many times, they do not correctly judge the environment in which they find themselves. Here, the editor has sorted out the new fraud cases in 2018 to remind international students to pay attention to safety!

d826a2b072ed91335563fe34516c3b8273463503.sourceText: 1. 利用社交网站信息欺诈
d826a2b072ed91335563fe34516c3b8273463503.translatedText: 1. Information fraud using social networking sites

99866e097832dfd68fc6d0daf4665718fba083d7.sourceText: 利用社交网站，犯罪者发出带有附件的一条链接。一旦受害人在公司内点开链接，就启动了一个程序，改程序会自动扫描你的公司电话号码、找到谁是总裁、个人日程预约记录，何时休假等。
99866e097832dfd68fc6d0daf4665718fba083d7.translatedText: Using social networking sites, criminals send out a link with an attachment. Once the victim clicks on the link in the company, a program is launched. The program will automatically scan your company phone number, find out who is the president, personal schedule appointment records, when to take vacations, etc.

b19c58a6afe91004ac2c1c5b626d49bb0e7f17f4.sourceText: 获取这些信息后，犯罪者向公司财务人员发电出邮，称欠某公司的钱，请支付100万美元给某人。所以一定要小心发布在社交媒体上的信息，因为全球有组织犯罪者正在寻找这些信息。
b19c58a6afe91004ac2c1c5b626d49bb0e7f17f4.translatedText: After obtaining this information, the criminal sent an email to the company's financial personnel, saying that he owed money to a certain company and asked him to pay US$1 million to someone. So be careful what you post on social media, as organized crime is looking for it around the world.

5964013ea7d389c7ce7a38cebaa3e898f2cb8a56.sourceText: 犯罪组织会在一些社交媒体网站、约会网站上寻找目标。
5964013ea7d389c7ce7a38cebaa3e898f2cb8a56.translatedText: Criminal organizations will look for targets on some social media websites and dating websites.

ea75fa4d15f2158dd36e39ecc08ea46f0d4db559.sourceText: 骗子们会花言巧语哄骗很多人，等网友被”套路”了，就会说”我想过来见见你”等语言暗示奔现，但又在即将见面的最有时间里说出了什么事来不了了。
ea75fa4d15f2158dd36e39ecc08ea46f0d4db559.translatedText: Scammers will use sweet words to deceive many people. When netizens are "routified", they will say "I want to come over and meet you" and other verbal hints, but then they will say something is wrong at the best time when they are about to meet.

dce169cb2861c5264849d80595f5a0cf12276e63.sourceText: 理由往往是突然生病，或者缠上了司法等等，骗子会说：”能不能借给我钱？帮帮我？”等把钱转给对方后，对方便将你拉黑。
dce169cb2861c5264849d80595f5a0cf12276e63.translatedText: The reasons are often sudden illness, or trouble with the law, etc. The scammer will say: "Can you lend me money? Help me?" After transferring the money to the other party, the other party will block you.

c3f78f989444554d5b0e8319200171ccce6461b3.sourceText: 这类案件遍及全球，往往目标是英国、加拿大、美国等西方国家。骗子一般会伪装成政府机构，称你欠了钱，如果不能立即支付就会被递解出境。受害人往往是新移民，不太了解相关的法律法规，以为自己真的欠款了。骗子一般是要求通过western union汇款。
c3f78f989444554d5b0e8319200171ccce6461b3.translatedText: This type of cases occurs all over the world, often targeting Western countries such as the United Kingdom, Canada, and the United States. Scammers will usually pretend to be a government agency and claim you owe money and will be deported if you don't pay immediately. Victims are often new immigrants who don’t know much about the relevant laws and regulations and think they really owe money. Scammers usually ask for money to be transferred through Western Union.

1840b1293c8466e721f6d36045850dd89c06c444.sourceText: 与移民诈骗类似，有组织犯罪者会把目标锁定在新移民身上，因为新移民往往还不了解，加拿大的警方和政府官员从来不会向居民索要现金。
1840b1293c8466e721f6d36045850dd89c06c444.translatedText: Similar to immigration fraud, organized criminals will target new immigrants, because new immigrants often do not understand that Canadian police and government officials will never ask residents for cash.

ca0179fff9fff841e207c92d643cd28556e808a4.sourceText: 骗子拨打电话，称自己是税务局(cra)的，告知新移民欠了相关税费，如果不还就会被逮捕。老移民显然清楚，这是诈骗。
ca0179fff9fff841e207c92d643cd28556e808a4.translatedText: The scammer calls and claims to be from the tax bureau (CRA), telling the new immigrants that they owe relevant taxes and fees and will be arrested if they do not pay back. The old immigrants obviously knew that this was a scam.

af3bbd8a935331b9d63bf573be2a190ff5309e2f.sourceText: 有多位留学生先后接到电话，对方自称是加拿大政府或者美国打来的，因某某事件或者处于安全考虑，要求他们不要与任何人联系。留学生初来乍到，不太了解相关的法律法规，以为就是政府打电话过来的，所以就轻信了。
af3bbd8a935331b9d63bf573be2a190ff5309e2f.translatedText: Many international students have received phone calls one after another. The other party claimed to be from the Canadian government or the United States and asked them not to contact anyone due to certain incidents or security concerns. International students are new here and don’t know much about the relevant laws and regulations. They think it’s just a call from the government, so they just believe it.

3ba3cc08b223e76d03b2e0217bff9ad512cb417a.sourceText: 骗取留学生的信任之后，骗子又打电话给在中国的家人，称他们的孩子在加拿大被绑架了，要他们交一大笔赎金。
3ba3cc08b223e76d03b2e0217bff9ad512cb417a.translatedText: After defrauding the trust of international students, the scammers called their families in China and claimed that their children had been kidnapped in Canada and asked them to pay a large ransom.

d4d47dd9c752af7a97ebfda2c2eb2e540e043abe.sourceText: 这些留学生因为不接电话，所以家人也联系不上，就信以为真，将钱款汇至骗子的账户中。
d4d47dd9c752af7a97ebfda2c2eb2e540e043abe.translatedText: Because these international students did not answer the phone, their families could not be contacted, so they believed it to be true and transferred money to the scammer's account.

2813931c2555acfa05371be08c5f8bc0756d7f8c.sourceText: 所以，中国驻外使领馆都已经发布通告，留学生如果接到此类电话，不要上当。
2813931c2555acfa05371be08c5f8bc0756d7f8c.translatedText: Therefore, Chinese embassies and consulates abroad have issued notices. International students should not be fooled if they receive such calls.

71df04445001c5a0d90cd2f7fa11706605ab85c5.sourceText: （中央社墨西哥市2日综合外电报导）美国华府智库「美国进步中心」今天公布报告指出，在墨西哥、加拿大、中美洲和加勒比海各地，大约每31分钟就有人使用来自美国的枪械犯案。
71df04445001c5a0d90cd2f7fa11706605ab85c5.translatedText: (Central News Agency, Mexico City, comprehensive foreign news report on the 2nd) The Washington DC think tank "Center for American Progress" released a report today stating that in Mexico, Canada, Central America and the Caribbean, someone uses firearms from the United States to commit a crime approximately every 31 minutes.

3ba31346dc33c26f31a8627559bec942750eee40.sourceText: 「美国进步中心」（Center for American Progress）表示，这项数字是根据美国政府资料加以分析得出，其中显示，2014到2016年间，15个国家刑事侦查行动所查获的5万133枝枪械来自美国。
3ba31346dc33c26f31a8627559bec942750eee40.translatedText: The "Center for American Progress" said this figure was based on an analysis of U.S. government data, which showed that between 2014 and 2016, 50,133 firearms seized in criminal investigations in 15 countries came from the United States.

2e833b73a1782a3c925c9bdff680e97061cf09b5.sourceText: 路透社报导，这项标题为「国界之外」的报告指出，美国法律规定松弛，助长美制枪械贩卖到墨西哥、萨尔瓦多和宏都拉斯等饱受暴力帮派肆虐的国家。
2e833b73a1782a3c925c9bdff680e97061cf09b5.translatedText: Reuters reported that the report titled "Beyond the Border" pointed out that lax U.S. legal regulations have facilitated the trafficking of U.S.-made firearms to countries plagued by violent gangs, such as Mexico, El Salvador and Honduras.

a3fe640b029a42e3296e3e2d446b61e78693bef9.sourceText: 根据上个月公布的官方数据，去年墨西哥的杀人案攀升至20多年来最高纪录。
a3fe640b029a42e3296e3e2d446b61e78693bef9.translatedText: Homicides in Mexico climbed to the highest level in more than 20 years last year, according to official data released last month.

36890fab0ab67d3d755621f3521407faff1bf729.sourceText: 「美国进步中心」对资料的分析结果显示，墨西哥合法枪械市场受到严格限制，但开枪杀人的比例从1997年的15%上升到2017年大约66%。
36890fab0ab67d3d755621f3521407faff1bf729.translatedText: Analysis of data by the "Center for American Progress" shows that the legal firearms market in Mexico is strictly restricted, but the proportion of homicides by gunfire increased from 15% in 1997 to approximately 66% in 2017.

934200698f40fc29c277551efbb999bb3c9f92bb.sourceText: 墨西哥政府曾要求美国当局多加打击枪枝贩运，但专家批评两国官员缺乏合作，没能遏止枪械南向流动。（译者：陈彥钧/核稿：张佑之）
934200698f40fc29c277551efbb999bb3c9f92bb.translatedText: The Mexican government has asked U.S. authorities to do more to crack down on gun trafficking, but experts have criticized officials from both countries for their lack of cooperation and their failure to stem the southbound flow of firearms. (Translator: Chen Yanjun/Verification: Zhang Youzhi)

b63f19428358aec9250f0df32a419f88a9428b77.translatedText: The Supreme Court will hear the Arizona Proposition 200 in March "Alberta Times" The U.S. Supreme Court has scheduled a hearing on Arizona's controversial Proposition 2 on March 18...

dbb5d6de8e6122bb7135f8b39d2b98f907218f42.sourceText: 最高法院三月审理亚省200号提案 《亚省时报》 美国最高法院排期3月18日审理亚利桑那州具有争议性的提案200号，也即是在居民登记为选民时，要求出示有效的公民身份。 在此之前，第九巡回上诉法庭曾裁决亚利桑那州政府不能要求选民在登记联邦选举时提供公民身份证明，但在州选举时可以使用此要求。 根据全国选民登记法规定，全国各州居民在登记选民时，必须签署声明自己为公民，但没有要求出示任何证据。 本州的200号提案要求申请人，无论在登记联邦选举或州选举时，必须提供驾驶执照、护照、出生证明、部落身份或入籍证书编号。 亚利桑那州总检察长汤姆霍恩说，这些身份文件很重要，能起到防止欺诈的作业用。 证据显示，越来越多亚省选民对200号提案表示赞同，投赞同票的人数从当初的44%到去年的56%。 亚利桑那州是全国第一个提出要求出示公民证据的州，过去几年里，堪萨斯州和佐治亚州也纷纷效仿。上诉法院的裁决并没有影响到其他州，但最高法院的裁决会。
dbb5d6de8e6122bb7135f8b39d2b98f907218f42.translatedText: The Supreme Court will hear the Arizona Proposition 200 in March "Alberta Times" The U.S. Supreme Court is scheduled to hear Arizona's controversial Proposition 200 on March 18, which requires residents to show valid citizenship when registering as voters. Previously, the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that Arizona state government cannot require voters to provide proof of citizenship when registering for federal elections, but can use the requirement in state elections. According to the National Voter Registration Act, residents of every state across the country must sign a declaration that they are citizens when registering to vote, but no evidence is required. The state's Proposition 200 requires applicants, whether registering for a federal or state election, to provide a driver's license, passport, birth certificate, tribal status or naturalization certificate number. Arizona Attorney General Tom Horn said these identification documents are important and can play a role in preventing fraud. Evidence shows that more and more Alberta voters are in favor of Proposition 200, with the number of people voting yes increasing from 44% initially to 56% last year. Arizona was the first state in the nation to require proof of citizenship, with Kansas and Georgia following suit in the past few years. The appeals court ruling doesn't affect other states, but the Supreme Court ruling does.

f880419ed7e93a8c15a93731e6d18bd3c3aac45a.sourceText: 港媒曝郭晶晶已怀孕3个月 宝宝每月将享23万零用钱 据香港媒体报道，跳水皇后郭晶晶跟香港名门富商之子霍启刚去年底结婚，被曝农历年间已确定怀有霍家第4代宝宝，传宝宝出生后就能享有每月6万港币(约23万台币)的零用钱。 据最新一期香港周刊报道，霍家每个人零用钱不同，但都由家族基金发出，长房长子霍震霆每月有5万元港币，郭晶晶的宝宝一出生就是每月6万元港币，比爷爷霍震霆还要多。
f880419ed7e93a8c15a93731e6d18bd3c3aac45a.translatedText: Hong Kong media revealed that Guo Jingjing is 3 months pregnant and the baby will enjoy a monthly allowance of 230,000 yuan. According to Hong Kong media reports, diving queen Guo Jingjing married Fok Qigang, the son of a famous Hong Kong businessman, at the end of last year. It was revealed that she was pregnant with the fourth generation baby of the Huo family during the Lunar New Year. It is said that after the baby is born, she will be able to enjoy a monthly allowance of 60,000 Hong Kong dollars (approximately NT$230,000). According to the latest issue of Hong Kong Weekly, everyone in the Huo family has different pocket money, but it is all issued by the family fund. The eldest son, Fok Zhenting, has 50,000 Hong Kong dollars per month. Guo Jingjing's baby has 60,000 Hong Kong dollars per month since birth, which is more than his grandfather Fok Zhenting.

197ce6a7fa2b29623b8de11367a117401c982ef4.sourceText: 第56届格莱美奖揭晓 蠢朋克风光夺5奖成大赢家 周日晚间，第56届格莱美音乐颁奖典礼在洛杉矶NBA湖人队主场举行。 颁奖典礼中，拥有独树一帜的作品风格，以演奏电子乐为主，来自法国的蠢朋克（daft punk）乐队，凭借神曲《Get Lucky》，成为了本届格莱美的大赢家，最终获得五项大奖。 新西兰创作才女Lorde成为第56届格莱美的新宠，她凭借专辑《Royals》一举斩获最佳流行歌手、最佳年度单曲等重要奖项。而这位女歌手今年只有17岁。 作为音乐界的奥斯卡奖，格莱美对流行音乐人的意义不言而喻。从保罗?#40614;卡特尼、麦当娜这些老牌巨星，到凯蒂佩瑞、泰勒斯威夫特等当家花旦，除了格莱美，恐怕也没有什么奖项能将这些人一网打尽。今年，到底有哪些赢家与看点，乃至听点呢？ 和奥斯卡一样，每年的格莱美，七七八八奖项不少，Imagine Dragons获奖最佳摇滚演绎，Vampire Weekend获奖最佳另类专辑，Black Sabbath黑色安息日获奖最佳金属乐队，Led Zeppelin齐柏林飞船获奖最佳摇滚专辑，Macklemore & Ryan Lewis获奖最佳新人厖而要论重量级的奖项，年度歌曲、最佳歌手，由Lorde和她的《Royals》囊括。 Lorde在现场的表现可用”诡异”形容。脸涂得煞白、嘴唇抹黑，再来两下一顿一顿的动作，网友形容，”一大波僵尸正在靠近”。 由披头士乐队成员(Paul McCartney)他参与的歌曲Cut Me Some Slack获奖最佳摇滚歌曲，他的搭档这样说。 一年忙到头，有人得意而归，小伙儿Bruno Mars频频被摇臂青睐，感觉想必不错。也有万年陪跑选手，比如”水果姐”Katy Perry，卯足劲唱跳一曲，却延续不被格莱美待见的宿命;更让人心碎的还有女汉子Pink，吊着绳索闭着眼，在空中旋转、倒挂，唱歌、互动一点儿没耽误，体力、唱功一律感天动地横扫北美，唯一耽误的是，拿奖。 而对中国人，更大的看点恐怕是，中国钢琴家郎朗与著名重金属乐队Metallica跨界合作经典歌曲《One》。在郎朗之前，亚洲没有偶像明星在格莱美上进入摇滚表演最主力阵容。正因为此，尽管这首歌曲的位置已近压轴，对于国人，更像是一个”开始”的隐喻。 接下来我们看看几个大家最关注的奖项吧： 综合类 1、年度制作（Record Of The Year） 《Get Lucky》－Daft Punk &Pharrell Williams 2、年度专辑（Album Of The Year） 《Random Access Memories》 – Daft Punk 3、年度歌曲（Song Of The Year） Lorde -《Royals》 4、最佳新人（Best New Artist） Macklemore &Ryan Lewis 5、最佳流行歌手（Best Pop Solo Performance） 《Royals》-Lorde 6、最佳流行专辑（Best Pop Vocal Album） 《Unorthodox Jukebox》-Bruno Mars 7、最佳流行乐队/组合（Best Pop Performance By A Duo Or Group With Vocals） 《Get Lucky》-Daft Punk Featuring Pharrell Williams &Nile Rodgers 8、最佳流行乐器演奏专辑（Best Pop Instrumental Album） 《Steppin’ Out》-Herb Alpert
197ce6a7fa2b29623b8de11367a117401c982ef4.translatedText: The 56th Grammy Awards were announced. Daft Punk won 5 awards and became the big winner. On Sunday night, the 56th Grammy Music Awards ceremony was held at the home court of the NBA Lakers in Los Angeles. During the awards ceremony, Daft Punk, a band from France with a unique style of work that mainly plays electronic music, became the biggest winner of this year's Grammy with its divine song "Get Lucky" and eventually won five awards. New Zealand creative talent Lorde became the new favorite of the 56th Grammy Awards. She won important awards such as Best Pop Singer and Best Single of the Year for her album "Royals". The female singer is only 17 years old this year. As the Oscars in the music industry, the significance of the Grammys to pop musicians is self-evident. From veteran superstars such as Paul Cartney and Madonna to leading celebrities such as Katy Perry and Taylor Swift, except for the Grammy, I am afraid there is no award that can catch them all. This year, what are the winners, highlights, and even things to listen to? Just like the Oscars, there are many awards at the Grammys every year. Imagine Dragons won the best rock performance, Vampire Weekend won the best alternative album, Black Sabbath won the best metal band, Led Zeppelin won the best rock album, Macklemore & Ryan Lewis won the best new artist. But in terms of heavyweight awards, song of the year and best singer were won by Lorde and her "Royals". Lorde's performance on the scene can be described as "weird". His face was painted white, his lips were blackened, and he made repeated movements. Netizens described it as, "a large wave of zombies are approaching." Paul McCartney's song "Cut Me Some Slack," in which he participated, won the best rock song, his partner said. A busy year has come to an end, and someone is returning home proudly. Bruno Mars, a young man, has been favored by rockers frequently, so it must be a good feeling. There are also runners who have been with them for thousands of years, such as Katy Perry, the "Fruit Sister", who sang and danced hard, but continued to have the fate of not being welcomed by the Grammys; what was even more heartbreaking was the female man Pink, who was hanging from a rope with her eyes closed, spinning and hanging upside down in the air, singing and interacting without any delay. Her physical strength and singing skills were all impressive, sweeping across North America. The only delay was winning the award. For the Chinese, perhaps the bigger highlight is the cross-border collaboration between Chinese pianist Lang Lang and the famous heavy metal band Metallica on the classic song "One". Before Lang Lang, no idol star in Asia had entered the main lineup of rock performances at the Grammys. Because of this, although this song is near the finale, it is more like a metaphor of "beginning" for Chinese people. Next, let’s take a look at the awards that everyone is most concerned about: Comprehensive category 1. Record Of The Year (Record Of The Year) "Get Lucky" - Daft Punk & Pharrell Williams 2. Album Of The Year (Album Of The Year) "Random Access Memories" - Daft Punk 3. Song Of The Year (Song Of The Year) Lorde - "Royals" 4. Best New Artist (Best New Artist) Macklemore & Ryan Lewis 5. Best Pop Solo Performance) "Royals" - Lorde 6. Best Pop Vocal Album (Best Pop Vocal Album) "Unorthodox Jukebox" - Bruno Mars 7. Best Pop Performance By A Duo Or Group With Vocals (Best Pop Performance By A Duo Or Group With Vocals) "Get Lucky" - Daft Punk Featuring Pharrell Williams & Nile Rodgers 8. Best Pop Instrumental Album (Best Pop Instrumental Album) "Steppin’ Out" - Herb Alpert

008fc9a45a2c502e043675b4db93962618dae1dd.sourceText: 亚利桑那州贷款拖欠率下降至5.18% 亚利桑那房地产市场的恢复已经进入了一个新的阶段，与全国其他地区相比，亚省按揭贷款拖欠比率不再升高。根据信用报告管理公司的报告，是2012年贷款违约率下降幅度最大的州。 亚利桑那州抵押贷款逾期60天，或者60天以上的计算，从去年第四季度的7.5%下降到了5.18%。全国的平均拖欠率从5.41%下降到5.19%。 亚利桑那的平均贷款额，从去年的197，319下降到189，900. 全国平均的贷款额为186，785. 信用公司负责人说这些欠款率是反映了旧贷款回款情况，而不是新的贷款。从这些数据可以看出，经济的复苏。很长时间无法还贷的用户，经济状况开始缓解，继续进行还贷。这也是房地产市场继续稳固的信号。 接下来我们来看看全国拖欠率最高的几个州的情况，佛罗里达拖欠率为12.47%，其次是内华达州，新泽西州和马里兰州。拖欠率最低的是北达科他州为1.53％，紧随其后的是南达科他州，内布拉斯加州和阿拉斯加。更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的Tinna (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
008fc9a45a2c502e043675b4db93962618dae1dd.translatedText: Arizona loan delinquency rate drops to 5.18% The recovery of the Arizona housing market has entered a new phase, with mortgage delinquency rates no longer rising in Alberta compared to the rest of the country. It was the state with the largest decline in loan default rates in 2012, according to the Credit Report Management Company. Arizona mortgage loans that are 60 days past due or more fell to 5.18% from 7.5% in the fourth quarter of last year. The national average delinquency rate dropped from 5.41% to 5.19%. The average loan size in Arizona fell to 189,900 from 197,319 last year. The national average loan size is 186,785. Credit company officials say these delinquency rates reflect collections on older loans, not new loans. What can be seen from these data is the recovery of the economy. For users who have been unable to repay their loans for a long time, their economic conditions have begun to ease and they can continue to repay their loans. This is also a sign that the real estate market continues to stabilize. Next, let’s look at the states with the highest delinquency rates in the country. Florida has a delinquency rate of 12.47%, followed by Nevada, New Jersey and Maryland. The lowest delinquency rate is in North Dakota at 1.53%, followed by South Dakota, Nebraska and Alaska. For more information about real estate, please contact Tinna of Goldtrust Realty (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

68c8788b40c7bd0ab324d75a10190fd306993d82.translatedText: 3rd anniversary of the trip to Taiwan: Mainland residents brought in more than 3.2 billion U.S. dollars in income to Taiwan Xinhuanet Three years ago, on July 4, the first group of mainland residents to travel to Taiwan was formed. Nearly 7...

f78e24e7d1f33b57ceb2513b55afc636eac1661a.sourceText: 3年前的7月4日，大陆居民赴台游首发团成行，近700名大陆首批来台游客梦圆宝岛。3年时间过去了，作为两岸民间交流的重要渠道和平台，大陆居民赴台旅游结出累累硕果。
f78e24e7d1f33b57ceb2513b55afc636eac1661a.translatedText: Three years ago, on July 4, the first group of mainland residents to travel to Taiwan was organized. Nearly 700 of the first batch of mainland tourists to Taiwan came to Taiwan to enjoy their dream. Three years have passed. As an important channel and platform for cross-strait people-to-people exchanges, mainland residents’ travel to Taiwan has yielded fruitful results.

c9df23e55fd10434ec11027bb3d5ed90e75255ca.sourceText: 从人数上看，大陆居民赴台旅游从2008年的6万人，快速增加到2009年的60万、2010年的124万，今年更有望突破200万。
c9df23e55fd10434ec11027bb3d5ed90e75255ca.translatedText: In terms of numbers, the number of mainland residents traveling to Taiwan increased rapidly from 60,000 in 2008 to 600,000 in 2009 and 1.24 million in 2010. This year, the number is expected to exceed 2 million.

3404f3ca47fcfd988cf854f3136abbc31988cff6.sourceText: 从经济效益来看，据台方测算，截至今年3月，大陆居民赴台旅游已给台湾创造32.47亿美元收益。
3404f3ca47fcfd988cf854f3136abbc31988cff6.translatedText: In terms of economic benefits, according to Taiwanese estimates, as of March this year, mainland residents traveling to Taiwan have generated US$3.247 billion in revenue for Taiwan.

7a4fce5d53f3b4dafc7d170a6f786a4b07ad73ac.sourceText: 3年来，大陆居民来台旅游从团限10人变更为5人以上，在台停留时间由不超过10天变更为15天。大陆分三批渐次扩大开放区域，至2010年7月实现所有省、自治区和直辖市开放赴台旅游。组团社由最初的33家增至目前的164家。海旅会与台旅会于2010年5月互设办事处。
7a4fce5d53f3b4dafc7d170a6f786a4b07ad73ac.translatedText: In the past three years, the group limit for mainland residents to travel to Taiwan has been changed from 10 people to more than 5 people, and the length of stay in Taiwan has been changed from no more than 10 days to 15 days. Mainland China has gradually expanded its open areas in three batches, and by July 2010 all provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities will be open to travel to Taiwan. The number of organized clubs has increased from the initial 33 to the current 164. The Overseas Travel Association and the Taiwan Travel Association established offices in each other in May 2010.

a52a9b1355ce55dcee7d5903cdbfd91020cda905.sourceText: 今年4月20日，两岸同步公布《大陆居民赴台湾旅游团队组接社合作合同要点》，为规范赴台旅游市场秩序、提升旅游品质提供了保障。针对大陆游客在台伤亡事故，两岸通过海旅会与台旅会协商建立健全两岸间旅游安全保障机制。
a52a9b1355ce55dcee7d5903cdbfd91020cda905.translatedText: On April 20 this year, the two sides of the Taiwan Strait simultaneously announced the "Key Points of the Cooperation Contract for the Organization of Mainland Residents' Tour Teams to Taiwan", which provides a guarantee for standardizing the order of the tourism market to Taiwan and improving the quality of tourism. In response to the casualties of mainland tourists in Taiwan, the two sides of the Taiwan Strait have negotiated with the Taiwan Travel Association through the Overseas Travel Association to establish and improve a cross-strait tourism safety guarantee mechanism.

09d653eb97f064cd62d1b319430e2638dbba6682.sourceText: 截至今年5月底，大陆居民赴台旅游的人数已达到234.81万人次，大陆已成为台湾第一大客源市场。继团体旅游之后，今年6月28日，大陆居民赴台个人游正式启动，大陆居民的宝岛之旅变得更加随性、深入。
09d653eb97f064cd62d1b319430e2638dbba6682.translatedText: As of the end of May this year, the number of mainland residents traveling to Taiwan has reached 2.3481 million, and the mainland has become Taiwan's largest source market. Following group tours, individual tours for mainland residents to Taiwan were officially launched on June 28 this year, making mainland residents’ trips to the treasure island more casual and in-depth.

da2bd1093b0f2bf2c5454fca68b0603c7e59acfa.sourceText: ”赴台游扩大了两岸人民的交往、交流，密切了两岸同胞的感情，同时对促进台湾经济发展也起到了积极的作用，受到了两岸同胞的热烈欢迎。”国务院台办发言人杨毅如此评价赴台游的成果。
da2bd1093b0f2bf2c5454fca68b0603c7e59acfa.translatedText: "Visiting to Taiwan has expanded the exchanges and exchanges between people on both sides of the Taiwan Strait, and strengthened the feelings of compatriots on both sides of the Taiwan Strait. It has also played a positive role in promoting Taiwan's economic development and has been warmly welcomed by compatriots on both sides of the Taiwan Strait." Yang Yi, spokesman for the Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council, commented on the results of the trip to Taiwan.

7ff7476344c83c58bb68fffc78bf379da8471c71.sourceText: 台湾观光部门一项统计显示，在境外旅客来台购物消费排名中，大陆游客以每人每日购物3997元（新台币，下同）位居第一。
7ff7476344c83c58bb68fffc78bf379da8471c71.translatedText: Statistics from Taiwan's tourism department show that in the ranking of overseas tourists' shopping consumption in Taiwan, mainland tourists ranked first with a daily shopping cost of 3,997 yuan (NTD, the same below) per person.

f7fcbb95320ab1b0ff47e9d3842aa84ffc12ceb6.sourceText: 大陆游客对台湾消费经济的拉动，从”凤梨酥经济”中可见一斑。这款台湾各地随处可见的传统糕点，因大陆游客的青睐而摇身变成”小金砖”：2006年，台湾全年凤梨酥产值仅有15亿元，2010年的产值则已升至250亿元，5年间增长逾16倍。
f7fcbb95320ab1b0ff47e9d3842aa84ffc12ceb6.translatedText: The influence of mainland tourists on Taiwan’s consumer economy can be seen from the “pineapple cake economy”. This traditional pastry that can be seen everywhere in Taiwan has turned into a "little gold brick" due to the favor of mainland tourists: in 2006, Taiwan's annual output value of pineapple cakes was only 1.5 billion yuan. In 2010, the output value had risen to 25 billion yuan, an increase of more than 16 times in five years.

8a6166d921ebfe519b3dcfeac0cf70869eb3d519.sourceText: 台湾旅行商业同业公会联合会秘书长许高庆4日在接受新华社记者采访时表示：”随着相关政策措施的不断完善，赴台游的发展一直在向预期迈进。”据估算，随着赴台游拓展到个人游，其带来的经济效益将迅速惠及台湾更多的民生产业，”让更多的升斗小民得到实惠”。
8a6166d921ebfe519b3dcfeac0cf70869eb3d519.translatedText: Xu Gaoqing, secretary-general of the Taiwan Federation of Travel Business Associations, said in an interview with Xinhua News Agency reporters on the 4th: "With the continuous improvement of relevant policies and measures, the development of tourism to Taiwan has been moving forward as expected." It is estimated that as tourism to Taiwan expands to individual tourism, the economic benefits it brings will quickly benefit more people's livelihood industries in Taiwan, "allowing more ordinary people to benefit."

324f75aef71002d7894d008c3265b62e994d5de4.sourceText: 岛内知名学者江岷钦认为，从三年前的”团进团出”，到今天团体游的蓬勃发展以及个人游的实现，其过程体现了两岸民众相互信任感的培植和发扬。随着深入接触与交流，两岸民众在文化、心理上，必将进一步融洽、契合。
324f75aef71002d7894d008c3265b62e994d5de4.translatedText: Jiang Minqin, a well-known scholar on the island, believes that the process from the "group in and out" three years ago to the vigorous development of group tours and the realization of individual tours today reflects the cultivation and development of mutual trust between people on both sides of the Taiwan Strait. With in-depth contact and exchanges, people on both sides of the Taiwan Strait will surely become more harmonious and compatible culturally and psychologically.

0487297a3f083c717e762def0fa0c3cd8281f749.sourceText: 7-11咖啡杯决定总统选举获胜者 (亚省时报) 连锁便利店7-11用自己的方法选美国总统，就是让购买咖啡的消费者自由选择要印有红色或蓝色的杯子。 许多美国人喜欢早上到便利店买杯咖啡。本地7-11连锁店周六早上推出代表共和党的红杯和代表民主党的蓝杯，让买咖啡者选择。 虽然这项民意调查不科学，但7-11管理层信心满满，称已成功预测过去三年中竞选的赢家。”我们得到的结果与真实民意调查结果很接近，”本州7-11市场部经理雷科勒尼说。 到本周一，奥巴马总统在凤凰城和美莎领先，吉伯特居民则多选罗姆尼。 无论民主党还是共和党，到超级周二就知结果。在这之前，到7-11买一杯奥巴马或者罗姆尼咖啡，权当 纪念吧。
0487297a3f083c717e762def0fa0c3cd8281f749.translatedText: 7-11 coffee cup determines the winner of the presidential election (Alberta Times) The convenience store chain 7-Eleven used its own method to select the President of the United States, which is to allow consumers who buy coffee to freely choose whether they want a cup printed with red or blue. Many Americans like to buy a cup of coffee at a convenience store in the morning. The local 7-11 chain launched a red cup representing the Republican Party and a blue cup representing the Democratic Party on Saturday morning, allowing coffee buyers to choose. Although this poll is unscientific, 7-Eleven management is full of confidence and says it has successfully predicted the winner of the election in the past three years. "The results we got were very close to the actual poll results," said Ray Colony, marketing manager for the state's 7-Eleven. As of Monday, President Obama was leading in Phoenix and Mesa, while Gilbert residents favored Romney. Whether Democrats or Republicans, the outcome will be known on Super Tuesday. Before that, go to 7-11 and buy a cup of Obama or Romney coffee as a souvenir.

4c196bf256d07183d4bcfa610c5f0afbacc7c43a.sourceText: 全美平信邮费增至49美分 上涨3美分为11年最大涨幅 据美联社报道，监管机构已经于去年12月批准邮资上涨计划。但很多人不会很快感受到邮费上涨，因为不管如何上涨，现已售出的”永远”邮票仍然可以不加钱继续使用。 上次邮费上涨是一年之前，当时平信邮费上涨1美分。 美国邮政局去年亏损50亿美元，曾经计划停止星期六送信和减少对退休人员的健保福利，但还没有得到国会批准。 《华盛顿邮报》说，这次是11年来最大的一次上涨，预计维持两年；随后由监管人员根据邮局能否收回亏损再做出决定。 尽管上周邮购公司和大批量邮寄行业对这次邮费上涨提出诉讼，目前上涨计划还照常实施。 邮局还没有印刷新邮票反应这种变化，而是依靠”永远”邮票。新”永远”邮票上出现的形象是当选国会议员的第一名非洲裔妇女Shirley Chisholm。以冬季鲜花为主题的另一种”永远”邮票将于2月14日发行。 明信片邮资将上升到34美分；平信重量每增加一盎司邮费加21美分；一封2盎司的平信收费为70美分。优先快递邮件（Priority Mail Express）收费19.99美元。
4c196bf256d07183d4bcfa610c5f0afbacc7c43a.translatedText: First-class mail postage across the United States increased to 49 cents, a 3-cent increase, the largest increase in 11 years. According to the Associated Press, regulators approved the postage increase plan in December. But many people won't feel the postage increase anytime soon, because no matter how it increases, the "forever" stamps that have been sold can still be used without adding money. The last time postage increased was a year ago, when the cost of first-class mail increased by 1 cent. The U.S. Postal Service lost $5 billion last year and had planned to stop delivering mail on Saturdays and reduce health care benefits for retirees, but it has not yet been approved by Congress. The Washington Post said that this is the largest increase in 11 years and is expected to last for two years; regulators will then make a decision based on whether the post office can recover losses. Although mail-order companies and the bulk mailing industry filed a lawsuit last week against the postage increase, the increase is still planned for now. The post office has not yet printed new stamps to reflect the change, instead relying on "forever" stamps. The image that appears on the new "Forever" stamp is Shirley Chisholm, the first African-American woman elected to Congress. Another "Forever" stamp featuring winter flowers will be released on February 14. Postage will rise to 34 cents for postcards; 21 cents for each additional ounce in weight; and 70 cents for a 2-ounce letter. Priority Mail Express costs $19.99.

2d9f16f4e66d02ea63d6a632a6dbb61ec0818c9e.sourceText: 旅巴93号公路冲出车道 1死20伤 19日深夜发生旅游巴士交通意外，一辆载有48名澳洲游客的旅游巴士，从大峡谷返回拉斯维加斯时，在著名景点胡佛水坝附近的高速路上失控冲出路面，司机当场身 亡，至少20名乘客受伤，其中15人送往附近医院救治，六名重伤者则由直升机送往南内华达州大学医疗中心急救。 州公共安全厅表示，意外发生于晚上7时50分左右，该旅游巴士沿93号高速公路北行，驶至胡佛水坝附近，距拉斯维加斯东南约64公里时，52岁的司机 罗尼史巴克斯心脏病突发导致巴士失控冲出路面，先冲上一座小丘，再在凹凸不平的地面滑行210公尺后才停下。 巴士车头损毁，但其他部分未受损。 位于拉斯维加斯的南内华达州大学医疗中心发言人说，伤者大部分超过50岁，六名重伤者主要是骨折或擦伤，并无生命危险。 总部在加州的旅游巴士公司「银州旅巴」(Silver State Trailways)总裁托尼费奥瑞尼说，司机罗尼史巴克斯应是因为心脏病突发而导致车祸事故，「所幸其他人都 未受严重伤害」。 这是近年来该地区第三次发生夺命车祸。 2009年1月，几乎在同一地点曾发生旅游巴意外，造成七名中国游客死亡，当时他们也是在游览大峡谷后回拉斯维加斯的路上。
2d9f16f4e66d02ea63d6a632a6dbb61ec0818c9e.translatedText: Tour bus ran off Route 93, killing 1 and injuring 20. A tourist bus accident occurred late at night on the 19th. A tourist bus carrying 48 Australian tourists was returning to Las Vegas from the Grand Canyon when it lost control and ran off the road on the highway near the famous Hoover Dam. The driver died on the spot and at least 20 passengers were injured. 15 of them were sent to a nearby hospital for treatment. Six seriously injured people were sent to the University of Southern Nevada Medical Center for emergency treatment by helicopter. The state Department of Public Safety stated that the accident occurred at about 7:50 pm. The tour bus was traveling north on Highway 93 near the Hoover Dam, about 64 kilometers southeast of Las Vegas. The 52-year-old driver Ronnie Sparks suffered a heart attack and the bus lost control and ran off the road. It first ran up a hill and slid 210 meters on the uneven ground before stopping. The front of the bus was damaged, but the rest of the bus was undamaged. A spokesman for the University of Southern Nevada Medical Center in Las Vegas said that most of the injured were over 50 years old, and the six seriously injured people mainly suffered fractures or abrasions, which were not life-threatening. Tony Fiorini, president of Silver State Trailways, a tour bus company headquartered in California, said the driver, Ronnie Sparks, probably suffered a heart attack and caused the accident. "Fortunately, no one else was seriously injured." This is the third fatal crash in the area in recent years. In January 2009, a tour bus accident occurred at almost the same location, killing seven Chinese tourists who were on their way back to Las Vegas after visiting the Grand Canyon.

831a354e0e03a6b69fc24f164b0953146b5897fb.sourceText: 亲爱的朋友： 之所以用这样的方式和您联系，是因为您和我们一样，由于求学工作或创业都生活在Arizona，都喜欢这里的蓝天、仙人掌和自由舒畅的环境，都在这里有着共同的生活感受。 如同美国所有的华人那样，亚里桑那州的华人用自己的聪明才智和吃苦耐劳的精神为自己赢得了生存空间，得到了美国社会的一致认同。如何雁过留声，人过留名，记载这一段历史，让亲人、后代以及同胞能共同分享我们的全部生活环境和快乐时刻，是每一个生活在美国的华人的内心希冀。 《美国华人生活年鉴-Arizona版》今后就是这样一个记载精彩瞬间的美妙舞台。 为了多角度地反映生活在Arizona华人的风貌，《生活年鉴》编辑部决定向本州全体华人和团体征稿。只要是基本发生在Arizona华人生活范围里的（只要你觉得有意义，可以不要完全受时间的限制），你愿意向别人共同分享的小故事（200-500字之间），诸如学习、工作、饮食、着装、旅游、购物、交际等方面，都属于本书包纳和编撰的范围（每个小故事可以附2-3张说明内容的照片）。小故事的描写不必面面俱到，也不需要玄虚哲理，只要交代前因后果即可。平平淡淡地叙述，安安逸逸地生活，合在一起就成了别具一格的《生活年鉴》，你的故事就成了我们大家共同的歌。 为了让更多的人分享你的故事，我们与太阳鸟网站共同开辟了《生活故事》栏目，你可以将你的故事直接发到网站，注明”生活故事”由编辑安排到合适的栏目中。您可以直接署原名，也可以用笔名。如果您愿意公布你的学习工作单位名称，我们会感到很高兴，这样能让读者看到Arizona 华人不同的风采。 基本栏目如下，你可以参考栏目，也可以不受栏目的局限，说出你自己难忘和感动的故事。 灿烂校园 UA、ASU、社区学院—————学校简介以及有关各专业的华人学生和职员上课、做实验、教课和工作的情况 中文教学——— 亚省各地中文学校教学情况、成果及学生读书的故事 别样年华 独立门户———华人的工作经历以及开设各种公司的故事、 山花烂漫———华人在亚省酸甜苦辣的经历 金玉其表 衣带当风———各种流行的穿着(阐述个性时尚和季节的关系) 妆饰人生———各种佩带的特写(可以显示gem show 上浏览的照片和有关工艺制作的情况) 美食天下 品尝美国———介绍美国各种食品，最好有在当地就餐的照片 中餐独秀———介绍本地中国餐馆的情况 西部家园 买房、卖房、修房、租房的故事 外拙内秀的民居—各种华人的居室外貌和院子 外秀内憨的公寓—供华人或学生居住的各色房屋 风情万种 各种有关Arizona的旅游照片和小故事，如沙漠博物馆。生物圈2号、大峡谷、牛仔节等， 各种文化技艺的展示（摄影、收藏、表演、选美等） 车行万里 宝马坐骑———个人与车的合影及小故事 靓车市场———介绍本地各车行的概况 汽车保养———介绍本地大型和小型的各种修车机构 心语天籁 心灵世界———华人教会的介绍、教会活动 文化雨丝———本地华人文化资讯
831a354e0e03a6b69fc24f164b0953146b5897fb.translatedText: Dear friend: The reason why we contact you in this way is because you, like us, live in Arizona for study, work or entrepreneurship. We both like the blue sky, cacti and free and comfortable environment here, and we all have the same experience of life here. Like all Chinese in the United States, the Chinese in Arizona have used their intelligence and hard-working spirit to win a living space for themselves, and have been unanimously recognized by American society. How to record this period of history so that our relatives, descendants and compatriots can share our entire living environment and happy moments together is the inner hope of every Chinese living in the United States. "Yearbook of Chinese American Life-Arizona Edition" will be such a wonderful stage to record wonderful moments from now on. In order to reflect the Chinese people living in Arizona from multiple perspectives, the editorial department of "Life Yearbook" decided to solicit contributions from all Chinese people and groups in the state. As long as they basically happen within the scope of Chinese life in Arizona (as long as you think it is meaningful, you don’t have to be completely limited by time), short stories (between 200-500 words) that you are willing to share with others, such as study, work, food, clothing, travel, shopping, communication, etc., all fall within the scope of inclusion and compilation in this book (each short story can be accompanied by 2-3 photos to illustrate the content). The description of the short story does not need to be comprehensive, nor does it need to be mysterious and philosophical, as long as the cause and effect are explained. Narrated plainly and lived comfortably, together they become a unique "Life Yearbook", and your story becomes a common song for all of us. In order to let more people share your story, we have jointly developed the "Life Story" column with the Sunbird website. You can send your story directly to the website and indicate "Life Story" and the editor will arrange it into the appropriate column. You can sign directly with your original name or use a pen name. We will be happy if you are willing to publish the name of your study and work unit, so that readers can see the different styles of Chinese people in Arizona. The basic columns are as follows. You can refer to the columns, or you can tell your own unforgettable and touching stories without being limited by the columns. Brilliant campus UA, ASU, community college——school introduction and the situation of Chinese students and staff in various majors taking classes, doing experiments, teaching and working. Chinese teaching——teaching situation, achievements and students’ study stories in Chinese schools across the province. Different Years. Independent portal——the work experience of Chinese and the stories of opening various companies. The beauty of mountain flowers——the ups and downs of Chinese experience in Alberta. The appearance of gold and jade. Clothes are in the trend - various popular clothes (explaining the relationship between personal fashion and seasons) Accessories and life - close-ups of various clothes (can display photos browsed on the gem show and related crafts) World of Food Taste America - introduce various American foods, preferably with photos of eating locally Chinese Food Show - introduce the situation of local Chinese restaurants Western Home Stories about buying, selling, repairing and renting a house Residential houses that are clumsy on the outside—all kinds of Chinese living rooms and courtyards; apartments that are clumsy on the outside—all kinds of houses for Chinese or students to live in; various tourist photos and stories about Arizona, such as the Desert Museum. Biosphere 2, Grand Canyon, Stampede, etc., various cultural skills displays (photography, collections, performances, beauty pageants, etc.) Cars traveled thousands of miles BMW mounts - personal photos with cars and short stories Beautiful car market - introduction to local car dealers Car maintenance - introduction to various local large and small car repair institutions Xinyu Tianlai Spiritual world - introduction to Chinese churches and church activities Cultural Rain - local Chinese cultural information

8802df0acfcfd39951503472d3a17d67aaea09ff.translatedText: Greenpeace launched an attack Netizens denounced

815aa5f6328eb60f623ad00e239c360bcafa569a.sourceText: 这个事件的起因是绿色和平组织披露的一则消息。该组织8月30日引述8月1日发表于《美国临床营养学杂志》上的一篇论文，该论文称，美国塔夫茨大学唐广文教授领导的一个研究团队利用中国湖南的24名农村儿童进行转基因?#40644;金大米?#65288;Golden Rice，国际上简称GR）的试验，这些”黄金大米”含有的β-胡萝卜素被认为可以弥补人体维生素A的不足，维生素A的缺乏可以导致夜盲症、失明，乃至死亡，据称全世界每年有25万学龄前儿童因缺乏维生素A而失明，其中半数在失明后死亡。
815aa5f6328eb60f623ad00e239c360bcafa569a.translatedText: . The cause of this incident was a piece of news disclosed by Greenpeace. On August 30, the organization quoted a paper published in the "American Journal of Clinical Nutrition" on August 1, which stated that a research team led by Professor Tang Guangwen of Tufts University in the United States used 24 rural children in Hunan, China to conduct genetically modified?#40644;Golden Rice?#65288;Golden Rice (internationally referred to as GR), the beta-carotene contained in these "golden rice" is believed to be able to make up for the lack of vitamin A in the human body. The lack of vitamin A can lead to night blindness, blindness, and even death. It is said that 250,000 preschool children around the world go blind due to lack of vitamin A every year, and half of them die after becoming blind.

f42c1db8fcd03fe3fb80fadd740246acff675f98.sourceText: 绿色和平组织发表声明，认为用中国儿童作为转基因大米的实验对象是极其不负责任的行为，呼吁中国政府审核该研究的合法性，并对受到影响的儿童提供医疗和法律援助。
f42c1db8fcd03fe3fb80fadd740246acff675f98.translatedText: Greenpeace issued a statement that it is extremely irresponsible to use Chinese children as experimental subjects for genetically modified rice, and called on the Chinese government to review the legality of the research and provide medical and legal assistance to the affected children.

869d4223457c65e89b1f511e5083d48d7c4cd159.sourceText: 该组织驻中国的食品与农业项目主任方立峰对媒体说：”转基因食品对人的健康具有潜在的风险，一个美国机构用中国儿童的身体测试转基因大米，我们对这样的实验得以进行感到愤慨和不可思议。农业部和浙江省农业厅早在4年前就已经叫停该实验，它为何还能死灰复燃？我们不得而知。”
869d4223457c65e89b1f511e5083d48d7c4cd159.translatedText: Fang Lifeng, director of the organization's food and agriculture program in China, told the media: "Genetically modified foods have potential risks to human health. An American institution used the bodies of Chinese children to test genetically modified rice. We are outraged that such an experiment can be carried out." It’s outrageous and unbelievable. The Ministry of Agriculture and the Zhejiang Provincial Department of Agriculture had stopped the experiment four years ago, so we don’t know why it can still be revived.”

b6ddd59306116f7969d78748411633289566f0fd.sourceText: 消息一出，在中美两地的论坛上引发大量讨论，其中多数是谴责的声音。诸如”米国公司又在大米上做文章！无耻之极！””若你有小孩，你会同意他（们）去’试验’吗？你敢肯定不会有长期的危险吗？” ”转基因的东东连实验用的老鼠都不吃！” 更有不少谴责唐广文个人的留言。
b6ddd59306116f7969d78748411633289566f0fd.translatedText: As soon as the news came out, it triggered a lot of discussion in forums in China and the United States, most of which were voices of condemnation. For example, "An American company is making a fuss about rice again! How shameless!" "If you have children, would you allow them to 'experiment'? Are you sure there will be no long-term danger?" "The genetically modified stuff will not even be eaten by the mice used in the experiment!" There were many messages condemning Tang Guangwen personally.

cf213092331a2e606a162b51dbe3c43c6f80bfda.sourceText: 遵循最高标准 试验效果理想
cf213092331a2e606a162b51dbe3c43c6f80bfda.translatedText: Follow the highest standards and achieve ideal test results

cdec7158446ba13212441e1722f43a7c2c52af73.sourceText: 针对这一事件，《侨报》记者8月31日联系塔夫茨大学类胡萝卜素和健康研究所（Carotenoids and Health Laboratory）的主任唐广文教授，正在休假的她将询问邮件转给校方。随后校方发言人克罗斯曼（Andrea Grossman）以书面形式回复说，塔夫茨大学在各种以人为对象的试验中，均遵循最高的道德标准。”黄金大米”的试验目的是针对发展中国家一个非常严重的健康问题寻找解决方法。根据世界卫生组织的统计，维生素A的缺乏影响着全世界2亿5000万的儿童，其中每年有25万儿童因此失明，这些人中的半数都在失明后死亡。尽管目前有各种维生素A的补充方式和社会项目，但仍无法解决维生素A的缺乏问题，本试验的目的就是进一步证实”黄金大米”在补充维生素A不足方面的有效性。
cdec7158446ba13212441e1722f43a7c2c52af73.translatedText: In response to this incident, a reporter from the Overseas Chinese News contacted Professor Tang Guangwen, director of the Carotenoids and Health Laboratory at Tufts University, on August 31. She was on vacation and forwarded the inquiry email to the school. School spokesperson Andrea Grossman subsequently responded in writing, saying that Tufts University adheres to the highest ethical standards in all experiments involving human subjects. The purpose of the "Golden Rice" trial is to find a solution to a very serious health problem in developing countries. According to the World Health Organization, vitamin A deficiency affects 250 million children worldwide, with 250,000 children going blind each year and half of these children dying after becoming blind. Although there are currently various vitamin A supplement methods and social projects, the problem of vitamin A deficiency still cannot be solved. The purpose of this trial is to further confirm the effectiveness of "Golden Rice" in supplementing vitamin A deficiency.

352b7aa83329c40fd274baca5076a09a41ecbde7.sourceText: 陈普诗词对联书法欣赏 竹杖铭 –陈普 山不在深，有空便登；器不必奢，好用就行。斯是竹杖，惟吾制之。削去青青叶，磨平枝簕边。节显强韧劲，竿留玉露痕。可以驱蛇蝎，履崎岖。无市井之俗气，通天地之灵馨。太白游仙梦，润之长征途。孔子云：乐在其中。 2012年12月 一剪梅 –陈普 放眼夜城灯万重。 山谷朦胧，道衢朦胧。 新朋旧友共邀觥。 月在杯中，情在杯中。 雅曲清谈魏晋风。 酒自浓浓，兴自浓浓。 主欢客悦两相融。 宴也有终，谊也无终。 答王楠 调寄一剪梅 —-阿普 2012 年感恩节 对联 ： 波生足底，涛声有韵； 月上眉梢，海色无边。 —福州连江筱埕听海， 即景。
352b7aa83329c40fd274baca5076a09a41ecbde7.translatedText: >Appreciation of Chen Pu's poetry, couplets and calligraphy Inscription on the bamboo stick - Chen Pu The mountain is not deep, so you can climb it when you have time; the tool does not need to be extravagant, just easy to use. This is a bamboo stick, but I made it. Cut off the green leaves and smooth the edges of the branches. The joints are strong and tough, and the poles leave traces of jade dew. It can drive away snakes and scorpions and walk on rough terrain. There is no tackiness in the market, but the spirit of heaven and earth. Taibai's dream of traveling to immortality nourishes his long journey. Confucius said: Enjoy it. December 2012 A pruning plum - Chen Pu Look at the night city with thousands of lights. The valley is hazy and the road is hazy. New and old friends are invited to have a toast together. The moon is in the cup, love is in the cup. Yaquqing talks about the style of Wei and Jin Dynasties. The wine is strong, and the excitement is strong. The host welcomes the guests and the two blend together. The banquet has an end, and the friendship has no end. Reply to Wang Nan Send a plum blossom - Apu's 2012 Thanksgiving couplet: The waves are rising on the soles of the feet, and the sound of the waves has a rhyme; the moon is above the eyebrows, and the color of the sea is boundless. ——Listen to the sea in Xiaocheng, Lianjiang, Fuzhou, and you will see the scene instantly.

6cab6599cdd7acf2c72ddc329c43b1cb865635e1.translatedText: Three Chinese-American congressmen took the oath to make history today (picture) Zhao Meixin...

930866001837b657f9da364a7c8e049a3f8bb92a.sourceText: 今日(1月3日)开始的第113届国会，三位华裔议员将宣誓就职。 这次，三位华裔议员来自加州的赵美心(Judy Chu)、来自美中芝加哥的谭美 达克沃斯(Tammy Duckworth)，及来自美东纽约市的孟昭文(Grace Meng)，都是杰出女性 ，不但写下在美华裔参政新页，在美国国会史上也是首见。
930866001837b657f9da364a7c8e049a3f8bb92a.translatedText: In the 113th Congress starting today (January 3), three Chinese congressmen will be sworn in. This time, the three Chinese-American congressmen, Judy Chu from California, Tammy Duckworth from Chicago, and Grace Meng from New York City, are all outstanding women. They have not only written a new page for Chinese-American political participation in the United States, but are also the first in the history of the U.S. Congress.

f6f01243c073f1a5004de074e89821e9a0b61e5e.sourceText: 众议员赵美心去年11月6日的选战中势如破竹，以超过两位数的差距战胜共和党对手Jack Orswell，顺利连任，成为加州历史上首位获得连任的华裔联邦众议员，缔造华裔参政辉煌历史。
f6f01243c073f1a5004de074e89821e9a0b61e5e.translatedText: Representative Zhao Meixin had a strong victory in the election on November 6 last year. She defeated her Republican opponent Jack Orswell by more than double digits and was successfully re-elected. She became the first Chinese-American federal representative to be re-elected in the history of California, creating a glorious history of Chinese-American participation in politics.

13193759af6cc5ff06b2baf5d8daa499f208620d.sourceText: 去年11月6日，国会众院纽约州第六选区孟昭文毫无意外地以七成选票成为美东地区第一位华裔国会众议员。
13193759af6cc5ff06b2baf5d8daa499f208620d.translatedText: On November 6 last year, Meng Zhaowen, the sixth district of New York State in the House of Representatives, became the first Chinese-American congressman in the Eastern United States with 70% of the votes.

ecaa217e41b1a4ede515659e1a19ef277b70640d.sourceText: 拥有一半华裔血统的谭米 达科沃斯(Tammy Duckworth)，6日晚宣告当选伊利诺州国会议员，成为伊州首位亚裔国会众议员。44岁的谭米 达科沃斯出生在泰国曼谷，母亲是华裔，父亲是美国人。她在伊拉克战争中失去双腿，2006年至2009年担任伊利诺伊州退伍军人部门主任，2009年至2011年被奥巴马任命为联邦退伍军人部公共及内务助理部长。
ecaa217e41b1a4ede515659e1a19ef277b70640d.translatedText: Tammy Duckworth, who is half-Chinese, was elected to the Illinois Congress on the evening of the 6th, becoming the first Asian-American congressman from Illinois. 44-year-old Tammy Dakovos was born in Bangkok, Thailand, to a Chinese mother and an American father. She lost her legs in the Iraq War and served as the director of the Illinois Veterans Department from 2006 to 2009. From 2009 to 2011, she was appointed by Obama as the federal assistant secretary of public affairs and interior affairs of the Department of Veterans.

6965e12e5a6be482cc4fc6ed93b425a3058160d6.sourceText: 众院首度同时有三位华裔议员的历史性时刻，发生在2010年5月。 那三位是吴振伟(David Wu，民主党，奥勒冈州)、赵美心，和周永康(Charles Kong Djou，共和党，夏威夷州)。
6965e12e5a6be482cc4fc6ed93b425a3058160d6.translatedText: The historic moment when there were three Chinese-American members of the House of Representatives at the same time for the first time occurred in May 2010. Those three are David Wu (Democrat, Oregon), Meixin Zhao, and Charles Kong Djou (Republican, Hawaii).

1a6bcb2af4a319ccb217ecdaf006663a6a7e4dd8.sourceText: 周永康2010年5月在艾柏甘比离任后的特别选举中出线，但他随即在11月期中选举，败给花房若子而告别国会，他昙花一现的任期只有半年多。 他也在华府合伙成立了游说公司「多数集团」。
1a6bcb2af4a319ccb217ecdaf006663a6a7e4dd8.translatedText: Zhou Yongkang stood out in the special election after Ambergambi left office in May 2010, but he was defeated by Wakako Hanabusa in the November midterm election and bid farewell to Congress. His short-lived term lasted only more than half a year. He also co-founded the lobbying firm Majority Group in Washington.

423f6f5dea9eb0163ecb4961b0124d3445b56434.sourceText: 继周永康2011年1月离任后，1998年当选的吴振伟，因涉嫌对友人的18岁女儿有不当性接触，于2011年7月在各方压力下辞职。 而赵美心成为众院硕果仅存的华裔议员。
423f6f5dea9eb0163ecb4961b0124d3445b56434.translatedText: Following Zhou Yongkang's resignation in January 2011, Wu Zhenwei, who was elected in 1998, resigned in July 2011 under pressure from all parties due to suspicion of inappropriate sexual contact with his friend's 18-year-old daughter. And Zhao Meixin became the only remaining Chinese-American member of the House of Representatives.

6d307a0bced98fb921f97935e72b2f85b14c55c3.sourceText: 加快签证申请 中国游客最快两天获得签证 对于中国和巴西的观光客而言，苦等美国签证的日子可能结束了。 美国国务院领事事务局的副助理国务卿多纳休表示，在重要地点增添人手并重新分配资源后，签证处理时间显著改善。 现在，中国的游客最快只要两天就可获得签证，巴西可能只要等一个星期。由于这些国家的观光业显著增长，签证处理必须加快。 多纳休表示，签证申请审批主要是出于安全考虑，为了确保民众不会滥用签证（例如，逾期居留），或进入美国企图犯罪或进行恐怖袭击，因此，领事馆对每一名申请人都综合面谈、成长经历和生物识别等资讯，确定不会对美国构成威胁。 有36个国家的旅客不需要签证便可进入美国，其中一些国家可能理所当然，包括英国、瑞士、西班牙等，不过文莱和新加坡赴美也免签证可能让不少人吃惊。 这些免签证国家能获得这个资格，是因为它们的拒签比率通常低于3％，而且与美国信息共享。 外国游客是美国经济的金矿之一，美国的国际旅游业去年的名目收入达到1530亿美元的历史新高，约占GDP的1％。不过，尽管有这个好成绩，美国的观光业是否真的从9/11恐怖攻击的重创之后回复并不明确，所以还有许多可以做，以进一步带动观光业。 36个免签证国家的游客占美国观光客的65％。不过巴西、阿根廷、智利等主要的拉丁美洲国家并不在名单上。而12亿人口的中国只有五个签证办公室。城市范围和费城相当的哈尔滨，如果要到最近的签证面谈点得花上将近8小时的车程。
6d307a0bced98fb921f97935e72b2f85b14c55c3.translatedText: Speeding up visa applications: Chinese tourists can get visas in as fast as two days For tourists from China and Brazil, the wait for a U.S. visa may be over. Donahue, deputy assistant secretary in the U.S. State Department's Bureau of Consular Affairs, said visa processing times have improved significantly after adding staff and reallocating resources to key locations. Now, Chinese tourists can get visas in as little as two days, while Brazilians may only have to wait a week. Due to the significant growth in tourism in these countries, visa processing must be expedited. Donahue said that visa application approval is mainly for security reasons. In order to ensure that people will not abuse their visas (for example, overstay), or enter the United States to attempt crimes or carry out terrorist attacks, the consulate therefore comprehensively interviews, growth experience, biometrics and other information on each applicant to determine that they will not pose a threat to the United States. Travelers from 36 countries can enter the United States without a visa. Some of these countries may be taken for granted, including the United Kingdom, Switzerland, Spain, etc. However, it may surprise many people that Brunei and Singapore also do not require a visa to enter the United States. These visa-exempt countries qualify because their visa rejection rates are typically less than 3% and they share information with the United States. Foreign tourists are one of the gold mines of the U.S. economy. U.S. international tourism revenue reached a record high of $153 billion last year, accounting for about 1% of GDP. However, despite this good result, it is not clear whether the U.S. tourism industry has truly recovered from the devastation caused by the 9/11 terrorist attacks, so there is still much that can be done to further boost the tourism industry. Visitors from 36 visa-free countries account for 65% of U.S. tourists. However, major Latin American countries such as Brazil, Argentina, and Chile are not on the list. China, with a population of 1.2 billion, has only five visa offices. In Harbin, which is about the same size as Philadelphia, it takes nearly 8 hours to drive to the nearest visa interview point.

3b36bcbb5eb66a39f39e4877629c67ee50fda7e1.translatedText: Two states are discussing the construction of an interstate highway directly connected to Vegas. Many people like to go to Las Vegas, but everyone knows that there is no direct road to Vegas when driving from the Phoenix metropolitan area...

1c61bd4f0ccf2a2efbbdc1b6fc51aecea3efc736.sourceText: 两州商议建州际公路直通维加斯 很多人喜欢去拉斯维加斯，但大家都知道，从凤凰城大都会开车出发，是没有路直通维加斯。如今，两州交通部门正在商议，改写这一历史。 两州交通部门把这条即将建设的公路称之为州际公路11号，得到包括州长布鲁尔在内的很多立法者、城市规划者的支持。两州交通部已经就公路进行了两年研究，将尽快提交具体地形报告。 现在，从凤凰城到拉斯维加斯，出城后先经过威肯伯格，上93号公路，经金曼，过胡佛水坝后，进入内华达州，再进入拉斯维加斯。其中胡佛水坝路段山多路窄，常有事故发生，上周才有一澳洲旅行团在此出事。
1c61bd4f0ccf2a2efbbdc1b6fc51aecea3efc736.translatedText: Two states are discussing the construction of an interstate highway directly connected to Vegas. Many people like to go to Las Vegas, but everyone knows that there is no direct road to Vegas by car from the Phoenix metropolitan area. Now, the transportation departments of the two states are discussing to rewrite this history. The transportation departments of the two states call this upcoming highway Interstate 11, and it has the support of many legislators and urban planners, including Governor Brewer. The two state departments of transportation have been conducting studies on the road for two years and will submit detailed terrain reports as soon as possible. Now, from Phoenix to Las Vegas, after leaving the city, first pass through Wickenburg, get on Highway 93, pass through Kingman, pass the Hoover Dam, enter Nevada, and then enter Las Vegas. Among them, the Hoover Dam road section is mountainous and narrow, and accidents often occur. Only last week, an Australian tour group had an accident here.

f6358e2c698ba897fe12ea57d6daac219894cd66.translatedText: Kohl’s to hire more than 52,000 seasonal employees (Alberta Times) Kohl’s said on Tuesday that…

5a69f03e411020dff66c9845f428c29c99c92ce4.sourceText: 科尔百货公司（Kohl’s）周二表示，计划在全国招聘逾52,000名年终季节性临时员工，此数目比去年增长了超过10％。 科尔预计平均每店将雇用41名新雇员。科尔百货在美国49个州拥有1,146家分店。此外，该公司的分销中心和信贷业务单位也将招聘约5,700名季节性的员工。 该公司表示，52,700名季节性员工的工作时间可以是每周数小时到逾20小时。该公司计划到11月中旬便完成聘请。典型的工作包括使用收银机、存货入库、货运处理和装卸货车。
5a69f03e411020dff66c9845f428c29c99c92ce4.translatedText: Kohl’s said on Tuesday that it plans to hire more than 52,000 year-end seasonal temporary employees nationwide, an increase of more than 10 per cent from last year. Kohl's expects to hire an average of 41 new employees per store. Kohl's has 1,146 stores in 49 states in the United States. In addition, the company's distribution centers and credit business units will also hire approximately 5,700 seasonal employees. The company said its 52,700 seasonal employees can work anywhere from a few hours to more than 20 hours a week. The company plans to complete hiring by mid-November. Typical tasks include operating a cash register, stocking inventory, freight handling, and loading and unloading trucks.

cf5b775b435c9bdc6315bdab0dc7964e3802385d.translatedText: Make your summer refreshing and beautiful - Win Salon has moved and opened (more pictures) (Alberta Times News, Xie Chengyan) Inspired by the famous hairstylist Win in Phoenix...

ead13d8d03a183ecbf5bf063a13376abe7af3a3c.sourceText: 让你的夏天清爽美丽－Win Salon 乔迁开业（多图） (亚省时报讯 谢成彦) 受凤凰城知名发型师Win的邀请，来到了位于Dobson & Frye的交界处，看到了装修简洁大方的Win Salon. 一走进屋，还以为自己走错了，屋里挂满了非常专业的油画和素描，是到画廊了吗？Win很热情的上来招呼，没有走错，这是发廊也是”画廊”。原来我们的发型师多才多艺，不仅是做发型的好手，踢球的干将，最早还是学绘画的专才。美感好，自然能给顾客剪出让他们满意的发型。 来参加Win Salon 开业聚会的朋友，很多都是他的顾客，大家都把发型整理的特别漂亮，简直是一个现场的发型秀。我赶紧抓住Win让他忙中偷闲聊几句。今年流行的发型会是怎样的？他微微一笑说，今年流行清爽的短发。听了我心中一阵窃喜，因为记者也刚剪了短发，无意之中跟上了流行的步伐。Win说短发看似简单，但是最考验发型师的功力，不像长发还可以通过吹卷来调整。短发没剪好，非常难遮掩。那么今年的短发又流行什么样子的呢？Win说短发比较挑脸型，不同的脸型，选择的发型不同，今年的发型都会比较厚，层次会压的比较低。即使现在的长发，一般层次也会往下压。那么颜色流行呢？Win说从亚洲人来看，因为我们的头发基本是黑色的，所以巧克力色调，会比较自然，时尚。 短短几句话，多少都觉得从专业人士那里得到了美丽的”圣经”，看来今年夏天，清爽，简洁的短发要大行其道了，你准备好了吗？别忘了新店的地址：284 S. Dobson Rd Chandler AZ 85224。
ead13d8d03a183ecbf5bf063a13376abe7af3a3c.translatedText: Make your summer refreshing and beautiful - Win Salon has moved and opened (more pictures) (Alberta Times News, Xie Chengyan) Invited by Win, a well-known hairstylist in Phoenix, I came to the intersection of Dobson & Frye and saw the simple and elegant Win Salon. As soon as I walked into the room, I thought I was in the wrong place. The room was filled with very professional oil paintings and sketches. Are you in a gallery? Win came up to greet me warmly. I was right. This is a hair salon and a "gallery". It turns out that our hairstylists are versatile. They are not only good at styling hair, but also good at playing football. They were also experts in painting at the earliest. With good aesthetics, you can naturally give customers a haircut that satisfies them. Many of the friends who came to Win Salon's opening party were his customers, and everyone had their hair styled very beautifully. It was like a live hair show. I quickly grabbed Win and let him chat for a while. What will be the popular hairstyle this year? He smiled slightly and said that refreshing short hair is popular this year. After hearing this, I felt secretly happy because the reporter had also just cut his hair short and unintentionally kept up with the trend. Win said that short hair may seem simple, but it tests the skill of the hairstylist the most. Unlike long hair, which can be adjusted by blowing and curling. Short hair is not cut properly and is very difficult to cover up. So what is the fashion for short hair this year? Win said that short hair is more flattering on the face shape. Different face shapes require different hairstyles. This year’s hairstyles will be thicker and the layers will be lower. Even if you have long hair now, the general layers will be pressed down. What about color pops? Win said that from an Asian perspective, because our hair is basically black, chocolate tones are more natural and fashionable. In just a few words, I feel like I got a beautiful "bible" from professionals. It seems that this summer, fresh and simple short hair will become popular. Are you ready? Don’t forget the new store’s address: 284 S. Dobson Rd Chandler AZ 85224.

99a9191dc11b3a8fe98dc54263b8ee92f79bbd7f.sourceText: 美国中文网据《今日美国》报道：一项最新的民意调查显示：现任总统奥巴马和罗姆尼之间的总统竞争趋于白热化。在还有不到两半个月的时间就要进行大选前的民调显示，尽管大多数受访者预计奥巴马最终将获胜，但是目前奥巴马仅仅以47％-46％的支持率领先罗姆尼。
99a9191dc11b3a8fe98dc54263b8ee92f79bbd7f.translatedText: According to USA Today, the Chinese website of the United States: A latest opinion poll shows that the presidential competition between current President Obama and Romney is becoming intense. Pre-election polls, which are less than two and a half months away, show that although most respondents expect Obama to ultimately win, Obama currently leads Romney with only a 47%-46% support rate.

007daabaf23cdf2dc4bd4b69e09e730673e7463a.sourceText: 这项由AP-GfK主导的民意调查显示：近58％的受访者认为奥巴马将在11月6日再次赢得总统大选，只有32％的人认为他会被罗姆尼击败。
007daabaf23cdf2dc4bd4b69e09e730673e7463a.translatedText: This poll led by AP-GfK shows that nearly 58% of respondents think Obama will win the presidential election again on November 6, and only 32% think he will be defeated by Romney.

da38178853d5bad7342accb5beb53296f05131fc.sourceText: 两个月前AP-GfK主导同样的民意调查显示：奥巴马以 47％-44％的优势领先罗姆尼。
da38178853d5bad7342accb5beb53296f05131fc.translatedText: The same AP-GfK poll two months ago showed Obama leading Romney 47%-44%.

a1c36d6f188ba488916b3a84dfde54d0922c42b4.sourceText: 美联社报道说，由于在接下来的两个星期中，共和党和民主党都在准备全国代表大会，罗姆尼选择的竞选搭档保罗 瑞恩对竞选的影响似乎不会太大。
a1c36d6f188ba488916b3a84dfde54d0922c42b4.translatedText: The Associated Press reported that as both Republicans and Democrats prepare for their national conventions in the next two weeks, Romney's choice of running mate Paul Ryan does not appear to have much impact on the campaign.

ef3af51c48f7300ae4d4127a8ff6a8f7169068c8.sourceText: 美联社的报道说：罗姆尼选定竞选伙伴保罗 瑞恩刚刚过了一周，保罗 瑞恩在中年选民中的支持率为38％，而34％的人对他不看好。在已经登记的选民中，保罗 瑞恩的支持率要稍微好一点为40％：34％。大约有四分之一的选民表示对保罗 瑞恩不了解。
ef3af51c48f7300ae4d4127a8ff6a8f7169068c8.translatedText: The Associated Press report said: It has just been a week since Romney selected his running mate Paul Ryan. Paul Ryan's support rate among middle-aged voters is 38%, while 34% are unfavorable to him. Among registered voters, Paul Ryan's approval rating is slightly better at 40% to 34%. About a quarter of voters say they don’t know anything about Paul Ryan.

63bb2835d8b33b54a4c6f13828577aa7f7596938.sourceText: 目前自称不倾向于任何一方的独立选民人数比例在下降，在这些人中罗姆尼的支持率保持优势，有41％的独立选民支持罗姆尼，而支持奥巴马的只有30％。大约21％独立选民说，他们不支持任何候选人。
63bb2835d8b33b54a4c6f13828577aa7f7596938.translatedText: The proportion of independent voters who claim not to lean toward either party is currently declining. Among these people, Romney's approval rating maintains an advantage. 41% of independent voters support Romney, while only 30% support Obama. About 21% of independent voters said they did not support any candidate.

d4258be8dace2fb37a582de5df46d926f8b12279.sourceText: 目前在所有选民中，有23％的人尚未决定支持任何一方的候选人。
d4258be8dace2fb37a582de5df46d926f8b12279.translatedText: Currently, 23% of all voters are undecided to support a candidate from either party.
