be1396d4f27b61be2f5778bb6db20dfaa2260210.sourceText: 气如虹：生活随笔–老人娱乐 前些日子，与耆英朋友们到拉斯维加斯赌城旅游三日，回来后，有好几位没参加的朋友总喜欢提问：「好不好玩呀？」我总是微笑回答：「讲明 是去玩嘛，当然好玩啰！」因为去游玩，不是上班，自由自在，「无王管」，毫无压力，没有责任，身心自然轻松舒畅。 大概是这回参加人数多，两部旅行者，整团耆老浩浩荡荡的前进，嘻嘻哈哈归来，让那「专门为你旅游」（Especially 4-U Tours）公司的导游满意，转动其灵活的生意 头脑，乘胜追击，再接再厉，又组织老虎林（Laughulin）小赌城三日游，预定在棕榈河渡假屋(River Palm Resort) 歇息，摆设博彩与博览阵势，欢迎光临，时间于九月廿四日 出发，仍然由耆英长老司徒存作领队，到时又有一番热闹景象。 对于我来说，由于相隔两个月，不打算再去卡司诺(Casino)了，我会选择其他的娱乐消遣。 如果早前没有去过的朋友，去游玩一下是好的，有兴趣打老虎的话，喜欢摸纸牌的话，再去也无妨，惟一要注意的是，千万不可沉迷于赌博，以娱乐游戏的心态 参与，一切便无问题，毕竟那里有许多「好玩」的玩意。 我所说「好玩」，有人不大认同，觉得没有什么特点，平平无奇。 只是看见人家去就想跟随去，羊群心理，从众效应；可是别人玩得高兴，自己去了回来也不见得快乐。 如果这样，就属于个别问题，与组织旅游玩乐的活动宗旨无关。 其实一个旅行者，尤其是老年人，必须懂得自我寻求乐趣，尽情投入享受旅程的精彩特色。 除非碰到某些意外不愉快的骚扰，那是突发的例外场合，不能计算在内。 关键性在本身的心境，最主要是乐观地迎接所安排的节目。 越南人常流传很有意义的一句诗：「人闷景物有何欢？」(người buồn cảnh vui đ鈛 bao giờ?)其含义是说，如果个人心情闷闷不乐，所有景物都不会欢欣。 理由很简单，景物是没有表情的，看看那些人为的建筑物体，即使最美丽，都没有生命；而各种花卉树木，是植物类型，被风吹摇摆，不能活跃行走；至于到处的鱼虫鸟兽 ，奔跑飞翔，爬行蠕动，却是那么陌生，张眼看望而缺乏感情 ….试想想，高龄长者面对这种种环境，若不肯投入心灵关注，即使是身处高级娱乐场所，也会感到乏味。 以我的内表妹秀卿为例，她平日醉心工作，上班很少请假，乐于加班赚取更多工资，然而，一旦去旅游，她就尽情享受，投入心意，不放弃任何吃喝玩乐的节目。 这次去赌城三日，每天都开心地迎接各项活动，从未听她埋怨过输钱的话。 她拉老虎机的心态非常开朗，总是欣赏那副奇妙的机器，放进钞票，看准自己计划投注的钱码，选择多少中奖的横竖交叉线条，手指一按钮，哈哈，镜 屏滚轮转动，注视着停留的图案，叮当叮当响起来，声音清脆悦耳，好开心：「啊！又赢啦」。 如果图像互动差距了，机械静静地躺着，她会惋惜慨叹：「哎！差一点点就中彩啦！」玩了两三个钟头，输了钱，她还解释说：「好玩呀 ，花点钱玩了这么久，值得呀！我当作是租赁游戏机来玩耍一下啰。」她的洒脱玩乐，是值得让人效法。 当然，人们不应时常去赌博场所，过度沉迷没有好处。 不过，我见许多老美的高龄人士都喜欢到卡司诺消遣，流连忘返，在博彩场中忘却外边的世界。 我曾去洛杉矶多次，同样见到不少华人耆老，在免费接载巴士站前等待去赌场，探究原因，是年纪老迈，退休在家，孤寂无聊，大家都认为，没有什么地方比卡司诺 更适合老人娱乐消遣。 其实华人耆老要娱乐消遣，还有许多选择。 在凤凰城来说，虽然没有热闹的唐人街，比较沉闷，但如果要打发时光，仍然可作适当的安排。 譬如，参加凤凰城耆英会，除了例假，每星期有五天活动，唱嗜歌，跳跳舞，搓麻雀，下象棋，打乒乓球，作健身操，耍太极拳，练模特姿势，或学习 英语，读入籍课程等等。 若不方便参与，可以去康乐老人大楼，那里有组织歌唱班，粤韵曲艺 ，音乐演奏，有时玩玩卡拉ＯＫ，每月第一个星期日晚还继续组织生日宴会，共同庆祝寿辰，亦有麻雀会​​战。 此外，也可以去纪念大厦，拜会居住那儿的一些老友，找寻投契的娱乐。 或者进行个别的活动，如喜欢聊天的相约朋友去茶楼品茗，打雀英雄就到朋友家中搓几圈卫生麻雀，下棋对奕者找个对手跃马腾车，音乐人士则聚集三五知音 满足所好，当然也可以做个独行侠，「独自去偷欢，寂寞找个伴」；可以独自上网，做个浏览天下的网中人….. 总而言之，老人娱乐，除了那些以赌博为主的所谓娱乐场外，还有不少消遣解闷的场所，只要懂得选择，何愁没有好去处。 假使真正闲得发慌，无聊到极，不妨来电邀请我，随时奉陪阁下去茶楼一盅两件，说地谈天，哈哈！
be1396d4f27b61be2f5778bb6db20dfaa2260210.translatedText: Qi Ruhong: Life Essays - Entertainment for the Elderly A few days ago, I went to Las Vegas for a three-day trip with my senior friends. After returning, several friends who did not participate always like to ask: "Was it fun?" I always smile and answer: "It's clear that I am going to play, of course it is fun!" Because I go to play, not to go to work, I am free and "no boss", there is no pressure, no responsibility, and my body and mind are naturally relaxed and comfortable. Probably because of the large number of participants this time, the two groups of senior citizens advanced vigorously and came back laughing and joking, which satisfied the tour guide of the "Specially 4-U Tours" company. They used their flexible business acumen to pursue the victory and kept up their efforts. They organized a three-day tour to the small gambling town of Laughulin and booked it at the River Palm Resort. After rest, we set up the gaming and exposition array, and welcome everyone. We will set off on September 24th, with senior elder Situ Cun still leading the team, and there will be a lively scene again. For me, since it’s been two months and I don’t plan to go to Casino again, I will choose other entertainment options. For those of you who haven’t been there before, it’s a good idea to go there. If you’re interested in hunting tigers or playing cards, it’s okay to go there. The only thing you need to pay attention to is that you must not be addicted to gambling. Participate with an entertainment and game mentality, and everything will be fine. After all, there are many “fun” things there. When I say "fun", some people don't agree with it and think it has no special features and is ordinary. Just seeing others go and wanting to follow them is a herd mentality and a herd effect; but if others are having fun, you may not be happy when you go and come back. If this is the case, it is an individual issue and has nothing to do with the purpose of organizing tourism and entertainment activities. In fact, a traveler, especially an elderly person, must know how to seek his own pleasure and devote himself to enjoying the wonderful features of the journey. Unless you encounter some unexpected and unpleasant harassment, it is an unexpected and exceptional occasion and cannot be counted. The key lies in your own state of mind, and the most important thing is to welcome the arranged program optimistically. There is a very meaningful poem often circulated by the Vietnamese: "What joy can a person have when he is depressed about the scenery?" (người buồn cảnh vui đ鈛 bao giờ?). The meaning is that if a person is depressed, all scenery will not be joyful. The reason is simple. The scenery has no expression. Look at those man-made buildings. Even the most beautiful ones are lifeless. All kinds of flowers and trees are plant types that are swayed by the wind and cannot walk actively. As for the fish, insects, birds and beasts everywhere, running, flying, crawling and squirming, they are so unfamiliar. They open their eyes and look at them without emotion... Just think about it, if the elderly are not willing to devote their spiritual attention to such an environment, they will feel bored even in high-end entertainment venues. Take my cousin Xiuqing as an example. She is devoted to her work on weekdays and rarely takes leave from work. She is willing to work overtime to earn more wages. However, once she goes on a trip, she enjoys it to the fullest and puts her heart and soul into it without giving up any food, drink or entertainment. This time I went to the casino for three days. Every day she happily welcomed various activities. I never heard her complain about losing money. She has a very cheerful attitude when playing slot machines. She always appreciates the wonderful machine. She puts in the banknotes, looks at the money she plans to bet, selects the number of winning horizontal and vertical lines, presses a button with her finger, haha, the mirror screen wheel rotates, watching the remaining pattern, the jingling jingling sounds, the sound is clear and sweet, she is so happy: "Ah! I win again." If the image interaction is not enough and the machine lies quietly, she will lament with regret: "Hey! I almost won the lottery!" After playing for two or three hours and losing money, she also explained: "It was fun. It was worth spending some money to play for so long! I treated it like renting a game console to play." Her free and easy play is worthy of others' imitation. Of course, people should not frequent gambling establishments, and there is no benefit in overindulging. However, I have seen that many elderly people from the United States like to go to Casino for entertainment, linger there, and forget about the outside world in the casino. I have been to Los Angeles many times, and I have also seen many Chinese elderly people waiting in front of the free bus stop to go to the casino. When I inquired about the reason, they are old, retired at home, lonely and bored. Everyone thinks that there is no place more suitable for the elderly to have fun and relax than Casino. In fact, Chinese seniors have many choices when it comes to entertainment. In Phoenix, although there is no lively Chinatown and it is relatively dull, if you want to kill time, you can still make appropriate arrangements. For example, if you join the Phoenix Senior Citizens Association, in addition to your period, there are five days a week of activities, including singing, dancing, playing mahjong, playing chess, table tennis, doing aerobics, doing Tai Chi, practicing model poses, learning English, taking naturalization courses, etc. If it is not convenient to participate, you can go to the Leisure Elderly Building, which organizes singing classes, Cantonese folk arts, music performances, and sometimes karaoke. Birthday parties are also organized on the first Sunday night of every month to celebrate birthdays together, and there are also mahjong battles. In addition, you can also go to the Memorial Building to meet some old friends who live there and find some entertainment in speculation. Or engage in individual activities, such as meeting friends who like to chat to go to a teahouse to drink tea, a sparrow hero going to a friend's house to rub a few laps of hygienic sparrows, a chess player finding an opponent with a prancing horse or a chariot, and musicians gathering with close friends to satisfy their interests. Of course, you can also be a lone ranger, "go alone to have fun, and find a companion when you are lonely"; you can surf the Internet alone and be a person on the Internet who browses the world... All in all, in terms of entertainment for the elderly, in addition to the so-called casinos that mainly focus on gambling, there are also many places for entertainment and boredom. As long as you know how to choose, there is no need to worry about not having a good place. If you are really busy and bored, you might as well call me and invite me to accompany you to the teahouse for a cup or two and chat, haha!

cb73fe672e839d03be6803fe6acd939e23b089d2.sourceText: 市政府资料显示，纽约市职场在2010年变得更加危险，发生的摔死、人身伤害和暴力攻击事件比过去增多。 纽约邮报报导，纽约市去年发生68起职场死亡，比前年增加五起。人身伤害和暴力攻击事件连续两年上升，一共发生15起职场杀人桉和13起枪击桉，自杀(self-inflicted death)事件也增加了。 劳工局劳工统计处(BLS)的初步资料显示，职场摔死从2009年的五起增加到2010年的13起，增加一倍多。例如本月初在曼哈坦上城西区一家教堂的房顶上，一名建筑工人不小心掉下来摔死。 BLS经济师伯格曼(Bruce Bergman)指出，贸易、交通和公用事业部门发生的职场死亡事件最多，从前年的19起上升到去年的21起。除了摔死增多，人身伤害和暴力事件也升至五年来最高水平。 但一个工人安全的组织的官员表示，这些数字敲响警钟。「纽约职场安全与健康委员会」（NYCOSH）执行长休夫洛(Joel Shufro)说：「裁员伤害了工人，雇主要求他们干更多的事，却支付较少报酬。」 休夫洛表示，今天的工人往往面临更危险局面，因为他们把裁员的坏消息传递给被裁员者时，后者就把怒火朝他们身上发洩。 休夫洛还说，现在全美的10%失业率也影响了工人，摔死主要发生在没有工会的建筑工地，工人担心失业而不愿抱怨职场的不安全因素。 休夫洛指出，西语裔工人和25-54岁工人发生的职场死亡率最高。
cb73fe672e839d03be6803fe6acd939e23b089d2.translatedText: City government data shows that New York City workplaces became more dangerous in 2010, with more deaths, personal injuries and violent attacks occurring than in the past. The New York Post reported that there were 68 workplace deaths in New York City last year, five more than the year before. Personal injuries and violent attacks have increased for two consecutive years, with a total of 15 workplace homicides and 13 shootings, and self-inflicted deaths have also increased. Preliminary data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that fatal falls in the workplace more than doubled from five in 2009 to 13 in 2010. For example, earlier this month, a construction worker accidentally fell to his death from the roof of a church in Uptown Manhattan. BLS economist Bruce Bergman pointed out that the trade, transportation and utilities sector had the most workplace fatalities, rising from 19 the year before to 21 last year. In addition to the increase in falls, injuries and violence have also risen to their highest levels in five years. But officials with a worker safety group said the figures were a wake-up call. "Layoffs hurt workers," said Joel Shufro, CEO of the New York Council on Occupational Safety and Health (NYCOSH). "Employers ask them to do more and pay less." Shufro said that today's workers often face more dangerous situations because when they convey the bad news of layoffs to those who have been laid off, the latter take out their anger on them. Hueflow also said that the current 10% unemployment rate in the United States has also affected workers. Falling deaths mainly occur at construction sites without unions. Workers are worried about losing their jobs and are unwilling to complain about unsafe factors in the workplace. Huuffro noted that Hispanic workers and workers ages 25 to 54 have the highest workplace fatality rates.

(Compiled by this website) After a period of near death, with the recovery of the real estate market, the loan industry has revived, bringing new employment opportunities. Governor Jane Brewer and Tempe Mayor announced Thursday that California-based Union Bank is expanding its operations with a new lending center in Tempe that will create 250 jobs. The 42,000-square-foot center will open in June at Washington Street and North Priest.

76c6e9f9358c506dcd99e5d68b0f369a38a0dcbe.sourceText: 希尔斯召回795,000台Kenmore除湿机 （亚省时报）因为潜在火灾和烧伤的危险，Sears和Kmart百货宣布召回约795,000台肯莫尔牌（Kenmore）除湿机。这些公司和美国消费者产品安全委员会周四联合声明说，该除湿机可能过热、冒烟、融化和着火。 公司收到107例事故报告，其中三起事故发生吸入烟雾损伤。报告包括超过700万美元的财产损害。 这种除湿机是2003-2005年之间生产，有三种型号包括35-，50-，70-品脱，售价在140到220美元之间。他们在美国的西尔斯和凯马特商店，及这两家公司的网站上销售。 该产品由白色塑料制造，在顶部有肯莫尔商标。除湿机大小是21-24英寸高，大约15英寸宽，大约13.5英寸深。他们包含风扇，湿度控制和水桶。一些型号包括遥控器。 型号数码是：35-pint (2004) – 580.54351400；50-pint (2003) – 580.53509300；70-pint (2003) – 580.53701300；70-pint (2004) – 580.54701400；70-pint (2005) – 580.54701500。如果把桶子拿掉，这些型号数码应该可以在机器内侧的右方看到。 个人可以联系召回中心（855）400-4641，或者 www.Kenmoredehumidifierrecall.com 。消费者将收到西尔斯价值$75、$80、$90或$100的礼物卡。礼物卡的价值取决于除湿机的容量和制造年份。礼物卡可以在任何Sears或Kmart，或商店网站上使用。 那些不需要礼物卡的消费者可以要求退款。所有受到召回影响的消费者也将收到25美元的优惠券，可以在Sears或者Sears网站上购买新的肯莫尔除湿机。
76c6e9f9358c506dcd99e5d68b0f369a38a0dcbe.translatedText: > Sears recalls 795,000 Kenmore dehumidifiers (Alberta Times) Sears and Kmart department stores have announced a recall of approximately 795,000 Kenmore brand dehumidifiers due to potential fire and burn hazards. The dehumidifiers could overheat, smoke, melt and catch fire, the companies and the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission said in a joint statement Thursday. The company received 107 accident reports, three of which involved smoke inhalation injuries. Reports include more than $7 million in property damage. This dehumidifier was produced between 2003 and 2005 and comes in three models including 35-, 50-, and 70-pint, priced between $140 and $220. They are sold in Sears and Kmart stores in the United States, as well as on both companies' websites. The product is made of white plastic and has the Kenmore branding on the top. Dehumidifier dimensions are 21-24 inches high, approximately 15 inches wide, and approximately 13.5 inches deep. They contain fans, humidity controls and water buckets. Some models include a remote control. The model numbers are: 35-pint (2004) – 580.54351400; 50-pint (2003) – 580.53509300; 70-pint (2003) – 580.53701300; 70-pint (2004) – 580.54701400; 70-pint (2005) – 580.54701500. If you remove the barrel, these model numbers should be visible on the right side of the inside of the machine. Individuals can contact the recall center at (855) 400-4641, or www.Kenmoredehumidifierrecall.com. Consumers will receive a Sears gift card valued at $75, $80, $90 or $100. The value of the gift card depends on the dehumidifier's capacity and year of manufacture. Gift cards can be used at any Sears or Kmart, or on the store website. Those consumers who don't need the gift cards can request a refund. All consumers affected by the recall will also receive a $25 coupon to purchase a new Kenmore dehumidifier at Sears or on the Sears website.

7020d7e4f24609f7f7f7004c51fb7d9404aff55a.sourceText: 奥的斯电梯再出故障 11名广交会宾客受困近1小时 （亚省时报特约记者杨绮薇报道） 本月５日因故停运、导致广州塔（小蛮腰）４２ 名游客被困一小时的奥的斯电梯， 16 日再生故障，导致 11 名广交会宾客在电梯内受困近 1 小时。 10 月 16 日，广交会开幕第三天，入住广州邦泰国际公寓的 11 名广交会宾客，在乘坐奥的斯牌电梯返回房间时，电梯突然发生故障，从 5 楼快速下坠到 3 楼。 11 名广交会宾客备受惊吓，并被困在电梯内近 1 小时。涉事电梯还是奥的斯牌。 受困的 11 名广交会宾客中，有 3 名外籍人士。被困宾客陈先生对记者说，电梯升至 5 楼时突然停顿，然后” 没有任何征兆，就突然掉了下去” 。据了解，当时电梯下坠数秒后停住，电梯内显示屏上显示停在 3 楼。大家按开门键没有反应，只好拨打电梯内的电话求救。 20 分钟后，即当天晚上 8 时许，西子奥的斯电梯维修人员才赶到现场，从外部撬开电梯门，把 11 名宾客解救出来。 据奥的斯维修人员称，事故是因超载而造成的。但多名被困的宾客说，电梯内部的显示核载标准为 1000kg ， 13 人，当时并没有超过核载人数，电梯也没有发出超载警告。大家对维修人员给出的解释均不满意，并表示愿意称量体重看是否超重。
7020d7e4f24609f7f7f7004c51fb7d9404aff55a.translatedText: The Otis elevator broke down again and 11 Canton Fair guests were trapped for nearly an hour. (Reporting by Yang Qiwei, Special Correspondent of the Alberta Times) The Otis elevator that was out of service for some reason on the 5th of this month, causing 42 tourists to be trapped in the Canton Tower for an hour, broke down again on the 16th, causing 11 Canton Fair guests to be trapped in the elevator for nearly an hour. On October 16, the third day of the Canton Fair, 11 Canton Fair guests staying at the Bangtai International Apartment in Guangzhou were taking the Otis elevator back to their rooms when the elevator suddenly malfunctioned and fell rapidly from the 5th floor to the 3rd floor. Eleven Canton Fair guests were frightened and trapped in an elevator for nearly an hour. The elevator involved was an Otis brand. Among the 11 Canton Fair guests stranded, three were foreigners. Mr. Chen, a trapped guest, told reporters that the elevator suddenly stopped when it reached the fifth floor, and then "suddenly fell without any warning." It is understood that the elevator fell for a few seconds and then stopped. The display screen in the elevator showed that it had stopped at the third floor. Everyone pressed the door button but there was no response, so they had to call the phone in the elevator for help. Twenty minutes later, at about 8 pm that night, Xizi Otis elevator maintenance personnel arrived at the scene, pried open the elevator door from the outside, and rescued 11 guests. According to Otis maintenance personnel, the accident was caused by overloading. However, many trapped guests said that the rated load standard displayed inside the elevator was 1,000kg and 13 people, which was not exceeded at the time, and the elevator did not issue an overload warning. Everyone was not satisfied with the explanation given by the maintenance staff and expressed their willingness to weigh themselves to see if they were overweight.

c94d2615387cb5678a898c19905307c9743ea9a5.sourceText: 夏令时11日凌晨2时开始 （亚省时报） 今年日光节约时间于3月11日凌晨2时(也就是10日深夜2时)开始，将于11月4日的凌晨2时结束。日光节约时间意味春天到来，也表示当天少睡一小时。 日光节约时间对有些人可能没有影响，但刚开始日光节约时间的前几天，有些人的生理时钟可能调适不过来，因此会影响心情和工作效率，造成车祸、职场伤害，甚至股市下跌。 亚利桑那州是全美为数不多不执行夏令时的州，全州只有那瓦霍自治区实行DST。虽然本州大多数居民不用调拨钟表，但出州远行的朋友要注意时差。
c94d2615387cb5678a898c19905307c9743ea9a5.translatedText: Daylight saving time starts at 2 a.m. on March 11th (Alberta Times) This year, daylight saving time starts at 2 a.m. on March 11 (that is, 2 a.m. on the night of the 10th) and will end at 2 a.m. on November 4. Daylight saving time means the arrival of spring, and it also means losing an hour of sleep that day. Daylight saving time may have no effect on some people, but in the first few days of daylight saving time, some people's biological clocks may not be able to adjust, which may affect their mood and work efficiency, resulting in car accidents, workplace injuries, and even a stock market drop. Arizona is one of the few states in the United States that does not implement daylight saving time. Only the Navajo Autonomous Region in the state implements DST. Although most residents of the state do not need to set their clocks, those traveling out of state should be aware of the time difference.

095633969c4ca176e7fa93e9c2db22d418b18470.sourceText: 台北国际电脑展促成近250亿美元订单 为期５天的２０１１年台北国际电脑展４日闭幕，展览吸引了来自１６２个国家和地区的约３．６万买家，比去年增长３．１％。展览共促成了价值近２５０亿美元的订单（含采购意向）。 展览主办方–台湾对外贸易发展协会展览事务负责人洪铭钦介绍，今年展会的热门采购项目是 平板电脑 及相关产品。此外，智慧型手机、电子书、３Ｄ科技以及云端服务也受到买主青睐。 洪铭钦认为，本次展会最大的亮点是国际化程度大大增加，更多的国际知名大公司在展览上发布新品或举行报告会和研讨会。此外，本次展会上出现了很多最新产品。 据了解，本次展会的前５大买主地区为美国、日本、中国大陆、香港、韩国。与国际同类展览相比，台北国际电脑展的国际买家数量居全球第二、亚洲第一。 本次展览共有１８００家厂商设立了５３００个摊位，比去年增加９％。
095633969c4ca176e7fa93e9c2db22d418b18470.translatedText: Computex Taipei facilitated nearly US$25 billion in orders. The five-day Computex Taipei 2011 concluded on the 4th. The exhibition attracted approximately 36,000 buyers from 162 countries and regions, an increase of 3.1% over last year. The exhibition has generated orders worth nearly US$25 billion (including purchase intentions). Hong Mingqin, head of exhibition affairs at the Taiwan Foreign Trade Development Association, the organizer of the exhibition, said that the popular purchasing items at this year’s exhibition are tablet computers and related products. In addition, smartphones, e-books, 3D technology and cloud services are also favored by buyers. Hong Mingqin believes that the biggest highlight of this exhibition is that the degree of internationalization has greatly increased, and more internationally renowned large companies will release new products or hold report meetings and seminars at the exhibition. In addition, many latest products appeared at this exhibition. It is understood that the top five buyer regions of this exhibition are the United States, Japan, Mainland China, Hong Kong, and South Korea. Compared with similar international exhibitions, the number of international buyers at Computex Taipei ranks second in the world and first in Asia. A total of 1,800 manufacturers set up 5,300 booths at this exhibition, an increase of 9% over last year.

Although the Bode couple did not guess the special number 13 that day, they guessed 5 numbers correctly. Mr. Bode, a retired police officer, told the Mojave Daily News he planned to use the money to buy a new car for his wife, give some money to his son and invest the rest for retirement.

9029b7be93f375396b612871ceb8dc36aac9bcda.sourceText: （亚省时报） 密西根大学和哈佛大学研究人员24日公布的最新调查显示，美国至少有一个月每人每天生活费不到两元的家庭，过去15年增加逾一倍，从1996年的63万6000户，增至去年的146万户。 密西根大学教授沙佛说，政府的福利措施虽然减少了赤贫的影响，但没有完全消除。他说，由于粮食券也计为家庭收入，使每天生活费只有两元的家庭下降到80万户，但仍比1996年的47万5000户增加许多。 这项调查显示，赤贫家庭中有五分之一是领取租房补助，或是住政府楼；66%的家庭至少有一名子女享受政府健保。但在调查中，这些因素没有计入家庭收入。 保守智库传统基金会研究员莱克特说，给贫穷家庭提供的多数援助都不是现金。他说，联邦和各州去年通过70项计画，发放9000亿元补助给穷人，如健保、粮食券、能源援助和大学赠款等。 莱克特说，这项调查是表明家庭一个月期间的赤贫，因此更能反映这些家庭遇到的失业、离异或短期危机等问题。
9029b7be93f375396b612871ceb8dc36aac9bcda.translatedText: (Alberta Times) The latest survey released by researchers from the University of Michigan and Harvard University on the 24th showed that the number of households in the United States living on less than $2 per person per day for at least one month has more than doubled in the past 15 years, from 636,000 households in 1996 to 1.46 million households last year. Schaffer, a professor at the University of Michigan, said that although government welfare measures have reduced the impact of extreme poverty, they have not completely eliminated it. He said that because food stamps are also counted as household income, the number of households living on only two yuan a day has dropped to 800,000, which is still much higher than the 475,000 households in 1996. This survey shows that one-fifth of extremely poor families receive rental subsidies or live in government buildings; 66% of families have at least one child covered by government health insurance. But in the survey, these factors were not factored into household income. Lecter, a fellow at the Heritage Foundation, a conservative think tank, said most aid to poor families is not cash. He said that the federal and state governments passed 70 programs last year, distributing 900 billion yuan in subsidies to the poor, such as health insurance, food stamps, energy assistance and college grants. Lecter said the survey shows a household's extreme poverty over a one-month period and is therefore more reflective of issues such as unemployment, divorce or short-term crises experienced by these households.

d6805b677e22c191195148981cf9f1ddb7357db8.sourceText: 庆祝中华民国建国一百年国庆文化访问团9月巡回美国13城市 侨务委员会庆祝中华民国建国一百年国庆文化访问团将于9月9日至10月10日巡回美国波士顿、匹兹堡、底特律、芝加哥、达拉斯、洛杉矶、旧金山、凤凰城、圣地亚哥、西雅图、波特兰、华府及纽约等地，演出14场次，期藉此演出与侨胞欢度双十国庆，并将台湾优质文化与美国主流社会分享，透过这场艺术飨宴，让世界看见台湾的生命力与文化活力。 此次访问团由台湾跨界国乐美女乐团「无双乐团」担纲演出，以「璀璨100 乐扬四海」为主题，重新诠释国、台语经典歌曲、流行音乐及世界名曲，乐团演出包括笛子、柳琴、扬琴、三弦、小阮、中阮、琵琶、月琴、古筝、二胡、大提琴、打击、美声及舞蹈，展现时尚新古典音乐之美。 「无双乐团」演出足迹遍布全球，在中南美洲邦交国危地马拉、多米尼加等国巡回演出，场场爆满，多次登上当地媒体娱乐头版头条。2010年2月亦筹组侨务委员会春节文化访问团至欧洲巡演，受到德国、法国、比利时、荷兰、意大利等地侨胞与外国友人的热烈回响。此次精选曲目如「雨夜花」、「白牡丹」、「我只在乎你」、「甜蜜蜜」及「感恩的心」代表台湾不同世代记忆及心情，也安排了传统国乐名曲如「田野琴声」及「赛马」、西洋名曲「大黄蜂的飞行」、台湾流行歌曲「菊花台」及「千里之外」，让美国侨胞及各界朋友感受台湾音乐文化的万种风情。 中华民国建国一百年国庆意义非凡，侨务委员会与美国13城市主办侨团诚挚邀请侨胞偕旧雨、携新知共同欢度「精彩100」的璀璨与荣耀，详细演出时间及地点，可洽各华侨文教服务中心或驻外馆处。
d6805b677e22c191195148981cf9f1ddb7357db8.translatedText: The National Day cultural delegation to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Republic of China will tour 13 cities in the United States in September. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Council's National Day cultural delegation to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Republic of China will tour the United States from September 9 to October 10 in Boston, Pittsburgh, Detroit, Chicago, Dallas, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Phoenix, San Diego, Seattle, Portland, Washington, DC, and New York, performing 14 performances. The performance will celebrate the National Day with overseas Chinese and share Taiwan's high-quality culture with mainstream American society. Through this artistic feast, the world will see the vitality and cultural vitality of Taiwan. The visiting group is led by Taiwan's cross-border Chinese music orchestra "Wu Shuang Ensemble". With the theme of "Brilliant 100 Music Spreading Around the World", it reinterprets Chinese and Taiwanese classic songs, pop music and world famous songs. The orchestra's performances include flute, liuqin, dulcimer, sanxian, small ruan, zhongruan, pipa, yueqin, guzheng, erhu, cello, percussion, bel canto and dance, showing the beauty of fashionable neoclassical music. The "Unparalleled Band" has performed all over the world, touring in Guatemala, the Dominican Republic and other countries in Central and South America. The venues were sold out and it made the headlines of local media and entertainment many times. In February 2010, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council's Spring Festival cultural delegation was organized to tour Europe, which received enthusiastic response from overseas Chinese and foreign friends in Germany, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Italy and other places. The selected tracks such as "Rainy Night Flower", "White Peony", "I Only Care About You", "Sweet Honey" and "Grateful Heart" represent the memories and moods of different generations in Taiwan. Traditional Chinese music such as "The Sound of the Field" and "Horse Racing", the Western famous song "Flight of the Bumblebee", Taiwanese popular songs "Chrysanthemum Terrace" and "Thousands of Miles Away" are also arranged, allowing American overseas Chinese and friends from all walks of life to experience the various styles of Taiwan's music culture. The 100th anniversary of the founding of the Republic of China is of great significance. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Council and the overseas Chinese delegations hosted by 13 cities in the United States sincerely invite overseas Chinese to celebrate the brilliance and glory of "Wonderful 100" with old rain and new knowledge. For detailed performance time and location, please contact the overseas Chinese cultural and educational service center or the overseas Chinese embassy office.

d84fe4d37467760ae7f87636525c97524e7fd3af.sourceText: FBI: 杀手逃犯可能藏在摩门教社区 联邦调查局探员说，一名冷血杀手在八年前血洗武装押款车后逃去无踪，现在有证据显示他匿藏在本州岛的摩门教社区。 杰森布朗被指控在2004年11月29日，在48街和雷大道外的凤凰剧院外，用枪朝押款车保卫罗伯特帕罗马雷斯开枪五次，使其死亡。FBI调查员蓝星说，布朗在他价值￥56000元的自行车上留下指纹。蓝星说，43岁的布朗是个说谎高手，用假身份混上一个摩门教徒身份。 布朗在南加州长大，曾在盐湖城和内华达州生活很长时间。现在仍在全国十大通缉犯名单，花红达10万美元。 FBI表示，布朗可能拥有两支手枪，高约5’10，重170至180磅之间，绿色眼睛和金色头发。 凡有其信息者，可打沉默证人电话：480-WITNESS (480-948-6377)。
d84fe4d37467760ae7f87636525c97524e7fd3af.translatedText: FBI: Fugitive killer may be hiding in Mormon community FBI agents say a cold-blooded killer who ran away without a trace after robbing an armed escort truck eight years ago now has evidence that he is hiding in a Mormon community on Honshu Island. Jason Brown is accused of fatally shooting guard Robert Palmares five times in an escort vehicle on Nov. 29, 2004, outside the Phoenix Theater off 48th Street and Ray Avenue. FBI investigator Blue Star said Brown left fingerprints on his $56,000 bicycle. Blue Star said Brown, 43, was a master liar who used a false identity to appear to be a Mormon. Brown grew up in Southern California and spent time living in Salt Lake City and Nevada. He is still on the list of the ten most wanted criminals in the country and has a bonus of $100,000. The FBI said Brown, who may have two handguns, is about 5'10" tall, weighs between 170 and 180 pounds, and has green eyes and blond hair. Anyone with information can call Silent Witness at 480-WITNESS (480-948-6377).

1a5a5bc13ca3b2d1ea5d74decd754896ca80c331.sourceText: 佛州迈阿密骇人的裸男吃脸案和其他一连串人吃人案，让许多民众怀疑世界上或许真有僵尸，网路谣言绘声绘影，连联邦政府也得出面澄清：这些事件与僵尸无关。 5月26日，迈阿密31岁裸男尤金吃掉65岁流浪汉波普75%的脸庞。接着29日，马里兰州一名21岁学生坦承谋杀室友并吞下他的心和脑。加拿大色情男​​优麦格诺达日前涉嫌奸杀中国留学生并生啖其肉，警方正展开全球追缉行动。 多起人吃人事件在网路上引发热烈讨论，「僵尸启示录」（zombie apocalypse，指大量僵尸复活并攻击人类）一词更成为Google热门搜寻关键词第二名。八卦网站Gawker也指佛州一所高中爆发连疾病管制单位也无法解释的「神秘的红疹」疫情，就是僵尸正接管世界的进一步证据。
1a5a5bc13ca3b2d1ea5d74decd754896ca80c331.translatedText: The shocking naked man’s face-eating case in Miami, Florida, and a series of other cannibalism cases have made many people suspect that there may be zombies in the world. Internet rumors are so vivid that even the federal government has to come out to clarify: These incidents have nothing to do with zombies. On May 26, a 31-year-old naked man named Eugene in Miami ate 75% of the face of a 65-year-old homeless man named Pop. Then on the 29th, a 21-year-old student in Maryland confessed to murdering his roommate and eating his heart and brain. Canadian porn actor Magnotta was recently suspected of raping, killing and eating the flesh of a Chinese student. The police are launching a global manhunt. Many incidents of cannibalism have sparked heated discussions on the Internet, and the term "zombie apocalypse" (which refers to a large number of zombies resurrecting and attacking humans) has become the second most popular search keyword on Google. Gossip website Gawker also pointed to a "mysterious rash" outbreak at a Florida high school that even disease control authorities could not explain, as further evidence that zombies are taking over the world.

96fd4613cab676c5b45e575d1ff1b96f14a3f3c4.sourceText: 美国疾病管制暨预防中心(CDC)曾多次用「僵尸启示录」当作宣导防灾知识时的吸睛标题，然而CDC这次正式声明：僵尸并不存在。 CDC发言人戴格写信给「哈芬登邮报」网站说：「本中心并不知道有病毒和疾病能让人死而复生，或造成类似僵尸的征候。」 人类已在动物界观察到类似僵尸的行为。巴西热带雨林新发现的真菌Ophiocordyceps camponoti-balzani能控制蚂蚁的脑袋，让它们往适合这类真菌生长的地点移动，达到目的后便杀死蚂蚁。 迈阿密警方怀疑食脸男尤金可能因吸食迷幻药「浴盐」而犯案，众院正在考虑将「浴盐」列为跟海洛因、麦角二乙胺（LSD）同级的毒品，本州稍早前已经立法禁售「浴盐」。
96fd4613cab676c5b45e575d1ff1b96f14a3f3c4.translatedText: The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has repeatedly used "Zombie Apocalypse" as an eye-catching title when promoting disaster prevention knowledge. However, the CDC officially stated this time: Zombies do not exist. CDC spokesman Daigle wrote to the Huffington Post website: "The Center is not aware of viruses or diseases that can bring people back from the dead or cause zombie-like symptoms." Humans have observed zombie-like behavior in the animal kingdom. Ophiocordyceps camponoti-balzani, a newly discovered fungus in the Brazilian rainforest, can control the heads of ants, allowing them to move to locations suitable for the growth of this type of fungus, and then kill the ants after achieving their goal. The Miami police suspect that face-eating man Eugene may have committed the crime by taking the psychedelic drug "bath salts." The House of Representatives is considering classifying "bath salts" as a drug on the same level as heroin and ergot diethylamine (LSD). The state had earlier enacted legislation to ban the sale of "bath salts."

05d3e0f211a77a2274308f3976d1322297705674.translatedText: College Board Will SAT Test The SAT, the most commonly accepted college admissions test, will get a facelift. College Board President Cole, who sponsors the SAT test...

d803e7f5445e9442d6938c4bab0cc1d455a6ca11.sourceText: 大学理事会 将SAT测验 最普遍被接受的大學入學考試SAT將改頭換面，主辦SAT測驗的大學理事會主席柯爾曼26日以電郵通知其6000個會員說，該理事會將重新設計SAT測驗，更著重於高中畢業生能在大學獲得成功所需的「核心知識與技 巧」，並使SAT更切合需要。 大學理事會是在SAT的市場占有開始輸給其標準測驗的對手ACT之後，展開這項修改計畫。西部和南部的高中生多考ACT，東西兩岸的高中生多考SAT。 2012年畢業班有超過166萬學生考SAT，是SAT歷史上應考人數最多的年班，SAT的考生也日益多元化，有更多的低收入者、非洲裔和西語裔學生考SAT。 但在2011年，考ACT的人首次超過考SAT的人，柯爾曼在電郵中表示，修改SAT的原因之一是確保它切合需要，他說：「雖然SAT是目前對大學和專業準備的最佳標準化衡量工具，但大學理事會有責任對每年所服務的數以百萬計學生確保我們的計畫被持續評估與增強，以及最重要的對接受我們服務者的新需要加以回應。」他表示，他的目標是對學生、高等教育官員、從幼稚園到高中的校長、教師和輔導人員增進SAT的價值。 SAT上一次修改是在2005年，包括增加了作文、考試時間延長，和滿分從1600分提高為2400分。柯爾曼批評SAT的作文測驗容許太多的個人敘述，未挑戰學生寫作提出證據的論述，而這是大學要求的技巧。
d803e7f5445e9442d6938c4bab0cc1d455a6ca11.translatedText: College Board Will SAT Test The SAT, the most commonly accepted college admissions test, will be redesigned. Coleman, chairman of the College Board, which sponsors the SAT test, notified its 6,000 members via email on the 26th that the board will redesign the SAT test to focus more on the "core knowledge and skills" that high school graduates need to succeed in college and make the SAT more relevant to their needs. The College Board launched the changes after the SAT began losing market share to its standardized test rival, the ACT. High school students in the west and south often take the ACT, while high school students on the east and west coasts often take the SAT. In the graduating class of 2012, more than 1.66 million students took the SAT, making it the class with the largest number of students taking the SAT in history. SAT candidates are becoming increasingly diverse, with more low-income, African-American and Hispanic students taking the SAT. But in 2011, for the first time, more people took the ACT than took the SAT. Coleman said in an email that one of the reasons for revising the SAT was to make sure it was relevant. "While the SAT is by far the best standardized measure of college and professional readiness, the College Board has a responsibility to measure it every year," he said. The millions of students we serve ensure that our programs are continually evaluated, enhanced, and most importantly responsive to the emerging needs of those we serve," he said. His goal is to increase the value of the SAT to students, higher education officials, principals, teachers and counselors from kindergarten through high school. The SAT was last revised in 2005, including adding an essay, extending the test time, and raising the full score from 1,600 to 2,400. Coleman criticized the SAT's essay test for allowing too much personal narrative and failing to challenge students to write evidence-based arguments, a skill required in college.

3b0f7e41d84a1b603c380b1356b19f3c267f0a97.sourceText: SB1070移民法中，警方可拦检疑为非法移民的条款，日前在被联邦最高法院裁决保留后，已出现第一起警方通报联邦探员逮捕非法移民的合作案例。 美国移民与海关执法局探员1日晚逮捕两名被本州警察拦检到的非法移民嫌犯。 马利科巴郡警长阿派奥表示，两名嫌犯是该局打击人口走私小组在执行交通拦检时查获。 最高法院在6月25日的裁决中，​​虽然推翻移民法大部分的条款，却保留该法最具争议性的条款，亦即允许警察在合理怀疑的情况下，可拦检盘查移民身分。 不过，国内安全部不久即宣布，USICE探员仅会回应警方符合极为特定标准的通报。 在本州触犯人口走私被视为重罪，而USICE在1日逮捕的嫌犯中，其中一人即是无人陪伴的16岁青少年。 阿派奥表示，儿童偷渡案件日益增多。 阿派奥预期在最高法院的裁决后，这类案件将持续获得USICE的配合，但其他类型案件的请求协助，可能不再获得联邦回应。 不过，阿派奥仍感欣慰，他说：「至少联邦政府也认同该局警察有资格盘查某些问题，并可在没有种族侦防的情况下，判定移民身分。」
3b0f7e41d84a1b603c380b1356b19f3c267f0a97.translatedText: In the SB1070 Immigration Act, the provision that the police can stop and examine suspected illegal immigrants was retained by the Federal Supreme Court ruling. The first case of cooperation in which the police notified federal agents to arrest illegal immigrants has appeared. U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents arrested two illegal immigrant suspects who were stopped by local police on the evening of the 1st. Maricopa County Sheriff Arpaio said the two suspects were discovered by the department's anti-human smuggling team during a traffic stop. In its ruling on June 25, the Supreme Court overturned most provisions of the immigration law, but retained the most controversial provision of the law, which allows the police to stop and check the status of immigrants if there is reasonable suspicion. However, the Department of Homeland Security soon announced that USICE agents would only respond to police reports that met very specific criteria. Human smuggling is considered a felony in this state, and one of the suspects arrested by USICE on the 1st was an unaccompanied 16-year-old teenager. Arpaio said cases of child smuggling are increasing day by day. Arpaio expects that after the Supreme Court’s ruling, such cases will continue to receive cooperation from USICE, but requests for assistance in other types of cases may no longer receive federal responses. However, Arpaio is still pleased, saying, "At least the federal government recognizes that the bureau's police officers are qualified to investigate certain questions and determine immigration status without racial profiling."

0ceb86e0417376dac9a62f7e5f533d8457267bb5.sourceText: 第六届《凤凰之夜》将于九月二十三日在ASU隆重举行 (亚省华联供稿) 第六届《凤凰之夜》庆祝中华人民共和国成立63周年国庆招待会暨中秋佳节将于2012年9月23日在亚利桑那州立大学隆重举行。为了筹办这次活动，亚省华人华侨联合总会会长费健于6月30日主持召开了第一次筹备会议。费健会长首先向大家介绍了第六届《凤凰之夜》筹备进展情况和初步活动安排。会议开得热烈有序，大家畅所欲言，集思广益，初步勾画出了一幅弘扬中国文化、促进中美友谊的活动蓝图。届时亚利桑那州侨学界将举办一系列相关庆祝活动，其中包括：中美文化论坛、国庆招待会、升旗仪式、青少年摄影比赛及优秀作品展览(有待最后决定)、才艺表演和中秋联谊舞会。 具体日期和庆祝活动安排如下: 时间: 九月二十三日 星期日 地点: Arizona State University MU Arizona Ballroom (MU 221) 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM 中美文化论坛 (FORUM) 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM 国庆招待会 (RECEPTION) 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM 中秋联谊舞会 (EVENING BALL) 5:00 PM – 9:00 PM 青少年摄影展览(待定) (YOUTH PHOTOGRAPH EXHIBIT) 有关具体事宜请与下列人士联系： 亚省华人华侨联合总会：费健会长 480-241-7263 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院：ASU Confucius Institute CI@asu.edu 最新消息和详情请浏览亚省华人华侨联合总会网站： www.chineseaz.org
0ceb86e0417376dac9a62f7e5f533d8457267bb5.translatedText: The 6th "Phoenix Night" will be grandly held at ASU on September 23rd (Contributed by Alberta Hualian) The 6th "Phoenix Night" celebration of the 63rd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China and the Mid-Autumn Festival will be held grandly at Arizona State University on September 23, 2012. In order to prepare for this event, Fei Jian, president of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Alberta, hosted the first preparatory meeting on June 30. President Fei Jian first introduced the preparation progress and preliminary activity arrangements of the 6th "Phoenix Night" to everyone. The meeting was held in a lively and orderly manner. Everyone spoke freely, brainstormed, and initially sketched out a blueprint for activities to promote Chinese culture and promote Sino-US friendship. At that time, the overseas Chinese community in Arizona will hold a series of related celebration activities, including: Sino-US Cultural Forum, National Day reception, flag-raising ceremony, youth photography competition and exhibition of outstanding works (to be finalized), talent show and Mid-Autumn Festival Dance. The specific dates and celebration arrangements are as follows: Time: Sunday, September 23rd Venue: Arizona State University MU Arizona Ballroom (MU 221) 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM Sino-US Cultural Forum (FORUM) 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM National Day Reception (RECEPTION) 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM Mid-Autumn Festival Dance (EVENING BALL) 5:00 PM – 9:00 PM Youth Photography Exhibition (to be determined) (YOUTH PHOTOGRAPH EXHIBIT) For specific matters, please contact the following people: Alberta Chinese Overseas Chinese Federation: President Fei Jian 480-241-7263 Arizona State University Confucius Institute: ASU Confucius Institute CI@asu.edu For the latest news and details, please visit the Alberta Chinese Overseas Chinese Federation website: www.chineseaz.org

0ca94cbfa07a44c91910cd5ab6ef1e4a717d603b.sourceText: IRS：申报家庭办公室扣除额将更简便 如果家庭办公室是你主要的工作和营业场所，你在报税时可申请扣除，但填写工作相当繁杂，也最容易引起审核者的特别关注。 国税局(IRS)近日宣布，为了使这一过程对国税局和纳税人都更容易，将在2014年为人们填写2013年税表提供一个新的选择。 目前，想要声明家庭办公室扣除额的纳税人，都必须填写一份单独的表格来清楚表明家庭只用于业务和办公室费用的百分比，要弄清楚是非常复杂的。但从2014年开始，你将不再需要做这些计算了。 相反，新的选项允许你声明办公室每平方英尺5美元的费用，上限达300平方英尺。这一简化形式将允许一年1,500美元扣除额的上限。 执业会计师说：”这将使得国税局和大多数申请此扣除的纳税人更轻松。”这也鼓励很多被扣除声明的复杂性吓跑的人开始提出申请。他还说，因为形式和过程的简化，新的扣除选项不太可能引发审计。 但是那些典型的申请超过1,500美元作为家庭办公室扣除的人们（通常的情况是他们的租金非常高的，或家庭的很大一部分被用作办公室），可能不得不继续使用当前的更复杂的方法来报税。 国税局说，340万纳税人在2010年申请家庭办公室扣除。因为记录保存和文书工作的减少，新的选项估计每年为小企业节省约160万小时。 对于美国最小的企业群来说，以前的扣除计算繁琐费时，并且提出的申请还可能会被驳回，因此对国税局这次的声明欢呼雀跃。
0ca94cbfa07a44c91910cd5ab6ef1e4a717d603b.translatedText: IRS: It will be easier to claim the home office deduction If your home office is your main place of work and business, you can claim a deduction when filing your tax return, but filling it out is quite complicated and is most likely to attract special attention from the reviewer. The Internal Revenue Service (IRS) recently announced that in order to make the process easier for both the IRS and taxpayers, it will provide a new option in 2014 for people to fill out their 2013 tax forms. Currently, taxpayers who want to claim a home office deduction must fill out a separate form to clearly indicate the percentage of the home used solely for business and office expenses, which can be complicated to figure out. But starting in 2014, you won't have to do these calculations anymore. Instead, the new option allows you to declare an office fee of $5 per square foot, up to a maximum of 300 square feet. This simplified form would allow a cap on deductions of $1,500 per year. "This will make it easier for the IRS and most taxpayers who claim this deduction," the certified public accountant said. It also encourages many people who are intimidated by the complexity of claiming the deduction to start filing. He also said the new deduction options are less likely to trigger audits because of simplified forms and processes. But those who typically claim more than $1,500 as a home office deduction (often where their rent is very high or a large portion of their home is used as an office) may have to continue using the current, more complicated method of filing their taxes. The IRS says 3.4 million taxpayers claimed the home office deduction in 2010. The new option is estimated to save small businesses approximately 1.6 million hours annually due to reduced recordkeeping and paperwork. The IRS's announcement was cheered by some of America's smallest businesses, where previous deductions had been cumbersome and time-consuming to calculate and claims could have been denied.

5290478778eaf9f10ad09c264643dac6af3d7a6e.sourceText: 太阳鸟纪事： Win的剪刀人生 (作者：清宝）在凤凰城钱德勒的Win发廊里，发现一张主人Win和中国第一夫人”彭丽媛”的合影。 于是绕有兴趣，和Win谈起这段经历。 1999年知名歌唱家彭丽媛要参加99年春晚，当时她一直留着过臀的长发，想剪个短发，给观众一个耳目一新的感觉。 于是彭丽媛的服装设计师找到了当时在全国最有名的广州发廊”胡丝嫩赏”的前发型设计师Win. 当时的Win和”胡丝嫩赏”的另外三个发型师刚刚合伙开了广州 的又一间顶级发廊”JK”。 彭丽媛的服装设计师向Win表达了彭丽媛想改发型的想法。 Win对着彭丽媛的照片说，根据彭丽媛的脸型，她还是适合长发，而且对于演艺人员来说，长发的可塑性高，会给外形设计者更多的创作空间。 尽管如此，彭丽媛还是不死心，坚持希望剪个短发试一试。 为了不鲁莽地减掉长发，又能实现彭丽媛试造型的目的，Win让对方买了一顶跟彭丽媛发质相似的假发，然后根据她的需要剪出了她想要的发型。 彭丽媛收到了剪好的短发，与长发对比了一下，发现发型师Win说的非常正确，还是长发比较适合她。 99年春节前夕，一个音乐颁奖盛典在广州举办，Win负责晚会嘉宾的发型设计，当日彭丽媛也是被邀请的颁奖嘉宾。 Win和彭丽媛终于在活动现场广州中山纪念堂，第一次见面，并愉快地合影留念。 彭丽媛非常喜欢Win的发型设计，并诚邀他参加春晚造型设计。 可是当时在广州同时开了多家发廊的Win实在抽不开身，婉言谢绝了邀请。 于是现在的Win发廊里就有了这张”第一夫人”的照片。 发型师Win与彭丽媛合影 Win从小学四年级开始学国画，原来他一直以为自己的未来应该是与画笔为生。 他从师著名国画家蔡天涛，中学又从师著名西洋画家吴宏树，中学毕业后到专业的美术学校学习。 人生多变，自己的美术训练尽然和形象设计结合起来，一把剪刀让他从一个普通的发型设计人员，成为了全国最顶级发廊的首席设计师。 和几个朋友一起投资了多家顶级发型设计工作室，每天中午起床，忙到每天凌晨，可以说是年轻有为。 就在事业风生水起时，家人都移民海外。 Win面对了新的考验：荣誉，金钱，家庭，身体，他到底需要什么？ Win跟记者说，当时的确挣钱挣得飘飘然，荣誉，金钱都有了，可是过着黑白颠倒的生活。 在他的心中一直觉得身体，家庭是最重要的，于是作出了最后的决定，和家人一起定居凤凰城。 他爱自己的事业，他手中的剪刀在中国为大家剪出了美丽，在海外他相信自己同样可以。 于是他又有了自己的发廊，每周四到凤凰城武术学校教小朋友画画，每周日铁打不动地参加足球队的训练。 在这里他同样用一把剪刀，剪出了自己精彩的人生。
5290478778eaf9f10ad09c264643dac6af3d7a6e.translatedText: Sunbird Chronicle: Win's Life with Scissors (Author: Qingbao) In Chandler's Win hair salon in Phoenix, I found a photo of the owner Win and China's first lady "Peng Liyuan". So I was interested and talked about this experience with Win. In 1999, the well-known singer Peng Liyuan was going to participate in the 1999 Spring Festival Gala. At that time, she had always had long hair that reached past her hips. She wanted to cut her hair short to give the audience a refreshing look. So Peng Liyuan's fashion designer found Win, the former hairstylist of "Hu Si Nen Shang", the most famous hair salon in Guangzhou at the time. At that time, Win and three other hairstylists from "Hu S Nen Shang" had just opened another top hair salon in Guangzhou, "JK". Peng Liyuan's costume designer expressed to Win that Peng Liyuan wanted to change her hairstyle. Win looked at Peng Liyuan's photo and said that according to Peng Liyuan's face shape, she is still suitable for long hair, and for entertainers, long hair is highly malleable and will give appearance designers more creative space. Despite this, Peng Liyuan still refused to give up and insisted on trying to cut her hair short. In order not to lose her long hair recklessly and achieve Peng Liyuan's goal of trying out the style, Win asked the other party to buy a wig with a similar hair texture to Peng Liyuan's, and then cut the hairstyle she wanted according to her needs. Peng Liyuan received the cut short hair and compared it with the long hair. She found that what the hairstylist Win said was very correct. Long hair is more suitable for her. On the eve of the Spring Festival in 1999, a music awards ceremony was held in Guangzhou. Win was responsible for the hair styling of the guests at the party. Peng Liyuan was also an invited award guest that day. Win and Peng Liyuan finally met for the first time at the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall in Guangzhou, where the event was held, and happily took a group photo together. Peng Liyuan liked Win's hair design very much and sincerely invited him to participate in the Spring Festival Gala styling design. But Win, who opened several hair salons in Guangzhou at the time, couldn't get away and politely declined the invitation. So now there is this photo of the "First Lady" in Win Hair Salon. Hairstylist Win took a photo with Peng Liyuan. Win started learning Chinese painting in the fourth grade of primary school. It turned out that he always thought that his future should be to make a living with a paintbrush. He studied under the famous Chinese painter Cai Tiantao, and in middle school he studied under the famous Western painter Wu Hongshu. After graduating from middle school, he studied at a professional art school. Life is full of changes, and his art training was combined with image design. A pair of scissors allowed him to go from an ordinary hairstylist to the chief designer of the top hair salon in the country. Together with a few friends, I invested in a number of top hair design studios. I got up at noon every day and worked until early every morning. It can be said that I am young and promising. Just when his career was booming, his family emigrated overseas. Win faces a new test: honor, money, family, body, what does he need? Win told reporters that at that time, he was indeed making a lot of money, and he had honor and money, but he lived a life of confusion between black and white. In his heart, he always felt that his health and family were the most important, so he made the final decision to settle in Phoenix with his family. He loves his career. The scissors in his hands cut beauty for everyone in China. He believes that he can do the same overseas. So he opened his own hair salon, taught painting to children at the Phoenix Martial Arts School every Thursday, and participated in the football team's training every Sunday. Here he also used a pair of scissors to cut out his wonderful life.

0040790848c2545a9e3a1dd58cddb2aac98847a8.sourceText: 美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）表示，由于CVS Caremark药品连锁店旗下一家公司报错药品价格，导致1.3万Medicare Part D受益人被多收药品费用，FTC将向这些受益人邮寄退款支票。 FTC的监管单位拉斯特谘询公司（Rust Consulting Inc.）本周二（9月4日）开始邮寄支票。这些支票在签发之日起60天内有效，必须在这段时间内兑现。 这些支票将邮寄给为治疗癫痫和乳腺癌症状，以及其它疾病而支付过高药品价格的老年人，支付这些药品价格的结果是导致他们被强迫进入所谓的?#29980;甜圈洞?#65288;donut hole），即政府保险项目中的一条鸿沟，其中的药品费用无法获得报销。 FTC 说，这些老年人根据不正确的药品价格名单选择了他们的处方药计划。CVS 下属的RxAmerica公司递交了不正确的药品价格，很多Medicare Part D受益人根据这些列举的价格选择了他们的药品。在某些情况下，这些药品的价格比RxAmerica提交价格高10倍。 CVS Caremark说，RxAmerica公司意外地在Medicare网站上公布不正确的药品价格信息，但FTC说，不正确信息也被公布在第三方网站上。这些药品在CVS和沃尔戈林（Walgreen）店内出售。 CVS Caremark同意在1月支付500万美元来解决问题。不正确价格被公布的时间是从2007年到至少2008年11月。对这一和解方案有问题的消费者，可拨打FTC免费热线电话1-888-773-8392查询。 CVS Caremark总部位于罗德岛Woonsocket市。他们是全美最大的药品福利管理公司之一，也是最大的药品连锁店之一。
0040790848c2545a9e3a1dd58cddb2aac98847a8.translatedText: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) said that because a company under the CVS Caremark drug chain misreported drug prices, it resulted in 13,000 Medicare Parts. D beneficiaries were overcharged for drugs, and the FTC will mail refund checks to these beneficiaries. Rust Consulting Inc., the regulatory arm of the FTC, began mailing checks on Tuesday (September 4). These checks are valid for 60 days from the date of issue and must be cashed within this time. The checks will be mailed to seniors who pay exorbitant drug prices to treat symptoms of epilepsy and breast cancer, among other illnesses, forcing them into what's known as the donut hole, a gap in government insurance programs in which drug costs are not reimbursed. The FTC said these seniors selected their prescription drug plans based on incorrect drug price lists. RxAmerica, a division of CVS, submitted incorrect drug prices, and many Medicare Part D beneficiaries selected their drugs based on those listed prices. In some cases, the prices for these drugs were 10 times higher than the prices submitted by RxAmerica. CVS Caremark said RxAmerica accidentally posted incorrect drug price information on the Medicare website, but the FTC said the incorrect information was also posted on third-party websites. The drugs are sold in stores at CVS and Walgreens. CVS Caremark agreed to pay $5 million in January to resolve the issues. The incorrect prices were published from 2007 to at least November 2008. Consumers with questions about this settlement can call the FTC’s toll-free hotline at 1-888-773-8392. CVS Caremark is headquartered in Woonsocket, Rhode Island. They are one of the largest pharmacy benefit managers in the United States and one of the largest drugstore chains.

The energy generated by the project can be supplied to 3,300 SPR customers and is estimated to offset 21,000 metric tons of carbon dioxide emissions per year, which is equivalent to removing approximately 4,100 cars from the road. SPR's goal is that solar power generation can meet 20% of electricity demand by 2020. 19 MW can only meet 10% of the electricity demand. SPR is the third largest electric utility company in the United States, with nearly 950,000 electric customers in the greater Phoenix metropolitan area.

936830076c14f317f1a5951e939456f3327b5cc5.sourceText: 扩大留学生OPT实习 议员忧抢本土生工作 最近奥巴马政府将外国学生29个月OPT实习工作计划的适用科系范围扩大，约增加90个新领域。 OPT (Optional Practical Training)工作实习计划允许获得科学、技术、工程和数学领域学位的外国学生，不用工作签证就可以在美国工作29个月。奥巴马政府上个月便开始扩大 实施OPT ，增加了90个合格科系及领域，使得适用领域达到400个，不过当时没有受到关注。 OPT适用科系加入了”计算机与信息科学，其他”(computer and information sciences, other)、”计算机编程，其他”(computer programming, other)等涵盖面大的类别，这些名称可能是跨学科主修的关键词。一些新符合OPT的非IT领域科系包括城市林业、行为科学、永续发展研究及考古学。 经济政策研究中心的移民政策分析师科斯塔表示，他并不太担心合格的科系领域增加。他主要担心这些领域并不是根据劳动力市场短缺而做出的决定，而且OPT实习劳工并没有工资保障，这影 响美国工人的工资。 对OPT扩大实施持批评态度的人士认为，这种做法相当于为增加H-1B签证开后门，而且会让这个后门大敞被滥用。例如，雇用H-1B签证劳工的雇主必须支付市场水平工资，而OPT的雇主则不受制于这些规定。 OPT名单原本就有”计算机编程/程序员，一般”和”计算机科学”。格拉斯利表示，有人会质疑这些新增加的专业是否称得上科学、技术、工程和数学领域，并符合OPT只开放给合格的高技能美国劳工短缺领域的要求。 从2006年至2010年，美国总共批准了43万0515件OPT申请，这个数字包括所有的OPT学生，而不仅是延长至29个月的申请。 另，美国劳工统计局6月1日公布美国今年5月的失业率为8.2%，若以学历背景区分，具大学学历的人口，失业率较4月略降0.1%，来到3.9%；同期高中学历者的失业率则由7.9%略升到8.1%；至于学历在高中以下者，失业率更高。
936830076c14f317f1a5951e939456f3327b5cc5.translatedText: Expanding OPT internships for international students, and lawmakers are worried about competing for jobs for local students. Recently, the Obama administration has expanded the scope of applicable departments for the 29-month OPT internship program for foreign students, adding about 90 new fields. The OPT (Optional Practical Training) work internship program allows foreign students with degrees in science, technology, engineering and mathematics fields to work in the United States for 29 months without a work visa. The Obama administration began to expand the implementation of OPT last month, adding 90 eligible departments and fields, bringing the number of applicable fields to 400, but it did not receive attention at the time. OPT applicable departments have added "computer and information sciences, other" (computer and information sciences, other), "computer programming, other" (computer programming, other) and other broad categories. These names may be keywords for interdisciplinary majors. Some of the new OPT-eligible non-IT fields include urban forestry, behavioral sciences, sustainability studies and archeology. Costa, an immigration policy analyst at the Center for Economic Policy Research, said he is not too worried about the increase in qualifying fields. His main concern is that these areas are not determined based on labor market shortages, and OPT intern workers do not have wage protection, which affects the wages of American workers. Critics of the expanded implementation of OPT believe that this approach is tantamount to opening a backdoor for increasing H-1B visas, and will leave this backdoor wide open for abuse. For example, employers hiring workers on H-1B visas must pay market wages, while employers on OPT are not subject to these regulations. The OPT list originally had "Computer Programming/Programmer, General" and "Computer Science". Grassley said some people will question whether these newly added majors can be called science, technology, engineering and mathematics fields and meet the requirements that OPT is only open to qualified high-skilled U.S. labor shortage fields. From 2006 to 2010, a total of 430,515 OPT applications were approved in the United States. This number includes all OPT students, not just applications extended to 29 months. In addition, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics announced on June 1 that the U.S. unemployment rate in May this year was 8.2%. If differentiated by educational background, the unemployment rate for those with a college degree dropped slightly by 0.1% from April to 3.9%. During the same period, the unemployment rate for those with a high school degree rose slightly from 7.9% to 8.1%. As for those with a high school degree or below, the unemployment rate was even higher.

The selection criteria include the convenience of travel, the value of shopping products, the diversity of shopping types and the urban experience.

413368a132f7697b9897d9c7e0322b317e9d34b0.sourceText: 专家们既注重诸如城市公共交通质素、打折期长短、所售物品种类及城市基础店铺装修等硬件设施，也考虑了服务业水平、居民友善程度、打折优惠期长短和高低市场兼容等软件条件。
413368a132f7697b9897d9c7e0322b317e9d34b0.translatedText: Experts not only focused on hardware facilities such as the quality of urban public transportation, the length of the discount period, the types of goods sold, and the decoration of basic urban stores, but also considered software conditions such as the level of the service industry, the friendliness of residents, the length of the discount period, and the compatibility of high and low markets.

980472b5aebc44e233f778c4459f714636724605.sourceText: ”Globe Shopper Index”的调查数据显示，有76%的游客在消费方面感到满意。但与此同时，香港在”价值”及”多元化”两项指标，分别仅取得5分及6分，”体验”方面则有7分。
980472b5aebc44e233f778c4459f714636724605.translatedText: Survey data from “Globe Shopper Index” shows that 76% of tourists are satisfied with their consumption. 904d5830c0f3395b521938754f287e8909d7eb0f.sourceText: 纽约、东京和伦敦，都在多元化取得10分。CNN推介的香港品牌是Fang Fong Projects，主打旧香港风味的旗袍，及集合各地时装品牌的KniQ。

The Hong Kong brands recommended by CNN are Fang Fong Projects, which specializes in old Hong Kong-style cheongsam, and KniQ, which brings together fashion brands from all over the world.

565666aa8f5584798d153769a4183234012efec2.sourceText: （本网编译）一系列高发的醉酒时间，让全美最大公立大学ASU的形象受损。 上周末警察说一个20岁的ASU学生和伙伴们大量饮用了龙舌兰酒，在急诊室大厅的轮椅上昏厥。据调查，学生在两小时内喝了20个龙舌兰酒，体内的酒精含量达到了0.47%，在亚利桑那州体内酒精达到0.08%就可以被认为是酒后驾驶。 最近是学期末，学生毕业季节，所以醉酒时间频发。校方已经通过各种渠道通知学生，需要冷静，防范校外聚会的不安全情况的发生。 这也提醒在ASU学习的中国留学生，最近晚上少单独出门，注意驾驶车辆，防止他人不正确的驾驶行为，造成的伤害。
565666aa8f5584798d153769a4183234012efec2.translatedText: (Compiled by this website) A series of frequent drunken hours have damaged the image of ASU, the largest public university in the United States. Over the weekend, police said a 20-year-old ASU student drank so much tequila with his friends that he passed out in a wheelchair in the emergency room lobby. According to the investigation, the student drank 20 tequila shots within two hours, and the alcohol content in his body reached 0.47%. In Arizona, an alcohol content of 0.08% in the body can be considered drunk driving. It's the end of the semester and the graduation season, so drunken moments are frequent. The school has informed students through various channels that they need to calm down and prevent unsafe situations at off-campus gatherings. This also reminds Chinese students studying at ASU to avoid going out alone at night recently and to drive carefully to prevent injuries caused by incorrect driving behavior of others.

d40998c584df149dbeedd6ddb15397c950c5c9e9.translatedText: Can China still have the dream of reviving the civilization of rituals and music? Before giving a speech, the reporter briefly interviewed Teacher Yin Hui.

f24ce721f63c482a8628a4cb683394fe76f844ed.sourceText: 殷慧，历史学博士，湖南大学岳麓书院副教授，亚利桑那州立大学访问学者。主要研究方向是宋代思想史。已发表《朱熹礼学思想研究》相关论文20余篇。目前主持国家社科基金1项《宋代礼学与理学研究》、省部级课题3项。
f24ce721f63c482a8628a4cb683394fe76f844ed.translatedText: Yin Hui, Ph.D. in history, associate professor at Yuelu Academy of Hunan University, visiting scholar at Arizona State University. The main research direction is the intellectual history of the Song Dynasty. He has published more than 20 papers related to "Research on Zhu Xi's Ritual Thoughts". Currently, he is in charge of 1 National Social Science Fund project "Research on Rites and Neo-Confucianism in the Song Dynasty" and 3 provincial and ministerial level projects.

c6235ac75795a0c2e718f504166e9a5687e67e49.sourceText: 殷慧老师说礼乐文明是中华文化的核心。在国学兴起的中华大地上，现代人对”礼乐文明”形成，和发展倍受关注。
c6235ac75795a0c2e718f504166e9a5687e67e49.translatedText: >Teacher Yin Hui said that the civilization of ritual and music is the core of Chinese culture. In the land of China where Chinese studies have emerged, modern people have paid close attention to the formation and development of "ritual and music civilization".

4a21eadae982a3a8f39a16b7d284ad5df6eb8745.sourceText: 中国自古以来就号称”礼义之邦”其礼乐文明的理想贯穿思想、社会、政治、教育等各个层面”礼义之邦”并非是”礼仪之邦”重要原因在于，中国古代传统政治思想有一条鲜明的主线，即以强化礼仪、礼制作为支撑，通过以礼为治、为学、为教来贯穿整个国家政治、社会以及个人。殷老师将在演讲中介绍礼乐文明的概念，发展，以及近现代的遭遇。现代的中国，从政府，文化界学者，甚至普通老百姓的生活受礼乐文化的影响非常深远。很多含有礼乐文明因素的活动，在国内日渐兴起！例如，2007年曲阜举办了盛大的”祭孔大典”，官方，民间以最神圣庄严的形式，来祭奠孔子这位礼义文明始祖。这活动成为当地外交一个文化符号，受到世界瞩目。中国学校课堂开设国学课，青少年18岁接受成年礼，甚至有文化学者将自己孩子的婚礼也加入国学礼仪，既普及了国学文化，又将婚礼办得独具一格。对礼乐文明的追捧，不仅在中国，更在世界兴起，那么”中国还能复兴礼乐文明的梦想吗?”我们一起来倾听，一起来探讨。11月15日下午4:30分 LL room 60 ASU Tempe 校区，不见不散！
4a21eadae982a3a8f39a16b7d284ad5df6eb8745.translatedText: China has been known as the "Land of Rites and Righteousness" since ancient times, and its ideals of ritual, music and civilization run through all levels of thought, society, politics, education, etc. The important reason why the "Land of Rites and Righteousness" is not a "state of etiquette" is that there is a distinct main line of ancient Chinese traditional political thought, which is supported by strengthening etiquette and etiquette, and through using etiquette for governance, learning, and teaching, it runs through the entire country's politics, society, and individuals. Teacher Yin will introduce the concept, development, and modern encounters of ritual and music civilization in his speech. In modern China, the government, cultural scholars, and even the lives of ordinary people have been deeply influenced by the culture of ritual and music. Many activities containing ritual, music and civilized elements are becoming increasingly popular in the country! For example, in 2007, Qufu held a grand "Confucian Memorial Ceremony". Officials and private citizens used the most sacred and solemn form to pay homage to Confucius, the founder of etiquette and justice civilization. This event became a cultural symbol of local diplomacy and attracted worldwide attention. Chinese school classes offer Chinese studies classes, and teenagers receive coming-of-age ceremonies at the age of 18. Some cultural scholars even include Chinese studies etiquette in their children’s weddings, which not only popularizes Chinese studies culture, but also makes weddings unique. The pursuit of ritual and music civilization is not only rising in China, but also in the world. So "Can China still revive the dream of ritual and music civilization?" Let's listen and discuss together. November 15th at 4:30 pm LL room 60 ASU Tempe campus, see you there!

c9fc2c24afa3df1ed5897a48e71e8cb6395aac45.sourceText: 学生抗议ASU禁烟令 在马里科巴郡社区学院委员会今年7月1日实行在校园禁烟后，亚利桑那州立大学教职员委员会九月也通过决议，宣布在其所有州立大学自有的校园及其租用设施内禁烟，2013年8月1日起实行。 不少学生ASU这项禁令不以为然，一个由学生领导的团体于上周三在坦佩校园发起抗议运动。 ”校方给出的信息不是在保护学生，而是保护他们自己，”卡洛斯阿尔法罗，主修经济和美国历史的大四学生说。”我们是成年人，我们有选择的自由。比如我们知道吃垃圾食品不好，但政府不能强迫人们不吃，这是我们自己的选择。” 除了亚利桑那州立大学，全国有600多所高校已承诺建立无烟校园。
c9fc2c24afa3df1ed5897a48e71e8cb6395aac45.translatedText: Students Protest ASU Smoking Ban After the Maricopa County Community College Board implemented a ban on smoking on campus on July 1 this year, the Arizona State University Faculty Senate also passed a resolution in September declaring that smoking will be banned on all state university-owned campuses and leased facilities, effective August 1, 2013. Many students at ASU disagreed with the ban, and a student-led group launched a protest movement on the Tempe campus last Wednesday. “The message the school is giving is not to protect students, but to protect themselves,” said Carlos Alfaro, a senior majoring in economics and U.S. history. "We are adults and we have the freedom to choose. For example, we know that eating junk food is not good, but the government cannot force people not to eat it. This is our own choice." In addition to Arizona State University, more than 600 colleges and universities across the country have pledged to establish smoke-free campuses.

dd65620aaf29fd936ab67f210dfa999d4627aa6e.translatedText: ASU will set up free non-credit courses

48f1e57964727a44edadc85e6ec087ac57214f05.sourceText: ASU将设免费无学分课程 哈佛开了，斯坦福和杜克也开了，本州的ASU和SCC终于也从善如流棗开设免费无学分…
48f1e57964727a44edadc85e6ec087ac57214f05.translatedText: ASU will set up free no-credit courses. Harvard has opened it, Stanford and Duke have also opened it, and the state's ASU and SCC have finally followed suit by offering free, no-credit courses...

266fea649973bb9bd29feb28090b400d6f27f56b.sourceText: 哈佛开了，斯坦福和杜克也开了，本州的 ASU 和 SCC 终于也从善如流棗开设免费无学分的在线课程。
266fea649973bb9bd29feb28090b400d6f27f56b.translatedText: > Harvard has opened it, Stanford and Duke have also opened it, and the state's ASU and SCC have finally followed suit by offering free, no-credit courses.

eb928382a349ef39353340ffa413c0b0a914a12a.sourceText: 近年，大规模开放式在线课程获得很多关注，全国有二十多个高校开设了免费在线课程，主要面向成人再教育。私人公司也看中这个平台，希望分一杯羹。人们如今可以在网上选项数十个免费课程，从代数到天文，金融统计等。哈佛大学有个计算机科学课程，斯坦福有个算法设计课程，这些课程通常只需几个星期可完成。
eb928382a349ef39353340ffa413c0b0a914a12a.translatedText: In recent years, massive open online courses have received a lot of attention. More than 20 universities across the country have opened free online courses, mainly for adult re-education. Private companies are also interested in this platform and hope to get a piece of the pie. People can now choose from dozens of free courses online, ranging from algebra to astronomy to financial statistics. Harvard has a computer science course and Stanford has an algorithm design course, and these courses usually only take a few weeks to complete.

e810f964bca5b5fbfe509e5b8bae4c3decbde13c.sourceText: 斯科斯岱尔社区学院（ SCC ），马利科巴郡社区学院之一，将于明年 2 月开始，在网上开设基础数学课程。 ASU 的免费在线课程原定在 8 月推出，虽因种种原因推迟，但也势在必行。
e810f964bca5b5fbfe509e5b8bae4c3decbde13c.translatedText: Scorsdale Community College (SCC), one of Maricopa County’s community colleges, will offer basic math courses online starting next February. ASU's free online courses were originally scheduled to launch in August. Although they have been delayed for various reasons, they are inevitable.

fe8155e8f832feae046ac53bedab075522a72c34.sourceText: 本州其他高校， UA 在 iTunes 上提供一些课程， NAU 和 UA 管理层尚未决定什么时候开始免费在线课程。
fe8155e8f832feae046ac53bedab075522a72c34.translatedText: Other colleges and universities in the state, UA offers some courses on iTunes, NAU and UA administration have not decided when to start free online courses.

ca931d809fd1c880431e090200d3a2a196e3f335.sourceText: 有专家预测，免费无学分的在线课程会越来越流行。当然，也有些高校对这种时髦无兴趣，如南加州大学。
ca931d809fd1c880431e090200d3a2a196e3f335.translatedText: Some experts predict that free, non-credit online courses will become more and more popular. Of course, there are some colleges and universities that are not interested in this trend, such as the University of Southern California.

60b82b0f2dcb881308e36476bc99a58f256c05c0.sourceText: 南开大学中文系孙昌武教授在ASU孔子学院精彩讲座
60b82b0f2dcb881308e36476bc99a58f256c05c0.translatedText: Professor Sun Changwu from the Chinese Department of Nankai University gave a wonderful lecture at the ASU Confucius Institute

4e0cd5ce29cc38f08d542dddef75d944a00faf9e.sourceText: 南开大学中文系孙昌武教授在ASU孔子学院精彩讲座 –佛教对中国文化的贡…
4e0cd5ce29cc38f08d542dddef75d944a00faf9e.translatedText: Professor Sun Changwu from the Chinese Department of Nankai University gave a wonderful lecture at the ASU Confucius Institute – Buddhism’s contribution to Chinese culture…

ddbc0ef6b31a65cb575b78d14d3bb58e0579664a.sourceText: –佛教对中国文化的贡献 2013年10月17日下午4点半，由亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院和国际语言与文学院共同组织，孙昌武教授在文学与语言大楼60多功能会议教室为60多名学者、硕博研究生，本科生以及文史爱好者带来了一场题为”佛教对中国文化的贡献”精彩专题讲座。亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院院长、中文系教授司马德琳博士出席并主持了本场讲座。
ddbc0ef6b31a65cb575b78d14d3bb58e0579664a.translatedText: – Buddhism’s contribution to Chinese culture At 4:30 pm on October 17, 2013, Professor Sun Changwu, co-organized by the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University and the International School of Languages and Literatures, gave an exciting special lecture entitled "The Contribution of Buddhism to Chinese Culture" to more than 60 scholars, master's and doctoral students, undergraduates, and literature and history enthusiasts in the 60-functional conference room of the Literature and Languages Building. Dr. Sima Delin, director of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University and professor of the Department of Chinese, attended and hosted this lecture.

963329bfbaf795bb1f8b8059a578452c1321e1aa.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院院长司马德琳教授
963329bfbaf795bb1f8b8059a578452c1321e1aa.translatedText: >Professor Sima Delin, Director of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University

8bad0f9b1a4b61bfd6ee5fe745c9edb7e227a48c.sourceText: 孙昌武教授现为中国南开大学文学教授，中国社会科学院宗教研究中心特约研究员、中国唐代文学学会理事、中国古代散文学会副会长、中国韩愈研究会副会长、中国柳宗元研究会副会长等。曾任日本神户大学、韩国岭南大学、香港中文大学客座教授，日本京都大学人文科学研究所外国人研究员。长期从事隋唐五代文学和中国佛教文化教学和研究。著有《柳宗元传论》、《唐代古文运动通论》、《佛教与中国文学》《中国佛教文化史》（5卷）等,并整理点校古籍和译介外国学者论著多种。
8bad0f9b1a4b61bfd6ee5fe745c9edb7e227a48c.translatedText: Professor Sun Changwu is currently a professor of literature at Nankai University in China, a special researcher at the Religious Research Center of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, a director of the Chinese Tang Dynasty Literature Society, the vice president of the Ancient Chinese Prose Society, the vice president of the Chinese Han Yu Research Association, the vice president of the Chinese Liu Zongyuan Research Association, etc. He has served as a visiting professor at Kobe University in Japan, Lingnan University in South Korea, and the Chinese University of Hong Kong, and as a foreign researcher at the Institute of Humanities at Kyoto University in Japan. He has long been engaged in the teaching and research of Sui, Tang, Five Dynasties literature and Chinese Buddhist culture. He is the author of "The Biography of Liu Zongyuan", "General Theory of the Classical Prose Movement in the Tang Dynasty", "Buddhism and Chinese Literature", "History of Chinese Buddhist Culture" (5 volumes), etc. He also collated ancient books and translated and introduced various works by foreign scholars.

8bb509be70f717b15d8bedea520b7096d776cbbe.sourceText: 讲座中，孙昌武教授首先简单介绍了佛教，深入浅出地阐释什么是佛教？佛是什么人？如何修佛？以及佛教是怎样传入中国的？ 等研究佛教的基本问题。在谈到修佛的时候，他说道， 四谛是苦、集、灭、道四条人生真理。人生的本质是苦的，所以修佛就是要知苦、断集、证灭以及修道。 接着，孙教授重点讲述了佛教对中国文化的影响。他将之总结成6个小点，分别为：佛教向中国输入了新的社会组织，僧团；佛教向中国输入了新的信仰；佛教给中国思想提供了丰富的理论资源；佛教对中国伦理的影响；佛教丰富了中国的文学艺术；以及佛教对民族性的影响。在说到佛教向中国输入新的信仰的时候，孙教授举了观世音菩萨救八苦的例子，由此，他认为，信仰的意义不在于能否实现，能否真的。在于给予人生希望，鼓励人在困难中坚持下去。引发了全场听众的深思。
8bb509be70f717b15d8bedea520b7096d776cbbe.translatedText: In the lecture, Professor Sun Changwu first briefly introduced Buddhism and explained in a simple and profound way what is Buddhism? Who is Buddha? How to practice Buddhism? And how was Buddhism introduced to China? etc. to study basic issues of Buddhism. When talking about practicing Buddhism, he said that the Four Noble Truths are the four truths of life: suffering, cessation, cessation, and the path. The essence of life is suffering, so practicing Buddhism means understanding suffering, eliminating its origin, realizing its cessation, and cultivating the Tao. Then, Professor Sun focused on the impact of Buddhism on Chinese culture. He summarized it into six small points, namely: Buddhism imported new social organizations and monastic orders to China; Buddhism imported new beliefs to China; Buddhism provided rich theoretical resources to Chinese thought; Buddhism influenced Chinese ethics; Buddhism enriched Chinese literature and art; and Buddhism influenced national character. When talking about Buddhism importing new beliefs into China, Professor Sun gave the example of Guanyin Bodhisattva saving eight sufferings. From this, he believed that the significance of belief does not lie in whether it can be realized or whether it is true. It is to give hope in life and encourage people to persevere in difficulties. It aroused deep thought in the audience.

83ddcba4336805bdae53be84eec85485c00f40cb.sourceText: 最后，孙教授讲述了一下我们应该对佛教和佛教文化所持的态度。他认为，我们因该对佛教表示同情和理解。并且应当从道德、伦理方面吸收宗教优秀的东西。由于佛教对中国思想，伦理，文化，文学艺术的巨大影响，做中国学问的人也要关注佛教。
83ddcba4336805bdae53be84eec85485c00f40cb.translatedText: Finally, Professor Sun talked about the attitude we should have towards Buddhism and Buddhist culture. He believes that we should express sympathy and understanding for Buddhism. And we should absorb the excellent things of religion from the moral and ethical aspects. Due to the huge influence of Buddhism on Chinese thought, ethics, culture, literature and art, people who are engaged in Chinese studies should also pay attention to Buddhism.

e29c947db8316c4a09bc524a60d71bb499c038a4.sourceText: 孙昌武教授回答大家的提问
e29c947db8316c4a09bc524a60d71bb499c038a4.translatedText: Professor Sun Changwu answered everyone’s questions

25a70000113953b8b273632b13d3ab8ac4956813.sourceText: 在提问环节，大家踊跃地把握这个难得的机会，纷纷向孙教授提出他们对佛教的思索以及对本次讲座的感想。来自社区的一位先生向孙教授请教了神秀禅师”心为明镜台”的有关问题。来自亚利桑那州立大学中文系的同学针对”佛教给予中国社会平等观念”这一说法和孙教授进行了探讨；另一位来自历史宗教系的同学则和孙教授讨论了佛教如何影响新儒学的形成。孙教授细致而耐心地回答了所有提问，并建议大家若有兴趣进一步研究中国的佛教，可以参考一下他的两本著作，分别为《禅思与诗情》和《中国佛教文化史》（5卷）。亚利桑那州立大学图书馆亦藏有孙昌武教授的大部分著作。
25a70000113953b8b273632b13d3ab8ac4956813.translatedText: During the question and answer session, everyone eagerly seized this rare opportunity and asked Professor Sun their thoughts on Buddhism and their thoughts on this lecture. A gentleman from the community asked Professor Sun about Zen Master Shenxiu's "Heart as a Mirror". A student from the Chinese Department of Arizona State University discussed with Professor Sun the statement that "Buddhism gives Chinese society the concept of equality"; another student from the Department of History and Religion discussed with Professor Sun how Buddhism affects the formation of New Confucianism. Professor Sun answered all questions carefully and patiently, and suggested that if you are interested in further studying Buddhism in China, you can refer to his two books, namely "Meditation and Poetry" and "History of Chinese Buddhist Culture" (5 volumes). The Arizona State University Library also contains most of Professor Sun Changwu's works.

f13fc8f8d3623488a0c90efd0bb9806e21741e44.sourceText: 讲座后，孔子学院组织了一场小型的招待会，从而使得听众们能够更加直接地和孙昌武教授进行交流。在招待会上，大家一边享用着丰盛美味的食物，一边围着孙教授继续探讨佛教和文学的各种联系与影响。孙教授的旁征博引、妙语连珠不时引得阵阵掌声和会心的笑声，为这场学术讲座划上了圆满的句号。
f13fc8f8d3623488a0c90efd0bb9806e21741e44.translatedText: After the lecture, the Confucius Institute organized a small reception, allowing the audience to communicate more directly with Professor Sun Changwu. At the reception, while enjoying sumptuous and delicious food, everyone gathered around Professor Sun and continued to discuss the various connections and influences between Buddhism and literature. Professor Sun's eloquent quotes and witty remarks occasionally attracted bursts of applause and knowing laughter, bringing this academic lecture to a successful conclusion.

33329d41492a8643b2f28e702946bffef85a73c4.sourceText: 北美地区百龄薪传圣火万里活动圆满完成 传递者抵洛 美西侨报 北美地区百龄薪传圣火万里绕境专车经过数百大小城市，历时31天后于11日返回出发地洛侨中心，驻洛杉矶台北经文处处长龚中诚出席欢迎归来仪式。 陈侨治是加州台湾同乡联谊会会长，章顺滔，万培杰分别是纽约和凤凰城台湾同乡联谊会成员。三人驾驶陈侨治用3万多元购买的RV，5月12日自洛侨中心出发，途径美南，美东及美中，行驶1万1650哩，耗油2268.7加仑，每天三人轮流开车。他们在美国绕境已达1万1千英哩，远超出他们所预计的1万英哩，途经美南，美东，美中，美西25座城市，路途中遭遇加拿大海关阻挠，未准入境加拿大，汽车机械故障延误程期，大风雨的吹袭但仍坚持前进，最终排除万难费时26天终于按照预定时间抵达西雅图，期间所经城市都受侨团热烈欢迎，深感中华民国深入侨心，另沿途也散发由外交部，侨委会及观光局所提供之介绍中华民国及各地旅游的文宣折页予主流社会人士，推广台湾形象。陈侨治表示，途径新泽西时，当地一位汪姓侨民，在家中布置装饰庆祝台湾100年，还在庭院竖起旗杆，升旗，欢迎三人到来，让陈侨治非常感动。龚中诚表示，百年薪传是壮举，传递的是一种精神。 圣火传递活动到达美东地区 西雅图地区迎接圣火的华人
33329d41492a8643b2f28e702946bffef85a73c4.translatedText: The 100-year-old torch relay event in North America was successfully completed and the bearer arrived in Los Angeles. Overseas Chinese News in North America. The 100-year-old torch relay in North America passed through hundreds of cities and returned to the Luo overseas Chinese center on the 11th after 31 days. Director of the Taipei Cultural Office in Los Angeles, Gong Zhongcheng, attended the welcome ceremony. Chen Qiaozhi is the president of the California Taiwanese Association, and Zhang Shuntao and Wan Peijie are members of the New York and Phoenix Taiwanese Associations respectively. The three people drove the RV purchased by Chen Qiaozhi for more than 30,000 yuan. They set off from the Luoqiao Center on May 12 and traveled through the southern, eastern and central United States, driving 11,650 miles and consuming 2,268.7 gallons of fuel. The three of them took turns driving every day. They have traveled 11,000 miles around the U.S., far exceeding the 10,000 miles they expected. They passed through 25 cities in the South, East, Central, and West Americas. They were blocked by Canadian customs on the way and were not allowed to enter Canada. There were mechanical problems in their cars that delayed the process, and strong winds and rains hit them. But they still persisted in moving forward. After a difficult 26 days, we finally arrived in Seattle as scheduled. During the period, the cities we passed were warmly welcomed by the overseas Chinese groups, and we were deeply impressed by the deep roots of the Republic of China in the hearts of overseas Chinese. Along the way, we also distributed brochures introducing the Republic of China and tourism in various places provided by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council and the Tourism Bureau to mainstream people in society to promote the image of Taiwan. Chen Qiaozhi said that when passing through New Jersey, a local expatriate named Wang decorated his home to celebrate Taiwan's 100th anniversary. He also erected a flagpole in the courtyard and raised the flag to welcome the three people. Chen Qiaozhi was very moved. Gong Zhongcheng said that passing on a century-old legacy is a feat that conveys a spirit. The torch relay arrives in the eastern United States. Chinese people in the Seattle area welcome the torch
