b3e2884c284b6649abb4295cb0c9a27935ba76d2.sourceText: 美国经济低迷，许多年轻女性因此暂离职场，重返校园接受更高教育。 经济学家预测，长此以往，下一代女性的发展将远优于男性。 纽约时报报导，美国劳动力呈现萎缩，经济学家以为多半是年纪较大的职工因心灰意冷退出就业市场，研究后发现许多暂离职场的人是年轻人，且女性居多，以致于出现卅 年来仅见的现象──全美在校女性人数高于在职女性。 在近20岁或20岁出头的女性把经济不景气视为自我提升技能机会时，许多年轻男性则因工作不好找，有什么做什么。 经济学家说，结果是下一代女性的就业优势，将远大于男性。 今年秋天，24岁的萝拉‧贝克成为丹佛大学策略沟通硕士班的学生。 她在「星巴克咖啡」兼差一年半，不想继续打零工，于是重回校园。 她说：「班上几乎清一色是女性。可能与课程性质有关，但也是因为女性认为必须接受更高教育，才能在所有领域与男性一较长短。」 女性薪资仍远低于男性。 美国官方宣布景气复苏两年半来，16到24岁男性有17万8000人找到工作机会，同龄的女性却有25万5000人失业。 显然是对就业机会低感到失望，两年半来，41万2000名年轻女性完全退出劳工市场。 研究显示，女性选择工作时较男性挑剔。 薪资已较低的女性，一旦又被减薪，工作意愿更低，尤其有丈夫可依靠的女性。 堪萨斯市联邦准备银行经济学家威利斯说：「工作再不好，无论理由为何，男性都较愿意屈就。」 美国社区大学的入学率不断创新纪录。 男女均有重返校园的趋势，不过，女性人数多出许多。 两年半来，18到24岁女性增加13万人，反观年轻男性只新增5万3000人。 除了教育差距，未来十年，女性就业优势高于男性另一原因，是许多具有高成长远景的职业，如家庭健康助理与牙齿卫生员，传统上是女性职业。 反观男性居多的 制造业以及与体力有关的一些行业的就业机会，未来普遍看跌。
b3e2884c284b6649abb4295cb0c9a27935ba76d2.translatedText: The U.S. economy is in a slump, so many young women have taken a break from the workplace and returned to school to receive higher education. Economists predict that in the long run, the next generation of women will fare far better than men. The New York Times reported that the U.S. labor force is shrinking, and economists believe that it is mostly older workers who are withdrawing from the job market due to frustration. Research has found that many of the people who have temporarily left the workplace are young people, and the majority of them are women. As a result, a phenomenon that has only been seen in 30 years has emerged - there are more women in school than working women in the United States. While women in their late 20s or early 20s see the economic downturn as an opportunity to improve their skills, many young men are struggling to find jobs and have nothing to do. Economists say the result is that the next generation of women will have a far greater employment advantage than men. This fall, 24-year-old Laura Baker became a student in the Master of Strategic Communication class at the University of Denver. She worked part-time at Starbucks Coffee for a year and a half. She didn't want to continue working part-time, so she returned to school. "The class is almost exclusively female," she said. "It may have something to do with the nature of the courses, but it's also because women believe they must receive higher education in order to compete with men in all areas." Women's salaries are still much lower than men's. In the two and a half years since the U.S. officially announced economic recovery, 178,000 men aged 16 to 24 have found job opportunities, while 255,000 women of the same age have lost their jobs. Apparently frustrated by low employment opportunities, 412,000 young women have dropped out of the labor market entirely in the past two and a half years. Research shows that women are more selective than men when choosing a job. Women who already have lower wages will be less willing to work once their wages are cut again, especially those who have husbands to rely on. Willis, an economist at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, said: "No matter how bad the job is, men are more willing to give in no matter the reason." U.S. community college enrollment continues to hit records. Both men and women are returning to school, but women are far more likely to do so. In the past two and a half years, the number of women aged 18 to 24 has increased by 130,000, while the number of young men has only increased by 53,000. In addition to the education gap, another reason why women will have a higher employment advantage than men in the next ten years is that many occupations with high growth prospects, such as home health aides and dental hygienists, are traditionally female occupations. On the other hand, employment opportunities in manufacturing and some industries related to physical strength, where men are mostly male, are generally bearish in the future.

4c4a8002a1989881f822bda362e87690b4ab38ae.sourceText: 非法移民数量下降 关系紧张照旧 （亚省时报） 据各市警察局长说，当地犯罪率较低并继续下降，同非法移民相关的犯罪和开支也在减少。 在上星期二和星期三凤凰城举行的边境安全展上，联邦官员同各州及地方警察局官员举行会议。他们大都认为，被抓获的偷渡移民数量从2005年高峰期的110万下降到2011年34万，减轻了警方的负担，但也引起犯罪方面令人担忧的变化。 尽管他们说没有再看到大批非法移民涌入美国抢夺低工资的工作，但联邦和地方执法官员说他们现在被迫面对更加顽固和可能更加威胁的偷渡者，包括携带走私毒品的移民。 联邦官员通过统计数字和图表指出，过去5年来随着边境力量加强，非法入境数量大幅下降。但地方执法官员看法不同，尤其是顺着国界沙漠地区巡逻的各郡警察局长。 东南靠近墨西哥的科柴斯郡警察局副局长洛斯洛克说，”我们在农村县看到很多牧场家庭、很多人每天都生活中恐惧中。” 在这次展览上，几十家技术公司提供最新式准军事工具，帮助加强边境安全。大小承包商提供可以看穿墙壁的雷达、安装在巡逻车高杆上的热敏摄像机，它们也可以在不适宜人类航行的水面安装在无人驾驶的巡逻船上。 但是布鲁尔州长星期二的开幕讲话就同联邦官员对峙。她声称联邦边境执法令人愤怒。”任何扭曲都不能掩盖绝对真相。多年来华盛顿袖手旁观，让边境漏洞更多、更加危险。” 作为回应，海关和边境保护局前高级官员阿赫恩说，布鲁尔的说法是”非常个人化的意见”。由于很多联邦官员仍然在职，说话不那么直截了当。而阿赫恩说，边境安全已经有了巨大改进。他说，边境巡逻人员已经扩张到2.1万人，为历史最高水平；包括远程录像监视系统和七架无人驾驶飞机在内的一系列新技术正在采用。 负责亚利桑那州移民和海关执法调查的联邦特工阿伦说，去年凤凰城51个中转房被搜查，而2008年联邦特工突袭搜查的中转房高达181个。他说，2011年的突袭活动中共有800名非法移民被逮捕，而在2008年3200名非法移民被逮捕。 美萨警察局长密尔斯泰德说，当地犯罪率下降到1960年代以来的最低水平。他说，去年梅萨地区1.79万人被逮捕，只有2%为非法移民嫌疑。那对该局监狱的影响已经下降到最低程度。 但科柴斯县警察局副局长洛斯洛克也承认新现实：2010年，超过300名偷渡客都是要到美国参与犯罪活动。他说，该县警察正在面临不同的非法移民：以个人或小团体出现、携带大麻或其它毒品偷渡。那些偷渡者大都是要把毒品交给中转人，然后很快回到墨西哥。 最繁忙的非法移民入口城市诺加拉斯警察局长科克哈姆说，该市犯罪率非常低，过去7年来只有两起凶杀案。但是，最近一名高中生被捕令他震惊，那名年轻人携带将近4磅海洛因，背包里有8万美元现金。 联邦调查人员也报告，非法移民对边境特工的攻击令人震惊。联邦调查局负责亚利桑那州的特工特加尔说，该局去年立案调查亚利桑那州将近500起特工受攻击案–从扔石头到开枪射击。那一数字相当于2008年117起的4倍多。
4c4a8002a1989881f822bda362e87690b4ab38ae.translatedText: Number of illegal immigrants drops, tensions remain (Alberta Times) According to municipal police chiefs, local crime rates are low and continue to decline, and crimes and expenses related to illegal immigrants are also decreasing. Federal officials held meetings with state and local police officers at the Border Security Show in Phoenix last Tuesday and Wednesday. Most of them believe that the number of immigrants caught smuggling has dropped from a peak of 1.1 million in 2005 to 340,000 in 2011, which has reduced the burden on the police, but has also caused worrying changes in crime. While they say they are no longer seeing large numbers of illegal immigrants flooding into the U.S. to compete for low-wage jobs, federal and local law enforcement officials say they are now forced to confront more persistent and potentially more threatening smugglers, including those carrying smuggled drugs. Federal officials point out through statistics and charts that illegal immigration has dropped significantly over the past five years as border strength has been strengthened. But local law enforcement officials, especially county police chiefs who patrol desert areas along the border, see things differently. "We see a lot of ranching families in rural counties, a lot of people living in fear every day," said Los Roque, deputy police chief of Cochise County in the southeast near Mexico. At this exhibition, dozens of technology companies provided the latest paramilitary tools to help strengthen border security. Contractors large and small provide radar that can see through walls, thermal cameras mounted on high poles on patrol cars, and they can be installed on unmanned patrol boats in waters unfit for human navigation. But Governor Brewer's opening remarks Tuesday pitted him against federal officials. She claims federal border enforcement is outrageous. "No distortion can obscure the absolute truth. For years, Washington stood idly by and allowed the border to become more porous and more dangerous." In response, Ahern, a former senior Customs and Border Protection official, said Brewer's statement was a "very personal opinion." With many federal officials still on the job, the rhetoric was less direct. And Aherne said border security has improved dramatically. He said the Border Patrol has expanded to 21,000 personnel, an all-time high, and a series of new technologies are being adopted, including a remote video surveillance system and seven drones. Allen, the federal agent in charge of Immigration and Customs Enforcement investigations in Arizona, said 51 halfway houses were raided in Phoenix last year, and federal agents raided 181 halfway houses in 2008. He said a total of 800 illegal immigrants were arrested in raids in 2011, while in 2008 3,200 illegal immigrants were arrested. Mesa Police Chief Milstead said the local crime rate has dropped to its lowest level since the 1960s. He said that of the 17,900 arrests in the Mesa area last year, only 2% were suspected of illegal immigrants. That impact on the department's prisons has been minimized. But Los Rock, deputy chief of the Cochise County Police Department, also admitted the new reality: In 2010, more than 300 illegal immigrants wanted to go to the United States to participate in criminal activities. He said police in the county are facing different types of illegal immigrants: appearing as individuals or in small groups, and smuggling in marijuana or other drugs. Most of the smugglers want to hand over the drugs to the transit person and then return to Mexico quickly. Coker Ham, the police chief of Nogalas, the busiest city for illegal immigration, said the city's crime rate is very low, with only two homicides in the past seven years. But he was shocked when a high school student was recently arrested with nearly 4 pounds of heroin and $80,000 in cash in his backpack. Federal investigators have also reported alarming attacks on border agents by illegal immigrants. Tegall, the FBI's special agent in charge in Arizona, said the bureau opened nearly 500 investigations into attacks on agents in Arizona last year - from rocks thrown to shootings. That number is more than four times the 117 cases in 2008.

cd31bac2fb9c1e5c6a5e5cecd5e8123e51dd4034.sourceText: 指着鼻子与总统说事 州长毁誉参半 （亚省时报） 布鲁尔州长自从1月25日在机场指着奥巴马总统的鼻子说事后，照片迅速登上各大媒体的头条，她也成了全球头条。尽管州长和白宫事后就此事发表过评论，说事实不是大家所看的那么简单，人们之至今对此念念不忘。 州长办公室发言人说，州长为此事收到近12000封电子邮件，有批评也有赞扬的。支持者说州长不畏强权，反对者则称布鲁尔没礼貌。有人说：”你欠奥巴马总统，亚利桑那州公民以及整个美国，乃至世界一个道歉。”
cd31bac2fb9c1e5c6a5e5cecd5e8123e51dd4034.translatedText: Governor Brewer pointed at President Obama's nose at the airport on January 25, and the photo quickly made headlines in major media, and she also became global headlines. Although the governor and the White House later commented on the matter, saying that the truth is not as simple as everyone seems, people still remember it. A spokesman for the governor's office said the governor received nearly 12,000 emails on the matter, ranging from criticism to praise. Supporters say the governor is unafraid of power, while opponents say Brewer is disrespectful. Someone said: "You owe President Obama, the citizens of Arizona, the entire United States, and the world an apology."

b026cde9340f2ca3c38409a55d1a09755fdf3995.sourceText: 凤凰城气如虹：洛矶山漫游之五-希望见黄金 旅行进入第四天，这天早上把所有行李搬上车，离开温哥华海岸旅馆，启程前往洛矶山脉。导游老谢告知，今日的乘车行驶路程最长久，总共要花费九小时，先抵达希望镇参观，晚上留宿黄金镇。 好兆头！充满希望，又见黄金，沿途观望，有崇山峻岭，白雪皑皑，有海河湖泊，波光粼粼，让我想起清人李文甫的绝妙对联：「绿水本无忧，因风皱面.；青山原不老，为雪白头。」人生何尝不是这样，社会的环境影响到自己，甚至改变了人生。 「人在江湖，身不由己」，像我这一代的越南华人，全部都被越战局势改变个人预期的前途。 路程遥远，车上没有伴唱机设备，只有放电影，导游怕大家纳闷，提议举办自我介绍活动，希望来自各方的游客能互相沟通，增进友谊，不是个别讲述，而是依照登记参加的组合，举派一个成员行到车厢前座，拿着传声器发表，导游作语言翻译。他以身作则，首先自我介绍是来自台湾，定居加州，替黄金假期作导游，主要负责加拿大旅程，五六月间来此服务，这团是今年最后一团，结束后飞回洛杉矶与家人团聚。 跟着依照座位前后轮流发言，如台湾六人组则由一位女士代表，三位移民新泽西州的上海耆老，也由一位老婆婆讲述，两对越南夫妇是休士顿与橙县的组合，也是由越妇以英语陈词，看来这旅行团女人比男人强势得多。我夫妻档当然是由我开腔，另外一对也是来自台湾的蓝氏夫妇，以及印度夫妇，则是男士说话，还有独自参与的广州梅先生，一位台湾青年厖总算挽回男人颓势。这样安排节目，别出心裁，是我参加旅行团以来初度尝试。 经过两小时车程，抵达希望镇，这只是个小市区，安静平和，路旁公园摆置Hope(希望)的牌匾，还有一些野兽木雕，形态活现。据说十九世纪时，人们到附近的莎菲河谷挖掘金矿，希望获得黄金致富，因而命名「希望」，后来更因拍摄《第一滴血》( First Blood) 的电影，竟然成为旅游名胜。 抱持了希望，继续前往黄金镇，沿途循菲沙河往东走，经过一个叫做「最后一根钉」( The Last Spike) 的景点，大家下车参观，看见这条横跨美洲大陆、连结东部与太平洋岸的铁路，和一般铁路没有什么特别，只是当年建筑艰苦，到达这里连接交会终点，施工者成功打下这最后一根卯钉，后来加拿大政府修建了一个纪念碑，成为旅游洛矶山必经的观光站。我俯首观察，铁路上每根钉头都一样，只是其中一根釉上金黄色作记号而已。 旅行车继续向黄金镇进发，中午停留旅游胜地──别号灰熊镇的可乐那市( Kelowna )，据导游介绍这里的果园、酒庄很著名，这里也有赌场和酒吧，有景色美丽湖区，由于时间不足，我们主要在这里品尝美味可口的中餐，跟着坐车游览观景。 傍晚终于见到黄金镇了，这里风光明媚，山势雄伟，环境幽静，是旅游洛矶山脉的主要出入口，我们被安排在这里食宿。旅行车在金马酒家前停泊，只见其他旅行团也在这里进餐，生意非常兴旺，尤其本周是加拿大的感恩节长假期，游客光顾特多，店主的小女孩也要帮忙服务。我们早已订下座位，还要等待先来的食客离去才能入席。 在等待晚餐的空档，我致电给定居卡加里的秦松叶、卢淑玲夫妇，联络一下，看看可不可以到来相聚。他俩是我的老同学，二○○五年曾来凤凰城探访我，同游大峡谷，转眼又七年了，我原本计划九月间往加拿大自由行，先到卡城秦府歇脚，再向各地出发，但因好几个朋友的时间不配合，惟有取消行程。最后却因太座一时高兴，参加了这个洛矶山七日游。 电话接通了，老同学是非常高兴，互相问候，我告知抵达黄金镇，他俩说相隔约九十分钟车程，谈话间并没有表示要到来见面的意思，也难怪，年龄大，往来不方便，晚上驾车较远不大安全。司机华哥告诉我，明晚住宿斑芙以东的肯莫镇，是最接近卡城的地方，应该可以会晤。 已经轮到我们进入金马酒家了，享受黄金镇的的广东美食，菜肴不错，大家满意。饭后转往近在咫尺的旅馆安眠，导游吩咐，今晚或明晨可到旁边的便利店购买早餐食品，因旅馆没有餐饮设备，明天正式漫游洛矶山脉，沿途更无饮食店供应服务。
b026cde9340f2ca3c38409a55d1a09755fdf3995.translatedText: The Phoenix City is full of energy: Rocky Mountain Odyssey Part 5 - Hope to See Gold. The trip entered the fourth day. This morning, I loaded all my luggage into the car, left the Vancouver Coast Hotel, and set off for the Rocky Mountains. Tour guide Lao Xie told us that today’s journey is the longest, taking a total of nine hours. We will first arrive at Hope Town for a visit and stay overnight in Golden Town. Good sign! Full of hope, and seeing gold again. Looking along the way, there are high mountains, snow-capped mountains, seas, rivers and lakes with sparkling waves. It reminds me of the wonderful couplet of Li Wenfu, a man from the Qing Dynasty: "Green water is originally worry-free, but its face is wrinkled by the wind; green mountains are not old, but are white-headed by snow." Isn't life like this? The social environment affects you and even changes your life. "People are in the world, and they have no choice but to do what they want." All Vietnamese Chinese of my generation have had their personal expectations for the future changed by the situation of the Vietnam War. The journey was long, and there was no phonograph equipment on the car, only movies. The tour guide was afraid that everyone would be confused, so he proposed to hold a self-introduction activity in the hope that tourists from all walks of life could communicate with each other and enhance friendship. Instead of speaking individually, according to the registered group, one member would be sent to the front seat of the car to speak with a microphone, and the tour guide would translate. He led by example. He first introduced himself as being from Taiwan and settled in California. He worked as a tour guide for Golden Holidays, mainly responsible for Canadian tours. He came here in May and June to serve. This group was the last group of the year. After the end, he flew back to Los Angeles to reunite with his family. Then the speeches took turns according to the seats. For example, the Taiwanese six-person group was represented by a woman, the three Shanghai seniors who immigrated to New Jersey were also narrated by an old woman, and the two Vietnamese couples were a combination of Houston and Orange County. The Vietnamese women also spoke in English. It seems that the women in this tour group are much stronger than the men. Of course, I was the one who spoke. The other couple, Mr. and Mrs. Lan, who are also from Taiwan, and the Indian couple were the men who spoke. There was also Mr. Mei from Guangzhou who participated alone. A young Taiwanese named Pang finally saved the man from losing his temper. Arranging the program in this way is unique and it is the first time I have tried it since joining a tour group. After a two-hour drive, we arrived at Hope Town. This is just a small urban area, quiet and peaceful. There are plaques of Hope placed in the park beside the road, and there are also some wood carvings of wild beasts, which are vivid in shape. It is said that in the 19th century, people dug gold mines in the nearby Shafi Valley, hoping to get rich from gold, so they named it "Hope". Later, it became a tourist attraction due to the filming of the movie "First Blood". With hope in mind, we continued to Golden Town and walked eastward along the Fraser River. We passed an attraction called "The Last Spike." We got off the car and visited. We saw that this railway across the American continent and connecting the East and the Pacific Coast was no different from ordinary railways. It was just that the construction was difficult in the past. When we reached the intersection here, the builders successfully laid the last spike. Later, the Canadian government built a monument, which became a must-pass tourist stop when traveling to the Rockies. I looked down and observed that every nail head on the railway was the same, except that one of them was glazed with golden yellow as a mark. The tour bus continued on to Golden Town and stopped at the tourist resort of Kelowna, also known as Grizzly Town, at noon. According to the tour guide, the orchards and wineries here are very famous, there are also casinos and bars, and there is a beautiful lake area. Due to lack of time, we mainly tasted delicious Chinese food here and followed the car tour to see the scenery. In the evening, we finally saw Golden Town. The scenery here is beautiful, the mountains are majestic, and the environment is quiet. It is the main entrance and exit for tourism in the Rocky Mountains. We were arranged to have food and accommodation here. The station wagon parked in front of the Golden Horse Restaurant, and I saw other tour groups dining here. The business was very prosperous, especially this week is the Canadian Thanksgiving holiday. There were so many tourists here that the owner’s little girl also had to help serve. We had already reserved seats and had to wait for the diners who came first to leave before we could sit down. While waiting for dinner, I called Qin Songye and Lu Shuling, the couple who live in Calgary, to get in touch and see if we could come and get together. They are my old classmates. In 2005, they came to Phoenix to visit me and traveled to the Grand Canyon together. It has been seven years since then. I originally planned to go on a free trip to Canada in September. I would stop at Calgary's Qinfu before setting off to other places. However, due to the unavailability of several friends' schedules, I had to cancel the trip. In the end, Taizu was so happy that he participated in this seven-day tour of the Rocky Mountains. The phone was connected. The old classmates were very happy and exchanged greetings. I told them that we had arrived in Huanghuang Town. They said they were about 90 minutes away by car. During the conversation, they did not express any intention of coming to meet. It is no wonder that because of their age, it is inconvenient to travel, and it is not safe to drive far at night. The driver, Brother Hua, told me that I would stay in Kenmore Town, east of Banfu tomorrow night, which is the closest place to Calgary, so we should be able to meet up. It was our turn to enter the Golden Horse Restaurant and enjoy the Cantonese cuisine in Golden Town. The dishes were good and everyone was satisfied. After the meal, we transferred to a nearby hotel to sleep. The tour guide told us that we can buy breakfast food at the nearby convenience store tonight or tomorrow morning. Since the hotel does not have catering facilities, we will officially travel to the Rocky Mountains tomorrow, and there will be no restaurants to provide services along the way.

728b2bbe819330e7f7d130f8dd617e88120eb239.sourceText: 2008年美国房地产崩溃之后，5年来，近1,600万房屋变成负资产，银主盘，大多数美国人对房产市场失去信心。
728b2bbe819330e7f7d130f8dd617e88120eb239.translatedText: After the U.S. real estate crash in 2008, nearly 16 million homes became negative equity in the past five years, and most Americans lost confidence in the real estate market.

c2511f4ab591997eb1c2021a11d78be4ab13336f.sourceText: 去年，置业网站Trulia向2,000名成年人进行一项调查，61%受访者预计今年房地产市场的价格将会上升。58%受访者表示，房价要回复到2008年高峰期的水平，至少还要10年的时间。接近80%的租屋人士表示，他们计划将来会置业。不管受访者是否过于乐观，美国房地产好转的跡象是难以忽视的。事实上，去年10月，全美房屋价格已经连续8个月上升，相比前年同期跃升6.3%左右，也是2006年6月以来的最大增幅。
c2511f4ab591997eb1c2021a11d78be4ab13336f.translatedText: Last year, the real estate website Trulia conducted a survey of 2,000 adults. 61% of the respondents expected that the real estate market prices will increase this year. 58% of the respondents said that it will take at least 10 years for housing prices to return to the peak level in 2008. Nearly 80% of renters said they plan to buy a home in the future. Whether or not respondents are overly optimistic, the signs of an upturn in U.S. real estate are hard to ignore. In fact, in October last year, home prices across the United States had risen for eight consecutive months, jumping about 6.3% compared to the same period last year, which was also the largest increase since June 2006.

83c11c6e5adffa35362f4b4e06d0bb25cfcd80f6.sourceText: 加州是房地产受灾最严重的地区之一，今年预计57%的住宅出售，将会吸引更多的置业人士争相竞投。房地产经纪人玛吉佩克(Marge Peck)指出，在佛罗里达州，凤凰城等地方的房地产又再捲土重来了，尤其是房价低于15万的房屋。
83c11c6e5adffa35362f4b4e06d0bb25cfcd80f6.translatedText: California is one of the areas hardest hit by the real estate disaster. It is expected that 57% of residential homes will be sold this year, which will attract more home buyers to compete. In Florida, real estate agent Marge Peck points out that real estate is making a comeback in places like Phoenix, especially for homes priced under $150,000.

5ee18af3dc8eb52b478da0399fa49f2b35645d03.sourceText: 今年，美国房地产市场能否延续这个趋势？ 大多数专家说，预测依赖于今年主流经济增长的情况，相信经济不会出现严重的落差。另有专家强调，所有房产市场都是本地的，即是沿海大都市地区和中西部城镇的条件差异很大。除了这些注意事项，以下是预测今年房地产的销售走势。 （一）房价上涨
5ee18af3dc8eb52b478da0399fa49f2b35645d03.translatedText: Can the U.S. real estate market continue this trend this year? Most experts say the forecast relies on mainstream economic growth this year and they believe the economy will not suffer a serious gap. Other experts stress that all housing markets are local, meaning conditions vary widely between coastal metropolitan areas and midwestern towns. With those caveats aside, here's a look at where real estate sales are expected to go this year. (1) Rising housing prices

ec95f53d435f29648e57d09f63266c4369082574.sourceText: 新建房屋的落成缓慢，推动价格成本上涨，这种趋势今年将会持续。全国房地产投资信託基金协会的经济学家卡尔文(Calvin Schnure)说，每年需要兴建125万至150万间全新的住宅和公寓，才能够跟上人口增长的需求。但是，自从房市崩溃6年以来，新住宅建成只有50万，这实际上造成市场供应的缺口。得克萨斯州房地产研究中心的首席经济学家马克(Mark Dotzour)说，预测今年的平均房价上升5%。
ec95f53d435f29648e57d09f63266c4369082574.translatedText: The slow completion of new houses has pushed up prices and costs, and this trend will continue this year. Calvin Schnure, an economist with the National Association of Real Estate Investment Trusts, said 1.25 million to 1.5 million new homes and apartments need to be built each year to keep up with population growth. However, in the six years since the housing market crashed, only 500,000 new homes have been built, effectively creating a supply gap in the market. Mark Dotzour, chief economist at the Texas Real Estate Research Center, said average home prices are forecast to rise 5% this year.

74634480dd94a89eaad9cb23371e00c2cc07dbbd.sourceText: 卡尔文说，租金市场有一个巨大的需求，大约300至500万名年龄20至30岁左右的年轻人，在经济衰退期间，他们搬回父母家或跟朋友住在一起。现时，当他们开始找工作，他们将会寻找自己的公寓。卡尔文说，以百分比计算，租金将会增加两倍或以上。今年，对于寻找租屋市场的年轻人来说，实在需要一点运气，这将会是一个挑战。他说，今年预测全美平均的租金增加4%一年，大都会地区预计将会增加7%至9%。
74634480dd94a89eaad9cb23371e00c2cc07dbbd.translatedText: Calvin said there is a huge demand in the rental market, with about 3 to 5 million young people aged 20 to 30 who moved back to their parents' homes or lived with friends during the recession. Now, when they start looking for jobs, they will be looking for their own apartment. In percentage terms, rents would triple or more, Calvin said. This year, for young people looking for a rental market, it will be a challenge if they really need a little luck. He said that this year, the national average rent is expected to increase by 4%, and metropolitan areas are expected to increase by 7% to 9%.

7045d5f40ef16163e565ad9d23ff481721a339a8.sourceText: （三）更少负资产的银主盘 置业人士想购买便宜的银主盘，法拍屋，机会可能越来越少。法拍屋的销售由2011年3月的28%下降至2012年6月的11%。主要原因是美国联邦住房金融局(FHFA)，联邦存款保险公司和银行已经卖断数以千间止赎房屋。购买者同意以低价大量购入，并同意负责与借款人商讨新的条款，而不是简单地变成负资产房屋处理。法拍房屋的数量已经下降，因为成千上万的借款人的经济状况已获得改善，加上房价上涨，有助支付房贷欠款。
7045d5f40ef16163e565ad9d23ff481721a339a8.translatedText: (3) Silver main projects with less negative equity. Home buyers who want to buy cheap silver main projects and foreclosure houses may have fewer and fewer opportunities. Foreclosure sales dropped from 28% in March 2011 to 11% in June 2012. The main reason is that the Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA), the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation and banks have sold out thousands of foreclosed homes. The buyer agrees to purchase a large quantity at a low price and agrees to be responsible for negotiating new terms with the borrower, rather than simply being dealt with the house in negative equity. The number of foreclosures has fallen as thousands of borrowers' financial conditions improved and rising home prices helped pay off their mortgage payments.

43d747a134d8daad9ba0e8c6d8db9a8761227301.sourceText: 德勤会计师事务所的一份报告预测，2013年单户住宅的需求将会大幅增长，主要是由首次置业人士所驱动的。这种趋势从去年11月的房屋买卖方调查可见，39%的房贷借款人是首次置业人士，2011年的比例是37%，明显有所增长。
43d747a134d8daad9ba0e8c6d8db9a8761227301.translatedText: A report by Deloitte & Touche LLP predicts that the demand for single-family homes will grow significantly in 2013, mainly driven by first-time homebuyers. This trend can be seen from the survey of home buyers and sellers in November last year. 39% of mortgage borrowers were first-time homebuyers, compared with 37% in 2011, which is a significant increase.

c2a3e7aff83c15b9e4f79856d92ed91d55082f01.translatedText: (5) The cost of housing construction will increase significantly

b17f856033d219974ff7b0e4d5a81f477422f8c1.sourceText: 住房建设材料，例如：石板，木材，铜等，价格将会大增。虽然住房建设的数量仍然低于水平，但是，建筑业的人才不足，很多合资格的建筑工人移民或转到其他行业。因此，其结果将会是推高建筑成本，不管是建材或人手的费用，也会较去年明显增加。
b17f856033d219974ff7b0e4d5a81f477422f8c1.translatedText: The price of housing construction materials, such as slate, wood, copper, etc., will increase significantly. Although the number of housing construction remains below the level, there is a shortage of talents in the construction industry, and many qualified construction workers immigrate or transfer to other industries. Therefore, the result will be to push up construction costs, whether it is building materials or labor costs, which will also increase significantly compared with last year.

d15e0e781924638682414e4cc3e5f9d568dbd277.sourceText: 今年，预计将会是物业经理赚翻的一年，年初，有物业管理人员开始销售多个止赎物业，与大型机构投资者同意一起持有和管理，或转作为租金市场。当然，投资者收购不良资产出租的趋势将会愈演愈烈，根据房地产商的资料，2011年投资置业的买屋人数比较2010年增长了65%。现时，许多投资者利用专业的物业管理公司来负责其房屋的租贷和维修管理，创造了该行业的巨大需求。
d15e0e781924638682414e4cc3e5f9d568dbd277.translatedText: This year is expected to be a year of huge profits for property managers. At the beginning of the year, some property managers began to sell multiple foreclosed properties, agree to hold and manage them with large institutional investors, or transfer them to the rental market. Of course, the trend of investors acquiring distressed assets for rent will become more and more intense. According to data from real estate developers, the number of home buyers who invested in real estate in 2011 increased by 65% ​​compared with 2010. Currently, many investors use professional property management companies to take care of the rental and maintenance management of their homes, creating huge demand in this industry.

d990d50511485244ac75b373b6d38c3f34b81ba6.sourceText: 平均而言，去年，借款人需要信用评分达到760分或以上，才能够获得抵押贷款，相比房地产高峰期，其标准要求更高。纽约市资本顾问公司的路易斯贝尔加拉(Luis Vergara)说，今年开始改变这种情况，信贷标准将会下降，更多的买家合付资格进入房地产市场，或造成贷款人之间竞争，有助为置业人士提供贷款。
d990d50511485244ac75b373b6d38c3f34b81ba6.translatedText: On average, last year, borrowers needed a credit score of 760 or above to obtain a mortgage loan. Compared with the peak period of real estate, the standards were higher. That situation will begin to change this year, said Luis Vergara of New York City Capital Advisors. Credit standards will fall, and more buyers with co-payments will enter the real estate market, which may create competition among lenders and help provide loans to homebuyers.

4c9bb16501469ec0de10964baa2fa69e1a20178a.sourceText: Mesa City与开平市缔结金兰 张肇鸿 祖藉廣東開平護龍東門里的鄧偉利是華僑移民第三代，他畢業於本州州立大學，服務於AT&T電話公司廿余年，并經營汽車零件中心，曾任美莎市(Mesa)青年會主席、警政參議會主席、瑪利科巴郡政治研究會主席，1988年至1989年出任美莎市副市長。1993年鄧偉利參加市長競選，以占票率百分之五十一點二當選，當年亞省第三大的美莎市人口有三十三萬，亞裔人口只占百分之一，他成功地擔任市長，殊屬不易。 美莎市成爲了由華裔市長管理全美最多人口的城市。鄧偉利上任后，為本地華人和開平祖家做了件好事，那就是讓美莎市和中國廣東開平締結成姐妹市。在僑領方慧賢的穿針引線下,美莎市與開平市成為金蘭之交，鄧市長親率市政府代表團和卅位開平鄉親回祖國廣東開平市簽約。當時回國的行程充滿變數，因為鄧市長期操勞市政而累壞了身子，隨時有開刀住院的可能，連上飛機也要徵得醫生同意才能成行。是出於對祖家的思念，還是鄧家祖宗有靈，鄧市長終於率團回到了開平，而且精神爽利，行程順暢。開平市長親自將一把城市”金鎖匙”贈予鄧偉利市長，祝賀他成為開平市的”榮譽市民”。須知道當時要獲此殊榮的人物，條件是須投資一千萬或純捐獻一百萬港幣的商賈才獲得認証。那本有如金子般沉重的名冊上，有着數十位遍佈港澳和海外的開平華僑，首位是香港恒生銀行董事長利國偉。但全書中沒有一位能象鄧偉利這般能在美國從政，並榮膺為市長的開平弟子，是他填補了這個空白。鳳凰城的開平鄉親回到開平，受到鄉親們隆重熱情的歡迎，市委安排我們住到別墅和觀光游覽，參觀故鄉重大的變化，并贈給每個姐妹市成員紀念品。鄧市長衣錦還鄉，鄉親們專門劈開一條山路，他家的祖墳得到重修。在香火縈繞中，鄧氏祖宗看到了有一個遠在美國的孝子賢孫，在西方修成了正果，法力無邊地穿越了太平洋，給地處僻壤的祖宗山墳加上了一道光環。 美莎市和開平市締結成為姐妹市後，時有代表團互訪，促進了兩地經濟、文化和各方面的合作與交流。數年前，有開平市代表團來到鳳凰城，資深僑領余文勁先生曾提到，作為開平三埠之一的荻海城，為什麼發展不如其它兩埠?文章發表後，引起開平當局的關注。後來，有「荻海舊城穿新裝」文章發表，介紹荻海改變後的新貎。并以一首詩來結尾: ”三埠如珠一水遙，長橋作綫串今朝，鄉情欲托潭江水，流到重洋慰遠僑。” 九月九日，美莎市和世界上六個姐妹市共同舉辦9.11十周年紀念活動，演出地點在美莎市藝術中心。 鄧偉利和方慧賢率團回廣東開平締結姐妹市 鄧偉利市長和作者合照 （ 1993 ）
4c9bb16501469ec0de10964baa2fa69e1a20178a.translatedText: Mesa City and Kaiping City forge a golden orchid relationship. Zhang Zhaohong, whose ancestral home is Hulongdongmenli in Kaiping, Guangdong, is the third generation of overseas Chinese immigrants. He graduated from Honshu State University, worked for AT&T Telephone Company for more than 20 years, and ran an auto parts center. He served as the chairman of the Mesa Youth Association, the chairman of the Police Council, and the chairman of the Maricopa County Political Research Association. From 1988 to 1989, he served as the deputy mayor of Mesa City. In 1993, Weili Tang ran for mayor and was elected with 51.2% of the vote. At that time, Mesa City, the third largest city in Alberta, had a population of 330,000, and the Asian population accounted for only 1%. It was not easy for him to successfully serve as mayor. Mesa City has become the city with the largest population in the United States governed by a Chinese-American mayor. After taking office, Deng Weili did a good thing for the local Chinese and Kaiping ancestral families, which was to establish a sister city between Mesa City and Kaiping, Guangdong, China. Under the guidance of overseas Chinese leader Fang Huixian, Mesha City and Kaiping City became close friends. Mayor Deng personally led the municipal government delegation and 30 Kaiping folks back to their motherland, Kaiping City, Guangdong, to sign a contract. At that time, the trip back to China was full of uncertainties. Because Deng was exhausted from working in the municipal government for a long time, there was a possibility of surgery and hospitalization at any time. Even before boarding the plane, he had to seek permission from the doctor before he could make the trip. Whether it was out of longing for his ancestral home or the spirit of the Deng family ancestors, Mayor Deng finally led the delegation back to Kaiping, feeling refreshed and traveling smoothly. The mayor of Kaiping personally presented a "golden key" to the city to Mayor Deng Weili and congratulated him on becoming an "honorary citizen" of Kaiping City. It is important to know that in order to receive this honor, a businessman must invest 10 million Hong Kong dollars or donate 1 million Hong Kong dollars to be certified. On that roster, which is as heavy as gold, there are dozens of overseas Chinese from Kaiping all over Hong Kong, Macao and overseas. The first is Lee Guowei, chairman of Hang Seng Bank in Hong Kong. But there is no Kaiping disciple in the book who can engage in politics in the United States and be honored as mayor like Deng Weili. It is he who fills this gap. The Kaiping folks from Phoenix City returned to Kaiping and received a grand and warm welcome from the folks. The Municipal Party Committee arranged for us to stay in villas and go on sightseeing tours to see the major changes in our hometown, and gave souvenirs to each sister city member. Mayor Deng returned home in fine clothes, and the villagers specially cut a mountain road, and his family's ancestral graves were rebuilt. Amidst the lingering incense, the Deng family's ancestors saw a filial son and grandson far away in the United States. He had achieved righteousness in the West and had boundless magical power to cross the Pacific Ocean, adding a halo to the remote mountain tomb of his ancestors. After Mesa City and Kaiping City became sister cities, delegations visited each other from time to time, which promoted economic, cultural and all-round cooperation and exchanges between the two places. A few years ago, a delegation from Kaiping City came to Phoenix. Mr. Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader, once mentioned why Dihai City, one of the three ports in Kaiping, was not as developed as the other two ports. After the article was published, it attracted the attention of the Kaiping authorities. Later, an article titled "New Clothes in the Old City of Ogikai" was published, introducing the new look of Ogikai after its transformation. And it ended with a poem: "Three ports are like pearls and one river is far away, and long bridges are now connected by strings. The nostalgia of the river flows to the ocean to comfort the overseas Chinese." On September 9, Mesa City and six sister cities around the world jointly held a commemorative event to commemorate the 10th anniversary of 9.11. The performance was held at the Mesa City Art Center. Deng Weili and Fang Huixian led a delegation back to Kaiping, Guangdong to establish sister cities. Mayor Deng Weili and the author took a photo (1993)

cd3202d900de19492d1d3a136d90a40d0b9f7875.sourceText: 8月中旬，本地Ｘ週报在头版文章写道：”亚省又有中文报纸喊价急售”，”似是5万美元便可成交”，”大有成事可能”。 两天后，在一个会场上，我问Ｘ週报的主笔：”此事何来？！”他爱理不理地反问:”那是讲你的吗？！”
cd3202d900de19492d1d3a136d90a40d0b9f7875.translatedText: In mid-August, the local X Weekly wrote in a front-page article: "Another Chinese newspaper in Alberta is for sale at an urgent price." Two days later, at a conference, I asked the editor of X Weekly: "Where did this come from?!" He asked indifferently: "Is that about you?!"

ef01e4c0b5584d5f1fd27d638c8cc7d4a1483e0e.sourceText: ”亚省共有三份中文报纸，问过XX侨报，我们两家报纸均无此事，第三家就是你报了。不然，就是造谣啦！”
ef01e4c0b5584d5f1fd27d638c8cc7d4a1483e0e.translatedText: " There are three Chinese newspapers in Alberta. , I asked the XX Overseas Chinese Newspaper, and neither of our two newspapers reported this. Otherwise, it is just a rumor!"

0355382deb98419c0142b901bfa304a587cb0178.sourceText: 他无言相对，表示出一个极不负责任的态度。 媒体是面向社会，报纸上的文章供公眾阅读，直接影响著社会舆论。因而，任何媒体都应该有一个社会责任感。 就以Ｘ週报谣传来说，其实一直在发酵。连日来，好些朋友、读者问本报的同仁：按照Ｘ週报传说，您家报纸己卖掉，您们用不著上班啦？同时，个别商户老板问，按照谣传，与本报长期合约怎麼办？无疑，谬种流传，正在產生效应。它詆毁了本报的信誉，骚扰本报团队的工作情绪，影响本报的业务开展，阻碍為大眾喜闻乐见的报业的发展。对这种不良的影响，Ｘ週报可以採取不负责任的态度吗?! 处身於自由民主的国度。言论自由、市场自由竞争。这种自由，应该以不要成為损害他人的信誉，侵犯他人的权益，暴露他人的私隐為前提。决不能像Ｘ週报那样．对一些影响到别报的权益事情，不调查研究，只捕风捉影，便由主笔按照自己的主观臆测．胡言乱说。说到底，该报以大减价或免费刊登广告的自欺欺人手段，把原在本报的刊登的广告拉过去，仍然逹不到压倒本报的强大影响力效果，又採取这种造谣惑眾、詆毁本报信誉的倒行逆施，完全违背媒体的道德标準，是绝对不能得逞的！ 本是同根生，相煎何太急。我们同是炎黄子孙，海外赤子。在异乡外域為求生计，从事媒体工作。不可能有任何政府或财团的援助，只能依靠当地华人同胞的支持，以登广告和订阅报纸等方式凝聚起大眾的爱心，使报业一步一步发展起来。我们对於自力更生创立的事业，自然是爱惜有加。眼前，本人年老多病，如何让事业传承和发展，这是我们自己要思考的问题，我们欢迎善长仁翁的多提宝贵的意见。然而，那些借机造谣惑众，无事生非，应该Stop！
0355382deb98419c0142b901bfa304a587cb0178.translatedText: He said nothing, showing an extremely irresponsible attitude. The media is oriented to society, and articles in newspapers are for the public to read and directly affect public opinion. Therefore, any media should have a sense of social responsibility. As far as the X Weekly rumors are concerned, they have actually been fermenting. In the past few days, many friends and readers have asked our colleagues: According to the legend of X Weekly, your newspaper has been sold, so you don’t have to go to work anymore? At the same time, some business owners asked, what should they do with the long-term contracts with this newspaper according to the rumors? Undoubtedly, the spread of falsehoods is having an effect. It slanders the credibility of this newspaper, harasses the working mood of the newspaper team, affects the business development of this newspaper, and hinders the development of a newspaper industry that is popular with the public. Can X Weekly adopt an irresponsible attitude towards this kind of bad influence?! We are in a free and democratic country. Freedom of speech and free market competition. This kind of freedom should be premised on not damaging other people's credibility, infringing on other people's rights, or exposing other people's privacy. It can never be like X Weekly. For some matters that affect the rights and interests of other newspapers, there is no investigation and research, but only speculation, and the main writer makes his own subjective assumptions. Nonsense. In the final analysis, the newspaper used self-deception methods of large discounts or free advertising to pull the advertisements originally published in this newspaper, but it still failed to achieve the powerful influence that overwhelms the newspaper. It also resorted to such perverse actions of spreading rumors to confuse the public and slandering the credibility of the newspaper. It completely violates the ethical standards of the media and must not succeed! They are born from the same root, so there is no need to rush into mutual conflict. We are both descendants of the Yan and Huang dynasties, and we are pure sons overseas. To make a living in a foreign land, he works in the media. It was impossible to receive any assistance from the government or financial groups. We could only rely on the support of local Chinese compatriots to gather public love through advertising and newspaper subscriptions, so that the newspaper industry could develop step by step. We naturally cherish the businesses we have established through our own efforts. At present, I am old and sick. How to inherit and develop our business is a question we have to think about. We welcome more valuable opinions from kind and benevolent people. However, those who take the opportunity to spread rumors and confuse the public and cause trouble over nothing should stop!

d996a30437a0538f138fc6a3f42524145f1c4d53.sourceText: 今年元旦起生效的《海峡两岸经济合作框架协议》(ECFA)成效初显。商务部最新发布的数据显示，今年第一季度两岸贸易同比增长近两成，其中大陆对台出口增幅更是超过三成。
d996a30437a0538f138fc6a3f42524145f1c4d53.translatedText: The Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA), which came into effect on New Year’s Day this year, has begun to show results. The latest data released by the Ministry of Commerce shows that cross-strait trade increased by nearly 20% year-on-year in the first quarter of this year, of which mainland exports to Taiwan increased by more than 30%.

05f97e38dc30922095e6e3f5578d0ebe17c2bbf6.sourceText: 商务部国际贸易经济合作研究院研究员刘雪琴告诉新华社记者，ECFA对相关产品的降税，大陆扩大进口贸易支持政策，两岸经济互补性强，世界经济形势的转好，这些因素共同促进了两岸贸易的增速。
05f97e38dc30922095e6e3f5578d0ebe17c2bbf6.translatedText: Liu Xueqin, a researcher at the Institute of International Trade and Economic Cooperation of the Ministry of Commerce, told Xinhua News Agency reporters that ECFA's tax reduction on related products, the mainland's expansion of import trade support policies, the strong economic complementarity between the two sides, and the improvement of the world economic situation. These factors have jointly promoted the growth of cross-strait trade.

ace8a9a1aa3e4f94563d6c78cfc2996a2c32f3f1.sourceText: 数据显示，首季两岸贸易额为376.2亿美元，同比上升19.7%。其中，大陆对台出口80.7亿美元，同比上升34.4%；自台进口295.5亿美元，同比上升16.2%。
ace8a9a1aa3e4f94563d6c78cfc2996a2c32f3f1.translatedText: Data show that cross-strait trade volume in the first quarter was US$37.62 billion, a year-on-year increase of 19.7%. Among them, mainland China's exports to Taiwan were US$8.07 billion, a year-on-year increase of 34.4%; China's imports from Taiwan were US$29.55 billion, a year-on-year increase of 16.2%.

5b58f32b90ad93c3903dde977a2bb3b43ab2ecc4.sourceText: ECFA早收清单的正式生效，进一步扫除两岸经贸往来障碍，其带来的效益正实实在在传递到两岸企业手中。根据规定，大陆出口台湾的267种产品和台湾出口至大陆的539种产品享受降税安排。
5b58f32b90ad93c3903dde977a2bb3b43ab2ecc4.translatedText: The official entry into force of the ECFA Early Harvest List further removes obstacles to cross-Strait economic and trade exchanges, and the benefits it brings are truly being passed on to enterprises on both sides of the Strait. According to regulations, 267 products exported from the mainland to Taiwan and 539 products exported from Taiwan to the mainland enjoy tax reduction arrangements.

f2ef93500b66dd90a5fa399d8512fcac076ecd98.sourceText: 台湾出口大陆的贸易量在稳定攀升。台湾农产特销中心连锁店控股有限公司董事黄一钟告诉新华社记者，ECFA早收清单让台湾更多水果品种得以享受降税优惠，报关口岸也相应增加，节省了人力物力成本。”虽然春节过后的这两三个月是水果销售淡季，但相对于去年同期，台湾水果销售大陆业绩成长了20%。”
f2ef93500b66dd90a5fa399d8512fcac076ecd98.translatedText: Taiwan’s exports to the mainland are steadily increasing. Huang Yizhong, director of Taiwan Agricultural Products Specialty Sales Center Chain Store Holdings Co., Ltd., told Xinhua News Agency that the ECFA early harvest list allows more fruit varieties in Taiwan to enjoy tax reductions, and customs declaration ports have also increased accordingly, saving manpower and material costs. "Although the two to three months after the Spring Festival are the off-season for fruit sales, Taiwan's fruit sales in mainland China have increased by 20% compared to the same period last year."

41b45545611062768ace6193ed3721bfa6de08d1.sourceText: 据台湾经济主管部门分析，得益于ECFA带来的众多商机，今年台湾出口增长10%的目标应可达成，吸引民间 投资 也有望达到1.1万亿元新台币的规模。
41b45545611062768ace6193ed3721bfa6de08d1.translatedText: According to analysis by Taiwan's economic authorities, thanks to the many business opportunities brought by ECFA, Taiwan's export growth target of 10% this year should be achieved, and private investment is expected to reach NT$1.1 trillion.

21b5234a28fa9c7a2e35fe3ab7d71331fc819b2f.sourceText: 根据 27 日 公布的 S&P/Case-Shiller 房价指数显示，美国 9 月房价连续第六个月上涨，显示房屋市场处于复苏之中。
21b5234a28fa9c7a2e35fe3ab7d71331fc819b2f.translatedText: According to the S&P/Case-Shiller house price index released on the 27th, U.S. house prices rose for the sixth consecutive month in September, showing that the housing market is recovering.

960815c1c2bed8927da4467ae037f2b845a082c9.sourceText: S&P/Case-Shiller 20 大都会区 9 月房价综合指数上升 0.3% ， 8 月为上升 0.8% 。 20 大都会区房价较去年同期上涨 3% 。
960815c1c2bed8927da4467ae037f2b845a082c9.translatedText: S&P/Case-Shiller The composite index of house prices in the 20 metropolitan areas rose 0.3% in September, after rising 0.8% in August. Home prices in 20 metropolitan areas rose 3% from the same period last year.

de8daeb2f6328cf11637f822abe267d44989f126.sourceText: 分析师说，时序已进入一年的疲弱部份，但房屋市场持续改善。在该指数所追踪的 20 大都会区中，有 13 城市 9 月房价上涨。与去年同期相比，今年凤凰城住房价格上涨了 20 ％，是最多的。亚特兰大房价经连续下跌 26 个月后，终于比去年同期上涨了 0.1 ％。
de8daeb2f6328cf11637f822abe267d44989f126.translatedText: Analysts said that the timing has entered the weak part of the year, but the housing market continues to improve. Home prices rose in September in 13 of the 20 metropolitan areas tracked by the index. Housing prices in Phoenix have increased by 20 percent this year compared to the same time last year, the most. After 26 straight months of declines, Atlanta home prices are finally up 0.1% from a year ago.

382e84bc706688ca1e134328ee46fb7f273a02d0.sourceText: 相比 2011 年 9 月 ，芝加哥和纽约的住房价格则分别下跌了 1.5 ％和 2.3 ％。凯司－席勒指数在第三季度 同比 上涨了 3.6 ％。而且， 20 个城市中有 17 个上涨。
382e84bc706688ca1e134328ee46fb7f273a02d0.translatedText: Compared to September 2011, housing prices in Chicago and New York fell by 1.5% and 2.3% respectively. The Case-Shiller index rose 3.6% year-over-year in the third quarter. And, 17 out of 20 cities saw increases.

6dad11f8ab3d4ffac7de80f65608908175a09802.sourceText: 近来的新屋开工，住宅建商指数及成屋销售均见上升。然而，尽管持续偏低的抵押贷款利率引来了部份买盘，但消费者仍面临严格的信用标准，官员说严格的贷款条件将阻碍强劲的房屋市场复苏。
6dad11f8ab3d4ffac7de80f65608908175a09802.translatedText: Recent new housing starts, the home builder index and existing home sales have both increased. However, while persistently low mortgage rates have led to some buying, consumers still face strict credit standards, and officials say strict lending conditions will hinder a strong housing market recovery.

c27f78889d6d70257d1ca85f265332f178667e59.sourceText: 尽管近来房价上涨，但仍较 2006 年高点下跌了约 30% 。
c27f78889d6d70257d1ca85f265332f178667e59.translatedText: Despite recent gains, home prices are still down about 30% from their 2006 high.

f5d4012a3f5f3d5664e495f3cb31e8167cc84256.sourceText: 围绕南周事件，中国各媒体和网站的态度已经显现无遗。
f5d4012a3f5f3d5664e495f3cb31e8167cc84256.translatedText: Regarding the Southern Zhou incident, the attitudes of various Chinese media and websites have been clearly revealed.

f84e2476e2e68347c71e7500d7cf094572cea9e5.sourceText: 《南方周末》报2013新年献词被撤改事件已经沸沸扬扬数日，中国官方至今没有正式做出任何回应。中国共产党党报《人民日报》属下的《环球时报》就此事件刊发的一篇社评，似乎成为中国媒体对官方态度回应的分水岭。
f84e2476e2e68347c71e7500d7cf094572cea9e5.translatedText: The incident of the Southern Weekend newspaper's 2013 New Year's message being withdrawn and altered has been a hot topic for several days, but the Chinese official has not made any official response. An editorial published by the Global Times, a subsidiary of the Communist Party of China's People's Daily, on the incident seemed to be a watershed moment in the Chinese media's response to the official attitude.

45e81ad66ba7ee8af07386c10dd4d9cbbe4bc49d.sourceText: 据多位媒体人士在微博中透露，中宣部要求媒体在周二（8日） 刊发《环球时报》社评：《南方周末’致读者’实在令人深思》。
45e81ad66ba7ee8af07386c10dd4d9cbbe4bc49d.translatedText: According to multiple media sources on Weibo, the Propaganda Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China requested the media to publish a "Global Times" editorial on Tuesday (8th): "Southern Weekend's 'To Readers' is really thought-provoking."

c77a01ab7343c78489e4194fc5d7db35457d83e6.sourceText: 该文指责，整个事件看来在最初阶段就被扩散者造了假。社论还提出：希望所有喜欢《南方周末》的人配合风波的平息，别逼一份中国报纸扮演它无论如何也承担不了的对抗角色。
c77a01ab7343c78489e4194fc5d7db35457d83e6.translatedText: The article accused that the entire incident seemed to have been fabricated by proliferators at the initial stage. The editorial also stated: I hope that all those who like Southern Weekend will cooperate with the quelling of the storm and not force a Chinese newspaper to play a confrontational role that it cannot bear anyway.

fe5c6b19891027881519b470d8b0ccaec72cc902.sourceText: 该社评周日在网络发表后，立即被众多媒体转载。
fe5c6b19891027881519b470d8b0ccaec72cc902.translatedText: After the editorial was published online on Sunday, it was immediately reprinted by many media.

33e90c32a9531ea0abb8b733078a95ff6b8ea465.sourceText: 腾讯新闻网在全文刊登此文后，声明写道：刊登此文并不意味腾讯网赞成其观点或证实其描述。
33e90c32a9531ea0abb8b733078a95ff6b8ea465.translatedText: After Tencent News published the full text of this article, it made a statement: Publishing this article does not mean that Tencent agrees with its views or confirms its description.

7e4a3c859ee5071383e5090a9a4c06df1150091f.sourceText: 新浪以”媒体称陈光诚涉及南方周末新年献词事件”为标题刊登了这一社论。
7e4a3c859ee5071383e5090a9a4c06df1150091f.translatedText: Sina published this editorial under the title "Media says Chen Guangcheng was involved in Southern Weekend's New Year's speech incident."

d2bd5ee6e6c668d6b7078dc48f825290c621a19b.sourceText: 网易周一转载社论时将标题改为” 南方周末官微：特刊封面导言系本报一负责人草拟”，并在随后重发《南方周末》2006年新年致辞：一句真话能比整个世界的分量还重。
d2bd5ee6e6c668d6b7078dc48f825290c621a19b.translatedText: When NetEase reprinted the editorial on Monday, it changed the title to "Southern Weekend's official Weibo: The cover introduction of the special issue was drafted by a person in charge of this newspaper", and then reposted Southern Weekend's 2006 New Year's message: A truth can weigh more than the weight of the entire world.

d5c8da5cb50ae311f4dbe08eebfc3f5c742c22d0.sourceText: 周一，官方新华社在网站首页转发了这一社论，注明了该文的来源出处，《人民日报》也转载了这一文章，标题改为：南方周末官微：特刊封面导言系本报一负责人草拟。
d5c8da5cb50ae311f4dbe08eebfc3f5c742c22d0.translatedText: On Monday, the official Xinhua News Agency reposted the editorial on the homepage of its website, indicating the source of the article. The People's Daily also reprinted the article, with the title changed to: Southern Weekend's official Weibo: The introduction to the cover of the special issue was drafted by a person in charge of the newspaper.

5a234584b59f5e0f6a7a2311516a21df11cc9762.sourceText: 同属南方报业集团的《南方日报》上，没有刊登《环球时报》的这一社论。中共上海市委机关报《解放日报》以及共青团中央属下的《中国青年报》也没有转载。
5a234584b59f5e0f6a7a2311516a21df11cc9762.translatedText: The Southern Daily, which is also part of the Southern Newspaper Group, did not publish this editorial from the Global Times. Jiefang Daily, the official newspaper of the Shanghai Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China, and China Youth Daily, an affiliate of the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League, also did not reprint it.

79d8df194179d76ccf54fa2d33be6c032704364e.sourceText: 与大多数党报机关报的沉默相比，各地方媒体和网站是否刊登这一社论似乎更为网民所关注。
79d8df194179d76ccf54fa2d33be6c032704364e.translatedText: Compared with the silence of most party newspapers and organs, netizens seem to be more concerned about whether local media and websites publish this editorial.

37f7bbd5703934396a0acf4ad06ab1161939abec.sourceText: 据网民转发到微博上的报纸头版显示，星期二转载了《环球时报》社评的还有广州《新快报》、《信息时报》和深圳《晶报》等。
37f7bbd5703934396a0acf4ad06ab1161939abec.translatedText: According to newspaper front pages forwarded by netizens on Weibo, Guangzhou's New Express, Information Times and Shenzhen's Jingbao also reprinted the Global Times editorial on Tuesday.

694e1c4278384b46165de8b6549e325dfaba8b96.sourceText: 与《环球时报》同属《人民日报》报系的《京华时报》也用摘编的方式转载社评，但其网络链接后来被移除。
694e1c4278384b46165de8b6549e325dfaba8b96.translatedText: The Beijing Times, which is part of the People's Daily newspaper chain like the Global Times, also reprinted the editorial in excerpts, but its online link was later removed.

6209a2f601630f790162f6dc633c7e0b2c5d9cf0.sourceText: 不过，同属南方系的《南方都市报》和曾属该报系的北京《新京报》并未转载此社评。
6209a2f601630f790162f6dc633c7e0b2c5d9cf0.translatedText: However, the Southern Metropolis Daily, which both belongs to the Southern Department, and the Beijing News, which once belonged to the same newspaper department, did not reprint this editorial.

d14a255766aca3d097a05a8743f8b1faed42bfff.sourceText: 其他没有转载的报章还包括湖南《潇湘晨报》、上海《新闻晨报》、《东方早报》和共青团中央机关报《中国青年报》，这让一些评论人士质疑中宣部的命令到底是否存在。
d14a255766aca3d097a05a8743f8b1faed42bfff.translatedText: Other newspapers that did not reprint include Hunan's Xiaoxiang Morning Post, Shanghai's News Morning Post, Oriental Morning Post and China Youth Daily, the central organ of the Communist Youth League, leading some commentators to question whether the order from the Central Propaganda Department exists.

4519b2c085ce8193db37e83386999ffac21e20bf.sourceText: 四川作家冉云飞在其微博上写道：今天全国包括重庆许多媒体没有屈服压力，刊登环球时报栽污南周事件的社评，但成都四大市场化报纸全面刊登，《天府早报》甚至变本加厉地加了编者按，其自甘阉割的奴性一览无余。
4519b2c085ce8193db37e83386999ffac21e20bf.translatedText: Sichuan writer Ran Yunfei wrote on his Weibo: Today many media outlets across the country, including Chongqing, did not yield to pressure and published editorials by the Global Times that slandered the Southern Zhou Dynasty. However, the four major market-oriented newspapers in Chengdu fully published it, and the Tianfu Morning Post even intensified its editorial note. The slavish nature of self-castration is clearly visible.

3be85bdd4ad4a4172198e5c26b24e596bc011f1d.sourceText: 观察人士注意到， 围绕南方周末新年献词事件，中国各媒体和网站的态度其实在其前几日的报道过程中已经显现无遗。
3be85bdd4ad4a4172198e5c26b24e596bc011f1d.translatedText: Observers have noticed that the attitude of various Chinese media and websites regarding Southern Weekend’s New Year’s speech incident has actually been revealed in their reporting in the past few days.

768c3f44a0695ad3d27ddaad3301838b156b3490.sourceText: 周二呈现在人们面前的已经经过数番调整和收拾，其过程远比其表相更为重要和耐人寻味。
768c3f44a0695ad3d27ddaad3301838b156b3490.translatedText: What was presented to people on Tuesday has been adjusted and sorted out several times, and its process is far more important and thought-provoking than its appearance.

769e0e9658ab49c22e03c797971f9d82e91e0e0c.sourceText: 面积达到60000平方英尺的医疗中心住扎吉尔伯特 金信地产 这些天，吉尔伯特（Gilbert）官员庆祝一件大喜事，美国退伍军人事务部宣布一个大型医疗中心选址在吉尔伯特市。地址选在在Val Vista和Pecos交界地区。医疗保健业工业将在这里拓展。 联邦部门预计建筑为两层楼高，60,000平方英尺。诊所将会在2014年的春天准备就绪。伊利诺伊州的麦克沙恩开发公司将建立医疗中心，并以每年近200万美元租赁给退伍军人事务部，租期20年。 这个建设项目预计将创造423个就业机会。镇官员估计，该诊所将永久聘用至少75人。联邦官员说，诊所将可容纳19000多名退伍军人在马里科帕县和皮纳尔和吉拉县的部分地区门诊服务。 退伍军人事务部将建立在亚利桑那州的19个社区为基础的门诊诊所。诊所将为菲尼克斯，图森和普雷斯科特的三个地区的主要医院做补充。 根据吉尔伯特市的经济发展文件，将近有800多个高科技企业在该项目附近发展起来。该地区经济的发展规划，就业机会的增加，将直接影响吉尔伯特市房地产市场。更多相关信息请咨询金信地产公司Tinna (480)287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@hotmail.com 。
769e0e9658ab49c22e03c797971f9d82e91e0e0c.translatedText: 60,000-square-foot medical center opens in Gilbert Jinxin Real Estate These days, Gilbert officials are celebrating a major event as the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs announces the site of a major medical center in Gilbert. The address was chosen at the junction of Val Vista and Pecos. The healthcare industry will expand here. The federal department anticipates the building to be two stories tall and 60,000 square feet. The clinic will be ready in the spring of 2014. Illinois-based McShane Development will build the medical center and lease it to the Department of Veterans Affairs for nearly $2 million per year for 20 years. The construction project is expected to create 423 jobs. Town officials estimate the clinic will permanently employ at least 75 people. Federal officials said the clinic will be able to accommodate more than 19,000 veterans for outpatient services in Maricopa County and parts of Pinal and Gila counties. The Department of Veterans Affairs will establish 19 community-based outpatient clinics in Arizona. The clinics will supplement three area major hospitals in Phoenix, Tucson and Prescott. According to the city of Gilbert's economic development documents, nearly 800 high-tech businesses have developed near the project. The economic development plan of the region and the increase of employment opportunities will directly affect the real estate market in Gilbert City. For more relevant information, please contact Tinna of Goldtrust Realty Company (480)287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@hotmail.com.

3b17067c72920a138bfeca9cb65cc6e84e416760.sourceText: 沙漠SUV内发现5尸体 可能涉贩毒 (亚省时报) 警察局官员说，皮纳尔郡维克谷（Vekol Valley）一辆被烧毁的SUV车内发现有5具尸体，他们很可能是贩毒集团暴力活动的受害者。 在发现尸体和被焚汽车的那个多山沙漠地区是著名的偷渡走廊，毒品和非法移民经过那个通道从墨西哥前往凤凰城和美国内地。 由于尸体被严重焚毁，调查人员甚至无法很快确定他们的性别和族裔。尽管还不能确定受害者是否来自墨西哥，当地警察局已经通知墨西哥总领馆。 一名边境巡逻特工周六早上4点30分首先看到那辆白色的福特Expedition车。尽管联邦和地方当局都尽力追踪那辆汽车，它还是失踪了。 天亮的时候，一名特工找到从8号州际公路前往沙漠的痕迹。那辆汽车显然是飞速离开公路，悬空一小段距离，然后进入沙漠。轮胎痕迹进入沙漠大约持续了两英里。 皮纳尔郡警察局长巴博说， 特工通过望远镜看到那辆车在冒烟。他们带着灭火器靠近，发现一具尸体在乘客座位上，后面货舱内躺着四具尸体。但前座空着。 巴博说，调查人员将确定受害者是在SUV着火之前死亡或者是起火时还活着。”这些人显然是被谋杀，但我们还不知道是（他们）如何死的。” 警方说，距离凤凰城以南35英里的皮纳尔郡暴力活动证明毒品走私还没有减缓，尤其是在该县西部。 皮纳尔郡警方去年曾经参与350次高速追逐嫌犯活动，多数都涉及贩毒集团成员。巴博说，这个星期沙漠里出现几次枪击事件，并有谋杀受害者的尸体留下。
3b17067c72920a138bfeca9cb65cc6e84e416760.translatedText: Five bodies were found in a desert SUV and may be involved in drug trafficking (Alberta Times) Police officials said that Vekol, Pinal County Five bodies were found in a burned SUV in the Valley, and they were likely victims of drug cartel violence. The mountainous desert area where the bodies and burned cars were found is a well-known smuggling corridor for drugs and illegal immigrants from Mexico to Phoenix and the United States. Because the bodies were so badly burned, investigators could not quickly determine their gender and ethnicity, although it was not yet certain whether the victims were from Mexico. The local police department has notified the Mexican Consulate General. A Border Patrol agent first sighted the white Ford Expedition at 4:30 a.m. Saturday. Despite efforts by federal and local authorities to track the car, an agent found tracks heading into the desert off Interstate 8. The car apparently sped off the road, hung in the air for a short distance, and then entered the desert, said Pinal County Police Chief Barber. Agents saw smoke coming from the vehicle through binoculars. They approached with a fire extinguisher and found a body in the passenger seat and four bodies lying in the rear cargo compartment, but the front seats were empty. Investigators will determine whether the victims died before the SUV caught fire or were still alive when it caught fire, but we don't know yet how (they) died," Barber said. Police say the violence in Pinal County, 35 miles south of Phoenix, is evidence that drug smuggling has not slowed down, especially in the western part of the county. Pinal County police were involved in 350 high-speed chases last year, most involving drug cartel members, and there have been several shootings and murder victims in the desert this week, Barber said.

b76babed5d3854872d353f6ffa4c3b24a9692a0f.sourceText: 金融研究公司Bankate.com在24日公布年度调查报告说，银行业为弥补法规收紧造成的损失，调高自动提款机(ATM)收费达破纪录的水准，并减少免费的支票帐户。 Bankate.com说，今年ATM收费是连续八年被调高，幅度达4%，为破纪录的2.50元；使用一家竞争银行的ATM，收费被调高11%，为1.57元，所以对许多客户 来说，使用一家竞争银行的ATM，收费为4.07元，上升了破纪录的7%。 银行传统上让其客户免费使用ATM，然后向使用跨行ATM的客户收费，来加以弥补，但现在人们越来越精明，只使用系统内的ATM，银行即试图弥补他们​​损失的收入。 Bankate.com对247家银行和储蓄银行的477个支票帐户分析后发现，银行提供的无利息支票帐户，只对39%的客户是不收费的，而去年这个比率是45%，2009年时是最 高峰的76%。 支票帐户的每月平均服务费也达破纪录的5.48元，比去年上涨25%。 Bankate.com分析员麦克布莱德说，银行业因法规收紧而收入降低，特别是政府在2010年限制银行对透支(overdraft)的收费，和去年把消费者使用销帐卡的刷卡费( swipe fee)降低两项法规，银行因而缩减了免费的支票帐户。 麦克布莱德说，刷卡费和透支收费过去是支持免费支票帐户的财源，现在银行业对给予免费支票帐户更加精挑细拣，通常只提供给优惠客户，例如有直接入帐(direct deposit) 的客户。 这些措施对客户的行为有影响，Bankate.com的调查显示，72%的银行客户表示，如果银行提高收费，他们将考虑换银行，去年这个比率是64%；帐户中至少有7万5000元的 高收入客户，是最可能换银行的人，他们中有82%的人表示，如果银行提高收费，他们将考虑换银行。 麦克布莱德说，消费者如果保持良好的金融习惯，仍旧能避免ATM收费和透支费，独立的免费支票帐户将继续萎缩，但大多数人仍有办法获得免费支票帐户，如设立直接入帐 ，或找到提供免费支票帐户的银行或信用合作社。
b76babed5d3854872d353f6ffa4c3b24a9692a0f.translatedText: Financial research company Bankate.com released its annual survey report on the 24th and said that in order to make up for the losses caused by tightening regulations, the banking industry has increased automatic teller machine (ATM) fees to record levels and reduced free checking accounts. Bankate.com said that this year, ATM charges have been raised for the eighth consecutive year, by 4%, to a record-breaking $2.50; the charge for using a competing bank's ATM has been increased by 11%, to $1.57, so for many customers, the charge for using a competing bank's ATM is $4.07, a record-breaking 7% increase. Banks have traditionally made up for it by letting their customers use ATMs for free and then charging customers for using interbank ATMs, but now that people are getting savvier and only use ATMs within the system, banks are trying to make up for their lost revenue. A Bankate.com analysis of 477 checking accounts at 247 banks and savings banks found that banks offer no-interest checking accounts with no fees for only 39% of customers, compared with 45% last year and a peak of 76% in 2009. The average monthly service fee for checking accounts also reached a record-breaking $5.48, up 25% from last year. McBride, an analyst at Bankate.com, said the banking industry's revenue has fallen due to tightening regulations, especially the government's 2010 restriction on bank overdraft fees and last year's reduction of swipe fees for consumers using charge cards, which led banks to reduce the number of free checking accounts. McBride said card fees and overdraft fees used to be a source of revenue to support free checking accounts, but now the banking industry is more selective about giving free checking accounts, often only to preferential customers, such as those with direct deposit. These measures have an impact on customer behavior. According to a Bankate.com survey, 72% of bank customers said they would consider changing banks if the bank raised fees. Last year, the rate was 64%. High-income customers with at least $75,000 in their accounts were the most likely to change banks. 82% of them said they would consider changing banks if banks raised fees. McBride said consumers can still avoid ATM fees and overdraft fees if they maintain good financial habits. Standalone free checking accounts will continue to shrink, but most people still have ways to get a free checking account, such as setting up direct deposit or finding a bank or credit union that offers a free checking account.

99d39b5b9156129afb607487fd6fdb6fde812792.sourceText: 奥巴马签署EB-5区域中心计划延长3年 奥巴马总统在9月30日签署了EB-5区域中心计划延长3年的法案，这一重新得到授权的法案9月13日在众议院以412票赞成3票反对获得了通过。 EB-5区域中心试点计划使得美国商业实体可以利用来自外国投资者的资金来为美国创造就业，如果外国投资者为合格的美国工人创造了10个就业机会，这些外国投资者以及他们的配偶和尚未年满21岁的未婚子女就可以获得绿卡。 在前所未有的这段经济危机时期内，EB-5计划为美国创造了42000个工作岗位，2012财政年度，在没有耗费纳税人任何一分钱的情况下，为美国注入了超过了21亿美元的资金。 国会批准延长EB-5区域中心计划为帮助美国实现经济复苏迈出了重要的一步，EB-5计划不仅直接为经济复苏带来了急需的资金，而且可以降低全国的失业率，因为该计划要求每个投资者都必须为美国创造10个全职工作岗位。 EB-5计划由于美国企业融资的需求和外国投资者为他们自己和家庭寻求更大的机会，而变得日益普及起来。仅今年一年，就有超过4200名投资者参与到该计划的投资之中，而且主要投资都集中在区域中心。 如今，总统奥巴马批准了延长的EB-5区域中心试点计划，就能令这一受到两党国会议员普遍欢迎的计划，可以一直运行到2015年9月30日。EB-5区域中心计划之所以得到两党国会议员的青睐，是因 为他们都相信这是刺激经济的可行办法。国会以压倒性优势通过的该计划，可以为提振美国经济创造大量的就业新岗位。 2012年以来，在美国一共有200个区域中心得到了移民局的批准，其中100多个比较活跃。EB-5投资移民根据目前的移民法规定，投资人投资50万元（相当于320万人民币）或100万美元，创造10个全职就业机会，首期申请和获得有条件绿卡，之后两年，申请取消条件绿卡，成为持有永久绿卡，就可以等待成为美国公民。
99d39b5b9156129afb607487fd6fdb6fde812792.translatedText: Obama signed a 3-year extension of the EB-5 Regional Center Program. President Obama signed a bill extending the EB-5 Regional Center Program for three years on September 30. This reauthorization bill passed the House of Representatives on September 13 with a vote of 412 in favor and 3 against. The EB-5 Regional Center Pilot Program allows U.S. business entities to use capital from foreign investors to create U.S. jobs. If the foreign investors create 10 jobs for qualified U.S. workers, these foreign investors, their spouses and unmarried children who have not yet reached the age of 21 can obtain green cards. During this unprecedented period of economic crisis, the EB-5 program created 42,000 American jobs and injected more than $2.1 billion in fiscal year 2012 without costing taxpayers a penny. Congressional approval of the extension of the EB-5 Regional Center Program is an important step in helping the United States achieve economic recovery. The EB-5 Program not only directly brings much-needed funds to the economic recovery, but also can reduce the national unemployment rate, because the program requires each investor to create 10 full-time jobs in the United States. The EB-5 program has become increasingly popular as a result of U.S. business financing needs and foreign investors seeking greater opportunities for themselves and their families. This year alone, more than 4,200 investors have participated in the program, with major investments concentrated in regional centers. Now, President Obama has approved an extension of the EB-5 Regional Center Pilot Program, which will allow this program, which has been widely welcomed by members of Congress on both sides of the aisle, to run until September 30, 2015. The EB-5 regional center program is favored by members of Congress from both parties because they believe it is a viable way to stimulate the economy. The plan, passed overwhelmingly by Congress, can create a large number of new jobs to boost the U.S. economy. Since 2012, a total of 200 regional centers have been approved by the USCIS, of which more than 100 are active. According to the current immigration laws, EB-5 investment immigration requires investors to invest 500,000 yuan (equivalent to 3.2 million yuan) or 1 million US dollars to create 10 full-time employment opportunities. They can apply for and obtain a conditional green card in the first phase. After two years, they can apply to cancel the conditional green card and become a permanent green card holder, and then they can wait to become a U.S. citizen.

d7f051a5d6c03e6e6e1e0bdb1a897ecd5ba77686.sourceText: 习近平对云南省昭通地震作出重要指示：要求当前把救人放在第一位，全力投入抗震救灾，妥善做好群众安置工作。
d7f051a5d6c03e6e6e1e0bdb1a897ecd5ba77686.translatedText: Xi Jinping issued important instructions regarding the earthquake in Zhaotong, Yunnan Province: He requested that saving lives be given top priority, that all efforts should be devoted to earthquake relief, and that people should be resettled properly.

e64947b86b20b1d609fad85daff8fda257572936.sourceText: 根据李克强总理批示要求，国家减灾委、民政部紧急启动国家救灾应急响应，国家减灾委秘书长、民政部副部长姜力率发展改革委、财政部、民政部、国 土资源部、住房城乡建设部、交通运输部、卫生计生委、地震局等8部门组成的国家减灾委、国务院抗震救灾指挥部联合工作组赶赴地震灾区查看灾情，协助指导地 方开展抗震救灾工作。
e64947b86b20b1d609fad85daff8fda257572936.translatedText: In accordance with the instructions of Prime Minister Li Keqiang, the National Disaster Reduction Commission and the Ministry of Civil Affairs urgently launched the national disaster relief emergency response. Jiang Li, Secretary-General of the National Disaster Reduction Commission and Vice Minister of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, led a joint working group of the National Disaster Reduction Commission and the State Council Earthquake Relief Command, composed of 8 departments including the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the Ministry of Land and Resources, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Transport, the Health and Family Planning Commission, and the Earthquake Administration, to rush to the earthquake-stricken areas to inspect the disaster situation and assist in guiding the local authorities. to carry out earthquake relief work.

d9b13c748d13a5d3f15c0dab1306fd9ca9eee700.translatedText: 12-year-old Arizona boy dies while hiking in 101-degree temperatures According to a CBS report on July 23,...

1be06620e9603e79ecee321c257a7fe9f70daf96.sourceText: 据哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS）7月23日报导，凤凰城警方表示，周五（7月22日）下午，这名12岁男孩和一个成年男子一起，在凤凰城沙漠植物园（Sonoran Desert Preserve）徒步旅行，途中男孩病倒。
1be06620e9603e79ecee321c257a7fe9f70daf96.translatedText: According to a CBS report on July 23, Phoenix police said that on the afternoon of Friday (July 22), the 12-year-old boy was hiking with an adult man in the Sonoran Desert Preserve in Phoenix when the boy fell ill.

243938e995113b93c759b383eb5e209ba6af5d6b.sourceText: 警方已经确定这名男孩是科迪‧富勒姆（Cody Flom），当时男孩在徒步旅行时，身上背着两升的水。
243938e995113b93c759b383eb5e209ba6af5d6b.translatedText: Police have identified the boy as Cody Flom, who was hiking with two liters of water on his back.

105e887a12f92af9a47cad3d088621a211c309c0.sourceText: 男孩在途中病倒后，同行男子试图把男孩带离旅行步道，但没有成功。这名男子便想用手机致电911求救，但手机没有信号。最后，他不得不把男孩留在那里，自己跑去寻求帮助。
105e887a12f92af9a47cad3d088621a211c309c0.translatedText: After the boy fell ill on the way, the man traveling with him tried to take the boy away from the travel trail, but failed. The man tried to use his cell phone to call 911 for help, but his cell phone had no signal. Finally, he had to leave the boy there and run to get help.

324ba6aba63d0fae643bd9fd29ccbb0ce5ad3b82.sourceText: 消防队员接到报告后赶到现场，男孩当时情况万分危急，立即被空运到凤凰城。
324ba6aba63d0fae643bd9fd29ccbb0ce5ad3b82.translatedText: Firefighters rushed to the scene after receiving the report. The boy was in critical condition and was immediately airlifted to Phoenix.

f45b6da5605472accfbce1f3ad2a6e14028c0734.sourceText: 男孩后来被宣布死亡，据悉死因是极端气温导致。
f45b6da5605472accfbce1f3ad2a6e14028c0734.translatedText: The boy was later pronounced dead, with the cause believed to be caused by extreme temperatures.

99be80bc9b2fb3ec078507f5e0673200366b7e93.sourceText: 目前，警方已经开始在这两个人徒步旅行的地区进行调查。
99be80bc9b2fb3ec078507f5e0673200366b7e93.translatedText: Currently, the police have begun investigations in the area where the two men were hiking.

e2678f0b9a982aba568dbfcfe37302acd037977f.sourceText: 据美国国家气象局消息，凤凰城在22日上午10时气温达到100华氏度，下午5点30分高达112华氏度（44.4摄氏度）。
e2678f0b9a982aba568dbfcfe37302acd037977f.translatedText: According to the National Weather Service, the temperature in Phoenix reached 100 degrees Fahrenheit at 10 a.m. on the 22nd, and reached 112 degrees Fahrenheit (44.4 degrees Celsius) at 5:30 p.m.

6da2dd313df81ae5effc235c33046a422dac5fc1.sourceText: 今年夏天以来，亚利桑那州已经发生几起因天气炎热致死的案例，这名男孩的死亡是最新的一起。6月下旬，亚利桑那州遭受热浪天气，造成当地至少有4人中暑身亡。其中一名25岁男性在凤凰城附近的皮纳尔县行山时，在高温中丧生。翌日，再有1名28岁女子与友人行山时，即使大量饮水，仍抵不住热浪煎熬而死亡。
6da2dd313df81ae5effc235c33046a422dac5fc1.translatedText: This boy's death is the latest of several deaths caused by hot weather in Arizona since this summer. In late June, Arizona suffered a heat wave, causing at least four people to die from heat stroke there. One of the men, a 25-year-old man, died in the heat while hiking in Pinal County near Phoenix. The next day, another 28-year-old woman was hiking with her friends. Even though she drank a lot of water, she could not withstand the heat wave and died.

As in previous years, the Asian community received announcements and congratulatory messages from the governor. In this year's "Asian Pacific Heritage Month", we hope that the state government can take practical actions to support the Asian community.

b1063686e2c4ed75b06c0a530563d827d655e09a.sourceText: 4月9日由亚裔企业家领导协会（Asian Corporate & Enrepreneur Leaders）牵头组织亚裔社区近百个社团联名上书，恳请州长在亚利桑那州出台政策，优先处理针对亚裔的仇恨犯罪，并拨出资金，建立亚裔语言热线等方式，促进亚裔社区民情的沟通。百名社团联名给州长信已经发出近一个月，还未听到州长的正式回复，希望在“亚太传统月”中，看到更实质的政策和措施出台。
b1063686e2c4ed75b06c0a530563d827d655e09a.translatedText: On April 9, Asian Corporate & Enrepreneur Leaders led nearly a hundred associations in the Asian community to jointly submit a letter, imploring the governor to introduce policies in Arizona to prioritize hate crimes against Asians, and allocate funds to establish Asian language hotlines and other methods to promote communication among Asian communities. It has been nearly a month since a letter signed by hundreds of associations to the governor was sent, but we have yet to hear a formal reply from the governor. We hope to see more substantial policies and measures introduced during "Asian Pacific Heritage Month".

1ea7fb461f8e1fd6100c53c8158a963bedaec3b0.sourceText: 亚利桑那华人历史协会：张肇鸿
1ea7fb461f8e1fd6100c53c8158a963bedaec3b0.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association: Zhang Zhaohong

34f54c560f54074fa683e83df5139a30964fdbf6.sourceText: 关崇琮参加第一次世界大战后，回中国把妻子带回美国。他们两夫妻数十年来胼手扺足创业，并育有十一个儿女。当时，人丁兴旺就是发家的本钱。关家经过了几十年的努力，家族壮大，事业有成，成为了亚利桑那华人社区的一个名门望族，并在主流社会上为华人争光不少。
34f54c560f54074fa683e83df5139a30964fdbf6.translatedText: After Guan Chongcong participated in the First World War, he returned to China and brought his wife back to the United States. The couple has been working hard to start a business for decades and has eleven children. At that time, a prosperous population was the capital for making a fortune. After decades of hard work, the Guan family has grown stronger and has a successful career. It has become a prominent family in the Arizona Chinese community and has won a lot of glory for the Chinese in mainstream society.

a66b2c284cd8d085b2ffbca62d85288ffcea22b5.sourceText: 但是，在排华年代，美国社会歧视华人。有些成功的华人商家去世，美国媒体上报导的往往不是逝者的名字，而是用他经营的商号来代替，因为美国人并不在乎华人的姓名。
a66b2c284cd8d085b2ffbca62d85288ffcea22b5.translatedText: However, in the era of Chinese exclusion, American society discriminated against Chinese people. When some successful Chinese businessmen die, the American media often reports not the name of the deceased, but the business name he ran instead, because Americans do not care about the names of Chinese people.

74c612a0e271476dd90cb77f268b4d4bf6010052.sourceText: 只有很少的华人被主流注意到，并留下了文字的纪录。关崇琼家族就是其中的少数之一。我们把这些碎片的文字和相片等经过搜集和整理，使人看到那个时代的华人风貌。
74c612a0e271476dd90cb77f268b4d4bf6010052.translatedText: Only a few Chinese people have been noticed by the mainstream and have left written records. The Guan Chongqiong family is one of the few. We have collected and organized these fragmentary texts and photos to allow people to see the Chinese style of that era.

d615dd03e53544a6ac89902e46697f7e5372f311.sourceText: 在一份1936年报纸上的文章，有关家大女儿关秀容在教堂上举办婚礼的一篇報导。
d615dd03e53544a6ac89902e46697f7e5372f311.translatedText: A 1936 newspaper article about the wedding of the family’s eldest daughter Guan Xiurong in a church.

fa389df8e7f123ac9f8055d82e07e2ae24aaacbd.sourceText: 关秀容是关崇琼在中囯出生的女儿。第一次世界大战结束后，关崇琼回广东老家开平，把妻子和这个6岁的长女带回到凤凰城。由于父母的儿女众多，作为大家姐的关秀容，尽力地照顾好弟妹们，分担着这个大家庭的重担。
fa389df8e7f123ac9f8055d82e07e2ae24aaacbd.translatedText: >Guan Xiurong is the daughter of Guan Chongqiong who was born in China. After the end of World War I, Guan Chongqiong returned to his hometown in Kaiping, Guangdong, and brought his wife and his 6-year-old eldest daughter back to Phoenix. Since her parents have many children, Guan Xiurong, as the eldest sister, does her best to take good care of her younger siblings and share the burden of this big family.

baa1b76c4549d61e188be5b160250df46fc5c917.sourceText: 作为一个华人社区的望族，关崇琼比其他华人家庭更快地融入到美国的社会，他很早就已经把家人带入到当地的教会，成为了凤凰城第一长老教会的成员。
baa1b76c4549d61e188be5b160250df46fc5c917.translatedText: As a prominent member of the Chinese community, Guan Chongqiong integrated into American society faster than other Chinese families. He had already brought his family into the local church very early and became a member of the First Presbyterian Church in Phoenix.

4a18a03fab9754d950d1a6fefac99c861ca37830.sourceText: 1936年，23岁的关秀容在教堂举办婚礼，接受五百名嘉宾的祝福。本地主流媒体以 “First Chinese Wedding In Church Here To Take Place This Morning” 为题目，详细地报道了这次婚礼。
4a18a03fab9754d950d1a6fefac99c861ca37830.translatedText: In 1936, 23-year-old Guan Xiurong held a wedding in the church and accepted the blessings of 500 guests. The local mainstream media reported the wedding in detail with the title “First Chinese Wedding In Church Here To Take Place This Morning”.

bfca244cf7fc7ab9b99948aba905290de9fe5e3c.sourceText: 关秀容是弟妹们敬重的大家姐，在23岁时，她远嫁到美国东部芝加哥的李家，从此以后相夫教子，直到2012年才去世，那年她99岁。
bfca244cf7fc7ab9b99948aba905290de9fe5e3c.translatedText: > Guan Xiurong is the eldest sister respected by her younger brothers and sisters. At the age of 23, she married to the Li family in Chicago, eastern United States. From then on, she raised her husband and raised her children until her death in 2012, when she was 99 years old.

437cf3fe9cc60a054609de7e1cbac76c481a5a63.sourceText: 儿女成群意味着生活的担子更重，关崇琼吃苦耐劳，坚韌和有发展眼光。 1940年，关崇琼在自己购买的土地上建起了商铺出租。他也有了自己新的商铺”TOY’S MARKET”。
437cf3fe9cc60a054609de7e1cbac76c481a5a63.translatedText: Having children in groups means a heavier burden in life. Guan Chongqiong is hard-working, tenacious and has a vision for development. In 1940, Guan Chongqiong built a shop on the land he purchased and rented it out. He also has his own new store "TOY’S MARKET".

0bd39d4c99f050ec9203085c72f4aa21bd89df03.sourceText: 当年，华人杂货铺大多数开在凤凰城南边的区域，而关氏市场座落在北边，那时的驼峰路和16大街已经是繁华的地段，关氏市场成为了早期最旺的华人商场。
0bd39d4c99f050ec9203085c72f4aa21bd89df03.translatedText: Back then, most Chinese grocery stores opened in the southern area of ​​Phoenix City, while Guan's Market was located in the north. At that time, Tuofeng Road and 16th Street were already prosperous areas, and Guan's Market became the most prosperous Chinese shopping mall in the early days.

522f82c1e1709da6bf6f303a59710efff8d2fb13.sourceText: Toy’s Market经营各类日用什货，出售新鲜水果和蔬菜和冷饮，商铺的门窗上贴满了各种广告，关崇琼用卖座的“冰淇淋”来做作广告。这是凤凰城华人商家目前能找到的最早的广告：
522f82c1e1709da6bf6f303a59710efff8d2fb13.translatedText: >Toy’s Market sells all kinds of daily necessities, selling fresh fruits, vegetables and cold drinks. The doors and windows of the shop are covered with various advertisements. Guan Chongqiong uses the popular “ice cream” as an advertisement. This is the earliest advertisement that can be found for a Chinese merchant in Phoenix:

0c9bfa15d3633a80feed803d932fcc415c0c74f9.sourceText: “祝贺我们1940年的新店开張！这是有一流的产品的Toy’s 杂货市场！请尝试的双重丰富的冰淇淋！这是在我们自己卫生工厂制造的，时刻提供冰淇淋派对的服务，我们的设备制造所有的口味。冰淇淋每 PINT是15美分 ，每QUART 是25 美分。免费送外卖！”
0c9bfa15d3633a80feed803d932fcc415c0c74f9.translatedText: "Congratulations on the opening of our new store in 1940! This is Toy's Grocery Market with first-class products! Please try the double rich ice cream! It is made in our own sanitary factory, always available for ice cream parties, and our equipment makes all flavors. Ice cream is 15 cents per pin and 25 per quart. cents. Free food delivery! "

520021bba14965cd27ccd049d8d4f4afc375634d.sourceText: 正當关家事业向前发展的时候，第二次世界大战爆发了！
520021bba14965cd27ccd049d8d4f4afc375634d.translatedText: Just as the Guan family's career was moving forward, World War II broke out!

e55b7619cdcdb46e6753aac17e9acd09215d971d.sourceText: 1941年12月7日，日本偷袭珍珠港！“天皇诏书”对英、美宣战，同一天，英、美对日宣战。
e55b7619cdcdb46e6753aac17e9acd09215d971d.translatedText: On December 7, 1941, Japan attacked Pearl Harbor! The "Edict of the Emperor" declared war on Britain and the United States. On the same day, Britain and the United States declared war on Japan.

0d35fb90778c72278c780a9572daf795be5b8531.sourceText: 当时停泊在珍珠港的“亚利桑那号”战列舰，被轮翻轰炸中沉没，1177名将士遇难。直至如今，残骸中仍然有1102具阵亡将士的遗体。
0d35fb90778c72278c780a9572daf795be5b8531.translatedText: The USS Arizona battleship anchored in Pearl Harbor was sunk by a rollover bombing, killing 1,177 sailors. To this day, there are still 1,102 remains of fallen soldiers in the wreckage.

4a718cd1a2cc9bae763f12ef154fea7cba0f110e.sourceText: 为了纪念阵亡的官兵，1962年在原战列舰残骸的上方建成纪念馆，“亚利桑那号”上两具19,585磅重的铁锚也被打捞上岸。一具被安置在夏威夷欧胡岛上的珍珠港，而另一具则安置在亚利桑那州的首府凤凰城。“亚利桑那号”沉没时，船上载有150万加仑燃油，约50万加仑燃油没有引爆，至今仍缓慢泄漏，渗出的燃油被称为“亚利桑那号之泪”。
4a718cd1a2cc9bae763f12ef154fea7cba0f110e.translatedText: In order to commemorate the fallen officers and soldiers, a memorial hall was built above the wreckage of the original battleship in 1962, and the two 19,585-pound anchors on the "Arizona" were also salvaged ashore. One was placed in Pearl Harbor on the Hawaiian island of Oahu, while the other was placed in Phoenix, the capital of Arizona. When the Arizona sank, it was carrying 1.5 million gallons of fuel. About 500,000 gallons of fuel did not detonate and are still slowly leaking. The seeping fuel is known as the "Tear of the Arizona."

22ffaf5ae7284c1b47353eda043438741c1c8e38.sourceText: 当年在凤凰城，人口有六万五千四百人，而华人仅有四百三十一人(成人或限户主)。在二次世界大战期间，七十多位华裔弟子应徵服役，他们勇赴欧洲战场，太平洋战场和中国战场，其中有五位军人在浴血奋战中牺牲。6位华裔弟子回到祖国抗日前线，和中国军民共同打击日寇。
22ffaf5ae7284c1b47353eda043438741c1c8e38.translatedText: In Phoenix at that time, the population was 65,400, but there were only 431 Chinese (adults or heads of households only). During World War II, more than 70 Chinese disciples were drafted to serve in the European battlefield, the Pacific battlefield and the Chinese battlefield. Five of them died in bloody battles. Six Chinese disciples returned to the anti-Japanese front line of their motherland and worked with the Chinese military and civilians to fight against the Japanese invaders.

b5d2d2d2febebbc11fa0a13646cd9995903e9ccc.sourceText: 当时，关家的大儿子关卫理(William Kwan Toy) 已经成年，他应征入伍。两年之后，关家三儿子关护理（Gray Kwan Toy），也从军入伍，保家卫国。（待续）
b5d2d2d2febebbc11fa0a13646cd9995903e9ccc.translatedText: At that time, the eldest son of the Kwan family, William Kwan Toy, had reached adulthood and he enlisted in the army. Two years later, the third son of the Kwan family, Gray Kwan Toy, also joined the army to protect his family and country. (to be continued)

2596edbd226d47e43efb92fc11563a4f5bbf1c5a.sourceText: 目前亚利桑那州患病人数超过16.5万人，亚省面临更大新冠威胁。今日新型冠状病毒感染新增例2107人，新增死亡104人，总感染人数165934人，总死亡3408人! 检查总人数数据，目前超111.2万人，日检测数1.3万人…日检出率14.6%….感染率12.7%，新冠患者检出率突破10%。

Checking the total number of people, it currently exceeds 1.112 million, and the number of daily tests is 13,000...the daily detection rate is 14.6%...the infection rate is 12.7%, and the detection rate of new crown patients exceeds 10%.

3cc95efc282a847e00e01c684bd837adedb04f65.sourceText: 昨日数据新增1813人，新增死亡0人，总感染人数163827人，总死亡3304人! 住院病人激增，病床占有率从原来的70%多，增加到84%。以目前增量，医疗系统瘫痪指日可见。。。。大家能呆在家的尽量呆家。目前新冠开始在各个社区散发，卫生部敦促市民戴口罩，洗手，不到人群聚集地方，做好更多，更完善的安全隔离措施。
3cc95efc282a847e00e01c684bd837adedb04f65.translatedText: Yesterday's data showed 1,813 new cases, 0 new deaths, a total of 163,827 infections, and a total of 3,304 deaths!
