dcf1d9f49b4081e90f6d1bb5edd5765cae6205df.sourceText: 美国EB-5投资移民项目留学生也可申请 在看到美国国务院最近公布的排期进展情况和职业移民第二优先排期状况后，越来越多的中国大陆留学生在筹划通过EB-5的方式申请绿卡。美国EB-5投资移民区域中心项目延期3年至2015年9月，这一消息无疑给正在酝酿以参加EB-5投资移民区域中心项目而快速解决在美绿卡身份问题的中国大陆留学生带来希望。 美国EB-5投资移民区域中心项目延期3年至2015年9月。 这一消息无疑给正在酝酿以参加EB-5投资移民区域中心项目而快速解决在美绿卡身份问题的中国大陆留学生带来希望，特别是在看到美国国务院最近公布的排期进展情况和职业移民第二优先排期状况后，越来越多的中国大陆留学生在筹划通过EB-5的方式申请绿卡。加之今年H-1B名额很快告罄，更使许多即使找到工作也因为没有H-1B名额而不能就职的留学生萌生申请EB-5的想法。 EB-5投资移民根据目前的移民法规定，投资人投资50万或100万美元，创造10个全职就业机会，首期申请和获得有条件绿卡，之后两年，申请取消条件。 留学生通过EB-5申请绿卡在时间方面的要求比较高，因为如果留学生已经在美国持F-1身份，许多EB-5申请人需要在自己毕业前或OPT到期前，顺利获得EB-5有条件绿卡批准并递交I-485调整身份申请，以获得依附在I-485申请上的工作许可证，并持此工作许可证在美国工作，以此来避免没有H-1B名额之苦。 如果留学生在美国之外的地方，则需争取赶在明年8月底美国各大学开学之前获得移民签证，以便以绿卡身份入境按时到美国入学。这部分留学生中，除在中国的高中毕业生、大学毕业生外，还有一些以前到澳大利亚或其他国家留学的青年学生，现在希望转到美国继续高等教育。由于时间问题对于留学生EB-5申请人非常重要，所以，需要根据美国移民程序认真计算和规划。 那么，如何计算和规划EB-5申请时间和程序？下面用一个案例做介绍。 2012年3月，一位在美国持学生身份的EB-5申请人递交了I-526申请。该申请人参加一个EB-5区域中心项目，这个区域中心已经成功筹建和完成了10以上的EB5投资移民项目，而且做到了100% 有条件绿卡批准和100% 取消条件申请批准的好成绩。 根据律师的了解，处理EB-5投资移民的加州服务中心从来没有对这个区域中心的以往项目作出类似意图否决或否决的意见，而且参加这一区域中心项目的投资人，无论是有条件绿卡或者是取消条件申请，批准时间常大大快于移民局公布的正常审理时间。 2012年6月12日，移民局签发补充文件通知，要求EB-5申请人提供更多证据证明投资人资金进出帐和经济能力支持投资移民申请。 2012年8月24日，经过充分准备，申请人递交了对移民局补充文件的回复。 2012年8月30日，移民局批准了申请人的EB-5有条件绿卡申请。由于美国移民法没有允许EB-5投资移民申请人同时递交I-485，因此，申请人必须在获得I-526批准后才可以递交I-485调整身份的申请。当移民局收到该申请人的I-485 申请后，将在大约90天时间内签发工作许可证和旅行证。这样，该申请人就可以持工作许可证在美国工作，而不需要申请H-1B了。 综上所述，如果留学生已经在美国持有合法身份、在选择区域中心项目得当、项目不出现移民局所关注的问题前提下，大约需要6个月左右的时间递交I-485申请，大约9个月时间可以获得工作许可。 如果留学生人不在美国，则需要在6个月获得有条件绿卡申请批准后，再加上美国签证中心和美国驻中国领事馆的程序所需的时间。
dcf1d9f49b4081e90f6d1bb5edd5765cae6205df.translatedText: International students under the U.S. EB-5 investment immigration program can also apply. After seeing the recent progress of the US State Department’s scheduling and the second priority status of employment-based immigrants, more and more international students from mainland China are planning to apply for green cards through the EB-5 method. The U.S. EB-5 Investment Immigration Regional Center project has been extended for three years to September 2015. This news undoubtedly brings hope to mainland Chinese students who are planning to participate in the EB-5 Investment Immigration Regional Center project and quickly solve their green card status issues in the United States. The U.S. EB-5 Investment Immigration Regional Center project has been extended for three years to September 2015. This news undoubtedly brings hope to international students from mainland China who are planning to participate in the EB-5 Investment Immigration Regional Center project to quickly solve their green card status problems in the United States. Especially after seeing the scheduling progress recently announced by the U.S. Department of State and the second-priority scheduling status of employment-based immigrants, more and more international students from mainland China are planning to apply for green cards through EB-5. In addition, this year's H-1B quota is quickly exhausted, which has given rise to the idea of ​​applying for EB-5 for many international students who cannot find a job even if they find a job because there is no H-1B quota. According to the current immigration laws, EB-5 investment immigration requires investors to invest US$500,000 or US$1 million to create 10 full-time employment opportunities. They can apply for and obtain a conditional green card in the first phase, and then apply to cancel the conditions in the next two years. The time requirement for international students to apply for a green card through EB-5 is relatively high, because if the international student is already holding F-1 status in the United States, many EB-5 applicants need to successfully obtain EB-5 conditional green card approval and submit an I-485 adjustment of status application before they graduate or OPT expires, in order to obtain a work permit attached to the I-485 application and work in the United States with this work permit to avoid the pain of not having an H-1B quota. If international students are outside the United States, they need to obtain an immigrant visa before the start of American universities at the end of August next year so that they can enter the United States with green card status and enroll on time. Among this group of international students, in addition to high school graduates and college graduates in China, there are also some young students who previously studied in Australia or other countries and now hope to transfer to the United States to continue higher education. Since the time issue is very important for international student EB-5 applicants, careful calculation and planning are required according to the U.S. immigration procedures. So, how to calculate and plan the EB-5 application time and procedures? A case is used as an introduction below. In March 2012, an EB-5 applicant with student status in the United States submitted an I-526 application. The applicant participated in an EB-5 regional center project. This regional center has successfully prepared and completed more than 10 EB5 investment immigration projects, and achieved 100% conditional green card approval and 100% conditional application approval. According to the lawyer’s understanding, the California Service Center, which handles EB-5 investment immigration, has never issued a similar intention to deny or reject previous projects of this regional center. Moreover, investors who participate in this regional center project, whether they are conditional green cards or conditional cancellation applications, often have approval times much faster than the normal processing time announced by the Immigration Bureau. On June 12, 2012, the Immigration Bureau issued a supplementary document notice, requiring EB-5 applicants to provide more evidence to prove the investor’s capital inflow and outflow and financial ability to support the investment immigration application. On August 24, 2012, after thorough preparation, the applicant submitted a response to the Immigration Bureau’s supplementary documents. On August 30, 2012, the USCIS approved the applicant’s EB-5 conditional green card application. Since U.S. immigration law does not allow EB-5 investment immigration applicants to submit I-485 at the same time, applicants must obtain I-526 approval before submitting I-485 application for adjustment of status. When USCIS receives the applicant's I-485 petition, it will issue a work permit and travel permit within approximately 90 days. In this way, the applicant can work in the United States with a work permit without applying for H-1B. To sum up, if an international student already holds legal status in the United States, chooses a regional center project properly, and the project does not raise any issues of concern to the Immigration Bureau, it will take about 6 months to submit the I-485 application and about 9 months to obtain a work permit. If the international student is not in the United States, it will take 6 months after the conditional green card application is approved, plus the time required for the procedures at the U.S. Visa Center and the U.S. Consulate in China.

a897d8d3ff814133f83bf7ccf82b5f92f55f18ec.sourceText: H-1B签证或涨价遭外包公司批评 《华盛顿邮报》称，参议院移民草案中新增加了一条工作签证费提案，将使依赖于外国籍员工的公司，如埃森哲（Accenture）、Infosys、塔塔咨询服务公司（Tata Consultancy Services）等，为加强边境控制而买单。 彭博社收集的数据显示，这一举措将使公司雇用外国熟练工的H-1B签证费用增加一倍，达到4,825美元，也将把目前每年8.5万份的签证限额增加至18万份。 该条文尤其针对的是那些有50%的员工为H-1B或L-1签证持有者的外包公司，包括位于孟买的TCS和Wipro软件公司。在2015年，那些公司将为每份签证多支付1万美元的费用。 南卡罗来纳州参议员格雷厄姆（Lindsey Graham）说，”这一改变意味着雇用海外员工的综合费用才是公司的真正问题”。 参议院司法委员会（Senate Judiciary Committee）在5月21日通过了这项立法。法案内容增加了加强边境安全措施，这将通过实施H-1B签证和入籍申请的新费用来支付。这些资金将被放入一项信托基金，帮助购买监控美墨边境的无人驾驶飞机，建立更多安全围栏，并雇用更多执法人员。 草案中新增的这一部份主要是为了达到共和党议员们的要求，他们希望任何移民立法均包括了使非法移民更难进入美国的措施。法案中也为美国境内约1,100万非法移民提供了成为公民的途径。 外包公司纷纷批评这种提高费用的做法。新泽西Cognizant技术解决方案公司（Cognizant Technology Solutions）向摩根大通（JPMorgan Chase）、美国银行（Bank of America）和花旗集团（Citigroup）提供了办公室后台支持和其它服务。公司说，如果法案成真，他们的业务将受到威胁。 据美国公民及移民服务局（U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services）数据，在9月30日结束的财政年度中，Cognizant是H-1B签证的第一名赞助人，他们共获得了9,336份新签证。公司拒绝透露在美国公司的H-1B签证持有员工数量。 根据参议院的建议收费结构，位于都柏林的埃森哲公司将为2012财政年度的H-1B 签证增加1,010万美元的费用。埃森哲女发言人乔安 佐丹奴（Joanne Giordano）拒绝作出评论。 如果参议院通过这一提案，位于印度的外包公司，包括Infosys、塔塔谘询服务和Wipro，所支付的签证费用可能会上涨3.5倍。 TCS在2012年获得了7,427份签证，为引进同等数量的外国科技术员工，他们将每年支付8,910万美元的费用。Infosys将额外支付6,750万美元，Wipro也将额外支付5,170万美元。 美国国际化人才议会（American Council on International Personnel）说，这些费用中还不包括更新现有签证的成本和每位员工1,000 至3,000美元的法律费用。 如果公司在申请H-1B或L-1签证时歪曲事实，该法案将对他们每次违法处以１万美元的罚款。 2013年第一季度美国计算机和数学职业的失业率为3.5％，远低于7.7％的平均失业率。这两大职业主导了H-1B签证份额。 一些美国公司支持提高费用。在2012年9月公布的一份声明中，总部位于华盛顿州雷蒙德市(Redmond)的微软公司提出了为额外的H1-B签证支付每份１万美元费用的建议。 司法委员会同意建立一项基金，那些赞助外国员工申请永久居民的公司，多收1,000美元用以鼓励加强科学和技术教育。 参议院多数党领袖里德（Harry M. Reid）说，他希望下月在他的议院中讨论这一立法。如果参议院通过法案，它将面临来自一些众议院共和党人对非法移民变合法的反对声浪。
a897d8d3ff814133f83bf7ccf82b5f92f55f18ec.translatedText: H-1B visas may increase in price and are criticized by outsourcing companies. The Washington Post stated that a new work visa fee proposal was added to the Senate immigration bill, which will make companies that rely on foreign employees, such as Accenture, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, etc., pay for strengthened border controls. The move would double the cost of H-1B visas for companies hiring skilled foreign workers to $4,825, and would also increase the current annual visa limit of 85,000 to 180,000, according to data compiled by Bloomberg. The provision specifically targets outsourcing companies where 50% of their employees are H-1B or L-1 visa holders, including Mumbai-based software companies TCS and Wipro. In 2015, those companies will pay $10,000 more per visa. "This change means that the combined cost of hiring overseas workers is the real issue for companies," said South Carolina Senator Lindsey Graham. The Senate Judiciary Committee passed the legislation on May 21. The bill adds enhanced border security measures that would be paid for by implementing new fees for H-1B visas and naturalization applications. The money will be put into a trust fund to help buy drones to monitor the U.S.-Mexico border, build more security fencing and hire more law enforcement officers. The new section was added to the bill to satisfy Republican lawmakers who want any immigration legislation to include measures to make it more difficult for illegal immigrants to enter the United States. The bill also provides a path to citizenship for the approximately 11 million illegal immigrants in the United States. Outsourcing companies have criticized this practice of raising fees. New Jersey-based Cognizant Technology Solutions provides back-office support and other services to JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America and Citigroup. Companies say their businesses would be threatened if the bill goes through. Cognizant was the No. 1 sponsor of H-1B visas in the fiscal year that ended Sept. 30, with 9,336 new visas granted, according to U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services. The company declined to disclose the number of H-1B visa holders employed at U.S. companies. Dublin-based Accenture will increase fees for H-1B visas by $10.1 million in fiscal year 2012 under the Senate's proposed fee structure. Accenture spokeswoman Joanne Giordano declined to comment. If the Senate passes the proposal, the visa fees paid by outsourcing companies in India, including Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services and Wipro, may increase by 3.5 times. TCS received 7,427 visas in 2012 and will pay $89.1 million annually to bring in the same number of foreign tech workers. Infosys will pay an additional $67.5 million and Wipro will pay an additional $51.7 million. The fees do not include the cost of renewing existing visas and legal fees of $1,000 to $3,000 per employee, the American Council on International Personnel said. The bill would fine companies $10,000 per violation if they misrepresented facts when applying for H-1B or L-1 visas. The U.S. unemployment rate for computer and mathematics occupations in the first quarter of 2013 was 3.5%, well below the average unemployment rate of 7.7%. These two major occupations dominate the share of H-1B visas. Some U.S. companies support raising fees. In a statement released in September 2012, Redmond, Washington-based Microsoft proposed paying $10,000 each for additional H1-B visas. The Judiciary Committee agreed to create a fund that would give companies that sponsor foreign workers their applications for permanent residence an extra $1,000 to encourage science and technology education. Senate Majority Leader Harry M. Reid said he hopes to take up the legislation in his chamber next month. If the Senate passes the bill, it will face opposition from some House Republicans to legalizing illegal immigration.

ddb6150a63a59dbfc639bad76a2c1834334fa5d7.sourceText: EB-5计划渐成赚钱手段 联邦严查投资移民（图） 一项移民计划目前正受到2个联邦部门的调查。该移民计划允许富有的外国人及其他们的家人通过支付高昂的费用而成为美国公民。 国土安全部和证券交易委员会正在对一项叫做EB-5的”投资人签证项目”进行审查。负责该项目的是公民和移民事务局(USCIS) ，这是国土安全部负责签证发放的部门。 通过该计划已经得到了至少23亿美元，这些钱被用于美国各地数百个建设项目，其中包括在佛蒙特的一个滑雪度假地到加州的一条商业街。 但某些这样的开发项目现在已经破产或因为指称的欺诈而陷入法律纠纷，从而使人们对该移民事务部门有效监控该计划的能力提出了质疑。这些担忧也引起了联邦机构的注意。 根据EB-5计划，在美国的及在海外的外国人必须要投资至少50万美元才能获得一个临时性的签证。如果他们的投资能够在2年后创造10个就业机会，投资人及他们的家人将能申请永久居民的身份，并最终可成为美国公民。如果无法做到这点的话，他们可能会被递解出境。到目前为止，大多数投资人都不能确保是否会得到其投资额的偿还。 这项计划是在22年前推出的。移民事务当局自那时起已经批准发放了12904个投资移民签证。这项投资已经创造了约46810个就业机会。 这一曾经不为人知的计划现在成为一项赚钱的行当，因为美国的经济衰退导致了建筑业资金的匮乏。开发商和移民律师们已经将他们的目光投向了中国和其它遥远的国度。 自2008财年开始以来，申请该类签证的外国人的总人数已经达到12201人。
ddb6150a63a59dbfc639bad76a2c1834334fa5d7.translatedText: >The EB-5 program has gradually become a means of making money. The federal government is strictly investigating investment immigration (picture). An immigration program is currently under investigation by two federal departments. This immigration program allows wealthy foreigners and their families to become U.S. citizens by paying a hefty fee. The Department of Homeland Security and the Securities and Exchange Commission are reviewing an investor visa program called EB-5. Responsible for the program is the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS), the visa-issuing arm of the Department of Homeland Security. At least $2.3 billion has been raised through the program, which has been used for hundreds of construction projects across the United States, from a ski resort in Vermont to a strip mall in California. But some such developments are now bankrupt or in legal trouble over alleged fraud, raising questions about the immigration service's ability to effectively monitor the scheme. These concerns have also drawn the attention of federal agencies. Under the EB-5 program, foreigners in the United States and abroad must invest at least $500,000 to obtain a temporary visa. If their investment creates 10 jobs after two years, the investors and their families will be able to apply for permanent resident status and eventually become U.S. citizens. If they are unable to do this, they may be deported. Until now, most investors had no assurance that their investments would be repaid. This scheme was launched 22 years ago. Immigration authorities have since approved the issuance of 12,904 investment immigrant visas. This investment has created approximately 46,810 jobs. What was once a little-known program is now a lucrative business as the U.S. recession leaves the construction industry starved of money. Developers and immigration lawyers have set their sights on China and other far-flung lands. Since the beginning of fiscal year 2008, the total number of foreigners applying for this type of visa has reached 12,201.

bc284e8ba345009583f6a5dee08956a039589c4c.sourceText: 云南鲁甸6.5级地震：超过400人逝去 全国紧急驰援 据国家地震台网官方微博消息称，截至5日14时30分，云南鲁甸地震共造成410人死亡，2373人受伤。 据中新网报道 中国西南，地震后的鲁甸县城，阴雨不断。 24小时前，这里发生了云南省14年来最大的一次地震。 大灾面前，人命关天。把救人放在第一位棗这是中国官方和民间的一致呼声。以震中为目标，分秒必争，中国各方力量全力驰援灾区。 然而，血站告急、交通阻梗、物资短缺、滑坡落石、滂沱大雨以及余震不断厖24小时过后，灾区救援依旧困境重重。 强震：云南14年来最强震 余震已四百余次 北京时间8月3日16时30分许，云南省昭通市鲁甸县境内发生6.5级地震，造成重大人员伤亡。截至4日14时，地震已造成398人死亡、1801人受伤。 满目疮痍的大地，生离死别的痛哭。在汶川地震过去6年，芦山地震过去1年后，云南鲁甸，这个位于中国西南的小县城引来全世界关注，?#22823;地震?#20063;再度成为中国社会的紧急动员令。 通讯中断、通往震中道路阻断，震区街头随处可听见痛哭声，震中龙头山镇几被夷为平地，数百人死亡千余人流离失所厖震后不久，从灾区传来的消息渐渐让外界意识到此次地震的巨大危害，舆论也开始疑惑：为何震级不太高，伤亡却如此严重？ 此次地震的震中位于鲁甸县龙头山镇，处于昭通棗鲁甸断裂带，震区200公里范围内历史上有5级以上地震记录44次，2013年震区100公里范围内发生3次5级以上地震。可以说，发生地震的鲁甸处于地震高发区，但这次6.5级地震却是云南省14年来最大一次地震。
bc284e8ba345009583f6a5dee08956a039589c4c.translatedText: A magnitude 6.5 earthquake in Ludian, Yunnan: more than 400 people died and a nationwide emergency rescue was rushed. According to the official Weibo of the National Seismological Network, as of 14:30 on the 5th, the Ludian earthquake in Yunnan caused a total of 410 deaths and 2,373 injuries. According to China News Service, in southwest China, it rained continuously in Ludian County after the earthquake. 24 hours ago, the largest earthquake in Yunnan Province in 14 years occurred here. In the face of a major disaster, human life is at stake. Putting saving lives first is the unanimous voice of Chinese officials and people. With the epicenter as the target, every second counts, and all forces in China are going all out to assist the disaster area. However, 24 hours after the blood bank emergency, traffic congestion, material shortages, landslides and rockfalls, torrential rain and aftershocks continued, the rescue in the disaster area was still faced with difficulties. Strong earthquake: The strongest earthquake in Yunnan in 14 years, with more than 400 aftershocks. At about 16:30 on August 3, Beijing time, a magnitude 6.5 earthquake occurred in Ludian County, Zhaotong City, Yunnan Province, causing heavy casualties. As of 14:00 on the 4th, the earthquake had killed 398 people and injured 1,801 people. The devastated earth, weeping bitterly at separation and death. Six years after the Wenchuan earthquake and one year after the Lushan earthquake, Ludian, Yunnan, a small county in southwest China, has attracted worldwide attention. The earthquake has once again become an emergency mobilization order for Chinese society. Communications were interrupted, roads leading to the epicenter were blocked, and cries of pain could be heard everywhere in the streets of the earthquake area. Longtoushan Town, the epicenter of the earthquake, was almost razed to the ground, and hundreds of people died and more than a thousand people were displaced. Shortly after the earthquake, news from the disaster area gradually made the outside world aware of the huge harm of the earthquake. Public opinion also began to wonder: Why are the casualties so serious despite the low magnitude? The epicenter of this earthquake is located in Longtoushan Town, Ludian County, in the Zhaotong-Zaoludian Fault Zone. There have been 44 recorded earthquakes of magnitude 5 or above within 200 kilometers of the earthquake area. In 2013, three earthquakes of magnitude 5 or above occurred within 100 kilometers of the earthquake area. It can be said that Ludian, where the earthquake occurred, is in a high-risk earthquake area, but this 6.5-magnitude earthquake was the largest earthquake in Yunnan Province in 14 years.

7b786897c130ecb5b52ba66b5ee7e629f629549b.sourceText: 美5月房价上涨12.2% 6年最高 根据周二公布的房价指数表现现实，全美5月份房价较去年同比上涨12.2%，达2006年3月份来最大涨幅。 同时，标普希勒房价指数对全美20个大城市所作的房价指数调查也显示，全美5月份房价较4月份环比上涨2.4%，也逼近历史高点。 在20个城市中，达拉斯和丹佛的房价涨幅达2000年以来最高纪录。 房价上涨的得益于房产市场供不应求，民众工资稳定上升，且房贷率达到历史低点。 房价上涨对于促进房市健康发展和经济复苏都益处良多，能够让更多卖价参与房市中，并且刺激消费。 房贷利率从5月初开始上涨，30年固定房贷利率自5月初至6月底已上涨至4.51%，达两年来最大值。 自美联储主席伯南克讲话称将于今年下半年放慢购买债券速度后，房贷利率就开始一路飙升。美联储债券购买计划使得长期利率能够维持于低点，鼓励更多的借贷和支出。
7b786897c130ecb5b52ba66b5ee7e629f629549b.translatedText: U.S. house prices rose 12.2% in May, the highest in 6 years. According to the housing price index released on Tuesday, U.S. housing prices rose 12.2% year-on-year in May, the largest increase since March 2006. At the same time, the S&P Shiller House Price Index's house price index survey of 20 major cities in the United States also showed that house prices in the United States increased by 2.4% in May compared with April, which is also close to historical highs. Among the 20 cities, Dallas and Denver saw their highest home price gains since 2000. The rise in housing prices is due to the housing market being in short supply, wages rising steadily, and mortgage rates reaching historical lows. Rising house prices are of great benefit to promoting the healthy development of the housing market and economic recovery, allowing more sales prices to participate in the housing market and stimulating consumption. Mortgage interest rates began to rise in early May, and the 30-year fixed mortgage interest rate rose to 4.51% from the beginning of May to the end of June, reaching the highest level in two years. Mortgage interest rates have soared since Federal Reserve Chairman Ben Bernanke said he would slow down bond purchases in the second half of this year. The Fed's bond-buying program keeps long-term interest rates low, encouraging more borrowing and spending.

bec8bfc453601b8f537e4aefa4c9d8c30e4a6246.translatedText: Arizona oil prices bucked the trend and fell for the 14th consecutive year. Dropped to $3.35 (Alberta Times) Gasoline prices in Alberta continued to decline, with the average price falling by 5.2 cents last week to $3.350 per gallon. Looking at gas prices across the state, the East Valley gas price averages $3.265, the lowest in the state, while Flagstaff has the highest price, averaging $3.562 per gallon. Although residents of this state have enjoyed continued declines in gas prices, gas prices in the District of Columbia and 33 other states have been on the rise. The average price of gas in the Midwest has risen by more than 10 cents, exceeding the previous week's increase. "Across the country, we are experiencing rising gas prices, consistent with recent changes in crude oil prices and hot weather," said Arizona Automobile Association spokesperson Linda Gorman. "Given current market factors, Alberta oil prices will continue to decline in the short term, barring unforeseen circumstances."

fb6a3bea993afc5ba38a49702ba5834afaa03c89.translatedText: Huang Xinmin expressed his great gratitude to the Chinese and American friends who have supported him for a long time, especially since he had no support from existing politicians or financial groups and relied entirely on mobilizing every citizen around him to win the election with a high vote. He said that although he was elected, the work he will face in the future will be more difficult. He will actively implement his political program and truly serve the citizens of Chandler.

fd0f1136edc9291126462afd48a6705a3875e8b7.translatedText: Chandler City has a population of 260,000. It is the Silicon Valley of Arizona. It has a large number of high-tech companies and is an area with a relatively concentrated Chinese population in Arizona. The election of Chinese-American Huang Xinmin opened the way for Chinese-Americans to participate in politics.

bda4c58739a2fcb823d25dc59a2f2b40e34aa6c5.sourceText: In this modern world, diversity is looked at as beauty and a key element of bridging the gaps to create unity. Asian Pacific Americans are still counted as 搈odel minority’ in USA. But the Asian Pacific Americans are very diverse with their language, culture, heritage and general needs. Traditional thinking is Asian Pacific American are reluctant to report their concerns and ashamed to seek help when needed. Thus, the overall ideas about Asian Pacific Americans are, they are doing well in their own areas or they do not want to voice out their ideas. Janelle Wong, a political scientist and director of Asian-American Studies at the University of Maryland oppose to this view. His findings are, ”They understand what power lies with government in terms of people’s everyday lives,” he also mentioned, ”They’re not afraid of the social safety net,” As a person, everyone possesses the right to express his or her own opinion. Casting vote is a way to make a statement. Asian Pacific Americans need to come forward to practice the civic engagement process of get out and vote. Vote is not about choosing a Political leader only, but helps to shape up the policies on employment, education, immigration/citizenship, and civic participations to better each community. Asian Pacific Americans need to empower themselves by practicing the right to vote to bring a change for them and for their future generations. Each Individual is a change agent. An improved future can be directed only with combined voice. Knowing and understanding individual strengths will contribute to the combined effort. To make a path of continuous growth of young leadership and place them to lead the community, nation and the world; we all need to make an effort to bring Asian Pacific Americans on the front line. Many social organizations are dedicating their efforts to highlight this issue and bring awareness. OCA – Greater Phoenix Chapter initiated a series of events to promote and ensure the voter registration awareness. One of their upcoming events is free movie screening on 21 September 2014 at Arizona Historical Society, Tempe, AZ. Freedom Summer a heart touching movie a part of our history will be screened followed by QA. Freedom Summer: This is the compelling story? In the hot and deadly summer of 1964, the nation could not turn away from Mississippi. Over ten memorable weeks known as Freedom Summer, more than 700 student volunteers joined with organizers and local African Americans in a historic effort to shatter the foundations of white supremacy in one of the nation抯 most segregated states. Working together, they canvassed for voter registration, created Freedom Schools and established the Mississippi Freedom Democratic Party with the goal of challenging the segregationist state Democratic Party at the national convention in Atlantic City. Freedom Summer was marked by sustained and deadly violence, including the notorious murders of three civil rights workers, countless beatings, the burning of 35 churches and the bombing of 70 homes and community centers. Directed by acclaimed filmmaker Stanley Nelson (Freedom Riders, The Murder of Emmett Till), Freedom Summer highlights an overlooked but essential element of the civil rights movement: the patient and long-term efforts by outside activists and local citizens in Mississippi to organize communities and register black voters – even in the face of intimidation, physical violence and death.

13283effc494e0238a6ee0c1bba79e484394fd7b.translatedText: The total number of people tested increased to 352, 252 tested positive, 309 were ruled out for infection, and 6 are awaiting results. Looking at the changes in the numbers, we can look at the indisputable fact that there is a shortage of testing reagents across the state. No matter what symptoms you have, it may not be possible to test so quickly. If you are afraid of infection, stay home and don’t even go hiking. There are now more people on each mountain than in supermarkets. The numbers have been growing, but the number of people waiting for results has dropped significantly, indicating that results are being obtained faster. Phoenix is ​​dangerous, but that doesn't mean Chandler isn't dangerous. It's safer to stay at home.

caf8bb6ae6725874aba04b062ef409749f57de3e.translatedText: Maricopa is the county with the largest number of confirmed cases, with a total of 139 cases. Phoenix, Chandler, Scottsdale, Mesa, Tempe, and Peoria all belong to Maricopa County. Researchers analyzed this number. Most of the cases are in Phoenix. Among the 139 cases, men accounted for the majority, with a total of 81 people. The affected age group is mainly between 18 and 40 years old. Those aged 41-65 account for 33%. Those over 65 years old account for 30%. Among the 139 confirmed patients, 25 are being treated in the hospital and 7 are in critical condition.

The Golden Rooster celebrates the New Year, and we celebrate together at home and abroad! 2017...

95b7eb452243090e679454144856b76b39224008.sourceText: 金鸡贺新春，海内外同欢庆！2017年1月28日美国亚利桑那春节联欢晚会（亚省春晚）在美莎艺术中心举办。在中国农历新年我们一起为祖国，为家人祈福，送上新年的问候。每年”亚省春晚”是中美朋友体验中国传统文化和艺术的好机会。今年我们又会有什么惊喜奉献给观众呢?
95b7eb452243090e679454144856b76b39224008.translatedText: The golden rooster celebrates the New Year, and we celebrate together at home and abroad! On January 28, 2017, the Arizona Spring Festival Gala (Alberta Spring Festival Gala) was held at the Meisha Art Center. During the Chinese New Year, we pray for our motherland and our families together, and send New Year greetings. The annual "Alberta Spring Festival Gala" is a good opportunity for Chinese and American friends to experience traditional Chinese culture and art. What surprises will we offer to the audience this year?

b0d5c8958bf69b5b6f02ec7a575099286a5aeb45.sourceText: 中国大鼓雄浑的震响，将拉开金鸡春晚的序幕。亚省艺术学院的师生，亚省中华乐团，以及来自现代中文学校和希望中文学校的演奏团体，美国公立学校学习中文的小朋友，将给您拜个新年，为亚利桑那的华人送上新年的艺术盛宴。
b0d5c8958bf69b5b6f02ec7a575099286a5aeb45.translatedText: > The powerful sound of the Chinese drum will kick off the Golden Rooster Spring Festival Gala. Teachers and students from the Alberta School of the Arts, the Alberta Chinese Orchestra, as well as performance groups from Modern Chinese School and Hope Chinese School, as well as children learning Chinese in American public schools, will wish you a happy New Year and provide a New Year's artistic feast to the Chinese in Arizona.

d4736c5f33c3ee77fae135f2e238fb86e882c5a4.sourceText: 亚省艺术学院依然是本次春晚的品质担当，傣族大型群舞《花腰花》将中国少数民族的异域风情带到凤凰城。花季少女，头顶竹笠，走在傣家山水间，传统傣族” 三道弯” 曼妙的身姿，不再是主旋律，现代傣族少女把时尚音乐元素，放进了生活里，展现了新时代下傣族人民的幸福生活。亚省艺术学院新生代老师将中国现代舞《当代节奏》搬上舞台，用舞蹈了展现当代中国人生活和工作的节奏。参加这个舞蹈的演员，不仅有训练多年的舞蹈演员，还有在亚利桑那州工作的普通的工程师，老师等等，他们平时很少接触舞蹈。这次也是他们的首秀，他们的演出也将会带来一个完全不同的视觉感受。
d4736c5f33c3ee77fae135f2e238fb86e882c5a4.translatedText: >The Alberta College of the Arts is still responsible for the quality of this Spring Festival Gala. The large-scale group dance "Huayaohua" of the Dai ethnic group brought the exotic customs of China's ethnic minorities to Phoenix. The girl in bloom, with a bamboo hat on her head, walks among the mountains and rivers of the Dai family. The graceful figure of the traditional Dai "three bends" is no longer the main theme. The modern Dai girl puts fashionable music elements into her life, showing the happy life of the Dai people in the new era. The new generation of teachers from the Art Institute of Alberta put the Chinese modern dance "Contemporary Rhythm" on the stage, using dance to show the rhythm of contemporary Chinese people's life and work. The actors participating in this dance include not only dancers who have trained for many years, but also ordinary engineers, teachers, etc. who work in Arizona, and they rarely come into contact with dance. This is also their first show, and their performance will also bring a completely different visual experience.

63576eaefd7138e6eb723e512cd5592529378532.sourceText: 芭蕾是舞蹈的经典舞种，可是你是否看到过在人的身体上立起脚尖，展现白天鹅的婀娜多姿呢？来自中国乐山杂技团演员将力量与美完美结合，带来高难度的杂技节目《肩上芭蕾》，为了让大家有更多的惊喜，在这里就不再剧透了。
63576eaefd7138e6eb723e512cd5592529378532.translatedText: Ballet is a classic form of dance, but have you ever seen a human body standing on tiptoes to show the gracefulness of a white swan? Actors from China's Leshan Acrobatic Troupe perfectly combine strength and beauty to present the highly difficult acrobatic show "Shoulder Ballet". In order to give you more surprises, I won't spoil it here.

32d83d62d62f12a40c34c81c96c8b64cf53cf03e.sourceText: 亚省春晚是美国朋友了解华人社区的一个新窗口，今年我们将联手亚省现代中文学校，希望中文学校一起来展示中华文化。以”中国年”主题的绘画书法展活动正在筹备中，更多惊喜会陆续为您带到。
32d83d62d62f12a40c34c81c96c8b64cf53cf03e.translatedText: >The Alberta Spring Festival Gala is a new window for American friends to understand the Chinese community. This year we will join hands with the Alberta Modern Chinese School, hoping that the Chinese schools will work together to showcase Chinese culture. The painting and calligraphy exhibition with the theme of "Year of China" is under preparation, and more surprises will be brought to you one after another.

fa21f36405177dcb91dcc527e72d02dc3bced0fb.sourceText: 2013ASU全明星 歌手大赛于11月8日晚在ASUNeebhall圆满结束。 帅气的卢顥同学给大家带来难以忘怀的视听感受，众望所归，最终摘夺冠军的桂冠。 也祝贺我们的崔璨妹子获得第二名的荣誉和杨心平同学获得第三名的好成绩。 每位参加全明星的选手都非常的棒！他们是从六十多位参赛选手中选出来的实力唱将，感谢他们带来的精彩表演。
fa21f36405177dcb91dcc527e72d02dc3bced0fb.translatedText: The 2013 ASU All-Star Singing Competition ended successfully on the evening of November 8th at the ASU Neebhall. The handsome classmate Lu Hao brought everyone an unforgettable audio-visual experience and was highly anticipated by everyone, and finally won the championship. Congratulations also to our girl Cui Can for winning second place and our classmate Yang Xinping for winning third place. Every player who participated in the All-Stars was great! They are talented singers selected from more than 60 contestants. Thank you for their wonderful performances.

5c60a6b90ed6d29626171b733d523dab97b97349.sourceText: (ASU学生学者联谊会来稿)4 月 3 日终于迎来了亚利桑那州立大学第六届歌手大赛的巅峰对决。 作为全校最吸引眼球最值得期待的文艺盛会，比赛现场人声鼎沸热闹非凡， 小编也赶到现场，一同体验了本次的饕餮盛宴。
5c60a6b90ed6d29626171b733d523dab97b97349.translatedText: (submission from the ASU Students and Scholars Association) April 3 Today finally ushered in the pinnacle showdown of Arizona State University’s sixth singing competition. As the most eye-catching and anticipated cultural event in the school, the competition site was bustling with people and the editor also rushed to the scene to experience this gluttonous feast together.

6f803b76c08522f285470d12f17929be26e38879.sourceText: Scissors ， Stone ， Cloth 乐队接连带来三首劲爆的摇滚，一下点燃了全场的激情。暖场嘉宾的开场为比赛拉开了序幕，现场火爆的气氛还未平息，主持人又为现场同学播放了明星大咖们的祝福?#40644;家强、叶璇、刘力扬。。。纷纷 7 位进入决赛的歌手加油鼓气，现场顿时充满了紧张的火药味，到底歌神称号花落谁家，无人知晓。
6f803b76c08522f285470d12f17929be26e38879.translatedText: Scissors, Stone, and Cloth bands successively presented three explosive rock songs, igniting the passion of the audience. The warm-up guests kicked off the competition. Before the heated atmosphere subsided, the host played blessings from celebrities such as Jia Qiang, Michelle Ye and Liu Liyang to the students present. . . The seven singers who entered the finals cheered for each other, and the scene was filled with a tense atmosphere. No one knew who would win the title of God of Song.

89956b4f4c50a5e6c12608fd5341f21af7b6e21c.sourceText: 3 号歌手叶凯琳在一二轮的竟演中演唱了《 Listen 》、《 Hurt 》两首歌曲，她的声线无论在快歌还是慢歌之中都可以做到转换自如。虽然遗憾没能进入前三甲，但是她的表现震撼了全场的观众。
89956b4f4c50a5e6c12608fd5341f21af7b6e21c.translatedText: Singer No. 3 Ye Kailin sang two songs, "Listen" and "Hurt" in the first and second rounds of competition. Her voice can switch freely between fast songs and slow songs. Although it was a pity that she failed to enter the top three, her performance shocked the audience.

24b51eee1fd3cc369b56c93dc8f158ed9ef58556.sourceText: 作为唯一一位以个人形式出现的男歌手张衍，他的唱歌功底丝毫不逊色于其他女歌手，尤其是声音与周杰伦神似，一开口便得到了在场观众的欢呼。评委老师们同样认为张衍同学的声音条件不错，有发展潜力。我们希望张衍在明年能够再次参加歌手大赛，取得更好的成绩！
24b51eee1fd3cc369b56c93dc8f158ed9ef58556.translatedText: As the only male singer Zhang Yan appears as an individual, his singing skills are not inferior to other female singers, especially his voice is similar to Jay Chou. He received cheers from the audience as soon as he opened his mouth. The judges and teachers also believed that Zhang Yan’s voice was in good condition and had potential for development. We hope that Zhang Yan can participate in the singer competition again next year and achieve better results!

4596248322db611bcd9aad20de55ea0eec8ee428.sourceText: 相信 6 号选手高畅的一首《存在》给现场观众留下了深刻的印象，感情饱满，而且高音部分拿捏得当，一副天生的好嗓子。希望她以后可以给大家带来更多的翻唱作品。
4596248322db611bcd9aad20de55ea0eec8ee428.translatedText: I believe that Contestant No. 6 Gao Chang's song "Existence" left a deep impression on the audience. It is full of emotion, has good control of the high notes, and has a naturally good voice. I hope she can bring you more cover songs in the future.

eb729ee45293c1805b6a30e24cec56693eec8907.sourceText: 作为连续两届进入歌手大赛决赛的董泽茜同学不仅是实力派歌手，更是颜值极高的女歌手。一上台就被称作”女神”，人气颇高的她不负众望，获得了最佳人气歌手奖。董泽茜同学是否还会参加下一届的歌手大赛呢？让我们拭目以待。
eb729ee45293c1805b6a30e24cec56693eec8907.translatedText: Dong Zeqian, who has entered the finals of the singer competition for two consecutive years, is not only a powerful singer, but also a very good-looking female singer. She was called the "goddess" as soon as she came on stage. She was so popular that she lived up to expectations and won the Most Popular Singer Award. Will Dong Zeqian still participate in the next singer competition? Let's wait and see.

cc0b08fc074f42203c7b87a67733382b2c55d4bd.sourceText: 7 号选手高子潇获得了本次歌手大赛的季军。她给大家留下的印象用一个字形容就是稳。第一轮表现平平的她扛住了压力，在第二轮的比赛中以一首《虹之间》夺得季军头衔，黑马一般的表现令观众赞叹不已。
cc0b08fc074f42203c7b87a67733382b2c55d4bd.translatedText: Contestant No. 7 Gao Zixiao won the third place in this singer competition. The impression she left on everyone can be described in one word as stability. After a mediocre performance in the first round, she withstood the pressure and won the third place title with her song "Between Rainbows" in the second round. Her dark horse performance amazed the audience.

516cb861efde434938fe45b3e831bc69a88ca728.sourceText: 亚军歌手王思嘉在第二轮的比赛中选用了经典歌曲《我怀念的》，也许是赢得了评委与观众的共鸣，在观众投票环节中获得了有力的支持，使她一举成为了夺冠的大热门。
516cb861efde434938fe45b3e831bc69a88ca728.translatedText: The runner-up singer Wang Sijia chose the classic song "What I Miss" in the second round of the competition. Perhaps she won the resonance of the judges and the audience, and received strong support in the audience voting session, making her the favorite to win the championship.

90cee06810c3a3f7f441632d218eb9b11388ddb8.sourceText: 本次歌手大赛的冠军得主是由阿呆、靖璟组成的有一个乐队。结合说唱和民谣进行自我创作的两位音乐人用他们独特的曲风征服了在场的每一位听众。有一个乐队也在夺冠后承诺讲给大家带来更多的原创作品，与大家分享自己的音乐之路。
90cee06810c3a3f7f441632d218eb9b11388ddb8.translatedText: The champion of this singer competition is a band composed of Ah Dai and Jing Jing. The two musicians, who combine rap and folk songs to create their own songs, conquered every audience present with their unique style. One band also promised to bring more original works to everyone after winning the championship and share their musical journey with everyone.

42cb1c3afffb347a898409204b7ab98eca73338c.sourceText: 音乐会的时间虽然短暂，但艺术的空间却是无限的。歌手们在舞台上拼尽全力，为大家奉献了一首又一首的经典歌曲。无论是无缘决赛的歌手们，还是已经取得成绩的歌手们都要继续努力，第七届亚利桑那州立大学歌手大赛等着你们的再次参与！我们来年，再战！
42cb1c3afffb347a898409204b7ab98eca73338c.translatedText: Although the concert time is short, the space for art is unlimited. The singers worked their best on the stage and performed one classic song after another for everyone. Regardless of the singers who missed the finals or the singers who have achieved results, please continue to work hard. The 7th Arizona State University Singer Competition is waiting for you to participate again! Let’s fight again next year!

44643096e9fdf2d763febd3866ac145177305eca.sourceText: 追求卓越，引领未来–”清华青少年杰出计划”首届青少年交流大会启动
44643096e9fdf2d763febd3866ac145177305eca.translatedText: Pursue excellence and lead the future – the first youth exchange conference of the "Tsinghua Youth Outstanding Program" was launched

0865717f11afd47be38003c9133fe07fa5f3190b.sourceText: 经过数月精心筹备, 首届青少年经验交流大会将于2012 年2月25日在美国硅谷史坦福大学举行。会议宗旨在于促进青少年相互交流生活成长过程中的经历, 包含多元文化, 积思广益, 互相借鉴学习。
0865717f11afd47be38003c9133fe07fa5f3190b.translatedText: After months of careful preparation, the first youth experience exchange conference will be held on February 25, 2012 at Stanford University in Silicon Valley, USA. The purpose of the conference is to promote young people to exchange their experiences in life and growth, including multi-culturalism, to pool their ideas, and to learn from each other.

21ead62d76926ec31df0a8514ef1b198be69dea2.sourceText: 会议采用国际学术会议的方式, 参会者可只提交论文或提交论文并上台讲演。论文题材不限, 可以是一次影响人生的经历, 一件促进反思的事件, 一项超越自我的追求；学校日常生活，个人独特的学习历程；暑假社会实践经历, 科学夏令营活动, 学校社团活动, 社区公益活动；参加著名学术活动或科技竞赛经历, 参加文艺体育团体或竞赛经历等。 所有通过的论文将装订成册, 与参会学生及家长分享。大会将有教育界嘉宾发表主题讲演, 随后是学生的论文讲演, 同时将有著名教授及教育界名人嘉宾组成的评审团做现场点评。优秀论文将获得相应奖励, 从演讲内容, 演讲技巧, 表达方式等多个方面评出各项优秀奖数名, 并颁发证书和奖金。最高奖金为1000美金。提交的论文和演讲仅限英语, 论文册则可随后译成中文。
21ead62d76926ec31df0a8514ef1b198be69dea2.translatedText: The conference adopts the format of an international academic conference. Participants can only submit papers or submit papers and give lectures on stage. There is no limit to the topic of the paper. It can be an experience that affects life, an event that promotes reflection, a pursuit of self-transcendence; daily life in school, a unique personal learning process; summer social practice experience, science summer camp activities, school club activities, community charity activities; experience in participating in famous academic activities or science and technology competitions, participation in literary and sports groups or competitions, etc. All approved papers will be bound into a book and shared with participating students and parents. The conference will have keynote speeches by educational guests, followed by student paper presentations. At the same time, a jury composed of famous professors and educational celebrities will make on-site comments. Excellent papers will receive corresponding awards. Several excellence awards will be selected from various aspects such as speech content, speech skills, expression methods, etc., and certificates and bonuses will be awarded. The maximum prize is US$1,000. Submitted papers and speeches are in English only, and the thesis volume can be subsequently translated into Chinese.

4fd56323541c0d419ba361b49a737d97a7d04e74.sourceText: 大会的具体细节,论文模本,截止日期等,可到 www.tsinghuayouth.org 网站查阅或联系 tydpconference@gmail.com 。欢迎各地区校友子弟及清华之友子弟参加。网上报名： https://docs.google.com/spreadsheet/viewform?formkey=dExQUHVwazB6a25IVXhnUjdHVTFZZWc6MQ
4fd56323541c0d419ba361b49a737d97a7d04e74.translatedText: The specific details of the conference, paper templates, deadlines, etc. can be found at www.tsinghuayouth.org or contact tydpconference@gmail.com. Children of alumni and friends of Tsinghua University from all regions are welcome to participate. Online registration: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheet/viewform?formkey=dExQUHVwazB6a25IVXhnUjdHVTFZZWc6MQ

9ba81671da0f99a16affce91f70f86d293652efd.sourceText: 清华青少年杰出计划是由美国清华校友发起的非赢利组织。服务美国及全球校友、清华之友及其子女，主要针对高年级中学生和大学生。旨在帮助青少年成员在学业、品德、职业发展方面，挑战自我，发挥最大潜能。锻炼组织和团队领导能力，培养成为具有全球化视野的华人下一代科技及政治精英的兴趣。培育青年领袖，促进美中交流。本次大会由旧金山湾区三大著名非盈利组织硅谷清华联网(海外最大清华校友会 www.tsinghua.net), 美中高层次人才交流协会 (www.ucahp.org), 和清华企业家协会北美分会（ www.teec.org.cn )资助，并得到中国驻旧金山总领事馆教育组及史坦福大学教授的大力支持。
9ba81671da0f99a16affce91f70f86d293652efd.translatedText: The Tsinghua Youth Distinguished Program is a non-profit organization initiated by Tsinghua alumni in the United States. Serves alumni, friends of Tsinghua and their children in the United States and around the world, mainly targeting senior middle school students and college students. It aims to help young members challenge themselves in terms of academic, moral and career development and realize their maximum potential. Exercise organizational and team leadership skills, and cultivate interest in becoming the next generation of Chinese technological and political elites with a global perspective. Cultivate young leaders and promote exchanges between the United States and China. This conference is funded by three well-known non-profit organizations in the San Francisco Bay Area: Silicon Valley Tsinghua Network (the largest overseas Tsinghua alumni association www.tsinghua.net), the U.S.-China High-Level Talent Exchange Association (www.ucahp.org), and the North American Chapter of the Tsinghua Entrepreneurs Association (www.teec.org.cn). It also receives strong support from the Education Group of the Chinese Consulate General in San Francisco and Stanford University professors.

e6b7208bc5f6a8a68df1d8e6844c1a83fdfa66f5.translatedText: > Arizona leads nation in solar energy development Arizona ranks second in the U.S. in solar system installation and solar development...

91efd51bdbc2be4bbb3a69ca046fe7c0fec05a86.sourceText: 亚利桑那太阳能发展领先全国 州长珍布鲁尔周二宣布，在全国太阳能系统安装和太阳能发展方面，亚利桑那州居美国第二，领先于全国很多地方。 州长说，亚利桑那州的太阳能产业增长会给本州居民带来财富。”阳能不仅使我们减少对外国石油的依赖，也能为本州创建数千名高收入工作。” 根据州政府新闻稿，2011年以来，本州在太阳能领域有近4800个就业岗位，应用率仅次于加州。
91efd51bdbc2be4bbb3a69ca046fe7c0fec05a86.translatedText: Arizona leads nation in solar energy development Arizona ranks second in the U.S. in solar system installation and solar development, Gov. Jen Brewer announced Tuesday, ahead of many places across the country. The governor said growth in Arizona's solar industry will bring wealth to state residents. "Solar energy not only reduces our dependence on foreign oil, but also creates thousands of high-paying jobs for the state." According to a state government press release, since 2011, the state has created nearly 4,800 jobs in the solar field, with an application rate second only to California.

35fdab41e3db61d3daf479de1becf64a0fdd8679.sourceText: 金信地产新闻：面向高科技工作人员的公寓开始被房地产商重视 一个价值五千万的新公寓在坦坯开始兴建，这个公寓的目标人群是高科技园区工作人员，例如霍尼韦尔，因特尔的员工。这些是新设计的，甚至可以自己定制的豪华公寓。 新建的圣嘉佩乐酒店式公寓，有384个单位，项目占地19.5英亩，由马克 – 泰勒住宅公司在Hardy 和 Elliot交接兴建，8月开始出租。 这也成为了一个出租行业的风向标，面向那些年轻的，高收入的专业人员，他们倾向租房，同时规划自己的事业。这些人成为出租行业新的营销对象。”现在的年轻专业人士的居住战略，通常会租比较长的时间，在职业的上升期，他们不会花太多的时间来考虑住房维护的问题，他们很专注于工作”马克 – 泰勒开发的副总裁克里斯说。他还说：”在过去，住公寓是高收入人群的禁忌，可是现在自定义家园，可以在他们的产品中实现”。 他们今年在坦坯南部开发的另一公寓，出租的对象很多收入都达到了6位数。 近十年大量的高科技产业进驻坦坯和钱德勒地区，大部分豪华公寓没有跟上，只有部分建在ASU附近。对于高收入的承租人，小区设施要求更加完备。例如24小时的健身中心，先进的虚拟教练，水疗中心，还有按摩池，网络设施，咖啡厅等等。这样的房子面积在775平方英尺的大约租金为875美元/月。大的三居室的多层套房大约1600美元每个月。更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的Tinna(480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com 。
35fdab41e3db61d3daf479de1becf64a0fdd8679.translatedText: Jinxin Real Estate News: Apartments for high-tech workers have begun to be valued by real estate developers. Construction of a new apartment worth $50 million has begun in Tanbei, targeting high-tech park workers such as those at Honeywell and Intel. These are newly designed luxury apartments that you can even customize yourself. The newly built Santa Capella serviced apartments have 384 units. The project covers an area of ​​19.5 acres and is being built by Mark Taylor Homes at Hardy and Elliot. Leasing began in August. It has also become a benchmark for the rental industry, targeting young, high-income professionals who tend to rent while planning their careers. These people have become the new marketing targets of the rental industry. "Today's young professionals generally rent for a longer period of time as they move up the career ladder. They don't spend too much time thinking about home maintenance. They're very focused on their work," said Chris, vice president of development at Mark Taylor Developments. He also said: "In the past, living in an apartment was a taboo for high-income people, but now customized homes can be realized in their products." In another apartment they developed this year in the south of Tanbei, many of the renters have incomes in the six figures. In the past decade, a large number of high-tech industries have moved into the Tangbai and Chandler areas. Most luxury apartments have not kept up, and only some are built near ASU. For high-income tenants, community facilities are required to be more complete. For example, there are 24-hour fitness centers, advanced virtual coaches, spas, massage pools, Internet facilities, coffee shops, etc. The approximate rent for such a house with 775 square feet is $875 per month. A large three-bedroom multi-level suite costs about $1,600 per month. 51dc2041b7afb5969a02b097e9ed30256553c8ee.translatedText: Chronicles of the Sunbird (7): Ma Lin fell in love with Chinese (Editor's note) At a certain time, in a certain space, we are here, in Arizona, the United States. Some people stay...

cb31d484d85e590e902d9f5a488ba178e595f413.sourceText: （编者按）在某个时间，某个空间，我们在这里，美国亚利桑那州，有的人留下来了，有的人海归了，在时间和空间的交界点中，有很多分秒组成的故事，在太阳鸟亚省华人网中，我们看到张肇鸿，气如虹，文若，慧明，凤鸣，心水等很多老侨用文字记录他们的生活，首先感谢他们的记录，让我们看到了一代移民的成长足迹。在凤凰城还有一些在高科技区忙碌的新移民，以及来学习的留学生，他们带着７０后，８０后，９０后的华裔的气息，来到这里，他们面对的人生变化和选择，正在发生。”太阳鸟亚省华人网”希望能记录下这些，调动采访力量来记录这个时间和空间里的故事。如果你身边有有意思的人，或者有意思的故事，请与我们联系，一起分享《太阳鸟纪事》。
cb31d484d85e590e902d9f5a488ba178e595f413.translatedText: (Editor's note) At a certain time, in a certain space, we are here, in Arizona, the United States. Some people stay, and some people return from overseas. At the intersection of time and space, there are many stories composed of minutes and seconds. On the Sunbird Asia Chinese Network, we see Zhang Zhaohong, Qi Ruhong, Wen Ruo, Huiming, Fengming, Xinshui and many other old overseas Chinese recording their lives in words. First of all, we would like to thank their records for allowing us to see the growth footprints of a generation of immigrants. In Phoenix, there are also some new immigrants who are busy in the high-tech district, as well as international students who come to study. They come here with the aura of Chinese people born in the 1970s, 1980s, and 1990s. The life changes and choices they face are happening now. "Sunbird Asia Chinese Network" hopes to record these and mobilize the power of interviews to record the stories in this time and space. If you have interesting people or interesting stories around you, please contact us and share "Sunbird Chronicles" together.

c913b3a0e4a862453e0726097355a0d798f19827.sourceText: （亚省时报） 5 月 5 日， 由加州大学洛杉矶分校孔子学院和中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆协同主办西南地区的” 汉语桥” 选拔赛 ，在加州大学洛杉矶分校 Popper 剧院 顺利闭幕。代表亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院的 丹强尼 （ Jonny Dangerfield ）和 马麟 （ Zach Marin ）荣获了第一名和第二名的佳绩。丹强尼的单口相声《哭笑不得》让所有的来宾笑得前俯后仰。马麟演唱的《父亲的草原 母亲的河》也让现场掌声雷动。中国驻洛杉矶教育部领事负责人陈准民领事, 教育部领事许翠英都表示对亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院的选手给他们留下的印象非常深刻。
c913b3a0e4a862453e0726097355a0d798f19827.translatedText: (Alberta Times) On May 5, the “Chinese Bridge” audition competition in the southwest region, co-sponsored by the Confucius Institute at UCLA and the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, concluded successfully at the Popper Theater at UCLA. Jonny Dangerfield and Zach Marin, representing the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, won first and second place. Dan Johnny's stand-up comedy "Laughter and Cry" made all the guests laugh out loud. Ma Lin's performance of "Father's Grassland, Mother's River" also received thunderous applause from the audience. Consul Chen Zhunmin, head of the Chinese Consulate of the Ministry of Education in Los Angeles, and Xu Cuiying, consul of the Ministry of Education, both expressed that they were very impressed by the contestants from the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University.

d99c178190c67017da3ba65dc2aaf0a18ffee8a9.sourceText: ＡＳＵ孔子学院院长马科琳（Madeline K. Spring）马麟 丹强尼 副院长徐智萍
d99c178190c67017da3ba65dc2aaf0a18ffee8a9.translatedText: >ASU Confucius Institute Director Madeline K. Spring, Ma Lin, Dan Johnny, Vice President Xu Zhiping

fc42f89d2513ea06ecdd1d1e94825b3b1e1e2f0b.sourceText: 记者第一次与马麟在电话中攀谈，他的语速很快，似乎连换气的机会都没有。他说以前在大众面前说话都很紧张，现在好多了，这都受惠于学习中文。其实说起学习中文还要追溯到两年前非常偶然的一个机会。刚刚进入大学学习生物的马麟，和父亲参加亚利桑那州立大学纪录片项目的宴会，在宴会上，马麟与两位负责中文项目的老师聊天。老师问马麟是否希望让自己学习的东西更独特一些呢？试一试中文！就这么简单的一次交谈，真得改变了他的选择，在大学第二语言的学习中，大部分同学都选西班牙语，只有马麟别具一格的选了中文。”中文绝对是一个完全不同的东西，第二我很享受这个学习过程，比如记单词，第三是中文是手和眼组合的学习过程”马麟说一开始学习中文，他就爱上了这个语言。
fc42f89d2513ea06ecdd1d1e94825b3b1e1e2f0b.translatedText: > This reporter chatted with Ma Lin on the phone for the first time. He spoke very fast, as if he didn’t even have a chance to breathe. He said that he used to be nervous when speaking in front of the public, but now he is much better, all thanks to learning Chinese. In fact, talking about learning Chinese can be traced back to a very accidental opportunity two years ago. Ma Lin, who had just entered college to study biology, attended a banquet for the documentary project at Arizona State University with his father. At the banquet, Ma Lin chatted with two teachers in charge of the Chinese project. The teacher asked Ma Lin if he wanted to make what he studied more unique? Give Chinese a try! Such a simple conversation really changed his choice. When learning a second language in college, most of his classmates chose Spanish, but Ma Lin uniquely chose Chinese. "Chinese is definitely a completely different thing. Secondly, I enjoy the learning process, such as memorizing words, and thirdly, Chinese is a learning process of hand and eye combination." Ma Lin said that he fell in love with this language as soon as he started learning Chinese.

0671e376e90267ee0e9a0784e285e0d657004fc5.translatedText: Ma Lin is singing Chinese songs

01093076f70802a63a15bbd9946c90e8dc4a3a69.sourceText: 利用音乐来学习中文对马麟来说是最有效的方式。这次参加”汉语桥”中文比赛，马麟选了《父亲的草原 母亲的河》这首歌，他说中国有非常悠久的历史，很多文字不仅有表面文字的意义，还有更深层次的象征。歌词中唱到” 父亲曾经，形容草原的清香，让他在天涯海角也总不能相忘；母亲总爱，描摹那大河浩荡，奔流在蒙古高原，我遥远的家乡。” 这是通过父亲母亲的讲述来描绘故乡，其中饱含着对家乡的思念，更有看到家乡物品对父亲，母亲的思念。马麟告诉记者他的父母都去世了，每次唱着这首歌就能感觉到爸爸妈妈就在自己身边，似乎从来没有离开过。他特别能理解歌曲中”睹物思人”的意思。
01093076f70802a63a15bbd9946c90e8dc4a3a69.translatedText: Using music to learn Chinese is the most effective way for Ma Lin. To participate in the "Chinese Bridge" Chinese competition this time, Ma Lin chose the song "Father's Grassland, Mother's River". He said that China has a very long history, and many words not only have superficial literal meanings, but also have deeper symbolic meanings. The lyrics sing, "My father once described the fragrance of the grassland, which he could never forget even in the ends of the world; my mother always loved me, describing the mighty river flowing on the Mongolian plateau, my distant hometown." This is a description of the hometown through the narration of the father and mother, which is full of longing for the hometown, and the longing for the father and mother when seeing the items in the hometown. Ma Lin told reporters that his parents have passed away. Every time he sings this song, he can feel that his parents are by his side, as if they have never left. He especially understands the meaning of "seeing things and missing people" in the song.

a4329ac966a77a11c322a178759bda5ccde9c33e.sourceText: 马麟获得”汉语桥”第二名
a4329ac966a77a11c322a178759bda5ccde9c33e.translatedText: Ma Lin won the second place in the "Chinese Bridge"

0af767ecac39d2fc990360f90a562af4e6b54ed6.sourceText: 马麟不仅喜欢中国歌曲还喜欢京剧等中国的传统艺术，新的一轮比赛在夏天马上就要开始了，马麟告诉我们他在准备新的歌曲，希望有更加完美的表现，争取到中国看看这个非常特别的国度。
0af767ecac39d2fc990360f90a562af4e6b54ed6.translatedText: Ma Lin not only likes Chinese songs but also traditional Chinese arts such as Peking Opera. A new round of competition is about to begin in the summer. Ma Lin told us that he is preparing new songs, hoping to have a more perfect performance, and strive to go to China to see this very special country.

582f8889f78e5d0de0789e16a221924aec31c8fa.sourceText: 凤城华人 共庆龙年-记大型舞台剧 “花木兰” (凤凰城 吉人供稿) 春日春风春浩荡, 龙年龙岁龙腾飞。2012年元月28日, 龙年正月初六, 亚利桑那州的凤凰城已是花柳春风, 一片春意盎然, 在全体华人社区欢度新春之际,一部妇孺皆知的花木兰女扮男装,替父从军的中国传统历史故事,在凤凰城瓇兹剧场拉开了序幕。凤凰武术学会的编导们, 把这个千古流芳的花木兰的故事, 在原本历史记载的基础上,采用了新颖的创作手法,将中国传统武术和舞蹈相结合, 用刚柔相济的艺术表演形式, 以她全新的面目展现在观众面前。 随着灯光渐起,只见年幼的小木兰认真地跟父练武, 随母起舞。随着投影屏幕上出现的金戈铁马的战争场 面,仿佛将观众带入了古疆场, 另人震撼。在接到皇帝召书时, 木兰不忍年迈的父亲再上战场,三位一体的木兰扮演者们, 用舞蹈和八卦拳相融合的表演形式, 将木兰深爱父亲, 但又内心矛盾挣扎, 百感交加的情感, 淋漓尽致地表现出来。列队而来的身佩盔甲, 艳丽的绿外衣加上红头巾, 红腰带的武士们, 在舞台上显得英姿勃勃, 当观众目不暇接地欣赏着历史疆场的真实再现时, 大型舞台背景和投影屏幕上千变万化地呈现出凤凰武术学会的老师们和学生们创作的木兰历史故事图画, 更为表演增添了无穷地意境和气氛。 跟随剧情的变化, 小木兰慢慢地长大, 武术和舞蹈也时而参差, 时而融为一体, 整场演出共有14位不同年龄的女孩子扮演木兰, 她们能文能武表演有度, 不光将女孩子木兰的柔情演绎得十分出色, 也将花木兰穿上戎装替父从军,在战场上坚毅的信念和拼死作战时的骁勇体现无遗。当扮演四位一体的花木兰战功显赫,凯旋归来时,舞台上下都沸腾起来, 台上载歌载舞,欢庆木兰衣锦还乡,台下掌声欢呼声不断。整场表演贯穿着中国古典传统舞蹈,戏剧表演和拳术, 剑术, 刀术, 棍术等。 这场演出,台下座无虚,有近四分之一是非华裔观众, 他们由衷地喜爱中国传统文化。舞台剧 ” 花木兰”不光让观众欣赏到了中国武术和舞蹈,戏剧的表演艺术, 也同时感受到了力量与柔美的完美结合。特别是在海外能亲眼看到华裔和非华裔学生扮演女英雄花木兰, 真是我们华人的骄傲。与此同时,这场成功的演出不光受到了凤凰城各华人社团和镁莎市瓇兹中学的大力支持,同时也受到了亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院的全力协助与参与。 凤凰武艺学院成立只有刚一年, 能在短短几个月里排出这样有创意有水准的大型舞台剧, 令观众赞叹不息, 这也是凤凰武术学会全体师生共同努力的结晶。精彩演出结束了, 观众还久久不愿离去,一位老华侨激动地说,这是他在凤凰城几十年来看到的由华人团体组办的最成功最有专业艺术水准的一次演出。 最让我们感慨的是, 凤凰武术学会将传统武术,舞蹈和表演艺术推向了一个前所未有的新的艺术领域。
582f8889f78e5d0de0789e16a221924aec31c8fa.translatedText: >Phoenix City Chinese celebrate the Year of the Dragon - A record of the large-scale stage play "Mulan" (contributed by Phoenix City Jiren) The spring breeze is mighty, and in the Year of the Dragon, the dragon soars. On January 28, 2012, the sixth day of the first lunar month in the Year of the Dragon, Phoenix, Arizona was already full of spring flowers and willows. As the entire Chinese community celebrated the New Year, a traditional Chinese historical story of Hua Mulan, a woman well known to women and children, who disguised herself as a man and joined the army in place of her father, kicked off at the Phoenix Theater. The choreographers of the Phoenix Martial Arts Society, based on the original historical records, used novel creative techniques to tell the story of the ever-famous Hua Mulan, combining traditional Chinese martial arts with dance, and using an artistic performance form that combines hardness and softness to present her in front of the audience in a brand new way. As the lights gradually turned up, young Mulan was seen seriously practicing martial arts with her father and dancing with her mother. As the war scenes of armies and iron horses appeared on the projection screen, the audience seemed to be brought into an ancient battlefield, which was shocking. When receiving the emperor's summons, Mulan couldn't bear her elderly father to go to war again. The three actors of Mulan used dance and Bagua boxing to vividly express Mulan's deep love for her father, but her inner conflict and struggle, and her mixed feelings. The warriors lined up wearing armor, bright green coats, red turbans, and red belts looked heroic on the stage. While the audience was dazzled by the true reappearance of the historical battlefield, the large stage background and projection screen presented ever-changing pictures of Mulan's historical story created by the teachers and students of the Phoenix Martial Arts Society, adding endless artistic conception and atmosphere to the performance. As the plot changes, little Mulan slowly grows up, and martial arts and dance sometimes differ and sometimes merge into one. There are 14 girls of different ages playing Mulan in the whole performance. They are able to perform both literary and martial arts. Not only do they interpret the tenderness of the girl Mulan very well, but they also put on a military uniform and join the army in place of her father. Her perseverance on the battlefield and her bravery in desperate battles are fully reflected. When Hua Mulan, who played the role of the Four in One, made outstanding military exploits and returned triumphantly, the stage was filled with excitement. There were songs and dances on the stage to celebrate Mulan's return home, and the audience applauded and cheered continuously. The entire performance runs through Chinese classical and traditional dances, drama performances and boxing, swordsmanship, knife skills, stick skills, etc. The audience for this performance was packed, with nearly a quarter of the audience being non-Chinese. They sincerely loved traditional Chinese culture. The stage play "Mulan" not only allows the audience to appreciate the performing arts of Chinese martial arts, dance, and drama, but also feels the perfect combination of strength and softness. Especially being able to see Chinese and non-Chinese students playing the heroine Hua Mulan overseas is really a source of pride for us Chinese people. At the same time, this successful performance not only received strong support from various Chinese associations in Phoenix and Meisha Middle School, but also received full assistance and participation from the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University. The Phoenix Martial Arts Academy has only been established for a year, and the ability to produce such a creative and high-level large-scale stage play in just a few months has amazed the audience. This is also the result of the joint efforts of all the teachers and students of the Phoenix Martial Arts Academy. The wonderful performance was over, but the audience still refused to leave. An old overseas Chinese said excitedly that this was the most successful and professional performance organized by a Chinese group that he had seen in Phoenix for decades. What impresses us most is that the Phoenix Martial Arts Society has pushed traditional martial arts, dance and performing arts into an unprecedented new art field.

9a7252cc9e3f3d2bc59cb2874767f6be8673cf32.sourceText: 轻歌曼舞尽风流—记耆英会老年模特队时装秀（图） 刘国泰 2012年8月17日上午，在鳳凰城華人耆英中心，举办了一塲老年模特时装秀表演。 随着一曲”甜蜜蜜”歌声响起，人们企盼已久的耆英会老年模特队终于登台亮相。在教练温聚臻的带领下，队员们鱼贯而出时，顿时让大家眼前一亮。炫丽的服装，时尚而不失高雅。她们或单独亮相，或成双成对的全身心投入，每一个步调都踩在音乐的节拍上，每一举手投足都那么恰如其分，把数月来辛苦训练的成绩发挥的淋漓尽致。这里没有专用的灯光设计，没有专用的舞台，甚至连专用的更衣室也没有。可有的是她们数月刻苦训练的执着和数百名耆英老人们的期望。数十年来不曾穿过的长裙和盛装，再配以得体的高跟鞋，现在穿在她们身上显得特别高雅，就像重新又回到了她们的年轻时代，神采奕奕，精神焕发。老人们自行设计的表演很有其独特之处，她们随身携带的小道具每每起到画龙点睛的作用，尤其是大家乘其它队员表演之际，反复换了好几套服装依次上场，形成了台上的川流不息，使人眼花撩乱，目不暇接，真不知有多少人在表演。 她们的精彩表演吸引了上百老人们的目光并迎来阵阵掌声。十数台照相机及摄像机都聚焦在舞台上，争相抓拍那些妩媚的瞬间。这时也许会使许多人陷入到沉思之中：这难道就是我那平昔不善言谈的老伴？这难道就是我那深居简出的朋友？怎么一到这个舞台上，就好象换了一个人，竟是那样的精神抖擞，容光焕发。 你准想不到，这些模特队的成员都是年过花甲的老人，十个人的平均年龄已超过了七十岁。大家的前半生都在为儿女们操劳，而今孩子们都长大成人，事业有成，大多都不需老人操心。在进入人生的最后一站，现在她们要为自己活着。心情舒畅，身体健康也是做为儿女们最大的心愿。所以为了自己，为了儿女，也是为了共同的爱好和信念，老姐妹们自发走到了一起，在温教练的辛勤指导下，通过训练大家的身体得到了锻炼，个人气质明显得到提高，更重要的是通过走时装秀大家从中得到了快乐。 今天她们在这里征服了上百名耆英老人的心，明日在新的舞台上，她们一定能以自己的才艺去征服更多的观众。让我们予祝她们的成功！＼ 耆英会老年模特队
9a7252cc9e3f3d2bc59cb2874767f6be8673cf32.translatedText: Singing and dancing to the fullest—a fashion show of the elderly model team of the Elderly Association (picture) Liu Guotai On the morning of August 17, 2012, at the Chinese Elderly Center in Phoenix, a fashion show of elderly models was held. As the song "Sweet Honey" played, the long-awaited senior model team of the Senior Citizens Association finally appeared on the stage. Under the leadership of coach Wen Juzhen, when the players filed out, everyone's eyes immediately lit up. Dazzling clothing, fashionable yet elegant. They either appeared alone or in pairs and devoted themselves wholeheartedly. Every step was based on the beat of the music. Every move and every move was so appropriate, giving full play to the results of months of hard training. There is no special lighting design, no special stage, or even a special dressing room. But what is left is their persistence in training hard for months and the expectations of hundreds of senior citizens. Long skirts and dresses that had not been worn for decades, paired with decent high heels, now looked particularly elegant on them, as if they had returned to their youth again, full of energy and energy. The performances designed by the old people themselves are very unique. The small props they carry with them often play a finishing touch. Especially when other team members perform, they repeatedly change several sets of costumes and come on stage, forming a continuous flow on the stage, which is dazzling and dizzying. I really don’t know how many people are performing. Their wonderful performance attracted the attention of hundreds of people and received bursts of applause. Dozens of cameras and cameras were focused on the stage, vying to capture those charming moments. At this time, many people may fall into deep thinking: Is this my wife who is usually not good at talking? Could this be my reclusive friend? Why is it that as soon as I arrive on this stage, I feel like a different person, so energetic and radiant. You would never expect that the members of these model teams are all elderly people in their 60s, and the average age of the ten people is over 70 years old. Everyone spent the first half of their lives working hard for their children. Now that the children have grown up and have successful careers, most of them don’t need to worry about the elderly. Entering the last station of their lives, they now have to live for themselves. Having a good mood and good health are also the biggest wishes for children. Therefore, for themselves, for their children, and for their common hobbies and beliefs, the old sisters came together spontaneously. Under the diligent guidance of Coach Wen, everyone got physically exercised through training, and their personal temperament was significantly improved. More importantly, everyone got happiness from the fashion show. Today they have conquered the hearts of hundreds of senior citizens here. Tomorrow on the new stage, they will definitely be able to conquer more audiences with their talents. Let us wish them success! ＼ Senior Model Team of Senior Citizens Association

038cb7858f16ebeb5e56195c3ea056df40b22878.sourceText: 亚省时报新增“国际专版” 本报创办二十一年来，一贯重视采用新华通讯社、中国新闻社提供的信息。近几年，进而荣获新华通讯社编排的每周专版【中国】、【港澳台湾】、定期专版【上海世博】；中国新闻社编排的定期连续专版【北京奥运】和【四川成都】，等等。自本期起，中国新闻社给本报增加了编排每周专版【国际】。这对于提升我­们华文媒体的素质和水平，确实起到了良好的促进作用。同时，有利于我­们的力量集中到掌握当地华人的信息，依靠特约撰­述和专栏作家的共同努力，办好生活园地和文艺副刊，办成既有共性又有­个性，具备旗帜鲜明和地方特色的华人小区报，为适应华人侨胞的需求服务。 本报对于亚省内外以至北美各地的读者和热心支持者，表示衷心的感谢！本报特别优惠长期­订阅户：订报一年35元；两年70元；三年一百元；零取每份两毛­。
038cb7858f16ebeb5e56195c3ea056df40b22878.translatedText: >Alberta Times has added an "international special edition". Since its establishment 21 years ago, this newspaper has always attached great importance to the use of information provided by Xinhua News Agency and China News Service. In recent years, it has been awarded weekly special editions [China], [Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan], and regular special editions [Shanghai World Expo] compiled by Xinhua News Agency; regular continuous special editions [Beijing Olympics] and [Sichuan Chengdu] compiled by China News Agency, etc. Starting from this issue, China News Agency has added a weekly special page [International] to this newspaper. This has indeed played a good role in improving the quality and level of our Chinese media. At the same time, it is conducive to us to concentrate our efforts on grasping the information of the local Chinese, rely on the joint efforts of special writers and columnists, run a good life garden and literary supplement, and build a Chinese community newspaper that has both commonality and individuality, a distinctive banner and local characteristics, and serves the needs of the overseas Chinese. This newspaper would like to express its heartfelt thanks to the readers and enthusiastic supporters inside and outside Alberta and even across North America! Special offer for long-term subscribers of this newspaper: 35 yuan for one year; 70 yuan for two years; 100 yuan for three years; 20 cents for each subscription.

da0f0a0395a55dd6901fe0e77ffac0cd7fe5b95b.sourceText: 7月16日晚7点，由大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会（侨联）牵头在六福餐厅举行了一个近两百人的餐会，为凤凰城市市长候选人”克劳德马托克斯” (Claude Mattox)拉票助选。资深侨领余文劲、侨务咨询委员尹衍桓，侨联主席邓朝驹、前华人议员黄仕均，侨联副主席张华芳、侨务委员高志中、亚太健康促进会创办人徐凯莱，慈济凤凰城联络处黄玉莲，中华语文学院院长李玲麟，中餐馆会副主席梅树德、理事陆少明、亚省开平同乡会会长甄硕钦、副会长关兆峰、华人华侨联合总会会长费健、华人者英会主席崔增祁、中华总会主席邱顺雄夫妇、川渝同乡会会长陈志钢、余风采堂代表余文泽、二十多个华人社团的负责人以及侨团代表都参加了餐会。 克劳德马托克斯在凤凰城为市民服务了近三十年。最早是三十年前，马托克斯家里被打劫，年轻的他决定站出来为社区安全做一些服务。而这份为公众服务的工作，一干起来，就没了尽头。无论是自己从事保险工作，还是其他行业，都把维护一个安全的社区作为自己的责任。今年是马托克斯作为凤凰城市议员的第三年，总结了自己多年的服务经验，他决定参选凤凰城市长，用切实的服务把凤凰城建成最安全，教育质量最高， 商业最稳定的社区。侨务咨询委员尹衍桓，侨联主席邓朝驹、前华人议员黄仕均，侨联副主席张华芳、侨务委员高志中都发表了简短的讲话，支持克劳德马托克斯参加选举。耆英会主席崔增祁更是举出实例，他讲述了克劳德马托克斯服务社区期间，为保存下耆英会（华裔老人会）所做的努力。 很多现场的朋友对即将参加选举的准市长提出了很多苛刻又尖锐的问题。例如前华人议员黄仕均提出两个华人聚集地区的发展，是会继续遵循前任市长的老政策，还是会出台新的政策？新旧社区的取舍等问题。克劳德马托克斯表示不会重复做以前做过的工作，会遵循一些以前的发展规划，同时也会与时俱进与规划发展部门沟通，作出最合理的规划。有人说凤凰城的税收已经够高了，他上台后是否还会增加税收？克劳德马托克斯表示绝对不会轻易增加税收，会寻找其他方式来解决政府资金不足的问题。现场提问此起彼伏，非常热烈。 当然也有轻松的时刻，新东方艺术学校的艺术舞蹈班的学生彭缇娜，给现场嘉宾带来了中国傣族舞蹈《雨竹林》，华裔画家李成也现场挥毫泼墨为克劳德马托克斯送上 了一幅国画?#39532;到成功?#65292;助选餐会到晚上九点才圆满结束。 8月1日，也就是下周一，凤凰城市开始注册参加选举。只要是居住在凤凰城市29天以上的居民，都有权参加投票。注册投票的表格在各图书馆都可以取到。有关选举的具体信息可咨询： www.phoenix.gov/election 或致电选举处602-261-VOTE (8683) 602-534-2737.
da0f0a0395a55dd6901fe0e77ffac0cd7fe5b95b.translatedText: At 7 p.m. on July 16, a dinner party for nearly 200 people was held at Luk Fook Restaurant, led by the Greater Phoenix Chinese Overseas Chinese Association (Overseas Chinese Federation), to canvass votes for the Phoenix City mayoral candidate "Claude Mattox". Senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin, Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee member Yin Yanhuan, Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Deng Chaoju, former Chinese councilor Huang Shijun, Vice Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Zhang Huafang, Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee member Gao Zhizhong, Asia Pacific Health Promotion Association founder Xu Kailai, Tzu Chi Phoenix City Liaison Office Huang Yulian, Dean of the Chinese Language School Li Linglin, Chinese Restaurant Association Vice Chairman Mei Shude, Director Lu Shaoming, President Zhen Shuoqin and Vice President Guan Zhaofeng of the Kaiping Association of Alberta, Fei Jian, President of the Overseas Chinese Federation, Cui Zengqi, Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Association, Qiu Shunxiong, Chairman of the Chinese Federation and his wife, Chen Zhigang, President of the Sichuan and Chongqing Association, Yu Wenze, representative of Yu Fengcaitang, and more than 20 heads of Chinese associations and representatives of overseas Chinese groups attended the dinner. Claude Mattox has served the citizens of Phoenix for nearly three decades. Thirty years ago, Mattox's home was robbed. As a young man, he decided to stand up and do some service for community safety. And this job of serving the public has no end once you start it. Whether you work in insurance or in other industries, you all regard maintaining a safe community as your responsibility. This year is Mattox’s third year as a Phoenix city councilman. Summing up his many years of service experience, he decided to run for mayor of Phoenix City and use practical services to build Phoenix into the safest community with the highest quality education and the most stable business. Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee member Yin Yanhuan, Overseas Chinese Federation Chairman Deng Chaoju, former Chinese parliamentarian Huang Shijun, Overseas Chinese Vice Chairman Zhang Huafang, and Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee member Gao Zhizhong all gave brief speeches in support of Claude Mattox's participation in the election. Cui Zengqi, chairman of the Senior Citizens Association, even gave an example. He told about Claude Mattox's efforts to preserve the Senior Citizens Association (Chinese Elderly Association) during his service to the community. Many friends present raised many harsh and pointed questions to the prospective mayor who is about to participate in the election. For example, former Chinese councilor Huang Shijun proposed that the development of two Chinese-populated areas will continue to follow the old policies of the previous mayor, or will new policies be introduced? Issues such as the choice between old and new communities. Claude Mattox said that he would not repeat the work done before and would follow some previous development plans. At the same time, he would also keep pace with the times and communicate with the planning and development department to make the most reasonable plan. Some people say that taxes in Phoenix are already high enough. Will they increase taxes after he takes office? Claude Mattox said he would never increase taxes easily and would look for other ways to solve the problem of insufficient government funds. Questions came one after another and were very lively. Of course, there were also relaxing moments. Tina Peng, a student in the art dance class of the New Oriental Art School, performed the Chinese Dai dance "Raining Bamboo Forest" to the guests. Chinese painter Li Cheng also presented a traditional Chinese painting to Claude Mattox with a splash of ink. The dinner party did not end successfully until 9 p.m. Registration for the election will begin in Phoenix on August 1, next Monday. Residents who have lived in Phoenix for more than 29 days are entitled to vote. Registration forms to vote are available at all libraries. For specific information about the election, please consult: www.phoenix.gov/election or call the Election Office at 602-261-VOTE (8683) 602-534-2737.

f054c445b9aa2f9bd8922ca5996d12910d3400ab.sourceText: 反对亚利桑那州移民法的团体31日向联邦法院提出控诉，要求本州停止执行该法律中的一项条款，即禁止人们因在路边寻求或提供散工服务，而妨碍交通。 墨裔法律辩护和教育基金与其他团体指称，此条款违反宪法保障的言论自由，因为它限制了人们表达需要工作的言论自由权；州府不能根据凤凰城零星的因找工妨碍交通的事件，对全州执行禁令。 联邦地方法官苏珊波顿在去年7月裁决，SB1040移民法的部分条款可以执行，包括在路边招工或待工；其他争议性较强的条款，如警察可在拦检时询问对方的移民身分，则不得执行。州长布鲁尔对波顿的裁决提出上诉，但失败了，她已向联邦最高法院提出上诉。 布鲁尔的律师说，限制散工是为了解决安全问题，散工使驾车人分心、骚扰行人、侵入和损坏私人财产。他们说，散工群聚路边，招手要车辆停车，对停下的车辆蜂拥而上。在凤凰城、钱德勒、美沙和泉山市，散工在路边留下了水瓶、食物包装纸和其他垃圾。 波顿先前拒绝墨裔团体的请求，禁止执行这项对散工的规定，但在联邦第九巡迴上诉法院于9月对类似的法律做出裁决后，允许墨裔团体再度提出控诉。第九巡迴上诉 法院裁决，加州瑞登多滩市不得执行禁止散工站在公共人行道、向驾车人寻求工作的法律，因为该法律违反工人的言论自由权，其规定也太广泛，连儿童对经过的车 辆喊叫「洗车」也属违法。
f054c445b9aa2f9bd8922ca5996d12910d3400ab.translatedText: Groups opposing Arizona's immigration laws filed a complaint with the federal court on the 31st, asking the state to stop enforcing a provision of the law that prohibits people from obstructing traffic by seeking or providing casual labor services on the roadside. The Mexican Legal Defense and Educational Fund and other groups alleged that this provision violated the constitutional guarantee of free speech because it restricted people's right to express their need for work; the state could not enforce a statewide ban based on sporadic incidents in Phoenix of blocking traffic while looking for work. Federal District Judge Susan Bolton ruled in July last year that some provisions of the SB1040 immigration law can be enforced, including recruiting or waiting for workers on the roadside; other more controversial provisions, such as the police being able to ask people about their immigration status during stops, cannot be enforced. Governor Brewer unsuccessfully appealed Bolton's ruling, and she has appealed to the U.S. Supreme Court. Brewer's attorneys say the restrictions on casual workers address safety concerns, as they distract motorists, annoy pedestrians, and trespass and damage private property. They said casual workers gathered on the roadside, waving for vehicles to stop and swarming stopped vehicles. In Phoenix, Chandler, Mesa and Spring Mountain, day workers left water bottles, food wrappers and other trash on the roadside. Bolton had previously rejected a request by Mexican-American groups to bar enforcement of the day-worker rule, but allowed the groups to sue again after the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals ruled in September on a similar law. The Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals has ruled that the city of Redondo Beach, Calif., cannot enforce a law that prohibits day workers from standing on public sidewalks and asking motorists for work because the law violates workers’ free speech rights and is so broad that it would make it illegal even for children to yell “wash your car” at passing cars.

This will promote the communication, liaison and exchange between overseas Chinese and overseas Chinese groups and the Fujian Overseas Chinese Federation system, and gather overseas forces for Fujian Province to "comprehensively implement the great opening-up strategy and form a great opening-up pattern." Yang Wentian of the Arizona Overseas Chinese Association was promoted to director of the liaison office.

9e80337bbddebddf8343535bad66a43f26b898fa.sourceText: 首批获福建省侨联委任的海外联络处主任是：美国纽约联络处主任：陈清泉（美国美孚集团董事长）、美国亚利桑那州联络处主任：杨文田（登峰（美国）有限公司董事长）、加拿大多伦多联络处主任：欧阳元森（加拿大欧阳氏集团总裁）、加拿大温哥华联络处主任：林广场（加拿大元亨控股企业总裁）、马达加斯加联络处主任：蔡国伟（福建天球有限公司董事长）、新西兰联络处主任：高炜（新西兰安发国际控股集团总裁）、南非联络处主任：李新铸（南非中国商贸城董事长）、副主任：庄斌官（Z.B.G进出口有限公司董事长）、印尼联络处主任：许金聪（印尼宇宙集团执行主席）、菲律宾联络处主任：庄永泉（菲律宾华美密胺塑料製品有限公司董事长）、匈牙利联络处主任：郑春生（福建莆田市郑氏集团董事长）、波兰联络处主任：陈铭坤（波兰新达中国商城董事长）。 福建是中国的侨务大省，现有海外华侨华人一千二百六十多万人，分佈在世界上一百七十六个国家和地区。长期以来，广大闽籍侨胞发扬「爱拚敢赢」的可贵精神，沐雨栉风、艰苦创业，为侨居国经济社会发展作出了重要贡献。与此同时，广大闽籍侨胞大力弘扬「爱国爱乡」的优良传统，高度关注和支持家乡和祖（籍）国的各项建设，通过海内外乡亲的共同努力，尤其是闽省侨联係统热心的「牵线搭桥」，广大闽籍侨胞纷纷回闽投资兴业、捐赠公益，为福建改革开放和科学发展、跨越发展作出了重要的、不可替代的贡献。
9e80337bbddebddf8343535bad66a43f26b898fa.translatedText: The first batch of overseas liaison office directors appointed by the Fujian Provincial Overseas Chinese Federation are: Director of the New York Liaison Office in the United States: Chen Qingquan (Chairman of Mobil Group, USA); Director of the Arizona Liaison Office in the United States: Yang Wentian (Director of Dengfeng (USA) Co., Ltd. Director of the Liaison Office in Toronto, Canada: Ouyang Yuansen (President of the Ouyang Group of Canada), Director of the Liaison Office in Vancouver, Canada: Lin Guangguang (President of Yuanheng Holdings of Canada), Director of the Liaison Office in Madagascar: Cai Guowei (Chairman of Fujian Tianqiu Co., Ltd.), Xinxi Director of the Lan Liaison Office: Gao Wei (President of New Zealand Anfa International Holdings Group), Director of the South African Liaison Office: Li Xinzhu (Chairman of South Africa China Trade City), Deputy Director: Zhuang Binguan (Chairman of Z.B.G Import and Export Co., Ltd.), Director of the Indonesian Liaison Office: Xu Jincong (Indonesia Universe Collection Executive Chairman of the Youth League), Director of the Philippine Liaison Office: Zhuang Yongquan (Chairman of the Philippines Huamei Melamine Plastic Products Co., Ltd.), Director of the Hungarian Liaison Office: Zheng Chunsheng (Chairman of the Zheng Group in Putian City, Fujian), Director of the Polish Liaison Office: Chen Mingkun (Chairman of Poland Xinda China Mall). Fujian is China's major province for overseas Chinese affairs. There are currently more than 12.6 million overseas Chinese, distributed in 176 countries and regions in the world. For a long time, the vast number of overseas Chinese from Fujian have carried forward the valuable spirit of "Love to work hard and dare to win", brave the rain and wind, and work hard to start a business, making important contributions to the economic and social development of the countries where they live. At the same time, the majority of overseas Chinese from Fujian vigorously carry forward the fine tradition of "patriotism and love for hometown" and pay close attention to and support the various constructions of their hometown and ancestral country. Through the joint efforts of folks at home and abroad, especially the enthusiastic "matchmaking" of the Fujian Overseas Chinese Federation system, the majority of overseas Chinese from Fujian have returned to Fujian to invest in businesses and donate to charity, making important and irreplaceable contributions to Fujian's reform and opening up, scientific development, and leapfrog development.

43f140aab413ce804241b6867caed3defdf4b656.sourceText: （亚省时报 周宜申）春回大地，春意盎然。二O一三年二月十六日，亚省中国餐馆协会假中亚利桑纳街友扶助中心（Central Arizona Shelter Services, 简称CASS）向广大街友派发中式餐点。活动场面秩序井然，充满和谐。 上午十一时，伴随着锣鼓声，具有浓郁中国味儿的舞狮表演拉开了本次活动的序幕。街友们兴致勃勃，他们排起长龙，安静的等待领取食物。亚省中国餐馆协会理事高志中先生介绍说，向街友派发免费餐食是亚省中国餐馆协会积极回应和配合CASS的服务工作。这是该会连续第四次为街友派餐。他们特别准备了一千人份的中式餐点，无论数量、质量、还是口味都能满足街友们的用餐需求。据瞭解，该会的领导和骨干们牺牲个人时间，无偿的计划和组织这次善举。 记者瞭解到，这次派餐的食谱包括米饭、炖牛肉、清炒西兰花、橘香鸡快和炸素春捲，另外，还配有好运饼和各式饮料。记者看到，中餐师傅们将烹饪好了的食物从铁质容器中取出，一一盛放在展示桌上的不鏽钢食物容器中。橘香鸡块和炸素春捲为现场烹炸。
43f140aab413ce804241b6867caed3defdf4b656.translatedText: (Alberta Times Zhou Yishen) Spring returns to the earth, full of spring spirit. On February 16, 2013, the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta distributed Chinese meals to street residents at the Central Arizona Shelter Services (CASS). The event was well-ordered and full of harmony. At 11 a.m., accompanied by the sound of gongs and drums, a lion dance performance with a strong Chinese flavor kicked off the event. The street residents were in high spirits. They lined up in a long queue and waited quietly to receive food. Mr. Gao Zhizhong, director of the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta, said that distributing free meals to street residents is the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta’s active response and cooperation with CASS’s service work. This is the fourth consecutive time the association has distributed meals to homeless people. They have specially prepared Chinese meals for 1,000 people, which can meet the dining needs of street friends in terms of quantity, quality, and taste. It is understood that the leaders and backbones of the association sacrificed their personal time to plan and organize this charity event for free. The reporter learned that the recipes for this meal include rice, stewed beef, stir-fried broccoli, orange-flavored chicken quick and fried vegetarian spring rolls. In addition, it also comes with good-luck cakes and various drinks. The reporter saw that the Chinese chefs took out the cooked food from the iron containers and placed them one by one in stainless steel food containers on the display table. Orange-flavored chicken nuggets and fried vegetarian spring rolls are cooked and fried on site.
