35ef0ea6163e30d122a3dd9163cf3ef98d3db05b.sourceText: （张肇鸿供稿）大凤凰城侨联总会第三届秋游活动，将于十一月廿三日(星期六)，上午十时至下午三时在天庇市的 KIWAINS 公园内举行，公园的具体地址是：6111 S. All America Way Tenpe AZ 85283。这个名为＂同济娱乐中心＂的公园内有个大湖，环境十分优美，这是侨联第三次在同一公园举办秋游。秋游活动后大家还可租用船只游湖，是个适于合家休闲度假的好去处。 侨联将为秋游活动提供免费食物和饮料，有各种娱乐活动和抽奖，欢迎各届人仕携家带眷前来参加，共渡一个愉快的周末。
35ef0ea6163e30d122a3dd9163cf3ef98d3db05b.translatedText: (Contributed by Zhang Zhaohong) The third autumn outing of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Greater Phoenix City will be held on November 23 (Saturday) from 10 am to 3 pm at KIWAINS Park in Tenpe City. The specific address of the park is: 6111 S. All America Way Tenpe AZ 85283. This park named "Tongji Recreation Center" has a large lake and a very beautiful environment. This is the third time that the Overseas Chinese Federation has held an autumn outing in the same park. After the autumn outing, you can also rent a boat to cruise the lake, making it a great place for family leisure vacation. The Overseas Chinese Federation will provide free food and drinks for the autumn outing, as well as various entertainment activities and lucky draws. People from all walks of life are welcome to come with their families to participate and spend a pleasant weekend together.

b511c44beaec1dc371ab15b8ae5f0d944cda3e9a.sourceText: 美国单身一族 有何经济代价？
b511c44beaec1dc371ab15b8ae5f0d944cda3e9a.translatedText: What is the economic cost of being single in America?

c0dfc32d208e9da555038b48580577ff14cc2a35.sourceText: 美国单身一族 有何经济代价？ 单身人士，似乎是新的时尚。今天，只有51%的美国成年人已经结婚，近30%的家…
c0dfc32d208e9da555038b48580577ff14cc2a35.translatedText: What is the economic cost of being single in the United States? Singles seem to be the new fad. Today, only 51% of American adults are married, and nearly 30% of households...

d7146d7f25621b65505e5e1e158b2a8f9b16cd72.sourceText: 单身人士，似乎是新的时尚。今天，只有51%的美国成年人已经结婚，近30%的家庭是单身人士，创下美国的历史最高水平。
d7146d7f25621b65505e5e1e158b2a8f9b16cd72.translatedText: Singles seem to be the new fashion. Today, only 51% of American adults are married, and nearly 30% of households are single, a record high in American history.

3c1854d2df6b7c3004abd120b152b414e70cc2a9.sourceText: 自1960年以来，独居美国人的比例增加了一倍。 现时，美国有1.2亿名单身人士，其中包括从未结婚，丧偶或离婚的，作为单身人士，不仅是生活自由，还配备了一个标价。 根据消费支出的调查报告，单身人士花费于食物，住房，税收和医疗保险的预算，相比已婚人士佔更大的份额，每年，单身人士对美国经济的贡献大约是19万亿美元。 越来越多的公司针对单身人士的服务和需求，推出合适的产品，视他们为一个不可忽视的力量。
3c1854d2df6b7c3004abd120b152b414e70cc2a9.translatedText: Since 1960, the share of Americans living alone has doubled. Currently, there are 120 million singles in the United States, including those who have never been married, are widowed or divorced. Being single not only brings freedom to life, it also comes with a price tag. According to the Consumer Expenditure Survey, singles spend a larger share of their budget on food, housing, taxes and health insurance than married people, and singles contribute approximately $19 trillion to the U.S. economy each year. More and more companies are launching products suitable for the services and needs of singles, treating them as a force that cannot be ignored.

192ac1acc7ba961e2673bb4178a9a3713662b4c8.sourceText: 以下是几个美国单身人士的状况，以及他们所面临的财政挑战： （一）单亲父母 根据美国人口普查局的资料，美国有1360万名与子女同住的未婚父母，其中包括1千万名未婚母亲，170万名未婚父亲以及190万名未婚夫妇。 有一半的单身母亲年收入少于25,000，其家庭中位数是已婚夫妇家庭的三分之一。只有三分之一的单身母亲，收到子女的任何抚养费，平均金额大约是每月300美元左右。 没有人生伙伴来分享养育幼儿的责任，许多的单身家长也需要找日托中心的帮助，但是，根据美国2012年认识幼儿的报告指出，美国有35个州和哥伦比亚特区，每年的婴儿护理中心的平均成本，甚至高于公立大学的本州学生的费用。
192ac1acc7ba961e2673bb4178a9a3713662b4c8.translatedText: The following are the situations of several single people in the United States and the financial challenges they face: (1) Single parents According to the U.S. Census Bureau, there are 13.6 million unmarried parents living with their children in the United States, including 10 million unmarried mothers, 1.7 million unmarried fathers, and 1.9 million unmarried couples. Half of single mothers earn less than $25,000 a year, and their median household is one-third that of married couples. Only one-third of single mothers receive any child support, and the average amount is about $300 per month. Without a life partner to share the responsibilities of raising young children, many single parents also need the help of day care centers. However, according to the 2012 Understanding Toddlers report in the United States, there are 35 states and the District of Columbia in the United States. The average annual cost of infant care centers is even higher than the cost of in-state students at public universities.

d54b5eec9b4f5f85eadeb278d7bd423cadacd369.sourceText: （二）单身老人 金融解决方案的行政总监詹姆斯(James Heafner)说：”单身人士，对于退休的准备，更为艰难。研究表明，有其他人协助计划，确实是有差别的。” 2011年嘉信理财的调查发现，85%的已婚美国人有为退休的储蓄做好准备，相反，单身人士只有67%。 这些准备不足的退休人士，可能要付出更巨大的代价，尤其是女性，她们的平均寿命比男性更长。 詹姆斯说：”这将会是不能依靠其他人的IRA或401(k)，或是任何的退休金，代表著你必须要独自解决退休之后的金钱问题。你只能依靠自己的社会保障金，而不是你的配偶。再者，因为你是单身，一生中所缴付的税率也是较高。” 布兰代斯大学海勒学院社会政策与管理的一项研究，题为：”越活越少：新经济中的老人安全网”，调查发现，只有16%的单身老人，感到经济安全的，相反，已婚的老人是31%。 对于女性来说，情况是更糟糕的。年龄65岁及以上的女性，其贫困率是11.5%，然而，对于单身的年老女性，这个比率几乎是两倍之高，为19.1%。
d54b5eec9b4f5f85eadeb278d7bd423cadacd369.translatedText: (2) Single Seniors James Heafner, executive director of financial solutions, said: "Single people have a more difficult time preparing for retirement. Research shows that having other people assist with planning does make a difference." A 2011 Charles Schwab survey found that 85% of married Americans were prepared to save for retirement, while only 67% of single people were prepared. These ill-prepared retirees may pay a greater price, especially women, who live longer on average than men. "You're not going to be able to rely on other people's IRAs or 401(k)s, or any retirement savings, which means you have to be on your own to solve your money problems in retirement," James said. "You're relying on your own Social Security, not your spouse. And because you're single, you're paying a higher tax rate throughout your life." A study by the Heller School of Social Policy and Management at Brandeis University, titled: "Living More and Less: A Safety Net for the Elderly in the New Economy," found that only 16% of single elderly people feel financially secure, compared with 31% of married elderly people. For women, the situation is even worse. For women aged 65 and over, the poverty rate is 11.5%. However, for single older women, the rate is almost twice as high, at 19.1%.

6b092d555253c4fa5b8bed89979e24caff0b3f5c.sourceText: （三）独居的代价 美国大约有3,300万名独居人士，许多人是自己选择的。 现时，单身人士购买三分之一的房地产，根据全国房地产经纪人协会，未婚男性购买房屋，大约是估10%，未婚女性佔所有购房者的21%。 但是，大多数的单身人士均租住房屋，今年的平均租金达到创纪录的水平，其中有27个城市的平均租金突破1,000美元。 卡勒金融集团总裁里克卡勒(Rick Kahler)说：”如果你是单身的话，没有人与你分担基本生活的费用，例如水电费和维修成本等。”
6b092d555253c4fa5b8bed89979e24caff0b3f5c.translatedText: (3) The cost of living alone There are approximately 33 million people living alone in the United States, and many of them choose to live alone. Currently, single people purchase one-third of all real estate. According to the National Association of Realtors, unmarried men account for approximately 10% of home purchases. Unmarried women account for 21% of all homebuyers. However, the majority of singles rent, and average rents hit record levels this year, with 27 cities seeing average rents top $1,000. "If you're single, you don't have anyone to share the basics of living with, like utilities and maintenance costs," said Rick Kahler, president of Kahler Financial Group.

7897331029db1bee79b701d60b2b8a647e1f0432.sourceText: 有美国社区调查数据的分析表明，对于年纪大的单身人士来说，独居的开支，仅是房屋的费用，佔其收入近35%。相反，如果他们不是独居的话，房屋开支仅佔22%。 根据美国单身人士协会，医疗保健，退休和其他福利，均是以已婚人士为中心的结构，未婚人士平均得到少25%的福利。 再者，单身人士通常要付出更多的汽车和房屋保险费用。 因此，有专家鼓励单身人士如果受伤或生病，应该申请伤残保险，因为他们没有伴侣或配偶的依赖。 至于，健康保险费用，对于单身人士来说，也是更沉重的负担，因为没有配偶的计划，万一他们失业，失去工作的医疗保险，他们将要面对更多的生活难题。
7897331029db1bee79b701d60b2b8a647e1f0432.translatedText: An analysis of American Community Survey data shows that for older singles, the cost of living alone is just the cost of housing, which accounts for nearly 35% of their income. In contrast, if they do not live alone, housing expenses account for only 22%. According to the National Association of Singles, health care, retirement and other benefits are structured with married people in mind, with unmarried people receiving an average of 25% less benefits. Furthermore, single people typically pay more for car and home insurance. Therefore, some experts encourage single people to apply for disability insurance if they are injured or sick because they do not have a partner or spouse to rely on. As for the cost of health insurance, it is also a heavier burden for single people, because without a spouse's plan, if they lose their job and lose their job's medical insurance, they will face more life problems.

e52d5bc93369a36f4cb1663dc268aa1f4d2034ec.sourceText: 中美又将对话 两国互动有新变化
e52d5bc93369a36f4cb1663dc268aa1f4d2034ec.translatedText: China and the United States will have a dialogue again, and there will be new changes in the interaction between the two countries

ca0981a0c55a6836e206f8c1d1252147496ae518.sourceText: 中美又将对话 两国互动有新变化 中国完成权力交接后，作为世界上第一和第二大的经济体，中美高层外交互动就拉开…
ca0981a0c55a6836e206f8c1d1252147496ae518.translatedText: China and the United States will have a dialogue again, and there will be new changes in the interaction between the two countries. After China completed the transfer of power, as the world's largest and second largest economies, high-level diplomatic interactions between China and the United States began...

329af8b7758308c2f942754107ddb02a8fc9060e.sourceText: 中国完成权力交接后，作为世界上第一和第二大的经济体，中美高层外交互动就拉开帷幕。先是美国新任财长雅各布 卢于3月19日至20日访华，随后新任国务卿克里也将于4月中旬访问中国。接下来则是第五轮中美战略与经济对话将于6月份在华盛顿举行，中国将派出庞大代表团参与中美之间最重要也是最大的对话交流平台。
329af8b7758308c2f942754107ddb02a8fc9060e.translatedText: After China completed the transfer of power, as the world's first and second largest economies, high-level diplomatic interactions between China and the United States began. First, the new US Treasury Secretary Jacob Lew visited China from March 19 to 20, and then the new Secretary of State Kerry will also visit China in mid-April. Next, the fifth round of China-US Strategic and Economic Dialogue will be held in Washington in June. China will send a large delegation to participate in the most important and largest dialogue and exchange platform between China and the United States.

b07bc259ea4421340323ea9e00034342d88cc803.sourceText: 实际上，近期中美互动有几个变化值得关注。一是涉及中美互动的高层人事发生大调整。以中美战略与经济对话为例，美方主导者为国务卿和财长，中方为主管商务的副总理和主管外交事务的国务委员。前几轮对话双方各自的主导人员美方为希拉里和盖特纳，中方为王岐山和戴秉国。人事调整后，从中方来看，应是新任副总理汪洋和由外交部长升任国务委员的杨洁篪。从美方来看，则是新任国务卿克里和财长雅各布 卢。杨洁篪一直从事对美事务，拥有丰富的对美工作经验，而克里和雅各布 卢则相对是对华外交新手，克里在参议院外交关系委员会的外交经验也是有限的。
b07bc259ea4421340323ea9e00034342d88cc803.translatedText: In fact, there have been several recent changes in Sino-US interactions that deserve attention. First, there have been major adjustments in high-level personnel involved in Sino-US interactions. Taking the China-US Strategic and Economic Dialogue as an example, the leaders on the US side are the Secretary of State and the Secretary of Finance, while the Chinese side is the Vice Prime Minister in charge of Commerce and the State Councilor in charge of Foreign Affairs. In previous rounds of dialogue, the leaders of both sides were Hillary Clinton and Geithner on the American side, and Wang Qishan and Dai Bingguo on the Chinese side. After the personnel adjustment, from the Chinese side, it should be the new Vice Prime Minister Wang Yang and Yang Jiechi, who was promoted from Foreign Minister to State Councilor. From the US side, it is the new Secretary of State Kerry and Treasury Secretary Jacob Lew. Yang Jiechi has been engaged in affairs with the United States and has rich experience in working with the United States, while Kerry and Jacob Lew are relatively novices in diplomacy with China. Kerry also has limited diplomatic experience in the Senate Foreign Relations Committee.

feb0bc071c5d389102d45c66ab83aab3d38fcd88.sourceText: 二是过去十年中美实力对比发生变化。随着实力对比变化、世界格局嬗变、国际权势转移，影响两国关系的内外环境也相应发生了变化。中美两国关系的发展不是孤立的，而是与整个大的趋势和国际格局的变化紧密相关的。中国的经济总量已经从2000年只占美国的八分之一快速扩展到2012年的二分之一左右，并且两国经济总量的差距仍在逐步缩小。受国际金融危机的冲击，美国主导世界发展方向、构建国际安全格局和掌握全球治理体系的能力下降。
feb0bc071c5d389102d45c66ab83aab3d38fcd88.translatedText: Second, the balance of power between China and the United States has changed in the past decade. As the balance of power changes, the world structure evolves, and international power shifts, the internal and external environments affecting the relations between the two countries have also changed accordingly. The development of Sino-US relations is not isolated, but is closely related to the overall general trend and changes in the international landscape. China's economic aggregate has rapidly expanded from only one-eighth of that of the United States in 2000 to about one-half in 2012, and the gap between the two countries' economic aggregates is still gradually narrowing. Affected by the international financial crisis, the United States' ability to lead the world's development direction, build an international security pattern, and master the global governance system has declined.

f44e88c8683a773966262ebff463ce8615f36ec7.sourceText: 三是中美正在努力构建新型大国关系。中美两国元首就构建新型大国关系达成重要共识，这成为中美关系未来发展的方向。但对于如何构建这种新型大国关系仍是未来一段时间需要中美两国共同摸索和尝试的过程。双方国内政治生态的变化、两国经贸摩擦、地区安全冲突等都在一定程度上存在影响或中断两国构建新型大国关系努力的可能性。
f44e88c8683a773966262ebff463ce8615f36ec7.translatedText: Third, China and the United States are working hard to build a new type of major-country relationship. The heads of state of China and the United States reached an important consensus on building a new type of major-country relationship, which has become the direction of future development of China-US relations. However, how to build this new type of major-country relationship is still a process that requires China and the United States to jointly explore and try in the coming period. Changes in the domestic political ecology of both countries, economic and trade frictions between the two countries, and regional security conflicts have the potential to affect or interrupt the efforts of the two countries to build a new type of major-country relationship to a certain extent.

ae3a704c71379a72f722f88625813fc6705fbb3e.sourceText: 我们认为，在美国奥巴马第二任期和中国习李体制下，近期中美互动也有几个亮点和增长点。
ae3a704c71379a72f722f88625813fc6705fbb3e.translatedText: We believe that under the second term of Obama in the United States and the Xi-Li system in China, there are several bright spots and growth points in recent Sino-US interactions.

98038ff27ab99a6765488017e64fde28e428188c.sourceText: 一是内向治理。中美两国都面临政治、经济、社会领域出现的一系列体制性、结构性问题，迫切需要加强内部治理，以实现可持续发展，这是各自面临的首要问题，也是双方的共同利益。中国和美国，作为既竞争又相互依存的两大经济体，实现各自国内的优化治理，这不但符合两国人民的根本利益，而且对亚太地区的和平与发展、对世界的发展与治理都具有积极的和建设性的意义。两国就各自国内面临的问题，在一些共通的、软性的领域存在开展合作的共同利益。如美国实施?#20877;工业化?#25112;略，重振制造业，中国实施?#21019;新驱动?#25112;略，加快产业结构调整，两国可以此为基础，推进两国合作共赢，拓展共同利益。
98038ff27ab99a6765488017e64fde28e428188c.translatedText: > First, inward governance. Both China and the United States are facing a series of institutional and structural problems in the political, economic, and social fields. They urgently need to strengthen internal governance to achieve sustainable development. This is the primary issue facing each other and the common interest of both parties. China and the United States, as two major economies that are both competitive and interdependent, achieve optimal domestic governance. This is not only in the fundamental interests of the two peoples, but also has positive and constructive significance for the peace and development of the Asia-Pacific region and the development and governance of the world. The two countries have common interests in cooperating in some common and soft areas regarding the problems faced by each other domestically. For example, the United States implements the "industrialization" strategy to revitalize the manufacturing industry, and China implements the "new drive" strategy to accelerate the adjustment of industrial structure. The two countries can use this as a basis to promote win-win cooperation between the two countries and expand common interests.

a7a195505a1649ff96196bdd35209b4a4306ffec.sourceText: 二是地区治理。地区经济合作、地区安全稳定，特别是亚太地区的政治、经济、安全架构的稳定和秩序的构建是两国的共同利益所在。中美可以共同为地区治理提供公共产品，维护地区安全、管控危机，在区域性机制安排上合作，致力于地区治理。朝鲜半岛核问题、伊朗核问题、叙利亚问题等，都需要两国携手应对，以此来维护地区的安全与稳定。当下，朝鲜半岛危机一触即发，存在失控的危险，中美的共同利益就是维护半岛的和平，防止核扩散，实现半岛无核化。
a7a195505a1649ff96196bdd35209b4a4306ffec.translatedText: The second is regional governance. Regional economic cooperation, regional security and stability, especially the stability and order building of the political, economic and security architecture in the Asia-Pacific region, are the common interests of both countries. China and the United States can jointly provide public goods for regional governance, maintain regional security, manage crises, cooperate on regional institutional arrangements, and commit to regional governance. The Korean Peninsula nuclear issue, the Iranian nuclear issue, the Syrian issue, etc. all require the two countries to work together to maintain regional security and stability. At present, the crisis on the Korean Peninsula is about to break out and there is a danger of losing control. The common interests of China and the United States are to maintain peace on the peninsula, prevent nuclear proliferation, and achieve the denuclearization of the peninsula.

efd25966bb92c028b1ec0c3f350a147e775d6c84.sourceText: 三是全球治理。首先是全球公域治理。以海洋、太空、网络、极地等为代表的全球公域仍处于无序状态，缺乏治理机制和规则约束，亟待建章立制，规范全球公域的开发、管理和治理。中美作为在全球公域治理事务上拥有较大实力和话语权的国家，全球公域的发展和治理是中美两国的共同利益，这为两国合作制定治理规范和监管体系提供了潜在空间。
efd25966bb92c028b1ec0c3f350a147e775d6c84.translatedText: The third is global governance. The first is global commons governance. The global commons represented by oceans, space, networks, polar regions, etc. are still in a state of disorder and lack governance mechanisms and rule constraints. There is an urgent need to establish rules and regulations to standardize the development, management and governance of global commons. As countries with greater strength and say in the governance of global commons, China and the United States have common interests in the development and governance of global commons. This provides potential space for the two countries to cooperate in formulating governance norms and supervision systems.

ffe688db813605f31669f04092995ed42bcac07f.sourceText: 其次是全球规范治理。美国认识到，国际规则的构建、国际秩序的维护、国际制度的运行等单靠美国自身已经力不从心，无法独自解决的全球性问题越来越多，两国可在现有国际体系的基本原则和基本架构下对现有全球规范的治理进行适当的调整。
ffe688db813605f31669f04092995ed42bcac07f.translatedText: The second is global normative governance. The United States recognizes that the establishment of international rules, the maintenance of international order, and the operation of international systems are beyond the capabilities of the United States alone and that there are more and more global problems that cannot be solved alone. The two countries can make appropriate adjustments to the governance of existing global norms based on the basic principles and basic structure of the existing international system.

3b6f426fe59a61d1e00d532f44dd2442b893cbe3.sourceText: 形成有利于结构优化、社会公平的税收制度，增加低收入者收入，调节过高收入，实现发展成果由人民共享
3b6f426fe59a61d1e00d532f44dd2442b893cbe3.translatedText: Form a tax system that is conducive to structural optimization and social fairness, increase the income of low-income earners, regulate excessively high incomes, and realize that the fruits of development are shared by the people

1a8b0610cbcb62d9134e7c4780c5d8406cf1bad3.sourceText: 近日，俏江南集团董事长张兰因”注销户口、变更国籍”一事引发民众广泛关注。
1a8b0610cbcb62d9134e7c4780c5d8406cf1bad3.translatedText: Recently, Zhang Lan, chairman of South Beauty Group, has attracted widespread public attention for "cancelling her household registration and changing her nationality."

280eea223d33a95f3eb19490afbbe97f95c91f91.sourceText: 这些年，选择移民的中国富人并非张兰一个，引发的热议也从未停止。
280eea223d33a95f3eb19490afbbe97f95c91f91.translatedText: In recent years, Zhang Lan is not the only wealthy Chinese person who has chosen to immigrate, and the heated discussion has never stopped.

9027d85a921e788b430eaf59d28a3d2601ae6320.sourceText: 反观一些欧美国家，为何民众面对富人移民却淡定得多？原因之一可能与中国富人相比，部分欧美国家的富人在移民时，要面对复杂的税收。
9027d85a921e788b430eaf59d28a3d2601ae6320.translatedText: On the other hand, in some European and American countries, why are people so much calmer in the face of wealthy immigrants? One reason may be that compared with wealthy Chinese, wealthy individuals from some European and American countries have to face complex taxes when immigrating.

4424f191d4ac084c1dc29c2972d191437904d750.sourceText: 据媒体报道，根据美国税法规定，美国公民即使放弃美国国籍，美国政府也可追溯5年，要求其补齐放弃美国国籍前5年拥有的海外资产隐匿不报而逃避的税收和罚金。如果没有依法纳税，按照新的主动申报方案当中的规定，这些人得补交8年的税款和利息，外加一笔罚金，罚金数额为受罚人过去8年当中最高账户余额的 25%。
4424f191d4ac084c1dc29c2972d191437904d750.translatedText: According to media reports, according to U.S. tax laws, even if a U.S. citizen relinquishes U.S. citizenship, the U.S. government can look back for five years and require him to make up for the taxes and penalties he evaded by concealing overseas assets owned five years before giving up U.S. citizenship. If they fail to pay taxes in accordance with the law, according to the provisions of the new voluntary declaration plan, these people will have to pay back taxes and interest for 8 years, plus a penalty amount of 25% of the penaltyee's highest account balance in the past 8 years.

7cfd4b6fd41a9cd8b4e8641e09e62f0ff52febf6.sourceText: 此外，美国法律规定，放弃美国国籍的特定人群需为超过60万美元的未实现资产收益缴税，即”退出税”（Exit Tax）。据媒体之前的报道，”脸谱”联合创始人爱德华多?#33832;维林移民时为其持有的”脸谱”股权收益所需缴纳的税金约为3.65亿美元，这笔巨额款项可以一直推迟到他出售”脸谱”股权时才缴纳。但如果选择推迟缴纳，萨维林需要向美国政府付上每年3.28%的利息。
7cfd4b6fd41a9cd8b4e8641e09e62f0ff52febf6.translatedText: In addition, U.S. law stipulates that certain people who give up U.S. citizenship need to pay tax on unrealized asset gains exceeding $600,000, known as "Exit Tax." According to previous media reports, Facebook co-founder Eduardo Verin had to pay about $365 million in taxes on his Facebook equity gains when he immigrated. This huge amount can be deferred until he sells his Facebook equity. But if he chooses to defer payment, Saverin will need to pay an annual interest of 3.28% to the US government.

ffd6ae152c73d5345af2db7686e377e97344738a.sourceText: 相比之下，中国富人想要弃籍就轻松得多。根据《中华人民共和国国籍法》第十条规定，中国公民具有下列条件之一的，可以经申请批准退出中国国籍：一、外国人的近亲属；二、定居在外国的；三、有其它正当理由。另据第九条规定，定居外国的中国公民，自愿加入或取得外国国籍的，即自动丧失中国国籍。在我国现行征收的几大税种中，并无 ”退出税”，而且对富豪应纳税的境外所得采取自行申报制，其放弃国籍时，追溯也并不严格。
ffd6ae152c73d5345af2db7686e377e97344738a.translatedText: In contrast, it is much easier for wealthy Chinese to abandon their citizenship. According to Article 10 of the "Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China", Chinese citizens who meet one of the following conditions may renounce Chinese nationality upon application and approval: 1. Close relatives of foreigners; 2. Those who have settled in a foreign country; 3. There are other legitimate reasons. According to Article 9, Chinese citizens who have settled abroad and voluntarily join or acquire foreign nationality will automatically lose their Chinese nationality. Among the major types of taxes currently levied in our country, there is no "exit tax", and a self-declaration system is adopted for the taxable overseas income of the wealthy. When they give up their nationality, the traceability is not strict.

dfb8466c1ebeb5be1936dbea182909713a93c27a.sourceText: 税制上的每一步优化，都是老百姓最关心的利益问题。形成有利于结构优化、社会公平的税收制度，增加低收入者收入，调节过高收入，实现发展成果由人民共享，是十八大(专题)报告中的重要内容。一些欧美国家应对富豪弃籍采取的措施，或许能为我们提供借鉴。
dfb8466c1ebeb5be1936dbea182909713a93c27a.translatedText: Every step of optimization of the tax system is the most important issue of interest for the people. Forming a tax system that is conducive to structural optimization and social fairness, increasing the income of low-income earners, regulating excessively high incomes, and realizing that development results are shared by the people are important contents in the report of the 18th National Congress (thematic). The measures taken by some European and American countries to deal with wealthy people abandoning their citizenship may provide us with reference.

4000b665788071575abbcb63ef1df9dcb0412e81.sourceText: 经济 | 苹果疑在亚利桑那州大招人马，测试自动驾驶汽车
4000b665788071575abbcb63ef1df9dcb0412e81.translatedText: Economy | Apple is suspected of hiring a lot of people in Arizona to test self-driving cars

e16e7deb076767b2b2759a7a7d0e8f6a269bacd4.sourceText: 经济 | 苹果疑在亚利桑那州大招人马，测试自动驾驶汽车 雷锋网11月29日消息 据外媒 MacRumors 近…
e16e7deb076767b2b2759a7a7d0e8f6a269bacd4.translatedText: Economy | Apple is suspected of hiring a lot of people in Arizona to test self-driving cars. News from Lei Feng.com on November 29, according to foreign media MacRumors Recently...

b06e434b31e933074eac9a3fdb6787fc92cfc0df.sourceText: 雷锋网11月29日消息 据外媒 MacRumors 近日报道，有匿名消息人士爆料称，苹果公司正在亚利桑那州测试自动驾驶汽车，并且最近开始招募相关工作人员。
b06e434b31e933074eac9a3fdb6787fc92cfc0df.translatedText: News from Lei Feng.com on November 29, according to foreign media MacRumors Recently, it was reported that anonymous sources broke the news that Apple is testing self-driving cars in Arizona and has recently begun recruiting relevant staff.

c2f59da7887ab1439aee1576b0e41dc9464fa12f.sourceText: 消息人士称，在过去几个月的时间里，苹果公司一直在该州附近的前菲亚特-克莱斯勒汽车测试基地招聘多名测试工程师和技术人员。苹果在招募过程中已经表明，需要测试的是自动驾驶技术。
c2f59da7887ab1439aee1576b0e41dc9464fa12f.translatedText: > Sources say that over the past few months, Apple has been recruiting multiple test engineers and technicians at the former Fiat Chrysler Automobiles testing site near the state. Apple has made it clear during the recruitment process that what needs to be tested is self-driving technology.

213c95ccb69a4c473da0b91579a9d10cc4ce0e27.sourceText: 该场地于 2005 年以 3.12 亿美元的价格被卖给了一家房地产开发商，但后来又被 Surprise 市拿了回去，且多年来没有受到影响。根据参观过测试场地的人士介绍，该场地满足多项驾驶模拟条件，如椭圆形飚速环道、不同坡度的路面（包括可以模拟潮湿天气的路面状况）、以及交叉路口等。
213c95ccb69a4c473da0b91579a9d10cc4ce0e27.translatedText: The site was sold to a real estate developer in 2005 for $312 million, but was later taken back by the city of Surprise and remained untouched for years. According to people who have visited the test site, the site meets a number of driving simulation conditions, such as oval speed loops, roads with different slopes (including road conditions that can simulate wet weather), and intersections.

6a592757bf5d3aa1779b2a7fe208846c3d07ebe4.sourceText: 此前曾有记录表明该场地已经被租给了一家名为Route 14 Investment Partners LLC的公司。虽然目前不能看出苹果和这家公司是否具有明确的联系，但从此前的报道来看，苹果已经熟知使用壳牌公司来进行物业、商标出租等用途。
6a592757bf5d3aa1779b2a7fe208846c3d07ebe4.translatedText: Previous records indicate that the site has been leased to a company called Route 14 Investment Partners LLC. Although it is currently unclear whether Apple has a clear connection with this company, judging from previous reports, Apple is already familiar with using Shell for property, trademark leasing and other purposes.

c04d01490fd3e0c07b229261abbd05c936d25c8c.sourceText: 同时，此前也有报道显示，克莱斯勒公司曾在这个测试场地测试各种恶劣环境下对于汽车车体和涂装的影响。
c04d01490fd3e0c07b229261abbd05c936d25c8c.translatedText: At the same time, previous reports showed that Chrysler had used this test site to test the effects of various harsh environments on car bodies and coatings.

d7d28e0997682b782c66f2a3aa23dc629b503577.sourceText: 美国亚利桑那州可以算是研发自动驾驶技术较为活跃的地区。根据外媒报道，该州的自动驾驶技术上路测试政策是全美国最友好的，因此吸引了包括Uber在内的许多公司，在该地区进行道路测试。
d7d28e0997682b782c66f2a3aa23dc629b503577.translatedText: Arizona in the United States can be regarded as a relatively active area in the development of autonomous driving technology. According to foreign media reports, the state’s road testing policy for autonomous driving technology is the most friendly in the United States, which has attracted many companies, including Uber, to conduct road testing in the region.

72359109760a91c445b39494092716d7d8679da0.sourceText: 谷歌兄弟公司Waymo也一直在亚利桑那州开展自动驾驶汽车的测试。在经过九年的开发之后，Waymo 已向外表示，将会在未来几个月内，在亚利桑那州的凤凰城正式推出无人出租车服务。
72359109760a91c445b39494092716d7d8679da0.translatedText: Google's sister company Waymo has also been testing self-driving cars in Arizona. After nine years of development, Waymo has stated that it will officially launch its autonomous taxi service in Phoenix, Arizona in the next few months.

078a10a4cd08786811ec7add1062fdcb35fe198c.sourceText: 目前苹果和克莱斯勒均未证实苹果在该州布局无人驾驶的言论。
078a10a4cd08786811ec7add1062fdcb35fe198c.translatedText: Currently neither Apple nor Chrysler has confirmed Apple’s remarks about deploying self-driving cars in the state.

ccbed4eed3a2c6e280b182e74cdfc8394463fb56.sourceText: 虽然在自动驾驶领域，苹果起步晚于Waymo、Uber、特斯拉等一系列汽车厂商，但其正在稳步前进。
ccbed4eed3a2c6e280b182e74cdfc8394463fb56.translatedText: Although Apple started later than Waymo, Uber, Tesla and other car manufacturers in the field of autonomous driving, it is making steady progress.

0fd01c00c203881109eb2d27644eb699c6c6a376.sourceText: 苹果已经从加州政府获得了在马路上测试自动驾驶汽车的牌照。而在不久前，苹果也罕见地通过论文的方式，对外公开了一项新的自动驾驶研发技术。据了解，该项技术可在仅仅使用激光雷达的条件下，依靠软件工具，能精准识别周边路况。而现在，如消息人士爆料，苹果正在亚利桑那州大招人马进行自动驾驶技术测试，不难看出其在无人驾驶领域付出的努力和决心。
0fd01c00c203881109eb2d27644eb699c6c6a376.translatedText: Apple has obtained a license from the California government to test self-driving cars on the road. Not long ago, Apple also rarely disclosed a new autonomous driving research and development technology through a paper. It is understood that this technology can accurately identify surrounding road conditions by relying on software tools using only lidar. Now, as sources have revealed, Apple is recruiting people to test autonomous driving technology in Arizona. It is not difficult to see its efforts and determination in the field of autonomous driving.

bd6d0870c9e9b3ddd4916888e3d444bf725877ed.sourceText: 总体来看，苹果在该领域还是面临巨大的挑战。不管是自动驾驶技术还是汽车设备，都与该领域的领先厂商存在若干年的差距。特别是在数据积累、人工智能等领域远远落后于竞争对手。而我们应该都清楚，这些差距仍然需要时间来追赶。
bd6d0870c9e9b3ddd4916888e3d444bf725877ed.translatedText: Overall, Apple still faces huge challenges in this field. Whether it is autonomous driving technology or automotive equipment, there is a gap of several years with the leading manufacturers in this field. Especially in areas such as data accumulation and artificial intelligence, it lags far behind its competitors. And we should all know that these gaps will still take time to catch up.

0842fbcd65b80b7f0849b7d375749ea8bd87b538.sourceText: （孔子学院来稿 艾米丽编译）国际知名的培训教师特里华尔兹（Terry Waltz）将在本周五和周六为中文教师带来为期两天的培训。特里说中文，她将会讲述很多学习教中文的技巧。图桑高中外国语老师们已经在过去的几年中开始使用TPRS教学模式，在学生语言能力，课堂管理方面取得非常好的教学效果。 教师培训时间：5月10日本周五上午8时至下午3：20 5月11日本周六上午8时至下午3：20 地点：图桑高中图书馆 有兴趣的老师可上网报名：http://www.surveymonkey.com/s/YSHRDGM 本次活动免费

35d682006564465d9ebb06a029f1a5f99323523c.translatedText: Rising labor costs in China will have limited impact on U.S. inflation Xinhuanet Since the beginning of this year, the inflation level in the United States has been rising month by month, with the inflation rate in May reaching 3.57%. This is...

11545bc2a32fa2899c8cb14b4e51475152b239e7.sourceText: 美国的一些经济学家认为，很多美国人赖以生存的”中国制造”商品价格上涨，帮助推高了美国通胀，而这又缘于中国劳动力成本的上升以及中国国内通胀的对外传导。
11545bc2a32fa2899c8cb14b4e51475152b239e7.translatedText: Some economists in the United States believe that the rising prices of "Made in China" goods that many Americans rely on for survival have helped push up U.S. inflation, and this is due to the rise in China's labor costs and the external transmission of China's domestic inflation.

fb02b9875b7311954a96393e45e2b09ceacff874.sourceText: 今年5月，中国居民消费价格指数(CPI)同比涨5.5%，创34个月新高，通胀形势依然严峻。
fb02b9875b7311954a96393e45e2b09ceacff874.translatedText: In May this year, China's consumer price index (CPI) rose 5.5% year-on-year, hitting a 34-month high. The inflation situation remains severe.

92ad01852ddceb850686887a85185209f7476c6f.sourceText: 中国社科院金融所金融市场室主任曹红辉说，中国的劳动力成本确实在上升，但它对于美国通胀的影响是微弱的，甚至难以构成显著的正相关关系。
92ad01852ddceb850686887a85185209f7476c6f.translatedText: Cao Honghui, director of the Financial Markets Office of the Institute of Finance, Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, said that China's labor costs are indeed rising, but its impact on U.S. inflation is weak, and it is difficult to even form a significant positive correlation.

5b54a02998866f88c322180b86ae531c80b3c2aa.sourceText: 中国劳工工资水平虽然一直在提升，但并非”暴涨”，其近些年来的上涨幅度保持在10%左右，由于基数较低，比之其他新兴市场国家，涨后的工资仍然偏低。
5b54a02998866f88c322180b86ae531c80b3c2aa.translatedText: Although China's labor wage levels have been increasing, it is not a "skyrocketing". The increase in recent years has remained around 10%. Due to the low base, compared with other emerging market countries, the post-increase wages are still low.

0d9f8a2f505a66a6aec7bbeacad86eb6d63afeae.sourceText: 劳动力价格上涨是在中国经济发展、人口结构转变和收入分配改革政策共同影响下发生的。中国劳动力成本在商品价格中的比重偏低，特别是在加工贸易领域，还不到10%，即使出现一定程度的上涨，对产品最终价格的影响也十分有限。产品价格是由供需双方决定的，需要经过市场能否接受的检验，并非单纯由劳动力价格上涨决定。
0d9f8a2f505a66a6aec7bbeacad86eb6d63afeae.translatedText: The rise in labor prices is caused by China's economic development, demographic transformation and income distribution reform policies. The proportion of China's labor costs in commodity prices is relatively low, especially in the field of processing trade, less than 10%. Even if there is a certain increase, the impact on the final price of the product will be very limited. Product prices are determined by both supply and demand and need to be tested to see if they can be accepted by the market. They are not simply determined by rising labor prices.

55f3564b9324a14a1b7b7706dafe03ae1cf58c2a.sourceText: 由于各新兴市场经济体之间存在显著竞争关系，低端消费品比较容易形成替代关系，中国出口到美国的商品价格是难以真正大幅上升的。
55f3564b9324a14a1b7b7706dafe03ae1cf58c2a.translatedText: Due to the significant competition between emerging market economies, low-end consumer goods are relatively easy to form substitution relationships, and it is difficult for the prices of goods exported from China to the United States to rise significantly.

c16e646eb2c2e2c347ebd97ffa55facc5008af22.translatedText: A World War II memorial will be built in Phoenix (Alberta Times) The state parliament recently approved the establishment of a special committee responsible for creating a World War II memorial in Phoenix. …

34b51c588df439e8d5441a7a82c3f5c30ad5b1ad.sourceText: 州议会日前批准成立一个特别委员会，负责在凤凰城创建一个二战纪念馆。 政府立法委员会上周批准建立纪念馆的动议，计划于今年12月7日破土动工。纪念馆主要展出从珍珠港亚利桑那号打捞出的枪支，和密苏里号战舰，还有二战老兵使用过的武器等。 1941年，日本偷袭珍珠港，击沉美军的亚利桑那号，迫使美国参战。密苏里号是太平洋战争结束时，日军签署投降仪式的战舰，两者意义非凡。州务卿肯贝内特为了争取亚利桑那号枪支出了不少力，从一个名为”向坠落的枪支致敬”的团体中争取过来。
34b51c588df439e8d5441a7a82c3f5c30ad5b1ad.translatedText: The state Legislature recently approved the establishment of a special committee responsible for creating a World War II memorial in Phoenix. The Government Legislative Committee approved the motion to build a memorial hall last week, and plans to break ground on December 7 this year. The memorial hall mainly displays guns salvaged from the USS Arizona at Pearl Harbor, the USS Missouri battleship, and weapons used by World War II veterans. In 1941, Japan attacked Pearl Harbor and sank the USS Arizona, forcing the United States to join the war. The USS Missouri was the battleship on which the Japanese signed the surrender ceremony at the end of the Pacific War. The two are of great significance. Secretary of State Ken Bennett worked hard to secure the Arizona's gun from a group called "Salute to the Fallen Gun."

6b4688ed72f1a8ca46c9f881413f5f8ba284d3be.sourceText: 中国几大银行拒赴日参加国际金融年会

8475d17cef798ea373d23f5aa51d1c62bba3907c.translatedText: Several major Chinese banks refused to go to Japan to participate in the International Financial Annual Conference Washington? According to foreign media reports, Sino-Japanese relations have intensified due to the sovereignty dispute over the Diaoyu Islands (called the Senkaku Islands in Japan)...

4b8a82bf13e1c9ee764028fd7c3aefdc2f05ece0.sourceText: 报道说，目前中国农业银行和交通银行已表示取消全部活动，工商银行和建设银行的总部人员不赴东京与会，只派遣东京分行人员参加会议，只有中国银行还未表明是否出席。
4b8a82bf13e1c9ee764028fd7c3aefdc2f05ece0.translatedText: Reports say that the Agricultural Bank of China and the Bank of Communications have canceled all activities. The headquarters personnel of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China and the China Construction Bank will not go to Tokyo to attend the meeting. Only Tokyo branch personnel will be sent to attend the meeting. Only the Bank of China has not yet stated whether it will attend.

030c1b7abcf27ba3e585e084867ced5f14fb9e4b.sourceText: 报道表示，多数中国银行都没有说明在最后时刻决定不参加会议的理由，但外界分析，北京明显想表达不快，而中日钓鱼岛主权争端已影响到经济领域，超越了地区性争端的范围。
030c1b7abcf27ba3e585e084867ced5f14fb9e4b.translatedText: The report stated that most Chinese banks did not explain the reasons for their decision not to participate in the meeting at the last moment. However, outside analysis showed that Beijing clearly wanted to express its displeasure, and the Sino-Japanese sovereignty dispute over the Diaoyu Islands has affected the economic field and exceeded the scope of regional disputes.

b3096e857bdcb8c4da3add4997f1be392d9a2bfb.sourceText: 世界银行和IMF的年会是世界金融、经济方面官员、非政府组织和银行业最大的聚会之一。年会组织方估计，将有约2万名代表参加10月9日到14日召开的年会和各类研讨活动。
b3096e857bdcb8c4da3add4997f1be392d9a2bfb.translatedText: The annual meetings of the World Bank and IMF are one of the largest gatherings of financial and economic officials, non-governmental organizations and the banking industry in the world. The organizers of the annual meeting estimate that about 20,000 representatives will participate in the annual meeting and various seminars held from October 9 to 14.

540098906d1240b056dd32edc33b5b9c8b395771.sourceText: 国际货币基金组织总裁拉加德星期二在华盛顿举行的记者会上对中日两国因钓鱼岛主权争端产生的摩擦表示关切，希望双方能冷静处理纠纷，并担心中日对立影响世界经济的增长。
540098906d1240b056dd32edc33b5b9c8b395771.translatedText: At a press conference in Washington on Tuesday, International Monetary Fund President Christine Lagarde expressed concern about the friction between China and Japan over the dispute over the Diaoyu Islands sovereignty. She hopes that both sides can handle the dispute calmly and is worried that the confrontation between China and Japan will affect the growth of the world economy.

263a67132ffd4b3731848ed0a02b5e7294183695.sourceText: 她说，目前不稳定的全球经济需要这两个经济大国”全面接触”。
263a67132ffd4b3731848ed0a02b5e7294183695.translatedText: She said the current unstable global economy required "full engagement" between the two economic giants.

0f3411eff2abc718431542eb1897d37994567baa.sourceText: 中日两国的国内民族主义情绪以及长期隔阂在某种程度上激化了两国的主权争端。外界担心，中日岛争会损坏这两个亚洲最大经济体之间的贸易关系。
0f3411eff2abc718431542eb1897d37994567baa.translatedText: Domestic nationalist sentiments and long-term estrangement between China and Japan have intensified the sovereignty dispute between the two countries to some extent. The outside world is worried that the island dispute between China and Japan will damage the trade relations between Asia's two largest economies.

cd8ec3c440dba9761ed96b5f204303c4871c4414.translatedText: There are nearly 80 Chinese teachers on site

cd707a8c35083bbb98d5a4523c11b683ece1091c.sourceText: 12月4日上午9点，亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院邀请王周淑涵教授，在MU 为220教师举行了中文教师讲座。王教授是马里兰大学国家外语中心副主任，特拉华州外语国际教育督学，亚洲协会中文推广执行长。她长期从事中文教育的推广工作，这次讲座受到了当地中文教师的热烈欢迎。孔子学院的院长司马德琳教授致欢迎词，感谢王教授来亚利桑那讲学，当天接近80位从学前教育到大学教育的中文教师到现场听课，大家都表示受益匪浅。 王周淑涵教授从学习者，教学者两个角度来分析一堂课的设置，用5Cs的标准来评价课程Communication、 Cultures、 Connections、 Comparison、 Community王教授认为Community和Comparison应该放在最前面，因为交流都是应该在一个community裡进行的，Comparison是强调方法，思考的方法，材料运用的方法等等。王教授要求中文课要尽量使用中文，不要用太多的英文来解释，因为这样能够促进学生的思考，当他们遇到不懂的词要自己去思考，弄明白。老师在课堂上可以运用很多教学材料，例如歌曲，诗歌，故事等等，但是在选择材料时要尽量使用学生生活中用得到的，或者稍微高于他们能力的材料，这样既能巩固他们学过的旧知识也能获得新的信息。王教授将大部分的教学规则都用简短的话总结出来，给老师们带来很直接的帮助。
cd707a8c35083bbb98d5a4523c11b683ece1091c.translatedText: At 9 a.m. on December 4, the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University invited Professor Wang Zhoushuhan to hold a Chinese teacher lecture for 220 teachers at MU. Professor Wang is the deputy director of the National Foreign Language Center at the University of Maryland, the superintendent of foreign language and international education in Delaware, and the executive director of Chinese language promotion at Asia Society. She has been engaged in the promotion of Chinese education for a long time, and this lecture was warmly welcomed by local Chinese teachers. Professor Smadelin, the director of the Confucius Institute, delivered a welcome speech and thanked Professor Wang for coming to Arizona to give lectures. Nearly 80 Chinese teachers from preschool education to university education attended the lecture that day, and everyone said they benefited a lot. Professor Wang Zhoushuhan analyzed the setting of a class from the perspective of learners and teachers, and used the 5Cs standard to evaluate the courses Communication, Cultures, Connections, Comparison, and Community. Professor Wang believed that Community and Comparison should be placed at the top because communication should be carried out in a community. Comparison emphasizes methods, methods of thinking, methods of using materials, etc. Professor Wang requires that Chinese classes should use Chinese as much as possible and not use too much English to explain, because this can promote students' thinking. When they encounter words they don't understand, they have to think and figure it out by themselves. Teachers can use many teaching materials in the classroom, such as songs, poems, stories, etc., but when selecting materials, they should try to use materials that students can use in their lives, or that are slightly above their abilities. This can not only consolidate the old knowledge they have learned, but also obtain new information. Professor Wang summarized most of the teaching rules in short words, bringing very direct help to teachers.

eb4dfe7e2131191af5ea2e8c18bbf5e17a0a87fd.sourceText: 在演讲的间隙，记者问王教授相与其他州相比，亚利桑那州的中文教育发展情况怎样？王教授说最近5年亚利桑那州发展的非常迅速。特别是以孔子学院为中心，抓住了教师培训这个重要点。这样孔子学院与各中文学校，公立学校中的孔子课堂一起形成了面，这是非常好的格局。只有老师的质量拉上去了，中文教育才有希望。在问到在这个基本中文教育的面基本形成的情况下，下一步应该加强哪些方面的发展？王教授表示有专家进行培训很重要，但是更应该提供一些当地教师相互交流的机会，可以多开一些公开课，让大家相互交流经验。同时也让更多的美国主流社会看到中文教育的成果，让他们对中文教育充满信心。同时美国联邦基金扶持的”星谈计划”也有很多为中文老师提供的培训机会，老师们可以走出去和全美的教师一起探讨中文教育。欢迎老师们到 www.startalk.umd.edu,看看，找到适合自己的培训项目。王教授还指出，很多人只关注到自己教授的课程，其实他们没有体会到，他们正在做一件非常伟大的事情，就是在建设海外中文教育的课程体系。因为和西班牙文，英文不同，很多中文教学的课程设计都是由中文老师来完成的，他们对全美建设中文教学体系起了非常重要的作用。 王周淑涵教授不仅从细的方面给中文老师们带来很多设计课程的好办法，同时也为亚利桑那州整体中文教育的发展提出了很好建议。
eb4dfe7e2131191af5ea2e8c18bbf5e17a0a87fd.translatedText: During the break of the speech, the reporter asked Professor Wang how the development of Chinese education in Arizona compares with other states. Professor Wang said that Arizona has developed very rapidly in the past five years. In particular, with the Confucius Institute as the center, the important point of teacher training has been grasped. In this way, the Confucius Institute has formed an interface with various Chinese schools and Confucius Classrooms in public schools. This is a very good pattern. Only when the quality of teachers improves can Chinese education have hope. When asked, with this basic aspect of Chinese education basically formed, what aspects of development should be strengthened next? Professor Wang said that it is important to have experts for training, but more opportunities should be provided for local teachers to communicate with each other, and more open classes can be held to allow everyone to exchange experiences. At the same time, it also allows more mainstream American society to see the results of Chinese education, giving them confidence in Chinese education. At the same time, the "Star Talk Project" supported by the federal funds of the United States also provides many training opportunities for Chinese teachers. Teachers can go out and discuss Chinese education with teachers across the United States. Teachers are welcome to go to www.startalk.umd.edu to take a look and find a training program that suits you. Professor Wang also pointed out that many people only pay attention to the courses they teach. In fact, they do not realize that they are doing a very great thing, which is building an overseas Chinese education curriculum system. Because unlike Spanish and English, many Chinese teaching curriculum designs are completed by Chinese teachers, who have played a very important role in building a Chinese teaching system across the United States. Professor Wang Zhoushuhan not only brought many good ways to design courses to Chinese teachers in detail, but also made good suggestions for the development of overall Chinese education in Arizona.

d7dfb42b5f6bf8199cb7c591b1834df8fd72e538.sourceText: 据北京铁路局相关负责人介绍，中国铁路客户服务中心网站(www.12306.cn)只对注册用户提供网上购买火车票服务，互联网用户在网站购票前，须先注册为网站用户。网站每日5时至24时提供购票服务。
d7dfb42b5f6bf8199cb7c591b1834df8fd72e538.translatedText: According to the relevant person in charge of the Beijing Railway Bureau, the China Railway Customer Service Center website (www.12306.cn) only provides online train ticket purchasing services to registered users. Internet users must register as website users before purchasing tickets on the website. The website provides ticket purchasing services from 5:00 to 24:00 every day.

97b356f099b30e76576f8a728843e4261d62c243.sourceText: 电话订票统一号码为95105105。直接拨打本地订票电话，即可接入电话订票系统，只收取本地普通话费。电话订票系统每日开放时间为6时至23时。
97b356f099b30e76576f8a728843e4261d62c243.translatedText: The unified number for telephone booking is 95105105. Directly dial the local ticket booking number to access the telephone booking system, and only local ordinary phone charges will be charged. The telephone booking system is open daily from 6:00 to 23:00.

eb1fe13cfbf12444318abda41d71b19fde049eb5.sourceText: 一张有效身份证件同一乘车日期同一车次只能购买一张车票(但使用同行成年人的有效身份证件信息购买儿童票的除外)。同一笔订单可购买的车票数量不超过5张。
eb1fe13cfbf12444318abda41d71b19fde049eb5.translatedText: A valid ID document can only purchase one ticket for the same train on the same date of travel (except for children's tickets purchased using the valid ID document information of accompanying adults). The number of tickets that can be purchased in the same order shall not exceed 5.

74fbaea803c4a1e4fad1c692ad207529ded7c493.sourceText: 网络购票有4种有效证件，分别是”中华人民共和国居民身份证”、”港澳居民来往内地通行证”、”台湾居民来往大陆通行证”、”护照”。而电话订票一代身份证也可以使用。
74fbaea803c4a1e4fad1c692ad207529ded7c493.translatedText: There are 4 valid documents for online ticket purchase, namely "Resident Identity Card of the People's Republic of China", "Mainland Travel Permit for Hong Kong and Macao Residents", "Mainland Travel Permit for Taiwan Residents", and "Passport". The first-generation ID card can also be used for telephone booking.

851c7c212fba723906c7e65c3539798ea1855bd4.sourceText: 铁路部门表示，使用二代身份证进行互联网和电话订票，可以提高换、取车票的速度。
851c7c212fba723906c7e65c3539798ea1855bd4.translatedText: The railway department stated that using second-generation ID cards for Internet and telephone bookings can speed up ticket exchange and pickup.

35099f8f03e77cafe77dd3b245813642105ecd62.sourceText: 1.凭订票时使用的证件、订票单号及实际乘车人的有效证件，至就近的车站或客票代售点窗口进行取票。
35099f8f03e77cafe77dd3b245813642105ecd62.translatedText: 1. With the ID used when booking the ticket, the ticket order number and the valid ID of the actual passenger, go to the nearest station or ticket sales point window to collect the ticket.

6de4406b1cf7eff0850d55d8b9d32af78e60dd63.sourceText: 2.取学生票时还应出示符合规定的学生减价优惠凭证(附学生优惠卡)；取儿童票时不须出示实际乘车人有效证件；取伤残军人(警察)票时应携带符合规定的减价优待凭证，至车站售票窗口办理取票业务。
6de4406b1cf7eff0850d55d8b9d32af78e60dd63.translatedText: 2. When picking up a student ticket, you should also present a compliant student discount voucher (with a student discount card); when picking up a child ticket, you do not need to show the valid ID of the actual passenger; when picking up a disabled soldier (police) ticket, you should bring a compliant voucher for discounted fare and go to the station ticket window to handle the ticket collection business.

359cf5c396c0681a7092693c6c50592270a8e949.sourceText: 3.在客票代售点取票，收取5元/张的客票销售服务费。
359cf5c396c0681a7092693c6c50592270a8e949.translatedText: 3. To collect tickets at the ticket sales point, a ticket sales service fee of 5 yuan/ticket will be charged.

13cb7fe76ddbeb4a7af0f581197481706df7d48f.translatedText: More than a thousand?#29454;Eagle?#38431; Crack down on ticket dealers

e7efcaeebe4be05fcc31ce5b5287589ea5abf569.sourceText: 晨报讯(记者 何欣)建立”黑名单”、盯控”黑号码”、跟踪”黑账户”厖记者昨天从铁道部公安局获悉，为维护旅客的权益以及铁路运输秩序，严厉打击倒卖火车票的违法犯罪活动，全国铁路公安机关将自即日起至明年2月16日，集中开展打击倒票的”猎鹰战役”。
e7efcaeebe4be05fcc31ce5b5287589ea5abf569.translatedText: Morning News (Reporter He Xin) established a "blacklist", monitored "black numbers", and tracked "black accounts." Reporter Pang learned yesterday from the Public Security Bureau of the Ministry of Railways that in order to safeguard the rights and interests of passengers and the order of railway transportation and severely crack down on illegal and criminal activities of reselling train tickets, the national railway public security agencies will focus on launching the "Falcon Campaign" to combat ticket scalping from now until February 16 next year.

2fa3caa6767561c9f6fc1e8dab2672e28def8a2b.sourceText: 春运到来前，铁路部门推出的实名制售票、互联网售票等措施，既方便了群众，又在一定程度上遏制了倒票行为。然而，票贩子们也随之改变了传统倒票方式，陆续出现了网络倒票、收集身份证套购车票等新方法。针对这一情况，铁路公安机关组建1046只”猎鹰”小分队，负责对票贩子寻迹追踪，打点掏窝。
2fa3caa6767561c9f6fc1e8dab2672e28def8a2b.translatedText: Before the arrival of the Spring Festival, the railway department launched real-name ticket sales, Internet ticket sales and other measures, which not only facilitated the masses, but also curbed ticket scalping to a certain extent. However, ticket dealers have also changed the traditional methods of ticket scalping, and new methods such as online ticket scalping and collecting ID cards to purchase tickets have emerged. In response to this situation, the railway public security agency established a team of 1,046 "Falcons" to track ticket dealers and crack down on them.

5d5553442fb9bef38aca0420ba30b3af55d99189.sourceText: 西站建实名验票亭 西侧停车场明起停用
5d5553442fb9bef38aca0420ba30b3af55d99189.translatedText: Real-name ticket inspection kiosks will be built at West Railway Station. The parking lot on the west side will be out of service from tomorrow

638797c813242dfb945e5603a011e086bc74cd23.sourceText: 晨报讯 (记者 陈琳)昨天，北京站、北京西站开始搭建实名验票亭。明年1月8日春运起，两站进站乘车开始实行实名制验票。届时，旅客需持与购票相同的身份证明进站乘车，车站不再发售站台票。
638797c813242dfb945e5603a011e086bc74cd23.translatedText: Morning News (Reporter Chen Lin) Yesterday, Beijing Railway Station and Beijing West Railway Station began to build real-name ticket inspection kiosks. Starting from January 8 next year during the Spring Festival travel season, real-name ticket verification will be implemented when entering and boarding the train at the two stations. At that time, passengers will need to bring the same identity certificate used to purchase tickets to enter the station and board the train, and platform tickets will no longer be sold at the station.

6d511fc90e27a2e1414dc428d26a896b1e7294b3.sourceText: 昨天下午，记者在北京西站北广场西侧空地上看到，施工人员正在组装白墙红顶的小亭子。每个小亭子约两平方米大小，四周都有窗户，为方便移动，小亭子四角还安装了轮子。
6d511fc90e27a2e1414dc428d26a896b1e7294b3.translatedText: Yesterday afternoon, reporters saw construction workers assembling a small pavilion with white walls and red roof in the open space on the west side of the North Square of Beijing West Railway Station. Each pavilion is about two square meters in size, with windows all around. To facilitate movement, wheels are installed on the four corners of the pavilion.

074e15ffdb37b2b815bff8d547120b82aed2774f.sourceText: 据悉，这种安检小亭子届时会移动到进站口，两个小亭子之间一个通道，一个小亭子里站两组工作人员背对背对通道里的乘客进行验票。在启用时，通道上方会加装防雪雨棚。
074e15ffdb37b2b815bff8d547120b82aed2774f.translatedText: It is reported that this kind of security check booth will be moved to the entrance of the station. There will be a passage between the two booths. In one booth, two groups of staff will stand back to back to check the tickets of passengers in the passage. When activated, a snow-proof canopy will be installed above the passage.

1f721875f9f97ec5b8ea8efcd9c51bf53f25ef41.sourceText: 据北京西站介绍，西站北广场一楼、二楼和南广场一共搭建110个验票通道，预计明年1月5日前能安装完毕。每个验票口前设有预检区。参照广州实名制验票经验，每个预检区口和验票口设一名武警。
1f721875f9f97ec5b8ea8efcd9c51bf53f25ef41.translatedText: According to Beijing West Railway Station, a total of 110 ticket inspection channels have been built on the first floor, second floor and south square of the North Square of West Railway Station. It is expected that they will be installed before January 5 next year. There is a pre-check area in front of each ticket gate. Based on Guangzhou’s real-name ticket inspection experience, an armed police officer is stationed at each pre-inspection area entrance and ticket inspection gate.

5074340febed2dbc7ef0fa3a77a8810ee30692d7.sourceText: 据介绍，为方便未带证件或证件丢失的旅客乘车，110个通道中包括14个公安制证口。
5074340febed2dbc7ef0fa3a77a8810ee30692d7.translatedText: According to reports, in order to facilitate passengers who do not bring their documents or have lost their documents to board the bus, the 110 passages include 14 public security entrances.

d07bdbb17784e9abc7a7a3e305881e7ac6b79936.sourceText: 另外，春运期间，北京西站站厅内还将设13台自助换票机，旅客也可自己到换票机上操作换取火车票。
d07bdbb17784e9abc7a7a3e305881e7ac6b79936.translatedText: In addition, during the Spring Festival travel period, 13 self-service ticket exchange machines will be installed in the station hall of Beijing West Railway Station. Passengers can also go to the ticket exchange machines themselves to exchange for train tickets.

62567ae9a3ac3008fb53933e7f98e7ad36a06a7b.sourceText: 为搭建临时售票窗口，从明天8点起，北京西站北广场西社会停车场在春运期间将禁止一切社会车辆包括大型车辆等进入，同时对停车场进行封闭。预计2012年1月23日恢复停车场使用。
62567ae9a3ac3008fb53933e7f98e7ad36a06a7b.translatedText: In order to set up a temporary ticket sales window, from 8 o'clock tomorrow, the West Social Parking Lot of the North Square of Beijing West Railway Station will prohibit the entry of all social vehicles, including large vehicles, during the Spring Festival travel period, and the parking lot will be closed at the same time. The parking lot is expected to resume use on January 23, 2012.

3d495bb6810aecc533b76bad02b4d53f1490e0bb.sourceText: 北京站验票区设立在北京站站前广场进站口与东西两个临时售票区之间的空地上，已经搭建起9个红顶白墙的简易房，工作人员在屋内安装电路设备和供暖设备，并给验票亭安装玻璃。
3d495bb6810aecc533b76bad02b4d53f1490e0bb.translatedText: >The ticket inspection area of ​​Beijing Station is set up in the open space between the entrance of the square in front of Beijing Station and the two temporary ticket sales areas on the east and west. Nine simple rooms with red roofs and white walls have been built. The staff installed circuit equipment and heating equipment in the houses, and installed glass on the ticket inspection booths.

b6739182735cd9379a2d88898c1e3e30e4e86ddb.sourceText: 春运期间，两站不再发售站台票，对于老幼病残孕等重点旅客，两站有专门的服务小组，保证他们能顺利上车。
b6739182735cd9379a2d88898c1e3e30e4e86ddb.translatedText: During the Spring Festival travel period, platform tickets will no longer be sold at the two stations. For key passengers such as the elderly, the young, the sick, the disabled and pregnant, the two stations have dedicated service teams to ensure that they can board the train smoothly.

7f802431e4ed0df5e811d63cd1a3a93f6f2f3877.sourceText: 儿童早期教育父母课堂走进新东方（图）
7f802431e4ed0df5e811d63cd1a3a93f6f2f3877.translatedText: Early childhood education parent classroom enters New Oriental (picture)

df625d2ed81e6fed3ddad334140bd80df10a915e.sourceText: 儿童早期教育父母课堂走进新东方（图） 有州政府专项资金支持的First Things First，亚利桑那…
df625d2ed81e6fed3ddad334140bd80df10a915e.translatedText: Early childhood education parent classroom enters New Oriental (picture) First Things First, supported by special funds from the state government, Arizona...

2a46b020e492161a31a495569fa4761f0b430445.sourceText: 儿童早期教育父母课堂走进新东方（图） 有州政府专项资金支持的First Things First，亚利桑那州儿童早期教育如今非常具体地覆盖到了华人社区。从10月19日开始，一个帮助父母学习儿童早期教育的课程在新东方艺术学校展开。新东方成为州政府儿童早期教育的第一个面对 华裔学校。 这个项目是针对怀孕到5岁儿童大脑的发育。美国当代著名的儿童早教专家Dr. Jill Stamm和她的助手ASU博士研究生Rachel Lam主讲。当晚Rachel给十几个亚裔家庭带来的精彩的介绍。很多父母总是希望从孩子懂事开始教他学习东西。Rachel介绍其实孩子的学习，大脑的发展从出生就开始了。 1岁的孩子，大脑的链接已经完成75%的发展。3岁是孩子的大脑已经是出生时的两倍。例如在孩子出生的前六个月是视觉发展最快的时间。如何与孩子交流，通常是通过视觉来完成的。在0-5岁的孩子，家长与婴儿身体的接触，与婴儿做的表情交流，都被孩子们的大脑记录下来，在他们默默无声的时候，已经从接触的世界里开始了大量的学习。早期教育研究专家发现在孤儿院成长的孩子，因为没有身体的接触，没有一对一的照顾和重视，他们的大脑发育，就和正常家庭孩子的发育程度不同。早期教育中给予孩子重视，肢体接触，言语表情的交流非常重要。 在接下去的十周的时间里，两位早期教育专家就会如何促进儿童大脑的发育给新父母们做专业的介绍，例如如何用音乐来发展儿童的大脑，不同的性别大脑发育的区别，怎样与孩子交流促进大脑的发展。州政府资助的早教课程将于每周四晚在新东方开课。
2a46b020e492161a31a495569fa4761f0b430445.translatedText: Early childhood education parent class enters New Oriental (picture) First Things First, supported by special funds from the state government, early childhood education in Arizona now very specifically covers the Chinese community. Starting from October 19, a course to help parents learn early childhood education was launched at New Oriental Art School. New Oriental became the state government’s first early childhood education school for Chinese Americans. This project targets the brain development of children from pregnancy to 5 years old. The famous contemporary American early childhood education expert Dr. Jill Stamm and her assistant ASU doctoral candidate Rachel Lam gave lectures. Rachel gave a wonderful introduction to more than a dozen Asian families that night. Many parents always hope to teach their children to learn things from the time they are sensible. Rachel introduced that in fact, children’s learning and brain development begin from birth. For a 1-year-old child, 75% of the brain's connections have completed development. By the age of 3, a child's brain is already twice the size it was at birth. For example, the first six months of a child's life is the time when a child's vision develops the fastest. How to communicate with children is usually done visually. For children aged 0-5, the physical contact between parents and the baby and the facial expressions communicated with the baby are all recorded by the children's brains. When they are silent, they have already begun to learn a lot from the world they are exposed to. Early education research experts have found that children who grow up in orphanages, because there is no physical contact, one-on-one care and attention, their brain development is different from that of children from normal families. Paying attention to children in early education, physical contact, and communication with verbal expressions are very important. In the next ten weeks, two early education experts will give professional introductions to new parents on how to promote children's brain development, such as how to use music to develop children's brains, the differences in brain development between different genders, and how to communicate with children to promote brain development. State government-funded early childhood education classes will start every Thursday evening at New Oriental.

ee4f69b84603338bb6afa39dc47c4596f87e4bde.sourceText: 孙俪要变亿万富婆 揭身家亿万的女星
ee4f69b84603338bb6afa39dc47c4596f87e4bde.translatedText: Sun Li wants to become a billionaire. An actress with a net worth of billions is revealed.

aa45e80b65ee90f2445ef3a28659afaaf7682ea4.sourceText: 孙俪要变亿万富婆 揭身家亿万的女星 5月7日晚8点，微博认证为”蓝鲸财经记者工作平台”…
aa45e80b65ee90f2445ef3a28659afaaf7682ea4.translatedText: Sun Li wants to become a billionaire. An actress with a net worth of billions is revealed. At 8pm on May 7, Weibo was certified as the "Blue Whale Financial Reporter Work Platform"...

683ba84d78fd25c875ba462550696611c6d353aa.sourceText: 为此新浪娱乐连线孙俪经纪人及海润影视创始人刘燕铭，刘燕铭否认蒋欣入股：”蒋欣？蒋欣是谁？她怎么会有海润的股份，她不是我们的演员。”孙俪经纪人则未做回复。
683ba84d78fd25c875ba462550696611c6d353aa.translatedText: For this reason, Sina Entertainment contacted Sun Li's agent and Hairun Film and Television founder Liu Yanming. Liu Yanming denied Jiang Xin's investment: "Jiang Xin? Who is Jiang Xin? How could she have shares in Hairun? She is not one of our actors." Sun Li's agent did not respond.

37b57fd271c78c93c205e8b54ef68bfc00c955c6.sourceText: 娱乐圈嫁得好的女明星不少，但是像李嘉欣这样嫁得如此之好的屈指可数。虽然丈夫许晋亨是个风流公子哥，但婚后牢牢被李大美人把住，李嘉欣在为夫家生子后更是母凭子贵得到过亿豪宅的奖赏，地位早已今非昔比。有如此财力雄厚的夫家，李嘉欣的生活绝对奢华。当初结婚时，8克拉鸽子蛋，500万婚纱，亿元婚礼惊呆了不少人。婚后李嘉欣奢华程度有过之而无不及，价值昂贵的铂金包包是她的最爱，出入都坐着老公为其专门购置的百万座驾，当然最令人咋舌的还是其市价2亿元的望海豪宅，最奢华的豪门媳妇李嘉欣当仁不让。
37b57fd271c78c93c205e8b54ef68bfc00c955c6.translatedText: > There are many female stars in the entertainment industry who marry well, but there are only a handful of women who marry as well as Michelle Reis. Although her husband Xu Jinheng was a romantic young man, he was firmly controlled by Dame Li after their marriage. After giving birth to a son for her husband's family, Li Jiaxin was rewarded with a mansion worth over 100 million yuan based on her son's wealth. Her status is no longer what it used to be. With such a wealthy husband's family, Michelle Reis' life is absolutely luxurious. When I first got married, the 8-carat pigeon egg, 5 million wedding dress, and 100 million yuan wedding shocked many people. After marriage, Michelle Reis's level of luxury was even greater. Expensive platinum bags were her favorite. She drove around in a million-dollar car specially purchased by her husband for her. Of course, the most astonishing thing was her Wanghai mansion with a market price of 200 million yuan. The most luxurious wealthy daughter-in-law, Michelle Reis, took her place.

6e60decbedd4c79e5d7dd6e771de69af438eb25a.sourceText: 婚前大S虽然也是娱乐圈的吸金大户，生活小奢侈，但绝对谈不上奢华。可是在嫁给汪小菲晋升为豪门阔台之后，奢华的本性一览无遗。出入名包在手大牌在身，身为?#38795;子控?#30340;她更是把当季各大一线品牌的名鞋悉数搜罗到家中，出入更是有千万豪车劳斯莱斯幻影保驾护航。最近，更传大S将暂时息影入住名下北京的4000万豪宅，专心造人以巩固自己豪门媳妇的位置。虽然从结婚时就站在新闻的风口浪尖，但大S依旧是那个我行我素的人，有钱就要现，绝不藏着掖着。
6e60decbedd4c79e5d7dd6e771de69af438eb25a.translatedText: Although Big S was also a big moneymaker in the entertainment industry before marriage and lived a small luxury life, it was definitely not luxurious. But after marrying Wang Xiaofei and being promoted to a wealthy family, her luxurious nature was clearly revealed. She carries luxury bags and big-name brands when she goes out. As a child control, she even collects all the famous shoes from all the first-line brands of the season into her home. She is also escorted by a million-dollar Rolls-Royce Phantom when she goes out. Recently, it has been rumored that Big S will temporarily take a break from acting and move into the 40 million mansion he owns in Beijing to concentrate on creating a wife to consolidate his position as the daughter-in-law of a wealthy family. Although she has been at the forefront of the news since her marriage, Big S is still a person who goes her own way. When she has money, she shows it and never hides it.

a0d24cfd6ac4ae5132dcf98561ef5a3b11c2fac5.sourceText: 从《还珠格格》里的小丫鬟到如今拥有自己工作室独当一面的大老板，范冰冰的蜕变让很多人羡慕。作为娱乐圈的”戏霸”和”代言女王”，年入数千万的范爷不差钱，因此才有底气喊出?#25105;自己就是豪门?#30340;豪言壮语。嘴上这么说，现实中范爷一举一动也都有豪门的派头。作为近年来公认的”时尚女王”，范冰冰的服装每件都价格不菲，搭配奢华的顶级品牌包包可谓是相当益彰。座驾是最新的奔驰S级，更有私人价值2000万的小型飞机，连给老妈买件衣服都动辄数十万，范爷财力的确不一般。
a0d24cfd6ac4ae5132dcf98561ef5a3b11c2fac5.translatedText: > From the little maid in "Huan Zhu Ge Ge" to the big boss with his own studio now, Fan Bingbing's transformation has made many people envious. As a "drama king" and "endorsement queen" in the entertainment industry, Mr. Fan, who earns tens of millions a year, is not short of money, so he has the confidence to say that he is a rich man. Saying this, in reality, every move made by Mr. Fan has the style of a wealthy family. As the recognized "fashion queen" in recent years, Fan Bingbing's clothes are all expensive, and they look great when paired with luxurious top-brand bags. The car he drives is the latest Mercedes-Benz S-Class, and he also owns a small plane worth 20 million yuan. Even buying clothes for his mother often costs hundreds of thousands. Mr. Fan's financial resources are indeed extraordinary.

22527da7da7fe9a88db9e5f047913a4428994ef1.sourceText: 作为歌坛的天后，王菲的身价自然不用多说，光复出后的巡演收入破亿。和李亚鹏婚前，王菲行事高调，婚后则是安心过着相夫教子的生活，不过没变的还是一如既往的大手笔，爱马仕包包从不离身，一身行头都10万起价，80万的保姆车眼都没眨就买下，此外和李亚鹏夫妻俩还有多辆豪车。最能看出王菲财力的还是其名下的物业，从最早的别墅嘉林花园，到丽高王府，再到晴翠园，每栋都市价千万以上，一座比一座豪华。
22527da7da7fe9a88db9e5f047913a4428994ef1.translatedText: As the queen of the music industry, it goes without saying that Faye Wong is worth more. Her tour revenue after her comeback exceeded 100 million. Before her marriage to Li Yapeng, Faye Wong acted in a high-profile manner, but after her marriage, she lived a peaceful life as a husband and raised children. However, what has not changed is that she is still as generous as ever. Hermès bags never leave her body, and her outfits all start at 100,000 yuan. She bought a nanny car worth 800,000 yuan without blinking an eye. In addition, she and Li Yapeng own several luxury cars. What best reflects Faye Wong's financial strength are the properties under her name, from the earliest villa Jialin Garden, to Ligao Palace, to Qingcui Garden, each of which is worth more than tens of millions, and each one is more luxurious than the last.

bfa7cb2bd3331955763a71c3e85eb10a01d3b08b.sourceText: 虽然和外国富豪前男友VIVI玩完，没能成功进入豪门，但身为一线女星，在国际上也颇具知名度，章子怡绝对是内地身家最高的女星。作为娱乐圈数一数二的女富婆，章子怡的奢侈程度绝对不遑多让，价值千万的鸽子蛋不知道晃瞎了多少人羡慕的眼睛，每次出现在镜头前无不是顶级品牌的一身行头，宛如贵妇出巡般。同时，其名下拥有多栋价值百万到千万的豪宅，跟赵本山、成龙等大腕一样坐拥5000万的私人飞机，”国际章”的消费能力真不是一般人能比的。也许在她看来，无论能不能嫁入豪门，至少自己要像个豪门。
bfa7cb2bd3331955763a71c3e85eb10a01d3b08b.translatedText: Although she ended her relationship with the wealthy foreign ex-boyfriend VIVI and failed to enter a wealthy family, as a first-line actress and well-known internationally, Zhang Ziyi is definitely the mainland actress with the highest net worth. As one of the richest women in the entertainment industry, Zhang Ziyi's level of luxury is by no means inferior. Her pigeon eggs worth tens of millions have blinded many people's envious eyes. Every time she appears in front of the camera, she is always dressed in top brands, just like a lady on a tour. At the same time, he owns many luxury houses worth millions to tens of millions, and like Zhao Benshan, Jackie Chan and other big names, he owns a 50 million private jet. The "International Chapter"'s spending power is really beyond the comparison of ordinary people. Maybe in her opinion, no matter whether she can marry into a wealthy family or not, she should at least look like a wealthy family.

ac380f9f8f5c82f260de6dd4e6cf13123dae6775.sourceText: 随着赵薇怀孕并在新加坡产下女儿，赵薇神秘老公黄有龙也渐渐浮上出面，黄有龙，香港富商。人称”龙哥”、”阿龙”，祖籍武汉，靠房地产发家，现主要在深、广两地投资经营度假村房地产项目。对于黄有龙的资产情况，有指其身家最少4亿，还拥有一架私人飞机。
ac380f9f8f5c82f260de6dd4e6cf13123dae6775.translatedText: As Zhao Wei became pregnant and gave birth to her daughter in Singapore, Zhao Wei's mysterious husband Huang Youlong also gradually came to light. Huang Youlong, a wealthy businessman in Hong Kong. Known as "Long Ge" and "Along", he is originally from Wuhan and made his fortune in real estate. Now he mainly invests and operates resort real estate projects in Shenzhen and Guangzhou. As for Huang Youlong's assets, it is said that he is worth at least 400 million and also owns a private jet.
