92a0701a1c42b24f98bf70d52aae420c1da0f21d.sourceText: 【凤凰笔会】 李建民：游东京增上寺有感 凤凰城 李建民 酷暑来游增上寺，神情凝重步蹒跚。 汴梁不复东京景，日本俨然唐汉观。 同种同宗煎太急，一衣带水两重天。 后庭玉树花犹艳，思此心凉已泫然。 增上寺是位于日本东京都港区芝公园的一座净土宗寺院，山号为三缘山。也是江户幕府德川家的灵庙之一。从东京塔俯瞰，青瓦飞檐，浓荫蔽日，增上寺屏蔽在东京港繁华之外，独留一片清静。为了保护这片净土，周围不允许摩天大厦。寺内僻静庄严，香烟缭绕。环顾汉字满目，处处中国礼仪，隐隐有汉唐之风。又想起清明上河图，然东京汴梁之盛景不在。佛教自汉朝传入中国，又经朝鲜传到东瀛。盛唐时，日本多次遣使赴中国学习。大唐显泱泱之风，盛情款待又毫无保留。斗转星移，此东京非彼东京，汉唐之风却在扶桑。虽同种同宗，然近代兵戎相向。嘴上功夫应休矣。两国交往，实力说话。可” 第二经济体” 冲昏了头脑，至今犹唱后庭遗曲！能不让人酷暑心凉，涕流泪下！哀哉痛哉！
92a0701a1c42b24f98bf70d52aae420c1da0f21d.translatedText: [Phoenix PEN] Li Jianmin: Reflections on visiting Zenjoji Temple in Tokyo Phoenix City Li Jianmin Visiting Zengshang Temple in the sweltering heat, I look solemn and shambling. Bianliang no longer has a view of Tokyo, and Japan looks like a view of the Tang and Han Dynasties. The same kind and the same sect are fried too quickly. One clothes and two layers of water. The flowers of the jade tree in the back garden are still beautiful, and my heart feels cold just thinking about it. Zojoji Temple is a Pure Land sect temple located in Shiba Park, Minato-ku, Tokyo, Japan. Its mountain name is Sanyuan Mountain. It is also one of the spiritual temples of the Tokugawa family of the Edo shogunate. Looking down from Tokyo Tower, with green tiles and eaves, thick shade blocking out the sun, Zojoji Temple is shielded from the bustling Tokyo Port, leaving only a quiet place. To protect this pure land, no skyscrapers are allowed around it. The temple is secluded and solemn, filled with smoke. Looking around, there are Chinese characters everywhere, Chinese etiquette everywhere, and a hint of the style of the Han and Tang Dynasties. I think of the "Along the River During the Qingming Festival" again, but the grand scene of Bianliang in Tokyo is not there. Buddhism was introduced to China from the Han Dynasty and then to Japan via Korea. During the prosperous Tang Dynasty, Japan sent many envoys to China to study. The Tang Dynasty showed its great style, hospitality was warm and unreserved. As time goes by, this Tokyo is not that Tokyo, but the style of Han and Tang Dynasties is in Fusang. Although they are of the same species and origin, they have fought against each other in modern times. The lip service should stop. In the exchanges between the two countries, strength speaks for itself. But the "Second Economy" got carried away, and it is still singing its legacy! It can make people feel cold in the hot summer and shed tears! What a sorrow! What a pain!

49597d99c00fcd2a6a655602fe2fbbdcf1885511.sourceText: 张肇鸿 世上独一无二的风铃 风铃在古代中是佛殿、宝塔等檐下悬挂铃，在风吹时摇曳发叮咚清脆的声音。 风铃种类繁多…
49597d99c00fcd2a6a655602fe2fbbdcf1885511.translatedText: > Zhang Zhaohong The unique wind chimes in the world. In ancient times, wind chimes were bells hung under the eaves of Buddhist temples and pagodas. They swayed and made a crisp tinkling sound when the wind blew. There are many types of wind chimes...

5dcb42a4c2e237319fd992b324902feec88740cc.translatedText: >The unique wind chimes in the world

e9ef94bc0a1f28cd88d4139d08a92b45361a2426.sourceText: 风铃在古代中是佛殿、宝塔等檐下悬挂铃，在风吹时摇曳发叮咚清脆的声音。
e9ef94bc0a1f28cd88d4139d08a92b45361a2426.translatedText: Wind chimes were hung under the eaves of Buddhist temples and pagodas in ancient times. They swayed and made a tinkling sound when the wind blew.

0e3f81e5c66bcedf4e9152e8361be9066a0bb2b8.sourceText: 风铃种类繁多，有竹木的、石头的、陶瓷的、金属的、贝壳的等等。
0e3f81e5c66bcedf4e9152e8361be9066a0bb2b8.translatedText: There are many kinds of wind chimes, including bamboo, stone, ceramic, metal, shell and so on.

ac7fc96e32e5cbdfeb2ff857b4bbc514e299dc2c.sourceText: 风铃有视觉造型之美，又有听觉之享受，感觉上让人清凉，既是居家的小摆饰，也是宗教用的器物；它可以是轻松休闲，也可以是庄严宁静。
ac7fc96e32e5cbdfeb2ff857b4bbc514e299dc2c.translatedText: Wind chimes have visual beauty, auditory enjoyment, and refreshing feeling. They are both small home decorations and religious objects; they can be relaxing or solemn and peaceful.

41cb239e3102ff617c12406df081087dee569074.sourceText: 唐朝《开元天宝遗事》有记载：歧王宫中竹林中，悬碎玉片子，每夜闻碎玉子相触声，即知有风，号为“占风铎”，可测风向，这应该是风铃最早的起源。
41cb239e3102ff617c12406df081087dee569074.translatedText: "The Legacy of Kaiyuan Tianbao" of the Tang Dynasty records: In the bamboo forest of King Qi's palace, pieces of jade were hung. Every night when the sound of broken jade pieces was heard, one knew there was wind. It was named "Zhanfeng Duo" and the wind direction could be measured. This should be the earliest origin of wind chimes.

c9154f09c1ee0b1993cc0aa04509f4a54ac8981f.sourceText: 事实上，中国的铃、钟、铎，与西方的 bell、chime ，虽有不同，却在造型上、听觉上有很多的相似性，因而丰富了风铃的创作与运用。
c9154f09c1ee0b1993cc0aa04509f4a54ac8981f.translatedText: In fact, although Chinese bells, bells, and bells are different from Western bells and chimes, they have many similarities in shape and hearing, which enriches the creation and application of wind chimes.

2e742789c7b957f30c9e83f614adfc58a0b3cc33.sourceText: 风铃有着优美声音和美感。中国古人悬挂风铃，却是实用性高过装饰性，以“风吹玉振”的声音，达到静心养性和祈福的目的。“园中纽红绳，密缀响金铃，每有鸟鹊飞，园史掣索惊。”这种风铃，是用于警示用的。
2e742789c7b957f30c9e83f614adfc58a0b3cc33.translatedText: Wind chimes have beautiful sounds and aesthetics. Ancient Chinese people hung wind chimes, but they were more practical than decorative. The sound of "wind blowing and jade vibrating" was used to achieve the purpose of calming the mind, cultivating the spirit and praying for blessings. "The garden is tied with red ropes and densely decorated with ringing golden bells. Every time a bird or magpie flies, the garden is frightened." This kind of wind chime is used as a warning.

17809ec2af52afba1a983db1d334997d4726aba1.sourceText: 在建筑方面，宋史．礼志有记载；“明堂庭树松梓桧，门不设戟，殿角皆垂铃。” 明堂在中国历代都是一个重要的政教地点，不设兵戎，却在屋檐四角设铃，有警惕、平和之意、少了肃杀苛刻的氛围。
17809ec2af52afba1a983db1d334997d4726aba1.translatedText: In terms of architecture, Song History. It is recorded in the Book of Etiquette: "There are pine trees and cypress trees in the courtyard of the Mingtang. There are no halberds at the door, and bells hang from the corners of the hall." The Mingtang has been an important political and religious place in all dynasties in China. There are no soldiers, but bells are set up at the four corners of the eaves, which conveys vigilance and peace, and lacks a harsh atmosphere.

46d18716df44b7e61824cc49be57e8bcf7d71f48.sourceText: 风铃在居家的风水勘舆上，是以风铃声的“好韵”，以招来“好运”，此时悬挂风铃，看重的是方位的摆设。
46d18716df44b7e61824cc49be57e8bcf7d71f48.translatedText: In terms of Feng Shui at home, wind chimes use the "good charm" of the sound to attract "good luck". When hanging wind chimes at this time, the most important thing is the placement.

f3aa772dfee66142c69bc4be64e8502234e13a89.sourceText: 风铃在佛教意涵上有惊觉、欢喜、说法三义，常见于佛教的法器、乐器及塔寺塔寺檐角建筑中。
f3aa772dfee66142c69bc4be64e8502234e13a89.translatedText: Wind chimes have three meanings in Buddhism: awakening, joy, and preaching. They are commonly found in Buddhist ritual vessels, musical instruments, and eaves and corner buildings of pagodas and temples.

dd43cd650a1edc4a2d2f05b37d94d5f0c021d45d.sourceText: 有一首“风铃偈”：“浑身似口挂虚空，不论东西南北风，一律为他说般若，叮叮咚咚叮叮咚。”所谓“叮叮咚咚”是代表“苦、空、无常、无我”的佛理，在大藏述略：“风铃扬音闹苍嘘，真相堂堂照膏火，教音默默鸣风铃”。
dd43cd650a1edc4a2d2f05b37d94d5f0c021d45d.translatedText: There is a "Wind Chime Gatha": "The whole body seems to be hanging in the void, no matter the east, west, north or south wind, it will always say Prajna for him, ding ding dong dong ding ding dong." "The so-called "ding-ding-dong-dong" represents the Buddhist philosophy of "suffering, emptiness, impermanence, and selflessness." It is briefly described in the Tripitaka: "The sound of the wind chimes makes the people boo, the truth shines brightly on the anointing, and the sound of the teachings silently rings the wind chimes."

a91a479e0736f7cb95ba5c650df7de592501da17.sourceText: 世界各地都有风铃，不但在艺术创作上日益推陈出新，近年来更着意于风铃“音乐性”的表现，不同种类的风铃也作为打击乐器被用于古典音乐中。风铃在全世界可能以日本最为风行，它是日本夏天风物诗的代表之一。
a91a479e0736f7cb95ba5c650df7de592501da17.translatedText: Wind chimes are found all over the world. Not only are they increasingly innovative in artistic creation, but in recent years they have paid more attention to the "musical" performance of wind chimes. Different types of wind chimes are also used as percussion instruments in classical music. Wind chimes may be the most popular in Japan in the world, and they are one of the representatives of Japanese summer scenery.

3e7fa6c8f8f76fbab937c81718ff0bbbca2902d2.sourceText: 夏日里在建筑和门檐挂上一串风铃，风动发出愉快清脆的声音，能让人心宁安静、吉祥平安。遇有祭祀庆典，悬挂风铃外带一则祈福短文的意象，也可以说是艺术、文化和音乐美好的结合。
3e7fa6c8f8f76fbab937c81718ff0bbbca2902d2.translatedText: In summer, hang a string of wind chimes on buildings and door eaves. The wind will make a pleasant and crisp sound, which can make people feel peaceful, auspicious and safe. When there are sacrifices and celebrations, the image of hanging wind chimes with a short blessing message can also be said to be a beautiful combination of art, culture and music.

d5fc510025ca3e126e1836eef6a5b6b80d32b350.sourceText: 在印尼的巴厘岛，因崇尚多神信仰，传说风神藉由竹管风铃，以风吹竹管的频率表示风神的到来，并显示神威。
d5fc510025ca3e126e1836eef6a5b6b80d32b350.translatedText: In Bali, Indonesia, due to the advocating polytheistic beliefs, it is said that the wind god uses bamboo wind chimes to indicate the arrival of the wind god and show his power with the frequency of the wind blowing the bamboo tube.

8c0c4f5f5688eadda464f948ca8d5f94adf5c2ad.sourceText: 在美国，风铃寓意美好的祝福。每天听到悦耳的风铃声令人感到好运。美国人常挑选风铃作为馈赠礼品，普遍喜欢简约风格颜色，以自然原色或者古铜色为主。笔者查阅到风铃的价格从十几元到几百美元不等。
8c0c4f5f5688eadda464f948ca8d5f94adf5c2ad.translatedText: In the United States, wind chimes mean good wishes. Hearing the sweet sound of wind chimes every day brings good luck. Americans often choose wind chimes as gifts. They generally like simple colors, mainly natural primary colors or bronze. The author found that the price of wind chimes ranges from more than ten yuan to several hundred dollars.

26894230c0664d5f990c13f3d30a06eeb380a1f3.sourceText: 如果是好朋友送的，风铃的响声代表着一声声的问候；如果是情侣送的，那是代表恋情和想念。事实上，当风吹过，铃声都会让你想起某个人。如果你送给别人，别人就会记住你。
26894230c0664d5f990c13f3d30a06eeb380a1f3.translatedText: If it is given by a good friend, the sound of the wind chimes represents greetings; if it is given by a couple, it represents love and longing. In fact, when the wind blows, the sound of a bell reminds you of someone. If you give it to others, they will remember you.

08f85a2c76f9030ffe23fe565f1c79f8561a8d4a.sourceText: 前天有聋哑朋友给女儿薮薇送上一个用手工精心制作的风铃。这个风铃用薄薄的不锈钢片，通过高温喷射枪烧蚀而制成。这是代表一个聋哑人的手语“我爱你！”（I Love You! )
08f85a2c76f9030ffe23fe565f1c79f8561a8d4a.translatedText: The day before yesterday, a deaf-mute friend gave his daughter Xue Wei a carefully handmade wind chime. This wind chime is made of thin stainless steel sheets that are ablated by a high-temperature spray gun. This is the sign language "I Love You!" for a deaf-mute person.

5d0a0d73a8786491b0d785eb320dfa75daf03b8e.sourceText: 小拇指代表字母“I”，是“我”的意思，大拇指和食指组成字母“L”，代表“爱” Love ，大拇指和小拇指组成字母“Y”，代表“你”。
5d0a0d73a8786491b0d785eb320dfa75daf03b8e.translatedText: The little finger represents the letter "I", which means "I", the thumb and index finger form the letter "L", which represents "Love", and the thumb and little finger form the letter "Y", which represents "you".

cf3e9a03a375410e1f41c37356e1631fb29e0f08.sourceText: 这个“我爱你！”的手语在全世界也是非常流行的。
cf3e9a03a375410e1f41c37356e1631fb29e0f08.translatedText: The sign language "I love you!" is also very popular around the world.

08d04afc4d8e54a5b330ad2d27d8263c0c1c672c.sourceText: 这个特别的风铃，其手掌的上那个心形，内中刻有“meme”的字样，这是是聋哑人对薇薇亲切的呢称，下面的五个心片连缀作为铃，是对薇薇的怀念，连接在一起成为了世上独一无二的纪念物。风吹铃响，发岀的声音特别清晰动听迥荡。
08d04afc4d8e54a5b330ad2d27d8263c0c1c672c.translatedText: This special wind chime has a heart shape on the palm with the word "meme" engraved in it. This is a nickname given to Weiwei by deaf-mute people. The five heart pieces below are connected as a bell, which is a memory of Weiwei. Together they become a unique memorial in the world. The wind blew the bell, and the sound was particularly clear and melodious.

dab079e1b0c6ab12afc693e970356225f8daf6de.sourceText: 我没有把风铃挂在外面随风摇曳，而是挂在室内，并放上一个“同心结”，以寄托对女儿的思念。
dab079e1b0c6ab12afc693e970356225f8daf6de.translatedText: Instead of hanging the wind chime outside to sway in the wind, I hung it indoors and put a "concentric knot" to express my longing for my daughter.

fb4024969feea8a00ae80f439d0afee25e7329d6.sourceText: 特朗普收紧绿卡 美国华人紧张
fb4024969feea8a00ae80f439d0afee25e7329d6.translatedText: Trump tightens green card, Chinese Americans are nervous

1a44246ed1c02be4fdf576e028168679795a2fbe.sourceText: 特朗普收紧绿卡 美国华人紧张 【侨报记者高睿10月11日洛杉矶报道】特朗普紧缩移民政策的大刀不仅砍向&#822…
1a44246ed1c02be4fdf576e028168679795a2fbe.translatedText: Trump tightens green card, Chinese Americans are nervous [Overseas Chinese News reporter Gao Rui reported in Los Angeles on October 11] Trump’s tightening immigration policy not only strikes at the &#822...

2183cf13ddb87bc69c423281a05f0482fa9a78a3.sourceText: 【侨报记者高睿10月11日洛杉矶报道】特朗普紧缩移民政策的大刀不仅砍向”非法移民”，就连”合法移民”也不放过，包括亲属移民在内的绿卡发放也被喊”卡”，准备由2014年每年64.5万的绿卡发放缩减14至54万。虽然特朗普的态度还没有最后形成法律，但他挥舞的大砍刀已经让包括华人在内的很多合法移民开始担忧他们排期中的亲属在未来几年中可能面临的叵测变数。
2183cf13ddb87bc69c423281a05f0482fa9a78a3.translatedText: [Overseas Chinese News reporter Gao Rui reported in Los Angeles on October 11] Trump tightened The broad knife of shrinking immigration policy not only targets "illegal immigrants", but also "legal immigrants". The issuance of green cards, including family-based immigrants, is also called "card". It is planned to reduce the annual green card issuance from 645,000 in 2014 to 140,000 to 540,000. Although Trump’s attitude has not yet been finalized into law, the machete he wields has made many legal immigrants, including Chinese, worry about the unpredictable changes that their relatives on the waiting list may face in the next few years.

c3bf0e61f14003a0de0774b18373652fc0912a01.sourceText: 洛杉矶华人伍女士11日表示，2007年她以亲属移民的方式申请弟弟来美，到了2008年才排上期，原来理论上要等10年才能排到签证，但特朗普上台后移民政策紧缩，弟弟的排期很可能要延期到14年以后，这让美国公民伍女士开始担忧以下几个问题：
c3bf0e61f14003a0de0774b18373652fc0912a01.translatedText: Ms. Wu, a Chinese from Los Angeles, said on the 11th that she applied for her younger brother to come to the United States through family immigration in 2007, and it was only in 2008 that she was in line. It originally took 10 years to get a visa, but after Trump came to power, the immigration policy tightened. Her brother's schedule is likely to be extended to 14 years later, which makes Ms. Wu, an American citizen, worried about the following issues:

56199d3708bc749ba10d1a158893713b044476bc.sourceText: 1、弟弟：伍女士的弟弟1972年生人，如今已经45岁，按2008年排期算起，14年后弟弟已经50了，那个时候再来美国他还能干啥？现在就连美国大学毕业生都找不到理想的工作，更何况一个年过半百的”外国人”？弟弟直言不讳地表示，他们夫妻移民美国主要是为了女儿，希望孩子能在美国上高中、念大学，如果女儿来美的事泡汤了，他们来不来美国已经没有什么意义了。
56199d3708bc749ba10d1a158893713b044476bc.translatedText: 1. Younger brother: Ms. Wu's brother was born in 1972 and is now 45 years old. Based on the 2008 schedule, his brother will be 50 in 14 years. What else can he do when he comes to the United States? Even American college graduates can't find an ideal job now, let alone a "foreigner" over fifty years old? The younger brother bluntly stated that the couple immigrated to the United States mainly for their daughter. They hoped that their children could attend high school and college in the United States. If their daughter's plan to come to the United States failed, it would no longer matter whether they came to the United States or not.

965a060e118422b6ead0d9320ca26a78c80e3922.sourceText: 2、女儿：弟弟的女儿2002年出生，如果能顺利地排期到2022年移民美国，那个时候女儿20岁，还有机会来美上大学；但如果被特朗普的紧缩政策再延误一两年的话，女儿就超过21岁的”成年人”界限，就根本没有可能移民美国了；如果再”点背”一些落入特朗普”砍掉”的几十万合法绿卡名单中，那就彻底没戏了。
965a060e118422b6ead0d9320ca26a78c80e3922.translatedText: 2. Daughter: My brother’s daughter was born in 2002. If she can be successfully scheduled to immigrate to the United States in 2022, her daughter will be 20 years old by then and still have the opportunity to come to the United States to attend college; but if Trump is If the austerity policy of the United States is delayed for another year or two, her daughter will exceed the 21-year-old "adult" limit, and it will be impossible to immigrate to the United States; if she "spots" some more and falls into the list of hundreds of thousands of legal green cards that Trump has "cut off", it will be completely out of the question.

3af017f706fa88805e277d1011853bc9b51d5a7e.sourceText: 3、投资：为了能让女儿来美后能顺利跟上美国的课程，弟弟早已兵马未动、粮草先行，从小学起就让女儿上国际学校，到今年已经念到了初二，每年几十万人民币的学费，这么多年下来仅学费加起来已经花了上百万了。如果因为特朗普的”变卦”女儿来不了美国，那么这上百万的先期投资就打了水漂了。
3af017f706fa88805e277d1011853bc9b51d5a7e.translatedText: 3. Investment: In order to enable his daughter to successfully follow American courses after coming to the United States, my brother has already put troops and food first. He has sent his daughter to an international school since elementary school. This year, she has already entered the second grade of junior high school. The annual tuition is hundreds of thousands of yuan. Over the years, the total tuition alone has cost millions. If his daughter cannot come to the United States because of Trump's "change of intentions," then the millions of upfront investments will be in vain.

a516214c1913acd4429261fc21bea00a4be1f84a.sourceText: 4、房子：为了弟弟一家人的亲属移民，伍女士已经在南加州圣盖博市买了一套价值百万美元的房子，弟弟为这套房子付出了20万美元，父母也把他们的退休金换成美元，花在儿孙移民美国的投资上，可以说全家人为了移民美国已经到了砸锅卖铁的地步，如果这个时候特朗普变了卦，那伍女士一家三代算是被坑惨了。
a516214c1913acd4429261fc21bea00a4be1f84a.translatedText: 4. House: In order to immigrate relatives of her younger brother and his family, Ms. Wu has bought a million-dollar house in San Gabriel, Southern California. Her younger brother paid $200,000 for this house. Her parents also converted their retirement funds into U.S. dollars and spent it on investment for their children and grandchildren to immigrate to the United States. It can be said that the whole family has reached the point of selling iron to immigrate to the United States. If Trump changes his mind at this time, then three generations of Ms. Wu's family will be devastated.

89359aff85af095b1f64f9b0556ae7550f8cc5bb.sourceText: 伍女士认为，特朗普政府不应当随随便便地把移民政策改来改去，对那些没有答应的合法移民你可以修改移民政策，而对那些已经答应的、已经排期的合法移民就应当兑现诺言和政策。如果弟弟、父母和孙女因为特朗普移民政策的”变卦”而受到影响，伍女士不知道自己下一步该怎么走，是继续留在美国？还是回到中国照顾父母二老？”如果有民众抗议示威，我第一个举着牌子加入其中，抗议特朗普苛刻合法移民的政策”！
89359aff85af095b1f64f9b0556ae7550f8cc5bb.translatedText: Ms. Wu believes that the Trump administration should not change the immigration policy casually. You can modify the immigration policy for those legal immigrants who have not been approved, but for those legal immigrants who have been approved and have been scheduled, the promises and policies should be fulfilled. If her younger brother, parents and granddaughter are affected by Trump's "change" in immigration policy, Ms. Wu doesn't know what her next step should be. Should she continue to stay in the United States? Or go back to China to take care of your parents and elders? "If there are public protests and demonstrations, I will be the first to hold a sign and join them to protest against Trump's harsh legal immigration policies!"

c992facd632fc708b639ac4ea740ec6181b565bf.translatedText: Do not increase the burden on the United States

dcf41158956d9f2d67ae5537a4c23bb7c4843d16.sourceText: 圣盖博华裔居民程女士介绍说，她的女儿是个单亲妈妈，几年前通过工作签证拿到了绿卡，可是女儿一个人带着两个孩子很不容易，为了维持生活，女儿打两份工，一是接送老人到老年中心，二是到社区学校教中文和英语，但两份工作的薪水都不高，不足以支付每月1600美元的房租，所以，她每个月还要把自己在中国的退休金换成美元用来贴补女儿。
dcf41158956d9f2d67ae5537a4c23bb7c4843d16.translatedText: Ms. Cheng, a Chinese resident of San Gabriel, said that her daughter is a single mother and obtained a green card through a work visa a few years ago, but it is not easy for her daughter to raise two children alone. , in order to make ends meet, her daughter works two jobs, one is to transport the elderly to a senior center, and the other is to teach Chinese and English in community schools. However, the salaries of both jobs are not high and are not enough to pay the monthly rent of US$1,600. Therefore, she has to convert her pension in China into US dollars every month to supplement her daughter.

0b47585a04be18d6bdffe0226c1273a6254abc3a.sourceText: 程女士表示，她已经3次”探亲”来美帮助女儿照顾两个孩子，第一次呆了3个月，第二次呆了5个月，一个月前她第3次来美，虽有6个月的签证，但她不敢呆满半年，生怕影响下次入境。”我现在非常纠结，按时回国吧，担心回去就再也进不来了；逾期拘留吧，又怕影响女儿绿卡变公民”。
0b47585a04be18d6bdffe0226c1273a6254abc3a.translatedText: Ms. Cheng said that she has come to the United States three times to "visit relatives" to help her daughter take care of her two children. The first time she stayed was 3 months, the second time she stayed 5 months, and a month ago she came to the United States for the third time. Although she had a 6-month visa, she did not dare to stay for half a year for fear of affecting her next entry. "I am very confused now. I should return to China on time. I am worried that I will never be able to enter the country again. I should be detained overdue, and I am afraid that it will affect my daughter's green card and become a citizen."

405470ac39df1c2c6232b1954b8d1ead041ee356.sourceText: 程女士支持总统针对非法移民的紧缩政策，但希望特朗普不要对合法移民也大开杀戒，”我女儿是个守法居民，因为前夫做了违法的事情她毅然离婚；现在到了洛杉矶她愿意为美国做贡献，为此她积极工作，照章纳税，一人打两份工。虽然生活很辛苦，但我们几代人一起努力，共同面对生活的挑战，绝不给中国人丢脸，不给美国人增加负担”。
405470ac39df1c2c6232b1954b8d1ead041ee356.translatedText: Ms. Cheng supports the president's austerity policy against illegal immigrants, but hopes Trump will not also kill legal immigrants. "My daughter is a law-abiding resident, but she decided to divorce her ex-husband because he did something illegal. Now in Los Angeles, she is willing to contribute to the United States. For this reason, she actively works, pays taxes according to regulations, and works two jobs. Although life is very hard, we work together across generations to face the challenges of life together, and will never embarrass the Chinese or increase the burden on the Americans."

d9dc958da59d8e819ff10000a13685cf23bc645a.sourceText: 北上广甩洛杉矶几条街
d9dc958da59d8e819ff10000a13685cf23bc645a.translatedText: >A few streets north, Shanghai and Guangzhou in Los Angeles

7835c0ae9a8ad35dea18ae5762037a580fb4263a.sourceText: 洛杉矶中医师郑先生2006年申请弟弟妹妹来美，但听说现在移民局正在处理2002年的排期，这让他心灰意冷。”2002年至今已经排队了15年，按照这个速度计算，我弟弟妹妹最快也要等到2021年。谁知道那个时候特朗普的移民政策会变成什么样子，如果真的如媒体所说，特朗普要砍掉几十万的绿卡名额，我弟弟妹妹不幸”中枪”的话，那我们的所有努力最后都变成竹篮打水一场空。”
7835c0ae9a8ad35dea18ae5762037a580fb4263a.translatedText: >Mr. Zheng, a traditional Chinese medicine practitioner in Los Angeles, applied for his younger siblings to come to the United States in 2006, but he was frustrated when he heard that the Immigration Bureau was now processing the 2002 application. "We have been waiting in line for 15 years since 2002. At this rate, my younger brother and sister will have to wait until 2021 at the earliest. Who knows what Trump's immigration policy will look like by then. If, as the media says, Trump is going to cut off hundreds of thousands of green card quotas, my brother If the younger brother or sister is unfortunately "shot", then all our efforts will be in vain. "

5d02866e42118fa68471e9188d1c64569a9bf35e.sourceText: 郑医生说他现在都不相信美国政府了，弟弟妹妹也觉得亲属移民太渺茫，已经不抱什么希望了。”妹妹说中国现在发展得比美国快，北上广的建设已经甩洛杉矶好几条街了，来不来美国还真的需要重新考虑一下。网上说现在每年从美国来中国的留学生多达几十万人，美国人都争相来中国发展，我们还有必要往美国钻吗”？
5d02866e42118fa68471e9188d1c64569a9bf35e.translatedText: Dr. Zheng said that he no longer believes in the US government. The younger brother and sister also feel that relative immigration is too slim and they have no hope. "My sister said that China is developing faster than the United States. The construction of Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou has already surpassed Los Angeles by several blocks. You really need to reconsider whether to come to the United States. It is said online that there are hundreds of thousands of international students coming to China from the United States every year. Americans are rushing to come to China to develop. Do we still need to go to the United States?"

3263b55ddcc84a044e47b4d1e95ddc2e6054e8fa.sourceText: 美主审法官敦促苹果三星首长和谈
3263b55ddcc84a044e47b4d1e95ddc2e6054e8fa.translatedText: The U.S. presiding judge urges the chief executives of Apple and Samsung to negotiate for peace talks

c70806db004d82def07e7eb52658670be386ff3f.sourceText: 美主审法官敦促苹果三星首长和谈 主审苹果公司和三星电子之间专利官司的联邦法官高兰惠(Lucy Koh)，要…
c70806db004d82def07e7eb52658670be386ff3f.translatedText: The U.S. presiding judge urges the chief executives of Apple and Samsung to negotiate for peace talks. Lucy Koh, the federal judge presiding over the patent lawsuit between Apple and Samsung Electronics, wants...

0483d7ba8df518a1e75e3b6e38cd6d8ddfd8a5f0.sourceText: 主审苹果公司和三星电子之间专利官司的联邦法官高兰惠(Lucy Koh)，要求这两家公司的首席执行官在陪审团审议之前，再举行一次会谈，试着和平解决争端。
0483d7ba8df518a1e75e3b6e38cd6d8ddfd8a5f0.translatedText: Lucy Koh, the federal judge presiding over the patent lawsuit between Apple and Samsung Electronics. Koh, asked the CEOs of the two companies to hold another meeting to try to resolve the dispute peacefully before the jury deliberates.

3185e1e02a98dd7263113cd681e413ba144da839.sourceText: 高兰惠法官周三(8月15日)警告律师说，她在移交案件给九名成员组成的陪审团审议前，”看到双方都存在风险”。双方律师均回应将话带到。陪审团审议预计最快21日开始。
3185e1e02a98dd7263113cd681e413ba144da839.translatedText: Judge Ko Lan-hye warned lawyers on Wednesday (August 15) that she "saw risks for both sides" before handing over the case to a nine-member jury for consideration. Lawyers for both sides responded. Jury deliberations are expected to begin as soon as the 21st.

994c20716ae6f62ec8c8904793e5f3de93d31275.sourceText: 知识产权顾问穆勒(Florian Mueller)表示，他不认为这一争端的和解时机已经成熟，双方都下了很大的筹码，这场用于智能手机和平板式电脑的专利战受到密切关注。
994c20716ae6f62ec8c8904793e5f3de93d31275.translatedText: Intellectual property consultant Florian Mueller said he did not believe the time was ripe for settlement in this dispute. Both sides have placed a lot of chips, and this patent war for smartphones and tablets has been closely watched.

c9c311f5ce0401bbf965cef34adb4bec1fd4e739.sourceText: 该诉讼是2011年提出，现在开庭已进入第三周，双方举证陈述告一段落。2010年苹果接触三星表达专利侵权的关切后公司之间的会议都被披露。法官5月间曾要求苹果公司首席执行官库克(Tim Cook)和三星公司首席崔志成(Choi Gee-sung)在预审前举行会谈，当时两家公司都同意了。
c9c311f5ce0401bbf965cef34adb4bec1fd4e739.translatedText: This lawsuit was filed in 2011. Now the trial has entered its third week, and both parties have come to an end. Meetings between the companies were revealed after Apple approached Samsung in 2010 to express concerns about patent infringement. The judge in May asked Apple CEO Tim Cook and Samsung Chief Choi Gee-sung to meet before a preliminary hearing, and both companies agreed at the time.

9420c0ed163b73be6d35283486ebbf617443937c.sourceText: 但那次和之后的几次尝试，都未能促成会谈。熟悉内情的人士说，双方都看重各自的专利组合，且认知相距甚远。
9420c0ed163b73be6d35283486ebbf617443937c.translatedText: But that and subsequent attempts failed to lead to talks. People familiar with the matter said that both parties value their respective patent portfolios and are far apart from each other.

b7f6b879af913277b955fa3807bfe911b9115303.sourceText: 法官高兰惠在整个审判过程中对两方都感到不耐烦。她建议说，两方公司都想强调专利拥有权，这些讯息在过去3周已经明白陈述。她强调，”在许多方面，任务已经完成了，是该寻求和解的时候了。”
b7f6b879af913277b955fa3807bfe911b9115303.translatedText: Judge Gao Lanhui was impatient with both sides throughout the trial. She suggested that both companies wanted to emphasize patent ownership, messages that had been clearly stated over the past three weeks. She emphasized, "In many ways, the task has been accomplished, and it is time to seek reconciliation."

3a6efb81b05a77a09f187e099a960af0a801e39e.sourceText: 苹果首先于2011年4月指控三星抄袭行动装置专利，三星也迅速反控苹果侵权。
3a6efb81b05a77a09f187e099a960af0a801e39e.translatedText: Apple first accused Samsung of plagiarizing mobile device patents in April 2011, and Samsung quickly countersued Apple for infringement.

1cb8b0459a048a00cfd0c55053249238bc361647.sourceText: 苹果除了向三星求偿25亿美元外，也进一步希望美国法院对三星平板电脑颁布的暂时禁售令能转为永久禁售，并且扩及三星智慧手机。
1cb8b0459a048a00cfd0c55053249238bc361647.translatedText: In addition to seeking $2.5 billion in compensation from Samsung, Apple also further hopes that the temporary sales ban issued by the US court on Samsung tablet computers can be converted into a permanent ban and extended to Samsung smartphones.

7a5aa73d210e407716681656db2c88c65bc6c1db.sourceText: 三星则试图说服陪审团苹果专利无效，并负起控告侵权而造成的损害责任。
7a5aa73d210e407716681656db2c88c65bc6c1db.translatedText: Samsung tried to convince the jury that Apple’s patent was invalid and would be liable for damages caused by the infringement.

9b200330bcd87c0d43462f2dae95b88d0b363825.sourceText: 我的祖国已经越来越显现出浮躁，狂热，悲哀，迷茫的气息。社会在财富的迅速积累下，糜烂与堕落，国富民衰的迹象越来越明显，各级政府处处想着与民争利，社会两极分化异常严重。富人们肆无忌惮的忘乎所以，穷人们走投无路般的苟延残喘，青年人的思想在社会的约束中扼杀，中年人的幸福被居高不下的房价击碎，老年人的健康被日益污染的环境毁灭。学术界一潭死水，文化界死水一潭，政治界腐败堕落，娱乐界本着娱乐至死的精神，麻痹所有还有一丝想要抗争与改变的人们，所有中国人都在争骗抢夺，生怕自己被别人挤下去。高油价，高房价，与民争利的地方政府绑架了整个中国的向前发展，弱小的人民只有在网上穿着马甲，搞笑娱乐，无奈自嘲，解构雷人。这便是如今国家最大的可悲。看似表面的欢声笑语一团和气掩盖着深深的悲哀。看似繁荣向上的祖国，却处处充满了不可预测的危机。作为一名普通的中国年轻人，我担心未来的国家会像虚幻的巴比伦之城一样在顷刻间坍塌毁灭。所以，我亲爱的祖国，请你不要继续堕落了。
9b200330bcd87c0d43462f2dae95b88d0b363825.translatedText: My motherland has become more and more impetuous, fanatical, sad and confused. With the rapid accumulation of wealth, society has become corrupted and degenerated, and the signs of the country's wealth and people's decline have become increasingly obvious. Governments at all levels are always trying to compete with the people for profit, and social polarization is extremely serious. The rich are unscrupulously forgetful, the poor are desperate and lingering, the ideas of young people are stifled by social constraints, the happiness of middle-aged people is shattered by high housing prices, and the health of the elderly is destroyed by the increasingly polluted environment. The academic world is a stagnant pool, the cultural world is a stagnant pool, the political world is corrupt and degenerate, and the entertainment world is based on the spirit of entertainment to death, paralyzing all people who still have the slightest desire to fight and change. All Chinese people are cheating and robbing, for fear that they will be squeezed out by others. High oil prices, high housing prices, and local governments that compete with the people for profit have hijacked the entire development of China. The weak people can only wear vests online, make fun and entertain themselves, and have no choice but to laugh at themselves and deconstruct and make people laugh. This is the greatest tragedy of the country today. The seemingly superficial laughter and harmony conceal a deep sadness. The seemingly prosperous motherland is full of unpredictable crises. As an ordinary young Chinese, I worry that the country in the future will collapse and be destroyed in an instant like the illusory city of Babylon. Therefore, my dear motherland, please do not continue to degenerate.

84c2a8e6ea3a9b68f3040863e4ee8b7f15ea39cd.sourceText: 2004 年左右是中国人的集体幸福年代，那时物价尚低，人民收入稳中有升，食堂半勺肉菜1块2毛5，93汽油3块2毛3，伊利芦荟味酸奶也曾经1块5毛，北京三环以内房价才万元不到，个税起征点调到2000元。但之后随着2007年的猪肉上涨，中国物价就像坐云霄飞车一样，直奔九天。至今的三年时间里，各类物价至少上涨30%，而此时，中国人的平均工资并没有上涨30%，更有大学生毕业那天我们一起失业，每个月挣1000元不到，在大城市中贷款租房，贷款买公交月票，死死挣扎在生活底线的边缘。不是我们不去心怀理想，而是这个社会不允许我们心怀理想。傻.逼脑残超级不反应中国社会现状的《一起去看流星雨》没有被封杀，反而是打动感动每个80后，反应房价居高不下的《蜗居》准备开始封杀了。说什么，剧中言语不符合社会主义精神文明建设！我就不明白了，大家都是成年人，又不是释迦摩尼，谁没看过A.片，谁没有过圈圈叉叉，谁心里没想过这个那个。要知道孔夫子也是有儿有女的。说明什么？说明孔子也是被激情燃烧过的…
84c2a8e6ea3a9b68f3040863e4ee8b7f15ea39cd.translatedText: Around 2004, it was an era of collective happiness for the Chinese people. At that time, prices were still low and people's incomes were rising steadily. Half a spoonful of meat and vegetables in the canteen cost 2.5 cents for 1 yuan, 93 gasoline cost 3 yuan 2.3 cents, Yili aloe-flavored yogurt was once 1 yuan and 5 cents, house prices within Beijing's third ring road were less than 10,000 yuan, and the threshold for personal income tax was raised to 2,000 yuan. But then, with the rise in pork prices in 2007, China's prices were like a roller coaster, heading straight for nine days. In the past three years, prices of various commodities have increased by at least 30%. At this time, the average salary of Chinese people has not increased by 30%. We also lost our jobs together on the day we graduated as college students. We earn less than 1,000 yuan a month. We take loans to rent houses and buy monthly bus passes in big cities, struggling to the edge of the bottom line of life. It's not that we don't have ideals, it's that this society doesn't allow us to have ideals. "Let's Watch the Meteor Shower", which is stupid, stupid and does not reflect the current situation of Chinese society, was not banned. Instead, it moved everyone born in the 1980s. "Dwelling", which reflects the high housing prices, is about to be banned. What can I say? The language in the play is not in line with the construction of socialist spiritual civilization! I just don’t understand. We are all adults, and we are not Gautama Buddha. Who has never watched pornographic movies, who has never been in a circle, and who has never thought about this or that. You must know that Confucius also had sons and daughters. What does it mean? It shows that Confucius was also burned by passion...

04d52631e612ea3762c919a4206874b3dfe4907d.sourceText: 亲爱的广电总局，把好片子好电影禁播后，留下一群毫无内涵的文化垃圾，污染已经被严重污染的祖国花朵?#23665;西黑砖窑，陕西华南虎，云南躲猫猫，贵州俯卧撑，湖北捞尸船，湖南小白宫，重庆黑社会，杭州欺实马，北京圈地运动，上海钓鱼执法，广州飞车抢劫，纵观中国天下，社会已经浑成了这样，广电总局还管什么”马上回去给你吃棒棒糖。”吃怎么了，草莓口味，香草口味的又怎么了！都当婊子好多年了，还立什么精神文明大牌坊。
04d52631e612ea3762c919a4206874b3dfe4907d.translatedText: Dear State Administration of Radio, Film and Television, after banning good movies, what is left behind is a group of cultural garbage without connotation, polluting the flowers of the motherland that have been seriously polluted? Suppression, Hubei corpse boat, Hunan Little White House, Chongqing underworld, Hangzhou bully, Beijing land enclosure movement, Shanghai fishing law enforcement, Guangzhou speeding robbery, looking at the world of China, society has become such a mess, what does the State Administration of Radio, Film and Television care? You have been a bitch for many years, why are you setting up a big memorial for spiritual civilization?

31304239e97d82553bd1c397b096b6ae00e67c78.sourceText: 说罢总局，让我们看看令人蛋疼的中国油价。中石化中石油近两年的行径已经失信于整个国人。有几十亿美金投资非洲南美的油田，有几千万人民币装修自己公司的大吊灯，就不知道体谅百姓们的苦衷。去年国际油价最高的时候，美国油价4美元一加仑，中国油价6块钱一升。后来国际油价暴跌，美国油价2美元一加仑，中国油价6块钱一升。最近国际油价略有升高，美国油价是2.5美元一加仑，中国油价竟一口气冲破了6块钱。说什么与国际接轨，中国油价压根涨上去就没落下过来。偶尔落下来，又迅速涨回去！中石油股票就圈了亿万中国人的钱，油价又抢了亿万中国人的钱，最近天然气还要逼宫涨价。还说什么民族企业要支持。要不是垄断经营，谁他娘的支持这么不善良这么贪婪的中国企业。美国企业想着社会责任，信誉形象，回报民众，持续发展。中国国有企业就想着千方百计的从老百姓里抢钱，牌子大的大抢，牌子小的小抢。后来中石化有人站出来辟谣，其实吧，我们屋里的大吊灯没有花1000万，你们实在是误解毫不利己，专门利人的国有企业了，我们很疼很受伤，这个吊灯也就值800万厖
31304239e97d82553bd1c397b096b6ae00e67c78.translatedText: With that said, let’s take a look at China’s painful oil prices. The behavior of Sinopec and PetroChina in the past two years has broken the trust of the entire Chinese people. There are billions of dollars invested in oil fields in Africa and South America, and tens of millions of yuan decorating the chandeliers of their own companies, but they don't know how to understand the difficulties of the people. When international oil prices were at their highest last year, the price of oil in the United States was US$4 per gallon and the price in China was US$6 per liter. Later, international oil prices plummeted. The price of oil in the United States was US$2 per gallon and the price in China was US$6 per liter. International oil prices have increased slightly recently. In the United States, the price of oil is US$2.5 per gallon, but in China, the price of oil has exceeded 6 yuan in one go. Speaking of being in line with international standards, China's oil prices have never fallen after they have risen. Occasionally it falls, and then it rises back up quickly! PetroChina's stock has robbed hundreds of millions of Chinese people's money, and oil prices have robbed hundreds of millions of Chinese people's money. Recently, the price of natural gas has been forced to increase. They also said that national enterprises should be supported. If it weren't for monopoly management, who the hell would support such an unkind and greedy Chinese company. American companies think about social responsibility, reputation and image, returning to the people, and sustainable development. China's state-owned enterprises are trying every possible means to steal money from the people, big brands and small brands. Later, someone from Sinopec came forward to refute the rumors. In fact, the big chandelier in our house did not cost 10 million. You really misunderstood a state-owned enterprise that is not self-interested and specializes in benefiting others. We are very painful and hurt. This chandelier is only worth 8 million.

7980ada47a87fd79a58f5d8b7f98af3dfdc649dd.sourceText: 对于这些善良的中国大企业，我已经无话可说，让我们看看更令人蛋疼的中国房价。最近看到一篇文章谈论如今中国疯狂的房价，确实不能不让人担忧。原来，中国的房地产业已经把地方政府、国家经济及民众利益捆绑在一起，要挟着整个中国内地经济。国务院发展研究中心宏观经济研究部部长余斌近日表示，房地产业占到 GDP的6.6%和四分之一投资，直接相关产业达60个，已成为中国经济的直接命脉。一旦房地产市场出现大的波动，现阶段依靠房地产发展生产的几十个行业，如钢筋水泥生产商等，还有那些投资房地产业的大中型企业都将受到无法估量的损失，甚至可能因为大量资金的丧失，让失血严重的中国实体经济崩溃。更重要的是那些给房地产业巨量信贷的银行将陷入数以万亿计的坏账、死账当中，对中国金融业造成毁灭性的打击。
7980ada47a87fd79a58f5d8b7f98af3dfdc649dd.translatedText: I have nothing to say about these kind-hearted large Chinese companies. Let’s take a look at the even more annoying housing prices in China. I recently saw an article talking about the crazy housing prices in China, which really makes people worried. It turns out that China's real estate industry has tied together local governments, the national economy and people's interests, threatening the entire mainland Chinese economy. Yu Bin, director of the Macroeconomic Research Department of the Development Research Center of the State Council, recently stated that the real estate industry accounts for 6.6% of GDP and a quarter of investment, with 60 directly related industries, and has become the direct lifeblood of China's economy. Once there is a major fluctuation in the real estate market, dozens of industries that currently rely on real estate development and production, such as steel and cement manufacturers, as well as large and medium-sized enterprises that invest in the real estate industry, will suffer immeasurable losses. The loss of a large amount of funds may even cause the collapse of China's serious real economy. What's more important is that the banks that provide huge amounts of credit to the real estate industry will be trapped in trillions of bad and dead debts, causing a devastating blow to China's financial industry.

c500401a11e44e1ab41bad19b200c3d44cde942a.sourceText: 美国一套房子的平均售价是20-30万美元，大约是100多万人民币，而且美国所指的这些房子都是国内所说的的上下两层带车库的别墅（House）。但京沪深三市，随便50-60平米的小户型，一百好几十万就跟说着玩一样。中国虽然2012还要拯救地球，但是谁都知道，如今的中国没有超过美国的经济实力，更没有美国完善的社会保障，以百姓硬性需求的房屋当做国家经济前进的动力，危险系数实在太高了。美国人平均工资2000-3000美金，人家攒钱买20万美金的房子。我们中国人平均工资2000-3000人民币，我们也攒钱买20万美金的房子。这个比较大家很容易看清楚了吧。
c500401a11e44e1ab41bad19b200c3d44cde942a.translatedText: The average selling price of a house in the United States is 200,000 to 300,000 US dollars, which is about more than 1 million yuan, and the houses referred to in the United States are what is known in China as a two-story villa with a garage (House). But in the three cities of Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen, a small apartment of 50-60 square meters, ranging from one hundred to hundreds of thousands, is just a joke. Although China still wants to save the earth in 2012, everyone knows that today's China does not have the economic strength of the United States, nor does it have the perfect social security of the United States. The risk factor is too high if the country's economic advancement is driven by housing that is in demand by the people. The average salary in the United States is 2,000-3,000 US dollars, and people save up to buy a house worth 200,000 US dollars. The average salary of us Chinese is 2,000-3,000 RMB, and we also save money to buy a house worth 200,000 US dollars. This comparison is easy for everyone to see clearly.

524cbd5666fb1201b839809cc976f974cb804d79.sourceText: 换种说法，中国房价现在不能跌，因为一旦跌了，政府、银行、各大企业都会遭受重大的损失。政府从中牟利是不容否认的。所以，如果与民争利的政府利益不能被侵害，只能牺牲老百姓的利益了。房价2万块一平米，一个月2500元的工资都不够被中国移动、中国石油抢的，喝着毒牛奶，吃着注水肉，去餐馆点盘凉菜花个百八十，去医院看个感冒花个百八千，孩子上幼儿园还要每个月交3000元的赞助费，这要省吃俭用到何年何月才能买得起一套房子啊！中国企业还有一点是非常抢钱的，虽然如今人民币兑美元是6.8比1，但是中国引进的所有美国商品物价，全都是按照8比1换算计价的。中国百姓一点也没有享受人民币升值带来的那一丝好处。而且政府近期还要计划征收企业发放给员工的生活补贴费。使本来就捉襟见肘的青年人，生活更加艰辛。
524cbd5666fb1201b839809cc976f974cb804d79.translatedText: In other words, China's housing prices cannot fall now, because once they fall, the government, banks, and major enterprises will suffer heavy losses. It is undeniable that the government is profiting from this. Therefore, if the government's interests that compete with the people cannot be infringed, the interests of the people can only be sacrificed. The housing price is 20,000 yuan per square meter, and the monthly salary of 2,500 yuan is not enough. China Mobile and China National Petroleum Corporation are snatching it away. Drinking poisonous milk, eating water-injected meat, going to restaurants to order cold dishes costs 180, going to the hospital to treat a cold costs 18,000 yuan, and paying a monthly sponsorship fee of 3,000 yuan for children to go to kindergarten. How many years and months will it take to be frugal enough to afford a house? Another thing about Chinese companies is that they are very greedy for money. Although the current RMB-USD exchange rate is 6.8:1, the prices of all American goods imported into China are calculated based on the 8:1 conversion. The Chinese people have not enjoyed the slightest benefit from the appreciation of the RMB. In addition, the government plans to collect living allowances paid by enterprises to employees in the near future. This makes life even more difficult for young people who are already struggling.

53ae780ee7c95c556129598ed7a36e981216f5ef.sourceText: 最近看CNN，发现美国人一报道国内，就是美国经济水生火热，无数美国人挣扎在生活底线，早上5点出去上班，晚上10点下班，要养三个孩子。爷爷都70岁了，还天天扫大街，不能退休，因为跟股市挂钩的养老金全都跌光了，房子没有了，他只能住在清洁车上，怎一个惨字了得。但是CNN一报道中国，就是中国内地富豪采购团又在香港置地，买高档用品。因为中国最有能力的消费阶层年龄偏低，外国都是47岁左右，而中国大约只有35岁左右。（外国靠奋斗，中国靠继承）所以国外的奢侈品牌都改变自己的营销策略，设计符合年轻富豪审美的商品。CNN接着报道中国北京、上海某地举办超级跑车大赛，这些高档跑车，在中国的售价都比国外高上2到3倍，但中国富豪们还是蜂拥而至的前来购买。炫富的程度一点不逊于中国魏晋南北朝时期的士族阶级。这可把欧洲美国的奢侈品公司高兴坏了，因为中国富人为他们濒临破产的公司全部买单。看到这些新闻，我作为一个中国人一点喜悦之感都没有，只有深深的悲哀。
53ae780ee7c95c556129598ed7a36e981216f5ef.translatedText: I watched CNN recently and found that when Americans reported on the country, the U.S. economy was booming. Countless Americans were struggling to live at the bottom of their lives. They went to work at 5 a.m., got off work at 10 p.m., and had three children to raise. Grandpa is 70 years old, and he still sweeps the streets every day. He can't retire because all his pensions linked to the stock market have been wiped out. His house is gone, and he can only live in a cleaning truck. How miserable can he be. But as soon as CNN reported on China, a purchasing group of wealthy mainland Chinese people bought land in Hong Kong to buy high-end supplies. This is because China’s most capable consumer class is relatively young. In foreign countries, they are all about 47 years old, while in China they are only about 35 years old. (Foreign countries rely on hard work, while China relies on inheritance.) Therefore, foreign luxury brands have changed their marketing strategies and designed products that meet the aesthetics of young rich people. CNN then reported that a supercar competition was held in Beijing and Shanghai, China. The price of these high-end sports cars in China is 2 to 3 times higher than abroad, but Chinese wealthy people still flock to buy them. The level of showing off wealth is no less than that of the gentry class in China's Wei, Jin, Southern and Northern Dynasties. This makes luxury goods companies in Europe and the United States very happy, because Chinese wealthy people are footing the bill for their companies that are on the verge of bankruptcy. Seeing these news, as a Chinese, I feel no joy at all, only deep sadness.

17d060037550469b1c4b737cd59ad21657233f32.sourceText: 社会脏了，人心散了，大家就像参加最后的狂欢一样，在不知不觉中娱乐至死。娱乐新闻就是貌美大明星嫁了才俊大富豪，大富豪家有车有房有奶，买一个包包要花多少钱，一群珠光宝气的傻大姐参加什么慈善晚会，去什么高档会所，又走光露点了。学术新闻就是某某教授抄袭了，剽窃了，潜规则了，被人砍了。政治新闻就是祖国很牛很强大，人民很好很幸福。经济新闻就是股市有望触底反弹，房价继续稳中有升。原来，我们中国人的自信心就建立在这些虚妄的空中楼阁之上，一点科技含量也没有。跑车、别墅、明星、流星雨、嫁豪门，大众媒体的导向让中国人都去向钱看齐，还有谁去思考如何建设一个人心向上的中国社会。
17d060037550469b1c4b737cd59ad21657233f32.translatedText: Society is dirty, people's hearts are broken, and everyone is just like participating in the last carnival, unknowingly entertaining themselves to death. The entertainment news is that a beautiful star is married to a talented and rich man. The rich man's family has a car, a house, and milk. How much does it cost to buy a bag? A group of stupid ladies with jewels attend some charity party or go to some high-end club, and they are exposed again. Academic news means that a certain professor plagiarized, plagiarized, unwritten rules, and was censored. Political news is that the motherland is great and powerful, and the people are good and happy. The economic news is that the stock market is expected to bottom out and housing prices continue to rise steadily. It turns out that the self-confidence of us Chinese people is based on these false castles in the air, which have no technological content at all. Sports cars, villas, celebrities, meteor showers, and marrying rich people. The guidance of mass media makes Chinese people focus on money. Who else thinks about how to build a Chinese society with uplifting people.

19248463b6001ac70b5f7fc32e38dd558702da75.sourceText: 人无远虑，必有近忧。生于忧患，而死于安乐。得民心者得天下。中国，请你擦亮双眼！不要被短期的利益，西方国家的恶意吹捧，虚假的繁荣所蒙蔽，其实百姓们的生活还是辛苦的，他们劳累的心灵还是需要被温暖的。亲爱的祖国！我真想改变些什么，改变这即将堕落的人心，改变这只为名利钱财而运转的社会。但是我无能为力，国家都混乱了，我们个人生活得再好又能怎样呢？想想《乔家大院》的最后结局，乔致庸最终实现了他天下通银的梦想，但这是靠乔家给各地官府运送耻辱的 ”庚子赔款”来实现的，这叫发国难财。所以，我们个人的奋斗要和国家的前进融合在一起才行。国不幸，家不幸，人不幸。只有中国的大环境充满希望，我们每个中国人才能真正的看到希望。这不是用娱乐搞笑来麻痹自己，而是勇敢追求我们应得的幸福。国际社会如何捧我们，说我们蓬勃发展不重要，关键是我们自己是否感觉幸福的像花儿一样。日本快速发展后的迅速衰落，值得所有国人警惕。
19248463b6001ac70b5f7fc32e38dd558702da75.translatedText: If you don’t have long-term worries, you must have immediate worries. Born in sorrow and died in happiness. He who wins the hearts of the people wins the world. China, please keep your eyes open! Don't be blinded by short-term interests, malicious flattery by Western countries, and false prosperity. In fact, people's lives are still hard, and their tired hearts still need to be warmed. Dear motherland! I really want to change something, change this human heart that is about to fall, and change a society that only operates for fame, wealth and money. But there is nothing I can do, the country is in chaos, what can we do no matter how good our personal lives are? Think about the final ending of "The Courtyard of the Qiao Family". Qiao Zhiyong finally realized his dream of universal silver, but this was achieved by the Qiao family delivering the humiliating "Gengzi Indemnity" to local governments. This is called making a country difficult to make money. Therefore, our personal struggle must be integrated with the progress of the country. The country is unfortunate, the family is unfortunate, and people are unfortunate. Only when China's general environment is full of hope can each of us Chinese truly see hope. This is not about numbing ourselves with entertainment and comedy, but about bravely pursuing the happiness we deserve. It doesn’t matter how the international community praises us and says we are thriving. The key is whether we ourselves feel as happy as flowers. Japan's rapid decline after rapid development deserves the vigilance of all Chinese people.

e626bde7e4f00f257b355e1e508ac0755aa5549b.sourceText: 我是一只不招人喜欢的流浪之猫，我可以选择默默消失在人群，喝得醉生梦死，绝尘而去。但是我的祖国，你不能！因为你寄托了十三亿人的希望！你不应该让你的人民绝望哭泣，为了房价油价艰难的活在这个不公平的世间！恶性竞争，相互猜忌，急功近利，炫富自大，冷酷无情，心无大爱，这不是一个负责任的大国国民应该做的事情。娱乐至死伤害的只是我们那颗本来纯洁而又充满希望的内心。不是满声牢骚，杞人忧天，只是已到危机之时。我们能够做的唯有认清现实。
e626bde7e4f00f257b355e1e508ac0755aa5549b.translatedText: I am an unlovable stray cat. I can choose to disappear silently into the crowd, get drunk and walk away. But my motherland, you can't! Because you have placed the hopes of 1.3 billion people! You should not let your people cry in despair and live in this unfair world for housing and oil prices! Vicious competition, mutual suspicion, eagerness for quick success, arrogance and arrogance, ruthlessness and lack of love are not what a responsible citizen of a big country should do. Entertainment to death only hurts our originally pure and hopeful hearts. It’s not that I’m full of complaints or unfounded worries, it’s just that we have reached a crisis point. All we can do is recognize the reality.

e9acabcd4d6f94ef65e633ad8ceff77ff0d4917d.sourceText: 据美国《世界日报》报道，美国南加州华裔律师表示，新移民家庭出现家暴案呈增加趋势。 蒙特利公园市一对华人中年夫妇日前发生家暴，导致怀孕女方被殴死亡，惊动小区，只是一例。 家暴案中有华裔家长和子女因观念不同发生纠纷。 阿罕布拉令先生一家来自中国陕西，女儿现年18岁，在蒙市餐馆工作。 春节期间，女儿有一天整夜没回家，父母打电话也无响应。 次日返家时，父母追问细节遭拒，令先生生气打了女儿一巴掌。 女儿报警称父亲施暴。 最后女儿出走，搬到男友处居住。 另外一家暴案发生在继母和继子间，导致继母和先生关系破裂。 圣盖博居民华女士与先生均是再婚，先生有一15岁儿子，因华女士烧菜味道不合继子口味，两人发生争吵进而出现推挤。 继子打911报警，称继母施暴。 华女士的先生也偏袒亲生儿子，认为华女士无道理，提出离婚。 亚凯迪亚一中年华人夫妇经营进出口生意，男方年初赴大陆寻货源时发生外遇。 春节期间太太察看先生手机，发现不少暧昧短信，两人发生激烈争吵动手。 太太一气之下报警称遭家暴并提出离婚。 律师刘龙珠表示，打报警电话应非常慎重，一旦报警，夫妻关系可能难以挽回。 律师邓洪表示，新移民家庭出现家暴案呈增加趋势。 一旦家暴发生，部分华人忘记求助专业人士。 他呼吁，华人小区应成立一个针对解决新移民家庭家暴问题的特殊团体，防止更多家暴发生。
e9acabcd4d6f94ef65e633ad8ceff77ff0d4917d.translatedText: According to the US "World Journal" report, a Chinese lawyer in Southern California said that domestic violence cases among new immigrant families are on the rise. A domestic violence incident occurred between a middle-aged Chinese couple in Monterey Park, resulting in the pregnant woman being beaten to death, which alarmed the community. This is just one example. In domestic violence cases, Chinese parents and their children had disputes due to different concepts. Mr. Alhambraling's family is from Shaanxi, China. His daughter is 18 years old and works in a restaurant in Mengcheng. During the Spring Festival, my daughter didn't come home all night, and her parents didn't respond when they called her. When they returned home the next day, their parents asked for details but were refused. The husband was angry and slapped his daughter. The daughter called the police to report that her father was violent. Eventually, the daughter ran away and moved in with her boyfriend. Another domestic violence occurred between the stepmother and stepson, which resulted in the breakdown of the relationship between the stepmother and her husband. Ms. Hua, a resident of San Gabriel, and her husband are both remarried. The husband has a 15-year-old son. Because the taste of Ms. Hua’s cooking did not suit his stepson’s taste, the two had a quarrel and pushed each other. The stepson called 911 to report that his stepmother was violent. Ms. Hua's husband also favored his biological son. He thought Ms. Hua was unreasonable and filed for divorce. A middle-aged Chinese couple in Arcadia runs an import and export business. The husband had an affair when he went to the mainland to look for supplies at the beginning of the year. During the Spring Festival, my wife checked her husband's mobile phone and found many ambiguous text messages, and the two got into a heated argument. The wife was so angry that she reported domestic violence to the police and filed for divorce. Lawyer Liu Longzhu said that you should be very cautious when calling the police. Once the police are called, the relationship between husband and wife may be irreparable. Lawyer Deng Hong said that domestic violence cases among new immigrant families are on the rise. Once domestic violence occurs, some Chinese people forget to seek professional help. He called on the Chinese community to set up a special group to solve the problem of domestic violence in new immigrant families to prevent more domestic violence.

13a9f8e631b1203314a96631c4f470cfefc0e481.translatedText: Gudong, Los Angeles: Roast Duck and Roast Duck Among the six livestock species, duck ranks second after chicken. It has always been one of the main rural industries and the most creative delicacy...

20e5512903e730199a50b0418e29915d0b0e0dfa.sourceText: 六畜之中,鸭仅次于鸡,排行第二,一直是农村主要产业之一,也是最能让人发挥创意的美食资源之一。电影「养鸭人家」为鸭刊碑立石,名店「全聚德」把鸭供上美食殿堂,可不是嗑的。全鸭席一出,鸡猪牛羊诸畜牲都得回避,只有鸭能独当一面,可以一次过为我们提供一桌丰盈味美的飨宴。
20e5512903e730199a50b0418e29915d0b0e0dfa.translatedText: Among the six livestock species, duck ranks second after chicken. It has always been one of the main rural industries and one of the most creative food resources. The movie "Duck Farmer" has a monument dedicated to ducks, and the famous restaurant "Quanjude" serves ducks as a delicacy. It is not just for eating. Once the all-duck banquet is served, chickens, pigs, cattle, sheep, and other livestock have to be avoided. Only duck can stand alone and provide us with a rich and delicious feast at once.

43c3c8f723694e11d3e381b7bab5b012c5679abb.sourceText: 香酥鸭、沙茶鸭、八宝鸭、卤水鸭、盐水鸭、窝烧鸭、酱鸭、熏鸭、腊鸭、板鸭厖各具特色,各有风味,不论宴客自用,皆为上选的佳肴。偶尔懒得动杓,或者来了朋友,需要「斩料」,那么烧鸭半只,油菜一碟, 外加啤酒两瓶,便是蛮不错的一顿了。 我吃过许多种不同烹法的鸭,也许因为是广东人的缘故, 总觉得广式的烧鸭最够味道。不过我对鸭的认识却不多,村里也没有人养鸭。由于少小离家,对故乡印象最深也最留恋的,只有村前那条河。那是一条善变的河,在潮水退下之后,会缩河成溪,流水清澈,游鱼可见,是村童乐水的好去处。我就是在那儿学会游泳的。但是潮水一来, 很快又变成汪洋一片, 听说祖先的「金山船」,曾经不只一次直接由外洋开进来, 从而使小村渐渐成为著名的侨乡。可是没想到,多年后假期还乡, 久驻胸臆的大河,竟然成了肮脏不堪的养鸭场,满江满川的鸭,把水搅得浑浊如浆,不只不宜游泳,连村民日常的用水都成了问题了! 养鸭原来还有这​​么个弊端! 这当然不尽是鸭的责任,只怪鸭的肥油蒙蔽了村干部的眼,令他们看不见那片大好的江河了! 更想不到的是,辛辛苦苦学会一套烹鸭的技法,以为来到美国可以大展鸿图,大赚美钞,谁知老美对鸭全无好感,除了两片鸭胸肉, 还一定要法式烹调才可以上桌外,鸭的其余部份,见了都怕。莫可奈何,到头来吃烧鸭的,还是只有我们几个广东人!
43c3c8f723694e11d3e381b7bab5b012c5679abb.translatedText: Crispy duck, sand tea duck, eight-treasure duck, braised duck, salted duck, nest-roasted duck, sauce duck, smoked duck, cured duck, and salt-fried duck each have their own characteristics and flavors. They are all the best choices for entertaining guests or for personal use. Occasionally, if you are too lazy to use the ladle, or if you have friends over and need to "chop up the ingredients", half a roast duck, a plate of rapeseed, and two bottles of beer can be a pretty good meal. I have eaten duck cooked in many different ways. Perhaps because I am a Cantonese, I always feel that Cantonese-style roast duck is the most delicious. But I don’t know much about ducks, and no one in the village raises ducks. Because I left home when I was young, the only thing that left the deepest impression and nostalgia for my hometown was the river in front of the village. It is a fickle river. After the tide recedes, it shrinks into a stream. The water is clear and fish can be seen. It is a good place for village children to enjoy the water. That's where I learned to swim. But when the tide came, it soon turned into a vast ocean. It is said that the "Jinshan Ship" of our ancestors had sailed in directly from overseas more than once, thus making the small village gradually become a famous hometown of overseas Chinese. But I didn’t expect that when I returned home after a vacation many years later, the river that I had long cherished turned into a filthy duck farm. The ducks in the river made the water turbid and muddy. Not only was it unsuitable for swimming, it also became a problem for the villagers’ daily water use! It turns out that raising ducks has such a drawback! Of course, this is not entirely the duck’s responsibility. It’s just that the fat of the ducks blinded the village cadres, preventing them from seeing the beautiful river! What's even more unexpected is that I worked so hard to learn a set of duck cooking techniques, thinking that I could make great achievements in the United States and make a lot of US dollars. Unexpectedly, the Americans have no good opinion of ducks. Except for the two pieces of duck breasts, which must be cooked in French style before they can be served, I am afraid of the rest of the duck. No matter what, in the end, we are the only Cantonese people who eat roast duck!

641d9c1ab1dc0033cc6349ef687b5a0c0ac02f30.sourceText: 这还不算,美国人非但不吃烧鸭,还对烧鸭诸多留难。想必是给它改坏了名啦,原来鸭和我们一样,也有艺名和笔名,故此烧鸭又叫火鸭和挂炉鸭。可你这鸭是怎么回事呢?既不在火中,又不在炉里,要冷不冷,要热不热,整天就这么没遮没拦的挂着,能吃吗?烧好了挂出来卖,尚且情有可言,烧之前那几个用来风干的钟点,说破嘴皮老美也是听不进去,也不知道打了多少场官司,费了多少唇舌, 才勉强让我们姑且挂着。
641d9c1ab1dc0033cc6349ef687b5a0c0ac02f30.translatedText: That’s not to mention, Americans not only don’t eat roast duck, but also have many difficulties with it. I must have changed its name. It turns out that ducks, like us, also have stage names and pen names, so roast duck is also called fire duck and hanging furnace duck. But what's going on with your duck? It's not in the fire, it's not in the furnace, it's cold or hot, it's been hanging like this all day long, can it be eaten? After it's cooked and hung up for sale, it's reasonable to say that the few hours it was spent drying before it was burned, even the old Americans couldn't listen to it, and I don't know how many lawsuits were fought and how much lip service was spent before we reluctantly let us hang it for the time being.

fc4ef131aef5e263409e2f7bd3398a336505f4a7.sourceText: 烤鸭的命运好多了,由于冠上了北京的大名, 简直可以横着走,连香甜嫩滑的南京盐水鸭,也给挤了出去了。但是讲到物尽其用,又差得远矣。我们吃烧鸭,由鸭头至鸭屁股，几乎可以悉数全收，吃它个片甲不留。可你这烤鸭呢,人家瞧得上的,就只有那薄薄的一张皮,早已沦为头台,任你填也好塞也好,根本不成大器。所以广东人干脆管它叫片皮鸭,和本是一家的兄弟划清界线,免得烧、烤混淆。
fc4ef131aef5e263409e2f7bd3398a336505f4a7.translatedText: The fate of roast duck is much better. Because it has the name of Beijing, it can almost go sideways, even the sweet and tender Nanjing salted duck is squeezed out. But when it comes to making the best use of everything, it is far from enough. When we eat roasted duck, we can eat almost all of it from the duck head to the duck buttocks, leaving no trace behind. But as for your roast duck, the only thing that people value is the thin skin. It has long been reduced to the top, no matter how stuffed it is, it is not a big deal at all. So the Cantonese people simply call it sliced ​​duck to draw a clear line between brothers who are members of the same family, so as to avoid confusion between roasting and roasting.

4caded2df978d6b68fafdb3ba0b589f7b1c7e229.sourceText: 大大的一只鸭,只吃小小几片皮,有多可惜!岂料更糟的还在后头,现在有些人竟连鸭皮也不敢吃了,原因是动物的皮乃高胆固醇者五大戒条之一,不可不小心。你们说啦,如此红亮润泽、皮脆肉滑的烤鸭,教它以后如何是好! 其实,老美无知而已。要知道,烧鸭在风干之前​​,需先行涂料上皮,这样做除了令鸭更加鲜美可口之外, 同时还有保鲜作用,使鸭质在一定时间内不会变坏。至于烤鸭, 那就更玄,讲出来相信老美只有瞪眼的份儿。需知烤鸭的吃法,应是鸭皮加大蒜, 再加甜酱,然后用烙饼包之。是的,鸭皮不错是肥了一点,但大蒜刚好把那油腻给劈了;大蒜无疑也是辛辣了一点,但甜酱又刚好把那怪味给盖了; 而烙饼,那该是一张刚刚烙好的薄饼,柔软而温香, 这样凑合起来, 才是一件足堪回味的烤鸭。不必吃饭,来一碗小米粥,便是无以上之。问题是,这里并无北京填鸭供应,为了应市,只好以广东烧鸭充数;同时,也不知是谁自作聪明,觉得烙饼不大对广东人的胃口,就以白面粉做的甜饼顶替,结果大有来头的北京烤鸭,就这样变成了甜不辣不知何味了!
4caded2df978d6b68fafdb3ba0b589f7b1c7e229.translatedText: What a pity it is to eat only a few pieces of skin from a big duck! Unexpectedly, the worse is yet to come. Now some people even dare not eat duck skin. The reason is that animal skin is one of the five major precepts for people with high cholesterol. Do not be careful. You said, with such a bright red and moist roast duck, crispy skin and smooth meat, teach it what to do in the future! In fact, we are just ignorant. You should know that before the roasted duck is dried, it needs to be coated on the skin. This not only makes the duck more delicious, but also has a preservation effect, so that the quality of the duck will not deteriorate within a certain period of time. As for the roast duck, it's even more mysterious. If you tell me about it, I believe the Americans will just stare. You need to know how to eat roast duck: add garlic to duck skin, add sweet sauce, and then wrap it with pancakes. Yes, the duck skin is a little fatter, but the garlic just cuts through the greasiness; the garlic is undoubtedly a little spicy, but the sweet sauce just covers up the strange smell; and the pancake should be a freshly baked pancake, soft and warm, so combined, it is a roast duck that is worthy of the aftertaste. No need to eat, a bowl of millet porridge is the best. The problem is that there is no supply of Peking duck here, so in order to meet the market demand, they have to use Cantonese roast duck. At the same time, I don’t know who is smart enough to think that pancakes are not suitable for Cantonese people, so they use sweet pancakes made of white flour instead. As a result, the famous Peking duck has become sweet or not spicy!

f304123464521ad09992588c10272d5463c1fd65.sourceText: 看来跟盐水鸭一样,烧鸭和烤鸭也是苦命鸭!
f304123464521ad09992588c10272d5463c1fd65.translatedText: It seems that like salted duck, roast duck and roast duck are also miserable ducks!

9a451c92ed5bb7a957e8cfccc406ddcc3b7691f4.translatedText: Go crazy with your kids—Alberta College of the Arts Summer Camp From June to August 2017, the Art Institute of Alberta held its first summer camp. With Li Cihui...

b4ee5894595bdf594de9ea98a7d3f437f3a36d47.sourceText: 2017年6月到8月，亚省艺术学院开办了首期暑期夏令营，在李慈惠，Molly, 吴老师，谢老师的共同努力下，全新的以开发，引导为主的教育模式，受到了老师和家长们一致好评。 在游戏中学习中文 怎么让不同年龄，不同语言程度的孩子，喜欢开口说中文，努力的说中文？这可是把老师们难坏了，看看无聊的教科书，几个标准的中文句子，难道就让孩子们重复重复再重复吗？不行，这样的教科书，老师自己都看不下去，怎么让孩子们喜欢？于是我们的中文学习就从组建一家”幸运龙”餐厅开始，孩子们有的当经理，有的当服务员，有的当顾客，我们利用一周的课程，让孩子学会了餐厅礼貌用语，中文菜，中文甜点等等基本句子和单词。孩子们也很快把自己学的单词和句子派上用场，在餐厅里开始自由交流。怎样增加更多的单词量，还能继续扩大中文的使用范围呢？一直当一个彬彬有礼的吃客，多没意思呀？有一天，老师让孩子们到餐厅当一个”捣蛋鬼”，这可把孩子们高兴坏了。一个不礼貌的顾客，看看餐厅的服务员和经理们如何应付。当遇到不礼貌顾客，经理和服务员们自己想到了需要打电话跟孩子们的家长交流，反映孩子在餐厅的不良行为，甚至打电话向警察求助。同时在游戏结束后他们还讨论，为什么顾客不礼貌，他们哪些地方做得不对，怎样罚款和惩罚。一个小小餐厅，让孩子们扮演了不同角色，最大限度地发挥了，他们的中文使用能力。老师也成了，”幸运龙”厅里最难对付的捣蛋鬼，给孩子们带来了很多麻烦，可是对付不礼貌顾客，孩子们的鬼主意也真不少，同样罚老师表演节目，为餐厅搞卫生，还要坐牢。。。。。真是个疯狂餐厅！
b4ee5894595bdf594de9ea98a7d3f437f3a36d47.translatedText: From June to August 2017, the Art Institute of Alberta held its first summer camp. With the joint efforts of Li Cihui, Molly, Teacher Wu, and Teacher Xie, the new education model that focuses on development and guidance has been well received by teachers and parents. Learning Chinese in games How to make children of different ages and language proficiency like to speak Chinese and work hard to speak Chinese? This is very difficult for teachers. Looking at the boring textbooks and a few standard Chinese sentences, are they just asking the children to repeat them again and again? No, the teacher himself can’t stand this kind of textbook, so how can the children like it? So our Chinese learning started by setting up a "Lucky Dragon" restaurant. Some of the children worked as managers, some as waiters, and some as customers. We used a week's course to let the children learn basic sentences and words such as restaurant politeness, Chinese dishes, Chinese desserts, etc. The children also quickly put the words and sentences they learned to use and began to communicate freely in the restaurant. How to add more words and continue to expand the scope of Chinese use? How boring is it to be a polite diner all the time? One day, the teacher asked the children to be "troublemakers" in the restaurant, which made the children very happy. A rude customer, see how the waiters and managers of the restaurant deal with it. When encountering rude customers, the manager and waiters themselves thought of calling the children's parents to report their children's bad behavior in the restaurant, and even called the police for help. At the same time, after the game, they also discussed why the customers were rude, what they did wrong, and how to fine and punish them. A small restaurant allows children to play different roles and maximize their Chinese language skills. The teacher has also become the most difficult troublemaker in the "Lucky Dragon" hall, causing a lot of trouble for the children. However, the children also have a lot of tricks to deal with rude customers. They also punish the teacher to perform a show, clean up the restaurant, and even go to jail. . . . . What a crazy restaurant!

a446787be2a3eb4050f391bb29fba45a8fdb694e.sourceText: 孩子们自制的中文菜单

a1244b6e363c641e3f6e2a2b0c435e6442982c70.sourceText: 在故事中感受音乐 每天的声乐课是孩子们最享受，中国歌曲，美国歌曲的时候。老师给孩子们讲歌曲中的故事，让孩子用自己的想象，把音乐中的故事画出来。同样的故事，在孩子们心中却都是如此不同。
a1244b6e363c641e3f6e2a2b0c435e6442982c70.translatedText: Feel the music in the story. Daily vocal lessons are when children enjoy Chinese and American songs the most. The teacher told the children the stories in the songs and asked the children to use their imagination to draw the stories in the music. The same story is so different in the minds of children.

7548b607e11470977ffb0a6781860433da0d7a71.sourceText: 孩子们根据音乐里的故事画出的故事梗概 在手工中领略生活 泥塑，剪纸，折纸，穿手链，搭房子，手工课的精彩内容数也数不过来。老师让孩子们在基本色彩搭配的基础上，给了一些孩子们自由发挥空间。在完成老师老是需要他们完成的手工后，他们可以根据自己的想象，做自己想做的东西。看看他们的杰作，只有你想不到的，没有您看不着的。
7548b607e11470977ffb0a6781860433da0d7a71.translatedText: The children draw a summary of the story based on the story in the music. Experience life through handicrafts. Clay sculpture, paper cutting, origami, wearing bracelets, building houses, there are countless exciting contents in the handicraft class. The teacher asked the children to use the basic color matching and gave some children space to play freely. After completing the craft work that the teacher always wants them to do, they can make what they want according to their imagination. Take a look at their masterpieces. There is nothing you can’t imagine but nothing you can’t see.

605755d17eee393cce48d337f81fc96841731c9e.sourceText: 小朋友用杯子蛋糕的杯子制作的手工
605755d17eee393cce48d337f81fc96841731c9e.translatedText: > Children’s handicrafts made from cup cake cups

77a4d8c90578b3c83bd789c88ea84676847a44ec.sourceText: 在运动中传承文化 ”左三圈 右三圈 脖子扭扭 屁股扭扭，早睡早起 咱们来做运动”健身操和武术是夏令营中的特色。孩子们和专业的舞蹈和武术老师一起学习舞蹈和武术的基本功。教室里常常传来，响亮的习武之声。。。。。看看他们第一次练习马步的样子吧！
77a4d8c90578b3c83bd789c88ea84676847a44ec.translatedText: Inheriting culture through sports “Three circles on the left, three circles on the right, neck twisting, butt twisting, go to bed early and get up early, let’s do some exercise” Aerobics and martial arts are the features of the summer camp. Children learn the basics of dance and martial arts with professional dance and martial arts teachers. The loud sound of martial arts practice often comes from the classroom. . . . . Look at how they practice horse walking for the first time!

635c0233e26fdee62ae9c0a7ed908e32a72ce40d.sourceText: 正在学功夫的孩子们 首期亚省艺术学院的夏令营圆满结束了，老师，孩子，家长们都很开心和满意，我们相约下一个假期。9月23日亚省艺术学院的”中秋国庆晚会”将在mesa arts center举行，今年的晚会又有新内容，音乐剧就要给你带来惊喜！欢迎大家报名来参加表演！一起欢庆我们的节日。 更多精彩课程8月隆重开始
635c0233e26fdee62ae9c0a7ed908e32a72ce40d.translatedText: Children who are learning kung fu. The first summer camp of the Art Institute of Alberta has ended successfully. The teachers, children, and parents are very happy and satisfied. We will meet up for the next vacation. 59407f96bb7289e305d081e7b5a5937f2cd61184.sourceText: 非法？女人经营食物银行遭控 （亚省时报） 一名格兰岱市的女人说，该市威胁她，如果她继续在她自家前院经营食物银行，市政府将把她送监狱。 过去七年里，拉米雷斯在自家前院分发免费食物给有需要的人士。但市政府说，他们已经接到投诉，说拉米雷斯此举令许多无业游民出现在该社区，严重影响该社区的治安，而且她并没有向市政府申请开设食物银行的要求。市政府说，如果拉米雷斯继续经营，她将面临被罚款甚至被捕。 卢瑟福协会现自愿帮助拉米雷斯，他们向格兰岱市政府发出律师信，声称市政府的决定违反了宪法权利和亚利桑那法律。 市长会见拉美雷斯，对她的食物银行进行了解。拉米雷斯说，她只想继续分发免费食物给有需要的人。 评：美国虽然没有城管，但也不能在自家前院摆摊。
59407f96bb7289e305d081e7b5a5937f2cd61184.translatedText: Illegal? Woman charged for running food bank (Alberta Times) A ​​Glendale woman says the city threatened to send her to jail if she continued to run a food bank in her front yard. For the past seven years, Ramirez has distributed free food to those in need in his front yard. However, the city government said that they had received complaints that Ramirez’s move had caused many unemployed homeless people to appear in the community, seriously affecting the security of the community, and that she had not applied to the city government for opening a food bank. The city says Ramirez faces fines and even arrest if she continues to operate. The Rutherford Association has now volunteered to help Ramirez, sending an attorney's letter to the Glendale city claiming the city's decision violates constitutional rights and Arizona law. The mayor met with Ramirez to learn about her food bank. Ramirez said she just wants to continue distributing free food to those in need. Comment: Although there is no urban management in the United States, you cannot set up a stall in your front yard.

c9083dd82c4b486bddb797d70a05ec21e89b4cc2.sourceText: （亚利桑那州台湾同乡联谊会供稿）昨晚（2013年9月29日），图桑近两百华人嘉宾在图桑Casio Del Sol共襄盛举，欢庆”双十”祝中华民国成立102年。远道而来的台湾综艺主持 王海波，知名歌手方宁（小凤飞飞），情歌王子王瑞瑜，模仿秀大王阿标，给现场来宾带来一场齐聚乡音乡情的精彩演出。 晚会于6时，亚利桑那州台湾同乡联谊会王瑞瑾宣布晚宴正式开始，台湾侨委会咨询委员尹衍桓，高志中，图桑中华文化中心会长，Richard Fe Tom 夫妇，负责人Peter Chan，图桑老年中心 Patsy Lee，以及来自凤凰城的侨联顾问邓朝驹，海外妇女会Annie White，中华总会会长邱顺雄夫妇，台湾同乡联谊会会会长万培杰都到现场祝贺。
c9083dd82c4b486bddb797d70a05ec21e89b4cc2.translatedText: (Contributed by the Taiwanese Association of Arizona) Last night (September 29, 2013), nearly two hundred Chinese guests in Tucson participated in a grand event at Casio Del Sol in Tucson to celebrate the "Double Ten" and celebrate the 102nd anniversary of the founding of the Republic of China. Taiwanese variety show host Wang Haibo, well-known singer Fang Ning (Xiao Feng Feifei), love song prince Wang Ruiyu, and imitation show king Abiao all came from afar to give the guests a wonderful performance that brought together local accents and nostalgia. At 6 o'clock, Arizona Taiwanese Association Wang Ruijin announced the official start of the dinner. Taiwan Overseas Chinese Affairs Council advisory committee members Yin Yanhuan, Gao Zhizhong, president of the Tucson Chinese Cultural Center, Richard Fe Tom and his wife, director Peter Chan, Tucson Senior Center Patsy Lee, overseas Chinese Federation consultant Deng Chaoju from Phoenix, Overseas Women's Association Annie White, Chinese Federation President Qiu Shunxiong and his wife, Taiwanese Association President Wan Peijie all came to the scene to congratulate.

ba0adc489f26321f5b59c05ad56f1dd6f9c54bd3.sourceText: 知名综艺主持王海波，曾是台湾女花脸第一人，首位参加中国春晚演出的台湾花脸演员，播音金钟奖获得者。在洛杉矶定居１５年，第三次来亚利桑那演出。当晚给嘉宾带来了歌曲《包青天》 还用戏曲的方式演绎有关月亮的流行歌曲，又把大家带到了中秋月圆时分。王海波从艺五十年，她表示会不断的传承自己科班出身的戏曲事业，但是会用更多元化的方式来把这些精彩的技艺展现给观众，她现在涉足，主持，歌唱，表演等多种表演方式，给嘉宾带来一个难忘的夜晚。
ba0adc489f26321f5b59c05ad56f1dd6f9c54bd3.translatedText: Wang Haibo, a well-known variety show host, was the first Taiwanese female with colorful faces, the first Taiwanese colorful-faced actor to participate in the China Spring Festival Gala, and the winner of the Golden Bell Award for Broadcasting. Having lived in Los Angeles for 15 years, this is my third time performing in Arizona. That night, the song "Bao Qingtian" was brought to the guests, and a popular song about the moon was performed in the form of opera, which brought everyone to the full moon of the Mid-Autumn Festival. Wang Haibo has been in the performing arts for 50 years. She said that she will continue to pass on her opera career, but will use more diversified ways to show these wonderful skills to the audience. She is now involved in hosting, singing, performing and other performance methods to bring an unforgettable night to the guests.

0f418db5404371207ff3fcd189f844174f2b0dc9.translatedText: Wang Ruiyu, the Prince of Love Songs, performed popular love songs such as "Kapok Road", "Teardrops of Love", "Release Me" and "Love You for Ten Thousand Years" to the guests. There was great harmony on and off the stage.

9518b61f973bd24c1a579fab6352b5300477e819.sourceText: 王瑞瑜是本次演出团的领队，他对当晚演员们的表现非常满意，他说有两位艺人都是第一次来图桑，可是对于这么干燥炎热的天气，以及时差问题，演员们都自己调整得很好，演出非常顺利，更重要的是台上台下的互动，王瑞瑜表示一台专业的演出，就是有观众参与的互动节目。他们非常在乎全场嘉宾的反应，当晚的气氛他非常满意。
9518b61f973bd24c1a579fab6352b5300477e819.translatedText: Wang Ruiyu is the leader of this performance group. He is very satisfied with the performance of the actors that night. He said that two of the artists came to Tucson for the first time. However, the actors adjusted well to such a dry and hot weather and the jet lag problem. The performance went very smoothly. What is more important is the interaction on and off the stage. Wang Ruiyu said that a professional performance is an interactive program with the participation of the audience. They cared very much about the reaction of all the guests, and he was very satisfied with the atmosphere that night.
