619db0dd399bd1b87e5aa7a04924dd9ac69e66cf.sourceText: 华人一般来说都比较吟持稳重，遇见生人不多说话，更不用说说心裡话了。经过三天的共处，团内的朋友互相比较熟悉起来，相互交谈的话题也显得轻松和自由多了。这天晚上，我和几位来自加拿大的台湾朋友在一起聊天，大家对灵山梵宫的建筑都赞不绝口，其艺术造诣可与着名的伦敦威斯敏斯特大教堂嫓美。但是，从整个佈局来看，总觉得和佛教的理念有些格格不入。在我们的概念裡，佛教殿堂都是按天圆地方的观念，平面佈局，层层深入，和北京的四合院有相似之处，如今灵山梵宫是高柱长廊苍穹结构，让人有如进入罗马基督教堂时相似的感觉，只是壁画，花纹，凋塑完全是佛教的人物和故事。另外就是我们在灵山看到一些穿着黄色背心的人在打扫场院，给我们一种异样的感觉，一问才知道是临时工，而不是寺院的小和尚。这和我们头脑中的概念有很大的不同。据我所知，中国大陆长期以来，实行按行政级别来确定工资和生活待遇，直至住房标准，例如科技人员定为工程师–科级待遇，高工–处级待遇，教授–局级待遇，从而各行各业都都有了一个级别划分，因此也出现了处级和尚，局级喇嘛，唱歌也可以唱成将军的现象。如今的和尚都是大学毕业的学士级和尚，当然不会再从打扫庭院做起囖！再说，大陆这些年一直提倡以经济效益为中心，这个思想也渗透到宗教领域，有的寺院也实行了承包，脱俗的僧侣也被拉回到纷繁的大千世界，用香火，求签，旅游来提高经济效益，扰乱了佛门的清淨，这是一个值得注意的问题。 閒谈中，还有一位台湾朋友向我提出一个古怪的问题，”共产党不信教，为什麽花这麽多钱建大佛？”我一时语塞，不知从何答起。突然，大学裡上”政治经济学”课的一条理论跃入了我的脑海，即经济基础和上层建筑的关係。经济基础决定上层建筑，上层建筑又反作用于经济基础。宗教，文化，艺术都属于上层建筑的范畴，上层建筑要为经济基础服务。共产党要管理好国家，就一定要管好宗教，文化，艺术等上层建筑领域的东西。建造大佛，能团结广大的佛教信众，进一步有利于推动两岸的文化交流，实现祖国和平统一的目标，我想这就是不信教的人建大佛的原因。 晚餐，品尝了驰名的无锡小排骨，果然名不虚传，外焦裡嫩，酥烂可口。是用江南的一种细皮白肉猪的前腿处的排骨肉制作。现已有小包装产品销往国外，改革开放给中国产品带来了无限商机。 在进入餐厅的大饭店门口，赫然写着某某局长乔迁之喜，酒会在二楼梅花厅。给我的第一反应就是这一定是贪官。个人搬家最多请客人来新居祝贺罢了，还到大饭店大摆宴席干什麽，这那还有一点点共产党的味道，十足的败类。奇怪的是，中国政府一直在提反腐倡廉，还有人敢这样做。中纪委只要到大饭店走一圈，就可以轻而易举地查出一批贪官来。 第二天上午，参观了宜兴紫砂陶瓷研究所，壁橱裡陈列着许多珍贵的紫砂壶。大的比人体还高，精致的只有手指姆那麽大，形态各异。宜兴紫砂壶已有数百年的历史，主要在这裡地下几10米深处，蕴藏着一层含铁的粘土粉砂岩，质地非常细腻。当地百姓靠山吃山，把它开採出来，经过拍打，造型，烧制等工艺，制成紫砂壶。它的外形优雅，色泽紫而不姹，红而不嫣；泡茶则不夺茶香，吸附茶气。历代多少文人为之倾倒，多少墨客为之挥毫，明清朝廷也把它选为贡品，做出的品牌为当地创造了可观的经济效益。这种以资源为依托的手工工艺产品，是受到资源限制的，现在，已拥有一批国家级美术工艺师，他们以精巧的工艺，做出行行色色的珍贵紫砂艺术品，我相信不用多久，紫砂壶的涨幅一定会超过汽油！
619db0dd399bd1b87e5aa7a04924dd9ac69e66cf.translatedText: Generally speaking, Chinese people are more reserved and do not speak much when meeting strangers, let alone speak their true feelings. After three days of being together, the friends in the group became more familiar with each other, and the topics of conversation became much more relaxed and free. That evening, I was chatting with several Taiwanese friends from Canada. Everyone was full of praise for the architecture of Lingshan Brahma Palace. Its artistic achievements can be compared to the famous Westminster Abbey in London. However, looking at the entire layout, I always feel that it is somewhat incompatible with Buddhist concepts. In our concept, Buddhist temples are based on the concept of a round sky and a square earth, with a plane layout and deep layers. They are similar to the courtyard houses in Beijing. Today, the Lingshan Brahma Palace has a sky structure with high columns, long corridors, and gives people a similar feeling as when entering a Roman Christian church. However, the murals, patterns, and sculptures are all Buddhist characters and stories. In addition, we saw some people in yellow vests cleaning the courtyard in Lingshan, which gave us a strange feeling. After asking, we found out that they were temporary workers, not young monks from the temple. This is very different from the concept in our minds. As far as I know, for a long time in mainland China, wages and living conditions have been determined according to administrative levels, as well as housing standards. For example, scientific and technological personnel are classified as engineers - section-level treatment, senior engineers - division-level treatment, and professors - bureau-level treatment. As a result, all walks of life have been divided into levels. Therefore, there is also the phenomenon that division-level monks and bureau-level lamas can sing and become generals. Today’s monks are all bachelor-level monks who have graduated from universities. Of course, they will no longer start by cleaning courtyards! Besides, the mainland has been advocating economic benefits as the center in recent years. This idea has also penetrated into the religious field. Some temples have also implemented contracting. Refined monks have also been dragged back into the complicated world. They use incense, fortune-seeking, and tourism to improve economic benefits, disturbing the purity of Buddhism. This is a noteworthy issue. During the chat, a Taiwanese friend asked me a strange question, "Why does the Communist Party spend so much money building a giant Buddha if it doesn't believe in religion?" I was at a loss for words and didn't know where to start my answer. Suddenly, a theory from the "Political Economics" class in college jumped into my mind, that is, the relationship between the economic base and the superstructure. The economic base determines the superstructure, and the superstructure reacts on the economic base. Religion, culture, and art all belong to the category of superstructure, and the superstructure must serve the economic base. If the Communist Party wants to manage the country well, it must manage things in the superstructure such as religion, culture, and art. Building the Giant Buddha can unite the vast number of Buddhist believers, further promote cultural exchanges between the two sides of the Taiwan Strait, and achieve the goal of peaceful reunification of the motherland. I think this is why non-believers build Giant Buddhas. For dinner, we tasted the famous Wuxi short ribs. It was well-deserved, charred on the outside, tender on the inside, crispy and delicious. It is made from the spareribs from the front legs of a kind of fine-skinned white pig from Jiangnan. Nowadays, small packaged products are sold abroad, and reform and opening up have brought unlimited business opportunities to Chinese products. At the door of the hotel as you enter the restaurant, it is clearly written that Director XX is moving into a new house. The reception will be in the Plum Blossom Hall on the second floor. My first reaction was that this must be a corrupt official. When a person moves, he only invites guests to the new house to congratulate him. Why should he hold a banquet in a big hotel? There is still a little bit of the Communist Party in him, and he is a complete scum. What is strange is that the Chinese government has been promoting anti-corruption and promoting integrity, but there are still people who dare to do so. The Central Commission for Discipline Inspection can easily identify a group of corrupt officials by simply visiting a large hotel. The next morning, I visited the Yixing Zisha Ceramics Research Institute. There were many precious Zisha pots displayed in the closet. The big ones are taller than the human body, and the exquisite ones are only as big as a fingertip, with different shapes. Yixing Zisha teapot has a history of hundreds of years. It mainly contains a layer of iron-containing clay siltstone several 10 meters underground. The texture is very fine. Local people rely on the mountains to mine it, and after beating, shaping, firing and other processes, they make purple clay pots. Its appearance is elegant, its color is purple but not beautiful, and red but not red. When making tea, it does not take away the tea aroma, but absorbs the tea aroma. Many literati in the past dynasties were fascinated by it, and many poets were fascinated by it. The Ming and Qing dynasties also selected it as a tribute, and the brand they created created considerable economic benefits for the local area. This resource-based handicraft product is limited by resources. Now, we have a group of national-level art craftsmen. They use exquisite craftsmanship to create a wide range of precious purple clay artworks. I believe that it won’t be long before the price of purple clay teapots will exceed that of gasoline!

b593689f67e43433185b0043871b1db4f6d33d10.sourceText: 紫砂陶瓷研究所的门前是许多个体户组成的商业街，在这裡又看到了无锡老街的气息，保留着原质原味。无锡以泥菩萨出名，各种神态各异，色彩鲜豔的泥胎制成的大大小小的老头，老太太，小娃娃和各色人物摆满了地摊，十分可爱迷人，价格也不贵，大家都买一点回家送朋友。泥菩萨的造型也有了新发展，有一种名叫”小孩撒尿”的泥娃娃，泡在水中，拿出来用开水一浇，就会自己撒尿，真好玩！其原型可能来自比利时的那个撒尿的小童。在地摊上用竹圈套泥菩萨的游戏还是吸引着众多的游客。还有我小时候去玩耍时最喜欢吃的挑担卖的豆腐脑，五分钱一碗，上面还撒上一点点虾皮。紫菜和香油，味道好极了。在这条街上，终于见到了一家卖豆腐脑的摊位，挑担已变成了大桶，两块钱一碗，价钱涨了40倍，味道远不如过去，可能是水质不像过去那麽纯淨了。人也是一样，越长越成熟，但少年时代那纯真的味道再也找不回来了，我真留恋少年时代的那个我。（待续）
b593689f67e43433185b0043871b1db4f6d33d10.translatedText: In front of the Zisha Ceramics Research Institute is a commercial street composed of many self-employed people. Here you can see the atmosphere of the old streets of Wuxi, retaining the original taste. Wuxi is famous for its clay Bodhisattva. Old men, old ladies, little dolls and other characters of various shapes and sizes made of colorful clay bodies with different looks and expressions are all placed on the street stalls. They are very cute and charming, and the price is not expensive. Everyone buys some to take home as gifts for their friends. There has also been a new development in the shape of the clay Bodhisattva. There is a kind of clay doll called "kid peeing". It is soaked in water, taken out and poured with boiling water, and it will pee on its own. It's so fun! The prototype may come from the Belgian pissing child. The game of trapping clay Buddhas in bamboo traps at street stalls still attracts many tourists. There is also the tofu puff that I loved to eat when I was playing on the street. It costs five cents a bowl, with a little dried shrimps sprinkled on top. Seaweed and sesame oil, it tastes great. On this street, I finally saw a stall selling tofu porridge. The burden has turned into a big bucket. A bowl costs two yuan. The price has increased 40 times. The taste is far inferior to that in the past. Maybe the water quality is not as pure as it used to be. The same goes for people, they become more mature as they grow older, but the innocence of their youth can never be found again. I really miss the me in my youth. (to be continued)

9b028d6abfaebccd54fc725106b9312247d46bb8.sourceText: 中国证监会解聘吴建敏 新官郭树清走马上任 （亚省时报广州特约记者杨绮薇报道） 中国证监会1日发布公告，解聘第三届并购重组委委员、北京天健兴业资产评估有限公司总经理吴建敏，这是证监会历史上首次解聘并购重组委员会委员。中国证监会有关负责人表示，吴建敏委员在借用他人账户持有ST圣方股票的情况下，未按规定申请回避，于2010年3月3日参与审核了ST圣方并构重组方案，违反了证监会的相关规定。 曾两度获得中国经济界最高奖”孙冶方奖”、被称为学者型官员的建行董事长郭树清被委以重任，赴任中国证监会主席。这位温文尔雅、待人平和的学者型官员，履历颇为丰富：1998年，42岁的郭树清从体改委官员的位置上调贵州省任副省长，分管外资和金融，完成了第一次跨越。2001年，恰逢中国外汇储备的巨额增长期，郭树清调任国家外汇管理局局长，从副省长到金融高官，再次完成第二次跨越；而这一次，郭树清要从银行业走入证券业，引领中国资本市场的未来。 中国证监会新任主席郭树清走马上任的第一天上午，出席了第九届中小企业融资论坛，他在致辞中表示，证监会对内幕交易和证券期货犯罪始终坚持”零容忍”的态度，发现一起坚决查处一起。他指出，现阶段我国的内幕交易有两种情况：有一部分人有目的地利用特殊地位和关系，谋取不正当利益；也有一部分人主观意识不甚明确，没有认识到这是与贪污、盗窃、欺诈性质相近的犯罪行为。 郭树清承诺，将继续改进监管手段和方式，严惩操纵市场、欺诈上市、利益输送、虚假披露等违法违规行为，维护好市场三公原则。”小偷从菜市场偷一棵白菜，人们都可以义愤填膺。但是有人把手伸进了成千上万股民的钱包，却常常不会引起人们重视。这就是内幕交易的实质。?#37101;树清这段形象生动的话语铿锵有力，让股民倍受鼓舞。 虽然郭树清没有证券业的直接从业经历，但各大银行都是上市公司，且在带领建行上市的过程中，郭树清对证券业已有颇多接触。据建行一位中层管理人员评价，郭树清对建行引进战略投资者，推进上市，战略的不断转型，风险把控以及业务结构的调整方面贡献巨大。在推进商业银行转型方面，郭树清提出”以客为尊”的服务理念，注重客户体验，并极力推动建行零售业务的发展。该人士强调，郭树清对大局的把握”非常厉害”，这从建行近几年业务的发展情况来即可见一斑。为应对全球金融危机，中国政府出台了4万亿经济刺激计划，中资银行亦随之在过去两年发放了天量贷款，而在2009至2010年的巨额放贷潮中，建行的贷款增速是四家国有商业银行中最低的。今年以来政府不断加强对房地产的宏观调控，建行作为中国基建领域最有优势的银行，却早在前年就开始一直以房地产业贷款占比下降作为工作重点之一，而这一具有前瞻性的把握也让建行可以更为从容地应对宏观环境的变迁。 据悉，自郭树清2005年上任至今，建行资产规模已经有了近三倍的增长，截至今年9月末，建行总资产规模已经达到11.77万亿，不良贷款率也进一步下降为1.02%，比2005年末下降了2.82个百分点。在他任内，建行的市值曾一度超越工行，成为全球市值第一大的银行。这次郭树清临危受命，赴任证监会，股民希望这位被誉为”救火队长”的新官，上任后烧好”三把火”，把中国的股市烧得通红。
9b028d6abfaebccd54fc725106b9312247d46bb8.translatedText: The China Securities Regulatory Commission fired Wu Jianmin and a new official Guo Shuqing took office. (Reported by Yang Qiwei, Special Correspondent of the Alberta Times in Guangzhou) The China Securities Regulatory Commission issued an announcement on the 1st to dismiss Wu Jianmin, a member of the third M&A and Reorganization Committee and general manager of Beijing Tianjian Xingye Asset Appraisal Co., Ltd. This is the first time in the history of the China Securities Regulatory Commission that a member of the M&A and Reorganization Committee has been dismissed. The relevant person in charge of the China Securities Regulatory Commission said that when Wu Jianmin borrowed other people's accounts to hold ST Shengfang's stocks, he failed to apply for recusal as required and participated in the review of ST Shengfang's merger and reorganization plan on March 3, 2010, which violated the relevant regulations of the China Securities Regulatory Commission. Guo Shuqing, chairman of China Construction Bank, who has twice won the "Sun Yefang Award", the highest award in China's economic circles, and is known as a scholar-type official, has been entrusted with the important task of serving as chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission. This gentle and gentle scholar-type official has a rich resume: In 1998, the 42-year-old Guo Shuqing was promoted from the position of an official of the Restructuring Commission to the deputy governor of Guizhou Province, in charge of foreign investment and finance, completing his first leap. In 2001, coinciding with the period of huge growth in China's foreign exchange reserves, Guo Shuqing was transferred to the position of Director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, completing the second leap from deputy governor to senior financial official; and this time, Guo Shuqing wanted to move from the banking industry into the securities industry and lead the future of China's capital market. On the morning of his first day after taking office, the new chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, Guo Shuqing, attended the 9th Small and Medium Enterprises Financing Forum. In his speech, he said that the China Securities Regulatory Commission has always adhered to a "zero tolerance" attitude towards insider trading and securities and futures crimes, and will resolutely investigate and deal with each case found. He pointed out that there are two situations of insider trading in my country at this stage: some people purposefully use their special status and relationships to seek illegitimate benefits; and some people have unclear subjective consciousness and do not realize that this is a crime similar to corruption, theft, and fraud. Guo Shuqing promised to continue to improve regulatory methods and methods, severely punish illegal activities such as market manipulation, fraudulent listings, benefit transfers, false disclosures, etc., and maintain the principles of market fairness and justice. "When a thief steals a cabbage from the vegetable market, people can be filled with indignation. But when someone puts his hand into the wallets of thousands of investors, people often don't pay attention to it. This is the essence of insider trading." Shuqing's vivid words were sonorous and powerful, which encouraged investors. Although Guo Shuqing has no direct experience in the securities industry, all major banks are listed companies, and in the process of leading CCB to go public, Guo Shuqing has had a lot of exposure to the securities industry. According to the evaluation of a middle-level manager of CCB, Guo Shuqing has introduced strategic investors to CCB, promoted its listing, and continuously transformed its strategy and risks. Guo Shuqing has made great contributions in terms of control and adjustment of business structure. In terms of promoting the transformation of commercial banks, Guo Shuqing has put forward the "customer-oriented" service concept, focused on customer experience, and vigorously promoted the development of CCB's retail business. The person emphasized that Guo Shuqing's grasp of the overall situation has been "very good", which has been reflected in CCB's business in recent years. This can be seen from the development situation. In response to the global financial crisis, the Chinese government introduced a 4 trillion economic stimulus plan, and Chinese banks have also issued huge amounts of loans in the past two years. During the huge lending wave from 2009 to 2010, CCB's loan growth rate was the lowest among the four state-owned commercial banks. Since the beginning of this year, the government has continued to strengthen macro-control of real estate. As the most advantageous bank in China's infrastructure field, China Construction Bank has been focusing on the decline in the proportion of loans to the real estate industry as one of its priorities as early as the year before last. This forward-looking grasp also allows CCB to respond to changes in the macro environment more calmly. It is reported that since Guo Shuqing took office in 2005, CCB's assets have nearly tripled. As of the end of September this year, CCB's total assets have reached 11.77 trillion, and the non-performing loan ratio has further dropped to 1.02%, a decrease of 2.82% from the end of 2005. percentage points. During his tenure, CCB's market value once surpassed ICBC and became the world's largest bank. This time, Guo Shuqing was appointed to the China Securities Regulatory Commission. Investors hope that this new official, known as the "firefighting captain", will burn the "three fires" after taking office and burn China's stock market red.

bafc8e88d1be6955f38ea02eff266fb15457cac9.sourceText: (希望中文学校供稿) 2013年快要结束了，希望中文学校教学工作也渐渐接近尾声。12月11号是秋季教学的最后一天，学校依然是一片忙碌的景象，不见一点松懈。下午谢小红校长和中文组的老师召开了本学期的中文教学总结会，感谢各位老师辛勤耕耘，为每一个孩子的付出和努力, 并对下学期的中文教育提出更高的要求。鼓励老师开拓视野，加强教学趣味性及实用性。计划对老师教学需要的补充资料和用具给予大力支持。大家为下学期如何提升教学水平，培养孩子们的学习兴趣进行了热烈的讨论, 献计献策。并对如何在教学中充分利用我校正筹备建立的中文图书馆也提供了很多有建设性的建议。一些老师已经计划假期充分利用这批图书作教学参考, 补充丰富现有教材。
bafc8e88d1be6955f38ea02eff266fb15457cac9.translatedText: (Contributed by Hope Chinese School) 2013 is coming to an end, and the teaching work of Hope Chinese School is gradually coming to an end. December 11th is the last day of autumn teaching, and the school is still a busy scene, with no sign of slack. In the afternoon, Principal Xie Xiaohong and the teachers of the Chinese group held a summary meeting of Chinese teaching for this semester. They thanked all the teachers for their hard work and efforts for each child, and put forward higher requirements for Chinese education in the next semester. Encourage teachers to broaden their horizons and make teaching more interesting and practical. The plan provides strong support to teachers with supplementary materials and tools needed for teaching. Everyone had a heated discussion and offered suggestions on how to improve teaching standards and cultivate children's interest in learning in the next semester. He also provided many constructive suggestions on how to make full use of the Chinese library that our school is preparing to establish in teaching. Some teachers have planned to make full use of this batch of books as teaching reference during the holidays to supplement and enrich existing teaching materials.

c979a251936d3a1c49394ebfd30ccc94d538a384.sourceText: 演讲厅里, 陈普博士给学校和社区的书法爱好者们做书法讲座－学写楷书, 广受书法爱好者欢迎。讲座结束后，陈普博士亲自给大家做书写示范。 时间晚了, 天色也暗了, 但学校的两间舞蹈室乐声不断。所有舞蹈课最后一天还在加班加点加紧排练。何春玲老师的中国现代舞课, 蒋琳老师的中国民族舞蹈课, 汤可老师的历史文化舞剧表演课都好不热闹。老师教的热情，孩子们练得积极。一起为明年1月25日学校庆祝春节晚会和二月的中国周准备节目。同时舞蹈班开放课堂，向家长作这学期的汇报演出。
c979a251936d3a1c49394ebfd30ccc94d538a384.translatedText: In the lecture hall, Dr. Chen Pu gave calligraphy lectures to calligraphy enthusiasts in schools and communities - learning to write regular script, which was widely welcomed by calligraphy enthusiasts. After the lecture, Dr. Chen Pu personally gave everyone a writing demonstration. It was late and the sky was getting dark, but the music continued in the school's two dance studios. On the last day of all dance classes, I still worked overtime and rehearsed. Teacher He Chunling’s Chinese modern dance class, Teacher Jiang Lin’s Chinese folk dance class, and Teacher Tang Ke’s historical and cultural dance drama performance class were all very lively. The teachers teach with enthusiasm and the children practice actively. Let’s prepare programs together for the school’s Spring Festival Gala on January 25 next year and China Week in February. At the same time, the dance class opened its classroom to perform reports and performances for parents this semester.

36b1454558c0a0d961a62a02160dcf51675a16d9.translatedText: A day of intense study and life is coming to an end. Volunteers, parents, teachers and children wish each other a happy holiday and cherish their farewells. They hope to meet again when school starts on January 11, 2014 and make progress together in the new year.

a23f61c25d56869bcc9122eefe139062496734fa.sourceText: 本报综合讯「占领华尔街」运动13日持续在全美多个城市延烧。 许多在公园扎营的抗议人士，因未遵守公园关闭的宵禁规定，而遭到警方强制驱离。 几十名「占领波特兰」抗议人士无视市长的命令，13日持续待在公园建立的营地。 警方在接近中午时迅速进入营地，把抗议人士驱离至街上。 波特兰警方表示，在下午的取缔行动中，约有50人遭逮捕。 目击者指出，警方在取缔时，还使用扩音器警告民众，任何人若拒绝遵守规定，将会遭到逮捕。 波特兰市市长亚当斯(Sam Adams)先前以卫生问题，以及毒虫和窃贼在公园内横行为由，下令抗议人士的营地在12日午夜以前关闭。 在警方突袭后几个小时，开始涌入更多的抗议群众，人数在整个下午不断攀升。 数百名手持警棍的警察肩并肩站成一排，以阻挡抗议人士前进。 在整晚的对峙中，群众人数一度达到数千人；镇暴警察在清晨破晓之际陆续撤离，大多数围观民众也纷纷回家，但从10月6日在波特兰市两公园扎营至今 的抗议人士，则仍在现场。 其他城市的占领行动，还包括盐湖城警方逮捕19人。 该市约有150名抗议人士，均已在公园内扎营数周。 另外，在纽约州首府「占领奥伯尼」的行动中，有24名抗议人士因不遵守州立公园晚间11时关闭的规定而遭逮捕。 在丹佛，当局则强迫抗议人士离开公园，过程中甚至有两名抗议人士攻击警方。
a23f61c25d56869bcc9122eefe139062496734fa.translatedText: Comprehensive news from this newspaper: The "Occupy Wall Street" movement continued to spread in many cities across the United States on the 13th. Many protesters who camped in the park were forcibly removed by the police because they failed to comply with the curfew that closed the park. Dozens of "Occupy Portland" protesters ignored the mayor's order and continued to stay in the camp established in the park on the 13th. Police quickly entered the camp near noon and drove the protesters away into the streets. Portland police said about 50 people were arrested during the afternoon crackdown. Witnesses pointed out that the police also used loudspeakers to warn the public that anyone who refused to comply with the regulations would be arrested. Portland Mayor Sam Adams previously ordered the protestors' encampment to close before midnight on the 12th, citing sanitation issues and the infestation of vermin and thieves in the park. Hours after the police raid, more protesters began to arrive, with numbers rising throughout the afternoon. Hundreds of police officers armed with batons stood shoulder to shoulder to block the protesters' advance. During the confrontation throughout the night, the number of people once reached thousands; the riot police gradually withdrew at dawn in the morning, and most of the onlookers also went home. However, the protesters who had camped in two parks in Portland since October 6 are still at the scene. Occupy actions in other cities also included the arrest of 19 people by Salt Lake City police. There are about 150 protesters in the city who have been camping in the park for several weeks. In addition, during the "Occupy Albany" action in the New York State capital, 24 protesters were arrested for not complying with the 11 p.m. closure of state parks. In Denver, authorities forced protesters to leave a park, and two protesters even attacked police in the process.

d0ae073e88d5e6d3e823e678097dc8c5e3c5a5bf.sourceText: 海外华人的文化习俗，有时与祖国的民俗惯例有很多的不同，譬如侨社的春宴，往往是过完春节才开始进行，而一直要吃到四月份方可完场，其中高高兴兴的，热热闹闹的，应了那句”有心不怕迟，四月都是拜年时”的老话。 春宴是侨团与侨团，宗亲与宗亲之间的一种感情联络，亲友之间平时各忙各的，往往是”一年不见，见面一年。”能够在春宴中互相问候和祝福，是一种牵挂，也是一种缘份。往往听到有人说，谁谁去年还来过春宴呢，今年还来不来呀！ 春宴看似平凡和简单，只不过是随便吃吃饭，聊聊天，自由自在，无拘无束，彼此之间握个手，逗个笑，固然是开心一场，能够在春宴上抽到幸运奬，或者拿到奬牌、奬学金，那就更开心了。又有谁想过，就是这种不经意，无排场的聚会，竟然是维系侨情最原始又最有效力的活动呢﹖如果有那一年侨社不摆春宴了，试问问鳯凰城的老侨们，这个春季怎麽啦﹖还要不要过呀﹖ 侨团春宴往往是提早廿天发出请帖，新老侨收到就要安排出席时间，如果要穿州过省的，还得预先定下机票和车期，然后在指定时里，打扮得身光颈靓，按时按候地出席，有些老人家平时不怎麽出门，到了春宴也要劳烦儿孙开车或陪同带到宴会上去，大家见面时还会拉住手长气地说道：真是高兴啊！又见到老友了，几十岁啦，见得一回得一回呀，多多保重呀！?。 如果有上级的团体来参加春宴，那倒是天大的面子事情了，往往事先要登报以示欢迎，安棑专人接机和洗尘 ，在宴会上安棑最当眼的上座，恭请首长发表高见，然后大家拍烂手掌，事后还要登报鸣谢等等。礼规习裕虽然多多，却是一点儿也马虎不得。 春宴实际运作通常由鸣锣舞狮开始，然后由新上任的侨团主席致词，一番恭贺新禧的话语后，又常会转到传统的十二生肖文化，比如在”牛年”，就会以”牛”为题材来作文章，讲尽”牛”的好话，例如把「扭转乾坤」说成”牛”转乾坤，股市明明还在低谷，却大讲”牛气冲天”，真是语不惊人誓不休。如在”兔”年，就会说恭祝大家扬眉”吐”气，获利回”吐”等。有时也有例外，比如碰到”蛇”年或 ”鼠”年，讲不出甚麽好的恭维说话，也得千方百计，转弯抺角去”兜拢”一番，务必能联系上一些吉祥话来把气氛搞活，让到场嘉宾都能皆大欢喜。主席讲完，又到贵宾讲，统统讲完，接着如有颁奬活动的就开始颁奬，或发奬学金，有文娱节目的就开唱歌，跳舞。大家都肚子饿了，然后宴会开始。通常春宴的菜色，从第一次到最后一次，大都不会相差太多，只是数个月下来，量量腰围又多了一、两吋的，是心甘命扺还是徒呼奈何？往往也就顾不得这麽多了。 如果要介绍来宾，就有点煞有其事了，一怕读错了贵宾的”官衔”，二怕漏掉了到会侨领，计较的还要按名次排先后。如有错漏还要一一补上。被介绍的侨领尽管大家都熟络得不得了，也要起立躹躬致敬，有时往往大扺是同一帮人，只是在不同的侨团春宴见面，也得十次八次地被重覆介绍给大家，一次一次地鞠躬和挥手。众人当然也会一次又一次地鼓掌表示的祝贺。宴会高潮往往是抽奬，礼物多是日常用品，也多有用不着的，不过大家还是兴高彩烈地钉着得奖号码，能在一年之春抽到奬品，表示今年有运行了，当然值得高兴啦！ 宴会最后还得介绍侨团自身的职员，然后齐齐举杯向大家祝福，部分侨团还有祈祷，节目做完了，宗亲朋友之间再次一一握手互别珍重，叮嘱明年再见。把上这些大大小小的事情统统做完了，做好了，这样的春宴才算是大功告成。 鳯凰城的侨团春宴在侨联成立之后开始盛行，以前的侨团春宴大都在《华美酒家》和《六福酒家》轮流举办，近年也有到不同酒家设宴的。年年举办的侨社春宴虽然大同小异，但每个团体也各有特色，形成了海外华人丰富多采的侨社文化。
d0ae073e88d5e6d3e823e678097dc8c5e3c5a5bf.translatedText: The cultural customs of overseas Chinese are sometimes very different from the folk customs of the motherland. For example, the spring banquet of overseas Chinese communities often starts after the Spring Festival and is not completed until April. The happy and lively ones are in line with the old saying, "If you are determined, don't be afraid of being late, April is the time to pay New Year's greetings." The Spring Banquet is an emotional connection between overseas Chinese groups and clansmen. Relatives and friends are usually busy with their own affairs. It is often "a year of not seeing each other but a year of seeing each other." Being able to greet and wish each other at the Spring Banquet is a kind of care and a kind of fate. I often hear people say, so-and-so came to the Spring Banquet last year, but will you come this year? The Spring Banquet seems ordinary and simple. It is just about eating, chatting, free and unrestrained, shaking each other's hands and making a smile. It is certainly a happy time. If you can draw a lucky prize at the Spring Banquet, or get a medal or scholarship, it will be even happier. Who would have thought that this kind of casual and unostentatious gathering could be the most original and effective activity to maintain the friendship between overseas Chinese? If there is a year when the overseas Chinese community does not hold a spring banquet, let me ask the old overseas Chinese in Huanghuang City, what is going on this spring? Do you still want to go through it? The overseas Chinese group's spring banquet often sends invitations 20 days in advance. New and old overseas Chinese have to arrange the time to attend. If they want to cross the state or province, they have to book air tickets and bus dates in advance, and then dress up at the designated time and attend on time. Some elderly people usually don't go out much. When the spring banquet comes, they have to bother their children and grandchildren to drive or accompany them to the banquet. When everyone meets, they will hold hands and say angrily: "How happy!" I see my old friend again, he’s dozens of years old. We see him once and for all, so take care of yourself! ?. If a group from a higher level comes to attend the spring banquet, it is a huge matter of honor. They often have to publish a newspaper in advance to express their welcome. An She will be picked up and cleaned at the airport. At the banquet, An She will be the most conspicuous person. He respectfully invites the leader to express his opinion, and then everyone clapped their hands, and they will also publish a newspaper to thank them afterwards, etc. Although there are many etiquette and rules, they are not careless at all. The actual operation of the Spring Banquet usually starts with gongs and lion dances, and then the newly appointed chairman of the overseas Chinese association delivers a speech. After some words of congratulations on the new year, it often turns to the traditional zodiac culture. For example, in the "Year of the Ox", it will start with Writing an article on the subject of "cow", saying all the good things about "cow", for example, saying "cow" turns things around, the stock market is still at a low, but talking about "bullishness", it is really not surprising. For example, in the Year of the Rabbit, people would say, "I wish you all the best to raise your eyebrows and "vomit" your profits, etc." Sometimes there are exceptions. For example, if you encounter a "Snake" or "Rat" year, you can't say any good compliments, so you have to do everything you can to "get it together". You must be able to connect some auspicious words to liven up the atmosphere and make everyone present happy. After the chairman finished speaking, he went to the distinguished guests to speak. After all the speeches were finished, if there was an award ceremony, awards would be given or scholarships would be given out. If there were entertainment programs, singing and dancing would begin. Everyone was hungry, and then the party began. Usually the dishes at the spring banquet will not differ much from the first to the last. However, after a few months, the waist circumference has increased by one or two inches. Are you willing to die or do you want to do nothing? Often I don’t care about so much. If you want to introduce guests, it would be a bit awkward. Firstly, you are afraid of mispronounced the "official title" of the distinguished guest, and secondly, you are afraid of missing the overseas Chinese leaders who are attending the meeting, and you have to arrange them according to their ranking. If there are any errors or omissions, please make them up one by one. Even though the introduced overseas Chinese leaders are very familiar to everyone, they still have to stand up and bow in salute. Sometimes the leaders are from the same group, but they meet at different overseas Chinese group spring banquets, and they have to be introduced to everyone ten or eight times, bowing and waving again and again. Of course, everyone would applaud again and again to express their congratulations. The climax of the banquet is often the lottery. Most of the gifts are daily necessities, and most of them are useless. However, everyone still happily pins the winning numbers. Being able to draw a prize in the spring of the year means that it has been successful this year. Of course, it is worth being happy! At the end of the banquet, the staff of the overseas Chinese group had to be introduced, and then they all raised their glasses to bless everyone. Some of the overseas Chinese groups also prayed. After the program was over, relatives and friends shook hands again one by one, cherished each other, and told them to see each other again next year. Once all these big and small things are done and done, the Spring Banquet will be considered complete. The spring banquets of overseas Chinese groups in Huanghuang City became popular after the establishment of the Overseas Chinese Federation. In the past, most spring banquets of overseas Chinese groups were held alternately at "Huamei Restaurant" and "Liukfook Restaurant". In recent years, banquets have also been held in different restaurants. Although the spring banquets of overseas Chinese communities held every year are similar, each group also has its own characteristics, forming a rich and colorful overseas Chinese community culture.

f6a6ff8f0f2cd75228dfdacbfecfe77fb8281f22.translatedText: According to confirmation from relevant departments, Yi Junqing, the main person in charge of the Central Translation and Translation Bureau, is not suitable to continue working in his current position due to life style problems. He has been removed from his post as director of the Central Translation and Translation Bureau, and Jia Gaojian has been appointed as director of the Central Translation and Translation Bureau.

f4639a1b08b6762035ba4db4a5eabbb3f71c0756.sourceText: 衣俊卿，教授、博士生导师，中央编译局局长。1976年7月?978年2月在黑龙江省虎林县迎春粮库青年点下乡，1982年毕业于北 京大学哲学系，1987年获贝尔格莱德大学哲学博士学位。曾先后担任黑龙江大学哲学系主任，《求是学刊》主编，黑龙江大学副校长，黑龙江大学校长、党委副 书记。2007年3月起任黑龙江省委宣传部部长、省社会科学界联合会党组书记，2007年4月起担任黑龙江省委常委、省委宣传部部长、省社会科学界联合会 党组书记。2010年2月起担任中央编译局局长。现兼任中国现代外国哲学学会副会长、中国俄罗斯东欧中亚学会副会长、中国辩证唯物主义学会常务理事、中国 人学学会常务理事、中国马克思主义哲学史学会理事。
f4639a1b08b6762035ba4db4a5eabbb3f71c0756.translatedText: Yi Junqing, professor, doctoral supervisor, director of the Central Compilation and Translation Bureau. From July 1976 to February 1978, he went to the countryside at the Youth Point of Yingchun Grain Depot, Hulin County, Heilongjiang Province. He graduated from the Philosophy Department of Peking University in 1982 and received a doctorate in philosophy from the University of Belgrade in 1987. He has served as the dean of the Philosophy Department of Heilongjiang University, the editor-in-chief of Qiushi Journal, the vice president of Heilongjiang University, and the president and deputy secretary of the Party Committee of Heilongjiang University. From March 2007, he served as the director of the Propaganda Department of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee and the Party Secretary of the Provincial Federation of Social Sciences. Since February 2010, he has served as the director of the Central Translation and Translation Bureau. He is currently the vice president of the Chinese Society of Modern Foreign Philosophy, the vice president of the Chinese Society of Russian, Eastern European and Central Asian Studies, the executive director of the Chinese Society of Dialectical Materialism, the executive director of the Chinese Society of Humanities, and the director of the Chinese Society for the History of Marxist Philosophy.

0f3dd7d02104bc1a9ee230c074185070dd6ee8e5.sourceText: 长期从事马克思主义文化哲学、国外马克思主义的研究工作，主要研究领域：马克思的实践哲学、当代马克思主义、现代化进程中的日常生活批判理论。 主要著作有：《实践派的探索与实践哲学的述评》、《东欧的新马克思主义》、《现代化与日常生活批评》、《历史与乌托邦》、《回归生活世界的文化哲学》、 《20世纪的新马克思主义》、《20世纪的文化批判》、《文化哲学》、《现代化与文化阻滞力》等。译著：《日常生活》和《宗教与当代西方文化》。在各类学 术期刊发表学术论文200多篇。
0f3dd7d02104bc1a9ee230c074185070dd6ee8e5.translatedText: has long been engaged in research on Marxist cultural philosophy and foreign Marxism. His main research areas are: Marx's practical philosophy, contemporary Marxism, and critical theory of daily life in the process of modernization. His main works include: "Review of the Exploration of Practical School and Practical Philosophy", "New Marxism in Eastern Europe", "Modernization and Criticism of Daily Life", "History and Utopia", "Cultural Philosophy Returning to the Living World", "New Marxism in the 20th Century", "Cultural Criticism in the 20th Century", "Cultural Philosophy", "Modernization and Cultural Resistance", etc. Translated: "Everyday Life" and "Religion and Contemporary Western Culture". Published more than 200 academic papers in various academic journals.

a1ebddb090cb3c3ecfd893c89dae4378f7c906a2.sourceText: 曾荣获黑龙江省十大杰出青年、黑龙江省新长征突击手、全国留学回国人员先进个人、国家级有突出贡献的中青年专家、全国宣传文化系统”四个一批”人才、全国杰出专业技术人才等称号，并入选国家”百千万人才工程”以及教育部”新世纪优秀人才支持计划”。
a1ebddb090cb3c3ecfd893c89dae4378f7c906a2.translatedText: has been awarded titles such as the Top Ten Outstanding Young People of Heilongjiang Province, the New Long March Commando of Heilongjiang Province, the National Advanced Individual for Returned Overseas Students, the National Young and Middle-aged Experts with Outstanding Contributions, the "Four Batch" Talents of the National Publicity and Culture System, and the National Outstanding Professional and Technical Talents. He was also selected into the national "Hundreds and Thousands of Talents Project" and the Ministry of Education's "New Century Excellent Talent Support Plan".

20d923b2c67716afab9724d8ae1551325aa830cc.sourceText: 搬家公司乱收费用 （亚省新闻） 一个总部设在达拉斯的搬家公司被揭露在帮客人从印第安纳州搬家到本州钱德勒市的过程中乱收费用。 原印第安纳州韦恩堡的山特先生说，7月25日，他将货物交给搬家公司之后就毫无信息，直至上周六才收到，几乎滞后一个月。而且搬家公司还提高价格，从原来的$4700提高到$8200，令山特大为火光。 搬家公司按重量收费，原给他的估计约为$6900，但货物装车后，搬家公司声称比原估计增加了12000磅，因此要加价。山特不服，报警求助。 度量衡部门上周六重新过磅，确定货物重量为7940磅，山特最后以$5546交款收货。 此事共涉及三家公司，其中搬家公司在亚利桑那州的商业牌照已经暂停，事件交由警方调查。 为了避免上述事件，山特呼吁大家，不要贪便宜，尽量与大公司打交道。遇事也别慌张，报警处理最合法。
20d923b2c67716afab9724d8ae1551325aa830cc.translatedText: Moving company overcharged (Alberta News) A Dallas-based moving company was exposed for overcharging customers while helping them move from Indiana to Chandler, home state. Mr. Shante, who is originally from Fort Wayne, Indiana, said that after he handed the goods to the moving company on July 25, he had no information. He did not receive it until last Saturday, almost a month late. Moreover, the moving company also raised the price from the original $4,700 to $8,200, which made Shante furious. The moving company charged based on weight, and the original estimate given to him was about $6,900. However, after the goods were loaded, the moving company claimed that the weight increased by 12,000 pounds compared with the original estimate, so the price had to be increased. Shan Te was dissatisfied and called the police for help. The weights and measures department re-weighed the goods last Saturday and determined the weight of the goods to be 7,940 pounds. Shante finally paid $5,546 to receive the goods. A total of three companies were involved in the matter. Among them, the moving company's business license in Arizona has been suspended, and the incident was handed over to the police for investigation. In order to avoid the above-mentioned incidents, Shante calls on everyone not to be greedy for cheap and try to deal with large companies. Don’t panic when something happens, calling the police is the most legal way to deal with it.

31ca1f09cd0d0b09012e991df7f21a6e56a668a1.sourceText: 凤凰城台北姊妹市供稿 来自十个国家与凤凰城国际姊妹会缔结姊妹城市的近五十位国际青年大使于七月聚集凤凰城访问,七月二十四日上午十时拜会凤凰城市政府,由凤凰城市议员魏那士 史瑞拉代表凤凰城市长在一楼会议大厅举行接待会,交换礼物与团体照,十个国家的国际青年大使包括Calgary, Canada; Catania, Italy; Chengdu, China; Ennis, Ireland; Grenoble, France; Hermosillo, Mexico; Himeji, Japan; Ramat-Gan, Israel, and Taipei, Taiwan及Phoenix, USA. 这是国际青年大使聚集凤凰城的亲善访问,及进行与凤凰城姊妹市及各城市之间的多元文化 交流与增进国际友谊. 同日下午一时,所有十个国家的国际青年大使应凤凰城台北姊妹市之邀观赏在凤凰城中央图书馆举行的台湾高科技图片与台湾风情文化图片展览,台北姊妹市主席李玲麟代表台湾台北市欢迎 国际青年大使光临,特别为所有国际青年大使举行切大蛋糕欢迎仪式,并赠送每位国际青年大使礼物.并且在七月二十二日下午六时为来自台湾台北市青年大使陈佳与叶拓 吾举行欢迎餐会与凤凰城台北姊妹市会员认识与联谊,同时感谢义工朋友们对台北姊妹市举办所有活动的支持与协助. 国际青年大使交流活动是每年凤凰城姊妹会很重视及很重要的活动,借着国际青年大使的交流,促进国际姊妹城市之间的美好友谊,加强国民外交,及达到多元文化交流.
31ca1f09cd0d0b09012e991df7f21a6e56a668a1.translatedText: Contributed by Phoenix City Taipei Sister City Nearly fifty international youth ambassadors from ten countries who have signed sister cities with the Phoenix International Sisterhood gathered in Phoenix for a visit in July. They paid a visit to the Phoenix City Government at 10 a.m. on July 24. Phoenix City Councilor Vinash Shreela held a reception on behalf of the mayor of Phoenix City in the conference hall on the first floor, exchanging gifts and group photos. International youth ambassadors from ten countries include Calgary, Canada; Catania, Italy; Chengdu, China; Ennis, Ireland; Grenoble, France; Hermosillo, Mexico; Himeji, Japan; Ramat-Gan, Israel, and Taipei, Taiwan and Phoenix, USA. This is a goodwill visit for the international youth ambassadors gathered in Phoenix to conduct multicultural exchanges and enhance international friendship with Phoenix sister cities and cities. At 1:00 pm on the same day, international youth ambassadors from all ten countries were invited by Phoenix Taipei sister city to view the exhibition of Taiwan high-tech pictures and Taiwanese customs and culture pictures held at the Phoenix Central Library. Taipei sister city chairman Li Linglin welcomed Taipei City, Taiwan on behalf of Taipei City. When the International Youth Ambassadors came, a big cake-cutting welcome ceremony was held for all International Youth Ambassadors, and gifts were given to each International Youth Ambassador. A welcome dinner was held at 6:00 pm on July 22 for Youth Ambassadors Chen Jia and Ye Tuowu from Taipei City, Taiwan to get to know and socialize with Phoenix City Taipei Sister City members. At the same time, we would like to thank the volunteers for their support and assistance in all activities held by Taipei Sister City. The International Youth Ambassadors exchange activity is a very important and important activity for the Phoenix City Sisters every year. Through the exchanges of international youth ambassadors, it promotes the beautiful friendship between international sister cities, strengthens national diplomacy, and achieves multicultural exchanges.

cbe81d7f7f838cc0bdec77b740cee9bb5d31f822.sourceText: 黄仕蔚先生英文名叫MANNY WONG，在上世纪七、八十年代我还做生意时，已经和黄先生相识，那时他从加州搬来鳯凰城做INSURANCE生意，黄先生为人和霭可亲 ，谦逊有礼，时常面露笑容，哥前哥后，他学贯中西，精通中英美墨多国言语，所以他在侨社很活跃，常帮助很多对英文有困难的新移民。 记得1989年我在餐馆圣诞派对席上我介绍一个新来文化界朋友与黄先相识，当时我提议在鳯凰城好否做间中文报纸，其实那时鳯凰城中国人不多，如果没有 财团或党派做后台支持，会如沙漠地耕种，不枯死才怪，但他们真的在一个月拿到执照不久他们第一间中文报纸叫亚利桑那华报在鳯凰城面世，但他们开业几个 月，大家因经济难支持暂停，后来一个创办亚省时报，另一个又创办中英文的亚美报，并非如昨日有壹间周报所说被”亚省时报给共产了”，误导读者。 无可否认，黄先生确是亚利桑那办中文报纸其中的一个先驱者。 早年黄先生不幸染上CANCER绝症，经两年多的调理，群医束手，不只钱财耗尽很多，精神打击也不少，MANN​​Y生前和事后得到各方人士，亲朋戚友，金钱和精神支持， 相信MANNY九泉之下很感激，家属也十分多谢。
cbe81d7f7f838cc0bdec77b740cee9bb5d31f822.translatedText: Mr. Huang Shiwei’s English name is MANNY WONG, when I was still doing business in the 1970s and 1980s, I already knew Mr. Huang. At that time, he moved to Phoenix from California to run the INSURANCE business. Mr. Huang was amiable, humble and polite, and always smiled. Before his elder brother, he was well versed in Chinese and Western learning, and was proficient in Chinese, British, American, and Mexican languages. Therefore, he was very active in the overseas Chinese community and often helped many new immigrants who had difficulties with English. I remember that at a restaurant Christmas party in 1989, I introduced a new friend from the cultural industry to Mr. Huang. At that time, I suggested whether to open a Chinese newspaper in Phoenix. In fact, there were not many Chinese people in Phoenix at that time. Without the backstage support of a consortium or party, it would be like farming in the desert. It would be strange if it did not die. But they really got the license in one month. Soon after, their first Chinese newspaper called Arizona Chinese News was launched in Phoenix, but they opened a few In August, everyone suspended their support due to financial difficulties. Later, one founded the Alberta Times and the other founded the Asian American Newspaper in Chinese and English. It was not as a weekly newspaper said yesterday that the "Alberta Times was given to the Communists" and misled readers. There is no denying that Mr. Huang is indeed a pioneer in running Chinese-language newspapers in Arizona. Mr. Huang unfortunately contracted CANCER in his early years. After more than two years of treatment, all the doctors were helpless. Not only did he spend a lot of money, but he also suffered a lot of mental shock. MANNY received financial and spiritual support from various people, relatives and friends before and after his death. I believe MANNY is very grateful, and his family is also very grateful.

The king said: "The old man (old gentleman) has come from a thousand miles away...

9e8a0f32caaab8fca70935be9d0fc71cf3a176f0.sourceText: 王齐先：说仁义 「说仁义」是四书中孟子卷上，孟子见梁惠王彼此对话的一句话。 王曰：「叟（老先生）不远千里而来，亦将有以利吾国乎？」孟子对曰：「王，何必曰利？亦有?#20161;义?#32780;已矣厖!」（意思是 孟子到梁国去见国君惠王，惠王见了孟子说：老先生你不怕这千里路程来到这里，大概有什么好的法子有「利」于我梁国吧？孟子回答：国王为什么要 说到这「利」字呢？但我们还有「仁义」可谈啊厖！）假使国家的臣子不讲​​仁义道德，而先讲「利」，那他将来不夺去君主的王位，他 不会满足的。 至于说「仁义」那就有益处多了。 孟子公元前289前生于山东省邹县，受业子思门下，（子思是孔子之孙）他殁于公元前372年，享年84岁。 山东人有句俗话来形容人的寿命说：「你能渡过73这一关；就能活到84。」因为孔子活到73岁，孟子活到84岁，因此才有73、84这句 话。 江湖传说，毛泽东在晚年曾夸口说：我要超过「亚圣」孟子的寿命。 结果，他没超过，83岁去世。 孟子曾与其学生着孟子七篇，他的学说「尊王贱霸，重仁义，轻功利，创性善说，认为人人都可以成尧舜。」因此，后人称他「亚圣」。 谚语：「你待我不仁；我就待你不义！」史鉴「三字经」：曰仁义、礼智信，此五常，不容紊。 （意思：仁者爱之理；心之德也！义者事之宜也，一点不可紊乱。 从这些话语中，足见人民无论是愚或不肖，早就具有仁义的观念，何须乎饶舌，将此仁义，再多所解释？ 可是儒家大贤，程子曾说：「仲尼只说一个仁字，孟子开口便说仁义」。 殊不知，孟子开篇所说的「亦有仁义而已矣」，其源头乃出自孔子。 在《周易》第二章就说：「立人之道，曰仁与义。」孟子开口便说仁义，乃本乎此。 孔子将立人之道，以仁义两字提纲挈领，真是太好了，可说他是中华民族的先知。 主耶稣的大爱，祂被钉在十架上作了挽回祭，这是祂彰显立人之道，正如孔子所说：「仁者爱人」，「见义不为无勇也」。 试问谁敢博施大爱，行此大勇，成仁取义，以践神圣睿智呢？ 祂之遵从父神旨意，亦即昭示耶和华的义，故甘于成仁。 诗云：「祂的仁义存到永远（诗112：9）。而哥林多后书九章九节也引此节经文，这仁与义，就是立人之道，二者缺一不可 。 所谓人，人是活人，不是死人。 死人都要复活，信者永生，否则永死。 复活在主，立己立人，曰仁曰义，无逾于此。 旧约但以理也懂立人知道，他曾为耶路撒冷，求主的大仁大义（但9：16）。 再如对麦基洗德的释名说：「他头一个名翻出来就是仁义王。」（来7：2）在三节续说：乃是「与神的儿子相似」！ 如此可见，麦基洗德不过如神的儿子相似而已；而真的仁义王，才是我们的主，耶稣基督。 所以基督徒必靠着祂，「要多接仁义的果子」（腓一：11）。 须知「那赐粮给撒种的，赐粮给人吃的；必多多加给他种地的种子，有增添他们仁义的果子，叫他们凡事富足（哥后9：10）」。 我们既然富足，就当凡事施舍奉献，使感谢归神！ 这样仁义，何等美好。 仁义的主，既已仁义待我们，我们自当因信称义，投入祂之大仁大爱的怀抱。 实质我们都是神仁义的果子！ 来！ 我们携手连心，在主的恩典里同在下，一同开花结果，布满地面，并且使仁义的果子结满枝上（肢体）来献给神，这才是荣神益人的仁义圣灵的果子 。
9e8a0f32caaab8fca70935be9d0fc71cf3a176f0.translatedText: Wang Qixian: Talking about benevolence and righteousness "Speaking of benevolence and righteousness" is a sentence in the Mencius volume in the Four Books, when Mencius saw King Hui of Liang talking to each other. The king said: "The old man (old gentleman) has come thousands of miles away, will he be able to benefit our country?" Mencius said to him: "King, why do you need to say benefit? There is also righteousness. It's already huge!" (It means: Mencius went to Liang to meet King Hui. King Hui met Mencius and said: Old sir, you are not afraid of traveling a thousand miles here. Is there any good way to "benefit" our country? Mencius replied: Why does the king talk about the word "benefit"? But we still have "benevolence and righteousness" to talk about. If the ministers of the country do not talk about benevolence and righteousness, but talk about "benefit" first, then he will not be satisfied if he does not take away the throne of the monarch in the future. As for "benevolence and righteousness", it is much more beneficial. Mencius was born in Zouxian County, Shandong Province in 289 BC, and was a disciple of Zi Si (Zi Si was the grandson of Confucius). He died in 372 BC at the age of 84. Shandong people have a saying to describe human lifespan: "If you can survive 73 years old, you can live to 84 years old." Because Confucius lived to 73 years old and Mencius lived to 84 years old, the sayings 73 and 84 are born. Legend has it that Mao Zedong boasted in his later years: I will live longer than the "lesser sage" Mencius. As a result, he did not survive and died at the age of 83. Mencius and his students wrote seven chapters of Mencius. His doctrine "respects kings and despises hegemons, emphasizes benevolence and righteousness over utilitarianism, creates good ideas, and believes that everyone can become Yao and Shun." Therefore, later generations called him "The Lesser Sage." Proverb: "If you treat me unkindly, I will treat you unjustly!" Shi Jian's "Three Character Classic": It says benevolence, righteousness, propriety, wisdom and trust. These five constants cannot be messed up. (Meaning: Benevolence is the principle of love; the virtue of the heart! Righteousness is the right thing to do, and it must not be disordered at all. From these words, it is clear that people, whether they are stupid or unkind, have already had the concept of benevolence and righteousness. Why bother to explain this benevolence and righteousness more? However, the great Confucian sage Cheng Zi once said: "Zhongni only said the word benevolence, while Mencius spoke of benevolence and righteousness when he opened his mouth." As everyone knows, the source of what Mencius said at the beginning, "There is only benevolence and righteousness," came from Confucius. In the second chapter of the Book of Changes, he said: "The way to establish a person is benevolence and righteousness." Mencius started talking about benevolence and righteousness. The great love of the Lord Jesus was nailed to the cross as a propitiation. This is how He demonstrates the way to establish people. Just as Confucius said: "The benevolent love others." The poem goes: "His righteousness endures forever (Psalm 112:9). And 2 Corinthians 9:9 also quotes this verse. This kind and righteousness is the way to establish a person, and the two are indispensable. The so-called human beings are living people, not dead people. The dead will be resurrected, and those who believe will live forever, otherwise they will die forever. Resurrection is in the Lord. He establishes himself and establishes others. Humanity and righteousness are nothing more than this. Daniel in the Old Testament also knew that he had prayed for the Lord's mercy and righteousness for Jerusalem (Dan. 9:16). Another example is the explanation of Melchizedek's name: "His first name is translated as King of Righteousness." (Hebrews 7:2) It is continued in verse three: "Like the Son of God"! It can be seen that Melchizedek is only like the Son of God; and the real King of Righteousness is our Lord, Jesus Christ. Therefore, Christians must rely on Him to "receive the fruit of righteousness" (Philippians 1:11). We must know that "He who gives food to the sower will multiply the seed of his planting, so that they may be enriched in the fruit of righteousness (2 Corinthians 9:10)." Since we are rich, we should give in everything and give thanks to God! How wonderful is this righteousness. Since the Lord of righteousness has been righteous to us, we should be justified by faith and fall into the embrace of His great mercy and love. In fact, we are all the fruits of God’s righteousness! Come! Let us join hands and bear fruit together in the grace of the Lord, and let the fruits of righteousness fill the branches (bodies) to offer to God. This is the fruit of the righteousness of the Holy Spirit that glorifies God and benefits people.

41be8de7c8cfbb876b3394d8fe58c06cc438309c.translatedText: On April 8, 2018, Deputy Consul General of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles Shuangming was invited to attend the Spring Banquet of Longgang Qinyi Office in Phoenix City and celebrate the New Year with more than 200 local overseas Chinese. After leaving Phoenix City, the acting vice president interacted with the overseas Chinese leaders of the Longgang Office on WeChat and talked about his experience of attending the event, which is now published as follows:

aa845b8fa80c454e3871b94328541d1a5750eddd.sourceText: 首先感谢凤凰城龍岡親义公所的邀请，很高兴第一次在龙岡春宴上和传统侨团的侨胞们见面。
aa845b8fa80c454e3871b94328541d1a5750eddd.translatedText: First of all, I would like to thank the Longgang Qinyi Office of Phoenix City for the invitation. I am very happy to meet the overseas Chinese from the traditional overseas Chinese group at the Longgang Spring Banquet for the first time.

9d85451bb0d413e428699db7766043e01bfd1a02.translatedText: Traditional societies in Phoenix, including Longgang Office, have played an important and positive role in the past and present in terms of mutual help and cultural inheritance.

d6199ea0d250a505d2913b37915779ca55ce1e5e.sourceText: 龙岡公所侨领能看清两岸局势的历史、现实和未来，勇于担当历史责任，敢于”吃螃蟹”，这在传统社团中是难能可贵的。两岸现状不只是两岸人民的事情，也的确关系并影响到海外侨团、侨胞。
d6199ea0d250a505d2913b37915779ca55ce1e5e.translatedText: The overseas Chinese leaders of Longgang Office can clearly see the history, reality and future of the cross-strait situation, have the courage to shoulder historical responsibilities, and dare to "eat crabs". This is rare and valuable among traditional societies. The current situation on both sides of the Taiwan Strait is not only a matter for the people on both sides of the Taiwan Strait, but also affects overseas Chinese groups and compatriots.

9d043d7897e65b25b0df329bc21cc42a7c6373bb.sourceText: 我和我的同事越来越强烈地认识到，自己所从事的这份工作也是作为中国人一份子的社会责任、历史责任。特别是在看到个别侨领不愿或不敢正视大陆发展现实，或因一己意见或一己利益而置民族大义于不顾，有意无意为”台独”站台时，这份责任感来得更加强烈。
9d043d7897e65b25b0df329bc21cc42a7c6373bb.translatedText: My colleagues and I realize more and more strongly that the job we are engaged in is also the social and historical responsibility of being a member of the Chinese people. This sense of responsibility becomes even stronger when we see that some overseas Chinese leaders are unwilling or afraid to face up to the reality of mainland China's development, or that they disregard the interests of the nation because of their own opinions or interests, and intentionally or unintentionally stand for "Taiwan independence."

6b13bc7a71dd8c884e4f4f33638f68a59a914412.sourceText: 我尊重历史沿革，深知侨胞的理解支持和出席活动一样地重要。令人欣慰的是，祖（籍）国早日统一，是包括传统侨社在内的绝大多数华侨华人社团、侨胞的真实心愿。这次活动安排也是顺应了民意，着眼于公所的长远发展。
6b13bc7a71dd8c884e4f4f33638f68a59a914412.translatedText: I respect the history and know that the understanding and support of overseas Chinese is as important as attending the event. What is gratifying is that the early reunification of the ancestral (home) country is the true wish of the vast majority of overseas Chinese communities and overseas Chinese, including traditional overseas Chinese communities. The arrangement of this event also complied with public opinion and focused on the long-term development of the office.

b44bbd4d4fdaa26253711fb329e4054d295cb40f.sourceText: 如我在席间所言，传统社团、侨领的确需要分清几个概念：孙中山精神、历史的和现在的国民党、台湾岛、民进党、”台独”势力。作为绝大多数会员来自中国大陆的传统社团，在说出支持统一的同时，也要在头脑中分清这几个概念，更要在行动上多做支持统一的事情。
b44bbd4d4fdaa26253711fb329e4054d295cb40f.translatedText: As I said during the meeting, traditional organizations and overseas Chinese leaders really need to distinguish between several concepts: the spirit of Sun Yat-sen, the historical and current Kuomintang, Taiwan Island, the Democratic Progressive Party, and the "Taiwan independence" forces. As a traditional society with the vast majority of members from mainland China, while speaking out in support of reunification, we must also distinguish these concepts in our minds, and we must also do more in action to support reunification.

da8ee29a6f60b00ee125b3889561c83e319629b7.sourceText: 成语说，”兄弟阋于墙，外御其侮”，而蔡英文当局亲痛仇快的言行与此背道而驰。”华侨”更名为”侨民”已贻笑天下，而此次不敢面对谈统一，也显露了所谓”维持现状”不过是为”台独”寻找托辞罢了。
da8ee29a6f60b00ee125b3889561c83e319629b7.translatedText: There is an idiom that says, "Brothers are jealous of each other and defend themselves against their insults." However, the words and deeds of the Tsai Ing-wen authorities run counter to this. Changing the name of "overseas Chinese" to "overseas Chinese" has made people laugh all over the world, but this time they dare not face talks about reunification, which also reveals that the so-called "maintaining the status quo" is just an excuse for "Taiwan independence."

aa8344464d60246276c067dd50533b3b930e8229.sourceText: 在中华民族源远流长的历史长河中，您、我、每一个海内外中国人不过是一滴水珠。但涓滴成河，凡是涉及统一这样关乎民族大义的事情，都值得我们为之努力。我想说，这其间，龙岡公所的侨领、侨胞绝不是孤单前行。
aa8344464d60246276c067dd50533b3b930e8229.translatedText: In the long history of the Chinese nation, you, me, and every Chinese at home and abroad are just a drop of water. But every drop makes a river, and anything that involves national justice such as reunification is worth our efforts. I want to say that during this period, the overseas Chinese leaders and compatriots in Longgang Office were by no means walking alone.

2176c064e978ea6d6967210037179c8d6b663265.sourceText: 最后，我愿分享习近平主席在不同场合就台湾问题所说的几句话，以期和侨胞们共勉：”肯取势者可为人先，能谋势者必有所成。”两岸同胞共同推动两岸关系和平发展，就是在为实现中华民族伟大复兴作贡献。”只要两岸凡事都从中华民族整体利益考虑，就一定能克服前进道路上的各种困难和阻碍，推动两岸关系和平发展不断取得新成就。”
2176c064e978ea6d6967210037179c8d6b663265.translatedText: Finally, I would like to share a few words that President Xi Jinping said on the Taiwan issue on different occasions, in order to encourage the overseas Chinese: "Those who are willing to seize the momentum can be the first, and those who can seek the momentum will achieve success." Compatriots on both sides of the Taiwan Strait jointly promote the peaceful development of cross-Strait relations, which is contributing to the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. "As long as both sides of the Taiwan Strait consider the overall interests of the Chinese nation in everything they do, they will surely be able to overcome various difficulties and obstacles on the way forward and promote the peaceful development of cross-Strait relations to continuously achieve new achievements."

ab3e37903b68f5f2b66be5b0ed12e22e68898718.sourceText: 这一源于今年4月底的赌场诉讼案过去几个月里吸引了世界各地人们的眼球，因为案子的14名被告无疑是实现了人们想象中的”赌徒的梦想”以极小的筹码各自赢得了几万甚至几十万的回报，而赌场气急败坏，直指赌客作假，却又缺乏有力证据。甚至一名华裔赌客还被半夜从赌场酒店的房间里揪出来，私下遭拷问数小时之久。
ab3e37903b68f5f2b66be5b0ed12e22e68898718.translatedText: This casino lawsuit that originated at the end of April this year has attracted the attention of people all over the world in the past few months, because the 14 defendants in the case have undoubtedly realized the "gambler's dream" in people's imagination. They each won tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands in returns with very small chips. The casino was furious and accused the gamblers of fraud, but lacked strong evidence. A Chinese gambler was even pulled out of his casino hotel room in the middle of the night and tortured privately for several hours.

0c490c16d32ef6274ff5d234274e76009750435c.sourceText: 事实是，事发当晚的14名亚裔赌客（绝大多数为华人）发现他们玩的百家乐每一局都是按照相同的顺序在发牌，于是他们逐渐加大筹码，最终40多局玩下来，每个人都获利不菲。赌场人员发现事情蹊跷，遂介入调查，但却没有发现赌客们有什么不轨的行为。事后赌场认定，问题出在扑克牌本身。通常赌场新买来的扑克牌都是在出厂前由生产商随机洗过，所以赌场通常也没有再去重新洗一遍的必要。但事发时所用的由密苏里州堪萨斯城Gemaco公司生产的这副扑克牌却是漏网之鱼，没有被洗过。但这副牌也并非是按照2、3、4、5这样的顺序排列，具体的排列规则厂家以商业机密为由拒绝透露。尽管这副没有被随机洗过的牌并非是以阿拉伯数字的顺序来排列，但事发当晚的赌客们还是看出了规律，因为每一局的发牌顺序都是一样的。
0c490c16d32ef6274ff5d234274e76009750435c.translatedText: The fact is that the 14 Asian gamblers (mostly Chinese) on the night of the incident found that the cards were dealt in the same order in every round of baccarat they played, so they gradually increased their chips. In the end, they played more than 40 rounds, and everyone made a lot of profits. Casino staff noticed something fishy and intervened to investigate, but found no foul play on the part of the gamblers. Afterwards, the casino determined that the problem lay with the playing cards themselves. Usually, new playing cards purchased by casinos are randomly shuffled by the manufacturer before leaving the factory, so there is usually no need for casinos to wash them again. However, the deck of playing cards used at the time of the incident, manufactured by Gemaco Company of Kansas City, Missouri, had slipped through the net and had not been laundered. But this deck of cards is not arranged in the order of 2, 3, 4, and 5. The manufacturer refused to disclose the specific arrangement rules on the grounds of commercial confidentiality. Although the deck of cards that had not been randomly shuffled was not arranged in the order of Arabic numerals, the gamblers on the night of the incident still saw the pattern, because the order of dealing the cards in each round was the same.

8dc354a482936321ced8307cdc303b5e3ba7fc5e.sourceText: 这一看似对赌场不公的游戏，在赌客们来说却也并非没有风险。来自马里兰州Ellicott市的51岁华裔赌客Michael Cho表示，尽管每一局出牌的顺序都相同，但我们没法确认下一局会不会突然发生改变，所以，赌客同样面临风险，这才叫赌博。幸运的是，赌桌上的牌一次次重复着前面的规律，一直持续了40多手，大约2个半小时，之后才被叫停。
8dc354a482936321ced8307cdc303b5e3ba7fc5e.translatedText: This seemingly unfair game to casinos is not without risks for gamblers. Michael Cho, a 51-year-old Chinese gambler from Ellicott, Maryland, said that although the order of the cards in each round is the same, we cannot confirm whether the next round will suddenly change. Therefore, gamblers are also exposed to risks. This is called gambling. Fortunately, the cards on the gambling table repeated the previous pattern again and again, and continued for more than 40 hands, about 2 and a half hours, before being stopped.

3e948f1f3935b26439f3576c71f94485d623ad13.sourceText: 最终赌场输掉￥1,536,700美元，其中￥558,900美元被当场兑现，剩下的￥977,800赌场拒绝支付，并且要求赌客们归还前面的50多万。
3e948f1f3935b26439f3576c71f94485d623ad13.translatedText: In the end, the casino lost ￥1,536,700, of which ￥558,900 was cashed out on the spot, and the remaining ￥977,800 was refused by the casino and asked the gamblers to return the previous 500,000.

6016725ea537e87de3d53d988b6ee2f44e4cb9f9.sourceText: 主审该案的新州法官James Isman认为，一方面赌客们没有做违法的事，二来洗牌是赌场自己的责任，第三，赌客们并没有办法确认牌的顺序在下一局不会发生改变。因此他裁定赌场败诉，必须兑现赌客们的筹码。
6016725ea537e87de3d53d988b6ee2f44e4cb9f9.translatedText: New State Judge James Isman, who presided over the case, believed that on the one hand, the gamblers did not do anything illegal, and secondly, it was the casino's own responsibility to shuffle the cards. Thirdly, the gamblers had no way to confirm that the order of the cards would not change in the next round. Therefore, he ruled that the casino lost the case and must cash in the gamblers' chips.

01157095853bf3b69c0e0a0df2e985036005996f.sourceText: 据悉金砖赌场目前也在同时起诉扑克牌的生产商Gemaco公司，该公司已公开承认在产品方面的失误，并称这只是一起非常孤立的事件。
01157095853bf3b69c0e0a0df2e985036005996f.translatedText: It is reported that Golden Nugget Casino is also currently suing Gemaco, the manufacturer of playing cards. The company has publicly admitted its product mistakes and said that this was just a very isolated incident.

394664bea24068be5d888de2718c478ccca1d866.sourceText: 另一方面，针对14名赌客中的三名华裔提出的种族歧视指控，赌场方面坚决否认，认为这毫无根据，因为赌场为了吸引亚裔赌客，还专门设立了一个亚裔专区，并建了一个专门的亚裔餐厅。但提出歧视指控的华人赌客称自己被无故关押和盘问数小时之久，没有水和食物，期间身体一度被抵在墙上无法活动，个人权利遭到严重侵犯。
394664bea24068be5d888de2718c478ccca1d866.translatedText: On the other hand, the casino firmly denied the accusation of racial discrimination made by three Chinese people among the 14 gamblers, saying it was groundless because in order to attract Asian gamblers, the casino also set up a special Asian area and built a special Asian restaurant. However, the Chinese gambler who filed the discrimination claim said that he was detained and interrogated for several hours without reason, without water and food. During this period, his body was pressed against the wall and unable to move, and his personal rights were seriously violated.

With the December immigration deadline, the fourth priority for Chinese-born relative immigrants has been restored and synchronized with the world...

c113994eced997cd6f9fb5ba912139248f2e8b77.sourceText: 中国出生亲属移民恢复第四优先世界同步 12月移民截期，中国出生的亲属移民第四优先恢复与世界同步。中国出生的第三优先其他类原地踏步。 亲属移民类： 第一优先(公民的成年未婚子女)：移前四周。 第二优先：2桝类(永久居民的配偶及未成年子女)：移进五周。 2桞类(永久居民的成年未婚子女)：移前五周。 第三优先(公民已婚子女)：移进一周。 世界第四优先(成年公民的兄弟姐妹)：移进一周。中国出生的第四优先：移进二周。 职业移民类： 中国出生的第二优先(具高等学位或特殊能力者)：移进七周。 世界第三优先一般类(技术劳工、专业人员)：移前四周。中国出生的第三优先一般类：移前十周。 世界第三优先其他类(无技术劳工如保母、管家)：移进四周。中国出生的第三优先其他类：原地踏步。
c113994eced997cd6f9fb5ba912139248f2e8b77.translatedText: The fourth priority for Chinese-born relative immigrants has been restored and synchronized with the world. The December immigration deadline has been restored and the fourth priority for Chinese-born relative immigrants has been restored and synchronized with the world. The Chinese-born third priority category and other categories stayed put. Relative-based immigration category: First priority (unmarried adult children of citizens): four weeks before transfer. Second priority: Category 2 (spouse and minor children of permanent residents): five weeks to move in. 2. Category 2 (unmarried adult children of permanent residents): five weeks before transfer. Third priority (married children of citizens): Move forward one week. World Priority 4 (siblings of adult citizens): Moved forward one week. The fourth priority for those born in China: move into the second week. Employment immigration category: Second priority for those born in China (those with advanced degrees or special abilities): seven weeks of immigration. The world's third priority general category (skilled workers, professionals): moved forward four weeks. Third priority general category for those born in China: ten weeks before transfer. The world's third priority category of other categories (unskilled labor such as nannies and housekeepers): moved to the next area. The third priority category for those born in China: stay put.

89c7c9641f43961b45f0d4b15a1bf951785960c9.sourceText: 感恩节传统被打破 或改名“黑色星期四” 感恩节是美国和加拿大所独有的节日。按照传统惯例，每年11月份第四个星期四就是美国的感恩节，这一天他们要与家人团聚，共同度过家庭时光，与此同时他们将生活中的一切收获归功于神，故名”感恩节”；这一天美国的商家也基本都关门过节。 然而近两三年，这些传统日益被打破，越来越多的美国零售业商在感恩节这一天继续营业，为满足当日购物者的需求。 今年的感恩节当天（11月22日），美国的许多大型零售商都计划提早营业时间。沃尔玛、Toys R Us 和Sears计划在晚8点开始营业，一直持续到第二天的”黑色星期五”营业时间结束。这个时间正好是在大多数家庭吃过晚餐，可以出来购物的时段。Target零售店将保持去年的做法，在感恩节当天的晚9点开始营业。 Sears的发言人Brian Hanover说：”有一部份美国人愿意在感恩节少吃一点火鸡，而出来购物。客户不断告诉我们他们希望在黑色星期五获得更灵活的购物时间。” 根据零售商的市场调研，在感恩节过后的黑色星期五，有些人不愿起个大早去商家排队购买打折商品，相比，他们更愿意在感恩节当晚免了甜点，提早去排队买打折商品。也就是说他们更愿意熬夜购物，而不是起早购物。看到了这一商机的商家自然不愿意无动于衷，于是他们修改了自己在感恩节和黑色星期五的营业时间，在传统 中不营业的感恩节继续营业。 Kmart市场总监Ndy Stein说：”这样的变化已经持续几年了，在感恩节当日购物变得越来越重要。所以我们延长感恩节当日的营业时间，如果人们在最后一分钟发现他们的晚餐上 还缺少什么，他们可以到我们店里买。同时，在次日的黑色星期五我们于早6点就开始迎接顾客。” 但零售商表示只要顾客在感恩节当日的购物需求保持高涨，他们就将继续在当日提早开始营业。 在回应市场需求和方便客户购物的同时，商家的做法也遭到很多店员和一些购物者的抗议和抵制。 去年，当一些商家把黑色星期五的营业时间提前至前一天晚上，也就是感恩节的晚上9点开始时，已经招致了员工和一些购物者的不满，他们担心美国的公众假日会因此变得越来越少。 今年，随着商家在感恩节提早营业时间的计划被公布，一些员工的抗议活动已在酝酿中：Target店员工已经开始一项题为”挽回感恩节”的请愿活动；沃尔玛的工人表示，他们准备在黑色星期五当天举行抗议活动。 组织了去年类似抗议活动的Target店前员工Anthony Hardwick说：”这太可笑了，人们放弃感恩节与家人共聚晚餐，就为了买一台降价销售的300美元的平板电视？” 有人说，按照这样的发展，”感恩节”将被更名为”黑色星期四”。
89c7c9641f43961b45f0d4b15a1bf951785960c9.translatedText: Thanksgiving tradition is broken or renamed "Black Thursday" Thanksgiving is a holiday unique to the United States and Canada. According to traditional practice, the fourth Thursday of November every year is Thanksgiving in the United States. On this day, they reunite with their families and spend family time together. At the same time, they attribute all the gains in life to God, hence the name "Thanksgiving"; on this day, most businesses in the United States are closed for the holiday. However, in the past two or three years, these traditions have been increasingly broken, and more and more American retailers continue to operate on Thanksgiving Day to meet the needs of shoppers on that day. On Thanksgiving Day this year (November 22), many large retailers in the United States plan to open earlier. Walmart, Toys R Us and Sears plan to open at 8 p.m. until the end of Black Friday hours the next day. This time happens to be when most families have had dinner and can go shopping. Target retail stores will continue to open at 9 p.m. on Thanksgiving Day, as they did last year. Brian Hanover, a spokesman for Sears, said: "There are some Americans who are willing to eat less turkey on Thanksgiving and go out to shop. Customers continue to tell us that they want more flexible shopping hours on Black Friday." According to the retailer's market research, on Black Friday after Thanksgiving, some people are not willing to get up early to go to the store to queue up to buy discounted goods. Compared with this, they are more willing to skip dessert on Thanksgiving night and queue up early to buy discounted goods. This means they are more likely to stay up late to shop than get up early to shop. Merchants who saw this business opportunity were naturally unwilling to remain indifferent, so they modified their business hours on Thanksgiving and Black Friday, and continued to operate on Thanksgiving, which is traditionally closed. Kmart marketing director Ndy Stein said: "This change has been going on for a few years, and shopping on Thanksgiving Day has become more and more important. So we have extended the opening hours on Thanksgiving Day so that if people find that they are missing something from their dinner at the last minute, they can come to our store to buy it. At the same time, on Black Friday the next day, we start welcoming customers at 6 a.m." But the retailer said that as long as customer demand for shopping on Thanksgiving Day remains high, they will continue to open early on the day. While responding to market demand and making shopping easier for customers, merchants' practices have also been met with protests and boycotts by many store employees and some shoppers. Last year, when some businesses moved their Black Friday opening hours to 9 p.m. the night before, on Thanksgiving Day, they angered employees and some shoppers, who worried that the U.S. would have fewer public holidays. This year, as plans for businesses to open earlier on Thanksgiving were announced, some employee protests were already brewing: Target store employees have started a petition titled "Save Thanksgiving"; Walmart workers said they were preparing to hold protests on Black Friday. Anthony Hardwick, a former Target store employee who organized a similar protest last year, said: "This is ridiculous. People give up Thanksgiving dinner with their families just to buy a $300 flat-screen TV that is on sale?" Some people say that according to this development, "Thanksgiving" will be renamed "Black Thursday."

240d29f5df0656478fd1b203c3aa0270ee868959.sourceText: 年轻移民8月16日在凤凰城聚会抗议亚利桑那州长布鲁诺对抗奥巴马行政命令，拒绝给暂缓递解的移民发驾照。（美联社图）

7bd2a61cbf66c5385925d92678f5c5fe46d29835.sourceText: 纽约-泛欧证券交易所可能被美国原材料交易平台”洲际交易所”收购。这一金额为82亿美元的收购计划已得到双方监事会的批准，有望于2013年下半年完成合并。合并后的企业将成为全球最大的证券交易公司。这一计划还必须获得持股方和反垄断监督机构的批准。今年早些时候，欧盟反垄断机构驳回了纽约政券交易所与德国证券交易所的合并计划。纽约-泛欧证券交易集团在纽约、巴黎、布鲁塞尔、阿姆斯特丹和里斯本都有交易所。而洲际交易所的重点是与原材料贸易有关的期权和期货业务。
7bd2a61cbf66c5385925d92678f5c5fe46d29835.translatedText: NYSE Euronext may be acquired by US raw materials trading platform Intercontinental Exchange. The US$8.2 billion acquisition plan has been approved by the supervisory boards of both parties and is expected to be completed in the second half of 2013. The combined company will become the world's largest securities trading company. The plan must also be approved by shareholders and antitrust regulators. Earlier this year, EU antitrust authorities rejected a planned merger between the New York Stock Exchange and Deutsche Boerse. NY-Euronext has exchanges in New York, Paris, Brussels, Amsterdam and Lisbon. The focus of Intercontinental Exchange is on options and futures business related to raw materials trading.
