718c878c5bb34ffd2239c5497274e6c79505bf8e.translatedText: Comment: The future that Chinese young people want Author: Zhang Guangzhao China is about to hold its 18th National Congress, and the leadership is about to change. At this time, the most populous country in the world...

3124fc585faf983cb7cb10f8b21b682cb9fb6b9e.sourceText: 中国即将召开十八大，领导层行将换届。此时，这个世界上人口最多的国家在多个方面面临挑战。这些挑战纵然有国际因素，但其本质上是中国内部问题。
3124fc585faf983cb7cb10f8b21b682cb9fb6b9e.translatedText: China is about to hold its 18th National Congress, and the leadership is about to change. At this time, the world's most populous country faces challenges on multiple fronts. Although these challenges have international factors, they are essentially China's internal problems.

17820bba2d493799e4c57b3cb6d34b2e2105cf6b.sourceText: 美国康奈尔大学中国政治专家安德鲁莫萨(Andrew Mertha)最近在《亚洲政策》(Asia Policy)杂志上发表文章指出，中国新一代领导人面临包括中央和地方的政治经济关系调整、创建多种渠道满足社会预期（尤其是1989年后的那一代人的预期）等重大挑战。
17820bba2d493799e4c57b3cb6d34b2e2105cf6b.translatedText: Andrew Mertha, an expert on Chinese politics at Cornell University in the United States, recently published an article in the magazine "Asia Policy" and pointed out that China's new generation of leaders faces major challenges including the adjustment of political and economic relations between the central and local governments and the creation of multiple channels to meet social expectations (especially the expectations of the generation after 1989).

63aceefc18debc1b4faa04782105e0511f5fac8a.sourceText: 中国国家主席胡锦涛9月8日在亚太经合组织(Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation)第二十次领导人非正式会议上表示，中国今后将在着力推动包容性增长等方面努力。并承诺，中国将逐步建立以权利公平、机会公平、规则公平为主要内容的社会公平保障体系，促进人人平等获得发展机会。
63aceefc18debc1b4faa04782105e0511f5fac8a.translatedText: Chinese President Hu Jintao stated at the 20th Informal Leaders’ Meeting of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation) on September 8 that China will work hard to promote inclusive growth in the future. It also promised that China will gradually establish a social equity guarantee system with fair rights, fair opportunities, and fair rules as its main content to promote equal access to development opportunities for everyone.

292dcdf967ce31bd83ec18703e94a1961a363614.sourceText: 改革开放以来，中国的经济越来越好，人们的生活得到了极大的改善。但如今中国面临一个或许是最为重要的问题，即中国要往哪里走，中国领导人要带领中国百姓过上一个什么样的生活。这对于年轻人来说，尤其重要。
292dcdf967ce31bd83ec18703e94a1961a363614.translatedText: Since the reform and opening up, China's economy has been getting better and better, and people's lives have been greatly improved. But now China is facing perhaps the most important question, which is where China is going and what kind of life Chinese leaders want to lead the Chinese people to live. This is especially important for young people.

2644da448575ef6c400ce142f944d4434d0d4b44.sourceText: 笔者作为一个中国的”80后”，无论是从自身感触还是对身边同龄人的观察，都强烈感受到国家当前面临的一个最为急切的挑战，即是如何满足年轻人的社会预期以及消除其不满情绪。
2644da448575ef6c400ce142f944d4434d0d4b44.translatedText: As a Chinese born in the 1980s, whether from my own feelings or from my observations of my peers, I strongly feel that one of the most urgent challenges facing the country is how to meet the social expectations of young people and eliminate their dissatisfaction.

6728c3b89c7c284621f5b2d1497dcf8619552f8d.sourceText: 对于”80后””90后”的年轻人来说，他们极度渴望拥有公平的机会，藉以自己的努力而改变命运。对他们而言，只有社会向上流动的渠道是畅通的，未来才是充满希望的。然而他们面对的现实，却恰恰相反。笔者这一代年轻人，曾经被认为是”垮掉的一代”：不能吃苦、缺乏责任感等等。但事实证明，他们不是。他们能吃苦，更不缺乏责任感（近几起群体抗争事件中年轻人的积极参与便证明了这一点）。他们最不满的是，当这个国家提供的机会越来越少的时候，还有那么多的不公平、不公正。
6728c3b89c7c284621f5b2d1497dcf8619552f8d.translatedText: For young people born in the 1980s and 1990s, they are extremely eager to have fair opportunities and change their destiny through their own efforts. For them, only if the channels for upward social mobility are open can the future be full of hope. However, the reality they faced was exactly the opposite. Young people of the author's generation were once considered the "Beat Generation": unable to endure hardship, lacking a sense of responsibility, etc. But it turns out, they are not. They can endure hardship and do not lack a sense of responsibility (the active participation of young people in recent group protests proves this). What they are most dissatisfied about is that when this country provides fewer and fewer opportunities, there are still so many unfairness and injustices.

916595864880803b0990156d86a7e60ccf5790f7.sourceText: 对于大学生群体来讲，尤其是草根阶层的大学生，当他们迈出校门走向社会时，发现很多机会不会因为你更聪明更勤奋而选择你，竞争对手或许学历不如你，能力不如你，勤奋度也不如你，但他（她）却有一个有钱或有权的家长或亲戚，不出意外的话，就是自己竞争失败出局。一开始，他们还会觉得苦闷想不通，后来发现这个社会就是这样，也就不再四处抱怨。但造成的结果是，在他们的内心深处，对社会的不满情绪开始一点一点的积聚，对国家的失望情绪也在不断的蔓延，甚至有一部分人觉得看不到什么希望。然而，当这个国家最有朝气、最有活力的人群对未来不再充满希望时，将是极度可怕的。
916595864880803b0990156d86a7e60ccf5790f7.translatedText: For college students, especially grassroots college students, when they step out of school and enter the society, they find that many opportunities will not choose you because you are smarter and more diligent. Your competitors may not be as well-educated, capable, or diligent as you, but he or she has a rich or powerful parent or relative. If nothing else, he or she will fail the competition and be eliminated. At first, they would feel depressed and confused, but later they discovered that society was like this and stopped complaining. But the result is that deep in their hearts, dissatisfaction with society begins to accumulate bit by bit, and disappointment with the country continues to spread. Some people even feel that there is no hope. However, it would be extremely frightening when the country's most vibrant and dynamic group of people no longer have hope for the future.

0314b9c7fc7f798e84372df349d9f08e1533a70a.sourceText: 这里有两个典型的领域让他们不满。一是以央企为代表的国有企业，已经形成事实上中国目前最大的利益集团，这个集团的开放性严重不足，利益的自我封闭分配严重。即使是从中国最顶尖的两所大学毕业，都很有可能被排斥在外。另一个是公务员考试。首先一个国家的年轻人对公务员如此热衷的现象是不正常的，这个问题暂且不说。另一个或许更重要的问题是，本来一个公平的稀缺资源竞争机会，如今却充满不公正。对于一些平民子弟而言，成绩好不一定进的去，而对于一些具有特殊家庭背景的人来说，考得不好也照样能进去。
0314b9c7fc7f798e84372df349d9f08e1533a70a.translatedText: There are two typical areas where they are dissatisfied. First, state-owned enterprises represented by central enterprises have formed the largest interest group in China. This group is seriously lacking in openness and has serious self-enclosed distribution of interests. Even those who graduate from China's top two universities are likely to be excluded. The other is the Civil Service Examination. First of all, it is abnormal for young people in a country to be so enthusiastic about civil servants. Let’s not discuss this issue for now. Another, perhaps more important, issue is that what was originally a fair opportunity to compete for scarce resources is now full of injustice. For some common people, good grades may not necessarily make it in, but for some people with special family backgrounds, they can still get in even if they do not do well in the exam.

fb92263a726fbc75234ec85db08c6a7a926a65f5.sourceText: 笔者的校友，曾就读于中国人民大学财政金融学院的黄红在今年的国家公务员考试中，顺利通过笔试、面试和体检，面试成绩和总成绩均排在她报考的青海保监局”专业监督岗位”第一名。她本以为自己的辛勤付出终于得到了回报，结果却是该局人事处以”性格内向”为由将其拒之门外。黄红的大学老师和单位同事都为其鸣不平，”她一点也不内向”。然而，留给黄红的是无奈与失望：”我不相信考试了，完全不信任，这次，我伤透了。”
fb92263a726fbc75234ec85db08c6a7a926a65f5.translatedText: The author's alumnus Huang Hong, who studied at the School of Finance at Renmin University of China, successfully passed the written test, interview and physical examination in this year's National Civil Service Examination. Both her interview score and overall score ranked first in the "Professional Supervision Position" of the Qinghai Insurance Regulatory Bureau for which she applied. She thought her hard work had finally paid off, but it turned out that the Bureau's Human Resources Department rejected her as an "introvert." Huang Hong's university teachers and colleagues at work complained about her, saying, "She is not introverted at all." However, what Huang Hong was left with was helplessness and disappointment: "I don't believe in the exam anymore, I don't trust it at all. This time, I am heartbroken."

29d97e8ad0f8c64b6b61827485173d472e37a55f.sourceText: 还有，广东中山市人社局纪委书记梁国影通过其他官员”配合”，篡改其儿子成绩助其考取公务员。其实，像这样被曝光的事件只占到总体违规案例的很小一部分，事实上存在大量不为人知的不公正案例。或许，只有那些同样遭受了不公正待遇的年轻人，才能体会他们内心的愤怒感。以至于，现在一个有意思的现象是，大家都相互”忠告”，报考职位时尽量避开只招录一人的职位，不仅是因为竞争可能会激烈，更大的原因是在于这个职位或已经”内定”。
29d97e8ad0f8c64b6b61827485173d472e37a55f.translatedText: Also, Liang Guoying, secretary of the Discipline Inspection Commission of the Human Resources and Social Security Bureau of Zhongshan City, Guangdong, "cooperated" with other officials to tamper with his son's grades to help him pass the civil service examination. In fact, publicized incidents like this only account for a small proportion of overall violations, and in fact there are a large number of unknown cases of injustice. Perhaps only those young people who have also suffered unfair treatment can understand their inner anger. As a result, an interesting phenomenon now is that everyone is "advising" each other to try to avoid positions that only recruit one person when applying for a job. This is not only because the competition may be fierce, but also because the position may have been "unofficially determined."

12fd1b82b60efc64ed833922a6f4e98b7a767b7f.sourceText: 其实，以笔试为主的初试是基本公平的，在这一环节，个人背景作用几乎为零。不公正的地方往往在面试环节以及最终录取环节，因为这两个环节没有可以量化的标准，主观性严重。所以，针对于此，可以采取一些更为公平公开的机制手段。例如，面试、录取环节彻底公开化。另外，一个非常重要的原因在于，属地亲属的庇护。当前的大量不公源自属地有背景亲属的庇护，所以，可以探索建立公考回避制度。
12fd1b82b60efc64ed833922a6f4e98b7a767b7f.translatedText: In fact, the preliminary test, which is mainly written, is basically fair. In this link, the role of personal background is almost zero. The unfairness often occurs in the interview process and the final admission process, because these two links have no quantifiable standards and are highly subjective. Therefore, in response to this, some more fair and open mechanisms can be adopted. For example, the interview and admission process are completely open to the public. In addition, a very important reason is the protection of territorial relatives. A large number of current injustices stem from the protection of relatives with backgrounds in the jurisdiction, so we can explore the establishment of a public examination avoidance system.

5dadaea6f42d809824bdddf7bc9a36056529412a.sourceText: 可以说，中国的”80后”、”90后”年轻人正在经历着中国大转型带来的巨大阵痛，在面对前所未有的社会、家庭压力时，他们至少渴望这个国家给他们一个真正公平公正的机会，如何满足他们的这份期待是未来执政者绕不开的课题。
5dadaea6f42d809824bdddf7bc9a36056529412a.translatedText: It can be said that China's "post-80s" and "post-90s" young people are experiencing the tremendous pain caused by China's great transformation. When facing unprecedented social and family pressures, they at least long for the country to give them a truly fair and just opportunity. How to meet their expectations is an issue that future leaders cannot avoid.

1373d9fd0e61d3b0a6440ffee187d02ea0966384.sourceText: 对于”70后”这样稍年长的人来说，他们渴望生活得有尊严，权利不会被随意践踏，年老退休时可以享受良好的社会保障。然而现实是怎样的呢？网络一度热传”中国政法大学教师给女儿的一封信”的博文，信中这位北大博士痛陈自己无能，给自己刚出生的女儿上个户口都这么难。心酸之余，如果这样的精英都不能过上有尊严的生活，何论普通大众。
1373d9fd0e61d3b0a6440ffee187d02ea0966384.translatedText: For older people like those born in the 1970s, they long to live with dignity, their rights will not be trampled on at will, and they can enjoy good social security when they retire. But what is the reality? A blog post titled "A Letter from a Teacher at China University of Political Science and Law to His Daughter" was widely circulated on the Internet. In the letter, the doctor from Peking University lamented his incompetence and how difficult it was to obtain a household registration for his newborn daughter. Apart from being sad, if such elites cannot live a dignified life, so can the general public.

689562fd386674069c6da9b6ecc27591d14a1410.sourceText: 包括年轻人在内的所有中国人都深为不满的是，国家财富分配的极度不平等。中国的收入差距很大程度上是制度性的，是人为拉大的差距。这就要求执政者敢于打破利益格局，敢于挑战已有分配秩序，使分配制度更加科学公正。
689562fd386674069c6da9b6ecc27591d14a1410.translatedText: All Chinese people, including young people, are deeply dissatisfied with the extremely unequal distribution of the country's wealth. China's income gap is largely institutional and artificially widened. This requires those in power to dare to break the pattern of interests, dare to challenge the existing distribution order, and make the distribution system more scientific and fair.

ab54d0cd3ae112f276d554f6bfae401b88fbe285.sourceText: 伴随着经济的高速发展，中国执政党内部日益形成一种寡头政治：一个强有力的官僚集团控制了国家大部分的资源和财富。美国商业智库”战略预测”(Stratfor)在今年2月份的一个报告里披露，大约0.2%的中国政治、经济精英控制着国家70%的财富。根据国家统计局最近的一次统计，中国在2004年的基尼系数是0.47；中国社科院社会研究所在2010-2011社会形势分析与预测报告会上指出，基尼系数目前在0.5左右（按照国际标准，基尼系数在0.3～0.4之间为正常状态，超过0.4为警戒状态，达到0.6则属于危险状态）。
ab54d0cd3ae112f276d554f6bfae401b88fbe285.translatedText: Along with the rapid economic development, an oligarchy is increasingly forming within China's ruling party: a powerful bureaucratic group controls most of the country's resources and wealth. The American business think tank "Stratfor" disclosed in a report in February this year that about 0.2% of China's political and economic elites control 70% of the country's wealth. According to the latest statistics from the National Bureau of Statistics, China's Gini coefficient was 0.47 in 2004; the Institute of Social Sciences of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences pointed out at the 2010-2011 Social Situation Analysis and Forecast Report that the Gini coefficient is currently around 0.5 (according to international standards, a Gini coefficient between 0.3 and 0.4 is a normal state, exceeding 0.4 is an alert state, and reaching 0.6 is a dangerous state).

eec8335a2df67974d9bf7d4db198223fcac4667f.sourceText: 这种不平等导致了社会矛盾，强化了本已紧密的政治和经济联系网络。造成的最重大后果是，即便中国领导人个人由衷地想要政治改革，体制性障碍也成为改革进程中的最大阻力。然而，让大多数人共享国家发展带来的繁荣，而不是让少数人攫取国家的大部分财富，已经成为执政者绕不开的执政课题.
eec8335a2df67974d9bf7d4db198223fcac4667f.translatedText: This inequality leads to social conflicts and strengthens an already tight network of political and economic ties. The most significant consequence is that even if Chinese leaders sincerely want political reform, institutional obstacles have become the biggest obstacle to the reform process. However, allowing the majority of people to share the prosperity brought about by the country's development, rather than letting a few people seize most of the country's wealth, has become an unavoidable governance issue for those in power.

a8a8420bcd9b4bff58748c460925f9888efc45d5.sourceText: 中共从十四大开始，逐渐形成了制度化的领导集体。但另一个事实是，领导人受到了权力制约的同时，决策的权威性与有效性渐趋弱化。过去的经验证明，很多正确的改革举措，最终的有效性受到各种特权形式的削弱，甚至异化了这些改革。
a8a8420bcd9b4bff58748c460925f9888efc45d5.translatedText: Starting from the 14th National Congress, the Communist Party of China has gradually formed an institutionalized leadership collective. But another fact is that when leaders are constrained by their power, the authority and effectiveness of decision-making gradually weakens. Past experience has proved that the ultimate effectiveness of many correct reform measures has been weakened by various forms of privilege, and even alienated these reforms.

554ae3330459bc1759b1d20d160d7cf9f558ea61.sourceText: 但是，经济增长放缓、收入差距日益扩大以及公权力的滥用正对中国共产党的执政能力构成严峻考验。当今的党情民心，任何上台执政的领导人都不能轻视。这是中国改革的机会，也是动力。中国目前最需要一个勇于重建包容性政治、经济体系的领导集体。在这个体系里，每一个公民都不会被遗忘，可以生活得幸福、有尊严。
554ae3330459bc1759b1d20d160d7cf9f558ea61.translatedText: However, slowing economic growth, widening income gaps and the abuse of public power are posing severe tests to the Chinese Communist Party's ability to govern. Today's party sentiment and people's sentiments cannot be underestimated by any leader who comes to power. This is an opportunity and a driving force for China's reform. What China needs most now is a leadership group that has the courage to rebuild an inclusive political and economic system. In this system, every citizen will not be forgotten and can live happily and with dignity.

f9833cc80b8bd9815cd63f815fdaa6aaf75ba714.sourceText: 张广昭是中国人民大学国际关系学院硕士研究生。
f9833cc80b8bd9815cd63f815fdaa6aaf75ba714.translatedText: Zhang Guangzhao is a master’s student at the School of International Relations, Renmin University of China.

5572ff101da1abe90fd203ecc8d40c66a63ffe41.sourceText: 郑弘：心里的话-向淑英的告白 八月二十一日亞美報社長王淑英女士在擠滿了親朋好友的Green Acres Cemetery舉行了告別式。以下是鳳凰城中文學校 鄭弘 在告別式中的口白。淑英是個樂觀愛笑的直腸子，希望她喜歡，開心得走。 淑英: 你好大的面子， 你看看， 今天都是那些人來送你了。 連我們William先生都為你打上了領帶，這 ~~ 不簡單， 你的面子很大喔! 我知道，你是不情願的。但我還是忍不住要說 ”這種勞師動眾的事，還是少一點比較好”。OK，跟你開個玩笑，別介意啊! 雖然沒有跟你打過麻將(我也不會打)，唱卡拉OK或純吃飯，但總覺得你是個很好的朋友。人家說:”君子之交淡如水”大概就是這個意思吧。 Hey，今天鳳凰城中文學校的校長和董事都來了。謝謝你對學校(或者說)對鳳凰城所有中文學校長期的支持與照顧。 你知道，在海外做中文學校是傻瓜作的事。在我們之前，你和另一群傻瓜為了當年鳳凰城唯一的一所中文學校盡心盡力了許多年。人家告訴我，你是大家口中多才多藝的王老師。 後來你到報社作事，還是沒忘記學校。你為所有的學校開闢了中文學校園地，定期刊登學生作品。在那個資源不豐富的年代，這可是很了不起的創舉喔! 你的亞美報，對各個學校的來稿，總在第一時間，以顯著的版面刊登。凡是學校的事，你永遠是乾乾脆脆的。你對海外中文教育有一份特殊的情感，大家都看到了。 換個話題吧! 張肇鴻寫了一篇非常感人懷念你的文章。他向我要你的相片。我從電腦中過濾了千百張相片，沒找到幾張有你的。找到的卻都有你那招牌式露齒的笑容。說實話，你那張微笑的臉，這一個禮拜來，在我的腦子裡揮之不去。(For the record) 嚴重影響本人工作情緒。 看完張肇鴻的文章，我心有戚戚焉。一方面，你是個非常客氣，而且善良的人。但在新聞事業上，你卻是一絲不苟，堅持完美，幾乎到達頑固的地步。怎麼說呢? 你似乎總能挑出我的文稿/圖稿裡面的錯字。而且為了更正錯誤，你不惜打多通電話，反覆確認，好像在刊登諾貝爾獎大文豪的鉅作。這就是淑英吧! 回到那些相片，相片中的你(王社長)總是躲在後排，或在一旁傻笑(有圖為證)。似乎印證了你謙卑良善帶點羞怯的個性。但是，這與本地官場排排坐的相片文化可就格格不入了。Hey，沒有別的意思，只是講點意見給你參考一下。 淑英啊! 雖然很捨不得, 還是要跟你說: 休息吧! 不用再熬夜，晨昏顛倒了。 不用再送報紙了(人家說CEO兼打雜) 不用再作會議紀錄了 (謝天謝地) (僑界複雜) 也不用再招人流言蜚語了 記得要以自己為榮 想想你 嫁了個好老公(傅屏生是個打著燈籠，喲不，拿著手電筒都找不到的好男人) 兒子，女兒都很優秀也都長大了。兒子進了醫學院，女兒U of A剛畢業，念的那個先進的專業，英文怎麼拼我都搞不清楚 你把亞美報辦得有聲有色是個事實 雖然你不承認，經由辦報，你對本地華人社會是具有影響力的。 這是你很大的成就；畢竟，幹到報社社長的沒幾個喔! 說到影響力，因為你的 不良示範 ，我想–你的朋友再也沒有人敢不繫安全帶了。Ironically, 這也算是正面的影響，雖然…代價太高了。 淑英，一路好走。下輩子大家再來作朋友吧!
5572ff101da1abe90fd203ecc8d40c66a63ffe41.translatedText: Zheng Hong: What’s in my heart - a confession to Xiang Shuying On August 21, Ms. Wang Shuying, the president of Asian American Newspaper, held a farewell ceremony at Green Acres Cemetery, which was crowded with relatives and friends. The following is what Zheng Hong of Phoenix Chinese School said in his farewell ceremony. Shuying is an optimistic and cheerful person, I hope she likes it and leaves happily. Shuying: You have so much face. Look, those are the people who came to see you off today. Even our Mr. William has put on a tie for you. This is not easy. It is a great honor for you! I know you are reluctant. But I still can't help but say, "It would be better to do less of this kind of laborious work." OK, I’m joking with you, don’t mind! Although I haven’t played mahjong with you (I can’t play either), sang karaoke or just had meals, I always feel that you are a very good friend. People say: "The friendship between gentlemen is as light as water", which probably means this. Hey, the principal and directors of Phoenix Chinese School are here today. Thank you for your long-term support and care of the school (or rather) all Chinese schools in Phoenix. You know, running a Chinese school overseas is a fool's errand. Before us, you and another group of fools worked hard for many years to build the only Chinese school in Phoenix. People tell me that you are the versatile Teacher Wang that everyone calls you. Later, you worked in a newspaper office, but you still didn't forget about school. You have opened a Chinese literature campus for all schools and regularly publish student works. In an era when resources were limited, this was a great initiative! Your Asian American Newspaper always published submissions from various schools in a prominent space as soon as possible. When it comes to school matters, you are always straightforward. You have a special affection for overseas Chinese education, and everyone has seen it. Let’s change the topic! Zhang Zhaohong wrote a very touching article in memory of you. He asked me for your photo. I filtered hundreds of photos from my computer, but I couldn't find a few with you in them. The ones I found all had your signature toothy smile. To be honest, your smiling face has been lingering in my mind for this past week. (For the record) Seriously affects my work mood. After reading Zhang Zhaohong’s article, I felt very sad. On the one hand, you are a very polite and kind person. But in journalism, you are meticulous and insist on perfection, almost to the point of stubbornness. What can I say? You always seem to be able to pick out typos in my manuscripts/artwork. And in order to correct the error, you did not hesitate to make multiple phone calls and confirm repeatedly, as if you were publishing a masterpiece by a Nobel Prize-winning writer. This is Shuying! Going back to those photos, you (President Wang) in the photos are always hiding in the back row, or giggling on the side (there are pictures to prove it). It seems to confirm your humble, kind and somewhat shy personality. However, this is incompatible with the local officialdom photo culture. Hey, I don’t mean anything else, I just want to give you some opinions for your reference. Shuying! Although I am very reluctant to part with you, I still want to tell you: rest! You don’t have to stay up late anymore, and the morning and evening are reversed. No more delivering newspapers (people say the CEO is also a handyman), no more taking meeting minutes (thank God) (the overseas Chinese community is complicated) and no more recruiting people to gossip. Remember to be proud of yourself and think about you. I married a good husband (Fu Pingsheng is a good man who can’t be found with a lantern, oh no, with a flashlight). My son and daughter are both excellent and have grown up. My son has entered medical school, and my daughter has just graduated from U of A. She is studying in an advanced major. I can’t figure out how to spell it in English. It is a fact that you have run the Asian American Newspaper so well. Although you don’t admit it, by running the newspaper, you have influence on the local Chinese society. This is a great achievement for you; after all, not many people have become the president of a newspaper! Speaking of influence, because of your "bad example", I think - no one of your friends dares not to wear a seat belt anymore. Ironically, this can be considered a positive impact, although... the price is too high. Shuying, have a good trip. Let’s all be friends again in the next life!

b594bdebb1a426a9b11351e78273807a3d1ea508.translatedText: Mother's Day special planning [Phoenix PEN Club] Yu Xinjie: "My Child" – Happy birthday An An! Phoenix Yu Xinjie...

7814aa9757caef6c748b4899cdde02f1f7092cf8.sourceText: 我的孩子 今天是你的生日 你十八岁的生日 十八年前的今天 是我们母女相见的日子 你那胖胖的小脸上 有我因喜悦流下的泪水 你的一切让我着迷 你的出世 让妈妈感觉 终于有了牵挂 终于从空中飘下 与这个世界有了牵连
7814aa9757caef6c748b4899cdde02f1f7092cf8.translatedText: My child, today is your birthday, your eighteenth birthday, eighteen years ago today, was the day when our mother and daughter met. Your fat little face has the tears I shed for joy. Everything about you fascinates me. Your birth Let my mother feel that I am finally concerned, finally floating down from the sky, and connected with the world

9a58c676ad065906080cf6797b8a5aabaeae0133.sourceText: 我的孩子 你在我的左右慢慢地长大 你肆无忌惮的哭闹 让妈妈不知所措 你天真无邪的笑容 将一股暖意注入妈妈的心田 我的人跟随你起起落落 我的心被你时时刻刻充满 那夜夜不让妈妈睡觉的梦魇 即使到今天也记忆犹新 你的一举一动 都让妈妈痴迷 你是妈妈的世界
9a58c676ad065906080cf6797b8a5aabaeae0133.translatedText: My child, you are growing up slowly by my side. Your unbridled crying makes my mother overwhelmed. Your innocent smile injects a warmth into my mother's heart. My people follow you ups and downs. My heart is filled with you all the time. The nightmare that prevents my mother from sleeping every night is still fresh in my memory even today. They all make mom obsessed. You are mom's world

45200898078c1ffdf5a9f315aaa4944dc060a471.sourceText: 我的孩子 当你第一次能够”看着”妈妈微笑 我的泪水 从我的眼中溢出 那四个月被你没日没夜的”折磨” 终于有了回报 你的聪明 超出了妈妈理解的极限 从第一个月开始 妈妈就放弃了”欺哄”你的想法 你那能分辨出奶粉好坏的舌头 是妈妈了解你的开始 你将妈妈带入了一个新”天地”
45200898078c1ffdf5a9f315aaa4944dc060a471.translatedText: My child. When you could "look" at mom smiling for the first time, my tears overflowed from my eyes. Those four months of being "tortured" by you day and night finally paid off. Your intelligence exceeded the limit of mom's understanding. From the first month on, mom gave up on the idea of "bullying" you. Your tongue that can tell the quality of milk powder is the beginning of mom's understanding of you. You brought my mother into a new "world"

a969881b2de4a347b5c15b5436338bcc6b92c253.sourceText: 我的孩子 抚养你长大 是一项超出我想象的”课题” 远远超过了攻读博士学位的”艰难” 当有你之后 我今生唯一的骄傲 从我的学位变成了你 从我自己变成了”只有你” 你的聪明才智 远远超出了我的能力 那全身全意抚养你的日子 让爸爸妈妈 筋疲力尽面面相觑
a969881b2de4a347b5c15b5436338bcc6b92c253.translatedText: My child, raising you is a "project" beyond my imagination. It far exceeds the "difficulty" of studying for a doctorate. After having you, my only pride in this life is from my degree to you. From myself to "only you", your intelligence and intelligence are far beyond my ability. The days when I devoted myself to raising you made my parents happy. Exhausted, we looked at each other

c65b81af0a40e25542c19385c9ac1cd349f73306.sourceText: 我的孩子 你第一次放声”高歌” 让妈妈奢望还是不会说话好 当你第一次 将妈妈的手臂从爸爸肩膀上挪去 让我吃惊你”嫉妒心”的提前出现 你用遥控器轻易地为我们”换台” 让我们”愤怒无比” 你那从来不愿走路的小腿 让我们怀疑你将用它们做何用途 你将周围的大人小孩 都”降服”在你面前
c65b81af0a40e25542c19385c9ac1cd349f73306.translatedText: My child, the first time you sang "loudly", it was better to let your mother have the luxury of not being able to speak. When you removed your mother's arm from your father's shoulder for the first time, I was surprised by the early appearance of your "jealousy". You used the remote control to easily "change the channel" for us, making us "extremely angry". Your little legs that never wanted to walk made us doubt what you would use them for. You would make the adults and children around you They all "surrender" in front of you

7fd29c772140a27268a2dada328f9b363c5ad31a.sourceText: 我的孩子 你的聪明伶俐 是周围人的话题 你扑进每一个 认识不认识人的怀抱 将他们的心引到你这里 幼儿园食堂阿姨向我抱怨 因为你忘了和她说”hi” 老师也偷偷告诉我 我离开后你哭泣的声音 在我转身之后 嘎然停止 你轻易地占据了大家的心
7fd29c772140a27268a2dada328f9b363c5ad31a.translatedText: My child, your intelligence is the talk of the people around you. You throw yourself into the arms of everyone you know or not, and lead their hearts to you. The aunt in the kindergarten cafeteria complained to me because you forgot to say "hi" to her. The teacher also secretly told me that the sound of your crying after I left suddenly stopped after I turned around. You easily occupy everyone's hearts

35be434ed2f972c666be1008f63d1b03f0cb79b0.sourceText: 我的孩子 妈妈一直在琢磨你究竟像谁 你将爸爸妈妈的缺点 悉数”照单全收” 而你的优点 又远远超过了我们 你的忍耐坚韧 你的宽容大度 你的聪明智慧 你的看轻人世间的不公 你的不靠自己的智慧而行 你的不以恶报恶的胸怀 让妈妈终于放心让你远走高飞
35be434ed2f972c666be1008f63d1b03f0cb79b0.translatedText: My child, my mother has been wondering who you are like. You "accept all the shortcomings of your parents" and your advantages far exceed ours. Your patience and tenacity, your tolerance and generosity, your intelligence and wisdom. Let mom finally feel at ease and let you fly away

fbb395bc6c9990bdee021a9bb83d85e34e3452d9.sourceText: 我的孩子 你是妈妈今生最大的礼物 神耶和华给我的爱的补偿 妈妈曾经的苦难 因你而看轻 妈妈曾经的怨恨 因你而看淡 你是妈妈早上起床的动力 开始准备你离家以后的日子 从几年前就已经开始 似乎现在与以往已不同 你不仅仅是妈妈的宝贝 已经成为妈妈的依靠
fbb395bc6c9990bdee021a9bb83d85e34e3452d9.translatedText: My child, you are mom’s biggest gift in this life. The compensation for the love God and Jehovah gave me. Mom’s past sufferings were underestimated because of you. Mom’s past resentment was underestimated because of you. You are the motivation for mom to get up in the morning. Start preparing for the days after you leave home. It started a few years ago. It seems that now is different from the past. You are not just my mother’s baby. It has become my mother's support

6492a1d68007113e66341a08817bc099544b982c.sourceText: 我的孩子 这十八年来 妈妈从你身上 将从小没经历的长大过程 一一与你一同体验 对你爱的倾注 让妈妈时常反应过度 你的聪明智慧 有时让妈妈自惭不如 你的超出同龄孩子的聪慧 让妈妈难以应付 你是妈妈今生唯一的骄傲 有你万事足
6492a1d68007113e66341a08817bc099544b982c.translatedText: My child. In the past eighteen years, my mother has learned from you. I will experience the growing process that I have never experienced since childhood. The devotion to your love has made my mother often overreact. Your intelligence and wisdom sometimes make my mother feel inferior. Your intelligence, which is beyond that of children of the same age, makes it difficult for my mother to cope with it. You are my mother's only pride in this life. With you, everything is sufficient.

45e06d49b48d70c35a4bea804b1d26b43923b1be.sourceText: 散打是一项互以对方技击动作为转移的斗智、较技的对抗性竞赛项目，是中国武术的重要组成部分，古称相搏、手搏、卞、弁、白打、拍张、手张、相散手等。由于徒手相搏的运动形式在台子上进行，又称”打擂台”。
45e06d49b48d70c35a4bea804b1d26b43923b1be.translatedText: > Sanda is a confrontational competition of wits and skills based on each other's martial arts movements. It is an important part of Chinese martial arts. Since the form of hand-to-hand fighting is carried out on a stage, it is also called "fighting stage".

7b8992db0986682a33e8c62167dd4abe3f52dd57.sourceText: 从古代到近代广泛流传，由于规则的不健全、不统一，两人互搏互决的项目一直在民间广泛流传。直到新中国成立后，武术被当做优秀的民族文化遗产加以继承和发展。在经过十年不断探索后，散打在 1989 年被批准列为体育正式项目。这是武术散打发展史上一个新的阶段。随着近年来省级比赛、国家级比赛、全国散打王争霸赛、中外对抗赛，以及世界杯武术散打比赛等一系列竞赛的进行，使武术散打正以崭新的姿态推向世界。
7b8992db0986682a33e8c62167dd4abe3f52dd57.translatedText: has been widely circulated from ancient times to modern times. Due to the imperfect and inconsistent rules, the project of two people competing against each other has been widely circulated among the people. It was not until the founding of New China that martial arts was inherited and developed as an excellent national cultural heritage. After ten years of continuous exploration, Sanda was approved as an official sport in 1989. This is a new stage in the history of the development of martial arts and Sanda. With the progress of a series of competitions in recent years such as provincial competitions, national competitions, the National Sanda King Competition, Chinese and Foreign Competitions, and the World Cup Wushu Sanda Competition, Wushu Sanda is being introduced to the world with a new attitude.

afd04cf4b230ffda720b8af98d479f2dce50e93b.sourceText: 散打突出地反映了武术的本质技击性，然而又明显区别于使人致伤致残的技击内容，在技法上不允许使用反关节擒拿动作，以及用肘法进攻对方。它具有严格的比赛规则，并以增强体质、交流技艺、提高技术水平为出发点，这与其它运动项目相同。 二、对抗性，武术散打明显区别于武术套路。对抗性的技击内容是武术散打的基本特征，它不仅要求具有良好的五项基本素质和熟练的散打技术，还要有敏捷的应变能力与良好的心理素质，具有较强的对抗性。 三、民族性，武术散打技法特点是”远踢、近打、贴身摔”。它不仅由于技法不同于拳击、跆拳道、泰拳等搏击术，更由于技法特点中蕴含的武术特点的哲学方法上的不同。另外比赛形式与方法也具有鲜明的民族特色。
afd04cf4b230ffda720b8af98d479f2dce50e93b.translatedText: Sanda prominently reflects the essence of martial arts, but it is clearly different from the content of martial arts that can cause injury and disability. The use of anti-joint grappling movements and the use of elbows to attack the opponent are not allowed. It has strict competition rules and is based on strengthening physical fitness, exchanging skills and improving technical level, which is the same as other sports. 2. Confrontation: Wushu Sanda is obviously different from Wushu routines. Confrontational martial arts content is the basic feature of martial arts Sanda. It not only requires good five basic qualities and proficient Sanda techniques, but also has agile adaptability and good psychological quality, and has strong confrontational nature. 3. Nationality, the characteristics of martial arts Sanda techniques are "far kicking, close hitting, and close throwing". It is not only different from boxing, taekwondo, Muay Thai and other fighting arts in terms of techniques, but also due to the differences in philosophical methods of martial arts characteristics contained in the characteristics of techniques. In addition, the competition format and methods also have distinctive national characteristics.

154aa7f8f338f5c5d28912b0f40e72bc001ceeec.sourceText: 潘洋，现役美国散打国家队队员。师从原湖北省武术队总教练，国际级武术大师，安天荣教授，系统全面的对中华武术理论和哲学进行研究。后随美国散打国家队总教练”宝岛拳王”李忆元教练，精研中国散打。

Later, he studied Chinese Sanda intensively with coach Li Yiyuan, the head coach of the American Sanda National Team and "Treasure Island Boxing Champion".

0d9d4c35bc2f4e40c87d5e0f9355799f47d63843.sourceText: （王劲报道）二零一三年元月二十四日，中华商会在亚利桑那州立大学的法学院举办了一场法律知识讲座。这次讲座主要谈论了与商界和华人社区精明相关的几个方面。讲座由法学院院长Douglas Sylvester致开幕词，并由前议员Barry Wong先生主持。
0d9d4c35bc2f4e40c87d5e0f9355799f47d63843.translatedText: (Reported by Wang Jin) On January 24, 2013, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce held a legal knowledge lecture at the Arizona State University School of Law. This lecture mainly talked about several aspects related to savvy in the business world and the Chinese community. The lecture was opened by Douglas Sylvester, Dean of the School of Law, and moderated by former MP Mr. Barry Wong.

60d9b7f1b3d944f38abbd219fbeab1f38cacbbf2.sourceText: （左到右）戴学正 Kristofer Halvorson 伍兆文 黄仕钧（Barry Wong）（摄像Eddie）
60d9b7f1b3d944f38abbd219fbeab1f38cacbbf2.translatedText: (left to right) Dai Xuezheng Kristofer Halvorson Wu Zhaowen Huang Shijun (Barry Wong) (Photographer Eddie)

befca79c919fa4e806e95a42f852dfad65af29de.sourceText: 中华总商会主席伍兆文律师首先介绍了商业法律，介绍了中美司法体系的不同之处。同时，伍兆文律师根据近年的几次案例，重点分析了美国的海外腐败法案， 并和法学院的学生讨论了这个法案的影响。随后，Kristofer Halvorson律师讲解有关专利和商标的法律知识。Halvorson律师详细介绍了近年中国和美国的专利商标方面的最新动向，为在座的商界人士讲解了美国公司在中国扩大业务时经常遇到的有关知识产权的情况和解决办法。最后，戴学正律师介绍了移民法，随着更多的中国人来美国留学，访问，移民，移民美国成为了更多人关注的话题，戴学正律师介绍了移民的历史和现状，讲解了目前常见的一些移民方式。
befca79c919fa4e806e95a42f852dfad65af29de.translatedText: Lawyer Wu Zhaowen, Chairman of the Chinese General Chamber of Commerce, first introduced commercial law and introduced the differences between the Chinese and American judicial systems. At the same time, lawyer Wu Zhaowen focused on analyzing the US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act based on several cases in recent years, and discussed the impact of this act with law students. Later, lawyer Kristofer Halvorson explained legal knowledge about patents and trademarks. Attorney Halvorson introduced in detail the latest trends in patents and trademarks in China and the United States in recent years, and explained to the business people present the intellectual property-related situations and solutions that American companies often encounter when expanding their business in China. Finally, lawyer Dai Xuezheng introduced immigration law. As more Chinese come to the United States to study, visit, and immigrate, immigrating to the United States has become a topic of more and more people's attention. Attorney Dai Xuezheng introduced the history and current situation of immigration, and explained some of the current common immigration methods.

1754f982ceb253401a171d89017d13ccfca4ece5.sourceText: 来参加讲座的各界人士和亚利桑那州立大学的法学院的学生踊跃参与讨论，三位经验丰富的律师给大家带来了一场生动活跃的法律知识讲座。这次活动是亚利桑那中华商会今年将举办的一系列活动之一，这次的讲座也受到了亚利桑那州立大学法学院，Perkins Coie律师行的大力支持。
1754f982ceb253401a171d89017d13ccfca4ece5.translatedText: People from all walks of life who came to the lecture and students from the Arizona State University School of Law actively participated in the discussion. Three experienced lawyers gave everyone a lively and lively lecture on legal knowledge. This event is one of a series of events that will be held by the Arizona Chinese Chamber of Commerce this year. This lecture is also strongly supported by the Arizona State University School of Law and the Perkins Coie law firm.

e31833edb188d2cfc1ec101c5cab253cebff0c54.sourceText: 6月4日上午11时，台湾国民党美国亚利桑那直属分部（直属分部），亚利桑那台湾乡亲马英九后援会（后援会）在凤凰城康乐大厦举行盛大的成立仪式。当地资深侨领，侨委会 咨询顾问余文劲，提前到场表示祝贺，国民党中央海外部夏大明主任发来贺函，候补中央委员姚其川也到场祝贺，现场嘉宾近百人。 上午康乐大厦的一楼大厅，放满了花篮，四处挂满了旗帜，前来的嘉宾也带上了活动的主题领巾，共同庆贺直属分部和后援会的成立。咨询顾问尹衍桓，亚省时报 社长甄硕钦，商界名人关宗任，开平同乡互助会，黄氏宗亲会，邓氏宗亲会，亚美报，娟娟花坊，方慧娴，张华芳，黄政捷，谢茵，谷音等 朋友都送来了花篮。余文劲，余氏宗亲会等也送来了礼金。义工卓继煜和林凤菊一早就来帮忙。梁维国上台宣读了余文劲的贺函，在贺函中余先生呼吁实行”三民主义” 争取和平统一，完成历史赋予的伟大使命。国民党海外部主任夏大明在贺函中指出，马英九后援会要团结在一起，统筹规划助选事宜，全力为马英九连任之路，奉献心力。候补中央委员姚 其川上台致辞。他强调了为马英九助选的重大意义，虽然马英九在本届执政当中很多地方还有不足之处，欢迎民众积极指出，但是继续坚持马英九的积极与大陆合作的基本立场，提升 台湾，繁荣未来是每个台湾民众的心声，希望国民党党员，马英九后援会用自己的选票来说话，为创造稳定，富裕的台湾而努力。姚其川庄严地取出国民党党旗和马英九后援会的旗帜，授 任给直属分部常务委员，后援会会长王玮王亭，全场高唱党歌，高呼挺”马”口号。王玮王亭表示贯彻中央的指示，组织好当地党员的活动，积极招募支持马英九 的人士，是他们当前最重要的任务。目前，双十节回台团，和明年1月份的竞选团的活动正在积极的筹备当中。 两岸共谋发展，拥护马英九与大陆的和平会谈，积极支持马英九连任也成为当地侨社支持这两个新团体成立的基石。
e31833edb188d2cfc1ec101c5cab253cebff0c54.translatedText: At 11 a.m. on June 4, the Taiwan Kuomintang’s Arizona branch (direct branch) and the Arizona Taiwanese Ma Ying-jeou Support Association (support association) held a grand opening ceremony at the Kangle Building in Phoenix. Yu Wenjin, a senior local overseas Chinese leader and consultant of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council, arrived in advance to express congratulations. Director Xia Daming of the Overseas Affairs Department of the Kuomintang Central Committee sent a congratulatory letter. Alternate member of the Central Committee Yao Qichuan also came to congratulate. There were nearly a hundred guests present. In the morning, the lobby on the first floor of the Kangle Building was filled with flower baskets and flags hung everywhere. Guests who came also brought scarves with the theme of the event to celebrate the establishment of the directly affiliated branch and the support club. Consultant Yin Yanhuan, President of the Alberta Times Zhen Shuoqin, business celebrity Guan Zongren, Kaiping Mutual Aid Association, Huang Clan Association, Deng Clan Association, Asian American Newspaper, Juanjuan Flower Shop, Fang Huixian, Zhang Huafang, Huang Zhengjie, Xie Yin, Gu Yin and other friends all sent flower baskets. Yu Wenjin, the Yu clan association and others also sent gifts. Volunteers Zhuo Jiyu and Lin Fengju came to help early in the morning. Liang Weiguo took the stage and read Yu Wenjin's congratulatory letter, in which Mr. Yu called for the implementation of the "Three People's Principles" to strive for peaceful reunification and complete the great mission entrusted by history. Xia Daming, director of the Overseas Department of the Kuomintang, pointed out in his congratulatory letter that Ma Ying-jeou's supporters should unite together to coordinate the planning of election support matters and devote themselves to Ma Ying-jeou's re-election. Alternate member of the Central Committee Yao Qichuan took the stage and delivered a speech. He emphasized the significance of supporting Ma Ying-jeou in the election. Although Ma Ying-jeou still has many shortcomings in the current administration, the public is welcome to actively point out, but he will continue to adhere to Ma Ying-jeou's basic position of actively cooperating with the mainland. Upgrading Taiwan and prospering the future are the aspirations of every Taiwanese people. He hopes that members of the Kuomintang and Ma Ying-jeou supporters will speak for themselves with their votes and work hard to create a stable and prosperous Taiwan. Yao Qichuan solemnly took out the Kuomintang party flag and the flag of the Ma Ying-jeou Support Association, and appointed Wang Wei and Wang Ting, the standing committee member of the directly affiliated branch and the president of the support association, and the whole audience sang the party anthem and shouted the "Ma Ying-jeou" slogan. Wang Wei and Wang Ting said that implementing the instructions of the central government, organizing the activities of local party members, and actively recruiting people who support Ma Ying-jeou are their most important tasks at the moment. Currently, active preparations are underway for the return to Taiwan group during the Double Ten Festival and the campaign group activities in January next year. The two sides of the Taiwan Strait seek common development, support Ma Ying-jeou's peace talks with the mainland, and actively support Ma Ying-jeou's re-election. This has also become the cornerstone of the local overseas Chinese community's support for the establishment of these two new groups.

8df284c629a349b6847647f3377169ea65c21ec0.translatedText: Obama has been elected "the most admired man in America" ​​for ten consecutive years China News Service, December 28...

377955a7055e1232c856a0d7defa93712e36586c.sourceText: 民调显示，17%的美国人称奥巴马是自己最钦佩的对象。现任美国总统特朗普获得了14%的投票，排名第二。而前国务卿希拉里则被9%的人选为最受尊重的女性，排名第一，仅以2%差距位居其后的是前第一夫人米歇尔。
377955a7055e1232c856a0d7defa93712e36586c.translatedText: A poll showed that 17% of Americans said Obama is the person they admire most. Current US President Trump received 14% of the vote, ranking second. Former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton was voted the most respected woman by 9%, ranking first, followed by former First Lady Michelle Obama with only a 2% gap.

81db570e1177f5fc19cd90f3444d39e2866cf270.sourceText: 据盖洛普新闻报道，今年是”希拉里连续第16年当选最受尊重女性”。她先后22次获得这一称号，比任何女性都要多。而唯一一位比奥巴马获选次数还多的男性是前总统艾森豪威尔，他共获选12次。
81db570e1177f5fc19cd90f3444d39e2866cf270.translatedText: According to Gallup News, this year is “Hillary’s 16th consecutive year as the most admired woman.” She has won this title 22 times, more than any other woman. The only man who has been elected more times than Obama is former President Eisenhower, who was elected 12 times.

de70b057ce950fa916b8d0d0241faaa8cd21cff8.sourceText: 自1946年起，除1976年外，盖洛普公司每年都会让美国民众选出他们最钦佩的男性和女性。在任总统获得这一称号共有58次，其中未能排名首位的在任总统有杜鲁门(1946 – 1947，1950 – 1952)、约翰逊(1967 – 1968)、尼克松(1973)、福特(1974 – 1975)、卡特(1980)以及老布什(2008)。
de70b057ce950fa916b8d0d0241faaa8cd21cff8.translatedText: Since 1946, every year except 1976, Gallup has asked the American people to choose the men and women they most admire. A total of 58 sitting presidents have won this title. Among them, the sitting presidents who did not rank first include Truman (1946-1947, 1950-1952), Johnson (1967-1968), Nixon (1973), Ford (1974-1975), Carter (1980) and Bush Sr. (2008).

5f2721427b38921060c3b4c566fcfc7a7740cb71.sourceText: 盖洛普新闻中还写到， 除特朗普、杜鲁门(1947年)和福特(1974年)曾得到过低于50%的工作支持率以外，所有在任总统的这一支持率都在50%以上。
5f2721427b38921060c3b4c566fcfc7a7740cb71.translatedText: Gallup News also wrote that except for Trump, Truman (1947) and Ford (1974) who have received job approval ratings below 50%, all current presidents have job approval ratings above 50%.

2645d1137080865b715a59d3ce0c9839665d9d74.sourceText: 为完成今年的民调，盖洛普公司在12月4日至11日间对1049名18岁以上人士进行了随机电话采访。受访人士分布在全美50个州和哥伦比亚特区。参加民调的人当中，有1/4的人未选出自己最钦佩的男性/女性。
2645d1137080865b715a59d3ce0c9839665d9d74.translatedText: To complete this year's poll, Gallup conducted random telephone interviews with 1,049 people over the age of 18 between December 4 and 11. Respondents were located in all 50 states and the District of Columbia. Among those who participated in the poll, 1/4 did not choose the man/woman they admired most.
