0e5a684a129fc20e4970754640bb84d674cfb8d7.sourceText: 余源：诗国流连话中秋 凡是华人，都喜欢中秋节，凡是华人，都会背诵”床前明月光，疑是地上霜。举头望明月，低头思故乡。”这是光照千古的伟大诗人李白的代表作，这首诗看似平白如话，”貌不惊人”，但却是天下第一”意境”的不朽名篇。试试展开想象的翅膀：一个万籁俱寂的中秋夜晚，皓月当空，繁星点点。似水的月光静静地流淌，漫过床头，漫过静夜，也漫过旅外游子的心。”独在异乡为异客，每逢佳节倍思亲”，此时此刻，游子辗转难眠，思绪万千：惦念年迈的双亲，眷恋温柔的妻子，牵挂稚嫩的儿女。全诗朴素自然，构思细腻而深幽，尤其，”疑”、”举”、”低”三个动词用得惟妙惟肖，把诗人思乡之情表露无遗。 李白，对明月情有独钟，以月入诗的佳作比比皆是。”明月出天山，苍茫云海间。长风几万里，吹度玉门关””长安一片月，万户捣衣声。秋风吹不尽，总是玉关情”，尤其那首”月下独酌”： 花间一壶酒，独酌无相亲。 举杯邀明月，对影成三人。 月既不解饮，影徒随我身。 暂伴月将影，行乐须及春。 我歌月徘徊，我舞影零乱。 醒时同交欢，醉后各分散。 永结无情游，相期邈云汉。 你看：月亮，令李白走火入魔；月亮，是李白不可须臾离开的”恋人”。据说，李白的最后归宿是：一个星空灿烂的晚上，他支案湖边，把酒临风，喝得酩酊大醉。突然，他发现湖心的一轮白玉盘招手，不能自持，纵身向湖里一跃厖。这故事是真是假就留待考古学家去论证吧，有一点显而易见，李白确是一位不折不扣的”月痴”。 其实，酷爱明月，借月抒怀的文人墨客恒河沙数，杜甫的”月夜忆舍弟”： 戍鼓断人行，秋边一雁声。 露从今夜白，月是故乡明。 有弟皆分散，无家问死生。 寄书长不达，况乃未休兵。 张九龄 的”望月怀远”： 海上生明月，天涯共此时。 情人怨遥夜，竟夕起相思！ 灭烛怜光满，披衣觉露滋。 不堪盈手赠，还寝梦佳期。 苏轼的”水调歌头”： 明月几时有，把酒问青天。 不知天上宫阙，今夕是何年。 我欲乘风归去，惟恐琼楼玉宇，高处不胜寒。 起舞弄清影，何似在人间。 转朱阁，低绮户，照无眠。 不应有恨，何事长向别时圆。 人有悲欢离合，月有阴晴圆缺，此事古难全。 但愿人长久，千里共婵娟。 ”苏门三杰”中，苏东坡特疼爱其弟弟苏辙，这首”水调歌头”就是怀念弟弟的。”转朱阁，低绮户，照无眠”，苏軾把月亮描绘成一个穿门钻户，跟大人捉”迷藏”的调皮小童，害得他兄弟俩谁也别想睡得安稳。按理说，小孩般的月亮是不会记恨谁的，但她常常在人们离别时又大又圆，真气人！”人有悲欢离合，月有阴晴圆缺，此事古难全”，人生的悲欢离合，月亮的阴晴圆缺，难道亘古不变，无法尽善尽美吗？”但愿人长久，千里共婵娟”。这”长久”，也许指人的岁数，也许指人的感情，也许兼而有之。总之，心有灵犀的人，即使相隔千里，也可共赏明月啊。 写到这里，我募然想起一件趣事：唐朝大诗人李贺有一天吟道：”天若有情天亦老”。吟罢，说也奇怪，他怎么冥思苦想也对不出下联。后来，到了宋朝，大理寺丞石延年妙手偶得，吟出：”月如无恨月常圆”，这副对联对仗工整，意境绝配，传为千古美谈。
0e5a684a129fc20e4970754640bb84d674cfb8d7.translatedText: Yu Yuan: The Poetry Country lingers on the Mid-Autumn Festival. All Chinese people like the Mid-Autumn Festival, and all Chinese people will recite "The bright moonlight in front of the bed, it is suspected to be frost on the ground." Raise your head to look at the bright moon, lower your head to think about your hometown. "This is the representative work of Li Bai, the great poet who has illuminated the ages. This poem may seem plain and simple, but it is an immortal poem with the best "artistic conception" in the world. Try to spread the wings of your imagination: a silent Mid-Autumn night, with a bright moon in the sky and stars dotted there. The water-like moonlight flows quietly, over the bedside, through the quiet night, and through the wanderers. "Lonely as a stranger in a foreign land, I miss my family even more during the holidays." At this moment, the wanderer can't sleep, thinking a lot: thinking about his elderly parents, his tender wife, and his young children. The whole poem is simple and natural, and the conception is delicate and profound. In particular, the three verbs "suspicious", "lift" and "low" are used vividly, which fully expresses the poet's homesickness. Li Bai had a special liking for the bright moon, and there are many masterpieces that use the moon in his poems. "The bright moon rises above the Tianshan Mountains, among the vast sea of clouds." The wind blows tens of thousands of miles across the Yumen Pass." Chang'an is covered with a moon, and thousands of households are pounding their clothes. The autumn wind cannot blow away, but the love is always in love", especially the song "Drinking Alone under the Moon": A pot of wine among the flowers, drinking alone without a blind date. Raising glasses to invite the bright moon, the shadows become three people. The moon does not know how to drink, and the shadow follows me. For a while, the moon will shadow, and the music must be until spring. I sing to the moon and wander, and my dancing shadows are scattered. When we are awake, we have sex, but when we are drunk, we are separated. We will travel together forever, and we will meet each other in Miao Yunhan. You see: the moon made Li Bai obsessed; the moon was Li Bai's "lover" who could not leave for a moment. It is said that Li Bai's final destination was: one night under a bright starry sky, he went to bed by the lake, drank wine in the wind, and got drunk. Suddenly, he found a white jade plate in the center of the lake waving at him. He couldn't control himself and jumped into the lake. Whether this story is true or not is left to archaeologists to prove. One thing is obvious, Li Bai is indeed a "moon crazy". In fact, the literati who loves the bright moon and expresses his feelings through the moon, Du Fu's "Remembering the Brothers on a Moonlit Night": The sound of gurgling drums breaks the line of people, and the sound of wild geese on the edge of autumn is white. The moon is bright in my hometown. My brothers are scattered, and I have no home to ask about life and death. I have not yet stopped sending letters. Zhang Jiuling's "Looking at the Moon and Huaiyuan": The bright moon rises on the sea, and the world is at this time. Lovers hate each other in the distant night, but they feel the dew in their clothes. It’s too late to have a good night’s sleep. Su Shi’s “Shui Tiao Song Tou”: When will the bright moon come? I don’t know what year it is in the palace in the sky. I want to go back in the wind, but I am afraid that it will be too cold to dance in the sky. Turning to the Zhu Pavilion, looking down at the house, there should be no regrets, why should we be reunited when we say goodbye? People have joys and sorrows, and the moon waxes and wanes. I hope that people will live forever and share the beauty of the moon. Among the "Three Heroes of the Su Family", Su Dongpo loved his younger brother Su Che very much. This song "Shui Tiao Song Tou" is in memory of his younger brother. A mischievous little boy plays hide and seek with adults, making it impossible for any of his brothers to sleep peacefully. It stands to reason that the child-like moon would not hold grudges against anyone, but she is often big and round when people say goodbye. , so irritating! "People have joys and sorrows, and the moon waxes and wanes. This is not the case in ancient times." Is it true that the joys and sorrows of life and the waxing and waning of the moon are eternal and cannot be perfected? "For a long time, thousands of miles apart, we share the beauty of the moon." This "long time" may refer to a person's age, or to a person's feelings, or both. In short, people who have the same understanding of each other can enjoy the bright moon together even if they are thousands of miles apart. Writing this, I suddenly remembered an interesting thing: Li He, a great poet of the Tang Dynasty, one day recited: "If the sky is sentimental, the sky will also grow old." After reciting it, it is strange that no matter how hard he thought, he could not come up with the second couplet.

306acf81c0427456bd81064e5ab15428c1e9d755.sourceText: 当兵成入籍捷径 华裔青年踊跃从军（图）
306acf81c0427456bd81064e5ab15428c1e9d755.translatedText: Serving as a soldier has become a shortcut to naturalization. Young Chinese people are eager to join the army (pictures)

881ba1802ea3851f33b2571ec9a95ae66d9ae26a.sourceText: 当兵成入籍捷径 华裔青年踊跃从军（图） 美国陆军特别征兵开放54种?#38750;绿…
881ba1802ea3851f33b2571ec9a95ae66d9ae26a.translatedText: Being a soldier is a shortcut to naturalization. Young Chinese people are eager to join the army (pictures) The U.S. Army Special Recruitment has opened 54 types of green cards...

baef97880891acd162fb14816ab82ac64cd43425.sourceText: 美国陆军特别征兵开放54种?#38750;绿卡?#36523;份快速归化美国公民，吸引大批华裔前往应征。
baef97880891acd162fb14816ab82ac64cd43425.translatedText: The U.S. Army Special Recruitment has opened 54 types of green cards to quickly naturalize American citizens, attracting a large number of Chinese to apply.

a4b39e8628c44d39dd39d3a25899e67cc132ef4a.sourceText: 图为美国陆军人事处上士王强(左)、陆军主管圣盖博谷征兵处的指挥官Patrik W. Caukin(中)、美国陆军空降师华裔上士桑迪(右)。
a4b39e8628c44d39dd39d3a25899e67cc132ef4a.translatedText: Pictured are U.S. Army Personnel Staff Sergeant Wang Qiang (left), Army Commander Patrik W. Caukin in charge of the San Gabriel Valley Recruitment Office (middle), and U.S. Army Airborne Division Chinese-American Staff Sergeant Sandy (right).

cc6a4ef86e254479bbf73e1c48283f7bfe57709e.sourceText: 针对54种”非绿卡”身份提供”快速入籍”及”优厚福利”的美国陆军”紧缺人才征兵计划”启动两天，吸引南加州大批华裔有志青年前往报名，包括洛杉矶加大、南加大、圣地亚哥加大等多所大学中国国际学生纷沓而至，更有博士、硕士准备”投笔从戎”，忙坏了征兵办公室。
cc6a4ef86e254479bbf73e1c48283f7bfe57709e.translatedText: The U.S. Army's "Short-Demand Talent Recruitment Program", which provides "quick naturalization" and "generous benefits" for 54 "non-green card" statuses, has been launched for two days, attracting a large number of Chinese aspiring young people in Southern California to sign up, including Chinese international students from many universities such as the University of California, Los Angeles, the University of Southern California, and the University of California, San Diego. There are also doctors and masters who are preparing to "write and join the army", which has busy the recruitment office.

59c2a606d55c7daba1900523bf33a795cacd60f9.sourceText: ”这两天简直忙趴了！”负责艾尔蒙地、阿苏萨、罗兰冈、波莫那等圣盖博谷四个征兵办公室统筹征兵工作的美国陆军指挥官Patrik Caukin表示，从本周一上班开始，四个办公室就不断涌进华裔应征者，办公室电话更响个不停，打听募兵情况的民众源源不断。两天当中仅仅是专程前往四个办公室报名的或打听详情的华裔，就不下数百人。
59c2a606d55c7daba1900523bf33a795cacd60f9.translatedText: “I’ve been so busy these two days!” U.S. Army Commander Patrik Caukin, who is responsible for coordinating recruitment work at the four recruiting offices in the San Gabriel Valley including El Monte, Azusa, Rowland Heights, and Pomona, said that since starting work on Monday, the four offices have been flooded with Chinese recruits. The office phone has been ringing non-stop, with a steady stream of people inquiring about the recruitment situation. During the two days, hundreds of Chinese people made a special trip to the four offices to register or inquire about details.

68f3c3352d79b20e8489307e105f0bbb9e7b19e5.sourceText: 此次特别募兵计划MAVNI(Military Accessions Vital to the National Interest)，将招收包括中文、韩文、泰语、菲律宾语等全球多国60种语言在内的双语人员，对象主要是过去两年在美合法居住，但目前尚未获得在美永久居留(绿卡)的17至34岁男女，包括在美华人留学生、留学生配偶等，均有机会加入美军、并跳过绿卡申请程序，快速成为美国公民。
68f3c3352d79b20e8489307e105f0bbb9e7b19e5.translatedText: This special recruitment plan MAVNI (Military Accessions Vital to the National Interest), will recruit bilingual personnel including Chinese, Korean, Thai, Filipino and other 60 languages ​​from around the world. The targets are mainly men and women aged 17 to 34 who have lived in the United States legally in the past two years but have not yet obtained permanent residence (green card) in the United States, including Chinese international students in the United States, spouses of international students, etc., all have the opportunity to join the US military, skip the green card application process, and quickly become American citizens.

8988fa78f117b461fa66dc6a06a62606506ee3ac.sourceText: 在艾尔蒙地美国陆军征兵处，两天来前往应征的华裔青年源源不断。华裔陆军上士桑迪表示，不少华裔国际学生结伴而来，部分则是家长为孩子先来打听情况，由于应征者太多，本来正常下午5时下班的征兵处，不得不推迟到晚上9时关门。
8988fa78f117b461fa66dc6a06a62606506ee3ac.translatedText: At the U.S. Army Recruiting Office in El Monte, there has been a steady stream of Chinese young people applying for the draft in the past two days. Sandy, a Chinese-American Army sergeant, said that many Chinese international students came in groups, and some of them were parents who came to inquire about the situation for their children. Because there were so many applicants, the recruitment office, which normally closed at 5 p.m., had to postpone its closing until 9 p.m.

e359b7ba923ae4ef7a59d41d53ec4e0a9023a2ef.sourceText: 初步统计，目前前往应征的华人80%为国际学生，包括在读的国际学生和已完成学业、正在实习的国际学生，不少已获博士和硕士学位的中国留学生也在应征之列。
e359b7ba923ae4ef7a59d41d53ec4e0a9023a2ef.translatedText: Preliminary statistics show that 80% of the Chinese applicants are international students, including current international students, international students who have completed their studies and are doing internships. Many Chinese students who have obtained doctorates and master's degrees are also among the applicants.

fe2cf0185dd1e0dcda9b772d9757f34ad95f91f2.sourceText: 今年夏天刚从洛杉矶加大法学院毕业、并通过加州律师执业考试的一位女博士表示，与其耗费大好时光面对冗长繁复的移民身份调整，不如从军报效美国，一举两得。她希望未来成为一名美军律师。
fe2cf0185dd1e0dcda9b772d9757f34ad95f91f2.translatedText: A female Ph.D. who just graduated from the University of California, Los Angeles School of Law this summer and passed the California Bar Examination said that instead of spending a lot of time facing the long and complicated adjustment of immigration status, it is better to join the military and serve the United States, killing two birds with one stone. She hopes to become a U.S. Army lawyer in the future.

2390e216574d45a371c1ab8e2bf2e12d3edfb154.sourceText: 2日专程前往艾尔蒙地征兵处为独生子打听当兵情况的张氏夫妇表示，”好男要当兵”，希望让儿子到部队锻炼成长。张太太表示，她从小在部队长大，深知”部队锻炼出来的人就是不一样”，儿子从小娇生惯养，”相信离开父母才能走得更高更远”。不过张太太表示，儿子目前已是加大圣地亚哥三年级国际学生，一年就毕业，”这是让我们最感为难的地方”。
2390e216574d45a371c1ab8e2bf2e12d3edfb154.translatedText: On the 2nd, the Zhangs made a special trip to the El Monte Military Recruitment Office to inquire about their only son’s status as a soldier. They said, “A good man wants to be a soldier” and hoped that their son would be trained and grow up in the army. Mrs. Zhang said that she grew up in the army and knew that "people trained by the army are different." Her son was pampered since he was a child and "believes that only by leaving his parents can he go higher and further." However, Mrs. Zhang said that her son is currently a third-year international student at UC San Diego and will graduate in one year. “This is what makes us most embarrassed.”

54117779f6f80bef17f9063abc62a6d77931fbb0.sourceText: 当天陪同正在巴沙迪那小区学院就读的外甥女前往应征的韩太太表示，她的女儿之前在圣地亚哥当了四年海军，目前正在圣地亚哥加大学习会计，”我的经验是，女儿当兵当对了！”韩太太表示，女儿18岁入伍，海军四年下来，”整个人非常成熟”，不仅解决了公民身份，现在读书”所有费用军队包，每个月还有2000元补助”。
54117779f6f80bef17f9063abc62a6d77931fbb0.translatedText: Mrs. Han, who accompanied her niece who was studying at Pasadena Community College to apply for the draft that day, said that her daughter had been in the Navy for four years in San Diego and is currently studying accounting at the University of California in San Diego. "My experience is that my daughter is the right choice to join the military!" Mrs. Han said that her daughter joined the Army at the age of 18 and after four years in the Navy, "the whole person is very mature."

940d15ae89640d77f0d3b3c6fbf3c2840293d65e.sourceText: 征兵处指挥官Patrik Caukin表示，近年圣盖博谷亚裔和华裔当兵人数明显上升，新兵当中高达90%至95%是亚裔，其中又以华裔为主，虽然快速入籍是解决移民身份的快捷方式，而军中机会和发展前景也相当吸引新移民。
940d15ae89640d77f0d3b3c6fbf3c2840293d65e.translatedText: Recruitment Office Commander Patrik Caukin said that the number of Asian and Chinese soldiers in the San Gabriel Valley has increased significantly in recent years. As many as 90% to 95% of new recruits are Asian, and the majority of them are Chinese. Although rapid naturalization is a quick way to resolve immigration status, the opportunities and development prospects in the military are also very attractive to new immigrants.

6de9ef311c4abc05397fe0928bbbd9797694ebba.sourceText: 至于美军此次特别征兵是否意味着战争潜在？Caukin表示，经过近年的战争之后，美国目前没有出兵计划，不过他表示，即便不是用于军事，美军也会在其他用途，比如年前的海地地震，美国就派出大量部队帮助救难，”军队的功能多种多样”。
6de9ef311c4abc05397fe0928bbbd9797694ebba.translatedText: As for whether this special recruitment by the US military means the potential for war? Caukin said that after recent wars, the United States currently has no plans to send troops. However, he said that even if it is not used for military purposes, the US military will be used for other purposes. For example, during the earthquake in Haiti two years ago, the United States sent a large number of troops to help with rescue operations. "The functions of the military are diverse."

81cfa80796fd2779d4336c6495b3bcd473f98b35.sourceText: 起源于上世纪80年代末和90年代初，购买「空时」的做法是可让州府、地方政府和学校员工以付费方式，购买不存在的工作年资，最多可增加五年，以便符合退休和领取终生年金的资格。而已符合退休年龄的员工亦可额外购买「空时」，亦即可增加年资，让年金最多增加25% 。 在本州，临退休的员工使用未享用的「病假」抵押工时更是一种流行做法。凤凰城每年给公务员带薪病假15天，如果员工不使用病假，日积月累，可以带来一笔不小的收入。 在亚利桑那州，包括所有国家机构，高等教育，法院和退休制度，去年支付了630万美元给502名员工，平均支付12591美元。凤凰城在2010年有903名员工用「病假」抵工时，涉及金额达10.79万美元，平均每人$11,958美元。 迄今为止，凤凰城用病假抵押工时最多的个桉是2010年乔治理查兹。当时58岁警官2010年退休时，他获得「病假」工资$14,4279美元，而他一年的退休金只有$139,963。 凤凰城候任市长格雷格斯坦顿说，城市将全面检讨这种补偿方式，以确定是否节省纳税人的钱，并最大限度第提高员工的生产力。
81cfa80796fd2779d4336c6495b3bcd473f98b35.translatedText: Originating in the late 1980s and early 1990s, the practice of purchasing "empty time" allows state, local government, and school employees to pay for non-existent years of service, adding up to five years to qualify for retirement and lifetime annuities. Employees who have reached retirement age can also purchase additional "empty time", which can increase their seniority and increase their annuity by up to 25%. In this state, it is even more popular for employees who are about to retire to use their unused "sick leave" to mortgage their working hours. Phoenix City provides 15 days of paid sick leave to civil servants every year. If employees do not use their sick leave, over time, it can bring in a considerable amount of income. In Arizona, which includes all state agencies, higher education, courts and retirement systems, $6.3 million was paid to 502 employees last year, with an average payout of $12,591. In 2010, 903 Phoenix employees used "sick leave" to cover work hours, involving a total amount of US$107,900, an average of US$11,958 per employee. To date, the person in Phoenix who has used the most sick leave to mortgage hours is George Richards in 2010. When the then 58-year-old police officer retired in 2010, he received "sick leave" pay of $144,279, and his annual pension was only $139,963. Phoenix Mayor-elect Greg Stanton said the city will comprehensively review this compensation method to determine whether it saves taxpayers money and maximizes employee productivity.

cfc2803ea2c4269123cf2d333bbc55fe43cb2c05.sourceText: 凤凰城发出酷热警告，亚利桑那州四人热死
cfc2803ea2c4269123cf2d333bbc55fe43cb2c05.translatedText: Phoenix issues heat warning, four people die from heat in Arizona

813d5fb097a1d9b7019add947b7db0bc21616389.sourceText: 凤凰城发出酷热警告，亚利桑那州四人热死 美国国家气象局已经向亚利桑那州大部分地区下周整个星期发出了极端高温…
813d5fb097a1d9b7019add947b7db0bc21616389.translatedText: Phoenix issues heat warning, four people die from heat in Arizona The National Weather Service has issued an extreme heat warning for most of Arizona for the entire week of next week...

3a2ffc1886bf951a52fc04b8439ccf1839b8ea16.sourceText: 美国国家气象局已经向亚利桑那州大部分地区下周整个星期发出了极端高温警告。
3a2ffc1886bf951a52fc04b8439ccf1839b8ea16.translatedText: The National Weather Service has issued an extreme heat warning for most of Arizona for the entire week of next week.

417ade04db417be1041314c40c701e3e4664eaba.sourceText: 凤凰城星期天的高温预计将达到摄氏49度，整个一周都不会凉爽下来。
417ade04db417be1041314c40c701e3e4664eaba.translatedText: The high temperature in Phoenix on Sunday is expected to reach 49 degrees Celsius, with no signs of cooling down all week long.

f5803f112aa09614bc8a31399bdcb5a365347d09.sourceText: 上周亚利桑那州的凤凰城气温曾一度飙升至摄氏47.7度，比1968年的纪录高摄氏3度。受热浪影响，亚利桑那州当地至少有4人中暑身亡。其中，上周六先有一名25岁男性在凤凰城附近的皮纳尔县登山时，在高温中而丧生。翌日，再有1名28岁女子与友人登山时，即使大量饮水，仍抵不住热浪煎熬而死亡。
f5803f112aa09614bc8a31399bdcb5a365347d09.translatedText: Last week, the temperature in Phoenix, Arizona soared to 47.7 degrees Celsius, 3 degrees Celsius higher than the record set in 1968. Affected by the heat wave, at least four people died of heatstroke in Arizona. Among them, a 25-year-old man died in the heat last Saturday while hiking in Pinal County near Phoenix. The next day, another 28-year-old woman died from the heat wave even though she drank plenty of water while hiking with her friends.

cc19b5a31ebf8142813d756e49a2e17be90c3132.sourceText: 面对如此高温天气，专家们警告说，非常小的孩子和老人应当待在室内，并告诫那些外出的人要注意预防与高温有关的疾病：饥渴、皮肤晒红、抽筋以及极度疲劳感。
cc19b5a31ebf8142813d756e49a2e17be90c3132.translatedText: In the face of such hot weather, experts warn that very young children and the elderly should stay indoors, and warn those who go out to prevent heat-related illnesses: hunger and thirst, red skin, cramps and extreme fatigue.

3736599cb8d5064e167f43d5ca1cb937d8601df9.sourceText: 凤凰城当局和当地教会已经为无家可归者设立了庇护所。电力公司正在安排更多的人力值班，确保有充足的电力供空调使用。人们被建议在白天不要遛狗，表示街道和人行道的气温可能达到炽热的76摄氏度。
3736599cb8d5064e167f43d5ca1cb937d8601df9.translatedText: Phoenix authorities and local churches have set up shelters for the homeless. The power company is arranging more manpower on duty to ensure that there is sufficient power for air conditioning. People are being advised not to walk their dogs during the day, with temperatures on streets and pavements likely to reach a scorching 76C.

559c5445c1a002e2dc82a1b58bdc2109a05144ee.sourceText: 气象学家指出，极端高温天气是强大的高压系统控制美国西南部部分地区所致。
559c5445c1a002e2dc82a1b58bdc2109a05144ee.translatedText: Meteorologists pointed out that the extreme high temperature weather is caused by a strong high pressure system controlling parts of the southwestern United States.

1d90c8915c19eba636eb55b25f8adba349ec37d1.sourceText: 不要和自己女人讲道理

b6decfdb35fb9223ca2c6ae2dfd670de418b8b01.sourceText: 不要和自己女人讲道理 常常听男人们说希望找一个知书达理的女人做自己的伴侣，但情况却往往事与愿违，通常好像是…
b6decfdb35fb9223ca2c6ae2dfd670de418b8b01.translatedText: Don’t reason with your woman. I often hear men say that they hope to find a knowledgeable and reasonable woman as their partner, but things often backfire. It usually seems like...

a94f5a08b5584e8144f0597be5a25eb27b66bcd9.sourceText: 不要和自己女人讲道理 常常听男人们说希望找一个知书达理的女人做自己的伴侣，但情况却往往事与愿违，通常好像是那些知书达理的女人都被别人娶走了，而自己的女人偏偏是最不讲理的。 请别怀疑你的眼光，事实上，别人的女人不过是表面看起来知书达理而已，你的女人对待外人没准比她们做的还好，只是你不是外人，你是她最亲近的人，在你面前，她不想掩饰也没必要掩饰女人不讲理的本性。所以你也可以这样安慰自己：她对我不讲理是因为她爱我，这样也许你会感觉舒服一些。 女人不讲理的这个特点在你们争吵的时候一定会体现得淋漓尽致，也许是因为芝麻大点儿的事你们闹了别扭，起初你们会尝试互相说服，作为男人，你习惯了逻辑性思维，你认为有理走遍天下，于是你开始摆事实讲道理，并列出一二三条给她听，可是你会发现她根本听不进去，而且还用一大堆不是理由的理由反驳你，如果实在说不过你，她甚至可以耍赖，你如果说她不讲理，没准她会直接告诉你：我就​​是不讲理，怎么了？ 你一定会觉得很无奈吧？这么点儿的小事怎么就是跟她说不通呢？没错，就是说不通，而且我还劝你别费口舌了，女人本来就是非理性的动物，你硬要用理性的思维去说服她，用理性的方法去解决问题，她怎么会吃你这一套呢？那只能让两个人越吵越凶罢了！如果你真的想结束这场战争，那么就别和她讲理了，你就委屈一些，放低姿态，别跟她争了，你再这么争下去，她没准会说你不爱她呢！你岂不是更​​没处说理？ 你想想看，她当初嫁给你，岂因为你擅长讲理哉？实指望你疼她，宠她一辈子也。如今你忘了疼她宠她，动辄要和她讲理，你很讲理，会讲理，能把白马说成非马，她早就知道，她就是不吃你这一套，你便有一百个理又待如何？其实你只要略施小惠，​​稍表殷勤，说句感性的话，送个小礼物，眉目间表示未忘对她好，你就是一百个理通通不对，她也愿意听你的。女人之与男人，只要你对她好，你对她好了，你作强盗，她愿意作强盗婆;你作汉奸，她愿跟着你挨骂。但你不疼她，你再伟大，你是圣贤帝王，讲不讲理一概与她无干──这是把事情说的极端了。重要的是她的基本意识型能如此，你要和她讲什么理？ 有一天，如果碰巧她在和别人讲话，你不妨注意听听。你会猛然发现，原来她和别人讲话，是很讲理的！可见她只是不和你讲理，她故意不和你讲理，当然是暗示你要以理之外的感觉对待她。可惜你从柏拉图读到康德的”纯粹理性批判”，涉理深矣，迷于理亦深矣，聪明一世，就是想不起该什么时候讲理，什么时候不必讲理。 我知道你的心里也会不平衡，但家是用情而不是用理组成的，本来就不是讲理算账的地方，你不是律师，她也不是法官。 所以，聪明的男人都是不会和自己的女人讲理的，因为，讲不出理来。
a94f5a08b5584e8144f0597be5a25eb27b66bcd9.translatedText: Don’t reason with your woman. I often hear men say that they hope to find a knowledgeable and reasonable woman as their partner, but the situation often backfires. It usually seems that those knowledgeable and reasonable women are married by others, and their own women are the most unreasonable. Please don't doubt your vision. In fact, other people's women just appear to be knowledgeable and reasonable on the surface. Your woman may treat outsiders better than they do, but you are not an outsider. You are the person closest to her. In front of you, she does not want to hide and there is no need to hide the unreasonable nature of women. So you can also comfort yourself this way: She is being unreasonable to me because she loves me, so maybe you will feel better. This characteristic of women being unreasonable will definitely be reflected clearly when you quarrel. Maybe it is because you are at odds over something bigger than sesame. At first, you will try to persuade each other. As a man, you are used to logical thinking. You think it is reasonable to go all over the world, so you start to tell the facts. Reasons, and list one, two or three to her, but you will find that she can't listen at all, and will refute you with a lot of reasons that are not reasons. If she really can't convince you, she can even cheat. If you say that she is unreasonable, she may tell you directly: I am just unreasonable, what's wrong? You must feel helpless, right? Why can't she understand such a trivial matter? That's right, it just doesn't make sense, and I also advise you to stop talking. Women are inherently irrational animals. If you insist on using rational thinking to convince her and use rational methods to solve problems, how can she fall for you? That will only make the two people quarrel more and more fierce! If you really want to end this war, then don't reason with her. Just be aggrieved, lower your attitude, and stop arguing with her. If you continue to argue like this, she might say that you don't love her! Aren’t you even more incapable of reasoning? Think about it, did she marry you because you were good at reasoning? I really hope you will love her and pamper her forever. Now you forget to love her and dote on her, and you always want to reason with her. You are very reasonable, you can reason, and you can say that a white horse is not a horse. She has known it for a long time. She just won't accept your trick, so what if you have a hundred reasons? In fact, as long as you do a little favor, show a little attentiveness, say something sentimental, give a small gift, and show in your eyes that you have not forgotten to treat her well, she will be willing to listen to you even if you are completely clear about what is wrong. Between a woman and a man, as long as you treat her well and you treat her well, she will be willing to be a robber if you are a robber; if you are a traitor, she will be scolded along with you. But you don't love her, no matter how great you are, you are a sage emperor, whether you are unreasonable or not has nothing to do with her - this is taking things to the extreme. The important thing is that her basic consciousness can be like this. What reason do you want to reason with her? One day, if she happens to be talking to someone else, you might as well pay attention. You will suddenly realize that she is very reasonable when talking to others! It can be seen that she just refuses to reason with you. She deliberately refuses to reason with you, which of course implies that you should treat her with unreasonable feelings. It's a pity that you read Kant's "Critique of Pure Reason" from Plato. You are deeply involved in the theory, and you are also deeply obsessed with the theory. You are so smart that you just can't remember when to be reasonable and when not to be reasonable. I know that your heart will be unbalanced, but family is made up of emotions rather than reason. It is not a place for reasoning and settling accounts. You are not a lawyer, and she is not a judge. Therefore, smart men will not reason with their women because they cannot be reasoned with.

367e056755ba153fc32b4d08aaf9eb0683bf6955.sourceText: 凤凰城侨联将举办大型庆祝国庆联欢会(图)
367e056755ba153fc32b4d08aaf9eb0683bf6955.translatedText: The Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation will hold a large-scale party to celebrate the National Day (picture)

fb4914c3090b7abb9aecde65beea552c6f7b7978.sourceText: 凤凰城侨联将举办大型庆祝国庆联欢会(图) （侨联供稿）每年七月四日，是鳯凰城侨联举办华人聚会欢庆美国国庆独…
fb4914c3090b7abb9aecde65beea552c6f7b7978.translatedText: The Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation will hold a large-scale party to celebrate the National Day (picture) (Contributed by the Overseas Chinese Federation) Every year on July 4th, the Overseas Chinese Federation of Phoenix City holds a gathering of Chinese people to celebrate the National Day of Independence of the United States...

4dc21d148b417fed1cbce2d4085f2b416cbf847c.sourceText: （侨联供稿）每年七月四日，是鳯凰城侨联举办华人聚会欢庆美国国庆独立日传统的日子。往年，侨联举办华裔小姐选美并开展庆祝活动。今年，鳯凰卫视定于八月初在鳯凰城举办全美鳯凰小姐的选美活动，侨联决定今年的本地选美活动另择日期举行，庆祝国庆日的传统活动将以自娱自乐的形式举办大型庆祝国庆联欢会，欢迎各华人侨团、组织和个人前来参加，共庆节日。 目前，侨联已组织一批义工积极开展淮备工作。在四月中旬，青少年征文比赛”我的美国梦”和绘画比赛”我爱美国”己经开始征稿，将分别于六月一日和六月十日评选出优秀作品，在庆祝大会上颁奖。绘画作品请于五月三十一日前送交新东方艺术学校于华老师（电话 602-490-8613）或位于新世界商塲内的Hong KongFifts Ms.Maggie Wong(602-3280969)。作文请于六月九日前用电子邮件寄送到 phoenixunitedguoqing@gmail.com 专用邮箱，或电话602-285-5670与崔增祁联系。成人为纪念国庆撰写的实现美国梦经历的文章将陆续在报刋专栏发表或选登在今年的国庆专刋，卡拉OK大赛和麻将比赛也正在积极筹划中，参加者请电话与方慧贤（602-498-3555) 邓情芬（623-498-3555）报名。大会安排一个半小时的文娱演出，节目正在安排中，希望参加表演的团体和个人请尽早与吕丽华（480-213-9187）闻琳琳（480-516-8868）联系。
4dc21d148b417fed1cbce2d4085f2b416cbf847c.translatedText: (Contributed by the Federation of Overseas Chinese) Every year on July 4th, the Overseas Chinese Federation of Phoenix City holds a traditional Chinese gathering to celebrate the National Day of Independence of the United States. In previous years, the Overseas Chinese Federation held the Miss Chinese beauty pageant and carried out celebration activities. This year, Phoenix Satellite TV is scheduled to hold the Miss Phoenix National Beauty Pageant in Phoenix City in early August. The Overseas Chinese Federation has decided to hold the local beauty pageant on another date this year. The traditional activities to celebrate the National Day will be a large-scale celebration of the National Day party in the form of self-entertainment. All Chinese overseas groups, organizations and individuals are welcome to participate and celebrate the holiday together. At present, the Overseas Chinese Federation has organized a group of volunteers to actively carry out preparation work. In mid-April, the youth essay competition "My American Dream" and the painting competition "I Love America" ​​have begun collecting submissions. Excellent works will be selected on June 1 and June 10 respectively, and awards will be given at the celebration meeting. Please submit your paintings to Teacher Yu Hua of New Oriental Art School (Tel. 602-490-8613) or Hong KongFifts Ms. Maggie Wong (602-3280969) located in New World Mall before May 31st. Please send your essay by email to the dedicated mailbox phoenixunitedguoqing@gmail.com before June 9, or contact Cui Zengqi at 602-285-5670. Articles written by adults on their experiences of realizing the American dream written in commemoration of National Day will be published in newspaper columns or selected for inclusion in this year’s National Day issue. Karaoke competitions and mahjong competitions are also being actively planned. Participants please call Fang Huixian (602-498-3555) and Deng Qingfen (623-498-3555) to register. The conference will arrange a one-and-a-half-hour cultural performance. The program is being arranged. Groups and individuals who wish to participate in the performance should contact Lu Lihua (480-213-9187) and Wen Linlin (480-516-8868) as soon as possible.

158be18e01f5b285a8b2d794b7c6ed77f0560c51.sourceText: 庆祝活动预定在 Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints 敎堂( 46st. And Indianola)举行。联欢活动将于七月四日上午十一点开始，现塲有画展、乒乓球、麻将、水球逰戏、卡拉OK、书法和个人藏品展等多项活动。中午有各种食品免费供应，包括美式BBQ，HotDog和中歺食品等。下午两点举办简短庆典，对新入籍公民的祝贺，并安排一个半小时的文娱演出。全部活动免费，欢迎大家踊跃参加，共同欢渡节日。
158be18e01f5b285a8b2d794b7c6ed77f0560c51.translatedText: The celebration is scheduled to be held at Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints Church (46st. And Indianola). The party will start at 11 a.m. on July 4th and will include art exhibitions, table tennis, mahjong, water polo, karaoke, calligraphy and personal collection exhibitions. A variety of food is available for free at noon, including American BBQ, HotDog and Chinese food. A short celebration will be held at 2 p.m. to congratulate the newly naturalized citizens, and a one-and-a-half-hour cultural performance will be arranged. All activities are free, and everyone is welcome to participate and celebrate the festival together.

80217c571306944926f30262602d134e45d04e50.sourceText: 国庆筹备活动义工们正在开会讨论
80217c571306944926f30262602d134e45d04e50.translatedText: National Day preparation volunteers are meeting to discuss

cfe4e56c26e5260d502213d8c79785232b983f55.sourceText: （刘国泰撰稿）位于凤凰城south 7th Ave.和Buckeye交界处耸立着两栋十层高的楼房，这里是美国住房部为实现居者有其屋建造的老人公寓。从九十年代初，第一位华人住进这里算起来已经有二十年了。如今这里的华人住户已达到86户，约140多人，占全部居民70%以上，已成为凤凰城地区老年华人最多的聚居点。这栋公寓的周围有一座图书馆，一个运动场，旁边就有一个门诊部和医院，门口就是公共汽车站和小商店，生活十分方便。这里的居民团结互助，融乐祥和，就像一个大家庭。今年大家民主選舉了五人組成的居民委員會，由三名華人和一名墨西哥人，一名拉丁美洲的移民組成。每星期一晚的中國電影欣賞，星期三晚的交谊舞会，星期四晚的英语口语班更丰富了老人们的文化生活。
cfe4e56c26e5260d502213d8c79785232b983f55.translatedText: (Written by Liu Guotai) Two ten-story buildings stand at the intersection of south 7th Ave. and Buckeye in Phoenix. These are apartments for the elderly built by the U.S. Department of Housing to realize home ownership. It has been twenty years since the first Chinese moved here in the early 1990s. Today, there are 86 Chinese households here, with more than 140 people, accounting for more than 70% of all residents. It has become the largest concentration of elderly Chinese in the Phoenix area. This apartment is surrounded by a library, a sports field, a clinic and a hospital next to it, and there are bus stops and small shops at the door, making life very convenient. The residents here are united and help each other, living in harmony and harmony, just like a big family. This year we democratically elected a five-member residents committee, composed of three Chinese, one Mexican, and one Latin American immigrant. Chinese movie appreciation on Monday night, social dance on Wednesday night, and English speaking class on Thursday night enrich the cultural life of the elderly.

313ee94dc0506d5235baea70bf9dd6525a2ff8b5.sourceText: 十一月十七日，楼内居民欢聚在一起，共进感恩节大餐。这是大厦居民委員会组织的一次感恩节聚餐会。纪念大厦办公室的經理和工作人员也与义工们一起布置大厅。居委会钱主任与居委会成员热情地为参加者服务。他们把火鸡肉.面包及饮料等分发给大家，尤其是那些残疾人。参加聚会的大约有七.八十人，有来自中国的移民，有来自欧洲.非洲及拉丁美洲等地的移民，还有在美国本土出生的人。他们八仙过海,各显其能，做了好多拿手好菜让大家品尝。这里有中国菜系的红烧排骨.辣子鸡丁.木耳肉片.红烧百页结等。也有西方菜系的意大利面，蔬菜沙拉以及各种甜点。大家在组织者的带领下，手拉手，肩并肩唱起欢乐的歌，为美好的生活祈祷.祝福。大厅里装饰树上的纸带表达了人们的祝福，字里行间诚挚的表达了自己的心愿。感谢神的保佑；感谢美国政府给老人们创造的美好的生活环境；感谢家人及亲朋好友的亲切关爱。
313ee94dc0506d5235baea70bf9dd6525a2ff8b5.translatedText: On November 17, the residents in the building gathered together for a Thanksgiving dinner. This is a Thanksgiving dinner organized by the building residents committee. Managers and staff from the Memorial Building office also worked with volunteers to decorate the lobby. Director Qian of the neighborhood committee and members of the neighborhood committee enthusiastically served the participants. They distributed turkey, bread and drinks to everyone, especially those with disabilities. There were about 70 to 80 people attending the party, including immigrants from China, immigrants from Europe, Africa and Latin America, as well as people born in the United States. The Eight Immortals crossed the sea, each showed his talents, and cooked many delicious dishes for everyone to taste. Here you can find Chinese-style braised pork ribs, spicy chicken, fungus slices, braised 100-page knots, etc. There are also Western-style pastas, vegetable salads and a variety of desserts. Under the leadership of the organizer, everyone held hands and sang happy songs side by side, praying and blessing for a better life. The paper tapes on the decorative tree in the hall express people's blessings, and their sincere wishes are expressed between the lines. Thank you to God for your blessing; thank you to the U.S. government for creating a beautiful living environment for the elderly; thank you to your family, relatives and friends for their kind care.

e8757c9e6bb6b7064cc585a478aef95e16834182.sourceText: 居民們手拉手象征着团结如一家人
e8757c9e6bb6b7064cc585a478aef95e16834182.translatedText: The residents held hands to symbolize unity as a family

226ec4a36c1d83f70ec70393e98bfea0b4389ee5.sourceText: 十一月十九日，凤城华人基督教会来到纪念大厦举办了隆重的感恩节庆会。康乐大厦.康宁大厦及汉森老人中心的几十位老人也赶来参加。还有一些散居在外的老人们也慕名而来。组织者安排摆放的一百二十张座椅已经坐满了人，可客人们还在陆续赶来，宽敞的大厅一下变得那么狹小。义工们把楼外花园里的十几张长椅全搬进来，可还是有好些人在那站着，有些楼里的住户将自己家里的椅子也搬了来，大家热情地招呼着每一位客人。
226ec4a36c1d83f70ec70393e98bfea0b4389ee5.translatedText: On November 19, the Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church came to the Memorial Building to hold a grand Thanksgiving celebration. Dozens of elderly people from Kang Le Building, Kang Ning Building and Hansen Senior Center also came to participate. There are also some elderly people living abroad who come here to visit. The one hundred and twenty seats arranged by the organizers were already full, but guests were still arriving one after another, and the spacious hall suddenly became so small. The volunteers moved in all the more than a dozen benches in the garden outside the building, but there were still many people standing there. Some residents in the building also moved their own chairs in. Everyone warmly greeted every guest.

c8fcf13459ac2143fb2ff7c0abc2a6ea88a13a25.sourceText: 十点半感恩节庆会开始。首先是基督教会的组织者为大家演唱了”一切歌颂赞美”，”因祂活着”等感谢圣恩的歌。耆英会老人合唱团也以国语及粤语分别为大家演唱歌曲，歌声嘹亮，神采奕奕。陈志刚先生高超和风趣的”变脸”表演使庆会达到高潮。小朋友们也赶来助兴，他们为大家表演舞蹈”掀起你的盖头来”和”吉祥谣”，稚气的表演使老人们开怀大笑，其乐融融。演出在大家欢乐的游戏中结束。
c8fcf13459ac2143fb2ff7c0abc2a6ea88a13a25.translatedText: The Thanksgiving party starts at half past ten. First, the organizers of the Christian church sang "All Praise", "Because He Lives" and other songs to thank the Holy Grace for everyone. The Senior Citizen's Choir also sang songs in Mandarin and Cantonese for everyone. The singing was loud and full of energy. Mr. Chen Zhigang's superb and funny "face-changing" performance brought the celebration to a climax. Children also came to join in the fun. They performed the dance "Lift Your Hijab" and "Auspicious Ballads" for everyone. Their childish performances made the elderly laugh and have fun. The performance ended with everyone having fun playing games.

de88b37d126354731174f94371580ace4d07084e.sourceText: 十二点多开始聚餐。丰盛的菜肴直使人垂涎。教会带来了美味的肉丸和炒菜；曾丽卿为这次聚会置办了叉烧包和盐焗鸡，大家更把聚餐作为自己展现烹饪手艺的舞台。这里不仅有品味俱佳的烤火鸡，而且有中国各地的名菜。如四川的麻婆豆腐与陕北的洋芋擦擦；扬州炒饭与上海的生煎包子；百花酿豆与炒鸡丁；糯米丸子与卤烧肉。更有好多说不出名字的南北佳肴名菜，不同风格的稀饭.甜点。刘鸿钧老先生为大家奉献了俩大桶豆腐脑，还将豆腐渣做成了健康的甜点。大家对他的手艺和热诚赞叹不已。这么多的美味佳肴真使人大快朵颐。
de88b37d126354731174f94371580ace4d07084e.translatedText: The dinner started at around twelve o'clock. The sumptuous dishes are mouth-watering. The church brought delicious meatballs and stir-fried vegetables; Zeng Liqing bought barbecued pork buns and salt-baked chicken for the gathering, and everyone even used the dinner as a stage to show off their cooking skills. Not only are there delicious roast turkeys, but also famous dishes from all over China. For example, Mapo tofu from Sichuan and potato zacha from northern Shaanxi; Yangzhou fried rice and fried steamed buns from Shanghai; Baihua stuffed beans and stir-fried diced chicken; glutinous rice balls and braised pork. There are also many unnamed famous dishes from the North and the South, as well as different styles of porridge and desserts. Mr. Liu Hongjun dedicated two large buckets of tofu porridge to everyone, and also made the tofu pulp into healthy desserts. Everyone marveled at his craftsmanship and enthusiasm. So many delicacies are really a feast for the eyes.

e872856e9aaf3998c3506b0d81a9da7aeca9fa5c.sourceText: 感恩庆会结束了，它给大家带来的欢乐却久久不能平息。老人们依惜告别。再见了，请珍重，让我们下一次再相聚。
e872856e9aaf3998c3506b0d81a9da7aeca9fa5c.translatedText: The Thanksgiving celebration is over, but the joy it brought to everyone cannot subside for a long time. The old people bid farewell with regret. Goodbye, please cherish it and let us meet again next time.

d25131faaf66d7a27f119b8113fa6381b9355575.sourceText: 崔増祁: 云南行（十一）

6f89e27dad8a6cd260cfb9b914e31a11038319f9.sourceText: 崔増祁: 云南行（十一） 凤凰城 崔増祁 云南石林已被联合国授予”世界文化遗产”的…
6f89e27dad8a6cd260cfb9b914e31a11038319f9.translatedText: Cui Xiangqi: Trip to Yunnan (11th) Phoenix City Cui Xiangqi Yunnan Stone Forest has been awarded the "World Cultural Heritage" by the United Nations...

5b95e38dc07c62b20a017d6f26f15a6d296f2dab.sourceText: 云南石林已被联合国授予”世界文化遗产”的称号，这里奇峰异石林立，令人目不暇接。中国政府对这里的管理也作得很好，游客众多却井井有秩，在我游历过的中国的景点中，这里的游览环境是最舒适的，达到了世界级水平。还有，对七十五岁以上老人一律免费（成人票价人民币l75元），在老人免费乘车和免费游公园方面，中国确实做得比美国好。
5b95e38dc07c62b20a017d6f26f15a6d296f2dab.translatedText: The Yunnan Stone Forest has been awarded the title of "World Cultural Heritage" by the United Nations. There are many strange peaks and rocks here, which is dizzying. The Chinese government has also done a good job in managing this place. There are many tourists but everything is well organized. Among the scenic spots in China that I have visited, the tourist environment here is the most comfortable and has reached a world-class level. Also, it is free for seniors over 75 years old (adult ticket price is RMB 175). China has indeed done better than the United States in terms of free rides and free park visits for seniors.

c17101378d6dad396e59c23da772180115807b69.sourceText: 我这次回访石林，主要是寻找历史的足迹。抗战时期，我们住在明良煤矿的时矦，父亲曾利用一次长假帯着我来过石林，并留下了全家的合影。这次我帯着当年的照片来找原来照相的地方。七十年过去了，物转星移，政权交替，一代代人的逝去，但石林仍保持其原貌，我自岿然不动，这就是大自然的伟大之处。沿着峋石林立、异峰突起的崎岖小道，在千万块长相各异的石林中要寻找一块与旧照片上相同的石头真不是件容易的事情，就像在大兴安岭的丛林中寻找一颗特定的红杉，也像在北京王府井节日的闹市中寻找一亇迷失的孩子。我仔细地观察每一处石林的地形地貌，然后再细细地观赏它的长相，我请穿着民族服装的导𨔼指奌，在每个景奌前后左右地仔细观量，一群青年学生兴致勃勃地拿起照片参加到”探宝”的队伍里，邦助我一块石头一块石头地对照，他们虽然没有找到，却髙兴地要和我合影，嘱咐我一定要把新旧照片一起放在网上。我给他们诉说起抗日战争时期的生活，对于在和平年代幸福生活中成长的他们来说，这七十年前的往事就是一部新奇的历史故事。突然，当地一位摄像师看了照片，若有所思地说，也许就在”剑池”？这指点迷津的一句话，使我眼前突然一亮。我怎么就没有想到父亲来此一𣸯，必然找一亇着名景点留影，剑池是石林着名景点之一，而且背景中似有水池。真是山穷水尽疑无路，枊暗花明又一村，我终于在皓瀚的石林中找到了当年照片上的那些石头，他们仍像一头巨兽张着大嘴在呐喊，髙呼着”起来，不愿做奴隶的人们”，唤起民众的觉醒，激发出抗日爱国的热情，它呼焕着中国人民为自由、平等、博爱的理想奋斗。一位外国逰客参照旧照为我摄下了新影
c17101378d6dad396e59c23da772180115807b69.translatedText: My return visit to Stone Forest this time was mainly to look for traces of history. During the Anti-Japanese War, when we lived in Mingliang Coal Mine, my father took me to Stone Forest during a long vacation and took a group photo of the whole family. This time I took the photos from that year and went to the original place where I took them. Seventy years have passed, things have changed, political power has changed, and generations have passed, but the stone forest still maintains its original appearance, and I remain unmoved. This is the greatness of nature. Along the rugged path with numerous rocks and protruding peaks, it is not easy to find a stone that is the same as the one in the old photos among thousands of stone forests with different shapes. It is like looking for a specific redwood in the jungle of Daxinganling Mountains, or looking for a lost child in the bustling Wangfujing Festival in Beijing. I carefully observed the topography of each stone forest, and then looked at its appearance. I asked a guide wearing national costumes to look around each scene carefully. A group of young students enthusiastically picked up photos and joined the "treasure hunt" team. They helped me compare stone by stone. Although they didn't find it, they happily wanted to take a photo with me and asked me to put the old and new photos online together. I told them about my life during the Anti-Japanese War. For them who grew up in a happy life in peaceful times, the past seventy years ago was a novel historical story. Suddenly, a local photographer looked at the photo and said thoughtfully, maybe it is in "Jianchi"? This instructive sentence made my eyes suddenly light up. Why didn't I think that when my father came here, he would definitely find a famous scenic spot to take photos. Jianchi is one of the famous scenic spots in the Stone Forest, and there seems to be a pool in the background. There was really no way out, and there was only one village after another. I finally found the stones in the photo in the vast stone forest. They were still shouting like a giant beast with its mouth open, shouting "Rise up, people who don't want to be slaves", arousing the people's awakening and stimulating anti-Japanese patriotic enthusiasm. It inspired the Chinese people to fight for the ideals of freedom, equality, and fraternity. A foreign tourist took a new photo of me based on old photos

7c70c46caf3b737afaaab6b257832b6b6f6b5574.translatedText: I returned to Stone Forest in 2012

dbdab0b6231950b946c19805990df2e0dd82825d.sourceText: 七十年前父母亲帯我游石林
dbdab0b6231950b946c19805990df2e0dd82825d.translatedText: My parents took me to visit Stone Forest seventy years ago

ad0ed41fdc9499c42c6ca9d9c54da97efee7c495.sourceText: 照片上那个儿童已变成鹤髮老人，世道变迁、人生百态，引来了无穷的回忆。我也回忆起父母亲对我的养育和关爱，在他们生命中的每一刻，分分秒秒都在关注着我，直至生命的最后一刻。我感受到我的父母亲在九泉之下还继续在护佑着我….他们最心爱的宝贝儿子。
ad0ed41fdc9499c42c6ca9d9c54da97efee7c495.translatedText: The child in the photo has become a gray-haired old man. The changes in the world and the various aspects of life have brought endless memories. I also recalled the nurturing and love my parents gave me. They paid attention to me every moment of their lives until the last moment of their lives. I feel that my parents are still protecting me...their most beloved son.

d8a1daaa53b3aadf32b5cd907c68f402b2f8d35c.sourceText: 离开了石林，来到宜良小街的一间烧鸭店午歺，这个小镇叫狗街。狗街的烧鸭在云南首屈一指，相传清光绪年间一学子进京赶考，宿米市胡同，其随从在北京”便宜坊”学得一手焖炉烧鸭技术，回滇后开设烧鸭店，深受当地食客喜爱。滇趆铁路修䢖时期，法国工程师们常光顾小店，对烧鸭赞不绝口。抗战时任云南省政府主席的龙云先生还专门赐匾”京都烧鸭”以彰其业蹟，于是该店声名大振。云南各地民众坐火车来解馋的络绎不绝，我记得儿时也随父母亲来品嚐过，那是战时困难环境中的一份了不起的时尚，。今天重新来到这里，听到狗街烤鸭仍觉得倍感亲切。烧鸭师傅己是第四代传人了，手艺仍十分精湛，一隻烧鸭只卖38元人民币，不到五美元，在美国鳯凰城是十八美元，北京全聚德还要贵，一百八十块人民币。据说狗街的狗喜欢赶着鸭子跑，所以狗街的鸭子肉质特别有”筋道”。
d8a1daaa53b3aadf32b5cd907c68f402b2f8d35c.translatedText: Leaved the Stone Forest and had lunch at a duck restaurant in Yiliang Street, a small town called Dog Street. Dog Street's roast duck is the best in Yunnan. According to legend, during the Guangxu period of the Qing Dynasty, a student went to Beijing to take the exam in Sumi City Hutong. His entourage learned the skill of roasting duck in a stew oven at the "Bianyi Fang" in Beijing. After returning to Yunnan, he opened a roast duck restaurant, which was deeply loved by local diners. During the construction of the Yunnan-Baiji Railway, French engineers often visited the shop and praised the roasted duck. Mr. Long Yun, who was the chairman of the Yunnan Provincial Government during the Anti-Japanese War, even gave a plaque "Kyoto Roast Duck" to commemorate his business achievements, and the store became famous. There is an endless stream of people from all over Yunnan taking trains to satisfy their cravings. I remember tasting it with my parents when I was a child. It was a great fashion in the difficult environment of wartime. I came here again today, and I still feel very warm when I hear about Dog Street Roast Duck. The roast duck master is the fourth generation, and his craftsmanship is still very exquisite. A roast duck only sells for 38 yuan, less than five dollars. In the United States, it is eighteen dollars in Phoenix City, and it is even more expensive in Quanjude, Beijing, at one hundred and eighty yuan. It is said that the dogs in Dog Street like to chase ducks, so the duck meat in Dog Street is particularly chewy.

a26de5f98c67a30841914f7a9c924986408ff230.sourceText: 髦髭之年，访旧地，忆往年童趣，是人生一大乐事。但人生不能总是停留在美好的回忆中。结束了三天寻根之旅，依依不捨地登上了飞往北京的航班。再见了云南！再见了昆明！再见了宰格村！如果上帝还给我再一次机会的话，五年后再来看望你们。
a26de5f98c67a30841914f7a9c924986408ff230.translatedText: In the year of the fashionable mustache, visiting old places and reminiscing about the childhood fun of the past is one of the great pleasures in life. But life can't always stay in beautiful memories. After a three-day trip to find my roots, I reluctantly boarded the flight to Beijing. Goodbye Yunnan! Goodbye Kunming! Goodbye Zaig Village! If God gives me another chance, I will come visit you again in five years.

9ff2aa2f07455e18a1021b037ce8b4cc32e0d664.sourceText: 华盛顿-波士顿沿途GDP也差不多占到全美1/3。这条高速路两侧蓝天碧草，地广人稀，漂亮大气的Single House(独栋别墅)如映画中，美轮美奂。而令人诧异的是，其中有不少别墅售价仅30-40万美元，只相当于人民币200-300万元，几乎不够在国内一线城市买套公寓房！华文报纸形容美国房市甚至用了”溃决”字眼。如《拥自宅率降幅80年来最大》、《信贷收紧就业无望粉碎美国梦，房屋拥有率过去10年大滑坡》，就分别是10月7日《世界日报》与《星岛日报》的某个版面头条标题，文中提到，由于年轻人买不起房，美国近十年间家庭拥有自己房子的比例，从上个十年的66.2%降到65.1%，创1929年来最大降幅。
9ff2aa2f07455e18a1021b037ce8b4cc32e0d664.translatedText: The GDP along the Washington-Boston route accounts for almost 1/3 of the United States. This highway is surrounded by blue sky and green grass on both sides, with a vast area and sparsely populated areas. The beautiful and majestic Single Houses are as beautiful as in the pictures. What is surprising is that many of the villas are priced at only US$300,000-400,000, which is equivalent to only RMB 2-3 million, which is barely enough to buy an apartment in a first-tier domestic city! Chinese-language newspapers even used the word "collapse" to describe the U.S. housing market. For example, "The homeownership rate has fallen the most in 80 years" and "Credit tightening on employment is unlikely to crush the American dream, and the home ownership rate has plummeted in the past decade." were headlines on a page of World Journal and Sing Tao Daily on October 7 respectively. The article mentioned that because young people cannot afford to buy a house, the proportion of households in the United States who own their own homes has dropped from 66.2% in the last decade to 65.1% in the past decade, the largest decline since 1929.

9570fe949a0dd055663d690144f97ae7256266d5.sourceText: 近两年咨询买房的北京、上海人正在增多，而且90%以上是为了孩子留学考虑，家庭结构多为”丈夫工作+全职太太”模式。对这部分人群而言，现在的确到了”卖中国房，买美国房”的好时机棗以房价是普通百姓家庭年收入8倍为最合适来算的话，则美国差不多已如此，而中国一线城市则远超过这一水平。他建议，如果中国人真想在美购房投资，不妨选择大学附近，这样可以租给学生，比如在华盛顿特区附近马里兰州的马里兰大学附近，一套包括3-4个卧房的二手房售价现在只有25-30万美元，租金大概3000美元一月。目前这种方式已有中国人在实践。
9570fe949a0dd055663d690144f97ae7256266d5.translatedText: In the past two years, the number of people from Beijing and Shanghai who are inquiring about buying a house has increased, and more than 90% of them are considering studying abroad for their children. The family structure is mostly a "husband works + full-time wife" model. For this group of people, it is indeed a good time to "sell Chinese houses and buy American houses". If the most suitable calculation is that house prices are 8 times the annual income of ordinary people's families, the United States is almost the same, while China's first-tier cities far exceed this level. He suggested that if Chinese people really want to buy and invest in houses in the United States, they might as well choose a place near a university so that they can be rented to students. For example, near the University of Maryland in Maryland, near Washington, D.C., a second-hand house with 3-4 bedrooms currently sells for only $250,000-300,000, and the rent is about $3,000 a month. This method is currently being practiced by the Chinese.

42700222b8cfad3ec40169374303e321a19176e6.sourceText: 美国规定贷款利息可以冲抵个人收入免税。比如年收入10万美元，2万美元付房屋贷款，则只需按8万交个人所得税。且现在贷款年利率较低， 30年房贷年利率仅为3.875%，扣除每年大约1.5%的房产税，总体还是很合算。
42700222b8cfad3ec40169374303e321a19176e6.translatedText: The United States stipulates that loan interest can be offset against personal income tax-free. For example, if your annual income is US$100,000 and your mortgage payment is US$20,000, you only need to pay personal income tax of US$80,000. And now the annual interest rate of loans is low. The annual interest rate of a 30-year mortgage is only 3.875%. After deducting the annual property tax of about 1.5%, it is generally very cost-effective.

37ffe6333a42685583fd7d4aee3f8bd6ab85586d.sourceText: 纳税须知 持有海外帐户 报税须填写 美国居民若前一年海外所有帐户金额加起来超过1万美元，纳税人来年6月底前须利用TDF90-22.1表申报，虽经会计师协会宣导，仍有纳税人一知半解未予申报。会计师说，今年法院的两项判决，以及1040税表上Schedule B增加一项提问，已使纳税人即使海外所有帐户金额未达1万美元，但只要有海外帐户，一样须诚实填写。 如果蓄意申报没有海外帐户，并在税表上签名，日后被国税局发现其实拥有符合申报要求的海外帐户，将使纳税人面临最高达60万元罚款。 1040税表上填写利息、股息的Schedule B，过去有一栏会询问纳税人是否在海外拥有金融帐户，及是否有签名权利，但附加的「指示」会说，如果纳税人前一年海外所有金融帐户金额加起来不超过1万元，可以回答没有。但新增加的提问，第一个问题是「你有无海外帐户？」非常直接，意味纳税人即使海外帐户只有几百美元，一样要诚实回答。 而只有在回答「有」后，才须回答第二个问题，即过去​​原有的提问，即纳税人只有去年海外所有帐户总额超过1万元，才须使用TDF90-22.1表申报海外帐户。 新增提问让纳税人无法再打迷糊仗，一旦在被国税局稽查员问话时，不能以搞不清楚问题做辩护。而今年7月联邦第四巡回上诉法院针对United States vs.Williams案，及11月犹他地区法院针对United States vs.McBride案，都显示纳税人在Schedule B表填写没有海外帐户并签名后，事后如被发现拥有海外帐户时，都难逃是「蓄意不报」罪名，法官允许国税局施加罚款。 目前国税局查帐时，一定不会忘掉询问「你有没有海外帐户」、「加起来有没有超过1万元」，因此协会一再宣导纳税人要做好税务规画，在合法范围下节税。 该法追溯自1970年代，当时国会针对贩毒洗钱者通过FBAR条款，规定只要纳税人前一年在海外所有帐户金额加起来超过1万元。换句话说，即使是将钱分散在台​​湾、中国大陆等地银行帐户，只要总额逾1万元，都构成申报条件。 「财务犯罪执行网路」（Financial Crime Enforcement Network）并订定蓄意未申报海外帐户的严格罚款，即每年罚款至少10万元或帐户金额一半，且可追溯过去六年，即最高可罚款60万元。
37ffe6333a42685583fd7d4aee3f8bd6ab85586d.translatedText: > Tax Instructions Holding overseas accounts, the tax return must be filled in If the total amount of all overseas accounts of U.S. residents in the previous year exceeds US$10,000, taxpayers must use Form TDF90-22.1 to declare before the end of June of the next year. Despite the publicity from the Institute of Accountants, there are still taxpayers who are ignorant and fail to declare. Accountants said that this year's two court decisions and the addition of a question to Schedule B on the 1040 tax form have forced taxpayers to fill in the form honestly even if the amount of all overseas accounts does not exceed US$10,000, as long as they have overseas accounts. If you deliberately declare that you do not have an overseas account and sign the tax form, and are later discovered by the IRS that you actually have an overseas account that meets the reporting requirements, the taxpayer will face a fine of up to 600,000 yuan. Schedule B for filling out interest and dividends on the 1040 tax form. In the past, there was a column that asked the taxpayer whether he had financial accounts overseas and whether he had the right to sign. However, the additional "instructions" said that if the total amount of all overseas financial accounts of the taxpayer in the previous year did not exceed 10,000 yuan, he could answer no. But among the newly added questions, the first question is "Do you have an overseas account?" It is very direct, which means that taxpayers must answer honestly even if their overseas account only has a few hundred dollars. Only after you answer "yes", you need to answer the second question, which is the original question in the past. That is, taxpayers must use Form TDF90-22.1 to declare overseas accounts only if the total amount of all overseas accounts exceeded 10,000 yuan last year. The new questions allow taxpayers to no longer be confused. Once questioned by an IRS auditor, taxpayers cannot plead ignorance as a defense. The Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals case of United States vs. Williams in July this year and the United States vs. McBride case in the Utah District Court in November both showed that after a taxpayer fills in the Schedule B form and signs it and signs it, and later is found to have an overseas account, it will be a crime of "deliberate failure to report." The judge allowed the IRS to impose a penalty. At present, when the Internal Revenue Service audits accounts, they will never forget to ask "Do you have an overseas account?" and "Does the total exceed 10,000 yuan?" Therefore, the association has repeatedly promoted taxpayers to make good tax planning and save taxes within the legal scope. The law dates back to the 1970s, when Congress passed FBAR provisions to target drug traffickers and money launderers, stipulating that as long as the sum of all taxpayers' overseas accounts in the previous year exceeds $10,000, the law is subject to FBAR. In other words, even if the money is dispersed in bank accounts in Taiwan, Mainland China and other places, as long as the total amount exceeds 10,000 yuan, it constitutes a declaration condition. The "Financial Crime Enforcement Network" has also set strict fines for deliberately failing to declare overseas accounts, that is, a fine of at least NT$100,000 or half of the account value per year, and can be traced back to the past six years, that is, a maximum fine of NT$600,000.

088989d6194bcf10711cf72250a7dd0add59b9d0.sourceText: 中国留学生被打后续：明目张胆的种族歧视必须严加谴责 凤凰城华人福利会主席 张肇鸿 亚利桑纳州立大学的本科生，中国女学生石晓琳(Xiaolin Shi，音译) ，5月20日在Tempe市轻铁列车上，因为说中文，而遭到白人妇女凯莉．拉特莱奇(Kalie Rutledge) 的恶性谩骂：”你们是溷蛋，你们滚回中国去”。她还对石晓琳紧追不捨，把她打到血流满脸，石晓琳的朋友也遭到攻击。拉特莱奇在当晚即被警方逮捕，被控严重攻击，被关进马里科帕郡监狱，在5月31日需再度出庭。此桉件已引起华人侨界、留学生、旅美学者、华商以及华文媒体的公愤，共同呼吁美国司法部门要严惩肇事者，并给予受害者和家属以及社会一个公正的交代。 凤凰城华人福利会把消息分传送到不同的群体中后，有亚特兰大的侨领Betty在回覆告知：同样是在5月20日，美国乔治亚州的Gwinnett 郡政府，联合了法院，消防单位，警察局，人口调查局，学校，还有医院等单位，针对LEP (limited English proficiency，英文能力有限者）的语言使用，举办了全美第一次的讨论会。 根据民权法桉第六条（title vi of civil rights act of 1964) 法律，人民全体，包括合法以及不合法居民，一律平等，这里包函了语言的使用。众议员Padrol Marin提到自2006年起就有English only，（如只能用英文考驾照）的提桉，今年第五次被亚裔与拉丁裔联手所否决。 在Gwinnett 郡，除英语外，民众使用的语言高达146种，lep的比例很高。在magistrate地方法院的刑事诉讼民事法中，如房东/房客，家暴，低于$1500商业桉件等等，法官给大家看四种语文的译件，但这四种语文均不包括中文，不知道是否华人英文能力特强而不需要，或是不去争取？以前最需要翻译人员的是韩文，如今是越文。 这些事实告诉我们： 一、华人华侨在美国说中文并不违法。 二、打人者才是真正的溷蛋，必须受到法律的严厉制裁。 三、如此明目张胆地使用种族歧视语言和肢体暴力发生在当今美国社会，我们必须要严加谴责。对华人的偏见与歧视，不只出现在亚利桑那州或是乔治亚州，在全美不同的地方都曾发生过，需警钟长鸣，坚持不懈地反对。 四这类桉件不会只发生在中国留学生身上，同样也会发生在每一位华人华侨的身上。所以我们一定要团结起来，向社会、政界和司法界发音，要保障自身的权益，严防这类事件再度发生。 历史告诉我们， 美国排华运动早期只是零星的暴民式的攻击、劫掠与谋杀，后来演变成为有组织的、制度性的、由官方推行的全面性行动。排华的主要份子，也由原先只局限于工人阶级而扩展到议会与市府，政客为了争取工人选票，乃牺牲华人利益以取宠，这整个行动背后的动力，就是种族歧视。所以从1882年起，实施了六十三年的排华恶法。为何华人对种族歧视如此的深恶痛绝和坚决的反对？就是因为华人受其种族歧视祸害最深和时间最长的族裔之一。但如果当年数十万中国人真的是被赶出美国，那麽金矿谁来开採？铁路如何修成？农田水库矿山由谁去开拓建造？美国的繁华又将被推迟多少年？ 2011年10月6日美国参议院通过向排华立法正式致歉，2014年5月9日，美国劳工部长裴瑞兹指出：”华裔工人不仅建了铁路，他们还协助建设美国。” 美国国会从修订排华法桉到废除，再到表示道歉，继而肯定华人对美国社会的贡献，其中除了美国政府的态度转变外，华人自身的争取也是极其重要的力量。 如今的美国，排外有了死灰复燃的趋向，亚利桑那州是第一个提出反对非法移民政策的州，乔治亚州也随之跟进。如今这两个州的建商要找劳力工人都难！餐馆行业也深有同感，现在没有高薪难请到一个厨房帮工。政府总是说非法移民抢走美国人饭碗，其实正如同百年前修铁路一样，苦力劳工只能远隔重洋去找中国人做！而今的房屋建筑、餐馆行业、户外作业等长时间、重体力的工作，很多美国人宁愿去领救济也不愿干！很多粗活脏活还不是靠新移民去扛？如果排外政策在美国延续，民间对移民和少数族裔的偏见和排挤将会增加，针对移民和少数族裔的歧视也会加剧，这些事态需要我们华人去持续关注。 凤凰城华人福利会长期以来反对种族歧视，争取平等权利。1975年，时任华人福利会主席的余文劲先生，就因纽约华裔工程师泊车被警察无理殴打，引发2万华人的示威游行，发表过《团结就是力量》的文章，引起广泛的影响。华人福利会将继往开来，为争取华人的公平正义和维护权益而作不懈的努力。
088989d6194bcf10711cf72250a7dd0add59b9d0.translatedText: Follow-up to the beating of a Chinese international student: blatant racial discrimination must be severely condemned Zhang Zhaohong, Chairman of the Phoenix Chinese Welfare Association Xiaolin Shi, a Chinese female student who is an undergraduate at Arizona State University, was assaulted by a white woman, Kelly, on a Tempe light rail train on May 20 because she spoke Chinese. Kalie Rutledge’s vicious abuse: “You are idiots, go back to China.” She also chased Shi Xiaolin and beat her until her face was bloody. Shi Xiaolin's friends were also attacked. Rutledge was arrested by the police that night and charged with aggravated assault. He was booked into the Maricopa County Jail and will appear in court again on May 31. This case has aroused public outrage among the Chinese community, overseas students, scholars in the United States, Chinese businessmen, and Chinese media. They have jointly called on the U.S. judicial department to severely punish the perpetrators and give a fair explanation to the victims, their families, and society. After the Phoenix Chinese Welfare Association distributed the message to different groups, Betty, an overseas Chinese leader in Atlanta, responded and informed: Also on May 20, the Gwinnett County Government in Georgia, USA, united the courts, fire units, police stations, census bureaus, schools, hospitals and other units to hold the first seminar in the United States on the language use of LEP (limited English proficiency). According to Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, all people, including legal and illegal residents, are equal, which includes the use of language. Rep. Padrol Marin mentioned that the English only proposal has been around since 2006. This proposal was rejected for the fifth time this year by Asians and Latinos. In Gwinnett County, there are 146 languages ​​spoken by the people in addition to English, and the proportion of LEP is very high. In the criminal proceedings and civil law of the Magistrate District Court, such as landlord/tenant, domestic violence, commercial cases less than $1500, etc., the judge showed everyone translations in four languages, but these four languages ​​do not include Chinese. I wonder if the Chinese have strong English skills and do not need it, or do not strive for it? In the past, the language that needed translators most was Korean, but now it is Vietnamese. These facts tell us: 1. It is not illegal for overseas Chinese to speak Chinese in the United States. 2. Those who beat others are the real bastards and must be severely punished by law. 3. Such blatant use of racially discriminatory language and physical violence occurs in today’s American society, and we must severely condemn it. Prejudice and discrimination against the Chinese have not only occurred in Arizona or Georgia, but have occurred in different places across the United States. We need to sound the alarm and persist in opposition. 4. Such incidents will not only happen to Chinese students studying abroad, but will also happen to every overseas Chinese. Therefore, we must unite and speak out to society, politics and the judiciary to protect our own rights and interests and prevent such incidents from happening again. History tells us that in the early days of the anti-Chinese movement in the United States, there were only sporadic mob-style attacks, robberies, and murders. Later, it evolved into an organized, institutional, and comprehensive action promoted by the government. The main anti-Chinese elements were originally limited to the working class and expanded to the parliament and city government. In order to win workers' votes, politicians sacrificed the interests of the Chinese to gain favor. The driving force behind this entire action was racial discrimination. Therefore, starting from 1882, the evil Chinese Exclusion Law was implemented for sixty-three years. Why do Chinese people hate and firmly oppose racial discrimination? It is because the Chinese are one of the ethnic groups that have suffered the most and for the longest time from racial discrimination. But if hundreds of thousands of Chinese were really driven out of the United States, who would mine the gold? How was the railway built? Who will develop and build farmland, reservoirs and mines? How many more years will America's prosperity be delayed? On October 6, 2011, the U.S. Senate passed a formal apology for the Chinese exclusion legislation. On May 9, 2014, U.S. Secretary of Labor Perez pointed out: "Chinese workers not only built the railroad, they also helped build the United States." The U.S. Congress went from revising the Chinese exclusion law to repealing it, and then apologized, and then affirmed the contribution of the Chinese to American society. In addition to the change in the attitude of the U.S. government, the struggle of the Chinese themselves is also an extremely important force. Today in the United States, there is a resurgence of xenophobia. Arizona was the first state to propose policies against illegal immigration, and Georgia followed suit. It is now difficult for builders in these two states to find laborers! The restaurant industry also feels the same way. It is now difficult to hire a kitchen helper without a high salary. The government always says that illegal immigrants take away American jobs. In fact, just like building railroads a hundred years ago, coolie laborers can only find Chinese people across the ocean! Today, many Americans would rather receive relief than work in long-term, physically strenuous jobs such as home construction, restaurant industry, and outdoor work! Aren’t new immigrants going to do a lot of the menial and dirty work? If xenophobic policies continue in the United States, public prejudice and exclusion against immigrants and ethnic minorities will increase, and discrimination against immigrants and ethnic minorities will also intensify. These situations require our Chinese to continue to pay attention. The Phoenix Chinese Welfare Association has long opposed racial discrimination and fought for equal rights. In 1975, Mr. Yu Wenjin, then chairman of the Chinese Welfare Association, was unreasonably beaten by the police because a Chinese engineer in New York was parking his car, which triggered a demonstration by 20,000 Chinese people. He published an article "Unity is Strength", which caused widespread influence. The Chinese Welfare Association will carry forward the past and make unremitting efforts to strive for fairness and justice and safeguard the rights and interests of the Chinese people.

017a26172c2b69f51ce4993333aaddd01840a5fe.sourceText: 亲爱的同学们、家长们、老师们和朋友们 两个月前，新冠肺炎病毒的爆发，我们为国内的疫情忧心如焚，纷纷伸出了援助之手。亚省现代中文学校也积极和本地多个华人团体合作，贡献自己的一份爱心，为我们的亲人朋友和战斗在抗疫前线的医护人员贡献一点力量。 如今，美国疫情情势严峻，各种医疗物资匮乏，燃眉之急亟待解决！ 亚利桑那州立大学是我们长期紧密合作的伙伴，为我们学校的成立和发展提供了慷慨的支持和帮助。ASU因疫情停课后，依旧有一部分教职工坚守岗位，维持学校网课教学和社区服务，特别是ASU Biodesign的教职工承担了新冠肺炎病毒检测繁重危险的任务，他们都更面临医用防护用品紧缺的问题。经过与ASU沟通协调，我们计划为ASU不能离开工作岗位，坚持工作人员捐献医疗防护物资。 在此，向各位同学、家长和老师和朋友们发起倡议，希望大家一起行动起来，为在这场疫情中，ASU及ASU相关医疗单位直面危险的的工作人员捐款。 与病魔赛跑，时间就是生命，学校决定购买与捐款同步进行，并且已经预先筹集了10000个医疗口罩，价值4700美金，力求以最快的速度让大家的善款善行落到实处。捐款不论多少，量力而行，完全自愿，希望大家积极行动起来，积少成多，聚沙成塔，伸出援助之手，一起渡过难关。同时，学校募筹组也会继续积极寻找其他物资来源，在收到更多的捐款时会持续的捐助。 我们将按法律和有关规定，捐助款项秉承公开透明的原则，每一分钱都毫无保留地用于ASU抗疫物资购买。 捐款方式请点击: https://charity.gofundme.com/o/en/campaign/fundraising-to-help-asu-fight-covid-19 这场灾难，必将记在历史里，刻骨铭心，每个人都困在原地，用力的活着。于暗夜中为作光明，愿我们都能做黑暗里的一点点小小萤光，慢慢的聚在一起，如火炬，如太阳。。 感谢各位同学、家长、老师和朋友的大力支持和爱心捐赠。 亚省现代中文学校
017a26172c2b69f51ce4993333aaddd01840a5fe.translatedText: Dear students, parents, teachers and friends Two months ago, when the COVID-19 virus broke out, we were worried about the domestic epidemic and extended a helping hand. The Alberta Modern Chinese School is also actively cooperating with many local Chinese groups to contribute its share of love to our relatives and friends and the medical staff fighting on the front lines of the fight against the epidemic. Today, the epidemic situation in the United States is severe and various medical supplies are scarce. The urgent need needs to be solved urgently! Arizona State University is a long-term and close partner of ours and has provided generous support and assistance to the founding and development of our school. After ASU suspended classes due to the epidemic, some faculty and staff still stayed at their posts to maintain the school's online teaching and community services. In particular, the faculty and staff of ASU Biodesign took on the heavy and dangerous task of testing for the new coronavirus, and they all faced the problem of a shortage of medical protective equipment. After communicating and coordinating with ASU, we plan to donate medical protective materials to ASU staff who cannot leave their jobs. Here, I would like to initiate an initiative to all students, parents, teachers and friends, hoping that everyone will take action together and donate to the staff of ASU and ASU-related medical units who are facing danger during this epidemic. In the race against the disease, time is of the essence. The school decided to purchase and donate at the same time, and has already raised 10,000 medical masks in advance, worth 4,700 US dollars, striving to implement everyone's donations as quickly as possible. No matter how much the donation is, it should be done according to one's ability, and it is completely voluntary. I hope everyone can take active actions, accumulate a small amount into a big sum, gather sand into a tower, lend a helping hand, and tide over the difficulties together. At the same time, the school fundraising team will continue to actively look for other sources of supplies and will continue to donate when more donations are received. We will adhere to the principle of openness and transparency in donating funds in accordance with laws and relevant regulations, and every penny will be used for the purchase of anti-epidemic materials for ASU without reservation. To donate, please click: https://charity.gofundme.com/o/en/campaign/fundraising-to-help-asu-fight-covid-19 This disaster will be remembered in history and will be unforgettable. Everyone is trapped in place and trying their best to survive. In order to be the light in the dark night, I hope we can all be little fluorescent lights in the darkness, slowly gathering together, like a torch, like the sun. . Thank you to all classmates, parents, teachers and friends for your strong support and loving donations. Alberta Modern Chinese School

58b5eccf2fa1275e31911110c8700d1fbe97a624.translatedText: The U.S. revoked their visas. Most visitors wanted to sneak into Canada to apply for refugees.

22d2271f6b5f4727094ee36a8f543cfebc7051e0.sourceText: 遭美撤销签证 多数访客欲偷渡加国申请难民 2017年8月6日，难民越过美加边境，进入魁省。 美国当局表示，随着…
22d2271f6b5f4727094ee36a8f543cfebc7051e0.translatedText: The U.S. revoked their visas. Most visitors wanted to sneak into Canada to apply for refugees. On August 6, 2017, refugees crossed the U.S.-Canada border and entered Quebec. U.S. authorities said that as...

420c42f392685823d5255272ed8eaaa24210bf1c.sourceText: 美国当局表示，随着北方守望行动（Operation Northern Watch）的展开，已经撤销了美国签发的数千访客签证，其中的大多数访客计划或已经前往加拿大申请难民，有些与恐怖组织有关联。
420c42f392685823d5255272ed8eaaa24210bf1c.translatedText: U.S. authorities said that with the unfolding of Operation Northern Watch, thousands of visitor visas issued by the United States have been revoked. Most of the visitors plan to or have already gone to Canada to apply for asylum, and some have ties to terrorist organizations.

8a27c09b9a25388bd80641da68d3d75be00dc7cb.sourceText: 依据美国国务部的一份报告，北方守望行动旨在打击美加边境签证欺诈、偷渡和恐怖威胁等犯罪活动，自2015年1月实施以来，美国当局已经撤销了由85个美国驻外使领馆签发的约2,400个访客签证。
8a27c09b9a25388bd80641da68d3d75be00dc7cb.translatedText: According to a report from the U.S. Department of State, Operation Northern Watch aims to combat criminal activities such as visa fraud, smuggling and terrorist threats at the U.S.-Canada border. Since its implementation in January 2015, U.S. authorities have revoked approximately 2,400 visitor visas issued by 85 U.S. embassies and consulates abroad.

f230f3c451c5e215db0d398ded0e85fb3f8e59ae.sourceText: 美国国务部外交安全局（ DSS）的该份年度报告称，在被撤消签证的人中，有些人在美国犯了罪，但通过”北方守望行动”发现，绝大多数被撤消签证者打算或已经到加国申请难民庇护，还有些与恐怖组织有关联。
f230f3c451c5e215db0d398ded0e85fb3f8e59ae.translatedText: The annual report of the U.S. Department of State's Diplomatic Security Service (DSS) stated that some of the people whose visas were revoked had committed crimes in the United States, but through Operation Northern Watch, it was found that the vast majority of those whose visas were revoked planned to or had already applied for refugee asylum in Canada, and some were associated with terrorist organizations.

72a458e1607b48992a60993145e0211d4012c846.sourceText: 美国国务部的一名官员在发给CBC的一封电子邮件中表示，外交安全局不能公布有关恐怖组织以及任何与之有关联嫌疑者的信息。该局也没有公布，被撤销签证的持有者到底有多少已前往加拿大。
72a458e1607b48992a60993145e0211d4012c846.translatedText: A U.S. Department of State official said in an email to CBC that the Bureau of Diplomatic Security cannot release information about terrorist organizations or anyone suspected of being associated with them. The bureau has not announced how many of the revoked visa holders have gone to Canada.

ef0156def5c88668c560cd3794fa0465dd2d7d18.sourceText: 该官员补充道，执法部门透露，一些人承认他们试图或打算在加拿大申请庇护，至于其他人，外交安全局有理由相信他们已计划到加国申请庇护。
ef0156def5c88668c560cd3794fa0465dd2d7d18.translatedText: The official added that law enforcement agencies revealed that some people admitted that they tried or planned to apply for asylum in Canada. As for others, the Diplomatic Security Service had reason to believe that they had planned to apply for asylum in Canada.

0309cf380e3d6f3de40947af81d7299326a73b95.sourceText: 美国外交安全局表示，美国会对每一名入境旅客进行全面安检，但在某些情况下，有人在入境后，不良信息才会浮现。
0309cf380e3d6f3de40947af81d7299326a73b95.translatedText: The U.S. Bureau of Diplomatic Security stated that the United States will conduct comprehensive security checks on every incoming passenger, but in some cases, bad information will only surface after someone enters the country.

11650e319d872f24fc9f6b1fe80f3a879e06bcdb.sourceText: 加拿大公共安全部长古德尔（Ralph Goodale） 10月时曾表示，加拿大官员发现，由美国使领馆签发的某些文件有被滥用的趋势。他说，加拿大已经要求美国追根溯源，检查这些旅行证件的共同特点，以及这些旅行证件持有者为何无意留在美国，只是将这些证件作为工具，入境美国，然后直奔加国。
11650e319d872f24fc9f6b1fe80f3a879e06bcdb.translatedText: Canadian Public Safety Minister Ralph Goodale said in October that Canadian officials had discovered that certain documents issued by the U.S. embassy and consulates had a tendency to be misused. He said that Canada has asked the United States to trace the origins of these travel documents and examine the common characteristics of these travel documents and why the holders of these travel documents had no intention of staying in the United States, but only used these documents as a tool to enter the United States and then go straight to Canada.

a7e2f277b6e245c15a870797a6bb7ca51b100799.sourceText: 若爱真的只是擦肩而过,你是否愿意为我做片刻的停留？也许有一种爱，明知是深爱，却不敢相守。也许有一种爱，明知是煎熬，却乐此不疲。如若真的这样，你情愿让爱就这样擦肩而过吗？ 一直喜欢冰心赠与葛洛的一句话：爱在左，情在右。是啊，左边离心脏最近，所以更要我们用心去爱，当谁也不想失去哪怕一点点左边的爱，一点点右边的情的时候，不小心真的已经擦肩而过了！有多少爱可以重来，又有多少爱可以擦肩而过呢？廊桥遗梦，留下了多少千年的爱恋？谁说蝴蝶飞不过沧海？谁说一场游戏一场梦，谁说思念没有了尽头？ 一直喜欢冰心赠与葛洛的一句话：爱在左，情在右。是啊，左边离心脏最近，所以更要我们用心去爱，当谁也不想失去哪怕一点点左边的爱，一点点右边的情的时候，不小心真的已经擦肩而过了！有多少爱可以重来，又有多少爱可以擦肩而过呢？廊桥遗梦，留下了多少千年的爱恋？谁说蝴蝶飞不过沧海？谁说一场游戏一场梦，谁说思念没有了尽头？ 若爱只是擦肩而过，如同飞机飞过蓝天，其结果仅仅是消逝天际而已。牵手的那一刻，以为紧紧地握住了天荒地老，以为紧紧地握住了永远的幸福！擦肩的那一刻，以为轻轻的相拥着彼此温度，以为轻轻的相拥着彼此的幸福!曾经相约在每年的七夕，托清风捎来你丝丝地祝福，曾经山盟海誓要与你一起漂泊，一起浪迹天涯。一转身，你的背后只是一片飘落的枫叶，随风而起. 也许，我苍白的文字无以诉说对你无休无止的情感与牵挂！不错，人生有许多珍贵与美丽的瞬间，一直珍藏在我们心底最温暖的地方！人生也有许多绮丽的相遇与不捨的分别！踏着那条昔日熟悉的，你曾经走过无数次的小路，风景依然如昨日繁华。 佛说：前世500次的回眸,才换来今生的擦肩而过。不知道前世到底要擦肩而过多少次,才换来彼此的相知相识？也许千千万万次吧！然，有一种情感，虽然刻骨铭心，虽然痛彻心扉，虽然记忆犹新，却只能默默地浅浅的相望！却只能遗憾的擦肩而过！ 曾经的错过，曾经的美丽，即使化为乌有，即使悄悄地遗落在风裡雨裡，也许走过，路过，错过，都是一种人生的经历，也都是人生的一份财富!独自徜徉在浪漫的文字裡,任凉风习习，爱到底如梦千重？抑或如梦万重？悄悄地体会着这份指尖飞舞的快乐，我分明已经感受，这裡面凝结着爱的呼吸，爱的花香，爱的浪漫，爱的不捨！是怎样的一种情怀在感动着你我？是怎样的擦肩而过丝丝拨弄着优美的旋律？又是怎样一种刻骨铭心的爱恋在牵扯着你的心灵？ 爱，也许如风飘来，也会如风飘走！那份依恋，那份执着，那份相思，那份感动！依旧纠缠在一起，陪你走过每一个且喜且忧的日子。其实，人生中真的有太多的等待与守候，也有太多的无奈与沉思！学会一个人静静地享受这份孤独的美丽。慢慢的品读每一个季节给予你的记忆。 眉宇间，透出一丝丝笑靥，嘴角扬起一片片灿烂！岁月蹉跎，我轻轻的仰望着天空，试着寻找那份曾经失落的感动与微笑。昨天和今天的画面，依然那样的清晰！依然那样的铭记!转身，有多少爱，我们可以擦肩而过？
a7e2f277b6e245c15a870797a6bb7ca51b100799.translatedText: If love really just passes by, are you willing to stay for a moment for me? Maybe there is a kind of love that you know you love deeply, but you don’t dare to stay together. Maybe there is a kind of love that you know is torment, but you never get tired of it. If this is really the case, are you willing to let love pass you by like this? I have always liked the words Bing Xin gave to Ge Luo: Love is on the left, love is on the right. Yes, the left side is closest to the heart, so we need to love with all our heart. When no one wants to lose even a little bit of love on the left side and a little bit of affection on the right side, we may have missed it accidentally! How much love can come back, and how much love can pass by? How many thousands of years of love have been left behind by the covered bridge’s legacy? Who says butterflies cannot fly across the sea? Who said a game is a dream, who said longing has no end? I have always liked the words Bing Xin gave to Ge Luo: Love is on the left, love is on the right. Yes, the left side is closest to the heart, so we need to love with all our heart. When no one wants to lose even a little bit of love on the left side and a little bit of affection on the right side, we may have missed it accidentally! How much love can come back, and how much love can pass by? How many thousands of years of love have been left behind by the covered bridge’s legacy? Who says butterflies cannot fly across the sea? Who said a game is a dream, who said longing has no end? If love just passes by, like a plane flying across the blue sky, the result is just that it disappears from the sky. The moment I held hands, I thought I was holding on tightly for eternity, and I thought I was holding on to eternal happiness! The moment we rubbed shoulders, I thought we were embracing each other's warmth, and we were embracing each other's happiness! We once met each other on Chinese Valentine's Day every year, and asked the breeze to bring you your blessings. We once vowed to wander with you and wander the world together. When you turn around, there is just a falling maple leaf behind you, rising in the wind. Perhaps, my pale words cannot express my endless emotions and concerns for you! Yes, there are many precious and beautiful moments in life, which are always treasured in the warmest place in our hearts! There are also many beautiful encounters and reluctant partings in life! Walking on that familiar path that you have walked countless times before, the scenery is still as prosperous as yesterday. Buddha said: Looking back 500 times in the past life is the only way to pass it by in this life. I wonder how many times we passed each other in the previous life before we got to know each other? Maybe thousands of times! However, there is a kind of emotion that is unforgettable, painful, and fresh in the memory, but we can only look at each other in silence! But I can only pass it by with regret! The past misses, the past beauty, even if they are reduced to nothing, even if they are quietly left in the wind and rain, maybe they have passed by, passed by, or missed, it is a life experience and a wealth of life! Wandering alone in the romantic words, letting the cool breeze blow, love is like a thousand dreams? Or is it like a dream? Quietly experiencing the joy of flying on my fingertips, I have clearly felt that it contains the breath of love, the fragrance of love, the romance of love, and the reluctance of love! What kind of feelings are touching you and me? What kind of passing by is playing a beautiful melody? What kind of unforgettable love is tugging at your heart? Love may come and go like the wind! That attachment, that persistence, that lovesickness, that touch! We are still entangled together and accompany you through every day of joy and sorrow. In fact, there is really too much waiting and waiting in life, as well as too much helplessness and contemplation! Learn to enjoy the beauty of loneliness quietly by yourself. Slowly read the memories each season gives you. Between the brows, there was a hint of smile, and the corners of the mouth were brightly raised! As time goes by, I gently look up at the sky, trying to find the touch and smile that I once lost. The pictures from yesterday and today are still so clear! Still remember it like that! Turn around, how much love can we pass by?

264a343cca266cf923b80db36d13eb1e994cc03f.sourceText: 钱德勒五辆车连环相撞，一人重伤，四人轻伤
264a343cca266cf923b80db36d13eb1e994cc03f.translatedText: One person was seriously injured and four people were slightly injured in a five-vehicle pile-up in Chandler

10868c7c37f2d822708992119dbd5a4a8979082c.sourceText: 钱德勒五辆车连环相撞，一人重伤，四人轻伤 Arizona Department of Transportati…
10868c7c37f2d822708992119dbd5a4a8979082c.translatedText: A five-car pile-up in Chandler left one person seriously injured and four people slightly injured. Arizona Department of Transportati...

d3872f5d4d89a76a4178fe632d6221b03cf53cfb.sourceText: 据官员介绍，在钱德勒的亚利桑那大道和环路202发生了的五车碰撞得重大交通事故，导致一人受重伤。钱德勒消防局说，其他四人在碰撞事故中遭受轻伤。
d3872f5d4d89a76a4178fe632d6221b03cf53cfb.translatedText: According to officials, a major traffic accident involving five vehicles occurred at Arizona Avenue and Loop 202 in Chandler, resulting in one person being seriously injured. The Chandler Fire Department said four other people suffered minor injuries in the collision.

e54d41329156dc179ccf5def2bddd71c389015d1.sourceText: 亚利桑那大道上的北行车道被限行，司机转入环路202的东行线。ADOT说，限制仍然存在，但交叉路口已被清除。
