fb3e94399408da4ebf049b156c23bb47373b328d.sourceText: 凤凰城凤鸣：快乐轻松的公务员生活 (续二) 在经历了一年多无忧无虑、无牵无挂的自清、自律的轻松自由生活后，由于体制改革，我们整个〝农业机械修配处〞被从省机械厅端到省农业厅，成为农业 厅的一个下属处级单位。 我有规律的生活一下被打乱，我们被搬到省城的边缘，离家很远而荒凉的东郊，没有了优雅而美丽的环境，学习武术的事情也化为泡影；远离了刚 熟悉的朋友，下班后的业余时间只能继续呆在办公室，或是在单身宿舍打发时间，那个心情特别的郁闷。 我们农业机械修配处的办公室在三楼，我住的单身宿舍楼在另一座楼的三层楼，每天下三楼、上三楼，爬楼梯成了我锻炼身体的好办法。 上楼时一步两阶，飞奔上楼气不喘，下楼如履平地身轻如燕。 同事们见到我这个新来的年轻人，充满活力的样子，都愿意和我聊天交朋友。 慢慢地我熟悉了新环境，也交接了许多新朋友，对新的生活和工作有了信心和情趣。 很快我发现，在我们办公室的三楼走廊上，摆有一付乒乓球台桌，午饭和晚饭后有同事们打球，清脆的兵乓球声吸引着我，虽然和他们不熟悉，我先是站 在旁边观战，渐渐地我跃跃欲试，在同事们的纵拥下，也上了乒乓球战场。 由于好久没有打球了，很快被淘汰下来。 经过一段时间的练习，很快和经常打球的人熟悉起来，我的业余时间也开始丰富多彩起来。 为了庆祝节日，团支部组织青年人，准备文化娱乐节目，我参加了小合唱和二人对唱。 演出非常成功，丰富多彩的业余生活，使我的郁闷心情一扫而光。 郁闷心情不翼而飞的原因，还有业余时间的文化学习。 我参加了英语学习班和古典文学学习班。 晚饭后骑着自行车，到很远的业余学校上课，感觉有用不尽的精力。 那时的业余学习班，是教育局提倡督办的免费学习班，为的是提高从业人员的文化业务技术水平，更有利于工作的开展。 对我自己而言，提高了我的文学修养，能写出更多更好的工作简报，处领导也很支持我的业务学习。 那一年的冬天特别冷，记得下第一场大雪时，大雪从夜晚何时开始下的不知道。 当我像往常一样洗梳完下楼晨练时，发现机关大院己是白雪皑皑，厚厚的白雪把整个大院覆盖，晨练马上改为扫雪。 在宿舍楼的储藏室找来大扫帚，用尽力气一下一下扫、嘴里啍唱着心爱的歌。 虽然天气很寒冷，可是不一会就开始满身暖和起来，从宿舍楼到食堂，先扫出一条小路，和从食堂扫雪过来的炊事员师付汇合。 渐渐开始扫雪的人多起来，大家一起把必经之路清扫出来，不至影响办公和外出。 离上班时间还早，几个年轻人七手八脚很快堆起一个雪人，插上红萝卜做雪人鼻子，更有年轻人打起了雪仗，一场大雪把一个死气沉沉的机关大院， 变成年轻人欢乐的天堂。 虽然远离车水马龙喧嚣的城市中心，快乐的年轻人永远能乐在其中，这就是年轻人的天性。 新的机关座落在距离我家很远的东郊，只能每周回家一次，邦年老的父母做些家务。 没有家庭重担，爱人远在部队，一个人自由支配所有的业余时间。 这一年多的工作、学习、业余活动都丰富多​​彩，感谢上帝的慈爱和恩典，一直充充满满的陪伴着我。
fb3e94399408da4ebf049b156c23bb47373b328d.translatedText: Phoenix City Fengming: Happy and Relaxed Civil Servant Life (continued 2) After more than a year of carefree, carefree, self-disciplined and relaxed life, due to the structural reform, our entire "Agricultural Machinery Repair Department" was transferred from the Provincial Machinery Department to the Provincial Department of Agriculture and became a subordinate division-level unit of the Department of Agriculture. My regular life was suddenly disrupted. We were moved to the edge of the provincial capital, to the desolate eastern suburbs far away from home. Without the elegant and beautiful environment, learning martial arts also came to nothing; I was far away from the friends I had just met, and I could only stay in the office or pass the time in the single dormitory after get off work. I felt very depressed. The office of our Agricultural Machinery Repair Department is on the third floor. The single dormitory where I live is on the third floor of another building. I go down and up the third floor every day. Climbing the stairs has become a good way for me to exercise. When going upstairs, two steps at a time, I ran up the stairs without losing breath, and when I went downstairs, I felt like walking on flat ground, and I was as light as a swallow. When my colleagues saw me, a new young man who was full of energy, they were willing to chat and make friends with me. Slowly I became familiar with the new environment, made many new friends, and gained confidence and interest in my new life and work. Soon I discovered that there was a table tennis table in the corridor on the third floor of our office. Colleagues would play ball after lunch and dinner. The crisp sound of table tennis attracted me. Although I was not familiar with them, I first stood by and watched the game. Gradually, I was eager to try it. With the support of my colleagues, I also entered the table tennis battlefield. Since I haven't played for a long time, I was quickly eliminated. After a period of practice, I quickly became familiar with people who often play golf, and my spare time began to become more colorful. In order to celebrate the festival, the Youth League branch organized young people to prepare cultural and entertainment programs. I participated in a small chorus and duet. The performance was very successful, and my colorful spare time life swept away my depression. The reason why the depressed mood disappeared is also the cultural study in my spare time. I took English classes and classical literature classes. After dinner, I rode my bicycle to attend classes at a distant amateur school. I felt like I had endless energy. At that time, the part-time study class was a free study class promoted and supervised by the Education Bureau in order to improve the cultural and professional technical level of employees and make it more conducive to the development of work. For myself, it has improved my literary accomplishment and enabled me to write more and better work briefings. The department leaders also support my business learning. The winter of that year was extremely cold. I remember the first heavy snowfall. I don’t know when the heavy snow started falling at night. When I went downstairs for morning exercises after washing up as usual, I found that the courtyard of the government agency was already covered with snow. Thick white snow covered the entire courtyard, so my morning exercises were immediately changed to snow sweeping. I found a big broom in the storage room of the dormitory building, swept it with all my strength, and sang my favorite song. Although the weather was very cold, my whole body started to feel warm after a while. From the dormitory building to the cafeteria, I first cleared a path and met the cook Shifu who was sweeping the snow from the cafeteria. Gradually, more and more people began to clear the snow, and everyone worked together to clear the only way to pass, so as not to affect work and outings. It was still early before going to work, so several young people quickly built a snowman and inserted carrots to make the snowman's nose. Some young people also had a snowball fight. A heavy snowfall turned a lifeless government compound into a happy paradise for young people. Although they are far away from the bustling city center, happy young people can always have fun. This is the nature of young people. The new institution is located in the eastern suburbs far away from my home. I can only go home once a week to help my elderly parents do some housework. There is no family burden, my lover is far away in the army, and I can spend all my spare time by myself. Over the past year, my work, study, and leisure activities have been rich and colorful. I am grateful to God for His love and grace, which has always been with me.

2f59675b89e3ebb33e4dd23f988f2b43b1b61240.sourceText: 房市溜滑梯 低价屋跌最惨 这一波房市危机，高价住宅的机运比低价住宅好得多。与2006年房价达到巅峰时相比，全美顶级住宅价值平均下跌38%；底层住宅房价则比2007年的高峰折损63%。 「今日美国报」引用哈佛大学的研究结果，表示美国各大城市普遍都有这种现象。例如，亚特兰大高级住宅去年11月的价格，比2007年高峰时期降低23%，底层住宅价格却折掉50%。旧金山最贵的房子比巅峰时期降价24%，最便宜的房子则降价54%。 各大市场房价出入极大。亚特兰大底层住宅售价低于12万2533元，高级住宅则从22万1679元起跳。旧金山两者分别是31万2546元和57万3577元。 哈佛研究员麦丘说，在许多城市，价位较低的房子在房价涨到巅峰之前增值更大，因此后来也跌得更凶。 例如，旧金山底层房价达到巅峰前几乎涨了两倍，高级住宅则只涨了不到一倍。麦丘说，在房市崩溃前，贷款商向较低收入家庭放宽贷款条件，导致较便宜房子的需求和价格激增。 此外，所得较高的屋主通常更有能力度过经济衰退，不必在市况恶劣时被迫卖掉房子。哈佛的研究报告估计，低收入小区去年的法拍屋平均比率，比高收入小区高出一倍以上，房价也因此更加低迷。 不过，房利美和房地美预定10月1日开始降低向贷款商承购的房贷额度，可能使一些地方的高级住宅受到降价压力。 面对金融危机，这两个联邦房贷担保机构在2008年底提高保证收购的贷款额度，以在高房价市场刺激放款。现在许多地区的保证收购额度，将从72万9750元降到62万5000元。此举可能使贷款商对超出额度的贷款提高利率，并可能影响房屋交易。
2f59675b89e3ebb33e4dd23f988f2b43b1b61240.translatedText: The real estate market is on a slippery slope, with low-priced houses falling the hardest. In this wave of housing market crisis, high-priced houses have much better luck than low-priced houses. Compared with 2006, when housing prices reached their peak, the value of top-tier residential properties in the United States has dropped by an average of 38%; the value of bottom-tier residential properties has dropped by 63% from the peak in 2007. "USA Today" quoted research results from Harvard University and stated that this phenomenon is common in major cities in the United States. For example, the price of high-end residential properties in Atlanta in November last year was 23% lower than the peak in 2007, while the price of lower-level residential properties was discounted by 50%. The most expensive house in San Francisco is down 24% from its peak, while the cheapest house is down 54%. Housing prices vary widely across major markets. Lower-end homes in Atlanta sell for less than $122,533, while high-end homes start at $221,679. In San Francisco, the two are 312,546 yuan and 573,577 yuan respectively. McCue, the Harvard researcher, said that in many cities, lower-priced homes gained more in value before prices peaked, and therefore fell more sharply later. For example, in San Francisco, housing prices for low-end housing almost tripled before reaching their peak, while housing prices for high-end housing only less than doubled. McCue said that before the housing market crashed, lenders relaxed loan terms for lower-income households, causing demand and prices for cheaper homes to surge. In addition, homeowners with higher incomes are generally better able to weather a recession and are not forced to sell their homes when the market gets tough. A Harvard research report estimates that the average rate of foreclosures in low-income communities last year was more than double that of high-income communities, making housing prices even more depressed. However, Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac are scheduled to begin reducing the amount of mortgages they will purchase from lenders on October 1, which may put pressure on price reductions for high-end residential properties in some places. In the face of the financial crisis, the two Federal Mortgage Guarantee Agencies increased the loan limits for guaranteed acquisitions at the end of 2008 to stimulate lending in a market with high housing prices. Now the guaranteed purchase limit in many areas will be reduced from 729,750 yuan to 625,000 yuan. The move could allow lenders to raise interest rates on loans that exceed their limits and could affect housing transactions.

759f9949ffda5bf6221f9aa56fb372df915b9ff6.sourceText: 微笑与咖啡 （亚省时报） 日本人纵有千般不是，他们对待工作与事业的热诚、专注、虔敬、执着的精神和态度，还是令人敬佩的。特别是餐饮业方面，不论员工还是店东，都是认真尽责，全力以赴，务求做到宾至如归，人人称好。于是日子有功，无形中形成了三方一体，休戚与共。如东京一家经营有年的饺子店，因为老师傅死了，事前他又把做饺子的配方卖了给别人，店主为了一个「诚」字，居然决定停业，而一群光顾多年的老顾客，又居然不离不弃，每天都到店前来遛转遛转,希望它会复业，结果惊动了传媒,纷纷深入採访，竞相报导，以致一时传为佳话，令城中人既感动又惋惜。 类似饺子店这样的例子，一定不少。就笔者所知，东京一家着名咖啡连锁店，最近宣告结业，同样令人为之扼腕。 在东方人心目中，餐为主，饮为副，无论你的咖啡店开得多麽浪漫雅致，也只能是在人家办完正经事之后一个无聊的去处,或者充其量,是一个为人们提供清谈雅聚、消暑歇脚之地，与堂皇富丽的酒楼饭店根本不可同日而语。日本人淹宅加外明白这一点，所以直截了当把自已的咖啡店叫作「谈话室」。可是请别误会，以为此「室」仅是一间「室雅何须大」的清雅小室而已。他共有四间之多，分别开在东京御茶之水、池袋与新宿三地，最小的那间也有170个座位。新宿火车站口的老店，则拥有350个座位，面积550平方咪，即6000呎，马上就是开业四十週年大庆。如此的规模，就是叫它们做咖啡楼或加啡阁，也是当之无愧。不过「谈话室」之所以出名，倒不在于大，而是由于店裡有一种特别温馨的氛围，足以令人流连忘返，一杯难忘。淹宅加外认为，一杯芳香的咖啡，固然可以给人一份美好的感受，但是顾客们首先接触的，并不是咖啡，而是员工，如果他们一开始就给人一个亲切友善的微笑，留下好印象，那麽接下来的一切就一定好办得多。所以在「谈话室」，微笑、鲜花与咖啡，是同等重要的三宝，正如顾客、员工与老板的关係同样重要一样。 淹宅加外这样做,是有原因的。大学时，他患了肺痨。在当时，那几乎是必死的重病，己经作了最坏的打算。却没想到，绝望中住进医院，面对着一张张和蔼可亲的笑脸,竟渐渐发觉，活着还真好,又不想死了。文雅点说，护士小姐们那些动人的微笑，重新点燃了他生命之灯，使他坚强起来，勇敢起来，终致战胜了病魔。此后，微笑就成了淹宅加外努力追寻的东西，也成了他开启成功之门___「谈话室」的钥匙。 「谈话室」在1966年开张。不过早在一年之前，他便开始招募员工，着手集训，并立下规矩，所有新人头三年必须入住宿舍，而且每晚九时前就要就寝,以便保証质素，统一进度，和养成良好习惯。至目前为止，住过宿舍接受过严格培训的职工，已超过二千人。出人意表的是，「谈话室」的东西并不贵，香浓的咖啡，可口的糕饼，一律仅售一千丹，还不够十美元。所以一开张，立即引起人们___特别是教授和作家们的兴趣。他们常常一坐就是几个钟头，听说有不少成功的论述，感人的佳作，皆是在咖啡的芳香与殷勤周至的款待之中写就的。 可惜，物换星移，到了今天，肯住进宿舍接受微笑和插花训练的年轻人，已是凤毛麟角。目下，在一百一十多名服务员之中，只有二成受过认真培训，而绝大多数的八成，就都为钟点散工了。虽然生意还不错，然而服务水准就明显每况愈下，与淹宅加外的原意渐走渐远。痛心之馀，他终于毅然决定___关门! 年前，香港有两家老店突然宣佈歇业，同样成为大小报刊热衷的话题。一家是以蛋挞鬆化甘香而驰名，连前港督彭定康也大讚好吃的「泰昌饼店」，一家是以盐焗鸡鲜嫩香滑为卖点，连远在北美的古冬也为之垂涎的「泉章居饭店」。前者是因为业主疯狂加租无法支撑下去而不得不罢手，值得同情，后者是因为抵挡不住地产商一次又一次银弹轰炸而买棹归田，也可以理解。不过，这两家老店和日本人那两家老店，情形有点不同，媒体的观点与用意，更迥然有别，假如现在我们把当日四份报纸同时摊开来，请您从顾客的角度来评比一下店主们的高下与得失，或者乾脆请您来为这篇短文写个结语，您会如何下笔呢?
759f9949ffda5bf6221f9aa56fb372df915b9ff6.translatedText: Smiles and Coffee (Alberta Times) Despite all the flaws of the Japanese, their enthusiasm, concentration, piety, and persistent spirit and attitude toward work and career are still admirable. Especially in the catering industry, both employees and store owners are conscientious and dedicated to their responsibilities and go all out to make guests feel at home and praised by everyone. So the days are successful, and a tripartite body is formed invisibly, sharing weal and woe. For example, a dumpling shop in Tokyo that has been in business for many years, because the old chef passed away and sold the dumpling recipe to others beforehand, the shop owner decided to close down for the sake of "sincerity". However, a group of old customers who had been patronizing the shop for many years stayed with them, visiting the shop every day in the hope that it would reopen. As a result, the media was alarmed, and they conducted in-depth interviews and reports. It became a good story for a while, which made people in the city both moved and regretful. There must be many examples like dumpling shops. As far as the author knows, a famous coffee chain in Tokyo recently announced its closure, which is also disappointing. In the minds of Oriental people, eating is the main thing and drinking is the supplement. No matter how romantic and elegant your coffee shop is, it can only be a boring place after people finish their serious business, or at best, it is a place for people to chat, relax and rest. It is not the same as a magnificent restaurant. The Japanese know this, so they call their coffee shop a "talking room." But please don't misunderstand that this "room" is just a small and elegant room. There are four restaurants in total, located in Ochanomizu, Ikebukuro and Shinjuku in Tokyo. The smallest one has 170 seats. The old store at the Shinjuku train station entrance has 350 seats and an area of ​​550 square meters, or 6,000 feet. It will soon be celebrating its 40th anniversary. With such a scale, even if they are called coffee shops or coffee shops, they are well-deserved. However, the reason why "Conversation Room" is famous is not because of its size, but because the store has a particularly warm atmosphere that makes people linger and have an unforgettable drink. Yanzhaijiawai believes that a cup of fragrant coffee can certainly give people a good feeling, but the first thing customers come into contact with is not the coffee, but the employees. If they give people a friendly smile from the beginning and leave a good impression, then everything that follows will be much easier. Therefore, in the "talking room", smiles, flowers and coffee are the three equally important treasures, just as the relationship between customers, employees and the boss is equally important. There is a reason why Yanzhai Jiawai does this. In college, he suffered from tuberculosis. At that time, it was almost a serious illness that would lead to death, and we had already prepared for the worst. Unexpectedly, when I was admitted to the hospital out of despair, and faced with friendly smiling faces, I gradually realized that it was really good to be alive, and I didn’t want to die. To put it more elegantly, the touching smiles of the nurses rekindled the light of his life, making him strong and brave, and finally defeated the disease. Since then, smile has become what Yan Zhaigai strives to pursue, and it has also become the key to his "talking room" that opens the door to success. The "Talking Room" opened in 1966. However, as early as a year ago, he started recruiting employees, started training, and set a rule that all new employees must live in the dormitory for the first three years and go to bed before nine o'clock every night in order to ensure quality, unify progress, and develop good habits. So far, more than 2,000 employees have lived in dormitories and received strict training. Surprisingly, the things in the "talking room" are not expensive. The fragrant coffee and delicious cakes all cost only one thousand Dan, which is less than ten dollars. So as soon as it opened, it immediately aroused the interest of people, especially professors and writers. They often sit for hours at a time, and I heard that there are many successful essays and touching masterpieces, all written amidst the aroma of coffee and the attentive and thoughtful hospitality. Unfortunately, things have changed and today, there are very few young people willing to live in dormitories to receive training in smiling and flower arrangement. Currently, only 20% of the more than 110 waiters have received serious training, while the vast majority of 80% are part-time workers. Although the business is good, the service level is obviously deteriorating, and it is gradually getting further and further away from the original intention of Yanzhaijiawai. In addition to being sad, he finally decided to close his doors! A few years ago, two old stores in Hong Kong suddenly announced their closure, which became a hot topic in newspapers and magazines. One is Tai Cheong Cake Shop, which is famous for its soft and sweet egg tarts. Even former Hong Kong Governor Chris Patten praised the deliciousness. The other is Quan Zhang Ju Restaurant, whose selling point is the tenderness and smoothness of salt-baked chicken, which is even coveted by people as far away as North America. The former was forced to stop because the owner was unable to sustain the rent increase, which is worthy of sympathy. The latter was bought and returned to the land because he could not withstand the silver bullet bombardment of real estate developers again and again, which is also understandable. However, the situation of these two old stores and the two old Japanese stores is a bit different, and the views and intentions of the media are even more different. If we spread out the four newspapers of the day at the same time, would you please evaluate the performance, gains and losses of the store owners from the perspective of customers, or simply ask you to write a conclusion for this short article. How would you write?

ef4d5ab15f61394e544506af896ac538cc42e3b5.sourceText: 解忧的天使 嘉霖 开车去凤凰城是为听吴玲瑶的演讲”幽默处处有”。一月三十一日下午﹐…
ef4d5ab15f61394e544506af896ac538cc42e3b5.translatedText: Angel that relieves worries Jialin I drove to Phoenix City to listen to Wu Lingyao’s speech “Humor is Everywhere”. On the afternoon of January 31st,...

d41577934b06eb969e683792e2a48bb7d023a4ba.sourceText: 解忧的天使 嘉霖 开车去凤凰城是为听吴玲瑶的演讲”幽默处处有”。一月三十一日下午﹐梅萨小区学院的演讲厅内﹐里三层外三层挤满了人﹐两旁加了椅子还是不够坐﹐有的来宾只好站着。吴玲瑶的粉丝们纷纷前来﹐和她握手照相﹐她确实是位有号召力的华人女作家。 吴玲瑶的幽默带来听众们此起彼伏的欢笑声。演讲中她的笑话紧凑地一个接一个﹐小潮方去﹐大潮又来﹐令人耳目接之不暇。说吴玲瑶是位把快乐带给大家的天使﹐一点也不夸张。在财源滚滚的年代﹐她送给大家更多的笑声﹐是锦上添花。在裁员滚滚的时节﹐她带给大家许多的慰藉﹐是雪中送炭。而人生不如意事十有八九﹐她的幽默真的会让不如意的人们高兴起来。 吴玲瑶的幽默寓意深刻﹐听完后还有回味的余意。譬如她说﹐我们应把生活中悲哀的事在心目中缩小﹐把身边快乐的事在心目中放大。”幽默处处有” ﹐ 悲喜端在一念间。她劝听众要能懂得自嘲﹐– 像那位不以貌胜的凌峰﹐在他”八千里路云和月”节目里描写自己的长相﹐说中国人五千年的苦难都写在他的脸上。– 换来的当然是观众的笑声。 她说的男生看女生最令人捧腹。”从后面看想犯罪﹐从旁边看想撤退﹐从前面看想防卫。” ”猛然一看﹐啊呀﹐怎么这样的。仔细一看﹐还不如猛然一看。” 大约三年前﹐我曾在”亚省时报” 上写过”解忧功” 一文。说到许多医学上的研究显示，无论是开怀大笑还是微微一笑， 都能使人松弛紧张的神经，改变人的恶劣情绪，增强免疫系统的功能。乐观的人不会无病呻吟，乐天的人才能健康长寿。笑能减少焦虑，迷茫，忧惧和忿怒，使人转忧为喜。笑能有效对付有害人体的内分泌，此种功效没有任何药物能办得到。在哈哈声中，三千大千的烦恼都随风而逝，这是何等爽心的乐事。吴玲瑶就是一位解忧的天使。 那些享有版权的笑话可惜不能在此复述﹐她已出版的许多书里还有更多的笑料。下次吴玲瑶再来的时候﹐大家千万不要错过听演讲的机会。
d41577934b06eb969e683792e2a48bb7d023a4ba.translatedText: > Angel of Worry Relief Jialin drove to Phoenix City to listen to Wu Lingyao’s speech “Humor is Everywhere”. On the afternoon of January 31st, the lecture hall at Mesa Community College was packed with people on three floors. Even with the addition of chairs on both sides, there was still not enough seating, so some guests had to stand. Fans of Wu Lingyao came one after another to shake hands with her and take photos. She is indeed an influential Chinese female writer. Wu Lingyao's humor brought laughter to the audience. During her speech, her jokes came one after another in a compact manner. The small tide went away and the big tide came again, which made people dizzy. It is no exaggeration to say that Wu Lingyao is an angel who brings happiness to everyone. In an era of abundant wealth, she brings more laughter to everyone, which is the icing on the cake. In the season of layoffs, she brings a lot of comfort to everyone and is a timely help. Nine times out of ten things in life are going to be unhappy, and her humor will really make those unhappy people happy. Wu Lingyao's humor has profound meaning, and you will still have lingering aftertaste after listening to it. For example, she said, we should make the sad things in life smaller in our minds, and enlarge the happy things around us in our minds. "Humor is everywhere", joy and sorrow are all in one thought. She advised the audience to learn to laugh at themselves, like Ling Feng, who was not judged by his appearance. He described his appearance in his "Eight Thousand Miles to the Clouds and Moon" program, saying that the Chinese people's five thousand years of suffering were written on his face. – Of course, the result was laughter from the audience. She said that boys looking at girls are the most hilarious. "When you look at it from the back, you want to commit a crime. When you look at it from the side, you want to retreat. When you look at it from the front, you want to defend yourself." "When you look at it suddenly, oh, why is it like this? When you look carefully, it's better to take a sudden look." About three years ago, I wrote an article on "Relieving Worry" in the "Alberta Times". Speaking of, many medical studies have shown that whether it is a hearty laugh or a slight smile, it can relax people's tense nerves, change people's bad mood, and enhance the function of the immune system. Optimistic people will not complain unnecessarily. Only optimistic people can live a long and healthy life. Laughter can reduce anxiety, confusion, fear and anger, and turn worries into joy. Laughter can effectively deal with endocrine harmful to the human body. This effect cannot be achieved by any medicine. In the sound of haha, all the troubles of the three thousand and thousands are gone with the wind. What a refreshing pleasure it is. Wu Lingyao is an angel who relieves worries. Unfortunately, those copyrighted jokes cannot be reproduced here; there are many more in her many published books. Next time Wu Lingyao comes again, everyone must not miss the opportunity to listen to the speech.

c76e7855460f0c6dbd0ea484b2761c6827138ba7.sourceText: 12月25日，日本首相野田佳彦在访华启程前称，他会通报中方，日本将首次购买中国政府发行的人民币债券。会谈中，温家宝总理表示，中方愿同日方密切配合，促进两国本币金融市场发展，加快推动中日韩三国自贸区进程和东亚财金合作。
c76e7855460f0c6dbd0ea484b2761c6827138ba7.translatedText: On December 25, Japanese Prime Minister Yoshihiko Noda said before his visit to China that he would inform China that Japan would purchase RMB bonds issued by the Chinese government for the first time. During the talks, Premier Wen Jiabao stated that China is willing to work closely with Japan to promote the development of the two countries' local currency financial markets and accelerate the process of the China-Japan-ROK free trade area and East Asia financial cooperation.

46a7862678eb27e204a7748902f3999bdda14475.sourceText: 此前，日本财务大臣安住淳在宣布购买100亿美元中国国债，引起世界性的关注。野田此次访华被认为是以寻求经济合作为重心，作为美国第二大债主的日本，购买美国第一大债主中国的国债，无疑具有指标意义。若日本购买中国国债计划付诸实施，则会引起多种效应，由中国单方面的持有日本国债变成相互持有，日本不仅在外交上给中国送上一个”礼包”，更是一石多鸟，对自身同样大有裨益。
46a7862678eb27e204a7748902f3999bdda14475.translatedText: Previously, Japanese Finance Minister Azumi Junzai announced the purchase of US$10 billion in Chinese government bonds, which attracted worldwide attention. Noda's visit to China is considered to be focused on seeking economic cooperation. As the second largest creditor of the United States, Japan's purchase of treasury bonds from China, the largest creditor of the United States, is undoubtedly of symbolic significance. If Japan's plan to purchase Chinese government bonds is implemented, it will cause a variety of effects. China's unilateral holding of Japanese government bonds will become mutual holdings. Japan will not only send a "gift package" to China diplomatically, but it will also kill two birds with one stone, which will also be of great benefit to itself.

086c1373283018268a6ae7ee7e37922cfe68550a.sourceText: 中国从2005年就开始购买日本国债。仅今年4月，中国就净购入1.33万亿日元的日本中长期国债，创下历史纪录，并在日本国内引起波澜。日本认为，中国单方面持有日本国债将使日本在外交上陷于被动，希望通过购买中国国债与中国推进金融市场等经济领域的信息交换，并确保对中国的一定发言权。
086c1373283018268a6ae7ee7e37922cfe68550a.translatedText: China began to purchase Japanese government bonds in 2005. In April this year alone, China purchased a net 1.33 trillion yen of Japanese medium- and long-term government bonds, setting a historical record and causing waves in Japan. Japan believes that China's unilateral holding of Japanese government bonds will make Japan passive diplomatically. It hopes to promote information exchange with China in financial markets and other economic fields through the purchase of Chinese government bonds and ensure a certain say in China.

55ab30840e7c860cf01ce5b7152277353716b1d1.sourceText: 野田佳彦曾任财务大臣，在推进与中国的财经合作方面有一套自己的打算。从经济战略考量，截至今年11月底，日本外汇储备总额约达1.3万亿美元，规模仅次于中国，居全球第二。日本外汇储备构成中，超过七成是美元资产。在8月初，美国国债信用评级下调，美元的基础货币地位开始动摇的情形下，投资人民币债券能够降低风险，降低汇率波动带来的损失。
55ab30840e7c860cf01ce5b7152277353716b1d1.translatedText: Yoshihiko Noda was the former Minister of Finance and has his own plans for promoting financial cooperation with China. From an economic strategic perspective, as of the end of November this year, Japan's total foreign exchange reserves amounted to approximately US$1.3 trillion, ranking second in the world after China. More than 70% of Japan's foreign exchange reserves consist of U.S. dollar assets. In early August, when the credit rating of U.S. Treasury bonds was downgraded and the U.S. dollar's base currency status began to shake, investing in RMB bonds can reduce risks and reduce losses caused by exchange rate fluctuations.

6ada0be719eb0fffd1967c2352f2e0b1ddad74ad.sourceText: 有分析指出，在美欧债务危机大背景下，外储构成多元化已成为大势所趋。对日本来说，眼下持有人民币资产既比持有欧元等高风险资产更安全，也符合日本一贯的偏保守外储投资策略。日本在分散风险的同时，顺水推舟送中国一个人情，顺手支持了一下人民币。
6ada0be719eb0fffd1967c2352f2e0b1ddad74ad.translatedText: Some analysts pointed out that in the context of the debt crisis in the United States and Europe, diversification of the composition of foreign reserves has become a general trend. For Japan, holding RMB assets is now safer than holding high-risk assets such as euros, and it is also in line with Japan's consistently conservative foreign reserve investment strategy. While diversifying risks, Japan also favored China and supported the RMB.

dfbb3ffce6b8d762473d4606f89e6ab8c3674478.sourceText: 对中国来说，这是人民币首次成为发达经济体储备货币，是人民币国际化的重要进展。法国农业信贷银行战略分析师达留什 科瓦尔奇克说，一个G7国家购买中国国债，这是对人民币的极大认可。由于人民币有别于美元、欧元和日元等货币，其在全球市场的流动受到中国政府限制，此次中国允许G7国家购买国债，反映出中国已对人民币在全球流通开了一个口子。
dfbb3ffce6b8d762473d4606f89e6ab8c3674478.translatedText: For China, this is the first time that the RMB has become the reserve currency of a developed economy, and it is an important progress in the internationalization of the RMB. Dariusz Kowalczyk, a strategic analyst at Crédit Agricole, said that a G7 country buying Chinese government bonds is a great recognition of the yuan. Because the RMB is different from currencies such as the U.S. dollar, euro and Japanese yen, its flow in the global market is restricted by the Chinese government. This time, China allowed G7 countries to purchase treasury bonds, which reflects that China has opened a loophole for the global circulation of the RMB.

faad55cdd62a8488a2bd01fbb0faa548a3c30de8.sourceText: 中日互相持有彼此的国债，可能会加速日本摆脱对美元依赖的趋势，但并不会撼动美元当前的地位，更不意味着日本会放弃美国国债。虽然日本对美元的信任有所下降，但在购买中国国债的同时，今后日本仍会购买美国国债的力度，毕竟日本的外汇储备持有美元最多，中国亦是如此。一百亿美元的人民币债券仅是象征性的，但意义却是长远的
faad55cdd62a8488a2bd01fbb0faa548a3c30de8.translatedText: China and Japan hold each other's treasury bonds, which may accelerate Japan's move away from dependence on the U.S. dollar, but it will not shake the current status of the U.S. dollar, nor does it mean that Japan will give up U.S. treasury bonds. Although Japan's trust in the U.S. dollar has declined, while buying Chinese government bonds, Japan will still purchase U.S. government bonds in the future. After all, Japan holds the largest number of U.S. dollars in foreign exchange reserves, and so does China. The US$10 billion RMB bond is only symbolic, but its significance is long-term

f596c406b3183ac56f7d37c792f17c688871f46d.sourceText: 中共官方媒体《环球时报》27日刊发北大教授评价韩寒的文章说，韩寒最新的博文说明，韩寒开始试图超出对现象的罗列而更深入地思考，，寻找”阐释中国”的新路径。这是超出”左””右”框架的努力，也是寻求对现实真正有力回应的开始。
f596c406b3183ac56f7d37c792f17c688871f46d.translatedText: The Chinese Communist Party's official media "Global Times" published an article on Han Han on the 27th by a professor from Peking University, saying that Han Han's latest blog post shows that Han Han has begun to try to go beyond listing phenomena and think more deeply to find new ways to "explain China." This is an effort to go beyond the "left" and "right" frameworks, and it is also the beginning of seeking a truly powerful response to reality.

6cc576049b3f7984271e5d661a6ee9da0e455a81.sourceText: 12月23日至26日三天时间里，韩寒在其博客上接连发出三篇博文，分别是《谈革命》、《说民主》、《要自由》，引起中国社会广泛关注，也引发了新的思考和讨论。
6cc576049b3f7984271e5d661a6ee9da0e455a81.translatedText: In the three days from December 23 to 26, Han Han published three blog posts in succession on his blog, namely "Talk about Revolution", "Talk about Democracy", and "Want Freedom", which attracted widespread attention in Chinese society and also triggered new thinking and discussion.

56e1a95d749503ea088127e3bf4164b9ca967854.sourceText: 《环球时报》在26日发表社评肯定了韩寒”党组织庞大到一定程度，它就是人民本身，人民就是体制本身”的说法后，27日又刊发了题为《韩寒化蛹为蝶，超越”左”与”右”》的文章对韩寒大加赞赏。
56e1a95d749503ea088127e3bf4164b9ca967854.translatedText: After the "Global Times" published an editorial on the 26th affirming Han Han's statement that "the party organization is so large that it is the people themselves, and the people are the system itself", it published an article on the 27th entitled "Han Han turns into a butterfly, transcending the "left" and "right"" and praised Han Han greatly.

1665af3206fb8e81b3c14f39b4f76138ec32384c.sourceText: 中国青年作家韩寒经是新概念作文大赛一等奖获得者，高中中途退学，畅销书作家，他现在是著名赛车手，中国访问量最高的博客主人。2010年，韩寒与奥巴马、比尔盖茨等一道，进入美国《时代周刊》年度全球影响力100人的候选名单。许多人把韩寒视为一个对社会重大问题发表看法的”公民”而高度重视，将他视为一个远远溢出知识分子原有的对于中国问题思考的新人物。
1665af3206fb8e81b3c14f39b4f76138ec32384c.translatedText: Chinese young writer Han Hanjing is the first prize winner of the New Concept Essay Contest. He dropped out of high school and is a best-selling author. He is now a famous racing driver and the owner of the most visited blog in China. In 2010, Han Han, together with Obama and Bill Gates, entered the shortlist of the 100 most influential people in the world by Time Magazine. Many people attach great importance to Han Han as a "citizen" who expresses his views on major social issues, and regard him as a new figure who goes far beyond the original thinking of intellectuals on Chinese issues.

3de4534383d83d7867e52ac68e312445ebfc0962.sourceText: 文章说，这三篇最新的博文可以视为这位年轻意见领袖对于中国问题系统思考的一部分。韩寒从之前”扮演众多社会问题抨击者的角色”，到今天阐述了自己对中国的重大问题，如”革命””民主””自由”的理解，是一个从直觉开始的批判之旅向着理性思考的升华。
3de4534383d83d7867e52ac68e312445ebfc0962.translatedText: The article said that these three latest blog posts can be regarded as part of this young opinion leader’s systematic thinking on China issues. From "playing the role of a critic of many social issues" before, Han Han has now elaborated on his understanding of China's major issues, such as "revolution", "democracy" and "freedom". It is a critical journey starting from intuition and sublimating to rational thinking.

d550e6fffdc12cfed2115bd88f6473c3729e7cdd.sourceText: 如何认识中国？如何理解中国今天的状况和三十年来的发展？这既是上世纪80年代以来知识分子内部 ”左””右”分歧的焦点，也是一直在知识分子中争讼不已的问题。但从今天看，中国30年来的发展显然超出了”现代性”的”左””右”二元对立。中国并没有按照”左””右”知识分子所预想的模式和构架发展。
d550e6fffdc12cfed2115bd88f6473c3729e7cdd.translatedText: How to understand China? How to understand China’s current situation and its development over the past thirty years? This has been the focus of the “left” and “right” differences among intellectuals since the 1980s, and it is also an issue that has been constantly debated among intellectuals. But from today's perspective, China's development over the past 30 years has clearly gone beyond the binary opposition of "modernity" of "left" and "right". China has not developed according to the model and structure envisioned by "left" and "right" intellectuals.

b643989c46b277d12f20a9fcf4e5535bb521e3c7.sourceText: 往往”左””右”的知识分子过度局限于自己的意识形态立场，对中国的新发展缺乏阐释力，也无力具体地回应中国所面对的挑战和问题。上世纪90年代以来，不少中国知识分子始终处于一种 ”阐释中国的焦虑”之中，失掉对现实的把握。”左””右”的二元对立既限制了知识分子看世界和中国的角度，也限制了他们对现实的真正客观理性的思考能力。不少知识分子力图超越”左””右”，从原有的固定的价值中超离，寻求更深入具体地把握中国。
b643989c46b277d12f20a9fcf4e5535bb521e3c7.translatedText: Often "left" and "right" intellectuals are overly limited to their own ideological positions, lack the ability to interpret China's new developments, and are unable to respond specifically to the challenges and problems China faces. Since the 1990s, many Chinese intellectuals have been in a state of "anxiety about interpreting China" and have lost their grasp of reality. The binary opposition of "left" and "right" not only limits the perspective from which intellectuals view the world and China, but also limits their ability to think truly objectively and rationally about reality. Many intellectuals strive to transcend "left" and "right", break away from the original fixed values, and seek to understand China more deeply and concretely.

cb47538c0f8295121401f763cee2dd4b6a3ef78a.sourceText: 因此，文章认为，韩寒的这个选择其实并不偶然，也是上世纪90年代以来许多知识分子艰难而认真的思考链条中的一环。
cb47538c0f8295121401f763cee2dd4b6a3ef78a.translatedText: Therefore, the article believes that Han Han’s choice is not accidental. It is also a link in the difficult and serious thinking chain of many intellectuals since the 1990s.

0858c92833fdf9ec4ee630b9056bb6b15ea1fee7.sourceText: 文章认为，韩寒这几篇重要博文的意义，在于他开始试图超出对现象的罗列而更深入地思考，寻找”阐释中国”的新路径。这是超出”左””右”框架的努力，也是寻求对现实真正有力回应的开始。这其实给了当下知识分子更多启示，我们都需要更多面对现实的中国，而不是拘泥于既定的框架和模式；我们都需要对于现实进行有力的阐释，而不是背弃现实去满足自己的一厢情愿。
0858c92833fdf9ec4ee630b9056bb6b15ea1fee7.translatedText: The article believes that the significance of Han Han's important blog posts is that he began to try to think more deeply beyond the list of phenomena and find a new path to "explain China." This is an effort to go beyond the "left" and "right" frameworks, and it is also the beginning of seeking a truly powerful response to reality. This actually gives more inspiration to current intellectuals. We all need to face the reality of China more, rather than sticking to established frameworks and models; we all need to provide a powerful interpretation of reality, rather than abandoning reality to satisfy our own wishful thinking.

bc5da3dcb913c084d819cb09e61320018aeadcdf.sourceText: 文章最后说，韩寒已化蛹为蝶，一个年轻人敢于直面他所面对的现实，试图给予新的阐释，他有勇气超越自己，那我们应该如何回应？
bc5da3dcb913c084d819cb09e61320018aeadcdf.translatedText: The article concluded that Han Han has turned into a chrysalis and turned into a butterfly. A young man dared to face the reality he faced and tried to give a new interpretation. He had the courage to surpass himself. So how should we respond?

868c43d28dd5af0787de0d6135929d053bfc83be.sourceText: 亚洲邻国抓住国庆商机
868c43d28dd5af0787de0d6135929d053bfc83be.translatedText: Asian neighbors seize National Day business opportunities

f2c8bdae02c7f6d44813f7a44fe296dc68aa9cbc.sourceText: 韩联社9月30日报道说，据韩国方面预测，中国国庆长假期间，预计将有15万中国游客赴韩旅游。如果中国游客真的达到这个数字，将比去年同期猛增逾6万人，创下历史之最。
f2c8bdae02c7f6d44813f7a44fe296dc68aa9cbc.translatedText: > Yonhap News Agency reported on September 30 that according to South Korean predictions, 150,000 Chinese tourists are expected to travel to South Korea during China’s National Day holiday. If Chinese tourists really reach this number, it will surge by more than 60,000 compared to the same period last year, setting a record high.

63e10688cf7c47130ae7adca0b1628e9dff5faa8.sourceText: 韩国SBS电视台报道说，中国游客以出手大方闻名，每人在韩期间的购物平均花费为70万韩元(约合人民币3990元)，是其他外国游客的2至3倍。
63e10688cf7c47130ae7adca0b1628e9dff5faa8.translatedText: South Korea's SBS TV station reported that Chinese tourists are known for their generosity. The average shopping expenditure per person during their stay in South Korea was 700,000 won (approximately RMB 3,990), which is 2 to 3 times that of other foreign tourists.

f467519ad541c66886f4d77389864749ed6c986a.sourceText: 为了招揽出手阔绰的中国游客，韩国各大百货店、免税店的竞争已进入白热化阶段。韩国现代百货店表示，去年9月29日至10月6日，中国游客购买金额比前年剧增220%，而今年年轻中国游客将越来越多，因此正在加大对中国游客的促销力度。
f467519ad541c66886f4d77389864749ed6c986a.translatedText: In order to attract large-spending Chinese tourists, the competition among major department stores and duty-free shops in South Korea has entered a fierce stage. South Korea's Hyundai Department Store stated that from September 29 to October 6 last year, the purchase amount of Chinese tourists increased sharply by 220% compared with the previous year. This year, there will be more and more young Chinese tourists, so it is increasing its promotional efforts for Chinese tourists.

f12c0d5f39be841836206e6c9e6c6f8ec9426a03.sourceText: 釜山政府则将在10月7日前针对邮轮航站大楼、购物中心、餐厅、酒店和旅游景点集中检验指示牌、菜单、旅游设施、服务员的服务态度、卫生、住宿设施资费表以及出租车非法收费等行为，以期给中国游客留下个好印象。
f12c0d5f39be841836206e6c9e6c6f8ec9426a03.translatedText: > The Busan government will focus on inspections of cruise terminals, shopping malls, restaurants, hotels and tourist attractions before October 7 for signage, menus, tourist facilities, waiter service attitude, sanitation, accommodation facility tariffs and illegal taxi charges, in order to leave a good impression on Chinese tourists.

d4993f9a386cb7ad47c3046194481042123c2ed1.sourceText: 而在日本，自2012年中日关系趋冷以来，最近个人游和团体游似乎都出现复苏迹象。
d4993f9a386cb7ad47c3046194481042123c2ed1.translatedText: In Japan, since the cooling of Sino-Japanese relations in 2012, both individual travel and group travel seem to be showing signs of recovery recently.

1b0f223122085b00a791d1efc1c0e2a3fe0f218e.sourceText: 作为中日友好象征的横滨中华街恢复了去年中断的庆祝国庆节的游街活动。”东京地下铁”也将在中国国庆节当天开始发放中文传单。东京的私营铁路企业小田急电铁也于9月28日至10月4日，在东京新宿站进行面向外国游客的促销活动，计划销售Hello Kitty等商品。商品均有中文的导购广告，还会发放中文旅游地图等。
1b0f223122085b00a791d1efc1c0e2a3fe0f218e.translatedText: As a symbol of Sino-Japanese friendship, Yokohama Chinatown has resumed its National Day parade that was interrupted last year. "Tokyo Metro" will also start distributing Chinese leaflets on China's National Day. Odakyu Electric Railway, a private railway company in Tokyo, will also conduct promotional activities for foreign tourists at Tokyo Shinjuku Station from September 28 to October 4, and plans to sell Hello Kitty and other products. The products all have shopping guide advertisements in Chinese, and Chinese tourist maps are also distributed.

4d512e2370d2142da11035fbaead34dfccacc2cc.sourceText: 日本国家旅游局调查显示，8月份访日中国游客人数为16万多，虽然同比减少15%，不过正逐渐接近2012年中日关系趋冷前20万多人的峰值水平。这也让日本对于中国黄金周的旅游市场，产生了不小的期许。
4d512e2370d2142da11035fbaead34dfccacc2cc.translatedText: A survey by the Japan National Tourism Administration shows that the number of Chinese tourists visiting Japan in August was more than 160,000. Although it decreased by 15% year-on-year, it is gradually approaching the peak level of more than 200,000 people in 2012 before the cooling of Sino-Japanese relations. This has also given Japan a lot of expectations for China’s Golden Week tourism market.

1215e151b1735abf0a81b2438aacc6fea3968c41.sourceText: 而对于泰国来说，”十一”是仅次于春节的中国游客抵达高峰期，曼谷、普吉、清迈、苏梅这些热门地区酒店的预订数量目前都出现了不同程度的增长，曼谷各大商场也都在推出相应的打折活动。
1215e151b1735abf0a81b2438aacc6fea3968c41.translatedText: For Thailand, National Day is the peak period for the arrival of Chinese tourists after the Spring Festival. The number of hotel reservations in popular areas such as Bangkok, Phuket, Chiang Mai and Samui has increased to varying degrees, and major shopping malls in Bangkok are also launching corresponding discounts.

e615a067f7aa31e5944344aef548635063d7fb3d.sourceText: 除了泰国，柬埔寨、老挝等东南亚国家近年来也逐渐成为中国游客的新选择。由于这些国家大多实行落地签，有一部分游客从泰国入境、游览之后，再转到这些泰国的邻国游玩，极大地拉动了这些国家的旅游业。以柬埔寨为例，仅在今年上半年，赴柬埔寨的中国游客增长超过50%，柬埔寨方面也计划增加更多的中国直航航线，吸引中国游客到柬埔寨旅游。
e615a067f7aa31e5944344aef548635063d7fb3d.translatedText: In addition to Thailand, Southeast Asian countries such as Cambodia and Laos have gradually become new choices for Chinese tourists in recent years. Since most of these countries implement visas on arrival, some tourists enter and visit Thailand, and then travel to Thailand's neighboring countries, which greatly boosts the tourism industry in these countries. Taking Cambodia as an example, in the first half of this year alone, the number of Chinese tourists to Cambodia increased by more than 50%. Cambodia also plans to add more direct flights to China to attract Chinese tourists to Cambodia.

3d84b709c41b5f354444172bbfbc1bd28dd7b27b.sourceText: 英国寻求推出共同签证
3d84b709c41b5f354444172bbfbc1bd28dd7b27b.translatedText: The United Kingdom seeks to launch a common visa

8a0bf7c4de7f193c5409f529c8a802e4b5cdb074.sourceText: 作为老牌欧洲国家，英国也开始采取举措吸引中国游客。据英国《每日电讯报》9月28日报道说，内政大臣特雷萨 梅表示，内政部正在审视简化来自中国签证申请的办法，可能推出同时适用于英国与其他欧洲国家的共同签证申请程序。
8a0bf7c4de7f193c5409f529c8a802e4b5cdb074.translatedText: As an established European country, the United Kingdom has also begun to take measures to attract Chinese tourists. According to the British "Daily Telegraph" report on September 28, Home Secretary Theresa May said that the Home Office is reviewing ways to simplify visa applications from China and may introduce a common visa application process that applies to both the UK and other European countries.

d1092f176df7cae465e803455f18068fb124fa80.sourceText: 在这之前，特里萨 梅曾一直反对放松签证限制。签证政策的改变，尤其受到英国零售商们的欢迎，在他们看来，中国游客仅通过一个签证，就可以轻而易举地到法国等申根条约国中的26个国家消费购物，而英国没有加入申根协定，这使中国游客无法进入，从而影响了英国的收入。英国商务大臣凯布尔表示，英国不能让中国富人及游客因繁琐签证而”放弃来英国”。
d1092f176df7cae465e803455f18068fb124fa80.translatedText: Prior to this, Theresa May had always opposed relaxing visa restrictions. The change in visa policy is especially welcomed by British retailers. In their view, Chinese tourists can easily go shopping in 26 Schengen treaty countries such as France with just one visa. However, the United Kingdom has not joined the Schengen Agreement, which prevents Chinese tourists from entering, thus affecting British income. British Business Secretary Cable said that the UK cannot let wealthy Chinese and tourists "give up coming to the UK" because of cumbersome visa requirements.

c3353e3d8d3dd547c31d55937cb975466b985a5b.sourceText: 据英国《金融时报》报道，到英国旅游的中国人每次的消费额通常达到1676英镑，几乎是全球平均旅游消费额的三倍。
c3353e3d8d3dd547c31d55937cb975466b985a5b.translatedText: According to the Financial Times, Chinese tourists traveling to the UK usually spend up to £1,676 each time, which is almost three times the global average tourist spending.

7c37b69b84acc7541bf15fe7f7960b1fadcc1e88.sourceText: 俄罗斯也试图在黄金周吸引更多中国游客。俄新网9月28日消息称，俄联邦旅游署署长拉季科夫在9月27日世界旅游日时表示，中国是个巨大的市场，每年有1亿人次出国旅游。而俄罗斯具有吸引中国游客的独特潜力。他强调，去年，中国赴俄旅客数量占外国游客的第二位，达到97.8万人。
7c37b69b84acc7541bf15fe7f7960b1fadcc1e88.translatedText: Russia is also trying to attract more Chinese tourists during Golden Week. Russia News reported on September 28 that Radikov, director of the Russian Federal Tourism Administration, said on World Tourism Day on September 27 that China is a huge market, with 100 million people traveling abroad every year. And Russia has unique potential to attract Chinese tourists. He emphasized that last year, the number of Chinese tourists to Russia ranked second among foreign tourists, reaching 978,000.

269dbc702a6e142c382327a276612ee60f9b7e44.sourceText: 为了吸引十一期间中国游客到俄罗斯旅游，俄罗斯方面认为，”红色游”是对中国游客最具吸引力的一个项目。俄罗斯旅游署官员西尔琴科表示，目前对苏联时期纪念地感兴趣的中国游客越来越多，因此，应当在全国开辟这样的旅游线路，以吸引更多的中国人到俄罗斯旅游。
269dbc702a6e142c382327a276612ee60f9b7e44.translatedText: In order to attract Chinese tourists to Russia during the National Day holiday, the Russian side believes that "red tourism" is the most attractive project to Chinese tourists. Silchenko, an official of the Russian Tourism Administration, said that there are currently more and more Chinese tourists interested in Soviet-era memorial sites. Therefore, such tourist routes should be opened across the country to attract more Chinese to travel to Russia.

79b525e2e95768f62e274400eb5561da375521ee.sourceText: 亚省开平同乡会来稿：為更进一步促进宗亲及开平之友的团结精神，联络感情，亚省开平同乡会谨定於2012年12月9日（星期日）上午10时至下午2时，在Cesar Chavez Park, 7858 S. 35th Ave, Phoenix 85339 (Baseline Rd & 35th Ave)的公园，首次举办小型的郊游联谊活动，希望参加者依时到场。
79b525e2e95768f62e274400eb5561da375521ee.translatedText: Submission from the Kaiping Association of Kaiping, Alberta: In order to further promote the spirit of unity and connection between clan members and friends in Kaiping, the Kaiping Association of Alberta would like to hold a meeting at Cesar Chavez on December 9, 2012 (Sunday) from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. Park, 7858 S. 35th Ave, Phoenix 85339 (Baseline Rd & 35th Ave) is hosting a small outing and social event for the first time, and we hope that participants will be there on time.

6a49a07b30b365c3572957edc33d1b7e81581185.sourceText: 保险工业近些年因为自然灾害出现了很大的亏损。 保险企业也许是被迫上涨保险费，特别是东南，中西部地区。 某知名保险企业负责人表示：” 我们已经连续四年创纪录的亏损，”哈特维希告诉”今日美国”。 ” 我的感觉是，保费可能会上升4％至5％。” 2008年房主保险每年平均成本在791美元，2010年已经增加到807美元，根据保险信息研究所的数据。 哈特维希告诉”今日美国”，他预测，2011年房主保险全国平均会涨到$ 840。 更多房地产资讯请咨询金信地产Tinna 480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
6a49a07b30b365c3572957edc33d1b7e81581185.translatedText: The insurance industry has suffered huge losses due to natural disasters in recent years. Insurance companies may be forced to increase insurance premiums, especially in the southeast, central and western regions. The head of a well-known insurance company said: "We have had record losses for four consecutive years," Hartwig told USA Today. "My sense is that premiums will probably go up 4 to 5 percent." The average annual cost of homeowners insurance was $791 in 2008 and had increased to $807 in 2010, according to the Insurance Information Institute. Hartwig told USA Today that he predicts the national average for homeowners insurance will rise to $840 in 2011. For more real estate information, please contact Goldtrust Realty Tinna 480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

0ed472a7e6c2864597adc32443f32b34200b082d.sourceText: 共和党总统初选 三强浮现 新近加入选战的德州州长培瑞来势汹汹。(美联社) 共和党2012年的总统提名初选竞赛暖身战即将结束，目前已隐约形成三强逐鹿局面﹕一名立场温和的前州长、一名茶党的红人和一名保守的州长，各自具有优势和弱点。 数月来，虽然保守派对前麻州州长罗穆尼(Mitt Romney)的温和立场以及在麻州推行全民健保改革不满，他在民调中一直居领先地位。 但现在他面临极端保守的国会众议员蜜雪巴克曼(Michele Bachman)的严重挑战，此人在茶党支持下赢得爱阿华州假投票的胜利。这项假投票被视为共和党早期提名战之前的一次关键测试。 罗穆尼和巴克曼还面临长期担任德州州长的培瑞(Rick Perry)的挑战。培瑞是社会问题与财政政策上的保守派，他在德州的经济成绩相当亮丽，他主张小政府政策，本月主持了一场三万人参加的祷告大会。他可以跟巴克曼争夺美国的右翼保守派选民，又可以跟罗穆尼较量治理州政府的经验。 维吉尼亚大学政治研究中心主任萨巴托(Larry Sabato)教授说﹕「他(为共和党)带来在全国大选中获胜的可能性，而巴克曼没有。罗穆尼跟茶党以及共和党最保守分子的关系存在严重问题，培瑞却获得这些人的支持。」 最近数年来全美的失业率一直居高不下，德州创造的就业机会却领先全国。他也是一位竞选高手，在2000年继布什之后，连续三次当选德州州长。 萨巴托说﹕「他(培瑞)将紧追罗穆尼，我不知道罗穆尼是否对培瑞的竞选方式做了充分准备。培瑞长期坚持『焦土』哲学，那就是他长期担任州长的原因。」 另一方面，罗穆尼开展竞选活动比巴克曼和培瑞早了好几个月，获得了共和党重要捐款人的支持，还拥有在全国竞选的经验，因为他在2008年参加了共和党总统候选人的竞争。 纽约国王学院政治学教授柯尔宾说﹕「培瑞尚未经受考验，尽管来自德州的报告说他是一位竞选高手。全国的舞台才能真正考验一个人的能力。」
0ed472a7e6c2864597adc32443f32b34200b082d.translatedText: The top three emerge in the Republican presidential primary. Texas Governor Perry, who has recently joined the campaign, is coming aggressively. (Associated Press) The warm-up battle for the Republican Party's 2012 presidential nomination primary race is coming to an end, and a three-strong race has emerged: a moderate former governor, a Tea Party celebrity and a conservative governor, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Former Massachusetts Gov. Mitt Romney has led polls for months despite conservative dissatisfaction with his moderate stance and his push for universal health care reform in Massachusetts. But now he faces a serious challenge from ultra-conservative Rep. Michele Bachman, who won Iowa's fake vote with Tea Party support. The sham vote was seen as a key test ahead of the early Republican nomination battle. Romney and Buckman also face a challenge from longtime Texas Governor Rick Perry. Perry is a conservative on social issues and fiscal policy. His economic performance in Texas is quite impressive. He advocates small government policies and hosted a prayer meeting attended by 30,000 people this month. He can compete with Buckman for right-wing conservative voters in the United States, and he can compete with Romney for his experience in running state governments. Professor Larry Sabato, director of the Political Research Center at the University of Virginia, said: "He (brings the Republican Party) the possibility of winning the national election, but Bachman does not. Romney has serious problems with the Tea Party and the most conservative elements of the Republican Party, but Perry has the support of these people." In recent years, the unemployment rate in the United States has remained high, but Texas has led the country in job creation. He is also a campaign expert. In 2000, he was elected governor of Texas for three consecutive times after Bush. Sabato said: "He (Perry) will go after Romney, and I don't know if Romney is fully prepared for Perry's campaign style. Perry has long adhered to the 'scorched earth' philosophy, and that is why he has been governor for a long time." Romney, on the other hand, launched his campaign several months earlier than Buckman and Perry, has the support of major Republican donors, and has national campaign experience because he participated in the 2008 Republican presidential candidate competition. Corbin, a political science professor at King's College in New York, said: "Perry has not been tested yet, although reports from Texas say that he is a good campaigner. The national stage can truly test a person's ability."

5c0b052222ebd11f35c756957f235b9c656a9779.translatedText: New Oriental's large-scale open class - teach you to experience belly dance Recently, New Oriental Art School has opened a belly...

08e3b431e6e47e6df955ea8b5434286d0a61377c.sourceText: 新东方大型公开课-教你体验肚皮舞 近期，新东方艺术学校开设了肚皮舞的课程，在学员中引起了非常强烈的反响。肚皮舞是目前风靡全球的将女性健身、减肥、塑形及提升女性身心灵气等多方面完美结合的一种舞蹈。本课程由中国著名的肚皮舞表演艺术家汤可老师担任。为了能让更多的朋友体验这种舞蹈所带来的美好感受和神奇效果。新东方艺术学校将在本校内开设一场免费的肚皮舞公开课，汤可老师将和您一起领略肚皮舞的风采。朋友们，下周末的晚上，就请你穿上健身的衣服，到新东方来放松一下吧。 主讲人：汤可 毕业于云南艺术学院，中国著名的肚皮舞表演艺术家。中东belly dance 协会会员，中国茜娅belly dance培训基地高级教练。师从台湾著名身心灵导师（南怀瑾先生的高徒）林凯韦先生，潜心研习SQ 身心灵的课程，并在昆明创办了”金色主题”身心灵工作坊，把身心灵的课程结合瑜伽融入到舞蹈里面。具有多年的舞蹈教学和大型文艺汇演及公关酒会的策划（编导）经验，多次代表中国到海外表演。曾任云南民族大学民族服饰研究所副所长。2004 年 环球小姐中国西南片区（获奖前十名佳丽）形象设计总监。曾参加云南电视台”女人香”系列节目，主讲形象设计、化妆、礼仪、仪表、仪态、茶道等。 时间：2012年8月25日星期六 晚上7点 地点：新东方艺术学校 1100 N Alma School Rd, Suite 18, Chandler AZ在Ray Road and Alma School Road交叉口的西北角，蓝天中餐馆的北面。 咨询电话：602-490-8613 ； 480-319-1098 或EMAIL至新东方艺术学校邮箱： azeaainfo@gmail.com 海鸥的舞
08e3b431e6e47e6df955ea8b5434286d0a61377c.translatedText: New Oriental's large-scale open class - to teach you to experience belly dance Recently, New Oriental Art School has opened a belly dance course, which has aroused a very strong response among students. Belly dancing is a dance that is currently popular all over the world and perfectly combines many aspects of women's fitness, weight loss, body shaping and improvement of women's body, mind and soul. This course is taught by Tang Ke, a famous belly dance performing artist in China. In order to allow more friends to experience the beautiful feelings and magical effects brought by this kind of dance. New Oriental Art School will hold a free open belly dance class in the school. Teacher Tang Ke will appreciate the style of belly dance with you. Friends, please put on your fitness clothes next weekend night and go to New Oriental to relax. Speaker: Tang Ke graduated from Yunnan University of the Arts and is a famous belly dance performing artist in China. He is a member of the Middle East Belly Dance Association and a senior coach at the Xiya Belly Dance Training Base in China. Under the tutelage of Mr. Lin Kaiwei, a famous Taiwanese body and mind teacher (a disciple of Mr. Nan Huaijin), he devoted himself to studying SQ body and mind courses, and founded the "Golden Theme" body and mind workshop in Kunming, integrating body and mind courses into dance with yoga. He has many years of experience in dance teaching and planning (directing) large-scale cultural performances and public relations receptions, and has performed overseas on behalf of China many times. He once served as deputy director of the National Costume Research Institute of Yunnan University for Nationalities. 2004 Image Design Director of Miss Universe China Southwest Region (top ten winners). She once participated in the "Female Scent" series of Yunnan TV station, giving lectures on image design, makeup, etiquette, appearance, manners, tea ceremony, etc. Time: Saturday, August 25, 2012, 7 pm Location: New Oriental Art School 1100 N Alma School Rd, Suite 18, Chandler AZ At the northwest corner of the intersection of Ray Road and Alma School Road, north of Blue Sky Chinese Restaurant. Inquiry hotline: 602-490-8613; 480-319-1098 or EMAIL to New Oriental Art School Email: azeaainfo@gmail.com The Dance of Seagulls

18cf76d0e9294093db0d5b264252e5af4425024f.sourceText: 7月16日微信＂520hate crime事件交流群＂的二十多朋友，在六福酒家相聚一堂。交流对＂520ASU中国学生在轻轨上被白人袭击＂案件判决的看法。从时间发生到最后的听证结束，大家都献计献策，并到法院现场支持。资深侨领余文劲先生，团结华人社区民众，发起捐款，给法官写信，研究案件进展等活动，为保障受害者的利益，严惩罪犯努力。华人律师伍兆文，Eileen Sullivan, Melissa Ho, Amanda Chua (亚利桑那亚裔美国法律协会主席) and Tony King联合起来义务为受害人提供法律咨询等服务，并拒绝收取任何费用。原先华人社区募集到1300美元，为受害人石晓琳（英译）打官司的善款，没有支出。其中一千元再次捐赠给受害人，希望她能尽快恢复身心健康。
18cf76d0e9294093db0d5b264252e5af4425024f.translatedText: On July 16, more than 20 friends from the WeChat "520hate crime incident exchange group" gathered together at Luk Fook Restaurant. Exchange views on the verdict of the case "520ASU Chinese students were attacked by white people on the light rail". From the moment it happened to the end of the final hearing, everyone contributed ideas and came to the court to support it. Mr. Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader, united the people of the Chinese community, initiated donations, wrote letters to the judge, studied the progress of the case and other activities, in an effort to protect the interests of the victims and severely punish the criminals. Chinese lawyers Wu Zhaowen, Eileen Sullivan, Melissa Ho, Amanda Chua (President of the Arizona Asian American Law Association) and Tony King joined forces to provide legal consultation and other services to the victims on a voluntary basis and refused to charge any fees. It turned out that the Chinese community raised US$1,300 to fight the lawsuit for the victim Shi Xiaolin (English translator), but none was spent. One thousand yuan of which was donated again to the victim in the hope that she could recover her physical and mental health as soon as possible.

38ab9d864c0a804ad384528edc178e1193025ac2.sourceText: 通过本次事件，华人社区侨领，政界人士，法律专业人士，以及普通民众都团结起来，一起为华裔受害者石晓琳献计献策，为捍卫海外华人利益共同发声。
38ab9d864c0a804ad384528edc178e1193025ac2.translatedText: Through this incident, Chinese community leaders, politicians, legal professionals, and ordinary people have united to provide advice and suggestions for the Chinese victim Shi Xiaolin, and to jointly speak out to defend the interests of overseas Chinese.

15dde7c69be74d7c877e73079a079f4dd3c097a7.sourceText: 商务部周二盘前发布数据显示，全美零售额在7月份连续第四个月实现增长，但是0.2%的增幅不及市场预期的0.3%。除去波动比较大的汽车、汽油和建材类产品之后的所谓核心零售额在7月份增长0.5%，这也是今年开年以来出现的最大月度增幅。随着市场对这一数据进行消化，华尔街股市小幅高开后在早盘出现短暂下探，不过由于亚特兰大联储主席表示，联储在退出量化宽松（QE）的决定上还存在一定不确定性，市场担忧情绪获得暂时性缓解，三大股指逐渐转涨，并维持上扬态势直到收盘。
15dde7c69be74d7c877e73079a079f4dd3c097a7.translatedText: Data released by the Department of Commerce before the market opened on Tuesday showed that U.S. retail sales increased for the fourth consecutive month in July, but the 0.2% increase was less than the 0.3% market expectation. So-called core retail sales, which exclude volatile automobiles, gasoline and building materials products, rose 0.5% in July, the largest monthly increase since the start of the year. As the market digested this data, Wall Street stocks opened slightly higher and then briefly dipped in early trading. However, as the president of the Atlanta Fed stated that there was still some uncertainty in the Fed's decision to exit quantitative easing (QE), market concerns were temporarily alleviated. The three major stock indexes gradually turned higher and maintained an upward trend until the close.

b08e57bb234ffdf9a5f305b51aa1a40af3890371.sourceText: 男子偷泳池水被捕 (亚省时报) 偷车，偷电视，偷金钱，甚至偷人都听过吧？但偷游泳池水，听过没有？ 马利科巴郡警员说，美莎居民曼纽奥瓦列因在自己家外的游泳池，用塑料袋装了两袋水而被捕，事后，奥瓦列辩称自己家缺水才到游泳池装了两袋水。但警员在他身上还发现了一个不属于他的游戏机，因不会用而放在家里闲置。
b08e57bb234ffdf9a5f305b51aa1a40af3890371.translatedText: Man arrested for stealing swimming pool water (Alberta Times) Have you heard of stealing cars, stealing TVs, stealing money, and even stealing people? But have you ever heard of stealing swimming pool water? Maricopa County police said that Mesa resident Manuel Ovalle was arrested for filling two bags of water in plastic bags at the swimming pool outside his home. Afterwards, Ovalle claimed that his home was short of water and went to the swimming pool to fill two bags of water. However, the police also found a game console on him that did not belong to him and had been left unused at home because he did not know how to use it.

c2bf609ccc97ac1d293b07a6b5aaacf04d7a1eb9.sourceText: 华裔特色在亚省建州百年庆典活动初露头角(图) （亚省时报谢成彦 太阳鸟特约记者冯海燕报道） ２月１４日上午９点，亚利桑那州建州１００年庆典活动在州政府隆重举行。州长简布鲁尔回顾了１００年来亚利桑那州的建立和发展，全州人民的努力，相信在州政府的带领下，亚利桑那州会变得更加强大。在这个全州同庆的日子里，亚利桑那的华裔政客们也到现场支持。庆典前，由凤凰城华人侨团联合总会（侨联）派出具有中国民族特色的舞狮表演，为亚利桑那州的生日庆典做了开场表演，为亚利桑那祈福。资深侨领余文劲，众议院余艳芬，前众议院黄仕钧，侨联主席邓朝驹，副主席余长全，副主席张华芳等侨领都参加活动进行庆祝。 本次庆典由州政府主办，现场活动持续三天，2月11号中午12点到下午10点与2月12号中午12点到下午6点在凤凰城城区举行了彩街游行庆祝活动。活动主要由分成8部分内容构成：娱乐、饮食、音乐、文化摊、全家游乐区、酒园、工艺品和教育亭子。 中国代表团当天在中央舞台献上了舞狮、武术表演和一场中国舞蹈，赢得了台下观众的阵阵掌声。 ”’我是半个月前接到[表演]通知的，”本次舞蹈表演的负责人新东方艺术学校校长吕丽华说到。”我们的小演员们都有好几年的表演经验了，她们不紧张。”’而由DynamicWushu带来的武术表演更是当天表演的一个小高潮，台下观众反应热烈，与演员 积极互动。 除表演外，中国代表团另在文化区拥有2个文化摊，在四、五十个文化摊中占住了一席之地，打出了中国的响亮名片。文化摊一个主推饮食，一个主推文化，摊前驻足的人络绎不绝。侨联下属的中国餐馆协会在当天准备了600位VIP席位的饭菜，为本次活动贡献了自己的力量。
c2bf609ccc97ac1d293b07a6b5aaacf04d7a1eb9.translatedText: Chinese characteristics are emerging in the centenary celebrations of Arizona's statehood (photo) (Reported by Xie Chengyan of the Alberta Times and Feng Haiyan, Sunbird special correspondent) At 9 a.m. on February 14, the 100th anniversary celebration of Arizona's statehood was held grandly at the state government. Governor Jane Brewer reviewed the establishment and development of Arizona over the past 100 years and the efforts of people across the state, and believed that under the leadership of the state government, Arizona will become stronger. On this day of celebration across the state, Chinese-American politicians in Arizona also came to support the event. Before the celebration, the Phoenix Federation of Chinese Overseas Chinese Associations (Overseas Chinese Federation) sent a lion dance performance with Chinese characteristics to open Arizona's birthday celebration and pray for Arizona. Senior overseas Chinese leaders Yu Wenjin, House of Representatives Yu Yanfen, former House of Representatives Huang Shijun, Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Deng Chaoju, Vice Chairman Yu Changquan, Vice Chairman Zhang Huafang and other overseas Chinese leaders participated in the event to celebrate. The celebration was hosted by the state government, and the on-site activities lasted for three days. The Colorful Street Parade celebrations were held in downtown Phoenix from 12 noon to 10 pm on February 11th and from 12noon to 6pm on February 12th. The event is mainly divided into 8 parts: entertainment, food, music, cultural stalls, family play area, wine garden, crafts and educational pavilion. The Chinese delegation presented lion dance, martial arts performances and a Chinese dance on the central stage that day, winning rounds of applause from the audience. "'I received the notice [of the performance] half a month ago," said Lu Lihua, the principal of New Oriental Art School, who is in charge of this dance performance. "Our young actors have several years of performance experience, and they are not nervous." The martial arts performance presented by Dynamic Wushu was a small climax of the day's performance. The audience responded enthusiastically and actively interacted with the actors. In addition to performances, the Chinese delegation also owns two cultural stalls in the cultural area, occupying a place among the forty or fifty cultural stalls, and playing a famous business card of China. One of the cultural stalls focuses on food and the other focuses on culture. There is an endless stream of people stopping in front of the stalls. The Chinese Restaurant Association, a subsidiary of the Overseas Chinese Federation, prepared meals for 600 VIP seats that day and contributed to this event.

f35df12b4182630729c2b98d83dee76dfc599e55.sourceText: 麦凯恩称奥巴马应负大使遇难全责 （亚省时报） 针对国务卿希拉里对驻利比亚大使遇袭身亡承担责任的表态，本州共和党参议员约翰麦凯恩表示赞赏，但他坚称白宫仍需澄清这件事，并表示作为军队总司令的奥巴马应该对此负有责任。 参议员麦凯恩说，(希拉里担责)这是个值得让人称赞的姿态，”尤其是当白宫正在尽力避开承担任何责任的时候”。 麦凯恩连同其他2名共和党参议员在一项声明中发表了上述言论。 他们认为，维护美国人在全世界的安全终究是总司令的职责，但当前美国经济的困境使得安全问题受到了负面影响。 此外，这三位共和党议员还发出质疑，他们称美国驻利比亚班加西领事馆遭袭明显是恐怖事件，为何当局要把它归结于一部反伊斯兰电影所惹的祸呢？据此，他们要求奥巴马政府解释清楚，”我们依然认为，美国人民应该了解事情的全貌。” 他们还说，”如果奥巴马不知道在班加西不断升级的恐怖主义威胁，那么我们会对他的国家安全团队失去信任；如果他在袭击发生之前就得知了此事，那么他本人就应承担这个悲剧的全部责任。” 据悉，9月11日，美国大使克里斯托弗?#21490;蒂文斯及其他3名外交官在美驻利比亚班加西领事馆遇袭身亡。此后，美国共和党就此事一直向民主党发难，对奥巴马的外交政策进行批判。 这一悲剧性事件转而变成政治话题，成为影响美国总统选举选情的一个因素。国务卿希拉里为了避开大选的”政治陷阱”，于日前表示将承担美国驻利比亚大使遇袭身亡的责任。
f35df12b4182630729c2b98d83dee76dfc599e55.translatedText: McCain said Obama should bear full responsibility for the death of the ambassador (Alberta Times) In response to Secretary of State Hillary Clinton's statement that she took responsibility for the attack and death of the ambassador to Libya, Republican Senator John McCain expressed his appreciation, but he insisted that the White House still needs to clarify the matter and said that Obama, as the commander-in-chief of the military, should bear the responsibility. Senator McCain said it was a commendable gesture "especially when the White House is trying to avoid taking any responsibility." McCain, along with two other Republican senators, made the remarks in a statement. They believe that maintaining the security of Americans around the world is ultimately the responsibility of the commander-in-chief, but the current plight of the U.S. economy has negatively affected security issues. In addition, the three Republican congressmen also raised questions. They said that the attack on the U.S. Consulate in Benghazi, Libya, was obviously a terrorist incident. Why did the authorities attribute it to an anti-Islamic movie? Accordingly, they asked the Obama administration to explain clearly, "We still believe that the American people deserve to know the full story." They also said, "If Obama was not aware of the escalating terrorist threat in Benghazi, then we would have lost trust in his national security team; if he was informed of the attack before it occurred, then he himself should bear full responsibility for this tragedy." It is reported that on September 11, US Ambassador Christopher Teevens and three other diplomats were attacked and killed at the US Consulate in Benghazi, Libya. Since then, the US Republican Party has been challenging the Democratic Party on this matter and criticizing Obama's foreign policy. This tragic incident turned into a political topic and became a factor affecting the US presidential election. In order to avoid the "political trap" of the general election, Secretary of State Hillary Clinton recently stated that she would take responsibility for the attack and death of the US ambassador to Libya.

223ae134e2cf1c6d912b6a9894a588c5e680ca93.sourceText: （撰稿：斐匿中文学校校长崔增祁） 值圣诞佳节和新的一年来临之际，12月22日大凤凰城地区和图桑市的七所中文学校负责人共聚太平洋布菲歺厅庆贺节日，交流办学经验，共同研究和探讨在未来年度如何加强合作与交流，为传播中华文化作出更好的成绩。参加聚会交流的有图桑祖筍中文学校校长陈荣基、副校长曹佩琴，土桑国语基督徒教会中文学校副校长杨峰，斐匿中文学校校长崔增祁，凤城华人基督教中文学校校长李珍， 凤城中文学校董事会召集人谢健明，希望中文学校董事长何世江、校长谢小红、董事会顾问黄双双、现代中文学校董事长宋良武、校长朱岩、教学副校长田韶微，希望中文学校董事会顾问、全美中文学校协会会长帅致若。
223ae134e2cf1c6d912b6a9894a588c5e680ca93.translatedText: (Written by Cui Zengqi, principal of Feini Chinese School) On the occasion of Christmas and the new year, on December 22, heads of seven Chinese schools in the greater Phoenix area and Tucson gathered at the Pacific Buffet Hall to celebrate the holiday, exchange school experience, and jointly study and discuss how to strengthen cooperation and exchanges in the coming years to make better achievements in spreading Chinese culture. Participating in the gathering and exchanges were Chen Rongji, principal of Tucson Zusun Chinese School, and Cao Peiqin, vice principal of Tucson Mandarin Christian Church Chinese School; Yang Feng, vice principal of Tucson Mandarin Christian Church Chinese School; Cui Zengqi, principal of Feini Chinese School; Li Zhen, principal of Fengcheng Chinese Christian School; Fengcheng Chinese School Board Convener Xie Jianming, Hope Chinese School Chairman He Shijiang, Principal Xie Xiaohong, Board Advisor Huang Shuangshuang, Modern Chinese School Chairman Song Liangwu, Principal Zhu Yan, Teaching Vice Principal Tian Shaowei, Hope Chinese School Board Advisor and President of the National Chinese Schools Association Shuai Zhiruo.

3316c7e7a5ebf299bc649b6c4c0bc64e04bd7850.sourceText: 聚会的华文教育人员合影
3316c7e7a5ebf299bc649b6c4c0bc64e04bd7850.translatedText: A group photo of Chinese education personnel gathered at the gathering

bf50021ace60fe1ce75b8def2f387057aecfeabf.sourceText: 各中文学校董事长或校长分别介绍了近年来学校发展的近况和教学管理措施，并对今后在管理和教学方面如何加强合作、互通讯息提出了许多宝贵的建议。祖筍中文学校校长陈荣基就中文学校办学经验作了主题发言。该校成立于1950年，是我省建立最早的中文学校，有着雄厚的师资力量和丰富的教学经验，近年来，在中国侨办举办的中华文化知识大赛、世界华文作文大赛多次获奖，并在具有较高水平的海外华裔青少年”鲁迅文学奖”作文比赛中有学生获奖。
bf50021ace60fe1ce75b8def2f387057aecfeabf.translatedText: The chairman or principal of each Chinese school introduced the current status of school development and teaching management measures in recent years, and put forward many valuable suggestions on how to strengthen cooperation and exchange information in management and teaching in the future. Chen Rongji, principal of Zusun Chinese School, gave a keynote speech on the experience of running Chinese schools. The school was founded in 1950 and is the earliest Chinese school established in our province. It has strong teaching staff and rich teaching experience. In recent years, it has won many awards in the Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition and the World Chinese Composition Competition organized by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of China, and students have won awards in the "Lu Xun Literature Award" composition competition for overseas Chinese teenagers with a high level.

34f38342cd7599eabfb40b5293c40634f9f3ef90.sourceText: 今年本州在华文教育领域最大的喜讯是，现代中文学校和希望中文学校双双被中国国家侨务办公室办授予海外华文教育示范单位。这两所学校都是在九十年代相继建立起来的中文学校，经过一批又一批新老志愿者坚持不懈的努力，在办学规模、教学模式、师资培训、教学质量和成果方面都取得了优异的成绩，在学校管理、资金筹集和合作办学等方面也积累了许多宝贵经验。大家一致认为，授予示范学校称号是对这两所学校近二十年来取得的教学成果的肯定与鼓励，也为我们所有从事华文教育的学校和人员树立了学习的榜样。
34f38342cd7599eabfb40b5293c40634f9f3ef90.translatedText: The biggest good news in the field of Chinese education in this state this year is that both Modern Chinese School and Hope Chinese School were awarded overseas Chinese education demonstration units by the State Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of China. Both schools were established Chinese schools in the 1990s. Through the unremitting efforts of batches of new and old volunteers, they have achieved excellent results in school scale, teaching mode, teacher training, teaching quality and results. They have also accumulated a lot of valuable experience in school management, fund raising and cooperative school running. Everyone agreed that being awarded the title of Model School is an affirmation and encouragement of the teaching achievements of these two schools in the past two decades, and it also sets an example for all our schools and personnel engaged in Chinese education to learn from.

cdb2c74b49fcff7a96e9bbeeaf073281426f4805.sourceText: 在座的中文学校的董事长和校长们都认为，每所中文学校，有着不同的环境和背景，通过多年的坚持努力，办出了多元化的各具特色的学校，适应社会的需求，目标都是为了更好地传播中华文化。 大家表达了一个共同的心声是：虽然在海外办华文教育都遇到许许多多的困难，每所学校的义工都感受过其中艰辛的滋味，但大家都有坚定信念，从不言放弃，所有的学校义工都有一颗热爱中华文化的心，都有传承和弘扬中华文化的坚定信念，在艰辛中我们分享着成功的喜悦。
cdb2c74b49fcff7a96e9bbeeaf073281426f4805.translatedText: The chairmen and principals of the Chinese schools here believe that each Chinese school has a different environment and background. Through years of persistent efforts, it has developed a diversified and unique school to adapt to the needs of society, with the goal of better spreading Chinese culture. Everyone expressed a common sentiment: Although running Chinese education overseas encounters many difficulties, and volunteers from every school have experienced the hardships, we all have firm beliefs and never give up. All school volunteers have a heart that loves Chinese culture and a firm belief in inheriting and promoting Chinese culture. In the midst of hardships, we share the joy of success.

25c3f6c097ce31b1dcb912d198af73d5c221192d.sourceText: 到会的人员对几十年来老华侨们在创建和建设中文学校过程中作出的贡献表示敬意；尤其对创建希望、现代两所中文学校付出过努力、至今还关心和支持华文教育的希望中文学校第一任校长唐孝先老师和现代中文学校创办人之一陆平老师等表示敬意。
25c3f6c097ce31b1dcb912d198af73d5c221192d.translatedText: Those present at the meeting paid tribute to the contributions of the old overseas Chinese in the creation and construction of Chinese schools over the past decades; they especially paid tribute to the first principal of Hope Chinese School, Mr. Tang Xiaoxian, and one of the founders of Modern Chinese School, Mr. Lu Ping, who had worked hard to found two Chinese schools, Hope and Modern, and still care and support Chinese education.

97e1143d7eab99535210ad5f56490043838caa6f.sourceText: 同行们难得在一起，总有説不完的话题。大家希望校长交流会能有一个模式延续下 来。告别的时，希望中文学校的何世江董事长和谢小红校长把他们刚刚收到的中国海外交流协会捐赠的”华星书屋”项目的图书和教学参考书分送给到会的学校，与大家一起分享。
97e1143d7eab99535210ad5f56490043838caa6f.translatedText: It is rare for colleagues to be together, and there is always endless topics to talk about. Everyone hopes that the principal exchange meeting can continue as a model. When bidding farewell, I hope that Chairman He Shijiang and Principal Xie Xiaohong of the Chinese School will distribute the books and teaching reference books from the "Huaxing Bookstore" project donated by the China Overseas Exchange Association to the schools present and share them with everyone.

02b9881de0e73f1cd6f4550f0739a888e92dbed6.translatedText: A page of Chinese history in Tucson - a trip to the grocery store

acce780a9e5cf1d340bd99ec603fe04d9447909f.sourceText: 图桑的华人历史之一页－杂货店之旅 (图桑鲍家麟来稿) 九月十五日是周末﹐炎夏已近尾声﹐气温不再是三位数了…
acce780a9e5cf1d340bd99ec603fe04d9447909f.translatedText: A page of Chinese history in Tucson - a trip to the grocery store (contributed by Bao Jialin, Tucson) September 15th is the weekend, the hot summer is coming to an end, and the temperature is no longer in three digits...

708c228857c872e1d706f4747fd2749d86904646.sourceText: 九月十五日是周末﹐炎夏已近尾声﹐气温不再是三位数了。 那天晴空万里﹐ 艳阳高挂。 华人文化中心雇来的一辆豪华巴士﹐满载各行各业的﹑关心华美族历史 的老老少少﹐要去重温一段﹑七八十年前﹐图桑华人的杂货店的历史。
708c228857c872e1d706f4747fd2749d86904646.translatedText: September 15th is the weekend, the hot summer is coming to an end, and the temperature is no longer in three digits. That day the sky was clear and the sun was shining high. A luxury bus hired by the Chinese Cultural Center was filled with people of all ages and from all walks of life who were concerned about the history of the Chinese American people. They were going to relive the history of a Chinese grocery store in Tucson seventy or eighty years ago.

8a3c8b40814d1e24e0a1024015574e29c6d79c60.sourceText: 首先去的是 一家南边BarrioHollywood的墨西哥饼店﹐专售托地拉饼。 然后﹐巴士过艾伦商店，这是 华人文化中心主席李佩奇家的商店。 第二站是安尼塔街的安尼塔商店﹐现由 墨裔人士经营﹐所售墨式点心香甜可口。 以前这是华人经营的商店。 第三站是第三 大道与第九街交叉口的帝国商店﹐目前仍由华人经营﹐大家在此享用热狗午餐。 第 四站是原为李瑞彬祖父所开的店铺﹐现为拉普马委拉商店。 最后一站是城中区一家 老人公寓﹐邻近旧日华人聚居之地。 该区绝大部份已在建造市府文化中心表演厅时 拆除﹐保存的只剩当年的黑白照片。
8a3c8b40814d1e24e0a1024015574e29c6d79c60.translatedText: The first thing I went to was a Mexican tortilla shop in BarrioHollywood in the south, which specializes in tortellini. Then, the bus passed Allen's Store, which is the store owned by Peggy Lee, chairman of the Chinese Cultural Center. The second stop is the Anita store on Anita Street, which is now run by Mexicans. The Mexican snacks sold are sweet and delicious. This used to be a Chinese-run shop. The third stop was the Empire Store at the intersection of Third Avenue and Ninth Street, which is still run by Chinese people. Everyone enjoyed a hot dog lunch here. The fourth stop is the store originally opened by Li Ruibin’s grandfather, now it is Lapu Maweila Store. The last stop was an apartment for the elderly in Chengzhong District, near the old Chinese settlement. Most of this area has been demolished during the construction of the Municipal Cultural Center Performance Hall, and only black-and-white photos from that year remain.

31fcf43efbb583e10d65a75a4c67f33d5202d1f8.sourceText: 每至一站﹐就可看到展示的旧日照片和影片﹐并有舞狮表演﹐中国舞蹈和墨国舞蹈﹐ 又有马里亚奇乐队又奏又唱。 在一个清静点的角落﹐有专人负责搜集邻近老人的口 述见闻﹐以保存这段珍贵的历史。
31fcf43efbb583e10d65a75a4c67f33d5202d1f8.translatedText: At each stop, you can see old photos and videos on display, as well as lion dance performances, Chinese dances and Mexican dances, as well as Mariachi bands playing and singing. In a quiet corner, there is a dedicated person responsible for collecting the oral experiences of the elderly people nearby in order to preserve this precious history.

81669ee75834557342dcb759f675a7d174bd60b3.sourceText: 每至一站﹐即由宾州大学的戴迦朵(Grace Delgado)教授解说﹐她说当年华墨在此融 洽相处﹐华人也能互助互信。 图桑华人杂货店在全盛时期有三百多家。 短短的艾伦 街就有八九家华人店铺﹐彼此没有恶性竞争﹐竟能协调合作而共存共荣。 譬如甲卖 牛肉﹐其余八家就不卖牛肉。 有的卖干货﹑有的卖面包点心。 戴迦朵教授的新书﹐ 今年刚由史旦福大学出版﹐题目是”变华人为墨西哥人”﹐图桑华人文化中心有售。 有的墨西哥人爱吃的东西还是华人发明的。 例如萨拉地多﹐在切了一半的柠檬上﹐嵌 进一颗酸梅﹐酸上加酸﹐吃的时候能让人酸得做鬼脸。 但这是自然产品﹑健康食 物。 帮助大家回忆这段历史的有华人会馆主席谭积辉﹐华人文化中心主席李佩奇﹐中心 的历史小组召集人白若冰(Robin Blackwood)﹐李瑞彬﹐和MaryMalaby. 李佩奇说 她小时候的玩伴几乎都是墨裔。 最后一站还展示一辆保存在楼地欧博物馆(Rodeo Museum) 的李恭的马车。 早年Mary Malaby的祖父李恭在回归中国时﹐托人将之出售﹐博物馆的人以七十五元购得﹐目前已 整旧如新。 为了”杂货店之旅”’﹐特地由博物馆运来展览﹐还有专人向好奇的人详 细解说。 下午六时﹐大家才踏上归程﹐都觉得这是一个很有意义﹐也是很成功的活动。
81669ee75834557342dcb759f675a7d174bd60b3.translatedText: At each stop, Professor Grace Delgado from the University of Pennsylvania will explain. She said that the Chinese and Mexicans lived harmoniously here, and the Chinese could help and trust each other. In its heyday, there were more than 300 Chinese grocery stores in Tucson. There are eight or nine Chinese shops in Allen Street. There is no vicious competition between them, but they can coordinate and cooperate to coexist and prosper together. For example, if A sells beef, the other eight stores do not sell beef. Some sell dry goods, and some sell bread and snacks. Professor Decgado's new book was just published this year by Stanford University. It is titled "Transforming Chinese into Mexicans" and is available for sale at the Tucson Chinese Cultural Center. Some of the things Mexicans love to eat were invented by the Chinese. For example, saladeto is made by inserting a sour plum into a half-cut lemon, adding sourness to the sourness. It can make people grimace with sourness when eating it. But this is a natural product, healthy food. Helping everyone recall this period of history were Chinese Association Chairman Tan Jihui, Chinese Cultural Center Chairman Li Peiqi, center's history group convener Robin Blackwood, Li Ruibin, and Mary Malaby. Li Peiqi said that almost all of her playmates when she was a child were Mexicans. The last stop also displays Li Gong's carriage preserved in the Rodeo Museum. When Mary Malaby's grandfather Li Gong returned to China in the early years, he asked someone to sell it. Someone from the museum bought it for 75 yuan. It is now as good as new. For the "Grocery Store Tour", the museum specially brought it to the exhibition, and a dedicated person explained it in detail to those who were curious. At 6 p.m., everyone headed back home. They all felt that this was a very meaningful and successful event.

ee7da42086befcddd38ce091910c858875dce612.sourceText: １月３日，微博上几幅”春运装备”图引来众网友的强势围观，让人拍案叫绝，并立刻掀起了2012年春运的第一波”调侃潮”。昨天记者经多方打听，终于找到了”春运装备”图的原创作者miss王，而其创作的”春运青年”图谱，更是把2011年特火的普通青年、文艺青年、2B青年瞬间”秒杀”了。
ee7da42086befcddd38ce091910c858875dce612.translatedText: On January 3, several pictures of "Spring Festival Transport Equipment" posted on Weibo attracted a lot of attention from netizens, making people marvel and immediately set off the first wave of "ridicule" about the 2012 Spring Festival Transport. Yesterday, after many inquiries, the reporter finally found the original author of the "Spring Festival Transport Equipment" picture, Miss Wang, and the "Spring Festival Youth" picture created by him instantly "killed" ordinary youths, literary youths, and 2B youths who were particularly popular in 2011.

56b2c6525dbf30c4cfa060290ef40e200624d4f2.translatedText: "Screaming chicken" clears the way, the tattoo stickers are particularly domineering

c3003517938729016b999bbcd5eb6596fb455381.sourceText: 在miss王的创作中，”让人远离你的春运装备”最是令人称绝：那由无数颗尖尖的铆钉组成的平底鞋，有个很霸气的名字”拒踩铆钉鞋”，一旦踩到必能血溅五步，亲，淘宝就有实物哦，还可以挤地铁、公交时候穿。全身金黄叫声惊悚的那只鸡，有个很应景的名字叫”开道惨叫鸡”，双手一捏，惨叫鸡那撕心裂肺的叫声响彻车厢，过道上连垃圾都不敢待着。还有个特霸气的文身贴纸往身上一粘，立马变黑道，方圆3尺无人近身，保平安最给力。最后那惊悚的血浆包饮料一喝，必然让所见之人狂癫不止！
c3003517938729016b999bbcd5eb6596fb455381.translatedText: Among miss Wang's creations, "Spring Festival travel equipment that keeps people away from you" is the most It’s amazing: those flat shoes composed of countless pointed rivets have a very domineering name of “refuse to step on rivet shoes”. Once you step on them, you will be splashed with blood for five steps. Dear, Taobao has the real ones. You can also wear them when squeezing the subway or bus. The chicken with a golden body and a frightening squawking was aptly named the "Screaming Chicken". With a squeeze of both hands, the screaming chicken's heart-rending cry resounded throughout the carriage, and even the garbage was not allowed to stand in the aisle. There is also a very domineering tattoo sticker that once you stick it on your body, you will immediately turn into a gangster, and no one will come close within a 3-foot radius, which is the best way to keep you safe. The last drink of the terrifying plasma pack drink will definitely drive everyone who sees it crazy!

f128fd4f2be30136709d3f5cec8d89afdfb96539.sourceText: 防盗内裤、迷你麻将桌、供电量720日的山寨手机、成人尿不湿、无三聚氰胺添加猛牛一头、蛇皮编织袋、折叠随手凳、开道特权证厖在miss王创作的”春运骨灰级装备”中，最深入人心的就是迷你麻将桌，长路漫漫，没准能把车费赢回来！广大网友大力建议铁道部也放开一点，搞几个常配麻将桌，这才叫人性化管理嘛！对了，还要记得带上无三聚氰胺添加的猛牛一头，渴的时候还能随时挤奶喝！
f128fd4f2be30136709d3f5cec8d89afdfb96539.translatedText: Anti-theft underwear, mini mahjong table, copycat mobile phone with 720-day power supply, and adult diapers , melamine-free bull head, snakeskin woven bag, foldable stool, lane privilege certificate. Among the "Spring Festival Hardware Equipment" created by miss Wang, the most popular one is the mini mahjong table. It's a long journey, but you may be able to win back the fare! The majority of netizens strongly suggest that the Ministry of Railways should also be more liberal and establish a few regular mahjong tables. This is called humanized management! By the way, remember to bring a melamine-free cow so you can milk it and drink it anytime you are thirsty!

9b081c7337c087a21a0a8e16c4d398aaa4081cb2.sourceText: 春运装备不同，春运青年分”四类”
9b081c7337c087a21a0a8e16c4d398aaa4081cb2.translatedText: Different Spring Festival transportation equipment, Spring Festival transportation youth are divided into "four categories"

d8e7e60d5203568e25e715d5079f59e76b3df1b6.sourceText: 根据”春运装备”的不同，”春运青年”的分类也格外迥异！蛇皮袋、尿不湿、板凳傍身的青年叫”苦逼青年”；安全锤、防狼喷雾、方针摄像头保平安的叫”迫害妄想青年”；打坐垫、颈枕、功夫茶会享受的叫”淡定青年”；随身携带线装本史记、高脚杯、欧洲旅行指南的光荣地称作”装13青年”厖在”春运青年”面前，更是把2011年火遍网络的普通青年、文艺青年、2B青年瞬间成为了浮云！
d8e7e60d5203568e25e715d5079f59e76b3df1b6.translatedText: According to the different "Spring Festival transportation equipment", the classification of "Spring Festival transportation youth" is also very different! Young people who wear snakeskin bags, diapers, and benches are called "hard-working young people"; those who wear safety hammers, anti-wolf spray, and target cameras to ensure safety are called "persecuted and delusional young people"; those who enjoy meditation cushions, neck pillows, and Kung Fu tea parties are called "calm young people"; those who carry them with them everywhere Threaded historical records, goblets, and European travel guides, gloriously called "Youth Pretended 13", loomed in front of the "Youth during the Spring Festival", turning the ordinary youths, literary youths, and 2B youths who became popular on the Internet in 2011 into a cloud in an instant!
