c8f3152ae587f3c7a690b53899cec289d3a59a6c.translatedText: Four friends complained about the fun of the Spring Festival travel

6dff4b6f6d5b0855e5167e5b8f417c482d3fbc9a.sourceText: 以上的”春运装备”和”春运青年”创作者有4个人，主力手Miss王现在在北京一家网站担任编辑，”有一个朋友历经千辛万苦买到一张回家的票后，4个人就凑在一起吐槽自个儿的经历，就这么给创作出来了。”Miss王回忆说，春运最惨的经历是学生时候，”到重庆的T9 啊，很拥挤啊，硬座啊，那时候我忘了火车提速么，是28小时还是多久，反正这28小时我没有去厕所过，因为厕所里都是人，28小时里也没有吃饭，看到人多就不想吃了。
6dff4b6f6d5b0855e5167e5b8f417c482d3fbc9a.translatedText: There are 4 creators of the above "Spring Festival Transport Equipment" and "Spring Festival Transport Youth", the main player is M Miss Wang now works as an editor for a website in Beijing. “After a friend went through all kinds of hardships to buy a ticket to go home, the four of us got together to complain about their experiences, and that’s how we created it.” Miss Wang recalled that the worst experience during the Spring Festival travel period was when she was a student, “Going to T9 in Chongqing Ah, it’s very crowded, hard seats. I forgot about the train speed increase at that time. Is it 28 hours or how long? Anyway, I haven’t been to the toilet in the past 28 hours because the toilets are full of people. I haven’t eaten in 28 hours. I don’t want to eat when I see so many people.

b0cf55524a78ae181fd260dac13629da69f30319.sourceText: 而”春运青年”的分类更逗，”这个真是吹牛时搞出来的，因为身边人的这些症状越发严重，运用到春运中就特逗！”4个创作者都说，调侃春运只想说春运就是这么苦的事，”春运青年”更是伤不起啊！
b0cf55524a78ae181fd260dac13629da69f30319.translatedText: And the classification of "Spring Festival Youth" is even more funny. "This is really made when I was bragging, because the symptoms of people around me are getting more and more serious. It is very funny when applied to the Spring Festival!" "The four creators all said that when they made fun of the Spring Festival Transport, they just wanted to say that the Spring Festival Transport was such a hard thing, and the "Youth during the Spring Festival Transport" couldn't afford to be hurt!

e8c7d4df48ebf4fd8063128bfbd26aad33eaba0c.translatedText: Phoenix PEN Club Ye Xinjie: Lotus. You were born in the mud, but you refused to be contaminated by filth. Trampled the mud under your feet. You only want to cuddle up with the clear water. Your scent is fragrant and the fragrance is stronger than the distance. You are fresh and refined. Standing in the water, you do not grow branches or vines, nor do you want to grow side branches. You stand there clean, but do not look coquettish. You are not afraid of the scorching sun. You emerge from the mud but are not stained. You are a humble gentleman among flowers. You are unwilling to join the flow and join in the pollution. You have broken the fate of fate. You are pure and unstained. You stand tall and tall, unwilling to surrender to fate. You are only willing to be surrounded by clear water. Keep the holiness of the soul to express the way of life

12bcc25edeaa9e628e8363b9d44d77cac36cf761.sourceText: 【 侨报网 3月13日综合报道】自特朗普竞选美国总统以来，就主张严厉打击非法移民，并严格控制难民的接收数量。上任后，他通过提高移民申请要求、缩减”政治庇护”等一系列措施来兑现当初的承诺。事实证明，他成功了！2017年美国接收难民的数量达到2002年以来最低水平；同年，美国移民与海关执法局（简称ICE）共逮捕了14.347万非法移民，数量创下近3年来的新高。
12bcc25edeaa9e628e8363b9d44d77cac36cf761.translatedText: [Qiaobao.com, March 13th Comprehensive Report] Since Trump ran for the US President, he has advocated a severe crackdown on illegal immigration and strictly controlled the number of refugees accepted. After taking office, he fulfilled his original promise through a series of measures such as increasing immigration application requirements and reducing "political asylum." Facts have proved that he succeeded! In 2017, the number of refugees admitted to the United States reached the lowest level since 2002; in the same year, the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) arrested a total of 143,470 illegal immigrants, a record high in the past three years.

c0aed4bdf6e30115c8c969db765d329a83499c10.sourceText: 据中新网报道，根据国务院的数据，自特朗普2017年1月上任以来至12月31日，特朗普政府共接受了29022名难民，为2002年以来的最低值。
c0aed4bdf6e30115c8c969db765d329a83499c10.translatedText: According to China News Service, according to data from the State Department, since Trump took office in January 2017 to December 31, the Trump administration accepted a total of 29,022 refugees, the lowest since 2002.

b81f90492c9215ee0f0314d383542868593c8f5a.sourceText: 2002年，美国共接受了29468名难民，在此前的2001年，美国发生了911恐怖袭击，此后美国政府减少了所有合法移民的数量。
b81f90492c9215ee0f0314d383542868593c8f5a.translatedText: In 2002, the United States accepted a total of 29,468 refugees. In 2001, the September 11 terrorist attacks occurred in the United States. After that, the U.S. government reduced the number of all legal immigrants.

3907f985918dac3c454cd406ec2259ba035c1fb8.sourceText: 据悉，美国在2018年接受难民的数量将会持续下降，特朗普政府计划新的一年最多接收4.5万难民，这是收容难民法出台37年以来的最低值。
3907f985918dac3c454cd406ec2259ba035c1fb8.translatedText: It is reported that the number of refugees accepted by the United States will continue to decline in 2018. The Trump administration plans to accept up to 45,000 refugees in the new year, which is the lowest value in the 37 years since the refugee admission law was introduced.

ee4b4449bd8b7eb0b73d5fec69354e1a72dde8b0.sourceText: 此外，国务院已告知难民机构，随着特朗普削减入境美国的难民人数，2018年当局将大幅收缩全美安置难民办公室的数量。美国的难民安置是由九个非营利机构处理，他们接受联邦政府的资金，监督数百个地方办公室，帮助新移民适应新生活。
ee4b4449bd8b7eb0b73d5fec69354e1a72dde8b0.translatedText: In addition, the State Department has informed refugee agencies that as Trump cuts the number of refugees entering the United States, the authorities will significantly shrink the number of refugee resettlement offices across the United States in 2018. Refugee resettlement in the United States is handled by nine nonprofit agencies, which receive federal funds and oversee hundreds of local offices that help newcomers adjust to their new lives.

ffe1a3bbfd6035265c89495276fa1b0b4b4e6ccc.sourceText: 华盛顿移民研究中心执行主任克里克里安表示：”特朗普实现了选举时的承诺，他(特朗普)说了他要做，他确实这么做了。”
ffe1a3bbfd6035265c89495276fa1b0b4b4e6ccc.translatedText: Executive director of the Center for Immigration Studies in Washington, Krikorian, said: "Trump has fulfilled his election promise. He (Trump) said he would do it, and he did it."

02fc31fbcacee8dd59072c503087bbaf07ede7a6.sourceText: 美国移民举起抗议牌。中新社图片
02fc31fbcacee8dd59072c503087bbaf07ede7a6.translatedText: Immigrants in the United States held up protest signs. China News Service Picture

4ea617c9d15a0af0540602e5e908ab8e25e4e73d.sourceText: 另外，皮尤中心2月发布的最新数据显示，ICE在2017年共逮捕了14万3470人，比2016年大幅上升了30%。其中被捕人数上升最多的是佛州、德州北部以及奥克拉荷马州，光是达拉斯地区去年就有16500名无证移民被捕。
4ea617c9d15a0af0540602e5e908ab8e25e4e73d.translatedText: In addition, the latest data released by the Pew Center in February showed that ICE arrested a total of 143,470 people in 2017, a significant increase of 30% from 2016. The largest increases in arrests occurred in Florida, northern Texas and Oklahoma. In the Dallas area alone, 16,500 undocumented immigrants were arrested last year.

94054a4a7a7d8edcfd1680880f04a5df040ad3ea.sourceText: 此外在2016-2017年间，新奥尔良、亚特兰大、波士顿以及底特律地区的无证移民被捕案例也上升了超过50%。
94054a4a7a7d8edcfd1680880f04a5df040ad3ea.translatedText: In addition, between 2016 and 2017, the number of arrests of undocumented immigrants in New Orleans, Atlanta, Boston and Detroit also increased by more than 50%.

9ecf56fbc293df4e30bd33740c91b828bc4aecbe.sourceText: 国民党亚利桑那直属分部3月24日上午10:30分在凤凰城红锅餐厅举行党员活动热烈庆祝马英九大选成功。当天，曾到台湾参加选举拉票的党员，纷纷上台给大家讲述拉票活动中的趣事，让台下的听众都笑成一团，直拍胸口，后悔没有一起去。用常务委员王玮婷的话说，亚利桑那直属分部的后援团，在拉票队伍中相当出名，估计下次选举活动亚利桑那直属分部估计可以拿”出场费”了。
9ecf56fbc293df4e30bd33740c91b828bc4aecbe.translatedText: > The Arizona branch of the Kuomintang held a party member event at 10:30 a.m. on March 24 at the Red Pot Restaurant in Phoenix to warmly celebrate Ma Ying-jeou's election victory. On that day, party members who had gone to Taiwan to participate in the election canvassing came on stage one after another to tell everyone interesting stories about the canvassing activities. The audience burst into laughter, clapped their chests, and regretted not going together. In the words of standing committee member Wang Weiting, the support team of the Arizona branch is quite famous among the canvassing team. It is estimated that the Arizona branch will be able to receive "appearance fees" in the next election event.

9afd40d232e2aec588ec958a632ef1b5e8c94f7c.sourceText: 常务委员王玮婷 挺马后援团成员王玮婷，章文秀，李问浙，曹嘉仪，邓凯蒂，严瑜，杨永慧，潘文慧，闵中英，詹浩文夫妇，范宪文等轮流上台带来了精彩的演讲。让人印象最深刻的就是在长途车上”金牌司仪”杨永慧，”皇后”潘文慧的表演，活动刚开始车内还特别谦虚，谁也不愿意拿话筒讲话，在两位美女的带动下车上说笑话，唱歌，跳舞，好不热闹，话筒在大家的争夺下四处传递。让全车的人充满了欢乐，忘记了晕车。在大马路上，他们载歌载舞拉着群众一起欢乐，就连听报告的现场，因为她们”在选举人群中杀出一条血路””脚上冒出大水泡””全部成为病号的罪魁祸首” ”到昏暗的菜市场扫街””亚利桑那帽子在台湾亮相”的精彩故事感动。
9afd40d232e2aec588ec958a632ef1b5e8c94f7c.translatedText: Standing member Wang Weiting and members of the support group Wang Weiting, Zhang Wenxiu, Li Wenzhe, Cao Jiayi, Deng Katie, Yan Yu, Yang Yonghui, Pan Wenhui, Min Zhongying, Zhan Haowen and his wife, Fan Xianwen, etc. took turns on the stage to give wonderful speeches. The most impressive thing was the performance of "Gold Medal Master of Ceremonies" Yang Yonghui and "Queen" Pan Wenhui on the long-distance bus. At the beginning of the event, the people in the car were very humble. No one was willing to speak with the microphone. The two beauties got out of the car and told jokes, sang and danced. It was very lively. The microphone was passed around as everyone competed for it. It made everyone in the car full of joy and forgot about motion sickness. On the main road, they sang and danced and brought the crowd to joy. Even those who were listening to the report were moved by the wonderful stories of "fighting their way through the electoral crowd", "big blisters on their feet", "all being the culprits of the illnesses", "sweeping the streets in a dark vegetable market" and "the debut of Arizona hats in Taiwan".

8e376c108741d20c3e6d7db4c15daf8b24a9a3ef.sourceText: 还是这些欢乐的宝贝，在讲完她们难忘的助选经历后，在现场又唱又跳，把分佈的活动推向了高潮，侨联副主席崔增祁高唱”我的家在东北松花江上厖”唱得气势磅礴迎来阵阵掌声，美女们在后面举手伴舞，活动在红锅餐厅美味的自助餐中圆满结束。
8e376c108741d20c3e6d7db4c15daf8b24a9a3ef.translatedText: These happy babies, after talking about their unforgettable election experience, sang and danced on the spot, pushing the distributed activities to a climax. Cui Zengqi, vice chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, sang "My home is on the Songhua River in Northeast China" and received bursts of applause. The beauties raised their hands and danced behind. The event ended successfully with a delicious buffet at the Red Pot Restaurant.

d92ffd9a1d300867a67dd41bcb5779175c63c172.sourceText: 凤凰城轻轨延长线破土动工 凤凰城轻轨延长线工程将于近日破土动工。本期工程计划使用三亿美元，兴建三站，到2016初通车。 三站分别为Glendale，Northern和Dunlap，约3.2英里长，都在19大道上，预计每天将增加5000名乘客。 另一个轻轨延伸工程，美莎市的3英里四站工程已于2012年夏天开始，也将于2016年初通车。
d92ffd9a1d300867a67dd41bcb5779175c63c172.translatedText: The Phoenix Light Rail Extension Line will break ground. The Phoenix Light Rail Extension Line project will break ground in the near future. This phase of the project plans to use US$300 million to build three stations, which will be opened to traffic in early 2016. The three stations, Glendale, Northern and Dunlap, will be approximately 3.2 miles long, all on 19th Avenue, and are expected to add 5,000 passengers per day. Another light rail extension project, a 3-mile, four-station extension in Mesa City, began in the summer of 2012 and will open to traffic in early 2016.

93ba26c974d54af9b0f9f35b852ece2531721b57.translatedText: Smart and beautiful, the ten universities in the United States with the most beauties and hotties (photo) Recently, a group of photos of the winners of the campus beauty contests of nine prestigious Japanese universities were exposed, and the results were on the Chinese Internet...

103d945683d8ef2412852389718130cf5e8eb7ad.sourceText: 最近一组日本九所名牌大学校花大赛冠军照片曝光，结果在中国网民中引起热议。看惯了中国各种校花的网友们，在看完日本校花后，纷纷吐槽”长相不忍直视” ”高度不够”等。当然各国民众的审美标准不同，而且名校选校花不能只看脸蛋，还要看大脑，这就比较难了，聪明又美丽的女孩少见，即使在大学也不易寻觅。
103d945683d8ef2412852389718130cf5e8eb7ad.translatedText: A recent group of photos of the champions of the campus beauty contests of nine prestigious Japanese universities were exposed, and the results aroused heated discussion among Chinese netizens. Netizens who are used to seeing all kinds of school beauties in China, after seeing Japanese school beauties, complained about "their looks are unbearable" and "not tall enough". Of course, the beauty standards of people in different countries are different, and it is more difficult to choose a beauty in a prestigious school based not only on the face, but also on the brain. Smart and beautiful girls are rare, and it is not easy to find them even in college.

51a9b4a60ffc4186d2fbe9f210d4b55afa30b6c5.sourceText: 美国大学不搞选美，也没有校花。但美国大学有一项评比，那就是每年推出美女辣妹最多大学排行榜。老乔看了一下2014美国大学的排行榜，结果人人皆知的常春藤学校没一个上榜，看起来在名校找美女辣妹不容易。美国大学评比美女一定要加上两个字：辣妹，这是因为光美不行还要火辣，要能够吸引人，除了脸蛋以外还要看身材。以下是2014年美国美女辣妹最多大学排行榜前10名的学校，让我们看看美国大学的美女高度高度够不够，辣妹到底辣不辣。
51a9b4a60ffc4186d2fbe9f210d4b55afa30b6c5.translatedText: American universities do not hold beauty pageants, nor do they have campus beauties. But there is a competition among American universities, which is to publish a ranking list of universities with the most beautiful girls every year. Lao Qiao took a look at the 2014 American university rankings, and found that none of the well-known Ivy League schools were on the list. It seemed that it was not easy to find beautiful girls in prestigious schools. When evaluating beauties in American universities, two words must be added: hot girl. This is because if you are not just beautiful, you must also be hot. In order to be attractive, in addition to your face, you also need to look at your figure. The following are the top 10 universities with the most beautiful girls in the United States in 2014. Let’s see if the beauties in American universities are tall enough and whether the hot girls are hot or not.

659ebba5b1797ef088885b8a34d78ded9ed742bf.sourceText: 2014年美国美女辣妹最多大学排行榜第一名对中国人来说是个不起眼的大学：亚利桑那州州立大学。但该校在美国很出名，一是这所大学是有名的派对大学，二是这所大学女学生身材好，而且亚利桑那州气候炎热，校园中穿的很清凉的女生比比皆是，这道风景线让人印象深刻。连世界著名的模特公司维多利亚秘密都对亚利桑那州州立大学的女大学生感兴趣，看起来该校应改成模特学校了。
659ebba5b1797ef088885b8a34d78ded9ed742bf.translatedText: The first place in the list of universities with the most beautiful girls in the United States in 2014 is an inconspicuous university to the Chinese: Arizona State University. But the school is very famous in the United States. First, it is a famous party university. Second, its female students have good figures. Moreover, Arizona has a hot climate. There are many girls wearing cool clothes on campus. This scenery is impressive. Even the world-famous modeling agency Victoria's Secret is interested in female college students from Arizona State University. It seems that the school should be converted into a modeling school.

ee02f904ac26b2759601fcbc7fd2813ed3338e54.sourceText: 塑化剂风波殃及台湾烘焙糕饼业，消费者信心再遭重创 随着台湾”查塑”工作的继续，台湾烘焙糕饼业也被塑化剂波及。适逢端午假期，原本应是食品业销售旺季，但台湾消费者的信心却再遭重创。 据台湾媒体报道，涉及塑化剂案的昱伸、千宾两家业者，疑将自制的果酱卖给面包、糕饼烘焙业。 另外，最新调查发现，”毒源”之一的昱伸香料公司曾将掺有塑化剂的香料销往台北市、台中市供烘焙业者制作面包。 而台中市有关机构到其下游公司调查发现，昱伸向其供货已至少5年，下游厂商多达120多家且遍及全台。目前调查人员正加紧将疑遭掺塑的16种水果香精与果酱送验，并逐一核对厂商名册厘清问题产品流向。 据了解，昱伸公司老板赖俊杰在应讯时，供称有一个”业界都知道的商业秘密”，即不仅饮料和保健食品，面包、蛋糕等烘焙食品中也普遍掺入起云剂。 此言一出，顿时让舆论大哗，也令台湾烘焙业者纷纷出面澄清。但不管最终调查结果如何，很多消费者如今已是”内心怕怕”。记者在台北信义区一些烘焙店发现，往日热卖的果酱面包已鲜见踪影。不少店家打出大幅让利的海报，以挽回消费信心。 时下正值毕业季，台湾各大饭店的谢师宴、家宴开得分外热闹。在塑化剂的阴影下，饭店都会在提供的果汁上特别标明为新鲜水果现榨而成。有业者干脆把大号榨汁机搬到现场，即榨即饮。
ee02f904ac26b2759601fcbc7fd2813ed3338e54.translatedText: The plasticizer crisis has affected Taiwan's bakery and cake industry, and consumer confidence has been hit hard again. As Taiwan's "plastic inspection" work continues, Taiwan's bakery and cake industry has also been affected by plasticizers. It coincides with the Dragon Boat Festival holiday, which is supposed to be the peak sales season for the food industry, but Taiwanese consumer confidence has been hit hard again. According to Taiwan media reports, two companies involved in the plasticizer case, Yushen and Qianbin, are suspected of selling homemade jam to the bread and pastry baking industry. In addition, the latest investigation found that Yushen Spices Company, one of the "poison sources", had sold spices mixed with plasticizers to Taipei and Taichung cities for bakery operators to make bread. Relevant agencies in Taichung City investigated its downstream companies and found that Yushen has been supplying products to it for at least five years, with more than 120 downstream manufacturers throughout Taiwan. Investigators are currently working hard to send 16 types of fruit flavors and jams suspected of being adulterated with plastics for inspection, and are checking the manufacturer's list one by one to clarify the flow of the problematic products. It is understood that when contacted, Lai Junjie, the boss of Yushen Company, confessed that he had a "trade secret known to everyone in the industry", that is, not only beverages and health foods, but also baked goods such as bread and cakes are commonly mixed with clouding agents. As soon as this statement came out, public opinion immediately aroused, and Taiwan's baking industry also came forward to clarify. But no matter what the final survey result is, many consumers are now "fearful". Reporters found in some bakeries in Taipei's Xinyi District that the popular jam bread in the past was rarely seen. Many stores have put up posters offering huge profit discounts to restore consumer confidence. It’s graduation season now, and the graduation banquets and family banquets in major hotels in Taiwan are extremely lively. Under the shadow of plasticizers, restaurants will specifically indicate on the juice provided that it is freshly squeezed from fresh fruit. Some operators simply moved large juicers to the site to squeeze and drink immediately.

800afab5dc7067800f984884d01f75814a76a112.sourceText: 如何取得优质房屋贷款? –五大步骤,第三步 上周我们讲到如何取得优质房屋贷款的第二步，想要贷款的人都需要做哪些前期工作。下面我们要继续教大家如何取得优质房屋贷款的下一步骤。 第三步: 申请贷款步骤： 在拿到买卖双方认可的购屋合约后，买家应立即请房屋经纪去公证行立案。买房需要缴付订金（earnest money）,订金金额有些是$1000,有些是需要房屋买价的 5%，每位卖家的要求都不一样，特别是短卖屋和银行屋。 根据亚利桑那州的买房合约, 通常有10天的估价撤离条款, 或者根据另外的合同条款来定。通常10天期限一到，只要买方未签署撤离条款（Removal Contingency），买方仍可撤销合约及要回订金！ 随即安排房屋检查，要求卖方进行杀白蚁工作，并要求卖方购买房屋设施保险（Home Warranty）。 将购房合约递交给选定的贷款银行，并告知公证行的联络资料。准备好自己的薪水单，W2，报税单，银行月结单，以及自己的私人数据一并交予。贷款专员会为您安排好房屋估价事宜。若估价低于买价，您需要另外支付其中的差价。贷款全额是取决于房屋估价价值。贷款会在2-3周后获得批准。您会被要求到公证处 或者通常到产权公司签署贷款的法律性文件，同时缴付给产权公司包括：头款，手续费等费用之后的 2-3天内银行会放款，且整个房屋过户程序。在产权公司向县政府做过户登记手续后，才算正式完成法律程序交接。买方向地产经纪拿取新家钥匙。 （本文章未完，下周待续 -五大步骤,第四步）
800afab5dc7067800f984884d01f75814a76a112.translatedText: How to obtain a high-quality home loan? – Five steps, step three Last week we talked about the second step of how to obtain a high-quality home loan, and what preliminary work people who want a loan need to do. Now we’re going to continue teaching you the next steps on how to get a quality home loan. Step 3: Apply for a loan: After getting the house purchase contract approved by the buyer and seller, the buyer should immediately ask the housing agent to go to the notary office to file the case. Buying a house requires a deposit (earnest money). Some deposits are $1,000, while others require 5% of the purchase price of the house. Each seller's requirements are different, especially for short-sale houses and bank houses. Under Arizona home purchase contracts, there is usually a 10-day appraisal withdrawal clause, or it may be determined by other contract terms. Usually once the 10-day period is up, as long as the buyer has not signed the removal clause (Removal Contingency), the buyer can still cancel the contract and get the deposit back! Immediately arrange a home inspection, require the seller to perform termite removal work, and require the seller to purchase home facility insurance (Home Warranty). Submit the house purchase contract to the selected lending bank and provide the notary's contact information. Prepare your pay stub, W2, tax return, bank statement, and your personal data to hand over. A loan officer will arrange a home appraisal for you. If the appraisal is lower than the purchase price, you will need to pay the difference. The full amount of the loan is determined by the appraised value of the home. Loan approval takes 2-3 weeks. You will be required to go to the notary office or usually to the title company to sign the legal documents of the loan. At the same time, you will pay the title company including: down payment, handling fees and other fees. The bank will release the loan within 2-3 days, and the entire house transfer process will be completed. The transfer of legal procedures is officially completed only after the property rights company completes the ownership registration procedures with the county government. The buyer picks up the keys to his new home from the real estate agent. (This article is not finished and will be continued next week - five major steps, step four)

8905ca6378ef43ecb740bfab4f0b761fd1ba3c8f.sourceText: 凤凰城气如虹：佳儿佳妇 我的次子国风与琼瑶结婚的佳期，是从去年就选择的吉日11/11/11星期五，终于已经如期举行，完满成功。 亲友都向我道贺，在恭祝叠翁之喜的同时，不忘祝贺「佳儿佳妇」，就是祝贺我的好儿子娶得好媳妇。 凡是祝贺词句都是美好的，我当然感谢亲友的衷心祝福，有什么比得上晚年岁月，获得佳儿佳妇敬重，真正安享老爸、老爷之福呢！ 「你要做个好老爷，饮心抱茶时要赏赐封大利市呀！」在一年前知道国风择吉成亲，朋友们陆续取笑我。 广州话的「心抱」，即是儿媳妇，原本是「新妇」的古时语音转变过来，相对而言，我夫妇就成为「家公家婆」，口头尊称的「老爷、奶奶」。 既然荣登第二任老爷，自当准备饮茶「利市」。 「利市」就是喜事派上用场的红包，里面装有钱币，「利市大封多大吉」，是一般收礼者所期望；「求其红纸一封，意思意思」，则是赠送人 所表白。 不过，身为老爷，红包也不能太「小器」，至少红红封包要大大，一定「好好睇睇」。 这次婚礼关于新娘敬茶的环节，起初有些亲友不大明了，原因是请柬上注明婚礼在诗歌时代(Scottsdale)市「双轼天堂谷度假酒店」(Doubletree Paradise Valley resort)举行，四时卅分是 婚礼仪式，五时恭候，六时入席，显然是西式作风，怎么还有时间「饮心抱茶」？ 其实不然，国风与琼瑶11/11/11星期五的婚礼，可算是别出心裁，采取中越美混合仪式。 首先保持华人传统习俗，结婚前夕，新郎新娘不能会面，各自在家准备婚嫁礼仪，装潢家居啦，张挂花环花饰啦，贴上门联，双囍啦，上头梳髲等等。 佳期当天早晨，男家就忙碌着装饰花车，「周府迎亲」，原定九时半起花轿向女家出发，十一时迎娶新娘回来，无奈由于种种程序的安排，拖延了时间，迎亲时辰迟缓 了；但都没关系，「有心唔怕迟」，都是六个一的好日子。 所有这些准备细节，新郎以花车到女家迎亲是传统中式，伴娘们拦门阻挡不准轻易娶得新娘也是传统习俗，新娘向长辈敬茶也是华人礼仪。 至于「过大礼」，旧称纳征，也是传统礼节，一般在大婚前进行，但衡量居于美国社区环境的不便，一切从简，决定与迎亲一起进行，所以伴郎之外另加四名好兄弟陪同 ，每人捧住礼盒向女家呈献，我们采用五个越式礼盒，因为圆圆的礼盒，隆起的盖子，并用双囍红绸覆盖着，美观阅目。 礼盒装有四宝首饰、聘金利市，龙凤花烛，龙凤礼饼，槟榔柑桔，洋酒石榴，以及寓意吉祥的莲子、百合厖等等，我拜托何锦莲权充大妗姐职务，助我 主持这个迎亲礼仪，抵达女家，也是由五位伴​​娘接礼，然后回礼，新郎到女家成为新女婿，经过一番仪式，迎娶新娘回家，点燃龙凤花烛啦，新娘敬茶啦厖可谓 忙得不可开交。 啊呀！ 就是这样子，中式越式的礼仪式忙完了，一对新人和五对伴郎伴娘又急于赶到酒店，准备下午四时半在酒店园地举行西式的证婚典礼。 我这对老爷奶奶和长子小女，还须招待其他外州的亲友一顿午餐，然​​后回家略为整装，再赶去希尔顿酒店所属的双轼酒店（Doubletree ） 花园，出席西式的婚礼与宴会。 我见到酒店花园搭建临时的礼台，新娘正式穿着婚纱，合法的证婚人主持婚礼，伴郎伴娘一对对先入场，五对完毕，然后是新郎上台，岳父带领新娘交给新郎，还有一对 花童一路散花上前，隆重弹奏起〈结婚进行曲〉，新郎新娘互相配戴结婚戒指，宣誓正式成为夫妻，这就是我的「佳儿佳妇」，上午那种迎亲仪式，只是依照传统 习俗循例举行而已。 继续下来是入席前的湖畔简餐，让宾主轻松一下，最后是压轴的婚礼宴客酒会，在方慧贤的主持下，令亲友不感纳闷，满堂笑声，新郎新娘也有很好的表现，夫 唱妇弹，新郎吟诗示爱，新娘感人肺腑的倾诉，都留给亲友难忘印象，我有此佳儿佳妇，真正老怀安慰。
8905ca6378ef43ecb740bfab4f0b761fd1ba3c8f.translatedText: Phoenix City is full of energy: a beautiful son and a beautiful wife. The auspicious date for the wedding of my second son Guofeng and Qiong Yao was the auspicious day of November 11, Friday, which I had chosen since last year. It was finally held as scheduled and was a complete success. Relatives and friends all congratulated me. While congratulating me on my great success, they also did not forget to congratulate me on "a good son and a good wife", that is, congratulating my good son on getting a good wife. All words of congratulations are beautiful, and of course I am grateful for the heartfelt blessings from my relatives and friends. What can be better than being respected by a beautiful son and a beautiful woman in my later years, and truly enjoying the blessing of being a father and a master! "You have to be a good master, and when you drink tea with your heart, you should be rewarded with a big fortune!" A year ago, I learned that it was a national custom to choose auspicious weddings, and my friends started teasing me one after another. In Cantonese, the word "heart embrace" means daughter-in-law. The ancient pronunciation of "bride" has changed. Relatively speaking, my wife and I have become "father-in-law and mother-in-law", and they are verbally addressed as "master and grandma". Since he has been crowned the second master, he should be prepared to drink tea to "profit the market". "Good luck" is a red envelope that comes in handy for happy events. It contains coins. "Good luck brings great luck." This is what the recipient usually expects. "Please give me a red paper for your meaning." It is the expression of the giver. However, as a gentleman, the red envelope should not be too "small". At least the red envelope should be big, so you must "look at it carefully". At this wedding, some relatives and friends were not sure about the tea ceremony for the bride at first. The reason was that the invitation stated that the wedding would be held at Doubletree Paradise Valley resort in Scottsdale. The wedding ceremony was held at 4:30, with waiting at 5 and sitting down at 6. It was obviously a Western style. How could there be time to "drink tea"? In fact, this is not the case. The wedding of Guofeng and Qiong Yao on Friday, November 11, can be regarded as unique, using a Chinese-Vietnamese-American hybrid ceremony. First of all, traditional Chinese customs should be maintained. On the eve of the wedding, the bride and groom cannot meet each other. They prepare wedding etiquette at home, decorate the home, hang garlands and decorations, paste couplets on the door, double combs, comb their hair, etc. On the morning of the wedding day, the groom's family was busy decorating the float for the "Welcome to the Zhou Mansion". The sedan was originally scheduled to leave for the groom's family at 9:30, and the bride would come back at 11:00. Unfortunately, due to various arrangements, the time was delayed, and the wedding time was delayed; but it didn't matter, "If you have the intention, don't be afraid of delay", it is all a good day in six days. All these preparation details include the traditional Chinese custom of the groom going to the bride's house on a float to welcome her, the traditional custom of the bridesmaids blocking the door to prevent the bride from marrying easily, and the Chinese etiquette of the bride serving tea to her elders. As for "excessive gifts", formerly known as "nazheng", it is also a traditional etiquette and is usually performed before the wedding. However, considering the inconvenience of living in the American community environment, everything was kept simple and decided to be done together with the wedding ceremony. Therefore, in addition to the best man, four good brothers accompanied the bride. Each of them held a gift box and presented it to the bride's family. We used five Vietnamese gift boxes because the round gift boxes, raised lids, and covered with double-necked red silk are beautiful to read. The gift box contains four treasures of jewelry, betrothal gold and profit, dragon and phoenix flower candles, dragon and phoenix gift cakes, betel nuts and tangerines, foreign wine and pomegranates, as well as auspicious lotus seeds, lilies, etc. I asked He Jinlian to act as the eldest sister and help me. After presiding over this wedding ceremony, he arrived at the bride's house, where the five bridesmaids received the gifts and then returned the gifts. The groom went to the bride's house and became the new son-in-law. After a ceremony, he married the bride and went home. The dragon and phoenix candles were lit, and the bride served tea. Pang was very busy. Oh! Just like this, the Chinese and Vietnamese-style etiquette was finished, and the newlyweds and five pairs of groomsmen and bridesmaids rushed to the hotel to prepare for a Western-style wedding ceremony in the hotel grounds at 4:30 pm. The grandparents, my eldest son and my daughter also had to entertain other relatives and friends from out of state for lunch, then go home to get dressed up, and then rush to the Doubletree Garden of the Hilton Hotel to attend a Western-style wedding and banquet. I saw a temporary ceremony stage set up in the hotel garden. The bride formally wore a wedding dress, and the legal witnesses presided over the wedding. The groomsmen and bridesmaids entered the venue first, and the five couples were completed. Then the groom came on stage, and the father-in-law led the bride to the groom. There was also a pair of flower girls who scattered flowers and played the "Wedding March" grandly. The bride and groom put on wedding rings and swore to officially become husband and wife. This is my "beautiful son and beautiful woman". The wedding ceremony in the morning was just in accordance with tradition. It's just a custom. It continued with a simple meal by the lakeside before the dinner, allowing the guests and hosts to relax. Finally, there was the wedding banquet, hosted by Fang Huixian, which made the relatives and friends not puzzled. The whole house burst into laughter. The bride and groom also performed very well. The husband and wife sang songs, the groom recited poems to express his love, and the bride's heartfelt confessions, all left an unforgettable impression on relatives and friends. I have such a beautiful son and a beautiful woman, who truly comforts me.

0b213147c58f18b5c1fd50af65599fff4a861322.sourceText: （本网编译）美莎公立学校的食堂员工再次受到正确储藏食物的培训，在亚当斯小学上周二发生发放变质三明治和胡萝卜的事件后。 现在还不知道亚当斯小学食堂工作人员是否会受到纪律处分。 上周二从艺术中回来后，变质的食物被要求扔掉，亚当斯小学的学生被发放了免费的热食。美莎发言人表示，这是一个非常严重的事件。保存食物的冰柜并没有问题，变质的食物是由于人工操作失误，造成的。 家长和老师都说三明治很硬而且颜色变绿。 有三个班级的学生，发放了这些食物。 幸运的是，发现的早，学生被告知把三明治和胡萝卜扔掉。当他们回到学校后，还是可以到学校的食堂就餐。 美莎共有82所学校，每天服务45000份午餐和10000份点菜，一年共消费2800,000美元。亚当斯小学是最近唯一发生这种情况的学校。
0b213147c58f18b5c1fd50af65599fff4a861322.translatedText: (Compiled by this website) Mesa Public School cafeteria employees were once again trained on the correct storage of food, after an incident at Adams Elementary School last Tuesday in which spoiled sandwiches and carrots were distributed. It's unknown if the Adams Elementary School cafeteria staff will face disciplinary action. After returning from the arts last Tuesday, students at Adams Elementary School were given free hot meals after spoiled food was asked to be thrown away. A Mesa spokesperson said this was a very serious incident. There is nothing wrong with the freezers used to store food. The spoiled food is caused by manual errors. Parents and teachers said the sandwich was hard and turned green. The food was distributed to students in three classes. Fortunately, it was discovered early and the student was told to throw away the sandwich and carrots. When they return to school, they can still eat in the school cafeteria. Mesa has 82 schools, serving 45,000 lunches and 10,000 a la carte meals every day, consuming a total of US$2.8 million a year. Adams Elementary School is the only school where this has happened recently.

06ca49af0dab1cbbbb6a6cab65ee07c05b21dc22.sourceText: 在公立学校，除了联邦发凡的免费午餐的学生以外，学生每天付1.85美元为餐费。学区已经新雇佣了30位兼职工作人员，花了近20万更新新设备，帮助处理食物保鲜的问题。
06ca49af0dab1cbbbb6a6cab65ee07c05b21dc22.translatedText: In public schools, except for students who receive federal free lunch, students pay $1.85 per day for meals. The school district has hired 30 new part-time staff and spent nearly $200,000 on new equipment to help deal with food preservation issues.

c1be54f7489874eb8fee21a91ae7a41e25532e70.sourceText: 主办方执行总监LLOYD Y.ASATO介绍今年5月9日的”亚太之美”募款晚宴，将表彰”Lin Sue Cooney, Leezie Kim, Evelyn Casuga, Macbeth Torno”四位杰出的亚裔女性。 Lin Sue Cooney 是有28年经验的电视主播。她主持12频道下午5点和晚上10点的的节目。她有丰富的主持经验，在业内获得了众多的奖项。LinSue Cooney不仅是一个优秀的媒体人，还是社区工作的热心参与者。 Leezie Kim 是Fox餐厅的副总，被全国餐饮组织提名。Leezie Kim是一位能干的韩国女性，谁也想不到这个餐厅副总曾经是一名出色的律师，帮助很多客户成功完成大量的交易。 Evelyn Casuga 刚刚从亚利桑那公共服务社区事务部总经理一职退休。她曾经在APS工作了10年。她也是优秀的经济发展师，曾获得亚利桑那经济发展协会的年度经济发展师的称号。 Macbeth Torno是Mayo医疗中心的注册护士，她从1983年开始参与亚利桑那社区工作。她在菲律宾获得护士的本科学位。后来又获得了教育管理硕士学位。在菲律宾医学院担任教师。因为她在菲律宾和美国的杰出贡献，获得很多奖项，例如”突出分会主席” ”社区年度护士”等。 这四位杰出亚裔女性将会在今年的募款晚宴上被隆重表彰。据亚太社区促进会的创始人华裔徐凯莱女士介绍，今年的募款晚宴也是亚太社区促进会成立10周年的特别日子，希望有更多的朋友能一起参与到关注亚裔健康的活动中来。她介绍今年募款晚宴的主持也是重量级的人物，她是现任亚利桑那妇女协会的CEO，Sara Presler, JD。她曾是两届的Flagstaff市的市长。
c1be54f7489874eb8fee21a91ae7a41e25532e70.translatedText: The organizer's executive director LLOYD Y.ASATO introduced the "Beauty of Asia Pacific" fundraising dinner on May 9 this year, which will honor "Lin Sue Cooney," Leezie Kim, Evelyn Casuga, Macbeth Torno” four outstanding Asian women. Lin Sue Cooney is a television anchor with 28 years of experience. She hosts Channel 12's 5pm and 10pm shows. She has extensive hosting experience and has won numerous awards in the industry. LinSue Cooney is not only an excellent media person, but also an enthusiastic participant in community work. Leezie Kim, Vice President of Fox Restaurants, was nominated by the National Restaurant Organization. Leezie Kim is a capable Korean woman. No one would have thought that this restaurant vice president was once an excellent lawyer and helped many clients successfully complete a large number of transactions. Evelyn Casuga just retired as general manager of the Arizona Department of Human Services Community Affairs. She has worked at APS for 10 years. She is also an accomplished economic developer and was named Economic Developer of the Year by the Arizona Economic Development Association. Macbeth Torno is a registered nurse at Mayo Medical Center who has been involved in the Arizona community since 1983. She received her undergraduate degree in nursing in the Philippines. Later he earned a master's degree in educational administration. Served as a teacher at the Philippine Medical College. Because of her outstanding contributions in the Philippines and the United States, she has received many awards, such as "Outstanding Chapter President" and "Community Nurse of the Year". These four outstanding Asian women will be honored at this year’s fundraising dinner. According to the Chinese founder of the Asia-Pacific Community Promotion Association, Ms. Xu Kailai, this year’s fundraising dinner is also a special day for the 10th anniversary of the founding of the Asia-Pacific Community Promotion Association. She hopes that more friends can participate in activities that focus on Asian health. She introduced that the host of this year’s fundraising dinner is also a heavyweight. She is the current CEO of the Arizona Women’s Association, Sara Presler, JD. She served two terms as mayor of Flagstaff.

a41de8c7041304318724b01948313c56ad28e403.sourceText: 亚太社区促进会”亚太之美”募款晚宴是亚裔社区最受成功人士关注的活动，一张晚宴入场券通常价格高达$100美元。活动所有收入是用来做美国亚裔健康的慈善活动。例如每次在”太阳鸟”亚利桑那华人网刊登的免费乙肝筛查，免费的戒烟项目，为无保险的亚裔提供廉价的体检等等都是他们提供的服务。他们在中美社区已经成为非常有影响力的亚裔品牌，多年来受到亚裔西裔社区的共同关注。
a41de8c7041304318724b01948313c56ad28e403.translatedText: Asian Pacific Community Promotion Association's "Beauty of Asia Pacific" fundraising dinner is the most popular event for successful people in the Asian community. A dinner ticket usually costs up to $100. All proceeds from the event will be used for charity activities related to Asian American health. For example, free hepatitis B screening, free smoking cessation programs, and low-cost physical examinations for uninsured Asians are all services they provide every time they are published on the "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese website. They have become a very influential Asian brand in the Chinese and American communities and have attracted the attention of the Asian Hispanic community over the years.

898a94f3cf1af525c57396fddfc3d3c8fa51f6d7.sourceText: 相关新闻：世界卫生组织说，已经开始在国际范围调查在中国造成17人死亡的新的禽流感毒株。
898a94f3cf1af525c57396fddfc3d3c8fa51f6d7.translatedText: Related news: The World Health Organization said that it has begun an international investigation into a new avian influenza strain that killed 17 people in China.

f19b8a80f08a25475fcc19c5c47b3f3d5deb34c8.sourceText: 另外有将近100人被感染，其中大多数人在上海附近地区。
f19b8a80f08a25475fcc19c5c47b3f3d5deb34c8.translatedText: Nearly 100 other people have been infected, most of them in areas near Shanghai.

3883c103a145e81731f6ddc25008f93fd0fc0761.sourceText: 到目前为止，据信这种毒株只从鸟类传染给人。不过，有关官员说，这次感染禽流感的人当中有大约一半并没有和禽类接触。
3883c103a145e81731f6ddc25008f93fd0fc0761.translatedText: So far, this strain is believed to have been transmitted only from birds to humans. However, officials said that about half of the people infected with bird flu this time had no contact with poultry.

1a7da50bfb1d7ef8d6e2cd9fd5f39efc98dcd071.sourceText: 世卫组织说，目前还没有证据显示新型禽流感病毒，也就是H7N9 病毒，能够轻易在人与人之间传染。
1a7da50bfb1d7ef8d6e2cd9fd5f39efc98dcd071.translatedText: The WHO said that there is currently no evidence that the new avian influenza virus, also known as the H7N9 virus, can be easily transmitted between people.

e35f831545574885cb82d6aae4a343e9b37a6369.sourceText: 但是，中国当局正在调查，如果某人和禽流感患者在没有防护的条件下长期接触，例如和感染的家人接触，是否会造成人与人之间的传染。
e35f831545574885cb82d6aae4a343e9b37a6369.translatedText: However, Chinese authorities are investigating whether human-to-human transmission can occur if someone has long-term unprotected contact with an avian flu patient, such as with an infected family member.

ca1498a6139b2849d8a2efc7a6cec4af3eee2af9.sourceText: 预计除了中国调查人员之外，美国和欧洲的调查人员也将参加世卫组织的调查。
ca1498a6139b2849d8a2efc7a6cec4af3eee2af9.translatedText: It is expected that in addition to Chinese investigators, investigators from the United States and Europe will also participate in the WHO investigation.

4eaf24cea1cbed6f5b6968319f5a9c2d3b89829f.sourceText: 中国被认为是禽流感传染风险较大的国家之一，因为中国的家禽数量居世界之首，而农村养的许多鸡和人类有接触。
4eaf24cea1cbed6f5b6968319f5a9c2d3b89829f.translatedText: China is considered one of the countries with a greater risk of avian influenza infection because China has the largest number of poultry in the world, and many chickens raised in rural areas have come into contact with humans.

7f6f0a8e03a93a3119e787c870b174c62ec5c630.sourceText: 文扬：中国人自己的大事自己办 11 月 3 日，天宫一号目标飞行器与神舟八号飞船成功实现首次交会对接。 中国继美国和俄国之后成为了第三个掌握了这种被称为space docking technique的国家。 当初因为中国加入16国国际空间站计划的申请屡屡被拒，后来只好自己单独搞，近年来进展迅速，正在一步一步接近目标。按中国航天专家的说法：”我们国家载人航天工程是按照三步走的战略来发展的，我们第一步已经完成了载人航天，实现了有人在空间活动。第二步我们就要完成空间实验室这项工作。第三步建设一个长期的有人照料的空间站。如果说我们第二步工作完成得好，也就是说这个交会对接任务能够完成的非常好，把交会对接的技术突破，那我们载人航天工程就又向前前进了一大步。”（北京航天飞行控制中心主任陈宏敏） 从”神舟”飞天到”嫦娥”奔月，再到”天宫”升空、世人已经毫不怀疑中国人这种”几步走”的发展战略终究会走到目的地，也完全习惯了中国人这种一次接一次的”前进了一大步”。 习以为常的结果，近年来，连国外媒体常见的”惊呼”和国内媒体一向的”欢呼”也都景象不再了。毕竟，那都是人们看到巨人刚站起来时的自然反应，当巨人大步行走时，大家就只是安静地观看，根据其步速认真地计算其行程，根据其行程严肃地评估其影响，顾不上一惊一乍地瞎嚷嚷了。 据说，当初拒绝中国加入国际空间站计划的理由是”就像你不会让一个十几岁的年轻人持有你的法拉利轿车车钥匙一样”。结果，众目睽睽之下，这个信心满满、生机勃勃的年轻人开始自己动手制造北京吉普。 理由更充分： 法拉利虽好，但那是别人的，北京吉普再简陋，但它是自己的。 法拉利再好，也有老旧退役的时候，北京吉普从第一代做起，总会逐步升级到接近法拉利。 最重要的，开别人的法拉利，什么都要听别人的，开自己的北京吉普，想怎么开怎么开，想去哪里去哪里。 如此看来，像探月这种事关整个中华民族未来发展的大事情，还是自己单独搞更好。 此事之大，可以大到什么程度？在新闻里看到被称之为”嫦娥之父”的中国月球探测工程首席科学家欧阳自远先生如是说： ”大量蕴藏在月球上的氦3是非常好的一种核聚变燃料。经过初步测算，月球上的储量是一百万吨到五百万吨。?#20551;如利用氦3的话，中国全年的发电量大约需要8吨，美国全年的发电量大约需要25吨。那么，从月球上把氦3运回来一次，中国全年的能源需求已经全部解决。” 在我看来，不为别的，仅仅这一项，在探月工程上的所有努力就都具有事关整个中华民族未来发展的重大意义。 中国人自制的北京吉普，哪怕只解决了中国的能源需求这一个大问题，就已功在千秋。 怎能设想，到了人类开始利用月球资源的时代，十几亿中国人还是不得不依赖外国的技术和能力取得所需的一切？ 中华民族是世界上第一大民族，这个民族的未来，只能掌握在自己手里。所以，事关整民族未来发展的大事，也只能自己来办。 谨以此文祝贺中国航天器太空交会对接一次成功。 2011年11月3日
7f6f0a8e03a93a3119e787c870b174c62ec5c630.translatedText: Wen Yang: Chinese people take care of their own major affairs. On November 3, the Tiangong-1 target aircraft and the Shenzhou-8 spacecraft successfully completed their first rendezvous and docking. China has become the third country after the United States and Russia to master this so-called space docking technique. At first, because China's application to join the 16-nation International Space Station program was repeatedly rejected, it later had to do it alone. In recent years, it has made rapid progress and is getting closer to the goal step by step. According to Chinese aerospace experts: "Our country's manned space project is developed according to a three-step strategy. In the first step, we have completed manned spaceflight and realized manned activities in space. In the second step, we will complete the work of the space laboratory. In the third step, we will build a long-term and useful space laboratory." If we complete the second step of the work well, that is to say, the rendezvous and docking mission can be completed very well, and our manned spaceflight project will take a big step forward." (Chen Hongmin, Director of Beijing Aerospace Flight Control Center) From the "Shenzhou" flying into the sky to the "Chang'e" flying to the moon, and then the "Tiangong" taking off, the world has no doubt that the Chinese's development strategy of "a few steps" will eventually reach its destination, and is completely accustomed to the Chinese's "big step forward" one after another. As a result of taking it for granted, in recent years, even the common "exclamations" of foreign media and the usual "cheers" of domestic media have disappeared. After all, that was people's natural reaction when they saw the giant standing up. When the giant walked, everyone just watched quietly, carefully calculated its journey based on its pace, seriously evaluated its impact based on its journey, and did not bother to yell in surprise. It is said that the reason for rejecting China’s participation in the International Space Station program was “just like you wouldn’t let a teenager hold the keys to your Ferrari.” As a result, in full view of the public, this confident and energetic young man began to build Beijing Jeep by himself. The reason is even better: Although the Ferrari is good, it belongs to others. No matter how crude the Beijing Jeep is, it belongs to oneself. No matter how good Ferrari is, there will be times when it gets old and retires. Starting from the first generation, Beijing Jeep will always gradually upgrade to be close to Ferrari. The most important thing is that if you drive someone else's Ferrari, you have to listen to others for everything. If you drive your own Beijing Jeep, you can drive it however you want and go where you want to go. From this point of view, for a major event like lunar exploration that concerns the future development of the entire Chinese nation, it is better to do it alone. How big can this matter be? I saw in the news that Mr. Ouyang Ziyuan, the chief scientist of China's lunar exploration project, who is known as the "Father of Chang'e", said: "The large amount of helium 3 stored on the moon is a very good nuclear fusion fuel. Preliminary calculations show that the reserves on the moon are one million tons to five million tons. If helium 3 is used, China's annual power generation will require about 8 tons, and the United States' annual power generation will need about 25 tons. Then, by transporting helium 3 back from the moon once, China's annual energy needs will be completely solved." In my opinion, if for no other reason than this alone, all efforts in the lunar exploration project are of great significance related to the future development of the entire Chinese nation. The Chinese-made Beijing Jeep, even if it only solves the big problem of China's energy demand, has already made a lasting contribution. How can we imagine that in an era when humans begin to utilize lunar resources, more than one billion Chinese people will still have to rely on foreign technology and capabilities to obtain everything they need? The Chinese nation is the largest nation in the world, and the future of this nation can only be controlled in its own hands. Therefore, major issues related to the future development of the entire nation can only be handled by ourselves. I would like to congratulate China's successful space rendezvous and docking with this article. November 3, 2011

a79e416ef889064ca3b0d0124a20139efd690292.sourceText: 倾听 张肇鸿 有一位长年住在山里的印第安人因为特殊机缘，接受一位住在纽约的友人邀请，到纽约做客。 当纽约友人引领着印地安人出了机场正要穿越马路时，印地安人对着纽约友人说：「你听到蟋蟀声了吗？」纽约友人笑着说：「您大概坐飞机坐太久了，这机场的引道连到高速公路上，怎么可能有蟋蟀呢？」 又走了两步路，印地安朋友又说：「真的有蟋蟀！我清楚听到牠们的声音。」纽约友人笑得更大声了：「您瞧！那儿正在施工打洞，机械的噪音那么大，怎么会听得到蟋蟀声呢？」印地安人二话不说，走到班马线旁安全岛的草地上翻开了一段枯倒的树干，招呼纽约友人前来观看那两只正高歌的蟋蟀！只见纽约友人露出不可置信的表情，直呼不可能！「你的听力真是太好了，能在那么吵的环境下还听得到蟋蟀叫声！」 印地安朋友说：「你也可以啊！每个人都可以的！我可以向你借你口袋里的零钱来做个实验吗？」「可以！可以！我口袋里大大小小的铜板有十几元，您全拿去用！」纽约友人很快地把钱掏出来交给印地安友人。 「仔细看，尤其是那些原本眼睛没朝我们这儿看的人！」说完话的印地安友人，把铜板抛到柏油路上，突然，有好多人转过头来看，甚至有人开始弯下腰来捡钱。 「您瞧，大家的听力都差不多，不一样的地方是，你们纽约人专注的是钱，我专注的是自然与生命。所以听到与听不到，全然在于有没有专注地倾听。」
a79e416ef889064ca3b0d0124a20139efd690292.translatedText: Listen to Zhang Zhaohong There was an Indian who had lived in the mountains for many years. Due to special opportunities, he accepted the invitation of a friend living in New York to visit New York. When the New York friend led the Indian out of the airport and was about to cross the road, the Indian said to the New York friend, "Did you hear the crickets?" The New York friend smiled and said, "You must have been flying for too long. The approach road of the airport is connected to the highway. How can there be crickets?" After walking another two steps, the Indian friend said again: "There really are crickets! I heard their sound clearly." The New York friend laughed even louder: "Look! There is construction going on there, and the machinery is making so much noise. , how can you hear the sound of crickets?" Without saying a word, the Indian walked to the grass on the safety island next to the Banma Line and opened a section of a fallen tree trunk, calling his New York friends to come and watch the two singing crickets! I saw my friends in New York showing disbelief and saying it was impossible! "Your hearing is so good that you can still hear the chirping of crickets in such a noisy environment!" The Indian friend said, "You can do it too! Everyone can do it! Can I borrow the change in your pocket to do an experiment?" "Yes! Yes! I have more than ten yuan in large and small copper coins in my pocket. You can use them all!" The New York friend quickly took out the money and handed it to the Indian friend. "Look carefully, especially those who didn't originally look towards us!" After speaking, the Indian friends threw the coins onto the asphalt road. Suddenly, many people turned their heads to look, and some even began to bend down to pick up the money. "You see, everyone's hearing is similar. The difference is that you New Yorkers focus on money, while I focus on nature and life. So whether you hear or not, it all depends on whether you listen attentively."

6967493c85d77b9157b899a3d154899d43e0a38a.sourceText: 丽影霓裳俏公主——凤凰选美报道（七） 张肇鸿 还记得去年选美吗﹖以”春之婷‧夏之盈 ‧秋之情‧冬之鸣”的四季变换来连贯全场，明快又亮丽，周畅小姐成为了2010年华裔小姐选美皇后。这一场 《四十韵华彩鳯飞》的选美，被资深侨领余文劲先生称为 ”历年来最好的一次。” 那么，今年的选美又有甚么特色呢﹖侨联副主席张华芳有新建议：今年改用中西文化相结合的形式来进行，借鉴于四部有中国巾帼英雌人物和西方童话故事的电影为蓝本，营造出一场新的鳯凰城华裔小姐选美。 为了配合这场国庆与选美，侨联今年找到了更好的场地演出，新选择的剧场交通适中，泊车方便，舞台寛阔，符合导演要求。而导演则聘用了Hodgie乔先生担任，Hodgie乔是位韩国人。在2007年，乔已在中国云南艺术学院编导了”鹤妻”音乐剧，是云南艺院戏剧系第一次与美国方面完美的合作。Hodgie乔6岁学跆拳道，青年来美学过音乐、体操、芭蕾、爵士舞甚至街舞等，编导过上百场甚有影响力的舞蹈在全美国各地演出，尤擅长武术舞蹈，而由他执导的电影包括有：阿纳斯塔西娅、我能做任何事、未完成事件和未解之谜等。这也是侨联首次聘请专业外藉人来执导全程选美。和去年一样，今年的选美也以四个主题来表达，分别是 ”京典花木兰、魅彩美人鱼、魔幻俏公主和梦幻灰姑娘。” 下面就让我们 ”先睹为快”. 一、动漫京典花木兰。曾记否木兰诗中：”万里赴戎机，关山度若飞。朔气传金柝，寒光照铁衣。将军百战死，壮士十年归。”的诗句？中国花木兰的女中豪杰形象甚至被美国荷李活以动漫形式搬上大银幕。今次选美以 ”花木兰” 为首场，特显中华文化的厚重和辉煌。在 ”花木兰” 之前的序幕中，我们特别要求导演一定要塑造一个激越的氛围和气势，以煽起观众的热情。所以，乔导特别设计了一场以武术，芭蕾，霹雳舞和杂技的舞蹈来开场，并运用强大照明，使用红色和紫色灯光，并以追光及侧光来 ”捆绑” 舞者，通过高分贝音乐和烟幕，制造强烈的气氛，并以此序幕牵引出选美佳丽的集体舞蹈 ”花木兰”。 京韵十足的”花木兰”由新东方艺术学校的Vanessa胡编导，胡老师自幼习舞又到过纽约深造，能舞善导，而新东方艺校的练舞场地十分专业，实木地板，通顶落地大镜，隔音，光线充足，阔落，佳丽们通过刻苦练习，已掌曜到花木兰表演的神韵与功架。今年，我们将看到一场有别于往年以中国古代美女 ”独抱琵琶半遮脸” 的出场形式，取而代之的是一批 ”不教胡马渡关山” 俊俏姑娘以飒爽英姿的风格来亮相。 二、浪漫魅彩美人鱼。花木兰之后，一阵不同风格的轻音乐把我们的感觉从刚强拉回到柔美，方才如火如荼的劲舞渐变成可爱的沙滩派对。在第二场泳装秀的序幕中，加勒比的海风缓缓吹来，一群漫妙舞者 (Hodgie乔编舞) 在橙色和黄色灯光中婀娜多姿地跳起拉丁舞 (由加勒比拉丁舞组表演) ，让观众陶醉在浪漫的异国夏日风情中厖。 在彩灯和音乐之下，佳丽们身穿泳装行走catwalk出场，有如魅彩美人鱼，展现起她们美好的身段。还记得吗？曾消隠了数十年的佳丽泳装秀直到去年才重回舞台，不过当时的佳丽腰间还是遮掩地系上了一条丝巾，这也是全世界 ”最特别” 的泳装秀！今年的佳丽能打破这种画蛇添足的思想桎梏吗？因为在三四十年前，凤凰城华裔小姐选美早就已经有过这种显现身段美态的泳装表演呢！ 三、魔幻才华俏公主。第三场序幕，我们先看到一场中国魔术式的 ”变脸”，而与之呼应的，是由Hodgie乔编导的”古代魔盒”（由Worldbeat舞蹈团演出），并由此引出佳丽们的才艺表演。在古典音乐和绿、紫、蓝色灯光的衬托下，佳丽们一一登场，用歌曲、钢琴、小提琴、民间舞、民族舞、拉丁舞等才华显示出现代女性的多才多艺的一面，其中不少节目曾得到过奬项呢！才艺表演是选美过程中最令人赏心悦目的环节，声色智艺看佳丽，谁又可在这场技艺比赛中稳操胜券？！ 四、梦幻秀慧灰姑娘。第四场是智慧问答，作为序幕，乔导演编排了一段Funky Ballroom 舞蹈，由芭蕾舞团演出。而当古典音乐响起，舞台上蓝灯摇动起旋光，烟幕再开启之时，七位佳丽已身穿晚礼服，在俊男陪伴下来到台前，进行智慧问答。她们将如何回答问题﹖又有那一位佳丽能够艳压群芳，最终穿上最合适的”水晶鞋”，从”灰姑娘”变为2011年度的鳯凰城华裔小姐，戴上璀璨的皇冠呢﹖一场《丽影霓裳俏公主》的选美将在7月4日进行，让我们拭目以待！
6967493c85d77b9157b899a3d154899d43e0a38a.translatedText: Beautiful Princess in Neon Clothes - Phoenix Beauty Pageant Report (7) Zhang Zhaohong Do you still remember the beauty pageant last year? The four-season changes of "Spring Ting‧Summer Pleasure‧Autumn Love‧Winter Song" connected the whole scene, bright and beautiful, and Miss Zhou Chang became the 2010 Miss Chinese Beauty Queen. This beauty pageant of "Forty Rhymes of Hua Cai Fei Fei" was called "the best one in the past" by Mr. Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader. So, what are the characteristics of this year's beauty pageant? Zhang Huafang, vice chairman of the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, has a new suggestion: This year, the pageant will be held in a form that combines Chinese and Western culture, drawing on four movies featuring Chinese heroines and Western fairy tales to create a new Miss Chinese beauty pageant in Phoenix City. In order to cooperate with this National Day and beauty pageant, the Overseas Chinese Federation found a better venue to perform this year. The newly selected theater has moderate transportation, convenient parking, and a spacious stage, which meets the director's requirements. The director hired Mr. Hodgie Joe, who is a Korean. In 2007, Qiao has written and directed the musical "The Crane Wife" at Yunnan University of the Arts in China. It was the first perfect cooperation between the drama department of Yunnan University of Arts and the United States. Hodgie Joe learned Taekwondo at the age of 6. As a young man, he studied music, gymnastics, ballet, jazz dance and even street dance. He has choreographed and directed hundreds of influential dance performances across the United States. He is especially good at martial arts dance. The films he directed include: Anastasia, I Can Do Anything, Unfinished Business, and Unsolved Mysteries. This is also the first time that the Overseas Chinese Federation has hired a professional outsider to direct the entire beauty pageant. Like last year, this year's beauty pageant is also expressed with four themes, namely "Beijing Mulan, Charming Mermaid, Magical Princess and Dream Cinderella." Let us take a "sneak peek" below. 1. Animated Beijing Mulan. Have you ever remembered the line in Mulan's poem: "I went thousands of miles to fight, and passed through the mountains as if I were flying. The fresh air spreads to the golden watch, and the cold light shines on the iron clothes. The general died in a hundred battles, and the strong man returned in ten years." The heroine image of China's Hua Mulan was even brought to the big screen in the form of animation by Hollywood in the United States. This beauty pageant starts with "Mulan", which highlights the richness and splendor of Chinese culture. In the prologue before "Mulan", we specifically asked the director to create an exciting atmosphere and momentum to arouse the audience's enthusiasm. Therefore, Director Qiao specially designed a dance to start with martial arts, ballet, break dancing and acrobatics, and used powerful lighting, using red and purple lights, and using chasing lights and side lights to "bind" the dancers. Through high-decibel music and smoke screens, he created a strong atmosphere and used this as a prelude to lead the beauty pageant's collective dance "Mulan". The Beijing-style "Mulan" is choreographed and directed by Vanessa Hu from the New Oriental Art School. Teacher Hu has been dancing since she was a child and has furthered her studies in New York. She is good at dancing and directing. The dance practice venue at the New Oriental Art School is very professional, with solid wood floors, floor-to-ceiling mirrors, sound insulation, ample lighting, and wide floor space. Through hard practice, the beauties have mastered the charm and performance of Mulan's performance. This year, we will see a show that is different from previous years in which ancient Chinese beauties "holding a pipa alone and half covering their faces" will be replaced by a group of handsome girls who "don't teach Huma to cross the mountains" and will appear in a dashing and heroic style. 2. Romantic and charming mermaid. After Mulan, a burst of light music of different styles brought our feelings back from strong to soft, and the vigorous dance just now gradually turned into a lovely beach party. In the prelude to the second swimsuit show, the Caribbean sea breeze blew slowly, and a group of graceful dancers (choreographed by Hodgie Joe) performed graceful Latin dances (performed by the Caribbean Latin dance group) under orange and yellow lights, making the audience intoxicated in the romantic and exotic summer style. Under the colorful lights and music, the beauties appeared on the catwalk wearing swimsuits, like charming mermaids, showing off their beautiful figures. Remember? The beauty swimsuit show, which had been missing for decades, did not return to the stage until last year. However, the beauties at that time still wore a silk scarf to cover their waists. This was also the "most special" swimsuit show in the world! Can this year's beauties break the shackles of this superfluous thought? Because thirty or forty years ago, the Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant had already had this kind of swimsuit performance that showed off the beauty of the figure! 3. The magical and talented pretty princess. In the prologue of the third scene, we first saw a Chinese magic-style "face-changing", which echoed the "Ancient Magic Box" choreographed and directed by Hodgie Qiao (performed by the Worldbeat Dance Company), which led to the talent show of the beauties. Set against the backdrop of classical music and green, purple and blue lights, the beauties took the stage one by one, using songs, piano, violin, folk dance, folk dance, Latin dance and other talents to show the versatile side of modern women. Many of these performances have won awards! The talent show is the most enjoyable part of the beauty pageant. Who can win the beauty contest with confidence in their beauty, beauty, intelligence and skills? ! 4. Dreamy and beautiful Cinderella. The fourth scene was a quiz. As a prelude, Director Qiao choreographed a Funky Ballroom dance performed by the ballet company. When the classical music started playing, the blue lights on the stage swayed, and the smoke screen turned on again, the seven beauties, already dressed in evening gowns, accompanied by handsome men, came to the stage to engage in wisdom questions and answers. How will they answer the question? Which beauty can surpass all other beauties, finally put on the most suitable "crystal slipper", change from "Cinderella" to Miss Chinese in Phoenix City in 2011, and wear a bright crown? A beauty pageant for "Princess Liying and Pretty Dresses" will be held on July 4th, let's wait and see!

On December 21, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association held its annual meeting to summarize the association’s activities over the past year and the work to be carried out next year...

7bf6f69137785a0ff0efcb7df84fca649f1f2b03.sourceText: 12月21日，亚省中国餐馆协会召开年会，总结一年来的协会活动和明年即将开展的工作。今年餐馆会和百事可乐签定新的合约计划，为会员争取更大的优惠；而集体购货的计划也在继续进行中；协会还和郡卫生局开过工作会议，为日后更改的卫生检查条例进行瞭解和沟通。在社区服务方面，中餐馆会连年举行温暖送街友活动，并在悼念华人先辈活动，侨联庆国庆、选美活动中出钱出力。 中餐馆会办过温馨的春宴，在保龄球大赛、龙舟大赛中也获得了好成织。本次会议讨论了明年二月举办餐馆会春宴等事项。在圣诞到来之际，主席张华芳恭祝会员们圣诞新年快乐!并希望广大会员届时踊跃参加餐馆会春宴。
7bf6f69137785a0ff0efcb7df84fca649f1f2b03.translatedText: On December 21, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association held its annual meeting to summarize the association’s activities over the past year and the work to be carried out next year. This year the restaurant will sign a new contract plan with Pepsi-Cola to obtain greater discounts for members; the collective purchase plan is also ongoing; the association has also held a working meeting with the county health bureau to understand and communicate on future changes to health inspection regulations. In terms of community services, Chinese restaurants will hold warm send-off events to homeless people year after year, and contribute money and effort in commemorating Chinese ancestors, the Overseas Chinese National Day, and beauty pageants. The Chinese Restaurant Association held a warm spring banquet, and also won good success in bowling competitions and dragon boat competitions. This meeting discussed matters such as holding a restaurant spring banquet next February. On the occasion of Christmas, Chairman Zhang Huafang wishes members a happy Christmas and New Year! He also hopes that all members will actively participate in the restaurant's spring banquet.

2769b1a3b78774441727ae27eaa7e57e27e53d86.translatedText: The difficulties of the U.S. retirement benefit system are getting worse

f3cfbba12f7b8a6c2dc2b8583ec174ba90100a95.sourceText: 美国退休福利制度困难加重 （亚省时报） 监督向老年人提供退休金和医疗照顾的政府官员说，有关项目正陷于财务困…
f3cfbba12f7b8a6c2dc2b8583ec174ba90100a95.translatedText: The difficulties of the U.S. retirement benefit system are getting worse (Alberta Times) Government officials who oversee the provision of pensions and medical care to the elderly say that relevant programs are in financial difficulties...

0b7faa8aecdb32e86fa665ecb56115065592c665.sourceText: 监督向老年人提供退休金和医疗照顾的政府官员说，有关项目正陷于财务困境，而且去年一年来境况更为糟糕。 美国千百万老年人或者残障人士依靠称为社会安全的退休金制度维生。有几百万人还要依靠65岁以上的人享受的健康保险：即医疗照顾项目。 星期一的报告说，这一退休福利项目将在2033年前耗尽储备金，比先前的估计还提早了三年时间。那意味着这一体系的收入将完全依靠工资税中的特定部分，迫使官员把福利削减四分之一。 管理社会安全体系的官员说，为老年人提供的医疗照顾项目到2024年也面临资金匮乏局面。 财政部长盖特纳说，华盛顿必须采取步骤使得有关项目依然能承担未来几代人所需费用。问题在于二战后出生的人数异乎寻常之多，而这批人正在达到退休年龄，增加了有资格享受退休福利的人数。退休人士也比以往的寿命长，那也增加了退休福利的费用。 在所谓的”婴儿潮”之后出生的那一代人人数较少，所以向他们的征税所筹集的资金也较少。费用升高和收入降低的问题导致社安项目出现赤字。那使得决策者不得不在提高征税或削减福利或者双管齐下之间作出困难的抉择。
0b7faa8aecdb32e86fa665ecb56115065592c665.translatedText: Government officials who oversee the provision of pensions and medical care to the elderly say that relevant programs are in financial difficulty, and the situation has become worse last year. Millions of elderly or disabled Americans rely on a pension system called Social Security to make ends meet. Millions of people still rely on health insurance available to people over 65: Medicare. Monday's report said the retirement benefit program will deplete reserves by 2033, three years earlier than previously estimated. That means the system will rely entirely on a specific portion of payroll taxes for revenue, forcing officials to cut benefits by a quarter. Officials who run Social Security say health care programs for seniors will also be underfunded through 2024. Treasury Secretary Geithner said Washington must take steps to make the projects affordable for generations to come. The problem is that an unusually large number of people were born after World War II, and these people are reaching retirement age, increasing the number of people eligible for retirement benefits. Retirees are also living longer than ever, which increases the cost of retirement benefits. The generation born after the so-called "baby boom" is smaller, so taxing them raises less money. The problems of rising costs and lower revenues have led to deficits in Social Security programs. That leaves policymakers with a difficult choice between raising taxes or cutting benefits or both.

3f443807effb8f7c37d1a03b9eb6aaabb809e1ec.translatedText: Choices of Investment Immigration (Alberta Times) My friend has a company that has been in business for more than 30 years. He wants to retire and sell the company to me. But I don't know if this is a...

431e3959e0ba84982c90e13295431dc73999d333.sourceText: 我朋友有一家已营业30多年的公司，他想退休把公司卖给我。 但我不知道这是否是个好主意做100万投资移民，还是应该去投资区域中心投资50万？ 答：不论你的决定是个人投资或区域投资中心，一般而言，大多数的个人投资是以投资100万美元为主（除了失业率至少为全国失业率150％以上的区域﹑大都市统计区 或仅有二万人口市镇以外的区域外，这些个人投资的金额为50万美元)，而大多数区域中心则以投资50 万美元为主。 如果是个人投资案，基本上你要自己经营业务，而投资区域中心，你将是一位有限合伙人，对中心的经营运作没有参与的权利。 移民局共有超过173家批准的不同项目的区域中心，有些区域中心可能在财务上有问题，也可能申请绿卡被拒。 你朋友的公司已开业超过30年，不属新企业(新企业为1990年11月29 日之后成立的公司)，要符合投资移民的企业的资格要改组﹑重建或扩大经营，增加40%的 雇员或净资产。 即使你改组或重建你朋友的公司，让它达到符合投资移民企业的资格，你仍要增加十位或更多的美国员工（扩大40%的营运），除非你朋友的业务已有麻烦（过去 24个月或12个月中企业的净值已遭20%的损失），继续保持目前所有的员工两年可顶替创造工作机会的要求。 如果你朋友的公司是1​​990年11月29日之后的公司﹐那么建议你只是买他公司的资产100万元﹐你设立你自己的全新公司雇10个全时间的美国员工就比较容易办理。
431e3959e0ba84982c90e13295431dc73999d333.translatedText: My friend has a company that has been in business for more than 30 years, and he wants to retire and sell the company to me. But I don’t know if it’s a good idea to do 1 million investment immigrants, or should I invest 500,000 in an investment regional center? Answer: Regardless of whether you decide to invest individually or in a regional investment center, generally speaking, most individual investments are based on investments of US$1 million (except for areas with an unemployment rate of at least 150% of the national unemployment rate, metropolitan statistical areas, or areas with a population of only 20,000, the amount of individual investments is US$500,000), while most regional centers are based on investments of US$500,000. If it is an individual investment case, you basically have to run the business yourself. If you invest in a regional center, you will be a limited partner and have no right to participate in the operation of the center. There are more than 173 approved regional centers for different projects by the Immigration Bureau. Some regional centers may have financial problems or may have their green card applications rejected. Your friend's company has been in business for more than 30 years and is not a new enterprise (a new enterprise is a company established after November 29, 1990). To qualify as an enterprise for investment immigration, it must reorganize, rebuild or expand operations, and increase its employees or net assets by 40%. Even if you reorganize or rebuild your friend's company so that it qualifies as an investment immigrant enterprise, you will still need to add ten or more U.S. employees (expand operations by 40%). Unless your friend's business is in trouble (the business's net worth has suffered a 20% loss in the past 24 months or 12 months), continue to maintain the two-year job creation requirement for all current employees. If your friend's company was established after November 29, 1990, then it is recommended that you just buy his company's assets for 1 million yuan. It will be easier for you to set up your own brand new company and hire 10 full-time American employees.

a1834e6c240910ef0a7d90df2f575211067aeec3.translatedText: Survey: National gasoline prices fell for the first time in months (Alberta Times) A national survey released on Sunday showed that the national average gasoline price over the past two weeks...

810b1be0ab5a1cc023df8dd8e5488baa56c49a82.sourceText: 调查：全美汽油价格数月来首次下跌 （亚省时报） 上周日公布的一项全国性调查显示，在过去2周内全国平均汽油价格下降超过5美分，这是去年12月以来的首次下跌。 据有线电视新闻网报道，伦德伯格调查显示，目前普通汽油的平均价格是3.91美元。这一价格比2周前下跌了至少5美分，当时的平均油价已逼近4美元大关。 ”我们可以将汽油价格几周以来出现的下降归因于原油（价格的变化），”发行人特里比?#20262;德伯格说。 汽油供应量丰富，但原油价格却”抬高”了汽油成本，她说。由于原油价格稳定了下来，汽油价格因此下降。 如果原油不上涨，”我们在今后几周还可能看到5到10美分的下跌，”她说。 即使前瞻至5月下旬，全国进入驾驶高峰期，如果原油价格保持稳定，油价也可能因为供应量充足而不会暴增。 全国1年前的平均油价是3.88美元，比目前的平均价格少3美分，伦德伯格说。 伦德伯格调查每2周就会统计一次全国数千加油站的油价。在过去这2周中，芝加哥的平均油价下跌了近19美分，降至4.26美元，但这仍然是最近一次调查中最高的城市油价。 另外，平均油价最低的城市在俄克拉荷马的塔尔萨（Tulsa），为3.52美元。
810b1be0ab5a1cc023df8dd8e5488baa56c49a82.translatedText: Survey: National gasoline prices fell for the first time in months (Alberta Times) A nationwide survey released on Sunday showed that the national average price of gasoline has fallen by more than 5 cents in the past two weeks, the first decline since December. According to CNN, a Lundberg survey showed that the current average price of regular gasoline is $3.91. The price is down at least 5 cents from two weeks ago, when the average oil price was approaching the $4 mark. "We can attribute the decline in gasoline prices that we've seen over the past few weeks to crude oil (price changes)," publisher Trib?#20262; DeBerg said. Gasoline is in abundant supply, but crude oil prices have "increased" the cost of gasoline, she said. As crude oil prices stabilized, gasoline prices fell. If crude oil doesn't rise, "we could see another 5 to 10 cents lower over the next few weeks," she said. Even if we look forward to late May, when the country enters peak driving period, if crude oil prices remain stable, oil prices may not surge due to sufficient supply. The national average price of gas a year ago was $3.88, 3 cents less than the current average price, Lundberg said. The Lundberg Survey counts gas prices at thousands of gas stations across the country every two weeks. Chicago's average gas price has dropped nearly 19 cents over the past two weeks to $4.26, but it's still the highest city price in the most recent survey. In addition, the city with the lowest average gas price is Tulsa, Oklahoma, at $3.52.

d41e9fa3ddc92676a9534633d2e253de37e288aa.sourceText: 牛气冲天 不是股市是马路 (亚省时报) 周日傍晚，钱特勒警方在马路上射杀了一头牛。 晚上7时左右，一头牛失控践踏了一名9岁男孩后冲到Queen Creek和Alma School路附近，继续向前猛冲，交通警设置路障阻止不果，开枪射杀。 这是近期内钱特勒第二起疯牛上路事件。要是牛气冲天的是股市或房市该多好。

Around 7 p.m., a cow lost control and trampled a 9-year-old boy, then rushed near Queen Creek and Alma School roads. It continued to charge forward. Traffic police set up roadblocks to stop the boy and shot him. This is the second Mad Cow incident in Chandler in recent times. If only the stock market or the housing market were bullish.

4c578860242d93813747208a1f032df22587d4bf.sourceText: 在美国纯中国血统的中国大陆移民312万多人中，第一代移民的人数为169万多人，占华裔移民总数的54.2%，他们很多仍按较传统方式生活。
4c578860242d93813747208a1f032df22587d4bf.translatedText: Among the more than 3.12 million mainland Chinese immigrants in the United States with pure Chinese ancestry, the number of first-generation immigrants is more than 1.69 million, accounting for 54.2% of the total number of Chinese immigrants. Many of them still live in a more traditional way.

c45aebf9db6bb35948461d24725b20112a1dbff0.sourceText: 第一代移民的人数为51万多人，占华裔移民总数的16.4%。第二代以上移民人数为91万多人，占华裔移民总数的29.4%。
c45aebf9db6bb35948461d24725b20112a1dbff0.translatedText: The number of first-generation immigrants is more than 510,000, accounting for 16.4% of the total number of Chinese immigrants. The number of second-generation and above immigrants is more than 910,000, accounting for 29.4% of the total number of Chinese immigrants.

b55cbba543459e656262c9f2bcf417f5fdb0602d.sourceText: 第二代华裔的生活方式较为美国化，多用英文沟通和社交，与主流社会接触比较多。第一代与第二代一起生活的华裔家庭人口约占45.8%，他们生活方式较为混合化。
b55cbba543459e656262c9f2bcf417f5fdb0602d.translatedText: The lifestyle of the second generation Chinese Americans is more American, they mostly communicate and socialize in English, and they have more contact with mainstream society. Approximately 45.8% of the population of Chinese families living with the first and second generations live together, and their lifestyles are relatively mixed.

663878626455a3423d4001054f5bda16041cd338.sourceText: 华人在美国的居住很有规律，主要是集中在加州、纽约和大都会城市。加州的华裔人口有110多万人，占总华裔人口的36.9%，纽约州华裔人口为50多万人，占16.9%。
663878626455a3423d4001054f5bda16041cd338.translatedText: Chinese people live regularly in the United States, mainly concentrated in California, New York and metropolitan cities. The Chinese population in California is more than 1.1 million, accounting for 36.9% of the total Chinese population, and the Chinese population in New York State is more than 500,000, accounting for 16.9%.

663c5ed9d32a977f0702ad07b5578a4216fb2e3a.sourceText: 其它美国华裔最多分布于新泽西州，有13万多人，占4.4%。德州有12万多人，占4.2%。马萨诸塞州有11万多人，占3.8%。华盛顿州有8万多人，占2.8%。宾夕法尼亚州有7万多人，占2.5%。马里兰州有6万多人，占2.3%。佛罗里达州有6万多人，占4.1%。
663c5ed9d32a977f0702ad07b5578a4216fb2e3a.translatedText: The largest number of other Chinese Americans are located in New Jersey, with more than 130,000 people, accounting for 4.4%. There are more than 120,000 people in Texas, accounting for 4.2%. There are more than 110,000 people in Massachusetts, accounting for 3.8%. There are more than 80,000 people in Washington state, accounting for 2.8%. There are more than 70,000 people in Pennsylvania, accounting for 2.5%. There are more than 60,000 people in Maryland, accounting for 2.3%. There are more than 60,000 people in Florida, accounting for 4.1%.

9eab3d7f5a615e3949aa093d1b8204571cd247d8.sourceText: 而按都会地区来看，纽约-新泽西东北地区来自中国大陆移民数量为55万多人，旧金山-奥克兰圣荷西地区有50多万人，洛杉矶-长堤-河边地区有45万多人，大华府地区有10万多人，大芝加哥地区有近9万人。
9eab3d7f5a615e3949aa093d1b8204571cd247d8.translatedText: By metropolitan area, there are more than 550,000 immigrants from mainland China in the New York-New Jersey Northeast area, more than 500,000 immigrants in the San Francisco-Oakland San Jose area, more than 450,000 people in the Los Angeles-Cairo-Riverside area, more than 100,000 people in the Greater Washington area, and nearly 90,000 people in the Greater Chicago area.

b5f07afb9b37b6b2c153619bd97286325096f9a4.sourceText: 美国的华裔人口主要来自四个地区，其中来自中国的移民占据主导地位。在第二次世界大战前，美国的华人移民多来自广东和香港。20世纪50年代，大量中国台湾民众移居美国。与此同时，东南亚各国的中国公民移民美国后也构成美国华人社区的一部分。
b5f07afb9b37b6b2c153619bd97286325096f9a4.translatedText: The Chinese population in the United States mainly comes from four regions, among which immigrants from China dominate. Before World War II, most Chinese immigrants in the United States came from Guangdong and Hong Kong. In the 1950s, a large number of Taiwanese people immigrated to the United States. At the same time, Chinese citizens from Southeast Asian countries immigrated to the United States and formed part of the Chinese community in the United States.

5219ba0a981c8ee503b5ed083589e15f08355abf.sourceText: 20世纪70年代后，中国居民赴美留学、探亲人数增多，在90年代形成民众赴美的高潮，这些人被称之为华裔中的新移民，以区别以前来自广东、香港的老侨和来自台湾的移民。
5219ba0a981c8ee503b5ed083589e15f08355abf.translatedText: After the 1970s, the number of Chinese residents studying in the United States and visiting relatives increased. In the 1990s, there was a climax of people going to the United States. These people are called new immigrants of Chinese descent to distinguish the old overseas Chinese from Guangdong and Hong Kong and the immigrants from Taiwan.

0b5d95d64fdcbb4a46aeadae78afb49d83f20d10.sourceText: 在美国的华裔移民中，来自中国大陆的移民占据多数，比例为59.5%，也就是说美国华裔移民中5个人中，3个是来自中国大陆。来自中国台湾的移民占15.9%，美国华裔移民6个人中，有1个来自台湾。来自东南亚各国的中国血统移民占15.3%，美国华裔移民6个人中有1个来自东南亚各国。
0b5d95d64fdcbb4a46aeadae78afb49d83f20d10.translatedText: Among the Chinese immigrants in the United States, immigrants from mainland China account for the majority, accounting for 59.5%. This means that 3 out of 5 Chinese immigrants in the United States are from mainland China. Immigrants from Taiwan, China account for 15.9%. Among the 6 Chinese immigrants in the United States, 1 is from Taiwan. Chinese immigrants from Southeast Asian countries account for 15.3%, and 1 in 6 Chinese immigrants in the United States is from Southeast Asian countries.

baaee32ae0cb920815f96d6ff5bbaad69b29dd4b.sourceText: 10月15日晚在蓝天酒家举行了”凤凰之夜”中秋国庆的感谢晚宴。 亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会（华联）会长费健，志愿者们12人参加。 一年来的时间里，志愿者们在一起都是领任务或者解决问题，这一天终于可以就说说笑笑。 费健说非常感谢大家的支持，因为在座的各位，以及那些没时间来参加感谢晚宴的朋友，”凤凰之夜”活动才能办得这么成功，并邀请来宾共同举杯庆祝”凤凰之夜” 的顺利举行。 当晚志愿者聊天， 调侃只有一件事情谈得最热闹那就是华联未来的发展。 会长费健首先确定了几件能为华人社区做的事情，志愿者李军，提出华联未来发展的远景。 孔子学院代表徐智萍和唐国明则用孔子学院的成长过程，说怎样把远景规划，和现在做的事情结合起来。 饭局上，李健就担任起记录的责任，前副会长廖峰说华联的宗旨就是要弘扬中华文化，保护华人利益，提高华人地位。 在座的志愿者李军，陶世诚，林欣，王馨欣，汪洋，戎勤奋就你一言我一语，提议华联接下去可以去做的具体活动，怎样利用现有的人力、物力、财力来逐步实现预定 的宗旨。 例如弘扬中华文化，就由”凤凰之夜”中秋国庆活动，春节的传统活动来实现，提高华人地位，华联鼓励华人参政议政，尽量为华裔创造参政，选举的讲座辩论等活动，通过这些活动 让大家有参政意识，扩大华人的话语权。 保护华人利益上，会尽全力争取一些方便华人的服务，包括签证等问题。 有志愿者开玩笑说：”等了一年，原来打算就好好吃一顿的，没想到又杀死这么多脑细胞…”看到，这些快乐而”自虐”的志愿者们，相信华 联的明天会更好！
baaee32ae0cb920815f96d6ff5bbaad69b29dd4b.translatedText: The "Phoenix Night" Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day appreciation dinner was held at the Blue Sky Restaurant on the evening of October 15th. Fei Jian, President of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Arizona (Hualian), and 12 volunteers participated. For a year, the volunteers have been working together to solve problems. On this day, they were finally able to chat and laugh. Fei Jian said that he was very grateful for everyone’s support, as well as those friends who did not have time to attend the thank-you dinner. The “Phoenix Night” event was so successful, and he invited the guests to toast to celebrate the success of the “Phoenix Night”. There was only one thing that was most talked about and that was the future development of Hualian. President Fei Jian first identified several things that could be done for the Chinese community. Volunteer Li Jun proposed the future development of Hualian. Confucius Institute representatives Xu Zhiping and Tang Guoming used the growth process of the Confucius Institute to talk about how to combine the long-term planning with the current things. At the dinner, Li Jian took on the responsibility of recording. Former Vice President Liao Feng said that the purpose of Hualian is to promote Chinese culture, protect the interests of the Chinese, and improve the status of the Chinese. The volunteers present, Li Jun, Tao Shicheng, Lin Xin, Wang Xinxin, Wang Yang, and Rong Qinjin, suggested specific activities that Hualian can do in the future, and how to use existing manpower, material resources, and financial resources to gradually achieve the intended purpose. For example, the promotion of Chinese culture can be achieved through the "Phoenix Night" Mid-Autumn Festival National Day activities and the traditional activities of the Spring Festival to improve the status of the Chinese. Hualian encourages Chinese to participate in politics and try to create activities such as political participation and election lectures and debates for Chinese people. Through these activities, everyone will be aware of political participation and expand the voice of the Chinese. In terms of protecting the interests of the Chinese, we will do our best to provide services that are convenient for the Chinese, including visa and other issues. One volunteer joked: "I waited for a year and originally planned to have a good meal, but I didn't expect to kill so many brain cells..." Seeing these happy and "self-abuse" volunteers, I believe that Hualian's tomorrow will be better!

f5f8709b43aff74984f8b803947d6e88832f8f36.sourceText: 太想做全民总统 马英九选情堪忧 世界新闻网 马英九总统竞选办公室今天成立，正式迈向2012连任之路。但监察院前院长钱复日前接受媒体专访时表示，以目前局势看来，他非常忧心马总统选情，原因是马总统太想做全民总统，然而在台湾蓝绿对立的社会中，最后顾此失彼，蓝的气他、绿的不感谢他，「四处道歉、四处解释，把总统做小了」。 钱复说，马总统「温良恭俭让」样样俱到，却「做到累死，也被人怨死」，因为我们处于一个对立社会，如果偏哪一边，就被另一边打死，「要是在中间，两边一起打你」。他说，有时候一个人「心太好，反而被好所害」，马英九就是一个例子。 钱复日前接受凤凰卫视「风云对话」节目主持人阮次山专访，在长约廿分钟访谈中，细数马英九的特质及台湾政局，并对马的选情表达忧心。 面对主持人提问，马总统应该会赢，但会选得很辛苦。钱复坦言不能完全接受，他说，有些比较中立的媒体所做民调，民进党主席蔡英文、行政院前院长苏贞昌都可以赢过马英九，且都赢过百分之四到六，「这已经不太会有错误了」。 此外，从2008年后，很多次补选，国民党赢少输多，主要原因是蓝营死忠的人没有出来投票，所以投票率降低，这是他最忧虑的。 钱复认为，以台北的盘势来看，泛蓝占百分之五十五、泛绿占百分之四十五，如果马英九能够有一个举动，让所有蓝的都觉得对了，「你终于像我们所想的」，就会赢了。 面对紧张的选举情势，马总统表现却很沉着，「不心惊肉跳」，也让钱复有些意外。钱复自称「一路走背运」，所以永远记得「未虑胜、先虑败」，他认为，马总统的沉着，与其成长过程一路顺遂有关，「他不大了解有时候可能不这么顺」。 钱复感叹，今天在民主国家做领导者不容易，像日本菅直人、美国欧巴马、菲律宾艾奎诺，都不很舒服，也许民主政治要付出的代价，就是「牺牲一些好的政治人物」。 面对钱复的忧虑，国民党发言人苏俊宾响应表示「谢谢钱院长关心」，国民党对未来选举有高度危机意识，但只要目标明确、方向正确，无需太过担忧。他并强调，马总统要当全民总统，不仅是竞选承诺，也是对台湾最好的方式，没有讨好谁的问题，「做全民有利的事，就是全民总统」。
f5f8709b43aff74984f8b803947d6e88832f8f36.translatedText: Ma Ying-jeou wants to be the president of the people too much, but Ma Ying-jeou's election situation is worrying. World News Network Ma Ying-jeou's presidential campaign office was established today, officially heading towards the road to re-election in 2012. However, Qian Fu, the former director of the Supervisory Yuan, said in an exclusive interview with the media that based on the current situation, he is very worried about President Ma's election. The reason is that President Ma really wants to be the president of the people. However, in Taiwan's society where blue and green are opposed, he ends up focusing on one thing and the other. The blue people are angry with him, while the green people do not thank him. They "apologise and explain everywhere, making the president smaller." Qian Fu said that President Ma was "gentle, courteous, frugal and accommodating" in everything, but "he was tired to death and was blamed to death" because we are in an antagonistic society. If you lean to one side, you will be beaten to death by the other side. "If you are in the middle, both sides will beat you together." He said that sometimes a person "has a good heart and is harmed by his kindness." Ma Ying-jeou is an example. Qian Fu recently accepted an exclusive interview with Ruan Cishan, the host of Phoenix TV's "Wind and Cloud Dialogue" program. During the approximately 20-minute interview, he detailed Ma Ying-jeou's characteristics and Taiwan's political situation, and expressed concern about Ma Ying-jeou's election. When asked by the host, President Ma should win, but the election will be very difficult. Qian Fu admitted that he could not fully accept it. He said that some polls conducted by relatively neutral media showed that DPP Chairman Tsai Ing-wen and former Executive Yuan President Su Tseng-chang could beat Ma Ying-jeou, and both won by 4 to 6 percent. "This is no longer wrong." In addition, since 2008, in many by-elections, the Kuomintang has won less and lost more. The main reason is that die-hard blue camp people did not come out to vote, so the turnout rate dropped. This is what worries him most. Qian Fu believes that judging from the situation in Taipei, 55% are blue and 45% are green. If Ma Ying-jeou can make a move that makes all the blue people feel that he is right and "you are finally what we thought," he will win. Facing the tense election situation, President Ma behaved calmly and "not panicked," which also surprised Qian Fu. Qian Fu claimed that he had "unlucky luck along the way", so he always remembered to "think about defeat before thinking about victory." He believed that President Ma's composure was related to his smooth growth process. "He didn't quite understand that sometimes it might not be so smooth." Qian Fu lamented that it is not easy to be a leader in a democratic country today. Naoto Kan in Japan, Obama in the United States, and Aquino in the Philippines are all very uncomfortable. Perhaps the price to be paid for democratic politics is to "sacrifice some good politicians." In response to Qian Fu's concerns, Kuomintang spokesperson Su Junbin said, "Thank you, Dean Qian, for your concern." The Kuomintang has a high degree of crisis awareness about future elections, but as long as the goal is clear and the direction is correct, there is no need to worry too much. He also emphasized that President Ma's desire to be the people's president is not only a campaign promise, but also the best way for Taiwan. There is no question of who to please. "If you do things that are beneficial to the people, you will be the people's president."
