1733dfa6ce60f113d79c95ff5c24fdf3cd17f7f0.sourceText: 凤凰城一所名为”女神寺”的寺院，在经过长达半年的卧底调查后，发现竟为一所妓院。 警方已经逮捕了涉案的20名男女。 但凤凰城警察局发言人马托斯(Steve Martos)表示，当局仍在追捕潜逃在外的17名涉案人员。 被捕的20人已经被以卖淫罪等罪名起诉。 在本周三的搜查工作中，警方获取了证据表明在这个寺庙工作的男女”护工”以为寺庙”募捐”的名义从事卖淫活动;而他们竟然还打着”新密宗”(neo tantric)治疗法 的旗号。 由于邻居的抱怨、一家报纸的报导，以及寺庙的网站上的信息，引起了警方的注意并开始卧底调查。 马托斯说：”这家妓院的不同之处在于他们伪装成寺院，并打着宗教活动的旗号;利用宗教自由进行卖淫犯罪活动。” 马托斯说：”我们当然尊重宪法第一修正案赋予人民的权利。但宗教自由不等于他们可以利用此来犯罪。”马托斯告诉记者说，这家”寺庙”妓院每月收入数十 万。 这家”女神寺”的网站上这样说：”性是神圣的，是生命核心的治愈力量。一旦我们对性敞开双臂而不是拒绝它，我们就会表现出成功，幸福并且有力量。” 网站上还登出裸女的照片，在”女神们”一栏下标出她们所在的州。 该寺庙的”老鸹”，现年50岁的伊犁色(Tracy Elise)已经被捕并已卖淫罪、非法控制罪、拉皮条罪以及经营妓院罪而起诉。 该寺庙位于凤凰城市中心地区，并且在萨当那还有一个办事处。 这个办事处很可能是卖淫者休息睡觉的地方。
1733dfa6ce60f113d79c95ff5c24fdf3cd17f7f0.translatedText: A temple in Phoenix called the "Goddess Temple" was discovered to be a brothel after a half-year undercover investigation. The police have arrested 20 men and women involved in the case. But Phoenix Police Department spokesman Steve Martos said authorities are still hunting for the 17 people involved in the case who are absconding. The 20 people arrested have been charged with prostitution and other crimes. During the search on Wednesday, the police obtained evidence that the male and female "caregivers" working at the temple were engaged in prostitution in the name of "raising donations" for the temple; and they were even doing so under the guise of "neo tantric" therapy. Complaints from neighbors, a newspaper report, and information on the temple's website brought police to the attention and began an undercover investigation. Matos said: "What is different about this brothel is that they disguise themselves as a temple and use religious freedom to carry out criminal activities of prostitution." Matos said: "Of course we respect the rights given to the people by the First Amendment of the Constitution. But religious freedom does not mean they can use it to commit crimes." Matos told reporters that this "temple" brothel earns hundreds of thousands a month. The website of this "goddess temple" says: "Sex is sacred and a healing force at the core of life. Once we open our arms to sex instead of rejecting it, we will appear successful, happy and powerful." The website also publishes photos of naked women, marking their states under the "Goddess" column. The temple's "old man", 50-year-old Tracy Elise, has been arrested and charged with prostitution, unlawful control, pimping and running a brothel. The temple is located in downtown Phoenix and also has an office in Sadhana. This office was probably where prostitutes rested and slept.

e10a3429b13ef59106bbd733bc5cd0c3d9330efa.sourceText: 据陕西广播电视台《第一新闻》报道 眼看就要过年了，许多年轻人在享受即将和家人团聚的喜悦的同时，还要面临一些不得不说的尴尬，最近，网友们就总结出春节过年回家的十大劫难，包括不发年终奖、春运票难买、回家催婚火力强等事情都荣誉上榜，那么到底这些劫难是否像网友所说的那样令人恐怖呢？
e10a3429b13ef59106bbd733bc5cd0c3d9330efa.translatedText: According to Shaanxi Radio and Television Station's "First News" report The New Year is just around the corner. While many young people are enjoying the joy of being reunited with their families, they also have to face some embarrassments. Recently, netizens have summarized the top ten disasters of returning home for the Spring Festival, including no year-end bonuses, difficulty in buying Spring Festival tickets, and strong pressure to get married when returning home. So are these disasters as scary as netizens say?

63de75b793f042caae49085133bb0609559b9443.sourceText: ”亲，现在起至12月31日止，您拨打24小时免费客服热线110，包全身体检、包吃住，还有许多聚划算优惠套餐厖”这可不是一条淘宝网站推销卖货的帖子，而是福州警方以”淘宝体”形式在微博上对逃犯发布的?#36890;缉令?#20869;容。近段时间，越来越多的公安机关开始甚至频繁地运用新颖的网络语言，什么淘宝体、咆哮体、凡客体、非诚体，在微博上宣传自己、回复群众、作预警提示等，引得众多网友议论纷纷，褒贬不一。有关人士认为，公安机关此举是亲民的表现，但应限于非执法交流，并恪守道德底线。
63de75b793f042caae49085133bb0609559b9443.translatedText: "Dear, from now until December 31, you can call the 24-hour toll-free customer service hotline 110, which will include a full physical examination, food and accommodation, and many Juhuasuan discount packages." This is not a post on Taobao website to promote sales, but an arrest warrant issued by Fuzhou police on Weibo in the form of "Taobao body" for fugitives. In recent times, more and more public security agencies have begun to frequently use novel Internet languages, such as Taobao style, roaring style, Fanke style, and Feicheng style, to promote themselves, reply to the masses, and issue early warning reminders on Weibo, which has attracted many netizens to discuss, with mixed praise and criticism. Relevant people believe that this move by the public security organs is a sign of being close to the people, but it should be limited to non-law enforcement exchanges and adhere to the moral bottom line.

ae2784d66212c9990567bf2864fc4abc7e58fdae.translatedText: Yesterday afternoon, "blogger" Fuzhou Public Security Bureau Public Relations Department Public Relations Section Ma Tengzhou responded to netizens' questions and said that the official Weibo of Fuzhou Public Security Bureau is defined as the "big brother next door". Different from serious official press conferences, the language posted on Weibo should be closer to the masses and richer in Internet language characteristics, so that it can be more easily accepted by more netizens, thereby achieving the function of disseminating information as quickly as possible.

bbfe1bdd4b6f79e576fc5b3ebe242442f259c4fa.sourceText: 《华尔街日报》：中国人为何利率越低越爱存款? 美国《华尔街日报》网站9月24日文章题：银行对待中国人越糟糕，中国人存的钱就越多 多年来，对于中国人为什么要存那么多钱有过很多种解释。这里有一种新的解释：国际货币基金组织(IMF)的一项研究指出，中国的银行对待其客户越是糟糕，中国的客户存的钱就会越多。 自从上世纪90年代中期以来，中国城市家庭的储蓄率已经从占可支配收入的19%上升到30%。而也就是在这一时间段，中国的人均收入增加了5倍。人越是富有，存的钱就会越少，这种说法还说得过去。但是在中国，情况则恰好相反。 一些经济学家认为中国人存钱的目的是为了应对糟糕的养老和医疗体系，因为他们知道一旦生病就要花很多的钱。还有人认为中国人想买房子。 IMF的经济学家马尔哈?#32435;巴尔的说法则不同。他说中国人的头脑中有一个储蓄额度目标，这样才能买得起房子和家电，看得起病以及做其它事情。他们会竭尽全力达到这个目标。 所以当排除通胀因素之后银行给的利息更少时，他们就会多存钱。而当银行给的利息更多时，他们就会少存钱，因为即使少存钱他们也能很容易达到目标。 1996年以来，中国银行的利率水平越来越恶化棗?#20063;就是说利率低于通胀率的差距越来越大。所以，中国人存的钱越来越多。因此，银行越是对客户不好，客户们反而存钱越来越多。 纳巴尔写道：”银行储蓄利率的持续升高以及更多的其他投资选择将有助于家庭达到预期的储蓄目标。”换句话说，如果银行对客户好一些，他们就会少存一些钱。
bbfe1bdd4b6f79e576fc5b3ebe242442f259c4fa.translatedText: "Wall Street Journal": Why do Chinese people love to deposit more when interest rates are lower? The title of the article on the US "Wall Street Journal" website on September 24: The worse banks treat Chinese people, the more money Chinese people save. Over the years, there have been many explanations for why Chinese people save so much money. Here's a new explanation: An International Monetary Fund (IMF) study notes that the worse Chinese banks treat their customers, the more money Chinese customers save. Since the mid-1990s, the savings rate of Chinese urban households has risen from 19% of disposable income to 30%. During this period, China's per capita income increased fivefold. It makes sense that the richer people get, the less they save. But in China, the situation is exactly the opposite. Some economists believe that Chinese people save money to cope with the poor pension and medical system, because they know that they will spend a lot of money if they get sick. Others think Chinese people want to buy houses. IMF economist Malhar Barr puts it differently. He said Chinese people have a savings target in mind so that they can afford to buy a house and appliances, afford medical treatment and other things. They will do whatever it takes to achieve this goal. So when banks pay less interest after adjusting for inflation, they save more. And when banks give more interest, they will save less because they can easily reach their goals even if they save less. Since 1996, the interest rate level of the Bank of China has been getting worse and worse, which means that the gap between interest rates and the inflation rate is getting wider and wider. Therefore, Chinese people are saving more and more money. Therefore, the worse a bank treats its customers, the more customers save more and more money. "Continued increases in bank savings rates and a wider range of other investment options will help households reach their desired savings goals," Nabar wrote. In other words, if banks treat customers better, they will save less.

6c3bef29d32345638daefe6d60977a3aad84379c.sourceText: 美国国务院近日对美国公民发出旅行警告，要求避免前往墨西哥14个州(墨西哥共有31个州)全部或部分地区。 这是墨西哥2006年发动打击毒品犯罪行动以来，美国发布范围最广的墨西哥旅行禁令。 美国国务院建议公民除非有必要目的，应避免前往奇瓦瓦、科维拉、塔毛利帕斯等毗邻美国的州以及墨中部的杜兰戈等州。 美国国务院同时建议美国公民谨慎前往其它3个近邻美国的州，及中部与西部几个贩毒集团频繁发生交火的州。 其中，临近本州的诺加拉斯和亚省人喜爱的旅游热点，俗称岩石点的海滩地区尤为危险。 上星期美国国务院曾称，美国公民已经成为包括谋杀、绑架与拦路抢劫等墨西哥贩毒暴力的受害者。 警告称，美国公民前往墨西哥尽量采用主要道路，​​太阳下山后尽量留在旅馆。 如果人们仍希望前往海滩地区，请绕道Lukeville前往。
6c3bef29d32345638daefe6d60977a3aad84379c.translatedText: The U.S. State Department recently issued a travel warning to U.S. citizens, requiring them to avoid traveling to all or parts of 14 Mexican states (out of a total of 31 states in Mexico). This is the most extensive travel ban to Mexico issued by the United States since Mexico launched a crackdown on drug crimes in 2006. The U.S. State Department advises citizens to avoid traveling to states bordering the United States, such as Chihuahua, Cohulla, and Tamaulipas, as well as states such as Durango in central Mexico, unless for essential purposes. The U.S. State Department also advises U.S. citizens to be cautious when traveling to three other states that are close to the United States, as well as states in the central and western parts of the country where frequent crossfires between drug cartels occur. Among them, the beach area of ​​Nogalas, which is close to the state and a popular tourist hotspot for Albertans, commonly known as Rock Point, is particularly dangerous. The U.S. State Department said last week that U.S. citizens have become victims of drug-trafficking violence in Mexico, including murder, kidnapping and robberies. The warning advises U.S. citizens traveling to Mexico to use major roads and stay in hotels after the sun goes down. If people still want to go to the beach area, take a detour to Lukeville.

830b20d96cb00da85cc27b1c92a49dc9c702fde5.sourceText: 侨务委员会提醒侨胞务必依现行健保规定办理停复保 侨务委员会迩来接获侨胞反应，渠等预定出国6个月以上，出国前办理健保停保，入境后未办理复保，后又出国未办理停保，爰接获健保局追缴入境后健保费等 案例。 依据行政院卫生署中央健康保险局网站上公布之现行健保停复保规定，在国内设有户籍之民众，每次出国预定6个月以上，可选择「继续加保」或「办理停保」 。 选择「继续加保」之民众，不须申请（如未办理停保即属于继续加保），出国期间持续缴纳保险费，继续享有健保医疗权益。 选择「办理停保」民众，出国前向投保单位申请，出国期间暂停缴纳保险费，并同时暂停医疗给付权益。 返国不论停留期间长短，应自返国日起复保、缴纳保险费及恢复健保医疗给付。 并请注意以下事项： 1. 在国外期间不能办理复保，须等到返国才能办理复保。 办理复保请填妥『复保申请表』，检附户籍誊本及入出境证明或护照全份影本，向投保单位办理复保。 未办理复保，仍然要追缴返国日起之保险费。 2. 每次返国如出国期间未满6个月，即不符合停保规定，将注销停保并追缴停保期间保险费，同时恢复停保期间之健保医疗给付权益。 3. 返国后如有再次预定出国6个月之情形，必须重新选择是否停保；如果选择停保，应重新提出申请。 4. 停保、复保申请表可至健保局全球资讯网（http://www.nhi.gov.tw）下载列印。 5. 每次出国期间超过2年，经户政机关将其户籍迁出国外者，自户籍迁出日起即不具有加保资格。 民众返国时，应先向户政机关办妥恢复户籍登记，再次取得加保资格后，才能重新办理加保。 侨务委员会特别提醒在国内设有户籍之侨胞，依现行健保规定，如出国后又返国不论停留期间长短，应自返国日起复保、缴纳保险费及恢复健保医疗给付。 另外，二代健保预定于102年1月1日实施，届时需依二代健保相关规定办理。
830b20d96cb00da85cc27b1c92a49dc9c702fde5.translatedText: The Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission reminds overseas Chinese to be sure to stop and reinstate insurance in accordance with the current health insurance regulations. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee has recently received reports from overseas Chinese that they planned to go abroad for more than 6 months, stopped their health insurance before leaving the country, failed to reinstate their insurance after entering the country, and then failed to stop their insurance after leaving the country. They also received cases where the National Health Insurance Bureau demanded payment of post-entry health insurance premiums. According to the current health insurance suspension and reinstatement regulations published on the website of the Central Health Insurance Bureau of the Department of Health of the Executive Yuan, people with household registration in China who plan to go abroad for more than 6 months each time can choose to "continue to add insurance" or "to cancel the insurance." People who choose to "continue to add insurance" do not need to apply (if they have not stopped the insurance, they will continue to add insurance). They will continue to pay the insurance premiums while going abroad and continue to enjoy health insurance and medical rights. People who choose to "apply for suspension of insurance" should apply to the insurance company before going abroad. Insurance premiums will be suspended during their stay abroad, and medical benefit rights will be suspended at the same time. Regardless of the length of stay after returning to the country, insurance coverage, insurance premiums and health insurance medical benefits should be restored from the date of return. And please pay attention to the following matters: 1. Reinsurance cannot be applied for while abroad. You must wait until you return to the country to apply for reinsurance. To apply for reinsurance, please fill out the "Reinsurance Application Form", attach a copy of your household registration and entry and exit certificate or a full copy of your passport, and apply for reinsurance to the insured unit. If reinsurance is not carried out, the insurance premium from the date of return to the country will still be required. 2. If the stay abroad is less than 6 months each time you return to the country, the insurance suspension regulations will not be met. The insurance suspension will be canceled and the insurance premium during the suspension period will be recovered. At the same time, the health insurance medical benefit rights during the suspension period will be restored. 3. If you plan to go abroad for 6 months again after returning to the country, you must choose whether to stop the insurance again; if you choose to stop the insurance, you should apply again. 4. The application form for insurance suspension and reinstatement can be downloaded and printed from the National Health Insurance Bureau’s global information website (http://www.nhi.gov.tw). 5. Those who go abroad for more than 2 years each time and have their household registration moved abroad through the household registration authority will no longer be eligible for insurance coverage from the date of transfer of household registration. When people return to their country, they should first complete the restoration of household registration registration with the household registration authority, and only then can they apply for the insurance again after they have obtained the qualifications for adding insurance again. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission specially reminds overseas Chinese with household registration in China that according to the current health insurance regulations, if they return to the country after going abroad, regardless of the length of stay, they should reinstate insurance, pay insurance premiums, and resume health insurance medical benefits from the date of return. In addition, the second-generation health insurance is scheduled to be implemented on January 1, 2020. At that time, the relevant regulations of the second-generation health insurance will need to be handled.

b2ddfd1816a0edc6c62558aaa45de0468b7f5e29.sourceText: >的疑惑 （亚省时报） 旧社会，中国某地有位周姓老地主，家中雇了一干长工。为了让长工们早起床，多干活，周老地主每天天不亮就钻到鸡窝里学鸡叫，引诱公鸡提前打鸣。公鸡睡得正香，无心鸣叫，周老地主契而不舍，憋着嗓子闷叫不止。那些鸡们不堪骚扰，不得已跟着吼几嗓子，把老地主对付走了之后，鸡们还可以睡个回笼觉。周老地主这时就去把长工们从炕上轰起来：”鸡都叫了，天都亮了，下地干活去。你们这些懒骨头。”当然，长工们去干活之后，周老地主也同那些鸡们一样，睡回笼觉去了。这是动画电影 >里的一段故事。这个老地主就是有名的”周扒皮”。 我从大陆买来这部动画片给孩子们看。本意是让生在星条旗下，吃牛肉饼长大的不革命后代们认识中国旧社会的黑暗。不想当我再一次看完这部儿时看过无数遍的老电影后，竟是满脑子的问题和疑惑。 第一，这个”旧社会”是从哪一年开始？有人说是1911年？不对。这是推翻帝制那一年，这应当是新社会的第一年。有人猜是1921年？更不对了，谁要说旧社会开始于1921年就该坐大牢。这一年是中国共产党的诞生年。那是1840年？或公元前221年，即始皇元年？越扯越远。您说，这”旧社会”从哪年开始？ 第二，这个”旧社会”的终点是哪一年？有人说当然是1949年。那一年，三座大山被推翻了，长工们一夜之间都是主人了。具体是在哪一夜变成了主人，这取决于解放军哪一天进村。不过后来又有了”新三座大山”，有人总在山顶，有人总在山坳，这就是不平等。也有人说长工们从来就没翻过身，长工的儿孙们现在是农民工。我的问题是，究竟该听谁的？旧社会有没有个终点？这个终点是1949年吗？ 看来，用史学的观点定义”旧社会”有一定难度。 第三，我咨询了中美两国的法律专家：周扒皮半夜学鸡叫，骗长工们提前上班犯的是什么罪？美国专家说这可以定为”间接欺骗罪”。周扒皮是先骗鸡，然后，利用受骗鸡们的非自觉行为欺骗长工。但从法律上讲，还没有给人欺骗动物定罪的案例。所以，这个案子很棘手。但是，周先生没有伤害鸡，不构成虐待动物罪。如果周先生愿意出钱，这位律师可以为周先生争取到无罪。中国律师更绝：”这个周扒皮1950就给镇压了。他罪大恶极，不杀不足以平民愤。在枪毙他的诸多罪状中，没有学鸡叫这一条。”如此说来，半夜学鸡叫不犯法？只是个人操守和诚实问题？ 第四，周老地主有什么别的罪状我不知道。但从他”间接欺骗”的行为来看，他没有用罚款和武力手段逼迫长工们加班加点。他的手段有点上不了台面，有点羞羞答答。比起现儿今大陆一些公司目无法纪，公开要求职工无偿加班加点的放肆行为，周地主也该算半个善人了。我想国内”富士通”之类的公司应该向周老地主学习。可以骗职工，但不可以逼职工加班加点。我的问题是如何让加班合法化？这是保持经济长期两位数发展的大问题。如果2012年版的新劳工法将每周法定工作时间上调至45小时，看上去，每天仅仅多干一小时，但能增加12.5%的工作量。这个提案一定使95%的老板们欣喜若狂？既然有绝大多数人的拥护，这个提案一定能通过。反正人大里都是老板们的代表，只有两位已被同化了的农民工代表，没有鸡的代表。 白驹过隙，时光冉荏。当年的那些坏人现在看来未必有罪；而现在那些在台上油头粉面，衣着光鲜的风云人物在将来的命运如何？这是我最后的问题。 刘希凡 2011年6月2日
b2ddfd1816a0edc6c62558aaa45de0468b7f5e29.translatedText: > Doubts (Alberta Times) In the old society, there was an old landowner named Zhou in a certain place in China, and his family hired a group of long-term workers. In order to get the long-term workers to get up early and work more, Mr. Zhou, the landowner, went to the chicken coop every day before dawn to imitate the crow of the rooster, luring the rooster to crow in advance. The rooster was sleeping soundly and crowing unintentionally. Landlord Zhou was reluctant to part with him and kept crowing in a muffled voice. The chickens couldn't bear the harassment, so they had no choice but to roar a few times. After the old landlord was dealt with, the chickens could go back to their cages to sleep. At this time, Landlord Zhou went to push the long-term workers from the kang: "The chickens have crowed and it is dawn, go to the fields to work. You lazy bones." Of course, after the long-term workers went to work, Old Landlord Zhou also went back to sleep in the cage like the chickens. This is a story from the animated movie >. This old landlord is the famous "Zhou Bapi". I bought this cartoon from China for my children to watch. The original intention was to let the non-revolutionary descendants who were born under the Stars and Stripes and grew up eating beef patties understand the darkness of China's old society. I didn't expect that when I watched this old movie that I had watched countless times as a child, my mind would be filled with questions and doubts. First, when did this “old society” begin? Some people say it was 1911? wrong. This was the year the monarchy was overthrown, and this should be the first year of the new society. Someone guessed it was 1921? What's more wrong, whoever said that the old society started in 1921 should be jailed. This year is the birth year of the Communist Party of China. That was 1840? Or 221 BC, the first year of the First Emperor? Further and further. When did you say this "old society" began? Second, when will the end of this "old society" be? Some say of course it was 1949. That year, three mountains were overthrown, and the long-term workers became the masters overnight. The specific night on which he became the master depends on which day the People's Liberation Army enters the village. But then there were "three new mountains". Some people are always at the top of the mountain, and some are always at the bottom of the mountain. This is inequality. Some people say that the long-term workers have never turned over, and that the children and grandchildren of the long-term workers are now migrant workers. My question is, who should I listen to? Is there an end to the old society? Is this end point 1949? It seems that it is difficult to define "old society" from a historical point of view. Third, I consulted legal experts from China and the United States: What crime did Zhou Papi commit by imitating the crow of a chicken in the middle of the night and deceiving the long-term workers to go to work early? American experts said this could be classified as "indirect deception." Zhou Papi first deceived the chickens, and then used the unconscious behavior of the deceived chickens to deceive the long-term workers. But legally, there have been no cases of people being convicted of cheating on animals. So, this case is very difficult. However, Mr. Zhou did not harm the chickens and did not commit the crime of animal cruelty. If Mr. Zhou is willing to pay, the lawyer can fight for Mr. Zhou's innocence. The Chinese lawyer went even further: "Zhou Papi was suppressed in 1950. His crimes were so heinous that the people would not be outraged if he were not killed. Among the many crimes for shooting him, there was no such thing as crowing like a chicken." So, is it not illegal to crow like a chicken in the middle of the night? Just a matter of personal integrity and honesty? Fourth, I don’t know what other crimes Mr. Zhou has committed. But judging from his "indirect deception" behavior, he did not use fines or force to force long-term workers to work overtime. His methods are a bit off-the-beaten-path and a bit shy. Compared with the lawless behavior of some companies in mainland China today, which publicly require employees to work overtime for free, Landlord Zhou should be considered a half-hearted person. I think domestic companies such as "Fujitsu" should learn from Landlord Zhou. You can deceive employees, but you cannot force them to work overtime. My question is how to legalize overtime? This is a big problem in maintaining long-term double-digit economic development. If the 2012 version of the new labor law increases the legal working hours per week to 45 hours, it seems that it will only be one more hour per day, but it will increase the workload by 12.5%. This proposal must make 95% of bosses ecstatic? Since there is support from the vast majority of people, this proposal will definitely pass. Anyway, the National People's Congress is filled with representatives of the bosses. There are only two representatives of migrant workers who have been assimilated, and there are no representatives of chickens. The white horse has passed by, and time flies by. Those bad guys back then may not seem guilty now; but what is the future fate of those now well-dressed and well-dressed people on stage? This is my final question. Liu Xifan June 2, 2011

afaa2e367c6baf6a47d73b61ed3ae6e9969ecf64.sourceText: （本报讯妞妞报导）11月19日晚7时在新东方艺术学校举行了周年庆聚会，用学生的绘画作品，舞蹈，展示了一年来学校的成果，其中的交谊舞展示和学习特受 欢迎，大约有七八十中美朋友一起度过了这个愉快的夜晚。 新东方艺术学校从初建校的40来个学生到现在已经发展到了100多。 目前学校已经有4为专职舞蹈老师，3位绘画老师。 课程的项目也从最早的舞蹈课，扩展到了包括少儿舞蹈班, 少儿绘画班, 少儿手工课, 成人舞蹈班, 成人舞蹈男生班, 成人交谊舞课, Zumba健身舞课, 合唱训练课, 太极健身, 扭秧歌班等十几个课程，以及中国书画文化讲座。 一年来，新东方艺术学校给华人社区众多的精彩表演，但是重头戏还是在今年春节。 ” 看春晚”是中国人过春节年夜饭中最重要的活动之一。 新东方艺术学校就承担起了凤凰城春晚的重任。 2012年凤凰城春晚将于1月21日（农历29日）在Chandler Center For The Arts隆重举行。 新东方艺术学校，ASU孔子学院，图桑华声合唱团，美西侨报等单位联合主办，送上容集汉族，藏族，羌族，傣族，彝族，等中国民族舞蹈参演，大合唱，独唱，童声 合唱，器乐相结合的一台璀璨的中国文化艺术盛宴。 感恩节，圣诞节马上就要到了，华人朋友要给身边的朋友送什么礼物呢？ 送上几张春晚礼券票，应该是个特别的选择，可以让中西朋友真正感受到华裔民族文化的魅力。 如今春晚门票已经开始热卖，在新东方艺术学校，欣欣，利利各大超市都有销售。 更多详情请联系：(602) 490-8613
afaa2e367c6baf6a47d73b61ed3ae6e9969ecf64.translatedText: (Niuniu report from our newspaper) An anniversary party was held at New Oriental Art School at 7 pm on November 19th. The students’ paintings and dances were used to showcase the school’s achievements over the past year. The ballroom dance display and learning were particularly popular. About 70 to 80 Chinese and American friends spent this pleasant night together. New Oriental Art School has grown from about 40 students when it was first established to more than 100 students now. Currently, the school has 4 full-time dance teachers and 3 painting teachers. The curriculum has also expanded from the earliest dance classes to more than a dozen courses including children's dance classes, children's painting classes, children's handicraft classes, adult dance classes, adult dance classes for boys, adult ballroom dance classes, Zumba fitness dance classes, chorus training classes, Tai Chi fitness classes, Yangko dance classes, and lectures on Chinese calligraphy and painting culture. Over the past year, New Oriental Art School has given many wonderful performances to the Chinese community, but the highlight is this year’s Spring Festival. "Watching the Spring Festival Gala" is one of the most important activities for Chinese people during the Spring Festival New Year's Eve dinner. New Oriental Art School has taken on the important task of hosting the Phoenix Spring Festival Gala. The 2012 Phoenix Spring Festival Gala will be held on January 21 (the 29th of the lunar calendar) at the Chandler Center For The Arts. Co-organized by New Oriental School of the Arts, ASU Confucius Institute, Tucson Huasheng Choir, American Overseas Chinese Newspaper and other units, it presents a dazzling Chinese culture and art feast that combines Han, Tibetan, Qiang, Dai, Yi and other Chinese ethnic dance performances, cantata, solo, children's chorus, and instrumental music. Thanksgiving and Christmas are coming soon. What gifts should Chinese friends give to their friends? Sending a few Spring Festival Gala gift vouchers should be a special choice, allowing Chinese and Western friends to truly feel the charm of Chinese ethnic culture. Tickets for the Spring Festival Gala are now on sale and are available at New Oriental Art School, Xinxin, and Lili supermarkets. For more details please contact: (602) 490-8613

04128694cada50c34a9e7ffa67a2d066ddafe782.translatedText: University rankings reflect the craze for studying abroad

12f3be284a38c83501beb059ceac507e422dd895.sourceText: 大学排行榜折射留学热 伦敦棗编制全球顶级大学排行榜的调查公司在9月11日发布报告称，选择前往国外留学的学生…
12f3be284a38c83501beb059ceac507e422dd895.translatedText: University rankings reflect the craze for studying abroad. London Zao, a research company that compiles rankings of the world's top universities, released a report on September 11 saying that students who choose to study abroad...

26718b3844136211ca4a41b8e8d14b2cf8e33adc.sourceText: 伦敦棗编制全球顶级大学排行榜的调查公司在9月11日发布报告称，选择前往国外留学的学生人数出现”势不可挡的增长势头”。
26718b3844136211ca4a41b8e8d14b2cf8e33adc.translatedText: London Zao, a research company that compiles rankings of the world's top universities, released a report on September 11 saying that the number of students choosing to study abroad has shown "unstoppable growth momentum."

14a868944b93b287fffe33bc51c0833928300867.sourceText: 位于伦敦的QS咨询研究公司(Quacquarelli Symonds)发布了年度QS全球大学排行榜，这家公司的学术顾问约翰?#22885;莱利(John O扡eary)写道，”全球出国留学人数出现势不可挡的增长势头，这些学生选择在国外的顶级大学接受教育。”
14a868944b93b287fffe33bc51c0833928300867.translatedText: London-based QS Consulting Research Company (Quacquarelli Symonds) released the annual QS Global University Rankings, the company's academic consultant John? #22885; O'Eary) wrote, "There is an unstoppable growth trend in the number of students studying abroad around the world, and these students choose to receive education at top universities abroad."

a7f76eb1459f93e1b526f0a91f8de356c17caf65.sourceText: 他指出，”最新公布的大学排行榜显示，即使近年来出国留学人数增长可观，全球排名前100位大学招收的国际学生人数依然增长了近10%。”
a7f76eb1459f93e1b526f0a91f8de356c17caf65.translatedText: He pointed out, "The latest university rankings show that even in recent years The number of students studying abroad has increased significantly, and the number of international students enrolled in the world's top 100 universities has still increased by nearly 10%. "

3315ce86c9c42087e98c67495c5ee188e477ee16.sourceText: 在今年的全球大学排行榜上，麻省理工学院（Massachusetts Institute of Technology，简称MIT）超过剑桥大学(Cambridge University)，在最有影响力的顶级大学榜单上荣登榜首，这份排行榜根据一系列因素进行衡量，包括学界和潜在雇主的评价。
3315ce86c9c42087e98c67495c5ee188e477ee16.translatedText: In this year's global university rankings, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (Massachusetts). The Institute of Technology (MIT) has overtaken Cambridge University to top the list of the most influential top universities, which is based on a range of factors, including reviews from academics and potential employers.

d566ac9085202ee69fe5953d41fb12965c2df837.sourceText: 美国和英国大学依然占据QS全球大学排行榜的主导地位，在这份自2004年开始统计的榜单上，全球前10名大学均为英美高校。
d566ac9085202ee69fe5953d41fb12965c2df837.translatedText: American and British universities still dominate the QS global university rankings. On this list, which has been compiled since 2004, the top 10 universities in the world are all British and American universities.

79988f46b15549b8862ea1dd8b700ef8d009aa02.sourceText: QS公司编制排行榜的方法考虑了外国学生和教师人数的因素，这在今年的榜单上有所反映。
79988f46b15549b8862ea1dd8b700ef8d009aa02.translatedText: QS's ranking method takes into account the number of foreign students and teachers, which is reflected in this year's list.

85e27ffb64aab56d32431b35954ace48e0195632.sourceText: 奥莱利表示，”比如说，剑桥大学的国际学生人数虽然一直在显著增长，但是该项指标的排名下降五位，导致剑桥大学从全球大学排行榜的榜首下滑到第二位。”
85e27ffb64aab56d32431b35954ace48e0195632.translatedText: O'Reilly said, "For example, although the number of international students at the University of Cambridge has been growing significantly, its ranking in this indicator dropped five places, causing the University of Cambridge to slip from the top of the global university rankings to second place."

5e013fd7b1aa0aa72e2b4860f686e7baeb628121.sourceText: 同样，美国加州大学伯克利分校(University of California at Berkeley)的排名也有所下降棗从2004年的第二位下降到第22位棗QS公司顾问马丁因斯(Martin Ince)表示，这不仅反映伯克利分校的师生比例相对较低，还表明这所学校”对国际教师和学生缺乏吸引力”。
5e013fd7b1aa0aa72e2b4860f686e7baeb628121.translatedText: Similarly, the University of California at Berkeley (University of California at Berkeley) Berkeley also fell in the rankings, from second place in 2004 to 22nd. Martin Ince, a consultant at QS, said this not only reflected Berkeley's relatively low teacher-student ratio, but also showed that the school was "unattractive to international teachers and students."

9b0862e0fab6a69245bcd54a61e1cb19213a787a.sourceText: QS公司指出，最成功的大学争先恐后地吸引全世界最优秀的学生和教师。这家公司表示，”对国际学生与国际教师的比例进行简单评估，可以作为指标来衡量一所大学的多元化和国际吸引力。”
9b0862e0fab6a69245bcd54a61e1cb19213a787a.translatedText: QS pointed out that the most successful universities compete to attract the best students and teachers from around the world. The company said, "A simple assessment of the ratio of international students to international faculty can be used as an indicator to measure a university's diversity and international attractiveness."

68545d47dcd9e79b20c8ee3c7250c487c6345702.sourceText: 随着越来越多的学术排名陆续出现，帮助即将迈入校门的学生选择他们理想的大学，评论界表达了对这些排行榜客观性和科学性的关注。
68545d47dcd9e79b20c8ee3c7250c487c6345702.translatedText: As more and more academic rankings emerge to help incoming students choose their ideal university, critics have expressed concerns about the objectivity and scientific nature of these rankings.

91def36fbaf1a27ccfea9c5f3810c21b1184986e.sourceText: QS公司的研究主管本?#32034;特(Ben Sowter)去年承认，这些大学排行榜是”按照英语系国家的大学模式而设计的”。
91def36fbaf1a27ccfea9c5f3810c21b1184986e.translatedText: Ben Sowter, QS's head of research, admitted last year that these university rankings were "designed according to the model of universities in English-speaking countries".

48ee0f96a3a084ba6775b25d4b57fae8e7142da7.sourceText: 但是记者D稤?#21476;腾普兰(D.D. Guttenplan)在《国际先驱论坛报》(IHT)引述他的话说，目前有340万学生在本国以外的学校留学，QS公司致力于”帮助国际学生做出更合理的选择”。
48ee0f96a3a084ba6775b25d4b57fae8e7142da7.translatedText: But reporter D.D. Guttenplan quoted him in the International Herald Tribune (IHT) as saying that there are currently 3.4 million students studying abroad in schools outside their home countries, and QS is committed to "helping international students make more reasonable choices."

9b13e7154e776619f6821ee51381731f0ea20b54.sourceText: 就像与我一起在《国际先驱导报》”Rendezvous”博客撰稿的同事马克 麦克唐纳(Mark McDonald)今年撰文指出的那样，”许多中国家庭聘请留学中介，帮助他们办理大学申请流程，每位中介的收费最高可以达到1万美元，如果学生进入在排行榜上位居前列的大学，比如《美国新闻世界报道》(U.S. News & World Report)、QS公司和所谓的上海排行榜（指由上海交通大学发布的世界大学学术排名棗译注），中介还能获得同样数额不菲的奖金。”
9b13e7154e776619f6821ee51381731f0ea20b54.translatedText: As my colleague Mark McDonald, who writes for the International Herald Herald’s “Rendezvous” blog, pointed out in an article this year, “Many Chinese families hire study abroad agents to help them with the college application process. Each agent can charge up to $10,000 if the student enters a university that ranks high on the rankings, such as U.S. News & World "

6e27053cfa2587f9df1ded8fda698d9a92cc131b.sourceText: 显而易见，出国留学对那些想接受全球优质教育的学生来说很有吸引力。对于这些大学本身及其所在的国家而言，这也是学费和外汇收入方面的经济刺激因素。
6e27053cfa2587f9df1ded8fda698d9a92cc131b.translatedText: It’s obvious that studying abroad is attractive to students who want to receive a high-quality global education. It is also an economic stimulus in terms of tuition fees and foreign exchange earnings for the universities themselves and the countries in which they are located.

bf167b3905759ed540f3247f5ed13be0d26e4b13.sourceText: 然而，出国留学取决于各国政府是否愿意接受外国学生。QS公司研究主管本?#32034;特向英国广播公司(BBC)指出，英国更严格的签证规定将让部分国际学生放弃申请英国大学。
bf167b3905759ed540f3247f5ed13be0d26e4b13.translatedText: However, studying abroad depends on the willingness of governments to accept foreign students. Ben?#32034;, director of research at QS, pointed out to the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC) that the UK's stricter visa regulations will prevent some international students from applying to British universities.

18bfc8cce6edb0f7314d6e10651052efe9087791.sourceText: 《水立方杯》中文歌曲大赛落下帷幕 本州选手将赴北京参赛(图) 据”水立方杯”全美中文学校协会美国总赛区消息：全美中文学校协会总赛区决赛于6月13日及6月15日在波士顿举行。 2011年”水立方杯”海外华裔青少年中文歌曲大赛全美中文学校协会美国总赛区评委由有关方面专家组成。他们是：段晓毅（著名男高音歌唱家。毕业于四川音乐学院，中央音乐学院，路易斯安那大学音乐学院，波士顿音乐学院。曾担任过四川歌舞剧院独唱演员。在美在不同歌剧中担任主角，曾在美多个城市举办个人演唱会。）；李玉新（著名男高音歌唱家。毕业于中央音乐学院。出国前为中央乐团男高音歌唱演员。来美后，在波士顿新英格兰音乐学院深造，李玉新参加过多项重大国际声乐比赛并获奖，如：麦卡列斯特国际声乐大赛，帕瓦罗蒂国际声乐大奖等。）；张兴彦（著名男低音歌唱家。毕业于中央民族大学音乐系，波士顿大学艺术学院歌剧系。曾为中央民族乐团独唱演员，中央民族大学音乐系声乐教授，沈阳音乐学院国际教育中心教授。）；魏晶（著名女高音歌唱家。毕业于西安音乐学院，中央音乐学院，美丹杰罗音乐学院，波士顿大学艺术学院歌剧系。从事声乐教学多年，在欧美地区演出，在不同歌剧中担任主角。在林肯中心举办过获奖音乐会。）；乔万钧（毕业于中央音乐学院,美国伯克利音乐学院.为现任北美中国表演艺术协会会长；北美合唱协会会长；曾担任中央电视台青歌赛北美赛区评委；首届波士顿地区国际合唱节艺术总监）。 在评比过程中，专家们认真地观看了各地赛区胜出选手的录像带。专家们按音准,节奏,演唱技巧,中文吐字,舞台演绎五个方面对选手们进行了评判。选票以无记名方式进行。最后以平均分数排列名次。 结果选出了王雯倩、严婕娅、朱芷晴、雷西雅、何佳璐、熊蔷羽六名选手将参加7月24日至8月8日在北京的《2011年”水立方杯”海外华裔青少年中文歌曲大赛》。本州的选手严婕娅作为高分之一入选，她目前还不满15岁，是这次总赛区入选到北京比赛的年龄最小的选手。 本州另两位选手高薇佳和蔡雅双以非常接近的比分作为后备选手，她们的演唱光盘已送北京，正等待进一步的通知。 至此，《2011年”水立方杯”海外华裔青少年中文歌曲大赛》全美中文学校协会美国总赛区落下了比赛的帷幕。《2011年”水立方杯”海外华裔青少年中文歌曲大赛》全美中文学校协会组委会希望通过这次活动能进一步推动海外青少年传唱中文歌曲，进一步学好中文。 照片：入选到北京比赛的凤凰城少年歌手严婕娅
18bfc8cce6edb0f7314d6e10651052efe9087791.translatedText: "Water Cube Cup" Chinese song contest has come to an end. Contestants from this state will go to Beijing to compete (picture) According to the "Water Cube Cup" National Chinese Schools Association U.S. General Division news: the National Chinese Schools Association General Division finals will be held in Boston on June 13th and June 15th. The judges for the 2011 "Water Cube Cup" Overseas Chinese Youth Chinese Song Contest of the National Association of Chinese Schools in the United States are composed of experts in relevant fields. They are: Duan Xiaoyi (a famous tenor singer. Graduated from the Sichuan Conservatory of Music, the Central Conservatory of Music, the University of Louisiana Conservatory of Music, and the Boston Conservatory of Music. He once served as a soloist in the Sichuan Song and Dance Theater. He has played leading roles in different operas in the United States and has held solo concerts in many cities in the United States.); Li Yuxin (a famous tenor singer. Graduated from the Central Conservatory of Music. Conservatory of Music. Before going abroad, he was a tenor singer with the Central Orchestra. After coming to the United States, he studied at the New England Conservatory of Music in Boston. Li Yuxin participated in many major international vocal competitions and won awards, such as: Macalester International Vocal Competition, Pavarotti International Vocal Award, etc.); Zhang Xingyan (famous bass singer. Graduated from the Music Department of Minzu University of China, Boston. Department of Opera, University College of Arts. Former soloist of the China National Traditional Orchestra, professor of vocal music in the Music Department of Minzu University of China, and professor of the International Education Center of Shenyang Conservatory of Music); Wei Jing (famous soprano singer. Graduated from Xi'an Conservatory of Music, Central Conservatory of Music, Medangelo Conservatory of Music, and Opera Department of Boston University School of the Arts. She has been engaged in vocal music teaching for many years in Europe and the United States. Regional performances, starring in different operas. He has held award-winning concerts at Lincoln Center.); Qiao Wanjun (graduated from the Central Conservatory of Music, Berklee College of Music in the United States. He is currently the president of the North American Chinese Performing Arts Association; the president of the North American Chorus Association; he served as a judge for the North American Division of the CCTV Youth Singing Competition; and the artistic director of the first Boston International Chorus Festival). During the evaluation process, the experts carefully watched the video tapes of the winning players from various regions. The experts judged the contestants in five aspects: pitch, rhythm, singing skills, Chinese pronunciation, and stage performance. Balloting is conducted by secret ballot. Finally, the rankings are ranked based on the average score. As a result, six contestants, Wang Wenqian, Yan Jieya, Zhu Zhiqing, Lei Xiya, He Jialu, and Xiong Qianyu, were selected to participate in the "2011 "Water Cube Cup" Overseas Chinese Youth Chinese Song Contest" in Beijing from July 24 to August 8. Yan Jieya, a player from this state, was selected as one of the top scorers. She is currently under 15 years old and is the youngest player selected from the general competition area to compete in Beijing. The other two contestants from the state, Gao Weijia and Cai Yashuang, are reserve contestants with very close scores. Their singing CDs have been sent to Beijing and are awaiting further notification. At this point, the "2011 "Water Cube Cup" Overseas Chinese Youth Chinese Song Contest" National Association of Chinese Schools U.S. Division has come to an end. The organizing committee of the National Association of Chinese Schools of the "2011 "Water Cube Cup" Overseas Chinese Youth Chinese Song Contest" hopes that through this event, it can further promote overseas youths to sing Chinese songs and further learn Chinese. Photo: Yan Jieya, a young Phoenix singer who was selected to compete in Beijing

5d354579d72d0fbd4ef8fb6f4c1dcbfcb7f05233.sourceText: 从2011年4月22日零点到2011年4月25日零点，亚利桑那州立大学中国学生学者联谊会主席竞选落下帷幕。本次选举总票数共计388张，其中有效选票331张，黄麟雯同学获得其中174张选票，以52.57％的支持率当选2011年-2012年度亚利桑那州立大学中国学生学者联谊会主席。 黄麟雯两年前开始在亚利桑那州立大学为中国学生学者联谊会服务，担任组织部长兼秘书长。她曾在2010年亚利桑那州立大学中国学生学者联谊会迎新晚会，中秋舞会，卡拉OK比赛中的组织和策划工作中有出色表现。她的竞选理念是：真诚服务开拓创新。在本次竞选活动中，她将完善学生会内部建设，加强对外交流，丰富课余活动等内容作为任内的主要任务。选举结果已经在公证人员监督下顺利完成，更多详情请关注亚利桑那州立大学中国学生学者联谊会网站《2011年ASU 中国学生学者联谊会主席竞选结果公告》。
5d354579d72d0fbd4ef8fb6f4c1dcbfcb7f05233.translatedText: From 0:00 on April 22, 2011 to 0:00 on April 25, 2011, the presidential election of the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of Arizona State University came to an end. There were a total of 388 votes in this election, of which 331 were valid votes. Huang Linwen received 174 of the votes and was elected as the 2011-2012 President of the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of Arizona State University with a support rate of 52.57%. Huang Linwen started serving the Chinese Students and Scholars Association at Arizona State University two years ago, serving as the organization director and secretary-general. She had outstanding performance in the organization and planning of the 2010 Arizona State University Chinese Students and Scholars Association Orientation Party, Mid-Autumn Dance, and Karaoke Competition. Her campaign philosophy is: sincere service, pioneering innovation. In this election campaign, she will improve the internal construction of the student union, strengthen external exchanges, and enrich extracurricular activities as her main tasks during her tenure. The election results have been successfully completed under the supervision of notaries. For more details, please pay attention to the "2011 ASU Chinese Students and Scholars Association Presidential Election Result Announcement" on the website of the Arizona State University Chinese Students and Scholars Association.

741c858e5aea08bca15e4447b5dd373ae4228c68.sourceText: 省级卫视的跨年晚会，历来是体现一台综合实力的平台。自从湖南卫视开办这一盛典，此前尚未有其他卫视染指跨年收视冠军。不过2012，随着湖南卫视的整体下滑，竞争对手们看到了机会，在”理性跨年”的口号下，仍有10余家省级卫视投身战局，华语乐坛数得上的老中青歌手，几乎都出现在各个跨年舞台。但最终，雷死人不偿命的芒果台再次轻松夺魁?#31361;然想到，似乎整个中国娱乐圈在2012都出现了反智的苗头，今年贺岁档的角逐，大赢家是《泰囧》，而阵容强大的几部电影，却折戟沉沙。
741c858e5aea08bca15e4447b5dd373ae4228c68.translatedText: Provincial TV’s New Year’s Eve party has always been a platform that reflects the comprehensive strength of a TV station. Since Hunan Satellite TV launched this grand ceremony, no other satellite TV has ever won the New Year's Eve ratings championship. However, in 2012, with the overall decline of Hunan Satellite TV, competitors saw opportunities. Under the slogan of "rational New Year's Eve", more than 10 provincial satellite TVs still joined the battle. Countless old, middle-aged and young singers in the Chinese music world appeared on almost every New Year's Eve stage. But in the end, the outrageous Mango Channel once again won the championship easily? #31361; However, it seems that the entire Chinese entertainment industry has shown signs of anti-intellectualism in 2012. In this year's Lunar New Year competition, the big winner is "Thailand", while several movies with strong lineups failed.

84b43f1810b277374d18896b0c348f898032b772.sourceText: 凤凰城一月房屋销售达到新高 公寓屋涨幅最大 （亚省时报） 加州新闻报道凤凰城一月房屋销售上升，达到了近五年一月销售的最高值。一共销售7123套房屋。与上个月相比下降了17.9%，但比去年同期高了3.2%。一月房屋的销售比1994年来平均销售量少了3.1%。这主要是因为新房子销售的数量仍然低迷。旧屋销售比平均销售量高了17.5%，是2006年1月以来的最高一次。新屋销售还是比平均年份的销售量低了66%。 与去年相比，十万以下的房屋销售下降了7.3%，十万到二十万房子销售量上升了3.3%， 二十万到六十万的房子上升了9%， 八十万以上的房子销售也增加了3.6%。凤凰城房屋销售的中值为127500美元，比上个月下降了1.2%，但是比去年同期上涨了7.1%。一月份独立屋均价为125900美元，比前一个月上涨0.7% 比去年上涨了5%。 公寓屋比去年上涨了9%。更多有关房地产新闻请咨询金信地产Tinna 电话（480）287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
84b43f1810b277374d18896b0c348f898032b772.translatedText: Home sales in Phoenix hit new highs in January, with condos seeing the biggest jump (Alberta Times) California news reported that home sales in Phoenix rose in January, reaching the highest January sales in the past five years. A total of 7,123 homes were sold. That's down 17.9% from the previous month, but 3.2% higher than the same period last year. Home sales in January were 3.1% below the average since 1994. This is largely because the number of new home sales remains sluggish. Existing home sales were 17.5% above average, the highest since January 2006. New home sales are still 66% below average sales. Compared with last year, the sales of houses with less than 100,000 yuan fell by 7.3%, the sales of houses with 100,000 to 200,000 yuan increased by 3.3%, the sales of houses with 200,000 to 600,000 yuan increased by 9%, and the sales of houses with more than 800,000 yuan also increased by 3.6%. The median home sale price in Phoenix is ​​$127,500, down 1.2% from last month but up 7.1% from this time last year. The average price of a single-family home in January was $125,900, up 0.7% from the previous month and 5% from last year. Apartment prices are up 9% from last year. 50715019378d1e92f23d742b49e531def26e3c1b.sourceText: 这起致命车祸发生在上周五（22日）美国时间约下午2时21分（新加坡时间23日清晨5时21分），地点是在亚利桑那州的国道64号北向公路。
50715019378d1e92f23d742b49e531def26e3c1b.translatedText: The fatal car accident occurred last Friday (22nd) at approximately 2:21 pm US time (5:21 am Singapore time on the 23rd) on the northbound National Highway 64 in Arizona.

0c756095881db62e6aef1303712f961a5f543239.sourceText: 车祸发生时，一辆在国道64号北向行驶的银色现代（Hyundai）汽车不知何故驶过分界线，与一辆迎面而来的绿色货车相撞。
0c756095881db62e6aef1303712f961a5f543239.translatedText: When the car accident occurred, a silver Hyundai car traveling northbound on National Highway 64 passed the dividing line for some reason and collided with an oncoming green truck.

ee6073f2d4b143d23f55033d0352d0a1d4998442.sourceText: 汽车与货车相撞后，接着又再撞上另一辆车，整辆轿车前半边被撞得毁坏不堪，足见冲击力之大。
ee6073f2d4b143d23f55033d0352d0a1d4998442.translatedText: After the car collided with the truck, it then hit another car. The entire front half of the car was badly damaged, which shows the huge impact.

f9ac4c49ced7ce3855eea5a6ecbb07408eacc772.sourceText: 汽车内的驾驶者与两名乘客当场丧命，另一名乘客则被送往当地佛拉克史拓福医疗中心（Flagstaff Medical Center）。
f9ac4c49ced7ce3855eea5a6ecbb07408eacc772.translatedText: The driver and two passengers in the car died on the spot, and the other passenger was sent to the local Flagstaff Medical Center.

715b5900930abc93772fde0786fbd8bf21571962.sourceText: 货车在撞击后偏离车道，司机当场丧命，另外四名乘客也同样被送往上述医疗中心。涉及车祸的第三辆车则没有任何伤亡。
715b5900930abc93772fde0786fbd8bf21571962.translatedText: The truck veered off the lane after the collision. The driver died on the spot, and the other four passengers were also sent to the above-mentioned medical center. The third vehicle involved in the crash did not suffer any injuries.

f3ba706f1ed16eae946331d223c4ffde09a9ea25.sourceText: 美国亚利桑那州公共安全部门受询时表示，在通知所有车祸死者的直属家属车祸消息前，不会公开死者身份。
f3ba706f1ed16eae946331d223c4ffde09a9ea25.translatedText: When asked, the Arizona Department of Public Safety stated that the identity of the deceased will not be disclosed until all immediate family members of the deceased are notified of the accident.

1f88efe2bcae644421b8aa5ed572f5148a50df40.sourceText: 但据了解，事发时杨俊玺开车，他的父母和妹妹此次是趁着圣诞假期，远赴美国探望他，以及一名定居美国的亲戚。
1f88efe2bcae644421b8aa5ed572f5148a50df40.translatedText: However, it is understood that Yang Junxi was driving when the incident occurred. His parents and sister were taking advantage of the Christmas holiday to go to the United States to visit him and a relative who had settled in the United States.

aad1d924152ce512231328e7944b3828d203d719.sourceText: 不料天意难测，夫妇俩和儿子竟就此命丧黄泉，唯一生还的女儿则需留院治疗。（人名译音）
aad1d924152ce512231328e7944b3828d203d719.translatedText: Unexpectedly, the couple and their son died unexpectedly, and the only surviving daughter needed to be hospitalized for treatment. (Transliteration of person’s name)

d3a92d1961cb63881213ddfd8f329ad47846cfcd.sourceText: 杨静慧已接受脊椎手术，刚转出加护病房，目前伤势稳定。
d3a92d1961cb63881213ddfd8f329ad47846cfcd.translatedText: Yang Jinghui has undergone spinal surgery and has just been transferred out of the intensive care unit. Her injuries are currently stable.

dfb8da83c6e191ce374ad5538ef8682248b7ad66.sourceText: 事发后，杨静慧伤得不轻，需接受脊椎手术，但目前已刚转出加护病房，伤势稳定。
dfb8da83c6e191ce374ad5538ef8682248b7ad66.translatedText: After the incident, Yang Jinghui was seriously injured and needed spinal surgery. However, she has just been transferred out of the intensive care unit and her injuries are stable.

f045e976b8c6f24a42420cc239435e02d262fe49.sourceText: 据《联合晚报》探悉，一家人每个星期天都会到淡滨尼的教会”活盼堂”（Living Hope Methodist Church）做礼拜。
f045e976b8c6f24a42420cc239435e02d262fe49.translatedText: According to "Lianhe Wanbao", the family attends services at the Living Hope Methodist Church in Tampines every Sunday.

0c299189cc484e6545765874ae6ca1d0655dde78.sourceText: 教会牧师陈明清（50多岁）今早受访时透露，这家人平时相当文静、不多说话，上周日（17日）并未到教堂聚会，相信已启程出发到美国。
0c299189cc484e6545765874ae6ca1d0655dde78.translatedText: Church pastor Chen Mingqing (in his 50s) revealed in an interview this morning that the family is usually quite quiet and does not talk much. They did not attend church gatherings last Sunday (17th) and are believed to have left for the United States.

a962bd3d9bd292999d68e356f10d10486bc91f88.sourceText: ”教会正密切关注他们的情况，希望能帮忙处理他们的身后事。”
a962bd3d9bd292999d68e356f10d10486bc91f88.translatedText: "The church is paying close attention to their situation and hopes to help deal with their aftermath."

6cc303ce956dd6378127cd2537a53b7f27d490df.sourceText: 出门旅行的朋友一定谨慎选择自驾游，因为交通法规和路宽不熟悉，常常发生交通事故。大峡谷深受旅行者喜爱但是这个路段上的交通事故市场发生，最好还是请当地导游导航或者驾车前往。
6cc303ce956dd6378127cd2537a53b7f27d490df.translatedText: Friends who travel must be careful when choosing self-driving tours, because traffic regulations and road widths are unfamiliar, and traffic accidents often occur. The Grand Canyon is very popular among travelers, but traffic accidents occur on this section of the road, so it is best to ask a local tour guide to navigate or drive there.

1760997410a352a937420000c87aca1fd3331069.sourceText: 凤凰城市长格雷格斯坦頓就职 华裔侨领中领馆代表祝贺（组图） 亚利桑那华裔侨领 政界有人到现场祝贺 （本报讯 谢成彦）1月3日凤凰城市市长格雷格斯坦頓（Greg Stanton）以及市议会成员在欧峰礼堂（Orpheum Theatre）举行就职典礼。支持新市长的人非常多，整个礼堂全部爆满，消防部门不得不控制进入，部分人员只能无奈的在市政大厅外看电视直播。华裔侨领余文劲 邓朝驹 张华芳 华裔前议员黄仕钧 侨务顾问李玲麟到现场祝贺。中国驻洛杉矶总领馆领事赵尚森，代表邱绍芳洛杉矶总领事面交贺词，祝贺格雷格斯坦頓就职。 中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆领事赵尚森 代表邱绍芳总领事面交贺词 市长格雷格斯坦以及4位议员在礼堂宣誓并发表讲话。市长格雷格斯坦随后宣布了一个重要的创造就业的合作项目。北凤凰城Mayo医疗中心进行教育学院的扩大，与坦坯（Tempe），美莎（Mesa），弗拉格斯塔夫（Flagstaff）等城市举办市长论坛。Mayo在其他地区创造5万个高质量的职位，现在这个合作也将让凤凰城市民受惠，为凤凰城的教育事业做出更多实事。市长在就职演讲中还指出，凤凰城将会和周边的城市联合成一个团队，共同合作为恢复经济而努力。 凤凰城台北姐妹市主席李玲麟与邱文琪恭贺市长Greg Stanton就职 在就职典礼上，几个议员都用不同的语言来表达了自己的感谢或者心愿，凤凰城是一个多元化的城市，市长需要平衡各个族裔的利益，来获得选民的信任。2011年10月26日晚5时30分到晚7时30分，格雷格斯坦頓作为凤凰城市长候选人到六福酒家进行了针对亚裔选民的辩论会。解答了很多亚裔来宾的问题。当时来自中国，日本，菲利宾，越南等十几个国家的亚太裔凤凰城市民，近300人参加了活动。格雷格斯坦頓精彩的演讲受到了亚裔的广泛认同，最终获选！ 2011年10月26日Greg Stanton 参加在六福酒家举办的亚裔助选辩论会
1760997410a352a937420000c87aca1fd3331069.translatedText: Phoenix Mayor Greg Stanton was inaugurated. Representatives of the Chinese Consulate in Arizona congratulated him (photo) Arizona Chinese Consulates. Some people from the political circles came to congratulate (Xie Chengyan from this newspaper). On January 3, Phoenix Mayor Greg Stanton and members of the city council held an inauguration ceremony at the Orpheum Theater. There were so many people supporting the new mayor that the entire auditorium was full, and the fire department had to control entry. Some people had no choice but to watch the live TV broadcast outside the city hall. Overseas Chinese leaders Yu Wenjin, Deng Chaoju, Zhang Huafang, former Chinese congressman Huang Shijun, and overseas Chinese affairs consultant Li Linglin came to the scene to congratulate. Zhao Shangsen, Consul General of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, delivered a congratulatory message on behalf of Consul General Qiu Shaofang in Los Angeles to congratulate Greg Stanton on his inauguration. Zhao Shangsen, Consul of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, delivered a congratulatory message on behalf of Consul General Qiu Shaofang. Mayor Greg Stein and four congressmen took the oath and delivered speeches in the auditorium. Mayor Greg Stein then announced a major job-creating partnership. Mayo Medical Center in North Phoenix is ​​expanding its education college and hosting mayoral forums with cities such as Tempe, Mesa, and Flagstaff. Mayo has created 50,000 high-quality jobs in other areas. Now this cooperation will also benefit the citizens of Phoenix and make more practical contributions to the education industry in Phoenix. The mayor also pointed out in his inauguration speech that Phoenix will join forces with surrounding cities to form a team and work together to restore the economy. Phoenix Taipei Sister City Chairman Li Linglin and Qiu Wenqi congratulated Mayor Greg Stanton on his inauguration. At the inauguration ceremony, several council members expressed their gratitude or wishes in different languages. Phoenix is ​​a diverse city, and the mayor needs to balance the interests of various ethnic groups to gain the trust of voters. From 5:30 pm to 7:30 pm on October 26, 2011, Greg Stanton, a candidate for mayor of Phoenix City, went to Luk Fook Restaurant to hold a debate targeting Asian voters. Answered many questions from Asian guests. At that time, nearly 300 Asian and Pacific Phoenix citizens from more than a dozen countries including China, Japan, the Philippines, and Vietnam participated in the event. Greg Stanton’s wonderful speech was widely recognized by Asians and he was finally selected! On October 26, 2011, Greg Stanton participated in the Asian presidential election debate held at Luk Fook Restaurant.

f7be4394d84e1913794971cfe122db617c5bbd41.sourceText: 《太阳鸟纪事》–“造越位”的旅行日记三（精彩还在继续）
f7be4394d84e1913794971cfe122db617c5bbd41.translatedText: "Sunbird Chronicle" - The third travel diary of "Creating Offside" (the excitement continues)

02babb9b3f393b190b23248f6bf27d086b980e2b.sourceText: 《太阳鸟纪事》–“造越位”的旅行日记三（精彩还在继续） 在某个时间，某个空间，我们在这里，美国…
02babb9b3f393b190b23248f6bf27d086b980e2b.translatedText: "Sunbird Chronicle" - The third travel diary of "Creating Offside" (the excitement continues) At a certain time, in a certain space, we are here, the United States...

89dc0ced67ef2876455ca3f3a95c6104eb50d3b8.sourceText: Day7: 就是这座火山，在公元79年把古罗马第二大城市庞贝城一夜之间埋在了五点六米的火山灰下面。今天二十公里外的那不勒斯繁华更胜当年庞贝。维苏威火山其实一直潜伏着，蠢蠢欲动。希望我们几千几万年后不要看到这一幕: 老师对着小朋友说，这就是著名的那不勒斯古城遗址。。。
89dc0ced67ef2876455ca3f3a95c6104eb50d3b8.translatedText: Day7: It was this volcano that buried Pompeii, the second largest city in ancient Rome, under 5.6 meters of volcanic ash overnight in AD 79. Today, Naples, twenty kilometers away, is even more prosperous than Pompeii was back then. Mount Vesuvius has actually been lurking, ready to move. I hope we won’t see this scene tens of thousands of years from now: The teacher said to the children, this is the ruins of the famous ancient city of Naples. . .

10dfb7e11d7ac5098bb43715e3ea2e7998167dc3.sourceText: Day8: 今天就两个主题， 车和山。一天基本在开车。东西横贯亚平宁，南北走了半个意大利， 从西南部的苏来托来到了东北部的圣马力诺。意大利三面环海，多山地丘陵。苏来托的旅馆在山顶上，毗邻地中海。圣马力诺也是山城，面向里德里亚海。今天早上先从苏来托盘山下来。接着东西横穿亚平宁山脉走过很多山路和隧道，穿越最高的雪山时，最长一个隧道有10多公里长。晚上又翻山上了圣马力诺。圣马力诺很安静整洁。在山顶可以俯瞰亚平宁和亚德里亚海。
10dfb7e11d7ac5098bb43715e3ea2e7998167dc3.translatedText: Day8: Today there are two themes, cars and mountains. Basically driving all day. It ran across the Apennines from east to west, half of Italy from north to south, from Suleto in the southwest to San Marino in the northeast. Italy is surrounded by sea on three sides and is mountainous and hilly. The hotel in Sureto is on a hilltop, next to the Mediterranean Sea. San Marino is also a mountain town facing the Ridrian Sea. This morning, we first came down from Su Lai Tuan Mountain. Then we crossed the Apennine Mountains from east to west through many mountain roads and tunnels. When crossing the highest snow-capped mountains, the longest tunnel was more than 10 kilometers long. In the evening we headed over the mountains to San Marino. San Marino is quiet and clean. From the top of the mountain you can overlook the Apennines and the Adriatic Sea.

cafbd59cd07036563f1cb2a9605782ae5da10384.sourceText: Day9: 威尼斯到的太晚了。还在找东南西北。不过水城的感觉一下就有了。所有的交通工具都有了水上版，水上出租车，水上公交车，水上马车，应有尽有。这条微信就是在水上公汽上发出的。
cafbd59cd07036563f1cb2a9605782ae5da10384.translatedText: Day9: Arriving in Venice too late. Still looking for southeast, northwest. But the feeling of water city is there immediately. All means of transportation have water versions, water taxis, water buses, water carriages, everything you need. This WeChat message was sent on the water bus.

eb18618609f8bc284f029d59506f26aff9ecc22f.sourceText: Day10: 威尼斯商业气息太浓了，到处是店铺，餐馆和酒店。游人特别多，不过这也是旅游胜地在旅游旺季的常见景象。威尼斯景色很美，很特别。不过就像在大峡谷一样，各处的景致大同小异，看看就审美疲劳了。相比于水，我更爱山。现在有点怀念亚利桑那周围的山了。我是不是想家了?
eb18618609f8bc284f029d59506f26aff9ecc22f.translatedText: Day10: Venice has a strong commercial atmosphere, with shops, restaurants and hotels everywhere. There are a lot of tourists, but this is also a common sight in tourist resorts during the peak tourist season. The scenery in Venice is beautiful and special. But just like in the Grand Canyon, the scenery is similar everywhere, and it makes you tired of looking at it. I love mountains more than water. I miss the mountains around Arizona a little bit now. Am I homesick?

283282be0509ccf694dbfc294ff9dda498e33801.sourceText: 移民政策收紧带来危机感？美国公民申请数量上升
283282be0509ccf694dbfc294ff9dda498e33801.translatedText: Is tightening immigration policy bringing a sense of crisis? The number of U.S. citizenship applications rises

e6bf2acce362775b4c088564669e56207db6bf8e.sourceText: 移民政策收紧带来危机感？美国公民申请数量上升 【侨报网综合报道】归化成为公民的申请通常在总统选举前出现高峰…
e6bf2acce362775b4c088564669e56207db6bf8e.translatedText: Is the tightening of immigration policy bringing a sense of crisis? The number of applications for U.S. citizenship rises [Comprehensive report by Qiaobao.com] Applications for naturalization and citizenship usually peak before the presidential election...

e57b8f5d7bdc6f1e4804e22a4b0893108f427d20.sourceText: 【侨报网综合报道】归化成为公民的申请通常在总统选举前出现高峰，在选举后面临低谷。但今年申请成为美国公民的人数超过了2016年，这是20年以来第一次出现总统选举年后公民申请数量没有回落的情况.
e57b8f5d7bdc6f1e4804e22a4b0893108f427d20.translatedText: [Comprehensive report by Qiaobao.com] Applications for naturalization and citizenship usually peak before the presidential election and face a trough after the election. But the number of people applying to become U.S. citizens this year exceeded that in 2016. This is the first time in 20 years that the number of citizenship applications has not dropped after a presidential election year.

4384d4ef4f7652a8d500dd048371eb5a1db50509.sourceText: 据纽约时报报道，上周，3542名移民在洛杉矶宣誓成为了美国公民。特朗普上任后加强遣返非法移民并取消DACA计划让绿卡持有者都感到紧张。
4384d4ef4f7652a8d500dd048371eb5a1db50509.translatedText: According to the New York Times, 3,542 immigrants were sworn in to become U.S. citizens in Los Angeles last week. After Trump took office, he stepped up the deportation of illegal immigrants and canceled the DACA program, which made green card holders nervous.

c59e10d05e94cbdfc377bb9dfd837b139238e5f0.sourceText: 纳洛欧教育基金会（Naleo Educational Fund）的高级顾问罗莎琳德（Rosalind Gold）称：”在当前的政治和政策环境下，美国公民变得更加有威力。”
c59e10d05e94cbdfc377bb9dfd837b139238e5f0.translatedText: Rosalind Gold, senior advisor of the Naleo Educational Fund, said: "In the current political and policy environment, American citizens have become more powerful."

6f9eadea1a4bdde179bee719e391a0c07d21e16b.sourceText: 目前全美大约有880万人有资格归化为美国公民，他们至少持有美国绿卡5年。
6f9eadea1a4bdde179bee719e391a0c07d21e16b.translatedText: There are currently about 8.8 million people in the United States who are eligible to be naturalized as U.S. citizens, and they have held U.S. green cards for at least 5 years.

54836b75f04abdfb8ebb63f74167df73c52f345c.sourceText: 在2017财年前三个季度中，即从2016年10月1日至2017年6月30日，783330人提交了归化申请，而前一年同期有725925人提交申请。
54836b75f04abdfb8ebb63f74167df73c52f345c.translatedText: In the first three quarters of fiscal year 2017, from October 1, 2016 to June 30, 2017, 783,330 people submitted naturalization applications, compared with 725,925 people in the same period the previous year.

868325d507cf5534ef956414cc25fdaf771484e2.sourceText: 随着申请人数的上升，处理申请的时间也相应变长。在6月底有708638份正在处理的申请，而在2016财年结束时只有522565份处理中的申请。等待时间也由4个月增长到了8.6个月。在一些大城市，如达拉斯、休斯敦、拉斯维加斯和迈阿密，申请等待时间会在1年以上。
868325d507cf5534ef956414cc25fdaf771484e2.translatedText: As the number of applicants increases, the time for processing applications also becomes longer. There were 708,638 active applications at the end of June, compared with 522,565 active applications at the end of fiscal year 2016. The waiting time has also increased from 4 months to 8.6 months. In some large cities, such as Dallas, Houston, Las Vegas and Miami, the waiting time for applications can be more than a year.

606c8e4dad52f81d009fad0b4b614d0eb4d4cf11.sourceText: 并非所有的永久居民都希望成为美国公民。墨西哥和中美洲国家的归化率比东南亚和俄罗斯低。担心丧失部分福利、申请费和公民测验都阻碍了永久居民的归化意愿。
606c8e4dad52f81d009fad0b4b614d0eb4d4cf11.translatedText: Not all permanent residents wish to become U.S. citizens. Mexico and Central American countries have lower naturalization rates than Southeast Asia and Russia. Fear of losing some benefits, application fees, and citizenship tests all deter permanent residents from naturalizing.

c15b0570b4dd96f7b84935ed55dde49f8befdd6a.sourceText: 但随着现在政治环境的改变，永久居民的权利可能被影响，绿卡持有者也有可能被驱逐出境。美国公民可以保障移民在承认犯罪后不被遣返，他们也可以享受只有公民才享有的联邦福利和工作。
c15b0570b4dd96f7b84935ed55dde49f8befdd6a.translatedText: However, as the current political environment changes, the rights of permanent residents may be affected, and green card holders may also be deported. U.S. citizenship protects immigrants from deportation if they admit to a crime, and they can also enjoy federal benefits and jobs that only citizens enjoy.

eb1e5875a73c9bf8151ae8facbea174425aae9ac.sourceText: 在去年的选举前，有一部分非营利组织就鼓励移民提交归化申请。许多城市出现归化申请潮，一些成人教育项目也为移民提供归化申请的相关教育课程。
eb1e5875a73c9bf8151ae8facbea174425aae9ac.translatedText: Before last year’s election, some non-profit organizations encouraged immigrants to submit naturalization applications. Many cities have seen a surge in naturalization applications, and some adult education programs also provide immigrants with education courses related to naturalization applications.

fbbbfc76a5dda07edc4f9735c35c52c6a8ffe964.sourceText: 美国移民和入籍费去年起大涨
fbbbfc76a5dda07edc4f9735c35c52c6a8ffe964.translatedText: US immigration and naturalization fees have increased significantly since last year

d930786e36067baa0959d0452481996a52136ca4.sourceText: 从2016年12月23日起，美国公民与移民服务局(USCIS)将执行新的收费价格。很多申请费大幅飙升，最高一项涨258%。移民局特别提醒移民申请人，凡是在23日当天或之后寄到或以任何形式提交到移民局的案件，都按新的标准收费。
d930786e36067baa0959d0452481996a52136ca4.translatedText: Starting from December 23, 2016, the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) will implement new fees. Many application fees have soared, with the highest one rising by 258%. The Immigration Bureau specially reminds immigration applicants that any cases mailed or submitted to the Immigration Bureau in any form on or after the 23rd will be charged according to the new standards.

ea44bcad5bb1d3d133efd6f3c2979416db94c4d6.sourceText: 美国公民与移民服务局(USCIS)执行的新收费价格，与华人最为相关的是下面这几项：
ea44bcad5bb1d3d133efd6f3c2979416db94c4d6.translatedText: The new fee prices implemented by the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) are most relevant to the Chinese:

57aac3ab2556145bc21b1ee73fde18575d4d49e2.sourceText: 1、绿卡申请：从985美元升至1140美元，涨幅约为16%；
57aac3ab2556145bc21b1ee73fde18575d4d49e2.translatedText: 1. Green card application: from US$985 to US$1,140, an increase of approximately 16%;

b92c7adee7904a40ce3df0728ccad96b7a640b9c.sourceText: 2、更新绿卡申请：从365美元升至455美元，涨幅约为25%；
b92c7adee7904a40ce3df0728ccad96b7a640b9c.translatedText: 2. Updated green card application: from US$365 to US$455, an increase of approximately 25%;

fd3a03ff269492b58fd36d3e8981fe68e0b26449.sourceText: 含玻璃 立普妥学名药被召回 由于药物可能含有玻璃碎屑，遭到污染，Ranbaxy制药公司宣布召回几十批在美国出售的降胆固醇药物立普妥(Lipitor)的学名药阿托伐他汀钙药片(Atorvastatin Calcium)。 这家印度药厂的好几家工厂过去几年接连发生质量缺失，促使FDA对其作业加强监督，一度还禁止其产品进口。FDA也指称这家公司曾对它生产的20几种学名药提供不实的试验结果。 Ranbaxy在其美国网站发布通告，宣布它正召回10、20和40毫克剂量的阿托伐他汀钙药片。这是立普妥的学名药。召回行动涵盖41批货号，几乎全是每瓶90片的产品，不过有三批货号每瓶有500片。80毫克剂量的药片不受影响。 使用这种药物的患者，可以与药房连络，确定他们的药品是来自Ranbaxy或其它学名药厂，如果是Ranbaxy的产品，必须进一步确定是否属于召回的批次。 立普妥原为全世界最畅销的降胆固醇药物，一个月用量药费大约115元，在美国一年的销售额将近80亿元，可是它在美国的专利去年11月30日到期。 FDA在立普妥专利期满当天午夜前，才决定让Ranbaxy出售它在新泽西州中部的Ohm实验室工厂制造的立普妥学名药。这次召回的是这家工厂或别处工厂制造的产品还不清楚。
fd3a03ff269492b58fd36d3e8981fe68e0b26449.translatedText: Containing glass, Lipitor generic drug recalled. Ranbaxy Pharmaceuticals announced a recall of dozens of batches of Atorvastatin Calcium tablets of the cholesterol-lowering drug Lipitor sold in the United States because the drug may contain glass fragments and be contaminated. Several factories of this Indian pharmaceutical company have experienced quality defects in the past few years, prompting the FDA to strengthen supervision of its operations and once banned the import of its products. The FDA also alleged that the company had provided false test results for more than 20 generic drugs it produced. Ranbaxy posted a notice on its U.S. website announcing that it is recalling atorvastatin calcium tablets in 10, 20 and 40 mg doses. This is the generic name for Lipitor. The recall covers 41 batches of product numbers, almost all of which contain 90 tablets per bottle, but three batches of product numbers contain 500 tablets per bottle. 80 mg dose tablets are not affected. Patients who use this drug can contact the pharmacy to confirm whether their drug comes from Ranbaxy or another generic pharmaceutical manufacturer. If it is a Ranbaxy product, they must further determine whether it belongs to the recalled batch. Lipitor was originally the best-selling cholesterol-lowering drug in the world, costing about 115 yuan a month. Its annual sales in the United States were nearly 8 billion yuan. However, its patent in the United States expired on November 30 last year. The FDA decided just before midnight on the day Lipitor's patent expired to let Ranbaxy sell the generic version of Lipitor that it makes at its Ohm Laboratories plant in central New Jersey. It's unclear whether the recall involves products made at this factory or elsewhere.

bb545762ae57807893f712ff5de5452983e4a5c5.sourceText: 亚利桑那州参院1070号法案

7bf75938a826e3249ba859f107d70643a0a2dfe8.sourceText: 亚利桑那州历来是反移民的重镇，因为州内的美墨边境是最多非法移民入境的途径，每年都有千上万的墨西哥人和中美洲人从亚利桑那州偏远沙漠进入美国。在1990年到2010年间，亚利桑那州非法移民数量翻了五倍，到2010年4月，亚利桑那州内的非法移民据信有46万人。
7bf75938a826e3249ba859f107d70643a0a2dfe8.translatedText: Arizona has always been a stronghold of anti-immigration, because the U.S.-Mexico border in the state is the entry route for the largest number of illegal immigrants. Every year, tens of thousands of Mexicans and Central Americans enter the United States from the remote deserts of Arizona. Between 1990 and 2010, the number of illegal immigrants in Arizona increased fivefold, and by April 2010, there were believed to be 460,000 illegal immigrants in Arizona.

02b167d523eef4c91630c1265ab7a9de8753afeb.sourceText: 受非法移民情势的影响，亚利桑那州也成为反移民的重镇，不断有严格的反移民立法出台，首当其冲当属亚利桑那州参院的1070号法案（Arizona SB 1070），该法案全称为《支持我们的执法人员和安全邻居法案（Support Our Law Enforcement and Safe Neighborhoods Act）》，该法案于2010年4月23日由州长简 布鲁尔（Jan Brewer）签署，计划在2010年7月29日生效，被《纽约时报》称为?#32654;国有史以来最广泛和严格的反移民法案?#12290;
02b167d523eef4c91630c1265ab7a9de8753afeb.translatedText: Affected by the illegal immigration situation, Arizona has also become a stronghold of anti-immigration. Strict anti-immigration legislation has been introduced continuously. The first one to bear the brunt is the Arizona Senate Bill 1070 (Arizona SB 1070), which is called the Support Our Law Enforcement and Safe Neighborhoods Act. Act, which was passed by Governor Jan Brewer on April 23, 2010 Brewer) and plans to take effect on July 29, 2010. It is called by the New York Times as the most extensive and strict anti-immigration bill in the history of the country.

05136f8d2e035cf9e16d5fe364bababac6434173.sourceText: 美国联邦法律要求，14岁以上的外国人，如果在美国停留时间超过30天，应该向美国政府注册，并在停留期间保管好注册文件，违反这一规定将构成联邦轻罪。亚利桑那州1070号法案将这一规定发挥到极致，1070号法案规定：亚利桑那州的外国人必须随身携带登记文件，否则就构成州轻罪。同时，法案允许执法人员在两种情况下应当检查亚利桑那州居民的身分登记证件：一是当执法人员在”合法拦截、拘留和拘捕”时，如果要决定某个人的移民身分；二是当执法人员合理怀疑某个人是非法移民，而进行没有任何具体目的”合法接触”时。
05136f8d2e035cf9e16d5fe364bababac6434173.translatedText: U.S. federal law requires that foreigners over 14 years old who stay in the United States for more than 30 days should register with the U.S. government and keep registration documents during their stay. Violation of this provision will constitute a federal misdemeanor. Arizona Bill 1070 takes this provision to the extreme. Bill 1070 stipulates that aliens in Arizona must carry registration documents with them or it will be a state misdemeanor. At the same time, the bill allows law enforcement officers to check the identity registration documents of Arizona residents in two situations: first, when law enforcement officers are conducting a "lawful interception, detention, and arrest" to determine a person's immigration status; second, when law enforcement officers reasonably suspect that a person is an illegal immigrant and conduct "lawful contact" without any specific purpose.

ef286d2157071f67ef43c4d7b4ee3d7e60b595b1.sourceText: 同时，1070法案还禁止州政府官员、当地官员或机构限制联邦移民法案的执行，并对向收容、雇佣和运输未登记外国人的行为予以惩罚。法案支持者认为，这是”通过执法减少（非法移民）数量”（attrition through enforcement）。法案的反对者认为，这一法案会鼓励种族貌相（Racial Profiling），警察在执法中会根据对方的种族或民族特点，来决定是否进行执法。法案的支持者则认为，这一法案可以避免警察以种族为单一标准来调查移民身分。为了解决这一问题，法案在临签署之前还进行了修订。对法案的反馈声音也非常不统一，该法案在超过70个城市引发抗议，并引发了抵制亚利桑那州的活动。但又有民调显示，该法案在亚利桑那州和全国范围内有支持者。法案通过后，引发了其他州的连锁反应，也考虑通过类似立法。
ef286d2157071f67ef43c4d7b4ee3d7e60b595b1.translatedText: At the same time, Bill 1070 also prohibits state government officials, local officials or agencies from restricting the implementation of federal immigration laws and penalizes the accommodation, employment and transportation of unregistered aliens. Supporters of the bill believe that this is "attrition through enforcement to reduce the number of (illegal immigrants)." Opponents of the bill believe that this bill will encourage racial profiling (Racial Profiling), and the police will decide whether to carry out law enforcement based on the racial or ethnic characteristics of the other party during law enforcement. Supporters of the bill say it would prevent police from using race as a single criterion to investigate immigration status. To address this issue, the bill was amended before it was signed. Feedback on the bill has been mixed, sparking protests in more than 70 cities and a boycott of Arizona. But polls show the bill has supporters in Arizona and nationwide. After the bill was passed, it triggered a chain reaction in other states to consider passing similar legislation.

e4db56d34a44d5666018ecdfc7a09e101d103d9e.sourceText: 在法案签署之后，包括司法部在内都质疑法案是否符合宪法或民权法案。在法案生效前一天，联邦法官发布了禁令，禁止执法人员在进行非移民执法时，拦问并要求民众确认合法身分，从而限制了法案倍受争议的部分。2012年6月，最高法院在裁决亚利桑那州诉美国（Arizona v. United States），肯定了执法时可以要求对方确认移民身分，但否决了其他条款。
e4db56d34a44d5666018ecdfc7a09e101d103d9e.translatedText: After the bill was signed, including the Department of Justice, questioned whether the bill was consistent with the Constitution or the Civil Rights Act. The day before the bill took effect, a federal judge issued an injunction prohibiting law enforcement officers from stopping and asking people to confirm their legal status during non-immigration enforcement, thereby limiting the controversial part of the bill. In June 2012, the Supreme Court ruled in Arizona v. United States, affirming that law enforcement can require the other party to confirm immigration status, but rejected other provisions.

e92f96663b0601898179685fd4234845a63ec093.sourceText: 阿拉巴马州众院56号法案

d73c8e1654e84f719987eebfc1def45d3414b372.sourceText: 阿拉巴马州众院56号法案（下称56号法案），全称为《比森-汉蒙阿拉巴马州纳税人和公民保护法案》，于2011年6月签署成州法案，这一法案是全美最严格的反移民法案，比亚利桑那州参院1070号法案还更严格。
d73c8e1654e84f719987eebfc1def45d3414b372.translatedText: >Alabama House Bill 56 (hereinafter referred to as Bill 56), the full name is the "Beason-Hammon Alabama Taxpayer and Citizen Protection Act". It was signed into a state bill in June 2011. This bill is the most stringent anti-immigration bill in the United States, even more stringent than Arizona Senate Bill 1070.

77a20dace60568eb649d7c7957e103e1ceccd5f2.sourceText: 56号法案要求，如果警察在合法拦止、拘留或抓捕时，有合理理由怀疑一个人是非法滞留美国，警察可以要求确认移民身分，除非是这种行为会妨碍其他官方的调查。法案还禁止非法移民获得州及地方层面的任何福利，非法移民不可以到公立学院或大学上学，公立小学、初中和高中的管理人员每年要确认每个学生是否非法移民，虽然非法移民的学生不会被学校排除，但在向州教育官员提交报告时，学区每年要提交疑似非法移民的数量统计。
77a20dace60568eb649d7c7957e103e1ceccd5f2.translatedText: Proposition 56 requires that if the police have reasonable grounds to suspect that a person is in the United States illegally when lawfully stopping, detaining, or arresting the person, the police may request confirmation of immigration status, unless such conduct would interfere with other official investigations. The bill also prohibits illegal immigrants from receiving any benefits at the state and local levels. Illegal immigrants are not allowed to attend public colleges or universities. Administrators of public elementary schools, junior high schools, and high schools must annually confirm whether each student is an illegal immigrant. Although students who are illegal immigrants will not be excluded from schools, school districts must submit statistics on the number of suspected illegal immigrants every year when submitting reports to state education officials. The

c08eb6010433da340f839bd95d9815a332cf325c.sourceText: 法案还禁止运输或接收非法移民，屋主不可以出租房屋给非法移民，州内的雇主不可以在知情的情况下雇佣非法移民。如果雇主已经雇佣了非法移民，而有合法身分的居民却被拒绝，雇主将会被控歧视。法案还要求大企业和小企业使用电子认证系统来确认雇员的移民身分，非法移民也不可以申请工作。生产虚假证件的行为是非法的，如果明知对方是非法移民的情况下，签订的合同是无效。
c08eb6010433da340f839bd95d9815a332cf325c.translatedText: bill also prohibits the transportation or reception of illegal immigrants. Homeowners cannot rent houses to illegal immigrants, and employers in the state cannot knowingly hire illegal immigrants. If an employer already hires an illegal immigrant but a resident with legal status is turned away, the employer could be sued for discrimination. The bill also requires large companies and small businesses to use an electronic certification system to confirm the immigration status of employees, and illegal immigrants will not be able to apply for jobs. The act of producing false documents is illegal. If you know that the other party is an illegal immigrant, the contract signed will be invalid.

33a57da8eb8183d974e4a23e58df66c19a8120a4.sourceText: 这一美国历史上最严格的反移民法案在争议声中通过（但似乎在亚利桑那州颇受支持），并招来了许多的官司，不同的机构、不同的人有不同的观点，在2012年8月20日，第11巡回法庭认为56号法案的大部分内容是无效的。在法案通过以后，助理司法部长托马斯?#20329;雷斯（Thomas E. Perez）在2011年12月2日致信阿拉巴马州蒙哥马利县警长办公室，提醒执法人员遵守”保护和服务所有遇到的人”的誓言。在托马斯的信中，提到56号法案与《1964年民权法案》第4章、《1968年奥林巴斯犯罪控制与安全街道法案》，根据美国法律，接受联邦政府资助的机构必须遵守这些法律，恪守不歧视的基本要求，否则联邦政府可能会终止拨款。
33a57da8eb8183d974e4a23e58df66c19a8120a4.translatedText: This most stringent anti-immigration bill in U.S. history was passed amid controversy (but seems to be quite popular in Arizona) and has attracted many lawsuits. Different agencies and different people have different views. On August 20, 2012, the 11th Circuit Court held that most of the contents of Bill 56 were invalid. After the bill passed, Assistant Attorney General Thomas E. Perez sent a letter to the Montgomery County Sheriff's Office in Alabama on December 2, 2011, reminding law enforcement officers to abide by their oath to "protect and serve all those they encounter." In Thomas' letter, he mentioned Bill 56, Chapter 4 of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, and the Olympus Crime Control and Safe Streets Act of 1968. According to U.S. law, institutions receiving federal funding must comply with these laws and adhere to the basic requirements of non-discrimination, otherwise the federal government may terminate funding.

64303d9452f8791be2d2b704609c37d58358f169.sourceText: 移民问题上联邦立法先占

adb3e398aef49bf97e9207709d04b5085c797195.sourceText: 联邦第12-884号裁决（Alabama v. United States of America），是关于阿拉巴马州56号法案中的第13条，该条文规定”隐藏、允许进港、鼓励停留或运输违反联邦法进入美国的外国人”是州犯罪，联邦最高法院讨论的是：联邦法是否对这一条款有先占？
adb3e398aef49bf97e9207709d04b5085c797195.translatedText: > Federal Ruling No. 12-884 (Alabama v. United States of America) is about Section 13 of Alabama Bill 56, which stipulates that "hiding, allowing entry, encouraging stay, or transporting aliens who have entered the United States in violation of federal law" is a state crime. The federal Supreme Court discussed: Does federal law preempt this provision?

94bbb52422cc938b0e85278d2c53fc1d794117a0.sourceText: 在分析中，联邦最高法院很大程度上是重复了亚利桑那州诉美国（Arizona v. United States）的结论。联邦最高法院强调的是在亚利桑那州诉美国一案中的结论，即”美国（联邦）政府在移民与外国人的问题上拥有广泛的、不容质疑的权威”。由此引申的是：美国与外国人之间的关系是重要关系，这种关系当属联邦政府来管理。虽然阿拉巴马州的法律管的是本州居民，但它同时管的是美国与外国人的关系，在这个问题上，联邦具有绝对的权威。
94bbb52422cc938b0e85278d2c53fc1d794117a0.translatedText: In its analysis, the Supreme Court largely repeated the conclusion of Arizona v. United States. The Supreme Court emphasized its conclusion in the Arizona v. United States case that "the United States (federal) government has broad and unquestionable authority on immigration and alien matters." What follows from this is: The relationship between the United States and foreigners is an important relationship, and this relationship should be managed by the federal government. Although Alabama's laws govern the state's residents, it also governs the relationship between the United States and foreigners. On this issue, the federal government has absolute authority.

8bfa05cd5f2739720f11d78909cf3f36cbb79d30.sourceText: 联邦最高法院强调处理移民问题权属联邦政府，在移民与国籍法中规定，如果（有人）明知对方是非法进入或停留在美国的非法移民，却仍然隐蔽、收容或庇护对方，以阻止对方被拘留，则会受到刑事处罚。同时，移民与国籍法也会对鼓励或引诱外国人非法进入和停留在美国人的予以刑事处罚。外国人在非法进入或再入境美国时，本身就有可能会受到法律的惩罚，美国也可以递解这些非法入境的外国人，但从联邦法律的角度上，仅仅是非法停留在美国并不构成刑事犯罪。从州政府与地方政府的角度看，联邦政府可以要求州政府和地方政府在处理移民问题上予以配合，但主导权不在州政府与地方政府。
8bfa05cd5f2739720f11d78909cf3f36cbb79d30.translatedText: The Federal Supreme Court emphasized that the federal government has the authority to deal with immigration issues. The Immigration and Nationality Act stipulates that if (someone) knows that the other person is an illegal immigrant who has illegally entered or stayed in the United States, but still hides, shelters or shelters the other person to prevent the other person from being detained, he will be subject to criminal penalties. At the same time, the Immigration and Nationality Act also criminalizes those who encourage or induce aliens to illegally enter and remain in the United States. Foreigners may be punished by law when they illegally enter or re-enter the United States. The United States can also deport these illegal aliens, but from the perspective of federal law, merely staying illegally in the United States does not constitute a criminal offense. From the perspective of state and local governments, the federal government can require state and local governments to cooperate in handling immigration issues, but the initiative does not lie with state and local governments.

c0f161360c2dc7022af82b6a2818519a6f8808c9.sourceText: 据此，联邦法院拒绝审理此案，呈请移审令的要求被拒绝
c0f161360c2dc7022af82b6a2818519a6f8808c9.translatedText: Accordingly, the Federal Court refused to hear the case and the request for a writ of transfer was denied.

a8b0217d09ee56b699daecd5935e71ca94385358.sourceText: 北达科塔州居民到亚利桑那州抢房子 （亚省时报） 通常会租用亚利桑那冬天退休房的北达科塔州的居民，不再租房了，他们到亚利桑那买房，占尽亚利桑那州房屋市场泡沫破灭的低价优势。 在凤凰城市内低价销售的房屋，吸引了很多北方人，其中包括许多在去年夏天洪灾中受灾的迈诺特居民。在吉尔伯特的经纪人洛基帕拉告诉迈诺特每日新闻报，从所谓的”雪鸟”往来是很稳定的。迈诺特居民丹科里蒂奇和他的邻居曾考虑在亚利桑那州租退休屋。水灾后，他们一起在迈诺特购买一个拼装屋，使他们在迈诺特有个住的地方，然后前往凤凰置业。丹科里蒂奇说，一个五间卧室的房子还带有游泳池，在一个封闭的小区内，房屋价格低得惊人。
a8b0217d09ee56b699daecd5935e71ca94385358.translatedText: North Dakota residents go to Arizona to grab houses (Alberta Times) North Dakota residents who would normally rent their winter retirement homes in Arizona are no longer renting and are buying homes in Arizona, taking advantage of the low prices of Arizona's housing market that burst. Low-priced homes in Phoenix are attracting northerners, including many Minot residents who were affected by last summer's flooding. Gilbert's agent, Rocky Parra, told the Minot Daily News that traffic from the so-called "Snowbirds" has been steady. Minot resident Dan Koritich and his neighbors considered renting a retirement home in Arizona. After the flood, they bought a trailer together in Minot, giving them a place to live in Minot, and then headed to Phoenix for real estate. A five-bedroom house with a swimming pool in a gated community is surprisingly affordable, Dankolitich said.

1ecc9be75893cf7431237f17a3dca2951034e559.translatedText: The Arizona Branch of the Chinese Kuomintang was present to welcome

3f47721c4ca6d44274c5d28f96dabdb0854f353f.sourceText: （中国国民党亚利桑那直属分部来稿）中华民国驻美大使金溥聪与夫人周慧婷四月四日至七日访问洛杉矶, 四月六日中午金溥聪大使伉俪出席洛杉矶侨界举办的盛大午宴, 并就台美关係发表演说. 国民党亚利桑那直属分部党员同志们踊跃参加, 并穿上党分部制服, 带上中华民国国旗围巾, 从亚利桑那州开车去洛杉矶参加欢迎活动, 党员们把这次欢迎金溥聪大使的活动, 当作是一次支持中华民国努力扩大外交, 争取国家主权的活动.
3f47721c4ca6d44274c5d28f96dabdb0854f353f.translatedText: (Contributed by the Arizona Branch of the Chinese Kuomintang) The Ambassador of the Republic of China to the United States, Jin Pucong, and his wife Zhou Huiting visited Los Angeles from April 4th to 7th. At noon on April 6th, Ambassador Jin Pucong and his wife attended a grand luncheon hosted by the overseas Chinese community in Los Angeles. He also delivered a speech on Taiwan-US relations. Comrades from the Arizona branch of the Kuomintang actively participated, wearing party branch uniforms and ROC flag scarves, and drove from Arizona to Los Angeles to participate in the welcome event. The party members regarded this event to welcome Ambassador Jin Pucong as an event to support the efforts of the Republic of China to expand diplomacy and strive for national sovereignty.
