544d0eaf779b5bf802b9ce89cbd9bdf5f43b9407.translatedText: (left to right) Cai Chang, Wang Wei, and Wang Ting Gao Qizheng, Min Zhongying, Zhan Zhoulixian, Zhan Haowen, Yang Yonghui, Yan Yu, Pan Wenhui, Han Yanqiong, Mi Huimin, Li Wenzhe, Zhu Jiayou

1d9f608db1db7c5b4e413a8d641fd0ff1140aafa.sourceText: 据筹委会总召集人高启正说: 金溥聪此行访问洛杉矶侨界活动的高潮, 就是在六日当天的侨宴, 整个宴会有千人出席, (其中也包括有大陆背景人士), 这说明中华民国的海外侨务工作和外交工作非常有效率, 也反映出越来越多的海外华人华侨认同中华民国的主权存在. 午宴期间, 金溥聪大使在致词中讚扬海外华侨对中华民国政府的支持和热爱, 并鼓励海外华侨多为中华民国作宣传和贡献心力, 他还表示, 这次来洛杉矶最大的收穫一 是学到很多东西, 二是南加州侨胞的热情令人感动. 当金溥聪大使得知国民党亚利桑那直属分部也来参加欢迎午宴时, 金溥聪大使伉俪特别与全体成员合影留念.
1d9f608db1db7c5b4e413a8d641fd0ff1140aafa.translatedText: According to Gao Qizheng, the general convener of the organizing committee, the climax of Jin Pucong's visit to the overseas Chinese community in Los Angeles was the overseas Chinese banquet on the 6th. The entire banquet was attended by a thousand people (including people with mainland background). This shows that the overseas Chinese affairs and diplomatic work of the Republic of China are very efficient, and also reflects that more and more overseas Chinese recognize the sovereign existence of the Republic of China. During the luncheon, Ambassador Jin Pucong praised overseas Chinese for their support and love for the government of the Republic of China in his speech, and encouraged overseas Chinese to promote and contribute to the Republic of China. He also said that the biggest gain from coming to Los Angeles this time is that I learned a lot, and the enthusiasm of the overseas Chinese in Southern California is touching. When Ambassador Jin Pucong learned that the Arizona branch of the Kuomintang was also attending the welcome lunch, Ambassador Jin Pucong and his wife specially took a group photo with all the members.

6e780345ebe33600db06375de76ee44d2020830b.sourceText: 参加这次欢迎活动的国民党亚利桑那直属分部党员们都非常兴奋和激动, 欢迎会结束后党员们纷纷发表己见, 党员闵中英说: 亚利桑那国民党直属分部, 由王玮王亭常委率领党员同志们参加洛杉矶欢迎金溥聪大使活动, 这是对马英九政府外交工作的支持, 我们要齐心协力拥护马英九总统, 继续带领台湾走上团结富强之路.
6e780345ebe33600db06375de76ee44d2020830b.translatedText: > The members of the Arizona branch of the KMT who participated in this welcome event were very excited. After the welcome meeting, party members expressed their opinions one after another. Party member Min Zhongying said: The Arizona KMT branch, led by standing committee member Wang Wei and Wang Ting, party members and comrades participated in the event to welcome Ambassador Jin Pucong in Los Angeles. This is a support for the diplomatic work of the Ma Ying-jeou government. We must work together to support President Ma Ying-jeou and continue to lead Taiwan on the road to unity and prosperity.

870004d432c67ff8a295686ce7f251782567452b.sourceText: （左至右） 金大使夫人 金大使 闵中英 党员潘文慧说: 得知要参加中华民国金溥聪大使来洛杉矶访问宴会, 一下子使我回想起2012年回台湾参加总统助选活动, 现在回忆起那些日子都是人生最美好的时刻, 今天王常委组织我们去参加洛杉矶欢迎中华民国金溥聪大使活动, 我们把活动看成是为中华民国争光, 为台湾加油的事情, 我常常和朋友谈起30年前拿着中华民国护照来美国时, 美国移民局, 海关等机构真有歧视妳的情况发生, 现在同样拿着中华民国护照来美国, 不但不用签证, 移民局都对我们很客气, 这就是中华民国外交的胜利, 这就是中华民国给我们的尊严. 党员詹浩文, 周丽仙也表示, 近来国民党执政团队出现几个贪污丑闻, 让马英九政府备受压力, 但我们仍然对马英九总统有信心, 这也正是中国国民党不断走向改革之路的动力, 海外侨胞坚抉支持马英九总统, 带领我们奋勇向前.
870004d432c67ff8a295686ce7f251782567452b.translatedText: (left to right) Ambassador Jin’s wife Ambassador Jin Min Zhongying Party member Pan Wenhui said: When I learned that I was going to attend the visit banquet of Ambassador Jin Pucong of the Republic of China in Los Angeles, it suddenly reminded me of my return to Taiwan in 2012 to participate in the presidential campaign. Now I recall those days as the best moments of my life. Today, Standing Committee Member Wang organized us to attend an event in Los Angeles to welcome Ambassador Jin Pucong of the Republic of China. We regard the event as a matter of bringing honor to the Republic of China and cheering for Taiwan. I often talk to my friends about how when I came to the United States with a Republic of China passport 30 years ago, the U.S. Immigration Service, Customs and other agencies really discriminated against you. Now I come to the United States with a Republic of China passport and not only do we not need a visa, but the Immigration Bureau is also very polite to us. This is a victory for the diplomacy of the Republic of China. This is the dignity given to us by the Republic of China. Party members Zhan Haowen and Zhou Lixian also said that there have been several corruption scandals in the Kuomintang ruling team recently, which has put the Ma Ying-jeou government under pressure, but we still have confidence in President Ma Ying-jeou. This is also the driving force for the Chinese Kuomintang to continue on the road to reform. Overseas Chinese are determined to support President Ma Ying-jeou and lead us forward bravely.

216744b7d3d7a6dc5f3296c0f5d1d720b53f3653.sourceText: （左至右） 金大使夫人 金大使 詹浩文 詹周丽仙 党员严瑜说: 每次去洛杉矶参加中华民国侨委会活动, 都是一次对中华民国的热爱和支持的具体体现, 这次去洛杉矶参加金溥聪大使欢迎午宴, 让我感到金大使是一个谦虚谨慎, 待人合和气, 彬彬有礼的大使, 因此更获得广大海外侨胞和美国政要的尊敬. 总之这次亚利桑那直属分部党员参加欢迎金溥聪大使活动, 让党分部工作更增加了凝聚力, 也让海外侨胞们更加了解马英九继续担任国民党主席的重要性.
216744b7d3d7a6dc5f3296c0f5d1d720b53f3653.translatedText: (Left to right) Ambassador Jin’s wife Ambassador Jin Zhan Haowen Zhan Zhoulixian Party member Yan Yu said: Every time I go to Los Angeles to participate in the activities of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council of the Republic of China, it is a concrete manifestation of my love and support for the Republic of China. This time I went to Los Angeles to attend Ambassador Jin Pucong’s welcome luncheon, which made me feel that Ambassador Jin is a modest, prudent, friendly and courteous ambassador. Therefore, he has gained the respect of overseas Chinese and American dignitaries. In short, this time party members directly under the Arizona branch participated in the event to welcome Ambassador Jin Pucong, which added cohesion to the work of the party branch and made overseas Chinese more aware of the importance of Ma Ying-jeou continuing to serve as chairman of the Kuomintang.

b457a4600c62a8296cb8f5b80c4b109c8038d23a.translatedText: Implementation of new tax reform: Payroll withholding tax may change, will it really save taxes? [Overseas Chinese News reporter Shang Ying reported in Irvine on January 4] At the beginning of the new year, President Trump last Christmas...

0307e927a1793a023b4b0e18d9b42e56773dfdf2.sourceText: 【侨报记者尚颖1月4日尔湾报道】新年伊始，特朗普总统去年圣诞节前签署的新税改法案生效实施。不少上班族民众期待2018年的第一份工资单将兑现新税法的减税承诺，有民众获悉工资单里的扣税部分或将减少。
0307e927a1793a023b4b0e18d9b42e56773dfdf2.translatedText: [Overseas Chinese News reporter Shang Ying reported in Irvine on January 4] At the beginning of the new year, the new tax reform bill signed by President Trump before Christmas last year came into effect. Many office workers expect that the first payslip of 2018 will fulfill the tax reduction promise of the new tax law. Some people have learned that the tax deduction part of the payslip may be reduced.

cca96a900e435d10a81c2a149a4eb315e50c7850.sourceText: 工资收入预扣税减少果真会省税吗？
cca96a900e435d10a81c2a149a4eb315e50c7850.translatedText: Will reducing withholding tax on salary income really save taxes?

5bf53c0af5b0e3ebc7c8d5bbff0634697f2cc11d.sourceText: 尔湾陈会计师表示，联邦收入税需要雇员领到工资就得交税，所以雇主在给雇员发工资时会预扣一定数额的收入税，这部分预扣税直接以雇员的名下预交国税局。年底报税期，国税局将会根据各人实际情况计算最终实际缴纳税额，多退少补。
5bf53c0af5b0e3ebc7c8d5bbff0634697f2cc11d.translatedText: Irvine Accountant Chen said that federal income tax requires employees to pay taxes when they receive wages, so employers will withhold a certain amount of income tax when paying employees wages, and this part of the withholding tax will be paid directly to the IRS in the name of the employee. During the tax filing period at the end of the year, the IRS will calculate the final actual amount of tax paid based on each person’s actual situation and refund any excess tax.

3b6af8b8f99a6dc2abf4272fa2db0165a83f8ed2.sourceText: 陈会计师表示，特朗普新税法被称为每个纳税人都得到减税，所以目前新税法生效实施后，上班族雇员工资单上的预扣税或有变化。如果旧税法时期每1，000美金的工资收入预扣200美金预付税，按照新税法的计算规则，工资单上预付的收入税部分或许减少，低于200美金。
3b6af8b8f99a6dc2abf4272fa2db0165a83f8ed2.translatedText: Accountant Chen said that Trump’s new tax law is said to be a tax cut for every taxpayer, so after the new tax law comes into effect, the withholding tax on the salary slips of office workers may change. If prepaid tax of $200 was withheld for every $1,000 of salary income during the old tax law period, according to the calculation rules of the new tax law, the prepaid income tax portion of the payroll may be reduced to less than $200.

e4efbdb51fca4af8eb83bf48a3a34773237edb67.sourceText: 陈会计师指出，但是这并不意味着你的收入税一定就会减少。新税法非常复杂，每个人每个家庭的情况又不同，收入税到底会减少或是增加，以年底报税后，国税局依据不同档税率规则而计算出的实际应付税务额为准。
e4efbdb51fca4af8eb83bf48a3a34773237edb67.translatedText: Accountant Chen pointed out that this does not mean that your income tax will definitely be reduced. The new tax law is very complex, and the situation of each person and each family is different. Whether the income tax will be reduced or increased depends on the actual amount of tax payable calculated by the Internal Revenue Service based on different tax rate rules after filing the tax at the end of the year.

5500ece4e486c2c1adb05dfc14d4d8a88adec819.sourceText: 美国国税局（IRS）网站最新的更新信息通知：由于2017年圣诞节前签署的新税法法案有变化，目前国税局有关工资收入预扣税的计算法则需要更新。1月份将发布初步的收入税预扣指导信息，一旦更新确定预扣税规则，将会尽快公布。因此，国税局鼓励雇主及工资服务行业2月份开始实施收入税预扣额的调整。
5500ece4e486c2c1adb05dfc14d4d8a88adec819.translatedText: Latest updated information notice from the U.S. Internal Revenue Service (IRS) website: Due to changes in the new tax law bill signed before Christmas 2017, the current IRS calculation rules for wage income withholding tax need to be updated. Preliminary income tax withholding guidance information will be released in January, and withholding tax rules will be announced as soon as possible once the withholding tax rules are updated. Therefore, the IRS encourages employers and payroll services industries to begin implementing adjustments to income tax withholding amounts in February.

e1e7699738f3312699d92b6fc1f28b4ce8e3d354.sourceText: 在此之前，雇主及工资服务行业暂时继续延用2017年旧有的工资收入税预扣规则表系统。
e1e7699738f3312699d92b6fc1f28b4ce8e3d354.translatedText: Prior to this, employers and the payroll service industry will temporarily continue to use the old wage income tax withholding rule table system in 2017.

3d31ed23acf12ecb4282c47cf89169eb4a7dc0cb.translatedText: The Hispanic population has a high birth rate and Republicans are worried about the future

b04004d794a5b747384bb36e90155e6fee974557.translatedText: The Hispanic population has a high birth rate and Republicans are worried about the future A report released on Tuesday by the Morris Institute of Public Policy at State University said that the Hispanic birth rate in the state has been...

6e910cb89da01ee07d35eacfe996d5198f1d4a72.sourceText: 西裔人口出生率高 共和党人忧变天 州立大学莫里斯公共政策研究所周二发表的报告称，本州西班牙裔人口出生率近年来一直高于其他族裔，由此推断，在不到二十年后，亚利桑那州很可能由坚定的共和党州，变成民主党州。 根据现行法律，凡在美国出生的婴儿自动成为美国公民，不管他们的父母是否合法移民，到他们年满18岁时就有投票权。 主流社会一直认为，拉美裔传统上比其他族裔人口登记和投票比例低，而且，这部分人口很可能获得投票权后，宁愿投给无党派人士，也不愿投票给共和党人。但根据报告数据，到2030年，本州的民主党人数量将等于或超过共和党人。这种情况是1984年以来没有出现过的。 此报告一出，势必将重燃在州议会关于非法移民子女，因在本州出生，应否享有公民权的政治辩论。 哈瓦苏湖区参议员，共和党人罗恩古尔德在上一届议会会期发起提案，提出州卫生部门应提供两种类型的出生证明：一种是给公民或永久合法居民的子女，另一种是给没有以上两身份的人士的子女。 古尔德周二说，希望此报告能促使美国最高法院解决一直以来回避的问题，美国宪法修正案第14条，”凡在美国出生的人，是美国及其居住州的公民”。许多共和党人认为，此修正案产生的年代在美国内战时期，沿用至今已经不合时宜，只会助长非法移民活动。 古尔德否认和许多共和党议员一样，对西裔人口增多，导致本州选票流向民主党产生恐惧。他说，”如果我们的边境问题得到解决，非法移民、贩毒问题得到有效遏制，我相信许多拉丁美裔选票会将选票投给共和党。我相信，我们的家庭价值观和工作伦理比民主党更适合。” 虽然，古尔德的理论仍有待观察，但在本州历史上，有过西裔对民主党更友好的记录。2010年，皮尤西裔中心发现71%的亚利桑那州西裔选民支持特里哥德当州长，只有28%西裔支持共和党的甄布鲁尔。最后布鲁尔赢了，是因为只有54%的民众投票。同样，只有40%西裔支持共和党人麦凯恩竞选连任，麦凯恩击败对手与西裔投票率低有关。 根据2010年人口普查数字，亚利桑那州人口的三分之一是西裔，占当年出生人口率的40%也是西裔。难怪共和党人有危机感。
6e910cb89da01ee07d35eacfe996d5198f1d4a72.translatedText: The Hispanic population has a high birth rate and Republicans are worried about the future. A report released Tuesday by State University's Morris Institute of Public Policy said that the Hispanic birth rate in the state has been higher than that of other ethnic groups in recent years, inferring that Arizona is likely to transform from a staunchly Republican state to a Democratic state in less than two decades. Under current law, babies born in the United States automatically become U.S. citizens, regardless of whether their parents immigrated legally, and have the right to vote when they turn 18. Mainstream society has always believed that Hispanics have traditionally registered and voted at lower rates than other ethnic groups, and that this group of people is likely to prefer to vote for independents rather than Republicans after gaining the right to vote. But according to the report, by 2030, the number of Democrats in the state will equal or exceed that of Republicans. This situation has not occurred since 1984. The release of this report is bound to reignite the political debate in the state Legislature over whether children of illegal immigrants should enjoy citizenship rights because they were born in the state. Sen. Ron Gould, a Republican from Lake Havasu, sponsored a bill last session that would have required state health departments to provide two types of birth certificates: one for children of citizens or permanent legal residents, and one for children of people without either status. Gould said on Tuesday he hoped the report would prompt the U.S. Supreme Court to address a long-avoided issue regarding the 14th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution, which states that "all persons born in the United States are citizens of the United States and of the state in which they reside." Many Republicans believe that this amendment was produced during the American Civil War and is outdated and will only encourage illegal immigration. Gould denied that he shared the fears of many Republican lawmakers that a growing Hispanic population in the state would shift votes toward Democrats. He said, "If our border problems are solved, illegal immigration and drug trafficking are effectively curbed, I believe that many Latino votes will vote for the Republican Party. I believe that our family values ​​and work ethics are better suited than the Democratic Party." Although, Gould's theory remains to be seen, but in the history of the state, Hispanics have a record of being more friendly to the Democratic Party. In 2010, the Pew Hispanic Center found that 71% of Hispanic voters in Arizona supported Terry Gold as governor, while only 28% supported Republican Zhen Brewer. In the end, Brewer won because only 54% of the people voted. Similarly, only 40% of Hispanics supported Republican McCain's re-election, and McCain's defeat was related to the low Hispanic turnout. According to 2010 census figures, one-third of Arizona's population is Hispanic, accounting for 40% of the birth rate that year. No wonder Republicans have a sense of crisis.

1495ee7f727a491795116c91b3b60017210771ee.translatedText: Five-state universities allow students to carry guns, making teachers uneasy. There are currently 5 states in which public universities allow students to bring guns to campus according to law, an increase of 4 states from more than two years ago. Many university teachers...

89ab131adf806bc10915b5889e3fcf6d54b7e975.sourceText: 目前有5个州的公立大学，学生依法可带枪到校，比两年多前增加4州。许多大学教师对此现象感到不安和恐惧。长久以来，许多美国大学获准自行决定是否允许学生带枪到校，许多大学至今仍禁止学生带枪。但是，2007年弗吉尼亚理工学院惨案为学生拥枪主张带来推动力，支持人士经由法院裁决、 州政府通过法案等方式，扩大公立大学学生的拥枪权。维权人士辩称，如果学生拥有枪，就能阻止赵承熙疯狂行凶。 2007年4月16日，弗吉尼亚理工学院发生韩裔凶手赵承熙开枪滥杀32名师生的恐怖事件。
89ab131adf806bc10915b5889e3fcf6d54b7e975.translatedText: There are currently 5 states in which public universities allow students to bring guns to campus by law, an increase of 4 states from more than two years ago. Many university teachers feel uneasy and fearful about this phenomenon. Many American universities have long been allowed to decide for themselves whether to allow students to bring guns to campus, and many still prohibit students from carrying guns. However, the massacre at Virginia Tech in 2007 gave impetus to student gun rights. Supporters used court rulings and state government bills to expand gun rights for students at public universities. Rights activists argued that if students had guns, they could prevent Cho Seung-hee from going on a rampage. On April 16, 2007, a horrific incident occurred at Virginia Polytechnic Institute where the Korean murderer Cho Seung-hee shot and killed 32 teachers and students indiscriminately.

1ce5103cea4a35690f003f4d831a95ff2ed96944.sourceText: 目前，全美有24州让各个大学自行决定是否禁止学生带枪，还有21州法律明文禁止学生随身”不外露带枪”。但这一切都在改变中。过去两年，大约25州提出法案，要求允许大学生用某种形式携带不外露的枪支。提案者往往以弗吉尼亚理工学院滥杀案，作为应允许学生拥枪的正当理由。尽管带枪让某些学生觉得有安全感，科罗拉多大学许多教师却感到不安和恐惧。他们表示，大学是他们可以畅所欲言，甚至提出争议性意见的”自由和开放场所”，但允许学生拥枪将制造恐惧和恫吓的气氛。 在本州，虽然众议会在今年初通过允许学生带枪议案，但因州长拒绝签字而胎死腹中。
1ce5103cea4a35690f003f4d831a95ff2ed96944.translatedText: Currently, 24 states in the United States allow each university to decide whether to prohibit students from carrying guns, and 21 states have laws that explicitly prohibit students from "not carrying guns openly". But that's all changing. In the past two years, about 25 states have introduced bills that would allow college students to carry some form of concealed firearm. Proponents often point to the Virginia Tech massacre as a legitimate reason why students should be allowed to own guns. While carrying guns makes some students feel safe, many University of Colorado faculty feel uneasy and fearful. They said that universities are "free and open places" where they can speak freely and even raise controversial opinions, but allowing students to own guns will create an atmosphere of fear and intimidation. In this state, although the House of Representatives passed a bill allowing students to carry guns at the beginning of this year, it failed because the governor refused to sign it.

11d24cfde9a77de261305753af891a2301403e20.sourceText: 凤凰城中文学校一年一度的秋季烤肉活动，十一月二日于Chandler 市的Arrowhead Meadows Park 举行。这次因为场地时间调度问题，延后于十一月初举办，学校决定依旧把烤肉和万盛节变装活动联合起来。虽然万盛节刚过，但公园凉亭用黑橘彩带加南瓜、蜘蛛网的装饰，以及家长、学生们鲜丽的服装，仍让人感受到节庆的气氛。
11d24cfde9a77de261305753af891a2301403e20.translatedText: Phoenix City Chinese School's annual Autumn Barbecue Events, held on November 2nd in Chandler Held at the city's Arrowhead Meadows Park. This time, due to venue scheduling issues, the event was postponed to early November. The school decided to still combine the barbecue with the Wansheng Festival costume event. Although the Wansheng Festival has just passed, the park pavilion is decorated with black and orange ribbons, pumpkins and spider webs, as well as the bright costumes of parents and students, which still makes people feel the festive atmosphere.

8514bbd187dcdeca96000ced1520df2d3e357650.sourceText: 今年新上任的中华文化协会会长陈春绢女士，早在一个月前就开始邀请家长，准备各式各样的拿手好菜。十点左右，许多热心的家长带着孩子们，就已经陆陆续续地抵达公园，佈置场地。十一点活动正式开始，大家先享用美食。这次的食物部分中西式都有，主菜有饭和炒米粉，加上配菜、凉拌、滷味、小吃等等，还有西式炭烤汉堡、热狗和比萨饼。另外也有多种汤类和解渴饮料选择，以及令人无法抗拒的甜点和水果派。
8514bbd187dcdeca96000ced1520df2d3e357650.translatedText: Ms. Chen Chunjuan, the newly appointed president of the Chinese Cultural Association this year, started inviting parents as early as a month ago to prepare a variety of specialty dishes. Around ten o'clock, many enthusiastic parents and their children arrived at the park one after another to arrange the venue. The event officially started at 11 o'clock, and everyone enjoyed the food first. The food this time includes both Chinese and Western styles. The main dishes include rice and fried rice noodles, plus side dishes, cold salads, braised dishes, snacks, etc., as well as Western-style charcoal grilled burgers, hot dogs and pizzas. There's also a wide selection of soups and thirst-quenching drinks, as well as irresistible desserts and fruit pies.

cddfc22aa1be306d9a7e5b03137e57d2cdda04a0.sourceText: 享用完美食，家长们就坐在凉亭内和好友们聊天，小朋友就开始去游戏摊位探险。由学生代联会高年级同学带领，不论是丢圈圈 (Ring Toss)，身体彩绘 (Face/ Body Part Painting)， 或球掷杯塔 (Ball Tossing Cup Tower) ，每个游戏摊位都大排长龙。草坪中央有个摄影棚，由谢健明董事带着他的专业相机，为着装打扮的家长和学生拍摄留念。游戏时间之馀，还穿插了程秀玲校长主持的抽奖活动。之后，重头戏-拔河比赛-登场，让活动掀起了高潮。每个人嘶声喊叫，使劲全力地想为队伍夺标，让在一旁加油的观众也感染了紧张的气氛。
cddfc22aa1be306d9a7e5b03137e57d2cdda04a0.translatedText: After enjoying the delicacies, the parents sat in the pavilion and chatted with their friends, while the children began to explore the game stalls. Led by senior students from the Student Generation Association, whether it was Ring Toss, Face/Body Part Painting, or Ball Tossing Cup Tower, there were long lines at every game booth. There is a photo studio in the middle of the lawn. Director Xie Jianming brought his professional camera to take pictures of the dressed-up parents and students. In addition to the game time, there was also a lottery hosted by Principal Cheng Xiuling. Afterwards, the main event - the tug-of-war competition - came on stage, bringing the event to a climax. Everyone shouted loudly and tried their best to win the championship for the team, which made the spectators cheering on the side also feel the tense atmosphere.

55b5c7a47414b1c1a96035112ddd8f1abacdfd88.sourceText: 最后，但也是小朋友最喜欢的击打Pi馻ta活动，聚集了所有人的目光。这次校方准备了二个Pi馻ta，一个可爱的Hello Kitty 和一个调皮猴子形状。当Pi馻ta被敲破，糖果掉出来的同时，小朋友一涌而上，整个烤肉活动在欢笑声中结束。
55b5c7a47414b1c1a96035112ddd8f1abacdfd88.translatedText: Last but not least, the children’s favorite activity was Pi Tao beating, which attracted everyone’s attention. This time the school prepared two pi buns, a cute Hello Kitty and a naughty monkey shape. When the Pi Tao was broken and the candies fell out, the children rushed up and the whole barbecue activity ended with laughter.

39ae9e7a3fcc4112910609b5c41c2aa0f9c42a10.sourceText: CCTV 神舟九号飞船已于2012年6月16日18时37分在酒泉卫星发射中心发射，实施首次载人空间交会对接任务，飞行乘组由男航天员景海鹏、刘旺和女航天员刘洋组成，景海鹏担任指令长。

537ad22fcf0d9018d049ea53e77e982ea165ee0e.sourceText: 九岁来美 国际化学奥赛摘金 从26个英文字母都不认识的九岁男童，如今代表美国参加国际化学奥林匹克大赛，惠特尼高中（Whitney High）的董冠亨（Joe Tung）为高中生涯画上圆满句号，将赴耶鲁大学学习生物化学和经济学，这也是十年来第二位加州高中生在该赛事获得金牌。 日前在土耳其举行的化学奥林匹克大赛，共有四名学生代表美国参赛。除董冠亨获得金牌外，另三人获得一金二银，是2001年来美国队成绩最好的一次，董冠亨还被选为选手代表，在开幕式致辞。 董冠亨受访时说，九岁从台湾移民来美，就读长堤一所小学，班里只有他一位亚裔，说的英语被小朋友嘲笑，上课听不懂。后来，妈妈把他的英文和历史课先读一遍，然后翻译给他听，过了两个月，董冠亨终于适应环境，并交了很多朋友。 董冠亨说，从小喜欢魔术表演，十年级时的一堂化学课，老师像变魔术做了一个实验，使他对化学兴趣一发不可收拾。十年级和11年级的暑假，他都去哈佛医学院实习，帮助教授追踪一种致癌蛋白质的路径，并发表论文。此项目使他进入西门子研究竞赛和英特尔科学竞赛准决赛。 不但化学好，董冠亨其他课业也很优秀，GPA、SAT、ACT以及12门AP课均满分。早在1月，耶鲁大学就邀请他参观学校，并安排学校获诺贝尔奖的化学教授共进午餐。虽后来陆续收到史丹福、MIT等名校录取信，但去耶鲁的决心已定。
537ad22fcf0d9018d049ea53e77e982ea165ee0e.translatedText: He came to the United States at the age of nine and won the gold medal in the International Chemistry Olympiad. A nine-year-old boy who did not know 26 English letters now represents the United States in the International Chemistry Olympiad. Joe Tung of Whitney High School has concluded his high school career and will go to Yale University to study biochemistry and economics. This is the second California high school student to win a gold medal in this event in ten years. A total of four students represented the United States in the Chemistry Olympiad held recently in Türkiye. In addition to Dong Guanheng's gold medal, the other three won one gold and two silver medals, which was the best performance of the American team since 2001. Dong Guanheng was also selected as the player representative to deliver a speech at the opening ceremony. In an interview, Dong Guanheng said that he immigrated to the United States from Taiwan at the age of nine and attended an elementary school in Changdi. He was the only Asian in the class. His English was laughed at by the children and he could not understand it in class. Later, his mother read his English and history lessons and then translated them to him. After two months, Dong Guanheng finally adapted to the environment and made many friends. Dong Guanheng said that he has been fond of magic performances since he was a child. In a chemistry class in the tenth grade, the teacher performed an experiment that looked like magic, which made his interest in chemistry out of control. During the summer vacations of the tenth and eleventh grade, he went to Harvard Medical School for an internship, helping his professor track the path of a cancer-causing protein and publishing a paper. This project made him a semifinalist in the Siemens Research Competition and the Intel Science Competition. Not only is Dong Guanheng good in chemistry, he is also excellent in other subjects, with perfect scores in GPA, SAT, ACT and 12 AP courses. As early as January, Yale University invited him to visit the school and arranged for lunch with the school's Nobel Prize-winning chemistry professor. Although I later received admission letters from prestigious schools such as Stanford and MIT, I was determined to go to Yale.

b5b05ea08d53fe42288383317c968aadda943632.sourceText: 美国国会参议院11日通过了《2011年货币汇率监督改革法案》。这一法案的主要内容是要求美国政府对所谓”汇率被低估”的主要贸易伙伴征收惩罚性关税。全美中华青年联合会、美华国际青年商会、北美海峡两岸文化交流协会、南加州中国金融学会、美国越柬寮华裔青年联谊会、全美华裔优秀青年联谊会、美国洛杉矶香港青年联谊会、北美深圳青年联合总会等跨区域侨团组织和华裔专业人士团体12 日向全美各州的众议员发出公开信，表示强烈反对在众议院通过这项带有明显贸易保护主义色彩的法案。他们表示这项法案不会对美国经济复苏带来利好，反而会进一步加剧美国国内的通货膨胀，以及延迟美国经济的波段性复苏。
b5b05ea08d53fe42288383317c968aadda943632.translatedText: The U.S. Senate passed the Currency Exchange Rate Supervision Reform Act of 2011 on the 11th. The main content of this bill is to require the U.S. government to impose punitive tariffs on major trading partners with so-called "undervalued exchange rates." On the 12th, cross-regional overseas Chinese organizations and Chinese professional groups such as the National Chinese Youth Federation, the American-Chinese International Youth Chamber of Commerce, the North American Cross-Strait Cultural Exchange Association, the Chinese Finance Association of Southern California, the Vietnamese-Cambodian Chinese Youth Association of the United States, the Outstanding Chinese Youth Association of the United States, the Hong Kong Youth Association of Los Angeles, and the Shenzhen Youth Federation of North America issued an open letter to representatives of states across the United States on the 12th, expressing their strong opposition to the passage of this bill with obvious trade protectionism in the House of Representatives. They said that this bill will not be beneficial to the U.S. economic recovery, but will further exacerbate domestic inflation in the United States and delay the wave-like recovery of the U.S. economy.

63ce36e069df7bf6bd425f0d078abf3cf03f5017.sourceText: 凤凰城气如虹：洛矶山漫游之六－万年大冰原 第五天清晨旅行车离开黄金镇，导游老谢宣布正式进入洛矶山脉境地，沿路两旁都是巍峨高山，重重叠叠，峰峰相连，山顶高耸入云，满盖皑皑白雪，壁间石块坚挺，峭拔嶙峋，雄伟壮观。 我从小生长于亚热带的越南，半世纪后移民美国，又住在沙漠之州亚利桑那，习惯酷热天气，热情热心，少处严寒地带。最寒冷的一次是数年前感恩节期间旅游大峡谷，领略寒风刺骨滋味；另有一回乘坐华航回越，半夜停留阿拉斯加落客，应该是最冰冻境地，但我们没有下机，只坐在机舱内望见外面处处雪白而已。 这回洛矶山漫游，亲身感受在高山湖泊围绕的情趣，被冰雪寒流侵袭的承受心态。导游不停讲述今日参观景点，是此次旅程的主要部份，好像戏剧的主题「戏肉」，最为精彩，大家提醒精神欣赏。 先到洛矶山脉的吆喝国家公园，这里面积不大，各人下车观赏著名的天然桥( Natural Bridge )，这是踢马河( Kicking Horse River)流经之处，看那水流湍急的河水猛烈冲刷着岩石，形成底层洞孔扩大，上面看似两段相接的石桥，状态神奇。河畔一带，青松翠绿，美景盎然。据说，最初印地安人来到这里，被奇景吸引，不禁惊叹呼叫「吆`yo！喝ho！」所以就叫吆喝国家公园。 再前去是贝多湖(Peyto lake)，地势高，湖水深，颜色亮丽，像蓝宝石的美，光彩夺目。 中午时分，旅行团终于抵达哥伦比亚大冰原（Columbia Icefields），哗！我第一次看到冰天雪地，初度身历冷酷冰冻世界，这位置在班芙（Banff）和杰士伯(Jasper)两座国家公园的交界山脊，是一块被冰雪覆盖万年的原始地！导游首先让我们进入旅客服务中心，解决大小便问题和自费午餐，也有商品店，令我意外的是，在这个近乎北极地带的冰原，餐饮处竟有广东同胞为客人服务，而且菜单还有越南牛肉粉，哈！对我这个不懂英文和少吃西餐的人来说，非常惬意。 午餐后，我们登上一辆由旅客中心提供的巴士，沿冰原大道载我们到一个更高集中点，那里有庞大的现代冰原雪车接送我们，不是摆放在旅客服务中心前的坦克车链条形式，而是巨型的特殊雪车，几个深纹巨轮，有一公尺半高，采用登陆月球车的低压巨型轮胎原理，这样才有实力行驶在滑溜的冰河上，但坐在车中感觉摇摇晃晃的，半途有段斜坡俯冲很直，令人提心吊胆！大约十五分钟车程，到达海拔高度为二千二百一十公尺，名叫阿塔巴斯卡冰河。 到达目的地，大家下车，环顾苍茫无垠的雪白冰原，踏足万年冰雪河床，晶莹剔透，真是人生难得的体验！据说品尝那甘甜清凉的冰河水，令人心旷神怡，导游吩咐游客携带空瓶子去盛装这万年冰河之水，回家与亲友分享，然而，遥望四周，处处凝结，哪有溶滴的冰水，只有来自台湾的蓝太，不畏严寒，谨慎行到前面的雪堆，不厌其烦地将雪花扒进瓶子里。 好了，参观过全世界独一无二的哥伦比亚大冰原，搭乘雪车抵达最寒冷冰冻阿塔巴斯卡冰河，有如进入地球北极圈，是这次洛矶山漫游的最精彩境界，令我满意。 离开万年大冰原，前往班芙国家公园，准备搭乘缆车从高峰观景，到达缆车中心，这里聚集许多游客，大部份为黄肤黑发亚裔人士，排长龙等待登上缆车，听到语言交谈，显然华人占优势，怪不得曾有学者预言，廿一世纪将是中国人的世纪，看来所言非虚，渐渐形成这种趋势。 太座畏高，想放弃坐缆车，我要费一番唇舌劝解，才没有错过这难逢的机会，每车厢只有四位乘客对面而坐，用透明玻璃门盖罩住，十分安全，登上高山，眺望整个洛矶山脉，领会慑人心魄巍峨峰峦，群山胜景，以及美丽湖泊。 乘缆车降下，旅行团最后去欣赏弓河瀑布，因当年玛莉莲梦露拍摄「大江东去」电影而扬名，如今梦露香消玉殒已久，正所谓「骨头打鼓」了，可是人们每到弓河瀑布旅游，就会提起这位著名艳星。 旅程原本包括自费泡温泉，但大多数团友不感兴趣，导游就安排在风情小镇班芙观光，品尝日式晚餐和购买明天早餐，然后入住附近的肯莫(Canmore)市，我本希望今晚能邀约卡加里老同学来此会晤，这时看看时钟已八点过半，太晚了，惟有取消原意。
63ce36e069df7bf6bd425f0d078abf3cf03f5017.translatedText: Phoenix City is like a rainbow: Roaming in the Rocky Mountains Part 6 - The Ten Thousand Years Icefield. On the morning of the fifth day, the tour bus left Golden Town, and the tour guide Lao Xie announced that it had officially entered the Rocky Mountains. There were towering mountains on both sides of the road, overlapping each other, and the peaks were connected. The tops of the mountains towered into the clouds, covered with white snow, and the rocks between the walls were firm, rugged, and majestic. I grew up in subtropical Vietnam. Half a century later, I immigrated to the United States and lived in the desert state of Arizona. I am accustomed to hot weather, warm-hearted and enthusiastic, and have rarely been in severe cold areas. The coldest time was when I traveled to the Grand Canyon during Thanksgiving a few years ago and experienced the biting cold wind. Another time I took China Airlines back to Vietnam and stopped in Alaska in the middle of the night to drop off passengers. It must have been the coldest situation, but we didn't get off the plane. We just sat in the cabin and saw the snow everywhere outside. During this trip to the Rocky Mountains, I experienced firsthand the joy of being surrounded by mountain lakes and the endurance of being attacked by the cold currents of ice and snow. The tour guide kept talking about the scenic spots visited today, which is an important part of the trip. It is like the theme of the drama "playing meat", which is the most exciting. Everyone is reminded to appreciate it carefully. First, we went to the Rockies National Park, which is not very large. Everyone got off the car and watched the famous Natural Bridge, which is where the Kicking Horse River flows. Watch the fast-flowing river violently wash away the rocks, forming holes in the bottom layer and expanding them. It looks like two connected stone bridges on top. The state is magical. The riverside area is full of green pines and beautiful scenery. It is said that when the Indians first came here, they were attracted by the wonders and couldn't help but exclaimed, "Yo! Ho!" So it was called Yoo National Park. Going further is Peyto Lake, with high terrain, deep water and bright color, like the beauty of sapphire, dazzling. At noon, the tour group finally arrived at the Columbia Icefields. Wow! It was the first time I saw ice and snow, and the first time I experienced the cold frozen world. This location is on the ridge at the junction of two national parks, Banff and Jasper. It is a primitive land covered by ice and snow for thousands of years! The tour guide first let us enter the tourist service center to solve the problem of urination and defecation and have lunch at our own expense. There is also a commodity store. To my surprise, in this almost Arctic ice field, there are Cantonese compatriots serving guests in the dining area, and the menu also includes Vietnamese beef noodles, ha! For me, who doesn’t understand English and eats little Western food, it’s very comfortable. After lunch, we boarded a bus provided by the visitor center and took us along the Icefields Parkway to a higher concentration point, where there was a huge modern icefield snowmobile to pick us up. It was not in the form of a tank chain in front of the visitor service center, but a giant special snowmobile. The special snowmobile has several deep-grained giant wheels, one and a half meters high. It adopts the low-pressure giant tire principle of the lunar landing rover, so that it can drive on slippery glaciers. However, it feels shaky while sitting in the car. There is a steep slope halfway down, which is scary! It takes about fifteen minutes to drive to the Athabasca Glacier with an altitude of 2,210 meters. After arriving at the destination, everyone got off the car, looked around the boundless white ice fields, and stepped onto the river bed of thousands of years of ice and snow. It was crystal clear. It was really a rare experience in life! It is said that tasting the sweet and cool glacier water is refreshing. The tour guide asked tourists to bring empty bottles to contain the ten thousand-year-old glacier water and share it with relatives and friends at home. However, looking around, there was condensation everywhere, and there was no drop of ice water. Only Lan Tai from Taiwan was not afraid of the severe cold. He walked cautiously to the snowdrift in front and took the trouble to scoop the snowflakes into the bottle. Well, after visiting the Columbia Icefield, which is unique in the world, and taking a snowmobile to reach the coldest and frozen Athabasca Glacier, it is like entering the Arctic Circle of the earth. This is the most exciting state of this Rocky Mountain adventure, and I am satisfied. Leaving the Ten Thousand Years Icefield, we headed to Banff National Park, preparing to take the cable car to view the scenery from the peak to the cable car center. There were many tourists gathered here, most of them were Asians with yellow skin and black hair. They lined up in a long queue to board the cable car. We heard conversations in different languages. It was obvious that the Chinese had an advantage. No wonder some scholars had predicted that the 21st century would be the century of the Chinese. It seems that what they said was true, and this trend has gradually formed. I was afraid of heights and wanted to give up taking the cable car. It took a lot of persuasion on my part to not miss this rare opportunity. Only four passengers in each carriage sat across from each other, covered by transparent glass doors. It was very safe. Climbing to the top of the mountain, overlooking the entire Rocky Mountains, and appreciating the breathtaking towering peaks, mountain scenery, and beautiful lakes. After taking the cable car down, the tour group finally went to admire the Bow River Falls. Marilyn Monroe became famous when she filmed the movie "Going Down". Now, Monroe has been dead for a long time. As the saying goes, her bones are beating, but every time people travel to Bow River Falls, they will mention this famous porn star. The trip originally included hot spring baths at their own expense, but most of the group members were not interested, so the tour guide arranged for sightseeing in the charming town of Banff, where they had a Japanese dinner and purchased breakfast for tomorrow, and then stayed in the nearby city of Canmore. I had hoped to invite old Calgary classmates to meet here tonight, but when I saw the clock, it was past half past eight, and it was too late, so I had to cancel my original intention.

5ae61273c1a5666cc739f4552e6c23889b4cd642.sourceText: 白宫宣布：习近平下月访美 （亚省时报） 白宫23日在农历大年初一宣布，中国国家副主席习近平在2月访问美国期间，定2月14日到访白宫，在情人节与欧巴马总统会谈。 中国下一代领导人的身分确定后，习近平首次访美备受瞩目。 白宫新闻办公室说，习近平是应白登副总统的邀请来访，将与白登举行会谈，还将会晤国务卿喜莱莉和其他美国高官，就两国双边关系、区域发展与全球议题交换意见 。 习近平的访美是对白登去年访问中国的回访，届时他还将访问爱阿华和加州等地。 习近平访美期间正值美国总统大选升温和失业率仍然居高，共和党参选人在选举中纷纷打出「中国牌」，表示将对中国经贸与外交政策采取强硬手段。 共和党参选人罗穆尼曾说，要在入主白宫的第一天就宣布，中国是操纵货币的国家。 习近平的来访预计将在美国政坛掀起波澜，但美国行政部门坚持美中关系稳定发展，及将中国纳入国际体系与规范的既定方向。 爱阿华州23日对习近平的到访表示兴奋，现任州长布兰斯岱(Terry E. Branstad)发表欢迎声明，期待习近平来到。 习近平1985年时任河北省正定县委书记时曾到访过爱州，留下深刻印象。 做为当年接待习近平的州长，布兰斯岱表示他去年9月访中时，曾当面力邀习近平访问爱州。 美国政界对作为胡锦涛接班人的习近平了解不深，他首次访问华府的主要目的，是让美方增加对中国未来领导人的了解，并与他建立直接沟通管道。 习近平的访美是今年中国领导人换届前的一次重要出访，依以前惯例，中美两国将就双方关切问题交换意见外，也将签署一系列经贸合作协议，其中可能是美国优势农产品 会受益。 中国16日纪念美国前总统尼克森访问中国40周年、签订上海公报和双边关系正常化，由习近平出面主持，接棒美中关系，与季辛吉相谈，强调中美关系要以「只 争朝夕」的精神推动两国和平合作，似为习近平访美定调。 但美国对中国军力透明化、经贸纠纷、网路渗透、人权议题与西藏问题仍有重大歧见。 美国驻中国大使骆家辉也说，习近平1985年在河北省任职时访问过爱阿华州，似乎给他留下了正面印象，「他对美国中西部的印象深刻，非常熟悉农业问题」 。 马英九总统在台湾大选中过半胜出，加上对台军售已于去年9月完成，习近平2月中旬访问白宫，在时间点的争议较少。 相对于美中经贸纠纷、人民币汇率、南海主权争议和亚太区域安全等议题，预料台海问题不会是美中交锋的重点。 中国对美国加强在亚太地区的军事存在和军售台湾表示不满。 中国与伊朗的经济关系密切，是伊朗的最大石油出口国，因此不满美国对伊朗核计画实施的制裁措施，中国最近拒绝了美国要求中国减少进口伊朗石油的呼吁。
5ae61273c1a5666cc739f4552e6c23889b4cd642.translatedText: The White House announced: Xi Jinping will visit the United States next month (Alberta Times) The White House announced on the 23rd on the first day of the Lunar New Year that Chinese Vice President Xi Jinping will visit the White House on February 14 during his visit to the United States in February to hold talks with President Obama on Valentine's Day. After the identity of China's next generation of leaders was confirmed, Xi Jinping's first visit to the United States attracted much attention. The White House Press Office said that Xi Jinping is visiting at the invitation of Vice President Biden and will hold talks with Biden. He will also meet with Secretary of State Hillary Clinton and other senior US officials to exchange views on bilateral relations, regional development and global issues. Xi Jinping's visit to the United States is a return visit to Biden's visit to China last year, during which he will also visit Iowa, California and other places. During Xi Jinping's visit to the United States, the U.S. presidential election was heating up and the unemployment rate remained high. Republican candidates played the "China card" in the election and stated that they would take tough measures on China's economic, trade and foreign policies. Republican candidate Romney once said that he would declare that China is a currency manipulator on the first day he takes office in the White House. Xi Jinping's visit is expected to cause waves in the U.S. political arena, but the U.S. executive branch insists on the stable development of U.S.-China relations and the established direction of integrating China into the international system and norms. Iowa expressed excitement about Xi Jinping's visit on the 23rd. Current Governor Terry E. Branstad issued a welcome statement and looked forward to Xi Jinping's arrival. Xi Jinping visited Aizhou in 1985 when he was secretary of the Zhengding County Party Committee in Hebei Province and left a deep impression on him. As the governor who received Xi Jinping that year, Brandisdale said that when he visited China in September last year, he personally invited Xi Jinping to visit Iowa. The U.S. political circles do not have a deep understanding of Xi Jinping, Hu Jintao's successor. The main purpose of his first visit to Washington is to allow the U.S. to increase its understanding of China's future leader and to establish a direct communication channel with him. Xi Jinping's visit to the United States is an important visit before the change of leadership in China this year. According to previous practice, China and the United States will not only exchange views on issues of mutual concern, but also sign a series of economic and trade cooperation agreements, among which the United States' superior agricultural products may benefit. On the 16th, China commemorated the 40th anniversary of former US President Richard Nixon's visit to China, the signing of the Shanghai Communique and the normalization of bilateral relations. Xi Jinping took over the chair and took over US-China relations. He held talks with Kissinger and emphasized that China-US relations should promote peaceful cooperation between the two countries in the spirit of "seizing the day", which seemed to set the tone for Xi Jinping's visit to the United States. However, the United States still has major differences on China's military transparency, economic and trade disputes, Internet penetration, human rights issues and the Tibet issue. U.S. Ambassador to China Gary Locke also said that Xi Jinping visited Iowa in 1985 when he was in office in Hebei Province and seemed to have left a positive impression on him. "He was deeply impressed by the Midwestern United States and was very familiar with agricultural issues." President Ma Ying-jeou won the Taiwan election with a majority, and arms sales to Taiwan were completed in September last year. Xi Jinping visited the White House in mid-February, so the timing was less controversial. Compared with issues such as U.S.-China economic and trade disputes, RMB exchange rate, South China Sea sovereignty disputes, and Asia-Pacific regional security, the Taiwan Strait issue is not expected to be the focus of the confrontation between the United States and China. China has expressed dissatisfaction with the United States' strengthening military presence in the Asia-Pacific region and arms sales to Taiwan. China, which has close economic ties with Iran and is Iran's largest oil exporter, is dissatisfied with U.S. sanctions over Iran's nuclear program and has recently rejected U.S. calls to reduce its imports of Iranian oil.

5ddbdc7571c300f1a79790f2e270abdf3dd9fa4c.sourceText: 曆法不同要分明 鳳凰城 氣如虹 公元 二 ○ 一 八 年 在全 球 倒 數 聲中降 臨 了 ， 在彩 色 繽 紛 的煙 花 發 放 中抵 達 了 。 新年新氣 象， 人 們 皆抱 持 新展 望， 定 下 新計 畫， 邁 向 新夢 想， 創 造 新境 界。 送舊迎新 ， 除 了 世 界 各國政 府 間互 相 致 賀， 以 及 向人 民 祝 福 外 ， 最大事宣 傳 的應 該 是商店、餐 飲業 和娛 樂場所， 期 望 吸 引 更多顧 客， 獲 得 營 利 豐 收。 此 外， 最 為 渲 染 的就 是 一班騷 人墨客， 喜 歡 舞 文弄墨 的作家 ， 少 不 免執筆敲鍵 ， 為新年、為節 日， 抒 發 感 懷， 吐露心聲 ， 傳 遞 上詩社網站 ， 貼在臉書頁面 ， 或投稿到報紙園 地， 紛 紛 登 載 發 表， 讓廣 大 的網民 ， 眾 多 的讀 者， 以 及 志趣相投的朋 友 ， 注 意 到新年與節 日 的來 臨， 不 會 忽 略 這些大好日子 。 在這 二 ○ 一 八 年 的前 後 兩星 期 中 ， 我閱 讀 到許 多 應節詩文 ， 自 己 也休 閒 素 描 一篇〈送舊迎新又一年〉湊 熱鬧。 我在欣 賞 這些優 秀 的詩 文 中 ， 又發 覺 有的作者行文搞錯了 ， 在這時 候 竟 然 吟詠「送雞迎狗」 ， 宣 稱 旺 旺 新年 ， 誤 導 了讀 者， 弄糊 塗 了部 分 不甚瞭 解 陰 陽 曆法的新一代 。 陰 陽 曆 法， 是新舊曆 法， 也是中外曆 法， 很多海 外 華 人 同 胞 還習 慣 叫唐曆和西曆 。 大 家 知 道， 中華民 族 有自 己 的曆 法 紀年 ， 就 是 陰 曆 的一年四季結 束， 秋收冬藏後 ， 來個隆 重 迎接新年 ， 民 間 一 直 稱 為 「過 年 」 ； 近 代 為了劃 清 與陽 曆 年的 界線， 避 免 混 淆， 常將傳 統 的農 曆 「過 年 」改稱春 節。 只不 過， 那是文 字 上的書 寫 佔 多， 民 間 家 家戶戶 還 是 嚷着「過年、過年」的 。 稱 為 春 節 的「過 年 」 ， 外 國 人慣稱中 國 年 。 中華民 國 政 府 為着與世 界 配 合 一起 ， 易 於 溝 通 日 期，從 推 翻 清 朝 之 後， 公共機 構 開 始 實 行 陽曆制 度， 也就成 為 國曆 ； 但在民 間， 仍 然重 視農 曆， 故有所 謂 「官 府 行陽曆 ， 民 間 過舊年」 。 舊年 ， 指舊 曆 年 ， 與新曆年不 同， 即是唐曆與西曆不 同， 正 確 地說是陰曆和 陽 曆有別 ， 中外曆 法 的計 算 方 式 有別 。 一個曆 法 以月亮的圓缺週期和四季分明定 為 一年 ， 另一個以地 球 環 繞 太 陽 一週為一年 。 陰曆對農 民 耕 種 很便 利， 是最佳的參 考 資 料， 通 常 稱 為 農 曆； 陽曆則每月有固 定 日 期， 方 便 於帳 目 結 算， 甚 至 把農 曆 的廿四節 氣 轉 移 到陽曆記 錄， 都有劃 一 日 期， 大 概 四年才相差一日 。 現 在 的陽 曆 是依 照 耶 穌 降生作 為 紀元 ， 因 而 有 二 ○ 一 八年的記 錄， 其 實 人 類 社 會 何止二千多年呢 ， 可 以 推 算 更年湮代遠 ， 更長 久； 不 過， 大家從信 仰 天主作起 點 ， 宗 教 神 聖， 祈 禱 虔 誠， 相 傳 下 來 就習 以為常 了 。 在中 國， 清朝時 期 曾經提 倡 過以軒 轅 黃帝為紀元 ， 經 過 考 證 計 算， 中華民 國 元 年 已 是 黃帝紀元四 六 ○ 九年 ， 比世 界 使 用 的公元超 過 二千多年 ， 可知人 類 世 界 歷 史 是多 麼 悠 久。 國 民 政 府 隨後沒有繼 續 採 用 黃帝紀元 ， 改 為 民 國 紀元 ， 炎 黃子孫 現 在 就不大清 楚 中 國 經 歷 幾多千年了 ， 只知目 前 台 灣 仍傳 承 民 國 紀元 ， 今 年 是一 ○ 七年 。 中 國 大陸則與世 界 接軌 ， 採 用 新曆 二 ○ 一 八年 。 至 於 民 間 使 用 的農 曆， 還 是 照 常 以十個天干配搭十二地支輪 流 紀 錄， 六十齊 頭 花甲子 ， 六十年一週期運 轉， 而 且 照 常 以十個天干代 表 五行 ， 甲乙屬木 ， 丙丁屬火 ， 戊己屬土 ， 庚辛屬金 ， 壬癸屬水 。 又以十二生肖來記 取 生 人 屬 相， 子鼠、丑牛、寅虎、卯兔、辰龍、巳蛇、午馬、未羊、申猴、酉雞、戌犬、亥豕 。 一 切 如故 ， 完 全 沒 有 改變 ， 所 有 命 相 學 家， 家 族 長 輩， 均以生肖為計 算 標 準， 只 要 道 出 所 屬 生肖 ， 掐指一算 ， 歲 數 多 少， 萬 無一失。 然 而， 要切 記 這是農 曆 的計 算， 即是陰 曆 、唐曆、舊 曆， 不 能 混 淆 在公元的陽 曆 裡 。 就以迎 接 這 二 ○ 一 八年元 旦 來說 ， 農 曆 還 是 丁酉年十一月十五日 ， 絕 不 能當作「送雞迎狗」 。 有朋 友 一 月 中旬家裡添 丁， 閱 讀 了部 分 作家詩文 ， 滿 腹 狐 疑， 想弄清 楚 生肖是 否 真個屬狗 ？ 我斬 釘截鐵 地說 明： 丁酉生肖屬雞 ， 等到戊 戌 新春降 臨 ， 才是旺 旺 狗 ， 還 有 一個多月哩 ！
5ddbdc7571c300f1a79790f2e270abdf3dd9fa4c.translatedText: Different calendars should be clearly understood. The Phoenix City is full of energy. The year 2018 AD arrived amidst the global countdown and the colorful fireworks. With the new year and new atmosphere, people all hold new prospects, set new plans, move towards new dreams, and create new realms. To see off the old and welcome the new, in addition to congratulations to each other and blessings to the people by governments around the world, the biggest publicity should be shops, catering industries and entertainment venues, hoping to attract more customers and obtain a bumper profit harvest. In addition, what is most exaggerated is a group of poets, writers who like to dance and write. Many of them can't help but write and type to express their feelings and express their feelings for the New Year and festivals. They are posted on the poetry society website, posted on the Facebook page, or submitted to the newspaper site, and are published one after another. Let the vast number of netizens, numerous readers, and like-minded friends notice the approach of the New Year and festivals and not ignore these great days. During the two weeks before and after 2018, I read many poems and essays corresponding to the festivals, and I also sketched an article "Farewell to the Old and Welcome to the New Year" to join in the fun. While appreciating these excellent poems and essays, I found that some authors made mistakes in their writing. At this time, they even chanted "Send the chickens and welcome the dogs" and declared a prosperous new year. This misled the readers and confused some of the new generation who did not understand the lunar calendar. The luni-yang calendar is the old and new calendars, as well as the Chinese and foreign calendars. Many overseas Chinese compatriots are still accustomed to calling them the Tang calendar and the Western calendar. As we all know, the Chinese nation has its own calendar year, which means that at the end of the lunar calendar year, after the autumn harvest and winter storage, a grand celebration is held to welcome the New Year, which has always been called the "New Year" among the people; The "New Year" was renamed the Spring Festival. It's just that most of the writing is on the text, and every household in the folk still shouts "Celebrate the New Year, celebrate the New Year". It is called the "New Year" of the Spring Festival, and foreigners commonly call it Chinese New Year. In order to cooperate with the world and make it easier to communicate dates, the government of the Republic of China began to implement the solar calendar system after the overthrow of the Qing Dynasty, which became the national calendar; but among the people, they still attached great importance to the lunar calendar, so there is a saying that "the government follows the solar calendar, and the people follow the solar calendar. Celebrate the New Year." The old year refers to the old calendar year, which is different from the new calendar year, that is, the Tang calendar is different from the Western calendar. To be precise, the lunar calendar is different from the solar calendar, and the calculation methods of the Chinese and foreign calendars are different. One calendar is based on the moon's waxing and waning cycle and the four distinct seasons, and the other is based on the earth's orbit around the sun. The lunar calendar is very convenient for farmers to farm and is the best reference material. It is usually called the lunar calendar; the solar calendar has fixed dates every month, which is convenient for settling accounts. The 24 solar terms of the lunar calendar are even transferred to the solar calendar records, and they all have the same dates, with only one day difference every four years. The current solar calendar is based on the birth of Jesus as the epoch, so there are records of 2018 years. In fact, human society is more than 2,000 years old. It can be estimated that it is older and longer; however, everyone starts from belief in God, and religion is sacred. Praying devoutly has become a common practice after being passed down from generation to generation. In China, the Qing Dynasty once advocated taking Xuanyuan Huangdi as the era. After verification and calculation, the first year of the Republic of China was already the year 4609 of the Yellow Emperor, which is more than 2,000 years older than the AD used in the world. This shows how long the history of the human world is. The Nationalist Government subsequently did not continue to adopt the Yellow Emperor Era and changed it to the Republic of China Era. The descendants of the Yan and Huang Dynasties now do not know how many thousands of years China has experienced. They only know that Taiwan still inherits the Republic of China Era, and this year is 107 years. Mainland China is in line with the world and adopts the new calendar of 2018. As for the lunar calendar used by the people, it is still recorded in turn with the ten heavenly stems matched with the twelve earthly branches, with sixty sixty-year-old sixty-year cycles, and the ten heavenly stems are still used to represent the five elements. A and B belong to wood, Bing and Ding belong to fire, Wu and Ji belong to earth, and Geng and Xin belong to metal. Rengui belongs to water. The twelve zodiac animals are also used to record the zodiac signs of people, such as rat, ox, tiger, rabbit, dragon, snake, horse, sheep, monkey, rooster, dog and pig. Everything is as before and has not changed at all. All fortune tellers and family elders use the zodiac as the calculation standard. As long as you tell the zodiac sign and count it with your fingers, you will be sure of your age. However, we must remember that this is a calculation based on the lunar calendar, that is, the lunar calendar, the Tang calendar, and the old calendar, and cannot be confused with the solar calendar of AD. As far as welcoming New Year's Day in 2018 is concerned, it is still November 15th in the year Dingyou in the lunar calendar, so it must not be regarded as "giving away chickens to welcome dogs." A friend had a baby in his family in mid-January. He read some poems by some writers and became full of doubts. He wanted to find out whether the zodiac sign was really a dog. Let me explain categorically: Dingyou’s zodiac sign is Rooster, and he will be prosperous until the Spring Festival of 1898, when he is a Dog. There is still more than a month left!

f9a2c88b883d16730475af97f76fd11049c0a61f.sourceText: (美西中国美术家协会来稿) 本月25日晚，由美西中国美术家协会组办，画家林萱在她的艺术工作室舉行了精彩的”色彩绘画”讲座，40多位的美术爱好者参加这次活动。
f9a2c88b883d16730475af97f76fd11049c0a61f.translatedText: (Contributed by the Western-American Chinese Artists Association) On the evening of the 25th of this month, organized by the Western-American Chinese Artists Association, painter Lin Xuan held a wonderful "Color Painting" lecture in her art studio. More than 40 art lovers participated in this event.

1e0c59c8467d0e78ae7befe015636dd32bf7f8c5.sourceText: 林萱1982年毕业于四川美术学院，后留任四川美院教学工作，1993年来美，先后在美国的大学雕塑设计室，以及凤凰城某知名艺术公司工作。林萱强调，爱是创造美的动力，也是美术作品的灵魂。林萱以现实中刘家昌先生的大量作品为例，赞扬刘先生对家人，自然朴实的爱，和勤劳工作的高尚品格，他和梵高，以及大师们一样的渴望表现美，和分享美。林萱通过对近200幅俄罗斯，法国，中国，美国世界风景名画和示范图分析，生动，简明的讲述了绘画构图的基本要素，构图中的几种形式，以及，静，动，曲，直，重复，反复，变化中统一等，各种表现形式。使大家对色彩?#30340;感觉和认知规律，色彩的调配方法有了新的认识。 林萱的讲座简述了，艺术创作和科学发明一样，对人们的生活起着重要作用，艺术引导，影响人们的审美和生活。 希望大家了解艺术的规律，用色彩的调配方法，帮助人们去创造自己美好的家园，漂亮的衣着和开心生活。 到工作室听讲座的不光有成人，也有学生，孩子们还一边听一边画，大家对学习绘画的热情很高，积极讨论。协会会长林峰和林萱画家不时地回答了大家长期以来在学习绘画中遇到的问题和困难。
1e0c59c8467d0e78ae7befe015636dd32bf7f8c5.translatedText: Lin Xuan graduated from Sichuan Academy of Fine Arts in 1982 and later stayed at the Sichuan Academy of Fine Arts to teach. She came to the United States in 1993 and worked successively in a university sculpture design studio in the United States and a well-known art company in Phoenix. Lin Xuan emphasized that love is the driving force for creating beauty and the soul of art works. Lin Xuan used a large number of real-life works by Mr. Liu Jiachang as examples, praising Mr. Liu's natural and simple love for his family, and his noble character of hard work. He, like Van Gogh and the masters, has the same desire to express beauty and share beauty. Lin Xuan analyzed nearly 200 world-famous landscape paintings and demonstration pictures from Russia, France, China, and the United States, and vividly and concisely described the basic elements of painting composition, several forms in composition, and various forms of expression such as stillness, movement, curve, straightness, repetition, repetition, and unity in change. This gives everyone a new understanding of the rules of color perception and cognition, as well as color mixing methods. Lin Xuan's lecture briefly stated that artistic creation, like scientific inventions, plays an important role in people's lives, and art guides and affects people's aesthetics and life. I hope everyone will understand the laws of art and use color mixing methods to help people create their own beautiful homes, beautiful clothes and happy lives. Not only adults but also students came to the studio to listen to the lecture. Children also painted while listening. Everyone was very enthusiastic about learning painting and actively discussed it. Association president Lin Feng and painter Lin Xuan answered questions and difficulties that everyone has long encountered in learning painting from time to time.

ed23a400478b311056784d5ee2afa1f658adbea4.sourceText: 玛琍珂巴郡公共卫生部于十月九日与亚历桑那州卫生部在州部会议室举行座谈会，正式组织动员全郡医生参加 ”宣誓向山谷热 乙肝 丙肝 挑战 ” 计划。 玛琍珂巴郡 公共卫生部主席华人徐凯莱医生説: 向”山谷热Vally Fever” ”乙肝Hepatitis B” 及”丙肝Hepatitis C” 宣战!MCMS执行长 Sara Presler主持了本次活动，长期做这三种疾病调查和研究的Richard Manch 医师 ，John Galgiani 医师给来宾做了这些疾病的特点，以及目前的治疗情况和高危人群的介绍。
ed23a400478b311056784d5ee2afa1f658adbea4.translatedText: The Makotoba County Public Health Department held a symposium with the Arizona State Department of Health in the state department conference room on October 9 to formally organize and mobilize doctors in the county to participate in the "Pledge to Challenge Valley Fever, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C" program. Dr. Xu Kailai, a Chinese chairman of the Majuba County Public Health Department, said: Declaring war on "Valley Fever", "Hepatitis B" and "Hepatitis C"! Sara Presler, CEO of MCMS, hosted this event. Dr. Richard Manch and Dr. John Galgiani, who have long been engaged in the investigation and research of these three diseases, introduced the characteristics of these diseases to the guests, as well as the current treatment status and high-risk groups.

ab186cb69b96319bb1987398271d488a7dd7ad99.sourceText: 对亚裔居民的健康威胁最大的三种疾病: Vally Fever, Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C 列为首要防治目标。 Vally Fever 是本地区独有的霉菌疾病，全美病例85%发生在本州，而其中50%集中在玛琍珂巴郡，这种山谷热通常与肺炎併发，若不及时疹治有致命危险性，目前病例显示在菲律宾裔及非洲裔居民社区发病率最高。 乙肝与丙肝在亚裔居民身上发病率最高，可能跟饮食与生活环境有密切关係，根据亚裔社区健康促进会的调查资料，在亚裔社区已发现略超过5000人是乙肝带病源者，而目前仅对丙肝成功研发出疫苗，可完全根治，但乙肝防治重点在推广预防及改善身边健康生活环境，让亚裔社区居民都能收到充份防治资讯及定期医疗检查服务正是郡卫生部目前最重要的工作。
ab186cb69b96319bb1987398271d488a7dd7ad99.translatedText: The three diseases that pose the greatest threat to the health of Asian residents: Vally Fever, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C are listed as the primary prevention and treatment targets. Vally Fever is a fungal disease unique to this region. 85% of the cases in the United States occur in this state, and 50% of them are concentrated in Makocoba County. This type of valley fever is usually complicated by pneumonia. If the rash is not treated in time, it can be fatal. The current cases show that the highest incidence rate is in Filipino and African-American communities. The incidence rates of hepatitis B and hepatitis C are highest among Asian residents, which may be closely related to diet and living environment. According to survey data from the Asian Community Health Promotion Association, slightly more than 5,000 people in the Asian community have been found to be carriers of hepatitis B. Currently, only hepatitis C has been successfully developed with a vaccine that can completely cure it. However, the focus of hepatitis B prevention and treatment is to promote prevention and improve the healthy living environment around them. It is the county health department's most important task at present to ensure that residents in Asian communities can receive adequate prevention and treatment information and regular medical examination services.

d730cf84f7a5ca474ed87e15c432a0770975d6cf.sourceText: 徐凯莱医生説:这是保卫我们自已的生命与健康，让全体亚裔家庭团结起耒打赢这埸 ”圣战” 。
d730cf84f7a5ca474ed87e15c432a0770975d6cf.translatedText: Dr. Xu Kailai said: This is to protect our own life and health and allow all Asian families to unite to win this "holy war."

f19486747640ce94b66b440066b84c6302605a14.sourceText: 华人医师徐凯莱创立亚裔社区促进会，积极推展亚裔社区健康福利计划与工作，多年下耒居住在玛琍珂巴郡的亚裔居民超过50%人口接受过该组织的服务并参加健康计划，每年该组织投入的服务经费均超过50万元。 今年徐凯莱医生接受玛琍珂巴郡卫生协会的甄选，出任卫生协会公共卫生部主席(Chairwoman of Maricopa County Medical Society Public Health Committee,) 同时也担任卫生协会的理事。
f19486747640ce94b66b440066b84c6302605a14.translatedText: Chinese physician Xu Kailai founded the Asian Community Promotion Association to actively promote Asian community health welfare programs and work. Over the years, more than 50% of the Asian residents living in Malikba County have received services from the organization and participated in health plans. The organization has invested more than 500,000 yuan in service funds every year. This year Dr. Xu Kailai was selected by the Maricopa County Medical Society Public Health Committee to serve as the Chairwoman of Maricopa County Medical Society Public Health Committee, and also serves as a director of the health association.

916e8c16e59004dfb1392157a46e5130583338aa.sourceText: 《亚省时报》特约记者杨立于2012年五月二十日从图森报道：图森中文学校校长雷宏即将卸任，他是在５月２０日举行的图森中文学校结业典礼上正式宣布这一消息的。
916e8c16e59004dfb1392157a46e5130583338aa.translatedText: "Alberta Times" special reporter Yang Li reported from Tucson on May 20, 2012: Lei Hong, the principal of Tucson Chinese School, is about to step down. He officially announced the news at the graduation ceremony of Tucson Chinese School on May 20.

e49393c1233724cd80401b2ef6c30ff7a5d3e4df.sourceText: 图森华人会馆特制”春风化雨”匾牌赠给雷宏校长
e49393c1233724cd80401b2ef6c30ff7a5d3e4df.translatedText: >The Tucson Chinese Association’s special plaque “Spring Breeze Turns into Rain” was presented to Principal Lei Hong

a024f735f2b87e07257e1a376ce60194279fe30b.sourceText: 表彰他对图森中文学校的贡献 （杨立摄）
a024f735f2b87e07257e1a376ce60194279fe30b.translatedText: in recognition of his contribution to Tucson Chinese School (Photo by Yang Li)

999a076c25c4bdb3c2e634624a08c716ac1f3adb.sourceText: 雷宏从2007年春季起就以副校长的身份，积极参与图森（祖筍）中文学校的校务工作，200 9 年秋季正式担任该校校长，迄今已有3年之久。在雷宏担任校长期间，他与两任副校长蔡志坤、曹佩琴及教务长陈荣基一道把图森中文学校办得有声有色，使其得到长足发展，注册人数最高时达180人。在中文繁简字传统教学项目上，雷宏领导改革了教学制度，缩短了原有的12年制，但增加了文学选修课，并把辅助学生通过AP中文考试正式纳入教学规划。这个制度同时兼顾了有些学生满足于完成基本教学内容、有些学生仍”吃不饱”的两头偏状况。除此之外，他又新增设了”’马力平’中文班”，引进全新教学法。他还进一步完善了双语班和成人班的教学制度，把教学对象从华裔子弟推广到了其他族裔。
999a076c25c4bdb3c2e634624a08c716ac1f3adb.translatedText: > Lei Hong has been actively involved in the school affairs of Tucson (Zu Sun) Chinese School as the vice principal since the spring of 2007, 2009 In the fall of 2016, he officially served as the principal of the school and has been there for three years. During Lei Hong's tenure as principal, he, together with the two vice-principals Cai Zhikun and Cao Peiqin, and the provost Chen Rongji, made the Tucson Chinese School a great success and achieved rapid development, with the highest number of registered students reaching 180. Regarding the traditional teaching project of Chinese traditional and simplified characters, Lei Hong led the reform of the teaching system, shortening the original 12-year system, but adding literature elective courses, and officially included assisting students in passing the AP Chinese exam into the teaching plan. This system takes into account both situations: some students are satisfied with completing the basic teaching content, and some students are still "not enough to eat". In addition, he added a new "Ma Liping" Chinese class and introduced a new teaching method. He also further improved the teaching system of bilingual classes and adult classes, and extended the teaching target from Chinese children to other ethnic groups.

6d1251913be55dd325b5b880b0fff344af6a3c89.sourceText: 在培训师资方面，他与中领馆、全美中文学校协会密切配合，每年选派中文学校教师回国培训，也把国侨办讲学团请进学校。为营造一个”学得开心、干得舒畅”学习、工作气氛，他还改善了中文学校对师生的奖励制度，并成功担起了学校与董事会之间的桥梁作用。作为校长，雷宏积极鼓励让学校的课外活动多样化、趣味化。学校每年举办识字比赛、作文比赛、演讲比赛、科学日和夏令营活动等,有些活动还和中国举办的相关活动紧密结合，不仅扩大了图森中文学校师生的视野，提高了中文学校的教学水平，而且也增强了图森中文学校的影响力。
6d1251913be55dd325b5b880b0fff344af6a3c89.translatedText: In terms of training teachers, he works closely with the Chinese Consulate and the National Association of Chinese Schools, selecting Chinese school teachers to return to China for training every year, and also inviting lecture groups from the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council to the school. In order to create a learning and working atmosphere of "learning happily and working comfortably", he also improved the Chinese school's reward system for teachers and students, and successfully served as a bridge between the school and the board of directors. As the principal, Lei Hong actively encourages the school’s extracurricular activities to be diversified and interesting. The school holds literacy contests, essay contests, speech contests, science days and summer camp activities every year. Some of the activities are closely integrated with related activities held in China, which not only expands the horizons of teachers and students of Tucson Chinese School, improves the teaching level of Chinese schools, but also enhances the influence of Tucson Chinese School.

e707584a8a9eb9978b32e47307db56efc0fc3dc5.sourceText: 在社区活动方面，他与图森华人文化中心紧密合作，把民族舞蹈、舞狮舞龙、抖空竹等传统项目带到图森的各种文化活动中。图森中文学校因而不仅是华裔子弟学习母语和母国文化的场所，而且还吸引了不少其他族裔的美国人来这里学中文和了解中国文化。
e707584a8a9eb9978b32e47307db56efc0fc3dc5.translatedText: In terms of community activities, he works closely with the Tucson Chinese Cultural Center to bring traditional projects such as folk dance, lion dance, dragon dance, and diabolo to various cultural activities in Tucson. Tucson Chinese School is therefore not only a place for Chinese children to learn their native language and culture of their mother country, but also attracts many Americans from other ethnic groups to come here to learn Chinese and understand Chinese culture.

615855c2e7d3d1f5bffcc4865f4ec2d93b655cb9.sourceText: 在担任图森中文学校校长的同时，雷宏还在亚利桑那大学神经生物学系全职工作。他主动请辞，一方面是他坚信”新领导、新创意、新高度”的理念，另一方面也是为了把更多的精力投入家庭，但他表示，他将会一如既往，继续为海外华教事业出力。
615855c2e7d3d1f5bffcc4865f4ec2d93b655cb9.translatedText: While serving as the principal of Tucson Chinese School, Lei Hong also works full-time in the Department of Neurobiology at the University of Arizona. He took the initiative to resign. On the one hand, he firmly believed in the concept of "new leadership, new creativity, and new heights", and on the other hand, he wanted to devote more energy to his family. However, he said that he would continue to contribute to the cause of overseas Chinese education as always.
