7390aa6afcb29bd2a6fb05cecf0db6b34ca4e525.sourceText: 本报特约记者 慧明

f4b30a68798e0f9a1f9f1746c690a03fa7a10437.sourceText: 今天是美国TUCSON封城的第一天。
f4b30a68798e0f9a1f9f1746c690a03fa7a10437.translatedText: Today is the first day of the TUCSON lockdown in the United States.

0ed693c6189ac6cd1de9cf2ab44e097df5c51be4.sourceText: 原本认为我在的这个城市是不可能封城的。这里气温干而热。冬天虽然有几天冷，但从三四月开始一直到十月底温度一直在华氏75到100度温度（摄氏18–40度）之间，极端有过115度。感冒病毒在这里很难持续藏身。 但今年不知怎么搞的，这个最适宜老人生活的城市，新冠病毒乘虚而入，让这安静祥和的城市不平静了，新冠病毒的感染率直逼纽约洛杉矶西雅图，位居美国前列。弄得本州州长和市长们手忙脚乱，像总统一样，分别渐行的封城，今天除了超市和药店开门，一切企业必须关门。
0ed693c6189ac6cd1de9cf2ab44e097df5c51be4.translatedText: I originally thought that it would be impossible to lock down the city where I live. The temperature here is dry and hot. Although there are a few cold days in winter, the temperature ranges from 75 to 100 degrees Fahrenheit (18-40 degrees Celsius) from March and April until the end of October, with extremes reaching 115 degrees. Cold viruses have a hard time hiding here. But somehow this year, in this city that is most suitable for the elderly, the new coronavirus took advantage of the situation and made this quiet and peaceful city uneasy. The infection rate of the new coronavirus is close to that of New York, Los Angeles, and Seattle, ranking among the highest in the United States. The governors and mayors of the state are in a hurry. Like the president, they are gradually closing the city. Today, except for supermarkets and pharmacies, all businesses must be closed.

e9ae5ab87881f66f69113ba516070b8c20032d2e.sourceText: 美国人有这么乖吗？我高度怀疑。
e9ae5ab87881f66f69113ba516070b8c20032d2e.translatedText: Are Americans so good? I highly doubt it.

70cba55b9b8f2b494698004ab9c6879c30510231.sourceText: 大山依旧壮观，但昔日车水马龙的马路果然不见，像似圣诞节时的马路，少见车流。原想一定有警察封锁路口，很失望，今天警察比平常还少。这造就了喜欢飙车的主，那一膀刺青的小伙，狠踩油门在40码的路上来个70、80码，吓你一跳。 停车场里也没了车，那平常认识不认识的人互相点个头问个好的礼仪也免去了。
70cba55b9b8f2b494698004ab9c6879c30510231.translatedText: The mountains are still spectacular, but the busy roads of the past are indeed gone. They look like roads at Christmas, with very little traffic. I thought there must be police blocking the intersection, but I was disappointed to find there were fewer police than usual today. This creates a guy who likes drag racing, that guy with tattoos on his arms, who will shock you by stepping on the accelerator and hitting 70 or 80 yards on the 40-yard road. There were no cars in the parking lot, and the usual etiquette of nodding and saying hello to each other between strangers was dispensed with.

3c352a549bab82f061b3958091a7d1fa36ca8f37.sourceText: 只有亚马孙的停车场，依旧熙熙攘攘。
3c352a549bab82f061b3958091a7d1fa36ca8f37.translatedText: Only the Amazon parking lot is still bustling with people.

ff59740e0b69a384c5957ca69cf5e01105062fbc.sourceText: 阳光这么明媚，白云如此浪漫，可那么喜欢晨练的美国年轻人都不在了，只有个别老年人坐着步行椅子在小路上慢行。平日所有的汽车都会为她让道，今天不用了。
ff59740e0b69a384c5957ca69cf5e01105062fbc.translatedText: The sun is so bright and the white clouds are so romantic, but the young Americans who like morning exercises are gone. There are only a few elderly people sitting on walking chairs and walking slowly on the path. Normally all cars would give way to her, but not today.

291adbffca29038b4a874292bb38a30b491462b4.sourceText: 大家都知道，今天本州确诊病毒患者1413，这怎么都不像这个冬日天堂的图桑市！这病毒真像个隐形幽灵，无形无色，来去无踪，猛地打你一下，你竟然不知道缘由。
291adbffca29038b4a874292bb38a30b491462b4.translatedText: As we all know, there are 1,413 confirmed virus patients in the state today. This is nothing like the winter paradise of Tucson! This virus is really like an invisible ghost, invisible and colorless, coming and going without a trace. It hits you hard and you don't even know why.

d0884976eafe00552346245b647edbd15692ae64.sourceText: 公司里到处是这样的张贴，像巫师们贴的咒语，仿佛贴得越多病毒就会越害怕似的。但上班族倒是真害怕了，哪个可怜人还憋出了“防毒防疫防同事”的名言，每次见人就像老杜的“老翁逾墙走”的场景。
d0884976eafe00552346245b647edbd15692ae64.translatedText: There are posts like this everywhere in the company, like spells posted by wizards, as if the more posts they post, the more scared the virus will be. But the office workers were really scared. The poor man even suppressed his famous saying of "preventing viruses, preventing epidemics, and preventing colleagues." Every time he saw someone, it was like Lao Du's "old man walking over the wall" scene.

fcc8e21d9221e0ca2dd498573c2e6fdf8161dcf5.sourceText: 但是即便这样口罩还是不能戴的，哪怕你的手洗得像鸡脚爪一样。因为一戴口罩你就等于自首了是病毒携带者。特别今天无症状携带者说法在网上流行，戴口罩还是不能被民众接受的，除非你心特别大，不在乎别人的斜视。 这也和美国崇尚个人英雄主义有关，每个人都认为自己有几块腱子肉就能对付病毒似的。可是今天已经有4000多人失去生命，远远超过珍珠港袭击和911攻击牺牲的人数。真是希望不要等到悲剧发生再感叹生命脆弱！戴上口罩吧。 听到一段五岁孩子打电话救爸爸的录音，很是感慨。感觉现在家长教育孩子的任务更重了。 回家赶快模拟生病场景，躺地屏气做无呼吸状，希望我那小狗能大声呼叫。许久没声响，偷眼一看，它正模仿我，摊在了地毯上……真是任重而道远。
fcc8e21d9221e0ca2dd498573c2e6fdf8161dcf5.translatedText: But even so, you still cannot wear a mask, even if your hands are washed like chicken feet. Because once you wear a mask, you are surrendering yourself as a virus carrier. Especially today, the theory of asymptomatic carriers is popular on the Internet. Wearing a mask is still not acceptable to the public, unless you are very big-hearted and don't care about other people's squints. This is also related to the United States' advocating individual heroism. Everyone thinks that they can deal with the virus with a few tendons. But today, more than 4,000 people have lost their lives, far more than the number of people who died in the Pearl Harbor attack and the 9/11 attacks. I really hope we don’t wait until a tragedy happens before lamenting the fragility of life! Wear a mask. I was very moved when I heard a recording of a five-year-old child calling to save his father. It feels like parents now have a heavier task in educating their children. I quickly simulated being sick when I got home, lying on the ground holding my breath as if I was not breathing, hoping that my puppy would scream loudly. There was no sound for a long time, and when I took a peek, I saw that it was imitating me and spread out on the carpet... It was really a long way to go.

4224f790c85cc1ce09a8372e415113d5e89cf30f.sourceText: 一、近年来，对华人歧视和偏见的事件时有发生。 2012年2月17日，ESPN在报导华裔球星林书豪新闻时，用”Chink in the Armor”双关语作标题，其中”Chink”是带有种族岐视的用词。 不少华人认为ESPN已不是第一次犯这种错误，要求彻查并开除这种自以为幽默的编辑。 ” Chink”一词产生于19世纪末排华反华时期，是反亚太裔暴力的行为的代表词汇。 ” Chink(中国佬)”一词对美国华人是种族歧视和伤害，正如揘字?即Nigger)对黑人的种族歧视一样。 ” Chink”字发音别扭，故意引人联想到清朝时扎长辫拉黄包车的华奴，用意十分恶劣。 在一片遣责声中，ESPN就此事表示再次道歉，并对此事负责头条新闻的有关雇员解雇；对有关主持人作停职30天的处理；并宣布电台评论员不再是ESPN雇员。 由于ESPN保证不会再次出现类似情况，事态才没有扩展到一发不可收拾的地步。 2008年，在美国高尔夫球大师赛上，哥伦比亚广播公司的广播员鲍比卡莱普特也同样用”中国佬”来形容中国选手梁文冲，在遣责声中，鲍比.卡莱普特 亲自作出了道歉。 2007年，亚利桑那州土桑市有间”春卷中餐”店主，在其广告传单上赫然印着：”每一份订餐都是由第一代中国移民用人力车来送达的….(Chinamen) 现在越来越贵了。”Chinaman”这称呼起源于150多年前的美国加州，当年第一批华人横渡太平洋，到美国淘金。他们生活窘迫，饱受白人歧视，被蔑称为”Chinaman”。这 种广告涉嫌侮辱华人，引起了众怒，在当地亚裔社团的强烈抗议下，中餐馆业主以广告只是为了幽默为由拒不道歉，掀起了一场种族歧视的风波。随即有六个代表少数族裔 的组织指责这些字眼侮辱华人，并起诉其老板迈克诺兹。经过近半年的抗议后，雷诺兹在广告传单上删除了所有侮辱华人的词句；广告公司也停止发送一切含有种族歧视的 传单，并对今后该店的广告内容严加审查。 在2004年，曾任太阳队总经理、90年代公牛核心球员斯蒂夫科尔在接受《亚洲周刊》采访时也用过”中国佬”来形容姚明。 同样，在一片遣责声浪中，斯蒂夫科尔也亲自作出道歉。 历史上，种族歧视对亚省华人亦同样伤害。 美国1882年通过的《排华法案》，以及日后不断迭加的排华恶法，禁止华人入境及剥夺公民权，甚至不准华人与其他族裔通婚，离开美国后不准再次入境，致使华人长 达六十一年不得移民美国，而在美国的华人也受到种族歧视和伤害。 据著名华人作家董鼎山记述，美国的排华高峰在19世纪后期，当时加州有报纸就把华人形容为：”半人半魔，吃老鼠，衣着破烂，不懂法律，吸鸦片，廉价劳工，吮吸 内脏的亚洲人”。 亚利桑那州立大学(ASU)的历史学教授布拉德福洛金汉，在其撰写的《斐匿：一个西南部都市的历史》的一书中也提到，一八九零年六月的 《亚利桑那共和报》曾经评述，”诡计多端的黄种人应该被限制在尽可能小的地区内。”而在土桑，华人日落前必须离开城镇，否则会被关进监狱至天明才重 获自由。 在斐匿市中心，曾经有过两次较为兴旺的”唐人街”，第一次在19世纪末，当年的”唐人街”，座落在第一街至第三街之间，南北则以麦地森与 捷弗森为界，是今日、更是当年鳯凰城的中心区及繁华地带。 在一八九零年初，本城华埠人数已逾二百。 至一八九二年，澎湃的反华运动起于民间，舆论界予以附会。 由于被迫害，华埠可能于此时被迫解体，第二次华埠的兴起在廿世纪的卅年代初叶。 查得本埠在1920年代有记载华人餐馆已有23间，而”唐人货仓”(华人开的杂货店)在1927年时为22间，到1931年猛增加46间，共计近80间，大多 分布在市中心及附近地带，而中文学校也于此时兴办。 后来华埠被讥为是纳污藏诟之区，故为警方时常搜查的对象，并殃及住户。 不堪其扰的华人纷纷迁出华埠。 华埠可能于此时作第二次解体。 中国和美国1943年成为二战的同盟国后，美国废除了1882年通过的《排华法案》，但直到”1965年移民和国籍法案”出台后，才被实质取消。 到2011年10月6日，美国国会参院通过了决议，为130前年不公正「排华法案」而道歉。 但种族岐视的残余现象，直到今年ESP的对林书豪的新闻报导时仍有发生。
4224f790c85cc1ce09a8372e415113d5e89cf30f.translatedText: 1. In recent years, incidents of discrimination and prejudice against Chinese people have occurred frequently. On February 17, 2012, when ESPN reported news about Chinese-American star Jeremy Lin, it used the pun "Chink in the Armor" as its title, in which "Chink" is a racially discriminatory term. Many Chinese believe that this is not the first time ESPN has made such a mistake, and demand a thorough investigation and dismissal of such an editor who thinks he is humorous. The word "Chink" originated from the anti-Chinese anti-Chinese period in the late 19th century and is a representative term for anti-Asian and Pacific Islander violence. The word "Chink" is racist and harmful to Chinese Americans, just like the word "Nigger" is racist to black people. The pronunciation of the word "Chink" is awkward, and it is deliberately reminiscent of the Chinese slaves who wore long braids and pulled rickshaws in the Qing Dynasty. The intention is very bad. Amid the outcry, ESPN apologized again for the incident, fired the employee responsible for the headlines, suspended the host for 30 days, and announced that the radio commentator was no longer an ESPN employee. Because ESPN ensured that a similar situation would not happen again, the situation did not get out of hand. In 2008, at the US Golf Masters, CBS broadcaster Bobby Calleput also used the term "Chinaman" to describe Chinese player Liang Wenchong. Amid the rebuke, Bobby Calleput personally apologized. In 2007, the owner of a "Spring Roll Chinese Food" shop in Tucson, Arizona, printed on its advertising flyer: "Each order is delivered by a first-generation Chinese immigrant using a rickshaw... (Chinamen) are getting more and more expensive now." The term "Chinaman" originated in California more than 150 years ago, when the first batch of Chinese crossed the Pacific to pan for gold in the United States. They lived in poverty, suffered from white discrimination, and were scornfully called "Chinamen." This This advertisement was suspected of insulting the Chinese people, which caused public outrage. After strong protests from the local Asian community, the Chinese restaurant owner refused to apologize on the grounds that the advertisement was only for humor, setting off a storm of racial discrimination. Subsequently, six organizations representing ethnic minorities accused the words of insulting the Chinese people and sued its owner Mike Notz. After nearly six months of protest, Reynolds deleted all insulting words from the advertising flyers; the advertising company also stopped sending all racially discriminatory flyers and strictly reviewed the content of the store's advertising in the future. In 2004, Steve Kerr, the former general manager of the Suns and a core player of the Bulls in the 1990s, also used the term "Chinaman" to describe Yao Ming in an interview with Asia Weekly. Similarly, amid the outcry, Steve Kerr also personally apologized. Historically, racial discrimination has also hurt the Chinese in Alberta. The "Chinese Exclusion Act" passed by the United States in 1882, as well as the subsequent vicious anti-Chinese laws, prohibited Chinese from entering and deprived them of their citizenship rights. Chinese were not even allowed to marry other ethnic groups, and were not allowed to re-enter after leaving the United States. As a result, Chinese were not allowed to immigrate to the United States for 61 years, and Chinese in the United States were also subject to racial discrimination and harm. According to the famous Chinese writer Dong Dingshan, the peak of Chinese anti-Chinese in the United States was in the late 19th century. At that time, a newspaper in California described the Chinese as: "half-man, half-demon, rat-eating, shabby-dressed, ignorant of the law, opium-smoking, cheap labor, offal-sucking Asians." Bradford Rockingham, a history professor at Arizona State University (ASU), also mentioned in his book "Phenomenon: A History of a Southwest City" that in June 1890. The Arizona Republic once commented, “The scheming yellow race should be confined to the smallest possible area. "In Tucson, the Chinese had to leave the town before sunset, otherwise they would be imprisoned until dawn before they were freed. In downtown Phoenix, there were two relatively prosperous "Chinatowns". The first time was at the end of the 19th century. The "Chinatown" was located between First Street and Third Street, with Madison and Jefferson as the boundary to the north and south. It was the central and prosperous area of Phoenix today and back then. In the early 1890s, the population of Chinatown in this city exceeded 200. By 1892, a surging anti-China movement began among the people, and the public opinion community joined in. Due to the persecution, Chinatown was probably forced to disintegrate at this time, and the second Chinatown emerged in the early 1930s. It was found that there were 23 Chinese restaurants recorded in the city in the 1920s, and the number of "Tangren Warehouses" (grocery stores owned by Chinese) was 22 in 1927. By 1931, there was a sharp increase of 46, for a total of nearly 80, most of which were located in the city center and nearby areas. Chinese schools were also established at this time. Later, Chinatown was ridiculed as an area harboring corruption, so it was often targeted by the police, and the residents were moved out of Chinatown. Chinatown may have been disintegrated for the second time. After China and the United States became allies in World War II in 1943, the United States repealed the Chinese Exclusion Act passed in 1882, but it was not effectively canceled until the Immigration and Nationality Act of 1965. By October 6, 2011, the U.S. Senate passed a resolution apologizing for the unfair "Chinese Exclusion Act" 130 years ago. But the remnants of racial discrimination still occurred when ESPN reported on Jeremy Lin this year.

00a256c1525700b9229d49ebce81b49707f259e9.sourceText: 二、华人对种族岐视坚持抗争。 1895年，加省一群本土出生的华裔籍民，成立同源会，目的是争取宪法上应得的权利，消除种族歧视，并在1904年立案改为同源总会。 全国性的同源会创会百多年来，争取国会修改1924年的移民法案，即限制华裔籍民的配偶及子女来美条例，且最终得罗斯福总统签字，以非配额移民美国。 这一法案使到妇女来美与丈夫团聚者为数最多。 而他们子女，很多日后成为华裔社会里的中坚分子。 另一项成果是在1943年，促请美国国会废止排华法案。 还有1952年，极力抨击美国驻香港领事馆调查手段，及对陪审的检举纯为歧视华人的行动。 同源会又于1980年发起全侨签名活动，反对积彩法院对华裔陈果仁被谋杀案的不公平判决，以及2OOO年要求美国法庭对华裔太空科学家李文和间谍案判决的平反，并反对法院 的歧视行为。 1957年，由于美国移民局搜查冒籍假纸事，遂燃起了全美华人反歧视的怒火，当时全美各埠华人代表集议于美京，为争取平等权利，成立《全美华人福利总会》 。 ” 斐匿福利分会”是也随之响应成立，并织极配合总会工作。 根据资料，当年的福利总会是华人向联邦政府注册的唯一社团。 福利总会的工作重点是团结其他侨团，共同向政府要求改善移民条例，通过合法手段去争取华人权益，对危害华人的条例促请废除。 为争取移民名额，增加难民入境，福利总会几经艰苦，卒获国会公平立法，由中国原有每年移民限额一百零五名，修改放宽为每年二万名，使中国移民来美之门大开 ，从而促进了日后华人社区的兴盛。
00a256c1525700b9229d49ebce81b49707f259e9.translatedText: 2. The Chinese continue to fight against racial discrimination. In 1895, a group of native-born Chinese nationals in Canada established the Homology Association with the purpose of fighting for their constitutional rights and eliminating racial discrimination. In 1904, the organization was established and renamed the Homology Association. The national One Origin Association has been around for more than 100 years, fighting for Congress to amend the 1924 Immigration Act, which restricts the immigration of spouses and children of Chinese citizens to the United States. It was eventually signed by President Roosevelt to allow non-quota immigration to the United States. This act enabled the largest number of women to come to the United States to reunite with their husbands. And many of their children will become backbone members of the Chinese society. Another achievement was in 1943, urging the U.S. Congress to repeal the Chinese Exclusion Act. Also in 1952, he strongly criticized the investigation methods of the U.S. Consulate in Hong Kong and the prosecution of jurors as purely discriminatory actions against the Chinese. In 1980, the Homology Association launched a nationwide signature campaign to oppose the unfair judgment of the Lottery Court in the murder case of Chinese-American Chen Guoren. In 2000, it requested the U.S. court to vindicate the judgment of the Chinese-American space scientist Li Wenhe in the espionage case, and opposed the discriminatory behavior of the court. In 1957, due to the U.S. Immigration Service's search for fake citizenship papers, the anti-discrimination anger of Chinese Americans in the United States was aroused. At that time, Chinese representatives from all over the United States gathered in the United States and Beijing to fight for equal rights and established the "National Chinese Welfare Federation." The "Feinian Welfare Branch" was established in response and organized to cooperate with the work of the General Association. According to information, the Welfare Federation was the only Chinese association registered with the federal government. The focus of the Welfare Federation is to unite other overseas Chinese groups to jointly request the government to improve immigration regulations, fight for the rights and interests of the Chinese through legal means, and urge the abolition of regulations that harm the Chinese. In order to obtain immigration quota and increase refugee admissions, the Welfare Federation went through many hardships and finally obtained fair legislation from Congress. China's original annual immigration quota was revised and relaxed from 105 to 20,000 per year. This opened the door for Chinese immigrants to come to the United States, thus promoting the prosperity of the Chinese community in the future.

e462ce1476c7dfd9d4c07e2ca859c993a76e3554.sourceText: 亚省时报记者邓凌摄影报导：
e462ce1476c7dfd9d4c07e2ca859c993a76e3554.translatedText: Photo report by Alberta Times reporter Deng Ling:

a8d0b034bb39d8d4ebf75b461a52ae1d5146e556.sourceText: 每年一度的亚省中餐馆协会春宴联欢活动，于二月十九日晚10时三十分在新世界酒楼举行，会员及各界人士共多人济济一堂，热闹非常 。 由新世界酒楼精心制作的精美、丰盛的晚餐令宾客赞不绝口，宴会上载歌载舞，先后有西藏舞和功夫表演，古雅瑜、黄欣明等的独唱，气功师冯俊杰与陈志钢表演的?#38024;穿 玻璃?#20196;宾客打开眼界，连声喝彩。 丰富礼物的抽奖可谓人人有份，皆大欢喜。 头奖、二奖分别是42吋和32吋的超薄型电视机，由餐馆会会员获得。 今年获得奖学金的优秀学生分别是：毕瀚澎、黄颖思、司徒欣华、曾祥沥。 餐馆会的会员都是从事餐馆业的，所以每次餐馆会的春宴活动都是晚上10点半以后才开始，对于遵循正常生活作式的本人来说，要这么晚去参加宴会确实挺有 心理压力，不过当我融入晚会的欢乐气氛中，与大家一起欢笑喝彩的时候，我感觉困意全消。 晚会结束时已经将近凌晨两点了，大家开心地抱着大包小包的获奖礼物，愉快地踏上归家之路。
a8d0b034bb39d8d4ebf75b461a52ae1d5146e556.translatedText: The annual Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association Spring Banquet was held at 10:30 pm on February 19th at the New World Restaurant. Many members and people from all walks of life gathered together, and it was very lively. The exquisite and sumptuous dinner carefully prepared by New World Restaurant wowed the guests. The banquet was full of singing and dancing, including Tibetan dance and kung fu performances, solos by Gu Yayu, Huang Xinming, etc., and "Through the Glass" performed by qigong masters Feng Junjie and Chen Zhigang. The guests opened their eyes and cheered continuously. It can be said that everyone has a part in the lottery with rich gifts and everyone is happy. The first and second prizes are 42-inch and 32-inch ultra-thin TVs respectively, which are won by restaurant club members. The outstanding students who received scholarships this year are: Bi Hanpeng, Huang Yingsi, Situ Xinhua, and Zeng Xiangli. The members of the Restaurant Association are all engaged in the restaurant industry, so each Spring Banquet of the Restaurant Association does not start until after 10:30 pm. For me who follow a normal life style, it is really psychologically stressful to attend the banquet so late. However, when I blended into the joyful atmosphere of the party and laughed and cheered with everyone, I felt that all my sleepiness disappeared. It was almost two o'clock in the morning when the party ended. Everyone happily carried large and small packages of winning gifts and happily embarked on the road home.

cc54b83d7f73d8e7108c8f2a409429415adb469d.sourceText: 华为中兴驳斥美国会报告“毫无根据” (图)
cc54b83d7f73d8e7108c8f2a409429415adb469d.translatedText: Huawei and ZTE refute the US Congress report as "baseless" (Photo)

d9b4c04c81528e52f07d8a8a48b4aa42674dc949.translatedText: Huawei and ZTE refute the US Congress report as "baseless" (Photo) The House Intelligence Committee issued a report on Monday (October 8) saying that Chinese communications company Huawei...

aab3a936144a984681ccaf9b0aec8672aeb5ed01.sourceText: 众议院情报委员会星期一（10月8日）发表报告说中国通讯企业华为和中兴对美国的国家安全构成威胁，华为和中兴星期一相继发表声明，反驳了报告对这两家企业所作的指责，形容报告与事实完全不符，纯属空穴来风，毫无根据。
aab3a936144a984681ccaf9b0aec8672aeb5ed01.translatedText: The House Intelligence Committee issued a report on Monday (October 8) saying that Chinese communications companies Huawei and ZTE pose a threat to the national security of the United States. Huawei and ZTE issued statements one after another on Monday, refuting the report's accusations against the two companies, describing the report as completely inconsistent with the facts, purely groundless and baseless.

8fcb4bd1c1b2a9914d7d60694eb775454682de36.sourceText: 华为高级副总裁丁少华9月13日到美国国会作证，否认了该公司在电信设备中设置间谍代码，并坚称其在进军美国市场的过程中不会给美国安全造成威胁。（网络图）
8fcb4bd1c1b2a9914d7d60694eb775454682de36.translatedText: Huawei Senior Vice President Ding Shaohua testified before the U.S. Congress on September 13, denying that the company set spy codes in telecommunications equipment and insisting that it would not pose a threat to U.S. security in its entry into the U.S. market. (Network map)

948e5e9a2795aa13a12aed10500227c4a866b4cb.sourceText: 据《纽约时报》报道，众议院情报委员会的报告称，该委员会从华为前雇员得到内部文件，显示它为解放军的”网络战”提供服务。该报告是共和党众议员、情报委员会主席罗杰斯发表的。
948e5e9a2795aa13a12aed10500227c4a866b4cb.translatedText: According to the New York Times, the House Intelligence Committee reported that the committee obtained internal documents from former employees of Huawei, showing that it provides services for the People's Liberation Army's "cyber warfare." The report was issued by Republican Representative Rodgers, chairman of the Intelligence Committee.

d34c9a7313de4b392a264f2d6a32f6c77e7fd129.sourceText: 《纽约时报》称，报告突出显示美中两国试图建立商业关系时要经过的敏感领域。这些努力也成大选投票几周之前的政治对话要点，两名候选人都说美中关系重要，也都承诺要在人民币汇率和贸易问题对中国采取强硬立场。
d34c9a7313de4b392a264f2d6a32f6c77e7fd129.translatedText: The New York Times stated that the report highlighted the sensitive areas that the United States and China have to go through when trying to establish commercial relations. These efforts have also become a key point in political dialogue in the weeks leading up to the general election. Both candidates have said that the U.S.-China relationship is important and have pledged to take a tough stance against China on the yuan exchange rate and trade issues.

7bcfef115bceff4bb0859b0e6e79cb25f2e97095.sourceText: 英国广播公司（BBC）说，这两家中国公司已经成为国际市场的重要竞争者，一直希望消除美国国会议员的怀疑，从而扩大在美国的业务。
7bcfef115bceff4bb0859b0e6e79cb25f2e97095.translatedText: The British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC) said that the two Chinese companies have become important competitors in the international market and have been hoping to eliminate the suspicions of U.S. lawmakers and expand their business in the United States.

ff69293093753722f9707ed0a1f7192c8ce117df.sourceText: 但是，美国众议院情报委员会在经过11个月的调查之后作出了有关威胁其国家安全的结论，并建议美国公司不要与这两家公司有商业往来。。
ff69293093753722f9707ed0a1f7192c8ce117df.translatedText: However, after an 11-month investigation, the U.S. House of Representatives Intelligence Committee concluded that it threatened its national security and recommended that U.S. companies not do business with these two companies. .

8be8400058d29a57c54985815ec24e2e3df7bbfa.sourceText: 华为表示，报告充满传闻，且未能提供明确的信息证明委员会的担忧是合理的，目的是阻挠中国公司进入美国市场、阻碍竞争。
8be8400058d29a57c54985815ec24e2e3df7bbfa.translatedText: Huawei said that the report was full of rumors and failed to provide clear information to prove that the committee's concerns were reasonable. The purpose was to prevent Chinese companies from entering the US market and hinder competition.

408ade796a3cc931aa81d79e0876f9b1e2e573c0.sourceText: 中兴通讯则表示，该企业不会对美国市场造成任何安全威胁，并且表示美国相关机构和人员的当务之急是”扩大视野审视整个电信产业供应链”。
408ade796a3cc931aa81d79e0876f9b1e2e573c0.translatedText: ZTE stated that the company will not pose any security threat to the US market, and stated that the top priority for relevant US agencies and personnel is to "expand their horizons and examine the entire telecommunications industry supply chain."

c1ce126e58ce48d1c77fa1e0246e175d23a368ea.sourceText: 华为是仅列瑞典爱立信之后的全球第二大路由器、开关和其他电讯设备生产商，中兴名列第五。
c1ce126e58ce48d1c77fa1e0246e175d23a368ea.translatedText: Huawei is the world's second largest manufacturer of routers, switches and other telecommunications equipment after Sweden's Ericsson, and ZTE ranks fifth.

16d2e51e5f5aafe0797a84455403ac9f9b8368f4.sourceText: 分析人士指出，美国众议院情报委员会的最新报告会阻碍华为和中兴在美国的业务发展，并且可能导致中美两国之间关系的进一步紧张。
16d2e51e5f5aafe0797a84455403ac9f9b8368f4.translatedText: Analysts pointed out that the latest report of the U.S. House of Representatives Intelligence Committee will hinder the business development of Huawei and ZTE in the United States and may lead to further tensions between China and the United States.

c8885cd2d9d82b38cdaefe12aa397e49aa0e5b35.sourceText: 美国众议院情报委员会主席罗杰斯在发布报告时说，情报委员会并没有敦促美国抵制华为和中兴生产的手机和其他手持装置，有关警告仅限于大规模处理数据的设备。
c8885cd2d9d82b38cdaefe12aa397e49aa0e5b35.translatedText: U.S. House of Representatives Intelligence Committee Chairman Rogers said when releasing the report that the Intelligence Committee did not urge the United States to boycott mobile phones and other handheld devices produced by Huawei and ZTE, and the relevant warning was limited to equipment that processes data on a large scale.

c9884d0e4adc8b1c7a5f33681bfcdbff720dedbb.sourceText: 分析人士指出，众议院情报委员会在美国总统竞选进入白热化之际发表这份报告，将促使奥巴马和罗姆尼以此为依据，竞相展开针对中国的攻击，以赢取美国选民的支持。
c9884d0e4adc8b1c7a5f33681bfcdbff720dedbb.translatedText: Analysts pointed out that the release of this report by the House Intelligence Committee at a time when the U.S. presidential election is intensifying will prompt Obama and Romney to use this as a basis to launch attacks on China to win the support of American voters.

b64f870be39f4aef4bb41a5a026e38df46670556.sourceText: 此前的报道说，：中国两大电讯公司华为和中兴星期一（10月8日）驳斥美国国会即将发表的报告，说它们的产品在美国可以安全使用。
b64f870be39f4aef4bb41a5a026e38df46670556.translatedText: Previous reports said: China's two major telecommunications companies Huawei and ZTE refuted an upcoming report by the US Congress on Monday (October 8), saying that their products are safe to use in the United States.

b696cfee1d58576da267830a1f6dc28a929e3188.sourceText: 据有线电视新闻网财经频道（CNNMoney）报道，众议院情报委员会最近准备发表的报告焦点放在华为和中兴的生意模式上，这两家中国公司都希望扩大在美国的业务。
b696cfee1d58576da267830a1f6dc28a929e3188.translatedText: According to CNNMoney, the House Intelligence Committee’s recent report to be released focuses on the business models of Huawei and ZTE. Both Chinese companies hope to expand their business in the United States.

f350b27c9c2716e7183813dc7c9ab78c9d4128a4.sourceText: 该委员会的正式报告还没有发表，但草稿星期一开始流传。报告声称，”华为和中兴为美国关键基础设施提供的设备带有风险，可能破坏美国国家安全的核心利益。”报告对于华为尤其关键，因为情报委员会的报告声称华为对有关安全问题提供了躲避性、不回应和不完成的回答。
f350b27c9c2716e7183813dc7c9ab78c9d4128a4.translatedText: The committee's formal report has not yet been published, but a draft began circulating Monday. The report claims that "the equipment provided by Huawei and ZTE for U.S. critical infrastructure carries risks that may undermine core interests of U.S. national security." The report is particularly critical for Huawei because the Intelligence Committee's report claimed that Huawei provided evasive, non-responsive and incomplete answers to relevant security questions.

90c07a0ae99acc3730b2bc893ed0ad37eaf2f6f4.sourceText: CNNMoeny说，华为和中兴都属于全世界最大的电讯公司，提供路由器和其它互联网设备。两大公司都试图扩大在西方的市场，但遭到以安全担心为由的抵制。
90c07a0ae99acc3730b2bc893ed0ad37eaf2f6f4.translatedText: CNNMoeny said that both Huawei and ZTE are among the world's largest telecommunications companies, providing routers and other Internet equipment. Both companies have tried to expand their markets in the West, but have faced resistance citing security concerns.

8a33090b473f18e5637dbf9704dd1b8bbd83286d.sourceText: 华为星期一称美方报告的那些说法”没有根据”。公司发言人普鲁莫（William Plummer）发表声明说，任何声称华为产品对于网络攻击特别容易脆弱的说法都是无视技术和商业现实、都是鲁莽地威胁美国就业和创新，不会对保护国家安全有任何好处，都是危险地在在政治上消遣合法的公私合作项目，应当受到揭露。
8a33090b473f18e5637dbf9704dd1b8bbd83286d.translatedText: Huawei on Monday called the claims in the US report "unfounded." Company spokesman William Plummer issued a statement saying that any claim that Huawei products are particularly vulnerable to cyberattacks ignores technical and commercial realities, recklessly threatens American jobs and innovation, does nothing to protect national security, and is a dangerous political diversion of legitimate public-private projects that should be exposed.

3488fecbc253c6ab5fc2f17e08b7ebd84124b6f5.sourceText: 中兴公司在声明中说，该公司的产品安全，它为中国公司同国会调查进行合作提供了前所未有的标准。
3488fecbc253c6ab5fc2f17e08b7ebd84124b6f5.translatedText: ZTE said in a statement that the company's products are safe and it provides unprecedented standards for Chinese companies to cooperate with congressional investigations.

91518ead02a22578808a5334651234485aa0cba9.sourceText: 中兴公司还对国会那一情报委员会提供最终通讯副本，说深刻不同意有关它是中国政府控制企业的任何说法。
91518ead02a22578808a5334651234485aa0cba9.translatedText: ZTE also provided a copy of its final communication to the congressional intelligence committee, saying it deeply disagrees with any suggestion that it is a Chinese government-controlled enterprise.

3e9493b2ba9a9816f75aa731635b16628bcaaa39.sourceText: 两家公司都说，一旦他们研究报告之后，将进一步发表评论。
3e9493b2ba9a9816f75aa731635b16628bcaaa39.translatedText: Both companies said they would comment further once they have reviewed the report.

af010558c2bb04986a5fc86d31fd49a055aca949.sourceText: 对于华为来说，北美市场一直是其最为关键但久攻不下的市场。特别是在全球电信设备市场整体疲软的大环境之下，北美市场对于华为而言显得尤为重要。
af010558c2bb04986a5fc86d31fd49a055aca949.translatedText: For Huawei, the North American market has always been its most critical market but has been unable to conquer it for a long time. Especially in the overall weak environment of the global telecommunications equipment market, the North American market is particularly important to Huawei.

89de77a905a8a6b69e92e907cc8421ce9b2fc119.sourceText: 2012年上半年，受全球经济低迷、电信设备市场增长发力等因素的影响，包括华为在内的全球五大电信设备商的业绩均出现不同程度的下滑。虽然华为未在半年报中公布其在电信运营商市场的具体业绩，但去年的年报数据显示，华为在这一市场的增长仅为3%。
89de77a905a8a6b69e92e907cc8421ce9b2fc119.translatedText: In the first half of 2012, affected by the global economic downturn, the growth of the telecommunications equipment market and other factors, the performance of the world's five largest telecommunications equipment manufacturers, including Huawei, declined to varying degrees. Although Huawei did not announce its specific performance in the telecom operator market in its semi-annual report, last year's annual report data showed that Huawei's growth in this market was only 3%.

c2fd49986243a73f48d4566678e0704e3519919d.sourceText: 在这种情况下，进入北美市场，就成为华为在电信设备市场增长快慢的关键一步。但是，华为未能进入北美市场的主要原因，不是产品质量或者竞标价格，而是一些非商业因素棗美国一些政客一直认为华为有”军方背景”，而在这一所谓的背景之下，如果让华为在美国市场部署网络，将”威胁美国国家安全”。
c2fd49986243a73f48d4566678e0704e3519919d.translatedText: Under this circumstance, entering the North American market has become a key step for Huawei's growth in the telecommunications equipment market. However, the main reason why Huawei has failed to enter the North American market is not product quality or bidding price, but some non-commercial factors. Some U.S. politicians have always believed that Huawei has a "military background." And under this so-called background, if Huawei is allowed to deploy networks in the U.S. market, it will "threaten U.S. national security."

ffbab3f1b7e50e33e3014c5bc8861ed401e12863.sourceText: 正因受到美国政府的压力，华为此前一直希望通过竞标和并购等方式进入北美市场，但始终未能如愿。2008年，华为与贝恩资本联合竞购3COM公司，却因美国政府阻挠未能成行；2011年，华为被迫接受美国外国投资委员会的建议，撤销收购3Leaf公司特殊资产的申请；同样是在2011年，美国商务部阻止华为参与国家应急网络项目招标。
ffbab3f1b7e50e33e3014c5bc8861ed401e12863.translatedText: Due to pressure from the US government, Huawei has been hoping to enter the North American market through bidding and mergers and acquisitions, but has never been able to do so. In 2008, Huawei and Bain Capital jointly bid for 3COM, but failed due to obstruction by the U.S. government. In 2011, Huawei was forced to accept the recommendation of the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States and withdraw its application to acquire 3Leaf's special assets. Also in 2011, the U.S. Department of Commerce blocked Huawei from participating in the national emergency network project bidding.

1603d15dca5efa7ff5dc996247f47d9bf9b6340b.sourceText: ”在华为全球战略布局中，唯一的困难就是北美市场。”华为总裁任正非此前的这番言语不仅道出了北美市场对于华为的重要性，也流露出华为进入这一市场的艰难。
1603d15dca5efa7ff5dc996247f47d9bf9b6340b.translatedText: "In Huawei's global strategic layout, the only difficulty is the North American market." Huawei President Ren Zhengfei's previous remarks not only revealed the importance of the North American market to Huawei, but also revealed the difficulty for Huawei to enter this market.

2c72d4bbc76867c21e91ae6e7208a702c8251ffa.sourceText: 在2012年下半年美国众议院情报委员会针对华为、中兴”可能威胁美国网络基础设施安全”一事举行的听证会上，华为高级副总裁丁少华否认了该公司在电信设备中设置间谍代码，并坚称其在进军美国市场的过程中不会给美国安全造成威胁。
2c72d4bbc76867c21e91ae6e7208a702c8251ffa.translatedText: At a hearing held by the U.S. House of Representatives Intelligence Committee in the second half of 2012 on the issue of Huawei and ZTE "possibly threatening the security of U.S. network infrastructure," Huawei Senior Vice President Ding Shaohua denied that the company had set spy codes in telecommunications equipment and insisted that it would not pose a threat to U.S. security in its entry into the U.S. market.

a1edf3ba4996199fee8eb3210904c5cde39d1e97.sourceText: 华为类似的表态已经做过多次，其中还包括愿意公开源代码接受美国政府审查等。不过，在这些努力之后，华为却始终未能获得北美市场的”通行证”。
a1edf3ba4996199fee8eb3210904c5cde39d1e97.translatedText: Huawei has made similar statements many times, including its willingness to disclose its source code to be reviewed by the US government. However, despite these efforts, Huawei has never been able to obtain a "pass" for the North American market.

8341679fdf7ff43aad42da982545cf7b5e5f995d.sourceText: 美国认定华为中兴或危害其国家
8341679fdf7ff43aad42da982545cf7b5e5f995d.translatedText: The United States determines that Huawei and ZTE may endanger its country

b50eaae2a5b603114c1c6c8365eb08aa6432ec5d.sourceText: 据环球时报提前发出的报道说，美国众议院情报委员会将在当地时间8日发布针对两家中国通信企业华为和中兴”可能对美国带来安全威胁”的调查结果。不过，结果已没有悬念。在美国CBS电视台7日播出的节目中，该委员会主席迈克?#32599;杰斯已为华为扣上帽子：”如果我是一家美国公司厖当人们正瞅着华为的生意时，如果真的关心自己的知识产权、关心顾客的隐私、关心美利坚合众国的国家安全，我会选择另外一家供货商。”
b50eaae2a5b603114c1c6c8365eb08aa6432ec5d.translatedText: According to an advance report from the Global Times, the U.S. House of Representatives Intelligence Committee will release the results of an investigation into two Chinese communications companies, Huawei and ZTE, that "may pose a security threat to the United States" on the 8th local time. However, the result is no longer in doubt. In a program broadcast on CBS on the 7th, Mike Jess, chairman of the committee, has labeled Huawei: "If I were an American company and people were looking at Huawei's business, if I really cared about my intellectual property rights, the privacy of my customers, and the national security of the United States of America, I would choose another supplier."

925deda51f76e6ea8e3a462c88f7c9618de7266d.sourceText: 该委员会对这两家中国企业的产品”涉嫌为中国间谍活动提供便利”的调查耗时近一年，9月中旬，华为和中兴的高管分别被要求在美众院听证会上提供证词。据路透社报道，美国CBS电视台的”60分钟”节目7日晚将播出对该委员会主席、前FBI特工迈克?#32599;杰斯的访谈，讨论”中国企业在美国电信市场竞争的危险”。该节目组5日发布的预告片显示，该委员会认为”华为对美国安全构成威胁”。预告片没有说明该委员会如何看待中兴。美国众议员洛普斯博格称：”我们开展这一调查的主要目的是教育美国企业界和通信领域人士。”
925deda51f76e6ea8e3a462c88f7c9618de7266d.translatedText: The committee’s investigation into the two Chinese companies’ products “suspected of facilitating Chinese espionage activities” took nearly a year. In mid-September, executives from Huawei and ZTE were asked to provide testimony at hearings in the U.S. House of Representatives. According to Reuters, the US CBS TV station's "60 Minutes" program will air an interview with committee chairman and former FBI agent Mike Jess on the evening of the 7th to discuss "the dangers of Chinese companies competing in the US telecommunications market." The trailer released by the program group on the 5th shows that the committee believes that "Huawei poses a threat to U.S. security." The trailer doesn't say what the committee thinks of ZTE. U.S. Representative Lopsberg said: "The main purpose of our investigation is to educate people in the American business community and communications field."

a4d0a0d0c5959f9bcf5ab8ed07559b156763daf1.sourceText: ”中国企业准备迎击美国国会报告的间谍指责”，美国”国会山”网站6日以此为题发文称，罗杰斯说，8日发表的报告将解释”为什么我们有这样的担忧”。对此，华为美国公司发言人布拉默对该网站称，”有一种假设称华为有个阴谋，为服从一国政府的命令，在自己的产品中植入某种设备──真的吗?这个阴谋需要成百上千人完成。”他称，华为是个在中国成立的公司，但展开国际业务，正如许多西方公司一样。将华为驱逐出美国”完全是政治因素”，意味着”更少的工作岗位，更少的外商投资，更少的创新和竞争，更高的宽带价格，更紧张的贸易争端”。布拉默称，华为产品的安全性在全世界都获得了证明，}”这是今天、也是以后的事实，但面对涉及政治议程的指控时除外”。
a4d0a0d0c5959f9bcf5ab8ed07559b156763daf1.translatedText: "Chinese companies are preparing to confront the espionage accusations in the U.S. Congressional report." The U.S. "Capitol Hill" website published an article with this title on the 6th. Rogers said that the report released on the 8th will explain "why we have such concerns." In this regard, Huawei US spokesman Bramer told the website, "There is a hypothesis that Huawei has a conspiracy to embed certain equipment in its products in order to obey the orders of a country's government - is it true? Hundreds of people are required to complete this conspiracy." He said that Huawei is a company established in China, but it conducts international business, just like many Western companies. Expelling Huawei from the United States is "entirely political" and means "fewer jobs, less foreign investment, less innovation and competition, higher broadband prices, and more tense trade disputes." Bramer said that the safety of Huawei's products has been proven around the world. "This is a fact today and in the future, except when facing accusations involving political agendas."

53697e3aed4aae7b3a6c5127f2470df29deb1ef4.sourceText: ”为打消疑虑，华为考虑美国上市”，《华尔街日报》5日的这一消息备受关注。报道称，过去一年多，华为高管和董事会成员对是否进行公开募股展开辩论，结论认为，公开募股有助于让华为的运营变得透明，”更像一家西方公司”。对此，布拉默表示，华为不会对”市场传言”进行评论，但”如果确实有这样的事情发生，这纯粹出于商业目的”。
53697e3aed4aae7b3a6c5127f2470df29deb1ef4.translatedText: "To dispel doubts, Huawei is considering listing in the United States." This news from the Wall Street Journal on the 5th attracted much attention. According to the report, Huawei executives and board members have debated whether to conduct a public offering for more than a year, concluding that a public offering would help make Huawei's operations transparent and "more like a Western company." In this regard, Bramer said that Huawei will not comment on "market rumors", but "if such a thing does happen, it is purely for commercial purposes."

d0abdd1ae36e55450df8ffba7e3ccdfbf372014c.sourceText: 枪击后吉佛兹首度公开露面
d0abdd1ae36e55450df8ffba7e3ccdfbf372014c.translatedText: Giffords made his first public appearance after the shooting

eeaa9cfac6493a51e5cf9b51db6c4386f23787cd.sourceText: 枪击后吉佛兹首度公开露面 众议员吉佛兹自今年1月在不幸头部遭枪击以来，首度公开露面。 美国广播公司新闻…
eeaa9cfac6493a51e5cf9b51db6c4386f23787cd.translatedText: Giffords made his first public appearance after the shooting. Congressman Giffords made his first public appearance since he was tragically shot in the head in January this year. ABC News…

6d69e55da252d0f960c0eef3bca219e8a5a7c205.sourceText: 枪击后吉佛兹首度公开露面 众议员吉佛兹自今年1月在不幸头部遭枪击以来，首度公开露面。 美国广播公司新闻网（ABC News）报导，吉佛兹夫婿航天员凯利在休士顿约翰逊太空中心附近，数百人参加的仪式中领奖之际，吉佛兹面带微笑坐着轮椅现身，并起身亲吻丈夫。 报导表示，她头发较之前公布的照片短很多，带着眼镜、米黄色围巾、穿浅色衬衫、牛仔裤及球鞋。 在航天飞机”奋进号”组员接受表扬之际，她看来神采奕奕和坐在旁边的人谈笑风生。凯利负责指挥奋进号任务。 在航天飞机组员观赏家庭电影之际，她提早离开。这些组员驾驶航天飞机安返地球而获颁太空飞行勋章。 早前，凯利宣布完成”奋进号”太空任务后退休，与妻子一起渡过艰难的康复期，并将二人的浪漫史写成书纪念。
6d69e55da252d0f960c0eef3bca219e8a5a7c205.translatedText: Giffords makes first public appearance since shooting Congressman Giffords made his first public appearance since he was tragically shot in the head in January this year. ABC News reported that when Giffords' husband, astronaut Kelly, received the award at a ceremony attended by hundreds of people near the Johnson Space Center in Houston, Giffords appeared in a wheelchair with a smile and stood up to kiss her husband. The report stated that her hair was much shorter than in previously released photos, and she was wearing glasses, a beige scarf, a light-colored shirt, jeans and sneakers. As the crew members of the space shuttle Endeavor were being commended, she looked in high spirits and was chatting and laughing with the people sitting next to her. Kelly is in charge of the Endeavor mission. She left early while the shuttle crew watched home movies. These crew members piloted the space shuttle safely back to Earth and were awarded the Space Flight Medal. Earlier, Kelly announced his retirement after completing the Endeavor space mission. He and his wife spent a difficult recovery period together and wrote a book to commemorate their romance.

e50d3d609c72bdf09d230110761651e00310fef5.sourceText: 端午节到了 去哪买好吃的粽子
e50d3d609c72bdf09d230110761651e00310fef5.translatedText: The Dragon Boat Festival is here. Where can I buy delicious rice dumplings?

a4647cf12637c7ebda817ee367a2bfa40e588ac9.sourceText: 端午节到了 去哪买好吃的粽子 端午节到了，到凤凰城什么地方找好吃的粽子呢？朋友推荐新世界大酒楼的肉粽，还有…
a4647cf12637c7ebda817ee367a2bfa40e588ac9.translatedText: The Dragon Boat Festival is here. Where can I buy delicious rice dumplings? The Dragon Boat Festival is here. Where can I find delicious rice dumplings in Phoenix? A friend recommended the meat rice dumplings at New World Restaurant, and...

8487c0a664ea07ff77daf22f9f03a064049098d6.sourceText: 端午节到了，到凤凰城什么地方找好吃的粽子呢？朋友推荐新世界大酒楼的肉粽，还有什么地方有特色的粽子，欢迎大家跟帖，交流！端午节都有哪些习俗呢，趁着节日赶紧来温故知新。
8487c0a664ea07ff77daf22f9f03a064049098d6.translatedText: The Dragon Boat Festival is here, where can I find delicious rice dumplings in Phoenix? A friend recommended the meat rice dumplings from New World Restaurant and other places with special rice dumplings. Welcome everyone to comment and exchange! What are the customs of the Dragon Boat Festival? Take advantage of the festival to review the past and learn the new.

a334aa31d1fac84fdc00396ffa814884cb5e55f6.sourceText: 中国民间过端午节是较为隆重的，庆祝的活动也是各种各样，比较普遍的活动有以下种种形式： 赛龙舟：
a334aa31d1fac84fdc00396ffa814884cb5e55f6.translatedText: The Chinese folk celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival very grandly, and there are various celebration activities. The more common activities include the following forms: Dragon boat racing:

1e0f225acb7fb1fae56beb82573895646ce7b746.sourceText: 賽龙舟，是端午节的主要习俗。相传起源于古时楚国人因舍不得贤臣屈原投江死去，许多人划船追赶拯救。他们争先恐后，追至洞庭湖时不见踪迹。之后每年五月五日划龙舟以纪念之。借划龙舟驱散江中之鱼，以免鱼吃掉屈原的身体。竞渡之习，盛行于吴、越、楚。
1e0f225acb7fb1fae56beb82573895646ce7b746.translatedText: Dragon boat racing is the main custom of the Dragon Boat Festival. According to legend, it originated from the ancient Chu people who were reluctant to leave their virtuous minister Qu Yuan and threw himself into the river. Many people rowed boats to chase and save him. They scrambled to catch up and disappeared when they reached Dongting Lake. After that, dragon boat racing was held every May 5th to commemorate the event. He rowed dragon boats to disperse the fish in the river to prevent them from eating Qu Yuan's body. The custom of racing was popular in Wu, Yue and Chu.

aea93e17327b02019c43cb5557ce18c35617c88a.sourceText: 其实 ，”龙舟竞渡”早在战国时代就有了。在急鼓声中划刻成龙形的独木舟，做竞渡游戏，以娱神与乐人，是祭仪中半宗教性、半娱乐性的节目。
aea93e17327b02019c43cb5557ce18c35617c88a.translatedText: In fact, "dragon boat racing" has been around since the Warring States Period. Carving a canoe into the shape of a dragon amidst the sound of drums and playing a boat racing game to entertain gods and people is a semi-religious and semi-entertaining program in the ritual.

81bae579d2fa07b6ec67b665071e535fc8b36df1.sourceText: 后来，赛龙舟除纪念屈原之外，在各地人们还付予了不同的寓意。
81bae579d2fa07b6ec67b665071e535fc8b36df1.translatedText: Later, in addition to commemorating Qu Yuan, people in various places also attached different meanings to the dragon boat race.

3738fc9ab3d6a9ad6c5ea2bda7ae67dfbd67bdd3.sourceText: 江浙地区划龙舟，兼有纪念当地出生的近代女民主革命家秋瑾的意义。夜龙船上，张灯结彩，来往穿梭，水上水下，情景动人，别具情趣。贵州苗族人民在农历五月二十五至二十八举行”龙船节”，以庆祝插秧胜利和预祝五谷丰登。云南傣族同胞则在泼水节赛龙舟，纪念古代英雄岩红窝。不同民族、不同地区，划龙舟的传说有所不同。直到今天在南方的不少临江河湖海的地区，每年端节都要举行富有自己特色的龙舟竞赛活动。
3738fc9ab3d6a9ad6c5ea2bda7ae67dfbd67bdd3.translatedText: Dragon boat racing in Jiangsu and Zhejiang regions also has the significance of commemorating Qiu Jin, a modern female democratic revolutionary born there. On the night dragon boat, lights are decorated, and people shuttle back and forth. The scenes on the water and under the water are moving and unique. The Miao people of Guizhou hold the "Dragon Boat Festival" from the 25th to the 28th of the fifth lunar month to celebrate the success of rice transplanting and wish for a good harvest. Compatriots of the Dai ethnic group in Yunnan compete in dragon boats during the Water Splashing Festival to commemorate the ancient hero Yan Hongwo. Different ethnic groups and different regions have different legends about dragon boat racing. To this day, in many areas in the south near rivers, lakes and seas, dragon boat races with their own characteristics are held every year during the Dragon Boat Festival.

977dbea1db9da653b094963c50c133b7eb2c0de4.sourceText: 清乾隆二十九年（1736年），台湾开始举行龙舟竞渡。当时台湾知府蒋元君曾在台南市法华寺半月池主持友谊赛。现在台湾每年五月五日都举行龙舟竞赛。在香港，也举行竞渡。
977dbea1db9da653b094963c50c133b7eb2c0de4.translatedText: In the 29th year of Qianlong’s reign in the Qing Dynasty (1736), dragon boat racing began in Taiwan. At that time, the prefect of Taiwan, Chiang Yuan-jun, hosted a friendly match at the Half-Moon Pool of Fahua Temple in Tainan City. Taiwan now holds a dragon boat race every May 5th. In Hong Kong, ferry races are also held.

528c37caabe93b2d6bfb0e0921819c6df3c7d02a.sourceText: 此外，划龙舟也先后传入邻国日本、越南等及英国。1980年，赛龙舟被列入中国国家体育比赛项目，并每年举行”屈原杯”龙舟赛。1991年6月16日（农历五月初五），在屈原的第二故乡中国湖南岳阳市，举行首届国际龙舟节。在竞渡前，举行了既保存传统仪式又注入新的现代因素的”龙头祭”。 ”龙头”被抬入屈子祠内，由运动员给龙头”上红”（披红带）后，主祭人宣读祭文，并为龙头”开光”（即点晴）。然后，参加祭龙的全体人员三鞠躬，龙头即被抬去汩罗江，奔向龙舟赛场。此次参加比赛、交易会和联欢活动的多达60余万人，可谓盛况空前。尔后，湖南便定期举办国际龙舟节。赛龙舟将盛传于世。
528c37caabe93b2d6bfb0e0921819c6df3c7d02a.translatedText: In addition, dragon boat racing has also been introduced to neighboring countries such as Japan, Vietnam and the United Kingdom. In 1980, dragon boat racing was included in China's national sports competitions, and the "Qu Yuan Cup" dragon boat race is held every year. On June 16, 1991 (the fifth day of the fifth lunar month), the first International Dragon Boat Festival was held in Yueyang City, Hunan Province, China, Qu Yuan's second hometown. Before the race, a "Dragon Head Sacrifice" was held that not only preserved the traditional ceremony but also injected new modern elements. The "dragon head" was carried into Quzi Temple, and after the athletes "painted red" (wearing a red belt) on the dragon head, the officiant read the sacrificial text and "consecrated" (i.e. lit the light) the dragon head. Then, everyone participating in the dragon ceremony bowed three times, and the dragon's head was carried to the Miluo River and rushed to the dragon boat racing venue. More than 600,000 people participated in the competitions, trade fairs and gala events this time, which was an unprecedented event. Since then, Hunan has held the International Dragon Boat Festival regularly. Dragon boat racing will be popular all over the world.

e75791e4ed1153b5c7ae34522e258e32472220e8.translatedText: Eating rice dumplings during the Dragon Boat Festival

fc8c52ac29c58d99a9a1fd6847c63a08fc03d1df.sourceText: 端午节吃粽子，这是中国人民的又一传统习俗。粽子，又叫”角黍”、”筒粽”。其由来已久，花样繁多。
fc8c52ac29c58d99a9a1fd6847c63a08fc03d1df.translatedText: Eating rice dumplings during the Dragon Boat Festival is another traditional custom of the Chinese people. Zongzi is also called "corner millet" and "tube rice dumpling". It has a long history and has many variations.

732904c0066f2a9c97bffa5e3e7968df08797b57.sourceText: 据记载，早在春秋时期，用菰叶（茭白叶）包黍米成牛角状，称”角黍”；用竹筒装米密封烤熟，称”筒粽”。东汉末年，以草木灰水浸泡黍米，因水中含碱，用菰叶包黍米成四角形，煮熟，成为广东碱水粽。
732904c0066f2a9c97bffa5e3e7968df08797b57.translatedText: According to records, as early as the Spring and Autumn Period, rice was wrapped in wild rice leaves (wild rice leaves) into the shape of horns, which was called "horn millet"; rice was packed in bamboo tubes, sealed and roasted, called "tube rice dumplings". At the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, millet was soaked in plant ash water. Because the water contained alkali, the millet was wrapped in wild rice leaves into a square shape and cooked to become Guangdong alkaline rice dumplings.

eee6566831d9fa9b6feb1f4b60c324c92012987a.sourceText: 晋代，粽子被正式定为端午节食品。这时，包粽子的原料除糯米外，还添加中药益智仁，煮熟的粽子称”益智粽”。 时人周处《岳阳风土记》记载：”俗以菰叶裹黍米，……煮之，合烂熟，于五月五日至夏至啖之，一名粽，一名黍。”南北朝时期，出现杂粽。米中掺杂禽兽肉、板栗、红枣、赤豆等，品种增多。粽子还用作交往的礼品。
eee6566831d9fa9b6feb1f4b60c324c92012987a.translatedText: In the Jin Dynasty, rice dumplings were officially designated as the Dragon Boat Festival food. At this time, in addition to glutinous rice, the raw materials for making rice dumplings were also added with the traditional Chinese medicine Yizhiren. The cooked rice dumplings were called "Yizhizong". Zhou Chu's "Yueyang Fengtu Ji" records: "It is customary to wrap millet in wild rice leaves,...boil it, combine it thoroughly, and eat it from May 5th to the summer solstice. It is called rice dumplings and millet." During the Southern and Northern Dynasties, hybrid rice dumplings appeared. Rice is adulterated with animal meat, chestnuts, red dates, adzuki beans, etc., and the varieties are increasing. Zongzi is also used as a gift for social interactions.

0abb02570b6a1388029ea2d8241e8401f0aefc05.sourceText: 到了唐代，粽子的用米，已”白莹如玉”，其形状出现锥形、菱形。日本文献中就记载有”大唐粽子”。宋朝时，已有”蜜饯粽”，即果品入粽。诗人苏东坡有”时于粽里见杨梅”的诗句。这时还出现用粽子堆成楼台亭阁、木车牛马作的广告，说明宋代吃粽子已很时尚。元、明时期，粽子的包裹料已从菰叶变革为箬叶，后来又出现用芦苇叶包的粽子，附加料已出现豆沙、猪肉、松子仁、枣子、胡桃等等，品种更加丰富多彩。
0abb02570b6a1388029ea2d8241e8401f0aefc05.translatedText: By the Tang Dynasty, the rice used for rice dumplings had become "as white as jade", and its shape appeared conical and diamond-shaped. "Datang Zongzi" is recorded in Japanese literature. In the Song Dynasty, there was "preserved rice dumplings", that is, rice dumplings with fruits. The poet Su Dongpo once wrote a poem: "Sometimes I see Yangmei in rice dumplings." At this time, there were also advertisements using rice dumplings to build pavilions and pavilions, wooden carts and horses, indicating that eating rice dumplings had become very fashionable in the Song Dynasty. During the Yuan and Ming Dynasties, the wrapping material of Zongzi changed from wild rice leaves to Ruo leaves. Later, Zongzi wrapped in reed leaves appeared. The additional ingredients include bean paste, pork, pine nuts, dates, walnuts, etc., and the varieties became more colorful.

996db1fc8d65b4a07b1aa2cab0e96bfc89edae7b.sourceText: 一直到今天，每年五月初，中国百姓家家都要浸糯米、洗粽叶、包粽子，其花色品种更为繁多。从馅料看，北方多包小枣的北京枣粽；南方则有豆沙、鲜肉、火腿、蛋黄等多种馅料，其中以浙江嘉兴粽子为代表。吃粽子的风俗，千百年来，在中国盛行不衰，而且流传到朝鲜、日本及东南亚诸国。
996db1fc8d65b4a07b1aa2cab0e96bfc89edae7b.translatedText: To this day, every year in early May, every Chinese family soaks glutinous rice, washes rice dumpling leaves, and makes rice dumplings, with more varieties of colors. In terms of fillings, in the north there are many Beijing date rice dumplings stuffed with jujubes; in the south there are various fillings such as bean paste, fresh meat, ham, egg yolks, etc., among which Jiaxing rice dumplings in Zhejiang are the representative ones. The custom of eating rice dumplings has been popular in China for thousands of years and has spread to North Korea, Japan and other Southeast Asian countries.

6c2130a2f2a0aee31f2d72adf8c87bf932d180e9.sourceText: 端午节小孩佩香囊，传说有避邪驱瘟之意，实际是用于襟头点缀装饰。香囊内有朱砂、雄黄、香药，外包以丝布，清香四溢，再以五色丝线弦扣成索，作各种不同形状，结成一串，形形色色，玲珑可爱。
6c2130a2f2a0aee31f2d72adf8c87bf932d180e9.translatedText: Children wear sachets during the Dragon Boat Festival. Legend has it that they are meant to ward off evil spirits and dispel plague. They are actually used to decorate their lapels. The sachet contains cinnabar, realgar and fragrant medicine, and is wrapped with silk cloth, which overflows with fragrance. Five-color silk strings are then tied into ropes and made into various shapes to form a string. They are colorful, exquisite and cute.

98cfb296fa9a09a3b7ae3d4b64f3b79a30774643.sourceText: 民谚说：”清明插柳，端午插艾”。在端午节，人们把插艾和菖蒲作为重要内容之一。家家都洒扫庭除，以菖蒲、艾条插于门眉，悬于堂中。并用菖蒲、艾叶、榴花、蒜头、龙船花，制成人形或虎形，称为艾人、艾虎；制成花环、佩饰，美丽芬芳，妇人争相佩戴，用以驱瘴。
98cfb296fa9a09a3b7ae3d4b64f3b79a30774643.translatedText: Folk proverb says: "Put willows during the Qingming Festival and moxa at the Dragon Boat Festival." During the Dragon Boat Festival, people regard planting mugwort and calamus as one of the important contents. Every family sweeps the courtyard, inserts calamus and moxa sticks in the eyebrows of the door, and hangs them in the hall. They also use calamus, mugwort leaves, pomegranate flowers, garlic and dragon boat flowers to make human or tiger shapes, which are called mugwort people and mugwort tigers. They are also made into garlands and ornaments, which are beautiful and fragrant. Women rush to wear them to drive away miasma.

252127ebd019fade053bc30fca1e589486dcc1ab.sourceText: 艾，又名家艾、艾蒿。它的茎、叶都含有挥发性芳香油。它所产生的奇特芳香，可驱蚊蝇、虫蚁，净化空气。中医学上以艾入药，有理气血、暖子宫、祛寒湿的功能。将艾叶加工成”艾绒”，是灸法治病的重要药材。
252127ebd019fade053bc30fca1e589486dcc1ab.translatedText: >Ai, also known as mugwort and mugwort. Its stems and leaves contain volatile aromatic oils. The peculiar aroma it produces can repel mosquitoes, flies, insects and ants, and purify the air. In traditional Chinese medicine, moxa moxa is used as medicine to regulate qi and blood, warm the uterus, and remove cold and dampness. The moxa leaves are processed into "moxa velvet", which is an important medicinal material for moxibustion treatment.

9d0d93aebbfb9f04555f8da7f58b792a57dee8d0.sourceText: 菖蒲是多年生水生草本植物，它狭长的叶片也含有挥发性芳香油，是提神通窍、健骨消滞、杀虫灭菌的药物。
9d0d93aebbfb9f04555f8da7f58b792a57dee8d0.translatedText: >Calamus is a perennial aquatic herb. Its long and narrow leaves also contain volatile aromatic oil, which is a medicine that can refresh the mind, strengthen bones, eliminate stagnation, and kill insects and bacteria.

6efc9b0944b29a11e6b6bbe036fbc454f8938109.sourceText: 可见，古人插艾和菖蒲是有一定防病作用的。端午节也是自古相传的”卫生节”，人们在这一天洒扫庭院，挂艾枝，悬菖蒲，洒雄黄水，饮雄黄酒，激浊除腐，杀菌防病。这些活动也反映了中华民族的优良传统。端午节上山采药，则是我国各国个民族共同的习俗。
6efc9b0944b29a11e6b6bbe036fbc454f8938109.translatedText: It can be seen that the ancients inserted mugwort and calamus to prevent diseases to a certain extent. The Dragon Boat Festival is also a "health festival" passed down from ancient times. On this day, people sweep the courtyard, hang mugwort branches and calamus, sprinkle realgar water, and drink realgar wine to stimulate turbidity, remove decay, and kill bacteria and prevent diseases. These activities also reflect the fine traditions of the Chinese nation. Going to the mountains to collect herbs during the Dragon Boat Festival is a common custom among all ethnic groups in my country.

27dfe1a263051cd011a1255a9d549bbbc158e9c8.sourceText: 新学期、新希望，凤凰城中文学校要开学了!
27dfe1a263051cd011a1255a9d549bbbc158e9c8.translatedText: New semester, new hope, Phoenix Chinese School is about to start!

ee4b19f6a895aab0f68d87779fccea883ba811ff.sourceText: 新学期、新希望，凤凰城中文学校要开学了! (凤凰城中文学校 来稿) 在炎炎的暑假即将结束，新的学期紧接著就要…
ee4b19f6a895aab0f68d87779fccea883ba811ff.translatedText: New semester, new hope, Phoenix Chinese School is about to start! (Contributed by Phoenix Chinese School) The hot summer vacation is coming to an end, and the new semester is about to begin...

7792300e8f0177ea95f50a86f53b855f69a55716.sourceText: (凤凰城中文学校 来稿) 在炎炎的暑假即将结束，新的学期紧接著就要开始，凤凰城中文学校邀请你加入我们的团队。本校秋季班将於八月十二日註册开学，上课地点在美莎社区大学 (Mesa Community College)，上课时间为每周日下午1:30 -3:30。 凤凰城中文学校不仅為学生开设由学前班一直晋阶到十一年级，并开办有初/高级会话班；欢迎社会大眾，有兴趣学中文的人士加入。课后从3:30 – 4:30并安排有中国结、篮球、绘画、排舞、吉他等课外活动。 如果您想多认识凤凰城中文学校，或是想加入这个大家庭，请与校长程秀玲联络(480-620-1982) 或参观学校网页( http://www.clsphoenix.org/ )。
7792300e8f0177ea95f50a86f53b855f69a55716.translatedText: (Contributed by Phoenix Chinese School) The hot summer vacation is coming to an end and the new semester is about to begin. Phoenix Chinese School invites you to join our team. Registration for the fall classes of our school will begin on August 12th. Classes will be held at Mesa Community College. Classes will be held every Sunday from 1:30 to 3:30 pm. Phoenix Chinese School not only offers students from pre-kindergarten to eleventh grade, but also offers beginner/advanced conversation classes; the public is welcome and anyone interested in learning Chinese is welcome to join. After class, extracurricular activities such as Chinese knotting, basketball, painting, line dancing, and guitar are arranged from 3:30 – 4:30. If you want to know more about Phoenix Chinese School or want to join this big family, please contact the principal Cheng Xiuling (480-620-1982) or visit the school website (http://www.clsphoenix.org/).

e3e4f29c4df2d44011c471e4fb467862c6117665.sourceText: 枪击案嫌犯身份：科罗拉多大学神经学博士生(图)
e3e4f29c4df2d44011c471e4fb467862c6117665.translatedText: The identity of the shooting suspect: a doctoral student in neurology at the University of Colorado (picture)

3f2087a28a38494d9d348ae7d793687e7f18a291.sourceText: 枪击案嫌犯身份：科罗拉多大学神经学博士生(图) 枪击案嫌疑人詹…
3f2087a28a38494d9d348ae7d793687e7f18a291.translatedText: The identity of the shooting suspect: a doctoral student in neurology at the University of Colorado (picture) The shooting suspect James...

5d25b30caf850b5e6b0b2123e548697d152a0b3b.sourceText: 枪击案嫌疑人詹姆斯-霍尔姆斯(James-Holmes)

98bed8a899c4245f6dcb3c531f93493049384bfa.sourceText: 丹佛警方在枪击案发生后迅速逮捕了该案嫌犯。这名枪手在被逮捕时没有做任何抵抗，经过调查，嫌犯是一名白人男性，名为詹姆斯 霍姆斯，1987年12月生，身高1.8米左右。他在袭击时身着黑衣，穿着防弹背心，头戴护目镜或防毒面具。
98bed8a899c4245f6dcb3c531f93493049384bfa.translatedText: Denver police quickly arrested the suspect in the case after the shooting. The gunman did not offer any resistance when he was arrested. After investigation, the suspect was a white male named James Holmes, born in December 1987, about 1.8 meters tall. He was dressed in black, wearing a bulletproof vest and goggles or a gas mask at the time of the attack.

584131f227d3cc1a81bd07a2439f64eb8dfc3a5f.sourceText: 消息称，霍姆斯是本地人，他曾在科罗拉多州丹佛医学院学习神经科学，将获得博士学位，但在上个月前退学。霍姆斯以前没有任何犯罪记录，他也没有合法的持枪证，因此警方找到的4把枪支棗突击步枪、雷明顿猎枪、两把手枪棗来源成疑。有报道认为，嫌犯在作案前做了较为充分的准备，装备较先进。但嫌犯的作案动机仍不明确。
584131f227d3cc1a81bd07a2439f64eb8dfc3a5f.translatedText: Sources say that Holmes is a local who studied neuroscience at Denver Medical College in Colorado and will receive a Ph.D., but dropped out last month. Holmes had no previous criminal record, and he did not have a legal gun license. Therefore, the origin of the four firearms found by the police - an assault rifle, a Remington shotgun, and two pistols - was questionable. Some reports believe that the suspect made relatively complete preparations and had relatively advanced equipment before committing the crime. But the suspect's motive remains unclear.

f781b1acb23390223486e8ad75bba71913fa451f.sourceText: 在被捕后，霍姆斯声称他在住宅布置了爆炸装置。警方随后疏散该住所周边的人群，通过消防天梯破窗而入发现数枚设计极其精密复杂的炸弹。警方表示，可能要耗费数小时甚至数天才能完成拆弹工作。
f781b1acb23390223486e8ad75bba71913fa451f.translatedText: After his arrest, Holmes claimed he planted an explosive device at the residence. The police subsequently evacuated the crowd around the residence and broke in through the fire escape ladder and discovered several bombs with extremely sophisticated designs. Police said it could take hours or even days to defuse the bomb.

090b9451aa280f8df2bf589df3faf2abc3fa465f.sourceText: 目前，美国联邦调查局正与当地警方合作，对这一事件进行调查。警方认为，此次袭击行动是袭击者个人所为。美国白宫发言人杰伊卡尼则称，政府认为此次枪击案与恐怖主义无关。
090b9451aa280f8df2bf589df3faf2abc3fa465f.translatedText: Currently, the FBI is cooperating with the local police to investigate this incident. The police believe that the attack was carried out by an individual attacker. White House spokesman Jay Carney said the government believed the shooting was not related to terrorism.

b83175136cee11f6c3b1f7ac2b873aaf25dc329e.sourceText: 此外，一名来自美国圣迭戈的女性声称，她的儿子就是枪击案的嫌犯，警方”抓对了人”。她说：”你们抓对了人。我需要告诉警方。我要坐飞机到科罗拉多州去。”
b83175136cee11f6c3b1f7ac2b873aaf25dc329e.translatedText: In addition, a woman from San Diego, USA, claimed that her son was the suspect in the shooting and that the police had "apprehended the right person." She said: "You have arrested the right person. I need to tell the police. I want to fly to Colorado."

56f060b057f54d3c50d19654c6854bc46f961ed3.sourceText: 丹佛枪击案嫌犯作案时穿蝙蝠侠剧服
56f060b057f54d3c50d19654c6854bc46f961ed3.translatedText: The suspect in the Denver shooting wore a Batman costume when committing the crime

76bd706fad522aa21bf03f80497535a29da4342d.sourceText: CNTV消息（网络新闻联播 记者龚瑛报道）当地时间20日凌晨00:30左右（北京时间20日15:30左右），美国科罗拉多州丹佛市发生一起严重的枪击案。据中央电视台驻华盛顿记者在北京时间20日深夜的连线，枪击事件目前已造成12人死亡，至少38人受伤，其中18人重伤，9人伤情”非常严重”。
76bd706fad522aa21bf03f80497535a29da4342d.translatedText: CNTV news (online news broadcast Reporter Gong Ying reported) Around 00:30 local time on the 20th (around 15:30 Beijing time on the 20th), a serious shooting occurred in Denver, Colorado, USA. According to CCTV reporters in Washington late at night on the 20th, Beijing time, the shooting incident has killed 12 people and injured at least 38 people, of which 18 were seriously injured and 9 were in "very serious" condition.

c8a091ed5deafb06326aab58cc6b5fe4c4aa68fb.sourceText: 据外媒报道，枪击案发生时正值《蝙蝠侠前传3：黑暗骑士崛起》首映礼开始后半小时左右。目击者称，袭击者身穿蝙蝠侠剧服，他出现在电影院前方时，很多人甚至以为是首映式上特意安排的环节。直到有人流血，尖叫声响起，大家才意识到是袭击事件。
c8a091ed5deafb06326aab58cc6b5fe4c4aa68fb.translatedText: According to foreign media reports, the shooting occurred about half an hour after the premiere of "Batman Begins: The Dark Knight Rises." Witnesses said that the attacker was wearing a Batman costume. When he appeared in front of the cinema, many people even thought it was a specially arranged part of the premiere. It wasn't until people were bleeding and screams started that everyone realized it was an attack.

677ce5e54ce5dfaba8511f2ad479252a6816f068.sourceText: 据央视记者介绍，生于1987年12月的嫌疑人名叫詹姆斯?#38669;尔姆斯，有合法的美国居住权。另据外电报道，枪击案犯罪嫌疑人曾是科罗拉多州大学医学院学生，现在已经退学，且并不在警方监视的名单上，这意味着他以前没有重罪记录，警方称嫌疑人此前只收到过一张交警的罚单。但从嫌疑人的装备来看，步枪、手枪、专业面具、防弹背心，足见此次袭击是有计划的预谋性枪击。
677ce5e54ce5dfaba8511f2ad479252a6816f068.translatedText: According to CCTV reporters, the suspect’s name was James Holmes, who was born in December 1987, and he has legal right to reside in the United States. According to foreign reports, the suspect in the shooting was a former medical student at the University of Colorado, but has now dropped out and is not on the police watch list, which means that he has no previous felony record. The police said that the suspect had only received one ticket from the traffic police before. However, judging from the suspect's equipment, including a rifle, a pistol, a professional mask, and a bulletproof vest, it is clear that the attack was a planned and premeditated shooting.

de39a991dd8ccd9f480dfd22815346df7e950a75.sourceText: 对于嫌疑人的作案动机，警方暂时还没有公布。据美国媒体报道，目前出现新的猜测是，嫌疑人是蝙蝠侠超级粉丝，作案是在模仿电影场景。
de39a991dd8ccd9f480dfd22815346df7e950a75.translatedText: The police have not yet announced the suspect’s motive. According to US media reports, new speculation is emerging that the suspect is a super fan of Batman and committed the crime to imitate movie scenes.

8adf9dba71e10ad2df748fa72c754ee5d2487c6d.sourceText: 中国驻芝加哥总领事馆称，目前还没有华人在此次枪击事件中受到伤害的信息。据介绍，科罗拉多州并不是华人的主要聚居区，华人遇害的可能性不是很大。
8adf9dba71e10ad2df748fa72c754ee5d2487c6d.translatedText: The Chinese Consulate General in Chicago stated that there is currently no information about Chinese people being harmed in this shooting incident. According to reports, Colorado is not a major inhabited area for Chinese, and the possibility of Chinese being killed is not very high.

cae71863a5a0e2c62455a3dc14ed338292e24dd8.sourceText: 【侨报记者聂达6月2日洛杉矶报道】事发于2016年1月16日亚利桑那州坦佩市（Tempe, Arizona）的中国留学生江玥驾车被追尾而后惨遭枪杀一案的犯罪嫌疑人戴维斯（Holly Davis）过堂，她面对大陪审团（Grand Jury）一级谋杀罪名表示：拒不认罪。其律师表示戴维斯在涉案期间曾服用管制药物，且长期受精神疾病困扰。不仅如此，辩方还曾于4月12日向法庭提出另获得一段合理准备时间，对大陪审团的控诉提出反驳。近日，凶嫌戴维斯再一次获得延期至8月25日。
cae71863a5a0e2c62455a3dc14ed338292e24dd8.translatedText: [Overseas Chinese News reporter Nie Da reported in Los Angeles on June 2] The incident occurred on January 16, 2016 in Tempe, Arizona. Jiang Yue, a Chinese student in Tempe, Arizona, was rear-ended while driving and was shot and killed by the suspect Davis (Holly). Davis, who pleaded not guilty to a first-degree murder charge in the Grand Jury. His attorney said Davis had taken controlled substances during the time he was involved in the case and had long suffered from mental illness. Not only that, the defense also asked the court on April 12 for another reasonable preparation time to rebut the grand jury's indictment. Recently, the suspect Davis once again received an extension to August 25.

603e5a0e388f68f749ee4ca7dd7fb4e221195d71.sourceText: 今日，据马里科帕县（Maricopa County）检察官办公室公共信息员怀尔德（Rebecca Wilder）表示，辩方律师曾于4月12日第一次向法庭提出另获得一段合理准备时间，用以搜集证据以反驳大陪审团的控诉，该延期申请获得许可，该许可有效期至5月27日。然而，5月19日，辩方再一次以相同的理由向法庭提出了延期申请，这一次延期申请于5月25日再次获得法官的许可，延至8月25日。
603e5a0e388f68f749ee4ca7dd7fb4e221195d71.translatedText: Today, according to Rebecca Wilder, public information officer of the Maricopa County Prosecutor's Office, the defense lawyer first requested the court on April 12 to obtain another reasonable preparation time to collect evidence to rebut the grand jury's indictment. The extension application was granted, and the permission was valid until May 27. However, on May 19, the defense once again applied to the court for an extension for the same reason. This time the extension application was granted by the judge again on May 25, and was extended to August 25.

1cf7157cdf9b7d22827cf56931cc7babdf607d9e.sourceText: 此前，据马里科帕县（Maricopa County）检察官办公室公共信息员酷伯（Jerry Cobb）表示，辩方律师已经正式向法庭提出申请，要求多给辩方一些时间以准备充足证据对大陪审团的控诉进行反驳。酷伯表示，通常来讲对大陪审团提出控诉的情况时有发生，但并不常见，尤其对于这类情形相对恶劣的案件，辩方选择对大陪审团意见提出反驳的情形少之又少，因为试图通过这种做法改变最终结果的希望是十分渺茫的。不过，辩方律师希望通过各种方式为他的辩护人争取最好的结果也是很正常的。酷伯还表示，通常来说，在辩方在向法院提出＂延长准备、搜集证据时间＂以反驳大陪审团的书面申请文件后，会进一步搜集证据、资料和相关法律文件，用以告之大陪审团成员：他们在做出控诉决定的过程中，有遗漏的证据，对证词有错误的理解或是对某些法律条款使用不当。
1cf7157cdf9b7d22827cf56931cc7babdf607d9e.translatedText: Previously, according to Jerry Cobb, public information officer of the Maricopa County Prosecutor's Office, the defense lawyer had formally applied to the court, requesting that the defense be given more time to prepare sufficient evidence to rebut the grand jury's indictment. Cooper said that generally speaking, indictments against grand juries occur from time to time, but they are not common. Especially for such relatively egregious cases, it is rare that the defense chooses to refute the opinions of the grand jury, because the hope of trying to change the final result through this method is very slim. However, it is normal for a defense attorney to hope to obtain the best outcome for his client through various means. Cooper also said that generally speaking, after the defense requests the court to "extend the time to prepare and collect evidence" to refute the grand jury's written application, it will further collect evidence, information and relevant legal documents to inform the grand jury members that they have omitted evidence, misunderstood the testimony or improperly used certain legal terms in the process of making the charging decision.

27af5ee1b0c500c9dba0095b28f70c1aa4a43803.sourceText: 不过，针对这起案件，酷伯个人表示，他以及本案法官均认为辩方这样的请求是基本无济于事的，毕竟这不同于一般的交通事故，比方说一司机被交警拦下，检查之后发现车中有药物存在，因此警方控诉他有服药驾车的违法情节，司机可以通过进行一系列检验来反驳控诉。酷伯说：＂然而在这种案例中，凶嫌戴维斯开枪打死留学生江玥事实如铁证，很难想象辩方能够通过怎样的证据证明戴维斯从根本上没有犯罪，并说服大陪审团？我想是几乎不可能的。＂
27af5ee1b0c500c9dba0095b28f70c1aa4a43803.translatedText: However, regarding this case, Kubo personally stated that he and the judge in this case believe that the defense's request is basically useless. After all, this is different from ordinary traffic accidents. For example, a driver is stopped by the traffic police. After inspection, it is found that there are drugs in the car. Therefore, the police accuse him of illegal driving while taking drugs. The driver can refute the accusation by conducting a series of tests. Cooper said: "However, in this case, the fact that the suspect Davis shot and killed foreign student Jiang Yue is irrefutable. It is difficult to imagine what kind of evidence the defense can use to prove that Davis was not guilty of a crime and convince the grand jury? I think it is almost impossible."

296f3e1f74077961ff3e52abbec320668e3b90ea.sourceText: 联合血液服务和雷鸟合作，呼吁大众在这个假日季节踊跃捐血。 ”圣诞和新年期间通常是一年之中献血者最少的一周，”联合血液服务中心发言人说。”假如节日里发生重大事故，医院血液供应不上，很难想象会是什么结果。” 联合血液中心和主办高尔夫球赛的斯格思岱尔市雷鸟合作，从即日起至12月31日（星期五），在任何联合血液服务机构捐血者，将获得为期一天的the 2012 Waste Management Phoenix Open（高尔夫球赛）门票一张。 供血中心欢迎所有类型的捐血者，但需求量最大的是O型阴性，因为这种血可以给任何血型人。 寻找捐血中心和预约时间，请致电877-827-4376或访问unitedbloodservicesaz.org。
296f3e1f74077961ff3e52abbec320668e3b90ea.translatedText: United Blood Services and Thunderbird have partnered to encourage the public to donate blood this holiday season. "The Christmas and New Year period are typically the fewest weeks of the year for blood donors," a spokesman for the United Blood Services said. "If a major accident occurs during the holiday and the hospital is unable to supply blood, it is hard to imagine what the outcome will be." The United Blood Center has partnered with the Scottsdale Thunderbirds, which hosts the golf tournament, and from now until Friday, December 31, anyone who donates blood at any United Blood Services agency will receive a one-day ticket to the 2012 Waste Management Phoenix Open (golf tournament). The blood donor center welcomes all types of blood donors, but the most in demand is type O negative, as this blood can be given to anyone with any blood type. To find a blood donation center and schedule an appointment, call 877-827-4376 or visit unitedbloodservicesaz.org.

23b7ac5b7eaab0d24067260fade6b5c8b2cba2e3.sourceText: 亚利桑那非盈利组织捐款给加州挨告 （亚省时报） 加州最高法院下令亚省一个非盈利组织将上个月向两个加州竞选组织捐款一千一百万美元的记录向加州选民公开。 加州总检察长卡马拉哈里斯和加州竞选资金管理部门在调查，这个名为”Americans for Responsible Leadership”的亚利桑那州非盈利组织给加州竞选组织捐款是否合法，因为该组织没有公开捐款人的资料。 哈里斯指出，ARL在10月间给一个加州政治行动委员会捐款，该委员会宗旨是反对州长杰里布朗主动收税提案，ARL还给另一个支持限制工会筹款的组织捐款。 联邦法律允许非盈利组织不公开捐款者的姓名，但加州法规要求给政治捐款者，政府有权要求其公开身份。
23b7ac5b7eaab0d24067260fade6b5c8b2cba2e3.translatedText: Arizona non-profit organization donated $11 million to two California campaign groups (Alberta Times) The California Supreme Court ordered an Alberta non-profit organization to disclose to California voters the records of its $11 million donation to two California campaign groups last month. California Attorney General Kamala Harris and the California Division of Campaign Finance are investigating whether donations to the California campaign by an Arizona-based nonprofit called Americans for Responsible Leadership were legal because the group did not disclose donor information. Harris noted that ARL donated in October to a California political action committee that opposed Gov. Jerry Brown's tax initiative, and to another group that supports restrictions on union fundraising. Federal law allows nonprofits not to disclose the names of donors, but California regulations require the government to require political donors to disclose their identities.

831c421d03469da152c7a1603675622d5c57da80.sourceText: 饮食八分饱，节省两分做慈善——慈济慈善募款晚宴 （《亚省时报》讯 胖圈报道）8月18日下午6时慈济慈善募款晚宴迎来了90多位的大德，他们在慈济凤凰城联络处的静思堂共进膳食，并慷慨解囊，为慈济募得近4万美元善款用于当地的慈善事业。 在上人證嚴法师的开誓，为来宾讲述吃饭八分饱，对身体的好处，提倡节约食物，为世界上更多需要帮助的人送去温暖。慈济师兄师姐们更是身体力行，用手语歌，唱出健康饮食的道理。他们亲手制作近十道的营养素食，让大德们现场品尝健康美食。 慈济在凤凰城传承着四大置业，食物、医疗、教育、文化。他们每周都为需要食物的人免费发放食品，并为没有保险的亚利桑那市民提供一年两次的健康体检，开设中文课程，促进中美文化交流。慈济是凤凰城慈善事业做得最规范的团体之一。这次慈善募款晚宴募得的资金，将继续用于亚利桑那当地的慈善事业，日后将会有更多需要食物，医疗保健和教育的贫民得到帮助。
831c421d03469da152c7a1603675622d5c57da80.translatedText: Eat eighty cents full, save two cents for charity - Tzu Chi Charity Fundraising Dinner (reported by "Alberta Times") Fat Circle Report) On August 18, at 6 p.m., Tzu Chi’s charity fund-raising dinner welcomed more than 90 eminent persons. They had a meal together at the Jing Si Hall of Tzu Chi’s Phoenix Liaison Office and donated generously, raising nearly US$40,000 for Tzu Chi for local charities. The Venerable Master Cheng Yen took the oath and told the guests about the benefits of eating eighty cents full, advocating food conservation and bringing warmth to more people in need in the world. The brothers and sisters of Tzu Chi even put their practice into practice, singing in sign language and singing the principles of healthy eating. They personally prepared nearly ten nutritious vegetarian dishes for the virtuous people to taste healthy food on the spot. Tzu Chi inherits four major properties in Phoenix: food, medical care, education, and culture. They distribute free food to those in need every week, provide biannual health checkups to Arizona citizens without insurance, offer Chinese courses, and promote cultural exchanges between China and the United States. Tzu Chi is one of the most standardized charities in Phoenix. The funds raised from this charity fundraising dinner will continue to be used for local charities in Arizona, and more poor people in need of food, medical care and education will be helped in the future.

a35ee5462a8a8f3d1ac67c5106623fb2ab8d1ee2.sourceText: 读书无用？大学毕业生低薪工作令人愁 （亚省时报） 随着世界经济缓慢的步骤，全球大学生的就业机会也愈来愈少，找到理想工作的可能性也在下降之中。 跟据国际经济机构OECD最新报告显示，西方世界14大国中有许多国家的大学毕业生在毕业后10年依旧在低薪职位（年薪低于3万美元）工作。而资料显示，美国和加拿大的状况尤其的令人担忧。 据报导表示，美国大学毕业生的低薪工作比率高达排行榜中14国的前3名内，而有超过30%的毕业生在毕业后无法找到高薪工作。 报告显示，大学生如果希望在工作事业上成功，您可能考虑考研究生，以提高您得到高薪职位的机会。 以下是排名中14个国家的大学生毕业后10年内依旧在低薪职位工作的比率：西班牙 44%，加拿大 38%，美国 33%，法国 29%，波兰 28%，英国 26%，澳大利亚24%，意大利24%，瑞士23%，德国20%，瑞典17%，荷兰16%，匈牙利13%，卢森堡3%。
a35ee5462a8a8f3d1ac67c5106623fb2ab8d1ee2.translatedText: Is studying useless? Low-paying jobs for college graduates are worrying (Alberta Times) As the world economy slows down, employment opportunities for college students around the world are becoming fewer and fewer, and the possibility of finding an ideal job is also declining. According to the latest report from the international economic organization OECD, college graduates from many of the 14 major countries in the Western world are still working in low-paying positions (annual salary less than US$30,000) 10 years after graduation. The data shows that the situation in the United States and Canada is particularly worrying. According to reports, the ratio of low-paying jobs for American university graduates is as high as the top three of the 14 countries in the ranking, and more than 30% of graduates are unable to find high-paying jobs after graduation. The report shows that if college students want to be successful in their careers, you may consider taking graduate degrees to increase your chances of getting a high-paying position. The following is the proportion of college students in the 14 countries in the ranking who are still working in low-paying positions 10 years after graduation: 44% in Spain, 38% in Canada, 33% in the United States, 29% in France, 28% in Poland, 26% in the United Kingdom, 24% in Australia, 24% in Italy, 23% in Switzerland, 20% in Germany, 17% in Sweden, 16% in the Netherlands, 13% in Hungary, and 3% in Luxembourg.

ed759a07f2d7dfcf5ef5777faaff372abaa869a1.sourceText: 辛亥革命百年之日 孙中山戎装雕像在广州落成（图) （亚省时报广州特约记者杨绮薇报道） 在辛亥革命一百周年纪念日到来之前，广州市大元帅府广场上的孙中山戎装雕像落成揭幕。据悉，这座历时3年创作完成的雕像，是目前中国唯一以戎装出现的孙中山纪念雕像。 记者在广州市海珠区大元帅府广场看到，新落成的孙中山铜像赫然矗立在珠水之畔，全副戎装的大元帅，手持长剑，气宇轩昂。他面向浩浩珠江，昂首挺立，目光炯炯，十分威严庄重。雕像的设计者、著名雕塑家、原广州美术学院院长梁明诚介绍，雕像总高6.1米，铜像高4.5米，重量达2吨。记者看到雕像正面篆刻有”孙中山像（1866-1925）”的字样，底座两侧篆刻了孙中山先生的两段语录，分别为：”统一是全体国民的希望，能够统一，全国人民便享福，不能统一，便要受害”；”文则以为，吾粤之所以为全国重者，不在地形之便利，而在人民进取性之坚强；不在物质之进步，而在人民爱国心之勇猛”。梁明诚解释说，孙中山曾三次在广州建立革命政权，其中两次就在珠水南岸（即现在的海珠区）设立大元帅府，戎装像如实再现了1923年孙中山先生就任海陆空大元帅时的风貌，既符合当时的历史环境，又充分体现了孙中山先生”敢为天下先”的革命精神。 广州市市委常委、宣传部长王晓玲在孙中山戎装雕像揭幕仪式上表示，广州是中国近代革命的策源地，孙中山先生正是从这里迈出了领导中国民主革命的第一步，在辛亥革命的准备、酝酿、发展、推进过程中，广州都是重镇。孙中山先生在广州三次领导武装起义，建立革命政权，革命先驱在这里烙印下的足迹，是中国近代政治舞台上引人注目的亮点，是活生生的中国近代革命史的教材，更是广州这座城市独特、不可复制的历史文化资源。 王晓玲说，广州市政府在大元帅府旧址广场建造大元帅戎装雕像，既是缅怀革命先驱，深化广州市纪念辛亥革命100周年纪念活动的重要内容，也是深入挖掘广州城市文化内涵，擦亮历史文化名城品牌的有力举措。
ed759a07f2d7dfcf5ef5777faaff372abaa869a1.translatedText: On the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911, a statue of Sun Yat-sen in military uniform was inaugurated in Guangzhou (photo) (Reported by Yang Qiwei, Special Correspondent of the Alberta Times in Guangzhou) Before the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911, a statue of Sun Yat-sen in military uniform was inaugurated in Guangzhou’s Grand Marshal’s Mansion Square. It is reported that this statue, which took three years to create, is currently the only memorial statue of Sun Yat-sen in military uniform in China. Reporters saw the newly completed bronze statue of Sun Yat-sen standing on the bank of the Pearl River in the Grand Marshal's Mansion Square in Haizhu District, Guangzhou. The Generalissimo in full military uniform, holding a long sword, looked majestic. Facing the mighty Pearl River, he stood with his head held high and his eyes bright, looking very majestic and solemn. Liang Mingcheng, the designer of the statue, a famous sculptor and the former president of the Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts, said that the total height of the statue is 6.1 meters, the bronze statue is 4.5 meters high, and the weight reaches 2 tons. The reporter saw that the words "Portrait of Sun Yat-sen (1866-1925)" were engraved on the front of the statue, and two quotations from Mr. Sun Yat-sen were engraved on both sides of the base, which are: "Unification is the hope of all citizens. With the reunification, the whole country can be reunified." The people will enjoy happiness, but if they cannot be unified, they will suffer"; "Wen Ze believes that the reason why Guangdong is the most important in the world is not the convenience of the terrain, but the strong enterprising spirit of the people; not the material progress, but the brave patriotism of the people." Liang Mingcheng explained that Sun Yat-sen established the revolutionary regime in Guangzhou three times, and twice he established the Generalissimo's Palace on the south bank of Zhushui River (now Haizhu District). The military uniform statue faithfully reproduces the appearance of Mr. Sun Yat-sen when he took office as the Generalissimo of the Sea, Land and Air in 1923. It is in line with the historical environment at that time and fully embodies Mr. Sun Yat-sen's revolutionary spirit of "dare to be the first in the world". Wang Xiaoling, member of the Standing Committee of the Guangzhou Municipal Party Committee and Minister of Propaganda, said at the unveiling ceremony of Sun Yat-sen's uniform statue that Guangzhou was the birthplace of China's modern revolution. It was here that Mr. Sun Yat-sen took the first step in leading China's democratic revolution. Guangzhou was an important town during the preparation, brewing, development, and advancement of the Revolution of 1911. Dr. Sun Yat-sen led three armed uprisings in Guangzhou and established a revolutionary regime. The footprints left by the revolutionary pioneers here are eye-catching highlights on the modern political stage of China, a living teaching material for the history of modern Chinese revolution, and a unique and unreplicable historical and cultural resource of the city of Guangzhou. Wang Xiaoling said that the Guangzhou Municipal Government's construction of the Generalissimo's military uniform statue in the square of the former site of the Generalissimo's Mansion is not only an important part of commemorating the revolutionary pioneers and deepening Guangzhou's commemoration of the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911, but also a powerful measure to deeply explore the cultural connotation of Guangzhou's city and polish the brand of a famous historical and cultural city.
