Some Chinese residents in the San Gabriel Valley were hit by the strongest wind in Southern California in the past decade on the evening of the 30th, no...

36cc875b8c28caedba3f210c5458da38705d34cb.sourceText: 圣盖博谷部分华人住户，30日晚受到南加州近十年来最大强风袭击，不少人被吓得整夜难以入眠。
36cc875b8c28caedba3f210c5458da38705d34cb.translatedText: Some Chinese residents in the San Gabriel Valley were hit by the strongest wind in Southern California in the past decade on the evening of the 30th. Many people were frightened and could not sleep all night.

e1175d242d10b5bc6b3cee96e66388fb5c571649.sourceText: 圣玛利诺高中陈姓应届毕业生，30日晚正忙著透过电脑送出加大入学申请资料时，突然发生的停电让他急死了，因为午夜12时是加大申请截止时间。他虽志不在加大，仍担心所申请的私立名校不给他入学许可，因此如期送出加大申请表对他很重要。
e1175d242d10b5bc6b3cee96e66388fb5c571649.translatedText: A recent graduate from San Marino High School named Chen was busy sending out application materials for UC admission through his computer on the evening of the 30th when a sudden power outage made him anxious because 12 o'clock at midnight was the application deadline for UC. Although he has no ambition to go to UC, he is still worried that the prestigious private school he is applying to will not grant him admission, so it is important for him to submit the UC application form as scheduled.

db9f7c2f829f3977fb04f0d595d605a7936ac2a6.sourceText: 幸亏住在蒙特利公园市的阿姨家没有停电，在父母碎碎念之下，父母一路飞车将他载到阿姨家，及时完成申请加大手续。
db9f7c2f829f3977fb04f0d595d605a7936ac2a6.translatedText: Fortunately, there was no power outage at his aunt's house in Monterey Park. After his parents thought about it, they drove him all the way to his aunt's house and completed the application for enlargement in time.

e5ba9d85bf4b4f159c63529048e747581338a178.sourceText: 在洛杉矶市开公司、定居巴沙迪那的曾小姐，1日上午10时许驾车经过每天必经的加利福利亚大道（California Blvd.）时，被一路看到的光景吓一跳。「不少长得高大的松树竟然应风而倒，满地枯枝落叶，一片残败。」
e5ba9d85bf4b4f159c63529048e747581338a178.translatedText: Ms. Zeng, who runs a company in Los Angeles and lives in Pasadena, was shocked by the sights she saw along the way when she drove by California Blvd. at about 10 a.m. on the 1st. "Many tall pine trees fell down in response to the wind, and the ground was covered with dead branches and leaves, which were in ruins."

4a92a893afc2e0522ab98aa8f0924064081a888c.sourceText: 由于不少路段因树木倒伏被封路，她只得绕道。原来半小时的路，当天却花了一小时半才到公司。
4a92a893afc2e0522ab98aa8f0924064081a888c.translatedText: Since many sections of the road were closed due to fallen trees, she had to take a detour. It used to be a half-hour journey, but it took an hour and a half to get to the company that day.

da69117055517606259f0b194cf5f6f6418dd66c.sourceText: 住家位于圣玛利诺及圣盖博间洛县属地的李太太说，30日晚10时许住家就开始停电，1日早晨继续停电，不但没法替子女准备早午餐。外出买早餐时也发现华洋商号未开门。当天稍后前往天普市一家美髮院打算染髮时，美髮院也未开门。
da69117055517606259f0b194cf5f6f6418dd66c.translatedText: Mrs. Li, who lives in San Marino and San Gabriel counties, said that the power outage began at 10 pm on the 30th and continued on the morning of the 1st. Not only was it impossible to prepare brunch for her children. When I went out to buy breakfast, I also found that Huayang Store was not open. Later that day, when I went to a hair salon in Temple City to dye my hair, the salon was not open.

5e25a26c308620827d8df2669704de9a6c87a4ab.sourceText: 「一场强风似乎将大家的正常生活机制都打乱了! 」她不无感触地指出。
5e25a26c308620827d8df2669704de9a6c87a4ab.translatedText: "A strong wind seems to have disrupted everyone's normal life mechanism!" She pointed out with emotion.

9be87edef23de886ed2c5587323477835c9cd7f9.sourceText: 订于2日将飞往上海的杨先生，1日前往圣盖博一家旅行社拿代办的中国大陆签证，只见铁门深锁，原来因停电旅行社休息。他情急之下只有动用平时少用的旅行经纪电话，才拿到签证。
9be87edef23de886ed2c5587323477835c9cd7f9.translatedText: Mr. Yang, who was scheduled to fly to Shanghai on the 2nd, went to a travel agency in San Gabriel to pick up a visa for mainland China on the 1st. He saw that the iron door was locked. It turned out that the travel agency was closed due to a power outage. In desperation, he had to use the rarely used travel agent phone number to get the visa.

5803941adc089ccd56591229778287e7026c9005.sourceText: 亚凯迪亚黄太太由于先生出国公干，一人独居在家，整夜被风吹得吱吱作响的窗户声吓得难以入睡。她说，更恐怖的是整夜警车及救护车警铃声大作。
5803941adc089ccd56591229778287e7026c9005.translatedText: > Mrs. Huang of Arcadia lives alone at home because her husband is on a business trip abroad. She is frightened by the sound of the squeaking windows all night and cannot sleep. She said what was even scarier was the sound of police car and ambulance sirens blaring all night long.

298b98262365098c0e6e2d3fdd9034e64696e945.sourceText: 1日下午近3时，位于New街及山谷大道交口的168超市前聚集数位华人。一名操著广东口音的华人说，大家跑来上工，结果公司没开，也未事先通知。唯他不愿证实是来超市上班，或在附近零售店上班。
298b98262365098c0e6e2d3fdd9034e64696e945.translatedText: At nearly 3 pm on the 1st, several Chinese people gathered in front of the 168 Supermarket at the intersection of New Street and Valley Avenue. A Chinese with a Cantonese accent said that everyone came to work, but the company was not open and no prior notice was given. But he refused to confirm whether he came to work in a supermarket or a nearby retail store.

7c0b7ec38d08af8c36316884273d9aef4b2e1aab.sourceText: 蒙罗维亚李先生1日从住家开往两哩外的210高速公路准备上班时，原来弹指间可开到的距离竟然花了半小时，直呼「今天不回家，要在公司附近找旅馆将就一晚。」
7c0b7ec38d08af8c36316884273d9aef4b2e1aab.translatedText: > When Mr. Li of Monrovia drove from his home to Highway 210, two miles away, on the 1st to prepare for work, it took half an hour to cover the distance that was within a snap of his fingers. He said, "If I don't go home today, I will find a hotel near the company for one night."

f9bb04d06a703a6f73d53148b99be803e32d35d6.sourceText: 受大风影响，有很多手机基地台也受到损害，许多手机用户都无法收到信号。
f9bb04d06a703a6f73d53148b99be803e32d35d6.translatedText: Affected by strong winds, many mobile phone base stations were also damaged, and many mobile phone users were unable to receive signals.

3898641d17485d09642ed7f22d57dba8942ac7b9.sourceText: AT&T一位客服代表表示，部分地区手机讯号全无，是因手机发射台受大风影响，目前他们正紧急维修，但没有明确的时间表。而另一大电信商Verizon客服透露，截止1日下午5时巴沙迪那、格兰岱等地区仍然处于无信号状态，没有修复时间表。T-Mobile截稿时暂时还没有做出回应。
3898641d17485d09642ed7f22d57dba8942ac7b9.translatedText: An AT&T customer service representative said that there was no mobile phone signal in some areas because the mobile phone transmitting stations were affected by strong winds. They are currently undergoing emergency repairs, but there is no clear timetable. Another major telecommunications provider, Verizon customer service, revealed that as of 5 pm on the 1st, Pasadena, Glendale and other areas were still without signal, and there was no timetable for repairs. T-Mobile had not responded as of press time.

0a684aecfdf56627db4e604a4c09c738b48deee7.sourceText: 手机讯号和网路讯号丧失加上电力中断，让许多人生活一下子倒退了几十年。南巴沙迪那郭先生透露，从1日晚至早上12时，网路、手机讯号全无，手机也因为一夜没有充电，电量耗尽。他透露，30日晚11时因为停电，先用手机当作应急灯，电量几乎耗尽。本以为电力到早上就会恢复，谁知到了早上连讯号也没了。
0a684aecfdf56627db4e604a4c09c738b48deee7.translatedText: The loss of mobile phone and Internet signals and power outages have set many people's lives back decades. Mr. Nan Pasadena Guo revealed that from the evening of the 1st to 12 o'clock in the morning, there was no Internet or mobile phone signal, and the mobile phone was exhausted because it was not charged overnight. He revealed that due to a power outage at 11 pm on the 30th, he first used his mobile phone as an emergency light and the battery was almost exhausted. I thought the power would be restored in the morning, but unexpectedly there was no signal in the morning.

ca94a5881e5fc8fae713906128192a169faa1604.sourceText: （亚省时报）4月26日亚利桑那亚美律师协会在钱德勒红宝石餐厅举行了2012年的春宴。 亚美律师协会邀请到了享誉全球的神探李昌钰亲临现场做精彩演讲，300多会员与嘉宾共襄盛举，欢庆亚省亚裔司法界大聚会。
ca94a5881e5fc8fae713906128192a169faa1604.translatedText: (Alberta Times) On April 26, the Arizona Asian American Lawyers Association held its 2012 Spring Banquet at the Chandler Ruby Restaurant. The Asian American Lawyers Association invited the world-renowned detective Li Changyu to give a wonderful speech. More than 300 members and guests participated in the grand event to celebrate the grand gathering of Asian judicial circles in Alberta.

f12b27199041b9a40b6acf6d608011d3a2f1c743.sourceText: 福克斯电视台10 频道的亚裔记者凯莉（Kelly Hessedal）主持了晚宴。 前主席布里安那（Briana E.Chua）致欢迎词，隆重介绍了享誉全球的神探李昌钰博士。 李昌钰，刑事鉴证的专家，从警50年间，秉承”让证据说话，对历史负责”的态度，先后到全球42个国家参与调查8000​​多起重大刑案，有些已成国际法庭科学界与警 界的教学范例，其中包括美国著名球星辛普森涉嫌杀妻案、克林顿绯闻案等，还有被许多中国人所熟知的”陈水扁枪击案”。 李昌钰走上演讲台，总是用风趣幽默的笑话，逗得来宾哈哈大笑，他自嘲说一个英文说的不太好的人，在美国同样是可以挣大钱。 李昌钰简单的介绍他在美国走向成功的经历”一切不可能的事情变成可能”职业信条贯穿了他的职业生涯。 精彩的案例很多，1993年芝加哥7人死亡的谋杀案中，就显示了李神探的超凡能力。 当警察几乎找不到任何头绪，搞的焦头烂额时，李昌钰在垃圾桶中找到了破案的关键性线索。 那就是几块吃剩的鸡肉。 通过购买鸡肉的发票，​​鸡翅被吃，鸡胸肉被留下来，也让李神探预测到了凶手是喜欢黑鸡肉的族裔，最终将这个特大谋杀案全部破获。 用”事实说话，还事件真相”就是他一生中在努力做的事情。 李昌钰的演讲给在座的很多年轻的司法界人员树立了榜样。
f12b27199041b9a40b6acf6d608011d3a2f1c743.translatedText: Fox Channel 10 Asian reporter Kelly Hessedal hosted the dinner. Former Chairman Briana E.Chua delivered a welcome speech and solemnly introduced the world-renowned detective Dr. Li Changyu. Li Changyu, an expert in criminal forensics, has been a police officer for 50 years, adhering to the attitude of "let the evidence speak for itself and being responsible for history". He has participated in the investigation of more than 8,000 major criminal cases in 42 countries around the world. Some of them have become teaching examples for the international forensic science community and the police community, including the famous American star Simpson's suspected wife murder case, the Clinton scandal case, and the "Chen Shui-bian shooting case" that is well known to many Chinese. Li Changyu walked up to the podium and always made the guests laugh with humorous jokes. He laughed at himself and said that a person who does not speak English very well can still make a lot of money in the United States. Li Changyu briefly introduced his experience of success in the United States. The professional creed of "everything impossible becomes possible" runs through his career. There are many wonderful cases. The 1993 murder case in Chicago that killed seven people demonstrated Detective Li's extraordinary abilities. When the police could hardly find any clues and were overwhelmed, Li Changyu found the key clue to solving the case in the trash can. That was a few pieces of leftover chicken. Through the invoice for purchasing chicken, the chicken wings were eaten and the chicken breasts were left, which also allowed Detective Li to predict that the murderer was an ethnic group who likes black chicken, and finally solved this huge murder case. "Speaking with facts and returning the truth" is what he has been working hard to do in his life. Li Changyu's speech set an example for many young judicial personnel present here.

5bfed59aa21926cadf3e8cdbbbc03e71a1e9aa47.sourceText: 周雅定 康明义 李昌钰

6cfedc13763aa717f1fb1f233ec3c5b652818698.sourceText: 当晚亚美律师协会的执行委员会成员在华裔女法官周雅定带领下宣誓就职。
6cfedc13763aa717f1fb1f233ec3c5b652818698.translatedText: That night, the members of the executive committee of the Asian American Bar Association were sworn in under the leadership of the Chinese female judge Zhou Yading.

b4ed28bda30bc8c21541fad5f5c39c930cb4cb4d.sourceText: 现场最热闹的场景就是拍卖李昌钰教授的书，作为年轻人的奖学金，2012年Soo Chang， Jeremiah Chin， Sheila Gholkar， frances Shinn-Eckbery四位年轻人获得了亚美律师协会的奖学金，他们也将用 自己的努力学习来回报社会，开拓自己的司法道路。
b4ed28bda30bc8c21541fad5f5c39c930cb4cb4d.translatedText: The most lively scene at the scene was the auction of Professor Li Changyu's books. As scholarships for young people, four young people, Soo Chang, Jeremiah Chin, Sheila Gholkar, and Frances Shinn-Eckbery, won scholarships from the Asian American Bar Association in 2012. They will also use their hard work to repay the society and open up their own judicial path.

b272d08040603987674a69b885192b3c125cb886.sourceText: 获得奖学金者合影留念（左二颁奖者）
b272d08040603987674a69b885192b3c125cb886.translatedText: The scholarship recipients took a group photo (second award recipient from the left)

8fb01b41b5002f3f823e9e1011d52a077f3af3b3.sourceText: 亚美律师协会主席康明义在活动的最后，感谢会员，友人们长期以来的大力支持，相约明年再会。
8fb01b41b5002f3f823e9e1011d52a077f3af3b3.translatedText: At the end of the event, Kang Mingyi, Chairman of the Asian American Lawyers Association, thanked members and friends for their long-term support, and we will meet again next year.

6722db3f090a4ad4bc647a1c22019c56e11e7bb1.sourceText: 大凤凰城房产新闻 在过去的六个月里大凤凰城的房屋的中值价格都在115000美元这个数字附近，这个是近十年的…
6722db3f090a4ad4bc647a1c22019c56e11e7bb1.translatedText: Greater Phoenix Real Estate News In the past six months, the median price of homes in Greater Phoenix has been around $115,000, which is the lowest price in the past decade...

a8fb8de3ae8cefe971715860cec385a0010fe11c.sourceText: 大凤凰城房产新闻 在过去的六个月里大凤凰城的房屋的中值价格都在115000美元这个数字附近，这个是近十年的最低价格。美国大城市的房屋价格的最低值出现在今年的三月和四月，但是大凤凰城地区不同，它出现在去年年底。去年十一月凤凰城的中值价格就从121000美元降到了115000美元，这个价格一直稳定至今。近期一些房地产的关键数据，例如破产屋，短卖屋的数量表明，房地产有可能在今年缓慢的复苏。今年五月是2007年以来申请破产最少的一个月，只有4221个申请。上个月破产的房子真正只有4212个，最有力的数据是正在处理的破产房屋只有27400栋，两年前有42000栋。
a8fb8de3ae8cefe971715860cec385a0010fe11c.translatedText: Greater Phoenix Real Estate News In the past six months, the median price of homes in Greater Phoenix has been around $115,000, which is the lowest price in the past decade. The lowest value for home prices in major U.S. cities occurred in March and April of this year, but unlike the greater Phoenix area, it occurred at the end of last year. The median price in Phoenix fell from $121,000 to $115,000 last November, and has remained stable ever since. Some recent key real estate data, such as the number of bankruptcies and short-sales homes, indicate that real estate is likely to recover slowly this year. May of this year had the fewest bankruptcy filings since 2007, with only 4,221 filings. There were really only 4,212 bankruptcies last month, and the best data available is that there were only 27,400 bankruptcies being processed, compared with 42,000 two years ago.

1d33fc87fca6f5767bb0bd606cca4f606b1f6b94.sourceText: 众院将通过《排华法案》道歉案 华人需居安思危
1d33fc87fca6f5767bb0bd606cca4f606b1f6b94.translatedText: The House of Representatives will pass an apology bill for the "Chinese Exclusion Act". The Chinese need to be prepared for danger in times of peace

379d9a56a179ea77bedfb1d2bb1d3578fd8a3760.sourceText: 众院将通过《排华法案》道歉案 华人需居安思危 联邦国会华裔众议员赵美心13日透露，《排华法案》道歉案在国会…
379d9a56a179ea77bedfb1d2bb1d3578fd8a3760.translatedText: The House of Representatives will pass an apology bill for the "Chinese Exclusion Act". The Chinese people need to be prepared for danger in times of peace. Chinese-American Representative Zhao Meixin of the Federal Congress revealed on the 13th that the "Chinese Exclusion Act" apology case has made a major breakthrough in Congress...

161cd9d70156fa0438e5581d8652a75258c7450b.sourceText: 联邦国会华裔众议员赵美心13日透露，《排华法案》道歉案在国会取得重大突破，该提案有望最早下周在国会众议院表决通过。对于姗姗来迟的道歉案，华人无不欣喜，但一些政治观察人士提醒说，国会道歉并非良心发现，而是看重了华人身上潜在的”价值”，华人要懂得居安思危。
161cd9d70156fa0438e5581d8652a75258c7450b.translatedText: Chinese-American Representative Zhao Meixin of the Federal Congress revealed on the 13th that the "Chinese Exclusion Act" apology case has made a major breakthrough in Congress. The proposal is expected to be voted on by the House of Representatives as early as next week. The Chinese are all happy about the long-awaited apology, but some political observers remind that the congressional apology is not a discovery of conscience, but an emphasis on the potential "value" of the Chinese. The Chinese must know how to be prepared for danger in times of peace.

c4175691c35124b676741f89a9ad5afc4be759a5.sourceText: 赵美心（Judy Chu）6月13日对外表示，众议院司法委员会主席史密斯（Lamar Smith）与她一同达成了一个两党联合协议，决定让众议院尽快对这个法案进行投票表决并得到通过，法案最早下周将在众议院表决通过。《排华法案》（Chinese Exclusion Act）是一部1882年5月6日美国国会通过的对华人歧视法案，也是美国历史上首部且唯一排除一个民族享有平等、自由的联邦法律。在此后之后，美国又出台了一系列排华法律。1943年为了加强与中国的”二战联盟”，《排华法案》才被废除，但美国始终未就此法案对华人道歉。
c4175691c35124b676741f89a9ad5afc4be759a5.translatedText: Judy Chu stated on June 13 that House Judiciary Committee Chairman Lamar Smith reached a bipartisan agreement with her and decided to have the House of Representatives vote on this bill as soon as possible and pass it. The bill will be voted on by the House of Representatives as early as next week. The Chinese Exclusion Act is a bill that discriminates against the Chinese passed by the U.S. Congress on May 6, 1882. It is also the first and only federal law in U.S. history that excludes an ethnic group from enjoying equality and freedom. After that, the United States introduced a series of anti-Chinese laws. The Chinese Exclusion Act was repealed in 1943 in order to strengthen the "World War II Alliance" with China, but the United States has never apologized to the Chinese for this act.

6f98f053058b188b0517a72caa31931ba31697ec.sourceText: 在众多华人社团支持下，作为首位华裔国会议员的赵美心一直在寻求国会向华人道歉。2011年5月26日她和两位国会众议员宣布，已向第112届国会递交众议院第282号议案，要求众议院就美国历史上通过的歧视华人法律，包括《排华法案》表示歉意。同天，来自加州和麻州的国会参议员范因斯坦（Dianne Feinstein）、布朗（Scott Brown）也联名向参议院提交了内容相同的第201号议案。2011年10月6日，国会参议院以全票通过法案，为历史上的排华法案表达歉意。如果6月18日众议院通过《排华法案》道歉案，那就意味着美国国会正式向华人道歉。
6f98f053058b188b0517a72caa31931ba31697ec.translatedText: With the support of many Chinese associations, Zhao Meixin, the first Chinese-American member of Congress, has been seeking an apology from Congress to the Chinese. On May 26, 2011, she and two members of Congress announced that they had submitted House Bill 282 to the 112th Congress, requesting the House of Representatives to apologize for the laws that discriminated against Chinese Americans passed in American history, including the Chinese Exclusion Act. On the same day, Senators Dianne Feinstein and Scott Brown from California and Massachusetts also jointly submitted Bill 201 with the same content to the Senate. On October 6, 2011, the Senate passed a bill with a unanimous vote to apologize for the historical Chinese Exclusion Act. If the House of Representatives passes the Chinese Exclusion Act apology bill on June 18, it will mean that the U.S. Congress officially apologizes to the Chinese.

15bae577887c339b463356d5090d4a65a19982a6.sourceText: 虽然美国国会向华”低头”姗姗来迟，但依旧使华人感到兴奋，甚至还对国会心怀感激。国会是否当真是良心发现才通过道歉案？观察家并不这样看。他们普遍认为，国会愿意通过《排华法案》道歉案并非心血来潮，这背后有其深刻的原因。从世界大格局看，同意向华人道歉案过与中国崛起密不可分。当下的中国是联合国五个常任理事国之一，且2010年中国经济已超过日本，荣登世界第二。而同样身为大国的美国要处理世界事务，绝对离不开中国。因此，国会对当年的《排华法案》道歉是历史的必然。
15bae577887c339b463356d5090d4a65a19982a6.translatedText: Although the U.S. Congress "bowed" to China belatedly, the Chinese people are still excited and even grateful to Congress. Did Congress really pass the apology out of conscience? Observers don’t see it that way. They generally believe that Congress’s willingness to pass the Chinese Exclusion Act apology is not a whim, and there are profound reasons behind this. From a global perspective, the case of agreeing to apologize to the Chinese is inseparable from the rise of China. Today, China is one of the five permanent members of the United Nations. In 2010, China's economy surpassed Japan's and ranked second in the world. As a major country, the United States cannot handle world affairs without China. Therefore, it is a historical necessity for Congress to apologize for the Chinese Exclusion Act.

05e74cb793cb7bcd38027c98f35918e76d293d79.sourceText: 但观察家强调，让国会道歉的真正原因，在于在美华人经济条件的改善、文化素质的提升，以及政治地位的提高。放眼美国，华人移民早已不再是”猪仔”，他们的受教育程度也越来越高。在美国，他们已从?#21171;力阶层?#36880;步转变为”知识阶层”，从低等行业上升到实业与金融业，从不敢”发声”到参政议政、争取政治权益。在全美，华人已突破400万，是亚裔移民中的最大族群。有调查报告显示，到2020年，华裔将成为全美第三大少数族裔。华裔的隐形潜力绝对不容小觑。
05e74cb793cb7bcd38027c98f35918e76d293d79.translatedText: However, observers emphasized that the real reason for Congress to apologize lies in the improvement of the economic conditions, cultural quality and political status of the Chinese in the United States. Looking at the United States, Chinese immigrants are no longer "piglets" and their education levels are getting higher and higher. In the United States, they have gradually transformed from the "powerful class" to the "intellectual class". They have risen from low-level industries to the industrial and financial industries. They have never dared to "speak out" to participate in political discussions and fight for political rights. In the United States, the number of Chinese has exceeded 4 million, making them the largest ethnic group among Asian immigrants. A survey report shows that by 2020, Chinese Americans will become the third largest ethnic minority in the United States. The hidden potential of Chinese Americans cannot be underestimated.

26dc9a3e830e38b861594ba70f1a694fab7e70e5.sourceText: 2012年美国大选已经开锣，国会议员换届也随之登场。经济富裕和票源喜人的华人群体，自然被政客们所青睐，争得华人的支持无疑将为自己增加政治筹码。而通过对《排华法案》道歉案，则是拉拢华人的最好手段。
26dc9a3e830e38b861594ba70f1a694fab7e70e5.translatedText: The 2012 U.S. election has begun, and the election of members of Congress has also begun. The Chinese, who are economically prosperous and have a good vote base, are naturally favored by politicians. Winning the support of the Chinese will undoubtedly increase their political bargaining chips. And passing the apology for the Chinese Exclusion Act is the best way to win over the Chinese.

2fb7c44da6288aba42fc4db171e8eeef9eb54830.sourceText: 面对国会的道歉，华人不要盲目乐观，而是应该居安思危。有华人学者提醒说，实用主义是美国政客们惯用的伎俩，他们今天笼络华人是有所求，华人绝对不能因此而认为美国会始终对华人以礼相待。华人要做的是继续创造优越的经济条件，保持较高的文化修养，同时还要更加积极参政。让华人在美国的各个领域都能有用武之地，且成为中流砥柱。对于如今的国会道歉案，华人只能将其看作是个开端，后续要做的是”百尺竿头更进一步”。彻底让美国政府和国会对华人另眼相看，才是最终目标。
2fb7c44da6288aba42fc4db171e8eeef9eb54830.translatedText: Faced with the apology from Congress, the Chinese should not be blindly optimistic, but should be prepared for danger in times of peace. Some Chinese scholars reminded that pragmatism is a common tactic used by American politicians. They want to win over the Chinese today. The Chinese must not think that the United States will always treat the Chinese with courtesy. What the Chinese need to do is to continue to create superior economic conditions, maintain high cultural attainment, and at the same time participate more actively in politics. Let Chinese people be useful in various fields in the United States and become the mainstay. Regarding today's congressional apology, the Chinese can only regard it as a beginning, and what they need to do next is to "make further progress." The ultimate goal is to completely make the U.S. government and Congress look at the Chinese in a different light.

811d14fc649bb416305ef4d8f9f06643b24131ad.sourceText: 港媒：妻子刘永清传患乳癌 胡锦涛拒留军委主席(图)
811d14fc649bb416305ef4d8f9f06643b24131ad.translatedText: Hong Kong media: His wife Liu Yongqing is rumored to have breast cancer, and Hu Jintao refuses to stay as chairman of the Central Military Commission (photo)

10253c38552fdde5a1ba7acf84eb175dd87793d0.sourceText: 港媒：妻子刘永清传患乳癌 胡锦涛拒留军委主席(图) 北京消息透露，中共十八大将于10月10日至18日召…
10253c38552fdde5a1ba7acf84eb175dd87793d0.translatedText: Hong Kong media: His wife Liu Yongqing is rumored to have breast cancer, Hu Jintao refuses to stay as chairman of the Central Military Commission (photo) Beijing news revealed that the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China will be held from October 10 to 18...

a79db2a93c74789940ab86470e2a1f7b0797b812.sourceText: 北京消息透露，中共十八大将于10月10日至18日召开。消息还指，胡锦涛希望在十八大裸退，即同时交出总书记和军委主席两职，不学江泽民交出党权还要再坐两年才交军权那样。据悉，胡做此决定，除政治考虑外，还与其身体健康有关，但能否如愿要视乎党内权斗结果。此外，胡的夫人刘永清也传患乳癌正接受治疗。
a79db2a93c74789940ab86470e2a1f7b0797b812.translatedText: Beijing news revealed that the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China will be held from October 10 to 18. The source also said that Hu Jintao hopes to resign naked at the 18th National Congress, that is, handing over the two positions of general secretary and chairman of the Military Commission at the same time. He does not want to follow Jiang Zemin's example of handing over party power and sitting for another two years before handing over military power. It is reported that in addition to political considerations, Hu's decision was also related to his physical health. However, whether he can achieve his wish depends on the outcome of the power struggle within the party. In addition, Hu's wife Liu Yongqing is also rumored to be suffering from breast cancer and is receiving treatment.

8866ac6d5b83facc8c69b9a0348b4e3cc828d673.sourceText: 据本报获悉，前不久结束的北戴河会议，中共高层已议定十八大于10月10日至18日举行，有关决定将交在稍后举行的中共十七届七中全会确认并公布。据指，北戴河会议上胡锦涛还提出，希望在十八大同时交出总书记和军委主席职，不再因循前任总书记江泽民的做法，交出党权后还任军委主席两年，才交出军权。
8866ac6d5b83facc8c69b9a0348b4e3cc828d673.translatedText: According to this newspaper, at the Beidaihe Conference that ended not long ago, the top leaders of the Communist Party of China have agreed to hold the 18th National Congress from October 10 to 18. The relevant decision will be confirmed and announced at the Seventh Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China to be held later. It is reported that at the Beidaihe meeting, Hu Jintao also proposed that he would hand over the positions of general secretary and chairman of the Central Military Commission at the same time at the 18th National Congress. He would no longer follow the practice of former general secretary Jiang Zemin, who surrendered party power and remained chairman of the Central Military Commission for two years before handing over military power.

64dbd1a2a337ef133319c5a9c5609371d0995854.sourceText: 消息指，2002年十六大江泽民是以对胡锦涛「扶上马送一程」名义，将总书记职交胡锦涛，两年后才交军委主席职给胡，胡对此做法并不欣赏，认为不符合制度，不但被外界视为恋栈权力，还影响下届领导人施政。消息指，胡的「党性原则」很强，很在乎自己的政治声誉，力主交接班制度化。但愿望是否可行要视乎中共党内各派权力之争，将交七中全会议定。
64dbd1a2a337ef133319c5a9c5609371d0995854.translatedText: Sources indicate that at the 16th National Congress of the Communist Party of China in 2002, Jiang Zemin handed over the post of General Secretary to Hu Jintao in the name of "giving Hu Jintao a ride." Two years later, he handed over the post of Chairman of the Central Military Commission to Hu. Hu did not appreciate this move and considered it inconsistent with the system. Not only was it regarded by the outside world as clinging to power, but it also affected the governance of the next leader. Sources indicate that Hu has a strong "party spirit", cares about his political reputation, and advocates institutionalizing the succession. However, whether the wish is feasible depends on the power struggle between various factions within the CCP, and will be decided by the Seventh Plenary Session of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

d61a60c95e024f7064d76e0ba54338db508c63c3.sourceText: 据悉，胡锦涛希望全退还与健康有关。消息未透露胡患何恙，但海外早前有报道指，八十年代末胡主政西藏时，因高原缺氧患心脏病一直未癒，近年曾发作住院。胡近年外访或会见外宾，不时表现气虚及头脸浮肿，引外界猜测。消息还指，胡的夫人刘永清患乳腺癌正接受治疗。去年1月胡出访美国，以及今年七一来港出席回归纪念，刘都未有随行。
d61a60c95e024f7064d76e0ba54338db508c63c3.translatedText: It is reported that Hu Jintao hopes to return all the goods related to health. The news did not disclose what ailment Hu was suffering from, but overseas reports earlier stated that when Hu was in power in Tibet in the late 1980s, he suffered from a heart attack due to hypoxia at the plateau and has not recovered from it. In recent years, he suffered an attack and was hospitalized. In recent years, when Hu visited foreign countries or met with foreign guests, he often showed signs of qi deficiency and swelling of his head and face, which aroused speculation from the outside world. The news also pointed out that Hu’s wife Liu Yongqing was suffering from breast cancer and was receiving treatment. When Hu visited the United States in January last year and came to Hong Kong on July 1 this year to attend the handover commemoration, Liu was not accompanying him.

dbe6f0f05729db1a3c86b61d36e60b2d3e7321e9.sourceText: 另据路透社称来自三个与权力核心接近的人透露，胡锦涛退后，将安排李克强就任军委副主席，主管武警，改变现时总理无军权局面。而全国人大常委会昨闭幕，但无审议免重庆前市委书记薄熙来全国人大代表的议题。
dbe6f0f05729db1a3c86b61d36e60b2d3e7321e9.translatedText: According to Reuters, three people close to the core of power revealed that after Hu Jintao retreats, Li Keqiang will be appointed as Vice Chairman of the Military Commission and in charge of the armed police, changing the current situation where the prime minister has no military power. The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress closed yesterday, but did not consider the issue of expelling former Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Secretary Bo Xilai from the National People's Congress.

32485b163fe6be2ded4e1b3f97f14738b0cd683f.sourceText: 中国投资者大举购买美房地产
32485b163fe6be2ded4e1b3f97f14738b0cd683f.translatedText: Chinese investors are buying up US real estate on a large scale

e322363ddc305ac6065dedb7e65330be93add425.sourceText: 中国投资者大举购买美房地产 《纽约时报》发表文章说，过去是日本人。来自东京的有钱人进入美国，购买美国地标性…
e322363ddc305ac6065dedb7e65330be93add425.translatedText: Chinese investors are buying up US real estate on a large scale. The New York Times published an article saying that in the past it was the Japanese. Rich people from Tokyo enter the United States and buy American landmarks...

d864b6e04b2a0b4173280ffb7fb612a709b852ea.sourceText: 《纽约时报》发表文章说，过去是日本人。来自东京的有钱人进入美国，购买美国地标性资产，从纽约洛克菲勒中心到加州鹅卵石海滩高尔夫球场（Pebble Beach Golf Links）。四分之一世纪之后的今天，另一批有钱人来到美国购买地产–中国人。
d864b6e04b2a0b4173280ffb7fb612a709b852ea.translatedText: The New York Times published an article saying that in the past it was the Japanese. Wealthy people from Tokyo enter the United States and purchase landmark American assets, from Rockefeller Center in New York to Pebble Beach Golf Links in California. A quarter of a century later, another group of wealthy people came to the United States to buy real estate – the Chinese.

60dbeefb24998ecd3cc56ea6f2810ad0bd443b7c.sourceText: 《纽约时报》说，尽管日本人在1980年的地产投资不顺–有些日本投资者购买美国资产出价太高，日本随后也出现历史上最大规模的房地产市场崩溃–中国投资者正在美国四散各地。
60dbeefb24998ecd3cc56ea6f2810ad0bd443b7c.translatedText: The New York Times said that although Japanese real estate investment in 1980 was not going well - some Japanese investors paid too much for American assets, and Japan subsequently experienced the largest real estate market collapse in history - Chinese investors are scattering all over the United States.

81eead5a0d7b64573e4818aaa1f7421d6a5c5996.sourceText: 两年之前开始的个别购买正在变成寻求高级地产和数十亿美元的交易。到目前为止，1980年代的那种担心还没有出现–当时有人说日本会买下美国。相反，中国人，或至少是他们的金钱，很受欢迎。
81eead5a0d7b64573e4818aaa1f7421d6a5c5996.translatedText: Individual purchases that began two years ago are turning into a hunt for prime real estate and billion-dollar deals. So far, the fears of the 1980s - when some said Japan would buy up the United States - have not materialized. Instead, the Chinese, or at least their money, are in demand.

18ff0ed8fb3b4bdc9152fdae75c9981373e57418.sourceText: 有人说，如果国内经济下降，中国可能很快后撤，就像日本那样。中国经济疲弱迹象已经出现，金融系统最近受到压力。如果北京介入缓和金融系统的紧张并刺激增长，这些担忧就会消失。
18ff0ed8fb3b4bdc9152fdae75c9981373e57418.translatedText: Some people say that if the domestic economy declines, China may quickly retreat, just like Japan. Signs of economic weakness in China have emerged, with the financial system recently under pressure. If Beijing steps in to ease tensions in the financial system and stimulate growth, these concerns will disappear.

6930527a79c482465c965a2c37d4c7151d5de475.sourceText: 但是最近几个星期，纽约市的几笔大交易让地产界惊奇。北京最大的商业地产开发公司总经理张欣和巴西萨弗拉家族（Safra family）联手买下曼哈顿中城的通用汽车大厦。大连万达集团据说要在曼哈顿建设一座豪华酒店。万达也计划在伦敦建酒店。
6930527a79c482465c965a2c37d4c7151d5de475.translatedText: But in recent weeks, several big deals in New York City have surprised the real estate world. Zhang Xin, general manager of Beijing's largest commercial real estate development company, and Brazil's Safra family teamed up to buy the General Motors Building in midtown Manhattan. Dalian Wanda Group is said to be building a luxury hotel in Manhattan. Wanda also plans to build a hotel in London.

f5d89ba234444df09bec1565a9e525601310272c.sourceText: 交易超出玻璃钢材大楼：中国大陆和香港投资者也正在成为仅次于加拿大人的美国住房第二大买主。
f5d89ba234444df09bec1565a9e525601310272c.translatedText: Deals go beyond fiberglass towers: Chinese and Hong Kong investors are also becoming the second-largest buyers of U.S. homes after Canadians.

9bcdc9ccbde3d87f6e1feaba14cce284280c3d4a.sourceText: 地产机构仲量行（Jones Lang LaSalle Capital）国际主管科林斯（Steve Collins）说，”他们仅仅是开始。那里有令人难以置信的财富。”仲量行最近在上海和北京为潜在买主举行会议。
9bcdc9ccbde3d87f6e1feaba14cce284280c3d4a.translatedText: Steve Collins, international head of real estate agency Jones Lang LaSalle Capital, which recently held meetings for potential buyers in Shanghai and Beijing, said, "They are just the beginning. There is incredible wealth out there."

8dd6e8ba97f33869cd27b2db52d09f891e56513a.sourceText: 就目前来说，中国政府鼓励投资。中国银行已经成为美国商业地产交易的最大外国融资机构。北京愿意投资多元化。中国政府持有美国财政债券超过1万亿美元，但由于利率很低，这些投资收益很少。
8dd6e8ba97f33869cd27b2db52d09f891e56513a.translatedText: For now, the Chinese government encourages investment. Bank of China has become the largest foreign financing institution for U.S. commercial real estate transactions. Beijing is willing to diversify its investments. The Chinese government holds more than $1 trillion in U.S. Treasury bonds, but because of low interest rates, these investments earn little.

bd559fffad15c1dbffba8af0e44323ff500127c9.sourceText: 分析全球商务和经济趋势的机构、洛蒂姆集团（ Rhodium Group）研究主任哈纳曼（Thilo Hanemann）说，过去两年来，对超过财政债券之外的投资支持力度加大，北京鼓励中国投资者到纽约和其它大城市看地产。
bd559fffad15c1dbffba8af0e44323ff500127c9.translatedText: Thilo Hanemann, research director of Rhodium Group, an institution that analyzes global business and economic trends, said that in the past two years, support for investment beyond fiscal bonds has increased, and Beijing has encouraged Chinese investors to look at real estate in New York and other big cities.

db578c2305e0e550ea5933b479a3aec82fcbb514.sourceText: 中国人也不限于大项目，有些项目从商业地产角度看规模相当小。SOHO中国总经理张欣2011年投资6亿美元买下公园大道广场（Park Avenue Plaza）49%的股份。同年，中国一家航空公司下属地产机构、HNA集团以2.65亿美元买下六大道1180号大厦。HNA还在时代广场买下卡萨酒店的店铺。
db578c2305e0e550ea5933b479a3aec82fcbb514.translatedText: The Chinese are not limited to large projects. Some projects are quite small in scale from a commercial real estate perspective. Zhang Xin, general manager of SOHO China, invested US$600 million to buy 49% of the shares of Park Avenue Plaza in 2011. In the same year, HNA Group, a real estate agency affiliated with a Chinese airline, purchased the No. 1180 Sixth Avenue building for US$265 million. HNA also bought the Casa Hotel store in Times Square.

efcd64aa29e1eb7d02f842b8c40374cfdebdaca1.sourceText: 中国投资者和机构也在加州买下大酒店，包括大学城的喜来登（Sheraton Universal）、靠近旧金山机场的皇冠广场（Crowne Plaza in Burlingame）安大略的希尔顿酒店（Hilton Ontario）。他们也在俄亥俄州托利多买下河滨地块，在新泽西莫里斯镇（Morristown）买下办公楼。
efcd64aa29e1eb7d02f842b8c40374cfdebdaca1.translatedText: Chinese investors and institutions have also bought large hotels in California, including the Sheraton Universal in University City, the Crowne Plaza in Burlingame near San Francisco Airport, and the Hilton Ontario in Ontario. They also bought riverfront land in Toledo, Ohio, and an office building in Morristown, New Jersey.

cce894430bfceef9ea419d7c086099e9dadbcce7.sourceText: 中国机构和投资者也相信美国商业地产市场的潜在收益将高于世界上其他地区。办公楼、工业和零售业地产都已经触底反弹。随着经济好转，办公楼空置率下降，租金稳定。
cce894430bfceef9ea419d7c086099e9dadbcce7.translatedText: Chinese institutions and investors also believe that the potential returns in the U.S. commercial real estate market will be higher than in other parts of the world. Office, industrial and retail real estate have bottomed out. As the economy improves, office vacancy rates decline and rents stabilize.

6e80a4e707180e40a93f6a7d640889dbf6a8813b.sourceText: 最后的礼物————崔增祁先生悼念仪式
6e80a4e707180e40a93f6a7d640889dbf6a8813b.translatedText: The last gift————Mourning ceremony for Mr. Cui Zengqi

7f7d317416ba5262a90306085d74a88359facd0a.sourceText: 最后的礼物————崔增祁先生悼念仪式 编者桉： 崔增祁先生的悼念仪式由亚利桑那侨联和华联共同主办，中国驻洛杉矶…
7f7d317416ba5262a90306085d74a88359facd0a.translatedText: The last gift————Mourning ceremony for Mr. Cui Zengqi Editor: The memorial ceremony for Mr. Cui Zengqi was co-sponsored by the Arizona Overseas Chinese Federation and the Hualian Federation of China, and the Chinese Embassy in Los Angeles...

0b5d5f288e5e98e6b37e24a773152d786500ae6f.sourceText: 编者桉： 崔增祁先生的悼念仪式由亚利桑那侨联和华联共同主办，中国驻洛杉矶大使馆领事打来慰问电话，美国参议员约翰麦肯恩颁发了特别贡献信给崔先生，激励他在在社区孜孜不倦为大家提供服务的精神。悼念现场看到很多侨领，社团负责人，更让人感动的是大厅中那些熟悉的陌生人。他们中，有的只与崔先生有一面之缘，或者几面之缘，有的甚至只通过电话。但是那天他们都特地请假，来送先生。希望我们通过此文缅怀先生，完成他未完成的工作，继承他不朽的精神。
0b5d5f288e5e98e6b37e24a773152d786500ae6f.translatedText: Editor: Mr. Cui Zengqi’s memorial ceremony was co-sponsored by the Arizona Overseas Chinese Federation and the Overseas Chinese Federation. The consul of the Chinese Embassy in Los Angeles made a condolence call. U.S. Senator John McCain issued a special contribution letter to Mr. Cui, inspiring his tireless service to everyone in the community. At the memorial site, I saw many overseas Chinese leaders and community leaders, and what was even more touching were the familiar strangers in the hall. Some of them have only met Mr. Cui once or several times, and some even only through phone calls. But they all took special leave that day to see off their husband. I hope that through this article we will remember our husband, complete his unfinished work, and inherit his immortal spirit.

f27ec6c35d46e051c5c15d9b54286b61e0ce6057.sourceText: 2016年4月7日，美国凤凰城的天空一改往日万里晴空，忽然寒风瑟瑟，阴雨绵绵。亚利桑那的华人朋友的心情也如这天气一般落入低谷，大家怀着不舍的心情来到凤凰恒绿墓园送侨领崔增祁先生最后一程。 崔增祁现任大凤凰城侨联总会副主席，耆英会顾问，亚省斐匿中文学校校长。2016年4月2日凌晨与癌症抗争近20年的崔老因病医治无效与世长辞。 在崔老去世前四天，我收到了他最后一封邮件，是关于2016年美国国庆青少年绘画比赛的稿件。这新闻还没上两天，崔老离开的消息让我无法相信。他那么开朗，身体那么好，怎么可能这么快因病去世呢？朋友说他得了癌症，他已经与癌症斗争了近二十年，他常常是医院做完化疗，就到社区去开会，去工作的。我完全无法把这位多年来，在耆英会能歌善舞，在斐匿中文学校当校长，在侨联组织各种活动，四处旅游，还常常写文章的，健硕，欢快的崔老和一个常常做化疗的癌症患者联系起来。在我心中，他不仅是个健康的老人，甚至是从精神和身体上看比普通老人更健康的人。电视里那些化疗过的癌症患者，怎么会是那么精神，那么快乐的呢？
f27ec6c35d46e051c5c15d9b54286b61e0ce6057.translatedText: On April 7, 2016, the sky in Phoenix, USA, changed from the usual clear sky to a sudden cold wind and continuous rain. The mood of Chinese friends in Arizona also fell to the lowest point like this weather. With reluctance, everyone came to Phoenix Evergreen Cemetery to bid farewell to the overseas Chinese leader Mr. Cui Zengqi. Cui Zengqi is currently the vice-president of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Greater Phoenix City, advisor to the Senior Citizens Association, and principal of the Alberta Chinese School. In the early morning of April 2, 2016, Mr. Cui, who had been fighting cancer for nearly 20 years, passed away due to ineffective treatment. Four days before Mr. Cui passed away, I received his last email, which was about the submission for the 2016 U.S. National Day Youth Painting Competition. This news has not been in the news for two days, and I can’t believe the news that Mr. Cui has left. He was so cheerful and in such good health, how could he die of illness so quickly? A friend said that he had cancer. He had been fighting cancer for nearly 20 years. He often went to the community for meetings and work after receiving chemotherapy in the hospital. I can't relate at all to this strong and cheerful Mr. Cui, who has been singing and dancing in the Senior Citizens Association, serving as the principal of Feini Chinese School, organizing various activities in the Overseas Chinese Federation, traveling around, and often writing articles for many years, and a cancer patient who often undergoes chemotherapy. In my mind, he is not only a healthy old man, he is even mentally and physically healthier than the average old man. How come those cancer patients on TV who have undergone chemotherapy are so energetic and happy?

6fc2e613b2b37cc6b4a7b8f662507aee04bd4ec3.sourceText: 崔增祁手迹 在悼念大厅内的播放着崔老的简历，”生活的志向：生命不在于活得长，活得久，而是在活得精彩，活得充实，活得有价值。”崔先生的追悼会在星期四举行，坐在我身边的华人朋友也是请假特地来参加。我问她和崔先生有什么交情，她就说她也是一名癌症患者。剩下的一切尽在不言中，我们的交流浅淡既止。 一位来自chandler的华人朋友，走上了演讲台，她说刚搬到凤凰城，想给爸爸妈妈找个老年人居住的地方，当时别人就建议她联系崔先生。对于陌生人的咨询，崔先生耐心讲解，还欢迎他们到康乐大厦参观。崔老亲自带他们参观那里老年人的生活。这让他们一家感到特别温暖。本来想什么时候送一个小礼物表达谢意，没想到，听到崔老去世的消息，痛失最后的机会。一位还在中国的当地华人朋友，也特地找朋友代表他来到现场，他前些日子还接到崔老的电话，讨论青少年画展的事情，当时就听他在电话里的声音有点虚。真没想到那就成了最后一次交流。现代中文学校和希望中文学校的校长也走上台悼念崔老，大家还在等待崔老的更多关于绘画比赛的通知，斐匿中文学校复课的通知，还有那么多事情说好要一起做的，如今崔老就匆匆离去了。。。。崔老说”对人生有热情的人，不管身在何处，永远有事要做，永远有话要说，也永远不会寂寞”。 崔老用自己的实际行动，实践着他的人生志向，在生命的最后一分钟还在做事，还在说为他送行不要伤心。 崔老走了，他送给了在座的我们一份珍贵的礼物，也是最后的礼物：一个精彩的，有价值的，不寂寞的人生。
6fc2e613b2b37cc6b4a7b8f662507aee04bd4ec3.translatedText: > Cui Zengqi's handwriting. Mr. Cui's resume was played in the memorial hall, "The ambition of life: life is not to live long, but to live wonderfully, live fully, and live valuable." Mr. Cui's memorial service was held on Thursday, and the Chinese friend sitting next to me also took time off to attend. I asked her about her relationship with Mr. Cui, and she said that she was also a cancer patient. All the rest was left unsaid, and our communication ceased to be superficial. A Chinese friend from Chandler took the stage. She said that she had just moved to Phoenix and wanted to find a place for her parents to live for the elderly. At that time, someone suggested that she contact Mr. Cui. Mr. Cui patiently explained the inquiries from strangers and welcomed them to visit the Kang Le Building. Cui Lao personally took them to see the life of the elderly there. This made their family feel particularly warm. I originally wanted to send a small gift to express my gratitude. Unexpectedly, when I heard the news of Mr. Cui's death, I lost my last chance. A local Chinese friend who is still in China also specially asked a friend to come to the scene on his behalf. He received a call from Mr. Cui a few days ago to discuss the youth art exhibition. At that time, his voice on the phone sounded a bit hollow. I didn't expect that it would be the last exchange. The principals of Modern Chinese School and Hope Chinese School also came to the stage to mourn Mr. Cui. Everyone is still waiting for more notices from Mr. Cui about the painting competition, the notice about the resumption of classes at Fenni Chinese School, and there are so many things that we agreed to do together, but now Mr. Cui has left in a hurry. . . . Mr. Cui said, "Those who are passionate about life will always have something to do and something to say, no matter where they are, and they will never be lonely." Mr. Cui used his actual actions to practice his life ambitions. He was still doing things at the last minute of his life and said not to be sad to see him off. Cui Lao left, and he gave us here a precious gift, which is also the last gift: a wonderful, valuable, and not lonely life.

55b5f5563b12ce2aa562bb05d4689e4cbee439ae.sourceText: 中新网10月17日电， 美国南加州的圣迭戈阳光灿烂，被认为是美国气候最棒的城市之一。据台湾”中广新闻网”报道，在一家健康杂志的调查中，它也获选为全美”最幸运的城市”。
55b5f5563b12ce2aa562bb05d4689e4cbee439ae.translatedText: China News Service, October 17th. San Diego in Southern California is sunny and is considered to be one of the cities with the best climate in the United States. According to Taiwan's "China Broadcasting News Network", it was also selected as the "luckiest city" in the United States in a survey by a health magazine.

cfa1b6f5a04c05bf146184a7c947a2d5f5276fbb.sourceText: 巴尔的摩、凤凰城、达拉瓦的威明顿、弗吉尼亚的里奇蒙以及赌城拉斯韦加斯也都挤进前十名。
cfa1b6f5a04c05bf146184a7c947a2d5f5276fbb.translatedText: Baltimore, Phoenix, Wilmington, Virginia, Richmond, Virginia and the casino city of Las Vegas also made the top ten.

0164d8016b82904c12f7514f15d8cfc62525f6c7.sourceText: 这项全美百大幸运城市调查，评量依据包括彩票中奖率、高尔夫球一杆进洞率、被雷打到的机率、被东西砸死的机率等等。
0164d8016b82904c12f7514f15d8cfc62525f6c7.translatedText: This survey of the top 100 lucky cities in the United States is based on factors such as lottery winning rate, golf hole-in-one rate, probability of being struck by lightning, probability of being hit by something, etc.

7ad4c5ad9c5016ce39456f7a92681141affb557e.sourceText: 在天秤的另一头，也就是最倒霉的城市第一名是西弗吉尼亚的查尔斯顿。根据调查，查尔斯顿居民被东西意外砸死的机率是圣迭戈的4倍，当地也从来没有人中过彩票头彩。
7ad4c5ad9c5016ce39456f7a92681141affb557e.translatedText: On the other end of the scale, the number one unlucky city is Charleston, West Virginia. According to surveys, Charleston residents are four times more likely to be accidentally hit by something than San Diego residents, and no one there has ever won the lottery jackpot.

d3c33918eca6b0f4b0ebf31960fcc586930ee055.sourceText: 华人关注的10大美国危险城市
d3c33918eca6b0f4b0ebf31960fcc586930ee055.translatedText: Top 10 most dangerous cities in the United States that Chinese people are concerned about

4124ed276e2a680892d6b7f44a5d4243d6db327b.sourceText: 没有市长愿意让自己的城市得到”最危险城市”的称号，然而暴力犯罪、贩毒和帮派活动却蔓延在许多大城市中。
4124ed276e2a680892d6b7f44a5d4243d6db327b.translatedText: No mayor is willing to let his city get the title of "the most dangerous city", but violent crime, drug trafficking and gang activities are spreading in many big cities.

3d20dc2a2dd827c1858f7b7155d5d86abffc4aa9.sourceText: 美国《生活》杂志近日列出一份华人关注的美国十大危险城市列表，以下即列表内容。
3d20dc2a2dd827c1858f7b7155d5d86abffc4aa9.translatedText: The American "Life" magazine recently listed a list of the top ten dangerous cities in the United States that Chinese people are concerned about. The following is the list.

6efbd1134d343f6ff54e6b45f4dcb261243c0b94.sourceText: 第十位：伊利诺伊州的罗克福德：受毒贩欢迎的中间站。
6efbd1134d343f6ff54e6b45f4dcb261243c0b94.translatedText: No. 10: Rockford, Illinois: A popular halfway house for drug dealers.

bb828979456ab2203f1db122e1bdbfe736b5e440.sourceText: 第九位：内华达州的拉斯维加斯：受赌徒欢迎的”罪恶”之城，地产危机是它犯罪率猛增的一个原因，它还充斥着大量的抢劫和攻击行为。
bb828979456ab2203f1db122e1bdbfe736b5e440.translatedText: Ninth place: Las Vegas, Nevada: A "sin" city popular with gamblers. The real estate crisis is one of the reasons for the surge in its crime rate. It is also filled with a large number of robberies and assaults.

55840a653fa187a0886e4fb63874a6246af82ac8.sourceText: 第八位：佛罗里达州的塔拉哈西：在佛罗里达州犯罪率最高的城市，贫穷和毒品走私肆虐着这个城市。
55840a653fa187a0886e4fb63874a6246af82ac8.translatedText: No. 8: Tallahassee, Florida: Poverty and drug trafficking plague the city with the highest crime rate in Florida.

96ba434b3fddb128eb4b8ebeaa6c0e3510a1ae82.sourceText: 第七位：加州的斯托克顿：毒贩利用这个城市的发达航道贩毒，并助长了帮派斗争。
96ba434b3fddb128eb4b8ebeaa6c0e3510a1ae82.translatedText: No. 7: Stockton, California: Drug dealers use the city's well-developed waterways to sell drugs and fuel gang wars.

c5db2486023a93ca07bf5ef414cdc876862ecec5.sourceText: 第六位：德克斯萨斯州的拉伯克：贩卖可卡因和兴奋剂的中转站。
c5db2486023a93ca07bf5ef414cdc876862ecec5.translatedText: No. 6: Lubbock, Texas: a transit point for the trafficking of cocaine and stimulants.

95ce416e8895a69b1ed6fd02270aa38f53790474.sourceText: 第五位：阿拉斯加州的安克雷奇：犯罪率是州犯罪率的两倍，州内强奸案最多的城市。
95ce416e8895a69b1ed6fd02270aa38f53790474.translatedText: Fifth place: Anchorage, Alaska: The crime rate is twice the state crime rate and the city with the most rapes in the state.

f4d5261ce395161fa424d7b6a8f9f8cab18fd9cc.sourceText: 第四位：密歇根州的弗林特：多年高失业率，当地经济不振，需长时间恢复，居高不下的高犯罪率。
f4d5261ce395161fa424d7b6a8f9f8cab18fd9cc.translatedText: Fourth place: Flint, Michigan: years of high unemployment, a sluggish local economy that will take a long time to recover, and a high crime rate.

2339362f7dffbe34bc3d2855268696b9a38c87fa.sourceText: 第三位：伊利诺伊州的斯普林菲尔德：高犯罪率，高贫困率，44岁以下居民居多，这也成为暴力犯罪的潜在因素。
2339362f7dffbe34bc3d2855268696b9a38c87fa.translatedText: Third place: Springfield, Illinois: High crime rate, high poverty rate, majority of residents under the age of 44, which has also become a potential factor for violent crime.

b49b73cda12cb1918bcb90af34ab73f6c13978d8.sourceText: 第二位：田纳西州的孟菲斯：美国城市中最贫困的，也导致了它的高犯罪率。
b49b73cda12cb1918bcb90af34ab73f6c13978d8.translatedText: No. 2: Memphis, Tennessee: The poorest city in the United States, which also contributes to its high crime rate.

dcf28124312db7ccf7b62e48f719b6feeeb2d151.sourceText: 第一位：密歇根州的底特律：高犯罪率，高自杀率及高失业率。
dcf28124312db7ccf7b62e48f719b6feeeb2d151.translatedText: No. 1: Detroit, Michigan: high crime rate, high suicide rate and high unemployment rate.

3dfbff870c9e101a8bbdfc72cee018557c33d469.sourceText: 图森一老师向女生颁发“不做作业奖”惹怒家长 （亚省时报） 图森一所学校的教师向一名8岁女生颁发”灾难奖”，理由是这名学生不完成家庭作业的理由最多。 女孩的母亲克里斯蒂娜 瓦尔迪兹大为不满，5月31日告诉地方电视台KGUN桾V，她的女儿卡桑德拉 西亚有一天放学回家时带回一个纸质”奖章”。”奖章”看似彩色卡片，上写：”你最棒！灾难奖。奖给桑德拉 加西亚。奖励你有最多不完成家庭作业的理由。” 加西亚的任课教师在卡片上署名”普洛曼女士”，附日期”2012年5月18日”和一个笑脸图案。教师当着全班学生的面把”奖”颁给加西亚，激起哄堂大笑。瓦尔迪兹后来找到学校校长，得到的答复是”只是玩笑” 瓦尔迪兹说：”我觉得，这是件残酷的事，不应该给孩子发这样的’奖’。”加西亚在完成家庭作业方面没有问题，还参加一个课后辅导班。 校方人员拒绝就这件事接受媒体采访。
3dfbff870c9e101a8bbdfc72cee018557c33d469.translatedText: A Tucson teacher gave a girl a "no homework award" and angered parents (Alberta Times) A teacher at a Tucson school awarded an 8-year-old girl a "disaster award" for having the most excuses for not completing her homework. The girl's mother, Christina Valdez, was dissatisfied and told local television station KGUN桾V on May 31 that her daughter Cassandra Sia brought home a paper "medal" from school one day. The "medal" looks like a colorful card that reads: "You're the best! Disaster award. Awarded to Sandra Garcia. For the most excuses for not completing your homework." Garcia's classroom teacher signed the card "Ms. Plowman," with the date "May 18, 2012" and a smiley face. The teacher awarded the "award" to Garcia in front of the whole class, causing the whole class to burst into laughter. Valdez later approached the school principal and received the reply that it was "just a joke." Valdez said: "I think this is a cruel thing and should not be given to children such an 'award.'" Garcia has no problem completing homework and participates in an after-school tutoring class. School officials declined to speak to the media about the incident.

e558b4a1cd7138b08c400fde5da25fca90c436e7.translatedText: Obstacles to the construction of Apple's Arizona sapphire factory have been cleared. Recently, the Gilbert Unified School District in the United States has unanimously agreed to expand the nearby foreign trade area...

6cf57f93adaacfbd49b6f4a05a85e2db1bd385a3.sourceText: 近日，美国吉尔伯特联合学区一致同意将附近的对外贸易区域进行扩展，其中苹果的蓝宝石工厂也将被列入其中。而在一周之前，该学区董事会的五名成员中有两名并不同意这一方案。 在该对外贸易区内，苹果将要购买设备的不动产税比这家公司年不动产税减少70%。由于存在一些潜在的影响，该区域内的每家征税组织将都必须要签订一份协议。
6cf57f93adaacfbd49b6f4a05a85e2db1bd385a3.translatedText: Recently, the Gilbert Unified School District in the United States has unanimously agreed to expand the nearby foreign trade area, including Apple's sapphire factory. A week ago, two of the district's five board members disagreed with the plan. In the foreign trade zone, the real estate tax for the equipment Apple will purchase is 70% lower than the company’s annual real estate tax. Due to some of the potential impacts, every taxing organization in the area will be required to enter into an agreement.

8dcf7bee951edc2ea6c9ca9cf5062762d5e97bf1.sourceText: 据悉，苹果发言人曾告知过该区域的董事会，如果他们这边不通过对外贸易区的提案，那么他们将会考虑将工厂移到其他州，毕竟仍有多个州正在努力争取这份协议。
8dcf7bee951edc2ea6c9ca9cf5062762d5e97bf1.translatedText: It is reported that an Apple spokesperson has told the regional board of directors that if they do not pass the foreign trade zone proposal, they will consider moving the factory to other states. After all, there are still many states working hard to obtain this agreement.

0a0e2abb95f24d2a473319be480f08311385bac1.sourceText: 10 月 25 至 28 日，美莎市友好访问代表团一行 16 人，在美莎市姐妹城市协会开平委员会主席黄智杰先生的率领下，抵达开平进行为期 4 天的友好访问，受到开平市政府的热烈欢迎和圣情接待。
0a0e2abb95f24d2a473319be480f08311385bac1.translatedText: From October 25 to 28, the Mesa City Friendship Delegation and his delegation 16 People, led by Mr. Huang Zhijie, chairman of the Kaiping Committee of the Mesha Sister Cities Association, arrived in Kaiping for a four-day goodwill visit and were warmly welcomed and received by the Kaiping City Government.

51140226a7e6d88b0151a21b50851391c1346506.sourceText: 开平市与美莎市于 1994 年结为友好姐妹城市。 17 年来，双方在文化、教育和经贸领域的交流不断拓展，两市的友谊也在交往中不断得到巩固。侨乡开平， 历史悠久 ， 环境优美，民风纯朴， 投资促进 ， 对外贸易 ， 开平市充满了吸引力 。 为了进一步推动两市的友好合作，深化两市间的文化、经济及多领域，开创两市友好往来的新局面。去年 11 月，开平黄耀雄市长率开平代表团访问美国期间，专程访问了美莎市，得到美莎市姐妹城市协会和美莎市市长的热情接待。此次，美莎市姐妹城市协会应开平黄耀雄市长的邀请和亚省开平同乡会的大力支持下组团回访开平市，实现两市互访，是两市进一步加强沟通与交流，推动两市发展友好合作关系的具体行动与表现。
51140226a7e6d88b0151a21b50851391c1346506.translatedText: Kaiping City and Mesha City became sister cities in 1994. Over the past 17 years, exchanges between the two sides in the fields of culture, education, economy and trade have continued to expand, and the friendship between the two cities has also been continuously consolidated through exchanges. Kaiping, the hometown of overseas Chinese, has a long history, beautiful environment, simple folk customs, investment promotion, and foreign trade. Kaiping City is full of attractions. In order to further promote the friendly cooperation between the two cities, deepen the cultural, economic and multiple fields between the two cities, and create a new situation of friendly exchanges between the two cities. Last November, Kaiping Mayor Huang Yaoxiong led a Kaiping delegation to visit the United States. They made a special trip to Mesa City and received a warm reception from the Mesa Sister Cities Association and the mayor of Mesa City. This time, at the invitation of Mayor Huang Yaoxiong of Kaiping and with the strong support of the Kaiping Association of Kaiping, Mesa City Sister Cities Association organized a delegation to visit Kaiping City and realized mutual visits between the two cities. This is a concrete action and performance of the two cities to further strengthen communication and exchanges and promote the development of friendly cooperative relations between the two cities.

f76fb40b8319013b3e739fe381cafacea97d820a.sourceText: 在开平市访问期间，美莎市友好代表团一行在市外侨局、侨联领导的陪同下，到旅游景点、工厂、学校、文广新局等地进行了参观与交流活动，先后参观了立园、自力村碉楼与村落、赤坎古镇等景点，爱颖纺织、华艺卫浴等公司，以及开平一中、开侨中学，翠山湖开发区，还专程探访亚省开平同乡会会长 关兆峰住开平百合镇松朗龙湾村的 101 岁的老祖母 。在文广新局参观时，该局局长谭伟强热情地接待了客人，并进行了友好会谈和交流，他们对纺织卫浴和美丽的侨乡很感兴趣。在立园、自力村内，访问团成员对中西合璧的园林建筑艺术和华侨文化表现了浓厚的兴趣，并对侨乡开平积极对碉楼资源进行挖掘工作表示赞赏。在开平一中，访问团成员与学生们进行了热烈的交流，并兴致勃勃地与师生们合影留念。
f76fb40b8319013b3e739fe381cafacea97d820a.translatedText: During the visit to Kaiping City, the Mesha City Friendship Delegation, accompanied by the leaders of the Municipal Overseas Chinese Bureau and the Overseas Chinese Federation, visited tourist attractions, factories, schools, the New Bureau of Culture, Radio and Television and other places. During the exchange activities, we visited scenic spots such as Liyuan Garden, Zili Village Watchtowers and Villages, Chikan Ancient Town, companies such as Aiying Textile and Huayi Sanitary Ware, Kaiping No. 1 Middle School, Kaiqiao Middle School, and Cuishan Lake Development Zone. We also made a special trip to visit the president of the Kaiping Association of Kaiping, Alberta. Guan Zhaofeng is a 101-year-old grandmother who lives in Longwan Village, Songlang, Baihe Town, Kaiping. During the visit to the New Bureau of Culture, Media, Radio and Television, Tan Weiqiang, director of the Bureau, warmly received the guests and had friendly talks and exchanges. They were very interested in textile sanitary ware and the beautiful hometown of overseas Chinese. In Liyuan and Zili Village, members of the visiting delegation showed strong interest in the art of garden architecture that combines Chinese and Western styles and the overseas Chinese culture, and expressed their appreciation for Kaiping, the hometown of overseas Chinese, for their active exploration of watchtower resources. In Kaiping No. 1 Middle School, members of the visiting delegation had a lively exchange with the students and happily took photos with the teachers and students.

84bc0f170d4a3757f5c7ed3bb1e408e9187a9244.sourceText: 27 日晚，开平市人民政府在半岛酒店举行晚宴，热情欢迎美莎市友好访问代表团一行。市长黄耀雄，市人大常务副主任张星杰，市委常委颜海娜，市政协副主席林国宁，市府办公室主任何武健，市外事侨务局、文广新局、教育局、经信局相关部门领导以及去年 11 月出访美加开平代表团成员出席了晚宴。
84bc0f170d4a3757f5c7ed3bb1e408e9187a9244.translatedText: On the evening of the 27th, the Kaiping Municipal People's Government held a dinner at the Peninsula Hotel to warmly welcome the Meisha City friendly visit delegation. Mayor Huang Yaoxiong, Executive Deputy Director of the Municipal People's Congress Zhang Xingjie, Member of the Standing Committee of the Municipal Party Committee Yan Haina, Vice Chairman of the CPPCC Lin Guoning, Municipal Office Director He Wujian, leaders of relevant departments of the Municipal Foreign Affairs and Overseas Chinese Affairs Bureau, the Bureau of Culture, Media, Radio and Television, the Education Bureau, and the Economic and Information Technology Bureau, as well as members of the Kaiping delegation that visited the United States and Canada in November last year attended the dinner.

67cb84adf18db36c395f6cee29ff036868b4069f.sourceText: 在晚宴上，市长黄耀雄致欢迎词。黄耀雄说：” 秋风送爽、秋色宜人，我们有幸迎来了美国亚历桑那州美莎市姐妹城市协会的尊贵客人，我真诚地希望美莎市姐妹城市协会继续发挥桥梁纽带作用，加强和增进两市的交流与合作。” 他指出，一是推介我市投资环境。二是深化经贸合作，诚意邀请各位客人参与我市举行第六届中国（开平）牛仔服装节开幕式，加深对开平牛仔服装行业的了解，推进彼此的经贸合作。三是加强文化、教育的交流。期望两市在平等互利，扩大交流，深化合作的基础上，达到优势互补，共赢发展的目的。在晚宴上双方还进行了纪念品的互赠仪式。
67cb84adf18db36c395f6cee29ff036868b4069f.translatedText: At the dinner, Mayor Huang Yaoxiong delivered a welcome speech. Huang Yaoxiong said: "The autumn breeze is refreshing and the autumn colors are pleasant. We are fortunate to welcome the distinguished guests of the Sister Cities Association of Mesa, Arizona, USA. I sincerely hope that the Mesa Sister Cities Association will continue to play a role as a bridge and link to strengthen and enhance exchanges and cooperation between the two cities." He pointed out that the first is to promote the investment environment of our city. The second is to deepen economic and trade cooperation. We sincerely invite all guests to participate in the opening ceremony of the 6th China (Kaiping) Denim Clothing Festival held in our city to deepen our understanding of the Kaiping denim clothing industry and promote mutual economic and trade cooperation. The third is to strengthen cultural and educational exchanges. It is expected that the two cities will achieve the goal of complementary advantages and win-win development on the basis of equality and mutual benefit, expanding exchanges and deepening cooperation. During the dinner, the two parties also exchanged souvenirs.

dfc20c7ec1c49a96f79be7612c4f3afa26ac9ebf.sourceText: 据悉，两市期望通过这次访问，能进一步推进两市的友好交流与合作关系，推进两市的经贸合作、文化艺术和教育交流与开展多层次的联谊活动。
dfc20c7ec1c49a96f79be7612c4f3afa26ac9ebf.translatedText: It is reported that the two cities hope that through this visit, they can further promote the friendly exchanges and cooperation between the two cities, promote economic and trade cooperation, cultural and artistic exchanges and educational exchanges between the two cities, and carry out multi-level networking activities.

8639009adae9bf3cac5ff1f365e867bb51796517.sourceText: 格兰岱禁建新赌场问题闹上国会 上周四，美国国会众议院小组通过一项来自亚利桑那共和党的提案，禁止本州的Tohono O’odham部落在格兰岱尔建设新赌场。 格兰岱和谷区两个印第安部落领导人对此表示赞赏，而来自皮奥利亚和Tohono O’odham部落则气愤不平，宣称此禁令打破了选民对部落的承诺。 1960年，美国陆军工程兵部队在吉拉河修建画岩水坝，导致部落的土地9880英亩受到洪水冲洗，摧毁了750英亩农场，严重影响了Tohono O’odham部落的收入。在本州的国会议员强烈要求下，美国国会通过一项法案，在1986年给Tohono O’odham部落30万美元在皮马，皮纳尔和马利科巴郡范围内购买共9880英亩的保留地作为赔偿。 Tohono O’odham部落在马利科巴郡购买了135英亩位于皮奥利亚和格兰岱之间，并打算用来兴建赌场。这一计划令两市选民争吵不休。 皮奥利亚市长鲍勃贝瑞特认为，赌场计划可以建成一个经济实惠的度假胜地。但格兰岱官员说，部落关于赌场的计划影响了该市体育和娱乐区的建设，最终导致拖慢税收，影响整个城市的经济。市领导和一些居民对赌场选址意见很大，认为部落在一所高中的对面兴建赌场简直不可思议。格兰岱选民投票反对赌场兴建。 禁令提案是由亚利桑那州共和党议员特伦弗兰克斯提出，众议院自然资源委员会以32-11通过。本州有两位众议员担任委员会成员，一位是共和党的保罗戈沙，一位是民主党的劳尔格里亚瓦。戈沙支持提案，格里亚瓦投反对票。 部落要建赌场，要得到内政部同意。此时内政部官员说，弗兰克斯提案违背1986年的法律。当年的法律应该是：赔偿给Tohono O’odham部落购买的土地，”应被视为联邦印第安保留区为目的，”包括博彩。 按现行亚利桑那州法律，大凤凰城谷区最多容纳7个保留地赌场，Tohono O’odham部落提出的赌场计划为第8个。另，Tohono O’odham部落在本州已经经营两个赌场，这次提出的为第3个。 目前尚未清楚众议院是否通过草案，估计共和党不会诸多刁难。但上到民主党主导的参议院就不好说了。
8639009adae9bf3cac5ff1f365e867bb51796517.translatedText: The issue of banning new casinos in Glendale comes to Congress. On Thursday, a U.S. House of Representatives panel passed a proposal from the Arizona Republican Party to ban the state's Tohono O'odham tribe from building new casinos in Glendale. Leaders of the Glendale and Valley Indian tribes applauded the move, while leaders from the Peoria and Tohono O’odham tribes were furious, saying the ban broke voters’ commitment to their tribes. In 1960, the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers built the Pictured Rock Dam on the Gila River, causing flooding of 9,880 acres of tribal land, destroying 750 acres of farms, and severely affecting the Tohono O’odham Tribe’s income. After strong demands from members of the state's Congress, the U.S. Congress passed a bill in 1986 that gave the Tohono O'odham tribe $300,000 to purchase a total of 9,880 acres of reservation land in Pima, Pinal and Maricopa counties as compensation. The Tohono O’odham Tribe purchased 135 acres in Maricopa County between Peoria and Glendale with the intention of building a casino. The plan pitted voters in both cities at loggerheads. Peoria Mayor Bob Barrett believes the casino plan could create an affordable resort. But Glendale officials say the tribe's plans for the casino interfered with the construction of the city's sports and entertainment district, ultimately slowing down tax revenues and affecting the entire city's economy. City leaders and some residents had strong objections to the casino's location, saying it was unthinkable that a tribe would build a casino across from a high school. Glendale voters vote against casino construction. The ban proposal was introduced by Arizona Republican Rep. Terron Franks and passed the House Natural Resources Committee 32-11. The state has two representatives serving on the committee, Republican Paul Gosha and Democratic Raul Griava. Gosha supported the proposal, while Griava voted against it. If a tribe wants to build a casino, it must obtain approval from the Ministry of Interior. At this time, Interior Ministry officials said the Franks proposal violated the 1986 law. The law at the time should have been that the land purchased by the Tohono O’odham Tribe “shall be treated as a federal Indian reservation for purposes,” including gaming. According to current Arizona law, the greater Phoenix Valley area can accommodate up to seven reservation casinos, and the casino plan proposed by the Tohono O’odham Tribe is the eighth. In addition, the Tohono O’odham Tribe already operates two casinos in the state, and this is the third one proposed. It is not yet clear whether the House of Representatives has passed the draft, and it is estimated that the Republicans will not create many difficulties. But it's hard to say when it comes to the Democratic-dominated Senate.

2b94cf72d8dca3a20385e67ee7af9fd565c41400.sourceText: 新疆正成为中国向西开放的桥头堡
2b94cf72d8dca3a20385e67ee7af9fd565c41400.translatedText: Xinjiang is becoming the bridgehead for China’s opening to the west

7ce238aa7b370a5810cf4af084b52462318e0830.sourceText: 新疆正成为中国向西开放的桥头堡 新华网 ４日，新疆维吾尔自治区主席努尔白克力说，当前我们比以往任何时候更需…
7ce238aa7b370a5810cf4af084b52462318e0830.translatedText: Xinjiang is becoming the bridgehead for China’s opening to the west Xinhuanet On the 4th, Nur Bekri, Chairman of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, said that currently we need to open up more than ever...

e9aa2c607d44298756c2a7232070b35b6b990104.sourceText: ４日，新疆维吾尔自治区主席努尔白克力说，当前我们比以往任何时候更需要开放，今后新疆将义无反顾、一如既往进一步加大开放力度。
e9aa2c607d44298756c2a7232070b35b6b990104.translatedText: On the 4th, Nur Bekri, Chairman of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, said that currently we need to open up more than ever. In the future, Xinjiang will not look back and continue to further increase opening up.

2d23a400052ba7aeeb47723aafb96b97cdfdaec9.sourceText: 努尔白克力在当天新疆举办的”开放的新疆更开放”座谈会上说，当前新时期新阶段，要实现新疆科学发展、后发赶超，更需要我们全力推进对内对外开放，在更大范围、更广领域、更高层次上参与国际国内经济技术合作与竞争，更好地利用区内区外两种资源、两个市场。
2d23a400052ba7aeeb47723aafb96b97cdfdaec9.translatedText: Nur Bekri said at the "Open Xinjiang is More Open" symposium held in Xinjiang that day that in the current new era and new stage, to achieve scientific development in Xinjiang and catch up with latecomers, we need to fully promote opening up to the outside world, participate in international and domestic economic and technological cooperation and competition on a larger scale, in wider fields, and at a higher level, and make better use of two resources and two markets inside and outside the region.

080b1ba36af1532d4b775a13dd33d4ca0ada2b73.sourceText: 他要求各级政府、各有关部门必须树立世界眼光、形成战略思维，从全局的战略的高度充分认识新时期新疆对外开放的重大意义，进一步优化开放环境、拓展开放空间、增强开放活力，努力把新疆的对外开放提高到一个新的水平。
080b1ba36af1532d4b775a13dd33d4ca0ada2b73.translatedText: He required governments at all levels and relevant departments to establish a world perspective, form strategic thinking, fully understand the significance of Xinjiang's opening to the outside world in the new era from an overall strategic perspective, further optimize the opening environment, expand open space, enhance opening vitality, and strive to raise Xinjiang's opening to the outside world to a new level.

43c478a3516f95af631b51cf10ec7e3a108510a5.sourceText: 改革开放以来特别是近年来，新疆坚持”外引内联、东联西出、西来东去”的方针，实行”引进来，走出去”相结合，充分发挥向西开放的地缘区位优势，使新疆由闭塞落后的西部边陲省区发展成为中国向西开放的前沿阵地，目前与１６０多个国家和地区建立了经贸合作关系。
43c478a3516f95af631b51cf10ec7e3a108510a5.translatedText: Since the reform and opening up, especially in recent years, Xinjiang has adhered to the policy of "introducing externally and connecting internally, linking the east with the west, and going from the west to the east" and implemented the combination of "bringing in and going out" to give full play to the geographical advantages of opening to the west. Xinjiang has developed from a closed and backward western border province into a frontier for China's opening to the west. Currently, it has established economic and trade cooperation relations with more than 160 countries and regions.

2280e5f5399eb4e623cc56f9dda64a5bfd76fd62.sourceText: 努尔白克力说，目前，新疆正在编制《新疆向西开放发展规划》，争取把新疆向西开放真正上升到国家战略加以推进，把新疆建设成为中国向西开放的桥头堡，陆上能源资源大通道。
2280e5f5399eb4e623cc56f9dda64a5bfd76fd62.translatedText: Nur Bekri said that currently, Xinjiang is formulating the "Xinjiang Opening to the West Development Plan", striving to truly elevate Xinjiang's opening to the west to a national strategy and promote it, and build Xinjiang into a bridgehead for China's opening to the west and a major land channel for energy resources.

faf1e73253742b22af7858a9e8c0ed9bd756c7cf.sourceText: 新疆维吾尔自治区商务厅厅长和宜明说，目前新疆已形成全方位、宽领域、多层次的对外开放新格局。
faf1e73253742b22af7858a9e8c0ed9bd756c7cf.translatedText: He Yiming, director of the Department of Commerce of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, said that Xinjiang has now formed a new pattern of all-round, wide-ranging, and multi-level opening up to the outside world.

2ba827852319d99b5707d7e619b6bf777accadfa.sourceText: 他４日透露，中国与其他国家建立的首个国际边境合作中心棗中哈霍尔果斯国际边境合作中心将于今年第三季度实现封关运营，这是由中哈两国元首共同促成的跨境合作区，届时中哈两国及第三国公民可在这一跨国”大市场”内，自由进行商贸洽谈和商品交易。
2ba827852319d99b5707d7e619b6bf777accadfa.translatedText: He revealed on the 4th that the China-Kazakhstan Horgos International Border Cooperation Center, the first international border cooperation center established between China and other countries, will be closed for operations in the third quarter of this year. This is a cross-border cooperation zone jointly promoted by the heads of state of China and Kazakhstan. By then, citizens of China and Kazakhstan and third countries can freely conduct business negotiations and commodity transactions in this transnational "big market".

34d77c88b8220d21a9d27725699ad4d46ee9d7b2.sourceText: 和宜明说，除了已建立的中俄地方边境经贸协调机制、新疆－塔吉克斯坦经贸合作分委会机制、新疆－阿塞拜疆经贸合作工作组机制，新疆还积极建立与哈萨克斯坦地方经贸合作机制、恢复与吉尔吉斯斯坦地方经贸合作机制的前期筹备工作，正在商讨建立新疆棗格鲁吉亚经贸合作机制事宜。
34d77c88b8220d21a9d27725699ad4d46ee9d7b2.translatedText: He Yiming said that in addition to the established Sino-Russian local border economic and trade coordination mechanism, the Xinjiang-Tajikistan Economic and Trade Cooperation Subcommittee mechanism, and the Xinjiang-Azerbaijan Economic and Trade Cooperation Working Group mechanism, Xinjiang is also actively establishing a local economic and trade cooperation mechanism with Kazakhstan, resuming the preparatory work for a local economic and trade cooperation mechanism with Kyrgyzstan, and is discussing the establishment of an economic and trade cooperation mechanism between Xinjiang and Georgia.

d89c2a572a068ede839b1a40b54dab1addec3b7a.sourceText: 他还透露，新疆将积极做好与周边的印度、巴基斯坦、阿富汗、蒙古等建立地方经贸合作机制的前期准备工作，尽快推动新疆与亚美尼亚、土耳其、伊朗经贸合作机制的建立。
d89c2a572a068ede839b1a40b54dab1addec3b7a.translatedText: He also revealed that Xinjiang will actively make preliminary preparations for establishing local economic and trade cooperation mechanisms with neighboring India, Pakistan, Afghanistan, Mongolia, etc., and promote the establishment of economic and trade cooperation mechanisms between Xinjiang and Armenia, Turkey, and Iran as soon as possible.

d0abddc88deb00311eb415e89a8c853f440f7aaa.sourceText: 目前，新疆已拥有一类对外开放口岸１７个、二类口岸１２个，与周边国家运输网络和通道建设取得新进展，中哈原油管道建成运营，土库曼斯坦－乌兹别克斯坦－哈萨克斯坦－中国的天然气管道建成运营；拥有各类国家级产业园区１２个，正在积极申报、扩建和升级多个国家级经济技术开发区、综合保税区和边境经济合作区。
d0abddc88deb00311eb415e89a8c853f440f7aaa.translatedText: At present, Xinjiang has 17 first-class ports open to the outside world and 12 second-class ports. It has made new progress in the construction of transportation networks and corridors with neighboring countries. The China-Kazakhstan crude oil pipeline has been completed and put into operation, and the Turkmenistan-Uzbekistan-Kazakhstan-China natural gas pipeline has been put into operation. It has 12 national-level industrial parks of various types, and is actively applying for, expanding and upgrading multiple national-level economic and technological development zones, comprehensive bonded zones and border economic cooperation zones.

65c1f8d718179b70a639d95e694a343cbddd1b1f.sourceText: 记者从新疆商务厅了解到，备受外界关注的喀什、霍尔果斯特殊经济经济开发区的规划目前已完成初稿，国家的政策意见即将出台，建设工作将全面展开，力争用５年左右时间，基本完成基础设施建设，
65c1f8d718179b70a639d95e694a343cbddd1b1f.translatedText: The reporter learned from the Xinjiang Department of Commerce that the first draft of the plans for the Kashgar and Horgos Special Economic Development Zones, which have attracted much attention from the outside world, has been completed. The national policy opinions will be released soon, and the construction work will be fully launched, striving to basically complete the infrastructure construction in about five years. ,

fd157e988eb89acd39cf3b18c0394e752a20db0e.sourceText: 处于当前大建设大开放大发展时期的新疆吸引了越来越多国内外大企业大集团，截至２０１０年底，入驻新疆的世界５００强、中国５００强等知名企业有３０８家，比２００９年增加了１１３家。近期，大众汽车集团定下在新疆投资建厂、发展汽车产业的意向。
fd157e988eb89acd39cf3b18c0394e752a20db0e.translatedText: Xinjiang, which is in the current period of great construction, opening up and development, has attracted more and more large domestic and foreign large enterprises and groups. By the end of 2010, 308 well-known companies such as the Fortune Global 500 and China's Top 500 had settled in Xinjiang, an increase of 113 companies from 2009. Recently, Volkswagen Group has decided to invest and build factories in Xinjiang to develop the automobile industry.

1da803ef44b1c1757369329f005ea950848e6832.sourceText: 霍恩炮轰奥巴马政府 亚利桑那州总检察长汤姆霍恩对奥巴马总统非常不满，认为总统阻止本州岛打击非法移民进程。 上周五，联邦政府发表简报支持美国上诉法院第九巡回庭对亚利桑那州200号提案否决议，认为提案200违反联邦法，亚省居民在选举登记时无需提供公民身份证明。 200号提案由亚省选民在2004年通过，主要内容为凡亚省居民，无论在登记为州选民或联邦选民时，必须提供驾照、护照、出生证、部落证明或入籍证号码。在”十月决议”中，上诉法院裁定，提案200号阻碍了公民投票机会的普及。 根据联邦法选举标准（适合任何州），任何人申请登记为选民，只要在选举登记表上声明自己是公民，无需出示身份证明文件。 霍恩说，”首先，奥巴马政府在边界的工作未能尽力，然后，它又起诉亚利桑那州，以防止我们打击非法移民。再来，联邦辩称边境是安全的，现在又阻止我们验证公民身份，这是违反美国人民利益。” 亚利桑那州已经成功要求法院对200号提案决议重新审核，定于6月21日在加州的帕萨迪纳进行。
1da803ef44b1c1757369329f005ea950848e6832.translatedText: Horn blasts the Obama administration. Arizona Attorney General Tom Horn is very dissatisfied with President Obama, believing that the president is preventing his state from cracking down on illegal immigration. On Friday, the federal government issued a brief supporting the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit's decision to reject Arizona's Proposition 200, arguing that Proposition 200 violated federal law and that Alberta residents did not need to provide proof of citizenship when registering for elections. Proposition 200 was passed by Alberta voters in 2004. The main content is that residents of Vancouver must provide their driver's license, passport, birth certificate, tribal certificate or naturalization certificate number when registering as a state or federal elector. In the October Resolution, the appeals court ruled that Proposition 200 hindered the expansion of voting opportunities. Under federal law election standards (appropriate for any state), anyone applying to register as a voter declares themselves to be a citizen on the electoral registration form without having to produce identification documents. "First, the Obama administration failed to do its best job at the border, and then it sued Arizona to prevent us from cracking down on illegal immigration," Horn said. "Third, the federal government argued that the border was secure, and now it is preventing us from verifying citizenship, which is contrary to the interests of the American people." Arizona has successfully asked the court to review the Proposition 200 resolution, which is scheduled for June 21 in Pasadena, California.
