4e23798d2f54015b39a84cf18bfc5c41cd329b82.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association: Zhang Zhaohong

c505756e4f1b98455e8bbaacbda2e59abd4670d1.sourceText: 在弗拉格斯塔夫(Flagstaff )，有一栋由黄世质买下的物业。 它是一座两层楼的木结构的建筑，非常适合在一楼扩展洗衣业务，在二楼为家庭提供生活空间。新业务位于当地的“旧金山大街”和“凤凰大道”的拐角处。旧金山大街从城市的最南端延伸到城市的最北端，并且从这个拐角处穿过圣达菲铁轨和66号公路，在弗拉格斯塔夫被称为“Main Street”。
c505756e4f1b98455e8bbaacbda2e59abd4670d1.translatedText: In Flagstaff, there is a property bought by Huang Shizhi. It is a two-story timber frame building, ideal for expanding a laundry business on the first floor and providing living space for the family on the second floor. The new business is located locally on the corner of San Francisco Avenue and Phoenix Avenue. San Francisco Avenue stretches from the southernmost tip of the city to the northernmost tip of the city, and from this corner crosses the Santa Fe Railroad tracks and Route 66, known in Flagstaff as "Main Street."

ed4da92dc71a84b45ae141d9da10813f8fc0975e.sourceText: 随着业务的持续发展和繁荣，即使在大萧条时期，该地点的知名度也在不断提高。每个人都必须洗衣服， 客户是66号公路旁的铁路和锯木厂工人，城镇居民和旅行者。黄世质决心留下来，他要成为一名好美国公民，并赢得居民的尊重。
ed4da92dc71a84b45ae141d9da10813f8fc0975e.translatedText: As business continued to grow and prosper, the location continued to grow in popularity, even during the Great Depression. Everyone had to do laundry, and the customers were railroad and sawmill workers along Route 66, town residents, and travelers. Huang Shizhi is determined to stay. He wants to become a good American citizen and win the respect of the residents.

26b7f909cf90ef4123f004ddb2f713aaff79e514.sourceText: 黄世质通过努力工作和提供最好的洗衣服务，努力融入美国的生活方式。随着时间的流逝，他证明了自己，并为成为美国人而感到高兴和自豪。黄世质将自己的公司命名为“美国洗衣店”。强调他的爱国精神，公司的信笺顶部都带有一面美国国旗。
26b7f909cf90ef4123f004ddb2f713aaff79e514.translatedText: Huang Shizhi strives to integrate into the American lifestyle by working hard and providing the best laundry service. Over time, he proved himself and became happy and proud to be an American. Huang Shizhi named his company "American Laundry." Emphasizing his patriotism, the company's letterheads feature an American flag at the top.

3c61c23e6bc07b489b49523b0800258e4350afcf.sourceText: 洗衣房配备了几台过时的机械设备，以扩大其洗衣业务。大一些的男孩帮助母亲谢瑶 ，因为他们能够处理洗衣店中的体力劳动。 1921年，威廉（Lema）是第一个出生在洗衣房二楼的人。不久之后，另一个孩子玛格丽特（Margaret）也出生了，这个家庭已经超出了二楼的三居室居住区，每个房间有三到四个兄弟姐妹。十多年来，在洗衣房二楼生了六个孩子。 父母住在地板的一个角落，一楼有一个卫生间供整个家庭使用，还有一个厕所。
3c61c23e6bc07b489b49523b0800258e4350afcf.translatedText: The laundry room was equipped with several outdated pieces of machinery to expand its laundry operations. The older boys help their mother Xie Yao because they are able to handle the physical labor in the laundry. In 1921, William (Lema) was the first person born on the second floor of the laundry room. Soon after, another child, Margaret, was born, and the family outgrew the three-bedroom living quarters on the second floor, with three or four siblings in each room. Over a decade, six children were born on the second floor of the laundry room. The parents live in a corner of the floor and there is a bathroom for the whole family on the first floor, as well as a toilet.

893206009bde96fde00eeee8dbc3183771ec358c.sourceText: 每当黄世质从旧金山订购中国商品时，他总是从旧金山的唐人街购买彩票，店员将彩票和商品一并寄给他。 他订阅了旧金山中文报纸，在1929年年底的大萧条开始的一天，他读到他的一张彩票与中奖号码匹配。
893206009bde96fde00eeee8dbc3183771ec358c.translatedText: Whenever Huang Shizhi ordered Chinese goods from San Francisco, he always bought lottery tickets from Chinatown in San Francisco, and the clerk sent him the lottery tickets and goods together. He subscribed to the San Francisco Chinese newspaper, and one day in late 1929, at the start of the Great Depression, he read that one of his lottery tickets matched the winning numbers.

61fc58c2b12c5ea5fe010ce092fb6dbf46e9a0a4.sourceText: 黄世质赢得了高达$ 20,000的奖金！ 以今天的货币计算，这笔钱的购买力超过300,000美元！ 他快速前往旧金山领取奖金，同时梦想着这种意外之财将如何帮助他不断增长的家庭和生意。黄世质用中彩票的钱在主楼中建造了一座附加楼，这是创建商业运营的第一步。
61fc58c2b12c5ea5fe010ce092fb6dbf46e9a0a4.translatedText: Huang Shizhi won a whopping $20,000 prize! In today’s money, this money has a purchasing power of over $300,000! He made a quick trip to San Francisco to collect his winnings while dreaming about how this windfall would help his growing family and business. Huang Shizhi used the lottery money to build an additional building to the main building, which was the first step in creating a commercial operation.

4f027b1f4bb4c5121ff5641abb4d08fc07953e18.sourceText: 新增加的房屋容纳现代化的设备和燃烧蒸汽和热水的燃木锅炉。蒸汽进入压机和熨烫机以保持稳定的温度，水被存储在1,000加仑的储水箱中，以向洗衣机提供水。黄世质安装了设备，例如大型6英尺长的卧式洗衣机，脱水机，滚筒（干衣机），压力机，制衣机和手摇机。 漏斗是几英尺宽的蒸汽加热滚筒式熨烫机，用于熨烫餐巾，桌布，枕头套和亚麻布，包括整张床单。将物品送入多辊手推车，另一端平放并干燥以折叠并准备包装。
4f027b1f4bb4c5121ff5641abb4d08fc07953e18.translatedText: The new addition accommodates modern appliances and a wood-fired boiler that burns steam and hot water. Steam enters the press and ironing machine to maintain a stable temperature, and water is stored in a 1,000-gallon water storage tank to provide water to the washing machine. Huang Shizhi installed equipment such as a large 6-foot-long horizontal washing machine, dehydrator, tumbler (dryer), press, clothes making machine, and hand-crank machine. Hoppers are several feet wide steam-heated drum ironers used for ironing napkins, tablecloths, pillowcases, and linens, including entire sheets. The items are fed into the multi-roller cart and the other end is laid flat and dried to be folded and ready for packaging.

9560ac14fcfd520c975199134df59be7b4fa88d5.sourceText: 到1930年，该洗衣店已全面投入运营。黄世质雇了几名员工与其家人一起进行压制，折叠和整理，最后交付给客户。 锅炉每天要烧掉一根木头， 大型电动机和工业皮带轮系统使洗衣机运转。 男孩们操作了洗衣机，提取器，滚筒和其他必要的准备操作。
9560ac14fcfd520c975199134df59be7b4fa88d5.translatedText: By 1930, the laundromat was fully operational. Huang Shizhi hired several employees to work with his family on pressing, folding and sorting, and finally delivering them to customers. Boilers burn a log of wood every day, and large electric motors and industrial pulley systems keep washing machines running. The boys operated washers, extractors, drums and other necessary preparatory operations.

4ab17fd7b0cb766f367db41466653f151f2d8dfd.sourceText: 家庭中的每个人都在工作，有了最新的设备，洗衣店业务很快达到顶峰，雇用了多达12名员工。 几年后，黄世质从多个供应商那里购买木材，然后燃烧成煤炭。事实证明，这种煤炭价格便宜，效率更高。 洗衣房安装了带有螺旋钻的大料斗，将煤炭送入锅炉。男孩们很高兴，因为铲煤炭比砍木头和将木头拖到锅炉房的工作量要少，而这通常是在不利的天气条件下进行的，尤其是在冬天。
4ab17fd7b0cb766f367db41466653f151f2d8dfd.translatedText: Everyone in the family was at work, and with the latest equipment, the laundry business soon reached its peak, employing as many as 12 people. A few years later, Huang Shizhi purchased wood from multiple suppliers and burned it into coal. This coal has proven to be cheaper and more efficient. A large hopper with an auger was installed in the laundry room to feed the coal to the boiler. The boys were happy because shoveling coal was less work than chopping and hauling wood to the boiler room, which was often done in adverse weather conditions, especially in winter.

41a0bca189c154380ca5c2688de9f7be451c3460.sourceText: 很难相信，几年后，黄世质再次在旧金山赢得了中奖彩票，但金额比第一次少。到这个时候，家庭中居住在楼上的已有九个人。 因此，他在对面的那条街建造了一座与洗衣店分开的房屋。 那是一个梦想中的房子，一个两层的大房子，有九间卧室，五间浴室，四个厨房，起居室和饭厅以及一个地窖。房间的布置就像迷你公寓，可容纳家庭中的每个人。 在地窖中，黄世质建造了一个燃煤和石油的锅炉将热水加热，然后流向整个房屋中的散热器。
41a0bca189c154380ca5c2688de9f7be451c3460.translatedText: It’s hard to believe that a few years later, Huang Shizhi won the winning lottery ticket again in San Francisco, but the amount was smaller than the first time. By this time, there were nine people in the family living upstairs. So he built a house separate from the laundromat on the opposite street. It was a dream house, a large two-story house with nine bedrooms, five bathrooms, four kitchens, living and dining rooms and a cellar. The rooms are arranged like mini apartments to accommodate everyone in the family. In the cellar, Huang built a coal- and oil-fired boiler to heat hot water, which then flowed to radiators throughout the house.

70a8881018c214066f64d7c368fb66ef3ff258d9.sourceText: 随着彩票资金和生意兴隆，黄世质的资产增长了。他有一个帝国！ 凭借他的商业意识和赌博经验，他制定了一项总体计划来开发该物业并投资于其他企业。在很多情况下，那些喜欢彩票和遗产之类的“轻松赚钱”的人，都有赚更多钱的冲动。
70a8881018c214066f64d7c368fb66ef3ff258d9.translatedText: As lottery funds and business prospered, Huang Shizhi's assets grew. He has an empire! Using his business sense and gambling experience, he developed a master plan to develop the property and invest in other ventures. In many cases, people who enjoy "easy money" like lotteries and inheritances have the urge to make more money.

8b7d8ad39a3560382a3741410f551d4060564be7.sourceText: 黄世质有勇于冒险的信心。起初，他只限于自己了解的投资，只在旧金山，凤凰城和阿加西大街上购买了房地产。也许这可以追溯到他年轻时的时代，当时他被限制在旧金山唐人街的边界。 他成为房东并出租了许多房产。 土地的一部分归圣达菲铁路所有，黄世质亲自管理，以获得99年的租约，这是可能的最长的房地产租约。
8b7d8ad39a3560382a3741410f551d4060564be7.translatedText: Huang Shizhi has the confidence to take risks. At first, he limited himself to investments he understood, buying real estate only in San Francisco, Phoenix and Agassiz Street. Perhaps this goes back to his youth, when he was confined to the borders of San Francisco's Chinatown. He became a landlord and rented out many properties. A portion of the land is owned by the Santa Fe Railroad, which Huang personally managed to secure a 99-year lease, the longest real estate lease possible.

be13b620239226b5d5611017e9bc56b708131109.sourceText: 黄世质仍然是赌徒，他继续投资，但是他投资在他所不了解的事情上，例如德克萨斯州的油井。可以想象，他破产了。
be13b620239226b5d5611017e9bc56b708131109.translatedText: Huang Shizhi was still a gambler and he continued to invest, but he invested in things he didn't understand, such as oil wells in Texas. As you can imagine, he was bankrupt.

c3d5b4b8d33a4c0c07d7346dad83533c505c07d1.sourceText: 然后，黄世质向思科（Cisco）投资了资金，思科虽然繁荣了一段时间，但最终失败了。 他是主要股东，已投资1,000美元。 他也是Monte Vista酒店的原始投资人之一。这是一间位于历史悠久的66号公路上，拥有63间客房和套房的豪华酒店，建于1926年，位于弗拉格斯塔夫市中心。
c3d5b4b8d33a4c0c07d7346dad83533c505c07d1.translatedText: Huang Shizhi then invested money in Cisco, which prospered for a while but ultimately failed. He is the major shareholder and has invested $1,000. He was also one of the original investors of the Monte Vista Hotel. This 63-room and suite luxury hotel was built in 1926 on historic Route 66 in downtown Flagstaff.

77625e3d213587c02af3badce3cf2826d1cdf61e.sourceText: 黄世质投资的酒店是美国最闹鬼的酒店之一。约翰·韦恩（John Wayne）发誓，他看见了幻影侍者的幽灵，幽灵侍者在夜间徘徊在大厅，敲开提供客房服务的门。黄世质投资了这家幽灵般的酒店。到1955年，黄世质的家人以$ 27,000的价格兑现了股票。以通货膨胀率调整后的今天的货币价值，这将是260,000美元。
77625e3d213587c02af3badce3cf2826d1cdf61e.translatedText: The hotel invested by Huang Shizhi is one of the most haunted hotels in the United States. John Wayne swore he saw the ghost of a phantom bellboy who wandered the halls at night, knocking on doors offering room service. Huang Shizhi invested in this ghostly hotel. By 1955, Huang Shizhi's family cashed in the stock for $27,000. In today's money, adjusted for inflation, that would be $260,000.

bcd44a84aa6dc8b5bdd1bf1a5a83eca43a6549f8.sourceText: 黄世质一直保持着王氏慈善协会的会员身份，并为弗拉格斯塔夫和旧金山唐人街的组织的慈善事业做出了贡献。他还为支持中国抗战买了“航空救国券”。尽管有《排华法案》，但是在第二次世界大战期间，由于与日本的问题，美中之间的关系有所改善。（待续）
bcd44a84aa6dc8b5bdd1bf1a5a83eca43a6549f8.translatedText: Huang has maintained membership in the Wang Charitable Association and contributed to philanthropic efforts with organizations in Flagstaff and San Francisco's Chinatown. He also bought "aviation national salvation coupons" to support China's war of resistance. Despite the Chinese Exclusion Act, relations between the United States and China improved during World War II due to issues with Japan. (to be continued)

82c7f61eedda7bff5c480b6791419fa99aa987d5.sourceText: By Barry Wong (Phoenix, Ariz.) There was an air of excitement in the party suites and hallways among the nearly 1,000 partygoers assembled at the Hyatt Regency Phoenix, site of the Arizona Republican Party’s November 4, 2014 election night party. The high energy atmosphere had set the tone for the evening among Republican Party supporters and faithful. At stake were all statewide offices (Governor, Secretary of State, Treasurer, Attorney General, Superintendent of Public Instructions (education) and Corporation Commissioner (two seats)), congressional seats, legislative seats, city council seats and ballot measures. Everyone was anxious to learn the results of the Governor’s race which pitted from the two major parties Doug Ducey, the sitting Republican state Treasurer and former CEO of Cold Stone ice cream company, against Fred DuVal, Democrat former chairman of the Arizona Board of Regents and Clinton White House staffer. An hour after the polls closed at 7:00pm initial election results were announced by county and state election officials showing Ducey ahead of DuVal by a comfortable margin. Soon thereafter, GOP partiers were spreading the word that Ducey had won, at least unofficially, after NBC News declared Ducey the winner. As the evening inched closer to nine o’clock, the planned time for the GOP stage program, another round of word-spreading declared that DuVal had conceded defeat thus paving the way for a Ducey victory speech. Party revelers started crowding in the grand ballroom making their way towards and surrounding the stage. As hundreds of people gathered and as TV news cameras with their bright lights focused, GOP Chairman Robert Graham welcomed everyone. He started by introducing Pastor Edward Yun, President of the Arizona Korean Churches Association, to give the opening prayer; followed by singing of the National Anthem. Elected officials, one-by-one, spoke on stage as they started building excitement for Ducey. Speakers included Maricopa County Sheriff Joe Arpaio, Senators John McCain and Jeff Flake, Congressmen Trent Franks, David Schweikert and Matt Salmon, and Governor Janice Brewer. As the buildup was reaching its peak Ducey’s family came on stage including his mother, grandmother and other relatives; then followed by his wife, Angela, and three sons, Jack, Joe and Sam. With the crowd now in a frenzy, Angela introduced her husband ”... please welcome Arizona’s Governor 杄lect Doug Ducey.” After prolonged applause and with electricity in the air, Ducey came on stage waving and beaming with a wide smile. He gave a warm and heartfelt victory speech after kind words about his Democrat opponent. Ducey emphasized that he will be Governor for all the people of Arizona and will work towards policies that will provide opportunities for all Arizonans as was his campaign focus. He said he will start working to build a team to advance his administration as Governor. Standing along the rope barriers facing the stage were leaders from many Arizona Asian American communities. Among them were Jae Chin, Edward Yun, Jaeman Lee, Whansik Choi and Kaye Won (Korean community); Kevin Dang, Mai Le, Sang Nguyen and Andrew Nguyen (Vietnamese community); Charles Chiu (Chinese community); Raphael Ahmed and Farhana Ahmed (Bangladesh community); Marie Cunning and Charmel de la Cruz (Filipino community); Astria Wong and Al Carstens (Asian community); and Barry Wong (Chinese/Asian communities). The Ducey Campaign and the Republican Party established Asian American coalitions to garner voter support from Arizona’s fast growing Asian American community. They made a concerted and genuine effort to reach out to the Asian community. Conversely, the Asian community responded favorably with votes for Republican candidates and for Ducey. With Ducey winning by nearly 54% of the vote (as of press time), every vote including the Asian vote was critically important. ”The Ducey Campaign and Ariz. GOP are applauded for recognizing and respecting the Asian American community,” said Wong, co-chairman of Asian Americans for Ducey, and chairman of Ariz. GOP’s Asian American Coalition. ”Further, leaders of the various Asian communities are congratulated for engaging their community members to participate in the American system of democracy by voting.” The GOP and campaigns are evolving by recognizing and courting the vote of ethnic communities. This commitment to community outreach was important in this election cycle and will continue to be important for future elections. One’s vote is truly one’s voice! Barry Wong is an Arizona attorney and a former Arizona legislator (four terms, Arizona House of Representatives) and Corporation Commissioner (utility regulator).

598508c9d695dad48b609bad1a16f4c58588762a.sourceText: 马利科巴郡警周一在埃文岱尔搜出毒品、枪支，并拘捕三名非法入境男子。其中一名男子因入店行窃和使用毒品重罪，于2009年被驱逐出境。三名犯罪嫌疑人在马利科巴郡属非法。探员在行动中发现了4.4磅可卡因，另有4支AK-47步枪和1支AR-15手枪。警方已与烟酒和火器局联系，以设法确定枪支的来源。 ”这是继周日拘捕涉嫌绑架和控制本地卖淫妇女的非法居留外国人案件的另一起罪案，”阿派奥警长说。鉴于日益猖獗的非法入境者犯罪，马利科巴郡警方将继续执行联邦和州移民法，保障合法居民权益。
598508c9d695dad48b609bad1a16f4c58588762a.translatedText: Maricopa County police seized drugs, guns and arrested three illegal immigrants in Avondale on Monday. One of the men was deported in 2009 after being convicted of felony shoplifting and drug use. Three suspects are illegal in Maricopa County. During the operation, agents discovered 4.4 pounds of cocaine, four AK-47 rifles and an AR-15 pistol. Police have contacted the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms to try to determine the source of the gun. “This is another crime following Sunday’s arrest of an illegal foreigner suspected of kidnapping and controlling local women for prostitution,” Chief Apao said. In view of the increasingly rampant crimes committed by illegal immigrants, Maricopa County Police will continue to enforce federal and state immigration laws and protect the rights of legal residents.

b291fda97f5e506bf73d253467f35207f580cb62.sourceText: 《太阳鸟纪事》–“造越位”的旅行日记二（精彩还在继续）
b291fda97f5e506bf73d253467f35207f580cb62.translatedText: "Sunbird Chronicle" - The second travel diary of "Creating Offside" (the excitement continues)

9b9d5fd3611046ce7282745b34f8d869f6683a84.sourceText: 《太阳鸟纪事》–“造越位”的旅行日记二（精彩还在继续） 在某个时间，某个空间，我们在这里，美国…
9b9d5fd3611046ce7282745b34f8d869f6683a84.translatedText: "Sunbird Chronicle" - The Second Travel Diary of "Creating Offside" (the excitement continues) At a certain time, in a certain space, we are here in the United States...

e8ba304c17aad1d93193bb14e039a2fead7a6562.sourceText: 在某个时间，某个空间，我们在这里，美国亚利桑那州，有的人留下来了，有的人海归了，在时间和空间的交界点中，有很多分秒组成的故事，在太阳鸟亚省华人网的《太阳鸟纪事》中，我们看到张肇鸿，气如虹，文若，慧明，凤鸣，心水等很文友记录他们的生活，首先感谢他们的记录，让我们看到了一代移民的成长足迹。在凤凰城还有一些在高科技区忙碌的新移民，以及来学习的留学生，他们带着７０后，８０后，９０后的华裔的气息，来到这里，他们面对的人生变化和选择，正在发生。”太阳鸟亚省华人网”希望能记录下这些，调动采访力量来记录这个时间和空间里的故事。如果你身边有有意思的人，或者有意思的故事，请与我们联系，一起分享《太阳鸟纪事》。
e8ba304c17aad1d93193bb14e039a2fead7a6562.translatedText: At a certain time, in a certain space, we are here in Arizona, the United States. Some people have stayed, and some have returned from overseas. At the intersection of time and space, there are There are many stories composed of minutes and seconds. In the "Sunbird Chronicles" of the Sunbird Asia Chinese Network, we see Zhang Zhaohong, Qi Ruhong, Wen Ruo, Huiming, Fengming, Xinshui and many other literary friends recording their lives. First of all, we would like to thank their records for allowing us to see the growth footprints of a generation of immigrants. In Phoenix, there are also some new immigrants who are busy in the high-tech district, as well as international students who come to study. They come here with the aura of Chinese people born in the 1970s, 1980s, and 1990s. The life changes and choices they face are happening now. "Sunbird Asia Chinese Network" hopes to record these and mobilize the power of interviews to record the stories in this time and space. If you have interesting people or interesting stories around you, please contact us and share "Sunbird Chronicles" together.

6b9139ab3f0e1c0f16546cb8487e6b5a4f5ce16c.sourceText: Day5: 这两天走的实在太累了，早上临时决定冒险开车去EUR罗马新城，见证了一下墨索里尼的伟大理想。十几公里的路，走了足有40多分钟。又花了一个小时才找到停车位。进罗马时，就把车留在了EUR。 到了真理之口看到一些空着的停车位，心里有些后悔。直到看见一辆车窗被砸的车，心里不由得想起老祖宗的话，塞翁失马，焉知非福! 到了西班牙广场，坐了赫本坐过的台阶。又去了著名的Borghese博物馆。因为没有预约，被拦在门外。时间还早，看着时阴时晴的罗马，突然有点索然。
6b9139ab3f0e1c0f16546cb8487e6b5a4f5ce16c.translatedText: Day5: I was really tired from walking these two days, so I decided to take the risk and drive to EUR Rome New Town in the morning to witness Mussolini’s great ideals. It took more than 40 minutes to walk more than ten kilometers. It took another hour to find a parking space. When entering Rome, I left the car at EUR. When I arrived at the Mouth of Truth and saw some empty parking spaces, I felt a little regretful. Until I saw a car with a smashed window, I couldn't help but think of the words of my ancestors, a blessing in disguise! When I arrived at the Plaza de España, I sat on the steps where Hepburn had sat. Went to the famous Borghese Museum again. Because I didn't have an appointment, I was stopped outside. It was still early, and looking at Rome, which was sometimes cloudy and sometimes sunny, I suddenly felt a little bored.

c742a7547ad7142b7acbbd4fd9f7ef29de5a58af.sourceText: 翻开地图，看到一个游人不常去的小镇Tivoli，决定去那打发时间。离罗马40多公里的小镇，最后一段是盘山而上。渐渐的，大半拉齐奥地区就展现在眼前。是从老街区的后面走进去的，街道狭窄蜿蜒，小镇幽静古朴。七转八转，碰一家全手工铜器店。喜欢铜器的我，恨不得搬他个几大件。迫于现实，只买了一个小小铜壶。已经出了店门的我，又匆匆赶回去照相。憨厚的老工匠特意拿起锤子，摆了pose给我照。我有了一丝丝感动。
c742a7547ad7142b7acbbd4fd9f7ef29de5a58af.translatedText: Turning over the map, I saw Tivoli, a small town not often visited by tourists, and decided to go there to kill time. A small town more than 40 kilometers away from Rome, the last section is winding up the mountain. Gradually, most of the Lazio region came into view. Walking in from the back of the old neighborhood, the streets are narrow and winding, and the town is quiet and quaint. After walking around for a while, I came across a handmade copperware shop. I like copperware, so I can’t wait to move a few big pieces of it. Due to reality, I only bought a small copper kettle. I had already left the store and hurried back to take pictures. The honest old craftsman specially picked up the hammer and posed for me to take a picture. I was slightly touched.

55bfc7bab3a8617c5e9f2ba159fda2623d3b9d42.sourceText: 晚饭选在一个小巷子里的小餐馆。主人很热情，不过语言不通，最后点的东西有大半不知道是什么。餐前小吃，餐前面包，餐前菜，色拉，海鲜， 第一道主菜，第二道主菜接连上来，真是惊喜跟着惊喜。味道没得说，比前几天的大餐好多了。价格也是非常实惠。
55bfc7bab3a8617c5e9f2ba159fda2623d3b9d42.translatedText: We chose a small restaurant in a small alley for dinner. The host was very enthusiastic, but he didn't speak the language well, so I didn't know what most of the last things he ordered were. Tapas, pre-dinner bread, appetizers, salads, seafood, the first main course, and the second main course came one after another. It was really surprise after surprise. Needless to say, the taste is much better than the feast of the past few days. The price is also very affordable.

f04b9215d8f1d33b260e326acf664eb35784a038.sourceText: 我们吃饭时，其他就餐的顾客都是小镇上的人。相比40公里外匆忙紧张的罗马人，小镇人都很和善安详。 小镇人之间相处非常和谐融洽。店主一家人也其乐融融。突然之间，我觉得幸福就是， 简单，快乐，平和。真的很简单。10点多了，慢慢地把车开回旅馆，微风拂面。我的心中，平安快乐。
f04b9215d8f1d33b260e326acf664eb35784a038.translatedText: When we were eating, the other customers were all from small towns. Compared to the hurried and nervous Romans 40 kilometers away, the people in the town were very kind and peaceful. People in the small town get along very harmoniously and harmoniously. The owner and his family are also enjoying themselves. Suddenly, I felt that happiness is simple, joyful and peaceful. It's really simple. It was past 10 o'clock, and I slowly drove back to the hotel, with the breeze blowing on my face. In my heart, I am at peace and happy.

a00c148243bddedc4655b8648c158043884039c0.sourceText: Day6: 从罗马向南三个小时车程，刚过那不勒斯就是苏莲托。这是一个建在悬崖峭壁上的城市。从17世纪开始就是欧洲著名的旅游胜地。城市不大，大约生活了不到两万人。城里布满了各种店铺和旅馆。这些房子又有好多建在一层又一层的峭壁上。
a00c148243bddedc4655b8648c158043884039c0.translatedText: Day6: Three hours’ drive south from Rome, just past Naples is Sorrento. This is a city built on a cliff. It has been a famous tourist destination in Europe since the 17th century. The city is not big, with less than 20,000 people living there. The city is dotted with various shops and hotels. Many of these houses are built on layer after layer of cliffs.

48a6335ac5e4b9564372c8bdd98cd9b65dc4fba7.sourceText: 连接这些店铺的路好多都是碎石铺的，而且非常狭窄。更显得整个城市的陡峭和古老。城市最下层是港口，好多大型地中海游轮都在此停泊。据说从海上驶来，苏莲托特别雄奇壮观。天气好的时候，蔚蓝的大海非常秀丽。
48a6335ac5e4b9564372c8bdd98cd9b65dc4fba7.translatedText: Many of the roads connecting these shops are paved with gravel and are very narrow. It makes the whole city even more steep and ancient. The lowest level of the city is the port, where many large Mediterranean cruise ships are anchored. It is said that Sorrento is particularly majestic and spectacular coming from the sea. When the weather is good, the blue sea is very beautiful.

9ac555a4d30deeebfad9f674e5db167d13caa704.sourceText: 不过今天是在雨中驶进苏莲托的。错过了她美丽的一面。不过，也许想像中的她才是最美的。我们的旅馆不在城里，是在苏莲托上面的上面的上面的接近山顶的绝壁上。要再开二三十分钟的山路。伴随着帕瓦罗蒂的’回归苏莲托’，车子沿着蜿蜒的山道慢慢的爬进了旅馆。旅馆房间有个后园和露台，也是修在山壁上。从那里可以俯视苏莲托，也可以观赏远处隔海相望的维苏威活山和那不勒斯。苏莲托，我们来了。下次再来，那就是回归苏莲托。
9ac555a4d30deeebfad9f674e5db167d13caa704.translatedText: But today we drove into Sorrento in the rain. Missed her beautiful side. However, maybe she is the most beautiful in imagination. Our hotel is not in the city, but on a cliff near the top of Sorrento. It takes another twenty or thirty minutes to drive on a mountain road. Accompanying Pavarotti's "Return to Sorrento", the car slowly climbed into the hotel along the winding mountain road. The hotel room has a back garden and terrace, which are also built on the mountain wall. From there you can overlook Sorrento, as well as Mount Vesuvius and Naples across the sea in the distance. Sorrento, here we come. Next time I come, it will be back to Sorrento.

25bb5db2fdc7ce31af95ba44b0b9dc47e4f825f3.sourceText: 大凤凰城市区房租上涨
25bb5db2fdc7ce31af95ba44b0b9dc47e4f825f3.translatedText: Rents in the greater Phoenix area have increased

835901f7cd98e32b6303e9cd348d8a8568d1f03e.sourceText: 大凤凰城市区房租上涨 根据Research firm realfacts, 与去年9月低，大凤凰城市区房租均价…
835901f7cd98e32b6303e9cd348d8a8568d1f03e.translatedText: Rents in the greater Phoenix area have increased. According to Research firm realfacts, the average rent in the greater Phoenix area is lower than that in September last year...

3b5b063c66b2df36e8a867575de0c96facaecc77.sourceText: 大凤凰城市区房租上涨 根据Research firm realfacts, 与去年9月低，大凤凰城市区房租均价为$815，今年房租上涨了4.9%。如果根据亚利桑那州立大学凯利商学院的数据，数据甚至更高，上涨了5.8%。 出租房依然很受欢迎对于那些不想买房或者没法贷款的人来说。凯利商学院的房地产理论与实践的主任Orr说，房屋周转率的提高，房屋空置率的下降，促使房租增高。 平均租金的上涨，并不能认为非常准确的指标。在每月租金5000美金以上的豪宅出租，让平均租金上涨。 9月，有4342个房子在市场上出租（不包括度假屋），而2013年市场上有6486个房子出租。市场上出租房还没有恢复到正常数量，也是房租上涨的原因之一。
3b5b063c66b2df36e8a867575de0c96facaecc77.translatedText: Rents in the greater Phoenix area have increased. According to Research firm realfacts, the average rent in the greater Phoenix area is $815, which is lower than in September last year. Rent has increased by 4.9% this year. The numbers were even higher, up 5.8%, according to data from Arizona State University's Kelley School of Business. Rentals remain popular for those who don't want to buy a home or can't get a mortgage. Orr, director of real estate theory and practice at the Kelley School of Business, said the increase in housing turnover and the decrease in vacancy rates have contributed to higher rents. The increase in average rents cannot be considered a very accurate indicator. Renting out luxury properties with a monthly rent of more than $5,000 will increase the average rent. In September, there were 4,342 properties on the market (excluding vacation homes), compared with 6,486 properties on the market in 2013. The number of rental properties on the market has not yet returned to normal, which is one of the reasons for the rise in rents.

97f147d23286e952ebaae0040b1d265349579586.sourceText: 高速路车祸死亡率下降 根据亚利桑那州运输部报告，2010年在亚利桑那州公路上因车祸死亡人数有所下降。 报告说，去年有762人在高速公路和地方道路因车祸身亡，这比2009年下跌超过5%。而四年前，这个数字是1301人，这年是本州有史以来最多车祸死亡记录。 ADOT是致力研究本州高速公路安全的部门。ADOT主任在新闻发布会上说：”减少致命的酒后驾驶引致的车祸是我们的目标。” 事实上，酒后驾驶在亚利桑那州可能引致暂时吊销驾照90天，监禁1到10天，扣留车辆和罚款，还要评估点火联锁设备的安装。这样的惩罚在全美国来说相当严厉。 以下是ADOT在2010年收集的一些有关车祸数据： –2010年，本州共发生106，177起车祸 –从2009年到2010年，乡村地区的车祸死亡人数下降了20%（481降到382） –同一时间，市区车祸死亡人数增加了17%（325升至380人） –虽然在乡村车祸（21375）占20%，他们在2010年死亡率占49% –78%跟酒精相关的车祸发生在城市地区 –2010年致命事故涉及的驾驶者多数在25-34岁年龄组 –车祸导致亚利桑那州在2010年直接经济损失达2.668亿美元 –73.6%的车祸发生在上午6时至下午6时 –10月是车祸的高峰
97f147d23286e952ebaae0040b1d265349579586.translatedText: Highway crash fatalities decline The number of fatalities caused by crashes on Arizona highways declined in 2010, according to the Arizona Department of Transportation. The report said 762 people were killed in crashes on highways and local roads last year, a drop of more than 5 percent from 2009. Four years ago, the number was 1,301, making it the state's highest-ever crash fatality year. ADOT is the agency dedicated to highway safety in the state. "Reducing fatal crashes caused by drunk driving is our goal," the ADOT director said in a news release. In fact, driving under the influence in Arizona can result in a 90-day driver's license suspension, one to 10 days in jail, vehicle impoundment and fines, as well as evaluation for the installation of an ignition interlock device. Such punishments are quite severe across the United States. Here are some crash data collected by ADOT in 2010: – In 2010, there were 106,177 crashes in the state – From 2009 to 2010, fatalities in rural areas dropped 20% (from 481 to 382) – During the same period, fatalities in urban areas increased by 17% (from 325 to 380) – While rural crashes accounted for 20% of crashes (21,375), they accounted for 49% of fatalities in 2010 – 78% of alcohol-related crashes occurred in urban areas – Most of the drivers involved in fatal crashes in 2010 were in the 25-34 age group – Crashes cost Arizona $266.8 million in direct economic losses in 2010 – 73.6% of crashes occurred between 6 a.m. and 6 p.m. – October was the peak month for crashes

1d9a02d8b9a03b965cea36cee4d8a430759275b3.sourceText: 国地产衰败中的暴富商机
1d9a02d8b9a03b965cea36cee4d8a430759275b3.translatedText: Opportunities for getting rich amid the decline of domestic real estate

1e2a407cdd98b5d6be0711cf20a8bc980db0ed33.sourceText: 国地产衰败中的暴富商机 动人民群众喜闻乐见的好地方:http://www.popyard.org 最近听评…
1e2a407cdd98b5d6be0711cf20a8bc980db0ed33.translatedText: > Opportunities for getting rich amid the decline of domestic real estate A good place to attract people’s attention: http://www.popyard.org Recently I heard comments...

7615ad1b54d00c0c4356f1ee0e9f1310a740bf18.sourceText: 美国的地产市场且跌着呢。
7615ad1b54d00c0c4356f1ee0e9f1310a740bf18.translatedText: The real estate market in the United States is still falling.

5a164bb595eccd241b10524b944622e2a12f573a.sourceText: 如下图，根据美国商务部的数据，美国的房屋拥有率已经降到了1997年以来的最低点，65.4%。而与此同时空置房屋的单位租金中值却在不断上升。
5a164bb595eccd241b10524b944622e2a12f573a.translatedText: As shown below, according to data from the U.S. Department of Commerce, the U.S. homeownership rate has dropped to its lowest point since 1997, at 65.4%. At the same time, the median unit rent for vacant homes continues to rise.

325fe053bdbe319efd29c0908ab6691d90e507ee.sourceText: 是的，美国正在从一个所有者的社会向一个租用者的社会转变。美国的家庭依然在进行痛苦的去杠杆化。要了解什么叫去杠杆化，首先明白什么是家庭杠杆率：Household Leverage Ratio = Total household debt/ Disposable household income。美国家庭举债太多，所以杠杆率太高，而之前美国家庭之所以能轻易进行债务融资是因为主要抵押物如地产等价值坚挺，而今地产价值严重缩水，债务的重压就只有通过卖出地产等抵押物来缓解，而这就更加恶化了地产价格的劣势。所以说美国的经济危机也就是所有权的危机。
325fe053bdbe319efd29c0908ab6691d90e507ee.translatedText: Yes, the United States is changing from a society of owners to a society of renters. American households are still undergoing painful deleveraging. To understand what deleveraging is, first understand what household leverage ratio is: Household Leverage Ratio = Total household debt/ Disposable household income. American households borrowed too much, so the leverage ratio was too high. In the past, American households could easily obtain debt financing because the value of their main collateral, such as real estate, was strong. Now that the value of real estate has shrunk severely, the burden of debt can only be alleviated by selling real estate and other collateral, which has further worsened the disadvantage of real estate prices. Therefore, the economic crisis in the United States is also a crisis of ownership.

9723622d4313384035a0d2c79bc0f851869ef253.sourceText: 而美国家庭去杠杆化可能还需要6年左右的时间，在这样的情况下地产的复苏就注定是一个漫长而痛苦的过程。
9723622d4313384035a0d2c79bc0f851869ef253.translatedText: It may take about 6 years for American households to deleverage. Under such circumstances, the recovery of real estate is destined to be a long and painful process.

f3f884fc1761feb9ecb5c8af08124d1e96c9b1f7.sourceText: 不过做着发财美梦的聪明人没有必要等那么久，因为所有权被贱卖了，那么租用权就会兴起。所有权和租用权是可以做对冲的。这里有一个经典的案例那就是美国著名的租车公司Zipcar。Zipcar成立于2000年，可惜业绩一直都稀松平常，因为美国人始终鄙视租车过日子的人，结果Zipcar碰上了好时机—-08年经济危机，从此踏上了飞速增长的康庄大道：从2008年只有22.5万用户增长到了2011年11月份拥有65万用户和9500辆车。在一片凯歌声中，Zipcar于2011年成功上市，丑媳妇终于熬成了婆。
f3f884fc1761feb9ecb5c8af08124d1e96c9b1f7.translatedText: But smart people who dream of getting rich don't have to wait that long, because the ownership is sold at a low price, and then the leasehold rights will rise. Ownership and leasehold rights can be hedged. A classic case here is Zipcar, a famous American car rental company. Zipcar was founded in 2000, but unfortunately its performance has always been mediocre, because Americans have always despised people who rent cars to live their lives. As a result, Zipcar hit a good opportunity - the 2008 economic crisis, and has since embarked on a road of rapid growth: from only 225,000 users in 2008 to 650,000 users and 9,500 vehicles in November 2011. Amid the success, Zipcar was successfully launched in 2011, and the ugly daughter-in-law finally became a mother-in-law.

6a37d6c554965bf4ca12e137b70bcfe098439d41.sourceText: 拥有车的开销是美国家庭第二大的开销，大约占总开支的16%。根据美国汽车协会(AAA)数据，包括汽车贷款，折旧，维修，保险，税和汽油，一个每年开15000英里的中型汽车拥有者每年花在车上的钱是8588美元。所以当08年经济危机打开了美国家庭去杠杆化的闸门，汽车市场就开始一潭死水，而Zipcar就飞黄腾达起来。
6a37d6c554965bf4ca12e137b70bcfe098439d41.translatedText: The cost of owning a car is the second largest expense for American households, accounting for approximately 16% of total expenses. Including car loan, depreciation, maintenance, insurance, taxes and gas, an owner of a midsize car who drives 15,000 miles per year spends $8,588 on their vehicle annually, according to AAA. So when the 2008 economic crisis opened the floodgates for American households to deleverage, the car market began to stagnate, and Zipcar took off.

522eee20d00277d79229962f1018c45851bc6aed.sourceText: 看样子经济危机中也不竟是悲惨故事，比如”哭死了底特律，笑死了Zipcar”就是明证。
522eee20d00277d79229962f1018c45851bc6aed.translatedText: It seems that the economic crisis is not a tragic story. For example, "Detroit cried to death, Zipcar laughed to death" is proof.

e67fc4bbab9b5957bc20e1e4d397cd632bf26783.sourceText: 一个不可阻挡的潮流就是：美国正在从一个”拥有者”的世界变成”租用者”的世界。而且不仅仅是车和房子是这样，这股潮流正在无微不至的蔓延开。比如学生也渐渐开始放弃拥有课本，转向租用，现在甚至有了基于Kindle和iPad的图书租用业务。
e67fc4bbab9b5957bc20e1e4d397cd632bf26783.translatedText: An irresistible trend is that the United States is changing from a world of "owners" to a world of "renters". And it’s not just cars and houses, this trend is spreading in every possible way. For example, students are gradually giving up owning textbooks and turning to renting them. Now there is even a book rental business based on Kindle and iPad.

0b4d2bb41d64a252972a154efc79b23cc3c9cf28.sourceText: 精明的商家如果捉住了这个潮流，就能复制Zipcar的成功故事，这就是美国衰败中的另类繁荣。
0b4d2bb41d64a252972a154efc79b23cc3c9cf28.translatedText: If smart businesses seize this trend, they can copy the success story of Zipcar. This is an alternative prosperity in the decline of the United States.

cf98b747824edd5d9debe50ee4a3897429f658b6.sourceText: 秋高好登高 大峡谷本周六免门票 为庆祝国家公共土地日，本周六前往大峡谷的游客将获得免费入场。 从1994年开始，大峡谷与多个国家公园一起，为鼓励户外活动，在国家公共土地日当天免门票入场。该项免费不包括露营和其他旅游活动费用。大峡谷国家公园门票一般在七天内有效，这次活动中，如果游客在第二天再次进入公园景区，则按平时门票收费。 大峡谷国家公园每年有两次免门票活动，另外一次在十一月，主要服务对象为退伍军人。
cf98b747824edd5d9debe50ee4a3897429f658b6.translatedText: Happy Autumn Hike Free Admission to the Grand Canyon this Saturday In celebration of National Public Lands Day, visitors to the Grand Canyon this Saturday will receive free admission. Since 1994, the Grand Canyon has joined several national parks in offering free admission on National Public Lands Day to encourage outdoor activities. This free fee does not include camping and other tourist activities. Grand Canyon National Park tickets are generally valid within seven days. In this event, if tourists enter the park again on the next day, they will be charged the usual admission fee. Grand Canyon National Park has two free admission events each year, including one in November, primarily for veterans.

78ffe6cc895060cdee6a586d1e26df0df353076f.sourceText: 心水：点燃心香 心水 去年四月参加世界华文作家团到云南采风，每到寺庙参观，见到来自台湾的作家陈若曦大姐，恭敬的面对菩萨合十鞠躬。不像其他信众燃香跪拜，无意发现她敬佛的礼仪竟和我一致，在环保问题上有了共同话题。行程中因而受教良多，算是此行最大的收获。 年青时在原居地，每逢传统节日，我必驾车载先母去「二府庙」拜本头公；协助她将三牲水果摆放祭台上，往往被挂在庙内的大圈小圈神香以及插满铜炉的香枝，所燃放的缭绕烟雾熏到难睁双目，急不及待的跳出庙外。 那时只觉得庙内空气混浊，呼吸不畅，限于知识，还不知嗅多了神香所释放的烟雾会招惹癌魔。但已因为那迷茫烟雾而怕怕，故除了祭拜祖先时母命难违，向祖宗灵位上香外，到庙宇参观，就从来不烧香了。吸引我的是寺院内四周挂满的楹联，为此、往往被母亲数落一番。 海外华人，除了真正归依佛教的善信及领洗成了天主教或基督教的信徒外，余者大都敬拜祖先、诸天神佛和菩萨，早已佛道一家亲。因而、燃香烧冥钱拜三牲这些混肴了多元宗教祭仪的方式，也就被视为理所当然。代代相传，这种敬拜菩萨及祖先的礼仪就延伸下来，成了习俗。反正大家都如此，岂能违背？若不照搬都怕开罪神明和先人？ 随着时代变迁，不合世情的宗教教条也需要改革；比如往昔罗马教廷坚决反对堕胎，争论至今，不也要向时代妥协？默许女教友们在合情合理下进行堕胎手术。教延若坚持，那些被强奸成孕或意外怀孕的妇女，还不是偷偷去打杀了不受欢迎的小生命。 科学研究已证明，吸入香枝的烟雾者，日久必惹来「癌」魔入侵；对人健康百害而无一益。同时、为了环保，在全球关心地球的大题目下，点燃神香，实在是在破坏生态。因为制造香枝的原料是木材，试想世界各地寺庙及拜神的家庭每日点燃的香枝，要砍多少的树木啊？ 也许拜菩萨或敬神拜祖先的读者要问，入庙或在家祭拜时不烧香？如何完成流传已久的祭拜礼仪？其实心诚则灵，入寺庙敬佛拜菩萨，只要在佛像前合十，点燃心香，跪拜或许愿，再虔诚的三鞠躬或三跪叩礼，就已足够了。有灵验的神明、诸天菩萨或十方佛，必然收到信众所求。若不灵验，烧再多的香烛或冥钱，也都白搭。要知道佛菩萨或各路神仙都在另一维空间各显神通，才不会如五浊人世要收受贿赂呢？ 有些地方年节时「大拜拜」，除了尽量杀生、还焚烧极多的纸钱；祭拜先人更焚化纸屋纸车纸丫环，以备逝者在阴间享受？民间信仰多元宗教，这些极不环保的烧冥钱及纸扎物品，无非让活着的人减少对亡者的哀思而情有所托，早已远离佛教教仪。 佛教戒杀生，因此佛寺内拜菩萨一般是用鲜花或水果。有识之士，也渐渐将燃香礼仪改为点燃心香，合十、跪拜或鞠躬，心诚则灵，无改神佛的庇佑。定居瑞士的含弟在客厅供奉祖先灵位，祭台点燃的是用电量极微的电子香烛，总比燃真香好。 各寺院、庙宇的住寺，各地宗教道场的住持人，为了合力齐心挽救地球，在环保的大前题下，理应教育、开示、或通告信众们，现代人要改变参神敬佛拜祖先的旧方法。燃香枝以「点燃心香」替代，祭品改以水果鲜花供奉，不再杀生；(杀生是造孽障啊。)也不应再焚烧冥钱纸扎物品等。因为先人灵魂或已早豋极乐永享仙福，或轮回往生无觅处；那还会存留阴间等待亲人焚化的「物品」呢？ 任何不合时代精神的行为模式，都有改良的必要，宗教礼仪或教规也如此。 祈望各正信宗教团体领导人，各方高僧、大德、大师们及早昭示各信众，为了配合文明世界爱謢地球及拯救地球的行动，改良民间不环保的参拜礼仪此其时矣! 大爱精神无分宗教，不分种族国界；对我们生存的唯一地球，若不爱护，何来「爱心」呢？在此点燃心香，祝福诸位读者身心安康，恳请大家多多行善积德，齐来参予环保工作，为后代子孙略尽绵力。 二零一零年元月廿五日于无相斋。
78ffe6cc895060cdee6a586d1e26df0df353076f.translatedText: Favorite: Ignite the incense in the heart. Favorite: In April last year, I joined the World Chinese Writers Group to travel to Yunnan. Every time I visited a temple, I saw Sister Chen Ruoxi, a writer from Taiwan, who bowed respectfully to the Bodhisattva. Unlike other believers who burned incense and knelt down to worship, I accidentally discovered that her etiquette for worshiping Buddha was the same as mine, and we had a common topic on environmental issues. I learned a lot during the trip, which is the biggest gain from this trip. When I was young in my hometown, during traditional festivals, I would drive my late mother to the "Erfu Temple" to worship my father-in-law; I would help her place the fruits of the three animals on the altar, which would often be surrounded by large and small circles of sacred incense sticks hanging in the temple and incense sticks from the copper stove. The smoke would make it difficult to open my eyes, and I would jump out of the temple impatiently. At that time, I only felt that the air in the temple was turbid and my breathing was not smooth. I was limited by my knowledge. I did not know that smelling too much smoke from the sacred incense would attract cancer. But I was already afraid of the confusing smoke, so I never burned incense except when I paid homage to my ancestors and offered incense to the ancestor’s shrine. What attracts me is the couplets hanging all around the temple. For this, my mother often scolds me. Overseas Chinese, except those who have truly converted to Buddhism and those who have been baptized into Catholicism or Christianity, most of them worship their ancestors, gods, Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, and have long been members of the Buddhist and Taoist family. Therefore, burning incense, burning money, and worshiping three animals, which are mixed with multiple religious rituals, are taken for granted. From generation to generation, this etiquette of worshiping Bodhisattvas and ancestors has been extended and become a custom. Since everyone is like this, how can we violate it? If you don’t copy it, are you afraid of offending the gods and ancestors? As times change, religious dogmas that are not in line with the world also need to be reformed; for example, in the past, the Holy See was firmly opposed to abortion, and the debate continues to this day. Doesn’t it also have to compromise with the times? Female church members are tacitly allowed to perform abortions within reasonable limits. Jiao Yanruo insists that those women who were raped into pregnancy or had unwanted pregnancies did not secretly kill unwanted little lives. Scientific research has proven that those who inhale the smoke of incense sticks will inevitably be invaded by the "cancer" demon over time, which is harmful to human health without any benefit. At the same time, for the sake of environmental protection and under the global concern of the earth, lighting sacred incense is actually destroying the ecology. Because the raw material for making incense sticks is wood, just imagine how many trees would be cut down to light incense sticks every day in temples and families worshiping gods around the world? Readers who worship Bodhisattvas or worship ancestors may want to ask, why don’t you burn incense when entering a temple or worshiping at home? How to complete the long-standing worship ritual? In fact, sincerity leads to spiritual success. When entering a temple to worship Buddha and Bodhisattvas, it is enough to put your hands together in front of the Buddha statue, light the incense, kneel down or make a wish, and then bow or kneel three times sincerely. There are efficacious gods, bodhisattvas in the heavens, or Buddhas from the ten directions, and they will definitely receive the requests of believers. If it doesn't work, no matter how much incense or money you burn, it will be in vain. We must know that Buddhas, Bodhisattvas or gods from all walks of life are displaying their magical powers in another dimension, so they will not accept bribes like the five turbid worlds? In some places, during the New Year's Day, they not only kill as many animals as possible, but also burn a lot of paper money. They also burn paper houses, paper cars, and paper maids to worship their ancestors, so that the deceased can enjoy them in the afterlife? Folks believe in multiple religions. These extremely environmentally unfriendly burning money and paper items only allow the living to reduce their grief for the deceased and have some support. They have long been far away from Buddhist rituals. Buddhism prohibits killing, so flowers or fruits are usually used to worship Bodhisattvas in Buddhist temples. People with insight have gradually changed the etiquette of burning incense to lighting heart incense, folding hands, kneeling or bowing. Sincerity brings spirituality, without changing the blessing of gods and Buddhas. Brother Ham, who lives in Switzerland, worships his ancestors' shrines in the living room. The altar lights electronic incense candles that consume very little electricity, which is better than burning real incense. In order to work together to save the earth, the residents of various monasteries and temples, and the abbots of religious ashrams in various places, under the premise of environmental protection, should educate, enlighten, or inform believers that modern people need to change the old way of worshiping gods, worshiping Buddha, and worshiping their ancestors. Burning incense sticks should be replaced by "lighting the incense in the heart", and sacrifices should be offered with fruits and flowers instead of killing animals; (killing animals is a sin and obstacle.) It is also not possible to burn ghost money, paper or other items. Because the souls of our ancestors may have already lived in bliss and enjoy immortal blessings forever, or they may have been reincarnated and have no place to find them. So, will there still be "items" left in the underworld waiting for relatives to be incinerated? Any behavior pattern that is not in line with the spirit of the times needs to be improved, and the same is true for religious rituals or canons. I hope that the leaders of all orthodox religious groups, eminent monks, sages and masters from all walks of life will make it clear to all believers as soon as possible that in order to cooperate with the civilized world's actions to love and save the earth, it is time to improve the non-environmental worship rituals among the people! The spirit of great love does not distinguish between religions, races and national boundaries; if we do not care for the only earth we live on, how can we have "love"? I would like to light up my heart here and wish all readers good physical and mental health. I urge everyone to do more good deeds and accumulate virtue, come together to participate in environmental protection work, and do your best for future generations. On January 25, 2010, in Wuxiangzhai.

efb968d16f65c8030cfba64dca50093c2adcf1cd.sourceText: 新闻评论：《怒江告急》？中国建水坝动辄得咎 凤凰城 九峰 纽约时报头版《中国重启怒江水电站大坝项目，怒江告急》别有用心地诬称怒江水电项目是一场”灾难” ，海外一些华文媒体不加思索地附和跟风，世界周刊《中国建水坝霸权不睦邻？》提到”去年云南澜沧江糯扎渡水坝经八年建设，投产发电，澜沧江上游数个大坝拦水，造成湄公河水位不足” 。 更傲慢地指责”但中国却不能蛮横，无视邻国水资源需求而用大坝堵住所有水源，否则引起公愤” 。世界周刊似乎只图政治正确，既拿不出令人信服的事实和理论依据，又缺少严谨逻辑推理，有失媒体的公平公正性。 理论上讲水坝的建设本身并不会改变河流的径流总量，而蓄洪能力越强的大坝、系列梯级大坝起到削峰滞洪的作用，反而会减少下游洪灾，增大河流的有效供水量。极端的例子是季节河流，当雨季到来洪水泛滥成灾，人们往往只能望水兴叹，看着宝贵的淡水白白流入大海而无法利用；到了旱季的洪泛区又寸草不生，风沙弥漫，这样的河即使年径流量再大，人类受益有限。如果建设大坝把雨季的洪水蓄存起来以添补旱季的水资源不足，同时减少下游雨季水患的威胁，并产生清洁能源本是互利双赢的好事，怎么会成了堵住所有水源？说实在的，人类还没有一项技术可以堵住水源的。 大坝建成初期蓄水阶段如果控制不合理可能在一定时间内减少下游的流量，如果只顾自己发电而不能兼顾下游的利益就蛮横、霸道了。然而即使如此流域的水一滴也没有减少，只是流过的时间段发生改变，总的来说水坝的作用使得雨季水位降低，旱季水位升高，而不是一概而论建水电站造成河流水位不足。因为水电站本身并不消耗水资源，它只是改变了径流的方式，如果上下游配合，水电站对下游有效利用水资源一定是利大于弊。当然如果从水资源的控制关系到国家战略利益的考虑就另当别论了。所以一些国家炒作中国水电建设实质不是水资源利用问题而是地缘政治问题，这也便是纽时高调宣称”怒江告急”的政治目的之一。。 美国第二大河科罗拉多河年均径流量185亿立方米，落差不到3000米，并不是一条径流量充沛，落差很大的国际河流，然而美国沿河共建了5座大型水电站，水资源利用率89%，留给下游墨西哥18.5亿立方米的流量以保河口三角洲地带不至于干枯。怒江在中国境内落差4840米，出境年径流量703亿立方米，是科罗拉多河的三倍多。在中国国务院《能源开发”十二五”规划》中，怒江5座水电列入规划。纽约时报《中国重启怒江水电站大坝项目，怒江告急》就是要把一个水电项目刻意炒做成重大国际政治问题。且不论纽约时报为何不为仅拿到10%水权的墨西哥打抱不平，很多美国人都知道科罗拉多河上的美国第二高坝葛兰峡谷大坝上世纪九十年代也曾因环境保护组织以保护鱼类资源为目的炒作到几乎被炸毁的闹剧，幸亏连续几年的流域性干旱让人们再次认识到水资源的重要性才使得大坝得以保存，而近年来全球气候变暖的问题日益严重，更显的清洁能源的弥足珍贵。鱼类需要保护，地球更需要保护，皮之不在,毛将焉附？ 水利项目的建设与否，应该留给科学家去论证，人为的政治炒作无论对上游或下游的水资源利用，还是全人类共同面临的气候变暖问题都是有害无益的。公众应该用理性科学的态度应对那些不负责任传媒的恶意渲染。
efb968d16f65c8030cfba64dca50093c2adcf1cd.translatedText: News Commentary: "The Nu River is in emergency"? China often gets blamed for building dams Phoenix Jiufeng The front page of the New York Times "China restarts the Nu River hydropower dam project, the Nu River is in emergency" falsely claimed that the Nu River hydropower project was a "disaster" with ulterior motives. Some overseas Chinese media followed suit without thinking, and World Weekly "China's hegemony in building dams is not a good neighbor?" " mentioned that "Last year, after eight years of construction, the Nuozhadu Dam on the Lancang River in Yunnan was put into operation to generate electricity. Several dams in the upper reaches of the Lancang River blocked water, resulting in insufficient water levels in the Mekong River." He even more arrogantly accused, "But China cannot be arrogant and ignore the water needs of neighboring countries and block all water sources with dams, otherwise it will cause public outrage." World Weekly seems to be only trying to be politically correct. It is unable to provide convincing facts and theoretical basis, and lacks rigorous logical reasoning, which violates the fairness and impartiality of the media. Theoretically speaking, the construction of the dam itself will not change the total runoff of the river. Dams with stronger flood storage capacity and a series of cascade dams can reduce peaks and delay floods. On the contrary, they will reduce downstream floods and increase the effective water supply of the river. An extreme example is seasonal rivers. When the rainy season comes and floods occur, people often can only look at the water and sigh, watching the precious fresh water flowing into the sea in vain and unable to use it; in the dry season, the floodplain area is barren of grass and filled with wind and sand. Even if the annual runoff of such a river is large, human beings will benefit only limitedly. If a dam is built to store floods during the rainy season to supplement water shortages during the dry season, while reducing the threat of rainy season floods downstream and generating clean energy, it is a mutually beneficial and win-win good thing. How could it end up blocking all water sources? To be honest, mankind does not yet have a technology that can block water sources. If the control during the initial water storage stage of the dam is unreasonable, the downstream flow may be reduced for a certain period of time. It would be arrogant and overbearing to only care about its own power generation without taking into account the interests of the downstream. However, even so, the water in the basin has not decreased at all, but the time period during which it flows has changed. Generally speaking, the role of dams has reduced the water level in the rainy season and increased the water level in the dry season, rather than generalizing the construction of hydropower stations to cause insufficient river water levels. Because the hydropower station itself does not consume water resources, it only changes the pattern of runoff. If the upstream and downstream cooperate, the hydropower station will definitely have more benefits than disadvantages for the effective use of water resources downstream. Of course, if the control of water resources is related to national strategic interests, it is another matter. Therefore, the fact that some countries are hyping China's hydropower construction is not a water resource utilization issue but a geopolitical issue. This is one of the political purposes of the New York Times' high-profile claim that "the Nu River is in urgent need." . The Colorado River, the second largest river in the United States, has an average annual runoff of 18.5 billion cubic meters, with a drop of less than 3,000 meters. It is not an international river with abundant runoff and a large drop. However, the United States has built five large hydropower stations along the river, with a water resource utilization rate of 89%, leaving 1.85 billion cubic meters of flow for downstream Mexico to prevent the estuary delta from drying up. The Nu River has a height of 4,840 meters in China, and its annual runoff is 70.3 billion cubic meters, more than three times that of the Colorado River. In the "Twelfth Five-Year Plan for Energy Development" of the State Council of China, five hydropower projects in Nujiang are included in the plan. The New York Times' "China restarts Nu River hydropower dam project, Nu River is in emergency" is to deliberately hype a hydropower project into a major international political issue. Regardless of why the New York Times did not complain about Mexico, which only received 10% of its water rights, many Americans know that the Glen Canyon Dam, the second tallest dam in the United States on the Colorado River, was almost blown up in the 1990s due to the hype of environmental protection organizations for the purpose of protecting fish resources. Fortunately, several consecutive years of basin droughts have made people realize the importance of water resources again, so the dam can be saved. In recent years, the problem of global warming has become increasingly serious, making clean energy even more precious. Fish need protection, and the earth needs protection even more. If the skin is not there, where will the hair be? Whether water conservancy projects should be constructed or not should be left to scientists to demonstrate. Artificial political hype is harmful to both upstream and downstream water resource utilization, as well as to the climate warming problem faced by all mankind. The public should respond to the malicious exaggeration by irresponsible media with a rational and scientific attitude.

2a5a320bc8f9633c551f2a2f10b2b185c26953c0.sourceText: 第二届世界华文教育大会出台推动华文教育的新举措(图) 出席世界华教大会的美国代表：全美中文学校协会成员，各地华校校长 【全美中文学校协会来稿】上个月，第二届世界华文教育大会在西安市圆满闭幕。全美中文学校协会副会长帅致若代表协会出席了大会，并作为第一组的讨论召集人向大会作了报告。近日帅致若回到美国后，已向协会会长及一些华教人士汇报这届大会主要的内容和今后会给各地华教工作带来的机遇和推动华教发展的新举措。 这届华教大会共有来自37个国家和地区的近600名各界代表与会，共商华文教育大计。 大会主题是：凝聚力量，推动华文教育大发展。主要内容包括：交流目前海外华文教育的形势、特点及发展趋势；研讨促进海外华文教育可持续发展的新思路、新举措；举行”海外华文教育示范学校”授牌活动；表彰海外优秀华文教师；表彰海外杰出华教人士；举办中华文化知识竞赛总决赛。 令各国各地区华教人士收到鼓舞的是，这届大会上，国侨办推出了一系列新举措，来促进海外华文教育的大发展，主要包括： 加强与外国教育部门沟通合作，鼓励国内院校对外交流合作；拟在5年内在海外建300所华文教育示范学校；每年帮200所华文学校建中文图书室；开发”本土化”教材，以满足不同国家和地区对华文教材的”个性化”需求；研发趣味性强的课外读物和教辅材料；加大华文教师大培训力度，建立培训，考核，认证”三位一体”的培训机制；研发华文水平测试系统；大力开展中华文化体验活动，包括海外青少年夏（冬）令营，中华文化知识大赛，作文比赛等活动。 有关第二届世界华文教育大会的详细内容请见中国华文教育网相关报道： http://www.hwjyw.com/zt/worldChinese/conference/second/index.shtml
2a5a320bc8f9633c551f2a2f10b2b185c26953c0.translatedText: The second World Chinese Education Conference introduced new measures to promote Chinese education (photo) U.S. representatives attending the World Chinese Education Conference: members of the National Association of Chinese Schools, principals of Chinese schools in various places [Contribution from the National Association of Chinese Schools] Last month, the Second World Chinese Education Conference concluded successfully in Xi'an. Shuai Zhiruo, vice president of the National Association of Chinese Schools, attended the conference on behalf of the association and made a report to the conference as the discussion convener of the first group. After Shuai Zhiruo returned to the United States recently, he has reported to the president of the association and some Chinese education personnel on the main contents of this conference and the opportunities it will bring to Chinese education work in various places in the future as well as new measures to promote the development of Chinese education. Nearly 600 representatives from all walks of life from 37 countries and regions attended this Chinese Education Conference to discuss plans for Chinese education. The theme of the conference is: Gathering strength to promote the development of Chinese education. The main contents include: exchanging the current situation, characteristics and development trends of overseas Chinese education; discussing new ideas and new measures to promote the sustainable development of overseas Chinese education; holding the "Overseas Chinese Education Demonstration School" awarding event; commending outstanding overseas Chinese teachers; commending outstanding overseas Chinese educators; and holding the Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition Finals. What is encouraging to Chinese education professionals in various countries and regions is that at this conference, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council launched a series of new measures to promote the development of overseas Chinese education, including: Strengthen communication and cooperation with foreign education departments, encourage domestic institutions to exchange and cooperate with foreign countries; plan to build 300 Chinese education model schools overseas within five years; help 200 Chinese schools build Chinese libraries every year; develop "localized" teaching materials to meet the "individualized" needs for Chinese teaching materials in different countries and regions; conduct research and development Interesting extracurricular readings and teaching materials; intensify the training of Chinese teachers, establish a "trinity" training mechanism of training, assessment, and certification; develop a Chinese proficiency test system; vigorously carry out Chinese cultural experience activities, including overseas youth summer (winter) camps, Chinese cultural knowledge competitions, essay competitions and other activities. For details about the Second World Chinese Education Conference, please see the relevant reports on the China Chinese Education Network: http://www.hwjyw.com/zt/worldChinese/conference/second/index.shtml

7f0be0c888931991c94fcd5b162e6375ac9a4676.sourceText: 诺华药厂召回止痛药、胃药 （亚省时报） 联邦食品暨药物管理局(FDA)9日警告说，诺华药厂(Novartis)在内布拉斯加州林肯市的工厂，因为一项生产错误，可能把强力止痛药混在不需处方药购买的普通止痛药和胃药，如Excedrin、Gas-X等的药瓶中。 诺华药厂8日已经全面召回该工厂生产的止痛药和胃药。诺华公司收到投诉说，发现残破和碎屑药片，以及不一致的药品包装，该公司说，消费者应该停止使用这些药，并与该公司联络以获得退款。 诺华药厂8日宣布召回2014年12月20日失效的头痛药Excedrin，和咖啡因药片NoDoz，以及2013年12月20日及更早失效的止痛药Bufferin和胃药Gas-X。消费者可以打电话888-477-2403询问，诺华药厂建议消费者检查药片的形状、颜色、大小和印记是否一致，如果有一片或更多药片看来不一样，应把药退回给药局。 FDA官员9日说，诺华药厂生产的止痛药可能混入了也在该内州工厂制造的强力止痛药，包括Endo药厂的类鸦片药物Percocet、Endocet、Opana和Zydone。 Endo药厂说，没有确证的混合药片让消费者生病的报告。 FDA的官员考克斯说，该局并未召回这些止痛药，因为许多病人需要这些药，而买到错误药的机会也很低，所以病人不需过度紧张。考克斯说，该局目前正在检查该工厂，发现一个生产错误，可能使药片卡在机器中，并进入其他药品的包装内。 考克斯说，该局担心未来数周Endo厂止痛药的缺货，因为诺华药厂在上个月已经停止该工厂的生产。 FDA在一项声明中说，缺货的程度将取决于工厂能多快设立安全机制，防止未来发生类似的情况。
7f0be0c888931991c94fcd5b162e6375ac9a4676.translatedText: Novartis Pharmaceuticals Recalls Painkillers and Stomach Medicines (Alberta Times) The federal Food and Drug Administration (FDA) warned on the 9th that due to a manufacturing error at a Novartis plant in Lincoln, Nebraska, powerful painkillers may have been mixed into bottles of common painkillers and stomach medicines purchased without a prescription, such as Excedrin, Gas-X, etc. Novartis Pharmaceuticals has issued a comprehensive recall of painkillers and stomach medicines produced at the factory on the 8th. Novartis received complaints that broken and broken tablets were found, as well as inconsistent drug packaging. The company said that consumers should stop using these medicines and contact the company for a refund. On the 8th, Novartis announced the recall of the headache drug Excedrin and the caffeine pill NoDoz, which expired on December 20, 2014, as well as the painkiller Bufferin and stomach medicine G that expired on December 20, 2013 and earlier. as - FDA officials said on the 9th that painkillers produced by Novartis Pharmaceuticals may be mixed with powerful painkillers also manufactured in the state's factories, including Endo Pharmaceuticals' opioid drugs Percocet, Endocet, Opana and Zydone. Endo Pharmaceuticals said there are no confirmed reports of mixed pills making consumers sick. FDA official Cox said the agency is not recalling the painkillers because many patients need them and the chances of getting the wrong ones are low, so patients don't need to be overly nervous. Cox said the agency is currently inspecting the plant and found a manufacturing error that could have caused the pills to get stuck in the machine and get into the packaging of other drugs. Cox said the agency is concerned about the shortage of painkillers at the Endo plant in the coming weeks because Novartis stopped production at the plant last month. The extent of the shortage will depend on how quickly factories can put safety mechanisms in place to prevent similar situations from happening in the future, the FDA said in a statement.

1efd8f5a8c0f4c56872e3e053b80559da17ff3d3.sourceText: 长期以来，中文学校的小朋友们发表了为数不少的短文，我几乎每一篇都仔细的关读，小朋友们的作文，描述了他（她）们的见闻，他们的理想，他（她）们的爱好，他（她）们的喜乐，充满童趣、稚气和天真，每一篇习作都注明辅导老师的姓氏，我一个年逾古稀的老奶奶，感到中文学校的领导和老师们做了一件非常了不起的事，孩子们的家长也同样做了一件了不起的事。 我们的祖国有着五千年的悠久历史，我们民族的文化博大精深，无论我们生活在什麽国度，居住在世界任何地方，我们都有将伟大的中国文化传承下去的责任和义务，鳯凰中文学校的老师们，还有那些可爱的家长们，正是在做这样一件有意义的工作，他（她）们在培养孩子学习英语的同时，再学习中国文化，他（她）们的辛劳，值得赞扬。中华民族是一个有着灿烂文化的民族，一部二十四史，记述了多少英雄事迹，又记下多少宫帏惨变，祸起萧牆，夺嫡之争。从周朝的”诗经”开始，诗、词、歌、赋有如汪洋大海，浩瀚无边，唐诗、宋词更是烟波浩淼，让我们这些后人一生也享用不完，宋时的伟大诗人苏东坡，他脍炙人口的”水调歌头”…人有悲欢离合，用有阴晴圆缺，此事古难全，成了千古绝唱，在大自然中常常是”古难全”，人类社会以及每个人的人生也会是”古难全”。东坡居士写出了人生、万物的真谛。唐代的李白、杜甫更是家喻户晓，李杜的诗是言志，是诗人显意识的情意和表达，李白至今留下的一千馀首诗歌和杜甫的诗作以及从古到今多少文人墨客、诗人才子给我们留下的无以数计的精美绝伦的诗词和好文章，形式多样，内容丰富，精緻、微妙、婉转、流畅、深邃、悠长，读后令人回味无穷，引起我们对祖国民族文化、品德、学问、文学、艺术的联想和启迪，再说中国的四大名着更是一幅中国社会的民俗画卷，单说一部”红楼梦”就浓缩了中国封建社会的兴衰….，所有这些都是祖国文化宝库中的玫宝，我们从文化的视角来欣赏，品味前人留下的这些珍贵文化遗产，作为炎黄子孙，应该引以为荣，作为一个蕴藏着丰富文化气息的民族的后代，我们将为之骄傲。再从历史的角度来看，秦皇、汉武、唐宗、宋祖，明、清、民国至今，我们的祖国在漫长的历史长河中，出现了多少值得讴歌的民族英雄，又历经了多少腥风血雨，这些都应该让我们的下一代、下二代小朋友们至少有一个粗略的了解，因为我们是炎黄子孙。 我绝没有提倡复古的意思，现代科技日新月异，小朋友们必须学习并掌握科学技术，但我认为，不管他她们将来是从医或学电子工程，学经济、修管理，学国际贸易，或学地质勘测、航天技术等等，都不应该忘了老祖宗的灿烂文化，那是一颗璀璨的明珠。小朋友们应该传承下来。 我非常赞赏那些让孩子们回到家就说中国话的家长，让小朋友在美国受教育的同时，接受一些中华民族的传统教育，对中国的优良传统有所领悟和感受，这是一件值得大家去努力完成的有意义的事情，感谢中文学校的组织者和老师们，他（她）们正是在做着予我们的后代有益的事，希望通过他（她）的努力，如果能在众多小朋友中培养出如李白、杜甫、李时珍、鲁迅、杨振宁、钱学森等诸多的文学家和科学家，那将是中国人之大幸。 以上所谈，纯属个人看法，不妥之处，敬请指正。
1efd8f5a8c0f4c56872e3e053b80559da17ff3d3.translatedText: For a long time, children in Chinese schools have published a lot of short essays. I read almost every one of them carefully. The children’s essays describe their (her) knowledge, their ideals, and their (her) hobbies. , their (her) joy is full of childishness, childishness and innocence, and each exercise is marked with the last name of the tutor. As an old woman who is over seventy years old, I feel that the leaders and teachers of the Chinese school have done a great thing, and the parents of the children have also done a great thing. Our motherland has a long history of five thousand years, and our national culture is extensive and profound. No matter what country we live in or where we live in the world, we have the responsibility and obligation to pass on the great Chinese culture. The teachers of Huanghuang Chinese School, as well as those lovely parents, are doing such a meaningful work. They are training their children to learn English while also learning Chinese culture. Their hard work is worthy of praise. The Chinese nation is a nation with a splendid culture. The Twenty-Four Histories record many heroic deeds, as well as many tragic changes in the palace curtains, disasters caused by Xiaoqiang, and battles for the heir. Starting from the "Book of Songs" of the Zhou Dynasty, poems, lyrics, songs, and poems are like a vast ocean, vast and boundless. Tang poetry and Song poetry are even more vast, allowing us descendants to enjoy them endlessly in our lifetimes. Su Dongpo, the great poet of the Song Dynasty, is highly praised The "water melody song" of the human population...people have joys and sorrows, as well as the ups and downs. This matter is difficult to complete in ancient times and has become a masterpiece through the ages. In nature, it is often "uncompleted in ancient times". Human society and everyone's life will also be "uncompleted in ancient times". Dongpo layman wrote the true meaning of life and all things. Li Bai and Du Fu in the Tang Dynasty are even more well-known to every household. Li Du's poems are the expression of ambition, the emotions and expressions of the poet's conscious mind. Li Bai has left more than a thousand poems and Du Fu's poems, as well as many literati, poets and talents from ancient times to the present. The countless exquisite poems and good articles left by them are diverse in form, rich in content, exquisite, subtle, tactful, smooth, profound and long. After reading, they are endlessly memorable and arouse our understanding of the national culture, moral character and learning of our motherland. Questions, associations and inspirations from literature and art. Besides, China’s four famous masterpieces are a folklore picture of Chinese society. One “Dream of Red Mansions” alone condenses the rise and fall of China’s feudal society... All of these are treasures in the cultural treasure house of the motherland. We appreciate them from a cultural perspective and taste these precious cultural heritages left by our predecessors. As descendants of the Yan and Huang Dynasties, we should be proud of them. As descendants of a nation rich in cultural flavor, we will be proud of them. From a historical perspective, from Emperor Qin to Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty, Emperor Zong of the Tang Dynasty, Emperor Song of the Song Dynasty, Ming Dynasty, Qing Dynasty, and the Republic of China to the present day, our motherland has had many national heroes worth praising and experienced many bloody storms in its long history. These should give our next generation of children at least a rough understanding, because we are the descendants of Yan and Huang. I have no intention of advocating retrospection. Modern technology is changing rapidly, and children must learn and master science and technology. However, I believe that whether they study medicine, electronic engineering, economics, management, international trade, geological surveying, aerospace technology, etc., they should not forget the splendid culture of their ancestors, which is a bright pearl. Children should pass it on. I greatly appreciate those parents who allow their children to speak Chinese when they return home. While being educated in the United States, their children can receive some traditional education of the Chinese nation and understand and feel the fine traditions of China. This is a meaningful thing worthy of everyone's efforts. Thank you to the organization of the Chinese school. Organizers and teachers, they are doing things that are beneficial to our future generations. I hope that through his or her efforts, it will be a great blessing for the Chinese people if they can cultivate many writers and scientists such as Li Bai, Du Fu, Li Shizhen, Lu Xun, Yang Zhenning, Qian Xuesen, etc. among many children. What I said above is purely my personal opinion. Please correct me if it is inappropriate.

d6c8834b6715ef53c2c2476d08c13e23f490af5b.sourceText: 「华总来稿」由中国海外交流协会、美国侨报中国文化发展中心提供的《中华民族全家福》图片展日前在凤凰城华人耆英中心举行，无论华人或美国友人，都仔细地观看每一镜框里色彩美丽的照片和有关各民族的简介说明。有的家庭老少三代一同观看，其乐融融，体现出海外炎黄子孙浓重的家园情结。
d6c8834b6715ef53c2c2476d08c13e23f490af5b.translatedText: "Submissions from the Chinese Nationality" provided by the China Overseas Exchange Association and the Chinese Cultural Development Center of the Chinese Overseas Chinese Newspaper were recently held at the Chinese Senior Center in Phoenix. Both Chinese and American friends carefully looked at the beautifully colored photos and brief introductions about each ethnic group in each frame. Some families, old and young, watched it together and enjoyed it happily, reflecting the strong home complex of the descendants of Yan and Huang overseas.

58bb25efc92776254b6b1a237c4c9d45ce610f70.sourceText: 展览现场 众所周知，中华民族是由56个民族组成的大家庭。公元221年前，秦始皇统一中国，建立了第一个多民族国家。 1949年新中国建立后，开始了中国各民族平等、团结、互助的时代。摄影家陈海汶带领14人创作团队，费时一年多，走遍28个省市、自治区，运用独特的摄影采访方法，摄影了大量照片，以生动的视角语言，全方位展现56个民族的现实生活情况。
58bb25efc92776254b6b1a237c4c9d45ce610f70.translatedText: Exhibition scene As we all know, the Chinese nation is a big family composed of 56 ethnic groups. Before 221 AD, Qin Shihuang unified China and established the first multi-ethnic country. After the founding of New China in 1949, the era of equality, unity, and mutual assistance among all ethnic groups in China began. Photographer Chen Haiwen led a creative team of 14 people and spent more than a year traveling to 28 provinces, municipalities and autonomous regions. Using a unique photography interview method, he took a large number of photos and used a vivid perspective to comprehensively display the real life conditions of 56 ethnic groups.

67bea2658c94e0f0d577e2e244bf8f627e481522.sourceText: 中国海外交流协会希望通过《中华民族全家福》图片的展出，为促进中国及至世界各民族互相了解，共同繁荣和发展做出贡献。此次活动得到亚利桑那州华人华侨总会（亚省华总）顾问吴亮祖先生、亚省华总代会长王胜君先生、亚省华总常务副会长、图桑中文学校校长雷宏先生、亚省华总财务吴宁先生、亚省华总秘书长 曹志斌 先生、亚省华总徐强、杨文田先生、科学家工程师协会杨厦先生、亚省高科技协会姚小寅、徐伟、卓云峰先生，ASU中国学生学者联谊会、UA中国学生学者联谊会、美国凤凰国际旅行社等的大力协助，大家对他们表示衷心的感谢。图片将移到图桑继续举行展出。首展将于12月18日在St. Philip Plaza举办的ALFONSO GOURMET交友会进行。
67bea2658c94e0f0d577e2e244bf8f627e481522.translatedText: The China Overseas Exchange Association hopes that through the exhibition of the "Chinese Nation Family Portrait" pictures, it will contribute to promoting mutual understanding, common prosperity and development of all ethnic groups in China and the world. This event was attended by Mr. Wu Liangzu, advisor of the Arizona Chinese Association (Arizona Chinese Association), Mr. Wang Shengjun, acting president of the Arizona Chinese Association, Mr. Lei Hong, executive vice president of the Arizona Chinese Association, principal of Tucson Chinese School, Mr. Wu Ning, the treasurer of the Arizona Chinese Association, and Cao Zhibin, secretary-general of the Arizona Chinese Association. Sir, Mr. Xu Qiang and Mr. Yang Wentian of the Huazhong Association of Alberta, Mr. Yang Xia of the Association of Scientists and Engineers, Mr. Yao Xiaoyin, Xu Wei, and Zhuo Yunfeng of the Alberta High-tech Association, ASU Chinese Students and Scholars Association, UA Chinese Students and Scholars Association, Phoenix International Travel Agency, etc. for their great assistance. We would like to express our heartfelt thanks to them. The pictures will be moved to Tucson where they will remain on display. The first exhibition will be held on December 18th at the ALFONSO GOURMET Dating Meeting in St. Philip Plaza.
