6986f99252ba45e31652fbda532360a1a757759e.sourceText: 在某个时间，某个空间，我们在这里，美国亚利桑那州，有的人留下来了，有的人海归了，在时间和空间的交界点中，有很多分秒组成的故事，在太阳鸟亚省华人网的《太阳鸟纪事》中，我们看到张肇鸿，气如虹，文若，慧明，凤鸣，心水等很多老侨用文字记录他们的生活，首先感谢他们的记录，让我们看到了一代移民的成长足迹。在凤凰城还有一些在高科技区忙碌的新移民，以及来学习的留学生，他们带着７０后，８０后，９０后的华裔的气息，来到这里，他们面对的人生变化和选择，正在发生。”太阳鸟亚省华人网”希望能记录下这些，调动采访力量来记录这个时间和空间里的故事。特约记者冯海燕就记录了一个留学生的一天，平凡的一天也夹杂着选择和坚持。如果你身边有有意思的人，或者有意思的故事，请与我们联系，一起分享《太阳鸟纪事》。
6986f99252ba45e31652fbda532360a1a757759e.translatedText: At a certain time, in a certain space, we are here, in Arizona, USA. Some people have stayed, and some have returned from overseas. At the intersection of time and space , there are many stories composed of minutes and seconds. In the "Sunbird Chronicles" of the Sunbird Asia Chinese Network, we see many old overseas Chinese such as Zhang Zhaohong, Qi Ruhong, Wen Ruo, Huiming, Fengming, Xinshui, etc. recording their lives in words. First of all, we would like to thank them for their records, which allow us to see the growth footprints of a generation of immigrants. In Phoenix, there are also some new immigrants who are busy in the high-tech district, as well as international students who come to study. They come here with the aura of Chinese people born in the 1970s, 1980s, and 1990s. The life changes and choices they face are happening now. "Sunbird Asia Chinese Network" hopes to record these and mobilize the power of interviews to record the stories in this time and space. Special reporter Feng Haiyan recorded a day in the life of an international student. An ordinary day is also mixed with choices and persistence. If you have interesting people or interesting stories around you, please contact us and share "Sunbird Chronicles" together.

90e0fd2ce1e91cdb280367bb7be7d927cac80d05.sourceText: 美中文化艺术交流协会举办“茶余饭后”之交响乐 （李文）美中文化艺术交流协会继十月份举办的” 茶余饭后 ”，画家范融先生主讲过的”中国画欣赏”後，得到大家热烈的反应，对中国多名世界级名画家的大作赞叹不已，深感佩服，受益不少。 与会人员合影 十一月份的” 茶余饭后 ”同样在”凤城大酒家”举办，这次由协会副主席凤城变脸大师陈志钢先生带来一席”怎么欣赏交响乐”第一章，综览交响乐的结构。 陈先生以精美图片投影解读说：他介绍的是西方交响乐，主要分作四部：弦乐部、木管乐部、铜管乐部、打击乐部。它们都各执其独特音色风格，互相协调，互相呼应。 弦乐部好比是人体亮丽的外表，音色优雅，飘逸柔美，共有小提琴、中提琴、大提琴(坐着拉)低音大提琴(站着或坐在高椅子拉)。木管乐代表人体的体格，结实强壮，与亮丽的外表融为一股有灵气的摄人音色，最为表表者便是双簧管(oboe)、箫、笛、等。铜管乐是人体的骨干，硬朗的一面，计有圆号，此乐器型态大而重，圆形的喇叭口扭曲转向後方向上展示、小号、长号等，在游行表演时是最常见的乐器之一。打击乐包括各种大小不一的鼓、敲打金属类像常见的三角形琴或木琴等。 陈先生再补充说，除以上四部乐器外，如乐章有需要时，还会加上钢琴或竖琴。各种乐器的分配比例及方位的左右，前後位置的安排，都表现出和谐协调。在乐曲演奏进行时，每部所谱奏的乐章好比是诉说一段话语，优扬飘逸或激情奔放都使人们在欣赏中陶醉无穷，诚然，能奏出优美音色的乐器，其价值也不菲。 会众很感谢陈先生为我们带来这主题，给我们增加对音乐的兴趣，尤其是交响乐的认识，也有提问说，现在有些流行曲也以交响乐来配乐，不是失去古典音乐的特色吗？古雅瑜老师补充说，其实音乐已在不断的演变成多元化了，从而适应各层面发展，音乐最终还是音乐，只不过各适其适吧了，并没有立场的阶限，只有欣赏者的观感角度不同而已。 顺此，美中文化艺术交流协会在十二月廾七日(星期四)晚上6:30在凤城酒家举办的” 茶余饭后 ”，由协会主席古雅瑜主讲”唱出健康与快乐”。古老师在社区中已进行”乐疗”义务服务，所见效果非常显著，古代人常说以乐疗疾，常听乐曲消愁解闷，远离抑郁，免於服药，音乐能陶冶身心，音乐是养生之道。 欢迎各界朋友同来参与，共赏音乐大餐宴，会后设有五脏小餐宴，每人最低诮费十元，敬请淮时出席，祝各位节日快乐健康。
90e0fd2ce1e91cdb280367bb7be7d927cac80d05.translatedText: The U.S.-China Cultural and Art Exchange Association held the "After Dinner" symphony (Li Wen) The U.S.-China Cultural and Art Exchange Association held the "After Dinner" symphony in October. After the "Appreciation of Chinese Paintings" lectured by the painter Mr. Fan Rong, everyone received an enthusiastic response. They admired the masterpieces of many world-class Chinese painters, deeply admired them, and benefited a lot. A group photo of participants. The "After Dinner" in November was also held at the "Fengcheng Restaurant". This time, Mr. Chen Zhigang, the vice chairman of the association and the face-changing master of Fengcheng, gave a lecture on the first chapter of "How to Appreciate a Symphony", giving an overview of the structure of a symphony. Mr. Chen used exquisite picture projections to explain: What he introduced was a Western symphony, which is mainly divided into four parts: string section, woodwind section, brass section, and percussion section. They all have their own unique timbre and style, coordinating and echoing each other. The string section is like the bright appearance of the human body, with elegant, elegant and soft tone. It consists of violin, viola, cello (played while seated) and double bass (played standing or sitting on a high chair). Woodwind music represents the physique of the human body, which is strong and strong, and blends with the bright appearance into an aura and attractive sound. The most representative ones are the oboe, flute, flute, etc. Brass music is the backbone of the human body, the tough side, including French horns. This instrument is large and heavy. The round bell mouth is twisted and turned back to show upwards. Trumpets, trombones, etc. are one of the most common instruments during parade performances. Percussion includes drums of various sizes, percussion instruments such as common triangles or xylophones, etc. Mr. Chen added that in addition to the above four instruments, a piano or harp will also be added if the movement requires it. The distribution ratio of various musical instruments and the arrangement of the left and right positions and the front and back positions all show harmony and coordination. When the music is being played, each piece of music is like telling a sentence. Its elegance, elegance or passion make people endlessly intoxicated in appreciation. It is true that instruments that can produce beautiful sounds are valuable. The congregation was very grateful to Mr. Chen for bringing us this theme, which increased our interest in music, especially symphony. Some people also asked that some popular songs are also scored with symphony. Isn’t it losing the characteristics of classical music? Teacher Gu Yayu added that in fact, music has continued to evolve into diversification, thus adapting to the development of various levels. Music is still music in the end, but each is suitable for its own use. There is no level of standpoint, only the perspective of the viewer's perception is different. Along with this, the U.S.-China Cultural and Art Exchange Association will hold an "After Dinner" event at Fengcheng Restaurant at 6:30 pm on December 7 (Thursday). The chairman of the association, Gu Yayu, will give a lecture on "Singing Health and Happiness." Teacher Gu has performed voluntary "music therapy" services in the community, and the results he has seen are very significant. Ancient people often said that music can be used to treat diseases. Listening to music often can relieve sorrow and relieve boredom, stay away from depression, and avoid taking medicine. Music can cultivate the body and mind, and music is the way to maintain health. Friends from all walks of life are welcome to come and enjoy the music banquet. There will be a small dinner banquet for five internal organs after the meeting. The minimum fee per person is ten yuan. Huaishi is kindly invited to attend. I wish everyone a happy and healthy holiday.

5022da2c2d7c24efec1d72096c3b198d7013b9b2.sourceText: 美东经典旅游之七——尼加拉瀑布 凤凰城 气如虹 第四日，旅行团参观了赫氏朱古力世界与康宁玻璃中心之后，继续向北方前进，经过水牛城，终于在下午时分抵达尼加拉瀑布美境区域，观赏盛名远播的瀑布奔流。 尼加拉瀑布（Niagara Falls），有些书报详细地译音为尼亚加拉大瀑布，都是一样，没有差别，其名源自印第安语，其意为「雷神之水」，位置在在纽约州水牛城附近的美国与加拿大边境交界处，五大湖区汇流的尼加拉河上。 尼加拉瀑布，与南美洲巴西和阿根廷间的伊瓜苏瀑布，连同非洲赞比亚和津巴布韦间的维多利亚瀑布，并列为世界三大跨国瀑布。 陈导游述说，尼加拉河分隔着美国纽约州和加拿大安大略省，对面高楼林立的是加拿大国境，美国这边只有一栋高楼而已。这个瀑布最著名，吸引最多游客，但不是最大，最大的瀑布在巴西。 我们在瀑布区域下车，四周观赏，哗！果然是雄伟景像，澎湃汹涌的流水，万马奔腾的气势，浪涛不绝，推波助澜，由高向下的冲激倾泻，浪花四溅，蔚为奇观；河水声音潺潺，时而哗啦拍响，时而擂鼓动荡。站立此间，让你感觉人生极具挑战性，不能犹豫停滞，必须奋勇向前！ 这里是最具特色的风景区，观光客密集，人人观望，赞美，拍照，录像，乐此不疲。尼加拉大瀑布由三个部分组成，我们先后欣赏马蹄瀑布(Horse shoe)和美国瀑布(American Falls)，据讲述，马蹄瀑布形成马蹄状的弧线，故有此名称，高度为五十三公尺，宽阔度有六百七十公尺；美国瀑布略高一些，宽度却只有前者的一半。 黄昏来临，我们再度登车，返回瀑布旅游中心区，下榻优质酒店(Quality hotel)，导游分配了房间，吩咐大家放置妥行李后就要集中大厅，引领团友步行去观看新娘面纱瀑布(Veil of the Bride)。这项参观属自由性质，个别可以离团活动，黎姓的越南夫妇疲倦，留在旅馆歇息，谁人想去睹场碰运气也可以，但大部分仍随导游欣赏瀑布。 这时夜暮低垂，华灯亮丽，光彩若隐若现照映在奔腾瀑布上，水珠四溅，气象万千，形成美丽七彩的夜景。听说，美国这边只欣赏到瀑布的侧面，欲窥全貌，最好到对岸加拿大去。 我们所处的地点与加拿大一桥之隔，我看见那座桥，名叫彩虹桥，有护照随身的话，即可过境游览；可惜时间不充足，且要步行一段路程，我们三人小组耗去不少体力，不想再疲劳往返了。如果能搭乘著名的「雾中少女」号游轮最好，在加国那边欣赏到瀑布正面奇观，惟因天气不佳，今年四月天还未恢复此浪漫游船节目。 我们只好在岸上观望，拍照留念，以对面加拿大的楼房为背景，五光十色，有赌场的霓虹灯饰，也见到满地可的奥运高塔地标，倒是不错的美景。 夜了，肚子饿了，步行回到中心区，根据导游所指示的一家中餐馆用餐，然后步行回旅馆，沿途见到一栋灯光辉煌的赌场，本想去娱乐参观，但我们三人都有点倦意，惟有返回旅馆，沐浴更衣，早些休息。 翌日早起，是旅游的第五天，也是惟一的早晨不用赶紧把行李搬上车。大家在清新的空气中步行出瀑布区域，风冷雾淡，再次欣赏瀑布奔流，然后返回旅游区中心的 巨幕IMAX影院，自费观看尼加拉瀑布的传奇故事，银幕宽大，解析高清，观众有真实的感觉。影片主题都是围绕着尼加拉瀑布，目的都是介绍瀑布的雄壮与传奇，希望吸引更多游客光临。 巨幕首先放映是原住民的逃婚事件，少女不满意族人安排的婚嫁，结婚之日决心逃跑，受到追赶，最终跳下波涛汹涌的尼加拉瀑布，成为女神。另一个老妇让人装进大木桶，推落瀑布，随波逐流，冲到下游，让人救起，平安无恙。最后一个是在尼加拉瀑布遇险的家庭，在惊涛骇浪中呼叫挣扎，被经过船只救援的惊心动魄故事。影片相当精彩，在在显示尼加拉瀑布的神奇与雄壮。 散场，大家回旅馆收拾行李，告别优质酒店，告别尼加拉瀑布！导游告诉大家，今日整天都在车上，从水牛城直往波士顿，除了中途的午餐，及排泄方便，稍事逗留，将车不停轮，预定晚上抵达波士顿就享受龙虾大餐。
5022da2c2d7c24efec1d72096c3b198d7013b9b2.translatedText: The Seventh Classic Tour of the Eastern United States - Niagara Falls, Phoenix, and the Rainbow. On the fourth day, after visiting Hearst Chocolate World and the Corning Glass Center, the tour group continued to move north, passing through Buffalo, and finally arrived at the beautiful area of ​​Niagara Falls in the afternoon to watch the famous rushing waterfall. Niagara Falls, some books and newspapers have translated it in detail as Niagara Falls, they are all the same, there is no difference. Its name comes from the Indian language, which means "water of thunder". It is located at the junction of the United States and Canada border near Buffalo, New York, on the Niagara River where the Great Lakes converge. Niagara Falls, Iguazu Falls between Brazil and Argentina in South America, and Victoria Falls between Zambia and Zimbabwe in Africa are among the world's three largest transnational waterfalls. Tour guide Chen said that the Niagara River separates the state of New York in the United States and the province of Ontario in Canada. The Canadian border is lined with high-rise buildings on the opposite side, and there is only one high-rise building on the American side. This waterfall is the most famous and attracts the most tourists, but it is not the largest, the largest waterfall in Brazil. We got off the car at the waterfall area and looked around, wow! Sure enough, it is a majestic scene, with surging water, the momentum of thousands of horses galloping, endless waves, adding fuel to the flames, rushing downwards from high to high, splashing waves, making it a spectacle; the sound of the river is gurgling, sometimes clattering, sometimes beating drums. Standing here, you feel that life is extremely challenging, you cannot hesitate to stagnate, you must move forward bravely! This is the most unique scenic spot with a large number of tourists. Everyone is watching, praising, taking pictures, and videotaping, and enjoys it endlessly. Niagara Falls consists of three parts. We admired the Horseshoe Falls and the American Falls successively. According to reports, the Horseshoe Falls forms a horseshoe-shaped arc, hence its name. It is 53 meters high and 670 meters wide; the American Falls is slightly taller, but only half as wide as the former. As dusk came, we boarded the bus again and returned to the tourist center of the waterfall. We stayed at a Quality hotel. The tour guide assigned a room and told everyone to gather in the lobby after placing their luggage and lead the group to walk to see the Veil of the Bride Falls. This tour is free in nature, and individuals can leave the group for activities. The Vietnamese couple surnamed Li were tired and stayed at the hotel to rest. Those who want to see it can also try their luck, but most of them still follow the tour guide to enjoy the waterfalls. At this time, the night is low, the lights are bright, and the brilliance is faintly reflected on the Pentium waterfall. Water droplets splash in all directions, creating a beautiful and colorful night scene. I heard that you can only see the side of the waterfall from the United States. If you want to see the whole thing, it’s best to go to Canada on the other side. Our location is separated from Canada by a bridge. I saw the bridge called the Rainbow Bridge. If you have your passport with you, you can cross the border for sightseeing. Unfortunately, there is not enough time and we have to walk a distance. Our group of three has consumed a lot of energy and we don’t want to go back and forth tiredly. It would be best if you can take the famous "Maid of the Mist" cruise ship, and enjoy the wonders of the waterfall on the Canadian side. However, due to bad weather, this romantic cruise program has not been resumed in April this year. We had no choice but to watch and take photos on the shore. With the Canadian buildings across the way as the background, they were colorful, with the neon lights of the casinos, and the Olympic Tower landmark in Montreal. It was a nice view. It was night and we were hungry. We walked back to the central area, ate at a Chinese restaurant instructed by the tour guide, and then walked back to the hotel. Along the way, we saw a brightly lit casino. We wanted to visit for entertainment, but the three of us were a little tired, so we had to return to the hotel, shower and change clothes, and rest early. Getting up early the next day was the fifth day of travel and the only morning where I didn't have to rush to load my luggage into the car. Everyone walked out of the waterfall area in the fresh air, the wind was cold and the fog was light, and they admired the rushing waterfall again. Then they returned to the giant-screen IMAX theater in the center of the tourist area to watch the legendary story of Niagara Falls at their own expense. The screen was large and the resolution was high-definition, giving the audience a real feeling. The theme of the film is all around Niagara Falls, with the purpose of introducing the majesty and legend of the waterfall, hoping to attract more tourists. The giant screen first showed an incident involving an aboriginal escape from marriage. The girl was dissatisfied with the marriage arranged by her tribe and decided to run away on her wedding day. She was chased and eventually jumped off the turbulent Niagara Falls to become a goddess. Another old woman had someone put her in a big wooden barrel, push her down the waterfall, drift with the current, and rush downstream, where she was rescued and found safe. The last one is the thrilling story of a family in distress at Niagara Falls, who struggled in the rough waves and were rescued by a passing boat. The video is quite exciting, showing the magic and majesty of Niagara Falls. After the show, everyone went back to the hotel to pack their luggage, bid farewell to quality hotels, and bid farewell to Niagara Falls! The tour guide told everyone that they were in the car all day today, going straight from Buffalo to Boston. Except for lunch on the way and for excretion convenience, they stopped for a while and kept the car running. They planned to enjoy a lobster dinner when they arrived in Boston in the evening.

2fe9d3ae91fee77ebb6258e7c3199204ecef0fdc.sourceText: 美中文化艺术交流协会:＂中国画浅谈＂马到成功(图)！ 画家李成介绍中国画的起始 (美中文化艺术交流协会来稿)由美中文化艺术交流协会主办的，新东方艺术学校协办的首次文化艺术讲座，＂中国画浅谈＂上周六（十一月十九日）下午四时半在新东方艺术学校举行，由画家李成（范融）先生和书法家陈普博士首先给与会者浅谈了中国画的起始，二千多年来随着各个朝代的变迁在各个不同历史时期的发展和变化，介绍了唐代的大画家世称”画圣”吴道子和他的”八十七神仙图”对中国画的巨大影响和贡献，其中又穿引出了近代画马大师徐悲鸿先生如何倾毕生积蓄二次收藏”八十七神仙图”的不解之缘的有趣故事，引起了听众的赞叹之声。接着画家范融以”马”为主线详细地介绍了唐代的大画家阎立本的不朽传世之作”历代帝王图”，以及描写唐太宗李世民把文成公主嫁于藏王松赞干布故事的”步辇图”对后世的影响和其历史意义。二位从东汉的”马踏飞燕”谈到近代的徐悲鸿”奔马图”。其中唐代画马巨匠曹霸却没有留下任何作品，陈普博士详细地给大家解读了大诗人杜甫写的”丹青引送曹霸将军”的诗使大家了解曹霸坎珂的一生。使人为之唏嘘不已。曹霸的学生韩干的”牧马图”、张萱的”虢国夫人游春图”、北宋大画家的李公麟的”五马图”、书沽家赵孟兆页的”人骑图”、元人任仁发的”二马图”都引起大家的极大的兴趣。特别是清末全才大画家任伯年的画马新法，近代画马大师徐悲鸿融汇中西的”奔马”、”八骏图”。还有齐白石老人的许许如生的”群虾图”更是让人惊叹不已，对徐悲鸿和齐白石二位大师的爱国情操的傲骨人品更是钦佩万分。 书法家陈普解读诗词 画家范融和书法家陈普博士现场一唱一和，配合历代画家的生平，趣事，把一浅谈的讲座讲得十分生动活泼，妙趣横生。虽时间关系，但听众意尤未尽。纷纷询问下次举办的时间和内容，有的中外朋友要求能举办书画学习班，美中文化艺术交流协会的负责人古雅余女士和陈志钢先生给大家一一做了解答和良好的互动交流。这次讲座是美中文化艺术系列讲座的第一讲，接下来将每月举行一次有关美中文化艺术讲座或演练班。希望所有爱好文化艺术的中外朋友们大家一起来共同做好美中文化艺术的交流工作。
2fe9d3ae91fee77ebb6258e7c3199204ecef0fdc.translatedText: US-China Cultural and Art Exchange Association: "A Brief Talk on Chinese Painting" is an immediate success (pictures)! Painter Li Cheng introduces the beginning of Chinese painting (Contributed by the U.S.-China Culture and Art Exchange Association) The first cultural and art lecture, "A Brief Talk on Chinese Painting", sponsored by the U.S.-China Culture and Art Exchange Association and co-organized by the New Oriental Art School, was held at 4:30 pm on Saturday (November 19) at the New Oriental Art School. The painter Mr. Li Cheng (Fan Rong) and the calligrapher Dr. Chen Pu first gave the participants a brief talk about the beginning of Chinese painting and its development over the past two thousand years. The development and changes of various dynasties in different historical periods introduced the great influence and contribution of Wu Daozi, a great painter in the Tang Dynasty who was known as the "Painting Sage" and his "Eighty-seven Immortals" on Chinese painting. It also introduced the interesting story of how Mr. Xu Beihong, a modern horse painting master, spent his life savings to collect the "Eighty-Seven Immortals" twice, which aroused the audience's praise. Then painter Fan Rong introduced in detail the immortal work "Pictures of Emperors of All Dynasties" by Yan Liben, a great painter of the Tang Dynasty, using "horse" as the main line, as well as the "Palm of Chariots" which describes the story of Tang Taizong Li Shimin marrying Princess Wencheng to King Songtsen Gampo of Tibet, and its influence on later generations and its historical significance. The two talked about Xu Beihong's "Galloping Horse Picture" from the Eastern Han Dynasty's "Horse Treading on Flying Swallows". Among them, Cao Ba, a master of horse painting in the Tang Dynasty, did not leave any works. Dr. Chen Pu gave everyone a detailed interpretation of the poem "Drawings Lead to General Cao Ba" written by the great poet Du Fu to help everyone understand the life of Cao Ba Kanke. It makes people sigh. Cao Ba's student Han Gan's "Herding Horses Picture", Zhang Xuan's "Guo Lady's Spring Outing", the great Northern Song Dynasty painter Li Gonglin's "Five Horses Picture", the calligrapher Zhao Meng Zhaoye's "Man and Horse Picture", and Yuanren Ren Renfa's "Two Horses Picture" all aroused great interest from everyone. In particular, Ren Bonian, a great all-around painter in the late Qing Dynasty, developed a new method of painting horses, and Xu Beihong, a modern horse painting master, combined Chinese and Western "Galloping Horses" and "Eight Horses". There is also Qi Baishi’s Xu Rusheng’s “Shrimp Picture” which is even more amazing. I admire the patriotic sentiments and proud characters of the two masters Xu Beihong and Qi Baishi. Calligrapher Chen Pu interprets poetry. Painter Fan Rong and calligrapher Dr. Chen Pu sang and sang together on the spot. They combined the lives and interesting stories of painters from past generations to make the brief lecture very lively and interesting. Although the time was limited, the audience's interest was not enough. They all asked about the time and content of the next event. Some Chinese and foreign friends asked for a calligraphy and painting class. Ms. Gu Yayu and Mr. Chen Zhigang, the leaders of the U.S.-China Cultural and Art Exchange Association, gave everyone answers one by one and had a good interactive exchange. This lecture is the first lecture in a series of lectures on U.S.-China culture and art. Subsequently, there will be a monthly lecture or practice class on U.S.-China culture and art. I hope that all Chinese and foreign friends who love culture and art will come together to do a good job in the exchange of culture and art between the United States and China.

fb5068f2f8cde894b06b56fb80fa6e92335f1f70.sourceText: (凤凰城龙冈公所通讯 张肇鸿报道) 6月22日，凤凰城龙冈公所全体成员召开会议，在刘全知主席的主持下，讨论关于支持凤凰城侨联总会举办７月４日庆祝美国国庆活动和下一届恳亲大会的准备工作事项。
fb5068f2f8cde894b06b56fb80fa6e92335f1f70.translatedText: (reported by Zhang Zhaohong from Phoenix City Longgang Office) On June 22, all members of the Phoenix Longgang Office held a meeting, under the chairmanship of Chairman Liu Quanzhi, to discuss preparations for supporting the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation to hold the July 4th celebration of the United States National Day and the next Qinqin Conference.

df02e95495cbd385b0e2530a20f38a6f6d866ffa.sourceText: 历年来，凤凰城龙冈公所积极支持侨联的各项活动。在每年的庆祝国庆活动中，龙冈出钱出力，不但团体有广告赞助，不少龙冈个人也有广告赞助，侨联派售的抽奖券任务也是按时按量去完成。在凤凰城侨团中，龙冈公所是一个热心公益的团体。
df02e95495cbd385b0e2530a20f38a6f6d866ffa.translatedText: Over the years, Phoenix Longgang Office has actively supported various activities of the Overseas Chinese Federation. In the annual National Day celebrations, Longgang contributes money and effort. Not only the group has advertising sponsorship, but many Longgang individuals also have advertising sponsorship. The task of selling lottery tickets by the Overseas Chinese Federation is also completed on time and in quantity. Among the overseas Chinese groups in Phoenix City, Longgang Office is a group that is enthusiastic about public welfare.

a2e21d9563af974f9d6720f5ceaf9f1b35161aee.sourceText: 自上任主席张华芳接下2016年美洲龙冈总公所第21届恳亲大会任务后，凤凰城龙冈公所全体成员热情高涨，发扬龙冈团队的精神, 脚踏实地去做准备工作。关宗任先生首先捐助恳亲大会壹万美元，荣膺美洲龙冈总公所永远荣誉顾问，龙冈公所成员亦纷纷响应，踊跃捐款办恳亲，目前已筹到款项达到壹万八千七百美元，叧还有认捐的五百美元，为21届恳亲大会各项活动开展打下良好的经济基础。为完善恳亲财政制度，会议决议财政支出需由恳亲大会共同主席之一(刘汝璋、关锡樵、张肇鸿) 与现任财政(刘邓婉仪) 合签方能生效，大的银码还应有三人签署，以保障财政的公开和安全。决议还设立财政助理(关昆容) ，以协助现任财政的事务。
a2e21d9563af974f9d6720f5ceaf9f1b35161aee.translatedText: Since the inaugurated chairman Zhang Huafang took over the task of the 21st Friendship Conference of the Americas Longgang Office in 2016, all members of the Phoenix Longgang Office have been enthusiastic, carried forward the spirit of the Longgang team, and made preparations in a down-to-earth manner. Mr. Guan Zongren first donated US$10,000 to the Qinqin Conference and was awarded the permanent honorary advisor of the American Longgang Office. Members of the Longgang Office also responded and actively donated money to organize the Qinqin. So far, the amount raised has reached US$18,700, with only US$500 pledged, laying a good economic foundation for the activities of the 21st Qinqin Conference. In order to improve the Qinqin financial system, the meeting decided that financial expenditures must be co-signed by one of the co-chairmen of the Qinqin Conference (Liu Ruzhang, Guan Xiqiao, Zhang Zhaohong) and the current financial officer (Liu Deng Wanyi) before it can take effect. The large code should also be signed by three people to ensure the openness and security of the finances. The resolution also established a financial assistant (Kuan Kun-rong) to assist the current financial affairs.

37e932d487af4a155a138e353b8c6725cecae299.sourceText: 秘书长张华芳报告有关恳亲会议酒店的接洽现况，并将尽量去争取较好条件的酒店合约。与会成员还初步讨论有关恳亲期间的旅游景点，希望让龙冈四姓亲人，到时能欣赏到亚利桑那州独特的地理景色和环境风貌。(更多资讯请上凤凰城龙冈公所纲网站： http://www.paaca.us/lungkong.htm
37e932d487af4a155a138e353b8c6725cecae299.translatedText: Secretary-General Zhang Huafang reported on the current status of the hotel contract for the Qinqin Conference and will try his best to obtain a hotel contract with better conditions. The participating members also preliminarily discussed tourist attractions during the wedding, hoping that the four relatives of the Longgang family could appreciate Arizona's unique geographical scenery and environmental features. (For more information, please visit the Phoenix Longkong Public Office website: http://www.paaca.us/lungkong.htm

3a30d26114ea7c4c7964b6a87cda32060bdcdd93.sourceText: 2015年2月7日上午11点，亚省中国餐馆联合会主办的排餐街友活动在Phoenix的ＣＡＳＳ(Centural Arizona Shelter Service)如期举行，宽阔的场地里阳光明媚，街友聚集，秩序良好地排队等待领餐；
3a30d26114ea7c4c7964b6a87cda32060bdcdd93.translatedText: On February 7, 2015, at 11 a.m., the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta held a dinner party for street friends at CASS (Centural Arizona Shelter) in Phoenix. Service) was held as scheduled, the sun was shining brightly in the spacious venue, street residents gathered and lined up in good order to receive meals;

6cbea084927940f3173225e37c0d7c3d097597c5.sourceText: 而发放区域内的工作人员、后厨人员、各个年龄段得志愿者正在紧张有序地忙碌着。
6cbea084927940f3173225e37c0d7c3d097597c5.translatedText: while the staff in the distribution area, kitchen staff, and volunteers of all ages were busy in an nervous and orderly manner.

c0b4c25be1f6a76de5687bbfe4a09bfd97926cfd.sourceText: 记者看到，今天的热食内容有西兰花炒牛肉，橘子鸡丁，春卷和白米饭，街友还能领取饮品和幸运曲奇，安排得十分贴心。
c0b4c25be1f6a76de5687bbfe4a09bfd97926cfd.translatedText: The reporter saw that today’s hot food included stir-fried beef with broccoli, diced orange chicken, spring rolls and white rice. Street residents could also receive drinks and fortune cookies, which was a very considerate arrangement.

0ea52957cdb5678e21b02bfb0df50a3b333b9f94.sourceText: 此外，主办方不仅邀请Ceil Holden和他的乐队带来现场音乐，活跃气氛，更有舞狮表演传递中国文化，令人耳目一新。
0ea52957cdb5678e21b02bfb0df50a3b333b9f94.translatedText: In addition, the organizer not only invited Ceil Holden and his band to bring live music to enliven the atmosphere, but also a lion dance performance to convey Chinese culture, which was refreshing.

c2bc436a2ce17194df422a062e37eef37358b707.sourceText: 主办方亚省中国餐馆联合会(餐馆会)拥有100多间中餐厅成员，从93年正式成立至今已经携手走进第22个年头。作为餐馆会众多的活动之一，派餐街友的活动从协会成立初开始，每年在中国农历春节的前夕如期举行。
c2bc436a2ce17194df422a062e37eef37358b707.translatedText: The organizer, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association (Restaurant Association), has more than 100 Chinese restaurant members. It has been officially established in 1993 and has entered its 22nd year together. As one of the many activities of the restaurant association, the activity of distributing meals to street friends has been held since the establishment of the association and is held as scheduled every year on the eve of the Chinese Lunar New Year.

a4543396a0ac0a73b2c5e1b43952b6cbfd29d85f.sourceText: 亚省中国餐馆协会会长Helen Zhang简短致辞
a4543396a0ac0a73b2c5e1b43952b6cbfd29d85f.translatedText: >Helen Zhang, President of the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta, gave a brief speech

45708fe721cc2d1f1f4ed8acdee7c59c8b631a12.sourceText: 据接受采访的Charlie Xu和Homer Zhang介绍，本次活动预计有800-1200名街友到场领取食物和饮料，而热心投入到活动中的工作人员及志愿者约有30-40人，大家齐心协力进行了1个星期的筹划准备，保证了这次活动的顺利完成。
45708fe721cc2d1f1f4ed8acdee7c59c8b631a12.translatedText: According to interviews with Charlie Xu and Homer According to Zhang, 800-1,200 street residents are expected to come to receive food and drinks at this event, and there are about 30-40 staff and volunteers who are enthusiastic about the event. Everyone worked together for a week to plan and prepare, ensuring the smooth completion of this event.

b70c1b28f19d79a5cceecd3192e4ba387fcd5fb2.sourceText: 被问及活动的目的，Charlie提到了回馈社会”因为中国餐馆靠着消费者的支持得以发展壮大，协会希望每年做一些有意义的活动，对社会、公众表达谢意，作出回报。”
b70c1b28f19d79a5cceecd3192e4ba387fcd5fb2.translatedText: were asked about the purpose of the event, and Charlie mentioned giving back to the society. "Because Chinese restaurants rely on the support of consumers to develop and grow, the association hopes to do some meaningful activities every year to benefit the society and the public." Express gratitude and repay. "

dc89d9b643455311a2757edc9f8359703d12a936.sourceText: 由各个中餐厅派出人员组成的后厨团队
dc89d9b643455311a2757edc9f8359703d12a936.translatedText: A kitchen team composed of personnel from various Chinese restaurants

b31e9259470bfdaa40889466472acdbf36c34f0b.sourceText: 本次活动的中国志愿者多来自于ASU的学生，他们表示，是在亚利桑那华人网上看到本次活动信息然后报名参加的。
b31e9259470bfdaa40889466472acdbf36c34f0b.translatedText: Most of the Chinese volunteers for this event are students from ASU. They said that they saw the information about this event on the Arizona Chinese website and signed up.

ae0bcf489a566209f0be4218e23d05118985c4b1.translatedText: The staff took a group photo after the event

3c860cf0f49441d39d820f5034ec0a145b5fa291.sourceText: 伴随着菲尼克斯的明媚阳光，本次活动圆满完成。正如乐队主唱所说的”…good food, good people!” 这样融合了现场音乐、民族元素、感恩情怀的派餐活动，为无家可归的人们带去了温暖，也体现了亚省中餐会、中国同胞的团结和爱心。 爱心无价，愿这样充满正能量的活动在今后的日子里，更多，更好。
3c860cf0f49441d39d820f5034ec0a145b5fa291.translatedText: With the bright sunshine in Phoenix, this event was successfully completed. As the lead singer of the band said, "...good food, good people!" This meal distribution activity, which combines live music, ethnic elements, and feelings of gratitude, brings warmth to the homeless people, and also reflects the unity and love of the Alberta Chinese Dinner Party and Chinese compatriots. Love is priceless, and I hope that such activities full of positive energy will be more and better in the days to come.

224b8533e73a3ba069beb76f51dc2ff15ef7dffd.sourceText: （陈丽君摄影报道） 2016 年 3 月 13 日晚六福酒家张灯结彩，锣鼓喧天，凤凰城耆英会在这里举行 2016 度庆猴年新春联欢会。 尽管中国农历新年已过，但凤凰城依然春意浓浓。 有超过 300 名的各界朋友前来恭贺新春，大家齐聚一堂，欢 声 笑语 ， 互致新春最美好的祝福，共度佳节。
224b8533e73a3ba069beb76f51dc2ff15ef7dffd.translatedText: (photo report by Chen Lijun) On the evening of March 13, 2016, Luk Fook Restaurant was decorated with lanterns, gongs and drums, and the Phoenix Senior Citizens Association held a 2016 New Year Gala to celebrate the Year of the Monkey. Although the Chinese New Year has passed, Phoenix is ​​still feeling springy. More than 300 friends from all walks of life came to congratulate them on the New Year. Everyone gathered together, laughed and exchanged the best wishes for the New Year and spent the festive season together.

47646e244fcc4b55d1327657398c58989d1a78d9.sourceText: 嘉宾有资深侨领余文劲，前美国白宫亚太裔委员邓朝驹，侨联主席邓洪钺， 亚省 华联董事长吴亮祖， 亚省龙岗亲义公所主席张肇鸿 ， 亚省餐馆协会主席张华芳， 美国福建海外联谊会会长杨文田，亚省 华总 荣誉会长 徐强，美西侨报社长兼主编方慧贤， 亚省开平同乡会主席余江英， 亚省开心会，亚省余氏宗亲会，亚省华人福利会，亚省龙岗亲义公所， 亚省黄氏宗亲会 等众多侨领、社团负责人及州府、市府官员 到场祝贺。
47646e244fcc4b55d1327657398c58989d1a78d9.translatedText: Guests include senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin, former US White House Asian and Pacific Islander Commissioner Deng Chaoju, Chairman of the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese Deng Hongyue, Chairman of the Hualian Association of Alberta Wu Liangzu, Chairman of the Longgang Friendship Association of Alberta Zhang Zhaohong, Chairman of the Alberta Restaurant Association Zhang Huafang, President of the American Fujian Overseas Friendship Association Yang Wentian, Honorary President of the Chinese Association of Alberta Xu Qiang, President and Editor-in-Chief of the Overseas Chinese Newspaper in the United States Fang Huixian, Many overseas Chinese leaders, community leaders, and state and city government officials were present to congratulate the event, including Yu Jiangying, Chairman of the Kaiping Association of Alberta, the Alberta Happy Association, the Yu Clan Association of Alberta, the Chinese Welfare Association of Alberta, the Longgang Family and Righteousness Office of Alberta, and the Huang Clan Association of Alberta.

fa008c578f1735c33f737563c99ca583913db5f0.sourceText: 晚会司仪由 吴亮祖和李爱珍 担任，耆英会老人表演的祥狮献瑞拉开了晚宴的序幕，嘉宾 们给祥狮”赏红”，场面红火热闹。 耆英会主席陈秀波和副主席尹凤影、余富强致欢迎词， 首先感谢大家的光临和对耆英会的支持，对 2015 年耆英会的工作进行了总结和 肯定。 展望未来，耆英会 新一届领导集体， 满怀信心，团结友爱，包容和谐，谋求福祉， 进一步 丰富老年人的精神文化生活，提高老年人的生活品质 。 最后祝各位在新的一年里家庭幸福”暖猴猴”，身体健康”喜猴猴”，万事如意”美猴猴”。耆英会 2016 年全体理事会成员上台高举酒杯，向来宾们祝贺新春。
fa008c578f1735c33f737563c99ca583913db5f0.translatedText: The emcees of the party were Wu Liangzu and Li Aizhen. The elderly people from the Senior Citizens Association performed a lion presentation to kick off the dinner. The guests "rewarded" the lions with reds, and the scene was lively and lively. Chairman Chen Xiubo and vice-chairmen Yin Fengying and Yu Fuqiang of the Senior Citizens Association delivered welcome speeches. First of all, they thanked everyone for coming and supporting the Senior Citizens Association, and summarized and affirmed the work of the Senior Citizens Association in 2015. Looking forward to the future, the new leadership group of the Senior Citizens Association is full of confidence, unites and loves, is inclusive and harmonious, seeks welfare, further enriches the spiritual and cultural life of the elderly, and improves the quality of life of the elderly. Finally, I wish you all a happy family, good health, and good luck in the new year. All members of the 2016 Council of Senior Citizens Association came to the stage and raised their glasses to wish the guests a happy New Year.

4e0b79a2ef9d66f973a30e75208823d1ea4845e9.sourceText: 大家一边品赏美食，一边欣赏耆英会老人们自编自导自演的节目。国语、粤语合唱，歌舞表演、旗袍走秀等竞相登场，可谓精彩纷呈， 迎来阵阵掌声和欢呼声 。尽管很多演员已年过古稀， 但 个个精神抖擞，充满自信 ； 喜庆的服饰、甜美的笑脸充盈整个舞台，在他（她）们身上看到了老年人历经岁月沉淀的迷人风采，成为”最美夕阳红”。 期间向优秀服务人员道德锟、 尹凤影、余富强、曾丽卿、谭玉英、 李贻琤 、 陈雪莉、李国仪、爱莉西亚?/SPAN> 托科 进行了颁奖，感谢他 ( 她）们对 耆英会 所做的无私奉献。 除 凤凰城华人耆英会赞助奖学金一千美金 外 ，要特别感谢邓广肇家族 20 多年来坚持不懈，每年一千美金资助奖学金。陈秀波主席、裴霞云主任、王湧教授和孙飞教授 向 四位优秀的应届高中毕业生陈美恒（一等奖），王圆（二等奖），黄雪莹（三等奖）， Maria Dong （提名奖）颁发了奖学金，鼓励他（她）们学有所成，将来更好的服务社会。宴会中间还穿插抽奖活动，很多来宾获得了丰厚的奖品。
4e0b79a2ef9d66f973a30e75208823d1ea4845e9.translatedText: While enjoying the delicious food, everyone also enjoyed the program written, directed and performed by the senior citizens of the Senior Citizens Association. Mandarin and Cantonese choruses, song and dance performances, cheongsam catwalks, etc. all appeared on stage. It was a wonderful event and received bursts of applause and cheers. Although many actors are over seventy years old, they are all full of energy and confidence; festive costumes and sweet smiles fill the entire stage. They can see the charming style of the elderly that has accumulated over the years, becoming "the most beautiful sunset red". During the period, awards were presented to outstanding service personnel Daodekun, Yin Fengying, Yu Fuqiang, Zeng Liqing, Tan Yuying, Li Yicheng, Chen Shirley, Li Guoyi, Alicia Toko, and thanked them (her) for their selfless contributions to the Senior Citizens Association. In addition to the US$1,000 scholarship sponsored by the Phoenix Chinese Seniors Association, special thanks go to the Deng Guangzhao family for their perseverance over the past 20 years in sponsoring the US$1,000 scholarship each year. Chairman Chen Xiubo, Director Pei Xiayun, Professor Wang Yong and Professor Sun Fei awarded scholarships to four outstanding recent high school graduates Chen Meiheng (first prize), Wang Yuan (second prize), Huang Xueying (third prize), and Maria Dong (nomination prize), encouraging them to achieve success in their studies and better serve the society in the future. There was also a raffle held during the banquet, and many guests won generous prizes.

54391021e97d404737153b0d5505c2aa0439f513.sourceText: 老人们用激情点燃了舞台，动听的歌曲、曼妙的舞步表达了对新年的祈福和对生活的美好祝愿，向大家展示了老人们积极进取、健康向上的新风貌。 衷心祝愿老人们猴年吉祥，健康长寿，笑口常开。联欢会 在一 片喜庆祥和的气氛中落下帷幕， 让我们用微笑拥抱猴年，共同期待明年的相聚。
54391021e97d404737153b0d5505c2aa0439f513.translatedText: The elderly people lit up the stage with their passion. The beautiful songs and graceful dance steps expressed their blessings for the New Year and their best wishes for life, showing everyone the new outlook of the elderly people who are enterprising, healthy and progressive. I sincerely wish the elderly people good luck in the Year of the Monkey, good health and longevity, and always smile. The party ended in a festive and peaceful atmosphere. Let us embrace the Year of the Monkey with a smile and look forward to our reunion next year.

899d9491c3611914900497fd3b8912a0204a155a.translatedText: China questions Japan’s intentions and is highly vigilant about Japan’s true intentions (pictures) Article source: Yahoo News on 2013-02-08 08:14:…

96534171bea38746b95e30eff6636a5d046278f4.sourceText: 对于日方称中国海军舰艇用火控雷达照射日方舰机一事，中方8日作出回应指出，日方的说法完全是无中生有，日方蓄意散布虚假信息，抹黑中国形象，制造紧张气氛。中国国防部当日还公布了事件有关事实经过，并指出日方舰机经常对中国海军舰机长时间、近距离跟踪监视，是造成中日海空安全问题的根源。
96534171bea38746b95e30eff6636a5d046278f4.translatedText: In response to Japan’s claim that Chinese naval ships used fire control radars to illuminate Japanese warships and aircraft, China responded on the 8th and pointed out that Japan’s statement was completely fabricated and that Japan deliberately spread false information, smeared China’s image, and created tension. The Chinese Ministry of National Defense also announced the relevant facts of the incident that day, and pointed out that Japanese warships and aircraft often tracked and monitored Chinese naval warships and aircraft for a long time and at close range, which was the root cause of China-Japan maritime and air security problems.

9eeae16348dd7d65593633451b1e883954046a38.sourceText: 针对日本媒体报道日本防卫大臣指称中国海军舰艇用火控雷达瞄准日本自卫队舰机的报道，国防部新闻事务局8日表示，1月19日下午16时许，中国海军一艘护卫舰在东海相关海域进行例行训练，期间发现日本自卫队一架舰载直升机接近中方舰艇，中方舰载雷达保持正常观察警戒，并未使用火控雷达。
9eeae16348dd7d65593633451b1e883954046a38.translatedText: In response to Japanese media reports that the Japanese Defense Minister alleged that Chinese naval vessels used fire control radars to target Japanese Self-Defense Force ships and aircraft, the Information Bureau of the Ministry of National Defense stated on the 8th that at about 16:00 on January 19, a Chinese Navy frigate was conducting routine training in relevant waters of the East China Sea. During the period, a Japanese Self-Defense Force ship-borne helicopter was found approaching the Chinese ship. The Chinese ship-borne radar maintained normal observation and alert and did not use fire control radar.

a19694311c0b80f808dc19015c46219c20545b39.sourceText: 1月30日9时许，中国海军舰艇在东海相关海域执行例行训练任务，期间发现日本”夕立”号驱逐舰在中方舰艇附近近距离跟踪监视，中方舰载雷达保持正常观察警戒，没有使用火控雷达。日方所谓中国海军舰艇火控雷达瞄准日方舰机的说法不符合事实。
a19694311c0b80f808dc19015c46219c20545b39.translatedText: At about 9:00 on January 30, Chinese naval ships were performing routine training missions in relevant waters of the East China Sea. During the period, they discovered that the Japanese destroyer "Yuridachi" was tracking and monitoring the Chinese ship at close range. The Chinese shipboard radar maintained normal observation and alert and did not use fire control radar. Japan’s claim that the Chinese naval ship’s fire control radar is targeting Japanese warships and aircraft is not consistent with the facts.

7c2c61cc1fe65e7e5fcb67139831ec4bed09d99f.sourceText: 国防部强调，需要指出的是，近年来，日方舰机经常对中国海军舰机长时间、近距离跟踪监视，是造成中日海空安全问题的根源，中方就此多次向日方提出了交涉。
7c2c61cc1fe65e7e5fcb67139831ec4bed09d99f.translatedText: The Ministry of National Defense emphasized that it needs to be pointed out that in recent years, Japanese warships and aircraft have often tracked and monitored Chinese naval warships and aircraft for a long time and at close range, which is the root cause of China-Japan maritime and air security problems. China has made representations to Japan on many occasions.

2b83c54d960b5023b7fe20894c7cdec2bffcd008.sourceText: 国防部表示，近期，日方不断散布歪曲、抹黑中国军队正常战备训练活动的不实言论，此次又在没有与中方核实事实的情况下，单方面向媒体公布虚假情况，日本政府高官发表不负责任的言论，渲染”中国威胁”，肆意制造紧张气氛，误导国际舆论，这一动向值得大家警惕、深思。中方希望日方切实采取有效措施，停止制造东海紧张气氛的行为，不要再发表不负责任的言论。
2b83c54d960b5023b7fe20894c7cdec2bffcd008.translatedText: The Ministry of National Defense stated that recently, Japan has continued to spread false statements that distort and discredit the normal combat readiness training activities of the Chinese military. This time, it unilaterally announced false information to the media without verifying the facts with China. Senior Japanese government officials made irresponsible remarks, exaggerated the "China threat," wantonly created tension, and misled international public opinion. This trend deserves everyone's vigilance and reflection. China hopes that Japan will take effective measures to stop creating tension in the East China Sea and stop making irresponsible remarks.

9b7e0210d1bf2040f0f05d54a7b5f398d37380cf.sourceText: 针对上述事件，中国外交部发言人华春莹8日亦指出，日方挑起钓鱼岛争端以来，中方在采取必要措施维护国家领土主权的同时，一直保持克制和负责任态度，致力于通过对话磋商管控和解决问题。日方不仅不纠正错误，还变本加厉出动大量舰机持续采取损害中国主权的行动。
9b7e0210d1bf2040f0f05d54a7b5f398d37380cf.translatedText: In response to the above incident, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Hua Chunying also pointed out on the 8th that since Japan provoked the Diaoyu Islands dispute, China has always maintained restraint and a responsible attitude while taking necessary measures to safeguard national territorial sovereignty, and is committed to managing and solving problems through dialogue and consultation. Not only did Japan fail to correct its mistakes, it also intensified its efforts by dispatching a large number of warships and aircraft to continue to take actions that undermined China's sovereignty.

8922e93084e0225c52527f668f34a150a6e89219.sourceText: 华春莹强调，日方舰机对在公海进行正常巡航训练的中国海军舰艇长期进行近距离跟踪监视，是造成中日海空安全问题的根源。此次日方蓄意散布虚假信息，抹黑中国形象，渲染”中国威胁”，制造紧张气氛，误导国际舆论。”我们不禁要问，日方究竟意欲何为？不得不对日方真实意图保持高度警惕。”
8922e93084e0225c52527f668f34a150a6e89219.translatedText: Hua Chunying emphasized that Japanese warships and aircraft have long-term and close tracking and surveillance of Chinese naval vessels conducting normal cruise training on the high seas, which is the root cause of China-Japan maritime and air security problems. This time, Japan deliberately spread false information, smeared China's image, exaggerated the "China threat", created a tense atmosphere, and misled international public opinion. "We can't help but ask, what exactly does Japan intend? We have to remain highly vigilant about Japan's true intentions."

16ab716999f12d861f1cd1e5dbc0c62ede1ba143.sourceText: ”我们希望日方不要再搞小动作，回到对话解决问题的正确轨道上来”，华春莹说。
16ab716999f12d861f1cd1e5dbc0c62ede1ba143.translatedText: "We hope that Japan will stop making small moves and return to the right track of dialogue to solve problems," Hua Chunying said.

be58c5bd3761ecbdac10a0dffc6702ab9861b4ef.sourceText: 而在此前一天的例行记者会上，针对有关日媒称中国近期示强影响中日关系的说法，华春莹则表示，中方主张在中日四个政治文件原则精神基础上发展中日关系的方针没有变化。同时，中国维护国家领土主权的立场坚定不移。现在的问题不是中方示强，而是日方在钓鱼岛问题上单方面采取挑衅行动，日方舰机持续在钓鱼岛海域、空域非法活动，损害中国领土主权。
be58c5bd3761ecbdac10a0dffc6702ab9861b4ef.translatedText: At a regular press conference the day before, in response to Japanese media claims that China's recent assertiveness has affected Sino-Japanese relations, Hua Chunying said that China's policy of developing Sino-Japanese relations based on the principles and spirit of the four political documents between China and Japan has not changed. At the same time, China’s position on safeguarding national territorial sovereignty is unswerving. The problem now is not China's show of strength, but Japan's unilateral provocative actions on the Diaoyu Islands issue. Japanese ships and aircraft continue to illegally operate in the waters and airspace of the Diaoyu Islands, undermining China's territorial sovereignty.

77f872388cbea7dc8e47c644d53ec12291e10385.sourceText: 华春莹表示，近日来，日方人为炒作危机，制造紧张，抹黑中国形象，这一做法与改善关系的努力背道而驰。中方一贯主张通过对话磋商妥善管控和解决有关问题。希望日方正视历史和现实，同中方相向而行，为此做出切实努力。
77f872388cbea7dc8e47c644d53ec12291e10385.translatedText: Hua Chunying said that in recent days, the Japanese side has artificially hyped up the crisis, created tension, and smeared China's image. This approach runs counter to efforts to improve relations. China has always advocated the proper management and resolution of relevant issues through dialogue and consultation. We hope that Japan will face up to history and reality, work with China halfway, and make practical efforts to this end.

be4d6fdc0700138585aa186605497b3b93bd203a.sourceText: 5月13日下午，《非诚勿扰》新西兰专场刚刚录制完毕，主持人孟非便难掩内心激动第一时间在微博上感慨道，”新西兰专场今天下午录制完毕，不仅创下了2010年开播以来所有海外专场的最高牵手成功率，而且全场high翻，台上台下一片欢乐，结尾满是欢呼和眼泪，连导演组同事们最后都离开监视器挤到台口鼓掌！这一幕将长久地留在我的回忆中。”黄菡也忍不住跟着感叹，”我是开心得眼眶湿润，孟老师是激动得连连口误。”代班嘉宾曾子航也紧跟着表示，”新西兰专场真的让我彻底相信了’缘，妙不可言！”’之后，孟非更是在各种场合向众人力荐，”大家到时一定要看《非诚勿扰》新西兰专场，史上最精彩的专场，没有之一！”
be4d6fdc0700138585aa186605497b3b93bd203a.translatedText: On the afternoon of May 13, the New Zealand special episode of "If You Are the One" has just been recorded The host Meng Fei couldn't hide her excitement and immediately said on Weibo, "The New Zealand special was recorded this afternoon. Not only did it set the highest success rate of holding hands among all overseas specials since it was launched in 2010, but the whole audience was in high spirits. There was joy on and off the stage. The ending was full of cheers and tears. Even the colleagues in the directing team In the end, everyone left the monitor and crowded to the stage to applaud! This scene will remain in my memory for a long time." Huang Han couldn't help but sigh, "I was so happy that my eyes were filled with tears, and Teacher Meng was so excited that I kept making mistakes." The substitute guest Zeng Zihang also said, "The New Zealand performance really convinced me, it's so wonderful!" "' After that, Meng Fei recommended it to everyone on various occasions, "Everyone must watch the New Zealand show of "If You Are the One". It is one of the most exciting shows in history! "

287647047686aa704a4f996489279c27a29677f4.sourceText: 据悉，在新西兰专场中，勇敢的”爆灯妹”层出不穷，个性都颇为直接。最后留灯女生或爆灯的动心女生正好是男嘉宾心动女生的状况时有发生，黄菡老师忍不住当场飙泪感叹爱情缘分的奇妙。除了史上最年长的51岁女嘉宾将登台外，更是创下了爆灯人数最多、牵手成功率最高、开场最震撼、精彩感人场景最多等多项之最。据统计，新西兰专场17位男嘉宾、15位女嘉宾，总共成功牵手了10对，成功率高达60%。当红女星江一燕也将在节目中亮相为好友助阵，更是表示，”如果好朋友牵手成功，我也要上《非诚勿扰》。”值得一提的是，新西兰专场超震撼的战舞开场尤为不能错过。伴着异域鼓点，四个健壮彪悍的毛利人手持长枪突降舞台。强劲有力的踏步，浑身满是刺青和图腾。腰间围着草裙，瞪圆了双眼、吐着长舌头，时不时吼着”嘿！哈！”……着实让场下观众为之一惊！主持人孟非出场后，几个毛利小伙子突然舞枪弄棒着朝他冲了过去，孟非竟泰然自若地和他们玩起了”情景剧”。看孟非毫无惧意，四人又突然像顽皮的孩子一样对着孟非做起了鬼脸，最后一个个跳跃着离开了。此外，被称为世界上最后一片净土的新西兰风光也是一大不容错过的看点，届时将在男嘉宾的个人短片中一一呈现。 健美男现场抱起孟非 自称”新西兰最大的一块胸肌”
287647047686aa704a4f996489279c27a29677f4.translatedText: It is reported that in the New Zealand show, there are many brave "girls who shine" and their personalities are quite direct. It often happens that the girl who is left last or the girl who is attracted by the spotlight happens to be the girl who is attracted by the male guest. Teacher Huang Han couldn't help but burst into tears on the spot and lamented the wonder of love and fate. In addition to the 51-year-old oldest female guest in history who will be on stage, the show has also set records such as the largest number of people lighting up the show, the highest success rate of holding hands, the most shocking opening, and the most exciting and touching scenes. According to statistics, there were 17 male guests and 15 female guests in the New Zealand special event, and a total of 10 couples successfully held hands, with a success rate of 60%. Popular actress Jiang Yiyan will also appear on the show to support her friends. She even said, "If my good friends hold hands successfully, I will also appear on "If You Are the One." It is worth mentioning that the super shocking war dance opening of the New Zealand special is not to be missed. Accompanied by exotic drums, four strong and sturdy Maori men descended onto the stage holding spears. With powerful steps, his body is covered with tattoos and totems. Wearing a grass skirt around her waist, her eyes widened, her tongue stuck out, and she shouted "Hey! Ha!" from time to time... which really shocked the audience! After the host Meng Fei appeared on the stage, several Maori boys suddenly rushed towards him with guns and sticks, but Meng Fei calmly played a "situation drama" with them. Seeing that Meng Fei showed no fear, the four of them suddenly made faces at Meng Fei like naughty children, and finally jumped away one by one. In addition, the scenery of New Zealand, known as the last pure land in the world, is also an attraction not to be missed, which will be presented one by one in the male guest's personal short film. The bodybuilder picked up Meng Fei on the spot and claimed to have "the biggest chest muscle in New Zealand"

70c153afcd5fea71df524b4e68545b083af3510c.sourceText: 完美身材令众人惊叹 俯卧撑、现场托举女嘉宾
70c153afcd5fea71df524b4e68545b083af3510c.translatedText: His perfect figure amazed everyone. He did push-ups and lifted the female guest on the spot

78df5a64764d787889aea6f50842ab23d2593896.sourceText: 电梯落地，高大健壮的猛男季嵩一出场便让全场惊叹不已。紧接着他一把抱起了孟非，丝毫不费力气。天津出生，新西兰长大。西式的饮食结构、对健美的热爱，把他塑造成了”新西兰最大的一块胸肌”。一天五到七餐，几乎每两个小时吃一顿。天天去都去健身房，目前也正是一名健身教练。现场，季嵩也是一展完美身材和惊人力量。让女嘉宾坐在身上大做花式俯卧撑、高高托举非洲姑娘小德……尤其是在个人短片中展示的胸肌，让众人看得目瞪口呆。在新西兰生活了多年，未来季嵩希望能回国发展，继续从事健美行业，帮助中国男人塑造健美体型。
78df5a64764d787889aea6f50842ab23d2593896.translatedText: When the elevator landed, the tall and strong hunk Ji Song amazed the audience as soon as he appeared. Then he picked up Meng Fei without any effort. Born in Tianjin and raised in New Zealand. A Western-style diet and a love for bodybuilding shaped him into "the largest chest muscle in New Zealand." Eat five to seven meals a day, almost every two hours. I go to the gym every day and am currently a fitness instructor. At the scene, Ji Song also showed off his perfect figure and amazing strength. The female guest was asked to sit on her body and do fancy push-ups, and she lifted up the African girl Xiao De... Especially the chest muscles shown in the personal short film made everyone stunned. After living in New Zealand for many years, Ji Song hopes to return to China for development in the future, continue to work in the bodybuilding industry, and help Chinese men build a toned body.

4839301ad80818afdbca14147fbf35cb7137c2b7.sourceText: 在感情方面，季嵩只谈过一次恋爱。他现场坦言，”我的感情经历比较少，相对而言我还是比较喜欢温柔性感的中国女孩。喜欢她们身上那种细腻，和不同于国外女生的独特气质。中国女生看上去一碰就碎，让人很想去保护她们。我虽然是大块头，但我一点不可怕。我觉得我长得挺可爱的，而且为人很幽默、开朗。真的希望以后每天下班的时候可以看到一盏灯为我而亮，早上醒来第一眼就能看到心爱的人，两个人一起吃饭、看电影，做喜欢的事情，这就是我想要的生活。只要感觉对了，我也可以为了她回国。”场上女生听完分外感动，更有女嘉宾坚持为他把灯留到了最后。他最终能否成功牵手呢？ 非洲姑娘恋上帅气高尔夫教练 ”你把我的心带走了！”
4839301ad80818afdbca14147fbf35cb7137c2b7.translatedText: In terms of relationships, Ji Song has only been in love once. He confessed on the spot, "I have relatively little relationship experience. Relatively speaking, I prefer Chinese girls who are gentle and sexy. I like their delicacy and unique temperament that is different from foreign girls. Chinese girls look like they can break at the touch of a finger, which makes people want to protect them. Although I am big, I am not scary at all. I think I look pretty cute and I am very humorous." , cheerful. I really hope that I can see a light turn on for me every day when I wake up in the morning. We can eat, watch movies, and do things we like together. This is the life I want. As long as it feels right, I can go back to China for her." The girls on the scene were very moved after hearing this, and some female guests insisted on keeping the light for him until the end. Can he finally succeed in holding hands? African girl falls in love with handsome golf coach "You took my heart away!"

20b3efb876d46aa977ab92ca0b583cc0aeb68e0c.sourceText: ”爆灯姐”为意中人最后留灯 ”我们很配很合适！”
20b3efb876d46aa977ab92ca0b583cc0aeb68e0c.translatedText: "Sister Bang Deng" left the final message for the one she loves, "We are a perfect match!"

1899f163326e0f9a0ba5a16b5494ea6d61133213.sourceText: 帅气儒雅的高尔夫球教练张晓明以出众的气质和外形备受场上女生们的青睐，一段曲折的人生经历更是让人感动。在新西兰多年间，他每天都要打三份工，帮助父亲还债。后来父亲病逝，他就去到高尔夫球场打球寻找内心平静，却意外成为了一名高尔夫教练。前女友陪伴他度过了最艰难的日子，后来却选择了回国导致两人无奈分手。父亲的离开，让他一度无暇顾及感情。经过岁月的沉淀，内心也越来越渴望一份属于自己的平静幸福。”我希望她知性温柔、独立孝顺、通情达理，最重要的是能够成为一个好妈妈。”场上的非洲姑娘小德对他颇为心动，坚持留灯到最后，”你笑起来很好看、声音特温柔，我感觉你把我的心领走了！你特别适合当我们家的女婿。”对此，张晓明会作何回应呢？
1899f163326e0f9a0ba5a16b5494ea6d61133213.translatedText: The handsome and elegant golf coach Zhang Xiaoming is favored by the girls on the court for his outstanding temperament and appearance. His tortuous life experience is even more touching. For many years in New Zealand, he worked three jobs every day to help his father pay off his debts. Later, his father died of illness, so he went to the golf course to find peace of mind, but unexpectedly became a golf instructor. His ex-girlfriend accompanied him through the most difficult days, but later chose to return to China, resulting in the two having no choice but to break up. His father's departure left him no time to take care of his feelings. After years of precipitation, my heart has become more and more eager for my own peace and happiness. "I hope she is intellectual, gentle, independent, filial, reasonable, and most importantly, able to become a good mother." The African girl Xiaode on the scene was very moved by him and insisted on keeping the light on until the end, "You have a beautiful smile and a very gentle voice. I feel like you have taken my heart away! You are particularly suitable to be our son-in-law." How will Zhang Xiaoming respond to this?

4de2cfe121bbc987c601852c17f1d3d23c0e1311.sourceText: 已过而立之年的栾喆却仍富有童心，喜欢收藏MINI老爷车和玩具、爱养小动物。曾经很瘦，如今却变得又胖又壮并下决心减肥。”爆灯姐”丁东丽主动示好道，”你根本没必要减肥，我就喜欢你这种结实魁梧点的，这个体型跟我很配。而且你的确是我喜欢的类型，我也喜欢小动物，希望有个人能跟我一起养。”对于未来的另一半，栾喆希望对方是个大方、孝顺、开朗、活泼的女生。最终，只有丁东丽坚持为他把灯留到了最后，并继续告白道，”我看你已经很久了，我们真的很合适！”最终，他会牵起丁东丽的手吗？
4de2cfe121bbc987c601852c17f1d3d23c0e1311.translatedText: Three years later, Luan Zhe is still full of childlike innocence. He likes to collect classic MINI cars and toys, and loves to raise small animals. Once thin, now I am fat, strong and determined to lose weight. "Sister Baodeng," Ding Dongli said proactively, "You don't need to lose weight at all. I like you who are stronger and taller. This body shape suits me very well. And you are indeed my type. I also like small animals. I hope someone can raise them with me." For his future partner, Luan Zhe hopes that the other half will be a generous, filial, cheerful, and lively girl. In the end, only Ding Dongli insisted on leaving the light for him until the end, and continued to confess, "I have seen you for a long time, and we are really suitable!" In the end, will he hold Ding Dongli's hand?

798b4545c8baf52b67036ff1e88d2e948bba189f.sourceText: 男嘉宾遭遇”大反转” 先是”爆灯”、后是”群辩”
798b4545c8baf52b67036ff1e88d2e948bba189f.translatedText: The male guest encountered a "big reversal", first "exploding" and then "group debate"

ee058842bb4258d9354574661484938e63b799e9.sourceText: 被反问择偶标准太挑剔 与黄菡、曾子航现场过招
ee058842bb4258d9354574661484938e63b799e9.translatedText: was asked that the standards for choosing a spouse are too picky Live battle with Huang Han and Zeng Zihang

c1bd053325265a6ecd99cfcf95c77ccefba336ff.sourceText: 初登场时，来自上海的男嘉宾朱晔让人感觉很是文静、内敛，而且擅长烹饪，北方的包子、广东的汤、西式烘焙……无所不能，一副居家好男人形象。6号女生果断爆灯，”我就是个吃货。而且他的面相我也很喜欢。”不料，紧接着却上演了一幕大反转。谈及择偶标准，朱晔表示，”对于未来的另一半，我可以不限地域、年龄、国籍，也可以接受离异的女生。但如果有孩子，我只接受孩子父亲是洋人的，因为中国家庭成员太多，都想来看孩子，会影响两个人之间的关系。另外，我从小吃的比较清淡，不能接受每餐吃面食、吃辣的女生。我比较高、比较瘦，所以不能接受个子矮、较胖的女生……”
c1bd053325265a6ecd99cfcf95c77ccefba336ff.translatedText: When he first appeared, the male guest Zhu Ye from Shanghai made people feel that he was very quiet and restrained, and he was good at cooking. He could make steamed buns from the north, soups from Guangdong, and Western baking... he could do it all, and he looked like a good family man. Girl No. 6 said decisively, "I am a foodie. And I also like his face." Unexpectedly, a big reversal happened immediately afterwards. Talking about the criteria for choosing a spouse, Zhu Ye said, "For my future partner, I can accept divorced girls regardless of region, age, or nationality. But if I have a child, I will only accept that the father of the child is a foreigner, because there are too many Chinese family members who want to see the child, which will affect the relationship between the two people." In addition, I have been eating lightly since I was a child, so I cannot accept girls who eat pasta or spicy food for every meal. I am taller and thinner, so I cannot accept girls who are shorter or fatter..."

449a18f4cca1339ab3781d0e8db4f8efa9689f78.sourceText: 此番言论随即引发了全场热议。女嘉宾李璐表示，”我本来对你印象挺好的，现在你说每句话我得有800次原谅你的冲动才能继续听你讲话。”朱晔紧接着回应，”你说话不应该掺杂个人情绪，这是我的想法和要求，我不需要你的原谅。我只是表达我想要的，你干嘛对我那么不满呢？”黄菡老师也认为，”两个人的饮食习惯不同，互相改变一点没准会多一种乐趣。实在不行，各吃各的也未尝不可。”朱晔也紧跟着反驳，”我完全不同意黄老师的观点。”曾子航忍不住问道，”男嘉宾，有没有人说过你有点’事儿妈’？”一向优雅的美女甜点师张丹丹也忍不住建议道，”表现出来的可能是真性情，但在这个场合不妨内敛、平和一点。”对于如此个性突出的男嘉宾，最后会有多少盏灯为他而亮呢？
449a18f4cca1339ab3781d0e8db4f8efa9689f78.translatedText: This comment immediately sparked a heated discussion in the audience. Female guest Li Lu said, "I originally had a good impression of you, but now I have to forgive you 800 times for every word you say before I can continue to listen to you." Zhu Ye immediately responded, "You should not mix personal emotions with your words. This is my idea and request. I don't need your forgiveness. I just expressed what I want. Why are you so dissatisfied with me?" Teacher Huang Han also believed, "The eating habits of two people are different, and maybe it will be more fun to change each other." If it doesn't work, it's okay for everyone to have their own meal." Zhu Ye also retorted, "I completely disagree with Teacher Huang's point of view." Zeng Zihang couldn't help but ask, "Male guest, has anyone ever said that you are a bit of a troublemaker?" Zhang Dandan, the always elegant and beautiful pastry chef, couldn't help but suggest, "You may be showing true temperament, but you might as well be restrained and calm on this occasion." For such a distinguished male guest, how many lights will be turned on for him in the end?

bae8f5dadd542c70eec3116c3fc0029f9037f41b.sourceText: 又是一年流感季节 高峰提前到来
bae8f5dadd542c70eec3116c3fc0029f9037f41b.translatedText: Another year of flu season, the peak has arrived early

610a80c7cddd63d216614399ff6309710e747396.sourceText: 又是一年流感季节 高峰提前到来 亚利桑那州卫生服务部报告说，到目前为止，流感已经扩散到全州15个郡，有1143…
610a80c7cddd63d216614399ff6309710e747396.translatedText: Another year of flu season, the peak has arrived early. The Arizona Department of Health Services reported that so far, the flu has spread to 15 counties across the state, with 1,143...

8cdb0cb40ece05d8123ca1f4bcc8183537805b88.sourceText: 亚利桑那州卫生服务部报告说，到目前为止，流感已经扩散到全州15个郡，有1143个病例，其中马利科巴郡一名婴儿因此死亡。
8cdb0cb40ece05d8123ca1f4bcc8183537805b88.translatedText: The Arizona Department of Health Services reported that so far, the flu has spread to 15 counties across the state, with 1,143 cases, including the death of an infant in Maricopa County.

574532c73953c8cd0aa2e7a67032e875a75cd305.sourceText: 卫生部的数据显示，今年的流感病例明显多于去年同期。
574532c73953c8cd0aa2e7a67032e875a75cd305.translatedText: Data from the Ministry of Health show that there are significantly more influenza cases this year than during the same period last year.

a8bfcd66251674e788987e1c3cf33bc0a5966f7e.sourceText: 通常，流感季节从每年10月1日开始，持续至来年的五月下旬。市民感染高峰期没有一定规律，一般在圣诞节/冬至前后。
a8bfcd66251674e788987e1c3cf33bc0a5966f7e.translatedText: Usually, the flu season starts on October 1 of each year and lasts until late May of the following year. There is no certain pattern in the peak period of citizen infection, but it usually occurs around Christmas/Winter Solstice.

ea7072f16328ef8bf459028628061d17d1ae2fbd.sourceText: 根据卫生部资料，有一名马郡儿童感染甲型流感身亡。去年有两宗儿童死亡病例，今年已经有四宗。（卫生部没有追踪成人感染流感死亡数字）
ea7072f16328ef8bf459028628061d17d1ae2fbd.translatedText: According to the Ministry of Health, a child in Ma County died of influenza A infection. There were two child deaths last year and there have been four this year. (The Ministry of Health does not track the number of deaths among adults infected with influenza.)

33e4649abf6bc1c2cb37b0d026340f0e5611f9ea.sourceText: 现发现的三类流感病毒中，甲型和乙型最常见。卫生部官员说，今年报告最多的是甲型。
33e4649abf6bc1c2cb37b0d026340f0e5611f9ea.translatedText: Of the three types of influenza viruses currently found, type A and type B are the most common. Health Ministry officials said the most reported cases this year were type A.

24512ccf97cac22b79011259efaa746c3ab70b49.sourceText: 甲型流感主要感染对象是老人和婴儿。保护自己最好的方法是接种疫苗，卫生部建议成人和6个月以上婴儿应尽早接种流感疫苗。
24512ccf97cac22b79011259efaa746c3ab70b49.translatedText: Influenza A mainly infects the elderly and infants. The best way to protect yourself is to get vaccinated. The Ministry of Health recommends that adults and infants over 6 months old should get the flu vaccine as early as possible.

b0ad2e44e745c470cb88a7c7c875d7113bf90101.translatedText: Five tips to avoid the flu

c90a777c00fff34add6f4e057ec9866976818e63.sourceText: 避免接触眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴。
c90a777c00fff34add6f4e057ec9866976818e63.translatedText: Avoid contact with your eyes, nose and mouth.

362c91f220dd365ff5a7f8cb81899dea19241b92.sourceText: 洗手，特别是在如厕后和咳嗽或打喷嚏之后。
362c91f220dd365ff5a7f8cb81899dea19241b92.translatedText: Wash your hands, especially after using the bathroom and after coughing or sneezing.

a0efff42c77b4b741570fd6acb6c7ee0040a10c9.sourceText: 使用消毒洗手液洗手，如果没有就用肥皂洗。
a0efff42c77b4b741570fd6acb6c7ee0040a10c9.translatedText: Use hand sanitizer to wash your hands, or soap if not available.

517a3c039439e18577d8bae8de14dd5057e4ebc4.translatedText: If you are sick, stay home and take time off.

33a508b8bc696f190c9db78019b0c7e14f460927.sourceText: 使用一次性纸巾，用完后扔掉。
33a508b8bc696f190c9db78019b0c7e14f460927.translatedText: Use disposable paper towels and throw them away after use.

3a72e96217474735e0c6395b70b789bc06f2bab7.sourceText: “华文教育·名师巡讲”团在凤凰城进行为期一周的讲学
3a72e96217474735e0c6395b70b789bc06f2bab7.translatedText: The "Chinese Education·Famous Teacher Tour" group held a week-long lecture in Phoenix

2b266b7546e39304b3760ebe545fa8c7b53ff74a.sourceText: “华文教育·名师巡讲”团在凤凰城进行为期一周的讲学 （亚省时报） 由中国海外交流协会选派的赴美国”华文教育 名师巡讲”一行5人于8月13日抵达凤凰城，开始了为期一周的讲学。13日大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会主席张华芳，副主席崔增祁，全美中文学校协会副会长帅致若以及现代中文学校，希望中文学校校长们在食为天餐厅举办欢迎晚宴。 ”华文教育名师巡讲”团由中国海外交流协会王匡廷先生、詹志博先生、复旦大学葛剑雄教授、北京师范大学朱志平教授和姚梅林教授组成。在美期间，三位专家将围绕中华文化专题、汉字词汇教学和儿童心理学等课程开展培训。 本次讲学活动由中国海外交流协会和中国华文教育基金会联合主办，得到了深圳市耀华实验学校的部分资助，由全美中文学校协会承办。 讲学团在凤凰城地区为教师培训的具体日程如下： 凤凰城地区的培训因各种条件限制，分成两天完成，两场课程的内容不同。 8月16日（周四）晚6:00-9:00：儿童教育心理学（2小时）-姚梅林教授；汉字、词汇趣味教学(上）（1小时）-朱志平教授 8月19日（周日）上午9:00-12:00 ：中国文化专题（2小时）-葛剑雄教授；汉字、词汇趣味教学（下）（1小时)-朱志平教授 授课地点：MCC（美莎社区大学），BP building，room – BP4（地址见图） （朱志平教授前左一 葛剑雄教授前左三 姚梅林教授后左二）
2b266b7546e39304b3760ebe545fa8c7b53ff74a.translatedText: "Chinese Education·Famous Teacher Tour" conducted a week-long lecture in Phoenix (Alberta Times) A group of 5 people selected by the China Overseas Exchange Association to go to the United States for the "Chinese Education Famous Teacher Tour" arrived in Phoenix on August 13 and began a week-long lecture. On the 13th, Zhang Huafang, Chairman of the Greater Phoenix Chinese Overseas Chinese Association, Cui Zengqi, Vice Chairman, Shuai Zhiruo, Vice Chairman of the National Association of Chinese Schools, and Modern Chinese Schools hoped that the principals of Chinese schools would hold a welcome dinner at Shiweitian Restaurant. The "Chinese Education Famous Teacher Tour" group consists of Mr. Wang Kuangting and Mr. Zhan Zhibo of China Overseas Exchange Association, Professor Ge Jianxiong of Fudan University, Professor Zhu Zhiping and Professor Yao Meilin of Beijing Normal University. During their stay in the United States, the three experts will conduct training on Chinese cultural topics, Chinese character vocabulary teaching, and child psychology. This lecture event was jointly sponsored by the China Overseas Exchange Association and the China Chinese Education Foundation, partially funded by Shenzhen Yaohua Experimental School, and hosted by the National Association of Chinese Schools. The specific schedule of the lecture group's training for teachers in the Phoenix area is as follows: Due to various constraints, the training in the Phoenix area was divided into two days, and the contents of the two courses were different. August 16 (Thursday) 6:00-9:00 pm: Child Educational Psychology (2 hours) - Professor Yao Meilin; Interesting Teaching of Chinese Characters and Vocabulary (Part 1) (1 hour) - Professor Zhu Zhiping August 19 (Sunday) 9:00-12:00 am: Chinese Culture Special Topic (2 hours) - Professor Ge Jianxiong; Interesting Teaching of Chinese Characters and Vocabulary (Part 2) (1 hour) - Professor Zhu Zhiping Teaching location: MCC (Mesa Community College), BP building, room – BP4 (see the picture for the address) (Professor Zhu Zhiping is first from the left in front, Professor Ge Jianxiong is third from the left in front, and Professor Yao Meilin is second from the left)

b4d2c944d3db088eb386fee176f88864dad213be.translatedText: Hope Chinese School: Insights on the development of Chinese schools Hope Chinese School Dai Yuhua Ten years have passed. In these ten years, I have witnessed with my own eyes...

e2fcb61702f03a13eb25fb37394bd818f9c03d8f.sourceText: 希望中文学校 戴玉华

ff801e0c9e3c571f7880270df383427b0d3c409d.sourceText: 十年的光景已经过去了,在这十多年里，我亲眼地目睹到我们中文学校和其它中文学校一样规模从小到大,无论是从课程设置的多样化、教师资源的多源化、教学管理的规范化都达到了一定的高度。从和家长和社会人士的谈话中，我感受到中文学校受到了社会的逐步认同，到中文学校学习已经成了我们华人家庭甚至是一些中文是第二语言的家庭不可缺少的一个部分。我作为一名海外中文学校的老师，甚是感到欣慰，我也很高兴我们的孩子能够生长在美国，同时又有机会真正体会到我们中华民族语言的精辟，把中华民族五千年智慧的结晶永远地传承下去。
ff801e0c9e3c571f7880270df383427b0d3c409d.translatedText: Ten years have passed. During these ten years, I have witnessed with my own eyes that our Chinese school has grown from small to large like other Chinese schools. Whether it is the diversification of curriculum, the diversification of teacher resources, or the standardization of teaching management, it has reached a certain height. From conversations with parents and people in society, I feel that Chinese schools are gradually recognized by society. Studying in Chinese schools has become an indispensable part of our Chinese families and even some families where Chinese is a second language. As a teacher in an overseas Chinese school, I feel very gratified. I am also very happy that our children can grow up in the United States and at the same time have the opportunity to truly experience the incisiveness of our Chinese language and pass on forever the crystallization of the five thousand years of wisdom of the Chinese nation.

fe26c92c120dfd578d7cac9d289e169a8a252003.sourceText: 作为一名海外华文教育工作者，既肩负着教授中文知识的职责，又肩负着为我们的孩子连接中西方文化的桥梁,针对这些，我和其它的老师一样，除了参加各种各样的教师培训来提高自己的业务能力，同时又互相切搓，想尽多种多样的教学方法来吸引学生的学习兴趣。例如：首先在学习中，充方利用学生已有的语言技能来协助中文的学习，这样学生会有信心尝试去学,而不会觉得自己一无所知。第二，教学中要时常有交流互动，鼓励学生发表自己的观点，达到学为所用。第三，注重因材施教，课程的设置要符合中文基础薄弱的学生，同时也要給基础扎实的学生想象发挥的空间，这样会给不同层次的学生互动的机会，从而提高学习效果。最后，有效地采用多媒体教学。利用多媒体教学是需要老师精心设计和挑选的。我们要选择与学生的年龄适当，内容贴近学生生活的教具和游戏来帮助学生学习和巩固学习内容。
fe26c92c120dfd578d7cac9d289e169a8a252003.translatedText: As an overseas Chinese educator, I am not only responsible for teaching Chinese knowledge, but also responsible for connecting Chinese and Western cultures for our children. Regarding these, like other teachers, I not only participate in various teacher trainings to improve my professional capabilities, but also interact with each other and try out a variety of teaching methods to attract students' interest in learning. For example: First of all, during learning, students should use their existing language skills to assist in Chinese learning, so that students will have the confidence to try to learn without feeling that they know nothing. Second, there should be constant communication and interaction in teaching, and students should be encouraged to express their own opinions so that what they learn can be put to use. Third, we should pay attention to teaching students in accordance with their aptitude. The curriculum should be designed to suit students with weak Chinese foundation. At the same time, students with solid foundation should be given room to imagine and express themselves. This will give students at different levels opportunities to interact and improve learning results. Finally, effectively use multimedia teaching. The use of multimedia teaching requires careful design and selection by teachers. We must choose teaching aids and games that are appropriate for the students' age and whose content is close to students' lives to help students learn and consolidate learning content.

b3fb52de524d7dc51950a93af69d2267d987c32e.sourceText: 独特的低年级的数学教学
b3fb52de524d7dc51950a93af69d2267d987c32e.translatedText: Unique mathematics teaching for lower grades

5107b5dac9698263f9783bb9ef9bbb1959992774.sourceText: 教授数学二册已有几年了，说真心话，我真的很喜欢这个年龄的孩子。他们爱憎分明，从来不会隐藏自己,喜欢就是喜欢，不喜欢就是不喜欢,我很幸运从孩子的表情中我可以感受到他们的真实想法。很早以前在大学修教育学分的时候，记得最清晰就是对于低年级的孩子不是看到他们学到了多少知识，会做了多少数学题，而是在教学过程中注重让孩子参与，用贴近孩子生活的实例去激起孩子的学习欲望，从而促进孩子积极主动地去学。在这多年的数学教学中，我一直遵询这样的原則，我也真正体会到了孩子在这样的教学原则中学习受益颇多。
5107b5dac9698263f9783bb9ef9bbb1959992774.translatedText: I have been teaching mathematics volume 2 for several years. To be honest, I really like children of this age. They love and hate clearly and never hide themselves. If they like it, they like it, and if they don't like it, they don't like it. I'm lucky that I can feel their true thoughts from the children's expressions. When I was taking education credits in college a long time ago, what I remember most clearly is that for the children in the lower grades, we did not see how much knowledge they had learned or how many math problems they could solve. Instead, we focused on involving children in the teaching process and used examples close to children's lives to stimulate children's desire to learn, thereby promoting children to learn proactively. In these many years of teaching mathematics, I have always followed this principle, and I have truly realized that children benefit a lot from learning under such teaching principles.

492162716b69141bc7b3f463150239b5041c81e2.sourceText: 讲到运用生活中的实例来教学，就是让孩子在学习的过程中能够真正地感受到看到、听到、甚至于摸到他们要学的东西。我拿教授孩子学认识时间来做一个例子,我来先解释一下什么是看到。在认识时间的教学中，我收集了各种不同形状和质地的时钟，有的是实物，有的是图片，学生可以亲眼地看到各种不同形状的时钟，他门很感兴趣，有的同学告诉我，他真希望他有这么多样式的钟在他的房间里。第二个摸到，我准备了几个可以操动的玩具时钟，每个学都有机会操作和体会到什么是整点、半点、小时、分钟等一系列的认识时间的术语,学生们都争先恐后地到前面来，没有一个胆怯或者不想试的。最后一个來说说听到，当然在任何科目的教学中，听是很重要的一个不可缺少的重要环节。在这个教学中，我让孩子听听整点和半点都是什么样的声音？什么时候时钟只发出很微弱的声音?然后大家一起静下来，听听教室里的时钟发出的声音。在整个认识时钟的这个课时，孩子们都是在积极勇跃地参与。在孩子们的言行中，我感受到了这些孩子的天真无邪，感受到了孩子求知的欲望,也感受到了虽然他们年龄小，这并不代表老师和家长是孩子学习的主人，孩子才是他们自己学习的主人。
492162716b69141bc7b3f463150239b5041c81e2.translatedText: When it comes to using examples from life to teach, it means that children can truly see, hear, and even touch what they want to learn during the learning process. Let me take teaching children to learn to recognize time as an example. Let me first explain what seeing is. In the teaching of understanding time, I collected various clocks of different shapes and textures, some of which were real objects, and some of which were pictures. Students could see clocks of various shapes with their own eyes. They were very interested. Some students told me that he really wished he had so many styles of clocks in his room. The second one touched it, I prepared several toy clocks that could be operated. Each student had the opportunity to operate and experience a series of terms for understanding time such as hour, half hour, hour, minute, etc. The students all rushed to the front, and no one was timid or did not want to try. The last one is to talk about listening. Of course, listening is an important and indispensable link in the teaching of any subject. In this teaching, I ask the children to listen to what the whole point and the half point sound like? When does the clock make only a faint sound? Then everyone calms down and listens to the sound of the clock in the classroom. Throughout the lesson on understanding clocks, the children actively participated. In the words and deeds of the children, I felt the innocence of these children, the desire for knowledge, and the fact that although they are young, this does not mean that teachers and parents are the masters of children's learning, but children are the masters of their own learning.

6f007cd68b3d5c320e1ce1ce2453eb5ff2c17481.sourceText: 当大部分人都在关注你飞得高不高时， 只有少部分人关心你飞得累不累， 这就是友情。
6f007cd68b3d5c320e1ce1ce2453eb5ff2c17481.translatedText: When most people are concerned about whether you fly high, only a few people care about whether you are tired from flying, this is friendship.

4ca8263423df8a0ba35bb7752f3d3cc91c94f1b5.sourceText: 一个中心∶一切以健康为中心。
4ca8263423df8a0ba35bb7752f3d3cc91c94f1b5.translatedText: >One center: everything is centered on health.

eeb3f5c5bbd9a5d05e31d8a68565aeac145863c6.sourceText: 两个基本点∶遇事潇洒一点，看世糊涂一点。
eeb3f5c5bbd9a5d05e31d8a68565aeac145863c6.translatedText: Two basic points: be more chic when things happen, and be more confused about the world.

3660d8367152c7ebf45f46bf8c957de0091dc1e8.sourceText: 三个忘记∶ 忘记年龄， 忘记过去， 忘记恩怨。
3660d8367152c7ebf45f46bf8c957de0091dc1e8.translatedText: Three forgets: forget age, forget the past, forget grudges.

a3b238a3a012c8587873fb5dc057e78e960a7342.sourceText: 四个拥有∶ 无论你有多弱或多强，一定要 拥有真正爱你的人， 拥有知心的朋友， 拥有向上的事业， 拥有温暖的住所。
a3b238a3a012c8587873fb5dc057e78e960a7342.translatedText: Four possessions: No matter how weak or strong you are, you must have someone who truly loves you, have close friends, have a progressive career, and have a warm place to live.

66c1cbf1cc871298572217cbfe123c3505295933.sourceText: 五个要∶ 要唱， 要跳， 要俏， 要笑， 要苗条。
66c1cbf1cc871298572217cbfe123c3505295933.translatedText: Five things: to sing, to dance, to be pretty, to laugh, and to be slim.

577c3eb281f4e67c6e2fbb7c922ea68f528a745b.sourceText: 六个不能∶ 不能饿了才吃， 不能渴了才喝， 不能困了才睡， 不能累了才歇， 不能病了才检查， 不能老了再後悔。
577c3eb281f4e67c6e2fbb7c922ea68f528a745b.translatedText: Six don'ts: Don't eat when you're hungry, don't drink when you're thirsty, don't sleep when you're sleepy, don't rest when you're tired, don't get checked when you're sick, don't regret it when you're old.

a1a3050bcff926baf0fe0003fa9196f97c81a79d.sourceText: 这些话，可以说给每一个你珍惜的朋友听:-)
a1a3050bcff926baf0fe0003fa9196f97c81a79d.translatedText: You can say these words to every friend you cherish:-)
