e65dada534d1426cabe54910f08ec97d77456eec.sourceText: 张肇鸿:寄往天堂的信 淑英您好： 或者每天寄往天堂的信件會很多，也不知天堂的郵局是否會因為經濟不好而裁員或關閉？我希望這封信能送到您的手中。 不是說好從洛杉磯回來後談談藝術和文化方面的話題嗎？但這次您爽約了。您還說過前兩次的小吃不是您做東，下次要由您來請，那您就趕快回來請吧，我們也還有一大幫朋友要輪著要請您啊！ 您走了，我想找一些照片給您做個專輯。但在我的電子相簿里，您的相片竟然是那樣的缺少。這也難怪，去年有次上網，遇到駭客入侵，電腦當機了，有字幕彈出，要收取$60才能復原。致電朋友幫忙，個個都說不能向惡勢力低頭，否則會後患無窮，結果電腦真的給駭死了，內面有一批攝影協會的相片和文章還未能貯存到光碟上呢。還好，部分登報的資料可由您回郵給我。今年換了新的硬盤，駭客又來光顧，因通貨膨脹，”保護費”已加到$75，此回學乖了，即時用信用卡付帳，還買了”保險”，才得以保住資料(不要笑我)。定過神來後，我盡量找呀找，找呀找，您的資料真的不多呢，在攝影協會中您不是做公關職位的嗎？所以我又到影協的網站去搜集，在各位同好的網頁里搜翻了天，又給鄭弘會長Email尋求支援，會長刷刷刷地回郵了一批網頁的資料，結果是皇天不負有心人，看過一、二千張的相片之後，找到了數張有你在場的群體照片。 那天在吊唁靈堂上，也有不少感概，因為在其它人的葬禮上，過世的人大都有一疊的相片，放也放不完的，但在這里，屏幕上有關您的照片就只有那麼几張。不過，找不到不等於不存在，在靈堂外站滿人的走廊上，見到前僑聯主席余自任先生，他的手中就有您的照片。鄭弘會長在致悼念辭時，也拿出了您在中文學校活動時的相片，當時的你不是主角，只是在一旁微笑。而當您成為主角時，就有了那麼多的親朋好友懷念您，為您傷心落淚，為您深表惋惜。那天，您讓我們欣賞到您的書法、您辦的海報、報紙、雜誌，還讓我們看到您在每張照片中那燦爛的笑容。 在網頁上找不夠相片，就到您的報紙上去找吧。我從2007年找至2011年，在近一百五十份的亞美報中，見到有千百個人的相片上了報，但怎麼就找不到您呢？難道賣花姑娘自己頭上只插竹葉麼？後來，終於在2010年2月25日的頭版上看到了。那天，您和僑領們去見州長JanBrewer，了解有關新稅務方面的問題，事關重大，不能不見報，但是，能見到的也是您的一個側面。當然，在另一份報紙中，是有一張您的個人正面彩色相片，不但端庄賢惠，而且耀眼亮麗，那就是您的遺照啊！您是個社長，那是您辦的報紙，那是您的心血結晶，您培養她，愛護她，您從不把她作為謀取個人利益的工具，報上不單止難於見到您的相片，連您的名字也十分少見到，您用自己嚴謹的專業操守，贏得了社會對這份報紙的專重，也贏得了大家對您的贊美。 雖然找不到足夠的相片來給您做專輯，但作為攝影協會中的一員，我還是有些後著的。影協當初成立時，我拍過一些會員自我介紹的視頻，也拍到您，這段視頻現在變得很珍貴，上面有您的音容笑貌，還有您那一句令人深思的話語：我不喜歡懾影，但我必須要學！邏輯謹密的您為何會這樣說呢？了解您的人知道，攝影藝術沙龍的學習太花時間和精力了，您那份辛苦勞累的工作目前還無法讓您投入到那種喜歡的階段，但為了讓報紙辦得更好，您還是在百忙之中抽空去學習。而這一點，也正是我們要向您學習的地方。 還有一件令我十分的震惊事情，因為在網上看到了首期的亞美報(2007年12月20日)，頭版就有一篇關於”珍惜生命謹慎開車”的文章，其中報導了全美國每年有四萬人死於上百萬起的交通事故中，亞利桑那州几乎每天有3000起闖紅燈事故，導至約過半的人員的傷殘，除了闖紅燈外，還有16種原因會導至出車禍，其中包括：疲勞駕駛，觀看車外風光，違章駕駛，打手機，調整座位、冷氣、音響等設施，吃東西飲飲料，看地圖、資料、報紙，甚至男人在車上刮鬍鬚，女人塗口紅等等。看過了，會令人出一身冷汗，這些事我們經常都會不經意地在車上做，危險呀！大家今後真的要小心開車，切勿大意！ 淑英，我們知導您的事故屬於意外，重提這些問題，是為了更加去關心他人的生命安全，相信您會贊同的，畢竟在我們這個脆弱的塵世間，再也承受不起如此這般的震撼和打擊了。 不寫了，快點寄出，讓您設計的那兩位小天使送去吧，但愿您在天之靈得到安息。您的朋友們將永遠地懷念您！
e65dada534d1426cabe54910f08ec97d77456eec.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: Letters sent to heaven Hello Shuying: Or there will be a lot of letters sent to heaven every day. I wonder if the post office in heaven will lay off employees or close due to the bad economy? I hope this letter reaches you. Didn’t you agree to talk about art and culture when you get back from Los Angeles? But this time you missed the date. You also said that you were not the host of the snacks for the first two times, and you will be the one to treat them next time, so please come back and treat them as soon as possible. We also have a large group of friends who want to treat you in turn! Since you left, I want to find some photos to make an album for you. But in my electronic photo album, your photos are so missing. It’s no wonder that last year I was online and encountered a hacker attack. My computer crashed and subtitles popped up. I had to charge $60 to restore it. I called my friends for help, but they all said that I couldn't bow to the evil forces, otherwise there would be endless troubles. As a result, the computer was really frightened to death, and there were a batch of photos and articles from the Photographic Association that could not be saved to the CD. Fortunately, some of the information published in the newspaper can be returned to me by you. I got a new hard drive this year, but hackers came again. Due to inflation, the "protection fee" has been increased to $75. I behaved myself and immediately paid the bill with a credit card and bought "insurance" to protect my data (don't laugh at me). After I regained my composure, I tried my best to search and search. You really don’t have much information. Don’t you hold a public relations position in the Photography Association? So I went to the website of the Film Association to search again, searched all over the web pages of my colleagues, and sent an email to President Zheng Hong for support. The president responded by emailing a batch of information from the web pages. It turns out that Huang Tian paid off. After looking at 1,000 or 2,000 photos, I found several group photos with you present. I had a lot of feelings at the condolence hall that day, because at other people's funerals, most of the deceased people have a stack of photos that are endless, but here, there are only a few photos of you on the screen. However, not being found does not mean that it does not exist. When I saw Mr. Yu Ziren, the former chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, in the corridor full of people outside the mourning hall, he had your photo in his hand. When President Zheng Hong delivered his condolence speech, he also took out a photo of you during the Chinese school activities. You were not the protagonist at that time, you were just smiling from the side. And when you become the protagonist, there are so many relatives and friends who miss you, shed tears for you, and express deep regret for you. That day, you let us appreciate your calligraphy, the posters, newspapers, and magazines you created, and you also let us see your bright smile in every photo. If you can't find enough photos on the web, look for them in your newspaper. I searched from 2007 to 2011. In nearly 150 Asian and American newspapers, I saw hundreds of people's photos published in the newspapers, but why can't I find you? Does the flower girl only have bamboo leaves on her head? Later, I finally saw it on the front page of February 25, 2010. That day, you and the overseas Chinese leaders went to see Governor Jan Brewer to learn about the new tax issues. The matter was so important that it had to be reported, but what we could see was also a side of you. Of course, in another newspaper, there is a personal frontal color photo of you, which is not only dignified and virtuous, but also dazzling and bright. That is your posthumous photo! You are the president, that is the newspaper you run, that is your brainchild, you cultivate her, love her, and you never use her as a tool for personal gain. Not only is it difficult to see your photo in the newspaper, but it is also very rare to see your name. With your rigorous professional ethics, you have won the society's attention to this newspaper, and you have also won everyone's praise for you. Although I can't find enough photos to make an album for you, as a member of the Photography Association, I still have some ideas. When the Film Association was first established, I took some videos of members introducing themselves, and I also filmed you. This video has become very precious now. It contains your voice and smile, as well as your thought-provoking words: I don’t like to film, but I have to learn it! Why would you say this if you are so logical? People who know you well know that studying at the Photographic Art Salon takes too much time and energy. Your hard and tiring work has not yet allowed you to invest in the stage that you like. However, in order to make the newspaper run better, you still find time to study in your busy schedule. And this is exactly what we want to learn from you. Another thing that shocked me was that I saw the first issue of Asia-American News (December 20, 2007) on the Internet. There was an article on the front page about "Cherish life and drive cautiously." It reported that 40,000 people die in millions of traffic accidents every year in the United States, and that there are almost 3,000 red light running incidents in Arizona every day. Therefore, in addition to running red lights, there are 16 reasons that lead to car accidents, including: driving while fatigued, looking at the scenery outside the car, driving illegally, talking on mobile phones, adjusting seats, air conditioners, stereos and other facilities, eating and drinking, reading maps, information, newspapers, and even men shaving in the car and women applying lipstick, etc. After seeing this, it will make you break out in a cold sweat. We often do these things inadvertently in the car. It is dangerous! Everyone should really drive carefully in the future and don't be careless! Shuying, we know that your accident was an accident. We raise these issues again to care more about the safety of others. I believe you will agree. After all, in this fragile world of ours, we can no longer bear such shocks and blows. No more writing, send it quickly and let the two little angels you designed send it to you. I hope your soul can rest in peace in heaven. You will be forever missed by your friends!

d932b87f40d39ec2645e236b9462735ca970b146.sourceText: 性奴案救人英雄获表彰 可终生免费吃汉堡
d932b87f40d39ec2645e236b9462735ca970b146.translatedText: The hero who rescued people in the sex slave case was commended and could eat free burgers for life

2afcab236015706d93515a8bf09aa08dbdbd1fdf.sourceText: 性奴案救人英雄获表彰 可终生免费吃汉堡 查尔斯拉姆齐 …
2afcab236015706d93515a8bf09aa08dbdbd1fdf.translatedText: The hero who rescued people in the sex slave case was commended and could eat free burgers for life. Charles Ramsey...

1ec0d48fbdcae9cc4ce7e6038365ee8ce6726d37.sourceText: 据美联社23日报道，为”表彰”救人英雄查尔斯拉姆齐（上图），俄亥俄州克利夫兰市多家餐馆决定，今后免费为他提供汉堡。
1ec0d48fbdcae9cc4ce7e6038365ee8ce6726d37.translatedText: According to the Associated Press report on the 23rd, in order to "recognize" the hero Charles Ramsey (pictured above) who saved people, many restaurants in Cleveland, Ohio decided to provide him with free burgers in the future.

0b9222c1456539e645659450f0fff0703380500c.sourceText: 拉姆齐住在克利夫兰市，是一家餐馆的洗碗工，因帮助3名受囚禁女子获释而成为家喻户晓的”英雄”。
0b9222c1456539e645659450f0fff0703380500c.translatedText: Ramsey lives in Cleveland and is a dishwasher in a restaurant. He became a household name "hero" after helping three imprisoned women be released.

73949e0e35f14825f7de9a97ab12067847ba551f.sourceText: 拉姆齐的邻居阿里埃勒卡斯特罗涉嫌绑架并囚禁三名女子10年。
73949e0e35f14825f7de9a97ab12067847ba551f.translatedText: Ramsey’s neighbor Ariel Castro is suspected of kidnapping and imprisoning three women for 10 years.

5e440a076e1e666541373bd5b938d38f305316f6.sourceText: 接受电视台采访时，拉姆齐回忆道，本月6日，他听到隔壁有人呼喊后便放下手中的麦当劳巨无霸汉堡，前去邻居家一看究竟。他随后帮助一名女受害者逃脱，并且打电话报警，协助警方解救另外两名女子和一个6岁儿童。
5e440a076e1e666541373bd5b938d38f305316f6.translatedText: In an interview with a TV station, Ramsay recalled that on the 6th of this month, after hearing someone shouting next door, he put down the McDonald's Big Mac burger in his hand and went to his neighbor's house to see what was going on. He then helped a female victim escape, called the police, and assisted the police in rescuing two other women and a 6-year-old child.

e687c2293f4debed26522b9185da3312e0d5633c.sourceText: 拉姆齐的救人故事随后被多家媒体广泛报道。有网友把他接受采访时所说的话改编成一首歌，这首歌在视频网站YouTube的点击率超过40万次。
e687c2293f4debed26522b9185da3312e0d5633c.translatedText: > Ramsey’s rescue story was subsequently widely reported by many media. Some netizens adapted what he said during the interview into a song, which has been viewed more than 400,000 times on the video website YouTube.

49ebac2a62686efd26088456ff7081c8400e0015.sourceText: 为表彰拉姆齐的义举，他原先工作的那家餐馆为他制作了一款特殊汉堡。另外，克利夫兰十多家餐馆一致决定，今后只要拉姆齐到店就餐，汉堡可以免费吃。
49ebac2a62686efd26088456ff7081c8400e0015.translatedText: In recognition of Ramsay's charity, the restaurant where he used to work made a special burger for him. In addition, more than a dozen restaurants in Cleveland have unanimously decided that in the future, whenever Ramsey dines in the restaurant, burgers can be eaten for free.

ecde846443fa754e64b5828e4ee52eccb4d418b5.sourceText: 港食神大赛第十届新增“虾饺之王”宝座
ecde846443fa754e64b5828e4ee52eccb4d418b5.translatedText: The 10th Hong Kong Food God Contest has added the title of "King of Shrimp Dumplings"

b26161e1fed41b839c094a5e55d659aee533eb99.sourceText: 港食神大赛第十届新增“虾饺之王”宝座 中新社 由香港旅游发展局主办的大型中式菜肴厨艺比赛”美食…
b26161e1fed41b839c094a5e55d659aee533eb99.translatedText: The 10th Hong Kong God of Food Contest has added the title of "King of Shrimp Dumplings" China News Service A large-scale Chinese cuisine cooking competition sponsored by the Hong Kong Tourism Board Food...

a0146f52415bac221cee06c6a24328ecc6a2a078.sourceText: 由香港 旅游 发展局主办的大型中式菜肴厨艺比赛”美食之最大赏”今年迎来第十届，比赛特新设奖项，以香港美食代表之一的虾饺为题，邀请全港厨师角逐?#34430;饺之王?#30340;封号。
a0146f52415bac221cee06c6a24328ecc6a2a078.translatedText: by Hong Kong Tourism The large-scale Chinese cuisine cooking competition "The Greatest Food Award" organized by the Development Bureau has entered its tenth year this year. The competition has a new award based on shrimp dumplings, one of the representatives of Hong Kong cuisine, and invites chefs from all over Hong Kong to compete for the title of "The King of Dumplings"

3dd6ac49bb2c667d9437375e179c52137cc860b3.sourceText: 此项厨师比拼向来有香港”食神”大赛的美誉。旅发局主席田北俊13日在 记者 会上表示，香港是”亚洲美食之都”，美食是非常重要的旅游卖点。2010年，过夜旅客在港的餐饮消费，总共为香港带来超过150亿港元收益，与2009年相比，上升超过四成。
3dd6ac49bb2c667d9437375e179c52137cc860b3.translatedText: This chef competition has always been known as the "God of Food" competition in Hong Kong. Tian Beijun, chairman of the Hong Kong Tourism Board, told reporters on the 13th. It was stated at the meeting that Hong Kong is the "Gourmet Capital of Asia" and food is a very important tourism selling point. In 2010, overnight tourists' dining consumption in Hong Kong brought a total revenue of more than HK$15 billion, an increase of more than 40% compared with 2009.

270b4aaa30f40844abc5c7ad29271af1baecc195.sourceText: 今届决赛的评审团包括多位海外名厨，例如两位米其林(Michelin)星级名厨，还有来自新加坡、澳大利亚和 中国 台湾 的”厨神”。旅发局亦会邀请海外传媒来港报道决赛过程，让海外观众和读者分享战况。此外，部分名厨稍后更会筹组美食团来港。
270b4aaa30f40844abc5c7ad29271af1baecc195.translatedText: The jury for this year's final includes many overseas celebrity chefs, such as two Michelin-starred chefs, as well as chefs from Singapore, Australia and Taiwan, China. The HKTB will also invite overseas media to report on the finals, allowing overseas audiences and readers to share the results.

9be8eddff25b39578ba28251684c62c046a1cf10.sourceText: 今届”美食之最大赏”现已接受报名，截止日期为7月4日。今年设有四个不同的比赛组别棗”点心”、”饭类”、”羮类”及”蔬菜”。初赛将于7月底进行，届时每个组别将选出10家食肆进入8月举行的决赛，角逐4个组别的至高荣誉金奖、金奖及银奖荣誉。
9be8eddff25b39578ba28251684c62c046a1cf10.translatedText: This year's "The Greatest Food Award" is now open for registration, and the deadline is July 4. This year, there are four different competition categories: "Snacks", "Rice" and "Cooking". Category" and "Vegetables". The preliminary competition will be held at the end of July, when 10 restaurants from each group will be selected to enter the finals in August to compete for the highest honors of gold, gold and silver awards in 4 groups.

4770eaa6a37b53c549e76fcab24951676d18ac1c.sourceText: ”虾饺之王”为点心组特设奖项，评审团会按饺皮韧度、火候等多项准则，决定”虾饺之王”宝座的归属。
4770eaa6a37b53c549e76fcab24951676d18ac1c.translatedText: "King of Shrimp Dumplings" is a special award for the dim sum group. The jury will decide who will be crowned "King of Shrimp Dumplings" based on various criteria such as the toughness of the dumpling skin and the degree of heat.

4123c6f96929c5659619cb438d572fc8b1271a58.translatedText: Only when we arrived_ did we know

574a524131f6ce190e996d8b4f2ce58b19ecdcd8.sourceText: 到了_ 才知道 张肇鸿 环游世界让我们从美洲出发走一圈： 到了美国，才知道不管对方是谁，你都可以打个官司告一告…
574a524131f6ce190e996d8b4f2ce58b19ecdcd8.translatedText: When we arrived_ did we know Zhang Zhaohong. Let’s travel around the world and take a trip from the Americas: When we arrived in the United States, we realized that no matter who the other party is, you can file a lawsuit and sue us...

560eacddfd1c4e94d35e81987c373b8b22ded94b.sourceText: 到了_ 才知道 张肇鸿 环游世界让我们从美洲出发走一圈： 到了美国，才知道不管对方是谁，你都可以打个官司告一告。 到了夏威夷，才知道女人可以不必买胸罩。 到了加拿大，才知道面积比中国还大的地方；人比北京还少。 到了墨西哥，才知道要去美国，还可以走地下道。 到了巴拿马，才知道一条河，也代表了主权的重要。 到了巴西，才知道衣服穿得很少也用不着害臊。 到了古巴，才知道雪茄有N种味道。 到了智利，才知道火车在境内拐个弯也很难办到。 到了阿根廷，才知道不懂足球会让人晕倒。 到欧洲了： 到了北欧，才知道太阳也会睡懒觉。 到了德国，才知道一板一眼，竟然是双B的骄傲。 到了英国，才知道童话中的幸福与快乐都是伪造。 到了荷兰，才知道海平面原来这么高。 到了法国，才知道被人调戏，还会很有情调。 到了西班牙，才知道被牛拱到天上，还可以哈哈大笑。 到了南斯拉夫，才知道为什么有人不愿回到祖国的怀抱。 到了俄罗斯，才知道伏特加是一种饮料。 到了奥地利，才知道连个乞丐都能弹上一支小调。 到了瑞士，才知道开个银行账户，没有百万美金是会被人耻笑。 到了丹麦，才知道编个童话其实可以不打草稿。 到了意大利，才知道GUCCI, PRADA比中国还少。 到了希腊，才知道迷人的地方其实都是破庙。 到了梵蒂冈，才知道在境内任何地方开枪，都可以打着罗马的鸟。 到了非洲，才知道人吃人有时候也是一种需要 到了埃及，才知道一座塔能有多么奥妙。 到了撒哈拉，才知道节约用水的重要。 到了南非，才知道象牙比钻石还少。 到了中东，才知道竟然会分不清楚个人的生命与民族尊严到底谁重要。 到了阿拉伯，才知道做男人是多么的骄傲。 到了阿富汗，才知道冤枉都不能上告。 到了伊拉克，才知道枪炮弹药；随处都能捡到。 回到亚洲： 到了日本，才知道死不认账的人有时候还会很有礼貌。 到了韩国，才知道亚洲足球使上帝都差点疯掉。 到了泰国，才知道漂亮妹妹裤档里居然有小鸟。 到了香港，才知道明星都会戴着口罩。 到了中国，才知道计划生育多重要。
560eacddfd1c4e94d35e81987c373b8b22ded94b.translatedText: We arrived_ and then we knew Zhang Zhaohong. After we arrived in the United States, we realized that no matter who the other party is, you can file a lawsuit and sue us. When I arrived in Hawaii, I learned that women don’t need to buy bras. When I arrived in Canada, I realized that it is a place larger than China and has fewer people than Beijing. When I arrived in Mexico, I learned that if I wanted to go to the United States, I could go underground. When I arrived in Panama, I realized that a river also represents the importance of sovereignty. When I arrived in Brazil, I realized that there is no need to be ashamed of wearing very little clothes. When I arrived in Cuba, I learned that cigars have N kinds of flavors. When I arrived in Chile, I realized that it was difficult for the train to turn around within the country. When I arrived in Argentina, I realized that not knowing football would make people faint. When I arrived in Europe: When I arrived in Northern Europe, I realized that the sun can also sleep in. When I arrived in Germany, I realized that double B’s pride was in being strict. When I arrived in England, I realized that the happiness and joy in fairy tales were all fake. When I arrived in the Netherlands, I realized how high the sea level was. When I arrived in France, I realized that being teased can be very flirtatious. When I arrived in Spain, I realized that I could still laugh out loud while being lifted up to the sky by a bull. When I arrived in Yugoslavia, I realized why some people didn’t want to return to the embrace of their motherland. When I arrived in Russia, I learned that vodka is a drink. When I arrived in Austria, I realized that even a beggar could play a minor tune. When I arrived in Switzerland, I realized that people would laugh at me if I didn’t have a million dollars to open a bank account. When I arrived in Denmark, I realized that you can actually write a fairy tale without drafting it. When I arrived in Italy, I realized that GUCCI and PRADA were even less popular than those in China. When I arrived in Greece, I realized that the charming places were actually ruined temples. When I arrived at the Vatican, I learned that if you shoot anywhere in the Vatican, you can shoot a bird in Rome. When I arrived in Africa, I realized that cannibalism is sometimes necessary. When I arrived in Egypt, I realized how mysterious a tower can be. When I arrived in the Sahara, I realized the importance of saving water. When I arrived in South Africa, I realized that ivory was rarer than diamonds. When I arrived in the Middle East, I realized that it was hard to distinguish between personal life and national dignity. After arriving in Arabia, I realized how proud it is to be a man. When I arrived in Afghanistan, I realized that even if I was wronged, I could not file a complaint. Only after arriving in Iraq did I learn about guns and ammunition; they can be found everywhere. Back to Asia: When I arrived in Japan, I realized that people who refuse to admit their mistakes can sometimes be very polite. When I arrived in South Korea, I realized that Asian football makes God almost crazy. When I arrived in Thailand, I realized that my beautiful sister actually had a bird in her pants. When I arrived in Hong Kong, I realized that celebrities all wear masks. Only after arriving in China did I realize how important family planning is.

19a790c9f6beaf319d100c82d82f182c4a5e2ea1.sourceText: 民主党籍国会众议员嘉贝丽吉福兹 (Gabrielle Gifford) 被枪击七个多月后，两党礼貌性休兵期即将结束。本州岛共和党籍州参议员安提诺瑞 (Frank Antenori) 已递出文件，可能参选目前吉福兹的众议员席位。 安提诺瑞是第一位公开宣布可能与民主党人吉福兹竞争的共和党人。吉福兹继今年 1 月在土桑遭到枪击，头部中弹受伤后，一直在治疗和康复过程中。安提诺瑞的助理说：「他在严肃考虑参选，但尚未正式决定。」 根据去年的人口普查，本州岛在 2012 年的大选中，新增了一个国会议员选区，但选区范围还没最后敲定。 吉福兹没有公开说她是否准备竞选连任。枪案发生后，吉福兹今年 8 月初第一次重返国会，参加提高债限协议的投票，几乎使每个人都感到惊喜。 民主党党魁黛比．舒尔茨说，她期待吉福兹能重返国会「全职工作」。
19a790c9f6beaf319d100c82d82f182c4a5e2ea1.translatedText: More than seven months after Democratic Rep. Gabrielle Gifford was shot, a bipartisan polite truce is coming to an end. Republican state Sen. Frank Antenori has filed papers to potentially run for Giffords' current seat in the House of Representatives. Antinori is the first Republican to publicly announce a possible run against Democrat Giffords. Giffords has been in treatment and recovery after being shot in the head in January in Tucson. Antinori's assistant said: "He is seriously considering running, but has not yet made a formal decision." According to last year's census, the island added a new congressional district in the 2012 general election, but the district boundaries have not yet been finalized. Giffords has not said publicly whether she plans to run for re-election. Giffords surprised almost everyone by returning to Congress in early August for the first time since the shooting to vote on raising the debt limit. Democratic Party leader Debbie. Schultz said she looks forward to Giffords returning to Congress "full time."

During the entire week of Thanksgiving starting from November 22, there are discounts every day that make consumers' wallets wide open. The United States...

27e006ac30dd33055675281f12ce87727ebc2686.sourceText: 从11月22日开始的感恩节整整一周，每天都有令消费者荷包大开的折扣。
27e006ac30dd33055675281f12ce87727ebc2686.translatedText: Throughout the week of Thanksgiving starting on November 22, there are discounts every day that will make consumers' wallets wide open.

d94eac9f2cc0704e0c6b4b5608c2579209f79373.sourceText: 美国感恩节（11月23日）和黑色星期五（24日）在即，年底假期商家打折促销、民众大采购即将由此开始。从11月22日开始的感恩节整整一周，每天都有令消费者荷包大开的折扣。
d94eac9f2cc0704e0c6b4b5608c2579209f79373.translatedText: Thanksgiving Day (November 23) and Black Friday (24th) are approaching in the United States, and merchant discounts and mass purchases will begin during the year-end holidays. Throughout the week of Thanksgiving starting on November 22, there will be discounts every day that will make consumers' wallets wide open.

392f7d028d9ca0e84df620583468178813216cc7.sourceText: 中国消费者也赶黑五购物热潮
392f7d028d9ca0e84df620583468178813216cc7.translatedText: Chinese consumers are also jumping on the Black Friday shopping craze

1544cd7fe95b5b57e8a74afdd093a24a939fcfa8.sourceText: 据全美零售商联合会的数据，约1.64亿美国人计划在即将到来的感恩节周末购物，包括黑色星期五和网络星期一。
1544cd7fe95b5b57e8a74afdd093a24a939fcfa8.translatedText: According to data from the National Retail Federation, about 164 million Americans plan to shop during the upcoming Thanksgiving weekend, which includes Black Friday and Cyber ​​Monday.

b6a8d8cd73faf6d5f281beb6896641bb9eb9a0e2.sourceText: 全球领先的支付服务提供商Worldpay预测，中国消费者对黑色星期五购物兴趣很大。最新数据显示，来自中国的销售额为线上商户贡献了37%的年同比增长。
b6a8d8cd73faf6d5f281beb6896641bb9eb9a0e2.translatedText: Worldpay, the world's leading payment service provider, predicts that Chinese consumers will be very interested in Black Friday shopping. The latest data shows that sales from China contributed 37% year-on-year growth to online merchants.

665033944ada5900ed65c6998c2358a3dfd27452.sourceText: 在线购物的趋势上升并不罕见，但由于在线销售只占整体零售业的一小部分，感恩节一周的实体店销售也不容小觑。此外，在感恩节和黑五促销期间，在线和实体零售相结合的模式颇具吸引力，可以使消费者在线浏览后下单，同时让他们在开车回家的路上取走选购的商品。
665033944ada5900ed65c6998c2358a3dfd27452.translatedText: The rising trend of online shopping is not unusual, but with online sales making up only a small portion of overall retail, in-store sales during Thanksgiving week should not be underestimated. In addition, during Thanksgiving and Black Friday sales, the combination of online and physical retail models is attractive, allowing consumers to browse online and order, while allowing them to pick up their purchases on the way home.

4ce9941fd51ba5ca85473332e0929aca36c0328d.sourceText: 消费者需要注意的是，几乎所有的促销都有特定时间。当消费者正在研究一项促销时，必须在查找购物地点和价格的同时，查阅促销的时间。
4ce9941fd51ba5ca85473332e0929aca36c0328d.translatedText: Consumers need to note that almost all promotions have specific times. When consumers are researching a sale, they must look up the timing of the sale as well as finding where to shop and prices.

53ce7b504a474236f0826148225e7478af52e242.sourceText: 此外，购买智能手机可能牵涉要签订合同，折扣幅度的计算可能比较复杂，所以想要购买智能手机的消费者，需要在前往商店之前做好功课。
53ce7b504a474236f0826148225e7478af52e242.translatedText: In addition, purchasing a smartphone may involve signing a contract, and the calculation of the discount may be complicated, so consumers who want to buy a smartphone need to do their homework before going to the store.

3347fa5f6d7c00e37aff77b6a2d8aac85fff2f78.sourceText: 同时， 一些促销的时间和价格可能会改变，这一点也需要提前关注。
3347fa5f6d7c00e37aff77b6a2d8aac85fff2f78.translatedText: At the same time, the time and price of some promotions may change, which also needs to be paid attention to in advance.

41e821c608acc1553bfc29b6254afd6b1cacc09f.sourceText: 感恩节一周 每天买什么最合算
41e821c608acc1553bfc29b6254afd6b1cacc09f.translatedText: What is the most cost-effective thing to buy every day during Thanksgiving week

af32434bff9a47d9aef602b436bbea245c589d44.sourceText: 随着黑色星期五销售开始提前和持续时间延长，消费者在选择哪天购物上要具有”战略眼光”。
af32434bff9a47d9aef602b436bbea245c589d44.translatedText: As Black Friday sales start earlier and last longer, consumers must have a "strategic vision" in choosing which day to shop.

2d6ea115facf3f54f64ab88563064f5faa77ace8.sourceText: 据”商业内幕”报导，今年对于电子产品类来说，最好的折扣日是感恩节当天。黑色星期五当天更有许多优惠，特别是玩具和服装类别。网络星期一的折扣将继续，预计是购买鞋、化妆品和笔记本电脑的最佳日子。
2d6ea115facf3f54f64ab88563064f5faa77ace8.translatedText: According to "Business Insider", the best discount day for electronic products this year is Thanksgiving. There are a lot of deals on Black Friday, especially in the toys and clothing categories. Cyber ​​Monday discounts are continuing, and it's expected to be the best day to buy shoes, makeup, and laptops.

ec03f6c0373400cafe893fa28f4edd5b17ebd4f9.sourceText: 虽然黑色星期五仍然是商家提供最大折扣的日子，Adobe的预测显示，本周一些最大折扣将不会在星期五。
ec03f6c0373400cafe893fa28f4edd5b17ebd4f9.translatedText: While Black Friday remains the day when merchants offer the biggest discounts, Adobe's forecast shows that some of the week's biggest discounts won't be on Friday.

eeba05bf43f80e64a26e78bb04a8bde8783ebc38.sourceText: 下面是Adobe总结出感恩节一周中的每天最好交易。
eeba05bf43f80e64a26e78bb04a8bde8783ebc38.translatedText: Here’s Adobe’s roundup of the best deals for each day of Thanksgiving week.

830f52c12ec0e7d2a3b050c381fac6681e6dd7c5.sourceText: 感恩节前的星期三：圣诞节装饰品
830f52c12ec0e7d2a3b050c381fac6681e6dd7c5.translatedText: The Wednesday before Thanksgiving: Christmas decorations

21fd622c5d5e44ffb523b63f359413e6e66022ee.sourceText: 在你吃感恩节火鸡之前，应该考虑购买圣诞装饰品。这是节日优惠的最佳日子，在感恩节涨价之前，预计折扣将达到22.7%。
21fd622c5d5e44ffb523b63f359413e6e66022ee.translatedText: Before you eat your Thanksgiving turkey, you should consider shopping for Christmas decorations. This is the best day for holiday deals, with discounts expected to reach 22.7% before the Thanksgiving price increase.

128ae9b692a5bcee0bfe55614ddd67132bdebede.sourceText: Old Navy也在周三开始黑色星期五销售，上午9点开始每一笔消费有50%的折扣。
128ae9b692a5bcee0bfe55614ddd67132bdebede.translatedText: Old Navy also kicks off its Black Friday sales on Wednesday, with 50% off every purchase starting at 9 a.m.

bcac2e119cc5306b7879aadcc56fffdc01d5dd3a.sourceText: 感恩节：电脑、服装、电子游戏和体育用品
bcac2e119cc5306b7879aadcc56fffdc01d5dd3a.translatedText: Thanksgiving: Computers, Clothing, Video Games and Sporting Goods

71a27155cdae66d89b199a7186095e59aa19da5c.translatedText: Computers (16% off) Sporting Goods (11% off) Clothing (15% off) Video games and consoles (9.6% off)

c22028989477a581314bb6ae5c8fb6bd206b3d53.sourceText: 黑色星期五：电视、平板电脑等
c22028989477a581314bb6ae5c8fb6bd206b3d53.translatedText: > Black Friday: TVs, tablets and more

33450d0771dd5983a083e53376210ae0604c8b38.sourceText: Adobe说，黑色星期五仍然是购物的最佳日子，本周五，应该注意以下商品的促销：
33450d0771dd5983a083e53376210ae0604c8b38.translatedText: Black Friday is still the best day for shopping, Adobe says, and this Friday, you should look out for sales on the following items:

7cc2261da34ceafebd84326aadfb37d24f3ca388.translatedText: TVs (23.7% off) Tablets (23.6% off) Jewelry (12% off) Home appliances (17.7% discount)

3dcba810a4ffe3700651a051d7a98febb25a55b2.sourceText: 网络星期一（Cyber Monday）有望成为今年最大的购物日。根据Adobe的预测，在一天之内，商店销售额预计将达到66亿美元，比去年增长16.5%。
3dcba810a4ffe3700651a051d7a98febb25a55b2.translatedText: Cyber ​​Monday promises to be the biggest shopping day of the year. In one day, store sales are expected to reach $6.6 billion, up 16.5% from last year, according to Adobe's forecast.

42b7adf13dbc92d45501fedb5d2db92bed745b6c.sourceText: 虽然在黑色星期五和感恩节当天很多高科技产品价格比较便宜，而网络星期一则是购买玩具的最佳日子，价格暴跌19.1%。
42b7adf13dbc92d45501fedb5d2db92bed745b6c.translatedText: While many high-tech products are cheaper on Black Friday and Thanksgiving, Cyber ​​Monday is the best day to buy toys, with prices plunging 19.1%.

e303d2ba15e49d92fa3b5db119416d7c85962e55.sourceText: 星期二：家居用品和宠物用品
e303d2ba15e49d92fa3b5db119416d7c85962e55.translatedText: Tuesday: Home Furnishings and Pet Products

5073900236f4393ca9d8bf362e053707d714dfa4.sourceText: 在普遍认知中，下周二是黑色星期五疯狂消费之后退货的日子，但那天仍然有合算的商品折扣。
5073900236f4393ca9d8bf362e053707d714dfa4.translatedText: It is generally accepted that next Tuesday is the day to return goods after the crazy spending on Black Friday, but there are still cost-effective product discounts on that day.

8d0b5911a89c742596f5790b77f62f946b1d6f53.sourceText: 感恩节后的周二预计将是买家具和床上用品（12.8%的折扣）和宠物用品（21.7%的折扣）的好日子。
8d0b5911a89c742596f5790b77f62f946b1d6f53.translatedText: The Tuesday after Thanksgiving is expected to be a great day to buy furniture and bedding (12.8% off) and pet supplies (21.7% off).

c3ba7c16705c7b1d9b8b0bf608ba536778d130b6.translatedText: Bfads.net: You can search for a specific product and see all the discounts using this website.

8f340b2b82c6b1d077465309d18504ba1e5c647a.translatedText: Camelcamelcamel.com: Provides historical price comparisons so you can see if an item is really the lowest price, or if you should wait until the price drops more before selling.

72f8900cec83716c0bab0c085e36d69e9d3b562a.sourceText: 每人每年可获得一次免费信用报告 信用评分制度是用来衡量个人信用价值的重要依据，银行是否愿意贷款给购屋者，贷款人的信用报告及分数占了很大的因素，所以在贷款前，最好先查阅一下自己的信用报告。根据公平及正确信用处理法(Fair and Accurate Credit Transactions Act)，每一个人每年可以免费拿到一次自己的信用报告，此报告分别由三家主要的信用纪录公司提供，这三家公司分别是: Equifax、Experian以及TransUnion，最简单的方法是上网到 AnnualCreditReport.com 去免费申请。 在拿到该份信用报告后，请详细检查您的个人资料是否正确，像是: 姓名、住址、年龄等等；是否有不明账户出现，例如: 您未持有的信用卡账户、贷款账户等，以及有无任何账户是您每期按时缴款，却出现迟缴的纪录，如果有任何错误、您有权向信用纪录公司提出证明，要求更正。信用报告上出现错误，可能导致您付出比别人高的贷款利率，甚至造成银行拒绝您的贷款申请。 不好的信用纪录会导致银行给贷款者较高的贷款利率，因为对银行来说，贷款者的信用价值(Creditworthiness)较低、风险比较高。银行是如何评估贷款者的信用价值及风险呢? 除了信用报告内容外，银行通常还会使用信用评分来做决策。决定信用评分的公式有几种，但是大部分的贷款银行使用一套称作FICO的公式，它的分数范围介于300-850之间，分数越高代表信用越好，要提高您的信用分数是有方法的。 改善自己的信用纪录及分数，才不会在购屋时比别人付出更高的贷款利率。如果您有任何房地产方面的问题，非常欢迎您打电话到我的专线 (480) 612-4545 或 email至 Rich@RichLiao.com
72f8900cec83716c0bab0c085e36d69e9d3b562a.translatedText: Each person can get a free credit report once a year. The credit score system is an important basis for measuring personal credit worthiness. The lender's credit report and score play a large factor in whether a bank is willing to lend to a home buyer. Therefore, it is best to check your own credit report before applying for a loan. According to the Fair and Accurate Credit Transactions Act, everyone can get their own credit report for free once a year. This report is provided by three major credit record companies: Equifax, Experian and TransUnion. The easiest way is to go online to AnnualCreditReport.com to apply for free. After getting the credit report, please check in detail whether your personal information is correct, such as: name, address, age, etc.; whether there are any unknown accounts, such as: credit card accounts, loan accounts, etc. that you do not hold, and whether there are any accounts where you pay on time every period but have a record of late payment. If there are any errors, you have the right to submit proof to the credit record company and request corrections. Errors on your credit report may cause you to pay a higher loan interest rate than others, or even cause the bank to reject your loan application. A bad credit record will cause the bank to give the borrower a higher loan interest rate, because to the bank, the borrower's creditworthiness is low and the risk is relatively high. How do banks evaluate the credit worthiness and risk of borrowers? In addition to the content of credit reports, banks usually use credit scores to make decisions. There are several formulas for determining credit scores, but most lending banks use a formula called FICO. Its score range is between 300-850. The higher the score, the better the credit. There are ways to improve your credit score. Improve your credit history and score so that you won't pay a higher loan interest rate than others when buying a house. If you have any questions about real estate, you are very welcome to call my hotline (480) 612-4545 or email to Rich@RichLiao.com

1296df4fc6d262a00c505aa73e877e03dfa0ea2b.translatedText: Lecture topic: Main problems and solutions in English reading and writing for children in Chinese families

6e044367b5a0ddf8178394bff6626ddc44e36ec0.sourceText: 讲座内容：一、教育专家帮您分析华人家庭孩子们在阅读与写作方面存在的问题；二、家长如何帮助孩子们选择阅读材料；推荐应该为孩子订阅的报刊杂志；三、怎么培养孩子良好的阅读习惯，如何让孩子们享受阅读的乐趣。
6e044367b5a0ddf8178394bff6626ddc44e36ec0.translatedText: Lecture content: 1. Education experts help you analyze the problems existing in reading and writing for children in Chinese families; 2. How parents can help their children choose reading materials; recommend newspapers and magazines that children should subscribe to; 3. How to cultivate good reading habits in children and how to let children enjoy the pleasure of reading.

fe59efcfe601a3f771633c6fb41b22ab95ed42e1.sourceText: 主讲人：仝校长。仝校长的全名是Dr. Fawzia Mai Tung，因为她曾经开办过一家私立学校，并任校长，所以在亚利桑那州的华人社区，大家习惯称呼她为仝校长。她是教育学博士，也是语言天才。她精通中文、英语、法语及阿拉伯语等多门语言。她有七个孩子们，全部都是自己在家教学，个个成绩优异，年纪大的几个孩子分别获得多个博士学位。
fe59efcfe601a3f771633c6fb41b22ab95ed42e1.translatedText: Speaker: Principal Tong. The full name of the principal is Dr. Fawzia Mai Tung. Because she once opened a private school and served as the principal, everyone in the Chinese community in Arizona is accustomed to calling her the principal. She has a doctorate in education and is also a language genius. She is fluent in Chinese, English, French and Arabic and other languages. She has seven children, all of whom are taught at home, and all of them have excellent grades. The older children have obtained multiple doctorates.

34e0a9bf1d42b4676dcd84c69019b62d5528186e.sourceText: 仝校长在新东方艺术学校开设了英文阅读写作课，教授2到12年级英文阅读写作和SAT英文阅读写作。半年来，仝校长使用自己独创的十次课教学法，效果显著，经她培训的孩子，其英文阅读与写作水平都有很大提高。
34e0a9bf1d42b4676dcd84c69019b62d5528186e.translatedText: Together with the principal, he opened an English reading and writing class at New Oriental Art School, teaching English reading and writing and SAT English reading and writing to grades 2 to 12. In the past six months, Principal Tong has used her own original ten-class teaching method, which has achieved remarkable results. The English reading and writing levels of the children she trained have greatly improved.

ad980e4001f1d849d0542ce088ef75489cbd2da9.sourceText: 在英文阅读与写作的常规教学中，基本上以三种体裁为主：记叙文、说明文、议论文。记叙文是基础，小孩子们都是从读写记叙文开始的。这半年来，仝校长的教学重点是记叙文的写作，跟她学习的孩子，在记叙文写作上进步很大。接下来她将以说明文的阅读写作为教学重点。我们的大多数孩子们最终将用到的是议论文的写作。SAT阅读与写作的考核重点是议论文。如果孩子们将来的专业是理工科方向，那么学会科普类文章的写作就显得很重要了。
ad980e4001f1d849d0542ce088ef75489cbd2da9.translatedText: In the conventional teaching of English reading and writing, three genres are basically used: narrative, expository, and argumentative. Narratives are the foundation, and children start by reading and writing narratives. In the past six months, the principal's teaching focus has been on narrative writing, and the children who studied with her have made great progress in narrative writing. Next, she will focus on reading and writing expository texts. What most of our children will eventually use is argumentative writing. The SAT reading and writing assessment focuses on argumentative essays. If the children's future major is science and engineering, then it is very important to learn how to write popular science articles.

f07945f14d9af1cf0254ff9e1c172e79b8dc1bf7.sourceText: 阅读是写作的前基础，要想作文写作好，平时一定要多阅读。仝校长通过多年的教学发现，孩子们平时的阅读多以小说为主，很少阅读科普类文章和议论文，导致孩子们写作文时编故事的能力都很强，但说明文与议论文的阅读与写作能力相对较弱。那么，我们的家长该如何为孩子选择阅读材料呢？家庭订阅什么样的报刊杂志，家长该怎么带领孩子们一起阅读呢？本次讲座中，教育专家仝校长将和您一起分享她的经验。
f07945f14d9af1cf0254ff9e1c172e79b8dc1bf7.translatedText: Reading is the foundation for writing. If you want to write well, you must read more. Through many years of teaching, the principal discovered that children usually read mostly novels and rarely read popular science articles and argumentative essays. As a result, children are very capable of making up stories when writing essays, but their reading and writing skills of expository essays and argumentative essays are relatively weak. So, how should our parents choose reading materials for our children? What kind of newspapers and magazines should families subscribe to, and how should parents lead their children to read together? In this lecture, an education expert and principal will share her experience with you.

4b9ffe4c278c74ce94ba3c096e474d23efc7680d.sourceText: —–参加希望中文学校2014年秋季亲子运动会有感
4b9ffe4c278c74ce94ba3c096e474d23efc7680d.translatedText: ——–Feelings about participating in the 2014 Autumn Parent-Child Sports Meet of Hope Chinese School

8af68a6ec8eb9029e9b5fb1f640cd5e588a3d7ab.sourceText: 2014年10月18日，星期天，我应邀参加希望中文学校在Chandler的Tumbleweed Park举行的秋季亲子运动会。 酷暑已消，秋凉宜人，那天阳光和煦，蓝天无云。学校有关人员早早在大棚下支起炉架烧烤，随着一阵阵烤肉飘香时，长桌上已摆放好大家带来的百家美味饭菜，准备工作有條不絮地进行着。远处传来一阵阵孩子们的嘻闹声，那是学校特意租来的 Bounce House 和棉花糖机，为的就是让孩子们尽情享受这季节的一番盛情，看得出学校为此颇费心思。
8af68a6ec8eb9029e9b5fb1f640cd5e588a3d7ab.translatedText: On Sunday, October 18, 2014, I was invited to participate in the Autumn Parent-Child Sports Meet held by Hope Chinese School at Tumbleweed Park in Chandler. The scorching heat has gone, autumn is pleasantly cool, the sun is warm that day, and the sky is blue and cloudless. Relevant personnel of the school set up a barbecue under the greenhouse early. As the aroma of barbecue came, hundreds of delicious meals brought by everyone were placed on the long table, and the preparations were carried out in an orderly manner. There were bursts of children's laughter in the distance. It was the Bounce House and the cotton candy machine that the school had specially rented in order to let the children enjoy the hospitality of this season. It was obvious that the school had put a lot of thought into this.

2d6a571a14c19e8e8f83cc87c01d6849d465c324.sourceText: 午餐后，多种多样的比赛、游戏开始，家长们和孩子们同乐，老师们在一旁协助，好多家庭三代出动，其乐融融。在我看来举办亲子活动，帮助家长营造与孩子间的交流，增进家长及孩子间亲情，家庭与家庭间的感情，提高孩子的综合能力，更好地发展孩子的社会交往能力，也是学校策划此次活动别有用心之处。 作为一所民办周末中文学校，现有近400多名学生，希望中文学校也面临各种挑战，承受各种压力。田琳校长对我说过这样一句让我印象深刻的话：”学校需要宣传，让更多的人认识它，了解它，但更重要的，也是根本的，就是要切实提高教学质量，这样才能提高我们的竞争力。”我想，希望正是这样踏踏实实地干，各项工作也井然有序地进行。周青董事长和董事们，积极支持、配合田校长，运动会上，那种欢乐祥和，欣欣向荣的气氛再次体现了学校领导集体的团结和干练。 午餐时，同桌对面坐着李健先生、董斌先生。我在媒体上多次看到李、董二位的大名，这次幸会，一见如故。在近距离接触中，寡言的李健显得稳重老成，健谈的董斌真是精力充沛。孙宏伟先生我以前见过，这次重逢分外高兴。他为人热心、随和，脸上永远挂着笑容，和我中年时很相像。 我总的感觉，希望中文学校全校师生、家长、管理层，加上义工，同心同德，团结一致，气氛融洽，关系和谐，充满正能量。 本学期希望中文学校开办公益性的成人英语班，聘请在中美两国有丰富教学经验的余老师(DennisYee）任教。余太太（阮蔼明，NormaYee)每次都陪同余老师一起来，上课时做些教辅工作。余老师夫妇，作为嘉宾前来观看运动会。 记得余老师第一次上课前，作自我介绍。他早年加入美国空军，他的姐夫还是二次大战时帮助中国抗击日本侵略者的空军飞虎队队员，曾击落三架日机。余太太的父亲，也是飞虎队队员，曾驻扎在缅甸，余太太就是在缅甸出生的。说到这里，教室里响起热烈的掌声，表示对英雄空军世家的崇高敬意。 余老师夫妇与学校真是有缘。1995年8月19日，星期六，下午二时，坦佩中文学校成立大会暨开学典礼在Tempe的Edna Vihel Activity Center的Community Room 开始。几十年如一日热心帮助、照顾中国留学生的余太太，是嘉宾，她还在大会上发言。 十九年后，我们再次相遇，余太太还几次带着感恩之心对我说：”我那时不懂汉语拼音，就是到你们学校来旁听，学会了汉语拼音，你唐校长不收我学费。”现在她先生余老师来学校义务教成人英语班，这件事传为美谈。
2d6a571a14c19e8e8f83cc87c01d6849d465c324.translatedText: After lunch, various competitions and games began. Parents and children had fun together, with teachers assisting. Many families had three generations participating and had a great time. In my opinion, organizing parent-child activities can help parents create communication with their children, enhance the affection between parents and children, and the relationship between families, improve children's comprehensive abilities, and better develop children's social interaction skills. This is also the school's ulterior motive in planning this activity. As a private weekend Chinese school with nearly 400 students, Hope Chinese School also faces various challenges and endures various pressures. Principal Tian Lin said something to me that impressed me deeply: "The school needs publicity to let more people know and understand it, but more importantly and fundamental, it is to effectively improve the quality of teaching, so as to improve our competitiveness." I think, I hope that it is in this way that we can work down-to-earth and all the work can be carried out in an orderly manner. Chairman Zhou Qing and the directors actively supported and cooperated with Principal Tian. The joyful, peaceful and prosperous atmosphere at the sports meeting once again reflected the unity and competence of the school leadership. During lunch, Mr. Li Jian and Mr. Dong Bin sat across the table. I have seen the names of Li and Dong in the media many times. It was a pleasure to meet them this time and we felt like old friends at first sight. In close contact, the taciturn Li Jian seemed steady and mature, while the talkative Dong Bin was really full of energy. I have met Mr. Sun Hongwei before, and I am particularly happy to meet him again this time. He is warm-hearted, easy-going, and always has a smile on his face. He is very similar to me in middle age. I generally feel that I hope that all the teachers, students, parents, management, and volunteers of the Chinese school will work together as one, be united, have a harmonious atmosphere, harmonious relationships, and be full of positive energy. This semester, we hope that the Chinese school will open a non-profit adult English class and hire Dennis Yee, who has rich teaching experience in China and the United States, to teach. Mrs. Yu (Norma Yee) comes with Teacher Yu every time and does some teaching assistant work during class. Teacher Yu and his wife came to watch the sports meeting as guests. I remember that Teacher Yu introduced herself before her first class. He joined the U.S. Air Force in his early years. His brother-in-law was also a member of the Air Force Flying Tigers who helped China fight against the Japanese invaders during World War II and shot down three Japanese planes. Mrs. Yu’s father was also a member of the Flying Tigers and was stationed in Myanmar. Mrs. Yu was born in Myanmar. At this point, warm applause broke out in the classroom, expressing high respect for the heroic Air Force family. Teacher Yu and his wife are really connected to the school. At 2:00 pm on Saturday, August 19, 1995, the founding meeting and opening ceremony of Tempe Chinese School began in the Community Room of the Edna Vihel Activity Center in Tempe. Mrs. Yu, who has been enthusiastically helping and caring for Chinese students for decades, was a guest of honor and also spoke at the conference. Nineteen years later, we met again, and Mrs. Yu said to me several times with gratitude: "I didn't know Chinese Pinyin at that time, so I came to your school to audit and learned Chinese Pinyin. You, Principal Tang, didn't charge me tuition." Now her husband, Mr. Yu, comes to the school to teach adult English classes on a voluntary basis, and this incident has become a good story.

e9bfc4cb2329d809ef556a9cb9bd3258ceca7cec.sourceText: （综合报导）在宾夕法尼亚州的选举集会上，美国总统唐纳德.特朗普呼吁为毒品犯罪增加死刑选项。他说，因为可以给毒贩判处死刑，中国和新加坡的毒品问题比美国少的多。
e9bfc4cb2329d809ef556a9cb9bd3258ceca7cec.translatedText: (Comprehensive Report) At an election rally in Pennsylvania, US President Donald Trump called for adding the death penalty option for drug crimes. He said that because drug dealers can be sentenced to death, China and Singapore have much less drug problems than the United States.

0c018dac1787f55eaa0d069c4f4ad84d2a24492e.sourceText: 据美国《政治事实》新闻网14日报道，特朗普在日前参加一个宾夕法尼亚州的竞选集会时呼吁，给毒贩增加死刑选项。他说：「解决毒品问题的唯一途径就是强硬。」
0c018dac1787f55eaa0d069c4f4ad84d2a24492e.translatedText: According to the US "Political Facts" news network reported on the 14th, Trump recently called for adding the death penalty option to drug dealers when attending a campaign rally in Pennsylvania. He said: "The only way to solve the drug problem is to be tough."

19515847219d9b538233c05e647821cea0ee6982.sourceText: 他表示，去年他访问中国和新加坡的时候，他曾经与中国和新加坡领导人谈论过禁毒问题。他说，给毒贩增加死刑选项的主意来源于这两个国家。他在去年访问中国的时候，瞭解到中国的毒品犯罪处罚措施，其中就包括死刑，特朗普认为死刑可以有效帮助中国震慑并治理毒品犯罪。
19515847219d9b538233c05e647821cea0ee6982.translatedText: He said that when he visited China and Singapore last year, he had discussed the anti-drug issue with the leaders of China and Singapore. He said the idea to add the death penalty option to drug traffickers came from those two countries. When he visited China last year, he learned about China's punishment measures for drug crimes, including the death penalty. Trump believes that the death penalty can effectively help China deter and control drug crimes.

97b11350047af99208ce15d58cd7f3607d96946a.sourceText: 特朗普最后说到:「一些国家有非常非常严厉的惩罚措施，有死刑。顺便说一句，他们的毒品问题比我们少的多！」
97b11350047af99208ce15d58cd7f3607d96946a.translatedText: Trump finally said: "Some countries have very, very severe punitive measures, including the death penalty. By the way, they have much less drug problems than we do!"

3db5a1ff2f81d10e11eba3d5ee68f3cd2e5f5b77.sourceText: 在提到新加坡的毒品问题时，他则表示：「在新加坡，我问总理先生，你们国家有毒品问题吗？李显龙说，不，我们没有任何毒品问题。我需要确定他这个『没有任何问题』是不是开玩笑，于是我问他，一点毒品问题也没有吗？新加坡总理说，他们对毒品问题零容忍，任何贩毒到新加坡的人都会被处以死刑！」
3db5a1ff2f81d10e11eba3d5ee68f3cd2e5f5b77.translatedText: When referring to Singapore's drug problem, he said: "In Singapore, I asked Mr. Prime Minister, does your country have a drug problem? Lee Hsien Loong said, no, we don't have any drug problem. . I needed to make sure that he was joking when he said "there is no problem", so I asked him, is there no drug problem at all? The Prime Minister of Singapore said that they have zero tolerance for drug problems, and anyone who traffics drugs into Singapore will be sentenced to death! "

5f0ca2a7cfcd5f0aece045d54e265d1dab654fcf.sourceText: 至于特朗普是否真的会为贩毒设立死刑这件事儿，特朗普表示，他不确定美国人民是否会接受如此严厉的惩罚。但是他说毒贩们正在摧毁家庭。
5f0ca2a7cfcd5f0aece045d54e265d1dab654fcf.translatedText: As for whether Trump will really establish the death penalty for drug trafficking, Trump said that he is not sure whether the American people will accept such a severe punishment. But he said drug dealers are destroying families.

ea095a379ef7f692e8dce3f4c0027999f94e184e.sourceText: 「很多州，你会因为杀一个人而获得死刑，而一个毒贩，在他贩毒的一生里头，他会杀掉几千个，三千个五千个人，毁掉几千个家庭，我们能把毒贩怎么样？关上30天！甚至不去抓他！我们不能再闹着玩了，这就是我们有问题的原因！我们必须要付诸行动！」他在集会上表示。
ea095a379ef7f692e8dce3f4c0027999f94e184e.translatedText: "In many states, you will get the death penalty for killing one person, but a drug dealer, in his life of selling drugs, will kill thousands, three thousand to five thousand people, and destroy thousands of families. What can we do to the drug dealer? Lock him up for 30 days! Don't even catch him! We can't play around anymore, that's why we have a problem! We must take action!" he said at the rally.

52e9cbcd2cb9b06334272b4e728184529b7e556d.sourceText: 据《华盛顿邮报》报道，他要求给毒贩判处死刑的呼吁得到了当晚最热烈的欢呼。在特朗普谈到中国和新加坡的毒品死刑政策时，数十人点头表示同意。「我们爱特朗普！」一个男人喊道。一个女人大声喊道:「立刻通过死刑!」
52e9cbcd2cb9b06334272b4e728184529b7e556d.translatedText: His call for the death penalty for drug dealers received the loudest cheers of the night, the Washington Post reported. Dozens of people nodded in agreement when Trump spoke of China and Singapore's drug death penalty policies. "We love Trump!" one man shouted. A woman shouted: "Pass the death penalty immediately!"

483a02514ec461b4ef9cfb6270bd4691a074582d.sourceText: 特朗普说:「我们不能只是一直依靠蓝丝带委员会（负责法律制定和修改的参议院委员会），他们只会说不会做。我们需要做点什么！」
483a02514ec461b4ef9cfb6270bd4691a074582d.translatedText: Trump said: "We can't just keep relying on the Blue Ribbon Committee (the Senate committee responsible for formulating and amending laws). They will only say they will not do it. We need to do something!"

be8c34454896d03c49f90fb2b6b32ed8dc24dd31.sourceText: 此前特朗普也想过对毒贩实施更严厉的制裁。在他发表这些讲话不到两周前，特朗普提出了美国需要增加针对毒贩的「非常强硬」的惩罚措施，以帮助解决日益严重的阿片类药物成瘾问题。
be8c34454896d03c49f90fb2b6b32ed8dc24dd31.translatedText: Trump has also thought about imposing tougher sanctions on drug traffickers before. His remarks came less than two weeks after Trump laid out the need for the United States to increase "very tough" penalties against drug traffickers to help address the growing opioid addiction problem.

240ffbd15c8757fb1e938350e244f988d54497c2.sourceText: 不过不是所有人都支持特朗普立法为毒贩增加死刑，《政治事实》反驳了特朗普给毒贩判处死刑的言论。
240ffbd15c8757fb1e938350e244f988d54497c2.translatedText: However, not everyone supports Trump’s legislation to increase the death penalty for drug dealers. “Political Fact” refuted Trump’s remarks on imposing the death penalty on drug dealers.

27e43def9b7d754d8acb66559829a5c8ffc6fc1e.sourceText: 该网站文章表示，由于美国宪法规定「只有夺取他人性命」的犯罪才能被判处死刑，因此尚不清楚法律界会如何判定贩毒犯罪是否符合「夺取他人性命」的犯罪。该网站表示，如果特朗普强行通过针对贩毒犯罪的死刑，可能会造成「违宪」。
27e43def9b7d754d8acb66559829a5c8ffc6fc1e.translatedText: The website article stated that since the U.S. Constitution stipulates that "only crimes that take another person's life" can be punished with the death penalty, it is unclear how the legal profession will determine whether drug trafficking crimes qualify as "taking another person's life." The website stated that if Trump imposes the death penalty for drug trafficking crimes, it may be "unconstitutional."

ca98db67db77aafef4162689fa480eae29e20879.sourceText: 美国吸毒人数目前成上升趋势，美国疾病防控中心2015年发佈报告称，从2002年到2013年，美国12岁以上的人群中，吸食过海洛因的人数增长了63%，死亡人数增加3倍。2013年，约有51.7万美国人称在过去一年内吸食过海洛因，8257人吸食过量致死。美国依然是世界上最大的毒品消费国家，消费了世界上60%的毒品。
ca98db67db77aafef4162689fa480eae29e20879.translatedText: The number of drug addicts in the United States is currently on the rise. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention released a report in 2015 stating that from 2002 to 2013, the number of people over the age of 12 in the United States who have smoked heroin increased by 63%, and the number of deaths tripled. In 2013, approximately 517,000 Americans reported using heroin in the past year, and 8,257 people overdosed and died. The United States is still the world's largest drug consumer, consuming 60% of the world's drugs.

7f31fc2cd02e8673f979406424b1aa59f5c25f42.sourceText: 威力球得主匿名领奖 （亚省时报） 本州岛奖券局官员7日宣布，11月28日开奖、奖金5亿8750万元的「劲球奖」(Powerball)第二位中奖人已经出面，是一位30多岁的已婚男子，住在喷泉山。但是这名幸运儿不愿身分曝光，也表示将继续工作。 这名中奖人告诉奖券局官员说，他花了十元购买奖券，并一直把奖券塞在汽车的遮阳板后面。这张中奖奖券是喷泉山的一个便利商店卖出的。 奖券局官员凯伦巴克说，这名男子选择一次领取税前现金1亿9200万元，由于本州岛是夫妻共有财产州，他的妻子也将拥有一半的奖金。这名男子在财务方面非常精明，想要花时间做出可靠的财务计划，并设立一个慈善机构，协助他们夫妻支持的目标。他们也表示将继续工作。 巴克说，这名男子是一位专业人士，过去住在宾州，去年才搬到本州岛，搬到喷泉山后，只买过两次奖券。为了税的问题，他迅速决定在今年领奖，不拖到2013年，因为2013年是否发生财政悬崖的不确定性使他很担忧。 这个历来第二高额的彩券奖金的另一名得主是密苏里州狄尔朋的希尔一家，他们已经领取了一半的奖金。这次的劲球奖造成全美民众疯狂购买，一度达每分钟卖出13万张。 历来最高额的奖券奖金是今年3月开奖的兆彩(Mega Millions)奖金6亿5600万元，由三位中奖人均分。
7f31fc2cd02e8673f979406424b1aa59f5c25f42.translatedText: > The Powerball winner anonymously claimed the prize (Alberta Times) Officials from the Honshu Island Lottery Bureau announced on the 7th that the second winner of the "Powerball" prize of 587.5 million yuan in the November 28 lottery has come forward. He is a married man in his 30s who lives in Fountain Hills. However, the lucky man did not want his identity to be revealed and said he would continue to work. The winner told lottery officials that he spent ten yuan to buy the ticket and kept it tucked away behind the sun visor of his car. The winning ticket was sold at a convenience store in Fountain Hills. Lottery Bureau official Karen Buck said the man chose to receive a lump sum of $192 million in pre-tax cash. Since the island is a community property state, his wife will also own half of the winnings. The man was very financially savvy and wanted to take the time to make a solid financial plan and set up a charity to assist with the goals they supported as a couple. They also said they would continue to work. Buck said the man was a professional who used to live in Pennsylvania and moved to the state island last year. After moving to Fountain Hill, he only bought lottery tickets twice. For tax reasons, he quickly decided to accept the award this year instead of waiting until 2013, because the uncertainty of whether a fiscal cliff would occur in 2013 worried him. Another winner of the second-largest lottery jackpot ever is the Hill family of Dearborn, Missouri, who have already claimed half of their prize. This time, the Powerball Awards caused people across the United States to go crazy buying, and at one time, 130,000 tickets were sold every minute. The largest lottery prize ever was the Mega Millions prize of $656 million drawn in March this year, which was shared equally among three winners.

86063ce126bde7d72dba4b842c65b5979178635b.sourceText: 斐匿余风采堂郊游活动参加人数二百余人，热闹空前 亚省时报记者纳兰摄影报导： 十一月四日中午，秋高气爽，风和日丽，每年一度的余风采堂郊游活动在凤凰城中心街的Margaret Hance Park举行，当日参加郊游的人数二百余人，为历年人数最多，热闹空前。余氏郊游目的，对内是联络宗亲，对外是团结侨社。在斐匿余风采堂元老、资深侨领余文劲的领导及全体职员的努力下，斐匿余风采堂的会务不断发展壮大，余氏郊游不仅仅是代表余氏宗亲的活动了，而是侨社中彼此联络感情，加强团结的一项有意义的活动。此次热心参加活动的侨团首长有：亚省众议员余艳芬， 资深侨领邓朝驹，侨联主席张华芳，副主席崔增祁，科工专会长徐强，黄氏宗亲会主席黄振捷，亚省华商会主席伍兆文，华人耆英会主席邓情芬，英端分会主席黄定邦夫人，邓高密公所副主席邓贺铮，龙冈公所顾问关锡樵，亚省华文笔会副主席邝添权，开平同乡会名誉顾问胡寿柏，华裔退伍军人会总指挥邓兆麟，同源会副会长甄艺文，亚省时报总编辑邓凌等。 当日的午餐除了现场烧烤的香肠、汉堡牛肉、火鸡肉，炸鸡，炒面等等之外，还有最具特色的由余氏婶母们自制的糕点，这些家乡特色的Home Made糕点有钱也买不到，这也是每一次余氏活动中最吸引我的亮点之一。 午餐后是丰富礼物的抽奖活动，礼物之多，可谓人人有份，永不落空。奖品都是与柴米油盐分不开的油、糖、饼干、洗衣用品、家庭用品等等，实用性强，逗得个个笑颜逐开，郊游活动中，每人获得一张价值五元的”日本公园”免费入门券，日本公园就在郊游场地的旁边，一个绿化建设很不错的公园，内有很多漂亮的大锦鲤，以及小型瀑布，令人赏心悦目。 这次郊游活动令大家渡过一个非常Happy的周日，并留下了深刻的印象，希望明年再聚！
86063ce126bde7d72dba4b842c65b5979178635b.translatedText: More than 200 people were participating in the outing at Fei Niyu Fengcai Hall, and it was unprecedentedly lively. Photo report by Alberta Times reporter Nalan: At noon on November 4th, the autumn air was crisp and the wind was sunny. The annual Yufengcaitang outing was held at Margaret Hance Park on Center Street in Phoenix. More than 200 people participated in the outing that day, the largest number in history, and the excitement was unprecedented. The purpose of Yu's outing was to connect with family members internally and to unite the overseas Chinese community externally. Under the leadership of Fei Niyu Fengcai Hall and senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin and the efforts of all staff, Fei Niyu Fengcai Hall has continued to grow and develop. The Yu family outing is not only an activity on behalf of the Yu family, but also a meaningful activity for the overseas Chinese community to connect with each other and strengthen unity. The leaders of the overseas Chinese delegation who enthusiastically participated in the event include: Alberta House of Representatives Yu Yanfen; Senior overseas Chinese leader Deng Chaoju, Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Zhang Huafang, Vice Chairman Cui Zengqi, Chairman of the Science and Industry Association Xu Qiang, Chairman of the Huang Clan Association Huang Zhenjie, Chairman of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Alberta Wu Zhaowen, Chairman of the Chinese Seniors Association Deng Qingfen, Yingduan Branch Chairman Mrs. Huang Dingbang, Deng Gaomi Vice Chairman of the Office Deng Hezheng, Longgang Office Consultant Guan Xiqiao, Vice Chairman of the Chinese PEN Association of Alberta Kuang Tianquan, Honorary Advisor of the Kaiping Association Hu Shoubai, General Director of the Chinese Veterans Association Deng Zhaolin, Vice President of the Tongyuan Association Zhen Yiwen, Editor-in-Chief of the Alberta Times Deng Ling, etc. In addition to the on-site grilled sausages, hamburger beef, turkey, fried chicken, fried noodles, etc., the lunch that day also had the most unique pastries homemade by Yu’s aunts. These home-made pastries with hometown characteristics cannot be bought even if you have money. This is one of the highlights that attracts me most in every Yu’s event. After lunch, there is a lottery with abundant gifts. There are so many gifts that everyone has a share and never fails. The prizes are oil, sugar, biscuits, laundry supplies, household items, etc. that are inseparable from firewood, rice, oil, and salt. They are very practical and make everyone smile. During the outing, everyone received a free entrance ticket to the "Japanese Park" worth five yuan. The Japanese Park is next to the outing venue. It is a park with good green construction. There are many beautiful large koi carp and small waterfalls, which are pleasing to the eye. This outing made everyone have a very happy Sunday and left a deep impression. We hope to meet again next year!

576eb9ef5ffae367e326437987f3bd3e4268aafa.sourceText: 尊師重道 – 學生代聯會出奇招 鳳凰城中文學校慶祝教師節（图） （郑弘报导） 九月二十八日是孔子誕辰紀念日也是台灣的教師節。承襲尊師重道的優良傳統，鳳凰城中文學校 學生代聯會在會長 文及恩 和指導老師 楊儉樂 (及恩的媽媽)的策劃下, 在教師節前夕給學校全體老師一個溫馨的驚喜。九月二十五日放學後, 所有老師被請到學校辦公室享用由”热心媽媽團” 準 備的多樣精美台灣小吃。隨即在指導老師 楊儉樂 和校長 程秀玲 女士的引言下, 學生代聯會會長 文及恩與 代聯會幹部向老師們獻上教師節的祝福, 感謝老師們對學生和學校的付出。接著, 在 文 爸爸的操作下投影機開始放映由代聯會同學們花了三個多禮拜攝製剪輯的溫馨短片。影片中搜集了各班小朋友和家長感謝老師的錄影。純真的訊息加上輕快的配樂(周杰倫聽”媽媽”的話), 感動了所有的人。播放結束, 學生代聯會送給每位老師一份包裝精美的禮物其中包涵了謝師短片的光碟。孩子的真情和創意讓老師們渡過了一個難忘的教師節。指導老師 楊儉樂 表示學生代聯會利用兩個週日的時間，每人負責錄製兩班學生的錄影工作，再從中文學校的照片檔案當中找出老師們上課的照片，接著進行編排、配樂、剪接等工作,雖然花了很多時間去製作這個DVD，但他們都很高興能為老師們盡一點心意，以感謝老師們對所有學生的付出。代聯會能製作出這麼溫馨感人的DVD是靠著全校家長與學生的通力合作。加入鳳凰城中文學校大家庭請與校長 程秀玲 聯絡(480-620-1982) ( http://clsphoenix.org/ )。觀賞謝師短片請至 http://JEFFJENQ.zenfolio.com/p82062284 人氣王校長 程秀玲 幽默開場 學生代聯會郭柏邑, 陳意陞, 田緒荊, 吳易霖, 文及恩 老師們笑開懷
576eb9ef5ffae367e326437987f3bd3e4268aafa.translatedText: Respecting teachers and respecting moral principles – Student Representative Association’s surprising move Phoenix Chinese School celebrates Teachers’ Day (photo) (reported by Zheng Hong) September 28th is the anniversary of the birth of Confucius and is also Taiwan’s Teachers’ Day. Adhering to the fine tradition of respecting teachers, Phoenix Chinese School Student Representative Association, under the planning of the president Wen Ji'en and the instructor Yang Jianle (Ji'en's mother), gave all the school teachers a warm surprise on the eve of Teacher's Day. After school on September 25, all teachers were invited to the school office to enjoy a variety of exquisite Taiwanese snacks prepared by the "enthusiastic mothers group". Immediately after the introduction by the instructor Yang Jianle and the principal Ms. Cheng Xiuling, the President of the Student Representative Association Wen Ji'en and the cadres of the Student Representative Association presented Teacher's Day blessings to the teachers and thanked the teachers for their dedication to the students and the school. Then, under the operation of Wen’s father, the projector began to show the heart-warming short film that the students from the Generation Association spent more than three weeks filming and editing. The video collects videos of children and parents from each class thanking their teachers. The innocent message coupled with the brisk soundtrack (Jay Chou listened to "Mom") touched everyone. At the end of the broadcast, the Student Representative Association gave each teacher a beautifully wrapped gift, which included a CD containing a short video of thanking the teacher. The children's sincerity and creativity made the teachers spend an unforgettable Teacher's Day. Instructor Yang Jianle said that the Student Representative Association spent two Sundays, each person was responsible for recording two classes of students, and then found the photos of the teachers in class from the photo archives of the Chinese school, and then arranged, scored, edited and other work. Although it took a lot of time to make this DVD, they were very happy to do something for the teachers to thank the teachers for their dedication to all students. The Generation Association was able to produce such a heartwarming and touching DVD because of the cooperation of parents and students throughout the school. To join the Phoenix Chinese School family, please contact the principal, Cheng Xiuling (480-620-1982) ( http://clsphoenix.org/ ). 7591b403fa787ccd40620b23d114203e5814a8ce.sourceText: 凤凰城消防队援助纽约灾后重建 （亚省时报） 二十名凤凰城的警察和消防队员周一被派遣到纽约市，以帮助其在飓风后重建。 飓风过去已两周，纽约长岛十多万居民仍处于断电状态，大批灾民仍在临时避难中心留宿，民生怨道。纽约市官员向全国危险事件管理团队发出求助信息，官员称，纽约在飓风后急需超过5000件设备，包括发电机，自卸卡车和叉车等，用以清除被大风刮倒的建筑物和大树。 凤凰城援救队预计在纽约逗留两星期，驻扎在皇后区的花旗球场，帮助该区灾后重建。
7591b403fa787ccd40620b23d114203e5814a8ce.translatedText: Phoenix Fire Department assisted in New York's post-disaster reconstruction (Alberta Times) Twenty Phoenix police and firefighters were dispatched to New York City on Monday to help it rebuild after the hurricane. Two weeks after the hurricane, more than 100,000 residents in Long Island, New York, are still without power. A large number of victims are still staying in temporary evacuation centers, and people are complaining about their livelihood. New York City officials sent a message to the National Hazardous Incident Management Team for help. Officials said New York urgently needed more than 5,000 pieces of equipment after the hurricane, including generators, dump trucks and forklifts to clear buildings and trees blown down by strong winds. The Phoenix rescue team is expected to stay in New York for two weeks, stationed at Citi Field in Queens, to help with the area's post-disaster reconstruction.

701002758bb77148f1c500525ff3f717c4eea132.translatedText: >A Peoria woman faces a felony charge of animal cruelty on February 6. Her dog, a tabby pit bull mix, chewed half of his right leg short.

04443f7179ba74f1deea8139b37560c0d6becfee.sourceText: 皮奥里亚的警察署接到一个匿名举报后，动物管制人员的联系米歇尔， 22 岁，投诉她，没有让狗”卡梅拉”得到应该的医疗照顾。
04443f7179ba74f1deea8139b37560c0d6becfee.translatedText: Animal control officers contacted Michelle, 22, after the Peoria Police Department received an anonymous tip complaining that she was not getting her dog, Carmela, the medical attention she deserved.

be26fc4bed3be00af17eeeedccc050bda3e4d464.sourceText: 警方说，主人告诉他狗卡梅拉受伤了，大约一年前狗被车撞了。
be26fc4bed3be00af17eeeedccc050bda3e4d464.translatedText: Police said the owner told him the dog Carmela was injured after the dog was hit by a car about a year ago.

d97870b2eb362348e2bb7ecba819a7297ededc7b.sourceText: 当了官审查卡梅拉，右前腿的下半部分已经掉了，裸露着骨和肉，被感染。卡梅拉被留下了血腥的标志。
d97870b2eb362348e2bb7ecba819a7297ededc7b.translatedText: When the official examined Carmela, the lower part of her right front leg had fallen off, exposing the bones and flesh, and was infected. Carmella was left with a bloody mark.

a415c3cb6a472f34dd452e2f0e00ca255d661111.sourceText: 尽管由兽医提供了付款计划，主人米歇尔仍然没有對狗的损伤进行治疗。她也没有选择卡梅拉人道安乐死结束了长期的痛苦。
a415c3cb6a472f34dd452e2f0e00ca255d661111.translatedText: Despite being offered a payment plan by the veterinarian, owner Michelle failed to treat the dog's injuries. She also chose Carmela Humane Euthanasia to end her long suffering.

acc9f8a929dc63ba7c67395ec0df283bc0ba04b6.sourceText: 警方说，皮奥里亚的动物控制局交出她的狗。狗在的皮奥里亚紧急动物诊所被照顾。她后来被转移到亚利桑那州动物保护协会，兽医对狗进行手术。手术后太阳谷的动物收容所为卡梅拉提供了护理。
acc9f8a929dc63ba7c67395ec0df283bc0ba04b6.translatedText: Animal Control in Peoria surrendered her dog, police said. The dogs are being cared for at the Peoria Emergency Animal Clinic. She was later transferred to the Arizona Humane Society, where veterinarians performed surgery on the dog. The Animal Shelter in Sun Valley provided care for Carmela after the surgery.

7f0d874b380de5544969b87ca731b94f6962f99b.sourceText: 除了起诉虐待动物，米歇尔还被要求偿还继续为卡梅拉恢复期间的在治疗和护理所产生的费用。
7f0d874b380de5544969b87ca731b94f6962f99b.translatedText: In addition to the animal cruelty prosecution, Michelle is also ordered to repay the costs of continued treatment and care for Carmela while she recovers.

0b339ac4550d28484a2b3a748afa2279d8046a48.sourceText: 卡梅拉已恢复和正在等待被赡养。
0b339ac4550d28484a2b3a748afa2279d8046a48.translatedText: Carmela has recovered and is waiting to be fostered.

c89e6edae3d6467340b3d95019d974edceb9db08.sourceText: 康州枪击案后 州长未确切枪支法是否重定 (亚省时报) 亚利桑那州州长布鲁尔周一发布对康州枪击事件的看法。对在自己签署的亚利桑那州在公共场合携带武器法律是否要重修，她说”不确定”。 布鲁尔称事件”绝对可怕”，”令人心碎”。当被问到亚省是否修订禁枪法时，布鲁尔说，邪恶的人杀人不一定用枪，2001年9月11日那场浩劫，恐怖分子使用了飞机。 相对于枪支管制，州长认为更重要的是学校安全和精神健康。枪支在精神健康的人手里是保护人身和财产安全的武器，在精神不健康人手里就成了杀人凶器。 作为共和党人，布鲁尔不支持禁枪。自2009年上任州长后，布鲁尔已经签署了一系列法案，扩大了亚省人携带枪支权利。包括允许成年人携带隐藏的武器，成年人可以在州签发许可的酒吧或餐馆里随时携带枪支，虽然他们不允许喝酒。近日，布鲁尔还签署了一项法律，允许成年人将武器带在公立社区学院和大学的停车场或车库。
c89e6edae3d6467340b3d95019d974edceb9db08.translatedText: After the Connecticut shooting, the governor did not confirm whether gun laws will be revised (Alberta Times) Arizona Governor Brewer released his views on the Connecticut shooting on Monday. She said she's "not sure" whether Arizona's law on carrying weapons in public, which she signed, will be revised. Brewer called the incident "absolutely horrific" and "heartbreaking." When asked whether Alberta would amend its gun laws, Brewer said evil people do not necessarily use guns to kill people. In the catastrophe of September 11, 2001, terrorists used airplanes. The governor believes school safety and mental health are more important than gun control. In the hands of mentally healthy people, guns are weapons to protect personal and property safety, but in the hands of mentally unhealthy people, they become murder weapons. As a Republican, Brewer does not support gun bans. Since taking office as governor in 2009, Brewer has signed a series of bills expanding Albertans' right to bear arms. Including allowing adults to carry concealed weapons, adults can carry firearms at any time in state-licensed bars or restaurants, although they are not allowed to drink alcohol. Brewer also recently signed a law allowing adults to carry weapons in public community college and university parking lots or garages.

This is a brief training experience that allows citizens to gain a better understanding of police work and learn some basic skills for self-protection. To register, please contact: 623-202-1032 Helen_zhang3@yahoo.com

51b53a5a2ac3718e2357e97a04eedb85efb264a5.sourceText: 内华达州止赎数字连续62个月高居全美第一后，终于被亚省超越。 止赎追踪公司RealtyTrac上週四公佈的数据显示，三月份，全国的指数率都在下降，内华达州下降最多。 本州在三月有近3600家被银行收回，有超过5900位业主收到违约通知，成了全美房地产业重灾区。实际上这数据已经比上一季度下降了4%，比去年同期低41%。 内华达州在二、三月的止赎活动减少了8%，比去年同期下降了近70%。加州保持在全美第三的排名。
51b53a5a2ac3718e2357e97a04eedb85efb264a5.translatedText: After Nevada's foreclosure numbers topped the nation for 62 consecutive months, it was finally surpassed by Alberta. Data released Thursday by foreclosure tracking firm RealtyTrac showed index rates fell across the country in March, with the largest declines in Nevada. In March, nearly 3,600 properties in the state were repossessed by banks, and more than 5,900 property owners received default notices, making it the hardest-hit area for the real estate industry in the United States. In fact, this figure has dropped by 4% from the previous quarter and is 41% lower than the same period last year. Foreclosure activity in Nevada fell by 8% in February and March, and is down nearly 70% from the same period last year. California remains third in the nation.

268b07462c4a7cedd8161dc240530ad32ad9ba2d.sourceText: 七月四日，大鳯凰城侨联成功地举办了一塲庆祝美国国庆日的联欢会。今年与往年不相同，没有了选美，代之以各种娱乐活动和节目表演，办得十分成功。庒严的献旗礼，丰盛美味的食物，精彩的文娱演出，感人的青少年画展和美国梦的征文，还有卡拉Ok、乒乓球 、麻将、书法和孩子们的水球游戏，构筑出温馨祥和的节日气氛。感谢义工们两个多月来付出的宝贵时间和流淌的辛勤汗水。
268b07462c4a7cedd8161dc240530ad32ad9ba2d.translatedText: On July 4th, the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation successfully held a party to celebrate the Fourth of July. This year was different from previous years. There was no beauty pageant. Instead, there were various entertainment activities and performances, which was very successful. Xi Yan’s flag-presenting ceremony, sumptuous and delicious food, wonderful entertainment performances, touching youth art exhibitions and essays on the American Dream, as well as karaoke, table tennis, mahjong, calligraphy and children’s water polo games created a warm and peaceful festival atmosphere. Thank you to the volunteers for their precious time and hard work over the past two months.

d7b1da8c7b62eb703d9dd3c968281e9f4dd98b47.sourceText: 除此之外，我感受最深的是这次庆祝活动促进了大鳯凰城东部和中西部的文化的交融，拉近了相互之间的距离。大鳯凰城地区华人侨社的活动, 大体上分为两个部分。居住在中西部的华人，因为来到美国时间比较长，人们习惯称呼为老侨，每年举办美国国庆选美和年初各社团举办春宴，互祝新年快乐，道新春祝福。居住在东部的华人，大多是近二十多年来移居美国，人们简称为新侨，他们每年举办庆祝中国国庆和中秋的活动，近年来也邀请老侨们参加。，别看这东部和西部只有二十来哩的距离，都是华人，庆祝会的风格却迥然相异。西部庆祝会供应的食品是典型的中歺，围成园桌。主持人一般都讲广东话和英语，表演必自舞狮醒岁开始，歺叙中表演一些传统的戏曲和舞蹈。东部庆祝会的食品一般都是西式歺点，一人一份，边吃边找朋友交谈。主持人一般都讲国语和英文，表演节目以青少年为主，并举办交谊舞会。
d7b1da8c7b62eb703d9dd3c968281e9f4dd98b47.translatedText: In addition, what I felt most deeply was that this celebration promoted the cultural integration between the eastern and central and western parts of Daluohuang City and shortened the distance between them. The activities of the Chinese overseas community in the Daluohuangcheng area are generally divided into two parts. Chinese living in the Midwest are accustomed to being called Laoqiao because they have been in the United States for a relatively long time. Every year, they hold a National Day beauty pageant and various societies hold spring banquets at the beginning of the year to wish each other a happy New Year and New Year blessings. Most of the Chinese living in the east immigrated to the United States in the past 20 years or so. They are simply called Xinqiao. They hold activities to celebrate China's National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival every year. In recent years, they have also invited old overseas Chinese to participate. , even though the distance between the east and west is only about twenty miles, both are Chinese, but the styles of the celebrations are completely different. The food served at Western celebrations is typical Chinese food, served around a garden table. The host usually speaks Cantonese and English, and the performance will start with a lion dance to wake up the new year, and some traditional operas and dances will be performed during the performance. The food at Eastern celebrations is usually Western-style snacks, one for each person, and you can chat with friends while eating. The hosts generally speak Mandarin and English, the performances are mainly for young people, and social dances are held.

b909bedfcd9839226089ec1b94d8b45504181e40.sourceText: 这次侨联筹办美国国庆，从一开始就设定了方便各个方面、各个地区的华人华侨前来参加的方针，也包括欢迎其它族裔的朋友前来。従地点的选择上，改变了过去以方便Phoenix居民为主，放在Down Town的做法, 而是把庆祝地点放在Phoenix 的东部边界，使 Tempe, Mesa, Scossdale 的朋友也能在三、四十分钟的车程内到逹。食品也是中西结合，美国国庆当然少不了热狗和汉堡，再加上中式炒麵炒饭和中西合璧的炸鳮、手撕肉，人人赞不絶口。
b909bedfcd9839226089ec1b94d8b45504181e40.translatedText: This time the Overseas Chinese Federation is organizing the National Day of the United States. From the beginning, it has set a policy to facilitate overseas Chinese from all walks of life and regions to participate, including welcoming friends from other ethnic groups to come. Regarding the choice of location, we changed the past practice of placing it in Down Town mainly for the convenience of Phoenix residents. Instead, we placed the celebration location on the eastern border of Phoenix, so that friends from Tempe, Mesa, and Scossdale can also get there within a 30-40 minute drive. The food is also a combination of Chinese and Western. Of course, hot dogs and hamburgers are indispensable on the National Day of the United States. In addition, Chinese fried noodles and fried rice, as well as Chinese and Western fried anchovies and pulled pork, everyone is full of praise.

e52bd14eebdd037c5f7cb436b0441c036e105bdd.sourceText: 演出的文娱节目也是尽量把方方面面的好节目都容纳进来，採取公开征集的方式，请东部富有舞台组织经验的吕丽华校长和闻琳琳老师进行选定。于是，一台充满活力具有民族特色的表演节目呈现在人们面前。他们不是专业的，不是最精彩的，但却是大家熟悉的，最喜爱的，因为它是我们自己的。这台节目有来自西部的粤曲小调和风𩐳的旗袍秀，也有来自东部久负盛名的中华乐团的民乐合奏和美丽的民族舞蹈；有老年人合唱美丽的阿美利加，也有希望中文学校儿童们的説唱脸谱; 人们沉醉于传统京剧贵妃醉委婉动听的唱腔之中，又被Michael Jackson 那奇妙而难度极髙的舞蹈带进另一个世界；华人基督教会的白衣天使们用他们轻盈的舞姿使演出在髙潮中结束 。这场演出比较全面地反映了大鳯凰城地区华人文化活动的状况，大家互相观摩交流，同台合作演出, 增进了友谊，也拉近了彼此间的距离。
e52bd14eebdd037c5f7cb436b0441c036e105bdd.translatedText: The cultural and entertainment programs performed also try to include all kinds of good programs, and adopt an open collection method. Principal Lu Lihua and teacher Wen Linlin from the east, who are experienced in stage organization, are invited to make selections. As a result, a performance full of vitality and national characteristics was presented to people. They are not professional or the most exciting, but they are familiar and favorite to everyone because they are our own. This program includes Cantonese opera tunes and cheongsam shows from the west, as well as folk music ensembles and beautiful folk dances from the prestigious Chinese orchestra in the east; there are senior citizens singing the beautiful America, and there are also children from Hope Chinese Schools rapping faces; people are immersed in the euphemistic and beautiful singing voice of the traditional Peking Opera Princess, which was also inspired by Michael Jackson The wonderful and extremely difficult dance brought into another world; the angels in white from the Chinese Christian Church ended the performance on a high note with their light dance moves. This performance more comprehensively reflected the status of Chinese cultural activities in the Dahuang City area. Everyone observed and communicated with each other and performed together on the same stage, which enhanced friendship and shortened the distance between each other.

192f792dd485755af0e931755cd9a6026551d3d5.sourceText: 2010年上海世博会中国馆的电子动态版《清明上河图》赴台展出签约仪式5月28日在上海世博局举行。上海世博局副局长黄健之与台湾联合报系经济日报社社长杨仁烽分别在协议书上签字。根据协议，201O年上海世博会中国馆电子动态版《清明上河图》将于7月1日至9月4日在台北花博会的争艳馆展出。
192f792dd485755af0e931755cd9a6026551d3d5.translatedText: The signing ceremony for the electronic dynamic version of "Along the River During the Qingming Festival" to be exhibited in Taiwan at the China Pavilion at the 2010 Shanghai World Expo was held on May 28 at the Shanghai World Expo Bureau. Huang Jianzhi, deputy director of the Shanghai World Expo Bureau, and Yang Renfeng, president of Taiwan's United Daily News and Economic Daily, signed the agreement respectively. According to the agreement, the electronic dynamic version of "Along the River During the Qingming Festival" at the China Pavilion at the 2010 Shanghai World Expo will be displayed at the Zhengyan Pavilion of the Taipei Flower Expo from July 1 to September 4.

740daac16369b7890426608d0401614911eb127b.sourceText: 杨仁烽表示，尽管台湾有130多万民众来上海参观过世博会，但是，能有机会进馆欣赏《清明上河图》的仍属少数。更多的台湾民众希望有机会亲眼见到她。
740daac16369b7890426608d0401614911eb127b.translatedText: > Yang Renfeng said that although more than 1.3 million people from Taiwan came to Shanghai to visit the World Expo, there were still only a few people who had the opportunity to enter the museum to appreciate "Along the River During the Qingming Festival". More Taiwanese people hope to have the opportunity to see her in person.

413df6665bcdc1f42a18fa0e0fc5b0a91c6ee3c0.sourceText: 上海世博会中国馆电子动态版《清明上河图》以北宋画家张择端所绘的《清明上河图》为蓝本，利用计算机科技与尖端投影设备，将宽24．8厘米、长528．7厘米的原作，放大30倍，在6米高11O米长的巨大屏幕上”动”了起来。在这幅会”动”的经典名画中，有脚夫赶着毛驴缓缓前行，虹桥上商贾百工络绎不绝。河上船工的号子声，岸边生意人的吆喝声，声声入耳。白天出现的人物多达691名，晚上也有377人。屏幕前以沙石铺叠，投影成像,波光粼粼，更添真实感。整个画面以四分钟为周期，日、夜景交替，将900年前北宋首都汴京的繁华风貌栩栩如生地呈现在参观者眼前。
413df6665bcdc1f42a18fa0e0fc5b0a91c6ee3c0.translatedText: The electronic dynamic version of "Along the River During the Qingming Festival" of the China Pavilion at the Shanghai World Expo is based on the "Along the River During the Qingming Festival" painted by the Northern Song Dynasty painter Zhang Zeduan. It uses computer technology and cutting-edge projection equipment to enlarge the original work, which is 24.8 centimeters wide and 528.7 centimeters long, 30 times and "move" on a huge screen that is 6 meters high and 110 meters long. In this classic painting that can "move", there are porters driving donkeys forward slowly, and there is an endless stream of merchants and workers on Hongqiao. The sound of boatmen's horns on the river and the shouts of businessmen on the shore are all in my ears. As many as 691 characters appear during the day, and 377 at night. Sand and stones are laid in front of the screen, and the projected image is sparkling, adding to the sense of reality. The entire picture takes four minutes as a cycle, with day and night scenes alternating, vividly presenting the prosperous style of Bianjing, the capital of the Northern Song Dynasty 900 years ago, before the visitors' eyes.

b6d96b3abde71c6a21fb46a00fba51ac5f883527.sourceText: （橙县华侨文教服务中心来稿）为响应「汉字文化节」系列活动，位于橙县的莘莘中文学校日前(八月十四日)在该校大礼堂，举办「三字经」背诵比赛。今年共有120多名学生报名参赛，经过初赛淘汰，当天各组总计64位参赛者进入决赛。
b6d96b3abde71c6a21fb46a00fba51ac5f883527.translatedText: (Contributed by the Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center) In response to the "Chinese Character Culture Festival" series of activities, Xinxin Chinese School in Orange County recently (August 14) held a "Three Character Classic" recitation competition in the school auditorium. This year, more than 120 students signed up to participate. After elimination in the preliminary rounds, a total of 64 contestants from each group entered the finals that day.

1f398d5d694addc56ae029fe1df434d70c407270.sourceText: 获得奖品 橙县华侨文教服务中心高主任家富肯定并赞扬莘莘中文学校举办此项活动的意义，也赞许参赛小朋友们的努力，透过背诵经典提高学习中华文化的兴趣。 莘莘中文学校校长孙蔼云表示，中华文化博大精深，有非常多的传世经典，都值得现代的孩子们学习。这几年来学校每年暑假期间，都举办不同经典内容的背诵活动，希望学生们因参加活动，对中华文化有更深层的认识，今年选定「三字经」，希望孩子们在背诵当中溶入日常生活中身体力行。 徐玲副校长指出，今年橙县地区报名参赛的学生，绝大多数为越华裔，或是父母亲一方是美国人，且均是在美国出生的孩子。报名的有凯德文教基金会、传福中文学校、莘莘中文学校及个人参赛等学生参与。比赛分成幼稚组、初小、初级、中级、高级等五组进行。参赛者均十分优秀，竞争可以说相当激烈，选出优胜及前三名。今年的奖品十分特别，所有进入决赛的小朋友都可获得由学校提供的奖品，第一、二、三名另外还可获奖金。
1f398d5d694addc56ae029fe1df434d70c407270.translatedText: Received Prizes Gao Jiafu, director of the Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center, affirmed and praised the significance of Xinxin Chinese School for hosting this event. He also praised the efforts of the participating children to increase their interest in learning Chinese culture through reciting classics. Sun Aiyun, principal of Xinxin Chinese School, said that Chinese culture is extensive and profound, and there are many classics handed down from ancient times, all of which are worthy of learning by modern children. In the past few years, the school has organized recitation activities with different classic contents every summer. It is hoped that students will have a deeper understanding of Chinese culture through participating in the activities. This year, the "Three Character Classic" was selected, hoping that the children can incorporate the recitation into their daily lives. Vice Principal Xu Ling pointed out that most of the students in Orange County who signed up for the competition this year are Vietnamese-Chinese, or have one parent who is American, and they are all children born in the United States. Those who signed up include students from the Kaide Cultural and Educational Foundation, Chuanfu Chinese School, Xinxin Chinese School and individual participants. The competition is divided into five groups: infantile group, elementary school, elementary, intermediate and advanced. The contestants are all very good, and the competition can be said to be quite fierce. The winner and the top three will be selected. This year's prizes are very special. All children who enter the finals will receive prizes provided by the school. The first, second and third place will also receive bonuses.
