51b3ff0fc12f6b5f3ef88844a62341d39dbb780c.sourceText: 2012年1月27日晚7:30，凤城华人基督教会，在教会的礼堂内举行了一场盛大的”新春庆祝特会”。 春节是我们中国人庆祝新年的节日，在这一天每个在外工作的人，都要在除夕之前赶回家中与亲人团聚。 我们在海外的华人，大多是几家亲朋好友一起聚餐，庆祝中国的新年。 今年凤城华人基督教会，举办这场〝新春庆祝特会〞，具有深远的意义。 一是解大家的思乡之苦，传承中国的文化，更要感谢神的恩典，真的是寄托了我们的新春、新年、新希望，一场喜乐、祥和的”新春特会”，挑旺了 人们对生活的希望！ 晚7:30的晚会，从7点会众就开始陆续进场，7:15就已人员爆满，教会还开辟了第二会场，演职人员把座位空出来，教会的会员也让出了座位 ，请新来宾进场入坐，二人座位挤三人，就是这样在大厅的后面，仍然站满了热情的观众，大约有千人以上。 晚会7:30准时开始，以鼓舞团契的”欢天喜地”歌舞开场，欢乐的气份充满会场。 亚省华人合唱团与阳光儿童合唱组，演唱了龙的传人、踏雪寻梅和新年好三首歌曲，使人感到特别温馨。 杨牧师有一个短讲，为大家讲述”叶公好龙”的故事，告戒我们，不要像叶公那样喜欢龙、但又不了解龙而怕龙。 我们想要得到福音的福份，不了解神是不行的，所以我们需要常常读圣经，了解神爱我们和神的旨意，从而真正得到这福音的福气。 叶青青的钢琴演奏，使人沉醉于时而悠扬时而激昂的美妙琴声中。 男声二重唱〝我的新年〞，唱出了专业水平，用歌声告别过去的一年，更唱出了新的一年励志和希望。 教会中文学校的小朋友的舞蹈〝金孔雀与吉祥谣〞，表现了孩子们天真、快乐、活泼的生活。 女声独唱”故乡是北京”则唱出了在海外的华人，对祖国首都北京的那份挚着的热爱和无限的思念。 琵琶独奏”彝族舞曲、玫瑰花”让人欣赏到马莱姊妹弹奏琵琶的优美乐曲，和心悦诚服的高超技艺。
51b3ff0fc12f6b5f3ef88844a62341d39dbb780c.translatedText: At 7:30 pm on January 27, 2012, Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church held a grand "New Year Celebration Meeting" in the church auditorium. The Spring Festival is a festival for us Chinese to celebrate the New Year. On this day, everyone working outside must rush home to reunite with their relatives before New Year's Eve. Most of us overseas Chinese gather with a few relatives and friends to celebrate the Chinese New Year. This year, the Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church held this "New Year Celebration Special", which is of far-reaching significance. The first is to relieve everyone's pain of homesickness, pass on Chinese culture, and more importantly, thank God for His grace, which really entrusts us with our New Year, New Year, and new hope. A joyful and peaceful "New Year party" has inspired people's hope for life! For the evening party at 7:30 p.m., members of the congregation started arriving at 7 o'clock, and it was already full by 7:15. The church also opened a second venue, where performers and cast members vacated their seats, and church members also gave up their seats and invited new guests to come in and take their seats. Three people were squeezed into the two seats. Even so, the back of the hall was still full of enthusiastic spectators, about a thousand or more people. The party started on time at 7:30, with the song and dance of "Happily Ever After" that inspired the fellowship, and the atmosphere of joy filled the venue. The Alberta Chinese Chorus and the Sunshine Children's Chorus sang three songs: Descendants of the Dragon, Walking in the Snow to Seek Plum Blossoms and Happy New Year, which made people feel particularly warm. Pastor Yang has a short sermon, telling everyone the story of "Ye Gong loves dragons", warning us not to be like dragons like Ye Gong, but don't understand dragons and are afraid of dragons. If we want to get the blessings of the gospel, it is impossible to understand God. Therefore, we need to read the Bible often and understand God’s love for us and God’s will, so as to truly get the blessings of the gospel. Ye Qingqing's piano performance makes people immersed in the beautiful piano sound that is sometimes melodious and sometimes exciting. The male duet sang "My New Year" to a professional level. They bid farewell to the past year and also sang inspiration and hope for the new year. The dance "Golden Peacock and Auspicious Ballads" performed by children from the church's Chinese school showed the children's innocent, happy and lively life. The female solo "Hometown is Beijing" sang out the sincere love and infinite longing of the Chinese overseas for Beijing, the capital of the motherland. The pipa solo "Yi Dance, Rose" allows people to appreciate the beautiful music of the Malay sisters playing the pipa and their superb skills.

47714e7e6d5e5415698ae95e475134c3971c3147.sourceText: 陈志钢弟兄的川剧”变脸”更是让人称赞叫好，过去看”变脸”，演员要转过身才可变，可陈志钢的变脸，就在众目睽睽下，一霎那就变成另一付脸 谱，短短几分钟就变换了六张脸谱。 京剧清唱”沙家浜”、江莹姿、袁英瑜的刀术、袁喜怡的独舞”好日子、古雅瑜的独唱”天路–青藏高原组曲”以及4位男士的舞蹈”雪山颂歌”，所有节目之间 的转场，都有不同的主持人用特别的串词联接，很有创意。整场晚会的节目都非常受欢迎，带给会众极大的快乐，晚会中充满了阵阵掌声、欢笑声和 欢呼声，最后在会众齐唱”我们成为一家 人”的歌声中结束晚会。
47714e7e6d5e5415698ae95e475134c3971c3147.translatedText: Brother Chen Zhigang's Sichuan Opera "Face Changing" is even more praised and applauded. In the past, when watching "Face Changing", the actors had to turn around to change, but Chen Zhigang's face changing, in full view of the public, changed into another face in an instant, and he changed six masks in just a few minutes. Peking opera a cappella "Shajiabang", Jiang Yingzi, Yuan Yingyu's sword skills, Yuan Xiyi's solo dance "Good Day", Gu Yayu's solo "Tianlu - Qinghai-Tibet Plateau Suite" and four men's dance "Snow Mountain Ode", between all programs Different hosts used special words to connect the transitions, which was very creative. The entire party was very popular and brought great joy to the congregation. The party was filled with bursts of applause, laughter and cheers. At the end, the congregation sang "We Become a Family". The party ended with the song "People".

121fc563f68ceaaa61ffa96fc17bf4999804b89b.sourceText: 晚会结束后，众人都涌入交谊厅，那里有教会同工们用两天时间，为会众预备了丰富的各式茶点，其中有粤菜点心、北方小吃、山东小吃、甜点水果和许多热粥、 茶和饮料。 会众们一面品赏美味可口的甜点、饮料，一面畅谈刚刚欣赏完的文娱节目，教会的兄弟姊妹也借此机会，向邀请来的慕道友传讲福音，介绍我们凤城华人基督教会的 宗旨和信仰，直到晚上十点半多钟，会众们才依依不舍、高高兴兴地回家去。 感谢神让我们有福气，在异国他乡还能有过中国新年的福份，我们真是度过了一个内容丰富多彩、欢乐祥和的、不一样的春节联欢晚会，不只欣赏文娱节目，更传扬了耶稣 基督十字架上的救恩！
121fc563f68ceaaa61ffa96fc17bf4999804b89b.translatedText: After the party, everyone poured into the social hall, where church staff spent two days preparing a rich variety of refreshments for the congregation, including Cantonese dim sum, northern snacks, Shandong snacks, dessert fruits and many hot porridge, tea and drinks. While enjoying the delicious desserts and drinks, the congregants chatted about the entertainment program they had just finished watching. The brothers and sisters of the church also took this opportunity to preach the gospel to the invited seekers and introduce the purpose and beliefs of our Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church. It was not until about 10:30 in the evening that the congregants went home reluctantly and happily. Thank God for giving us the blessing of being able to celebrate the Chinese New Year in a foreign country. We really had a colorful, joyful and peaceful Spring Festival Gala that was different. We not only enjoyed the entertainment programs, but also preached the salvation of Jesus Christ on the cross!

bca6d0d8b8b287e045a1786e47de62c2878a7d90.sourceText: 直升机坠毁 机上四人亡 雅瓦培郡警办公室官员说，周六，一架私人直升飞机从萨当那飞往斯格思岱时，在营豪园附近坠毁于维德河，机上四人全部罹难。 搜索队于七月一日在坠机地点发现四具罹难者遗体，经核对，他们分别为凤凰城居民，70岁的雷蒙德佩里，68岁的洞溪居民凯伦史丁，和64岁的格伦岱居民丹维夫妇。 国家运输安全委员会的调查人员正在寻找飞机黑匣，以确定是什么原因引起这场坠机悲剧。 营豪园（Camp Verde）位于凤凰城以北约86英里。
bca6d0d8b8b287e045a1786e47de62c2878a7d90.translatedText: Helicopter crashes, four people on board killed All four people on board were killed when a private helicopter crashed into the Verde River near Yinghao Park on Saturday while flying from Sardonna to Scottsdale, Yavapai County Sheriff's Office officials said. The search team found the remains of four victims at the crash site on July 1. After verification, they were 70-year-old Raymond Perry, a Phoenix resident, 68-year-old Cave Creek resident Karen Sting, and 64-year-old Glendale residents Danway and his wife. Investigators with the National Transportation Safety Board are searching for the plane's black boxes to determine what caused the tragic crash. Camp Verde is located about 86 miles north of Phoenix.

abbd19230f3de135cc17530f791918c5420fb8ed.sourceText: 健康调查：美国人活更久但病情加重 （亚省时报） 根据每年一度的美国民众健康调查显示，美国人的寿命延长了，因心脏病和癌症而死亡的人数已减少，但慢性疾病(糖尿病、肥胖和高血压)的患者人数却增加了。 由美国公共健康协会、预防伙伴基金会和公共健康基金会赞助的2012年”美国健康排名”(America’s Health Rankings)凸显了肥胖、糖尿病、高血压和久坐的行为达到了令人不安的程度。拜医学进步之赐，继续生活在不健康状态下的病人更多了。 这份引用疾病控制与预防中心、美国医学会、美国人口普查局和FBI的报告调查报告显示，佛蒙特州连续六年的健康状态都荣登榜首。该报告着眼于24项卫生的措施，包括烟草和酒精滥用、运动、传染性疾病、犯罪率、公共卫生经费、获得免疫接种、早产率、癌症和心脏病的发病率。 路易斯安那州的酗酒率很低而且儿童免疫接种率很高，但是它排名低因为在24个卫生项目里，它有13项得低分，其中包括肥胖和糖尿病。 该报告指出了下列不健康的行为：?超过四分之一的美国人（26.2％）有久坐不动的毛病，意思是在30天内，这些人都没有做任何工作以外的体力活动。这种人在密西西比州占36％，在田纳西州和西弗吉尼亚州各占35.1％。?27.8％的美国成年人都是肥胖者，肥胖者的定义是比健康的体重多了约30磅或更多，全美肥胖人数达6,600万人，超过整个英国的人口。肥胖率最低的州是科罗拉多州，那里也有超过20％的人是肥胖者。?全国有糖尿病患的成年人，比例是9.5％，但在西弗吉尼亚州、南卡罗来纳州和密西西比州则是12％以上。?30.8％的美国成年人有高血压，但在犹他州只有22.9％，在阿拉巴马州则高到40.1％。高血压是心血管疾病的主要因素，这是与心脏和血管有关的问题。 现在美国的平均预期寿命是78.5年，自1990年以来过早死亡人数下降了18％，心血管疾病的死亡率下降了34.6％，癌症死亡人数下降7.6％。
abbd19230f3de135cc17530f791918c5420fb8ed.translatedText: Health Survey: Americans are living longer but getting sicker (Alberta Times) According to the annual American Public Health Survey, Americans are living longer, and deaths from heart disease and cancer have decreased, but the number of patients with chronic diseases (diabetes, obesity, and high blood pressure) has increased. America’s Health Rankings 2012, sponsored by the American Public Health Association, Prevention Partners and the Public Health Foundation, highlights disturbing levels of obesity, diabetes, high blood pressure and sedentary behaviors. Thanks to medical advances, more patients continue to live in unhealthy conditions. The report, which cited the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the American Medical Association, the U.S. Census Bureau and the FBI, found that Vermont has topped the list for health status for six consecutive years. The report looks at 24 health measures, including tobacco and alcohol abuse, exercise, infectious diseases, crime rates, public health funding, access to immunizations, premature birth rates, cancer and heart disease rates. Louisiana has low alcohol abuse rates and high childhood immunization rates, but it ranks low because it scores low in 13 of 24 health categories, including obesity and diabetes. The report identifies the following unhealthy behaviors: More than a quarter of Americans (26.2%) are sedentary, meaning they have not done any physical activity outside of work in a 30-day period. Such people account for 36% in Mississippi and 35.1% each in Tennessee and West Virginia. ?27.8% of American adults are obese, defined as being about 30 pounds or more more than a healthy weight. There are 66 million obese people in the United States, more than the entire population of the United Kingdom. The state with the lowest obesity rate is Colorado, where more than 20 percent of the population is obese. Nationally, 9.5% of adults have diabetes, but in West Virginia, South Carolina and Mississippi it is more than 12%. ?30.8% of U.S. adults have high blood pressure, but only 22.9% in Utah and as high as 40.1% in Alabama. High blood pressure is a major factor in cardiovascular disease, which are problems related to the heart and blood vessels. Average life expectancy in the United States is now 78.5 years, premature deaths have dropped 18% since 1990, deaths from cardiovascular disease have dropped 34.6%, and cancer deaths have dropped 7.6%.

718255aba16304cd365c8df5c217b03f2d378d50.sourceText: “第八期海外华文媒体高级研修班”到闵行区参观访问 ”第八期海外华文媒体高级研修班”到闵行区参观访问 本报代表对海归学童入学及高端人才服务中心感兴趣 6月15日，由国务院侨办宣传司和上海市人民政府侨办联合主办的”第八期海外华文媒体高级研修班”成员一行约60人到闵行区参观访问，其成员均为海外主要华文媒体的负责人。上海市人民政府侨务办公室副主任蔡建国，闵行区委副书记、区长莫负春及区各有关委办局领导参加了接待。 参访团一行先后参观了古美街道卫生服务中心、七宝古镇及区高端人才服务中心，近距离感受闵行千年历史文化和便捷、舒适的生活环境，了解闵行区政府在留住人才、培育人才、服务人才方面所做的工作及出台的相关政策。 本报代表就海归人员的外籍子女入学问题向蔡建国主任提出咨询，蔡主任也欣然作答。他说，外籍儿童在沪上学，按规定要入读国际学校。上海有20家国际学校，大部分设在闵行区，这些学校都专收外籍学童。如果外籍儿童要想入上海市公立学校，蔡主任说，前提是对方是否愿意接收，言下之意是要靠家长自己各显神通。但如果是归侨华侨子女报考上海市高中（中专、技校）或大专院校者，侨办会在核实材料后提供出具身份证明，使其在升学考试中得到加分。 其实，上海市在解决留学海归人士的子女入学问题方面一直领先国内其他城市。2005年，浦东新区就出台了《浦东新区关于解决留学人员子女入学入托问题的操作办法》，在全市率先推出对义务教育阶段的留学人员子女入学免收杂费，享受市民同等待遇，以及在留学人员子女中评选奖学金的政策举措。 随后，研修班成员还参观了闵行区的高端人才服务中心，中心的陶慎先主任向各位介绍了中心的情况。 作为上海市第一个高端人才服务中心，闵行区高服中心是一个非公组织，是专门为高端人才服务。而高端人才，主要是指在海外学习并取得硕士学位，学成后在海外工作五年（博士学位的在海外工作三年）以上，在专业领域拥有自主知识产权、高技术含量科研成果且市场开发前景广阔的创业人才；在国内外拥有独立知识产权和发明专利，且其技术成果国际先进，能够填补国内空白、具有市场潜力并进行产业化生产的创业人才；在引领电子信息、环保节能、现代设计重点产业，以及在金融服务、生物医药、新材料、新能源、文化创意等产业带技术、带项目、带资金和具有自主创新能力的创业人才。闵行区高服中心将对这类人才提供管家式，一对一服务。 研修班成员对闵行的城市发展及人才工作政策予以充分肯定，特别是对政府借助社区卫生服务中心这一平台，利用网络的便捷为居民提供人性化的服务，充分体现了”智慧”闵行这一做法发表了感慨，纷纷表示今后要充分利用海外华文媒体的优势加大宣传国内人文、城市建设等方面的内容，让海外的华人、华侨及时、真切地了解国内的形势及相关政策。
718255aba16304cd365c8df5c217b03f2d378d50.translatedText: The Eighth Overseas Chinese Media Advanced Training Class visited Minhang District The "Eighth Overseas Chinese Media Advanced Training Class" visited Minhang District. Representatives of this newspaper were interested in the enrollment of overseas students and the high-end talent service center. On June 15, about 60 members of the "Eighth Overseas Chinese Media Advanced Training Class" jointly sponsored by the Propaganda Department of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council and the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the Shanghai Municipal People's Government visited Minhang District. The members were all heads of major overseas Chinese media. Cai Jianguo, deputy director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the Shanghai Municipal People's Government, Mo Yinchun, deputy secretary of the Minhang District Committee and District Mayor, and leaders of relevant committees and bureaus in the district attended the reception. The delegation visited Gumei Subdistrict Health Service Center, Qibao Ancient Town and District High-end Talent Service Center, experienced Minhang’s thousand-year history and culture and convenient and comfortable living environment at close range, and learned about the work done by the Minhang District Government in retaining talents, cultivating talents, and serving talents and related policies issued. Representatives of this newspaper asked Director Cai Jianguo about the enrollment of foreign children of returnees, and Director Cai was happy to answer. He said that foreign children studying in Shanghai are required to attend international schools, most of which are located in Minhang District. These schools only accept foreign children. For Shanghai public schools, Director Cai said that the prerequisite is whether the other party is willing to accept them. The implication is that it is up to the parents to show their talents. However, if the children of returned overseas Chinese apply for admission to Shanghai high schools (technical secondary schools, technical schools) or colleges and universities, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office will provide proof of identity after verifying the materials, so that they can get extra points in the entrance examination. In fact, Shanghai has always been ahead of other cities in China in solving the enrollment problem of children of overseas students. In 2005, Pudong New Area issued the "Pudong New Area Operational Measures for Solving the Enrollment and Enrollment Problems of Children of Overseas Students", which was the first in the city to launch policies and measures to exempt the children of overseas students in compulsory education from miscellaneous fees, enjoy the same treatment as citizens, and select scholarships among the children of overseas students. Subsequently, members of the training class also visited the High-end Talent Service Center in Minhang District. Director Tao Shenxian of the center introduced the situation of the center to everyone. As the first high-end talent service center in Shanghai, the Minhang District Gaofu Center is a non-public organization that specializes in serving high-end talents. High-end talents mainly refer to entrepreneurial talents who have studied abroad and obtained a master's degree, worked overseas for more than five years after graduation (three years for a doctorate), and have independent intellectual property rights, high-tech scientific research results and broad market development prospects in professional fields; they have independent intellectual property rights and development at home and abroad. Entrepreneurial talents with patents and internationally advanced technological achievements who can fill domestic gaps, have market potential and carry out industrial production; entrepreneurial talents who are leading key industries such as electronic information, environmental protection and energy conservation, and modern design, as well as bringing technology, projects, funds, and independent innovation capabilities in industries such as financial services, biomedicine, new materials, new energy, and cultural creativity. The Minhang District High-Tech Service Center will provide housekeeping-style, one-on-one services to such talents. The members of the training class fully affirmed Minhang's urban development and talent work policies, especially the government's use of the community health service center as a platform to use the convenience of the Internet to provide residents with humanized services, which fully embodies the "wisdom" of Minhang.

4217c2b82eee59e746acf59920ce5e6ad352cce5.sourceText: 罢免选举 亚省破天荒 刘易斯胜 （亚省时报） 11月的超级星期二选举中，亚利桑那州参议院主席罗素皮尔斯（PEARCE, RUSSELL）在自己的选区（18选区，美莎市）马失前蹄，45%:53%，被对手杰里刘易斯（LEWIS, JERRY）赢了不止一个马鼻子。 皮尔斯是2010年生效的SB1070移民法提案者，此法虽得州参众两院通过，州长签字生效，却也因此将亚利桑那州推动舆论的风口浪尖。 虽然皮尔斯一向以强硬的打击非法移民形象出现，但这次他的竞选方案相对保守，包括企业减税，私人学校教育券，堕胎限制，枪支权利，工会的限制，将移民法案放到最后。对手刘易斯没有强调移民问题，同样着重教育。 由于皮尔斯推行的打击非法移民法案，使他遭到西裔社区和选民的强烈反感,推动了这次号称?#32610;免皮尔斯选举?#12290;罢免选举在亚利桑那州近100年历史上是第一次。 刘易斯胜了皮尔斯，也意味着共和党议员将推举一名新的参议院领袖。 共和党人提醒党内参选人从皮尔斯落败得到教训，应采取较温和的方式，以避免遭到类似下场。
4217c2b82eee59e746acf59920ce5e6ad352cce5.translatedText: Recall election, unprecedented in Alberta, Lewis wins (Alberta Times) In the Super Tuesday election in November, Arizona State Senate President Russell Pearce (PEARCE, RUSSELL) lost ground in his own district (District 18, Mesa City), 45%:53%, and was defeated by his opponent Jerry Lewis (LEWIS, JERRY) by more than one horse. Pierce was the sponsor of the SB1070 immigration law that took effect in 2010. Although this law was passed by the Texas House of Representatives and the Senate and signed by the governor, it has also pushed Arizona to the forefront of public opinion. Although Pierce has always appeared as a tough opponent of illegal immigration, this time his campaign plan is relatively conservative, including corporate tax cuts, private school education vouchers, abortion restrictions, gun rights, restrictions on unions, and putting the immigration bill at the end. Opponent Lewis did not emphasize immigration issues, but also focused on education. Because of Pierce's implementation of the bill to combat illegal immigration, he was strongly disliked by the Hispanic community and voters, leading to this so-called recall election, the first in Arizona's nearly 100-year history. Lewis' victory over Pierce also means that Republican lawmakers will elect a new Senate leader. Republicans reminded candidates in the party to learn lessons from Pierce's defeat and should adopt a softer approach to avoid a similar fate.

8091fcae10c0d0809423833c291f2411f1294cd5.sourceText: (新东方艺术学校供稿)又一年，又是金光璀璨的季节，又是明月高照的季节，我们即将迎来中秋佳节。这一天，我们期盼团圆，我们欣赏歌舞；为了庆祝中秋佳节，新东方艺术学校， 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院，亚利桑那州华人华侨联合会将于2014年9月14日在钱德勒艺术中心举办”金秋中国舞蹈艺术节”将为您奉上精彩绝伦的成人肚皮舞，风韵典雅的朝鲜族舞，热情奔放的蒙古族舞，生动形象的彝族独舞，独具魅力的汉族舞蹈，温柔婉约的中国古典舞，刚柔并济的东北秧歌民间舞组合以及纯美的钢琴和小提琴演奏等。表演者来自新东方艺术学校。晚会将于下午四点钟正式开始，可在钱德勒艺术中心办公室办理购票。 除此之外，1:30到3:30之间，亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院还将举办一系列免费的中华文化活动。您及您的家人有机会获赠精美的中华手工艺品。届时，将会有书法展、国画展、中华古典乐器展，以及亚利桑那州高中生拍摄的中国之行照片展。 我们期待和您及家人共度相聚的美好时光，提前祝愿您和家人中秋节快乐！ 演出时间：2014年9月14日 ( 星期天 )下午4点 9-14-2014 SUNDAY 4:00pm 地点：Chandler Center for the Arts Address: 250 N Arizona Ave, Chandler, AZ 85225
8091fcae10c0d0809423833c291f2411f1294cd5.translatedText: (Contributed by New Oriental Art School) Another year, it is the season of shining golden light, and it is the season of shining moon, we are about to usher in the Mid-Autumn Festival. On this day, we look forward to reunion and enjoy singing and dancing; in order to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival, New Oriental Art School, The Confucius Institute at Arizona State University and the Arizona Overseas Chinese Federation will hold the "Golden Autumn Chinese Dance Festival" at the Chandler Art Center on September 14, 2014, and will present you with a wonderful adult belly dance, a classic of charm. Elegant Korean dance, passionate and unrestrained Mongolian dance, vivid Yi solo dance, unique and charming Han dance, gentle and graceful Chinese classical dance, Northeastern Yangko folk dance combination with both strength and softness, and pure piano and violin performances. The performers are from New Oriental Art School. The party will officially begin at 4 p.m. Tickets can be purchased at the Chandler Center for the Arts office. In addition, the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University will also hold a series of free Chinese cultural activities between 1:30 and 3:30. You and your family have the opportunity to receive exquisite Chinese handicrafts. At that time, there will be a calligraphy exhibition, a traditional Chinese painting exhibition, an exhibition of Chinese classical musical instruments, and an exhibition of photos taken by Arizona high school students from their trip to China. We look forward to spending quality time with you and your family, and wish you and your family a Happy Mid-Autumn Festival in advance! Performance time: September 14, 2014 (Sunday) 4:00 pm 9-14-2014 SUNDAY 4:00pm Venue: Chandler Center for the Arts Address: 250 N Arizona Ave, Chandler, AZ 85225

b3600b15161c32678d7947cd37fbbb240dc380da.sourceText: 母亲节特别策划：爱在心头 口自开 ”有些情，埋得越深，就越真；有些事，藏得越久，就越妙”，身在海外的我们对于母爱，对亲人的思念，感触得更深。母亲节就要到了，请把那些你珍藏多年的故事与最亲爱的人一起分享。” 人人都热爱母亲，大人小孩都可以参与” ，由” 太阳鸟”亚利桑那华人网和《美西侨报》联合主办，凤凰笔会，现代中文学校，希望中文学校，凤凰城中文学校，斐匿中文学校，华人基督教会中文学校，图桑中​文学校联合推出《母亲节特刊》活动。 《母亲节特刊》以不同的形式展现母爱，可以是一句话，一个照片，一篇文章，截稿日期 5月10日。 来稿是请注明： 母亲的名字 自己的名字 以及联系方式 体裁不限，被选取的文章和照片将会在《太阳鸟亚利桑那华人网》《美西侨报》陆续刊登。
b3600b15161c32678d7947cd37fbbb240dc380da.translatedText: Mother’s Day Special Plan: Love is in the heart, the mouth opens from the mouth "Some feelings become truer the deeper they are buried; some things become better the longer they are hidden." When we are overseas, we miss our mother's love and our loved ones more deeply. Mother's Day is coming, please share the stories you have treasured for many years with your dearest ones. "Everyone loves mothers, adults and children can participate." "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese Network and "American Western Chinese News" jointly sponsored, Phoenix PEN, Modern Chinese School, Hope Chinese School, Phoenix Chinese School, Phoenix Chinese School, Chinese Christian Church Chinese School, Tucson Chinese School jointly launched the "Mother's Day Special Issue" event. The "Mother's Day Special Issue" shows maternal love in different forms, it can be a sentence, a photo, an article, the deadline for submission is May 10th. Please indicate: Mother's name Your own name As well as contact information, there is no restriction on genre. The selected articles and photos will be published in "Sunbird Arizona Chinese Network" and "Spanish-American Overseas Chinese News".

4aefc79e01832994af678e59d616895075639744.sourceText: 中国上班族压力上全球第一？
4aefc79e01832994af678e59d616895075639744.translatedText: Are Chinese office workers the most stressed in the world?

287f8938c5e191b6601a055601521948613d6bb4.sourceText: 中国上班族压力上全球第一？ 中国内地上班族压力的上涨已位列全球第一？根据办公方案提供机构雷格斯最新发布的调…
287f8938c5e191b6601a055601521948613d6bb4.translatedText: Are Chinese office workers the most stressed in the world? Is the pressure on office workers in mainland China the highest in the world? According to the latest survey released by Regus, an office solution provider...

f56beb183b8a12af405232608aae7028656c52d0.sourceText: 从今年4月开始，雷格斯对全球范围内80个国家和地区超过1.6万名职场人士进行调查，发现四分之三 (75%) 的中国内地上班族认为自己承受的压力比去年更高了，该比例位列全球第一。位列第二的是德国人，亚太其他国家则位列第三，中国香港地区位列第四。香港地区有 55% 的上班族表示所承受的压力高于去年。而全球的平均值为48%。
f56beb183b8a12af405232608aae7028656c52d0.translatedText: Starting in April this year, Regus surveyed more than 16,000 professionals in 80 countries and regions around the world and found that three-quarters (75%) of office workers in mainland China believe that they are under higher pressure than last year, ranking first in the world. The Germans ranked second, with other Asia-Pacific countries ranking third, and Hong Kong, China ranking fourth. Fifty-five percent of office workers in Hong Kong reported experiencing higher levels of stress than last year. The global average is 48%.

8b8106a7ce0801331cbec91ddd3e9acd41c377ad.sourceText: 对于导致压力上升的主要原因，多数受访者认为是工作所致。中国内地73%的受访者认为工作是压力的主要来源，在香港持这一观点的人数比例为 62%，在全球范围内则有 59% 的受访者认为工作是压力的主因。调查称，从大环境来看，经济增速放缓和欧元区债务危机令大多数中国和德国职场人士倍感压力。
8b8106a7ce0801331cbec91ddd3e9acd41c377ad.translatedText: Regarding the main reason for increased stress, most respondents believe that it is caused by work. 73% of respondents in mainland China believe that work is the main source of stress, 62% of people in Hong Kong believe that work is the main source of stress, and 59% of respondents globally believe that work is the main cause of stress. The survey said that from the perspective of the overall environment, the slowdown in economic growth and the euro zone debt crisis have made most Chinese and German professionals feel stressed.

caf35b5e6f8791d6d841521f0fa0324277faae01.sourceText: 除了工作外，中国内地和香港的受访者都将个人财务状况视作第二压力来源，排第三的则是来自客户或管理层的压力。
caf35b5e6f8791d6d841521f0fa0324277faae01.translatedText: In addition to work, respondents from mainland China and Hong Kong regard personal financial status as the second source of stress, and the third is pressure from customers or management.

b2a1a4bd9d433e376f02ed75a4543fdfa3ab9b58.sourceText: 在中国内地，上海似乎成为”压力之都”，受访的上海在职人士中有近 80% 感到压力上升，北京的比例则为67%。雷格斯东亚区总裁韩蓝霆 (Hans Leijten) 对第一财经记者表示，随着中国年轻人为了追求更加平衡的工作和生活，所谓的”裸辞”现象日益增加。
b2a1a4bd9d433e376f02ed75a4543fdfa3ab9b58.translatedText: In mainland China, Shanghai seems to have become the "city of stress." Nearly 80% of employed people in Shanghai feel increased pressure, while the proportion in Beijing is 67%. Hans Leijten, president of Regus East Asia, told China Business News that as young people in China pursue a more balanced work and life, the so-called "naked speech" phenomenon is increasing.

ae58e16236ac6988a70fcca0d7feefa11bd1ce77.sourceText: 裸辞指的是还没找好下家就辞职，其反映的职场人士”决绝”程度堪比裸婚。
ae58e16236ac6988a70fcca0d7feefa11bd1ce77.translatedText: Naked resignation refers to resigning before finding a new job, which reflects the degree of "determination" of the workplace comparable to naked marriage.

787a7821f8d1642d208f35e4314efb64495295e5.sourceText: 从全球范围来看，在亚太区将工作视为压力主要来源的受访者比例相较于欧洲、美国及拉丁美洲国家都要高。同时，小企业员工比大企业员工更容易感受到来自客户的压力。
787a7821f8d1642d208f35e4314efb64495295e5.translatedText: From a global perspective, the proportion of respondents who regard work as the main source of stress is higher in the Asia-Pacific region than in European, American and Latin American countries. At the same time, employees in small businesses are more likely to feel pressure from customers than those in large enterprises.

e508686c71d97aa691f32f9a5e60b6975fd357df.sourceText: 针对如何解决职场压力，上述调查发现过半数 (55%)的中国内地受访者将弹性办公方式视为减压方式，88%的中国内地受访者还认为弹性办公方式可提升生产力。
e508686c71d97aa691f32f9a5e60b6975fd357df.translatedText: Regarding how to deal with workplace stress, the above survey found that more than half (55%) of mainland Chinese respondents regard flexible working as a way to reduce stress, and 88% of mainland Chinese respondents also believe that flexible working can improve productivity.

826dfff850b83fd6a5ee15f750daa935da2da395.sourceText: 参与此次调查的NGO人士罗宾毕什普认为，国家和地区文化是弹性办公方式较大的障碍之一，其次是管理层对管理失控的担忧。”这次调查最突出的发现是有63%的亚太地区受访者认为弹性办公方式是解决压力问题的方法。”她说，”我们一直深信企业不可忽视员工因工作与生活不平衡，对企业造成的负面影响。许多企业担心弹性办公会导致工作效率下降，事实上，弹性办公不等于员工减少工作量，而是在工作时间、方式及地点上有更大主导权。”
826dfff850b83fd6a5ee15f750daa935da2da395.translatedText: Robin Bishop, an NGO person who participated in the survey, believes that national and regional culture is one of the biggest obstacles to flexible working methods, followed by management's concerns about management being out of control. "The most striking finding of this survey is that 63% of respondents in the Asia-Pacific region believe that flexible working is a way to solve stress problems," she said. "We have always believed that companies cannot ignore the negative impact that employees have on the company due to work-life imbalance. Many companies are worried that flexible working will lead to a decrease in work efficiency. In fact, flexible working does not mean that employees reduce their workload, but that employees have greater control over the time, method and location of work."

0cd456ade886f01d367a6ad102376f5f79bd75a7.sourceText: 蒙特利公园市警方提醒居民提防手机被盗 近一段时间蒙市接连发生多起手机偷窃案，为提醒广大民众提高警惕，避免让自己成为下一个受害者，洛县警局日前发出警告，并提出自我保护的8项建议。 1、打开手机的密码或识别码功能，以防里面的个人信息在手机失窃后被人盗用；2、保存好手机的序列号；3、不要把个人的秘密资料存入手机；4、开启手机 的GPS功能，如果手机没有自带这项功能，可到市场上购买，这样就可以在手机被盗后进行追踪。 5、警惕陌生人旨在分散注意力的交谈，这是手机失窃最常见的场景，往往在这个时候，另一个人正在身后偷窃你兜里的手机；6、不要把手机放在餐厅的桌面上 ，而应藏在衣兜或手袋里；7、手机失窃后用另一个电话马上报警；8、如果你看到小偷，不要与之扭打，而要记下对方的车牌号、颜色、车型和逃离 方向。
0cd456ade886f01d367a6ad102376f5f79bd75a7.translatedText: Monterey Park police remind residents to be wary of cell phone thefts. In recent times, there have been a number of mobile phone theft cases in Montreal. In order to remind the public to be more vigilant and avoid becoming the next victim, the Los Angeles County Police Department recently issued a warning and put forward 8 suggestions for self-protection. 1. Turn on the password or identification code function of the phone to prevent the personal information inside from being stolen after the phone is stolen; 2. Keep the serial number of the phone; 3. Do not store personal secret information in the phone; 4. Turn on the GPS function of the phone. If the phone does not come with this function, you can buy it in the market, so that you can track the phone after it is stolen. 5. Be wary of strangers’ distracting conversations. This is the most common scenario for cell phone theft. Often, at this time, another person is stealing the cell phone in your pocket behind you; 6. Do not put the cell phone on the table in the restaurant, but hide it in your pocket or handbag; 7. Use another phone to call the police immediately after the cell phone is stolen; 8. If you see a thief, do not fight with him, but write down the other person’s license plate number, color, model, and escape direction.

51145f776b2b784f603b6d41f7485404e494f68c.translatedText: An Embarrassing Experience Feng Ming I have not experienced many embarrassing things in my life, but one time is unforgettable. Looking back to this day, I still can’t let it go. It’s not that I can’t forgive...

8d5bc9637657870c848669706b74ed6bada068b4.sourceText: 一次尴尬经历 凤鸣 一生中经历的尴尬事不多，但有一次是刻骨铭心的，至今回想起来，还有些不能释怀，不是不能原谅，而是想不明白，她为何会那样无礼、粗鲁地对待我们！ 事情发生在十几年前。当时的中国，改革开放不久，各项事物都在日新月异的改革变化中，事情的处理运作也都向世界靠拢，那一年我是第二次来美国探亲，孩子为我在美国买好机票，如果是以前，要用特快专递寄回中国，这次可通过一个中间公司，直接从中国北京寄到我家，本是件好事，不料想拿到机票一看，麻烦来了！因为是住美国的公司，通过电话告知他中国的公司办事处，把我的名字汉语拼音打错了，经过他们与北京办事处联系，让我去北京的办事处更换机票，按照他们告知的地址，有我的朋友陪我一同前往。 我的朋友是北京大学哲学系毕业的，为人处事是相当认真，我们是初中最要好的同学，在北京她很熟悉，我们高高兴兴地在北京的大街上，一边聊天，一边寻找要去的公司。很快我们在一幢写字楼上，找到那家公司的办事处，经过协商，有一位先生去机场更改机票，让我们坐在办事处等候。坐下来等候时才打眼观察，在这不大的十几平方的办公室内，有两位年青女士坐在电脑前忙碌着。这时我忽然感到口渴，发现在客人坐的沙发旁，有一个那时很时髦的饮水机，还有一次性的纸杯，我想这就是为客户准备的吧！我对朋友说：”我好想喝杯水！”（我是个从来不在外喝水的人，那天竞是天生第一次在外想讨杯水！不料想却碰了钉子）我的朋友听说我想喝水，就站起来准备为我倒水！这时耳边忽然传来一位女士严厉的声音：”这水你们不能喝！要喝水到外面走廊去喝！”我当时就蒙了！感到被拒绝、被羞辱，差点就掉下眼泪，心想这水不让喝，你们放在这里做什么？我的朋友是急脾气，立刻就火冒三丈指问她：”为什么不让喝饮水机的水，你们把人分为三、六、九等吗？这里摆着水不让喝，让我们去走廊喝，难道你们就是这样对待客户的吗？把你们经理找来，我要投诉你们！厖”我的朋友的话，就像机枪一样讲了一大堆道理，不好听的话，也说了不少。这时另一位坐在后面的女士忙解围说：”你们想喝就喝吧！不要再吵了！”糟遇这种局面让我很尴尬，以前也从未经历过这样粗鲁、无礼的事，想喝水竞招惹这无情羞辱，如果地上有裂缝，会毫不犹豫的钻进去，想喝水的意愿全无，只顾拉着朋友赶紧往外走，朋友也是得理不让人的主，临走朋友放下一句狠话：”你这人太没教养！回家问问你的父母，这样对人太无礼？”在回家的路上，我给朋友说：”你说她没教养，这句话太重了，如果是我，我会很难接受，可那位女士好像还不如我的反应强烈！” 事情过去了，我们没有投诉她，总想多一事不如少一事，为这种人生气不值。事后我想：那位年青女士为什么会这样呢？肯定有人这样交待过，处在她的位置想一下，她也只是执行任务而已。当年刚改革开放不久，有些人在形式上学习国外的办公室的布置，只想摆摆样子，不料想碰到我这当真的人。不知这位女士，在以后的日子里，是怎样反省这件事？ 现在情况大不相同了，无论去那里办事，送上瓶装水或从饮水机接水招待客户，是再正常不过的事了，像我当年糟遇尴尬的事，不会再发生了！
8d5bc9637657870c848669706b74ed6bada068b4.translatedText: An Embarrassing Experience Feng Ming I have not experienced many embarrassing things in my life, but one incident is unforgettable. Looking back to this day, I still can't let it go. It's not that I can't forgive, but I can't understand why she treated us so rudely and rudely! It happened more than ten years ago. At that time, China was not long after the reform and opening up. Everything was undergoing rapid reform and change, and things were handled and operated closer to the world. That year I came to the United States for the second time to visit relatives. My children bought me a ticket in the United States. If it was before, I would have to send it back to China by express mail. This time, it could be sent directly from Beijing, China to my home through an intermediary company. This was originally a good thing, but I didn’t expect to get the ticket and trouble came! Because it was a company living in the United States, I informed the company's office in China over the phone that the Chinese pinyin of my name was wrong. After they contacted the Beijing office, they asked me to go to the Beijing office to change my ticket. According to the address they informed me, my friend accompanied me. My friend graduated from the Philosophy Department of Peking University. She is very serious in dealing with people. We are the best classmates in junior high school. She is very familiar with her in Beijing. We happily chatted on the streets of Beijing while looking for the company to go to. Soon we found the company's office in an office building. After negotiation, a gentleman went to the airport to change our tickets and asked us to sit in the office and wait. When I sat down to wait, I took a closer look. In this small office of more than ten square meters, there were two young ladies sitting in front of the computer busy. At this time, I suddenly felt thirsty and found that next to the sofa where the customers were sitting, there was a very fashionable water dispenser at that time, as well as disposable paper cups. I think this was prepared for customers! I said to my friend: "I really want a glass of water!" (I never drink water outside, and that day was the first time in my life that I wanted to ask for a glass of water outside! Unexpectedly, I hit a snag.) When my friend heard that I wanted to drink water, he stood up and prepared to pour me some water! At this time, a lady's stern voice suddenly came to my ears: "You can't drink this water! If you want to drink water, go to the corridor outside to drink!" I was confused at that time! I felt rejected and humiliated, and almost shed tears. I thought to myself, this water is not allowed to be drunk, what are you doing here? My friend had a bad temper and immediately got angry and asked her: "Why are you not allowed to drink water from the water dispenser? Do you classify people into three, six, and nine? There is water here and we are not allowed to drink it. We are allowed to drink in the corridor. Is this how you treat customers? Find your manager and I will complain to you! Pang" My friend's words were like a machine gun and he made a lot of sense and said a lot of unpleasant things. At this time, another lady sitting in the back hurriedly came to the rescue and said: "You can drink if you want! Stop arguing!" I was very embarrassed to be in this situation. I had never experienced such a rude and disrespectful thing before. I wanted to drink water and was so cruelly humiliated. If there was a crack in the ground, I would not hesitate to get in. I had no intention of drinking water. I just dragged my friend to it. When I go out, my friends are the ones who don't want to be ignored. Before leaving, my friend said harshly: "You are so uneducated! Go home and ask your parents. Is this too rude?" On the way home, I said to my friend: "You said she was uneducated. This is too strong. If it were me, I would find it difficult to accept it, but that lady didn't seem to have as strong a reaction as me!" The matter has passed, and we have not complained against her. We always think that one more thing would be better than one less thing. It is not worth getting angry with such a person. Afterwards I thought: Why did that young lady do this? Someone must have explained it like this. If you think about it in her position, she is just performing a task. Not long after the reform and opening up, some people were formally studying the layout of foreign offices, just to show off, but they didn't expect to meet a serious person like me. I wonder how this lady will reflect on this matter in the days to come? The situation is very different now. No matter where I go to do errands, it is normal to deliver bottled water or receive water from the water dispenser to entertain customers. Things like the embarrassing things I encountered back then will never happen again!

54787f97bb04c37d191e91b7d3970ab0d2e49f89.sourceText: 城市人口增长 新奥尔良最快底特律最慢
54787f97bb04c37d191e91b7d3970ab0d2e49f89.translatedText: Urban population growth: New Orleans is the fastest and Detroit is the slowest

395da99adccac1b02c84bb06b6bfb950e71d482c.sourceText: 城市人口增长 新奥尔良最快底特律最慢 （亚省时报） 据统计，美国人口超过30万的城市在2010年7月至2…
395da99adccac1b02c84bb06b6bfb950e71d482c.translatedText: Urban population growth: New Orleans is the fastest and Detroit is the slowest (Alberta Times) According to statistics, US cities with a population of more than 300,000 grew from July to February 2010...

768fd0b856ea1992589cc0cc43fd59f4f1d64c2d.sourceText: 城市人口增长 新奥尔良最快底特律最慢 （亚省时报） 据统计，美国人口超过30万的城市在2010年7月至2011年7月间的平均人口增长率为1.5%。彭博商业周刊（Bloomberg BusinessWeek）最近排名列出人口增长最快及最慢的10个城市。 人口增长最快的10个城市平均人口增长率为3.1%，平均失业率为8.0%， 略低于全国平均8.1%，法拍屋率为0.16%， 略高于全国平均0.15%。排名从一至十分别为新奥尔良，奥斯汀，丹佛，罗利，坦帕，亚特兰大，华盛顿，夏洛特，埃尔帕索和迈阿密。 人口增长最慢的10个城市的平均人口增长率为0.1%，其中4个城市在统计期间人口下降。平均失业率为8.4%，法拍屋率为0.19%，两项指数均高于全国平均。排名从一至十分别为底特律，克里夫兰，圣路易斯，巴尔的摩，芝加哥，密尔沃基，威奇托，匹兹堡，费城和洛杉矶。
768fd0b856ea1992589cc0cc43fd59f4f1d64c2d.translatedText: Urban population growth is New Orleans the fastest and Detroit is the slowest (Alberta Times) According to statistics, the average population growth rate of U.S. cities with a population of more than 300,000 between July 2010 and July 2011 was 1.5%. Bloomberg BusinessWeek recently ranked the 10 cities with the fastest and slowest population growth. The average population growth rate of the 10 cities with the fastest growing population is 3.1%, the average unemployment rate is 8.0%, slightly lower than the national average of 8.1%, and the foreclosure rate is 0.16%, slightly higher than the national average of 0.15%. Ranking from one to ten are New Orleans, Austin, Denver, Raleigh, Tampa, Atlanta, Washington, Charlotte, El Paso and Miami. The average population growth rate of the 10 cities with the slowest population growth was 0.1%, and 4 of them experienced population decline during the statistical period. The average unemployment rate is 8.4% and the foreclosure rate is 0.19%, both of which are higher than the national average. Ranking from one to ten are Detroit, Cleveland, St. Louis, Baltimore, Chicago, Milwaukee, Wichita, Pittsburgh, Philadelphia and Los Angeles.

432cc9f8a12423ee4492798ed705c41a286843c8.sourceText: 美国原油产量大增或改变国际格局 BBC报道，美国已探明页岩油储粮出人意料地大幅度上升，可能将改变全球原油出…
432cc9f8a12423ee4492798ed705c41a286843c8.translatedText: A surge in U.S. crude oil production could change the international landscape. The BBC reported that the U.S.'s proven shale oil and grain reserves unexpectedly increased significantly, which may change global crude oil exports...

a09b20cd23cdb335b67d9cb381eeb34f5da85799.sourceText: BBC报道，美国已探明页岩油储粮出人意料地大幅度上升，可能将改变全球原油出产国对比格局。据国际能源署（IEA）预计，今后五年内，全球新增原油供应的三分之一将来自美国。这意味着美国将从原油主要进口国变成净出口国，而对中东原油的需求将因此而减速。 国际能源署在一年两次的五年预测报告中指出，北美在原油供应市场掀起的巨浪正波及全球。
a09b20cd23cdb335b67d9cb381eeb34f5da85799.translatedText: The BBC reported that the U.S.'s proven shale oil and grain reserves unexpectedly increased significantly and may change the global comparison of crude oil producers. According to the International Energy Agency (IEA), one-third of the world's new crude oil supply will come from the United States in the next five years. This means that the United States will become a net exporter of crude oil from a major importer, and demand for Middle East crude oil will slow down as a result. The International Energy Agency pointed out in its twice-yearly five-year forecast report that the huge wave set off by North America in the crude oil supply market is affecting the world.

6f91e0dbdb7fea97640ab2e08bc1a71db89ab924.sourceText: 报告预计，到2015年，美国将取代俄国成为世界第一大天然气出产国；到2035年，美国国内能源需求将”自给自足”。
6f91e0dbdb7fea97640ab2e08bc1a71db89ab924.translatedText: The report predicts that by 2015, the United States will replace Russia as the world's largest natural gas producer; by 2035, the United States' domestic energy demand will be "self-sufficient."

b20042476969dd420961f6a4521881cd42be6241.sourceText: 而美国原油产量大增，将结束世界对中东石油的依赖。中东石油出产国组成石油出口国组织欧佩克（Opec），占目前全球原油产量的35%。
b20042476969dd420961f6a4521881cd42be6241.translatedText: The surge in U.S. crude oil production will end the world's dependence on Middle East oil. Middle East oil-producing countries form the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (Opec) and account for 35% of current global crude oil production.

f3b8a13068df91405bffbb94c78c89a1a892bc87.sourceText: 国际能源署预计，2012-18年间，美国每天原油产量将增加390万桶，占传统的非欧佩克原油出产国增产的三分之二。
f3b8a13068df91405bffbb94c78c89a1a892bc87.translatedText: The International Energy Agency predicts that U.S. crude oil production will increase by 3.9 million barrels per day between 2012 and 2018, accounting for two-thirds of the increase in production by traditional non-OPEC crude oil producing countries.

5fac7b0fc59938c48ae9600bd71888f359a860c7.sourceText: 同时，全球原油需求将增8%，其中大部分将由非欧佩克出口国提供。
5fac7b0fc59938c48ae9600bd71888f359a860c7.translatedText: At the same time, global crude oil demand will increase by 8%, most of which will be provided by non-OPEC exporting countries.

cc69b8c070307afb2a3d003f283196ffdaa0de71.sourceText: 报告指出，欧佩克成员国的原油产量在今后五年内仍将保持增长，但速度会明显减慢，日产量增175万桶，比IEA去年的预计少75万桶。 主要原因是”阿拉伯之春”后北非及撒哈拉南部非洲安全状况不断恶化。
cc69b8c070307afb2a3d003f283196ffdaa0de71.translatedText: The report pointed out that the crude oil production of OPEC member countries will continue to grow in the next five years, but the rate will slow down significantly, with daily production increasing by 1.75 million barrels, 750,000 barrels less than the IEA expected last year. The main reason is the deteriorating security situation in North Africa and sub-Saharan Africa after the "Arab Spring".

629638cf2d7955ddf42001cdfd3c95bc866ce857.sourceText: 美国原油产量大增的主要原因是被许多人称为美国能源市场救星的页岩油。
629638cf2d7955ddf42001cdfd3c95bc866ce857.translatedText: The main reason for the surge in U.S. crude oil production is shale oil, which many people call the savior of the U.S. energy market.

ac87d26a117cb441eac5e1f4db63dd48aa9653a4.sourceText: 但页岩油开采作业的批评者指出，液压破碎法将导致用水量激增，可能会造成水污染、甲烷排放，还可能导致地颤。
ac87d26a117cb441eac5e1f4db63dd48aa9653a4.translatedText: But critics of shale oil extraction operations point out that fracking will lead to a surge in water consumption, which may cause water pollution, methane emissions and may cause ground shaking.

fd732fb5e5919c4a5cc107171d66b90c05aece62.sourceText: 法国已经禁止使用液压破碎法开采页岩油，但英国最近解除了对液压破碎法的临时禁令。
fd732fb5e5919c4a5cc107171d66b90c05aece62.translatedText: France has banned the use of hydraulic fracturing to extract shale oil, but the UK recently lifted its temporary ban on hydraulic fracturing.

According to Tencent Sports News, the Chinese college women's football team was invited by the Twelve League, one of the American College Sports Championships...

41f7b249d73f449e6b05f8a37e7b005f6676eb3e.sourceText: 据腾讯体育讯，中国大学生女子足球队受美国大体联冠军联盟之一一?#24085;克（微博）十二联盟的邀请，于 2016 年 8 月 21 日抵达美国，作为期一周的访问，在与加州伯克利分校女子足球队友谊赛首战告捷后，于 8 月 25 日下午到达亚利桑那州凤凰城， ASU 大学女子足球队接待了跨洋前来交流的中国北师大女子足球队， 8 月 27 日双方进行了一场精彩激烈的友谊赛。中国女子足球队靠团队努力，不怕吃苦耐劳, 永不放弃的精神，在 40 度高温天气下终以 1 ： 0 战胜 ASU 大学女足，凤城侨胞闻知来自祖国的孩子们來凤城比赛，都十分高兴，奔走相告，鼓掌加油，知名汗血天马画家范融先生和夫人彭长缨更是欣喜不已追踪拜访，范融先生更是挥毫泼墨作 [ 雄风万里图 ] 一幅，并盖上一枚美人如玉剑如虹大章以示欢迎和祝贺。范融开心地和领队教练郎健及其他几位教练们说，我有这枚章子已有十多年了这还是第一次派上用呢. 祝贺女足為华人争光！ 女足的教练和队员们表示感谢凤城僑胞们的热情和支持，并以一件签名队服回赠。据郎健教练介绍，北师大女足是中国最早的女足，曾五次蝉联北京女子足球赛冠军，三次蝉联全国女子足球赛冠军，郎健教练说这次是代表中国大学生女足首次访美，是来学习和交流的，希望用足球架起两国大学生交流的桥梁。 画家范融 挥毫泼墨作 [ 雄风万里图 ] 一幅
41f7b249d73f449e6b05f8a37e7b005f6676eb3e.translatedText: According to Tencent Sports News, the Chinese college women's football team was invited by the Twelve League, one of the American College Sports Championships (Weibo), and arrived in the United States on August 21, 2016. As a one-week visit, after winning the first friendly match with the University of California, Berkeley women's football team, on August 25 Arriving in Phoenix, Arizona on the afternoon of August 27, the ASU women's football team received the Beijing Normal University women's football team from China who came across the ocean for exchanges. On August 27, the two sides had a wonderful and fierce friendly match. The Chinese women's football team relied on team efforts, was not afraid of hard work, and never gave up, and finally defeated the ASU women's football team 1:0 in a 40-degree hot weather. The overseas Chinese in Fengcheng were very happy to hear that the children from the motherland were coming to Fengcheng to compete. One picture, and stamped with a large seal of Beauty Like Jade, Sword Like Rainbow, to express welcome and congratulations. Fan Rong happily told the team coach Lang Jian and several other coaches that I have had this badge for more than ten years and this is the first time I have put it to use. Congratulations to the women's football team for winning glory for the Chinese! The coaches and players of the women's football team expressed their gratitude to the overseas Chinese in Fengcheng for their enthusiasm and support and gave them a signed team uniform as a gift. According to coach Lang Jian, the Beijing Normal University women's football team is the earliest women's football team in China. It has won the Beijing Women's Football Championship five times and the National Women's Football Championship three times. Coach Lang Jian said that this is the first visit to the United States on behalf of the Chinese college women's football team. The purpose is to learn and exchange, and hopes to use football to build a bridge for exchanges between college students in the two countries. 157b36a63b242285b7775e1a7d5895397df2d202.translatedText: Feini Chinese School: Children's creativity (picture) (Principal of Feini Chinese School Cui Zengqi) One day in mid-March, on behalf of the school, I accepted a very precious gift...

0df4fc385a64a50e0f0e13ec32e3f259067d3769.sourceText: （ 斐匿中文学校校长 崔增祁）三月中旬的一天，我代表学校收下了一份十分珍贵的礼物。孩子们交给我一个塑料盒，里面装有五元八角钱和一封信，説这是他们四个学生送给学校的。我问了孩子们的家长，他们也不知究竟。现在我才弄清楚是四个孩子，八岁的Fedora，七岁的Latisha，六岁／Lawrence和五岁的Lucas在学校放春假时，自己想起动手做了一些小礼品，到街上去销售，把卖来的钱捐赠给学校。孩子们的创意是多么清新纯朴和令人感动。我把孩子们的信和一位家长的追记一并送贵刋发表，愿大家一起分享这份真情。
0df4fc385a64a50e0f0e13ec32e3f259067d3769.translatedText: (Principal of Feini Chinese School Cui Zengqi) One day in mid-March, on behalf of the school, I accepted a very precious gift. The children handed me a plastic box containing five yuan and eighty cents and a letter saying that it was given to the school by four of their students. I asked the children's parents and they didn't know. Now I find out that the four children, eight-year-old Fedora, seven-year-old Latisha, six-year-old Lawrence, and five-year-old Lucas, were on spring break at school. I thought of making some small gifts, selling them on the street, and donating the money from the sales to the school. The children's creativity is so fresh, simple and touching. I am sending the children's letters and a parent's posthumous note to you for publication. I hope everyone can share this true feeling.

ed672fcbd8edb42669c9fbb089eb85f56a38d699.sourceText: 前两个星期，正是我家小孩放春假。一天，我们把小孩放在邻居蓉姨家玩，晚上我们在蓉姨家吃饭，忽然听到街上有小孩大叫”Braccelace for sale”;刚想开门看一看是怎么回事。只见有一张小桌子摆在车房前面，Lawrence和 Lucas 来回奔跑，大叫’Braccelace for sale’，Fedora和 Latisha 站在桌子前面也放声大叫。看到我们要出来，连忙跑过来阻止，不让我们看他们的祕密行动。
ed672fcbd8edb42669c9fbb089eb85f56a38d699.translatedText: The past two weeks, it was my children’s spring break. One day, we left our children to play at our neighbor's Aunt Rong's house. We were having dinner at Aunt Rong's house in the evening, and suddenly we heard a child shouting "Bracelace for sale" on the street. We were about to open the door to see what was going on. There was a small table placed in front of the garage. Lawrence and Lucas were running back and forth, shouting "Braccelace for sale". Fedora and Latisha stood in front of the table and shouted loudly. Seeing that we were about to come out, they quickly ran over to stop us, preventing us from seeing their secret operations.

abff6a4c8cceae29837943cec512e3ad07d513fa.sourceText: 蓉姨告诉我们，那天他们一起玩的时矦，就决定自己动手做一些简单的 Braccelace，自己尝试在街上卖，我大声叫好。想不到我多年想孩子们多活跃一点的希望，得来全不费功夫。往后的几天，他们不断在街上叫卖，而且主动去敲邻居的门推销，居然赚得几块钱。更有趣的是，他们把钱全数捐赠给了斐匿中文学校，并受到校长握手表扬。通过这次经历，他们懂得了自己创建Business ，亲自体㑹到收获和捐助社会的欢乐。
abff6a4c8cceae29837943cec512e3ad07d513fa.translatedText: Aunt Rong told us that when they were playing together that day, she decided to make some simple Braccelace by herself and try to sell it on the street. I applauded loudly. Unexpectedly, my long-awaited wish for my children to be more active came to fruition without any effort. In the next few days, they kept hawking on the street and took the initiative to knock on neighbors' doors to sell, and actually made a few dollars. What’s even more interesting is that they donated all the money to Feinian Chinese School and were praised by the principal with a handshake. Through this experience, they learned how to build their own business and personally experienced the joy of harvesting and donating to society.

6331de5d4b6cb6d56a4f527512f29b3b0165b74d.translatedText: After eight years of European health insurance, the problem has become more serious

d56b799adc5d111304a84165b1f016bdb59c15b1.translatedText: After eight years of European health insurance, the problem has become more serious (Washington, 23rd) Today is the eighth anniversary of the legislation of "ObamaCare"...

22b840f4b31372640f0df6833e1419c84bc0af14.sourceText: （华盛顿二十三日电）今天是「奥巴马健保」（ObamaCare）立法八周年的日子，它有一个令人印象深刻的特色，就是能存活这么久。
22b840f4b31372640f0df6833e1419c84bc0af14.translatedText: (Washington, 23rd) Today is the eighth anniversary of the legislation of "ObamaCare" (ObamaCare). It has an impressive feature, that is, it can survive for so long.

f3d42afdf9c00fc765176873361f607142d3b9bc.sourceText: 美国人的情况比「奥巴马健保」实施前还要糟。健保费和自付款节节上升，可供消费者选择的健保变少了。更多人受「联邦医疗补助」（Medicaid）照护，但它只是一种代价高昂，而且不可持续的福利，在许多情况下，对于患者的健康而言，比没有保险的情况还糟。美国人的预期寿命，在半个多世纪以来，已连续两年下降。
f3d42afdf9c00fc765176873361f607142d3b9bc.translatedText: Americans are worse off than before Obamacare was implemented. Health insurance premiums and deductibles are rising, and consumers have fewer health insurance options to choose from. More people are covered by Medicaid, but it is a costly and unsustainable benefit that is, in many cases, worse for patients' health than without insurance. American life expectancy has declined for two consecutive years in more than half a century.

a1f2956d6395499103ac7c325c98d7295cd2052e.sourceText: 这些后果，「奥巴马健保」要承担很大的责任。
a1f2956d6395499103ac7c325c98d7295cd2052e.translatedText: "Obamacare" will bear a great responsibility for these consequences.

4b34add63debfffa2bba198d7c3e4a85af179c9d.sourceText: 「可负担健保法案」（Affordable Care Act）最明显的缺点，就是未能兑现其名称的承诺-「可负担」。奥巴马总统在2010年，曾向美国人保证，该法律的健保交易所将创造「竞争市场」，美国人可购买价格合理的优质保险。
4b34add63debfffa2bba198d7c3e4a85af179c9d.translatedText: >The most obvious shortcoming of the "Affordable Care Act" is that it fails to fulfill the promise of its name - "affordability." President Obama assured Americans in 2010 that the law's health insurance exchanges would create a "competitive market" where Americans could buy quality insurance at affordable prices.

179566d76cc7b02cc1f27626089772719d126022.sourceText: 然而，在联邦健保网洛的市场，2017年的平均保费收入，比2016年高出百分之25，并且比2013年的平均保费超过两倍，相比2017年，2018年「奥巴马健保」银级健保的保费，增加了百分之34。而且，实付费用也一路飙升，今年个人银级计划的平均免赔额，接近4，000元。
179566d76cc7b02cc1f27626089772719d126022.translatedText: However, in the federal Medicare market, the average premium income in 2017 was 25% higher than in 2016, and more than twice the average premium in 2013. Compared with 2017, the premium for "Obamacare" silver-level health insurance increased by 34% in 2018. Moreover, out-of-pocket expenses have also soared. The average deductible for individual silver-level plans this year is close to 4,000 yuan.

f2a450486179ef94330fc0585b8c2c108dc65b35.sourceText: 「奥巴马健保」的高保费和高免赔额，已使数百万人被排除在健保之外。在去年6月，有四分之一的美国人说，由于成本的原因，他们或家人中缺乏必要医疗护理。
f2a450486179ef94330fc0585b8c2c108dc65b35.translatedText: >The high premiums and high deductibles of "Obamacare" have excluded millions of people from health insurance. Last June, one in four Americans said they or a family member lacked necessary medical care because of cost.

7f3103958b181df0049de12a83beece7a2506b23.sourceText: 这种健保没有其他的竞争者。「奥巴马健保」使保险业者损失数以亿元计，许多业者已逃离「奥巴马健保」系统，全美只有一半的县份只有一个「奥巴马健保」业者提供服务。
7f3103958b181df0049de12a83beece7a2506b23.translatedText: This kind of health insurance has no other competitors. "Obamacare" has caused insurance companies to lose hundreds of millions of dollars. Many insurance companies have fled the "Obamacare" system. Only half of the counties in the United States have only one "Obamacare" provider to provide services.

c5f8349c0ba12085140cedeaea92e4c928b2bedb.sourceText: 长期以来，「奥巴马健保」的捍卫者一直将没有健保率下降，作为「奥巴马健保」成功的证据，但是它再也无法坚持下去。去年，美国没有健保者增加320万人，关键因素就是健保成本太高，难以负担。
c5f8349c0ba12085140cedeaea92e4c928b2bedb.translatedText: Defenders of "Obamacare" have long pointed to declining uninsured rates as evidence of "Obamacare's" success, but it can no longer hold up. Last year, the number of people without health insurance in the United States increased by 3.2 million. The key factor is that the cost of health insurance is too high and unaffordable.

af5eca6ce473f9334284e0891485e05e99290fb3.sourceText: 而且，依照「奥巴马健保」法律，使1，500万人进入Medicaid系统，这项本来只照顾美国低所得的制度，如今，也因为大量民众涌入，使这项本来是美国人的福利，变成一种诅咒。
af5eca6ce473f9334284e0891485e05e99290fb3.translatedText: Moreover, in accordance with the "Obama Health Care" law, 15 million people have entered the Medicaid system. This system, which originally only catered for low-income Americans, has now become a curse due to the influx of a large number of people, which was originally a welfare for Americans.

e6df6883a188c6dc36d7190439bb08fa62791bd8.sourceText: 最近一项研究显示，在俄勒冈州发现，获Medicaid照护的人，健康情况本来就比许多没有健保的人更差。两年后再做研究，发现Medicaid照护的患者，与没有保险的患者相比，「并未显着改善他们的健康状况」。
e6df6883a188c6dc36d7190439bb08fa62791bd8.translatedText: A recent study in Oregon found that people receiving Medicaid care are already in worse health than many people without health insurance. A repeat study two years later found that Medicaid patients "did not significantly improve their health" compared with uninsured patients.

721f2a5e0427c2098e52ad4819291f79fdb5b7e4.sourceText: 根据参院国土安全委员会的报告，更糟的是，「奥巴马健保」使许多州份扩大Medicaid业务，加剧美国使用致命鸦片类的疫情。「奥巴马健保」扩大Medicaid业务，使处方止痛药更便宜和更广泛地使用，并且有非法进入黑市的情况。
721f2a5e0427c2098e52ad4819291f79fdb5b7e4.translatedText: According to the report of the Senate Homeland Security Committee, to make matters worse, "Obamacare" has allowed many states to expand Medicaid services, exacerbating the epidemic of deadly opioid use in the United States. Obamacare expanded Medicaid, made prescription painkillers cheaper and more widely available, and illegally entered the black market.

4c78f3ae402746cb557d09ce5559216e4116fc7a.sourceText: Medicaid诈骗案也和致命鸦片类用药大增有关，自「奥巴马健保」实施后，这类药物增加了百分之55。而全美Medicaid诈骗案，有百分之80是发生在扩大Medicaid业务的州份发生，是未参加扩大Medicaid业务州份的两倍。
4c78f3ae402746cb557d09ce5559216e4116fc7a.translatedText: Medicaid fraud is also linked to a surge in the use of deadly opioids, which have increased by 55 percent since the implementation of Obamacare. Eighty percent of the U.S. Medicaid fraud cases occurred in states that expanded Medicaid services, twice the rate in states that did not participate in expanding Medicaid services.

0f907ad3217ce7fd4d304d749b5dc3d6208a86a7.sourceText: 自从「奥巴马健保」生效之后，健保费用变得更昂贵，投保人的负担加重，美国人的健康情况变得更差。
0f907ad3217ce7fd4d304d749b5dc3d6208a86a7.translatedText: Since "Obamacare" took effect, health insurance has become more expensive, the burden on policyholders has increased, and the health of Americans has become worse.

8e6ddb8cfe4a8e5207885fdd5ddc131dc5ecd656.sourceText: （编者按）努力学习了二十多年他终于成为了台湾清华大学计算机系的博士生，然而就在读博的第二年，他毅然选择放弃计算机的博士学位，完全投入音乐的学习，是什么让他做出了这样的选择？本期《太阳鸟纪事》黄光立与您一起分享这段特别的经历。
8e6ddb8cfe4a8e5207885fdd5ddc131dc5ecd656.translatedText: (Editor's note) After studying hard for more than 20 years, he finally became a doctoral student in the Department of Computer Science at Tsinghua University in Taiwan. However, in the second year of his Ph.D., he decided to give up his Ph.D. in computer science and devote himself entirely to the study of music. What made him make such a choice? In this issue of "Sunbird Chronicle" Huang Guangli shares this special experience with you.

78203432eaff1d8098ce98bb9e5a3e8a29e7cd23.sourceText: （太阳鸟记者 木香报道） 清瘦的身形，内敛儒雅的气质，这便是我们初在一次”太阳鸟”举办的茶文化讲座上见黄光立为我们演奏钢琴曲时，他给我们留下的印象。生于70年代末的他，与我几乎是同龄人，这个时代的人，在成长的人生道路上，随着各种社会文化的变迁，也更愿意挑战自己，勇于去创造自己丰富的人生。黄光立其实是ASU音乐系的钢琴在读博士，闲暇之余，教教朋友钢琴。普通人总是对艺术有着美好的向往和无限的崇拜，但在异国他乡的土地上，走上艺术这条道路却并不平坦，需要拥有无比的勇气和克服异常艰难的决心。好奇心促使我们想了解，这样一个看似并不张扬，带着浓重书卷气的男子是如何在这条崎岖的道路上坚持至今的。
78203432eaff1d8098ce98bb9e5a3e8a29e7cd23.translatedText: (Sunbird reporter Mu Xiang reported) Slender figure, restrained and elegant temperament, this is the impression that Huang Guangli left on us when we first saw Huang Guangli playing piano music for us at a tea culture lecture held by Sunbird. Born in the late 1970s, he is almost the same age as me. People of this era are more willing to challenge themselves and have the courage to create their own rich lives along with various social and cultural changes as they grow up. Huang Guangli is actually a PhD candidate in piano in the ASU Music Department. In his spare time, he teaches piano to his friends. Ordinary people always have a beautiful yearning and infinite admiration for art, but in a foreign land, embarking on the road of art is not smooth. It requires incomparable courage and determination to overcome extremely difficult difficulties. Curiosity prompted us to want to know how such a seemingly unassuming and bookish man persisted on this rugged road to this day.

b707715d731502bb8e552071eaaa462e9913291a.sourceText: 正如很多从小就学习钢琴的人一样，黄光立也从7岁便开始练琴，一直坚持了6年。又如很多因为现实的学习压力而被迫放弃了将钢琴发展成专业的人一样，他在小学6年级那年，将学习的重心转移到了升学压力上。国中，高中，大学，朝着家人所期望的方向，选择了电机系，之后又继续考上了国立清华大学计算机系的硕士，博士。然而，所有在童年经历过音乐熏陶和洗礼的人也许都了解，不管今后是否能成为音乐家，他们所学过的乐器，已经变成他们生活中不可或缺的一部分。那是一片圣地，也是他们心中纯净的源泉，在无声无息之中，已经渗透到了他们的生命和生活中。那种艺术的张力，虽偶尔会被压抑，但只要时机和条件允许，就会强烈地爆发出来。而黄光立正是如此，大学毕业之后，当升学的压力不再时时逼近，他在业余时间开始重新温习已多年不曾亲近的钢琴。其时，因着某种因缘际会，黄光立认识了他的一位恩师，正是这位恩师的出现，为他重新走上音乐的道路开启了一扇大门。
b707715d731502bb8e552071eaaa462e9913291a.translatedText: >Just like many people who have learned piano since childhood, Huang Guangli started practicing piano at the age of 7 and has been practicing for 6 years. Like many people who were forced to give up developing piano as a major due to real learning pressure, when he was in the sixth grade of elementary school, he shifted the focus of his studies to the pressure of entering higher schools. After going to junior high school, high school, and university, I chose the Department of Electrical Engineering in the direction that my family expected. After that, I went on to get a master's degree and a Ph.D. in the Department of Computer Science at National Tsinghua University. However, everyone who has experienced the influence and baptism of music in childhood may understand that regardless of whether they can become musicians in the future, the instruments they have learned have become an indispensable part of their lives. It was a holy land and a source of purity in their hearts. It had penetrated into their lives silently. That kind of artistic tension, although occasionally suppressed, will burst out strongly as long as the time and conditions allow. This is exactly the case for Huang Guangli. After graduating from college, when the pressure to further his education no longer loomed, he began to review the piano again in his spare time, which he had not been close to for many years. At that time, due to some kind of fate, Huang Guangli met one of his mentors. It was the appearance of this mentor that opened a door for him to embark on the road of music again.

bede3a9032b669a2b358c0f71742e4df074bdcbc.sourceText: 虽然有幼时的功底，但毕竟荒废多年，想要重拾，也不是一件容易的事，与一路走音乐专业上来的人比，黄光立欠缺了多年的积累，比他人多了一个断层。然而因着一种对音乐执着的信念和无比的热情，在恩师的帮助下，黄光立将他的音乐天赋和理工科的逻辑思维糅合又诠释在对钢琴的演奏里，形成了一种独特的理解。依靠着这个信念的支持，终于在台湾清华大学就读计算机博士的第二年，他考上了台湾辅仁大学的音乐硕士。
bede3a9032b669a2b358c0f71742e4df074bdcbc.translatedText: Although he has a good foundation in childhood, it has been neglected for many years and it is not easy to pick it up again. Compared with people who have studied music all the way, Huang Guangli lacks the accumulation of many years and has one more gap than others. However, due to his persistent belief and unparalleled enthusiasm for music, and with the help of his mentor, Huang Guangli combined and interpreted his musical talent and logical thinking in science and engineering into his piano performance, forming a unique understanding. Relying on the support of this belief, in the second year of studying for a PhD in computer science at Tsinghua University in Taiwan, he was admitted to the Master of Music at Fu Jen Catholic University in Taiwan.

b80f254ef5ce00e5467cb8f65175d019dcc89f17.sourceText: ”其实，当初我选择在清华大学读博士，就是因为我喜欢那所学校有平台钢琴（三角钢琴）。”黄光立的声音里透着一种不可动摇的坚持。在旁人看来如此渺小的理由，却成为了他选择学校最大的动力。让人相信，即使在与社会大众随波逐流的压力下，仍然无法淹没他潜意识里对音乐，对钢琴的激情。
b80f254ef5ce00e5467cb8f65175d019dcc89f17.translatedText: "Actually, I chose to study for a doctoral degree at Tsinghua University because I liked the platform piano (grand piano) in that school." Huang Guangli's voice revealed an unshakable persistence. What seemed like such a small reason to others became the biggest motivation for him to choose a school. It is believed that even under the pressure of going with the crowd, his subconscious passion for music and piano could not be drowned.

7905307b711b893fa8530f601f00add690246e61.sourceText: ”那么，是什么让你最终决定放弃你读了多年的计算机，转而重新寻求读音乐呢？”在黄光立考上音乐硕士以后，他毅然选择了放弃计算机博士学位，开始了另一条崭新而并不陌生的人生轨道。
7905307b711b893fa8530f601f00add690246e61.translatedText: "So, what made you finally decide to give up studying computer science, which you have studied for many years, and instead seek to study music again?" After Huang Guangli was admitted to the master's degree in music, he resolutely chose to give up his doctorate in computer science and start another new and familiar life track.

2148412f3c3946c15c63b67975b11fc79c97bf53.sourceText: ”也许，是我厌倦了走一条可以预见到老的人生轨迹，虽然，这种生活也许在物质上会更加充实，我亲眼见到许许多多拥有着高薪水，却每天加班到深夜的以前的同行，那样的生活在我看来并不值得羡慕。”
2148412f3c3946c15c63b67975b11fc79c97bf53.translatedText: " Maybe I am tired of following a predictable life path. Although this kind of life may be more fulfilling materially, I have personally seen many of my former colleagues who have high salaries but work overtime until late at night every day. In my opinion, life is not something to be envied. "

99307fbbeebe0ac38fb9991a54ce5d0f4b6a1823.sourceText: ”那如此说来，你是更喜欢一种无法预见，能给自己挑战并且有充实的精神享受的人生了？”
99307fbbeebe0ac38fb9991a54ce5d0f4b6a1823.translatedText: " In that case, you prefer a life that is unpredictable, provides you with challenges and has fulfilling spiritual enjoyment? "

7863f71892032fe6269d9c6445e8c8588254ddb9.sourceText: ”但是音乐这条路并不好走，你在享受丰富的精神生活的同时，是否意识到将来会面临的现实的生存压力？而且，你家人也支持你做出这样的选择？放弃了可以预见的充裕而稳定的物质生活？”我提出了心中的疑问。
7863f71892032fe6269d9c6445e8c8588254ddb9.translatedText: "But the path of music is not easy. While you are enjoying a rich spiritual life, are you aware of the real survival pressure you will face in the future? Moreover, your family also supports you in making such a choice? Giving up the foreseeable abundant and stable material life?" I raised the question in my mind.

5e0e6f2c46ea573a7b6f49d68c642f2254dafeab.sourceText: 黄光立淡淡地一笑：”我家人也是无奈的支持吧，因着我的坚持，不过将来的生存压力是肯定会有的，但我并不后悔。”
5e0e6f2c46ea573a7b6f49d68c642f2254dafeab.translatedText: Huang Guangli smiled faintly: "My family also has no choice but to support me. Because of my persistence, there will definitely be pressure to survive in the future, but I have no regrets."

9cebfe16136ccda242e5d77a3fa9811f895e5b4b.sourceText: 黄光立表示，他热爱音乐，也热爱教育。他希望把他对音乐的理解和如何重新回归艺术的经验传达给也想学习音乐的人。下一步的计划，是出一本书，教大家如何欣赏钢琴演奏，以及钢琴演奏家是如何将内在的感情和特定的手势缺一不可地完美地结合成一曲曲音乐的篇章的。另外，凭着多年的工科背景，他也在自学录音工程专业的知识，当然，还是要继续完成钢琴博士学位的。
9cebfe16136ccda242e5d77a3fa9811f895e5b4b.translatedText: Huang Guangli said that he loves music and education. He hopes to convey his understanding of music and his experience of returning to art to people who also want to learn music. The next plan is to publish a book to teach everyone how to appreciate piano performance and how pianists perfectly combine inner feelings and specific gestures into pieces of music. In addition, with many years of engineering background, he is also studying recording engineering on his own. Of course, he still has to complete a doctorate in piano.

a5cd4d1e0c0c9e7384d641f393a58cae0104a671.sourceText: 临别，黄光立用他对音乐的独到见解，为我们演奏了一曲优美动听的钢琴曲。看着有力的手指在黑白的琴键上飞舞，时而跳跃的手指，时而悠扬的手臂，听着抑扬顿挫，间或柔情似水的琴声，让我们相信，他真的是用对音乐的激情在谱写对生活的热爱。著名奥地利作曲家莫扎特曾说过，”如果爱是一种力量，那音乐则是一种动力”，是音乐的动力让黄光立选择了去给自己创造全新的生活。有时候，这就是人生，有的人选择安逸而平稳的人生，有的人选择富有激情而挑战的人生。
a5cd4d1e0c0c9e7384d641f393a58cae0104a671.translatedText: Farewell, Huang Guangli used his unique insights into music to play a beautiful piano piece for us. Watching the powerful fingers flying on the black and white keys, sometimes jumping fingers, sometimes melodious arms, and listening to the mellow and sometimes tender sound of the piano, we believe that he is really using his passion for music to compose his love for life. The famous Austrian composer Mozart once said, "If love is a kind of power, then music is a kind of motivation." It was the motivation of music that made Huang Guangli choose to create a new life for himself. Sometimes, this is life, some people choose a comfortable and stable life, and some people choose a passionate and challenging life.

ceeee2803d8adb56b729ac2768bf17dc22911977.sourceText: 《太阳鸟纪事》:在某个时间，某个空间，我们在这里，美国亚利桑那州，有的人留下来了，有的人海归了，在时间和空间的交界点中，有很多分秒组成的故事，在太阳鸟亚省华人网的《太阳鸟纪事》中，我们看到张肇鸿，气如虹，文若，慧明，凤鸣，心水等很多老侨用文字记录他们的生活，首先感谢他们的记录，让我们看到了一代移民的成长足迹。在凤凰城还有一些在高科技区忙碌的新移民，以及来学习的留学生，他们带着７０后，８０后，９０后的华裔的气息，来到这里，他们面对的人生变化和选择，正在发生。”太阳鸟亚省华人网”希望能记录下这些，调动采访力量来记录这个时间和空间里的故事。如果你身边有有意思的人，或者有意思的故事，请与我们联系，一起分享《太阳鸟纪事》。
ceeee2803d8adb56b729ac2768bf17dc22911977.translatedText: "Sunbird Chronicle": At a certain time, in a certain space, we are here in Arizona, USA. Some people stayed and some returned from overseas. At the intersection of time and space, there are many stories composed of minutes and seconds. In the "Sunbird Chronicles" published by the Sunbird Asia Chinese website, we see Zhang Zhaohong, Qi Ruhong, Wen Ruo, Huiming, Fengming, Xinshui and many other old overseas Chinese recording their lives in words. First of all, we would like to thank them for their records, which allow us to see the growth footprints of a generation of immigrants. In Phoenix, there are also some new immigrants who are busy in the high-tech district, as well as international students who come to study. They come here with the aura of Chinese people born in the 1970s, 1980s, and 1990s. The life changes and choices they face are happening now. "Sunbird Asia Chinese Network" hopes to record these and mobilize the power of interviews to record the stories in this time and space. If you have interesting people or interesting stories around you, please contact us and share "Sunbird Chronicles" together.

65e5107123bbc8cffe18a44fb186dbbe3c38d19c.sourceText: 新东方艺术学校中秋晚会本周末进行最后一次彩排

55a9326ce2415f76fee262f2ac132cacb21526df.sourceText: 新东方艺术学校中秋晚会本周末进行最后一次彩排 中秋来临，佳节将至。新东方艺术学校将于今年的中秋节之夜在CHANDLER艺术中心为大家奉献一台中秋晚会。新东方校长吕丽华告诉记者，”这场晚会实际上也是学校的学年汇报演出。同时进行的还有学生画展。此次晚会的目的主要是为了展示在过去的一学年里学生们的学习成绩和检阅教师们的教学成果，同时也为明年的春节晚会做好准备。同时更是为了回报亚省华人社区多年来对新东方艺术学校的支持和关爱。” 在谈到中秋晚会与蛇年春晚的关系时，吕校长说，”春晚是面向全社会的，考虑到春晚的综合性与娱乐性，它必然与中秋晚会不同。”春晚是集声乐、器乐、舞蹈、武术、技巧等于一体的大型综艺晚会。内容更丰富，形式更多样。除了新东方自己的节目外，美国社区、华人社区及中国艺术家都将加盟。比如CHANDLER儿童合唱团中的美国指挥和孩子们已经再为蛇年春晚做准备了。 这次中秋晚会学校将会不遗余力地为观众呈现中国各民族舞蹈、武术、钢琴表演等节目。整台晚会的演员将全部由新东方艺术学校的学生组成。晚会的导演、舞美设计将由学校的老师自行担任。为了成功举办这次演出，学校的老师和学生已经进行了数月的苦练。目前，演出的准备工作已经到了最后的冲刺阶段，节目彩排，广告宣传，舞台设计等，学校和数家协办单位正在紧锣密鼓地进行中，本周六将进行最后一次彩排。 最后，吕丽华校长说：”感谢社会各界的支持，感谢孔子学院的鼎力相助。感谢家长的大力协助，感谢班妈们辛苦的工作！” 另外，晚会开始之前，将在剧院前厅举行学生画展，同行进行的还有由ASU的教授DR.JILL STAMM和她的学生主持的幼儿早期教育咨询活动。 演出时间：9月30日 星期天下午 3:00pm—-4:00pm 学生画展 4:00pm—-6:00pm 晚会 演出地点：Chandler Center for the Arts 250 North Arizona Avenue Chandler, AZ 85225 本场晚会入场劵免费，欢迎捐款，每票$5。 取票地点：新东方艺术学校 联系电话：602-490-8613 Email:azeaainfo@gmail.com 新东方艺术学校网址： www.eaaaz.com
55a9326ce2415f76fee262f2ac132cacb21526df.translatedText: New Oriental Art School Mid-Autumn Party. The Mid-Autumn Festival is approaching and the festival is approaching. New Oriental Art School will present a Mid-Autumn Festival Party to everyone at the CHANDLER Art Center on the night of this year's Mid-Autumn Festival. New Oriental Principal Lu Lihua told reporters, "This party is actually the school's school year report performance. There is also a student painting exhibition. The purpose of this party is mainly to display the academic performance of students in the past school year and review the teaching results of teachers, and to prepare for next year's Spring Festival Gala. At the same time, it is also to repay the Chinese community in Alberta for their support and care for New Oriental Art School over the years." When talking about the relationship between the Mid-Autumn Festival Gala and the Spring Festival Gala of the Year of the Snake, President Lu said, "The Spring Festival Gala is for the whole society. Considering the comprehensiveness and entertainment of the Spring Festival Gala, it must be different from the Mid-Autumn Festival Gala." The Spring Festival Gala is a large-scale variety show that integrates vocal music, instrumental music, dance, martial arts, and skills. Richer content and more diverse forms. In addition to New Oriental's own programs, the American community, Chinese community and Chinese artists will all join. For example, the American conductor and children in the CHANDLER Children's Choir are already preparing for the Spring Festival Gala of the Year of the Snake. The school will spare no effort to present Chinese ethnic dances, martial arts, piano performances and other programs to the audience during this Mid-Autumn Festival Gala. The entire cast of the show will be composed entirely of students from the New Oriental Art School. The party's director and stage design will be performed by the school's teachers themselves. In order to successfully hold this performance, the teachers and students of the school have been practicing hard for several months. At present, preparations for the performance have reached the final sprint stage, including program rehearsals, advertising, stage design, etc. The school and several co-organizers are in full swing, and the final rehearsal will be held this Saturday. Finally, Principal Lu Lihua said: "Thank you to all walks of life for your support, and thank you to the Confucius Institute for your help. Thank you to the parents for their strong assistance, and thank you to the class mothers for their hard work!" In addition, before the party begins, a student art exhibition will be held in the front hall of the theater, and there will also be an early childhood education consultation activity hosted by ASU professor DR.JILL STAMM and her students. Performance Time: Sunday, September 30th, 3:00pm--4:00pm Student Art Exhibition 4:00pm--6:00pm Party Performance Location: Chandler Center for the Arts 250 North Arizona Avenue Chandler, AZ 85225 Admission to this evening is free, donations are welcome, $5 per ticket. Ticket collection location: New Oriental Art School Contact number: 602-490-8613 Email: azeaainfo@gmail.com New Oriental Art School website: www.eaaaz.com
