3a2dd9aa426058a47b49b3bc16bd49998dac68d8.sourceText: 国会减赤委员会似乎未能完成至少削减1兆2000亿元赤字的使命，两党20日相互指责对方，准备21日宣布因在增税和削减福利上存在严重分歧，无法在23日的最后期限 前达成协议。 减赤委员会的一事无成可能加剧股市动荡，也可能使美国国债再度面临降评危机。 减赤委员会的失败可能导致国防和许多政府部门的2013年预算面临自动削减，以降低1兆2000亿元开支。 也可能导致只有9%的国会支持率进一步下跌，使明年面临竞选连任的议员受到伤害，同时严重影响到欧巴马总统的连任，他的刺激经济计画导致联邦预算赤字大增。 减赤委提出减赤方案的最后期限是23日，但委员会应在21日就提出计画，以使国会预算处有时间对减赤计画进行评估。 减赤委员会内部的分歧严重，多数共和党人不同意民主党要求的增税，而民主党也不接受共和党人大幅削减福利计画，如社安、老年人的联邦医疗保险(Medicare)， 和给穷人的医疗补助计画(Medicaid)。 随着明年的选举在即，两党议员都很难做出让步。 今年夏天在发生国债危机期间，国际三大评估机构之一的史坦普公司调降了美国国债的评等，从三A级降至AA+。 但调降没使减赤委员会产生压力，两党主要议员20日纷纷在周日脱口秀节目上指责对方。 共和党参议员凯尔在NBC电视台「会见新闻界」中说：「看看民主党的立场，就是『我们必须增税』。国会必须通过的就业法案，又几乎将增加5000亿元预算。我们 对改革福利制度没有兴趣。」 民主党人认为，没有达成减赤协议，是因为共和党人拒绝考虑增税。 民主党参议员帕蒂． 穆雷在CNN电视台节目中说：「两党存在严重分歧，我认为双方都必须做出牺牲，年收入逾百万元的富人也必须做出牺牲，但共和党人不愿让步。」 共和党众议员亨萨林说：「没人愿做出让步。减赤委陷入僵局，是因为没有抓住机遇。」 国防部长潘尼达和许多议员认为，开始自动削减预算将给五角大厦和其他政府机构带来灾难性的后果。
3a2dd9aa426058a47b49b3bc16bd49998dac68d8.translatedText: The Congressional Deficit Reduction Committee seems to have failed to complete the mission of reducing the deficit by at least 1.2 trillion yuan. The two parties accused each other on the 20th and prepared to announce on the 21st that they could not reach an agreement before the deadline of the 23rd due to serious differences on tax increases and welfare cuts. The failure of the Deficit Reduction Committee to accomplish anything may intensify the turmoil in the stock market and may also put U.S. Treasury bonds at risk of another downgrade. Failure of the deficit reduction committee could result in automatic cuts to defense and many government departments' 2013 budgets to reduce spending by $1.2 trillion. It may also lead to a further decline in the approval rating of Congress, which is only 9%, hurting members facing re-election next year, and seriously affecting the re-election of President Obama, whose economic stimulus plan has led to a large increase in the federal budget deficit. The deadline for the Deficit Reduction Committee to propose a deficit reduction plan is the 23rd, but the committee should submit a plan on the 21st to allow the Congressional Budget Office time to evaluate the deficit reduction plan. The divisions within the deficit reduction committee are serious. Most Republicans do not agree with the tax increases demanded by Democrats, while Democrats do not accept Republicans' drastic cuts to welfare programs such as Social Security, Medicare for the elderly, and Medicaid for the poor. With elections looming next year, it will be difficult for lawmakers from both parties to make concessions. During the national debt crisis this summer, S&P, one of the three major international rating agencies, downgraded the rating of U.S. Treasury bonds from triple-A to AA+. However, the reduction did not put pressure on the deficit reduction committee. On the 20th, major members of the two parties criticized each other on Sunday talk shows. Republican Senator Kyle said on NBC's "Meet the Press": "Look at the Democratic position, which is, 'We must raise taxes.' The jobs bill that Congress must pass will almost increase the budget by another 500 billion yuan. We have no interest in reforming the welfare system." Democrats believe that the lack of a deficit reduction agreement is because Republicans refuse to consider raising taxes. Democratic Senator Patty. Murray said on the CNN TV program: "There are serious differences between the two parties. I think both sides must make sacrifices, and wealthy people with annual incomes of more than one million dollars must also make sacrifices, but Republicans are unwilling to make concessions." Republican Congressman Hensarling said: "No one is willing to make concessions. The deficit reduction committee is deadlocked because it has not seized the opportunity." Defense Secretary Pennida and many lawmakers believe that starting automatic budget cuts will have disastrous consequences for the Pentagon and other government agencies.

2189a44890faeccfa7e6d19e468a448df6a13fce.sourceText: 十九路军与淞沪战役 （一） 十九路军为何驻沪（下） 余玉书 从以上的历史背景看来，绝对不是蒋介石特意安排十九路军镇守上海，来与日军打一场硬仗。因为蒋的策略是以空间换取时间来准备长期抗战，例如物资的积聚与转移内地等。但更重要的是先安内，然后振外。所谓”安内”也者，其实就是”剿共”。第一，蒋介石想不到广州的”国民政府”中的粤桂派只信任广东部队镇守京沪来监视他，但以为陈铭枢一向对他”忠贞”，应该不会出问题，于是十九路军就这样阴差阳错地调来了大上海的周围，市区则以华界为限。（其余地区则包括英租界、法租界与日租界）第二，蒋介石想不到十九路军这支广东部队，虽然由官长到士兵，每天满口不离”刁那妈！”可是骁勇善战，视死如归，与日军作战，不但一点不害怕，而且以一挡十，勇往直前。引起战端的日本第一遣外舰队司令盐泽幸一扬言四天内可战领上海，甚至蒋介石自己在一九三二年一月二十一至二十三日在上海时事新报所发表之谈话指出：当时中国军队之装备如果与日本开战，日本在十天以内便可以亡中国。不过客观而论之，如果日本不去偷袭珍珠港，不去燃起东南亚的战火，而倾全力用来攻打中国的话。蒋氏这番话倒不是危言耸听，不过中国人值得骄傲的是，十九路军这批广东佬，却在援兵有限的困境之下，苦撑了三十三天，我不曾败，敌也不曾胜，就算是打成和局平手，也是甲午之战以来，绝无仅有之事，中国军队也算是胜利了。 当日本平民及军队在上海一再制造事端之后，由于忍无可忍，广东人脾气一向爽直火爆，十九军军长蔡廷锴遂于一月二十三日上电南京中央：”据报，日本海军及陆战队强迫我接受不能忍受之条件，并闻将取断然处置，职等为国家人格计，如该寇来犯，决在上海附近抵抗，即使牺牲全军，亦非所顾！” 陈铭枢别号真如，蔡廷锴的军部却设在真茹。一月二十六日，日本驻上海总领事井仓松向上海市政府提出最后通牒，要求解散排斥日货团体、道歉、惩凶、赔款等五项，限二十八日下午六时前答复。蒋介石接报后，一方面命上海市长吴铁城在当日下午覆牒完全承认后，一方面急派宪兵第六团前往真茹接替第十九军为防务。岂料正在防务交接之际，日军不理会覆牒，仍然原定计划进攻，于是蔡廷锴军长便在真茹指挥，并发出全线抵抗的命令，连刚抵达的宪兵第六团也加入与十九路军并肩作战。蒋介石在翌日的日记中有记述：”闻昨日对上海日领事要求，我方已予承认，彼亦已满足，且表示傍晚撤兵，何乃至午夜又冲突也。”
2189a44890faeccfa7e6d19e468a448df6a13fce.translatedText: The Nineteenth Route Army and the Battle of Songhu (1) Why the Nineteenth Route Army was stationed in Shanghai (Part 2) Yu Yushu From the above historical background, it is definitely not Chiang Kai-shek who specially arranged for the Nineteenth Route Army to guard Shanghai to fight a tough battle with the Japanese army. Because Chiang's strategy was to trade space for time to prepare for a long-term war of resistance, such as the accumulation of supplies and transfer to the mainland. But the more important thing is to calm down the inside first and then revitalize the outside. What is called "an internal peace" actually means "suppressing communism". First, Chiang Kai-shek did not expect that the Guangdong-Guangxi faction in the "National Government" in Guangzhou would only trust the Guangdong troops to guard Beijing and Shanghai to monitor him. However, he thought that Chen Mingshu had always been "loyal" to him and there should be no problems. Therefore, the 19th Route Army was accidentally transferred to the area around Greater Shanghai, and the urban area was limited to the Chinese border. (The rest of the areas include the British Concession, the French Concession and the Japanese Concession) Secondly, Chiang Kai-shek could not have imagined that the Guangdong force of the 19th Route Army, from officers to soldiers, kept saying "Diao Na Ma!" every day, but they were brave and good at fighting. The commander of Japan's First Foreign Fleet, Koichi Shiozawa, who caused the war, threatened to conquer Shanghai within four days. Chiang Kai-shek himself even stated in a statement published in the Shanghai Current Affairs Newspaper from January 21 to 23, 1932: If the equipment of the Chinese army at that time went to war with Japan, Japan would be able to conquer China within ten days. But objectively speaking, if Japan did not attack Pearl Harbor and ignite the war in Southeast Asia, but instead devoted all its strength to attacking China. Chiang's words are not alarmist, but what the Chinese people should be proud of is that the 19th Route Army, a group of Cantonese soldiers, managed to hold on for thirty-three days under the predicament of limited reinforcements. We were never defeated, and the enemy was never defeated. Even if it was a draw, it was the only thing that had happened since the Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1894. The Chinese army could be considered a victory. After the Japanese civilians and troops repeatedly caused trouble in Shanghai, the Cantonese people had always been outspoken and hot-tempered because they could no longer bear it. The commander of the 19th Army, Cai Tingkai, sent a telegram to the Nanjing Central Committee on January 23: "It is reported that the Japanese navy and marines forced me to accept intolerable conditions and will be dealt with decisively. The rank is a measure of national character. If the bandits invade, they will resist near Shanghai. Even if the entire army is sacrificed, it will not be considered!" Chen Mingshu was nicknamed Zhenru, but Cai Tingkai's military headquarters was located in Zhenru. On January 26, Japan’s Consul General in Shanghai, Matsu Ikura, issued an ultimatum to the Shanghai Municipal Government, demanding five items including the dissolution of anti-Japanese goods groups, an apology, punishment of the perpetrators, and compensation, with a deadline to respond before 6 p.m. on the 28th. After receiving the report, Chiang Kai-shek ordered Shanghai Mayor Wu Tiecheng to fully acknowledge the ultimatum in the afternoon of the same day, and on the other hand, he urgently dispatched the Sixth Military Police Regiment to Zhenru to take over the 19th Army's defense. Unexpectedly, during the handover of defense, the Japanese army ignored the ultimatum and still planned to attack. Therefore, Commander Cai Tingkai took command in Zhenru and issued an order to resist across the board. Even the newly arrived Sixth Military Police Regiment joined the 19th Route Army to fight side by side. Chiang Kai-shek recorded in his diary the next day: "I heard yesterday's request for the Japanese consul in Shanghai. We have acknowledged it and he has satisfied it. He also expressed his intention to withdraw troops in the evening. How come there was another conflict at midnight."

e219c73cba4edd11fe75925f0744f33cb88ca0b6.sourceText: （秋香 供稿）4月9日星期三上午，在Tempe的Pyle Adult Recreation Center，喜福会举办的免费英语学习班成功地上了第一次课，共有十六名学员前来听讲。主讲唐孝先老师来美前是国内高校资深英文老师，具有丰富的语言教学经验。他这次是义务为本英语学习班讲课。
e219c73cba4edd11fe75925f0744f33cb88ca0b6.translatedText: (Contributed by Qiuxiang) On the morning of Wednesday, April 9, at Pyle Adult Recreation in Tempe Center, the free English learning class organized by the Joy Luck Club successfully held its first class, with a total of sixteen students attending the class. The lecturer, Mr. Tang Xiaoxian, was a senior English teacher in domestic universities before coming to the United States and has rich language teaching experience. This time he is volunteering to teach this English class.

e57911114413cc63aa40f6d1b7f52006ca08b358.sourceText: 喜福会(Chinese Joy Luck Club)是凤凰城以中国华东地区来美人士为主体的联谊组织，为华人社区做好事、办实事，举办这个成人英语学习班，给来美国探亲家属、留学生配偶和其他想学英语的人士，提供面对面学习的机会，并且不收学费。教师也由志愿者担任，义务任教。
e57911114413cc63aa40f6d1b7f52006ca08b358.translatedText: The Chinese Joy Luck Club is a Phoenix-based social organization based on people from East China who come to the United States. It does good deeds and practical things for the Chinese community. It holds this adult English learning class to provide face-to-face learning opportunities for family members visiting relatives in the United States, spouses of international students and other people who want to learn English, and there is no tuition fee. Teachers are also provided by volunteers who teach on a voluntary basis.

f0356c3ca3bd636e7caa46e4de5fd47d0b795ab3.sourceText: 这是一项公益性活动，得到喜福会会员的大力支持，由八人组织筹备组，聘请会说汉语、有丰富语言教学经验的唐孝先老师、华老师(Diana Desilva)执教。很多人发来电邮、打来电话，报名踊跃。
f0356c3ca3bd636e7caa46e4de5fd47d0b795ab3.translatedText: This is a public welfare activity with strong support from the members of the Joy Luck Club. The preparatory team is organized by eight people, and teachers Tang Xiaoxian and Diana Desilva, who can speak Chinese and have rich language teaching experience, are hired to teach. Many people sent emails and called and signed up enthusiastically.

511f70c731106460102a48c39cc4df0409cd15ab.sourceText: 该班着重实用，採用场合情景教学，分人际交流、社区、国家、环境、食品、购物、家、健康、就业、交通与旅游等十个方面，活学活用，学以致用，立竿见影。每星期三上午上课一次，两个小时，集中学习一个方面。
511f70c731106460102a48c39cc4df0409cd15ab.translatedText: This class focuses on practicality and uses situational teaching, which is divided into ten aspects: interpersonal communication, community, country, environment, food, shopping, home, health, employment, transportation and tourism. Learn and apply what you have learned, and you will get immediate results. There is a class every Wednesday morning for two hours, focusing on one aspect.

40f5a050dfbc0cff60316a20a3a2deceeeb5a3d8.sourceText: 学习班上课地点在Tempe的Pyle Adult Recreation Center，Tempe市政府社区服务局很快批准。大凤凰城侨联副主席崔增祁先生、新东方艺术学校负责人于华老师等，前来祝贺英语学习班开学。
40f5a050dfbc0cff60316a20a3a2deceeeb5a3d8.translatedText: The class will be held at the Pyle Adult Recreation Center in Tempe, which was quickly approved by the Community Services Bureau of the Tempe City Government. Mr. Cui Zengqi, Vice Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Greater Phoenix City, and Mr. Yu Hua, the head of the New Oriental Art School, came to congratulate the opening of the English learning class.

696da5dd63f82469bdb28c5ecbcd423ba34497f6.sourceText: （亚省时报特约记者陈丽君）中国农历蛇年即将到来之际， 2013年2月2日喜福会也迎来了新年的第一次聚会。阳光明媚，和煦的春风轻拂着人们的脸庞，中午11点大家齐聚Scottsdale一家地道的亚洲餐馆，互致以新年美好的祝愿。此次大约70多人参加聚会，可谓历年来人数最多的，年龄最大的85岁，依然精神抖擞，说话铿锵有力。会长顾名峰告诉我们，喜福会在创会之初的会员主要是来至上海，宗旨是弘扬中华文化，增加交流，增进友谊，每年都举行一些家庭聚会和户外活动，丰富大家的业余生活。近几年由于很多人喜欢参加这样的聚会，协会的人员不断增加，会员不止局限于上海地区，会员来至中国各省，市及地区，不乏有多彩多艺的人才，每次聚会大家除了可以品尝到美味的菜肴，而且畅所欲言，同时还能欣赏精彩的文艺表演，弹古筝，拉二胡，唱歌，朗诵诗等，到处洋溢着欢声笑语。在新的一年里，协会将继续秉承宗旨，举行大家喜闻乐见，娱乐性及参与性强的活动，进一步丰富和活跃大家的生活。让喜福会走进千家万户，真真成为人们分享欢乐，健康益智的开心家园。
696da5dd63f82469bdb28c5ecbcd423ba34497f6.translatedText: (Alberta Times Special Correspondent Chen Lijun) As the Chinese Lunar Year of the Snake is approaching, On February 2, 2013, the Joy Luck Club also held its first gathering of the new year. The sun was shining brightly, and the warm spring breeze was blowing on people's faces. At 11 noon, everyone gathered at an authentic Asian restaurant in Scottsdale to exchange good wishes for the new year. There were about 70 people attending the gathering this time, which was the largest number in history. The oldest one was 85 years old, and he was still energetic and spoke forcefully. President Gu Mingfeng told us that when the Joy Luck Club was founded, its members mainly came to Shanghai. Its purpose was to promote Chinese culture, increase exchanges, and enhance friendship. Every year, some family gatherings and outdoor activities are held to enrich everyone's spare time life. In recent years, because many people like to attend such gatherings, the number of members in the association has been increasing. Members are not limited to Shanghai. Members come to all provinces, cities and regions in China, and there is no shortage of colorful and versatile talents. At each gathering, in addition to tasting delicious dishes and talking freely, they can also enjoy wonderful cultural performances, playing guzheng, erhu, singing, reciting poems, etc., and everywhere is filled with laughter and laughter. In the new year, the association will continue to uphold its purpose and hold activities that are popular, entertaining and participatory to further enrich and enliven everyone's lives. Let the Joy Luck Club enter thousands of households and truly become a happy home for people to share joy, health and education.

c4af02983ab345d0a1f429116fe7b6f64d8444cc.sourceText: 恐慌抛售股票 损失难弥补 （亚省时报） 许多分析师认为，投资人对美债评级调降、欧洲债务危机和上周股市大跌的心理担忧，将使8日的股市出现巨跌，导致股市更加危险。但理财师认为，如果坚持正确的投资理念，投资人从长期看将可能弥补损失。 旧金山投资公司Yeske Buie的叶斯柯说﹕「制定投资计划的宗旨，就是确定在出现目前这种局面时，知道采取何种措施。」 但坏消息不断接踵而来，投资人秉持正确的投资宗旨并非易事。 股市受挫可能导致许多投资人的资产受损，如年轻人投资的股票可能占70%，因此，股票的价值可能与股市一起下跌。但理财师认为，他们应考虑把更多资金转入股市，以便补回损失。 不过，即使是在低价时期购进股票也令人畏惧，因为投资人在股市动荡时期的本能反应，就是脱手卖掉。 维吉尼亚州Edelman理财公司执行长艾德曼说﹕「如果现在因恐慌而卖掉股票，股市没有恢复，你是低价出手和面临亏损。只能经得起股市上升，而经不起下跌的投资人，将会损失大部分投资。」 过去数周，经常和定期重新平衡投资的战略尤其显得重要，特别是在投资人即将需要资金的时候。专家认为，接近或已经退休的人，不应在股票上投资过多。 如果在当前形势下对购进股票没有信心，就应回头看过去两年，多数的投资组合是以股票居多，因为股市在升高。即使是股市上周出现大跌，史坦普500指数目前仍比2009年3月的低谷时期高77%，比2007年的高点少23%。 现在购进股票，以便实现投资的重新平衡，将有利于投资人的长期投资。但在做法上要慎重，而且不要指望迅速获利。
c4af02983ab345d0a1f429116fe7b6f64d8444cc.translatedText: Panic selling of stocks, losses difficult to recoup (Alberta Times) Many analysts believe that investors’ psychological concerns about the downgrade of U.S. debt ratings, the European debt crisis and last week’s stock market crash will cause the stock market to plummet on the 8th, making the stock market more dangerous. However, financial planners believe that if they adhere to the correct investment philosophy, investors will be able to make up for their losses in the long run. Yeske Buie of San Francisco investment company Yeske Buie said: "The purpose of formulating an investment plan is to determine what measures to take when the current situation occurs." But bad news keeps coming, and it is not easy for investors to adhere to the correct investment objectives. A setback in the stock market may cause the assets of many investors to be damaged. For example, young people may invest in 70% of stocks. Therefore, the value of stocks may fall along with the stock market. But financial planners believe they should consider transferring more funds into the stock market to make up for losses. But buying stocks even when prices are low can be daunting because investors' instinctive reaction in times of market volatility is to sell. Edelman, CEO of Edelman Financial Management in Virginia, said: "If you sell stocks now out of panic and the stock market does not recover, you are selling at a low price and facing losses. Investors who can only withstand the rise in the stock market and cannot withstand the decline will lose most of their investment." In the past few weeks, the strategy of frequent and regular rebalancing of investments has become particularly important, especially when investors are about to need funds. Experts believe that people who are approaching or already retired should not invest too much in stocks. If you are not confident about buying stocks under the current situation, you should look back at the past two years. Most investment portfolios were stock-heavy because the stock market was rising. Even with the stock market's sharp decline last week, the S&P 500 is still 77% above its March 2009 trough and 23% below its 2007 high. Buying stocks now to rebalance your investment will benefit investors in the long term. But be cautious in your approach, and don't expect quick profits.

2312018c83be0a20a50a6e2eea5532c0333e0d24.sourceText: 来源：新浪网 1，死也是平等的。 在美国阿灵顿国家公墓，无边无际的洁白的十字架，将军与士兵相连，死而平等； 在北京八宝山公墓，师军级上墙，兵团级入房，死了也要有级别。 2，穷也有尊严。 美国某地下了大雪，学校要求所有的学生都要回校，有的家长反对。学校说，这是为了那些家贫无暖气的孩子，他们回校可以有暖气和热汤。一些家长说，你就让家里没暖气的孩子回校就好了，为什么要全部回去？学校说，这样做是为了维护穷孩子的自尊心。 3，照顾弱势人群，你会发现中美有不同的乞丐。 中国的乞丐以儿童、老人、妇女、残疾人为主，很少青壮年； 美国的乞丐以青壮年为主，很少有老弱病残。 为什么？因为美国乞丐是因为懒，而中国乞丐因为穷。 美国政府不养懒人，但供养老弱病残，所以，老弱病残不用去乞讨；中國政府养懒人，老弱病残得不到供养，所以离乡背井四处乞讨。 4，普世价值观。 太平天国时期，一美国传教士来到中国，他看到了匪夷所思的苦难，他得出如此判断：中国最需要的不是现代科技，而是基础文明。基础文明就是契约精神、权利意识和对民主政治和个人自由的理解，这些东西现在被称为普世价值。 意思就是：每个人都应该懂得，除非你还是个野蛮人。 5，让历史发挥它应有的作用。家丑需要外扬。 美国的历史教科书上，对自己的历史越是丢人的事就写的越详细比如歧视黑人、虐待华工等，就是没有几段自己的”伟大成就”。原来美国人是把家丑真实地传扬给后代，以警醒后人决不再犯同样的错误。一切历史都是当代史，给历史整容，会唐突了现实，苍白了将来，弱智了后人，最可怕的是家丑还会不断地重复。 6，第一课学什么？ 胡适在美国曾经历过美国小学开学上的第一课，整堂课的内容全是小学生跟着老师大声背诵：”我保证使用我的批评才能，我保证发现我的独立思想，我保证接受教育，从而使自己能够做出判断。”这段誓词是美国第三任总统杰斐逊亲自为美国小学生撰写的。 7，为什么美国不会怕中国。 诺贝尔经济学奖获得者弗里德曼在他的书中写到：不用担心中国偷窃美国技术，因为美国可以很快地发明新的技术；最应该担心的是中国偷窃了美国独立宣言、宪法精神等代表美国价值的东西。当中国开始拷贝这些东西的时候，才是中国强大的开始,那才会对美国构成实质威胁。
2312018c83be0a20a50a6e2eea5532c0333e0d24.translatedText: Source: Sina.com 1. Death is also equal. In Arlington National Cemetery in the United States, there are endless white crosses, and generals and soldiers are connected and equal in death; in Babaoshan Cemetery in Beijing, the division level is on the wall, the corps level is in the room, and there is a rank even in death. 2. There is dignity in being poor. It snowed heavily somewhere in the United States, and the school asked all students to go back to school. Some parents objected. The school said this was for children whose families were poor and had no heating, so that they could have heating and hot soup when they returned to school. Some parents say, just let the children who don’t have heating at home go back to school. Why do you have to go back to school? The school says it does this to protect the self-esteem of poor children. 3. Take care of the vulnerable people. You will find that there are different beggars in China and the United States. The beggars in China are mainly children, the elderly, women, and the disabled, and there are very few young and middle-aged people. The beggars in the United States are mainly young and middle-aged people, and there are very few old, weak, sick, and disabled people. Why? Because American beggars are lazy, while Chinese beggars are poor. The U.S. government does not support lazy people, but it does support the old, weak, sick and disabled, so the old, weak, sick and disabled do not have to beg. The Chinese government supports lazy people, but the old, weak, sick and disabled cannot be provided for, so they leave their homes and beg everywhere. 4. Universal values. During the Taiping Rebellion, an American missionary came to China. He saw the incredible suffering and concluded that what China needed most was not modern technology, but basic civilization. The basic civilization is the spirit of contract, the awareness of rights and the understanding of democratic politics and personal freedom. These things are now called universal values. Meaning: everyone should understand, unless you are a barbarian. 5. Let history play its due role. Family scandals need to be publicized. In American history textbooks, the more embarrassing things about our history are written in more detail, such as discrimination against black people, mistreatment of Chinese workers, etc., but there are not a few paragraphs about our own "great achievements." It turns out that Americans truly pass on family scandals to future generations to warn future generations never to make the same mistake again. All history is contemporary history, and giving history a facelift will blunt reality, pale the future, and retarde future generations. The most frightening thing is that family scandals will continue to be repeated. 6. What to learn in the first lesson? Hu Shi once experienced the first lesson of an American elementary school in the United States. The entire class was composed of primary school students reciting aloud with the teacher: "I promise to use my critical talents, I promise to discover my independent thoughts, and I promise to receive an education so that I can make judgments." This oath was personally written by Jefferson, the third president of the United States, for American primary school students. 7. Why is the United States not afraid of China? Friedman, the Nobel Prize winner in economics, wrote in his book: Don’t worry about China stealing American technology, because the United States can quickly invent new technologies; what you should worry about most is that China steals the American Declaration of Independence, the spirit of the Constitution, and other things that represent American values. When China starts copying these things, it will be the beginning of China’s strength, and that will pose a real threat to the United States.

53a22847eb8765f9afd35d4cf04106b88c341825.sourceText: 7月18日沙尘暴 （图片来自The Arizona Republic）
53a22847eb8765f9afd35d4cf04106b88c341825.translatedText: Sandstorm on July 18 (Picture from The Arizona Republic)

447ee97a524db19e70f904b5cfdf053a50303327.sourceText: ２０１１年７月１８日晚６时，凤凰城出现了本月的第二次强沙尘暴。傍晚天空阴沉下来，即使是在室内都可以闻到空气中弥漫的沙尘味道。风沙渐起，记者于６时３０分，开到５１号和２０２高速上，高速路上的车辆已经比以往少很多，大部分人都为了规避沙尘暴的风险，选择了更改出门的时间。高速上的车辆速度也都比以往慢，大约在６０mile左右。高速上的能见度约在500米。这次沙尘暴在城市中的风速比几个星期前的沙尘暴风速慢很多，目前没有得到因沙尘暴引起的损失。
447ee97a524db19e70f904b5cfdf053a50303327.translatedText: At 6 pm on July 18, 2011, the second severe sandstorm this month occurred in Phoenix. The sky darkened in the evening and you could smell the dust in the air even indoors. The wind and sand started to pick up. At 6:30, the reporter drove to Highway 51 and Highway 202. There were far fewer vehicles on the highway than before. Most people chose to change the time they went out in order to avoid the risk of sandstorms. The speed of vehicles on the highway is also slower than before, about 60 miles. Visibility on the highway is about 500 meters. The wind speed of this sandstorm in the city was much slower than that of the sandstorm a few weeks ago. There has been no damage caused by the sandstorm so far.

e5e248338216f605a3c64c293c55b6e3b8998510.sourceText: 2012年6月2日，沈阳出现雷雨大风等强对流天气。18时许，发布暴雨红色预警，截至当日17时，沈阳降雨量最大的地区铁西滑翔已经超过100毫米。强降雨导致城市积水严重，多处出现千米堵车状况。
e5e248338216f605a3c64c293c55b6e3b8998510.translatedText: On June 2, 2012, strong convective weather such as thunderstorms and strong winds occurred in Shenyang. At about 18:00, a red rainstorm warning was issued. As of 17:00 that day, the rainfall in Tiexi, the area with the highest rainfall in Shenyang, had exceeded 100 mm. Heavy rainfall caused serious water accumulation in the city and caused traffic jams of 1,000 meters in many places.

7fa0e3509554c72ef839e07561a7a7f50c02270f.sourceText: NBC说，新泽西州3人死亡；宾夕法尼亚、康涅狄格和弗吉尼亚各2人死亡，马里兰和西弗吉尼亚各一人死亡；北卡罗来纳州一人在海上死亡。
7fa0e3509554c72ef839e07561a7a7f50c02270f.translatedText: NBC said three people died in New Jersey; two people each died in Pennsylvania, Connecticut and Virginia; one person each died in Maryland and West Virginia; and one person died at sea in North Carolina.

080e7dabd49fec15e642712dc0fa727d1edcd35d.sourceText: 在北上之前，”珊迪”已经在加勒比海地区造成65人死亡。
080e7dabd49fec15e642712dc0fa727d1edcd35d.translatedText: Before heading north, "Sandy" had killed 65 people in the Caribbean.

52a6983ff3c078014df47f3afd7a5507591f38f1.sourceText: 国家广播公司（NBC News）报道还说，”珊迪”造成的破坏逐步清晰，主要灾情如下：
52a6983ff3c078014df47f3afd7a5507591f38f1.translatedText: The NBC News report also said that the damage caused by "Sandy" is gradually becoming clear. The main disasters are as follows:

567146f27f7ee1e1adc89941cbe32bb0e4d13968.sourceText: – 东部17州超过810万住户和商家停电，其中半数分布在新泽西和纽约；
567146f27f7ee1e1adc89941cbe32bb0e4d13968.translatedText: – More than 8.1 million households and businesses in 17 eastern states were without power, half of them in New Jersey and New York;

9f4f33cb9ea878b31b3886379916061e50aa22e6.sourceText: – 纽约市皇后区和风点（Breezy Point）大火，至少50户住房被毁。由于天气恶劣，消防员难以接近火场，火灾原因至今仍不清楚；
9f4f33cb9ea878b31b3886379916061e50aa22e6.translatedText: – The Breezy Point fire in Queens, New York City, at least 50 homes were destroyed. Due to bad weather, it was difficult for firefighters to approach the fire, and the cause of the fire is still unclear;

d00dba4a580144d89c1455800aa9f0e101019bd5.sourceText: – 纽约市东河下面7条隧道淹水。大都会捷运局主席洛塔（Joseph Lhota）宣布，具有108年历史的纽约地铁系统从来没有遭受过如此严重的灾难；
d00dba4a580144d89c1455800aa9f0e101019bd5.translatedText: – Seven tunnels under the East River in New York City were flooded. Metropolitan Rapid Transit Authority Chairman Joseph Lhota announced that the 108-year-old New York subway system has never suffered such a severe disaster;

00dee01c9842a4212f6272e76083f6824abc4dbe.sourceText: – 曼哈顿和新泽西之间的通勤铁路（PATH）停摆，新泽西州长克里斯蒂（Chris Christie）星期二说，预计要7-10天才能恢复；
00dee01c9842a4212f6272e76083f6824abc4dbe.translatedText: – The commuter rail (PATH) between Manhattan and New Jersey is suspended, and New Jersey Governor Chris Christie said on Tuesday that it is expected to take 7-10 days to resume;

43d694234270d244897809a09ac8b4f7d551b5ae.sourceText: – 新泽西州霍博肯市一半在水下，救援人员干脆无法进市。市长济默（Dawn Zimmer）说，人们必须认识到形势非常危险；
43d694234270d244897809a09ac8b4f7d551b5ae.translatedText: – Half of Hoboken, New Jersey, is underwater, making it impossible for rescuers to get into the city. Mayor Dawn Zimmer said people must realize the situation is very dangerous;

f98a2849217cbb05eb687270a0d61d81588a888a.sourceText: – 由于溃堤，新泽西北部至少4个城镇成沼泽–姆纳奇（Moonachie）、小渡口（Little Ferry）、南哈肯萨克（South Hackensack）和哈肯萨克（Hackensack）被淹，街道上最深处达6英尺；
f98a2849217cbb05eb687270a0d61d81588a888a.translatedText: – At least four towns in northern New Jersey became swamps due to levee breaches – Moonachie, Little Ferry, South Hackensack and Hackensack were flooded, with the highest depth reaching 6 feet on the streets;

fd4feeb204bd89f293dd50e5cde8d7f61c07aeea.sourceText: – 纽约大学医院紧急撤离215名病人，因为备用发电机也不能运行；
fd4feeb204bd89f293dd50e5cde8d7f61c07aeea.translatedText: – New York University Hospital evacuated 215 patients because backup generators could not operate;

14eee75092c7df3c4ab59f6f5551c8c515033b85.sourceText: – 风暴潮已经摧毁纽约州火岛（Fire Island）部分房屋；
14eee75092c7df3c4ab59f6f5551c8c515033b85.translatedText: – Storm surge has destroyed some houses in Fire Island, New York State;

1b98c209cde2a4be6db4f2a028d86129627fc663.sourceText: – 东部机场共取消1.5万个航班，其中纽约市三大机场星期二仍然关闭；铁路运输受严重影响，其中美国铁路（Amtrak）取消东北走廊全部班次；
1b98c209cde2a4be6db4f2a028d86129627fc663.translatedText: – A total of 15,000 flights were canceled at eastern airports, with the three major airports in New York City remaining closed on Tuesday; rail transportation was severely affected, with Amtrak canceling all flights in the Northeast Corridor;

0cdd0c2279a131d414a9dd07afa5fc3ad295a1a7.sourceText: – 水位上升迫使新泽西州蚝溪（Oyster Creek）核电厂从星期一晚上关闭。
0cdd0c2279a131d414a9dd07afa5fc3ad295a1a7.translatedText: – Rising water levels forced the Oyster Creek nuclear power plant in New Jersey to shut down from Monday night.

77e31a1b0331436b5a1a3fcf37558759e7006731.sourceText: NBC说，”珊迪”造成的财产损失目前还不清楚。 飓风珊迪恐掀巨浪 纽约市府戒备升级(图)
77e31a1b0331436b5a1a3fcf37558759e7006731.translatedText: >NBC said that the property damage caused by "Sandy" is currently unknown. Hurricane Sandy is threatening to cause huge waves, and the New York City government has escalated its alert (Photo)

b71cd526b569f47c2d8246b8dc46ca985f8bb3c0.sourceText: 飓风 珊迪 正在向纽约逼近，纽约市的大众捷运系统全线停运，市长彭博发布强制撤离命令，要求水岸低洼地带的 37 万名民众必须撤离至安全区域，公校全部停课一天。这一系列措施显示出，市府对飓风的应急有所升级，而水岸涨潮将成为飓风对纽约市的最大威胁。
b71cd526b569f47c2d8246b8dc46ca985f8bb3c0.translatedText: Hurricane Sandy is approaching New York. All New York City's mass transit systems have been suspended. Mayor Bloomberg has issued a mandatory evacuation order, requiring 370,000 people in low-lying areas along the waterfront to evacuate to safe areas, and all public schools have been suspended for one day. This series of measures shows that the city government has upgraded its emergency response to hurricanes, and rising tides will become the biggest threat from hurricanes to New York City.

e24a8ca5f4a6c461fbd32d9823d85ed068305cfa.sourceText: 飓风今晚登陆 市长呼吁紧急撤离危险区
e24a8ca5f4a6c461fbd32d9823d85ed068305cfa.translatedText: Hurricane makes landfall tonight and the mayor calls for emergency evacuation from dangerous areas

05db9412b01760e34b1d4bb59b0581060e035011.sourceText: 纽约市长彭博今天在布鲁克林紧急事务办公室召开记者会，更新飓风桑迪的最新情况，同时再次呼吁居住在高危区的民众撤离。
05db9412b01760e34b1d4bb59b0581060e035011.translatedText: New York Mayor Bloomberg held a press conference at the Brooklyn Emergency Office today to update the latest situation of Hurricane Sandy and once again called on people living in high-risk areas to evacuate.

fcbe0d406135d77517fae93f0d0262d98490fe39.sourceText: 民众今晚应避免乘坐电梯，防止突然断电导致电梯卡在楼层之间。另外，民众也最好远离窗户以免风大导致玻璃破裂造成伤害。
fcbe0d406135d77517fae93f0d0262d98490fe39.translatedText: People should avoid taking the elevator tonight to prevent sudden power outages causing the elevator to get stuck between floors. In addition, people are advised to stay away from windows to avoid damage caused by glass breakage due to strong winds.

62d48ec9e547a3466a1868e68d83e62793bbcae8.sourceText: 新泽西纽约数千用户电力中断
62d48ec9e547a3466a1868e68d83e62793bbcae8.translatedText: Thousands of users in New Jersey, New York, lost power

c006aff4643251d0da68c6a8ae748bc87c60d647.sourceText: 飓风巨浪冲击也使纽约和新泽西的供电和通讯系统受到严重影响。
c006aff4643251d0da68c6a8ae748bc87c60d647.translatedText: The impact of hurricane waves also severely affected the power supply and communication systems in New York and New Jersey.

019ccfab000689cf453dd971d381bd158c475ad6.sourceText: 在飓风 珊迪的影响下，今天（10月29日）纽约全市公共交通系统停运，市议员顾雅明办公室也发布信息，提醒民众注意安全。
019ccfab000689cf453dd971d381bd158c475ad6.translatedText: Under the influence of Hurricane Sandy, the public transportation system in New York City was suspended today (October 29). City Councilor Gu Yaming's office also issued a message to remind the public to pay attention to safety.

089cd68d903b2ac63e8fb0e81f65749123805c7f.sourceText: 受飓风 珊迪的作用，纽约全市今天刮起大风并伴有阵雨，每小时风速超过39英里，民众出行很不方便。今天纽约公共交通全线停运，在皇后区的法拉盛很多商铺都歇业一天。在路边也有不少被大风吹掉的路牌，市议员顾雅明办公室也特别召开记者会提醒民众注意安全。
089cd68d903b2ac63e8fb0e81f65749123805c7f.translatedText: Affected by Hurricane Sandy, New York City experienced strong winds and showers today, with wind speeds exceeding 39 miles per hour, making it very inconvenient for people to travel. All public transportation in New York was suspended today, and many shops in Flushing, Queens, were closed for the day. There were also many street signs blown off by strong winds on the roadside. City Councilor Gu Yaming's office also held a special press conference to remind the public to pay attention to safety.

3047b415cccc5257f24c983d22fae22c0f399cc3.sourceText: 顾雅明强调，此次飓风 珊迪可能是近几十年来最大的，民众决不能掉以轻心。虽然在他的辖区市议会20选区内并没有ZoneA的高危地带，但是也有部分区域属于Zone B和Zone C，因此民众仍然需要特别小心，没有特别的事情尽量不要出门。
3047b415cccc5257f24c983d22fae22c0f399cc3.translatedText: Gu Yaming emphasized that this hurricane Sandy may be the largest in recent decades, and the public must not take it lightly. Although there are no high-risk areas in Zone A in the 20th District of the City Council in his jurisdiction, there are also some areas that belong to Zone B and Zone C. Therefore, people still need to be particularly careful and try not to go out unless there is something special.

a8652c29ff7c94fe08a4868b07b038901ed73cc6.sourceText: 办公室同时公布了皇后区5个的紧急避难中心地址，顾雅明提醒如果家里断水断电可以到中心居住，他同时说家里应当准备水以及手电筒等应急物品，如果遇到紧急情况拨打911或者311求助。（美国中文网 何晰媛 王依依 葛迪之）
a8652c29ff7c94fe08a4868b07b038901ed73cc6.translatedText: The office also announced the addresses of five emergency evacuation centers in Queens. Gu Yaming reminded that if there is a water or power outage at home, you can go to the center to live. He also said that you should prepare emergency supplies such as water and flashlights at home. If you encounter an emergency, call 911 or 311 for help. (American Chinese website He Xiyuan, Wang Yiyi, Ge Dizhi)

8e37685dd3235e15e759709021b12ad594560e5a.sourceText: 露营季节到来 小心与熊邂逅 春暖花开，正是露营的好季节。西南野生动物保护中心提醒外出郊游、露营的游客：小心黑熊。 去年六月，吉伯特一女士在野外牵狗散歩时，遭遇黑熊攻击身亡。西南野生动物保护中心主任卡尔金说，黑熊的嗅觉明锐，很容易找到食物和露营帐篷。她建议露营者不要在帐篷或睡觉的地方留下食物。食物，洗漱用品等有味道的东西应该放在密封容器储存在汽车里。她说相比人类，熊更怕对方。卡尔金说，可以考虑在身上、脚腕带铃铛，让熊知道你的到来而避远。 如果遇见熊，不要慌张奔跑。卡尔金说，原地等待，慢慢离开，不要激怒它，等它转身走远后再沿相反方向离开。西南野生动物保护中心在4月21日有一个”与熊邂逅”的特别活动，详情请参阅： www.southwestwildlife.org
8e37685dd3235e15e759709021b12ad594560e5a.translatedText: Camping season is here, beware of encounters with bears. Spring is here, and it’s a good season for camping. The Southwest Wildlife Conservation Center reminds tourists who go out for outings and camping: Be careful of black bears. In June last year, Ms. Gilbert was attacked and killed by a black bear while taking her dog for a walk in the wild. Kalkin, director of the Southwest Wildlife Conservation Center, said black bears have a keen sense of smell and can easily find food and camping tents. She advises campers not to leave food in their tents or sleeping quarters. Food, toiletries and other smelly items should be stored in the car in airtight containers. She said bears are more afraid of each other than humans. Consider wearing bells on your body or ankles to let bears know you're coming and stay away, Culkin said. If you encounter a bear, don't panic and run. Culkin said, wait where you are, leave slowly, don't provoke it, wait for it to turn around and walk away, and then leave in the opposite direction. Southwest Wildlife Conservation Center has a special "Bear Encounter" event on April 21st. For details, please see: www.southwestwildlife.org

b373a657f3aeb65e4b454fc66d445b444810bf1a.sourceText: 翌日，十二月十九日星期一早晨，天未亮我已经起床，盥洗妥当就离开旅店房间，行十几步就进入赌场，只见冷冷清清的，赌客不多，大概他们都像我妻那 般，昨晚赌到深夜，现在仍然酣睡。 我巡视整个赌场，相信廿四小时只有这个时候最寂静吧！ 再行去前面两家食店，刚刚准备开店，还未营业。 我想观赏普里娒山谷（Primm Vally）市镇的早晨景色，步行出门外，哎呀！ 寒风凛冽，好难抵受，急忙退回落地玻璃门内，外面高耸竖立的招牌灯光依然闪烁，像嘲笑我的怯懦！ 我觉得无聊，找副老虎机博彩一下，以打发时光。 不多久，梁满姊妹经过，她俩取笑我大早晨就想发财，还说打算走过对面吃早餐，埋怨天气实在寒冷。 我告诉她那些免费券可以在这里的餐饮店使用，不必走出外面受寒流侵袭之苦，梁满就高兴的相约余江英夫妇，我也召唤太座，六人一同进入巨型餐饮店（Mega Cafe）， 共用早点。 至于我的小组另外四位亲友，比我起床迟，一切只好「贵客自理」。 九时三刻，「专门为你旅游」（Especially 4-U Tours）的旅行车已到来接载我们，十时起程前往离这里四十英里的著名拉斯维加斯赌城，其中有几位 不欲坐车往返劳累，宁愿留在赌场旅馆内，可以睡眠，可以发财，还有其他娱乐，反正晚上要回来住宿。 我则想去赌​​城中心区蹓跶，主要是到中国城游览一番；自从三年前我夫妇的结婚纪念，特地来此一游之后，近日再无踏入赌城，美国的经济下滑，听 说拉斯维加斯的面貌依然焕发亮丽。 旅行车行走超过半小时，抵达繁盛的拉斯维加斯中心区域，停在金海岸赌场（Gold Coast Casino）门前，让旅客自由行，导游吩咐下午六时再集中一起，观赏晚上辉煌灿烂的圣诞 灯光。 这时每个人精神特别兴奋，总算可随心所欲，自我选择节目。 我站立外边仰望，只见金海岸赌场广阔宏伟，比威士忌赌场雄壮，所谓金海岸，纯粹是悦耳的名称，其实四周通衢大道，楼房店铺，没有海洋；走进赌场内巡视，里面纵横宽广，有休闲 客厅，有购物商场，有餐饮店，还有一间中文大字招牌：钱庄面家。 赌场内摆设各式各样的老虎机、夹杂一列列牌桌，牌桌上不少荷官是华人脸孔，聚集不同肤色的赌客，游客进进出出不算很多，各处有空档位置， 如果懒得走动，在内流连消遣，可打发时光。 我们这团人化整为零，此一组彼一群地在商议如何安排节目，大部份都计划到外面观光，去中国城的呼声最高，不久就见他们浩浩荡荡地步出大门，向目的 地前进；有两三位队友因疏忽联络离了群，又不熟识路途，不谙语言，惟有在金海岸流连。 我的六人小组连贯一起，总不能各散东西，不便胡乱走动；而且秀卿已决定去一号越南汤粉店品尝美食，肚子未饿，打算先在金海岸淘金一番；林镜明则因 腿部疼痛，不便​​远行，暂时在商店内选购物品。 直到正午时分，才依照原定计划去一号越南餐馆，准备搭乘的士，可这儿没有七座位计程车，我们在赌场门外正踌躇未决时，一位华人女士正载着几位老人来睹场 ，见此情形，竟义务协助载送三人去中国城，遇上贵人，真是幸运，尚余三人就容易解决。 后来楚荣想出最佳办法，就是打电话叫堂弟阿福出来相聚，共进午餐，阿福居住拉斯维加斯，在赌场上班，今天星期一刚好是他的例假，那就最好了 ，只要有一辆车，分批接送，什么往来难题都迎刃而解。 我们总共七个人，前往一号越南餐馆，果然名不虚传，只见食客如云，要登记排名等候，有钱饮食原来也不容易，经过一番时间消磨，才能饱尝美食。 最后还是由阿福分两次载我们返回金海岸，他告别离去，我们六人又回到金海岸流连，我原定去中国城观光购物的计划，因种种不便而打消了。 不久后，很多团友也陆续回来，有的在客厅阅报，有的四处蹓跶，有的继续博彩厖大家都等待晚上的观赏精彩的圣诞灯光节目。
b373a657f3aeb65e4b454fc66d445b444810bf1a.translatedText: The next day, Monday morning, December 19, I got up before dawn, left the hotel room after washing, and walked a dozen steps into the casino. I saw it was deserted and there were not many gamblers. They were probably like my wife, who gambled until late last night and were still sleeping soundly. I patrolled the entire casino. I believe this is the quietest time of the day! Let's go to the first two restaurants. They have just been preparing to open their stores, but they are not yet open. I wanted to see the morning view of the town of Primm Vally and walk outside, oh my! The cold wind was biting and it was so unbearable that I hurriedly retreated inside the floor-to-ceiling glass door. The towering signboard lights outside were still flashing, as if laughing at my cowardice! I felt bored and looked for a slot machine to pass the time. Not long after, Sister Liang Man passed by. They made fun of me for wanting to get rich so early in the morning. They also said they planned to walk across the street to have breakfast and complained that the weather was really cold. I told her that those free coupons could be used in restaurants here, so she didn't have to go outside to suffer from the cold wave. Liang Man happily met with Yu Jiangying and his wife. I also summoned the queen, and the six of us entered the Mega Cafe to share breakfast. As for the other four relatives and friends in my group, they got up later than me, so they had to "take care of themselves". At nine-thirty, the "Specially 4-U Tours" tour bus arrived to pick us up. At ten o'clock, we set off for the famous Las Vegas casino, forty miles away. Some of us didn't want to be tired from traveling back and forth in the car, and preferred to stay in the casino hotel where we could sleep, make money, and have other entertainment. Anyway, we had to come back to stay at night. I wanted to take a stroll in the central area of ​​the casino, mainly to visit Chinatown. Since my husband and I made a special trip here for our wedding anniversary three years ago, I have not set foot in the casino recently. The U.S. economy is in decline, but I heard that Las Vegas is still looking bright. The tour bus walked for more than half an hour and arrived at the bustling central area of ​​Las Vegas. It stopped in front of the Gold Coast Casino and allowed the tourists to travel freely. The tour guide told them to gather together at 6 pm to watch the brilliant Christmas lights at night. At this time, everyone is very excited and can finally choose the program as they please. I stood outside and looked up, and saw that the Gold Coast Casino is vast and majestic, more majestic than the Whiskey Casino. The so-called Gold Coast is just a pleasant name. In fact, it is surrounded by thoroughfares, buildings and shops, and there is no ocean. When I walked into the casino and inspected it, I saw that it was wide and wide, with leisure rooms, shopping malls, restaurants, and a big Chinese signboard: Qianzhuang Noodle House. The casino is equipped with a variety of slot machines and rows of card tables. Many of the dealers on the card tables are Chinese, and gamblers of different skin colors gather there. There are not many tourists coming in and out, and there are free seats everywhere. If you are too lazy to move around, you can hang around and pass the time. Our group broke into pieces, and one group after another were discussing how to arrange the program. Most of them planned to go sightseeing outside, and the most popular one was to go to Chinatown. Soon we saw them marching out of the gate and heading towards their destination; two or three teammates left the group due to neglect of contact, and they were not familiar with the road or the language, so they could only hang out on the Golden Coast. My group of six people are cohesive and cannot scatter their things and move around randomly; and Xiuqing has decided to go to the No. 1 Vietnamese Soup Noodle Shop to taste the delicious food. She is not hungry yet and plans to go panning for gold on the Golden Coast first; Lin Jingming has pain in his legs and is unable to travel far, so he temporarily chooses items in the store. It wasn't until noon that we went to Vietnamese Restaurant No. 1 as planned and prepared to take a taxi. However, there were no seven-seat taxis here. When we were hesitating outside the casino, a Chinese lady was driving a few elderly people to see the venue. Seeing this situation, she volunteered to help drive the three of them to Chinatown. I was really lucky to meet a noble person. It was easy to solve the problem with the remaining three. Later, Chu Rong came up with the best idea, which was to call his cousin Ah Fu to come out and have lunch together. Ah Fu lives in Las Vegas and works in a casino. Today, Monday, happens to be his period, so that would be the best. As long as there is a car and pick-up and drop-off in batches, all the communication problems can be easily solved. There were seven of us in total, and we went to Vietnamese Restaurant No. 1. As expected, it was well-deserved. There were so many diners, and we had to register and wait. It is not easy to have money to eat, and it takes a lot of time to enjoy the delicious food. In the end, Afu drove us back to Golden Coast twice. He said goodbye and left, and the six of us returned to Golden Coast to hang out. My original plan to go sightseeing and shopping in Chinatown was canceled due to various inconveniences. Soon after, many group members also came back one after another. Some were reading newspapers in the living room, some were wandering around, and some continued to play. Everyone was looking forward to watching the wonderful Christmas light show in the evening.

7cd00b77258980b0461d037634fc4889df35e0d8.sourceText: 加州沦为全美贫穷率最高州 漤发福利是主因
7cd00b77258980b0461d037634fc4889df35e0d8.translatedText: California has become the state with the highest poverty rate in the United States, and welfare is the main reason

87f6790823ccb081ae72647931f705cde29083cc.sourceText: 加州沦为全美贫穷率最高州 漤发福利是主因 （洛杉矶十四日电）全美国贫穷率最高的是那一个州？不是密西西比、新…
87f6790823ccb081ae72647931f705cde29083cc.translatedText: California has become the state with the highest poverty rate in the United States, and welfare is the main reason (Los Angeles, 14th) Which state has the highest poverty rate in the United States? Not Mississippi, New...

fad70fc1a37131972b99537f7435b061fcb253f6.sourceText: （洛杉矶十四日电）全美国贫穷率最高的是那一个州？不是密西西比、新墨西哥或西维吉尼亚等州，而是加州。根据美国人口普查局的「补助贫穷措施」（Supplemental Poverty Measure）统计，加州人口之中，每五个人几乎就有一个人是穷人。
fad70fc1a37131972b99537f7435b061fcb253f6.translatedText: (Los Angeles, 14th) Which state has the highest poverty rate in the United States? Not states like Mississippi, New Mexico or West Virginia, but California. According to the U.S. Census Bureau’s Supplemental Poverty Measure, almost one in every five people in California is poor.

dea0def8e0d9f21f68759bb6ae2491ed00020a55.sourceText: 这项「补助贫穷措施」统计反映各州住屋、食物、公用事业项目和衣服的成本，也包含政府非现金补助的项目，它亦是现金的一种方式。
dea0def8e0d9f21f68759bb6ae2491ed00020a55.translatedText: This "Poverty Assistance Measures" statistic reflects the cost of housing, food, utility projects and clothing in each state. It also includes government non-cash subsidies, which are also a form of cash.

01e0c53b2da74f5c32d24b44eaa5b6aede41d193.sourceText: 洛杉矶时报报导，考虑到就业增长强劲以及多个行业的繁荣，值得一提的是，为什么加州落后，特别是在截至2016年的五年里，加州人均国内生产总值增长率，是美国平均水平的两倍。按加州人均生产总值增长率为百分之12.5，而全美是百分之6.27。
01e0c53b2da74f5c32d24b44eaa5b6aede41d193.translatedText: Considering strong job growth and prosperity in many industries, it’s worth asking why California is lagging behind, especially since in the five years to 2016, California’s per capita GDP growth was twice the U.S. average, the Los Angeles Times reported. California's per capita GDP growth rate is 12.5%, while the national GDP growth rate is 6.27%.

3c097d6639931f08786cb927e778c84412478593.sourceText: 加州政策制定者并没有忽视对抗贫穷的工作。加州首府沙加缅度和各地方政府花费很多资源在协助贫穷项目。加州几个福利计划和市的项目相互重叠。许多人所得在贫穷线标准的百分之200，仍然接受福利救济。美国人口普查局统计，加州和地方政府从1992年至2015年，花费在福利项目的经费共为9，580亿元，包括现金补助、对供应商付款和其他公共福利项目。占全美人口百分之12的加州，发放福利总额则占全美的三分之一。
3c097d6639931f08786cb927e778c84412478593.translatedText: California policymakers are not neglecting their efforts to fight poverty. Sacramento, the capital of California, and local governments spend a lot of resources on poverty-assisted projects. Several welfare programs and municipal programs in California overlap. Many people earn less than 200 percent of the poverty level and still receive welfare benefits. According to the U.S. Census Bureau, California and local governments spent a total of $958 billion on welfare programs from 1992 to 2015, including cash subsidies, payments to providers and other public welfare programs. California, which accounts for 12% of the nation's population, accounts for one-third of the nation's total welfare payments.

503fee887a576c9b4fd119bf33c8989c8c4631f2.sourceText: 长期以来，加州民主党人一直放纵这个「蓝色州」（指民主党州份）的意识形态，而几乎不必承担任何政治代价。
503fee887a576c9b4fd119bf33c8989c8c4631f2.translatedText: California Democrats have long indulged the ideology of this "blue state" with little to no political cost.

51e8c766e5e2a7165b82e53332173f429fd1cad9.sourceText: 慷慨发放福利，它非但没能解决贫穷率上升的问题，反而有恶化情况。
51e8c766e5e2a7165b82e53332173f429fd1cad9.translatedText: Generous welfare payments have not only failed to solve the problem of rising poverty rates, but have actually worsened the situation.

4b3ec1480cca602995b5cb4b3e8ccfa3f15de732.sourceText: 在1980年代及1990年代，若干州份，主要是威斯康星州、密西根州和维吉尼亚州，进行福利改革，在柯林顿总统及共和党控制的国会运作之下，这些改革使这些州份过去依赖福利的人，成为正常劳工，使这些州份摆脱贫穷州的标籤。
4b3ec1480cca602995b5cb4b3e8ccfa3f15de732.translatedText: In the 1980s and 1990s, several states, mainly Wisconsin, Michigan and Virginia, carried out welfare reforms. Under the operation of President Clinton and the Republican-controlled Congress, these reforms enabled people in these states who used to rely on welfare to become normal workers, freeing these states from being labeled as poor states.

6c2c11be72964498ac9c11be605dc9fb4a2a3196.sourceText: 反观加州情况。加州的福利受益者在没有任何附加条件的现金支出中，所得到的援助金额过大。就好像福利改革透过加州，留下了一个依赖陷阱。移民更是陷入困境，有百分之55的移民家庭，获得某种经过经济状况检验的福利，而当地人只有百分之30。
6c2c11be72964498ac9c11be605dc9fb4a2a3196.translatedText: Look at the situation in California. California’s welfare recipients are receiving disproportionate aid in cash payouts with no strings attached. It's as if welfare reform passed through California and left a dependency trap. Immigrants are even more in trouble, with 55 percent of immigrant families receiving some kind of means-tested benefit, compared with only 30 percent of natives.

3daa2ca103d17c9725de8e48c045aad260f0d279.sourceText: 如果加州不将福利政策订定，真协助领取福利者脱离贫穷，而是政客一直以福利金争取低收入者的支持，加州要摆脱「贫穷州」的名声，恐怕很难。
3daa2ca103d17c9725de8e48c045aad260f0d279.translatedText: If California does not formulate welfare policies to really help welfare recipients escape poverty, but instead politicians continue to use welfare benefits to win the support of low-income people, it may be difficult for California to get rid of its reputation as a "poor state."

5c2e051ff1ef9603a52e12697c8609f3499b3a94.sourceText: 方便海外华人回中国居留 中国绿卡降低门坎
5c2e051ff1ef9603a52e12697c8609f3499b3a94.translatedText: It is easier for overseas Chinese to return to China to live in China and the threshold for China’s green card is lowered

b721226c0a8ae83ef3103807a0c311008701ca61.sourceText: 方便海外华人回中国居留 中国绿卡降低门坎 中国公安部出入境管理局副局长曲云海24日表示，中国将扩大居留许可…
b721226c0a8ae83ef3103807a0c311008701ca61.translatedText: It is easier for overseas Chinese to return to China to live in China. The threshold for China’s green card is lowered Qu Yunhai, deputy director of the Exit-Entry Administration Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security of China, said on the 24th that China will expand residence permits...

03a4dade7764670f29b6f79a5603af7232ba527d.sourceText: 中国公安部出入境管理局副局长曲云海24日表示，中国将扩大居留许可证的签发对象，并降低门坎，方便海外华人获得中国绿卡，回中国居留。
03a4dade7764670f29b6f79a5603af7232ba527d.translatedText: Qu Yunhai, deputy director of the Exit-Entry Administration of the Ministry of Public Security of China, said on the 24th that China will expand the number of recipients of residence permits and lower the threshold to facilitate overseas Chinese to obtain Chinese green cards and return to China to reside.

79a2be91bdc883951ee0aff1847960cc67f29069.sourceText: 中社社报导，曲云海表示，近年来，中国公安机关一直在采取积极措施，为外籍华人提供入境、停留居留便利，因为「数量众多、分布广泛的外籍华人群体，是促进中国社会经济发展和争取国际支持的重要力量」。
79a2be91bdc883951ee0aff1847960cc67f29069.translatedText: China News Agency reported that Qu Yunhai said that in recent years, China's public security organs have been taking active measures to provide entry, stay and residence convenience for foreign Chinese, because "the large and widely distributed foreign Chinese group is an important force in promoting China's social and economic development and gaining international support."

b4b792698cdaf558c2ef307fdfb16de30bfb3ac6.sourceText: 他说，方便海外华人回中国居留，一是适当扩大居留许可的签发对象。自2010年6月1日起，中国公安部推出了扩大外国人居留许可签发对象政策，增设了探亲、投靠、置房(置房类家属)、赡养、寄养类居留许可。合法入境的外籍华人，凡符合条件，均可申请办理上述居留许可。
b4b792698cdaf558c2ef307fdfb16de30bfb3ac6.translatedText: He said that to make it easier for overseas Chinese to return to China to reside, the first step is to appropriately expand the subjects for which residence permits are issued. Since June 1, 2010, the Ministry of Public Security of China has launched a policy to expand the categories of residence permits issued to foreigners, and has added residence permits for visiting relatives, seeking refuge, purchasing a house (householding for family members), supporting, and fostering. Foreign Chinese who have entered the country legally and meet the conditions can apply for the above-mentioned residence permit.

be074fc752e9da9d3a4303c02332c074b4d825b8.sourceText: 据统计，2010年6月至2011年底，共签发探亲类居留许可3万6000人次、投靠类居留许可187人次、置房类居留许可3068人次，赡养类居留许可348人次，寄养类居留许可2万8000人次。而「签发对象绝大部分是外籍华人」。
be074fc752e9da9d3a4303c02332c074b4d825b8.translatedText: According to statistics, from June 2010 to the end of 2011, a total of 36,000 residence permits for family visits, 187 residence permits for seeking refuge, 3,068 residence permits for house purchase, 348 residence permits for support, and 28,000 residence permits for foster care were issued. And "most of the recipients are foreign Chinese."

3d006fefb2e766d0f038500f33095d3b38b185ae.sourceText: 出入境管理局同时也逐步降低「绿卡审批门坎」。曲云海说，2004年8月15日，经国务院批准，公安部、外交部颁布实施了「外国人在中国永久居留审批管理办法」，即中国的「绿卡制度」。该办法着眼引进中国需要的高层次人才和投资者，同时也对外籍华人办理「中国绿卡」提供了便利。
3d006fefb2e766d0f038500f33095d3b38b185ae.translatedText: The Entry-Exit Administration Bureau is also gradually lowering the "green card approval threshold." Qu Yunhai said that on August 15, 2004, with the approval of the State Council, the Ministry of Public Security and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs promulgated and implemented the "Measures for the Approval and Management of Foreigners' Permanent Residence in China", which is China's "green card system." This measure focuses on introducing high-level talents and investors that China needs, and also provides convenience for foreign Chinese to apply for "Chinese Green Cards."

5e9ce5b18b5eaf550c48b9d64a55195c574134c3.sourceText: 他指出，外籍华人除可按投资、任职者身分申请「中国绿卡」外，还可因家庭团聚事由申请「绿卡」，主要针对投靠父母的未满18周岁的未婚子女、中国公民的外籍配偶以及年满60周岁投靠境内近亲属的老年外籍华人，只要符合一定生活保障、居留年限等条件。
5e9ce5b18b5eaf550c48b9d64a55195c574134c3.translatedText: He pointed out that in addition to applying for a "China Green Card" based on investment and employment status, foreign Chinese can also apply for a "Green Card" for family reunification, mainly for unmarried children under the age of 18 who live with their parents, foreign spouses of Chinese citizens, and elderly foreign Chinese who are over 60 years old and live with close relatives in the country, as long as they meet certain conditions such as living security and length of residence.

2605d5184bae82c00aa9f6c714b10d068f54ef79.sourceText: 曲云海说，据统计，2004年8月至2012年7月，中国公安部共批准3275人获得「绿卡」，其中以家庭团聚名义获批共1663人，其中夫妻团聚1204人，亲子团聚433人，亲属投靠26人，占总数的50.8%；为「千人计划」621名海外高层次引进人才签发「绿卡」。
2605d5184bae82c00aa9f6c714b10d068f54ef79.translatedText: Qu Yunhai said that according to statistics, from August 2004 to July 2012, the Ministry of Public Security of China approved a total of 3,275 people to obtain "green cards", including those approved in the name of family reunification. A total of 1,663 people, including 1,204 couples reunited, 433 parents and children, and 26 relatives, accounting for 50.8% of the total; "Green Cards" were issued to 621 high-level overseas talents under the "Thousand Talents Plan".

6f29ddb001cf1ce1023c7844713bc96cc3e43675.sourceText: 此外中国公安机关施行的办理口岸签证、办理签证延期、变更签证种类和增加签证入境次数等便利性措施，受惠群体也包括外籍华人。他说，这些政策便利了外籍华人赴中国探亲、观光和访问，增进了外籍华人的归属感。
6f29ddb001cf1ce1023c7844713bc96cc3e43675.translatedText: In addition, the convenience measures implemented by the Chinese public security organs such as port visa processing, visa extension, changing visa types and increasing the number of visa entries also benefit the foreign Chinese. He said that these policies have facilitated foreign Chinese to visit relatives, sightseeing and visits in China, and enhanced the sense of belonging of foreign Chinese.

fc4f76eef64ed7053bf69a25506553bc58535465.translatedText: Reprinted from Hong Kong Apple Daily

0629c89df1ea7f6f0f8e500a166280145833ef17.sourceText: 方励之丧礼将于当地时间周六在图桑市东边的一个墓园内的殡葬服务中心的小礼堂举行。记者现场所见，墓园是一大片青青草坪，还有有许多棕榈树环绕，一望无际可见远处的山丘。工作人员告诉《苹果》记者，方先生的遗体将在告别仪式后进行火化。据悉，届时除方的家人、亲友和同事外，部份流亡美国的民运人士亦会前来参加遗体告别仪式。 据悉，方励之生前常与学生到该市一家中餐厅──朱家园聚餐。昨日记者前往该餐厅，一提起他，厨师们都记得，说他总是一大班人光顾，每次必点招牌蟹。但他们则从来不知方的威水史，亦不知他离世。 记者还在餐厅里发现了一份名为亚利桑那州《壹周报》（ next weekly）的免费中文报纸，无论中文名还是英文名都抄足香港壹传媒集团旗下的刊物。餐厅老闆说，这份报纸是从凤凰城运来的，这里最新一份是三月九日出版的。 方猝死后一星期，台湾陆委会副主委刘德勳昨首度以官方立场致哀：「方励之教授其实是大陆知名的科学家，在过往大陆民主运动中扮演非常重要的指标性的角色，因此大家对他的定位都非常肯定，他的过世相信对整个人权的发展是一个损失。政府的立场，对这样不幸的事实，我们当然表示哀悼。」
0629c89df1ea7f6f0f8e500a166280145833ef17.translatedText: > Fang Lizhi’s funeral will be held on Saturday, local time, in the small auditorium of the funeral service center in a cemetery east of Tucson. What the reporter saw at the scene was that the cemetery was a large green lawn, surrounded by many palm trees, and the hills in the distance could be seen as far as the eye could see. The staff told the "Apple" reporter that Mr. Fang's body will be cremated after the farewell ceremony. It is reported that in addition to Fang's family, relatives, friends and colleagues, some pro-democracy activists in exile in the United States will also come to attend the farewell ceremony. It is reported that Fang Lizhi often had dinner with his students at Zhujiayuan, a Chinese restaurant in the city. Yesterday, reporters went to the restaurant. When they mentioned him, the chefs all remembered that he was always visited by a large group of people and always ordered the signature crab. But they never knew about Fang's Wei Shui history or his death. The reporter also found a free Chinese newspaper called Arizona's "Next Weekly" in the restaurant. Both its Chinese and English names were copied from publications owned by Hong Kong's Next Media Group. The restaurant owner said the newspaper was shipped from Phoenix, and the latest one here was published on March 9. One week after Fang Sudden's death, Liu Dexun, deputy chairman of Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council, expressed his condolences from an official position for the first time yesterday: "Professor Fang Lizhi is actually a well-known scientist in the mainland. He played a very important and iconic role in the mainland's democratic movement in the past, so everyone is very sure of his position. His I believe that his death is a loss to the development of human rights as a whole. From the government's perspective, we certainly express our condolences for such an unfortunate fact."

bb994e4de2cd4b6db1a769050653b98b003284b5.sourceText: 方励之生前居住图桑市，位于美国西南部，是距墨西哥最近的城市。当地天气炎热乾燥，除被作为「市徽」的蜥蜴随处可见外，还有比人高的树形仙人掌，数量似乎比人还多。据统计该市人口 52万，是亚利桑那州第二多人的城市，但即使白天在市中心马路上，记者一眼望去不会超过十人。反而车流倒是穿梭不断。 当地的士司机解释，这里民居很分散。没驾车的记者去到据称是该市唯一一个能买到手机 SIM咭的地方，为一张 14美元（约 109港元）的电话卡，来回却花了 500元港币的士费，实在昂贵。
bb994e4de2cd4b6db1a769050653b98b003284b5.translatedText: Fang Lizhi lived in Tucson, which is located in the southwest of the United States and is the closest city to Mexico. The local weather is hot and dry. In addition to the lizards used as the "city emblem" that can be seen everywhere, there are also tree-shaped cacti that are taller than people. There seem to be more people than people. According to statistics, the city has a population of 520,000, making it the second most populous city in Arizona. However, even on the street in the city center during the day, the reporter could not see more than ten people at a glance. On the contrary, the traffic flow was constant. The local taxi driver explained that the houses here are very scattered. The reporter who did not drive went to what was said to be the only place in the city where he could buy a mobile phone SIM card. A phone card cost US$14 (approximately HK$109), but it cost him HK$500 in taxi fare for the round trip, which was really expensive.

ca9df8df41687ab72b5a3a8b4c4fa03b5cda2fba.sourceText: 每月一宗枪击案 亚利桑那大学一带可算是该市最热闹的地方，火辣辣的太阳下，少男少女衣着清凉享受青春。当地的中国留学生提醒记者，天黑勿在街上乱逛，该市治安不好，平均每月有超过一宗枪击桉。记者本来半信半疑，走过市区餐厅却看见窗上「不准携枪入内」的告示牌，赶紧快步回旅馆。不过，至今记者接触到的人大多热情友善。
ca9df8df41687ab72b5a3a8b4c4fa03b5cda2fba.translatedText: One shooting per month. The area around the University of Arizona can be regarded as the busiest place in the city. Under the scorching sun, boys and girls dress coolly and enjoy their youth. Local Chinese students reminded reporters not to wander around the streets after dark. Public security in the city is not good, with an average of more than one shooting per month. The reporter was dubious at first, but when he walked past a downtown restaurant, he saw a "No guns allowed" sign on the window and hurried back to the hotel. However, most of the people this reporter has come into contact with so far are warm and friendly.

6b2326293dc3f00c6d2b7ce688ab2219fe3cb594.sourceText: 11月22日晚8时，来自北京的”雷动天下”现代舞舞团在凤凰城完成了他们2014在北美的巡演，为美国之旅画上了圆满的句号。亚利桑那艺术学校与”雷动天下”现代舞团达成了初步合作意向，未来将把亚利桑那优秀的舞蹈学生，送到北京参加现代舞团的培训。
6b2326293dc3f00c6d2b7ce688ab2219fe3cb594.translatedText: At 8:00 pm on November 22, the "Thunder World" modern dance troupe from Beijing completed their 2014 North American tour in Phoenix, drawing a successful conclusion to the US tour. . The Arizona Art School has reached a preliminary cooperation intention with the "Thunder World" modern dance company. In the future, Arizona's outstanding dance students will be sent to Beijing to participate in the training of the modern dance company

d726d55c5eb10d90d4233061929ef75fe92abc91.sourceText: 当晚《前定的暗色》《十月》《独自等待》《踏莎行》 将近一个半小时的精彩演出让大家看到了不一样的中国。舞团的创始人曹诚渊先生接受了”太阳鸟”亚利桑那华人网记者的采访。他表示”雷动天下”就是想让西方的朋友看到现代的中国，我们不再是像清朝的，民国的样子，我们现在面对的，大部分是和西方国家的人遇到的同样的问题：环境问题，交通问题，人与人的相处，沟通的问题。我们用舞蹈的形式，告诉大家中国人现在的思考。
d726d55c5eb10d90d4233061929ef75fe92abc91.translatedText: That night, "The Dark Color", "Waiting Alone" and "Traveling in the Sand". The nearly one-and-a-half-hour wonderful performance allowed everyone to see a different China. Mr. Cao Chengyuan, the founder of the dance company, was interviewed by a reporter from the "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese Network. He said that "Thunder World" is to let Western friends see modern China. We are no longer like the Qing Dynasty and the Republic of China. Most of what we are facing now is Western. People in other countries encounter the same problems: environmental problems, traffic problems, getting along with others, and communication problems. We use the form of dance to tell everyone what the Chinese people are thinking now.

2aa5ba42faaaeaa2468fca6b3a908dcc081947b0.translatedText: Stills of "Taking a Walk on the Sand" (1)

af51f70fee3f65e33a3194ddca82751a665763f8.sourceText: 《踏莎行》剧照（二） Photo credit: Wang Da Sheng， Li Xiao Ping 《踏莎行》表现了传统与创新的冲突与磨合，并憧憬艺术生命成长和成熟后的恬然自由。这是2013中国舞蹈双周的开场舞，深受现场观众的喜爱。 《前定的暗色》作品以人与人，人与环境间的关系为话题，通过桑氏舞蹈剧场极具个人风范的创意和动作方式，戏剧性地给与诠释。该作品已先后在、德国、墨西哥、波兰、拉脱维亚五个国家等十几个城市巡演，以强烈的戏剧张力和舞台视效征服了世界观众。 正如舞蹈家曹诚渊所说，中国现代舞甚至比西方的现代舞更加开放，更加敢于表现，不拘于流派，让大家感受到现代中国生机勃勃的景象。未来他希望能与当地的舞蹈学校有更多的交流与合作，为现代舞培养更多的人才。
af51f70fee3f65e33a3194ddca82751a665763f8.translatedText: Stills of "Taking a Walk on the Sand" (2). Photo credit: Wang Da Sheng, Li Xiao Ping "Traveling on the Sand" expresses the conflict and integration of tradition and innovation, and looks forward to the tranquil freedom after the growth and maturity of artistic life. This is the opening dance of the 2013 Chinese Dance Weekend and is deeply loved by the audience. The work "Predestined Darkness" focuses on the relationship between people and the relationship between people and the environment. It is dramatically interpreted through the creative and action methods of Sand Dance Theater. The work has toured more than a dozen cities in five countries, including Germany, Mexico, Poland, and Latvia, and has conquered the world's audiences with its strong dramatic tension and stage visual effects. As dancer Cao Chengyuan said, Chinese modern dance is even more open than Western modern dance, more daring to express, and not limited to genres, allowing everyone to feel the vibrant scene of modern China. In the future, he hopes to have more exchanges and cooperation with local dance schools to cultivate more talents for modern dance.

8410334348279c2d1db3da6eadf53f0fbea241df.sourceText: 五月鲜花献母亲 洛杉矶举办大型《黄河之魂》主题音乐会 亚省时报 为庆祝母亲节，中国驻洛杉矶总领馆，美国国际文化艺术交流学会联合举办《五月鲜花献母亲－黄河之魂》主题音乐会，母亲节当天在 Wilshire Ebell 剧院举行庆祝辛亥革命100周年《黄河之魂》主题音乐会，洛杉矶总领馆还在音乐会前举办辛亥革命100周年历史图片展，中国驻洛杉矶总领馆邱绍芳总领事，副总领事孙伟德，卞立新，刚刚履新的文化参赞车兆和等中领馆官员出席，与南加州各界共庆母亲节。 邱绍芳在音乐会前的酒会上致词，祝福天下的母亲健康快乐。邱绍芳表示，今年是辛亥革命100周年，今天的音乐会更有纪念意义，孙中山领导的辛亥革命推翻了封建帝制，在中国历史上开创了新纪元。今天中国经济腾飞，国际地位提高，然而我们也有遗憾，尚未完成国家的统一。他说，希望能利用辛亥革命百年纪念活动激励中华儿女为中华复兴 、国家统一而努力。 《五月鲜花献母亲－黄河之魂》音乐会歌颂孕育华夏5000年文明的母亲河，表达海外华人对祖国母亲的深深眷恋。音乐会的重头戏，双钢琴演奏的钢琴协奏曲《黄河》，气势磅礴，扣人心弦，特别是最后的《保卫黄河》大合唱，催人奋发，激励人心。此次音乐会还有一大特点，就是外国人用中文演唱脍炙人口，大家耳熟能详的经典名曲，男高音歌唱家 Gabriel Silva 演唱的《在那桃花盛开的地方》，加唱的《乌苏里船歌》更是调动起全场的气氛，女高音Lizbeth Lucca 演唱的《我爱你，中国》更是引起大家的共鸣，女高音歌唱家周媄媄，张莉，孙欣欣等的演唱也博得观众的热烈掌声。
8410334348279c2d1db3da6eadf53f0fbea241df.translatedText: Flowers for Mother in May, a large-scale "Soul of the Yellow River" themed concert was held in Los Angeles. The Alberta Times In order to celebrate Mother's Day, the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles and the American Association for International Cultural and Art Exchange jointly organized a concert with the theme of "Flowers for Mother in May - Soul of the Yellow River" at Wilshire Ebell on Mother's Day. The theater held a concert themed "Soul of the Yellow River" to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911. The Consulate General of Los Angeles also held a historical photo exhibition of the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911 before the concert. Consul General of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles Qiu Shaofang, Deputy Consul General Sun Weide, Bian Lixin, and newly appointed Cultural Counselor Che Zhaohe and other Chinese Consulate officials attended to celebrate Mother's Day with all walks of life in Southern California. Qiu Shaofang delivered a speech at the reception before the concert, wishing all mothers in the world good health and happiness. Qiu Shaofang said that this year marks the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911, and today's concert is even more commemorative. The Revolution of 1911 led by Sun Yat-sen overthrew the feudal monarchy and ushered in a new era in Chinese history. Today, China's economy is taking off and its international status has improved. However, we also regret that the country's reunification has not yet been completed. He said that he hoped to use the centenary commemoration of the Revolution of 1911 to inspire the Chinese people to work hard for the rejuvenation of China and the reunification of the country. The concert "Flowers for Mother in May - Soul of the Yellow River" celebrates the mother river that has given birth to 5,000 years of Chinese civilization and expresses the deep attachment of overseas Chinese to their motherland. The highlight of the concert, the piano concerto "Yellow River" played by two pianos, was majestic and exciting, especially the final chorus "Defend the Yellow River", which was inspiring and inspiring. Another major feature of this concert is that foreigners sang in Chinese a well-known classic song, "Where the Peach Blossoms Bloom" by tenor Gabriel Silva, and the additional "Ussuri Barcarolle" aroused the atmosphere of the audience. Soprano Lizbeth Lucca The performance of "I Love You, China" resonated with everyone, and the performances of sopranos Zhou Yumei, Zhang Li, Sun Xinxin and others also won warm applause from the audience.

f5c33250d5c8f9c1ce51317746578261c9c29995.sourceText: 气候反常 西岸霜冻 东岸温暖 美国国家气象局表示，全国的气温出现两极。加州南部和中部、亚利桑那州发布霜冻警报，局部温度低至摄氏零度以下。在亚特兰大，一些居民在温和的天气中穿着短衣短裤，乔治亚州正在经历反常的高温天气。 西部海岸加州南部的果园和农地正在抢收作物，避免灾难性的霜冻灾害。洛杉矶盆地和圣地亚哥局部地区正在经历罕见的比正常温度低20华氏度的低温天气，低温可能导致全国的水果和蔬菜的价格上升。 在南加州，一些果园担心抢收的速度不够快。据CBS新闻报导，种植主Ben Taft表示，在降温之前，他只来得及抢收30%的橘子，在未来几天，如果还有零度的低温天气，他将失去70%的收成。
f5c33250d5c8f9c1ce51317746578261c9c29995.translatedText: Abnormal climate: frost on the west coast and warm on the east coast. The National Weather Service said that temperatures across the country have become bipolar. Frost warnings were issued in southern and central California and Arizona, with local temperatures dipping below zero degrees Celsius. In Atlanta, some residents wore shorts and shorts in the mild weather as Georgia experienced unseasonably high temperatures. Orchards and farmland along the West Coast and in southern California are scrambling to harvest crops and avoid catastrophic frost damage. The Los Angeles Basin and parts of San Diego are experiencing rare cold temperatures up to 20 degrees Fahrenheit below normal, which could lead to higher prices for fruits and vegetables across the country. In Southern California, some orchards are worried that the harvest isn't happening fast enough. According to CBS News, grower Ben Taft said that he only had time to harvest 30% of the oranges before the temperature dropped. In the next few days, if there is still sub-zero low temperature weather, he will lose 70% of the harvest.

d121ad5f1ed023e57cbff4154b9540aaf2d1e1e0.sourceText: 一周震两次比华利山凌晨发生浅层地震 比华​​利山7日凌晨发生3.5级浅层地震，南加州大部分地区都有震感，没有造成损失或者人员受伤。 根据美国地质调查局的报告，这次地震是本周在比华利山发生的第二次地震，地震发生在凌晨12：03分，地震震中非常浅。 洛杉矶大部分地区都有震感。 从圣塔莫尼卡到圣费南多谷都有人们报告有震感。 很显然这是由于地震发生在浅层造成。 洛杉矶火警部门的发言人汉姆福瑞（Brian Humphrey）说，地震后洛杉矶消防局进入紧急状态，所有106个消防站都进行了损失调查，而火警局的直升飞机也在空中盘旋进行勘查。 地震紧急状态在凌晨12：46分结束，消防局并没有发现任何人员伤亡以及损失。 比华​​利山的这次地震是在两周内发生的第二次地震，第一次发生在星期一早晨3：27分，当时发生了3.2级地震。 地震学家并没有立即表示两起地震是否有所关联。
d121ad5f1ed023e57cbff4154b9540aaf2d1e1e0.translatedText: Two earthquakes a week, a shallow earthquake occurred in Beverly Hills early in the morning A 3.5-magnitude shallow earthquake occurred in Beverly Hills in the early morning of the 7th. The earthquake was felt in most parts of Southern California. No damage or injuries were caused. The earthquake, the second to hit Beverly Hills this week, occurred at 12:03 a.m. and had a very shallow epicenter, according to the U.S. Geological Survey. The quake was felt in much of Los Angeles. People from Santa Monica to the San Fernando Valley reported feeling the tremors. Apparently this was caused by the earthquake occurring at shallow depths. Brian Humphrey, a spokesman for the Los Angeles Fire Department, said that the Los Angeles Fire Department entered a state of emergency after the earthquake. All 106 fire stations conducted damage surveys, and the Fire Department's helicopters were also hovering in the sky for inspections. The earthquake emergency ended at 12:46 a.m., and the fire department did not find any casualties or losses. The quake in Beverly Hills was the second in two weeks, the first occurring at 3:27 a.m. Monday morning when a magnitude 3.2 quake struck. Seismologists did not immediately say whether the two quakes were related.

fa0e0a1cb838939822dbd376b1de402a46edacc9.sourceText: 实现购屋梦（一） 对新移民来讲，购屋是实现美国梦的其中一步，当您考虑购屋时，有以下几点提供给您参考。 1. 了解自己能负担什么价位的房子，例如: 您有多少头期款，每个月能负担多少房屋贷款，如果能够取得银行愿意核准贷款的证明(Pre-qualified或Pre-approved)，对顺利 购屋会有很大的帮助。 Pre-qualified和Pre-approved这两者的差别在于: 前者只是贷款银行对于您的收入、资产及负债等基本个人资料做一个大概评估，让您知道大概可以借到多少钱；后者则是正式提出 贷款申请，银行进一步根据所提供的文件证明，像是报税单、薪资单、银行月结单等等，并查核您的财务背景后，让您知道银行最多愿意借您多少钱。 如果能拿到银行的Pre-approved证明，当然是比Pre-qualified好。 2. 要清楚自己在购屋过程中的权利，例如: 法律规定，所有人都有平等购屋的权利，不应受到种族、肤色、国籍、信仰、性别、家庭状况及是否残障等因素的影响；不动产 交易相关行业(Real estate settlement services)的从业人员，彼此之间不得收取介绍费、回扣，因为这可能会增加您付出的费用；还包括购屋时您应收到的文件、产生的费用及贷款者 应有的权利等等，强烈建议您选择一位全职、专业的房地产经纪人来为您的权利把关、同时提供咨询。 人生因为有梦而美，但要筑梦踏实，在开始寻找理想中的房屋之前，至少要先了解什么价位的房子是您负担得起的，才不会在找到美梦中的房屋之后，因为贷 不到款而感到失落。 我们将于下周的专栏中，再继续说明，如您有房地产方面的问题，欢迎打电话到我的专线(480) 612-4545 或email至 Rich@RichLiao.com 。
fa0e0a1cb838939822dbd376b1de402a46edacc9.translatedText: Realizing the dream of buying a house (1) For new immigrants, buying a house is one of the steps to realize the American dream. When you consider buying a house, the following points are provided for your reference. 1. Understand the price of a house you can afford, such as: how much down payment you have, and how much housing loan you can afford each month. If you can obtain proof that the bank is willing to approve the loan (Pre-qualified or Pre-approved), it will be of great help to the smooth purchase of a house. The difference between Pre-qualified and Pre-approved is: the former is just a rough assessment by the lending bank of your basic personal information such as income, assets and liabilities to let you know how much money you can borrow; the latter is a formal loan application. The bank further relies on the provided documentary evidence, such as tax returns, salary slips, bank statements, etc., and checks your financial background to let you know the maximum amount of money the bank is willing to lend you. If you can get a Pre-approved certificate from the bank, it is certainly better than Pre-qualified. 2. Be clear about your rights in the process of buying a house. For example: The law stipulates that everyone has the equal right to buy a house and should not be affected by factors such as race, color, nationality, creed, gender, family status, disability, etc.; Practitioners in real estate transaction-related industries (Real estate settlement services) are not allowed to charge referral fees or kickbacks from each other, because this may increase the cost you pay; it also includes the documents you should receive when buying a house, the fees incurred, and the lender. Due rights, etc., it is strongly recommended that you choose a full-time, professional real estate agent to check your rights and provide consultation at the same time. Life is beautiful because of dreams, but to build a solid dream, before you start looking for your ideal house, you must at least understand what price of a house you can afford, so that you will not feel disappointed because you cannot get a loan after you find your dream house. We will continue to explain in next week's column. If you have any questions about real estate, please call my hotline (480) 612-4545 or email to Rich@RichLiao.com.

cedd31cb5a9933e8a0899af55d961167dd2e7a0e.sourceText: 吉福兹中枪案 无限期搁置 联邦地区法院法官伯恩斯 25 日裁决，图森滥射案凶嫌劳夫纳精神状况不适合接受审判，并将这起案件无限期搁置。 此次滥射案导致国会众议员嘉贝丽．吉福兹头部中弹受重伤，但奇迹似地生还，目前仍在接受复健中。 伯恩斯的这项裁决，意味着 21 岁的劳夫纳将被送到一座联邦监狱关押四个月，等待其精神能力恢复。 在 25 日的法庭听证会上，劳夫纳曾一度胡言乱语，他低着头说：「感谢你提供的畸形人展览，她死在我的面前。」伯恩斯于是命令法警把劳夫纳带离法庭。 劳夫纳后来又被带回法庭。伯恩斯告诉他，他有权观看听证会过程，并问他是否愿意到另一房间观看，劳夫纳回答说：「我想看电视屏幕。」 劳夫纳已在密苏里州春田一家联邦监狱关押了五周，接受法院指定的两名精神病专家的鉴定，以确定他是否理解这项诉讼的后果。但两名专家的鉴定报告没有公布。
cedd31cb5a9933e8a0899af55d961167dd2e7a0e.translatedText: The Giffords shooting case has been put on hold indefinitely. Federal District Court Judge Burns ruled on the 25th that Loughner, the suspect in the Tucson shooting case, was mentally unfit to stand trial and put the case on hold indefinitely. This indiscriminate shooting led to Congresswoman Gabrielle. Giffords was shot in the head and seriously injured, but miraculously survived and is still recovering. Burns' ruling means the 21-year-old Loughner will be sent to a federal prison for four months while he waits to regain his mental capacity. During the court hearing on the 25th, Loughner was rambling at one point. He lowered his head and said, "Thank you for the freak exhibit. She died in front of me." Burns then ordered the bailiff to take Loughner away from the court. Loughner was later brought back to court. Burns told him he had a right to watch the hearing and asked if he would go to another room to watch, to which Loughner replied, "I want to watch the TV screen." Loughner has been held in a federal prison in Springfield, Missouri, for five weeks while two court-appointed psychiatrists examined him to determine whether he understood the ramifications of the lawsuit. However, the appraisal reports of the two experts have not been released.

7510c871595174d0fdfb0ae954602e508c9ff45e.sourceText: 中国民间音乐家华彦钧（阿炳）于1950年9月在无锡录製的六首二胡、琵琶曲中，有一首二胡曲，经中央音乐学院教授杨荫浏先生与阿炳商酌，定名为《二泉映月》。 这首感情丰富的乐曲，曲名很美，艺术上有强烈的感染力，曾获得「二十世纪华人音乐经典作品奖」，已被选为世界十大名曲之一。 着名音乐家贺绿汀先生曾说过：「二泉映月这个风雅的名字，其实与此音乐的内涵是矛盾的，与其说音乐描写了二泉映月的风景，不如说是深刻地抒发瞎子阿炳自己痛苦的身世。」 美国波士顿交响乐团首席指挥小泽征尔，听了中央音乐学院姜剑华二胡独奏此曲后，说他有断肠之感。后来他在波士顿交响乐团指挥演奏《二泉映月》后说：「我指挥得不好，还没有充分发挥乐曲的长处。」 可见中外音乐界权威人士，都一致肯定《二泉映月》乐曲，并给予高度的评价。 2010年02期《苏州杂志》上刊登了冬苗《陆文夫一生的「阿炳情缘」》一文，该文疑点重重，一直受熟知阿炳水平及其作品人士质疑。《陆文夫一生的「阿炳情缘」》曾被《扬子晚报》、《报刊文摘》转载，后来又变换不同的题目，在网络上广为流传至今。文中居然说：「《二泉映月》并非阿炳创作，源自风月场中婊子和嫖客调情时，唱的淫曲《知心客》！」 那麽《知心客》是什麽样的曲调呢？《知心客》又名《码头调》，是流传于苏南的民间小调。曲调悦耳，婉转动听。各地传唱的歌词不同。江苏太仓流传的《知心客》具有代表性，歌曲确实描绘了青楼女子的生活。1937年上海明星公司摄製的电影《马路天使》的主题曲《天涯歌女》，就是贺绿汀先生根据《知心客》改变的。1964年香港长城电影公司拍摄的电影《三笑》中的插曲，也採用《知心客》的曲调填词而成。苏州民歌《大九连环》中《苏州风光》的第一段等等，也借用了《知心客》。可见民众对《知心客》并不陌生。1950年《二泉映月》录音问世后的头二十年，人们从未发现它与《知心客》有丝毫联繫。 这种谣传从上世纪七十年代起，有所增多。《中国古代音乐史稿》及《十番锣鼓》的着者、成功解读了宋代姜白石曲谱的近代民乐奠基人杨荫浏，把《知心客》的工尺谱译成简谱，并且记上原来的歌词，对照《二泉映月》曲谱，人们看到两首曲子的旋律，没有任何相似或相近的地方，曲调、风格和韵味完全风马牛不相及。 1978年杨荫浏先生两次写信给着名二胡教育家、南京师范大学音乐系教授黎松寿先生，谈及「《二泉映月》脱胎小曲《知心客》」之事。在1978年9月27日的信中写道：古怪之说越来越多。有人说，「阿炳的二泉映月脱胎于民间小曲知心客」，厖若让此说法成立，无异于承认阿炳的二泉映月一文不值。 同年10月11日杨荫浏给黎松寿的信中，再次提及《知心客》的问题厖「附上《知心客》的译稿（根据工尺谱）。您一看就会看出与《二泉映月》毫无关係。 由此可见，冬苗《陆文夫一生的「阿炳情缘」》中所说的「《二泉映月》并非阿炳创作，源出风月场中婊子和嫖客调情时，唱的淫曲《知心客》！」实属无稽之谈。
7510c871595174d0fdfb0ae954602e508c9ff45e.translatedText: > Among the six erhu and pipa pieces recorded by Chinese folk musician Hua Yanjun (A Bing) in Wuxi in September 1950, there was an erhu piece, which was named "Two Springs Reflect the Moon" after discussion between Mr. Yang Yinliu, a professor at the Central Conservatory of Music, and A Bing. This emotionally rich piece of music has a beautiful title and a strong artistic appeal. It has won the "20th Century Chinese Music Classic Award" and has been selected as one of the top ten famous songs in the world. The famous musician Mr. He Luting once said: "The elegant name Erquan Yingyue is actually contradictory to the connotation of the music. Rather than describing the scenery of Erquan Yingyue, the music profoundly expresses the painful life experience of the blind man A Bing." Seiji Ozawa, chief conductor of the Boston Symphony Orchestra in the United States, said that he felt heartbroken after listening to Jiang Jianhua's erhu solo at the Central Conservatory of Music. Later, after he conducted the performance of "The Moon on Two Fountains" with the Boston Symphony Orchestra, he said, "I did not conduct well and did not give full play to the strengths of the music." It can be seen that authorities in the music industry at home and abroad unanimously affirmed the music "The Moon Reflects on Two Fountains" and spoke highly of it. In the 2010 Issue 02 of Suzhou Magazine, Dong Miao published an article titled "Lu Wenfu's Love Affair with Abing in His Life". The article was full of doubts and has been questioned by those who are familiar with Abing and his works. "Lu Wenfu's Life of "Abing's Love"" was reprinted by "Yangtze Evening News" and "Newspaper Digest". Later, it changed different titles and has been widely circulated on the Internet to this day. The article actually said: ""Er Quan Ying Yue" was not written by A Bing, but originated from the obscene song "Zhi Xin Ke" sung by the bitch in the sex shop when she was flirting with her client!" So what kind of tune is "Zhi Xin Ke"? "Zhi Xin Ke", also known as "Dock Diao", is a folk tune spread in southern Jiangsu. The melody is pleasant and melodious. The lyrics sung vary from place to place. "Intimate Guest" circulated in Taicang, Jiangsu Province is representative, and the song really depicts the life of a brothel woman. The theme song "Song Girl from the End of the World" for the movie "Street Angel" produced by Shanghai Star Company in 1937 was changed by Mr. He Luting based on "Intimate Guest". The episode in the 1964 movie "Three Smiles" shot by Hong Kong's Great Wall Film Company also used the tune of "Intimate Guest" to compose the lyrics. The first paragraph of "Suzhou Scenery" in the Suzhou folk song "Dajiu Lianlian" and so on also borrowed from "Intimate Guest". It can be seen that the public is no stranger to "Intimate Guest". In the first twenty years after the recording of "Er Quan Ying Yue" came out in 1950, people never found that it had the slightest connection with "Intimate Guest". Such rumors have increased since the 1970s. Yang Yinliu, the author of "History of Ancient Chinese Music" and "Shi Fan Gong and Drum" and the founder of modern folk music who successfully interpreted the music score of Jiang Baishi in the Song Dynasty, translated the Gongchi score of "Zhi Xin Ke" into simplified notation and recorded the original lyrics. When comparing the score of "Er Quan Ying Yue", people can see that the melodies of the two pieces have no similarities or similarities, and the tune, style and charm are completely unrelated. In 1978, Mr. Yang Yinliu wrote twice to Mr. Li Songshou, a famous erhu educator and professor of the Music Department of Nanjing Normal University, talking about "The Moon Reflected in Two Springs" which was born out of the ditty "Zhi Xin Ke". In a letter dated September 27, 1978, he wrote: There are more and more weird stories. Some people say that "A Bing's Two Springs Reflect the Moon was born out of the folk ditty Zhixinke". If Pang allows this statement to be true, it is tantamount to admitting that A Bing's Two Springs Reflect the Moon is worthless. In a letter from Yang Yinliu to Li Songshou on October 11 of the same year, he once again mentioned the issue of "Zhixinke". "Attached is the translation of "Zhixinke" (according to Gongchi Pu). You will see at a glance that it has nothing to do with "Er Quan Ying Yue". From this we can see that what Dong Miao said in "Lu Wenfu's Life and Love with Abing" that ""The Moon Reflected in Two Springs" was not written by Abing, but originated from the obscene song "Intimate Guest" sung by the bitch in the sex shop when she was flirting with her client!" is really nonsense.
