2a3fb56bb82a8dc3e22e9f4eb7ad9ab857124bba.sourceText: 中国新闻周刊英文版（News China)，日前在洛杉矶圣盖博希尔顿酒店举行创刊三周年酒会。 中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆邱绍芳总领事，华裔联邦众议员赵美心，中国新闻社美国分社社长王晓晖，周刊执行总裁腾 绍骏，和部分民选官员，各界嘉宾近两百人出席了当晚的酒会。 中国新闻社美国分社社长王晓晖致辞时表示，隶属于中新社的中国新闻周刊，其中文版在2011中国期刊排行榜中名列第一，英文版自08年登陆北美后发行量已超过8万 册，读者遍及美国50个州，全球读者遍及四大洲13个国家和地区，今年周刊的销售翻了一番，订户翻了两番，继英文版之后，周刊又相继推出了日文版，韩 文版，意大利文版和南亚版。 周刊美加发行3年来 已经成为美国智库，研究中国的专家和美国各大图书馆必读与收藏的刊物。 中领馆邱绍芳总领事对周刊发行3周年表示祝贺，他说，新闻周刊英文版受到美国主流读者的普遍好评，订户越来越多，发行量越来越大，起到了沟通中美文化的桥梁作用 ，让美国朋友和海外华人华侨真实地了解到中国开放30多年来所发生的巨大变化。 华裔联邦众议员赵美心赞扬新闻周刊英文版在美国的发行，帮助美国读者了解中国起到的作用表示肯定，纠正了美国一些媒体对中国一些报导不够公正，为美国读者提供了全面公正的新闻报导。 随后，赵美心和后来致辞的阿罕布拉市长沉时康，蒙特利公园市长刘达强等民选官员向中国新闻社美国分社长王晓晖，周刊执行总裁腾绍骏颁发贺状。
2a3fb56bb82a8dc3e22e9f4eb7ad9ab857124bba.translatedText: The English version of China News Weekly (News China) recently held a reception for its third anniversary at the San Gabriel Hilton Hotel in Los Angeles. Consul General Qiu Shaofang of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, Chinese-American Congressman Zhao Meixin, China News Service’s U.S. Bureau Chief Wang Xiaohui, weekly CEO Teng Shaojun, as well as some elected officials and nearly 200 guests from all walks of life attended the reception that night. In his speech, Wang Xiaohui, president of the US branch of China News Service, said that the Chinese version of China News Weekly, which is affiliated to China News Service, ranked first in the 2011 Chinese periodical rankings. The English version has circulated more than 80,000 copies since it was launched in North America in 2008. Readers are in 50 states in the United States, and global readers are in 13 countries and regions on four continents. This year, the sales of the weekly have doubled, and the subscribers have quadrupled. Following the English version, the weekly has launched Japanese versions, and South Korea. Chinese version, Italian version and South Asian version. In the three years since the publication of the weekly in the United States and Canada, it has become a must-read and collected publication for American think tanks, experts on China and major American libraries. Consul General Qiu Shaofang of the Chinese Consulate expressed congratulations on the third anniversary of the publication of the weekly. He said that the English version of Newsweek has been widely praised by mainstream readers in the United States, with an increasing number of subscribers and a growing circulation, and has served as a bridge between Chinese and American cultures. , allowing American friends and overseas Chinese to truly understand the tremendous changes that have taken place in China over the past 30 years of opening up. Chinese-American Congressman Zhao Meixin praised the publication of the English version of Newsweek in the United States and affirmed its role in helping American readers understand China. It has corrected some unfair reports on China by some American media and provided American readers with comprehensive and fair news reports. Later, Zhao Meixin, Alhambra Mayor Shen Shikang, Monterey Park Mayor Liu Daqiang and other elected officials presented congratulatory certificates to Wang Xiaohui, China News Agency's US branch president, and Teng Shaojun, CEO of China News Weekly.

ac42537fd2f9542aba2d710852036f8013ed6836.sourceText: 凤城华人保龄球赛颁奖 六福酒家赢得全年总冠军（图） 美西侨报 保龄球比赛要比球技，更拼体力与耐力。 每年六月至十二月是第一阶段，接着一月至五月是第二阶段比赛，今年第一阶段冠军中餐会与第二阶段冠军六福酒家争夺总冠军，六福酒家技高一筹赢得全年总冠军。 5月23日颁奖典礼中朱绍明获个人单局最高分289（满分300），朱绍明获个人三局最高分。欣欣超市获全年三局最高分。大会设置少年组，自幼即培养选手，今年二位得奖人均不超过10岁。 中餐馆协会近年积极投入组织二队参加全年比赛，在暑假六月至九月间请专人负责指导，吸引更多餐饮员工加入。
ac42537fd2f9542aba2d710852036f8013ed6836.translatedText: >Fengcheng Chinese Bowling Competition Awards Ceremony Luk Fook Restaurant won the overall championship for the year (photo) American Overseas Chinese News Bowling competition requires more physical strength and endurance than ball skills. The first stage is from June to December every year, followed by the second stage from January to May. This year, the champion Chinese restaurant in the first stage will compete with the champion Luk Fook Restaurant in the second stage for the overall championship. Luk Fook Restaurant has the upper hand to win the overall championship for the whole year. In the award ceremony on May 23, Zhu Shaoming received the highest personal score of 289 in a single game (out of 300 points), and Zhu Shaoming received the highest personal score in three games. Xinxin Supermarket received the highest score among the three games throughout the year. The conference has a youth category to train contestants from an early age. This year’s two winners are both under 10 years old. In recent years, the Chinese Restaurant Association has actively invested in organizing a second team to participate in the year-round competition, and hired dedicated personnel to provide guidance during the summer vacation from June to September to attract more catering employees to join.

fd1b2f8d3899f131a55701a1657b002fc5fc754f.sourceText: 慧明：种出了文化情结 图桑 慧明 原本建立绿手指这个群，就是几个喜欢翻土种花草的朋友相互切磋一下技艺，像隐居山林的武界高手那般，把式练久了不过瘾，便出山找人比划比划，也乘机结识一下天下英雄。 谁知这一入江湖，便知江湖的无限了。 那久违了的爱犊之心最先便从心底哪个角落渗了出来，借着顺着浇水滴滴浸入那绿色的幼苗，小心呵护之情几乎不亚于对付一个婴儿或者一个宠物。不小心弄折一片叶一根藤，都会心疼自责许久。 那满园的绿色仿佛就是自己可爱的宝宝，忍不住还会对这无声的精灵呢喃起来。女性更擅长此道，往往是园中并无对答者，你却见她吴侬软语说个不休，两手还上下梳理，像是给出门的女儿打点行装。男人虽然不谙娘腔，浇完水，抹一把汗，丢下一句，”给我好好地长”便也有丝丝的柔情了。 这地里的精灵也争气。别看这是沙漠，太阳又可着劲地给力，可只要你舍得精力，给她喂点水，她就会百般妩媚地回报你。 还是乍寒时光，那黄瓜便顶着满身的刺与冷冷的露水抗争着，与早早张开嫣红笑脸的桃花并肩报春。豆角也随其后，迫不及待地甩出一根根长长的辫子，随风飘舞，仿佛不这样就不能展现少女思春的情怀一样。那挤眉弄眼的辣椒和娇羞的迷你番茄也不甘落后，一下花颜似海，毫无悬念地把时节拖入了夏日的台阶。 虽说亚利桑那的热天不怎么待见，可在渴望绿色的人们面前，骄阳的肆虐在五花八门的遮阳设备下一样显得苍白无力。那南瓜冬瓜最不理睬这些，依然把大把灿烂的黄花缀满围墙和支架，悄然无息地让晶莹剔透的小瓜翡翠般地挂在荫下。丝瓜苦瓜还有扁豆家族们，要么不爆发，要么就像那什么旗袍协会的美人那般，成群飘逸过来，婀娜多姿，让你美不胜收，目不暇接。 手指们也真像犯了瘾似的，进了门了起了床了先往园里巡视一番，然后心满意足地开始一天。有文化的便幽幽地说，那是宠物情结，园里的绿色永远是长不大看不够的宠物。 那专家们才有的美学观念也在院里得到了平民的诠释。无论青涩的小苗还是慵懒的冬瓜疙疙瘩瘩的苦瓜，在手指们的摄影中总是那么自然，那么完美，甚至还能闻到淡淡的清香。哪怕在聚会中，果蔬已经成了盘中餐，手指们还恋恋不舍地为她们留下一张又一张倩影。 比绿色更让人心醉的是手指们的友谊。不说手指们在群里如何为新来的，一时失手的不厌其烦地指点迷津，也不必说那富余的收获者开车半天将自己爆发的丝瓜扁豆送给群友，就是看聚会上平生不曾谋面的朋友，拿着自己多余的种子，互相告诫南方的荠菜东北的姑娘儿如何栽种，就会心生感动。手指们虽然年龄不同性别不一，但每个人却都是大师和学生，没有矜持，没有冷漠，没有居高临下，只有热情和互相的关爱。有人说，每个人付出的时候都收获了一份友谊的种子，哎，真真是旁观者清哪。 还有人说这绿院工程意义重大，若每户人家都如此，沙漠就凭添一份绿色云云。其实哪有这般伟大。但种着种着，种出了家乡的气息，乡情渐浓，乡愁却淡了，”直把杭州做汴州”的感觉就出来了。古人”日啖荔枝三百颗，”就有”不辞长作岭南人”愿望，而今我辈”常品家蔬数十样”，一不小心也找到家乡故土的感觉。 真没想到，绿指纤纤竟种出了文化的情结。
fd1b2f8d3899f131a55701a1657b002fc5fc754f.translatedText: Huiming: A cultural complex has been planted Tucson Huiming The Green Fingers group was originally established when a few friends who liked to dig up soil and grow flowers and plants competed with each other on their skills. They were like martial arts masters who lived in seclusion in the mountains. When they couldn't get enough of practicing the moves for a long time, they went out to find people to compete with, and also took the opportunity to meet the world's heroes. Who would have thought that once you enter the world, you will know that the world is limitless. The long-lost love for calves first seeped out from some corner of my heart. By watering it and soaking it into the green seedlings, I cared for them with as much care as I would for a baby or a pet. If you accidentally break a leaf or a vine, you will feel sad and blame yourself for a long time. The green in the garden seems to be my own cute baby, and I can't help but murmur to this silent elf. Women are better at this. Often there is no answerer in the garden, but you see her Wu Nong talking softly and combing her hands up and down, as if she is packing her daughter's luggage for leaving home. Although men are not familiar with sissy, after pouring water, wiping sweat, and saying, "Grow well for me," there will be a trace of tenderness. The elves here are also up to date. Even though this is a desert, the sun can be very powerful, but as long as you give up your energy and feed her some water, she will reward you with all kinds of charm. It is still a cold time, and the cucumber is fighting against the cold dew with its thorns all over its body, announcing spring side by side with the peach blossoms that have opened their bright red smiling faces early. Dou Jiao followed suit, eagerly throwing out her long braids and fluttering in the wind, as if she couldn't show the girl's youthful feelings otherwise. The eye-catching peppers and shy mini tomatoes are not far behind, and they are as colorful as the sea, dragging the season into the summer without any suspense. Although Arizona's hot weather is not something we are welcome to see, in front of people who yearn for green, the raging sun pales in comparison with the various sunshade devices. The pumpkin and winter melon paid no attention to these, and still decorated the walls and supports with a large number of brilliant yellow flowers, quietly letting the crystal clear melons hang in the shade like emeralds. The loofah, bitter gourd, and lentil families either don't explode, or they float over in groups like the beauties from the Cheongsam Association, so graceful that you are overwhelmed with beauty and dizzying. The fingers seemed to be addicted. After entering the door and getting up, they first visited the garden and then started the day with satisfaction. Educated people will quietly say that it is a pet complex. The green in the garden will always be a pet that can't get enough of it. The aesthetic concepts only possessed by experts were also interpreted by civilians in the courtyard. No matter the green seedlings or the lazy winter melons and bitter melons, they are always so natural and perfect in the photos taken by our fingers, and you can even smell a faint fragrance. Even at a party, when fruits and vegetables have become part of the meal, the fingers still linger on leaving beautiful photos for them one after another. What is more intoxicating than the color green is the friendship between fingers. Not to mention how the fingers in the group took the trouble to give guidance to the newcomers who accidentally missed it. Not to mention the surplus harvester drove for a long time to deliver the loofah and lentils that he had exploded to the group members. Just watching the friends at the party who have never met in their lives, holding their own extra seeds, telling each other how to plant shepherd's purse in the south and the girls in the northeast, will make you deeply moved. Although the fingers are of different ages and genders, everyone is a master and a student. There is no reserve, no indifference, no condescension, only enthusiasm and mutual care. Some people say that everyone reaps the seeds of friendship when they give. Hey, it is really clear to onlookers. Some people say that this green courtyard project is of great significance. If every household does this, the desert will be greener. In fact, it is not that great. But as we kept planting, we planted the atmosphere of our hometown. As the nostalgia grew stronger, the nostalgia faded, and the feeling of “making Hangzhou Bianzhou” emerged. The ancients "ate three hundred lychees a day" and had the desire to "continue to grow up as Lingnan people". Nowadays, our generation "constantly eats dozens of kinds of home vegetables" and accidentally finds the feeling of hometown. I really didn’t expect that the slender green fingers would actually have a cultural complex.

fc20cb753482ded30c0f5f450907a0d9cd866387.sourceText: 移民局新规：留学生申请驾照 美国移民局（USCIS）最近出台一份新纲要，对于持F签证（全日制学生）、M签证（职业培训学生）和J 签证（交换学生）者，解释了其申请驾驶执照或州身份证的相关规定。 如果目前你持有F、M或J签证并符合以下所有要求，你将有资格申请驾驶执照或州身份证： 在”’学生和交流访问者系统”’（Student and Exchange Visitor System ，SEVIS）的记录处于”有效”(active)状态，并且从”有效”之日起至少等待了两个工作日。 从进入美国之日起，至少等待了10天才提出申请驾驶执照或州身份证; 根据规定，非移民身份至少还有6个月以上才截止到期。 USCIS希望各州通过SAVE程序验证申请人的信息。SAVE程序是一个政府间的数据库，允许各州政府机关对照国土安全部的数据库，以检查申请人的移民身份。 持有F、M或J签证的个人欲申请驾驶执照或州身份证，需携带以下材料到当地的DMV（机动车管理部门）： 附有有效签证的护照， I?94表（到达/离境记录）， 申请F或M签证的I – 20表，申请 J签证的DS – 2019表， 如有申请就业授权文件（EAD）的I – 766表，可带上。 如果身份改变，带上案件通知（Notice of Action）I – 797或I – 797A表。 社会安全号码（Social Security Number，SSN）。如果社会安全管理部（Social Security administration ，SSA）拒绝给予F、M或J非移民签证持有者一个社会安全号码，应该会发出一封拒绝受理SSN的说明信，即 SSA – L676表。如果没有社会安全号码，在DMV办公室申请驾照或身份证时，必须出示这封信。 此外，如果随行家属能提供目前个人身份证明材料和主要签证持有者的身份证明，也有资格申请驾驶执照或州身份证。 对于F、M或J非移民签证持有者，社会安全号码不是申请驾驶执照或身份证的必须文件。但在大多数州，非移民可能需要申请一个社会安全号码。有关如何申请，可 按照社会安全管理部（Social Security administration ，SSA）网站所述的说明http://www.ssa.gov/。 如果F、M或J非移民护照上的姓名与I – 20或DS?2019签证表格上的名字不符，在去DMV之前，须通过所在学校的学生办公室主任（Dean of Student Office，DSO）修改I-20表，或联络有关负责人员（Responsible Officer ，RO）修改DS-2019表。
fc20cb753482ded30c0f5f450907a0d9cd866387.translatedText: New Immigration Bureau regulations: International students apply for a driver's license The U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) recently issued a new outline explaining the regulations for applying for a driver’s license or state identification card for F visa holders (full-time students), M visas (vocational training students), and J visas (exchange students). You will be eligible to apply for a driver's license or state identification card if you currently hold an F, M, or J visa and meet all of the following requirements: Your record in the Student and Exchange Visitor System (SEVIS) is "active" and you have waited at least two business days from the "active" date. From the date of entering the United States, you must wait at least 10 days before applying for a driver's license or state identification card; according to regulations, non-immigrant status will not expire for at least 6 months. USCIS expects states to verify applicants' information through the SAVE process. The SAVE program is an intergovernmental database that allows state agencies to check an applicant's immigration status against the Department of Homeland Security's database. Individuals holding an F, M or J visa who want to apply for a driver's license or state identification card need to bring the following materials to their local DMV (Department of Motor Vehicles): Passport with valid visa, Form I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record), Form I-20 for F or M visa, Form DS-2019 for J visa, Form I-766 for Employment Authorization Document (EAD) if you have one. If your status has changed, bring Notice of Action Form I-797 or Form I-797A. Social Security Number (SSN). If the Social Security Administration (SSA) denies a Social Security number to an F, M, or J nonimmigrant visa holder, it should issue a letter denying the SSN, known as SSA – Form L676. If you do not have a Social Security number, you must present this letter when applying for a driver's license or ID card at a DMV office. In addition, accompanying family members are also eligible to apply for a driver's license or state identification card if they can provide current personal identification documents and proof of identity of the primary visa holder. For F, M, or J nonimmigrant visa holders, a Social Security number is not required when applying for a driver’s license or identification card. But in most states, nonimmigrants may need to apply for a Social Security number. On how to apply, follow the instructions on the Social Security Administration (SSA) website at http://www.ssa.gov/. If the name on the F, M or J non-immigrant passport does not match the name on the I-20 or DS?2019 visa form, before going to the DMV, you must modify the I-20 form through the Dean of Student Office (DSO) at your school, or contact the relevant responsible officer (Responsible Officer, RO) to modify the DS-2019 form.

d589d3fec6760a82e04ee45b7a3f82a91ef4af71.sourceText: 北美华文作家协会2012年代表大会8月29日在法拉盛喜来登大酒店揭幕，北美各分会代表近百人出席。这次大会旨在团结值得崇敬的文字工作族，彼此沟通交流、分享心得、互相砥礪。驻纽约台北经济文化办事处处长高振群出席开幕典礼致词，为华人作家加油打气。 世界华文作家协会创立于1981年，会员3000多人。北美华文作家协会是七大洲最大的协会.，有20 多个分会 (至少有35个会员，才被接纳為分会) 。亚利桑那州分会是2001年加入的。这次出席大会代表是，现任会长少君、分会创立时会长老真。 大会聘请白先勇先生（国民党著名将领白崇喜之公子）担任主讲。他以新著「父亲与民国」為题，畅谈这部图片為主传记文学传记写作的心得。此次演讲与纽约世界日报合办，以扩大文学在社区的影响，有数百人到场听讲, 场面鼎盛。 因地利之缘，得纽约佛光山的协助，大会第三天， 移师到上州的鹿野苑继续两天两夜的活动。「鹿野苑」是一个风景优美、环境清幽的山间活动中心。会上，作家丛甦作近期海外华文文学发展的发言，作家少君作网络文学和文学出版工作动态的发言。还有，各分会心得交流、心灵禪修、赏枫巡山等活动。 31日，欣逢中秋节，当晚举行了「中秋之夜」，由少君与陈十美担任晚会主持。 与会者自编自导自演【草裙舞】，有男扮女装客串演出，搅笑娱乐，热闹非常 。
d589d3fec6760a82e04ee45b7a3f82a91ef4af71.translatedText: The 2012 Congress of the Chinese Writers Association of North America was unveiled at the Sheraton Hotel in Flushing on August 29th. Nearly a hundred representatives from branches in North America attended. This conference aims to unite admirable writing professionals to communicate, share experiences, and strengthen each other. Gao Zhenqun, director of the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in New York, attended the opening ceremony and delivered a speech to cheer for Chinese writers. The World Chinese Writers Association was founded in 1981 and has more than 3,000 members. The North American Chinese Writers Association is the largest association on the seven continents. It has more than 20 branches (at least 35 members are required to be admitted as a branch). The Arizona chapter was added in 2001. The representatives attending the conference this time were Shaojun, the current president, and Changzhen, the president when the branch was founded. The conference hired Mr. Bai Xianyong (son of the famous Kuomintang general Bai Chongxi) as the keynote speaker. Taking the title of his new book "Father and the Republic of China", he talked about his experience in writing this picture-based literary biography. This lecture was co-organized with the New York World Journal to expand the influence of literature in the community. Hundreds of people attended the lecture, which was a great occasion. Due to the favorable geographical location and the assistance of Fo Guang Shan in New York, the conference moved to Deer Park in Upstate for two days and two nights on the third day. "Deer Park" is a mountain activity center with beautiful scenery and quiet environment. At the meeting, writer Cong Su gave a speech on the recent development of overseas Chinese literature, and writer Shaojun gave a speech on the latest trends in online literature and literary publishing. There are also activities such as experience exchange, spiritual meditation, maple viewing and mountain patrol among branches. On the 31st, the Mid-Autumn Festival was celebrated, and a "Mid-Autumn Night" was held that night, with Shaojun and Chen Shimei as hosts. Attendees wrote, directed and performed [Hula Dance] themselves, and some men dressed up as women to perform as guest performers, making it hilarious and entertaining.

e8442e14b7c74c4ad7ab0e0e09654bd95a1bf33d.sourceText: 第六届“世粤联会”泰国曼谷盛大开幕 【广东侨务信息】 8月13日上午，备受海内外关注的第六届世界广东同乡联谊大会（简称 ”世粤联会”）在泰国首都曼谷盛大开幕。来自全球30多个国家和地区的2000多位粤籍俊彦乡贤相聚一堂，共叙乡情，共襄发展，吸引了全球侨界的广泛关注。 第六届”世粤联会”由泰国潮州会馆、泰国客家总会、泰国广肇会馆联合主办。大会的主题是”纪念辛亥百年，推动革新发展”，旨在缅怀海外华侨对辛亥革命的丰功伟绩，增进海内外粤籍乡亲的团结合作，加强联谊交流，深化经贸合作，实现合作共嬴，以促进侨社和谐革新与发展，推动粤泰经贸文化交流，实现广东经济社会发展新跨越，推动民族统一复兴的伟大事业。 第六届”世粤联会”开幕式气氛热烈，泰国副总理差林差林育班隆，中国驻泰国大使管木，国侨办副主任马儒沛，广东省政府秘书长唐豪，粤籍乡贤代表等先后在开幕式上致辞。”世粤联会”常务理事会主席、广东省侨办主任吴锐成作了工作报告。国侨办主任李海峰、广东省省长黄华华、广东省委常委、统战部部长周镇宏为大会题词。 第六届”世粤联会”内容丰富，形式多样，精彩纷呈。粤籍青年才俊、商界精英汇聚一堂的青年论坛经、经济论坛等活动陆续拉开帷幕，期间还举行了”幸福广东，多彩世界棗广东海外联谊会书画家作品海外巡展”剪彩仪式，”辛亥革命与华侨华人”主题演讲等活动。 近年来，广东省积极加强与东盟国家的战略合作，2010年广东省与泰国以召开合作协调年度会议为平台，建立了粤泰长期合作机制，加强了在旅游、农业、教育、卫生等领域的交流合作。因此，本届”世粤联会”在泰国召开意义特殊，大会以乡亲、亲情、友情为纽带，将有利于进一步拓展粤泰合作空间，进一步宣传中华文化，促进粤泰人民友好交流往来。 据了解，广东是全国重要的侨乡，祖籍广东的华侨华人、港澳台同胞3000多万人，广东人的足迹遍布世界五大洲的160多个国家和地区。海外粤籍乡亲念祖爱乡、团结重义、克勤克俭、自强不息，与当地人民和睦共处,积极参与当地经济社会建设,为祖籍国与住在国发展做出了重大贡献。统计显示，截止2010年底，广东累计实际利用港澳资金超过1700亿美元，约占利用外资总量的68%；全省侨资企业达5万多家，占外资企业总数的2/3强；海外侨胞、港澳同胞捐 赠广东慈善公益事业超过450亿元，为广东积极社会作出了积极贡献。 为了促进世界各地广东乡亲的互相联系，增强广东乡亲的团结和凝聚力，1999年，新加坡广东会馆和马来西亚广东会馆联合会共同向世界各地的广东社团发出举办”世粤联会”的倡议，得到了世界各地粤籍乡亲社团的积极响应。作为全世界粤籍乡亲的联谊性活动，在广东省各级领导和侨务部门的支持和推动下，至今已在新加坡、广东、香港、马来西亚和印度尼西亚等国家和地区成功举办了五届，成为全球粤籍社团和乡亲联谊交流合作的重要平台。 第七届世界广东同乡联谊大会预订于2013年在澳门召开。
e8442e14b7c74c4ad7ab0e0e09654bd95a1bf33d.translatedText: The 6th "World Cantonese Federation" grandly opened in Bangkok, Thailand [Guangdong Overseas Chinese Affairs Information] On the morning of August 13, the 6th World Cantonese Friendship Conference (referred to as the “World Cantonese Friendship Conference”), which has attracted much attention at home and abroad, opened grandly in Bangkok, the capital of Thailand. More than 2,000 Cantonese talents from more than 30 countries and regions around the world gathered together to share their nostalgia and develop together, attracting widespread attention from the global overseas Chinese community. The 6th "World Cantonese Federation" is co-sponsored by the Chaozhou Association of Thailand, the Hakka Federation of Thailand, and the Guangzhou Association of Thailand. The theme of the conference is "Commemorating the Centennial of 1911 and Promoting Innovation and Development". It aims to commemorate the great contributions of overseas Chinese to the Revolution of 1911, enhance the unity and cooperation of Cantonese folks at home and abroad, strengthen friendship and exchanges, deepen economic and trade cooperation, and achieve win-win cooperation, so as to promote the harmonious innovation and development of overseas Chinese communities, promote economic, trade and cultural exchanges between Guangdong and Thailand, achieve new leaps in Guangdong's economic and social development, and promote the great cause of national reunification and rejuvenation. The opening ceremony of the 6th "World Cantonese Federation" was held in a warm atmosphere. Thailand's Deputy Prime Minister Charimcharin Yubanlong, Chinese Ambassador to Thailand Guan Mu, Deputy Director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council Ma Rupei, Secretary-General of the Guangdong Provincial Government Tang Hao, and representatives of Cantonese rural sages successively delivered speeches at the opening ceremony. Wu Ruicheng, Chairman of the Standing Council of the "World Cantonese Federation" and Director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Guangdong Province, made a work report. Li Haifeng, Director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council, Huang Huahua, Governor of Guangdong Province, and Zhou Zhenhong, Member of the Standing Committee of the Guangdong Provincial Committee and Minister of the United Front Work Department, wrote inscriptions for the conference. The 6th "World Cantonese Federation" is rich in content, diverse in form and exciting. Activities such as the Youth Forum and the Economic Forum, which brought together young talents from Guangdong and business elites, kicked off one after another. During the period, the ribbon-cutting ceremony of the "Happy Guangdong, Colorful World - Overseas Tour Exhibition of the Works of Calligraphers and Painters of the Guangdong Overseas Friendship Association" and the theme speech of "The Revolution of 1911 and Overseas Chinese" were also held. In recent years, Guangdong Province has actively strengthened strategic cooperation with ASEAN countries. In 2010, Guangdong Province and Thailand held an annual cooperation and coordination meeting as a platform to establish a long-term cooperation mechanism between Guangdong and Thailand and strengthened exchanges and cooperation in the fields of tourism, agriculture, education, health and other fields. Therefore, the holding of this "World Guangdong Federation" in Thailand is of special significance. The conference will be conducive to further expanding the cooperation space between Guangdong and Thailand, further promoting the Chinese culture, and promoting friendly exchanges between the people of Guangdong and Thailand with the ties of hometown, family ties and friendship. It is understood that Guangdong is an important hometown of overseas Chinese in the country. There are more than 30 million overseas Chinese and compatriots from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan who are native to Guangdong. The footprints of Guangdong people can be found in more than 160 countries and regions on five continents of the world. Overseas Cantonese folks cherish their ancestors and love their hometown, are united and righteous, diligent and thrifty, and strive for self-improvement. They live in harmony with the local people, actively participate in local economic and social construction, and have made significant contributions to the development of their country of origin and the country of residence. Statistics show that by the end of 2010, Guangdong had actually used more than 170 billion U.S. dollars of funds from Hong Kong and Macao, accounting for about 68% of the total amount of foreign capital utilized; there were more than 50,000 overseas Chinese-funded enterprises in the province, accounting for two-thirds of the total number of foreign-funded enterprises; overseas Chinese, Hong Kong and Macao compatriots had donated more than 45 billion yuan to Guangdong charities and public welfare, making positive contributions to Guangdong's positive society. In order to promote the mutual contact of Cantonese people from all over the world and enhance the unity and cohesion of Cantonese people, in 1999, the Singapore Cantonese Association and the Federation of Malaysian Cantonese Associations jointly issued an initiative to organize the "World Cantonese Association" to Guangdong organizations around the world, which received positive response from Cantonese organizations around the world. As a social event for Cantonese folks around the world, with the support and promotion of leaders at all levels and the overseas Chinese affairs department of Guangdong Province, it has been successfully held for five times in countries and regions such as Singapore, Guangdong, Hong Kong, Malaysia and Indonesia, and has become an important platform for exchanges and cooperation between Cantonese societies and folks around the world. The 7th World Guangdong Friendship Conference is scheduled to be held in Macau in 2013.

974c3f8d3bb2351d080d7bf3476c7805bf2241df.sourceText: 第二天上午参观南京长江大桥，这是中国人自行设计自行施工的第一座跨越长江的铁路公路两用大桥，1968年国庆前夕建成通车，在当时是轰动全中国的大事。长江上的第一座大桥是五十年代苏联援建的武汉长江大桥。60年代初，中苏关係紧张，苏联撤走了全部专家，停止对中国的一切帮助，连一张技术资料都不留。中国人提出”自力更生，艰苦奋斗，自主创新”，在十分困难的条件下，勒紧裤带，挺了过来。成功地爆炸了原子弹氢弹和建成南京长江大桥是那个时代具有代表性的事件。当时人们激发出的爱国热情和为科学事业献身的精神是十分难能可贵的。1985年，中国政府开始建立国家科技进步奖时，我作为建设行业评审委员曾来这裡作过详细考察，提议该项目申报当年的科技进步特等奖，并获得成功。25年过去了，中国的桥樑建造技术有了飞跃进步，南京已经有了四座长江大桥。这些年，中国是世界上建桥最多的国家，技术上也已进入世界前列，先后建成了世界最长的32.5公里的东海大桥（上海到洋山深水港），上海到宁波的杭州湾跨海大桥，和世界上最长的斜拉桥—-苏（州）（南）通大桥，最长的拱形桥—-卢浦大桥。下一步的目标将是两岸共建福建通往台湾的海峡大桥和隧道，历史将展现出崭新的一页。
974c3f8d3bb2351d080d7bf3476c7805bf2241df.translatedText: The next morning, we visited the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge, which was the first railway-highway bridge across the Yangtze River designed and constructed by the Chinese. It was completed and opened to traffic on the eve of the National Day in 1968. It was a sensational event in China at the time. The first bridge on the Yangtze River was the Wuhan Yangtze River Bridge built with Soviet aid in the 1950s. In the early 1960s, the relationship between China and the Soviet Union was tense. The Soviet Union withdrew all its experts and stopped all assistance to China, leaving not even a single piece of technical information. The Chinese people advocated "self-reliance, hard work, and independent innovation." Under very difficult conditions, they tightened their belts and survived. The successful detonation of the atomic and hydrogen bombs and the completion of the Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge were representative events of that era. The patriotic enthusiasm and dedication to science inspired by people at that time were very commendable. In 1985, when the Chinese government began to establish the National Science and Technology Progress Award, I came here as a construction industry review member to conduct a detailed inspection and proposed that the project apply for the special prize for science and technology progress that year, and it was successful. Twenty-five years have passed, and China's bridge construction technology has made rapid progress. Nanjing already has four Yangtze River bridges. In recent years, China has built the most bridges in the world, and has also entered the forefront of the world in terms of technology. It has successively built the world's longest 32.5-kilometer East China Sea Bridge (Shanghai to Yangshan Deep Water Port), the Hangzhou Bay Cross-sea Bridge from Shanghai to Ningbo, and the world's longest cable-stayed bridge - Su (Nan) Tong Bridge, and the longest arch bridge - Lupu Bridge. The next goal will be for both sides of the Taiwan Strait to jointly build the Strait Bridge and Tunnel from Fujian to Taiwan. History will open a new page.

2ed381448c6320dcb978a129ccb9c2f2779429b4.translatedText: The majestic Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge

2de873392d9111486ac5797c123189d190be9e0c.sourceText: 站在高高的桥头堡上，望着滚滚而来的江水，思绪万千，国事家事天下事一齐涌上心头。滔滔长江水，记述了中国人民苦难而沉重的历史。我的父辈们的青春是在抗日战争中渡过的，他们不论是扛起枪杆去前线杀敌，或是在后方支援前线，都是为了早日把日本鬼子赶出中国去。日本鬼子在中国犯下的滔天罪行，南京大屠杀的班班血泪，人们永远不会忘记。中国政府决定放弃对日本的战争赔偿要求，我一直想不通是为什麽，我至今看到那膏药旗总是觉得不舒服，这是我们这一代人难解的情节。如今日本有些人还要想篡改历史，为侵略战争翻桉，这是绝对不能允许的，应该告诉我们的子子孙孙永远不能忘记这段历史。 好不容易熬到了抗战胜利，自己人又打了起来。当时的国民政府也确实太腐败了，我虽还是个少年，我已感觉到了一些，在上海，有钱人纸醉金迷，歌舞昇平；穷苦人食不饱腹，露宿街头；三年间，法币，银元劵，金元劵几次变动，老百姓的钱变得越来越不值钱，人们要拿着一面袋的钞票去抢购大米。试想这样的社会能长久吗？于是，小米加步枪的军队打败了全部美式精良装备的正规军，没有战船的军队靠老百姓的帆船横渡长江，占领了总统府。 历史就是这样，得民心者得天下，失民心者失天下。共产党来了，开始人们担心共产共妻，怕共匪是青面獠牙，其实这都是欺骗百姓的政治宣传，就如后来说的蒋匪统治下的台湾人民处于水深火热之中，一样是无稽之谈。在信息闭塞的那个时期，搞政治的人就是常利用人们的善良和无知去欺骗人。解放军刚进城的时候，三大纪律八项注意，不动人们一针一线，全力扫除旧社会的污浊，社会面貌为之一新，那时真可以做到夜不闭户。共产党提出要建设新中国，实现工业化，再也不要受外人的欺侮和凌辱，深得大家赞同，多少爱国有识之士，放弃国外的优惠待遇，投奔祖国参加建设，钱学森就是最典型的代表。我们这一辈的年轻人，豪情壮志，决心为中国的工业化献出自己的一切，希望中国能早日自己造汽车，造飞机和轮船。解放后有过那麽五，六年比较安定的美好时光，后来不知是过于急进的方针或成功后的骄傲，还是个人崇拜或农民领袖的必然规律，或是有野心家阴谋篡权或领导人争权夺利，总之，现在还不到能说清楚这段历史原因的时候，也不是本文想要说清楚的事。事实是，中国大陆人民再次陷入了困惑和苦难，经历了包括文化大革命在内的灾难。文化大革命不仅是对中国几千年文化的摧残和破坏，使国民经济停滞不前，更严重的是破坏了人与人之间的关係和基本道德准则，搞得人人自危，谁也不敢说真话。敢想敢说敢干的人少了，中庸之道占据了社会主流，许多人以自保平安为前提，社会失去了向前推进的原动力。 与此同时，退居台湾的国民政府，在总结了失败的经验教训后，以国计民生为本，在蒋经国先生的领导下，先大陆20年实现了经济腾飞，成为亚洲四小龙之一。台湾的民主政治也向前迈出了一大步。 经历近20年磨难的大陆人，当再次睁眼看世界的时候，发现已经发生了惊人的变化。邓小平看清楚了这一点，决定拨正航向，把中国转回社会主义初级阶段，再加上改革开放，摸着石头过河，不管白猫黑猫，抓住耗子就是好猫。这些通俗的语言给中国带来了连续30年的高速度经济增长，中国成长为世界第二大经济体，再次成为世界组织中的举足轻重的重要成员。我们为祖国的发展而高兴，而骄傲。也为两岸关係的和平发展和合作感到欣慰。 但是，兴奋之馀，总觉得有点什麽放心不下。我认为在发展中缺乏一点民族精神和道德精神; 一个缺乏精神力量支持的经济发展是难以长久的。 最近，中国又重新提倡雷锋精神想是注意到了这一点。还有一点令人担忧的是贪污和公私不分，有人说现在当官的，还有那些不带官帽的官，大大小小的国有企业老总，经理，他们的衣食住行连同国内外旅游，送礼都是公家报销，这是一笔多大的开支啊！奥迪A4， A6是当前中国中层干部的标准用车，现在的领导又都喜欢自己开车，又有派头，又自由，一切费用公家出。就在我们旅游前不久，甘肃省一辆六个座位的校车挤进了六十个学生，造成翻车，十几人死亡的事故。人们不禁要问，为什麽不把干部买小汽车的钱多给孩子们买些校车。贪污不仅是拿走了千百万元的财富，而是拿走了人民群众对政府的信心。此外，民主政治的进一步提高，政治体制如何适应经济发展的需要，都需要逐步改进和完善。我们爱祖国，我们为祖国的每一个成就高兴，我们也为祖国存在的疾弊担忧，这就是国外游子对慈母的心情。 国事写了那么多，家事就以后再讲了。
2de873392d9111486ac5797c123189d190be9e0c.translatedText: Standing on the high bridgehead, looking at the rolling river, thousands of thoughts, national affairs, family affairs and world affairs came to my mind. The surging Yangtze River records the painful and heavy history of the Chinese people. My fathers' youth was spent in the Anti-Japanese War. Whether they carried guns and went to the front lines to kill the enemy, or supported the front lines from the rear, they all did it to drive the Japanese devils out of China as soon as possible. People will never forget the heinous crimes committed by the Japanese in China and the blood and tears of the Nanjing Massacre. The Chinese government decided to give up its demand for war compensation from Japan. I have never been able to figure out why. I still feel uncomfortable when I see that plaster flag. This is a plot that is difficult for our generation to understand. Today, some people in Japan still want to tamper with history and justify the war of aggression. This is absolutely unacceptable. Our descendants should never forget this period of history. After finally surviving the victory of the Anti-Japanese War, our own people started fighting again. The National Government at that time was indeed too corrupt. Although I was still a young man, I had already felt something. In Shanghai, the rich lived in revelry, singing and dancing; the poor had no food to eat and lived on the streets. In the past three years, the legal currency, silver dollar coupons, and gold dollar coupons had changed several times, and people's money became less and less valuable. People had to grab bags of banknotes to buy rice. Just imagine, can such a society last long? As a result, the army with millet and rifles defeated all the regular armies with sophisticated American equipment. The army without warships relied on ordinary people's sailboats to cross the Yangtze River and occupied the presidential palace. History is like this, those who win the hearts of the people win the world, and those who lose the hearts of the people lose the world. When the Communist Party came, people began to worry about the communists sharing their wives, and that the communist bandits were green faces and fangs. In fact, this was all political propaganda to deceive the people. Just like the later statement that the people of Taiwan were in dire straits under the rule of the Chiang bandits, it was also nonsense. In a period of limited information, politicians often took advantage of people's kindness and ignorance to deceive people. When the People's Liberation Army first entered the city, they followed the Three Major Disciplines and Eight Points of Attention, and worked hard to clean up the filth of the old society. The society was completely new. At that time, it was really possible to keep the doors open at night. The Communist Party proposed to build a new China, realize industrialization, and no longer be bullied and humiliated by outsiders. It won everyone's approval. Many patriotic and insightful people gave up preferential treatment abroad and defected to the motherland to participate in construction. Qian Xuesen was the most typical representative. The young people of our generation are ambitious and determined to dedicate everything they have to China's industrialization. We hope that China can build its own cars, planes and ships as soon as possible. After the liberation, there were five or six years of relatively stable and good times. Later, I don’t know whether it was due to overly aggressive policies or pride after success, or the cult of personality or the inevitable law of peasant leaders, or the conspiracy of ambitious people to usurp power, or the leaders competing for power. In short, it is not yet time to explain clearly the historical reasons, and it is not what this article wants to explain clearly. The fact is that the people of mainland China have once again fallen into confusion and suffering, and have experienced disasters including the Cultural Revolution. The Cultural Revolution not only devastated and destroyed thousands of years of Chinese culture and stagnated the national economy, but more seriously destroyed the relationships between people and basic moral principles, making everyone in danger and no one dared to tell the truth. There are fewer people who dare to think, speak, and act. The golden mean has taken over the mainstream of society. Many people put self-preservation and safety as the premise, and society has lost the driving force to move forward. At the same time, the Nationalist Government that retreated to Taiwan, after summing up the experience and lessons of its failure, put the national economy and people's livelihood first, and under the leadership of Mr. Chiang Ching-kuo, the mainland achieved economic growth in the first 20 years and became one of the Four Asian Tigers. Taiwan's democratic politics has also taken a big step forward. After nearly 20 years of suffering, mainland Chinese people opened their eyes to see the world again and found that astonishing changes had taken place. Deng Xiaoping saw this clearly and decided to correct the course, return China to the primary stage of socialism, coupled with reform and opening up, and cross the river by feeling the stones. It doesn't matter whether the cat is white or black, as long as it catches the mouse, it is a good cat. These popular languages ​​have brought China 30 consecutive years of high-speed economic growth. China has grown into the world's second largest economy and has once again become a pivotal and important member of the world organization. We are happy and proud of the development of our motherland. I am also pleased with the peaceful development and cooperation of cross-Strait relations. However, despite being excited, I always feel that there is something uneasy about me. I think there is a lack of national spirit and moral spirit in development; an economic development that lacks the support of spiritual power is difficult to last. Recently, China has re-advocated the Lei Feng spirit, presumably taking note of this. Another worrying thing is corruption and the lack of distinction between public and private affairs. Some people say that those who are now officials, as well as those without official hats, CEOs and managers of large and small state-owned enterprises, their food, clothing, housing, transportation, domestic and foreign travel, and gifts are all reimbursed by the public. This is a huge expense! Audi A4 and A6 are currently the standard cars for middle-level cadres in China. Nowadays, leaders like to drive their own cars with style and freedom, and all expenses are paid by the public. Not long before our trip, a six-seat school bus in Gansu Province had 60 students squeezed into it, causing it to overturn and kill more than a dozen people. People can't help but wonder why the money spent by cadres on cars is not used to buy school buses for the children. Corruption not only takes away millions of dollars of wealth, but also takes away the people's confidence in the government. In addition, the further improvement of democratic politics and how the political system adapts to the needs of economic development need to be gradually improved and improved. We love the motherland, we are happy for every achievement of the motherland, and we are also worried about the shortcomings of the motherland. This is the feeling of foreigners towards their loving mothers. Having written so much about state affairs, I will leave it to family matters later.

14174027a61a904962baae619ef6b848b8727700.sourceText: 能量饮料致死频发 药管局加强把关(图) 市场上贩卖的” 5 小时能量”饮料高含维他命 B12 ，研究员质疑其超出每日所需的摄入量 纽约时报报导，能量饮料(energy drink)是饮料业的一匹黑马，迅速成长，广受民众欢迎，去年在美国的销售额达到100亿元。尽管业内人士吹嘘能量饮料可以提神解劳，增强体力，补充能量，专家却对此质疑。近年更是频发因能量饮料致死事件，联邦药物管理局(FDA)也已开始加强审查它的安全性。 提神饮料日渐畅销，说明业内人士宣传相当成功，让特别是年轻一代消费者相信这种饮料有提神和增强体力的功效。 受访的研究员和科学研究指出，这种能量饮料含有高量咖啡因，只是把咖啡因和其他成分(如牛磺酸，维他命B群等)混合在一起，但除了咖啡因，其他成分对提神和增强体力则没有多大帮助。 而且能量饮料售价较高，比如一罐16盎司饮料售价2.99元，而含更多咖啡因的星巴克咖啡都比它便宜，一杯12盎司咖啡售价1.85元。 明尼苏达州立大学研究饮料的副教授裴提特说：”如果你喝一杯咖啡，它对你的新陈代谢影响，跟能量饮料是一样的。”研究指出，咖啡因是全球使用最普遍的一种兴奋剂，能使人清醒，如在适当时机饮用，可能改善体能。 由于不时传出年轻人饮用能量饮料死亡或受伤事件，FDA现在对能量饮料加强观察。去年十月FDA就在调查可能同妖怪饮料公司（Monster Beverage Corp）能量饮料相关的5起死亡报告。
14174027a61a904962baae619ef6b848b8727700.translatedText: Energy drinks have frequently caused deaths, the FDA has stepped up surveillance (picture) The "5-hour energy" drink sold on the market contains high levels of vitamin B12, and researchers question whether it exceeds the daily required intake. The New York Times reported that energy drinks are a dark horse in the beverage industry. They have grown rapidly and are widely popular. Sales in the United States last year reached 10 billion yuan. Although industry insiders boast that energy drinks can refresh themselves, increase physical strength, and replenish energy, experts have questioned this. In recent years, there have been frequent deaths caused by energy drinks, and the Federal Drug Administration (FDA) has also begun to strengthen its review of its safety. The increasing popularity of energy-boosting drinks shows that industry insiders have succeeded in convincing consumers, especially the younger generation, that this type of energy drink has the effect of refreshing people and enhancing their physical strength. Interviewed researchers and scientific studies pointed out that this kind of energy drink contains high amounts of caffeine, which is just mixed with other ingredients (such as taurine, vitamin B complex, etc.), but other than caffeine, other ingredients are not very helpful in refreshing and strengthening their physical strength. And energy drinks are priced higher, for example, a 16-ounce can costs 2.99 yuan, while Starbucks coffee with more caffeine is cheaper, with a 12-ounce cup of coffee priced at 1.85 yuan, said Petit, an associate professor of beverage research at Minnesota State University: "If you drink a cup of coffee, it will have the same impact on your metabolism as an energy drink." "Research points out that caffeine is the most commonly used stimulant in the world and can make people wake up. If consumed at the right time, it may improve physical performance. Due to reports of deaths or injuries among young people drinking energy drinks from time to time, the FDA is now increasing its observation of energy drinks. In October last year, the FDA was investigating five death reports that may be related to Monster Beverage Corp's energy drinks.

046b369e4ede95edb91693ba46f4f048614b717e.sourceText: （报人老真） 序 老报人话：本期起开辟这个专栏，意在让社区有一个明辨是非的平台。对有些事情，想摆摆事实，讲讲道理，不妨写出来。好像下面刋登的佳叔讲话稿，确实适当。心平气和，说话能实事求是。不文非饰过，不扣大帽子，别以为”老子文章天下第一”，更不要摆开非要吵吵吵闹闹的姿态，而要让别人有讨论或补正的余地，没有调查研究就不作结论，才能让人信服，受人欢迎。
046b369e4ede95edb91693ba46f4f048614b717e.translatedText: (reporter Lao Zhen) Preface An old newspaper reporter said: This column has been launched since this issue to give the community a platform to distinguish right from wrong. For some things, if you want to present the facts and make sense, you might as well write them down. It seems that the speech written by Uncle Jia published below is indeed appropriate. Be calm and speak truthfully. Don’t be pretentious, don’t use big names, don’t think that “I am the best in the world in articles”, and don’t pretend to be noisy, but allow others room for discussion or correction, and don’t draw conclusions without investigation and research, so that you can be convincing and popular with others.

b79363e36926c3eae073899ae0be9714217ed6a1.sourceText: 回忆二十二年前，在亚省开创当地第一张华报，顿觉惭愧！ 那时，自己只是两袖清风，中文报纸得以功成面世呀，全赖当地华人侨胞记得1985年，邝添权等三位亚省餐馆业老板回乡观光，看到的扶持！ 本人是一介小文化人，以为报纸刊物写稿、编纂史志为生。 文革后，主持复办当地报纸。 1989年初移民来美。 到了亚省便跟邝老板讨论，期望能重操本行。 这位好朋友领着我，驱车东西南北走了一遍，了解亚省的侨情，进行了社会调查。 所见所闻，这里华人侨胞约两万多，居住很分散。 对中华文化的需求如饥似渴。 要说创办一份中文报纸，缺乏人才和财力。 可谓”荒漠植树．谈何容易”！ 为求生计，我先到旅馆做客房清洁工。 不久，进ROSTBOOKING印刷厂打工，同时进MCC社区学院上英语课及电脑打字课。 年底，通过邝老板认识了黄仕蔚先生。 这时，他离开了原来做保险经纪的工作，正在寻求就业。 对于办报纸，一说就合拍了。 为了办报的经济来源，两人找社区老大、爱国侨领邓文华先生。 他一口答应，借出Ｘ万美元，并从自用的办公室腾出一个房间作编辑部。 就这样，组成了办报的三人小组：顾问邓文华，社长黄仕蔚（负责对外联络和拉广告），总编辑甄硕钦（承担报纸写稿组稿、编辑排版、付印出版等全盘业务）。 1990年4月初，以黄仕蔚和甄硕钦两人为负责人在州工商业登记部门，注册领取开业牌照（有案可查）。 由于亚省其时没有”?铅字排版??设备，我就根据在印刷厂做工的观察和思考，试用??打字印出大样、按照划定版式进行剪裁、贴上版纸，送印刷厂照相制版?? 这样运作，当时在海外报业相信鲜为人知的。 当时，本人单枪匹马写稿、编纂。 做出报纸全部内容。 去找中兴金行老板谭雄先生等支持，让该公司的余伟权先生用电脑打字，带回家与太太余霭蓉一起进行手工贴版，送往印刷厂拍照，制版付印。 第一张《亚利桑那华报》在1990年4 月29日面世。 那时，本人一边在印刷厂上班，一边办报。 说真话，就算黄先生在世也不好意思认自己是什么”亚省华文报业鼻祖”,不知道哪位雅士把黄先生供奉为”鼻祖”，到底是有意推黄先生”下水”，还是别有用心 ？ 只有他自己才知道。 至于《亚利桑那华报》命运又如何？ 看来还得说个明白，下期分解吧。
b79363e36926c3eae073899ae0be9714217ed6a1.translatedText: Recalling the creation of the first local Chinese newspaper in Alberta 22 years ago, I feel ashamed! At that time, I was just a breeze, and the success of the Chinese newspaper was all thanks to the local Chinese who remembered that in 1985, three Alberta restaurant owners, including Kwong Tianquan, visited their hometown for sightseeing and saw support! I am a small cultural person who makes a living by writing articles for newspapers and magazines and compiling historical records. After the Cultural Revolution, he presided over the resumption of local newspapers. I immigrated to the United States in early 1989. When I arrived in Alberta, I discussed it with Boss Kuang, hoping to return to my profession. This good friend took me on a drive from east to west, north and south, to understand the situation of overseas Chinese in Alberta and conduct a social survey. From what I have seen and heard, there are about 20,000 overseas Chinese here, and they live very scattered. There is a hunger for Chinese culture. When it comes to starting a Chinese newspaper, there is a lack of talent and financial resources. It can be said that "planting trees in the desert is easier said than done"! To make a living, I first worked as a housekeeper in a hotel. Soon, he started working at ROSTBOOKING Printing Factory, and at the same time, he took English classes and computer typing classes at MCC Community College. At the end of the year, I met Mr. Huang Shiwei through Boss Kuang. At this time, he had left his original job as an insurance broker and was seeking employment. Regarding running a newspaper, we clicked as soon as we talked about it. In order to provide financial resources for running the newspaper, the two approached the community boss and patriotic overseas Chinese leader Mr. Deng Wenhua. He agreed immediately, lent $X million, and vacated a room in his own office as the editorial office. In this way, a three-person team was formed to run the newspaper: consultant Deng Wenhua, president Huang Shiwei (responsible for external liaison and advertising), and editor-in-chief Zhen Shuoqin (responsible for all aspects of newspaper writing, editing, typesetting, printing and publishing). In early April 1990, with Huang Shiwei and Zhen Shuoqin as the persons in charge, they registered at the state industrial and commercial registration department to receive an opening license (the records are available). Since there was no "typesetting" equipment in Alberta at the time, based on my observations and thoughts while working in a printing factory, I tried typing to print out a large sample, cut it according to the prescribed layout, affixed the plate paper, and sent it to the printing factory for photography and plate making. This operation was unknown in the overseas newspaper industry at the time. At that time, I wrote and edited the entire content of the newspaper single-handedly. I went to Mr. Tan Xiong, the owner of Zhongxing Financial Bank, and asked Mr. Yu Weiquan of the company to type on the computer, and took it home to hand-paste it with his wife Yu Airong. Then I sent it to the printing factory to take pictures, and the first "Arizona Chinese News" was published on April 29, 1990. At that time, I was working in the printing factory and running the newspaper at the same time. To tell the truth, even if Mr. Huang is alive, he would be embarrassed to admit that he is the "originator of Chinese-language newspapers in Alberta." I wonder which scholar worships Mr. Huang as the "originator". Is it because he intends to push Mr. Huang into the trap, or does he have ulterior motives? As for the fate of the "Arizona Chinese News", it seems that we have to explain it clearly in the next issue.

e508a6e25f5a22c57fb4c16fe952b0173265547f.sourceText: 中新网2月22日电 美国《世界日报》日前刊文称，美国巴沙迪那一妇女组织当地时间2月20日邀请国土安全部官员，解释发生枪击时如何保护自己。针对校园枪击案增加，专家指出，发生枪击案时，要注意观察所处环境，尽可能的逃跑或躲藏，保护自身安全至关重要。
e508a6e25f5a22c57fb4c16fe952b0173265547f.translatedText: China News Service, February 22 The American "World Journal" recently published an article stating that a women's organization in Pasadena, the United States, invited officials from the Department of Homeland Security on February 20, local time, to explain how to protect themselves in the event of a shooting. In response to the increase in school shootings, experts point out that when a shooting occurs, it is important to observe the environment and run or hide as much as possible to protect your own safety.

111c5bb32ca5d89b4fc0dee06b9bdab30ed5a4c3.sourceText: 资料图：当地时间2月14日，美国佛州校园发生枪击案，致人员死伤。许多绝望的学生父母赶到现场，想查看他们的孩子是否受伤。一个名叫米歇尔的母亲说她的女儿在学校里面，女儿给她发了一个短信，上面写着：学校里发生了枪击事件，这是真的。
111c5bb32ca5d89b4fc0dee06b9bdab30ed5a4c3.translatedText: Data map: On February 14, local time, a shooting occurred on a campus in Florida, USA, resulting in casualties and injuries. Many desperate parents of students rushed to the scene to see if their children were injured. A mother named Michelle said that her daughter was at school and her daughter sent her a text message that read: There was a shooting at the school. This is true.

8b5a4ed943d70a0cd6a037272bd152b30ffd333c.sourceText: 国土安全部洛杉矶地区安全保护官员Richard Mitchen表示，枪击案频发，万一不幸发生此类事件时，如何做出反应保护自己的安全，至关重要。
8b5a4ed943d70a0cd6a037272bd152b30ffd333c.translatedText: Richard Mitchen, security protection officer for the Los Angeles region of the Department of Homeland Security, said that shootings occur frequently. If such an incident unfortunately occurs, how to respond to protect one's own safety is crucial.

fdade30a60c10981eeea82ed0c58e977cdd9fd59.sourceText: 首先，发生枪击案时，要注意所处环境可能的危险，了解所在位置最靠近的两个出口。如果枪手在附近，首先是选择逃跑，逃跑前心里设定一个逃跑路线和计划。
fdade30a60c10981eeea82ed0c58e977cdd9fd59.translatedText: First of all, when a shooting occurs, pay attention to possible dangers in the environment and know the two closest exits to your location. If a gunman is nearby, the first thing to do is to choose to escape. Before escaping, make an escape route and plan in your mind.

ef99d1bb624a68da154df42f3c3b7cd4494eb30f.sourceText: 其次是躲藏，要躲在枪手视线外的区域，堵住通往藏身处的入口并锁上门，将手机设置为静音，如生命受到威胁可奋力攻击。
ef99d1bb624a68da154df42f3c3b7cd4494eb30f.translatedText: The second step is to hide. You should hide in an area out of sight of the gunman. Block the entrance to the hideout and lock the door. Set your mobile phone to silent. If your life is threatened, you can attack vigorously.

6da99514ef7c403ae3bac6e4016c56b96d911f5d.sourceText: 第三，当执法人员到达现场时，要保持冷静遵守指示，并放下手中物品，举起双手，手指分开，避免向执法人员快速移动，避免指点、尖叫或喊叫，疏散时不要停下向执法人员求助或问路。
6da99514ef7c403ae3bac6e4016c56b96d911f5d.translatedText: Third, when law enforcement officers arrive at the scene, stay calm and comply with instructions, put down the items in your hands, raise your hands with your fingers spread apart, avoid moving quickly toward law enforcement officers, avoid pointing, screaming or shouting, and do not stop to ask for help or directions from law enforcement officers when evacuating.

cba565b46692bf7f055bd4d818000e64ed1ddb1d.sourceText: 第四，打电话报警时，要向警方说明现行枪手位置、人数和枪手外观描述、枪手所持武器数量和种类、现场可能受害人数等，以便警方采取适合的救援行动方式。
cba565b46692bf7f055bd4d818000e64ed1ddb1d.translatedText: Fourth, when calling the police, you must explain to the police the current location, number of people, description of the gunman's appearance, the number and type of weapons held by the gunman, the number of possible victims at the scene, etc., so that the police can take appropriate rescue operations.

0c39849b65c472e1b5f90cce0c001cf407d79223.sourceText: Richard Mitchen还说，要注意识别工作环境中的暴力迹象，因为很多现场行凶的枪手，可能是现任或者过去的雇员，如果认为某个雇员或同事表现有潜在暴力行为，要对人力资源部作出警示。比如有雇员或同事的酒精或非法药物用量增加、原因不明的缺席，含混不清的口头抱怨、忧郁和退避、有明显情绪波动，越来越多的评论暴力、武器和暴力犯罪等，这些迹象都有可能是潜在暴力迹象的反应。
0c39849b65c472e1b5f90cce0c001cf407d79223.translatedText: Richard Mitchen also said that attention should be paid to identifying signs of violence in the work environment, because many of the gunmen who committed crimes at the scene may be current or past employees. If an employee or colleague is believed to be potentially violent, the human resources department must be alerted. Signs such as an employee or co-worker's increased use of alcohol or illegal drugs, unexplained absences, vague verbal complaints, depression and withdrawal, significant mood swings, and increased comments about violence, weapons, and violent crime may all be responses to signs of potential violence.

8b643bab289dfe771d173ee1e697a6f7bf16c0ab.sourceText: 如何在发生枪击案时有效的示警也很重要，安保产品业者Robert Blair表示，在最短的时间内通知大家发生枪击案，能拯救更多生命，建议在大型校园安装一定数量的紧急警报装置，在学生宿舍安装严密的进出安全和报警系统，在停车场各个楼层，安装有声响的安全监控系统，一旦发生紧急事件，都可随时发出警报。
8b643bab289dfe771d173ee1e697a6f7bf16c0ab.translatedText: How to provide effective warnings in the event of a shooting is also very important. Robert Blair, a security product manufacturer, said that notifying everyone of a shooting in the shortest time can save more lives. It is recommended to install a certain number of emergency alarm devices on large campuses, install strict entry and exit security and alarm systems in student dormitories, and install audible security monitoring systems on all floors of the parking lot. In the event of an emergency, alarms can be issued at any time.

bccaabf79eba1a743406949610617b1ad4fc84c1.sourceText: 美国“购物狂”城市排行 华盛顿居首 (亚省时报) 在人们印象中，与美国时尚中心如洛杉矶和纽约相比，华盛顿不可能在”购物狂”排行上占先。尽管作为政治中心的首都似乎并不重视着装打扮，据金融网站Bundle.com提供的统计数据，华盛顿哥伦比亚特区是美国第一购物狂城市，本州的斯格思代(Scottsdale)居然位列第四。 清单上的城市是位于美国南部和西部的人口众多且富裕的城市，纽约市和洛杉矶则意外地没有上榜。加利福尼亚州贝克斯菲尔德出产加州76％的石油，该地居民平均每月花费201.50美元着装，名列第10。 美国前10购物狂城市的每月平均开支清单如下： 1.华盛顿特区：居民的每月平均衣服鞋帽开支：$263；2. 弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿：居民的每月平均衣服鞋帽开支：$254.58；3.田纳西州纳甚维尔：居民的每月平均衣服鞋帽开支：$251.17； 4.亚利桑那州斯科茨代尔：居民的每月平均衣服鞋帽开支：$243.17；5.得克萨斯州达拉斯市：居民的每月平均衣服鞋帽开支：$228.58；6.美国加利福尼亚州旧金山:居民的每月平均衣服鞋帽开支：$227.42; 7.加利福尼亚州圣何塞市: 居民的每月平均衣服鞋帽开支：$221.17; 8.华盛顿州西雅图市: 居民的每月平均衣服鞋帽开支：$221.17; 9.美国德克萨斯州奥斯汀市: 居民的每月平均衣服鞋帽开支：$213; 10.加利福尼亚州贝克斯菲尔德: 居民的每月平均衣服鞋帽开支：$201.50.
bccaabf79eba1a743406949610617b1ad4fc84c1.translatedText: Washington ranks first among U.S. cities for “shopaholics” (Alberta Times) In people’s minds, compared with American fashion centers such as Los Angeles and New York, Washington is unlikely to take the lead in the ranking of “shopaholics.” Although the capital as the political center does not seem to pay much attention to dress, according to statistics provided by the financial website Bundle.com, Washington, DC is the number one shopaholic city in the United States, and Scottsdale in this state actually ranks fourth. 1ae7e5312351ed8342d2be43f6820eb6106e0818.sourceText: 母亲，我叫钓鱼岛 二十年前强盗在我的身躯上让灯塔闪耀 他们想要占有我的身体到天荒地老 我不应该是强盗无耻的夜宵 我支离破碎的容貌，母亲，你可看到
1ae7e5312351ed8342d2be43f6820eb6106e0818.translatedText: Mother, my name is Diaoyu Island. Twenty years ago, the robbers let the lighthouse shine on my body. They want to possess my body until the end of time. I should not be the shameless midnight snack of the robber. My broken appearance, mother, you can see.

1e063fe7cdff26cd3267aa93021cedb8fc13fb48.sourceText: 母亲，我叫钓鱼岛 昨天强盗撞翻了您的孩子我的同胞 强盗用滑稽的借口给他们戴上镣铐 他们只是为了陪伴我的寂廖 为何，为何强盗要将他们用烈火燃烧
1e063fe7cdff26cd3267aa93021cedb8fc13fb48.translatedText: Mother, my name is Diaoyu Island. Yesterday the robbers knocked over your child, my compatriot. The robbers used funny excuses to shackle them. They were just to accompany my loneliness. Why, why did the robbers burn them with fire

7c34bd679fa57d0a2830163735d77bc4545852cf.sourceText: 母亲，我叫钓鱼岛 不是强盗嘴里的尖阁列岛 我不应该背着沉重的背包 在尘世的纷纷扰扰中被人嘲笑 我的精彩应该闪耀在你博大的云霄 我的骄傲应该执着在你温暖的怀抱
7c34bd679fa57d0a2830163735d77bc4545852cf.translatedText: Mother, my name is Diaoyu Island, not the Senkaku Islands in the mouth of the robbers. I should not carry a heavy backpack and be laughed at in the chaos of the world. My wonderfulness should shine in your broad sky. My pride should cling to your warm embrace

b592167db48a5ea6a9808fcb13ddeb2d6ade0ea2.sourceText: 母亲，我叫钓鱼岛 我期待，期待那一秒 您披起战袍，吹响号角 在犀利的炮火中将我的名字呼叫 那一刻，母亲 躺在你温柔怀中，我是您永远要呵护的宝 母亲，我叫钓鱼岛 您起的名字从生叫到老

You call my name in the sharp gunfire. At that moment, mother, lying in your gentle arms, I am the treasure you will always take care of. Mother, my name is Diaoyu Island. The name you gave me has been called from birth to old age.

3e869557febce2bd1ce575f66ba5b3bf3ded7045.sourceText: 美西中国美术家协会成立新的理事会 2013年 3 月 16 日周五晚，美西中国美术家协会召开 2013 年度会议。回顾在过去的几年，协会在华人社区举办丰富多彩的中西艺术绘画欣赏活动，中国传统书法欣赏系列讲座，同时还开办不同层次的绘画，书法，国画的学习培训班，提高了华人的艺术欣赏和绘画水平，丰富了社区的文化艺术生活。 新的一年，协会计划除了做好以往的工作外，还将举办首届华人绘画比赛和作品展览。并就具体方案做了详细的讨论。 由于事业的发展，上届部分理事有的迁到外州，有的回中国发展。协会衷心感谢他们以往热心的工作和贡献。协会还选举了艾薇，李明良，刘佳昌，张福涛为协会理事，梁美艳为协会副主席兼秘书长，林峰为协会主席。特聘亚省知名教育家书法家陈普博士为荣誉主席。新的理事会将一如既往地为丰富社区文化艺术活动而不懈工作。
3e869557febce2bd1ce575f66ba5b3bf3ded7045.translatedText: >The Chinese Artists Association in the United States and the West established a new board of directors. On the evening of Friday, March 16, 2013, the Chinese Artists Association in the United States and the West held its 2013 annual meeting. Looking back on the past few years, the association has organized a variety of Chinese and Western art and painting appreciation activities in the Chinese community, and a series of lectures on traditional Chinese calligraphy appreciation. It has also opened different levels of painting, calligraphy, and traditional Chinese painting training classes, which have improved the Chinese people's art appreciation and painting level, and enriched the cultural and artistic life of the community. In the new year, the association plans to hold the first Chinese painting competition and exhibition in addition to doing its previous work. and conducted detailed discussions on specific plans. Due to the development of the business, some of the directors of the previous term moved to other states, and some returned to China for development. The Association sincerely thanks them for their enthusiastic work and contributions in the past. The association also elected Ai Wei, Li Mingliang, Liu Jiachang, and Zhang Futao as directors of the association, Liang Meiyan as vice president and secretary-general of the association, and Lin Feng as chairman of the association. Dr. Chen Pu, a well-known educator and calligrapher in Alberta, is specially appointed as the honorary chairman. The new board of directors will continue to work tirelessly to enrich cultural and artistic activities in the community.

18dcc187a7af125bf819b55ab3f84b5e83a8c5bc.sourceText: 想出相亲航班创意的是大陆低价航空春秋航空，下午2时5分，从上海飞往昆明、中转黔江的5个小时航程中，有男、女各10名乘客是专程报名相亲活动而来，女生年龄最大25岁、男生年龄最大的是39岁。
18dcc187a7af125bf819b55ab3f84b5e83a8c5bc.translatedText: The person who came up with the idea of ​​the blind date flight was Spring Airlines, a low-cost mainland airline. At 2:05 p.m., during the five-hour flight from Shanghai to Kunming with a stopover in Qianjiang, there were 10 male and 10 female passengers who specially signed up for the blind date event. The oldest girl was 25 years old and the oldest boy was 39 years old.

869e26990e46c0044e70afdea149e84659cac1d0.sourceText: 康嘉和受访时说，她在台湾长大、高中后到美国念书，现于上海担任一家电影杂志编辑，一直以来都是自己一个人在世界各地漂泊。她想拓展交友圈，所以报名参加，如果真遇到好对象，不排斥在上海定下来。
869e26990e46c0044e70afdea149e84659cac1d0.translatedText: Kang Jiahe said in an interview that she grew up in Taiwan, went to the United States to study after high school, and now works as an editor for a film magazine in Shanghai. She has always been wandering around the world alone. She wants to expand her circle of friends, so she signed up. If she really meets a good partner, she won't rule out settling down in Shanghai.

d028cf6289ddcf000906fef1f6288a78dbbbc09c.sourceText: 春秋航空新闻发言人张武安表示，相亲航班概念来自员工，公司工作人员30岁以下占8成，尤其是空姐和机师工作时间和一般人不同，不易拓展交友圈，人事单位本来就在为员工主办”月娘活动”，后来发想干脆由对内拓展到对外，于是有了这次活动。
d028cf6289ddcf000906fef1f6288a78dbbbc09c.translatedText: Spring Airlines spokesperson Zhang Wuan said that the concept of blind date flights came from employees, and 80% of the company's employees are under the age of 30. In particular, flight attendants and pilots work different hours than ordinary people, and it is difficult to expand their social circle. The human resources department was originally hosting a "Yue Niang Activity" for employees, and then thought of expanding it from internal to external, so this activity was born.

e6461e52c83fb405a1ae3e91a0bebbd423e12dda.sourceText: 张武安说，这次报名情况非常踊跃，为平衡男女比例，最后挑选出20人。由于春秋航空也加入两岸航线，因此将积极规划两岸相亲航班，让两边年轻人有更多交流机会。
e6461e52c83fb405a1ae3e91a0bebbd423e12dda.translatedText: Zhang Wuan said that the number of registrations this time was very enthusiastic. In order to balance the ratio of men to women, 20 people were finally selected. Since Spring Airlines has also joined the cross-strait routes, it will actively plan cross-strait blind date flights to provide young people on both sides with more exchange opportunities.

717fa3047bcc6f21413d01872b25e0abbb9549f8.sourceText: 他介绍，在5个小时航程中，将安排多项空中版的”非诚勿扰”活动，如果遇上心仪对象，可藉由亮灯表达心意。
717fa3047bcc6f21413d01872b25e0abbb9549f8.translatedText: He introduced that during the 5-hour flight, a number of aerial versions of "If You Are the One" activities will be arranged. If you meet the person you like, you can express your feelings by lighting up the lights.

2d25ad222423043ba70638b089e33f451b3a26b0.sourceText: 法新社7日称，中共中央委员会委员加上候补委员共376人将参加为期4天的会议，三中全会往往会定下一届政府5年任期的经济工作调子。
2d25ad222423043ba70638b089e33f451b3a26b0.translatedText: Agence France-Presse stated on the 7th that a total of 376 members and alternate members of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China will participate in the four-day meeting. The Third Plenary Session of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China often determines the economic work plan for the next government's five-year term.

091a83058f1c21bb214c455283a9c1b6d9af64b8.sourceText: 路透社7日称，中国领导人将在这次会议上制定今后数年的改革议程，在中国经济飞速发展30年后把这个庞大的经济体引上更具可持续的道路。历史上的三中全会往往是重大经济改革的跳板。
091a83058f1c21bb214c455283a9c1b6d9af64b8.translatedText: Reuters said on the 7th that Chinese leaders will formulate the reform agenda for the next few years at this meeting, putting this huge economy on a more sustainable path after 30 years of rapid economic development. Historically, the Third Plenary Session of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China has often been the springboard for major economic reforms.

c3ee47f2ff78702077887b1b63084fa30adf8472.sourceText: 5月3日晚，中国驻洛杉矶总领馆一楼大厅灯火通明，一派热闹。 各侨团均派代表参加总领馆首次举办的主题为”觅乡音，话友情，联谊招待会”。 洛杉矶中国总领馆总领事邱绍芳大使，副总领事孙伟德，卞立新，教育参赞陈准民，文化参赞车兆和，商务参赞舒骆玫，科技参赞张健以及侨务，新闻，签证等组别的领事基本 都出席了招待会，与各侨团侨领联谊话友情。 邱绍芳大使致辞首先就表示，今日把大家邀请到总领馆来是与侨界乡亲们话友情，觅乡音，同时，我们今日没有请媒体参加，目的是请大家在总领馆就像到了家一样 休闲，随意。 喜欢谈什么，想了解什么，有什么要求或建议都可以提出来。 接着他向侨胞们一一介绍了总领馆各组别的负责人和在场的领事认识，希望大家多多利用这次联谊的机会相互了解沟通。 跟着邱绍芳大使扼要地把当前国内外的形势概括做了介绍，特别是中美之间大家关心的话题也作了介绍。 同时感谢侨界华人华侨一直关心促进两岸交流以及参与祖国的建设，支持家乡建设，努力推进中美两国的合作作出的贡献表示感谢。 邱大使也表示，总领馆继续一如归往地服务侨社，关心支持侨胞在当地发展，努力维护侨胞在美的合法权益。
c3ee47f2ff78702077887b1b63084fa30adf8472.translatedText: On the evening of May 3, the lobby on the first floor of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles was brightly lit and bustling. All overseas Chinese groups sent representatives to participate in the first-ever reception held by the Consulate General with the theme of "Looking for Local Sound, Talking about Friendship, and Networking Reception." Ambassador Qiu Shaofang, Consul General of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, Deputy Consuls General Sun Weide and Bian Lixin, Education Counselor Chen Zhunmin, Cultural Counselor Che Zhaohe, Commercial Counselor Shu Luomei, Science and Technology Counselor Zhang Jian, as well as consuls from the overseas Chinese affairs, press, visa and other groups basically attended the reception and talked with the overseas Chinese leaders of various overseas Chinese delegations. Ambassador Qiu Shaofang first said in his speech that the purpose of inviting everyone to the Consulate General today is to talk about friendship with the overseas Chinese community and learn about local accents. At the same time, we did not invite the media to participate today. The purpose is to invite everyone to the Consulate General to feel relaxed and casual as if they were at home. You can put forward whatever you like to talk about, what you want to know, and any requests or suggestions you have. Then he introduced the heads of each group of the Consulate General and the consuls present to the overseas Chinese one by one. He hoped that everyone would take advantage of this opportunity to understand and communicate with each other. Ambassador Qiu Shaofang then briefly introduced the current domestic and international situation, especially the topics of concern between China and the United States. At the same time, I would like to express my gratitude to the overseas Chinese in the overseas Chinese community for their continuous concern to promote cross-strait exchanges, participate in the construction of the motherland, support the construction of their hometown, and strive to promote cooperation between China and the United States for their contributions. Ambassador Qiu also said that the Consulate General will continue to serve the overseas Chinese community as always, care about and support the development of overseas Chinese in the local area, and strive to safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of overseas Chinese in the United States.

ef1e9d601b9a25ad88324466a7e192da3c05d2f5.sourceText: 招待会现场充满浓浓的乡情和友谊，邱大使还不时主动用粤语与广​​东特别是四邑籍的侨胞话家常，与会的侨胞也与总领馆各组别的领事互动，了解各自关心的 问题。 而且总领馆的官员也应侨胞的要求合影留念。 会场洋溢着祥和热烈，欢声笑语，总领馆还为侨胞们准备了丰盛的中式晚餐。
ef1e9d601b9a25ad88324466a7e192da3c05d2f5.translatedText: The reception was full of deep nostalgia and friendship. Ambassador Qiu also took the initiative to speak in Cantonese from time to time with the overseas Chinese in Guangdong, especially those from Siyi. The overseas Chinese in attendance also interacted with the consuls from various groups of the Consulate General to understand the issues they were concerned about. Moreover, officials of the Consulate General also took photos at the request of the overseas Chinese. The venue was filled with peace, warmth, laughter, and the Consulate General also prepared a sumptuous Chinese dinner for the overseas Chinese.

ab80419a2f913cb795b42db2b9a2e6b9565780a6.sourceText: 沉甸甸的《尚俭堂》匾额——读作家唐孝先《尚俭堂文集》有感 凤凰城 潘啸皋 收到了好友作家唐孝先赠予的他新近出版的力作《尚俭堂文集》（电子版），万般欣喜，我极专心和认真地用了一整天的时间拜读了《尚俭堂文集》整书。首先让我沉思的是该书的书名，启用”尚俭堂”三字作为书眉，就已经嗅闻到这本书的历史的沉淀。作家出身于名门望族，据《晋阳唐氏宗谱》（藏上海图书馆），先生是唐朝凌烟阁二十四功臣（长孙无忌、魏征、秦琼等均在内）之一、莒国公唐俭四十三世孙；历经千年、世代相传、一脉相承。唐家世代政绩卓越，且崇尚节俭，民国时期作家祖辈在家乡无锡南长街购置的产业，就以”尚俭”二字为堂名。为其书写匾额的是中国国民党元老吴稚晖先生，民国35年（1946年）春，时年82岁高龄的吴稚晖老先生亲临无锡，题写尚俭堂匾，尚俭堂匾额不久就制作成功，为白底黑字。白底，用数层白漆漆成；黑字，用亮晶晶的无烟煤细屑，拌在黑漆里涂上，字形饱满厚实、苍劲有力、铁划银勾、入木三分。 1949年后，当时政府向唐家买下宅第的大部分，扩大南长街小 学校址，尚俭堂堂匾遂从大厅上取下，仍归唐家。文革前，匾额还在老宅后门旁柴间屋里，家人将它翻过来，字朝下，架在两只竹马上，上面放着木柴。文革期间，作家的叔祖父母被迫搬出老宅，住在一处斗室内，吴稚晖耄耋之年书写的堂匾，从此下落不明……。如此珍贵文物失落，实在可惜。《尚俭堂文集》文集里多篇文章，记述作者童年在家里见过的堂匾、国画、对联等传统文化珍品，在十年浩劫中被红卫兵抄没，字里行间透露作者的无奈和惋惜。 《尚俭堂文集》是文史专辑，选收唐孝先在美国《世界日报》、《世界周刊》、《亚省时报》、台湾《中外杂志》等报刊杂志上发表过的文章近60篇，分别列在家史追述、怀旧忆往、无锡故事、人物春秋、文史杂记5个篇目下。”家史追述”栏，从不同的视角，记述学长祖父、叔祖父、父亲、母亲，骨肉亲情与传统文化揉合在一起。”怀旧忆往”栏，记述对学长一生不同时期有重大影响的人物：童年时期崇敬的庄公凤冈老先生，青年时期读大学时的良师沈制平老师，中年时期到美国后遇见的好朋友美国人罗立尔博士等等。 《尚俭堂文集》全书文化气息浓厚，情趣高雅，文笔清新简练，叙事条理清晰。文章内容遍及中外人物、人文历史、科学发明、战事始末、间谍案件、民俗风情、轶闻趣谈，以及诗词、书法、绘画、戏剧、国乐、曲艺、烹调等中华国粹。 作家旅美前在中国，教学之余的著述，主要是英美文学介绍和研究。来美国后，于上世纪九十年代，开始在《亚省时报》、《世界日报》等报刊上发表文章，欧美文化、历史、文学、人物等，都有涉及。进入二十一世纪后，写作重心转向中国历史文化、名人学者。笔者对唐兄的愽学多才钦佩不已。阅读他的文章仿佛重温了中国的近代史，即便”无锡县志”也不如此文集的徉尽生动。是近代鲜见的优秀作品。唐兄的文章，践行返璞归真，全书各大部分，采用原文、译文、提示的编排方式展现全书，这是《尚俭堂文集》一书的新意所在。全文没有引经据典，更旡所谓的学术注解，全靠直言支撑，只有少量对人物的解释，通篇是他学问的积累和精华的咀嚼，不显山漏水，危言耸听，看不到商榷的影子却不时纠正着前辈或今人的误读。 《尚俭堂文集》整个书本的装帧设计也颇丰特色，从我们出版界的行话”美编是行内资深高手”；更㐽服翁台生先生、吳柏萱先生等主编及出版人的惠眼。 作为一位杰出的教育家和前辈，唐先生最大的成就便是桃李满天下，为了传承中国文化，他曾经创办亞利桑那州第一所教漢語拼音、簡體字的中文學校，已培养了莘莘学子无数。唐先生不仅朋友四方，还拥有一个幸福的家庭，他们相逢在有江苏的兰考之称的苏北响水、曾经共同生活在荒芜的盐碱地上、共同求学，共同探索，共同走过艰难的岁月，又共同分享硕果累累的快乐，是令晚辈们极其羡慕的一对伉俪。从”尚俭堂”走出来的学者，纪录了唐先生的成果，以书会友，交融感情、传递知识、传承经验，我荣幸地阅读《尚儉堂文集》電子版，先睹为快，仅以此文字表达谢意。
ab80419a2f913cb795b42db2b9a2e6b9565780a6.translatedText: The heavy plaque of "Shang Jian Tang" - Thoughts on reading the "Collected Works of Shang Jian Tang" by the writer Tang Xiaoxian Phoenix City Pan Xiaogao I received a gift from my friend, the writer Tang Xiaoxian, of his recently published masterpiece "Collected Works of Shang Jian Tang" (electronic version). I was extremely happy. I spent a whole day reading the entire "Collected Works of Shang Jian Tang" with great concentration and seriousness. The first thing that made me think deeply was the title of the book. By using the three characters "Shang Jian Tang" as the header, I could already smell the historical accumulation of this book. The writer was born into a distinguished family. According to the "Genealogy of the Tang Family in Jinyang" (collected by the Shanghai Library), he was one of the 24 heroes of Lingyan Pavilion in the Tang Dynasty (including Changsun Wuji, Wei Zheng, Qin Qiong, etc.) and the 43rd grandson of Tang Jian, Duke of Ju Kingdom. It has been passed down from generation to generation for thousands of years and has been passed down from generation to generation. The Tang family had outstanding political achievements for generations and advocated frugality. During the Republic of China, the property purchased by the writer's ancestors on Nanchang Street in his hometown of Wuxi was named after the two characters "Shang Jian". The person who wrote the plaque for it was Mr. Wu Zhihui, a veteran of the Chinese Kuomintang. In the spring of the 35th year of the Republic of China (1946), the 82-year-old Mr. Wu Zhihui came to Wuxi in person and inscribed the Shangjian Hall plaque. The Shangjian Hall plaque was successfully produced soon, with black characters on a white background. The white background is painted with several layers of white paint; the black characters are made of shiny anthracite shavings mixed with black paint. After 1949, when the government purchased most of the mansion from the Tang family and expanded the site of Nanchang Street Primary School, the Shang Jian Tang plaque was removed from the hall and remained in the possession of the Tang family. Before the Cultural Revolution, the plaque was still in the firewood room next to the back door of the old house. The family turned it over, with the words facing down, and put it on two bamboo horses with firewood on top. During the Cultural Revolution, the writer's uncle and grandparents were forced to move out of their old house and live in a small house. The whereabouts of the plaque written by Wu Zhihui when he was 60 years old has been unknown since then... It is a pity that such precious cultural relics have been lost. There are many articles in the "Collected Works of Shang Jian Tang" describing the traditional cultural treasures such as plaques, traditional Chinese paintings, and couplets that the author saw at home in his childhood. They were confiscated by the Red Guards during the ten years of catastrophe. The author's helplessness and regret are revealed between the lines. "Collected Works of Shang Jian Tang" is a literary and historical album, which collects nearly 60 articles published by Tang Xiaoxian in newspapers and magazines such as "World Journal", "World Weekly", "Alberta Times" in the United States, and "China and Foreign Magazine" in Taiwan. They are listed under five categories: family history recollection, nostalgic memories, Wuxi stories, characters' spring and autumn, and literary and historical miscellaneous notes. The "Family History" column describes the senior's grandfather, uncles, father, and mother from different perspectives. The family ties and traditional culture are blended together. The "Nostalgic Memories" column describes the people who had a significant impact on the seniors at different times in their lives: Mr. Zhuang Gong Fenggang, whom he admired in childhood, Mr. Shen Zheping, a good teacher in college during his youth, Dr. Lolier, an American who was a good friend he met after arriving in the United States in middle age, etc. "Collected Works of Shang Jian Tang" is full of cultural atmosphere, elegant taste, fresh and concise writing style, and clear narrative structure. The articles cover Chinese and foreign figures, humanities and history, scientific inventions, the beginning and end of wars, espionage cases, folk customs, anecdotes, as well as Chinese quintessences such as poetry, calligraphy, painting, drama, traditional Chinese music, folk arts, and cooking. The writer was in China before moving to the United States, and his writings in his spare time were mainly introductions and research on British and American literature. After coming to the United States, in the 1990s, he began to publish articles in newspapers such as the "Alberta Times" and "World Journal", covering European and American culture, history, literature, characters, etc. After entering the 21st century, the focus of writing shifted to Chinese history, culture, and famous scholars. The author has great admiration for Brother Tang’s scholarly talent. Reading his articles is like reliving the modern history of China. Even "Wuxi County Chronicles" is not as vivid as this collection. It is an excellent work rarely seen in modern times. Brother Tang's articles practice returning to nature. Most parts of the book are presented in the form of original text, translation, and prompts. This is the novelty of the "Collected Works of Shang Jian Tang". There are no quotations from scriptures in the whole text, let alone so-called academic annotations. It is all supported by straightforward words and only a small amount of explanations of characters. The whole text is the accumulation of his knowledge and the essence of the chewing. There is no leakage, alarmism, no shadow of discussion, but he often corrects the misunderstandings of his predecessors or modern people. The binding design of the entire book of "Collected Works of Shang Jian Tang" is also quite distinctive. From the lingo in our publishing industry, "the art editor is a senior expert in the industry"; it has also won the favor of editors and publishers such as Mr. Weng Taisheng and Mr. Wu Baixuan. As an outstanding educator and senior, Mr. Tang’s greatest achievement is that he has students all over the world. In order to inherit Chinese culture, he once founded the first Chinese school in Arizona that teaches Chinese pinyin and simplified characters, and has trained countless students. Mr. Tang not only has friends from all over the world, but also has a happy family. They met in Xiangshui, northern Jiangsu, known as the Lankao of Jiangsu. They once lived together on the barren saline-alkali land, studied together, explored together, went through difficult years together, and shared fruitful happiness together. They are a couple that the younger generations are extremely envious of. Scholars who came out of "Shang Jian Tang" have recorded Mr. Tang's achievements. They use books to make friends, blend emotions, pass on knowledge, and pass on experience. I am honored to read the electronic version of "Shang Jian Tang Collected Works" and have a sneak peek. I can only express my gratitude with these words.

9810d795d42b8f85b1fdb99391cd357669a3f34d.translatedText: Children's institutions in Arizona in the United States are accused of shelving thousands of child abuse cases. According to a report by the New York Times on December 10, a long-term homicide investigator in the United States...

307b57500e4e733e022999f9df866934450bb7ee.sourceText: 报道说，这一丑闻可能对亚利桑那州州政府造成严重打击。该州州长布鲁尔本人正面临各种批评和要求经济安全局长卡特辞职的呼声。卡特是布鲁尔一手提拔的官员，目前负责几十个社会保障项目，包括儿童福利。
307b57500e4e733e022999f9df866934450bb7ee.translatedText: reported that this scandal may cause a serious blow to the Arizona state government. Governor Brewer himself is facing various criticisms and calls for the resignation of Economic Security Director Carter. Carter, an official promoted by Brewer, now oversees dozens of social security programs, including child welfare.

7000c777aad1768416080be0f9526c0f2ce0a965.sourceText: 同1997年到2002年之间73名儿童因虐待和忽视死亡的危机不同，目前，儿童福利机构已积压1万个案件，另有1.2万个案件正在调查，这次人们普遍认为，儿童保护局需要深度改革。当地儿童行动联盟总裁耐马克说，由于衰退期间预算削减，儿童保护局面临的挑战十分严重。许多保护儿童的服务项目被迫停止，无法帮助需要”逃离”家庭的儿童。另外，为有工作家长提供的补贴被冻结、削减或者儿童照料补贴减少，联邦对儿童保护局的拨款减少也是造成这一问题的原因。
7000c777aad1768416080be0f9526c0f2ce0a965.translatedText: Unlike the crisis in which 73 children died due to abuse and neglect between 1997 and 2002, child welfare agencies currently have a backlog of 10,000 cases and another 12,000 cases are under investigation. This time it is generally believed that the Child Protection Bureau needs deep reform. Nemark, president of the local Children's Action Alliance, said the challenges faced by the Child Protection Agency due to budget cuts during the recession are serious. Many child protection services have been forced to cease to help children who need to "escape" from their families. In addition, subsidies for working parents have been frozen, cut or child care subsidies have been reduced, and federal funding for the Child Protection Agency has also contributed to the problem.

115dda0a994527e25161e91b5c84b3885c00e242.sourceText: 布鲁尔上周要求议员、检察官、儿童福利权益人士和州府官员组成一个团队，监督未调查的热线电话报案，但这一工作将大大增加儿童保护局的人员配备压力，其正面临600人的员工缺口
115dda0a994527e25161e91b5c84b3885c00e242.translatedText: Brewer last week asked lawmakers, prosecutors, child welfare advocates and state officials to form a team to oversee uninvestigated hotline reports, but the effort will greatly increase staffing pressure on the Child Protective Service, which is facing a 600-person staffing shortfall.

741545ce038e190de930f33f2506460c053e61a6.sourceText: 當世界各地都準備歡欣鼓舞的熱烈慶祝建國百年之際，人人思考如何用一種不同於過去的方式來慶祝”一百年”。 當看到遠見雜誌發表”新台灣之光100”後，激動的內心產生了萬丈豪氣，正如逆水操舟，更應擊槳奮進。 遠見雜誌從台灣幾千筆中篩選出９９名，保留了第一百名給每一個”你”。彰顯此刻台灣人民奮鬥精神。在國父孫中山先生創建民國的百年基礎上，盤點這些軟實力可以進入下一個”一百年”。 亞省建國百年雙十國慶籌備會可以說是用”深耕深崛”的苦心，找出了一批極為優秀的天才年輕歌手，他們不僅擁有天生的金嗓，更能自編自創歌曲，他們是來自台灣的夢天使合唱團，及李歐納（高雄），劉協書（台中），江彥廷（嘉義），楊忠婷（鳯城皇后），李睿英（西安），廣州的好朋友，這些年輕朋友將給大家一份驚喜。 同時非常感謝遠見雜誌與MaxLuck Co. Mrs. Chiang贊助大會多份”新台灣之光100”為抽獎禮品。今年的建國百年國慶大會秉承這份精神，也延續這份動力，”年年慶雙十再續一百年”。
741545ce038e190de930f33f2506460c053e61a6.translatedText: As all parts of the world prepare to celebrate the centenary of the founding of the People's Republic of China with joy and enthusiasm, everyone is thinking about how to celebrate the "centenary" in a different way from the past. When I saw "New Taiwan's Light 100" published by Vision Magazine, I was so excited that I felt so heroic. Just like sailing a boat against the current, I should paddle forward. Vision Magazine selected 99 names from thousands of entries in Taiwan and reserved the 100th name for each "you". Demonstrate the fighting spirit of the Taiwanese people at this moment. Based on the 100 years since the founding of the Republic of China by Dr. Sun Yat-sen, the founding father, taking stock of these soft powers can help us enter the next "hundred year". It can be said that the Preparatory Committee for the National Day of the Centenary of the Founding of the Province of Alberta has used "deep cultivation and deep development" to identify a group of extremely outstanding talented young singers. They not only have natural golden voices, but also can compose and compose their own songs. They are from Taiwan The Dream Angel Chorus, as well as Li Oona (Kaohsiung), Liu Xieshu (Taichung), Jiang Yanting (Chiayi), Yang Zhongting (Queen of Chengcheng), Li Ruiying (Xi'an), good friends from Guangzhou, these young friends will give everyone a surprise. At the same time, I am very grateful to Vision Magazine and MaxLuck Co. Mrs. Chiang for sponsoring multiple copies of "New Taiwan Light 100" as raffle gifts at the conference. This year's National Day Conference for the Centenary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China adheres to this spirit and continues this motivation, "celebrating Double Ten every year for another hundred years."
