18926327c35e5319f2b12cbd582cb34454f222ec.sourceText: 中国学生在美遇害敲警钟 留学热潮下安全需重视 编者按：4月11日凌晨1时，两名正在美国南加州大学就读的中国籍留学生在住所附近的车内被枪杀。警方怀疑这是一起持枪抢劫案，犯罪嫌疑人目前在逃，案件仍在调查之中。这起事件再次为中国赴美留学生人身安全问题敲响了警钟。 据当地警方透露，枪击案发生在西亚当斯地区南加州大学校园附近的一条街道上。南加大校方证实，遇害中国留学生为一男一女，姓名分别是瞿铭和吴颖，均生于1988年，同为南加大工程学院电子工程专业研究生。警方初步查明，案发时，瞿铭驾驶一辆宝马轿车护送吴颖回到她租住的公寓外，将车临时停在路边交谈时，一名枪手突然从车外向车内开枪，子弹穿过玻璃击中两人。瞿铭中枪后奋力跑出车外，到吴颖租住的公寓外拍门求救，但因体力不支倒在门外。警方闻讯后赶到现场，将两人送往附近的医院救治，终因伤势过重抢救无效死亡。 警方认为，这是一起持枪抢劫案，犯罪嫌疑人是一名男子，具体情况不详。多位目击者反映，案发时至少听到3声枪响，并看到有人慌忙逃离现场，但由于当时一片漆黑且正在下雨，无法看清嫌犯的体貌特征。警方仍在对案件进行深入调查，并加紧在附近区域搜捕嫌犯。南加大公共安全部门当天中午已在案发地所在的街道设置了临时安全岗楼，并派人全天24小时守卫。 案发后，南加大校方已经联系被害学生家属，并及时向全校师生通报了有关情况，提醒他们提高警惕，注意人身安全。中国驻洛杉矶总领馆立即启动领事保护应急机制，一方面派员赶赴学校了解情况，促请校方配合家属处理善后事宜，另一方面提醒领区中国留学生，切实提高安全防范意识，尽量避免夜间外出。 南加大校园地处犯罪率较高的洛杉矶中心地带。据美联社援引当地警方的数据称，今年以来已有4人在该区域被杀，而上一次南加大学生死亡案件发生在2008年。 两名中国留学生遇害案，震动了整个南加大校园，很多学生在第一时间打电话向父母亲友报平安，还有一些学生因担心人身安全，正在考虑搬离案发社区。学校不少师生和附近居民自发来到案发现场献花致哀。校方当晚在校园内举行了正式的悼念活动。 南加大是全美国际学生人数最多的大学。据统计，2011年外国留学生人数为7226人，占该校3.8万名在校生的19%。而在国际学生当中，中国学生人数占35%，是最大的外国留学生群体。这种情况是全美大学的一个缩影。近年来，赴美留学的中国学生数量迅速增长，已占在美国际留学生总数的四分之一。 中国经济的高速增长，让越来越多的家庭可以承担起子女留学海外的费用。但与此同时，由于美国社会枪支泛滥，部分地区治安混乱，中国留学生遭遇暴力犯罪以及各类事故等不幸事件的数量也在上升。随着中国学生留美热潮的持续升温，人身安全问题应该引起学生、家长以及有关部门的高度重视。
18926327c35e5319f2b12cbd582cb34454f222ec.translatedText: The murder of Chinese students in the United States is a wake-up call. Safety needs to be paid attention to during the study abroad boom. Editor's note: At 1 a.m. on April 11, two Chinese students studying at the University of Southern California were shot dead in a car near their residence. The police suspect this was an armed robbery. The suspect is currently at large and the case is still under investigation. This incident once again sounded the alarm for the personal safety of Chinese students studying in the United States. According to local police, the shooting occurred on a street near the University of Southern California campus in the West Adams area. The University of Southern California confirmed that the murdered Chinese students were a man and a woman. Their names were Qu Ming and Wu Ying. They were both born in 1988 and were both graduate students in electronic engineering at the School of Engineering at the University of Southern California. The police initially found that at the time of the incident, Qu Ming drove a BMW sedan to escort Wu Ying back to her rented apartment. When the car was temporarily parked on the side of the road to talk, a gunman suddenly opened fire from outside the car and the bullets penetrated the glass and hit two people. After being shot, Qu Ming struggled to run out of the car and knocked on the door of Wu Ying's rented apartment for help, but he collapsed outside the door due to physical exhaustion. After hearing the news, the police rushed to the scene and sent the two people to a nearby hospital for treatment. They eventually died from their injuries and failed to save them. Police believe this was an armed robbery and the suspect is a man whose circumstances are unknown. Many witnesses reported that they heard at least three gunshots during the incident and saw someone hurriedly fleeing the scene. However, because it was dark and raining at the time, they could not clearly see the physical characteristics of the suspect. The police are still conducting an in-depth investigation into the case and are stepping up their search for suspects in nearby areas. The USC Public Safety Department set up a temporary security watchtower on the street where the incident occurred at noon that day, and sent personnel to guard it 24 hours a day. After the incident, the University of Southern California has contacted the families of the murdered students and promptly informed all teachers and students of the school about the situation, reminding them to be more vigilant and pay attention to personal safety. The Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles immediately activated the consular protection emergency mechanism. On the one hand, it sent personnel to the school to understand the situation and urged the school to cooperate with the family in handling the aftermath. On the other hand, it reminded Chinese students in the consular district to effectively improve their safety awareness and try to avoid going out at night. The USC campus is located in the heart of Los Angeles, which has a high crime rate. According to the Associated Press, citing local police data, four people have been killed in the area so far this year, and the last death of a USC student occurred in 2008. The murder of two Chinese international students shocked the entire USC campus. Many students immediately called their parents, relatives and friends to report that they were safe. Some students were considering moving out of the community where the crime occurred because they were worried about their personal safety. Many teachers and students of the school and nearby residents spontaneously came to the scene of the crime to lay flowers and express their condolences. The school held a formal memorial service on campus that night. The University of Southern California has the largest number of international students in the United States. According to statistics, the number of foreign students in 2011 was 7,226, accounting for 19% of the school’s 38,000 students. Among international students, Chinese students account for 35%, making them the largest group of foreign students. This situation is a microcosm of universities across the United States. In recent years, the number of Chinese students studying in the United States has grown rapidly and now accounts for a quarter of the total international students in the United States. China's rapid economic growth has enabled more and more families to afford the cost of their children studying abroad. But at the same time, due to the proliferation of guns in American society and the chaos of public security in some areas, the number of unfortunate incidents such as violent crimes and various accidents encountered by Chinese students is also on the rise. As the craze for Chinese students studying in the United States continues to heat up, the issue of personal safety should attract the attention of students, parents and relevant departments.

636d545f8c119ee742d46498ddf2b77015fc4523.sourceText: 房屋装修: 西人或华人装修公司到底谁更令人放心？ 在加拿大，装修房屋是一件值得谈谈的事情，尤其是你选择了西人作为自己房子的装修公司时，那其中的一些事情可能会超出你的想象;同时，你选择华人装修公司，那么有些事情也不像在国内那么容易。 尽管从工种上来说，加拿大和中国很类似，大致都分为水管工、电工、瓦工(泥瓦屋顶工)、木工、油漆工和地板工等。但是，在具体操作和规格上来说，加拿大的要求就会严格很多。首先来讲，这些工匠都必须有政府颁发的从业资格证。在中国，遍地都是装修队，既没有注册公司，也没有证件，大多兜揽生意都靠口才。因此，中国老百姓装修，和装修队发生冲突的事例不在少数。大多都是承诺的做工水准和最后做出来的差距很大，或者偷工减料导致质量不好等等。而且在中国，家庭在这方面属于弱势群体，因为没有非常严格的法律执行来保证装修队的质量和诚信。 在加拿大，法律比较健全，如果你选择了西人装修公司为自己的家干活，那么，你要严格按照法律执行。尤其是在工作时间上，劳工法要求周六、周日休息，每天工作时间为8小时，准时下班，如果加班，每小时要按照双倍工资计算发给工人。西人装修公司给一座独立屋施工，一般会组成10个工人的一支装修队伍，所签工期大约为3个月。 尽管如此，加拿大也有很多华人装修公司，其行事风格也秉承了很多中国特色。 如果你选择了华人装修公司来做，同样一座独立屋，装修工人的数量会被压缩至4 人之内，这是为了节省昂贵的人工费用，而且完工时间大约只需要2个月。另外，加班也是时常有的，至于工钱，估计没人多提。 至于工种的不同，华人装修公司秉承了中国人的作风，如果技术还不错的工人，会兼顾瓦工、水工、凿墙甚至清理垃圾等工作。 通常而言，华人移民都愿意选择华人装修公司，因为西人装修公司的做工时间过于长，而且人数过多，有些工人工在作时间也未必会认真干活，反而在磨洋工，因此导致业主的装修成本大增。不过，西人装修公司也有好的地方，就是装修的质量还是比较靠谱的。 华人装修公司由于很多是临时接一些活，因此，质量不仅很难保证，是否能按时完工也很难说。大致有两个经验值得我们借鉴的。 第一，包工包料要写明材料的品牌和要求。如果不是正规的装修公司，仅是装修队，那么，和个人谈条件，要自己拟一份合同，写明瓷砖要用什么品牌，油漆要用什么品牌，五金件的品牌等。如果这些没有写明白，到时候装修队很可能用的是最劣质的材料，当你发现的时候，又没办法和他把道理讲清楚。 第二，款项要分期支付。很多家庭上当受骗就是因为轻信装修队，刚开始只支付了少量定金，发现装修队干活十分认真，因此就放心地把余款在没有装修完就结清了，结果发现钱一结完后，装修队或者不见了踪影，或者干活开始敷衍了事。 总结之后，发现省钱又放心的装修经验是，找一家华人装修公司，一方面是便于沟通，另外一方面是公司多少比装修队正规，所有的内容都是按照合同办事，因此装修的程序和检验也相对来说合格一些。 虽然装修公司比装修队所花的成本要高一些，但是品质却可以保证，同时华人装修公司也比西人装修公司的成本要低很多。 不过，要注意的是，一定要强调他们干活的规范性。俗话称，一分价钱一分货，如果你想拥有一个不错水准的装修，那么，也不用过于省钱。如果你是只希望降低成本并且可以牺牲质量的客户，那么装修队可能会更适合一些。 另外，你还需要注意，即使你找了装修队或者装修公司，你也要在家里备下齐全的装修工具，这是为了将来的不时之需。很多时候，你会碰到装修队中一些工人不按照规定施工的，需要钉子的地方可能简单用胶代替，而需要拧紧螺丝的地方他们可能简单把螺帽一套就过去了。这时候，就需要你找出钉子，强制工人给你钉上;或者你自己找出扳手将螺帽拧紧。 在加拿大买房子和装修，并不如在国内那么方便，首先，合适的工人不如国内那么多。另外，有时候你会发现自己家的工人很难沟通，你们总是发生摩擦，当你希望装修公司给另派一名工人时，公司却告诉你没有人手了，除非你有足够的耐心等别人家的活干完再抽调工人过来。在这时候，你就知道在国外装修房子有多么不容易了。
636d545f8c119ee742d46498ddf2b77015fc4523.translatedText: House decoration: Who is more reassuring, a Western or a Chinese decoration company? In Canada, house decoration is something worth talking about, especially if you choose a Western decoration company as your house decoration company, then some of the things may be beyond your imagination; at the same time, if you choose a Chinese decoration company, then some things are not as easy as in China. Although Canada and China are very similar in terms of job types, they are roughly divided into plumbers, electricians, bricklayers (tile roofers), carpenters, painters and floorers. However, in terms of specific operations and specifications, Canada's requirements are much stricter. First of all, these craftsmen must have a professional qualification certificate issued by the government. In China, there are decoration teams everywhere. They have neither registered companies nor certificates. Most of them rely on their eloquence to drum up business. Therefore, there are many cases of conflicts between Chinese people decorating and decorating teams. In most cases, there is a big gap between the promised workmanship level and the final product, or cutting corners, resulting in poor quality, etc. Moreover, in China, families are a vulnerable group in this regard, because there is no very strict legal enforcement to ensure the quality and integrity of the decoration team. In Canada, the laws are relatively sound. If you choose a Western decoration company to work on your home, you must strictly abide by the laws. Especially in terms of working hours, the labor law requires Saturdays and Sundays to be rested, and the working time to be 8 hours a day, and to get off work on time. If overtime is worked, workers must be paid double wages every hour. When Xiren Decoration Company constructs a detached house, it usually forms a decoration team of 10 workers, and the contracted construction period is about 3 months. Despite this, there are also many Chinese decoration companies in Canada, and their styles also inherit many Chinese characteristics. If you choose a Chinese decoration company to do it, for the same independent house, the number of decoration workers will be reduced to less than 4 people. This is to save expensive labor costs, and the completion time will only take about 2 months. In addition, overtime work is also common. As for wages, I guess no one mentions it much. As for the different types of work, Huaren Decoration Company adheres to the Chinese style. If the workers have good skills, they will also take care of bricklaying, waterworks, wall cutting and even garbage cleaning. Generally speaking, Chinese immigrants are willing to choose Chinese decoration companies, because the working hours of Western decoration companies are too long, and there are too many people. Some workers may not work seriously during working hours, but are doing foreign work, thus causing the owner's decoration costs to increase significantly. However, Xiren Decoration Company also has a good point, that is, the quality of decoration is relatively reliable. Since many Chinese decoration companies take on temporary work, it is not only difficult to guarantee the quality, but also difficult to say whether they can complete the work on time. There are roughly two experiences worth learning from. First, when contracting work and materials, the brand and requirements of the materials must be stated. If it is not a formal decoration company, but just a decoration team, then negotiate with the individual and draw up a contract yourself, specifying what brand of tiles, paint, and hardware brand should be used. If these are not written clearly, the decoration team is likely to use the lowest quality materials. When you find out, you will not be able to explain the reason clearly to them. Second, the payment must be made in installments. Many families were deceived because they trusted the decoration team. They only paid a small deposit at the beginning and found that the decoration team was very serious about their work, so they settled the remaining balance without finishing the decoration. However, they found that as soon as the money was settled, the decoration team either disappeared or started to work perfunctorily. After summarizing, I found that the most cost-effective and reliable decoration experience is to find a Chinese decoration company. On the one hand, it is easier to communicate. On the other hand, the company is more formal than the decoration team. Everything is done in accordance with the contract, so the decoration procedures and inspections are relatively qualified. Although the cost of a decoration company is higher than that of a decoration team, the quality can be guaranteed. At the same time, the cost of a Chinese decoration company is much lower than that of a Western decoration company. However, it should be noted that the standardization of their work must be emphasized. As the saying goes, you get what you pay for. If you want to have a good level of decoration, then you don't have to save too much. If you are a customer who only wants to reduce costs and can sacrifice quality, then a decoration team may be more suitable. In addition, you also need to note that even if you find a decoration team or decoration company, you must have a complete set of decoration tools at home for future emergencies. Many times, you will encounter some workers in the decoration team who do not follow the regulations. Where nails are needed, they may simply use glue, and where screws need to be tightened, they may simply use a set of nuts. At this time, you need to find a nail and force the worker to nail it for you; or you need to find a wrench and tighten the nut yourself. Buying a house and renovating it in Canada is not as convenient as in China. First of all, there are not as many suitable workers as there are in China. In addition, sometimes you will find that it is difficult to communicate with your own workers, and you always have friction. When you want the decoration company to send another worker, the company tells you that there is no manpower, unless you are patient enough to wait for other people's work to be completed before sending workers over. At this time, you will know how difficult it is to decorate a house abroad.

45e77c8e64b1078974a4fe88ed1f05f4561530e3.sourceText: 希望中文学校由家长和孩子们组成的青年交响乐团刚刚成立了两个月，就在这次晚晏上成功地演奏了三首动人的乐曲。同时学校歌舞团的十几位成员的伴唱，也令大家耳目一新。严婕娅、孙宏伟、王乐军三位朋友分别为大家演唱了大家非常熟悉的中文歌曲。
45e77c8e64b1078974a4fe88ed1f05f4561530e3.translatedText: Hope Chinese School Youth Symphony Orchestra composed of parents and children has just been established for two months and successfully performed three moving pieces of music at this evening party. At the same time, the accompaniment of more than a dozen members of the school's song and dance troupe also made everyone feel refreshed. Three friends, Yan Jieya, Sun Hongwei and Wang Lejun, sang Chinese songs that everyone is very familiar with.

cffc056c0ee5a9b6a1ea0fb0951f05ed07b5f75d.sourceText: 两个女孩子穿着古代的水袖长裙，给大家带来舞蹈《天女散花》。孩子们穿着中式的传统服装进行的时装表演和集体大拜年，学校给每个孩子的发红包活动 将晚宴的气氛推向了高潮。
cffc056c0ee5a9b6a1ea0fb0951f05ed07b5f75d.translatedText: Two girls wore ancient long skirts with water sleeves and performed the dance "Tiannu Scattering Flowers". The children dressed in traditional Chinese costumes performed a fashion show and gave a collective New Year greeting, and the school distributed red envelopes to each child, pushing the atmosphere of the dinner to a climax.

2427a9d6e65fd02af1f793f3c50ac7f0009ff900.sourceText: 晚宴中最有趣的是多次抽奖活动，不时有幸运的人得到各种不同的小小的奖品，笑声和祝福声不断地从各个角落里响起。几位属龙的朋友得到了一个个红红的塑料挂龙，笑得嘴都合不拢。
2427a9d6e65fd02af1f793f3c50ac7f0009ff900.translatedText: The most interesting part of the dinner was the multiple lottery activities. From time to time, lucky people received various small prizes. Laughter and blessings continued to ring from every corner. Several friends who were born in the year of dragon got red plastic hanging dragons and laughed so much that they couldn't close their mouths.

db94848c743871b9b5acc198a83359753ec45475.sourceText: 最后，所有的朋友，一起唱起了我们在中国几乎每年的除夕之夜都会听到的歌曲《难忘今宵》。晚宴结束的时候，就听到有朋友感叹：人这一生中，能有多少个春节晚宴是二百多人一起渡过的呢？这真是一个令人难忘的夜晚。
db94848c743871b9b5acc198a83359753ec45475.translatedText: Finally, all my friends sang the song "Unforgettable Tonight" that we hear almost every New Year's Eve in China. At the end of the dinner, I heard a friend sigh: How many Spring Festival dinners can be spent together by more than 200 people in a person's life? It was truly an unforgettable night.

6f22f71bb39526e164e729d86d3c0a7b9574b651.sourceText: 亚利桑那州中文教师培训圆满结束(图) 亚利桑那州一百四十多位教师参加讲学团培训课程 中国海外交流协会讲学团顺利结束 八月十九日凤凰城地区参加培训课程人员与讲学团成员合影 【全美中文学校协会来稿】经全美中文学校协会廖会长与中国海外交流协会联系，中国海外交流协会今年8月派出了两组讲学团到美国各地为中文学校教师培训，讲学团成员刚刚结束了在各地的培训课程，8月27日已启程返回中国大陆。 这次中国海外交流协会经过长时间的准备，在各地聘请教育名师。两组讲学团教授分别来自于复旦大学、北京师大、南京师大和暨南大学。培训课程包括中国文化专题、汉语教学法和儿童教学心理学。所有参加了全部培训课程的教师都获得了中国海外交流协会颁发的培训证书。 在亚利桑那州讲学的是复旦大学葛剑雄教授、北京师大朱志平教授和姚梅林教授。他们于酷暑季节在亚利桑那州待了一周，分别在凤凰城和图桑市举行了三天讲座，参加听课的人数超过一百四十人，其中包括本州八所中文学校教师和学校管理人员以及一些对培训课程感兴趣的家长，许多在全日制学校任教中文的教师也参加了这次培训课程。凤凰城地区有八十多位教师报名，还有一些对课程感兴趣的家长和当地社区华人也赶来听课。8月16日周四的课程安排在晚上，很多教师在下班后赶来听课，他们对姚梅林教授教授的”儿童学习的心理规律与教育的智慧”印象深刻，感到很受启发。8月19日周日上午，葛剑雄教授讲授”中国文化的复兴和建设”，朱志平教授讲授”汉语字词教学及其方法”。当天一百多座位的教室几乎全部被听课人员占满。听课的教师们表示，朱志平教授讲授的课程对今后的中文教学很有启发和实用意义。还有教师专门带着朱志平教授主编的”跟我学汉语”课本来与朱教授合影。高年资的葛剑雄教授才结束在捷克的讲学，就赶到西雅图开始讲学，紧接着又赶到亚利桑那州讲学。他阐述的独到而精辟的观点、高屋建瓴般的分析，使听课人员感到受益匪浅。一些中文学校负责人和老师听课后表示很敬佩讲学团教授们的不辞辛苦的工作态度和敬业精神。 本州中文教师陆平（左）现代中文学校副校长朱岩（右）与朱志平教授（’跟我学汉语’课本主编）合影 亚利桑那州的图桑祖荀中文学校、亚省希望中文学校和现代中文学校都参与了接待讲学团的工作，当地有好几所中文学校的负责人积极组织了教师的报名活动。 国侨办老师与图桑中文教师合影 （左二）姚梅林教授（左三）葛剑雄教授（左四）朱志平教授（右一）中国海外交流协会詹志博先生 全美中文学校协会理事会感谢各地中文学校接待讲学团和积极组织教师报名参加培训，也感谢各地媒体为此次教师培训所做的宣传推动工作。 全美中文学校协会 (The Chinese School Association in the United States, 简称CSAUS) 是一个全国性非盈利性公益组织。协会自一九九四年成立以来，经过历届理事会的共同努力，协会会员学校已达四百多所，遍布美国四十三个州的几乎所有大、中城市。协会会员学校的在校学生人数从开始的几百人发展到今天的十万余人。全美中文学校协会利用与会员学校的紧密联系以及与国内外教育单位的协作关系，每年都会组织各类大型与华文教育有关的活动，今后协会还将继续主办”教师培训”活动，为促进华文教育在美国的发展继续努力。
6f22f71bb39526e164e729d86d3c0a7b9574b651.translatedText: Chinese teacher training in Arizona concluded successfully (picture) More than 140 teachers in Arizona participated in the lecture group training course. The China Overseas Exchange Association lecture group concluded successfully. Participants in the training course in the Phoenix area took a group photo with members of the lecture group on August 19. [Contribution from the National Association of Chinese Schools] After contacting President Liao of the National Association of Chinese Schools and the China Overseas Exchange Association, the China Overseas Exchange Association sent two lecture groups to various parts of the United States to train Chinese school teachers in August this year. The members of the lecture team have just completed their training courses in various places and have returned to mainland China on August 27. This time, the China Overseas Exchange Association has made long-term preparations and hired famous education teachers from various places. The two groups of lecture group professors come from Fudan University, Beijing Normal University, Nanjing Normal University and Jinan University respectively. Training courses include Chinese cultural topics, Chinese teaching methods and children's teaching psychology. All teachers who participated in all training courses received training certificates issued by the China Overseas Exchange Association. The lecturers in Arizona are Professor Ge Jianxiong of Fudan University, Professor Zhu Zhiping and Professor Yao Meilin of Beijing Normal University. They stayed in Arizona for a week during the hot summer season and held three days of lectures in Phoenix and Tucson. More than 140 people attended the lectures, including teachers and school administrators from eight Chinese schools in the state and some parents who were interested in training courses. Many teachers who teach Chinese in full-time schools also participated in this training course. More than 80 teachers in the Phoenix area have signed up, and some parents and Chinese from the local community who are interested in the course also come to attend the class. The course on Thursday, August 16, was scheduled in the evening. Many teachers came to attend the class after get off work. They were deeply impressed and inspired by Professor Yao Meilin's "Psychological Laws of Children's Learning and the Wisdom of Education." On the morning of Sunday, August 19, Professor Ge Jianxiong taught "Revival and Construction of Chinese Culture", and Professor Zhu Zhiping taught "Chinese Word Teaching and Its Methods". That day, almost all the classroom with more than 100 seats was occupied by lecturers. Teachers who attended the class said that the courses taught by Professor Zhu Zhiping were very inspiring and practical for future Chinese teaching. There are also teachers who specially brought the "Learn Chinese with Me" textbook edited by Professor Zhu Zhiping to take photos with Professor Zhu. Senior Professor Ge Jianxiong just finished his lectures in the Czech Republic and rushed to Seattle to start giving lectures, and then rushed to Arizona to give lectures. His unique and incisive viewpoints and lofty analysis benefited the audience a lot. After listening to the class, some Chinese school leaders and teachers expressed their admiration for the hard work attitude and professionalism of the professors in the lecture group. Lu Ping (left), a Chinese teacher in the state, Zhu Yan (right), vice-principal of the Modern Chinese School, and Professor Zhu Zhiping (chief editor of the "Learn Chinese with Me" textbook). Tucson Zuxun Chinese School, Alberta Hope Chinese School and Modern Chinese School in Arizona all participated in the work of receiving the lecture group. The heads of several local Chinese schools actively organized teacher registration activities. A group photo of teachers from the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council and Tucson Chinese teachers (second from left) Professor Yao Meilin (third from left) Professor Ge Jianxiong (fourth from left) Professor Zhu Zhiping (first from right) Mr. Zhan Zhibo of the China Overseas Exchange Association. The National Association of Chinese Schools Board of Directors thanks Chinese schools in various places for hosting lecture groups and actively organizing teachers to sign up for the training. It also thanks local media for their publicity and promotion work for this teacher training. The Chinese School Association in the United States (CSAUS) is a national non-profit public welfare organization. Since the association was established in 1994, through the joint efforts of successive councils, the association has more than 400 member schools, covering almost all large and medium-sized cities in 43 states in the United States. The number of students in the association's member schools has grown from a few hundred students to more than 100,000 today. The National Chinese Schools Association utilizes its close ties with member schools and collaborative relationships with domestic and foreign educational institutions to organize various large-scale activities related to Chinese education every year. In the future, the Association will continue to host "teacher training" activities and continue to work hard to promote the development of Chinese education in the United States.

e6a29f9a36e31af91c64b95541aca60ffddd0f63.sourceText: 官员磨拳擦掌 提高边境围栏的现金 亚利桑那州的官员正在加紧为7月20日推出一个新的网站，接受捐赠支付沿该州的美墨边境的部分额外的围栏建设。 根据四月批出的立法，国家将用捐款捐物和犯人劳动，以沿边境部分地区建立更多的击围栏。鉴于非法移民和日益增多的暴力事件，共和党议员支持围栏法案，并为建立围栏所需资金提出筹款办法。 法案提议者，州参议员史蒂夫史密斯说，网站将于7月20日开通。这是在亚利桑那州立法机关的2011届常会通过围栏法的一部分。
e6a29f9a36e31af91c64b95541aca60ffddd0f63.translatedText: Officials gearing up to raise cash for border fence Arizona officials are gearing up to launch a new website on July 20 to accept donations to pay for the construction of additional fencing along the state's portion of the U.S.-Mexico border. Under legislation approved in April, the state will use donations of materials and prison labor to build more fencing along parts of the border. Republican lawmakers have backed fencing bills and proposed ways to fund the fencing in light of illegal immigration and rising violence. State Sen. Steve Smith, the bill's sponsor, said the website would launch on July 20. This was part of the fencing law passed by the Arizona Legislature during the 2011 regular session.

b9eeac21ff4154a12b12f840468e6474642157eb.sourceText: 8月31日,在黄金峡谷拍到了山猫跳上仙人掌的照片。这只山猫在狮子的追赶下，慌不择路地爬上了一棵仙人掌的顶端，并在上边逗留了6个小时才敢下来。
b9eeac21ff4154a12b12f840468e6474642157eb.translatedText: On August 31, I took a photo of a bobcat jumping on a cactus in Golden Canyon. Chased by a lion, the lynx climbed to the top of a cactus in a panic and stayed there for six hours before daring to come down.

e307b14b0ac90c2f0326bc631a10b37b3581cafe.sourceText: 记亚省现代中文学校二十周年校庆典礼 初夏时节，紫槿飘香。2016年五月七日上午，亚省现代中文学校在 Marcos de Niza High School礼堂举办了隆重的二十周年校庆典礼。春风化雨二十载，欢欣满堂同喝釆，现代教育延绵绵，善泽兴学育英才。在”好日子”欢快的歌声中，庆祝典礼拉开了序幕。一组充满活力，身材姣美的中文学校的女学生，伴随着中华乐团女生合唱团的优美歌声，跳起了动感十足的彩绸舞。”欢乐的舞蹈跳出今天的喜庆，动听的歌声送来一片欢腾。今天是个好日子，今天是20校庆，亚省现代中文学校。20年的风雨兼程，20年的桃李芬芳，今天我们终于迎来了欢聚的时刻，共享灿烂和辉煌。欢迎你老义工，中文学校的创始人，欢迎你,长期对中文学校大力支持的朋友。欢迎你们，努力奋发学习的同学们，欢迎你们，不辞辛苦风雨无阻的家长们，欢迎你们辛勤的园丁，尊敬的老师们。”校长Jim Xi和董事长田韶微以充满诗意的致辞获得了学校师生和嘉宾们的热烈掌声和共鸣。今天的节目主持人是享誉亚省美丽端庄的Cindy Lin和中文学校资深教师陶世城，他们充满激情和文采飞扬的中英文报幕吸引了所有的观众。
e307b14b0ac90c2f0326bc631a10b37b3581cafe.translatedText: >Memory of the 20th Anniversary Celebration of Alberta Modern Chinese School In early summer, the fragrance of purple hibiscus bloomed. On the morning of May 7, 2016, Alberta Modern Chinese School held a grand 20th anniversary celebration ceremony in the auditorium of Marcos de Niza High School. The spring breeze has turned into rain for twenty years, and the whole hall is full of joy and drinking together. Modern education continues, and good deeds promote education and cultivate talents. In the cheerful singing of "Good Day", the celebration ceremony kicked off. A group of energetic and beautiful female students from the Chinese school performed a dynamic colorful silk dance accompanied by the beautiful singing of the Chinese Orchestra Girls' Chorus. "The joyful dance brings out the joy of today, and the beautiful singing brings joy. Today is a good day, today is the 20th anniversary of the Alberta Modern Chinese School. After 20 years of ups and downs, 20 years of fragrant peaches and plums, today we finally ushered in the moment of joyful gathering, sharing splendor and glory. Welcome to you old volunteers, the founders of Chinese schools, welcome to friends who have been supporting Chinese schools for a long time. Welcome to you students who work hard, welcome to you, parents who work tirelessly regardless of rain or shine, welcome to you hard-working gardeners, and respected teachers." Xihe Chairman Tian Shaowei won warm applause and resonance from teachers, students and guests of the school with his poetic speech. Today's program hosts are Cindy Lin, who is renowned for her beauty and dignity in the province, and Tao Shicheng, a senior teacher at the Chinese school. Their passionate and literary announcements in Chinese and English attracted all the viewers.

e5a4c82a6f1a4b5b3833b93c1a20112fe44a0f2e.sourceText: 主持人林欣Cindy Lin（左） 陶世城（右）
e5a4c82a6f1a4b5b3833b93c1a20112fe44a0f2e.translatedText: Moderator Lin Xin Cindy Lin (left) Tao Shicheng (right)

95fbe8d39e177573c931286510c6c0d41289f9f0.sourceText: 二十年一路走来，我们学校得到了各届人士的大力支持和帮助。在这欢庆的时刻，我们有幸请来了多位嘉宾参加了我们的校庆。他们是中国驻洛杉矶领事馆王学政领事，孙卫东领事，孔子学院院长Dr. Joe Cutter和孔子学院主任Mrs. Fannie Tam；全美中文学校协会名誉会长帅致若；希望中文学校校长田琳，董事长李健；图桑中文学校校长陈荣基；凤凰城中文学校董事长Edmond Tse；凤城华人基督教会学校李珍副校长；孟子中文学校校长刘凤霞；亚省时报甄社长；亚美报编辑孙涧萍；亚省华人华侨联合会李健会长，陶世城，费建，王惟咨，董斌，彭菲；凤凰城侨联总会邓洪钺主席，余文劲，邓朝驹，高志中，张肇鸿；Mesa Community College校长潘寿安；资深教育领导唐孝先。
95fbe8d39e177573c931286510c6c0d41289f9f0.translatedText: Over the past twenty years, our school has received strong support and help from people from all walks of life. In this moment of celebration, we are fortunate to have many guests attend our school anniversary. They are Consul Wang Xuezheng and Consul Sun Weidong of the Chinese Consulate in Los Angeles, Dr. Joe Cutter, Director of the Confucius Institute, and Mrs. Fannie Tam, Director of the Confucius Institute; Shuai Zhiruo, Honorary President of the National Association of Chinese Schools; Tian Lin, Principal of Hope Chinese School, and Li Jian, Chairman of the Board; Chen Rongji, Principal of Tucson Chinese School; Edmond, Chairman of Phoenix Chinese School Tse; Vice Principal of Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church School Li Zhen; Principal of Mencius Chinese School Liu Fengxia; President of the Alberta Times Zhen; Editor of Asian American Newspaper Sun Jianping; President of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Alberta Li Jian, Tao Shicheng, Fei Jian, Wang Weizi, Dong Bin, Peng Fei; Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Phoenix City Deng Hongyue, Yu Wenjin, Deng Chaoju, Gao Zhizhong, Zhang Zhaohong; Mesa Community College principal Pan Shouan; senior education leader Tang Xiaoxian.

d680db7cfa2e9a9588618f1e716a3ea9d8960e17.sourceText: 同时我们也收到了来自全美中文学校协会会长张星宇的贺信，张会长在贺信中高度赞扬了我们学校为华裔年轻的一代和多元化的社区传播中华文化所做的贡献社区，表彰了二十年来兢兢业业无数志愿者们，并预祝我们庆典获得圆满成功！尤为让大家激动的是坦佩市长为我校发来了公告：鉴于亚省现代中文学校自建校以来长期致力于本地区中文教育和文化交流及社区建设所作出的积极贡献，我，坦佩市长麦克.米切尔宣布2016年5月7日为亚省现代中文学校日。
d680db7cfa2e9a9588618f1e716a3ea9d8960e17.translatedText: At the same time, we also received a congratulatory letter from Zhang Xingyu, President of the National Association of Chinese Schools. In his congratulatory letter, President Zhang highly praised our school’s contribution to spreading Chinese culture to the young generation of Chinese Americans and the diverse community, commended countless volunteers who have worked hard over the past two decades, and wished our celebration a complete success! What particularly excited everyone was the announcement sent by the Mayor of Tempe to our school: In view of the positive contributions that the Alberta Modern Chinese School has made to Chinese education, cultural exchanges and community construction in the region since its establishment, I, the Mayor of Tempe, Mike Mitchell, declare May 7, 2016 as the Alberta Modern Chinese School Day.

ffbdb8d70004a57455da1ffb9422108b97742314.translatedText: Director of the Confucius Institute Dr. Cutter (first from left) and Director of the Confucius Institute Mrs Fannie Tam (first from right) presented the trophy to the Modern Chinese School. Chairman Tian Shaowei received the award (second from left)

0c5c3f5ec99c3c442e66c3c55f4b44f5c998223f.sourceText: 王学政领事在台上代表中国驻洛杉矶领事馆向现代中文学校二十年庆典表示了热烈的祝贺！王领事说海外华文教育就是一项传承华夏文明的”留根工程”，现代中文学校在传承中华文明弘扬中华文化方面发挥着重要作用，肩负着神圣责任！孔子学院院长Dr. Cutter作为嘉宾也在台上讲话向学校表示了热烈的祝贺，并与孔子学院主任 Mrs Fannie Tam一起为现代中文学校颁发了奖杯，以表彰我们学校为弘扬中华文化做出的巨大贡献！ 忆往昔，桃李不言，自有风雨话沧桑；看今朝，厚德载物，更续华教誉凤凰。在我们亚省现代中文学校二十年庆典的今天，我们饮水思源，不曾忘记建校初期的艰难。现代中文学校自1996年8月建校以来，已从当年的三十多位学生， 三、四位老师的小小规模，发展到今天六百多位学生注册的盛况。 学校开设了二十七个中文班，十七个数学班，十几个各类补习班及才艺课 。源于优质的教学，我校学生的学习成绩有目共睹。我校在2013 年荣获了”全美示范华文学校”的光荣称号并至今保持这个荣誉。
0c5c3f5ec99c3c442e66c3c55f4b44f5c998223f.translatedText: On behalf of the Chinese Consulate in Los Angeles, Consul Wang Xuezheng expressed warm congratulations to Modern Chinese School on its 20th anniversary celebration! Consul Wang said that overseas Chinese education is a "root project" to inherit Chinese civilization. Modern Chinese schools play an important role in inheriting Chinese civilization and promoting Chinese culture, and shoulder sacred responsibilities! Dr. Cutter, Director of the Confucius Institute, also spoke on the stage as a guest and expressed warm congratulations to the school, and together with Mrs Fannie Tam, Director of the Confucius Institute, presented the trophy to the Modern Chinese School in recognition of our school’s great contribution to the promotion of Chinese culture! Recalling the past, the peach and plum blossoms are silent, and they have their own ups and downs; looking at the present, they are generous and virtuous, and they continue to have the reputation of Phoenix. Today, as we celebrate the 20th anniversary of our Alberta Modern Chinese School, we drink water and remember its origins, and we have never forgotten the difficulties in the early days of the school’s establishment. Since the establishment of Modern Chinese School in August 1996, it has grown from a small scale of more than 30 students and three or four teachers to today's grand occasion of more than 600 registered students. The school has opened 27 Chinese classes, 17 math classes, and more than a dozen various cram schools and talent classes. Due to high-quality teaching, the academic performance of our school students is obvious to all. Our school won the honorable title of “National Model Chinese School” in 2013 and has maintained this honor to this day.

d7004aa3bce0f00389d3a28c768631678c8e60bb.sourceText: 前校长和前董事长朱岩
d7004aa3bce0f00389d3a28c768631678c8e60bb.translatedText: Former principal and former chairman Zhu Yan

22047a83e118b560fe5c8107da9545c937ae88ae.sourceText: 前校长和前董事长朱岩代表学校邀请了二十年来带领学校前行的历届校长和董事长们上台，全体师生为他们报以热烈的掌声表示了对他们的敬意和感谢！
22047a83e118b560fe5c8107da9545c937ae88ae.translatedText: Former principal and former chairman Zhu Yan invited the previous principals and chairman of the board of directors who have led the school for twenty years to the stage on behalf of the school. All teachers and students gave them warm applause to express their respect and gratitude to them!

40641f4b0e9f7d167ffa40a9692a59f14e03270a.sourceText: 这是1996-2016年各界校长和董事长的名单：1.徐强，2.周圭珍Diana Ho，3.张永航，4.陈挺，5.何际平（缺席），6.费健，7.李人（缺席），8.陶世城，9.高颖（缺席），10.Steve Tu，11.經天伟，12.林苏，13.俞志毅（缺席），14.于志，14.魏艺（缺席），15.Gary Li，16.Tony Tam，17.贺春晓，18.汪阳，19.宋良武（缺席），20.朱岩，21.田韶微，22.Jim Xi。大家都很感激他们作为学校的领头羊为学校作出的特殊贡献！德高望重的老校长Diana Ho周圭珍代表老领导们回顾了学校历史并送上祝贺！学校同时感谢了所有现任和退役的义工，校委会和董事会的领导们！
40641f4b0e9f7d167ffa40a9692a59f14e03270a.translatedText: This is the list of principals and chairmen from all walks of life from 1996 to 2016: 1. Xu Qiang, 2. Zhou Guizhen Diana Ho, 3. Zhang Yonghang, 4. Chen Ting, 5. He Jiping (absent), 6. Fei Jian, 7. Li Ren (absent), 8. Tao Shicheng, 9. Gao Ying (absent), 10. Steve Tu, 11. Jing Tianwei, 12. Lin Su, 13. Yu Zhiyi (absent), 14. Yu Zhi, 14. Wei Yi (absent), 15. Gary Li, 16. Tony Tam, 17. He Chunxiao, 18. Wang Yang, 19. Song Liangwu (absent), 20. Zhu Yan, 21. Tian Shaowei, 22. Jim Xi. Everyone is very grateful for their special contributions to the school as leaders of the school! The respected old principal Diana Ho and Zhou Guizhen reviewed the history of the school on behalf of the old leaders and sent congratulations! The school also thanks all current and retired volunteers, school committee and board leaders!

9d69cef809ff02e64c9241b5f2b963b589b05dbe.sourceText: 现任的校委会和董事会成员孙吉军，王玉兰，王晓红，凌洪，吴觐，吴革，朱岩，汪阳，Allan Yang, Fannie Tam,何琦，Steve Tu，Larry Song, 苗玉良也上台接受了校长和董事长的表彰。董事长田韶微隆重地宣布了下届校长为王玉兰女士，董事长为JIM XI先生！王玉兰女士代表学校向学校的中流砥柱–所有的老师们致以崇高的敬意和感谢！ 我们的学校有一个幼儿说说唱唱班。别看班上的小朋友们年龄小，可是了不起，早早地就开始背诵古诗词了！更让人称道的是他们今天勇敢地走上了舞台！毕业典礼上一首《咏鹅》一首《春晓》让小朋友在放松、欢快的氛围中歌唱大自然，既能适应他们这个年纪超强的模仿能力，更能激发他们对中文的兴趣和热情。这里是他们的第一个舞台。天真无邪，欢腾跳跃。在现代中文学校，他们将正式踏上汉语学习的美好征程。幼儿说说唱唱班作为汉语学习的起步课程，桂蕊老师通过教授内容健康、耳熟能详、朗朗上口的儿歌古诗来帮助幼儿接受汉语、汉字、古诗，汉文化等从而培养幼儿对汉语学习的兴趣和提升学习的动力。 现代西方物理学和天文学理论的发展为人类天马行空的想象力插上了翅膀。正是处在青少年期的同学们对历史和穿越的好奇与探索，宋皎昱，邵英，曾颖华，桂蕊老师六年级和七年级给大家呈现出了一台别出心裁的穿越剧《现代中文学校开学了》－高尔基，李白，祖冲之，马良，达芬奇，花木兰，他们都来中文学校了，古今中外名人汇聚，八仙过海那是各显神通。这是中华文化的交流，也是对未来穿梭时空的期待。 人生最大的修养莫过于爱，感恩和宽容！希望生活能如冰心老人所期许描述的：爱在左，同情在右，走在生命的两旁，随时播种，随时开花，将这一径长途，点缀得香花弥漫，使穿枝拂叶的行人，踏着荆棘，不觉得痛苦，有泪可落，却不是悲凉。希望每一位孩子在成长的过程中都能学会感恩，懂得宽容！吴凰华陈芳老师一年级班的孩子一起表演的手语歌舞”感谢”。孝顺父母，尊敬师长，是中国的传统美德。感谢爸妈，老师，路边的小花小草，经过的大风大雨，感谢流动的水，伟大的高山 感谢上天和大地，感谢一切可以感谢的人，事，物，让孩子在学习中文的同时，培养正确的人生观，做一个心存感恩的人。感谢学校创造的好平台，让我们一年级的孩子有实践的机会。
9d69cef809ff02e64c9241b5f2b963b589b05dbe.translatedText: Current school committee and board members Sun Jijun, Wang Yulan, Wang Xiaohong, Ling Hong, Wu Jin, Wu Ge, Zhu Yan, Wang Yang, Allan Yang, Fannie Tam, He Qi, Steve Tu, Larry Song, and Miao Yuliang also took the stage to accept the commendation from the principal and chairman. Chairman Tian Shaowei solemnly announced that the next president will be Ms. Wang Yulan and the chairman will be Mr. JIM XI! On behalf of the school, Ms. Wang Yulan expressed her high respect and gratitude to all the teachers, the mainstay of the school! Our school has a rap class for toddlers. Although the children in the class are young, they are amazing. They started reciting ancient poems early! What's even more commendable is that they bravely took to the stage today! The songs "Ode to the Goose" and "Spring Dawn" at the graduation ceremony allowed the children to sing about nature in a relaxed and cheerful atmosphere. This song can not only adapt to their strong imitation ability at this age, but also stimulate their interest and enthusiasm for Chinese. This is their first stage. Innocent and jumping with joy. At Modern Chinese School, they will officially embark on a wonderful journey of learning Chinese. As a starting course for learning Chinese, teacher Guirui helps children accept Chinese language, Chinese characters, ancient poems, Chinese culture, etc. by teaching healthy, familiar, and catchy children's songs and ancient poems, thereby cultivating children's interest in learning Chinese and improving their motivation for learning. The development of modern Western physics and astronomy theories has given wings to human imagination. It is precisely because of the curiosity and exploration of history and time travel by students in their teenage years that teachers Song Jiaoyu, Shao Ying, Zeng Yinghua, and Guirui in the sixth and seventh grades presented a unique time travel drama "Modern Chinese School Begins" - Gorky, Li Bai, Zu Chongzhi, Ma Liang, Leonardo da Vinci, Hua Mulan, they all came to the Chinese school. Celebrities from ancient and modern times gathered together, and the Eight Immortals crossed the sea, each showing his magical powers. This is an exchange of Chinese culture and an expectation for the future of traveling through time and space. The greatest cultivation in life is love, gratitude and tolerance! I hope that life can be as described by the old man Bing Xin: love on the left, sympathy on the right, walking on both sides of life, sowing seeds at any time, blooming at any time, embellishing this long path with fragrant flowers, so that pedestrians walking through the branches and leaves, stepping on the thorns, will not feel pain, and there will be tears to fall, but they will not be desolate. I hope every child can learn to be grateful and tolerant as they grow up! Children from Teacher Wu Huanghua and Chen Fang’s first-grade class performed the sign language song and dance “Thank You” together. Being filial to parents and respecting teachers are traditional Chinese virtues. Thank parents, teachers, the little flowers and grass on the roadside, the strong winds and heavy rains that have passed, thank the flowing water, the great mountains, thank God and the earth, thank all the people, things and things that can be thanked, so that while learning Chinese, children can cultivate a correct outlook on life and become a grateful person. Thanks to the school for creating a good platform that allows our first-grade children to have the opportunity to practice.

75a4791d5356ed20566225b93b01a55ba5cef5ab.sourceText: 我们的学校拥有一支活跃于凤凰城的学生乐队。在蔡善皋老师的精心指导下，在纪念反法西斯战争胜利七十周年的庆典上及亚省春节联欢晚会上均有上乘的表现，受到了普遍地观注和好评。他们为大家演奏了保留曲目《梁祝》及电视剧《红高梁》插曲《九儿》。获得了全场观众的热烈掌声。女生合唱团也在乐队的伴奏中演唱了如泣如诉的《九儿》。其中小提琴独奏的杨星雨同学出色的演技更是让观众们赞不绝口。
75a4791d5356ed20566225b93b01a55ba5cef5ab.translatedText: Our school has a student band that is active in Phoenix. Under the careful guidance of Teacher Cai Shangao, he performed excellently at the celebration commemorating the 70th anniversary of the victory of the Anti-Fascist War and the Alberta Spring Festival Gala, and received widespread attention and praise. They played the repertoire "Butterfly Lovers" and the episode "Nine Children" from the TV series "Red Sorghum" for everyone. Received warm applause from the entire audience. The girls' choir also sang the tearful "Jiuer" with the accompaniment of the band. Among them, the outstanding performance of Yang Xingyu, the violin soloist, won the audience's praise.

235dabfc606b3f4bc5b6cfbb7e22ed4e8562bac3.sourceText: 我们每个人都有属相，这就是我们熟知的十二生肖。而这十二生肖中的每种属相都有它不同寻常的脾气秉性，Liching，Annie Zhou，陶世诚老师们的双语班及中文口语班的同学们把十二生肖的故事表演得惟妙惟肖，风趣活泼。
235dabfc606b3f4bc5b6cfbb7e22ed4e8562bac3.translatedText: Each of us has a zodiac sign, which is what we know as the Chinese zodiac. Each animal sign in the Chinese zodiac has its own unique temperament. Liching, Annie Zhou, and students from Teacher Tao Shicheng’s bilingual class and Chinese speaking class performed the stories of the twelve zodiac signs vividly, humorously and lively.

ea90c38c7ee3218e00d7002c95ebc7a4c1cb2ab5.sourceText: 我们现代中文学校不仅为孩子们开设了各种不同的课程，也为家长们准备了绘画，合唱，舞蹈，摄影等多门课程，这不仅培养了家长们的兴趣爱好，也极大地丰富了大家的业余生活。家长和老师们为观众们奉献了一只这支热情奔放的新疆舞蹈《石榴裙》，他们美丽的服装，婀娜多姿的舞姿，整齐的阵容让全场响起了热烈的掌声，大家都为这组没有舞蹈基础却凭借着勤学苦练呈现美的妈妈们表示了敬意！ 以往听到《童年》这首歌总是感慨青葱的岁月带走了曾经属于我们的纯真的童年。而听了傅彤张慈惠老师改编的由二年级同学演唱的歌曲《童年》，大家一定会有不同的感受。这首歌唱出了许多在美国长大的孩子的心声。而其中的一些嗟叹还是源于我们的现代中文学校呢。
ea90c38c7ee3218e00d7002c95ebc7a4c1cb2ab5.translatedText: Our modern Chinese school not only offers a variety of courses for children, but also prepares painting, chorus, dance, photography and other courses for parents. This not only cultivates parents' interests and hobbies, but also greatly enriches everyone's spare time life. Parents and teachers presented a passionate Xinjiang dance "Pomegranate Skirt" to the audience. Their beautiful costumes, graceful dance postures, and neat lineup made the audience burst into warm applause. Everyone paid tribute to this group of mothers who had no dance background but showed beauty with their hard work and study! In the past, when I heard the song "Childhood", I always lamented that the green years have taken away the innocent childhood that once belonged to us. After listening to the song "Childhood" adapted by teacher Fu Tong and Zhang Cihui and sung by second grade students, everyone will have different feelings. This song speaks to the hearts of many children growing up in America. And some of these sighs still originate from our modern Chinese schools.

d1e6848b70ff5c21d0d0d950fe07ac55847def58.sourceText: 四位老师（高京京、万荣、杨梅、阳晓丹）也共同合作献上我们的节目—-表演唱《校园的早晨》，四十多个同学整齐着装、声音洪亮，每个人脸上都洋溢着青春的笑颜。亮点是站在最前排表演的小姑娘，穿着鲜艳夺目的花裙子，象真正的舞者在一片花团锦簇的草地中，看似一只只灵动娇小的蝴蝶在挥动着色彩斑斓的翅膀，那动人的舞姿，象在寻找美丽、寻找自由、寻找梦想！ 最后，同学们一起祝”现代中文学校，生日快乐！” 此时台下雷动的掌声，不单是对美的欣赏！力的喝彩！更是对同学们出色表演的赞叹！
d1e6848b70ff5c21d0d0d950fe07ac55847def58.translatedText: Four teachers (Gao Jingjing, Wan Rong, Yang Mei, and Yang Xiaodan) also collaborated to present our program - performing "Morning on Campus". More than 40 students were neatly dressed and had loud voices. Everyone's face was filled with youthful smiles. The highlight is the little girl performing in the front row, wearing a bright and eye-catching floral skirt, like a real dancer in a meadow full of flowers, looking like smart and petite butterflies waving their colorful wings. Her moving dance looks like she is looking for beauty, freedom, and dreams! Finally, the students wished "Happy Birthday, Modern Chinese School!" The thunderous applause from the audience was not just an appreciation of beauty! Big cheers! I also admire the outstanding performance of the students!

485d0b479e3ec6a46b42f0cd11b470f4cc8527db.sourceText: 武术伴随着中国历史与文明的发展，走过了几千年的风风雨雨，成为了中华民族安魂守魄的法宝。从小习武不仅可以强身健体，还可以修身养性，益处颇多。我们学校自开设武术课以来，一直有一支飒爽英姿的武术队伍。今天他们也来到了这个舞台，为大家展示站如松，坐如钟，行如风的中国武功。
485d0b479e3ec6a46b42f0cd11b470f4cc8527db.translatedText: Along with the development of Chinese history and civilization, martial arts have gone through thousands of years of ups and downs and become a magic weapon for the Chinese nation to protect their souls. Practicing martial arts since childhood can not only strengthen the body, but also cultivate one's moral character, which has many benefits. Since our school opened martial arts classes, we have always had a brave and heroic martial arts team. Today they also came to this stage to show everyone the Chinese martial arts of standing like a pine, sitting like a bell, and walking like the wind.

98c7086ebdf65ddaeea4b650b05ab332b7708344.sourceText: 带着依依不舍的情怀，带着对未来的憧憬和向往，我们毕业班的同学们就要告别现代中文学校了。十年寒窗，包含了他们及父母日复一日，年复一年的坚持和努力。临别的时候，他们一定有许多话要对学校，对老师及同学们讲。毕业班的同学都获得了奖学金和毕业证书。毕业班的李素慧老师施教有方，多才多艺，认真负责。每年毕业班的演出都能令人眼前一亮，为孩子们留下永久的回忆。今年的毕业班表演好像是个乐团，谭晓琳拉中提琴和张笑笑拉小提琴，许佳薇弹电子琴，张恩瀚吹法国号,何璐，张恩源，林丽君，James Hu唱歌，真是多才多艺。”给我自由，让我玩火。给我理由，让我飞上天。在让我成长，我会变坚强，我只要往前看充满希望，想着未来。” 这首毕业班学生自己填词并演唱的歌曲《往前看》 震撼了全场观众！
98c7086ebdf65ddaeea4b650b05ab332b7708344.translatedText: With reluctance and longing for the future, our graduating class is about to say goodbye to Modern Chinese School. The ten years of hardship include the persistence and hard work of them and their parents day after day, year after year. When parting, they must have a lot to say to the school, teachers and classmates. The graduating class received scholarships and diplomas. Teacher Li Suhui of the graduating class teaches well, is versatile, and is serious and responsible. The performances performed by the graduating class every year are eye-catching and leave lasting memories for the children. This year's graduating class performed like an orchestra, with Tan Xiaolin playing the viola and Zhang Xiaoxiao playing the violin, Xu Jiawei playing the electronic keyboard, Zhang Enhan playing the French horn, and He Lu, Zhang Enyuan, Lin Lijun, and James Hu singing. They were really versatile. "Give me freedom and let me play with fire. Give me a reason and let me fly into the sky. Let me grow and I will become stronger. I just need to look forward with hope and think about the future." This song "Look Forward" written and sung by the graduating students themselves shocked the audience!

7411d7f5cdaa885abff95f34506e9fab264caa84.sourceText: 学校极为重视中文教育和教学效果，一年一度的中文知识竞赛正是检验同学们成绩的最佳途径！王玉兰教学副校长为一等奖的26位同学颁发了奖杯， 并表彰了所有二等三等奖的同学。六位参加了2016第二届?#21326;舞杯?#33310;蹈大赛和两位文章被选送到中国周杂志的同学们也受到了王玉兰的表彰。
7411d7f5cdaa885abff95f34506e9fab264caa84.translatedText: The school attaches great importance to Chinese education and teaching effectiveness. The annual Chinese knowledge competition is the best way to test the students' performance! Vice President of Teaching Wang Yulan presented trophies to the 26 students who won the first prize, and commended all the students who won the second and third prizes. Six students who participated in the 2016 Second Dance Cup Dance Competition and two whose articles were selected to be sent to China Week magazine were also commended by Wang Yulan.

cb8a2a52576d491d3c5cd37fb7b24d84a952a8b8.sourceText: 近年来我们学校的学生会出色地组织了多项活动，真正成为了连接学校与学生的桥梁和纽带。三位学生会主席赵岩，Monet Tam, 程文婷代表学生会全体成员为大家介绍了今年学生会参加春节联欢、中国周、敬老院、学生乐队、高尔夫募捐赛所做出的努力和贡献！学生会辅导员陈斌不辞辛苦为学校做出了年鉴并为获得绘画比赛的学生们颁奖！她为学生会喝彩的演讲也激励了更多的学生准备加入学生会。 二十年我们风雨兼程，在异国的土地上生根、开花丶结果。回望走来的一串串脚印，我们骄傲，我们自豪！我们没有辱没我们的祖先留给我们的勤劳，勇敢和智慧。无论何时，无论身处何地，那块魂飞梦绕的土地永远是我们心中挥也挥不去的情怀和记忆。在庆典结束之前，我们学校成人合唱团，所有的老师，校委会董事会成员以及吕丽华，李淑祥，李明珉，纳思佳，王雪，王玉兰)，杨京生，唐南筠，朱岩老师们的中文学前班，三年级，八年级，九年级，十年级，Pre AP/SAT中文班，和AP/SAT中文班的同学们上台在学校乐队的伴奏下，在蔡老师的指挥下为大家演唱两首深情动听的歌曲《大海呀，故乡》和《同一首歌》，借以表达对故土的浓浓的思念和对美好未来的向往和憧憬。我们唱着同一首歌, 向着同一个目标, 携手同进! 祝愿我们的孩子茁壮成长!祝愿我们的学校蒸蒸日上!
cb8a2a52576d491d3c5cd37fb7b24d84a952a8b8.translatedText: In recent years, the student union of our school has excellently organized a number of activities, truly becoming a bridge and link between the school and students. Three student union presidents, Zhao Yan, Monet Tam, and Cheng Wenting, on behalf of all members of the student union, introduced the efforts and contributions made by the student union this year in participating in the Spring Festival Gala, China Week, nursing homes, student bands, and golf fundraisers! Chen Bin, counselor of the Student Union, worked tirelessly to create a yearbook for the school and presented awards to the students who won the painting competition! Her speech applauding the student union also inspired more students to prepare to join the student union. Over the past twenty years, we have gone through ups and downs, taking root, blooming and bearing fruit in a foreign land. Looking back at the series of footprints, we are proud, we are proud! We have not insulted the hard work, bravery and wisdom our ancestors left us. No matter when, no matter where we are, that piece of land that haunts our dreams will always be the feelings and memories in our hearts that cannot be shaken off. Before the celebration ended, our school's adult choir, all teachers, school committee board members and teachers Lu Lihua, Li Shuxiang, Li Mingmin, Na Sijia, Wang Xue, Wang Yulan), Yang Jingsheng, Tang Nanjun, Zhu Yan's Chinese preschool, third grade, eighth grade, ninth grade, tenth grade, Pre Students from the AP/SAT Chinese class and the AP/SAT Chinese class took the stage to sing two soulful and beautiful songs, "Ocean, Hometown" and "The Same Song", accompanied by the school band and under the command of Teacher Cai, to express their deep longing for their homeland and their longing and longing for a better future. We sing the same song, work towards the same goal, and work together! I wish our children will thrive! I wish our school will thrive!

1d0f151f8184918da6e7efd752b58571c7f55435.sourceText: 亚省艺术学院备战全美舞蹈大赛 名师助阵专项指导
1d0f151f8184918da6e7efd752b58571c7f55435.translatedText: The Art Institute of Alberta prepares for the National Dance Competition, and famous teachers provide special guidance

5325fa3a9663d810d1829ea84f183c1b61cce577.sourceText: 亚省艺术学院备战全美舞蹈大赛 名师助阵专项指导 在刚刚结束的2016–2017海外桃李杯国际舞蹈…
5325fa3a9663d810d1829ea84f183c1b61cce577.translatedText: The Art Institute of Alberta prepares for the National Dance Competition, and famous teachers provide special guidance. In the just-concluded 2016–2017 Overseas Taoli Cup International Dance...

c7cf372963094762745bc41af52ec090dc03ee45.sourceText: 在刚刚结束的 2016–2017 海外桃李杯国际舞蹈大赛中，亚省艺术学院彭天悦同学一举夺得大赛最高奖项白金奖。这标志了亚省艺术学院中国舞水平在全美前列。 为了同学们有更多的机会提升和学习，亚省艺术学院特聘请了曾任海外桃李杯纽约赛区评委陈薇老师光临指导。她将针对舞蹈的艺术表现形式，技术要点，比赛流程等做专项辅导。让基础扎实的学生，在比赛中获得优异成绩 。
c7cf372963094762745bc41af52ec090dc03ee45.translatedText: In the just-concluded 2016–2017 In the Overseas Taoli Cup International Dance Competition, Peng Tianyue, a student from the Art College of Alberta, won the Platinum Award, the highest award in the competition. This marks that the level of Chinese dance at the Alberta School of the Arts is among the best in the United States. In order for students to have more opportunities to improve and learn, the Art Institute of Alberta specially hired Chen Wei, a former judge of the New York competition of the Overseas Peach and Plum Cup, to provide guidance. She will provide special guidance on the artistic expression of dance, technical points, competition procedures, etc. Let students with a solid foundation achieve excellent results in competitions.

e0bcc7eba3e4c06e320c5fae78bb9c9d0f585c4e.sourceText: 今年亚省艺术学院许多不同年龄段的独舞，组舞，群舞等同学都在备战下届比赛，想将自己的舞艺提升一个新的高度 。
e0bcc7eba3e4c06e320c5fae78bb9c9d0f585c4e.translatedText: This year, many solo dancers, group dancers, group dancers and other students of different ages at the Art Institute of Alberta are preparing for the next competition and want to take their dance skills to a new level.

9231e925b2945dea6b44e363879ed4eee8c7789a.sourceText: 比赛是让一个舞者梦想成真的踏板，结果固然重要，但最重要的是使参加比赛的同学得到一个学习的过程、人生的经历、锻炼的机会和奋斗的目标 。
9231e925b2945dea6b44e363879ed4eee8c7789a.translatedText: The competition is the stepping stone for a dancer's dream to come true. The results are important, but the most important thing is that the students participating in the competition get a learning process, life experience, exercise opportunities and goals to strive for.

bdd46e77d433fd0863262cc61e02b7f30ee446d9.sourceText: 有意选择独舞，小组舞的同学请和你们的班级任课老师或邱老师联系，在老师的建议和指导下选择节目并安排上小课时间（由于目前小课很多，请家长提前和老师，学校安排上课时间）。我们先由本校老师教动作和排节目，陈薇老师来了以后会个别指导 。
bdd46e77d433fd0863262cc61e02b7f30ee446d9.translatedText: If you are interested in choosing solo dance or group dance, please contact your class teacher or Teacher Qiu. Under the teacher's advice and guidance, you can choose the program and arrange the time for small classes (since there are currently many small classes, parents are asked to arrange class time with the teacher and the school in advance). We will first be taught movements and routines by teachers from our school. Teacher Chen Wei will provide individual guidance when she comes.

81e758138affff6a1ebc704510acc96bf17e5220.sourceText: 有很多同学不完全是为了比赛，只是希望提高技术，加强舞蹈基本功训练，和准备独舞，小组舞。请大家尽快找老师选定节目，以便学校统一安排时间 。
81e758138affff6a1ebc704510acc96bf17e5220.translatedText: There are many students who do not do it entirely for the competition, but just hope to improve their skills, strengthen basic dance training, and prepare for solo and group dances. Please ask your teacher to select the program as soon as possible so that the school can arrange the time in a unified manner.

e9c45b6f815a176350e2f5c1198e8a1231ce7f20.sourceText: 陈薇老师毕业于北京舞蹈学院，主修中国古典舞，民族舞。 2001 年在美国弗吉尼亚州的雪兰多大学继续深造，获得了现代舞，爵士舞和编舞的硕士学位。陈薇老师曾在中国大陆，台湾，香港，美国专门从事专业舞蹈教学，接受过数次最佳导师的荣誉，在美国电视台的舞蹈比赛中获得优秀舞蹈教师称号。陈薇老师的学生们多次在国际舞蹈比赛中荣获最高奖项。
e9c45b6f815a176350e2f5c1198e8a1231ce7f20.translatedText: Teacher Chen Wei graduated from Beijing Dance Academy, majoring in Chinese classical dance and folk dance. In 2001, he continued his studies at Shenandoah University in Virginia, USA, and received a master's degree in modern dance, jazz dance and choreography. Teacher Chen Wei has specialized in professional dance teaching in mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and the United States. She has received the honor of being the best instructor several times and won the title of outstanding dance teacher in a dance competition on American television. Teacher Chen Wei’s students have won the highest awards in international dance competitions many times.

ae869e046ddb0d12ed54a9becf532fb3806de743.sourceText: 陈薇老师中美丰富的教学经验和海外桃李杯舞蹈大赛评委的资格，相信一定能为我们的同学们带来一个新的飞跃 。
ae869e046ddb0d12ed54a9becf532fb3806de743.translatedText: Teacher Chen Wei’s rich teaching experience in China and the United States and her qualifications as a judge of the Overseas Taoli Cup Dance Competition, I believe she will definitely bring a new leap forward for our students.

79413262a8026d72562d7ac86989d4c6a1e04489.sourceText: 纽约美国中文电视台评为最佳优秀舞蹈老师奖，陈薇（左）和中国驻美大使馆文化参赞李立言（右）合影
79413262a8026d72562d7ac86989d4c6a1e04489.translatedText: New York American Chinese TV station named the Best Dance Teacher Award, Chen Wei (left) and Li Liyan (right), cultural counselor of the Chinese Embassy in the United States, took a photo

fbb4bd0a76cc91e0cdf1fc1526d538c969b7d417.sourceText: 亚利桑那三所大学研究生院入选全美最佳研究生院名单 （本网讯）三所亚利桑那学校入选了由美国新闻以及世界报道评选的最佳研究生院。亚利桑那州立大学的W.P凯利商学院（The W.P. Carey School of Business at Arizona State University ），亚利桑那大学的尔利尔管理学院（ University of Arizona抯 Eller College of Management ）分别获得全职MBA项目的第30名和第44名。雷鸟国际管理学院排名第88.（The Thunderbird School of Global Management in Glendale） 该排名主要衡量了招收对象的选择性，专家对项目质量的观点以及工作的统计数据。 亚利桑那州立大学与亚利桑那大学还分别获得美国新闻和世界报道最佳发学院和工程学院的排名。 亚利桑那州立大学的桑德拉康纳学院（The Sandra Day O’onnor College of Law ），顶级 法学院中排名第29，亚利桑那大学的詹姆斯稥.罗杰斯大学（The James E. Rogers College of Law ）获得法学院排名第38。 亚利桑那州立大学的艾拉答富尔顿工程学院（ The Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering ）位于工程类第44名，亚利桑那大学工程学院（ UA’ College of Engineering ）排名第48。
fbb4bd0a76cc91e0cdf1fc1526d538c969b7d417.translatedText: Three Arizona university graduate schools have been named to the list of the best graduate schools in the United States (News from this website) Three Arizona schools have been selected as the best graduate schools by U.S. News and World Report. The W.P. Carey School of Business at Arizona State University and the University of Arizona's Eller College of Management ranked 30th and 44th respectively among full-time MBA programs. The Thunderbird School of Global Management in Glendale is ranked No. 88. The ranking primarily measures the selectivity of admissions, expert opinions on program quality, and job statistics. Arizona State University and the University of Arizona were also ranked among the best hair and engineering schools by U.S. News and World Report. The Sandra Day O’onnor College of Law at Arizona State University was ranked 29th among the top law schools, and The James E. Rogers College of Law at the University of Arizona was ranked 38th among the top law schools. The Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering at Arizona State University is ranked 44th in the engineering category, and the UA’ College of Engineering is ranked 48th.

397a777aa132725472d7d06f5e20e556cfadad93.sourceText: 奥巴马赢了美国 输了亚省
397a777aa132725472d7d06f5e20e556cfadad93.translatedText: Obama won the United States but lost in Alberta

9bd046c32ba707def003fc9023aefc5b75a2eb3e.sourceText: 奥巴马赢了美国 输了亚省 （亚省时报） 周二投票中，虽然奥巴马多了罗姆尼300万选票，最终以303张选举…
9bd046c32ba707def003fc9023aefc5b75a2eb3e.translatedText: Obama won the United States but lost in Alberta (Alberta Times) In the Tuesday vote, although Obama had 3 million more votes than Romney, the final election was 303...

b1169ef4657e2d0b56ca103db6073e05bf19e9ba.sourceText: 奥巴马赢了美国 输了亚省 （亚省时报） 周二投票中，虽然奥巴马多了罗姆尼300万选票，最终以303张选举人票获得连任，但在亚利桑那州，罗姆尼则赢奥巴马12%。 周二之前，亚利桑那州一度被认为摇摆州，选民对民主党和共和党举棋不定，但偏向共和党。投票结果表明，共和党数十年在本州的影响力不容忽视，罗姆尼得票874918张，奥巴马得票682925张。
b1169ef4657e2d0b56ca103db6073e05bf19e9ba.translatedText: Obama won the United States but lost in Alberta (Alberta Times) In Tuesday's voting, although Obama received 3 million more votes than Romney and was ultimately re-elected with 303 electoral votes, in Arizona, Romney beat Obama by 12%. Before Tuesday, Arizona was once considered a swing state, with voters undecided between Democrats and Republicans but leaning Republican. The voting results showed that the Republican Party's influence in the state for decades cannot be ignored. Romney received 874,918 votes and Obama received 682,925 votes.

3594e06d700b8d784b2a725befb0e320f36d681a.sourceText: 两名青少年因涉嫌谋杀亚利桑那州立大学亚裔教授被起诉
3594e06d700b8d784b2a725befb0e320f36d681a.translatedText: Two teenagers were indicted on suspicion of murdering an Asian professor at Arizona State University

68e1fe1e07d32ad5e9104f300db39b2cc3287e79.sourceText: ​Junseok Chae于3月25日被报告失踪，其遗骸于7月17日在亚利桑那州一处垃圾填埋场被发现 援引自马…
68e1fe1e07d32ad5e9104f300db39b2cc3287e79.translatedText: Junseok Chae was reported missing on March 25, and his remains were found in an Arizona landfill on July 17. Quoted from Ma...

b02ad516761ee0dc477d91c17fc1a41249261938.sourceText: ​Junseok Chae于3月25日被报告失踪，其遗骸于7月17日在亚利桑那州一处垃圾填埋场被发现
b02ad516761ee0dc477d91c17fc1a41249261938.translatedText: Junseok Chae was reported missing on March 25, and his remains were found in an Arizona landfill on July 17

9f141d13d256a86c7079615b17dd71ca21538a8f.sourceText: 援引自马里科帕县警长办公室消息，两名青少年被指控涉嫌谋杀于三月份失踪的亚利桑那州立大学教授Junseok Chae。
9f141d13d256a86c7079615b17dd71ca21538a8f.translatedText: Citing news from the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office, two teenagers have been charged with the murder of Arizona State University professor Junseok Chae, who disappeared in March.

56d31ee2a7cd320a66884937556350e111f3973d.sourceText: 县警长办公室在一次声明中称，副院长兼工程学教授Junseok Chae于3月25日下班后并未回家而被报告失踪。
56d31ee2a7cd320a66884937556350e111f3973d.translatedText: Vice dean and engineering professor Junseok Chae was reported missing after he did not return home after get off work on March 25, the county Sheriff's Office said in a statement.

7bb8a67fc94e25fe31e6ff9ec6eb397008bcaaec.sourceText: Gabrielle Austin，左，Javian Ezell，右，将面临谋杀指控
7bb8a67fc94e25fe31e6ff9ec6eb397008bcaaec.translatedText: >Gabrielle Austin, left, and Javian Ezell, right, will face murder charges

1a2848fee7019b9b52a0e270f601b92bf584b533.sourceText: 路易安纳州什里夫波特县警察在收到关于可疑车辆的报案后出警，并遇到了本案嫌疑人，现年18岁的Javian Ezell和Gabrielle Austin二人，随后案件告破。与嫌疑人一起的第三个人的身份尚未可知。
1a2848fee7019b9b52a0e270f601b92bf584b533.translatedText: Shreveport County, Louisiana, police responded after receiving a report about a suspicious vehicle and encountered the suspects in the case, 18-year-old Javian Ezell and Gabrielle Austin, and the case was solved. The identity of a third person with the suspect has not yet been revealed.

9d7c31e5cd7dd5942d6fb664004af4b286d33ce0.sourceText: 警方已确认该车辆属于被害人Chae教授，并根据已获悉证词警方推断Chae教授已经遇害。
9d7c31e5cd7dd5942d6fb664004af4b286d33ce0.translatedText: The police have confirmed that the vehicle belongs to the victim, Professor Chae, and based on the testimony they have received, they infer that Professor Chae has been killed.

20ffd57395efd6baa5c7cf8b96fc5be6f7add800.sourceText: 什里夫波特警方于3月30号与我县警长办公室取得联系。
20ffd57395efd6baa5c7cf8b96fc5be6f7add800.translatedText: > Shreveport Police contacted our County Sheriff’s Office on March 30.

27a33ec7b59985b718d8f41a75cab8fda4688e24.sourceText: 据声明称， 经进一步调查，警方确定Chae在凤凰城北的某十字路口处遇害，警方在搜索该地区时发现了几件证据。教授的遗体被抛弃在一处垃圾箱中，随后意外被带到了位于瑟普赖斯市的亚利桑那西北地区垃圾填埋场。
27a33ec7b59985b718d8f41a75cab8fda4688e24.translatedText: According to the statement, after further investigation, police determined that Chae was killed at an intersection in north Phoenix, and police found several pieces of evidence while searching the area. The professor's body was dumped in a dumpster and accidentally taken to the Northwest Arizona Regional Landfill in Surprise.

428eadb7013285075416731259567cd6d54b47e1.sourceText: 在州国民警卫队，垃圾管理部门，和建筑公司提供的重型设备帮助下，县警长办公室于5月11日至7月17日对该填埋场进行了搜索，并找到了随后被确认属于Chae的人类遗骸及其他相关证据。
428eadb7013285075416731259567cd6d54b47e1.translatedText: With the help of heavy equipment provided by the State National Guard, Waste Management, and construction companies, the County Sheriff’s Office searched the landfill from May 11 to July 17 and located human remains later identified as belonging to Chae and other related evidence.

d8b62d17335e993f192eddc4e045046e2c269db7.sourceText: 近日，Ezell和Austin已被引渡至亚利桑那州，并于7月15日被捕，两名嫌疑人将被指控一级谋杀，持械抢劫和盗窃交通工具。
d8b62d17335e993f192eddc4e045046e2c269db7.translatedText: Recently, Ezell and Austin have been extradited to Arizona and were arrested on July 15. The two suspects will be charged with first-degree murder, armed robbery and theft of transportation.

a3a43324530548af26fb5e99cb807205314d62bc.sourceText: 据称，两名嫌疑人单人的保释金为100万美元。CNN正试图确认两名嫌疑人的律师。根据监狱记录，Ezell和Austin将于9月3日被传讯。
a3a43324530548af26fb5e99cb807205314d62bc.translatedText: It is said that the bail for each of the two suspects is US$1 million. CNN is trying to identify attorneys for both suspects. Ezell and Austin will be arraigned on Sept. 3, according to jail records.

ed3739c8adb2bd96ec2acf61f14a0bf9cd235af8.sourceText: 据亚利桑那州立大学介绍, Chae在首尔的高丽大学取得其学士学位，之后在密歇根大学安娜堡分校获得了电子工程与计算机科学的硕士及博士学位，随后于2005年开始在亚利桑那州立大学任教。
ed3739c8adb2bd96ec2acf61f14a0bf9cd235af8.translatedText: According to Arizona State University, Chae obtained his bachelor's degree from Korea University in Seoul, and then obtained his master's and doctoral degrees in electrical engineering and computer science from the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, and then began teaching at Arizona State University in 2005.

4469a58ca5f30de4b039352c6c3fd92468fd7cba.translatedText: Pearl of the Desert | Chinese History in Arizona, USA (39) Chapter 4: The History of Four Chinese Families
