a726e5ed4b1193a2dc2f63e94b4a3a88351f1f43.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association: Zhang Zhaohong 2. Guan Chongqiong Family (1) The history of the Guan Chongqiong Family can be preserved to a large extent because of this family...

f663190833cf688a7c4f70254f9babd96b3f9f86.sourceText: 关崇琼家族的历史能够保存下来，很大的程度是这个家族对国家有贡献，对祖国有贡献，对华人社会有贡献。
f663190833cf688a7c4f70254f9babd96b3f9f86.translatedText: > The history of the Guan Chongqiong family can be preserved to a large extent because this family has contributed to the country, the motherland, and the Chinese society.

86621dc2e0cd4c900c3e3dd11ab75da22fabf6c6.sourceText: 关崇琼(1893-1981)，广东开平赤坎田心村人，享年88岁。关崇琼太太李女好（1891-1975 ），广东开平田心村人，享年84岁。在他们的一生中，共育有十一个儿女。
86621dc2e0cd4c900c3e3dd11ab75da22fabf6c6.translatedText: > Guan Chongqiong (1893-1981), a native of Tianxin Village, Chikan, Kaiping, Guangdong, died at the age of 88. Guan Chongqiong’s wife Li Nuhao (1891-1975), a native of Tianxin Village, Kaiping, Guangdong, died at the age of 84. During their lifetime, they had a total of eleven children.

0e6fe83f3186446c7aaec2d017233d3fe0a3a5de.sourceText: 在未编写关崇琼家族历史之前，虽然这个家族在上世纪二十年代至七十年代，在华人社区中享有很高的知名度，但半个世纪过去之后，已经渐渐被人遗忘。
0e6fe83f3186446c7aaec2d017233d3fe0a3a5de.translatedText: Before the history of Guan Chongqiong’s family was written, although the family enjoyed a high reputation in the Chinese community from the 1920s to the 1970s, half a century later, it had been gradually forgotten.

f0c145e6f8a7b10a2fbfad345484ba9b1bf8edbe.sourceText: 关崇琼前辈在1981年去世后，在凤凰城侨联发行的电话薄上，能看到他惟一的一张黑白相片，写着：凤凰城华人侨团联合总会创会主席，没有其他更多的讯息。凤凰城侨联创立于1968年。
f0c145e6f8a7b10a2fbfad345484ba9b1bf8edbe.translatedText: After the death of senior Guan Chongqiong in 1981, his only black and white photo can be seen in the phone book issued by the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation, which reads: Founding Chairman of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation, and there is no other more information. The Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation was founded in 1968.

bd742049bd0665999d456a5c6c878047e370d0dc.sourceText: 上世纪九十年代，作者加入由刘、关、张，赵四姓组成的“龍岡”宗親团体。那时知道了关崇琼前辈是凤凰城龍岡组织创办人和首任主席，看到留的下一张集体照，但没有其他更多的讯息。
bd742049bd0665999d456a5c6c878047e370d0dc.translatedText: In the 1990s, the author joined the "Longgang" clan group consisting of Liu, Guan, Zhang and Zhao. At that time, I learned that senior Guan Chongqiong was the founder and first chairman of the Phoenix Longgang Organization. I saw the next group photo left, but there was no other information.

9599ee864ffbe26c5e7951012c6e985eb643b28f.sourceText: 此后，在积累凤凰城华人的历史时，关崇琼家族的资料越来越多，也越来越觉得有代表性，所以从编写《沙漠明珠》第一集开始，就写上了关崇琼家族的故事。
9599ee864ffbe26c5e7951012c6e985eb643b28f.translatedText: Since then, when accumulating the history of Chinese people in Phoenix City, more and more information about the Guan Chongqiong family has become more and more representative, so starting from the first episode of "Desert Pearl", the story of the Guan Chongqiong family has been written.

30411612dbf97b2aec442abb28480d73f6491bd3.sourceText: 近年来，由于不断的探访，作者得到了关家的信任，他们把很多原件、资料和相片让我参阅，使我能较系统地写下这个著名家族的原创故事。
30411612dbf97b2aec442abb28480d73f6491bd3.translatedText: In recent years, due to constant visits, the author has gained the trust of the Guan family. They have provided me with many original documents, information and photos, so that I can write down the original story of this famous family in a more systematic way.

f202a68a5716bcd5eac0e8b65012c34dab61b42a.sourceText: 在亚利桑那州的华裔家庭中，只有关崇琼父子参加过第一次世界大战和第二次世界大战，並且都立过军功。
f202a68a5716bcd5eac0e8b65012c34dab61b42a.translatedText: Among the Chinese families in Arizona, only Guan Chongqiong and his son participated in World War I and World War II, and both of them had military merit.

e411aea598f19852f5ad0def989edbde1ed5eef5.sourceText: 关崇琼参加第一次世界大战，并在战争中负伤，荣获“紫心勋章”。
e411aea598f19852f5ad0def989edbde1ed5eef5.translatedText: Guan Chongqiong participated in World War I and was wounded during the war, and was awarded the "Purple Heart Medal".

0e1df161f3f36c074a268cbd4e87085c60bf8925.sourceText: 关家的两个儿子参加第二次世界大战，回到中国参加抗战。大儿子关卫理后来官拜中校，是亚利桑那州华裔军人军阶最高的保持者。三儿子关护理是飞虎队成员，属于当年美军司令部的特种兵。
0e1df161f3f36c074a268cbd4e87085c60bf8925.translatedText: The two sons of the Guan family participated in the Second World War and returned to China to participate in the Anti-Japanese War. The eldest son, William Kwan, later became a lieutenant colonel and became the highest-ranking holder of the Chinese-American military rank in Arizona. The third son, Guan Guannuo, was a member of the Flying Tigers, a special forces unit of the US military headquarters.

45a5a96b78f1e17aebc77227592e8cd1c45ff55d.sourceText: 关崇琼被选入亚利桑那退伍军人《名人堂》，本州只有三位华裔军人有此荣誉。
45a5a96b78f1e17aebc77227592e8cd1c45ff55d.translatedText: Guan Chongqiong was elected to the Arizona Veterans Hall of Fame. Only three Chinese-American soldiers in the state have this honor.

f72f1103dc929a6e1adb93cde7a3ac4c7395d712.sourceText: 这个家族为抗战出钱出力，照顾来美训练的中国空军战士，结下了深厚的情谊。
f72f1103dc929a6e1adb93cde7a3ac4c7395d712.translatedText: This family contributed money and effort to the Anti-Japanese War, took care of the Chinese Air Force soldiers who came to the United States for training, and formed a deep friendship.

2615cabc6bfba6a850fd25dcbff4727d0c43d14b.sourceText: 这个家族无论在地产、商铺、餐馆业方面经营有方，成为华人商界创业的成功典范。
2615cabc6bfba6a850fd25dcbff4727d0c43d14b.translatedText: This family is well-run in real estate, shops, and restaurants, and has become a successful example of Chinese business entrepreneurship.

978beecfc8db242eaf4359d147e08d9b731e0945.sourceText: 这个家族热心公益，在主流社会和华人社区有过积极的贡献，建树良多。
978beecfc8db242eaf4359d147e08d9b731e0945.translatedText: This family is enthusiastic about public welfare, has made positive contributions to mainstream society and the Chinese community, and has made many achievements.

22d7cdc0a37d4b0fe642d468dc702aa0aa64de4c.sourceText: 关崇琼家居物业（D. H. Toy Residence）已被列入国家史迹名录。
22d7cdc0a37d4b0fe642d468dc702aa0aa64de4c.translatedText: The D. H. Toy Residence is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

4a021a69e408064a77117fe4f7c3137b14c4324f.sourceText: 2016年，美洲龙岡在凤凰城召开第十六届恳親大会，得到关氏家族的大力支持，赞助一万美金给筹委会。大会期间，作为凤凰城龙岡的创始人，关崇琼夫妇的照片被放置在大堂中，被四姓宗亲所尊敬。有百多年历史的《龙岡季刊》，连续三年全页刊登这幅相片。
4a021a69e408064a77117fe4f7c3137b14c4324f.translatedText: In 2016, Longgang America held the 16th Kiss Conference in Phoenix. It received strong support from the Guan family and sponsored US$10,000 to the organizing committee. During the conference, as the founders of Phoenix Longgang, the photos of Guan Chongqiong and his wife were placed in the lobby and were respected by the four surnamed clan members. "Longgang Quarterly", which has a history of more than 100 years, has published this photo on its full page for three consecutive years.

89925e66dc20d5282757e8bd5448f001a512e251.sourceText: 还有重要的一点，是关氏家族善于保存资料，关崇琼从移民美国开始，就保留有入境证明，退伍文件，回美证件，甚至百年前的汽车保险等等。在这次的归档编写中，作者把这些未曾发表过的关家族谱，资料，文件，相片等重新整理，为这个具有代表性的家庭，留下更多的历史记录。
89925e66dc20d5282757e8bd5448f001a512e251.translatedText: Another important point is that the Guan family is good at preserving information. Since Guan Chongqiong immigrated to the United States, he has kept entry certificates, discharge documents, return documents, and even car insurance from a hundred years ago, etc. In this archiving process, the author reorganized these unpublished family genealogies, materials, documents, photos, etc., to leave more historical records for this representative family.

39676359d4d0983abc4a5944c31c02e285175183.sourceText: 在多次採访的过程中，我深深地感到这个家族的平凡和伟大，在不断在採访中写作，又在不断写作中再採访，随着资料的增加而不断的增修，可以说，关崇琼家族是本地华人百多年来的典范，也是编者所能够搜集到最多史料的家族之一。
39676359d4d0983abc4a5944c31c02e285175183.translatedText: In the process of many interviews, I deeply felt the ordinaryness and greatness of this family. I continued to write during interviews, and continued to interview while writing, and continued to revise with the increase of data. It can be said that the Guan Chongqiong family has been a model for local Chinese for more than a hundred years, and it is also one of the families that the editor has been able to collect the most historical materials.

d455e625753bb761e6991446fdde84b88e0e9dfd.sourceText: 我们将分期发表资料，让大家更了解这个亚利桑那州著名的华人家族。（待续）
d455e625753bb761e6991446fdde84b88e0e9dfd.translatedText: We will publish information in installments to let everyone know more about this famous Chinese family in Arizona. (to be continued)

13e5b9707f39edc28f14b383b23f2f87a8d453ef.sourceText: “情暖重阳儿歌稿”–重阳节儿歌（四首） 孤阿婆的节日 妈妈买来新衣裳， 爸爸买来重阳糕。 我用自己零花钱， 买来串串紫葡萄。 送给隔壁孤阿婆， 祝她重阳佳节好！ 阿婆收下咱礼物， 张开嘴巴哈哈笑。 过路客人见了夸：?#30631;这一家懂敬老！?U> 重阳节 金菊花，香味飘， 重阳佳节来到了。 想陪爷爷去登高， 爸爸伴他上山了。 想去做些重阳糕， 妈妈早已做好了。 只好等待爷爷回， 伴他一起把话唠。 赏菊花 九九重阳节， 菊花朵朵开。 我扶老奶奶， 公园看花来。 一路菊花笑， 夸我真乖乖！ 摇呀摇 摇呀摇，摇呀摇， 小船摇到外婆桥。 外婆桥上看到了， 欢迎外甥乖宝宝。 我送外婆重阳糕， 还有苹果和香蕉。 今天正是重阳节， 我祝外婆节日好！ 作者简介： 梁临芳，当过农民、教师，现为基层文化干部。中国寓言文学研究会理事、浙江省作家协会会员、浙江省民间文艺家协会会员、浙江省音协音乐文学学会会员、黄岩区民间文艺家协会副主席。在全国各地报刊发表了3400多篇（首）文艺作品，其中350多篇作品入选各种书籍，180多篇作品在全国各地举办的征文或比赛中获奖。曾获浙江省”向灰色童谣说不”新童谣大赛一等奖、中央人民广播电台全国”每周一歌”征集评选银奖；全国校园歌曲选拔赛二等奖；全国第二届优秀童谣评选二等奖；第三、五届中国寓言文学”金骆驼奖”、第五、十届”金江寓言文学奖”、第七届中国少年儿童歌曲卡拉OK电视大赛银奖、第八届”奥运之春”中国民族民间歌曲金奖。著有寓言集《驴子送礼》、《小白兔画骆驼》；哲理诗集《凤毛麟角集》；儿歌集《小河马学拼音》、《快乐的小蘑菇》等。
13e5b9707f39edc28f14b383b23f2f87a8d453ef.translatedText: "Warm and Loved Double Ninth Festival Children's Rhymes" - Double Ninth Festival Children's Songs (Four) The festival for the lonely grandma. Mom bought new clothes, and dad bought Double Ninth Festival cakes. I used my pocket money to buy bunches of purple grapes. Give it to the lonely grandma next door and wish her a happy Double Ninth Festival! Grandma accepted our gift, opened her mouth and laughed. The passers-by praised them: "This family knows how to respect the elderly!" ?U> Double Ninth Festival Golden chrysanthemums, fragrant, the Double Ninth Festival is here. I wanted to accompany my grandfather to climb a mountain, but my father accompanied him up the mountain. I want to make some Double Ninth Festival cakes, but my mother has already made them. I had no choice but to wait for grandpa to return and chat with him. Appreciating chrysanthemums On the Double Ninth Festival, chrysanthemums are in bloom. I helped the old lady come to the park to see the flowers. Smiling like a chrysanthemum all the way, praising me for being such a good boy! Rocking and rocking, rocking and rocking, the boat rocked to Grandma's Bridge. Grandma saw it on the bridge and welcomed my nephew's good baby. I gave grandma Double Ninth Festival cakes, apples and bananas. Today is the Double Ninth Festival. I wish grandma a happy holiday! About the author: Liang Linfang, once a farmer and teacher, is now a grassroots cultural cadre. Director of the Chinese Fable Literature Research Association, member of the Zhejiang Provincial Writers Association, member of the Zhejiang Provincial Folk Writers Association, member of the Zhejiang Provincial Music Association Music and Literature Society, and vice chairman of the Huangyan District Folk Writers Association. He has published more than 3,400 (first) literary and artistic works in newspapers and periodicals across the country, of which more than 350 works have been selected into various books, and more than 180 works have won awards in essay contests or competitions held across the country. He has won the first prize in Zhejiang Province's "Say No to Gray Nursery Rhymes" New Nursery Rhyme Competition, the silver medal in the National "Song of the Week" competition by China National Radio, the second prize in the National School Song Selection, the second prize in the Second National Excellent Nursery Rhyme Selection, the third and fifth Chinese Fable Literature "Golden Camel Awards", the fifth and tenth "Jinjiang Fable Literature Awards", the seventh China Youth and Children's Song Karaoke TV Competition Silver Award, and the eighth "Olympic Spring" Chinese National Folk Song Gold Award. He is the author of a collection of fables such as "Donkey Giving Gifts" and "Little White Rabbit Drawing a Camel"; a collection of philosophical poems "Collection of Phoenixes and Raiders"; and a collection of children's songs such as "Little Hippo Learns Pinyin" and "Happy Little Mushroom".

1714baec63902b062ef6ae581de4d3017d2a8846.sourceText: 墨子－让人怦然心动的高贵名字
1714baec63902b062ef6ae581de4d3017d2a8846.translatedText: Mozi - a noble name that makes people's hearts beat

9101fd529de8296cd3e64b95d800a3efc0c46cc9.sourceText: 墨子－让人怦然心动的高贵名字 斐鳯鸣 伟大并不一定成功，在多难的民族历史上，往往伟大一定是不成功。三千年前…
9101fd529de8296cd3e64b95d800a3efc0c46cc9.translatedText: Mozi - a noble name that makes people's hearts beat Fei Minming Greatness does not necessarily mean success. In the troubled history of a nation, greatness often means failure. Three thousand years ago...

0bcbe6a445a82b8f45e0665752a0885410c26fe2.sourceText: 墨子－让人怦然心动的高贵名字 斐鳯鸣 伟大并不一定成功，在多难的民族历史上，往往伟大一定是不成功。三千年前有一个名字，让我们今天面对他感到惭愧，他不是一个成功的名字，但在中华历史文化中占着绝对伟大的位置，他叫墨子。 依照孟子的说法，墨子秀头，由于经常走路后脚跟是跛一跛的。庄子则说得更详细，墨子腿上没有毛，也没有肉，也就是骨瘦如柴。由这些描述，后人怀疑墨子是印度人，特别是墨子的姓名是墨翟，音与”貊狄”同。对于一个黑色的外国人当然就是印度人。而且墨子的兼爱思想很有佛家的影子，其实墨子学说不太像佛教，而像印度本土的婆罗门教，由此推理认定墨子是印度人。这些的讲法与猜测都过于武断与简单。 墨子的颜色，是属于中国的纯粹的黑色，墨子哲学就是一种高贵的黑色哲学，而这个让我们今天感到陌生的黑色，用它大气的衬托出三千年前诸子百家其他颜色的鲜明，使中华文化整个色板更有定力与活力。 墨子白天别人当他是乞丐，晚上别人睡了他还在走。为了民间公义，就那么质朴而笃定地奔走在社会底层，他的这种黑夜行走，看上去很孤独，其实他一直拥有一个与他言行相依的团队，组合成一种正义的集体力量，这样一个人，真是值得每个中国人怀念。 这样的形像，非常容易在武侠章回小说中看到，无论在三国演义中关云长千里走单骑，护嫂寻主，或在宋朝水浒传中都比比皆是。 近年风靡华人世界金庸的小说天龙八部中的乔峯及鹿鼎记中的天地会盟主陈近南都体现了墨子”侠”的精神。 墨子是一个侠客，他对”义”的追求就是后来侠客精神的重要来源。 虽然今天大家对武侠小说的评价认定是小说，这是有久公平的讲法。至少在金庸的故事中，可以看到历史文化的轨迹。喜欢武侠小说的读者，应该喜欢读一读墨家学派中故事，特别有关”巨子”的传言，其实具有深层文化的底蕴。”巨子”是墨家学派的领导者，”巨子”享有足够的权威，甚至掌控了团员的生杀大权，这是墨家与其它学派最大的区别。 从”巨子”的权力来透析墨家，某种意义上很类似一个教团，具有宗教性，但墨家不信奉某个特定的神灵，所以不能说它是完全的宗教组织。墨家信徒通过”巨子”制度形成非常严密的组织，有着共同的道德伦理，价值观以及信仰。 墨家在”巨子”制度下追求一种彻底清教徒式的思想和行为方法。因讲求”非乐”，所以不要音乐，讲”节葬”，连父母的丧礼也很苛刻，这些思想与行为并不适应中国传统的社会形态。 儒家与墨家比较起来，就显得”中庸”也较有回旋的余地。 在”商鞅变法”电视连续剧中，可以看到三千年前墨家”巨子”绝对权力的形象，好像也只有这一部电视剧做深度叙述墨家的内幕。 解读墨家有太多大儒，学者与专家的看法，但用最基层的语言与墨子神交应更符合它的本意，没有一丝轻视的意思。反而金庸大师的历史武侠小说，本来就够份量代表现代文学。 最后对墨家的衰微其主因也在”巨子”制度的绝对权力，有权力就必有争夺。但更重要的原因应是墨家找不到足以维系团队生存需要的经济基础。墨家退出了历史主角，但这并不影响它的伟大，就连促使它加速衰微的那些因素，也包含着让人怦然心动的高贵。墨家虽然没有成功的独占历史全页，但它是伟大的。
0bcbe6a445a82b8f45e0665752a0885410c26fe2.translatedText: Mozi - a noble name that makes people's hearts beat. Fei Minming Greatness does not necessarily mean success. In the troubled national history, greatness often means failure. There was a name three thousand years ago that makes us feel ashamed to face him today. He is not a successful name, but he occupies an absolutely great position in Chinese history and culture. His name is Mozi. According to Mencius, Mozi's appearance was because he often walked with a limp in his heels. Zhuangzi said in more detail that Mozi had no hair or flesh on his legs, which meant he was as skinny as a stick. Based on these descriptions, later generations suspected that Mozi was an Indian, especially since Mozi's name was Mo Zhai, which sounds the same as "Qidi". For a black foreigner of course it is an Indian. Furthermore, Mozi's thought of universal love has a strong resemblance to Buddhism. In fact, Mozi's theory is less like Buddhism and more like Brahmanism in India. From this, we can infer that Mozi is an Indian. These statements and speculations are too arbitrary and simple. The color of Mozi is pure black that belongs to China. Mozi's philosophy is a noble black philosophy, and this black that seems strange to us today uses its grandeur to set off the vividness of other colors of various schools of thought three thousand years ago, making the entire color palette of Chinese culture more determined and dynamic. During the day, others thought Mozi was a beggar, but at night he was still walking around when others were sleeping. For the sake of civil justice, he ran so simply and resolutely at the bottom of society. His walking in the dark seemed very lonely. In fact, he always had a team that depended on his words and deeds, forming a collective force for justice. Such a person is really worth remembering by every Chinese. This kind of image is very easy to see in martial arts chapter novels. Whether it is Guan Yun riding a thousand miles alone in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, protecting his wife in search of his master, or in the Water Margin of the Song Dynasty, it can be seen everywhere. In recent years, Qiao Feng in Jin Yong's novel The Eight Parts of the Dragon and Chen Jinnan, the leader of the Tiandihui in The Deer and the Cauldron, both embody Mozi's "chivalrous" spirit. Mozi was a chivalrous man, and his pursuit of "righteousness" was an important source of the chivalrous spirit later on. Although today everyone’s evaluation of martial arts novels is that they are novels, this is a fair statement. At least in Jin Yong’s story, we can see the trajectory of history and culture. Readers who like martial arts novels should like to read stories from the Mohist school, especially the rumors about the "giant man", which actually have deep cultural roots. "Juzi" is the leader of the Mohist school. "Juzi" enjoys sufficient authority and even controls the life and death of the members. This is the biggest difference between Mohism and other schools of thought. Analyzing Mohism from the perspective of the power of the "giant", in a sense it is very similar to a religious order and has a religious nature. However, Mohism does not believe in a specific god, so it cannot be said to be a complete religious organization. Mohist believers formed a very tight organization through the "giant" system and shared common moral ethics, values ​​and beliefs. The Mohists pursued a thoroughly puritanical way of thinking and behavior under the "giant" system. Because of the emphasis on "non-music", there is no need for music, and "festival funerals" are emphasized. Even the funerals of parents are very harsh. These thoughts and behaviors do not adapt to the traditional Chinese social form. Comparing Confucianism with Mohism, Confucianism appears to be "moderate" and has more room for maneuver. In the TV series "Shang Yang's Reform", you can see the image of the Mohist "giant" with absolute power three thousand years ago. It seems that this is the only TV series that gives an in-depth account of the Mohist family's inside story. There are too many great Confucians, scholars and experts’ opinions on interpreting Mohism, but using the most basic language to communicate with the Mozi God is more in line with its original intention, and there is no slightest hint of contempt. On the contrary, Master Jin Yong's historical martial arts novels are already significant enough to represent modern literature. Finally, the main reason for the decline of Mohism was the absolute power of the "giant" system. Where there is power, there must be competition. But the more important reason should be that the Mo family could not find an economic foundation sufficient to sustain the team's survival needs. Mohism has withdrawn from the historical protagonist, but this does not affect its greatness. Even the factors that accelerated its decline also contain a heart-pounding nobility. Although Mohism did not successfully monopolize the entire page of history, it was great.

edba5c0ed97a3c4a5b3dfb495d7017b305be4f2d.translatedText: (Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association Newsletter) The Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association held a meeting on June 12 to elect a new leadership team. Zhang Huafang serves as the chairman. This is the first time in the 26 years since the Chinese Restaurant Association was established that a woman has served as chairman.

99f85ab4bcb78f4a1d6c51c53944f1d2267b6505.sourceText: 会议由前任主席关兆峰主持。餐馆会之前曾发信给会员广泛征求意见，部分会员有投票参加选举，会议综合现场投票结果，最终选出2014年新班底。
99f85ab4bcb78f4a1d6c51c53944f1d2267b6505.translatedText: The meeting was chaired by former chairman Guan Zhaofeng. The Restaurant Association had previously sent a letter to members to solicit opinions. Some members voted to participate in the election. The meeting combined the on-site voting results and finally selected the new team for 2014.

8bb7c8373ee6d8b6919937e127b3738e68714ffc.sourceText: 会议对前任主席关兆峰两年来工作成效给予肯定，并报以热烈的掌声。新任主席张华芳表示，十分感谢各位董事的信任，今后将努力工作，让亚省中国餐馆协会的会务更上一层楼。她还在会上提出若干建议，并期望董事们在日后工作继续给予支持和鼓励。大家对她的当选送上了良好的祝愿。
8bb7c8373ee6d8b6919937e127b3738e68714ffc.translatedText: The meeting recognized the effectiveness of former chairman Guan Zhaofeng's work in the past two years and gave warm applause. The new chairman Zhang Huafang said that he was very grateful to all the directors for their trust and would work hard in the future to bring the affairs of the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association to a higher level. She also made several suggestions at the meeting and hoped that the directors would continue to provide support and encouragement in future work. Everyone sent their best wishes for her election.

6e63b1f734e25d56efa0677cbb15eb07864300e7.sourceText: 美国农业部食品安全检查局日前宣布，新乐（Shamrock）食品公司召回在本州出售的7500磅醃好鸡肉和醃好牛肉，原因是标籤不当。 美国农业部上週五发表公告说，这批醃好的牛肉含有大豆，小麦和亚硫酸盐，醃好的鸡肉含有小麦，牛奶和亚硫酸盐。亚硫酸盐是已知的过敏原。 这批召回的肉类生产日期是12月1日至12月29日，分售到全州各大小超市和食肆。其中最初标记为鸡大胸，识别号码为2844671的10磅重包。牛肉包装为10磅重包，识别号码为3096311。 此次召回类别为揑类?#65292;意思是该产品会引起严重的不良健康后果。到目前为止，没有人因为食用这些产品而引起不适。 有关召回问题，消费者可以致电新乐食品602-477-2401Sandy Kelly或e-mail Sandy_Kelly@shamrockfoods.com
6e63b1f734e25d56efa0677cbb15eb07864300e7.translatedText: The U.S. Department of Agriculture's Food Safety and Inspection Service recently announced that Shamrock Foods is recalling 7,500 pounds of marinated chicken and marinated beef sold in the state due to improper labeling. The U.S. Department of Agriculture issued a notice on Friday saying that the marinated beef contained soy, wheat and sulfites, and the marinated chicken contained wheat, milk and sulfites. Sulfites are a known allergen. The production date of this batch of recalled meat is from December 1 to December 29, and it was sold to various supermarkets and restaurants across the state. One of the 10-pound bags was originally labeled Chicken Breasts and had identification number 2844671. The beef is packaged in 10-pound bags with identification number 3096311. The recall category is classified as pinch?#65292; meaning that the product can cause serious adverse health consequences. So far, no one has become ill from consuming these products. For recall issues, consumers can call Shamrock Foods 602-477-2401 Sandy Kelly or e-mail Sandy_Kelly@shamrockfoods.com

501ee35941c506500e78d5548d062c47fc469f93.sourceText: 如许多的人们，如许匆匆的脚步，但是他们永远只是陌生的过客，在旧金山Market Street和你擦肩而过。这里远比凤凰城喧闹。我不知道是不是只有我在宁静的地方呆了太久。如果你在Market Street上闭上眼聆听，你会觉得你听到的只有疯狂。
501ee35941c506500e78d5548d062c47fc469f93.translatedText: Like many people, such hurried footsteps, but they will always be just stranger passers-by, passing you on Market Street in San Francisco. It's far more noisy than Phoenix. I wonder if it's just me who's been in a quiet place for too long. If you closed your eyes and listened on Market Street, you would think all you heard was madness.

baadde522e82700db259f78a3d92bcd6754c9499.sourceText: 救护车还是救火车在尖锐地叫着，电车的铃声把耳朵扎的生疼，所有车辆的鸣笛和轰鸣，跳街舞的人从劣质的音响里放出响成一片的舞曲。加上无数人的脚步和声音，所有这些汇集成声浪，让街边每个建筑的内脏都在颤抖。
baadde522e82700db259f78a3d92bcd6754c9499.translatedText: Ambulances or firetrucks screamed sharply, the bells of trams pierced the ears, all the vehicles whistled and roared, and the street dancers played dance music from the inferior speakers. Coupled with the footsteps and voices of countless people, all these converged into a sound wave that made the guts of every building on the street tremble.

bee57d737652d200294f6ee8c232a08f5328e142.sourceText: 可是我依然能分辨出那种嚣张而痛苦鼓声。那不知所云地、让我熟悉的鼓点又随着脚步传来。但是这一次，我听不到那一句经典的”Welcome to San Francisco!”
bee57d737652d200294f6ee8c232a08f5328e142.translatedText: But I can still distinguish the arrogant and painful drum sound. The incomprehensible and familiar drumbeat came again with my footsteps. But this time, I couldn't hear the classic "Welcome to San Francisco!"

bd9b28a84c8904320efaf8da8c1b570a09370225.sourceText: 这是我心里的第一个念头。我站在那里呆呆地听了半天，但是除了那随意并疯狂的鼓点声，我一个词也没有听懂。
bd9b28a84c8904320efaf8da8c1b570a09370225.translatedText: This was the first thought in my mind. I stood there and listened blankly for a long time, but apart from the random and crazy drum beats, I didn't understand a single word.

1a6b47a6965b0cb432e54a16403910f9b97c2fb1.sourceText: 花白的头发被剃光了。黑色的衣着是一样的破旧，但是决不是曾经的那套行头。他的鼓，或者更精确的说，他的那些中餐馆用的酱油桶还是差不多原来的样子。有几个桶上依然倒扣着锅。如果只是看到他的照片，你很难知道他到底是在敲鼓还是在做饭。但是此情此景，即使你说在做饭，我也一点儿也笑不出来。
1a6b47a6965b0cb432e54a16403910f9b97c2fb1.translatedText: The gray hair was shaved. The black clothes are as shabby as ever, but they are definitely not the same outfit as before. His drums, or more accurately, his Chinese restaurant soy sauce buckets, are still pretty much the same. Some of the barrels still had pots upside down. If you just see his photo, it's hard to tell whether he is playing the drums or cooking. But in this situation, even if you said you were cooking, I couldn't laugh at all.

814048f6da7a41838b8861c643a9c1278c7cb154.sourceText: 他歇口气的时候，抬起眼睛，和他深深的抬头纹一起看了看我。依然还是那种怀疑而冷漠的眼神-我想他根本不会认得我。曾经在他面前呆了并试图读懂他的人，这次依然在他面前依然是一个陌生人。他大概只是在想，我会不会扔点钱给他。
814048f6da7a41838b8861c643a9c1278c7cb154.translatedText: When he took a breath, he raised his eyes and looked at me along with his deep forehead wrinkles. There was still that suspicious and cold look in his eyes - I didn't think he would recognize me at all. The person who once stood in front of him and tried to read him was still a stranger in front of him this time. He was probably just wondering if I would throw some money at him.

40af0984f9a3a66b1c13474244fb4b6394ac4582.sourceText: 不记得在哪本书上读过，街头艺人是城市衣服上的美丽的纽扣，是城市书本上的绚丽的插图。他们中有的心怀梦想，单纯、年轻而又有才华。象我在夏威夷Wakiki遇到的Kiana，她弹着和我一模一样的吉他（Breedlove的一款）。听我说我用的吉他和她一模一样后，毫不吝惜地让我替她演奏了好一阵子。随后又把她的全套CD都让我挑拣。她和我讨论吉他的Open Tune，讨论民谣和原声，她相信她会成名，会写更多的好歌，会有更多的听众。
40af0984f9a3a66b1c13474244fb4b6394ac4582.translatedText: I don’t remember which book I read in. Street performers are beautiful buttons on urban clothes and gorgeous illustrations in urban books. Some of them have dreams, are simple, young and talented. Like Kiana, whom I met in Wakiki, Hawaii. She played the exact same guitar as me (a Breedlove model). After hearing that the guitar I used was exactly the same as hers, she let me play for her for a while without hesitation. Then she let me choose from her entire set of CDs. She and I discussed Open Tune on the guitar, folk songs and acoustics. She believed that she would become famous, write more good songs, and have more listeners.

8c0039b945447c05df6111aae8c40290c52a48be.sourceText: 我也希望她能够成名。为此，我也一直企盼着。
8c0039b945447c05df6111aae8c40290c52a48be.translatedText: I also hope she can become famous. For this, I have been looking forward to it.

e9a5b84d1bb5079aa3d0c6980f3d29775e6f158c.sourceText: 但是他完全不是。我知道，他自己也知道。他比晦涩的《尤利西斯》更加难以理解。在他呆滞僵硬的脸上，在他怀疑冷漠的眼中，我完全读不懂他。他的鼓和我心中定义的音乐如电车的两根铁轨，完全不会有任何的交集。自然，他新改的词我也没有奢望能听懂。我相信他从来不会想着成名，他也不会想着更多的听众。人们走过他的身边，永远都是步履匆匆。象我这样停留许久，又不给钱，我知道他一边疯狂地敲，一边一定在想，”这个家伙想干嘛？”
e9a5b84d1bb5079aa3d0c6980f3d29775e6f158c.translatedText: But he is anything but. I know it, and he knows it too. He is even more difficult to understand than the obscure Ulysses. In his dull and stiff face, in his suspicious and cold eyes, I couldn't read him at all. His drums and the music that I define in my mind are like the two railroad tracks of a tram, there is no intersection at all. Naturally, I didn’t expect to understand his newly revised words. I believe he never thought about becoming famous, nor did he think about a larger audience. When people walk past him, they are always in a hurry. After staying like this for a long time without paying me, I knew that while he was knocking wildly, he must be thinking, "What does this guy want to do?"

a4e32be8ba2f1100ffb2ce9bf04b4147b83b8c98.sourceText: 我走开，为他远远照了张像。阳光驱散了清晨的雨，蒸汽依然从地面涌出。
a4e32be8ba2f1100ffb2ce9bf04b4147b83b8c98.translatedText: I walked away and took a picture of him from a distance. The sun dispersed the early morning rain, but steam still rose from the ground.

d6895995c7c8fbf32ae784b28f9b3e6e0e625793.sourceText: 十一岁贾可荣获全美音乐教师协会钢琴大赛西南区决赛初中组第一名 （左）参加比赛的贾可 刚满十一岁的贾可（Katrina Jia) 于一月七日在拉斯维加斯举行的西南区六州决赛中以娴熟的技巧，卓越的表现力和出类拔萃的演奏独压群芳，脱颖而出夺得初中组（十一至十四岁）第一名并且将代表西南区参加三月份在纽约举行的全美大赛的总决赛。 每年举办的MTNA全美音乐教师协会钢琴大赛分为三个级别：州级，区域级，国家级。每州参赛的第一名才能进入区域级比赛，全美五十个州分为七个区域比赛，只有在区域比赛中取得第一名才能进入国家级决赛，真可谓是难上加难的比赛。这次贾可代表亚利桑那州在分别来自加州，犹他州，新墨西哥州，内华达州和夏威夷州的强手中年纪最小，又是第一次且要对面不乏在各种钢琴大赛中获奖的优胜者和某些不利因素，贾可获胜这不仅归于她的天赋，更是与她平时刻苦的练习分不开，也与许飞老师平时的授教和每次亲自带着学生参加比赛临场的经验指教分不开。让我们衷心祝愿贾可在决赛中取得最好的成绩。
d6895995c7c8fbf32ae784b28f9b3e6e0e625793.translatedText: Eleven-year-old Katrina Jia won the first place in the junior high school category of the Southwest Regional Finals of the National Association of Music Teachers Piano Competition (left) Jia Ke who participated in the competition. Katrina Jia, who just turned 11, dominated the six-state Southwest Regional Finals held in Las Vegas on January 7 with her skillful skills, outstanding expression and outstanding performance. She stood out and won the first place in the junior high school category (11 to 14 years old) and will represent the Southwest Region in the finals of the National Competition to be held in New York in March. The MTNA National Music Teachers Association Piano Competition held annually is divided into three levels: state level, regional level, and national level. The first place in each state can enter the regional competition. The fifty states in the United States are divided into seven regional competitions. Only the first place in the regional competition can enter the national finals. It is really an extremely difficult competition. This time, Jia Ke represents Arizona and is the youngest among strong players from California, Utah, New Mexico, Nevada and Hawaii. It is the first time that she has to face many winners in various piano competitions and some disadvantages. Jia Ke’s victory is not only due to her talent, but also inseparable from her hard work. It is also inseparable from teacher Xu Fei’s usual teaching and the experience of personally taking students to participate in every competition. Let us sincerely wish Jia Ke the best in the finals.

dcdec2784e74f1b66f41a712b9b3375cfbcf558b.sourceText: 广告暗示亚裔女性为玩物引不满 近年来，白人男子和亚裔女性在一起的情景，成了美国电视广告的”主旋…
dcdec2784e74f1b66f41a712b9b3375cfbcf558b.translatedText: The ad implies that Asian women are dissatisfied with playthings. In recent years, the scene of white men and Asian women together has become the "main theme" of American TV advertisements...

01c97ef9ea68c6df5dbe4819390f48cd8f9b17af.sourceText: 据报道，近年来亚裔面孔在美国产品广告中频频出现，包括快餐品牌麦当劳、电信运营商威瑞森通讯、连锁超市沃尔玛等大型企业都曾在广告中将亚裔作为主 角。然而，当广告中出现成双成对的角色时，人物形象却多数只有一个模板棗白人男子配亚裔女性。这样的组合似乎成为美国广告中跨族裔夫妻的典型。
01c97ef9ea68c6df5dbe4819390f48cd8f9b17af.translatedText: According to reports, Asian faces have appeared frequently in American product advertisements in recent years, including fast food brand McDonald's, telecom operator Verizon Communications, supermarket chain Walmart and other large companies have used Asians as the main characters in their advertisements. However, when pairs of characters appear in advertisements, most of the characters only have one template: a white man and an Asian woman. This combination seems to have become a typical example of interracial couples in American advertisements.

36c51cf7260a9f7d892cd2e0c6fe581a90d5428d.sourceText: 报道指出，以上这种情况刺痛了美国亚裔群体的”神经”。美国广告机构IW Group主席比尔?#20381;梦达称，美国亚太裔媒体联盟定期对这种情况表达不满。依梦达称：”亚裔认为此类广告暗示亚裔女性代表异国情调甚至是白人的玩物。”与此同时，依梦达称：”广告一般不启用亚裔男性为爱人形象，因为他们不够男人、不够性感、不够强壮，无法吸引白人女性，并且很少与其他族裔的女性交往，所 以他们成不了广告主角。”
36c51cf7260a9f7d892cd2e0c6fe581a90d5428d.translatedText: The report pointed out that the above situation stung the "nerves" of the American advertising agency IW. Group Chairman Bill? "At the same time, Imonda said: "Ads generally do not use Asian men as romantic partners because they are not manly enough, sexy enough, and strong enough to attract white women, and they rarely interact with women of other ethnic groups, so they cannot become the protagonists of advertisements. "

5dc6149157e706af8a517b1b2ceb6463f4a4b3c0.sourceText: 此外，针对美国电视广告中启用白人男子与亚裔女性配对的情况，报道指出，这凸显了亚裔形象在美国的长期历史问题。美国华盛顿大学研究亚裔的教授蕾拉尼?#35199;铭称：”广告这样拍摄，源于我们对亚裔许多根深蒂固的观念，关于亚裔男性和女性在性特点上的误解。”
5dc6149157e706af8a517b1b2ceb6463f4a4b3c0.translatedText: In addition, regarding the pairing of white men and Asian women in American TV advertisements, the report pointed out that this highlights the long-term historical problem of Asian images in the United States. Leilani?#35199; Ming, a professor of Asian studies at the University of Washington, said: "The filming of the advertisement stems from many of our deep-rooted ideas about Asians and misunderstandings about the sexual characteristics of Asian men and women. "

b20004c61fea9428695ce2808c8d0a459cd7254a.sourceText: 马萨诸塞州州立大学亚裔研究项目主任CNLe则认为，这些误解源于影视剧中对亚裔的刻画，包括亚裔女性的异国情调和性感迷人，以及二战时美国军人与亚裔女性交往的描写。”媒体产生强大影响力和文化意象，好莱坞至今仍在发挥着作用，因为这很符合白人男性观众的胃口。”
b20004c61fea9428695ce2808c8d0a459cd7254a.translatedText: CNLe, director of the Asian Studies Program at Massachusetts State University, believes that these misunderstandings stem from the portrayal of Asians in film and television dramas, including the exoticism and sexy charm of Asian women, and the depiction of interactions between American soldiers and Asian women during World War II. "The media has a strong influence and cultural images, and Hollywood is still playing a role today, because it is in line with the appetite of white male audiences. "

ab2405979b617cd33637d88cedff3ebca5844cda.translatedText: "Celebrating the Mid-Autumn Festival and welcoming the National Day" series of activities - Poster design and photography competition award ceremony The Confucius Institute at Arizona State University held a poster design competition and a photography competition in early September 2014...

f41963ae029293f16a9037df61fcf30a93027097.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院于2014年9月初举办了海报设计比赛及摄影比赛。海报设计比赛面向1-6年级的学生，摄影比赛则是面向7-12年级的学生。孔子学院共收到来自亚利桑那州各个学校的共计160多幅海报作品以及150多张照片。许多美国学生参与了”我眼中的亚利桑那”摄影比赛，用他们的照相机展现了他们对这片西南沙漠的热爱之心。
f41963ae029293f16a9037df61fcf30a93027097.translatedText: The Confucius Institute at Arizona State University held a poster design competition and a photography competition in early September 2014. The poster design competition is open to students in grades 1-6, and the photography competition is open to students in grades 7-12. The Confucius Institute received a total of more than 160 poster works and more than 150 photos from various schools in Arizona. Many American students participated in the "Arizona Through My Eyes" photography competition, using their cameras to show their love for this southwest desert.

fbd37d0574c110935705f84f9910c798da0a023f.sourceText: 所有获奖的海报设计作品和摄影作品均在MU Arizona 宴会厅展出。观众们在小朋友的艺术结晶前流连忘返
fbd37d0574c110935705f84f9910c798da0a023f.translatedText: All award-winning poster design works and photography works will be displayed in the MU Arizona Ballroom. The audience lingered in front of the children's artistic crystallization

df16b210a2e9e2faa8d52e0eb6a4b360ccc9944a.sourceText: 9月21日， 所有获奖的优胜作品在ASU的MU大楼进行展出，同时有隆重的颁奖典礼。当天，获奖的小小艺术家们在家长的带领下，在室内弦乐团的伴奏下，盛装出席了优胜作品展览和颁奖典礼。很多家庭对此次活动非常重视，老老小小全家出动。大概有500人参观了展览并出席了颁奖仪式。ASU孔子学院和国际语言与文学院院长Joe Cutter博士为海报设计大赛的获奖学生颁奖，中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆孙鲁山副总领事为摄影比赛的优胜学生颁奖。家长们的相机不断拍照留念，记录小画家及小摄影师的光荣时刻和成长的难忘瞬间。
df16b210a2e9e2faa8d52e0eb6a4b360ccc9944a.translatedText: On September 21st, all the winning works were displayed in the MU building of ASU, and there was a grand awards ceremony. On the same day, the award-winning young artists, led by their parents and accompanied by the chamber string orchestra, attended the exhibition of winning works and the award ceremony in their best attire. Many families attach great importance to this event, and whole families, old and young, come out to attend. About 500 people visited the exhibition and attended the award ceremony. Dr. Joe Cutter, dean of the ASU Confucius Institute and School of International Languages ​​and Literatures, presented awards to the winning students of the poster design competition. Sun Lushan, Deputy Consul General of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, presented awards to the winning students of the photography competition. Parents' cameras kept taking pictures, recording the glorious moments and unforgettable moments of growth of the little painters and photographers.

761b4f966797bc6959b9173acca9dbdef1116423.sourceText: 观众们聚精会神地欣赏着获奖佳作
761b4f966797bc6959b9173acca9dbdef1116423.translatedText: The audience attentively appreciated the award-winning works

36643688415dbb00e9fa22a10b01d2755277bc9f.sourceText: 孔子学院专程邀请了来自菲尼克斯地区优秀的学生室内弦乐团为本次颁奖典礼更添艺术氛围
36643688415dbb00e9fa22a10b01d2755277bc9f.translatedText: The Confucius Institute specially invited the outstanding student chamber string orchestra from the Phoenix area to add an artistic atmosphere to this award ceremony

307d27c70309a760ac3000e70581fb77e6fb6d29.sourceText: 此次海报设计比赛共收到160多份1-6年级学生的参赛作品。依照学生们所在年级的不同，参赛作品共分为2个小组来进行评比，分别是1-3年级和4-6年级。评委从每个年级评出1,2,3等奖，以及优秀作品奖。这160余份参赛作品给评委们留下深刻的印象。评委们感叹这些小小艺术家们的想象力，创造力以及对绘画细节的把握能力。 K-2年级的小朋友虽然年龄小，但是画画功力一点都不输给高年级的学生。该小组获得一等奖的作品是Iris Wang小朋友的《Lantern Festival》，画中朱红的灯笼错落有致地展现出中华民族传统节日的喜庆氛围；该组获得二等奖的作品是Lian Smith小朋友的《The Impressions of Beijing》；Mcartney Weisenss 小朋友的《The Face of China》和 Lena Zhang 小朋友的《Rainbow Dragon》并列该组的第三名。4-6年级同学的作品更为细腻，他们把各种不同的元素融入到自己的作品里，该小组的一等奖获奖作品《ATeamwork Race》出自Konrad Yuan之手,画中人物齐心协力、众志成城的神志感动了所有的评审嘉宾以及观众；Isabel Qin的二等奖作品《Lazy Panda 》在细节处下功夫，将熊猫慵懒散淡之情表现地淋漓精致；而Grace Zhang的二等奖作品《Rounded House in Southern China》则是将福建土楼里面田螺坑土楼群完美地收入方寸之间，让人不由感叹其结构奇巧、规模宏大；而获得三等奖的是Davina Chen 的《Playing in the Garden》 。
307d27c70309a760ac3000e70581fb77e6fb6d29.translatedText: This poster design competition received more than 160 entries from students in grades 1-6. According to the different grades of the students, the entries were divided into two groups for evaluation, namely grades 1-3 and grades 4-6. The judges will select the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd prizes from each grade, as well as the outstanding work award. The judges were deeply impressed by the more than 160 entries. The judges marveled at the imagination, creativity and ability of these young artists to grasp the details of their paintings. Although the children in grades K-2 are young, their drawing skills are not inferior to those of senior students at all. The first-prize winning work of this group was "Lantern Festival" by Iris Wang, in which the vermilion lanterns are scattered in an orderly manner, showing the festive atmosphere of traditional Chinese festivals; the second-prize winning work of this group was "The Impressions of Beijing" by Lian Smith; "The Face of China" by Mcartney Weisenss and "Rainbow Dragon" by Lena Zhang tied for third place in this group. The works of students in grades 4-6 were more delicate. They incorporated various elements into their works. The group's first-prize winning work "ATeamwork Race" was created by Konrad Yuan. The characters in the painting worked together and united as one to move all the judges and the audience; Isabel Qin's second-prize winning work "Lazy Panda" 》 worked hard on the details, expressing the lazy and indifferent mood of the panda vividly and exquisitely; and the second prize work "Rounded House in Southern China" by Grace Zhang perfectly integrated the Tianluokeng Tulou cluster in the Fujian Tulou into a small space, making people marvel at its ingenious structure and grand scale; and the third prize winner was Davina Chen's "Playing in the Garden".

da41d5254fed633dff6fadd612aba5db7c713c49.sourceText: ASU孔子学院院长Joe Cutter博士为海报设计1-3年级组的1，2，3等奖选手颁奖
da41d5254fed633dff6fadd612aba5db7c713c49.translatedText: Dr. Joe Cutter, Director of the ASU Confucius Institute, presented awards to the 1st, 2nd and 3rd place winners of the poster design grade 1-3 group

d6e0437c2b1f42c80d713bca2891ecdc951a083a.sourceText: ASU孔子学院院长Joe Cutter博士为海报设计4-6年级的优胜选手颁奖 7到12年级的摄影比赛同样是精彩斑斓。本次比赛共收到150多幅参赛作品，学生们的足迹遍布亚利桑那州的山山水水，体现了亚利桑那州独特的自然风貌和原生之美。评委们觉得学生的作品表达了丰富的场景。他们对照片的描述显示了他们对自己脚下这片土地的热爱。7-9年级组的一等奖获奖作品《Noir Walking Cactus》由Harrison Kessel拍摄，黑白照片里一株巨大而高耸入云的仙人掌却如同人类一般有着四肢，颇有沙漠散步之情趣；二等奖是Abhinav Kolli《The Towers》；三等奖则分别是Lucy Song的《The Determined Tree》和Ana Rousu的《Cherry Sunset》。 10-12高年級小組的一等奖获奖作品 《Arizona抯 Natural Wonder》由Jared Briones拍摄, 他的照片完美地展現了大峽谷的鬼斧神工，其选角之独特让观众啧啧称奇、心驰神往；Logan Schultz的《Arizona》获得了二等奖。该组的三等奖由Vanessa Setjodiningrat的《Summertime Sunset 》 获得。由于优秀作品太多，让评委们目不暇接，难以取舍。除了以上的一二三等奖外，评委们还在分别海报设计比赛及摄影比赛中评出了50多份优秀作品奖。
d6e0437c2b1f42c80d713bca2891ecdc951a083a.translatedText: Dr. Joe Cutter, Director of the ASU Confucius Institute, presented awards to the winners of poster design for grades 4-6. The photography competition for grades 7-12 was also exciting. This competition received a total of more than 150 entries. The students' footprints are all over the mountains and rivers of Arizona, reflecting Arizona's unique natural features and native beauty. The judges felt that the students’ work conveyed a rich range of scenes. Their descriptions of the photos reveal their love for the land beneath their feet. The first prize-winning work of the 7th to 9th grade group was "Noir Walking Cactus", taken by Harrison Kessel. In the black and white photo, a huge and towering cactus has limbs like a human being, giving it the feeling of a desert walk; the second prize was Abhinav Kolli's "The Towers"; the third prizes were Lucy Song's "The Determined Tree" and Ana Rousu's "Cherry Sunset". The first prize-winning work of the 10-12 senior group, "Arizona's Natural Wonder," was shot by Jared Briones. His photos perfectly showed the wonders of the Grand Canyon, and his unique casting amazed and fascinated the audience; Logan Schultz's "Arizona" won the second prize. The third prize in this category was won by "Summertime Sunset" by Vanessa Setjodiningrat. Because there were so many excellent works, the judges were overwhelmed and found it difficult to choose. In addition to the above first, second and third prizes, the judges also awarded more than 50 outstanding works awards in poster design competitions and photography competitions.

343d7f7128d406919e873316e5b12f2f6c27d0c7.sourceText: 监视墨界非法勾当 无人机进驻本州 (亚省时报） 当局周二再获得 1 架高科技监视无人飞机，可飞临亚利桑那州崎岖的边界地区，以搜查由墨西哥越界而来的毒品走私犯和非法移民。 美国国土安全部海关边境保护局表示，这架掠夺者型（ Predator B ）无人机派驻在亚利桑那州维斯塔山（ Sierra Vista ）的国家空中安全作业中心，即与亚利桑那州东南部接壤的墨西哥边界以 北数哩处。 这架无人机加入阵容后，海关边境局可用以监视美国西南部近 2000 哩长墨国边界的无人机达到 6 架；其中 4 架的基地在亚利桑那州中心地区，另 2 架则在德州圣体 城（ Corpus Christi ）。 海关边境局发表声明说：” 由这 2 个中心发动的任务使本局可自加州东端部署无人机，以飞越亚利桑那州、新墨西哥州和德州与墨国的共同陆上边界。”
343d7f7128d406919e873316e5b12f2f6c27d0c7.translatedText: Drones are coming to the state to monitor illegal activities in Mexico (Alberta Times) Authorities on Tuesday obtained another high-tech surveillance drone that can fly over Arizona's rugged border area to search for drug smugglers and illegal immigrants crossing the border from Mexico. The U.S. Department of Homeland Security's Customs and Border Protection said the Predator B drone was stationed at the National Air Security Operations Center in Sierra Vista, Arizona, a few miles north of the Mexican border in southeastern Arizona. The addition of this drone to the lineup brings the number of CBP drones used to monitor the nearly 2,000-mile-long border with Mexico in the southwestern United States to six; four of them are based in central Arizona, and the other two are based in Corpus Christi, Texas. "Missions from these two centers allow CBP to deploy drones from the eastern tip of California to fly across Arizona, New Mexico, and Texas' shared land border with Mexico," CBP said in a statement.

382d9701e1d5b573157c44dc93f04d097002183e.sourceText: 平衡预算，不仅是联邦政府，也是州政府的问题。经济大萧条，严重影响美国一些地区的财政收入和预算短缺。根据预算政策优先中心的报告，美国数十个州面临着数以亿计的预算不足。 《 24/7 华尔街》研究 2011 财年，找出总资金预算短缺 27% 或以上的地区，这些州，预算极为不足。在大多数情况下，财政预算最差的地区，当地经济也惨不忍睹。由于预算短缺，被迫大幅度削减政府服务。 2011 财年，全美有 29 个州削减残疾人和老年人的福利， 34 个州减少儿童和早期教育的资金。但是，大多数的州也维持政府雇员的职位，福利和工资。 第三位亚利桑那州 2011 年财政预算不足百分比： 39.0% ， 2011 年预算不足金额： 33 亿美元， 2012 年预测的预算缺口： 17.0% ， 2006 年至 2010 年国内生产总值的变化： +2.7% ， 2006 年至 2010 年房屋销售中位价的变化： -28.6% 。 像内华达州一样，亚利桑那州受到二次房贷危机的冲击尤为严重。 2006 年至 2010 年期间，本州房价中位数下跌 28.6% ，全美第四位最恶劣的地区。此期间，生产总值，贫困和收入水平停滞不前，甚至明显地恶化。 2009 年以来，亚利桑那州州已经是全美最严重的预算不足地区之一，三年的总计为 121 亿美元。为了平衡预算，州政府已经做出戏剧性的预算削减，包括撤销超过 100 万名低收入居民的医疗补助资格，削减 4,000 多名儿童的学前教育资金，出售州政府办公楼等。
382d9701e1d5b573157c44dc93f04d097002183e.translatedText: Balancing the budget is not only a problem for the federal government, but also for the state governments. The Great Recession severely affected fiscal revenue and budget shortfalls in some areas of the United States. Dozens of U.S. states face budget shortfalls worth hundreds of millions, according to a report from the Center on Budget Policy Priorities. 24/7 Wall Street looked at fiscal year 2011 to identify states with gross budget shortfalls of 27 percent or more, states that were extremely underfunded. In most cases, the areas with the worst budgets also have terrible local economies. Due to budget shortfalls, government services have been severely cut. In fiscal year 2011, 29 states cut benefits for people with disabilities and the elderly, and 34 states reduced funding for children and early education. However, most states also maintain government employee positions, benefits, and salaries. No. 3 Arizona 2011 budget shortfall percentage: 39.0%, 2011 budget shortfall amount: $3.3 billion, 2012 forecast budget gap: 17.0%, GDP change from 2006 to 2010: +2.7%, change in median home sales price from 2006 to 2010: -28.6%. Like Nevada, Arizona has been particularly hard hit by the second mortgage crisis. Between 2006 and 2010, the state's median home price fell 28.6 percent, the fourth worst rate in the nation. During this period, gross product, poverty and income levels stagnated or even worsened significantly. Arizona has had one of the nation's worst budget shortfalls since 2009, with a three-year total of $12.1 billion. In an effort to balance the budget, the state has made dramatic budget cuts, including revoking Medicaid eligibility for more than 1 million low-income residents, cutting preschool funding for more than 4,000 children, selling off state office buildings and more.

d808fdf3b8922e5c360671de09d7ce013710929b.translatedText: Mom, I came back late Su Wei Mom, I came back late. A few days ago, I heard your loud laughter from the overseas phone call, and imagined your gentle steps as before...

54c80b120961dee9a0a4c5ebee9315083f67148a.sourceText: 妈妈，我回来晚了 苏炜 妈妈，我回来晚了。几天前，才从越洋电话里听到你朗朗的笑声，想象着你一如往昔的轻轻步履，淡淡笑容。你从来都是这样的：泰山崩于前而色不变，浮沉不乱，宠辱不惊。我以为你一定会象往日一样地等待着我这个远行儿子的归来?一杯清茶、一句絮语，就为我拂尽万里尘埃；任何难关你都可以变成生命中的坦途，你是这样一位不动声色而又进退从不失据的母亲。 妈妈，你或许是世间最最平凡的一个女子，多少虚名、荣耀的光环都与你毫不相关。你似乎从不过问世俗功利的每一个细节，任何富贵贫贱的朋友你都会一样笑着迎进家门，任何复杂纷繁的纠纷都可以在你大而化之的微笑里熄火，任何掀天动地的风暴都可以消解于你举重若轻的一拂袖、一挥手之间棗无论是抗日的连天烽火、文革的嚣天狂澜，也无论是一个传统大家庭可能有的无穷纠葛，或者各种可能穷困也可能奢华的人生大转弯棗你永远是平定风波的那一滴甘露。拉直曲线的那一根标尺，凝聚亲情温热、道义自信的那双无形的纤手，台风眼里那一个安静泰然的港湾厖。妈妈，原谅我，直到成年后我才突然颖悟：原来你身上闪耀着这么多容易被人忽略又如此令人动容的高贵品格，妈妈，原来你是这样一位伟大的母亲！ 妈妈，我回来晚了。我本来准备把这番话写在我的文稿里，但我想留着亲自跟你说。妈妈，你走得太急，急得连信息时代宇宙航天的速度都不能帮助我啊，就差那么半天，你竟然不能见到你最牵挂的远行儿子和孙女一面，听不到作为儿子的迟到了几十年的赞语美言！妈妈，我现在就带着端端站在你的面前，妈妈，你醒一醒，再看看我们，再看看我和小端端厖 妈妈，你慢慢地走。风范长存，深恩永在。妈妈，你永远是活在我们生活中、生命中的好妈妈，好母亲！ 一九九八年十月二十三日
54c80b120961dee9a0a4c5ebee9315083f67148a.translatedText: Mom, I'm late when I come back Su Wei Mom, I'm late when I come back. A few days ago, I heard your loud laughter from the overseas phone call, and imagined you walking lightly and smiling as before. You have always been like this: Mount Tai collapses but remains unchanged, ups and downs remain undisturbed, favors and disgrace remain unfazed. I thought you would be waiting for the return of my son who had traveled far away like you did in the past. A cup of tea and a whisper could wipe away the dust for me. You can turn any difficulty into a smooth road in life. You are such a calm mother who never loses ground when advancing or retreating. Mom, you may be the most ordinary woman in the world, and all your fame and glory have nothing to do with you. You never seem to care about every detail of worldly utilitarianism. You will welcome any friend, rich or poor, into your home with a smile. Any complicated disputes can be extinguished in your big and easy smile. Any storm that shakes the world can be resolved with your ease. With a flick of your sleeves or a wave of your hand, whether it is the raging war of the Anti-Japanese War or the turmoil of the Cultural Revolution, the endless entanglements that a traditional big family may have, or the various life changes that may be poor or luxurious, you will always be the drop of nectar that calms the storm. The ruler that straightens the curve, the invisible hands that condense family warmth and moral confidence, the quiet and calm harbor in the eye of the typhoon. Mom, forgive me, it wasn’t until I became an adult that I suddenly realized: It turns out that you shine with so many noble qualities that are easily overlooked and so touching. Mom, it turns out that you are such a great mother! Mom, I'm late. I was going to write this in my manuscript, but I wanted to save it to tell you in person. Mom, you left in such a hurry that you couldn't even help me with the speed of space travel in the information age. In just half a day, you couldn't see your son and granddaughter who were traveling far away and couldn't hear your son's praises that were decades late! Mom, I will stand in front of you with Duan Duan now. Mom, wake up and look at us again, then look at me and little Duan Duanpang. Mom, you walk slowly. Your style will last forever, your kindness will last forever. Mom, you will always be a good mother and a good mother living in our lives! October 23, 1998

68dcc38cdacade7f3e8167f34c94b7a3815ff305.sourceText: (华人耆英会供稿)最近，华人耆英会常务委员会讨论决定年度选举将於今年十二月十四日（星期五）上午八时半召开年度会员大会，并选举新一届的主席，副主席和新的执行委员会。主席和副主席候选人用自己报名和会员提名相结合的方式进行。 凡居住大凤凰城地区，年满陆十周岁的均可申请加入该会為正式会员。该会宗旨是团结华人耆英，增进会员福利。希望热心為耆英服务的本会会员积极报名参加选举，并加入到义工队伍中来，共同努力，把一年一度的会员大会开成团结欢乐的大聚会。 近年来，由於部份会员家庭住址有了变化未能收到会议通知，希望会员们相互转告并把新的地址写信或电话通知我们，以便加强联繫。 华人耆英会：电话; 602-262-6411 閔中英 电话：602-264-5158 杨济群 电话：602-253- 0812 余江英 电话：602-200-4984 尹凤影 电话：315-717-5555 11 /17/2012
68dcc38cdacade7f3e8167f34c94b7a3815ff305.translatedText: (Contributed by the Chinese Seniors Association) Recently, the Standing Committee of the Chinese Seniors Association discussed and decided The annual general election will be held at 8:30 am on Friday, December 14th this year, and the new chairman, vice-chairman and new executive committee will be elected. Candidates for the chairman and vice-chairman shall use a combination of self-registration and member nomination. Anyone who lives in the greater Phoenix area and is over ten years old can apply to join the association as a formal member. The association's purpose is to unite the Chinese elderly and enhance member benefits. We hope that members of the association who are enthusiastic about serving the elderly will actively sign up for the election and join the volunteer team to work together to make the annual membership meeting a united and joyful gathering. In recent years, some members have not received meeting notices due to changes in their home addresses. We hope that members will tell each other and inform us of their new addresses by letter or phone so that we can strengthen contact. Tel: 602-262-6411 Min Zhongying Tel: 602-264-5158 Yang Jiqun Tel: 602-253-0812 Yu Jiangying. Tel: 602-200-4984 Yin Fengying Tel: 315-717-5555 11/17/2012

d26f91afbad8f5f0bd5a2bf82eb3f707e5e9c597.sourceText: 二O一五年九月二十三日，国家主席习近平访美期间，安排在西雅图会见华人华侨代表，我有幸被邀请参加了会见，真感到十分荣幸。我一生中亲眼见过国家主席有四位。青年时代见过毛泽东和刘少奇，那时他们在天安门上，我在广塲上。中年时代见过江泽民，那是在人民大会堂内，颁发科技进歩奨的大会上，和国家领导人一起合影留念。这一次是髦毞之年，又一次有机会见到习近平主席一起合影留念，还出席了招待会，聆听他朴实诚恳的讲话，确实很受感动。我这一辈子可能再没有这样的机㑹了。 习大大给我的印象是老实敦厚，照相时，我看到他头顶上百分之九十的黑髮中夹杂着丝丝白髪，我就觉得他实在、可信。许多中国的领导干部喜欢把头髪染得油光黑亮，配上那满脸的绉纹，给人予不真实的感觉，我不喜欢。 习大大给大家讲话十分亲切。他的第一句话説到他见到大家的感受是”老乡见老乡，两眼泪汪汪啊！”一下子就拉近了和大家的距离，迎来了一片欢笑声和热烈的掌声。他用华人为修筑贯通美国中西部通太平洋铁路和华人华侨支持中国抗日战争的史实赞扬了老华侨们对中国和美国作出的贡献。用打鉄还要自身硬、老虎苍蝇一起打宣示了反贪治国的决心。他对华人华侨的三点希望我觉得十分恳切。一是遵守所在国法律，融入主流社会。这话从中国国家主席説出来是多么不容易。我们听演讲的人马上就有人说，听见了吗？习主席要我们做好美国人。是啊！仔细一想，是这个道理。你移民来美国，就应该和美国人民生活在一起，融入美国的主流社会，否则你留在美国干什么？二是希望我们为中美友谊牵綫搭桥，促进美中经贸交㳘。只有实现了第一点融入主流社会，有了发言权，才能有能力做好第二点。三是希望每个人做中华文化的传播者，讲中国故事，使美国人更了解一个真正的中国。是啊！真正的中国是一个曾经被列强欺侮的中国，一个力求发展经济、改善生活、渴望和平的中国，是一个十亿农民希望每天能有肉吃、能够看上病、过上小康生活的中国。在我接触到的美国人当中，对中国真正的了解还是很不够的，甚至是很片面的。就如我们生长在大陆的人看着西藏从农奴制变化到今天，是一个很大的进歩，中央政府付出了很大的努力和代价，而有的美国朋友却不以为然。中国人处理一些事情的方式只有用中国文化才能讲得通。说到中华文化，华人耆英会和老人公寓是存放在美国的中华文化的宝库，这里有丰富的人生经历和各式各样的人才，希望大家展示各自的才华，为传播中华文化作出新的贡献。
d26f91afbad8f5f0bd5a2bf82eb3f707e5e9c597.translatedText: On September 23, 2015, during President Xi Jinping’s visit to the United States, he arranged to meet with representatives of overseas Chinese in Seattle. I was fortunate to be invited to attend the meeting. I really feel honored. I have personally seen four presidents in my life. When I was young, I met Mao Zedong and Liu Shaoqi. They were at Tiananmen Square and I was at Guangzhou Square. I met Jiang Zemin when I was in middle age. It was at the Great Hall of the People, where I took a group photo with national leaders at a conference to announce scientific and technological progress. This time is the year of fashion. I once again had the opportunity to meet President Xi Jinping and take a group photo together. I also attended the reception and listened to his simple and sincere speech. I was really moved. I may never have such an opportunity again in my life. Xi Jinping gave me the impression of being honest and honest. When I took the photo, I saw that 90% of the black hair on the top of his head was mixed with traces of white hair. I felt that he was honest and trustworthy. Many Chinese leading cadres like to dye their hair glossy black and have crepe lines all over their faces, which gives people an unreal feeling. I don't like it. President Xi Jinping spoke to everyone very cordially. The first sentence he said about his feelings when he saw everyone was, "My fellow countrymen meet my fellow countrymen, and my eyes well up with tears!" He immediately shortened the distance between him and everyone, and was greeted with laughter and warm applause. He used the historical facts that Chinese people built the Pacific Railway through the Midwest of the United States and the overseas Chinese supported China's Anti-Japanese War to praise the contributions of the old overseas Chinese to China and the United States. Using an iron to hit oneself hard and hitting tigers and flies together demonstrates the determination to fight against corruption and govern the country. I find his three hopes for the Chinese and overseas Chinese very sincere. The first is to abide by the laws of the host country and integrate into mainstream society. It is not easy for the Chinese president to say this. As we listened to the speech, someone immediately said, “Did you hear that?” President Xi wants us to be Americans. yes! If you think about it carefully, this is the truth. When you immigrate to the United States, you should live with the American people and integrate into mainstream American society. Otherwise, why would you stay in the United States? Second, we hope that we can build bridges for Sino-US friendship and promote U.S.-China economic and trade exchanges. Only by integrating into mainstream society and having a say in the first point can we be able to do the second point well. Third, I hope that everyone can be a disseminator of Chinese culture and tell Chinese stories so that Americans can better understand a real China. yes! The real China is a China that was once bullied by foreign powers. It is a China that strives to develop the economy, improve lives, and longs for peace. It is a China where one billion farmers hope to have meat to eat every day, to be able to see a doctor, and to live a well-off life. Among the Americans I have come into contact with, their true understanding of China is still insufficient and even very one-sided. Just like those of us who grew up in mainland China, we have seen that Tibet's transformation from serfdom to today is a big step forward. The central government has put in a lot of effort and cost, but some American friends don't think so. The way Chinese people deal with some things can only make sense using Chinese culture. Speaking of Chinese culture, the Chinese Senior Citizens Association and the Senior Citizen Apartments are the treasure troves of Chinese culture stored in the United States. There are rich life experiences and various talents here. I hope everyone can show their talents and make new contributions to the spread of Chinese culture.

aa069c4669746c9fec6864d8056b241ec6c96f8b.sourceText: 习大大让代表们转达祖国对在美工作和生活的华人华侨的问候，祝大家中秋愉快、身体健康、阁家幸福。并为每位代表带来了一块家乡的钓鱼台月饼。一切都觉得像家人一样亲切。 我为中国有了这样一位朴实而且优秀的领导人髙兴和自豪。他有过贫困农村生活的经历，他知道人民的疾苦和需求，他也长期在基层工作，积累了相当的治政经验。期望祖国在习大大的任期内，一天比一天更强大，祝愿我们的同胞生活得更加美满幸福。谢谢廖莹㑹长为我摄下了两张珍贵的照片。
aa069c4669746c9fec6864d8056b241ec6c96f8b.translatedText: Xi Jinping asked the representatives to convey the greetings of the motherland to the overseas Chinese working and living in the United States, and wished everyone a happy Mid-Autumn Festival, good health, and happiness for their families. Each representative was given a piece of Diaoyutai mooncake from his hometown. Everything feels like family. I am very happy and proud that China has such a simple and excellent leader. He has lived in poor rural areas and knows the sufferings and needs of the people. He has also worked at the grassroots level for a long time and accumulated considerable political experience. I hope that the motherland will become stronger day by day during Xi Jinping’s term, and I wish our compatriots will live a happier and happier life. Thank you to Liao Yingchang for taking two precious photos for me.

811c10f96cad305928b2a5ed6fa76d4ea1815bd3.sourceText: 每年秋季的中秋与国庆双庆活动已成为我们的传统。今年，庆祝仪式将于九月十八日（星期日）晚5-7时，在位于Tempe的亚利桑那州立大学校园Memorial Union Ballroom举行。
811c10f96cad305928b2a5ed6fa76d4ea1815bd3.translatedText: The Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day celebrations every autumn have become our tradition. This year, the celebration will be held on Sunday, September 18th (Sunday) from 5-7 pm at the Memorial Union Ballroom on the Arizona State University campus in Tempe.

0198a63243acfb33587dc27f614ca7edc3f59805.sourceText: 我们诚挚地邀请你前往参加这一庆典，与当地民众、中国洛杉矶总领馆官员、美国政府政要、华人社区各组织的负责人、及文化和商业团体的代表会聚一堂。届时，你将能享受华裔艺术家们优美的四重奏旋律。
0198a63243acfb33587dc27f614ca7edc3f59805.translatedText: We sincerely invite you to participate in this celebration and gather with local people, officials from the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, U.S. government dignitaries, heads of various organizations in the Chinese community, and representatives of cultural and business groups. By then, you will be able to enjoy the beautiful quartet melodies of Chinese-American artists.

bc11125bd71b6dad6b0ddee3ee88b6d5a604c8c6.sourceText: 同日，亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院将于下午3-5时，在Memorial Union举办关于中美关系的讲座；庆祝仪式之后的晚7-9时，中秋舞会将在Memorial Union Ballroom 继续进行。舞会免费。

The dance is free.

2b4be02b08ffa8e69e6fc1b014ae0faa90f92bfd.translatedText: After hearing the video mentioned by Fang Fang, "all of which are fake," I couldn't help but respect Wuhan people or Wuhan beauties even more. I used to think that only Li Na had such chivalrous beauty.

dc97b95f30e22af42e8871b2a716872219f4b981.sourceText: 这次疫情一来发觉原来武汉有更多的真美女就在身边。那个方方就是一个，你完全可以躲在小楼里大写武汉的樱花，长江的伟岸或者绵长，可人家偏偏做个喇叭，将疫区的家长里短播将出来，弄得长江日报再无脸面见人。 那个社区大姐看到超市经理们发疫难财，一声怒吼，让不法商人收起一点贪婪黑心。
dc97b95f30e22af42e8871b2a716872219f4b981.translatedText: As soon as the epidemic broke out, I realized that there are more real beauties around Wuhan. That Fangfang is one. You can hide in a small building and write about the cherry blossoms in Wuhan, the great bank of the Yangtze River, or the length of the Yangtze River, but they just use a loudspeaker to short-circuit the news to parents in the epidemic area, making the Yangtze River Daily lose face. When the community elder sister saw the supermarket managers struggling to make money due to the epidemic, she roared and asked the unscrupulous businessmen to stop being greedy and evil.

34018a277a6351c8c2c86e6a352b004ff57f0789.sourceText: 这次这美女更是豁出去了，拿着手提电喇叭对着楼下的总理视察直呼“全部都是假的”。孙副总理摸不着头脑，不喊加油也罢，哪有这么不给面子的欢迎？
34018a277a6351c8c2c86e6a352b004ff57f0789.translatedText: This time this beauty went all out, holding a portable electric horn and calling out to the Prime Minister inspecting the event downstairs, "It's all fake." Vice Premier Sun was confused. Even if he didn't shout "come on", how could he receive such a disrespectful welcome?

4a72b7d4b2214da1048d54fdee32080f04e9c41d.sourceText: 这位美女还美在执着，让那假的声音在高楼里反复回响，不绝于耳！ 虽然武汉男儿也会用手电直射天空，以示哀悼，或以夜半鬼叫发泄悲愤，最值得称赞的不过是“李文亮的老婆武汉人养起来”的豪气，但与武汉女流相比毕竟输了胆识，还略逊风骚。那皇城来的大臣都敢怼，那侠胆意气岂是江南柔弱女子可能比！
4a72b7d4b2214da1048d54fdee32080f04e9c41d.translatedText: This beauty is still beautiful because of her persistence, which makes her fake voice echo repeatedly in the high-rise building! Although Wuhan men would also shine their flashlights into the sky to express their condolences, or vent their grief and anger by making ghostly noises in the middle of the night. The most praiseworthy thing is that "Li Wenliang's wife was raised by Wuhan people" for their heroic spirit, but compared with Wuhan women, they are still less courageous and slightly less coquettish. The ministers who came from the imperial city dared to quarrel with each other, how brave and courageous could they be compared to the weak women from the south of the Yangtze River!

35c6cedef63e5ff3c39c59d4114d7472417ccdd5.translatedText: > The media sternly warned that China may face a peak of bridge disasters in the next ten years. Article source: Apple Daily on 2013-02-07 15:55:46…

ae3c45690d9a4f57c57796d9a018376b4b241288.sourceText: 首先，常识告诉我们，死伤人数绝不可能是官方所讲的二十人。二十五辆车，即使全部没有乘客，至少也应有二十五个司机。他们被炸飞至十层高的地面，应该非死即伤，而绝大部份跌落桥底的车辆都严重变形，更何况是人，因此，绝不可能只有二十人死伤！第一时间赶到现场救人的附近村民，在其中一辆私家车已救出四人，而事发后几小时，当地传媒就报道二十六人死亡，其后官方却不断向下修正死伤人数，甚至连烟花货车的司机也不在名单上。显然，官方少报死伤人数，很易令人联想到，他们是否心中有鬼？
ae3c45690d9a4f57c57796d9a018376b4b241288.translatedText: > First of all, common sense tells us that the number of casualties cannot be the 20 people officially stated. Twenty-five cars, even if all without passengers, should have at least twenty-five drivers. They were blown ten stories to the ground, and they should be dead or injured. Most of the vehicles that fell under the bridge were severely deformed, let alone people. Therefore, there was no way that there were only twenty casualties! Nearby villagers who rushed to the scene to rescue people immediately rescued four people in one of the private cars. A few hours after the incident, local media reported that 26 people were dead. Later, the official government continued to revise the number of casualties downwards, and even the driver of the fireworks truck was not on the list. Obviously, the official underreported the number of casualties. It is easy to think that there is something wrong with them?

79942562c0e82218f338547203f5c21b02e8127b.sourceText: 其次，炸桥是非常专业的工作，爆破专家必须先找出支撑点，再钻孔、埋炸药，并同时引爆，才有可能炸断一条八十米长的桥面及一座支撑的桥墩。现在，一轮载重五吨的烟花货车，竟可完成爆破专家才能做到的事，除非中国已秘密研制出新型烟花，其威力强如导弹，否则只说明那座桥的质量很有问题，甚至没有烟花爆炸它也是时候寿终正寝了。事实上，从桥面、桥墩的残骸所见，只有很少且很幼的铁枝，而非惯常的密密麻麻钢筋。不要忘记，那车烟花并非同时爆炸，而是逐一引爆的，破坏力跟等量炸药不可相提并论。
79942562c0e82218f338547203f5c21b02e8127b.translatedText: Secondly, blowing up a bridge is a very professional job. Demolition experts must first find the supporting points, drill holes, bury explosives, and detonate them at the same time. Only then can they blow up an 80-meter-long bridge deck and a supporting pier. Now, a firework truck carrying a load of five tons can actually do what only blasting experts can do. Unless China has secretly developed a new type of fireworks that are as powerful as missiles, it only means that the quality of the bridge is very problematic, and it is time to die even without fireworks. In fact, what can be seen from the remains of the bridge deck and piers are only a few and very young iron branches, instead of the usual densely packed steel bars. Don't forget that the fireworks did not explode at the same time, but one by one. The destructive power cannot be compared with the same amount of explosives.

6825b0c03c866b24a38407f0cea8786de33f4ab3.sourceText: 这些迹象显示，通车十二年的义昌大桥，质量或设计很有问题。网民统计，过去五年，全国垮桥三十七条，平均每两个月就塌一条，其中只有三宗有官员被问责。偷工减料的豆腐渣工程多涉及官员的贪污腐败，桥樑、公路、防洪大堤等公共工程更是重灾区，而负责修建、监督公路及桥樑的各地交通部门，也是被揭发贪腐的重灾区。
6825b0c03c866b24a38407f0cea8786de33f4ab3.translatedText: These signs show that the Yichang Bridge, which has been open to traffic for 12 years, has serious problems with its quality or design. According to statistics from netizens, 37 bridges collapsed across the country in the past five years, with an average of one collapse every two months. In only three of these cases, officials were held accountable. Most of the shoddy projects involving shoddy work involve official corruption. Public projects such as bridges, highways, and flood control embankments are the hardest hit areas. The local transportation departments responsible for building and supervising highways and bridges are also the hardest hit areas when corruption is exposed.

dc1c99426e51409b42a16d58dcc8ff1314008584.sourceText: 从九七年起，全国有十几个省市自治区的二十二名交通厅长，因染指公路工程而落马，其中河南省十六年来连续四任交通厅长，都因为贪污腐败而被撤职。今次出事的义昌大桥，正是已被判无期徒刑的张昆桐担任河南交通厅长时建造的。
dc1c99426e51409b42a16d58dcc8ff1314008584.translatedText: Since 1997, 22 transportation directors in more than a dozen provinces, municipalities and autonomous regions across the country have been dismissed because of their involvement in highway projects. Among them, four consecutive transportation directors in Henan Province in the past 16 years were dismissed due to corruption. The Yichang Bridge where the accident occurred was built when Zhang Kuntong, who had been sentenced to life imprisonment, was the director of the Henan Department of Transportation.

1f05ca9327e3dc4d0c6faaa4afff0521a52ae4aa.sourceText: 如果正常豆腐渣大桥的寿命约为十年左右，则未来十年仍是塌桥、毁桥的高峯期。祈求春运期间，这些豆腐渣工程不会出事，否则伤亡更惨重！
1f05ca9327e3dc4d0c6faaa4afff0521a52ae4aa.translatedText: If the life span of a normal tofu bridge is about ten years, the next ten years will still be the peak period for bridge collapse and bridge destruction. I pray that nothing will happen to these shoddy projects during the Spring Festival, otherwise the casualties will be even greater!
