7dce9fd03ddc4d410e7fd88195603a45ab1c5ad9.sourceText: 气如虹:港越关係 凤凰城 气如虹 七月一日是纪念香港回归祖国的日子，今年已届二十年，由于中国日渐强盛，海内外华人蒙受恩泽，相对地位也提高，侨社活动更趋积极。于是乎，对这个纪念日，特别重视，不少地方都组织座谈会，举办庆祝晚宴，形形色色，围绕着这个历史性话题，发出现代国人扬眉吐气的声音，表露关心香港回归祖国前途的走向。 亚利桑那州侨界已于六月十七日，在大凤凰城地区，举办庆祝回归座谈会与聚餐晚宴，我也以越华联谊会副会长名义，出席会议，聆听中国驻洛杉矶两位领事，以及侨界名人学者的感言。 此间有些朋友觉得奇怪，我是越南华人，看来越南与香港拉不上关係，怎会有兴趣参加这种会议？其实，凡是炎黄子孙，即使出生于外国，大都心繫祖国，祖宗源远流长的文化习俗传承，永久不变。除非数典忘宗，否则，不会不关心祖国领土大事，更何况，上世纪五、六、七十年代，香港与越南交往非常密切，若与内地比较，关係更为深刻。 怎麽说呢？由当年世界局势谈起吧！那个冷战时代，国际间壁垒分明，自由与共产，互相争斗，誓不两立，断绝往来。香港是英国属地，与美国同一阵线，称为自由世界，美国高举反共旗帜，支撑越南共和国盟邦进行勐烈反共，绝不可以和共产党有任何接触；中国大陆则坚决打倒美帝，扫除资本主义，反对走资派，落下铁幕。就是这因素，形成香港与越南华人走在一起，频繁接触，关係密切。 像我这样年纪的越华人士，懂得那麽多的中华文化，熟稔汉学，传承国粹，无可否认，乃当年越南堤岸那庞大华人城的传统环境影响，其次是依赖台湾和香港两地，提供充分的精神粮食。 那时越华同胞棣属中华民国管辖，华校由台湾教育部供应教科书，华文报纸一律以中华民国纪年，所有文化书刊、艺术品都来自台湾，中华民国驻越大使馆的文化专员，对侨胞教育鼎力协助。 此外，最具影响力就是香港了。港越民间文化交流甚广，层面博大深远，这是时势造成，由于香港地位特殊，仍是殖民地，没有国防军事的严厉防范顾虑，民间社会自由活动，许多商贸、学术交流，完全不受限制，能够发挥得淋漓尽致。而且，越华同胞以广东人居多，与港人语言相同，具备亲切感，沟通容易，越南华人就更喜爱香港，交流频密，不在话下。 我小时候，越南堤岸的十家电影院，均放映香港电影，以粤语片为主，国语片和西片只有两家。那时期，白燕、张活游、吴楚帆的家庭伦理片；林凤、胡枫、张英才的言情片，关德兴、曹达华、石坚、罗豔卿、于素秋的武侠片，新马师曾、邓碧云、任剑辉、白雪仙的全部歌唱片，日日上映，习以为常，对越华观众来说，太过熟识了，差点误以为是本土拍摄的影片呢！ 还有香港粤剧红伶和歌星到越南舞台献艺，也是每年轮流转，如谭兰卿、梁无相、潘有声、胡茄、马师曾、红线女、新马师曾、任剑辉、白雪仙、梁醒波、张月儿、何非凡、邓丽君、郭申生、林黛、严俊、李丽华厖越华人士都有机会欣赏，反而大陆同胞一般只是曾经闻名，却无缘观看。 至于书籍报刊，歌曲唱片，就不用说了，早期大量进入越南南方，定期刊物如《今日世界》、《星岛画报》、《良友画报》、《新闻天地》、《当代文艺》、《读者文摘》厖小说作品更多，言情的、侦探的、武侠的、诲淫的，林林总总，应有尽有，最吸引是金庸着作《射鵰英雄传》，内容情节精彩，在香港报纸刊登一星期后，立即集结印成小册子，飞快速递到越南，让读者可以先睹为快。《女飞贼黄莺》的侦探连续故事，也令不少读者抢阅；杨天成和夏飞的性爱作品，一度让众多青年沉迷，想入非非。爱好写作的文友，更喜欢投稿去香港文艺刊物，以港币计算的稿费，比越币高得多，绞尽脑汁得到更好的报酬，又能扬名海外，高兴极了。 说到这裡，大家应该明瞭港越关係的密切因素，不单单在文学戏剧上，其他各领域也很活跃，各项商品，普通的或名贵的，只要香港有，越南一定有。后期有了录影带，在家中可观赏剧集；有了伴唱机，随时卡拉ＯＫ唱歌，对越华同胞生活影响更加广泛，成为联繫情谊的社交活动，成为家庭藉以教导孩子学习中文的器材，因为一九七五年越南政权易帜初期，华文教育全面停滞，中文几乎窒息，如果没有香港录影带和卡拉ＯＫ的传入，越南华人无法接受祖籍文化，形象必然改观。 试想想，香港对越南华人这麽强劲影响，港越关係确实密切；华人居留越南，仍然保持民族传统文化，大部分拜香港之赐，实不为过。既是这样，越华人士关心香港，诚属正常，只是其他地区华人不会留意，尤其大陆同胞，有时感到不明白而已。
7dce9fd03ddc4d410e7fd88195603a45ab1c5ad9.translatedText: Qi Ruhong: Hong Kong-Vietnam Relations Phoenix City Qi Ruhong July 1st is the day to commemorate the return of Hong Kong to the motherland. This year marks the 20th anniversary. As China becomes increasingly prosperous, Chinese people at home and abroad have benefited from it, their relative status has also improved, and the activities of overseas Chinese communities have become more active. As a result, special attention has been paid to this anniversary. Many places have organized symposiums and held celebration dinners, all around this historic topic, to express the proud and proud voices of modern Chinese people and to express their concern for the future of Hong Kong's return to the motherland. The overseas Chinese community in Arizona held a symposium and dinner to celebrate the return of China in the greater Phoenix area on June 17. I also attended the meeting as the vice president of the Vietnam-China Friendship Association and listened to the speeches of two Chinese consuls in Los Angeles, as well as celebrities and scholars from the overseas Chinese community. Some friends here find it strange that I am a Vietnamese Chinese. It seems that Vietnam has no relationship with Hong Kong. How can I be interested in participating in such a meeting? In fact, most of the descendants of Yan and Huang, even if they were born in foreign countries, care about the motherland, and the long-standing cultural customs of their ancestors will never change. Unless they forget their origins, they will not care about the territorial affairs of the motherland. What's more, in the 1950s, 1960s and 1970s, Hong Kong and Vietnam had very close exchanges. If compared with the mainland, the relationship was even more profound. How to say it? Let’s start with the world situation back then! In that era of the Cold War, international barriers were clearly defined. Freedom and communism were fighting each other, vowing to be incompatible and severing contacts. Hong Kong is a British territory and is on the same front as the United States. It is called the free world. The United States holds high the anti-communist banner and supports its allies in the Republic of Vietnam to fight fiercely against communism. It must not have any contact with the Communist Party. Mainland China resolutely overthrows American imperialism, wipes out capitalism, opposes capitalist roaders, and falls under the Iron Curtain. It is this factor that has led to the Chinese people in Hong Kong and Vietnam coming together, having frequent contact and close relations. For Vietnamese people of my age who know so much about Chinese culture, are familiar with Sinology, and inherit the essence of the Chinese nation, it is undeniable that they are influenced by the traditional environment of the huge Chinese city on the Vietnam Embankment. Secondly, they rely on Taiwan and Hong Kong to provide sufficient spiritual food. At that time, the Vietnamese and Chinese compatriots were under the jurisdiction of the Republic of China. Chinese schools were provided with textbooks by the Ministry of Education of Taiwan. Chinese newspapers were all dated in the Republic of China. All cultural books, periodicals, and artworks came from Taiwan. The cultural attaché of the Embassy of the Republic of China in Vietnam provided full assistance to the education of overseas Chinese. In addition, the most influential one is Hong Kong. The folk cultural exchanges between Hong Kong and Vietnam are extensive and far-reaching. This is due to the current situation. Due to Hong Kong's special status, it is still a colony and does not have strict defense and military concerns. Civil society can move freely, and many commercial and academic exchanges are completely unrestricted and can be brought into full play. Moreover, most of the Vietnamese and Chinese compatriots are Cantonese, and they speak the same language as the Hong Kong people. They have a sense of intimacy and easy communication. The Vietnamese Chinese prefer Hong Kong and have frequent exchanges. When I was a child, the ten movie theaters in Vietnam's embankment all screened Hong Kong films, mainly Cantonese films, and only two had Mandarin and Western films. During that period, family ethics films by Pak Yan, Cheung Wo-yau and Ng Chu Fan; romantic films by Lin Feng, Wu Feng and Zhang Yingcai; martial arts films by Kwan Tak Hing, Cao Dahua, Shi Jian, Luo Yanqing and Yu Suqiu; and all song albums by Xin Ma Si Tsang, Tang Biyun, Yam Kim Fai and Pak Suet Sin, were released every day. They were so accustomed to it that they were so familiar to Vietnamese and Chinese audiences that they almost mistakenly thought they were films shot locally! There are also Hong Kong Cantonese opera stars and singers who perform on the Vietnamese stage, and they rotate every year, such as Tan Lanqing, Liang Wuxiang, Poon Yousheng, Hu Ji, Ma Shitsang, Hongxian Nu, Xin Ma Shitsang, Yam Jianhui, Bai Xuexian, Liang Xingbo, Zhang Yueyi, Ho Feifan, Teresa Teng, Guo Shensheng, Lin Dai, Yan Jun, Li Lihua and Pang Yuehua. People from China have the opportunity to enjoy it. On the contrary, mainland compatriots are generally famous but have no chance to watch. As for books, newspapers, and music records, needless to say, they entered southern Vietnam in large numbers in the early days. Regular periodicals such as "Today's World", "Sing Tao Pictorial", "Liangyou Pictorial", "News World", "Contemporary Literature and Art", "Reader's Digest" Pang's novels and more romance works , detective, martial arts, pornographic, there are all kinds of them, the most attractive is Jin Yong's "The Legend of the Condor Heroes", the content and plot are wonderful, one week after it was published in the Hong Kong newspaper, it was immediately printed into a booklet and quickly delivered to Vietnam, so that readers can have a sneak peek. The serial detective story of "Female Snitch Huang Ying" also attracted many readers to read it; the sex works of Yang Tiancheng and Xia Fei once fascinated many young people and caused them to have wild imaginations. Literary friends who love writing prefer to submit articles to Hong Kong literary and art publications. The fees calculated in Hong Kong dollars are much higher than in Vietnamese dollars. They rack their brains to get better rewards and become famous overseas. They are very happy. At this point, everyone should understand the close relationship between Hong Kong and Vietnam. It is not only active in literature and drama, but also in other fields. All kinds of commodities, ordinary or expensive, if they are available in Hong Kong, they must be available in Vietnam. Later, with the advent of video tapes, dramas could be watched at home; with the advent of karaoke machines, karaoke singing was available at any time, which had a wider impact on the lives of Vietnamese and Chinese compatriots. It became a social activity to bond friendships, and became a device for families to teach their children to learn Chinese. Because at the beginning of the change of regime in Vietnam in 1975, Chinese education was completely stagnant, and the Chinese language was almost suffocated. Without the introduction of Hong Kong videos and karaoke, Vietnamese Chinese would not be able to accept their ancestral culture, and their image would inevitably change. Just think about it, Hong Kong has such a strong influence on the Chinese people in Vietnam, and the relationship between Hong Kong and Vietnam is indeed close. It is not an exaggeration to say that the Chinese living in Vietnam still maintain their traditional national culture, and most of them owe it to Hong Kong. In this case, it is normal for Vietnamese-Chinese people to care about Hong Kong, but Chinese people in other areas will not pay attention to it, especially compatriots from the mainland, who sometimes feel confused.

5aa05c11a20f6bbd62b7078a90b7d6482df91ea1.sourceText: 沙漠明珠 | 美国亚利桑那州华人历史（五）
5aa05c11a20f6bbd62b7078a90b7d6482df91ea1.translatedText: Pearl of the Desert | Chinese History in Arizona, USA (5)

05690f62d0ff7088ae1d50da38e1ea1dd73e29a4.sourceText: 亚利桑那州历史协会：张肇鸿 弗拉格斯塔夫（Flagstaff）的华人 从1850年代开始，美国开始对横跨亚利桑…
05690f62d0ff7088ae1d50da38e1ea1dd73e29a4.translatedText: Arizona Historical Association: Zhang Zhaohong The Chinese in Flagstaff From the 1850s, the United States began to cross Arizona...

a01d455d9e57d86eb60c81fed10588a74a66fc08.sourceText: 亚利桑那州历史协会：张肇鸿

bf7dec6ccbf200a8ba61a046772bad22e2a89cd6.sourceText: 从1850年代开始，美国开始对横跨亚利桑那州北部的第35条路线进行勘测，以此作为与加利福尼亚州的可能贸易路线。 首先是货车路，然后在1851年布置铁路，路线将穿过弗拉格斯塔夫（Flagstaff）。 但是，由于政治，战争等因素的影响，直到1882年铁路才通过该地区。 [60]
bf7dec6ccbf200a8ba61a046772bad22e2a89cd6.translatedText: Beginning in the 1850s, the United States began surveying Route 35 across northern Arizona as a possible trade route with California. First a wagon road, then a railroad in 1851, the route would pass through Flagstaff. However, due to political, war and other factors, the railway did not pass through the area until 1882. [60]

ec4dd35bdf8df1fb0b32ac12cb7823d7e308030f.sourceText: 我们搜集到跨州铁路沿线城镇的华人历史。弗拉格斯塔夫的华人与该市的隧道有关。
ec4dd35bdf8df1fb0b32ac12cb7823d7e308030f.translatedText: >We collected the Chinese history of towns along the interstate railway. Flagstaff's Chinese population is associated with the city's tunnels.

1728f4d7b565c9f84b8f6579a5ba5d0ab268cc60.sourceText: 根据弗拉格斯塔夫商业新闻（Flagstaff Business News）的 报道， [61] “弗拉格斯塔夫最早的隧道可以追溯到1880年代和1890年代，是中国居民挖的。这些居民是商人和餐馆和洗衣房等自有场所。中国居民因1886年一场大火烧毁了市中心而受到指责，有传言说他们将隧道挖为逃生之道。”
1728f4d7b565c9f84b8f6579a5ba5d0ab268cc60.translatedText: According to Flagstaff Business News, [61] "Flagstaff's earliest tunnels date back to the 1880s and 1890s and were dug by Chinese residents. These residents were merchants and owned establishments such as restaurants and laundries. The Chinese residents were blamed for a fire that destroyed the city center in 1886, and there were rumors that they dug the tunnels as an escape route."

eb1e9a10f049787a0cbb3f172a72ac10bcc4d73a.sourceText: 报道中引用弗拉格斯塔夫先锋博物馆馆长乔·米汉（Joe Meehan）的话说， “当中国人被驱逐出弗拉格斯塔夫(Flagstaff)时，他们会去威廉姆斯（Williams）或西部的其他地点等事情降温。通常他们被错误的指控和追捕，因为他们造成了更大的火灾。” 米汉说 “更大的隧道确实存在于几条街道的胡同下。”“在两座建筑物之间通过而不会弄湿大量的商业记录簿。”
eb1e9a10f049787a0cbb3f172a72ac10bcc4d73a.translatedText: Joe Meehan, director of the Flagstaff Pioneer Museum, was quoted as saying in the report, "When the Chinese were driven out of Flagstaff, they would go to Williams or other locations out west to cool things down. Often they were falsely accused and hunted because they were causing bigger fires," Meehan said. "Larger tunnels do exist down several street alleys." "Pass between two buildings without getting a lot of business record books wet."

248103b61b6c2b5dcaa449924dec716062f9b12b.sourceText: “有一条隧道从旧金山街和铁路大道（66号公路）东北角的一家商店的地下室延伸到北半个街区的另一座建筑物的地下室。赌徒利用此隧道逃避警察的突袭，并允许他们通过小巷离开。” “在商店的前台柜台，有人会按下一个按钮，该按钮会在地下室发出蜂鸣声，警告参与者逃脱，” “由于体积小，他们不得不爬过隧道。”
248103b61b6c2b5dcaa449924dec716062f9b12b.translatedText: "There is a tunnel that extends from the basement of a store on the northeast corner of San Francisco Street and Railroad Avenue (Route 66) to the basement of another building half a block to the north. Gamblers used this tunnel to evade police raids and allowed their exit through the alley." "At the store's front counter, someone would press a button that would beep in the basement, alerting participants to escape," "Due to their small size, they had to crawl through a tunnel."

2511fad9175f378fec1517c15436637c71f6dcf7.sourceText: 克莱恩图书馆的档案保管员西恩·埃文斯（R. Sean Evans）有不同的看法。
2511fad9175f378fec1517c15436637c71f6dcf7.translatedText: R. Sean Evans, an archivist at the Crane Library, sees it differently.

d93f6f068f844f8e18004501f2cd3bfbce2a4863.sourceText: 他表示，很容易得出结论，因为这些隧道是在铁路建设时代之后建造的，所以不太可能由中国铁路工人建造或使用。由于隧道的规模和目的，隧道不太可能进行任何形式的非法活动。埃文斯说“建筑物间的隧道大部分是为了方便自己的业务来往而建造的，而且并不宽泛。” [62]
d93f6f068f844f8e18004501f2cd3bfbce2a4863.translatedText: He said it was easy to conclude that because the tunnels were built after the era of railway construction, they were unlikely to have been built or used by Chinese railway workers. Due to its size and purpose, the tunnel is unlikely to host any form of illegal activity. Evans said that "most of the tunnels between buildings were built to facilitate their own business and were not wide." [62]

ced876f2d62aff810d88029c3243f4243c46a081.sourceText: 到1920年代，弗拉格斯塔夫已是一个有数千人口的城镇，电力公司在建筑物的地下挖隧道以输送电力。 像许多建筑项目一样， 41条隧道大部分是由中国工人开挖的，他们需要工作，为几分钱而工作。 [63]
ced876f2d62aff810d88029c3243f4243c46a081.translatedText: By the 1920s, Flagstaff was a town of several thousand people, and electric companies dug tunnels under buildings to deliver electricity. Like many construction projects, the 41 tunnels were dug mostly by Chinese workers who needed to work and worked for pennies. [63]

ab449b81c94ce19fb4b602ca038f2dcac57b4ec5.sourceText: 从上述的报道可以看到，当时的社会对华人有着严重不当的指控和歧视。
ab449b81c94ce19fb4b602ca038f2dcac57b4ec5.translatedText: From the above reports, we can see that the society at that time had serious and inappropriate accusations and discrimination against the Chinese.

b464858d4424f90a7cc463afeaee44b060a90892.sourceText: 2019年 8月23日，在弗拉格斯塔夫有一个著名的展览，展览名为“韧性：弗拉格斯塔夫过去和现在的妇女”。这是亚利桑那州历史学会（AHS）和北亚利桑那大学马丁·史普林格研究所的一项合作项目。展览分享了二十位女性的动人故事，她们曾面临过巨大的挑战，克服了艰辛，痛苦和不利。 [64] 早期从中国移民到弗拉格斯塔夫（Flagstaff）的谢瑶（英文姓名: Dew Yu Wong），是展览中的人物之一。该作品在先锋博物馆（Pioneer Museum）和在线展览中展出。
b464858d4424f90a7cc463afeaee44b060a90892.translatedText: On August 23, 2019, there was a famous exhibition in Flagstaff called "Resilience: Women of Flagstaff Past and Present." This is a collaborative project between the Arizona Historical Society (AHS) and the Martin Springer Institute at Northern Arizona University. The exhibition shares the moving stories of twenty women who have faced tremendous challenges and overcame hardship, pain and disadvantage. [64] Xie Yao (English name: Dew Yu Wong), who immigrated from China to Flagstaff in the early days, is one of the characters in the exhibition. The work is on display at the Pioneer Museum and online.

5dc5c3f317f6749ea6919acc4a9398f835f86ed0.sourceText: 华人历史新书“永不孤单” （ NeverAlone ）

bb958f4a063c7f1630174542e1bfd0cd69751c7a.sourceText: 2021年3月，80岁的Jimmy June Wong出版了他的新书《永不孤单》（Never Alone）。作者的中文姓名读音是“Wong Ben hai”, (笔者译为“黄炳海”，因其家中兄弟以“炳”字排名)。
bb958f4a063c7f1630174542e1bfd0cd69751c7a.translatedText: In March 2021, 80-year-old Jimmy June Wong published his new book "Never Alone". The author's Chinese name is pronounced "Wong Ben hai" (the author translated it as "Huang Binghai" because his brothers in the family are ranked with the character "Bing").

85cc64224a0a68c3fc8a5a43a23abfea322fdfd0.sourceText: 作者的祖父是1850年代从中国来美的移民。这个故事基于许多稀有的历史文献和照片，描述了他的祖父和父母及其九个兄弟姐妹真实的故事，以及他们为适应美国生活方式所做出的努力。
85cc64224a0a68c3fc8a5a43a23abfea322fdfd0.translatedText: The author's grandfather was an immigrant from China in the 1850s. The story, based on many rare historical documents and photographs, tells the true story of his grandfather and parents and their nine siblings, and their efforts to adapt to the American way of life.

51ef9062f1f326e51982ee002434ac49d0b84b47.sourceText: 作者在“永不孤单”回忆录中提到，如果我的祖父没有计划离开中国为我的家人找到更好的生活，我很可能会在中国农村里勉强生存。我们在美国扎根的尝试并不容易。我们遇到了种族主义，在天使岛的移民噩梦，《排华法案》，以及对驱逐出境的持续恐惧，我们试图适应。我父亲的第一任妻子是一个“绑小脚”的女人。我们努力创建了“美国洗衣店”和“美国厨房”这样的企业。我们有一个大家庭，我们在学校学习刻苦，每个人，无论我们年龄多大，都在家族企业中工作。
51ef9062f1f326e51982ee002434ac49d0b84b47.translatedText: The author mentioned in the memoir "Never Alone" that if my grandfather had not planned to leave China to find a better life for my family, I would probably be barely surviving in rural China. Our attempts to put down roots in the United States were not easy. We encountered racism, the immigration nightmare on Angel Island, the Chinese Exclusion Act, and the constant fear of deportation as we tried to adapt. My father's first wife was a woman with "tied feet." We worked hard to create businesses like American Laundry and American Kitchen. We have a big family, we study hard in school, and everyone, no matter our age, works in the family business.

0c735baceeeccdf5630becc0aae850c7a195e805.sourceText: 1915年，Jimmy June Wong的父亲黃世质（英文姓名: June Wong）和母亲谢瑶（Dew Yu Wong），由旧金山搬到亚利桑那的弗拉格斯塔夫（Flagstaff）小镇。他们买下了一间洗衣房，抚养了9个孩子， Jimmy是家中最小的儿子。他在书中分享了他的家人移民美国的经历，以及童年和成长的有趣而凄美的故事。书中保存了许多有关家族历史的论文，图片，文件和纪念品，其中许多都是稀有的，甚至在图书馆或馆藏中都找不到。 [65]
0c735baceeeccdf5630becc0aae850c7a195e805.translatedText: In 1915, Jimmy June Wong’s father Huang Shizhi (English name: June Wong) and mother Xie Yao (Dew Yu Wong) moved from San Francisco to the small town of Flagstaff, Arizona. They bought a laundry room and raised nine children, Jimmy being the youngest son. In the book, he shares his family's experience immigrating to the United States, as well as funny and poignant stories of his childhood and growing up. Many papers, pictures, documents and memorabilia about the family's history are preserved in the book, many of which are rare and cannot even be found in libraries or collections. [65]

cda44590387b60ca6c1f56e365762ec739028d70.sourceText: 笔者购得了这本书。在亚利桑那弗拉格斯塔夫（Flagstaff），这是唯一的一本记载华人家庭历史的书籍。这个家庭从1850代起至今已跨越了六代人，书中有许多华人早期的遭遇、拼博、失败和成功的故事，十分具有时代感。我们将在本文第四章与大家分享其中的故事。
cda44590387b60ca6c1f56e365762ec739028d70.translatedText: >The author purchased this book. This is the only book chronicling the history of a Chinese family in Flagstaff, Arizona. This family has spanned six generations since the 1850s. The book contains many stories of early Chinese encounters, struggles, failures and successes, which is very contemporary. We will share the story with you in Chapter 4 of this article.

9ccd04aea09a12f018f2756c8db21a35779598d5.sourceText: 金黄酥脆真功夫–海城美食新推“古法手烤乳猪”（图） 溪墨 广东人婚宴无烧猪不成席，可见其在粤菜中的独特地位。如果溯源，烤乳猪的历史要从西周算起，那时称为”炮豚”，属于”八珍”之一。以后历代都是珍馐美味，《齐民要术》还详细记录了它的特色和加工方法。到清朝初期更成为满汉全席;主打菜，获得朝野青睐并一直在官府和民间流行。再后来，烹调技术不断发展改良，人手烧烤发展到密封式烤炉，腌肉酱料不仅加入粤菜独有的海鲜酱，”皮水”令发展突破，演变出广东烧味独有的麻皮烧猪。 精选原料 正宗烧乳猪需采用九十天未戒奶，产自广东南雄县的幼猪。”海城”选用的乳猪均为四至五斤重，皮薄脂肪均匀。 密制酱料 师傅在处理乳猪前，均以麦芽糖及醋混成的密制酱料均匀的涂在乳猪外层表皮，醋酸令皮层收缩，破坏表皮纤维组织，另加热时更有效抽走水分，从而达到金黄酥脆的效果。再将面酱、料酒、芝麻酱及腐乳、蒜泥等调料均匀涂抹在猪膛内，用烤叉穿好，入炭火炉烤。 古法烧烤 ”海城美食”力求美食的原汁风味，返璞归真推出古法手烤乳猪，其原因是，正宗的烧乳猪，师傅需眼观火候变化，耳听乳猪受热发出的”嗞嗞”声。乳猪体积肥瘦比例每只不同，爆皮时间不同，只能凭师傅的经验以及听音控制。听到”嗞嗞”声代表需快速蒸发水分，但若温度太高，乳猪容易烧干。当乳猪表皮出现气泡后，需用竹签将气泡搓破，随即在表面刷油降温。而在适当的时候需要将乳猪移开炉火，防止烧焦。手烤乳猪吃的是师傅的技术，这种明火烧烤的焦香、酥化、松脆的手烤风味是封闭烤炉难以媲美的。 ”海城”另一新菜”北京片皮鸭”，同样受到广大饕餮食客的大力追捧。特色菜不再一一列举，还是请读者亲自去海城大快朵颐一番吧。
9ccd04aea09a12f018f2756c8db21a35779598d5.translatedText: Golden and crispy real Kung Fu – Haicheng Food’s new "Old Method Hand-roasted Suckling Pig" (photo) Ximo Cantonese people’s wedding banquets cannot be complete without roasted pig, which shows its unique status in Cantonese cuisine. If we trace its origins, the history of roasted suckling pig can be traced back to the Western Zhou Dynasty, when it was called "cannon pig" and was one of the "Eight Treasures". It has been a delicacy in all dynasties since then, and "Qi Min Yao Shu" also records its characteristics and processing methods in detail. In the early Qing Dynasty, it became the main dish of Manchu and Han banquets. It was favored by both the government and the public and has been popular among the government and the people. Later, cooking technology continued to develop and improve, and manual barbecues developed into sealed ovens. The marinated meat sauce was not only added with seafood sauce unique to Cantonese cuisine, but also "skin water" made a breakthrough in development, and the unique Cantonese roasted pork with pockmarked skin was evolved. Selected raw materials: Authentic roasted suckling pig must use young pigs that have not stopped breastfeeding for 90 days and are produced in Nanxiong County, Guangdong. The suckling pigs selected by "Haicheng" weigh four to five pounds, with thin skin and even fat. Dense Sauce Before handling the suckling pig, the chef evenly applies a dense sauce mixed with maltose and vinegar on the outer skin of the suckling pig. The acetic acid shrinks the skin and destroys the fibrous tissue of the skin. It also more effectively removes moisture when heated, thereby achieving a golden and crispy effect. Then spread the noodles sauce, cooking wine, sesame sauce, fermented bean curd, garlic paste and other seasonings evenly into the pig's chest, pierce it with a roasting fork, and bake it in the charcoal stove. The ancient barbecue "Haicheng Cuisine" strives for the original flavor of the food, returning to the original nature and launching the ancient hand-roasted suckling pig. The reason is that to authentically roast suckling pig, the chef needs to watch the changes in the heat and listen to the "sizzling" sound of the suckling pig when it is heated. The fat and thin ratio of each suckling pig is different, and the skin bursting time is different. It can only be controlled by the master's experience and listening to the sound. Hearing the "sizzling" sound means that the water needs to evaporate quickly, but if the temperature is too high, the suckling pig will easily burn dry. When bubbles appear on the skin of the suckling pig, use a bamboo skewer to break the bubbles, and then brush oil on the surface to cool down. At the appropriate time, the suckling pig needs to be removed from the fire to prevent it from burning. The hand-roasted suckling pig is a result of the skill of the master. The scorched, crispy, and crunchy hand-roasted flavor of this open-fire barbecue is difficult to match in a closed oven. Another new dish in "Haicheng", "Beijing Sliced ​​Duck", is also highly sought after by the majority of gourmet diners. I won’t list the special dishes one by one, but readers are invited to go to Haicheng and have a delicious meal in person.

bbaab510a01acba29d339772798379aeef9841b3.sourceText: 回美证是允许持有绿卡或有条件绿卡的移民在离开美国一段时间以后再返回美国时不需要到美国大使馆或领事馆办理回美签证的一种文件。 如果绿卡持有者在离开美国之前就已经知道自己会在美国境外停留超过一年时间，那么，绿卡持有者就可以在离开美国之前申请’回美证’.相反，如果你在美国境外停留的时间少于一年，您则不需要申请回美证，直接凭借您的绿卡就可以重新进入美国。在申请回美证后，美国移民局会书面通知您前往当地的Application Support Center打手指模的时间。 总体来说，回美证允许其持有人在境外停留时间从发证日期起不超过两年的时间。对于持有有条件绿卡的申请者，回美证有效期的计算方式略有不同，两年境外停留有效时间或从颁发回美证之日算起，或申请取消条件之日算起，但是以最早的日期为准。请注意，两年有效境外停留是回美证最长有效期，不得申请延长。 由于申请回美证要求申请者必须在美国境内提出，所以对于已经在美国境外的绿卡持有者来讲，如果您有意在美国境外停留时间超过一年而又没有申请回美证，美国移民局会假定你放弃永久居民或有条件居民的身份。需要注意的是，回美证本身并不会阻止出入境口岸工作人员发现并判断你已经放弃了永久居民身份，但是，至少使得海关官员在回美证有效期间内，不得单凭在海外拘留时间来判断你是否放弃了永久居民身份。 除此之外，出入境工作人员仍然可能在您入境时盘问您在美国境外的时间，从而判断你在境外的活动是否与准许入境有关，还可以通过回美证来判断回美证是否通过欺诈或失实陈述而获得的。可见回美证并非万无一失，若持有回美证的人员被发现曾有超期境外停留的情形，同样可被拒绝入境。
bbaab510a01acba29d339772798379aeef9841b3.translatedText: A reentry permit is a document that allows immigrants holding a green card or a conditional green card to return to the United States after leaving the United States for a period of time without having to apply for a return visa at the U.S. embassy or consulate. If the green card holder knows that he will stay outside the United States for more than one year before leaving the United States, the green card holder can apply for a 'reentry permit' before leaving the United States. On the contrary, if you stay outside the United States for less than one year, you do not need to apply for a reentry permit and can re-enter the United States directly with your green card. After applying for a re-entry permit, the US Citizenship and Immigration Service will notify you in writing of the time to go to the local Application Support Center to have your fingerprints taken. Generally speaking, a re-entry permit allows its holder to stay abroad for no more than two years from the date of issuance. For applicants holding conditional green cards, the validity period of the re-entry permit is calculated slightly differently. The validity period of the two-year stay abroad is calculated from the date of issuance of the re-entry permit or the date of application to cancel the conditions, but whichever date is the earliest. Please note that two years of valid overseas stay is the maximum validity period of the return permit and no application for extension is allowed. Since applying for a re-entry permit requires applicants to apply within the United States, for green card holders who are already outside the United States, if you intend to stay outside the United States for more than one year without applying for a re-entry permit, the US Immigration Service will assume that you have given up your status as a permanent resident or conditional resident. It should be noted that the re-entry permit itself will not prevent the entry-exit port staff from discovering and judging that you have given up your permanent resident status. However, at least it will prevent customs officials from judging whether you have given up your permanent resident status solely based on the time you have been detained overseas while the re-entry permit is valid. In addition, immigration staff may still question you about the time you spent outside the United States when you enter the country to determine whether your overseas activities are related to your entry permit. They can also use the re-entry permit to determine whether the re-entry permit was obtained through fraud or misrepresentation. It can be seen that the re-entry permit is not foolproof. If a person holding a re-entry permit is found to have overstayed his stay abroad, he may also be refused entry.

8adabd5c8a2919ad43724715292237dfb2b4347f.sourceText: 巴布警长被宣布无罪 亚利桑那州检察长上周五宣布，巴布警长警长被指控威胁要将他的一名男性情人递解出境的控罪不成立，巴布警长无罪。 今年早些时候，皮纳尔县巴布警长要求有关方面就他的前男友俄洛兹科对他的指控进行调查。俄洛兹科指责巴贝乌滥用职权，对他进行了威胁和恐吓。 巴贝乌当时承认他是男性同性恋者，并与俄洛兹科有特别关系。俄洛兹科据称来自墨西哥。巴贝乌否认他曾经威胁要将俄洛兹科递解出境。 巴贝乌也对俄洛兹科进行了反击，指控俄洛兹科曾经利用与他有关的网站和推特账户进行财物偷窃和身份偷窃。 周五，检察长科尔在一份声明中说，总检察官办公室将不会对巴贝乌或俄洛兹科提起指控。本调查确认，巴贝乌没有犯下任何的刑事罪行；尽管俄洛兹科的行为可能构成犯法，但除了一项轻罪指控外，对他并没有合理的定罪可能。 州总检察长霍恩是一名共和党人。他今年2月说，他的部门会对巴布的行为进行调查。当时巴布是共和党总统大选提名人罗姆尼在亚利桑那州竞选机构的联合主席。调查开始之后，巴布辞去了该项职务。 巴布在8月31日发表声明说：”真相终于大白。我受到了这些虚假指控的人身攻击、职业攻击和政治上的攻击。如今我已经得到昭雪。”
8adabd5c8a2919ad43724715292237dfb2b4347f.translatedText: Sheriff Babb was acquitted. The Arizona Attorney General announced Friday that Sheriff Babb was not guilty of a charge that he threatened to deport one of his male lovers. Earlier this year, Pinal County Sheriff Babb asked authorities to investigate allegations made against him by his ex-boyfriend Orozko. Orozko accused Babeu of abusing his power and threatening and intimidating him. Babeu admitted at the time that he was gay and had a special relationship with Orozko. Orozco is said to be from Mexico. Babeu denies that he ever threatened to deport Orozko. Babeu also hit back at Orozko, accusing Orozko of using websites and Twitter accounts associated with him to commit property theft and identity theft. Attorney General Cole said in a statement on Friday that the AG's office would not bring charges against Babeu or Orozko. This investigation determined that Babeu had not committed any criminal offense; while Orozko's conduct may have constituted a crime, there was no reasonable prospect of conviction against him other than a misdemeanor charge. State Attorney General Horn is a Republican. He said in February that his department would investigate Babb's behavior. At the time, Barb was co-chairman of Republican presidential nominee Mitt Romney's Arizona campaign. After the investigation began, Babb resigned from that position. Babb issued a statement on August 31, saying: "The truth has finally come out. I have been personally, professionally and politically attacked by these false accusations. Now I have been cleared."

4d3035ddfe9e512a18b7aba1dfc1a4a999722974.sourceText: 中国表演艺术家洛城挥毫飙书 国风?#20013;国表演艺术家书画展 （本报驻洛杉矶记者甄松伟摄影报导） 中国著名表演艺术家姜昆，唐国强，张铁林，郁钧剑等，应联合国书画会邀请，经中国文联挑选特邀2月2日在纽约联合国总部举办《国 风?#20013;国表演艺术家书画展》，此次访美的艺术家都是中国家喻户晓的超级明星，他们不仅德艺双馨，在演艺界取得举世瞩目的成就，也是学养深厚，，技艺高超的著名书画家 。 这次在联合国和洛杉矶举行书画展，堪称中国艺术界对外交流的一盛事。 中国艺术家一行3日到达洛杉矶，为一睹中国著名的表演艺术家的风采，洛杉矶地区侨胞3日晚共聚一堂，与前来洛杉矶举办书画展的艺术家们共度春节，欢迎晚宴在洛杉矶御珍楼举行 ，出席晚宴的有中国总领馆文化参赞车兆和，新闻领事乐利文，洛杉矶县政委员安东诺维奇以及夫人胡惠玲，名人政要，侨领侨胞近300人出席。 晚宴上姜昆表演了精彩的相声小段，唐国强为大家再现了《三国演义》诸葛亮出山的片段，张铁林与卞小贞来一段现代京剧《沙家浜》，郁钧剑演唱了一首中国民歌，博得现场 侨胞阵阵掌声，艺术家们还现场即席挥毫，赠送给抽奖的观众。 姜昆在接受媒体采访时表示，老一辈艺术家基本上都是琴棋书画样样精通，可见艺术爱好在沟通人的情感，激发人的文化情趣，甚至艺术创作灵感方面。 曾在英国留学的张铁林表示，文化传承是一个过程，也是文化工作者的一种职责，我虽然多次扮演皇帝，但是我的书画方面还是个”小兵”。 据了解，这次访美参加书画展的除了姜昆，唐国强，张铁林，郁钧剑，还有中国文联副主席著名书画家覃志刚，徐沛东，每人均展出多年来创作的15幅字画作品，这几位 中国著名的表演艺术家不仅在表演艺术领域成就卓著，在书画艺术方面也有很深的造诣。
4d3035ddfe9e512a18b7aba1dfc1a4a999722974.translatedText: Chinese performing artist Luo Cheng Hui Hao Biao Shu National style?#20013; National performing artist calligraphy and painting exhibition (Photography by our reporter in Los Angeles, Zhen Songwei) Famous Chinese performing artists Jiang Kun, Tang Guoqiang, Zhang Tielin, Yu Junjian, etc. were invited by the United Nations Calligraphy and Painting Society and selected by the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles to hold the "National "Feng?#20013; Calligraphy and Painting Exhibition of Chinese Performing Artists", the artists visiting the United States this time are all well-known superstars in China. They are not only talented in virtue and art, and have made world-renowned achievements in the entertainment industry, but they are also well-known calligraphers and painters with profound knowledge and superb skills. This calligraphy and painting exhibition held at the United Nations and Los Angeles can be regarded as a grand event for the Chinese art world's foreign exchanges. A group of Chinese artists arrived in Los Angeles on the 3rd. In order to see the famous Chinese performing artists, overseas Chinese in the Los Angeles area gathered together on the evening of the 3rd to spend the Spring Festival with the artists who came to Los Angeles to hold a calligraphy and painting exhibition. The welcome dinner was held at the Yuzhen Building in Los Angeles. The dinner was attended by Che Zhaohe, cultural counselor of the Chinese Consulate General, Le Liwen, the press consul, Antonovich, the Los Angeles County Supervisor, his wife Hu Huiling, celebrities and dignitaries, and nearly 300 overseas Chinese leaders. At the dinner, Jiang Kun performed a wonderful cross talk segment, Tang Guoqiang recreated the scene of Zhuge Liang's appearance in "The Romance of the Three Kingdoms", Zhang Tielin and Bian Xiaozhen performed a modern Peking opera "Shajiabang", and Yu Junjian sang a Chinese folk song, which won bursts of applause from the overseas Chinese at the scene. The artists also improvised on the spot and gave them to the audience for the lottery. Jiang Kun said in an interview with the media that the older generation of artists are basically proficient in all kinds of music, chess, calligraphy and painting. It can be seen that art hobbies can communicate people's emotions, stimulate people's cultural interests, and even inspire artistic creation. Zhang Tielin, who once studied in the UK, said that cultural inheritance is a process and a responsibility of cultural workers. Although I have played the role of emperor many times, I am still a "little soldier" in calligraphy and painting. It is understood that in addition to Jiang Kun, Tang Guoqiang, Zhang Tielin, and Yu Junjian who visited the United States to participate in the calligraphy and painting exhibition, there are also famous calligraphers and painters Qin Zhigang and Xu Peidong, vice presidents of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles. Each of them exhibited 15 calligraphy and painting works created over the years. These famous Chinese performing artists not only have outstanding achievements in the field of performing arts, but also have profound attainments in calligraphy and painting.

44b6cbf5819da901107a084fc4958fd667749415.sourceText: 四川省副省长黄小祥在成都会见了州长,亚利桑那州的首府凤凰城与四川省省会成都是姊妹城市， 会见时双方交换了关于四川和亚利桑那州之间的友谊和合作关系的意见。州长在成都还参观访问了英特尔的制造工厂并与美国亚利桑那州立大学的其他代表一起在四川大学作了一个主题演讲。亚利桑那州长中国之行取得圆满成功，中国人民日报海外版刊登了亚利桑那州长代表团访华的消息。
44b6cbf5819da901107a084fc4958fd667749415.translatedText: Huang Xiaoxiang, Vice Governor of Sichuan Province, met with the governor in Chengdu. Phoenix, the capital of Arizona, and Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province, are sister cities. During the meeting, the two sides exchanged views on the friendship and cooperative relations between Sichuan and Arizona. The governor also visited Intel's manufacturing plant in Chengdu and delivered a keynote speech at Sichuan University with other representatives from Arizona State University. The Arizona Governor's trip to China was a complete success. The overseas edition of the Chinese People's Daily published the news of the Arizona Governor's delegation's visit to China.

03c35344cf60e999dc6f4354680c114ab3e37f6f.sourceText: 〔亚省华联供稿~侯峰报道〕亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院，亚利桑那州华人华侨联合总会沿袭以往惯例在”凤凰之夜”中秋国庆活动日举办中美文化论坛。今年是第三届，论坛的主题是《中美合作面面观》，于2011年9月18日下午3：00在亚利桑那州立大学隆重举行。两百余热衷于中美友好的各界人士，包括ASU的学者，学生，孔子学院师生，从事或感兴趣中美商贸的工商界人士参加了这次有许多挑战性话题的论坛。
03c35344cf60e999dc6f4354680c114ab3e37f6f.translatedText: [Contributed by the Hualian Federation of Alberta ~ Reported by Hou Feng] The Confucius Institute at Arizona State University and the Arizona Overseas Chinese Federation followed past practices and held a Sino-US cultural forum on the "Phoenix Night" Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day event. This year is the third session. The theme of the forum is "Aspects of Sino-US Cooperation". It was held grandly at 3:00 pm on September 18, 2011 at Arizona State University. More than two hundred people from all walks of life who are passionate about Sino-US friendship, including ASU scholars, students, teachers and students of the Confucius Institute, and business people engaged in or interested in Sino-US business, participated in this forum with many challenging topics.

105eb3b9cf7440205a80d480c345cca6df52d612.sourceText: 中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆陈准民参赞用翔实的数据介绍过去一年中国经济稳健发展，中美经贸互惠互利继续扩大，美国对中国出口快速增长，特别是来自中国的游客和留学生为美国带来数十亿美元的收入和百万工作机会。去年中国赴美留学生上升超过30%，超过印度再次成为最大的留学生来源国。黄皮肤黑头发，风华正茂的学子们是美国校园里的亮点。
105eb3b9cf7440205a80d480c345cca6df52d612.translatedText: Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles Chen The civilian counselor used detailed data to introduce the steady development of China's economy over the past year. The mutual benefits of Sino-US economic and trade continued to expand, and the US exports to China grew rapidly. In particular, tourists and students from China brought billions of dollars in income and millions of job opportunities to the United States. Last year, the number of Chinese students studying in the United States increased by more than 30%, surpassing India once again and becoming the largest source of international students. Students with yellow skin and black hair who are in their prime are the bright spots on American campuses.

f9a2de004a33ad57c4db8f94b80eada995582cb9.sourceText: 陈伟博士，Embedded and Communications Group 总经理， Intel China，曾经是凤凰城现代中文学校家长篮球队的活跃分子，一个把凤凰城称作第二故乡的杭州人。当他7年前被Intel派往上海封装厂负责管理工作的时候，一个同行问他：你离开中国多少年了？陈伟说17年了。朋友摇摇头说，中国是一个快速改变的国家，一个单位如果你离开半年回来可能都跟不上趟，错过中国社会17年的大变革，你的工作中将会面临巨大的挑战。陈伟详细讲述了他面对的再次的文化冲击，许多不顺心，不习惯的社会现象，抱着一种尊重历史，相信中国会在未来十年二十年变得越来越好的包容心态去面对，成功地在美国老板和中国员工间建起一条不同文化，不同经营理念，不同管理方式衔接纽带。Intel 1998年进入中国，现在有16个城市有Intel的设施机构，雇员8000人。Intel中国占Intel全部业务量的16.5%。作为一个华人，陈伟为祖国的许多进步感到由衷的自豪。陈伟经常往返上海和故乡杭州之间，每次乘高铁回家效率非常高，误差从来没超过五分钟，简直太快了。不像过去，从杭州到上海要费半天的功夫，现在坐下来，喝杯茶，喘口气，本想休息一下都来不及就到了。
f9a2de004a33ad57c4db8f94b80eada995582cb9.translatedText: Dr. Chen Wei, general manager of Embedded and Communications Group, Intel China, was once an active member of the parent basketball team of Phoenix Modern Chinese School, a Hangzhou native who calls Phoenix his second hometown. When he was sent by Intel to take charge of management work at the Shanghai packaging plant seven years ago, a colleague asked him: How many years have it been since you left China? Chen Wei said it has been 17 years. My friend shook his head and said that China is a rapidly changing country. If you leave an organization for half a year and come back, you may not be able to keep up. If you miss the 17 years of major changes in Chinese society, you will face huge challenges at work. Chen Wei described in detail the cultural shock he faced again and the many social phenomena he was not accustomed to. He faced it with a respect for history and believed that China would become more and more tolerant in the next ten or twenty years. He successfully built a link between American bosses and Chinese employees with different cultures, different business concepts, and different management methods. Intel entered China in 1998 and now has Intel facilities in 16 cities with 8,000 employees. Intel China accounts for 16.5% of Intel's total business volume. As a Chinese, Chen Wei is sincerely proud of the many progress of his motherland. Chen Wei often travels between Shanghai and his hometown of Hangzhou. Every time he takes the high-speed train home, it is very efficient. The error never exceeds five minutes. It is simply too fast. Unlike in the past, it took half a day to get from Hangzhou to Shanghai. Now, when I sit down, drink a cup of tea, and take a breath, I arrive before I even have time to take a rest.

16b6a7124c23108cb67ac4063db6b53700456914.sourceText: Rudy Vetter，大凤凰城经济委员会国际贸易部资深副总裁，以一个充满豪情的题目吸引大家的注意：”亚利桑那－新的西海岸 怎样的地理和经济上的巨大竞争优势吸引中国企业”。Veter先生介绍的大凤凰城地区的投资环境，凤凰城紧邻美国最大的州加州和港口，以及其他临近州构成一日供货圈，一年有300天日照，气候适合许多产业，没有重大自然灾害，有325个高尔夫球场，众多的艺术画廊和休闲场所，生活方便，房地产及生活费用低廉，有十分具有吸引力的政府工业激励计划，已经吸引了包括美国太阳能产业市场占有率最大的中国企业Suntech入住Goodyear。
16b6a7124c23108cb67ac4063db6b53700456914.translatedText: > Rudy Vetter, senior vice president of the International Trade Department of the Greater Phoenix Economic Council, attracted everyone's attention with a passionate topic: "Arizona-the new west coast, what kind of geographical and economic huge competitive advantages attract Chinese companies". Mr. Veter introduced the investment environment in the greater Phoenix area. Phoenix is ​​close to California, the largest state in the United States, and its ports, and forms a one-day supply circle with other neighboring states. There are 300 days of sunshine a year, the climate is suitable for many industries, there are no major natural disasters, there are 325 golf courses, numerous art galleries and leisure venues, life is convenient, real estate and living costs are low, and there is a very attractive government industrial incentive plan, which has attracted Chinese companies including Suntech, which has the largest market share in the U.S. solar industry, to move into Goodyear.

b1a8b3d17dd5a8a5fe0b6942f2ca91b82ccff024.sourceText: Jerry Liu，尚德电力Suntech Arizona 总经理。尚德电力是2001年由施正荣博士创立至今，短短十年已经成长为全球最大的晶硅组件制造商，分支机构遍布13个国家，有3个地区运营中心，分别在无锡，瑞士沙夫豪森和美国旧金山。2010年1月在美国投资建设了第一条生产线，并很快投入生产，现在已经开始三班倒全负荷生产，每年从中国进口4百万美元的太阳能板，在Goodyear组装后销往全国各地。刘先生带领他的管理团队介绍了尚德在Goodyear的工厂和技术是尚德最先进的生产线，并介绍光伏产业在亚利桑那这个多太阳的地区辉煌的前景。最后报告人集体回答听众的提问。Doreen，一个曾在中国修过一年课，刚从亚利桑那州立大学毕业的大学生，提问在美国长大的孩子如何在中国找工作和融入中国社会的问题，对我们许多第一代移民和子女确是一个很好和十分具有挑战的话题。亚省华联总会网站：www.chineseaz.org.
b1a8b3d17dd5a8a5fe0b6942f2ca91b82ccff024.translatedText: Jerry Liu, General Manager of Suntech Arizona. Suntech Power was founded by Dr. Shi Zhengrong in 2001. In just ten years, it has grown into the world's largest crystalline silicon component manufacturer, with branches in 13 countries and three regional operation centers in Wuxi, Schaffhausen, Switzerland, and San Francisco, the United States. In January 2010, it invested in the construction of the first production line in the United States and quickly put it into production. Now it has started three shifts of full-load production. It imports 4 million US dollars of solar panels from China every year, and sells them all over the country after being assembled in Goodyear. Mr. Liu led his management team to introduce Suntech's factory and technology in Goodyear, which is Suntech's most advanced production line, and introduced the brilliant prospects of the photovoltaic industry in this sun-rich region of Arizona. Finally, the speaker collectively answered the audience’s questions. Doreen, a college student who has studied in China for a year and has just graduated from Arizona State University, asked how children who grew up in the United States can find jobs in China and integrate into Chinese society. It is indeed a good and very challenging topic for many of us first-generation immigrants and their children. The website of the Chinese Federation of Alberta: www.chineseaz.org.

31a1f24e15cfaf2790ae82976946b11ac168bc22.translatedText: China has jumped to the third largest inbound tourist reception and the fourth largest outbound tourism consumer in the world. During the "Eleventh Five-Year Plan" period, Chinese domestic tourists...

d20c8f79371f953c7b433ccc32b351f3452759c8.sourceText: 中国跃居全球第三大入境游接待国和第四大出境游消费国 ”十一五”期间，中国国内旅游人数年均增长12％；入境过夜旅游人数年均增长3．5％；出境旅游人数年均增长19％，我国目前已跃居全球第三大入境旅游接待国和第四大出境旅游消费国。 国家旅游局旅游促进与国际合作司司长满宏卫9日在此间举行的新闻发布会上说，过去的五年，在政府的大力支持下，中国旅游行业紧抓机遇，借助北京奥运会、上海世博会等有利时机，妥善应对汶川特大地震灾害、国际金融危机等众多不利因素冲击，完成了”十一五”规划确定的主要任务，旅游业保持了平稳较快发展的良好势头：全国旅游业总收入年均增长15％；居民人均出游率达1．5次；旅游消费对社会消费的贡献超过10％。旅游业对我国经济社会发展的积极作用更加突显。 据统计，2010年中国旅游业实现了平稳较快增长，国内旅游人数21亿人次，同比增长10．6％；旅游业总收入1．57万亿元，同比增长21．7％；旅游直接就业达1350万人；入境过夜旅游人数5566万人次，同比增长9．4％，已成为世界第三大旅游目的地；旅游外汇收入458亿美元，同比增长15．5％；出境旅游人数5739万人次，同比增长20．4％。 满宏卫说，2011年是中国”十二五”的开局之年，中国旅游业将以科学发展为主题，以转变发展方式为主线，”全面发展国内旅游、积极发展入境旅游、有序发展出境旅游”，努力保持我国旅游业的持续较快发展。
d20c8f79371f953c7b433ccc32b351f3452759c8.translatedText: China has jumped to the third largest inbound tourist reception and fourth largest outbound tourism consumer in the world. During the "Eleventh Five-Year Plan" period, the number of domestic tourists in China increased by an average of 12% annually; the number of inbound overnight tourists increased by an average of 3.5%; and the number of outbound tourists increased by an average of 19%. my country has now become the world's third largest inbound tourism receiving country and the fourth largest outbound tourism consumer. Man Hongwei, director of the Department of Tourism Promotion and International Cooperation of the National Tourism Administration, said at a press conference held here on the 9th that in the past five years, with the strong support of the government, China’s tourism industry has seized opportunities and taken advantage of favorable opportunities such as the Beijing Olympics and the Shanghai World Expo to properly respond to the Wenchuan earthquake disaster, international Despite the impact of many unfavorable factors such as the financial crisis, the main tasks set in the "Eleventh Five-Year Plan" have been completed, and the tourism industry has maintained a good momentum of stable and rapid development: the total national tourism revenue has grown at an average annual rate of 15%; the per capita travel rate of residents has reached 1.5 times; tourism consumption has contributed more than 10% to social consumption. The positive role of tourism in my country's economic and social development has become more prominent. According to statistics, China's tourism industry achieved steady and rapid growth in 2010, with 2.1 billion domestic tourists, a year-on-year increase of 10.6%; total tourism revenue was 1.57 trillion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 21.7%; tourism directly employed 13.5 million people; The number of overseas overnight tourists was 55.66 million, a year-on-year increase of 9.4%, making it the world's third largest tourist destination; tourism foreign exchange revenue was US$45.8 billion, a year-on-year increase of 15.5%; the number of outbound tourists was 57.39 million, a year-on-year increase of 20.4%. Man Hongwei said that 2011 is the first year of China's "Twelfth Five-Year Plan". China's tourism industry will take scientific development as the theme and change the development mode as the main line. It will "comprehensively develop domestic tourism, actively develop inbound tourism, and develop outbound tourism in an orderly manner" and strive to maintain the sustained and rapid development of my country's tourism industry.

0a5dc492ebbabbcb0f9734ba73fb81d597a6cdee.sourceText: 投资移民竞相注资 特许学校翻身
0a5dc492ebbabbcb0f9734ba73fb81d597a6cdee.translatedText: Investment immigrants are competing to inject capital, and charter schools are turning over.

5abb3494ab4b7bbbbb627bd112ccb0ed9d67c7e6.sourceText: 投资移民竞相注资 特许学校翻身 美国的特许学校(charter schools)正处于艰困期，有些财务状况…
5abb3494ab4b7bbbbb627bd112ccb0ed9d67c7e6.translatedText: Investment immigrants are competing to inject capital, and charter schools are turning over. Charter schools in the United States are in a difficult period, and some financial conditions are...

adff88574ed1e33b59fdb1402d6417242caf8417.sourceText: 投资移民竞相注资 特许学校翻身 美国的特许学校(charter schools)正处于艰困期，有些财务状况不佳，有些因表现不好面临州政府管理机构关闭的命运。 但是，希望取得绿卡的外国投资者为它们带来了「生机」。 富有的外国投资人利用联邦移民当局的「EB-5」签证计画，向这些特许学校大量投资，大兴土木，借以为自己和家人取得在美居留身分，特许学校也因此受惠。 来自中国、奈及利亚、俄罗斯和澳洲的富人，正投资数百万甚至数千万美元，为美国的特许学校兴建教室、图书馆、篮球场、科学实验室。 纽约州水牛城、本州佛罗伦斯市的特许学校都出现外国富人投资计画。 佛罗里达州商业发展厅官员说，外国人在特许学校的投资额明年可望增为早先的三倍，达到9000万元。 投资于特许学校如此盛行，主要是因为外国投资者认为，他们的投资将不受经济衰退影响。 中国一个投资论坛网站今年春天宣传投资美国特许学校，宣称此种投资不会失败，因为美国政府会稳定地向特许学校提供经费。 根据全名为「第五类优先就业型计画」的「EB-5」签证计画，外国人向美国指定的目标就业区(TEA，失业率为国家平均失业率的1.5倍)或偏远地区 投资50万美元，即可为自己和家人取得绿卡。 如在其他地区投资，则需100万元。 过去20年，这类外国人投资大部分集中于商业房地产开发计画，像是豪华大饭店、滑雪胜地，甚至加油站。 但是，有企业头脑的经纪人从这个签证计画找到了赚钱的黄金机会，把亟需现金的特许学校与富有的外国投资人「撮合」到一起，让一方如愿拿到绿卡，一方得以扩充学校 。 投资顾问云格瑞说：「学校这一方的需求相当庞大，投资方也是一样。」他两年前创立「美国教育资金公司」(Education Fund of America)，专精于让外国投资者找到需要资金 的美国特许学校。 他说，他目前正为北卡罗来纳、犹他及亚利桑纳州共11所特许学校安排「EB-5」签证投资，还有更多交易在进行中。 他强调：「这只是开始，这个计画将有爆炸性的成长。」
adff88574ed1e33b59fdb1402d6417242caf8417.translatedText: Investment immigrants are competing to inject capital, and charter schools are turning over. Charter schools in the United States are in a difficult period. Some are in poor financial condition, and some are facing the fate of closure by state government agencies due to poor performance. However, foreign investors hoping to obtain green cards have brought "life" to them. Wealthy foreign investors took advantage of the federal immigration authorities' "EB-5" visa program to invest heavily in these charter schools and build large-scale construction projects to obtain residency status in the United States for themselves and their families, and charter schools also benefited. Rich people from China, Nigeria, Russia and Australia are investing millions or even tens of millions of dollars to build classrooms, libraries, basketball courts and science laboratories for charter schools in the United States. Charter schools in Buffalo, New York, and Florence, New York, have seen investment plans by wealthy foreigners. Officials with the Florida Department of Business Development say foreign investment in charter schools is expected to triple next year, reaching $90 million. Investing in charter schools is so popular largely because foreign investors believe their investments will be recession-proof. A Chinese investment forum website promoted investment in U.S. charter schools this spring, claiming that such investments would not fail because the U.S. government would steadily provide funding to charter schools. According to the "EB-5" visa program, whose full name is the "Fifth Category Priority Employment Program," foreigners can obtain green cards for themselves and their families by investing US$500,000 in designated Target Employment Areas (TEAs) or remote areas in the United States, where the unemployment rate is 1.5 times the national average unemployment rate. If investing in other areas, 1 million yuan is required. Over the past 20 years, much of this foreign investment has been in commercial real estate developments, such as luxury hotels, ski resorts and even gas stations. However, corporate-minded brokers found a golden opportunity to make money from this visa program, "matching" cash-hungry charter schools with wealthy foreign investors, allowing one to get a green card and the other to expand the school. "The demand on the school side is huge, and so are the investors," said investment consultant Yun Gere, who founded Education Fund of America two years ago and specializes in helping foreign investors find U.S. charter schools in need of funding. He said he is currently arranging "EB-5" visa investments for a total of 11 charter schools in North Carolina, Utah and Arizona, with more deals in the works. He stressed: "This is just the beginning, this project will have explosive growth."

5c67d50111c9669228800b507d33c4f48fcb094d.translatedText: Forbes: The American dream comes true, foreign immigrants among the richest people in the United States This year, Forbes listed nearly ten of the 400 richest people in the United States...

1f40a559cc6036e099abf30fdbfd31a16e58f0b3.sourceText: 《福布斯》美国富豪榜中的移民亿万富豪37位个人加上两对夫妻，共创造出39笔亿万财富，他们分布在各行各业，但多集中在高科技、金融和零售领域。
1f40a559cc6036e099abf30fdbfd31a16e58f0b3.translatedText: There are 37 immigrant billionaires on the Forbes list of American richest people, plus two couples, who have created a total of 39 billionaires. They are distributed in various industries, but most of them are concentrated in high-tech, finance and retail fields.

f477e3d1ca68389bbe2970dcd0f292ec8dcdd0fa.sourceText: 不少成功移民企业家为着名的美国企业做出了重要贡献，例如谷歌的联合创始人布林（Sergey Brin）出生在俄罗斯的犹太家庭；雅虎公司（Yahoo）联合创始人杨致远（Jerry Yang）出生于台湾；电子港湾（eBay）的创始人奥米迪亚（Pierre Omidyar）来自法国，以及帮助创办eBay的斯克尔（Jeffrey Skoll）是加拿大人。仅这三家公司就雇用了美国将近9万名员工。
f477e3d1ca68389bbe2970dcd0f292ec8dcdd0fa.translatedText: >Many successful immigrant entrepreneurs have made important contributions to well-known American companies, such as Google co-founder Sergey Brin who was born in a Jewish family in Russia; Yahoo co-founder Jerry Yang was born in Taiwan; eBay founder Pierre Omidyar is from France, and Jeffrey Skoll, who helped found eBay, is Canadian. These three companies alone employ nearly 90,000 people in the United States.

c0b5d2fc12610ac75bd74657778f94f5cfce9b74.sourceText: 榜单中的其他人创立了许多人经常光顾的商店和餐厅。包括Forever 21是韩裔夫妇张东文（Do Won Chang）张金淑（Jin Sook）创立的，熊猫连锁快餐店（Panda Express）的掌门人程正昌与蒋佩琪夫妇（Andrew and Peggy Cherng）。创建了超级战队（Power Rangers）品牌的以色列大亨萨班（Haim Saban）。
c0b5d2fc12610ac75bd74657778f94f5cfce9b74.translatedText: >Others on the list have created shops and restaurants that many people frequent. These include Forever 21, founded by Korean couple Do Won Chang and Jin Sook, and Andrew and Peggy Cherng, the owners of the Panda Express chain. Haim Saban, the Israeli tycoon who founded the Power Rangers brand.

1e4a117afe6ae53558eedeaea08b75ad1e976096.sourceText: 移民富豪多居加州、纽约 来自大中国区占7位
1e4a117afe6ae53558eedeaea08b75ad1e976096.translatedText: Most of the rich immigrants live in California and New York. Seven people are from Greater China.

b4e956dc159b19c1ac68d189951fed039fa6e936.sourceText: 这些移民富豪过半数都居住在拥有金州之称的加州，其次是纽约州。在美国富豪榜400位上榜富豪的2万亿（兆）美元财富中，仅这两个州的移民富豪财富总和就占2000亿美元。近一半来自6个国家与地区：中国、匈牙利、印度、以色列、俄罗斯和台湾。
b4e956dc159b19c1ac68d189951fed039fa6e936.translatedText: More than half of these rich immigrants live in California, known as the Golden State, followed by New York State. Among the US$2 trillion in wealth of the 400 richest people in the United States, the combined wealth of immigrant rich in these two states alone accounts for US$200 billion. Nearly half come from 6 countries and regions: China, Hungary, India, Israel, Russia and Taiwan.

7eab5afc669e7a594a9c174b0b13c0fcd95ba662.sourceText: 其中来自大中国区占了7位。若算上南非出生的陈颂雄（Patrick Soon-Shiong），则有8位。陈拥有财富90亿美元，从事制药业，亦是南非第一大富豪。父母亲来自中国，二战期间迁往南非。
7eab5afc669e7a594a9c174b0b13c0fcd95ba662.translatedText: Among them, 7 are from Greater China. If you include South African-born Patrick Soon-Shiong, there are 8. With a fortune of US$9 billion, Chen is engaged in the pharmaceutical industry and is South Africa's richest man. My parents were from China and moved to South Africa during World War II.

ebe600368c1077c651b738b76d2c5fba5bdf2223.sourceText: 来自台湾的孙大卫（David Sun）和来自中国的杜纪川（John Tu）各拥有40亿美元财富。他两于1987年在车库里创立了金士顿科技（Kingston Technology）公司。
ebe600368c1077c651b738b76d2c5fba5bdf2223.translatedText: David Sun from Taiwan and John Tu from China each have a fortune of US$4 billion. The two founded Kingston Technology in a garage in 1987.

192597872a132f0020d7f002b7276b2a78e8a780.sourceText: 王恒（Roger Wang Hung，1948年－）祖籍广东广州，在台湾成长念书。1973年赴美获工商管理硕士学位。1978年创立美国泛太平洋控股。目前财富30亿美元。
192597872a132f0020d7f002b7276b2a78e8a780.translatedText: > Roger Wang Hung (Roger Wang Hung, born in 1948) is originally from Guangzhou, Guangdong, and grew up and studied in Taiwan. In 1973, he went to the United States to obtain a master's degree in business administration. Founded Pan Pacific Holdings in 1978. Current wealth is US$3 billion.

5adefef3298554e37782e99f105cd2c53ea6e076.sourceText: 出生扬州由父亲带到台湾、日本，最后落脚在美国的程正昌，和在缅甸出生的蒋佩琪夫妇创建的熊猫餐饮集团（Panda Management Co.），已经发展为美国最大的中式餐饮连锁企业。财富27亿美元。
5adefef3298554e37782e99f105cd2c53ea6e076.translatedText: Panda Management Co., founded by Cheng Zhengchang, who was born in Yangzhou, was brought to Taiwan and Japan by his father, and finally settled in the United States, and Peggy Chiang, who was born in Myanmar. It has developed into the largest Chinese restaurant chain in the United States. Wealth $2.7 billion.

5a0539bd39cd5a2adb5d6239e96d440e62db30c9.sourceText: 冯国经（Victor Fung）则是创立百年之久的香港供应链集团利丰（Li & Fung）创始人的孙辈继承人。财富27亿美元。
5a0539bd39cd5a2adb5d6239e96d440e62db30c9.translatedText: Victor Fung is the grandson of the founder of the century-old Hong Kong supply chain group Li & Fung. Wealth $2.7 billion.

81c76f60cc88d4b35af0cd54046894518ce924b5.sourceText: 来自台湾南投的高民环（Min Kao）则是GPS卫星导航器Garmin公司的联合创始人，财富23亿美元。
81c76f60cc88d4b35af0cd54046894518ce924b5.translatedText: Min Kao from Nantou, Taiwan is the co-founder of the GPS satellite navigation company Garmin, with a wealth of US$2.3 billion.

ff666ddd74ba971a88df659997aed40ed1e53ecd.sourceText: 杨致远（Jerry Yang）则是大家熟悉的雅虎创办人，来自台湾，财富17亿美元。
ff666ddd74ba971a88df659997aed40ed1e53ecd.translatedText: Jerry Yang is the well-known founder of Yahoo. He is from Taiwan and has a wealth of US$1.7 billion.

812d4b8a0cc9404e7c676323b1cdd34b8ce4729d.sourceText: 动汽车公司特斯拉（Tesla）创始人近来最受瞩目
812d4b8a0cc9404e7c676323b1cdd34b8ce4729d.translatedText: >The founder of electric car company Tesla has attracted the most attention recently

c0268c10479a10884efa5bb153a81a0e91b303ef.sourceText: 目前最受瞩目的企业家之一，美国电动汽车公司特斯拉（Tesla）的创始人穆斯克（Elon Musk）于1992年移居美国。他在17岁时，由于拒绝在南非参军，为当时奉行种族隔离政策的政府卖命，在没有得到父亲支持的情况下第一次移民到加拿大。接着他又转到美国宾州大学（University of Pennsylvania），在那里取得了物理学和商业双学位。他发现美国拥有一个热情友好的环境，首先与伙伴共同创立了在线付款系统贝宝（PayPal），随后又创办了目前已经实现盈利的电动车公司。
c0268c10479a10884efa5bb153a81a0e91b303ef.translatedText: One of the most high-profile entrepreneurs currently, Elon Musk, the founder of the American electric car company Tesla, immigrated to the United States in 1992. When he was 17 years old, he immigrated to Canada for the first time without the support of his father because he refused to join the army in South Africa and worked for the government that pursued the apartheid policy at that time. He then transferred to the University of Pennsylvania, where he obtained a double major in physics and business. He found the United States to be a welcoming and welcoming environment, first co-founding the online payment system PayPal with partners, and then launching a now profitable electric car company.

314b1cef0b82eae28d2fabc0c5387937dd562d38.sourceText: 穆斯克的财富今年勐增了超过一倍，跃升至67亿美元，特斯拉股价飙升是原因之一。他最新的构想超回路列车（Hyper loop）能在35分钟内将乘客从旧金山搭载至洛杉矶。
314b1cef0b82eae28d2fabc0c5387937dd562d38.translatedText: Musk's wealth has more than doubled this year, jumping to $6.7 billion, partly due to the surge in Tesla's stock price. His latest idea, the Hyperloop, could carry passengers from San Francisco to Los Angeles in 35 minutes.

33149cb3bddc425d4798d39075971bc46a052acf.sourceText: 美国梦：”你得努力工作，得自己创造机遇，这里，一切都是可能的！”
33149cb3bddc425d4798d39075971bc46a052acf.translatedText: American Dream: "You have to work hard and create your own opportunities. Here, everything is possible!"

caa935d8dda8ac675a8fda998b4a884ee0a74b80.sourceText: 汽车零部件制造商Flex-N-Gate的首席执行官，同时也是美国橄榄球大联盟球队杰克逊维尔捷豹（NFL’s Jacksonville Jaguars）老板沙希德（Shahid Khan），16岁时带着父亲给的500美元来到美国学习工程学。在伊利诺伊大学（University of Illinois）学习期间他曾经做过洗碗工，每小时挣1.20美元。
caa935d8dda8ac675a8fda998b4a884ee0a74b80.translatedText: Shahid Khan, the CEO of the auto parts manufacturer Flex-N-Gate and the owner of the NFL’s Jacksonville Jaguars, came to the United States to study engineering when he was 16 years old with $500 given by his father. While studying at the University of Illinois, he worked as a dishwasher, earning $1.20 an hour.

89f5b471eeb4b035f011dbd014c3d866da1a93b3.sourceText: 希德翰曾接受《福布斯》采访时表示，”在美国你可以做任何你想做的事，”他说，”你得努力工作，得自己创造机遇，也得有点运气。但是在这里，这一切都是可能的。” 这不正是每位移民的美国梦。
89f5b471eeb4b035f011dbd014c3d866da1a93b3.translatedText: Sidhan once said in an interview with Forbes, "You can do anything you want in the United States," he said. "You have to work hard, you have to create your own opportunities, and you have to have a little luck. But here, all this is possible." This is not the American dream of every immigrant.

7b1b715fd27252460eeff2e7cd81bfa4638d96fa.sourceText: 金信地产：美国房地长市场外国投资持续攀升 根据全国房地产经纪人协会，2012年国际房地产采购活动简介会，截至2012年3月国际房地产买家在美国的采购总额达到82.4亿元，与2011年的66.4亿美元相比，有大幅增长。非居民外国人和最近的移民之间的国际销售总额平分。 国际买家买了全国各地的房屋，但四个州占采购的51% – 佛罗里达州，加利福尼亚州，得克萨斯州和亚利桑那州。佛罗里达州一直是增长最快的地方，外国购买占26％，加利福尼亚州和得克萨斯州有11％是第二，亚利桑那州的占7%。靠近本国，对航空运输的便利，以及气候和位置是所有潜在的外国买家重要的考虑。?国际买家来自全球各地，但加拿大，中国包括香港，墨西哥，印度，英国占55％，所有的国际交易，根据调查结果。加拿大和中国仍是增长最快的。而中国从2011年的9%，成为了11％，加拿大占24％的国际销售。百分之四十五名国际采购低于25万美元。国际买家所支付的平均价格是$ 400,000，美国整体平均为212,000美元。几个原因解释为什么国际平均价格高于整体平均价格。国际客户通常比国内的买方富裕，他们寻找的是比较高档的房屋，例如，适合多代人生活的一个更大的房屋，或一个属性相对独立的房屋，并在比较突出的良好社区。 外国买家购买很多是自住，也有度假和出租使用。 66％ 的国际买家购买独立屋。62％的国际采购由现金完成，自2007年以来都在增加。因为在美国没有信用记录，贷款融资仍然是国际买家的主要问题。更多房地产的信息咨询金信地产的Tinna(480)287-0180 E-mail: Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
7b1b715fd27252460eeff2e7cd81bfa4638d96fa.translatedText: Jinxin Real Estate: Foreign investment in the U.S. real estate market continues to rise According to the National Association of Realtors' 2012 International Real Estate Purchasing Activity Briefing, the total purchases by international real estate buyers in the United States as of March 2012 reached $8.24 billion, a significant increase compared with $6.64 billion in 2011. Total international sales are split equally between nonresident aliens and recent immigrants. International buyers bought homes across the country, but four states accounted for 51% of purchases – Florida, California, Texas and Arizona. Florida has been the fastest growing state with 26% of foreign purchases, followed by California and Texas with 11% and Arizona with 7%. Proximity to home country, ease of air transport, as well as climate and location are important considerations for all potential foreign buyers. ?International buyers come from all over the world, but Canada, China, Hong Kong, Mexico, India, and the United Kingdom account for 55% of all international transactions, according to the survey results. Canada and China are still the fastest growing. China's share increased from 9% in 2011 to 11%, and Canada accounted for 24% of international sales. Forty-five percent of international purchases were less than $250,000. The average price paid by international buyers is $400,000, and the overall U.S. average is $212,000. Several reasons explain why the international average price is higher than the overall average price. International clients are generally wealthier than domestic buyers and are looking for more upscale properties, for example, a larger home suitable for multi-generational living, or a relatively self-contained property in a good neighborhood that stands out. Foreign buyers buy many properties for their own use, as well as for vacation and rental use. 66% of international buyers purchase single-family homes. 62% of international purchases are made with cash, an increase since 2007. Because there is no credit history in the United States, loan financing remains a major issue for international buyers. 1b986e795712151fefed01f976efe8efd41d72e9.translatedText: California will raise taxes and Alberta will benefit (Alberta Times) Is California’s budget woes actually good news for Alberta? Maybe. California residents passed Proposition 30 last week…

efa38b5822f3783fe0b1e5ef7d6633e924a235c7.sourceText: 加州加税亚省得益 （亚省时报） 加州的预算困境竟是亚省好消息？也许吧。 加州居民上周通过了提案30号，其主要内容是一年增加所有加州人销售税25万美元。 近日，大凤凰城经济委员会(GPEC)开始行动，将50位加州CEO请到亚利桑那，以本州税率低于加州的优惠，诚邀加州企业家到本州生活和做生意。其中一些高知名度的公司以表示有兴趣到亚省发展。
efa38b5822f3783fe0b1e5ef7d6633e924a235c7.translatedText: >Alberta benefits from California’s tax hike (Alberta Times) Is California’s budget woes actually good news for Alberta? Maybe. California residents passed Proposition 30 last week, which would increase sales taxes by $250,000 a year for all Californians. Recently, the Greater Phoenix Economic Council (GPEC) took action to invite 50 California CEOs to Arizona, and sincerely invited California entrepreneurs to live and do business in the state with a lower tax rate than California. Some of these high-profile companies have expressed interest in developing in Alberta.

4a94da0bed5892e81586364d1b196dfa7d98c513.sourceText: 亚利桑那医疗机构努力减少早产 早产是婴儿夭折的主要原因，在亚利桑那州，有八分之一的婴儿是早产婴儿。州健康服务部近日加入一个全国性组织，倡议生育健康婴儿，以降低早产婴儿数量。健康服务部说，2011年，本州有85,000名婴儿出生，有12.7%的婴儿是早产儿，超过全国平均水平（12.2%）。根据医学标准，妊娠37周前出生的婴儿是早产儿，39周出生的婴孩是足月婴儿。早产婴儿的成因各有不同，有的因为孩子的健康问题导致早产，有些因孕妇因​​抽烟、酗酒和吸毒，慢性疾病等。还有的则因孕妇的特殊嗜好，想为自己的孩子选择一个特殊的出生日而提早生产。医学界人士认为，教育妊娠妇女如何保障生产足月婴儿是一个大课题，敦促孕妇做好产前检查，以减少不必要的早产现象。如今，在本州46个有产科的医院中，有40个医院签署了一项协定，在非紧急情况下，禁止为妊娠39周前的孕妇作引产手术。健康服务部说，力争在2014年，将早产婴儿降低至占出生率的8%左右。
4a94da0bed5892e81586364d1b196dfa7d98c513.translatedText: Arizona Healthcare Facilities Effort to Reduce Premature Birth Preterm birth is the leading cause of infant death, accounting for one in eight babies born prematurely in Arizona. The state Department of Health Services recently joined a national group advocating for healthy babies to reduce the number of premature babies. The Department of Health Services said 85,000 babies were born in the state in 2011, and 12.7 percent of the babies were premature, exceeding the national average of 12.2 percent. According to medical standards, babies born before 37 weeks of pregnancy are premature babies, and babies born at 39 weeks of pregnancy are full-term babies. The causes of premature babies vary. Some are caused by the child's health problems, while others are caused by the pregnant woman's smoking, alcohol and drug abuse, chronic diseases, etc. Others give birth early due to the special preferences of pregnant women who want to choose a special birth date for their children. People in the medical field believe that educating pregnant women on how to ensure the delivery of full-term babies is a major issue, and they urge pregnant women to do prenatal check-ups to reduce unnecessary premature births. Today, 40 of the state's 46 obstetrics hospitals have signed an agreement prohibiting induction of labor before 39 weeks of pregnancy in non-emergency situations. The Ministry of Health Services said it will strive to reduce the number of premature babies to about 8% of births by 2014.

5e578fb32ac30cf7f7ad0959c02af5d34a0bc17e.translatedText: There are rumors of amnesty, illegal immigrants are rushing to the United States regardless of everything, and smuggling fees are soaring As senators and representatives from both parties in Congress scramble to promote immigration reform, the number of illegal immigrants has increased "...

ded8264fcaa4a0b8a369c9d9d0adf44a3c742e95.sourceText: 欧巴马在总统大选后曾就移民政策表态。他宣称，「拉美裔选民授权和政治参与的增加将为美国带来强大的利益。我确信，那些生活在美国的人，应该有获得合法身分的途径」，这一席话以及国会参众两院陆续推动移民改革，让非法移民有了盼头。
ded8264fcaa4a0b8a369c9d9d0adf44a3c742e95.translatedText: Obama made a statement on immigration policy after the presidential election. He declared, "The increase in Hispanic voter empowerment and political participation will bring powerful benefits to the United States. I am convinced that those living in the United States should have a way to obtain legal status." This statement, as well as the successive promotion of immigration reform by the House of Representatives and the Senate, gave hope to illegal immigrants.

b406499f685aabf3638533ad39858d994f608f36.sourceText: 美国各地非法移民聚集的地区，如东华盛顿州和斯波肯市(Spokane)等非法移民聚居地区，移民人数势必大幅增加。
b406499f685aabf3638533ad39858d994f608f36.translatedText: In areas where illegal immigrants gather across the United States, such as Eastern Washington State and Spokane, the number of immigrants is bound to increase significantly.

23b725de0c45ba01c6f202f58aecf026efd63d0e.sourceText: Examiner网站29日报导，由于偷渡入境的非法移民增加，偷渡费已经飙涨。亚利桑纳州反对非法移民着称的警长阿帕约(Joe Arpaio)最近逮捕十名从墨西哥偷渡入境的非法移民，他们每人所付的偷渡费为4000元。此数字相当引人注目。和「墨西哥以外」(Other Than Mexico，OTM)的偷渡客比较，墨西哥偷渡客所付的费用是最便宜的，OTM的偷渡费动辄上万。
23b725de0c45ba01c6f202f58aecf026efd63d0e.translatedText: The Examiner website reported on the 29th that due to the increase in illegal immigrants smuggling into the country, smuggling fees have soared. Arizona Sheriff Joe Arpaio, who is known for his opposition to illegal immigration, recently arrested ten illegal immigrants who smuggled themselves into the country from Mexico. Each of them paid a smuggling fee of 4,000 yuan. This number is quite striking. Compared with stowaways from Other Than Mexico (OTM), Mexican stowaways pay the cheapest fees, and OTM stowaway fees can easily reach tens of thousands.

29b750af3704d06279ed373c4cf1f4cd0245d148.sourceText: 非法移民，特别是拉美裔，倾向支持自由派国会议员的福利政策，并把他们的亲戚和乡亲向民主党拉拢。欧巴马在2012年的总统大选，获得拉美裔选民近七成的选票，除了「欧记健保」对拉美裔选民有强大的吸引力以外，欧巴马主张给予非法移民某种形式的「大赦」，使得拉美裔选民和非法移民对欧巴马有相当的期待。
29b750af3704d06279ed373c4cf1f4cd0245d148.translatedText: Illegal immigrants, especially Hispanics, tend to support the welfare policies of liberal members of Congress and draw their relatives and fellow citizens to the Democratic Party. In the 2012 presidential election, Obama won nearly 70% of the votes of Hispanic voters. In addition to the strong appeal of "European Health Insurance" to Hispanic voters, Obama advocated granting some form of "amnesty" to illegal immigrants, which made Hispanic voters and illegal immigrants have considerable expectations for Obama.

d13c27f2e45218960b63fd2a57a70c6cd578de71.sourceText: 目前的房屋贷款利率正处于低点，现在还在租屋的人，该是好好考虑购买房屋的时候了，为什麽说买屋比租屋好? 为您分析以下几点:
d13c27f2e45218960b63fd2a57a70c6cd578de71.translatedText: The current housing loan interest rate is at a low point. People who are still renting a house now should seriously consider buying a house. Why is buying a house better than renting a house? Let us analyze the following points for you:

9bb9524235fce626f9ad6108e2aba086e568ff97.sourceText: 1) 购屋可以节税。您交付的购屋贷款利息和房地产税可以从年所得中扣除，假设您去年底购屋，申请了16万元30年的银行贷款，年利率为4.25%，今年一月一号是第一次的缴款日，那麽今年一整年所交付的贷款利息约为$6,748，这些利息加上所缴的房地产税，是可以从您今年的总收入中扣除的，这样便可以降低应付税额。
9bb9524235fce626f9ad6108e2aba086e568ff97.translatedText: 1) Buying a house can save taxes. The interest on the home purchase loan and the real estate tax you paid can be deducted from your annual income. Assume that you bought a house at the end of last year and applied for a 30-year bank loan of 160,000 yuan with an annual interest rate of 4.25%. January 1 this year is the first payment date. Then the loan interest paid throughout this year is about $6,748. These interests plus the real estate tax paid can be deducted from your total income this year, which can reduce the amount of tax payable.

beafdf87006b2746a4cdb0044651b52f61fa0ff3.sourceText: 2)强迫自己存款。贷款购屋就像是开了一个储蓄帐户，每个月缴款中的一部分是本金，本金缴的越多，您拥有的房屋淨值就越多，加上房屋会增值，这些房屋淨值，就好像是储蓄存款，越来越多。
beafdf87006b2746a4cdb0044651b52f61fa0ff3.translatedText: 2) Force yourself to make a deposit. Buying a house with a loan is like opening a savings account. Part of the monthly payment is the principal. The more principal you pay, the more home equity you have. In addition, the value of the home will increase. This home equity, like a savings deposit, will increase more and more.

9dea375c43fc3951148b40f90ce46057cd749881.sourceText: 3)会有较稳定的住屋支出。租过房屋的人应该都知道房租几乎是跟随物价调涨的，如果您的购屋贷款是固定利率的方桉，那麽在贷款期间内，每个月的房贷支出几乎都是固定的。
9dea375c43fc3951148b40f90ce46057cd749881.translatedText: 3) There will be more stable housing expenses. Anyone who has rented a house should know that rents almost follow price increases. If your home purchase loan is a fixed-rate plan, then your monthly mortgage payments will be almost fixed during the loan period.

923c436405b8b96dd37908a9e1bd305200e5d8c0.sourceText: 4)拥有更高的自主权。租屋者永远都要受到房东的限制，如果拥有自己的房子，想要做些Home Improvement、换个地毯、窗帘的，都可以自己做决定。
923c436405b8b96dd37908a9e1bd305200e5d8c0.translatedText: 4) Have higher autonomy. Renters will always be subject to landlord restrictions. If you own your own house and want to make some home improvements, change carpets, or curtains, you can make your own decisions.

4959e7f08ef119d8c0b9decdc047709cc20a607a.sourceText: 5)购屋是最好的投资方式。以保守的估计 (依据美国近百年来的长期房价资料计算)，房屋的年增值率，大约都有5%一年，来做一个简单的算数: 假设您贷款购买房子，买了一间价值20万的房屋，放了20%的头期款，也就是4万元，如果房子一年后上涨了5%，变成21万，把它卖了之后可以赚到1万元，您算算，这样是多少的投资报酬率? 很简单的可以算出是25%，因为您只投资了4万元，便赚了1 万元。当然，这是以长期平均值来算，在2003至2007年之间，由于当时房市供需失调，房价涨的太快，在当时购屋而现在还没有脱手的屋主，应该要有长期抗战的精神，房价总有一天会涨回来的，谁都无法预测最好的价格点，但是根据房价历史资料来看，5-7年是一个盛衰循环期，现在的低利率贷款市场对购屋者更加有利。 租屋缴房租，就像把钱丢到水裡，有去无回，不像拥有自己的房屋有以上这些优点。现在的房屋贷款市场对购屋者更有利，打算购屋的人，应该考虑行动了，如果您有任何房地产方面的问题，非常欢迎您打电话到我的专线 (480) 612-4545 或 email至 Rich@RichLiao.com 。
4959e7f08ef119d8c0b9decdc047709cc20a607a.translatedText: 5) Buying a house is the best way to invest. Based on conservative estimates (calculated based on long-term housing price data in the United States over the past century), the annual appreciation rate of a house is about 5% a year. Let’s do a simple calculation: Suppose you buy a house with a loan, buy a house worth 200,000, and put down 20% of the down payment, which is 40,000 yuan. If the house increases by 5% after one year, it becomes 210,000 yuan, and you can earn 10,000 yuan after selling it. Calculate, what is the return on investment? It can be easily calculated to be 25%, because you only invested 40,000 yuan and earned 10,000 yuan. Of course, this is calculated based on the long-term average. Between 2003 and 2007, due to the imbalance between supply and demand in the housing market, housing prices rose too fast. Homeowners who bought a house at that time and have not sold it now should have the spirit of long-term resistance. Housing prices will rise back one day. No one can predict the best price point. However, according to historical data on housing prices, 5-7 years is a cycle of boom and bust. The current low-interest loan market is more beneficial to home buyers. Renting a house and paying rent is like throwing money into the water, never getting it back, unlike owning your own house which has the above advantages. The current housing loan market is more favorable to home buyers. Those who plan to purchase a home should consider taking action. If you have any questions about real estate, you are very welcome to call my hotline (480) 612-4545 or email to Rich@RichLiao.com.
