21def11078b0fc9fc2e407572789f5f7f40878e1.sourceText: 江苏一官员酒后出租车上遗落数十张卡 牵出腐败窝案 当地时间2012年12月6日晚，有人在江苏太仓”烟雨江南”论坛爆料称，太仓一公务员醉酒后将手包遗落在出租车上，里面有购物卡、洗浴卡、银行卡等各类卡片几十张，卡面金额合计3万多元。此事经过网络发酵，这名公务员有了个外号”卡哥”。太仓检察院据此展开调查，发现”卡哥”是太仓市沙溪镇建设管理所原副所长沈永刚，其存在受贿34万余元的腐败事实。随着”卡哥”的落马，检察机关顺藤摸瓜，又查处了太仓沙溪、双凤两镇6名干部，向这些干部行贿的工程老板最终也难逃法网。 几十张卡片落在出租车上 ”卡哥”哪来这么多卡？ ”卡哥”名声大噪的第二天，太仓市检察院就注意到了这条网络反腐线索。经过调查，”卡哥”正是太仓市沙溪镇建设管理所原副所长沈永刚。侦查员发现，太仓市永恒建设工程有限公司吴连彩和其哥哥在沙溪、双凤镇均承接了大量市政、道路工程，并且有人多次举报吴氏兄弟向相关领导干部行贿，种种迹象表明，沈永刚可能就是吴氏兄弟行贿的对象之一。 2012年12月，吴氏兄弟交代，他们曾花10万元给沈永刚买车，并提供了相关证据。沈永刚只得主动交代了自己的经济问题。去年3月7日，沈永刚因涉嫌受贿被提起公诉。检察机关办案查明，2006年至2012年，沈永刚在担任太仓市沙溪镇建设管理所副所长期间，在负责市政建设等工作过程中，多次非法收受他人财物共计人民币34万余元。去年3月19日，法院作出一审判决，沈永刚犯受贿罪，判处有期徒刑7年，没收财产人民币14万元。 ”卡哥”落马牵出腐败窝案 受贿物品千奇百怪 ”卡哥”落马，检察机关却并没有停下脚步。根据吴连彩行贿的轨迹，双凤镇建管所原副所长朱卫东受贿、水利站原站长邹树林受贿、农经站原站长高雪明挪用公款、原镇人大主席邹大庆受贿、镇建管所原所长周惠元受贿等窝串案全部曝光。这些干部除了收受现金贿赂外，还有各种千奇百怪的受贿品。朱卫东在2007年和2010年自有厂房建造期间，收受行贿人所购买的砖、水泥、黄沙等，共计人民币4万多元。经检察院提起公诉，太仓市法院对朱卫东作出一审判决：因利用职务便利多次收受他人所送财物合计人民币254050元、港币1万元，朱卫东被判处有期徒刑十年，没收财产人民币10万元。 2012年底，邹大庆在自家别墅卫生间改造期间，接受了做个体工程的陈某支付的淋浴房定金3000元和两个抽水马桶的费用8960元，而这仅仅是邹大庆担任双凤镇副镇长、党委副书记、双凤镇招商中心主任、镇人大主席期间，所收受的贿赂款人民币423769.19元中的一小部分。今年1月24日，邹大庆被法院判处有期徒刑六年零三个月，并处没收财产人民币13万元。 行贿人也难逃法网 4月10日，双凤镇建设管理所原所长周惠元涉嫌受贿案开庭审理。检察机关办案查明，其在担任太仓市双凤镇建设管理所副所长、镇招商中心副主任、建管所所长期间，利用职务上的便利，索取或者非法收受他人所送财物人民币24万余元。 受贿人受到法律严惩，行贿人同样难逃法网。2006年至2012年间，吴连彩每年年底或年初都会到沈永刚的家中”送礼”，而他所送出的共计人民币212689元的”厚礼”，也被一一查明。去年8月7日，太仓市法院对行贿人吴连彩作出一审判决。法院认定，太仓永恒建设工程有限公司犯单位行贿罪，判处罚金人民币10万元；吴连彩犯单位行贿罪，判处有期徒刑10个月。 另外，在查处”卡哥”系列腐败案时，检察机关查明太仓市水利局沙溪水利站原站长戴兴元存在滥用职权犯罪。最终，其因犯受贿罪、滥用职权罪被判处有期徒刑六年，并处没收财产人民币8万元。
21def11078b0fc9fc2e407572789f5f7f40878e1.translatedText: A drunken Jiangsu official left dozens of cards in a taxi, leading to a corruption case. On the evening of December 6, 2012, local time, someone broke the news at the "Small Rain Jiangnan" forum in Taicang, Jiangsu, that a drunken Taicang official left his handbag in a taxi. There were dozens of shopping cards, bath cards, bank cards and other cards in it, with a total face value of more than 30,000 yuan. After the matter was fermented on the Internet, the civil servant was nicknamed "Brother Ka". The Taicang Procuratorate launched an investigation based on this and found that "Cargo" was Shen Yonggang, the former deputy director of the Construction Management Office of Shaxi Town, Taicang City, and that he had taken bribes of more than 340,000 yuan in corruption. Following the fall of "Brother Ka", the procuratorate followed suit and investigated and dealt with six more cadres from Shaxi and Shuangfeng towns in Taicang. The project boss who bribed these cadres could not escape the law in the end. Dozens of cards were left in the taxi. Where did "Brother Card" get so many cards? The day after "Brother Ka" became famous, the Taicang City Procuratorate noticed this online anti-corruption clue. After investigation, it was found that "Brother Ka" was Shen Yonggang, the former deputy director of the Construction Management Office of Shaxi Town, Taicang City. Investigators found that Wu Liancai and his brother of Taicang Yongheng Construction Engineering Co., Ltd. undertook a large number of municipal and road projects in Shaxi and Shuangfeng Towns, and there were multiple reports that the Wu brothers bribed relevant leading cadres. Various signs indicate that Shen Yonggang may be one of the Wu brothers' bribery targets. In December 2012, the Wu brothers confessed that they had spent 100,000 yuan to buy a car for Shen Yonggang and provided relevant evidence. Shen Yonggang had no choice but to take the initiative to explain his financial problems. On March 7 last year, Shen Yonggang was prosecuted on suspicion of accepting bribes. The procuratorial organ handled the case and found that from 2006 to 2012, while serving as the deputy director of the Shaxi Town Construction Management Office in Taicang City, Shen Yonggang illegally accepted property from others, totaling more than 340,000 yuan, on many occasions while responsible for municipal construction and other work. On March 19 last year, the court made a first-instance verdict that Shen Yonggang was guilty of accepting bribes and was sentenced to 7 years in prison and his property of 140,000 yuan was confiscated. The arrest of "Brother Ka" led to the corruption case. There were all kinds of strange bribes. The arrest of "Brother Ka" did not stop the prosecution. According to Wu Liancai’s bribery trajectory, former deputy director of the Shuangfeng Town Construction Management Office Zhu Weidong accepted bribes, former director of the Water Conservancy Station Zou Shulin accepted bribes, former director of the Agricultural Economic Station Gao Xueming misappropriated public funds, former town People’s Congress Chairman Zou Daqing accepted bribes, and former director of the town Construction Management Office Zhou Huiyuan accepted bribes. In addition to accepting cash bribes, these cadres also accepted all kinds of strange bribes. During the construction of his own factory in 2007 and 2010, Zhu Weidong accepted bricks, cement, yellow sand, etc. purchased from bribers, totaling more than 40,000 yuan. After a public prosecution by the Procuratorate, the Taicang City Court made a first-instance verdict against Zhu Weidong: Because he took advantage of his position to accept property from others multiple times, totaling RMB 254,050 and HKD 10,000, Zhu Weidong was sentenced to ten years in prison and his property was confiscated with RMB 100,000. At the end of 2012, when Zou Daqing was remodeling the bathroom in his villa, he accepted a deposit of 3,000 yuan for the shower room and 8,960 yuan for two flush toilets from Chen, who was doing individual engineering work. This was only a small part of the 423,769.19 yuan in bribes Zou Daqing had received during his tenure as the deputy mayor of Shuangfeng Town, deputy secretary of the party committee, director of the Shuangfeng Town Investment Center, and chairman of the town People's Congress. On January 24 this year, Zou Daqing was sentenced to six years and three months in prison by the court and ordered to confiscate property of RMB 130,000. Briberyers cannot escape the law. On April 10, Zhou Huiyuan, the former director of the Shuangfeng Town Construction Management Office, was tried in court for allegedly accepting bribes. The procuratorial organ handled the case and found that while he was the deputy director of the Construction Management Office, deputy director of the town investment center, and director of the Construction Management Office of Shuangfeng Town, Taicang City, he took advantage of his position to solicit or illegally accept more than 240,000 yuan in property from others. Bribery recipients are severely punished by law, and bribe givers cannot escape the law. From 2006 to 2012, Wu Liancai would go to Shen Yonggang's home to "give gifts" at the end or beginning of every year, and the "gifts" he gave totaling RMB 212,689 were also identified one by one. On August 7 last year, the Taicang City Court issued a first-instance verdict against the briber Wu Liancai. The court found that Taicang Yongheng Construction Engineering Co., Ltd. was guilty of unit bribery and was sentenced to a fine of RMB 100,000; Wu Liancai was guilty of unit bribery and sentenced to 10 months in prison. In addition, when investigating the "Kage" series of corruption cases, the procuratorate found that Dai Xingyuan, the former director of the Taicang Water Conservancy Bureau's Shaxi Water Conservancy Station, committed the crime of abusing his power. Ultimately, he was sentenced to six years in prison for bribery and abuse of power, and his property was confiscated of RMB 80,000.

57f60d5ee33d5814d2f1196f1b01ae9e68d2195f.sourceText: 日前，记者拍摄到刘若英和其未婚夫逛家具城挑选家具，两人亲密如同新婚夫妇。图为刘若英。
57f60d5ee33d5814d2f1196f1b01ae9e68d2195f.translatedText: A few days ago, reporters photographed Rene Liu and her fiancé shopping for furniture in a furniture store. The two were as intimate as a newlywed couple. The picture shows Liu Ruoying.

c8c02825f54cf8b8750ac81a154b6bb9ecb67450.sourceText: 刘若英身穿白衣短裤，素颜出门，神情中不乏疲惫。看来近期忙于《全球热恋》宣传的她相当缺乏休息。
c8c02825f54cf8b8750ac81a154b6bb9ecb67450.translatedText: Rene Liu was wearing white clothes and shorts, going out without makeup, and she looked tired. It seems that she lacks rest as she has been busy promoting "Global Love" recently.

cbc9819e20aad1ea185c677d9794bce978b4c1c5.sourceText: 刘若英一行将车开往一家高级餐厅，汽车停稳后从车上先下来的是一位身材高大的年轻男士，虽然他戴着墨镜，留着络腮胡，但记者还是立即认出他就是那位与刘若英深夜按摩同回公寓的神秘男友。
cbc9819e20aad1ea185c677d9794bce978b4c1c5.translatedText: Rene Liu and his party drove to a high-end restaurant. After the car stopped, the first person who got out of the car was a tall young man. Although he wore sunglasses and had a beard, the reporter immediately recognized him as the mysterious boyfriend who returned to the apartment with Rene Rene for a late-night massage.

0d341edf5d368164b61a36ef5d9f975f397df9d7.sourceText: 刘若英未婚夫不但对她处处维护，更主动帮她拉开餐厅大门，相当殷勤体贴
0d341edf5d368164b61a36ef5d9f975f397df9d7.translatedText: Rene Liu's fiancé not only protected her in every way, but also took the initiative to help her open the door of the restaurant. He was very attentive and considerate

cc65151e20f6e6feacd740b43b5a2ac769d74ac2.sourceText: 饭后，刘若英更打起精神，和男友一起来到北四环一家着名的家具城选购家具，一路上两人交头接耳，有商有量，从他们甜蜜而默契的眼神中，难免让人猜测，两人正在为新房装修而费神。
cc65151e20f6e6feacd740b43b5a2ac769d74ac2.translatedText: After the meal, Rene Liu even said I cheered up and went to a famous furniture store in the North Fourth Ring Road with my boyfriend to buy furniture. The two of them talked and discussed the whole way. From their sweet and understanding eyes, it was inevitable that people would guess that the two of them were busy decorating their new house.

41978d982c67dfed2668d792c421098bcc13338b.sourceText: 事后记者了解到，刘若英的男友是通过一名合作过的导演介绍的，男方是浙江人，名下的企业为家族产业，从事物流和运输业务，家族资产数亿，是浙江省最大的物流企业，作为该企业少掌门的刘若英男友长期活跃在京城，与娱乐圈也有接触。据悉，刘若英与男友感情发展非常顺利，双方都已见过家长，8月吉日多，照目前的发展趋势来看，两人可能本周内就会领证完婚。
41978d982c67dfed2668d792c421098bcc13338b.translatedText: Afterwards, the reporter learned that Rene Liu’s boyfriend was introduced by a director he had worked with. The man is from Zhejiang, and the company under his name is a family business, engaged in logistics and transportation business. The family assets are hundreds of millions. It is the largest logistics company in Zhejiang Province. As the young head of the company, Rene Liu’s boyfriend has been active in Beijing for a long time and has contact with the entertainment industry. It is reported that the relationship between Liu Ruoying and her boyfriend is developing very smoothly. Both parties have met their parents. August has many auspicious days. Judging from the current development trend, the two may get the marriage certificate this week.

7e61cb6cd8290fc1aaf3c4632f701f9c0547c3a7.sourceText: 台湾新生儿”男女失衡” 问题严重
7e61cb6cd8290fc1aaf3c4632f701f9c0547c3a7.translatedText: The "male-female imbalance" problem among Taiwanese newborns is serious

431fc71c1c3eb91ec5074a31b6f37e6074784a7c.sourceText: 台湾新生儿”男女失衡” 问题严重 来源: 新华网 台湾卫生主管部门最新发布的２０１０…
431fc71c1c3eb91ec5074a31b6f37e6074784a7c.translatedText: The "male-female imbalance" among Taiwanese newborns is a serious problem Source: Xinhuanet The latest 2010...

06d3dd775f14fd798af7ac874a5fabbd3f04335a.sourceText: 台湾当局禁止医疗院所筛检未出生婴儿性别，但执法并未落实，导致筛检性别行为时常发生。此外，由于不少家庭受”重男轻女”意识影响，孕妇主动要求医院进行性别筛检并堕胎，因此不易找到违法证据，难以对医院进行处罚。台湾生殖医学会理事长陈信孚说，以前台湾１０个家庭有９．９个要男宝宝，现在顶多７个想要男生。他呼吁社会进一步转变观念，以保持人口性别比例平衡。
06d3dd775f14fd798af7ac874a5fabbd3f04335a.translatedText: Taiwan authorities prohibit medical institutions from screening the gender of unborn babies, but law enforcement has not been implemented, resulting in frequent gender screening practices. In addition, because many families are affected by the "son preference" consciousness, pregnant women actively request hospitals to conduct gender screening and abortion. Therefore, it is difficult to find illegal evidence and punish the hospital. Chen Xinfu, chairman of the Taiwan Reproductive Medicine Society, said that in the past, 9.9 out of 10 families in Taiwan wanted a boy, but now at most 7 want a boy. He called on society to further change its mindset to maintain a balanced gender ratio in the population.

d3d365ac7e64cfe65f04ad8c10c94b39b96956d4.sourceText: 在十月六日星期天晚上，在新东方艺术学校举办了温馨活跃而隆重的”画马研讨会暨范融作品欣賞” 活动。画家范融先生早早已把廾多幅骏马图展示在厅中供來宾观赏，更有大型花篮庆贺，与会的众多佳宾大都是爱马人仕。
d3d365ac7e64cfe65f04ad8c10c94b39b96956d4.translatedText: held a warm, lively and grand "Horse Painting Seminar and Appreciation of Fan Rong's Works" event at the New Oriental Art School on the evening of Sunday, October 6th. The painter Mr. Fan Rong had already displayed many pictures of horses in the hall for guests to enjoy. There were also large flower baskets to celebrate. Most of the guests present were horse lovers.

322c6c66516fb0ac2b5500e834efa2f9a2ad7cab.sourceText: 首先由主持人林欣小姐介绍参加研讨会的各位佳宾。並由凤城基督教会刘书华牧师祝祷，新东方艺术学校吕丽华校长致词，美中文化艺术交流协会陈志刚付主席祝画展成功展出，更预祝至明年”马到成功”，佳宾钱嘵吾先生幽默的致词说，真马不如画马，因范融画家已把马定形在那美的一瞬间了。
322c6c66516fb0ac2b5500e834efa2f9a2ad7cab.translatedText: First of all, the host Ms. Lin Xin introduced all the distinguished guests attending the seminar. Pastor Liu Shuhua of Fengcheng Christian Church gave a blessing, and President Lu Lihua of the New Oriental Art School delivered a speech. Chen Zhigang, Vice Chairman of the US-China Cultural and Art Exchange Association, wished the exhibition a success, and also wished "immediate success" next year. Guest Mr. Qian Kaiwu gave a humorous speech, saying that a real horse is not as good as a painted horse, because artist Fan Rong has already fixed the horse in that beautiful moment.

fce0f186a9c9f5d32a3d91c0d499e113f9617638.sourceText: （左）画家范融 （右）主持人 林欣
fce0f186a9c9f5d32a3d91c0d499e113f9617638.translatedText: (left) painter Fan Rong (right) host Lin Xin

77763314889655196eac7f9feb5507debda6f7ce.sourceText: 画家范融甄选了多幅名画作介绍，如东汉的青铜器《马踏飞燕》，已是国家的旅游标志；唐朝的《昭陵六骏》名扬天下；曹霸的马及代表作廾四功臣像虽己失传，但因杜甫的诗名畄千古；韩干的《牧马图》；元朝任仁发的《二马图》，更赤裸裸的讲述了清官与贪官的维肖维妙形像；清朝任伯年的墨染作画更开启了新方向，影响了近代画的作风，如徐悲鸿的画马，便是融汇中西结合此作法，成为一代丈大师，画家范融都一一作了简单而深入的讲解，他更讲解了为何叫《汗血宝马》？此马体健俊美善跑，产於今土厍曼斯坦，现存只有近三千來匹，因皮肤细腻(皮薄)奔跑後表皮毛细血管易破裂，以致流出的汗色近赭红像血所致，使爱马人仕对汗血天马有更深的了解。范融隋即展示和讲觧多年来自已的部分精品之作如《美人如玉劍如虹》，《八骏图》，《春风得意马啼疾》，《龙腾》，《双骏图〉，《大漠风暴〉，〈长风万里〉，〈腾飞骏马图〉, 等多幅作品，同時一一详尽地回荅了多位佳賓的提出各种问题，现场充满了和谐友好的交流气氛。
77763314889655196eac7f9feb5507debda6f7ce.translatedText: Painter Fan Rong selected a number of famous paintings to introduce, such as the Eastern Han Dynasty's bronze "Horse Treading on Flying Swallows", which has become a national tourism icon; the Tang Dynasty's "Six Horses of Zhaoling" is famous all over the world; Cao Ba's horse and his representative work, the Four Heroes, have been lost, but they are famous through the ages because of Du Fu's poem; Han Gan's "Herding Horses"; Ren Renfa's Yuan Dynasty's "Herding Horses" "Two Horses" more nakedly describes the lifelike images of honest and corrupt officials; Ren Bonian's ink-dyed paintings in the Qing Dynasty opened up a new direction and influenced the style of modern paintings. For example, Xu Beihong's painting of horses blended Chinese and Western methods and became a master of his generation. Painter Fan Rongdu gave a simple and in-depth explanation one by one. He also explained why it is called "Breathed Horse"? This horse is strong, handsome and good at running. It was born in Shemanstein, today. There are only about 3,000 horses in existence. Because the skin is delicate (thin), the capillaries in the epidermis are easy to rupture after running, so that the color of the sweat is almost ocher red like blood, which makes horse lovers have a deeper understanding of the sweat-blooded Pegasus. Fan Rongsui displayed and explained some of his masterpieces over the years, such as "Beauty Like Jade, Sword and Rainbow", "Eight Horses", "Horse Crying in Proud Spring Breeze", "Soaring Dragon", "Two Horses", "Desert Storm", "Wind for Ten Thousand Miles", "Soaring Horses", and many other works. At the same time, he responded to various questions raised by many guests in detail one by one. The scene was filled with a harmonious and friendly atmosphere of communication.

5c5d201062ac2f66dd6e7457fd5b34244b3d9d94.sourceText: 画家范融不但多次举办画展，还到社区学校讲解中国画文化，促进美中艺术交流的团结，更在中国国庆，侨社的春宴及中秋聚会，亚洲艺术节泼墨挥毫，为会中应节作画赠画以作留念，更在美国主流社会如各市政府，和州政府都有收藏了范融的〈骏马图〉成为友好交流的美事，他的画以致受到高度的好评和赞赏，画家范融不但善长画马，即兴时还曾在亚省笔会的春宴作了《年年有鱼图》，在中秋时作了《花好月园图》更在《和平颂》音乐会中即兴挥毫作了《飞鸽和平图〉贏得了数百位中外人士的簽名支持，把传扬中国文化艺术推向高峰，成为一时佳话。
5c5d201062ac2f66dd6e7457fd5b34244b3d9d94.translatedText: Painter Fan Rong not only held many art exhibitions, but also went to community schools to explain Chinese painting culture and promote the unity of art exchanges between the United States and China. He also splashed ink on China's National Day, the Spring Banquet and Mid-Autumn Festival gatherings of overseas Chinese communities, and the Asian Art Festival, and painted and donated paintings as souvenirs for the festival. It is also collected by mainstream societies in the United States, such as municipal and state governments. Fan Rong's "Horse Picture" became a beautiful thing for friendly exchanges, and his paintings were highly praised and appreciated. The painter Fan Rong was not only good at painting horses, he also improvised "There are fish every year" at the spring banquet of the Alberta PEN Association. In autumn, he composed "The Garden with Flowers and the Moon" and even improvised the "Picture of Flying Pigeons and Peace" during the "Ode to Peace" concert, which won the signatures and support of hundreds of Chinese and foreign people. It pushed the spread of Chinese culture and art to the peak and became a good story.

a4446f32a1d342b1f5f3ff18fb074229db0a383f.sourceText: 现场嘉宾与画家范融合影留念
a4446f32a1d342b1f5f3ff18fb074229db0a383f.translatedText: The guests took a commemorative photo with the painter Fan

7036cf13b73f2c73d101a92b3e707c7d98ad8204.sourceText: 结束时，画家范融表白说：画马还是他的最爱，因主流社会和各個階层都容易明白马的展示形态，无论是马的飞腾、奔啸、都是激励人生发奋上进的正能量，马的冲劲又鼓励着自我图强，毅力可嘉，意识形态互相呼应着，实是难能可贵。
7036cf13b73f2c73d101a92b3e707c7d98ad8204.translatedText: At the end, the painter Fan Rong confessed that painting horses is still his favorite, because mainstream society and all walks of life can easily understand the display form of horses. Whether it is the horse's flying or galloping, it is a positive energy that inspires life to make progress. The horse's momentum also encourages self-improvement. The perseverance is commendable, and the ideologies echo each other, which is really commendable.

858a3a0eed4a176ed294c387abf1990a4a4392d0.translatedText: > Tracing the origins of Chinese guild halls and hometown associations Zhang Zhaohong Since the discovery of gold mines in California, a large number of Chinese began to enter the United States. f24ee3663173ab8a382e5deb22c6a531cc4424bd.sourceText: 华人会馆和同乡会之溯源 张肇鸿 自從加州發現金礦，大量華人開始進入美國。至1852年，在三藩市的華人已達到三千人，隨後的卅年間，來美國的華人人數就增至十萬。但自從華人踏上美國後，也面對着强烈的敵視和猜疑。為了適應環境，尤其是在人地生疏的地方，華人自然集體而居，於是有了唐人街。由於移民的故鄉不同，所講的方言不同，所以唐人街就有了各種不同地方的會館、同鄉會、宗親會等社群組織。這些組織為它的同鄉需要提供協助，有些還為新會員設立招待所，讓會員關係更加密切。新移民來到一個有相同方言與文化的團體中，這對於他們溝通家鄉消息，并在休戚與共中找到安全和互助十分重要。唐人街的鄉的同鄉、更加密切，也讓新移民立即能不可磨滅的貢獻。中國商店、中國餐館、傳統習俗、熟悉的文字，也讓新移民得到一種安心。 1849年12月，第一個華人會館在三藩市成立，至1851年分為兩個團體，其中一個來自台山、新會、開平，恩平的”四邑會館”，另一個來自中山、鶴山、高要”三邑會館”，1852年，中山人組成了”阳和會館”;其它會館還有”肇慶會館”、”合和會館”、”岡州會館”，客家人也組成了”人和會館”，最大的會館”寧陽會館”是從”四邑同鄉會”分出來的，新寧人(台山人)在加州華人中佔有大多數，因此”寧陽會館”有相當的影响力。到了1854年，華人會館和同鄉會組成了” 七大會館”，後統稱為”中華會館”(CHINESE. CONSOLTDATED.BENVOLENT.ASSOCIATION) 。 中華會館代表着絶大多數來自廣東二十多個地區的華人移民。此時會館的領導地位已確立，對於初到陌生地方的移民，有一個自己熟識的鄉音的組織，不竟是一個極大的安慰。中華會館是華人非官方的代言人，它為促進華人福利，調解個人和團體之間的糾紛，供給華人子女中文教育提供幫助；會館也是主持殯葬事務的組織，負責死去華人的埋葬，並把骸骨運回家鄉。早期的中華會館曾派人維持華埠的治安，並為維護華人權益進行訴訟，有時直到美國的最高法院。 中華會館還負責迎送和協助待朝廷外交使節的任務。光緒四年(1878年)，中國第一任駐美公使陳蘭彬赴任抵達三藩市，當時三邑會館通事梁楠領導六大會館的商董二百余人恭候歡迎。之後，第一任領事陳樹棠在三藩設立金山領事館，華埠對內的事務由中華會館處理，大事則向領事請示，而對外則由領事交涉。朝廷的命令是可以直達華埠僑民的。有公使大員過境或到訪，中華會館代表僑民歡迎，優加款待。1886年，張蔭桓公使抵三藩市，僑團歡宴，殆無虛席。還有中國艦隊到訪，華僑倍感興奮，熱烈歡迎，如此愛國熱情舉措，日後沿成定例。 美國各大城市中的華人大都建有類似中華會館的組織。紐約的”中華公所”在1883年成立，是由60個代表紐約各方面的團體所組成。各地的組織也有着相應的聯系，當年美國排華法案在美京華盛頓獲得通過後，美國反華情緒達到高潮，各地的中華會館便聯合成一個”全美中華會館”，以協調各地中華會館為維護華人權益所進行的各種活動。 亞利桑那州在19世紀已有華人定居於此。1880年代，本州的鐵路工程完成，華人入礦山工作，但大部份進入本城的華埠，於是更促進了它的繁榮。1890年初，本城華埠人數已逾二百。在亞省早期的華人文物中，有1894年華人SINO.KWONG和1906年鄧遇隆回祖國後返回斐匿唐人街的兩張文字紀錄。而本埠的華人組織多數以宗親團體稱謂，如鄧氏宗親的”鄧高密公所”，余氏宗親的”余風采堂”，黃氏宗親的”黃江夏雲山公所”(即現在的黃氏宗親會)，劉、關、張、趙四姓組成的”龍岡公所”等。本埠雖然沒中華會館，但鳯凰城華人僑團在1968年成立了”斐匿僑團聯合總會”，它和各地的中華公所、中華會館有着相同的功能和地位。 廣東的僑鄉開平，自古以來就是四邑地區中人流和物流的集散地，早年開平鄉親到美國謀生的人很多。1850年代，開平人與台山、新會、恩平人在三藩市成立了”四邑會館”。1862年，開平人的鄧姓、胡姓和台山人余姓脫离四邑會館共組”合和會館”，1898年開平人和恩平人又組成”恩開會館”，後於1909年合并於”肇慶會館”。1911年”旅美開平同鄉總會”在三藩市成立的，今年是100周年紀慶大典，有邀請鳳凰城開平代表參加慶典。到今天，在全美各地仍有不少開平鄉親的組織，如”美國南加州開平潭江聯誼會”等等。 在鳳凰城的同鄉會組織有亞省台灣同鄉聯誼會、亞省川渝聯誼會等。亞省開平同鄉互助會於2011年在鳳凰城成立，該會表示日後將努力地為亞省的開平鄉親做好互助和服務工作。
f24ee3663173ab8a382e5deb22c6a531cc4424bd.translatedText: The Origin of Chinese Guild Halls and Hometown Associations Zhang Zhaohong Since the discovery of gold mines in California, a large number of Chinese began to enter the United States. By 1852, the number of Chinese in San Francisco had reached 3,000. In the following thirty years, the number of Chinese coming to the United States increased to 100,000. But since the Chinese set foot in the United States, they have also faced strong hostility and suspicion. In order to adapt to the environment, especially in places where people and land are unfamiliar, the Chinese naturally lived in groups, so Chinatown was born. Because immigrants come from different hometowns and speak different dialects, Chinatown has various local guilds, hometown associations, clan associations and other community organizations. These organizations provide assistance to the needs of their fellow citizens, and some also set up guesthouses for new members to bring members closer together. It is important for new immigrants to come to a group that shares a common dialect and culture, so that they can communicate with each other about their homeland and find safety and mutual support in sharing weal and woe. Chinatown is closer to fellow townspeople and allows new immigrants to make an immediate and indelible contribution. Chinese shops, Chinese restaurants, traditional customs, and familiar words also give new immigrants a sense of peace of mind. In December 1849, the first Chinese Guild Hall was established in San Francisco. By 1851, it was divided into two groups, one of which was the "Siyi Guild Hall" from Taishan, Xinhui, Kaiping, and Enping, and the other was the "Sanyi Guild Hall" from Zhongshan, Heshan, and Gaoyao. In 1852, Zhongshan people formed the "Yanghe Guild Hall"; Its guilds also include the "Zhaoqing guild hall", "Hopewell guild hall" and "Gangzhou guild hall". The Hakkas also form the "Rhehe guild hall". The largest guild hall, the "Ningyang guild hall", is branched off from the "Siyi Township Association". Xinning people (Taishan people) account for the majority of the Chinese in California, so the "Ningyang guild hall" has considerable influence. By 1854, the Chinese Association and the Chinese Association formed the "Seven Assembly Halls", which were later collectively referred to as "CHINESE. CONSOLTDATED. BENVOLENT. ASSOCIATION". The Chung Hwa Association represents the vast majority of Chinese immigrants from more than 20 regions in Guangdong. At this time, the leadership position of the guild hall has been established. For immigrants who have just arrived in a strange place, it is a great comfort to have an organization with a local accent that they are familiar with. The Chung Hwa Association is an unofficial spokesperson for the Chinese. It promotes the welfare of the Chinese, mediates disputes between individuals and groups, and provides help with Chinese education for Chinese children. The association is also an organization that presides over funeral affairs, responsible for the burial of dead Chinese and transporting the bones back to their hometowns. The early Chinese Association sent people to maintain law and order in Chinatown and litigated to protect the rights and interests of the Chinese, sometimes reaching the Supreme Court of the United States. The Chinese Association is also responsible for welcoming and assisting diplomatic envoys awaiting the imperial court. In the fourth year of Guangxu's reign (1878), Chen Lanbin, China's first minister to the United States, arrived in San Francisco. At that time, Liang Nan, the general manager of the Sanyi Guild Hall, led more than 200 business directors from the six major halls to welcome him. After that, Chen Shutang, the first consul, established the Jinshan Consulate in San Francisco. Domestic affairs in Chinatown were handled by the Chinese Association, major matters were sought from the consul, and external affairs were handled by the consul. The imperial court's orders could reach the overseas Chinese in Chinatown directly. When envoys or dignitaries are passing through or visiting, the Chinese Association will welcome them and provide them with special hospitality on behalf of the overseas Chinese. In 1886, Minister Zhang Yinhuan arrived in San Francisco, where the overseas Chinese delegation held a banquet that was almost full. There was also a visit from the Chinese fleet, and the overseas Chinese were very excited and warmly welcomed them. Such a patriotic and enthusiastic move will become a regular practice in the future. Most Chinese in major cities in the United States have organizations similar to the Chinese Association. The "China Office" in New York was established in 1883 and was composed of 60 groups representing all aspects of New York. Organizations in various places also have corresponding connections. After the U.S. Chinese Exclusion Act was passed in Washington, D.C., anti-China sentiment in the United States reached its climax, and Chinese associations in various places united into a "National Chinese Association" to coordinate various activities carried out by Chinese associations in various places to safeguard the rights and interests of the Chinese. Chinese people settled in Arizona in the 19th century. In the 1880s, the state's railway project was completed, and Chinese people worked in the mines, but most of them entered the city's Chinatown, which further promoted its prosperity. In early 1890, the city's Chinatown population exceeded 200. Among the early Chinese cultural relics in Alberta, there are two written records of Chinese SINO. Most of the Chinese organizations in this town are named after clan groups, such as the "Deng Gaomi Office" of the Deng clan, the "Yu Fengcaitang" of the Yu clan, the "Huangjiang Xia Yunshan Office" of the Huang clan (now the Huang clan association), and the "Longgang Office" composed of the four surnames Liu, Guan, Zhang, and Zhao, etc. Although there is no Chinese Association in this city, the Chinese Overseas Chinese Association in Phoenix City established the "Fenian Overseas Chinese Association" in 1968, which has the same functions and status as the Chinese offices and Chinese Associations in various places. Kaiping, the hometown of overseas Chinese in Guangdong, has been a distribution center for people and goods in the Siyi area since ancient times. In the early years, many people from Kaiping came to the United States to make a living. In the 1850s, people from Kaiping, Taishan, Xinhui and Enping established the "Siyi Guild Hall" in San Francisco. In 1862, people surnamed Deng and Hu from Kaiping and Yu from Taishan broke away from the Siyi Guild Hall to form the "Hehe Guild Hall". In 1898, people from Kaiping and Enping formed the "Enkai Guild Hall", which was later merged into the "Zhaoqing Guild Hall" in 1909. In 1911, the "Kaiping Association of Chinese Residents in the United States" was established in San Francisco. This year is the 100th anniversary celebration, and representatives from Kaiping in Phoenix City were invited to participate in the celebration. To this day, there are still many organizations of Kaiping folks across the United States, such as the "Kaiping Tanjiang Association of Southern California, USA" and so on. The hometown associations in Phoenix include the Alberta Taiwan Association, the Alberta Sichuan-Chongqing Association, etc. The Kaiping Mutual Aid Association of Alberta was established in Phoenix in 2011. The association stated that it will work hard to provide mutual aid and services to the Kaiping folks in Alberta in the future.

2f3b8f7e149363159bb503ce100460a26933dd53.sourceText: 美一家四口中毒死亡 两中国养女包括在内 美联社称，宾州一家四口因一氧化碳中毒而死亡，朋友和邻居们为此感到惋惜和痛心。 据Bucks郡地区检察官海克乐介绍，宾州州警局周二调查结果表明，周一，在跟妻子米歇尔吵架之后，该州Milford镇居民雷劳尔走到车库，开动汽车自杀。在周一晚赶到雷劳尔家中时，警方发现车库里充满了高浓度的一氧化碳。 海克乐说，调查人员相信雷劳尔的妻子和孩子们试图去救他，不幸被高浓度的一氧化碳毒死。消防营救人员未能挽回雷劳尔一家人的性命。 雷劳尔的外甥Rob Zern告诉记者，”雷劳尔一家试图挽救彼此的生命，但没有成功，我不知道这有什么错误，但这终归是一场悲剧。” 海克乐说，死亡的原因和方式仍然有待法医证实。 州警察没有发现遗言，但是车库的门把手被打掉，”这暗示丈夫进去之后，不想受到打扰或被抢救。” 调查人员表示，现场情况也暗示，他的妻子去到车库，打破另一张门的窗户，试图抢救他，但是她看来被致死性气体窒息倒下。 16岁的女儿金伯利（Kimberly）去到车库隔壁的厨房，被发现倒在地板上。十岁的女儿佳米（Jamie）据信也是如此，当营救人员到达的时候已经奄奄一息，后来不治身亡。 邻居Maggie Chambers女士说，两个女儿是从中国领养的，他们是”一个甜蜜的家庭”。 当地学校在网站宣布了两名女孩的死讯。数学老师MaryAnn Byatt在网站上说：”金伯利（Kimberly）是一名最甜蜜的人，总是关心他人，”网站上还说金伯利是一名很优异的学生，在高二学期结束时，她的微积分考试成绩满分。她也参加唱诗班及爵士乐队。 10岁的佳米就读5年级，参加学校的阅读奥林匹克队。与姐姐一样，她也参加学校的乐队及唱诗班，长大后想成为兽医。 周二下午，6个金伯利的同班同学在金伯利家的邮箱内，安放了花朵，然后围成一个圈，拉手祈祷。17岁的邻居Aislinn Strohecker说：”每个人都喜欢她，她的脸上总是洋溢着微笑，他们是最开心的一家人，他们很平易近人。”
2f3b8f7e149363159bb503ce100460a26933dd53.translatedText: Four members of an American family died of poisoning, including two Chinese adopted daughters. The Associated Press stated that a Pennsylvania family of four died due to carbon monoxide poisoning, and friends and neighbors expressed regret and heartache. According to Bucks County District Attorney Heckler, an investigation by the Pennsylvania State Police on Tuesday showed that after a fight with his wife Michelle on Monday, Ray Lauer, a resident of Milford Township, walked to the garage and drove his car to commit suicide. When police arrived at Relauer's home Monday night, they found the garage filled with high levels of carbon monoxide. Heckler said investigators believe Relauer's wife and children were poisoned by high levels of carbon monoxide while trying to save him. Fire rescue personnel were unable to save the lives of the Relauer family. Relauer's nephew Rob Zern told reporters, "The Relauer family tried to save each other's lives but failed. I don't know what was wrong with this, but it was a tragedy after all." Heckler said the cause and manner of death still need to be confirmed by the medical examiner. State police found no last words, but the garage door handle was knocked off, "suggesting that after the husband went in, he did not want to be disturbed or rescued." Investigators said the scene also suggested that his wife went to the garage, broke the window of another door and tried to save him, but she appeared to be suffocated by the lethal gas and collapsed. Daughter Kimberly, 16, went to the kitchen next to the garage and was found collapsed on the floor. Ten-year-old daughter Jamie, believed to be the same, was dying when rescuers arrived and later died. Neighbor Maggie Chambers said the two daughters were adopted from China and they were "a sweet family." The local school announced the girls' deaths on its website. "Kimberly was the sweetest person and always cared about others," math teacher MaryAnn Byatt said on the website, which also said Kimberly was an excellent student who received a perfect score on her calculus exam at the end of her sophomore semester. She also participates in choir and jazz band. 10-year-old Jiamie is in fifth grade and competes on the school's Reading Olympiad team. Like her sister, she also participates in the school band and choir, and wants to be a veterinarian when she grows up. On Tuesday afternoon, six of Kimberly's classmates placed flowers in Kimberly's mailbox, then formed a circle, held hands and prayed. Neighbor Aislinn Strohecker, 17, said: "Everyone loved her, she always had a smile on her face, they were the happiest family, they were very approachable."

dfd67d8de8e263d0a9ff86c81bcafb1cf9b8979e.sourceText: 【凤凰笔会】方正：秋天有感 凤凰城 方正 立秋了，天气 骤 然 变 冷，老祖宗的 节 气准得令人不可思 议 ！ 秋天 总 是跟 伤 感有点瓜葛， 秋湖的水美得让人叹息， 秋天的落叶 让人伤感，秋天的夕阳更让人恋恋不舍。 ”落霞与孤鹜齐飞， 秋水共长天一色”，王勃这对名句是文人对秋景最出神入化的描写。 秋天跟月亮也扯不清关系，中秋 赏 月，三五好友凑到一起 对 茶当歌，吃着手里的小月 饼 ，傻傻凝望天空中的大月 饼 出神。 欲乘 风 而去，又恐 琼 楼玉宇， 起舞弄清影，高 处 不 胜 寒，冰美人嫦娥， 你为 什么偏偏要跑到月亮那个 鸟 不生蛋的地方去呢？ 月亮 粑粑，肚里（里面）坐个爹爹， 爹爹出来 买菜，碰达奶奶， 奶奶出来 绣花，绣扎糍粑， 糍 粑跌得井里，变扎蛤蟆， 蛤蟆伸脚， 变扎喜鹊， 喜 鹊上树，变扎斑鸠， 斑 鸠咕咕咕， 和尚呷豆腐， 豆腐一匍渣，和尚呷 粑粑， 粑粑一匍壳， 和尚呷菱角， 菱角溜溜尖，和尚望 哒天， 天上四扎字， 和尚犯 哒事， 事又犯得 恶，抓哒和尚剁脑壳。 这 首我少年 时 代最 爱 的 湖南 通俗民 间诗 歌， 连 我女儿也能吟唱一二。 中国曾 经是个诗歌王国，唐宋两朝发展到顶峰，天上月亮一个，地下诗人无数。 古往今来，多少文人墨客，吟 诗作赋，以月光为题，夜色为景，创作了无数流芳百世 的不朽之作。 艺术语言和形式虽各有千秋，但对月光的情有独钟却是古今中外艺术家所共有的情结。 月光仿佛有某 种奇幻的魔力， 让 人 的思绪在夜色的笼罩下自由驰骋， 起伏的情感融入月光的幻想， 从 心中流淌出一首首描写月光和夜色的佳作，让人目不暇接，美不胜数。 音乐中以月光为题的也很多， 比如德彪西的月光，贝多芬的月光奏鸣曲还有肖邦的夜曲。 说到音乐中的夜色和月光，不能不提到波兰的钢琴诗人 – 肖邦。肖邦（ Fryderyk Fanciszek Chopin ， 1810 － 1849 ）生于波 兰，自幼喜爱民间音乐， 极富天才。七 岁时开始作曲，八岁登台演出，不满二十岁成为波兰著名的钢琴家和 作曲家。 后来波 兰沦陷，在漫长的一百多年里，波兰三次分别被俄国，普鲁士和奥地利 帝国瓜分。不愿臣服的肖邦，下半生都是在国外渡 过的，终生都没能回到他热爱的 故 乡。在华沙的萧邦公园里，至今还有一座萧邦的雕像，他的头向着东凝 视著祖国，至死也不暝目。 肖邦在国外流亡的日子， 创作了大量充满激情的不朽钢琴 作品。沙俄曾想收 买他，授予他 [ 俄帝国首席 钢琴家 ]的称号 ，但被肖邦 严辞拒绝. 肖邦晚年思 乡情切，生活得十分痛苦和寂寞， 他称自己为 [ 远离母亲的儿子 ] ，死前嘱附 亲人把心脏运回祖国埋葬, 以了却多年的思 乡之苦。 肖邦一生中共写了 21 首 夜曲，首首精巧 细腻，浪漫清幽，充满了诗情画意，杳渺幽香，让人爱不释手。 其中这首 E 大 调夜曲 ( 作品９第２号 ) ，作于 1830 年，是 萧邦所有的夜曲中最脍 炙人口的一首，具有典型的肖邦早期作品的 风格，恬静，优美，精雕细琢， 仿佛水晶灯般的晶 莹剔透。 夜深人静， 万 籁俱寂， 漫游在萧邦幻美的音乐天地里， 原来音 乐 的世界可以是 如此的美丽，如此的深不可 测！ 飘渺的夜色雾气之中，银白色的月光缓缓地照在宁静的湖面上，波光粼粼，晚风荡漾， 有如酣 饮了一壶美酒，醉倒在夜色的月光里。 夜色清幽霜 满楼， 凭 栏晓月照枝头。 梦 惊酒醒心何往？ 柳 雾秋寒点点愁。 萧邦的夜曲，将波兰民族音乐马祖卡舞， 波 兰舞曲和圆舞曲巧妙地融合在一起 ，装 饰音与半音音阶，转调以及双手节奏的复杂组合，写出充满美感和纯粹 的 钢琴音乐，大大扩展了钢琴音色的表现力和生命力。鲁宾斯坦曾说：萧邦是钢琴 中的灵魂，是 钢琴的吟游诗人。 与前 辈大师们描写月光有所不同，德彪西这首《月光》更注重对月光的真实感觉和印象，连同他的管弦乐序曲《牧神午后前奏曲》，开闯了印象主义之先河，成为印象派的传世经典之作。这首月光写于 1890 年，是 钢琴组曲《贝加摩组曲》中的一首。 《月光》 这首曲子是基于对意大利北部贝加摩地区月光的印象，运用了色彩极其丰富的和声，对宁静湖水中的朦胧夜色，水中的婆挲倒影，皎洁斑斓的月光的迷人色彩，都有着非常准确和感性的描写。 不同于 贝多芬，肖邦对月光的浪漫阐述，德彪西的月光世界，没有鲜明的对比和戏剧性冲突，非常强调和谐，用哲理般的思想，写实的象征手法，平静感受着光与影的色彩和自然韵律， 如同 梦境一般地飘浮在雾朦朦的清凉空气之中，月光之下。。。。。。 2013 － 09 － 28
dfd67d8de8e263d0a9ff86c81bcafb1cf9b8979e.translatedText: [Phoenix PEN] Fang Zheng: Feelings about Autumn Phoenix City Fang Zheng It’s the beginning of autumn, the weather has suddenly turned cold, and the solar terms of our ancestors are so accurate that it’s incredible! Autumn is always related to sadness. The water of Autumn Lake is so beautiful that people sigh, the fallen leaves in autumn make people sad, and the sunset in autumn makes people reluctant to leave. "The setting clouds and solitary swans fly together, and the autumn water forms the same color as the sky." These two famous lines by Wang Bo are the most exquisite descriptions of autumn scenery by literati. Autumn has nothing to do with the moon. During the Mid-Autumn Festival, friends gather together to enjoy the moon, sing songs over tea, eat small moon cakes in their hands, and stare innocently at the big moon cake in the sky. I want to ride the wind and go away, but I am afraid that the beautiful buildings and jade buildings will dance to clear the shadows. It is too cold at high places. Ice beauty Chang'e, why do you have to go to the moon, a place where birds do not lay eggs? Moon, daddy, sitting in the belly (inside), daddy comes out to buy vegetables, meets grandma, grandma comes out to embroider, embroider glutinous rice cake, glutinous rice cake falls into the well, turns into a toad, the toad stretches its legs, turns into a magpie, magpie climbs the tree, turns into a turtle dove, the turtle dove coos, the monk eats tofu, A piece of tofu is crumbs, the monk is eating a piece of cake, a piece of rice cake is a piece of shell, the monk is eating water chestnuts, the water chestnuts are sharp, the monk is looking at the sky, there are four characters in the sky, the monk commits a crime, and he commits a crime again, he grabs the monk's head and chops it off. This is my favorite Hunan popular folk poem when I was a boy. Even my daughter can sing a few words. China was once a kingdom of poetry. During the Tang and Song dynasties, it reached its peak. There was only one moon in the sky and countless poets underground. Throughout the ages, countless literati have recited poems and composed poems, using moonlight as their theme and night as their scenery, creating countless immortal works that will last forever. Although the artistic languages ​​and forms have their own merits, the special liking for moonlight is a complex shared by artists both at home and abroad in ancient and modern times. The moonlight seems to have some kind of magical magic, allowing people's thoughts to roam freely under the cover of the night. The ups and downs of emotions are integrated into the fantasy of the moonlight, and masterpieces describing the moonlight and night flow out from the heart, which is dizzying and beautiful. There are many songs with the theme of moonlight, such as Debussy's Moonlight, Beethoven's Moonlight Sonata and Chopin's Nocturne. Speaking of night and moonlight in music, we cannot fail to mention the Polish piano poet – Chopin. Chopin (Fryderyk Fanciszek Chopin, 1810-1849) was born in Poland. He loved folk music since childhood and was extremely talented. He began composing music at the age of seven, performed on stage at the age of eight, and became a famous pianist and composer in Poland before he was twenty. Later, Poland fell. In more than a hundred years, Poland was divided three times by Russia, Prussia and the Austrian Empire. Chopin, who was unwilling to surrender, spent the rest of his life abroad and never returned to his beloved hometown. In the Chopin Park in Warsaw, there is still a statue of Chopin. His head was facing east, staring at the motherland, and he would not close his eyes until his death. When Chopin was in exile abroad, he created a large number of passionate and immortal piano works. Tsarist Russia once wanted to bribe him and grant him the title of [Chief Pianist of the Russian Empire], but Chopin sternly refused. In his later years, Chopin was homesick and lived a very painful and lonely life. He called himself a "son far away from his mother" and before his death, he asked his relatives to transport his heart back to the motherland for burial, thus ending the pain of homesickness for many years. Chopin wrote a total of 21 nocturnes in his life. The first one is exquisite, romantic and quiet, full of poetry and painting, and has a subtle fragrance that makes people put it down. Among them, the Nocturne in E major (Op. 9 No. 2), composed in 1830, is the most popular of all Chopin's nocturnes. It has the typical style of Chopin's early works, quiet, beautiful, carefully crafted, and as crystal clear as a crystal lantern. In the dead of night, everything is silent, wandering in Chopin's magical world of music, it turns out that the world of music can be so beautiful, so unfathomable! In the misty night mist, the silver-white moonlight slowly shines on the quiet lake, with sparkling waves and rippling evening wind. It's like drinking a pot of fine wine and getting drunk in the night moonlight. The night is quiet and frosty, the building is full of frost, and the dawn moon shines on the branches by the railing. Dream: Where to go when you wake up from a drunken state of mind? Willow fog, autumn cold, a little sad. Chopin's nocturne cleverly combines the Polish national music mazurkas, polonaises and waltzes, with a complex combination of decorative tones, chromatic scales, modulations and the rhythm of both hands, creating piano music full of beauty and purity, which greatly expands the expressiveness and vitality of piano timbre. Rubinstein once said: Chopin is the soul of the piano and the bard of the piano. Different from the descriptions of moonlight by previous masters, Debussy's "Moonlight" pays more attention to the real feeling and impression of moonlight. Together with his orchestral overture "Prelude to the Afternoon of the Faun", it pioneered Impressionism and became a classic of Impressionism. Moonlight was written in 1890 and is one of the piano suites "Bergamo Suite". "Moonlight" This piece is based on the impression of moonlight in the Bergamo region of northern Italy. It uses extremely colorful harmonies to describe the hazy night in the quiet lake, the reflection of the waves in the water, and the charming colors of the bright and colorful moonlight. It is a very accurate and emotional description. Unlike Beethoven and Chopin's romantic interpretation of moonlight, Debussy's moonlight world has no sharp contrasts and dramatic conflicts. It places great emphasis on harmony. It uses philosophical thoughts and realistic symbolic techniques to calmly feel the colors and natural rhythms of light and shadow, floating like a dream in the cool misty air under the moonlight. . . . . . 2013-09-28

2323fc0e0a27df026a68ad7c6ee24ba917889277.sourceText: 【凤凰笔会】于心洁：《朱令》 凤凰城 于心洁 你美丽的容颜刻印在每个人的脑海你现在的境况搅扰着每个人的心扉曾经…
2323fc0e0a27df026a68ad7c6ee24ba917889277.translatedText: [Phoenix Pen Club] Yu Xinjie: "Zhu Ling" Phoenix City Yu Xinjie Your beautiful face is engraved in everyone's mind. Your current situation is disturbing everyone's heart. Once...

0fb71c1f1cb5f4223e75b6489ca4c53d2f9585be.sourceText: 你美丽的容颜 刻印在每个人的脑海 你现在的境况 搅扰着每个人的心扉 曾经万般忍耐的心 已经到了极限 曾经钢硬了的心肠 无法再熟视无睹
0fb71c1f1cb5f4223e75b6489ca4c53d2f9585be.translatedText: Your beautiful face is engraved in everyone's mind. Your current situation is disturbing everyone's heart. The heart that was once so patient has reached its limit. The heart that was once hardened can no longer turn a blind eye

8efbf2c080453adfbf86841025facd8fea7a310b.sourceText: 我们无能为力 在许多的地方 我们沉默不语 因为过多的无奈
8efbf2c080453adfbf86841025facd8fea7a310b.translatedText: We are powerless. In many places we are silent because of too much helplessness

2d8102281eb2af97e928157dcf72fcfdf585a3d2.sourceText: 但现在 已经不能再视而不见 你让我们看到了自己的遭遇 如果不再做出最后的呐喊
2d8102281eb2af97e928157dcf72fcfdf585a3d2.translatedText: But now, we can no longer turn a blind eye. You let us see what we are going through. If you don’t make the last cry

fd6c55246998ee436c3848ee83118847a6e6448f.sourceText: 那死是你的解脱的感觉 让我们夜不能寐 那生死都由不得自己的痛苦 让我们不得不造访你的遭遇
fd6c55246998ee436c3848ee83118847a6e6448f.translatedText: , then death is your feeling of relief. It makes us sleepless at night. Life and death cannot be controlled by our own pain. It makes us have to visit your experience

b34f47e16f496a2e1f70eca62707ec5cbbb42279.sourceText: 我签了我的名 只为每个人可能的遭遇 我发出了我的声音 只为替你发出一声叹息
b34f47e16f496a2e1f70eca62707ec5cbbb42279.translatedText: I signed my name just for everyone's possible experience. I made my voice just to sigh for you

01bf05c7cbc14956b233a701aa230e26cd6a5c97.sourceText: 你是这个时代悲剧的象征 让我们不想再苟且偷生地活着 你是这个时代不公的缩影 震撼的也不仅仅是我们的良知
01bf05c7cbc14956b233a701aa230e26cd6a5c97.translatedText: You are a symbol of the tragedy of this era. It makes us no longer want to live in an ignoble existence. You are the epitome of the injustice of this era. It’s not just our conscience that is shocked

d6f8ec3473216356e904219da95acaf4a2ce6475.sourceText: 你也许对自己的遭遇毫无记忆 却将我们的心狠狠地敲打 你的智力已经与孩童无疑 让人们惋惜愤怒无奈而呐喊
d6f8ec3473216356e904219da95acaf4a2ce6475.translatedText: You may have no memory of what happened to you, but you beat our hearts hard. Your intelligence is no doubt that of a child, making people cry with regret and anger helplessly

895e0608ef1438a98921686490cd81a0552e7936.sourceText: 无法想象你的痛苦 失去的记忆是你的福气 无法体会你的心情 曾经的聪明伶俐成为我们永久的痛
895e0608ef1438a98921686490cd81a0552e7936.translatedText: I can’t imagine your pain. The lost memory is your blessing. I can’t understand your mood. What was once smart has become our eternal pain

ddb9674a59036ca881827cb798c987c5f08d3588.sourceText: 神说：申冤在我 我必报应 可我依旧愿意为你发出一声叹息 主基督耶稣说：他必再来 等待着主为你做主的那天
ddb9674a59036ca881827cb798c987c5f08d3588.translatedText: God says: It is mine to redress the grievance. I will retaliate. But I am still willing to sigh for you. The Lord Christ Jesus said: He will come again. Waiting for the day when the Lord will decide for you.

666af75f3a4c2328eae771b6da15748f1abd7cfb.sourceText: 万国寄信便览 编辑兼总理： 黄金
666af75f3a4c2328eae771b6da15748f1abd7cfb.translatedText: A Handbook of Letters to All Nations Editor and Prime Minister: Gold

ad0915b752af76149de0d0599786f5dab3de082e.sourceText: 在二十世纪之初，五大洲之间的邮政靠轮船运送。一位姓黄名金的广东兴宁华侨，在旧金山邮局负责投递中文信件。年复一年，由于家乡人不识“洋文“，加上地理知识匮乏，从各国寄到美国的信件大批大批地被宣判为“无法投递“。于是他编辑出了这本1500页的《万国寄信便览》。
ad0915b752af76149de0d0599786f5dab3de082e.translatedText: At the beginning of the 20th century, postal services between the five continents were transported by ship. An overseas Chinese from Xingning, Guangdong, named Huang Jin, was responsible for delivering Chinese letters at the San Francisco Post Office. Year after year, due to the inability of people in my hometown to read "foreign languages" and the lack of geographical knowledge, a large number of letters sent to the United States from various countries are declared "undeliverable." So he edited this 1,500-page "Common Notes on Letters from All Nations".

bdaf4ee64ca854733544179a5c9f43d59567f2d4.sourceText: 作者查到，从书中的第1390页至1393页，记录了1913年的美国“亞利笋那省”（亚利桑那州）“无法投递“的中文信件，其中有杂货店、洗衣店和餐馆等的名号和地址的资料，包括“匪匿埠”(phoenix）有13间，在“祖荀埠”（Tucson)多达58间，另外还有其它城镇的华人店铺的资料。
bdaf4ee64ca854733544179a5c9f43d59567f2d4.translatedText: The author found that from pages 1390 to 1393 of the book, there are records of "undeliverable" Chinese letters from the "Arizona Province" (Arizona) in the United States in 1913. Among them are Information on the names and addresses of grocery stores, laundries and restaurants, including 13 in Phoenix and as many as 58 in Tucson, as well as information on Chinese shops in other towns.

e9fc41dc4207d7a31a545c4876283c57a5b73dfe.sourceText: 1913年版的《万国寄信便览》封面为红色漆布硬皮，书名烫金，因长期翻看使用，封皮磨损、颜色脱落。此书为万国寄信便览出版社编辑出版，主编为广东新宁旅美华侨黄金。黄金有感于“方今中外交通，华夷互市,披阅球图有如斯……。而外商两部曾无随时调查表以宣慰众睹，即有使领就近编册而限于一隅”，海外众华商也因信息交流不方便，不能凝聚众力，以至在国际商战中遭遇西方商业公司打压，兼且国内顽 固势力轻视阻碍，因而独自搜集海外公司、商号编著此册。
e9fc41dc4207d7a31a545c4876283c57a5b73dfe.translatedText: The cover of the 1913 edition of "Letter of Letters from All Nations" is a hard cover of red oilcloth, and the title of the book is gilded. Due to long-term reading and use, the cover is worn and the color has fallen off. This book is edited and published by Wanguo Letter Publishing House. The editor-in-chief is Jin Jin, an overseas Chinese living in the United States in Xinning, Guangdong. Huang Jin felt that "today's traffic between China and foreign countries, mutual trade between China and foreign countries, and reading the world map are like this.... However, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade did not have a survey form at any time to comfort the public, and even if they had officials nearby, they could only compile it in one corner." Overseas Chinese businessmen were also unable to unite their efforts due to inconvenient exchange of information. They were even suppressed by Western trading companies in the international business war, and the stubborn domestic forces ignored the obstacles, so they independently collected overseas companies and firms to compile this volume.

c0a16b0a46dc3f04dd011aad7d4830cc57c2bf51.sourceText: 黄金为什么要编辑这本《万国寄信便览》呢？作为旧金山邮局投递中文信件的职员，他日复一日，看到无论事家书还是商业信件，由于地址不详，无法投递。于是决定收集世界各地华人商家地址成册，以解决华人不会书写国际邮件信封的问题。（那个年代，许多人把信件邮寄到附近商家，让后商家通知收信人。）然而，1906年4月18日旧金山的一场大地震葬送了黄金等人几年
c0a16b0a46dc3f04dd011aad7d4830cc57c2bf51.translatedText: Why did Huang Huang edit this "Common Notes on Letters from All Nations"? As a clerk delivering Chinese letters at the San Francisco Post Office, he saw day after day that whether family letters or business letters could not be delivered due to unknown addresses. So we decided to collect the addresses of Chinese businesses around the world into a book to solve the problem of Chinese people not being able to write international mail envelopes. (In that era, many people mailed letters to nearby businesses, and the merchants notified the recipients.) However, a major earthquake in San Francisco on April 18, 1906 destroyed all the data collected by Jin Jin and others in the past few years

71f33392c03b4768e6c3a3c0032038d35d525823.sourceText: 以来收集的所有资料。震灾过后，收集资料重新开始。终于在1913年2月《万国寄信便览》得以问世。黄金说这本书“耗费了他们很多时间和精力”。
71f33392c03b4768e6c3a3c0032038d35d525823.translatedText: . After the earthquake, data collection resumed. Finally, in February 1913, the "Notes on Sending Letters to All Nations" was published. Gold said the book "took a lot of their time and energy."

b9ae8469b4229d2808485c316514723f15c58750.sourceText: 《万国寄信便览》全书涉及全世界数十个国家和地区，可谓是一部庞大国际商业网络的洋洋大观，是研究民国早期中国国际交通、 邮政、中国国际商业网络发展的第一手资料，具有重要的史料价值。这是一部不可多得的、具有重要研究价值的著作。此书由美国华侨余华，于 2006年9月捐赠给中国华侨历史博物馆。
b9ae8469b4229d2808485c316514723f15c58750.translatedText: "A Guide to Sending Letters from All Countries" covers dozens of countries and regions around the world. It can be said to be a vast overview of a huge international business network. It is a first-hand material for studying the development of China's international transportation, postal service, and China's international business network in the early Republic of China. It has important historical value. This is a rare work with important research value. This book was donated to the China Overseas Chinese History Museum in September 2006 by Yu Hua, an American overseas Chinese.

6e2178e6d927db2696ee2d1b7b28e290895083ce.sourceText: 1900年，凤凰城已有三间著名的餐馆由华人经营，但资料却是由英文文章记载下来的。 当时，从中国从寄往亚利桑那州各城镇的华人信件，也是因为寄信者在信封上所写的地址不详或有错漏，所以无法转寄到亚利桑那领地的商铺或者个人所收到。二十世纪之初，正值中国改朝换代，大清政府垮台而军阀混战。有道是：“风火连三月，家书抵万金”，但寄往万里之遥的信件，却往往无法送到大洋彼岸亲人之手，幸而，还有这么一位有心人，把这些信件一一收集，汇编成书，才让我们在今天还可看到了当时这些店铺的资料。这是亚省华人最早的中文资料记载。
6e2178e6d927db2696ee2d1b7b28e290895083ce.translatedText: In 1900, three famous restaurants in Phoenix were run by Chinese, but the information was recorded in English articles. At that time, Chinese letters sent from China to cities and towns in Arizona could not be forwarded to stores or individuals in the Arizona Territory because the address written by the sender on the envelope was unknown or had errors. At the beginning of the 20th century, China was undergoing a dynasty change. The Qing government collapsed and warlords fought. There is a saying: "A letter from home is worth ten thousand dollars when the wind and fire last for three months." However, letters sent thousands of miles away often fail to reach the hands of relatives on the other side of the ocean. Fortunately, there is such a caring person who collects these letters one by one and compiles them into a book, so that we can still see the information of these shops at that time today. This is the earliest Chinese record of Chinese people in Alberta.

85829c894c0f1d3b803148932c4b2e37342fbb37.sourceText: 雷大雨小 各州移民法提案多数失败 由于联邦政府没有移民改革行动，各州在移民议题上都试图自行处理，相对于 2010年的六个州，今年有一半以上的州参考来亚利桑那州的立法。 不过，各州此起彼落提案又提案后，惩罚措施最严格的法案几乎都失败。 《美联社》报导，那些通过的州法案多是强化现有的联邦法律，不过有少数州确实通过了帮助非法移民的立法。 为了让州议员们可以专注于预算危机，许多有关移民的措施被搁置。加上企业主出面强烈反对更严厉的制裁，他们担心会失去劳动力来源而且文书作业也会增加。 在年初，高失业率、共和党主导的新国会，以及全国对于白宫或国会没有能解决非法移民这个问题的怨气，使得亚利桑那州的法律被各州模仿。 路易斯安那州共和党州众议员哈里森声称，联邦政府没有行动引发他对移民问题制定州法律。不过哈里森和多数其他议员的提案最后都没有过关，而且要求企业使用联邦政府的电子电子验证系统E-verify检查新员工工作资格的法案多数也都失败。只有少数几个州认真地要惩罚雇主。 目前为止，只有乔治亚州和犹他州通过了有关移民的综合法案。南卡罗来纳州和阿拉巴马州仍在考虑。犹他州的法律包括一项允许非法移民工作的条款，而美国公民自由联盟则就犹他州的执法规定提出诉讼。 对于那些希望加强移民执法的州而言，乔治亚州法案最接近亚利桑那州立法，它的新法律允许地方执法人员对于不能提出可接受的身分证明的嫌疑人进行移民身份检查。和2007年亚利桑那州立法类似的是，乔治亚州还有一项规定要求10名以上雇员的雇主于2013年7月之前使用E-verify。乔治亚州州长本月签 署了这个法案，反对人士则表示要对该州提出诉讼。 在首府华盛顿让非法移民学生和年轻人合法化的《梦想法案》最近失败后，几个州于本会期通 过立法帮助非法移民学生。马里兰州核准非法移民适用州立大学学费，伊利诺伊州可能为他们成立私人奖学金基金，而康乃狄克州则让非法移民适用州内学费的范围 扩大到研究所。奥勒冈州给发法移民适用州内学费的法案在参议院通过，不过还没送到众议院。 亚利桑那州的议员要求学区注明学生的居住地，不过是为了防止住在墨西哥边境的儿童进入亚利桑那州的学校就读。 只有印第安纳州通过法律禁止非法移民适用州内学费，但这主要是象征性的动作。 多数州移民法案没有获得通过，而无法达成妥协是关键原因。不过正反两方的专家多把这些立法的失败归因于企业主。 ”企业主用以往没有走出来反对”，大多支持移民改革的小型企业主所组成的全国性联盟ImmigrationWorks USA主席杰卡布指出。 许多佛罗里达州的企业主表示，他们担心移民权利团体组织抵制亚利桑那州旅游的这种杯葛会对经济造成损害。 在亚利桑那州，60名高层企业主管签署一封信给该州的参议院议长，要求暂停执行移民立法。 位于印第安纳波利斯的礼来制药厂是公开反对亚利桑那州式法案的公司之一。上周，印第安纳州州长丹尼尔斯签署了较为温和的立法：非法移民不得适用州内学费，以及终止雇用非法移民企业的抵税额。 在犹他州，企业协助制订立犹他州协定。这份协定在执法上类似于亚利桑那州，不过允许非法移民在该州工作。在自由联盟提告后，一名法官上周冻结了这个法案。 事实上，佛罗里达州因为众议院和参议院未能就E-verify这个问题达成妥协使得法案失败。印第安纳州和阿拉巴马州也因参众两院对雇主的措施意见分歧而面临类似的分裂。 主张严格限制移民的移民研究中心执行主任柯阔瑞认为，许多企业担心E-verify的实施来反对这些法案。 在此同时，移民及支持者也准备反攻。 在佛罗里达州，农场工人、学生和其他移民和积极人士于委员会听证会期间花了几星期在州政府抗议，不过幕后也进行大量游说。 在堪萨斯州，他们迅速传播共和党众议员佩克把非法移民比作野生猪的YouTube影片，很快在全国引发反弹，使得那里的法案失败。 拉丁裔团体Democracia USA刊登广告反对科罗拉多州、宾州和佛罗里达州的法案，该团体主席莫苏里声称，这些州的法案没有能回答基本问题。例如聘用保姆的家庭是否必须使用E-verify，或是新员工被发现没有工作资格时雇主是否会受 到失业保险的限制。 民主党联邦参议员上周于华盛顿重新提出《梦想法案》，不过不太可能通过共和党主导的众议院，当然更不可能在2012年大选前通过。
85829c894c0f1d3b803148932c4b2e37342fbb37.translatedText: Most of the state immigration law proposals failed. As the federal government has not taken action on immigration reform, states are trying to handle immigration issues on their own. Compared with six states in 2010, more than half of the states this year referred to Arizona's legislation. However, as states proposed one after another, the bills with the most stringent penalties almost all failed. The Associated Press reported that most of the state bills passed strengthened existing federal laws, but a few states did pass legislation to help illegal immigrants. Many immigration measures have been put on hold so state lawmakers can focus on the budget crisis. Plus business owners have come out strongly against tougher sanctions, fearing a loss of labor sources and an increase in paperwork. At the start of the year, high unemployment, a new Republican-dominated Congress and national resentment that the White House or Congress were failing to address the problem of illegal immigration led to Arizona's law being copied by other states. Louisiana Republican state Rep. Harrison claims that the federal government's inaction prompted him to enact state laws on immigration. However, Harrison and most other lawmakers' proposals ultimately failed, and most bills requiring companies to use the federal government's electronic verification system to check new employees' job qualifications also failed. Only a few states are serious about punishing employers. So far, only Georgia and Utah have passed comprehensive bills on immigration. South Carolina and Alabama are still considering it. Utah's law includes a provision allowing illegal immigrants to work, and the American Civil Liberties Union sued Utah over its enforcement provisions. For states looking to tighten immigration enforcement, the Georgia bill comes closest to the Arizona legislation, with its new law allowing local law enforcement officers to conduct immigration status checks on suspects who cannot present acceptable proof of identity. Similar to the 2007 Arizona legislation, Georgia also has a provision requiring employers with more than 10 employees to use E-verify by July 2013. Georgia's governor signed the bill into law this month, and opponents have threatened to sue the state. After the recent failure of the DREAM Act to legalize illegal immigrant students and young people in Washington, several states passed legislation this session to help illegal immigrant students. Maryland has approved state college tuition for illegal immigrants, Illinois may establish a private scholarship fund for them, and Connecticut has expanded the scope of in-state tuition for illegal immigrants to graduate schools. Oregon's bill to provide in-state tuition for immigrant immigrants passed the Senate but has not yet been sent to the House of Representatives. Arizona lawmakers are requiring school districts to indicate where students live, simply to prevent children living on the Mexican border from attending Arizona schools. Only Indiana has passed a law banning in-state tuition for illegal immigrants, but that was mostly a symbolic move. Most state immigration bills failed to pass, and the inability to reach a compromise was a key reason. But experts on both sides of the aisle mostly attribute the failure of these laws to business owners. "Business owners have not come out in the past to oppose it," said Jacob Jacobs, president of ImmigrationWorks USA, a national coalition of small business owners who mostly support immigration reform. Many Florida business owners say they fear the economic damage from a boycott organized by immigrant rights groups against travel to Arizona. In Arizona, 60 top business executives signed a letter to the state's Senate president calling for a moratorium on immigration legislation. Indianapolis-based Eli Lilly and Company is one of the companies that has spoken out against the Arizona-style bill. Last week, Indiana Governor Daniels signed milder legislation that would ban in-state tuition for illegal immigrants and end tax credits for businesses that employ illegal immigrants. In Utah, businesses helped create the Utah Compact. The agreement is similar to Arizona in enforcement, but allows illegal immigrants to work in the state. A judge froze the bill last week after a lawsuit from the Liberty Alliance. In fact, Florida's bill failed because the House and Senate failed to reach a compromise on the issue of E-verify. Indiana and Alabama are facing similar divisions with the House and Senate divided over employer measures. Ke Kuorui, executive director of the Immigration Research Center, which advocates strict restrictions on immigration, believes that many companies are worried about the implementation of E-verify and oppose these bills. Meanwhile, immigrants and their supporters are preparing to fight back. In Florida, farmworkers, students and other immigrants and activists spent weeks protesting at the state government during committee hearings, but there was also heavy lobbying behind the scenes. In Kansas, they quickly spread a YouTube video of Republican Rep. Pecker comparing illegal immigrants to wild pigs, which quickly triggered a national backlash and caused the bill there to fail. The Latino group Democracia USA ran ads opposing the bills in Colorado, Pennsylvania and Florida. Mossuri, the group's president, claimed that the bills in these states failed to answer basic questions. For example, whether families hiring nannies must use E-verify, or whether employers will be subject to unemployment insurance if a new employee is found to be ineligible to work. Democratic federal senators reintroduced the "Dream Act" in Washington last week, but it is unlikely to pass the Republican-dominated House of Representatives, and certainly not before the 2012 election.

2e51111564a6c9446d4489806bb0dad09da0cb55.sourceText: 亚利桑那中华商会举办商业联谊会 （亚省时报讯） 亚利桑那中华商会与6月26日下午五点半在斯科茨代尔（Scottsdale）市的莫特卢西亚酒店举行商业联谊会。除了中华商会的部分会员，还有很多第一次参加华裔商业联谊的朋友，大约20多人。 参加商业联谊会的朋友来自各行各业，有律师，会计师，保险，金融，媒体从业人员，企业主等等。这是松散的联谊方式，大家各自拿着自己喜欢的饮料或者食品，一边品味美酒佳肴，一边相互认识，介绍自己从事的行业，看看是否有合作的机会和可能。 下次亚利桑那中华商会的活动将于9月27日与凤凰城成都姐妹市合作共同开展与中国进行经济合作项目。
2e51111564a6c9446d4489806bb0dad09da0cb55.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Chamber of Commerce held a business networking party (Alberta Times News) The Arizona Chinese Chamber of Commerce held a business networking party at 5:30 pm on June 26 at the Motel Lucia Hotel in Scottsdale. In addition to some members of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, there were also many friends who were participating in the Chinese Business Network for the first time, about 20 people. Friends participating in the business fraternity come from all walks of life, including lawyers, accountants, insurance, finance, media practitioners, business owners, etc. This is a loose way of networking. Everyone takes their favorite drinks or food, and while tasting the fine wine and food, they get to know each other, introduce the industries they are engaged in, and see if there are any opportunities and possibilities for cooperation. The next event of the Arizona Chinese Chamber of Commerce will be on September 27 in cooperation with the sister city of Chengdu in Phoenix to jointly carry out economic cooperation projects with China.

9871dbe2a5af70df14a19e6e9e36b35cfe675f72.sourceText: 中华商会主办的这次讲座于当晚 7:00 ，在亚利桑那州立大学市中心校区举办。现场来了近 40 位华裔小企业主或者商业部门负责人。多家美国电视台，报纸进行了采访报道。州务卿肯 贝内特到现场详细介绍了州政府解决州政府财政赤字的办法，从缩减政府运行成本，依然将 60% 的税收来支持教育，创造好的投资环境，吸引从加州转战其他地方的经济体。

b4cb026baab314a5e99e06ddf88cf2e8960017b5.sourceText: 香港-本周三，亚洲开发银行(Asian Development Bank)发布的报告预测，中国经济发展减退，同一天发布的中国经济数值疲软，这些都突显了全球经济动荡和发展势头的放缓让亚洲地区的经济步履蹒跚，亚洲经济的两位数增长时代已经成为了过去时。
b4cb026baab314a5e99e06ddf88cf2e8960017b5.translatedText: Hong Kong - On Wednesday, the Asian Development Bank (Asian Development Bank) released a report predicting a decline in China's economic development. China's economic data released on the same day were weak. These highlighted that global economic turmoil and the slowdown in development momentum have made the Asian economy falter. The era of double-digit growth in Asian economies has become a thing of the past.

1a0c61a1226895ea699ba5f0ccd05f108fd0f861.sourceText: 亚洲开发银行在对亚洲区域最新一期的经济报告中更新称，崛起中的亚洲地区棗包括中国、印度、印度尼西亚和泰国，但不包含日本在内棗在2012年的经济增速可能达到6.1%，比2009年要高一点。而此时，世界经济依然因为全球经济危机而徘徊不前。
1a0c61a1226895ea699ba5f0ccd05f108fd0f861.translatedText: The Asian Development Bank updated in its latest economic report on the Asian region that the rising Asian region includes China, India, Indonesia and Thailand, but does not include Japan. The economic growth rate in 2012 may reach 6.1%, which is slightly higher than in 2009. At this time, the world economy is still reeling from the global economic crisis.

be85ef3f9ebea821371f7f113cce8dcd5a135978.sourceText: 更新后的报告大幅降低了亚洲开发银行于今年4月针对同一区域所做的预测，当时的报告预测，2012年这一区域的经济增速为6.9%，2013年的增速为7.3%。预期的调低突显了全球经济状况今年出现了恶化。
be85ef3f9ebea821371f7f113cce8dcd5a135978.translatedText: The updated report significantly lowered the forecast made by the Asian Development Bank for the same region in April this year, which predicted that the economic growth rate in this region would be 6.9% in 2012 and 7.3% in 2013. The lower forecasts underscore the deterioration in global economic conditions this year.

3b0db2761a8c9c2125f3f3f22a54147e90b4709e.sourceText: 在香港举行的新闻发布会上，亚洲开发银行首席经济学家李昌镛(Changyong Rhee)表示，”经济增速下滑的速度比预期的要快得多。”
3b0db2761a8c9c2125f3f3f22a54147e90b4709e.translatedText: At a press conference in Hong Kong, Changyong Rhee, chief economist of the Asian Development Bank, said, "Economic growth is declining much faster than expected."

e069af7ff269fd2dcdfa5847ee1f1487d2adbf92.sourceText: 更加糟糕的是，经济下滑尤为明显的是本地区的重量级经济体，中国和印度。预期这两国今年的经济增速分别只能达到7.7%和5.6%。
e069af7ff269fd2dcdfa5847ee1f1487d2adbf92.translatedText: What's worse is that the economic decline is particularly obvious in the region's heavyweight economies, China and India. The economic growth rates of these two countries are expected to only reach 7.7% and 5.6% respectively this year.

03621a1a5afb63d8419949b0b90027cca652c61e.sourceText: 同样地，这两个数字比亚洲开发银行之前的预测和两国去年的增速都要低；因为国内问题，比如经济转型步伐缓慢，印度受创尤其严重。
03621a1a5afb63d8419949b0b90027cca652c61e.translatedText: Again, these two figures are lower than the Asian Development Bank's previous forecasts and both countries' growth rates last year; India was particularly hard hit because of domestic problems, such as the slow pace of economic transformation.

dad2cb0edfbd0c6bf81d24a4c50f9d5e6213cc61.sourceText: 和印度相比，中国对出口的依赖性更高。去年一年，中国经济已经快速放缓。经济危机之前，中国经济出现了多年的两位数狂飙，虽然如此，决策者还算认可大约7.5%的经济增速。
dad2cb0edfbd0c6bf81d24a4c50f9d5e6213cc61.translatedText: Compared with India, China is more dependent on exports. China's economy has slowed down rapidly over the past year. Before the economic crisis, China's economy experienced double-digit surges for many years. Despite this, policymakers still recognized an economic growth rate of about 7.5%.

700ea02396c3441486b7fa8b1ba7ed34e15d682a.sourceText: 周三，来自中国服务业的数字显示，今年9月，服务业出现了过去多个月里最为疲软的扩张态势：国家统计局发布的采购经理人指数从8月的56.3%下跌到了9月的53.7%。这一数字如高于50%，则显示行业在扩张。
700ea02396c3441486b7fa8b1ba7ed34e15d682a.translatedText: On Wednesday, figures from China's service industry showed that in September this year, the service industry experienced the weakest expansion in the past many months: the purchasing managers index released by the National Bureau of Statistics fell from 56.3% in August to 53.7% in September. If this number is higher than 50%, it shows that the industry is expanding.

f82d98bab92f4ff3f348e6845993518d84ffb376.sourceText: 根据亚洲开发银行的数据，服务业为中国整体经济增长贡献了40%的份额，并贡献了三分之一的就业机会。分析人士评论，9月疲软的经济数据显示，不仅是出口，中国的内需也不景气。
f82d98bab92f4ff3f348e6845993518d84ffb376.translatedText: According to the Asian Development Bank, the service industry contributes 40% to China's overall economic growth and one-third of its employment opportunities. Analysts commented that weak economic data in September showed that not only exports, but also China's domestic demand was sluggish.

9412c0987a733a11c1b5cd9cf78c45938f074658.sourceText: 今年第三季度，法国兴业银行(Soci閠?G閚閞ale)驻香港经济学家克劳斯 巴德尔(Klaus Baader)在给客户的报告中写道，”我们看到，亚洲经济正在见底回升，但是，不确定的程度上升了。”
9412c0987a733a11c1b5cd9cf78c45938f074658.translatedText: In the third quarter of this year, Klaus Bader, an economist at Société Générale in Hong Kong Baader wrote in a report to clients, "We see that the Asian economy is bottoming out, but the level of uncertainty has increased."

2607764e11d09603ce7edcd03f7a63d0268e430d.sourceText: 亚洲开发银行强调，虽然它预期亚洲经济增速放得更加缓慢了，但是这个增速依然”令人羡慕”。
2607764e11d09603ce7edcd03f7a63d0268e430d.translatedText: The Asian Development Bank emphasized that although it expects Asia's economic growth to slow down, the growth rate is still "enviable."

b2a6103bce896f4d953e479b9283e51d3e18a5b7.sourceText: 首席经济学家李昌镛说，”没有必要恐慌，”他补充说，中国以走着瞧的态度实施措施，刺激增长， ”在此刻”这好像”是正确的方式”。
b2a6103bce896f4d953e479b9283e51d3e18a5b7.translatedText: Chief Economist Lee Chang-yong said, "There is no need to panic," adding that China is taking a wait-and-see attitude to implement measures to stimulate growth, which "seems to be the right way to go at this moment."

8b0d0abd643a3233c563dc7120fc9e51309118cb.sourceText: 长久以来，分析人士都主张，中国和其他新兴经济体必须着眼于经济增长的质量，而不是纯粹的经济扩张速度。他们还主张，降低这些经济体对以出口和制造业促增长的依赖性，转而把重心放在培育内需、提高生产力和鼓励服务业的发展等方面。
8b0d0abd643a3233c563dc7120fc9e51309118cb.translatedText: Analysts have long argued that China and other emerging economies must focus on the quality of economic growth rather than the sheer rate of economic expansion. They also advocated reducing the dependence of these economies on exports and manufacturing to promote growth, and instead focusing on cultivating domestic demand, improving productivity and encouraging the development of the service industry.

d12040a426ce3b6087e56bea5d642774cb5d4c7a.sourceText: 李昌镛说，这一区域的服务业规模比外界普遍相信的要更大，但是，破旧的基础设施和合格人才的匮乏束缚了经济的发展，同时，糟糕的规则设计和前后不一的执行方式常常扼杀了经商环境。
d12040a426ce3b6087e56bea5d642774cb5d4c7a.translatedText: Lee Changyong said the region's service industry is larger than generally believed, but shabby infrastructure and a lack of qualified talent have constrained economic development, while poorly designed rules and inconsistent enforcement often stifle the business environment.

7c8b82a57fcc50458d0ca941d34788d6eed9ca00.sourceText: 李昌镛表示，”有大量的规则限制竞争，它们束缚了服务业的发展，影响了从街角小店到移动电话的所有服务业，必须清除这些障碍。”
7c8b82a57fcc50458d0ca941d34788d6eed9ca00.translatedText: Lee Changyong said, "There are a large number of rules that restrict competition. They restrict the development of the service industry and affect all service industries from corner stores to mobile phones. These obstacles must be removed."

2cf189220db4e35531be2e026439206d2c5f6609.sourceText: 凤凰城空港机场成全美十大最危险机场 最新的”旅游和休闲”杂志指出，凤凰城空港机场被评为全美最危险的机场之一。 该杂志声称，他们根据美国35个最繁忙的机场，过去5年内，FAA跑道安全报告和独立跑道数据得出的结论。 空港机场排名第8，理由是有19个跑道事故。 2010年3月，一架离境的西南航空公司737班机差点与抵达的帝国航空公司塞斯纳班机相撞，当时双方相距只有50英尺。 该杂志并报告了空港机场最近完成的跑道安全方面改进，包括跑道状态灯，新的滑行道连接器和年底竣工的安全缓冲地带扩展。
2cf189220db4e35531be2e026439206d2c5f6609.translatedText: Phoenix Airport ranks among the top ten most dangerous airports in the United States. The latest "Travel and Leisure" magazine pointed out that Phoenix Airport has been rated as one of the most dangerous airports in the United States. The magazine claims it based its conclusions on FAA runway safety reports and independent runway data over the past five years at the 35 busiest airports in the United States. Konggang Airport ranked 8th, citing 19 runway accidents. In March 2010, a departing Southwest Airlines 737 nearly collided with an arriving Imperial Airways Cessna flight, just 50 feet apart. The magazine also reported on the airport's recently completed runway safety improvements, including runway status lights, new taxiway connectors and a safety buffer extension that was completed by the end of the year.

fe41072c79da440bf336854bd2808ddad02f489b.sourceText: 今奇：卞和典故之引发古人说：“凤凰不落无宝之地”
fe41072c79da440bf336854bd2808ddad02f489b.translatedText: Modern Strangeness: What caused Bian He’s allusion to cause the ancients to say: “The Phoenix never falls to a land without treasures”

9c4cc92304b3d1a61082985041a0bd8e6c53634d.sourceText: 今奇：卞和典故之引发古人说：“凤凰不落无宝之地” 《趣话凤凰城》（1） 神州大地战国时期，楚人卞和在山中偶…
9c4cc92304b3d1a61082985041a0bd8e6c53634d.translatedText: Modern Strangeness: What caused Bian He’s allusion to cause the ancients to say: “The Phoenix never falls to a land without treasures” "Interesting Words about Phoenix" (1) During the Warring States Period in China, Bian He, a Chu man, happened to see a phoenix falling on a big stone in the mountains...

0d67bb84699e5116a6a631ca3f24409559d6b8bb.sourceText: 神州大地战国时期，楚人卞和在山中偶见一凤凰落扵一块大石之上，卞和以此石献于厉王，厉王以欺君之罪断卞和左足。武王继位，卞和又献此石，武王又以欺君之罪断其右足。数年后文王继位，卞和抱石痛哭扵荆山，文王派人剖其石，果得举世罕见之宝玉。文王为表彰卞和的一片忠诚，命命宝石为”和氏璧”。司马迁在《廉颇蔺相如列传》中称”和氏璧”天下共传之宝也”。 三十年前今奇与德国大使馆文化参赞海顿在1988龙年谈龙时他问起”凤”，今奇顺便告诉海顿”和的故典，”。海顿听了很高兴，他说美国有个鳯凰城，可能夙凰城埋藏着许多宝石。海顿很热心他找了一些夙凰城的历史资料和传说…..传说总有些神话色彩如同我们的”西㳺记”，原来我们的凤凰城早有凤凰落地之趣味神话。 早在四千年前，神州大地一批炎黄子孙在天灾苦役逼迫下，不惜长途跋涉远离家乡，其中一部分西越沙漠进入今天的阿拉伯地区之后又分别跨过红海南下进非州；渡过地中海北上欧洲厖又经历千年演变一些顽强的神州健儿踏入美州，神州人进入美洲比着名航海家哥仑布发现美洲”新大陆”早一千年。人们不难看出印第安人与今日神州大地的蒙古人西藏人，在气质和外形上都有相似之処。 ”美利坚”在地球上尙未出现的一千年前，在印第安人居住地，有一天的早晨突然降了一阵红雨，红雨过后霞光满天有位九十九岁高龄的印第安老婆婆，第一个看到一只美丽的长尾大鸟落到山前一片沙漠中。第二天人们犮现大鸟降落的沙漠中生长出一大片鲜花和绿草，许多印第安人欢快地跑下山奔向鲜花和绿草，当人们走近的时候，大家被惊呆了，原来那鲜花是五颜六色的宝石，绿草是晶莹欲滴的翡翠！朴实的印第安人手牵手，高兴地围着这一大片神圣宝石唱歌跳舞，谁也不去拿宝石。这消息很快被百里外的印第安人大酋长知道了，他派了二十个壮汉带着一百个奴僕，命令他们把全部宝石収回来。当二十个壮汉刚刚闯入宝石圈突然燃起冲天大火，火光映红天空，只见那只长尾美丽大鸟飞出飞出火焰在天空转了三圈就朝太平洋方向飞去，后来有人推断美丽的长尾大鸟飞向神州大地，也有人说长尾神鸟飞向了天堂。
0d67bb84699e5116a6a631ca3f24409559d6b8bb.translatedText: When King Wu succeeded to the throne, Bian He presented the stone again, and King Wu had his right foot amputated for the crime of deceiving the king. A few years later, when King Wen succeeded to the throne, Bian He cried bitterly and went to Jingshan Mountain to hold a stone. King Wen sent people to cut open the stone, and the result was a rare gem and jade in the world. In recognition of Bian He's loyalty, King Wen ordered the gem to be "He's Bi". Sima Qian said in "The Biography of Lian Po and Lin Xiangru" that "He's Bi" is a treasure that has been passed down all over the world. Thirty years ago, when Jin Qi was talking about the dragon with Haydn, the Cultural Counselor of the German Embassy in 1988, he asked about "phoenix". Jin Qi told Haydn by the way, "The story of "He". Haydn was very happy to hear that. He said that there is a Phoenix City in the United States, which may be the Phoenix. There are many gems buried in the city. Haydn was very enthusiastic. He found some historical information and legends about Suhuang City... The legends always have some mythical flavor, just like our "Xi'an Ji". It turns out that our Phoenix City has an interesting myth about the landing of the phoenix. As early as 4,000 years ago, a group of descendants of the Yan and Huang people in China were forced by natural disasters and hard labor to travel long distances away from their hometowns. Some of them entered the deserts of Western Vietnam and entered today's Arabia. Then they crossed the Red Sea and went south to Africa; they crossed the Mediterranean and went north to Europe and experienced thousands of times. In the 1980s, some tenacious Chinese athletes entered the Americas. The Chinese entered the Americas a thousand years before the famous navigator Columbus discovered the "New World" in the Americas. It is not difficult to see that the Indians are similar in temperament and appearance to the Mongols and Tibetans in today's China. A thousand years before "America" appeared on the earth, in the Indian settlement, a burst of red rain suddenly fell one morning. After the red rain, the sky was filled with glow. A ninety-nine-year-old Indian woman was the first to see a beautiful long-tailed bird landing in a desert in front of the mountain. The next day, people saw a large area of flowers and green grass growing in the desert where the big bird landed. Many Indians ran happily down the mountain towards the flowers and green grass. When people came closer, they were shocked. It turned out that the flowers were colorful gems and the green grass was crystal clear emerald! The Indians held hands and sang and danced happily around this large area of sacred gems. No one went to take the gems. The news was soon known to the Indian chief hundreds of miles away. He sent twenty strong men with a hundred slaves and ordered them to take back all the gems. Just when Han broke into the gemstone circle, a fire burst into the sky, and the fire reflected the sky red. He saw the beautiful long-tailed bird flying out, flying out of the flames, turning three times in the sky, and then flew towards the Pacific Ocean. Later, some people inferred that the beautiful long-tailed big bird flew to the land of China, and some people said that the long-tailed divine bird flew to heaven.

538ab9c13ff7b6bc0cb613192ca640e81dbca6df.translatedText: Chinese Ambassador to the United States Cui Tiankai’s trip to Arizona

b1c6e7c366412977ea8346382e30249283469a2c.sourceText: 中国驻美国大使崔天凯亚利桑那之行 （谢成彦 郜子雁 报道）2016年4月12日崔天凯大使访问美国亚利桑那…
b1c6e7c366412977ea8346382e30249283469a2c.translatedText: Chinese Ambassador to the United States Cui Tiankai’s trip to Arizona (reported by Xie Chengyan and Gao Ziyan) On April 12, 2016, Ambassador Cui Tiankai visited Arizona, the United States...

70033df87a9f0527a2b9e82b792895f33493d373.sourceText: （谢成彦 郜子雁 报道）2016年4月12日崔天凯大使访问美国亚利桑那州，会见了州长Doug Ducey, 凤凰城市市长Greg Stanton。受到关注的是当天晚上，在Wrigley Mansion酒店，崔天凯大使受约参加的演讲和提问。本次活动是由桑德拉康纳研究所（Sandra Day O’onnor Institute ）和麦凯恩国际领导学院（The McCain Institute for International Leadership）主办。崔大使回答了前大使，麦凯恩国际领导学院总监Kurt Volker有关，中国经济，国防，以及邻国的关系等问题。众多来宾向崔大使提出了空气质量，人权，独生子女政策，西藏等等问题。崔大使表示中国的经济正在转型，不再是以高污染，低廉价劳动力在经济竞争中取胜。现在正在激励年轻人的创造性，提供更多技术含量高的职位。中国与邻国之间的关系，大部分都是正常的，局部会有一些利益冲突，但是中国还是本着和平对话，协商的态度，积极地解决问题。中国同样反对核武器的研究和制造，共同维护世界和平和安全。崔天凯的精彩的演讲受到中美来宾的热烈反应。
70033df87a9f0527a2b9e82b792895f33493d373.translatedText: (Xie Chengyan and Gao Ziyan) 报道）2016年4月12日崔天凯大使访问美国亚利桑那州，会见了州长Doug Ducey, 凤凰城市市长Greg Stanton。受到关注的是当天晚上，在Wrigley Mansion酒店，崔天凯大使受约参加的演讲和提问。 This event is sponsored by the Sandra Day O’onnor Institute and The McCain Institute for International Leadership.崔大使回答了前大使，麦凯恩国际领导学院总监Kurt Volker有关，中国经济，国防，以及邻国的关系等问题。众多来宾向崔大使提出了空气质量，人权，独生子女政策，西藏等等问题。崔大使表示中国的经济正在转型，不再是以高污染，低廉价劳动力在经济竞争中取胜。 It is now stimulating the creativity of young people and providing more highly technical positions. Most of the relations between China and its neighboring countries are normal, with some local conflicts of interest. However, China still actively solves problems in the spirit of peaceful dialogue and consultation. China also opposes the research and manufacture of nuclear weapons and jointly safeguards world peace and security. Cui Tiankai’s wonderful speech received enthusiastic responses from Chinese and American guests.

752fdfdc9b28265fd844d894735c3ce197ee9039.sourceText: Kurt Volker与崔天凯大使交换礼物
752fdfdc9b28265fd844d894735c3ce197ee9039.translatedText: Kurt Volker exchanged gifts with Ambassador Cui Tiankai

8162938435940c1e32f0854e7fea252e3f37fb6d.sourceText: 4月13日晚6：00，中国驻美国大使崔天凯先生的招待会在亚利桑那大学Sun Devil Fitness Complex Maroon Gym 举行。近百名ASU中国留学生，教师代表和使馆工作人员参加了此次招待会。
8162938435940c1e32f0854e7fea252e3f37fb6d.translatedText: At 6:00 pm on April 13, a reception for Mr. Cui Tiankai, Chinese Ambassador to the United States, was held at the Sun Devil Fitness Complex Maroon Gym at the University of Arizona. Nearly a hundred ASU Chinese students, teacher representatives and embassy staff attended the reception.

ff4ddb9f69043dc4dcc53b66f945908a0c649fa1.sourceText: 招待会上，崔天凯大使就ASU中国学生的情况，中美关系，中美青年之间的交流进行了简短的演讲。招待会后，崔天凯大使与在场的ASU中国留学生进行了近距离的交流。ASU的中国留学生就自己关心的话题向大使进行了提问。一位工程专业的中国留学生向崔天凯大使询问了自己专业在美国和国内的就业情况，分享了自己目前面临的就业困惑。崔大使在现场耐心地向他进行了解答。崔大使表示，无论是在美国就业还是回国，都尊重同学们自己的选择，都有利于促进中美两国关系的发展。
ff4ddb9f69043dc4dcc53b66f945908a0c649fa1.translatedText: At the reception, Ambassador Cui Tiankai gave a brief speech on the situation of Chinese students at ASU, Sino-US relations, and exchanges between Chinese and American youths. After the reception, Ambassador Cui Tiankai had a close communication with the Chinese students at ASU present. Chinese international students at ASU asked the ambassador questions about topics they care about. A Chinese engineering student asked Ambassador Cui Tiankai about the employment situation of his major in the United States and China, and shared the employment confusion he currently faces. Ambassador Cui patiently answered his questions at the scene.崔大使表示，无论是在美国就业还是回国，都尊重同学们自己的选择，都有利于促进中美两国关系的发展。

15c26c0bb8a0f6d755bc1faf0dfc2da483e2b9f4.sourceText: 崔天凯大使在亚利桑那州立大学的演讲
15c26c0bb8a0f6d755bc1faf0dfc2da483e2b9f4.translatedText: Ambassador Cui Tiankai’s speech at Arizona State University

a65ca05f6809b8a862549b4e181084a8a313eeb0.sourceText: 据在场的中国留学生介绍，此次招待会开始之前，崔天凯大使已于下午单独会见了一部分ASU的中国留学生代表。这些学生代表由ASU CSSA等学生组织推荐，在ASU进行不同阶段、不同专业的学习。记者采访到现场的一位参加下午招待会的中国留学生代表。她说自己是一名来ASU上学的交换生，在下午的活动中，她向大使提问了有关中国留学生申请硕士奖学金的相关情况。
a65ca05f6809b8a862549b4e181084a8a313eeb0.translatedText: According to the Chinese students present, before the reception began, Ambassador Cui Tiankai had met with some Chinese student representatives from ASU individually in the afternoon. These student representatives are recommended by student organizations such as ASU CSSA and study at ASU at different stages and majors. The reporter interviewed a Chinese student representative who attended the afternoon reception. She said that she was an exchange student coming to ASU to study. During the afternoon event, she asked the ambassador about the situation of Chinese international students applying for master's scholarships.

c1ef6d565ba4aa5678428e809c4d87e55cd693fa.sourceText: 据现场的一位大使馆的工作人员介绍，此次崔天凯大使来ASU的访问活动由ASU 华盛顿中心McCain Institute 负责组织。ASU CSSA 中国学生会负责接待。
c1ef6d565ba4aa5678428e809c4d87e55cd693fa.translatedText: According to an embassy staff member at the scene, Ambassador Cui Tiankai’s visit to ASU was organized by the ASU Washington Center McCain Institute. ASU CSSA Chinese Students Association is responsible for reception.

9c5a0c7a2b0fd840d40190a27bb4b5c164528a26.sourceText: 招待会结束后，崔天凯大使与在场的部分学生一一进行了合影留念。
9c5a0c7a2b0fd840d40190a27bb4b5c164528a26.translatedText: After the reception, Ambassador Cui Tiankai took photos with some of the students present one by one.
