86b201256b89ec7973187c26c95bd64a617fc10d.translatedText: The tap water in Tempe has a strange smell, but the city says there is no problem

d12e01fef7250c9452874d8b0093c29fca3a02de.sourceText: 坦佩自来水有怪味 市府说无问题 (亚省时报） 近日，有坦佩居民投诉自来水有点发霉的味道，但市政府保证，居…
d12e01fef7250c9452874d8b0093c29fca3a02de.translatedText: The tap water in Tempe has a strange smell, the city says there is no problem (Alberta Times) Recently, some Tempe residents have complained that the tap water has a moldy smell, but the city government has assured that...

dc0c76a46d28bd0b8616df111a708cc58b2c8ee0.sourceText: 近日，有坦佩居民投诉自来水有点发霉的味道，但市政府保证，居民喝的水绝对安全。 在上周，坦佩市对供水系统作了些调整，以便有效地处理”在向日葵野火中被焚烧的土地带来的大量泥浆，和最近雨水带来的沙石”。 为了处理这些水中的泥浆，坦佩供水部门暂时停止使用粉末活性炭，而这些活性炭正是减少水中异味的关键。 尽管水含异味，市政府网站一再表示”坦佩的饮用水，符合所有安全饮用水法案要求，绝对安全，请放心喝。” 市政府表示，本周风暴不会减少，风沙、泥浆混入水源的机会增多，周末前供水部门不会恢复使用活性炭。 如果居民觉得水中的异味无法接受，坦佩市政府建议大家自行使用活性炭过滤器过滤，或在水中加入柠檬片去味。 （笔者认为：还是买瓶装水喝放心。）
dc0c76a46d28bd0b8616df111a708cc58b2c8ee0.translatedText: Recently, some Tempe residents have complained that the tap water has a moldy smell, but the city government has assured that the water residents drink is absolutely safe. Last week, the city of Tempe made changes to its water system to effectively handle "the large amounts of mud from the land burned in the Sunflower Fire, as well as the sand and gravel from recent rains." To deal with the sludge in the water, the Tempe Water Department temporarily stopped using powdered activated carbon, which is key to reducing odors in the water. Although the water contains an odor, the city government website has repeatedly stated that "Tempe's drinking water meets all requirements of the Safe Drinking Water Act and is absolutely safe. Please feel free to drink it." The city government stated that the storms will not decrease this week, and the chances of sand and mud mixing into the water source will increase. The water supply department will not resume using activated carbon before the weekend. If residents find the odor in the water unacceptable, the Tempe City Government recommends that they use activated carbon filters to filter it or add lemon slices to the water to remove the odor. (The author thinks: It’s safe to buy bottled water.)

854df3677b1c9972ebe7081a1fc9d313fa7f3e09.sourceText: 您知道商业(commercial)房地产和住宅(residential)房地产有什麽不同吗? 您如果正想投资商业房地产，但却不知它和住宅房地产有什麽不同，在有进一步的行动之前，最好先把它们弄清楚，才不会为自己带来麻烦。
854df3677b1c9972ebe7081a1fc9d313fa7f3e09.translatedText: Do you know the difference between commercial real estate and residential real estate? If you are thinking about investing in commercial real estate, but you don't know the difference between it and residential real estate, it is best to clarify them before taking any further action, so as not to cause trouble for yourself.

7d225336ce327bf3ea6ab6e7f42ea46aade89903.sourceText: 基本上，此两种房地产最明显易见的不同点，当然就是有不同的用途，住宅房地产是给人住的，包含了独立屋(single family homes)、公寓(condos)、集合住宅(town homes) 等等，而商业房地产是给人工作用的，像是办公楼(office buildings)、商场(retail space)和在附近的建筑等等。
7d225336ce327bf3ea6ab6e7f42ea46aade89903.translatedText: Basically, the most obvious difference between these two types of real estate is, of course, that they have different uses. Residential real estate is for people to live in, including single family homes, apartments (condos), town homes, etc., while commercial real estate is for people to work, such as office buildings, shopping malls (retail space), nearby buildings, etc.

1651bc41179bd4a7d33dcc75f67f12c5194fb5b5.sourceText: 投资房地产的过程、手续虽然大致一样，但是投资的方法却有些不同，投资商业房地产通常要花更多的费用，虽然不是百分之百如此，但大致上投资商业房地产所必须准备的钱通常多于住宅房地产，所以拟定好投资策略是很重要的。
1651bc41179bd4a7d33dcc75f67f12c5194fb5b5.translatedText: Although the process and procedures of investing in real estate are roughly the same, the investment methods are somewhat different. Investing in commercial real estate usually costs more. Although this is not 100% true, generally speaking, the money required to invest in commercial real estate is usually more than that in residential real estate, so it is important to formulate a good investment strategy.

3cdf4d82094d4de4e6f340fee8bf1945af29be67.sourceText: 最重要的一点认知，就是不要认为我们可以轻易的把住宅房地产转换成商业房地产，或是把商业房地产改成住宅房地产，所有房地产的分类、分区，都有一定的理由、原因，虽然有可能，但是基本上要改变房地产的用途、分区是颇困难的，所以购买之前，最好先确定该房地产的用途是您想要的。
3cdf4d82094d4de4e6f340fee8bf1945af29be67.translatedText: The most important thing to understand is that we should not think that we can easily convert residential real estate into commercial real estate, or change commercial real estate into residential real estate. All real estate classifications and zonings have certain reasons. Although it is possible, it is basically difficult to change the use and zoning of real estate. Therefore, before buying, it is best to make sure that the use of the real estate is what you want.

10e380669f2b491101a2e95a1e627a26537aa499.sourceText: 总而言之，商业房地产和住宅房地产是不相同的，如果房地产是您的投资选择之一，在您有所行动之前，建议您要对相关法令规定有所研究、了解，最好能找一位诚实负责的房地产经纪人，来为您提供谘询，相信能使您的房地产交易顺畅许多。如果您有任何房地产方面的问题，非常欢迎您打电话到我的专线 (480) 612-4545 或 email至 Rich@RichLiao.com 。
10e380669f2b491101a2e95a1e627a26537aa499.translatedText: In short, commercial real estate and residential real estate are different. If real estate is one of your investment choices, before you take action, it is recommended that you research and understand the relevant laws and regulations. It is best to find an honest and responsible real estate agent to provide you with consultation. I believe it will make your real estate transaction much smoother. If you have any questions about real estate, you are very welcome to call my hotline (480) 612-4545 or email to Rich@RichLiao.com.

5c2aebd9bfe5e0b1fa4a901bb4033aaa7b9ca40d.translatedText: Dr. Chen Kewei's lecture on "Prevention of Alzheimer's Disease and Related Research Progress"

86bc158408a2860db6b3523e3249a0163db281f7.translatedText: Dr. Chen Kewei's lecture on "Prevention of Alzheimer's Disease and Related Research Progress" (Contributed by Modern Chinese School) The parent lecture activities of Modern Chinese School have continued...

1ec6acbe29a50155792cfa6c54aad2794f3ab8bc.sourceText: (现代中文学校供稿)现代中文学校的家长讲座活动已经延续了多年，学校利用家长等待孩子上课的时间举办各种各样的讲座，不但丰富了大家的业余文化生活，还给家长在工作，生活，子女教育，身体健康等方面提供了信息和经验，深受大家的欢迎。
1ec6acbe29a50155792cfa6c54aad2794f3ab8bc.translatedText: (Contributed by Modern Chinese School) The parent lecture activities of Modern Chinese School have been continued for many years. The school uses the time of parents to wait for their children to go to class to hold various lectures. It not only enriches everyone's amateur cultural life, but also provides parents with information and experience in work, life, children's education, physical health, etc., and is very popular with everyone.

2447d3df81426c2d55c0f27b6c11e8833acb697d.sourceText: 校领导何琦为大家介绍讲座内容
2447d3df81426c2d55c0f27b6c11e8833acb697d.translatedText: School leader He Qi introduced the content of the lecture

555fff4b0e10ee7355d6924e978241acc6c11e35.sourceText: 2014年3月28日学校邀请到了原本校学生家长、老师陈克伟博士做了关于老年痴呆的预防及其有关研究进展专题讲座。陈克伟是Banner Alzheimer抯 Institute的资深科学家，在相关领域利用神经影像学技术有多年的研究经历、并与本州及其中国国内几所大学有长期的合作。
555fff4b0e10ee7355d6924e978241acc6c11e35.translatedText: On March 28, 2014, the school invited Dr. Chen Kewei, a parent and teacher of former school students, to give a special lecture on the prevention of Alzheimer's disease and related research progress. Chen Kewei is a senior scientist at the Banner Alzheimer's Institute. He has many years of research experience using neuroimaging technology in related fields and has long-term cooperation with several universities in this state and China.

8447023d8eb543b276ea8c655c18527971a4e33b.sourceText: 陈克伟博士正在给大家讲解老年痴呆症的病原对比
8447023d8eb543b276ea8c655c18527971a4e33b.translatedText: Dr. Chen Kewei is explaining to everyone the comparison of pathogens of Alzheimer's disease

9da9cf740f01c2e922adc4a61b4c1fd59d6d05d6.sourceText: 陈克伟博士首先介绍了与老年痴呆病有关的几种风险基因与致病基因。同年龄一样，遗传等因素是我们所不能控制的，我们其实可以积极主动地通过做许多事情来降低老年痴呆的发病风险的。比如，在我们平时的生活中对大脑的保护，包括合理的饮食，健康规律的生活方式，积极锻炼身体，适当的有氧运动和在医生指导下的对血压，血脂，血糖等的控制，适当的服用维生素等等。这些当然有益于我们的身体健康同时还对大脑有保护作用。
9da9cf740f01c2e922adc4a61b4c1fd59d6d05d6.translatedText: Dr. Chen Kewei first introduced several risk genes and pathogenic genes related to Alzheimer's disease. Like age, genetics and other factors are beyond our control. We can actually proactively do many things to reduce the risk of Alzheimer's disease. For example, the protection of the brain in our daily life includes a reasonable diet, a healthy and regular lifestyle, active physical exercise, appropriate aerobic exercise, control of blood pressure, blood lipids, blood sugar, etc. under the guidance of a doctor, proper taking of vitamins, etc. These are certainly good for our physical health and also have a protective effect on the brain.

ee439533ea3c211979771b77991cdb6bd9bb9515.sourceText: 孤独封闭的生活对大脑健康绝无好处，开朗乐观，思想活跃，兴趣广泛，关注外界事物，善于与人交往的性格对身心和大脑的健康是非常有益的。大家建立自己的朋友圈，积极参加社交活动，快乐自己，幸福全家。
ee439533ea3c211979771b77991cdb6bd9bb9515.translatedText: A lonely and closed life is not good for brain health. Being cheerful and optimistic, active in thinking, with a wide range of interests, paying attention to external things, and being good at interacting with others is very beneficial to the health of the body, mind, and brain. Everyone builds their own circle of friends and actively participates in social activities to make themselves happy and the whole family happy.

60b5a375658f1b7ee38a725e177e886ef9faadab.sourceText: 另外，有关的研究结果表明，学习新的、具有一定挑战性的知识或技能，使自己的大脑不断受到正面的刺激也是一种保持大脑神经健康有效方法，总之积极向上的人生态度，健康快乐的生活方式一定是我们每一位成功老龄化的人追求的目标。
60b5a375658f1b7ee38a725e177e886ef9faadab.translatedText: In addition, relevant research results show that learning new and challenging knowledge or skills so that your brain is constantly stimulated by positive stimulation is also an effective way to keep your brain nerves healthy. In short, a positive attitude towards life and a healthy and happy lifestyle must be the goal pursued by every successful aging person.

7b4e4ba7db7a5d8cee08ed5a1ed6572c395a66df.sourceText: 除了自身积极有效的保持恼健康的因素之外，陈克伟博士在讲座中介绍了由Banner Alzheimer’s Institute 等众多研究单位、药物开发厂家和联邦政府通力合作、支持进行的老年痴呆预防启动计划（Alzheimer’s Prevention Initiative），他邀请各位学生家长们、朋友们以志愿者的身份参与该计划。为此，他提供了为该研究计划建立起来的志愿者注册网站 www.endALZnow.org 参与该研究是我们大家共同努力为早期攻克给病人本人病痛、给病人的家庭及整个社会精神和经济负担并且严重影响生活质量的疾病作出每位自己的贡献。于此同时，该启动计划还会不定期的给每位参与者提供最新的有关的研究成果、包括如何改变生活方式以降低发病的风险。所以是于社会、个人都有益的一件事。
7b4e4ba7db7a5d8cee08ed5a1ed6572c395a66df.translatedText: In addition to his own active and effective factors in maintaining health, Dr. Chen Kewei introduced in the lecture the Alzheimer’s Prevention Initiative (Alzheimer’s Prevention Initiative), which is supported by the cooperation and support of many research units such as the Banner Alzheimer’s Institute, drug development manufacturers, and the federal government. He invited parents and friends of students to participate in the program as volunteers. To this end, he provided the volunteer registration website www.endALZnow.org established for the research plan. Participating in this research is a joint effort by all of us to make our own contribution to the early overcoming of diseases that cause pain to the patient, impose mental and economic burdens on the patient's family and the entire society, and seriously affect the quality of life. At the same time, the startup plan will also provide each participant with the latest relevant research results from time to time, including how to change lifestyles to reduce the risk of disease. So it is something that is beneficial to society and individuals.

9fdfb18c94e295fc0750062ee9d282299f697b03.sourceText: 最后，陈博士演示了用神经影像技术观测到的与老年痴呆有关的脑异常变化。 一张张大脑图像展示在听众面前，陈博士从专业的角度讲解了正常和病变的脑图像区别，使听众从科学角度认识和了解老年痴呆的医学诊断。
9fdfb18c94e295fc0750062ee9d282299f697b03.translatedText: Finally, Dr. Chen demonstrated the abnormal brain changes related to Alzheimer's disease observed using neuroimaging technology. Brain images were displayed in front of the audience one by one. Dr. Chen explained the difference between normal and diseased brain images from a professional perspective, allowing the audience to understand and understand the medical diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease from a scientific perspective.

a9861f6034e8c1307403cb05e383fd6af928e2ef.translatedText: The classroom is packed with seats

fff0c9e3086618e91eca0a1fea89e9b6d1dfa1c2.sourceText: 讲座在被挤得满满的会场里结束了，许多家长围着陈克伟进行了进一步的讨论。大家所关心的问题很多，讨论非常热烈，有关注自己应该怎样尽早预防的，有帮助父母咨询的，也有给匆匆赶来没能听到讲座的朋友传达的。是啊，健康是人们关心的头等大事，网络时代有关谈健康的信息相信每个人每天都会收到不止一条两条，可见健康对生命，生活，家庭，社会多么重要。感谢陈克伟博士的演讲和给大家带来的医学保健常识，能使大家预防老年痴呆的意识从年青时开始。但愿我们每个人都能健健康康，无病无灾的，快快乐乐的长命百岁。
fff0c9e3086618e91eca0a1fea89e9b6d1dfa1c2.translatedText: The lecture ended in a packed venue, with many parents surrounding Chen Kewei for further discussions. There were many issues that everyone was concerned about, and the discussions were very lively. Some were concerned about how to prevent it as early as possible, some were concerned about helping parents consult, and some were conveyed to friends who came in a hurry and could not hear the lecture. Yes, health is the top priority for people. In the Internet age, I believe everyone receives more than one or two messages about health every day. This shows how important health is to life, life, family, and society. Thanks to Dr. Chen Kewei for his speech and the medical and health care knowledge he brought to everyone, we can make everyone aware of preventing Alzheimer's disease from a young age. I hope that each of us can be healthy, free from disease and disaster, and live a long and happy life.

50afa8ca40661060ae3a0713ac8ba61cef0520a0.sourceText: 大凤凰城台美商会于二月十一日晚上六点，假凤城海鲜酒家举行2017年新春晚宴，大凤凰城主流政商名流及台侨，一起迎接金鷄年，欢渡元宵佳节。 晚宴由祥狮献瑞热闹开场，会长张圣仪代表全体理监事向与会嘉宾致词，并简介商会歴史､历届商会致力促进台美国民外交活动剪影，让与会嘉宾更明瞭商会为谋合台美商机不遗馀力并感谢所有赞助商，义工团队，最后并敬祝大家鸡年行大运，好运旺旺来。 亚利桑那州卅长Dough Doucey，指示卅长多元平等办公室执行长Barry Wong 代表颁发Proclamation 明定为农曆春节日贺状给大鳯凰城台美商会，由创会会长萧时英，前会长张晴玲及会长张圣仪共同接下贺状。凤凰城市长Greg Stanton在致词时，还特别分享去年参访台湾时，和台湾总统蔡英文及台北市市长柯文哲的自拍照，并表示对去年的参访之行，留下美丽及深刻的回忆。 此次出席的主流政要，尚有马利柯帕郡检察长Bill Montgomery ､新当选亚利桑纳卅共和党党主席Jonathan Lines､钱德乐市副市长Kevin Hartke､钱德乐市姊姊市主席Jack Sellers､市府副执行长Nachie Marquez､市议员Rene Lopez､Mark Stewart､凤凰城经贸厅执行长Hank Marshall､凤凰城姊妹市主席兼执行长Paula West､凤凰城姊妹市理事主席Judy Schumacher､钱德乐市多元裔经理Leah Powell､钱德乐Tullamore姊妹市主席 Ellen Harrington及理事､资深大律师Brian Foster､Snell & Wilmer､L.L.P, Fox 10 News资深电视新闻主播Troy Hayden､知名职业橄榄球星Kerri Reed､北美洲台商总会理事黄玉莲､商会先进范元能､郑淑惠､唐碧霞，张志平，大凤凰城台美商会理事徐爱妮､Juan Carrillo､叶琍琍､王栋齐､李裕泉､王丽玉､蔡雪梨､邓锦欢､窦蕙芝､王栋贤伉俪､黄一帆､简媁婷､杜淑儝､黄鍚珩､李佩伦､特别委员王丽诏､陈祈君､严招弟､Rob Truman，王文修牙医师，侨务顾问郑弘等，亜省台湾同乡会会长林国祥､凤凰城中文学校董事长陈立雯､亜省台美人妇女会创会会长郭慈玉､FAPA 会长黄丽𠎠､亚省亚裔医师协会主席徐凯莱，北美台湾工程师协会硅谷分会2016会长徐名璋，前美国在台协会官员于震､亚省亚裔律师协会，钱德乐商会､韩侨商会､越侨商会､亚裔商会､亜省华商会长伍兆文､亜省妇女地产协会全卅总会长张圣仪､亜省科工会长李江､柴林会计师事务所､亜省艺术学院､亜省共和党亜裔联盟主席Farhana Ahmed等政商名流及商会会员眷属近三百馀人出席晚宴，盛况空前。
50afa8ca40661060ae3a0713ac8ba61cef0520a0.translatedText: The Taiwanese American Chamber of Commerce in Greater Phoenix City held its 2017 New Year Dinner at Fengcheng Seafood Restaurant at 6pm on February 11th. Mainstream political and business celebrities and overseas Chinese in Greater Phoenix City welcomed the Year of the Golden Rooster and celebrated the Lantern Festival. The dinner started with a lively ceremony of Lion Presentation. President Zhang Shengyi addressed the guests on behalf of all the directors and supervisors, and introduced the history of the Chamber of Commerce and the profile of previous chambers of commerce's efforts to promote Taiwan-U.S. civil diplomacy activities, so that the guests could understand that the Chamber of Commerce spared no effort to explore business opportunities in Taiwan and the United States and thanked all sponsors and volunteer teams. Finally, he wished everyone good luck and good luck in the Year of the Rooster. Arizona Governor Dough Doucey instructed Barry Wong, CEO of the Governor's Office of Diversity and Equality, to issue a Proclamation certificate, designated as the Lunar New Year's Day, to the Taipei American Chamber of Commerce in Daluo City. The founding president Xiao Shiying, former president Zhang Qingling and president Zhang Shengyi jointly accepted the congratulatory certificate. In his speech, Phoenix Mayor Greg Stanton also shared a selfie he took with Taiwan President Tsai Ing-wen and Taipei Mayor Ko Wenzhe during his visit to Taiwan last year, and said that he left beautiful and profound memories of last year's visit. Mainstream dignitaries present this time include Maricopa County Attorney Bill Montgomery, newly elected Arizona Republican Party Chairman Jonathan Lines, Chandler City Vice Mayor Kevin Hartke, 4d93a645a64cd62a6aad992049fdb9156797d0b1.sourceText: 北京铁营医院到亚利桑那州立大学参加行为健康交流项目 （亚省时报 末末报道）12月05日下午五时，凤凰城知名华裔医生杨桐的沙漠脊柱医疗研究所，迎来了多位来自中国北京铁营医院的医生。他们是由神经内科主任医师孙培云院长带队，参加亚利桑那州立大学行为健康项目的访问团。ASU行为健康项目主任罗纳德博士（Ronald R.O’Donnell）把访问团带到了临床第一线，让他们感受美国医疗体制的基本制度。玛丽库帕医生学会华人医生徐凯莱，大法医胡约翰（John X.Hu）到现场欢迎远道而来的中国医生。 访问团与当地华人医生合影留念 杨桐医生首先带访问团参观了他的医疗研究所。这里有手术室，诊疗室以及病房像个小医院。杨桐医生首创的”杨氏椎间孔镜下椎间盘髓核摘除术”业界闻名，他的研究所就是一个针对性非常强，研究与实践相结合的机构。 杨桐医生（右）带孙佩云（中）院长参观他的手术室 针对奥巴马的医疗改革法案，孙培云院长向杨桐医生咨询了一线医务人员的看法。杨桐医生表示他反对奥巴马的改革，很多东西，医生做出了努力，是需要报酬的，不是都可以免费。就如加拿大其他国家，有很多免费的医疗服务，但是他们的市民并没有得到应有的治疗。他们必须等好多个月，才有机会进行治疗。这对患者和医生都没有好处，欧巴马的医疗改革也许会让美国的医疗体制变得更糟糕。 杨桐医生同时向孙院长了解中国分级医院的情况。孙院长说目前在中国民营医院还不多，但是在十八大召开后，总理李克强表示在未来十年，会为海外的高端的医疗人员提供更多的投资机会。孙院长欢迎杨桐医生回国投资，为中国的居民提供高品质医疗服务。 当地医生与访问团进行了亲切的交流，当晚6点半才依依惜别，并希望在未来，在北京或者凤凰城有更多的交流和合作的机会。
4d93a645a64cd62a6aad992049fdb9156797d0b1.translatedText: Beijing Tieying Hospital went to Arizona State University to participate in a behavioral health exchange program (Alberta Times) Mo Mo Report) At 5 pm on December 5, the Desert Spine Medical Research Institute of the well-known Chinese doctor Yang Tong in Phoenix welcomed many doctors from Tieying Hospital in Beijing, China. They were led by Dean Sun Peiyun, chief physician of the Department of Neurology, and participated in a visiting delegation from the behavioral health program of Arizona State University. Dr. Ronald R. O’Donnell, director of the ASU Behavioral Health Program, took the visiting group to the clinical frontline to let them experience the basic system of the American medical system. Xu Kailai, a Chinese doctor from the Mary Cooper Medical Association, and John X. Hu, a medical examiner, came to the scene to welcome the Chinese doctors who came from afar. The visiting group took photos with local Chinese doctors. Dr. Yang Tong first took the visiting group to visit his medical research institute. There are operating rooms, consultation rooms and wards like a small hospital. Dr. Yang Tong is famous in the industry for his pioneering "Young's transforaminal endoscopic disc nucleectomy". His institute is a very targeted institution that combines research and practice. Dr. Yang Tong (right) takes President Sun Peiyun (middle) to visit his operating room. Regarding Obama's health care reform bill, President Sun Peiyun consulted Dr. Yang Tong for the views of frontline medical staff. Dr. Yang Tong expressed his opposition to Obama's reforms. Doctors need to be paid for many things they have made efforts, and not everything can be free. Just like other countries in Canada, there are many free medical services, but their citizens do not receive the treatment they deserve. They have to wait many months for a chance to receive treatment. This is not good for patients or doctors, and Obama's health care reform may make the U.S. medical system worse. Dr. Yang Tong also learned from President Sun about the situation of graded hospitals in China. President Sun said that there are currently not many private hospitals in China, but after the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, Prime Minister Li Keqiang stated that in the next ten years, more investment opportunities will be provided for overseas high-end medical personnel. President Sun welcomed Dr. Yang Tong to return to China to invest and provide high-quality medical services to Chinese residents. The local doctors had a cordial exchange with the delegation and said goodbye at 6:30 that night. They hoped to have more exchange and cooperation opportunities in Beijing or Phoenix in the future.

98e6332f1e89401c3f0e373b6c71a505a12ac70b.sourceText: 幸福感强的州自杀率高 华盛顿 4 月 25 日 公布的美国学者比较幸福感与自杀率的研究意外发现：在美国被认为幸福感较强的州，自杀率也比较高。 这个报告运用了美国联邦政府对行为风险因素的监控调查和自杀率等数据，对美国 50 个州和华盛顿特区进行比较研究。 研究发现，”最幸福的”犹他州自杀率名列第 9 ，”最不幸福的”肯塔基州自杀率仅排第 16 。排列幸福感前 10 名的州依次是：犹他、刘易斯安娜、科罗拉多、明尼苏达、怀俄明、夏威夷、亚利桑那、特拉华、佛罗里达、内华达。 这 10 个州中有 6 个排名自杀率前 15 名：内华达第 3 、怀俄明第 5 、科罗拉多第 6 、犹他第 9 、亚利桑那第 11 、佛罗里达第 15 。 排列幸福感最后 10 名的州依次为：肯塔基、西弗吉尼亚、宾夕法尼亚、印第安纳、密苏里、俄亥俄、纽约、马萨诸塞、密歇根、罗得岛。 这 10 个州中，排名自杀率前 10 名的只有西弗吉尼亚，列第 8 ；纽约州民众幸福感排第 45 位，而自杀率更排在第 50 位。 心理学家分析这种现象指出，如果一个人周遭的人对生活都比较满意，而自己对生活不满意，则受挫感会更强。如果生活在一个大家认为比较好的地方，而你对生活不满意，就更容易感觉到没有别的地方会让自己高兴，更会感到绝望。 另有研究发现，国际上也有类似现象存在，比如北欧国家社会福利好，人们的幸福感强，但自杀率也比较高。不过研究者坦言，不同国家文化背景不同，数据收集系统不一样，国家与国家之间没有可比性。
98e6332f1e89401c3f0e373b6c71a505a12ac70b.translatedText: > States with a strong sense of happiness have high suicide rates. Washington, April 25 A published study by American scholars comparing happiness and suicide rates unexpectedly found that states in the United States that are considered to have stronger happiness have higher suicide rates. This report uses data from the U.S. federal government's Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance Survey and suicide rates to conduct a comparative study of the 50 U.S. states and Washington, DC. The study found that Utah, the "happiest" state, ranked ninth in suicide rate, while Kentucky, the "unhappiest" state, ranked only 16th in suicide rate. The top 10 happiest states are: Utah, Louisiana, Colorado, Minnesota, Wyoming, Hawaii, Arizona, Delaware, Florida, and Nevada. Six of those 10 states ranked in the top 15 for suicide rates: Nevada 3rd, Wyoming 5th, Colorado 6th, Utah 9th, Arizona 11th, and Florida 15th. The 10 happiest states are: Kentucky, West Virginia, Pennsylvania, Indiana, Missouri, Ohio, New York, Massachusetts, Michigan, and Rhode Island. Among these 10 states, only West Virginia ranks in the top 10 for suicide rate, ranking 8th; New York State ranks 45th for people's happiness, and 50th for suicide rate. Psychologists analyze this phenomenon and point out that if the people around a person are relatively satisfied with life, but they are dissatisfied with life, the frustration will be stronger. If you live in a place that everyone thinks is better and you are not satisfied with your life, it is easier to feel that there is no other place that will make you happy, and you will feel more desperate. Other studies have found that similar phenomena exist internationally. For example, Nordic countries have good social welfare and people have a strong sense of happiness, but their suicide rates are also relatively high. However, researchers admit that different countries have different cultural backgrounds and different data collection systems, so there is no comparability between countries.

357e65b7d4a686fa46462dd68e10e4dcfb619f9b.sourceText: 彩墨丹青在美莎（组图） (林萱工作室供稿)7月13号，美国国庆节的第2个周末，林萱工作室的学生们在MESA DOWNTOWN,的画廊展出了学生 的画，同时表演了中国画的画画过程，他们是Karchyi Chang, Julia Zhang,James Zhang, Zi qing Kuang，Olivia Zhao, Amanda Gong。他们的画，集中体味中国画的意境、格调、气韵和色调，把中国人情思中 最为厚重的沉淀，画成水墨花鸟，展示给世人。 中国画不象西画，先找好了题材，再找模特儿照着画，总有一个对象的束缚，天地的限制，虽然也有形神 兼备，但''意''就不够了。中国画是画家在生活体验中体味万物的形象，''深入生命节奏的核心''，以自由谐 和的形式，表达出画家最深的意趣。 中国画水墨画传始于唐代，成于五代，盛于宋元。以笔法为主导，充分发挥墨法的功能，中国画法不全是 具体物象的刻画，而倾向抽象的笔墨表达人格心情与意境。中国画有一种建筑的行线美，音乐的节奏美，舞蹈 的姿态美。其要素不在机械地写实，如花鸟画写生的精妙，为世界第一。中国画的美不光是我们中国华人喜爱，它 也深深地感动了当地的美国人，再没有一个画能种象中国画那样，给国人以更多的情感。那是中华民族的底蕴 、中国人古典的底气和性情。 我们十分感谢凤凰城华人侨团联合总会组办这次活动，不光是让中国画能够在各国人前展示她的独特的美， 更多的是让学生们能从学习中国画和现场表演画中国画的实践中，认识自己民族文化的魅力，对自己的能力和 华人的背景充满自信和骄傲。 林萱老师的学生画作欣赏 Julia Zhang Olivia Zhao Karchyi Chang Zi qing Kuang Karchyi Chang, Julia Zhang,James Zhang, Zi qing Kuang, Olivia Zhao, Amanda Gong with Mr. Zengqi cui David
357e65b7d4a686fa46462dd68e10e4dcfb619f9b.translatedText: Colorful Ink Paintings in Mesa (Photos) (Contributed by Lin Xuan Studio) On July 13, the second weekend of the Fourth of July, students from Lin Xuan Studio exhibited their paintings in the gallery of MESA DOWNTOWN, and also performed the painting process of Chinese painting. They are Karchyi Chang, Julia Zhang, James Zhang, Zi Qing Kuang, Olivia Zhao, and Amanda Gong. Their paintings focus on appreciating the artistic conception, style, charm and tones of Chinese paintings, and display the most profound accumulation of Chinese people's emotions into ink paintings of flowers and birds for the world to see. Chinese painting is different from Western painting. You must first find the subject matter and then find a model to follow the painting. There is always a constraint of the object and the limitations of heaven and earth. Although it has both form and spirit, "meaning" is not enough. Chinese painting is an image of the painter appreciating all things in his life experience. It "goes deep into the core of the rhythm of life" and expresses the painter's deepest interest in a free and harmonious form. Chinese ink painting began in the Tang Dynasty, matured in the Five Dynasties, and flourished in the Song and Yuan Dynasties. Taking the brushwork as the main focus and giving full play to the function of the ink method, Chinese painting is not all about the depiction of specific objects, but tends to use abstract brushwork to express personality, mood and artistic conception. Chinese painting has the beauty of lines in architecture, the rhythm of music, and the posture of dance. Its elements are not mechanical realism, such as the exquisiteness of flower and bird painting, which ranks first in the world. The beauty of Chinese painting is not only loved by us Chinese, but also deeply moved the local Americans. No other painting can bring more emotions to the Chinese people like Chinese painting. That is the heritage of the Chinese nation and the classical confidence and temperament of the Chinese people. We are very grateful to the Phoenix Federation of Overseas Chinese Associations for organizing this event, which not only allows Chinese painting to showcase its unique beauty in front of people from all over the world, but also allows students to understand the charm of their own national culture through the practice of learning Chinese painting and performing Chinese painting live, and become confident and proud of their own abilities and Chinese background. 402f2a0d6396f36eb1a518644bc0b2d97f69def1.sourceText: 从中文学校所想到的．．．． 杨济群 长时间以来，中文学校的小朋友们发表了为数不少的短文，我几乎每一篇都仔细的读，小朋友们的作文，描述了他（她）们的见闻，他（她）们的欢乐和他（她）们的理想，充满童趣，稚气和天真，每一篇习作都注明辅导老师的姓氏，我一个年逾古稀的老奶奶，感到中文学校的老师们做了一件非常了不起的事，孩子们的家长也同样做了一件了不起的事。 我们的祖国有着五千年的悠久历史，我们民族的文化博大精深，无论我们生活在什么国度，居住在世界任何地方，我们都有将伟大的中国文化传承下去的责任和义务，鳯凰城中文学校的老师们，还有那些可爱的家长们正是在做这样一件有意义的工作，他（她）们在培养孩子学习英语的同时再学习中国文化，他（她）的辛劳值得赞扬。 中华民族是一个有着灿烂文化的民族，一部二十四史记述了多少英雄事迹，又记下了多少宫闱惨变，祸起萧墙，夺嫡之争。从周朝的?#35799;经?#24320;始，诗、词、歌、赋，有如汪洋大海，浩瀚无边，唐诗、宋诗更是烟波浩淼，让我们这些后人一生也享用不完，宋时的伟大诗人苏东坡，他脍炙人口的”水调歌头”．．．．”人有悲悲欢离合，月有阴晴圆缺，此事古难全”成了千古绝唱，大自然中”古难全”，人类社会以及每个人的人生也会是”古难全”。东坡居士写出了人生，万物的真谛。唐代的李白、杜甫更是家喻户晓，李、杜的诗是言志，是诗人显意识的情意和表达，李白至今留下的一千余首诗歌和杜甫的诗作以及从古到今多少文人墨客诗人才子给我们留下的无以数计的精美绝伦的诗词和好文章，形式多样，内容丰富，精致，微妙，婉转流畅，深邃悠长，读后令人回味无穷，引起我们对祖国民族文化、品德、学问、文学艺术的联想和启迪。再说中国的四大名著，更是一幅中国社会的民俗画卷，单说一部”红楼梦”就浓缩中国封建社会的兴衰，．．．所有这些都是祖国文化宝库中的瑰宝，我们从文化的视角来欣赏，品味前人留下的这些珍贵文化遗产，作为炎黄子孙应该引以为荣，作为一个蕴藏丰富文化气息的民族的后代，我们将为之骄傲。再从历史的角度看，秦皇汉武，唐宗宋祖，明清民国至今，我们的祖国在漫长的历史长河中，出现了多少值得讴歌的民族英雄，又经历了多少腥风血雨，这些都应该让小朋友们至少有一个粗略的了解，因为我们是炎黄子孙。我不是在提倡复古，现代科技日新月异，小朋友们应该掌握，也必须掌握，但，我认为，不管他（她）们将来是从医，或是学工程技术，学经济管理，学国际贸易，或学地质勘探等等，都不应该忘了老祖宗的灿烂文化，那是一颗璀璨的明珠。我非常赞赏那些让孩子们回到家就说中国话的家长，让小朋友们从小就接受一些中华民族的传统教育，对中国的优良传统有所感受和领悟，这是一件值得大家去努力成的有意义的事情，感谢中文学校的组织者和老师们，他（她）们正是在做着给予我们的后代有益的事，希望通过他（她）们的努力，如果能在众多小朋友中培养出如李白、杜甫、李时珍、鲁迅、杨振宁等这样的伟大人才，那将是中国人之大幸。 以上所谈，纯属个人看法，不妥之处，敬请指正。
402f2a0d6396f36eb1a518644bc0b2d97f69def1.translatedText: What I thought of from the Chinese school. ． ． ． Yang Jiqun For a long time, children in Chinese schools have published many short essays. I have read almost every one of them carefully. The children's essays describe their experiences, their joys and their ideals, and are full of meaning. Childlike, childish and innocent, each exercise is marked with the tutor's surname. As an old woman who is over seventy years old, I feel that the teachers at the Chinese school have done a great thing, and the parents of the children have also done a great thing. Our motherland has a long history of five thousand years, and our national culture is extensive and profound. No matter what country we live in, or where we live in the world, we have the responsibility and obligation to pass on the great Chinese culture. The teachers of Huanghuangcheng Chinese School and those lovely parents are doing such a meaningful work. They are training their children to learn English while learning Chinese culture. His or her hard work is worthy of praise. The Chinese nation is a nation with a splendid culture. The Twenty-Four Histories record many heroic deeds, as well as many tragic changes in palaces, disasters, and battles for the right to inherit the throne. Since the Zhou Dynasty, poems, lyrics, songs, and rhymes have been as vast as the ocean, and the Tang poetry and Song poetry are even more vast, allowing us descendants to enjoy endlessly in our lifetimes. Su Dongpo, the great poet of the Song Dynasty, was famous for his "water melody song head". ． ． ． "People have joys and sorrows, separation and reunion, the moon waxes and wanes, and this has never been the same in ancient times." It has become an eternal song. "It is hard to be perfect in the past" in nature, and human society and everyone's life will also be "unlike in the past." Dongpo layman wrote the true meaning of life and all things. Li Bai and Du Fu in the Tang Dynasty are even more well-known to every household. The poems of Li Bai and Du Fu are the expression of ambition, the emotions and expressions of the poet's conscious mind. Li Bai has left more than a thousand poems and Du Fu's poems so far, as well as the countless literati, poets and talents from ancient times to the present have left us countless poems. There are countless exquisite poems and good articles in various forms, rich in content, exquisite, subtle, mellow and smooth, profound and long. It is endlessly memorable after reading, and it arouses our association and enlightenment about the national culture, moral character, knowledge, literature and art of our motherland. Let’s talk about China’s Four Great Classics, which are also a folklore picture of Chinese society. Just one “Dream of Red Mansions” condenses the rise and fall of China’s feudal society. ． ． All of these are treasures in the cultural treasure house of the motherland. We appreciate them from a cultural perspective and taste these precious cultural heritages left by our predecessors. As descendants of the Yan and Huang Dynasties, we should be proud of them. As descendants of a nation rich in cultural flavor, we will be proud of them. From a historical perspective, from the Qin Emperor to the Han Dynasty, to the Emperors of the Tang Dynasty and the Song Dynasty, from the Ming to the Qing Dynasty and the Republic of China to the present day, our motherland has had many national heroes worth praising and experienced many bloody storms in its long history. Children should have at least a rough understanding of these, because we are the descendants of the Yan and Huang Dynasties. I am not advocating retrospection. Modern technology is changing with each passing day. Children should and must master it. However, I think that whether they will go into medicine, study engineering technology, study economic management, study international trade, or study geological exploration, etc., they should not forget the splendid culture of their ancestors, which is a bright pearl. I very much appreciate those parents who let their children speak Chinese when they return home, so that the children can receive some traditional Chinese education from an early age and have a feel and understanding of China's fine traditions. This is a meaningful thing worthy of everyone's efforts. Thank you to the organization of the Chinese school I hope that through their efforts, great talents such as Li Bai, Du Fu, Li Shizhen, Lu Xun, Yang Zhenning, etc. can be cultivated among many children, it will be a great blessing for the Chinese people. What I said above is purely my personal opinion. Please correct me if it is inappropriate.

26303407ef0de834ba8b1fe66531c784354ab304.sourceText: 亚利桑那州长希望日间劳动法规生效 亚利桑那州州长珍布鲁尔的律师要求上诉法院撤销裁决，使SB1070法律中鲜为人知的一部分生效。SB1070除了赋予亚利桑那州警察权力，在执行公务时可对任何怀疑是非法移民的人士提出检查身份证明的要求外，法律还禁止在交通阻塞时段，禁止任何人在街道或高速路旁举牌寻求工作。日间劳动法规随SB1070在2010年7月生效，但因警察执法权部分引起拉美裔强烈抗议，导致美国地方法院苏珊波顿法官将其搁置。州长希望上述法院在审核SB1070的同时，将日间劳动法规单独区分开来，使之早日生效。
26303407ef0de834ba8b1fe66531c784354ab304.translatedText: Arizona Governor Wants Day Labor Rule to Go into Effect Lawyers for Arizona Governor Jen Brewer are asking an appeals court to reverse the ruling, allowing a little-known part of the SB1070 law to go into effect. In addition to giving Arizona police the power to ask for identification of anyone suspected of being an illegal immigrant while on duty, SB 1070 also prohibits anyone from holding a sign on the street or highway looking for work during traffic jams. The day labor regulation went into effect in July 2010 with SB 1070, but it was put on hold by U.S. District Court Judge Susan Bolton due to outcry among Latinos over the police enforcement portion. The governor hopes that the above-mentioned courts will separate day labor regulations while reviewing SB1070 so that they can take effect as soon as possible.

bd89e5460cf99d7492bc463cda0069139a63c876.sourceText: 移民美国要善打缴税算盘 中美老百姓的纳税习惯差异较大，新移民们很容易水土不服，甚至为美国税法大伤脑筋。实际上，尽管美国税法体制严格，却非常人性化，不仅考量纳税人的意愿与实际情况，还具有体制透明、无重复税、承认海外报税等优势，让新移民们越来越安心。 在信奉法律、严格遵法的美国，自行纳税观念早已深入美国老百姓心中。在众多税种中，个税与人们的日常生活关系最为密切，因而成为纳税焦点。美国个税按家庭、按年度计算征收，具体缴纳的税款额度由纳税人自己核定，颇有几分”自行纳税我做主”的意味。 既然纳税是生活中必不可少的组成部分，美国纳税人便顺势将自行纳税制度又提高了一个层次：不是怎样安排税费缴纳，而是如何更有条理、更加专业地进行”家庭纳税管理”。聘请一位顾问进行专业咨询学习，进而有序地收纳、保存家庭交税票据及有可能抵税的票据，俨然成为美国家庭的必修课。而到了交税季，美国各团体也竞相举办各种省税讲座，教人们合理避税的方法。 透明人性化的美国税法使纳税人们不惧纳税。正如投资移民专家、锦国怡凯执行董事宁立说，尽管美国施行自主纳税制度，但刚刚走上美国的新移民只要多适应，增强家庭财税规划的意识，就能顺利过渡。或者选择专业的移民中介公司，获得专业的落地安家服务，也是便利的方法。 美国税法为特定阶层的纳税人设立了税收抵免优惠等减税免税内容。政府规定这些税收抵免优惠的目的，主要是追求税收的公平，比如勤劳所得收入的税费抵免，就是为了减轻低收入者的负担。通常，”勤劳所得抵免”是返还性的，即使纳税人没有达到纳税标准，也可以拿到一笔相当于该项抵免额的退税。 纳税人除本人享受的减免外，还可为每个符合条件的被抚养者（例如照顾孩子）扣除减免。其次，凡与个人工作有关的费用支出，如雇主未予补偿的差旅费、投资咨询费、工会会费、与受雇有关的教育费、制服费、专业期刊订阅费、税务顾问及律师、会计费、搬家费，甚至雇请牧师的费用、赌博费（以赌博收入为限）等，都包括在可以扣除的项目之内。 此外，最牵动国人对比神经的还是住房贷款利息税费扣除，如让人纳税人支付的住房贷款利息、投资利息支出在一定范围内获得税费扣除，而且，美国个税在征收时还考虑到通货膨胀的因素，当经济发生波动时，美国政府首先考虑的不是如何保住自己的财政收入，而是稳定纳税人的税负水平，保护纳税人的利益。
bd89e5460cf99d7492bc463cda0069139a63c876.translatedText: When immigrating to the United States, you must plan your tax payment well. The tax habits of Chinese and American people are quite different. It is easy for new immigrants to become acclimated and even worry about the U.S. tax laws. In fact, although the U.S. tax law system is strict, it is very user-friendly. It not only takes into account the wishes and actual situation of taxpayers, but also has the advantages of transparent system, no duplication of taxes, and recognition of overseas tax returns, making new immigrants more and more at ease. In the United States, which believes in and strictly abides by the law, the concept of self-payment of taxes has long been deeply rooted in the hearts of the American people. Among the many types of taxes, personal tax has the closest relationship with people’s daily lives and has therefore become the focus of taxation. Personal tax in the United States is levied on a per-family basis and on an annual basis. The specific amount of tax paid is determined by the taxpayers themselves, which is quite a bit like "I make the decision when I pay my own taxes." Since paying taxes is an indispensable part of life, American taxpayers have taken advantage of the situation and raised the self-tax payment system to another level: not how to arrange tax payment, but how to conduct "family tax management" in a more organized and professional manner. It has become a required course for American families to hire a consultant for professional consulting and learning, and then to collect and save family tax receipts and possible tax deductible receipts in an orderly manner. When tax season comes, various groups in the United States are also competing to hold various tax saving lectures to teach people how to reasonably avoid taxes. The transparent and user-friendly U.S. tax law makes taxpayers not afraid of paying taxes. As Ning Li, an investment immigration expert and executive director of Jinguo Yikai, said, although the United States implements an independent tax system, new immigrants who have just entered the United States can make a smooth transition as long as they adapt more and enhance their awareness of family financial and tax planning. Or choose a professional immigration agency to get professional settlement services, which is also a convenient way. The U.S. tax law has established tax deductions and exemptions such as tax credits for certain classes of taxpayers. The purpose of the government's provision of these tax credit preferences is mainly to pursue tax fairness. For example, the tax credit for hard-earned income is to reduce the burden of low-income people. Usually, the "hard-earned income credit" is refundable. Even if the taxpayer does not meet the tax standard, he or she can get a tax refund equal to the amount of the credit. Taxpayers may deduct deductions for each qualifying dependent (such as child care) in addition to the deductions they receive personally. Secondly, all expenses related to personal work, such as travel expenses not compensated by the employer, investment consulting fees, union dues, employment-related education fees, uniform fees, professional journal subscriptions, tax consultants and lawyers, accounting fees, moving expenses, even the cost of hiring a pastor, gambling fees (limited to gambling income), etc., are included in the deductible items. In addition, what most worries the Chinese people is the tax deduction for housing loan interest. For example, the housing loan interest and investment interest paid by taxpayers can be deducted within a certain range. Moreover, the U.S. personal tax also takes into account the factor of inflation when the economy fluctuates. When the economy fluctuates, the U.S. government’s first consideration is not how to maintain its own fiscal revenue, but to stabilize taxpayers’ tax burden levels and protect taxpayers’ interests.

52599f543182ef4b758df0c91ae9b4091a000250.sourceText: 商业调查公司RealtyTrac在上周发布了美国住房情况调查报告，报告显示，房屋价格上涨的速度快于大多数美国人的工资增长水平，例如洛杉矶，凤凰城和圣地亚哥。人口稠密地区的美国中低产阶级再次出现住房难的问题。今年来，全国超过三分之二的房产市场出现价格暴涨，包括旧金山和纽约这些中心城市。美国银行一份最新报告估计当前全美房价水平距离合理价格已高估了14%。
52599f543182ef4b758df0c91ae9b4091a000250.translatedText: The business research company RealtyTrac released a survey report on the housing situation in the United States last week. The report shows that housing prices are rising faster than the wage growth of most Americans, such as Los Angeles, Phoenix and San Diego. The lower and middle class Americans in densely populated areas are once again experiencing housing difficulties. This year, more than two-thirds of the country’s real estate markets have experienced skyrocketing prices, including central cities like San Francisco and New York. A latest report from Bank of America estimates that current U.S. home prices are 14% overvalued from reasonable prices.

76162194cd05b69fd5ddefc36061ff9189e17e49.sourceText: 美国房价近年不断攀升，标普Case-Shiller美国20个城市综合房价指数今年1月同比增长5.7%，而丹佛、波特兰、西雅图、旧金山等城市更增长超过双位数，该房价指数距2006年高峰仅剩11%。全美房地产经纪商协会(NAR)首席经济学家杨恩(Lawrence Yun)称，在考量美国家庭收入和薪资仅微幅增长的情况下，房价飙涨双位数并不健康，这将不利一些潜在购屋者的入市。他形容，在当前的美国房市，要用合适的价位找到合适的房产已成了潜在买家的一大困扰。NAR最近公布2月的成屋销售下滑7.1%创3个月最低，但同月成屋销售签约指数却上涨3.5%，凸显成屋供应不及迫使房价窜高的异常现象，也显示房贷利率不断下降对房市的买气有所助益。
76162194cd05b69fd5ddefc36061ff9189e17e49.translatedText: U.S. housing prices have been rising in recent years. The S&P Case-Shiller U.S. 20-city composite housing price index increased by 5.7% year-on-year in January this year, while Denver, Portland, Seattle, San Francisco and other cities even grew by more than double digits. The housing price index is only 11% away from the peak in 2006. Lawrence Yun, chief economist of the National Association of Realtors (NAR), said that when U.S. household income and wages are only growing slightly, double-digit price increases are not healthy and will discourage some potential home buyers from entering the market. He described that in the current U.S. housing market, finding the right property at the right price has become a major problem for potential buyers. NAR recently announced that existing home sales fell by 7.1% in February, the lowest in three months. However, the existing home sales contract index increased by 3.5% in the same month, highlighting the abnormal phenomenon of insufficient supply of existing homes forcing housing prices to rise. It also shows that the continuous decline in mortgage interest rates has helped the purchasing sentiment of the housing market.

f6229e926b903ddc6371c3abde1c3dcda2b4de22.sourceText: RealtyTrac在分析在美国456个地区的房屋成交记录后发现，炒房者急功近利，房价的增长已经快上升到一些特殊时期历史高点，美国房产市场出现了价格泡沫担忧。在综合考虑房价与收入的负担能力尽管如此，高房价依然受到普通工薪阶层的追捧。RealtyTrac的高级副总裁Daren Blomquist认为，购房者需要花费资金在住房的花费上，用于其他消费的资金将越来越少。虽然绝大多数的住房市场房价增幅低于历史高位，但房价仍然在不断增长，住房者浮动的平均工资，使得美国住房市场的前景变得不可预期。
f6229e926b903ddc6371c3abde1c3dcda2b4de22.translatedText: RealtyTrac analyzed housing transaction records in 456 regions in the United States and found that real estate speculators are eager for quick success, the growth of housing prices has almost risen to some historical highs in special periods, and there are concerns about price bubbles in the U.S. real estate market. Taking into account the affordability of housing prices and income, high housing prices are still sought after by ordinary working-class people. Daren Blomquist, senior vice president of RealtyTrac, believes that homebuyers need to spend money on housing, leaving less and less money for other consumption. Although the growth rate of house prices in most housing markets is lower than historical highs, house prices are still growing, and the floating average wages of homeowners make the prospects of the U.S. housing market unpredictable.

76d34dbbbec4cf2ac49b2df167e907c0c4281a54.sourceText: 房地美(Freddie Mac)资料显示，今年2月的30年期房贷利率为3.66%，为连续7个月低于4%，标普Case-Shiller房价指数的发起人席勒(Robert Shiller)2007年在论文中描写房价上涨引发民众上涨预期心理时称，这个涨价的反馈机制是一个社会传染病。现在，这个反馈机制的强化作用正持续扩大。一年前，美国民众认为房价12个月后可上涨2.5%，民众在2月接受调查时认为房价一年后可上涨4.4%，现在NAR最新的调查发现民众预期房价的涨幅已高达8.2%。美国银行认为房价很可能进行修正，不过，由于房价上涨的动能和预期心理还在，在真正回档并造成买气缩手之前，美国房价上涨的惯性仍然不变，但或许上涨的空间可能不如民众预期那么高。
76d34dbbbec4cf2ac49b2df167e907c0c4281a54.translatedText: According to data from Freddie Mac, the 30-year mortgage interest rate in February this year was 3.66%, which was lower than 4% for seven consecutive months. In 2007, Robert Shiller, the founder of the S&P Case-Shiller housing price index, described in a paper that rising housing prices triggered people's expectation of rising prices. He said that the feedback mechanism of price increases is a social epidemic. Now, the reinforcing effects of this feedback mechanism are continuing to expand. A year ago, the American people believed that house prices would rise by 2.5% in 12 months. When people were surveyed in February, they thought that house prices would rise by 4.4% in a year. Now, the latest NAR survey found that people expect house prices to rise by as high as 8.2%. Bank of America believes that housing prices are likely to correct. However, since the momentum and expectation of rising housing prices are still there, the inertia of rising housing prices in the United States will remain unchanged before it truly pulls back and causes a retrenchment of buying sentiment. However, the room for increase may not be as high as public expectations.

ad5c47705c3ed1889de44129093eed5d4ec5c5e7.sourceText: 在上周末刚刚结束的春晚彩排中，刚刚获得2016凤凰城华裔小姐的彭天悦，在和艺术学院其它小演员交流比赛心得的时候，也强调了学习中国民族舞蹈，展示民族特色，让她变得与其他同龄人与众不同。彭天悦说亚利桑那的学术水平在全美并不突出，所以对于一个即将申请大学的普通学生来说，要想在优秀学校申请中脱颖而出很难。。。。彭天悦成绩也非常优秀，可是她说SAT满分的学生很多，别的州更是比比皆是，没有什么特别。但是她学习了中国舞蹈近十年，这项技艺让她在各种比赛中都给周围的人留下了深刻的印象。中国舞蹈就是亚裔面孔下，东方文化的传承。她告诉年纪小的学习舞蹈的学妹，在学习舞蹈中学会交朋友，找到欢乐，坚持下去。她也告诉和她差不多大的朋友，不要说自己忙，没有时间练习。她说她几乎每天都练习中国舞蹈，只要你喜欢就一定能腾出时间，也一定能做到，当时间的积累，你比别人做得更多的时候，她就成为你身体的一部分，让你与其他人不同。 亚省春晚也将坚持把中华艺术更多的展现给美国观众，让更多的朋友感受最返璞归真的中国文化！ 春晚我们相约2月13日美莎艺术中心，不见不散！
ad5c47705c3ed1889de44129093eed5d4ec5c5e7.translatedText: In the Spring Festival Gala rehearsal that just ended last weekend, Peng Tianyue, who had just won the 2016 Miss Chinese Phoenix Phoenix, was exchanging her competition experience with other young actors at the Art Academy. She also emphasized learning Chinese folk dances and displaying national characteristics, which made her different from other peers. Peng Tianyue said that Arizona's academic standards are not outstanding in the United States, so for an ordinary student who is about to apply to college, it is difficult to stand out among excellent school applications. . . . Peng Tianyue's grades are also very good, but she said there are many students with perfect SAT scores, and they are everywhere in other states, so there is nothing special about them. But she has studied Chinese dance for nearly ten years, and this skill has allowed her to impress those around her in various competitions. Chinese dance is the inheritance of Eastern culture under the face of Asians. She told the younger girls studying dance to learn to make friends, find joy and persevere while learning dance. She also told her friends who are about the same age as her not to say that they are busy and have no time to practice. She said that she practices Chinese dance almost every day. As long as you like it, you will definitely make time and you will definitely be able to do it. When time accumulates and you do more than others, it will become a part of your body and make you different from others. The Alberta Spring Festival Gala will also insist on showing more Chinese art to American audiences, allowing more friends to experience the most authentic Chinese culture! Let’s meet for the Spring Festival Gala at the Meisha Art Center on February 13th, see you there!

e0a86be5f32f33e5c57e42ade3a8826205a82850.sourceText: 推网络课程 反应两极 透过计算机网络获得大学文凭，作为一种较廉价的教育方式深受大众欢迎，如今加大也开始推出网络课程。 由于加大饱受资金与空间短缺，被迫等候课堂空位的学生越来越多，特别是化学、微积分与写作等就读人数众多的入门课。为减轻学生等候修课的压力，加大开始尝试网络授课。 柏克莱加大于今夏首次推出实验性网络课程?#22522;础化学（Chemistry 1A）。这一网络课程帮助圣拉菲一名担任救生员的学生，加快进修生物与经济双学位的进度。一名家住沙加缅度、未能申请到宿舍的学生也可在家修课。 但柏大突然转向电子教育，使得部分人士担忧加大品牌受影响。这既非由马萨诸塞理工学院与史丹福大学普及的无学分网络免费课程，也非对所有人开放、推出大量由盈利教育者赞助的网络课程的凤凰城大学。柏大的网络课程是藉助社交网络软件、视频会议、网络实验演示、聊天室与讨论版，提供学分、精挑细选的学位课程。柏大教育技术主管玛拉．汉库克说：「这也是由我们教员提供的加大教育体验。」 加大校董会顶着众多争议，于去年暑期投票通过网络授课计划。部分加大教员与讲师担心，网络学位计划将影响学士教育的质量并有损加大名誉。柏大博士生沙恩．伯乐说，网络课程是导致公共高等教育彻底内爆的可怕开端。 柏大教员协会表示，网络计划不仅是教育的退化，也是一种破坏教员对标准与课程控制的集权政策。但柏大极有吸引力的法学院院长克利斯多佛．爱德雷是网络课程的倡导者，他说服校董会尝试网络课程。 除旧金山加大外，每所加大学院均将提供一门网络课程。大约70名教员提供建议，其中30项已被采纳。这些课程正在发开阶段，将于2012年向加大学生开放。 此外，除了注入戴维斯加大的西班牙语、洛杉矶加大的政治学与尔湾加大的物理学等大量低级入门课程外，艺术、科学与技术以及恐怖主义与战争等就读人数众多的高级课程，也将进行网络授课实验。
e0a86be5f32f33e5c57e42ade3a8826205a82850.translatedText: The promotion of online courses has received mixed reactions. Obtaining a university diploma through the computer network is a cheaper way of education and is very popular among the public. Now the University of California has also begun to launch online courses. As UC suffers from a shortage of funds and space, more and more students are forced to wait for space in classes, especially in introductory classes with large enrollments such as chemistry, calculus and writing. In order to reduce the pressure on students to wait for courses, more schools have begun to try online teaching. UC Berkeley launched an experimental online course for the first time this summer - Chemistry 1A. This online course is helping a student working as a lifeguard in Santa La Fe accelerate his progress toward a double major in biology and economics. A student who lives in Sacramento and is unable to apply for a dormitory can also take courses at home. However, PCB's sudden shift to electronic education has caused some people to worry about the impact on the brand. This is neither the non-credit free online courses popularized by Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Stanford University, nor the University of Phoenix, which is open to everyone and has launched a large number of online courses sponsored by for-profit educators. Park University's online courses use social network software, video conferencing, online experiment demonstrations, chat rooms and discussion boards to provide credit and carefully selected degree courses. Marla., Director of Educational Technology at Cypress University. "This is also a UC educational experience provided by our faculty," Hancock said. The UC Board of Regents voted to approve the online teaching plan last summer despite a lot of controversy. Some UC faculty and lecturers worry that online degree programs will affect the quality of bachelor's education and damage UC's reputation. Shane. Bole said that online courses are the terrible beginning of a complete implosion of public higher education. The UC Faculty Association says the online plan is not only a degradation of education but also a totalizing policy that undermines faculty control over standards and curriculum. But Christopher, the very attractive dean of the law school at Columbia University. Edley was an advocate of online courses and persuaded the school board to try online courses. Each UC campus, except UC San Francisco, will offer an online course. Approximately 70 faculty members provided suggestions, 30 of which have been adopted. These courses are in the development stage and will be available to UC students in 2012. In addition, in addition to injecting a large number of low-level introductory courses such as Spanish at UC Davis, political science at UC Los Angeles, and physics at UC Irvine, online teaching experiments will also be carried out for high-level courses with large enrollments such as art, science and technology, and terrorism and war.

96a08e8f909ab3a498f92618ea61e7e46b95e4ae.translatedText: Pearl of the Desert | Chinese History in Arizona (34) The earliest Chinese family in Flagstaff (2)

b0940d66d2efbc7ad7049f74940c02fc0e757093.sourceText: 亚利桑那州华人历史协会：张肇鸿 1905年9月28日，黄世质带着预付的回程票登船返回旧金山。他被港口的移民官员…
b0940d66d2efbc7ad7049f74940c02fc0e757093.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association: Zhang Zhaohong On September 28, 1905, Huang Shizhi boarded the ship and returned to San Francisco with a prepaid return ticket. He was arrested by the immigration officer at the port...

f39eb22094bf4c2dd29b0d8363b8c94e263a1050.sourceText: 1905年9月28日，黄世质带着预付的回程票登船返回旧金山。他被港口的移民官员拘留，在该港口对入境者进行了讯问，以证明他们有资格进入美国。
f39eb22094bf4c2dd29b0d8363b8c94e263a1050.translatedText: >On September 28, 1905, Huang Shizhi boarded the ship and returned to San Francisco with a prepaid return ticket. He was detained by immigration officials at the port, where arrivals are questioned to prove their eligibility to enter the United States.

ce7419b40777d4e207a1551a124986495fb301cb.sourceText: 黄世质能说一口流利的英语，手里拿着出生证明，并且有两个证人可以证明他以前住在旧金山，所以他有权重新进入美国。
ce7419b40777d4e207a1551a124986495fb301cb.translatedText: Huang Shizhi can speak fluent English, has a birth certificate in his hand, and has two witnesses who can prove that he previously lived in San Francisco, so he has the right to re-enter the United States.

d8b83f685265947930e1f2b9afc32637ebab5d45.sourceText: 他回到了旧金山，在自己熟悉的小商店和药草店做些零工和杂事，直到他有足够的钱返回亚利桑那的阿什福克（Ash Fork）小镇，在那里他继续为采石场和铁路工人做饭并为他们洗衣服。在这三年中，他得知妻子已经去世，儿子与妻子家人同住。他之前希望能把妻儿带过来，实际上，鉴于他的经济状况，他意识到在美国是无法照料残疾（绑小脚）的妻子和雇用仆人的。
d8b83f685265947930e1f2b9afc32637ebab5d45.translatedText: He returned to San Francisco, doing odd jobs and errands in the small shops and herb shops he was familiar with, until he had enough money to return to the small town of Ash Fork, Arizona, where he continued to cook and wash clothes for quarry and railroad workers. During these three years, he learned that his wife had died and his son was living with his wife's family. He had hoped to bring his wife and children over, but in fact, given his financial situation, he realized that it would be impossible to care for his disabled wife and hire servants in the United States.

10c5ace7c12e8da34f81036d38de91c68b459c95.sourceText: 黄世质有了积蓄后，第二次返回中国，这次要找一个有工作能力的女人。在代理机构的帮助下，他再次从香港进入广州。选择了一个16岁名叫谢瑶的农家女孩，并恭敬寻求她父母的允许。
10c5ace7c12e8da34f81036d38de91c68b459c95.translatedText: After Huang Shizhi had saved up, he returned to China for the second time, this time to find a woman with the ability to work. With the help of an agency, he entered Guangzhou from Hong Kong again. A 16-year-old farm girl named Xie Yao was chosen and her parents' permission was respectfully sought.

670230aa5ab7c0f27110c0743622f0a9e8954666.sourceText: 两个月后，在与女方家人成功谈判之后，他们结婚了。在回美国之前的1911年，妻子生下了第一个儿子。由于在中国没有经济前途，黄世质决定返回美国。因为《排华法案》的缘故，他再次把新家庭留在了中国。而他和前妻所生下的儿子，一直由其祖父母抚养。
670230aa5ab7c0f27110c0743622f0a9e8954666.translatedText: Two months later, after successful negotiations with the woman’s family, they got married. In 1911, before returning to the United States, his wife gave birth to her first son. With no financial future in China, Huang Shizhi decided to return to the United States. Because of the Chinese Exclusion Act, he once again left his new family in China. The son he had with his ex-wife has been raised by his grandparents.

6fd87b00f7a82e27daad517f052d126881b19742.sourceText: 同年9月，黄世质回到旧金山。 由于1906年的旧金山的大地震，市政厅的档案被烧毁。 地震发生前居住在旧金山的任何人，几乎都可以自动获得公民身份，而只需要两个见证人在场的证明即可。任何愿意说谎的人都可以成为美国公民。 在旧金山待了一会之后，黄世质回到了亚利桑那的Ash Fork。 他在那里工作，并将钱寄给中国的家人，同时制定了将他们带回美国的计划。
6fd87b00f7a82e27daad517f052d126881b19742.translatedText: In September of the same year, Huang Shizhi returned to San Francisco. Due to the 1906 San Francisco earthquake, City Hall's archives were burned. Anyone who lived in San Francisco before the earthquake was almost automatically granted citizenship, requiring only the presence of two witnesses. Anyone willing to lie can become an American citizen. After spending time in San Francisco, Huang Shizhi returned to Ash Fork, Arizona. There he worked and sent money to his family in China while making plans to bring them back to the United States.

ca3380d311b47426dd41a8ec897bb079b0213ca5.sourceText: 黄世质准备了必要的文件。他第三次回到中国，很高兴见到他的家人。他第二任的妻子和六岁的儿子渴望去美国，但第一任妻子的家人决心将他的儿子由他们抚养，男孩也不愿离开他的家人。 黄世质不得不放弃，即使他已经为这个的八岁儿子做了适当的申请。 他不想浪费这个申请，并将出生证明卖给想带亲戚或朋友到美国的人，这些人被称为“纸儿子”（Paper Son）。
ca3380d311b47426dd41a8ec897bb079b0213ca5.translatedText: >Huang Shizhi prepared the necessary documents. He returned to China for the third time and was happy to see his family. His second wife and six-year-old son were eager to go to the United States, but the first wife's family was determined to have their son raised by them, and the boy was unwilling to leave his family. Huang Shizhi had to give up, even though he had made appropriate applications for this for his eight-year-old son. He didn't want to waste the application and sold the birth certificate to people who wanted to bring relatives or friends to the United States, known as "Paper Sons."

132cb869571a3f7dfbe3fef31a436957700fa8c9.sourceText: 有一个家庭希望黄世质带一个男孩假扮他的儿子到美国。 这个男孩大约十岁， 他的名字被登记为Wong Ben Sen（黄炳森）。 黄世质把赚来的钱用来支付整个家庭搬到美国的费用。尽管黄本森只有十岁，但黄世质对他进行了彻底的教育，因为他将要面对航程和冒险的经历，特别是到达美国时海关人员不可避免的审问。 这是一场赌博，但“纸儿子”的家庭愿意接受。
132cb869571a3f7dfbe3fef31a436957700fa8c9.translatedText: A family wanted Huang Shizhi to bring a boy to the United States pretending to be his son. The boy was about ten years old and his name was registered as Wong Ben Sen. Huang Shizhi used the money he earned to pay for his family's move to the United States. Although Huang Benson was only ten years old, Huang Shizhi gave him a thorough education for the voyage and adventures he would face, especially the inevitable interrogation by customs officers upon arriving in the United States. It's a gamble, but one the Paper Son family is willing to take.

62128af0a821b0797e9725a052bd5d06c1f1b438.sourceText: 黄世质保证从美国寄钱以帮助妻子的父母维持生计。他还答应汇钱给他的第一个儿子的家人。1916年9月12日，他们四人登上了中国商船最便宜的舱位回美国。几乎在整个旅程中都遭受了晕船的困扰，没有充足的日照或新鲜空气，最终到达旧金山的天使岛（Angel Island）。
62128af0a821b0797e9725a052bd5d06c1f1b438.translatedText: Huang Shizhi promised to send money from the United States to help his wife's parents make ends meet. He also promised to send money to his first son's family. On September 12, 1916, the four of them boarded the cheapest cabin on a Chinese merchant ship and returned to the United States. Suffering from seasickness almost the entire trip, without much sunlight or fresh air, we finally arrived at San Francisco's Angel Island.

925cf24dca99200115cae497fd7bb081f62678e1.sourceText: 《排华法案》只允许商人，神职人员，外交官，教师和学生入境，劳工被禁止。在30年的时间里，美国移民局对超过100万移民进行了调查和讯问， 其中有17.5万的中国人入境，约20％被拒绝。 通关过程通常是残酷和羞辱的！中国移民抱怨说他们像罪犯一样被关在笼子里长达数周或数月之久，并遭到了漫长而紧张的审讯。
925cf24dca99200115cae497fd7bb081f62678e1.translatedText: The "Chinese Exclusion Act" only allows businessmen, clergy, diplomats, teachers and students to enter the country, and workers are prohibited. Over the past 30 years, the U.S. Immigration Service has investigated and interrogated more than 1 million immigrants. Among them, 175,000 Chinese were admitted, and about 20% were rejected. The playthrough process is often brutal and humiliating! Chinese immigrants complain that they are held in cages like criminals for weeks or months and subjected to lengthy and tense interrogations.

bef41f98ffc495e64853e15b80985056506de422.sourceText: 谢瑶显得虚弱生病被命令去医院做体检，经确定她是由于航行的艰辛和怀孕所致。如一旦确定她有任何疾病，最终要返回到中国。新进入者将进行彻底的审问。
bef41f98ffc495e64853e15b80985056506de422.translatedText: Xie Yao appeared weak and sick and was ordered to go to the hospital for a physical examination. It was determined that she was caused by the hardships of the voyage and pregnancy. If it is determined that she has any disease, she will eventually have to return to China. New entrants will undergo a thorough interrogation.

536712456353539c80c5f5cd18e0827f2fe86ae1.sourceText: 黄世质的证词让检查员感到满意，没有采取进一步的行动。谢瑶通过翻译被讯问。“纸儿子”黄本森只有十岁，被问到有关他的村庄和居住的问题时，检查员给他看了照片，黄本森与他所谓的父亲或继母之间似乎没有特别的相似之处，也许检查员认为它不足以使其成为问题。最后一个是小儿子黄炳军（Wong Ben Jun），但他只有五岁，酷似他的母亲。检查员给他一家人有利的报告，移民专员准许合法地进入美国。
536712456353539c80c5f5cd18e0827f2fe86ae1.translatedText: >Huang Shizhi's testimony satisfied the inspector and no further action was taken. Xie Yao was interrogated through an interpreter. "Paper son" Huang Benson was only ten years old. When asked about his village and residence, the inspector showed him photos. There seemed to be no particular similarity between Huang Benson and his alleged father or stepmother. Perhaps the inspector did not think it was enough to make it a problem. The last one is the youngest son Wong Ben Jun, but he is only five years old and looks exactly like his mother. Inspectors gave the family a favorable report, and immigration commissioners allowed legal entry into the United States.

e01171af5301b95b04f0b1d9ee2c2df1b22e932c.sourceText: 他们前往旧金山的唐人街。黄世质为了使妻子和孩子感觉更舒适，购买了中国主食和商品，有大米，水果和蔬菜干，中式香肠，咸蛋，腌鸭，酱油，香油，鱼罐头，竹笋罐头和调味品等等。除了食物外，他还订购了草药，用于治疗大多数疾病或不适。在旧金山，一家人登上了南太平洋前往加利福尼亚州的火车。 并从那里转到圣达菲铁路的火车去弗拉格斯塔夫（Flagstaff）。
e01171af5301b95b04f0b1d9ee2c2df1b22e932c.translatedText: They head to San Francisco's Chinatown. In order to make his wife and children feel more comfortable, Huang Shizhi bought Chinese staple foods and commodities, including rice, dried fruits and vegetables, Chinese sausages, salted eggs, pickled duck, soy sauce, sesame oil, canned fish, canned bamboo shoots and condiments, etc. In addition to food, he also ordered herbal medicines, which were used to treat most diseases or ailments. In San Francisco, the family boarded the Southern Pacific train bound for California. From there transfer to the Santa Fe Railroad to Flagstaff.

79c8691111e992902477fa62cd9c5bacf4523b71.sourceText: 当时是9月，以后将要面对的严冬。他们在弗拉格斯塔夫租了一所小房子。他在里面开了一个洗衣房，大部分时间都用来洗衣服。 几乎没有足够的空间容纳居住。燃木柴的炉灶将水加热，用老式的搓衣板和手摇绞扭机，然后在后院拉绳晒衣服。天气不好的时候，就挂在了整个屋子里。
79c8691111e992902477fa62cd9c5bacf4523b71.translatedText: It was September, and we were going to face the severe winter in the future. They rented a small house in Flagstaff. He opened a laundry room inside and spent most of his time doing laundry. There is barely enough room for habitation. A wood-burning stove heats water, an old-fashioned washboard and a hand-cranked wringer are used, and laundry is dried on a string in the backyard. When the weather is bad, they are hung throughout the house.

4559155ba5c0a16aef17f84748a99b0118086431.sourceText: 为了赚钱，黄世质在当地餐厅的厨房工作，还自制肥皂，他从城镇附近的餐馆收集免费用过的猪油和油脂，用他自己的配方对碱液进行了碱处理，这是他从以前的洗衣店工作中学到的。男孩帮助母亲做家务，生活很艰难，但他的妻子从未抱怨过这种新的辛劳。
4559155ba5c0a16aef17f84748a99b0118086431.translatedText: To make money, Huang Shizhi worked in the kitchens of local restaurants and also made his own soap. He collected free used lard and grease from restaurants around town and alkaline the lye with his own recipe, which he learned from his previous job in a laundry. Life was difficult for the boy as he helped his mother with housework, but his wife never complained about this new toil.

9b98724870ac78ca8001e97cee68e0075090cf41.sourceText: 当他们用完珍贵的中国罐头食品和干货，黄世质会向旧金山的Henry Chong＆Company重新订购，然后将它们送到Flagstaff。 传统的饮食习惯使他们在适应陌生的环境变得容易一些。
9b98724870ac78ca8001e97cee68e0075090cf41.translatedText: When they ran out of precious Chinese canned foods and dry goods, Huang Shizhi would reorder them from Henry Chong & Company in San Francisco and send them to Flagstaff. Traditional eating habits make it easier for them to adapt to unfamiliar environments.

53018db39fe8675ea799882d0e826dbefba4b9f0.translatedText: The governor hopes to complete the presidential candidate nomination early. Alberta Times Governor Brewer hopes to advance the state's presidential candidate nomination election to January 31, and...

3c4660f9b3d48eb4c9449fd9584fe2187107746f.sourceText: 州长希望提早完成总统候选人提名 亚省时报 布鲁尔州长希望将本州的总统候选人提名选举提早到1月31日，而非平常的六月份。 州长近日在一份声明中说，亚利桑那州在推进全国性的问题，如打击非法移民和加强边境安全、医疗支出和财政危机等方面，都走在别州的前面。她希望总统候选人提名选举也能走在全国的前面，让更多人了解亚利桑那州。布鲁尔还说，作为共和党重镇码头的亚利桑那州，提早推出总统候选人，对整个总统选举过程有重大影响意义。 预计州长将在近期正式宣布此项计划，但可能为佛罗里达州坦帕举行的共和党全国代表大会带来激烈讨论。
3c4660f9b3d48eb4c9449fd9584fe2187107746f.translatedText: The governor hopes to complete the presidential candidate nomination early. Alberta Times Governor Brewer hopes to advance the state's presidential candidate nomination election to January 31, instead of the usual June. The governor said in a statement recently that Arizona is ahead of other states in advancing national issues such as combating illegal immigration and strengthening border security, health care spending and fiscal crises. She hopes that the presidential nomination election will also lead the country and let more people know about Arizona. Brewer also said that the early introduction of presidential candidates in Arizona, a stronghold of the Republican Party, will have a significant impact on the entire presidential election process. The governor is expected to formally announce the plan in the near future, but it is likely to spark heated debate at the Republican National Convention in Tampa, Florida.

e20d81a913a9856b1200f0104d0d6cd2a63b26fd.sourceText: 为佳叔加油 司威立

e36337f7a478c618011d07ecb78f281e3bcc7a30.sourceText: 为佳叔加油 司威立 （亚省时报） 佳叔在亚省时报写专栏有相当长的一段时间，以他的高龄能如此勤勉不休的长期写…
e36337f7a478c618011d07ecb78f281e3bcc7a30.translatedText: Cheer for Uncle Jia, Sweili (Alberta Times) Uncle Jia has been writing a column in the Alberta Times for a long time. Considering his advanced age, he can write so diligently and non-stop for a long time...

becc307fc7b05ca26ecdbfe76e2c7723c39595ad.sourceText: 佳叔在亚省时报写专栏有相当长的一段时间，以他的高龄能如此勤勉不休的长期写作，并分享他的理念，是我们亚省华人之福。 在报章杂志写稿的人，除了记者之外，大半的文章是散文或艺文，能仗义执言，恳切说公道话，不乡愿，不拍马屁者不多，这是我华人笔园难能可贵，并须表扬 的楷模。 亚省华人，尤其是在大鳯城地区，近十年来人口增加甚多，各方面的人才也济济一堂，学术界的专家和科技的精英更是不胜枚举。 希望华人社会能有更多的「笔」分享他们的专精，分享他们的经验，分享他们的智慧，分享他们的执着。让文化的贡献和奉献壮大我们的侨界，让智慧和经验是我们的侨社更健康，繁荣。
becc307fc7b05ca26ecdbfe76e2c7723c39595ad.translatedText: Uncle Jia has been writing a column in the Alberta Times for a long time. Considering his advanced age, he can write so diligently and non-stop for a long time and share his ideas. This is a blessing to us Chinese people in Alberta. Among those who write in newspapers and magazines, except for journalists, most of their articles are prose or artistic literature. There are not many who can speak uprightly, speak truth sincerely, and are unwilling to flatter others. This is a rare example for our Chinese writing community and must be praised. The Chinese population in Alberta, especially in the Dalu City area, has increased significantly in the past ten years, and there are also many talents in all fields, including experts in academia and scientific and technological elites. I hope that there will be more "pens" in the Chinese community to share their expertise, their experience, their wisdom, and their perseverance. Let cultural contributions and dedication strengthen our overseas Chinese community, and let wisdom and experience make our overseas Chinese community healthier and more prosperous.

Reuters learned from multiple sources that a large number of Apple engineers are seeking to leave their jobs recently, and the number has reached the highest level in history...

d0aa43066467c0c2a4911d409713111d004b7980.sourceText: 一位专注苹果公司的猎头日前透露，他的LinkedIn消息和邮件里塞满了苹果工程师的求职简历，而其中有些人才在苹果工作了一年，还有些人是苹果忠实的老员工。
d0aa43066467c0c2a4911d409713111d004b7980.translatedText: A headhunter who focuses on Apple recently revealed that his LinkedIn messages and emails are filled with resumes of Apple engineers, and some of them have worked at Apple for a year, and some are loyal old Apple employees.

bdb597dcf35dc4ff11d0921495c06bfabe6d9fb2.sourceText: 除了职业猎头公司外，还有风投公司向《路透社》证实了类似的消息。在今年四月份，一位投资人士称：”苹果公司高管和员工的不满情绪与日俱增，更多人打算跳槽。”
bdb597dcf35dc4ff11d0921495c06bfabe6d9fb2.translatedText: In addition to professional headhunting companies, venture capital firms also confirmed similar news to Reuters. In April this year, an investor said: "The dissatisfaction among Apple executives and employees is growing day by day, and more people are planning to change jobs."

734791786af197c0766444a5a0bef76effe74689.sourceText: 另一位风投透露，他们收到的来自苹果员工的简历明显增多。在与几位求职者交谈之后，他们明白了原因：第一，新兴公司的薪酬更高；第二，乔布斯离世后，苹果的文化已经发生改变。
734791786af197c0766444a5a0bef76effe74689.translatedText: Another venture capital investor revealed that they have received a significant increase in resumes from Apple employees. After talking to several job seekers, they understood why: First, salaries are higher at emerging companies; second, Apple's culture has changed since Jobs passed away.

0629650a91b1a4b4a4c483cbee02844187211779.sourceText: 此外，在今年三月份，知名博客Daring Fireball著名苹果分析师约翰?#26684;拉博（John Gruber）透露，留住员工已经成为苹果当下面临的最大的问题。他说：”我认为，随着事态的发展，这一问题将会越来越严重，因为一些极具天赋的工程师和设计师都将弃苹果而去。”
0629650a91b1a4b4a4c483cbee02844187211779.translatedText: In addition, in March this year, well-known Apple analyst John Gruber of the well-known blog Daring Fireball revealed that retaining employees has become the biggest problem facing Apple. "I think as things go on, this problem is going to get worse because some of the most talented engineers and designers are going to leave Apple," he said.

74a4c337b40d17c8af801c2716a90f1ffe929e29.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: Talking about Dragon in the Year of Dragon Zhang Zhaohong When the Year of Dragon arrives, I say "Dragon". Congratulations on getting rich and prosperous business! Men, women, old and young, are in good health, and all have good luck. Parents and elders...

69ee48f23e2edc70b2bc25114c520202709fe381.sourceText: 龙年一到要说「龙」，恭喜发财生意兴隆! 男女老少身体好，个个行运一条龙。 父母长辈添福寿，儿女成鳯又成龙。 兄弟高大又威猛，姐妹可爱又玲珑。 媳妇娶到贤淑女，嫁女嫁到快婿成龙。 心想事成好福气，阖家欢喜乐融融。 居家置业风水好，右白虎来左青龙。 日日都是平安日，家家和谐有祥龙。 餐馆龙年行大运，老板回复好笑容，打杂不会缺吕宋，厨房不会塞水龙。 快餐急Call外卖送，堂食时时排长龙。 生意兴隆通四海，财源似水入猪笼! 龙年一到要说「龙」，讲到自己发好梦：天天茶居叹乌龙，虾饺烧卖一笼笼，三餐时常鲍参翅，饮酒又有交叉窿(xo)。 衣着光鲜人敬重，老牌香水用古龙。 手带「金劳」份量重，开着「平治」去兜风。 买间大屋八个Room，鱼缸养条大红龙。 欧化家俬有品味，电视音响震耳聋。 听歌要听徐小鳯，看戏要看李小龙。 日日Golf.to个洞，晚晚保龄响隆隆。 卡拉OK高声唱，粗声粗气吓恐龙，唱完劲歌唱粤曲，游龙戏鳯戏鳯游龙。 半夜开台打八圈，叫糊叫到沙喉咙。 女友个个好娇容，银纸多多眼蒙胧，蒙胧一醒是个梦，美梦醒来一场空。 龙年一到要说「龙」，「遥远的东方有条龙」，金山阿伯返唐山，唐山处处绿映红。 直航班机飞香港，又坐高铁过九龙。 神洲大地风光好，东看西看似游龙。 泰山顶上观日出，黄山拍摄迎客松，海南岛上看红日，黑龙江省赏冰龙，北京西安寻古迹，三下江南学乾隆。 童年往事未忘记，回乡探亲拜祖宗，清明扫墓招风雨，人人赞我「掘尾龙」。 祖屋翻新份内事，修桥铺路乡情浓。 高朋满座家常客，亲朋戚友排长龙。 洗钱洗到袋穿窿，计数计到大乱龙，个个夸我金山伯，原来真是过江龙！ 龙年一到要说「龙」，龙的传人做好龙，家庭和睦万事兴，夫妻恩爱情意浓，细声细气讲大事，心平气静好笑容。 站穏脚跟来做人，从来不做变色龙。 隔篱邻舍关系好，法例法治要遵从，明白事理人开朗，千祈莫做牛皮灯笼。 白天不做亏心事，晚上不怕「广昌隆」。 行善积福不落后，相互帮助情谊浓，侨社团结好办事，公益事业日兴隆。 恭祝各位龙年旺，一年到尾做猛龙！
69ee48f23e2edc70b2bc25114c520202709fe381.translatedText: When the Year of the Dragon comes, say "Dragon". Congratulations on getting rich and prosperous business! Men, women, old and young, may be in good health, and may all have good luck. Parents and elders will be blessed with good fortune and longevity, and children will become dragons and dragons. The brothers are tall and mighty, while the sisters are cute and delicate. The daughter-in-law will marry a virtuous and virtuous daughter, and the married daughter will marry a quick son-in-law. May all your wishes turn into good blessings, and your family may be happy and harmonious. Home buying has good feng shui, the white tiger on the right comes to the green dragon on the left. Every day is a safe day, and every family is harmonious and has auspicious dragons. The restaurant will have good luck in the Year of the Dragon. The boss will smile well, the handyman will not be short of Luzon, and the kitchen will not have a water tap. Fast food is urgently called for takeout delivery, and there are always long queues for dine-in food. Business is booming all over the world, and wealth is like water flowing into a pig cage! When the Year of the Dragon comes, I say "dragon" and talk about having good dreams: I sigh at the oolong tea every day, sell a cage of shrimp dumplings, eat abalone and ginseng wings for three meals, and have cross holes when drinking (xo). Well-dressed people respect you, and you wear cologne as a brand-name perfume. Carrying the "Jinlao" is heavy, and driving the "Pingji" for a ride. Buy a big house with eight rooms and raise a big red dragon in a fish tank. The European furniture is tasteful and the TV speakers are deafening. When listening to music, you must listen to Xu Xiaofan, and when watching movies, you must watch Bruce Lee. Golf.to a hole every day, bowling rumble every night. Sing loudly in karaoke and scare the dinosaurs with your rough voice. After singing, you can sing Cantonese opera and play with dragons and dragons. In the middle of the night, they played eight rounds on the stage and screamed until their throats were scratched. My girlfriend has a pretty face and a lot of money. Her eyes are blurry. When she wakes up from the blur, it’s just a dream. When she wakes up, her dream is all in vain. When the Year of the Dragon comes, we say "dragon", "There is a dragon in the far east." When Jinshan's uncle returns to Tangshan, Tangshan is green and red everywhere. Take a direct flight to Hong Kong and take the high-speed rail to Kowloon. The land of Shenzhou has beautiful scenery. Looking from east to west, it looks like a swimming dragon. Watch the sunrise on the top of Mount Tai, take pictures of welcoming pines in Huangshan, watch the red sun on Hainan Island, admire ice dragons in Heilongjiang Province, search for historical sites in Xi'an, Beijing, and go to Jiangnan three times to learn about Qianlong. I have never forgotten the memories of my childhood. I went back to my hometown to visit relatives and worship my ancestors. I swept tombs during the Qingming Festival to attract wind and rain. Everyone praised me as a "tail-digger". Renovating the ancestral house is part of the job, building bridges and paving roads, and the feeling of nostalgia is strong. The house was packed with guests and regulars, and there was a long line of relatives and friends. I laundered money until my pockets were pierced, I counted and counted dragons, and everyone praised me Jin Shanbo. It turned out that I was really a dragon across the river! When the Year of the Dragon comes, we say "Dragon". If the descendants of the Dragon are good dragons, everything will be prosperous if the family is harmonious, the husband and wife will have strong love and affection, talk about big things in a soft voice, be calm and smile. Stay on your feet and be a human being, never be a chameleon. Have a good relationship with your neighbors, obey the laws and regulations, be sensible and cheerful, and pray not to be a cowhide lantern. Don’t do bad things during the day, and don’t be afraid of "Guang Chang Long" at night. Doing good deeds and accumulating blessings will not lag behind, the friendship of mutual help will be strong, the overseas Chinese community will unite to do things well, and the public welfare undertakings will prosper day by day. I wish you all a prosperous Year of the Dragon and be a Raptor all year round!

05f85648df7a467dab349ff00b7bed4c9b812dba.sourceText: 亚利桑那清华校友会第五届会长和董事会选出(图) 亚利桑那清华校友会(TAAA)改选及章程修改会议于2011年5月8日在司捷家中举行。会上正式选出第五届会长和由7名董事组成的董事会，详情可查阅校友会网站， http://www.tsinghua-az.org/ 。 Intel公司的陶敏出任TAAA第五届会长, ASU的于宏宇和付秋实出任副会长，鹿姗主持财务，另外三名董事分别是ASU的刘凌涛，Intel的陆骁和周贵安。此届董事会任期到2014年1月份。 TAO Min Min Tao graduated from Tsinghua University in 2001 with a B.S. in Engineering Mechanics. She received her M.S. and Ph.D. degrees in 2002 and 2006 respectively in Applied Mechanics (Majoring Solid Mechanics with a Minor in Material Science) from California Institute of Technology. She is currently a Staff Packaging Engineer in Pathfinding Integration Group at Intel ATTD Chandler. She is from Shanghai, China. In her spare time, she enjoys hiking and reading.

At the meeting, the fifth president and a board of directors composed of seven directors were formally elected. For details, please check the alumni association website, http://www.tsinghua-az.org/. Tao Min from Intel serves as the fifth president of TAAA, Yu Hongyu and Fu Qiushi from ASU serve as vice presidents, Lu Shan is in charge of finance, and the other three directors are Liu Lingtao from ASU, Lu Xiao and Zhou Gui'an from Intel. The term of this board of directors is until January 2014. TAO Min Min Tao graduated from Tsinghua University in 2001 with a B.S. in Engineering Mechanics. She received her M.S. and Ph.D. degrees in 2002 and 2006 respectively in Applied Mechanics (Majoring Solid Mechanics with a Minor in Material Science) from California Institute of Technology. She is currently a Staff Packaging Engineer in Pathfinding Integration Group at Intel ATTD Chandler. She is from Shanghai, China. In her spare time, she enjoys hiking and reading.
