eeafdf32a711fa2499042376182bd60ea9a35c6d.sourceText: 每当谈到养生方法的时候，我们总要为先人的智慧惊叹，其实生活中普通的一件小事都能成为延年益寿的条件之一。
eeafdf32a711fa2499042376182bd60ea9a35c6d.translatedText: Whenever we talk about health preservation methods, we always have to marvel at the wisdom of our ancestors. In fact, every ordinary little thing in life can become one of the conditions for longevity.

f59d14c914dc844e37ab6ac803395890d0a4e6d7.sourceText: 一般女性年过40，皮肤开始变黑，嗓门变粗，腰围增加。而宋美龄在60多岁时，仍然身材适中，体重始终保持50公斤左右。她的肌肤依然白净，柔软润泽，光彩照人。尤其是她那纤纤十指，凝脂滑润。经多方查证，宋美龄的养生之道具有很深的科学内涵，这也是她长盛不衰的秘诀。
f59d14c914dc844e37ab6ac803395890d0a4e6d7.translatedText: Generally, when women reach the age of 40, their skin begins to darken, their voice becomes thicker, and their waistline increases. When Soong Meiling was in her 60s, she was still in moderate shape and her weight remained around 50 kilograms. Her skin is still fair, soft, moist and radiant. Especially her slender fingers, which are smooth and smooth. After multiple verifications, Soong Meiling's health regimen has profound scientific connotations, which is also the secret of her long-lasting prosperity.

b301cda9cb641fe0d3927bd535091837d1b13ea9.sourceText: 宋美龄很注重饮食质量，少食多餐。每餐两荤、两素，每天必须就5次餐，每一次进餐也只吃五分饱，即使再喜欢吃的食物，也绝不贪食。她几乎每天都会用磅秤称体重，只要发觉体重稍微重了些，会立刻改吃青菜沙拉，不吃任何荤的食物。
b301cda9cb641fe0d3927bd535091837d1b13ea9.translatedText: Song Meiling pays great attention to the quality of her diet, eating small meals often. There are two meat and two vegetarian meals in each meal, and you must eat 5 times a day. At each meal, you only eat 50% full. No matter how much you like the food, you will never be gluttonous. She weighs herself on a scale almost every day. Whenever she notices that she is a little heavier, she will immediately switch to eating green salad instead of any meaty food.

15dfe5ebd3156336f8c90ae681ed2693a9dfc2f7.sourceText: 抗衰老处方:食勿过饱，淡食杂食
15dfe5ebd3156336f8c90ae681ed2693a9dfc2f7.translatedText: Anti-aging prescription: Don’t eat too much, eat light and omnivorous food

7b63dd1ed1f8b75cbc99af1de7abf9ce3d2a399f.sourceText: 要饮食平衡，粗细搭配，荤素结合，多吃绿色蔬菜和水果。不暴饮暴食，不过饱过饥。进食太多，会引起肥胖而早衰。饮食搭配合理，能量平衡，可延缓衰老。
7b63dd1ed1f8b75cbc99af1de7abf9ce3d2a399f.translatedText: Eat a balanced diet, a combination of meat and vegetables, and eat more green vegetables and fruits. Not overeating, but not overeating. Eating too much can cause obesity and premature aging. A reasonable diet and balanced energy can delay aging.

fe2ae7b56f34a1326c231deec154497d2a9b107a.sourceText: 另外，要充足摄取ω-3不饱和脂肪酸。它是人体必需的脂肪酸，能保证人们健康长寿的重要物质，当人体内有足够的ω-3不饱和脂肪酸时，可以有效防止记忆力低下、免疫性疾病等。它还能清除血液中产生的”垃圾”来改善血管弹性，预防心血管疾病。
fe2ae7b56f34a1326c231deec154497d2a9b107a.translatedText: In addition, adequate intake of omega-3 unsaturated fatty acids is required. It is an essential fatty acid for the human body and an important substance that can ensure people's health and longevity. When there are enough omega-3 unsaturated fatty acids in the human body, it can effectively prevent memory loss, immune diseases, etc. It can also remove "junk" produced in the blood to improve blood vessel elasticity and prevent cardiovascular disease.

c6f445e5ea64a3c6c92f03e67ad0cf3551868348.sourceText: 宋美龄没有便秘的毛病，但每天临睡之前都要灌肠。虽然，这种方法并没有科学依据，但宋美龄却几十年如一日坚持灌肠，目的是要将毒素清洗出来，达到排毒的作用。这在一般人认为是件既麻烦又痛苦的事，可是她却把这当作一种愉快的事来做。
c6f445e5ea64a3c6c92f03e67ad0cf3551868348.translatedText: Song Meiling did not suffer from constipation, but she had to take enema every day before going to bed. Although this method has no scientific basis, Soong Meiling insisted on enema for decades, with the purpose of cleaning out toxins and achieving detoxification. Most people think this is a troublesome and painful thing, but she does it as a pleasant thing.

d8dd3ef037f260fd7371f75d70b99031939e731d.sourceText: 抗衰老处方:养生祛疾，排毒第一
d8dd3ef037f260fd7371f75d70b99031939e731d.translatedText: Anti-aging prescription: Maintain health and eliminate diseases, detoxification is the first step

56cf01976572ef65aac31b3741145baaf693c305.translatedText: Methods for human body detoxification and detoxification:

0d408415ae175bab5baacf0d2563729be88658a9.sourceText: 运动排毒最轻松：运动能够加速新陈代谢，帮助皮肤和肺脏排毒，通过出汗等方式排除 其他器官无法解决的毒素。可以根据自己的喜好选择运动方式。 足浴：因为脚是体内毒素的最大沉积处，所以要坚持足浴。芳香疗法：可利用蒸气浴发汗排毒，也就是利用人体面积最大的皮肤作为出汗排毒的系统。洗肠排毒：洗 肠排毒是一种应急的方法，但不能作为排毒的常用手段。
0d408415ae175bab5baacf0d2563729be88658a9.translatedText: Exercise is the easiest way to detoxify: Exercise can accelerate metabolism, help detoxify the skin and lungs, and eliminate toxins that other organs cannot resolve through sweating and other methods. You can choose the exercise method according to your own preferences. Foot bath: Because the feet are the largest deposit of toxins in the body, you must insist on foot bath. Aromatherapy: You can use steam baths to sweat and detoxify, which means using the largest area of ​​the human body, the skin, as a sweating and detoxifying system. Colon cleansing and detoxification: Colon cleansing and detoxification is an emergency method, but it cannot be used as a common method of detoxification.

0d39ec99b5c557403db53298c9d6b8b11200f893.sourceText: 特别推荐：饮食：常饮绿茶、蔬菜汁与果汁，常吃薯类、杂粮、海藻等食物排毒。每周吃两天素食，给肠胃休息的机会。
0d39ec99b5c557403db53298c9d6b8b11200f893.translatedText: Special recommendations: Diet: Regularly drink green tea, vegetable juices and fruit juices, and regularly eat potatoes, grains, seaweed and other foods to detoxify. Eat vegetarian food two days a week to give your stomach a chance to rest.

b8ba754f4a3e70d136b656157fbd547a8698dd83.sourceText: 沐浴：在家里泡浴时可加入精油，如柠檬草3滴+马郁兰3滴+迷迭香3滴，可去除宿便，排解毒素。
b8ba754f4a3e70d136b656157fbd547a8698dd83.translatedText: Bath: You can add essential oils when taking a bath at home, such as 3 drops of lemongrass + 3 drops of marjoram + 3 drops of rosemary, which can remove feces and detoxify.

4a43e2bd2dc58d6888e71423ce667ed7409efa99.sourceText: 宋美龄始终保持冰肌玉肤，原因之一就是她坚持天天按摩。每天午睡前或晚上临睡前，两名护士轮流为她按摩。一般是从眼睛、脸部到胸部、腹部再到下肢、脚背、脚心。这样的全身按摩可以促进血液循环。
4a43e2bd2dc58d6888e71423ce667ed7409efa99.translatedText: Song Meiling has always maintained smooth skin and beautiful skin. One of the reasons is that she insists on getting massage every day. Two nurses take turns massaging her every day before nap or before going to bed at night. Generally from the eyes and face to the chest and abdomen to the lower limbs, insteps and soles of the feet. Such a full body massage can promote blood circulation.

cbb0e6582af67c423ca4148a20f236ffab42959e.sourceText: 抗衰老处方:穴位刺激，按摩首选
cbb0e6582af67c423ca4148a20f236ffab42959e.translatedText: Anti-aging prescription: acupoint stimulation, massage is the first choice

e5fba9501b52952410f243daa6c764e0b5f39d7f.sourceText: 提高免疫力：实验发现：按摩穴位，可以刺激血液中的白血球、淋巴球等免疫细胞有所增加，从而提高人体免疫力。
e5fba9501b52952410f243daa6c764e0b5f39d7f.translatedText: Improve immunity: Experiments have found that massaging acupoints can stimulate an increase in white blood cells, lymphocytes and other immune cells in the blood, thereby improving human immunity.

1134d75a0e9382a5afec676a6496c4248ae4c7a6.sourceText: 促进新陈代谢：氧分和营养成分对构成体内组织的细胞进行新陈代谢来说是必需的。进 行穴位按摩，能够促进血液循环，为体内各组织提供更充分的氧分 和营养成分，活跃新陈代谢。促进血液循环：通过按摩，各反射区的穴位能够调节人体机能，从而使不适症状消失，血液恢复正常循环。
1134d75a0e9382a5afec676a6496c4248ae4c7a6.translatedText: Boosts metabolism: Oxygen and nutrients are necessary for the metabolism of cells that make up tissues in the body. Acupoint massage can promote blood circulation, provide more adequate oxygen and nutrients to various tissues in the body, and activate metabolism. Promote blood circulation: Through massage, the acupuncture points in each reflection area can regulate human body functions, so that discomfort symptoms disappear and blood returns to normal circulation.

52bea8bb2a5326605958f2f1ce532bee5c16ac3b.sourceText: 每当有熟人来看她，并在她的面前夸奖她如何如何能干时，她便淡淡一笑，引用《圣经》上的话，回答说：”我要打的仗已经打过，要走的路已经走过，权、名、利已成硝烟散去，忘记这一切吧！”
52bea8bb2a5326605958f2f1ce532bee5c16ac3b.translatedText: Whenever an acquaintance came to see her and praised her in front of her on how capable she was, she would smile lightly, quote the words from the Bible, and reply: "I want to fight. The battle has been fought, the road to be walked has been traveled, power, fame, and wealth have disappeared. Forget it all! "

7db4aeaba9f8b89991a74be54e6a430f3ce08f42.sourceText: 抗衰老处方:信仰，精神避难所

29413377b95eef124a2065695a41b178bccc9895.sourceText: 信仰是一服良药。一个人的健康包括生理、心理方面，而这两者是互相关连的。身体的状况会影响心理情绪，情绪也会影响身体健康。信仰所带来的平安、喜乐、爱心、自尊、盼望，会影响到内分泌系统，最终影响身体的抗病能力和恢复速度。
29413377b95eef124a2065695a41b178bccc9895.translatedText: Faith is a good medicine. A person's health includes physical and psychological aspects, and the two are interrelated. Physical conditions will affect mental and emotional conditions, and emotions will also affect physical health. The peace, joy, love, self-esteem, and hope brought by faith will affect the endocrine system, ultimately affecting the body's disease resistance and recovery speed.

bb0601bb50865ae7a5f62d910bd624efee379085.sourceText: 有研究表明，信仰任何一种主流宗教的人，不论男女，其平均寿命比其他人要长，他们的免疫系统功能也比其他人的好。
bb0601bb50865ae7a5f62d910bd624efee379085.translatedText: Studies have shown that people of any mainstream religion, regardless of gender, live longer on average than others, and their immune systems also function better than others.

d6abb35c2402f6d8277b4b0edd91c079eedae427.sourceText: 宋美龄同普通人一样，有七情六欲，有喜怒哀乐。然而，她的身世、学识、情趣和文化背景决定着她有很高的自控能力。每当她碰到不愉快的事情，有个好习惯，就是找熟人聊天，说说心中的话，使淤积之气一扫而光。
d6abb35c2402f6d8277b4b0edd91c079eedae427.translatedText: Song Meiling, like ordinary people, has seven emotions and six desires, including joy, anger, sorrow and joy. However, her life experience, knowledge, taste and cultural background determine that she has a high ability of self-control. Whenever she encounters something unpleasant, she has a good habit of chatting with acquaintances and talking about what is on her mind, so that the accumulated energy can be swept away.

8f8c344b1f7843ddc8fb5ad0823b95f608a68428.sourceText: 抗衰老处方:心境平和，勿大喜大悲
8f8c344b1f7843ddc8fb5ad0823b95f608a68428.translatedText: Anti-aging prescription: Keep a peaceful mind, do not be overjoyed or sad

6edf1cf2f6e5c922d42ed44163992c9e75f17ea4.sourceText: ”看得开，放得下”，是一种大智慧，七情太过，不利健康。精神状态不佳，能使中枢 神经传导受阻，体内各器官系统生理功能失常，使呼吸、心率紊 乱，身体无力，神经功能失调，内分泌紊乱，加速衰老。胸怀坦荡，心情好，不为得失而悲喜，就会使人体气血调和，心情开朗，精神振奋，延年益寿。
6edf1cf2f6e5c922d42ed44163992c9e75f17ea4.translatedText: "See openly and let go" is a kind of great wisdom. Excessive emotions are bad for health. Poor mental state can block the conduction of the central nervous system, cause physiological dysfunction of various organ systems in the body, cause breathing and heart rate disorders, physical weakness, neurological dysfunction, endocrine disorders, and accelerate aging. Being open-minded, in a good mood, and not feeling sad or happy about gains and losses will harmonize the body's qi and blood, make you cheerful, energetic, and prolong life.

ef4584d2cf24ec58e52fdb39f7a58e1ae1269851.sourceText: 在台湾时期的宋美龄惟一的嗜好就是吸烟，蒋介石生前多次劝她戒烟，但都未戒成。蒋介石去世以后，她下定决心把吸了60多年的烟戒掉了。
ef4584d2cf24ec58e52fdb39f7a58e1ae1269851.translatedText: Song Meiling's only hobby in Taiwan was smoking. Chiang Kai-shek advised her to quit smoking many times before her death, but she failed to quit. After Chiang Kai-shek's death, she made up her mind to quit smoking after more than 60 years of smoking.

345d9f74a6a5d9ab43bfac0a964f0e915ac275da.sourceText: 抗衰老处方:戒除烟瘾，酒损容颜
345d9f74a6a5d9ab43bfac0a964f0e915ac275da.translatedText: Anti-aging prescription: Quit smoking, drinking alcohol will damage your appearance

1a593247a975cab8b810ce72c23deace1eda7477.sourceText: 吸烟无论对自己或身边的人都会造成伤害，香烟中的尼古丁会逐渐破坏呼吸系统，并引起其他慢性疾病，而且尼古丁还会使血管收缩，令皮肤不能吸收足够氧气，更生能力立即下降，容易出现皱纹，肤色也会变得枯黄。不可否认的是，戒烟的确在延长寿命方面显示出其效果。
1a593247a975cab8b810ce72c23deace1eda7477.translatedText: Smoking will cause harm to yourself or those around you. The nicotine in cigarettes will gradually damage the respiratory system and cause other chronic diseases. Nicotine will also constrict blood vessels, preventing the skin from absorbing enough oxygen. It is undeniable that quitting smoking does show its effects in extending life.

91272d23c8f3bdd309adfbcfc10a1d3a15994ba3.sourceText: 阅读书刊是宋美龄长年的习惯。她每天必翻阅纽约各大英文报纸。空闲时就画国画、写毛笔字。因为研习绘画必须精神集中，杂念尽除，心平气和，神意安稳，意力并施，使全身血气通畅，体内各部分机能都得到调整，大脑的神经系统获得平衡，有效地促进血液循环和新陈代谢。
91272d23c8f3bdd309adfbcfc10a1d3a15994ba3.translatedText: Reading books and periodicals has been Song Meiling's long-term habit. She reads major English newspapers in New York every day. In my free time, I draw Chinese paintings and write calligraphy. Because the study of painting requires concentration, elimination of distracting thoughts, calmness of mind, stability of mind, and simultaneous application of concentration and concentration, so that the blood and energy of the whole body can be smoothed, the functions of all parts of the body can be adjusted, the nervous system of the brain can be balanced, and blood circulation and metabolism can be effectively promoted.

54d8457f22e1878643a25eb26c554ce6647812ba.sourceText: 抗衰老处方:培养良好的个人爱好
54d8457f22e1878643a25eb26c554ce6647812ba.translatedText: Anti-aging prescription: Cultivate good personal hobbies

bd739e9d409bee933e434425872960ed603d6d02.sourceText: 琴棋书画是中国古人颇为赞许的兴趣爱好，养鱼喂鸟，种植花木也是有益身心健康的活动。
bd739e9d409bee933e434425872960ed603d6d02.translatedText: Piano, chess, calligraphy and painting are hobbies that were highly praised by the ancient Chinese. Raising fish, feeding birds, and planting flowers and trees are also activities that are beneficial to physical and mental health.

9f5e754f1e37072c6affc6f017309b7575fe174e.sourceText: 音乐是生活的”调味剂”，节奏鲜明的乐曲，可以激发人的精神与体力；有助于使人趋于安定。 特别推荐：做点可以一个人做的事情，如绘画、游泳、弹琴、远足、摄影等，这样当你一个人的时候，就会感觉很充实。另外，你的爱好越多，你对新朋友的吸引力也就越大。
9f5e754f1e37072c6affc6f017309b7575fe174e.translatedText: Music is the "flavor" of life. Music with a distinctive rhythm can stimulate people's spirit and physical strength; it helps to make people more stable. Special recommendation: Do something you can do alone, such as painting, swimming, playing the piano, hiking, photography, etc., so that you will feel fulfilled when you are alone. Plus, the more hobbies you have, the more attractive you will be to new people.

5160079257a51fa28a656f64d9c5f55b5a1d0937.translatedText: Go to bed late and get up late, have a regular schedule

cfd09612ebc1a048e06dcae0be48d708619b5955.sourceText: 宋美龄平时的作息很有规律。每日里作画、读书的时间一般不会超过2小时。晚上看一小会儿电视，或弹半小时钢琴。她一般晚上11点左右上床休息，第二天早上9点以后起床。
cfd09612ebc1a048e06dcae0be48d708619b5955.translatedText: Song Meiling's usual schedule is very regular. The time spent painting and reading generally does not exceed 2 hours a day. Watch TV for a little while in the evening, or play the piano for half an hour. She usually goes to bed around 11pm and gets up after 9am the next morning.

ba86ef8e2446284da962d6be2f08f2f8e2e941b2.sourceText: 抗衰老处方:睡眠充足，环境凉爽
ba86ef8e2446284da962d6be2f08f2f8e2e941b2.translatedText: Anti-aging prescription: Get enough sleep and a cool environment

4f458518786121b478f760878bca1ed7ccb1bd8d.sourceText: 睡眠要平衡，睡眠太长，会使机体功能呆滞，久而久之便可致病；睡眠太少，则会因精神耗竭，不能恢复而致痼疾。研究表明：每天晚上睡眠时间超过8个小时的人，死亡率较高。当然，每天睡眠时间少于4个小时，也有增加死亡概率的危险。所以每晚睡7~8小时的人最长寿。
4f458518786121b478f760878bca1ed7ccb1bd8d.translatedText: > Sleep should be balanced. Sleeping for too long will cause the body's functions to become sluggish, which can lead to illness over time; sleeping too little will lead to chronic illness due to mental exhaustion and inability to recover. Research shows that people who sleep more than 8 hours a night have a higher mortality rate. Of course, sleeping less than 4 hours a day also increases the risk of death. Therefore, people who sleep 7 to 8 hours a night live longest.

32a136f46711376f2e29330f9166930cf790a3ea.sourceText: 特别推荐：晚10点到早6点是最佳的睡眠时间，最晚不要超过11点，因为皮肤的新陈代谢会从11点开始，在1点到3点间达到高峰，因此这时的深度睡眠会给你的皮肤最完善的保养。（摘自加拿大《星星生活报》）
32a136f46711376f2e29330f9166930cf790a3ea.translatedText: Special recommendation: 10 pm to 6 am is the best time to sleep, and no later than 11 o'clock, because the skin's metabolism starts at 11 o'clock and reaches its peak between 1 o'clock and 3 o'clock, so deep sleep at this time will give your skin the most complete care. (Excerpted from Canada's "Star Life News")

0aa28a050603d7078ba40247eb6d6ff645e82cc7.translatedText: If there is humor, life will not be lonely

d5e2c80aa739da0aa7d852e20e0876d7c85bfc47.sourceText: 有幽默，生活就不寂寞 戴晨志 语言，是欢笑、幸福的起始点；语言，也是灾难、痛苦的引爆点！ 有一则故事说…
d5e2c80aa739da0aa7d852e20e0876d7c85bfc47.translatedText: If there is humor, life will not be lonely Dai Chenzhi Language is the starting point of laughter and happiness; language is also the tipping point of disaster and pain! There is a story saying...

1e5c8679f14c9b5f5b564d4a9f3129825977d809.sourceText: 有幽默，生活就不寂寞 戴晨志 语言，是欢笑、幸福的起始点；语言，也是灾难、痛苦的引爆点！ 有一则故事说道：有一对夫妻搭火车旅行，可是沿路上，太太一直嘀咕地讲话，一下子嫌火车开得太慢、一下子埋怨冷气太冷，或服务人员的态度不好厖而她的先生，虽是闭目养神，耳朵却不得闲，必 须忍受 太太的唠叨。 后来，先生有个机会，转了个头，礼貌地跟旁边的旅客打招呼；当别的旅客问到他们的职业时，先生回答说：「我是小公司老板，我太太则是有名的制造家！」 噢，制造家？是制造什么产品啊？」别的旅客好奇地问道。 先生一脸正经地说：「专门制造不愉快！」 人的生活，有的充满欢喜、快乐，有的则是充满悲苦、不愉快！ 当然，自己的心境很重要，可是，跟我们相处在一起的人，也很重要；如果自己的另一半、或工作伙伴，个性很严肃、不幽默、不风趣，也不浪漫，甚至常唠叨、嫌弃、埋怨，或是事事负面思考，那么生活就会像个「制造家」一样－－专门制造不愉快。 所以，牛顿曾说：「愉快的生活，是由愉快的思想造成的。」 而好莱坞知名影星布莱德彼特也说：「幽默感比性感更重要！」 为什么？因为一个大美女，如果只有美艳和性感，每天却冷漠、不笑，也不懂得幽默、轻松开玩笑，则不会受人欢迎！ 同样地，男人也不必讲究性感、一直秀着肌肉，而是要智慧风趣、有幽默感，才会可爱！ 最近，有个女学生考我说：「老师，考你一个脑筋急转弯－－什么事会让上面的人愉快，下面的人高兴？」 「啊？这厖这要我怎么回答？」我一时之间语塞，不知如何说起。 「老师你不会是不是？还是不好意思说？」女学生得意地说：「怎么会不好意思呢？答案就是－－『演唱会』嘛！」 「老师，再来，再考你一题！」女学生兴致勃勃地又问道：「什么事是刘先生和刘太太每天睡觉时都要做的事？」 「啊？这厖又要我说什么呢？」我又支吾了。 「老师，你不要害羞嘛！你仔细想，大声说没关系嘛！」女学生一直催促着我，可是，我还是不知如何回答。 「老师，这没什么不好意思说的嘛，睡觉时都要做的事，就是『闭上眼睛』啊！」女学生笑嘻嘻地说。 沟通小箴言 「幽默」是一种能量、也是一种浪漫，它能增加人与人之间的亲密度！所以，「有笑声，就没战争；有幽默，就不寂寞！」 现代社会，经济不景气，生活步调紧凑、忙乱，每个人的工作压力都很大；然而，人总是要学习用「幽默心、浪漫情」，来纾解自己的情绪压力，才会有快乐、豁达的人生！ 所谓「万法唯心，境随心转」，只要心中有爱、有幽默，人的嘴角就会往上扬，就会有欢笑和快乐。 因此，「四个Ｌ」是我们可以学习的方向，那就是－－「Love、Learn、Listen、Laugh」，也就是说，「只要心中有爱，也不断地学习成长，同时不断地倾听别人，则生活中就会充满欢笑！」 语言，是欢笑、幸福的起始点；语言，也可能是灾难、痛苦的引爆点！ 说话中，若带着关怀、肯定与幽默，就会充满「愉悦与品味」；言谈中，若带着抱怨、指责与嫉妒，就会充满「冲突与酸味」！
1e5c8679f14c9b5f5b564d4a9f3129825977d809.translatedText: With humor, life will not be lonely Dai Chenzhi Language is the starting point of laughter and happiness; language is also the tipping point of disaster and pain! There is a story: There was a couple traveling by train, but along the way, the wife kept mumbling, sometimes complaining that the train was moving too slowly, sometimes complaining that the air conditioner was too cold, or the service staff had a bad attitude. But her husband, although he closed his eyes to concentrate, his ears were not free, and he had to endure the wife's nagging. Later, when the husband had the opportunity, he turned around and greeted the passengers next to him politely. When other passengers asked about their occupations, the husband replied: "I am the owner of a small company, and my wife is a famous manufacturer!" Oh, manufacturer? What product are you manufacturing? "Other travelers asked curiously. The teacher said seriously: "Specialized in creating unhappiness!" Some people's lives are full of joy and joy, while others are full of sorrow and unhappiness! Of course, our own state of mind is very important, but the people we get along with are also very important. If our significant other or work partner has a very serious personality, is not humorous, not interesting, and is not romantic, and even often nags, dislikes, complains, or thinks negatively about everything, then life will be like a "manufacturer" - specializing in creating unhappiness. Therefore, Newton once said: "A happy life is caused by happy thoughts." And the famous Hollywood movie star Brad Pitt also said: "A sense of humor is more important than sexiness!" Why? Because if a beautiful woman is only beautiful and sexy, but is indifferent every day, does not smile, and does not know how to be humorous and easy to joke, she will not be popular! Similarly, men don’t have to be sexy and show off their muscles all the time, but they have to be smart, funny, and have a sense of humor to be cute! Recently, a female student asked me a question: "Teacher, I will give you a brain teaser - what will make the people above you happy and the people below you happy?" "Ah? How do you want me to answer this question?" I was speechless for a moment and didn't know how to start. "Teacher, you can't do it, are you? Or are you embarrassed to say it?" The female student said proudly: "How can you be embarrassed? The answer is -'concert'!" "Teacher, come again, let me test you again!" The female student asked enthusiastically: "What do Mr. Liu and Mrs. Liu do every day when they sleep?" "Ah? What does this guy want me to say?" I hesitated again. "Teacher, don't be shy! If you think about it carefully, it's okay to speak loudly!" The female student kept urging me, but I still didn't know how to answer. "Teacher, there's nothing embarrassing to say. What you have to do when you sleep is to 'close your eyes'!" the female student said with a smile. Communication Motto "Humor" is a kind of energy and romance. It can increase the intimacy between people! Therefore, "If there is laughter, there will be no war; if there is humor, there will be no loneliness!" In modern society, the economy is in recession, life is compact and hectic, and everyone is under great work pressure; however, people always need to learn to use "humor and romance" to relieve their emotional pressure, so that they can have a happy and open-minded life! As the saying goes, "Everything is based on the mind, and the environment changes with the mind." As long as there is love and humor in the heart, the corners of the person's mouth will turn upward, and there will be laughter and happiness. Therefore, the "Four Ls" are the directions we can learn from, that is - "Love, Learn, Listen, Laugh". In other words, "As long as there is love in your heart, you continue to learn and grow, and you continue to listen to others, your life will be full of laughter!" Language is the starting point of laughter and happiness; language can also be the tipping point of disaster and pain! If you speak with care, affirmation and humor, you will be full of "pleasure and taste"; if you speak with complaints, accusations and jealousy, you will be full of "conflict and sourness"!

a58378bfa0785f32333f7231c8fdc1d37b0dd529.sourceText: 《细说红楼》编者按： 红楼梦87版的电视剧歌曲音乐是著名作曲家王立平根据曹雪芹的《金陵十二钗》词，花了四年多时间写成的，其中《葬花吟》几乎花费了这位音乐家近两年的时间。其歌曲经过陈力这位音乐奇才的演绎，几乎成了歌迷心中的千古绝唱。 为了重现红楼歌曲的美妙，美国亚里桑那（Arizona）州的图桑(Tucson)华声合唱团和亚里桑那大学孔子学院共同筹办了2013 红楼梦乐曲中秋音乐会(9月20日 \9月21日举行)，届时，王立平和陈力都会出席音乐会，陈力还会担当合唱的主唱。这是红楼梦电视剧自87年播出后陈力第一次出山重演红楼歌曲。 鉴于海外的观众对红楼梦故事了解的不足，本栏特地邀请专家介绍和点评红楼故事和人物，也希望因此抛砖引玉，引起更多华人朋友的兴趣。
a58378bfa0785f32333f7231c8fdc1d37b0dd529.translatedText: "A Detailed Description of Red Mansions" Editor's Note: The song music of the 87 version of "Dream of Red Mansions" was written by the famous composer Wang Liping based on the lyrics of "The Twelve Hairpins of Jinling" by Cao Xueqin. It took more than four years to write, among which "The Song of the Burial Flowers" took the musician almost two years. Its songs, performed by Chen Li, a music wizard, have almost become eternal songs in the hearts of fans. In order to recreate the beauty of the Red Mansions songs, the Tucson Huasheng Chorus in Arizona and the Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona jointly organized the 2013 Mid-Autumn Festival Concert of Dreams of Red Mansions (held on September 20 and September 21). Wang Liping and Chen Li will attend the concert, and Chen Li will also serve as the lead singer of the chorus. This is the first time Chen Li has performed the song of Red Mansions since the TV series "Dream of Red Mansions" was aired in 1987. In view of the lack of understanding of the story of Dream of Red Mansions by overseas audiences, this column specially invites experts to introduce and comment on the story and characters of Red Mansions. We also hope that this will inspire more Chinese friends.

5bd81d0ec07c65cc46a6253ffb8fa600ad0a6040.sourceText: 图桑 慧明 又是哭哭啼啼的诗歌！读了《红楼梦》三十四回中黛玉的《题帕三绝》后，人们对这位林妹妹的哭吟已经有了一点适应。不喜欢诗词的朋友也许会赶快跳过，去寻找下面的情节了。 且慢，诸位。请看官暂且在这儿驻驻脚，体会一下此哭与他哭的不同。 这次哭诗的产生也是缘于宝玉。宝玉在女儿大院里闲来无事，总喜欢和女孩搭讪。不巧，这次和自己母亲（王夫人）的丫鬟金钏儿斗嘴调情，被王夫人听见了。天下的母亲模样不一，但护犊之心却是同样的。王夫人不说自己儿子的花心，反而指责金钏儿下作，导致金钏儿羞辱难辩，投井自杀。传言到贾政（宝玉的父亲）那里，就是儿子强奸丫鬟未遂的事了。早先，贾政听说儿子与戏子有往来，有同性恋之嫌，已经像吞了只苍蝇似的，现在又听说此等事，气必然不打一处来，便统统鞭打在这不肖之子的腿和屁股上了。 宝玉被打，除了贾母能指责贾政外，其他乖巧的诸如宝钗袭人之类的说点两面不得罪的话题，也红一下眼，喉咙里颤抖几下，便是安慰了。 唯独这林妹妹不同，在宝玉昏睡中不说一句话，却哭得”两个眼睛肿得桃儿一般” ”半天，方抽抽噎噎的道：你可都改了罢！”这句话王夫人、宝钗，袭人更无论贾母贾政都说不出的――说得出也无益于教的，而唯独只有黛玉才能说得那般地贴心，那么地刻骨铭心。这宝黛爱情还未曾挑明，林妹妹就能如此痴情，铁石做的男人也会动情，情种情圣的宝哥哥会不动心？送给黛玉几块半旧不新的帕子就是顺理成章的了。（那个非诚勿扰节目，女的一爆灯，男的都乖乖地感动了，都是一个理。） 旧时送块手绢给情哥情妹，已经是很稀罕的事了，其级别不会比今天送九十九朵玫瑰，或者在女生宿舍下狼嚎更低。在那个男女授受不亲的时代，这块绢子已经是很偷情和定情了。那唐宋时期流行的张生赶考，莺莺送他的就是手帕之类的旧物，无怪熟了《西厢记》的林妹妹一见了旧手绢便”不觉神痴心醉”。 我们都是俗人，总是不解这个宝玉送什么不好，不送珠玉也罢，送个手帕至少要是个新的吧。其实燕雀焉知鸿鹄之志呵，现时爱情流行的是喜新厌旧和奢侈，但古代时尚的是恪守传统和旧物，而且这丝织的帕子，横也是丝（思），竖也是丝（思），还有什么能比此物更相思的呢？ 无怪黛玉会”觉得浑身火热，面上作烧，走至镜台揭起锦袱一照，只见腮上通红，真合压倒桃花”—过来人都心知肚明，这爱情之火一旦燃起，便什么胆量和胸襟都有了。 看官请细读这段文字： ”宝玉能领会我这一番苦意又令我可喜。我这番苦意，不知将来可能如意不能，又令我可悲。要不是这个意思，忽然好好的送两块帕子来，竟又令我可笑了。再想到私相传递，又觉可惧。他既如此，我却每每烦恼伤心，反觉可愧。如此左思右想，一时五内沸然。由不得馀意缠绵，便命掌灯，也想不起嫌疑避讳等事，研墨蘸笔，便向那两块旧帕上写道—-” 这妹妹明知前面有可喜、可悲、可笑、可惧甚至可愧之事，可五脏六腑都沸腾燃烧了，非写点什么才对得起心中的爱情，您看，这哭诗还有悲的味道吗？说的大气点，有点爱情侠女什么都不在乎的气概；往小里说，像邻家的女孩爱上了隔壁的大哥，双亲都反对，女孩披头散发，顾不得涕泪纵横，抽噎断声：我就跟他了！ 仰慕、表白、求互动似乎是当今爱情的必由之路，但在那时也需要勇气，特别是弱女子。 附《题帕三绝》： 眼空蓄泪泪空垂，暗洒闲抛更向谁。 尺幅鲛绡劳解赠，叫人焉得不伤悲。 抛珠滚玉只偷潸，镇日无心镇日闲。 枕上袖边难拂拭，任他点点与斑斑。 彩线难收面上珠，湘江旧迹已模糊； 窗前亦有千竿竹，不识香痕渍也无？
5bd81d0ec07c65cc46a6253ffb8fa600ad0a6040.translatedText: Tusang Huiming Another weeping poem! After reading Daiyu's "Three Wonders of Inscription" in Chapter 34 of "Dream of Red Mansions", people have become somewhat accustomed to Sister Lin's cries. Friends who don't like poetry may skip it quickly and look for the plot below. Wait a minute, everyone. Please stop here for a moment and experience the difference between this cry and his. The emergence of this weeping poem is also due to Baoyu. Baoyu had nothing to do in his daughter's courtyard and always liked to chat with girls. Unfortunately, this time I was quarreling and flirting with my mother's (Mrs. Wang's) maid Jin Chuan'er, and she was overheard by Mrs. Wang. Mothers all over the world look different, but their desire to protect their calves is the same. Mrs. Wang did not talk about her son's philandering, but instead accused Jinchuan'er of being a deceiver, causing Jinchuan'er to be humiliated and unable to defend herself, and committed suicide by throwing herself into a well. Rumors reached Jia Zheng (Baoyu's father) that his son had attempted to rape a maid. Earlier, when Jia Zheng heard that his son was having contact with an actor and was suspected of homosexuality, he felt as if he had swallowed a fly. Now that he heard about this again, he was so angry that he whipped the unscrupulous son's legs and buttocks. When Baoyu was beaten, in addition to Jia's mother who could blame Jia Zheng, other well-behaved people, such as Baochai's attack on people, said something that was not offensive to both sides. Their eyes turned red and their throats trembled a few times, which was comfort. Only this sister Lin was different. She didn't say a word while Baoyu was sleeping, but she cried until her "eyes were swollen like peaches." After a long time, Fang choked and said: "You have changed it!" This sentence was something that neither Mrs. Wang, Baochai, Xiren, nor Jia Mu Jia Zheng could say - it would be useless to teach, and only Daiyu could say it so thoughtfully and unforgettable. The love between Bao and Dai has not yet been made clear. Sister Lin can be so infatuated, and a man made of iron and stone can be moved. How can the passionate brother Bao not be moved? It is only natural to give Daiyu a few old and stale handkerchiefs. (In the If You Are the One show, when a woman lights up, the men are moved obediently. This is all for the same reason.) In the old days, it was already a very rare thing to give a handkerchief to a lover's brother or sister, and its level would not be lower than today's giving of ninety-nine roses or howling like a wolf in the girls' dormitory. In that era when men and women were not close to each other, this piece of silk was already a symbol of secret love and love. It was popular in the Tang and Song Dynasties that when Zhang Sheng was rushing to take exams, Yingying gave him handkerchiefs and other old things. No wonder Sister Lin, who was familiar with "The Romance of the West Chamber", became "unconsciously infatuated" when she saw the old handkerchiefs. We are all common people, and we always wonder why it is not good to give this gem. It doesn’t matter if you don’t give it a pearl or jade, you should at least give it a new handkerchief. In fact, how can a sparrow know the ambition of a swan? The current trend in love is to love the new and hate the old and to be extravagant, but in ancient times, the fashion was to adhere to tradition and old things. Moreover, this silk handkerchief is made of silk (thinking) horizontally and silk (thinking) vertically. What else can be more lovesick than this thing? No wonder Daiyu would "feel hot all over her body and her face would be burning. She walked to the mirror and lifted up her brocade bag to take a photo, and saw that her cheeks were red, and the true match overwhelms the peach blossoms." Everyone who has been there knows well that once the fire of love is ignited, she will have all the courage and ambition. Readers, please read this passage carefully: "It makes me happy that Baoyu can understand my bitterness. I don't know whether my bitterness may not come true in the future, which makes me sad. If it hadn't been for this purpose, he suddenly sent two good handkerchiefs, which made me laughable again. Thinking about conveying them privately, it makes me laughable. I felt terrible. Since he was like this, I was always troubled and sad, and I felt ashamed. I couldn't help but feel lingering, so I held the lamp and couldn't think of anything like suspicion and avoidance. I dipped my ink and pen and wrote on the two old handkerchiefs - " This sister knows that there are things that are gratifying, sad, ridiculous, scary and even shameful, but her internal organs are boiling and burning. She has to write something to be worthy of the love in her heart. Look, does this weeping poem still have a sad taste? To put it more grandly, it has the air of a romantic heroine who doesn’t care about anything; to put it more simply, it’s like the girl next door falling in love with the eldest brother next door, both parents are against it, the girl has disheveled hair, tears streaming down her cheeks, and sobs: I’m going to follow him! Admiration, confession, and interaction seem to be the only way to love today, but at that time, courage was also required, especially for weak women. Attached is the "Three Wonders of Inscription on the Pa": The eyes are filled with tears, and the tears are empty, and I cast them to whomever I want. A piece of shark's wool is given away as a gift, which makes people feel sad. Tossing beads and rolling jade is just for stealing, and I have no intention of spending the day in leisure. It's hard to wipe off the sleeves on the pillow, leaving them speckled and stained. Colored threads are difficult to collect, and the old traces of the Xiangjiang River have been blurred; there are thousands of bamboo poles in front of the windows, and there are no traces or stains of fragrance?

9ba36c014ab43eb8b4245906f9dc05dbd2ede6fa.sourceText: 上海棗相关采访以及监管备案文件的查阅结果显示，中国一名高级监管者的亲属通过购买一家保险公司的股票而获得巨额利润，这家保险公司一度深陷困境，如今已成为中国最大的金融巨头之一。
9ba36c014ab43eb8b4245906f9dc05dbd2ede6fa.translatedText: Relatives of one of China's top regulators made huge profits by buying shares in a troubled insurance company that has become one of China's biggest financial giants, interviews with Shanghai Zao and a review of regulatory filings show.

be1c22df11ac1ee0e0b0e9c2670a965862304eeb.sourceText: 这位监管者名为戴相龙，在2002年时任中国的中央银行行长，并对保险行业有监管权。当时，他的亲属协助掌控的一家公司买进了平安保险公司的大量股份，数年后，这些股份的价值达到了数十亿美元。几年前逃脱破产厄运的平安公司当时正在招纳新的投资者，随后举行首次公开募股。
be1c22df11ac1ee0e0b0e9c2670a965862304eeb.translatedText: This regulator is named Dai Xianglong. He was the governor of the Central Bank of China in 2002 and had regulatory authority over the insurance industry. At that time, a company his relatives helped control bought a large stake in Ping An Insurance Company. A few years later, the value of these shares reached billions of dollars. Ping An, which escaped bankruptcy a few years ago, was recruiting new investors and subsequently holding an initial public offering.

ac018df5090a26f99aa2dd7a14163178b9b90c58.sourceText: 外界越来越关注中国政坛显贵家族积聚的财富，与此同时，戴相龙亲属的投资行为表明，财富已经从政治精英家族延伸到了一些监管者的家族，这些监管者掌握着中国商业和金融领域最重要的权柄。身为经济学家的戴相龙后来不再担任央行行长一职，现在管理着全球最大的投资基金之一，也就是规模高达1500亿美元（约合9348亿元人民币）的中国社会保障基金。
ac018df5090a26f99aa2dd7a14163178b9b90c58.translatedText: The outside world is increasingly paying attention to the wealth accumulated by prominent Chinese political families. At the same time, the investment behavior of Dai Xianglong's relatives shows that wealth has extended from the families of political elites to the families of some regulators, who hold the most important power in China's business and financial fields. Dai Xianglong, an economist, later stopped serving as central bank governor and now manages one of the world's largest investment funds, the US$150 billion (approximately 934.8 billion yuan) China Social Security Fund.

105da8364698cf6c0e77f7d654abbc258cea292a.sourceText: 尚不清楚他的亲属通过这笔交易获得了多少利润，但分析人士称，这笔交易使人们更加怀疑，中国资本市场是否得到了有效的监管。
105da8364698cf6c0e77f7d654abbc258cea292a.translatedText: It is not clear how much profit his relatives made from the deal, but analysts said the transaction raised doubts about whether China's capital markets were effectively regulated.

05c17f6090a9d2cfa0d00defc795319be763093f.sourceText: 密歇根大学法学院(University of Michigan Law School)中国证券法方面的专家郝山(Nicholas C. Howson)说：”这些交易本身并不违法，甚至也不能成为腐败的证据，但是它们助长了中国国内一种令人担忧的看法的蔓延，即中国最高层官员的家族拥有特权，能够获得尚未举行首次公开募股的资产。”说到中国的时候，他用的是中国的正式名称中华人民共和国的缩写PRC。
05c17f6090a9d2cfa0d00defc795319be763093f.translatedText: Nicholas C. Hao Shan (Nicholas C.), an expert on Chinese securities law at the University of Michigan Law School "These transactions are not themselves illegal or even evidence of corruption, but they contribute to the spread of a worrying perception within China that the families of China's most senior officials have privileged access to assets that have not yet held an IPO," said Howson, referring to China, using the abbreviation of the People's Republic of China, its official name.

52d406c2834154e0f10c579f536b203235dea0a5.sourceText: 监管备案文件显示，购买平安股份的那家公司由多家投资公司控制，包括戴相龙的女婿车峰创办的两家公司，以及其他一些同车峰的亲戚和业务伙伴相关的公司。
52d406c2834154e0f10c579f536b203235dea0a5.translatedText: Regulatory filings show that the company that purchased Ping An's shares is controlled by a number of investment companies, including two companies founded by Dai Xianglong's son-in-law Che Feng, as well as other companies related to Che Feng's relatives and business partners.

cf09238609fd341dcd0b4a05cfed882a70bbb96c.sourceText: 记录显示，购买平安股份的时候，这家名为鼎和创业投资有限公司的公司拿到了极其优惠的价格，每股的价格只相当于英国一家大银行短短两个月前买价的一小部分。2002年12月26日，鼎和花费5500万美元购买了平安的股份。到了2007年，这笔投资的价值最后一次得到公开披露的时候，这些股票已经价值31亿美元。
cf09238609fd341dcd0b4a05cfed882a70bbb96c.translatedText: Records show that when purchasing Ping An shares, the company called Dinghe Venture Capital Co., Ltd. received an extremely favorable price. The price per share was only a fraction of the purchase price of a major British bank just two months ago. On December 26, 2002, Dinghe spent US$55 million to purchase shares of Ping An. By 2007, the last time the value of the investment was publicly disclosed, the shares were worth $3.1 billion.

83594d28064c3289e53b6df14aa87f6f15f7616e.sourceText: 调查此事的过程当中，本报发现，没有迹象表明戴相龙知晓自己亲属的行为，也没有迹象表明交易当中存在任何违法行为。但是，看起来，这些亲属确实通过投资处于戴相龙监管之下的金融服务公司发了大财。
83594d28064c3289e53b6df14aa87f6f15f7616e.translatedText: During the investigation of this matter, this newspaper found that there was no sign that Dai Xianglong knew about his relatives' behavior, and there was no sign that there was any illegal behavior in the transaction. But it appears the relatives did make fortunes by investing in financial services companies under Mr. Tai's supervision.

bcb9d18a318acd8e4d6189e8447cd9ea44c8f17d.sourceText: 另一个相关事例则是，据海通证券在上海的招股章程显示，鼎和曾于2002年11月收购了该公司的大量股份。海通当时也处于戴相龙的监管权限之内。
bcb9d18a318acd8e4d6189e8447cd9ea44c8f17d.translatedText: Another relevant example is that according to the prospectus of Haitong Securities in Shanghai, Dinghe acquired a large number of shares in the company in November 2002. Haitong was also under Dai Xianglong’s supervisory authority at the time.

a6349be0dc1b3e889b4208fd7b372de8e05eb0df.sourceText: 公开的备案材料显示，到2007年，海通刚刚在上海上市的时候，鼎和所购股票的价值约为10亿美元。此后，戴相龙的妻子柯用珍曾在2007年到2010年之间担任海通监事会主席。
a6349be0dc1b3e889b4208fd7b372de8e05eb0df.translatedText: Public filing materials show that by 2007, when Haitong was first listed in Shanghai, the value of the shares purchased by Dinghe was approximately US$1 billion. Since then, Dai Xianglong’s wife Ke Yongzhen served as chairman of Haitong’s supervisory board from 2007 to 2010.

752d186c8a2f8221dc84b421d0fd6dc1d7744dee.sourceText: 戴相龙和全国社会保障基金(National Social Security Fund)的发言人没有回复要求置评的电话。代表戴相龙女婿车峰发言的一名女士则通过邮件否认车峰曾持有平安公司的股份。该女士称，买下平安股份的是另一名商人，此人又因融资困难而将股份转售给了另一些人，这些人当中包括车峰的亲友，但并不包括车峰本人。
752d186c8a2f8221dc84b421d0fd6dc1d7744dee.translatedText: Spokespeople for Dai Xianglong and the National Social Security Fund (National Social Security Fund) did not return calls seeking comment. A woman who spoke on behalf of Dai Xianglong's son-in-law, Che Feng, denied via email that Che Feng had ever held shares in Ping An. The woman said that another businessman bought Ping An's shares, and that person resold the shares to other people due to financing difficulties. These people included Che Feng's relatives and friends, but did not include Che Feng himself.

4d21e3c844d39d2d5b8dc9fef57f4f8ab538a884.sourceText: 前述商人”没钱打理他创立的产业，所以就一次性地卖出了全部股份”，这位名叫简妮 刘(Jenny Lau)的女士在一封邮件中说。
4d21e3c844d39d2d5b8dc9fef57f4f8ab538a884.translatedText: The aforementioned businessman “had no money to take care of the industry he created, so he sold all his shares at once,” the woman named Jenny Lau said in an email.

a741312d86ccc659d707c3bcd68f396f6f86f330.sourceText: 然而，本报查阅的公司记录显示，车峰与其亲属及长期商业伙伴一起组建了一个复杂的公司网络，使他和其他人有效地控制了鼎和创业投资公司，后者投资了平安和海通的证券。记录还显示，其中一家公司后来提名车峰为平安监事会监事，任期是2006年到2009年。
a741312d86ccc659d707c3bcd68f396f6f86f330.translatedText: However, company records reviewed by this newspaper show that Che Feng worked with relatives and long-term business partners to form a complex network of companies that gave him and others effective control of Dinghe Venture Capital, which invested in securities of Ping An and Haitong. Records also show that one of the companies later nominated Che Feng to be a supervisor on Ping An's board of supervisors, serving from 2006 to 2009.

d4ed4bae9c09923a29166ff080c93dde3cbe4fcd.sourceText: 上月，本报曾经报道 ，2002年，在鼎和公司购买平安股票的同一天，另一家投资公司也以不同寻常的低价购买了平安的股份。这家公司就是天津泰鸿公司 ，后在温家宝担任主管中国金融机构的副总理期间由其亲属部分控制。2007年末，泰鸿公司所购平安股票的价值为37亿美元。
d4ed4bae9c09923a29166ff080c93dde3cbe4fcd.translatedText: Last month, this newspaper reported that in 2002, on the same day that Dinghe Company purchased Ping An's shares, another investment company also purchased Ping An's shares at an unusually low price. This company was Tianjin Taihong Company, which was later partially controlled by Wen Jiabao's relatives when he was vice premier in charge of China's financial institutions. At the end of 2007, the value of Taihong's shares in Ping An was US$3.7 billion.

ac884c933930ac32136532b5b6a93e7f83d5808c.sourceText: 鼎和和泰鸿的投资活动意味深长，部分是因为到2002年末，北京的监管者已经对平安公司法外开恩，允许该公司无须按规定出售部分业务。20世纪90年代末期，平安一直在抵制要求分业经营的法规，因为平安高管担心，业务剥离会导致公司破产。
ac884c933930ac32136532b5b6a93e7f83d5808c.translatedText: > The investment activities of Dinghe and Taihong are significant, in part because by late 2002, regulators in Beijing had given Ping An extrajudicial favor, allowing the company to sell off parts of its business without being required to do so. In the late 1990s, Ping An had been resisting regulations requiring separate operations because Ping An executives worried that divesting businesses would lead to the company's bankruptcy.

d3b9e8b9e7859ffe5f521825298c7c9fa1785e25.sourceText: 还不清楚温家宝或者戴相龙是否为平安出面干预过此事，但2002年4月，该公司获得了重组和保留证券及信托业务的许可。两年后，平安首次在香港公开发售股票。2007年，平安再度在上海上市之后，公司的股价急剧飙升。现在，平安已经跻身全世界最大金融机构的行列，公司价值估计为650亿美元。
d3b9e8b9e7859ffe5f521825298c7c9fa1785e25.translatedText: It is unclear whether Wen Jiabao or Dai Xianglong intervened on behalf of Ping An, but in April 2002, the company obtained permission to reorganize and retain its securities and trust businesses. Two years later, Ping An launched its first public offering of shares in Hong Kong. In 2007, after Ping An was listed in Shanghai again, the company's stock price soared. Today, Ping An ranks among the world's largest financial institutions, with a company value estimated at $65 billion.

1efc73e730dbc6d370569c8e7f451a60d3850f67.sourceText: 在监管机构决定豁免平安之前，平安的高管及投行股东曾对包括戴相龙在内的监管者进行大力游说。
1efc73e730dbc6d370569c8e7f451a60d3850f67.translatedText: Before the regulators decided to exempt Ping An, Ping An’s executives and investment bank shareholders had vigorously lobbied regulators, including Dai Xianglong.

4e94f68e0701f413f667c341095540807c3ee8d8.sourceText: 本报查阅了一些写给戴相龙的信件复印件。其中一封来自平安董事长马明哲，他在信中请求戴相龙批准平安于1998年在海外上市，强调说，”如此庞大的资金，在国内筹集将相当困难”。
4e94f68e0701f413f667c341095540807c3ee8d8.translatedText: This newspaper reviewed some copies of letters written to Dai Xianglong. One of the letters came from Ma Mingzhe, chairman of Ping An. In the letter, he asked Dai Xianglong to approve Ping An's overseas listing in 1998, emphasizing that "it will be very difficult to raise such a huge amount of funds domestically."

2fa45eebc14317a4bc1f67f0daf672cb4e12e212.sourceText: 监管备案文件显示，购买平安股份的时候，由戴相龙的亲戚部分控制的鼎和公司拿到了极其优惠的价格。公开备案文件以及一家官方报纸的报道显示，2002年12月，鼎和从国有运输巨头中国远洋运输（集团）总公司（简称”中远”）手中购买了约6650万股平安股票，拆股之后算下来每股价格0.4美元。与温家宝亲戚有关的泰鸿公司也是以这个价格购买了平安股份。
2fa45eebc14317a4bc1f67f0daf672cb4e12e212.translatedText: Regulatory filing documents show that when purchasing Ping An shares, Dinghe Company, which is partially controlled by Dai Xianglong’s relatives, received an extremely favorable price. Public filings and reports in a state newspaper show that in December 2002, Dinghe purchased about 66.5 million shares of Ping An from state-owned shipping giant China Ocean Shipping (Group) Corporation (COSCO), at a price of $0.40 per share after the stock split. Taihong Company, which is related to Wen Jiabao's relatives, also purchased Ping An shares at this price.

dfbdecb6ddd89a05162d669721c60035821a637b.sourceText: 这个价格远远低于英国汇丰银行(HSBC)于同年10月购买平安10％股权的价格。以今天的汇率计算，汇丰支付的价格为每股1.6美元。
dfbdecb6ddd89a05162d669721c60035821a637b.translatedText: This price is far lower than the price at which HSBC purchased 10% of Ping An's shares in October of the same year. At today's exchange rates, HSBC paid $1.60 per share.

fabf7584cb6b1439ec37e0df0c00fcaedf8e31ad.sourceText: 还不清楚中远为什么会以如此低的折扣出售平安股份。中远没有回复要求置评的电话。平安的一名女发言人也没有回电话。
fabf7584cb6b1439ec37e0df0c00fcaedf8e31ad.translatedText: It is unclear why COSCO sold Ping An shares at such a low discount. Cosco did not return calls seeking comment. A Ping An spokeswoman also did not return calls.

6f688ca6cb9c733775bf1637b3a8e581958d260b.sourceText: 戴相龙现年68岁，长期担任政府监管人员及国有企业高管。他曾在中国农业银行(Agricultural Bank of China)、中国太平洋保险(China Pacific Insurance)以及于上世纪90年代初在交通银行(Bank of Communications)担任高级职务。当时隶属于该行的海通证券即在他的管辖权限之内。
6f688ca6cb9c733775bf1637b3a8e581958d260b.translatedText: Dai Xianglong is 68 years old and has long served as a government regulator and a senior executive of a state-owned enterprise. He has held senior positions at the Agricultural Bank of China, China Pacific Insurance and, in the early 1990s, the Bank of Communications. Haitong Securities, which was affiliated with the bank at the time, was within his jurisdiction.

8080755f0a5a02e9f0e7693333741d01e7adaf21.sourceText: 1995年，他被任命为中国的中央银行的行长，这是这个国家金融领域最有权力的职位之一。2002年12月，他卸职转任天津市市长。接下来，他于2008年就任全国社会保障基金理事会(National Council for Social Security Fund)理事长。在职业生涯的大部分时间里，他与中国的一些高层领导建立了紧密的关系，其中就包括温家宝，他俩都曾在权力巨大的中央金融工作委员会(Central Financial Work Commission)任职。该委员会负责管辖中国的银行、证券和保险监管机构，以及中国的大型金融机构。
8080755f0a5a02e9f0e7693333741d01e7adaf21.translatedText: In 1995, he was appointed governor of China's central bank, one of the most powerful positions in the country's financial sector. In December 2002, he resigned and became mayor of Tianjin. Next, he became chairman of the National Council for Social Security Fund in 2008. For much of his career, he has developed close relationships with some of China's top leaders, including Wen Jiabao, both of whom served on the powerful Central Financial Work Commission. The committee oversees China's banking, securities and insurance regulators, as well as China's large financial institutions.

67fbfc9c90800824e59b13c3fbbfec83847c87c6.sourceText: 大型金融服务公司也寻求戴相龙的帮助，目的是在中国的严格监管环境当中谋求发展。举例来说，本报查阅的相关记录以及对马明哲一名前助理的采访显示，长期担任平安董事长的马明哲的电话簿中就列有戴相龙以及他的妻子和女婿的名字。
67fbfc9c90800824e59b13c3fbbfec83847c87c6.translatedText: Large financial services companies have also sought Dai's help as they seek to grow amid China's strict regulatory environment. For example, relevant records reviewed by this newspaper and an interview with a former assistant of Ma Mingzhe showed that the name of Dai Xianglong, his wife and son-in-law were listed in the phone book of Ma Mingzhe, the long-time chairman of Ping An.

fe3ba287465ab89b7c967b7766d95852415dd4d0.sourceText: 除此之外，一度担任平安驻北京代表处主任的李春彦上个月在一次电话采访中说，他曾安排马明哲与戴相龙的亲属包括他的女婿车峰见面。
fe3ba287465ab89b7c967b7766d95852415dd4d0.translatedText: In addition, Li Chunyan, who once served as director of Ping An’s representative office in Beijing, said in a telephone interview last month that he had arranged for Ma Mingzhe to meet with Dai Xianglong’s relatives, including his son-in-law Che Feng.

23a3577355367dde7919d8b0bcc4886a9be265a6.sourceText: ”不能说我是介绍人，我只不过是带他们过去见面而已，”他说道，但拒绝透露具体细节。”我只是一个小人物，你知道的。”他又补充道，”我与戴相龙行长的家人都挺熟的。”
23a3577355367dde7919d8b0bcc4886a9be265a6.translatedText: "You can't say that I am the introducer, I just take them there to meet," he said, but refused to disclose specific details. "I'm just a small person, you know." He added, "I'm quite familiar with President Dai Xianglong's family."

8756efa0dfd2f57c45a233548a23ee33263321cf.sourceText: 之后，在全国社会保障基金理事会，戴相龙开始监管一笔巨大的资金，这一基金曾投资过海通和平安股份。今年9月，这家政府控制的社会保险基金宣布它将投资36亿美元给16家私募股权基金，其中包括新天域资本 (New Horizon Capital)，这家公司的创始人包括温家宝总理的独子温云松。
8756efa0dfd2f57c45a233548a23ee33263321cf.translatedText: Later, at the National Council for Social Security Fund, Dai Xianglong began to supervise a huge fund, which had invested in shares of Haitong and Ping An. In September, the government-controlled social insurance fund announced it would invest $3.6 billion in 16 private equity funds, including New Horizon Capital, whose founders include Wen Yunsong, the only son of Premier Wen Jiabao.

33d84b3ffacd299b8852336a027d4e3797326e45.sourceText: 大学生车祸脑死 医生放弃治疗前奇迹苏醒 一名因严重车祸而被诊断为脑死的大学生，原本将成为器官捐赠者。不料，他在医生考虑拔除其生命辅助器材数小时前奇迹般苏醒，为家人带来了一份最好的圣诞礼物。 21岁的山姆施密德在ASU主修贸易。今年10月19日，他在一场五车连环车祸中，头部严重受伤。由于伤势过重，当地医院无法为施密德进行治疗，必须将他空运到凤凰城圣若瑟医疗中心的巴罗神经学研究所，由专科医生为他进行极具生命危险的动脉瘤手术。 由于施密德在手术后仍然昏迷不醒，医务人员开始为他进行临终关怀护理，并与其家人商量器官捐献事宜。然而，就在此时，施密德却开始回应医生的指令，甚至能举起手指。如今，他能依靠学步器材走动，说话速度虽慢但也已有所改善。施密德的母亲说：”我告诉所有人，如果要称之为现代的奇迹，这就是一个奇迹。” 施密德的主治医生斯佩茨也同意这是个奇迹，并表示，施密德极可能完全康复，他甚至希望能在圣诞节请假回家和家人一起欢度节日。
33d84b3ffacd299b8852336a027d4e3797326e45.translatedText: College student brain-dead in car accident miraculously revives before doctors give up treatment A college student who was diagnosed as brain-dead due to a serious car accident was originally going to be an organ donor. Unexpectedly, he miraculously revived hours before doctors considered removing his life-support equipment, bringing the best Christmas gift to his family. Sam Schmid, 21, is majoring in trade at ASU.今年10月19日，他在一场五车连环车祸中，头部严重受伤。 Due to the severity of his injuries, local hospitals were unable to treat Schmid, and he had to be airlifted to the Barrow Neurological Institute at St. Joseph's Medical Center in Phoenix, where specialists performed life-threatening aneurysm surgery. Because Schmid remained unconscious after the surgery, medical staff began providing him with hospice care and discussing organ donation with his family. However, at this moment, Schmid began to respond to the doctor's instructions and even raised his finger. Today, he can walk around with the help of a walking device, and his speaking speed, although slow, has improved. Schmid's mother said: "I tell everyone that if you want to call it a modern miracle, this is a miracle." Schmid's doctor Speight also agreed that this is a miracle and said that Schmid is very likely to make a full recovery. He even hopes to take leave at Christmas to go home and celebrate the holidays with his family.

69f84bace7b4aa3915abfb494fa771043ceefacf.sourceText: 犯罪嫌疑人阿瑟 道格拉斯 哈蒙

b10bbae9c4f07c5f2f5fabf14e8e7106ec975c48.translatedText: By depressing the dollar, we can make America great again, only for fear of many disadvantages

cc8cd53b4b892619e4dc4c989ccc169ce8c237b5.translatedText: By depressing the dollar, we can make America great again, only for fear of many disadvantages [Compiled by Juheng.com, Guo Zhaoqing] According to MarketWatch analyst report...

5b243722dd721e335c45471dcbaf984fa3d4dd43.sourceText: 根据 MarketWatch 分析报导，没有那个美国政治人物希望美国人生活越来越差，也不会刻意采取不利于一般美国投资人的行动。
5b243722dd721e335c45471dcbaf984fa3d4dd43.translatedText: According to MarketWatch Analysts report that no American politician wants Americans' lives to get worse and worse, nor will they deliberately take actions that are detrimental to ordinary American investors.

625f60e8e213d4d49dc4329b0b46a260afbaf044.sourceText: 然而，压低美元的政策 — 尽管出于善意，长期而言，却可能让美国投资人吃足苦头。
625f60e8e213d4d49dc4329b0b46a260afbaf044.translatedText: However, the policy of pushing down the dollar - although well-intentioned - may prove painful for U.S. investors in the long run.

dfc36dbf09622dcdb373dee9a583c73500d80b22.sourceText: 短期而言，美元疲弱有利美国出口，提振美国经济，让美国再次伟大。
dfc36dbf09622dcdb373dee9a583c73500d80b22.translatedText: In the short term, a weak dollar will benefit U.S. exports, boost the U.S. economy, and make America great again.

b7e6bc175345aba9347557fb7664f89be46a9900.sourceText: 但长期而言，美元贬值对美国投资人可能弊端重重：
b7e6bc175345aba9347557fb7664f89be46a9900.translatedText: However, in the long term, the depreciation of the US dollar may have many disadvantages for American investors:

8be089b792b52903f2c591c626123fd6148708ee.sourceText: 1. 美元一直是世界的储备货币，这让美国得以采取有利的财政与货币政策，造福美国投资人。而美元贬值可能危及美元的储备货币地位。
8be089b792b52903f2c591c626123fd6148708ee.translatedText: 1. The US dollar has always been the world's reserve currency, which allows the United States to adopt favorable fiscal and monetary policies to benefit American investors. A depreciation of the U.S. dollar could jeopardize the U.S. dollar’s ​​reserve currency status.

9199cf793c456e385336bcaabbe89dd7fb75f487.sourceText: 2. 当美国政府主动压低美元价值，谁还希望持有美元？当其他国家开始怀疑持有美元的价值时，美元的储备货币地位，便将受到负面冲击。
9199cf793c456e385336bcaabbe89dd7fb75f487.translatedText: 2. When the U.S. government actively lowers the value of the U.S. dollar, who still wants to hold U.S. dollars? When other countries begin to doubt the value of holding U.S. dollars, the U.S. dollar's reserve currency status will be negatively impacted.

b9f0f9f6ee0ce3df9495a126acb81895787fbcdc.sourceText: 3. 美国是高负债国家。大部份的公债系由外国人提供资金。当美元下跌，外国人为何还要购买美国债券？
b9f0f9f6ee0ce3df9495a126acb81895787fbcdc.translatedText: 3. The United States is a highly indebted country. Most public debt is financed by foreigners. Why do foreigners buy U.S. bonds when the dollar falls?

562767c8cc00440810fd00501f9a3d0cc700e181.sourceText: 4. 当外国人购买美国债券的需求消退，利率便会上升。
562767c8cc00440810fd00501f9a3d0cc700e181.translatedText: 4. When foreigners’ demand for U.S. bonds subsides, interest rates will rise.

44c4147f45b964e96cfa89fd1f4c9196dbf2804a.sourceText: 5. 美国是主要进口国。当美元疲弱，进口商品成本便会上升，这将导致通货膨胀上升。
44c4147f45b964e96cfa89fd1f4c9196dbf2804a.translatedText: 5. The United States is the main importing country. When the dollar weakens, the cost of imported goods rises, which leads to higher inflation.

b365da4d372603139c0d82725a7173cd2fce1cec.sourceText: 6. 通货膨胀快速上升，对股市将极为不利。
b365da4d372603139c0d82725a7173cd2fce1cec.translatedText: 6. Rapidly rising inflation will be extremely detrimental to the stock market.

5f033159c978be6c98c4dc223aaf48a4e2f835e2.sourceText: 7. 为了控制快速上升的通货膨胀，联準会 (Fed) 将调高利率。
5f033159c978be6c98c4dc223aaf48a4e2f835e2.translatedText: 7. To control rapidly rising inflation, the Federal Reserve (Fed) will raise interest rates.

445c507be8b2efe70fdd19dc87052f8f7894d246.sourceText: 8. 利率快速上升，对股市将属利空。
445c507be8b2efe70fdd19dc87052f8f7894d246.translatedText: 8. Rapid rise in interest rates will be negative for the stock market.

3c488571cf6f1a134301188761c892ff9047d6b5.sourceText: 9. 外国人目前买进大量美国股票，若美元下跌，外国人购买美国股票的理由将消退，这绝非股市所乐见。
3c488571cf6f1a134301188761c892ff9047d6b5.translatedText: 9. Foreigners are currently buying a large number of U.S. stocks. If the dollar falls, the reasons for foreigners to buy U.S. stocks will disappear, which is not what the stock market is happy to see.

fa5dda75f9575561a85fd6030ae08c2a212fcdee.sourceText: 机场安检牢骚多 当心挑你严查！ 不喜歡聯邦運輸安全局(TSA)機場檢查員的安檢程序嗎？排隊等待檢查時，最好不要抱怨太多，因為TSA目前在大約175個機場派有約3000名穿制服的 「行為偵測官」(behavior detection officer)，根據旅客行為和態度，挑出「高危險乘客」加以嚴查，藉以及早發現罪犯或恐怖分子。 但是，美國公民自由聯盟(ACLU)表示，觀察「指標」不應包括表達意見，即使「傲慢表達不滿機場安檢，也是憲法第一修正案保障的權利」。 CNN15日報導，它取得TSA的一份清單，列有約70項應注意的「行為指標」，藉以在全國機場找出「高危險乘客」。「傲慢抱怨機場安檢」是指標之一，如再與其他行為指標一起研判，很可能使該乘客受到額外安檢。 許多「指標」已在早先公開的政府報告中提到，像是神情緊張、心存恐懼、存心欺騙等。TSA官員一再表示，沒有任何一項指標有宗教或族裔含意。 但是，曾任聯邦調查局(FBI)探員的美國公民自由聯盟法律顧問吉爾曼表示，TSA的指標清單不應納入與「表達意見」有關的行為。他說：「即使是傲慢藐視機場安檢，也是憲法第一修正案保障的權利。我們都有權發表意見，尤其是政府要求有權搜查你的時候。」 某些專家指出，真正的恐怖分子可能會避免與當局對抗，凱達組織的訓練手冊要成員與社會打成一片。
fa5dda75f9575561a85fd6030ae08c2a212fcdee.translatedText: There are many complaints about airport security. Be careful to pick you out for strict inspection! Don't like the security screening process with federal Transportation Security Administration (TSA) airport screeners? When waiting in line for inspection, it's best not to complain too much, because TSA currently has about 3,000 uniformed "behavior detection officers" at about 175 airports. Based on the behavior and attitude of passengers, "high-risk passengers" are selected for strict investigation, so as to detect criminals or terrorists early. However, the American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) said that observing "indicators" should not include expressing opinions, even if "the arrogant expression of dissatisfaction with airport security is a right guaranteed by the First Amendment to the Constitution." CNN reported on the 15th that it had obtained a list from the TSA, which included about 70 "behavioral indicators" that should be paid attention to in order to identify "high-risk passengers" at airports across the country. "Arrogantly complaining about airport security" is one of the indicators. If combined with other behavioral indicators, it is likely that the passenger will be subject to additional security checks. Many "indicators" have been mentioned in earlier public government reports, such as nervousness, fear, intention to deceive, etc. TSA officials have repeatedly said that none of the indicators have religious or ethnic implications. However, Gilman, a legal counsel for the American Civil Liberties Union and a former FBI agent, said the TSA's list of indicators should not include behavior related to "expressing opinions." "Even the arrogance of flouting airport security is a right guaranteed by the First Amendment," he said. "We all have the right to express our opinions, especially when the government demands the right to search you." Some experts point out that real terrorists may avoid confrontation with authorities, and Al Qaeda's training manual urges members to blend in with society.

d76ae21d87f3a390d01b50f085058745c273eaad.sourceText: 共和党全国大会28日正式提名罗姆尼为总统候选人
d76ae21d87f3a390d01b50f085058745c273eaad.translatedText: The Republican National Convention formally nominated Romney as the presidential candidate on the 28th

1dd21a9598d729b1dba6a29afd71514fbce3a2a4.sourceText: 在佛州坦帕举行的共和党全国代表大会28日正式提名罗姆尼与瑞恩为总统与副总统候选人。
1dd21a9598d729b1dba6a29afd71514fbce3a2a4.translatedText: The Republican National Convention held in Tampa, Florida, on the 28th formally nominated Romney and Ryan as the presidential and vice presidential candidates.

fb2bd1084964092e030849d539dbf8003747d25e.sourceText: 因受飓风艾萨克影响而缩短了首日议程的共和党全国代表大会，28日下午2时起展开了第二天的议程，正式提名罗姆尼(Mitt Romney)与瑞恩(Paul Ryan)为共和党总统与副总统候选人。罗姆尼的被提名结束了冗长的初选程序，也正式开启了与奥巴马总统角逐白宫大位的拉锯选战。
fb2bd1084964092e030849d539dbf8003747d25e.translatedText: The Republican National Convention, which had its first day shortened due to the impact of Hurricane Isaac, started its second day at 2 pm on the 28th, officially nominating Mitt Romney and Paul Ryan as the Republican presidential and vice presidential candidates. Romney's nomination ended the lengthy primary process and officially opened the tug-of-war for the White House with President Obama.

88e36ec1ba368e887a22c751317e4ddd482ff6ba.sourceText: 罗姆尼定于30日晚发表接受党内提名的演说。
88e36ec1ba368e887a22c751317e4ddd482ff6ba.translatedText: Romney is scheduled to deliver a speech accepting the party's nomination on the evening of the 30th.

7a0f854f3ec594cecabbddb7bdba631084dd9a64.sourceText: 在艰辛和昂贵的初选中，罗姆尼被提名早在5月就已是笃定的事，28日下午党代表进行口头表决，到5时40分，在罗姆尼获得新泽西州的50张党代表票后，得票超过了提名门槛的1144票，正式成为共和党总统候选人。
7a0f854f3ec594cecabbddb7bdba631084dd9a64.translatedText: In the arduous and expensive primary election, Romney's nomination was already a certainty as early as May. Party representatives held a verbal vote on the afternoon of the 28th. By 5:40, after Romney received 50 party delegate votes from New Jersey, he received 1,144 votes, exceeding the nomination threshold, and officially became the Republican presidential candidate.

d60eb6b22d1481314ef86d3a447f7c260ddbfe42.sourceText: 在口头表决中，每当罗姆尼的名字被念出时，党代表就大声欢呼，罗姆尼最后获得2061张党代表票，其他202张党代表票则分属其他的参选人。
d60eb6b22d1481314ef86d3a447f7c260ddbfe42.translatedText: In the oral vote, party representatives cheered loudly every time Romney's name was read out. Romney finally won 2,061 party delegate votes, and the other 202 party delegate votes belonged to other candidates.

63c75ae0750261b9ddd1dbea1b83e8c0aed85ce4.sourceText: 共和党初选的参选人中，除了德州国会众议员保罗外，其他人都已表示支持罗姆尼，保罗的支持票不够使他进入提名表决，但他仍获得190张党代表票，前宾州国会参议员桑托伦获得9票，前犹他州长洪博培、国会众议员巴克曼和前路易斯安纳州长罗默各获得一票。
63c75ae0750261b9ddd1dbea1b83e8c0aed85ce4.translatedText: Among the candidates in the Republican primary, except for Texas Congressman Paul, everyone else has expressed support for Romney. Paul's support votes were not enough for him to enter the nomination vote, but he still received 190 party delegate votes. Former Pennsylvania Congress Senator Santorum received 9 votes. Former Utah Governor Huntsman, Congressman Buckman and former Louisiana Governor Romer each received one vote.

87cfe98f881b74af7a90ebe921d03e0f487db0e6.sourceText: 全代会28日稍后也表决通过瑞恩为共和党副总统候选人。在共和党全代会敲定罗姆尼的提名时，他在大会会场对面的旅馆中看电视对表决的转播，罗姆尼当晚在妻子安发表演说时，前往会场聆听。
87cfe98f881b74af7a90ebe921d03e0f487db0e6.translatedText: Later on the 28th, the National Congress also voted to approve Ryan as the Republican vice presidential candidate. When the Republican National Convention finalized Romney's nomination, he watched the TV broadcast of the vote in a hotel across from the convention venue. Romney went to the venue to listen when his wife Ann gave a speech that night.

ade962f809ef1d4c5519ad4cd9c31ad284d67e53.sourceText: 罗姆尼个人受欢迎度创下了近30年来最低点
ade962f809ef1d4c5519ad4cd9c31ad284d67e53.translatedText: Romney's personal popularity has hit its lowest point in the past 30 years

01c76d4cadcebd63ad47014cb3ea4656fce9bf94.sourceText: 美国广播公司称，最新的民调显示，共和党总统提名人罗姆尼的个人受欢迎度在主要政党提名史上创下了近30年来最低点 。美国广播公司/《华盛顿邮报》所作的民调称，一半受访者对罗姆尼没有好感，只有40%对罗姆尼抱有好感。到目前为止，没有一个候选人凭借如此低的支持率而赢得大选。相比之下，55%受访者对奥巴马抱有好感，47%对奥巴马消极看待。
01c76d4cadcebd63ad47014cb3ea4656fce9bf94.translatedText: ABC said that the latest polls show that Republican presidential nominee Romney's personal popularity has hit its lowest point in the past 30 years in the history of major party nominations. An ABC/Washington Post poll said that half of the respondents had an unfavorable opinion of Romney, while only 40% had a favorable opinion of Romney. So far, no candidate has won an election with such low approval ratings. In contrast, 55% of respondents have a favorable opinion of Obama, while 47% view him negatively.

cef7fab051a5e97c9a5f967b43e0827959fac5a0.sourceText: 不受民调结果的影响，参加坦帕全国共和党大会的代表心情依旧很乐观。来自新泽西的代表麦克接受采访时称，”你怎么可能不为大会感到兴奋呢。””4年前，我在明尼苏达州，从来没有见过像今年这样热情的场面。” 但是为了赢得会场以外选民的心，共和党利用大会召开首日的晚间黄金时间段向他们重新介绍罗姆尼，将罗姆尼描绘成家庭价值观和经济改革的倡导者。罗姆尼的妻子安和新泽西州长克里斯蒂两个性格截然迥异的人物成为大会主旨演讲人，两人希望通过自己的发言为罗姆尼赢得党内忠实选民和摇摆独立选民的支持。 1年来，妻子安一直为罗姆尼的竞选活动造势，在这次全国大会上，她试图淡化罗姆尼的严肃形象，将罗姆尼形容为一个爱孩子的好父亲，爱妻子的好丈夫。当提到自己身患乳腺癌，全家感到忧虑时，安说道”在我所读过的故事书中，看不到这样的情景：在冬天一个漫长的下午，屋外下着雨，屋内的5个孩子齐声痛哭。’
cef7fab051a5e97c9a5f967b43e0827959fac5a0.translatedText: Regardless of the poll results, delegates attending the National Republican Convention in Tampa remained optimistic. Representative Mike from New Jersey said in an interview, "How could you not be excited about the convention." "I was in Minnesota four years ago and I have never seen such a passionate scene as this year." But in order to win the hearts of voters outside the venue, the Republican Party used the evening prime time on the first day of the convention to reintroduce Romney to them, portraying Romney as an advocate of family values ​​and economic reform.罗姆尼的妻子安和新泽西州长克里斯蒂两个性格截然迥异的人物成为大会主旨演讲人，两人希望通过自己的发言为罗姆尼赢得党内忠实选民和摇摆独立选民的支持。 Over the past year, his wife Ann has been building momentum for Romney's campaign. At this national convention, she tried to downplay Romney's serious image, describing Romney as a good father who loves his children and a good husband who loves his wife. When she mentioned that she was suffering from breast cancer and her whole family was worried, Ann said, "In the story books I have read, I have never seen such a scene: on a long winter afternoon, it was raining outside, and the five children in the house were crying in unison."
