98507b54e6e717c2cc913ddad56bbadcc51b1019.sourceText: 慧明：山寨如来 如来在中国可以说是家喻户晓，虽然他不算是正宗的中国精神领袖，但他的博大精深，被历代百姓自觉传送。乃至今天，有事领导说了不算，还要拜一下佛主如来，才真正的心安理得。经过辰恩老儿西游记的添油加醋，如来呼风唤雨，指哪镇哪的功夫更是了得非凡，几乎人间没有解决不了的事，再多的悟空猴儿耍棍都没用。这就让人们不那么稀罕猴儿，特别是那些高人们就幻想着做如来了。那弥勒佛手下的黄眉童儿就是因崇拜佛主而生邪念的一位。 童儿的幻想是有来由的。因为家世非凡人，又常在弥勒佛身边，接触的都是天朝人物，见识多，便感觉自己就是日后的谁谁了。其二呢，个子高。别看天朝文武百官，横列两边，但像模像样的不多，许多充其量不过是官帽高耸，撑高了伟岸罢了。可黄眉童儿却不一般，不但身材高人一等，而且面目不可憎，特别随着弥勒佛，特别来眼缘，像人间小马哥那样，一下无来由地倾倒了无数矮官和女性崇拜者。其三，会模仿高人言行。常在佛主边，哪会不念经，哪怕变个佛主模样也不在话下。 这不，弃了老道孔孟祖宗不要，偏要寻找西学的唐僧师徒几人就正好遇到这黄眉小儿。知道唐僧求经致富心切，黄眉小儿就在西天之路变化出小雷音寺，自己便慈眉善目地装起如来佛主来了。 历经千辛万苦的唐僧见得祥云缭绕，又听得还有钟罄鼓乐回旋，仔细辨认还有点佛曲红歌的味道，便认定西天极乐世界已到，一头钻了进去，见像即拜，不分真假。如人间的百姓见了广场变草地了便以为上苍恩如甘露了，赞不绝口一样。 但唐僧们哪曾晓得，那黄眉小儿是厌倦了天上的小秘地位，乘弥勒佛不备，下凡到人间过一把佛瘾呢。 但佛岂是凡夫俗子可以做的！佛无论在天还是入人间，心面如一，永远慈悲为怀。而那些天上的星宿呢，别看天上像个人样，掉到地上则都是一个妖样。天蓬元帅够威风吧，掉到地上就是头猪。和人世间发配的封疆大臣一样，黄眉小儿掉下来便淫相、贪相和凶相毕露，不是到高老庄寻欢作乐，就是拿着天上的狼牙棒打黑，最后连唐僧带猴儿都被装进妖袋，还欺骗百姓说自己是黄眉老佛。 如来可以容忍芸芸众生无为，但决不许人间妖魔摇旗呐喊，鼓噪造反，独立山头，称王还称佛。即便你有仙家骨血，也会熙熙如来，吹捧天朝，吾佛还是不容你！于是顷刻之间，魔力全被消了去，黄眉还是黄眉，但老佛褪回了小儿，再也没了做山寨如来的念。 所幸，天人还是不如一，真佛还是慈悲，护了自家仙界。否则，那猴儿出来一顿乱棍，那山寨的早作一堆血肉了。
98507b54e6e717c2cc913ddad56bbadcc51b1019.translatedText: Huiming: Copycat Tathagata Tathagata can be said to be a household name in China. Although he is not an authentic Chinese spiritual leader, his profoundness has been consciously passed down by people of all ages. Even today, when something happens, no matter what the leader says, he still has to pay homage to the Buddha Tathagata to truly feel at ease. After Chen En's journey to the west, the Tathagata's ability to call the wind and rain, and point out where to suppress is even more extraordinary. There is almost nothing in the world that cannot be solved. No matter how many Wukong monkeys play with sticks, it will be useless. This makes people less curious about monkeys, especially those high-ranking people who dream of becoming Tathagata. The yellow-browed boy under Maitreya Buddha was one who had evil thoughts because of his worship of the Lord Buddha. Children's fantasies have a reason. Because my family was an extraordinary person, I was often around Maitreya Buddha, and I was in contact with people from the Celestial Dynasty. I had a lot of experience, so I felt like I would be someone in the future. Secondly, he is tall. Regardless of the hundreds of civil and military officials of the Celestial Dynasty, they are lined up on both sides, but not many of them are decent. Many of them are just official hats with high official hats, which only heighten the stature. But the yellow-browed boy was extraordinary. Not only was he superior in stature, but he also had an abominable face. He was especially attracted by Maitreya Buddha and had an eye-catching appearance. He was like a little horseman in the human world, attracting countless low-ranking officials and female admirers for no reason. Third, they will imitate the words and deeds of experts. How can I not recite sutras when I am always next to the Buddha, even if I change into the Buddha? No, Tang Seng and his disciples, who had given up their old ways and wanted to learn Western learning, happened to meet this yellow-browed boy. Knowing that Tang Monk was eager to seek scriptures and become rich, Huang Meixiaoer transformed himself into Xiaoleiyin Temple on the Road to the West, and pretended to be the Tathagata Buddha himself with a kind look on his face. After going through a lot of hardships, Tang Monk saw the auspicious clouds lingering, heard the bells and drums whirling, and carefully identified the smell of Buddhist songs and red songs, so he concluded that the Western Paradise had arrived, so he dove in and worshiped the statue as soon as he saw it, regardless of whether it was true or false. Just like the people in the world, when they see the square turned into grass, they think that God's grace is like nectar, and they are full of praise. But the Tang monks never knew that the yellow-browed boy was tired of his little secret position in heaven, so he took Maitreya unprepared and came down to earth to live a Buddhist experience. But Buddha is something that ordinary people can do! Whether the Buddha is in heaven or in the human world, his heart and face are the same and he is always compassionate. As for the stars in the sky, even though they look like humans in the sky, they look like monsters when they fall to the ground. Marshal Tianpeng is so majestic, but he looks like a pig when he falls to the ground. Just like the ministers assigned to the frontiers in the human world, the yellow-browed child showed his lustful, greedy and vicious features when he fell. He either went to Gao Laozhuang to have fun, or used the mace in the sky to beat black people. In the end, even Tang Monk and the monkey were put into the demon bag, and he deceived the people that he was the yellow-browed old Buddha. The Tathagata can tolerate the inaction of all sentient beings, but it will never allow the demons in the world to wave flags and shout, clamor for rebellion, become independent on the mountain, and call themselves kings and Buddhas. Even if you have the flesh and blood of the immortal family, and you are a bustling Tathagata, and you are praising the heaven, I, the Buddha, still won’t tolerate you!于是顷刻之间，魔力全被消了去，黄眉还是黄眉，但老佛褪回了小儿，再也没了做山寨如来的念。 Fortunately, heaven and man are still not as good as one, and the true Buddha is still compassionate and protects his own fairyland. Otherwise, if the monkey came out and gave them a beating, the villagers would have become a pile of flesh and blood.

b546324f69f558198adcff3ee9f94da27a5494a5.sourceText: 第一次秘密和谈毛泽东提出?#21644;为贵?BR> 上世纪50年代中期，中共中央的台湾政策发生了重大变化，由过去的单纯靠武力解决的方针改变为立足武力伺机彻底解决和力争和平解放相结合的政策。 1955年5月，周恩来总理在全国人大常委会上明确提出：”中国人民愿意在可能的条件下，争取用和平的方式解放台湾。”毛泽东主席也表示，我们跟台湾要”和为贵”， 爱国一家。 这些变化对国共对峙的政治格局产生了深刻的影响，1949年参加过北平和谈的南京政府代表团代表章士钊向周恩来主动请缨去香港，找他滞留在香港的国民党旧故，去向蒋介石做工作 ，争取实现国共谈判。 毛泽东和周恩来同意了章士钊的请求。 为此，中共中央专门给蒋介石写了一封信，交章士钊带到香港，通过关系转交给蒋介石。 在信中，中共中央主张国共谈判，实现第三次国共合作，并提出了两岸统一的四条具体办法：第一，除外交由中央统管外，台湾的人事安排，军政大权，由蒋介石管理; 第二，如台湾经济建设资金不足，中央政府可以拨款补助;第三，台湾社会改革从缓，有待条件成熟，亦尊重蒋介石意见和台湾各界人民代表进行协商;第四，国共双方要保证不 做破坏对方之事，以利两党重新合作。 信中结尾说”奉化之墓庐依然，溪口之花草无恙”，希望蒋介石能回故乡看看。 1956年春，章士钊带着中共中央给蒋介石的信，来到香港会见了国民党驻香港负责文宣工作、主持《香港时报》的许孝炎先生。 许孝炎随即从香港飞往台北，亲手将中共中央的信交给蒋介石，并将他与章士钊的会谈情况向蒋作了报告。 经过一年的认真考虑之后，1957年初蒋介石决定派宋宜山到北京一行，了解中共的真实意图。 宋是蒋的学生，曾任国民党中央候补委员，对蒋介石来说比较可靠。 1957年4月，宋宜山经香港、广州，乘火车抵北京。 在周恩来的安排下，中共中央统战部部长李维汉出面与宋宜山商谈，李维汉提出了中共关于合作的四项具体条件：(1)两党可以通过对等谈判，实现和平统一;(2)台湾可以 作为中央政府统辖下的自治区，享有高度自治;(3)台湾地区的政权仍归蒋介石领导，中共不派人​​士参与，而国民党可派人到北京参加中央政权的领导;(4)美国军事力量撤离 台湾海峡。 宋宜山回到香港后，写了一篇1万多字的报告交给蒋介石。 由于报告对大陆的成就颇多赞扬之词，蒋介石大为不悦。 再加上大陆此时已开始了反右斗争，蒋介石认为国共谈判的时机并不成熟，从而中止了进一步接触。
b546324f69f558198adcff3ee9f94da27a5494a5.translatedText: In the first secret peace talks, Mao Zedong proposed? In May 1955, Premier Zhou Enlai clearly stated at the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress: "The Chinese people are willing to strive to liberate Taiwan by peaceful means under possible conditions." Chairman Mao Zedong also said that we and Taiwan want "peace is most important" and we are patriotic. These changes had a profound impact on the political pattern of the confrontation between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party. In 1949, Zhang Shizhao, a representative of the Nanjing government delegation who participated in the Peking Peace Talks, took the initiative to invite Zhou Enlai to go to Hong Kong to find his old friends of the Kuomintang who were stranded in Hong Kong, and to work with Chiang Kai-shek and strive to realize the negotiations between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party. Mao Zedong and Zhou Enlai agreed to Zhang Shizhao's request. To this end, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China wrote a letter to Chiang Kai-shek and gave it to Zhang Shizhao to take to Hong Kong and pass it on to Chiang Kai-shek through connections. In the letter, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China advocated negotiations between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party to realize the third Kuomintang-Communist cooperation, and proposed four specific methods for cross-strait reunification: First, in addition to the central government's control of diplomacy, Taiwan's personnel arrangements, military and political power will be managed by Chiang Kai-shek; second, if Taiwan's economic construction funds are insufficient, the central government can allocate subsidies; third, Taiwan's social reform will be slowed down until conditions are mature, and Chiang Kai-shek's opinions will be respected and representatives of people from all walks of life in Taiwan will be consulted; fourth, both the Kuomintang and the Communist Party must ensure that they do not Do things to undermine the other party in order to facilitate the two parties to cooperate again. The letter ended by saying, "The tombs and huts in Fenghua are still there, and the flowers and plants in Xikou are intact." He hoped that Chiang Kai-shek could return to his hometown to visit. In the spring of 1956, Zhang Shizhao came to Hong Kong with a letter from the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China to Chiang Kai-shek and met with Mr. Xu Xiaoyan, who was in charge of the KMT's propaganda work in Hong Kong and chaired the "Hong Kong Times". Xu Xiaoyan immediately flew from Hong Kong to Taipei, personally handed the letter from the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China to Chiang Kai-shek, and reported to Chiang Kai-shek the status of his talks with Zhang Shizhao. After a year of careful consideration, Chiang Kai-shek decided to send Song Yishan to Beijing in early 1957 to understand the true intentions of the CCP. Song was a student of Chiang Kai-shek and had served as an alternate member of the Kuomintang Central Committee. He was relatively reliable to Chiang Kai-shek. In April 1957, Song Yishan traveled through Hong Kong and Guangzhou and arrived in Beijing by train. Under Zhou Enlai's arrangement, Li Weihan, Minister of the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee, came forward to discuss with Song Yishan. Li Weihan proposed four specific conditions for cooperation by the CCP: (1) The two parties can achieve peaceful reunification through reciprocal negotiations; (2) Taiwan can As an autonomous region under the central government, it enjoys a high degree of autonomy; (3) the power in Taiwan is still under the leadership of Chiang Kai-shek, and the CCP will not send people to participate, while the Kuomintang can send people to Beijing to participate in the leadership of the central government; (4) US military forces withdraw from the Taiwan Strait. After Song Yishan returned to Hong Kong, he wrote a report of more than 10,000 words and gave it to Chiang Kai-shek. 由于报告对大陆的成就颇多赞扬之词，蒋介石大为不悦。 In addition, the anti-rightist struggle on the mainland had already begun at this time. Chiang Kai-shek believed that the time for negotiations between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party was not ripe, so he suspended further contacts.

a3645b7959da8583162a73eeb9e3e032251a7c16.sourceText: 第二次秘密和谈 曹聚仁代蒋为母扫墓 1956年7月，当章士钊为国共和谈穿针引线的时候，另一个神秘人物也担负着同样使命从香港来到北京，这个神秘人物就是曹聚仁。 曹聚仁是旧中国颇负盛名的文人，与国共两党的高层人物有很深的交情。 曹聚仁回到大陆，周恩来在颐和园宴请了他。 10月3日，毛泽东在中南海接见了曹聚仁。 在谈到蒋介石的时候，毛泽东肯定了蒋介石在某些历史时期的作用，并表示了他准备再次与蒋介石握手的想法。 回港后，曹聚仁立即将详细情况转告国民党方面。 1957年5月，根据台湾方面的指令，曹聚仁第二次返回大陆，并代表蒋氏父子到蒋母的墓园扫墓。 回港后，曹聚仁立即向蒋经国通报了大陆之行的情况，并寄去了他在溪口拍摄的照片。 在另一封信中，他还谈了自己对国共两党再次合作的看法。 不过，国民党方面对再次谈判采取了一种既不让曹聚仁放弃，又不具体表态的态度，一拖就是几年。 1965年，当国民党二号人物李宗仁回到大陆并受到热烈欢迎的时候，蒋介石父子也展开了行动。 经常来往于香港和台北负责联络工作的王君通知曹聚仁，蒋经国在近期将亲临香港，接他到台湾商量要事。 曹聚仁急忙飞往北京，与中共领导人商讨了谈判的大纲要目，然后返回香港，等候蒋经国。 一天，王君来到曹聚仁住处让他上船与蒋经国先生密谈。 蒋经国让曹聚仁更多地介绍了北京的情况，希望曹聚仁将双方情况吃透，以便曹与蒋介石见面谈话时做到时间短，效率高。 不久，轮船抵台，蒋介石在官邸由蒋经国陪同，接见了曹聚仁，并在极秘密状态下开始谈话。 整个谈话自始至终只有他们三个人。 经过几次讨论，很快达成六项共识，其主要内容为： 一、蒋介石携旧部回到大陆，可以定居在浙江省以外的任何一个省区，仍任国民党总裁。 北京建议拨出江西庐山地区为蒋介石居住与办公的汤沐邑(意即台湾最高长官在中国大陆的起居与办公之地)。 二、蒋经国任台湾省长。 台湾除交出外交与军事外，北京只坚持农业方面必须耕者有其田，其他政务，完全由台湾省政府全权处理，以20年为期，期满再洽商。 三、台湾不得接受美国任何援助。 财政上有困难，由北京按美国支援数额照拨补助。 四、台湾海空军并入北京控制。 陆军缩编为4个师，其中一个师驻厦门和金门地区，三个师驻台湾。 五、厦门和金门合并为一个自由市，作为北京与台北之间的缓冲与联络地区。 该市市长由驻军师长兼任。 此师长由台北征求北京同意后任命，其资格应为陆军中将，政治上为北京所接受。 六、台湾现任官员官阶和待遇照旧不变。 人民生活保证只可提高，不准降低。 之后，曹聚仁立即返港，将谈判情况及六项条件报告给了中国共产党。 然而，1966年大陆发生了文化大革命，这一风浪也波及台湾，蒋介石对国共重开谈判产生了疑虑，从而改变了主意，国共两党重开谈判之事又一次搁浅。
a3645b7959da8583162a73eeb9e3e032251a7c16.translatedText: The second secret peace talks, Cao Juren visited the grave of Chiang Kai-shek's mother. In July 1956, when Zhang Shizhao was leading the way for the peace talks between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party, another mysterious figure also came to Beijing from Hong Kong with the same mission. This mysterious figure was Cao Juren. Cao Juren was a well-known scholar in old China and had deep friendships with senior figures in the Kuomintang and the Communist Party. Cao Juren returned to the mainland, and Zhou Enlai hosted a banquet for him in the Summer Palace. On October 3, Mao Zedong met with Cao Juren in Zhongnanhai. When talking about Chiang Kai-shek, Mao Zedong affirmed Chiang Kai-shek's role in certain historical periods and expressed his readiness to shake hands with Chiang Kai-shek again. After returning to Hong Kong, Cao Juren immediately informed the Kuomintang of the details. In May 1957, according to Taiwan's instructions, Cao Juren returned to the mainland for the second time and visited Chiang's mother's grave on behalf of the Chiang family and his son. After returning to Hong Kong, Cao Juren immediately informed Chiang Ching-kuo about his trip to the mainland and sent the photos he took at Xikou. In another letter, he also expressed his views on the cooperation between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party again. However, the Kuomintang adopted an attitude toward re-negotiation that neither allowed Cao Juren to give up nor expressed a specific position, and delayed it for several years. In 1965, when Li Zongren, the second-ranking figure of the Kuomintang, returned to the mainland and was warmly welcomed, Chiang Kai-shek and his son also took action. Wang Jun, who often traveled between Hong Kong and Taipei for liaison work, informed Cao Juren that Chiang Ching-kuo would visit Hong Kong in person in the near future and take him to Taiwan to discuss important matters. Cao Juren hurriedly flew to Beijing, discussed the outline of the negotiations with the leaders of the Communist Party of China, and then returned to Hong Kong to wait for Chiang Ching-kuo. One day, Wang Jun came to Cao Juren's residence and asked him to get on the boat to have a secret talk with Mr. Jiang Jingguo. Chiang Ching-kuo asked Cao Juren to introduce more about the situation in Beijing, hoping that Cao Juren would have a thorough understanding of the situation on both sides so that the meeting and conversation between Cao and Chiang Kai-shek could be short and efficient. Soon, the ship arrived in Taiwan. Chiang Kai-shek, accompanied by Chiang Ching-kuo, met Cao Juren at his official residence and started talking in extreme secrecy. The whole conversation was between the three of them. After several discussions, six consensuses were quickly reached, the main contents of which are: 1. Chiang Kai-shek can return to the mainland with his old troops and settle in any province other than Zhejiang Province and still serve as the president of the Kuomintang. Beijing proposed to allocate the Lushan area in Jiangxi Province to Tangmuyi where Chiang Kai-shek lived and worked (meaning the living and working place of Taiwan's top executive in mainland China). 2. Chiang Ching-kuo was appointed governor of Taiwan. In addition to handing over Taiwan's diplomacy and military affairs, Beijing only insists that in agriculture there must be land for every farmer. Other government affairs will be completely handled by the Taiwan Provincial Government for a period of 20 years, and negotiations will be held at the end of the period. 3. Taiwan shall not accept any assistance from the United States. If there are financial difficulties, Beijing will allocate subsidies according to the amount of US support. 4. Taiwan’s navy and air force were merged into Beijing’s control. The Army was reduced to four divisions, one of which was stationed in Xiamen and Kinmen, and three divisions were stationed in Taiwan. 5. Xiamen and Kinmen will be merged into a free city to serve as a buffer and liaison area between Beijing and Taipei. The mayor of the city is concurrently served by the garrison division commander. This division commander is appointed by Taipei with the consent of Beijing. His qualifications should be Army Lieutenant General and politically acceptable to Beijing. 6. The ranks and remuneration of current Taiwanese officials remain unchanged. People's livelihood security can only be improved, not lowered. Afterwards, Cao Juren immediately returned to Hong Kong and reported the negotiation status and the six conditions to the Communist Party of China. However, the Cultural Revolution broke out in mainland China in 1966, which also affected Taiwan. Chiang Kai-shek had doubts about the resumption of negotiations between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party, so he changed his mind. The resumption of negotiations between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party was once again shelved.

37c70846c0147cded6a474e257661861317bd946.sourceText: 第三次秘密和谈 陈立夫邀毛泽东访台 上世纪70年代初，国民党代表被赶出联合国，中美上海”联合公报”的发表，中日关系的改善，这些重大事件使台湾的处境急转直下，形势对大陆十分有利。 因此，毛泽东和周恩来又把和平解决台湾的问题提到了议事日程上。 国共两党重开谈判，仍然需要一个在两方面都说得上话的人居中联络。 由于曹聚仁已于1972年病逝，这方面的人选一下子成了空白。 于是，90岁高龄的章士钊再度请缨赴港与国民党方面联络。 周恩来得知章士钊的想法，感到十分为难。 因为章士钊几年前从病床上摔下来造成骨折，一直行动不便，只能靠轮椅代步。 如此情况，怎能做长途旅行呢?于是，周恩来便向毛泽东汇报了此事。 毛泽东反复权衡，认为章士钊的作用​​是其他人无法替代的，于是提出：”如果准备得好一点，是不是可以去呢?比如说派个专机去。”最后，在征得章士钊家属同意后，中共 中央决定派章士钊到香港。 经过周密安排，1973年5月，章士钊从北京乘专机启程赴港，周恩来亲自到机场为他送行。 章士钊到香港后不到一个月，因频繁的活动，过度的兴奋及对香港气候的不适，加之年事已高，7月1日不幸病逝于香港。 章士钊虽然出师未捷身先死，但他在香港的活动却产生了很大的影响。 由于中国共产党多次发出和谈建议和邀请，也出于对台湾的前途的考虑，蒋介石又动了与中共重开谈判的念头。 1975年春节期间，蒋介石将这一使命交给了抗战前曾主持过国共两党秘密谈判的国民党元老陈立夫。 陈立夫接受任务后，即通过秘密渠道向中共中央发出邀请毛泽东到台湾访问的信息。 也许是蒋介石知道自己时日无多，也许是陈立夫心情迫切，在中国共产党还没有回音的情况下，陈立夫便写了”假如我是毛泽东”一文，在香港报纸上公开发表。 他在文章中殷切欢迎毛泽东或周恩来到台湾访问，与蒋介石重开谈判之路，以造福国家和人民。 他特别希望毛泽东能不计前嫌，效仿北伐和抗日时期国共合作的先例，握手一笑，开创再次合作的新局面。 然而，国共两党当年的主要领导人都没有能够看到国共再次合作局面的出现。 蒋介石在此之后不久，于1975年4月去世。 一年半之后，毛泽东也与世长辞。
37c70846c0147cded6a474e257661861317bd946.translatedText: The Third Secret Peace Talks: Chen Lifu invited Mao Zedong to visit Taiwan. In the early 1970s, the Kuomintang representatives were expelled from the United Nations, the issuance of the Sino-US "Joint Communiqué" in Shanghai, and the improvement of Sino-Japanese relations. These major events caused Taiwan's situation to take a turn for the worse, and the situation was very favorable to the mainland. Therefore, Mao Zedong and Zhou Enlai put the peaceful settlement of the Taiwan issue on their agenda. When the Kuomintang and the Communist Party resume negotiations, they still need someone who can speak on both sides to liaise. Since Cao Juren died of illness in 1972, there was suddenly no candidate in this field. Therefore, the 90-year-old Zhang Shizhao once again asked Ying to go to Hong Kong to contact the Kuomintang. Zhou Enlai felt very embarrassed when he learned of Zhang Shizhao's thoughts. Because Zhang Shizhao fell off a hospital bed a few years ago and suffered a fracture, he has been unable to move and can only rely on a wheelchair. How could we travel long distances under such circumstances? So Zhou Enlai reported the matter to Mao Zedong. Mao Zedong repeatedly weighed the situation and believed that Zhang Shizhao's role could not be replaced by others, so he proposed: "If we were better prepared, could we go? For example, send a special plane to go." Finally, with the consent of Zhang Shizhao's family, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China decided to send Zhang Shizhao to Hong Kong. After careful arrangements, in May 1973, Zhang Shizhao took a special plane from Beijing to Hong Kong. Zhou Enlai personally went to the airport to see him off. Less than a month after Zhang Shizhao arrived in Hong Kong, he unfortunately died of illness in Hong Kong on July 1 due to frequent activities, excessive excitement, discomfort with the Hong Kong climate, and his advanced age. Although Zhang Shizhao died before leaving the army, his activities in Hong Kong had a great impact. Because the Chinese Communist Party had repeatedly issued peace talks proposals and invitations, and out of concern for Taiwan's future, Chiang Kai-shek had the idea of ​​re-opening negotiations with the Chinese Communist Party. During the Spring Festival of 1975, Chiang Kai-shek handed over this mission to Chen Lifu, a veteran of the Kuomintang who had presided over secret negotiations between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party before the Anti-Japanese War. After Chen Lifu accepted the mission, he sent a message to the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China inviting Mao Zedong to visit Taiwan through secret channels. Perhaps Chiang Kai-shek knew that his time was running out, or perhaps Chen Lifu was in an urgent mood. When the Chinese Communist Party had not yet responded, Chen Lifu wrote the article "If I Were Mao Zedong" and published it in a Hong Kong newspaper. In the article, he warmly welcomed Mao Zedong or Zhou En to visit Taiwan and reopen the path of negotiation with Chiang Kai-shek to benefit the country and the people. He especially hoped that Mao Zedong could ignore the past grudges, follow the precedent of the Kuomintang and the Communist Party cooperation during the Northern Expedition and the Anti-Japanese War, shake hands and smile, and create a new situation for cooperation again. However, the main leaders of the two parties at that time were unable to see the emergence of cooperation between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party again. Chiang Kai-shek died in April 1975 shortly thereafter. A year and a half later, Mao Zedong also passed away.

2c16bf7f0129eb85f950c7c5739711bb0adabcd5.translatedText: Illegal gun trade, the Attorney General and Republican lawmakers are at odds

0b914d1534f24180fa115660212c3530c642c194.translatedText: Illegal gun trade, the Attorney General is at odds with Republican lawmakers. Attorney General Holder clashed with congressional Republicans last Thursday over a failed investigation into Arizona's illegal gun trade...

ef2bb2f09e1f6821b1d83e118e8052a16e430914.sourceText: 非法枪支交易 司法部长与共和党议员对掐 联邦司法部长霍尔德上周四就一场失败的关于亚利桑那非法枪支交易的调查与国会共和党人发生了冲突。 当天参加众议院司法委员会听证的议员问霍尔德，在2011年初一项所谓”gun-walking”的策略被公开前，他知道些什么。作为”速度与激情行动” 的一部分，联邦探员被要求放弃立即逮捕一些嫌疑分子，相反试图通过对这些人的监视，顺藤摸瓜地挖出枪支走私集团中的大人物。根据司法部的 政策，这种策略通常被禁止使用。 在”速度与激情行动”中，数百从边境向南流入墨西哥的枪支不知去向，最后却出现在一些犯罪现场，其中有两支失踪的武器在边境巡警特里被杀害的现场找到。 霍尔德对司法委员会说，他与公众同时知道这项”gun-walking”策略，而且他”在大约同样的时间”获悉，出现在特里死亡现场的武器源自”速度与激情行动”。 在近几个月中，霍尔德关于他对这次失败的武器非法交易调查的处理与伊萨等共和党议员发生了多次对峙。霍尔德说，司法部已完全配合国会的调查，并把有关该行动的7600页的材料送交了国会。 ”我不想听到有关这7600页的话，”伊萨 说。他是负责调查该行动的众院监管与政府改革委员会的主席。他指出，”速度与激情”中监听装置显示，司法部许多关键人物对”gun-walking”策略负责。 霍尔德不同意伊萨的结论，说：”我不认为在华盛顿的任何人知道这些策略。”
ef2bb2f09e1f6821b1d83e118e8052a16e430914.translatedText: Illegal gun trade, the Attorney General was at odds with Republican lawmakers. Attorney General Holder clashed with congressional Republicans last Thursday over a failed investigation into Arizona's illegal gun trade. Lawmakers attending a House Judiciary Committee hearing that day asked Holder what he knew about a so-called "gun-walking" tactic before it became public in early 2011. As part of "Operation Fast and Furious," federal agents were asked to forego immediate arrests of some suspects and instead try to surveil them in an effort to uncover the biggest names in gun-trafficking rings. This tactic is generally prohibited under Department of Justice policy. In "Operation Fast and Furious," hundreds of guns that flowed south from the border into Mexico ended up at crime scenes, including two missing weapons found at the scene where Border Patrol Agent Terry was killed. Holder told the Judiciary Committee that he knew about the gun-walking tactic at the same time as the public and that he learned "at about the same time" that the weapons at the scene of Terry's death originated from Operation Fast and Furious. In recent months, Holder has been involved in multiple confrontations with Republican lawmakers including Issa over his handling of the failed arms trafficking investigation. Holder said the Justice Department has fully cooperated with the congressional investigation and has sent 7,600 pages of materials about the operation to Congress. "I don't want to hear anything about these 7,600 pages," Issa said. He is chairman of the House Oversight and Government Reform Committee, which is investigating the action. He pointed out that the listening devices in "The Fast and the Furious" showed that many key figures in the Department of Justice were responsible for the "gun-walking" strategy. Holder disagreed with Issa's conclusions, saying: "I don't think anyone in Washington knew about these tactics."

105cb7c9d731a85a9d12b69fcfb8fdf15301c15a.sourceText: 南北滨城“珠联璧合” 广州大连“亲上加亲” （亚省时报广州特约记者杨绮薇报道） 云山叠翠旭日红，珠水流光晴波碧。10月29日，广州友好城市再添新成员。”北方明珠”大连与”南国明珠”广州喜结友好城市。广州市委副书记、市长万庆良与大连市委副书记、市长李万才共同签署了两市缔结友好城市的协议书，标志着南北两座沿海开放城市的友好合作从此掀开新的一页。 万庆良说，大连是全国最早的沿海对外开放城市，在建设充满活力、富有魅力的宜居之都，探索科学发展模式，尤其是城市规划、城市建设方面，堪称中国城市建设的典范。广州是千年商都和国家中心城市，正加快建设国际商贸中心、世界文化名城、国家创新型城市、综合性门户城市、全省宜居城乡”首善之区”，全面提升核心竞争力、文化软实力和国际影响力。万庆良认为，大连和广州同为滨海城市，都是最早的沿海开放城市，在经济社会发展方面具有很强的互补性。两市缔结友好城市，可谓”珠联璧合”，”亲上加亲”。他希望在推进城市发展过程中，广州能够更好地学习借鉴大连的成功经验和科学发展模式。通过此次缔结友好城市的契机，进一步推动两市在更宽领域、更高层次的交流合作，共同促进两市经济社会又好又快地发展，增进两市人民福祉。 李万才表示，广州历史悠久，仁人志士辈出，康有为、梁启超、孙中山、黄花岗七十二烈士，到处都有可歌可泣的事迹。广州也是我国最早的对外贸易通商口岸，诞生了改革开放后的第一代个体工商业者和第一批”三资”企业。广州不仅是中国的”南大门”，更是我国改革开放的”领跑者”，是中国经济最活跃的城市之一，多年来经济总量始终位居全国城市前三甲，为其他城市科学发展树立了榜样。此次广州之行感受到广州市委、市政府带领全市人民建设国家中心城市，率先加快转型升级和建设”幸福广州”的睿智与豪气。两市合作是经济社会发展到一定阶段的必然要求，大连和广州一直相互支持，交流合作频繁。此次两市缔结友好城市，是两市协作发展史上的重要里程碑。大连将以此为新起点，加强与广州的交流与合作，实现共同发展、共同繁荣。 据了解，迄今为止，广州的友好城市总数已达23个。根据29日签订的协议书，广州大连两市将在会展、旅游、民营经济等领域展开全面合作，加强两市在经贸、人才、科技、文化、艺术、体育和城市管理等方面的联系与交流，建立政府间紧密的联系制度和应急联动合作机制。
105cb7c9d731a85a9d12b69fcfb8fdf15301c15a.translatedText: The North and South Bincheng are a perfect match. Dalian, Guangzhou “gets closer to each other” (Reported by Yang Qiwei, Special Correspondent of Guangzhou Times of the Alberta Times) The clouds and mountains are green and the sun is red, and the pearly water is shining and clear. On October 29, Guangzhou’s sister city added a new member. "Pearl of the North" Dalian and "Pearl of the South" Guangzhou have become sister cities. Wan Qingliang, deputy secretary of the Guangzhou Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, and Li Wancai, deputy secretary of the Municipal Party Committee and Mayor of Dalian, jointly signed an agreement to establish sister cities between the two cities, marking a new page in the friendly cooperation between the two open coastal cities in the north and the south. Wan Qingliang said that Dalian is the earliest coastal city in the country that is open to the outside world. It is a model of Chinese urban construction in building a vibrant, charming and livable city and exploring scientific development models, especially in urban planning and urban construction. Guangzhou has been a commercial capital for thousands of years and a national central city. It is accelerating its construction into an international business and trade center, a world-famous cultural city, a national innovative city, a comprehensive gateway city, and the province's livable urban and rural "best district" to comprehensively enhance its core competitiveness, cultural soft power, and international influence. Wan Qingliang believes that Dalian and Guangzhou are both coastal cities, the earliest coastal open cities, and are highly complementary in terms of economic and social development. The establishment of sister cities between the two cities can be described as a "perfect match" and a "closer relationship." He hopes that in the process of promoting urban development, Guangzhou can better learn from Dalian's successful experience and scientific development model. Through this opportunity to establish sister cities, we will further promote exchanges and cooperation between the two cities in a wider field and at a higher level, jointly promote the sound and rapid economic and social development of the two cities, and enhance the well-being of the people of the two cities. Li Wancai said that Guangzhou has a long history and has produced numerous people with lofty ideals. Kang Youwei, Liang Qichao, Sun Yat-sen and the 72 Huanghuagang martyrs all have commendable deeds everywhere. Guangzhou is also my country's earliest foreign trade treaty port, giving birth to the first generation of individual entrepreneurs and the first batch of "foreign-funded" enterprises after the reform and opening up. Guangzhou is not only the "Southern Gate" of China, but also the "leader" of my country's reform and opening up. It is one of the most economically active cities in China. For many years, its economic aggregate has always ranked among the top three cities in the country, setting an example for the scientific development of other cities. During this trip to Guangzhou, I felt the wisdom and pride of the Guangzhou Municipal Party Committee and Municipal Government in leading the people of the city to build a national central city, taking the lead in accelerating transformation and upgrading and building a "Happy Guangzhou". Cooperation between the two cities is an inevitable requirement for economic and social development to a certain stage. Dalian and Guangzhou have always supported each other and have frequent exchanges and cooperation. The establishment of sister cities between the two cities is an important milestone in the history of collaborative development between the two cities. Dalian will take this as a new starting point to strengthen exchanges and cooperation with Guangzhou to achieve common development and common prosperity. It is understood that so far, the total number of sister cities in Guangzhou has reached 23. According to the agreement signed on the 29th, Guangzhou and Dalian will carry out comprehensive cooperation in the fields of exhibitions, tourism, private economy and other fields, strengthen the contact and exchanges between the two cities in economy and trade, talent, science and technology, culture, art, sports and urban management, and establish a close inter-governmental contact system and emergency linkage cooperation mechanism.

3234f6bda2bb80fa51504c9e15b1bd15dd3279e6.sourceText: 为防范号称「冬季宁静杀手」的一氧化碳中毒，目前已有愈来愈多州立法要求住家必须安装一氧化碳警报器(carbon monoxide detector)。 今日美国报报导，虽然早在几十前即已规定住家必须安装烟雾警报器(smoke detector)，但可侦测无色无味、有毒可致命气体的类似装置?#19968;氧化碳警报器，却尚未普遍立法。 不过，该问题可望逐渐改善，以今年为例，至少有三个州，包括肯塔基、俄勒冈和华盛顿州，已开始要求新建住宅安装一氧化碳警报器；阿肯色州则计画自1月份开始规定新屋必须安装 。 而加州和威斯康辛州甚至要求现有一家庭住宅也要加装。 全国州议会会议(NCSL)人员韩德瑞克表示：「我们已见到更多州在处理该问题。」部分原因在于一氧化碳中毒意外的报导。 据悉，许多州将在未来五年内，通过住家必须安装一氧化碳警报器的立法；康乃狄克州今年已通过立法，先要求学校安装这种警报器。 制造一氧化碳警报器的伊利诺州业者黛博拉韩森说：「这些立法确实有必要，因为若没有这种警报器，根本无法及早侦测一氧化碳。」 据悉，大部分的一氧化碳警报器的价格从15元起跳，但必须每隔五年换新。
3234f6bda2bb80fa51504c9e15b1bd15dd3279e6.translatedText: In order to prevent carbon monoxide poisoning, known as the "winter safety killer", more and more states have legislated to require homes to install carbon monoxide alarms (carbon monoxide alarms). detector). USA Today reported that although smoke detectors have been required in homes for decades, similar devices that can detect colorless, odorless, toxic and deadly gases - carbon oxide alarms - have not yet been universally legislated. However, the problem is expected to gradually improve. Taking this year as an example, at least three states, including Kentucky, Oregon and Washington, have begun to require new homes to install carbon monoxide alarms; Arkansas plans to require new homes to install them starting in January. California and Wisconsin even require existing one-family homes to be retrofitted. "We've seen more states dealing with this issue," said Hendrick of the National Conference of State Legislatures (NCSL), in part because of reports of carbon monoxide poisoning accidents. It is reported that many states will pass legislation requiring the installation of carbon monoxide alarms in homes within the next five years; Connecticut has passed legislation this year to first require schools to install such alarms. Deborah Hanson, an Illinois company that manufactures carbon monoxide alarms, said: "These legislations are really necessary, because without such alarms, there is no way to detect carbon monoxide early." It is reported that the price of most carbon monoxide alarms starts at $15, but they must be replaced every five years.

474718cc08376ae70379f370ee213824992dc4ca.sourceText: 12日深圳湾的夜晚一片璀璨，青春和梦想在这里被充分点燃和释放，开幕式的第四篇章以《梦想在这里接力》为主题，首先是上场的是340名来自北师大珠海校区的普通大学生他们，他们身着绿装骑着自行车，在变幻的灯光和音乐的配合下，在舞台中央不断变化着各种图形，展示着目前在广东正蓬勃建设并广受民众欢迎的绿道形象。
474718cc08376ae70379f370ee213824992dc4ca.translatedText: The night of Shenzhen Bay was bright on the 12th. Youth and dreams were fully ignited and released here. The fourth chapter of the opening ceremony was themed "Dreams Relay Here". First up were 340 ordinary college students from Zhuhai Campus of Beijing Normal University. They were dressed in green and rode bicycles. With the changing lights and music, various graphics were constantly changing in the center of the stage, showing the image of the greenway that is currently under construction in Guangdong and is widely welcomed by the public.

14fddfedba70ab649977f1a1fc0c8e5bfd0a7f71.sourceText: 据悉，包括深圳在内的广东绵延2000多公里的绿道，代表着人们对绿色和生态世界的向往，大学生们用自行车表演，正是向所有朋友发出的美好生活的邀请。
14fddfedba70ab649977f1a1fc0c8e5bfd0a7f71.translatedText: It is reported that the greenways stretching for more than 2,000 kilometers in Guangdong, including Shenzhen, represent people's yearning for a green and ecological world. College students' performance on bicycles is an invitation to a better life to all their friends.

880be7a65c8e96289e7ed69705df20b9b7dc971d.sourceText: 历经了网上千万人的虚拟传递和在深圳等地的实体传递后，大运火炬”虹”于来到深圳湾 体育 场，第一棒火炬手是曾经骑自行车环绕中国的周子迁，随后火炬被依次传递给陈丽娜、奥运冠军程菲、中国泳坛名将孙杨、健美操全国冠军黄晋萱、世界艺术体操冠军戴菲菲，最后火炬被交到万众期待的中国奥运冠军刘翔的手上。
880be7a65c8e96289e7ed69705df20b9b7dc971d.translatedText: After being delivered virtually by tens of millions of people online and physically delivered in Shenzhen and other places, the Universiade Torch "Rainbow" finally came to Shenzhen Bay Sports At the event, the first torch bearer was Zhou Ziqian, who once cycled around China. The torch was then passed to Chen Lina, Olympic champion Cheng Fei, Chinese swimming star Sun Yang, national aerobics champion Huang Jinxuan, and world rhythmic gymnastics champion Dai Feifei. Finally, the torch was handed over to the much-anticipated Chinese Olympic champion Liu Xiang.

f08eb78df84e5d2d43b74a419e38d7113987ef69.sourceText: 在现场数万观众的支持声中，”飞人”;翔与非洲、美洲、欧洲以及大洋洲的代表运动员携手举着火炬，他们迎着”世界之门”跑去，”世界之门”为他们第三度缓缓打开，在距离火炬塔还有200米的位置时，五名火炬手用手中的火炬对准象征大体联标志”U字”面的五星的五颗星星点燃引信，火焰穿过青春大道，向着大海的方向，走向顶端的火炬塔，点燃了主火炬。
f08eb78df84e5d2d43b74a419e38d7113987ef69.translatedText: With the support of tens of thousands of spectators at the scene, "Flying Man" Xiang held the torch hand in hand with the representative athletes from Africa, America, Europe and Oceania. They ran towards the "Gate of the World", and the "Gate of the World" slowed down for them for the third time. Opening it, when they were still 200 meters away from the torch tower, the five torchbearers pointed the torches in their hands at the five stars symbolizing the "U" side of the Universiade logo and lit the fuse. The flame passed through Youth Avenue, towards the sea, towards the top of the torch tower, and lit the main torch.

fcb6316a0e88fa6e7a867da487d9cf802a391569.sourceText: WM凤凰城（高尔夫球）公开赛在斯各斯岱尔市开幕，有望为本地各行业带来超过200万收人。 酒店、食肆、食品、纪念品，各行业雨露均沾，这对经济低迷的斯各斯岱尔市来说确实是个好刺激。 而活动组织者说，去年以来，3100美元一套的贵宾票增加了20%，更加证实了这好势头。 展览大厅里，从纪念章、杯子、衣服到钥匙扣，几十种纪念品琳琅满目，无一不充满商机。 度假村满客，汽车旅馆无房，大小餐馆熙熙攘攘，仿佛让人看到花花绿绿的票子就在眼前。 高尔夫发烧友？ 买张25元的普票去体验一下吧。

The resorts are full, the motels have no rooms, and the restaurants are bustling with people, as if people can see colorful tickets right in front of them. Golf enthusiast? Buy a 25 yuan general ticket to experience it.

5f1923778de9a1b377ac5e14f1b5f9d802aeeb03.sourceText: CCN和美南中国专家协会联合会(FACPSU)现拟在2014年4月23日- 4月26日组织100人左右的海外高层次人才项目代表团考察访问徐州，南京等地。并在徐州召开美南中国专家协会联合会第十一届年会。在年会期间，FACPSU将邀请多省的政府人才机构，开发区平台和大型企业参会。本次代表团将组织安排涵及生物医药，电子信息，新能源，新材料，现代制造业及现代服务业等领域。希望能和国内的相关高新区，开发区，高科技园区，当地企业合作洽谈，找到合作共赢的机会。 迄今，我们已经确定了徐州和南京。其它城市待定。
5f1923778de9a1b377ac5e14f1b5f9d802aeeb03.translatedText: >CCN and the Southern American Federation of Chinese Professional Associations (FACPSU) are currently planned to be held on April 23, 2014- On April 26, an overseas high-level talent project delegation of about 100 people was organized to visit Xuzhou, Nanjing and other places. The 11th Annual Meeting of the Federation of South American Chinese Expert Associations was held in Xuzhou. During the annual meeting, FACPSU will invite government talent agencies, development zone platforms and large enterprises from many provinces to participate. This delegation will be organized and arranged to cover the fields of biomedicine, electronic information, new energy, new materials, modern manufacturing and modern service industries. We hope to cooperate and negotiate with relevant domestic high-tech zones, development zones, high-tech parks, and local enterprises to find opportunities for win-win cooperation. So far, we have identified Xuzhou and Nanjing. Other cities to be determined.

6a08ed2354a9022b858f681a25457f4749f4271f.sourceText: 如果申请人的项目被徐州选上并得到邀请，申请人将得到 5000人民币的国际旅费补助。如果申请人的项目被南京选上并得到邀请，申请人将得到4000人民币的国际旅费补助（两者均以邀请函为准）。除报名表之外，报名人还需要一起递交最高学位证书扫描件。
6a08ed2354a9022b858f681a25457f4749f4271f.translatedText: If the applicant’s project is selected by Xuzhou and invited, the applicant will receive an international travel subsidy of RMB 5,000. If the applicant's project is selected by Nanjing and invited, the applicant will receive an international travel subsidy of RMB 4,000 (both are subject to the invitation letter). In addition to the application form, applicants also need to submit a scanned copy of their highest degree certificate.

a3eca45ac101e3deba4ae5e995246ca4a877759e.sourceText: 1月20日2018年凤凰城华裔小姐选美大赛在凤凰城大学的礼堂圆满落下帷幕。经过近三个小时的精彩角逐，8位美丽大方的候选佳丽以及多个当地的艺术团体给所有观众带来一个令人难忘的夜晚。亚省艺术学院就是大力支持和参与的一个单位。今年是凤凰城华裔小姐选美比赛的第五十个年头。今天就来谈谈亚省艺术学院与选美比赛的情缘。
a3eca45ac101e3deba4ae5e995246ca4a877759e.translatedText: On January 20, the 2018 Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant came to a successful conclusion in the auditorium of the University of Phoenix. After nearly three hours of exciting competition, 8 beautiful and generous contestants and multiple local art groups brought an unforgettable night to all the audience. The Art Institute of Alberta is a unit that strongly supports and participates in this project. This year is the 50th year of the Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant. Today, let’s talk about the relationship between the Art Institute of Alberta and beauty pageants.

5094b5f6e65aed39e355a522c36ed557fe0280d1.sourceText: 首先，本选美比赛的总策划就是亚省艺术学院的老师闻玲琳，从亚省艺术学院成立以来到现在，闻玲琳老师连续四年担任总策划一职，年年创新，节目精彩纷呈。因此，亚省艺术学院也与选美接下了不解之缘，每年都为佳丽们提供比赛的排练场地，也为选美比赛输送美丽的候选佳丽，更是年年派优秀的节目参与演出。
5094b5f6e65aed39e355a522c36ed557fe0280d1.translatedText: First of all, the chief planner of this beauty pageant is Wen Linglin, a teacher from the Art Institute of Alberta. From the establishment of the Art Institute to the present, Ms. Wen Linglin has served as the chief planner for four consecutive years, with innovations every year and exciting programs. Therefore, the Art Institute of Alberta has a close relationship with the beauty pageant. It provides the beauties with a rehearsal venue for the competition every year, and also provides beautiful candidates for the beauty pageant. It also sends outstanding programs to participate in performances every year.

6b9fd5923d766618a5bf4e81da25caa0f1b22947.sourceText: 总策划 身着绿色礼服的闻玲琳老师 黎英拍摄

528e42ada8f4fdd0630493be5860c1ff3403ce8e.translatedText: This year’s No. 6 candidate Yan Kezhen is an outstanding student from the Art Institute of Alberta. Her Dai dance even conquered all the judges and audiences, and she won the title of Best Talented Miss in this competition. Yan Kezhen is also a soloist and lead dancer at the Alberta College of the Arts.

b57181b0d08026c5e4da4d2bffd21a6f08d305ca.sourceText: 在2018亚省春晚，她的独舞《山南笠影》群舞《傣家女儿，傣家雨》受到了中美观众的热烈欢迎。2016年亚省艺术学院的独舞和领舞演员，彭天悦众望所归，获得了2016年凤凰城华裔小姐的称号，她们都成为了学院孩子们的榜样。
b57181b0d08026c5e4da4d2bffd21a6f08d305ca.translatedText: At the 2018 Alberta Spring Festival Gala, her solo dance "Shannan Liying" group dance "Daughter of the Dai Family, Rain of the Dai Family" was warmly welcomed by Chinese and American audiences. In 2016, Peng Tianyue, the soloist and lead dancer of the Alberta College of the Arts, won the title of Miss Chinese Phoenix 2016. They have become role models for the children of the college.

96935d5039e06e3551d985ac275d568ed7fa3647.sourceText: 2016年凤凰城华裔小姐 黎英拍摄
96935d5039e06e3551d985ac275d568ed7fa3647.translatedText: Photographed by Miss Chinese Phoenix 2016 Li Ying

27f5e9894bd7873a3a12439564acb57b17c95ca0.sourceText: 今年亚省艺术学院成人班带来的舞蹈《绽放》，更是将活动推向了一个小高潮。一个个婀娜多姿的东方美女们，将手中的扇子和手绢都舞出了花，她们多彩多姿地绽放在舞台的每个角落，就如她们自己如花的年华，年年十八。这群姑娘都是舞蹈的发烧友，她们大多有自己幸福的家庭，用业余时间来学习舞蹈，演出之前更是加班加点，额外加课，希望给观众带来一个特别有中国传统特色的舞蹈。她们中，有的学习舞蹈已经多年，有的才刚刚加入这个队伍，是一个共同的兴趣爱好，把姑娘们聚在了一起，让她们重拾十八岁的梦想。
27f5e9894bd7873a3a12439564acb57b17c95ca0.translatedText: The dance "Blooming" presented by the adult class of the Art Institute of Alberta this year pushed the event to a climax.一个个婀娜多姿的东方美女们，将手中的扇子和手绢都舞出了花，她们多彩多姿地绽放在舞台的每个角落，就如她们自己如花的年华，年年十八。 These girls are all dance enthusiasts. Most of them have their own happy families and spend their spare time learning dance. They even work overtime and take extra classes before the performance, hoping to bring a dance with special Chinese traditional characteristics to the audience. Some of them have been studying dance for many years, and some have just joined the team. It is a common interest that brings the girls together and allows them to regain their eighteen-year-old dream.

86302fd71fe65dd1cd7dd75a3ae28b9766575c99.sourceText: 舞蹈《绽放》 艺柳白拍摄

2f253b9f5fbfc4d055990ed00420b75d7f4e03f2.sourceText: 选美比赛不仅是个比赛，更是一个展示华裔文化艺术的平台，在这一点上与亚省艺术学院的办学宗旨不谋而合。我们期待在未来的选美比赛中，依然能携手共同创造更多的辉煌。
2f253b9f5fbfc4d055990ed00420b75d7f4e03f2.translatedText: The beauty pageant is not only a competition, but also a platform to showcase Chinese culture and art. In this regard, it coincides with the purpose of running the Art Institute of Alberta. We look forward to working together to create more brilliance in future beauty pageants.

0bad16829530b9214ed4d0cd7233d8ac3aba2742.translatedText: House of Representatives passes bill allowing lottery winners to remain anonymous "Alberta Times" The Arizona House of Representatives voted overwhelmingly 51 to 8 on Tuesday to pass a proposal...

d03cf005dfc16f459c456a74ee0926a3add52ac8.sourceText: 亚利桑那州众议会周二以 51比 8 的票数压倒数投票通过一项提案，允许彩票中奖者可以选择不在公众媒体中公布姓名。
d03cf005dfc16f459c456a74ee0926a3add52ac8.translatedText: The Arizona House of Representatives voted overwhelmingly 51 to 8 on Tuesday to pass a proposal that would allow lottery winners to choose not to have their names published in the public media.

1f388b31eac113f3bea140bc91f0f49f20e3380d.sourceText: 本提案由喷泉山共和党籍众议员约翰卡瓦纳提出。卡瓦纳声称，彩票中奖应该给购买者带来幸运，而不是安全风险。按照现今法律，将中奖者姓名公布，无疑使中奖者的私隐暴露于众，正如去年赢得乐透大奖的喷泉山居民，曾因介意暴露身份而迟迟不领奖。
1f388b31eac113f3bea140bc91f0f49f20e3380d.translatedText: This proposal was introduced by Rep. John Kavanagh, a Fountain Hill Republican. Kavanagh claimed that winning the lottery should bring luck to the purchaser, not a security risk. According to current laws, publishing the name of the lottery winner will undoubtedly expose the privacy of the lottery winner to the public. Just like the Fountain Hill resident who won the lottery last year, he delayed accepting the prize because he was worried about having his identity exposed. The

b4e34df6a74c3740482f0823b6e21b7073d288d3.sourceText: 提案还有漏洞，如若成法，也只是州法，中奖者要想完全避免姓名被公布，还需各郡和各市镇，甚至彩票公司通过类似法案才能真正避免骚扰。
b4e34df6a74c3740482f0823b6e21b7073d288d3.translatedText: proposal still has loopholes. If it becomes law, it will only be a state law. If winners want to completely prevent their names from being published, counties, cities and towns, and even lottery companies will need to pass similar bills to truly avoid harassment.

297fd655bb173d0636ad4793878eb30af2374849.sourceText: 此外，众议院通过提案后，还要经过参议会通票和州长签署才能真正成为法律。
297fd655bb173d0636ad4793878eb30af2374849.translatedText: In addition, after the House of Representatives passes the proposal, it must be passed by the Senate and signed by the governor before it can truly become law.

3b557ae403136f4b63180b9be1e252110a055d7b.translatedText: The House of Representatives blocks the Deferred Action for Immigrants plan. ABC Network said that the House of Representatives recently passed an amendment to the Homeland Security spending bill to delete President Obama’s...

dec758fd7d1c4fc4130d56b63f1cc1bcb34dae31.sourceText: 众议院阻止非移延缓遣返计划 美国广播公司网称，众议院近日通过了一个国土安全开支法案的修正案，删除奥巴马总统的”年幼非法移民延迟行动”（DACA）的资金。该计划延迟了遣返那些幼年时期来到美国的非法移民，并让他们能留在美国及合法工作。 几乎所有共和党众议员都支持对该国土安全开支法案增加一项修正案，以删除DACA计划的资金。众议院多数党领袖坎特（Eric Cantor）和另外两名众议院移民改革”八人帮”成员都投了赞成票。 白宫国内政策委员会主任穆尼奥斯（Cecilia Mu oz）在西语裔媒体新闻发布会上说：”我认为这向拉美社区发出了一个有趣的信号。这个投票基本上将抹杀’梦想法案’受益人得到的好处。” 然而这次投票仅有象征意义。民主党控制的参议院基本不可能支持带有这样修正案的法案；即使有，奥巴马也不会签署。 6月10日，参议院将开始辩论移民改革法案。这次众议院的投票显示，给非法移民提供成为美国公民的机会并非众议院共和党人的头等大事。 发起删除DACA计划资金的纽约州众议员金恩（Steve King）就持这样的观点。他把参议院的移民改革法案称作”大赦”非法移民，并一直在试图使之失败。金恩在一份声明中说：”我的修正案阻止了很多参议院八人帮法案中的对应条款。如果能维持这一立场，总统签署的就不会是大赦。” 美国最大的年轻非法移民活动网络立即发表了尖锐的回应。海门涅玆在声明中说：”这令人愤怒，正好和我们国家对政治领导人的期望相反。难道众议院议长博纳要接受金恩的引领，彻底让共和党成为脱离群众的极端党派，永远将移民和拉美裔社区边缘化吗？” 不过共和党在此修正案上并非完全孤立。三名民主党人也投票支持该修正案。他们是乔治亚州的巴洛（John Barrow）、弗吉尼亚州的拉合尔（Nick Rahall）和北卡州的麦金塔尔（Mike McIntyre）。
dec758fd7d1c4fc4130d56b63f1cc1bcb34dae31.translatedText: The House of Representatives blocked the Deferred Action for Immigrants plan. ABC Network said that the House of Representatives recently passed an amendment to the Homeland Security spending bill to delete President Obama’s Deferred Action for Young Illegal Immigrants (DACA) funding. The plan delays the deportation of illegal immigrants who came to the United States as children and allows them to stay in the United States and work legally. Nearly all Republican House members support adding an amendment to the homeland security spending bill to remove funding for the DACA program. House Majority Leader Eric Cantor and two other members of the House’s “Gang of Eight” on immigration reform voted in favor. Cecilia Muñoz, director of the White House Domestic Policy Council, said at a Hispanic media press conference: "I think this sends an interesting signal to the Latin American community. This vote will basically wipe out the benefits of the beneficiaries of the 'Dream Act.'" However, this vote has only symbolic meaning. It is highly unlikely that the Democratic-controlled Senate would support a bill with such an amendment; even if it did, Obama would not sign it. On June 10, the Senate will begin debate on the immigration reform bill. The House vote shows that giving illegal immigrants a chance to become U.S. citizens is not a top priority for House Republicans. New York State Representative Steve King, who initiated the defunding of the DACA program, holds this view. He has called the Senate immigration reform bill "amnesty" for illegal immigrants and has been trying to defeat it. King said in a statement: "My amendment blocks many of the corresponding provisions in the Senate Gang of Eight bill. If this position is maintained, what the president signs will not be an amnesty." The largest activist network of young illegal immigrants in the United States immediately issued a sharp response. Hemenez said in a statement: "This is outrageous and the opposite of what our country expects from its political leaders. Is House Speaker John Boehner going to follow King's lead and completely turn the Republican Party into an extreme party that is out of touch with the masses and will forever marginalize immigrants and the Hispanic community?" However, the Republican Party is not completely alone on this amendment. Three Democrats also voted for the amendment. They are Georgia's John Barrow, Virginia's Nick Rahall and North Carolina's Mike McIntyre.

1f794d4a041680ebef62b33dc116872e38601cf6.translatedText: Selling diseased remains, US-based organ broker guilty of fraud (Central News Agency, Washington, 22nd comprehensive foreign news report) A businessman in Detroit, the United States, who has rented and sold donated organs for 20 years...

640cd3534d66c01409ecf329f74fdb6dee9c45f3.sourceText: （中央社华盛顿22日综合外电报导）美国底特律一名租售捐赠器官20年的商人，向医疗界客户贩售染病的遗体部位，今天遭判犯下诈欺罪，面临最高20年有期徒刑。
640cd3534d66c01409ecf329f74fdb6dee9c45f3.translatedText: (Central News Agency, Washington, 22nd comprehensive foreign news report) A businessman in Detroit, the United States, who has rented and sold donated organs for 20 years, sold diseased body parts to medical clients. He was convicted of fraud today and faces up to 20 years in prison.

7ec8690a903a953b9be7550d35159ef95d7c2342.sourceText: 路透社报导，美国人体部位交易市场大多不受管制，联邦当局加强展开全国调查时，查到拉斯本（Arthur Rathburn）涉嫌贩售染病尸体残肢。联邦探员2013年突击拉斯本的仓库时，惊见骇人的恐怖场景，包括人体尸块冻结成块。
7ec8690a903a953b9be7550d35159ef95d7c2342.translatedText: Reuters reported that the market for human body parts in the United States is mostly unregulated. As federal authorities stepped up a nationwide investigation, they discovered that Arthur Rathburn was suspected of selling diseased body parts. When federal agents raided Rathbun's warehouse in 2013, they were shocked to see horrifying scenes, including human body parts frozen into chunks.

06c783e5da4d5ed58776a3063a0bfe795182ce58.sourceText: 「沙加缅度勤奋者报」（Sacramento Bee）报导，发现身体部位堆积在冷冻库并储存于食物旁边，仓库内还有成堆昆虫且地板血迹斑斑，这些都只是这座尸体工厂的冰山一角。检方表示，仓库内还有感染人类免疫不全病毒（HIV）与B型肝炎的遗体，并储存著人体头部、躯干等部位等著贩售。
06c783e5da4d5ed58776a3063a0bfe795182ce58.translatedText: The "Sacramento Bee" reported that body parts were found piled up in the freezer and stored next to food. There were piles of insects in the warehouse and the floor was stained with blood. These are just the tip of the iceberg in this corpse factory. Prosecutors said that there were still human remains infected with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and hepatitis B in the warehouse, and human heads, torsos and other parts were stored waiting to be sold.

43504edd7b77e44eaa27622f7a0f6285950b98b5.sourceText: 但根据「底特律新闻报」（Detroit News），检方表示，买家是医疗业专业人士，他们购买遗体部位用于训练与研究，不知道这些遗体受到感染。
43504edd7b77e44eaa27622f7a0f6285950b98b5.translatedText: But according to the "Detroit News" (Detroit News), prosecutors stated that the buyers were medical professionals who purchased body parts for training and research without knowing that the bodies were infected.

813e1f0c78c8c9be829475697c6bc7fff207a808.sourceText: 现有美国法律仅规范用于移植的身体部位，像是心脏与肝脏。买卖身体部位用于研究与教育，像是拉斯本的事业，在美国法律中是合法的。拉斯本在对方不知情下，贩售感染爱滋病毒与肝炎的身体部位给顾客，遭控诈欺。
813e1f0c78c8c9be829475697c6bc7fff207a808.translatedText: Existing U.S. law only regulates body parts used for transplantation, such as hearts and livers. Buying and selling body parts for research and education, like Rathbun's venture, is legal under U.S. law. Rathbun was charged with fraud for selling body parts infected with HIV and hepatitis to customers without their knowledge.

314a2ff35a429df9a9e0423c9e00840506ab46c2.sourceText: 拉斯本的前妻兼事业伙伴伊丽莎白.拉斯本（Elizabeth Rathburn）作证，他们是从鼓励民众捐赠遗体供科学研究的公司收购人体部位。她作证时指出，为了提高利润，拉斯本有时收购染病遗体与部位；他们不想赔钱，因此对顾客说谎。这些遗体能够廉价售出，是因为很少有医疗机构想用在训练或教育。
314a2ff35a429df9a9e0423c9e00840506ab46c2.translatedText: Rathburn’s ex-wife and business partner Elizabeth Rathburn testified that they purchased human body parts from companies that encourage people to donate their bodies for scientific research. She testified that in order to increase profits, Rathbun sometimes purchased infected bodies and body parts; they did not want to lose money, so they lied to customers. The remains are sold cheaply because few medical institutions want to use them for training or education.

efb91d8953dcadccc713c4ed52ec2cb447710a9a.sourceText: 伊丽莎白对诈欺认罪并配合检方调查。拉斯本面临最高20年有期徒刑，不过，法官必须考量的联邦量刑準则，普遍要求判下较短刑期。法官预计将在春天对两人宣判。（译者：张晓雯/核稿：卢映孜）1070123
efb91d8953dcadccc713c4ed52ec2cb447710a9a.translatedText: Elizabeth pleaded guilty to fraud and cooperated with prosecutors in the investigation. Rathbun faces up to 20 years in prison, but federal sentencing guidelines that judges must consider generally call for a shorter sentence. A judge is expected to sentence both men in the spring. (Translator: Zhang Xiaowen/Verification: Lu Yingzi) 1070123

July 13th According to the American Overseas Chinese News Network, on the evening of the 9th local time, many Chinese people in the United States...

2c345786ca40ff13fc3a587d892cbd8131bff0b8.sourceText: 7月13日电 据美国侨报网报道，当地时间9日晚，不少美国华人民众都在自己的社交媒体上发现”又一名中国留学生疑似失踪”的信息迅速散布。同学和朋友们都纷纷开始利用社交网络寻找一名叫王威的留学生的下落。
2c345786ca40ff13fc3a587d892cbd8131bff0b8.translatedText: July 13th According to the American Overseas Chinese News Network, on the evening of the 9th local time, many Chinese Americans discovered on their social media that the information that "another Chinese student is suspected of missing" spread rapidly. Classmates and friends began to use social networks to find the whereabouts of an international student named Wang Wei.

4d11d0b5c95fc39008ce631d0ce2979b887ebd05.sourceText: 10日，亚利桑那州立大学（University ofArizona）中国学生学者联谊会也正式发布寻人启事，表示其校中国留学生王威离奇失联超过24小时，家人和朋友都无法与他联系上。朋友到其公寓寻找，发现台灯亮着，人和车不知所踪。于是，王的同学及友人快速与警方取得联络，没过多久，校方和同学们在警方的协助下，找到了失联多时的王威。
4d11d0b5c95fc39008ce631d0ce2979b887ebd05.translatedText: On the 10th, the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of Arizona State University also officially issued a missing person notice, stating that Wang Wei, a Chinese international student at the school, had mysteriously disappeared for more than 24 hours, and his family and friends were unable to contact him. A friend went to his apartment to search and found that the desk lamp was on and the person and car were missing. As a result, Wang's classmates and friends quickly contacted the police. Not long after, the school and classmates, with the assistance of the police, found Wang Wei, who had been missing for a long time.

96b40a56541a918a9ec8cb220d0150a33d4dce04.sourceText: 针对此事，来自亚利桑那州立大学学生会成员吴同学表示：”目前，王威已经与大家取得了联络，并确定没有受到任何危险和伤害，为尊重王威同学本人的意思，便不就此事原委进行深入谈论了，谢谢大家对王威和广大留学生安危的重视，现在王威是安全、健康的！”
96b40a56541a918a9ec8cb220d0150a33d4dce04.translatedText: In response to this matter, Wu, a member of the Arizona State University Student Union, said: "Currently, Wang Wei has contacted everyone and confirmed that he has not been in any danger or harm. To respect Wang Wei's wishes, we will not discuss the matter in depth. Thank you. We attach great importance to the safety of Wang Wei and the majority of international students. Now Wang Wei is safe and healthy! "

09a762cda297588f9d8901a37c9c7de2644af433.sourceText: 与其说此事为虚惊一场，不如说近来在美国所发生的种种有关留学生失踪、失联、遇害等等悲剧事件，的确让大家的精神感到过度敏感。
09a762cda297588f9d8901a37c9c7de2644af433.translatedText: Rather than saying that this incident is a false alarm, it is better to say that the recent tragic incidents involving the disappearance, loss of contact, and murder of international students in the United States have indeed made everyone feel overly sensitive.

a193510de9928ba2c8b79e99433c0035f79e8044.translatedText: Surf resort in the desert Phoenix Surf Park

d35d4d12e56bf6628e02f14ede1d27aefb272a1d.sourceText: 沙漠中的冲浪胜地 凤凰城冲浪公园 亚利桑那州一直以其充足的阳光和丰富的户外自然资源闻名于世。在炎热的夏季，…
d35d4d12e56bf6628e02f14ede1d27aefb272a1d.translatedText: Surf resort in the desert Phoenix Surf Park Arizona has always been famous for its abundant sunshine and rich outdoor natural resources. In the hot summer,...

20deb6729202f2eeefa7fdb1a860a48af0c1dc37.sourceText: 建于1969年，这个位于沙漠中央的神奇冲浪公园(Big Surf Water Park)规模位居全球第三，是美国首个内陆冲浪设施。公园内设有里面有10多条水上滑梯，以及模拟夏威夷威基基海滩(Waikiki Beach)的冲浪设施。在沙漠中冲浪是独一无二的体验，也是每一个美国年轻人的梦想。40年来，冲浪公园一直是亚利桑那州地标性的景点。
20deb6729202f2eeefa7fdb1a860a48af0c1dc37.translatedText: Built in 1969, this magical surf park (Big Surf Water Park) in the middle of the desert ranks third in the world in terms of scale and is the first inland surfing facility in the United States. The park has more than 10 water slides and surfing facilities that simulate Waikiki Beach in Hawaii. Surfing in the desert is a unique experience and the dream of every young American. For 40 years, Surf Park has been an Arizona landmark.

22e7e5fee324b186d4dabade37002196715b7fed.sourceText: 一位经常光顾冲浪公园的客人说到，”对所有冲浪者来说，最酷的事情就是季风季节的到来，刮起的强风能够掀起巨大的波浪并使波浪高涨。那是最好的浪涛。”
22e7e5fee324b186d4dabade37002196715b7fed.translatedText: A guest who frequents the surf park said, "The coolest thing for all surfers is the arrival of the monsoon season. The strong winds can set off huge waves and make the waves high. Those are the best waves."

1440dd397882a42f4b145f15493273821928a877.sourceText: 近年来，公园为吸引更多儿童和家庭的到来，不断完善加强服务的多元化。这里可以为游客组织孩子的生日派对，家庭聚会，或者是公司会议奖励活动。每到周末，公园还会安排有户外音乐会。
1440dd397882a42f4b145f15493273821928a877.translatedText: In recent years, the park has continued to improve and diversify its services in order to attract more children and families. Children's birthday parties, family gatherings, or company conference incentive events can be organized here for tourists. Every weekend, outdoor concerts are arranged in the park.

b164913d75339a50a229bf43796ddec161a9670c.sourceText: 参观信息：儿童,老人，现役军人,消防员，警员和每天下午3点后入园的游客都可享受门票优惠。
b164913d75339a50a229bf43796ddec161a9670c.translatedText: Visiting information: Children, the elderly, active military personnel, firefighters, police officers and visitors who enter the park after 3 pm every day can enjoy ticket discounts.

bb9588b892ca8487632428e178f125b405c20e6e.sourceText: 对于一个纯粹的旅行者来说，如果还未真正踏上过亚利桑那州，那便不算是了解完整的美国。被誉为”大峡谷之”的亚利桑那州位于美国西南部，首府凤凰城，地域辽阔。东接新墨西哥州，难与墨西哥共和国毗连，西隔科罗拉多河与加利福尼亚相望。亚利桑那州又有美国最大的法定美洲印第安人部落，而绵延277英里的大峡谷国家公园是亚利桑那州最具标志性的自然奇观，科罗拉多河自谷底穿流而过，顺势流向西南方向，而距谷底一英里多高的上方则矗立着一道道陡峭的岩石墙，令人叹为观止。
bb9588b892ca8487632428e178f125b405c20e6e.translatedText: For a pure traveler, if you have not truly set foot in Arizona, you have not understood the complete United States. Known as the "Grand Canyon", Arizona is located in the southwestern United States, with its capital city Phoenix and a vast territory. It is bordered by New Mexico to the east, the Republic of Mexico, and California across the Colorado River to the west. Arizona has the largest legal American Indian tribe in the United States, and the 277-mile-long Grand Canyon National Park is Arizona's most iconic natural wonder. The Colorado River flows through the valley bottom and flows southwestward. Steep rock walls stand more than a mile above the valley bottom, which is breathtaking.

d9d690336cb3a4fe996d6c927b0a4c4c46f6536b.sourceText: （亚省侨联崔增祁供稿） 7月13日晚，美莎市的Main St.的街灯闪耀着异样的光芒，街上的行人络绎不绝。这天，是美莎市展示画廊和商业的日子，马路两侧的店铺都开门迎接客人的到来，人行道上，许多摊位展示着各种各样的精美工艺品，到处充满着浓郁的艺术气息。在这条街上，有一家艺术品和珠宝店当天开业，经Mrs. April联繫，凤凰城侨联在七月四日组织的青少年迎国庆画展的优秀作品被移到该店参加了展出。一幅幅作品再次展示了华人青少年对美国歷史和民主，自由的赞颂。 曾在四川美术学院任教的独立画家，副教授林萱老师和小苏画室的苏智英老师还组织了近20名学生在现场作绘画表演。他们在凤凰城侨联的会标前，用画笔绘出了一幅又一幅美丽的图画，吸引了许多人驻足观看，人们不时地為孩子们的作品表示欣赏和讚叹。侨联的这次艺术活动為美莎社区增添了一个新的亮点，也深受本地华人的欢迎。许多家长陪着孩子们作画，热情地為他们提供服务，侨联的义工们也為画展的筹备付出了辛勤的汗水。人们希望凤凰城侨联多举办这样的活动，既弘扬了中华文化，也给孩子们提供了显示才华，接触和认识MESA SOLID ROCK 社会的机会，帮助青少年们更加健康地成长。
d9d690336cb3a4fe996d6c927b0a4c4c46f6536b.translatedText: (Contributed by Cui Zengqi, the Alberta Overseas Chinese Federation) On the evening of July 13, Main St. in Mesa City shines... The street lights of St. shine with a strange light, and there is an endless stream of pedestrians on the street. Today is the day when Mesa City showcases galleries and businesses. Shops on both sides of the road are open to welcome customers. On the sidewalk, many stalls display a variety of exquisite crafts, and there is a strong artistic atmosphere everywhere. On this street, there was an art and jewelry store that opened that day. After being contacted by Mrs. April, the outstanding works of the Youth National Day Art Exhibition organized by the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation on July 4 were moved to this store to participate in the exhibition. Each work once again shows Chinese teenagers' praise of American history, democracy, and freedom. Lin Xuan, an independent painter and associate professor who once taught at Sichuan Fine Arts Institute, and Su Zhiying from Xiaosu Studio also organized nearly 20 students to perform painting performances on site. They painted one beautiful picture after another in front of the logo of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation, attracting many people to stop and watch. People expressed their appreciation and admiration for the children's works from time to time. This art activity organized by the Overseas Chinese Federation has added a new highlight to the Meisha community and is also very popular among local Chinese. Many parents accompanied their children to paint and enthusiastically provided services to them. Volunteers from the Overseas Chinese Federation also worked hard in preparing for the exhibition. People hope that the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation will hold more activities like this, which will not only promote Chinese culture, but also provide children with opportunities to show their talents, contact and understand the MESA SOLID ROCK society, and help young people grow up healthily.

4534883d5ecabc4282a19868bd261817d45d803d.sourceText: 司威立：豆腐牛肉饭 一九六0年代，以一个半工半读的苦学生而言，我们没有权利每个周末去餐馆吃饭娱乐，偶然去旧金山的唐人街吃一个盘餐已经是一项无尚的享受。 我常告诉我的学生，在那个苦学时期，别人上学，我也在上学，别人在睡觉，我则在读书，别人在娱乐或休息，我则在打工赚学费。 周末尽可能赶打一份半工或可让周日稍微松弛一点，也可以多读书做功课。 如今我近不惑之年，我又能常常享用一盘豆腐牛肉饭，因为它让我想起了我的留学生生涯，也让我从心酸中有些甜滋味。 当年在唐人街的杰克逊街有一家粤菜小馆，那位老师傅能把豆腐块烧得嫩软，细腻入味，再加上他的浆肉技巧，牛肉片特别滑嫩，于是一盘可口的豆腐牛肉饭 是我不定期的口福，七角五分钱的盘餐加上二角五分钱的小费（时价），于是一块美金能让我这个苦留学生似过圣诞节吃大餐一般的快活、 满足。 如今在本埠的Main Street也有一家小餐馆能让我时时品尝入味嫩软豆腐的美滋味和牛肉滑嫩的可口，要享受这道盘餐的要诀是「热」，豆腐一定要烧透而又 不能「破相」，汁要鲜而微咸，很多餐厅不把持的「诀窍」就是过咸或过淡。 我感叹的是豆腐牛肉饭仍然美味可口，然我却年时渐高，竟无法吃完整盘好饭菜，但愿人长久，美食伴终生。
4534883d5ecabc4282a19868bd261817d45d803d.translatedText: Swillie: Tofu and Beef Rice In the 1960s, as a working-study student, we did not have the right to go to restaurants for dinner and entertainment every weekend. Occasionally going to San Francisco's Chinatown to have a plate of food was already a luxury. I often tell my students that during that period of hard study, while others were going to school, I was also going to school, others were sleeping while I was studying, others were having fun or resting, and I was working part-time to earn tuition. Try to work a part-time job on weekends to relax a little on Sunday, or read more and do more homework. Now that I am nearly 40 years old, I can often enjoy a plate of tofu and beef rice, because it reminds me of my life as an overseas student, and it also gives me a sweet taste in my heart. Back then, there was a Cantonese restaurant on Jackson Street in Chinatown. The old chef could cook the tofu cubes until they were tender, delicate and flavourful. Coupled with his cooking skills, the beef slices were particularly smooth and tender. So a delicious plate of tofu and beef rice was an irregular treat for me. The meal cost 75 cents plus a 25 cent tip (current price), so a dollar could make me, a poor international student, feel as happy and satisfied as having a Christmas feast. Nowadays, there is a small restaurant on Main Street in this city where I can always taste the delicious taste of soft tofu and the tenderness of beef. The key to enjoying this dish is "heat". The tofu must be cooked through but not "disintegrated", and the sauce should be fresh and slightly salty. The "secret" that many restaurants do not control is too salty or too bland. What I lament is that the tofu and beef rice is still delicious, but as I get older, I can't eat a whole plate of good food. I wish you a long life and good food to accompany you throughout your life.

bd580aa638f2a3047df3666a9292fe37358c4d32.sourceText: 达举债上限 远比坠崖可怕 《亚省时报》 投资者担心美国万一坠落「财政悬崖」，元旦后股市可能崩跌。 其实更可怕的是，华府数周后不及时达成协议，提高国债上限，因为这可能导致联邦赖债、信评再次降低、金融市场恐慌。 事实上，「财政悬崖」并没有出现，财政部31 日已开始采取一系列措施，以便为联邦政府提供保证运营的资金，并停止发行两个政府退休基金的新债，从而避免立即出现债务违约 ，把违约至少推迟到2月底。 市场策士表示，如坠落财政悬崖，导致加税和政府大肆削减开支，势必严重损害消费者和企业信心，不过美国经济还会再过一阵子才会陷于衰退。 国会在这段期间有很多机会采取补救措施，扭转一些坠崖效应。 这是美国股市仍未显现崩盘迹象，只是逐渐下降和震荡加剧的原因，也使华府能够不予理会。 以往股价一旦崩跌，国会都会被迫采取行动。 财政部长盖纳表示，美国技术上今年底就会达到国债上限。 白宫声明不打算对国债谈​​判，采取2011年的同样做法，不过它可能被迫重蹈覆辙，而这是市场最可怕的恶梦。 2011年的国债谈判，原来的程序之争引发激烈对抗，市场接连暴跌，连通过提高国债上限的法案之后，股市仍然狂泻，对华府的运作能力表现一种不信任投票，史坦普信评 机构也破天荒的把美国债信降低一级。 在当年8月21日为止的四周内，史坦普500指数暴降16%。 期权市场已有迹象显示投资者对1月抱持戒慎恐惧心态。 雇非法移民 查处创新高 在奥巴马总统矢言连任后将推动移民改革之际，美国移民及海关执法局(USICE)过去一个会计年度针对企业雇用非法移民的查核，已创下新高纪录。 这项查核一直是欧巴马移民政策的重点之一，欧巴马政府支持先清查美国境内的非法移民，改善边界安全，再来全面移民改革。 据统计，USICE对雇主查验劳工资格表格的稽核次数，已从2007年会计年度的250件，在2012年增至3000件。 从2009年至2012年会计年度，公司缴纳罚款的总金额由100万元骤增至1300万元。 而公司经理遭逮捕的人数则增至238人。 奥巴马日前在谈及有关第二任将解决移民改革问题时，他曾指出，任何措施都将包含对故意雇用非法移民的公司，处以罚款；虽然此非新的立场，但在当局开始致力 改革移民制度之际，可能是奥巴马将凸显的政策。 USICE在当时共查核数千家公司，并有339家公司在2011会计年度遭到罚款。 依据美联社所获得最近的资料，在2011会计年度，企业中位数的罚款为1万1000元；德州以63家公司遭罚款居冠，其次是新泽西州的37家公司。 据悉，雇主依规定必须要求员工填写I-9表格，以宣示可在美国可合法工作，目前雇主仅需确认身分证明文件看似真实文件。 当局对企业这项追查行动，是当局投入1亿3800万元进行职场执法努力计画的其中一部分，USICE人员必须逐一清查公司薪资名册，以比对出与社会安全号码和其他身分资料库不吻合 的姓名。
bd580aa638f2a3047df3666a9292fe37358c4d32.translatedText: Reaching the debt limit is far scarier than falling off a cliff "Alberta Times" Investors are worried that if the United States falls off the "fiscal cliff", the stock market may collapse after New Year's Day. In fact, what is even more frightening is that Washington failed to reach an agreement in time to raise the national debt ceiling after a few weeks, because this may lead to the federal government defaulting on debt, another reduction in credit rating, and panic in the financial market. In fact, the "fiscal cliff" has not appeared. The Ministry of Finance has begun to take a series of measures on the 31st to provide the federal government with funds to ensure operations and stop the issuance of new bonds for two government pension funds, thereby avoiding an immediate debt default and delaying the default until at least the end of February. Market strategists said that if the fiscal cliff falls, resulting in tax increases and severe government spending cuts, it will inevitably seriously damage consumer and business confidence, but it will take a while for the U.S. economy to fall into recession. Congress has many opportunities during this period to take remedial measures and reverse some of the effects of falling off a cliff. This is the reason why the U.S. stock market still shows no signs of collapse, but only gradually declines and intensifies volatility, and it also allows Washington to ignore it. In the past, when stock prices collapsed, Congress was forced to take action. Treasury Secretary Gaynor said that the United States will technically reach the national debt limit by the end of this year. The White House has stated that it does not intend to negotiate on the national debt, taking the same approach as in 2011, but it may be forced to repeat the same mistakes, which is the market's worst nightmare. In the 2011 national debt negotiations, original procedural disputes triggered fierce confrontations, and the market plummeted one after another. Even after the bill to increase the national debt ceiling was passed, the stock market continued to plummet, showing a vote of no confidence in Washington's operational capabilities. The Standard & Poor's credit rating agency also downgraded the U.S. debt credit rating by one level for the first time. In the four weeks to August 21 of that year, the S&P 500 index plummeted 16%. There are already signs in the options market that investors are wary of January. Investigations and Prosecutions of Employing Illegal Immigrants Hit a New High As President Obama vows to promote immigration reform after being re-elected, the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (USICE) inspections of companies employing illegal immigrants in the past fiscal year have reached a new high. This inspection has always been one of the focuses of Obama's immigration policy. The Obama administration supports first checking illegal immigrants in the United States and improving border security, and then comprehensive immigration reform. According to statistics, the number of USICE audits of employers' labor qualification forms has increased from 250 in the 2007 fiscal year to 3,000 in 2012. From the fiscal year 2009 to 2012, the total amount of fines paid by the company increased sharply from 1 million yuan to 13 million yuan. The number of company managers arrested increased to 238. When Obama recently talked about the issue of immigration reform that he would address in his second term, he pointed out that any measures would include imposing fines on companies that deliberately employ illegal immigrants. Although this is not a new position, it may be a policy that Obama will highlight when the authorities begin to work on reforming the immigration system. USICE inspected thousands of companies at that time, and 339 companies were fined in fiscal year 2011. In the 2011 fiscal year, the most recent data obtained by The Associated Press, the median fine was $11,000; Texas led the list with 63 companies fined, followed by New Jersey with 37 companies. It is reported that employers are required by regulations to require employees to fill out the I-9 form to declare that they can work legally in the United States. Currently, employers only need to confirm that the identification documents appear to be authentic documents. The company hunt is part of a $138 million workplace enforcement effort in which USICE agents must go through company payroll rolls one by one to match names that don't match Social Security numbers and other identity databases.
