412cbab65abd5be006c4e33765fb1f188d91de33.translatedText: Three-circle jump picture The performance famous for women's jiu-jitsu shows the limits of human flexibility. A teenage actor bends her body into various shapes, holding a crystal cup with her hands, feet, and mouth to show her flexibility.

b228c8426262c62f4e7a1804e32eafc70d5655db.sourceText: 柔术表演 把一张张普通的椅子，连续叠到7米高，让观众看得一身冷汗，生怕一个闪失，就把叠起来的椅子弄散，把顶上小演员给摔下来。这些杂技演员胆大心细，就是在高空依然表现得泰然自若。在7米高的层叠高椅上依然用身体展现高难度的造型。全场掌声雷动。
b228c8426262c62f4e7a1804e32eafc70d5655db.translatedText: Contortion performance. Ordinary chairs are stacked one after another to a height of 7 meters, which makes the audience sweat. For fear of a mistake, the stacked chairs will be scattered and the little actor on top will fall off. These acrobats are bold and careful, and they still show composure even at high altitudes. On the 7-meter-high stacked high chair, he still uses his body to perform difficult poses. The audience burst into applause.

f21b440a7dac012e9f865b5f5c5ecedb8da02566.sourceText: 凳子高空表演 这些小演员都经过了十几年的超乎想象的训练，他们将有中国传统特色的杂技，音乐，甚至舞狮民俗都带到了凤凰城，无论是中国观众还是美国，墨西哥观众都连连叫绝！墨西哥的空中杂技师们，在高空中进行秋千传递。一家四口人全是空中飞人，姿态优雅地在高空展现各种险象还生的技艺。他们通过不同的秋千，相互连接。空中飞人们从一个秋千跳到另一个秋千，有的甚至还要在空中翻几个筋斗。本周一几乎是亚利桑那最冷的晚上，观众们完全忘记了现场的寒冷，沉静在演员们精湛的技艺中，给凤凰城的寒冷季节带来了难得一见的娱乐享受。
f21b440a7dac012e9f865b5f5c5ecedb8da02566.translatedText: Stool high-altitude performance. These young actors have undergone incredible training for more than ten years. They have brought acrobatics, music, and even lion dance folk customs with Chinese traditional characteristics to Phoenix. Audiences in China, the United States, and Mexico have been wowed! Mexican aerialists perform swing passes high in the air. The family of four are all aerialists, showing off their skills in surviving various dangers at high altitudes gracefully. They are connected to each other through different swings. Trapeze people jump from one swing to another, and some even do several somersaults in the air. This Monday was almost the coldest night in Arizona. The audience completely forgot about the coldness of the scene and remained silent in the superb skills of the actors, bringing a rare entertainment enjoyment to the cold season in Phoenix.

0b8186737be06a6f7548b27faddef36c211bd82a.sourceText: 枪声响不停 上个周末不太平 （亚省时报） 上周五，康涅狄格州西南部钮敦镇（Newtown）的桑迪胡克小学（Sandy Hook Elementary）发生枪击案，造成28人丧生，其中包括20名儿童、学校校长及心理辅导员。20岁的枪手亚当兰扎到学校屠杀前在家枪杀了自己的母亲，到学校猛杀一阵后，在警员到达现场前已自杀身亡。 执法官员表示这是美国历史上最严重的大规模杀戮之一，死亡人数仅次于2007年4月16日维吉尼亚理工学院造成33人死亡的枪击案。 当天晚8:30许，在拉斯维加斯的一家大型赌场酒店-亚瑟王酒店（Excalibur hotel-casino），再发生一起枪击案，一名男子在枪杀一位妇女后，开枪自尽。 阿拉巴马州伯明翰周六接连发生两起枪案，造成连凶手在内的5人死亡以及包括两名警官在内的4人受伤，两案的嫌犯都已遭击毙。 同是16日，印第安纳州一名男子扬言要到住家附近小学犯案杀人，当地警方在他家搜出47把枪枝和弹药之后，已将他逮捕。 印州细得湖警方14日早上获报60岁的梅尔扬言要放火烧死妻子，还说要进入珍包尔小学”大开杀戒”。赶紧前往处理。细得湖位于芝加哥东南约72公里处。 血案发生后，各地政府要求执法单位加强巡逻。部分地区的学校向家长们传达讯息，表示校方正在着手维安事项，或向家长保证，校方会例行检查安全措施。部分学校拒绝讨论维安细节，但可以确定的是，全美各地的学校本周都会高度警戒。
0b8186737be06a6f7548b27faddef36c211bd82a.translatedText: The gunfire kept ringing out, and last weekend was not peaceful (Alberta Times) Last Friday, a shooting occurred at Sandy Hook Elementary School in Newtown, southwestern Connecticut, killing 28 people, including 20 children, the school principal and a psychological counselor. The 20-year-old gunman Adam Lanza shot his mother at home before going to the school to massacre. After going to the school to kill for a while, he committed suicide before the police arrived at the scene. Law enforcement officials said it was one of the worst mass killings in U.S. history, second only to the April 16, 2007 shooting at Virginia Tech that killed 33 people. At about 8:30 that night, another shooting occurred at the Excalibur hotel-casino, a large casino hotel in Las Vegas. A man shot a woman and then shot himself. Two shootings occurred in Birmingham, Alabama on Saturday, killing five people including the murderer and injuring four others, including two police officers. The suspects in both cases were killed. On the same day on the 16th, an Indiana man threatened to commit murder at an elementary school near his home. He was arrested after local police found 47 guns and ammunition at his home. On the morning of the 14th, the police in Lake Sidon, Indiana, received a report that 60-year-old Mel threatened to set fire to his wife and said he would enter Jane Bower Elementary School and "keep killing people." Go and deal with it quickly. Lake Xide is located about 72 kilometers southeast of Chicago. After the murder, local governments asked law enforcement agencies to step up patrols. Schools in some areas have sent messages to parents that the schools are working on security matters, or have assured parents that schools will routinely check safety measures. Some schools declined to discuss security details, but what is certain is that schools across the country will be on high alert this week.

0dc358439ddde78ebba41fd55121142bcbd6eba5.sourceText: (亚省华联供稿) 亚省华联继去年成功举办”2012年亚省华联首届网球公开赛”后，于今年3月9日和3月17日分别在 Chandler High School 和 Hamilton High School 又一次成功举办了”第二届亚省华联网球公开赛”。本次比赛吸引了30多名网球选手的参加，参赛选手年龄跨度大，最小的参赛选手只有12岁，最大的参赛选手近60岁。此次网球公开赛为网球爱好者提供了一个平台，各路好手汇聚一堂，利用这个难得的机会，再次享受了网球的乐趣。 此次网球公开赛由亚省华联主办。亚省华联董事王惟咨召集并协同李教练和张海标一起为公开赛提供了专业的赛事组织：包括赛程的编排，赛的格式和规则，等。亚省华联和本届公开赛的组织者感谢所有参赛的球员, 也特别感谢 Professional Tennis Management, PTM, Services (www.tennislessonsaz.com) 为本次网球公开赛提供赞助。 比赛从小组循环， 复赛，到决赛经过两个周末的激烈争夺，各个组别冠亚军各有归属。现将比赛结果公布如下。 男子单打：冠军-张海标，亚军-朱霆 男子双打：冠军-王惟咨/Mike Liu，亚军-朱霆/Jason Leong 女子单打：冠军-Thi Diep，亚军-佐藤女士 混合双打：冠军-Thi Diep/Fuyou Liu，亚军-佐藤女士/Jason Leong
0dc358439ddde78ebba41fd55121142bcbd6eba5.translatedText: (Contributed by the Alberta Hualian) After successfully hosting the "2012 Alberta Hualien First Tennis Open" last year, the Alberta Hualian Association held the 2012 Alberta Hualian Tennis Open at Chandler High School and Hamilton High School respectively on March 9 and March 17 this year. The "Second Asia Hualien Tennis Open" was once again successfully held. This competition attracted the participation of more than 30 tennis players, with a wide age range. The youngest player was only 12 years old, and the oldest player was nearly 60 years old. This tennis open provided a platform for tennis enthusiasts to gather together and take advantage of this rare opportunity to enjoy the fun of tennis again. The Tennis Open was hosted by the Alberta Hualien. Wang Weizi, the director of the Alberta Hualian, worked with Coach Li and Zhang Haibiao to provide professional event organization: including the arrangement of the schedule, the format and rules of the competition, etc. The Alberta Hualian and the organizers of this open would also like to thank Professional Tennis Management, PTM, Services (www.tennislessonsaz.com) for sponsoring this tennis open. After two weekends of fierce competition in the semi-finals, the championship and runner-up of each group are determined. The results of the competition are now announced as follows. Men's singles: Champion-Zhang Haibiao, runner-up-Zhu Ting. Men's doubles: Champion-Wang Weizi/Mike Liu, runner-up-Zhu Ting/Jason Leong. Women's singles: champion-Thi Diep, runner-up-Ms. Sato. Mixed doubles: champion-Thi Diep/Fuyou Liu, runner-up-Ms. Sato/Jason. Leong

5aa6cb21ed47a1d50a98e7f7f64cc7cd2f30974c.sourceText: —记亚省现代中文学校2020—2021秋季新学年开学
5aa6cb21ed47a1d50a98e7f7f64cc7cd2f30974c.translatedText: —Remember the start of the new academic year of the Modern Chinese School in Alberta in the fall of 2020-2021

e53d42d4dbf010e1e28eb08d2aa06e34cb2ce9d5.sourceText: 公元 2020，庚子鼠年，这一年因为一场突如其来的疫情，改变了每个人的生活……在这已经注定充满挑战的一年里，亚省现代中文学校全体师生勇于创新与改变，积极应对新形势新情况，以网课为载 体，圆满完成春季所有教学项目。如今，暑假已过，伴随 8 月初秋的脚步，依然炎炎烈日的亚省迎来新学年开学季。
e53d42d4dbf010e1e28eb08d2aa06e34cb2ce9d5.translatedText: AD 2020 is the Year of the Rat. This year, due to a sudden epidemic, everyone's life has changed... In this year that is already destined to be full of challenges, all teachers and students of the Alberta Modern Chinese School have the courage to innovate and change, actively respond to new situations and new situations, and use online courses as a carrier to successfully complete all spring teaching projects. Now, the summer vacation has passed, and with the footsteps of early autumn in August, the province is still facing the scorching sun and ushering in the beginning of the new school year.

668301476c41471d2b3144af05e2df7178ec7877.sourceText: 以“保障师生身体健康与生命安全”为最大考量，新一届选举产生的董事会和校委会成员意见高度一致，果断决定，新学年全部采用“网上课程”教学。虽然有春季网课成功的教学经验可循，但重磅推出整学年季的一系列网络课程学习，在课程设置、网络支持、行政管理、资源分配、教学多样化等各方面，学校领导、老师及义工都面临众多未知的挑战。幸运的是，不服输的现代人始终坚信，办法总比困难多，在新任董事长杨轶伦的支持鼓励下，在新任校长安然的领导带动下，所有现代人各司其职，各尽其责，迅速开展开学的各项准备工作。
668301476c41471d2b3144af05e2df7178ec7877.translatedText: Taking "protecting the health and life safety of teachers and students" as the biggest consideration, the newly elected members of the board of directors and school committee have highly unanimous opinions and decisively decided to adopt "online courses" for teaching in the new school year. Although there are successful teaching experiences for spring online courses to follow, the launch of a series of online courses throughout the school year has posed many unknown challenges for school leaders, teachers and volunteers in terms of curriculum, network support, administrative management, resource allocation, teaching diversification and other aspects. Fortunately, the modern people who refused to admit defeat always believed that there were always more solutions than difficulties. With the support and encouragement of the new chairman Yang Yilun, and the leadership of the new principal An Ran, all modern people performed their duties and fulfilled their responsibilities, and quickly started various preparations for the start of the school year.

eb75ee3db5ffd08b90937d149e56d430ee1d1f99.sourceText: 7 月 9 日，校长组织召开各教学组组长会议，讨论新学期各类课 程设置。7 月 16 日，明确继续开设中文、数学、AP 辅导、SAT 辅导等多门基础课程，在课外活动课方面，受限于网络教学模式，很多互动体验型兴趣课开课遇阻，经过多方沟通与努力，借鉴以往网课的成功经验，决定继续开展儿童舞蹈，成人舞蹈，舞蹈健身，美术，武术，公共演讲及英文写作课程，同时，积极回应家长要求，特聘计算机专 家增设 Python 编程课程。
eb75ee3db5ffd08b90937d149e56d430ee1d1f99.translatedText: On July 9, the principal organized a meeting of the leaders of each teaching group to discuss various curriculum settings for the new semester. On July 16, it was made clear that many basic courses such as Chinese, mathematics, AP tutoring, and SAT tutoring would continue to be offered. In terms of extracurricular activity classes, due to the online teaching model, many interactive and experiential interest classes were blocked from opening. After multi-party communication and efforts, and drawing on the successful experience of previous online classes, it was decided to continue to offer children’s dance, adult dance, dance fitness, art, martial arts, public speaking and English writing courses. At the same time, in active response to parents’ requests, specially hired computer experts were hired to add Python programming courses.

8a2050ace31987e3c0c50c5625a6eb11968895cc.sourceText: 7 月 25 日，现代中文学校召开全体教师线上会议暨新学期教师培训大会，董事长杨轶伦出席会议并讲话，校长安然及分管各项教学工作的副校长先后发言，积极安排部署各项开学事宜。会上，所有老师达成共识，在保障安全的前提下，要尽一切努力提高网课质量，让学生们像回到曾经的教室里一样，和老师同学们愉快的学习与交流。
8a2050ace31987e3c0c50c5625a6eb11968895cc.translatedText: On July 25, Modern Chinese School held an online meeting for all teachers and a new semester teacher training conference. Chairman Yang Yilun attended the meeting and delivered a speech. Principal An Ran and the vice principal in charge of various teaching tasks spoke successively and actively arranged and deployed various matters for the start of the school year. At the meeting, all teachers reached a consensus that under the premise of ensuring safety, they should make every effort to improve the quality of online classes so that students can learn and communicate happily with teachers and classmates as if they were back in the classroom.

82e328cc1501c85123d7c5da1ea7c90330a57a7c.sourceText: 同日，现代中文学校秋季招生开放网上注册报名。不同于以往开学日的现场咨询与注册，秋季学年的所有报名流程都在网上完成。在这个过程中，网络服务的义工团队牺牲了大量的个人休息时间升级维护网站，解答来自老师和家长们的各类技术问题。
82e328cc1501c85123d7c5da1ea7c90330a57a7c.translatedText: On the same day, the Modern Chinese School’s autumn enrollment will open for online registration. Unlike previous on-site consultation and registration on the first day of school, all registration processes for the fall academic year are completed online. During this process, the network service volunteer team sacrificed a lot of personal rest time to upgrade and maintain the website and answer various technical questions from teachers and parents.

8c88daf65ac38f04d3308ad1702d075f4aec1f42.sourceText: 8 月 1 日，中文学校开展新学年课程教材首次现场售卖活动，为 方便家长购买，特别开设了南北两处售书点。安然校长驱车上百英里， 取回需要的教材，而售书的义工团队更是不畏酷暑，在炎炎烈日下快 速分配教材，热情耐心地为每一位家长服务。义工们的真心付出得到 了家长们的称赞，一句“谢谢义工们，一分钟就能取到教材，太方便 了！”让所有的工作人员得到最大的支持与鼓励！第二次现场售书活 动即将在 8 月 16 日上午七点在 ASU 校园举行。
8c88daf65ac38f04d3308ad1702d075f4aec1f42.translatedText: On August 1, the Chinese school held its first on-site sales event of course materials for the new school year. To facilitate parents’ purchase, two book sales points were opened in the north and south. Principal An Ran drove hundreds of miles to retrieve the required teaching materials, and the book-selling volunteer team braved the scorching heat, quickly distributed teaching materials under the scorching sun, and served every parent enthusiastically and patiently. The sincere dedication of the volunteers was praised by parents, who said "Thank you volunteers, you can get the teaching materials in one minute, it is so convenient!" This gave all staff the greatest support and encouragement! The second in-person book signing event will be held on the ASU campus on August 16 at 7 a.m.

67d68b741255325238ab9e45c5257e1f2d267858.sourceText: 在一系列的精心筹备下，终于迎来了 8 月 8 日，2020 年金秋新一季开学日。在我们最熟悉最亲切的家里，各科老师带着精彩有趣的第一堂课，以最饱满的精神状态和最灿烂的笑容出现在电脑屏幕上，看见孩子们一张张可爱的笑脸，隔着屏幕就能感受师生间最真实的期待与欣喜！
67d68b741255325238ab9e45c5257e1f2d267858.translatedText: After a series of careful preparations, August 8th is finally ushered in, the opening day of the new golden autumn season of 2020. In our most familiar and friendly home, teachers from various subjects gave wonderful and interesting first lessons, appeared on the computer screen with the fullest mental state and the brightest smiles. Seeing the lovely smiling faces of the children, you can feel the truest expectations and joy between teachers and students through the screen!

1e7432e6f3b0088d17618e714518741d43745c5c.sourceText: 中文教学组组长高老师在开学当日表示，开课前，老师们做了大量的学习准备，如何把课件做的新颖有趣，重点突出；如何在网络课堂上利用语音和肢体语言展现亲和力；如何熟练操作教学软件等很多细节，大家都反推敲琢磨，力求做到最好！数学教学组组长单老师告诉我们，课堂上每个人都很专注认真，能听到的都是同学们积极回答老师提问的声音，没有任何其他杂音，
1e7432e6f3b0088d17618e714518741d43745c5c.translatedText: Teacher Gao, the leader of the Chinese teaching group, said on the opening day of the school year that before the start of the class, the teachers had made a lot of preparations for learning, including how to make the courseware novel, interesting and focused; how to use voice and body language to show affinity in the online classroom; how to skillfully operate the teaching software and many other details. Everyone worked hard and worked hard to do the best! Teacher Shan, the leader of the mathematics teaching group, told us that everyone in the class was very focused and serious, and all that could be heard were the voices of students actively answering the teacher’s questions without any other noise.

e7f986aa6ab14e420cc0ebe24affe2bcd3b4bacf.sourceText: 暨 南 六 班 曾 老 师 说 ： “ 我 们 班 的 同 学 不 仅 全 员 到 齐 ， 而 且 准 时 上 线 ， 课 间 休 息 的 时 候 ， 我 看 见 有 个 同 学 帮 弟 弟 调 试 上 课 设 备 ， 觉 得 很 欣 慰 ， 孩 子 们 都 在 互 相 帮 助 ， 我 们 也 要 共 同 努 力 ， 不 忘 初 心 ， 砥 砺 前 行 ！ ” 暨 南 一 班 的 李 老 师 说 ： “ 微 信 群 ， 邮 件 组 ， imessage, 网 上 多 媒 体 ， 我 用 更 细 致 的 工 作 来 弥 补 一 些 互 动 障 碍 ， 第 一 次 以 ZOOM 开 启 新 学 期 ， 这 一 脚 总 算 成 功 踢 出 去 了 ！ ” 双 双 五 班 的 袁 老 师 说 ： “ 第 一 节 课 虽 然 有 些 小 插 曲 ， 但 圆 满 完 成 教 学 任 务 ， 今 天 学 习 古 诗 ， 还 教 了 孩 子 们 古 诗 手 语 操 ， 很 有 成 就 感 ！ ” 拼 音 班 王 老 师 说 ： “ 小 朋 友 们 发 言 声 音 洪 亮 ， 积 极 互 动 ， 能 量 满 满 ， 我 期 待 未 来 几 个 月 与 孩 子 们 一 起 学 习 与 成 长 ！ ” 数 学 一 班 徐 老 师 说 ： “ 我 提 前 录 制 了 趣 味 视 频 ， 和 同 学 们 共 享 联 动 ， 在 这 个 ‘ 空 中 课 堂 ’ 上 ， 尽 量 做 到 让 学 生 有 回 到 教 室 上 课 的 感 觉 。 ”
e7f986aa6ab14e420cc0ebe24affe2bcd3b4bacf.translatedText: Jinnan Class 6 Teacher Zeng said: “Not only are all the students in our class here, but they are also online on time, and there are breaks between classes. At that time, I saw a classmate helping his younger brother adjust the class equipment, and I felt very relieved. The children were helping each other, and we must work together, not forgetting the original intention, and moving forward!” Jinan Yi! Teacher Li from the class said: "I used more detailed work to make up for some interaction obstacles in WeChat groups, email groups, imessage, and online multimedia. I started the new semester with ZOOM for the first time, and this kick was finally kicked out successfully. "Yes!" Teacher Yuan from Class 5 of Shuangshuang said: "Although there were some hiccups in the first class, I successfully completed the teaching task. I learned ancient poetry today and also taught the children the ancient poetry sign language exercises. I have a great sense of accomplishment!" Teacher Wang from the Music Class said: "The children spoke loudly, interacted actively, and were full of energy. I look forward to learning and growing with the children in the next few months!" Teacher Xu from the Mathematics Class 1 said: "I recorded in advance. We made interesting videos and shared them with our classmates. In this ‘air classroom’, we tried our best to make students feel like they were back in the classroom.”

061d6c0e4671744bb47d6ff1e0c728258be665a3.sourceText: 这就是“现代”！教学地点变了，授课方法变了，互动模式变了，但，现代中文学校全心全力为家长和学生们服务的宗旨没有变！各科授课老师们专业的业务能力和认真负责的教学态度没有变！来自各行各业的义工团队各显其能无私奉献的精神也没有变！这是特殊的开学日，也是载入现代校史的不平凡的开学日！这一天，创造历史的现代人元气满满，以乘风破浪的勇气开启了新的航程，也许前路波涛汹涌，风雨难测，但现代人始终相信，长风破浪会有时，直挂云帆济沧海！
061d6c0e4671744bb47d6ff1e0c728258be665a3.translatedText: This is “modern”! The teaching location has changed, the teaching methods have changed, and the interaction mode has changed, but the purpose of Modern Chinese School to serve parents and students wholeheartedly has not changed! The professional professional abilities and serious and responsible teaching attitude of teachers in various subjects have not changed! The volunteer team from all walks of life shows their selfless dedication and the spirit has not changed! This is a special opening day, and it is also an extraordinary opening day that will be recorded in modern school history! On this day, the modern people who created history are full of energy and start a new voyage with the courage to ride the wind and waves. The road ahead may be rough and windy and unpredictable, but modern people always believe that there will be times when the wind and waves break, and the sails will rise to the sea!

5f780f394b8ab0834620ec721972f5a4472bdba2.sourceText: 这里有爱，一切让我们期待！如果你也愿意同心筑梦，做现代人！到现代来
5f780f394b8ab0834620ec721972f5a4472bdba2.translatedText: There is love here, and we have everything to look forward to! If you are also willing to work together to build your dream, be a modern person! Come to modern times

729b4476b6ed1cf19e9c8a43dbe4e11118ecb904.sourceText: （ 刘国泰报道 ）3月27日，近百名纪念大厦的居民齐聚大厅，他们每人面前都有一碗热腾腾香喷喷的豆腐脑及甜香酥美的点心。这不是聚会或会餐，而是纪念大厦居委会一年一度的改选。纪念大厦居委会为大厦居民热情的服务赢得了很好的口碑以及大家的肯定。值此改选之际，刘洪钧老人連亱趕做了这些精美的食品让大家品尝。 一年来，居委会为大厦居民组织了丰富多姿的活动。大厅几乎每晚都有不同的节目。在兼职教练和热心人士的率领下，周一到周三是健身操和走秀活动，晚饭后老人们轻松地在一起活动筋骨。周四的交际舞和卡拉ok也甚受人欢迎。老人们或单或双翩翩起舞，许多不会跳舞的人围坐观看也是一种享受，周五歌唱团的活动给老人们一展歌喉的机会。大家还学唱英文歌曲，在娱乐中学习英语和了解美国历史，大大丰富了老人们的文化生活。他们还常常被邀请去社区活动或大型庆祝活动中表演。每逢感恩节，圣诞节及中国新年等重大节日，居委会还组织居民举办自助餐及交谊活动，这其间老人们八仙过海，各显神通，纷纷将各自最拿手的菜肴亮出来与大家分享，南北菜肴的汇集给节日增添了更加喜庆的风采。2013年居委会还组织了国际麻将公开赛，诸多高手尽展风采，于娱乐之中去探索中国麻将的文化魅力。 居委会还促使居民与大厦经理之间的沟通，这里的老人大多数不懂英语，一些懂英文的居民义务地帮助其他居民翻译有关资料和通知，成为居民与大厦经理之间的语言桥梁。居委会还请来ASU的大学生每周来大厦为居民提供语言帮助。并且居委会还在居民亲友來訪，改進对居民的生活服务及保护居民权益等方面做了大量工作。 大家对居委会有着很深的感情，称之为”咱们的居委会”。在此改选之际，居民们郑重地投下自己宝贵的一票，选举出新一届居民委员会成员： 主任：李爱珍 副主任：Arnold 书记：谢大卫 财务：罗培英 Sergeant of Arms： 林玉琪 选举结束后，热烈的掌声祝愿居委会的工作在2014年百尺竿头，更进一步！
729b4476b6ed1cf19e9c8a43dbe4e11118ecb904.translatedText: (Reported by Liu Guotai) ) On March 27, nearly a hundred residents of the Memorial Building gathered in the lobby. In front of each of them was a bowl of hot and fragrant tofu puffs and sweet and crispy snacks. This is not a party or a dinner, but a commemoration of the annual re-election of the neighborhood committee of the building. The Memorial Building Neighborhood Committee has won a good reputation and recognition from everyone for its enthusiastic service to the residents of the building. On the occasion of the re-election, old man Liu Hongjun rushed to prepare these exquisite foods for everyone to taste. Over the past year, the neighborhood committee has organized a variety of activities for building residents. The hall has a different program almost every night. Led by part-time coaches and enthusiastic people, there are aerobics and catwalk activities from Monday to Wednesday. After dinner, the elderly can relax and stretch their muscles together. Ballroom dancing and karaoke on Thursdays are also popular. The old people danced singly or in pairs, and it was a pleasure for many people who couldn't dance to sit around and watch. The singing group's activities on Friday gave the old people a chance to show off their singing voices. Everyone also learned to sing English songs, learn English and understand American history through entertainment, which greatly enriched the cultural life of the elderly. They are also often invited to perform at community events or large celebrations. During major festivals such as Thanksgiving, Christmas, and Chinese New Year, the neighborhood committee also organizes buffets and social activities for residents. During this period, the elderly people cross the sea, show their magical powers, and share their best dishes with everyone. The collection of northern and southern dishes adds a more festive style to the festival. In 2013, the neighborhood committee also organized the International Mahjong Open, where many masters showed off their talents and explored the cultural charm of Chinese mahjong in entertainment. The neighborhood committee also promotes communication between residents and building managers. Most of the elderly here do not understand English. Some residents who understand English volunteer to help other residents translate relevant information and notices, becoming a language bridge between residents and building managers. The neighborhood committee also invites college students from ASU to come to the building every week to provide language assistance to residents. In addition, the neighborhood committee has also done a lot of work in terms of visiting residents' relatives and friends, improving residents' daily services and protecting residents' rights and interests. Everyone has deep feelings for the neighborhood committee and calls it "our neighborhood committee." On the occasion of this re-election, the residents solemnly cast their precious votes to elect the new members of the residents committee: Director: Li Aizhen Deputy Director: Arnold Secretary: David Xie Finance: Luo Peiying Sergeant of Arms: Lin Yuqi After the election, warm applause was given to wish the work of the neighborhood committee will make great progress in 2014 and make further progress!

2686d681f2236b0752fc24ff22cecb58e60b2c07.sourceText: 一小时之前，刚刚飞机落地西雅图。正等待转机， 突然收到一个不相识人的微信， 转发了这张红楼梦庆典活动时我和王立平老先生和陈力的合影。 6月17日早上， 我们和参加红楼梦三十周年庆典活动的亲友们一起， 在北京植物园曹雪芹纪念馆参加红楼梦剧组庆祝活动。 正兴致勃勃观看时，忽然，一个手持专业相机的年轻人走到我身边， 说：”我是今天活动的摄影记者。真羡慕你啊， 你一定和王立平老师和陈力老师认识吧？ 我抓拍了一张你们刚才在一起的合影。方便的话，请加我微信， 我会尽快把照片传给你”。 这两天忙忙碌碌，居然把这件事忘记了。没想到， 这位记者真的兑现了承诺。到底是专业记者，明显地， 这张照片的效果，比我朋友现场手机抢拍的同一镜头的照片好很多。 意外惊喜，加倍开心[Heart] 6-19-2017，于西雅图
2686d681f2236b0752fc24ff22cecb58e60b2c07.translatedText: just landed in Seattle an hour ago. I was waiting for my next flight when I suddenly received a WeChat message from an unknown person who forwarded this photo of myself, Mr. Wang Liping and Chen Li during the Dream of Red Mansions celebration. On the morning of June 17, together with our relatives and friends who were participating in the 30th anniversary celebration of Dream of Red Mansions, we participated in the celebration of the crew of Dream of Red Mansions at the Cao Xueqin Memorial Hall in the Beijing Botanical Garden. While I was watching with interest, suddenly, a young man holding a professional camera came up to me and said, "I am the photojournalist for today's event. I really envy you. You must know Teacher Wang Liping and Teacher Chen Li, right? I captured a photo of you together just now. If it is convenient, please add me on WeChat and I will send the photo to you as soon as possible." I have been so busy these past two days that I actually forgot about this matter. Unexpectedly, this reporter really fulfilled his promise. After all, he is a professional reporter. Obviously, the effect of this photo is much better than the photo of the same lens that my friend took with his mobile phone at the scene. Unexpected surprise, doubly happy [Heart] 6-19-2017, in Seattle

45cd97bfb7443b8aa044803ed4a57c586a76b5af.sourceText: 全美资不抵债屋最多五个州 内华达州最惨 专家一般认为，美国房市已逐渐脱离底部，未来几年可望缓慢复苏。但根据房地产分析机构CoreLogic本月公布的报告显示， 2012年第一季底全美屋不抵债的房子(或溺水屋)仍高达1,140万户(23.7%)。 自2006年房市泡沫破灭以来，美国房价已下跌32.6%。全美房贷屋的总房价是12.2万亿美元，房贷金额是8.6万亿美元，换言之，房贷户的贷 款金额占房价总值约70.5%。但在美国有5个州，该比例达(或超过)80%，以下是美国财经网站《24/7 Wall St.》根据CoreLogic这份报告的数据，汇整了全美5个屋不抵债情况最严重的州: 1. 内华达州 屋不抵债比率:61.2% 总房价:933.9亿美元(全美第23低) 房贷余额:1,064.5亿美元(第21高) 房贷违约90天比率:12.1%(第2高) 在美国，没有一个州的房价跌幅超过内华达州，在2006~2011年期间，房价跌幅近60%，较全美平均跌幅超出7.2%，光2011年房价就进一步下跌了9.4%。这让该州的房贷占房价的比率达114%。据统计，该州的拉斯维加斯房价跌幅最惨，在2006~2011年期间下跌了63.2%。该州的失业率高 达11.6%，全美最高。 2. 佛州 屋不抵债比率:45.1% 总房价:7,773.4亿美元(全美第3高) 房贷余额:6,849.7亿美元(第2高) 房贷违约90天比率:16.8%(全美最高) 在2006~2011年期间，佛州房价下跌近50%。在今年第一季底，屋不抵债者达190万户，房贷接近违约者为16.8万户。该州的房贷余额达6,，580亿美元，在全美仅次于加州。佛州的失业率达8.6%，也超过全美平均的8.2%。 3. 亚利桑那州 屋不抵债比率:43.4% 总房价:2,491.7亿美元(全美第17高) 房贷余额:2,217.1亿美元(第15高) 房贷违约90天比率:5.8%(第20高) 该州的房价在2000年代中期蓬勃发展，直到2007~2008年开始走下波，凯斯-席勒预测2012年亚利桑那州的房价将再下跌9%。尽管已有一些迹象显示该州房市开始复苏，例如房价在2011年第四季到2012年首季上升60亿美元，同期间房贷余额也降低45亿美元，但屋不抵债比例却高达48.3%， 为全美第二高。 4. 乔治亚州 屋不抵债比率:37.2% 总房价:2,930.1亿美元(全美第15高) 房贷余额:2,465.2亿美元(第11高) 房贷违约90天比率:7.2%(第8高) 2011年该州房价下跌12.7%，跌幅居全美之冠。从2006年底起算，房价下跌了近35%，预计2012年将再下跌4.2%。该州在四月份超过7%的房贷户违约，总房贷余额为2,465.2亿美元，约占整体房价的84.1%，是全美房贷占房价比例第4高的州。 5. 密西根州 屋不抵债比率:35.6% 总房价:1,931.5亿美元(全美第18高) 房贷余额:1,612.4亿美元(第18高) 房贷违约90天比率:5.5%(第24高) 尽管屋不抵债的比例超过1/3，但密西根州仍有一些亮点:2011年房价上涨1.7%，五月份的失业率为8.5%，也较2010年6月份的15%大幅降低。
45cd97bfb7443b8aa044803ed4a57c586a76b5af.translatedText: The five states with the most insolvent housing in the United States, Nevada is the worst. Experts generally believe that the U.S. housing market has gradually left the bottom and is expected to recover slowly in the next few years. However, according to a report released this month by real estate analysis agency CoreLogic, at the end of the first quarter of 2012, the number of insolvent houses (or drowning houses) in the United States was still as high as 11.4 million (23.7%). Since the housing bubble burst in 2006, U.S. home prices have fallen 32.6%. The total housing prices of mortgage households in the United States are US$12.2 trillion, and the amount of mortgage loans is US$8.6 trillion. In other words, the loan amount of mortgage households accounts for approximately 70.5% of the total housing value. However, there are 5 states in the United States where the ratio reaches (or exceeds) 80%. The following is a summary of the 5 states with the worst housing insolvency in the United States based on the CoreLogic report by the U.S. financial website "24/7 Wall St.": 1. Nevada House insolvency ratio: 61.2% Total house price: $93.39 billion (23rd lowest in the United States) Mortgage balance: $106.45 billion (21st highest) 90-day mortgage default rate: 12.1% (second highest) In the United States, no state has experienced a greater decline in housing prices than Nevada. Between 2006 and 2011, housing prices fell by nearly 60%, exceeding the national average decline of 7.2%. In 2011 alone, housing prices fell by a further 9.4%. This brings the state’s mortgage-to-home price ratio to 114%. According to statistics, the state's Las Vegas housing prices experienced the worst decline, falling 63.2% between 2006 and 2011. The state's unemployment rate is as high as 11.6%, the highest in the United States. 2. Florida Home insolvency ratio: 45.1% Total housing prices: $777.34 billion (third highest in the United States) Mortgage balance: $684.97 billion (second highest) 90-day mortgage default rate: 16.8% (highest in the United States) Between 2006 and 2011, Florida home prices fell by nearly 50%. At the end of the first quarter of this year, 1.9 million households were unable to pay their housing debt, and 168,000 households were close to defaulting on their mortgage loans. The state's mortgage balance reaches $658 billion, second only to California in the United States. Florida's unemployment rate is 8.6%, which is higher than the national average of 8.2%. 3. Arizona Home insolvency ratio: 43.4% Total house prices: $249.17 billion (17th highest in the United States) Mortgage balance: $221.71 billion (15th highest) 90-day mortgage default rate: 5.8% (20th highest) Home prices in the state boomed in the mid-2000s until they began to falter in 2007-2008, and Case-Shiller predicts Arizona home prices will fall another 9 percent in 2012. Although there are some signs that the state's housing market is beginning to recover. For example, house prices increased by US$6 billion from the fourth quarter of 2011 to the first quarter of 2012, and the mortgage balance also decreased by US$4.5 billion during the same period, the housing insolvency rate is as high as 48.3%, the second highest in the United States. 4. Georgia Home insolvency ratio: 37.2% Total housing prices: $293.01 billion (15th highest in the United States) Mortgage balance: $246.52 billion (11th highest) 90-day mortgage default rate: 7.2% (8th highest) In 2011, housing prices in the state fell by 12.7%, the highest decline in the United States. Since the end of 2006, house prices have fallen by nearly 35% and are expected to fall by another 4.2% in 2012. More than 7% of the state's mortgage households defaulted in April, and the total mortgage balance was US$246.52 billion, accounting for approximately 84.1% of the overall housing price. It is the fourth-highest ratio of mortgage loans to housing prices in the United States. 5. Michigan Home insolvency ratio: 35.6% Total house prices: $193.15 billion (18th highest in the United States) Mortgage balance: $161.24 billion (18th highest) 90-day mortgage default rate: 5.5% (24th highest) Although more than one-third of the houses are insolvent, there are still some bright spots in Michigan: house prices rose by 1.7% in 2011, and the unemployment rate in May was 8.5%, which was also significantly lower than the 15% in June 2010.

666cbaa2c64229d37cb76e89632d7fecbe03f49a.sourceText: 《凤凰之夜》海报设计大赛摄影比赛拉开序幕(图) 第六届《凤凰之夜》庆祝中华人民共和国成立63周年国庆招待会暨中秋佳节将于2012年9月23日在亚利桑那州立大学隆重举行。本次活动由孔子学院举办的八年级以下的海报设计比赛以及中学到大学学生的摄影比赛拉开序幕。如果您有绘画和摄影的天份就请按照活动的要求参加比赛吧！ 活动的截止日期为9月3日 获奖作品将于9月23日展出
666cbaa2c64229d37cb76e89632d7fecbe03f49a.translatedText: "Phoenix Night" poster design competition photography competition kicked off (picture) The 6th "Phoenix Night" celebration of the 63rd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China and the Mid-Autumn Festival will be held grandly at Arizona State University on September 23, 2012. The event kicked off with a poster design competition for eighth grade students and below and a photography competition for students from middle school to university organized by the Confucius Institute. If you have talent in painting and photography, please follow the requirements of the event and participate in the competition! The deadline for the event is September 3rd and the winning works will be exhibited on September 23rd

5f04e0a690bccf2be9e1f8deb5ceb961faf5216b.sourceText: 编者按：母爱伟大，古今中外概莫能外。为了孩子，母亲可以牺牲一切，包括生命。这样的动人故事，在美国俄克拉何马州发生了。年仅 41 岁的斯黛西身患癌症，但为了腹中的孩子，毅然放弃化疗。孩子终于平安降生了，但斯黛西却在 3 天后离世。
5f04e0a690bccf2be9e1f8deb5ceb961faf5216b.translatedText: Editor's note: Mother's love is great, and it is unparalleled at all times and in all countries. For the sake of her children, a mother can sacrifice everything, including her life. Such a touching story happened in Oklahoma, USA. Stacey, who was only 41 years old, suffered from cancer, but decided to give up chemotherapy for the sake of her unborn child. The baby was finally born safely, but Stacey died 3 days later.

41220e70d712867800cb9d83f267a3ad5991cd86.sourceText: 斯黛西的兄嫂将斯黛西刚出生的女儿多蒂送到她身边。
41220e70d712867800cb9d83f267a3ad5991cd86.translatedText: Stacey's brother and sister-in-law sent Stacey's newborn daughter Dottie to her.

410b4908d6f0c64e1e9b7350b1c8ee0ca645953c.sourceText: 17 日，英国《每日邮报》报道了这个感人的故事。 Mitbbs.com
410b4908d6f0c64e1e9b7350b1c8ee0ca645953c.translatedText: On the 17th, the British "Daily Mail" reported this touching story. Mitbbs.com

7a2003fee5aef58916265d359aa80c2ca7e8a53c.sourceText: 怀孕了却患癌症，她做出了选择。 Mitbbs.com
7a2003fee5aef58916265d359aa80c2ca7e8a53c.translatedText: She was pregnant but had cancer. She made a choice. Mitbbs.com

868694226d46b652183797a331eaac7e2947b0d3.sourceText: 斯黛西曾被医生告知，她不可能怀孕。但今年 3 月，传来了不可思议的消息：她怀孕了！ Mitbb
868694226d46b652183797a331eaac7e2947b0d3.translatedText: Stacey was told by doctors that it was impossible for her to become pregnant. But in March of this year, incredible news came: She was pregnant! Mitbb

792953adc80f8867bbb8ded45d439a64935eee14.sourceText: 据《俄克拉何马人》报道，斯黛西充满欢笑和泪水，告诉他的兄弟菲利普：” 太令人无法相信了！”
792953adc80f8867bbb8ded45d439a64935eee14.translatedText: According to The Oklahoman, filled with laughter and tears, Stacey told his brother Philip: "It's unbelievable!"

d492dae529245139e396c73ff4ee7b99b9c6008d.sourceText: 但是，在接下来的几天和几周，正当斯黛西欢快地为未来的宝宝采购衣物和用品时，不幸发生了，她出现严重的头疼和视觉双影，体内每一寸地方都在振颤。斯黛西开始告诉菲利普：” 我很担心这个孩子。我希望自己能活得足够长，好生下这个孩子。但如果发生了什么事，请你抚养这个孩子。” Mitbbs.com
d492dae529245139e396c73ff4ee7b99b9c6008d.translatedText: But in the following days and weeks, as Stacy was happily shopping for clothes and supplies for her future baby, tragedy struck. She developed severe headaches and double vision, and every inch of her body was vibrating. Stacey began to tell Philip: "I'm worried about this baby. I hope I live long enough to have this baby. But if something happens, please raise this baby." Mitbbs.com

bb1a7d5ae8c321a7fb6a286b21214e2947e48f20.sourceText: 在家人的鼓励下，斯黛西在 7 月份看了好几个医生。但不幸的是， CT 扫描结果证实，她患了头颈癌。 Mitbbs.com
bb1a7d5ae8c321a7fb6a286b21214e2947e48f20.translatedText: With the encouragement of her family, Stacy saw several doctors in July. But unfortunately, a CT scan confirmed she had head and neck cancer. Mitbbs.com

52fd04f340f4fbbaa8b835def937059e169b8ae5.sourceText: 这样，斯黛西必须要做出选择：是自己保命还是生下孩子。菲利普告诉《俄克拉何马人》，斯黛西放弃了可能保命的化疗，而要生出孩子。 Mitbbs.com
52fd04f340f4fbbaa8b835def937059e169b8ae5.translatedText: In this way, Stacey must make a choice: save her own life or give birth to a child. Phillip told The Oklahoman that Stacy gave up potentially life-saving chemotherapy to have the baby. Mitbbs.com

9ec552b39b625dbec3893ee31faaab933a4162e2.sourceText: 在 8 月 16 日，斯黛西在家中摔倒，被立即送往俄克拉何马城医疗中心。 医生说，癌细胞已经侵犯了脑干。 两天后，胎儿心率下降，斯黛西心跳停止。医生和护士立即做出唯一能挽救孩子的决定：剖腹产取出孩子。于是，婴儿多蒂降生到这个世界，尽管只有新生儿平均体重的三分之一。多蒂被迅速进行新生儿特殊护理，而斯黛西也被送到另一个诊楼进行特殊治疗。 Mitbbs.com
9ec552b39b625dbec3893ee31faaab933a4162e2.translatedText: On August 16, Stacey fell at her home and was rushed to Oklahoma City Medical Center. The doctor said that the cancer cells had invaded the brain stem. Two days later, the fetal heart rate dropped and Stacey's heart stopped. Doctors and nurses immediately made the only decision that could save the baby: perform a caesarean section to remove the baby. So baby Dotty was born into the world, albeit only one-third the weight of an average newborn. Dottie was rushed into special neonatal care, and Stacey was sent to another clinic for special treatment. Mitbbs.com

704bf6970e89ba363780b716a05cbe322e7e73c6.sourceText: 孩子出生 3 天后，她满足地走了 Mitbbs.com
704bf6970e89ba363780b716a05cbe322e7e73c6.translatedText: Three days after the baby was born, she passed away contentedly Mitbbs.com

7ae57b20c5009c8fd242d13dbfc36f497ec6e48e.sourceText: 菲利普说，他妹妹斯黛西在那儿垂死挣扎，她几乎奄奄一息。 几天后，斯黛西从死神那里被夺回，她甚至一度想去掉呼吸机。菲利普说，这一时刻，他甚至看到了发生巨大奇迹的希望。 Mitbbsm
7ae57b20c5009c8fd242d13dbfc36f497ec6e48e.translatedText: Philip said his sister Stacey was dying there, she was almost dying. A few days later, Stacey was recaptured from death, and she even wanted to be removed from the ventilator. Philip said that at this moment, he even saw hope of a huge miracle happening. Mitbbsm

99c132d0d767f2a69ebd7a6f63d946ff33242a21.sourceText: 但不幸的是，癌细胞已经影响到斯黛西的视力，并侵蚀了她的喉咙。斯黛西时常处于不清醒状态，不能在她女儿多蒂的出生证上签字。 Mitbbs.com
99c132d0d767f2a69ebd7a6f63d946ff33242a21.translatedText: But unfortunately, the cancer has affected Stacey's vision and eroded her throat. Stacey was often unconscious and unable to sign her daughter Dottie's birth certificate. Mitbbs.com

c14430c444576e826b7e91a47f295f546b4eada9.sourceText: 斯黛西和女儿多蒂都太弱，彼此不能被带到对方身边。菲利普说，我们想把孩子的照片带给斯黛西看，但医生说，斯黛西无法看见照片。 9 月 8 日，斯黛西一度停止了呼吸，然后又苏醒过来。医生警告说，斯黛西离死亡很近了。 Mitbbs.com
c14430c444576e826b7e91a47f295f546b4eada9.translatedText: >Stacey and daughter Dottie are both too weak to be taken to each other. Philip said that we wanted to show Stacey the photo of the child, but the doctor said that Stacy could not see the photo. On September 8, Stacey briefly stopped breathing and then came to. Doctors warned Stacey was close to death. Mitbbs.com

357fc1af22f16714394b0c5bbd9d6ce60ee7a47a.sourceText: 在这种情况下，护士贝奥不忍斯黛西经受感情上的折磨，决定为斯黛西做点什么。 她与几个护士一道，用一种胶囊型的” 重症监护室” 将多蒂送到斯黛西身边。 Mitbbs.com
357fc1af22f16714394b0c5bbd9d6ce60ee7a47a.translatedText: In this case, nurse Beo couldn't bear Stacey's emotional torture and decided to do something for Stacy. Along with several nurses, she sent Dottie to Stacey in a capsule-shaped "intensive care unit." Mitbbs.com

9da352a278b738336bd6c39e56c1b30498f041d2.sourceText: 菲利普非常理解几个护士的爱心，尽管他认为这是徒劳的。但当菲利普尝试地告诉斯黛西，说女儿多蒂要来到她身边时，斯黛西居然睁开了眼睛并急切地寻找她的女儿。 Mitbbs.com
9da352a278b738336bd6c39e56c1b30498f041d2.translatedText: >Philip understands the love of several nurses very well, although he thinks it is in vain. But when Philip tried to tell Stacey that his daughter Dottie was coming to her, Stacy actually opened her eyes and eagerly looked for her daughter. Mitbbs.com

2a5ce235a70bd733a46bcd3ffe1b7a87e8fd852d.sourceText: 不久，护士将多蒂送到了斯黛西身边，并将多蒂放在斯黛西的胸前。这母女俩竟对视了几分钟。 Mitbbs.com
2a5ce235a70bd733a46bcd3ffe1b7a87e8fd852d.translatedText: Soon, the nurse sent Dottie to Stacey's side and placed Dottie on Stacey's chest. The mother and daughter actually looked at each other for several minutes. Mitbbs.com

bacea9113bb3b50b38988808a480c3c68968f2fc.sourceText: 菲利普告诉记者，没有人说话，病房安静极了。菲利普对斯黛西说：” 你做了一件美丽的事情。” 菲利普说，那是一个完美的时刻。三天后，斯黛西离开了人世。 Mitbbs.com
bacea9113bb3b50b38988808a480c3c68968f2fc.translatedText: Philip told reporters that no one spoke and the ward was extremely quiet. Philip said to Stacey, "You did a beautiful thing." Philip said it was a perfect moment. Three days later, Stacy passed away. Mitbbs.com

c3bb195d4b9c70f16860e949fbda39a2d76ff86c.sourceText: 多蒂现在跟舅舅菲利普、舅妈詹妮弗以及他们的 4 个孩子住在俄克拉何马城。詹妮弗说：” 我认为多蒂是一个奇迹。我会完成斯黛西的遗愿，一切为了多蒂的幸福。”
c3bb195d4b9c70f16860e949fbda39a2d76ff86c.translatedText: Dottie now lives in Oklahoma City with her Uncle Philip, Aunt Jennifer and their 4 children. Jennifer said: "I think Dottie is a miracle. I will fulfill Stacey's last wish and do everything for Dottie's happiness."

fcd9c5dc72debade89ebb874e9c0d1cdb1b6630c.sourceText: 李雨当选科工专凤凰城分会主席（图）
fcd9c5dc72debade89ebb874e9c0d1cdb1b6630c.translatedText: Li Yu was elected as the chairman of the Phoenix branch of the Science and Technology College (picture)

ce2ae33611f927aa39c92591f5568b136fbf2846.sourceText: 李雨当选科工专凤凰城分会主席（图） 五月十八日，旅美科学家工程师专业人士协会凤凰城分会（科工专），在凤凰城…
ce2ae33611f927aa39c92591f5568b136fbf2846.translatedText: > Li Yu was elected as the chairman of the Phoenix branch of the Science and Engineering College (picture) On May 18, the Phoenix branch of the Association of Scientists and Engineers in the United States (the science and engineering college) held its annual election in Phoenix...

f561d599642b50b5c539f369291b59e2eb8be9c3.sourceText: 五月十八日，旅美科学家工程师专业人士协会凤凰城分会（科工专），在凤凰城举行年度选举。科工专是由在亚利桑那州华人专业人士组成，在凤凰城正式登记注册的一个独立的、非政治性、非盈利性的华人团体。科工专协会理事会成员由协会全体会员大会选举产生，任期为一年，可连任两届。所有理事、顾问和会员都是义务为科工专协会服务。
f561d599642b50b5c539f369291b59e2eb8be9c3.translatedText: On May 18, the Phoenix branch of the Association of Scientists and Engineers in the United States (the science and engineering college) held its annual election in Phoenix. The College of Science and Technology is an independent, non-political, non-profit Chinese group composed of Chinese professionals in Arizona and officially registered in Phoenix. The members of the Board of Directors of the Association of Science and Technology Professionals are elected by the general membership meeting of the association, with a term of one year and can be re-elected for two terms. All directors, consultants and members are voluntary to serve the Association.

642935b8be0e8984e8cf839614329adadc826523.sourceText: 会议由理事会主席徐强主持，经全体理事投票选举，李雨女士当选会长，会长杨厦出任理事长，李江先生当选副会长。会议还选举了新一届的理事会成员为：李江，李雨，秦丰，汪竑峰，徐强，杨厦，袁亚华。徐强，杨文田出任协会顾问。新的工作班组为：秘书 张扶韬， 财务 刘彦妮，文体 杨厦，学术活动 黄雯，会员发展 邓胜文。会长杨厦回顾了过去一年科工专组织的活动，希望新一年能够为会员朋友们组织更多健康有益的活动。
642935b8be0e8984e8cf839614329adadc826523.translatedText: The meeting was chaired by Xu Qiang, chairman of the board of directors. After voting by all directors, Ms. Li Yu was elected as the president, president Yang Xia served as the chairman, and Mr. Li Jiang was elected as the vice president. The meeting also elected the new council members: Li Jiang, Li Yu, Qin Feng, Wang Hongfeng, Xu Qiang, Yang Xia, and Yuan Yahua. Xu Qiang and Yang Wentian serve as consultants of the association. The new working team is: Secretary Zhang Futao, Finance Liu Yanni, Culture and Sports Yang Xia, Academic Activities Huang Wen, and Member Development Deng Shengwen. President Yang Xia reviewed the activities organized by the College of Science and Technology in the past year and hoped that more healthy and beneficial activities could be organized for members and friends in the new year.

2ddc727c6880f446ac840359bc3da8bd11a7a4f1.sourceText: 科工专协会的宗旨是建立在促进亚利桑那州华人学者、工程师、专业人士之间的联络和交流；鼓励华人融入当地社会；保持与其它华人组织、留学生的联系；推动与促进中美两国在科技、文化、教育以及商务等方面的交流；增加美中两国人民之间的互相了解与合作。凡有意愿为社区服务的人士，欢迎参加我们的义工团队，欢迎各位参加我们组织的各种活动。
2ddc727c6880f446ac840359bc3da8bd11a7a4f1.translatedText: >The purpose of the Association of Science and Technology Professionals is to promote contacts and exchanges between Chinese scholars, engineers, and professionals in Arizona; encourage Chinese to integrate into local society; maintain contact with other Chinese organizations and international students; promote and promote exchanges between China and the United States in science and technology, culture, education, and business; and increase mutual understanding and cooperation between the people of the United States and China. Anyone who is willing to serve the community is welcome to join our volunteer team and participate in various activities organized by us.

4154dba28f3803d48fd2df12a82da9adaef416f6.sourceText: 到会成员合影（第一排左三新任主席李雨）
4154dba28f3803d48fd2df12a82da9adaef416f6.translatedText: Group photo of members present (new chairman Li Yu, third from left in the first row)

736754f6ae47ca97ec86dea25c01fa9131607aa5.sourceText: 凤凰城侨学界庆国庆迎中秋筹备活动全面展开 为庆祝中华人民共和国成立62周年和中华民族传统的中秋佳节，亚利桑那州侨学界将联合亚利桑那州立大学(ASU)、亚利桑那大学(UA)以及Thunderbird 商学院的中国学生学者联谊会举行欢度国庆,喜迎中秋的系列活动。 据筹委会总召集人陈卓眉、杨文田、徐强和活动执行主席、华人总会会长王建民介绍，此次”庆国庆, 迎中秋”将由一系列的活动组成， 国庆招待酒会、升旗仪式、文艺演出、国庆餐会、图片展览、联谊舞会、”国庆杯”篮球、羽毛球、乒乓球公开赛等活动将陆续展开。另外，主题为《我为祖国”十二五”规划献策》的征文比赛也将即时展开,欢迎各界希望祖国更加繁荣昌盛的朋友们献计献策,踊跃投稿。 系列活动的高潮将是2011年9月10日(星期六)下午6点在ASU 的MU 大楼举行的国庆中秋招待酒会和文艺演出。组委会将专门为此次系列活动提供奖品，并在9月10日晚会现场为优胜者颁奖。 据介绍，目前各项筹备工作已经有条不紊地展开，主办方热切期待广大侨胞和留美学生学者的积极响应、支持和参与。各项活动的具体时间与细节将陆续通过媒体向社会通告，也欢迎与活动筹委会联系（筹委会电子邮件： ArizonaChineseAssociation@gmail.com ）。
736754f6ae47ca97ec86dea25c01fa9131607aa5.translatedText: Preparatory activities for the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix to celebrate the National Day and welcome the Mid-Autumn Festival are in full swing. To celebrate the 62nd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China and the traditional Mid-Autumn Festival of the Chinese nation, the overseas Chinese community in Arizona will join hands with the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of Arizona State University (ASU), the University of Arizona (UA) and the Thunderbird School of Business to hold a series of activities to celebrate the National Day and welcome the Mid-Autumn Festival. According to Chen Zhuomei, Yang Wentian, Xu Qiang, general convener of the organizing committee, and Wang Jianmin, executive chairman of the event and president of the Chinese Association, the "Celebrating National Day and Welcome Mid-Autumn Festival" will consist of a series of activities. National Day receptions, flag-raising ceremonies, theatrical performances, National Day dinners, photo exhibitions, social dances, "National Day Cup" basketball, badminton, table tennis open competitions and other activities will be launched one after another. In addition, an essay competition with the theme "I Contribute to the Motherland's Twelfth Five-Year Plan" will also be launched immediately. Friends from all walks of life who hope that the motherland will be more prosperous are welcome to contribute ideas and contributions. The climax of the series of activities will be the National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival reception and artistic performances held at 6 pm on September 10, 2011 (Saturday) in the MU Building of ASU. The organizing committee will provide prizes specifically for this series of activities and award awards to the winners at the evening party on September 10. According to reports, all preparatory work has been carried out in an orderly manner, and the organizers are eagerly looking forward to the active response, support and participation of overseas Chinese, students and scholars studying in the United States. The specific time and details of each event will be announced to the public through the media. You are also welcome to contact the event organizing committee (organizing committee email: ArizonaChineseAssociation@gmail.com).

2645a54c25837850d0d9941cc2861720386e7891.translatedText: The United States’ “New California” declares independence and wants to become the 51st state: We have been out of control for too long [Environment...

855442387440af47e1356cc62dc6321e4de6fa40.sourceText: [环球网综合报道]”受够了税赋超收、法规繁多等问题，主要由加利福尼亚乡村区域组成的”新加州”16日宣布独立，决定让富裕的沿海地区留在加州。”台湾《中时电子报》1月17日报道称。
855442387440af47e1356cc62dc6321e4de6fa40.translatedText: [Global Network Comprehensive Report] "Fed up with problems such as excessive taxes and numerous regulations, the "New California", mainly composed of rural areas in California, declared independence on the 16th and decided to let the wealthy coastal areas stay in California." Taiwan's "China Times Electronic News" reported on January 17.

2aaa0331175e68e400532ea257a04b33d92ef262.sourceText: 谁说了算？据哥伦比亚广播公司(CBS)等美国媒体报道，”新加州”创建人表示，既然他们发表了”独立宣言”，就算是迈出独立的第一步。”我们失控太久了，”作为”新加州”创建人之一，普莱斯顿说，”高税率、糟糕的教育、恶劣的商业环境还有激进的社会意识形态厖”他们衷心希望，最后真能与沿海的加州郡分道扬镳，各走各的。不过，他们并不想脱离美国，只想成为美国第51州。
2aaa0331175e68e400532ea257a04b33d92ef262.translatedText: Who has the final say? According to US media reports such as CBS, the founders of "New California" said that since they issued the "Declaration of Independence", it was the first step towards independence. "We have been out of control for too long," said Preston, one of the founders of "New California." "High taxes, bad education, a bad business environment, and radical social ideologies." They sincerely hope that they can finally separate from the coastal California counties and go their own ways. However, they do not want to secede from the United States, they just want to become the 51st state of the United States.

415198494f9385ef6d49861329b9bf58544e7bee.sourceText: 报道称，”新加州”独立派很实际，一切都会照规矩来，他们将仿效西维吉尼亚州，援引美国宪法第4条第3款，与州立法机关合作，完成一切法律程序。
415198494f9385ef6d49861329b9bf58544e7bee.translatedText: reported that the "New California" independents are very practical and everything will follow the rules. They will follow the example of West Virginia and invoke Article 4, Section 3 of the U.S. Constitution to cooperate with the state legislature to complete all legal procedures.

953017b26eadb2d38dac20b3be20c87dffd02555.sourceText: 另一名”新加州”创建人李德说，在独立自主前，必须先证明能管好自己。尽管困难重重，又面对各方怀疑的眼光，”新加州”创建人团结一心，坚持要实现”建州梦”。
953017b26eadb2d38dac20b3be20c87dffd02555.translatedText: Another "New California" founder Li De said that before becoming independent, one must first prove that he can manage himself well. Despite the difficulties and the skepticism from all sides, the founders of "New California" united and insisted on realizing the "statehood dream."

7bd4596b36640d265924df921e80916e4d37da30.sourceText: 治粤八年南天王——传奇人物陈济棠 余玉书 （六）失先机满盘皆落索（中） 一九三一年四月三十日为了立法院长胡汉民汤山被囚事件，国府文官长古应芬，联同邓泽如、萧佛成、林森等三位国民党籍监察委员联名发出”弹劾蒋正中电”。 五月三日广东的第八路军总指挥陈济棠通电拥护四监委弹劾案（笔者按：此八路军不同于一九三七年八月十九日将共军改编的国民革命军第八路军），五月十一日广西方面李宗仁、白崇禧亦通电响应。而南京方面亦有三十名効忠蒋介石的将领以何应钦为首戏剧化地联名通电反击。五月二十五日汪精卫、孙科、陈济棠等二十二名国府委员联名限令蒋介石在四十八小时内自行辞职引退，但被拒绝。 七月二十一日广州国民政府颁讨伐令，粤桂两军分别向湘赣进兵，九月占彬州后，与中央军顾祝同部战于衡阳。九月十八日日军突袭沈阳北大营，张学良奉蒋命：”未到牺牲最后关头”，不战而退，国人抗日情绪高涨，齐呼枪口对外。于是双方暂时停战，共赴国难，分别在南京与广州召开了”第四次全国代表大会”，互相承认彼此所选出的中央委员。此外广州方面曾提出三项条件。 （一） 任陈铭枢掌京沪卫戌事宜。 （二） 由蒋发一电，对数年来政治措施引咎，并声明统一政府办法，决定后即行下野。 （三） 由粤方通电取消粤中政府，来京开会协商统一政府事。 十月十四日胡汉民被释放。十二月十五日蒋被逼辞去国府主席及行政院长两职，改选林森为国府主席，孙科为行政院长。但回到溪口的蒋介石，以休养为名，实际上仍然遥控南京政局，临走时一早安排好人事布局：江苏省主席顾祝同；浙江省主席鲁杰平；江西省主席熊式辉都是他的亲信，早就埋下了复出的契机。而广州方面虽然取消了”国民政府”，却由胡汉民、陈济棠、萧佛成、李文范、邹鲁、林云陔、刘纪文、刘鲁隐等粤桂人士组成了”西南政务委员会”与南京中央政府分庭抗礼，可是孙科的行政院长，当了不足一个月便因为财政困难而辞职，一向擅于掌握的汪精卫夫妇便在一九三二年一月十六日抵达杭州与蒋介石会谈后，在一月二十二日联袂返抵南京，二十八日汪接任行政院长，并在国府中成立最高军事权力机构棗”军事委员会”，成员包括蒋介石、冯玉祥、何应钦、朱培德、李宗仁等五人，蒋且被推为具有领袖意义的委员长，较之昔日的国民革命军总司令，自然是更上一层楼。至于陈济棠本人则在一九三五年十月被国民政府军事委员会授一级陆军上将。
7bd4596b36640d265924df921e80916e4d37da30.translatedText: The Southern Heavenly King who ruled Guangdong for eight years - the legendary figures Chen Jitang and Yu Yushu (6) Missing the opportunity and losing everything (middle) On April 30, 1931, in response to the imprisonment of Legislative President Hu Hanmin in Tangshan, the civil servant Gu Yingfen, together with three Kuomintang supervisory committee members including Deng Zeru, Xiao Focheng and Lin Sen, jointly issued an "Impeachment of Chiang Kai-shek". On May 3, Chen Jitang, commander-in-chief of the Eighth Route Army in Guangdong, sent a telegram to support the impeachment case of the Fourth Supervisory Committee (author's note: this Eighth Route Army is different from the Eighth Route Army of the National Revolutionary Army, which was reorganized from the Communist Army on August 19, 1937). On May 11, Guangxi's Li Zongren and Bai Chongxi also telegraphed in response. In Nanjing, thirty generals loyal to Chiang Kai-shek, led by He Yingqin, dramatically launched a joint telegram to counterattack. On May 25, 22 state councilors including Wang Jingwei, Sun Ke, and Chen Jitang jointly ordered Chiang Kai-shek to resign within 48 hours, but they were refused. On July 21, the Guangzhou National Government issued a crusade order, and the Guangdong and Guangxi armies marched towards Hunan and Jiangxi respectively. After occupying Binzhou in September, they fought with the Central Army Gu Zhu in Hengyang. On September 18, the Japanese army raided the North Camp of Shenyang. Zhang Xueliang was ordered by Chiang Kai-shek to retreat without a fight "before the final moment of sacrifice was reached." The anti-Japanese sentiment among the Chinese people was high, and they shouted at the gunpoint. So the two sides temporarily ceased fighting and jointly faced the national crisis. They held the "Fourth National Congress" in Nanjing and Guangzhou respectively, and recognized each other's elected Central Committee members. In addition, Guangzhou has proposed three conditions. (1) Chen Mingshu was appointed to be in charge of Beijing-Shanghai garrison affairs. (2) Chiang sent a telegram, blaming the political measures of the past few years and declaring a unified government approach. He would step down immediately after making the decision. (3) The Guangdong side will send a telegram to cancel the Guangdong-Chinese government and come to Beijing to hold a meeting to discuss unifying government affairs. Hu Hanmin was released on October 14th. On December 15th, Chiang was forced to resign as President of the State and President of the Executive Council, and instead elected Lin Sen as President of the State and Sun Ke as President of the Executive Council. However, Chiang Kai-shek, who returned to Xikou, in the name of recuperation, actually still controlled the political situation in Nanjing. Before leaving, he made arrangements for personnel arrangements early in the morning: Jiangsu Provincial Chairman Gu Zhutong; Zhejiang Provincial Chairman Lu Jieping; Jiangxi Provincial Chairman Xiong Shihui were all his cronies, and they had long buried the opportunity for a comeback. Although the "National Government" was abolished in Guangzhou, the "Southwestern Political Affairs Committee" was formed by Hu Hanmin, Chen Jitang, Xiao Focheng, Li Wenfan, Zou Lu, Lin Yunye, Liu Jiwen, Liu Luyin and other Guangdong and Guangxi people to compete with the Nanjing central government. However, Sun Ke, the executive director, resigned due to financial difficulties after less than a month in office. Wang Jingwei and his wife, who had always been good at controlling, came to power on January 16, 1932. After arriving in Hangzhou for talks with Chiang Kai-shek on January 22, they returned to Nanjing together on January 22. On the 28th, Wang took over as the President of the Executive Council and established the "Military Commission", the highest military authority in the government. Its members included Chiang Kai-shek, Feng Yuxiang, He Yingqin, Zhu Peide, Li Zongren and others. Chiang Kai-shek was promoted as the leader of the Generalissimo, which was naturally a step up from the former commander-in-chief of the National Revolutionary Army. As for Chen Jitang himself, he was awarded the rank of first-class Army General by the Military Commission of the Nationalist Government in October 1935.

48fc306e207e6156021bae990bb012bba6d61c79.sourceText: 新手贷款问题 是否可以提前付清 是否有罚金 买房子贷款总是会遇到很多问题，特别是第一次买房子的朋友。希望我们的专栏能帮大家解开心中的疑问，成为一名有备而来的消费者。您可以把问题电邮给我们 (FuJingFunding@Gmail.com)，或者直接致电（480）231-3715.我们会将一些典型的问题刊登在这里，以帮助到更多的朋友。 问题﹕（1）三十年固定利率贷款, 如果提前付清是否有罚金? （2）每月的付款额是不 是固定的同一个数额? （3）付款日期是不是固定在每月的同一天? （4）如果某个月迟付了几天, 会有什么事情发生? 回答﹕（1）对于三十年固定利率的贷款, 如果提前付清, 在多数情况下是不会有罚金的。所以您在 申请贷款时, 别忘了告知您的贷款公司或银行，讲明不希望有罚金。但少数情况下, 可能有罚金, 这是由于前一阶段利率比较低, 有很多屋主办理了重新贷款(Refinance), 而且有些屋主在短期内多次办理, 这就使得银行无利可图, 为了保护银行自身的利益, 有些银行加上了提前付清 需付罚金的条款。另外，如果屋主提前付清贷款而被征罚金, 罚金是可在当年报税时用于抵税的。 （2）对于固定利率贷款, 每月的付款额(这里是指包括了本金, 利息, 地产 税和保险, 简称PITI), 一般是不变的, 最起码在同一年度中是不变的。但由于房地产税和 房屋保险有可能调整(通常是上涨, 每年调一次), 这就有可能使你的月付款额上升。如果 你们每个月想多付一些, 也是可以的, 当然少付是不行的。 （3）每个月的付款日期通常是在 1号, 如果晚几天是可以的, 若在2日至15日之内收到钱, 则银行按天数计算利息, 待下一年调整月付款额时, 加上利息。 （4）多数银行是允许在每月的15日以前收到钱即可, 如果超过15日则要征”迟付费(Late Fee)”, 但若你迟付款不是几天, 而是几个星期(超过15天), 除了要交迟付费以外, 银行还会在信用局你的信用记录中记上一笔, 给你们造成坏信用。若 超过一个月, 银行就有可能开始执行没收手续(Foreclosure)。
48fc306e207e6156021bae990bb012bba6d61c79.translatedText: Loan questions for newbies: Can it be paid off in advance? Is there any penalty? There are always many problems when buying a house loan, especially for friends who are buying a house for the first time. We hope that our column can help you answer your questions and become a well-prepared consumer. You can email your questions to us (FuJingFunding@Gmail.com), or call (480) 231-3715 directly. We will post some typical questions here to help more friends. Questions: (1) For a thirty-year fixed-rate loan, is there a penalty if you pay it off early? (2) Is the monthly payment fixed at the same amount? (3) Is the payment date fixed on the same day every month? (4) What will happen if you pay a few days late in a certain month? Answer: (1) For a thirty-year fixed-rate loan, if you pay it off early, in most cases there will be no penalty. So when you apply for a loan, don’t forget to tell your loan company or bank that you don’t want to be fined. But in a few cases, there may be penalties. This is because the interest rates in the previous stage were relatively low, many homeowners have applied for refinance, and some homeowners have applied for it multiple times in a short period of time, which makes the bank unprofitable. In order to protect the bank's own interests, some banks have added a clause that requires a penalty for early payment. In addition, if the homeowner pays off the loan early and is levied a penalty, the penalty can be used as a tax deduction when filing taxes that year. (2) For fixed-rate loans, the monthly payment (here including principal, interest, real estate taxes and insurance, referred to as PITI), is generally unchanged, at least within the same year. But since real estate taxes and home insurance are subject to adjustment (usually increase, once a year), this may cause your monthly payment to rise. If you want to pay more every month, you can do that. Of course, paying less is not possible. (3) The payment date of each month is usually on the 1st. If it is a few days later, it is okay. If the money is received between the 2nd and the 15th, the bank will calculate the interest based on the number of days. When the monthly payment is adjusted in the next year, the interest will be added. (4) Most banks allow money to be received before the 15th of each month. If it is more than the 15th, a "Late Fee" will be levied. However, if your late payment is not a few days, but several weeks (more than 15 days), in addition to paying a late fee, the bank will also put a mark on your credit record with the credit bureau, giving you a bad credit. If it exceeds one month, the bank may initiate foreclosure procedures.

b3b284f6b970f744379330a0e6bff5fb04b072e0.sourceText: 昨日，中国社科院经济所和首都经贸大学联合发布首个《中国城市生活质量指数报告》。
b3b284f6b970f744379330a0e6bff5fb04b072e0.translatedText: Yesterday, the Institute of Economics of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences and the Capital University of Economics and Business jointly released the first "China Urban Life Quality Index Report".

8273b7b17a6ed72216b7ec3c9dc91c90dff88138.sourceText: 北京生活节奏全国最快
8273b7b17a6ed72216b7ec3c9dc91c90dff88138.translatedText: The pace of life in Beijing is the fastest in the country

adbb57da6e5fbf884584857d48587011f001b2af.sourceText: 据报告调查的课题组有关负责人介绍，” 生活质量指数” 由一系列客观指标和主观指标加权得出。主观指数包括收入、生活成本、医疗保障、生活环境、生活节奏及生活便利程度等满意度；客观指数包括人均财富、通货膨胀率、绿地面积、恩格尔系数等。
adbb57da6e5fbf884584857d48587011f001b2af.translatedText: According to the person in charge of the research team responsible for the report's investigation, the "quality of life index" is weighted by a series of objective indicators and subjective indicators. The subjective index includes satisfaction with income, cost of living, medical security, living environment, pace of life, and convenience of life; the objective index includes per capita wealth, inflation rate, green space area, Engel coefficient, etc.

c71e68efa451118ecb08ce6879ba7d76aba461a5.sourceText: 从调查结果看，在 30 个省会城市中，生活质量指数得分 55 分以上的城市有 15 个，超过平均分 54.49 ，排名前三位的城市是广州、上海、南京，北京名列第八。
c71e68efa451118ecb08ce6879ba7d76aba461a5.translatedText: According to the survey results, among the 30 provincial capital cities, 15 cities have a quality of life index score of 55 or above, exceeding the average score of 54.49. The top three cities are Guangzhou, Shanghai, and Nanjing, with Beijing ranking eighth.

843a8d5b281aef368e826be04523acf15c7e49fc.sourceText: 分区域看，东部城市生活质量客观指数高于西部，但主观满意度低于西部，这被认为是北京综合得分较低的原因之一。以银川和北京为例，银川的生活质量总指数排名靠前 ( 第 4 名 ) ，与其舒缓的生活节奏 (48.68 分，排名第一 ) 有关；而北京的生活质量总指数排名靠后，与其超快的生活节奏有很大关系 (38.03 分，排最后一名 ) 。
843a8d5b281aef368e826be04523acf15c7e49fc.translatedText: Looking at different regions, the objective index of quality of life in cities in the east is higher than that in the west, but the subjective satisfaction is lower than that in the west. This is considered to be one of the reasons for Beijing's low overall score. Taking Yinchuan and Beijing as examples, Yinchuan's overall quality of life index ranks high (4th), which is related to its slow pace of life (48.68 points, ranking first); while Beijing's overall quality of life index ranks low, which has a lot to do with its ultra-fast pace of life (38.03 points, ranking last).

50497ea2139aef9d9735abd04c98c3079208acf8.translatedText: Subjective feelings account for 40% of the weight

770363ec80b8c20cec52eb60e82a13bbe04c5779.sourceText: 同是超大型城市，广州、上海排名靠前，北京为何低这么多？报告撰写者直言，北京的环境质量明显落后。
770363ec80b8c20cec52eb60e82a13bbe04c5779.translatedText: They are both very large cities. Guangzhou and Shanghai rank high. Why is Beijing so low? The author of the report bluntly stated that Beijing’s environmental quality is obviously lagging behind.

fe77e8832dd0bec28bfbed9176689a68186bcab2.sourceText: 受访者的主观感受占据 40% 的权重，很大程度上会左右整体结果。比如西部大开发后，居民生活质量改善较快，居民满意度较高。而在” 生活成本满意度” 方面，上海和北京得分分别排在第 20 、 25 位，主观指数排在第 28 、 29 位，生活成本较高。
fe77e8832dd0bec28bfbed9176689a68186bcab2.translatedText: The subjective feelings of the respondents account for 40% of the weight and will largely influence the overall results. For example, after the development of the western region, residents' quality of life has improved rapidly and residents' satisfaction has been high. In terms of "satisfaction with cost of living", Shanghai and Beijing ranked 20th and 25th respectively, and the subjective index ranked 28th and 29th. The cost of living is relatively high.

b335dc06362b3124523d1a8aebdb4768084d5955.sourceText: 经济高速增长背后现” 两大反差”
b335dc06362b3124523d1a8aebdb4768084d5955.translatedText: There are "two major contrasts" behind the rapid economic growth

42a9e96fdd1b55b742d2456a7144c924a07f2683.sourceText: 近 30 年来，我国经济高速增长，但并没有出现与之相对应的” 生活质量满意度提高” 。
42a9e96fdd1b55b742d2456a7144c924a07f2683.translatedText: In the past 30 years, my country's economy has grown rapidly, but there has been no corresponding "improvement in quality of life satisfaction."

0f29f911fa9811e7557f85f15eada16b3ece7694.sourceText: 首都经济贸易大学经济学院院长张连城认为，经济增长背后存在” 两大反差” ：一是高速的经济增长与居民生活质量水平存在反差；二是居民实际生活质量与居民主观感受存在反差。
0f29f911fa9811e7557f85f15eada16b3ece7694.translatedText: Zhang Liancheng, dean of the School of Economics at Capital University of Economics and Business, believes that there are "two major contrasts" behind economic growth: first, there is a contrast between high-speed economic growth and residents' quality of life; second, there is a contrast between residents' actual quality of life and residents' subjective feelings.

978d19c4c05810311f6fc97bd689b230efaac9e7.sourceText: 张连城表示，通胀率高，高房价、社保水平低，生活节奏快，是致使主观满意度偏低的关键因素。
978d19c4c05810311f6fc97bd689b230efaac9e7.translatedText: Zhang Liancheng said that high inflation rate, high housing prices, low social security levels and fast pace of life are the key factors leading to low subjective satisfaction.

0d1c50320e85e8f333a56c63136776bca3df96a5.sourceText: 为此，在继续保持经济稳定快速增长的同时，加快经济发展方式的转变，包括经济增长方式的转变、收入分配方式的转变，包括完善社会保障制度，提高经济运行质量，提高经济增长质量，提高居民生活质量等，是今后最重要的任务。
0d1c50320e85e8f333a56c63136776bca3df96a5.translatedText: To this end, while continuing to maintain stable and rapid economic growth, accelerating the transformation of economic development methods, including changes in economic growth methods and income distribution methods, including improving the social security system, improving the quality of economic operations, improving the quality of economic growth, and improving the quality of residents' lives, are the most important tasks in the future.

579e803bc3af265da2b1365e7eed887157ec2291.translatedText: >West Lake in May, when the lotus flowers bloom. The state-owned Chengjun is on the coast of Zhejiang.

db2c88d277b12073ccb04a3f81d84901df5a03ac.sourceText: 浙江大学建校于1897年5月21日，今年是120周年校庆。 近日来除了杭州各大校区的校庆活动，全世界各地校友也纷纷以各种形式庆祝母校百廿华诞。
db2c88d277b12073ccb04a3f81d84901df5a03ac.translatedText: Zhejiang University was founded on May 21, 1897. This year is its 120th anniversary. In recent days, in addition to the anniversary activities held by major campuses in Hangzhou, alumni from all over the world have also celebrated the 120th anniversary of their alma mater in various forms.

c3a39c2f5b9e03c9c32f1ff6874aff242099f792.sourceText: 美国纽约帝国大厦将于5月20日晚（北京时间21日白天）为浙江大学120周年校庆日亮灯。灯体为浙大蓝，以庆祝浙大120周年校庆。这可能是帝国大厦有史以来第一次为中国国内大学校庆而亮灯，是浙江大学北美校友会大纽约分会送给母校120周年校庆的一份珍贵礼物。黄浦江畔，上海浙大校友打出了”我爱浙大”和”百廿浙大，海纳百川”的黄浦江亮灯视觉盛宴。 在杭州钱塘岸边，钱江新城浙大120周年校庆专题灯光秀以浙江大学校训”求是创新”为主题，以浙江大学校歌为背景音乐，浙江大学求是鹰也现身灯光秀。
c3a39c2f5b9e03c9c32f1ff6874aff242099f792.translatedText: The Empire State Building in New York, USA, will be lit up on the evening of May 20 (daytime on the 21st, Beijing time) for the 120th anniversary of Zhejiang University. The lamp body is Zhejiang University blue to celebrate the 120th anniversary of Zhejiang University. This may be the first time in history that the Empire State Building has been lit up for the celebration of a domestic university in China. It is a precious gift from the Greater New York Chapter of the North American Alumni Association of Zhejiang University to its alma mater for its 120th anniversary. On the bank of the Huangpu River, alumni of Zhejiang University in Shanghai put out "I love Zhejiang University" and "One hundred and twenty Zhejiang University, embracing all rivers", a visual feast of lights on the Huangpu River. On the bank of Qiantang in Hangzhou, the special light show for the 120th anniversary of Zhejiang University in Qianjiang New Town was based on the Zhejiang University motto "Seeking Truth and Innovation" as the theme, with the Zhejiang University school song as the background music, and the Zhejiang University Seeking Truth Eagle also appeared in the light show.

37a8d10444915b7b594f0cdf26d9bee41a5544b2.sourceText: 而在大洋彼岸的亚利桑那州Arizona，正是仙人掌树saguaro 开花之际，我们用最热烈的温度迎来了浙江大学的百廿大庆。亚省的浙大校友们藉此契机也欢聚一堂，庆祝母校的120华诞，也庆祝亚利桑那州浙大校友会正式成立。
37a8d10444915b7b594f0cdf26d9bee41a5544b2.translatedText: On the other side of the ocean in Arizona, when the cactus tree saguaro is blooming, we welcome the 120th anniversary of Zhejiang University with the warmest temperatures. Alumni of Zhejiang University in Arizona also took this opportunity to gather together to celebrate the 120th anniversary of their alma mater and the official establishment of the Zhejiang University Alumni Association in Arizona.

8fcbcae2941462e937e68cdb6c886a28fa6958ad.sourceText: 校友会的第一次活动在王惟咨学长的热心张罗下于2017年5月13在Jogoya Sushi Seafood Buffet举行. 共有26位校友参加，从79级的老校友到05级的新晋奶爸，跨度近三十年。大家虽然来自不同的年级不同的专业，相逢便相知，因为我们共同拥有一个美丽的母校–浙江大学，西子湖畔，人间天堂。 大家从当年的食堂最爱，到今天的工作子女，各种交集，许多相似，欢声笑语之间三个小时不知不觉就过去了，大家都觉得意犹未尽，相约再聚!
8fcbcae2941462e937e68cdb6c886a28fa6958ad.translatedText: The first event of the Alumni Association was held at Jogoya Sushi Seafood Buffet on May 13, 2017, with the enthusiasm of senior Wang Weizi. A total of 26 alumni participated, ranging from old alumni of the 79th grade to new dads of the 05th grade, spanning nearly thirty years. Although we all come from different grades and majors, we get to know each other when we meet, because we share a beautiful alma mater - Zhejiang University, beside the West Lake, paradise on earth. From being the favorites in the cafeteria back then to being working children today, we have all kinds of intersections and many similarities. Three hours of laughter and laughter have passed by unknowingly. Everyone feels that there is still more to come and we will meet again!

977c4f23cb4773e1ab17f5686b0b4f3b09630f66.sourceText: 亚利桑那州浙江大学校友会的成立，虽然是借母校校庆的东风，也是亚省浙大人的共同心声。它不仅仅是我们的过去与情怀的交集，更是我们的未来与发展的平台。目前亚利桑那州浙大校友微信群已有凤凰城Phoenix和图桑Tucson的63位校友。一日浙大， 永远浙里。如果你也是浙大人， 欢迎你和我们联系: weiziw@gmail.com ，也可以扫描下面的亚省浙大校友微信群二维码加入。
977c4f23cb4773e1ab17f5686b0b4f3b09630f66.translatedText: The establishment of the Zhejiang University Alumni Association in Arizona, although it is inspired by the anniversary of the alma mater, is also the common aspiration of Zhejiang University people in Arizona. It is not only the intersection of our past and feelings, but also the platform for our future and development. Currently, the Zhejiang University in Arizona alumni WeChat group has 63 alumni from Phoenix and Tucson. Once at Zhejiang University, forever at Zhejiang University. If you are also from Zhejiang University, you are welcome to contact us: weiziw@gmail.com, or you can scan the QR code of the WeChat group of Zhejiang University alumni below to join.

40ce5a6bdf45e5e03cc309502b25c8fbdd817f0e.translatedText: Real Estate Q&A Some professional terms you should know In the process of buying and selling a house, we will hear or see some real estate-related terms, what do you think...

ee79bc90021650eeb32802f3ead8644aa096008d.sourceText: 房地产问答 有些专业术语是您应该知道的 在买卖房屋的过程中，我们会听到或看到一些和房地产相关的用语，您对这些词汇、用语了解多少呢? 请参考以下问与答，或许能对您的房产交易有所帮助。 问: 什么是 Appraisal ( 估价 )? 答: Appraisal是由领有执照的专业估价师，在某一特定日期、对某一指定的房地产标的所做出的评估市价报告。 问: 什么是 SPDS? 答: SPDS是Seller抯 Property Disclosure Statement的简称，在亚利桑那的制式化购屋合约中，预先记载了此文件必需在购屋合约成立后的5天内由卖方提供，其中记载了像是: 正确地址、目前的屋主、HOA名称、费用以及房屋状况、已知问题等等的数据。 问: 什么是 COE ( 交屋日 )? 答: COE是Close of Escrow的简称，是房产交易的最后一个步骤，依照买卖双方同意的条件，在交屋日由Escrow Company处理交、付款，登记产权的程序。 问: 什么是 Buyer Market ( 买方市场 )? 答: 所谓的买方市场，是指在某一个房产区域中，在市场上的待售房屋数量供过于求，因而造成了房屋待售时间加长、屋价下跌。 问: 什么是 Seller Market ( 卖方市场 )? 答: 所谓的卖方市场就是在市场上的待售房屋数量没有办法满足购屋者的数量，因而造成了房屋短时间内便售出、屋价上涨。 如果您有任何房地产方面的问题，非常欢迎您打电话到我的专线 (480) 612-4545 或 email至 Rich@RichLiao.com
ee79bc90021650eeb32802f3ead8644aa096008d.translatedText: Real Estate Q&A Some professional terms you should know In the process of buying and selling a house, we will hear or see some real estate-related terms, how much do you know about these terms and terms? Please refer to the following questions and answers, which may be helpful to your real estate transaction. Q: What is an Appraisal? A: An Appraisal is a market value report on a specified real estate subject made by a licensed professional appraiser on a specific date. Q: What is SPDS? A: SPDS is the abbreviation of Seller's Property Disclosure Statement. In Arizona's standardized house purchase contract, it is pre-recorded that this document must be provided by the seller within 5 days after the house purchase contract is established. It records data such as: correct address, current owner, HOA name, fees, condition of the house, known problems, etc. Q: What is COE (Closed of Escrow)? A: COE is the abbreviation of Close of Escrow. It is the last step in the real estate transaction. According to the conditions agreed by the buyer and seller, the Escrow Company handles the handover, payment, and registration of property rights on the handover date. Q: What is a Buyer Market? A: The so-called buyer's market refers to an oversupply of houses for sale in a certain real estate area, which results in a longer period of time for houses to be sold and a fall in house prices. Q: What is a Seller Market? A: The so-called seller's market means that the number of houses for sale on the market cannot satisfy the number of home buyers, resulting in houses being sold in a short period of time and house prices rising. If you have any questions about real estate, you are very welcome to call my hotline (480) 612-4545 or email to Rich@RichLiao.com

ddccffac6aed2955b20aa79270b7b667dd9f5ad0.sourceText: 小心能驶万年车 交管测试逆向提示 过去几年内，逆向行驶已成为本州日趋严重的交通问题。 国家交通安全管理局说，2009年，在亚利桑那州有23人因反方向行车导致车祸死亡。为解决这一问题，亚利桑那运输部开始研试新路标技术。 安全工程师希望在高速公路入口放置醒目路标，提醒驾车人和公路巡警。运输部试验一种系统，在检验到汽车反方向后，阻止其进入高速公路。
ddccffac6aed2955b20aa79270b7b667dd9f5ad0.translatedText: Be careful when driving a car that can last for thousands of years Traffic control test reverse driving tips In the past few years, driving on the wrong side has become an increasingly serious traffic problem in the state. The National Transportation Safety Administration says that in 2009, 23 people were killed in Arizona crashes caused by driving in the wrong direction. To solve this problem, the Arizona Department of Transportation began testing new road sign technology. Safety engineers want to place prominent road signs at highway entrances to alert motorists and highway patrol officers. The Department for Transport is trialling a system that would prevent cars from entering the highway after detecting they are going in the opposite direction.

8cd959595f970f78372344e522c3d128cc953e80.sourceText: ”今奇猫”大致可分四类：第一类：”哲理猫”，作品如”猫语录”，”捉了三只老鼠之后”，”睡着了也许在醒着”第二类：”文革猫”，作品如：”天堂故事”，”梦幻””主人命令 – 让他咬一口”；第三类： ”大自在”，如”悟”，”小女纯纯真”，”妈妈下班了！”（又称激动的内心），猫咪霸住棋盘的”出人头地”；第四类为”天猫”，写猫咪在天上的无忧虑无虑及带给人间的无限娇媚柔情。
8cd959595f970f78372344e522c3d128cc953e80.translatedText: "Today's strange cats" can be roughly divided into four categories: The first category: "Philosophical cats", works such as "Cat Quotations", "After catching three mice", "Asleep and maybe awake" The second category: "Cultural Revolution cats", works such as: "Paradise Story", "Dream" "Master orders - Let him take a bite"; the third category: "great freedom", such as "enlightenment", "the little girl is innocent", "mom is off work!" (also known as the excited heart), the cat dominates the chessboard and "gets ahead"; the fourth category is "Tmall", which describes the carefreeness of cats in the sky and the infinite tenderness they bring to the world.

1e8c45d4a821d2fc0870ab475e85e60df5952a22.sourceText: 香港城规会采取措施杜绝“先破坏、后建设”
1e8c45d4a821d2fc0870ab475e85e60df5952a22.translatedText: The Hong Kong Town Planning Board takes measures to put an end to "destroy first, build later"

7baac6526bd6c27560b5ea65cca7371f0c722bc1.sourceText: 香港城规会采取措施杜绝“先破坏、后建设” 新华网 香港城市规划委员会４日公布新措施，杜绝”先破…
7baac6526bd6c27560b5ea65cca7371f0c722bc1.translatedText: The Hong Kong Town Planning Board takes measures to put an end to "destroy first, build later" Xinhuanet The Hong Kong Town Planning Board announced new measures on the 4th to put an end to "destruction first...

702c504eedbc9017768ac2043c4ebfc2103624e9.sourceText: 香港城市规划委员会４日公布新措施，杜绝”先破坏、后建设”的情况。城规会发言人指出，城规会决心保护乡郊及天然环境，不会容忍任何蓄意破坏乡郊及天然环境的行动。
702c504eedbc9017768ac2043c4ebfc2103624e9.translatedText: The Hong Kong Town Planning Board announced new measures on the 4th to put an end to the situation of "destruction first, then construction". A spokesman for the Town Planning Board pointed out that the Town Planning Board is determined to protect the countryside and the natural environment.

ac953ba91a53915bdbc76b2e11e03378601e3b9b.sourceText: 近年有新界土地在得到规划许可前，被非法填土及移除土地上的植物，意图使城规会因该土地已失去保护及保育价值，而对有关申请给予从宽考虑。城规会经讨论后决定采取措施，以杜绝”先破坏、后建设”的行为。
ac953ba91a53915bdbc76b2e11e03378601e3b9b.translatedText: In recent years, land in the New Territories has been illegally filled and plants removed before planning permission was obtained, with the intention of causing the Town Planning Board to reject the application because the land has lost its protection and conservation value. Please give lenient consideration. After discussion, the Town Planning Board decided to take measures to put an end to the behavior of "destruction first, construction later"

9839f1843dea5910b2148a02f2057eb0a496ac96.sourceText: 措施包括：如申请改划用途地带或规划许可的土地涉及非法填土／填塘等违例发展，城规会不会对该申请作出决定。此外，如规划监督就涉及规划申请的土地已进行执行管制行动，及已根据城市规划条例发出”恢复原状通知书”，城规会将根据”恢复原状通知书”所规定的土地复修后的状况，考虑该项申请。
9839f1843dea5910b2148a02f2057eb0a496ac96.translatedText: Measures include: If the land applied for rezoning or planning permission involves illegal land filling/pond filling and other illegal development, the Town Planning Board will No decision will be made on the application. In addition, if the planning authority has carried out enforcement control action on the land involved in the planning application and a "restoration notice" has been issued under the Town Planning Ordinance, the Town Planning Board will consider the application based on the post-rehabilitation condition of the land specified in the "restoration notice".

e5bd50502299dcdd8ebe85120f3fb5d19bfe74fa.sourceText: 美税收优惠大半归富有家庭
e5bd50502299dcdd8ebe85120f3fb5d19bfe74fa.translatedText: Most of the U.S. tax incentives go to wealthy families

b15886bd6ee1c781f4a119fed41c3b7e011809b7.sourceText: 美税收优惠大半归富有家庭 国会预算分析家星期三说，美国税法10项最大优惠今年可以让纳税人节省9000多亿美…
b15886bd6ee1c781f4a119fed41c3b7e011809b7.translatedText: Most of the U.S. tax incentives go to wealthy families. Congressional budget analysts said on Wednesday that the 10 biggest incentives in the U.S. tax code could save taxpayers more than $900 billion this year...

48825765dbf1e2aec23d42c9db7d9c6e04f0d2ef.sourceText: 国会预算分析家星期三说，美国税法10项最大优惠今年可以让纳税人节省9000多亿美元，但超过一半的优惠都进入全美20%的最富有家庭。
48825765dbf1e2aec23d42c9db7d9c6e04f0d2ef.translatedText: Congressional budget analysts said on Wednesday that the 10 biggest incentives in the U.S. tax code could save taxpayers more than $900 billion this year, but more than half of the incentives go to the 20% richest families in the United States.

a92926b523f48e92f1d2081db01c3684acc61be7.sourceText: 据《华盛顿邮报》报道，国会预算办公室的报道说，年收入超过32.7万美元的1%最富有家庭得到全部税收优惠的17%。
a92926b523f48e92f1d2081db01c3684acc61be7.translatedText: According to the "Washington Post" report, the Congressional Budget Office reported that the richest 1% of households with annual income of more than $327,000 receive 17% of all tax benefits.
