4ff8b5cadff09ae8eaa06f3a128ea1111cd78ec6.sourceText: 记得从上海到南京，上个世纪四十年代坐火车要一整天，六十年代后，快车大约要六个钟头，九十年代火车提速，又缩短到三四个钟头，如今有了高铁 ，行程只有一个小时。 科学技术的进步给我们的生活带来多大的变化啊！ 我们旅行团是乘大轿车，上海到南京已建起了八车道的高速公路，行程需三个半小时。 如果不是公路两侧那绵延不断的秦砖汉瓦的提醒，真以为是行驶在​​美国的10号公路上。 公路两边房屋的变化是中国农村变化发展的明证。 解放初期，农田间镶嵌着破旧的茅草屋，50年代，大约百分之五十的家庭盖起了砖瓦平房，80年代起，一批两三层楼的私人住宅拔地而起。 如今，这样的别墅式楼房已连成一片，还有一些十层以上的高楼耸立其间，这就是中国最富裕的江南农村60年变迁的真实写照。 可以说，这里农民的居住和生活水平，一点都不比城里差。 从上海到南京的路上，导游抽空介绍了自己。 他是湖北省山区农村的孩子，他是这个家庭的超生子女。 父母为了生下他，被罚款250元。 父母含辛茹苦，省吃俭用供他上学，他也不负亲人的期望，成了村里唯二的大学生，毕业后，又只身来到上海创天下，成为一名合格的导游。 他是知道今日的一切来之不易，他在读大学时，放暑假回家，想帮爸妈做点事，早上三点起床，从菜地摘了一挑菜去城里卖，一天才挣了 三块四毛钱，不够他一天的生活费。 于是，他决定向城市进军，寒假他去深圳打工,赚了一千块钱，认定了进大城市的决心。 现在，他来上海已经七年，在上海结了婚，贷款买了房子，把农村的父母也接到上海来居住，成了新一代的上海居民。 改革开放以来，上海已成为全国人民的上海，”上海人”已不是过去传统意义中的上海人，百分之七，八十是外来客，上海男人也不再是那样听话爱做家务事的 小男人了。 到南京，汽车直驶中山陵，这里是孙中山先生安息的地方。 中山陵面貌依旧，巍然耸立在紫金山山南麓，西邻明孝陵，东毗灵谷寺，整个建筑群依山势层层上升，肃穆庄严。 从书有’博爱’二字的陵门走起，登392级台阶抵达祭堂。 孙中山先生的遗体就安葬在他的卧像下面。 我们的南京地陪导游是一名曾在大学教授历史的老师，我向他请教孙中山先生遗体是否就安放在这里，回答是肯定的。 1925年3月12日中山先生在北京逝世，因向苏联订制的水晶棺未及时运到，遗体先放置在西式玻璃盖木棺内，安放在北京西山碧云寺石塔内。 1929年5月，国民政府任命何应钦为奉安迎柩总指挥，孙中山先生遗体灵柩5月28日运抵南京，公祭三天，6月1日举行’奉安大典’， 遗体放置在紫铜棺内葬 在孙中山卧像下五米深处。 苏联运来的玻璃钢棺后来放置在北京西山大佛寺内，为孙中山先生衣冠墓。 奉安典礼十分隆重，遗体途经的地方，都更名为’中山’，因而南京有了中山码头，中山南路，中山东路，中山桥，中山门，一直到中山陵连成一条线。 。 解放军渡长江前，国民政府曾有人提议把孙中山先生遗体迁走，请示了副总统孙科，孙分析了共产党对孙中山的态度，做出了不迁移的正确决定。 后来，还传出了国民军和共军共同守护中山陵的趣谈。
4ff8b5cadff09ae8eaa06f3a128ea1111cd78ec6.translatedText: I remember that it took a whole day by train from Shanghai to Nanjing in the 1940s. After the 1960s, it took about six hours by express train. In the 1990s, the speed of trains was shortened to three or four hours. Now with high-speed rail, the journey is only one hour. How much change has the progress of science and technology brought to our lives! Our tour group took a large car. An eight-lane expressway has been built from Shanghai to Nanjing, and the journey took three and a half hours. If it weren't for the continuous reminder of the Qin bricks and Han tiles on both sides of the road, I would have thought I was driving on US Route 10. The changes in the houses on both sides of the road are clear evidence of the changes and development of China's rural areas. In the early days of liberation, the farmland was dotted with dilapidated thatched houses. In the 1950s, about 50% of households built brick bungalows. Since the 1980s, a number of two- and three-story private residences have been built. Today, such villa-style buildings have been connected together, and there are also some high-rise buildings with more than ten floors standing among them. This is a true portrayal of the 60 years of changes in China's most affluent rural area in Jiangnan. It can be said that the living standards of farmers here are no worse than those in the city. On the way from Shanghai to Nanjing, the tour guide took the time to introduce himself. He is a child from a rural area in the mountainous areas of Hubei Province. He is the superborn child of this family. His parents were fined 250 yuan for giving birth to him. His parents worked hard and saved money to support him in school. He lived up to the expectations of his family and became the only college student in the village. After graduation, he came to Shanghai alone to create a world and became a qualified tour guide. He knew that everything he had today was hard-won. When he was in college, he went home during the summer vacation and wanted to help his parents with something. He got up at three in the morning, picked a pick of vegetables from the vegetable field and sold them in the city. He only earned three yuan and forty cents in one day, which was not enough for his daily living expenses. So, he decided to march into the city. During the winter vacation, he went to work in Shenzhen and earned a thousand yuan, which determined his determination to enter the big city. Now, he has been in Shanghai for seven years. He got married in Shanghai, bought a house with a loan, and brought his parents from the countryside to live in Shanghai, becoming a new generation of Shanghai residents. Since the reform and opening up, Shanghai has become a Shanghai for people all over the country. "Shanghai people" are no longer Shanghainese in the traditional sense of the past. Seventy to eighty percent are foreigners. Shanghai men are no longer such obedient little men who love to do housework. When arriving in Nanjing, the car drives directly to the Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, which is the resting place of Dr. Sun Yat-sen. The appearance of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum remains the same, standing majestically at the southern foot of Purple Mountain, adjacent to Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum in the west and Linggu Temple in the east. The entire building complex rises layer by layer along the mountain, solemn and solemn. Start from the mausoleum gate with the word "fraternity" written on it, and climb 392 steps to reach the memorial hall. Dr. Sun Yat-sen's body is buried under his lying statue. Our tour guide in Nanjing is a teacher who once taught history at a university. I asked him whether the body of Dr. Sun Yat-sen was placed here, and the answer was yes. Mr. Sun Yat-sen passed away in Beijing on March 12, 1925. Because the crystal coffin ordered from the Soviet Union did not arrive in time, his body was first placed in a Western-style glass-covered wooden coffin and placed in the stone tower of Biyun Temple in Xishan, Beijing. In May 1929, the Nationalist Government appointed He Yingqin as the commander-in-chief of the coffin ceremony. Dr. Sun Yat-sen’s coffin arrived in Nanjing on May 28. There was a three-day public memorial ceremony. The fiberglass coffin shipped from the Soviet Union was later placed in the Xishan Buddhist Temple in Beijing as the tomb of Dr. Sun Yat-sen. The enshrinement ceremony was very solemn, and the places where the remains passed were renamed "Zhongshan". As a result, Nanjing has Zhongshan Pier, Zhongshan South Road, Zhongshan East Road, Zhongshan Bridge, Zhongshan Gate, and all the way to the Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum. . Before the People's Liberation Army crossed the Yangtze River, someone in the Nationalist Government proposed to move the body of Dr. Sun Yat-sen, and asked Vice President Sun Ke for instructions. Sun analyzed the Communist Party's attitude towards Sun Yat-sen and made the correct decision not to move it. Later, there was also an interesting talk about the National Army and the Communist Army jointly guarding the Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum.

e2324844b25b97952e698488e19a43affc328d82.translatedText: The reclining statue of Dr. Sun Yat-sen

ab3f692b321b21efd59d685520c3e01b44ff6209.sourceText: 南京是中国有名的四大火炉之一，但紫金山山麓，青松翠柏，树林密布，是避暑的好去处。 小时候，每逢暑假，我和表兄弟们常来这里玩耍，跑遍了这里的山间小道，渴了喝一口山间泉水，现在想起来嘴里还甜滋滋的。 那时的我，天真无邪，觉得人世界间一切都是美好的，只知道玩得开心，在丛林溪水间一整天也不觉得累。 今天，当我60多年后重新踏上中山陵的台阶，拾级而上，想着近百年凝重的中国历史，每一步都迈得很沉重。 孙中山先生为推翻清封建王朝奋斗一生，是中国人民共同尊崇的领袖。 国民政府于1940年通令全国尊他为国父，人民政府也尊他为革命先驱，​​他的画像一直面对着毛泽东的画像放在天安门广场中央。 2011年，两岸都隆重庆祝辛亥革命推翻清王朝一百周年，不论各自想法有什么不同，敬重孙中山先生是相同的。 纵观历史长河，跳出党派观念去看这100年中国的历史，国共本是一家人，后来因为治国理念的差异加上权利上的争夺，搞得兄弟兵戎相见。 日本鬼子乘虚而入，外国势力也纷纷抢占地盘，结果是生灵涂炭，百姓遭殃。 到头来，今天两岸还得坐下来共同寻求合作统一的途径，100年绕了一个大圈，又回到了原点。 中山先生提出民族，民权，民生仍然是两岸政府都在寻求的目标，只是赋予的含义和提法略有不同。 振兴和发展中华民族精神仍然是两岸共同的目标；不断提高人民治理国家的权力是两岸政府都在努力的承诺；改善人民生活，为人民谋福利更是两岸政府在做的实事。 这就是两岸合作和统一的牢固基础。 我这只是一个凡人用一种超越政治的简易分析法得出的答案，实际情况当然会复杂得多。 我突然又联想到我们侨社的一些事，去年，亚省华联出现分歧，其间，不乏有识之士出来调解未果，最后形成了’华联’和’华总’两个组织，弄得领事馆 也很难办，最后是老百姓吃亏。 本来领事馆每年依靠华联来凤凰城为本地中国人做护照服务。 因为我们出现分裂，不得不请夏威夷一个旅行社来帮忙，结果出现了多收80美元的风波。 到了国庆和中秋，又是两个组织以几乎相同的内容办了两个庆祝活动，弄得我们这些’子民’们无所适从，好好一个国庆节给掰成两半，真不是滋味！ 我希望今年不要再旧戏从演。 两个组织可以各自搞各自的活动，但在国庆和办护照等重要活动中一定要合作。 希望大家本着中山先生倡导的’天下为公’精神和先生最喜欢的’博爱’二字，解决好’人民内部矛盾’，这比两岸问题要简单得多。 历史的一页已经翻了过去，真诚和让步是合作的前提，愿大家拿出点勇气，以领袖（侨领）的气质和风度来推动侨社的和谐。 （待续）
ab3f692b321b21efd59d685520c3e01b44ff6209.translatedText: Nanjing is one of the four famous furnaces in China, but the foothills of Purple Mountain, covered with green pines and cypresses and dense forests, are a good place to escape the summer heat. When I was a kid, my cousins ​​and I often came here to play during summer vacations. We ran all over the mountain trails here and took a sip of mountain spring water when we were thirsty. It still tastes sweet when I think about it. At that time, I was innocent and thought that everything in the world was beautiful. I just wanted to have fun and not feel tired even the whole day in the jungle and streams. Today, when I set foot on the steps of Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum again after more than 60 years, I climbed up the steps and thought about the dignified Chinese history of the past century. Every step I took was very heavy. Mr. Sun Yat-sen fought all his life to overthrow the Qing feudal dynasty and is a leader respected by the Chinese people. In 1940, the Nationalist Government issued an order to the whole country to respect him as the Father of the Nation, and the People's Government also respected him as a revolutionary pioneer. His portrait has been placed in the center of Tiananmen Square facing Mao Zedong's portrait. In 2011, both sides of the Taiwan Strait solemnly celebrated the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911 that overthrew the Qing Dynasty. Regardless of their differences in ideas, they all respect Dr. Sun Yat-sen in the same way. Looking at the long history of China and looking beyond the partisan concept to look at the history of China in the past 100 years, the Kuomintang and the Communist Party were originally one family. Later, due to differences in the philosophy of governing the country and the struggle for power, brothers fought against each other. The Japanese took advantage of the situation, and foreign forces also rushed to occupy the territory. As a result, lives were lost and the people suffered. In the end, today the two sides of the Taiwan Strait have to sit down and jointly seek a way to cooperate and unify. After 100 years, they have come full circle and are back to the starting point. Mr. Sun Yat-sen proposed that nation, civil rights, and people's livelihood are still the goals pursued by governments on both sides of the Taiwan Strait, but the meanings and formulations given are slightly different. Revitalizing and developing the Chinese national spirit is still the common goal of both sides of the Taiwan Strait; continuously improving the people's power to govern the country is a commitment that governments on both sides of the Strait are working hard; improving people's lives and seeking benefits for the people is a practical thing that governments on both sides of the Strait are doing. This is the solid foundation for cross-Strait cooperation and reunification. This is just the answer I got from a mortal using a simple analysis method that transcends politics. The actual situation is of course much more complicated. I suddenly thought of something about our overseas Chinese community. Last year, there was a disagreement between the Hualian Association of Alberta. During this period, many knowledgeable people came out to mediate but failed. In the end, two organizations were formed, the "Hualian" and the "Hua Zong", which made it difficult for the consulate to handle. In the end, the people suffered. Originally, the consulate relied on Hualian to come to Phoenix every year to provide passport services for local Chinese. Because we had a split, we had to ask a travel agency in Hawaii to help. As a result, there was a controversy about overcharging us by US$80. When it comes to National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival, two organizations organized two celebrations with almost the same content, leaving us ‘people’ at a loss as to what to do. It’s really unpleasant to have a National Day broken in half! I hope I won’t repeat the same old drama this year. The two organizations can each carry out their own activities, but they must cooperate on important activities such as National Day and passport applications. I hope that everyone will adhere to the spirit of "the world is for the common good" advocated by Dr. Sun Yat-sen and his favorite word "fraternity" to resolve the "contradictions among the people", which is much simpler than the cross-strait issue. A page of history has been turned. Sincerity and concession are the prerequisites for cooperation. I hope everyone can show some courage and promote the harmony of the overseas Chinese community with the temperament and demeanor of a leader (overseas Chinese leader). (to be continued)

8a09856478e6e1235caf18626a203850b6fd50eb.sourceText: （太阳鸟特约记者李睿英报道）2012年2月25日晚7时，美国亚利桑那州新东方艺术学校邀请到著名的作曲家，亚省春晚的导演刘洛宏老师给近50位当地的音乐爱好者举办了音乐欣赏讲座。他幽默诙谐的语言带来阵阵笑声，来宾都纷纷表示这是一场精彩绝伦的讲座。
8a09856478e6e1235caf18626a203850b6fd50eb.translatedText: (Reported by Sunbird Special Correspondent Li Ruiying) At 7 pm on February 25, 2012, the New Oriental Art School in Arizona, USA, invited the famous composer Liu Luohong, the director of the Alberta Spring Festival Gala, to give a music appreciation lecture to nearly 50 local music lovers. His humorous language brought bursts of laughter, and the guests all said that this was a wonderful lecture.

981c11bf37397b0986e85df31197849090c01e11.sourceText: 作曲家，亚省春晚的导演刘洛宏
981c11bf37397b0986e85df31197849090c01e11.translatedText: Composer Liu Luohong, director of the Alberta Spring Festival Gala

12816c47208439fa35205e549df632832a3b9de9.sourceText: 音乐是艺术中历史最悠久的一种，音乐也是最抽象的艺术，正是因为这种抽象感才带给了大家更多的联想。有很多人疑惑，为什么音乐只有7个音却能创造出无尽的乐曲表达人们的感情？刘老师告诉大家，这是因为音乐的四大要素：音的高低，音的长短，音的强弱和音色。而这四大要素中表达感情的最重要手段便是音的强弱。其实最早的音乐是没有强弱之分的直到15-17世纪的欧洲文艺复兴才出现。正是因为文艺复兴，艺术才有了极大的发展。
12816c47208439fa35205e549df632832a3b9de9.translatedText: Music is one of the arts with the longest history, and it is also the most abstract art. It is precisely because of this sense of abstraction that it brings more associations to everyone. Many people wonder why music can create endless music to express people's feelings even though it only has 7 tones. Teacher Liu told everyone that this is because of the four major elements of music: the pitch of the sound, the length of the sound, the strength of the sound, and the timbre. Among these four elements, the most important means of expressing emotions is the strength of the sound. In fact, the earliest music had no distinction between strong and weak. It did not appear until the European Renaissance in the 15th to 17th centuries. It is precisely because of the Renaissance that art has developed greatly.

cd9f4c251e0e4c1ccf7d6017a319bb066feb0a2e.sourceText: 为了更好地听懂音乐，刘洛宏老师以中国交响音乐史上最著名的小提琴协奏曲《梁山伯与祝英台》为例向我们讲解了如何鉴赏音乐。 刘老师称，在欣赏音乐前我们应做好准备工作，了解一定的故事背景和创作背景能更好地帮助我们了解音乐的内容及表达的情感。《梁山伯与祝英台》是中国四大民间传说中最广为流传的传说故事， 它讲述了梁山伯与祝英台不畏封建势力的胁迫最终化蝶的凄美爱情故事。协奏曲《梁祝》创作于1958年，1959年诞生。它是以上海越剧为基调写成的。同标准的奏鸣曲式一样《梁祝》分为三段曲， 第一大段为呈示部，它以梁山伯与祝英台之间的爱情为主题。这一大段分为三小段，第一段运用了小提琴的泛音和竖琴的波生这一点线结合的形势作为引子表现出阳光明媚的一天，梁山伯与祝英台的初遇。接着以长笛的悠长表达明朗的鸟语花香之景，为前奏引出小提琴主奏。最后一段为十八相送，以小提琴和大提琴来表现两人的不舍之情同祝英台无法将真相表明的纠结郁闷的心情。曲子第二段的主题为抗婚，以长管和大号表现封建势力的强大，之后用小提琴的碎弓模仿哭泣之声表现祝英台的悲伤和不愿服从于封建势力的心情。最著名的《化蝶》放在了最后，它再现了第一段的爱情主题。虽然曲子上基本相似，但却没有第一大段明朗和欢快的气息。在小提琴上加弱音器这一方法使乐曲有了朦胧灰暗的感觉，表现出在天上仙境百花齐开的美丽景象，梁山伯与祝英台变成蝴蝶双宿双膝。 这一段虽凄凉却表现出人们对他俩爱情的美好祝愿。最后的小提琴泛音更表现了两只蝴蝶的渐飞渐远。《梁祝》除了歌颂了伟大凄美的爱情更有人性不可违背的深远含义。
cd9f4c251e0e4c1ccf7d6017a319bb066feb0a2e.translatedText: In order to better understand music, teacher Liu Luohong explained to us how to appreciate music using the most famous violin concerto in the history of Chinese symphonic music, "Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai", as an example. Teacher Liu said that we should make preparations before enjoying music. Understanding a certain story background and creative background can better help us understand the content of the music and the emotions it expresses. "Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai" is the most widely circulated legend among the four major Chinese folklores. It tells the poignant love story of Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai who defied the coercion of feudal forces and finally transformed into butterflies. The concerto "Butterfly Lovers" was composed in 1958 and born in 1959. It is based on Shanghai Yue Opera. Like the standard sonata form, "Butterfly Lovers" is divided into three sections. The first section is the presentation section, which takes the love between Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai as its theme. This long section is divided into three sub-sections. The first section uses the dot-line combination of the overtones of the violin and the waves of the harp as an introduction to show the first encounter between Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai on a sunny day. Then the long flute expresses the clear scene of birds singing and the fragrance of flowers, and the violin lead is introduced as the prelude. The last section is about seeing each other off at eighteen, using violin and cello to express the two's reluctance and Zhu Yingtai's entangled and depressed mood of being unable to express the truth. The theme of the second section of the song is anti-marriage. The long pipe and tuba are used to express the power of feudal forces, and then the broken bow of the violin is used to imitate the sound of crying to express Zhu Yingtai's sadness and unwillingness to submit to feudal forces. The most famous "Butterfly" is placed at the end, which reproduces the love theme of the first paragraph. Although the music is basically similar, it doesn't have the bright and cheerful atmosphere of the first section. The method of adding a mute to the violin gives the music a hazy and dark feeling, showing the beautiful scene of flowers blooming in the heavenly fairyland, and Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai becoming butterflies on their knees. Although this paragraph is sad, it shows people's best wishes for their love. The final overtones of the violin also express the two butterflies flying away and away. "Butterfly Lovers" not only praises the great and poignant love, but also has a profound meaning that cannot be violated by human nature.

87faf0f2bdcf4bee3e1543788269ed9b98ef5868.sourceText: 本次音乐欣赏讲座非常成功，大家对此都表现出了异常的积极性。刘洛宏老师的引导下了解了更多的音乐知识，使大家的生活更加的丰富多彩。在活动的最后，更有听众表示希望可以经常组织此类有益身心陶冶情操的活动，使亚省华裔的生活更有滋有味。
87faf0f2bdcf4bee3e1543788269ed9b98ef5868.translatedText: This music appreciation lecture was very successful, and everyone showed unusual enthusiasm for it. Under the guidance of teacher Liu Luohong, we learned more about music, making everyone's lives more colorful. At the end of the event, some audience members expressed the hope that such activities that are beneficial to the body and mind and cultivate sentiments can be organized regularly to make the life of Chinese Americans in Alberta more interesting.

aef3126afd2f78a1a08ecd30b77ef98e0a31b7f8.sourceText: 新闻特写：绿叶对根的情意——参加华裔先烈悼念活动（组图）
aef3126afd2f78a1a08ecd30b77ef98e0a31b7f8.translatedText: News Feature: Green Leaf’s affection for its roots—participating in memorial activities for Chinese-American martyrs (photo)

5752c7f40e891a737ca3027a87984d2bab3d6c6a.translatedText: News Feature: Luye’s affection for roots—participating in memorial activities for Chinese-American martyrs (photo) (This website's news) May 26, 2014 "United States...

a648c57fdfe46f9f9e0a770d65a9945af26d22b0.sourceText: （本网讯）2014年5月26日”美国阵亡战士纪念日”，大约二十多位华裔，在美国凤凰城先民和军人纪念墓园，举行华裔先民的追悼和拜祭活动。当日，纪念墓园的人很多，大多是美裔，这是当地华人社区首次组织的集体悼念先人活动。追根溯源，表达对先人的崇敬和追忆，度过了一个有现实意义的纪念日。
a648c57fdfe46f9f9e0a770d65a9945af26d22b0.translatedText: (This website's news) On May 26, 2014, "American Memorial Day", about twenty Chinese Americans held memorial and worship activities for their Chinese ancestors at the American Ancestors and Military Memorial Cemetery in Phoenix, USA. On that day, there were many people at the memorial cemetery, mostly Americans. This was the first collective mourning activity organized by the local Chinese community to trace their origins and express their respect and remembrance of their ancestors. It was a meaningful anniversary.

5b14644306c89c4db99fb51334c5c1614ff95596.sourceText: 张肇鸿（左）本次活动的组织者 唐孝先（右）二十年前帮助寻找墓碑后人的华裔学者
5b14644306c89c4db99fb51334c5c1614ff95596.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong (left) organizer of this event. Tang Xiaoxian (right), a Chinese scholar who helped find the descendants of the tombstone twenty years ago

a74a4e719e53314e159f4e843939a2192e661b52.sourceText: 早上10点半，记者准时到达墓园，远远就看见本次活动的组织者张肇鸿先生。2013年他第一次到墓园，看到了这个名为”邓湘远”开平大楼村人的华人墓碑。这是亚利桑那发现的，迄今为止最老的一个华人墓碑，已经有140年。张肇鸿进行长达一年的寻访，他找到了”邓湘远”的族谱，以及后人。张肇鸿将整个寻访过程纪录下来，发表了题为《亚省华人历史文化大观园》之墓碑谜团的系列文章，在华人社区产生了巨大的影响。
a74a4e719e53314e159f4e843939a2192e661b52.translatedText: At 10:30 in the morning, the reporter arrived at the cemetery on time and saw Mr. Zhang Zhaohong, the organizer of this event, in the distance. In 2013, he went to the cemetery for the first time and saw this Chinese tombstone named "Deng Xiangyuan" from Kaiping Tower Village. This is the oldest Chinese tombstone discovered in Arizona so far. After a year-long search, Zhang Zhaohong found the genealogy of "Deng Xiangyuan" and his descendants. Zhang Zhaohong recorded the entire search process and published a book on the mystery of the tombstone titled "Grand View of Chinese History and Culture in Alberta". This series of articles has had a huge impact on the Chinese community.

67e7b5543490b8103e0eb0c5909ef9a581d51b6e.sourceText: 今年，张肇鸿撰写的《沙漠明珠》一书，记载了凤凰城华侨本土文化的发展，正式被国会图书馆和亚利桑那州立大学图书馆收藏，这本书将亚利桑那华人对美国发展所做的贡献，载入美国历史。
67e7b5543490b8103e0eb0c5909ef9a581d51b6e.translatedText: This year, Zhang Zhaohong wrote. The book "Pearl of the Desert" records the development of local Chinese culture in Phoenix and is officially collected by the Library of Congress and the Arizona State University Library. This book records the contribution of Arizona Chinese to the development of the United States.

7e759cb79fa8d46b2403dee827015c9492879356.sourceText: 资深侨领余文劲先生亲临现场，并送上鲜花。他是传统侨社大家敬重的老前辈。传统侨社对宗亲和姓氏观念很深。同一个姓氏或者家族，有人遇到困难都会慷慨相助。他不仅常常自己写文章，组织社区里大大小小的事情，每次活动都慷慨解囊。当日在六福餐厅，余文劲宴请所有参加祭奠的来宾。几十年如一日，将新老移民团结起来。
7e759cb79fa8d46b2403dee827015c9492879356.translatedText: Mr. Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader, came to the scene in person and sent flowers to everyone in the traditional overseas Chinese community. The traditional overseas Chinese community has a strong sense of kinship and surnames. People with the same surname or family will help each other generously. He often writes articles and organizes large and small events in the community. On that day, Yu Wenjin hosted a banquet for all the guests attending the memorial ceremony.

e03823f6dcdccfea2cf1e8b6fefc956b0ae8b02f.sourceText: （左至右）朱其华 朱莞菁 朱莞菱 陈彩屏
e03823f6dcdccfea2cf1e8b6fefc956b0ae8b02f.translatedText: (left to right) Zhu Qihua. Zhu Guanjing Zhu Guanling Chen Caiping

7be38fa76b2e17160ff170bdc8119249570e20ae.sourceText: 当天悼念活动最大亮点就是从伊拉克，阿富汗完成维和任务回来的华裔女军士官朱莞菱一家。父亲朱其华说希望孩子们知道他们的根在哪里，她们是年轻一代的代表，不能忘本。朱莞菱现在还是现役美国军人，正在参加Tempe警察培训，再过几个星期她就将正式从警察学校毕业，成为Tempe的女警察，为更多的市民服务。 这次祭奠活动中，老，中，青三代人的表现，让”美国阵亡战士纪念日”的意义非凡，它让生活在海外的华人心凝结在一起，寻找到”绿叶对根的情意”。
7be38fa76b2e17160ff170bdc8119249570e20ae.translatedText: The highlight of the day's memorial service was the family of the Chinese female sergeant Zhu Wanling who returned from the peacekeeping mission in Iraq and Afghanistan. Her father, Zhu Qihua, said that she hoped the children would know where their roots are. We are representatives of the younger generation and must not forget our roots. Zhu Guanling is still an active US soldier and is participating in Tempe police training. In a few weeks, she will officially graduate from the police academy and become a female police officer in Tempe to serve more citizens. In this memorial event, the performance of the old, middle and young generations made "American Memorial Day" of great significance. It allowed the Chinese people living overseas to unite together and find the "love between green leaves and roots".

9eb93f47fd2f512f3cbb5a7f1cf2e7696534c4a0.sourceText: 黄慧莉律师法律信箱（二十） 1。 我今年8月进入美国进入新的大学念硕士﹐可是这次进关﹐移民官并没有在为的I-20M表上盖章﹐请问这正常吗﹖ 答﹕ 自2012年8月10日开始，对于持有F、M、J签证反美入境的学生学者，美国海关Customs and Border Protection (CBP)已取消在其I-20和DS-2019表格上加盖入境 章的规定。 美国海关这一做法主要是为了和美国移民局的管理系统同步。 虽然美国海关一直以来都在入境学生的I-20和DS-2019上加盖入境章，但是这个印章不是必须的，因为I-20和DS-2019上的海关入境章并不代表学生的合法身份 或学期的时间。 目前，由于每个州的规定不同，一些联邦和州办事机构仍然要求国际学生提供盖章的I-20和DS-2019表格。 如果您所在的政府机构只接受盖章的I-20和DS-2019，您可以到美国移民局官方网站搃nforpass?#31995;统预约到当地移民局办公室补盖入境章，请大家注意，移民局提供的 这个预约服务只限于当前的过渡期，此项预约服务将于2012年11月21日停止。 如果国际学生对此仍有任何疑问，请直接联系(SEVP)机构，该机构电话:703-603-3400；邮箱:SEVP@dhs.gov。 2。 我的父亲已经病重﹐他想知道﹐如果他去世要交多少遗产税﹐我也想作个人的税务 计划﹐有何建议﹖ 答﹕ 2013年许多税收政策也许会有所改变。 下面有几个方面需要考虑。 512万遗产税和终身礼物税豁免即将在今年底过期。 在今年，如果有人继承去世者的遗产，512万元遗产可以免交遗产税。 礼物税和隔代继承税（generation-skipping）也按照这个数额同步豁免。 在去世之前，他们可以把遗产赠送给任何人，包括给孙辈或慈善机构。 夫妻两人加起来的省税额就是1024万元。 到了2013年，这个豁免额可能会有显著下降，也可能回到2002年的标准，每人仅有100万元的遗产税豁免。 用增值的股票赠与慈善机构。 不管什么时候，如有可能，应该向慈善组织赠送股票，而不是送现金。 这有两个好处，既能赠与，又不必支付资本利得税。 考虑转换成罗斯个人退休帐户（Roth IRA）。 假如你现在收入低或是没有所得，而在未来将有较高的收入，也许转换成罗斯退休帐户是一个好的计划。 通过大学储蓄计画（529 plans）把每年1万3000元的礼物税豁免转给子女或孙子女。 这个帐户增值是免税的，帐户里的钱可以用于投资，将来用于子女或孙子女的高等教育开支。 关注外国帐户法。 假如你有外国帐户，不仅需要申报帐户里超过1万美元的现金，而且现在开始所有外国银行和机构也要向美国国税局报告美国人超过5万美元的海外投资帐户。 如果不报，美国政府就会处罚并扣除他们在美国投资营利的30%。 当然﹐每人情况不同﹐请向专会计师或有执照的理财师作最好的规划。
9eb93f47fd2f512f3cbb5a7f1cf2e7696534c4a0.translatedText: Lawyer Huang Huili's legal mailbox (20) 1. I entered the United States in August this year to study for a master's degree at a new university. However, this time when I entered customs, the immigration officer did not stamp my I-20M form. Is this normal? Answer: Starting from August 10, 2012, the U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) has canceled the requirement to stamp entry stamps on the I-20 and DS-2019 forms for students and scholars holding F, M, and J visas who want to enter the United States. This approach of U.S. Customs is mainly to synchronize with the management system of the U.S. Immigration Service. Although the U.S. Customs has always stamped the entry stamp on the I-20 and DS-2019 of incoming students, this stamp is not necessary because the customs entry stamp on the I-20 and DS-2019 does not represent the student's legal status or semester time. Currently, some federal and state offices still require international students to provide stamped I-20 and DS-2019 forms because regulations vary from state to state. If your government agency only accepts stamped I-20 and DS-2019, you can go to the official website of the US Citizenship and Immigration Service to make an appointment to have your entry stamp reissued at the local immigration office. Please note that this appointment service provided by the USCIS is only during the current transition period, and this appointment service will cease on November 21, 2012. If international students still have any questions about this, please contact the SEVP agency directly at 703-603-3400 or SEVP@dhs.gov. 2. My father is seriously ill. He wants to know how much inheritance tax he will have to pay if he dies. I also want to make a personal tax plan. Any suggestions? Answer: Many tax policies may change in 2013. There are several aspects to consider below. 5.12 million estate tax and lifetime gift tax exemptions are set to expire at the end of this year. This year, if someone inherits the estate of a deceased person, an estate worth RMB 5.12 million will be exempt from estate tax. Gift tax and generation-skipping inheritance tax (generation-skipping) are also exempted at this amount. Before their death, they can make a gift to anyone, including grandchildren or charity. The combined tax savings for the couple is 10.24 million yuan. By 2013, this exemption amount may drop significantly, or it may return to the 2002 standard, with only 1 million yuan of inheritance tax exemption per person. Give appreciated stock to charity. Whenever possible, gifts of stock rather than cash should be given to charitable organizations. This has the two benefits of being able to make a gift and not having to pay capital gains tax. Consider converting to a Roth IRA. If you have low or no income now and will have higher income in the future, it may be a good plan to convert to a Roth retirement account. Transfer the annual gift tax exemption of $13,000 to your children or grandchildren through college savings plans (529 plans). The account grows tax-free, and the money in the account can be invested for future education expenses for children or grandchildren. Pay attention to the Foreign Accounts Act. If you have a foreign account, not only do you need to report cash in the account exceeding $10,000, but now all foreign banks and institutions must also report to the IRS foreign investment accounts of Americans exceeding $50,000. If they fail to report, the US government will punish them and deduct 30% of their investment profits in the United States. Of course, everyone’s situation is different, so please consult a professional accountant or licensed financial planner for the best plan.

552d004e80747e56f24378fbd83a8f3c598291c3.sourceText: 亚利桑那州拒绝非移被保释 高法否决 根据亚利桑那州严苛的反移民法而不得保释的数百名非法移民不久就可能有机会…
552d004e80747e56f24378fbd83a8f3c598291c3.translatedText: Arizona denies bail for immigrants, Supreme Court vetoes Hundreds of illegal immigrants who were held without bail under Arizona's draconian anti-immigrant law may soon have a chance...

060069c207bc36cf6f57c91828c7b5c62fba5617.sourceText: 据美联社报道，最高法院维持了某下级法庭在3周前作出的裁决，该裁决推翻了亚利桑那州在2006年通过的严苛反移民法。该反移民法拒绝让那些被拘押的受到重罪指控的非法移民被保释出狱。这些重罪指控包括：商店内行窃、严重身份盗窃、性侵犯及杀人。
060069c207bc36cf6f57c91828c7b5c62fba5617.translatedText: According to the Associated Press, the Supreme Court upheld a lower court's ruling three weeks ago that overturned Arizona's draconian anti-immigrant law passed in 2006. The anti-immigration law denies bail to illegal immigrants detained on felony charges. The felony charges include shoplifting, aggravated identity theft, sexual assault and homicide.

b1fc34ea370c808c15c51c973300753397f526b2.sourceText: 在该严苛法律执行期间，非法移民常常会在监狱中拘押数个月之久。他们常常因此而表示认罪并被移交给联邦移民当局递解出境。
b1fc34ea370c808c15c51c973300753397f526b2.translatedText: Illegal immigrants are often detained in jails for months while this draconian law is enforced. They often plead guilty and are turned over to federal immigration authorities for deportation.

12612396869887da9a7f45b160c0c2f950230d30.sourceText: 联邦最高法院的这项裁决已经为全亚利桑那州新一波的保释听证扫清了道路。
12612396869887da9a7f45b160c0c2f950230d30.translatedText: The federal Supreme Court ruling has cleared the way for a new wave of bail hearings across Arizona.

bd17ba49f6934860983c589be06269a34640ea7c.sourceText: 上个月，联邦第九巡回上诉法庭的一个11人的法官小组推翻了亚利桑那州的该严苛反移民法，称亚利桑那州的这一法律是在审判之前强制给予惩罚，因而违反了人们被赋予的正当程序权益。该委员会还说，这一法律是以一种”乱枪打鸟的方式”来应对所有的移民，而这些人有些可能是为了摆脱专制当局的迫害而逃离其祖国的。没有证据显示，该法律所要处理的是某个特别重要的问题。
bd17ba49f6934860983c589be06269a34640ea7c.translatedText: Last month, an 11-judge panel of the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals overturned Arizona's strict anti-immigration law, saying the law violated people's due process rights by imposing punishment before trial. The committee also said the law was a "shoot-to-shoot" approach to all immigrants, some of whom may have fled their home countries to escape persecution by authoritarian authorities. There is no evidence that the law addresses an issue of particular importance.

9556248d913df390f6e929ee362c769988b5a586.sourceText: 马里科帕县警长乔阿尔帕约（Maricopa County Sheriff Joe Arpaio）和县检察长比尔蒙哥马利（Bill Montgomery）在法庭中对该州法进行了辩护。
9556248d913df390f6e929ee362c769988b5a586.translatedText: Maricopa County Sheriff Joe Arpaio and County Attorney Bill Montgomery defended the state law in court.

7a68f2150d97636009affc49299e8d7bbbca4007.sourceText: 美国公民自由联盟（American Civil Liberties Union，ACLU）对最高法院的这项裁决表示欢迎。
7a68f2150d97636009affc49299e8d7bbbca4007.translatedText: The American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) welcomed the Supreme Court’s ruling.

fc26be5ad648efd1cb53e5d69022a161932e80dc.sourceText: ACLU的移民权益项目负责人塞西利亚?#29579;（Cecillia Wang）说：”最高法院今天的裁决应该能阻止亚利桑那州抛弃无罪推定及适用于每个人的保释听证权利的违宪企图。”
fc26be5ad648efd1cb53e5d69022a161932e80dc.translatedText: Cecillia Wang, director of the ACLU's Immigrant Rights Project, said: "Today's Supreme Court ruling should thwart Arizona's unconstitutional attempt to throw away the presumption of innocence and everyone's right to a bail hearing."

78cd5450956ec4f845916b284ce64908616616da.translatedText: China Forum: China's Role in the Global Economy As an important part of the series of activities to celebrate China's National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival, the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University...

f2d8b1fbc938654eeb2d20b84b3b2d40aec1ceae.sourceText: 作为庆祝中国国庆中秋系列活动的重要组成部分，美国亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院将于9月21日下午1:30-3:00,在Tempe校区 Memorial Union Turquoise Ballroom举办第六届中国论坛。 本次论坛的主题是”全球市场中与中国的合作”论坛将促进华人社区，商界领袖，政府政要以及公众之间的对话。论坛关注全球经济，中国重要性的提升，以及科技方面的创新。 中华人民共和国驻洛杉矶总领事馆孙鲁山将亲临现场带来精彩的演讲。 孔子学院以及国际字母与文化学院主任Joe Cutter说”中国论坛为学生和社区成员提供了一个独特的机会倾听那些亲自参与到中国投资的第一手的经验。今年的论坛将为听众提供生动有趣，又非常有价值的到中国做生意的见解和经验。” 除了主讲，本次论坛还将有三位特别的嘉宾，他们是文思海辉技术有限公司（ Pactera Technology International）执行副总裁，市场总监Jeff Wu。他的演讲是”全球化的路径-文思海辉的故事” Wu先生说如果最大的发达国家和最大的发展中国家一起合作的话，未来的挑战是成功的管理。虽然在某些问题上我们有不同的观点和信念，但是在很多领域我们是双赢的。其中最佳的途径之一就是技术创新与合作。 Daniel Shum, Najafi公司付总裁，将要演讲”中国的机会：文化的产品和媒体工业” Randal Schulhauser，美敦力公司（Medtronic）高级产品经理，将会给大家带来美敦力在中国发展的历史和未来的计划。 美敦力公司于中国有25年的业务。Randal Schulhauser说我们了解到这是一个非常有活动的市场，它的需求非常的庞大，很有挑战性。适应快节奏的变化，不同的，多样化的规则，了解客户，包括医患双方的需求是美敦力成功的关键。 本次活动期间还将有题为”美丽的亚利桑那州”摄影展览，孔子学院举办了青少年海报设计和摄影比赛。获奖作品将在现场展出。 本次活动免费对公众开放，但需要注册，座位有限。 欢迎预定： http://confuciusinstitute.asu.edu/portal/chinaforum2014 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院，国际字符与文化学院，亚省华联主办，凯丽全球教育，州立大学学生学者联谊会协办
f2d8b1fbc938654eeb2d20b84b3b2d40aec1ceae.translatedText: As an important part of the series of activities to celebrate China's National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival, the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University will hold a ceremony at Memorial Union Turquoise on the Tempe campus from 1:30-3:00 pm on September 21st. Ballroom hosts the 6th China Forum. The theme of this forum is "Cooperation with China in the Global Market." The forum will promote dialogue among the Chinese community, business leaders, government dignitaries, and the public. The forum focuses on the global economy, the growing importance of China, and innovation in science and technology. Sun Lushan, Consulate General of the People's Republic of China in Los Angeles, will be on hand to deliver a wonderful speech. Joe Cutter, Director of the Confucius Institute and International Letters and Culture Institute, said, "The China Forum provides students and community members with a unique opportunity to hear first-hand experiences of those who are personally involved in investing in China. This year's forum will provide the audience with lively, interesting, and very valuable insights and experiences on doing business in China." In addition to the main speaker, this forum will also have three special guests, they are Jeff Wu, executive vice president and marketing director of Pactera Technology International. His speech was "The Path of Globalization - The Story of Pactera". Mr. Wu said that if the largest developed countries and the largest developing countries work together, the future challenge is successful management. Although we have different views and beliefs on some issues, in many areas we are a win-win. One of the best ways is technological innovation and cooperation. Daniel Shum, deputy president of Najafi, will give a speech on "China's Opportunities: Cultural Products and Media Industry." Randal Schulhauser, senior product manager of Medtronic, will bring you the history and future plans of Medtronic's development in China. Medtronic has had business in China for 25 years. Randal Schulhauser said that we understand that this is a very active market, and its demand is very large and very challenging. Adapting to fast-paced changes, different and diverse regulations, and understanding the needs of customers, including doctors and patients, are the keys to Medtronic's success. There will also be a photography exhibition titled "Beautiful Arizona" during this event, and the Confucius Institute held a youth poster design and photography competition. The winning works will be displayed on site. This event is free and open to the public, but registration is required and seating is limited. Reservations are welcome: http://confuciusinstitute.asu.edu/portal/chinaforum2014 Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, Institute of International Character and Culture, hosted by the Hualian Association of Alberta, co-organized by Kaili Global Education, and State University Students and Scholars Association

1b11ec5f5d18cefb9ed9b6ddf2c29b179fa47cb6.translatedText: On the occasion of the New Year, at the invitation of a new world-class musical instrument museum, the U.S.-China Culture and Art Exchange Association will jointly host two Chinese art performances with the museum. It includes traditional Chinese arts such as song singing, instrumental music performance, dance, martial arts, dragon dance, Sichuan Opera face-changing and so on. At the same time, more than 20 large-scale art works with horses as the theme by the famous Chinese painter Li Cheng will be exhibited. We hope that all people, men, women and children from all walks of life who support the promotion of Chinese culture and art will come. Not only can you taste our traditional Chinese art again on the occasion of the New Year, but you can also appreciate and appreciate the architecture of the huge museum and the thousands of musical instruments from all corners of the world on display inside. Happy New Year, why not. Time: January 28, 11:00-12:00 am, 1:30-2:30 pm Location: Musical Instrument Museum, 4725 E. Mayo Boulevard, Phoenix, AZ 85050 Phone: 480-478-6000

81540c4953cbd380a2021c88eb8e560b30b1d8de.sourceText: 近日闻悉”亚省时报”甄社长的夫人，报社前主编余蔼蓉女士因病去世的不幸消息。很多年前就听说甄太太长期生病，病得很重，久治难愈。我因此想到，甄太太能享年七十八岁，除了美国现代医学的功效，应该是甄社长长期对夫人的精心照顾创造了这么一个奇迹。 大约在六，七年前，有次到甄社长家开一个有关写作的会议。甄社长刚把夫人从医院接回家。甄社长说，甄太太积劳成疾，每周要送几次医院去洗肾，都是甄社长早上送去，中午前把甄太太接回家，这种情况已经好几年了。快到中午时，甄社长说要给太太做饭了。 我有几次去报社，正好看到甄社长匆匆往外走，要赶到医院接甄太太。他迈着有点蹒跚而又急促的步子往停车的地方走去。后来听甄社长说起，他有一次因抢拍新闻镜头，身体失控，摔碎了膝盖，导致走路不便。 过去的几年当中，我经常将中文学校教师的文章和学生的作文送到”亚省时报”发表。有时周五得知已经出报，我们中文学校教师的文章或学生的作文已登上本期报纸，我就到西边去办事，顺便去取报纸，盼望早点一睹为快。车子开到甄社长的前院，好几次看到甄社长和帮手把坐在轮椅上的甄太太推到前院晒太阳，呼吸外面的新鲜空气。 前年的某一天，我到报社去，看到甄太太在晒太阳，她的脖颈倾斜耷拉着，好像已经很虚弱了。快到中午时，还是甄社长亲自为甄太太准备午餐。 甄社长自己的腿脚也不太灵活，总是亲力亲为地精心照顾他的老夫人，这么多年了，个中的艰辛，是外人难以想象的。有一次，在报上看到甄太太过去的同事和学生从外地赶来看望她的消息和照片。这一切，会给甄太太带来莫大的愉快和慰籍，甄社长是一个对太太多么有心的人。 从甄社长对甄太太的精心照顾上，让人看到了人间朴实的真爱。西方人在大教堂里举行婚礼，两个相爱的人在牧师的面前许下爱的誓言：不论是贫穷疾病永不离弃。甄社长和甄太太的婚礼也许没有这么浪漫，但他们像很多具有中华传统美德的夫妇一样，用自己真实的人生书写了人性中最美好的内容。更进一步看，一个对家人充满爱心的人才能真正对社会奉献爱心。 2009年秋，亚省华人作家协会和”亚省时报”为本地女作家许莊玲举行新书发布会，同时邀请了著名华人女作家吴玲瑶来演讲。活动结束前，甄社长上台讲了一番话，我至今印象深刻。 甄社长当时说，”亚省时报”创办快二十年了。曾有人问，办报这么辛苦，你们当初为什么要办报呢？甄社长说，为了吃饭。多么真实而朴素的话语！ 甄社长又说，最初办报时，没有现在先进的编辑软件。他的太太，即报社前主编余蔼蓉女士用老式的打字机排版，他们夫妇俩和女儿一起承担了报纸的编辑，排版，拉广告，出报，送报等所有的工作。报纸从最初的半月一期发展到后来的一周一期。现在已经是一周出两期了。 听到甄社长用平实的语言讲述办报的经历，我当时心里是感慨万分。试想，他们从中年以后来到这个语言不熟的陌生土地上打拼，靠自己的辛勤劳动和特长在异国从新开始，不仅为了自家人的生存立足，养育后代，并且开创出亚利桑那地区第一家正式华文报纸的新天地。 ”亚省时报”创办以来，为华人的信息交流，为社区的各种活动和公益事业，提供了一个重要的平台。最值得强调的是，”亚省时报”为中文学校的发展，多年来起了很大的促进作用。2006年至2010年，我在负责希望中文学校的工作时，”亚省时报” 登载了大量关于希望中文学校活动，教育探讨，教学动态等文章和照片，为传播希望中文学校的活动信息，为加强希望中文学校与当地社区的联系起了非常有力的作用。 特别重要的是，”亚省时报”多年前就在宝贵的版面上开辟了”中文教育园地”，专门登载本地各家中文学校的文章和学生习作。在过去的四年间，仅是我手中存有的剪报，希望中文学校的教师在”亚省时报”发表了近50篇教学心得的文章，这对教师们是很大的尊重和鼓励，有些年轻教师的文章是第一次见诸报端。这些文章在中文学校和社区获得了一定的反响。曾有好几位其它中文学校的教师说，他们把这些教学心得文章都剪贴留存下来了。 那四年当中，希望中文学校共有几十位学生在”亚省时报”上发表了他们稚嫩的习作。学生和教师家长拿到登载学生作文的报纸后，个个笑逐颜开，学生们的自信心和成就感也在其中得到肯定。 前人栽树，后人得益。甄社长和甄太太创立的”亚省时报”使我们中文学校得益。”饮水思源”，知恩感恩是我们中华民族的传统美德。我想，中文学校的师生家长都会记住和感谢”亚省时报”对中文学校的贡献。我本人也对我在从事中文教育工作时，社区所有给予支持和帮助的人士永存感激。
81540c4953cbd380a2021c88eb8e560b30b1d8de.translatedText: Recently I heard the unfortunate news that Ms. Yu Airong, the wife of President Zhen of the "Alberta Times" and the former editor-in-chief of the newspaper, passed away due to illness. Many years ago, I heard that Mrs. Zhen had been ill for a long time. She was very ill and could not be cured after long-term treatment. Therefore, I thought that Mrs. Zhen’s longevity at the age of seventy-eight was not only due to the effects of modern American medicine, but also President Zhen’s long-term careful care of his wife that created such a miracle. About six or seven years ago, I once went to President Zhen’s house to hold a meeting about writing. President Zhen just took his wife home from the hospital. President Zhen said that Mrs. Zhen became ill due to overwork and had to be sent to the hospital several times a week for kidney dialysis. President Zhen always sent her to the hospital in the morning and took Mrs. Zhen home before noon. This situation had been going on for several years. When it was almost noon, President Zhen said he was going to cook for his wife. I went to the newspaper office several times and happened to see President Zhen walking out in a hurry to rush to the hospital to pick up Mrs. Zhen. He walked towards the parking place with a somewhat staggering and hasty step. Later, I heard from President Zhen that he once lost control of his body while trying to snap a news shot, and broke his knee, causing difficulty in walking. In the past few years, I have often sent articles by Chinese school teachers and students' compositions to the "Alberta Times" for publication. Sometimes I learn on Friday that a newspaper has been published, and that an article by a teacher from our Chinese school or a composition by a student has been published in the current issue of the newspaper. I go to the west to do some errands and pick up the newspaper on the way, hoping to see it as soon as possible. The car drove to President Zhen's front yard, and several times I saw President Zhen and his helpers pushing Mrs. Zhen, who was in a wheelchair, to the front yard to bask in the sun and breathe the fresh air outside. One day the year before last, I went to the newspaper office and saw Mrs. Zhen sunbathing. Her neck was sloping, as if she was very weak. When it was almost noon, President Zhen personally prepared lunch for Mrs. Zhen. President Zhen's own legs and feet are not very flexible, so he has always personally taken good care of his old lady. After so many years, the hardships involved are unimaginable to outsiders. Once, I saw in the newspaper news and photos of Mrs. Zhen’s former colleagues and students who came from out of town to visit her. All this will bring great joy and comfort to Mrs. Zhen. President Zhen is a man who cares deeply about his wife. From President Zhen's careful care of Mrs. Zhen, people can see the simple and true love in the world. Westerners hold weddings in cathedrals, and two lovers make a vow of love in front of the priest: no matter poverty or illness, they will never leave. The wedding of President Zhen and Mrs. Zhen may not have been so romantic, but like many couples with traditional Chinese virtues, they used their real lives to write the most beautiful content in human nature. Looking further, a person who is full of love for his family can truly contribute love to society. In the fall of 2009, the Alberta Chinese Writers Association and the "Alberta Times" held a book launch for local female writer Xu Zhuangling, and also invited the famous Chinese female writer Wu Lingyao to give a speech. Before the event ended, President Zhen came on stage and spoke. I am still deeply impressed. President Zhen said at the time that the "Alberta Times" had been founded almost 20 years ago. Someone once asked, running a newspaper is so hard, why did you run a newspaper in the first place? President Zhen said, for food. What true and simple words! President Zhen also said that when the newspaper was first launched, there was no advanced editing software available today. His wife, Ms. Yu Airong, the former editor-in-chief of the newspaper, typeset with an old-fashioned typewriter. Together with their daughter, the couple and their daughter undertake all the tasks of editing, typesetting, advertising, publishing, and delivering newspapers. The newspaper developed from a semi-monthly issue to a weekly issue. It is now published twice a week. I was deeply moved when I heard President Zhen talk about his experience of running a newspaper in plain language. Just imagine, they came to this strange land where they didn’t know the language and worked hard after middle age. They relied on their hard work and expertise to start over in a foreign country. Not only did they gain a foothold for their own family’s survival and raise their children, but they also created a new world as the first official Chinese-language newspaper in Arizona. Since its establishment, the "Alberta Times" has provided an important platform for information exchange among Chinese people, as well as various community activities and public welfare undertakings. What is most worth emphasizing is that the "Alberta Times" has played a great role in promoting the development of Chinese schools over the years. From 2006 to 2010, when I was in charge of Hope Chinese School, the "Alberta Times" published a large number of articles and photos about Hope Chinese School's activities, educational discussions, teaching trends, etc. It played a very powerful role in spreading information about Hope Chinese School's activities and strengthening the connection between Hope Chinese School and the local community. What is particularly important is that the "Alberta Times" opened up a "Chinese Education Corner" on its valuable pages many years ago, specifically publishing articles and students' homework from local Chinese schools. In the past four years, I only have newspaper clippings in my hand. Teachers from Hope Chinese School have published nearly 50 articles on their teaching experiences in the "Alberta Times". This is a great respect and encouragement to the teachers. It is the first time that some young teachers' articles have been published in newspapers. These articles have received a certain response from Chinese schools and communities. Several teachers from other Chinese schools said that they had cut and pasted these teaching experience articles. During those four years, dozens of students from Hope Chinese School published their immature homework assignments in the "Alberta Times". After the students, teachers, and parents received the newspaper with the students' compositions, they all burst into laughter, and the students' self-confidence and sense of accomplishment were also affirmed. Forefathers plant trees, and future generations will benefit. The "Alberta Times" founded by President Zhen and Mrs. Zhen has benefited our Chinese school. "Drink water and think of its source." Gratitude and gratitude are the traditional virtues of our Chinese nation. I think teachers, students and parents of Chinese schools will remember and appreciate the contribution of The Alberta Times to Chinese schools. I am also eternally grateful to all the people in the community who have provided support and help when I was engaged in Chinese education.

53e7b8bdbfcb4c8d9250b983243244ff798be2f8.sourceText: 记者从2011年7月24日下午2时，亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会（华联）在钱德勒图书馆举行的庆中国国庆中秋系列活动筹备会议中获悉，三位重量级嘉宾将以”在全球市场中与中国的合作”为主题，给凤凰城朋友带来精彩的演讲。 嘉宾一：英特尔驻上海负责亚太地区市场的陈伟。他曾经服务于本地的摩托罗拉和英特尔，曾任英特尔上海工厂的总经理。有丰富的东西方IT市场管理和商场经验，对中美企业文化的异同有真实体验。 嘉宾二：尚德太阳能电力有限公司的执行副总裁邵华纤，她是尚德电力的开国元勋。尚德是中国大陆在凤凰城建厂投资的成功案例。企业在美国发展中得到的优惠，遇到的问题都非常有代表性，对一些新的希望到美国投资的商家，有借鉴价值。 嘉宾三：鲁迪 威尔特（Rudy Vetter）是亚利桑那的经济理事。他多年从事国际经济投资和发展的研究。亚利桑那商业投资方面的政策专家。 本次筹备会由华联副会长董斌主持，整个活动由华联，ASU孔子学院主办，大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会（侨联），与会来宾还积极坦诚地探讨了新老华联的合作问题，与领事馆的接洽问题，会长费健表示会团结一切华人力量，给当地华人带来一个欢乐团结的国庆节。 国庆中秋活动时间：2011年9月18日 地点： ASU Memorial Union
53e7b8bdbfcb4c8d9250b983243244ff798be2f8.translatedText: The reporter learned from the preparatory meeting for a series of activities to celebrate China's National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival held by the Arizona Overseas Chinese Federation (Hualian) at Chandler Library at 2 p.m. on July 24, 2011 that three heavyweight guests will give wonderful speeches to friends in Phoenix with the theme of "Cooperation with China in the Global Market." Guest 1: Chen Wei, who is responsible for the Asia-Pacific market at Intel in Shanghai. He once worked for local Motorola and Intel, and was the general manager of Intel's Shanghai factory. He has rich experience in IT market management and shopping malls in the East and West, and has real experience in the similarities and differences between Chinese and American corporate cultures. Guest 2: Shao Huaxian, Executive Vice President of Suntech Solar Power Co., Ltd. She is the founding father of Suntech Power. Suntech is a successful case of mainland China investing in building a factory in Phoenix. The preferential treatment companies have received while developing in the United States and the problems encountered are very representative and can serve as a reference for some new businesses hoping to invest in the United States. Guest 3: Rudy Vetter is Arizona’s economic director. He has been engaged in research on international economic investment and development for many years. Policy expert on business investments in Arizona. The preparatory meeting was hosted by Dong Bin, Vice President of Hualian. The entire event was hosted by Hualian, the ASU Confucius Institute, and the Greater Phoenix Chinese Overseas Chinese Association (Overseas Chinese Federation). Guests at the meeting also actively and candidly discussed cooperation issues between the new and old Hualian and contacts with the consulate. President Fei Jian said that he would unite all Chinese forces to bring a joyful and united National Day to the local Chinese. National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival Event Time: September 18, 2011 Location: ASU Memorial Union

e5b3f03ca30958321de76467d1939328759cc120.sourceText: 洛杉矶警方１２月１６日透露，枪击中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆的是一名来自上海的名为张宝亮的６７岁华裔男子，枪手事发前与中领馆外的一名保安 发生争执，因保安把他留下的标语放进垃圾箱而引​​起，随后枪手连开九枪，没有击中目标，中领馆外留下弹孔，案发后三小时枪手向附近警局投案 自首，警局收缴了他一支9毫米口径手枪，并起诉他犯下”故意杀人罪”，警方将其保释金定在10万元。 据称，张宝亮现居住洛杉矶，即将获得”自然归化”美国国籍。
e5b3f03ca30958321de76467d1939328759cc120.translatedText: The Los Angeles police revealed on December 16 that the person who shot the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles was a 67-year-old Chinese man named Zhang Baoliang from Shanghai. Before the incident, the gunman had a fight with a security guard outside the Chinese Consulate. An argument broke out because the security guard put the slogan he left in the trash can. The gunman then fired nine shots, missing the target and leaving bullet holes outside the Chinese Consulate. Three hours after the incident, the gunman surrendered to a nearby police station. The police station confiscated a 9 mm pistol from him and charged him with "intentional homicide." The police set his bail at 100,000 yuan. It is said that Zhang Baoliang is now living in Los Angeles and is about to obtain "naturalized" U.S. citizenship.

21e5321799ceba66e00dceac1a88959779a0be58.sourceText: 【凤凰城华人基督教会 凤鸣报导】2013年11月16日早上8点钟，当我准时到达教会时，亚太社区促进会与凤凰城华人基督教会的同工志愿者都已到位，所有桌椅都已摆放好、样样井然有序，已有不少人排在接待桌前。看到负责接待的同工们都面带微笑，热情地接待每一位来宾。有的志愿者忙着邦助来宾填写表格，有的志愿者根据来宾的不同需要，将他（她）们带到不同检查项目的桌前，有秩序地排好队。在测试胆固醇/血糖化验的一排桌前，人虽然多，仍然可以按预约的时间，按先后次序，拿到编号，坐在一字排开的椅子上，等待检查。
21e5321799ceba66e00dceac1a88959779a0be58.translatedText: [Reported by Phoenix Chinese Christian Church Fengming] At 8 o'clock in the morning on November 16, 2013, when I arrived at the church on time, co-worker volunteers from the Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association and Phoenix Chinese Christian Church were already in place. All the tables and chairs were placed and in order, and many people were already lined up at the reception table. I saw that the co-workers in charge of the reception were all smiling and enthusiastically receiving every guest. Some volunteers were busy helping guests fill out forms, and some volunteers took guests to tables with different inspection items according to their different needs and lined them up in an orderly manner. In front of a row of tables for cholesterol/blood sugar testing, although there are many people, you can still get the number according to the appointment time and in order, sit on the chairs lined up in a row, and wait for the test.

0981b5f3da3722200fd59c0261ced679e99ce39d.sourceText: 今天参加免费健康检查的来宾真不少，由于今天提供华语，越南语及韩语翻译，使不懂英语的来宾都得到及时的邦助。本次社区免费医疗服务，予备胆固醇/血糖化验100位、乳癌检查40位、流感予防300及6个月以上儿童100位、血压检查、乙型肝炎化验等检查项目，至下午1：00pm，得到胆固醇/血糖化验者105位，乳癌检查37位，（他们一直工作到下午4：00pm）流感预防疫苗接种75位，乙肝化验73位。另有60人参加了乙型肝炎讲座和奥巴马保健讲座。在座谈会中，为来宾们详细解荅疑问，当天就邦助20人申请奥巴马健康保健计划，还有许多人在会后的予约等待中。
0981b5f3da3722200fd59c0261ced679e99ce39d.translatedText: There are many guests participating in the free health examination today. Since Chinese, Vietnamese and Korean translations are provided today, guests who do not understand English can receive timely assistance. This community free medical service provided 100 people with cholesterol/blood sugar tests, 40 people with breast cancer examinations, 300 people with influenza prevention and 100 children over 6 months old, blood pressure tests, hepatitis B tests and other examination items. By 1:00pm, 105 people had received cholesterol/blood sugar tests, 37 people had breast cancer examinations, (they worked until 4:00pm) 75 people had influenza vaccinations, and 73 people had hepatitis B tests. Another 60 people attended the Hepatitis B lecture and the Obamacare lecture. During the symposium, the guests’ questions were answered in detail, and 20 people were assisted to apply for the Obama health care plan that day, and many others were waiting for appointments after the meeting.

54c56c51a33f17c2ccfd3dc7f55c9d05e4835d0b.sourceText: 亚太社区徒进会和凤凰城华人基督教会联合举行的社区免费医疗服务已完美结束。免费为亚太没有健康保险的社区人群服务，早亚太社区促进会一成立2002年就开始了，后来在每年春季、冬季两次免费健康检查服务。这次的免费健康检查从8月份就开始筹备，有亚太社区促进会和凤凰城华人基督教会合作，有13个赞助机构，邀请了医生7位、护士14位，更有50多位志愿者参与义务服务，使凤凰城广大的亚裔人群得到巨大邦助，得到众人的称赞和好评，真得也收到了完美的效果。
54c56c51a33f17c2ccfd3dc7f55c9d05e4835d0b.translatedText: The community free medical service jointly organized by the Asia Pacific Community Disciples Association and the Phoenix Chinese Christian Church has come to a successful conclusion. Free services for community groups without health insurance in Asia-Pacific began in 2002 when the Asia-Pacific Community Promotion Association was established. Later, free health examination services were provided twice every spring and winter. Preparations for this free health checkup began in August. The Asia-Pacific Community Promotion Association and the Phoenix Chinese Christian Church cooperated. There were 13 sponsoring organizations, 7 doctors, 14 nurses, and more than 50 volunteers were invited to participate in voluntary services. The vast number of Asian people in Phoenix received huge financial assistance and received praise and praise from everyone. It also received perfect results.

54db9a9f03d275ba7165d93e079fe97fa0fcf7c6.sourceText: 【侨报记者李竑8月11日纽约报道】虽然11日纽约黄金价格在10日创纪录冲高后回落，但在最近的三个交易日，仍然连续大幅上涨，累计涨幅达8%。面对金价”一路高歌”，华埠金店老板喜忧参半。专业人士提醒欲购买黄金保值者，要看清黄金实际价格，入场需谨慎。
54db9a9f03d275ba7165d93e079fe97fa0fcf7c6.translatedText: [Overseas Chinese News reporter Li Hong reported in New York on August 11] Although the price of gold in New York fell back on the 11th after hitting a record high on the 10th, it still continued to rise sharply in the last three trading days, with a cumulative increase of 8%. Faced with the “high-flying” price of gold, Chinatown gold shop owners have mixed feelings. Professionals remind those who want to buy gold to maintain their value, to see the actual price of gold clearly and to be cautious when entering the market.

a5b9ebf9de33830925b70973024e768072d4676a.sourceText: 社区人士郑正江表示，黄金在华人心目中一向有着特殊的地位，投资、保值要购买黄金，结婚、生子、祝寿送礼首选黄金饰品，黄金涨跌可以说牵动了许多人的心。
a5b9ebf9de33830925b70973024e768072d4676a.translatedText: Zheng Zhengjiang, a community member, said that gold has always had a special status in the hearts of Chinese people. Gold is purchased for investment and value preservation, and gold jewelry is the first choice for wedding, childbirth, and birthday gifts. The rise and fall of gold can be said to have affected the hearts of many people.

2e68fbf3f2a8848d2a64264e5d0350003acd7d3c.sourceText: 东百老汇鸿发金行总经理林玉芳表示，看着这些天金价上涨，她和许多同行一样喜忧参半。喜的是，由于大家手上都有存货，这些天赚了点钱；忧的是黄金价格不稳定，如此攀升，顾客不敢贸然买进，商家不敢进货，影响生意。”这些天客人少了三四成。”林玉芳说。黄金的上涨也带动了钻石、白金上涨，林玉芳表示，从今年4月到现在，钻石涨了40%，而目前白金和黄金几乎同价，这是从来未有的过的。
2e68fbf3f2a8848d2a64264e5d0350003acd7d3c.translatedText: Lin Yufang, general manager of East Broadway Hongfa Gold Bank, said that watching the price of gold rise these days, she, like many of her peers, has mixed feelings. The good news is that everyone has made some money these days because they have inventory on hand; the worry is that the price of gold is unstable and has risen so high that customers are afraid to buy rashly and merchants are afraid to purchase goods, which affects business. "The number of guests has dropped by 30 to 40% these days," Lin Yufang said. The rise of gold has also led to the rise of diamonds and platinum. Lin Yufang said that from April this year to now, diamonds have risen by 40%, and currently platinum and gold are almost the same price, which has never happened before.

e10e4321c742c7301a3525f3bcabb03448028835.sourceText: 金价上涨影响到了福州人的送礼习惯。周日要喝喜酒的黄女士原来打算购买一条手链，在表侄女的婚宴上作为见面礼送出，11日走了几家金店后，她放弃了原来的打算。黄女士说：”现在300元已经买不到一条像样的手链了，还是直接给钱算了。”林玉芳表示，确实现在越来越多福州人除了至亲的晚辈结婚，血缘关系稍远一点的晚辈结婚，都选择送现金了。?#20116;六年前，一两百元可以买到一条漂亮的手链，当见面礼又好看又大方。那时每到周末傍晚，婚宴要开始前，东百老汇各家金店都是被客人里三层外三层地围着，现在这样的情形再也见不到了。?/P>
e10e4321c742c7301a3525f3bcabb03448028835.translatedText: The rise in gold prices has affected the gift-giving habits of Fuzhou people. Ms. Huang, who was having a wedding banquet on Sunday, originally planned to buy a bracelet to give as a gift at her cousin's niece's wedding banquet. After visiting several gold stores on the 11th, she gave up her original plan. Ms. Huang said: "Now 300 yuan can no longer buy a decent bracelet, so I'd better give the money directly." Lin Yufang said that indeed, more and more people in Fuzhou now choose to give cash when getting married not only to their closest relatives, but also to those who are more distantly related by blood. ?#20116;Six years ago, one or two hundred yuan could buy a beautiful bracelet, which was nice and generous as a meeting gift. At that time, every weekend evening, before the wedding banquet, every gold shop on East Broadway would be surrounded by guests on three levels inside and three outside. We can no longer see such a situation. ?/P>

fdb5e3a7ff6521bd9b316ce279d2f800b60f68df.sourceText: 相当一部分华人购买黄金投资保值，据《华尔街日报》报道，今年以来金价已累计上涨25.5%。业界对黄金是否会继续走高目前意见不一，有分析师认为，欧美债务问题以及全球经济低迷仍将支撑黄金继续走强。甚至有交易员认为，黄金价格年末爬上2000元应该很”轻松”，但也人认为，随着金价进一步走高，价格大幅回落的风险也在加大。中国银行纽约华埠分行第一副总裁李根宝表示，欲购买黄金保值者，最好不要随短期的波动而动，购买时要看其?#23454;际价值?#65292;在价格大幅波动时入场要小心谨慎。
fdb5e3a7ff6521bd9b316ce279d2f800b60f68df.translatedText: A considerable number of Chinese people buy gold to invest in value-preservation. According to the Wall Street Journal, the price of gold has risen by 25.5% since the beginning of this year. The industry currently has mixed opinions on whether gold will continue to rise. Some analysts believe that debt problems in Europe and the United States and the global economic downturn will still support gold's continued strength. Some traders even believe that it should be "easy" for gold prices to climb to 2,000 yuan by the end of the year, but others believe that as gold prices rise further, the risk of a sharp price drop is also increasing. Li Genbao, the first vice president of Bank of China's New York Chinatown Branch, said that those who want to buy gold to protect its value should not follow short-term fluctuations. When buying, they should look at its international value and be cautious when entering the market when prices fluctuate significantly.

18ac3aea4c85c2c5241e4bf04f990f57a437e874.sourceText: 近日，马利科巴郡通报两例因毒蚊叮咬导致西尼罗病毒发作死亡案例。 两名死者均为老年男性。 州卫生和环境服务部说，本季节已接获西尼罗病毒案例超过100例。 据病毒专家发现，今年的毒蚊病例与往年不同。 去年的西尼罗病毒多发生在马利科巴郡东部，而今年，全郡都有。 去年，本州共有166人感染西尼罗病毒，14人因此死亡，其中大部分发生在马利科巴郡。 为了避免感染，应该做到以下几点： –避免黄昏和黎明之间到户外活动，这时的蚊子最活跃。 –如果一定要在室外活动，穿轻便的服装，以遮盖好胳膊和腿为好，并使用驱蚊剂。 –确保门窗紧闭。 –消除蚊子滋生的盆栽，废弃轮胎，鸟浴及其他可能收集积水的容器。 –确保游泳池和水景装饰清洁。 –每周至少两次给室外花盆，宠物饮水器换水。 若怀疑感染西尼罗病毒，请致电：602-506-6616。
18ac3aea4c85c2c5241e4bf04f990f57a437e874.translatedText: Recently, Maricopa County reported two deaths from West Nile virus attacks caused by venomous mosquito bites. Both deceased men were elderly men. The state Department of Health and Environmental Services says there have been more than 100 cases of West Nile virus this season. According to virus experts, this year's venomous mosquito cases are different from previous years. Last year, West Nile virus mostly occurred in eastern Maricopa County, but this year, it is found throughout the county. Last year, 166 people were infected with West Nile virus in the state and 14 people died, mostly in Maricopa County. To avoid infection, you should do the following: – Avoid going outdoors between dusk and dawn, when mosquitoes are most active. – If you must be outdoors, wear lightweight clothing that covers your arms and legs, and use mosquito repellent. – Make sure doors and windows are closed. – Eliminate mosquito-breeding potted plants, discarded tires, bird baths and other containers that may collect stagnant water. – Ensure pool and water feature decorations are clean. – Change the water in outdoor flower pots and pet drinking fountains at least twice a week. If you suspect West Nile Virus, please call: 602-506-6616.

c56c59d5fde269436bdcbce8c06b4fe95c2a31f2.sourceText: “水立方杯”海外青少年中文歌曲大赛亚利桑那赛区评分顺利结束（图） [亚利桑那州比赛组委会来稿] 上周六6月4日亚利桑那赛区裁判组为参加”水立方杯”海外青少年中文歌曲大赛的本赛区的选手进行了评分。十六位选手获” ’水立方杯’ ”亚利桑那赛区2011年优秀歌手奖”。 获奖选手名单为（按姓氏排列）：蔡雅双、董凌伽、高薇佳、梁宇晨、阮望、仝仁、仝伟、仝信、汪雯、熊炜、严婕娅、叶如心、余艳梅、张雨佳、赵诣、 郑曼吉。 其中，蔡雅双、高薇佳、严婕娅、赵诣四位选手将代表本赛区参加全美国的决赛，以便推选出代表美国到北京参加”水立方杯”海外青少年中文歌曲大赛的选手。 这次参加本赛区比赛的青少年有些来自本州四所中文学校：图桑祖筍中文学校、图桑国语教会中文学校、现代中文学校、希望中文学校；还有本州的其它青少年参赛；新墨西哥州因未设赛区，该州的选手也划归到本赛区。参赛选手出生地为美国，中国各省市，英国，沙特阿拉伯等地的包括满族，汉族和回族的华裔青少年，年龄段从14岁到26岁。 本赛区的选手演唱歌曲内容健康清新，范围广泛，既有父母辈熟悉的老歌曲，也有网络传播的最新歌曲。选手们在申请的过程和演唱中表现出积极参与的心态和青春向上的精神面貌，也展现出一定的演唱才能和水准。组委会期待本赛区的选手在全美国的决赛中胜出，更期待今后有更多的机会让青少年参与中华文化的活动。 本赛区的主裁判音乐博士郑小钟先生主持了这次评分活动，来自四所中文学校的裁判李国华先生，王楠女士，陈益女士，王桂仙女士共同完成了这次评分活动。本赛区组委会的两位共同主席朱岩，雷宏，以及组委会成员谢明，帅致若均全程出席了这次评分活动。 照片：裁判们在开会
c56c59d5fde269436bdcbce8c06b4fe95c2a31f2.translatedText: "Water Cube Cup" Overseas Youth Chinese Song Contest Arizona Division Scoring Successfully Concluded (Picture) [Submission from the Arizona Competition Organizing Committee] Last Saturday, June 4, the Arizona division referee team scored the contestants from this division who participated in the "Water Cube Cup" Overseas Youth Chinese Song Contest. Sixteen contestants won the "Water Cube Cup" and "Arizona Division 2011 Outstanding Singer Award". The list of winners is (arranged by surname): Cai Yashuang, Dong Lingjia, Gao Weijia, Liang Yuchen, Ruan Wang, Tongren, Tongwei, Tongxin, Wang Wen, Xiong Wei, Yan Jieya, Ye Ruxin, Yu Yanmei, Zhang Yujia, Zhao Yi, Zheng Manji. Among them, four contestants, Cai Yashuang, Gao Weijia, Yan Jieya, and Zhao Yi, will represent their region in the national finals in order to select contestants who will represent the United States in Beijing to participate in the "Water Cube Cup" Overseas Youth Chinese Song Competition. Some of the young people participating in this competition are from four Chinese schools in the state: Tucson Chinese School, Tucson Mandarin Chinese School, Modern Chinese School, and Hope Chinese School; there are also other young people in the state. Since New Mexico does not have a competition area, the contestants from this state are also included in this competition area. The contestants are Chinese teenagers from the United States, various provinces and cities in China, the United Kingdom, Saudi Arabia and other places, including Manchu, Han and Hui, ranging in age from 14 to 26 years old. The content of the songs performed by the contestants in this competition area is healthy and fresh, with a wide range of songs, including old songs familiar to parents and the latest songs spread on the Internet. The contestants showed an active participation mentality and youthful spirit in the application process and singing, and also showed a certain level of singing ability and quality. The organizing committee looks forward to the contestants in this competition area winning the national finals, and also looks forward to more opportunities for young people to participate in Chinese cultural activities in the future. The chief referee of this division, Mr. Zheng Xiaozhong, a doctor of music, presided over the scoring event. The referees from four Chinese schools, Mr. Li Guohua, Ms. Wang Nan, Ms. Chen Yi, and Ms. Wang Guixian, the two co-chairmen of the organizing committee of this division, Zhu Yan, Lei Hong, and organizing committee members Xie Ming and Shuai Zhiruo all attended the scoring event. Photo: The judges were in the meeting.

cd77b35957f799e1f9c2b3fff09ad1bcc4cace6a.sourceText: 美国经济数据“重头戏”——服务业创下近两年最快增速 在强劲订单需求的推动下，美国服务型企业2月份取得2015年10月份以来最快增速，表明美国经济中占比最大的这个部分势头良好。 总部位于亚利桑那州坦佩的供应管理学会(ISM)周五发布的数据显示，2月份非制造业指数从1月份的56.5升至57.6。该指数涵盖美国经济近90%的部分；数据高于50则代表增长。接受彭博调查的经济学家预期中值为维持在1月份的水平。 报告显示，企业活动指标创2005年以来次高水平；订单增速加快。再加上之前发布的ISM制造业指数创2014年8月以来最快增速，ISM的指标显示美国经济各行各业普遍乐观。 与此同时，美联储官员们最近也屡屡表态，称经济表现支持货币政策收紧。美联储下次政策会议将在3月14-15日召开，可能会决定加息。 接受彭博调查的经济学家对ISM非制造业指数的预期区间从54.5到59。 企业活动指标从60.3升至63.6，是2005年8月以来次高水平。 新订单指标从58.6升至61.2，是2015年8月以来最高。
cd77b35957f799e1f9c2b3fff09ad1bcc4cace6a.translatedText: The "highlight" of U.S. economic data - the service industry recorded the fastest growth rate in the past two years Driven by strong order demand, U.S. service companies achieved the fastest growth since October 2015 in February, indicating that the largest part of the U.S. economy is gaining momentum. Data released on Friday by the Tempe, Arizona-based Institute for Supply Management (ISM) showed that its non-manufacturing index rose to 57.6 in February from 56.5 in January. The index covers nearly 90% of the U.S. economy; a number above 50 indicates growth. The median forecast among economists surveyed by Bloomberg was for the economy to remain at January levels. The report shows that business activity indicators hit the second highest level since 2005; order growth accelerated. Coupled with the previously released ISM manufacturing index hitting the fastest growth rate since August 2014, ISM's indicators show that all walks of life in the U.S. economy are generally optimistic. At the same time, Federal Reserve officials have repeatedly stated recently that economic performance supports the tightening of monetary policy. The Federal Reserve's next policy meeting will be held on March 14-15 and may decide to raise interest rates. Economists surveyed by Bloomberg had expected the ISM non-manufacturing index to range from 54.5 to 59. The business activity indicator rose to 63.6 from 60.3, the second highest level since August 2005. The new orders indicator rose to 61.2 from 58.6, the highest level since August 2015.
