1f85a670ef826404e503e8462e7b73b8599e2946.sourceText: 特朗普提””梦想法案””换反””链式移…
1f85a670ef826404e503e8462e7b73b8599e2946.translatedText: Trump proposed the "Dream Act", "replacement" and "chain migration"...

9fb64e1c28261a8a825eb98da6bd8d640818ea1f.sourceText: 特朗普今年的移民政策备受挑战。（图片来源：美联社）
9fb64e1c28261a8a825eb98da6bd8d640818ea1f.translatedText: Trump's immigration policy this year has been challenged. (Photo source: Associated Press)

87bf1c91d14989a65fa91806f0b9d9938dbbb3d3.sourceText: 【侨报综合讯】特朗普总统九月初废除了奥巴马时期的DACA项目，当时他给出了半年缓冲期，并要求国会利用这个”机会”，作出关于DACA替代方案的最终决定。几个月来，民主党方面一直在预算、税改等议题的谈判中向共和党施压，希望通过DACA永久合法方案而未能成功。
87bf1c91d14989a65fa91806f0b9d9938dbbb3d3.translatedText: [Qiaobao Comprehensive News] President Trump repealed the Obama-era DACA program in early September. At that time, he gave a six-month buffer period and asked Congress to use this "opportunity" to make a final decision on the DACA replacement program. For several months, the Democratic Party has been putting pressure on the Republican Party in negotiations on budget, tax reform and other issues, hoping to pass a permanent legal DACA program but has failed.

76258c2e1954f5f2020a1dbad7e51ca5631cb615.sourceText: 据报道，特朗普周五发推特重申他要求的反链式移民和建设边境墙的立场。他说，如果民主党方面达不到他的要求，就别达成保留推迟递解儿童时期来美移民项目（DACA）的协议，他不会批准梦想法案（DreamAct）。国会民主党人则说，特朗普让我们在选举年不断争论这个问题。但我们不能因为他制造虚假的紧迫性及废除DACA的做法来创造一个全新移民制度。
76258c2e1954f5f2020a1dbad7e51ca5631cb615.translatedText: According to reports, Trump took to Twitter on Friday to reiterate his stance on calling for anti-chain immigration and the construction of a border wall. He said that if the Democratic Party fails to meet his demands, there will be no agreement to retain the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) program, and he will not approve the Dream Act (Dream Act). Congressional Democrats say Trump keeps us debating the issue in an election year. But we cannot create a new immigration system because of his false urgency and repeal of DACA.

1f6e103879b118c6895e507d10308ee691f43ef7.sourceText: 特朗普：先修边境墙再讨论梦想生
1f6e103879b118c6895e507d10308ee691f43ef7.translatedText: Trump: Build the border wall first and then discuss Dreamers

58418bd1478a9adcf296b3968b076c1201300d88.sourceText: 据侨报记者徐一凡报道，12月29日，总统特朗普发表推特称，民主党方面已经知道，在美国南部边境”建墙”、结束链式移民等不合理移民方式之前，不可能有新的童年入境暂缓递解项目（DACA）。
58418bd1478a9adcf296b3968b076c1201300d88.translatedText: According to Qiaobao reporter Xu Yifan, on December 29, President Trump tweeted that the Democratic Party already knows that there will be no new Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) program before "building a wall" on the southern border of the United States and ending unreasonable immigration methods such as chain migration.

fddb4b94d496b1bedfd0b7eeac053e763ca06530.sourceText: 特朗普以此向民主党发出清晰声音：不可能毫无条件地恢复或者建立新的、民主党一直在为之努力的DACA。
fddb4b94d496b1bedfd0b7eeac053e763ca06530.translatedText: Trump used this to send a clear message to the Democratic Party: It is impossible to restore or establish a new DACA without conditions, which the Democratic Party has been working hard for.

3808a37282da15bbf504ce145294628e2a997050.sourceText: 还在佛罗里达海湖庄园（Mar-a-lago）度假的特朗普在启程前往高尔夫俱乐部之前发布了这条推特。他说，民主党方面已经被知会、而且完全理解，如果不在南部边境建那座亟需的墙，并且结束可怕的链式移民以及荒谬的抽签移民系统，就不会有DACA。”我们必须以一切代价保卫我们的国家！”
3808a37282da15bbf504ce145294628e2a997050.translatedText: Trump, who was still on vacation at Mar-a-lago in Florida, posted this tweet before setting off for a golf club. He said Democrats have been informed and fully understand that without building the much-needed wall on the southern border and ending the horrific chain migration and absurd lottery immigration system, there will be no DACA. "We must defend our country at all costs!"

d2812b9e93b12a23181de83f5cded154176fa291.sourceText: 本月早些时候纽约发生未遂的恐怖袭击时，特朗普就表示，嫌犯正式通过”亲属链式移民”进入美国的，这威胁着美国的国家安全。由此，他在声明中强调国会必须终止”链式移民”，并采取其他加强边境和国内安全的措施。再早些时候，10月31日纽约发生的卡车冲撞恐怖袭击中，嫌犯是通过被称为”绿卡乐透”的多元化抽签移民系统进入美国的，当时特朗普也表示要停止乐透移民，要为”基于特长”的移民系统而奋斗。
d2812b9e93b12a23181de83f5cded154176fa291.translatedText: When an attempted terrorist attack occurred in New York earlier this month, Trump stated that the suspect had officially entered the United States through "relative chain migration," which threatened the national security of the United States. As a result, he emphasized in his statement that Congress must end "chain migration" and take other measures to strengthen border and domestic security. Earlier, in the truck-ramming terrorist attack in New York on October 31, the suspect entered the United States through the diversified lottery immigration system known as the "Green Card Lottery." At that time, Trump also stated that he would stop lottery immigration and fight for a "merit-based" immigration system.

d0d2ab31b5283c1abeff231cbf1b62cd59a7d65d.sourceText: 移民改革或将是明年重点立法项目
d0d2ab31b5283c1abeff231cbf1b62cd59a7d65d.translatedText: Immigration reform may be a key legislative project next year

ba476328528933433281acdf3056c82584611f37.sourceText: 据侨报记者徐一凡报道，所谓”基于特长”的移民系统，目前最为成型的计划就是国会共和党参议员汤姆卡顿（TomCotton）和大卫.佩杜（David Perdue）联名提出的《改革美国移民强化就业法案》（”RAISE”），主要内容有取消多元化抽签绿卡项目、减少亲属移民，以绿卡申请者技能为基础”打分”等内容。但自从今年8月初特朗普对该法案表示支持以后，因为白宫和国会都忙于医保、税改等议题，这方面一直没有推进。如今税改通过、奥巴马医保实质上被废除，移民改革很可能是2018年特朗普的重点立法项目。
ba476328528933433281acdf3056c82584611f37.translatedText: According to Qiaobao reporter Xu Yifan, the so-called "specialty-based" immigration system is currently the most well-formed plan of Republican Senators Tom Cotton and David Perdue. Perdue, the "Reforming American Immigration and Strengthening Employment Act" ("RAISE") mainly includes canceling the diversity lottery green card program, reducing family-based immigration, and "scoring" green card applicants based on their skills. However, since Trump expressed support for the bill in early August this year, there has been no progress in this regard because the White House and Congress are busy with issues such as health insurance and tax reform. Now that tax reform has been passed and Obamacare has been essentially repealed, immigration reform is likely to be Trump's key legislative project in 2018.

5e8c8bc5e982d9e7f78db181568d2d3783b23fe4.sourceText: 而且，特朗普在今年9月废除了奥巴马签署的DACA项目；当时他给出了半年的缓冲期，并要求国会利用好这个”机会窗口”，作出关于DACA替代方案的最终决定。几个月来，民主党方面一直在预算、税改等议题的谈判中向共和党施压，希望通过DACA永久合法的方案，但一直没能成功。国会亚太裔党团举行并参加过多次新闻发布会、静坐等抗议活动，华裔众议员赵美心还因此被捕过一小时。此外，不止一位共和党议员也表达过对DACA的同情之心。
5e8c8bc5e982d9e7f78db181568d2d3783b23fe4.translatedText: Moreover, Trump abolished the DACA program signed by Obama in September this year; at that time, he gave a half-year buffer period and asked Congress to take advantage of this "window of opportunity" to make a final decision on the DACA replacement program. For several months, the Democratic Party has been putting pressure on the Republicans in negotiations on budget, tax reform and other issues, hoping to pass a permanent and legal DACA program, but has been unable to succeed. The Congressional Asian Pacific American Caucus held and participated in many press conferences, sit-ins and other protests. Chinese-American Representative Zhao Meixin was arrested for an hour. In addition, more than one Republican congressman has expressed sympathy for DACA.

fa38d153b24b8354a91ca12845ae971b0183b818.sourceText: 如今，80万受益于该项目的”梦想者”还在等待国会裁决。特朗普今天亮出条件，要求民主党同意建墙、废除链式移民和绿卡乐透等才能恢复或更新DACA；料想来年围绕这些议题白宫与国会之间、两党之间将有废除DACA的”缓冲期”将在2018年3月5日结束。
fa38d153b24b8354a91ca12845ae971b0183b818.translatedText: Today, 800,000 "Dreamers" who benefited from the program are still waiting for Congress to decide. Trump set out conditions today, requiring the Democratic Party to agree to build a wall, abolish chain immigration and the green card lottery before restoring or renewing DACA. It is expected that there will be a "buffer period" between the White House and Congress and between the two parties on these issues in the coming year to abolish DACA, which will end on March 5, 2018.

29fda71d47e7b97de35695443e81dedaf7ac8b61.sourceText: 移民与海关执法局在亚州的凤凰城抓捕非法移民。（图片来源：美联社）
29fda71d47e7b97de35695443e81dedaf7ac8b61.translatedText: Immigration and Customs Enforcement arrests illegal immigrants in Phoenix, Asia. (Photo source: Associated Press)

8ca1ba148f9ab82bb1a7032809799e7c5e06fe68.sourceText: 特朗普正向世界慢慢关上移民大门
8ca1ba148f9ab82bb1a7032809799e7c5e06fe68.translatedText: >Trump is slowly closing the door on immigration to the world

01b8044071f9efd2d9cae9a4e341718df8e9af7c.sourceText: 研究世界移民问题和美国移民政策的独立智库国移民政策研究所（Migration Policy Institute）最新发布了一份2017年移民十大议题，”特朗普政府采取措施收紧合法移民”排在首位。
01b8044071f9efd2d9cae9a4e341718df8e9af7c.translatedText: The Migration Policy Institute, an independent think tank that studies world immigration issues and U.S. immigration policy, recently released a list of the top ten immigration issues in 2017. "The Trump administration's measures to tighten legal immigration" ranked first.

38e7bad9f0edd0d7f385b95d87a687a263c543bb.sourceText: 自今年1月20日就任总统以来，特朗普雷厉风行推行了一系列新政策，其中以移民政策改革、单一针对穆斯林的旅游禁令以及针对拉丁裔移民的边境执法等最为强硬，遭到的对抗也最激烈。
38e7bad9f0edd0d7f385b95d87a687a263c543bb.translatedText: Since taking office as president on January 20 this year, Trump has vigorously and resolutely implemented a series of new policies. Among them, immigration policy reform, a travel ban targeting Muslims only, and border enforcement targeting Latino immigrants are the toughest, and they have encountered the most fierce confrontation.

8037e2baa54d63f4cdb76482fbbda190222db202.sourceText: 尽管如此，特朗普推行移民政策和加强边境执法依然态度强硬，继稍做让步推出修改版移民禁令后，又列出一系列立法优先事项，包括美墨边界筑墙、加强执法遣返非法移民、停止向庇护城市发放联邦援助、建立新绿卡发放制度、限制向美国公民和永久居民的配偶和未成年子女发放绿卡、建立积分制移民制度、废除童年入境暂缓遣返计划（DACA）等。
8037e2baa54d63f4cdb76482fbbda190222db202.translatedText: Despite this, Trump still has a tough stance on pursuing immigration policies and strengthening border enforcement. After making slight concessions and launching a revised immigration ban, he also listed a series of legislative priorities, including building a wall on the US-Mexico border, strengthening law enforcement and deporting illegal immigrants, stopping federal aid to sanctuary cities, establishing a new green card issuance system, restricting the issuance of green cards to spouses and minor children of U.S. citizens and permanent residents, establishing a points-based immigration system, and abolishing the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) program.

f6001e69ac31d6d49b3791ae34721a04630714bf.sourceText: 政治素人特朗普入主白宫后的移民新政，虽然遭到全美范围内大规模反对，但也得到那些对过去八年民主党执政积怨已久的选民亲睐和力挺。舆论分析普遍认为，特朗普强硬态度是在兑现他竞选时许下的诺言，这也从另一个层面反映了美国社会在重大议题上越来越严重的分化。
f6001e69ac31d6d49b3791ae34721a04630714bf.translatedText: After Trump, a political novice, entered the White House, his new immigration policy met with massive opposition across the United States, but it also gained favor and support from voters who had long been resentful of the Democratic Party’s rule over the past eight years. Public opinion analysis generally believes that Trump's tough attitude is to fulfill the promises he made during the campaign, which also reflects the increasingly serious divisions in American society on major issues from another level.

7e04538a692f230843111716e11331c39bdf8c88.sourceText: 美国是一个移民国家，特朗普针对移民的这些举措直接影响到千万个家庭。美国移民政策研究所年底发布的一份移民研究报告称，特朗普政府正向世界某些地区慢慢关上移民大门。
7e04538a692f230843111716e11331c39bdf8c88.translatedText: The United States is a country of immigrants, and Trump’s measures against immigrants directly affect tens of millions of families. An immigration research report released by the U.S. Migration Policy Institute at the end of the year stated that the Trump administration is slowly closing the door to immigration in some parts of the world.

463b151bf5c02839b3fe73c3140a71cf6c2095df.sourceText: 特朗普政府近一年对新移民政策付出了巨大努力，空前积极地推动相关议程的实行，但法院、国会、地方政府在相当程度上不予配合，导致这些议程被延缓或搁置，因而并没有出现特朗普期待的重大变化。
463b151bf5c02839b3fe73c3140a71cf6c2095df.translatedText: The Trump administration has made great efforts to implement the new immigration policy in the past year and has been unprecedentedly active in promoting the implementation of relevant agendas. However, the courts, Congress, and local governments have not cooperated to a considerable extent, resulting in the delay or shelving of these agendas. Therefore, there have been no major changes that Trump expected.

6bf9d269ec166c2f60a7899eeca2e5cf8782519e.sourceText: 这一年移民新政的坎坷之路，使得去年大选时已经严重撕裂的美国社会雪上加霜。移民新政的坎坷，除去民主、共和两大阵营政治缠斗的因素外，最核心的还是触及了美国传统价值观，事实上，在即将过去的这一年，白种人和有色人种、精英阶层和中下阶层、媒体和政府的对立情绪继续加深。
6bf9d269ec166c2f60a7899eeca2e5cf8782519e.translatedText: The bumpy road of the new immigration policy this year has made the American society that was already severely torn during last year's election even worse. The ups and downs of the New Immigration Deal, apart from the factors of political struggle between the Democratic and Republican camps, most importantly touch on traditional American values. In fact, in the past year, the antagonism between white people and people of color, the elite and the lower-middle class, the media and the government has continued to deepen.

e30144e9372fd98634e260c99f7057f2425f3d4b.sourceText: 加州议会参议员Kevin de Leon本月20日在洛杉矶为支持梦想法案而发声。（图片来源：美联社）
e30144e9372fd98634e260c99f7057f2425f3d4b.translatedText: California Assembly Senator Kevin de Leon spoke out in support of the DREAM Act in Los Angeles on the 20th of this month. (Photo source: Associated Press)

3568047b2268422d5d0468b3ef46898e97feea1a.sourceText: 2017年多国移民政策收紧 背后原因令人深思
3568047b2268422d5d0468b3ef46898e97feea1a.translatedText: Many countries tightened their immigration policies in 2017. The reasons behind them are thought-provoking

d07239284caa5e5c2e99c20c1b03d0d8f9f33098.sourceText: 回望2017年，各国选情变化或经济低迷之下，政府往往总拿移民政策开刀。如今，限制性的移民项目逐渐成为新的规范，一个极为复杂的政治移民格局，正悄无声息的到来。各国移民政策不断收缩，到底背后有何原因？
d07239284caa5e5c2e99c20c1b03d0d8f9f33098.translatedText: Looking back at 2017, when the electoral situation in various countries changed or the economy was in a downturn, governments often resorted to immigration policies. Nowadays, restrictive immigration projects have gradually become the new norm, and an extremely complex political immigration pattern is arriving quietly. What are the reasons behind the continuous contraction of immigration policies in various countries?

ca83883ddda6c656e7af5630cfc69334b99ea2a9.sourceText: 首先，是悄然滋生的就业保护主义，在金融危机的阴影笼罩下，随着就业机会总量减少，移民国家”慷慨”发放绿卡的时代已宣告结束，他们以”训练本土人才”取代对海外劳工的依赖，降低移民人口水平。
ca83883ddda6c656e7af5630cfc69334b99ea2a9.translatedText: First, there is the quietly growing employment protectionism. Under the shadow of the financial crisis, as the total number of job opportunities decreases, the era of "generous" green cards issued by immigration countries has come to an end. They have replaced their reliance on overseas workers with "training local talents" and reduced the level of immigrant populations.

cf2df032dc7b61a4dfe1dbea25a53c617d5c86ee.sourceText: 在美国，特朗普上任后，进一步改革移民政策，除了在投资移民政策上进行调整外，H1-B签证改革将在提倡”留住最聪明、最优秀的人才”的基础上，优先为美国本土居民提供工作机会，包括取消H-4工作许可；甚至曾下达”买美国货，雇美国人”的行政命令，指导签证项目，”保护美国劳工的利”。因”学历超过职位所需”等原因，导致美国H-1B签证被拒，大批优秀人才无奈被迫失去了留美机会。
cf2df032dc7b61a4dfe1dbea25a53c617d5c86ee.translatedText: In the United States, after Trump took office, he further reformed the immigration policy. In addition to adjusting the investment immigration policy, the H1-B visa reform will give priority to providing job opportunities to American residents on the basis of advocating "retaining the brightest and best talents." This includes canceling the H-4 work permit; he even issued an executive order of "Buy American, Hire American" to guide the visa project and "protect the interests of American workers." Due to reasons such as "the academic qualifications exceed the requirements of the position", the U.S. H-1B visa was rejected, and a large number of outstanding talents were forced to lose the opportunity to study in the United States.

19eb8611ba155351e33d61df46c18ad1a8a8c8ee.sourceText: 在澳大利亚，总理特恩布尔表示，政府今后的就业政策将优先考虑澳大利亚人。有人提议，为防止人才被”浪费”，应减少接收移民，甚至，一些雇主把”缺乏澳大利亚经验”作为拒绝雇佣移民的理由。
19eb8611ba155351e33d61df46c18ad1a8a8c8ee.translatedText: In Australia, Prime Minister Turnbull said that the government's future employment policy will prioritize Australians. Some people have proposed that in order to prevent talents from being "wasted", the number of immigrants should be reduced. Some employers even use "lack of Australian experience" as a reason for refusing to hire immigrants.

32d9dd837c2fb08a1b596fda7c392464d13aeac3.sourceText: 在英国，政府将员工薪酬标准和移民技能费提高，让那些想聘请海外雇员的企业成本不断加大，这也意味着，他们将会把注意力放在本土寻觅对口的技术人才上。
32d9dd837c2fb08a1b596fda7c392464d13aeac3.translatedText: In the UK, the government has increased employee salary standards and immigration skills fees, which has increased costs for companies that want to hire overseas employees. This also means that they will focus on finding matching technical talents locally.

964facc7ca9baa8f6df5cdad477f97da80c109b9.sourceText: 其次，是近年来西方国家对全球化否定思潮的兴起。多国收紧移民政策，也是在全球化过程中进行的贸易保护。在全球化经济发展过程中，产业结构比较失衡开始显露出反全球化的倾向，他们必须通过提高申请标准来限制移民，从而对本国境内的产业进行保护。
964facc7ca9baa8f6df5cdad477f97da80c109b9.translatedText: Secondly, in recent years, there has been a rise in Western countries’ denial of globalization. The tightening of immigration policies by many countries is also a form of trade protection in the process of globalization. In the process of globalized economic development, the relatively unbalanced industrial structure has begun to show anti-globalization tendencies. They must restrict immigration by raising application standards to protect industries within their own countries.

c544b48562d7aad4c36990daf84379656b5becec.sourceText: 最后是在全球此起彼伏的恐怖袭击，迫使各国宁愿关上门自保，也不愿意广纳移民人口。最近几个月袭击纽约的两名恐怖分子，都是通过”失灵的”移民系统进入美国。特朗普表示，最糟糕的国家的最糟糕的公民通过签证抽签进入了美国，多样化签证为恐怖分子进入美国提供了渠道。
c544b48562d7aad4c36990daf84379656b5becec.translatedText: Finally, the recurring terrorist attacks around the world have forced countries to close their doors to protect themselves rather than accept immigrants. Two terrorists who attacked New York in recent months entered the United States through a "broken" immigration system. Trump said the worst citizens of the worst countries entered the United States through the visa lottery and that diversity visas provided a channel for terrorists to enter the United States.

7fd442433a3c4aaef982e93d88aca0e8051f3580.sourceText: 美国移民法变更的十分频繁以及不可预见，使美国移民政策也愈发变得含糊不清，对于华人而言，留美之路会更加难上加难。
7fd442433a3c4aaef982e93d88aca0e8051f3580.translatedText: The frequent and unforeseen changes in U.S. immigration laws have made U.S. immigration policies increasingly ambiguous. For Chinese, it will be even more difficult to stay in the United States.

8db8f8f1e2e08a4112629f1d8572c76d2f70c067.sourceText: 特朗普2018年或将做的5件与移民有关的事
8db8f8f1e2e08a4112629f1d8572c76d2f70c067.translatedText: > 5 things Trump may do related to immigration in 2018

80846dd3218dffa8798f603b3b5213cb7526b2de.sourceText: 特朗普第一年在移民政策上的作为与前任总统大不相同。
80846dd3218dffa8798f603b3b5213cb7526b2de.translatedText: > Trump’s immigration policy in the first year was very different from that of the previous president.

e39371071d55eb7aded6adee20be5f33bd259ae3.sourceText: 在执政第一年，特朗普打击非法移民，对合法移民也进行了诸多限制。
e39371071d55eb7aded6adee20be5f33bd259ae3.translatedText: In the first year of his administration, Trump cracked down on illegal immigration and also imposed many restrictions on legal immigration.

269e7fb3f85c913cab693ea1d2ca4fc38f62f859.sourceText: ICE大量逮捕非法移民，跨越边境的非法移民数量也降低。而在2018年，特朗普可能将做这五件与移民有关的事情。
269e7fb3f85c913cab693ea1d2ca4fc38f62f859.translatedText: ICE arrested a large number of illegal immigrants, and the number of illegal immigrants crossing the border also decreased. In 2018, Trump may do these five things related to immigration.

2b0953a9769d486d1729bd0b68ec3552abefb83c.translatedText: Report: Cochise County Sheriff dies in drunk driving crash An autopsy report released on Monday showed that Cochise County Sheriff Larry Devar, who died in a car accident on September 18, was caused by drunk driving...

fc9590a81529bf8db77aba6fdd7a6855299c39fb.sourceText: 报告：科奇斯郡警长醉驾撞车身亡 周一出炉的验尸报告显示，9月18日车祸身亡的科奇斯郡警长拉里德瓦是因醉驾驾驶导致意外发生。 报告指出，德瓦作为驾车人，当天和家庭成员一起野营狩猎时，在威廉姆斯附近沿砂石路行走，翻车身亡。他当时的车速是每小时62英里，行走在没有车速限制的道路。验尸报告还显示，德瓦出事时没有扣安全带。当局指出，出事车辆装有啤酒和白酒。 报告最重要一点，是指出德瓦的身体酒精含有量为0.29，超过本州法律规定的三倍。
fc9590a81529bf8db77aba6fdd7a6855299c39fb.translatedText: Report: Cochise County Sheriff dies in drunk driving crash An autopsy report released on Monday showed that Cochise County Sheriff Larry Devar, who died in a car accident on September 18, was driving under the influence and caused the accident. The report stated that Deva, as a motorist, was walking along a gravel road near Williams when he was camping and hunting with family members that day when his car overturned and died. He was driving 62 miles per hour on a road with no speed limit. The autopsy report also showed that Deva was not wearing a seat belt at the time of the accident. Authorities pointed out that the vehicle involved in the accident contained beer and liquor. The most important point of the report is that Deva's body alcohol content was 0.29, more than three times the state's legal limit.

dedde93749c7af9cb0a287275b9f399f16172f4e.sourceText: 国庆长假广州百货营收下降 旅游业赚了 （时报驻广州记者杨绮薇报道）中秋、国庆的8天长假已经结束，外出旅游、探亲的市民汹涌回潮，车流浩浩荡荡。由于今年中秋国庆期间高速公路免费，刺激了广州人出游，导致广州城里部分百货商场营收下降。但旅游业却赚了近80亿，同比增长13.07%。 据有广州市假日办统计，今年双节期间，广州百货业营业收入基本保持平稳，部分有跌幅，12家主要零售企业黄金周吸金9.12亿元，同比下降8.86%。但由于今年施行高速路免费政策，吸引了大量自驾游客来穗，广州市旅游局抽样调查结果显示，有13.43%的游客是自驾车前来广州旅游。根据测算，整个黄金周期间广州市接待自驾游游客达159.28万人次，比去年国庆黄金周多出34万人次。 长假期间的消费呈现U形走势，不少市民中秋留城，购买力强劲，让各大商家赚了个双节开门红。但假期中段，是市民出游的高峰，本地居民购买力减弱，而城外的游客群刚需消费明显，撑起了珠三角零售业消费的半边天，成为百货商场里的客流主力。10月6-7日，出城大军开始回流，再度大幅拉动黄金周末期的消费。 节日期间，广州周边市县的市民络绎不绝地开车或乘坐地铁进入广州城逛街购物，再次掀起售业消费的高潮。从位于天河商圈的友谊正佳店外停放的车牌来看，外地来的宾客占了六成以上，其中佛山、南海、顺德等地的客人占了大半，成为双节期间售业消费的主力军。 据广州市旅游局介绍，广州33个主要旅游景区（商业步行街除外），长假期间接待436.37万人次，同比增长35.11%，营业收入1.63亿元，同比增长20.77%，其中门票收入1.33亿元，同比增长16.61%.其中，长隆旅游度假区、陈家祠、广州动物园增幅显著。 抽样调查还显示，国庆黄金周期间来穗旅游以国内客为主；在国内客中，有64.84%是广东省内游客。外省游客中，前五位来自湖南、江西、湖北、广西、四川。广州市统计局黄金周零售餐饮业定点观测统计资料显示：15家餐饮企业（集团）累计实现营业收入1.25亿元，同比增长11.90%.其中三元麦当劳为餐饮企业实现营业额最高的企业，增幅较大的企业有南海渔村、美心星巴克等。
dedde93749c7af9cb0a287275b9f399f16172f4e.translatedText: > During the National Day holiday, Guangzhou's department store revenue dropped, and the tourism industry made money (Reporting by Yang Qiwei, Times reporter in Guangzhou) The eight-day Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day holidays have ended, and citizens traveling and visiting relatives have returned in large numbers, and the traffic flow has been huge. Since highways are free during the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day this year, Guangzhou people are encouraged to travel, resulting in a decline in the revenue of some department stores in Guangzhou city. However, the tourism industry earned nearly 8 billion, a year-on-year increase of 13.07%. According to statistics from the Guangzhou Municipal Holiday Office, during this year's Double Festival, the operating income of Guangzhou's department store industry remained basically stable, with some declines. 12 major retail companies attracted 912 million yuan during the Golden Week, a year-on-year decrease of 8.86%. However, due to the implementation of the toll-free expressway policy this year, a large number of self-driving tourists came to Guangzhou. The sample survey results of the Guangzhou Municipal Tourism Bureau showed that 13.43% of tourists came to Guangzhou by self-driving. According to estimates, Guangzhou received 1.5928 million self-driving tourists during the entire Golden Week, 340,000 more than last year’s National Day Golden Week. Consumption during the long holiday showed a U-shaped trend. Many citizens stayed in the city during the Mid-Autumn Festival and their purchasing power was strong, allowing major merchants to make a good start during the double festival. However, the middle of the holiday is the peak time for citizens to travel. The purchasing power of local residents weakens, while the tourists from outside the city have a clear need to spend, supporting half of the retail consumption in the Pearl River Delta and becoming the main passenger flow in department stores. From October 6th to 7th, the people leaving the city began to return, once again significantly boosting consumption during the golden weekend. During the festival, citizens from surrounding cities and counties around Guangzhou drove or took the subway into Guangzhou City for shopping, once again setting off a boom in retail consumption. Judging from the license plates parked outside the Youyi Zhengjia store in the Tianhe business district, guests from out of town accounted for more than 60%, of which the majority came from Foshan, Nanhai, Shunde and other places, becoming the main force in retail consumption during the Double Festival. According to the Guangzhou Municipal Tourism Bureau, Guangzhou's 33 major tourist attractions (excluding commercial pedestrian streets) received 4.3637 million visitors during the long holiday, a year-on-year increase of 35.11%. The operating income was 163 million yuan, a year-on-year increase of 20.77%, of which ticket revenue was 133 million yuan, a year-on-year increase of 16.61%. Among them, Chimelong Tourist Resort, Chen Clan Ancestral Hall, and Guangzhou Zoo experienced significant growth. The sample survey also showed that domestic tourists mainly came to Guangzhou during the National Day Golden Week; among domestic tourists, 64.84% were tourists from Guangdong Province. Among tourists from other provinces, the top five are from Hunan, Jiangxi, Hubei, Guangxi and Sichuan. The fixed-point observation statistics of the retail catering industry during the Golden Week of the Guangzhou Bureau of Statistics show that 15 catering companies (groups) achieved a cumulative operating income of 125 million yuan, a year-on-year increase of 11.90%. Among them, Sanyuan McDonald's was the enterprise with the highest turnover among catering enterprises. Enterprises with larger increases include Nanhai Fishing Village, Maxim's Starbucks, etc.

31d6ff7fbe07117ae59d8fe48c0ed26bf13f1ad8.sourceText: 联邦重核州医疗补助计划 （亚省时报） 联邦政府重新审核为期五年的亚利桑那州医疗补助计划{ACCCH)新比例。 上周五，联邦政府官员表示重新审核后再授权削减成本方案，包括冻结新申请者和增加新的病人自付额。州政府提出一些改革，要么缩减补助受惠人数，要么由病人自付某些费用，如吸烟者年费为50美元。 目前，亚省预算要求州长的内阁减少州政府对医疗补助计划开支约500万美元，以帮助整个财政预算短缺的11亿美元。 州政府计划的一个主要部分是保存本年度的190亿预计为医院和其他医疗供应商的额外削减金额。联邦官员说，他们正考虑分开审核。
31d6ff7fbe07117ae59d8fe48c0ed26bf13f1ad8.translatedText: > The federal government re-evaluates the five-year Arizona Medicaid program {ACCCH) with new rates. On Friday, federal officials said they would re-authorize cost-cutting measures that include a freeze on new applicants and new patient copayments. The state government has proposed some reforms, either reducing the number of subsidy recipients or requiring patients to pay certain costs out of pocket, such as an annual fee of $50 for smokers. Currently, the Alberta budget requires the governor's cabinet to reduce state government spending on Medicaid by about $5 million to help with the overall budget shortfall of $1.1 billion. A major part of the state government's plan is to save $19 billion in additional cuts expected this year for hospitals and other medical providers. Federal officials said they are considering separate reviews.

42362aaf413443d442baca144be760fcfd2e1478.sourceText: 潘啸皋：太仓漆画，江南奇葩 太仓漆画，江南奇葩 潘啸皋 一个金风送爽、丹桂飘香的下午。我拨通了画家张志强的电话：”张大师，您是斐声中外的漆画大师，这里有着许多仰慕您的读者，我想写一篇采访您的扎记。”我开门见山地提出了要求。”没问题！来就可以。”张画家的话如同他作品的风格棗简洁、明快。约定了时间我就直奔张志强创办的太仓通古公司漆画展馆的工作室而去。 画家的工作室座落在江苏太仓的一幢典雅的”枕河人家”内。面积并不大，室内摆设丰富而不凌乱，墙壁上悬挂着许多历年来完成的作品，画架及书桌上堆放着一些正在创作的画稿，甚至连放废画稿的垃圾篓也堆得满满的，可见画家孜孜不倦与精益求精的作风。 漫步在张志强创办的太仓通古公司漆画展馆里，一幅幅独具匠心江南创意漆画呈现在眼前，仿佛走进了千年时光的隧道。摆在记者眼前的是一幅叫《通古》的漆画作品（获”上海世博会中国美术作品展”最高奖）。漫天飞舞的大雪飘落在古朴的石桥中、飘落在枕河人家的青瓦上、飘落在桥下的小河里。与一般的画不同，画中小桥、流水、人家等等的纹理和轮廓很有质感，层次分明，境界深远。用手轻轻抚摸，可以感觉到画板十分光滑，石桥和青瓦，甚至每一片雪花处却有凹凸感，有些地方似乎因重复上色而被叠高，而这些细腻部分竟是由数不清的白色小碎片镶嵌而成。看到记者一脸迷惑，张大师笑着说：”不说你肯定猜不到，让我告诉你吧，这些白色小碎片是碎蛋壳！” 记者一看，果真如是，只是谁也想不到，这碎成龟裂状的蛋壳竟然能”入画”，还占据了画面的主要部分。仅此《通古》一幅，画家就先用油漆画好底图，然后将数十万粒蛋壳碎片，一点一点黏糊在底版上，再经过复杂的后道工序打磨抛光，花费三个多月的时间方始完成，可见每一幅作品创作的艰辛。记者随后又看了几幅其它的漆画作品，发现所有作品画面都很有质感，而且在每一幅作品上都能找到蛋壳。远看，画中物，无论是人物、器皿、动物还是房屋立体感甚强，仿佛伸手就能摸到实物，可谓画技高超；可近看，这又不像一幅画，倒像是一件用颜料和蛋壳等制成的工艺品。 张志强出生文化世家、自幼酷爱绘画，从小浸润在江南水乡的气息里，对江南水乡文化情有独钟。经多年潜心学习、研究、揉合西方文化元素于一体创立自己的风格。他的作品熔古今中外技法于一炉，显示了极高的艺术技巧和广搏的艺术修养。是古为今用、洋为中用的典范。他擅长素描、中国画。又把西方艺术手法融入到中国画中，创造了新颖而独特的风格。尤其他的漆画则渗入了中国画的笔墨韵味。他的创作题材广泛，山水、花鸟、走兽、人物、历史、神话，无不落笔有神，栩栩如生。那些具有历史沧桑感与江南古韵的砖石片瓦，都激发着画家的创作灵感，很自然地将其融入画面。20余年来，张志强植根江南水乡，用古老的漆画元素，传递浓郁的东方神韵。他创作并获奖的《岁月交响曲》、《水巷深深》等作品，绝大多数是以水乡古镇为背景，选取古桥、老街、水岸、人物等为元素，生动再现江南文化的古朴、凝重和深邃。我国的漆文化历史悠久,丰厚辉煌.在几千年的漫漫岁月中,不断发展和更新。现代漆画正是在这中华优秀传统探漆工艺技术的基础上滋生和绽放出来的一朵奇葩。漆画不仅因七千年的漆艺史而自信，更重要的是它那深沉、含蓄的 绘画 效果。温润、静谧的风格十分符合中华民族的审美取向。作为中国美术家协会会员、中国民间文艺家协会会员、江苏省工艺美术名人、高级工艺美术师的张志强，数年如一日，潜心钻研漆画艺术，在传统漆画领域孜孜不倦，勇于探索和创新，并取得了卓越成就。近年来，画家张志强善于思考、勤于创作、佳作频出，其漆画作品《时光》入选第二届全国漆画作品展、《水巷深深》入选第十一届全国美术作品展览、《通古》入选上海世博会中国美术作品展览并荣获优秀奖、《血脉相连》入选?#22238;望中国棗纪念辛亥革命100周年综合美术作品展?#12290; 在采访结束时画家对我说：”漆路漫漫，漆画传统工艺蕴籍着中华民族深厚的文化底蕴，也是中华文明历史的见证。”见我认同了他的观点，又接着诉说着：”要将’太仓漆画’的文化薪火相传，还真任重而道远；除了具备扎实的绘画功底，在这快节奏的时代潮流里，还必须耐得住’慢工出细活’的寂寞，以及对这份事业的执着。”在与记者告辞时张志强意味深长地说道。
42362aaf413443d442baca144be760fcfd2e1478.translatedText: Pan Xiaogao: Taicang lacquer painting, a wonder of the south of the Yangtze River Taicang lacquer painting, a wonder of the south of the Yangtze River Pan Xiaogao An afternoon with refreshing golden breeze and fragrant osmanthus. I called the painter Zhang Zhiqiang: "Master Zhang, you are a famous master of lacquer painting at home and abroad. There are many readers here who admire you. I would like to write an interview with you." I made my request straight to the point. "No problem! Just come." Painter Zhang's words are as concise and bright as the style of his works. After agreeing on a time, I went straight to the studio of the Lacquer Painting Exhibition Hall of Taicang Tonggu Company founded by Zhang Zhiqiang. The painter's studio is located in an elegant "Zhenhe Family" in Taicang, Jiangsu Province. The area is not large, and the indoor furnishings are rich but not cluttered. Many works completed over the years are hung on the walls. There are some paintings in progress piled on the easel and desk. Even the trash cans for discarded paintings are full. This shows the artist's tireless and striving for excellence. Wandering in the lacquer painting exhibition hall of Taicang Tonggu Company founded by Zhang Zhiqiang, one after another of unique Jiangnan creative lacquer paintings is presented in front of you, as if you have walked into a tunnel of thousands of years. In front of the reporter's eyes is a lacquer painting called "Tonggu" (which won the highest award at the "Shanghai World Expo Chinese Art Exhibition"). The heavy snow flying all over the sky fell on the ancient stone bridge, on the green tiles of the houses in Zhenhe, and on the small river under the bridge. Different from ordinary paintings, the textures and outlines of small bridges, flowing water, houses, etc. in the paintings are very textured, distinct and profound. Touching it gently with your hand, you can feel that the painting board is very smooth, but the stone bridges, green tiles, and even each snowflake have a concave and convex feel. Some places seem to be stacked up due to repeated coloring, and these delicate parts are actually made of countless small white fragments. Seeing the confused look on the reporter's face, Master Zhang smiled and said, "You wouldn't guess it if I didn't tell you. Let me tell you, these small white fragments are broken eggshells!" The reporter took a look and found that it was indeed the case, but no one could have imagined that the cracked eggshells could actually "come into the painting" and occupy the main part of the picture. For this piece of "Tonggu" alone, the artist first drew the base map with paint, then glued hundreds of thousands of eggshell fragments on the base piece by piece, and then polished it through complicated subsequent processes. It took more than three months to complete, which shows the hardship of creating each work. The reporter then looked at several other lacquer paintings and found that all the paintings were very textured, and eggshells could be found on each one. From a distance, the objects in the painting, whether they are people, utensils, animals or houses, are very three-dimensional, as if you can reach out and touch the real objects, which is a superb painting skill; but when you look up close, it doesn't look like a painting, but rather like a handicraft made of paint and eggshells. Zhang Zhiqiang was born into a cultural family and has been fond of painting since he was a child. He has been immersed in the atmosphere of Jiangnan water towns since he was a child and has a special liking for the culture of Jiangnan water towns. After years of painstaking study, research, and integration of Western cultural elements, he created his own style. His works combine ancient and modern Chinese and foreign techniques, showing extremely high artistic skills and extensive artistic accomplishment. It is an example of how the past can be used for the present and foreign things can be used for China. He is good at sketching and Chinese painting. He also integrated Western artistic techniques into Chinese paintings to create a novel and unique style. In particular, his lacquer paintings are imbued with the charm of Chinese painting. His creations cover a wide range of subjects, including landscapes, flowers and birds, animals, characters, history, and mythology, all of which are vivid and lifelike in his writing. Those masonry and tiles with a sense of historical vicissitudes and Jiangnan ancient charm inspired the artist's creative inspiration, and they were naturally integrated into the painting. For more than 20 years, Zhang Zhiqiang has taken root in the water towns of the south of the Yangtze River and used ancient lacquer painting elements to convey a rich oriental charm. Most of his award-winning works such as "Symphony of Time" and "Deep Water Alley" are based on ancient water towns as backgrounds, using ancient bridges, old streets, waterfronts, characters, etc. as elements to vividly reproduce the simplicity, dignity and profundity of Jiangnan culture. my country's lacquer culture has a long, rich and glorious history. It has been continuously developed and updated over thousands of years. Modern lacquer painting is a wonderful flower that breeds and blooms on the basis of this excellent traditional Chinese lacquer painting technology. Lacquer painting is not only confident due to its seven thousand years of lacquer art history, but more importantly, its deep and implicit painting effect. The gentle and quiet style is in line with the aesthetic orientation of the Chinese nation. As a member of the Chinese Artists Association, a member of the Chinese Folk Literature and Artists Association, a celebrity in arts and crafts in Jiangsu Province, and a senior arts and crafts artist, Zhang Zhiqiang has devoted himself to the art of lacquer painting for several years. He has worked tirelessly in the field of traditional lacquer painting, has the courage to explore and innovate, and has made outstanding achievements. In recent years, painter Zhang Zhiqiang is good at thinking and diligent in creation, and has frequently produced excellent works. His lacquer painting "Time" was selected into the Second National Lacquer Painting Exhibition, "Water Alley Deep" was selected into the 11th National Art Exhibition, "Tonggu" was selected into the Shanghai World Expo Chinese Art Exhibition and won the Excellence Award, and "Bloodline" was selected into the comprehensive art exhibition commemorating the 100th anniversary of the 1911 Revolution?#12290; At the end of the interview, the painter said to me: "The road to lacquer painting is long. The traditional craftsmanship of lacquer painting contains the profound cultural heritage of the Chinese nation and is also a witness to the history of Chinese civilization." Seeing that I agreed with his point of view, he continued: "We must make the cultural value of 'Taicang Lacquer Painting' There is still a long way to go to pass the fire; in addition to having a solid foundation in painting, in this fast-paced era, you must also be able to endure the loneliness of "working slowly and carefully" and be persistent in this career," Zhang Zhiqiang said meaningfully when bidding farewell to reporters.

27a8538f9c15d1b7f892a790520e150ee80636ba.translatedText: Records of modern Chinese schools in Alberta participating in the "Overseas Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition"

d3bceab07d22c496ec39c2e4557bf471203cd944.sourceText: （朱岩报道） 由全美中文学校协会主办的”海外中华文化知识大赛”于今年十月二十七日再一次走进了亚省现代中文学校的教室。尽管校方接到大赛通知时已距考试日期不足三个月 ，且新规定只允许13岁以上学生报名， 但我校依然有六十多位学生实地参加了大赛。 对这个大赛， 我校给予了极大的重视， 校领导宋良武、 沈颢瑾、田韶微、 宋皎昱等为这次赛事做了大量的准备工作。 考试当天， 学校严格遵守主办方的考场要求，安排了三个大教室以保证学生有足够间距，六位校董亲自监考。但见考场中，有的学生淡定自若，沉着冷静地先 浏览着考题， 然后胸有成竹有条不紊地圈着答案；有的聚精会神，快速答题；有的眉头紧皱， 面带困惑；有的举棋不定; 有的又在冥思苦想。看学生们这些认真的表情就知道很多同学都是有备而来的。值得一提的是我校AP中文班和暨南7年级全班同学，在朱岩老师和邵英老师的要求和鼓励下，全部报名参加了比赛。大家都把这届大赛当成是扩宽视野，增加知识面，提高中文水平的学习机会。 很多老师还在课上为同学们引经据典，讲解复习题， 极大提高了同学们的学习热情和兴趣。
d3bceab07d22c496ec39c2e4557bf471203cd944.translatedText: (reported by Zhu Yan) The "Overseas Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition" sponsored by the National Association of Chinese Schools once again entered the classrooms of modern Chinese schools in Alberta. Although the school received the notice of the competition less than three months before the exam date, and the new regulations only allow students over 13 years old to register, our school still has more than 60 students participating in the competition. Our school attaches great importance to this competition. School leaders Song Liangwu, Shen Haojin, Tian Shaowei, Song Jiaoyu and others made a lot of preparations for this event. On the day of the examination, the school strictly complied with the organizer's examination room requirements and arranged three large classrooms to ensure sufficient distance between students. Six school directors personally invigilated the examination. However, in the examination room, some students were calm and composed, browsing the test questions calmly and then circling the answers in an orderly manner; some concentrated on answering the questions quickly; some frowned. Their faces were confused; some were hesitant; some were thinking hard. Looking at the serious expressions of the students, it was clear that many students were well prepared. It is worth mentioning that all the students in the AP Chinese class and Jinan Grade 7 class in our school signed up for the competition at the request and encouragement of Teacher Zhu Yan and Teacher Shao Ying. Everyone regarded this competition as an opportunity to broaden their horizons, increase their knowledge, and improve their Chinese proficiency. Many teachers also quoted scriptures and explained review questions for students in class, which greatly improved students' enthusiasm and interest in learning.

5c3e0e6b4dd028ff6563a482c54548a12a52bdac.sourceText: 性教育准则颁布建议适龄儿童了解“性倾向” （亚省时报） 一个卫生与教育组织联盟9日向各州和学区提出新的性教育准则，其中包括小学二年级结束时，学生应知道身体部位的正确名字；五年级结束时，学生应该知道性倾向是指对一个同性或异性者有浪漫的爱意。 这个没有约束力的准则旨在鼓励学校对性、霸凌(bullying)、健全的关系等议题进行适合学生年龄的讨论，并在二年级前就打好基础，各学校可根据此准则设计各年龄层的课程，长期下来可帮助青少年顺利成长为成年人。 参与制定此准则的「青年维护者」团体主席黛博拉‧豪瑟说，美国各学校对敏感议题的讨论非常不一致，例如有些学校即使知道霸凌存在，也不去解决它，更别提与性倾向和性认同有关的霸凌，而这是应该正面去解决的议题。 这个新准则包括，在二年级结束时，学生应该知道男女身体部位的解剖学上正确名词，并了解任何生物都会生殖，如果不愿意，每个人都有权不让别人碰触；小学低年级生也应能认同各种不同的家庭结构，和解释霸凌与嘲弄为何不对。 在五年级结束时，学生除了了解青春期的知识，也应明白性骚扰和性虐待的定义；初中毕业生应能分辨性别认同、性别表达和性倾向，应能解释为何强暴受害者没有错，应知道霸凌、约会暴力，和性病的迹象及影响；高中毕业生应评估禁欲、保险套和其他「安全性行为」的有效性，并知道紧急避孕的方法。 一些专家称赞此准则鼓励提早对学生进行性教育；也有专家表示，此准则应着重禁欲，正如过去数十年反吸烟运动的成功是因为大力鼓吹。 参与制定此准则的组织还有美国卫生教育协会、美国学校卫生协会、全国教育协会─卫生资讯网、州卫生与体育领袖协会，和未来性教育计画。
5c3e0e6b4dd028ff6563a482c54548a12a52bdac.translatedText: Sex education guidelines have been released to recommend that school-age children understand "sexual orientation" (Alberta Times) A coalition of health and education organizations proposed new sex education guidelines to states and school districts on the 9th, including that by the end of second grade, students should know the correct names of body parts; by the end of fifth grade, students should know that sexual orientation refers to romantic love for a person of the same or opposite sex. The non-binding guidelines aim to encourage schools to have age-appropriate discussions about sex, bullying, healthy relationships and other issues, and lay a solid foundation before second grade. Schools can design curricula for each age group based on the guidelines, which will help teenagers grow into adults smoothly in the long run. Deborah Houser, chairwoman of the Youth Defenders group who participated in the formulation of this code, said that discussions of sensitive issues in schools in the United States are very inconsistent. For example, even if some schools know that bullying exists, they do not address it, let alone bullying related to sexual orientation and sexual identity, which is an issue that should be addressed head-on. The new guidelines include that, by the end of second grade, students should know the anatomically correct names for male and female body parts, understand that all living things reproduce and that everyone has the right not to be touched by others if they don't want to, and that students in the lower grades should be able to identify with various family structures and explain why bullying and teasing is wrong. By the end of fifth grade, in addition to knowledge about puberty, students should also understand the definitions of sexual harassment and sexual abuse; middle school graduates should be able to identify gender identity, gender expression, and sexual orientation; should be able to explain why rape victims are not wrong; and should know the signs and effects of bullying, dating violence, and sexually transmitted diseases; high school graduates should evaluate the effectiveness of abstinence, condoms, and other "safer sex practices" and know methods of emergency contraception. Some experts praised the code for encouraging early sex education among students; others said the code should focus on abstinence, just as the success of anti-smoking campaigns in past decades was due to strong advocacy. Organizations involved in developing the guidelines include the American Health Education Association, the American School Health Association, the National Education Association-Health Information Network, the Association of State Health and Physical Education Leaders, and the Future of Sexuality Education Project.

bc8c976d2bb71e76c680aa544c6bea036116a041.sourceText: 第四届中美合作论坛“从全球化经济看中美合作” (ASU孔子学院供稿) 2012年9月23日，亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院（ASU CI）联合亚省华人华侨联合总会（ACUA）在亚利桑那州立大学Memorial Union成功地举办了第四届中美合作论坛。本次论坛的主题为”从全球化经济看中美合作”。 论坛现场 (2012年9月23日 摄于亚利桑那州立大学，摄影 Linda Wei) 中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆副总领事孙伟德先生首先为论坛的开幕仪式致辞，他全面地陈述了中美之间的合作机遇及策略。接着，亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院院长司马德琳教授向来宾们介绍了本次论坛的主要内容及各位主讲嘉宾。出席本次论坛的主讲嘉宾包括Avnet 公司的首席合规官及副主席李军先生，亚利桑那州工商协会的副主席Hank Marshall先生，及亚利桑那州采购有限公司的副主席 Jeremy Schoenfelder 先生。 李军先生- Avnet 公司的首席合规官及副主席向大家陈述了Avnet公司是如何在全球化经济下做到高质量，低成本地向全球客户提供优质服务。总部设在凤凰城的Avnet公司为700多家大型供应商提供服务。在全球80多个国家拥有10多万客户。每天，有3万多件产品通过各种货运渠道发往世界各地。2009年至2012年期间，Avnet公司连续被《财富》杂志评为”最值得钦慕的公司”。李先生还为大家讲述了在当前已经规范化的中国市场的发展及心得。他说，Avnet公司在中国的发展，最大的挑战是如何培养及维持高水准的员工，如何进行危机管理及如何调解文化差异。同时，李先生也认为，中国市场具有极大的潜力，中国的中产阶级购买力越来越强。李先生在结语时，向在座的来宾表示Avnet公司愿意为有意进行中美合作的企业和机构提供指导方针，与大家分享如何在跨文化中取得双赢。 亚利桑那州商会的 Hank Marshall 在演讲 Hank Marshall先生是亚利桑那州工商协会的副主席。他的演讲主题为”亚利桑那新纪元”。他说，在全球化经济下，亚利桑那州与中国应寻求在更多的领域进行合作，做到互相理解，相互欣赏。Marshall 先生还指出，为了更好地开发中国市场，亚利桑那州应该要有更清醒的自我了解，把亚利桑那州可以为中国提供什么及中国需要什么更好地结合起来。他认为，亚利桑那州不应只是创意的使用者，它有能力成为创意的开发者。通过全球合作，亚利桑那州可以为世界提供更好的创意，产品及服务。 亚利桑那州采购有限公司的副主席 Jeremy Schoenfelder 先生向大家介绍了目前亚利桑那州知名的EB-5项目。亚利桑那州采购有限公司是Phoenix Mart的开发商，占地170万平方尺，是一个具有多功能，对团体及个体客户提供服务的商业中心。它可以容纳2000多户商家，50多万产品。据Jeremy Schoenfelder先生介绍，EB-5项目是根据美国政府早在1990年提出的移民政策所制定的项目，能有效的帮助亚利桑那州吸引投资及开创就业机会。同时，海外投资者可以根据要求，花费50万至100万美金对EB-5项目进行投资，并由此获得美国的绿卡。这是利于双方共赢的一个很好的合作机会，即可帮助开发商降低成本，也可吸引海外投资者，为亚利桑那州民众提供广泛的就业机会。他说，这个项目的成功，取决于政府和投资者要在对的时间，对的地点，找到对的产品，进行共同开发和发展。 热情的听众不时地为嘉宾精彩的演讲致以热烈的鼓掌，有些听众还在不停地记笔记。大家纷纷表示此次论坛对如何加强中美合作有很大的帮助。我们衷心的感谢为此次论坛付出巨大努力的筹办委员会，包括ASU孔子学院副院长徐智萍女士，Tony Tam 先生及众多志愿者，是他们的辛勤努力，使得本次论坛得以成功的举办。我们还要感谢赞助本次论坛的亚省华人华侨联合总会及亚利桑那州立大学人文学院。 去年的活动,请点击链接: 《中美合作面面观》论坛分享来自太平洋两岸产业发展的经验（图）
bc8c976d2bb71e76c680aa544c6bea036116a041.translatedText: The 4th Sino-US Cooperation Forum "Viewing Sino-US Cooperation from the Global Economy" (Contributed by ASU Confucius Institute) On September 23, 2012, the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University (ASU CI) and the Alberta Chinese Overseas Chinese Association (ACUA) successfully held the 4th Sino-US Cooperation Forum at the Memorial Union of Arizona State University. The theme of this forum is "Looking at Sino-US Cooperation from the Global Economy". Forum site (photographed at Arizona State University on September 23, 2012 by Linda Wei) Mr. Sun Weide, Deputy Consul General of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, first delivered a speech at the opening ceremony of the forum. He comprehensively stated the cooperation opportunities and strategies between China and the United States. Then, Professor Smadelin, Director of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, introduced the main content of this forum and the keynote speakers to the guests. Keynote speakers attending this forum include Mr. Li Jun, Chief Compliance Officer and Vice Chairman of Avnet Corporation, Mr. Hank Marshall, Vice Chairman of the Arizona Chamber of Commerce and Industry, and Mr. Jeremy Schoenfelder, Vice Chairman of Arizona Purchasing Co., Ltd. Mr. Li Jun - Chief Compliance Officer and Vice Chairman of Avnet Company stated to everyone how Avnet Company can provide high-quality and low-cost services to global customers in the global economy. Phoenix-based Avnet serves more than 700 large suppliers. It has more than 100,000 customers in more than 80 countries around the world. Every day, more than 30,000 products are shipped to all parts of the world through various freight channels. From 2009 to 2012, Avnet was continuously named the "Most Admirable Company" by Fortune magazine. Mr. Li also told everyone about the development and experience of the currently standardized Chinese market. He said that the biggest challenges for Avnet's development in China are how to cultivate and maintain high-level employees, how to manage crises and how to mediate cultural differences. At the same time, Mr. Li also believes that the Chinese market has great potential, and the purchasing power of China's middle class is getting stronger and stronger. In his closing remarks, Mr. Li told the guests present that Avnet is willing to provide guidelines for companies and institutions interested in Sino-US cooperation and share with everyone how to achieve a win-win situation in cross-culture. Hank Marshall of the Arizona Chamber of Commerce is giving a speech. Mr. Hank Marshall is the Vice President of the Arizona Chamber of Commerce and Industry. The theme of his speech was "Arizona's New Era." He said that in the globalized economy, Arizona and China should seek to cooperate in more areas and achieve mutual understanding and mutual appreciation. Mr. Marshall also pointed out that in order to better develop the Chinese market, Arizona should have a clearer self-understanding and better integrate what Arizona can provide China with what China needs. He believes that Arizona should not just be a user of ideas, it has the ability to be a developer of ideas. Through global collaboration, Arizona can provide the world with better ideas, products and services. Mr. Jeremy Schoenfelder, Vice Chairman of Arizona Purchasing Co., Ltd., introduced the well-known EB-5 projects in Arizona. Arizona Purchasing Co., Ltd. is the developer of Phoenix Mart, which covers an area of ​​1.7 million square feet. It is a multi-functional commercial center that provides services to groups and individual customers. It can accommodate more than 2,000 merchants and more than 500,000 products. According to Mr. Jeremy Schoenfelder, the EB-5 project is a project developed based on the immigration policy proposed by the U.S. government as early as 1990. It can effectively help Arizona attract investment and create job opportunities. At the same time, overseas investors can invest US$500,000 to US$1 million in EB-5 projects upon request, and thereby obtain a US green card. This is a good cooperation opportunity that is beneficial to both parties. It can help developers reduce costs, attract overseas investors, and provide a wide range of employment opportunities for Arizonans. He said that the success of this project depends on the government and investors finding the right product at the right time and in the right place for joint development and development. The enthusiastic audience applauded the guests' wonderful speeches from time to time, and some of the audience kept taking notes. Everyone said that this forum was of great help in strengthening Sino-US cooperation. We sincerely thank the organizing committee who have made great efforts for this forum, including Ms. Xu Zhiping, deputy director of the ASU Confucius Institute, Mr. Tony Tam and many volunteers. It is their hard work that made this forum a success. We would also like to thank the Chinese Federation of Alberta and the College of Humanities at Arizona State University for sponsoring this forum. For last year’s events, please click on the link: "Aspects of Sino-US Cooperation" forum to share experiences in industrial development from both sides of the Pacific (pictures)

6d8fcfb9876d2e073e4f1cc1f9c87882dc807203.sourceText: 傳統僑慶祝雙十節 張肇鴻 美國華僑慶祝雙十節最早可追溯到辛亥革命功的1911年。稱”華僑乃革命之母” 的孫中山長期以美國為推翻滿清的基地，四處奔走宣傳革命籌集經費，包括美國在內的華僑捐獻超過一千萬美元以上。一九一二年元月，孫中山由美國回國担任臨時大總統，美國各地華僑歌舞歡騰，熱烈慶祝中華民國成立。 一九四三年，羅斯福總統視中華民國為盟友，提議和批准廢除美國六十多年來十五種排華苛例，華人開始重新移民美國，而隨着華僑的增加，慶祝雙十的規模也逐年增加，尤其是上世紀六、七十年代，國府在聯合國形勢日益嚴竣，而對各地華僑更是加强聯係，並長期為僑社僑民提供各種實質性的援助。 根據搜集到的資料和相片，民國六十七年(1977年)，國府駐加州總領事范道瞻先生已到鳯凰城訪問，當年台灣的《中外雜誌》有如下報道: ”春宴計有一百餘衆，設座於以治餚精美見稱的《上海酒樓》，筵開十一席，裙屐翩躚籌交錯，飛觴祝福，此呼彼應。是日與會的中外人士俱屬當地中堅人物，專家學者，名譽首要，真乃濟濟名士。范道瞻總領事不辭跋踄，兼程蒞至，實具代表政府宣慰華僑同胞，還有鄧心平老華僑，名律師；章玲女士，為開州以來率先抵達鳯凰城華人之一，林默青名媛閨秀，DeConcini,Dino.Dennis 等州市府政要，謙恭之士，渴慕我國文化，為中華民國不貮之友。餐畢放映由領事館提供名為《忍》的影片，及映蔡鍔將軍發動二次革命，推翻袁世凱帝制之故事。” 由于本州和台灣的關係較為密切，國府連年派官員、慰問團到訪，包括中華舞蹈團、青年訪問團、光華慰問團、華夏訪問團、國立台灣藝校、佳音兒童合唱團、蘇文慶樂團等等，有資料、劇照、錦旗保留。國際獅子會在斐匿召開過世界年會，拍攝了大量的歷史照片，當年國府曾撥款一萬美元給斐匿僑聯總會，作為慶祝召開年會之經費。長期以來，僑社都有慶祝雙十節的活動。下面《義重深長的一篇話》，是當選了三屆斐匿僑聯主席方慧賢，於一九九四年中國週期間，在歡迎台灣駐洛杉聯絡處張慶衍處長的講話: （節錄當年《華報》：”我們僑居於美的僑胞，幾十年來得蒙中華民國政府僑務委員會鼎力支持，使美國華人福利會能在美京用精明的華人律師争居移民名額，幫助了無數僑胞之家眷、子女、兄弟、親戚由大陸、香港、澳門等地移民來美，家庭團聚，找尋新生，居美華僑若受到任何不合理的歧視或凌辱，也有機會在美京上訴。’) 美國各市之中文學校有99%都是國民政府在經濟上支持，每年在台灣設有教師研討會，訓練各僑校派出的代表，讓他們回僑居地後發揚中華文化，教育年幼的中華兒女，使他們理解和認識中國人的優秀傳統，驕傲地在美國做龍的傳人。僑務委員會設立文教中心，以便利輔助各僑校，供應教材以至教師。為了鼓勵華人參政，僑委會也花了不少精神、錢財，邀請年青的華裔回國研究，目的是鞏固華人在美之地位。以上所提及的只是僑委會多年來，為我們在美華僑所做好事的一部份。 自1983年中華文藝社設立後，至現在本埠有五間中文學校，僑委會從未斷過供應教材及書籍。四年前斐匿中文學校籌備時，捐助僑聯總會七萬美圓；每年經華美科技會頒發奬學金給華裔學生，且邀請不少華人回國研究。 為了幫助提高本埠華人在美國社會的地位，每年中國週都提供不少籌備經費；今年派來玲瓏舞蹈團為中國週節目撐腰，只求中國週在美國人面前辦得有聲有色，辦得成功。 國民政府為本埠之華人已花了很多心血、金錢，但從沒有要求過任何回報的條件，目的只如父母愛護子女一樣。僑務委員會對本埠華裔之濃情厚義，我們會銘記於心，嘴巴講的不管甚麼，心底深處的地位是永遠存在的。
6d8fcfb9876d2e073e4f1cc1f9c87882dc807203.translatedText: Traditional overseas Chinese celebrate the Double Ten Festival Zhang Zhaohong The overseas Chinese in the United States celebrate the Double Ten Festival as early as 1911, the year of the Revolution of 1911. Sun Yat-sen, who said that "overseas Chinese are the mother of the revolution," has long used the United States as a base to overthrow the Qing Dynasty. He traveled around to promote the revolution and raise funds. Overseas Chinese, including those in the United States, donated more than 10 million U.S. dollars. In January 1912, Sun Yat-sen returned from the United States to serve as the interim president. Overseas Chinese across the United States celebrated the founding of the Republic of China with singing and dancing. In 1943, President Roosevelt regarded the Republic of China as an ally and proposed and approved the abolition of fifteen harsh anti-Chinese regulations in the United States over the past sixty years. Chinese began to immigrate to the United States again. With the increase of overseas Chinese, the scale of Double Ten celebrations also increased year by year. Especially in the 1960s and 1970s, the government's situation in the United Nations became increasingly difficult, and it strengthened ties with overseas Chinese in various places and provided various substantive assistance to overseas Chinese communities for a long time. According to the collected information and photos, in the 67th year of the Republic of China (1977), the Consul General of the Republic of China in California, Mr. Fan Daozhan, visited Phoenix City. Taiwan's "China and Foreign Magazine" reported the following that year: "There were more than a hundred people at the spring banquet, and they were seated in the "Shanghai Restaurant", which is famous for its exquisite cuisine. There were eleven tables in the banquet, and the skirts and skirts were dancing together, and blessings were shouted in response to each other. The Chinese and foreign people attending the meeting today are all local backbones, experts and scholars, with the most important reputation, and they are really celebrities. Fan Daozhan The Consul General traveled all the way to express his condolences to the overseas Chinese compatriots on behalf of the government. There were also Deng Xinping, an old overseas Chinese and a famous lawyer; Ms. Zhang Ling, one of the first Chinese to arrive in Phoenix City since the founding of the state, Lin Moqing, a famous lady, DeConcini, Dino.Dennis The government officials of other states and cities are humble people who are eager for our country's culture and are unfailing friends of the Republic of China. After the meal, a film called "Forbearance" provided by the consulate was shown, which showed the story of General Cai E's second revolution to overthrow the Yuan Shikai monarchy. " Due to the close relationship between the state and Taiwan, the national government has sent officials and condolence groups to visit the state in successive years, including the Chinese Dance Troupe, the Youth Visiting Group, the Guanghua Consolation Group, the Huaxia Visiting Group, the National Taiwan Arts School, the Good Music Children’s Choir, the Su Wenqing Ensemble, etc. Information, stills, and banners have been preserved. The Lions Club International held its world annual conference in Phenomenal and took a large number of historical photos. At that time, the government allocated US$10,000 to the Phenomenal Overseas Chinese Federation as a fund to celebrate the annual conference. Overseas Chinese communities have long held activities to celebrate the Double Ten Festival. The following "A Word of Profound Meaning" is a speech made by Fang Huixian, the three-term chairman of the Feinian Overseas Chinese Federation, during China Week in 1994, when he welcomed Zhang Qingyan, director of the Taiwan Liaison Office in Los Angeles: (Excerpt from "Chinese News" of that year: "Our overseas Chinese living in the United States have received strong support from the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission of the Government of the Republic of China for decades, which has enabled the Chinese Welfare Association in the United States to use smart Chinese lawyers in Beijing to fight for immigration quotas, which has helped Countless overseas Chinese family members, children, brothers, and relatives immigrated to the United States from mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and other places to reunite with their families and find a new life. If overseas Chinese in the United States suffer any unreasonable discrimination or insult, they also have the opportunity to appeal in the United States and Beijing.’) 99% of Chinese schools in cities in the United States are financially supported by the National Government. Teacher seminars are held in Taiwan every year to train representatives sent by overseas Chinese schools so that they can carry forward Chinese culture when they return to their places of residence and educate young Chinese children so that they can understand and understand the fine traditions of the Chinese people and proudly serve as the descendants of the dragon in the United States. The committee established a cultural and educational center to facilitate and assist overseas Chinese schools, supply teaching materials and even teachers. In order to encourage Chinese people to participate in politics, the Overseas Chinese Committee also spent a lot of energy and money to invite young Chinese to return to the country to study, with the purpose of consolidating the status of the Chinese in the United States. The above mentioned are only part of the good things the Overseas Chinese Committee has done for us overseas Chinese in the United States over the years. Since the establishment of the Chinese Literature and Art Society in 1983, there are currently five Chinese schools in the city, and the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council has never stopped supplying teaching materials and books. When the Feinian Chinese School was being prepared four years ago, it donated US$70,000 to the Overseas Chinese Federation; every year, the China-American Science and Technology Association awards scholarships to Chinese students and invites many Chinese to return to China for study. In order to help improve the status of the local Chinese in American society, a lot of preparation funds are provided for China Week every year. This year, the Linglong Dance Troupe was sent to support the China Week program. We only hope that China Week will be held successfully in front of Americans. The National Government has spent a lot of effort and money on behalf of the Chinese in this city, but it has never asked for any conditions in return. The purpose is just like parents caring for their children. We will bear in mind the deep love and kindness of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission for the Chinese in this city. No matter what we say with our mouths, the status deep in our hearts will always exist.

b4c488f5ea82ce23dfed740537088da4fb2703a3.translatedText: (Phoenix City Uncle Bo) On March 14, the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation held a general meeting in the Harbor City cafeteria. Eighteen overseas Chinese community presidents and vice-chairmen attended. The conference elected Zhang Huafang as the chairman of the Federation of Overseas Chinese, and Li Jiang, Xu Qiang, Wen Linglin, Mei Shude and Wang Ruijin as vice presidents, forming a strong leadership team of the Federation of Overseas Chinese.
