1444ab4cb9f1a21073d809cf022007e3ca228e1a.sourceText: 従大理回昆明，走的是在抗战时期建设的滇缅公路基础上建成的髙速公路。导游和大家一起回顾了这条抗日战争时期维繫中华民族存亡的生命线上发生的故亊。当时，日冦占领了大半个中国和香港、中国直接和外界联系的海路和陆路均己被切断。接着，日夲占领趆南，切断了中国的一切通路，不用说枪炮武器得不到外援，生活物资也十分匮乏。当时国民政府决定修䢖昆明到缅甸的滇缅公路打开出路。这里地势险峻，髙山丛林，河流交错。这条公路全长一千四百五十三公里，在中国境内九百五十九公里，除昆明到下关452公里有农村道路外，其余路段都要沿着马帮的山区小路开闢新的公路。沿途要穿过怒山山脉、髙黎贡山脉，跨趆澜沧江、怒江等大河，工程之艰巨可见一般。当时向国际招标，最短工期要三年，还有许多附加条件。据传，在这民族危忘的关键时刻，时任云南省省长龙云下逹了由云南人自己䢖设这条公路的手令，并向国民政府蒋委员长作了一年䢖成，否则提头来见的担保。龙云的手令是用鸡毛信的方式，一封亲笔手令和一个装着手铐的盒子，意即不能如期完成就要依法严办。于是，二十万少数民族自备干粮，餐风露宿，扛起锄头、鉄铣、大锤，用背篓和石碾，用蚂蚁啃骨头的办法，硬是在不到一年的时间内，抠出了一条世界上最崎岖的公路。无数人献出了宝贵的生命，率领修路大军的王县长累瞎了眼睛，看到这些塲面的一些纪录片片断时，不禁落下了眼泪，深深地被我国少数民族在国家危忘时刻的爱国热忱所感动。这就是人民动员起来的力量。当时的美国总统罗斯福派专员前来勘察时，曾盛赞这是继埃及金字塔和万里长城之后的世界第三大奇迹。
1444ab4cb9f1a21073d809cf022007e3ca228e1a.translatedText: Returning to Kunming from Dali, we took the high-speed highway built on the basis of the Burma Highway built during the Anti-Japanese War. The tour guide reviewed with everyone the stories that happened on this lifeline that maintained the survival of the Chinese nation during the Anti-Japanese War. At that time, the Japanese occupied most of China and Hong Kong, and China's direct sea and land routes to the outside world had been cut off. Then, Japan occupied Pennan and cut off all access to China. Needless to say, there was no foreign aid for guns and weapons, and living materials were also very scarce. At that time, the Nationalist Government decided to build the Burma Highway from Kunming to Myanmar to open up a way out. The terrain here is steep, with high mountains and jungles and crisscrossed rivers. This highway has a total length of 1,453 kilometers, 959 kilometers in China. Except for 452 kilometers of rural roads from Kunming to Xiaguan, the remaining sections have to open new roads along the mountain trails of caravans. Along the way, it has to pass through the Nushan Mountains and the Gaoligong Mountains, and cross major rivers such as the Lancang River and the Nujiang River. The difficulty of the project is evident. At that time, international bidding was invited, and the minimum construction period was three years, with many additional conditions. It is said that at this critical moment of national crisis, the then governor of Yunnan Province, Long Yunxia, ​​issued an order for the Yunnanese to build this highway themselves, and gave Chairman Chiang Kai-shek of the Nationalist Government a guarantee that it would be completed within one year or else he would come forward to meet him. Long Yun's warrant was in the form of a chicken-feather letter, a handwritten warrant and a box containing handcuffs, which meant that if it could not be completed as scheduled, it would be strictly dealt with according to the law. So, 200,000 ethnic minorities prepared their own dry food and slept in the open. They carried hoes, iron mills and sledgehammers, used backpacks and stones to grind them, and used ants to chew bones. They just dug out the most rugged road in the world in less than a year. Countless people sacrificed their precious lives. County Magistrate Wang, who led the road construction army, was blinded by exhaustion. When he saw some of these documentary clips, he couldn't help but shed tears. He was deeply moved by the patriotic enthusiasm of our country's ethnic minorities in this moment of national crisis. This is the power of people mobilizing. When the then US President Roosevelt sent a commissioner to investigate, he praised it as the third wonder of the world after the Egyptian pyramids and the Great Wall.

72e2b0e936026a6b0f94cb263a4b5652530aee46.translatedText: >The Burma Highway passing through the Bao Mountains

867ec22f4495842dd99fb378ae2c6d3ece4961da.sourceText: 民工们修路的历史照片 这条公路䢖成通车，打碎了日夲军国主义妄啚短时间㧪杀中国的梦想，中国凭藉着长江三峡和贵州山地的有利地形，和鬼子展开了持久战; 沦䧟区的军民展开游击战、地道战抗击曰军。滇缅公路像一条搭桥（by pass）形成的新血管，维繋着全国抗日战塲。同样令人不能忘却的是华侨同胞的爱国热忱。公路䢖成后，需要大量的运输工具，旅居南洋的华侨陈嘉庚先生发起捐巨资支援抗战，筹集了13000多辆汽车。有了汽车，又缺司穖。于是又有一批华侨青年，放弃了国外安定富足的生活，组成机工服务团3192人回国支援抗战。当日军再次对这条生命线疯狂轰炸时，是当地少数民族用生命和鲜血维护了线路的畅通。1940年，日军炸断了澜沧江大桥，正当小日本向全世界大肆宣扬完全切断了中国的供应线时，满载物资的运输车队己经在七十个空汽油桶上架起的浮桥上源源不断地通过，成为战时的佳话。聂耳在”义勇军进行曲”词中描述说：”中华民族，到了最危险的时候，每个人都发出愤怒的吼声，用我们的血肉，筑成我们新的长城”正是这段历史的真实写照。行进在这条前辈先烈们用鲜血染红的大路上，听导逰讲述那一个个英雄故事，深深感受到人民力量的伟大。一个国家，只要民同此心，万众一心，就会焕发出无穷的力量。是的,人民,只有人民，才是推动历史的真正动力。但是，如果错用了人民的动力，那就会造成大灾难。一九五八年我们曾经亲身经历的全民大炼钢鉄，家家户户把铁锅和门窗砸了去炼钢铁，为的是实现年産一千零八十万吨钢，赶上英国。随后的”大跃进”和发生在上世纪六、七十年代的”文化大革命”，煽动不懂事的孩子们和年青人”为无産阶级政权”去抄家、打人、批斗。到头来是他们那几个人的窝里斗，害了全国的老百姓，害了整个国家和民族，弄得整个社会鸡犬不宁，三十年停滞不前。这段历史要好好总结，人民是无罪的，九泉之下的无産阶级革命家们总该作些反省和自我批评吧！
867ec22f4495842dd99fb378ae2c6d3ece4961da.translatedText: Historical photos of migrant workers building the road. The completion of this highway shattered the dream of Japanese militarism to kill China in a short time. China relied on the favorable terrain of the Three Gorges of the Yangtze River and the Guizhou mountains to launch a protracted war with the Japanese; The soldiers and civilians in the occupied areas launched guerrilla warfare and tunnel warfare to fight against the Japanese army. The Burma Highway is like a new blood vessel formed by a by-pass, maintaining the anti-Japanese war all over the country. What is also unforgettable is the patriotic fervor of the overseas Chinese compatriots. After the highway was completed, a large number of transportation tools were needed. Mr. Tan Kah Kee, an overseas Chinese living in Nanyang, initiated a huge donation to support the Anti-Japanese War and raised more than 13,000 vehicles. With cars, there is a lack of drivers. As a result, another group of overseas Chinese young people gave up their stable and prosperous life abroad and formed a mechanical service group of 3,192 people to return to China to support the Anti-Japanese War. When the Japanese army bombed this lifeline again, it was the local ethnic minorities who used their lives and blood to maintain the smooth flow of the line. In 1940, the Japanese army blew up the Lancang River Bridge. Just as little Japan was trumpeting to the world that it had completely cut off China's supply lines, transport convoys full of supplies were passing continuously on the pontoon bridge set up on seventy empty gasoline barrels, which became a good story during the war. Nie Er described in the lyrics of "March of the Volunteers": "When the Chinese nation is at its most dangerous, everyone roars in anger and builds our new Great Wall with our flesh and blood." This is a true portrayal of this period of history. Walking on this road stained red with the blood of the ancestors and martyrs, listening to the heroic stories told by the guide, I deeply felt the great power of the people. A country will radiate infinite power as long as its people are of the same mind and united as one. Yes, the people, and only the people, are the real driving force of history. However, if the power of the people is misused, it will cause catastrophe. In 1958, we personally experienced the nation-wide steelmaking campaign. Every household smashed pots and doors and windows to make steel in order to achieve an annual output of 10.8 million tons of steel and catch up with Britain. The subsequent "Great Leap Forward" and the "Cultural Revolution" that took place in the 1960s and 1970s incited ignorant children and young people to ransack homes, beat people, and criticize people "for the proletarian regime." In the end, it was the fighting between a few of them that harmed the common people across the country, harmed the entire country and nation, and made the entire society restless and stagnant for thirty years. This period of history must be summed up carefully. The people are not guilty. The proletarian revolutionaries who are under the influence of evil should always do some introspection and self-criticism!

9f3a79174f2fee9d6fcef953f8844d8ed708333f.translatedText: Yu Ding: Past Events in Jiangtun (3)

237f9c3720c4b9469f9d436b611540ec23a07fa1.sourceText: 于丁：江屯往事（三） 凤凰城 于丁 那时，一个女同学一直和我通信，她的意思表达的也很明确。可是，我父母不同…
237f9c3720c4b9469f9d436b611540ec23a07fa1.translatedText: Yu Ding: Past Events in Jiangtun (3) Phoenix Yu Ding At that time, a female classmate kept communicating with me, and her meaning was expressed very clearly. However, my parents are different...

8571dd6620f8bcaa009b1f3edba3429c4dfd8468.sourceText: 那时，一个女同学一直和我通信，她的意思表达的也很明确。可是，我父母不同意，我也很纠结。
8571dd6620f8bcaa009b1f3edba3429c4dfd8468.translatedText: At that time, a female classmate kept communicating with me, and her meaning was very clear. However, my parents didn't agree and I was very confused.

e376916bf28a1594dd03ee4ec6ec0aeda8ecd2c6.sourceText: 68年，我下乡，她去了生产建设兵团。本来兵团比农村好不了多少，可是不久她当上了《兵团战报》的记者，就不用干活了。她爸是大学教授，虽然文革中也被批斗，但”解放”早。她爸托关系把她调到省城的《兵团战报》记者站，实际已经脱离了兵团。
e376916bf28a1594dd03ee4ec6ec0aeda8ecd2c6.translatedText: In 1968, I went to the countryside and she went to the Production and Construction Corps. Originally, the Corps was not much better than the countryside, but soon she became a reporter for the "Corps War Report" and no longer had to work. Her father is a university professor. Although he was criticized during the Cultural Revolution, he was "liberated" early. Her father had some connections and transferred her to the reporter station of the "Corps Battle Report" in the provincial capital, and she had actually left the Corps.

124f2ba3f913dd1ac2ca26f2b35dca589dfe9986.sourceText: 她家就她一个女孩，是她爸的掌上明珠 。手风琴、小提琴、溜冰鞋、、、、要买啥买啥，兵团记者的身份又让她学会了摄影、骑马、打枪、、、、、、。
124f2ba3f913dd1ac2ca26f2b35dca589dfe9986.translatedText: She is the only girl in her family, and she is the apple of her father's eye. Accordion, violin, roller skates, etc., she bought whatever she wanted. As a reporter for the Corps, she also learned photography, horse riding, and shooting.

cf3a02cd818ddc70a15e18f6c189136110836d09.sourceText: 在一个班时，她学习一般，当了几年记者，成了文学青年。给我写信用的都是两个A四大的稿纸，因为超重，每封信都要贴好几张邮票。
cf3a02cd818ddc70a15e18f6c189136110836d09.translatedText: When she was in the same class, her studies were average. She worked as a reporter for several years and became a literary youth. The letters to me were all written on two A-size papers. Because they were overweight, each letter had to be affixed with several stamps.

2c71c5a429fa1dbfff48631dbd26e7ef407f9ae8.sourceText: 她的信常常是告诉我，她最近看了什么世界名著，然后就是几大篇子的读后感。让我也看那本书，也写读后感。或者是写读了她的读后感的读后感。
2c71c5a429fa1dbfff48631dbd26e7ef407f9ae8.translatedText: Her letters often tell me what world famous books she has read recently, and then her thoughts after reading several major chapters. Let me also read that book and write my thoughts after reading it. Or write a review of her review.

838cfca00adde9fa7d2bb1fa08cf1079df1681f2.sourceText: 她曾经让我在某一天的某个时辰看某颗星星，说那时她也会看那星星，这样我们就可以有心灵的沟通，情感的交流，对着星星做真情告白。
838cfca00adde9fa7d2bb1fa08cf1079df1681f2.translatedText: She once asked me to look at a certain star at a certain time on a certain day, saying that she would also look at that star at that time, so that we could have spiritual communication, emotional communication, and make true confessions to the stars.

dc2495843e83ab0af2a9f8940b39d068692a54b3.sourceText: 她还不止一次的给我寄来答卷，让我填：最喜欢的颜色、最爱吃的食品、最崇拜的名人、最厌恶的个性、、、、、、。
dc2495843e83ab0af2a9f8940b39d068692a54b3.translatedText: She also sent me answer sheets more than once, asking me to fill in: favorite color, favorite food, most admired celebrity, most disgusted personality,,,,,,.

7e7f8785a2df45cdb825139b6dc2b3c1fb7bf61c.sourceText: 每当接到她的来信，父亲就义正言辞地训导我：”儿子啊，这样的姑娘咱招惹不得，你这辈子就是农民了，哪能一会看星星，一会又答卷子的。就在农村踏踏实实说上个媳妇，好好过日子吧！”我觉得父亲说的有道理，渐渐的就不再回信了。
7e7f8785a2df45cdb825139b6dc2b3c1fb7bf61c.translatedText: Whenever I received a letter from her, my father lectured me righteously: "Son, we can't mess with a girl like this. You have been a farmer all your life. How can you look at the stars and answer papers the next. Just get a wife and live a good life in the countryside!" I felt that what my father said was reasonable, and gradually he stopped replying to letters.

872ef18887353ee6ee6531915ae05ddd6d8a8b23.sourceText: 下乡那年我二十二，大弟二十，在农村都是该娶媳妇的年龄。也许是不太接触社会的缘故，我对娶媳妇这事儿没有太强的渴望。
872ef18887353ee6ee6531915ae05ddd6d8a8b23.translatedText: When I went to the countryside, I was twenty-two and my eldest brother was twenty. In the countryside, we are both the age when we should marry a wife. Maybe it’s because I don’t have much contact with society, but I don’t have a strong desire to marry a wife.

7625225264116684aad87004f4273bd57190d942.sourceText: 我成熟挺晚的，都上高中了，还不知道鸡蛋为什么能浮出小鸡。一次，我问从事绵羊良种培育工作的父亲，父亲告诉我，公鸡母鸡也是通过交配完成射精，精液会储存在母鸡体内，鸡蛋形成时先与精子结合，然后才包裹上蛋壳。那以后，我才注意到公鸡母鸡的确会有那样的行为，即”公鸡踩蛋儿”。
7625225264116684aad87004f4273bd57190d942.translatedText: I matured quite late. I am already in high school, and I still don’t know why chickens can float out of eggs. Once, I asked my father, who is engaged in breeding high-quality sheep, and he told me that roosters and hens also ejaculate through mating. The semen is stored in the hen's body. When the egg is formed, it is first combined with the sperm and then wrapped in an eggshell. After that, I noticed that roosters and hens do behave like that, that is, "roosters step on eggs."

c6c11e6439d79a74feaa170070638d5a3bc49112.sourceText: 农村的孩子应该都早熟，不仅有马牛猪羊随时随地的活体演示，大人们的言传身教也是无所不在的。虽然一开会说的都是农业学大寨，抓革命促生产，要斗私批修、、、、、、。可在田间地头，大人们讲的全是黄笑话，连荤素搭配都没有，一色荤的。半大不小的姑娘小伙听着，脸也都不红不白的。比我还小两岁的三虎子不仅愿意听，善于讲，还能表演”公鸡踩蛋儿”，是全屯子男男女女公认的”绝活”。
c6c11e6439d79a74feaa170070638d5a3bc49112.translatedText: Children in rural areas should mature early. Not only are there live demonstrations of horses, cows, pigs and sheep at any time and anywhere, but the words and deeds of adults are also ubiquitous. Although the talk at the beginning of the meeting was all about learning from Dazhai in agriculture, grasping the revolution to promote production, fighting against selfishness and criticizing revisionists,,,,,,. But in the fields, the adults told all dirty jokes, not even a combination of meat and vegetables, just meat and vegetables. The young and old girls listened, and their faces were neither red nor white. San Huzi, who is two years younger than me, is not only willing to listen and good at speaking, but he can also perform "cock stepping on eggs", which is a "unique skill" recognized by men and women in the whole village.

9750f292a8b4f0876f6e430a6191ccfa9f11d263.sourceText: 每当屯子里的社员在”大消校”前面集合，而三虎子心情又很好，他差不多就会来一个”公鸡踩蛋儿”。他先是与大闺女小媳妇拉开距离，一个人开始单腿站立，两只胳膊上下拍打，头转来转去，表示大公鸡在梳理羽毛，抖擞精神，准备出击了。这时要是那个老娘们发现了，就会高声嚎叫：”快跑啊，三虎子要来了！”不知道是害怕还是兴奋，媳妇们笑着叫着，四处奔逃。说时迟那时快，三虎子会张开双臂像老鹰盘旋一般，在院子里 跑一个弧线，然后逮住目标。他会跑到那老娘们身后，拽住她一绺头发。一条腿支撑，另一条腿抬起来，呈痉挛状，全身也不停地抖动。那老娘们像真被”踩”了一样，拼命地高喊：来人哪，救命啊！这时往往她那个当丈夫的，也跟着笑。直到三虎子抽搐的那条腿一下比一下慢，全身也不再抖动时，那老爷们才象征性地开始追打三虎子，笑声呐喊声响作一团、、、、、、。
9750f292a8b4f0876f6e430a6191ccfa9f11d263.translatedText: Whenever the village members gathered in front of the "big elimination school" and Sanhuzi was in a good mood, he would almost do a "rooster stepping on the egg". He first distanced himself from the eldest daughter-in-law and the younger daughter-in-law, and began to stand on one leg, flapping his arms up and down, and turning his head back and forth, indicating that the big rooster was preening its feathers, cheering up, and preparing to attack. If the old lady finds out at this time, she will howl loudly: "Run quickly, the three tigers are coming!" I don't know whether it is fear or excitement, the wives are laughing and shouting, running around. Soon enough, Sanhuzi would spread his arms like an eagle, run in an arc in the yard, and then catch the target. He would run up behind the old woman and grab a lock of her hair. One leg was supported, the other leg was raised, spasmodically, and the whole body was shaking. The old woman seemed to have been "stepped on" and shouted desperately: "Here, help!" At this time, her husband often laughs too. It wasn't until Sanhuzi's twitching leg became slower and slower, and his whole body stopped shaking, that the old man symbolically began to chase Sanhuzi, and there was a chorus of laughter and shouts...

e9f525a79459c2c1a23fec1e907bbaf13a3f78b2.sourceText: 那时候，也没想到还能回城，还能高考，还能招工。父亲常说：”人家能祖祖辈辈当农民，咱们咋就不能？咱家往上数三辈儿，你太爷爷也是农民，是挑着挑子闯关东过来的、、、、、、。”
e9f525a79459c2c1a23fec1e907bbaf13a3f78b2.translatedText: At that time, I didn’t expect that I would be able to return to the city, take the college entrance examination, and recruit workers. My father often said: "People can be farmers for generations, why can't we? Three generations back in our family, your great-grandfather was also a farmer. He came here from Guandong on a pick-up truck..."

f59bab7d3ff171f1da7544d31a9a60ba18bda412.sourceText: 杨七哥给我介绍对象，父母都很高兴，但一听说是妇女队长大珍子，都没了底气，知道我这关过不了。
f59bab7d3ff171f1da7544d31a9a60ba18bda412.translatedText: > Brother Yang Qi introduced me to someone. My parents were very happy, but when they heard that it was Da Zhenzi, the women's captain, they lost their confidence and knew that I couldn't pass this test.

472cda810c6afa679cacac7ef705dce464f8bb9a.sourceText: 大珍子年龄和我差不多，在当时的农村就快成剩女了。一米七的大个儿，虎背熊腰的。平时不苟言笑，嗓门亮惹洪钟，干起农活顶一个好老爷们。大珍子最大的特点是黑的出奇，本来大伙儿都是整天在地里干活，风吹日晒的，谁也白不了。但她可是真黑呀，有点像黑人的那种黑。她要是穿上龙袍，戴上髯口，那就是女版包青天。这丫头娶回家来，别说不敢当陈世美，就是让你当王朝马汉，站她身边也胆儿颤啊！
472cda810c6afa679cacac7ef705dce464f8bb9a.translatedText: Dazhenzi was about the same age as me, and she was almost a leftover girl in the countryside at that time. He is a tall man of 1.7 meters and has a sturdy back. He is usually serious in speech, has a loud voice that makes Hong Zhong angry, and does farm work like a good old man. The biggest feature of Dazhenzi is that she is extremely dark. Originally, everyone worked in the fields all day long and was exposed to the wind and sun, so no one could turn white. But she is really dark, a bit like black people. If she puts on a dragon robe and a beard, she will be the female version of Bao Qingtian. When this girl comes home, let alone Chen Shimei, even if you are asked to be a dynasty mahan, you will still be afraid to stand next to her!

3d53043e2bb6814264dd23c6efb34f345073ffd7.sourceText: 杨七哥看我家人都不搭拢，倒也没深说。后来我和父母都感觉到了，杨七哥说给我介绍大珍子是探探口风，实际上是想把他闺女小青给我当媳妇。小青比我小一岁，也老大不小了。前年，小青妹妹兰子就嫁给了大队书记韩大耳朵的儿子，现在孩子都抱出来了。姐姐未出阁，妹妹先生娃，小青肯定是”亚历山大”。
3d53043e2bb6814264dd23c6efb34f345073ffd7.translatedText: Brother Yang Qi saw that my family members didn’t get along with each other, so he didn’t say anything in depth. Later, my parents and I both felt that Brother Yang Qi said that he introduced Dazhenzi to me just to test his feelings. In fact, he wanted to give me his daughter Xiaoqing as his wife. Xiaoqing is one year younger than me, so he is already quite a bit older. The year before last, Xiaoqing's sister Lanzi married the son of brigade secretary Han Big Er, and now she has brought out the children. The elder sister has not yet left the cabinet, and the younger sister is a baby. Xiaoqing must be "Alexander".

98c3bd1fa21caa56243e20cb7f67f0bde9a0d49e.sourceText: 杨七哥一来我家，十有八九，小青会来找他爸，总是家里有点什么事，而他爸又不着急走，小青就和他爸一起在我家坐一会。有时候是杨七哥把小青叫来，给我家送点红药水，绷带啥的。小青是屯子里的”赤脚医生”，其实就是有个药箱，大队时不时给发点药。
98c3bd1fa21caa56243e20cb7f67f0bde9a0d49e.translatedText: When Brother Yang Qi comes to my house, nine times out of ten, Xiao Qing will come to see his dad. There is always something going on at home, and his dad is not in a hurry to leave, so Xiao Qing will sit with his dad at my house for a while. Sometimes Brother Yang Qi calls Xiaoqing over and brings some red potion and bandages to my house. Xiaoqing is the "barefoot doctor" in the village. He actually has a medicine box, and the brigade gives out some medicine from time to time.

2d3c3dd117bcda64679b418eaa36e71cfbb0662c.sourceText: 小青个子不高，长得不好看，也不难看。人还是挺懂事儿的，就是文化太低了，好像就念了三年书。我父亲跟杨七哥说：”你家小青是个好孩子，可是我那混蛋儿子不是读的高中吗，不知道天高地厚，非要找个中学生，说是最少也得是小学毕业、、、、、、。”杨七哥是明白人，从此再也不提小青的事儿了。我父亲这话传出去，也把屯子了其它那些丫头”屏蔽”掉了。可悲也可喜，屯子里那些丫头没有一个读到小学毕业的。
2d3c3dd117bcda64679b418eaa36e71cfbb0662c.translatedText: Xiao Qing is not tall, not good-looking, nor ugly. The people are quite sensible, but their education is too low. It seems that they only went to school for three years. My father told Brother Yang Qi: "Your Xiaoqing is a good boy, but didn't my bastard son go to high school? I don't know how high the world is. I have to find a middle school student, at least a primary school graduate..." Brother Yang Qi is a sensible person and never mentions Xiao Qing again. When my father's words spread, the other girls in the village were also "blocked". It is sad but also gratifying that none of the girls in the village have graduated from elementary school.

cd6548299c548d11459bbbca6cb0a535198a497e.sourceText: 杨七哥当队长，不像沈富，每天都领着社员下地干活。杨七哥经常去大队呀、公社呀、前后屯呀，去办事。其中也包括给我介绍对象。七哥热心肠，知道本屯子没有合适的，就领我去后姜家、段家店、肖家岗子、、、、、、，去相亲。连江对岸的王家公社都去了，也没遇上合适的。
cd6548299c548d11459bbbca6cb0a535198a497e.translatedText: Yang Qi Ge is the captain, unlike Shen Fu, who leads the members to work in the fields every day. Brother Yang Qi often went to the brigade, the commune, and the front and rear villages to do things. This also includes introducing people to me. Brother Qi was kind-hearted and knew that there was no suitable person in this village, so he took me to Houjiangjia, Duanjiadian, Xiaojiagangzi, etc. to go on a blind date. I even went to the Wangjia Commune on the other side of the river, but I didn't find anyone suitable.

7d5e140911de596c80e5b77263913afa48535236.sourceText: 一回七哥领我在五棵树公社，见了一个姑娘，说是读过一年的农中。那姑娘倒是眉清目秀，可涂着胭脂，留海和发梢都烫的弯弯的，也觉得有点不舒服。我回来跟三虎子一说，三虎子第二天就骑着自行车奔五棵树去了。回来跟我说：”那姑娘你可不能要啊，去年把孩子生到苞米地了。他爹吊起来打，都没问出来是谁的种。”后来逼急了，对着他爹喊：”是你的！是你的！、、、、、、”给他爹气的当场就背过气去了。
7d5e140911de596c80e5b77263913afa48535236.translatedText: Once, Brother Qi took me to Wushu Commune and met a girl who said she had studied in a rural middle school for one year. The girl had pretty features, but she was wearing rouge, her hair was permed, and she felt a little uncomfortable. When I came back and told Sanhuzi, Sanhuzi rode his bicycle to Wukeshu the next day. He came back and said to me: "You can't have that girl. The child was born in the corn field last year. His father hung him up and beat him, but he didn't even ask who the child was." Later, he became anxious and shouted to his father, "It's yours! It's yours!" He was so angry that he passed away on the spot.

4df3c54cf4ee97cf167c0664568f42ae7b980886.sourceText: 后来这姑娘的事杨七哥也听说了，跟我家好一顿陪不是。
4df3c54cf4ee97cf167c0664568f42ae7b980886.translatedText: Later, Brother Yang Qi also heard about this girl and wanted to have a good meal with my family.

95206ef4ce93f9974432d756747875eaafb0a2e3.sourceText: 希望中文学校的各类舞蹈课设在Mesa Community College的专业舞蹈教室里，舞蹈室宽敞明亮，设施先进，孩子们在一个良好的专业的环境里学习舞蹈技巧，让每一次的舞蹈课不只是单纯的学习，更是一次艺术上的享受。每一次满怀着梦想的旋转，每一个承载着希望的跳跃，在这里得以实现。
95206ef4ce93f9974432d756747875eaafb0a2e3.translatedText: I hope that the various dance classes of the Chinese school will be located in the professional dance classroom of Mesa Community College. The dance room is spacious and bright, with advanced facilities. The children can learn dance skills in a good and professional environment, so that every dance class is not just a simple learning, but also an artistic enjoyment. Every rotation full of dreams, every jump carrying hope, can be realized here.

a220c7e2043d45c2f5e20774825e7bfe46753843.sourceText: 希望中文学校在这个专业舞蹈室里开设了少儿中国民族舞蹈、历史文化舞剧表演, 中国现代舞、成人中国民族舞蹈, Zumba等多个舞蹈课，想学舞蹈的同学和家长一定要来看看这个专业级别的舞蹈室呀！
a220c7e2043d45c2f5e20774825e7bfe46753843.translatedText: Hope Chinese School has opened a number of dance classes in this professional dance studio: children’s Chinese folk dance, historical and cultural dance drama performances, Chinese modern dance, adult Chinese folk dance, Zumba, etc. Students and parents who want to learn dance must come and see this professional-level dance studio!

ffdd21fcbc029a811991091bb663aafe641790c5.translatedText: The music has started, let’s dance together!

a4354c84036f9baebdad93a192368d7e0246ba61.translatedText: Consumer Attention Many banks have quietly raised fees (Alberta Times) Do you need a new card if you lose your bank debit card? Bank of…

2d6d6cd7cacdf33248f5f96588ca497ecd2e6675.sourceText: 你的银行借记卡遗失需要一张新卡吗？ 美洲银行（Bank of America）现在收取费用5美元，如果是快递寄送就是20元。 你要用手机存款吗？ 美国银行(US Bancorp)现在每张支票收取费用50美分。 面对社会大​​众对银行愤怒的反应和监管机构的加强监督，银行正在转向各种不引人注目的费用。 做什么似乎都要钱。 想汇钱到您的帐户吗？ 12月起，TD Bank对每一笔国内汇款收费15元。 网站MyBankTracker.com的共同创办人Alex Matjanec指出，?#22810;数人并不了解，银行一直在增加新的收费项目，或是调高原有的收费，或是让这些费用更难以规避。?BR> 银行仍然可以从大部分的支票帐户中赚取利润。 不过，它们的压力很大，由于高昂的透支(overdraft)费以及借记卡刷卡费必须调降的规定，银行将失去约12亿美元的收入。 此外，放款无法增长加上利率接近零，银行很难把它们所有的存款都贷放出去或是进行好的投资。 对于消费者来说，结果就是各种新的费用，以及从提款机提取现金到电汇、要求文件等各种业务的收费都调涨。 更重要的是，银行调高帐户的最低余额规定，并增加其他要求，使客户很难符合费用减免。 美洲银行在受到批评后，于10月下旬取消了借记卡每个月5元的使用费。 不过，今年又静悄悄地把基本的MyAccess支票帐户每月的收费调高3美元，现在每个月的帐户维护费从8.95美元增加到12元。 大通(Chase)银行和花旗集团也调高基本型支票户的收费，本月起，花旗集团的基本支票帐户每月收费从8美元调为10美元。 大通则是在2月份对标准支票帐户收取每月12元费用，许多客户以前没有被收费。 对于收费调涨引发的哗然，一些银行家认为，最终的答案在于诱导客户，提供他们更多其他业务的服务，而不是从支票帐户上动脑筋来弥补收入的损失。 为了管理银行内的个人支票帐户，银行必须支付从分行人员到支付联邦存款保险保费等成本，每年每个帐户约200到300美元。 在过去，银行从商家收取的费用以及客户每次刷借记卡或帐户透支的费用弥补了大部分的支票帐户维护成本，因此，银行提供大家免费的支票帐户。 TD Bank的主管表示，他们最热门的产品之一是三月推出的一个没有最低余额要求的简易型支票帐户，虽然月费要2.99美元，已经有将近30万客户签约。 而且几乎所有的主要银行都开始降低成本，削减分行及员工。 SNL金融表示，在经过15年的扩张后，银行业的分行数量为9万8202家，比2009年的高峰减少1.4％。 银行也调降付给储户的利率。 根据Market Rates Insight顾问公司，银行的平均存款利率从今年上半年的0.8％降到0.74％，不过多数消费者都没有注意到，这些行动转换成为真实的收入?整个银行业每个月的成本降低 了约15亿美元。
2d6d6cd7cacdf33248f5f96588ca497ecd2e6675.translatedText: > Lost your bank debit card and need a new one? Bank of America now charges $5 for express delivery, or $20 for express delivery. Do you want to use your phone to deposit money? US Bancorp now charges 50 cents per check. Faced with an angry public response to banks and increased scrutiny from regulators, banks are turning to a variety of unobtrusive fees. Everything seems to cost money. Want to send money to your account? Starting in December, TD Bank will charge $15 for every domestic transfer. Alex Matjanec, co-founder of the website MyBankTracker.com, pointed out that many people are not aware that banks have been adding new fees, or raising existing fees, or making these fees more difficult to avoid. ?BR> Banks can still make profits on most checking accounts. But they are under pressure. Banks will lose about $1.2 billion in revenue due to high overdraft fees and regulations that require lower debit card swipe fees. In addition, with lending unable to grow and interest rates near zero, banks will find it difficult to lend out or make good investments. For consumers, the result is a variety of new fees and higher fees for everything from cash withdrawals at ATMs to wire transfers and document requests. What's more, banks are raising minimum balances on accounts and adding other requirements that make it difficult for customers to qualify for fee waivers. Bank of America eliminated its $5 monthly fee for debit cards in late October, but this year it quietly raised the monthly fee for its basic MyAccess checking account by $3, and now has a monthly account maintenance fee from $8.95 to $12. Chase and Citigroup have also raised fees for basic checking accounts, with Citigroup raising its monthly fees from $8 to $10 in February. Many customers were not charged a monthly fee in February. In response to the uproar over fee increases, some bankers believe the ultimate answer lies in inducing customers to offer more services to other businesses rather than using their checking accounts to make up for lost revenue. To manage a personal checking account within a bank, banks have to pay costs ranging from branch staffing to paying federal deposit insurance premiums, which run about $200 to $300 per account per year. In the past, banks charged most of the checking account maintenance costs from merchants and every time a customer swiped their debit card or overdrawn their account, so banks offered everyone free TD checking accounts. Bank executives said one of their most popular products, a simple checking account with no minimum balance requirement, launched in March and has already signed up nearly 300,000 customers despite a monthly fee of $2.99. And nearly all major banks have begun cutting costs and cutting branches and staff. After 15 years of expansion, the number of branches in the banking industry is 1.4% lower than at the peak in 2009. Banks have also cut the interest rates they pay depositors. According to the consulting company Market Rates Insight, the average bank deposit interest rate fell to 0.74% from 0.8% in the first half of this year. However, most consumers did not notice that these actions converted into real income? The entire banking industry has reduced costs by about $1.5 billion per month.

4208601d37c70d28d6ddc4b80412f752b3e581ea.sourceText: 回台灣-選總統-過新年 （亞利桑那洲馬吳後援會來稿） 亞利桑那洲馬吳後援會於本月12日在耆英活動中心舉行第二次返鄉投票報名及確認說明會。 活動於早上10點開始，參加人員滿懷熱情，對返鄉投票及號召回國助選皆充滿希望和期待，並對所有義工的義務服務及幫助表達感謝，許多人都是離開台灣多年​​，但是他們對家鄉的大事依然充滿真誠，尤其是這次選舉攸關國民黨能否繼續執政，中華民國能否繼續帶領國人走向未來，因此，海外華人華僑手中的第一張選票都是極為珍貴的， 都是決定中華民國未來和希望的力量，參加活動的鄉親們都表示，一定不會缺席這次投票，絕不讓自己在有生之年留下遺憾。 ”回台灣。選總統。過新年”就是我們亞省馬吳後援會的助選口號，今年是中華民國建國百年，海外華人華僑也要沾沾百年的喜慶，我們馬吳後援會的全體義工希望能與更多熱愛台灣的國民一起回台灣投下我們神聖的一票，讓馬英九政府為我們台灣的經濟發展，國家興盛再奮鬥四年，請大家勇躍報名，我們願真誠的為你們服務。 目前報名返鄉投票已達30多人，其他陸續打電話詢問消息的朋友也非常勇躍，讓我們的義工們應接不暇，我們呼籲廣大的華人華僑們同我們一道，回國投給清廉友善，任勞任怨的馬英九總統一票。 義工聯絡電話：李問淅602-956-7889 章文秀602-793-1325 鄧凱蒂602-478-5709 楊永慧480-220-3723 蔡昌623-399-6828 曹嘉儀480-540-4462 王瑋婷480-899-7059
4208601d37c70d28d6ddc4b80412f752b3e581ea.translatedText: Return to Taiwan - elect the president - celebrate the New Year (contributed by the Arizona Ma Wu Support Association) The Arizona Ma Wu Supporters Association held the second return home voting registration and confirmation briefing at the Senior Citizens Activity Center on the 12th of this month. The event started at 10 o'clock in the morning. The participants were full of enthusiasm, full of hope and expectation for returning to their hometowns to vote and call for returning to the country to support the election. They expressed their gratitude to all volunteers for their voluntary services and help. Many people have left Taiwan for many years, but they are still sincere about the major events in their hometown. Especially this election is about whether the Kuomintang can continue to be in power and whether the Republic of China can continue to lead the people into the future. Therefore, the first vote in the hands of overseas Chinese is extremely precious. They are all the forces that determine the future and hope of the Republic of China. The villagers who participated in the event said that they will never miss this vote and will never let themselves have regrets in their lifetime. "Go back to Taiwan. Elect the president. Celebrate the New Year" is the campaign slogan of our Ma-Wu Support Association in Alberta. This year marks the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Republic of China. Overseas Chinese will also celebrate the centenary. All the volunteers of the Ma-Wu Support Association hope to return to Taiwan with more Taiwan-loving citizens to cast our sacred vote and let the Ma Ying-jeou government strive for Taiwan's economic development and national prosperity for another four years. Please sign up bravely. We are willing to serve you sincerely. At present, more than 30 people have signed up to return home to vote. Other friends who have called to inquire about the news are also very brave, which makes our volunteers overwhelmed. We call on the majority of Chinese and overseas Chinese to join us and return to the country to vote for President Ma Ying-jeou, who is honest, friendly, and hard-working. e390c35f6ef05fa60cb501cdc0109f5bf570522e.sourceText: 一女子身患怪病 脑脊髓液从鼻孔里流出 本州一名女子在超过4个月的时间里，不断有大量液体从其鼻孔里涌出，医生刚开始以为其只是轻微过敏，经严格检查才发现这种透明无色无味的液体正是该女子的脑脊髓液。 这名35岁的女子名叫安德里亚?#38463;拉贡，是3个女孩的妈妈。此前四个月，每当她往下看或弯下身，总会有大量无色无味的透明液体从她的左边鼻孔里涌出。不自觉咽下这种液体后，肋部会感到疼痛。 刚开始，医生告诉阿拉贡，这只不过是某种过敏症状，但阿拉贡知道情况不妙。后来她来到图森的UA医学院附属医院检查后，医生断定她的蝶窦（鼻腔周围含气的4对骨质空腔之一）后部出现两处裂缝，她脑部的脑脊髓液从这两处缝隙不断渗出。 医生表示，脑脊髓液渗漏的情况并不多见，通常10万-20万人中只有1例，患者一般因超重而具有较高颅压。此外，车祸或脑部受创也可能带来脑脊髓液渗漏。但危险的不是阿拉贡脑脊髓液的流失，因为人体是会不断产生脑脊髓液的，而当人体最干净的脑部同人体最脏的鼻部连接后，可能会带来致命感染。 幸运的是，在发生这种致命感染之前，阿拉贡已经通过手术，填补了其蝶窦的两处裂口。
e390c35f6ef05fa60cb501cdc0109f5bf570522e.translatedText: A woman suffers from a strange disease, cerebrospinal fluid flows out of her nostrils A woman in this state had a large amount of fluid gushing out of her nostrils for more than 4 months. Doctors initially thought she was just suffering from a mild allergy. After careful examination, they discovered that the transparent, colorless and odorless fluid was the woman's cerebrospinal fluid. The 35-year-old woman's name is Andrea?#38463; Ragone, a mother of three girls. In the past four months, whenever she looked down or bent down, a large amount of colorless and odorless transparent liquid would gush out of her left nostril. After involuntarily swallowing this liquid, you may experience pain in your ribs. At first, the doctor told Aragon that it was just an allergy symptom, but Aragon knew something was wrong. After she was later examined at the UA College of Medicine Hospital in Tucson, doctors determined that there were two cracks in the back of her sphenoid sinus (one of four pairs of bony cavities that contain air around the nasal cavity), and that cerebrospinal fluid in her brain was leaking from these two cracks. Doctors said that cerebrospinal fluid leakage is rare, usually only 1 in 100,000-200,000 people. Patients generally have high intracranial pressure due to being overweight. In addition, a car accident or brain injury may cause cerebrospinal fluid leakage. But the danger is not the loss of Aragon's cerebrospinal fluid, because the human body will continue to produce cerebrospinal fluid, and when the cleanest brain of the human body is connected to the dirtiest nose of the human body, fatal infections may occur. Fortunately, Aragon had surgery to fill two tears in his sphenoid sinus before the fatal infection developed.

Unexpectedly, Nevaih couldn't wait to reach out her little hand from her mother's womb, tightly grasped the doctor's finger, and tried to The doctor said: "Pull me out quickly!" Nevaikh's father quickly took the camera and captured the rare picture of the newborn baby reaching out from the mother's womb to grab the doctor's finger. When this photo was uploaded by the Atkins couple to the famous social networking site Facebook, it has now become one of the most popular online photos in 2013.

25ccd0dafcb9e906a1f6dbfeaa700c7b6a4a610e.sourceText: 婚姻中的 差异 很多现代人结婚的重点在「我可以从婚姻中得些什么？」当我们选择结婚，都对婚姻抱着一些期望，当期望变成失望的时候，就会 产 生不满、愤恨，甚至苦毒。当那种爱的感觉消失了，或者，当自己已找到其他「更理想」的选择，而且发现，这选择会比维持现在的婚姻更对自己有利益，那么选择「分开」就是最自然不过的事。也许有些夫妻为了孩子的缘故， 算是忍了下来，熬了过来，婚姻虽然没有破裂，但却活在痛苦之中。另有一些的夫妻不愿忍受那种的痛苦，就选择了分居或是离婚。其实，如果你过去与另一半因意见上存有差异，生活中常有冲突，就认定你们之间的关系将永远成为僵局，请你务必要打消这种危险的想法。也许，你所面临的状况意味着你们的关系需要调整。 谈恋爱时，我们往往会被与我们性格相反的人所吸引，例如：活泼外向的会喜欢冷静思考的人，动作敏捷的会欣赏慢条斯理型的，精打细算的人，往往会配上花钱大方的人。在恋爱中的人，总有一个错觉，以为他所爱的人是完美的，我们两人是如此的「速配；但是，当恋爱情绪的波浪平息后，夫妻回到了真实的世界，两人之间的差异就显示出来了。我们之中多少人会问：「我们为什么会结婚？我们总是意见不合，我们的选择肯定是错误的！」 婚姻中的「鲶鱼效应」 据说喜欢吃沙丁鱼的挪威人，最爱吃活的沙丁鱼。但是渔民无法将每一只沙丁鱼保持着活的运到港口，常常在运送中途因窒息而死亡。但有一条渔船总能让大部分沙丁鱼活着回到渔港。船长严格保守着秘密，直到船长去世了，大家才知道这个秘密。原来是船长在装满沙丁鱼的鱼槽里，放进了一条以鱼为主要食物的鲶鱼。鲶鱼进入鱼槽后，由于环境陌生，便四处流窜。沙丁鱼见了鲶鱼十分紧张，到处躲避，加速游动。这样一来，一条条沙丁鱼就可以活蹦乱跳地回到了渔港，这就是著名的「鲶鱼效应」。 在人生的旅程中，我们也许就像那些沙丁鱼一样，从大海到港口， 从出生到死亡，从摇篮到坟墓，像是一条不变的道路。一路只有吃、喝、拉、撒、睡，一生安安逸逸地渡过，以至于活得奄奄一息、毫无生气，因此在人生的道路上我们极需要鲶鱼相伴，才能「生气十足」地到达终点。结了婚的夫妻来说，有时也会出现「鲶鱼效应」的情形，但是思想起来还是满有神的恩典的，因为两个性格、思想、背景、专业都不相同的人， 要一辈子在一起是件相当不容易的事，需要极多的爱心、信心与耐心来处理彼此间的差异，在冲突中用爱的方式迈向和睦。 认识冲突 其实，只要有人的地方，就有冲突，因为冲突最主要是来自差异，当双方有不同的期望，而只有一方能满足时，就会产生摩擦，当双方以自我为中心的方式来解决问题时，冲突自然就会产生，当再加上每个人都不一样。都有不同的意见、观点、家庭背景、性别，个性，要朝夕相处当然会发生「铁磨铁」的现象。 更何况，我们都是罪人，我们大错不犯、小错不断，我们都以为自己的看法是最客观、最合情、最合理、最聪明的，因此，常坚持自己的意见。 而且，每个人都软弱，我们会期望、会失望、会情绪化、会论断、会惩罚别人。别人家的孩子我们不太担心，但爱之深、责之切，越是亲近的人，越容易起冲突，而且常会用不正确的方式处理冲突。 解决冲突的关键， 其实，迈向和睦的第一步在于自己愿意省察，能够看到自己的缺失，有能力向对方承认错误并道歉。也许对方的错比较多，但若我们愿意从心里饶恕对方对我们的伤害，就可以看到关系的恢復。因此，解决人际冲突唯一且最有效的办法就是改变自己。神常允许冲突的产生，祂就有能力修复我们的冲突。正如父亲送孩子东西，并不怕孩子弄坏，我们若愿向祂求助，他就有能力修理！帮助在冲突困境中的我们。 处理冲突急救箱 1当冲突来时，请注意不要尊「我」为大、坚持「我」意思、把别人当作活祭、一切为满足「我」要。 2当冲突来时，请先想想自己有没有错（没看见什么），勇于认错、承担责任。 3当冲突来时，请记得”只要你愿谦卑包容，没有解决不了的问题”。 4当冲突来时，请不要重翻旧帐，这招绝对不管用了！ 5 当冲突来时，如果你错了就承认；你对了就要闭嘴！ 6不要在冲突未获解决之前上床就寝。 记得『冰山下』的问题才是最严重的。 7 当冲突来时，「决定你以后日子好过与否，就在你是否留着几句话不讲。
25ccd0dafcb9e906a1f6dbfeaa700c7b6a4a610e.translatedText: Differences in Marriage Many modern people focus on "What can I get from marriage?" When we choose to get married, we all have certain expectations for marriage. When expectations turn into disappointment, dissatisfaction, resentment, and even bitterness will arise. When that feeling of love disappears, or when you have found other "more ideal" choices and find that this choice will be more beneficial to you than maintaining your current marriage, then choosing to "separate" is the most natural thing. Maybe some couples endured it and got through it for the sake of their children. Although their marriages did not break up, they lived in pain. Some couples are unwilling to endure that kind of pain, so they choose to separate or divorce. In fact, if you have had differences of opinion with your significant other in the past and often had conflicts in your life, you will conclude that the relationship between you will always be a deadlock. Please be sure to give up this dangerous idea. Maybe the situation you're facing means your relationship needs an adjustment. When we fall in love, we tend to be attracted to people with opposite personalities to our own. For example, lively and outgoing people will like people who think calmly, quick-moving people will like people who are slow and careful, and people who are budget-conscious will often be matched with people who spend money generously. People who are in love always have the illusion that the person they love is perfect and the two of us are so "speed-matched"; however, when the emotional wave of love subsides and the couple returns to the real world, the differences between the two are revealed. How many of us will ask: "Why did we get married? We always disagree, and our choices must be wrong!" The "catfish effect" in marriage It is said that Norwegians who like to eat sardines love to eat live sardines. However, fishermen cannot transport every sardine alive to the port, and often die of suffocation during transportation. But there is a fishing boat that can always bring most of the sardines back to the fishing port alive. The captain kept the secret strictly, and no one knew the secret until the captain's death. It turned out that the captain put a catfish whose main food was fish into the fish tank filled with sardines. After the catfish entered the fish tank, they moved around because of the unfamiliar environment. The sardines were very nervous when they saw the catfish. They hid everywhere and swam faster. In this way, sardines can return to the fishing port alive and kicking. This is the famous "catfish effect." In the journey of life, we may be like those sardines, from sea to port, from birth to death, from cradle to grave, like an unchanging road. Along the way, we can only eat, drink, defecate, urinate, and sleep. We spend our whole life in peace and comfort, so that we live lifeless and lifeless. Therefore, we desperately need catfish to accompany us on the road of life, so that we can reach the end point "full of life". For married couples, the "catfish effect" sometimes occurs, but it is still full of God's grace in thinking, because it is not easy for two people with different personalities, thoughts, backgrounds, and professions to stay together for a lifetime. It requires a lot of love, confidence, and patience to deal with their differences and use love to move towards harmony in conflicts. Understanding conflicts In fact, wherever there are people, there will be conflicts, because conflicts mainly come from differences. When both parties have different expectations, and only one party can meet them, friction will occur. When both parties solve problems in a self-centered way, conflicts will naturally arise. When coupled with the fact that everyone is different. They all have different opinions, viewpoints, family backgrounds, genders, and personalities. If they have to get along day and night, the phenomenon of "iron sharpens iron" will naturally occur. What's more, we are all sinners. We make big mistakes and small mistakes all the time. We all think that our views are the most objective, reasonable, reasonable and smart, so we always stick to our own opinions. Moreover, everyone is weak. We expect, are disappointed, become emotional, judge, and punish others. We don’t worry too much about other people’s children, but the closer we are to someone with deep love and responsibility, the more likely they are to have conflicts, and they often handle conflicts in incorrect ways. The key to resolving conflicts, in fact, is that the first step towards harmony is one's willingness to examine oneself, the ability to see one's own shortcomings, and the ability to admit mistakes and apologize to the other party. Maybe the other party has made more mistakes, but if we are willing to forgive the other party from the heart for hurting us, we can see the relationship restored. Therefore, the only and most effective way to resolve interpersonal conflicts is to change yourself. God often allows conflict to arise, and He has the power to repair our conflict. Just like a father who gives something to his child is not afraid that the child will break it, if we are willing to ask Him for help, He is able to repair it! Help us in conflict situations. First aid kit for dealing with conflicts 1. When conflicts arise, please be careful not to respect "I" as the greatest, insist on "I" will, treat others as living sacrifices, and do everything to satisfy "I". 2. When a conflict arises, please first think about whether you have made any mistakes (you have not seen anything), and be brave enough to admit your mistakes and take responsibility. 3. When conflicts arise, please remember that "as long as you are willing to be humble and tolerant, there is no problem that cannot be solved." 4. When conflict arises, please don’t reopen old scores, this trick will definitely not work! 5 When conflict comes, admit it if you are wrong; shut up if you are right! 6. Don’t go to bed without resolving the conflict. Remember that the problem "under the iceberg" is the most serious. 7. When a conflict arises, “the difference between whether you will have a better life in the future or not depends on whether you leave a few words unsaid.

db0aebff16f2ed8dd92976cb7d345743243c98f9.sourceText: 教育增税 本州將公投 （亚省时报） 亚利桑那州和其他四个個州6日將投票決定是否增稅，以便繼續為公立學校提供資金。政府資助的學校如何經營已在全國引起熱烈討論，部分州的投票將反映選民對教育增稅的基本看法。 本州和密蘇里、南達科他州把增稅措施交由選民表決，加州向選民提供兩個方案，俄勒岡州把企業退稅作為撥給學校的部分資金。全國州議會協會說，五個州將要表決的教育增稅計畫，是過去20年來，州級選舉中最多的一次。 為彌補預算赤字，許多州削減了給學校的資助。全國今年小學和初中獲得的資助，按學生人均計，有35個州仍不到2008年的水平。 受資金短缺的影響，學區被迫採取裁員、停止部分教學計畫，甚至有的改為每周四天上課的措施。從2008年9月到2012年9月，全國公立學校系統裁減了26萬4200員工，如今約剩787萬人。 反對增稅資助教育的人認為，即使是教育經費現在比十年前高出許多，學生的成績也並沒有進步。 全國小學和初中今年的經費預計為5180億元，不包括學校的基本建設和償債利息，每個學生平均約1萬434元。而十年前，全國中、小學的經費是4570億元，學生人均9480元。反對者主張，在撥出教育資助前，應對公立學校進行根本改革。 自2008年以來，亚利桑那州每個學生的教育支出減少近22%，降幅全國最大。本州每元徵收一分錢的銷售稅政策定明年到期，州府準備把這項政策永久化，一年約可籌到10億元教育資金。
db0aebff16f2ed8dd92976cb7d345743243c98f9.translatedText: Education tax increase This state will vote on a referendum (Alberta Times) Arizona and four other states will vote on the 6th whether to increase taxes in order to continue to fund public schools. How government-funded schools are run has sparked heated debate across the country, and votes in some states will reflect voters' underlying views on raising taxes on education. The state, along with Missouri and South Dakota, put tax increases up to voters, California offered voters two options, and Oregon used corporate tax rebates as part of the money it allocates to schools. The National Association of State Legislatures said five states will vote on education tax increases, the most in state elections in the past 20 years. To cover budget deficits, many states have cut funding for schools. Nationwide, the funding received by primary and junior high schools this year on a per-pupil basis is still less than the 2008 level in 35 states. Affected by the shortage of funds, school districts have been forced to take measures such as layoffs, halting some teaching plans, and some even switching to four days a week. From September 2008 to September 2012, public school systems across the country laid off 264,200 employees, leaving about 7.87 million employees today. Opponents of raising taxes to fund education argue that student achievement has not improved even though education funding is now much higher than it was a decade ago. Funding for primary and junior high schools across the country this year is expected to be 518 billion yuan, excluding school infrastructure and debt repayment interest, which averages about 10,434 yuan per student. Ten years ago, the funding for primary and secondary schools across the country was 457 billion yuan, with an average per student of 9,480 yuan. Opponents argue that public schools should undergo fundamental reforms before funding for education is set aside. Since 2008, Arizona’s per-pupil education spending has dropped nearly 22%, the largest decline in the nation. The state's one-cent-per-dollar sales tax policy is set to expire next year. The state government is preparing to make this policy permanent, which can raise about 1 billion yuan in education funds a year.

8574f86e6cbc8fb74bbdaa638ad4f75c9cdc4aec.sourceText: 我心目中的耆英会 杨济群 斐匿华人耆英会是什么？我常在问自己，是家？是朋友相聚的地方？是老人的俱乐部？我想，应该是，而又不完全是，它在我心目中是一个充满乐趣，能广交朋友，能帮助你解决刚到美国后所面临的问题的地方，因此，它是一个遵行规范，充满仁慈，人性，使老人们获得欢乐和生活稳定的团体，耆英会和耆英中心的工作人员付出100%的爱心帮助每一个遇到困难的人，她（他）们将对工作的责任心和对老年朋友的爱心洒向每一个人，大家都喜欢拥有这样一批工作人员的耆英会和耆英中心，爱护它，依靠它。 华人耆英会每天聚集了一批六十岁以上的老人，他（她）们98%以上是炎黄子孙，华夏儿女，有久居美国的老侨同胞，更多的是初来的新移民，她（他）们来自不同的国度，不同地域，但，有一个共同的特点，就是他（她）们的子女都称得上是”精英”，在耆英会大家戏称”咱们都是精英的妈和爸”。这些老人的孩子们在美国的各个岗位上，各种不同的职业中勤奋工作，他（她）们中有法官，律师，教师，餐饮业人员，有医生，有工程师．．．．．等等。在这一大批忙碌工作的孩子们面前，都面临着一个非常现实的问题，那就是对自己年老父母生活起居的安排，父母长期禁锢在大宅院里，不与外界接触，生活乏味，房子再大，陈设再讲究，都代替不了父母的精神寄托和所响往，一些老人来到后不久便萌生了回国的想法，我自己就曾有过这样的经历，想回大陆，想回北京，正当这时，一次偶然的相遇，使我知道凤城还有一个华人耆英会，从而我继续在美国留了下来，至今已有十七年，事情是这样，我们当时最为恼火的是没有医疗保险，很发愁，一天早晨散步到离家不远的湖边，迎面走来一个老先生，他用纯正的普通话向我们问好，相识之下，我们才知道他就是原耆英会英文书记王阔扑先生，当他得知我们整天关在家，无聊之极的时候，他建议我们去耆英会看看，第二天我们便来到华人聚集的地方－华人耆英中心，进门便看到这里呈现的一片快乐景象，有的在打麻将，有的打乒乓球，下象棋，打计算机，跳舞的，唱歌的，作健身运动的，作精美手工的．．．．．等等，人们根据自己不同的爱好进行着各种活动，最吸引我的是教室里传来的啷啷英语声，只见教英语课的高久致（Ｇeorge T Cole）正在大声地教授英语，他一边讲解，一边摆出各种姿式，时而用手指向前方，时而用脚蹬几下，忽而高声，忽而细语，手舞足蹈，教课中寓于娱乐，他幽默，生动而活泼的教课方法，使学生们（老人们）都在欢乐的气氛中学到英语，看到这一切，我高兴极了，对老伴说”有这样的地方，我们还回北京吗？”不去了，接着我们又认识了耆英中心的主任裴霞云女士和经理黄淑莲女士，她们给我俩老的帮助就更多了，由于裴主任的指引，我们解决了医疗保险的问题，还介绍我们住进了老人公寓，我们有了自己的?#31389;?#65292;生活安定了，我们的孩子们因而也安下心来，对我们放了心，一家人都非常感谢耆英会，从此，我常常到耆英中心，在那里我结交了许多新朋友，在那里我能得到政府的众多照顾，在那里，我经过英语老师的认真教授，通过了美国公民的考试，在那里，我融入到众多慈祥老人的集体中，获得友情，友爱，在那里，我做义工，发挥余热，为能够给大家做点事感到莫大的愉快和安慰。 今天耆英会以新的步伐在前进，它正在建立一种”快乐耆英文化”，耆英会主席崔增祈先生提出：让老年朋友们，”笑口常开，礼貌待人，团结互助，乐善为公”，进而达到”人人关爱耆英会，同心协力发展耆英会，把耆英会办成欢乐的大家庭”。 我在古稀之年能到这样一个让精神得到舒展，心情获得愉快的地方，真是幸运。 老年朋友们，到耆英中心来吧！相信你会”笑口常开，其乐融融”！！
8574f86e6cbc8fb74bbdaa638ad4f75c9cdc4aec.translatedText: The Senior Citizens Association in My Mind Yang Jiqun What is the Feini Chinese Senior Citizens Association? I often ask myself, is it home? Is it a place where friends gather? Is it an old man's club? I think it should be, but not entirely. In my mind, it is a place full of fun, where you can make friends, and can help you solve the problems you face when you first arrive in the United States. Therefore, it is a group that abides by regulations, is full of kindness and humanity, and makes the elderly happy and stable in life. Senior Citizens The staff of the Senior Citizen Association and the Senior Citizen Center give 100% love to help everyone who encounters difficulties. They will spread their sense of responsibility for work and love for elderly friends to everyone. Everyone likes the Senior Citizen Association and the Senior Citizen Center with such a group of staff, loves it, and relies on it. The Chinese Senior Citizens Association gathers a group of elderly people over 60 years old every day. More than 98% of them (her) are descendants of the Yanhuang people, sons and daughters of China. Some are compatriots who have lived in the United States for a long time, and more are new immigrants. They come from different countries and different regions, but they have a common characteristic, that is, their children can be called "elites." Everyone in the Senior Citizens Association jokingly calls "we are all elite moms and dads." The children of these old people work diligently in various positions and in various professions in the United States. Among them are judges, lawyers, teachers, catering industry personnel, doctors, and engineers. ． ． ． ． etc. In front of this large number of busy working children, they are all faced with a very real problem, that is, the living arrangements for their elderly parents. Their parents have been confined in the big house for a long time, without contact with the outside world, and their lives are boring. No matter how big the house is, no matter how exquisite the furnishings are, they cannot replace the spiritual sustenance and affection of their parents. Some old people came up with the idea of returning to China soon after arriving. I myself had such an experience. I wanted to go back to the mainland, and I wanted to go back to Beijing. At this time, an accidental encounter made me know that there was a Chinese Senior Citizens Association in Fengcheng, so I continued to stay in the United States. It has been seventeen years now. The thing is like this, we are The most annoying thing at that time was that I didn’t have medical insurance. I was very worried. One morning, I took a walk to the lake not far from my home. An old man came towards us. He greeted us in pure Mandarin. After we got to know each other, we found out that he was Mr. Wang Kuopu, the former English Secretary of the Senior Citizens Association. When he learned that we had been locked at home all day, he was extremely bored. At that time, he suggested that we go to the Senior Citizens Association. The next day we went to the Chinese Senior Citizens Center, a place where Chinese people gather. When we entered the door, we saw a happy scene here. Some were playing mahjong, some playing table tennis, chess, computers, dancing, singing, doing fitness exercises, and doing exquisite handicrafts. ． ． ． ． Wait, people are doing various activities according to their different hobbies. What attracts me most is the sound of English speaking in the classroom. I see George T. Gao, who teaches English class. Cole is teaching English loudly. While explaining, he makes various postures, sometimes points forward with his fingers, sometimes kicks with his feet, sometimes loudly, sometimes whispers, and dances. His teaching is filled with entertainment. His humorous, lively and lively teaching methods enable the students (elderly people) to learn in a happy atmosphere. I went to English and saw all this. I was so happy that I said to my wife, "If there is such a place, should we go back to Beijing?" Instead of going, we met the director of the Senior Citizen Center, Ms. Pei Xiayun, and the manager, Ms. Huang Shulian. They gave us more help. Thanks to Director Pei's guidance, we solved the problem of medical insurance. They also introduced us to live in an apartment for the elderly, and we had our own stable life. Our children also settled down and felt relieved about us. The whole family was very grateful to the Senior Citizen Association. From then on, I often went to the Senior Citizen Center, where I made many new friends. There I was able to receive a lot of care from the government. There, I passed the U.S. citizenship test through careful teaching by English teachers. There, I integrated into a group of many kind-hearted elderly people and gained friendship and love. There, I worked as a volunteer and used my spare energy. I felt great pleasure and comfort in being able to do something for everyone. Today, the Senior Citizen Association is moving forward at a new pace. It is building a "happy senior citizen culture." Mr. Cui Zengqi, chairman of the Senior Citizen Association, proposed: Let the elderly friends "smile often, be polite to others, unite and help each other, and be charitable to the public", so as to achieve the goal of "everyone cares about the Senior Citizen Association, works together to develop the Senior Citizen Association, and turns the Senior Citizen Association into a happy family." I am so lucky to be able to go to such a place where my spirit can be relaxed and my mood can be happy in my seventies. Senior friends, come to the Senior Citizens Center! I believe you will be "smiling and having fun"! !

22ba5716b31fcee8ccedcbdade31a96f3a39ca18.translatedText: Yang Wentian declares: Legal action has been taken against those who spread rumors and framers I, Yang Wentian, was entrusted by the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles to assist two consuls at the COFCO Chinese Cultural Center in Phoenix from the 17th to 18th of this month to handle the renewal and reissue of Chinese passports.

e96646aeeeb2d11030d06ee807ecd29547c2785c.sourceText: 本人杨文田，受中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆的委托，于本月17－18日在凤凰城中粮中国文化中心协助两位领事受理中国护照换发和补发事宜。17日11时，有人利用本人家庭内部纠纷，收买并押持了我的一位神智不清95岁高龄的亲戚，用轮椅推到办证现场挂牌闹事。严重影响了正常办证的秩序。随后，本人即向凤凰城警察局报案，警察已经受理此案。 11月21日，有人又在亚省某报纸刊登了所谓的读者来稿，公然损坏本人名誉以达到其不可告人的目的。我在此特作严正声明：美国是一个法治社会，如果我杨文田做了违法的事情，他们可以拿出证据到法院告我，相信美国法律会做出公正的判决。他们这种对我进行诬蔑、诽谤和人身攻击的行为已经造成了极其恶劣的社会影响和对我个人及家庭的伤害。他们的行为已经触犯了法律，我对造谣诬陷者已经采取了法律行动，请求法院追究其法律责任。
e96646aeeeb2d11030d06ee807ecd29547c2785c.translatedText: At 11 o'clock on the 17th, someone took advantage of an internal dispute in my family to bribe and hold a 95-year-old relative of mine who was unconscious and held him in custody. He pushed him in a wheelchair to the permit application site and caused trouble. It seriously affected the normal order of issuing certificates. Subsequently, I reported the case to the Phoenix Police Department, and the police accepted the case. On November 21, someone published a so-called reader submission in a newspaper in Alberta, openly damaging his reputation to achieve his ulterior motives. I hereby make a solemn statement: The United States is a society governed by the rule of law. If I, Yang Wentian, do something illegal, they can bring evidence to the court to sue me. I believe that American law will make a fair judgment. Their behavior of slandering, slandering and personally attacking me has caused extremely bad social impact and harm to me personally and my family. Their actions have violated the law. I have taken legal action against those who spread rumors and framed them and requested the court to hold them legally accountable.

d7a695885c7c5f51e6d0fc6771dcaa8699cd80e3.sourceText: 1 我是理工科毕业的研究生﹐ 十二个月的OPT 快要用完﹐ 我想再申请17 个月的OPT﹐ 需要如何办理﹖ 答﹕ 以下几点要特别注意﹕ A: 必须是在原有到期日期之前提出申请﹐ 在到期日后才提出申请者将不会被批准 B﹕申请人必须完成取得该学位的所有要求。 C: 在I-765申请表的第17栏必须上申请人所取得学位的CIP Code, 公司在E-verify 註册的名称﹐ 及公司E-verify的ID, 这个ID不是公司的报税号码﹐ E-verify 的号码只有五或六个数字 D﹕ 附上现有未过期的EAD 影本 E﹕ 附上I-94 小白卡影本。 F: 附上SEVIS I-20 COPY I-20 page 1-page 2 要有国际学生办公室人员的签名﹐ 同时申请人也要在第一页签名﹐ 这些签名必须在30 天内完成的 G. 在I-765表格第16栏填上 C3C H: 附上毕业证书影本﹐ 要确定延期的开始工作日是在 OPT旧有的工作日到期之后一天不能有间隔
d7a695885c7c5f51e6d0fc6771dcaa8699cd80e3.translatedText: 1 I am a graduate student in science and engineering. My 12-month OPT is about to be used up. I want to apply for another 17-month OPT. How should I apply? Answer: Special attention should be paid to the following points: A: The application must be submitted before the original expiration date. Applicants who submit the application after the expiration date will not be approved. B: Applicants must complete all requirements for obtaining the degree. C: Column 17 of the I-765 application form must include the CIP Code of the degree obtained by the applicant, the name of the company registered in E-verify, and the company's E-verify ID. This ID is not the company's tax return number, and the E-verify number only has five or six digits. D: Attach a copy of the existing unexpired EAD. E: Attach a copy of the I-94 white card. F: Attach SEVIS I-20 COPY I-20 page 1-page 2. It must have the signature of the International Student Office staff. At the same time, the applicant must also sign on the first page. These signatures must be completed within 30 days. G. Fill in C3C in column 16 of the I-765 form. H: Attach a copy of the graduation certificate. Make sure the starting day of the extension is on. There cannot be a gap of one day after the old working day of OPT expires

915899aa73c0ff364700d5d41c39709771439f19.sourceText: 2. 我的房东不肯把我的security deposit还我，因為他说我并没有在30天前就通知他，请问这合理吗？ 答：是的，若你在搬家之前30天，没有通知房东，房东会以為你要继续以每个月来租房子，因此你突然搬了家未通知房东，他无法在充足的时间内找房客，这一个月的security deposit 是可以被他没收的。
915899aa73c0ff364700d5d41c39709771439f19.translatedText: 2. My landlord refuses to return my security deposit to me because he said that I did not notify him 30 days in advance. Is this reasonable? Answer: Yes, if you do not notify the landlord 30 days before moving, the landlord will think that you will continue to rent the house every month. Therefore, if you suddenly move without notifying the landlord, he will not be able to find a tenant in sufficient time, and the security deposit for this month can be confiscated by him.

350110772d0666b3edb8e0573e440a40c14ff21a.sourceText: 银行不保险 华裔：向谁求偿？ 银行保险箱遇劫并不常见，劫匪这次凿破华美银行屋顶、垂降下地偷窃客户保险箱财物，有华裔损失10余万现金，如哑巴吃黄连，有苦难言。图为蒙面劫匪抢劫银行保险箱，把银行行员捆绑在地上的模拟照，并非华美银行案的情节。 slideshow 「蜘蛛大盗」打破银行屋顶、从天而降洗劫华美银行客户保险箱，银行与受害人损失惨重。糟糕的是，「保险公司原则上不承保银行客户保险箱」，理赔「师出无名」。据悉，此次不幸事件中有受害的华裔顾客损失10余万现金，可能求偿无门，欲哭无泪。 家住东区的华裔民众，存在华美银行罗兰冈分行保险箱中10余万元现金，因此次银行保险箱被盗不翼而飞。这些现金包括自己多年生意上的积蓄，部分是台湾和大陆的家人托管，部分则是家中老人准备留给几个孙子的遗产，因故没有存入银行账户，又担心放家中不安全，所以在银行租保险箱，但「万万没有想到银行保险箱同样不保险」。 代理多家大型保险公司的资深保险经纪林戴维表示，银行客户存款通常是由FDIC承保和理赔；但九成以上保险公司并不承保银行保险箱，理由是保险公司难以监控银行提供给民众的保险箱内投保物品的价值。换言之，一旦银行保险箱被盗，民众通常不会得到保险公司赔偿。至于银行本身是否为客户设保险（self-insurance），则视不同银行而定。 林戴维表示，民众贵重财物保险，最常见通过屋主自住房屋财物保险（HO3）承保，包括抢劫、盗窃、火灾、风灾甚至民众在海外损失的个人物品，均在承保范围。如果民众购买的是较便宜的DP3房屋险，通常只赔偿火灾和其他自然灾害损失，抢劫、盗窃及外出损失就难以得到赔偿。 不过林戴维表示，任何种类的房屋保险都有一定理赔上限，并非所有物品都可以得到100%赔偿。 资深保险经纪史振发表示，房屋财物保险赔付额通常比民众想象低。比如珠宝首饰类，包括黄金、钻石、珠宝、手表、皮草等，赔付额通常5000元至1万元；贵重骨董赔付额数千至1万元不等；枪支500元至5000元不等；商用办公用品2000元至2万元不等；贵重文件包括股票、证券、信用卡等1000元至5000元不等。现金的赔付额最低，通常为200元至1000元不等。 保险业者表示，最近一、两年，圣盖博谷房屋财产保险理赔申诉案急剧飙升，创十多年新纪录，包括华裔聚居的亚凯迪亚、罗兰冈、哈冈、北岭、波特牧场等地区，入室盗窃损失理赔案大幅成长，歹徒猖狂到光天化日下闯空门，或大张旗鼓有计划在居民区「守株待兔」。 北岭一户华裔人家不久前被歹徒闯空门，主人刚出门20分钟，回到家中所有贵重物品已被洗劫一空。在罗兰冈拥有餐馆的一名华裔老板，存放家中后院地下的40万元现金最近也不翼而飞，家中雇用多年的墨裔清洁工从此人间蒸发。 即使将贵重物品存放银行，也防不胜防。律师邓洪表示，他近年代理多起案件，均为银行内贼作案，包括员工偷窃经理人员的保险柜钥匙、司机偷盗客户财物。而银行财大气粗，也往往成为歹徒下手目标，使银行保险箱「保险系数愈来愈低」。 由于目前法律并无规定银行必须提供保险箱保险，邓洪建议，民众最好分散风险，不要将所有贵重物品存放同一家银行的保险箱；在将贵重物品存放银行保险箱前，最好问清银行承保政策，比如银行是否保证赔偿、最高赔付额度；民众也需做好贵重物品的登记，比如现金、珠宝、首饰等逐一登记存档，护照、出生证等也需复印，一旦意外发生，理赔追索更能「有据可争」。
350110772d0666b3edb8e0573e440a40c14ff21a.translatedText: Banks do not insure Chinese Americans: Who can they ask for compensation? It is not common for bank safes to be robbed. This time, the robbers broke through the roof of East West Bank and rappelled down to steal the contents of customers' safes. One Chinese American lost more than 100,000 in cash. It was like a mute eating coptis, and it was so painful. The picture shows a simulation of masked robbers robbing a bank safe and tying the bank clerk to the ground. It is not the plot of the East West Bank case. slideshow The "Spider Thief" broke through the bank roof, descended from the sky and robbed East West Bank customer safes. The bank and the victims suffered heavy losses. What’s worse is that “in principle, insurance companies do not cover safe deposit boxes of bank customers,” and the claims are “out of nowhere.” It is reported that the Chinese customer who was injured in this unfortunate incident lost more than 100,000 in cash and may have no way to seek compensation and is crying without tears. Chinese people living in the East District had more than 100,000 yuan in cash stored in a safe at the Rowland Heights branch of East West Bank, but the bank safe was stolen and disappeared. The cash included my savings from many years of business, part of which was entrusted to my family in Taiwan and Mainland China, and part of which was an inheritance that the elderly at home planned to leave to my grandchildren. For some reason, I did not deposit it in a bank account, and I was worried that it would be unsafe to leave it at home, so I rented a safe in a bank. However, "I never expected that bank safes are also not safe." David Lin, a senior insurance broker who represents many large insurance companies, said that bank customer deposits are usually insured and claimed by the FDIC; however, more than 90% of insurance companies do not insure bank safes because it is difficult for insurance companies to monitor the value of insured items in safes provided by banks to the public. In other words, once a bank safe is stolen, people usually will not be compensated by the insurance company. As for whether the bank itself provides insurance for customers (self-insurance), it depends on different banks. David Lin said that people’s valuable property insurance is most commonly insured through homeowner’s property insurance (HO3), which covers robbery, theft, fire, wind damage and even personal belongings lost overseas. If people buy the cheaper DP3 house insurance, it usually only compensates for fire and other natural disaster losses. Robbery, theft and outing losses are difficult to be compensated. However, David Lin said that any type of home insurance has a certain claim limit, and not all items can be 100% compensated. Senior insurance broker Shi Zhenfa said that house contents insurance compensation amounts are usually lower than people think. For example, for jewelry, including gold, diamonds, jewelry, watches, furs, etc., the compensation amount is usually 5,000 to 10,000 yuan; for valuable antiques, the compensation amount ranges from several thousand to 10,000 yuan; for firearms, it ranges from 500 yuan to 5,000 yuan; for commercial office supplies, it ranges from 2,000 yuan to 20,000 yuan; and for valuable documents, including stocks, securities, credit cards, etc., it ranges from 1,000 yuan to 5,000 yuan. Cash compensation has the lowest amount, usually ranging from 200 yuan to 1,000 yuan. Insurers said that in the past one or two years, the number of home insurance claims in the San Gabriel Valley has soared, setting a new record in more than ten years. In areas such as Arcadia, Rowland Heights, Haggang, Northridge, and Porter Ranch where Chinese Americans are concentrated, the number of burglary claims has increased significantly. The gangsters are so rampant that they break into empty doors in broad daylight, or they have plans to "wait and wait" in residential areas with great fanfare. A Chinese home in Beiling was broken into by gangsters not long ago. The owner had just gone out for 20 minutes, and all his valuables had been looted when he returned home. A Chinese owner of a restaurant in Rowland Heights recently lost $400,000 in cash stored in the basement of his home, and the Mexican cleaner who had been employed by his family for many years disappeared. Even if you store your valuables in a bank, they are still vulnerable. Lawyer Deng Hong said that he has represented many cases in recent years, all of which were committed by bank thieves, including employees stealing managers' safe keys and drivers stealing customers' belongings. Banks with deep pockets often become targets of gangsters, making bank safes "less and less safe." Since the current law does not require banks to provide safe deposit box insurance, Deng Hong suggested that people should diversify risks and not store all valuables in the safe of the same bank. Before storing valuables in a bank safe, it is best to ask the bank's insurance policy, such as whether the bank guarantees compensation and the maximum amount of compensation. People also need to register valuables, such as cash, jewelry, jewelry, etc., one by one, and copy passports, birth certificates, etc., so that if an accident occurs, claims can be more "arguable."

847de2fe73db1e4dcbf3c8cf388cc21d452f08cd.translatedText: A list released by the Social Security Administration on the 14th showed that the more traditional Sophia was the most popular name for baby girls, while Jacob has topped the list of baby boy names for 13 consecutive years.

3f7442aa3f18b7d0489f03eb2e6bd78daf7a8bec.sourceText: 身为电视真人实境节目明星的卡达夏，怀孕期间受到广泛报导，2009年12月生下梅森，导致2010年「梅森」从34名跃居12名。 去年在美国出生的男婴，有1万9393人命名为梅森。 男婴最流行的五个名字还包括威廉、杰登(Jayden)和诺亚(Noah)。 麦可(Michael)排名第六，创下这个名字自1948年以来最低的排名。 连续两年高居女婴名字榜首的伊莎贝拉(Isabella)，去年降为第二名。 女婴最流行的五个名字还包括爱玛(Emma)、奥莉薇亚(Olivia)和爱娃(Eva)。 社安署网站列有从1880年以来美国男女婴最流行的1000个名字，那一年最流行的是约翰和玛丽。 约翰现在排名27，玛丽更跌到112名。 女婴流行的名字波动较大，经常每年变动，男婴名字则比较稳定。 例如，威廉有100多年一直是男婴流行的名字，从来没有落在前20名之后。 苏菲亚在1997年才进入女婴流行名字前100名，伊莎贝拉从1949年到1990年一直没有进入前100名。 社安署也追踪哪些名字日益流行，哪些逐渐退烧。 女婴目前红得最快的名字是布瑞雅(Briella)，一举跃升394名，目前排名497。 男婴名字跃升最快的是布兰特利(Brantley)，前进416名，目前排名320。 奥巴马总统的名字巴拉克(Barack)，以及共和党总统人选罗穆尼的名字密特(Mitt)，都从来没有上榜。
3f7442aa3f18b7d0489f03eb2e6bd78daf7a8bec.translatedText: As a reality TV star, Kadasha's pregnancy was widely reported. She gave birth to Mason in December 2009, causing "Mason" to jump from 34th to 12th in 2010. Last year, 19,393 boys were named Mason in the United States. The top five most popular names for baby boys also include William, Jayden and Noah. Michael ranked sixth, the lowest ranking for this name since 1948. Isabella, which topped the list of baby girl names for two consecutive years, dropped to second place last year. The top five most popular names for baby girls also include Emma, ​​Olivia and Eva. The Social Security Administration website lists the 1,000 most popular names for boys and girls in the United States since 1880. The most popular names that year were John and Mary. John is now ranked 27th, and Mary has dropped to 112th. Popular names for baby girls fluctuate greatly, often changing from year to year, while baby boy names are more stable. For example, William has been a popular name for baby boys for over 100 years, never falling behind the top 20. Sophia only entered the top 100 popular names for baby girls in 1997, and Isabella remained outside the top 100 from 1949 to 1990. The Social Security Administration also tracks which names are growing in popularity and which are fading. The fastest popular name for baby girls is Briella, which jumped 394 places and is currently ranked 497th. The fastest-growing name for baby boys is Brantley, which advanced 416 places and currently ranks 320th. President Obama's first name, Barack, and Republican presidential candidate Romney's first name, Mitt, have never made the list.

Real estate in some big cities has entered a boom period again, with competition in places such as San Francisco and New York...

737b35650b8aa5675e101ea716f654ce11f1f623.sourceText: 部分大城市房地产又进入繁荣期，旧金山和纽约等地出现竞价战，因此有人质疑房地产市场不是复苏的问题，而是会否出现新泡沫。但是现实的另一面却对全国经济更重要：多数地方房市仍在拖累经济。
737b35650b8aa5675e101ea716f654ce11f1f623.translatedText: Real estate in some big cities has entered a boom period again, with bidding wars occurring in places such as San Francisco and New York. Therefore, some people question whether the real estate market is not about recovery, but whether a new bubble will appear. But the other side of reality is more important to the national economy: the housing market is still a drag on the economy in most places.

1b3e4d0b87b42b77d27964f8e5d3470439514554.sourceText: 住宅投资所占经济的比例仍然低于二次世界大战以来的任何时期，对经济增长的贡献低于1990年代初数百家抵押贷款机构倒闭潮时期，甚至低于1980年代初期的下滑，当时抵押贷款利率高达20%。
1b3e4d0b87b42b77d27964f8e5d3470439514554.translatedText: Residential investment remains lower as a share of the economy than at any time since World War II, and contributes less to economic growth than during the wave of hundreds of mortgage lender failures in the early 1990s, and even lower than the decline of the early 1980s, when mortgage rates topped 20%.

145b7f9d3380a28b2d2b0dd752427d4abc1fdc3b.sourceText: 5月8日上午10时，慈济凤凰城联络处上百人参加了浴佛仪式，同庆”慈济佛诞日，母亲节，全球慈济日”。 「供灯烛、香汤、供花香」司仪声音宏量引导，慈济的两位师姐向大德们演示了浴佛的基本程序。合掌，90度鞠躬，收沾智慧水，合掌起身，90度鞠躬，手触花香，合掌起身。 前来参加浴佛活动的人有上至七八十岁的老人，下至七八岁的小朋友，大家整齐地排列在静思堂。大众以整齐划一的动作，以清净心供灯烛、香汤、供花香礼敬诸佛，虔诚合掌仰天祝祷，祈愿天下无灾无难，人心净化祥和。
145b7f9d3380a28b2d2b0dd752427d4abc1fdc3b.translatedText: At 10 a.m. on May 8, hundreds of people from the Tzu Chi Phoenix City Liaison Office participated in the Buddha Bathing Ceremony to celebrate "Tzu Chi Buddha's Birthday, Mother's Day, and Global Tzu Chi Day." "Offer lamps, candles, incense soup, and offer flowers and incense," the emcee's voice guided the ceremony. Two senior sisters from Tzu Chi demonstrated the basic procedures for bathing the Buddha to the great masters. Put your palms together, bow at 90 degrees, dip your hands in the water of wisdom, stand up with your palms together, bow at 90 degrees, touch the fragrance of flowers with your hands, and stand up with your palms together. People who came to participate in the Buddha Bathing activity ranged from elderly people in their 70s and 80s to children as young as 78. They all lined up neatly in the Jingsi Hall. With uniform movements, the public offered lamps, candles, incense soup, and flower incense to pay homage to the Buddhas with a pure heart. They clasped their hands together and raised their heads to the sky to pray, hoping that the world would be free from disasters and that people's hearts would be purified and peaceful.

a5f8efdb762e2561ee134a462da96c7980005044.sourceText: 浴佛身，净自心，庄严的浴佛大典，优雅的歌声中，慢慢接近尾声。佛诞日，母亲节，全球慈济日，”三节”同庆，会众都获得慈济准备的水果和点心，将节日的心情带回家。
a5f8efdb762e2561ee134a462da96c7980005044.translatedText: Bath the Buddha body and purify your mind. The solemn Buddha bathing ceremony slowly comes to an end amid elegant singing. Buddha’s Birthday, Mother’s Day, and Global Tzu Chi Day were celebrated together. The congregation received fruits and snacks prepared by Tzu Chi to take the festive mood home with them.

049194b17f808f4ba14bfd256f9c9b8186ee1f96.sourceText: 走进圆明园和颐和园，和 10 年前来到这里一样，没有看到什么变化。寛阔的圆明园里空荡荡的，人们在清澈的湖水和绿树丛中漫步，我似乎看到那雄伟的宫殿，宫廷楼阁在空中时隐时现，但那只是幻觉。最后直接流入眼帘的还是西洋楼的那东倒西歪的石柱和断壁残垣。颐和园的万寿山和湖边的石舫虽然保持得十分完整，想到是慈禧太后挪用发展海军的国防经费建起这一座自己享乐的花园，一阵无名的不悦涌上心头。这两座位于北京西郊的公园留给后人的是中国国耻的记录。
049194b17f808f4ba14bfd256f9c9b8186ee1f96.translatedText: When I walked into the Old Summer Palace and the Summer Palace, I saw the same as when I came here 10 years ago. I didn’t see much change. The vast Old Summer Palace was empty, and people were walking among the clear lakes and green trees. I seemed to see the majestic palace, with its pavilions disappearing and appearing in the air, but that was just an illusion. The last thing that came directly into view was the swaying stone pillars and broken walls of the Western-style building. Although the Wanshou Mountain in the Summer Palace and the stone boats by the lake were kept intact, a senseless displeasure surged into my heart when I thought that Empress Dowager Cixi had misappropriated the defense funds for the development of the navy to build this garden for her own enjoyment. These two parks located in the western suburbs of Beijing have left to future generations a record of China’s national humiliation.

df0d4c9210bb8d6b8f2aef08daa4434b99612b3a.sourceText: 脑海中浮现出中国一百多年前的苦难历史。一个泱泱中华帝国从盛唐时期的各国百官朝贡，发展到清末洋人用洋枪洋炮打进京城，大肆掠夺国宝文物，金银财宝，烧毁了皇室宫殿，签订了丧权辱国的卖国条约，还要割地赔款，赔赏金额居然以四万万五千万同胞每人一两计算，要让每一个中国人记住这个屈辱。中国发生的这一切都因为长期闭关锁国，朝廷的昏庸及百姓的无知和贪婪所致。我加上百姓的无知和贪婪是指义和团一伙一味反对洋人，杀洋人烧教堂的不理智行为，和在英法联军抢劫和火烧圆明园之后，部分中国人贪小便宜进行的二次扫荡。遗憾的是，这样的无知和贪婪的習气在部分中国人的血脉里至今依然留存。
df0d4c9210bb8d6b8f2aef08daa4434b99612b3a.translatedText: The painful history of China more than a hundred years ago came to mind. A huge Chinese empire has developed from hundreds of officials from various countries paying tribute during the Tang Dynasty to the late Qing Dynasty when foreigners invaded the capital with foreign guns and cannons, plundered national treasures, cultural relics, gold and silver treasures, burned down the royal palaces, signed treasonous treaties that humiliated the country, and had to cede territory and pay compensation. The amount of compensation was actually calculated at one or two taels for each of the 450 million compatriots. Every Chinese must remember this humiliation. All of what happened in China was caused by the long-term isolation of the country, the stupidity of the imperial court, and the ignorance and greed of the people. I added the ignorance and greed of the people to refer to the irrational behavior of the Boxers who blindly opposed foreigners and killed foreigners and burned churches, and the secondary raids carried out by some Chinese people who were greedy for petty gains after the British and French allied forces robbed and burned the Old Summer Palace. Unfortunately, such ignorance and greedy habits still exist in the blood of some Chinese people.

bdffe1b4ddf26fa865e17af2eb38cf62a5b245cf.sourceText: 外国的入侵，使中国人民从睡梦中开始觉醒。康梁维新改革派的出现，继而孙中山先生领导革命推翻了满清政府。一百多年来，多少仁人志士为了中国的独立，民主和自由，抛头颅，撒热血；多少人为了中华民族的复兴，努力献身国家的建设和科学发展事业。应该说，当 1945 年中国取得抗日战争伟大胜利的时候，已雪去了大部分国耻，中国已恢复和确立了在国际间的大国地位。世界列强对中国的一切不平等条约被废止。 1945 年联合国成立之初，中国和美英苏法并列为联合国的常任理事国。只可惜我们当时还不够强大，加上内部不团结，把一大片本属中国的为外蒙古的土地从战胜国分裂出去。之后，两岸在分割状态下各自寻求发展，台湾曾取得亚洲经济四小龙的桂冠，而大陆在改革开放以来，迎来了连续 30 年的经济高速发展。香港澳门两块租借地也先后归还中国，一雪百年前的国耻。今天的中国已经成为全球第二大经济体，中国在全球事务中起着举足轻重的地位，中国发生了翻天覆地的变化。从整个发展历史来看，曾作为这个时代的国家领导人，蒋介石和毛泽东，邓小平都是有功劳的，在中国历史前进的过程中他们是推动者。尽管各自的执政过程中，都出现过一些错误，有的甚至是很大的错误，给人民带来极大伤害。但他们在维护民族独立，发展和提高国家实了，改善民众生活方面都作出了贡献。否则，也不会有中国的今天。
bdffe1b4ddf26fa865e17af2eb38cf62a5b245cf.translatedText: Foreign invasion has awakened the Chinese people from their sleep. The emergence of the Kangliang Reform Party, and then Mr. Sun Yat-sen led the revolution to overthrow the Manchu government. Over the past 100 years, how many people with lofty ideals have sacrificed their lives and blood for China's independence, democracy and freedom; how many people have devoted themselves to national construction and scientific development for the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. It should be said that when China achieved great victory in the Anti-Japanese War in 1945, most of its national humiliation had been averted, and China had restored and established its status as a great power in the world. All unequal treaties between world powers against China were abolished. When the United Nations was founded in 1945, China, the United States, Britain, the Soviet Union, and France were permanent members of the United Nations. It's a pity that we were not strong enough at the time, and coupled with internal disunity, a large piece of land that belonged to China and was called Outer Mongolia was separated from the victorious country. After that, the two sides of the Taiwan Strait each sought development in a state of separation. Taiwan once achieved the crown of the Four Asian Economic Tigers, while the mainland ushered in 30 consecutive years of rapid economic development since the reform and opening up. The two leased areas of Hong Kong and Macau were also returned to China one after another, averting the national humiliation of a hundred years ago. Today, China has become the world's second largest economy. China plays a pivotal role in global affairs. China has undergone earth-shaking changes. From the perspective of the entire history of development, as national leaders of this era, Chiang Kai-shek, Mao Zedong, and Deng Xiaoping all made contributions, and they were promoters in the advancement of Chinese history. Although some mistakes were made during their respective administrations, some were even big mistakes, which caused great harm to the people. But they have made contributions in safeguarding national independence, developing and improving the country's reality, and improving people's lives. Otherwise, China would not be where it is today.

1ef9b7fc7ec513cde69154eccff8b5181e922b25.sourceText: 正在我写稿之际，电视中传来了两岸领导人在新加坡会面的消息。昔日互称为”匪”的双方，今日互称”先生”握手言和，共进晚餐。天下华人无不拍手称快。我觉得这就像一个家庭里的兄弟俩，吵架的时候互不相让，骂来骂去，到头来还是一家人。其实我们抛开那遥远的主义，两岸领导人提出的纲领都是围绕振兴中华民族这个目标，都围绕着孙中山先生提出的民族，民权，民生方面作出努力。作为中华儿女，我为这相隔 66 年的两岸领导人的握手和会见交谈感到无比兴奋和激动。虽然两岸统一还有漫长的路要走，但和平的基石已经铺垫好。家和万事兴，中华民族将以这次握手为契机，共同走向更加繁荣富强。实现百年强国梦的理想更加现实和贴近了。
1ef9b7fc7ec513cde69154eccff8b5181e922b25.translatedText: As I was writing this article, news came on TV that leaders from both sides of the Taiwan Strait were meeting in Singapore. The two sides who used to call each other "bandits" now call each other "sir" and shake hands to make peace and have dinner together. All Chinese people in the world clapped their hands and cheered. I think it's like two brothers in a family. They don't give in to each other when they quarrel, and they curse each other, but in the end they are still a family. In fact, let's put aside those distant doctrines. The programs proposed by the leaders on both sides of the Taiwan Strait all focus on the goal of revitalizing the Chinese nation, and they all focus on the efforts of the nation, civil rights, and people's livelihood proposed by Dr. Sun Yat-sen. As a son and daughter of China, I feel extremely excited and excited about the handshakes and meetings and conversations between the leaders of the two sides of the Taiwan Strait after 66 years. Although cross-strait reunification still has a long way to go, the cornerstone of peace has been laid. When the family is united and everything prospers, the Chinese nation will take this handshake as an opportunity to work together toward greater prosperity. The ideal of realizing the century-old dream of a powerful country has become more realistic and closer.

52664bd5cfd1c166a74ae139c6d1d9c7ce3e1487.sourceText: 中国人对窝里斗都十分反感，但凡有中国人的地方总存在着这样那样的不协调。从两岸领导人握手联想到本地华人华侨的状况。侨领们如果也能以習马会为榜样，把侨胞利益放在首位，形成共同为侨胞服务的共识，相互多一点尊重对方，寻求更多共同合作活动的机会，也将是侨社的幸事。必要时，也可以先开启”汪辜会谈”。可不可以先从国庆共同升国旗做起。
52664bd5cfd1c166a74ae139c6d1d9c7ce3e1487.translatedText: Chinese people are very disgusted with fighting among themselves. Wherever there are Chinese people, there are always incongruities of one kind or another. From the handshake of leaders on both sides of the Taiwan Strait, we can think of the situation of the local Chinese and overseas Chinese. If the overseas Chinese leaders can follow the example of the Xi Jinping Club, put the interests of overseas Chinese first, form a consensus to jointly serve the overseas Chinese, respect each other more, and seek more opportunities for joint cooperation activities, it will also be a blessing for the overseas Chinese community. If necessary, the "Wang-Ku Talks" can also be started first. Can we start by raising the national flag together on National Day?

0c983b8130b9ecf8039c38624ce2a3adb39219b5.sourceText: 有人曾建议修复圆明园，重现昔日皇室的风光，也证明我们国力之富强。我觉得重修不如保留现状。命名国耻园。让我们的子孙莫忘国耻，永远不要忘记”落后就要挨打””有国才有家”的道理。也可以组织那些贪官们去看看，如果习近平再不把他们抓起来的话，中国又会沦落成什么样子？
0c983b8130b9ecf8039c38624ce2a3adb39219b5.translatedText: Some people have suggested restoring the Old Summer Palace to recreate the royal splendor of the past, which also proves the prosperity of our country. I think it is better to keep the status quo than to rebuild. Named the Garden of National Humiliation. Let our descendants never forget the national humiliation, and never forget the truth that "if you fall behind, you will be beaten" and "only when you have a country can you have a family." You can also organize those corrupt officials to see what China will be like if Xi Jinping doesn't arrest them again.
