0b2b74455686f52bfc9ecfa27a4b682f9bbb2a93.sourceText: 无证件移民合法化也很难脱贫 支持移民改革者一再声称，让1100万无证移民入籍，将可使他们脱离经济上的阴影。他们们认为，这些移民一旦取得合法身分，就能在经济的阶梯上攀升。但实际上，入籍并不能提供通向优薪工作的道路。 《纽约时报》认为，就像在洛杉矶和其他城市一样，移民即使得到完整的公民身份，许多人仍在经济阴影中谋生存，也继续在工资偏低的职位赚取现金报酬。全美数百万名工人–缝衣服、割草坪、照顾孩子、盖房子、打扫办公室和在餐馆打工–都完全是依靠现金经济生活。对于无证件移民来说，挣现金是获得收入又避免政府注意的最可靠方式。 移民法案的支持者利用经济流动性作为推动数百万在美移民合法化的主要理由。国会预算办公室上个月发表报告说，参议院法案将增加劳动力数量、提高生产率并产生长期广泛的影响。商界团体上周继续对众议院共和党施压，要他们考虑同样的法案。 《纽约时报》称，单单是入籍几乎不能提供通往优薪工作的道路。洛杉矶加州大学劳工中心项目主任纳洛（Victor Narro）说，有了合法地位可以消除人们受到的威胁，但其它方面就很难发挥作用。 专家指出，除非政府介入，否则即使移民改革法过关，新移民的经济状况也不会改变。 洛杉矶加州大学劳工中心研究2009年雇主违反劳工法的情形发现，外国出生劳工的工资比美国出生劳工更可能低于最低工资，无证移民尤其是女性情况更糟。该研究也发现，即使是合法居民，外国出生劳工的工资低于基本工资的人数约是美国出生员工的两倍左右。 纳洛说：”除非政府介入，确实执行劳工保护法，否则即使通过移民改革法，新移民将面临同样情况，雇主不会自动改变现状。” 无数赚取低工资的劳工是领取现金，无论他们的身分合法与否。有的人是因收入已经够低，想要避税，有的则是陷入两难处境─支领现金，否则就没工作可做。 许多工人都是在非正式公司环境中工作，比如在街角等待工作的临时工、通过社交网找到的保姆、而那些家庭的主人也不认为自己是雇主，不愿意报税或者不愿意遭受那种手续上的麻烦。有些是在只有几十人的企业中工作，后者要靠现金工资降低成本。 威斯康辛大学经济学教授费吉（Edgar L. Feige）指出，每年未申报的收入约达2万亿元，而现金工资只占这个估计数字的一部分。他指出，现金经济在加州尤为重要，而加州的无证移民比其他州更多。 纽约市立大学研究生中心社会学教授米尔克曼（Ruth Milkman）表示，移民人力规模和移民经济，让企业主建立一套不按牌理出牌的标准，而这类标准在其他地方、其他时代，是难以想像的。他说：”这些雇主习惯自己的一套经营方式，他们没有动机改变，也没有人迫使他们改变，而移民改革法案也显然不能改变这些走旁门左道的雇主的做法。”
0b2b74455686f52bfc9ecfa27a4b682f9bbb2a93.translatedText: It will be difficult for undocumented immigrants to escape poverty if they are legalized. Supporters of immigration reform have repeatedly claimed that naturalizing the 11 million undocumented immigrants will free them from the economic shadow. They believe these immigrants can move up the economic ladder once they obtain legal status. But in reality, naturalization does not provide a path to good-paying jobs. The New York Times believes that, as in Los Angeles and other cities, even if immigrants receive full citizenship, many continue to survive in the shadows of the economy and continue to earn cash compensation in low-wage positions. Millions of workers across the United States—sewing clothes, mowing lawns, taking care of children, building houses, cleaning offices, and working in restaurants—all rely entirely on a cash economy. For undocumented immigrants, earning cash is the surest way to earn income while avoiding government attention. Supporters of the immigration bill use economic mobility as the main reason to legalize millions of immigrants in the United States. The Congressional Budget Office reported last month that the Senate bill would expand the workforce, boost productivity and have broad, long-term impacts. Business groups continued to pressure House Republicans last week to consider the same bill. According to the New York Times, naturalization alone provides little path to good-paying jobs. Victor Narro, program director at the University of California, Los Angeles, Labor Center, said legal status can eliminate threats to people, but other aspects are difficult to work with. Experts point out that unless the government intervenes, the economic status of new immigrants will not change even if the immigration reform law is passed. The UCLA Labor Center studied employer violations of labor laws in 2009 and found that foreign-born workers were more likely to be paid less than the minimum wage than U.S.-born workers, and undocumented immigrants, especially women, were even worse off. The study also found that even as legal residents, about twice as many foreign-born workers were paid less than the base wage as U.S.-born workers. "Unless the government steps in and actually enforces labor protection laws, even if the immigration reform law is passed, new immigrants will face the same situation, and employers will not automatically change the status quo," Nallo said. Countless workers earning low wages receive cash, regardless of whether their status is legal or not. Some people want to avoid taxes because their income is already low enough, while others are stuck in a dilemma - they need cash, otherwise they will have no work to do. Many workers work in informal corporate settings, such as temporary workers waiting for jobs on street corners, nannies found through social networks, and household owners who do not consider themselves employers and are unwilling to file taxes or suffer the hassle of paperwork. Some work in companies with only a few dozen people, who rely on cash wages to keep costs down. Edgar L. Feige, an economics professor at the University of Wisconsin, pointed out that unreported income amounts to approximately $2 trillion each year, and cash wages only account for a portion of this estimate. He noted that the cash economy is particularly important in California, which has more undocumented immigrants than other states. Ruth Milkman, a professor of sociology at the Graduate Center of the City University of New York, said that the scale of the immigrant workforce and the immigrant economy have allowed business owners to establish a set of unreasonable standards that would be unimaginable in other places and in other eras. He said: "These employers are accustomed to their own way of doing business. They have no incentive to change, and no one is forcing them to change. The immigration reform bill obviously cannot change the practices of these employers who follow the other way around."

54777c0e6390b2b38c25f6eadbe04d78818c6541.sourceText: 四十多年头一宗 边境巡逻员被同事误杀 周日，边境巡逻警员工会负责人说，上周在本州南部殉职的联邦边境巡逻人员显然死于与同事的驳火。丧生的边境警员首先向两名同为边境警员的人开枪（误以为他们是武装走私者），并在那两名警员开枪回击时遭枪击毙命。 全国边境巡逻委员会主席乔治麦卡宾说，事发当天，这两批警员同时接近一个安装有感应器的地区，因为那里的感应器在周二凌晨在不同的方向被激活了。这两拨人相遇的是一个长着浓密灌木丛的地方。 警员艾维恩显然首先开了枪，并打伤了一名警员，但他却在遭到攻击的警员还击的时候被打死。 麦卡宾说，我不知道他当时看到或听到了什么而触发了整个事件的发生。不幸的是，这一事件导致了他的死亡和另外一名警员的受伤。 科奇斯郡代理警长罗特洛克肯定了这一情况，但他不敢肯定是艾维恩首先开的枪。他说，这将由相关的联邦调查机构来确定。 联邦调查局周五的一项声明中提到，这一枪击事件看来是一次误伤事件，因为涉及到的除了警员之外没有其他人。这也是1968年以来，第一起边境巡逻队员被同事误杀事件。
54777c0e6390b2b38c25f6eadbe04d78818c6541.translatedText: For the first time in more than 40 years, a Border Patrol agent was accidentally killed by a colleague. A federal Border Patrol agent killed on duty in the southern part of the state last week apparently died in a fight with a colleague, the head of the Border Patrol agents' union said Sunday. The border officer who died first shot at two fellow border officers (mistaking them for armed smugglers) and was shot dead when the two officers fired back. George McCubbin, chairman of the National Border Patrol Council, said the two groups of agents approached an area with sensors at the same time because the sensors there were activated in different directions early Tuesday morning. The two groups met in a place with thick bushes. Officer Ivian apparently fired first and wounded an officer, but he was killed when the attacking officer returned fire. "I don't know what he saw or heard that triggered the whole incident," McCubbin said. Unfortunately, the incident resulted in his death and the injury of another officer. Cochise County Deputy Sheriff Rotlock confirmed this situation, but he was not sure that Ivian fired the first shot. That will be determined by the relevant federal investigative agencies, he said. The FBI said in a statement Friday that the shooting appeared to be a friendly fire incident because no one other than officers was involved. This is the first time since 1968 that a Border Patrol agent has been accidentally killed by a colleague.

3a8e65a0c553db9b9864b80796cd3d9aae338d3c.sourceText: 美南加州中国高等院校校友会联合设置 “松竹梅”奖学金 南加州北京大学校友会于2011年11月22日宣布，联合加州地区清华大学、交通大学、中国科技大学、复旦大学、浙江大学、南京大学等中国高校校友会联合设置”松竹梅”奖学金，用于鼓励校友们的下一代积极参与社区活动；弘扬社区服务的精神；并增加第二代移民对父辈的了解及对中华文化的认同。 据南加州北大校友会会长常劲、侯任会长荣劼介绍，由各大校友会联合举办的”松竹梅”年度大型餐会，自2002年开始至今已经延续了十年，成为南加州地区中国高等院校校友们的一项传统。去年的”松竹梅”野餐会由南加州北大校友会牵头主办，活动获得了空前的成功，有超过四百多名校友及家属参加了这次活动，并取得近二千美元的节余。经主办单位讨论一致同意将节余用于设置”松竹梅”奖学金。 经各校友会提名，2011年第一届”松竹梅”奖学金评审委员会已经成立，常劲等三人出任评审委员会联席主席，评审委员会成员由各大校友会负责人组成。并定于12月17日时间下午２点到５点在洛杉矶亚凯迪亚市Masonic Center举办奖学金颁奖典礼。亚凯迪亚华人协会前会长戴守真表示非常支持这个鼓励华裔青少年认同中华文化的颁奖典礼。 本次奖学金将向6～12岁及13～18岁两个年龄组发放，申请人父母至少有一人在中国大陆的高校就读超过一年以上，并为该高校在北美地区的校友会成员。6～12岁组申请人须陈述各自的才艺及中华文化认同作文；13～18岁组申请人须陈述各自为社区服务及中华文化认同作文，每组各取十名最终获奖者。奖学金金额为每名$100美元，获奖者同时获得”松竹梅”奖学金获奖证书。 据介绍，本届”松竹梅”奖学金申请截止日期为11月30日，先由各校友会负责初选5～10名候选人，12月初完成评审，经评审委员会投票确定最后获奖名单。申请人或父母将申请表、短文及相关文件用电子邮件发至 puaascyb@gmail.com 。申请表可在南加州北大校友会www.pku.org或各校友会网站下载。（AACYF洛杉矶讯）
3a8e65a0c553db9b9864b80796cd3d9aae338d3c.translatedText: The Peking University Alumni Association of Southern California jointly established the "Pine, Bamboo and Plum" Scholarship. The Peking University Alumni Association of Southern California announced on November 22, 2011 that it has joined forces with Tsinghua University, Jiaotong University, University of Science and Technology of China, Fudan University, Zhejiang University, Nanjing University and other Chinese university alumni associations in California to jointly establish the "Song, Bamboo and Plum" scholarship to encourage the next generation of alumni to actively participate in community activities; promote the spirit of community service; and increase the second-generation immigrants' understanding of their parents and their recognition of Chinese culture. According to Chang Jin, president of the Peking University of Southern California Alumni Association, and Rong Jie, president-elect, the "Pine, Bamboo and Plum" annual large-scale dinner party jointly organized by major alumni associations has continued for ten years since 2002 and has become a tradition for alumni of Chinese colleges and universities in Southern California. Last year's "Pine, Bamboo and Plum" picnic was hosted by the USC-Northern University Alumni Association. The event was an unprecedented success. More than 400 alumni and their families participated in the event, and a savings of nearly US$2,000 was achieved. After discussion with the organizer, it was unanimously agreed that the savings would be used to set up the "Pine, Bamboo and Plum" scholarship. After being nominated by various alumni associations, the first "Songzhumei" Scholarship Review Committee has been established in 2011. Chang Jin and three other people serve as co-chairmen of the review committee. The members of the review committee are composed of heads of major alumni associations. A scholarship award ceremony will be held at the Masonic Center in Arcadia, Los Angeles from 2 to 5 pm on December 17th. Dai Shouzhen, former president of the Arcadia Chinese Association, expressed his strong support for this award ceremony that encourages Chinese teenagers to identify with Chinese culture. This scholarship will be awarded to two age groups, 6 to 12 years old and 13 to 18 years old. At least one of the applicant's parents has studied in a university in mainland China for more than one year and is a member of the university's alumni association in North America. Applicants in the 6-12-year-old group must state their talents and Chinese cultural identity composition; applicants in the 13-18-year-old group must state their community service and Chinese cultural identity composition. Ten final winners will be selected from each group. The scholarship amount is US$100 per person, and the winners will also receive a "Song, Bamboo and Plum" scholarship certificate. According to reports, the application deadline for this year's "Songzhumei" scholarship is November 30. Each alumni association will first select 5 to 10 candidates. The review will be completed in early December, and the final list of winners will be determined by voting by the review committee. Applicants or parents should email the application form, essay and relevant documents to puaascyb@gmail.com. The application form can be downloaded from the USC-PKU Alumni Association www.pku.org or the websites of each alumni association. (AACYF Los Angeles News)

dd56640d282cfb3dfed6a62fe42a403aa93c3221.sourceText: 威廉 莎士比亚 （1564-1616） 威廉 莎士比亚(William Shakespeare)，华语中尊称莎翁，生于儒略曆1564年4月23日，卒于儒略曆1616年4月23日或公曆1616年5月3日，享年52岁。他是英国文学史上最伟大的戏剧家兼诗人，也是西方文艺史上最杰出的作家之一、全世界最卓越的文学家之一。我收藏的《威廉 莎士比亚全集》(The Complete Works of William Shakespeare, by HarperCollins Publishers)裡，有37个剧本、154首十四行诗、两首长叙事诗和其他诗歌。 今年是莎翁诞生450周年，中国北京国家大剧院从4月下旬至11月底，将举行’致敬！莎士比亚’系列演出，在长达7个多月时间裡，不同国家、不同语言、不同题材的8台大戏先后登场。 莎士比亚出生在英格兰沃里克郡埃文河畔的小镇斯特拉福，并在那裡长大。父亲约翰 莎士比亚是位富商，经营羊毛和皮革生意，曾任首席市参议员。莎士比亚年轻时，上斯特拉福镇的文法学校，受过良好的拉丁文教育。他18岁时娶了比他大8岁的农家姑娘安妮 哈瑟维为妻，两人育有3个孩子。 大概是1585年，莎士比亚到了伦敦，开始剧院生涯。 1992年之前，他在伦敦的经历，鲜为人知。据说，他在剧院管过马，当过听差。到了1592年，他身为剧作家和演员，已声名大噪。 其后20年，他当演员、改编剧本、创作剧本。他演戏好像不太成功，但写戏的天才却得到公认。他事业有成，当了着名的环球剧院股东。他还是宫内大臣剧团的合伙人之一，后来该剧团改名为国王剧团。 他不时回到斯特拉福探望，并在那裡买了一所宽敞的住宅。1613年左右，他离开伦敦回到故乡，颐养天年。死后葬于斯特拉福教堂，这个地方已经成了文学爱好者朝觐的圣地。 1584年，莎翁的第一部剧本《错误的喜剧》问世，属于传统的’学院戏剧’，也就是在中学和大学创作演出的戏剧。 1590年到1613年，是莎士比亚创作的黄金时代。早期的悲剧和喜剧有《罗密欧与朱丽叶》和《威尼斯商人》。《罗密欧与朱丽叶》（1595-1596）是他最早获得成功的一部悲剧。故事取自意大利，发生在维洛那。这部悲剧揭示了古老的封建社会裡的内部斗争以及人与人之间不近情理的关係。《威尼斯商人》（1596-1597）是一齣深受欢迎的喜剧。故事也取自意大利，发生在威尼斯。这齣喜剧描绘了当时社会上形形色色的人物，揭露人类的罪恶：贪婪、恶毒、种族偏见、拜金主义和残暴。 莎翁早年（1590-1599）写的历史剧有《约翰王》以及《理查二世》、《亨利四世》上下编、《亨利五世》、《亨利六世》上中下编和《理查三世》。后面一系列的戏，写的都是约克家族和兰开斯特家族之间的斗争。 到了1600年，莎翁的创作似乎蒙上一层阴云。他开始深入透彻地观察生活，无情揭露伊丽莎白时代的社会矛盾。从1601年到1605年，他创作了四大悲剧：《哈姆雷特》、《奥瑟罗》、《李尔王》以及《麦克白》。 《哈姆雷特》的主要情节就是儿子哈姆雷特向谋杀父亲的凶手叔父复仇，取自十三世纪丹麦传奇故事。哈姆雷特企图解决内心世界和外部世界的矛盾，然而却悲壮地失败了。剧本以极大的洞察力揭示了人的动机与激情、揭示了使无辜与有罪同遭毁灭的可怕力量。这一切使《哈姆雷特》成为世界上最伟大的悲剧之一。 莎士比亚写十四行诗，是按照当时的风尚。文艺复兴时期，绝大多数诗人都写过十四行诗，诗的内容无非向心上人倾诉衷肠，抱怨她冷漠无情，变化无常。但是莎士比亚在许多十四行诗中，抒发了自己的真实感情。他觉得自己智力高超，又深感自己地位低微。请读他的第29首十四行诗： 可叹时运不济众人唾弃， 为飘零人间而独自哭泣； 怨苍天不闻兮徒然呼吁， 顾影自怜兮咒命运残酷； 愿自己如他人前程似锦， 或仪表堂堂或高朋满座， 有此人的机缘那人的本领， 对自己的长处却不满足； 一味自怨自艾自暴自弃， 但偶尔想到你便如云雀， 于拂晓时从阴霾的大地 飞向云间天堂高歌不息； 回忆你的情愫如获宝藏， 宁愿困厄不屑南面称王。 （孙梁译） 下面几行诗，摘自第110首十四行诗，倾诉了他作为演员和剧作家的苦恼： 唉，我的确曾经常东奔西跑， 扮作斑衣的小丑供众人赏玩， 违背我的意志，把至宝卖掉， 为了新交不惜把旧知冒犯。 （梁宗岱译） 此外，莎翁十四行诗中，第18首、第30首、第55首、第65首、第66首、第106首最为有名。 1593年到1594年，剧院因瘟疫而关闭，莎士比亚出版了两首以性爱为主题的叙事诗：《维纳斯和阿多尼斯》和《鲁克丽丝失贞记》，将它们献给南安普敦伯爵亨利 赖奥思利。 英国文学史上的人物，历经几百年纷纭评说，褒贬不一。评价始终肯定的，只有两位，一位是莎士比亚这位不倒翁；另一位则是早于勃朗蒂三姐妹(Charlotte, Emily and Ann Bronte)的女小说家简 奥斯汀(Jane Austen, 1775-1817)。
dd56640d282cfb3dfed6a62fe42a403aa93c3221.translatedText: William Shakespeare (1564-1616) William Shakespeare, also known as Shakespeare in Chinese, was born on April 23, 1564 in the Julian calendar and died on April 23, 1616 in the Julian calendar or May 3, 1616 in the Gregorian calendar. He was 52 years old. He is the greatest dramatist and poet in the history of British literature, one of the most outstanding writers in the history of Western literature and art, and one of the most outstanding writers in the world. My collection of "The Complete Works of William Shakespeare, by HarperCollins Publishers" contains 37 plays, 154 sonnets, two long narrative poems and other poems. This year marks the 450th anniversary of Shakespeare’s birth. From late April to the end of November, the National Center for the Performing Arts in Beijing, China will hold a tribute! Shakespeare’s series of performances lasted for more than 7 months, with 8 plays from different countries, languages, and themes successively staged. Shakespeare was born and raised in Stratford-upon-Avon, a small town in Warwickshire, England. His father, John Shakespeare, was a wealthy merchant who ran a wool and leather business and served as chief alderman. When Shakespeare was young, he went to the grammar school in Stratford Town and received a good Latin education. When he was 18 years old, he married Anne Hathaway, a farm girl who was 8 years older than him. The two had three children. Around 1585, Shakespeare arrived in London and began his theater career. Before 1992, little was known about his experience in London. It is said that he managed horses in the theater and worked as a footman. By 1592, he was already famous as a playwright and actor. For the next 20 years, he worked as an actor, adapted scripts, and wrote scripts. He didn't seem to be very successful in acting, but his genius in writing plays was recognized. He had a successful career and became a shareholder of the famous Globe Theatre. He was also a partner in the Chamberlain's Theater Company, which was later renamed the King's Theater Company. He returned to Stratford from time to time for visits and bought a spacious home there. Around 1613, he left London and returned to his hometown to spend his old age. After his death, he was buried in Stratford Church, which has become a holy place for literary lovers. In 1584, Shakespeare's first play "The Comedy of Errors" was published. It belongs to the traditional "academic drama", that is, drama written and performed in middle schools and universities. The period from 1590 to 1613 was the golden age of Shakespeare's creation. Early tragedies and comedies include "Romeo and Juliet" and "The Merchant of Venice." "Romeo and Juliet" (1595-1596) is his earliest successful tragedy. The story is taken from Italy and takes place in Verona. This tragedy reveals the internal struggles in the ancient feudal society and the unreasonable relationships between people. The Merchant of Venice (1596-1597) is a popular comedy. The story is also taken from Italy and takes place in Venice. This comedy depicts various characters in society at that time and exposes human evils: greed, viciousness, racial prejudice, money worship and cruelty. The historical plays written by Shakespeare in his early years (1590-1599) include "King John" and "Richard II", "Henry IV" Part 2, "Henry V", "Henry VI" Part 1, Middle and Part 2 and "Richard III". The following series of plays are all about the struggle between the York family and the Lancaster family. By 1600, Shakespeare's creation seemed to be under a cloud. He began to observe life deeply and thoroughly, ruthlessly exposing the social contradictions of the Elizabethan era. From 1601 to 1605, he created four major tragedies: "Hamlet", "Othello", "King Lear" and "Macbeth". The main plot of "Hamlet" is the son Hamlet's revenge on his father's murderer uncle, which is taken from the Danish legend in the thirteenth century. Hamlet attempts to resolve the contradiction between the inner world and the outer world, but fails tragically. The script reveals human motivations and passions with great insight, revealing the terrible forces that destroy both the innocent and the guilty. All this makes Hamlet one of the greatest tragedies in the world. Shakespeare wrote sonnets according to the fashion of the time. During the Renaissance, most poets wrote sonnets, which were nothing more than pouring out their hearts to their sweetheart, complaining about her indifference and fickleness. But Shakespeare expressed his true feelings in many sonnets. He feels that his intelligence is superior, but he also feels that his status is low. Please read his 29th sonnet: Lamenting the bad luck that everyone despises, I cry alone because I am drifting in the world; I blame the sky for not hearing my call in vain, I look at my shadow and pity myself and curse the cruel fate; I wish that I have a bright future like others, or a handsome appearance or a crowd of friends, with this person's opportunity and that person's ability, but not satisfied with my own merits; blindly complaining about myself, self-destruction, and self-destruction, But when I think of you occasionally, I am like a skylark, flying from the gloomy earth to the heaven in the clouds at dawn and singing endlessly; recalling your feelings is like finding a treasure, I would rather be in trouble than to be king in the south. (Translated by Sun Liang) The following lines, taken from Sonnet 110, express his troubles as an actor and playwright: Alas, I did often run here and there, Dressing up as a spotted clown for everyone to see, Selling treasures against my will, Offending old friends for new ones. (Translated by Liang Zongdai) In addition, among Shakespeare's sonnets, the 18th, 30th, 55th, 65th, 66th and 106th are the most famous. From 1593 to 1594, when theaters were closed due to the plague, Shakespeare published two narrative poems with sexual themes: "Venus and Adonis" and "Lucrece", dedicating them to Henry Wraysley, Earl of Southampton. Figures in the history of British literature have received mixed reviews over hundreds of years, with mixed praise and criticism. There are only two people whose evaluations are always positive. One is Shakespeare, the tumbler; the other is Jane Austen (1775-1817), a female novelist who preceded the three Bronte sisters (Charlotte, Emily and Ann Bronte).

e8c6a02ab9bebde6b345c0796438b6cb8aae9224.sourceText: 房屋产权保险到底给我们什么保障？ 买卖房屋时都会购买产权保险，透过购买产权保险可以让您在产权发生问题时还能保障自己的权益。房地产的产权为什么会有问题? 有几个原因: 可能是从前产权过户时没有处理好(Defects in the chain of Title)、该房地产曾经有未清偿的抵押借款(Mortgages)、曾经被扣押(liens)，或是有地役权(Easements)，所谓的地役权，指的是土地所有人对他人土地可行使之权利。这些产权的问题，有些是不容易被察觉的，例如: 诈欺行为、产权转让程序错误等，有些比较容易被察觉，但是不容易或不可能将它移除，像是: 被扣押、有地役权等等。 产权保险基本上跟一般保险一样，都是保险公司和投保者之间的一个契约，当投保者有损失时，保险公司会依照合约上的条款，赔偿投保者，但产权保险最大的不同点，在于它通常只保障保险契约订定之前已存在的问题，不像一般保险，是保障契约生效之后所发生的问题。 所以产权保险是为了保障房地产购买者，不会因为购买到产权有问题的房地产而遭受损失，您如果是贷款买房地产，贷款银行也会为了保障自身的权益，而要求您购买产权保险，因此产权保险有两种，一种是产权人保单(Owner抯 Policy)、它保障您的权益，通常由卖方付保费，另一种是银行保单(Lender抯 Policy)、在保障银行的权益，传统上由贷款人付保费，可视为贷款费用的一部份。 以上简单说明产权保险的重要性，如果您有任何房地产方面的问题，非常欢迎您打电话到我的专线 (480) 612-4545 或 email至 Rich@RichLiao.com
e8c6a02ab9bebde6b345c0796438b6cb8aae9224.translatedText: What protection does home title insurance give us? Title insurance is purchased when buying or selling a house. By purchasing title insurance, you can protect your rights and interests if there is a problem with the property rights. Why are there problems with the property rights of real estate? There are several reasons: Defects in the chain of Title may not have been handled properly during the transfer of property rights, the property may have had unpaid mortgages, liens, or easements. The so-called easements refer to the rights that the land owner can exercise over other people's land. Some of these property rights problems are not easy to detect, such as: fraud, errors in property transfer procedures, etc. Some are easier to detect, but it is not easy or impossible to remove them, such as: being seized, having an easement, etc. Title insurance is basically the same as general insurance. It is a contract between an insurance company and the policy holder. When the policy holder suffers a loss, the insurance company will compensate the policy holder in accordance with the terms of the contract. However, the biggest difference between title insurance and title insurance is that it usually only covers problems that existed before the insurance contract was entered into. Unlike general insurance, it covers problems that occur after the contract takes effect. Therefore, title insurance is to protect real estate buyers from suffering losses due to the purchase of real estate with questionable title. If you buy real estate with a loan, the lending bank will also require you to purchase title insurance in order to protect its own rights and interests. Therefore, there are two types of title insurance. One is the owner's policy (Owner's Policy), which protects your rights and interests. The seller usually pays the premium, and the other is the bank policy (Lender's policy). Policy), in order to protect the interests of the bank, the lender traditionally pays the premium, which can be regarded as part of the loan fee. The above briefly explains the importance of title insurance. If you have any questions about real estate, you are very welcome to call my hotline (480) 612-4545 or email to Rich@RichLiao.com

e0e43c08e3c9a5b60e48f566da3f7ad97c806e9d.sourceText: 美国经济数字有何变动？
e0e43c08e3c9a5b60e48f566da3f7ad97c806e9d.translatedText: How are the U.S. economic numbers changing?

d1f99bcb26fc32f7cf133934a189bba4a4628cda.sourceText: 美国经济数字有何变动？ 今年第三季度起，美国消费者的支出，是五个月之内，增加最多的，并希望经济增长持续下去…
d1f99bcb26fc32f7cf133934a189bba4a4628cda.translatedText: >How have the U.S. economic figures changed? Starting from the third quarter of this year, American consumers’ spending increased the most in five months, and they hope that economic growth will continue...

2e3e3dacd602059fcf3b6635adfdd6502fa9bebb.sourceText: 今年第三季度起，美国消费者的支出，是五个月之内，增加最多的，并希望经济增长持续下去。
2e3e3dacd602059fcf3b6635adfdd6502fa9bebb.translatedText: Starting from the third quarter of this year, American consumers’ spending increased by the most in five months, and they hope that economic growth will continue.

4347d3beecddd20c8f0d23945195e285ce3de3ad.sourceText: 然而，上週的其他数据显示，美国首次申请失业救济人数与上週持平，这表明在劳动力市场上缺乏强而有力的改善，避免美联储额外的货币政策的刺激。
4347d3beecddd20c8f0d23945195e285ce3de3ad.translatedText: However, other data last week showed that the number of people filing for unemployment benefits was unchanged from last week, indicating a lack of strong improvement in the labor market to avoid the stimulus of additional monetary policy from the Federal Reserve.

22e77c0906d49e39b6bd8c6d4ef8c82228bad622.sourceText: 美国商务部称，从6月持平之后，消费者开支增长0.4%。上个月的消费增长，佔美国经济活动的70%，符合经济学家的预测。
22e77c0906d49e39b6bd8c6d4ef8c82228bad622.translatedText: The U.S. Commerce Department said consumer spending increased 0.4% after being flat in June. Last month's growth in consumption, which accounts for 70% of U.S. economic activity, was in line with economists' forecasts.

59c800259ae6dcf0e252196d4f6f3d8f3c0d8fad.sourceText: 经通胀调整之后，消费开支增长0.4%，自2月份以来的最大增幅。
59c800259ae6dcf0e252196d4f6f3d8f3c0d8fad.translatedText: After adjusting for inflation, consumer spending increased 0.4%, the largest increase since February.

08ad8f5fdbfb3a3e1f466edb672f2cfaa3c50b27.sourceText: 纽约TD证券高级宏观策略专家文兰(Millan Mulraine)说：”消费活动的改善，证明整体经济活动在第三季度，可能是一个相当不错的开始。” 第二个来自美国劳工部的报告显示，首次申请失业救济人数持平于374,000名。过去0四星期的增长，平均增加1500人。
08ad8f5fdbfb3a3e1f466edb672f2cfaa3c50b27.translatedText: Millan Mulraine, senior macro strategist at TD Securities in New York, said: "The improvement in consumer activity proves that overall economic activity may be off to a pretty good start in the third quarter." The second report from the U.S. Department of Labor showed that the number of initial jobless claims was unchanged at 374,000. Growth over the past four weeks has averaged an increase of 1,500 people.

583cfa69bbdf2bb14b2df6e37644baa6fc1686f6.sourceText: 这些数字，更好地衡量劳动力市场的发展趋势。
583cfa69bbdf2bb14b2df6e37644baa6fc1686f6.translatedText: These figures better measure the development trend of the labor market.

36063099feaa6c6c2f23098b3dbcaded0b08defc.sourceText: 尽管消费者支出和住房数据表明，第三季度的经济活动改善，劳动力市场的状态可以决定美联储是否会在9月12日至13日政策会议上，提出额外的货币刺激经济。
36063099feaa6c6c2f23098b3dbcaded0b08defc.translatedText: Although consumer spending and housing data suggested that economic activity improved in the third quarter, the state of the labor market could determine whether the Federal Reserve will propose additional monetary stimulus for the economy at its September 12-13 policy meeting.

f10c244582107b1831920b67c610c8228629f9f6.sourceText: 7月份，失业率上升至8.3%，过去3年以来，美国失业率一直停留于8%以上，此外，企业支出下降和通货膨胀正在放缓。 资本经济的高级经济学家保罗达拉斯(Paul Dales)表示：”今天的数据是没有强大到足以阻止美联储9月中旬推出刺激经济政策。”
f10c244582107b1831920b67c610c8228629f9f6.translatedText: In July, the unemployment rate rose to 8.3%. The U.S. unemployment rate has stayed above 8% for the past three years. In addition, business spending has declined and inflation is slowing. Paul Dales, senior economist at Capital Economics, said: "Today's data is not strong enough to prevent the Federal Reserve from launching stimulus policies in mid-September."

d891009c90a9e3930c0552d0eb6ecad710e3ef18.sourceText: 事实上，经过6月的通胀调整之后，消费者支出下降0.1%。然而，上个月的消费增长，是第二季度一个令人鼓舞的跡象。
d891009c90a9e3930c0552d0eb6ecad710e3ef18.translatedText: In fact, after adjusting for inflation in June, consumer spending fell 0.1%. However, last month's consumption growth is an encouraging sign for the second quarter.

5ef046cd55032e3a080c4bd4fdba5ae44229acc7.sourceText: 在4月至6月期间，低迷的消费开支，保持以每年1.7%的速度缓慢增长。
5ef046cd55032e3a080c4bd4fdba5ae44229acc7.translatedText: From April to June, sluggish consumer spending maintained a slow growth rate of 1.7% per year.

65a7e7150341ae791e881fc19e245ec42679f33a.sourceText: 上个月，家庭支出增加，收入增长了0.3%，以6月份相同的幅度上升，扣取通货膨胀和家庭税收的收入增长，储蓄率却有所减少，从6月份的4.3%下降至7月的4.2%。
65a7e7150341ae791e881fc19e245ec42679f33a.translatedText: Last month, household spending increased and income increased by 0.3%, rising at the same rate as in June. Income growth after deducting inflation and household taxes has decreased, but the savings rate has decreased, falling from 4.3% in June to 4.2% in July.

4249021e253a84b9b0f3332cd3a68bac58966804.sourceText: 亚太社区促进会：如何预防和救助住宅火灾
4249021e253a84b9b0f3332cd3a68bac58966804.translatedText: Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association: How to prevent and rescue residential fires

6e3f033e1d9c8be5c9b631c90505de84805e9742.sourceText: 亚太社区促进会：如何预防和救助住宅火灾 （亚太社区促进会来稿）住宅火灾最常见的原因是烹调事故、烟雾以及不适…
6e3f033e1d9c8be5c9b631c90505de84805e9742.translatedText: Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association: How to prevent and rescue residential fires (Contributed by Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association) The most common causes of residential fires are cooking accidents, smoke and discomfort...

412f74dffebab57b26766a2be46948984011aa1b.sourceText: （亚太社区促进会来稿）住宅火灾最常见的原因是烹调事故、烟雾以及不适当的使用燃木材的炉子或加热器。下面列举了一些避免住宅火灾或火灾发生时保护人身安全的措施。防备火灾 在所有的卧室中或附近安装烟火探测器,包括住宅的每一层楼及地下室。定期检查烟火探测器,每年更换电池两次。
412f74dffebab57b26766a2be46948984011aa1b.translatedText: (Contributed by Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association) The most common causes of residential fires are cooking accidents, smoke and improper use of wood-burning stoves or heaters. Listed below are some steps you can take to avoid a home fire or to protect your personal safety if one occurs. Preparing for Fire  Install smoke detectors in or near all bedrooms, including every floor of the home and in the basement. Check smoke detectors regularly and replace batteries twice a year.

a6fa1b61b7ce5859fe35981398ead5337189d83f.sourceText: 准备A-B-C类型的灭火器。教会家庭成员如何使用。 知道房屋的所有出口,包括窗子。如果你住在公寓中,数一下你的公寓与两个离你最近的出口之间有几个门。 至少知道每一个房间的两个出口,以免烟火封住主要出口。 指定一个户外集合地点。 制定一项撤离计划,与家人一道练习。这将有助于确保你们能够迅速撤离,不会有任何失误。 在楼上的卧室中放置折叠式或链条式梯子。 安全地使用替代热源,例如燃木材的炉子或空间加热器: 决不要在室内使用煤气烤箱、煤气炉、烤肉架或大多数可以移动的煤气罐加热器。 准备消防材料:灭火粉、灭火器、厚油布或毯子及水。 在使用替代热源时,务必阅读制造商说明。
a6fa1b61b7ce5859fe35981398ead5337189d83f.translatedText: Prepare fire extinguishers of type A-B-C. Teach family members how to use it.  Know all exits to the house, including windows. If you live in an apartment, count how many doors there are between your apartment and the two closest exits.  Know at least two exits from each room so that fireworks do not block the main exit.  Designate an outdoor meeting place.  Develop an evacuation plan and practice it with your family. This will help ensure that you can evacuate quickly without any mistakes.  Place folding or chain ladders in upstairs bedrooms.  Safely use alternative heat sources, such as wood-burning stoves or space heaters:  Never use a gas oven, gas stove, barbecue or most portable gas tank heaters indoors.  Prepare fire-fighting materials: fire extinguishing powder, fire extinguisher, thick tarpaulin or blanket and water.  Always read the manufacturer's instructions when using alternative heat sources.

ac08cc0fc6fad7cca317668f529bde8b2b5314b4.sourceText: 不要在卧室、沙发或可能入睡的任何地点吸烟。
ac08cc0fc6fad7cca317668f529bde8b2b5314b4.translatedText: Don’t smoke in the bedroom, on the couch, or anywhere you might sleep.

e7882e54faad62093efb1e891daa7782141d9a32.translatedText: Close the bedroom door when you sleep.

c337f9775017dc560239d504393e1092659cb04f.sourceText: 确保你的门牌号码可以从街上清楚地看到,以便消防车找到你的住处。
c337f9775017dc560239d504393e1092659cb04f.translatedText: Make sure your house number is clearly visible from the street so fire trucks can find your home.

5218bbaec19bc7f0e70999ce0d75d5766b24ad80.sourceText: 准备消防材料:灭火粉、灭火器、厚油布或毯子及水。如果发生火灾
5218bbaec19bc7f0e70999ce0d75d5766b24ad80.translatedText: Prepare fire-fighting materials: fire extinguishing powder, fire extinguisher, thick tarpaulin or blanket and water. If a fire breaks out

39cc7c3f5f7838c632481a79d3c72535232acd1c.sourceText: 如果发生火灾棗撤离。不要返回室内。从邻居家拨打9-1-1电话。
39cc7c3f5f7838c632481a79d3c72535232acd1c.translatedText: If a fire breaks out, evacuate. Do not return indoors. Make a 9-1-1 call from your neighbor's house.

3cc4c4c99fd9dedb58655883e0babb808b09d123.sourceText: 在电器起火时绝对不要用水灭火。
3cc4c4c99fd9dedb58655883e0babb808b09d123.translatedText: Never use water to extinguish an electrical fire.

364c8d1a1d554badb25f306f982bd7802541de34.sourceText: 在厨房里可用苏打粉或盐扑灭燃烧的油火,如果是在锅中起火,可盖上盖子。
364c8d1a1d554badb25f306f982bd7802541de34.translatedText: Use soda ash or salt to extinguish burning oil fires in the kitchen. If the fire breaks out in a pot, cover it with a lid.

51b7875a9bf1d513a79e7e7c4a724abc08d2a2eb.sourceText: 如果被烟包围棗趴在地上爬行;用鼻子作浅呼吸,把罩衫、衬衣或外套作为过滤器。
51b7875a9bf1d513a79e7e7c4a724abc08d2a2eb.translatedText: If you are surrounded by smoke, crawl on the ground; take shallow breaths through your nose and use your blouse, shirt, or jacket as a filter.

3ba85f807763b9b43c44b814cde6044335dd7eb7.sourceText: 如果你必须穿过火焰棗屏住呼吸,快速移动,裹住头部及头发,低下头,尽量闭上眼睛。?如果衣服着火,「停下、卧倒、打滚」,直至火熄灭。
3ba85f807763b9b43c44b814cde6044335dd7eb7.translatedText: If you must walk through the flames, hold your breath, move quickly, wrap your head and hair, lower your head, and close your eyes as much as possible. ?If clothing catches fire, "stop, lie down, and roll" until the fire goes out.

e87064aea4664591e8c2794c2809a032a6fed7e3.sourceText: 如果你在​​一个无法逃出的房间内,不要开门,趴在地板上,在窗外挂一条白色或浅色的床单。核实所有家人的下落。如果有人走失,报告消防队。
e87064aea4664591e8c2794c2809a032a6fed7e3.translatedText: If you are in a room from which you cannot escape, do not open the door, lie on the floor, and hang a white or light-colored sheet outside the window. Verify the whereabouts of all family members. If anyone is lost, report it to the fire brigade.

087b5f5564879a0cd47f3eed8f9fc4e429f305dd.sourceText: 赵兵：战友 凤凰城 赵兵 我一位朋友有一隻大的黑色卷毛狗，去年春假他把狗放在我家裡，由我来照顾几天，朋友…
087b5f5564879a0cd47f3eed8f9fc4e429f305dd.translatedText: Zhao Bing: Comrade Phoenix Zhao Bing A friend of mine has a big black poodle. Last spring break, he left the dog at my house and I took care of it for a few days. My friend...

42116d2ef2471b1c584e91d2abd368af1b8f264b.sourceText: 我一位朋友有一隻大的黑色卷毛狗，去年春假他把狗放在我家裡，由我来照顾几天，朋友快回来的前一天，我给狗在后院洗了一个澡，刚洗完澡，也许是洗髮乳液的关係，一大群蜜蜂不知从哪裡来的一下就把狗团团围住，我去救援，蜜蜂也把我包围起来了，于是我就和狗一起逃跑，蜜蜂哪肯放过我们，蜜蜂们叮在狗身上密密麻麻，我拼命用手上的一本书把蜜蜂从它身上打下来，同时也把书往我身上打，我最后把衣服也脱下来，用衣服作为武器，衣服在空中拼命飞扬，我和狗拼命在后院绕着圈子狂奔，蜜蜂们对我们紧追不放，就这样狗，蜜蜂，和我在后院上演了一场追逐战。
42116d2ef2471b1c584e91d2abd368af1b8f264b.translatedText: A friend of mine has a big black poodle. Last spring break, he left the dog at my house and I took care of it for a few days. The day before my friend was about to come back, I gave the dog a bath in the backyard. Just after the bath, maybe it was because of the shampoo lotion, a large swarm of bees came from nowhere and immediately surrounded the dog. I went to rescue, and the bees also surrounded me, so I and The dog ran away together, but the bees refused to let us go. The bees stung the dog so densely that I tried my best to knock the bees off it with a book in my hand, and at the same time hit the book on me. I finally took off my clothes and used them as weapons. The clothes were flying in the air. The dog and I ran in circles in the backyard desperately, and the bees chased us. In this way, the dog, the bees, and I staged a chase in the backyard.

7edefa94567189fa52f6d0ff482cc95829a3d97e.sourceText: 眼看蜜蜂越来越多，由于衣服脱下后，身上就没有了保护，如果身上或身下一些重要部位受伤，哪后果是难以想像的，看来在后院高速地绕圈子也不是办法，本想跳进游泳池，但游泳池的栅栏的门不知为何在关键时候一下打不开，于是我就和狗跑进家裡来了，蜜蜂们当然毫不犹豫地跟进来不少，也有不少被关在外面，由于跟进来不少 蜜蜂，我和狗继续又开始在家裡狂奔。我们先逃到一个浴室, 当时想和狗一起跳进浴缸里好用淋浴来把蜜蜂赶走，但开淋浴要花几秒钟，我担心在开水时蜜蜂会有机可乘叮我几口，于是水也没开就逃出浴室，但不知怎麽又逃到另一个浴室，又逃出来，又逃到起居室，客厅，卧室，衣服储藏室，在逃难的过程当中，我用我手上的武器也消灭了不少蜜蜂，最后大概蜜蜂也被我们转晕了，它们是死的死，逃的逃，好多停在玻璃窗上等着我用杀虫喷雾器把它们一隻一隻地消灭掉。经过半小时的逃难和反击，最后我和狗终于胜利了。
7edefa94567189fa52f6d0ff482cc95829a3d97e.translatedText: Seeing that there are more and more bees, after taking off the clothes, there is no protection on the body. If some important parts of the body or lower body are injured, the consequences are unimaginable. It seems that circling in the backyard at high speed is not an option. I wanted to jump into the swimming pool, but the fence door of the swimming pool could not be opened at the critical moment for some reason, so I ran into the house with the dog. Of course, many bees followed them without hesitation, and many were shut out because they followed so many. Bee, the dog and I continued to run wild around the house again. Let's escape to a bathroom first, At that time, I wanted to jump into the bathtub with the dog so that I could use the shower to drive away the bees, but it took a few seconds to turn on the shower. I was worried that the bees would have a chance to bite me while the water was boiling, so I escaped from the bathroom without turning on the water, but somehow escaped to another bathroom, escaped again, and escaped to the living room again. In the process of escaping, I also killed many bees with the weapons in my hands. In the end, the bees were probably stunned by us. They were dead and fled. Many of them stopped on the glass windows and waited for me to kill them one by one with insecticidal spray. After half an hour of escaping and fighting back, the dog and I finally won.

829b7bf717e4eba427cbcf19623af17042c5c957.sourceText: 于是我开始清理战场和检查我们的受伤情况，由于我没有觉得哪裡在痛，看来一切完好。真是上帝保佑！但是要检查狗是否被叮到就有难度了，但它看上去还好，我在它头上和身上找了半天也找不出红点或被叮的痕迹,看样子狗也完好。我又等了一小时后在它身上找了一下看看哪裡有发炎的地方，幸运的是一切完好。但是，当我打开后院的门问狗要不要出去，它是一动也不动，尾巴也夹起来了，眼裡有一丝恐惧，看来它想到了刚才的情景，害怕了，也许有必要找一个心理医生给它也给我一些心理建设，将来才有勇气面对后院，但是人的心理医生好找但不知有没有狗的心理医生， 如果能找到既能看人也能看狗的心理医生就更好了，也许门诊费还可以打折或者买一送一。
829b7bf717e4eba427cbcf19623af17042c5c957.translatedText: So I started to clean up the battlefield and check our injuries. Since I didn't feel any pain, everything seemed to be fine. What a blessing! But it is difficult to check whether the dog has been bitten, but it looks fine. I searched for a long time on its head and body but could not find any red spots or traces of bites. It seems that the dog is also intact. I waited another hour and then looked around to see if there was any inflammation, and luckily everything was fine. However, when I opened the door to the backyard and asked the dog if he wanted to go out, he remained motionless, with his tail tucked up, and there was a trace of fear in his eyes. It seemed that he had thought of the scene just now and was scared. Maybe it is necessary to find a psychiatrist to give him and me some psychological training, so that he will have the courage to face the backyard in the future. However, human psychiatrists are easy to find, but I don’t know if there are any dog ​​psychiatrists. It would be better if you can find a psychiatrist who can see both people and dogs. Maybe the outpatient fee can be discounted or buy one get one free.

2d21d18a6aaea65ff05709e7e238e1129e92ee18.sourceText: 现在想来，这狗也太聪明了，在逃难的过程中，它是一步都没离开我，一直是很默契地和我一起逃，它知道跟着我跑一定没错。虽然我平时给它指令它不大听，但它遇到生命危险时，它是不需要任何指令的。另外我也很佩服它身上的毛和皮，如果没有这厚厚的捲毛和皮肤，它也许已在急诊室里打点滴了。上天造人造物真是奇妙啊！
2d21d18a6aaea65ff05709e7e238e1129e92ee18.translatedText: Now that I think about it, this dog is so smart. During the escape, it never left me for a step. It always ran with me in a tacit understanding. It knew that it was right to follow me. Although it usually doesn't listen well when I give it instructions, it doesn't need any instructions when its life is in danger. In addition, I also admire the fur and skin on its body. If it weren't for the thick curly hair and skin, it might have been in the emergency room on an intravenous drip. How wonderful it is that God created man-made creatures!

b4c7d520bcaf0415ffd6d0cd65c18b172690bd12.sourceText: 通过这次逃难的经过，我认识了一个可以信赖的狗战友。昨天我朋友把狗接回去了，在走时这隻狗看上去还有点不想走，看样子它也把我当成它的可靠的战友了。值得庆幸的是，它不用天天看见我家后院而心理惧怕了，而我每天一早起来，一睁开眼就看见后院，马上想到那次被蜜蜂追赶的可怕情景，看样子要把我心中对蜜蜂和后院的恐惧消除还真需要一段时间呢。
b4c7d520bcaf0415ffd6d0cd65c18b172690bd12.translatedText: Through this escape, I met a trustworthy dog ​​comrade. Yesterday, my friend took the dog back. When we left, the dog seemed a little reluctant to leave. It seemed that it regarded me as its reliable comrade. Fortunately, it no longer has to be afraid of seeing my backyard every day. When I wake up every morning, I see the backyard as soon as I open my eyes. I immediately think of the terrible scene of being chased by bees. It seems that it will take some time to eliminate the fear of bees and the backyard in my heart.

696e3459e0a51603355f63bb93ac7ec8f788f14d.sourceText: 以后我把这个故事告诉了另外一位朋友，他得知我是用给人用的洗髮乳给狗洗澡的，他就一直追问我是用了什麽牌子的洗髮乳这样会招蜂引蝶，可我想不起来了，于是他决定以后自己洗头再也不用洗发乳了。
696e3459e0a51603355f63bb93ac7ec8f788f14d.translatedText: Later I told this story to another friend. He learned that I used human shampoo to bathe the dog, and he kept asking me what brand of shampoo I used. This would attract bees and butterflies, but I couldn't remember it, so he decided to wash his own hair and never use shampoo again.

2347e4bbde560cd5a4e971262dae43aa3b024301.sourceText: 养狗的朋友们，在后院给狗洗澡时要当心蜜蜂哟。 即使你不养狗，假如你用了太香的洗髮乳洗你自己的头，出门时也最好戴个帽子，以免招蜂引蝶， 万一蜜蜂来了，你可没有狗战友在旁和你并肩作战，转移蜜蜂的注意力了。
2347e4bbde560cd5a4e971262dae43aa3b024301.translatedText: Dog owners, beware of bees when bathing your dog in the backyard. Even if you don't own a dog, if you wash your head with too fragrant shampoo, you'd better wear a hat when you go out to avoid attracting bees and butterflies. If bees come, you don't have a dog comrade to fight alongside you and divert the bees' attention.

1ca6644d67947df5acf26a281b7e60216770f1ea.sourceText: ​ 2020年1月25日亚省春晚在美莎艺术中心成功举办。1月26日某微信平台刊登了一则未证实的虚假消息。
1ca6644d67947df5acf26a281b7e60216770f1ea.translatedText: ​ On January 25, 2020, the Alberta Spring Festival Gala was successfully held at the Meisha Art Center. On January 26, an unconfirmed false news was published on a WeChat platform.

095ee030b0d027a95791c0e1f4743651ab1589cf.sourceText: 该平台在未经证实的情况发送有关疫情的假消息，引起当地华人的恐慌，在被多人投诉后，该平台发出了澄清消息。
095ee030b0d027a95791c0e1f4743651ab1589cf.translatedText: The platform sent unconfirmed false news about the epidemic, causing panic among the local Chinese people. After being complained by many people, the platform issued a clarification message.

ee4fe1c1e4bdbbf3cb3fe9f5bbedc45ded9e128c.sourceText: 本着对活动参与者与观众负责的态度，主办方第一时间联系了美国公共卫生最权威机构CDC， CDC表示该ASU发现的武汉肺炎确诊病例以及接触的人员所到地点和活动，CDC都会第一时间直接联系负责人进行调查，ASU武汉肺炎患者以及所有接触人员，均未参加过”亚省春晚”。虽然近几天通过私信方式通知了部分参与者实情，但是还有很多观众被这个谣言困扰，特此公告根据CDC的信息，”ASU武汉肺炎患者以及所有接触人员，均未参加过亚省春晚”。
ee4fe1c1e4bdbbf3cb3fe9f5bbedc45ded9e128c.translatedText: In line with the attitude of being responsible for event participants and audiences, the organizer immediately contacted the CDC, the most authoritative public health agency in the United States. The CDC stated that the CDC would directly contact the person in charge to investigate the confirmed cases of Wuhan pneumonia discovered by the ASU and the locations and activities of the people who came into contact with them as soon as possible. None of the ASU Wuhan pneumonia patients and all contacts had participated in the "Alberta Spring Festival Gala". Although some participants have been notified of the truth through private messages in recent days, many viewers are still troubled by this rumor. It is hereby announced that based on information from the CDC, "ASU Wuhan pneumonia patients and all contacts have not participated in the Alberta Spring Festival Gala."

39289e02c49b746753060f440deac83f547583f4.sourceText: 在国内疫情非常时期，发布、传播谣言是极其无耻且扰乱正常社会秩序的行为，主办方对传播谣言的平台和个人保留法律诉讼的权力。
39289e02c49b746753060f440deac83f547583f4.translatedText: During the extraordinary period of the domestic epidemic, publishing and spreading rumors are extremely shameless and disruptive to normal social order. The organizer reserves the right to take legal action against platforms and individuals who spread rumors.

c10d1a21b6b0dd052a9392d3b719878e058c17c7.sourceText: 经过与CDC，已经亚省公共卫生机构的咨询，亚利桑那州目前是安全的，感染风险很低，请华人朋友自己保护好在多元文化社区的形象，不造谣，不恐慌，保持合理的卫生安全行为。
c10d1a21b6b0dd052a9392d3b719878e058c17c7.translatedText: After consultation with the CDC and the Alberta Public Health Agency, Arizona is currently safe and the risk of infection is very low. Chinese friends please protect your image in the multicultural community, do not spread rumors, do not panic, and maintain reasonable health and safety behaviors.

2feac8815ca60e87fb42b97494759301167727b8.sourceText: 各位媒体朋友，凤凰城台湾同乡联谊会会员，朋友们：
2feac8815ca60e87fb42b97494759301167727b8.translatedText: Dear friends from the media, members of the Phoenix Taiwan Association, friends:

66462fe848ca9b1443f980cf896fd92ed9ce1fe7.sourceText: 鑑于近日台湾爆发大学生闯入立法院议场、倒挂国旗、拆立院名匾，千人占据立院和议场，少数学生甚至要求马英九道歉、江宜桦下台、警察退出国会。最高民意机关出这种丑事，让台湾民主再次蒙羞。全美台湾同乡联谊会为此发出严正声明，谴责议场乱局，支持马英九总统、也支持服贸协议。 感谢王福权前会长，黄伟悌前会长共同协助撰写全美台湾同乡联谊会对此事件之严正声明，谨附上本会严正声明，敬请所有台湾同鄕联谊会会员，媒体，朋友们能共同谴责「民进党以少数霸凌多数，杯葛法桉审查在先，煽动学生佔领立院，製造社会动乱在后」。同时本会支持政府拿出维护社会法治的决心，推动对台湾真正有益的服务贸易协定。
66462fe848ca9b1443f980cf896fd92ed9ce1fe7.translatedText: In view of the recent outbreak in Taiwan of college students breaking into the Legislative Yuan, hanging the national flag upside down, and tearing down the Legislative Yuan plaque. Thousands of people occupied the Legislative Yuan and the chamber. A few students even asked Ma Ying-jeou to apologize, Jiang Yihua to step down, and the police to withdraw from Congress. Such a scandal at the highest public opinion organ has once again brought disgrace to Taiwan's democracy. The National Taiwan Association issued a solemn statement condemning the chaos at the meeting, supporting President Ma Ying-jeou and the Trade in Services Agreement. Thanks to former President Wang Fuquan and former President Huang Weiti for jointly assisting in writing the solemn statement of the Taiwanese Association of America on this incident. I would like to attach the solemn statement of this association. We kindly ask all Taiwanese Association members, media, and friends to jointly condemn "the DPP uses a minority to bully the majority, boycotts laws and censorship first, incites students to occupy the Legislative Yuan, and creates social unrest later." At the same time, this association supports the government's determination to safeguard the rule of law in society and promote a services trade agreement that is truly beneficial to Taiwan.

3f5f5a49570cc53c399f1ff5d37279b7e1df99a9.sourceText: 凤凰城台湾同乡联谊会会长

4602850722dd8a7c9378cee526ecb2e4e035fabf.sourceText: 全美台湾同乡联谊会一向以「时时关心台湾，处处服务同乡」为宗旨，三十六年来结合认同台湾之乡亲，除了在侨居地守望相助之外，并同时坚决支持中华民国政府。全美台湾同乡联谊会针对近日立院乱局作出严厉的谴责，发表以下严正声明：
4602850722dd8a7c9378cee526ecb2e4e035fabf.translatedText: >The National Taiwanese Friendship Association has always been "caring about Taiwan at all times and serving fellow countrymen everywhere" as its purpose. For 36 years, it has united and identified with fellow Taiwanese. In addition to helping each other in the places where overseas Chinese live, it also firmly supports the government of the Republic of China. The Taiwan Association of America severely condemned the recent chaos in the Legislative Yuan and issued the following solemn statement:

67a60aab0caa4df8729a15b4e74ac4ee35b22690.sourceText: 学生立院暴行引发我们对台湾民主政治发展前景的担忧。即使服贸协议有争议，民主的精神与理性的态度还是需要遵守。受过高等教育的大学生，有不同政治社会诉求，应以理性表达，不得用暴力方式对民选政府进行抗争，贻笑大方。 立院乱局已使台湾再跃登国际新闻舞台，成为外媒讨论关注对象。从国内或海外看，或许有不同感受或结论，但对台湾，它绝不是一个正向的发展。事件爆发后，海内外媒体报导民主最高殿堂竟被学生们占据，国会尊严荡然无存，我们认为其行径何异于民粹暴民？ 服贸协议争论中，台湾的民主被民粹意识利用。世界各国都在争市场、台湾却在争议场；世界各国在拚经济，台湾朝野却在拚政治。台湾经济本来就低迷不振，若服贸协议处理不好，将是雪上加霜，不但使台湾民主再受重创，我们想问沉迷政治内耗的台湾，何时能拨云见日？
67a60aab0caa4df8729a15b4e74ac4ee35b22690.translatedText: The atrocities committed by students in the Legislative Yuan have caused us to worry about the prospects for the development of Taiwan's democratic politics. Even if the Services Trade Agreement is controversial, the democratic spirit and rational attitude still need to be observed. College students with higher education have different political and social demands, and they should express them rationally and not use violence to resist the democratically elected government, which is ridiculous. The chaos in the Legislative Yuan has once again made Taiwan appear on the international news stage and become the subject of discussion and attention by foreign media. From domestic or overseas perspectives, there may be different feelings or conclusions, but for Taiwan, it is by no means a positive development. After the incident broke out, media reports at home and abroad reported that the highest palace of democracy was occupied by students, and that the dignity of the Congress was gone. How do we think its behavior is different from a populist mob? During the debate on the Trade in Services Agreement, Taiwan’s democracy was exploited by populist consciousness. Countries around the world are competing for the market, but Taiwan is in the middle of controversy; countries around the world are competing for the economy, but Taiwan's government and opposition parties are competing for politics. Taiwan's economy is already in a sluggish state. If the trade in services agreement is not handled well, it will make matters worse. Not only will Taiwan's democracy suffer another heavy blow, we would like to ask when Taiwan, which is obsessed with internal political strife, will see the light of day.

a3ed43a8d999d42ddd422266d039230d34319965.sourceText: 全美台湾同乡联谊会期望反服贸团体及学生为其行为负责。 因此，我们公开作出以下严正要求： 反对党及在野人士利用学生遂行政治目的，其心可诛。我们呼吁反服贸团体及学生应就以非民主、非理性的方式去践踏国会尊严，去伤害执法人员，去羞辱国家的元首与阁揆行为，向社会作出公开道歉，并儘速离开国会议场。 滋事学生代表与反对党领袖尽快对话，同时我们也呼吁反对党领袖儘速与执政党领袖举行服贸协议辩论会，让全民更了解服贸协议全面内容，而不至于有所畏惧。我们呼吁王金平院长从捍卫国会尊严的角度行使警察权，国会尊严不是蓝绿或是意识形态之争的问题，它是捍卫民主价值之争，国会必须早日恢复议事运作，朝野应共襄盛举。 服贸协议是攸关国家未来经贸竞争力，也是我国进一步迈向自由化与国际化的重要步骤。我们支持两岸服贸协议，也认为这是台湾经济发展所必要的。台湾的服务业必须国际化，我们全力支持服贸协议。
a3ed43a8d999d42ddd422266d039230d34319965.translatedText: The National Taiwan Association hopes that anti-service trade groups and students will be responsible for their actions. Therefore, we publicly make the following strict demands: Opposition parties and opposition parties use students to achieve political purposes, and their intentions are punishable. We call on the anti-service trade groups and students to make a public apology to the society for trampling on the dignity of Congress, harming law enforcement officers, and humiliating the head of state and ministers in an undemocratic and irrational manner, and to leave the Congress venue as soon as possible. Representatives of the troubled students have dialogue with the leader of the opposition party as soon as possible. At the same time, we also call on the leader of the opposition party to hold a debate on the Trade in Services Agreement with the leader of the ruling party as soon as possible so that the whole people can better understand the comprehensive content of the Trade in Services Agreement and not be afraid. We call on President Wang Jinping to exercise police power from the perspective of safeguarding the dignity of the Congress. The dignity of the Congress is not a matter of blue-green or ideological battles. It is a battle to defend democratic values. Congress must resume its deliberations as soon as possible, and the government and the opposition should join in the grand event. The Trade in Services Agreement is related to the country’s future economic and trade competitiveness, and is also an important step for my country to further move towards liberalization and internationalization. We support the cross-strait trade in services agreement and believe it is necessary for Taiwan's economic development. Taiwan's service industry must be internationalized, and we fully support the Trade in Services Agreement.

419f555678e4ecb0a7ff0f1a0a26ef255bd75b77.sourceText: 祝融横行 佩森、拉文又起火头 周日下午，消防员接到报案，新的野火在佩森的Apache-Sitgreaves国家森林开始燃烧，起火地点属黑梅沙护林区。野火在佩森东北边44英里处，离熊谷湖约一英里。火势朝东北方向，第一天燃烧了约500英亩。 消防局说，大风助长了野火，对灭火有一定困难。同时，因为大风，直升飞机也无法加入消防行列。 周一，在凤凰城西南的希拉(Gila)河印第安人保留区也燃起山火。 当局把此火命名为”Dobbins火”，在Dobbins和83rd一带，属拉拉文（Laveen）范围，靠近凤凰城地界。 大火烧毁了75英亩，所幸的是消防员已在周一晚将火控制。
419f555678e4ecb0a7ff0f1a0a26ef255bd75b77.translatedText: Another wildfire broke out in Payson and La Verne. On Sunday afternoon, firefighters received reports of a new wildfire burning in the Apache-Sitgreaves National Forest in Payson, within the Black Mesa Range Area. The wildfire is 44 miles northeast of Payson and about a mile from Bear Valley Lake. The fire headed northeast and burned about 500 acres on the first day. The fire department said strong winds fueled the wildfires, making it difficult to extinguish them. At the same time, due to strong winds, helicopters were unable to join the firefighting ranks. On Monday, a wildfire also broke out on the Gila River Indian Reservation southwest of Phoenix. Authorities named the fire the "Dobbins Fire" in the area of ​​Dobbins and 83rd in Laveen, near Phoenix. The fire burned 75 acres, but firefighters were able to contain the blaze by Monday night.

Schumer's suggestion was immediately rejected by the Speaker of the House of Representatives.

9cc779b52726c2235eeefc9f047c1051a2dea40e.sourceText: 《非诚勿扰》走向海外中国式相亲为海外华人认同 据中国之声《全球华语广播网》报道，最近，江苏卫视《非诚勿扰》把触角伸向了海外，相继在澳大利亚、美国开设了专场，反响热烈；英国专场也在紧张筹备中。 欧洲的俊男靓女，能否接受《非诚勿扰》式的相亲方法？ 接下来我们连线《全球华语广播网》比利时观察员刘杨。 主持人：我们知道这个《非诚勿扰》这个节目在中国是很有市场的一个节目在欧洲是不是也特别受到关注呢？ 刘杨：《非诚勿扰》这个栏目生活在海外的华人华侨观众还是比较多的，很多人在业余的时间都在网上，甚至如果在家里能够有收到咱们国内电视台的节目，大家也都会 关注一些，特别是年轻男女，这回《非诚勿扰》来到欧洲，录制了一场别开生面的海外华人单身的相亲会。 确实也引起比较不小的关注，这种形式大家还是挺喜欢，只不过平常忙于工作，忙于学习，很多华人忘记了还有这样的一个好的方式，也是提醒在海外的华文媒体是不是也可以 办一些类似的相亲会什么的。 主持人：我们很想知道，欧洲华人对《非诚勿扰》这种相亲择偶方式是否认同？ 他们在择偶的观念方面与国内有什么不同呢？ 刘杨：男大当婚，女大当嫁，这是放之四海皆准的道理。 生活在海外的华人男女们同样也是面临着寻找自己另一半，完成自己终身大事的艰巨任务。 所以像《非诚勿扰》这样的相亲方式，海外华人基本上还是认可的，比如说这次报名参加节目的男女嘉宾大多都是在海外有长期的生活背景，而且有高学历，很多人在事业 上小有成就，虽然长期在海外生活学习，接受着不同体制的教育，吸收着不同文化的思想。 但是实际上，生活在海外华人的这些单身男女们，他们的择偶观并没有质的改变。 先来聊一聊女孩子们，生活在海外单身的女孩子们，在国人想象当中，好像很多人会觉得这些女孩很容易找到一位外国先生，可实际上由于文化、语言诸多背景上的差异 和不同，使得越来越多华人单身女性更倾向于找有着相似的生活环境和文化背景的中国男士，因为她们认为这样有助于两个人的想法更加融合，沟通更为容易。 还有一部分华人女性是受着自己家庭传统教育的影响，希望自己的另一半有爱心、有责任感，然后爱情能够一生一世，而且很多父母们不太赞成自己生活在海外的子女们找老外，这 也反映出中国人传统上一些家庭观念，比如说孝顺、雇家和易交流是考虑最多的因素。 当然较之国内的环境之下，国内的很多女性过于看重物质层面上的要求，很多留洋的女性反而不是那么现实，她们则更看重精神层次上的追求。 相对于华人女性比较传统观念的来讲，生活在海外的华人单身男士就更为传统，甚至可以用保守来形容，他们现在大多秉承两个方面的择偶标准，一方面他们要看女方与自己父母 辈的交流，中国人讲”百善孝为先”，即便中国男孩子认识了许多各个方面条件比较优秀的外国女孩，但是考虑到将来与自己父母语言沟通还有包括生活方式等方方面面的因素，这些 华人男生在择偶的时候就会倾向无沟通障碍的华人女性。 第二个标准，很多华人男士都有着娶妻要娶温柔贤惠的传统家庭观念，因为在部分华人男士的印象里，相对西方女的独立和自主来讲，温柔贤惠的华人女孩就更能够担当起 贤内助的角色，营造一种轻松的家庭氛围，而且这正是华人男士们所企盼的。 受生长教育环境的影响，西方女性更加独立自主，个人意识较强，不愿意过多的为男性改变，为家庭付出。 综上所述，无论男女生活在海外的华人单身人士，在选择伴侣的时候都有一个共同的标准，那就是有着相似生环境，相近的文化背景和价值观，而相对于国内的一些年轻人来 说，海外的华人单身男女们更加注重男生、女生之间精神层次的交流和生活模式的合拍。
9cc779b52726c2235eeefc9f047c1051a2dea40e.translatedText: "If You Are the One" Goes Overseas Chinese-style blind dates are recognized by overseas Chinese. According to Voice of China's Global Chinese Broadcasting Network, Jiangsu Satellite TV's "If You Are the One" has recently extended its tentacles overseas, opening special shows in Australia and the United States, and the response has been enthusiastic; the British special show is also under intense preparation. Can handsome men and beautiful women in Europe accept the "If You Are the One" style blind date method? Next, we connect with Liu Yang, the Belgian observer of "Global Chinese Broadcasting Network". Host: We know that the program "If You Are the One" is very popular in China. Is it also attracting special attention in Europe? Liu Yang: The program "If You Are the One" has a relatively large audience of overseas Chinese. Many people spend their spare time online. Even if they can receive programs from our domestic TV stations at home, everyone will pay attention to them, especially young men and women. This time, "If You Are the One" came to Europe and recorded a unique blind date meeting for overseas Chinese singles. It has indeed attracted a lot of attention. Everyone still likes this format. However, they are usually busy with work and study. Many Chinese people have forgotten that there is such a good way. It also reminds overseas Chinese media whether they can also organize some similar blind dates and so on. Host: We would like to know whether European Chinese agree with the dating and mate selection method of "If You Are the One"? How are their concepts of mate selection different from those in China? Liu Yang: Men should marry when they are older, and women should marry when they are older. This is a universal truth. Chinese men and women living overseas are also faced with the arduous task of finding their significant other and completing their lifelong events. Therefore, dating methods like "If You Are the One" are basically recognized by overseas Chinese. For example, most of the male and female guests who signed up for the show have long-term living backgrounds overseas and are highly educated. Many of them have achieved modest success in their careers. Although they have lived and studied overseas for a long time, they have received education from different systems and absorbed ideas from different cultures. But in fact, there has been no qualitative change in the views of single men and women living overseas on mate selection. Let’s talk about girls first. Single girls living overseas. In Chinese imagination, many people seem to think that it is easy for these girls to find a foreign gentleman. However, in fact, due to the differences in culture and language, more and more single Chinese women are more inclined to find Chinese men with similar living environment and cultural background, because they believe that this will help the two people’s ideas to be more integrated and communication easier. There are also some Chinese women who are influenced by the traditional education of their families. They hope that their significant other will be caring and responsible, and love will last a lifetime. Moreover, many parents do not approve of their children living overseas finding foreigners. This also reflects some traditional Chinese family concepts, such as filial piety, employment and ease of communication are the most important factors. Of course, compared with the domestic environment, many women in China place too much emphasis on material requirements. Many women who study abroad are not so realistic, and they pay more attention to spiritual pursuits. Compared with Chinese women who have more traditional ideas, Chinese single men living overseas are more traditional, and can even be described as conservative. Most of them now adhere to two standards for choosing a spouse. On the one hand, they depend on the woman's communication with her parents. The Chinese say "filial piety comes first". Even if Chinese boys know many foreign girls with better conditions in all aspects, considering the language communication with their parents in the future and other factors including lifestyle, these When choosing a mate, Chinese boys tend to prefer Chinese women who have no communication barriers. The second criterion is that many Chinese men have the traditional family concept of marrying a gentle and virtuous wife, because in the impression of some Chinese men, compared with the independence and autonomy of Western women, gentle and virtuous Chinese girls are more able to play the role of virtuous wives and create a relaxed family atmosphere, and this is exactly what Chinese men want. Affected by the environment in which they grew up and educated, Western women are more independent, have strong personal awareness, and are unwilling to change too much for men and contribute to the family. To sum up, regardless of whether Chinese single men or women living overseas have a common criterion when choosing a partner, they have a similar living environment, similar cultural background and values. Compared with some young people in China, overseas Chinese single men and women pay more attention to the spiritual communication between boys and girls and the compatibility of life styles.

c67cf4e153f6c2bdf1e6256e86759771a70bc365.sourceText: 上週，希尔斯因假日销售效能骤降，关闭100至120家希尔斯百货和K市场的消息传出，华尔街乃至普罗大众着实吓了一跳。 根据12月29日公佈的第一批关闭门店，包括希尔斯和K市场，共有79家商店倒闭，亚利桑那州没有涉及在内。 佛罗里达州有11家希尔斯和Kmart被关闭，每家门店有40至80名僱员，受灾最惨重。
c67cf4e153f6c2bdf1e6256e86759771a70bc365.translatedText: Last week, news broke that Sears would close 100 to 120 Sears department stores and K markets due to a sharp drop in holiday sales performance. Wall Street and even the general public were really shocked. According to the first batch of store closings announced on December 29, including Hills and K Market, a total of 79 stores have closed, and Arizona is not involved. Eleven Sears and Kmart stores were closed in Florida, with 40 to 80 employees at each store, and were the hardest hit.

e597ac5ce5a98d3bb906c7fd6f1880216e6f891f.sourceText: 亚美报社长王淑英的追悼大会隆重举行 [亚省时报] 八月二十一日，亚美报社长王淑英的追悼大会在斯科茨代尔绿园墓地隆重举行。会堂两边摆满了花圈，在王淑英的棺木旁，挂着马英九发来的唁电，称她为：”遗范犹存”。侨界各个团体，淑英的生前好友等，都含泪来为她作最后的送别。会堂坐满了来宾，两边走道还加了座位，即便这样，坐的人还是站的人多。很多的人只能站在门外。整整三个小时，人们聆听了王淑英生前为侨社，为中文学校，为慈善机构等所作的杰出贡献。她做义工涉及的范围之广，她助人为乐的各种美好品德，以及她作为报人的尽职尽责，使每一个人都深深地怀念她，赞美她，并异口同声地表达了痛失她以后的深深不舍。
e597ac5ce5a98d3bb906c7fd6f1880216e6f891f.translatedText: The memorial service for Asian American Newspaper President Wang Shuying was held grandly [Alberta Times] On August 21, the memorial service for Asian American Newspaper President Wang Shuying was held grandly at Green Garden Cemetery in Scottsdale. Both sides of the auditorium were filled with wreaths. Next to Wang Shuying's coffin, a condolence message from Ma Ying-jeou was hung, calling her: "The legacy remains." Various groups in the overseas Chinese community and Shuying's former friends came to pay her last farewell with tears in their eyes. The auditorium was full of guests, and there were extra seats in the aisles on both sides. Even so, there were still more people sitting than standing. Many people could only stand outside the door. For three hours, people listened to Wang Shuying’s outstanding contributions to overseas Chinese communities, Chinese schools, and charitable organizations during her lifetime. The wide range of her volunteer work, her various good qualities of helping others, and her conscientiousness as a newspaper reporter made everyone deeply miss her, praise her, and unanimously expressed their deep regret after losing her.

04654944ceb699717f92fec2295cf461d44b9ac0.sourceText: （太阳鸟亚省华人网报道）2012年4月7日-8日洛杉矶领事馆证件组工作人员到亚利桑那图桑市华人文化中心在美中国公民换发和补发中国护照。截止到4月8日上午11时左右，已经为100多个家庭提供了服务。
04654944ceb699717f92fec2295cf461d44b9ac0.translatedText: (Reported by Sunbird Asia Chinese Network) On April 7th and 8th, 2012, staff from the Documentation Section of the Los Angeles Consulate went to the Chinese Cultural Center in Tucson, Arizona to renew and reissue Chinese passports to Chinese citizens in the United States. As of around 11 a.m. on April 8, more than 100 families had been provided with services.

8aed9bf0380c61445b1ad088721412a2407fc87a.sourceText: 4 月8日上午9时10分本网站记者，开车近两个小时，到达换照现场进行采访。走进图桑市华人文化中心。换照的场地，宽敞，舒适井然有序，更换护照的要求贴在大厅内醒目的位置，两位工作人员在门口为前来办理护照的中国公民取号。记者看到来办证的人，十几分钟就能顺利的办完。费用一共是60美元一本，没有任何额外的服务费用。
8aed9bf0380c61445b1ad088721412a2407fc87a.translatedText: At 9:10 a.m. on April 8, our reporter drove for nearly two hours to arrive at the license renewal site for an interview. Enter the Tucson Chinese Cultural Center. The venue for passport replacement is spacious, comfortable and orderly. The requirements for passport replacement are posted in a conspicuous position in the hall. Two staff members are at the door to take numbers for Chinese citizens who come to apply for passports. The reporter saw that the people who came to apply for the certificate could successfully complete the application in ten minutes. The total cost is $60 per book, with no additional service fees.

b554bae2eebc1c687ad01b20e09f5f9710c92c21.sourceText: 记者在办证的外围现场了解到，当地华人们在感谢总领事馆为他们提供便利的同时，也产生了以下一些疑问和不满。
b554bae2eebc1c687ad01b20e09f5f9710c92c21.translatedText: The reporter learned at the outskirts of the visa application area that while the local Chinese people thanked the Consulate General for providing them with convenience, they also had the following questions and dissatisfaction.

70ce87341f5d1319d123ab2728310cb4ef149869.sourceText: 第一、办证点只选图桑市，而取消了凤凰城，是否合理（近二十年来都是凤凰城当地办理）？
70ce87341f5d1319d123ab2728310cb4ef149869.translatedText: First, is it reasonable to choose only Tucson as the certification point and cancel Phoenix (for the past twenty years, it has been handled locally in Phoenix)?

b0eab782e2e5eded785221001cb91def8e40320a.sourceText: 记者采访了前来换照的一位大叔，大叔说他是从凤凰城来的，早上6点半从家出发，8点半到达了办照地点，与他同来的还有老伴和外孙和外孙女。记者好奇，为什么把外孙和外孙女也带来了？大叔说儿女都很忙，他们只能自己开车来，可是路太远，他们也不太熟悉，怕英文的路看不清楚，特地带外孙和外孙女来指路的。另一位从凤凰城来的朋友，表示就是路途远了点，前几年都是在凤凰城都可以办，不知道为什么今年不在凤凰城办了。当记者问他遇到的人是来自凤凰城的多，还是图桑当地的多?他表示他遇到的凤凰城来的人多一些。图桑当地负责人图桑中文学校校长雷宏介绍，总领馆也就凤凰城来图桑换证问题，咨询过他很多详细情况，例如来图桑的路怎么走，要花多长时间，换证广告是否有在凤凰城刊发，图桑换证地点对来访者是否好找等等。8日下午为了让从凤凰城来的市民早点回去，他们也安排了凤凰城的优先办理等特别的待遇。但是记者从大部分来办证者那里了解到，他们觉得路途还是远了一些。
b0eab782e2e5eded785221001cb91def8e40320a.translatedText: The reporter interviewed an uncle who came to renew his license. The uncle said that he came from Phoenix. He set off from home at 6:30 in the morning and arrived at the license application location at 8:30. He was accompanied by his wife, grandson and granddaughter. The reporter was curious, why did you bring your grandson and granddaughter? The uncle said that his children were very busy, so they had no choice but to drive there by themselves, but the road was too far and they were not familiar with it. They were afraid that the road in English would not be clear, so he specially brought his grandson and granddaughter to guide him. Another friend who came from Phoenix said that it was just a long way away. In previous years, it could be done in Phoenix. I don’t know why it can’t be done in Phoenix this year. When a reporter asked him whether he met more people from Phoenix or from Tucson, he said he met more people from Phoenix. Lei Hong, the local person in charge of Tucson and the principal of Tucson Chinese School, said that the Consulate General also consulted him on many details about the issue of certificate renewal in Tucson from Phoenix, such as how to get to Tucson, how long it takes, whether advertisements for certificate renewal are published in Phoenix, whether the Tucson certificate renewal location is easy for visitors to find, etc. On the afternoon of the 8th, in order to allow citizens coming from Phoenix to go back early, they also arranged special treatment such as priority processing in Phoenix. However, the reporter learned from most of the people who came to apply for the certificate that they felt that the journey was still a long way.

64265de6a69bccdf0331677382c1d03e83e86576.sourceText: 根据2010年的人口普查，凤凰城占了亚利桑那华人人口的90%。由于绝大多数华人都居住在凤凰城地区，所以以往办证都会选在凤凰城的中国文化中心和图桑两地进行。但是今年却只在图桑办理。让90%的人都来回开上四小时车，来图桑换证，是不是最优的地点选择呢？
64265de6a69bccdf0331677382c1d03e83e86576.translatedText: According to the 2010 census, Phoenix accounts for 90% of Arizona's Chinese population. Since the vast majority of Chinese people live in the Phoenix area, in the past, the application process was done at the Chinese Cultural Center in Phoenix and Tucson. But this year it is only available in Tucson. Is it the best choice for 90% of people to drive four hours back and forth to come to Tucson to renew their certificate?

f7c321e9a442a5b92ba2770ba5da53aa71e808f9.sourceText: 第二、总领事馆办证工作人员拒绝接受采访，记者无法进入办证现场。
f7c321e9a442a5b92ba2770ba5da53aa71e808f9.translatedText: Second, the certificate processing staff of the Consulate General refused to be interviewed, and reporters were unable to enter the certificate application site.

4efe4886672aa8e018f5ec24901004ed243e4e38.sourceText: 当记者找到换照当地负责人图桑中文学校校长雷宏，想就是否会考虑到凤凰城换护照的问题，采访前来办护照的领事，雷校长说领事们不便与媒体接触。
4efe4886672aa8e018f5ec24901004ed243e4e38.translatedText: When the reporter approached Lei Hong, the local person in charge of the passport renewal, the principal of Tucson Chinese School, and wanted to discuss whether he would consider renewing his passport in Phoenix, and interviewed the consul who came to apply for the passport, Principal Lei said that it was inconvenient for the consuls to contact the media.

1922bfb560f9ac4d8e975951cb613303c8f91d66.sourceText: 第三、凤凰城地区许多华人华侨团体的负责人都曾经联系过总领事馆，希望他们能到凤凰城来办理，但至今没有得到是否继续来的明确答复。
1922bfb560f9ac4d8e975951cb613303c8f91d66.translatedText: Third, many heads of overseas Chinese groups in the Phoenix area have contacted the Consulate General, hoping that they can come to Phoenix for processing, but so far they have not received a clear answer on whether they will continue to come.

a5da1137deab5dc6e1f032fa09f93666162573ce.sourceText: 据记者了解，凤凰城的耆英会老年人中心和 中国科学家工程师专业人士协会凤凰城分会（科工专 ） 都与领事馆签证组联系过，希望证件组能像往年一样在凤凰城为当地华人提供换护照的服务。由于去年 ”华联风波” 和随后引发的 ”换护照风波” （详情请点击链接）。有消息称：总领馆希望最好能让”华联”和”华总”坐到一起，联合起来办这件事。我们不禁要问：如果他们没有联合起来做这件事情，总领事馆就不再在凤凰城为我们华人服务了？难道普通志愿者或者其他社团就没有资格来为社区服务，办好这件事吗？
a5da1137deab5dc6e1f032fa09f93666162573ce.translatedText: According to the reporter’s understanding, the Senior Citizen Center in Phoenix and the Phoenix branch of the Chinese Association of Scientists and Engineers (Science and Engineering Professionals) have both contacted the visa team of the consulate, hoping that the document team can provide passport replacement services for local Chinese in Phoenix as in previous years. Due to last year’s “Hualian incident” and the subsequent “passport replacement incident” (please click on the link for details). Sources say that the Consulate General hopes that it would be best if "Hualien" and "Hua Zong" can sit together and work together to handle this matter. We can’t help but ask: If they had not united to do this, would the Consulate General no longer serve us Chinese in Phoenix? Are ordinary volunteers or other organizations not qualified to serve the community and do this well?

eb74386424ac73f1f47c3cb8c3ca988135a9b108.sourceText: 总领馆至今仍对今年来凤凰城换护照持观望态度。
eb74386424ac73f1f47c3cb8c3ca988135a9b108.translatedText: The Consulate General still has a wait-and-see attitude towards coming to Phoenix to renew a passport this year.

33fc4edb6f64ba3b54a5360f0d27ea7f53588050.sourceText: 保障海外华人的利益，切实为华人服务，不是我们共同的目标吗？ 近二十年来，洛杉机总领事馆来凤凰城换护照的便民工作都做得很好，我们现在都在努力把这一传统保持下去。（完）
33fc4edb6f64ba3b54a5360f0d27ea7f53588050.translatedText: Protecting the interests of overseas Chinese and effectively serving the Chinese, isn’t it our common goal? Over the past two decades, the Consulate General in Los Angeles has done a great job in providing convenience for passport renewal in Phoenix, and we are now working hard to maintain this tradition. (over)

ead33b7dcfa6698535efef7eb5874696089187f7.sourceText: 边界巡逻员再传殉职 另一人受伤 联邦当局正在调查周二发生在亚利桑那州与墨西哥边境地区的枪击事件，此事造成了一位联邦边界巡逻员死亡，另一位人员受伤。 隶属布赖恩特里边境巡逻站三名巡逻员周二凌晨在距图森100英里的纳科沙漠巡逻时，发现地面传感器被触动后，三位巡逻员骑马前往查看，在距边界五英里处遭到攻击，30岁的尼古拉斯艾维恩被杀，他的一名同事脚踝和臀部受伤，第三名没有受伤。受伤的巡逻员已进当地医院。 联邦调查局和科奇斯郡警长办公室在周二下午在纳科召开新闻发布会，FBI官员说，调查局和当地警方出动四架直升机，越野车，大量骑警在犯罪现场搜索，可能需要数天才能完成报告。发言人拒绝透露调查人员是否收回枪弹壳，只说没有逮捕任何人，但当局怀疑对方不止一人开火射击巡逻员。 海关执法和边境保护局亚利桑那指挥官对艾维恩的遗孀和两名年幼女儿表示慰问，白宫在当日也向艾维恩家庭送来美国总统奥巴马的吊唁，奥巴马总统在信中说：”为艾维恩无私服务他的国家感到骄傲。”并表示，当局”正在尽一切所能，找到责任人。” 布赖恩特里巡逻站坐落在比斯比市，是在本州东南方，离凤凰城约210公里。该巡逻站两周前才刚以殉职的前边境巡逻员布赖恩特里的名字重新命名。 这是巡逻队自2010年与墨西哥帮派分子交火以来，首次发生巡逻队员遇难事件。亚省巡逻员布赖恩特里于2010年12月在相同的地区被杀害，引发国会和司法部的调查。因为美国联邦机构的一个失败的”速度与激情”（Fast and Furious）枪支追踪计划导致2,000支枪落入墨西哥贩毒集团和其他犯罪分子的手中。其中的两支枪在特里的谋杀被发现。 美国政府将成千上万的传感器安装在边境线，以防偷渡客，一旦传感器发出警报，巡逻员立即赶往该地点执行任务。自2002年以来，已有26个边境巡逻人员在执行任务中死亡。
ead33b7dcfa6698535efef7eb5874696089187f7.translatedText: A Border Patrol agent was reportedly killed in the line of duty and another was injured. Federal authorities are investigating a shooting on the Arizona-Mexico border on Tuesday that left a federal Border Patrol agent dead and another injured. Three patrol agents from the Bryant Terry Border Patrol Station were on patrol in the Naco Desert, 100 miles from Tucson, early Tuesday morning when they discovered that ground sensors had been triggered. The three patrol agents rode out to check and were attacked five miles from the border. Nicholas Avian, 30, was killed and one of his colleagues was injured in the ankle and hip. The third was not injured. The injured patrolman was admitted to a local hospital. The FBI and the Cochise County Sheriff's Office held a press conference in Naco on Tuesday afternoon. FBI officials said that the Bureau of Investigation and local police dispatched four helicopters, off-road vehicles, and a large number of mounted police officers to search the crime scene, and it may take several days to complete the report. The spokesman declined to say whether investigators had recovered gun shell casings, saying only that no arrests had been made, but authorities suspected that more than one person opened fire on the patrolman. The Arizona commander of Customs Enforcement and Border Protection expressed condolences to Ivian's widow and two young daughters. The White House also sent U.S. President Obama's condolences to Ivian's family on the same day. President Obama said in the letter: "I am proud of Ivian's selfless service to his country." The patrol station was renamed just two weeks ago after former Border Patrol Agent Brian Terry who was killed in the line of duty. This is the first time a patrol member has been killed since the patrol began fighting with Mexican gangs in 2010. Alberta ranger Brian Terry was killed in the same area in December 2010, sparking investigations by Congress and the Department of Justice. A failed "Fast and Furious" gun-tracing program by U.S. federal agencies resulted in 2,000 guns falling into the hands of Mexican drug cartels and other criminals. Two of the guns were found in Terry's murder. The U.S. government has installed thousands of sensors along the border to prevent illegal immigrants. Once the sensors sound an alarm, patrol officers immediately rush to the location to perform their tasks. Since 2002, 26 Border Patrol agents have died in the line of duty.

89f131044149068a65ddb8934c4f2bc67cf0a63e.sourceText: 中秋自己动手做月饼—- 新东方文化讲坛中秋文化系列讲座之一 中秋自已动手做月饼 新东方文化讲坛中秋文化系列讲座之一 张琳老师在给大家讲解月饼的制作过程 金秋已至，佳节将临，华人社区十分热闹，人们已经开始以各种形式迎接和庆祝着我们中国人的传统佳节。有的举行中秋国庆招待会，有的搞娱乐茶话会。而新东方文化讲坛推出的由陈普老师主讲的中秋文化系列讲座的活动更显得别具一格。中秋文化讲座的第一次活动内容是”自己动手做月饼”。 做好的月饼 中秋前夕，9月21周五晚上，由陈普老师的夫人张琳老师教大家自己动手制作月饼。张琳老师和另外两位朋友带来了早就揉好的面和拌好的豆沙、五仁馅。张老师现场教大家包馅、压模、烤制。朋友们相继品尝了冰皮和烤制的两种月饼。陈普老师还为大家带来了一种极品茉莉花茶让大家品尝。朋友们惬意地饮着好茶，尝着月饼，兴致勃勃地听张老师分享着做月饼的经验。陈普老师也不时地点上几句关于中秋节的历史和文化知识。新东方艺术学校的吕丽华校长和美中文化交流协会的李成老师也用些许幽默的话语逗得大家开怀大笑。 最后，每个朋友都拿着一盒自己亲自做出来的月饼高兴地离去。 接下来，新东方文化讲坛（新东方艺术学校与绿洲文教联合主办，”太阳鸟”亚’利桑那华人网策划） 将由陈普老师主讲中秋文化。时间另行通知，敬请关注！
89f131044149068a65ddb8934c4f2bc67cf0a63e.translatedText: Make your own mooncakes during the Mid-Autumn Festival - One of the series of lectures on the Mid-Autumn Culture at the New Oriental Culture Forum Make your own mooncakes during the Mid-Autumn Festival One of the Mid-Autumn Culture Lectures at the New Oriental Culture Forum, Teacher Zhang Lin is explaining the process of making mooncakes to everyone. The golden autumn is here, and the festival is approaching. The Chinese community is very lively, and people have begun to welcome and celebrate our traditional Chinese festivals in various forms. Some hold Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day receptions, and some hold entertaining tea parties. The Mid-Autumn Festival Culture Lecture Series launched by New Oriental Culture Forum, led by teacher Chen Pu, is even more unique. The first activity of the Mid-Autumn Festival Cultural Lecture is "Make Mooncakes by Yourself". Prepared mooncakes On the eve of the Mid-Autumn Festival, on the evening of Friday, September 21, Teacher Zhang Lin, the wife of Teacher Chen Pu, taught everyone how to make mooncakes by themselves. Teacher Zhang Lin and two other friends brought the noodles, bean paste, and five-nut fillings that had been kneaded long ago. Teacher Zhang taught everyone on the spot how to make stuffing, press molds, and bake. Friends tasted two types of mooncakes: snowskin and baked. Teacher Chen Pu also brought a kind of top-quality jasmine tea for everyone to taste. The friends drank tea, tasted mooncakes, and listened with interest to Teacher Zhang sharing his experience in making mooncakes. Teacher Chen Pu also added a few words about the history and culture of the Mid-Autumn Festival from time to time. Principal Lu Lihua from New Oriental Art School and teacher Li Cheng from the US-China Cultural Exchange Association also made everyone laugh with some humorous words. In the end, each friend left happily holding a box of mooncakes made by himself. Next, the New Oriental Culture Forum (co-sponsored by New Oriental Art School and Oasis Culture and Education, planned by "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese Network) will be lectured on Mid-Autumn Festival culture by teacher Chen Pu. The time will be notified later, so stay tuned!

b1d08e21b5455d7b95a7417701030c0e26af5f5b.sourceText: 6月17日上午，京沪高铁试运行情况向媒体开放，图为高铁列车服务员为一等座车厢的”乘客”端茶送水。京沪高铁运营初期，计划每天安排开行动车组列车90对，实行时速300公里和250公里混跑模式。从北京到上海最短时间为4小时48分钟。时速300公里动车组列车从北京到上海全程票价二等座555元，一等座935元，商务座 （包括观光座、一等包座）1750元；时速250公里动车组列车全程票价二等座410元，一等座650元。中新社发 侯宇 摄
b1d08e21b5455d7b95a7417701030c0e26af5f5b.translatedText: On the morning of June 17, the trial operation of the Beijing-Shanghai high-speed railway was opened to the media. The picture shows the high-speed railway train attendants serving tea and water to the "passengers" in the first-class carriage. In the initial operation of the Beijing-Shanghai high-speed railway, it is planned to operate 90 pairs of EMU trains every day, implementing a mixed running mode of 300 kilometers per hour and 250 kilometers per hour. The shortest time from Beijing to Shanghai is 4 hours and 48 minutes. The full fare for an EMU train with a speed of 300 kilometers per hour from Beijing to Shanghai is 555 yuan for a second-class seat, 935 yuan for a first-class seat, and 1,750 yuan for a business seat (including sightseeing seats and first-class private seats). The full fare for an EMU train with a speed of 250 kilometers per hour is 410 yuan for a second-class seat and 650 yuan for a first-class seat.
