fd6880211d0a8cba47c7cf0252807552a01e69c8.translatedText: Chinese Soldiers in World War I When Guan Chongqiong returned to China to get married, the customs document he used was "Temporarily Leaving the United States to Travel to Foreign Countries", so he could not stay in China for a long time. Soon after getting married...

c280442c1b6dd5c9c8d7becff97e1455d4d4287a.sourceText: 第一次世界大战中的华裔军人
c280442c1b6dd5c9c8d7becff97e1455d4d4287a.translatedText: Chinese soldiers in World War I

486a29bc991e2334aa2b6fca2da3923f5fe78278.sourceText: 关崇琼回国结婚，所用的海关文件是 “暂离美国出游外邦”，所以不能久留中国。结婚不久之后他就和妻子分别，在重返美国时，妻子已经怀上了他们的孩子。
486a29bc991e2334aa2b6fca2da3923f5fe78278.translatedText: Guan Chongqiong returned to China to get married. The customs document he used was "Temporarily Leaving the United States to Travel to Foreign Countries", so he could not stay in China for a long time. He separated from his wife shortly after their marriage, and when he returned to the United States, her wife was pregnant with their child.

7a94f7bf0c37527c0177811da07aab3136aadd92.sourceText: 《排华法案》非常的苛刻，关崇琼妻子来不了美国，他要家庭团聚，只能祈望有朝一日排华法案中止，或者在赚多点钱之后回老家去。 但是，世界格局的变化，给关崇琼命运带来了另一次的转变。
7a94f7bf0c37527c0177811da07aab3136aadd92.translatedText: The "Chinese Exclusion Act" is very harsh. Guan Chongqiong's wife cannot come to the United States. He wants to reunite his family. He can only hope that one day the Chinese Exclusion Act will be suspended, or he can return to his hometown after making more money. However, changes in the world situation brought another change to Guan Chongqiong's destiny.

9cdc41b4c56d400d5282afe6f159aae73766b328.sourceText: 1914年，第一次世界大战爆发，战火延烧至全球，世界上大多数国家都被捲入这场战争。中国的北洋政府也于1917年8月对德奥宣战，虽然并未直接派兵参与，但前后共有三十万华人前往欧洲战场，为协约国担负各种的后勤任务。
9cdc41b4c56d400d5282afe6f159aae73766b328.translatedText: In 1914, the First World War broke out and the war spread across the world. Most countries in the world were involved in this war. China's Beiyang government also declared war on Germany and Austria in August 1917. Although it did not directly send troops to participate, a total of 300,000 Chinese went to the European battlefield to undertake various logistical tasks for the Allied Powers.

7f1b9edb4c4e04ed188b8df38bc9735b714d6550.sourceText: 1915年，满载美国游客的“卢西塔尼亚号”邮轮被德国潜艇击沉。1917年, 德国使用无限制潜艇战，又击沉美国多艘船隻，美国与德国断交。之后，德国再向墨西哥发出“齐默尔曼电报”，要协助墨西哥取回割让给美国的失地。同年4月，美国总统威尔逊决定向德国宣战。
7f1b9edb4c4e04ed188b8df38bc9735b714d6550.translatedText: In 1915, the cruise ship "Lusitania" full of American tourists was sunk by a German submarine. In 1917, Germany used unrestricted submarine warfare and sank many American ships. The United States severed diplomatic relations with Germany. Afterwards, Germany sent the "Zimmermann Telegram" to Mexico to help Mexico recover the lost territory ceded to the United States. In April of the same year, U.S. President Wilson decided to declare war on Germany.

5b2250f0c578b324295e594088e48c07637750a8.sourceText: 在宣战六周后，美国只有73000人志愿参军。兵力的短缺与战事的紧迫要求美国政府提出征兵法案来弥补缺口。1917年5月18日，威尔逊总统签署美国首次征兵法案。先后向欧洲派了20万军队参战。
5b2250f0c578b324295e594088e48c07637750a8.translatedText: Six weeks after the declaration of war, only 73,000 people in the United States volunteered to join the army. The shortage of troops and the urgency of the war required the U.S. government to propose a conscription bill to make up for the gap. On May 18, 1917, President Wilson signed the first U.S. military draft bill. 200,000 troops were sent to Europe to participate in the war.

fdcd08dd29f78b9d0e73bc3963a0bf903aeb3154.sourceText: 美国实际上是要和协约国在战后分享成果。美国在1918年1月发布了十四点和平方案，其中的第二点大家很熟悉：“美国认为只要是公海，美国就有航行的完全自由，而不分是否战时。”
fdcd08dd29f78b9d0e73bc3963a0bf903aeb3154.translatedText: The United States actually wants to share the results with the Allied Powers after the war. The United States issued a fourteen-point peace plan in January 1918. The second point is familiar to everyone: "The United States believes that as long as it is high seas, the United States has complete freedom of navigation, regardless of whether it is wartime."

168f3fd8ad23adff0eeaa2b694295d372ddc9343.sourceText: 1917年10月，24岁的关崇琼应征服役，参军前，他在花旗餐馆工作。他是亚省参加过第一次世界大战的两名华裔军人之一。并留下了唯一的华裔从军的戎装相片。
168f3fd8ad23adff0eeaa2b694295d372ddc9343.translatedText: In October 1917, 24-year-old Guan Chongqiong was drafted into the military service. Before joining the army, he worked in a Citi Restaurant. He was one of two Chinese soldiers from Alberta who served in World War I. And left behind the only uniform photo of a Chinese-American serving in the army.

2ff6f4a4be8ceef28e47e245fa13281fbac37922.sourceText: 1917年10月，关崇琼在纽约和爱尔兰人战斗师接受基本训练。之后被派往欧洲战场。他所属的部队是美国远征军的第164步兵团，在军中总部任炊事工作。
2ff6f4a4be8ceef28e47e245fa13281fbac37922.translatedText: In October 1917, Guan Chongqiong received basic training with the Irish Fighting Division in New York. Later he was sent to the European battlefield. The unit he belongs to is the 164th Infantry Regiment of the American Expeditionary Force, and he works as a cook at the military headquarters.

88397ea2b819a6b294310f29784befe71909a910.sourceText: 关崇琼说，部队乘船去战争进行中的欧洲。由于船上条件很差，船到港口时，士兵们都在挨饿。他们下船后，去挖了土豆生吃，因为他们实在太饿了。
88397ea2b819a6b294310f29784befe71909a910.translatedText: Guan Chongqiong said that the troops took ships to go to Europe where the war was ongoing. Due to poor conditions on board, the soldiers were starving when the ship arrived at port. After they got off the boat, they dug up potatoes and ate them raw because they were so hungry.

96416c6f470c98fc4b23170d6090557fef83c588.sourceText: 士兵的生活非常寂寞，他认识的人很少，从未收到过任何邮件。第一次世界大战期间有所谓的“圣诞节休战”，泛指在平安夜或圣诞节中，军队间短暂且非官方的休战。关崇琼说战争很残酷，而且作为一个士兵的生活很孤独。他有好几个战友从未接到过任何家中的邮件。而在战争中一个最美好的回忆，是在圣诞节前夕，战友和他分享他们收到的信件。
96416c6f470c98fc4b23170d6090557fef83c588.translatedText: The soldier's life is very lonely. He knows few people and has never received any mail. During World War I, there was the so-called "Christmas Truce," which generally referred to a brief, unofficial truce between armies on Christmas Eve or Christmas Day. Guan Chongqiong said that war was cruel and life as a soldier was lonely. Several of his comrades never received any mail from home. One of the fondest memories of the war was when his comrades shared with him the letters they had received on Christmas Eve.

98b57f629bbe64601fe8c95ece4d0fd60ad0dc09.sourceText: 关崇琼在第164步兵团总部连续服务了20个月。在法国的尼斯 (Nice)和梅茨经历了战斗。战争中的炮火猛烈，他不幸地负了伤，在战地医院中上麻药取出了弹片。
98b57f629bbe64601fe8c95ece4d0fd60ad0dc09.translatedText: > Guan Chongqiong has served at the headquarters of the 164th Infantry Regiment for 20 consecutive months. Battles were fought in Nice and Metz, France. The artillery fire during the war was fierce, and he was unfortunately injured. He was given anesthesia to remove the shrapnel in a field hospital.

938cc8b21a2d0fa811ea9981a2b8f7cc63e73251.sourceText: 第一次世界大战中有6500万人参战，1000多万人丧生，2000万人受伤，造成了严重的人口及经济损失。关崇琼是战争中的幸存者，他被授予＂紫心勋章＂和“欧洲胜利勋章”，成为亚省首位荣获军功的华裔军人。
938cc8b21a2d0fa811ea9981a2b8f7cc63e73251.translatedText: In World War I, 65 million people participated in the war, more than 10 million people lost their lives, and 20 million people were injured, causing serious population and economic losses. Guan Chongqiong was a survivor of the war. He was awarded the "Purple Heart Medal" and the "European Victory Medal", becoming the first Chinese-American soldier in Alberta to receive military honors.

d7b4088128efd8c657d3f82b8254b6211b054626.sourceText: 1918年11月11日，第一次世界大战结。1919年3月，伤好后的关崇琼从法国返回美国凤凰城，并收到退役的通知。
d7b4088128efd8c657d3f82b8254b6211b054626.translatedText: On November 11, 1918, the First World War ended. In March 1919, after recovering from his injury, Guan Chongqiong returned to Phoenix, United States from France and received a notice to retire.

4120647224900ab3e70e3f4ea7ec638eb2bf7d0a.sourceText: 二战后，美国退伍军人成立 “退伍军人协会”，关崇琼一直是会员。日后，他入選了“亞省退伍軍人名人堂”（全州只有三名华裔军人）。
4120647224900ab3e70e3f4ea7ec638eb2bf7d0a.translatedText: After World War II, American veterans established the Veterans Association, and Guan Chongqiong has been a member. Later, he was inducted into the "Alberta Veterans Hall of Fame" (there are only three Chinese-American soldiers in the state).

72a8c1e1709c3a1f23f32b0d9d8e89b83201e77a.sourceText: 关崇琼退役后开始创业，经营商铺和房地产很成功。后来又开了关氏香格里拉餐馆。关崇琼是华人社区的著名的侨领，是大凤凰城侨团联合总会的创会主席，凤凰城龙岡团体的创会主席，对侨社有过积极的贡献。（待续）
72a8c1e1709c3a1f23f32b0d9d8e89b83201e77a.translatedText: Guan Chongqiong started his own business after retiring and was very successful in running shops and real estate. Later he opened Kwan's Shangri-La Restaurant. Guan Chongqiong is a well-known overseas Chinese leader in the Chinese community. He is the founding chairman of the Greater Phoenix Overseas Chinese Association and the founding chairman of the Phoenix Longgang Group. He has made positive contributions to the overseas Chinese community. (to be continued)

3d0e7acb29eb41f33e8bb3aea06cc952669a6cd5.sourceText: 〃轰动武林 震惊万教〃耒诠释今年表演团的精彩节目，浓浓的乡土亲情就压在每个人的心头。 今年表演节目超炫！超棒！超精彩！绝对是〃后悔终生〃如果你错过。 节目单元包括： 十亿掌声 有华人的地方就有邓丽君的歌声，唯一能征服日本，独佔香港，大陆，台湾及世界华人社区 被尊为十亿掌声的邓丽君是华语流行乐坛永恆的文化符号。 邓丽君出生在台湾云林，后迁至台东池上，今天池上乡的米是台湾最顶级国宴用米，也是今年凤城双十国庆酒会鲁肉饭指定用米。 邓丽君完整记录巨星台上的辉煌与台下观衆的快乐，一代歌后十亿掌声，留下世人永远的追忆，让我们在晚会舞台上分享由张静云模彷的表演，重温巨星的辉煌。 飞向一道彩虹 凤飞飞对歌曲的演绎堪称一绝，细腻的情感把握，毫厘不差的发音与转声，这背后又有多少坚辛努力学习的付出？最终能在强强竞争中与邓丽君比高共同站在台湾歌坛顶峯。 〃一生快乐 活得精彩〃凤飞飞代表台湾本土歌谣的灵魂，在晚会〃飞向一道彩虹〃节目中由刘明珠模彷让凤飞飞重现舞台。 天后金曲 台湾歌坛一代天后江蕙以〃二姊〃排行自称后，至今没人敢称大姊。 第一次到台湾的朋友想要体会台湾人情，那就先听听江蕙的歌曲。江蕙堪称当今台湾乐坛身价最高的歌手，因所唱歌曲大部份都是悲伤情歌，与妹妹江淑娜合称〃苦情姊妹花〃近年来苦情不再，应称她们〃幸福姊妹〃。 侨委会选择陈思安在节目中演唱江蕙的成名金曲包括〃酒后心声〃 〃惜别海岸〃 〃家后〃 〃伤心酒店〃 等，10月6日现场将有浓浓台湾情。 青春舞台 台视歌唱大赛最新出炉的帅哥小子黄家新将以完全接近萧煌奇原声演唱 〃你是我的眼〃 也要把歌坛教父洪荣洪的成名曲 〃思慕的人〃 〃一支小雨伞〃等分享大家。
3d0e7acb29eb41f33e8bb3aea06cc952669a6cd5.translatedText: > Sensational in the martial arts The wonderful performances of this year's performance group shocked Wanjiao Lei's interpretation, and the strong local family affection is in everyone's heart. This year’s performance is amazing! Awesome! Super exciting! It will definitely be "regret for life" if you miss it. The program units include: One Billion Applause. Wherever there are Chinese people, there is Teresa Teng’s singing voice. The only one who can conquer Japan, monopolize Hong Kong, Mainland China, Taiwan and the Chinese community around the world. Teresa Teng, who is revered as One Billion Applause, is an eternal cultural symbol in the Chinese pop music world. Teresa Teng was born in Yunlin, Taiwan, and later moved to Chishang, Taitung. Today, the rice from Chishang Township is the top rice used for state banquets in Taiwan, and is also the designated rice for Lu Pork Rice at this year's Double Ten National Day reception in Fengcheng. Teresa Teng completely recorded the brilliance of the superstar on stage and the joy of the audience in the audience. The queen of songs received a billion applause, leaving the world with eternal memories. Let us share the performance imitated by Zhang Jingyun on the party stage and relive the glory of the superstar. Flying to a Rainbow Feng Feifei's interpretation of the song is truly outstanding, with her delicate emotional grasp, flawless pronunciation and transposition. How much hard work and hard work is behind this? In the end, he was able to stand at the top of Taiwan's music scene with Teresa Teng in a strong competition. "Live a happy life, live a wonderful life" Feng Feifei represents the soul of Taiwan's local songs. In the evening party's "Fly to a Rainbow" program, Feng Feifei was imitated by Liu Mingzhu and made Feng Feifei return to the stage. Queen's Hits After Taiwan's pop music queen Jiang Hui ranked herself as "second sister", no one dares to call her eldest sister. If you are visiting Taiwan for the first time and want to experience the Taiwanese people, you should first listen to Jiang Hui’s songs. Jiang Hui can be called the most valuable singer in Taiwan's music scene today. Because most of the songs she sings are sad love songs, she and her sister Jiang Shuna are collectively known as the "Bitter Sisters". In recent years, the bitterness has disappeared, so they should be called "Happy Sisters". The Overseas Chinese Affairs Council selected Chen Si'an to sing Jiang Hui's famous hits in the program, including "Drunken Voices", "Farewell to the Coast", "Behind Home", "Sad Hotel", etc. There will be a strong sense of Taiwanese sentiments at the show on October 6. Youth Stage: Huang Jiaxin, the latest handsome boy from the Taiwan TV singing competition, will sing "You Are My Eyes" with a voice that is completely close to Xiao Huangqi's original voice. He will also share with everyone the famous songs of Hong Ronghong, the godfather of the music industry, "The Longing Man" and "A Little Umbrella".

ea767dd14c3162472e56ac486cb65d3986016f8b.translatedText: Will he meet his parents and get married? It was revealed on the Internet that Zhou Xun brought her boyfriend Gao Shengyuan back to her hometown. On the evening of the 11th, a Weibo netizen broke the news that she saw Zhou Xun and her boyfriend in Zhou Xun's hometown Quzhou...

248fd5e0d321bb48f599f0d4280bdb19e577a8c1.sourceText: 周迅自打高调甩出男朋友个人资料晒新恋情后，其男友高圣远在国内的关注度就以火箭速度直线飙升。最近，有网友在衢州偶遇周迅和高圣远，称周迅戴 着口罩，不给签名，也不让拍照，但在周迅的男朋友找安全通道的时候跟他聊了几句，觉得他比周迅亲切得多，很绅士。该网友还提到，高圣远但中文很不好，讲英 文。
248fd5e0d321bb48f599f0d4280bdb19e577a8c1.translatedText: Since Zhou Xun made a high-profile announcement about her boyfriend's personal information to show off her new relationship, the domestic attention of her boyfriend Gao Shengyuan has soared at a rocket speed. Recently, some netizens met Zhou Xun and Gao Shengyuan in Quzhou. They said that Zhou Xun wore a mask and did not sign autographs or take photos. However, when Zhou Xun's boyfriend was looking for a safe passage, he chatted with him for a few words and felt that he was much kinder and more gentlemanly than Zhou Xun. The netizen also mentioned that Gao Shengyuan is not very good at Chinese and speaks English.

5c79304d94e491ccb0e6615af983cfa14ba3decd.sourceText: 据悉，衢州是周迅老家，此番带男友回去，是要见家里亲戚的意思吗？不过这是周公子的私人行程，不允许签名和拍照是正常的。
5c79304d94e491ccb0e6615af983cfa14ba3decd.translatedText: It is reported that Quzhou is Zhou Xun’s hometown. Did you take your boyfriend back this time to meet your relatives? However, this is Mr. Zhou’s private itinerary, and it is normal that signatures and photos are not allowed.

61fd2452b0474efe832bae788044a1a19f2dce2f.sourceText: *刘思星窃取与军事有关的商业机密罪成立*
61fd2452b0474efe832bae788044a1a19f2dce2f.translatedText: * Liu Sixing was found guilty of stealing military-related trade secrets*

90477c0bde0ac14be6eff7b9d65662ae35380c49.sourceText: 前L-3通讯公司雇员刘思星(Sixing Liu, 又名Steve Liu)9月26日被陪审团裁定犯有六项违反武器出口控制法罪行以及拥有被窃商业机密、运送被窃财产以及向联邦特工撒谎。刘思星是中国公民，居住在新泽西州。他在2011年3月被捕，被控持有大量保密军事数据并在中国大学和政府的研讨会上展示这些信息。
90477c0bde0ac14be6eff7b9d65662ae35380c49.translatedText: Former L-3 Communications Company employee Sixing Liu, also known as Steve Liu was found guilty by a jury on September 26 of six counts of violating the Arms Export Control Act, as well as possessing stolen trade secrets, transporting stolen property and lying to federal agents. Liu Sixing is a Chinese citizen living in New Jersey. He was arrested in March 2011 and accused of possessing large amounts of classified military data and presenting the information at Chinese university and government seminars.

80477235f73a7ff02bed69fa3c5179c0edb22c2d.sourceText: 根据起诉书，刘先后在2009年和2010年携带个人手提电脑到重庆和上海参加会议，介绍他所从事的技术工作，而美国法律禁止未经许可输出国防技术。检方称，2010年11月，他从上海返回美国时，当机场的海关官员询问他参加会议的情况时，他说了谎。
80477235f73a7ff02bed69fa3c5179c0edb22c2d.translatedText: According to the indictment, Liu brought his personal laptop to Chongqing and Shanghai to attend meetings in 2009 and 2010 to introduce the technical work he was engaged in. U.S. law prohibits the export of defense technology without permission. Prosecutors said that when he returned to the United States from Shanghai in November 2010, he lied when customs officials at the airport asked him about his attendance at the meeting.

214c4e4567389869345db4732ba64be54cdf67dc.sourceText: 新泽西州的联邦检察官保罗 费希曼说：”我们不会容忍通过盗窃我们的机密来滥用我们国家的机会。”
214c4e4567389869345db4732ba64be54cdf67dc.translatedText: Paul Fishman, the federal prosecutor in New Jersey, said: "We will not tolerate the abuse of our country's opportunities by stealing our secrets."

39a770ba4d88b01f151dabbc644c0437480a881e.sourceText: 刘的律师詹姆斯 图尼克辩称，刘思星是个教育工作者，不懂美国武器出口控制法规，并不是故意犯罪。
39a770ba4d88b01f151dabbc644c0437480a881e.translatedText: Liu's lawyer, James Tunick, argued that Liu Sixing was an educator, did not understand U.S. arms export control regulations, and did not intentionally commit a crime.

76eff104d00f227376db43487180cb4c9b6aaad6.sourceText: 刘思星今年49岁，是三个孩子的父亲。由于有潜逃风险，在法庭做出有罪判决后，他被带回监狱。量刑裁决将定于1月7日做出。刘思星最长有可能被判20年监禁并罚款1百万美元。律师说，他们打算上诉。
76eff104d00f227376db43487180cb4c9b6aaad6.translatedText: Liu Sixing is 49 years old and the father of three children. As a flight risk, he was taken back to prison after a guilty verdict in court. A sentencing decision is scheduled for January 7. Liu Sixing may be sentenced to up to 20 years in prison and fined US$1 million. Lawyers say they plan to appeal.

a6051401370bb006cd9fd28ee98b077a179a588c.sourceText: *卧底行动中落网的张明算受到指控*
a6051401370bb006cd9fd28ee98b077a179a588c.translatedText: *Zhang Mingsuan, who was arrested during the undercover operation, was charged*

3513523d25a3b8f25ec6a44b21e1e587bba92682.sourceText: 另外也在9月26日，美国当局向纽约布鲁克林的一家联邦法院提交了针对中国公民张明算(Ming Suan Zhang)的指控状。他被控企图从美国购买大量的高规格碳纤维并输出中国。这种材料用于制造新式飞机，因属于军民两用材料，在美国受出口控制。
3513523d25a3b8f25ec6a44b21e1e587bba92682.translatedText: Also on September 26, the US authorities submitted a complaint against Chinese citizen Ming Suan Zhang to a federal court in Brooklyn, New York. He was accused of trying to purchase large quantities of high-grade carbon fiber from the United States and export it to China. This material is used to make new aircraft and is subject to export controls in the United States because it is a dual-use material.

c7d5bacfa1f30899f543b830a184c4d1ad9ce122.sourceText: 根据指控状披露的信息，40岁的张明算是在美国政府一项”钓鱼”行动中落网的。4月间，两名台湾人联系一家出售航空技术的公司的网站，希望绕过许可证审批程序而购买大宗的碳纤维。他们称背后买家是中国商人张明算。他们不知道的是，这个网站其实是美国移民和海关执法局设立的。张明算来美国接头时，对方其实是联邦特工。
c7d5bacfa1f30899f543b830a184c4d1ad9ce122.translatedText: According to the information disclosed in the complaint, 40-year-old Zhang Ming was caught in a "fishing" operation by the US government. In April, two Taiwanese contacted the website of a company that sells aerospace technology, hoping to bypass the license approval process and purchase large quantities of carbon fiber. They said the buyer behind it was Chinese businessman Zhang Mingsuan. What they didn’t know was that the website was actually set up by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement. When Zhang Mingzhu came to the United States to contact him, the other party was actually a federal agent.

c63645b4fb968a88ae0d3eca8e30b1ac032d3997.sourceText: 9月26日，张明算在法庭通过翻译说，他没有罪。他的美国律师说，张明算是经营体育用品的诚实商人，陷入了一桩他不完全了解的事情，以为自己是合法的。
c63645b4fb968a88ae0d3eca8e30b1ac032d3997.translatedText: On September 26, Zhang Mingsuan said through an interpreter in court that he was not guilty. His U.S. lawyer said Zhang Ming was an honest businessman dealing in sporting goods who got into something he didn't fully understand and thought he was legal.

d57e2a4a9941f6d7b441bffec51d37d3c6a6649a.sourceText: 杨绮薇：气势恢弘的杭廷顿庄园 广州 美国南加州闻名遐迩的杭廷顿庄园每周四免费对外开放。 侄女婷婷早早就在网上预订了6张门票。 周四一早，堂哥和侄女开车，一家人陪同我和先生，来到这个久负盛名的地方游览。 杭廷顿庄园离洛杉矶不远，几十分钟车程就到了。 庄园占地207英亩，原乃加州铁路大王、百万富豪兼艺术收藏家亨利． 杭廷顿之私产，杭廷顿死后把这一切全部捐给国家，现在，庄园成了南加州的旅游胜地。 庄园分为美术馆、图书馆和植物园三个大区域，其中的美术馆是亨利． 杭廷顿生前的住所，十分豪华奢侈。 我们首先参观美术馆和图书馆。 掩映在林木葱茏之中的两栋白色宫廷式建筑壮观气派、建造精美、气势恢弘，馆外四周花草繁盛的草坪上，排列着大量保存完整的十八世纪的石雕群，那些从历史隧道中走 来的名匠之作，肃穆地列阵而站，让游人目不暇接，仿佛一下子回到十八世纪。 美术馆内收藏了大量欧洲文艺复兴时期的绘画、十八世纪雕塑、织锦、瓷器及家具等，最让我们惊讶不已的是，1790年由Rosa Petersen所赠送的一台精美座钟，被保存相当完好， 经历了漫长岁月的淬炼，座钟依然金光闪闪、鋥亮如新。 图书馆内藏书六十多万册，其中有数百万份学者真迹手稿和孤本、善本，包括世界第一本活字印刷圣经、首版莎翁剧本、开国元勋富兰克林自传手稿以及美国大文豪梭罗于1854 年亲撰的”华尔腾手记”等。 这些珍贵的收藏，从不同层面反映了前后大约十个世纪的历史和人类文化，历史能如此完整地展现在后人面前，这让我们钦佩不已。 参观完美术馆和图书馆，我们绕到两馆后面的珍稀花卉大温室和儿童园区进行了短暂的流连。 很喜欢大温室里面的设计，这里的温室环境十分逼真，一进去就仿佛走进了原始森林，在热带雨林温室内，树枝上覆盖着附生植物，攀援植物就在我们头顶上形成一道绿色 的帐幔.周围有水雾不断喷洒而出，空气湿润，凉爽舒适，与外面的炎热截然不同。 这里是专门对少年儿童进行科教的地方，有很多科技设施，我看到很多小朋友在妈妈的带领下，在这里探寻热带森林动、植物的奥秘。 还有Children’s Pool，许多儿童在欢快嬉戏，不亦乐乎，看着这些小鸟一样欢乐的孩子，我的心情一下子也欢快起来。
d57e2a4a9941f6d7b441bffec51d37d3c6a6649a.translatedText: Yang Qiwei: The magnificent Huntington Manor in Guangzhou The famous Huntington Manor in Southern California is open to the public for free every Thursday. My niece Tingting booked 6 tickets online early. Early Thursday morning, my cousin and niece drove, and the whole family accompanied my husband and I to visit this prestigious place. Huntington Manor is not far from Los Angeles, just a few dozen minutes’ drive away. The manor covers an area of ​​207 acres and was originally owned by California railroad king, millionaire and art collector Henry. Huntington's private property was donated to the state after Huntington's death. Now, the manor has become a tourist attraction in Southern California. The manor is divided into three large areas: art gallery, library and botanical garden. The art gallery is Henry. Huntington's residence during his lifetime was very luxurious and luxurious. We first visited the art gallery and library. The two white palace-style buildings hidden among the lush trees are spectacular, exquisitely constructed and magnificent. On the lawn surrounded by flowers and plants outside the museum, there are a large number of well-preserved stone carvings from the 18th century. The works of famous craftsmen who came from the historical tunnel stand solemnly in formation, making visitors dizzy and feel as if they have returned to the 18th century. The art museum has a large collection of European Renaissance paintings, eighteenth-century sculptures, brocades, porcelain and furniture. What surprised us most was the exquisite clock presented by Rosa Petersen in 1790. It has been preserved quite well. After being tempered for a long time, the clock is still gleaming and as bright as new. The library contains more than 600,000 volumes, including millions of original manuscripts by scholars, as well as unique and rare books, including the world's first movable-type printed Bible, the first edition of Shakespeare's plays, the autobiography manuscript of founding father Franklin, and "Walton's Notes" written by the great American writer Thoreau in 1854, etc. These precious collections reflect the history and human culture of about ten centuries from different levels. We admire the fact that history can be so completely presented to future generations. After visiting the art gallery and library, we went around to the large greenhouse of rare flowers and the children's area behind the two museums for a brief visit. I really like the design inside the large greenhouse. The greenhouse environment here is very realistic. Once you enter, you feel like you have entered a primeval forest. In the tropical rainforest greenhouse, the branches are covered with epiphytes, and climbing plants form a green curtain above our heads. There is water mist spraying around, making the air moist, cool and comfortable, which is completely different from the heat outside. This is a place dedicated to science and education for children. There are many scientific and technological facilities. I saw many children, led by their mothers, exploring the mysteries of tropical forest animals and plants here. There are also Children’s Pool, where many children are playing happily and enjoying themselves. Looking at these children who are as happy as birds, my mood suddenly becomes happy.

53e3a226f11873509f8c843f32222c0bfbc211d9.sourceText: 九个亚利桑那企业成为全美快速成长公司 周一公布的全国500快速成长公司名单中，九个亚利桑那州企业上榜。而在全美5000家快速成长榜中，有89家本州公司上榜。 九家企业中，排在前五位的公司，无独有偶，总部都设在斯格思岱。脊椎治疗诊所(The Joint)成长最快，2009年至2012年的增长率为3,113%，排在94位。以开发医疗保健机构硬件和软件的GlobalMed，三年增长3,094%，排名第95。贷款公司Loan Resolution排名216。另一家斯格思岱公司Blue Global Media排在218。第303的Digital Video Networks。 其他上榜的公司包括凤凰城的IT服务公司MYTEK Network Solutions，315，吉伯特的货运运输公司American Group，325，凤凰城健康产品制造商DreamBrands，410，和图森物业损伤恢复和重建Citywide Restoration，471。
53e3a226f11873509f8c843f32222c0bfbc211d9.translatedText: Nine Arizona companies become the nation's fastest-growing companies Nine Arizona companies are on the list of the nation's 500 fastest-growing companies released on Monday. Among the 5,000 fastest-growing companies in the United States, 89 local companies are on the list. Among the nine companies, the top five companies are all headquartered in Scottsdale. Chiropractic clinics (The Joint) grew the fastest, with a growth rate of 3,113% from 2009 to 2012, ranking 94th. GlobalMed, which develops hardware and software for healthcare institutions, has grown 3,094% in three years and ranks 95th. Loan Resolution ranked 216th. Another Scottsdale company, Blue Global Media, ranked 218th. Digital Video Networks No. 303. Other companies on the list include Phoenix-based IT services company MYTEK Network Solutions, 315, Gilbert-based trucking company American Group, 325, Phoenix health products manufacturer DreamBrands, 410, and Tucson property damage recovery and reconstruction Citywide Restoration, 471.

128fb4d7d887ff942638a160cc2d0ffdcc721090.sourceText: 五洲洪门致公总堂周国祥会长于8月25日率领40多位昆仲专程从旧金山南下洛杉矶，为致公总堂第三代堂主黄三德墓重建的功德碑举办揭碑、拜祭仪式。揭碑仪式在洛杉矶中华坟场内黄三德墓前举行，30多位南加州当地侨社重量级侨领应邀出席并参加拜祭仪式。重修的墓碑庄严肃穆，墓碑记载了黄三德一生为中华民族和辛亥革命所作出的巨大贡献。墓碑的重建是今年海外华人社团为辛亥百年和辛亥功臣所做的最大一项纪念工程。
128fb4d7d887ff942638a160cc2d0ffdcc721090.translatedText: On August 25th, President Zhou Guoxiang of the Wuzhou Hongmen Zhigong General Hall led more than 40 Kunzhongs from San Francisco to Los Angeles to hold an unveiling and worship ceremony for the merit monument rebuilt on the tomb of Huang Sande, the third generation leader of the Zhigong General Hall. The unveiling ceremony was held in front of Huang Sande's tomb in the Chinese Cemetery in Los Angeles. More than 30 important overseas Chinese leaders from the local overseas Chinese community in Southern California were invited to attend and participate in the worship ceremony. The rebuilt tombstone is solemn and solemn. The tombstone records Huang Sande's great contribution to the Chinese nation and the Revolution of 1911 throughout his life. The reconstruction of the tombstone is the largest commemorative project undertaken by overseas Chinese communities this year to commemorate the centenary of the Xinhai Revolution and the heroes of the Xinhai Revolution.

39cfc818e97b2c6f9726ed9813d70c9283b757b4.sourceText: 拜祭仪式在当天上午9点吉时准时举行，墓碑前摆放了丰富的拜祭品，墓碑上有红布覆盖。仪式完全按照洪门组织的传统程序，庄严中不乏神秘色彩。仪式开始，堂内职员青龙、白虎分立墓碑两侧。五洲洪门致公总堂龙头周国祥会长宣读祭文，书记长欧阳仲珊主持了拜祭仪式。专程从中国广东湛江前来参加揭碑仪式的黄三德长孙黄子迪先生感谢洪门致公总堂以及世界各地洪门组织和北美各大侨团对黄三德墓碑重建工程的合力支持。在周国祥会长与黄子迪共同揭开了墓碑上的红绸后，参加拜祭仪式的嘉宾在完成上香、敬酒、献花、献宝、鸣炮等仪式后，再赴中华坟场内的敬亲亭内向先贤致祭，罗省台山宁阳会馆主席伍尚齐主持了拜祭仪式。
39cfc818e97b2c6f9726ed9813d70c9283b757b4.translatedText: The worship ceremony was held at the auspicious time of 9 o'clock in the morning that day. A rich offering of sacrifices was placed in front of the tombstone, and the tombstone was covered with red cloth. The ceremony completely followed the traditional procedures of the Hongmen organization, and was solemn and mysterious. At the beginning of the ceremony, the staff in the hall, Qinglong and Baihu, stood on both sides of the tombstone. Chairman Zhou Guoxiang, the leader of Wuzhou Hongmen Zhigong Hall, read out the memorial text, and Secretary General Ouyang Zhongshan presided over the ceremony. Mr. Huang Zidi, the eldest grandson of Huang Sande, who made a special trip from Zhanjiang, Guangdong, China, to attend the unveiling ceremony, thanked the Hongmen Zhigong Hall, Hongmen organizations around the world, and major overseas Chinese groups in North America for their joint support in the reconstruction project of Huang Sande's tombstone. After President Zhou Guoxiang and Huang Zidi jointly unveiled the red silk on the tombstone, the guests who participated in the worship ceremony completed the rituals of offering incense, toasting, presenting flowers, offering treasures, and firing cannons, and then went to the relatives pavilion in the Chinese Cemetery to pay tribute to the ancestors. Wu Shangqi, chairman of the Ningyang Association in Taishan, Luo Province, presided over the ceremony.

9c60161a251d093c712abb8d7ebdea4a7e76697c.sourceText: 左起：黄子迪 周国祥 五洲洪门致公总堂周国祥会长表示，自明末清初来，洪门社团一直是海外爱国华侨的重要组织，在辛亥革命期间，由于认同孙中山先生思想，从而投入积极支持孙中山先生在海外的革命活动。孙中山先生当年在北美各地的革命活动，美洲洪门组织更是发挥和扮演了非常重要的角色。当年在五洲洪门致公总堂在黄三德先生的带领下，发动全美各地的洪门昆仲积极为辛亥革命出钱出力，特别是当年中下层侨民对革命的无私奉献，甚为感人。这次重修黄三德墓碑就是在纪念辛亥百年之际，为了铭记以黄三德为代表的北美广大华侨先辈们当年爱家爱国的义薄云天的群体壮举。
9c60161a251d093c712abb8d7ebdea4a7e76697c.translatedText: From left: Huang Zidi Zhou Guoxiang President Zhou Guoxiang of Wuzhou Hongmen Zhigong General Hall said that since the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, the Hongmen Association has been an important organization for patriotic overseas Chinese. During the Revolution of 1911, because of its identification with Dr. Sun Yat-sen’s thoughts, it actively supported Mr. Sun Yat-sen’s revolutionary activities overseas. Dr. Sun Yat-sen's revolutionary activities in various parts of North America at that time, and the Free Gate Organization of the Americas played a very important role. At that time, under the leadership of Mr. Huang Sande, the Wuzhou Hongmen Zhigong General Hall mobilized Hongmen Kunzhong from all over the United States to actively contribute money and efforts to the Revolution of 1911. Especially the selfless dedication of the middle and lower class overseas Chinese to the revolution was very touching. The reconstruction of Huang Sande's tombstone this time is to commemorate the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911, in order to remember the collective feats of the vast number of overseas Chinese ancestors in North America represented by Huang Sande who loved their family and their country.

f56e752f52bf3dbbc5cd20aed2b467becd21e4e1.sourceText: 洛杉矶古冬：粥的传奇 大概没有谁不曾吃过粥吧! 记得从前读「国文」,有曰:「炊之为饭,煮之为粥。」可把我弄得像粥一样糊 涂了。 煮者,用火烹物也,而炊,烧煮也,那还不是一码子的事?倒是对两个弯弓夹一把米叫做粥,一直不得其解。 至后来吃了一碗北方「老兄」做的「稀饭」,心里才豁然开通,米加多一点水煮稀了,就是粥啦! 粥的命运—不说这个吧,它注定了要被人吃掉的!不过在不同的时空,盛在不同 人家的碗里,它又会有不同的身份和不同的价值。 无米不成炊(煮),米的多寡,决定粥的稀稠与分量,也决定粥所能发挥的作用的 大小。 在战乱或「三年灾害」的日子里,稀拉拉的一碗白粥,也被视为弥足珍贵的无上补品。 而设若粥煮的愈来愈稀,终于成为只见水不见米时,哀哉,那恐怕不待把它喝完,可怜的主人便可能一命呜呼了! 然而同样一碗清清淡淡的粥,摆在肚满肠肥的富贵人家面前,其使命又全然不同 。 它成了下一顿丰盛晚宴的前遣部队,有清肠消滞的功能,用以整拾拥塞的库存,俾便吐旧纳新。 寻常百姓,粥多用作早餐,好为他们新一天的生涯作必要的装备。 一碗清粥,一 小盘酱瓜或咸花生米,常常是北方人每天开门第一件要务。 广东人讲究一点,花样多一点,「白粥油炸鬼」之外,还有白果粥、及弟粥、艇仔粥、滑鸡粥、牛肉粥、海鲜粥厖不一而足。 煮粥的方法,北方人也较简单。 有些人索性在上晚留下一些白饭,第二朝用开水 一泡,就是一碗清清爽爽的白粥了。 想吃得丰富一点也行,在碗里加些现成的佐料,如紫菜、猪油、酱油、盐巴之类,它马上就变了样。 不过此时就不再是粥,而是一碗咸泡饭了。 在这方面,广东人同样另有蹊径。 我们索性就不叫煮,也不叫烧,而叫煲。 煲的 窍门在于明火,即火头旺而不间歇,煲时也不必搅动,任由它滚,这样煲出来的粥才够香滑。 所以上好的粥品店,都标明「明火白粥」,以作招徕。 可惜这样有水准的粥,已不多见。 日前我们在一家港式西餐厅叫了一碗鱼片粥,一看就知道是取巧,是滥竽充数,那不是粥,而是稍作加工的泡饭,就是把冷饭用绞绊机打烂,再用 微波炉一「叮」了事。 因为粥是稀饭,不耐饱,所以通常不用作正餐。 但除了作早餐之外,用来宵夜也 是不错。 过去香港有家叫一品香的上海馆子,晚上有清粥供应, 因而成为夜游人的「蒲点」,一如时下一些台式的清粥店,生意不错呢。 前些年有几个香港人,不知是豪情万丈,还是异想天开,当他们从楼市、股市中抢到第二桶金子时,居然以华贵的「中国会馆」与典雅的半岛酒店嘉麟楼为蓝本,开了几家大大的粥品店,一下子把粥捧至前所未有的高度,什么鲍鱼粥、鱼翅粥、燕窝粥都端了出来,以为加重了饵,不是以蚓投鱼,而是以金 丝结网,一定会从中再捞一桶金子。 岂料香港人是何等人也,再贵的粥也不过是粥,既不够丰厚浓郁,更不够辉煌夺目,如何能教他们看得上眼?加上时乖运蹇,股市暴泻,楼房霎时 成了负资产,客人都返回家去吃白粥,粥品店一时门堪罗雀,唯有关门大吉,也搬回家去再煮它的咸蛋粥了。 没有想到吧,平淡无奇的一碗粥,也有它一段不平凡的传奇!
f56e752f52bf3dbbc5cd20aed2b467becd21e4e1.translatedText: Los Angeles Gudong: The Legend of Porridge There is probably no one who has not eaten porridge! I remember reading "Guowen" before and there was a saying: "Cooking is rice, cooking is porridge." But it made me as confused as porridge. Boiling means using fire to cook things, and cooking means cooking. Isn't that the same thing? It's been a mystery to me that a handful of rice held between two bent bows is called porridge. Later, after eating a bowl of "porridge" made by a "brother" in the north, I suddenly understood. If the rice is boiled with a little more water, it becomes porridge! The fate of porridge - let's not talk about it, it is destined to be eaten by others! However, in different time and space, it will have different identities and different values ​​when served in different people's bowls. Cooking (cooking) is impossible without rice. The amount of rice determines the thickness and weight of the porridge, and also determines the role that the porridge can play. During the days of war or the "three-year disaster", a bowl of thin porridge was also regarded as a precious and supreme tonic. And if the porridge becomes thinner and thinner, and finally there is only water but no rice, then sadly, the poor owner may die before he finishes drinking it! However, the same bowl of light porridge, placed in front of a wealthy family with a full stomach, has a completely different mission. It has become the advance team for the next sumptuous dinner. It has the function of clearing the intestines and eliminating stagnation, and is used to tidy up the congested inventory so that the old can be emptied and the new can be brought in. Ordinary people, porridge is mostly used for breakfast, so as to make necessary preparations for their new day's life. A bowl of clear porridge, a small plate of pickled cucumbers or salted peanuts are often the first thing northerners do when they open their doors every day. Cantonese people are more particular and have more varieties. In addition to "white porridge and fried ghost", there are also ginkgo porridge, Ji Di porridge, Tingzi porridge, chicken porridge, beef porridge, seafood porridge and so on. The method of cooking porridge is also simpler for northerners. Some people simply leave some white rice in the morning and soak it in boiling water the next morning to have a refreshing bowl of white porridge. If you want to eat richer, just add some ready-made condiments to the bowl, such as seaweed, lard, soy sauce, salt, etc., and it will change immediately. But now it's no longer porridge, but a bowl of salty rice. In this regard, the Cantonese also have a different approach. We simply don’t call it boiling or roasting, but stewing. The trick to cooking the porridge is to use an open flame, that is, the fire is strong and not intermittent, and there is no need to stir when cooking, just let it roll, so that the porridge will be fragrant and smooth. Therefore, good porridge shops all label "open fire white porridge" to attract customers. It's a pity that porridge of this quality is rarely seen anymore. A few days ago, we ordered a bowl of fish fillet porridge at a Hong Kong-style Western restaurant. At first glance, we knew that it was a trick. It was not porridge, but slightly processed rice. The cold rice was smashed with a chopper and then "dinged" in the microwave. Because porridge is rice porridge and is not full, it is usually not used as a meal. But in addition to making breakfast, it is also good for late night snacks. In the past, there was a Shanghai restaurant called Yipinxiang in Hong Kong that served clear porridge in the evening, so it became a popular spot for night tourists. Just like some Taiwanese porridge restaurants nowadays, the business is good. A few years ago, a few Hong Kong people, whether out of arrogance or whim, when they grabbed the second pot of gold from the property market and stock market, actually opened several large porridge shops based on the luxurious "China Club" and the elegant Jialin Tower of the Peninsula Hotel, and suddenly promoted the porridge to unprecedented heights. If you tie a net with silk, you will surely get another pot of gold from it. Unexpectedly, what kind of people are Hong Kong people? No matter how expensive the porridge is, it is just porridge. It is not rich and rich enough, nor is it dazzling enough. How can we teach them to like it? Coupled with bad luck, the stock market plummeted, and the building suddenly became a negative asset. Customers returned home to eat white porridge. Didn’t you expect that an ordinary bowl of porridge also has an extraordinary legend!

7de8ffbcbdfd5a96579c340f46ce7bd542391283.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院成功举办汉语教学经验交流大会(图) 太阳鸟1月15日讯(记者 冯海燕) 长方形的教室内，十张长方形的桌子并排摆开，坐满了将近70位的与会者。这群人有着相同的职业背景，汉语老师。 亚利桑那州立大学（ASU）孔子学院举办的2012年美国外语教育协会经验教学大会（Post-ACTFL）于15日上午9点半开始在亚利桑那州立大学的MU二楼举行。会议持续5个小时，吸引了亚利桑那州从家庭老师到美国公立学校教师等不同背景的中文教育者。 ASU大学孔子学院院长司马德琳教授认为本次的经验会很成功。 ”我们今天有14位的讲师来和大家分享从ACTFL学到的知识。我觉得他们讲得很棒。听众的反响也很好。” 从2009年开始，今年是ASU孔子学院第3次资助亚利桑那州中文教师去丹佛参加为期3天 的ACTFL。 ”我们主要就希望通过ACTFL，亚利桑那州的中文教师可以及时更新对这个领域最新知识的了解，同时也希望他们能深化自己的专业知识。” 然而经验交流大会的做法，却不是一开始就有的。 ”作为赞助方，这对我们来说也是一个慢慢学习的过程，” 司马德琳教授说道。09年的时候，这些申请者只是简单地过去学习了下，回来之后并没有这样的经验交流大会。后来我们发现这实在是对资源的一种浪费。” Alice Fan是梅萨市罗德思中学的中文教师，有超过3年的汉语教学经验，她是经验会14名讲师之一，今年是她第3次参加ACTFL。 ”我主要是过去学习怎样动员学生更积极地参与课堂这一块。因我的学生主要是7、8年级的孩子，相对会叛逆一些，所以怎样和学生操持良好的互动就是我这次的主要目标。” 当问及从ACTFL学到的教学经验能否应用于现实时，Alice Fan肯定得点头。 ”当然。时代在变，这几年的孩子跟几年前的肯定有差别。所以我们的教学方法也必须跟着变。” 但对刘老师来说，他所理解的教学上的”变”可能还要多一层。 ”我在周末中文学校教中文，那里的孩子主要是华侨子女。他们的中文比美国人好，但又比普通的中国孩子差。” 刘老师打算今后在美国的公立学校教学，学生将主要是美国孩子。不同的受众促使他摸索着不同的教学方法，也促使着他来参加这样的经验交流会。幸运的是，孔子学院有可能增加这类经验会的举办次数。 ”上次的经验会是在2011年12月5号举行的。如果有可能的话，我们打算今后1 个月举办2次，” 司马德琳教授说。
7de8ffbcbdfd5a96579c340f46ce7bd542391283.translatedText: > The Confucius Institute at Arizona State University successfully held a Chinese teaching experience exchange conference (picture) Sunbird News on January 15 (Reporter Feng Haiyan) In the rectangular classroom, ten rectangular tables were placed side by side, filled with nearly 70 participants. This group of people have the same professional background, Chinese teachers. The 2012 American Association for the Education of Foreign Languages ​​Experiential Teaching Conference (Post-ACTFL) organized by the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University (ASU) was held on the second floor of the MU at Arizona State University starting at 9:30 am on the 15th. The conference lasted five hours and attracted Chinese educators from Arizona with different backgrounds, ranging from home teachers to American public school teachers. Professor Sima Delin, Director of the Confucius Institute at ASU University, believes that this experience will be very successful. "We have 14 lecturers today to share with you the knowledge they learned from ACTFL. I think they gave a great lecture. The response from the audience was also very good." Since 2009, this year is the third time that the ASU Confucius Institute has sponsored Chinese teachers in Arizona to go to Denver to participate in the 3-day ACTFL. "We mainly hope that through ACTFL, Chinese teachers in Arizona can update their understanding of the latest knowledge in this field in a timely manner, and we also hope that they can deepen their professional knowledge." However, the practice of the experience exchange conference was not there from the beginning. "As a sponsor, this is also a slow learning process for us," Professor Sima Delin said. In 2009, these applicants simply went there to study, and there was no such experience exchange conference after they came back. Later we discovered that this was really a waste of resources. "Alice Fan is a Chinese teacher at Rhodes Middle School in Mesa. She has more than 3 years of experience in teaching Chinese. She is one of the 14 lecturers in the experience meeting. This is her third time participating in ACTFL. "I mainly learned how to mobilize students to participate more actively in class. Since my students are mainly children in grades 7 and 8, they are relatively rebellious, so how to maintain good interactions with students is my main goal this time. "When asked whether the teaching experience learned from ACTFL can be applied to reality, Alice Fan must nod. "Of course. Times are changing, and children these days are definitely different from those a few years ago. So our teaching methods must also change. "But for Mr. Liu, the "change" in teaching that he understands may be even more layered. "I teach Chinese at a weekend Chinese school, and the children there are mainly children of overseas Chinese. Their Chinese is better than that of Americans, but worse than that of ordinary Chinese children. "Teacher Liu plans to teach in public schools in the United States in the future, and his students will mainly be American children. Different audiences prompt him to explore different teaching methods, and also prompt him to participate in such experience exchange meetings. Fortunately, the Confucius Institute may increase the number of such experience meetings." The last experience meeting was held on December 5, 2011. If possible, we plan to hold it twice in the next month,” Professor Sima Delin said.

59907a6e75f7cafc2bf45775ed202072fcec1abe.sourceText: 掉头发 掉頭髮 嘉霖 掉头发好像是一个令很多人感到苦恼的问题。正常情况下﹐有掉有长﹐正是所谓新陈代谢。一天掉几十根头发算是正常的。但掉得太多的话﹐三千烦恼丝成群结队﹐离头而去。到后来﹐童山濯濯﹐就会变成秃头。生发的药中国有何首乌﹐黑芝麻﹐和大黑枣﹐西方有卵磷脂﹐鱼肝油等等。有内服的﹐有外敷的。虽然种类繁多﹐但真正的效果如何﹐谁也不敢确定。美国人在生发药上﹐每年花费超过三亿。而昂贵的植发手术和假发费用尚未计算在内。美国掉头发学会(American Hair Loss Association)在其网址上警告大家说﹐根据华盛顿邮报的报导﹐百分之九十九的药都不灵。 许多年前﹐我也一度有这样的掉头发问题﹐医生也说不出一个所以然来。我就开始注意饮食中有什么与掉头发可能有关系的﹐没过多久﹐就发现如果吃了添加防腐剂的食物﹐如方便面﹐头发似乎就掉得多些。 有一天﹐在洗淋浴的时候﹐我忽然领悟到﹐脱发是不是因为用的水太热了。这和掉头发会有关系吗﹖记得小时候﹐见人杀鸡﹐在拔毛前﹐一定要浇热水﹐我问那杀鸡的人为什么﹐回答是这样毛才容易拔。果然不一会儿﹐眼看他一手抓着鸡﹐另一手干净利落地把鸡毛就都拔光了。活人与死鸡﹐似乎不能相提并论﹐但毛之附于皮则同焉﹐毛孔会热胀冷缩﹐其理则一。 掉头发的原因可能有很多种﹐涉及荷尔蒙﹐年龄﹐化疗﹐手术﹐皮肤病﹐循环系统不良﹐营养不良等问题﹐而且每个人的体质不同﹐这也和遗传有关。有人说洗发精中化学物太多也可能导致脱发。甚至有人说淋了空气污染的化学雨﹐也会有严重后果。但若是有人已经试过各种昂贵的生发药品﹐而头发仍掉个不止﹐那就不妨检讨一下是不是洗头时水温太热。 这是绝大多数医生不谈的题目。医生在诊断掉头发问题的时候﹐秉持在医学院念书时所学到的知识﹐立即的反应就是开个药方﹐考虑写那一种药最好﹐而不会先问﹕?#20320;洗头时用的水是不是很热﹖?/FONT> 学富五车的人也会有他的盲点。医生花了许多时间﹐学到的东西车载斗量﹐可说是满腹的医学知识﹐但却因此没看到可能的问题症结所在。而那一点点简单的常识﹐也许能使问题迎刃而解﹐亦未可说。试试看﹐不必挂号﹐不须门诊﹐说不定大家把淋浴洗头时水温降低后﹐百分之五十五治掉头发的药都灵验了。运气好的话﹐甚至不必用药。愿大家不费一分钱﹐都能保有一头真善美的秀发﹐使假发无用武之地。
59907a6e75f7cafc2bf45775ed202072fcec1abe.translatedText: Hair Loss Hair Loss Jialin Hair loss seems to be a problem that worries many people. Under normal circumstances, there is loss and growth, which is the so-called metabolism. It is normal to lose dozens of hairs a day. But if you drop too much, the three thousand trouble threads will flock away from your head. Later, Tongshan Zhuozuo will become bald. Chinese hair-growing medicines include polygonum multiflorum, black sesame, and jujube. In the West, there are lecithin, cod liver oil, etc. There are some for internal use and some for external use. Although there are many types, no one is sure of the real effect. Americans spend more than $300 million on hair growth drugs every year. The cost of expensive hair transplant surgeries and wigs has not yet been calculated. The American Hair Loss Association warns on its website that, according to the Washington Post, 99 percent of all treatments don't work. Many years ago, I also had such a hair loss problem, and the doctor couldn't explain the reason. I started to pay attention to things in my diet that might be related to hair loss. It didn’t take long before I discovered that if I ate foods with added preservatives, such as instant noodles, my hair seemed to fall out more. One day, while taking a shower, I suddenly realized that my hair loss was due to the water being too hot. Does this have something to do with hair loss? I remember when I was a kid, when I saw people killing chickens, they had to pour hot water on them before plucking the feathers. I asked the person who killed the chickens why, and the answer was that it would make the hairs easier to pull out. Sure enough, after a while, he grabbed the chicken with one hand and plucked all the feathers cleanly with the other hand. It seems that a living person and a dead chicken cannot be compared, but the hair attached to the skin is the same. The pores will expand and contract with heat and cold. This is the first principle. There may be many reasons for hair loss, including hormones, age, chemotherapy, surgery, skin diseases, poor circulatory system, malnutrition and other issues. Moreover, everyone's constitution is different, which is also related to genetics. Some people say that too many chemicals in shampoo may also cause hair loss. Some people even say that being exposed to chemical rain from air pollution will have serious consequences. But if someone has tried various expensive hair-growth drugs and still has hair loss, they might as well check whether the water temperature when washing their hair is too hot. This is a topic that most doctors don’t talk about. When doctors diagnose hair loss problems, they adhere to the knowledge they learned while studying in medical school. Their immediate reaction is to write a prescription and consider which medicine is best, without first asking: Is the water used when washing hair very hot? ?/FONT> People who have learned a lot will also have their blind spots. The doctor spent a lot of time and learned an incredible amount of medical knowledge, but he failed to see the possible crux of the problem. And that little bit of simple common sense may solve the problem easily, but there is no telling. Give it a try. There is no need to register or go to the outpatient clinic. Maybe if you lower the water temperature in the shower when washing your hair, 55% of the medicines for treating hair loss will be effective. If you're lucky, you won't even need to take medication. I hope that everyone can keep a true, kind and beautiful hair without spending a penny, making wigs useless.

55c18f46d86d6f9c1afc0e6cc6b4aa394d886c0b.sourceText: 前总统克林顿周四为卡莫纳站台 为本州民主党籍国会参议员候选人理查德卡莫纳助选，美国前总统比尔克林顿将于本周三莅临坦佩。 卡莫纳的竞选班子说，克林顿周三晚将出现在ASU的投票前夜助选会，选民可以在周四投票。民主党候选人卡莫纳与共和党候选人杰夫弗拉奇共同竞选国会参议员乔恩凯尔因推行流出的空缺。稍早前，卡莫纳已获得奥巴马总统的支持。 助选会在亚利桑那州立大学的Sun Devil Performance Lawn举行。
55c18f46d86d6f9c1afc0e6cc6b4aa394d886c0b.translatedText: Former President Clinton stood for Carmona on Thursday to campaign for the state's Democratic Senate candidate Richard Carmona. Former US President Bill Clinton will come to Tempe this Wednesday. Carmona's campaign said Clinton will appear at an ASU rally Wednesday night and voters can cast their ballots Thursday. Carmona, the Democratic candidate, is running against Republican Jeff Frache for the vacancy left by Sen. Jon Kyl's campaign. Earlier, Carmona had received the support of President Obama. The campaign will be held at Arizona State University's Sun Devil Performance Lawn.

e72fd8a34c11c16c5cd85a8f173fe6dc8e860ee7.sourceText: 割喉政治 传薄熙来要求公开审判 [世界电邮报要闻组综合13日电] 美国前国务卿赖斯(Condoleezza Rice)13日在华府智库传统基金演讲时，就「薄熙来桉」表示，「薄熙来的桉子说明了中国本身的问题，中国的政治是如何操作的，地方官员与中央领导人之间的关係是什麽。而且归根结柢，要看中国人民对中国历史上这起最大的政治丑闻之一做出何种反应」。 美国前驻中国大使洪博培(Jon Huntsman)则表示，导致薄熙来被停止中共党内高级职务的，可能是中国的割喉政治，而非更广泛的意识形态斗争。 美国之音报导，目前在史丹福大学执教的赖斯表示，儘管外界不知道到底发生了什麽，但很显然，它提出了如何在一个集权体制下实行法治的问题。 她并表示，让她感到特别有意思的是中国网路空间对薄熙来桉子的讨论的公开程度。她说，这说明中国人非常希望了解国内正在发生的事情，而且下决心搞清楚发生了什麽。 赖斯说，中国领导层已意识到，独裁政权的合法性无法永远维繫。她指出，到目前为止，中共通过使老百姓致富而实现其合法性，但基于繁荣之上的合法性不会持续很长时间，因为人们的期望值会越来越高。中国民众不满「太子党」握有特权、不满社会的不公平，在中共今年召开18大之际，说明领导层面临许多内部挑战。 洪博培则认为，「薄熙来事件」是美国一窥中国政治内幕的机会，让人们了解中国政治是如何的残酷无情；他猜测，此事件和今年10月的中共领导层更迭有关，薄熙来的政敌蒐集情资，对他採取行动，这就是中国的地方政治。 洪博培说，薄熙来不可能很快复职，因为在年底之前，他将被拿来作为贪腐的桉例。 他说，中国正进入领导层世代交替、可能大规模变革的时期，由于过去30多年维持8%至10%的经济成长，新一代领导人可能比较国家主义。 不过，他说，在国家副主席习近平接班之后，美国和中国有很大机会建立更深的战略关係；他并预测，2013年中，习近平将会开展部分自由化进程。 [香港新闻组] 一位「消息可靠人士」透露，已被「双规」的前中共中央政治局委员、重庆市委书记薄熙来，要求对他进行公开审判。 该位据称有高层背景的消息人士说，薄熙来在刚被「双规」时，非常愤怒，要求面见中央总书记胡锦涛和政治局常委周永康。在这一要求被拒绝后，他对专桉审查人员表示，「你们根本没有资格来审查我，给我立即滚蛋！」报导说，他甚至动手打了一位审查人员耳光。之后，便沉默不语，根本不理会专桉审查人员的询问。 香港「苹果日报」报导，当专桉审查人员为了打击薄熙来气焰而告诉他，他的妻子已被捕之后，薄熙来更是震怒。他一方面大骂周永康「不讲义气」，并承认是周永康向他透露了王立军出逃美国领馆的消息，还要求「他立即採取行动，不惜任何代价将王立军弄出来」；另一方面，薄又完全不承认妻子谷开来谋杀英国商人海伍德(Neil Heywood)，声称这完全是「政治陷害」，他绝不会承认这种「无中生有的栽赃陷害」。 薄熙来还要求对他进行公开的审判，并表示除非进行公开审判，否则他不会再说任何话。 另据「多维新闻」13日引述「接近中共内部直接处理薄桉」的消息人士说，根据中央调查组掌握的大量证据，薄熙来涉及的罪责将是「性质极其恶劣的贪腐问题、重大的刑事桉件以及挑战中央的『个人山头主义』」。 报导说，中共中央已初步掌握薄熙来数额惊人的海外资产，很可能成为中共党史上最大的贪腐桉件。目前已有证据显示他个人亲自指示或参与了几起涉及命桉的刑事桉件。此外，他个人「狂妄自大」蔑视中央权威，甚至挑战和威胁中央领导层。 根据中共高层对薄熙来以上「罪责」的初步定调，这位前中央政治局委员、重庆市委书记不仅政治生涯已结束，可能被判重罪甚至死刑。
e72fd8a34c11c16c5cd85a8f173fe6dc8e860ee7.translatedText: Cut-throat politics: Bo Xilai is rumored to demand a public trial [Global News Team reported on the 13th] Former US Secretary of State Rice (Condoleezza) When Rice gave a speech at the Heritage Foundation, a Washington think tank, on the 13th, he said about the "Bo Xilai scandal", "Bo Xilai's scandal illustrates China's own problems, how China's politics is operated, and what the relationship between local officials and central leaders is. And in the final analysis, it depends on how the Chinese people react to one of the biggest political scandals in Chinese history." Jon Huntsman, the former U.S. ambassador to China, said that China's cut-throat politics, rather than a broader ideological struggle, may have led to Bo Xilai's suspension from senior positions in the Chinese Communist Party. Voice of America reported that Rice, who currently teaches at Stanford University, said that although the outside world does not know what exactly happened, it clearly raised the issue of how to implement the rule of law in a centralized system. She also said that what she found particularly interesting was the openness with which Bo Xilai's case was discussed in Chinese cyberspace. She said this shows that the Chinese people really want to know what is happening in the country and are determined to find out what is going on. Rice said China's leadership has realized that the legitimacy of an authoritarian regime cannot be maintained forever. She pointed out that so far, the CCP has achieved its legitimacy by making ordinary people rich, but legitimacy based on prosperity will not last long because people's expectations will become higher and higher. The Chinese people are dissatisfied with the privileges held by "princelings" and dissatisfied with social injustice. As the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China is convening this year, it shows that the leadership faces many internal challenges. Huntsman believes that the "Bo Xilai incident" is an opportunity for the United States to get a glimpse into the inside story of Chinese politics, allowing people to understand how cruel and ruthless Chinese politics is. He speculates that this incident is related to the change of leadership of the Chinese Communist Party in October this year. Bo Xilai's political opponents collect information and take action against him. This is China's local politics. Huntsman said Bo Xilai is unlikely to be reinstated soon because he will be used as an example of corruption before the end of the year. He said that China is entering a period of leadership generation change and possible large-scale changes. Since the economy has maintained an economic growth of 8% to 10% in the past 30 years, the new generation of leaders may be more nationalistic. However, he said that after Vice President Xi Jinping takes over, the United States and China have a great opportunity to establish a deeper strategic relationship; he also predicted that in mid-2013, Xi Jinping will carry out a partial liberalization process. [Hong Kong News Group] A "reliable source" revealed that Bo Xilai, a former member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee who has been "double-regulated", requested a public trial for him. The source, said to have a high-level background, said that when Bo Xilai was first "double-regulated", he was very angry and asked to meet with Hu Jintao, General Secretary of the Central Committee, and Zhou Yongkang, member of the Politburo Standing Committee. After this request was rejected, he told the special reviewers, "You are not qualified to review me at all. Get out of here immediately!" Reports say that he even slapped one reviewer. After that, he remained silent and ignored the inquiries of the special reviewers. Hong Kong's "Apple Daily" reported that Bo Xilai was even more furious when special prosecutors told him that his wife had been arrested in order to dampen Bo Xilai's arrogance. On the one hand, he scolded Zhou Yongkang for being "unloyal" and admitted that it was Zhou Yongkang who revealed to him the news of Wang Lijun's escape from the U.S. consulate, and demanded that "he take immediate action to get Wang Lijun out at any cost." On the other hand, Bo completely refused to admit that his wife Gu Kailai murdered British businessman Neil Heywood, claiming that this was completely a "political frame-up" and that he would never admit such "unfounded frame-up." Bo Xilai also demanded a public trial and said he would not say anything more unless there was a public trial. According to "Duowei News" on the 13th, citing "sources close to the CCP's direct handling of Bo", according to the large amount of evidence obtained by the Central Investigation Team, Bo Xilai's crimes will be "extremely egregious corruption issues, major criminal cases, and "personal mountaineering" that challenges the central government." Reports say that the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China has initially grasped Bo Xilai's staggering amount of overseas assets, which is likely to become the largest corruption case in the history of the Communist Party of China. There is evidence that he personally directed or participated in several criminal cases involving murder. In addition, he is personally "arrogant" and defies central authority, and even challenges and threatens the central leadership. According to the preliminary determination of the "culpability" of Bo Xilai and above by the CCP's top leaders, not only is the political career of the former member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee and Secretary of the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee ended, but he may be sentenced to a felony or even death.

59f98a67934d5fc5cce1f39f5a0d92ab9944b07f.translatedText: China’s holdings of U.S. Treasury bonds hit a record high The latest statistics released by the U.S. Department of the Treasury on the 16th showed that China increased its holdings of U.S. Treasury bonds by $25.2 billion in May, making...

930c376f90c119e21a9062fa0c1dd106d5df8708.sourceText: 数据显示，2013年5月，中国持有美债首次达到创纪录的1.3159万亿美元，仍然为美国最大的债权国，这一数据较4月修正后的1.2907万亿美元增持了252亿美元。4月修正前的数据为1.2649万亿美元。
930c376f90c119e21a9062fa0c1dd106d5df8708.translatedText: Data show that in May 2013, China's holdings of U.S. debt reached a record high of $1.3159 trillion for the first time, making it still the largest creditor of the United States. This data increased by $25.2 billion from the revised $1.2907 trillion in April. The pre-revision figure for April was $1.2649 trillion.

5a4fad7f0d10142b44d2fec0461ea2e437691b65.sourceText: 从2012年5月到2013年5月这一年的时间看，中国持有美国国债总体呈现”增多减少”的趋势，其中减持只有4次，其余全部为增持，特别是从今年2月以来已连续4个月增持美国国债。
5a4fad7f0d10142b44d2fec0461ea2e437691b65.translatedText: From May 2012 to May 2013, China's holdings of U.S. Treasury bonds generally showed an "increase and decrease" trend. Among them, China reduced its holdings only four times, and the rest were all increases. Especially since February this year, it has increased its holdings of U.S. Treasury bonds for four consecutive months.

3758392b38c3c876761a724ac5cb36df275076a9.sourceText: 从数据看，2013年5月与2012年5月相比，中国持有美国国债同比增加了1519亿美元。而根据美国财政部上月公布的修正后的数据，与2011年相比，中国2012年全年增持685亿美元美债。
3758392b38c3c876761a724ac5cb36df275076a9.translatedText: From the data, compared with May 2012, China's holdings of U.S. Treasury bonds increased by US$151.9 billion year-on-year. According to revised data released by the U.S. Treasury Department last month, compared with 2011, China increased its holdings of U.S. debt by $68.5 billion in 2012.

f6f32207e7fc743e80025193daf695d0cc085fbd.sourceText: 在中国持续增持美债的同时，作为美国第二大债权国的日本则连续两个月减持美债，5月份日本持有的美债由4月的1.1127万亿美元降至1.1110万亿美元，与中国相差2049亿美元。4月份日本也曾减持了16亿美元美债。不过，该国持有美债总量仍连续13个月居于1.1万亿关口之上。
f6f32207e7fc743e80025193daf695d0cc085fbd.translatedText: While China continues to increase its holdings of U.S. debt, Japan, the second largest creditor of the United States, has reduced its holdings of U.S. debt for two consecutive months. In May, Japan's holdings of U.S. debt fell from $1.1127 trillion in April to $1.1110 trillion, a gap of $204.9 billion from China. Japan also reduced its holdings of U.S. debt by $1.6 billion in April. However, the country’s total U.S. debt holdings have remained above the 1.1 trillion mark for 13 consecutive months.

f9bc58692f36a0e4cb0d6a96e57d450b4976d23c.sourceText: 对于增持美国国债的问题，一些中国专家分析认为，考虑到目前世界经济的整体状况以及美国无可匹敌的国家实力，美国国债仍是国际债券市场的主导性投资产品。仅从安全性角度考虑，投资美债依旧要优于其他国家的债券。此外，美国经济日趋复苏，也为美元走强提供了支撑。
f9bc58692f36a0e4cb0d6a96e57d450b4976d23c.translatedText: Regarding the issue of increasing holdings of U.S. Treasury bonds, some Chinese experts believe that, taking into account the current overall state of the world economy and the unrivaled national strength of the United States, U.S. Treasury bonds are still the dominant investment product in the international bond market. From a safety perspective alone, investing in U.S. bonds is still better than bonds from other countries. In addition, the increasing recovery of the U.S. economy has also provided support for the strength of the U.S. dollar.

33dd76abc837500b86e40b9eb5410241cb99cc9a.sourceText: 无证移民小心！美移民执法机构明年重点检查无证者
33dd76abc837500b86e40b9eb5410241cb99cc9a.translatedText: Undocumented immigrants, beware! U.S. immigration law enforcement agencies will focus on inspecting undocumented people next year

d225db0141b8e287bbc9d3565a8556bd869be44b.sourceText: 无证移民小心！美移民执法机构明年重点检查无证者 中新网12月29日电 据美国《世界日报》报道，美国移民和海关执…
d225db0141b8e287bbc9d3565a8556bd869be44b.translatedText: Undocumented immigrants, beware! US immigration law enforcement agencies will focus on inspecting undocumented persons next year. China News Service, December 29 (Xinhua) According to the US "World Journal" report, the US Immigration and Customs Enforcement...

08fefa56d90f9b0852df4486ec0e5f9d8337ac12.sourceText: 中新网12月29日电 据美国《世界日报》报道，美国移民和海关执法局(ICE)高层官员指出，在新的一年里，移民主管机关将对职场移民人口加强稽查，并出现较历任总统执政期间都还严格的手段，重点在于雇主是否确实遵守移民法规。
08fefa56d90f9b0852df4486ec0e5f9d8337ac12.translatedText: China News Service, December 29 (Xinhua) According to the US "World Journal" report, senior officials of the US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) pointed out that in the new year, the immigration authorities will intensify inspections of immigrants in the workplace and adopt more stringent measures than during previous presidential administrations. The focus will be on whether employers actually comply with immigration regulations.

a147b416efb70de35314145b38ba08a37dc91c2e.sourceText: 数十年前，类似的职场移民稽查行动，经常引发雇用无证移民劳工的企业界反弹，导致稽查行动以雷声大雨点小告终。
a147b416efb70de35314145b38ba08a37dc91c2e.translatedText: Decades ago, similar workplace immigration audits often triggered backlash from companies that employed undocumented immigrant workers, resulting in the audits ending with a lot of thunder and a small amount of rain.

072fec89dbb58d4d9492b80620a1ff7e44320d81.sourceText: 联邦移民和海关执法局下辖的国土安全调查处(Homeland Security Investigations)负责田纳西州事务的副特别探员汉默尔(Robert Hammer)指出，仅在田州，联邦机关从2018年开始，就会针对州内各地的职场，全面加强移民执法，展开稽查行动。
072fec89dbb58d4d9492b80620a1ff7e44320d81.translatedText: Robert Hammer, deputy special agent in charge of Tennessee affairs of Homeland Security Investigations under the federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement Agency, pointed out that in Tennessee alone, starting in 2018, federal agencies will comprehensively strengthen immigration law enforcement and launch inspection operations targeting workplaces across the state.

06223dc968e52b73351660c0acc86160de2220c8.sourceText: 执行层面上，汉默尔指出，稽查重点可能着重于”重大基础设施”，包括机场、国防包商、食品运输业，以及其他涉及公共安全与福祉的企业。
06223dc968e52b73351660c0acc86160de2220c8.translatedText: At the executive level, Hamel pointed out that the focus of inspections may focus on "major infrastructure," including airports, defense contractors, the food transportation industry, and other companies involved in public safety and welfare.

1015f3948b27f945ab2dfdf5799888fc8aa34cc6.sourceText: 汉默尔以田州为例表示，在联邦移民和海关执法局代理局长霍曼(Thomas D. Homan)的命令下，调查人员过去这段期间，不断加强针对职场移民的稽查行动。他表示，霍曼要求调查人员必须把移民稽查行动的重点，放在各工作场所。
1015f3948b27f945ab2dfdf5799888fc8aa34cc6.translatedText: Taking Tianzhou as an example, Hammel said that under the order of Thomas D. Homan, acting director of the Federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement Agency, investigators have continuously strengthened inspections on workplace immigration during the past period. He said Homan asked investigators to focus their immigration audits on workplaces.

430127d00c03639221b91474b0571b2490530c03.sourceText: 汉默尔表示，不同工作地点所安排的优先级各有差别，重大基础设施则被主管机关列为优先项目。他说：”每个单位都缺人手。因此，在人力有限的情况下，我们必须把资源集中能够获得最大成效的目标上头。”
430127d00c03639221b91474b0571b2490530c03.translatedText: Hammel said that different work locations have different priorities, and major infrastructure is listed as a priority project by the competent authorities. He said: "Every unit is short of manpower. Therefore, with limited manpower, we must concentrate resources on the goals that can achieve the greatest results."

58901fa1f3c2d28842c38faf20484003dfd404ea.sourceText: 他说，来自社会大众的举报线索，也会让调查人员对其他工作场所展开稽查。
58901fa1f3c2d28842c38faf20484003dfd404ea.translatedText: He said that reporting clues from the public will also allow investigators to conduct inspections of other workplaces.

8f05eb1a05111605c05d3424957580d8d1b01d5c.sourceText: 汉默尔说：”我们希望对于民众举报与线索做出回应。线索通常来自公司行号里的现任员工，或者已经离职的前雇员都有。”
8f05eb1a05111605c05d3424957580d8d1b01d5c.translatedText: Hammel said: "We hope to respond to public reports and clues. The clues usually come from current employees in the company, or former employees who have resigned."

fcd2b10c85bc00f9c391430094e55b2f2da3bbf5.sourceText: 根据媒体报道，联邦机关加强职场移民扫荡，可能对聘用了移民劳公的公司行号与不同产业造成冲击，对于整体小区而言，也会造成某种程度的影响。
fcd2b10c85bc00f9c391430094e55b2f2da3bbf5.translatedText: According to media reports, federal agencies have stepped up their efforts to crack down on workplace immigration, which may have an impact on company lines and different industries that employ immigrant workers. It will also have a certain impact on the overall community.

f6b043bf62f228284cb98a2b74ee900ffdef45ad.sourceText: 反对人士指出，加强职场移民稽查将对辛苦赚钱养家的平民百姓带来伤害，对产业来说则如同遏止劳工供应来源。相对的，对稽查行动持赞成立场的支持者则指出，如此改变将为美国公民开启就业大门，也让合法劳工能够获得更好的薪资条件。
f6b043bf62f228284cb98a2b74ee900ffdef45ad.translatedText: Opponents point out that strengthening immigration inspections in the workplace will harm ordinary people who work hard to earn money to support their families, and for industries, it will be like curbing the source of labor supply. In contrast, supporters of the audit pointed out that such changes would open employment doors for American citizens and allow legal workers to obtain better wage conditions.

34085e2bc09c0b48209460096a42b2ec6ae1f039.sourceText: 凤凰城凤鸣：女儿第二次来美探亲 从年初开始，女儿在电话中传来好消息，准备今年夏天孩子放暑假期间，帶儿子来…
34085e2bc09c0b48209460096a42b2ec6ae1f039.translatedText: Phoenix City Fengming: My daughter comes to the United States to visit relatives for the second time. Since the beginning of the year, my daughter has received good news on the phone, and she is planning to bring her son to visit relatives in the United States during the children's summer vacation this summer...

f23e50bf47d9ae94a00ebd98ae4c98996818babb.sourceText: 凤凰城凤鸣：女儿第二次来美探亲 从年初开始，女儿在电话中传来好消息，准备今年夏天孩子放暑假期间，帶儿子来美探亲。我们夫妻二人都很高兴，盼着时间快点过。终於在七月底她们母子二人先飞来美国，与我们一家团聚，加上儿子一家共八口人欢聚一堂。他先生后来，与我们团聚。至此一双儿女的两家人，都在美國团聚，亲人团聚其乐融融，家的感觉真好！拍了许多全家福照片，留下珍贵的纪念。可是有团聚就有分离，他(她) 们是来也匆匆、去也匆匆，三周的时间一恍而过，他(她 ) 们現在已飞回中國自己的家。回想起来，忧如做了一场美梦，人去房空，若大的一幢房子，就只有我和先生两人。白天先生一早出门上班，只有我一人面对空房子。有极大的失落感。当我从思绪中拉回自己，想写点什么，又觉得無从下笔。一人在家，恍来恍去无所事事。經过几天来的调正，已能安静下心来做些事。 这次女儿帶她儿子凯文一起来美探亲，想利用三周的时间，让凯文到夏令营与美國小朋友一起，练习一下英语，提高凯文的英语口语水平。但是他来的有些晚，这里的中、小学都开学了，没有这种夏令营，练英语的计划泡湯了。让一个十几岁的孩子，天天在家呆着是多不容易的事。凯文的性格很好，很容易与人相处，很爱运动，也更爱玩游戏，这大概是現代孩子的统一的嗜好，很难自己控制，必须要周围的亲友限制和监督，凯文也不例外。 我的女儿给凯文规定，每天要学多少英语単词、打多長时间乒乓球、玩多長时间游戏等等，凯文基本上都能按计划完成，我每天除了忙一日三餐外，要陪凯文打两次乒乓球。和凯文打球一开始不太适应，他打球的风格和球路与我先生完全不同。首先，他的发球姿势怪怪的，发过来的球旋转的很励害，球拍一碰就飞出去了。凯文很得意我们(我和先生)都接不了他的無规则的上旋、下旋、左旋和右旋球。不过，没过多久，我渐渐地模到他发球和各种旋转球的規律，和我打球他不再小看我。我们俩每天有两场球的较量，你来我往互不相让，打得是难觧难分，不分胜负、输赢。每场打一抽屉球，一抽屉有300多个球，打得我们俩都挥汗如雨、汗流夹背。虽然这运动对我来说，已是很強的体育活动，可凯文不一会就休息过来，他又去玩一种在电视上玩的运动，他真是精力充沛，有混身用不完的力气，真得好羡慕他。为了能让凯文在美国的生活不单调，更有意义，除了在家的运动以外，她的母亲帶他去一个游乐场游泳，又帶他去一个运动场打羽毛球，把他妈妈累得不行，他一点事没有。他的到来，给我们帶来勃勃生机，家中充满了快乐的欢声笑话，家的感觉真好！ 女儿的先生这次虽然也来了，可是国内公司的事，仍然放不下。白天帶着出差的任务，飞来飞去，夜里还要与国内视频，安排工作，一天休息不了几个小时，实在是太忙、太劳累了，身体都呈現亚健康状态。。女儿在国内的工作性质，也是飞来飞去，有时夫妻二人都出差，家中多亏有公公、婆婆邦他（她）们照看孩子。現在的年青人也真不容易，要想事业有成，就要比别人多努力、多付出。看他（她 ）们都这样辛苦、劳累，真是看在眼里、疼在心上。感谢 神！虽然他（她 ）们都很辛苦、劳累，但有 神的保守，都还算工作顺利，能撑起自己这个幸福的家！
f23e50bf47d9ae94a00ebd98ae4c98996818babb.translatedText: Phoenix City Fengming: My daughter has come to the United States to visit relatives for the second time. Starting from the beginning of the year, my daughter has received good news on the phone, and she is planning to bring her son to visit relatives in the United States during the children's summer vacation this summer. We, as husband and wife, are very happy and look forward to the time passing by quickly. Finally, at the end of July, mother and son flew to the United States to reunite with our family. Together with our son's family, a total of eight people gathered together. His husband later reunited with us. So far, two families with two sons and a daughter have reunited in the United States. The family members are reunited happily. It feels like home! We took many family photos and left precious memories. But with reunion comes separation. They came and left in a hurry. Three weeks passed by in a flash, and they have now flown back to their home in China. Looking back, Youru had a sweet dream. The house was empty. If it was a big house, there were only my husband and me. During the day, my husband left for work early in the morning, and I was the only one facing an empty house. There is a great sense of loss. When I pull myself out of my thoughts and want to write something, I feel unable to do so. I was alone at home, wandering back and forth with nothing to do. After a few days of adjustment, I was able to calm down and do some things. This time, my daughter brought her son Kevin to visit relatives in the United States. She wanted to use three weeks to have Kevin go to a summer camp to practice English with American children and improve Kevin's English speaking skills. But he came a little late. The primary and secondary schools here have all started school. Without this kind of summer camp, the plan to practice English was ruined. It is not easy for a teenage child to stay at home every day. Kevin has a good personality and is easy to get along with others. He loves sports and playing games. This is probably a common hobby of modern children. It is difficult to control it by yourself and must be restricted and supervised by relatives and friends around you. Kevin is no exception. My daughter gave Kevin rules on how many English words he should learn every day, how long he should play table tennis, how long he should play games, etc. Kevin could basically complete it as planned. In addition to three meals a day, I had to play table tennis with Kevin twice every day. It was hard to get used to playing with Kevin at first. His playing style and approach were completely different from my husband. First of all, his serving posture is weird. The ball he serves spins so hard that the racket flies out as soon as he touches it. Kevin was very proud that neither of us (my husband and I) could catch his irregular top spin, back spin, left spin and right spin. However, it didn't take long for me to gradually learn the rules of his serve and various spins, and he no longer looked down upon me when I played with him. The two of us have two ball competitions every day. You come and I don't give in to each other. The fight is inseparable, with no winner or loser. We played a drawer of balls every game, and there were more than 300 balls in the drawer. We were both sweating profusely. Although this exercise is already a very strong physical activity for me, Kevin took a break after a while and went to play a sport played on TV. He was really energetic and had endless strength. I really envy him. In order to make Kevin's life in the United States less monotonous and more meaningful, in addition to the sports at home, her mother took him to an amusement park to swim, and then took him to a sports field to play badminton. His mother was so exhausted that he had nothing to do. His arrival brought us great vitality, and the home was filled with happy laughter and laughter. It felt so good to be at home! Although my daughter's husband is here this time, he still can't let go of the domestic company matters. During the day, I was flying back and forth with business trips, and at night I had to communicate with people in China to arrange work. I couldn't rest for a few hours a day. I was really too busy and tired, and my body was in a sub-healthy state. . My daughter’s work in China also involves flying back and forth, and sometimes both husband and wife are on business trips. Thanks to the father-in-law and mother-in-law, they can take care of the children at home. It’s really not easy for young people today. If you want to succeed in your career, you have to work harder and pay more than others. Seeing them (her) working so hard and tired, it really hurts my eyes and hurts my heart. Thank God! Although he (she) is very hard and tired, with God’s protection, they all work smoothly and can support their own happy family!

5dcfaa119bec9ebee7fefbf3ddce3379935d59e1.sourceText: 张艺谋贝尔谈《十三钗》 登《好莱坞报道》封面(图)
5dcfaa119bec9ebee7fefbf3ddce3379935d59e1.translatedText: Zhang Yimou Bell talks about "Thirteen Hairpins" and appears on the cover of "Hollywood Reporter" (photo)

704bc93f9b7a910894e4f51903013086abc85c7a.sourceText: 张艺谋贝尔谈《十三钗》 登《好莱坞报道》封面(图) 据国外媒体报道称，美国权威娱…
704bc93f9b7a910894e4f51903013086abc85c7a.translatedText: Zhang Yimou Bell talks about "Thirteen Hairpins" and appears on the cover of "Hollywood Reporter" (photo) According to foreign media reports, the authoritative American entertainment...

7f9da1651dc10c7c36cc17185bc416f5ccecec39.sourceText: 据国外媒体报道称，美国权威娱乐资讯媒体《好莱坞报道》在最新一期的封面人物中选择了由于拍摄《金陵十三钗》而备受关注的张艺谋与克里斯蒂安 贝尔这对组合，这篇报道主要探讨了《金陵十三钗》将会对中国商业电影产生的影响等。
7f9da1651dc10c7c36cc17185bc416f5ccecec39.translatedText: According to foreign media reports, the authoritative American entertainment information media "Hollywood Reporter" has chosen the pair of Zhang Yimou and Christian Bale, who have attracted much attention due to the filming of "Jinling Jinling", as the cover characters of the latest issue. This report mainly discusses the impact that "Jinling Jinling" will have on Chinese commercial films.

41149d188c50141fd41abe62a312e976548a1e4f.sourceText: 《金陵十三钗》以1937年日本侵略者制造的臭名昭著的南京大屠杀为历史背景，讲述了由贝尔饰演的一位美国殡仪职业者为寻求战争避难来到了一所天主教教堂，在那里，他认识了13位同样也为了躲避战火来到教堂的风尘女子。该片改编自著名作家严歌苓的同名小说，将于12月底在美国上映一周，全球首映时间为12月16日。
41149d188c50141fd41abe62a312e976548a1e4f.translatedText: "Jinling Thirteen Hairpins" takes the infamous Nanjing Massacre caused by the Japanese invaders in 1937 as the historical background. It tells the story of an American funeral professional, played by Bell, who came to a Catholic church to seek refuge from the war. There, he met 13 prostitutes who also came to the church to escape the war. The film is adapted from the novel of the same name by the famous writer Yan Geling. It will be released in the United States for one week at the end of December, with its world premiere on December 16.

01772d0759e1a6d9becc2a9c58614365912def4b.sourceText: 中国电影业这些年来蓬勃发展，票房成绩让世界同行感到艳羡。福克斯国际影业公司的总裁斯坦福 潘宁弛表示：”中国是世界上增长速度最快的市场，合作制片将对双方非常有利。”
01772d0759e1a6d9becc2a9c58614365912def4b.translatedText: The Chinese film industry has been booming in recent years, and its box office performance is the envy of its peers around the world. Stanford Panning, president of Fox International Pictures, said: "China is the fastest growing market in the world, and co-production will be very beneficial to both parties."

b8c4bdc872bff7ec29dad86e234d71b7a204a902.sourceText: 就业市场回暖 高薪职位增多
b8c4bdc872bff7ec29dad86e234d71b7a204a902.translatedText: The job market has picked up, and high-paying jobs have increased

45dcb15e14b257b180cd50a19ac1c2fd670c2436.sourceText: 就业市场回暖 高薪职位增多 CNNMoney称，在过去两年里，制造飞机、汽车和机械的工厂就业机会增长态势良…
45dcb15e14b257b180cd50a19ac1c2fd670c2436.translatedText: The job market has picked up, and high-paying jobs have increased. CNNMoney said that in the past two years, job opportunities in factories that manufacture aircraft, automobiles and machinery have grown at a good pace...

a63c39ff62d350dc9477a67516a0f21ee4702619.sourceText: 自从2010年2月就业市场达到谷底起，卫生保健行业就增加了400万个总就业机会增加数中的17%，而且很多保健职位薪水很高。
a63c39ff62d350dc9477a67516a0f21ee4702619.translatedText: Since the job market reached its bottom in February 2010, the health care industry has added 17% of the 4 million total job gains, and many health care positions have high salaries.

f339200de2dd2cdeb936b3538bd705010062ca88.sourceText: 根据劳工统计局，医疗和牙科诊所的门诊护理工作人员，工资中位数为每小时18美元，在医院工作的可达到23小时，注册护士则为每小时32美元左右。
f339200de2dd2cdeb936b3538bd705010062ca88.translatedText: According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, the median wage for ambulatory care workers in medical and dental offices is $18 per hour, with those working in hospitals earning up to 23 hours, and registered nurses making around $32 per hour.

a97e7d787ea328093941eb822786d27be8750ec3.sourceText: 另一个就业激增的是专业和技术服务，广义包括会计师、律师、建筑师和计算机工程师等。2010年年初美国经济开始复苏以来，这些工作占美国所有工作增加数的13%，平均工资为每小时28美元。尽管失业态势很严峻，但技术部门的失业率却低得多。
a97e7d787ea328093941eb822786d27be8750ec3.translatedText: Another area of ​​employment growth is professional and technical services, which broadly includes accountants, lawyers, architects and computer engineers. Since the U.S. economy began to recover in early 2010, these jobs have accounted for 13% of all job growth in the U.S., with average wages of $28 an hour. While unemployment is dire, unemployment in the technology sector is much lower.

47acce05315d46fa5fb80bfd6997800b25406565.sourceText: 软件开发人员的需求特别高。工资中位数每小时可达43美元，而这还可能会进一步提升。因为这类专业人员需要集科学、数学和业务技能于一身，而能够达到标准的人员极少。
47acce05315d46fa5fb80bfd6997800b25406565.translatedText: Software developers are in particularly high demand. Median wages are as high as $43 an hour, and this is likely to rise further. Because such professionals require a combination of scientific, mathematical and business skills, and few can meet the standards.

efa8a27c19bd24a0950a371f6adebcf31b86d301.sourceText: 去年全球IT和软件公司在美国雇用了约2千人，并计划在2015年之前，在欧洲和美国再招聘1万名专业人员。具备相关学历与经验的受聘人员，其薪资可达美元6位数。
efa8a27c19bd24a0950a371f6adebcf31b86d301.translatedText: Global IT and software companies employed about 2,000 people in the United States last year and plan to hire an additional 10,000 professionals in Europe and the United States by 2015. For those employed with relevant academic qualifications and experience, their salary can reach 6 figures in US dollars.

a2877a45c2ef8250bd2ff2f03c82ba9ba53974fc.sourceText: 虽然对于440万失业的美国蓝领来说，不具备大专以上学历的人，是不可能找到高薪工作的，但需要高级技术的制造工作职位，却是无需高学历的高薪职位。
a2877a45c2ef8250bd2ff2f03c82ba9ba53974fc.translatedText: Although it is impossible for the 4.4 million unemployed American blue-collar workers to find high-paying jobs without a college degree or above, manufacturing jobs that require advanced skills are high-paying positions that do not require high education.

2988177846e2ceda1fe1468c29f20f05ec77fd52.sourceText: 全国制造商协会首席经济学家穆特瑞称，经济衰退结束以来，制造业几乎创造了50万个就业机会，而且几乎所有的这些工作都来自耐用品部门，主要为航空航太、汽车、金属、电脑和机械，都是高薪工作。
2988177846e2ceda1fe1468c29f20f05ec77fd52.translatedText: National Association of Manufacturers Chief Economist Mutrie said that since the end of the recession, the manufacturing industry has created almost 500,000 jobs, and almost all of these jobs come from the durable goods sector, mainly aerospace, automobiles, metals, computers and machinery, and are all high-paying jobs.
