7713fefe68db87a44a56d91f8026c5e44cb49707.translatedText: The selling price of Tesla electric trucks is lower than experts expected, perhaps due to advances in battery technology TechWeb reports News on November 27, according to foreign media reports, special...

b6a431b51684e35530d8def53786645716f6e794.sourceText: TechWeb报道 11月27日消息，据国外媒体报道，特斯拉上周四公布了旗下首款电动卡车Semi的售价，虽然高于目前的柴油卡车，但还是远低于专家预期，这或许是得益于电池技术的进步。
b6a431b51684e35530d8def53786645716f6e794.translatedText: TechWeb reported According to foreign media reports, Tesla announced the price of its first electric truck Semi last Thursday. Although it is higher than the current diesel truck, it is still far lower than experts expected. This may be due to advances in battery technology.

ef35a3c448b97a07a9bbc2c8be5ba5bc10a06dd1.sourceText: 特斯拉在当时间11月17日发布了旗下首款电动卡车Semi，一周之后就公布了售价。特斯拉上周四公布的售价表明，续航300英里（约482公里）的入门版Semi售价为15万美元，续航500英里（约804公里）的高配版售价为18万美元，创始人系列中的那1000辆售价为20万美元。
ef35a3c448b97a07a9bbc2c8be5ba5bc10a06dd1.translatedText: >Tesla released its first electric truck, the Semi, on November 17, and announced the price a week later. The prices announced by Tesla on Thursday showed that the entry-level Semi with a range of 300 miles (approximately 482 kilometers) is priced at US$150,000, the high-end version with a range of 500 miles (approximately 804 kilometers) is priced at US$180,000, and the 1,000 vehicles in the Founder Series are priced at US$200,000.

d670ca021183b1e73aadaa964b39768b0781b81e.sourceText: 虽然特斯拉公布的还只是基础价格，并没有包括需要用户选择的配置选项，即便客户在确定配置之后，最终售价会略高，但其还是会低于专家们此前的预期。
d670ca021183b1e73aadaa964b39768b0781b81e.translatedText: Although Tesla announced only the basic price and did not include configuration options that users need to choose, even if the final price will be slightly higher after customers determine the configuration, it will still be lower than experts had previously expected.

0070b711dafcdb66fb58bfcb22268db3b55abbde.sourceText: 在特斯拉公布电动卡车Semi的售价之前，Axios记者史蒂夫.莱文（Steve Levine）曾出版过一本有关电池技术的书，在书中他提到专家们预计特斯拉Semi的售价在30万美元左右。《麻省理工技术评论》预计的售价更高，他们预计是在40万美元左右，比特斯拉公布售价的2倍还要高。
0070b711dafcdb66fb58bfcb22268db3b55abbde.translatedText: Before Tesla announced the price of the electric truck Semi, Axios reporter Steve Levine published a book on battery technology. In the book, he mentioned that experts expected the price of the Tesla Semi to be around US$300,000. "MIT Technology Review" estimates the selling price to be higher. They estimate it to be around US$400,000, which is more than twice Tesla's announced selling price.

33afb4b8c75bbd9cd6ccdb31387bc738c53d9662.sourceText: 从外媒后续的报道来看，特斯拉电动卡车的售价之所以远低于专家的预期，可能主要还是得益于电池技术的进步。
33afb4b8c75bbd9cd6ccdb31387bc738c53d9662.translatedText: Judging from subsequent reports from foreign media, the reason why the price of Tesla’s electric trucks is far lower than experts’ expectations may be mainly due to the advancement of battery technology.

6385f4cf4ddeea76e929f751170026e4a337060a.sourceText: 特斯拉在发布电动卡车Semi时，表示其每英里的耗电量不超过2千瓦/时，这也就意味着其入门版Semi的电池容量在600千瓦/时左右，高配版的电池容量则在1000千瓦/时左右。
6385f4cf4ddeea76e929f751170026e4a337060a.translatedText: When Tesla released the electric truck Semi, it stated that its power consumption per mile did not exceed 2 kilowatts/hour, which means that the battery capacity of its entry-level Semi is about 600 kilowatts/hour, and the battery capacity of the high-end version is about 1,000 kilowatts/hour.

e3e5ffcbaebeba81a28fab868ea386eedac98e55.sourceText: 特斯拉方面的一名高管去年曾表示，电池组成本会降到每千瓦/时190美元以下，这样1000千瓦/时的电池成本在19万美元左右，算上电动卡车的其他成本，Semi售价就在30万美元左右。
e3e5ffcbaebeba81a28fab868ea386eedac98e55.translatedText: A Tesla executive said last year that the cost of the battery pack would drop below $190 per kilowatt hour, so that the cost of a 1,000 kilowatt hour battery would be around $190,000. Taking into account other costs of the electric truck, the Semi would be priced at around $300,000.

93527b61510950299c009b1feaa7f382dc757d82.sourceText: 但这还只是特斯拉高管去年给出的估计，电池技术还在不断的进步。而特斯拉电动卡车要在2019年才会上市，目前还有一年多的时间，特斯拉有足够的时间来研发技术更先进、成本也更低的电池。此外，到目前为止，特斯拉所发布的电动汽车，还没有一款如期上市，上市时间都晚于发布会上公布的时间，电动卡车Semi不一定能在2019年如期上市，这也就意味留给特斯拉的时间会更多，可能会接近两年。
93527b61510950299c009b1feaa7f382dc757d82.translatedText: But this is only an estimate given by Tesla executives last year. Battery technology is still improving. The Tesla electric truck will not be launched until 2019, which is still more than a year away. Tesla has enough time to develop more technologically advanced and lower-cost batteries. In addition, so far, none of the electric vehicles released by Tesla have been launched as scheduled, and the launch time is later than the time announced at the press conference. The electric truck Semi may not be launched as scheduled in 2019, which means that Tesla will have more time, which may be close to two years.

e7e77233dad504d6516048226203225bedb73228.sourceText: 特斯拉方面给出的电动卡车每英里耗电量不超过2千瓦/时、每千瓦时成本190美元，可能都只是保守估计。从去年开始，电池成本就在不断下降。
e7e77233dad504d6516048226203225bedb73228.translatedText: >Tesla's estimate that electric trucks consume no more than 2 kilowatts/hour per mile and cost $190 per kilowatt-hour may be just conservative estimates. Battery costs have been falling since last year.

895fb55453c303e112b65bbd4c0067ee3e8146a8.sourceText: 而在今年5月份，一名专家曾告知Axios记者史蒂夫.莱文，续航500英里的电动卡车，可能只需要容量为500千瓦/时的电池组，而电池的成本可能会降低到120美元，算上与电池有关的其他部分，500千瓦/时电池组的全部成本在7万美元左右。
895fb55453c303e112b65bbd4c0067ee3e8146a8.translatedText: In May of this year, an expert told Axios reporter Steve Levin that an electric truck with a range of 500 miles may only require a battery pack with a capacity of 500 kW/h, and the cost of the battery may be reduced to US$120. Counting other parts related to the battery, the total cost of the 500 kW/h battery pack is around US$70,000.

7651d0a127f2d8ec1fd10ace1142141542ebd22f.sourceText: 电池组成本7万美元，加上整车的成本，续航500英里的高配版特斯拉Semi售价在18万美元就基本可行。
7651d0a127f2d8ec1fd10ace1142141542ebd22f.translatedText: The battery pack costs US$70,000. Adding the cost of the entire vehicle, a high-end Tesla Semi with a range of 500 miles is basically feasible at US$180,000.

2a92f01deaa0aec74d92575d39fb6a5af4e04494.sourceText: 虽然目前还不清楚特斯拉的电池技术能否达到这一水平，但特斯拉的电池技术在电动卡车上市之前肯定会有提升，即使不能将成本降到千瓦/时120美元，但肯定还是会远低于190美元。（辣椒客）
2a92f01deaa0aec74d92575d39fb6a5af4e04494.translatedText: Although it is unclear whether Tesla's battery technology can reach this level, Tesla's battery technology will definitely improve before the electric truck is launched. Even if the cost cannot be reduced to 120 US dollars per kilowatt hour, it will definitely be well below 190 US dollars. (Chili Guest)

913d221013b1d7488805a8f5b8cf58f0c49b0b07.sourceText: 侨联主席张华芳（右）接受王建新（左）馈赠的礼物 （凤凰城侨联来稿）十一月三十日，云南省民政厅老龄工作委员会辨公室副主任王建新率领访问团一行六人，访问美加地区温哥华，多伦多，纽约，洛杉磯，凤凰城及夏威夷多个城市，进行高龄人口社区计划交流。 面对中国经济改革开放卅年，这一世代约有二亿精英届临退休，这族群也是目前中国经济条件最好的阶层，相对退休人口的社区计画将是地方政府积争取与计划的商机。 云南的阳光带气候与地理位置均与亚歷桑那州相似，是最佳的退休养老地区，在侨联主席张华芳的安排下，该团访问了凤凰市政府及华人耆英中心，对於凤凰城每年近六百万美元的老人社区服务计画作了相当深入的瞭解与交流，同时对民间投资的太阳城社区计划感受深刻，希望未来云南省与本州做进一步的合作交流。
913d221013b1d7488805a8f5b8cf58f0c49b0b07.translatedText: Zhang Huafang (right), chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, accepted a gift from Wang Jianxin (left) (Contributed by the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation) On November 30, Wang Jianxin, deputy director of the Office of the Aging Work Committee of the Yunnan Provincial Department of Civil Affairs, led a six-member delegation to visit Vancouver, Toronto, New York, Los Angeles, Phoenix and Hawaii in cities in the United States and Canada to conduct exchanges on community plans for the elderly population. Facing the 30th anniversary of China's economic reform and opening up, about 200 million elites of this generation are about to retire. This group is also the class with the best economic conditions in China. Community projects for the retired population will be business opportunities that local governments are actively seeking to plan. Yunnan's sunbelt climate and geographical location are similar to Arizona, making it the best retirement area. Under the arrangement of Zhang Huafang, chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, the group visited the Phoenix Municipal Government and the Chinese Senior Citizens Center. They had a very in-depth understanding and exchange of Phoenix's annual community service plan for the elderly of nearly six million US dollars. At the same time, they were deeply impressed by the privately invested Sun City Community Plan, and hoped that Yunnan Province and the state would have further cooperation and exchanges in the future.

da42b979500458c4c8fc61437912cf51bcc5d87e.sourceText: 随着钓鱼岛争端的不断升温，关于中日钓鱼岛争端这一问题之由来、演变以及现状，中国民众中能够说出个一二三的，已不在少数。最近这次香港民间保钓人士成功登岛之日，正是日本战败投降的纪念日，虽然已过去67年，中国民众对于1945年8月15日这个日子，以及当时日本投降的大体情况，也都还有所记忆。然而，了解和记忆并非十分清晰和完整。日本虽然战败投降了，但作为战败国的它，日后不仅从美国手里又完整地收回了琉球，还顺手控制了原本不在琉球列岛地理界线之内的”尖阁群岛”。而中国虽然胜利了，但作为接受日本投降的战胜国，却不仅未能得到比《马关条约》之前更多的领土，而且直到今天也未能完全实现《开罗宣言》和《波茨坦公告》所规定的全部领土回收，包括自古以来属于中国的钓鱼岛及其附属岛屿。换句话说，仅就领土的增减而言，日本还是赢了，中国还是输了。这里的全部原因，在中国方面，一直难以一一说清。中国战胜了日本，但中国有抗战胜利凯旋门和纪念堂吗？对于日本宣布投降、中国抗战胜利并收回东三省、台湾及澎湖列岛等被日本窃取的全部领土这样一个自1840年以来中国人最为伟大和光荣的胜利，为什么见不到在隆重程度上与该事件的重大意义相匹配的全国性纪念地、纪念物、纪念日？在中国，人人都知道中国正式接受日本投降的第一个地点在哪里吗？更直接些，人人都还记得芷江这个地方吗？六十多年来，没有哪个地方比位于湘西怀化的芷江，更沉重、更惊心地背负着这些疑问。走进芷江，走进位于县城数公里之外七里桥村那个孤悬于农田和小路当中的”中国人民抗日战争胜利受降旧址”，也就同时走进了历史的厚重阴影。面前一座高不足十米，宽不过十几步小小的”受降纪念坊”，据说就是中国的抗战胜利”凯旋门”，与全球其他五座凯旋门棗罗马、柏林、米兰、巴黎、平壤凯旋门并列。而就是这个唯一的纪念建筑，当年也并非中国政府所树立，而是由时任芷江县长的杨化育向民间筹资并指挥百姓扒了芷江县城东门的城墙勉强修建而成。不仅如此，它还全部毁于”文化大革命”，因为上面镌刻着蒋中正、李宗仁、何应钦、白崇禧、于右任、孙科、王东原、居正、王云五等众多当时国民政府军政要人的题词。芷江受降旧址，是1945年8月21日当年中国陆军总司令何应钦举行受降仪式、签发相关命令、部署全国十六受降区102处缴械点受降工作的原始场所。旧址房屋和新修的纪念馆里陈列着照片和文物，据讲解员介绍，其中大部分是从海外收集来的，而现场记录了受降仪式的那段极为珍贵的影片资料，竟然还是从日本的档案馆中找到的。尽管当时的会场上挤满了中国记者，中国人自己却一丁点也没保留下来。暂且撇开国共两党的是是非非不谈，作为一个民族，如果我们对于自己的战争胜利、战胜国的利益、历史的真实面貌都满不在乎、语焉不详，如何指望敌方民族正视历史、深刻反思呢？钓鱼岛争端的深层原因，是日本仍在顽强地努力争取着它的”战败国的胜利”。如果中国方面仍在有意无意地继续着自己的”战胜国的失败”，难道不是对于日本最大的纵容吗？ 芷江，八年抗战中国军队取得决定性胜利的最后一场大会战”湘西会战”纪念地，美国第十四航空联队、著名的飞虎队大本营”芷江机场”所在地，先于9月9日南京受降的第一个受降仪式举办地，为什么会失之荒野，不见荣光，没有被大书特书？如果说日本人有意通过占有钓鱼岛作为其战败国的胜利象征，那么中国人对于芷江的遗忘和忽略，正是一个战胜国的失败标志！在这个意义上，芷江这个被很多中国人遗忘的地方，却是当今钓鱼岛争端的一个重要注解。 为了钓鱼岛，为了百年中日之战的最后一笔，最后一笑，中国人是否应该重振战胜国精神、再现胜利者威风？是否应该从重修芷江、大建芷江做起？曾记否？当年还有设立”芷江省”为抗战胜利纪念之动议！▉
da42b979500458c4c8fc61437912cf51bcc5d87e.translatedText: As the Diaoyu Islands dispute continues to heat up, there are not a few Chinese people who can tell a story about the origin, evolution and current situation of the Diaoyu Islands dispute between China and Japan. The latest day when Hong Kong private Diaoyu Islands activists successfully landed on the island was the anniversary of Japan's defeat and surrender. Although 67 years have passed, the Chinese people still remember the date of August 15, 1945, and the general situation of Japan's surrender at that time. However, understanding and memory are not entirely clear and complete. Although Japan was defeated and surrendered, as a defeated country, it not only fully recovered the Ryukyu Islands from the United States, but also took control of the "Senkaku Islands" that were originally not within the geographical boundaries of the Ryukyu Islands. Although China won, as a victorious country that accepted Japan's surrender, it not only failed to obtain more territory than before the Treaty of Shimonoseki, but also has not been able to fully realize the recovery of all territories stipulated in the Cairo Declaration and Potsdam Proclamation to this day, including the Diaoyu Islands and its affiliated islands that have belonged to China since ancient times. In other words, in terms of territorial gains and losses alone, Japan still won and China still lost. All the reasons here have been difficult to explain one by one from the Chinese side. China defeated Japan, but does China have a triumphal arch and memorial hall for the victory of the Anti-Japanese War? Regarding Japan’s declaration of surrender, China’s victory in the Anti-Japanese War, and the recovery of all the territories stolen by Japan such as the three northeastern provinces, Taiwan, and the Penghu Islands, which is the greatest and glorious victory for the Chinese since 1840, why are there no national memorial sites, monuments, and anniversaries that match the significance of the event in terms of grandeur? In China, does everyone know where the first place where China officially accepted Japan’s surrender was? More directly, does everyone still remember Zhijiang? Over the past sixty years, no place has been burdened with these questions more heavily and alarmingly than Zhijiang, located in Huaihua, western Hunan. When you walk into Zhijiang and into the "Site of the Victorious Surrender of the Chinese People's Anti-Japanese War", which is located in Qiliqiao Village a few kilometers away from the county seat and is isolated among farmland and paths, you will also walk into the heavy shadow of history. The small "Surrender Memorial Arch" in front of us is less than ten meters high and no more than a dozen steps wide. It is said to be China's victory in the Anti-Japanese War and is juxtaposed with the other five triumphal arches in the world - Rome, Berlin, Milan, Paris and Pyongyang. And this only memorial building was not built by the Chinese government at that time. It was built reluctantly by Yang Huayu, then the magistrate of Zhijiang County, who raised funds from the private sector and directed the people to tear down the east gate wall of Zhijiang County. Not only that, it was all destroyed by the "Cultural Revolution" because it was engraved with inscriptions from many important military and political figures of the Nationalist Government at that time, including Chiang Kai-shek, Li Zongren, He Yingqin, Bai Chongxi, Yu Youren, Sun Ke, Wang Dongyuan, Ju Zheng, and Wang Yunwu. The former surrender site of Zhijiang was the original place where He Yingqin, commander-in-chief of the Chinese Army, held the surrender ceremony on August 21, 1945, issued relevant orders, and deployed the surrender work at 102 surrender points in the 16 surrender zones across the country. Photos and cultural relics are displayed in the old house and the newly built memorial hall. According to the tour guide, most of them were collected from overseas. The extremely precious video material that recorded the surrender ceremony on site was actually found in Japanese archives. Although the venue was crowded with Chinese reporters, the Chinese themselves did not retain any of it. Putting aside the rights and wrongs of the Kuomintang and the Communist Party for the moment, as a nation, if we are indifferent and vague about our own war victory, the interests of the victorious country, and the true face of history, how can we expect the enemy nation to face up to history and reflect deeply? The underlying reason for the Diaoyu Islands dispute is that Japan is still tenaciously striving for its "victory as a defeated nation." If China is still continuing its "defeat of the victorious nation" intentionally or unintentionally, isn't it the greatest connivance to Japan? Zhijiang is the memorial site of the "Battle of Western Hunan", the last battle where the Chinese army won a decisive victory in the eight-year Anti-Japanese War. It is also the location of the Zhijiang Airport, the base camp of the 14th U.S. Air Force and the famous Flying Tigers. It was the site of the first surrender ceremony before the surrender of Nanjing on September 9. Why was it lost in the wilderness, not seen in glory, and not praised in a big way? If the Japanese intend to occupy the Diaoyu Islands as a symbol of victory for their defeated country, then the Chinese people's forgetfulness and neglect of Zhijiang is exactly a symbol of failure for a victorious country! In this sense, Zhijiang, a place forgotten by many Chinese people, is an important annotation of the current Diaoyu Islands dispute. For the Diaoyu Islands, for the last stroke of the century-old Sino-Japanese war, for the last smile, should the Chinese revive the victorious spirit and regain the majesty of the victor? Should we start by rebuilding and building Zhijiang River? Have you ever remembered? At that time, there was also a motion to establish "Zhijiang Province" to commemorate the victory of the Anti-Japanese War! ▉

87d6036c9df2062479b3576ea374d047b481bc73.sourceText: 丽江的另一美景就是玉龙雪山。雪山座落在丽江县城的北端，远远望去，一座座陡峭的山峰耸立云霄，像一条银白色的巨龙飘浮在云层之上。那山顶上的白雪在阳光下熠熠生辉，像一颗颗钻石放射出耀眼的光亮，远远看到一条由上而下的乳白色的宽带，那是古老的冰川。因為全球天气变暖或是丽江排放热量增长的原因，冰川的宽度趆来趆小，人们担心气矦的变迁将会影响他们纯净的水源供应。 玉龙雪山海拔高五千五百九十六米，是卋界上纬度最低海拔最髙的山峰，是中国南部最髙的雪山，据说至今无人登顶。也有人说曾有美国的登山队上去过，但没有在中国留下记录。我这次借助缆车和步行，也登上了三千二百四十米髙的云杉坪。这里古树参天，环境幽静，风吹着大片的树叶瑟瑟作响，抬头可以清晰见到玉龙雪山剑峰的身影，向下俯视淸沏见底的白水河蜿蜒流过，这里是纳西族男女殉情的塲所。相传纳西族人向往自由幸福的婚姻，一些青年為反抗汉文化封建包办婚姻的影响，常常為爱而双双来到云杉坪殉情，祈祷苍天，纵身悬崖，去天国寻求他们的幸福。他们相信云杉坪是通向天国之路，天国可以有自由相爱，那里有穿不完的绫罗绸缎，吃不完的鲜果珍品，喝不完的美酒香奶，用不完的金沙银团。这样的殉情一直延续至今，这就是信仰和爱的力量。每个人都曾经歷过青年时期冲动的爱的激情，会不顾一切地去追求那纯真的属于自己的甜密爱情。我相信男人和女人的身上都有一亇特殊的磁塲，当相对应的磁㘯碰撞在一起时，就会产生出强大的异性相吸的能量，促使人们做出超趆理智的行為。旅游的人们也在这里留下了无数祝愿祈福的木牌，据说真有炅验，真可谓心诚则灵。
87d6036c9df2062479b3576ea374d047b481bc73.translatedText: Another beautiful sight in Lijiang is the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. Snow Mountain is located at the northern end of Lijiang County. From a distance, the steep peaks tower into the sky, like a silver-white dragon floating above the clouds. The white snow on the top of the mountain shines in the sun, like diamonds emitting dazzling light. From a distance, you can see a wide milky white strip from top to bottom, which is an ancient glacier. Due to global warming or the increase in heat emissions from Lijiang, the width of the glacier has become smaller, and people are worried that changes in climate will affect their pure water supply. Jade Dragon Snow Mountain is 5,596 meters above sea level. It is the lowest and highest mountain in the world and the highest snow mountain in southern China. It is said that no one has climbed to the top. Some people also say that an American mountaineering team has been there, but there are no records left in China. This time I also used the cable car and walking to climb Yunshanping, which is 3,240 meters high. The ancient trees here are towering, and the environment is quiet. The wind rustles the large leaves. Looking up, you can clearly see the Jianfeng of the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. Looking down, you can see the clear Baishui River winding through. This is the place where Naxi men and women died for love. It is said that the Naxi people yearn for a free and happy marriage. In order to resist the influence of feudal arranged marriages in Han culture, some young people often come to Yunshanping to die for love, pray to the sky, jump off the cliff, and go to heaven to seek their happiness. They believe that Yunshanping is the road to heaven, where they can love each other freely. There are endless silks and satins, endless fresh fruits and treasures, endless wines and fragrant milk, and endless gold and silver balls. This kind of sacrifice continues to this day. This is the power of faith and love. Everyone has experienced the impulsive passion of love in youth, and will pursue the pure and sweet love of their own at all costs. I believe that both men and women have special magnets in their bodies. When corresponding magnets collide together, powerful opposite-sex attraction energy will be generated, prompting people to behave in a super rational way. Tourists have also left countless wooden plaques with wishes and blessings here. It is said that they are truly enlightening and can be said to be sincere and spiritual.

bd9248aefa090fe9a6b2b3592023de219174454e.sourceText: 在玉龙雪山，著名导演张艺谋又出手搞了一亇大手笔。张艺谋从他因导演出名的第一个杰作＂红髙梁＂开始，就显示了他在文艺创作中的不安份守己，以奇、特、大、强烈的震撼来吸引观众。他创作和导演的＂印象丽江＂，一看我就知道是张艺谋的作品。这塲演出是在三千米髙的山地上，是世界上最髙的剧塲，演员就是住在这块土地上的原住民，演出内容就是反映当地居民曾经经历过的生活。于是，来10个少数民族的鏗鏘汉子，来自16亇乡下村庄的普通农民，这五百多个有着黝黑皮肤的非专业演员，在这神奇广袤的土地上，以美丽的雪山為背景，帯着泥土汗水的味道，用他们和祖先一样厚实的肩膀，最原生的动作，最质朴的歌声，最滚烫的汗水，与天地共舞，与自然同声，给人们献上了一份震撼心𩆜、荡涤灵魂的盛宴。在炽热的阳光下，让你热血沸腾，我们的血似乎己经和纳西人流到了一起。面对雪山他们唱出，朋友来了，喝酒！朋友走了，喝酒！髙兴了喝酒！不髙兴了也喝酒。那仰天开怀喝酒的姿态充份展示了他们对待朋友的热情和对待生命的豁达楽覌，把少数民族的豪爽、粗獷表现得唯妙唯肖。这里创造了许多世界第一。
bd9248aefa090fe9a6b2b3592023de219174454e.translatedText: In Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, the famous director Zhang Yimou made another big move. Zhang Yimou has shown his uncompromising self-reliance in literary and artistic creation since his first masterpiece "The Red High Liang", which he became famous as a director, attracting the audience with strange, special, big and strong shocks. "Impression of Lijiang" he created and directed, I knew it was Zhang Yimou's work as soon as I saw it. This performance is performed on a mountain three thousand meters high. It is the highest theater in the world. The actors are the aborigines who live on this land. The content of the performance reflects the life that the local residents have experienced. So, here came the strong men of 10 ethnic minorities, ordinary farmers from 16 rural villages, these more than 500 non-professional actors with dark skin, in this magical and vast land, with the beautiful snow-capped mountains as the background, wearing mud clothes The smell of soil sweat, with their thick shoulders like their ancestors, the most primitive movements, the most simple singing, the hottest sweat, dancing with the heaven and earth, and singing in harmony with nature, presented people with a heart-shaking and soul-cleansing feast. Under the blazing sunshine, your blood will boil. Our blood seems to have flowed together with that of the Naxi people. Facing the snow-capped mountains, they sang, Friends are here, let’s drink! Friends are gone, drink! Get high and drink! Even when you are feeling down, you drink. The gesture of looking up to the sky and drinking happily fully demonstrates their enthusiasm for treating friends and open-mindedness towards life, and vividly expresses the boldness and roughness of ethnic minorities. Many world firsts have been created here.

a5acd920047b943d416bc83c55503b8289ea09b8.sourceText: 现在一讲起历史便是明清宫室秘闻，或是英雄豪杰，手刃倭寇之类，前几十年的发生的事倒让人淡淡地忘却了。历史就像个小媳妇被后人任性涂抹，连经历过的人都怀疑她存在的真实性了。当政的自己不说真话，销毁证据，还告诫卸任的一切秘密要烂在肚里，不许传出。所幸小民不属那列，还有机会为知青时代留一记录，补遗拾缺与波澜壮阔历史同行的小人物。
a5acd920047b943d416bc83c55503b8289ea09b8.translatedText: Nowadays, when we talk about history, we talk about the secrets of the palaces of the Ming and Qing Dynasties, or about heroes and heroines, killing Japanese pirates, etc. What happened in the past few decades makes people forget it lightly. History is like a little daughter-in-law who is willfully smeared by future generations. Even those who have experienced it doubt the authenticity of her existence. When he was in power, he refused to tell the truth, destroyed evidence, and warned that all secrets about leaving office should be kept in his stomach and not be spread out. Fortunately, ordinary people do not belong to that group, and they still have the opportunity to leave a record of the era of educated youth, filling in the missing people who walked with the magnificent history.

0957df286a6e17da06a2b2a251b5287396c63c49.sourceText: 每个时代有每个时代的追求，有不同的时代的英雄枭雄或狗熊，正如现今忽然蹦出个马云，那时稀罕的是焦裕禄。兄弟不才，下乡时节当了几年生产队长，没见过现在乡镇管事干的那些拆房逼税，上环刮宫的耀武扬威，也没轮上入党提升，倒是涕泪一把，溴事一摞，小晒一笑，以正视听。
0957df286a6e17da06a2b2a251b5287396c63c49.translatedText: Every era has its pursuits, and there are heroes or bears of different eras. Just like Jack Ma suddenly pops up nowadays, the rare one at that time was Jiao Yulu. My brother is not talented. He worked as a production team leader for several years when he went to the countryside. He has never seen the demolition of houses to force taxes, or the arrogance of having a curettage performed like that of the current township supervisors. He has not been promoted to the party in his turn. Instead, he cried a lot, had a lot of things to do, and smiled to put things in perspective.

73e9cbdd50a22b9681dd5289b6d9e1c5d3591426.translatedText: Accidentally, the native robe is added to the body

1162328152fa9461f2943f6b8e36aad7a2952951.sourceText: 按常规说，我这种城市里长大的学生是不可能在乡下生产队当上队长的，但谁叫我们正好生在一个不按常规出牌的年代呢。
1162328152fa9461f2943f6b8e36aad7a2952951.translatedText: According to convention, it is impossible for a student like me who grew up in the city to become the captain of a rural production team, but who told us that we happened to be born in an era that did not follow conventions.

0b052bdd200504d4e7d68abc59cd410f65ba8663.sourceText: 书没读几天，全部学生停课闹革命，全国大中小学都不上课，专读语录。后来发觉国家这样折腾也不是事，那管事的大手一挥，读书的没读过几本书的全部下乡去，”接受贫下中农再教育”，于是本人成为那上千万分之一，注销了城市户口，去了那江西井冈山专区下乡插队。
0b052bdd200504d4e7d68abc59cd410f65ba8663.translatedText: After a few days of reading the book, all students stopped classes to start a revolution. All universities, middle schools and primary schools across the country stopped attending classes and focused on reading quotations. Later, I realized that it was not a problem for the country to go through such troubles. With a wave of his hand, those who had not read a few books were all sent to the countryside to "receive the re-education of poor and lower-middle peasants." So I became one of those tens of millions, canceled my urban household registration, and went to the Jinggangshan District of Jiangxi Province to work in the countryside.

52fa1277f5a876eee80fc337c9599738cc4bbe92.sourceText: 那井冈山在当时中国可是个有名的地方，虽然比不上圣地韶山，但它毕竟是中国现任当局发迹的地方，红军在那里凭险阻挡国军进攻，站稳了几年脚跟。所以能到那里插队下乡也有点沾了仙气的感觉，和同窗写信聊天仿佛底气也上来了一点。我所在的队虽然是在山下，但听说那山上家家是烈属（参加红军，战死沙场），便还是心怀崇拜，有虔诚的心态。所以虽是城市学生一个，做起活来还是努力有加，不愿输给农人，几年下来各种农活包括山上的活（四面有山，先人在荒山栽种了油茶树）都学会了。但在农村，要让农人另眼相看，还必须做的强悍，精到。试举几例：
52fa1277f5a876eee80fc337c9599738cc4bbe92.translatedText: Jinggangshan was a famous place in China at that time. Although it was not as good as the holy land of Shaoshan, it was after all the place where the current Chinese authorities made their fortune. The Red Army stood firm there for several years by blocking the National Army's attack. So being able to go there and jump in the queue to go to the countryside felt a bit like a fairy. Writing letters and chatting with my classmates seemed to give me a little more confidence. Although my team was at the foot of the mountain, I heard that every family on the mountain was a martyred soldier (who joined the Red Army and died in battle), so I still felt admiration and piety. Therefore, even though I am a city student, I still work hard and do not want to lose to the farmers. Over the past few years, I have learned all kinds of farm work, including work on the mountains (there are mountains on all sides, and my ancestors planted Camellia oleifera trees in the barren hills). But in rural areas, to make farmers look at them differently, they must be strong and precise. To give a few examples:

a4afb51c0306ca0e454deb4c92987174ccd13dfc.sourceText: 农活中首要的是力气。这力气分两种，一种是耐力，虽然不重不难，要你长时间的坚持就看你的心力是否有足够的定力。这点所有的插友农伴都能做到，虽不喜欢但无奈的力量更大，逼着您定力养成；另一种就是负重力，需要足够的体魄和意志。村里有个小伙力大嘴也大，人喊阔嘴，自持年轻气壮，整天在我们知青面前幺五幺六的。一次出工挑牛栏粪，从牛栏里挑到田里，阔嘴嘴都撇到天上去了，笑话知青没力气。虽那时人力不壮，但气还有一口，我一口应战阔嘴，称两个三百斤的担子，一人一个送到田里。结果一个装到 250 斤左右，阔嘴歪斜地走了几步人倒下了，没了先前的傲气，只是喘着气斜眼看着我的洋相。一看对手倒了，我又增了几分自信，结果担子再加到 290 斤，一口气送到田里。虽然担子压得眼睛几乎曝出，但从此后，农伴们再也不敢小巧我们，我呢，私下也有了”会当临绝顶，一览众山小”的得意。
a4afb51c0306ca0e454deb4c92987174ccd13dfc.translatedText: The most important thing in farm work is strength. There are two types of strength. One is endurance. Although it is not heavy or difficult, if you persist for a long time, it depends on whether you have enough concentration. All the friends and farmers can do this. Although you don't like it but you have no choice but to do it, the force is greater, forcing you to cultivate it with determination; the other is to bear gravity, which requires enough physical strength and will. There is a young man in the village who is very powerful and has a big mouth. He is called "Big Mouth". He is young and vigorous. He behaves in front of us educated youths all day long. Once when I went to work to pick up dung from the cattle pen and carried it from the cattle pen to the field, my mouth was raised to the sky, laughing at the educated youth's lack of strength. Although my manpower was not strong at that time, I still had some energy, so I answered the challenge and weighed two three-hundred-jin burdens and carried them to the fields one by one. As a result, one person weighed about 250 pounds, walked a few steps crookedly with a wide mouth, and fell down. He lost his previous arrogance and just panted and squinted at me for making a fool of himself. Seeing that my opponent had fallen, I gained a little more confidence. As a result, I increased my load to 290 kilograms and sent it to the field in one go. Although the burden was so heavy that my eyes were almost exposed, from then on, the fellow farmers no longer dared to ignore us. I also secretly felt proud of "being able to stand at the top and see all the mountains and small mountains at a glance."

afcda6ad05e99f8e0eb43e2284fbf0d230afe1db.sourceText: 另外，手里的活计还要做得精到，让人信服。我们插队的地方因为雨水多，历来种的是水稻，所以犁耙插秧割稻都是常规的农活。刚干起来有点难，但干久了，那儿时玩耍养成的记忆便成了技压群雄的本事。比方那犁耙田就是将土活着水，弄平整了，可以供人插秧。其实那有点像小时玩泥巴活水，活着活着感觉就来了，土旮旯就变成水镜一般的了。还有更细致的撒种谷育秧，一般都是资深老农才有这般待遇，在比水镜还水镜的秧田上洒下种谷等待秧苗出生。老农小心翼翼，侍候秧田如同对待自己的闺女，弄得好根根都像出水芙蓉。但也有失手的时候，哪天风沙太大迷失了手里的分寸，待到秧苗出生便是稀毛癞痢一般，弄得拔秧的妇女叫苦不迭。不过在我们看来也就是小时在公园的湖面上撒沙子一样，沙溅水花，一路压过去就是。于是说尽了好话，让老土地让我这样的新手干一回。因为有儿时调皮玩耍的经历，所以撒起谷来，也潇洒大气，有模有样，老土地称赞有加。从此，有老农撑腰，这最精细的活里也有了青壮年的身影。
afcda6ad05e99f8e0eb43e2284fbf0d230afe1db.translatedText: In addition, the work in hand must be done meticulously and convincingly. The place where we jumped in line had a lot of rain and rice had always been grown, so plowing, transplanting and cutting rice were all routine farm work. It's a bit difficult to do it at first, but if you do it for a long time, the memory you developed while playing there will become the ability to beat the others. For example, plowing a field means turning the soil into water and smoothing it out so that people can plant rice. In fact, it is a bit like playing in mud and running water when you were young. The feeling of being alive comes over, and the dirt nook becomes like a mirror of water. There is also a more detailed method of sowing seeds and raising seedlings. Generally, only senior farmers are treated like this. They sow seeds and grains on a rice field that is even more watery than a mirror and wait for the seedlings to be born. The old farmer was careful and treated the rice fields as if they were his own daughters, making the roots look like hibiscus. But there are also times when the hand fails. One day the wind and sand are too strong and the sense of control in the hand is lost. When the seedling is born, it is like thin hair and dysentery, which makes the woman who pulls the seedlings complain endlessly. But from our point of view, it is just like spreading sand on the lake in the park when we were young. The sand splashes and the water splashes all the way over. So I said all my good words and asked the old land to let a novice like me do it for a while. Because I had the experience of being naughty and playful as a child, I spread the grain in a cool and stylish manner, and was praised by the old people. Since then, with the support of old farmers, young adults have also appeared in this most delicate work.

6256a3df360053de00a826a0d4489a01f7f7a29f.sourceText: 不过，插秧是我的短板，这也和幼时的经历有关。父母为人师表，总是教育我们不要玩杂耍，荒废学业，所以插兄们玩牌发牌溜得像刘谦，弯腰插秧像鸡啄米一样，不会发牌的我只好在并排插秧时被人拉下或者关在当中，汗流夹泥，举目无亲。好在农民老表以下力多少看人，不以成败论英雄，没受歧视。当时腰酸无比，特别是左面，总要撑着膝盖才能坚持。看着插妹们嘻哈一阵风样掠过，常自责很久，缺乏锻炼哪。后来到了美国体检，医生大惊失色，说他从医多年还从未见过人腰椎右面有强壮的肌肉，而左边一点肌肉没有，问为什么。怪不得我左腰老酸，插秧老追不上他人呢。为什么，能向老美说得清吗，说挑了十年担子，肌肉长到一边去了。恐怕他们连担子都没见过呢。
6256a3df360053de00a826a0d4489a01f7f7a29f.translatedText: However, transplanting rice is my shortcoming, which is also related to my childhood experience. My parents were good teachers and always taught us not to juggle and neglect our studies. Therefore, the brothers played cards and dealt cards like Liu Qian, and bent down to plant rice like a chicken pecking at rice. I, who couldn't deal with cards, had to be pulled down or locked in the middle when we were planting rice seedlings side by side, sweating and muddy, without any friends. Fortunately, the peasants judge people based on their strength and do not judge heroes based on success or failure, so they are not discriminated against. At that time, my back was extremely sore, especially on the left side, and I had to hold my knees to hold on. Watching the girls hip-hop passing by like a gust of wind, I often blamed myself for a long time for lack of exercise. Later, when I went to the United States for a physical examination, the doctor was shocked. He said that in his many years of medical practice, he had never seen a person with strong muscles on the right side of the lumbar spine, but no muscles at all on the left side. He asked why. No wonder my left waist is always sore and I can't keep up with others when planting rice. Why, can you explain it clearly to me? After ten years of shouldering the burden, my muscles have grown to one side. I'm afraid they haven't even seen the burden.

9a437e10201672e6d163d3fe98ebcc84b1ae6d97.sourceText: 农民虽然有时小气，但助人讲义气的古风还是深存心底的。这又要说到前面的阔嘴兄弟了。这兄弟显摆力气不假，但手活不精也常被农伴笑话。而且这兄弟脚下走路不稳，大概是外八字脚吧，凭白无故地走路会自己绊倒自己，脚花太乱。那年到山上扛木头，一伙青壮年都结伴成行，唯独阔嘴兄没人与他为伴。因为扛树除了是个力气活，还是个细心活，常常是两人扛一根木头，前面的人扛大头，后面的人要靠近树中间一些扛，减轻前面人的重量。在弯曲的山路上行走，后面的人责任更大，除了要看清前面的路外，还要预算肩扛的树尾是否会挂到岩壁，否则连人带树狼狈为奸都到沟底去了，危险大去了。这脚花乱的没人喜欢为伴。
9a437e10201672e6d163d3fe98ebcc84b1ae6d97.translatedText: Although farmers are sometimes stingy, the ancient custom of helping others and showing loyalty is still deep in their hearts. This brings us back to the broad-mouthed brothers in front of us. This brother showed off his strength, but he was often laughed at by his fellow farmers for not being good at handwork. Moreover, this brother is unsteady on his feet. He probably has splayed feet. He will trip over himself when he walks for no reason. His feet are too messy. That year when I went to carry wood on the mountain, a group of young and middle-aged people all went together, except Brother Kuozui, who had no one to accompany him. Because tree carrying is not only a physical job, but also a careful job. Usually two people carry a piece of wood. The person in front carries the big head, and the person behind has to carry it closer to the middle of the tree to reduce the weight of the person in front. When walking on a winding mountain road, the people behind you have greater responsibilities. In addition to seeing the road ahead clearly, you must also consider whether the tree tails you carry on your shoulders will hang on the rock wall. Otherwise, even the man and the tree will end up at the bottom of the ditch, and the danger will be great. No one likes the company of this messy guy.

23af26a76636c7feae7fdd3107ab3054ff2880c7.sourceText: 我是新手，也没人为伴，便最后与阔嘴自然搭配为伴。这阔嘴也真的名不虚传，认真倒是认真，背上的汗我在后面都看得见，但脚法就不敢恭维了。岂止是不敢恭维，看到阔嘴脚下在跳舞简直是胆战心惊了。沪语常说脚骨弹琵琶，大概就是这般境界。要知道，那时我们肩上扛着同一根木头，任何闪失都会导致两人与生死俱进。
23af26a76636c7feae7fdd3107ab3054ff2880c7.translatedText: I am a novice and have no one to accompany me, so I finally paired it with Kuo Zui. This broad-mouthed man really deserves his reputation, and he is very serious. I can see the sweat on his back from behind, but I cannot praise him for his footwork. Not only did he not dare to compliment him, but he was frightened to see Kuozui dancing at his feet. In Shanghai dialect, it is often said that the foot bones play the pipa, which is probably the state of play. You know, we were carrying the same piece of wood on our shoulders at that time, and any mistake would lead to life and death for both of us.

8ff8cdbee182e45f0127134460d761de35e7233a.sourceText: 但怕什么就来什么。在过一条山沟时，阔嘴那脚不是仅仅在弹琵琶了，而是乱弹古筝了。山里都没路，拿着砍刀干掉荆棘能过就是路了，遇上山涧放倒几棵小树并排一下还颤颤悠悠着就是桥了。过这桥也要有技巧，要脚板打横同时踩到两棵树上上才敢用力。阔嘴就有这个胆量，那外八字还未打横就敢用力，一脚踩上去整个人连同肩上的木头就滑落在两根树当中，整个桥上就剩下阔嘴的头和肩扛的木头了。
8ff8cdbee182e45f0127134460d761de35e7233a.translatedText: But whatever you are afraid of will come. When crossing a ravine, Kuozui's feet were not just playing the pipa, but the guzheng. There are no roads in the mountains. If you can cross the thorns with a machete, you can cross it. When you encounter a mountain stream, you can knock down a few small trees side by side and still tremble, which is a bridge. Crossing this bridge also requires skill. You have to step on two trees with your feet horizontally before you dare to exert force. Kuozui had such courage. He dared to use force even before the outer horoscope was crossed. He stepped on it and the whole person and the wood on his shoulders fell between the two trees. Only Kuozui's head and the wood on his shoulders were left on the bridge.

c22a1ad8c86509a956a96057a6e7b1e4a7ac869f.sourceText: 看官可曾忘记，这扛木的另一头是还没有过桥的我。如果我经受不住那强大的震动，丢了木头，自己得个平安，虽然无可指责，但阔嘴兄弟的生涯可能由于木头的再次弹起而结束。我死顶着没让树脱肩，让闻声赶来的伙伴救起了阔嘴。那拖起的阔嘴嘴吓得更宽了，半天没合拢来。
c22a1ad8c86509a956a96057a6e7b1e4a7ac869f.translatedText: Have you ever forgotten that the person on the other end of this tree is me who has not yet crossed the bridge? If I couldn't withstand the powerful shock and lost the wood, I would be safe. Although I was blameless, the career of Brother Broadmouth might have ended due to the wood bouncing back again. I held on tightly to keep the tree from falling off my shoulders, and let my friends who came after hearing the sound rescue Kuozui. The wide mouth stretched out even wider in fear, and it didn't close for a long time.

f95c20d35575ca3328dcdf45696eaf991d8dec2f.sourceText: 就这样以后选举队长时，乡亲们选了我，除了力气和技术外，其中一人就提起了这话题，说是有责任，用现在的话说就是有担当。
f95c20d35575ca3328dcdf45696eaf991d8dec2f.translatedText: In this way, when I elected the captain in the future, the villagers chose me. In addition to my strength and skills, one of them brought up this topic and said that I had responsibility, which in today's terms means responsibility.

96a8c803d963819a09b9174886dfd134821ae838.sourceText: 不过，被选为队长也属偶然。历来中国的官不是想当就能当得，每个时代都要走自己的程序。比方古代人纵有满腹经纶，也要进行科举选拔，从秀才做起。但当时不知道哪阵风吹来，说村里百姓可以自家选举队长，用现在的话就是民选了。有老爷子当官的背景，便可以入党入团，还可以坐大队书记的位子，我等没背景，又不是党员团员，纵然心中有万般念想，也是断不敢有此奢望的。但这个 20 多户， 100 多口人家的小村偏偏异类，虽然同姓吴，但事多，你不服我，我不服你，结果选举会上，让我这样知青得票最多，当上了队长。
96a8c803d963819a09b9174886dfd134821ae838.translatedText: However, being chosen as the captain was also accidental. Historically, it has not always been possible to become an official in China. Every era has to follow its own procedures. For example, even if people in ancient times had a lot of knowledge, they still had to conduct imperial examination selection, starting with scholars. But at that time, I don’t know what kind of wind came, and it was said that the people in the village could elect the captain by themselves. In today’s terms, it was popular election. If you have the old man's official background, you can join the party and the league, and you can also sit in the position of secretary of the brigade. I have no background, and I am not a party member. Even if I have all kinds of thoughts in my heart, I never dare to have such extravagant hopes. But this small village with more than 20 households and a population of more than 100 is a different kind. Although it has the same surname as Wu, it has many things to do. If you don’t obey me, I won’t obey you. As a result, at the election meeting, an educated youth like me won the most votes and became the captain.

c55b6825adb5c3fca126c8cd5d26640c73f27d6d.sourceText: 好好的城市学生不去读书，到乡下当上个队长也不是凭知识，在现在看来都是最不可思议的。但这一切都这样发生了。身在其中的时候更是只有受宠若惊，而没有今天的疑惑了。（待续）
c55b6825adb5c3fca126c8cd5d26640c73f27d6d.translatedText: If a good city student doesn't go to school, becoming a team captain in the countryside doesn't rely on knowledge. It seems to be the most incredible now. But it all happened like this. When I was in it, I could only feel flattered, instead of having the doubts I have today. (To be continued)

c842dc40c53c5a0e86c2accb5a27b05151d62e23.sourceText: 商慧明，现居亚利桑那图桑市，出生在上海，1968–1978年下乡在中国江西井冈山地区。恢复高考后，进入华东师范大学学习，毕业后在学校和出版社就职，为汉语大词典的编辑，主编过《我的名字叫中国》和《上海生活年鉴》，发表过数十篇专业论文及上百万字的文章。
c842dc40c53c5a0e86c2accb5a27b05151d62e23.translatedText: Shang Huiming, currently living in Tucson, Arizona, was born in Shanghai and went to the countryside in the Jinggangshan area of ​​Jiangxi, China from 1968 to 1978. After resuming the college entrance examination, he entered East China Normal University to study. After graduation, he worked in schools and publishing houses. He was the editor of the Chinese Dictionary, edited "My Name is China" and "Shanghai Life Yearbook", and published dozens of professional papers and millions of words of articles.

4d6f409afee03c91ba834003b0ab032183d77981.translatedText: Happy Congratulations to the Spring Festival Banquet Happy Congratulations to the Spring Festival Banquet Phoenix City is full of energy "Every street and alley, in everyone's mouth, the first words when meeting are congratulations, congratulations! Congratulations, congratulations, congratulations! Congratulations, congratulations, congratulations!" All the directors of the Alberta Vietnamese-Chinese Association are meeting the guests of the Spring Banquet. During the ceremony, Huang Hai, the former president, took the lead in singing, and all the directors followed him in singing, creating an exciting scene of the Spring Festival of 1898, showing a harmonious future, with both Vietnam and China taking care of each other, maintaining friendships with all walks of life in the overseas Chinese community, and moving forward side by side. This year’s Lunar New Year, the Year of the Dog, is prosperous. People in Huayue do not forget the traditional national customs and celebrate the New Year as always. This year, the Alberta Vietnamese-Chinese Association held its fourth annual spring banquet, which was held on the auspicious occasion of the Jade Emperor’s birthday on the ninth day of the Lunar New Year. It was held at the New World Restaurant in Mesa City and received support from people from all walks of life. The banquet was held for thirty-three seats, and representatives from various overseas Chinese associations also came to make the conference more colorful. Such as the Senior Citizens Association, the Cantonese Association, the Happy Party, the Restaurant Association, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, the Historical Association, the Overseas Chinese Association, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee, etc., plus Vietnamese and Chinese people, the Vietnamese community, and relatives and friends of the members, the entire hotel hall was full, filled with joy and laughter. , no wonder when he came out to meet and greet, he happily sang "Congratulations, Congratulations, Congratulations". When the guests were seated, on the podium, a Vietnamese band led by Meng Quan, editor-in-chief of Phoenix City Bamboo Pen Magazine, was already playing music, and Texas singer Huang Feng immediately sang Chinese songs. The melodious music kicked off the Spring Banquet. At seven o'clock, Fang Huixian, the president of the Western American Overseas Chinese Newspaper, announced the start of the party as the master of ceremonies and delivered the opening speech as usual. The old and new presidents Huang Hai and Zhuang Ming cooperated to make the party process orderly. The program started with the handover ceremony between the old and new presidents. Huang Hai handed over a seal symbolizing the Yuehua president to Zhuang Ming for acceptance, indicating that the responsibilities were properly transferred. Although the ceremony was simple, the responsibilities were dignified, and everyone understood it, and they responded with warm applause. Then all the directors lined up in front of the stage to greet the guests, sang a song "Congratulations, Congratulations" to wish the guests well. Then, the new president gave a concise and concise speech, to the general idea of ​​thanking everyone for their support and that he would do his best to serve the society in the future. On behalf of all the directors of the Vietnam-Chinese Association, he also expressed his gratitude to people from all walks of life, groups, shops, restaurants, supermarkets, etc., for giving gifts as dinner prizes to enrich the lottery gifts. Each table received five ordinary prizes, and nine medium prizes of more than 50 yuan, and special prizes. There are three special prizes, including two golden dogs given away by Jinlong Jewelry Store and a cash prize for selling lottery tickets. The Spring Banquet is held while tasting food and enjoying singing. Those who like to dance can also show off their skills without any interruption; lucky draws are also drawn in batches in turns, mixed in with the music and singing. Li Naixian Public Relations also invited representatives of the Vietnam Community to pay New Year greetings to everyone. The beauty queen and princess selected on the second day of the Lunar New Year were also led by the famous charity queen Youth Mother to appear on stage, giving the Spring Banquet a dazzling crown. According to the program schedule, at 8:15, scholarships were awarded to three outstanding students, all children of members, with the purpose of encouraging young people to study diligently; the outgoing president Huang Hai presided over the awarding, and the scholarships were 500 yuan per person. This was the most meaningful part of the dinner. activities. It was the turn of the God of Wealth to distribute red envelopes. Lin Xingdong played the role of the God of Wealth without a beard, looking more youthful and stronger than last year. He went to each table one by one to distribute the red envelopes, and everyone had a share. Huang Feng singers on the stage sang "The God of Wealth is here", bringing the whole banquet to a lively climax. What attracted the most attention to the guests was the real money they got, which were three special prizes. These lucky prize games were different from the previous free green coupons and ordinary prizes. Based on the sale of red lottery tickets, each ticket is priced at two yuan. In addition to the special golden dog award, 30% of the total income will also be used as the grand prize. When the rich man announced that the bonus was as high as six hundred US dollars, the buyers became even more enthusiastic and became the most commotion at the dinner. moment. The special lottery draw was finally held amidst the sounds of joy and congratulations. The process was very interesting. The little golden dog with the number drawn by Qiu Shunxiong made Deng Lingjie win the prize; the big golden dog with the number drawn by Huang Tai was won by Executive Director Wang Churong; the grand prize of 600 yuan was won by Hualian. At the table, Li Jian drew a number, and the lucky winner turned out to be Hong Xiuzhen, the wife of the new president. Sure enough, he got a windfall and was all smiles. After the lottery was completed, the guests left one after another and the banquet was over. However, the guests who liked to dance were still happy and never tired of it. The band had no choice but to continue playing. This joyful congratulations, singing and dancing New Year dinner did not stop until after half past ten, with reluctance. Leaving with infinite nostalgia.

c6b7be50f5c288ffda564919b62162c7867c2bcf.translatedText: The first governor in American history to win a recall election is Wisconsin Governor Scott Walker. Walker, is more confident than ever that the Chinese market and investment can boost Connecticut’s economy and employment.

a57bff4ace835582f0636cc46bdb73d6b7d97aed.sourceText: 沃克日前在沪出席一次商业访问活动中对《第一财经日报》记者强调中美经贸往来的重要性，”中国经济发展好，对美国市场会产生良好促进，反之亦然，我们鼓励美国企业在中国市场投资，创造就业，拉动两国经济互动，也希望能带动中美贸易的深入往来。”
a57bff4ace835582f0636cc46bdb73d6b7d97aed.translatedText: Walker recently attended a business visit in Shanghai and emphasized the importance of Sino-US economic and trade exchanges to a reporter from China Business News. "China's economic development will be a good boost to the US market, and vice versa. We encourage US companies to invest in the Chinese market, create jobs, and stimulate economic interaction between the two countries. We also hope that It can drive in-depth trade between China and the United States. "

01f213c4e037516c7f625cf4a60af86ce8ab1895.sourceText: 数据显示，美联邦政府3月月度财政收入为1860亿美元，当月财政支出2925亿美元，财政赤字高达1065亿美元，透支状况延续。奥巴马的任期内，美国联邦政府的财政赤字已经连续四个财政年度突破1万亿美元，居高不下的财政赤字是美国经济复苏面临的严峻挑战。
01f213c4e037516c7f625cf4a60af86ce8ab1895.translatedText: Data show that the U.S. federal government’s monthly fiscal revenue in March was 186 billion U.S. dollars, and fiscal expenditures for the month were 292.5 billion U.S. dollars. The fiscal deficit was as high as 106.5 billion U.S. dollars, and the overdraft situation continued. During Obama's term, the U.S. federal government's fiscal deficit has exceeded US$1 trillion for four consecutive fiscal years. The high fiscal deficit is a severe challenge facing the U.S. economic recovery.

04bc219e732a96314909b9c8d6202f5034d9fcc9.sourceText: 高债务的焦虑，切实地蔓延到美国的各大州政府官邸，而日益增长的中国资金寻求海外投资出路，使近期美国多个州的州长、政府官员竞相携盛大的代表团，各显神通展开新一轮的访华”吸金行动”。沃克在考察该州在中国开展业务的企业爱室丽家居时表示，此行不仅成功促使隶属光明食品集团的上海牛奶（集团）与康州相关研究机构签署合作协议，预备在奶牛饲料及养殖技术领域开展全面合作，康州米勒电气也宣布向上海汽车制造行业出口设备系统。
04bc219e732a96314909b9c8d6202f5034d9fcc9.translatedText: The anxiety of high debt has effectively spread to the official residences of major state governments in the United States, and the growing number of Chinese funds seeking overseas investment options has recently led to the governors and government officials of many states in the United States competing to bring large delegations, each showing their magic to launch a new round of "money-attracting operations" to visit China. When inspecting Ashley Home Furnishings, a company in the state that operates in China, Walker said that this trip not only successfully prompted Shanghai Milk (Group), a subsidiary of Bright Food Group, to sign a cooperation agreement with relevant research institutions in Connecticut to prepare for comprehensive cooperation in the fields of dairy feed and breeding technology, but Connecticut Miller Electric also announced the export of equipment systems to the Shanghai automobile manufacturing industry.

fd8f5c3c4b05864a63de2dd4c20fa7e5a4c88603.sourceText: 此前，美国加利福尼亚州州长杰里?#24067;朗访华首站，即获15亿美元中国企业资本开发旧金山湾区奥克兰市海外大型商住项目，预期给当地创造上万个工作机会，更有消息称数百亿美元的高铁项目正在洽谈之中。
fd8f5c3c4b05864a63de2dd4c20fa7e5a4c88603.translatedText: Earlier, at the first stop of California Governor Jerry Long's visit to China, he obtained US$1.5 billion in capital from Chinese companies to develop large-scale overseas commercial and residential projects in Oakland, San Francisco Bay Area, which is expected to create tens of thousands of local jobs. There is also news that a high-speed rail project worth tens of billions of dollars is under negotiation.

3b4841cb0aa45299cce35674bbfaca2019d4816f.sourceText: 美国的一些州政府也在上海、北京等中国城市新设中美经贸促进合作中心，沃克对本报记者表示：”中国市场对美国的重要性日益凸显，这是我第一次率贸易代表团访华，印象非常深刻。”据悉，中国是威斯康星州的第三大出口市场，2012年康州向中国的出口额达到15亿美元，同比增长11.8%。
3b4841cb0aa45299cce35674bbfaca2019d4816f.translatedText: Some state governments in the United States have also established new Sino-US Economic and Trade Promotion and Cooperation Centers in Chinese cities such as Shanghai and Beijing. Walker told this reporter: "The importance of the Chinese market to the United States has become increasingly prominent. This is the first time I have led a trade delegation to visit China, and I am very impressed." It is reported that China is Wisconsin's third largest export market. In 2012, Connecticut's exports to China reached US$1.5 billion, a year-on-year increase of 11.8%.

b2cf03b8bd749a1a4686df43781b6b906c9366ac.sourceText: 各州政府积极发起访华”吸金行动”，是由于美国联邦政府在2013年自动生效的大幅削减开支，减少拨款导致州政府收入下降，此前加州的斯托克顿政府已经申请破产，汽车之城底特律政府也因欠下140亿美元债务而财政告急，或将考虑申请破产。
b2cf03b8bd749a1a4686df43781b6b906c9366ac.translatedText: State governments actively launch "money-attracting operations" to visit China. This is due to the U.S. federal government's drastic spending cuts that automatically took effect in 2013. The reduction in allocations has led to a decline in state government revenue. Previously, the Stockton government in California has filed for bankruptcy. The government of Detroit, the automobile city, is also in financial distress due to debts of US$14 billion and may consider filing for bankruptcy.

3532394629b39267fb303f6daacbc16f35fc3c5c.sourceText: 分析人士对记者表示，如果经济活动不能得到积极改善，地区就业情况复苏不力，税收进一步减少，社会福利开支和州政府收入之间的差距会越来越大，加上政府养老金和医疗补助费用开始增加，各州政府会陷入新一轮财政危机，对美国经济复苏和金融市场稳定带来负面影响。
3532394629b39267fb303f6daacbc16f35fc3c5c.translatedText: Analysts told reporters that if economic activity cannot be actively improved, regional employment recovery is weak, and tax revenues are further reduced, the gap between social welfare expenditures and state government revenue will become wider and wider. In addition, government pension and Medicaid costs will begin to increase, and state governments will fall into a new round of fiscal crisis, which will have a negative impact on the U.S. economic recovery and financial market stability.

b4bb41c2bffe33abffeb48b4f0d9eb501aba743d.sourceText: 不确定的州财政状况前景，对金融市场产生负面影响。近日，向来是追求高回报、最爱美国封闭式地方政府债券的基金纷纷遭到投资者减持，整体价格水平从年初的溢价2.9%到如今折价1.8%。晨星分析师指出，投资者对美国地方政府的债券资产投资兴趣锐减，甚至产生恐慌。
b4bb41c2bffe33abffeb48b4f0d9eb501aba743d.translatedText: The uncertain outlook for state fiscal conditions has a negative impact on financial markets. Recently, funds that have always pursued high returns and loved U.S. closed-end local government bonds have been reduced by investors. The overall price level has gone from a premium of 2.9% at the beginning of the year to a discount of 1.8% today. Morningstar analysts pointed out that investors' interest in U.S. local government bond assets has dropped sharply and even caused panic.

4807321cbc70cd586323bf75ddf0cc6e004252a0.sourceText: 增收减赤、促进就业已经成为美国各州政府考虑的最首要问题，沃克提出了2015年前帮助康州增加25万个就业岗位的目标。此前，由于2011年上任以来大刀阔斧地改革，这位强势的共和党州长已经在不提高税收的情况下消除该州36亿美元的财政赤字，为纳税人节省超过10亿美元的开销。虽然康州州政府严苛的财政预算议案一度遭到工会组织大规模示威抗议，但最终骄人的经济成绩单战胜了一切。
4807321cbc70cd586323bf75ddf0cc6e004252a0.translatedText: Increasing revenue, reducing deficits, and promoting employment have become the most important issues considered by state governments in the United States. Walker proposed the goal of helping Connecticut create 250,000 jobs by 2015. Previously, due to his sweeping reforms since taking office in 2011, the powerful Republican governor has eliminated the state's $3.6 billion fiscal deficit without raising taxes, saving taxpayers more than $1 billion. Although the Connecticut state government's stringent fiscal budget bill was once met with large-scale demonstrations by labor unions, in the end the impressive economic performance defeated everything.

The rooms have been almost sold out and new rate now is $99+tax. They have a media room where we can have our group night activities (play card, chess, music, stories, or whatever for fun, sponsored by ACSE). Kids can swim in nicely warm indoor heated swimming pool. Any one from our ACSE group has the same group rate and 24 hours cancellation policy just in case. Ski-rental: Skier’s Edge Ski Shop at 560 W White Mountain Blvd. Pinetop, AZ 85935 (approx 10 minutes from Show Low on the way to Sun Rise) We can get 10% group discount for ski/boots rental for more than 10 people to show up at the same time. The shop will NOT open till 12:00 noon on 12/25 but extend hours to 7:00 PM on 12/24. For those who like to take advantage for lower-rental and better use of time, we will meet there approx 4:00 PM (or between 3:30 PM and 4:30 PM) on 12/24 to get our group rate (approx 20% lower than in Sun Rise). Renting after 3:00 PM counts as one-day charge. http://skiersedgepinetop.com/ For those who like to take a half day ski on 12/24 (12:30 PM – 4:00 PM), you’d better leave early morning to catch it (the best time since few people there for Christmas eve. day). It could be crowded on 12/25, so we’d better to leave hotel at or before 8:00 AM (assuming you have got all ski equipments). There is also a group 10% discount rate for more than 20 lift-tickets at window 6. Hope we all can get there around 8:45 AM. For those who don’t really care group-rate, you can do whatever schedule that you prefer. http://sunriseskiparkaz.com/winter/lift-tickets Finally, a couple of kind advices: (1) The risk is on your side, drive safe and ski safe; (2) Try to establish a good reputation for ACSE (Association of Chinese Scientists and Engineers) to the public – to be professional and gentlemen, as well as having your kids well-disciplined. See you there! Contacts just in case: Qian Xu: 623-703-8071 Amoy Yang: 623-332-5808 Wen Hung: 480-459-7850 ACSE Phoenix Media room (with TV) for our night activities on 12/24 – playing card, chess, majiang, and any fun games you can suggest. We are also allowed to bring some snacks, fruits, chips, and water there (provided by ACSE members) with short meeting to discuss our future plans. Meanwhile, you are welcome to join ACSE (annual fee: $20 for individual and $35 for family) to have connection to many on-going events / activities. Kids can definitely enjoy with heated indoor swimming pool (warm enough for every one). The complimentary full-breakfast will open earlier for our group at 6:30 AM (normal is 7:00 AM). We are lucky to have a sunny day on Sunday (since snows continues to this coming Friday morning). But it could be rather cold – high to 38 degree. I also checked major restaurants schedules at Christmas eve: Domino’s Pizza closed at 9:00 PM. KFC at 6:00 PM, McDonald’s till 12:00 midnight. Since we may not arrive at the same time on 12/24. I would say, eat yourself simply and come back for our night group fun from 7PM to 9PM in Media room. 1d32306acfe439d04eea0f97fc303188fef81976.sourceText: 一月二十二日，当地公益组织“公民之声”（Citizen Voice）为分发疫苗的一线员工们捐助了150份热腾腾的中餐。
1d32306acfe439d04eea0f97fc303188fef81976.translatedText: On January 22, the local public welfare organization "Citizen Voice" Voice donated 150 hot lunches to frontline workers distributing vaccines.

885d039fd222b5bb86a9dc9827152f1d31bc6bda.sourceText: 根据上次协助亚裔联盟（AZAA）给一线员工送餐的经验，这次“公民之声”特地定制了几种很受大家欢迎的中餐菜式：西兰花炒牛肉，酸甜鸡。新世界酒楼是幕后的大厨，不仅给了很大的优惠，还免费赠送150个春卷。 美味中餐准备完毕，可送餐的过程却是一波三折。上次AZAA去了四辆送餐车，这次只安排了三辆车，出餐当日，因为一些问题，临时又少了一辆送餐车，二辆车是否能装下所有食物呢？还好，这次送餐的公民之声的Frank和杨萍夫妇都带着两大车，经过小心翼翼的位置盘算，终于将150份午餐全部装下。
885d039fd222b5bb86a9dc9827152f1d31bc6bda.translatedText: Based on the experience of assisting the Asian Alliance (AZAA) to deliver meals to front-line employees last time, Citizen Voice has specially customized several popular Chinese dishes this time: stir-fried beef with broccoli and sweet and sour chicken. New World Restaurant is the chef behind the scenes, not only giving a great discount, but also giving away 150 spring rolls for free. The delicious Chinese food is ready, but the process of delivering the food is full of twists and turns. Last time AZAA went to four food delivery trucks, but this time only three trucks were arranged. On the day of the meal, due to some problems, one food delivery truck was temporarily missing. Can the two trucks hold all the food? Fortunately, the couple Frank and Yang Ping of Citizen's Voice who delivered the meals this time brought two large trucks. After careful positioning, they finally loaded all 150 lunches.

845f2071d10547e07fd75458fd335b72797f32c9.sourceText: 来到注射疫苗的现场，注射疫苗的场面比1月3号更壮观，车排成了长龙，虽然有警察引领车队，但是进出场地都有堵车。终于来到就餐楼，警察，义工都帮忙卸货，并把午餐送到餐厅，整个餐厅都弥漫着温暖的菜香!
845f2071d10547e07fd75458fd335b72797f32c9.translatedText: When we arrived at the vaccination site, the vaccination scene was more spectacular than on January 3. There was a long queue of cars. Although there were police officers leading the convoy, there were traffic jams entering and exiting the site. Finally, we arrived at the dining building. The police and volunteers helped unload the goods and delivered lunch to the restaurant. The whole restaurant was filled with the warm aroma of vegetables!

2991c48739c4657f23668d871c8df3601506849f.sourceText: 疫情无情，人有情！现场的每个人都在为人类克服这次灾难做努力，希望疫情尽快过去，我们能尽快恢复到相拥微笑，聚会旅行的日子。
2991c48739c4657f23668d871c8df3601506849f.translatedText: The epidemic is ruthless, but people are kind! Everyone on the scene is working hard to help mankind overcome this disaster. We hope that the epidemic will pass as soon as possible and that we can return to the days of hugging each other, smiling, gathering and traveling as soon as possible.

2d94c24f0d4ab9f04eb14f8d00d0f50df4ffa374.translatedText: The latest American university rankings: Harvard and Princeton are tied for first place (Alberta Times) "U.S. News & World Report" magazine announced the new annual American universities on Tuesday...

ebbb4af4ef51c432e67d3027851cbb65e41f9f1a.sourceText: 《美国新闻与世界报导》杂志，周二公布新一年度美国大学排名榜，哈佛大学和普林斯顿大学并列第一。 今年的美国大学榜，前十位改变不大，都是由长春藤名校占据前列位置，哈佛去年独占鳌头，今年普林斯顿则追上来分享榜首位置。 另一变动是去年排第九的芝加哥大学，今年跳四级与另外四家大学并列第五。 《美国新闻与世界报导》的大学榜，是根据各大学的本科生教育学术水平声誉、本科生留读和毕业率、学院资源、收生成绩、学生平均所得财政资源投入、毕业成绩和校友捐款 等七个标准，作​​出排名。 该杂志由1983年开始为美国的大学排名，是大学排名榜鼻祖，但多年来排名基本格局变化不大，用量化指标硬为大学分高下亦一直受争议。 杂志强调排名榜可为高中生找寻适合自己的大学提供参考。 美国大学排名榜前十位 1.哈佛大学，1.普林斯顿大学，3.耶鲁大学，4.哥伦比亚大学，5.加州理工学院，5.麻省理工学院，5.史丹福大学，5.芝加哥大学，5.宾夕 凡尼亚大学，10.杜克大学。
ebbb4af4ef51c432e67d3027851cbb65e41f9f1a.translatedText: "U.S. News & World Report" magazine announced the new annual American university rankings on Tuesday, with Harvard University and Princeton University tied for first place. This year's list of American universities has little change in the top ten, with the Ivy League schools occupying the top positions. Harvard took the top spot last year, and this year Princeton has caught up to share the top spot. Another change is that the University of Chicago, which ranked ninth last year, jumped four levels this year and tied for fifth with four other universities. The U.S. News & World Report's university rankings are based on seven criteria: reputation of undergraduate education and academic standards, undergraduate retention and graduation rates, college resources, admissions results, average financial resource investment by students, graduation results, and alumni donations. The magazine began ranking universities in the United States in 1983 and is the originator of university rankings. However, the basic pattern of rankings has not changed much over the years, and the use of quantitative indicators to rank universities has always been controversial. The magazine emphasizes that the rankings can provide a reference for high school students to find the university that suits them. The top ten universities in the United States are 1. Harvard University, 1. Princeton University, 3. Yale University, 4. Columbia University, 5. California Institute of Technology, 5. MIT, 5. Stanford University, 5. University of Chicago, 5. University of Pennsylvania, 10. Duke University.
