6e6c0ddfe892547e023d7f104a274e86d269b293.sourceText: 唐孝先： 瞎子阿炳的新闻说唱 凤凰城 唐孝先 无锡名人华彦钧（瞎子阿炳），早已作为民间音乐作曲家、演奏家而蜚声国内外；他的二胡曲《二泉映月》和琵琶曲《大浪淘沙》也获得二十世纪华人经典音乐作品奖。阿炳中年双目失明后，穷困潦倒，长期靠卖艺为生，其中的新闻说唱节目，就鲜为年轻一代所知了。 我小时候常常听到父辈讲述瞎子阿炳的故事。正因为父亲和我都是瞎子阿炳的”粉丝”（Fans），父亲晚年对我说过：’听听《二泉映月》，也就是纪念我。’如今定居美国纽约的婶婶施以明，娘家在无锡崇安寺施弄，和我通电话时，还要提到当年下午三点钟光景，瞎子阿炳到崇安寺里来说新闻了，她就要去听。我还读过多次亲临瞎子阿炳卖艺现场的无锡人，写下的文字资料。 瞎子阿炳在街头出现时，穿着一件旧长衫，戴着一副圆圆的墨镜，总是手持二胡，边走边拉。老伴董彩娣的肩上，搭着一个布袋，胸前背后还挂了其他乐器，有琵琶、唢呐、笙、笛等等。看到这样的情景，有人会说：”瞎子阿炳罪过人。”（”罪过人”，无锡话，”真可怜”的意思。） 瞎子阿炳卖艺，是以”说新闻”开始的。当天发生的新闻，他就能编成四个字一句的念白，还用无锡话押韵。开场白是：”说起新闻，话起新闻，新闻出勒，无锡北门（或是东、西、南门）。……有时是’唱新闻’，用滩簧（锡剧）的曲调演唱，也是四字一句：’说起新闻，唱起新闻，新闻新闻，大家听真，..….”他不能看报，那时收音机是稀罕之物，瞎子阿炳这样的穷人肯定不会拥有，我想一定是他上午躲在某家开着收音机的店铺里听了新闻，或者有好心人把当天报纸上的新闻读给他听，他默记下来，再加工创作，下午上街说唱。 有些段子，是时事专题，他会多日连续说唱，如《”沙壳子”的下场》。”沙壳子”是日伪的侦缉队长，说话嗓音嘶哑，故外号”沙壳子”，本名反而被人忘记了。他横行乡里，作恶多端。这一类汉奸，偏僻陌生的地方是不敢去的。恰好就在热闹的崇安寺，他被抗日游击队击毙了，无锡百姓人心大快，瞎子阿炳以此为题说了好几天。 瞎子阿炳的另一个段子《十九路军英勇抗战》，语言生动，正气凛然。先说上海被外国侵略者划分为租界：”上海本是，中国场哼（地方）。拨勒（给了）几只,外国猢狲；你也来分，他也来分。租田当作，自产格能（那样）。”无锡话有一句五字谚语”租田作自产”，意为把别人的东西占为己有。瞎子阿炳巧妙地将五个字一句变成四个字两句。 说起洋人在租界上的胡作非为，他唱到：”客人反倒，欺负主人。枪杀百姓，也勿抵命。权柄夺勒（在），他的手心。不讲公理，反叫文明。” 他热情歌颂十九路军英勇杀敌：’黄浦江边，十九路军，大刀列队，杀敌逞英。入侵敌寇，胆战心惊。刀光闪闪，逃窜无门，头颅落地，像割瓜藤。……全国上下，誓作后盾。爱国同胞，协力同心；定把敌寇，赶出国门。’ 瞎子阿炳还有一个歌颂革命烈士秦起的保留节目，叫《秦起血溅大雄宝殿》。共产党员秦起是大革命时代的无锡工人运动领袖，任总工会主席。1927年四*一二以后，蒋介石屠杀共产党人，秦起在无锡首当其冲。当时崇安寺大雄宝殿是总工会办公地点，秦起在此坚守阵地，军警前来抓人，他奋起反抗，在搏斗中被杀害。 瞎子阿炳的”说新闻”、”唱新闻”，不但有浓郁的家乡风味，有清楚的是非观念，有强烈的爱国热情，还有鲜明的爱憎立场。 瞎子阿炳说过新闻，就是自拉自唱，唱各种民间小调，填上新词，胡琴伴奏，最常唱的是无锡人差不多人人会唱的《无锡景》。 瞎子阿炳的胡琴能模仿鸡鸣狗叫、无锡人说话。孩子们特别感兴趣，他也特别喜欢孩子们。孩子们觉得叫他”瞎子阿炳”没大没小，问他：”我哩叫你啥咯？”他说：”就叫瞎子阿炳，蛮好咯。” 他演唱时，董彩娣收钱。到一定时候，瞎子阿炳就问她：”几乎啦？”董彩娣报一个数目，瞎子阿炳就说：”好啦，明天的开销够了。”然后用他的胡琴模仿人声讲几句无锡话：”谢谢老板，谢谢小开，谢谢太太，谢谢小姐，再会，再会！” 谋生活动结束，艺术生活开始。瞎子阿炳换一把胡琴，由董彩娣搀扶着在街上边走边拉，知音们跟在后面听。这时拉的不再是小调，后来被命名为《二泉映月》的乐曲，是人们经常听到的。
6e6c0ddfe892547e023d7f104a274e86d269b293.translatedText: Tang Xiaoxian: Blind Man A Bing's News Rap Phoenix City Tang Xiaoxian Wuxi celebrity Hua Yanjun (Blind Man A Bing) has long been famous at home and abroad as a folk music composer and performer; his erhu piece "The Moon Reflected in Two Springs" and pipa piece "Big Waves Tasting the Sand" also won the 20th Century Chinese Classic Music Award. After Abing lost his sight in middle age, he became impoverished and relied on performing arts to make a living for a long time. Among them, news and rap programs are rarely known to the younger generation. When I was a child, I often heard my parents tell the story of the blind man Bing. Precisely because my father and I are both "fans" of Blind Abing, my father said to me in his later years: "Listen to "Er Quan Ying Yue", which is to commemorate me." ’ My aunt Shi Yiming, who now lives in New York, USA, whose natal family was a nun in Chong’an Temple in Wuxi, told me on the phone that at three o’clock in the afternoon, the blind man A Bing came to Chong’an Temple to tell the news, and she was going to listen. I have also read written materials written by people from Wuxi who have visited Blind A Bing’s performance many times. When the blind man A Bing appears on the street, he wears an old gown and a pair of round sunglasses. He always holds an erhu and plays it while walking. There is a cloth bag on the shoulder of my wife Dong Caidi, and other musical instruments are hung on the chest and back, including pipa, suona, sheng, flute and so on. Seeing such a scene, some people will say: "Blind Man Bing has sinned against others." ("Sinned against others", in Wuxi dialect, means "so pitiful".) Blind Man Bing's performing arts started by "telling news". He could compile a four-character recitation of the news that happened that day, and rhyme it in Wuxi dialect. The opening line is: "Talking about the news, talking about the news, news out, Wuxi North Gate (or east, west, south gate)... Sometimes it is 'singing news', sung to the tune of Tanhuang (Xi Opera), it is also a four-character sentence: 'Speaking of the news, singing news, news news, everyone listens true..." He did not Being able to read newspapers, radios were a rarity at that time, and poor people like the blind Abing would definitely not have them. I think he must have hid in a shop with a radio on in the morning and listened to the news, or maybe a kind person read him the news from the newspaper of the day. He memorized it, reprocessed it, and sang in the streets in the afternoon. Some of the jokes were about current affairs, and he would rap them continuously for many days, such as "The End of Sha Kezi". "Sha Kezi" is the Japanese and puppet detective captain. He speaks with a hoarse voice, so he is nicknamed "Sha Kezi", but his real name has been forgotten. He ran rampant in the countryside and committed many evil deeds. This type of traitor would not dare to go to remote and unfamiliar places. Just at the bustling Chong'an Temple, he was shot dead by the anti-Japanese guerrillas. The people of Wuxi were very happy, and the blind man A Bing talked about it for several days. Another piece written by the blind man A Bing, "The Heroic Resistance of the Nineteenth Route Army," has vivid language and awe-inspiring righteousness. Let’s start with the fact that Shanghai was divided into concessions by foreign invaders: “Shanghai was originally a Chinese farm. I gave you a few foreign hozens. You came to share, and he came to share. Rented fields are treated as self-produced areas.” There is a five-character proverb in Wuxi dialect, “Rented fields are used for self-produced goods”, which means taking other people’s things as your own. The blind man A Bing cleverly changed one sentence of five characters into two sentences of four characters. Talking about the misbehavior of foreigners in the concession, he sang: "Guests bully their hosts. Shoot people, but don't take their lives. Power is in the palm of his hand. Instead of talking about justice, they call it civilization." He enthusiastically praised the 19th Route Army's heroic killing of the enemy: "On the Huangpu River, the 19th Route Army lined up with swords to kill the enemy and show off their heroism." Invading enemy invaders, terrified. The sword flashed, and there was no way to escape. The head fell to the ground, like cutting a melon and vine. ...The whole country vows to support us. Patriotic compatriots, work together as one to drive the enemy out of the country. ’ Blind Abing also has a repertoire that praises the revolutionary martyr Qin Qi, called “Qin Qi’s Blood Splattered in the Grand Palace.” Communist Party member Qin Qi was the leader of the Wuxi workers' movement during the Great Revolution and served as chairman of the Federation of Trade Unions. After April 12, 1927, Chiang Kai-shek massacred the Communists, and Qin Qi was the first to bear the brunt in Wuxi. At that time, the Main Hall of Chong'an Temple was the office of the Federation of Trade Unions. Qin Qi stood firm here. When the military and police came to arrest him, he resisted and was killed in the fight. Blind Abing's "telling news" and "singing news" not only have a strong hometown flavor, but also have a clear sense of right and wrong, a strong patriotic enthusiasm, and a clear love-hate stance. Blind man A Bing once said that when it comes to news, he just sings to himself, singing various folk tunes, adding new words, and accompaniment with the huqin. The most common song is "Wuxi Scene", which almost everyone in Wuxi can sing. Blind man A Bing's Huqin can imitate the crowing of chickens, the barking of dogs, and the speech of Wuxi people. Children were particularly interested, and he was particularly fond of children. The children felt that calling him "Blind Man Bing" was not a big deal, so they asked him: "What should I call you?" He said: "Just call him Blind Man Bing, that's fine." When he sang, Dong Caidi collected the money. At a certain time, blind Abing asked her: "Almost?" Dong Caidi reported a number, and blind Abing said: "Okay, tomorrow's expenses are enough." Then he used his Huqin to imitate a human voice and said a few words in Wuxi dialect: "Thank you, boss, thank you, Xiaokai, thank you, madam, thank you, miss, see you, see you!" The livelihood activities ended and the artistic life began. The blind man A Bing changed into a huqin and was supported by Dong Caidi as he walked and played the huqin on the street, while his close friends followed and listened. At this time, the music played was no longer a minor key. The music later named "Er Quan Ying Yue" was often heard by people.

70e9dfa73695b5b4a0e95fe6f3248adb16c655c1.sourceText: 吉它是一种被彻底滥化了的乐器，摇滚乐手弹着吉它，流行歌手弹着吉它，学生们弹着吉它，流浪者弹着吉它……以至于一次在成都的菜市场见到几把勉强可以称做吉它的东西在三轮车上胡乱堆着，20元（人民币）一把！还有一次在成都的春熙路见到一个盲人用一把肮脏的电吉它来卖艺，六根钢丝同时乱响的声音被效果器无限的放大，让人忍不住为这样的音乐而落泪，如果这样也是音乐的话。
70e9dfa73695b5b4a0e95fe6f3248adb16c655c1.translatedText: The guitar is an instrument that has been completely overused. Rock musicians play the guitar, pop singers play the guitar, students play the guitar, homeless people play the guitar... So much so that I once saw a few things that could barely be called guitars piled on a tricycle in a Chengdu wet market, costing 20 yuan (RMB) each! Another time I saw a blind man performing a show on Chunxi Road in Chengdu using a dirty electric guitar. The sound of six steel wires squeaking at the same time was infinitely amplified by the effect device. People couldn't help but cry for this kind of music, if this is also music.

3b7ef8f8c7b4d6686421591bbfa1f8baf2bfa2f8.sourceText: 真得会落泪。从那以后我厌恶电吉它和效果器，深深地厌恶。
3b7ef8f8c7b4d6686421591bbfa1f8baf2bfa2f8.translatedText: It really makes me cry. From then on I hated electric guitars and pedals, deeply.

4ec1b90f42130ca81f9b18b908564b394bece495.sourceText: 请原谅我再三提到成都，我本意并不是要贬低她。毕竟那是一个永远阴云蔽日的城市，府南河的水从青苔上默默流过，所有的人都会洋溢着一种发自内心的忧伤，这正是拨响六弦的好地方。我第一次拨起吉它……是多久以前？十多年前？那是一种来自最深处的声音，一直在心里拨响到现在。
4ec1b90f42130ca81f9b18b908564b394bece495.translatedText: Please forgive me for mentioning Chengdu again and again. My intention was not to belittle her. After all, it is a city where the sun is always covered by clouds. The water of the Funan River flows silently through the moss, and everyone will be filled with a kind of sadness from the heart. This is a good place to pluck the six strings. How long ago was it that I first picked up a guitar...? More than ten years ago? It was a voice that came from the deepest part and has been ringing in my heart until now.

f85ecc2bda08970f3900c28efa070da1ec529769.sourceText: 弹吉它和真正的吉它音乐是有质的差别的，而只有一颗安静的心才能理解六弦的音乐。Tommy Emmanuel，是心目中永远的英雄，一生中不可错过的诗歌。他当然不会是那种炙手可热的流行，也从来不在有限的吉它空间上过多炫耀他的技巧。弹过几乎他所有的乐谱，也不觉得如何深奥；然而和他的演奏去比较，会发现我自己引以为傲的各种技巧是多么地苍白无力。他有着Fingerstyle的典型曲风，但依然会带有各种颜色的风景，好像枫叶随风飘落的多彩。可惜我手头只有他的一盘《Only》，还有几个偶尔下载来的现场演奏。1994年的他用最后一曲长达 10分钟的丰采填写着Blues里每一个灵魂的空隙；而2004年的他已经白发斑斑，再也不没有了年轻时Jazz乐手那种常见的幽默。十个来自美国各地的孩子，他们用纯净的眼睛和Tommy坐在一起，用纯净的耳朵听着’Angelina’-和他的小女儿同名的曲子。
f85ecc2bda08970f3900c28efa070da1ec529769.translatedText: There is a qualitative difference between playing guitar and real guitar music, and only a quiet heart can understand six-string music. Tommy Emmanuel is an eternal hero in my heart and a poem that cannot be missed in life. He certainly wasn't the hot pop kind, and never showed off his skills too much in the limited guitar space. I have played almost all of his scores, and I don't think they are very profound; however, when compared with his performance, I will find that the various techniques I am proud of are pale and insignificant. He has the typical style of Fingerstyle, but still has scenery of various colors, like the colorful maple leaves falling in the wind. Unfortunately, I only have a copy of his "Only" and a few live performances that I occasionally downloaded. In 1994, he filled every soul gap in Blues with his 10-minute last song; but in 2004, he had gray hair and no longer had the humor that was common among young jazz musicians. Ten children from all over the United States sat with Tommy with pure eyes and listened to 'Angelina' - the namesake of his little daughter - with pure ears.

76e56758d2e6626f49c85977258422cc8fef99f9.sourceText: 吉它是少数几个你可以坐在身边聆听的乐器。However, I only have Tommy’s ONLY. 如果技巧一定要被用来炫耀，Justin King，是屈指可数的在木吉它上点弦的家伙。换句话说，他只用一只右手就可以弹出你可以想象的全部音乐。如果你一定要用Van Halen在电吉它上的做作来小看木吉它上的点弦，那你可以亲自一试-毕竟我换来的只是象倒立踩过钢丝的手指尖。Justin现场演奏的”Knock the wood”，就是用一把双把吉它，两手全部在眼花缭乱地点弦，象是十个舞蹈家在飞快地起舞。在《Le Bleu》里他仅仅三十岁的才华挥洒的淋漓尽致，从巴黎的晨歌舞蹈到时间的灰烬。对于这部写满天分的作品，西班牙一个名不见经传的女评论家写道：”Justin的每根手指都有让我晕倒的性感。”
76e56758d2e6626f49c85977258422cc8fef99f9.translatedText: The guitar is one of the few instruments you can sit next to and listen to. However, I only have Tommy’s ONLY. If skill must be used to show off, Justin King is one of the few guys who can play strings on an acoustic guitar. In other words, he can play all the music you can imagine with just one right hand. If you must use Van Halen's artificiality on the electric guitar to underestimate the string picking on the acoustic guitar, then you can try it yourself - after all, what I get in exchange is the fingertips that look like stepping on the steel wire upside down. When Justin played "Knock the Wood" live, he used a double guitar, with both hands playing the strings dizzyingly, like ten dancers dancing rapidly. In "Le Bleu", his talent at just thirty years old is fully displayed, from the morning song and dance in Paris to the ashes of time. Regarding this work full of talent, a little-known female critic in Spain wrote: "Every finger of Justin has a sexiness that makes me faint."

cca957b40fc302ec3563b645b19d74af34201f9b.sourceText: 而时间留下的不只是灰烬。
cca957b40fc302ec3563b645b19d74af34201f9b.translatedText: And time leaves more than just ashes.

204f7ecf4ddaef2b362e2029b145f3a07ced1a26.sourceText: 很遗憾浪费了大段的篇幅，而心中的女主角还没有出场。如果一定要有什么背景音乐来过渡的话，没有比John Williams和Itzhak Perlman的《Duos for Violin and Guitar》更加合适了。他们俩都是很讨巧的人物，在音乐和流行中间勉强讨好了双方。但是在这张CD里面，你会看到一个宏伟不可目视的人物：Niccolo Paganini（帕格尼尼）。
204f7ecf4ddaef2b362e2029b145f3a07ced1a26.translatedText: It's a pity that a lot of space was wasted, and the heroine in my heart has not yet appeared. If there must be some background music to transition, there is nothing more suitable than "Duos for Violin and Guitar" by John Williams and Itzhak Perlman. Both of them are very agreeable characters, barely trying to please both sides of the spectrum between music and pop. But in this CD, you will see a figure that is so majestic that it cannot be seen: Niccolo Paganini.

8c7936c834c8baa705dcc0c223309cce99c622ec.sourceText: 无论以什么言辞来形容他都是不过分的。只有把灵魂出卖给魔鬼的人，才可以具有这样夺目的光芒。我自己可以拉出令人勉强可以听听的提琴曲，然而他的乐谱是一本写给魔鬼的书，我在各种瞠目结舌的跨弦的八度音的迷宫中完全不知所措。双泛音、双颤音、左手拨弦同时右手连续跳弓，以至于他的曲谱看起来完全不是一个小提琴谱。他的幻想曲被当时的知名演奏家说：”错了吧，这只可能是四手联弹的钢琴谱。”
8c7936c834c8baa705dcc0c223309cce99c622ec.translatedText: No words can be used to describe him. Only those who have sold their souls to the devil can have such a dazzling light. I can play fiddle music that is barely audible, but his score is a book addressed to the devil. I am completely at a loss in the maze of jaw-dropping cross-string octaves. Double overtones, double vibratos, the left hand plucking the strings while the right hand continuously skips the bow, so that his score does not look like a violin score at all. His Fantasia was said by a well-known performer at the time: "You're wrong, this could only be a piano score for four hands."

0efd4e44e454f68041d7c4eee64b0fa22ef0b23b.sourceText: 然而错的并不是帕格尼尼。永远不是。”如果他不是魔鬼，那么他一定是上帝本人。”这是对其最深刻的评价。
0efd4e44e454f68041d7c4eee64b0fa22ef0b23b.translatedText: But it wasn't Paganini who was wrong. Never. "If he is not the devil, then he must be God himself." This is the most profound evaluation of him.

11a212ca5fa907d37f3148733ece927f03b26ddd.sourceText: 这样一个小提琴的魔鬼，居然放弃了公开的小提琴活动达数年之久去钻研吉它，而这背后的故事似乎还有着爱情。具体的事情永远不被人知晓，然而帕格尼尼的吉它音乐出乎意料的明朗简单，他的主要作品都带着特别的抒情色彩。吉它和小提琴的联袂在他的心里似乎和他的爱情故事一起被雪藏，然而从留下来的曲谱，你永远可以听到这非同一般的合奏。
11a212ca5fa907d37f3148733ece927f03b26ddd.translatedText: Such a violin devil actually gave up public violin activities for several years to study guitar, and the story behind this seems to involve love. The specifics will never be known, but Paganini's guitar music is surprisingly clear and simple, and his major works have a special lyrical flavor. The combination of guitar and violin seems to have been hidden in his heart along with his love story. However, from the remaining music scores, you can always hear this extraordinary ensemble.

fc170ea38dc78918d5f383c29aaac02d67bb2f94.sourceText: Heifetz，不可不提的小提琴。他严谨而完美，以至于他从来不笑。”我是音乐，不是小丑。”他从来没有象Perlman那样用一把比较小的琴来冒充八度的跨弦，也没有用其他的速度演奏过曲谱。他没有错音，一个也没有，即使在他平时练习的时候。Bach的各种小提琴曲在他手里完全变成了一架定时的钢琴：Bach不懂小提琴，而Heifetz也不屑于去理解钢琴。用机器人来演奏都不能取代Heifetz的特色。记得一曲《亚麻色头发的少女》之后，他没有笑。但是他的眼神在微笑，微微地笑。
fc170ea38dc78918d5f383c29aaac02d67bb2f94.translatedText: >Heifetz, the violin that must be mentioned. He was so strict and perfect that he never smiled. "I am music, not a clown." He has never used a smaller piano to pretend to cross an octave like Perlman did, nor has he played music at other speeds. He didn't miss a note, not a single one, even when he was practicing. Bach's various violin pieces completely turned into a timed piano in his hands: Bach didn't understand the violin, and Heifetz didn't bother to understand the piano. Even playing with a robot can't replace Heifetz's uniqueness. After remembering the song "Girl with Flaxen Hair", he didn't smile. But his eyes were smiling, smiling slightly.

2494da2dd699281330ff6d78806ac9b9c1beaa22.sourceText: 为了怀念一个好友的小号，在长江边吹响。还有为了怀念我积满灰尘的小提琴。拿起乐谱，轻轻弹起Tommy的”Question”。
2494da2dd699281330ff6d78806ac9b9c1beaa22.translatedText: In memory of a good friend, I played the trumpet by the Yangtze River. And to remember my dusty violin. Pick up the sheet music and play Tommy's "Question" gently.

2152ff6e87ab9355b28e8a99b3c448f3222f28e1.sourceText: 北京门楼文化自愿抢救者 -吕宝华 亞省時報 呂寶華，近得說他是鳳凰城藍天餐廳老闆的老爸，遠得說是前中國文化部一位老幹部。呂老愛好很多，身上的頭銜也很多，什麼攝影家協會的會員，收藏家協會會員，中國民間藝術家協會會員等等，原本覺得拿到他的名片應該是會印滿那些多少讓人羨慕的頭銜，可是真正看到他的名片，才發現是個讓人意外的稱呼 – – 北京門樓文化自願搶救者。於是發現，這個來鳳凰城度假的老人有些不同，4月15日記者在鳳凰城藍天餐廳專訪了呂老。 呂老一生從事文化行業，所以我們的話題就從寫文章開始。呂老在”亞省時報”的文章有幾十萬字，很受歡迎。他說寫文章首先是關注讀者，要知道讀者想看什麼，這樣才能有的放矢，寫出大家喜歡的好文章。2000年剛到鳳凰城的時候，他也疑惑過，因為和華人讀者接觸的時間和機會比較少，不知道海外的華人都想知道什麼。後來他發現”’變化”：時代的變化，國家的變化應該是大家有興趣的，而且這些變化要有時代特徵。2000年中國的發展和建設非常的紅火，因為大拆大建民眾呼籲搶救傳統文化。當時呂老就投入到中國古代油燈搜藏，北京民宅建築文化的記錄中去。他用兒子97年送給他的照相機，騎著自行車在老北京城裡四處奔忙，邊收藏，邊照相，邊做研究，總結。他對老北京的對聯，磚雕，石雕，鋪首都有非常細緻的研究。 當問及呂老為什麼會堅持在這些老文化做研究時，呂老舉了個例子。在保護北京民宅建築文化的生活的幾年中，作為老北京，更了解四合院了。四合院是北京傳統民居形式，遼代時已初成規模，經金、元，至明、清，逐漸完善，最終成為北京最有特點的居住形式。所謂四合，”四”指東、西、南、北四面，?#21512;?#21363;四面房屋圍在一起，形成一個”口”字形。經過數百年的營建，北京四合院從平面佈局到內部結構、細部裝修都形成了京師特有的京味風格。 四合院是一個封閉的空間，從外往裡看，看不到內部的空間，有隱蔽性，也有安全性。從內往外看，就一覽無遺。四合院內會種很多樹，花。然後會用走廊把內部的區域聯繫起來，很注重舒適和美觀。很多四合院都是清代的，這從四合院門口的對聯就能看出來。當年家家戶戶都是以讀書，保持傳統家庭觀念為主的民風，很多對聯都是倡導這些思想，比如”忠厚傳家久，讀書繼世長”等等。四合院裡的一些木雕，石雕，有很多蝙蝠，葫蘆，牡丹等圖案，因為這些圖案在當年都是福，祿，壽，喜，財的象徵，都是祝愿家庭平安幸福。呂老表示從四合院的保護當中，他可以享受到考古的樂趣。從衣食住行禮儀中，找到很多時代的文化，也可以從這些信息回到我們現在的實際生活，思考現在時代的特點。同時也可以夯實自己的文化基礎，了解刺繡，年畫，剪紙，皮影，地方戲曲等方方面面，去看當年民間藝術的特點，發展趨勢，來預測未來民間文化的發展繼承的形態和發展方向。呂老說相機是他的武器，書籍就是他的放大鏡。他每年都要讀幾百萬字的書，來系統的整理，記錄他拍的上萬張的照片，做這麼多的事情，不為獲得什麼，只是自己也享受這個學習的過程，也會讓以後的人，更迅速，系統的的獲得這些遺失了的信息。因為他拍的很多北京民宅已經看不見了，現在只能有照片來告訴大家這些文化特色，真的很遺憾，這也是為什麼他要在名片上稱自己為北京門樓文化自願搶救者的原因。 呂老退休了，沒見他閒下，反而看上去更忙了，為自己喜歡的事情花更多的時間，更多的精力，這也許是另一種安享晚年的方式，也請您繼續關注”亞省時報”呂老的文章，繼續傾聽呂老筆下的故事。
2152ff6e87ab9355b28e8a99b3c448f3222f28e1.translatedText: Beijing Gate Tower Culture Voluntary Rescuer - Lu Baohua, Alberta Times Lu Baohua, closer to say he is the father of the owner of the Blue Sky Restaurant in Phoenix, and far more to say he is a veteran cadre of the former Ministry of Culture of China. Mr. Lu has many hobbies and titles, such as a member of the Photographers Association, a member of the Collectors Association, a member of the Chinese Folk Artists Association, etc. I originally thought that his business card would be filled with enviable titles, but when I actually saw his business card, I discovered that it was an unexpected title - Beijing Gate Tower Cultural Voluntary Rescuer. Then I discovered that there was something different about this old man who came to Phoenix for vacation. On April 15, the reporter interviewed Mr. Lu exclusively at the Blue Sky Restaurant in Phoenix. Mr. Lu has been engaged in the cultural industry all his life, so our topic starts with writing articles. Mr. Lu's articles in the "Alberta Times" have hundreds of thousands of words and are very popular. He said that when writing articles, you must first pay attention to the readers. You must know what the readers want to see, so that you can be targeted and write good articles that everyone will like. When he first arrived in Phoenix in 2000, he also had doubts. Because he had less time and opportunities to interact with Chinese readers, he didn't know what overseas Chinese wanted to know. Later he discovered that "change": changes in the times and changes in the country should be of interest to everyone, and these changes must have the characteristics of the times. In 2000, China's development and construction were very prosperous. Because of the massive demolition and construction, the people called for the rescue of traditional culture. At that time, Mr. Lu devoted himself to collecting ancient Chinese oil lamps and recording the architectural culture of Beijing's residential buildings. Using the camera his son gave him in 1997, he rode a bicycle around old Beijing, collecting, taking photos, doing research and summarizing. He has conducted very detailed research on the couplets, brick carvings, stone carvings and paving capital of old Beijing. When asked why Mr. Lu insists on doing research on these ancient cultures, Mr. Lu gave an example. In the past few years of protecting the architectural culture of Beijing's residential buildings, as an old Beijinger, I have learned more about courtyard houses. Siheyuan is a traditional residential form in Beijing. It first took shape in the Liao Dynasty. It was gradually improved through the Jin, Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties, and eventually became the most distinctive residential form in Beijing. The so-called Sihe, "four" refers to the four sides of east, west, south and north. The houses on the four sides are surrounded together to form a "kou" shape. After hundreds of years of construction, Beijing's courtyard houses have formed the capital's unique Beijing style from their floor plan to internal structure and detailed decoration. The courtyard is a closed space. Looking from the outside in, the internal space cannot be seen. It provides concealment and safety. Looking from the inside out, you can see everything at a glance. There will be many trees and flowers planted in the courtyard. Corridors will then be used to connect the internal areas, with great emphasis on comfort and beauty. Many courtyards are from the Qing Dynasty, which can be seen from the couplets at the entrance of the courtyards. At that time, every household was based on reading and maintaining traditional family concepts. Many couplets advocated these ideas, such as "Loyalty will last forever, reading will last forever" and so on. Some of the wood carvings and stone carvings in the courtyard have many patterns such as bats, gourds, and peonies, because these patterns were symbols of fortune, wealth, longevity, happiness, and wealth in those days, and they all wished the family peace and happiness. Mr. Lu said that he can enjoy the fun of archaeology from the protection of the courtyard. From the etiquette of clothing, food, housing and transportation, we can find the culture of many eras. We can also use this information to return to our current actual life and think about the characteristics of the current era. At the same time, you can also lay a solid foundation for your own culture, learn about embroidery, New Year pictures, paper-cutting, shadow puppets, local operas and other aspects, see the characteristics and development trends of folk art at that time, and predict the form and direction of the development and inheritance of folk culture in the future. Mr. Lu said that the camera is his weapon and books are his magnifying glass. He reads millions of words of books every year, systematically organizes them, and records the tens of thousands of photos he takes. He does so many things not to gain anything, but to enjoy the learning process himself, and to allow future people to obtain the lost information more quickly and systematically. Because many of the Beijing houses he photographed are no longer visible, and now we can only have photos to tell everyone about these cultural features. It is really a pity. This is why he calls himself a voluntary rescuer of Beijing Gate Tower Culture on his business card. Mr. Lu has retired, but instead of being idle, he seems to be busier. He spends more time and energy on the things he likes. This may be another way to enjoy his old age. Please continue to pay attention to Mr. Lu's articles in the "Alberta Times" and continue to listen to the stories written by Mr. Lu.

57dacd9cefe9f115144306b3cc73b8bb769a9b57.sourceText: 天空很蓝，太阳很暖。 在这片大大的草坪上，街友们星散地围坐着，或冥想，或倾谈，或听歌。 先打个盹吧，人常说，梦里也许在醒着，醒的时候却常常发白日梦。 在凤凰城市中心，Madsion与12Ave之间的”CASS”，是县政府补助的慈善救助单位，内中收容着短暂无家可归的游民。 但对于很多流浪汉来说，二月四日对他们来说一定是个开心好日子，因为大家见到了”龙”，免费的午餐就在眼前，已经开始了，什么也不用准备，排队就可以了 。 服务他们的人是”龙的传人”，这些人头上戴着红帽子，身上穿着黄衣裳，在帽子和衣裳上还绣着一个龙头图案，告知大家今年是〝中国龙年〞。 在以往的许多年里，这批龙的传人都会在中国农历新年前后，准备好过千份的食物招待他们。 黄衣人群今天一早就来到了，搬来了炸炉，摆放好桌子，堆好汽水、瓶水和食物。 很多食材昨日已经在做准备，那一大大煲好味又多汁的牛肉，足足熬了老半天呢！ 开餐时间一到，他们开此分工合作，各自带上手套，把白米饭，绿兰花，金黄鸡块和春卷，再加上熟牛肉，装满了一碟又一碟，配备上纸巾叉子和 饮料，一份一份地递给今天的客人。 有时队伍太长，干脆就端起热腾的饭菜，送到队伍后面客人的手中，并告知大家，食物很充足，不够可再加。 龙的传人把这些客人称为”街友”，眼神里没有虚伪，也不是同情，有的只是善意和尊重。 他们手脚不停地做足几个小时，并不觉累，因为做善事的人会很开心。 和往年一样，这次善事由亚省中国餐馆协会举办，再加上一大批有善心和爱心的义工帮忙。 天空很蓝，太阳很暖。 街友们今天也很开心，因为有爱，因为有温饱，更因为得到了尊重。
57dacd9cefe9f115144306b3cc73b8bb769a9b57.translatedText: The sky was blue and the sun was warm. On this large lawn, street friends were scattered around, meditating, talking, or listening to songs. Take a nap first. People often say that you may be awake in your dreams, but you often daydream when you are awake. In downtown Phoenix, the "CASS" between Madsion and 12Ave is a charity assistance unit subsidized by the county government, which houses homeless people who are temporarily homeless. But for many homeless people, February 4th must be a happy day for them, because everyone saw the "dragon" and the free lunch was right in front of them. It had already started. There was no need to prepare anything, just queue up. The people who serve them are "descendants of the dragon". These people wear red hats and yellow clothes. There is also a dragon head pattern embroidered on the hats and clothes to inform everyone that this year is the "Chinese Year of the Dragon". In the past many years, the descendants of these dragons would prepare more than a thousand portions of food to entertain them around the Chinese New Year. The people in yellow arrived early this morning, brought in the frying pan, set up the table, and piled up sodas, bottles of water, and food. A lot of ingredients were being prepared yesterday, and the big pot of delicious and juicy beef took a long time to cook! When it was time to start the meal, they started to work together, each put on their gloves, filled one plate after another with white rice, green orchids, golden chicken nuggets and spring rolls, plus cooked beef, equipped with paper towels, forks and drinks, and handed them to today's guests one by one. Sometimes the queue is too long, so we simply bring hot meals to the guests at the back of the queue and tell everyone that the food is sufficient and if there is not enough, they can add more. The descendants of Long called these guests "street friends". There was no hypocrisy or sympathy in their eyes, but only kindness and respect. They keep working on their hands and feet for hours without feeling tired, because people who do good deeds will be very happy. As in previous years, this charity event was organized by the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association, with the help of a large number of kind-hearted and loving volunteers. The sky is blue and the sun is warm. The street friends are also very happy today because they have love, because they have food and clothing, and because they are respected.

8ce9b6769f48615cefd7d8f41a647a24c27b83e6.sourceText: 國民黨亞利桑那直屬分部舉辦中秋節聯誼會 （亚省时报） 國民黨亞利桑那直屬分部於九月十日在康樂大廈舉辦中秋節聯誼會，出席黨員踴躍，對回國投票做了更具體的說明，除了協助投票民眾完成選前登記，也將協助查看證件如護照期限是否符合投票資格，此外也希望計劃返台僑民訂機票前能與我們聯絡，人數越多，我們越有機會向航空公司爭取優惠折扣。 此次聯誼會除了共渡中秋，並希望黨員回國投票以實際行動支持馬政府連任。會中特別對前書記王淑英女士在成立直屬分部的貢獻上提出了感謝與懷念；同時特別邀請徐媽媽（徐彭樹霞）為直屬分部顧問之一。 會中對馬總統所說：「沒有榮華富貴可以分享，只有千斤重擔必須承受。」這句話大部份人聽了都深表贊同，試問，從李登輝的口中我們聽得到這句話嗎？因為當初的「李登輝政」是論功行賞，「陳水扁政府」是群臣亂政，從蔡英文的口中當然也不會，因為當初「陳水扁政府」的「群臣」，如今都在「蔡英文」手下身居要職。我們相信只有給馬政府再四年，國家才有希望。 這次聯誼會除備有百年國慶精緻禮物外，並準備了豐盛的午宴，黨員們自動自發的攜來可口菜餚，大家在享受美味外，並高唱愛國歌曲，大夥歡聚一堂，為這中華百年的中秋添上美麗回憶，最後在高呼馬英九凍蒜中圓滿閉幕。 直屬分部義工： 李問浙602-793-1325 章文秀602-956-7889 鄧凱蒂602-478-5709 曹嘉儀480-540-4462 梁小燕602-312-2203 王瑋王亭928-300-0915, 480-899-7059 國民黨亞利桑那直屬分部舉辦中秋節聯誼會
8ce9b6769f48615cefd7d8f41a647a24c27b83e6.translatedText: The Arizona branch of the Kuomintang held a Mid-Autumn Festival party (Alberta Times) The Arizona branch of the Kuomintang held a Mid-Autumn Festival party at the Kang Le Building on September 10. The party members attended enthusiastically and gave more detailed instructions on returning to the country to vote. In addition to assisting voters to complete pre-election registration, they will also assist in checking whether their documents, such as passport expiration date, are eligible for voting. In addition, we hope that overseas Chinese who plan to return to Taiwan can contact us before booking flights. The more people there, the more opportunities we have to obtain discounts from airlines. In addition to celebrating the Mid-Autumn Festival together, this sorority also hopes that party members will return home to vote and take practical actions to support the re-election of the Ma government. During the meeting, the former secretary, Ms. Wang Shuying, was especially thanked and remembered for her contribution in the establishment of the direct branch; at the same time, Mrs. Xu (Xu Pengshuxia) was specially invited to be one of the consultants of the direct branch. During the meeting, President Ma said: "There is no glory and wealth to share, only a heavy burden that must be borne." Most people deeply agreed with this sentence. I wonder, can we hear this sentence from Lee Teng-hui's mouth? Because the original "Lee Teng-hui government" was based on rewards based on merit, and the "Chen Shui-bian government" was a group of ministers who were in chaos. Of course, Tsai Ing-wen would not say that, because the "group of ministers" in the original "Chen Shui-bian government" now hold important positions under "Tsai Ing-wen." We believe that only by giving the Ma government another four years can the country have hope. In addition to the exquisite centenary National Day gifts, this party also prepared a sumptuous luncheon. Party members spontaneously brought delicious dishes. While enjoying the delicious food, everyone sang patriotic songs. Everyone gathered together to add beautiful memories to this centenary Mid-Autumn Festival. Finally, it ended successfully with shouts of Ma Ying-jeou's frozen garlic. 3fd0662d9cc407a662a079b8c85fa99e64c3fd87.translatedText: Take the first step in buying a home. Millions of people are buying a home every year. If you are like most Americans, then owning a home of your own...

052522f3c4f92099a94403380b398d44f81be25f.sourceText: 每年都有数百万的人在购买住宅，如果您也和大多数的美国人一样，那么拥有一户属于自己的住宅，一定是您心中的梦想。
052522f3c4f92099a94403380b398d44f81be25f.translatedText: Millions of people are buying a home every year. If you are like most Americans, then owning a home of your own must be your dream.

e8184171f3e4966bb924b81e83efa74f215c7486.sourceText: 在跨出购屋的第一步前，首先要了解自己能够负担什么价位的房屋，最简单的方法就是找一家贷款机构，预先取得自己的贷款资格，大多数的银行或贷款经纪人都会很乐意的告诉您，他们可以帮您取得的贷款额度。
e8184171f3e4966bb924b81e83efa74f215c7486.translatedText: Before taking the first step to buy a house, you must first know what price of a house you can afford. The easiest way is to find a lending institution and obtain your own loan qualifications in advance. Most banks or loan brokers will be happy to tell you the loan amount they can help you obtain.

9426427bb220bcd9b2c2778f006ad772939e661c.sourceText: 如果能够取得银行愿意核准贷款的证明(Pre-qualified或Pre-approved)，则对您顺利购屋有很大的帮助。 Pre-qualified和Pre-approved这两者的差别在于: 前者只是贷款银行对于您的收入、资产及负债等基本个人资料做一个大概评估，让您知道大概可以借到多少钱；后者则是您正式提出贷款申请，银行进一步根据您提供的文件证明，像是报税单、薪资单、银行月结单等等，并查核您的财务背景后，让您知道银行最多愿意借您多少钱。如果您能拿到银行的Pre-approved证明，当然是比Pre-qualified好。
9426427bb220bcd9b2c2778f006ad772939e661c.translatedText: If you can obtain proof that the bank is willing to approve the loan (Pre-qualified or Pre-approved), it will be of great help to your smooth purchase of a house. The difference between Pre-qualified and Pre-approved is that: the former is just a rough assessment by the lending bank of your basic personal information such as income, assets, and liabilities to let you know how much money you can borrow; the latter is when you formally apply for a loan, and the bank further relies on the documentary evidence you provide, such as tax returns, salary slips, bank statements, etc., and checks your financial background to let you know the maximum amount of money the bank is willing to lend you. If you can get a Pre-approved certificate from the bank, it is certainly better than Pre-qualified.

0a916d05ae1eeac4166ab218c8c6e990b81eca85.sourceText: 在了解了自己的购买能力之后，才能放心的去寻找自己梦想中的房屋，依照您家庭的需求选择如: 地区、需要几个房间、需要多大的呎数等等，在预算范围内选择生活机能方便的地区是很重要的，因为好区内的房子增值浅力高，抗跌性也佳，通常首次购屋者最容易犯的错误，就是喜欢选择大又漂亮的房子，而忽略了地点的重要性。
0a916d05ae1eeac4166ab218c8c6e990b81eca85.translatedText: After understanding your purchasing power, you can confidently find your dream house. Choose according to your family's needs such as: Area, how many rooms are needed, how many square feet are needed, etc., it is very important to choose an area with convenient living functions within the budget, because houses in good areas have higher value-added and better resistance to falling. Usually the most common mistake first-time home buyers make is to choose a large and beautiful house and ignore the importance of location.

cb6c686314fc997de0c55d1fa5a02d1c30b3e614.sourceText: 建议您选择一位服务亲切、诚实负责的房地产经纪人，来帮您寻找理想中的房屋，房地产经纪人通常有较多的资源，有些待售屋因为没有做好广告而被忽略了，房地产经纪人可以帮您做一个全面性的搜寻。如果您有任何房地产方面的问题，非常欢迎您打电话到我的专线(480) 612-4545 或email至Rich@RichLiao.com
cb6c686314fc997de0c55d1fa5a02d1c30b3e614.translatedText: It is recommended that you choose a real estate agent with friendly service, honesty and responsibility to help you find your ideal house. Real estate agents usually have more resources. Some houses for sale are ignored because they are not well advertised. Real estate agents can help you conduct a comprehensive search. If you have any questions about real estate, you are very welcome to call my hotline (480) 612-4545 or email to Rich@RichLiao.com

76dfe5c8b090411f27bf3a4459f0d9a6563bec48.sourceText: 作者简介：汪静玉，笔名王一冰，上世纪七十年代中期出生，14岁开始发表作品，17岁独自闯荡大江南北，18岁保送武汉大学中文系，2001年就读于武汉大学新闻学院研究生班。曾在《北京文学》、《青年文学》、《作家》、《芙蓉》等杂志上发表中短篇小说。作品多次被选刊转载和选入选本并多次获奖。著有诗集《青春的馈赠》、小说集《爱是绿叶》、《邂逅天堂的后窗》，出版长篇小说《天堂眼》、《夏天里最后一朵玫瑰》等9本书，其中《天堂眼》在全国引起较大的反响。2009年赴美。
76dfe5c8b090411f27bf3a4459f0d9a6563bec48.translatedText: About the author: Wang Jingyu, pen name Wang Yibing, was born in the mid-1970s. She began publishing works at the age of 14. She traveled all over the country alone at the age of 17. At the age of 18, she was recommended to the Chinese Department of Wuhan University. In 2001, she studied in the graduate class of the School of Journalism of Wuhan University. He has published short stories and short stories in magazines such as "Beijing Literature", "Youth Literature", "Writer", and "Furong". His works have been reprinted in selected journals and anthologies many times and won many awards. He is the author of the poetry collection "The Gift of Youth", the novel collection "Love is Green Leaves", and "The Rear Window of Encountering Heaven", and has published 9 books including the novel "Eye of Heaven" and "The Last Rose of Summer". Among them, "Eye of Heaven" has caused great repercussions across the country. Went to the United States in 2009.

ca23cb5d43c6951531017e7dea8205f4a65d7ef7.sourceText: 英国财政大臣乔治-奥斯本将于本周一宣布，英国将放宽对中国商务人士和游客的签证要求。
ca23cb5d43c6951531017e7dea8205f4a65d7ef7.translatedText: British Chancellor of the Exchequer George Osborne will announce on Monday that the UK will relax visa requirements for Chinese business people and tourists.

a20033bc24ea87302b322071233354aad3254bb7.sourceText: 数据表明，中国游客在英国人均消费高达1676英镑，为全球平均水平的三倍。2012年，中国游客在境外游上总共花费1020亿美元，已成为世界上最具有价值的游客。世界各国家吸引中国游客的竞争十分激烈，据了解，法国每年迎来的中国游客数量超过英国25%。
a20033bc24ea87302b322071233354aad3254bb7.translatedText: Data show that Chinese tourists spend up to 1,676 pounds per capita in the UK, which is three times the global average. In 2012, Chinese tourists spent a total of US$102 billion on overseas travel, making them the most valuable tourists in the world. Competition among countries around the world to attract Chinese tourists is fierce. It is understood that France welcomes 25% more Chinese tourists than the UK every year.

2390b28f3d480840155afe3b9a28583d485bcab2.sourceText: 将随同乔治-奥斯本出访的英国政府官员上周日表示，放宽签证要求的决定既具有象征性，又具有实质性意义。”商务人士普遍认为访英的签证制度比较困难。这个决定具有重大意义。我们希望向中国表示，我们欢迎他们的人民，也欢迎他们的投资。”该官员表示。
2390b28f3d480840155afe3b9a28583d485bcab2.translatedText: British government officials who will accompany George Osborne on his trip said on Sunday that the decision to relax visa requirements was both symbolic and substantive. "Business people generally believe that the visa system for visiting the UK is difficult. This decision is of great significance. We want to show China that we welcome their people and their investment," the official said.

68ad51118c78b7cc1c8d046acc4e4c5992d504a4.sourceText: 此前，英国零售商普遍对于中国游客的签证问题感到烦恼。他们抱怨，访英的繁琐手续正让他们失去这些社会地位日益上升的游客。
68ad51118c78b7cc1c8d046acc4e4c5992d504a4.translatedText: Previously, British retailers were generally worried about visa issues for Chinese tourists. They complain that the cumbersome procedures for visiting Britain are depriving them of these rising social status tourists.

65d0cb5d02dcaad1840688506b11ba69ff540a96.sourceText: 根据新的签证要求，中国商务人士将可申请24小时签发的优先签证，而不必再等待一周的时间。伦敦还将试行和其他欧洲国家联合的签证申请程序。
65d0cb5d02dcaad1840688506b11ba69ff540a96.translatedText: According to the new visa requirements, Chinese business people will be able to apply for priority visas issued 24 hours a day without having to wait a week. London will also trial a joint visa application process with other European countries.

2939a2dd053c10805528ba8c4c8dbe9c27ec9b6a.sourceText: 中国将买下全球？去年以来，除了中国对美国投资额首次超过美国对中国投资额外，中国在新兴市场和非洲、拉美的投资更令人侧目，特别是刚结束的亚太经合会(APEC)，中国力推「一带一路」，并成立400亿美元丝路基金，以及筹设亚洲基础设施投资银行等，大手笔的往外掏钱，「红色资本席捲全球」的说法不胫而走。
2939a2dd053c10805528ba8c4c8dbe9c27ec9b6a.translatedText: Will China buy the world? Since last year, for the first time, China's investment in the United States has surpassed the United States' investment in China. China's investment in emerging markets, Africa, and Latin America has attracted even more attention. Especially in the recently concluded Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC), China has vigorously promoted the "One Belt, One Road" initiative, established a US$40 billion Silk Road Fund, and established the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank. It has spent a lot of money abroad, and the saying that "red capital is sweeping the world" has spread like wildfire.

4a3f09f85b5b79c2f70a226b30379c0a3dfe77f9.sourceText: 根据美国商会今年4月一份报告，2013年中国对美国投资额已首次超过美国对中国投资额，这包括一系列有里程碑意义的中企在美并购案。
4a3f09f85b5b79c2f70a226b30379c0a3dfe77f9.translatedText: According to a report by the American Chamber of Commerce in April this year, China's investment in the United States exceeded the amount of U.S. investment in China for the first time in 2013, including a series of landmark mergers and acquisitions by Chinese companies in the United States.

c40380da1b07e9ecffb7df5e3dd2249f3640776a.sourceText: 此外，包括外媒关注的中国「高铁外交」，以及尚不太引人注目的核电、金融合作，新兴市场柬埔寨、缅甸、寮国等皆可见中资工程；更别说中国投资和中资公司已成为非洲和拉丁美洲的经济重要内容。
c40380da1b07e9ecffb7df5e3dd2249f3640776a.translatedText: In addition, including China's "high-speed rail diplomacy" that foreign media have focused on, as well as nuclear power and financial cooperation that have not attracted much attention, Chinese-funded projects can be seen in emerging markets such as Cambodia, Myanmar, and Laos; not to mention that Chinese investment and Chinese-funded companies have become an important part of the economies of Africa and Latin America.

23d5e2be1cd1aa115dc9b689a51df8d21f1f10d7.sourceText: 英国印度 接受中资

1b8199fa8869775190fc92c3686c49dd56c6bed5.sourceText: 一向态度高傲的欧洲也得低头。近年来中国资本积极参与欧洲基础设施建设，预计未来10年中国将大力投资英国基础设施。英国首相卡梅伦不得不说：「我们对中资持开放欢迎态度，这能够凸显双方经济优势。」此外，中国也和印度在9月敲定5年经贸合作计划，帮助印度升级老化的铁路系统等设施。
1b8199fa8869775190fc92c3686c49dd56c6bed5.translatedText: Europe, which has always had a proud attitude, must bow its head. In recent years, Chinese capital has actively participated in European infrastructure construction, and it is expected that China will invest heavily in British infrastructure in the next 10 years. British Prime Minister Cameron had to say: "We are open and welcoming to Chinese investment, which can highlight the economic advantages of both parties." In addition, China and India finalized a five-year economic and trade cooperation plan in September to help India upgrade its aging railway system and other facilities.

83b3616a5ddc1143f63edf1f75f1ef56e70ad4a4.sourceText: 中国的善行获得国际货币基金(IMF)赞许。IMF日前鼓励更多国家学习中国，投资基础建设改善财政，带动经济增长。
83b3616a5ddc1143f63edf1f75f1ef56e70ad4a4.translatedText: China’s good deeds have been praised by the International Monetary Fund (IMF). The IMF recently encouraged more countries to learn from China, invest in infrastructure, improve finances, and drive economic growth.

56aa8f4e0f28bde8fabb85e7396e8f71e80ed8a2.sourceText: 有外媒将中国大手笔「砸钱」的经援举措，比喻为二次大战后的「马歇尔计划」，不过分析人士说，中国的布局是深远的。「马歇尔计划是美国单向对欧洲实施，用以扩大美国影响力；而中国讲究双赢，中国的钱大部分花在丝路基金、金砖国家开发银行和亚洲基础设施投资银行，以带动更多国家」。
56aa8f4e0f28bde8fabb85e7396e8f71e80ed8a2.translatedText: Some foreign media have likened China's massive "spending money" economic aid measures to the "Marshall Plan" after World War II. However, analysts say that China's layout is far-reaching. "The Marshall Plan was a one-way implementation of the United States on Europe to expand American influence; China, on the other hand, values ​​win-win situations. Most of China's money is spent on the Silk Road Fund, the BRICS Development Bank and the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank to bring more countries together."

727a640810da3acbb2e53324e08c561a3a5e17f2.sourceText: 分析人士说，用通俗的话讲，中国的钱不是白给，虽然也不依靠这些钱来大赚一笔，但是仍属于商业行为。
727a640810da3acbb2e53324e08c561a3a5e17f2.translatedText: Analysts said that in layman's terms, China's money is not given in vain, and although it does not rely on the money to make a fortune, it is still a commercial behavior.

4efe855114604858dc412651fed270ea8b6a3f37.sourceText: （本网译）原定于十一月廿三日(星期六)，上午十时至下午三时在天庇市的 KIWAINS 公园内举行的大凤凰城侨联总会第三届秋游活动取消。侨联主席张华芳表示，因为周六是阴雨天气，为了让大家能有一个祥和健康的节日，侨联暂时取消此次活动，同时祝愿大家感恩节快乐。
4efe855114604858dc412651fed270ea8b6a3f37.translatedText: (Translated by this website) The third autumn outing of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Greater Phoenix, originally scheduled for November 23 (Saturday) from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. at KIWAINS Park in Tianpi City, has been cancelled. Zhang Huafang, chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, said that because of the rainy weather on Saturday, in order to allow everyone to have a peaceful and healthy holiday, the Overseas Chinese Federation has temporarily canceled this event and wishes everyone a happy Thanksgiving.

f7487dcd29b613acee7c56ad03c78ebebafcd5c5.sourceText: 几句珍语、胜读十年书 1、蜘蛛：能坐享其成，靠的就是那张关系网。 2、虾：大红之日，便是大悲之时。 3、天平：谁多给一点，就偏向谁。 4、瀑布：因居高临下，才口若悬河。 5、锯子：伶牙俐齿，专做离间行为。 6、气球：只要被人一吹，便飘飘然了。 7、钟表：可以回到起点，却已不是昨天。 8、核桃：没有华丽的外表，却有充实的大脑。 9、指南针：思想稳定，东西再好也不被诱惑。 10、花瓶：外表再漂亮，也掩不住内心的空虚。 11、树叶：得势时趾高气扬，失意时威风扫地。 12、历史的标点全是问号，历史的幕后全是惊叹号。 13、年轻人以为教育可以取代经验，年长者以为经验可以取代教育。 14、饭桌上批孩子，大人伤神，孩子伤胃，全家伤心。 15、 父母想念子女就像流水一样，一直在流; 而子女想念父母就像风吹树叶，风吹一下，就动一下，风不吹，就不动。 16、夫妻俩过日子要像一双筷子：一是谁也离不开谁; 二是什么酸甜苦辣都能一起尝。 17、挥不去的是记忆，留不住的是年华，拎不起的是失落，放不下的是情感，输不起的是尊严。 18、因为电话，信笺少了; 因为时尚，布料少了; 因为空调，汗水少了; 因为应酬，亲情少了; 因为宴会，食欲少了; 因为竞争，悠闲少了……
f7487dcd29b613acee7c56ad03c78ebebafcd5c5.translatedText: A few words are worth ten years of reading 1. Spider: Being able to enjoy the benefits depends on the network of relationships. 2. Shrimp: A red day is a time of great sorrow. 3. Balance: Whoever gives more will be favored. 4. Waterfall: Because it is condescending, it is eloquent. 5. Saw: Sharp-tongued and specialized in divisive behavior. 6. Balloons: As long as they are blown up, they will float away. 7. Clock: You can go back to the starting point, but it is no longer yesterday. 8. Walnut: Not gorgeous in appearance, but full of brains. 9. Compass: The mind is stable, and no matter how good things are, you will not be tempted. 10. Vase: No matter how beautiful it looks, it cannot hide the emptiness inside. 11. Leaves: When you are in power, you are arrogant, but when you are frustrated, your power is ruined. 12. The punctuation points of history are all question marks, and the behind-the-scenes of history are all exclamation points. 13. Young people think that education can replace experience, and older people think that experience can replace education. 14. If you criticize children at the dinner table, it will hurt the adults' spirits, hurt the children's stomachs, and make the whole family sad. 15. Parents miss their children like running water, which keeps flowing; while children miss their parents like leaves blown by the wind. When the wind blows, they move, but when the wind doesn't blow, they don't move. 16. Couples should live like a pair of chopsticks: firstly, no one can live without the other; secondly, they can taste all the sweet, sour, bitter and spicy together. 17. What cannot be shaken is memory, what cannot be retained is time, what cannot be carried is loss, what cannot be let go is emotion, what cannot be lost is dignity. 18. Because of phone calls, there is less letter paper; because of fashion, there is less fabric; because of air conditioning, there is less sweat; because of socializing, there is less family affection; because of banquets, there is less appetite; because of competition, there is less leisure...

fba49d4b02ba63fb2bf04ee5ffcafc775e5f77c5.sourceText: 图桑慧明：可以助军，也可以反战 每月总有那么一两次，这地方挂满美国国旗和彩旗，临街的矮墙张贴着各种各样的标语：”自由的土地需要你来保护”、”军队是国家的灵魂”，还有什么”你可以从此享受你的未来”充满感情色彩话语。不难判断，这里是本地的征兵站，今天又是招兵买马的日子了。 美国喜欢打仗，或者说不得不喜欢打仗。无论是推广民主的需要，还是利益所趋，还是报仇心切，都离不开武器军队和战士。前不久，硬是集十年之仇恨，从别国军方鼻子底下挖除了拉登，军方士气自然大振，所以这次招兵气势特别大，加上风助人势，胜利的旗帜哗哗飘扬，好不威风，气场真是很大。 过去那种拉壮丁式的招兵方式就显得落伍了。美国大学尽管也有现役军人，但招兵的人员基本上是不敢在学校露面的。但在高中招兵人员就经常在校门内外游说，招纳上大学经济有困难的学生，许诺多多，包括上大学的经费和以后的福利等等。但现在这种猥琐的招兵方式似乎过时了。 军队的支持者也随风而起，在征兵所的对面马路摇旗呐喊，”支持我们的军队””军队是我们的儿子”，甚至有人搬出了一战二战时著名的图片?#19968;个军人用手指着你，让你没有参军的念头都羞愧。 但就有不感到羞愧的人。 每次征兵所一开张，总有一伙反战团体与之同行，保持距离的站在对面或者并行。但手里的牌子和斜靠在路边的标语和前面是不同的。”NO WAR”是他们的主题，比如”战争不是解决问题的办法”、”和平是世界”等。比较含蓄和策略的是，反战者只唱对台戏，不直接指责军队。也有让人不得不动情的语言”你有过儿子吗？”一个老妇颤巍巍地举着这块分量不重的牌子。 但就是这一块牌子压得过往的车辆喘不过气来，让驾车者不由地动容。那减慢的车速和接二连三的喇叭声全送给了这位特殊的反战者。而那助军者，尽管满身披挂，穿他旧时妆，披我昔日勋，人们还是看过，一溜烟的走了。军人个体在美国是得到法律保护和舆论尊重的，但整体呢，人们基本上是对他们敬而远之的。 所以,各唱各的,互不干涉是双方共同遵守的底线，没有一方当面指责对方，也没有肢体接触，当然更没有警察干涉和进入法律程序什么的。征兵时间结束，双方收起各自的大旗，拜拜一声就算了结。因为大家都明白，改变一个人的观念比打一场战争还难。 如果一方反对伟大的军队长城，另一方举着大旗，唱着红歌，杀将过去，警察也来助兴，那就不是美国了。
fba49d4b02ba63fb2bf04ee5ffcafc775e5f77c5.translatedText: Tu Sang Huiming: You can help the army, or you can fight against the war. Once or twice a month, this place is decorated with American flags and colorful flags, and various slogans are posted on the low wall facing the street: "The land of the free needs you to protect", "The military is the soul of the country", and "You can enjoy your future from now on" full of emotional words. It is not difficult to judge that this is the local recruitment station, and today is another recruiting day. The United States likes to fight, or has to like to fight. Whether it is the need to promote democracy, the trend of interests, or the desire for revenge, weapons, armies and soldiers are inseparable. Not long ago, they gathered ten years of hatred and poached Bin Laden from under the noses of other countries' military forces. The morale of the military was naturally boosted, so the recruitment momentum was particularly strong this time. With the help of the wind, the flag of victory was fluttering. It was so majestic and powerful. The old way of recruiting soldiers seems outdated. Although there are active military personnel in American universities, the recruiters are basically afraid to show up on campus. But in high schools, recruiters often lobby inside and outside the school gates to recruit students who have financial difficulties in going to college. They make many promises, including funding for college and future benefits. But now this wretched way of recruiting seems outdated. Supporters of the military also followed the wind, waving flags and shouting on the road across from the recruitment office, "Support our army" and "The army is our son." Some even brought out the famous picture from World War I and World War II of a soldier pointing his finger at you, making you feel ashamed for not even thinking of joining the army. But there are people who are not ashamed. Every time a recruiting station opens, there is always a group of anti-war groups accompanying it, standing opposite or parallel to each other at a distance. But the sign in hand and the slogan leaning on the roadside are different from the one in front. "NO WAR" is their theme, such as "War is not the solution to problems", "Peace is the world", etc. What is more subtle and strategic is that the anti-war opponents only play opposite and do not directly accuse the military. There are also emotional words: "Have you ever had a son?" An old woman tremblingly held up this light sign. But it was this sign that overwhelmed the passing vehicles and made the motorists moved. The slowing down of the car and the continuous sound of horns were all dedicated to this special anti-war person. And even though the soldier who was helping the army was covered with robes, old-time makeup, and my past honors, people still looked at him and left in a flash. Individual military personnel are protected by law and respected by public opinion in the United States, but as a whole, people basically stay away from them. Therefore, everyone sings his own thing and non-interference is the bottom line that both parties abide by. No one party accuses the other party face to face, and there is no physical contact. Of course, there is no police intervention or legal proceedings. When the recruitment time is over, both sides put away their respective flags and say goodbye. Because everyone understands that changing a person's mindset is more difficult than fighting a war. If one side opposes the great military Great Wall, and the other side holds up big flags, sings red songs, kills generals, and the police also come to cheer, then it is not the United States.

86623c7b8c54398fafb18be0c7e643f11933389c.sourceText: 向南看 图森/皮马工资高 （亚省时报） 想要赚多点钱？你可以考虑申请图森市或皮马郡的工作了。 近日由图森媒体做了一份调查，发现该地区的年薪比亚利桑那州平均水准高。去年，图森市第1000个年薪最高的雇用赚取了72,411美元，比图森普通工人高37,000。同时，皮马郡年薪第1000高为63,258，比普通居民多赚了28,000美元。 相比该地区的类似社区，调查显示，图森市的工资比其他地区偏高。该市的消防员和警察工资也高于本州其他地区。 图森市长乔纳森罗斯柴尔德说，如果与外州其他大中城市相比，类似的工作，图森的工资水准显示不出优势。他说，城市很多高级职员的高工资与他们的高学历成正比。
86623c7b8c54398fafb18be0c7e643f11933389c.translatedText: Tucson/Pima wages are high (Alberta Times) Want to make more money? You may consider applying for jobs in Tucson or Pima County. A recent survey conducted by Tucson Media found that annual salaries in the area are higher than the Arizona average. Last year, Tucson's 1,000th highest-paid hire earned $72,411, 37,000 more than the average Tucson worker. Meanwhile, Pima County has the 1,000th-highest annual salary of $63,258, making $28,000 more than the average resident. Compared to similar communities in the area, surveys show that wages in Tucson are higher than other areas. The city also has higher salaries for firefighters and police officers than elsewhere in the state. Tucson Mayor Jonathan Rothschild said that if compared with other large and medium-sized cities outside the state for similar jobs, Tucson's salary level does not show an advantage. He said that the high salaries of many senior city employees are directly proportional to their high academic qualifications.

c60339ff62587950f4889777d2a5223972b6bb0e.sourceText: 记一支“大龄青年”演唱队 今年的华人国庆选美活动是近年来办得最热烈最成功的一次。无论是佳丽们的气质，表演和才华，还是专业舞蹈队伍的演出，都给人们耳目一新的感觉。在众多的表演中，报幕小姐唤出了一支平均年龄76岁的”大龄青年”演唱队,他（她）们的歌声在剧场中悠扬飘荡，把人们带进了辽阔的海洋，如痴如醉的美人鱼的故乡。当人们以热烈的掌声和欢呼声感谢他们的精彩演出时，有人不禁问起这些银发族的”大龄青年”是怎样练出这样专业演唱水平的。这一切需要从头说起。 凤凰城华人耆英会合唱团成立于2000年，这是老人们自娱自乐的组织，十来个喜爱唱歌的人凑在一起，唱一些年青时喜欢的歌，回忆往昔，舒发情怀。后来，经常在耆英中心的生日会和各种庆祝活动中演唱，丰富了老年人的文化生活，参与的人发展到60多人。近年来，他们在每年年初的春宴晚会上的演出引起了侨界的注意。大家希望他们能走出来为活跃侨社作些贡献。于是，他们开始在统一服装等方面作准备，合唱团的艺术指导曾丽卿借去北京旅游之际，自费为女合唱队员挑选和购置了服装，并开始在侨社庆祝中秋，庆祝国庆的晚会上演唱，逐步建立起了信心。 今年二月，国庆选美活动主席张华芳找到了曾丽卿，邀请耆英会合唱团参加选美会演出。这对耆英会合唱团来说，是一个很大的压力。这将是许多老人第一次走上舞台，有些虽在年轻时曾参加过业余演出，也是几十年前的事了。大家抱着重在参与的精神接受了这次演出任务。与往常的演出截然不同，这次演出不能有些微差错。为了便于练习，他们在合唱团中组织了一个小合唱表演队， 请来了在歌唱方面很有造诣的中文教师彭简女士作指导，开始了长达三个多月的训练。因为老师只有星期五晚上有空，他们就把排练时间按排在周五晚7-9点。许多老人改变了周末和子女团聚的按排，有时子女要老人回家帮忙，他们告诉子女，我星期五有事，一定要赶回去练唱。至于请我吃饭，那就改天吧。这样的事例不胜枚举。总之，这支队伍很有点自觉的纪律。晚上练唱选在纪念大厦，不会开车的就得有人接送，伍国芳，邓观寿，曾丽卿 担起了每次接送的任务。为了统一服装，大家趁节日减价出去采买。还有许多像我们的老团长惠炳华，指挥杜家华等一批默默为大家服务的义工。彭老师的训练也是从基础抓起。从每个字的发音到声部的合成，从走路的神态到脸部的表情，每个人都经历了一番脱胎换骨的训练。功夫不负有心人，三个月，上百遍的反复练唱，才唱出了今天的水平。老人们真正体验到”台上一分钟，台下十年功”的真谛。 当合唱队员们听到人们发自真心的赞赏，心中有无限的慰籍。他们对生命更充满了希望，对自己更充满了信心。歌唱家古雅瑜已提出和他们合作演出的建议，他们正准备着向下一个目标迈进。祝愿他们越活越年轻。
c60339ff62587950f4889777d2a5223972b6bb0e.translatedText: > Remembering an "older youth" singing team, this year's Chinese National Day beauty pageant is the most enthusiastic and successful one in recent years. Whether it is the temperament, performance and talent of the beauties, or the performance of the professional dance team, they all give people a refreshing feeling. Among the many performances, the announcer called out a singing team of "older youths" with an average age of 76. Their songs floated melodiously in the theater, bringing people into the vast ocean, the hometown of the mesmerizing mermaid. When people thanked them with warm applause and cheers for their wonderful performance, some people couldn't help but ask how these silver-haired "older youths" developed such professional singing skills. All this needs to be started from the beginning. The Phoenix Chinese Senior Citizens Choir was established in 2000. It is an organization for the elderly to entertain themselves. A dozen people who love singing get together to sing some songs they liked when they were young, recall the past, and relax their feelings. Later, he often sang at birthday parties and various celebrations at the Senior Citizen Center, enriching the cultural life of the elderly, and more than 60 people participated. In recent years, their performance at the Spring Festival Gala at the beginning of each year has attracted the attention of the overseas Chinese community. Everyone hopes that they can come forward and make some contributions to the active overseas Chinese community. As a result, they began to make preparations in terms of uniform clothing. When the choir's artistic director Zeng Liqing went to Beijing for a trip, she selected and purchased clothing for the female chorus members at her own expense, and began to sing at overseas Chinese communities to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival and celebrate the National Day, gradually building up their confidence. In February this year, Zhang Huafang, the chairman of the National Day Beauty Pageant, approached Zeng Liqing and invited the Senior Citizens' Association Choir to perform in the pageant. This is a great pressure for the Senior Citizens' Chorus. This will be the first time for many elderly people to take to the stage. Although some of them participated in amateur performances in their youth, it was decades ago. Everyone accepted this performance task with a spirit of participation. It is completely different from the usual performances, and there can be no slight mistakes in this performance. In order to facilitate practice, they organized a small choir performance team in the choir, invited Ms. Peng Jian, a Chinese teacher who is very accomplished in singing, to provide guidance and began more than three months of training. Since the teacher was only free on Friday night, they scheduled the rehearsal time for Friday night from 7 to 9 p.m. Many elderly people have changed their schedule for weekend reunions with their children. Sometimes their children ask the elderly to go home to help. They tell their children that I have something to do on Friday and must rush back to practice singing. As for inviting me to dinner, let’s leave it to another day. There are countless such examples. All in all, this team has a lot of self-discipline. In the evening, we chose to practice singing at the Memorial Building. Those who couldn't drive had to be picked up and dropped off. Wu Guofang, Deng Guanshou, and Zeng Liqing took on the task of picking up and dropping off each time. In order to unify the clothing, everyone went out to buy during the festival when prices were reduced. There are also many volunteers like our old team leader Hui Binghua and commanding Du Jiahua who serve everyone silently. Teacher Peng’s training also starts from the basics. From the pronunciation of each word to the synthesis of voices, from the way they walk to the expressions on their faces, everyone has gone through a whole new training. The hard work paid off. It took three months and hundreds of repeated singing exercises before I could sing at the level I am today. The elderly people truly experienced the true meaning of "one minute on stage, ten years of work off stage". When the chorus members heard people's sincere appreciation, they felt infinite comfort in their hearts. They are more hopeful about life and more confident in themselves. Singer Gu Yayu has proposed to perform with them, and they are preparing to move towards their next goal. I wish them to live younger and younger.

d5a3a7aba6673f260e1be72a3ccd4e5ba7abbdf7.sourceText: 上周三，亚利桑那州北部靠近大峡谷一带的一条高速公路主干线被浓烟笼罩，令驾驶人的能见度降至20 英尺左右，导致公路上发生多起交通事故。
d5a3a7aba6673f260e1be72a3ccd4e5ba7abbdf7.translatedText: Last Wednesday, a main highway in northern Arizona near the Grand Canyon was shrouded in thick smoke, reducing the visibility of drivers to about 20 feet, resulting in many traffic accidents on the highway.

f3f1400c68f0e2bd6e5f61dd009652863ba97173.sourceText: 据美联社报道，周二，在旗杆（Flagstaff）市附近的凯巴布国家森林（Kaibab National Forest）内，干燥的灌木丛和树木被人工点火。有关部门知道，通过一个晚上，因为风向转变，浓烟会飘向40 号州际公路。联邦林业局发言人史密斯（Brady Smith）说，令该局感到意外的是，森林火灾所产生的浓烟并没有如预期的那样消散。
f3f1400c68f0e2bd6e5f61dd009652863ba97173.translatedText: Dry brush and trees were set on fire Tuesday in the Kaibab National Forest near the city of Flagstaff, the Associated Press reported. Authorities know that over the course of a night, smoke can drift toward Interstate 40 as winds shift. Federal Forest Service spokesman Brady Smith said the agency was surprised that the smoke from the forest fires did not dissipate as expected.

66bfcb45572808b471a826a0ba66d70f156819bb.sourceText: 浓烟积聚在该高速公路上长达5 小时左右，在公路上酿成了多起撞车事故，多名驾驶人和乘客受了轻伤。为此，40 号高速公路被关闭了数小时，以防止发生更多车祸。
66bfcb45572808b471a826a0ba66d70f156819bb.translatedText: Thick smoke accumulated on the highway for about 5 hours, causing many crashes on the highway and causing minor injuries to many drivers and passengers. As a result, Highway 40 was closed for several hours to prevent further crashes.

74a17837eddcfeba57ceae00fb1e10ab166dcdc7.sourceText: 亚利桑那州公共安全厅（Arizona Department of Public safety） 发言人格雷福斯（Bart Graves）说，在黎明前，有一辆汽车被夹在两辆拖车之间，发生致命车祸。警方还无法立刻确定该车祸的肇因是否与能见度差有关。
74a17837eddcfeba57ceae00fb1e10ab166dcdc7.translatedText: Arizona Department of Public Safety spokesman Bart Graves said a fatal crash occurred before dawn when a car was wedged between two trailers. Police could not immediately determine whether poor visibility was the cause of the crash.

a849a42cfdf65762fab1ce6ac2a99f0f1b4623ae.sourceText: 点燃灌木丛的火是林业局放的。那种得到控制的点火在亚利桑那州颇为常见，因为林业管理人员希望通过人为放火来减少灌木和树木的密度，防止夏季出现严重森林野火。
a849a42cfdf65762fab1ce6ac2a99f0f1b4623ae.translatedText: The fire that ignited the bush was set by the Forestry Department. Controlled fires like that are common in Arizona as forest managers hope to reduce the density of shrubs and trees and prevent serious wildfires in the summer.

4a9000bcd8c09ffd7511373a72ad386379b4689c.sourceText: 人为放火所产生的烟雾常常成为居民和旅游者所不愿见到，因为他们常常会在一年中的这个时候涌往旗杆市观看秋天的落叶，但笼罩在上空的烟雾常常令人扫兴。
4a9000bcd8c09ffd7511373a72ad386379b4689c.translatedText: Smoke from man-made fires is often an undesirable sight for residents and tourists, who often flock to Flagstaff at this time of year to watch the fall leaves, but the haze hanging above is often a turn-off.

366acf0acda381b75f40fc5cfe3590c5a727605e.sourceText: 大峡谷地带的官员本星期发出警告：大峡谷北缘受控制的人工放火会在整个大峡谷上空产生烟雾。本月初，普雷斯科特（Prescott）一带的人工点火也让当地居民抱怨不止，因为浓烟导致空气品质变差。
366acf0acda381b75f40fc5cfe3590c5a727605e.translatedText: Grand Canyon officials warned this week that controlled fires on the north rim of the Grand Canyon could produce smoke throughout the canyon. Earlier this month, artificial fires in Prescott also caused local residents to complain because the thick smoke caused poor air quality.

6d8c669f50ea9102ef408b0b0e2f213b05af29c2.translatedText: [Phoenix Pen Club] Huiming: I have thoughts while I am relieved

9bd6e67ed6df3da8916222cb3cb2146f9889d3b8.sourceText: 【凤凰笔会】慧明：解气之余想 图桑 慧明 在马路左道上正常行驶着，猛地被右道一辆警车超出。斜眼一瞥速度表，…
9bd6e67ed6df3da8916222cb3cb2146f9889d3b8.translatedText: [Phoenix Pen Club] Huiming: I am relieved from my anger. Tucson Huiming was driving normally on the left lane of the road when he was suddenly overtaken by a police car on the right lane. A sideways glance at the speedometer revealed...

e1073e1f40df50a0d161ea4454f182f77faa1604.sourceText: 在马路左道上正常行驶着，猛地被右道一辆警车超出。斜眼一瞥速度表，兄弟按规矩出牌，没超过限速，一颗心放了下来。这警察事多，尽管前方没有他追逐的超速兔子，但警务在身，超速行驶也正常。正在替警察找超速的理由，呼地又从右道穿上一辆黑车，看看也就是一辆普通车，但此车胆特大，不但超速行驶，还超过左道的本人，进而狠追警车，在警车前逼停了警车。让人惊奇的是，这辆普通的车突然在内部亮起了警灯。
e1073e1f40df50a0d161ea4454f182f77faa1604.translatedText: was driving normally on the left lane of the road when he was suddenly overtaken by a police car on the right lane. A sideways glance at the speedometer revealed that the brother had followed the rules and did not exceed the speed limit, and felt relieved. This policeman has a lot on his plate. Even though there is no speeding rabbit ahead of him, the police officer is there and speeding is normal. While looking for excuses for speeding for the police, Hudi got into a black car from the right lane. It looked like an ordinary car, but this car was so bold that it not only speeded, but also passed him in the left lane. He then chased the police car fiercely and forced the police car to stop in front of it. Surprisingly, this ordinary car suddenly turned on its police lights inside.

e8c9f50393e013f3dd3acb38146407d598459580.sourceText: 正巧我到了购货中心，便很有兴趣地观察事态发展。那平常很耀武扬威，很张扬的警察叔叔老老实实地摇下了窗户，像我们平常被他抓住的模样，很沮丧的样子。只见前面的黑车上下来一个平常打扮穿制服的人，很平静地走到警车前，让警察出来—–不像我们必须坐在车里等待发落。看警察的热闹不敢太靠近，只是远远地听得，前方没有事故，你为什么超速等等。警察两手垂着，不像过去手放在枪上，好像很无辜很委屈的在辩解。看来警察遇到了他的克星—警务监察机构的人了。
e8c9f50393e013f3dd3acb38146407d598459580.translatedText: I happened to arrive at the shopping center and observed the development of the situation with great interest. The usually very arrogant and arrogant policeman rolled down the window, looking as frustrated as we usually do when he catches us. I saw a man in ordinary clothes and uniform getting out of the black car in front. He calmly walked to the police car and asked the police to come out - unlike us who had to sit in the car and wait for relief. I didn’t dare to get too close to see the police bustle. I just heard from a distance, “There’s no accident ahead, why are you speeding, etc.” The policeman's hands were hanging down, unlike before when he had his hands on his gun. He seemed to be defending innocently and aggrievedly. It looks like the cop has met his nemesis - the police watchdog.

6ed0892c69e970467712c27f8135307430c3198d.sourceText: 好呀，好呀，想不到你警察也有今天！兄弟满心的欢喜不敢在脸上流露，但心中充满了幸灾乐祸，往日自己的窝囊不堪回首的经历一一浮上心头：说后视镜上挂了个中国结影响我的驾驶视线，说我牌照灯灭了一个影响他的视线；大雨中别人撞了我逃走，警察还调侃说我车结实；说我为什么在小破车上挂一个名车的标牌显摆虚荣等等。虽然没拿到任何实质罚单，但收获一大堆影响心情的警告心里也不是味。
6ed0892c69e970467712c27f8135307430c3198d.translatedText: Okay, okay, I never thought you, the police, would be where you are today! The brother was filled with joy and did not dare to show it on his face, but his heart was full of schadenfreude, and his past experiences of being useless came to mind one by one: he said that a Chinese knot hanging on the rearview mirror affected my driving vision, that one of my license plate lights went out affected his vision; someone hit me and ran away in the heavy rain, and the police even joked that my car was strong; they said why I hung a famous car sign on a small shabby car to show my vanity, etc. Although I didn't get any actual fines, I was not happy to receive a lot of warnings that affected my mood.

4fd98c0b1a3753e70755dbd50b245f9e4b27b793.sourceText: 人往往是这样，看着别人特别是那些先前趾高气扬的人也倒霉了，自己心里便好过一点了。但解气之余倒也有了一点想法。这世界无论一个家庭还是一个社团，无论一个部门还是一个国家，无论你民主还是我一党两党，权力一大便容易独断和独裁，干出许多伤人心情，害己形象的事来，虽然他们都好像在维护次序和信条。如果没有制约和制衡机制，于家是家长制，于国便是专制了。警察被管很少碰见，但至少有人管说明这个国家还不至于无法无天。
4fd98c0b1a3753e70755dbd50b245f9e4b27b793.translatedText: People are often like this. Seeing others, especially those who were previously arrogant, suffer misfortune, makes you feel better. But while I was relieved, I also had some ideas. In this world, whether it is a family or a society, whether it is a department or a country, whether it is a democracy or a one-party or two-party movement, when one has power, it is easy to be arbitrary and authoritarian, and do many things that hurt people's feelings and harm one's own image, even though they all seem to be maintaining order and creed. If there is no check and balance mechanism, the Yu family will be patriarchal and the Yu country will be autocratic. It is rare to see the police being controlled, but at least someone is taking control of it, which shows that the country is not yet lawless.

China News Service, April 26. According to Australia's "Australian Daily" report, the Australian police have...

74fd8a310648227bf40d31ea252ba7692741c365.sourceText: 陆克文接到有关报告后，分别打电话给联邦移民部长宝文(Chris Bowen)和外交部副次长，还与中国驻澳大使陈育明及澳洲驻华大使孙芳安(Frances Adamson)，就此事进行沟通。
74fd8a310648227bf40d31ea252ba7692741c365.translatedText: After receiving the relevant reports, Kevin Rudd called Federal Immigration Minister Chris Bowen. Bowen and the Deputy Under-Secretary of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs also communicated with the Chinese Ambassador to Australia Chen Yuming and the Australian Ambassador to China Frances Adamson on this matter.

83e5de03e3fbb29f773c914ff26d2b96f9d1d707.sourceText: 他还通过电邮，向纽省警察提出这一案件。
83e5de03e3fbb29f773c914ff26d2b96f9d1d707.translatedText: He also raised the case with the New Provincial Police via email.

371886d91adae84c447882b8c98b3f3a31b572a8.sourceText: 陆克文通过中文微博说：”我极其厌恶种族主义，保护留学生的安全应为我们最基本的责任。”
371886d91adae84c447882b8c98b3f3a31b572a8.translatedText: Rudd said via Chinese Weibo: "I extremely hate racism, and protecting the safety of international students should be our most basic responsibility."

f5eeeb21ebdbccffb8d26b0106ce75d281e2f5d7.sourceText: 但他也力图淡化这次袭击事件的种族主义彩色，指称袭击和抢劫并非专门针对中国人。他称”除了两名中国学生外，其它人也遭抢劫，袭击并非专门针对中国人。”
f5eeeb21ebdbccffb8d26b0106ce75d281e2f5d7.translatedText: However, he also tried to downplay the racist nature of the attack, claiming that the attacks and robberies were not specifically targeted at Chinese people. He said, "In addition to two Chinese students, others were also robbed. The attack was not specifically targeting Chinese people."

3096c7c03ec71a90ea916bcb0ca2c59a6a2a29f7.sourceText: 陆克文已邀请中国学生与他分享在澳洲的学习经历。
3096c7c03ec71a90ea916bcb0ca2c59a6a2a29f7.translatedText: Rudd has invited Chinese students to share their study experience in Australia with him.

f584ce0c95eaa20f0bac3f9756677e54aeedd0cd.sourceText: 对两位中国学生遭暴力抢劫袭击事件的报道，已超出中国大陆范围，传到马来西亚、新加坡和香港。
f584ce0c95eaa20f0bac3f9756677e54aeedd0cd.translatedText: Reports on the violent robbery and attack on two Chinese students have spread beyond mainland China to Malaysia, Singapore and Hong Kong.

10a1bf19e27ab48df21d71078be1ce7fb54dab45.sourceText: 陆克文的减少不良影响行动似乎产生积极效果，许多学生赞扬这位前总理并感谢就此事提交澳洲各有关部门要求处理。(南峦)
10a1bf19e27ab48df21d71078be1ce7fb54dab45.translatedText: > Rudd's actions to reduce the negative impact seem to have a positive effect, with many students praising the former prime minister and thanking the relevant Australian departments for bringing the matter to the table. (Nanluan)

787e365303d8a7a32566283fab45bbfa64295dd4.sourceText: 据国外媒体报道，这是一个令人眼花缭乱的交配舞会，每年吸引成千上万游客前来观看。热爱大自然的人们在一条名为埃尔克蒙特的小道上漫步，观赏无数萤火虫上演”?#28783;光秀”。这样的经历是一种精神享受。埃尔克蒙特是一条通往大雾山国家公园的小道。
787e365303d8a7a32566283fab45bbfa64295dd4.translatedText: According to foreign media reports, this is a dazzling mating dance that attracts thousands of tourists every year. Nature lovers stroll along a trail called Elkmont to watch countless fireflies put on a "?#28783; light show." Such an experience is a spiritual enjoyment. Elkmont is a trail leading into the Great Smoky Mountains National Park.

d90bea42ee26b4b7c1706b84381d6cebda429ed9.sourceText: 每年6月的两周内，这些甲虫闪着亮光在空中飞行，构成一道惊人风景线。这场光的展示秀把森林变成詹姆斯-卡梅隆科幻片《阿凡达》中的场景。美国国家公园管理局说，这些萤火虫成年后只能存活21天，靠生物发光诱捕猎物和吸引配偶。
d90bea42ee26b4b7c1706b84381d6cebda429ed9.translatedText: For two weeks every June, these beetles fly in the sky with bright lights, forming an amazing scenery. This display of light transforms the forest into a scene from James Cameron's science fiction film "Avatar." The National Park Service says these fireflies can only live for 21 days as adults and rely on their bioluminescence to trap prey and attract mates.

e0816bbd637b013bcc836325b116ef742d00ea4b.sourceText: 每种萤火虫都有可以辨认的典型闪光模式。雄萤火虫一边飞舞一边闪光，不动的雌性用阵阵闪光作出回应。它们在5月底到6月中旬间的两周内最活跃。美国北卡罗来纳州的丹尼尔-卡尔森对《纽约时报》说：”它使人产生幻觉，就像是无声的交响乐。这是怎么了？怎么会这样？我们什么也不知道。”
e0816bbd637b013bcc836325b116ef742d00ea4b.translatedText: Each type of firefly has a recognizable typical flash pattern. The male fireflies flash as they fly, and the immobile females respond with bursts of flashes. They are most active during the two weeks between late May and mid-June. Daniel Carlson of North Carolina, USA, told the New York Times: "It makes people hallucinate, like a silent symphony. What's going on? How could this happen? We don't know anything."

After your house purchase contract is established, what should you pay attention to while waiting for the house to be handed over? The following points are required...

fcd9ccedffccb3fd38854cb4d198caeff189f4bc.sourceText: 要交屋了 欢喜之时如下事项可别忘 当您的购屋合约成立之后，在等待交屋的过程中要注意些什么呢？有以下几点是需要注意的。 最重要的一点是要维持好自己的贷款资格，通常银行在交屋之前，会再查一次您的信用报告，看看是否还符合贷款条件，您的信用分数是否降低到不符合贷款的标准。要避免做一些让信用分数降低的行为，例如：贷款买车、信用卡欠款增加太多、申请其它贷款等等，诸如此类的行为都会拉低您的信用分数，导致银行改变贷款条件，甚至不提供贷款。 再来，不要忘了通知相关单位您既将搬家，将会有新的地址，像是： 杂志及报纸公司、电话公司、水电公司、往来银行、信用卡公司等等，请他们把您的档案数据更改到新地址，更要记得向邮局声请邮件转寄服务，到邮局内或邮局网站 ( www.usps.com ) 填申请表，可以向邮局指定几月几日起，某某人的邮件要转寄到某地址，此项服务是免费的，邮局会代转邮件一年。 还有要把购屋头期款准备好，通常在签约交屋当天，您必须将头期款及其他交屋费用以银行保付支票 (Cashier抯 Check) 或银行电汇 (Wire Transfer) 的方式放到委托保管账户 (Escrow)，所以记得签约交屋之前先到银行办理。 最后，交屋前要对您所购买的房屋做一次最后的检查，从头到尾、从上到下，再彻底的看一遍，看看各项设备是否运作正常，像是电源插座、水电开关、家电用品是否运转等等，如果购买的是新建屋，要把尚未完成或必须修理的东西记下来，先约定好完成或修复的日期，请建商的代表签名，如果购买的是二手屋，要确定之前约定好必须修复、必须清理的东西都已完成，答应留下来、包含在购买合约里的事项都还在。以上简单说明交屋前该注意事项，如果您有任何房地产方面的问题，非常欢迎您打电话到我的专线 (480) 612-4545 或 email至 Rich@RichLiao.com
fcd9ccedffccb3fd38854cb4d198caeff189f4bc.translatedText: It’s time to hand over the house. When you are happy, don’t forget the following things. After your house purchase contract is established, what should you pay attention to while waiting for the house to be handed over? There are the following points that need to be noted. The most important thing is to maintain your loan qualifications. Usually, before handing over a house, the bank will check your credit report again to see if you still meet the loan conditions and whether your credit score has dropped to the point where you do not meet the loan standards. Avoid doing things that lower your credit score, such as taking out a car loan, increasing your credit card balance too much, applying for other loans, etc. Such actions will lower your credit score and cause the bank to change loan conditions or even not provide a loan. Next, don’t forget to notify the relevant units that you are moving and will have a new address, such as: magazine and newspaper companies, telephone companies, water and electricity companies, banks, credit card companies, etc., and ask them to change your file data to the new address. Also remember to apply for mail forwarding service from the post office, go to the post office or the post office website (www.usps.com) By filling out the application form, you can specify the date and month from which someone's mail should be forwarded to a certain address. This service is free, and the post office will forward the mail for one year. You also need to prepare the down payment for purchasing a house. Usually on the day you sign the contract and hand over the house, you must deposit the down payment and other house closing costs into an escrow account (Escrow) in the form of a cashier's check or bank wire transfer, so remember to go to the bank before signing the contract and handing over the house. Finally, before handing over the house, you should do a final inspection of the house you purchased. Look through it from beginning to end, top to bottom, to see if all the equipment is functioning properly, such as power sockets, water and electricity switches, household appliances, etc. Write down the things that have been completed or must be repaired, agree on the date of completion or repair, and ask the builder's representative to sign. If you are buying a second-hand house, make sure that all the things that have been agreed to be repaired and cleaned have been completed, and all the items that were promised to be kept and included in the purchase contract are still there. The above briefly explains what you should pay attention to before handing over a house. If you have any questions about real estate, you are very welcome to call my hotline (480) 612-4545 or email to Rich@RichLiao.com

1686350541680419157b44fef5180a078757d5bb.sourceText: 爆笑名句 张肇鸿 树多必有枯枝，人多必有白痴。 君子报仇，三年不晚。小人报仇，一天到晚。 帅有个屁用！到头来还不是被卒吃掉。 骑白马的不一定是王子，可能是唐僧；带翅膀的不一定是天使，也可能是「鸟人」。 就算是 Believe 中间还是有个 lie。 就算是 Friend 最后还是会有个 end。 就算是 Lover 最后还是会 over。 就算是 Forget 也要先 get 才行。 就算有个 Wife 心里也要假设 if。 树不要皮，必死无疑。人不要脸，天下无敌。 怀才就像怀孕，时间久了才能让人看出来。 客户是神，因为客户不是人。 前程四紧就是：手头紧、眉头紧、衣服紧、时间紧。 青春就像卫生纸。看着挺多的，用着用着就不够了。 幸福离我们很近，但是我们都忘了靠近。 能者多劳，疲劳的劳！ 男人过了五十岁只剩下一张嘴，过了六十岁就只有两个地方会变硬：肩膀硬跟肝硬 福利不是问题，问题是没福利。钱不是问题，问题是没钱。 今日事今日毕，过了今日就不必。
1686350541680419157b44fef5180a078757d5bb.translatedText: Funny quotes Zhang Zhaohong: When there are many trees, there are dead branches, and when there are many people, there are idiots. A gentleman's revenge is never too late. The villain takes revenge all day long. Being handsome is useless! In the end, he was not eaten by pawns. The one riding the white horse may not be a prince, but may be Tang Monk; the one with wings may not be an angel, but may also be a "birdman". Even Believe still has a lie in the middle. Even Friend will have an end in the end. Even Lover will eventually over. Even if it is Forget, it must be obtained first. Even if there is a Wife, I still have to assume if. If a tree doesn't need bark, it will surely die. If a person is shameless, he is invincible. Being pregnant is like being pregnant. It takes a long time for people to see it. Customers are gods because customers are not human beings. The four shortcomings of the future are: money is tight, brow is tight, clothes are tight, and time is tight. Youth is like toilet paper. It seems like there are quite a lot of them, but once I use them, it’s not enough. Happiness is very close to us, but we have forgotten to get closer. Those who are able work harder, those who are tired work harder! After the age of fifty, a man will only have one mouth. After the age of sixty, only two places will become hard: hard shoulders and cirrhosis of the liver. Welfare is not the problem, the problem is the lack of welfare. Money is not the problem, the problem is lack of money. Today's things are done today, and there is no need after today.
