f8f61c4cfd9ff0dc03144050993260a13885ee78.translatedText: >An advocate for freedom of speech outside the Guangzhou headquarters of Southern Weekend on Tuesday.

8171d284e6c4937d90547722c5b8b9947b303b62.sourceText: 南方报争演变成意识形态冲突
8171d284e6c4937d90547722c5b8b9947b303b62.translatedText: Southern newspaper dispute turns into ideological conflict

bd36d2af0373c04dc4cc9cc8b130d1f041e631a5.sourceText: 更新：周三早晨中国社交媒体网站新浪微博上广泛流传一则消息，《新京报》社社长戴自更前一天晚上因是否转载《环球时报》此前攻击《南方周末》的一篇社论而与宣传官员发生争执。周三出版的《新京报》最终刊出了这篇社论，该报几位记者证实，戴自更对此不满。
bd36d2af0373c04dc4cc9cc8b130d1f041e631a5.translatedText: Update: According to a widely circulated news on Chinese social media site Sina Weibo on Wednesday morning, Beijing News chief Dai Zigeng had argued with propaganda officials the night before over whether to reprint a Global Times editorial attacking Southern Weekend. The Beijing News, which was published on Wednesday, finally published the editorial, and several reporters from the newspaper confirmed that Dai was dissatisfied with it.

5adb5bd85fade661b28c4d08c0532444cf4bf78d.sourceText: 另外，微博上也流传，《南方周末》编辑记者已与宣传官员达成初步协议，后者允诺将给《南方周末》更多编辑自主权，但目前尚不清楚协议的细节。
5adb5bd85fade661b28c4d08c0532444cf4bf78d.translatedText: In addition, it was also circulated on Weibo that the editors and reporters of Southern Weekend had reached a preliminary agreement with propaganda officials, and the latter promised to give Southern Weekend more editorial autonomy, but the details of the agreement are currently unclear.

32c4cd77776fe680eb6c3a8400a6b082047daade.sourceText: 一名记者在接受采访时表示，周四报纸将正常出版。”明天的报纸还是会出版，宣传部明天还要和工作人员会谈，”这名记者在匿名的前提下说。另外几名记者则表示，协议的细节目前尚不清楚。
32c4cd77776fe680eb6c3a8400a6b082047daade.translatedText: A reporter said in an interview that the newspaper will be published normally on Thursday. "Tomorrow's newspaper will still be published, and the Propaganda Department will have meetings with staff tomorrow," the reporter said on condition of anonymity. Several other reporters said the details of the agreement were unclear.

77615b2a9ea33dc495fe92123e9818b5bfc4b46a.sourceText: 中国广州棗周二，中国一家自由派色彩居于前列的报纸因遭到审查而起的抗议活动在这个南方省会降格为意识形态冲突，倡导言论自由的人士与挥舞着红旗和毛泽东画像的共产党统治支持者形成了对峙。
77615b2a9ea33dc495fe92123e9818b5bfc4b46a.translatedText: Guangzhou, China Protests over censorship of one of China's most liberal newspapers degenerated into an ideological clash in the southern provincial capital on Tuesday, pitting free speech advocates against supporters of Communist rule waving red flags and portraits of Mao Zedong.

9c706106a6e3ca60140f150ae80d0170de9192ea.sourceText: 自由派和左派在发行《南方周末》的公司总部外发生对峙，起因是该报一些心有不甘的记者和编辑上周痛切 抗议 ，广东省宣传部门的负责人对他们的工作进行了粗暴干涉。之前，广东一直被认为是言论相对自由的堡垒而享有声誉。
9c706106a6e3ca60140f150ae80d0170de9192ea.translatedText: A confrontation broke out between liberals and leftists outside the headquarters of the company that publishes Southern Weekend, after some of the paper's unwilling reporters and editors bitterly protested last week against gross interference in their work by the head of Guangdong's propaganda department. Guangdong has previously had a reputation as a bastion of relatively free speech.

4d305110df940e2f526571c3b6328cd7b6d9aa89.sourceText: 随着大量名人和商界领袖以自由之名在网上集结，北京的高级宣传官员本周展开了妖魔化自由派记者及其支持者的全国性攻势。中宣部向各新闻机构发出了一项指令，称《南方周末》的强烈反抗有”境外敌对势力”的介入。
4d305110df940e2f526571c3b6328cd7b6d9aa89.translatedText: Beijing's top propaganda officials this week launched a nationwide campaign to demonize liberal journalists and their supporters, as scores of celebrities and business leaders rallied online in the name of freedom. The Propaganda Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a directive to all news organizations, saying that Southern Weekend's strong resistance was caused by the involvement of "hostile foreign forces."

46477e30d54943d52db08d5bfce132b5d1f54d20.sourceText: 中宣部的指令还要求中国记者不得继续支持《南方周末》，并坚称”党管媒体是不可动摇的基本原则”。该指令由研究中国新闻媒体的加州大学伯克利分校(University of California, Berkeley)”中国数字时代”(China Digital Times)研究小组翻译成英文。
46477e30d54943d52db08d5bfce132b5d1f54d20.translatedText: The directive from the Central Propaganda Department also requires Chinese journalists not to continue to support Southern Weekend and insists that "the party's control of the media is an unshakable basic principle." The directive was translated into English by the China Digital Times research group at the University of California, Berkeley, which studies Chinese news media.

9489f9d6909f22363f7b408877cde703ae6d02fe.sourceText: 某党媒编辑称， 与一名高级编辑就《南方周末》冲突进行的内部讨论中出现了”敌对势力”一词。广东之外的数名中国记者周二称，《南方周末》那些心怀不满的记者和编辑似乎不一定能得到好的结局，而他们要求罢免广东省委宣传部长庹震的呼吁很可能过于激进，上级部门无法接受。庹震于去年5月成为广东省宣传部门的负责人。
9489f9d6909f22363f7b408877cde703ae6d02fe.translatedText: A party media editor said that the term "hostile forces" appeared in an internal discussion with a senior editor on the conflict at Southern Weekend. Several Chinese journalists outside Guangdong said on Tuesday that disgruntled Southern Weekend reporters and editors seemed unlikely to end well, and that their call to oust Tuo Zhen, Guangdong's propaganda chief, was likely too radical to be accepted by higher authorities. Tuo Zhen became the head of Guangdong Provincial Propaganda Department in May last year.

f1a2a0ebe394298dd1c7c5ad2953b3d015c98eee.sourceText: 庹震本人也曾是一名记者。起而抗议的《南方周末》记者指责，该报的新年献词本来是要呼吁对宪法权利予以更大的尊重，但庹震下令对其进行了大幅改动。修改后的社评变成了对党的政策的赞扬。庹震尚未发表任何评论。
f1a2a0ebe394298dd1c7c5ad2953b3d015c98eee.translatedText: Tuo Zhen himself was a journalist. Journalists from Southern Weekend, who protested, accused the newspaper of having its New Year's message called for greater respect for constitutional rights, but Tuo Zhen ordered it to be significantly altered. The revised editorial became a praise of the party's policies. Tuo Zhen has yet to comment.

accf4d752f1d535f5cdfe2d2499afd2e97570bc1.sourceText: 《南方周末》所属的南方报业集团的一名前编辑称，省级宣传官员与该报不满记者及管理人员的代表周二继续进行了谈判。
accf4d752f1d535f5cdfe2d2499afd2e97570bc1.translatedText: Negotiations between provincial propaganda officials and representatives of disgruntled journalists and managers at the paper continued on Tuesday, said a former editor at the Southern Newspaper Group, which owns Southern Weekend.

33320f103540d9bcd3b9b2c4f124433de7bf8acb.sourceText: 这名前编辑因担心目前的工作受到威胁而要求匿名。他说，谈判的焦点是参与抗议的记者提出的两点要求，一是对新年献词事件进行调查，二是报纸管理层收回庹震与社评无关的声明。
33320f103540d9bcd3b9b2c4f124433de7bf8acb.translatedText: The former editor requested anonymity because he feared his current job would be in jeopardy. He said that the focus of the negotiations was on two demands made by journalists participating in the protest. One was to investigate the New Year's speech incident, and the other was that the newspaper management retract Tuo Zhen's statement that it had nothing to do with editorial.

e1464357931136b629ee4aebd70b4a6f0792b23e.sourceText: ”他们要求撤销声明，还要官方保证放松对记者的限制。不是要求脱离党的监管，而是要求监管更合理，允许记者反对官员，”他说，”另一项主要要求是要对之前发生的事情进行公正的解释，彻查此事以免重演。”
e1464357931136b629ee4aebd70b4a6f0792b23e.translatedText: "They are demanding a retraction of the statement and official assurances that restrictions on journalists will be relaxed. They are not asking for separation from the party's supervision, but for more reasonable supervision and allowing journalists to oppose officials," he said. "The other main demand is for a fair explanation of what happened before and a thorough investigation to avoid a recurrence."

70c1e5f6af006ffd7029360978987bb2301c9672.sourceText: 这名前编辑还称，如果僵局持续到周三，可能会影响该报周四的正常发行。他说，”实际上，这就是罢工。周四能不能出版还不清楚。”
70c1e5f6af006ffd7029360978987bb2301c9672.translatedText: The former editor also said that if the standoff continues into Wednesday, it may affect the newspaper's normal circulation on Thursday. He said, "Actually, this is a strike. It is not clear whether it can be published on Thursday."

2d6d30d16e2872617ee02e343ca010900562d629.sourceText: 到目前为止，中国高层官员还没有公开对该报的审查纠纷发表意见。这一纠纷可以检验，新上任的中共最高领导人习近平在支持更开放经济和政治政策的道路上能走多远。”我认为，习近平关于改革的言论并不都是虚伪的，” 原《南方周末》著名评论员陈敏说。2011年，陈敏在中共镇压潜在异见分子的行动中被迫离开南周。
2d6d30d16e2872617ee02e343ca010900562d629.translatedText: So far, senior Chinese officials have not publicly expressed their opinions on the newspaper's censorship dispute. The dispute could test how far China's new top leader, Xi Jinping, can go in favoring more open economic and political policies. "I don't think Xi Jinping's remarks on reform are all hypocritical," said Chen Min, a former well-known commentator on Southern Weekend. In 2011, Chen Min was forced to leave Southern Zhou during the CCP's crackdown on potential dissidents.

0dd093ad55660bfda3b21979c75c1a0f90134c61.sourceText: 周二，共产主义正统思想的卫道者出现在了该报总部，为中共对媒体的严格控制进行辩护。
0dd093ad55660bfda3b21979c75c1a0f90134c61.translatedText: Defenders of communist orthodoxy showed up at the newspaper's headquarters on Tuesday to defend the party's tight control of the media.

d9fad8da86443b65108b71b7f41f3cada464d5d8.sourceText: ”支持共产党，关闭卖国报，”十人左右的保守派示威者中有人高举着这样的标语牌。
d9fad8da86443b65108b71b7f41f3cada464d5d8.translatedText: "Support the Communist Party, shut down the traitorous newspapers," one of the ten conservative demonstrators held high a placard.

21e9cf098b190b60ca10007416f273d89d371e4a.sourceText: ”《南方周末》心怀美国梦，”另一个标语这样写道。”我们不要美国梦，我们要中国梦”。
21e9cf098b190b60ca10007416f273d89d371e4a.translatedText: "Southern Weekend embraces the American dream," read another slogan. "We don't want the American dream, we want the Chinese dream."

4394ce5e608bd4272e03cd2998ccbf58c171c3e5.sourceText: 大多数中共支持者拒绝透露自己的姓名。来自湖南省的杨兴发（音译）透露了自己的姓名，并且说，”《南方周末》属于人民。但是，该报总是忽略中国共产党的功绩，总是问中国为什么不能更像美国。实在无耻！”
4394ce5e608bd4272e03cd2998ccbf58c171c3e5.translatedText: Most CCP supporters refused to reveal their names. Yang Xingfa (transliteration) from Hunan Province revealed his name and said, "Southern Weekend belongs to the people. However, the newspaper always ignores the achievements of the Chinese Communist Party and always asks why China can't be more like the United States. It's so shameless!"

aebd4da08f97081b919b1ee11cdcb0949ef143af.sourceText: 一些参与者举着毛泽东的画像；其他一些人则挥舞着国旗和党旗。他们表示，他们的行为是自发的，并不是官方的要求。
aebd4da08f97081b919b1ee11cdcb0949ef143af.translatedText: Some participants held up portraits of Mao Zedong; others waved national and party flags. They said their actions were spontaneous and not officially requested.

1fb3d20b2ca1d7a0e341313a37c57a2a019fe158.sourceText: 该报总部大楼外的两派对峙局面反映了这起审查纠纷引发的激烈政治情绪和张力。互联网上掀起了关于此事的广泛讨论，寻找僵局的解决方案则成为了中央政府和胡春华面临的一大挑战，后者是新任的广东省委书记，并有可能在十年后接替习近平。
1fb3d20b2ca1d7a0e341313a37c57a2a019fe158.translatedText: The confrontation between the two groups outside the newspaper's headquarters reflects the intense political emotions and tensions triggered by the censorship dispute. The matter has been widely discussed on the Internet, and finding a solution to the impasse has become a challenge for the central government and Hu Chunhua, the new party secretary of Guangdong and the likely successor to Xi Jinping in a decade.

c99b77e5761232652c5fefb229d12da6427475ff.sourceText: 左派抗议者向20多名谴责审查的抗议者叫阵，双方之间出现推攘，数百名路人在旁观看，并用手机拍摄现场的情景。在场的约70名警察和安保人员大多数时候只是旁观，偶尔才会出手把双方人员拉开。
c99b77e5761232652c5fefb229d12da6427475ff.translatedText: Left-wing protesters called out to more than 20 protesters who denounced censorship. There were shoving and scuffles between the two sides. Hundreds of passers-by looked on and filmed the scene with their mobile phones. The approximately 70 police and security personnel present mostly just watched, occasionally taking action to pull people from both sides apart.

a2dbebffa9c18984cf7b511001764a4abfa32856.sourceText: 对抗之中，一度有人向左派抗议者抛洒面值五毛的纸币（价值约8美分）。”五毛党”一词被广泛用来讽刺亲党的左派分子。批评者称，”五毛党”在网上发一个支持党的帖子就能获得五毛钱的报酬。
a2dbebffa9c18984cf7b511001764a4abfa32856.translatedText: During the confrontation, someone threw 50-cent banknotes (worth about 8 cents) at leftist protesters. The term "50 Cent Party" is widely used to mock pro-party leftists. Critics say that the "50 Cent Party" can be paid 50 cents for posting a post supporting the party online.

ae532bfd66690807a8ab8aba5f4f15e4277cc09f.sourceText: 《南方周末》记者的支持者之一是28岁的诗人梁太平，他戴着因好莱坞电影和英国漫画《V字仇杀队》(V for Vendetta)而流行的面具。他说，他在官方媒体中央电视台上看到了这部电影，之后就买了这个面具。让很多中国人惊讶的是，这部电影提倡推翻一党专政，电视台却居然没有对该电影进行删节。
ae532bfd66690807a8ab8aba5f4f15e4277cc09f.translatedText: One of the supporters of the Southern Weekend reporter is the 28-year-old poet Liang Taiping, who wears a mask popularized by Hollywood movies and the British comic "V for Vendetta". He said he bought the mask after seeing the film on state broadcaster China Central Television. To the surprise of many Chinese, TV stations did not cut out the film, which advocates overthrowing one-party rule.

05d4d98c0e6b54958a948adf71a5b1570ff169b2.sourceText: ”《南方周末》是中国唯一一家愿意说出真相的报纸，”梁太平说。他补充说，自己是从将近500英里之外的长沙坐火车来此表示支持的。”没有言论自由，活着还有什么意义？”
05d4d98c0e6b54958a948adf71a5b1570ff169b2.translatedText: "Southern Weekend is the only newspaper in China that is willing to tell the truth," Liang Taiping said. He added that he came by train from Changsha, nearly 500 miles away, to express his support. "Without freedom of speech, what's the point of living?"

34b35a02fff931723c78a3915b4c3dd6b44863f3.sourceText: 《纽约时报》驻京记者黄安伟(Edward Wong)自广州、储百亮(Chris Buckley)自香港报道。Jonah M. Kessel自广州、安思乔(Jonathan Ansfield)自北京对本文有报道贡献。Mia Li自广州对本文有研究贡献。
34b35a02fff931723c78a3915b4c3dd6b44863f3.translatedText: "New York Times" Beijing correspondent Edward Wong reported from Guangzhou and Chris Buckley from Hong Kong. Jonah M. Kessel contributed reporting from Guangzhou and Jonathan Ansfield from Beijing. Mia Li contributed research to this article from Guangzhou.

17f88cd0ee7c54a222025f922187ba391288ee77.sourceText: 了解房地产开发流程的好机会 海通工程公司于1月17日在其钻石吧市办公室成功地举办了第一期房地产开发流程讲座…
17f88cd0ee7c54a222025f922187ba391288ee77.translatedText: A good opportunity to understand the real estate development process Haitong Engineering Company successfully held the first real estate development process lecture at its Diamond Bar City office on January 17th...

7aea3a0b10ac4d4e02386a51c0a65f975e5c2c77.sourceText: 海通工程公司于1月17日在其钻石吧市办公室成功地举办了第一期房地产开发流程讲座，讲座现场座无虚席，积极互动，气氛热烈；原计划十五人的讲座，实际报名三十人， 五人因实在坐不下，不得不安排到2月21日第二期讲座。李江博士以其渊博的理论知识及丰富的经验介绍了房地产开发流程， 让参与者了解到Land Entitlement（土地开发权），土地开发权的价值，土地开发权的种类以及土地开发全过程。商业和住宅开发，别墅兴建涉及土地开发权复杂的法规和程序，海通工程举办免费房地产开发权系列讲座为有意开展房地产开发业务的企业和个体提供了及时的资信平台。中华商报，大纪元时报，及环球东方卫视等媒体的记者参加了第一期讲座；加州华人营建工会会长张翼忠亲临现场指导。 海通工程举办免费房地产开发权系列讲座旨在回馈华人社区，李博士说： 用简单易懂的语言解释复杂的房地产法规，提纲挈领介绍房地产开发程序，目的是让新来美国的投资者尽快了解这个市场，熟悉美国市场规则，避免和减少在房地产投资方面的风险和损失。 海通工程有限公司（Pacificspan Engineering）拥有加利福尼亚州商业建筑工程施工总承包资质。作为极少数可承包联邦政府工程项目的华人建筑企业，海通工程可为企业及个体进行房地产投资提供项目策划，投资分析，土地分割，工程设计，项目报建，施工监理一站式服务，投资项目包括商业，住宅建筑新建，现有建筑加建，翻新. 海通工程公司总裁李江博士于八十年代初期就职于中国科学院，八十年代中期留学美国先后获得德州理工大学土木工程专业硕士，亚利桑那大学都市开发专业博士。李江博士毕业后早期在美国亚利桑那大学做课题研究，之后投身到美国知名建筑企业从事工程项目管理，在美国参与管理过的大中型工程项目达250多项。2005年创建海通工程有限公司；2011年带领公司承包美国联邦项目， 现为联邦政府长期工程承包商。从业二十多年李博士将渊博的建筑理论知识运用于管理各类工程项目，深受业内专业人士及顾客的好评。
7aea3a0b10ac4d4e02386a51c0a65f975e5c2c77.translatedText: Haitong Engineering Company successfully held the first real estate development process lecture at its Diamond Bar City office on January 17th. The lecture site was full of seats, active interaction, and the atmosphere was warm. The original plan was for fifteen people to attend the lecture, but 30 people actually signed up. Five people could not sit down, so they had to schedule the second lecture on February 21st. Dr. Li Jiang introduced the real estate development process with his profound theoretical knowledge and rich experience, allowing participants to understand Land Entitlement (land development rights), the value of land development rights, types of land development rights and the entire land development process. Commercial and residential development and villa construction involve complex regulations and procedures on land development rights. Haitong Engineering holds a series of free lectures on real estate development rights to provide a timely credit platform for companies and individuals interested in developing real estate development business. Reporters from China Business Daily, The Epoch Times, Global Dragon TV and other media attended the first lecture; Zhang Yizhong, president of the California Chinese Construction Union, came to the scene to provide guidance. Haitong Engineering holds a series of free lectures on real estate development rights to give back to the Chinese community. Dr. Li said: Explain complex real estate regulations in simple and easy-to-understand language, and introduce real estate development procedures in an outline. The purpose is to allow new investors in the United States to understand the market as soon as possible, become familiar with the U.S. market rules, and avoid and reduce risks and losses in real estate investment. Pacificspan Engineering Co., Ltd. (Pacificspan Engineering) has the general contracting qualification for commercial construction projects in California. As one of the few Chinese construction companies that can contract federal government projects, Haitong Engineering can provide one-stop services such as project planning, investment analysis, land subdivision, engineering design, project construction application, and construction supervision for enterprises and individuals for real estate investment. Investment projects include new commercial and residential buildings, existing building additions, and renovations. Dr. Li Jiang, the president of Haitong Engineering Company, worked at the Chinese Academy of Sciences in the early 1980s. He studied in the United States in the mid-1980s and received a master's degree in civil engineering from Texas Tech University and a doctorate in urban development from the University of Arizona. After graduation, Dr. Li Jiang did research at the University of Arizona in the early years, and then joined a well-known American construction company in engineering project management. He has participated in the management of more than 250 large and medium-sized engineering projects in the United States. Founded Haitong Engineering Co., Ltd. in 2005; led the company to contract U.S. federal projects in 2011, and is now a long-term engineering contractor for the federal government. With more than 20 years of experience in the industry, Dr. Li has applied his profound knowledge of architectural theory to the management of various engineering projects, and has been highly praised by professionals and customers in the industry.

dbb5f770e0aa6defec17a77cef28a7927425c740.sourceText: 圣诞老人到希望学院！ 圣诞老人到希望 12 月 16 日是希望中文学校这学期最后一次上课，这一天学生，家长和老师们都得到了一个大大的惊喜 – 圣诞老人来了学校，来到了每个班级，圣诞老人给每个中文班的学生都带了礼物。 低年级的学生们看到圣诞老人走进了教室时，满脸的表情充满了惊喜和惊讶。 他们都觉得太不可思议了，圣诞老人居然到了教室里，居然还会用中文和他们打招呼。学生们手里拿着圣诞老人送的电影票，有的说”他是真的”有的说”我能送给圣诞一块巧克力吗”， 看着学生们天真可爱的小模样，圣诞老人身边的”工作人员”都开怀不止。高年级的学生看到圣诞老人更多的是惊喜，好多学生都高兴的叫了起来，圣诞老人告诉学生们要坚持学中文并给每个学生送了一张 ITunes card. 一个繁忙的学期结束了，我们衷心祝福大家节日愉快，万事如意！ 2018 年春季开学希望校园里再相见！
dbb5f770e0aa6defec17a77cef28a7927425c740.translatedText: Santa Claus comes to Hope Academy! Santa Claus Comes to Hope December 16th is the last class of the semester at Hope Chinese School. On this day, students, parents and teachers all got a big surprise - Santa Claus came to the school and came to every class. Santa Claus brought gifts to every student in the Chinese class. When the lower grade students saw Santa Claus walking into the classroom, their faces were full of surprise and amazement. They all thought it was incredible that Santa Claus actually came to the classroom and greeted them in Chinese. The students held the movie tickets given by Santa Claus in their hands. Some said, "He is real" and others said, "Can I give you a piece of chocolate for Christmas?" Looking at the innocent and cute appearance of the students, the "staff" around Santa Claus were very happy. Senior students were even more surprised when they saw Santa Claus. Many students screamed with joy. Santa Claus told the students to keep learning Chinese and gave each student an ITunes card. A busy semester is over. We sincerely wish everyone a happy holiday and all the best! The spring semester of 2018 starts. Hope to see you again on campus!

01241bd23816eabaef2979aa85b2f908d497b702.sourceText: 文扬：中国人自己的大事自己办 11月3日，天宫一号目标飞行器与神舟八号飞船成功实现首次交会对接。中国继美国和俄国之后成为了第三个掌握了这种被称为space docking technique的国家。 当初因为中国加入16国国际空间站计划的申请屡屡被拒，后来只好自己单独搞，近年来进展迅速，正在一步一步接近目标。按中国航天专家的说法：”我们国家载人航天工程是按照三步走的战略来发展的，我们第一步已经完成了载人航天，实现了有人在空间活动。第二步我们就要完成空间实验室这项工作。第三步建设一个长期的有人照料的空间站。如果说我们第二步工作完成得好，也就是说这个交会对接任务能够完成的非常好，把交会对接的技术突破，那我们载人航天工程就又向前前进了一大步。”（北京航天飞行控制中心主任陈宏敏） 从”神舟”飞天到”嫦娥”奔月，再到”天宫”升空、世人已经毫不怀疑中国人这种”几步走”的发展战略终究会走到目的地，也完全习惯了中国人这种一次接一次的”前进了一大步”。 习以为常的结果，近年来，连国外媒体常见的”惊呼”和国内媒体一向的”欢呼”也都景象不再了。毕竟，那都是人们看到巨人刚站起来时的自然反应，当巨人大步行走时，大家就只是安静地观看，根据其步速认真地计算其行程，根据其行程严肃地评估其影响，顾不上一惊一乍地瞎嚷嚷了。 据说，当初拒绝中国加入国际空间站计划的理由是”就像你不会让一个十几岁的年轻人持有你的法拉利轿车车钥匙一样”。结果，众目睽睽之下，这个信心满满、生机勃勃的年轻人开始自己动手制造北京吉普。 理由更充分： 法拉利虽好，但那是别人的，北京吉普再简陋，但它是自己的。 法拉利再好，也有老旧退役的时候，北京吉普从第一代做起，总会逐步升级到接近法拉利。 最重要的，开别人的法拉利，什么都要听别人的，开自己的北京吉普，想怎么开怎么开，想去哪里去哪里。 如此看来，像探月这种事关整个中华民族未来发展的大事情，还是自己单独搞更好。 此事之大，可以大到什么程度？在新闻里看到被称之为”嫦娥之父”的中国月球探测工程首席科学家欧阳自远先生如是说： ”大量蕴藏在月球上的氦3是非常好的一种核聚变燃料。经过初步测算，月球上的储量是一百万吨到五百万吨。?#20551;如利用氦3的话，中国全年的发电量大约需要8吨，美国全年的发电量大约需要25吨。那么，从月球上把氦3运回来一次，中国全年的能源需求已经全部解决。” 在我看来，不为别的，仅仅这一项，在探月工程上的所有努力就都具有事关整个中华民族未来发展的重大意义。中国人自制的北京吉普，哪怕只解决了中国的能源需求这一个大问题，就已功在千秋。 怎能设想，到了人类开始利用月球资源的时代，十几亿中国人还是不得不依赖外国的技术和能力取得所需的一切？ 中华民族是世界上第一大民族，这个民族的未来，只能掌握在自己手里。所以，事关整民族未来发展的大事，也只能自己来办。 谨以此文祝贺中国航天器太空交会对接一次成功。 2011年11月3日
01241bd23816eabaef2979aa85b2f908d497b702.translatedText: Wen Yang: Chinese people take care of their own major affairs. On November 3, the Tiangong-1 target aircraft and the Shenzhou-8 spacecraft successfully achieved their first rendezvous and docking. China has become the third country after the United States and Russia to master this so-called space docking technique. At first, because China's application to join the 16-nation International Space Station program was repeatedly rejected, it later had to do it alone. In recent years, it has made rapid progress and is getting closer to the goal step by step. According to Chinese aerospace experts: "Our country's manned space project is developed according to a three-step strategy. In the first step, we have completed manned spaceflight and realized manned activities in space. In the second step, we will complete the work of the space laboratory. In the third step, we will build a long-term and useful space laboratory." If we complete the second step of the work well, that is to say, the rendezvous and docking mission can be completed very well, and our manned spaceflight project will take a big step forward." (Chen Hongmin, Director of Beijing Aerospace Flight Control Center) From the "Shenzhou" flying into the sky to the "Chang'e" flying to the moon, and then the "Tiangong" taking off, the world has no doubt that the Chinese's development strategy of "a few steps" will eventually reach its destination, and is completely accustomed to the Chinese's "big step forward" one after another. As a result of taking it for granted, in recent years, even the common "exclamations" of foreign media and the usual "cheers" of domestic media have disappeared. After all, that was people's natural reaction when they saw the giant standing up. When the giant walked, everyone just watched quietly, carefully calculated its journey based on its pace, seriously evaluated its impact based on its journey, and did not bother to yell in surprise. It is said that the reason for rejecting China’s participation in the International Space Station program was “just like you wouldn’t let a teenager hold the keys to your Ferrari.” As a result, in full view of the public, this confident and energetic young man began to build Beijing Jeep by himself. The reason is even better: Although the Ferrari is good, it belongs to others. No matter how crude the Beijing Jeep is, it belongs to oneself. No matter how good Ferrari is, there will be times when it gets old and retires. Starting from the first generation, Beijing Jeep will always gradually upgrade to be close to Ferrari. The most important thing is that if you drive someone else's Ferrari, you have to listen to others for everything. If you drive your own Beijing Jeep, you can drive it however you want and go where you want to go. From this point of view, for a major event like lunar exploration that concerns the future development of the entire Chinese nation, it is better to do it alone. How big can this matter be? I saw in the news that Mr. Ouyang Ziyuan, the chief scientist of China's lunar exploration project, who is known as the "Father of Chang'e", said: "The large amount of helium 3 stored on the moon is a very good nuclear fusion fuel. Preliminary calculations show that the reserves on the moon are one million tons to five million tons. If helium 3 is used, China's annual power generation will require about 8 tons, and the United States' annual power generation will need about 25 tons. Then, by transporting helium 3 back from the moon once, China's annual energy needs will be completely solved." In my opinion, if for no other reason than this alone, all efforts in the lunar exploration project are of great significance related to the future development of the entire Chinese nation. The Chinese-made Beijing Jeep, even if it only solves the big problem of China's energy demand, has already made a lasting contribution. How can we imagine that in an era when humans begin to utilize lunar resources, more than one billion Chinese people will still have to rely on foreign technology and capabilities to obtain everything they need? The Chinese nation is the largest nation in the world, and the future of this nation can only be controlled in its own hands. Therefore, major issues related to the future development of the entire nation can only be handled by ourselves. I would like to congratulate China's successful space rendezvous and docking with this article. November 3, 2011

c694dce9ba29219f6fedd267afb3be57e0b23d76.translatedText: —-2023 Alberta College of the Arts Annual Performance

531e998b2c8760cc0ac106f8f7233d0d6cf66415.sourceText: 九月十七日傍晚，亚省艺术学院的年度汇演在汉密尔顿剧场圆满落幕。作为当地华人社区文艺界的翘楚，亚省艺术学院声名远播，此次来观看演出的不仅有学生家长、亲朋好友，更有很多慕名而来的热爱舞蹈艺术的观众。此次汇演，不仅是学员们舞蹈技能的汇报展示，也是中秋佳节之际为观众奉上的一场视觉盛宴。
531e998b2c8760cc0ac106f8f7233d0d6cf66415.translatedText: On the evening of September 17, the Alberta College of the Arts’ annual performance concluded successfully at the Hamilton Theatre. As a leader in the local Chinese community's literary and artistic circles, the Art Institute of Alberta has a wide reputation. Not only parents, relatives and friends of the students came to watch the performance, but also many audiences who came here to watch the performance and love the art of dance. This performance is not only a report and display of the students' dance skills, but also a visual feast for the audience during the Mid-Autumn Festival.

a964bfa62a682524041b959dc4a2431166e70c88.sourceText: 当天演出的舞蹈节目有古典舞、民族舞，现代舞、身韵技巧组合、K-pop。大小演员们各展风采，观众掌声不断，好评如潮。四岁小朋友们带来的《早安》，不仅是这群四岁孩子的首演，而且爸爸妈妈同台共舞，着实令观众惊喜。成人舞蹈班的蒙古舞、藏族舞，孩子们带来的傣族舞，令人赏心悦目的同时，感慨幅员辽阔的中华大地造就了这些风格独特的舞蹈艺术。广受好评的敦煌舞《飞天乐鼓》，古典舞《幻世长安》，令观众不仅为孩子们的精湛舞技术叫绝，更是纷纷赞叹服化道的完美堪称专业水准。当天的舞美也为舞者们的表演锦上添花，变换多彩的灯光完美呈现了舞蹈的艺术效果。
a964bfa62a682524041b959dc4a2431166e70c88.translatedText: The dance programs performed that day include classical dance, folk dance, modern dance, body and rhythm skills combination, and K-pop. The actors, big and small, showed off their talents, and the audience applauded continuously and received rave reviews. "Good Morning" presented by the four-year-old children was not only the first performance of this group of four-year-old children, but also their parents danced on the same stage, which really surprised the audience. The Mongolian dance and Tibetan dance in the adult dance class, and the Dai dance brought by the children were pleasing to the eye and at the same time, I felt that the vast land of China has created these unique dance arts. The widely acclaimed Dunhuang dance "Flying Musical Drums" and the classical dance "Fantasy Chang'an" made the audience not only marvel at the children's superb dance skills, but also praised the perfection of Fu Huadao and its professional level. The dance beauty of the day also enhanced the performance of the dancers, and the changing colorful lights perfectly presented the artistic effect of the dance.

cca528130c6368e89635becb13054b3c74a273e2.sourceText: 演出中场时，学校还进行了颁奖典礼。对过去一年在全国各种舞蹈赛事中获奖的舞者进行表彰，观众集体见证他们付出汗水后收获的荣誉与掌声。
cca528130c6368e89635becb13054b3c74a273e2.translatedText: During the performance, the school also held an awards ceremony. The dancers who have won awards in various dance competitions across the country in the past year were commended, and the audience collectively witnessed the honors and applause they received after their hard work.

dc30db6143da1b5c1cbf0ee2f52875129dbff7cc.sourceText: 汇演散场时观众还意犹未尽地讨论着最喜欢的节目。演员们更是兴奋地在舞台上和后台合影留念。无论是演员还是观众，都已经开始期待明年二月的亚省春晚了。
dc30db6143da1b5c1cbf0ee2f52875129dbff7cc.translatedText: At the end of the performance, the audience was still discussing their favorite program. The actors were even more excited to take photos on stage and backstage. Both the actors and the audience are already looking forward to the Alberta Spring Festival Gala next February.

1b2c8c4aefbcaeedd25f380806b103ec502ff026.sourceText: 作为亚省艺术学院每年两场演出之一，汇报演出的所有工作都是由本校老师、义工及家长志愿者共同完成。大家精心策划、齐心协力，正是幕后这些人的无私。
1b2c8c4aefbcaeedd25f380806b103ec502ff026.translatedText: As one of the two performances every year at the Alberta School of the Arts, all the work of reporting on the performance is completed by teachers, volunteers and parent volunteers of the school. It was all careful planning and concerted efforts, and it was the selflessness of these people behind the scenes.

ab00fdfacb0e6c8a9731ef56da90eecd8aa58cd7.sourceText: 全球“野鸡大学”半数在美国 假文凭求职后果严重
ab00fdfacb0e6c8a9731ef56da90eecd8aa58cd7.translatedText: Half of the world's "pheasant universities" are in the United States, and the consequences of applying for a job with a fake diploma are serious

0b89548912a532c7cbf9b3f3d53a88b8d931ab02.sourceText: 全球“野鸡大学”半数在美国 假文凭求职后果严重 编者按： 近日媒体曝光的一份全球”野鸡大学&#…
0b89548912a532c7cbf9b3f3d53a88b8d931ab02.translatedText: Half of the world's "pheasant universities" are in the United States, and the consequences of applying for a job with a fake diploma are serious Editor's note: A global "Pheasant University" recently exposed by the media...

2c4e4fb7bfebef07f0fcf806230bcdf166c2454a.sourceText: 近日媒体曝光的一份全球”野鸡大学”黑名单中，691所大学和教育机构上榜，其中美国成为”野鸡大学”扎堆的重灾区，多达342所，占比接近50%。对于这份名单的权威性，专家表示毋庸置疑。而对于美国院校上榜数量之多，专家称这应归咎于美国的学校审批制度，总体而言，美国野鸡学校数量在逐年下降，而且只占美国高校很小比例，因而并不会影响学生对美国教育质量的总体看法和留美热情。不过，这份名单也给准留学生们提个醒，择校时一定要擦亮眼睛，多做功课识别”野鸡大学”，以防上当受骗。
2c4e4fb7bfebef07f0fcf806230bcdf166c2454a.translatedText: In a global "Pheasant University" blacklist recently exposed by the media, There are 691 universities and educational institutions on the list, of which the United States has become the hardest-hit area with "pheasant universities", with as many as 342, accounting for nearly 50%. Experts say there is no doubt about the authoritativeness of this list, and the number of American universities on the list is unquestionable. Experts say this is due to the school approval system in the United States. Generally speaking, the number of pheasant schools in the United States is declining year by year, and they only account for a small proportion of American colleges and universities. Therefore, it will not affect students’ overall perception of the quality of American education and their enthusiasm for studying in the United States. However, this list also reminds prospective international students to keep their eyes open when choosing a school and do more homework to identify "pheasant universities" to prevent being deceived.

f452234ae1fef0ad700b47f87dbe5582afd687b7.sourceText: 野鸡大学只占美国高校很小比例 这份关于”野鸡大学”的最新名单是媒体从美国教育部、美国高等教育认证委员会(CHEA)、俄勒冈州和缅因州教育厅处获得的。据悉，此次被曝光的691所未被认证的大学和教育机构中，美国最多，达342所，几乎占了一半；英国以67所位居第二；尼日利亚以19所位居第三。此外意大利、印度、加拿大、爱尔兰、澳大利亚、日本等国都有学校登榜，但是院校数量都低于20所。 看到该名单的学生和家长很是困惑，美国公布的名单，居然如此地自曝家丑，这个名单是否缺乏权威性？嘉华世达广东分公司资深顾问刘婷在接受本报记者采访时表示，美国高等教育认证委员会是协调并审核认证机构的专业机构，其公布的”野鸡大学”是基于认证机构的调查和评判，具有一定的权威性。 那美国”野鸡大学”占比如此之高，是否意味着美国的教育质量出现严重下滑？新通教育美国留学专家梁旅商表示，事实上，美国高校众多，将近4000多所，而野鸡大学只占其中很小的比例，美国总体的教育水平依然处于世界领先的地位，而且大部分院校都设有丰厚的奖学金，因而美国留学热潮在中国仍然高温不退。 ”与2010年公布的名单相比，此次公布的野鸡大学数量下降了一半(从1503所降至691所)，而且名单上也找不到远程教育学院的踪影。可见，野鸡大学的生存空间已经越来越小，而全球的留学环境则越来越好了。”
f452234ae1fef0ad700b47f87dbe5582afd687b7.translatedText: Pheasant University only accounts for a small proportion of American colleges and universities. The latest list of "Pheasant Universities" was obtained by the media from the U.S. Department of Education, the Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA), and the Oregon and Maine Departments of Education. It is reported that among the 691 unaccredited universities and educational institutions exposed this time, the United States has the largest number, accounting for 342, accounting for almost half; the United Kingdom ranks second with 67; Nigeria ranks third with 19. In addition, Italy, India, Canada, Ireland, Australia, Japan and other countries have schools on the list, but the number of institutions is less than 20. Students and parents who saw the list were very confused. The list published by the United States actually exposed family scandals in this way. Does this list lack authority? Liu Ting, a senior consultant at Jiahua Shida Guangdong Branch, said in an interview with this reporter that the American Higher Education Accreditation Council is a professional organization that coordinates and reviews accreditation institutions. The "Pheasant University" announced by it is based on the investigation and judgment of the accreditation agency and has a certain authority. Does the high proportion of "Pheasant University" in the United States mean that the quality of education in the United States has seriously declined? Liang Travelshang, an expert on studying in the United States from Xintong Education, said that in fact, there are nearly 4,000 colleges and universities in the United States, and Pheasant University only accounts for a small proportion of them. The overall educational level of the United States is still among the best in the world, and most institutions have generous scholarships. Therefore, the craze for studying in the United States is still high in China. "Compared with the list published in 2010, the number of pheasant universities announced this time has dropped by half (from 1,503 to 691), and there is no trace of distance education colleges on the list. It can be seen that the living space of Pheasant University has become smaller and smaller, while the global study abroad environment is getting better and better. ”

3aea202e718831f2d1b2b963a7907692a4fad046.sourceText: 用假文凭求职后果严重 据分析，美国”野鸡大学”占比将近50%主要跟美国的教育审批机制有关。由于在美国开办学校相对容易，办学的权利来自各个州而不是联邦政府的授予，因而管理松紧度不一的灰色地带为”野鸡大学”来带了便利。相对而言，加州和夏威夷州对注册大学的管理最为宽松，注册人只需要租下一个邮箱就可被视为在该州的办学地址，这也是为什么在美国夏威夷和加利福尼亚有最多野鸡学校。 不得不提的是，促使”野鸡大学”遍地开花的主要诱因，是留学生抱有”混文凭”的不良心态，而直接原因是学生留学前的?’功课”没有做足。”简而言之，留学生是自愿或者是上当而入读野鸡大学，他们有的是为了一张洋文凭而不在意学位是否受到认可，有的是没有了解清楚国外院校情况就仓促申请，无论是哪种做法，都是不可取的。”梁旅商如是表示。 他还告诉记者，美国是个相对开放的社会，一般工作对于学历要求不高，但是美国十分重视诚信，如果用假文凭求职，后果将会十分严重。因为野鸡大学的文凭是不被社会承认的，所以用它求职就是一种欺骗行为，等同于假文凭。美国十余个州已经将拿?#37326;鸡大学?#25991;凭求职列为犯罪。一旦被发现利用野鸡学历求职，其信誉将受到巨大打击，房屋贷款、信用的申请等将举步维艰，还得承担社会舆论的道德压力。
3aea202e718831f2d1b2b963a7907692a4fad046.translatedText: The consequences of using fake diplomas to find a job will be serious According to analysis, nearly 50% of "Pheasant Universities" in the United States are mainly related to the education approval mechanism in the United States. Since it is relatively easy to open a school in the United States, the right to run a school comes from each state rather than the federal government. Therefore, the gray area of varying degrees of management has brought convenience to "Pheasant Universities". Relatively speaking, California and Hawaii have the loosest management of registered universities. Registrants only need to rent a mailbox to be regarded as a school address in that state. This is why Hawaii and California have the most pheasant schools in the United States. It must be mentioned that the main reason for the proliferation of "pheasant universities" is that international students have a bad mentality of "mixed diplomas", and the direct reason is that students did not do enough homework before studying abroad. "In short, international students enroll in Pheasant University voluntarily or deceived. Some of them do it for a foreign diploma and don't care whether the degree is recognized. Some of them apply hastily without fully understanding the situation of foreign institutions. No matter which approach is taken, it is not advisable." Liang Travel Merchant said. He also told reporters that the United States is a relatively open society and generally does not require high academic qualifications for jobs. However, the United States attaches great importance to integrity. If you use a fake diploma to apply for a job, the consequences will be very serious. Because a Pheasant University diploma is not recognized by society, using it to apply for a job is an act of deception and is equivalent to a fake diploma. More than a dozen states in the United States have made it a crime to use chicken to obtain a job. Once someone is found to be using their pheasant academic qualifications to find a job, their credibility will take a huge hit. It will be difficult to apply for housing loans and credit, and they will have to bear the moral pressure of public opinion.

1d74132f97386f8691eb94bdac20d787c65660b2.sourceText: 选择院校要多去网站查院校资质 专家指出，这份黑名单的公布，也给准留学生们提了个醒儿，留学择校一定要谨慎，千万不要误入”野鸡大学”。 至于如何识别野鸡大学，专家表示首先可以登录教育部留学涉外监管网的网站去查询申请学校的资质是否被中国认可。国外认证方面则可以登录美国教育部的大学院校和项目数据库网站(http：//www.chea.org/search/search.asp)及全美高等教育认证委员会的网站进行查询。 启德留学美国项目总监涂攀告诉记者，美国还有各个大学的专业协会的认证，获得专业协会的认证代表该专业的教学质量得到了广泛的认可，同时获得这些专业认证也意味着要定期接受这些认证协会的审核。 ”这个专业认证实际上比大学排名还重要。大学排名受到排名指标的限制，并不能客观的体现大学的教学质量，但认证就不一样了，因为美国大学的认证制度审核非常严格，都是由第三方机构来审核，所以选大学选专业时一定要看大学认证和专业认证。比如读商科，一定要看看这所大学有没有AACSB认证，读工科一定要看看ABET认证。” 除了去各类网站查资质，学生也可以从院校要求和收费情况来识别野鸡学校。一般申请野鸡大学会十分容易，当学生发现入学门槛过低或者费用比其他学校便宜一大截的时候，就要当心了。因为国外正规的大学如果将入学要求定得太低，会影响到其他正常招生的学校，而这种情况是不被允许的。
1d74132f97386f8691eb94bdac20d787c65660b2.translatedText: When choosing a school, you should go to the website to check the school's qualifications. Experts point out that the announcement of this blacklist also reminds prospective international students that they must be cautious when choosing a school to study abroad, and do not mistakenly enter a "pheasant university". As for how to identify Pheasant University, experts said that you can first log on to the website of the Ministry of Education’s Overseas Study and Foreign Supervision Network to check whether the qualifications of the school you are applying for are recognized by China. For foreign accreditation, you can log on to the U.S. Department of Education’s university and project database website (http://www.chea.org/search/search.asp) and the National Higher Education Accreditation Council’s website for inquiries. Tu Pan, program director of Qi Tak Study Abroad in the United States, told reporters that the United States also has certifications from professional associations of various universities. Obtaining certifications from professional associations means that the teaching quality of the major has been widely recognized. At the same time, obtaining these professional certifications also means that they must be regularly audited by these certification associations. "This professional certification is actually more important than university ranking. University ranking is limited by ranking indicators and cannot objectively reflect the teaching quality of the university. However, certification is different because the certification system of American universities is very strict and is audited by third-party organizations. Therefore, when choosing a university and major, you must look at university certification and professional certification. For example, if you study business, you must see if the university has AACSB certification, and if you study engineering, you must look at ABET certification." In addition to checking qualifications on various websites, students can also identify pheasant schools from the school requirements and fees. It is generally very easy to apply to Pheasant University. When students find that the admission threshold is too low or the fees are much cheaper than other schools, they should be careful. Because if formal foreign universities set their admission requirements too low, it will affect other schools with normal admissions, and this situation is not allowed.

60f11be5da0c96d364df48941a91bbf3d3cc0c22.sourceText: 其他识别 野鸡大学的小技巧 -链接 查看学校的网址 一般美国大学的网址都是以edu结尾，如 www.harvard.edu ，如果你遇到一所大学是以.com结尾，很显然这不是一所得到主流社会认可的大学。
60f11be5da0c96d364df48941a91bbf3d3cc0c22.translatedText: Other tips for identifying Pheasant University - Link Check the school's website address. Generally, the website address of American universities ends with edu, such as www.harvard.edu. If you encounter a university that ends with .com, it is obvious that this is not a university recognized by mainstream society.

1d1feec24d36ab19712b681212e6331963077488.sourceText: 查看维基百科上的介绍 英文维基百科上有很多大学的条目，大部分美国大学都有介绍，大家可以到 www.wikipedia.org 上输入大学英文名称查询。
1d1feec24d36ab19712b681212e6331963077488.translatedText: View the introduction on Wikipedia. There are many university entries on the English Wikipedia. Most American universities have introductions. You can go to www.wikipedia.org and enter the English name of the university to query.

a6327df07999b2003011aa2d705c9fb2edad8116.sourceText: 查看US NEWS的大学排名 US NEWS每年都会对美国大学进行排名，只要这个排名上有的大学，肯定不是野鸡大学。但要注意的是，US NEWS的大学排名分为4类：国家级研究型大学、地区级综合性大学、文理学院和本科类大学。这四类的大学是互不重合的。比如斯坦福大学属于研究型大学，肯定在其他类别找不到。
a6327df07999b2003011aa2d705c9fb2edad8116.translatedText: View the US NEWS university rankings US NEWS ranks American universities every year. As long as there is a university on this ranking, it is definitely not a pheasant university. But it should be noted that the US NEWS university rankings are divided into 4 categories: national research universities, regional comprehensive universities, liberal arts colleges and undergraduate universities. These four types of universities do not overlap with each other. For example, Stanford University is a research university and cannot be found in other categories.

2e55cd6215548a4597aa87ed909f906f17be0165.sourceText: 当地时间2012年7月21日，哈布沙暴席卷美国凤凰城，碧蓝的天空顿时顿时变成了暗红色，场面恐怖无比。哈布沙暴在阿拉伯语中就是大规模沙尘暴的意思。 据美国官方天气报告显示，此次沙暴高度约为600米，造成凤凰城机场封闭20分钟，有关部门没有收到人员伤亡报告。
2e55cd6215548a4597aa87ed909f906f17be0165.translatedText: On July 21, 2012, local time, a Haboob sandstorm swept through Phoenix, USA. The blue sky suddenly turned into dark red, and the scene was extremely terrifying. Haab means large-scale sandstorm in Arabic. According to the official weather report of the United States, the height of the sandstorm was about 600 meters, causing the Phoenix Airport to be closed for 20 minutes. Relevant departments received no reports of casualties.

3612c0eed9726546d2ae394e15c9be390002b197.sourceText: 亚利桑那双十国庆大会好康好事多，今年侨委会文化表演团的节目精彩为历年之冠，仅邓丽君，凤飞飞及江蕙三位巨星的模彷秀就己经让每个家庭总动员出席，帅哥小子黄家新诠释萧煌奇成名曲”你是我的眼”还有叶爱菱，林晓培压轴演唱怀旧金曲，这绝对是美国华人乐坛卅年来的盛会，正如大会主席邱顺雄说: 绝对后悔终生，如果你错过这次晚会。 如果这些好料已经让你满意，那就必须深深吸口气，把激动的心情压下，后面仍有更多更多的台湾名菜要请你品尝，台湾礼品要送你带回家，还有华航洛杉矶-台北来回机票及升等劵，等你抽中拿走。 凤凰城台湾同乡联谊会蓄势待发多年，今年首次挑大樑办活动，就一呜惊人，募资近六千元为亚省乡亲在晚会开场办了一场十足台味的国庆”酒会”实际就是台湾小吃大会。 凤台联会长张圣仪随该会精英代表专程赴芝加哥唔彰化县长卓伯源，在”晓以大义下”，说服卓伯源选择亚利桑那为彰化县在美国第一场的台湾农産品推广会，现场除了能吃到，喝到还能拿到带回家。 好事还没完，华航洛杉矶办事处处长俞智特别感谢亚省乡亲多年支持华航的热情，非常难得一次捐出一张洛杉矶到台北来回经济舱机票及一张洛杉矶到台北-经济舱升至商务舱之(来回)升等券，将在国庆酒会上抽出二位幸运朋友”庆双十，免费搭华航”。
3612c0eed9726546d2ae394e15c9be390002b197.translatedText: > The Arizona Double Ten National Day Convention has a lot of good things going on. This year's Overseas Chinese Affairs Council cultural performance group's program is the most exciting in history. Only Teresa Teng, Feng Feifei and Jiang Hui imitated the three superstars. The show has already attracted every family member to attend. The handsome boy Huang Jiaxin performed Xiao Huangqi’s famous song "You Are My Eyes" and Ye Ailing, and Lin Xiaopei sang the nostalgic hit in the finale. This is definitely a grand event for the Chinese American music scene in the past 30 years. As the chairman of the conference Qiu Shunxiong said: You will definitely regret it for the rest of your life if you miss this party. If you are satisfied with these good ingredients, you must take a deep breath and suppress your excitement. There are still more famous Taiwanese dishes for you to taste, Taiwanese gifts for you to take home, and round-trip air tickets and upgrade coupons for China Airlines Los Angeles-Taipei, waiting for you to win. The Taiwanese Association of Phoenix City has been preparing for many years. This year, it hosted an event for the first time, and it was an astonishing success. It raised nearly 6,000 yuan to host a Taiwanese-style National Day "reception" for fellow residents of Alberta at the beginning of the party. It was actually a Taiwanese snack conference. Fengtai Federation President Zhang Shengyi made a special trip to Chicago with the elite representatives of the association to meet Changhua County Mayor Zhuo Boyuan. Under "Xiao Yiyi", he persuaded Zhuo Boyuan to choose Arizona for Changhua County's first Taiwanese agricultural product promotion fair in the United States. In addition to eating and drinking at the scene, you can also take it home. The good things are not over yet. Yu Zhi, Director of China Airlines' Los Angeles Office, would like to express his special thanks to the folks in Alberta for their enthusiasm in supporting China Airlines for many years. It is very rare to donate a round-trip economy class ticket from Los Angeles to Taipei and a (round-trip) upgrade coupon from Los Angeles to Taipei from economy class to business class. Two lucky friends will be selected at the National Day reception to "celebrate Double Ten and fly China Airlines for free."

daf073629f6c312d455ee62a7acfcd8f28dc5f93.sourceText: 3月”两会”期间，政治局常委一级人物中，只有周永康出席了重庆代表团会议。3月8日上午，薄熙来意外缺席”两会”，引发外界猜疑，当日下午，周陪同薄回到会场，当场高调挺薄，声言：”去年重庆经济社会发展取得了新成绩，多项经济指标增幅位居全国前列，’五个重庆’，建设取得积极进展，城乡面貌发生了新变化。” 就在王立军叛逃丑闻鼎沸、薄熙来灰头土脸之际，周无所顾忌的挺薄姿态，说明二人关系绝不简单。 s
daf073629f6c312d455ee62a7acfcd8f28dc5f93.translatedText: During the "Two Sessions" in March, among the first-level members of the Politburo Standing Committee, only Zhou Yongkang attended the Chongqing delegation meeting. On the morning of March 8, Bo Xilai was unexpectedly absent from the "Two Sessions", which aroused suspicion from the outside world. In the afternoon of the same day, Zhou accompanied Bo back to the venue and supported Bo in a high-profile manner on the spot, saying: "Last year, Chongqing achieved new results in economic and social development. The growth rate of many economic indicators ranked among the top in the country. The construction of the 'Five Chongqings' has made positive progress, and the urban and rural landscape has undergone new changes." Just when Wang Lijun's defection scandal was raging and Bo Xilai was disgraced, Zhou Wusheng's humble attitude showed that the relationship between the two was by no means simple. s

7b02d3563d78f9ca834624c74905a673dae14537.translatedText: On March 8, 2012, Zhou Yongkang (middle) participated in the deliberations of the Chongqing delegation at the fifth session of the 11th National People's Congress, and Bo Xilai (right) presided over the deliberations. Mitbbs.com

de2c378c0b4640503103e8c0cea6d645783e05c7.sourceText: 王立军与周永康的渊源 Mitbbs
de2c378c0b4640503103e8c0cea6d645783e05c7.translatedText: The origin of Wang Lijun and Zhou Yongkang Mitbbs

727a9a00176b2b54b436f959165b69de4d1f1ece.sourceText: 在王立军出事后，周永康力保王立军，这也是公开的事实。为何周永康要保王立军，这要从10年前王立军辽宁盘锦打黑说起。2002年秋，身为铁岭市公安局长的王立军，奉辽宁省公安厅之命，作为总指挥专门负责盘锦打黑。
727a9a00176b2b54b436f959165b69de4d1f1ece.translatedText: After Wang Lijun's accident, Zhou Yongkang tried to protect Wang Lijun. This is also a public fact. Why Zhou Yongkang wanted to protect Wang Lijun begins with Wang Lijun's attack on gangsters in Panjin, Liaoning Province 10 years ago. In the autumn of 2002, Wang Lijun, the police chief of Tieling City, was ordered by the Liaoning Provincial Public Security Department to be the commander-in-chief responsible for Panjin’s crackdown on organized crime.

00156af1f177b84f646358ef65fc94cecf6f8ecd.sourceText: 上世纪90年代末，王立军在一次警方行动中实施指挥 Mitbbs.com 王立军在指挥这次打黑行动中发现，黑恶组织在以商养黑的同时，积极寻求政治和法律庇护，通过赠送高档轿车、金钱等手段大肆贿赂、拉拢党政干部和政法干警，使其成为黑恶势力的保护伞，有的警察成为犯罪同谋、同伙。 Mitbbs.com 据称，一个有盘锦市至少22名公安干警涉案其中的黑社会性质的犯罪，让当年的王立军感觉到背后的压力很大。 Mitbbs.com 王立军与周永康的特殊关系就是从此建立起来的。周永康从上个世纪70年代底起从辽宁油田技术员起家，一直做到辽河石油勘探局局长、党委副书记，辽宁省盘锦市委副书记、市长的位置，在盘锦连续干了15年。王立军2002年的打黑，不经意地打到了周永康的老巢。 Mitbbs.com 王立军在盘锦打黑，黑社会的头目们为了保命，纷纷供出自己幕后的老板。其中有两个老板的父亲就是当时盘锦市的”通天人物”，据说曾经是周永康在盘锦的老上级。 Mitbbs.com 为了儿子的事情，两位老上级星夜驱车直奔北京周永康的宅邸，向周永康求救；还有一个版本称周永康的直系亲属（妻妹）也参与了他们儿子的生意。 Mitbbs.com 当时，周永康命令王立军亲自进京向自己汇报整个盘锦的打黑情况，并要求王立军停止在盘锦的进一步行动，这是王立军有幸得以单独与周永康会面，同时通过这样的交易逐步加深了两个人之间的”友谊”。此后，王立军利用各种机会向周永康表示了自己忠心，包括逢年过节的拜访甚至参与周永康的家庭聚会，与周永康的干儿子孔涛就是那时开始相识并相熟的。 Mitbbs.com 2月6日，王立军闯入美国驻成都领事馆。周永康通过孔涛随国安部副部长邱进去成都，进入总领事馆并传递周永康承诺保证他安全等信息，故王立军同意走出美领馆被他们带回北京。 Mitbbs.com 薄熙来与周永康关系走近与王立军有关 Mitbbs.com 薄熙来任职重庆后，其决心在重庆进行打黑，认为由他的密友王立军操刀最为合适。于是在2008年空降王立军由锦州市公安局长任重庆市公安局常务副局长、局长。当然，公安部那一关必须由周永康签字通过。 Mitbbs.com 因为王立军和孔涛关系密切，周永康在2009年亲自打电话给薄熙来，保证王立军在3年内连升三级，成为副市长。 Mitbbs.com 也因王立军和孔涛的关系，使他拉近了薄熙来和周永康的关系，使得薄熙后来获取周的支持。 Mitbbs.com
00156af1f177b84f646358ef65fc94cecf6f8ecd.translatedText: In the late 1990s, Wang Lijun took command during a police operation. Mitbbs.com When Wang Lijun directed this anti-gang operation, he discovered that while using business to support gangs, gangsters actively sought political and legal protection. They bribed party and government cadres and political and legal police officers by giving away high-end cars, money and other means, making them the protective umbrella of gangsters. Some police officers became criminal accomplices and accomplices. Mitbbs.com It is said that at least 22 Panjin City police officers were involved in a crime of a mafia nature, which made Wang Lijun feel a lot of pressure behind him. Mitbbs.com The special relationship between Wang Lijun and Zhou Yongkang was established from then on. Zhou Yongkang started out as a technician in the Liaoning oil field in the late 1970s and has been serving as director of the Liaohe Petroleum Exploration Bureau, deputy secretary of the party committee, deputy secretary of the party committee and mayor of Panjin, Liaoning Province. He has worked in Panjin for 15 consecutive years. Wang Lijun's crackdown on organized crime in 2002 inadvertently hit Zhou Yongkang's lair. Mitbbs.com Wang Lijun is fighting against gangsters in Panjin. In order to save their lives, the gangster leaders have to reveal their bosses behind the scenes. The fathers of two of the bosses were the "Tongtian figures" in Panjin City at that time. It is said that they were once Zhou Yongkang's old superiors in Panjin. Mitbbs.com Regarding their son's matter, two old superiors drove straight to Zhou Yongkang's mansion in Beijing at night and asked for help from Zhou Yongkang; there is also a version that Zhou Yongkang's immediate family members (wife and sister) were also involved in their son's business. Mitbbs.com At that time, Zhou Yongkang ordered Wang Lijun to go to Beijing to report to him personally on the anti-criminal situation in Panjin, and asked Wang Lijun to stop further actions in Panjin. This was Wang Lijun's honor to meet Zhou Yongkang alone, and at the same time, through such transactions, the "friendship" between the two people was gradually deepened. After that, Wang Lijun took advantage of various opportunities to express his loyalty to Zhou Yongkang, including visiting during holidays and even participating in Zhou Yongkang's family gatherings. It was then that he and Zhou Yongkang's godson Kong Tao began to meet and become familiar with each other. Mitbbs.com On February 6, Wang Lijun broke into the U.S. Consulate in Chengdu. Zhou Yongkang followed Vice Minister of National Security Qiu into Chengdu through Kong Tao, entered the Consulate General, and delivered information such as Zhou Yongkang's promise to ensure his safety, so Wang Lijun agreed to walk out of the US Consulate and be taken back to Beijing by them. Mitbbs.com The close relationship between Bo Xilai and Zhou Yongkang is related to Wang Lijun. Mitbbs.com After Bo Xilai took office in Chongqing, he was determined to crack down on organized crime in Chongqing and believed that his close friend Wang Lijun would be the most suitable. So in 2008, Wang Lijun was parachuted from the Jinzhou Municipal Public Security Bureau to serve as executive deputy director and director of the Chongqing Municipal Public Security Bureau. Of course, the Ministry of Public Security must be signed by Zhou Yongkang. Mitbbs.com Because of the close relationship between Wang Lijun and Kong Tao, Zhou Yongkang personally called Bo Xilai in 2009 to ensure that Wang Lijun would be promoted to three levels within three years and become deputy mayor. Mitbbs.com Wang Lijun's relationship with Kong Tao also brought him closer to Bo Xilai and Zhou Yongkang, which later enabled Bo Xilai to gain Zhou's support. Mitbbs.com

3ddb4243166973e8a3bbf3ccc00d2205e74ee09c.sourceText: 2010年11月，周永康（中）在重庆考察，薄熙来（右）陪同。 Mitbbs.com 在薄熙来”唱红打黑”期间，中共高层中，唯有周永康明确力挺。2010年，周永康前往重庆视察，大赞”重庆模式”和薄熙来，留下这一句：”打击、铲除黑恶势力，是让老百姓过上安定日子的’民心工程’。”之后，坊间传言：周有意将”中央政法委书记”一职，传给薄，而薄也有意接手。 Mitbbs.com
3ddb4243166973e8a3bbf3ccc00d2205e74ee09c.translatedText: In November 2010, Zhou Yongkang (middle) visited Chongqing, accompanied by Bo Xilai (right). Mitbbs.com During Bo Xilai's campaign to "sing up celebrities and fight against gangsters", only Zhou Yongkang among the CCP's top leaders clearly supported him. In 2010, Zhou Yongkang visited Chongqing and praised the "Chongqing Model" and Bo Xilai. He left this sentence: "Cracking down and eradicating evil forces is a 'popular project' to allow ordinary people to live a stable life." After that, there were rumors that Zhou intended to pass the position of "Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission" to Bo, and Bo also intended to take over. Mitbbs.com

3512622f1e5755fa5ebd5cf74d0d3f63dd3ecd14.sourceText: 2010年，周永康（左二）和薄熙来（左五）在重庆出席一场活动，一起唱红歌 Mitbbs.co
3512622f1e5755fa5ebd5cf74d0d3f63dd3ecd14.translatedText: In 2010, Zhou Yongkang (second from left) and Bo Xilai (fifth from left) attended an event in Chongqing and sang a red song together. Mitbbs.co

a6bfbd2555f0efa5345b5a8032cc88905dc8e726.sourceText: 薄熙来任职期间，也与周家有着利益交换。据四川和中石油的人透露，周的儿子周斌积聚了200亿人民币的个人财富，很多是薄协助获取的，其中四分之一皆中饱私囊。此外，周斌控制多数中石油系统以及四川和重庆的高层官员的提拔任命，薄在重庆则给了周斌400亿人民币的项目，使得他获得了近100亿元的利益。 Mitbbs.com 其实，除了金钱腐败关系，周永康支持薄熙来和王立军掌控政法委，就是要避免被清算。但事与愿违，在王立军、薄熙来相继出事后，周永康可能自身也难保了。 Mitbbs.com
a6bfbd2555f0efa5345b5a8032cc88905dc8e726.translatedText: During his tenure, Bo Xilai also had exchanges of interests with the Zhou family. According to people in Sichuan and PetroChina, Zhou's son Zhou Bin has amassed a personal fortune of 20 billion yuan, much of which was acquired with Bo's help, a quarter of which was pocketed personally. In addition, Zhou Bin controlled the promotion and appointment of most of the PetroChina system and senior officials in Sichuan and Chongqing. Bo gave Zhou Bin a 40 billion yuan project in Chongqing, allowing him to gain nearly 10 billion yuan in benefits. Mitbbs.com In fact, in addition to money and corruption, Zhou Yongkang supported Bo Xilai and Wang Lijun in controlling the Political and Legal Affairs Commission in order to avoid being liquidated. But things went counterproductive. After Wang Lijun and Bo Xilai's accidents happened one after another, Zhou Yongkang may not be able to protect himself. Mitbbs.com

7dcdd3be1a837aaba999dee42fe53757c6531926.sourceText: 今年是图桑中国艺术展示多彩多姿的一年。来自中国的访问学者及着名画家萧渝山和褚培岩教授，应图桑亚利桑那大学东亚系及孔子学院的邀请，于十一月十八日下午，在艺术系大楼301教室演讲并示范作画。到者有艺术系及东亚系教授学生，社会人士，共约七十馀人。二十日，复在图桑中国文化中心演讲及示范，观众俱皆惊叹其画作之美。
7dcdd3be1a837aaba999dee42fe53757c6531926.translatedText: This year is a colorful year for Chinese art in Tucson. Visiting scholars and famous painters Professors Xiao Yushan and Chu Peiyan from China were invited by the Department of East Asia and the Confucius Institute at the University of Arizona at Tucson to give lectures and demonstrate painting in Room 301 of the Art Department Building on the afternoon of November 18. There were about 70 people present, including professors, students from the Department of Art and East Asia, and members of the public. On the 20th, he gave a speech and demonstration at the Chinese Cultural Center in Tucson. The audience was amazed by the beauty of his paintings.

665d0f2d5ce8d6c261dafd410589e6e174eb75c2.sourceText: 两位艺术教授均为功力深厚之有名画家，艺术风格中西合璧。作品为数个博物馆及多国私人收藏家所珍藏。
665d0f2d5ce8d6c261dafd410589e6e174eb75c2.translatedText: Both art professors are famous painters with profound skills, and their artistic styles combine Chinese and Western styles. His works are collected by several museums and private collectors in many countries.

548d21e316de3e9d04e8d299aefeac134f0ab77b.sourceText: 州科技学院艺术系，以创新画法着称。随着艺术新思潮的兴起，他不满足于传统水粉画的表现方法，遂创出一整套的刮刀水粉新技法。因此他的水粉画既不同于传统水粉画，又与油画、水彩画迥然异趣。有多项获奖作品。这次他展示作品《走近周庄》长卷，是以刮为主，佐以动点透视的代表作。充分显示古老建筑因风化而产生的沧桑感、时空感和真实感。他曾多次获奖。
548d21e316de3e9d04e8d299aefeac134f0ab77b.translatedText: > Art Department of State College of Science and Technology, famous for its innovative painting methods. With the rise of new artistic trends, he was not satisfied with the traditional expression method of gouache painting, so he created a whole set of new techniques of scraper gouache. Therefore, his gouache paintings are not only different from traditional gouache paintings, but also completely different from oil paintings and watercolor paintings. There are many award-winning works. This time he is showing the long scroll work "Approaching Zhouzhuang", which is a masterpiece based on scraping and supplemented by moving point perspective. It fully displays the vicissitudes, time and space and reality of ancient buildings caused by weathering. He has won many awards.

b57839dd03d9eda424aec80a41cf4370c4e6f11c.sourceText: 十一月底﹐又有宋元明教授来访﹐并在卡他里那山麓中学等学校示范作画。宋元明係山东省临沂大学艺术系教授﹐擅画山水﹑花鸟﹑人物及走兽﹐尤擅画虎。作品获多项大奖﹐书画界称他为”鲁蒙画虎第一人” 。
b57839dd03d9eda424aec80a41cf4370c4e6f11c.translatedText: At the end of November, Professor Song Yuanming came to visit again and gave painting demonstrations at Catarina Foothill Middle School and other schools. During the Song, Yuan and Ming Dynasties, he was a professor at the Art Department of Linyi University in Shandong Province. He was good at painting landscapes, flowers and birds, figures and animals, especially tigers. His works have won many awards, and the calligraphy and painting circles call him "the first person to paint tigers in Lu Meng".

"Mother's Heart" on page 86 of "Tianqu": "My son is burrowed in the big clouds, and his loving mother is looking up to the sky; the rain is falling in the clouds in my heart, soaking my son's clothes." This song "Mother's Heart" is very simple at first glance, but when you taste it carefully, your eyes are blurred. ccda9f4692eaed207c549457e2140d653e5fb7ea.sourceText: 凤凰飞上凤凰台——凤凰选美报道（五） 张肇鸿 五月卅日，鳯凰城侨联总会主席邓朝驹，率团到加州罗省中华会馆及鳯凰卫视进行了交流和访问，这是侨联成立以来，首次正式拜会罗省中华会馆，同时也是鳯凰选美佳丽集体到鳯凰卫视参观和亮相，并向中华环球小姐取经和学习。 罗省中华会馆已有一百二十年历史，在华人侨社是个老大哥团体。当天，现任主席陈建邦已在堂所等候，其他各公所主席亦隆重欢迎我们一行到访。陈主席介绍罗省中华公所历史及现状，邓朝驹代表鳯凰城侨联总会向罗省中华会馆赠送牌匾，并邀请陈主席和其它首长参加侨联今年举办的庆祝美国国庆的活动。拜会完毕，选美佳丽们兴致勃勃地参观了中国城，并在孙中山像前拍照留念，有些还在唐人街购买了旗袍等记念品。傍晚，陈主席邀请大家到金龙酒家共进晚宴，席中宾主共同联欢歌舞。晚宴后，前中华会馆主席伍竞群带领佳丽们到有2401颗星的荷里活大道参观，在流光泛彩中，佳丽们又开心又兴奋行走荷里活星光大道，并和”蝙蝠侠”及”超人”等拍照留念。最后伍主席还邀请大家登上罗省最高的旋转餐厅茶叙，并观看了大洛杉矶地区的璀璨夜景。 五月卅一日早上，侨联率佳丽前往鳯凰卫视美洲台总部拜访，鳯凰卫视的曾建平副台长亲切会见了我们。今年是美洲台开播十周年。鳯凰卫视曾多次前来鳯凰城进行过采访和报导，几乎年年都有鳯凰记者冒着如火骄阳飞进凰凰城，毫无怨言又不计酬劳地宣扬《中国周》，访问《网络新娘》，拍摄《美国父母中国孩》，采访《华人支持Phil Gordon市长连任》，录制《凤凰城华人庆祝美国国庆和选美》，播出《四海童心迎奥运》、《鳯凰卫视在鳯凰》等等节目。侨联总会送上纪念牌匾，庆贺美洲台开播十周年，牌匾上书：”关爱万家百姓，翔鸣天地人间”，以表达鳯凰城华人对鳯凰卫视的钦佩。 其后，光彩照人的中华小姐蒋妮给佳丽传授选美经验，佳丽们纷纷提问，蒋妮用现身说法回答，博得了大家阵阵热烈的掌声。2006年，鳯凰小姐蒋卓群 (2005年冠军)，曾到鳯凰卫视参加过中华环球小姐的集训，并获 ”最具影视濳质奬”，各方面又多层次的培训，让蒋小姐用益无穷。 在鳯凰卫视的播声室，佳丽们维妙维俏模仿主播进行节目现场直播，让人看到她们显露才华的一面。鳯凰卫视还对鳯凰城侨联主席邓朝驹和张华芳进行了采访，并把这次访问进行了新闻播放。与此同时《侨报》记者也对佳丽们一一进行采访和拍摄，并把佳丽对亲人问候的录像制成视频放上网络播放，让远在万里之外的亲人也能看到佳丽们的现况。 六月八日，凤凰城选美佳丽到本地八号公共电视台担任义务接线生工作，这是从去年开始，凤凰城侨联总会对佳丽进行培训的项目之一，让人们不但看到她们外在美，也提升她们的心灵美。今年参选佳丽不但通过卫视转播，而且通过无远弗届的计算机网络，让全世界关心凤凰城选美佳丽的人们进行网络投票，以选出最佳人气奖项，这也是凤凰城历年选美的又一个新的举措，请大家为第三十届凤城佳丽踊跃投票，网址是由凤凰城”浩哥”创办的 www.sunbirdarizona.com 。2011让美丽升级，通过对佳丽们的内在美和外在美的提升，通过对佳丽们的培训和包装，通过各种传媒的宣传和报导，被《侨报》称之为”七仙女”凤凰佳丽飞上了鳯凰台，我们祝愿她们不断地展翅高飞！ 请大家踊跃为第三十届凤凰佳丽投票
ccda9f4692eaed207c549457e2140d653e5fb7ea.translatedText: Phoenix flies on the Phoenix stage - Phoenix beauty pageant report (5) Zhang Zhaohong On May 30, Deng Chaoju, chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Phoenix City, led a delegation to the Luo Province Chinese Association and Huanghuang Satellite TV for exchanges and visits. This was the first official visit to the Chinese Association of Luohuang Province since the establishment of the Federation of Overseas Chinese. It was also the first time that the beauty contestants from the Huanghuang City visited and appeared at Huanghuang Satellite TV to learn from Miss Universe China. The Chinese Association of Luo Province has a history of 120 years and is a big brother group in the Chinese overseas community. On the same day, the current chairman Chen Jianbang was waiting in the hall, and the chairmen of other offices also extended a grand welcome to our visit. Chairman Chen introduced the history and current situation of the Chinese Association of Luo Province. Deng Chaoju, on behalf of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Phoenix City, presented a plaque to the Chinese Association of Luo Province and invited Chairman Chen and other leaders to participate in the activities held by the Overseas Chinese Federation to celebrate the National Day of the United States this year. After the meeting, the beauty pageants visited China Town with great interest and took photos in front of the statue of Sun Yat-sen. Some of them also bought cheongsam and other souvenirs in Chinatown. In the evening, Chairman Chen invited everyone to have a dinner at the Golden Dragon Restaurant, where the guests and hosts sang and danced together. After the dinner, former Chung Wah Association Chairman Wu Jingqun led the contestants to visit Hollywood Boulevard, which has 2,401 stars. Under the colorful lights, the contestants walked happily and excitedly on the Hollywood Walk of Fame and took photos with "Batman" and "Superman". Finally, Chairman Wu also invited everyone to have a tea party at the highest revolving restaurant in Los Angeles and watch the bright night view of the greater Los Angeles area. On the morning of May 31st, the Overseas Chinese Federation led the contestants to visit the headquarters of Phoenix TV America. Zeng Jianping, the deputy director of Phoenix TV, cordially met with us. This year marks the 10th anniversary of the launch of America Channel. Phoenix Satellite TV has come to Phoenix City many times for interviews and reports. Almost every year, reporters from Phoenix City brave the scorching sun and fly into Phoenix City to promote "China Week" without any complaints or compensation, interview "Internet Bride", film "American Parents with Chinese Children", and interview "Chinese Support Phil" Mayor Gordon was re-elected", recorded "Phoenix Chinese Celebrate the National Day and Beauty Pageant", and broadcast programs such as "Children in the World Welcome the Olympics", "Fenghuang TV in Huanghuang" and other programs. The Overseas Chinese Federation sent a commemorative plaque to celebrate the 10th anniversary of the launch of American Channel. The plaque read: "Care for thousands of people, soaring in the world" to express the admiration of the Chinese people in Huanghuang City for Huanghuang Satellite TV. Later, the dazzling Miss China Jiang Ni taught the beauties her beauty pageant experience. The beauties asked questions one after another, and Jiang Ni answered with her own personal experience, which won warm applause from everyone. In 2006, Miss Huanghuang Jiang Zhuoqun (2005 champion) went to Huanghuang Satellite TV to participate in the training of Miss Universe China, and won the "Best Film and Television Quality Award". The multi-level training in all aspects has benefited Miss Jiang a lot. In the broadcasting studio of Huanghuang TV, the beauties imitated the anchors in a live broadcast of the program, allowing people to see their talents. Huanghuang Satellite TV also conducted an interview with Deng Chaoju and Zhang Huafang, chairman of the Federation of Chinese Overseas Chinese in Huanghuang City, and broadcast the visit as a news broadcast. At the same time, reporters from the "Qiao Bao" also interviewed and photographed the beauties one by one, and made videos of the beauties' greetings to their relatives and put them on the Internet, so that relatives thousands of miles away could see the current situation of the beauties. On June 8, the beauty pageant contestants from Phoenix City worked as voluntary operators at the local public television station No. 8. This is one of the training programs for the contestants launched by the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation since last year, so that people can not only see their outer beauty, but also enhance their inner beauty. This year's beauties will not only be broadcast on satellite TV, but also through the far-reaching computer network, allowing people around the world who care about the Phoenix City beauty pageant to vote online to select the most popular award. This is also another new initiative in Phoenix City's beauty pageants over the years. Please vote for the 30th Phoenix City Beauty Pageant. The website is www.sunbirdarizona.com founded by "Brother Hao" in Phoenix City. In 2011, we will upgrade beauty. Through the improvement of the inner and outer beauty of the beauties, through the training and packaging of the beauties, and through the publicity and reports of various media, the Phoenix beauties called the "Seven Fairies" by the "Overseas Chinese News" will fly onto the Phoenix Stage. We wish them to continue to spread their wings and fly high! Please vote for the 30th Phoenix Beauty

0f1ed4316db18ed666cd1bcc2837900f0bf27350.sourceText: 4日，台湾演员朱芷莹、胡锦、魏海敏、徐贵樱、蓝钧天（由左至右）出席舞台剧《游园惊梦》记者会。当日，根据台湾著名作家白先勇同名小说改编的舞台剧《游园惊梦》记者会在台北市西华饭店举行。 新华社发 据新华社台北7月4日电（记者傅双琪）两岸演员将共同参与演出著名作家白先勇创作的舞台剧《游园惊梦》，并计划自今年12月起在大陆9个城市以及香港巡演100场。 台湾国际新象文教基金会行政总监许博允在4日举行的新闻发布会上表示，这部舞台剧将于7月29日到31日在台北演出，然后于12月14日到17日在北京国家大剧院演出，随后将在上海、南京、杭州、广州、重庆、成都、武汉、青岛和香港等地巡演，总计演出100场。 许博允说，此次在台北的演出将有4位大陆优秀话剧演员参与，包括国家话剧院演员杨青、陈强、纪原以及上海昆剧团演员沈昳丽。 《游园惊梦》原为白先勇的短篇小说，于1966年出版，被认为是他的代表作品之一。白先勇和台湾知名舞台剧导演杨世彭合作将小说改编为剧本，于1982年首演，当时在台湾轰动一时。此剧以现代舞台剧的形式融合京剧和昆曲演出，将西方现代主义的表现手法与东方古典美学结合，是台湾戏剧史上的重要作品。 合作参与《游园惊梦》大陆演出的上海文化广播影视管理局艺术总监刘文国说，《游园惊梦》每到一个大陆城市演出，都希望能有当地的优秀话剧演员参与，不仅增加亲近感，也使两岸演员有机会同台演出、互相学习。他也希望台湾更多优秀文艺作品到大陆演出，共同传承中华文化。
0f1ed4316db18ed666cd1bcc2837900f0bf27350.translatedText: On the 4th, Taiwanese actors Zhu Zhiying, Hu Jin, Wei Haimin, Xu Guiying, and Lan Juntian (from left to right) attended the press conference of the stage play "A Dream in the Garden", which was adapted from the novel of the same name by the famous Taiwanese writer Bai Xianyong. The press conference was held at the Xihua Hotel in Taipei City. Xinhua News Agency, Taipei, July 4th (Reporter Fu Shuangqi) Actors from both sides of the Taiwan Strait will jointly perform the stage play "A Dream in the Garden" created by the famous writer Bai Xianyong, and plans to tour 100 performances in 9 mainland cities and Hong Kong starting from December this year. Xu Boyun, administrative director of Taiwan International New Image Cultural and Educational Foundation, said at a press conference held on the 4th that the stage play will be performed in Taipei from July 29 to 31, and then performed at the National Center for the Performing Arts in Beijing from December 14 to 17. It will then tour in Shanghai, Nanjing, Hangzhou, Guangzhou, Chongqing, Chengdu, Wuhan, Qingdao and Hong Kong, with a total of 100 performances. Xu Boyun said that this performance in Taipei will involve four outstanding mainland drama actors, including National Theater actors Yang Qing, Chen Qiang, Ji Yuan, and Shanghai Kunqu Opera Troupe actor Shen Zhenli. "A Dream in the Garden" was originally a short story by Bai Xianyong, published in 1966, and is considered one of his representative works. Bai Xianyong collaborated with the famous Taiwanese stage director Yang Shipeng to adapt the novel into a script, which was first performed in Taiwan in 1982. It was a sensation in Taiwan at the time. This play combines Peking Opera and Kunqu opera in the form of a modern stage play, combining Western modernist expression techniques with Eastern classical aesthetics, and is an important work in the history of Taiwanese drama. Liu Wenguo, artistic director of the Shanghai Culture, Radio, Film and Television Administration, who co-participated in the mainland performance of "A Dream in the Garden", said that every time "A Dream in the Garden" is performed in a mainland city, he hopes to have outstanding local drama actors participate. This will not only increase the sense of intimacy, but also give actors from both sides of the Taiwan Strait the opportunity to perform on the same stage and learn from each other. He also hopes that more outstanding literary and artistic works from Taiwan will be performed in the mainland to jointly inherit Chinese culture.

3e67785ea5d66298c440c9adc5fa6848ed6d8a49.sourceText: 威胁致深航航班紧急备降嫌犯抓获 据新华网报道，记者从湖北警方获悉，8月30日打匿名电话威胁致使深航航班紧急备降武汉的犯罪嫌疑人于9月1日18时25分被警方抓获。 据了解，犯罪嫌疑人名叫熊毅，1983年3月出生，为湖北省十堰市茅箭区市民。湖北警方是在广东警方协助下，在东莞大岭山镇宾馆将其抓获的。 深圳航空新浪官方微博31日凌晨发布消息称，2012年8月30日22时29分，深航ZH9706航班起飞后收到威胁信息，为确保安全，航空公司在第一时间安排该航班在就近机场备降，23时22分飞机安全备降武汉天河国际机场。在机场及航空公司的统一安排下，旅客已全部入住酒店，等31日补飞航班回深圳。当前，中国公安部门已介入调查。 这是连日来国内第二起航班「收到威胁信息」事件，29日20点18分，中国国航通过官方微博发布公告称，其CA981航班收到威胁信息，该航班已返航北京首都国际机场。
3e67785ea5d66298c440c9adc5fa6848ed6d8a49.translatedText: The suspect who threatened to make emergency diversion of Shenzhen Airlines flight was arrested. According to Xinhuanet, reporters learned from the Hubei police that the suspect who made an anonymous phone call on August 30 and threatened to cause the Shenzhen Airlines flight to make an emergency diversion to Wuhan was captured by the police at 18:25 on September 1. It is understood that the suspect’s name is Xiong Yi, born in March 1983, and a citizen of Maojian District, Shiyan City, Hubei Province. Hubei police, with the assistance of Guangdong police, captured him at a hotel in Dalingshan Town, Dongguan. Shenzhen Airlines' official Sina Weibo announced in the early morning of the 31st that at 22:29 on August 30, 2012, Shenzhen Airlines flight ZH9706 received threatening information after takeoff. To ensure safety, the airline arranged for the flight to make an alternate landing at the nearest airport as soon as possible. At 23:22, the aircraft safely made an alternate landing at Wuhan Tianhe International Airport. Under the unified arrangements of the airport and the airline, all passengers have checked into the hotel and are waiting for the make-up flight back to Shenzhen on the 31st. Currently, the Chinese public security department has intervened in the investigation. This is the second incident of "receiving threatening information" on a domestic flight in recent days. At 20:18 on the 29th, Air China announced on its official Weibo that its flight CA981 had received threatening information and that the flight had returned to Beijing Capital International Airport.

f8b89662cad3782cfb056c3a5c98bfe8c66b934b.sourceText: （特约记者陈丽君）在春暖花开，万物复苏的美好时节，亚省川渝联谊会于2013年3月30日在凤凰城华人基督教会举行了一次大联欢。此次大约100多人参加聚会，大多是川渝人。
f8b89662cad3782cfb056c3a5c98bfe8c66b934b.translatedText: (Special Correspondent Chen Lijun) In the beautiful season of spring when flowers are blooming and everything is recovering, the Sichuan-Chongqing Association of Alberta held a grand party at the Chinese Christian Church in Phoenix on March 30, 2013. About 100 people attended the party this time, mostly from Sichuan and Chongqing.

1c400d68030b73d17793c02edf4c34328f205ca3.sourceText: 亚利桑那川渝联谊会理事会成员

5514209c922a0f9f28b83d527786b1d869ded7dc.sourceText: 会长陈志刚告诉我们，亚省川渝联谊会在创会之初的会员主要是来至四川和重庆，宗旨是弘扬中华文化，增加交流，增进友谊。每年都举行一些聚会，丰富大家的业余生活。近几年由于很多人喜欢参加这样的聚会，协会的人员不断增加，会员不止局限于川渝地区，会员来至中国各省，市及地区，不乏有多彩多艺的人才，每次聚会大家除了可以品尝到各家各户烹饪的美味菜肴，而且畅所欲言，同时还能欣赏精彩的文艺表演，如弹钢琴，吹锁呐，拉小提琴，唱歌，民族舞蹈，鼓乐表演等。此次聚会还欣赏到现场即兴作画，中国功夫表演和川剧绝活”变脸”精彩的表演迎来阵阵掌声。整个活动精彩纷呈，到处洋溢着欢声笑语。
5514209c922a0f9f28b83d527786b1d869ded7dc.translatedText: President Chen Zhigang told us that the members of the Arizona Sichuan-Chongqing Friendship Association were mainly from Sichuan and Chongqing when it was founded. The purpose was to promote Chinese culture, increase exchanges, and enhance friendship. Some gatherings are held every year to enrich everyone's spare time life. In recent years, because many people like to attend such gatherings, the number of members of the association has continued to increase. Members are not limited to Sichuan and Chongqing. Members come to all provinces, cities and regions in China, and there is no shortage of colorful and versatile talents. At each gathering, in addition to tasting the delicious dishes cooked by various households, and speaking freely, they can also enjoy wonderful cultural performances, such as playing the piano, playing the suona, playing the violin, singing, folk dancing, drumming performances, etc. The party also enjoyed live impromptu painting, Chinese Kung Fu performances and Sichuan Opera's unique "Face Changing" performance which received bursts of applause. The whole event was wonderful and filled with laughter and joy.

4f00e7d089a34a507c381cee209d1928f6c9a978.translatedText: In the new year, the association will continue to uphold its purpose and hold entertaining and participatory activities that everyone loves to see and hear, to further enrich and enliven everyone's lives. Let the Sichuan-Chongqing Association of Alberta become a happy home for people to share joy and showcase their talents.

dfed844a03eacf54ae2138d301b90c93a7befb9a.sourceText: 骆家辉带“父亲”回乡省亲祭祖 （亚省时报广州特约记者杨绮薇报道） 11月4日下午，美国驻华大使骆家辉回台山市长塘镇吉龙村省亲祭祖，受到乡亲父老的夹道欢迎。 当日，身穿白衬衣，不打领带，挽起衣袖的骆家辉捧着父亲的遗照，在乡亲们的陪同下，穿过那条狭窄悠长的巷道，来到自己那栋青砖灰瓦房祖屋，在六叔公的指点下，爬上木梯子，将父亲的遗像与祖先的牌位放在一起。六叔公指着墙上的照片向骆家辉介绍祖上的亲人。随后，骆家辉与屋内与每一位亲人合影留念。 卸下大使外衣的骆家辉非常随和、亲切，俨然就是一个恭敬孝顺的晚辈、一个离乡背井荣归故里的游子。与大使一同返乡的还有他的妹妹。在骆家辉父母曾经住过的房间，妹妹触景生情，坐在床边流下了眼泪。骆家辉搂着妹妹轻轻安慰，神情默然。 骆家辉的祖居是一座约120平方米当地俗称”楼仔屋”的青砖灰瓦房，屋旁是一片种有香蕉、龙眼的果林。一百多年前，骆家辉的祖父修建了这栋房子。骆家辉的父母新婚后也曾在此屋小住。现在这座屋子是骆家辉六叔公骆耀章的居所。从祖屋出来，骆家辉轻轻搀扶着耄耋至亲的六叔公，与亲友们簇拥着来到祖坟，亲自焚香祭拜。两只肥硕的粤式烤乳猪是献给先人的最好祭品，噼里啪啦的爆竹寄托着大使对祖先的无限思念。 不少乡亲慕名从外地赶来，就是为了一睹大使的风采。据悉，大使此次已是第4次回乡省亲祭祖了。
dfed844a03eacf54ae2138d301b90c93a7befb9a.translatedText: Locke takes his "father" back to his hometown to pay homage to his ancestors (Reported by Yang Qiwei, Special Correspondent of the Alberta Times in Guangzhou) On the afternoon of November 4, Locke, the U.S. Ambassador to China, returned to Jilong Village, Changtang Town, Taishan to pay homage to his ancestors. He was welcomed by the villagers and elders. On that day, Locke, who was wearing a white shirt and no tie, with his sleeves rolled up, held his father's portrait. Accompanied by the villagers, he walked through the narrow and long lane to his ancestral house with gray bricks and gray tiles. Under the guidance of his sixth uncle, he climbed up the wooden ladder and placed his father's portrait and the memorial tablets of his ancestors. Uncle Six pointed to the photos on the wall and introduced Locke's relatives to his ancestors. Later, Locke took photos with every family member in the house. Locke, who has taken off his ambassadorial garb, is very easy-going and friendly, just like a respectful and filial junior, a wanderer who has left his hometown and returned to his hometown with honor. Returning with the ambassador was his sister. In the room where Locke's parents once lived, his sister was moved by the scene and sat on the bedside and shed tears. Locke hugged his sister and comforted her gently, his expression silent. Locke's ancestral home is a blue-brick and gray-tiled house of about 120 square meters, commonly known as "louziwu". Next to the house is a fruit forest with bananas and longans. Locke's grandfather built this house more than a hundred years ago. Locke's parents also stayed in this house after their wedding. This house is now the residence of Locke Ka Fai's sixth uncle, Locke Yaozhang. After coming out of his ancestral home, Locke gently supported his six-year-old uncle, and gathered with relatives and friends to his ancestral grave to burn incense and worship in person. Two plump Cantonese-style roast suckling pigs are the best sacrifices to the ancestors, and the crackling firecrackers express the ambassador's endless longing for his ancestors. Many villagers came from other places to catch a glimpse of the ambassador. It is reported that this is the fourth time that the ambassador has returned to his hometown to visit relatives and pay homage to his ancestors.
