5c0b1fa6e3009cddeea57034063567763ebd517e.sourceText: 张肇鸿：寻觅亚利桑那州历史上最早的华人餐馆
5c0b1fa6e3009cddeea57034063567763ebd517e.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: Looking for the earliest Chinese restaurant in Arizona's history

f60cb0375dc9e434cf75edaa037d915d29116f7d.sourceText: 张肇鸿：寻觅亚利桑那州历史上最早的华人餐馆 花旗餐馆 (American Kitchen) 廿世纪之初，亚华人…
f60cb0375dc9e434cf75edaa037d915d29116f7d.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: Looking for the earliest Chinese restaurant in Arizona's history Citi Restaurant (American Kitchen) At the beginning of the 20th century, the Asian Chinese...

be036826144280b20066a392ba1d4d14412b2d8a.sourceText: 廿世纪之初，亚华人已经从事餐馆业和开设什货店铺，但这些历史能被记载下来的资料却不多，照片则更少。据历史资料，从1900年至1940年，由凤凰城华人开设的餐馆有30间。而目前能找到亚省最早期的餐馆的相片只有两张，一张是1900年，在凤凰城中心地带，由余康中(Sing Yee, Sr.)经营的《花旗餐馆》(American Kitchen)。餐馆位于市区繁华的中央街 (Central)，是当其时极少数的中式餐馆之一。余先生学贯中英，经营有方，与当时的政商关係良好，不少初到埠的余氏宗亲被收留工作或得其帮助。余康中还担任过斐匿华侨学校校长，抗战时是斐匿华人救国后援会的副主席。虽然《花旗餐馆》原址已不存在，已无法进行更一步的历史遗址保护，但作为华人经营的第一间餐馆，却有着十分重要的历史意义。更难得的是，余康中留下了一张家庭相片，为亚省华人家庭历史留下了珍贵的人文资料。
be036826144280b20066a392ba1d4d14412b2d8a.translatedText: At the beginning of the 20th century, the Asian Chinese were already engaged in the restaurant business and opened grocery stores, but there are not many materials and even fewer photos that can be recorded about this history. According to historical data, from 1900 to 1940, there were 30 restaurants opened by Chinese in Phoenix. Currently, there are only two photos of the earliest restaurants in Alberta. One is the American Kitchen in the heart of Phoenix in 1900, run by Sing Yee, Sr. The restaurant was located on the bustling Central Street in the city and was one of the very few Chinese restaurants at the time. Mr. Yu was well versed in Chinese and English, was a good businessman, and had good relations with the political and business circles at that time. Many of the Yu family members who had just arrived in the port were taken in to work or received help. Yu Kangzhong also served as the principal of Fenie Overseas Chinese School, and during the Anti-Japanese War, he was the vice chairman of the Fenie Chinese National Salvation Support Association. Although the original location of "Citizen Restaurant" no longer exists and further protection of historical sites cannot be carried out, as the first restaurant run by Chinese, it has very important historical significance. What is even more rare is that Yu Kangzhong left a family photo, leaving precious humanistic information for the history of Chinese families in Alberta.

83bf06c755edcf5253eb461f6073f434769b1d76.sourceText: 余康中(Sing Yee, Sr.) 经营的《花旗餐馆》
83bf06c755edcf5253eb461f6073f434769b1d76.translatedText: >"Citi Restaurant" operated by Sing Yee, Sr.

097de27e791a5431e4e3d072bb50dfe02e8fd88e.sourceText: 另一张餐馆相片是在相同的年代，在土桑地区的墓碑镇，由阿龙(译音)和他的太太＂中国玛丽＂(广东中山人) 所开设的《坎坎餐厅》 (Can-Can Restaurant) 。
097de27e791a5431e4e3d072bb50dfe02e8fd88e.translatedText: > Another restaurant photo is the "Can-Can Restaurant" (Can-Can Restaurant) opened by Aaron (transliteration) and his wife "China Mary" (a native of Zhongshan, Guangdong) in the same era in Tombstone Town, Tucson.

f8c89a9a0da1f6af975d57a24455cbf7277fda34.sourceText: 关于被墓碑镇人称为的＂中国玛丽＂，是亚省早期华人的一个传奇女子，报章曾有报导，被人称为＂美国唐人街女当家＂。”中国玛丽”，真实身世、出生年龄无人知晓，她以?#38463;龙的妻子?#36523;份出现墓碑镇上。她身材丰满、健美，经常穿着绣着考究的图桉、以丝绸锦缎为多的唐装，华丽出众，穿戴着很多与众不同的珍奇珠宝。”中国玛丽”办事手法利落，当年唐人街各行各业都由她经手，身份、契约、找工作、薪水、船费全都由她过目、介绍批准，没有”中国玛丽”联络搭线，华人很难找到工作。那段时间她和旧金山的六大华人会馆(有译成6大公司Six Companie) 有良好的密切关系，互动交往频繁。那时候大部份的华人都居住在镇上第三街到第五街一带，华人住屋很紧密，屋里都挖地下室可以对外相通，有些地下室用作赌场、鸦片馆之用，其中也有活动中心、中华会馆，以供大家聚会。阿龙和妻子两人除了经营自己《坎坎餐厅》 (Can-Can Restaurant)，还经营礼品店、职业介绍所、批发买卖生意，也兼营鸦片馆、红灯区的营业权，夫妇俩的财产非常可观。白人眼中的”中国玛丽”就像一个女王一样，唐人街上的芝麻大小事，她都管。是当时唐人街的掌权”大姐大”。”中国玛丽”为人四海、豪放，有女侠的骨气，又是一位慈心善肠的女子，许多有病痛、没饭吃的人上门求助，”中国玛丽”不会拒他们在门外。曾经有一位白人牛仔从马背上摔了下来失去一条腿，?#20013;国玛丽?#19981;但请人送医，负担所有的医院开销费用，一直到白人牛仔完全康复为止。”中国玛丽”的一生多彩多姿，是敢爱敢恨的性情中人，她曾经和一个铁匠私奔，还被捉了回来，囚禁了一段日子。
f8c89a9a0da1f6af975d57a24455cbf7277fda34.translatedText: Regarding the "Chinese Mary" called "China Mary" by the people of Tombstone, she was a legendary woman of the early Chinese in Alberta. Newspapers once reported that she was called the "female head of Chinatown in the United States." "Chinese Mary", whose true life story and age of birth are unknown, appears in Tombstone as Dragon's wife. She is plump and muscular. She often wears Tang suits with elaborate embroidery patterns and mostly silk brocades. She is gorgeous and outstanding, and wears many unique and rare jewelry. "China Mary" had a neat way of doing things. At that time, she handled all walks of life in Chinatown. Identity, contract, job search, salary, and shipping fare were all reviewed, introduced and approved by her. Without "China Mary" to contact and connect, it would be difficult for Chinese people to find jobs. During that time, she had a good and close relationship with the Six Companies in San Francisco and had frequent interactions. At that time, most Chinese people lived in the area from Third Street to Fifth Street in the town. The Chinese lived very closely together and dug basements in their houses to communicate with the outside world. Some basements were used as casinos and opium dens. There were also activity centers and Chinese guild halls for everyone to gather. In addition to running their own Can-Can Restaurant, Aaron and his wife also run a gift shop, an employment agency, a wholesale trading business, and also operate opium dens and red light districts. The couple's property is very considerable. In the eyes of white people, "China Mary" is like a queen. She takes care of all the big and small things in Chinatown. She was the "eldest sister" in power in Chinatown at that time. "China Mary" is a cosmopolitan and bold woman, with the spirit of a heroine and a kind-hearted woman. Many people who are sick and have no food to eat come to her door for help, but "China Mary" will not turn them away. There was once a white cowboy who fell off his horse and lost a leg. However, he asked someone to send him to a hospital and paid all the hospital expenses until the white cowboy fully recovered. "Chinese Mary" had a colorful life and was a sweet-tempered person who dared to love and hate. She once eloped with a blacksmith and was captured and imprisoned for a period of time.

3a8297140274ec3a714e3919c0305c620aaf03a7.sourceText: 更令美国人不可思议的是，在1906年12月18日，当67岁的”中国玛丽”去世时，其葬礼的公开仪式轰动一时，资料提到，”中国玛丽”入殓后的柚木棺材停放在爱伦街的自宅中，屋里点着细细的线香，供桌上有烧全猪、全羊、鸡、鸭，有蔬菜生果，另外还有四位男士披麻戴孝，整夜在灵前拜祭、烧香、诵经不停，凡是来参加葬礼的中国妇女，均衣着华丽，脸上涂着厚厚的白粉，表情悲哀，她们配戴玉翠、象牙等饰物。有专业的乐班子吹奏着挽歌，不停地撒下大量的冥纸，用来打发那些黄泉路上的”讨债鬼”，免得妖魔鬼怪阻挡了死者的去路，顺利地抵达极乐世界。到了靴山公墓之后，棺木徐徐落穴下葬，葬礼之后，坟上供的好肉好菜也让当地的居民分享，她的葬礼让白人们大开眼界，并且在坊间不断地流传着、称颂着这位中国奇女子。
3a8297140274ec3a714e3919c0305c620aaf03a7.translatedText: What is even more incredible to Americans is that when the 67-year-old "China Mary" passed away on December 18, 1906, the public ceremony of her funeral caused a sensation. The data mentioned that the teak coffin of "China Mary" was parked in her home on Allen Street, and thin incense was lit in the house and placed on the table. There were roasted whole pigs, whole lambs, chickens, ducks, vegetables and fruits, and there were four men wearing hemp and mourning. They worshiped, burned incense, and chanted scriptures in front of the funeral all night long. All the Chinese women who came to attend the funeral were gorgeously dressed, with thick white powder on their faces and sad expressions. They wore jade, ivory and other accessories. A professional band plays elegy and keeps scattering large amounts of paper to ward off the "debt collectors" on the road to hell, lest the ghosts and monsters block the way of the deceased and successfully reach the paradise. After arriving at Boots Mountain Cemetery, the coffin was slowly lowered into the hole and buried. After the funeral, the good meat and dishes offered on the grave were also shared by the local residents. Her funeral was an eye-opener for the white people, and the people continued to spread and praise this strange Chinese woman.

04374d815fd63a7046cad61881e1cbf5fd9e2d65.sourceText: 我们于2015年9月去过墓碑镇探访，寻找＂中国玛丽＂的踪迹。小镇仍保留着当年旧貌，在原唐人街的地址，仍可以看到Can-Can字样，可见阿龙和＂中国玛丽＂开设的《坎坎餐厅》 影响至今不减。我们还去到爱伦街中国玛丽所住过的房屋原址，看到她的相片和资料。这所房屋是否能作为历史遗址保护其实已不重要，因为整个墓碑镇已是亚省历史文化的一个组成部分。临别之际，我们专门去了鞋山公墓的＂中国玛丽＂坟墓，向这位＂作千秋雄鬼死不还家＂的女汉子鞠躬致敬。
04374d815fd63a7046cad61881e1cbf5fd9e2d65.translatedText: We visited Tombstone in September 2015, looking for traces of "Chinese Mary". The town still retains its old appearance. You can still see the words Can-Can at the address of the original Chinatown. It can be seen that the influence of "Can-Can Restaurant" opened by Aaron and "China Mary" continues to this day. We also went to the original site of the house where Chinese Mary lived on Ellen Street and saw her photos and information. Whether this house can be protected as a historic site is not important anymore, because the entire town of Tombstone is an integral part of the history and culture of the province. On the occasion of parting, we went to the grave of "Chinese Mary" in Shoeshan Cemetery to bow and pay tribute to this woman who "will never return home until death."

5692ea269c638fefa5774cad485a4ed3ffcec9bd.sourceText: 政府关门否？医改下周开始 参院通过政府预算案 周五下午，参议院通过了一个防止政府关门的短期支出计划的议案，现在该议案已经被递送至众议院等待投票。四点，奥巴马总统宣布医疗保险改革计划将按照计划从下周开始，即便这将导致联邦政府部门关门。并补充道：”这是已经确定不容更改的事。” 随着下周二政府关门期限日趋逼近，民主党领导的参议院即将就财政预算案进行表决，而与此同时，共和党人领导的众议院内部则仍然就预算案的通过争执不下，而其核心问题则是奥巴马医改。 周四，国会共和党领袖决定延迟推出提高美国债务上限的法案，美国债务上限和政府关门危机仍然没有得到解除。目前，美国债务上限斗争激烈，主要症结在于奥巴马医保法案。由共和党人数占多数的众议院希望砍掉该法案，但参议院毫不退让。 奥巴马和共和党关于”新财年预算”和”债务上限”的谈判陷入僵局已有多日，而”医保方案”始终是谈判的”要害”。众议院议长博纳（Boehner）将斗争中心转向了债务上限问题。博纳同意提升债务上限的条件是：推迟一年施行奥巴马医保法案、税务改革和放松环境监管。不过博纳新方案在共和党内部遭到了反对。 如果国会不采取行动来补充联邦资金，政府非核心部门可能将于下周二关闭。 据华尔街见闻报道，周四，美国总统奥巴马在马里兰发表演讲，强调要保住”医保法案”。 医保法案即将生效，因此共和党加大攻击力度。周三，茶党参议员Ted Cruz花了21小时在国会驳斥奥巴马的医疗计划，这将双方的僵局推向了新一个高潮。奥巴马反击说，”这个世界是不是疯了，难道这是玩笑。” 美国国会10月1日如果不通过新财年预算，那么政府就要面临闭门风险。此外，美国债务上限警报已拉响，美国财政部部长Jack Lew已经预报过美国将于10月17日触及债务上限。他警告称：如果国会在2013年重演2011年的边缘政策，可能给经济造成更大伤害。而如果美国政府无力偿还债务，那么结果将是毁灭性的。 两党为解燃眉之急，纷纷提出自己的应急措施。上周五，众议院通过一项法案，以取消奥巴马医保为条件，向政府提供运行资金，避免政府关门。参议院民主党领导人Harry Reid随即表示反对，提议无条件通过一项政府临时支出法案，避免政府在4天后关门。 博纳表示众议院不会无条件通过临时支出法案。博纳说：”我认为指众议院会通过临时支出法案。共和党人没有兴趣让政府关门，但仍然推进取消奥巴马医保法案。美国人民不想要奥巴马医保法案，我们也不想让政府关门。共和党人等待参议院投票法案的结果。” 众议院要等待参议院通过临时支出法案的具体结果，才会采取行动。博纳表示，参众两院都不愿意承担让政府关门的责任，双方都想通过各种表态交锋，让对方承担压力，被迫让步。只不过，这种你来我往极费时间，美国政府关门的风险也变得更高了。 政府关门势必威胁到正常的秩序，但政府债务抵达上限带来的后果将更严重，用奥巴马的原话说，会”影响美国的信誉度”。 奥巴马的参谋Dan Pfeiffer说，共和党要的是敲诈，而不是谈判或者妥协，最后遭殃的是经济。 而共和党员Bob Corker则表示，阻挠谈判的共和党员只有Ted Cruz、 Mike Lee比较极端外，其他人还是愿意参与谈判的。
5692ea269c638fefa5774cad485a4ed3ffcec9bd.translatedText: Is the government shutting down? Health care reform starts next week and the Senate passes the government budget. On Friday afternoon, the Senate passed a bill on a short-term spending plan to prevent a government shutdown. The bill has now been sent to the House of Representatives for a vote. At four o'clock, President Obama announced that the health insurance reform plan will begin next week as planned, even if it will lead to a federal government department shutdown. He added: "This is something that has been determined and cannot be changed." As the government shutdown deadline approaches next Tuesday, the Democratic-led Senate is about to vote on the budget. At the same time, the Republican-led House of Representatives is still arguing over the passage of the budget, and the core issue is Obamacare. On Thursday, Republican leaders in Congress decided to delay the introduction of a bill to increase the U.S. debt ceiling. The crisis of the U.S. debt ceiling and government shutdown has not yet been resolved. Currently, there is a fierce battle over the debt ceiling in the United States, with the main sticking point being the Obamacare bill. The Republican-majority House of Representatives wants to kill the bill, but the Senate is refusing to back down. Negotiations between Obama and the Republican Party on the "new fiscal year budget" and the "debt ceiling" have been deadlocked for many days, and the "health care plan" has always been the "key point" of the negotiations. House Speaker Boehner turned the fight to the debt ceiling. Boehner agreed to raise the debt ceiling in exchange for a one-year delay in implementing Obamacare, tax reform and loosening environmental regulations. However, Boehner's new plan encountered opposition within the Republican Party. Non-core government departments could shut down next Tuesday if Congress doesn't act to replenish federal funding. According to Wall Street Insights, U.S. President Obama delivered a speech in Maryland on Thursday, emphasizing the need to preserve the "Medicare Act." The health care bill is about to take effect, so Republicans are stepping up their attacks. The standoff reached a new climax Wednesday when Tea Party Senator Ted Cruz spent 21 hours in Congress refuting Obama's health care plan. Obama countered, "Is the world crazy? Is this a joke?" If the U.S. Congress does not pass a budget for the new fiscal year on October 1, the government will face the risk of closing its doors. In addition, the U.S. debt ceiling alarm has been sounded, and U.S. Treasury Secretary Jack Lew has predicted that the United States will hit the debt ceiling on October 17. He warned that if Congress repeats the brinkmanship of 2011 in 2013, it may cause greater harm to the economy. And if the U.S. government is unable to repay its debt, the consequences will be devastating. In order to meet the urgent needs, the two parties have put forward their own emergency measures. On Friday, the House of Representatives passed a bill to provide operating funds to the government and avoid a government shutdown on the condition of canceling Obamacare. Senate Democratic leader Harry Reid immediately expressed his opposition and proposed unconditional passage of a temporary government spending bill to avoid a government shutdown in four days. Boehner said the House would not pass the temporary spending bill without conditions. Boehner said: "I think the House will pass a temporary spending bill. Republicans have no interest in shutting down the government, but they are still pushing to cancel Obamacare. The American people don't want Obamacare, and we don't want a government shutdown. Republicans are waiting for the results of the Senate vote bill." The House of Representatives will wait for the specific results of the Senate to pass the temporary spending bill before taking action. Boehner said that neither the House of Representatives nor the Senate is willing to take the responsibility of shutting down the government. Both sides want to use various statements to put pressure on the other party and be forced to make concessions. However, this kind of back-and-forth is extremely time-consuming, and the risk of a U.S. government shutdown has also become higher. A government shutdown will inevitably threaten normal order, but the consequences of government debt reaching the ceiling will be more serious. In Obama's original words, it will "affect the credibility of the United States." Obama's adviser Dan Pfeiffer said that the Republicans want blackmail, not negotiation or compromise, and the economy will suffer in the end. Republican Bob Corker said that the only Republicans who are obstructing the negotiations are Ted Cruz and Mike Lee, who are more extreme, but others are still willing to participate in negotiations.

5a8fe0dd47a913687b2b14be9994f2deaf87f416.translatedText: Spring has come early in Phoenix, and joy and laughter are in Hope! On the occasion of bidding farewell to the old year and welcoming the new, Alberta Hope Chinese School held the 2014 Year of the Horse Spring Festival Dinner at Fengcheng Restaurant on the evening of January 25th.

bc63e5468683b586d4d67c171a92d02d9d5613d6.sourceText: 倏然间，岁月的年轮在不经意中又多划了一圈。我们满怀着喜悦挥手告别硕果累累的2013年，带着执着与追求迎來新的一年。2013年是希望中文学校办学十九年来特别的一年，学校荣获国务院侨务办公室颁发的”海外华文教育示范学校”的光荣称号, 建立了学校图书馆华星书屋并开始启动, 严婕娅同学赢得2014亚省最杰出女青少年比赛冠军, 学生在各种大赛中获得好成绩。 谢小红校长回顾和总结了即将过去的一年,感谢师生, 家长和义工们的努力,支持和无私奉献。展望2014, 是一个充满着挑战、孕育着希望的一年，学校将把荣誉变为实力，要求教师们不断提升教学质量，努力构建高效课堂，使课堂教学更富生机与活力。 并转达了洛杉矶总领事刘健大使对大家的新春祝愿: 祝希望中文学校越办越好，祝大家新年快乐，学业进步！
bc63e5468683b586d4d67c171a92d02d9d5613d6.translatedText: Suddenly, the annual rings of the years made another circle inadvertently. We wave goodbye to the fruitful 2013 with joy and welcome the new year with persistence and pursuit. 2013 is a special year for Hope Chinese School in its 19th year of operation. The school won the honorary title of "Overseas Chinese Education Demonstration School" issued by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council. The school library Huaxing Bookstore was established and started. Yan Jieya won the 2014 Alberta Most Outstanding Female Youth Competition. Students have achieved good results in various competitions. Principal Xie Xiaohong reviewed and summarized the past year and thanked teachers, students, parents and volunteers for their efforts, support and selfless dedication. Looking forward to 2014, it is a year full of challenges and pregnant with hope. The school will turn honors into strength, requiring teachers to continuously improve the quality of teaching and strive to build efficient classrooms to make classroom teaching more vibrant and dynamic. He also conveyed New Year’s wishes to everyone from Ambassador Liu Jian, Consul General of Los Angeles: I wish Hope Chinese School will get better and better, and I wish everyone a happy New Year and academic progress!

7bc24d78aa13399e5a1dbc005e6c0531dd2d48a7.sourceText: 当晚师生, 家长,义工及嘉宾们,美莎社区大学的代表Patricia Esparza和历任学校管理者,共聚一堂庆祝这个特别的日子。老校长唐孝先，陈普，王馨欣，帅致若，赵彩虹和董事会顾问李建分别介绍了希望中文学校的渊源和历史，和大家分享了希望学校一步一个脚印成长起来的苦与乐。各种原因来不了的前校长董事长们也纷纷发来贺电。何世江董事长代表学校向美莎社区大学, 历任学校管理者和义工们对学校作出的贡献表示感谢。
7bc24d78aa13399e5a1dbc005e6c0531dd2d48a7.translatedText: That night, teachers, students, parents, volunteers and guests, including Mesa Community College representative Patricia Esparza and previous school administrators, gathered together to celebrate this special day. The old principals Tang Xiaoxian, Chen Pu, Wang Xinxin, Shuai Zhiruo, Zhao Caihong and board consultant Li Jian introduced the origin and history of Hope Chinese School respectively, and shared the pains and joys of Hope Chinese School's growth step by step. Former principals and chairman of the board of directors who could not come for various reasons also sent congratulatory messages. On behalf of the school, Chairman He Shijiang expressed his gratitude to Mesa Community College, previous school administrators and volunteers for their contributions to the school.

e0629f967a21830174aee5df8786397dccf66057.sourceText: 今年的晚宴节目很别出心裁，现场还有张正芬老师美术小班的马年画展。用餐期间穿插了幸运抽奖和”历届春节晚会歌曲竞猜”活动，家长们都非常活跃，猜中的还有一封开运红包，没猜中的也笑着直挠头，大家笑语连连。晚宴之后是学校舞蹈班的精彩表演，开场是蒋琳老师特别为春节编排的舞蹈《我给你拜年》, 孩子们脸上挂着欢喜的笑容，手持红红的灯笼，穿着喜庆的民族服装，一出场就喜气洋洋感觉到有央视春节晚会开场的味儿。开场舞一结束校长们就给当晚所有小朋友发红包，场面好不热闹，连主持人林欣也被孩子们挤到一旁直乐呵。汤可老师的小班小朋友表演《说唱脸谱》和《千古美人》时，台上的小”皇帝和”贵妃”们不紧不慢，可急坏了台下的爸爸妈妈。大家又是指又是点，但是”皇帝”和”贵妃”们架子不小，引得一阵阵欢声笑语。Elizabeth Sun同学演唱的《传奇》和孙宏伟的《欢聚一堂》更是唱技了得，而何春玲老师班表演的《草原母亲》豪迈奔放，举手投足间频现出专业水平。
e0629f967a21830174aee5df8786397dccf66057.translatedText: This year's dinner program is very unique, and there is also the Year of the Horse painting exhibition by the art class of teacher Zhang Zhengfen. During the meal, there were lucky draws and "Previous Spring Festival Gala Song Guessing" activities. Parents were very active. Those who guessed correctly also received a lucky red envelope. Those who guessed not correctly also laughed and scratched their heads. Everyone laughed. After the dinner, there was a wonderful performance by the school dance class, which started with the dance "I Wish You a New Year" specially choreographed by teacher Jiang Lin for the Spring Festival. The children had joyful smiles on their faces, holding red lanterns, and wearing festive national costumes. They were beaming as soon as they appeared and felt like the opening of the CCTV Spring Festival Gala. As soon as the opening dance ended, the principals distributed red envelopes to all the children that night. The scene was so lively that even host Lin Xin was squeezed aside by the children and laughed. When the children in Teacher Tang Ke's small class performed "Rap Face" and "Eternal Beauty", the little "emperor" and "concubine" on the stage were not in a hurry, but the parents in the audience were anxious. Everyone pointed and pointed, but the "emperor" and "concubine" were not small, attracting bursts of laughter. Elizabeth Sun's "Legend" and Sun Hongwei's "Happy Gathering" were even more impressive, while teacher He Chunling's class performed "Prairie Mother" boldly and boldly, showing professionalism in every gesture.

939f3cc8c7918e920b966b8c60181ab99592410d.sourceText: 最后是希望传统的大合唱。各位嘉宾和家长们一同登台，蔡善皋老师拉手风琴为大家伴奏，一起共唱”大海呀故乡”和”难忘今宵”。晚宴就要结束了，今宵正是难忘，我们来自五湖四海，今夜欢聚一堂。众人用广东话，上海话，无锡话，四川话，安徽话，江苏话，湖北话, 英文一一为大家拜年，希望在新的一年里，凝聚起奋进的共识，汇聚起创造的智慧和力量。让我们再接再厉再上一个新台阶、把希望中文学校办得更好！
939f3cc8c7918e920b966b8c60181ab99592410d.translatedText: Finally, there is the traditional chorus of hope. All the guests and parents took the stage together. Teacher Cai Shangao played the accordion to accompany everyone, and they sang "Ocean, My Hometown" and "Unforgettable Tonight" together. The dinner is coming to an end, and tonight is an unforgettable night. We come from all over the world and gather together tonight. Everyone spoke in Cantonese, Shanghai dialect, Wuxi dialect, Sichuan dialect, Anhui dialect, Jiangsu dialect, Hubei dialect, and English to express New Year greetings to everyone, hoping that in the new year, a consensus for progress can be gathered, and the wisdom and power of creation can be gathered. Let us continue our efforts to reach a new level and make Hope Chinese School even better!

3bb9f30be54acffe3105342ebd3287367df7f2d8.translatedText: 2013 was a very memorable year for the Guan Chongqiong family.

f9dd70374d792a6101e0511d2a1cf4a63acd6407.sourceText: 当时，关崇琼夫妇已经去世多年。其家族的成员也分散到美国和世界各地。仍在凤凰城的尚有关家的第六女儿关丽壁和第十一女儿关秀玉。她们代表关家，把一批珍贵的历史资料捐赠给《中国人民抗日战争纪念馆》，得到纪念馆所颁发的《收藏证书》，其内容如下：
f9dd70374d792a6101e0511d2a1cf4a63acd6407.translatedText: At that time, Guan Chongqiong and his wife had been dead for many years. Members of his family are also scattered throughout the United States and around the world. Still in Phoenix City are the sixth daughter Guan Libi and the eleventh daughter Guan Xiuyu of the Guan family. On behalf of the Guan family, they donated a batch of precious historical materials to the "Chinese People's Anti-Japanese War Memorial Hall" and received a "Collection Certificate" issued by the memorial hall. The content is as follows:

c626e8fa0f1851392e1811484b7b74ca3cdef1f5.translatedText: Ms. Guan Libi and Guan Xiuyu:

bf36c99c328b6b43fca32bdb3c2f28878c151d3b.sourceText: 您捐赠的“中国空军留美毕业学生签名赠送爱国侨领关崇琼先生的照片”等，我馆将长期珍藏。特发此证，以志纪念。
bf36c99c328b6b43fca32bdb3c2f28878c151d3b.translatedText: The "Photograph signed by a Chinese Air Force graduate studying in the United States and presented to the patriotic overseas Chinese leader Mr. Guan Chongqiong" you donated will be treasured by our museum for a long time. This certificate is specially issued as a commemoration.

f144a6ffe28bff6b937adc9a6adf5de71e2f88a3.sourceText: 这本《收藏证书》一直被关家珍藏着，从未有对外公开。直至2019年，97岁的关丽壁女士去世，年愈八十的关秀玉女士把这本纪念册交给我，这是一个十分信任的托付！我小心翼翼地接在手中，并通过摄影和复印，把这些资料记载下来，通过媒体向大众展示。
f144a6ffe28bff6b937adc9a6adf5de71e2f88a3.translatedText: This "Certificate of Collection" has been treasured by the Guan family and has never been made public. Until 2019, when 97-year-old Ms. Guan Libi passed away, Ms. Guan Xiuyu, who was turning 80, gave me this commemorative album. This is a trustworthy trust! I carefully took it in my hands, recorded it through photography and photocopying, and presented it to the public through the media.

77e6c2562db5266dbddf83b102cb4be9240abc64.sourceText: 资料中的这批1942年中国空军留美第二批毕业的空军，回国后成为了中国空军抗日的组成部分，1943年和美国空军组成“中美空军混合大队”，隶属于十四航空大队（又称“飞虎队），在祖国的蓝天和日本帝国空军进行殊死的战斗，直至牺牲。
77e6c2562db5266dbddf83b102cb4be9240abc64.translatedText: The second group of airmen who graduated from the Chinese Air Force in the United States in 1942 returned to China and became part of the Chinese Air Force's anti-Japanese force. In 1943, they formed a "Chinese and American Air Force Mixed Group" with the U.S. Air Force and were affiliated with the 14th Air Force Group (also known as the "Flying Tigers"). They fought desperately against the Imperial Japanese Air Force in the blue sky of the motherland until they died.

0c6f28e92892b18bf248aa8acbdded27009f96ba.sourceText: 数十年后，这些亲笔签名的军人照片已成为中国抗战历史的见证，为这些英雄的后人提供了宝贵的资料，也记载在那个中华民族生死存亡的年代，凤凰城华人为祖国抗战所作出过的贡献！
0c6f28e92892b18bf248aa8acbdded27009f96ba.translatedText: Decades later, these autographed military photos have become witnesses of the history of China’s Anti-Japanese War, providing valuable information for the descendants of these heroes. They also record the contributions made by Chinese people in Phoenix to the motherland’s Anti-Japanese War in that era when the Chinese nation was at stake!

e93e066e71e6d4a088ef5ea33a5bb8cb0a829ba5.sourceText: 英国奢侈品巨头巴宝莉公司周二警告称，巴宝莉公司销售量减少且利润降低，全球市场需求变得疲软，它的股价下跌了21%。一个重要原因：亚太市场需求，尤其是中国市场，已经不再是当初那种火箭般的增长速度了。巴宝莉公司说，亚太市场的销售量在第一财政季度上涨了18%，这只是一年前增速的一半。
e93e066e71e6d4a088ef5ea33a5bb8cb0a829ba5.translatedText: British luxury goods giant Burberry warned on Tuesday that sales and profits fell as global market demand weakened, sending its shares down 21%. An important reason: Asia-Pacific market demand, especially the Chinese market, is no longer growing at the same rocket-like rate as before. Burberry said sales in the Asia-Pacific market rose 18% in the first fiscal quarter, which was half the growth rate a year ago.

1a2b8a05faaaddac984242692bcab0fc4878f240.sourceText: 中国近三年来最慢的经济增长已经抑制了消费。总体而言，中国8月份的零售额增长了13%，达到了1.67万亿元，而去年同期的增速却高达17%。但分析人士指出，其他因素也影响到了高端奢侈品市场，比如社会风气的转变，以及对富人花钱更加广泛的公众审查力度。富人和他们的情妇们一直是宝石和名贵皮包的忠实消费者，但根据汇丰银行最近的一份报告显示，包二奶和养情人的风气在中国逐渐衰落。
1a2b8a05faaaddac984242692bcab0fc4878f240.translatedText: China's slowest economic growth in nearly three years has curbed consumption. Overall, China's retail sales increased by 13% in August to 1.67 trillion yuan, compared with a growth rate of 17% in the same period last year. But analysts say other factors are also affecting the high-end luxury market, such as changing social climate and greater public scrutiny of the money spent by the wealthy. The rich and their mistresses have always been loyal consumers of gemstones and expensive leather bags, but according to a recent report from HSBC, the culture of having mistresses and lovers is gradually declining in China.

2c2e3ef484ba6f34163d638f6ad09d96d9b1a847.sourceText: 在中国商人和官员中，赠送奢侈礼品是一种很常见的送礼方式，而这也被置于公众的监督之下。里昂证券亚太市场公司（CLSA Asia-Pacific Markets）分析家费舍尔（Aaron Fischer）称，这种监督降低了对奢侈礼品的需求，比如珠宝和名表。这家公司称，从去年6月到今年6月间购买奢侈品的消费者中，有16%的人承认这些奢侈品是作为商业合作的礼品。
2c2e3ef484ba6f34163d638f6ad09d96d9b1a847.translatedText: Luxurious gifts are a common practice among Chinese businessmen and officials, and are subject to public scrutiny. Aaron Fischer, an analyst at CLSA Asia-Pacific Markets, said such oversight has reduced demand for luxury gifts, such as jewelry and watches. The company said that 16% of consumers who purchased luxury goods from June last year to June this year admitted that these luxury goods were given as gifts for business cooperation.

583ce361233c2c179ff2e18d1177011be46da80c.sourceText: 中国领导层一直在呼吁政府官员停止消费奢侈品。据新华社消息，7月份，中国政府出台法规禁止公务员挪用政府资金购买奢侈品。
583ce361233c2c179ff2e18d1177011be46da80c.translatedText: China’s leadership has been calling on government officials to stop consuming luxury goods. According to Xinhua News Agency, in July, the Chinese government issued regulations prohibiting civil servants from misappropriating government funds to purchase luxury goods.

0f2704c036a8e84f5520ea880c65eb78a19b6644.sourceText: 自从去年2月亚省华人合唱团成立以来，在古雅瑜女士的辛勤指导下，已有成员40多位，合唱水平不断提高。并在第一华人浸信会，新东方艺术学校和康乐大厦建立了3个排练场地，有国语和粤语两大团队。在此，特别感谢以上3个单位对亚省华人合唱团以及本地区华人的业馀文娱生活的支持和帮助。 亚省华人合唱团成立以来，先后参加了大小不同的演出。参加了去年由新东方艺术学校主办的春节晚会，亚省华人华侨总会举办的庆中秋迎国庆舞会，亚省华人华侨联合总会举办的庆中秋迎国庆舞会，以及由亚省时报等10多个单位主办的庆中秋宴会。也即将在由新东方艺术学校和孔子学院主办的2012春节晚会上再次亮相(2012年1月21日，週六，晚7:00点)，同时也将在本地世界级乐器博物馆为庆祝中国新年举办的表演会上大放歌喉(2012年1月28日，週六，早11:00点，下午1:00点)。 为了进一步壮大合唱团的组织，提高合唱团的演唱水平，热烈欢迎所有对合唱音乐有兴趣的男女老少加入我们的行列，在这块华人业馀文娱生活的平台上，多享受一份交流和歌唱的乐趣。 联繫人： 古雅瑜：yayukhoe@yahoo.com 602-214-9793 黎景辉: kflai602@yahoo.com 480-203-6807 陈志钢：chenzhigang2000@yahoo.com 480-242-7863
0f2704c036a8e84f5520ea880c65eb78a19b6644.translatedText: Since the establishment of the Alberta Chinese Choir in February last year, under the hard guidance of Ms. Gu Yayu, there have been more than 40 members, and the level of chorus has been continuously improved. Three rehearsal venues have been established at the First Chinese Baptist Church, New Oriental Art School and Connaught Building, with two major teams, Mandarin and Cantonese. Here, I would like to express my special thanks to the above three units for their support and help to the Chinese Choir in Alberta and the amateur cultural and entertainment life of Chinese in this region. Since its establishment, the Alberta Chinese Chorus has participated in performances of various sizes. I participated in the Spring Festival Gala hosted by New Oriental Art School last year, the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day Ball held by the Chinese Federation of Alberta, the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day Ball held by the Chinese Federation of Alberta, and the Mid-Autumn Festival Banquet hosted by more than 10 organizations including the Alberta Times. It will also appear again at the 2012 Spring Festival Gala hosted by the New Oriental Art School and the Confucius Institute (January 21, 2012, Saturday, 7:00 pm), and will also sing at a local world-class musical instrument museum to celebrate the Chinese New Year (January 28, 2012, Saturday, 11:00 am, 1:00 pm). In order to further strengthen the organization of the choir and improve the singing level of the choir, we warmly welcome all men, women and children who are interested in choral music to join us and enjoy more communication and singing fun on this platform of Chinese amateur entertainment life. Contact: Gu Yayu: yayukhoe@yahoo.com 602-214-9793 Li Jinghui: kflai602@yahoo.com 480-203-6807 Chen Zhigang: chenzhigang2000@yahoo.com 480-242-7863

74d3f65ac78344ddfd7f0d797a362a30d8231d61.sourceText: 吉林省长就火灾道歉 长春市长做检讨 据中国之声《央广新闻》报道，吉林德惠禽类加工厂6/3特大爆炸燃烧事故国务院调查组第一次全体会议今天上午九点在长春召开。事故调查组组长、国家安监总局局长杨栋梁，吉林省省长巴音朝鲁，以及监察部、最高人民检察院、全国总工会等部门的负责人参加会议。 调查组起立向遇难者默哀 杨栋梁代表调查组，对遇难人员表示哀悼，对遇难者家属和受伤人员表示慰问。他提议现场人员起立，向遇难者默哀。 杨栋梁说，目前事故现场的清理搜救基本结束，转入全面救治伤员。现场的液氨争取今天天黑前全部转移走。 数十工人无法逃生死在车间门口 杨栋梁在发言中细数事故企业宝源丰存在的问题，包括不顾职工安全，冒险组织作业，在两个车间有数百名工人，如此劳动密集，但没有安全措施保障；企业安全制度不健全、不落实，安全意识淡薄，特别是对于防火、防泄漏，没有有效的措施；工厂车间从设计、建材选择、建设，一直到投产验收，都存在严重的问题；企业管理混乱，消防通道、安全出口不畅通；用工混乱，没有安全培训，没有逃生演习，很多人是因为无法逃生，死在车间门口。他说，”教训极其深刻，实在让人痛心。” 杨栋梁说，遇难者大都是农民工，农民工的生命是宝贵的，但企业只是把他们当作廉价劳动力，不顾安全盲目追求利润，只是一味做工，他说：”不能眼睛只盯着税收。没有安全，谈什么发展？谈什么和谐社会？这是底线。”他表示，企业主体责任不能逃脱，政府监督责任不可推卸。 国务院调查组第一次会议召开，标志着调查工作全面启动。杨栋梁表示，将以高度负责的态度，接受人民群众和新闻媒体的监督，给遇难者家属真诚、负责的交代。调查结果要经得起历史、时间、实践和人民群众的检验。 企业隐患突出 事故绝非偶然 针对公众关心的事故原因，杨栋梁说，这起特别重大火灾事故的直接原因目前还需要调查，火源在哪、是直接着火还是爆炸引起火灾，都需要调查取证、分析判断。目前消防专家和化工专家等都有到场开展工作。宝源丰公司的法人代表已经被依法控制，资产、资金已经冻结，全部执照吊销，并且实施了现场保护和资料封存。 杨栋梁说，事故企业宝源丰的隐患其实是突出的，事故不是偶然，而是必然的，因为平时检查不细、隐患排查不落实。如果有一个环节把住了，也不会是这样的结果，比如，车间门如果能开，就不会死这么多人。 车间打不开阻碍逃生 是否上锁需调查 杨栋梁介绍，事故现场最早发现遇难四十多人，后来发现其他很多人的遗体都堆在车间门口，导致遇难人数一下增加到上百人。而至于门当时是不是锁着，需要再调查，目前来看起码是门打不开、人出不来。 在会上，长春市市长姜治莹做出检讨，他表示不会文过饰非、回避问题，要处理好善后，配合调查组工作。吉林省省长巴音朝鲁表示自责和道歉。他说，深感工作中的差距和问题，政府监管存在很多漏洞，要深刻反思。 全国总工会副主席张鸣起说，初步发现事故企业存在漠视职工生命安全、违反安全生产的法律法规，相关制度不落实的问题。他提出，在善后工作中，对于遇难工人，不管体制内外、用工方式、来自城市还是乡村，都要一视同仁，同一个标准赔偿。 杨栋梁和张鸣起都提到，这次事故发生在禽类加工厂，不是传统的高危行业，但造成如此严重的伤亡，尤其值得警醒。 最高人民检察院副厅级检察员杨书文表示，会严查涉及到的失职渎职问题。公安部消防局的负责人表示：要举一反三，遏制事故频发。 监察部副部长姚增科表示：问责不能情绪化，要依法依规，对官员”该追责追责，该保护的保护”。
74d3f65ac78344ddfd7f0d797a362a30d8231d61.translatedText: The governor of Jilin apologized for the fire, and the mayor of Changchun made a review. According to Voice of China's "Central Broadcasting News" report, the first plenary meeting of the State Council's investigation team on the 6/3 massive explosion and combustion accident at Jilin Dehui Poultry Processing Factory was held in Changchun at 9 a.m. this morning. Yang Dongliang, leader of the accident investigation team and director of the State Administration of Work Safety, Bayin Chaolu, governor of Jilin Province, and heads of departments such as the Ministry of Supervision, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the All-China Federation of Trade Unions attended the meeting. The investigation team stood up to mourn the victims. Yang Dongliang, on behalf of the investigation team, expressed condolences to the victims and condolences to the families of the victims and the injured. He suggested that everyone at the scene stand and observe a moment of silence for the victims. Yang Dongliang said that the clean-up and search and rescue operations at the accident scene have basically ended, and the comprehensive treatment of the injured has begun. We will try to move all the liquid ammonia on site before dark today. Dozens of workers were unable to escape and died at the door of the workshop In his speech, Yang Dongliang detailed the problems of the accident company Baoyuanfeng, including disregarding the safety of employees and taking risks to organize operations. There are hundreds of workers in two workshops. It is so labor-intensive but there are no safety measures to guarantee it; the company's safety system is not perfect and implemented, and safety awareness is weak, especially for fire prevention and leakage prevention. , there are no effective measures; there are serious problems in the factory workshop from design, building material selection, construction, to production acceptance; corporate management is chaotic, fire escapes and safety exits are not smooth; labor is chaotic, there is no safety training, and there are no escape drills. Many people died at the door of the workshop because they were unable to escape. He said, "The lessons are extremely profound and really sad." Yang Dongliang said that most of the victims were migrant workers. The lives of migrant workers are precious, but companies only regard them as cheap labor, blindly pursue profits regardless of safety, and just work blindly. He said: "We cannot just focus on taxes. Without safety, how can we talk about development? How can we talk about a harmonious society? This is the bottom line." He said that the main responsibility of enterprises cannot be evaded, and the responsibility of government supervision cannot be shied. The first meeting of the State Council's investigation team was held, marking the full launch of the investigation work. Yang Dongliang said that he will accept the supervision of the people and the news media with a highly responsible attitude and give a sincere and responsible explanation to the families of the victims. The survey results must withstand the test of history, time, practice and the people. The enterprise's hidden dangers are prominent and the accident is no accident. Regarding the cause of the accident that the public is concerned about, Yang Dongliang said that the direct cause of this particularly serious fire accident still needs to be investigated. Where the fire source is, whether it was a direct fire or an explosion caused the fire, all need to be investigated, evidence collected, analyzed and judged. Currently, fire experts and chemical experts are on site to carry out work. The legal representative of Baoyuanfeng Company has been controlled in accordance with the law, assets and funds have been frozen, all licenses have been revoked, and on-site protection and data sealing have been implemented. Yang Dongliang said that the hidden dangers of the accident enterprise Baoyuanfeng were actually outstanding. The accident was not accidental, but inevitable because the usual inspections were not careful and the investigation of hidden dangers was not implemented. If one link had been taken care of, the result would not have been like this. For example, if the workshop door could be opened, so many people would not have died. The workshop cannot be opened, hindering escape. Whether it is locked needs to be investigated. Yang Dongliang said that more than 40 people were first found dead at the accident site. Later, the bodies of many other people were found piled at the door of the workshop, causing the number of victims to increase to hundreds. As for whether the door was locked at the time, further investigation is needed. At present, it seems that at least the door cannot be opened and people cannot get out. At the meeting, Changchun Mayor Jiang Zhiying made a self-examination. He said that he would not make excuses or avoid problems, but would handle the aftermath and cooperate with the investigation team. Jilin Province Governor Bayin Chaolu expressed remorse and apologized. He said that he was deeply aware of the gaps and problems in his work and that there were many loopholes in government supervision and needed to reflect deeply. Zhang Mingqi, vice chairman of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions, said that it was initially found that the company involved in the accident ignored the safety of employees, violated laws and regulations on production safety, and did not implement relevant systems. He proposed that in the aftermath, workers who died should be treated equally and compensated according to the same standard, regardless of whether they were inside or outside the system, how they were employed, or whether they were from urban or rural areas. Both Yang Dongliang and Zhang Mingqi mentioned that this accident occurred in a poultry processing plant, which is not a traditional high-risk industry, but it caused such serious casualties, which is particularly worthy of vigilance. Yang Shuwen, deputy department-level prosecutor of the Supreme People's Procuratorate, said that the related issues of dereliction of duty and dereliction of duty will be strictly investigated. The person in charge of the Fire Department of the Ministry of Public Security said: It is necessary to draw inferences from one example to curb the frequent occurrence of accidents. Yao Zengke, deputy director of the Ministry of Supervision, said: Accountability should not be emotional, but must be in accordance with laws and regulations. Officials "should be held accountable and protected."

d59f89fda665438239934a6690eb8e7f21d18c53.sourceText: 感恩假期机票难求 专家：尽早订票 受到美国航空公司缩减航班的影响，今年感恩节的美国国内线机票难求，票价恐怕易涨难跌，专家提醒，想要在感恩节搭机与家人同聚的旅客最好赶快订机票。 机票与饭店竞标网站Priceline com分析师布莱恩表示，现在距11月22日感恩节还有七个星期，但全美各家航空公司的假期机票价格上涨了2.9%，在底特律转机的机票也涨了1%。来回往返底特律的平均票价是362美元，但某些航线更昂贵。 根据旅游情报网站Travelzoo.com统计，最便宜机票的旅行假期是11月13~16日、22~23日和28~29日。最昂贵的日期是11月21日和24~24日。 此外，专家提醒，旅客最好注意行李费的问题，有时最多可能让旅行成本暴增数百美元。西南航空仍然没有收取行李费。若是持有达美航空SkyMiles的美国运通卡旅客，您个人的第一件托运行李是免费的。不过，廉价航空的Spirit和Allegiant目前已针对托运和随身携带的行李收取费用。 据密西根美国汽车协会统计，去年约有130万名密西根居民在感恩节假期旅行，90%搭乘交通工具，8%搭飞机，其余搭乘火车、汽车和轮船。联邦运输局统计，在去年的感恩节假期，美国航空公司表现不错，准时到达的航班达创纪录的85.7%，仅周二的感恩节准时率降至78%。 今年感恩节的状况会如何?这取决于航空公司的合并、美国航空公司的劳资问题和11月份不可捉摸的气候。
d59f89fda665438239934a6690eb8e7f21d18c53.translatedText: It’s hard to find tickets for the Thanksgiving holiday. Experts: Book tickets as early as possible. Affected by the reduction of flights by American Airlines, it is difficult to find domestic tickets for Thanksgiving this year, and ticket prices may rise easily but not fall. Experts remind that travelers who want to fly with their families during Thanksgiving should book their tickets as soon as possible. Bryan, an analyst at Priceline.com, a website that bids for air tickets and hotels, said that there are still seven weeks until Thanksgiving on November 22, but holiday ticket prices on airlines across the United States have increased by 2.9%, and tickets for connecting flights in Detroit have also increased by 1%. The average round-trip fare to Detroit is $362, but some routes are more expensive. According to travel information website Travelzoo.com, the travel holidays with the cheapest air tickets are November 13-16, 22-23 and 28-29. The most expensive dates are November 21st and 24th~24th. In addition, experts remind travelers to pay attention to baggage fees, which can sometimes increase travel costs by hundreds of dollars. Southwest Airlines still doesn’t charge baggage fees. If you are a Delta SkyMiles American Express cardholder, your first checked bag is free. However, budget carriers Spirit and Allegiant currently charge fees for checked and carry-on bags. According to statistics from the American Automobile Association of Michigan, about 1.3 million Michigan residents traveled during the Thanksgiving holiday last year, 90% of whom traveled by public transportation, 8% by plane, and the remainder by train, car, and ship. According to statistics from the Federal Transportation Agency, American Airlines performed well during last year's Thanksgiving holiday, with a record 85.7% of flights arriving on time. Only on Tuesday, the on-time rate dropped to 78%. What will Thanksgiving look like this year? That depends on airline mergers, labor issues at American Airlines and the unpredictable weather in November.

8c5eda777387de81f2795de107210b5b36c1b380.sourceText: 破产屋数量已探底 七月持续减少 根据多个地产分析，大凤凰地区的破产屋数量持续减少，是房屋市场缓慢恢复的信号。在七月凤凰城地区的破产屋为3176套，而六月份为3887套。六七月份获得破产通知的房子大约在4000套左右，去年同期大凤凰地区是7800多套。七月份，总的市场上存在的破产屋是23300套，六月为25300，市场分析人员指出，第一破产屋数量减少，第二陆续出来的破产屋还包括是前几个月申请，还为来得及放到市场上的后续房屋。根据市场信息，在未来市场上还将有15850套破产屋会在市场上。在今年后续的几个月里，银行拥有的房屋数量会稳步减少。如有更多买房问题可电话咨询金信地产公司Tinna (480)287-0180 电子邮箱： goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
8c5eda777387de81f2795de107210b5b36c1b380.translatedText: The number of bankrupt homes has hit bottom and continues to decrease in July. According to multiple real estate analysts, the number of bankrupt homes in the greater Phoenix area continues to decrease, which is a sign of the slow recovery of the housing market. There were 3,176 bankruptcies in the Phoenix area in July, compared with 3,887 in June. There were approximately 4,000 houses that received bankruptcy notices in June and July, compared with more than 7,800 houses in the greater Phoenix area during the same period last year. In July, the total number of bankrupt houses on the market was 23,300, and in June it was 25,300. Market analysts pointed out that the first number of bankrupt houses decreased, and the second one was that the number of bankrupt houses that came out one after another included those that were applied for in the previous few months and were subsequent houses that had time to be put on the market. According to market information, there will be 15,850 bankrupt houses on the market in the future. The number of bank-owned homes will steadily decrease over the coming months of the year. 3beaef2125cc920de3cbbd4cf0cce2966c02dd86.translatedText: Mr. Cui: A loving and serious principal Author Shuai Zhiruo In December 2014, more than 400 member schools of the National Association of Chinese Schools in Phoenix...

121022de67f086bd949658934cb214b4e972a479.sourceText: 斐匿中文学校是本地区历史最悠久的中文学校。这次聚会崔校长给大家带来了一个好消息：大凤凰城侨联正在凤凰城中西部寻找合适校舍，学校将于今秋复课。与会的各校负责人都向崔校长表示祝贺，崔校长盛情邀请凤凰城所有中文学校的负责人出席该校复课仪式，在场的各校负责人纷纷表示，到时一定出席庆祝仪式。
121022de67f086bd949658934cb214b4e972a479.translatedText: Feinian Chinese School is the oldest Chinese school in the region. At this gathering, Principal Cui brought everyone good news: the Overseas Chinese Federation of Greater Phoenix is ​​looking for a suitable school building in the central and western part of Phoenix, and the school will resume classes this fall. The heads of each school present at the meeting expressed their congratulations to Principal Cui. Principal Cui warmly invited the heads of all Chinese schools in Phoenix to attend the school's resumption ceremony. The heads of the schools present expressed that they would definitely attend the celebration ceremony.

334e9fc66ed355ae1402b39fbf55c9db6f948e0b.sourceText: 大家再也没有想到，还没到8月学校复课，令人尊敬的崔校长却已仙逝，今年元旦崔校长与华文教育界同仁们的见面竟然是最后一次会面，怎不令人痛惜万分！
334e9fc66ed355ae1402b39fbf55c9db6f948e0b.translatedText: Everyone has never thought that before the school resumed classes in August, the respected Principal Cui has passed away. The meeting between Principal Cui and colleagues in the Chinese education field on New Year's Day this year turned out to be the last meeting. How can it not be extremely sad!

9c59bf4a7718935ec8ff99385d691384ad3082a1.sourceText: 近几年来，凤凰城的六所中文学校负责人形成了一个习惯，每年开学之前大家聚在一起交流讨论华文教育事宜，相互之间已经形成友谊。同仁们对崔校长特别尊重，他微笑和善的面容、礼貌诚恳的态度，使人感到特别容易接近；崔校长年近八旬，仍然投身于华文教育，辛辛苦苦、认认真真地工作，可以说为传承中华语言文化鞠躬尽瘁，工作到生命的最后一息。
9c59bf4a7718935ec8ff99385d691384ad3082a1.translatedText: In recent years, the heads of the six Chinese schools in Phoenix have formed a habit of gathering together to discuss Chinese education issues before the start of each school year, and friendship has been formed between them. Colleagues have special respect for Principal Cui. His kind smile and polite and sincere attitude make people feel particularly approachable. Principal Cui is nearly eighty years old and still devotes himself to Chinese education. He works hard and conscientiously. It can be said that he devoted himself to the inheritance of Chinese language and culture until the last breath of his life.

e455eb39b603ac4c37e8920324d553f263446651.sourceText: 近日，校长们纷纷通过各种方式表达对崔老师的敬佩和悼念之意。大家记得，就在3月26日，崔校长送来电邮，说按照元旦校长们聚会时的提议，侨联已经把青少年绘画比赛提前到4月底，请校长们转发比赛消息。希望中文学校的田校长说，这是崔先生最后的遗愿，我们一定好好配合支持，让更多的学生参加这次比赛，也是对崔老师表示慰籍之意。崔老师是我们华文教育工作者学习的楷模，我们永远怀念您。（作者帅致若：全美中文学校协会第10届会长、全美中文学校协会凤凰城地区联络中心负责人）
e455eb39b603ac4c37e8920324d553f263446651.translatedText: Recently, principals have expressed their admiration and condolences to Teacher Cui in various ways. Everyone remembers that on March 26, Principal Cui sent an email saying that in accordance with the proposal of the principals’ gathering on New Year’s Day, the Overseas Chinese Federation has advanced the youth painting competition to the end of April, and asked the principals to forward the competition news. Principal Tian of Hope Chinese School said that this was Mr. Cui’s last wish. We will definitely cooperate and support him so that more students can participate in this competition. This is also a way to express his condolences to Mr. Cui. Teacher Cui is a role model for our Chinese language educators to learn from, and we will miss you forever. (Author Shuai Zhiruo: The 10th President of the National Association of Chinese Schools and the person in charge of the Phoenix Area Contact Center of the National Association of Chinese Schools)

517ad85d6b77d97fae573935d328041f4e2ede19.sourceText: 问: 购屋要慎选地区，请问该如何得知某地区的经济、治安状况，环境是否安全等问题? 答: 很多资讯都可以在互联网上免费取得，像是: www.CrimeReports.com 、www.FamilyWatchDog.us 这两个网站，只要输入您想查询的房屋地址，便会以地图的方式显示出附近的犯罪活动地点、性罪犯的照片、罪行及住家地址等资料，至于地区的经济、人口状况，则可以在www.BestPlaces.net 这个网站中找到资讯。

How can you know the economic and security conditions of a certain area, whether the environment is safe, etc.? Answer: A lot of information can be obtained for free on the Internet, such as: www.CrimeReports.com, www.FamilyWatchDog.us For these two websites, as long as you enter the address of the house you want to check, a map will display nearby criminal activity locations, photos of sex offenders, crimes, home addresses and other information. 49f2f2209b451850ad405ec6aa63b7f35d02cfb5.sourceText: 问: 什麽是Home Inspection? 答: Home Inspection(房屋检查)可以让购屋者对屋况有一个详细和整体性的瞭解，一位合格的专业房屋检查员可以为您提供深入、公正的房屋检查报告，报告上应该要记载关于房屋结构的状况，列出什麽东西需要修理或更换，并对一些主要设备，诸如冷气机、暖炉、热水炉等设备的状况做出一个评估。在亚利桑那的制式化购屋合约中，已预先列出买屋者在购屋合约成立后的10天内有权利做专业房屋检查，并依据检查结果要求售屋者改善，或做出是否购买的决定，所以Home Inspection是对购屋者的一个保障。
49f2f2209b451850ad405ec6aa63b7f35d02cfb5.translatedText: Question: What is Home Inspection? Answer: Home Inspection allows home buyers to have a detailed and comprehensive understanding of the condition of the house. A qualified professional home inspector can provide you with an in-depth and impartial home inspection report. The report should record the condition of the house structure, list what needs to be repaired or replaced, and make an assessment of the condition of some major equipment, such as air conditioners, heaters, water heaters, etc. In Arizona's standardized home purchase contract, it is stated in advance that the home buyer has the right to have a professional home inspection within 10 days after the home purchase contract is established, and based on the inspection results, the home seller will be required to make improvements or make a decision on whether to purchase. Therefore, Home Inspection is a guarantee for home buyers.

b31f66608f0d0f230c30eccd36b46b0f91e3cc66.sourceText: 据悉，这份声明并没有提供两艘船为何差点撞上的细节。不过据CNN报道，美军导弹巡洋舰在作业时，因为一艘中国海军舰艇的逼近不得不停下。但声明指出，这次事件将促使双方加强对?#33322;海技术专业最高标准?#30340;了解，包括船舶之间的通信，以减低意外的事故或事故的风险。

23955fded7fb00759e619156d568fbdf72820398.translatedText: Explanation of terms related to real estate In the process of buying and selling houses, we will hear or see some terms related to real estate. How much do you know about these words and terms...

b2eaba8733c56b1429660f3c88651ab125f401ef.sourceText: 房地产相关的用语解释 在买卖房屋的过程中，我们会听到或看到一些和房地产相关的用语，您对这些词汇、用语了解多少呢? 请参考以下问与答，或许能对您的房产交易有所帮助。 问: 什么是 REO? 答: REO是Real Estate Owned的缩写，简单的说它就是银行持有的房屋，也就是所谓的Bank Owned，Foreclosure时银行收回的房子。 问: 什麼是Appraisal ( 估價)? 答: Appraisal是由領有執照的專業估價師，在某一特定日期、對某一指定的房地產標的所做出的評估市價報告。 问：什麼是AS-IS? 答: 房產交易若有AS-IS條款，代表買賣雙方同意本次交易不對該房產做任何的維修、改進，賣方依然要提供已知問題給買方，買方也依然保有檢查該房產、並做出決定購買與否的權利。 问: 什麼是COE ( 交屋日)? 答: COE是Close of Escrow的簡稱，是房產交易的最後一個步驟，依照買賣雙方同意的條件，在交屋日由Escrow Company處理交、付款，登記產權的程序。
b2eaba8733c56b1429660f3c88651ab125f401ef.translatedText: Explanation of terms related to real estate In the process of buying and selling houses, we will hear or see some terms related to real estate. How much do you know about these terms and terms? Please refer to the following questions and answers, which may be helpful to your real estate transaction. Q: What is REO? A: REO is the abbreviation of Real Estate Owned. Simply put, it is a house owned by a bank, also known as Bank Owned. Foreclosure is a house repossessed by the bank. Q: What is an Appraisal? A: An Appraisal is a market value report on a specified real estate subject made by a licensed professional appraiser on a specific date. Q: What is AS-IS? A: If there is an AS-IS clause in a real estate transaction, it means that the buyer and seller agree not to make any repairs or improvements to the property in this transaction. The seller still has to provide known problems to the buyer, and the buyer still retains the right to inspect the property and make a decision whether to purchase it. Q: What is COE (Closed of Escrow)? A: COE is the abbreviation of Close of Escrow. It is the last step in the real estate transaction. According to the conditions agreed by the buyer and seller, the Escrow Company handles the handover, payment, and registration of property rights on the handover date.

fbfbba75ca3096e8f5d5b191ad3ff4a215a277c9.sourceText: 上海棗中国政府本月宣布将对房价进行新一轮调控，社交网站上充满了房主的抱怨声。为了在规定生效前售出自己的房产，他们在房管局前排起了长队。
fbfbba75ca3096e8f5d5b191ad3ff4a215a277c9.translatedText: Shanghai: The Chinese government this month announced a new round of housing price controls, and social networking sites were filled with complaints from homeowners. In order to sell their properties before the regulations came into effect, they queued up in front of the housing authority.

18649a7c3f3e5eae86dc3c50ad4392ecd42c3670.sourceText: 有些夫妇甚至采取了更加极端的做法：离婚。
18649a7c3f3e5eae86dc3c50ad4392ecd42c3670.translatedText: Some couples even take a more extreme approach: divorce.

1cb9e4073ae502ef31249d0fd9d632541978bfd9.sourceText: 按照新规定，个人售房将按转让所得利润征收20%的税。有谣传说，避免缴纳这一税款的办法之一就是与配偶离婚，至少在名义上离婚。于是，上海及中国各大城市过去一周的离婚申请出现急剧上升。
1cb9e4073ae502ef31249d0fd9d632541978bfd9.translatedText: According to the new regulations, individuals selling houses will be taxed at 20% on the profits gained from the transfer. Rumor has it that one way to avoid paying this tax is to divorce your spouse, at least in name only. As a result, divorce applications in Shanghai and major Chinese cities have risen sharply in the past week.

a68cb225dca02a92c28ffde4ed90fe75d4f3d3e7.sourceText: 离婚急剧增加，又一次显示了过去10年来，房地产问题已经变得多么不稳定，也说明了民众是多么反对新增税种。
a68cb225dca02a92c28ffde4ed90fe75d4f3d3e7.translatedText: The sharp increase in divorces once again shows how unstable the real estate issue has become over the past decade and how opposed the public is to new taxes.

2fe83a2f11298d1e8ef6a61c7b6c8868a39e394f.sourceText: 因为担心房价上升到失控状态并对社会稳定造成威胁，中央政府不断出台一些旨在遏制需求，制止投机的政策。
2fe83a2f11298d1e8ef6a61c7b6c8868a39e394f.translatedText: Worried that housing prices would rise out of control and threaten social stability, the central government has continuously introduced policies aimed at curbing demand and curbing speculation.

ab7ae8d25e2aa7b83cf550f630e51255a3fa036d.sourceText: 购房者、卖房者、房地产开发商，甚至包括通常严重依赖出售土地来取得收入的地方政府，则试图寻找规避政府限制的途径。
ab7ae8d25e2aa7b83cf550f630e51255a3fa036d.translatedText: Home buyers, home sellers, real estate developers, and even local governments, which often rely heavily on selling land for revenue, are trying to find ways to circumvent government restrictions.

9e11f564758bc58ca17b82b1a446b9ea4800d2a7.sourceText: ”他们总是这么做，”瑞信(Credit Suisse)驻香港的房地产分析师杜劲松说，”每当新政策出台，人们总是会想方设法绕开规定。”
9e11f564758bc58ca17b82b1a446b9ea4800d2a7.translatedText: "They always do this," said Du Jinsong, a Hong Kong-based real estate analyst at Credit Suisse. "Whenever new policies are introduced, people always find ways to get around the regulations."

ba3005ecbca42e9f242b34e1af61c3518eb8732a.sourceText: 过去10年，中国房地产市场一直是经济增长的重要引擎，而近来的房价飙升却引起了人们对不平等和房地产泡沫的担忧。
ba3005ecbca42e9f242b34e1af61c3518eb8732a.translatedText: China's real estate market has been an important engine of economic growth over the past decade, but the recent surge in housing prices has raised concerns about inequality and a housing bubble.

daeedbff806bada64d1db0f42646627b9f80f3aa.sourceText: 3月1日，在中国年度两会召开的前几天，重权在握的国务院（由温家宝总理领导）宣布了一系列新的房地产政策。分析人士称，这些政策震动了房产市场。
daeedbff806bada64d1db0f42646627b9f80f3aa.translatedText: On March 1, just days before China’s annual Two Sessions, the all-powerful State Council (led by Premier Wen Jiabao) announced a series of new real estate policies. Analysts say these policies have shaken the housing market.

7fbe7b6374becb0b4790330ee5cbbd5bb5b8cc40.sourceText: 国务院在声明中称，当地政府应该严格执行此前发布的一项规定，即出售二手房应按转让所得利润上缴20%的税。
7fbe7b6374becb0b4790330ee5cbbd5bb5b8cc40.translatedText: The State Council said in a statement that local governments should strictly implement a previously issued regulation that requires a 20% tax on the profits from the transfer of second-hand houses.

0f61036aa79794b55ac8c8cbe9a79abdf108d45d.sourceText: 各大城市的房管局和房地产交易中心顿时挤满了希望在规定生效以前把房子卖出去的人。（大多数地方政府都尚未宣布政策生效日期。）
0f61036aa79794b55ac8c8cbe9a79abdf108d45d.translatedText: Housing authorities and real estate transaction centers in major cities were suddenly crowded with people hoping to sell their houses before the regulations took effect. (Most local governments have yet to announce effective dates for their policies.)

c7e6c4cc75e672a12d9d39550e3fa43d3112c524.sourceText: 更怪异的事情发生了。上海、南京、武汉及其他各大城市的婚姻登记处也都挤满了离婚的人，他们承认是为了逃避房产税而假离婚。
c7e6c4cc75e672a12d9d39550e3fa43d3112c524.translatedText: Something weirder happened. Marriage registration offices in Shanghai, Nanjing, Wuhan and other major cities are also crowded with divorcees who admit to falsifying divorces to avoid property taxes.

15d4846aae4edf4c7f2e6dac38550a546a58cabd.sourceText: 很多人解释说，拥有两套房的夫妻申请离婚后，可以宣称他们每人只有一套房。这样，他们就可以避免其中一套房被列为第二套房。根据新规定，如果第二套房售出，他们就必须按售房所得利润上缴20%的税款。离婚后，他们卖掉手上的一套房，然后可以再复婚。
15d4846aae4edf4c7f2e6dac38550a546a58cabd.translatedText: Many people explain that after a couple who owns two homes files for divorce, they can claim that they each only have one home. This way, they can avoid one of their homes being listed as a second home. According to the new regulations, if the second home is sold, they must pay 20% tax on the profit from the sale. After the divorce, they sold a house and could remarry.

0b65d0dc1b7ccd97ff095573c065493dca82dbf9.sourceText: 上海闸北区的一家结婚登记处说，他们周二共接待了53对离婚申请，远远超出了正常水平。
0b65d0dc1b7ccd97ff095573c065493dca82dbf9.translatedText: A marriage registration office in Shanghai's Zhabei District said it received a total of 53 divorce applications on Tuesday, far exceeding the normal level.

e48e9093f26e675613ea45edbc5ecbda477e9c21.sourceText: 周五，33岁的弗兰西斯 陶(Frances Tao)与丈夫一同来到了浦东区的一家婚姻登记处。她承认他们是来申请离婚的，但不是为了逃避那20%的二手房交易税，而是为了绕开另一项限制政策，即买房者在购买第二套房时必须支付比买第一套房时高得多的首付。
e48e9093f26e675613ea45edbc5ecbda477e9c21.translatedText: On Friday, 33-year-old Frances Tao and her husband came to a marriage registration office in Pudong District. She admitted that they came to apply for divorce, but not to avoid the 20% second-hand housing transaction tax, but to bypass another restrictive policy, that is, when buying a second home, buyers must pay a much higher down payment than when buying the first home.

6f9b65f1e83718d53b3398ac718a47757666ffa5.sourceText: 弗兰西斯 陶说，通过离婚，他们其中一人就能按照买第一套房的政策买房，支付较低的首付，利率也较低。
6f9b65f1e83718d53b3398ac718a47757666ffa5.translatedText: Francis Tao said that through divorce, one of them can buy a house according to the policy of buying the first house, pay a lower down payment, and the interest rate is also lower.

a069048a9184856292ea6df800e5cbfb0860c7da.sourceText: ”我们别无选择，”弗兰西斯 陶说，”但是政府和开发商还是大把大把地挣钱。”
a069048a9184856292ea6df800e5cbfb0860c7da.translatedText: "We have no choice," said Francis Tao, "but the government and developers are still making a lot of money."

6f614bdf2fc9093f8830ba6147b867d37c705234.sourceText: Xu Yan对此文有报道贡献。
6f614bdf2fc9093f8830ba6147b867d37c705234.translatedText: Xu Yan contributed reporting to this article.

374eb599171c8a2ee5debbd1e6ac07cb95fcc8ac.sourceText: 龙的自述：和你说说我的前世今生（图）
374eb599171c8a2ee5debbd1e6ac07cb95fcc8ac.translatedText: Long’s Self-Report: Let me tell you about my past and present lives (pictures)

5c533c52028d52c0af1a258d1331649b79f999df.sourceText: 龙的自述：和你说说我的前世今生（图） （亚省时报） 你问我今年到底多大了，连我自己也说不清。而关于我家…
5c533c52028d52c0af1a258d1331649b79f999df.translatedText: Long’s Self-Report: Let’s tell you about my past and present lives (Pictures) (Alberta Times) You ask me how old I am this year, and even I can’t tell you. And about my family...

d77eb075698f4a1e2b6546f119d629fd7d8e2ef9.sourceText: 你问我今年到底多大了，连我自己也说不清。 而关于我家族的历史，也是经过我爷爷的爷爷一代代传下来的。 虽然世界上有很多地方都有我的族人，但只有在华夏大地，人们才以我为荣，奉我为尊，我也愿意与这块大地融为一体。 听说你们这里今年是以我之名纪年的龙年，我也就跟你们唠唠我的前世今生。 诞生篇： 合九物之形，存于意念之间 据我的先辈们说，在很久很久以前，我的祖先坠落人间，唯有伏地悲伤。 大量群众乃至达官贵人奔走数百十里，竞相围观这种巨型罕见的生物。 它腥味极重，满身鱼鳞，长着四只脚爪，嘴边有触须，头上有双角或独角，困蜿于地。 在陆地上，甚至连移动也有困难，像只丧家犬似的垂头丧气，当人们一桶桶地往它身上浇水时，它身上的鳞片也会为之开合，甚至能夹住围绕其身的 蝇蚁。 古代人民善良地为它搭棚，浇水以缓解其痛苦，直到它借滂沱大雨腾飞而去。 我的祖先是多种动物的综合体，原始社会就受到人类崇拜了。 具有虾眼、鹿角、牛嘴、狗鼻、鲶须、狮鬃、蛇尾、鱼鳞、鹰爪，九种动物合而为一又九不像的形象。 成长篇： 我们是由2爪变5爪的 我们的形象也是不断变化的，龙爪并非一开始就有五爪，而是历经各朝代从两爪到五爪发展过来的。 大概从7000年前到夏商周一直到秦汉，我们都是多为弯月形两爪。 从汉朝到隋唐，足多为三趾，这个形象基本就定格了直到元朝，你们​​看看唐、宋、元的瓷器上印的我们的身影就知道了。 从明清开始盛行四爪、五爪，不过只有皇家可使用五爪龙造型，民间只能用三爪或四爪龙的图案。 职能篇： 从汉代开始给你们当属相 除了能带给你们喜庆、吉祥、威武等等精神上的感觉，我还有个实实在在的工作能力棗纪年，既纪日夜星辰之年，也纪每一个人之年。 对于前者，把包括我在内的12生肖和12地支配起来就行了，轮到我就是”辰龙”，出生在这个年份的自然就属龙了。 而且我是12生肖中唯一非自然界的动物哦。 东汉王充提出了11个动物生肖，同一朝代的赵晔记有”吴在辰，其位龙”，恰好补上了”辰龙”，而成全了12生肖。 所以在东汉12生肖已经形成，至于12生肖的使用，至少在南北朝时代就已经出现。 我在12生肖中排老五，据说原本推牛为首，老鼠却蹿到牛背上，于是老鼠排第一，牛第二，虎、龙居三、四。 谁知兔子又不服，和我赛跑，结果排在了我的前面，我就屈居第五了。 富贵篇： 龙与帝王挂钩也是从汉朝 其实我们一家在你们的历史上也是荣耀之极。 各个朝代帝王称呼自己为”真龙天子”，龙也具有权力的象征。 与皇帝有关的事物也印上了龙的标记，如”龙床”、”龙颜”、”龙袍”等。 其实这还要从神话说起，传说中说人类始祖伏羲、女娲，皆龙身人首（或蛇身人首），又被称为”龙祖”, 其他先祖炎帝、黄帝，传说中和龙都有密切的关系，相传炎帝为其母感应”神龙首”而生，死后化为赤龙。 《史记》中说，黄帝和老百姓在首山采掘铜矿，把开采出来的铜铸成一只很大的铜鼎，放在荆山脚下。 铜鼎铸成时，有龙垂胡髯下迎黄帝，黄帝就骑到龙背上升天去了，作为炎黄子孙的中国人因而自称为”龙的传人”。 龙与帝王的联系从汉代始，刘邦告诉别人他父亲是赤龙。 从此，皇帝的身体叫”龙体”，脸叫”龙颜”，穿的衣服叫”龙袍”，坐的椅子叫”龙椅”，睡的床叫”龙床”，就连皇帝的子孙 也叫”龙子龙孙”。 到了元、明、清时期，皇帝龙袍上和宫殿中龙都成为五爪大龙。 不过中国的老百姓不喜欢代表皇权的龙，他们喜欢民间的我们，这种龙没有皇权的威严，它是一种吉祥的神物，能给人们带来欢乐和喜庆，这也是延续至今对我一家的 情感。
d77eb075698f4a1e2b6546f119d629fd7d8e2ef9.translatedText: If you ask me how old I am this year, even I can’t tell you. As for the history of my family, it has been passed down from generation to generation through my grandfather’s grandfather. Although my tribe is found in many places in the world, only in the land of China do people take pride in me and respect me, and I am willing to integrate with this land. I heard that this year here is the Year of the Dragon in my name, so I will tell you about my past and present life. Birth Chapter: The shape of nine things combined exists between thoughts. According to my ancestors, a long time ago, my ancestors fell into the world and could only lie on the ground in sorrow. A large number of people and even dignitaries traveled hundreds of miles to watch this giant and rare creature. It has a strong fishy smell, is covered with fish scales, has four claws, tentacles around its mouth, and has two or one horns on its head, which are stuck on the ground. On land, it even has difficulty moving, looking downcast like a bereaved dog. When people pour buckets of water on it, the scales on its body will open and close, and can even pinch the flies and ants surrounding it. The ancient people kindly built a shelter for it and watered it to ease its pain, until it took off under the heavy rain. My ancestors were a synthesis of many animals, and were worshiped by humans in primitive societies. It has shrimp eyes, antlers, an ox's mouth, a dog's nose, a catfish's whiskers, a lion's mane, a snake's tail, a fish's scales, and an eagle's claws. Nine animals merge into one and nine different images. Growth chapter: We changed from 2 claws to 5 claws. Our image is also constantly changing. The dragon claws did not have five claws at the beginning, but developed from two claws to five claws through various dynasties. From about 7,000 years ago to the Xia, Shang and Zhou Dynasties to the Qin and Han Dynasties, we mostly had two crescent-shaped claws. From the Han Dynasty to the Sui and Tang Dynasties, the feet mostly had three toes. This image was basically fixed until the Yuan Dynasty. You can see our figures printed on the porcelain of the Tang, Song and Yuan Dynasties. Four-clawed and five-clawed dragon designs have become popular since the Ming and Qing Dynasties. However, only the royal family can use the five-clawed dragon shape, while the folk can only use the three-clawed or four-clawed dragon pattern. Functions: I have given you the zodiac sign since the Han Dynasty. In addition to bringing you spiritual feelings of joy, auspiciousness, power, etc., I also have the practical ability of jujube to record the year, which not only records the year of the day and night, but also records the year of each person. For the former, just control the 12 zodiac signs and 12 places, including mine. When it is my turn, I will be "Chen Long", and anyone born in this year will naturally be a dragon. And I am the only non-natural animal among the 12 zodiac signs. Wang Chong of the Eastern Han Dynasty proposed 11 animal zodiac signs. Zhao Ye of the same dynasty recorded "Wu Zaichen, whose position is dragon", which just added "Chen Long" to complete the 12 zodiac signs. Therefore, the 12 zodiac signs have been formed in the Eastern Han Dynasty. As for the use of the 12 zodiac signs, it has appeared at least in the Northern and Southern Dynasties. I am the fifth among the 12 zodiac animals. It is said that the cow was originally pushed to be the first, but the mouse jumped on the cow's back, so the mouse ranked first, the cow second, and the tiger and dragon ranked third and fourth. Unexpectedly, the rabbit refused to accept it and raced with me. It ended up in front of me, and I was ranked fifth. Wealth and Honor: The association between dragons and emperors also dates back to the Han Dynasty. In fact, our family is also extremely glorious in your history. Emperors of various dynasties called themselves the "True Dragon Emperor", and the dragon also symbolized power. Things related to the emperor are also marked with dragon marks, such as "dragon bed", "dragon face", "dragon robe", etc. In fact, it starts with mythology. According to legend, the ancestors of mankind, Fuxi and Nuwa, both had the body of a dragon and a human head (or a snake body and a human head), and were also known as the "Dragon Ancestors." Other ancestors, Emperor Yan and Emperor Huang, are said to have a close relationship with dragons. According to legend, Emperor Yan was born after his mother sensed the "dragon head" and turned into a red dragon after his death. "Historical Records" says that the Yellow Emperor and the people mined copper mines in Shoushan Mountain, cast the mined copper into a large copper tripod, and placed it at the foot of Jingshan Mountain. When the bronze tripod was built, a dragon hung down from its beard to greet the Yellow Emperor, and the Yellow Emperor rode on the dragon's back and ascended to heaven. As descendants of the Yan and Huang emperors, the Chinese called themselves "descendants of the dragon." The relationship between dragons and emperors dates back to the Han Dynasty, when Liu Bang told others that his father was a red dragon. From then on, the emperor's body was called "dragon body", his face was called "dragon face", the clothes he wore were called "dragon robes", the chair he sat on was called "dragon chair", the bed he slept on was called "dragon bed", and even the emperor's descendants were called "dragon sons and grandsons". In the Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties, the dragons on the emperor's dragon robes and in the palace became five-clawed dragons. However, the Chinese people do not like the dragon that represents imperial power. They like us folk. This kind of dragon does not have the majesty of the imperial power. It is an auspicious creature that can bring joy and celebration to people. This is the emotion that continues to my family to this day.

e8048737c786f01a27f14ac1e0dab1f778fbdec3.sourceText: 唐詩宋词連綴: 餐館會中秋晚宴（凤城第一才子） 张肇鸿 露从今夜白 ， 月是故鄉明 。 西北望鄉何處是 ， 東南見月幾回圓 ？ 舉頭望明月 ， 高處不勝寒 ， 低頭思故鄉 ，故鄉在何方？ 身無彩鳳雙飛翼 ， 走馬蘭台類轉蓬 。 今夜月明人盡望 ，日久他鄉成故鄉？ 明月出天山 ， 蒼茫雲海間 。兒女離家遠， 愁思当告谁 ？ 不知乘月幾人歸 ？人有悲歡離合，月有陰晴圓缺，此事古難全！ 今夜清光似往年 ， 煙攏塞外月攏沙 ，驅車前往中秋宴， 夜泊秦淮近酒家 。《六福》門前多熱鬧，餐館會員聚一家， 秦時明月漢時關 ， 一夜鄉心五處同 。 塵中見月心亦閑 ， 群動悠然一顧中 。 不期而會重歡宴 ， 落花時節又逢君 。 鄉音無改鬓毛衰 ， 碧雲歸去認無踪 。誰問生意何境況？ 心有靈犀一點通 ！ 門前冷落車馬稀 ， 暮雲收盡溢清寒 ， 羌笛何須怨楊柳 ， 春風不度玉門關 ！ 餐館宴會節目豐，俊男演奏色時風：《月亮代表我的心》，吹破殘煙入夜風。手捧吉它再彈唱， 平陽歌舞新承寵 。 獨有鳳凰池上客 ， 初闻征雁已无蝉 ，美女粵曲唱入神， 大珠小珠落玉盤 。 低昂赴節随歌板 ， 一軒明月上簾櫳 。 鳳凰公主來獻藝， 峨嵋山月半輪秋 ，民間舞蹈〝老背少〞，爺爺背孫不禁風。演罷問伊何處人，西安姑娘陳伊恩， 獨在異鄉為異客 ， 每逢佳節倍思親 。 故園東望路漫漫 ，佳人舞罷說孝心:世間只見老背少，何日才能報親恩？ 洛陽親友如相問 ，今夜玉壶見冰心。 四川姑娘胡秋子，一襲旋舞四座惊， 美人胡為隔秋水 ， 焉得置之玉堂客 ？長袖揮出白云间， 一片孤城万仞山 。 曲折無心逐浪花 ， 海上明月共潮生 。掌聲響處弄清影， 一枝红艳露凝香 ，鳳凰佳麗冠亞季， 美人相并立瓊軒 。 但願人長久 ， 千里共嬋娟 。佳餚美味月餅甜，抽獎處處笑聲添， 輪欹影促猶頻望 ， 平分秋色一輪滿 。 玉颗珊珊下月輪 ， 花好月圓不夜天 。 彩雲易散琉璃脆 ， 長河漸落曉星沈 。 明朝人事隨日出 ， 明月何時照我還 ！？ 餐馆会中秋宴 胡秋子旋舞
e8048737c786f01a27f14ac1e0dab1f778fbdec3.translatedText: Tang poems and Song lyrics are connected: Mid-Autumn Festival Dinner in a Restaurant (The No. 1 Talent in Fengcheng) Zhang Zhaohong "The dew is white from tonight, and the moon is bright in my hometown." Where is the hometown in the northwest, and how full is the moon in the southeast? I raise my head to look at the bright moon, but it is too cold up there. I lower my head and think about my hometown. Where is my hometown? There are no colorful phoenix flying wings on the body, but the walking Malantai is like a turret. Tonight the moon is bright and everyone can see, will a foreign land become my hometown over time? The bright moon rises from the Tianshan Mountains, among the vast sea of ​​clouds. When your children are far away from home, who should you complain about? I wonder how many people will return by the moon? People have joys and sorrows, separations and reunions, the moon waxes and wanes, this is difficult to do in ancient times! Tonight the light is as clear as in previous years, the smoke is gathering outside the Great Wall, and the moon is gathering in the sand. I drive to the Mid-Autumn Festival banquet and spend the night in Qinhuai near a restaurant. There is a lot of liveliness in front of the "Lek Blessings". Members of the restaurant gather together, and the moon shines brightly during the Qin and Han dynasties. Seeing the moon in the dust, my heart is at ease, and I take a leisurely look at the group of movements. Unexpectedly, we will have a feast again, and we will see you again in the season of falling flowers. The local pronunciation has not changed, the hair on the temples has faded, and the green clouds have returned without a trace. Who asks how the business is doing? There is a clear understanding between the two minds! There are few cars and horses in front of the door, the dusk clouds have gathered and the cold is overflowing. Why should the Qiang flute blame the willows? The spring breeze does not pass through Yumen Pass! The restaurant banquet program was rich, and the handsome man played "The Moon Represents My Heart", which blew the remaining smoke into the night wind. Holding the guitar in hand and playing and singing again, Pingyang's singing and dancing become a new favorite. The unique visitor to the Phoenix Pond heard for the first time that there were no cicadas in the wild geese. The beautiful lady sang Cantonese opera in a trance, and the big and small beads fell on the jade plate. Go to the festival with a low head and follow the singing board, a bright moon hangs above the curtain. The Phoenix Princess came to perform, the half-moon in Mount Emei, the folk dance "Old Carry Young Man Back", and the grandpa carrying his grandson could not help but feel happy. After the performance, I asked Yi where she was from. Chen Yan, a girl from Xi'an, is a stranger in a foreign land. She misses her family even more during festive seasons. Looking eastward from my hometown, the road is long, and after dancing, the beautiful woman talks about her filial piety: Only the old and the young are seen in the world, when will I be able to repay my parents' kindness? Relatives and friends in Luoyang ask each other, and I see Bing Xin in the jade pot tonight. Hu Qiuzi, a girl from Sichuan, was astonished by her whirling dance. The beauty Hu was separated from the autumn water, so how could she be treated as a guest in the jade hall? The long sleeves waved out among the white clouds, an isolated city and Wanren Mountain. The twists and turns are careless, chasing the waves, and the bright moon on the sea rises with the tide. The shadows are clear where the applause is, a branch of red dew is fragrant, the phoenix beauty crowns the Asian season, and the beauties stand side by side in the palace. I hope that people will live forever and share the beauty of the moon thousands of miles apart. The delicacies are delicious, the mooncakes are sweet, the lottery draws are filled with laughter, and the shadows of the moonlight are constantly looked at, and the beauty is equally divided. Jade beads are shining under the moon wheel, and the moon is full and the sky is full of flowers. The colorful clouds are easy to scatter and the glass is crisp, and the long river gradually falls and the dawn stars sink. The personnel of the Ming Dynasty will rise with the sun. When will the bright moon shine on me again? ? Mid-Autumn Festival Banquet in the restaurant with Hu Qiuzi whirling dance

9c7eafe18b4005295e14e96cb16940bdab567b67.sourceText: 亚太健康促进会第六届慈善晚宴（图） 4月23日下午5点半在斯科茨代尔（Scottsdale）达博特里（Doubletree Paradise Valley Resort）举办了亚太健康促进会第六届慈善晚宴。资深侨领余文劲，侨务委员高志中，华裔医生廖峰，王馨欣等医生协会成员到场祝贺，并全力支持由华裔医生徐凯莱创办的亚太健康促进会，当晚大约有近400人参加了此次活动。 晚宴的第一部分是慈善义卖。很多具有东方特色的工艺品，生活用品，书画作品都在展示台上与买家们直接见面。这些义卖品有来自中国，日本，印度，泰国，缅甸等地。在拍卖过程中，四川画家李成现场创作的骏马图，受到了很多买家的关注，最后被拍卖到了600多美金。 当天晚上的慈善晚宴是活动的重点，晚宴上除了有美味的佳肴以外，还有很多让人感动的真实故事，让现场来宾度过了一个特别的夜晚。 2011年年亚太健康促进会以志愿者埃维塔 Saquilayan的名字命名了亚利桑那州立大学护士奖学金。每年都有一个品学兼优的学生获得这个奖学金。艾薇塔Saquilayan，2008年加入APCA董事会。她马上成为了APCA最积极活跃的志愿者。她在APCA的活动中最经常出现，工作也最刻苦，受到了很多好评。2010年她不幸去世，离开了我们。为了纪念埃维塔 Saquilayan，以及她在APCA里的精神，APCA设立了这个特别的护士奖学金，鼓励更多的亚裔学生像埃维塔 Saquilayan一样投入到医疗护理服务中去。在酒会上 2011年埃维塔 Saquilayan年获得奖学金的同学来到现场，接受这具有特殊意义的奖学金。 微芯片科技公司捐资支助华人二战退伍老兵，和华人小区志愿者丹尼斯议夫妇的医疗费用。当晚，芯片的首席执行官，斯蒂文（史蒂夫Sanghi）来到晚宴现场，APCA的创始人徐凯莱为斯蒂文颁发了荣誉奖章。斯蒂文用自己的亲身经历给大家讲述了一个在美国，有梦想就有希望的故事。斯蒂文出生印度的法律家庭，爸爸妈妈是法官和律师，家里没有人学工程类的学科，斯蒂文却疯狂爱上了当时的新科技技术，他选择了从工，来到了美国留学，参加了美国大学生的科技竞赛，也找到了自己事业发展的起点。在若干年后，在科技赛场上看到那些年轻的孩子，他就想到当时的自己。他怀抱着自己的梦想，一直在努力，在行业内作出了出色的成绩，现在他终于有能力去支持科技教育和医疗。他感谢美国给少数族裔一个实现梦想的平台，他可以来这里一起帮助那些有困难的朋友。斯蒂文的演讲迎来了全场热烈的掌声。 整个晚宴最动容的时刻，就在四位白发苍苍的二战退伍老兵走到领奖台上领奖。他们都是国家的功臣，从他们起立，缓慢的走上台开始，整个晚宴现场就爆发出雷鸣般的掌声。他们年轻的时候，为了国家的利益抛头颅洒热血，现在年纪大了，身体不好了，能有APCA联络到支持的单位来帮助他们解决健康医疗问题。受资助的华人小区志愿者余先生和余太太，他们义务为华人留学生服务，一干就是几十年，现在留学生都亲切地称他们为余爸爸和余妈妈，他们坚持不懈的努力，给我们创造了一个更加亲切的小区，他们也因此受到了华裔小区的敬仰。 这一天，讲故事和听故事的都和一群人有关系，亚太健康促进会的所有员工和志愿者。亚太健康促进会是亚裔健康慈善组织，每年都会通过这样的慈善义卖和晚宴来募捐医疗基金，今年已经是第六年。他们募集到的慈善基金用来为亚裔普及医疗讯息和健康常识，并提供一些免费的医疗服务。在过去几年中，APCA在糖尿病，心血管疾病，乙肝等检查方面做了大量的工作，并设立医学护理奖学金让更多人加入医疗事业当中。
9c7eafe18b4005295e14e96cb16940bdab567b67.translatedText: The 6th Charity Dinner of the Asia Pacific Health Promotion Association (photo) The 6th Charity Dinner of the Asia Pacific Health Promotion Association was held at 5:30 pm on April 23 at Doubletree Paradise Valley Resort in Scottsdale. Senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin, Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee member Gao Zhizhong, Chinese doctors Liao Feng, Wang Xinxin and other members of the medical association were present to congratulate and fully support the Asia-Pacific Health Promotion Association founded by Chinese doctor Xu Kailai. Nearly 400 people attended the event that night. The first part of the dinner was a charity sale. Many handicrafts, daily necessities, calligraphy and painting works with oriental characteristics are on the display stand to meet buyers directly. These charity items come from China, Japan, India, Thailand, Myanmar and other places. During the auction, the painting of a horse created by Sichuan painter Li Cheng attracted the attention of many buyers and was eventually auctioned for more than 600 US dollars. The charity dinner that night was the highlight of the event. In addition to delicious food, there were also many touching real stories, making the guests spend a special night. In 2011, the Asia Pacific Health Promotion Association named the ASU Nursing Scholarship after volunteer Evita Saquilayan. Every year, a student with excellent academic performance receives this scholarship. Evita Saquilayan joined the APCA Board of Directors in 2008. She immediately became APCA's most active volunteer. She appears most frequently in APCA activities, works the hardest, and receives a lot of praise. She unfortunately passed away in 2010 and left us. In order to commemorate Evita Saquilayan and her spirit in APCA, APCA established this special nursing scholarship to encourage more Asian students to devote themselves to medical nursing services like Evita Saquilayan. At the reception, the students who received the Evita Saquilayan scholarship in 2011 came to the scene to accept this scholarship of special significance. Microchip Technology Company donated funds to support the medical expenses of Chinese World War II veterans and Chinese community volunteer Dennis and his wife. That night, Chip's CEO, Steven (Steve Sanghi) came to the dinner, and APCA founder Xu Kailai presented Steven with a medal of honor. Steven used his own personal experience to tell everyone a story about how in the United States, where there is a dream, there is hope. Steven was born in a legal family in India. His parents were judges and lawyers. No one in the family majored in engineering. However, Steven fell madly in love with the new technologies at the time. He chose to work and came to the United States to study. He participated in technology competitions among American college students and found the starting point of his career development. A few years later, when he saw those young children in the technology arena, he thought of himself at that time. He has been working hard with his dream in mind and has made outstanding achievements in the industry. Now he finally has the ability to support science, technology, education and medical care. He thanked the United States for giving ethnic minorities a platform to realize their dreams and that he could come here to help friends in need. Steven's speech received warm applause from the audience. The most touching moment of the entire dinner was when four gray-haired World War II veterans walked up to the podium to receive their awards. They are all heroes of the country. From the moment they stood up and walked slowly onto the stage, the entire dinner venue burst into thunderous applause. When they were young, they sacrificed their lives and blood for the benefit of the country. Now that they are older and in poor health, APCA can contact supporting units to help them solve their health and medical problems. Mr. Yu and Mrs. Yu, the sponsored Chinese community volunteers, have volunteered to serve Chinese international students for decades. Now the international students affectionately call them Father Yu and Mother Yu. Their unremitting efforts have created a more friendly community for us, and they are admired by the Chinese community for this. On this day, storytellers and storytellers are connected to a group of people, all staff and volunteers of the Asia Pacific Health Promotion Association. The Asia Pacific Health Promotion Association is an Asian health charity organization that raises funds for medical funds through charity sales and dinners every year. This is the sixth year. The charitable funds they raise are used to popularize medical information and health knowledge for Asians, and provide some free medical services. In the past few years, APCA has done a lot of work in screening for diabetes, cardiovascular disease, hepatitis B, etc., and has established medical nursing scholarships to allow more people to join the medical career.

66fc8409ecdd8692d7b78d3060981d7879e00ef3.sourceText: ( 本网讯)２０１３年Tempe龙舟大赛于３月２３日早７时，在Tempe Lake展开赛事。今年不仅是美国国内的龙舟队伍参加比赛，远到加拿大的朋友到现场参加。资深侨领尹衍桓，资深华裔主持John Tang，以及亚裔房地产协会创会会长张圣仪都被邀请参加了开幕仪式。尹衍桓已经支持了龙舟比赛近十年，她回忆十年前刚刚准备龙舟比赛，两只龙舟的运费就要好几万美金，当年的台湾台北市市长，现在的台湾总统马英九，就为凤凰城华人捐赠了两只龙舟，并运送到凤凰城。这个组织了十年的龙舟赛，已经成为了一项国际赛事。尹衍桓和Tempe市议员应邀共同为龙舟赛点睛。
66fc8409ecdd8692d7b78d3060981d7879e00ef3.translatedText: ( News from this website) The 2013 Tempe Dragon Boat Race will start at 7 a.m. on March 23 at Tempe Lake. This year, not only dragon boat teams from the United States participated in the competition, but friends from as far away as Canada came to participate. Senior overseas Chinese leader Yin Yanhuan, senior Chinese host John Tang, and founding president of the Asian Real Estate Association Zhang Shengyi were all invited to attend the opening ceremony. Yin Yanhuan has supported the dragon boat race for nearly ten years. She recalled that when she was just preparing for the dragon boat race ten years ago, the shipping cost for two dragon boats was tens of thousands of dollars. Ma Ying-jeou, the mayor of Taipei, Taiwan, and now the president of Taiwan, donated two dragon boats to the Chinese people in Phoenix and shipped them to Phoenix. This dragon boat race, which has been organized for ten years, has become an international event. Yin Yanhuan and Tempe City Councilor were invited to put the finishing touches on the dragon boat race.
