a0b03b725e02a740476c58b6cc5a7d450bb6b09a.sourceText: 3. 法律面前人人平等，不过法律是有钱人制定的。
a0b03b725e02a740476c58b6cc5a7d450bb6b09a.translatedText: 3. Everyone is equal before the law, but the law is made by the rich.

1684ac1432a525b71fa7e9464c74c7c1cab0fc97.sourceText: 美国是个法制社会，佩洛西公物私用，富人疯狂地掠夺社会财富无疑也在法律框架之内进行的。美国为什么会出现这种明目张胆地掠夺劳动人民创造的财富的现象，原因很简单，因为游戏规则都是有钱人定的。无论美国国会，还是总统选举，哪一个不受大财团所左右。当国会基本由有钱人的代言人控制，法律自然图利有钱人，穷人只能望法兴叹。在”人人平等”的法律面前，富人明目张胆地掠夺穷人没商量。”有本事请律师来诉”，穷人请得起律师吗？美国的资本主义体系在华丽的外表下越来越没有人性，贪婪的有钱人，通过各种手段使这些贪婪的行为合理合法。
1684ac1432a525b71fa7e9464c74c7c1cab0fc97.translatedText: The United States is a legal society. Pelosi uses public property for private use, and the wealthy people's crazy plundering of social wealth is undoubtedly carried out within the legal framework. The reason why the United States is blatantly plundering the wealth created by working people is very simple, because the rules of the game are set by the rich. Neither the U.S. Congress nor the presidential election is influenced by big business groups. When the Congress is basically controlled by the representatives of the rich, the law will naturally benefit the rich, and the poor can only look at the law and sigh. In the face of the law that "everyone is equal", the rich blatantly rob the poor without any discussion. "If you can afford it, hire a lawyer to sue." Can the poor afford a lawyer? The American capitalist system is becoming more and more inhumane under its gorgeous appearance. Greedy rich people use various means to make these greedy behaviors reasonable and legal.

54571c26263ff975daf066b87c508e2e74fdbc35.sourceText: 腐败合法化才是腐败的最高阶段，在这一点上，美国同样引领世界潮流。
54571c26263ff975daf066b87c508e2e74fdbc35.translatedText: Legalizing corruption is the highest stage of corruption. At this point, the United States also leads the world trend.

20d47f676241984cb03f1a1fbd0f86e9bb0dd24b.sourceText: 当越来越多的人陷入困境忍无可忍的时候，法律的约束已经锁不住人民的不满，占领华尔街进而占领全美国成为绝大多数人民要求改变这种分配不公制度问题的正义行为，2011年的华尔街之秋必将对美国的政治产生深远的影响。
20d47f676241984cb03f1a1fbd0f86e9bb0dd24b.translatedText: When more and more people are in trouble and cannot bear it anymore, the constraints of the law can no longer contain the people's dissatisfaction. Occupying Wall Street and then occupying the entire United States has become a just act for the vast majority of the people to demand a change in this unfair distribution system. The Wall Street Autumn of 2011 will have a profound impact on American politics.

91dc70c6942ca989ca5d63b9f49dc971b28cecd6.sourceText: 4. 毁一个人先毁掉他的自信，要毁掉一个民族，首先毁了她的民族信仰和自信心。
91dc70c6942ca989ca5d63b9f49dc971b28cecd6.translatedText: 4. To destroy a person, first destroy his self-confidence. To destroy a nation, first destroy its national belief and self-confidence.

cef6662ef5da74f842c38f3010d69f1e78f38174.sourceText: 前一段中国刮起了一股骆家辉旋风，中国人的清官情节似乎终于在美国官员身上找到了寄托。深刻了解美国社会的海外华人觉得这事真幽默。美国的确有许多方面值得中国学习，但是美国并不是某些传媒在中国刻意渲染的那么完美，美国的许多做法并不适合是美国人口4倍以上的中国。百姓对美国的盲目崇拜很大程度受到”有心”传媒的蛊惑。笔者留心观察了一下，但凡中国发生什么负面新闻都会有台港和大陆包括网络传媒在内的某些传媒互相声援故意炒作，无限放大，然后就会拿美国作对比，最终归结到制度问题，这种炒作模式已经成了定式。通过网络时代”自由言论”的诱导，人们往往不自觉地忘记中美人均GDP是相差十几倍的国家；忘记30年前我们还是一个吃不饱肚子的国家；许多人甚至不知道美国的老祖宗用什么手段为他们三亿人口在北美占了那么一大块地方，以至于生活在那里的人们只要开垦1/3的土地都永远不用担心饥荒，不知道美国通过美元作为国际结算货币每年从全世界搜刮的几千亿美元，如果这笔钱用在中国农村足以使几亿人不需任何付出就可以过上中国式小康生活，这笔钱差不多够美国在全世界驻军庞大的费用，这种不劳而获的钱中国有吗？盲目的和美国对比无形中燃起对中国的不满和愤怒。正是这种愈演愈烈的操作，和中国民间不满情绪的累加，使得洪博培看到自己的工作成绩，也对中国网民扳倒中国政府挽救美国寄托起无比重大的希望。
cef6662ef5da74f842c38f3010d69f1e78f38174.translatedText: A Locke whirlwind blew up in China some time ago, and the Chinese people’s integrity seems to have finally found its sustenance in American officials. Overseas Chinese who have a deep understanding of American society find this really humorous. The United States does have many aspects that China can learn from, but the United States is not as perfect as some media deliberately portray it in China. Many of its practices are not suitable for China, which has a population more than four times that of the United States. The people's blind worship of the United States is largely beguiled by the "intentional" media. The author has carefully observed that whenever any negative news happens in China, some media in Taiwan, Hong Kong and mainland China, including online media, will support each other and deliberately hype it up, infinitely amplifying it. Then they will compare it with the United States. In the end, it comes down to institutional issues. This hype model has become a stereotype. Through the induction of "free speech" in the Internet age, people often unconsciously forget that the per capita GDP of China and the United States is more than ten times different; forget that 30 years ago we were a country with insufficient food to eat; many people don't even know what means the ancestors of the United States used to occupy such a large area of North America for their 300 million people, so that the people living there only need to cultivate it 1/3 of the land will never have to worry about famine. I don’t know that the United States collects hundreds of billions of dollars from the world every year through the use of the US dollar as the international settlement currency. If this money is used in rural China, it is enough to enable hundreds of millions of people to live a Chinese-style well-off life without any effort. This money is almost enough to cover the huge expenses of the United States stationing troops around the world. Does China have this kind of free money? Blind comparison with the United States inadvertently ignites dissatisfaction and anger against China. It is this intensifying operation and the accumulation of dissatisfaction among the Chinese people that make Huntsman see the results of his work and place great hope on Chinese netizens to overthrow the Chinese government and save the United States.

573a5039cfcd468b9f809648b0b647a4df5c11c4.sourceText: 是谁在配合洪博培扳倒中国的工作呢？除了传媒还有不少学者，专家不遗余力地在中国年轻一代中耕耘着。代表人物就是红极一时的郎咸平到处撰文，演讲，煞费苦心地把美国吹上了天，把中国30年的改革”比”得一无是处。2011年6月在极具代表性的清华大学学生会讲坛，以”中国改革出现什么问题”为题费尽心机地在做一篇大文章。
573a5039cfcd468b9f809648b0b647a4df5c11c4.translatedText: Who is cooperating with Huntsman’s work to bring down China? In addition to the media, there are many scholars and experts who are sparing no effort to work among China's younger generation. The representative figure is the very popular Lang Xianping, who writes articles and gives speeches everywhere, painstakingly extolling the United States and comparing China's 30 years of reform to nothing. In June 2011, at the very representative forum of the Tsinghua University Student Union, I worked hard to write a big article titled "What are the problems with China's reform?"

a9a362d73a202575fdd054cdceeb8e9d9bf1e6a6.sourceText: 郎咸平从资本论谈起，引经据典，旁征博引，可以看出为准备这篇讲稿郎咸平肩负着重大的使命感，经过长期思考和非常认真的准备，演讲十分成功，彻底征服了在场的学子们。首先郎咸平从理论上论证美国的改良资本主义制度彻底消除马克思论述的资本主义弊端，是人类社会的方向。然后对比中国的社会问题，朗教授描述的美国完美的解决之道无疑是给青年学生视野里展示，美国就是”人间天堂”。
a9a362d73a202575fdd054cdceeb8e9d9bf1e6a6.translatedText: Lang Xianping started from Das Kapital and quoted from classics and quotes. It can be seen that Lang Xianping shouldered a great sense of mission in preparing this speech. After long-term thinking and very serious preparation, the speech was very successful and completely conquered the students present. First, Lang Xianping theoretically demonstrated that the reformed capitalist system in the United States will completely eliminate the shortcomings of capitalism discussed by Marx, which is the direction of human society. Then comparing China's social problems, Professor Lang's description of the perfect solution in the United States is undoubtedly to show to young students that the United States is "heaven on earth."

ddff3cf034a06754f0d17fca7da0388bbd21a785.sourceText: 从美国的”陪审团,《普通法》系”讲到美国公平的法制社会；从美国”职业经理人的信托责任”讲到美国严密的银行股票监管；从”美国有公民愿意将自己一身的积蓄都放在美国的股票市场””藏富于民”，讲到” 通过美国的股票市场才能让他们的财富不断的成长，才能使他们老有所终、老有所养”；从”美国大学的收费高是对的，那是对于有钱人。但当你的收入低于某一个”平的时候，美国政府可以提供低息，甚至免息的学生贷款，还有学校和美国政府提供的奖学金！你知道吗？”强调美国穷人也能上得起学；再从”美国的法律规定，必须先给你治病。治完病之后再向你收钱，如果钱不够，可以分期付款”讲到美国十分人性化的医疗体系。天堂般的美国对比中国的乱像，肩负国家未来的年轻的学生们对自己的国家油然而生一种自惭形秽的感觉。
ddff3cf034a06754f0d17fca7da0388bbd21a785.translatedText: From the "jury and common law system" in the United States to the fair legal society in the United States; from the "fiduciary responsibility of professional managers" in the United States to the strict supervision of bank stocks in the United States; from "There are citizens in the United States who are willing to put all their savings in the U.S. stock market" and "hiding wealth among the people". Only through the U.S. stock market can their wealth continue to grow, so that they can live a happy life and have something to support them. It is true that the tuition fees of American universities are high, and that is for the rich. But when your income is lower than a certain level, the U.S. government can provide low-interest or even interest-free student loans, as well as scholarships provided by the school and the U.S. government! Did you know? "It emphasizes that poor Americans can also afford to go to school; and then follow "American law stipulates that you must be treated first. "We will charge you after the treatment, and if the money is not enough, you can pay in installments." He talked about the very humane medical system in the United States. The paradise-like United States compared to the chaotic image of China, and the young students who shoulder the country's future spontaneously felt ashamed of their own country.

09a217b655d370dfbbf5608d77935ce9124c4e9b.sourceText: 刻意描绘美国制度的无比优越之后，朗教授接下来笔锋一转回到主题”中国改革出了什么问题”。郎咸平的豪华大铺垫就是要为批判中国改革找理论依据，就是为后边的抨击中国时政占领道德制高点，就是为彻底解除学生的理论和思想武装，一种非常高超的演讲技巧。面对基本没有经历过30年艰难改革为国家感到自卑的年轻学生们，郎咸平开始口若悬河，口沫横飞地批判中国的各项改革。批教育改革；批企业改革；批完医改；批股改；批完食品安全；批完房改，总之中国30年的改革就是一无是处。从学生们的嘘声中感到年轻学子们开始对中国改革的不屑和对美国制度佩服的五体投地。在郎咸平这样的网络精英们忽悠下，好奇的学生们对美国的好感已经上升到信仰崇拜的高度，在他们心中美国就是完美的代名词。十分讽刺意味的是美国的草根百姓不认这个帐，尽管美国人均收入是中国人的十几倍，美国并没有解决好郎咸平所例举的社会问题。郎咸平演讲后不久风起云涌的占领华尔街运动实实在在给了郎咸平们一记响亮的耳光。
09a217b655d370dfbbf5608d77935ce9124c4e9b.translatedText: After deliberately describing the incomparable superiority of the American system, Professor Lang continued He turned back to the topic "What's wrong with China's reform?" Lang Xianping's grand preparation was to find a theoretical basis for criticizing China's reform, to occupy the moral high ground for his subsequent criticism of China's current affairs, and to completely disarm students' theory and ideology. It was a very superb speaking skill for young students who had basically not experienced 30 years of difficult reforms and felt inferior to the country. , Lang Xianping began to criticize various reforms in China. He criticized the education reform, the enterprise reform, the medical reform, the shareholding reform, the food safety reform, and the housing reform. In short, China's 30 years of reform were useless. From the boos of the students, I felt that the young students were beginning to express their disdain for China's reforms and their admiration for the American system. Under the deception of the British, the curious students' favorable impression of the United States has risen to the level of belief and worship. In their minds, the United States is synonymous with perfection. What is very ironic is that the grassroots people in the United States do not recognize this account. Although the per capita income of the United States is more than ten times that of the Chinese, the United States has not solved the social problems cited by Lang Xianping. The Occupy Wall Street movement that surged shortly after Lang Xianping's speech. It is really a slap in the face to Lang Xianping and others.

732fe48ada87a5b9b51e0b00aadc366bf493366b.sourceText: 由于金融危机股票缩水许多劳动者辛辛苦苦半辈子的退休金计划放在股市里损失过半，老无所养；昂贵的学费使得学生一毕业就背上还贷的大包袱，借钱是要还得，而毕业等于失业，无数莘莘学子愁白少年头；
732fe48ada87a5b9b51e0b00aadc366bf493366b.translatedText: Due to the financial crisis, the stock market has shrunk and many workers have lost more than half of their hard-earned pension plans in the stock market, leaving them with nothing to support them. Expensive tuition fees make students bear the burden of repaying loans as soon as they graduate. The borrowed money must be repaid, and graduation means unemployment, and countless students are worried about their youth. ;

1d55158fd5f4f11c2af7e6b88aa0ddbf8bc5c975.sourceText: 美国先看病后收钱更是完美的童话，美国先看病后收钱是有条件的，就是你得的是要命的病。否则，没钱能看病，看得起病吗？我们工作的世界500强大公司，今年的医疗保险突然变成前$1500美元医疗费用要自负，$1500以后自付20%，保险公司付80%，还要从工资里扣除每人近$2000美元保险费，这和没有医疗保险有什么差别。美国的普通医疗保险伴随着美国政府的一次次医改，肥了医生和医疗产业，坑的最惨的就是美国中产阶级。美国是所有发达国家人均医疗花费最高的国家，也是全民医疗保障最差的国家。
1d55158fd5f4f11c2af7e6b88aa0ddbf8bc5c975.translatedText: It is a perfect fairy tale in the United States to see a doctor first and then collect money. There are conditions in the United States, that is, you have a fatal disease. Otherwise, if you don’t have money to see a doctor, can you afford it? In the world’s top 500 companies where we work, this year’s medical insurance suddenly changed to pay for the first $1,500 of medical expenses out of pocket2. 0%, the insurance company pays 80%, and the insurance premium of nearly $2,000 per person is deducted from the salary. How is this different from having no medical insurance? Along with the U.S. government’s health care reforms, the U.S. government has enriched doctors and the medical industry, and the worst sufferers are the American middle class. The United States has the highest per capita medical expenses among all developed countries, and it also has the most universal medical insurance. A poor country.

1ac4d52c40ac3fd3d1123f878139a90224c5bc3b.sourceText: 美国有相对健全的法律制度，但是著名的辛普森案就是有钱能使鬼推磨和弱智陪审团结合产出的怪胎；1992年洛杉矶黑人因法庭审判不公引发的大暴动更是典型陪审团的制度弊端。陪审团《普通法》系并不像郎咸平渲染的那么完美。
1ac4d52c40ac3fd3d1123f878139a90224c5bc3b.translatedText: The United States has a relatively sound legal system, but the famous Simpson case was a monster produced by the combination of money and a mentally retarded jury; the 1992 black riots in Los Angeles due to unfair court trials were a typical shortcoming of the jury system. The "common law" system of juries is not as perfect as Lang Xianping exaggerated.

41ec85e024c04b0e7db9325996eaff8cffcf0c4f.sourceText: 最令全世界人民愤恨的正是郎咸平最为推崇的美国的职业经理人们，正是他们创造出来的形形色色的金融演生产品坑害了无数投资者，把美国也把世界推入金融风暴和长期的经济衰退的漩涡。郎咸平对他的同行们大加赞赏难道就没有一点的愧疚感。在郎咸平的哲学里杀一个人是罪犯，杀千万人就是英雄吗？
41ec85e024c04b0e7db9325996eaff8cffcf0c4f.translatedText: It is the American professional managers whom Lang Xianping admires most that make people all over the world resentful the most. It is the various financial products they created that have defrauded countless investors and pushed the United States and the world into the whirlpool of financial crisis and long-term economic recession. Doesn't Lang Xianping feel a little guilty when he praises his colleagues so much? In Lang Xianping's philosophy, killing one person is a criminal, but killing tens of millions of people is a hero?

e4e32c1a58769d9622e8a01340dd906b010796ad.sourceText: 郎咸平在美国学习生活过多年，有深厚的金融背景，对美国的种种社会问题，特别是金融领域的黑洞不应该不知道，而他这样处心积虑地去忽悠青年学生盲目崇拜美国，极力贬低中国，打击国人的自信难道是为了中国的明天更好吗？
e4e32c1a58769d9622e8a01340dd906b010796ad.translatedText: Lang Xianping has studied and lived in the United States for many years, and has a profound financial background. He should not be ignorant of various social problems in the United States, especially the black hole in the financial field. And he is deliberately deceiving young students to blindly worship the United States, trying to belittle China, and undermining the self-confidence of the Chinese people. Is it for the sake of a better future for China?

e96090ee40c1cc7c5cb35615e124b53bf880374a.sourceText: 台湾长大美国受教育的郎咸平张口闭口咱们，咱们中国，他内心里谁才是他真正的”咱们”呢？美国是世界最富裕的国家之一，美国经过几百年的人文法制建设，有很多方面值得中国学习和借鉴。中华文明崇尚的是三人行必有我师，师之美国推动了中国社会和经济进步。然而世界上本无完美的社会，美国也不例外，盲目崇拜甚至失去自我，便落入别人的陷阱，一个彻底失去自信的民族能够自立于世界民族之林吗？如果像清华学生这样的我国下一代精英都找不到北，中华民族的前途堪忧。
e96090ee40c1cc7c5cb35615e124b53bf880374a.translatedText: Lang Xianping, who grew up in Taiwan and was educated in the United States, keeps talking about us, we China. Who is his real "we" in his heart? The United States is one of the richest countries in the world. After hundreds of years of humanistic and legal construction, the United States has many aspects that China can learn from. Chinese civilization upholds the belief that when three people walk together, they must have their own teacher. The United States has promoted China's social and economic progress. However, there is no perfect society in the world, and the United States is no exception. If you blindly worship or even lose yourself, you will fall into the trap of others. Can a nation that has completely lost its self-confidence stand on its own in the world of nations? If the next generation of our country’s elites like Tsinghua students cannot find their way to Beijing, the future of the Chinese nation will be worrying.

f8f399b7d9dfd42acdca2da40c0fa076422d5a7b.sourceText: 在美国身陷伊拉克阿富汗战争十年，不经意间中国实现了由量变到质变的崛起，中华文明的自信也从八国联军进北京到日本人占领中国时的最低谷开始快速回升。是谁最不愿看到中国这种变化，不愿看到一个不仅经济快速发展，而且文化自信的大国屹立于世界东方？他们不仅军事上围堵中国，把中国封在第一岛链；经济上压制中国，不承认中国市场经济地位，不卖给中国高端科技产品；更重要的是花巨资，通过代理人在思想界制造混乱，打掉中华民族的自信，解除中国人的思想武装，培养思想界殖民地文化，为洪博培所说的利用中国人扳倒中国最终挽救美国时刻准备着。
f8f399b7d9dfd42acdca2da40c0fa076422d5a7b.translatedText: Ten years after the United States was involved in the war in Iraq and Afghanistan, China has inadvertently achieved a rise from quantitative change to qualitative change. The self-confidence of Chinese civilization has also begun to rebound rapidly from the lowest point when the Eight-Power Allied Forces entered Beijing to the Japanese occupation of China. Who is the least willing to see this kind of change in China, and to see a big country with not only rapid economic development but also cultural confidence standing in the east of the world? They not only surrounded China militarily and sealed China in the first island chain; they suppressed China economically, did not recognize China's market economy status, and did not sell high-end technology products to China; more importantly, they spent huge sums of money to create chaos in the ideological world through agents, destroy the self-confidence of the Chinese nation, disarm the Chinese people's ideas, cultivate colonial culture in the ideological world, and are always ready to use the Chinese to bring down China and ultimately save the United States as Huntsman said.

bffc10880caa0c20b2ba66787afc6f77fff9f3f1.sourceText: 站在海外视角看中国，中国国内有许多诸如惩治腐败，健全法制等政治问题，医改，教改等社会问题需要全社会的重视和大力推动，中国当前最值得警惕的是中国的崛起在立足未稳时再被”八国联军”一棍子打死过去一百年。以当今中国之国力，中国现在并不惧怕来自外部的围攻，怕的是”堡垒从内部攻破”，再里应外合。当中国社会无度地发泄自己的怨气，听信郎咸平之言，认为美国才是中国的救世主，甚至认为”美国国人来了好啊，我们可以直接选总统了”，那不是天真就是别有用心。埃及，利比亚，伊拉克，前苏联，哪一个动乱之后不是千疮百孔。即使一些国家愿意承担一时的痛苦换取国家的长治久安不能算错，但是像苏联和中国这样的大国一旦内乱，美国首先就是不择手段地分裂这个国家，以消除对美国霸权地位永远的后患。
bffc10880caa0c20b2ba66787afc6f77fff9f3f1.translatedText: Looking at China from an overseas perspective, China has many domestic political issues such as punishing corruption and improving the legal system. Social issues such as medical reform and education reform require the attention and vigorous promotion of the whole society. The most alarming thing about China at present is that China's rise was beaten to death by the "Eight-Power Allied Forces" in the past 100 years when its footing was not stable. With China's national power today, China is not afraid of siege from the outside. What it is afraid of is "the fortress is breached from within" and then cooperates with the outside. When the Chinese society vents its grievances excessively and listens to Lang Xianping's words and believes that the United States is China's savior, and even thinks that "it's great that Americans are here, we can directly elect the president," then they are either naive or have ulterior motives. Egypt, Libya, Iraq, and the former Soviet Union were not riddled with holes after the turmoil. Even if some countries are willing to bear temporary pain in exchange for long-term peace and stability, it is not wrong to say that once big countries like the Soviet Union and China are in civil strife, the United States will first do whatever it takes to divide the country to eliminate permanent troubles to the United States' hegemony.

b224bd58f4d49327f83a66f2dae14752cb8ff833.sourceText: 善良的，受农耕文化熏陶的中国人就像羊从来不知道狼的思维方式一样，中国人大多不知道美国政治家，战略家们在想什么。中国人常以”己所不欲勿施于人”的哲学幻想美国。如果西方国家像中国人想像的那么好，也就没有美国了。把别国种族灭绝，然后把人家的土地据为己有是西方人的”雄才大略”，可是几千年来曾是世界数一数二强国的中国汉人皇帝们可曾有过的”雄心”？当中国人以己之心度他人之腹时，西方实实在在地以小人之心度君子之腹。拿破仑有句名言，”中国是一头睡狮，让中国睡吧,她一旦醒来将震惊世界”。拿破仑这么想是因为他领导的，相对中国而言是那么一个小国寡民都能够横扫欧洲大陆，”1812年春天，60多万法国将士在拿破仑的率领下向俄国进发，大军规模超过当时巴黎人口总和”，如果拿破仑像中国皇帝一样手里有数亿人口，整个世界还不是拿破仑囊中之物，可惜拿破仑惧怕的东方庞然大物却是”黔之驴”，不具任何威胁。不管中华文化多么爱好和平，华夏民族是多么善良的民族，以西方人的思维方式，庞大的中国就是一头极具威胁的狮子，除非中国像过去数百年在那积贫积弱的”睡吧”，否则必置中国于之死地而后快，这是不以中国人善良的意志为转移的。
b224bd58f4d49327f83a66f2dae14752cb8ff833.translatedText: The kind-hearted Chinese people who have been influenced by the farming culture are like sheep who never know the way of thinking of wolves. Most Chinese people do not know what American politicians and strategists are thinking. Chinese people often fantasize about the United States based on the philosophy of "don't do to others what you don't want others to do to you." If Western countries were as good as the Chinese imagine, there would be no United States. It is a "majestic strategy" for Westerners to exterminate other countries and then take other people's land as their own. But did the Han emperors of China, who had been one of the world's most powerful countries for thousands of years, ever have such "ambition"? While the Chinese use their own hearts to judge the bellies of others, the West really uses the hearts of a villain to judge the bellies of a gentleman. Napoleon had a famous saying, "China is a sleeping lion. Let China sleep. Once she wakes up, she will shock the world." Napoleon thought so because he led a small country with a small population compared to China, which could sweep across the European continent." In the spring of 1812, more than 600,000 French soldiers marched toward Russia under the leadership of Napoleon. The size of the army exceeded "Exceeded the total population of Paris at that time." If Napoleon had hundreds of millions of people like the Chinese emperor, the whole world would not be in Napoleon's pocket. Unfortunately, the eastern behemoth that Napoleon feared was the "donkey of Guizhou" and posed no threat. No matter how peace-loving the Chinese culture is and how kind-hearted the Chinese nation is, from the Western way of thinking, the huge China is a very threatening lion. Unless China "sleeps" like the poor and weak country it has been for hundreds of years, China will surely die soon. This is not based on the good will of the Chinese people.

8325af031a5e8c92f723bc06b66e5eba5a0c510b.sourceText: 一旦中国发生内乱，西藏，新疆，台港澳首先就会在西方人权大于主权，民族自治的旗帜下分裂出去，中国国防将永远失去战略纵深。中国一旦倒退，美国永远不会给大梦初醒中国再一次崛起的机会。
8325af031a5e8c92f723bc06b66e5eba5a0c510b.translatedText: Once civil strife breaks out in China, Tibet, Xinjiang, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macao will first split off under the Western banner of human rights over sovereignty and national autonomy, and China's national defense will forever lose strategic depth. Once China regresses, the United States will never give China a chance to rise again.

42194bb9785ff2403be3b5012d688c5188a73c63.sourceText: 美国新增在澳大利亚住军标志着美国已经打响了新冷战的第一枪。美国正在复制当年用冷战瓦解苏联的手段瓦解中国，尽管中国绝不是当年的苏联，一些人把美国当成中国的大救星是不折不扣地与虎谋皮。
42194bb9785ff2403be3b5012d688c5188a73c63.translatedText: The new addition of US troops stationed in Australia marks that the United States has fired the first shot of the new Cold War. The United States is replicating the methods it used to disintegrate the Soviet Union in the Cold War to disintegrate China. Although China is by no means the Soviet Union of that year, some people regard the United States as China's great savior and are out-and-out seeking the skin of a tiger.

49d1ea269eccb814ec8ccc50e36b835573da0553.sourceText: 6. 中华民族要有清醒的战略思路，首先中国传媒界应该头脑清醒
49d1ea269eccb814ec8ccc50e36b835573da0553.translatedText: 6. The Chinese nation must have a clear-headed strategic thinking. First, the Chinese media industry should have a clear-headed mind.

49b5dca7798a14f1156096014fbfe1f76226b844.sourceText: 80年代美国联合盟国打压日本，打造逼日元升值的广场协议，阻断了日本崛起之路。美国不能容忍自己的盟国和自己比肩，更不会容忍中华文明走到自己前边。美国从伊拉克阿富汗撤军高调战略东移，不顾国内尽管两次量化宽松仍然日益恶化的政府财政预算，花巨资在中国周围拉帮结派，几乎与所有和中国有过过节的国家举行烧钱的军事演习。美国调兵遣将，排兵布阵把优势装备集中亚太地区对准中国其真正的战略动机是什么。当狼围着羊群转的时候，羊起码知道狼要干什么，但是许多中国传媒却在麻痹自己和国人硬要把狼的世界粉饰成美好的天堂，令无数善良的人们期盼着羊入虎口。
49b5dca7798a14f1156096014fbfe1f76226b844.translatedText: In the 1980s, the United States united its allies to suppress Japan and created the Plaza Accord that forced the yen to appreciate, blocking Japan's rise. The United States cannot allow its allies to stand shoulder to shoulder with itself, let alone allow Chinese civilization to come before it. The United States has a high-profile strategy of withdrawing troops from Iraq and Afghanistan and moving eastward. Regardless of the deteriorating domestic government budget despite two rounds of quantitative easing, the United States has spent huge sums of money to build cliques around China and held money-burning military exercises with almost all countries that have had problems with China. What is the real strategic motive of the United States in deploying troops, deploying troops, and concentrating superior equipment in the Asia-Pacific region to target China? When wolves circle around the sheep, the sheep at least know what the wolves are going to do. However, many Chinese media are paralyzing themselves and the Chinese people and insisting on whitewashing the world of wolves into a beautiful paradise, making countless kind-hearted people look forward to the sheep entering the tiger's mouth.

76b7aa2f5607c4106492750a888e031cefd75b40.sourceText: ”中华民族再次到了民族危亡的关键时期”，这绝不是危言耸听。海内外真正关心中华民族前途命运的有识之士无不对国内及海外华人思想界的错乱现象痛心疾首。当然再生气也用不着沦落到张口就骂的程度。其实包括那些编辑们，他们也是无知的受害者，是中华民族缺乏自信的表现，是西方强势文化入侵的直接牺牲者，但是他们也是我们的同胞。他们当中的许多人的确不清楚自己在干什么，我相信如果有一天看到他们为普世价值奋斗的结果是中国会像苏联土崩瓦解一样分裂成7大块，成为中华民族的千古罪人，会后悔莫及的。戈尔巴乔夫后悔过，有用吗？历史没有后悔药可吃。
76b7aa2f5607c4106492750a888e031cefd75b40.translatedText: "The Chinese nation has once again reached a critical period of national peril." This is by no means alarmist. People of insight at home and abroad who truly care about the future and destiny of the Chinese nation all deplore the chaos in the Chinese ideological circles at home and abroad. Of course, no matter how angry you are, you don't have to descend to the point of scolding. In fact, including those editors, they are also victims of ignorance, a manifestation of the lack of self-confidence of the Chinese nation, and direct victims of the powerful Western cultural invasion, but they are also our compatriots. Many of them really don't know what they are doing. I believe that if one day they see that the result of their struggle for universal values ​​is that China will split into seven large pieces like the collapse of the Soviet Union, and they will become the eternal sinners of the Chinese nation, they will regret it. Gorbachev regretted it. Was it useful? History has no regrets.

03e30f4793bc26a80a8bcf70861ab9137b11b200.sourceText: 美国前驻华大使，前州长，下届总统候选人在总统竞选辩论中把培养中国的戈尔巴乔夫明确无误地告诉世界，新华社竟然能解读成《美前驻华大使洪博培批美政客煽动反华情绪》。看到新华社的解读真是令人大惊失色，身在海外，真的不明白中国到底是哪一个环节出了问题，可以肯定的是，出问题的不是形形色色的郎咸平们！不是南方报系！也不是是孔庆东。
03e30f4793bc26a80a8bcf70861ab9137b11b200.translatedText: The former U.S. ambassador to China, former governor, and next presidential candidate clearly told the world that Gorbachev, who cultivated China, was clearly stated in the presidential election debate. I was really shocked to see Xinhua News Agency’s interpretation. Being overseas, I really don’t understand which link in China has the problem. What is certain is that the problem is not with all kinds of Lang Xianpings! Not from the Southern Newspaper Department! It’s not Kong Qingdong either.

10c9be8d06dec1eaf91766e85a739664e0b895ce.sourceText: 中国传媒界像环球时报，央视国际保持清醒头脑的并不多。新闻传媒肩负着监督政府促进社会进步的重任，而不是不负社会责任地随意渲染事件，甚至故意夸大负面影响，无限上纲上线，打击中国人的自信心，恶化中国的人文环境。维护社会稳定难道不是大众传媒的社会责任吗？
10c9be8d06dec1eaf91766e85a739664e0b895ce.translatedText: There are not many people in the Chinese media like Global Times and CCTV International who are clear-headed. The news media shoulder the important task of supervising the government to promote social progress, instead of exaggerating events at will without social responsibility, or even deliberately exaggerating the negative impact, going online indefinitely, damaging the self-confidence of the Chinese people, and deteriorating China's humanistic environment. Isn’t it the social responsibility of the mass media to maintain social stability?

8fa481b47a45340617a2c541a0488160271de5ab.sourceText: 这一点美国大众传媒的社会责任感和政策执行水平比中国同行高多了。自占领华尔街运动发生两个多月以来，运动起伏跌宕，占领市区，占领港口，占领校园，一度蔓延到上百个城市，并发生过数次血腥清场。美国的传媒没有跟着起哄唯恐天下不乱，一改报道他国，特别是”敌对”国家那种血腥场面和具有煽动性的文字，美国媒体对美国国内的事件报道平和老练多了。笔者跟踪美国当地的主要报纸，无论是三千示威人潮迫使奥克兰港暂时关闭，各地人山人海的游行场面，还是美国大兵荷枪实弹对准示威者并造成多处流血冲突的场面，这些在网上可以看到，但是在报纸上只有轻描淡写的描述。两个月来不管事态发展到多么尖锐，事件的报道没有上头版头条。占领华尔街的报道经常是有的，但大多数放在第四版以后，有两次放在头版也是在下部的角落里一个不起眼的标题加几句话，然后引到七八版去具体报道。你可以明显感觉到媒体为维护社会的稳定而煞费苦心。美国的媒体明白他所代表的价值观，十分规范的媒体自律，和强烈的社会责任感，相较中国的许多媒体却像是充满叛逆的少年，既没有成熟的民族自信，有缺乏社会责任感。中国非常重视人才的引进和培养，以”千人计划”为代表的科技人才引进和培养活动推动了国家的技术进步，但是中国当前更急迫需要的是有国际化视野，战略眼光和充分民族自信的高端人才充实到中国外交，传媒，文化和教育领域，从而避免亿万人民辛辛苦苦创造下的财富，神不知鬼不觉地被别人裹挟而去，甚至拱手相让。中国当前更需要的是站在战略的高度提升中国的软实力，扩大经济，文化，政治，军事在世界的影响力，用中华文明推动人类进步，保护中华民族的福祉。
8fa481b47a45340617a2c541a0488160271de5ab.translatedText: In this regard, the American mass media’s sense of social responsibility and policy implementation level are much higher than those of their Chinese counterparts. Since the Occupy Wall Street movement began more than two months ago, the movement has experienced ups and downs, occupying urban areas, ports, and campuses. It once spread to hundreds of cities, and several bloody liquidations occurred. The U.S. media did not follow suit and reported on other countries, especially "hostile" countries with bloody scenes and inflammatory texts, in order to avoid chaos in the world. The U.S. media reported on domestic events in the United States in a much calmer and more sophisticated manner. The author follows major local newspapers in the United States. Whether it is the 3,000 demonstrators who forced the Port of Oakland to temporarily close, the crowds of marches in various places, or the scenes in which American soldiers pointed live ammunition at the demonstrators, causing many bloody conflicts, these can be seen online, but only lightly described in newspapers. For two months, no matter how serious the situation became, the incident did not make the front page. There are often reports on Occupy Wall Street, but most of them are placed on page 4 or later. The two times they were placed on the front page were an inconspicuous headline with a few sentences in the lower corner, and then led to pages 7 and 8 for detailed reports. You can clearly feel that the media is taking great pains to maintain social stability. The American media understands the values ​​it represents, has very standardized media self-discipline, and has a strong sense of social responsibility. Compared with many Chinese media, they are like rebellious teenagers, with neither mature national self-confidence nor a sense of social responsibility. China attaches great importance to the introduction and cultivation of talents. The introduction and cultivation of scientific and technological talents represented by the "Thousand Talents Plan" has promoted the country's technological progress. However, what China needs more urgently now is to enrich high-end talents with international vision, strategic vision and full national self-confidence into the fields of China's diplomacy, media, culture and education, so as to prevent the wealth created by the hard work of hundreds of millions of people from being unknowingly taken away by others or even handed over to others. What China needs more now is to enhance China's soft power from a strategic perspective, expand its economic, cultural, political, and military influence in the world, use Chinese civilization to promote human progress, and protect the well-being of the Chinese nation.

ac9a1218410146f0717c813bf32af40babefe1c6.sourceText: 二零一二年十月二十四日

471cbba873b0ad06e5ce8b030b54abd04977d756.sourceText: 一、 护照正常换发所需材料
471cbba873b0ad06e5ce8b030b54abd04977d756.translatedText: 1. Materials required for normal passport renewal

485a00dbf37df632c39d718f83ca69d7811e4e6e.sourceText: 1. 填写 《中华人民共和国护照、旅行证申请表》。
485a00dbf37df632c39d718f83ca69d7811e4e6e.translatedText: 1. Fill in the "Application Form for Passport and Travel Permit of the People's Republic of China".

49b990e8755c82a70b84ef3d8f7b1c14cb45780c.sourceText: 2. 近期（6个月以内）照片2张,头部正面、无帽、饰照片,背景白色，小二寸（48mm?8mm），头部宽度为21mm～24mm，头部长度为28mm～33mm，照片清洁无污点。
49b990e8755c82a70b84ef3d8f7b1c14cb45780c.translatedText: 2. 2 recent (within 6 months) photos, front-facing, hoodless and decorated head, white background, two inches smaller (48mm ~ 8mm), head width 21mm ~ 24mm, head length 28mm ~ 33mm, clean and free of stains.

bcfd500c15aa747bc81e9ae427e924f27e842eca.sourceText: 注意：请勿遵循《申请表》贴照片处的照片大小要求。
bcfd500c15aa747bc81e9ae427e924f27e842eca.translatedText: Note: Please do not follow the photo size requirements in the photo area of ​​the "Application Form".

144280b6a90404ec0d91ef12a86fba992a68c9a6.sourceText: 3. 中国护照原件及复印件（包括护照资料页、签证页、延期页）。
144280b6a90404ec0d91ef12a86fba992a68c9a6.translatedText: 3. Original and copy of Chinese passport (including passport information page, visa page, extension page).

0abab8e44a61783e1690143ec6be55ca196163d4.sourceText: 4. 在美绿卡或工卡原件和复印件。（未取得绿卡者，请提供有效居留签证、I-94卡原件和复印件；或提供移民局批准签证延期或调整身份的证明信原件和复印件。）
0abab8e44a61783e1690143ec6be55ca196163d4.translatedText: 4. Original and copy of green card or employment card in the United States. (For those who have not obtained a green card, please provide the original and copy of a valid residence visa and I-94 card; or provide the original and copy of a letter from the Immigration Bureau approving visa extension or adjustment of status.)

5159f1a15924cd027db1805a32df11791aacd50f.sourceText: 5. 领事官员认为申请人有必要提交的其他材料。
5159f1a15924cd027db1805a32df11791aacd50f.translatedText: 5. Other materials that the consular officer deems necessary for the applicant to submit.

5d074fd2c23ef720032bd247c4ee7e13d3a85e01.sourceText: 二、 补发或非正常换发护照所需材料
5d074fd2c23ef720032bd247c4ee7e13d3a85e01.translatedText: 2. Materials required for reissue or abnormal replacement of passport

7737c7c4a031f322ccb839fa1b36b31d68bd3b9c.sourceText: 1. 填写 《中华人民共和国护照、旅行证申请表》 。
7737c7c4a031f322ccb839fa1b36b31d68bd3b9c.translatedText: 1. Fill in the "Application Form for Passport and Travel Permit of the People's Republic of China".

c106b8800c0206a87c650ff933719c13696fa42b.sourceText: 2. 提供原护照复印件及入美签证复印件、护照遗失/损坏报告（遗失护照有报警记录的，请提供报警单）。
c106b8800c0206a87c650ff933719c13696fa42b.translatedText: 2. Provide a copy of the original passport, a copy of the visa to enter the United States, and a report of passport loss/damage (if there is an alarm record for the lost passport, please provide the alarm sheet).

7ec730583547bfe74969fb6b26601a017934222b.sourceText: 如您曾在驻洛杉矶总领事馆办理过护照换发或延期，请在申请表显著位置将换发或延期具体时间标明，如您有延期页复印件也请提供，这样将有助于加快您护照的办理时间。
7ec730583547bfe74969fb6b26601a017934222b.translatedText: If you have ever applied for a passport renewal or extension at the Consulate General in Los Angeles, please indicate the specific time of the renewal or extension in a prominent position on the application form. If you have a copy of the extension page, please also provide it. This will help speed up the processing time of your passport.

148665b2ab54309e82c09d7918b933e541320993.translatedText: 3. 2 photos, the photo specifications are the same as before.

09847b63c3e05b055892853af5b573886a9509d4.sourceText: 4. 在美绿卡或工卡原件和复印件。（未取得绿卡者，需提供有效居留签证、I-94卡原件和复印件；或提供移民局批准签证延期或调整身份的证明信原件和复印件。）
09847b63c3e05b055892853af5b573886a9509d4.translatedText: 4. Original and copy of green card or employment card in the United States. (Those who have not obtained a green card must provide a valid residence visa, the original and copy of the I-94 card; or provide the original and copy of the certification letter from the Immigration Bureau approving the visa extension or adjustment of status.)

f3490482abfc765532104451a9ea61e9ededd3ea.sourceText: 5. 非正常途径来美，无入美签证复印件
f3490482abfc765532104451a9ea61e9ededd3ea.translatedText: 5. Coming to the United States through irregular means, without a copy of the visa to enter the United States.

a632a4f453d83d18f4bdbb0abafc212e76d34d61.sourceText: （1）无护照者，须提交户口本、身份证复印件，填写《书面申请》表，详细说明在中国的履历（包括原来学习和工作的单位）、来美经过、在美生活和身份、国内亲友的联系地址、电话等。如有国内公证机关出具的《出生公证书》，也请提供。
a632a4f453d83d18f4bdbb0abafc212e76d34d61.translatedText: (1) Those who do not have a passport must submit a household registration booklet, a copy of their ID card, and fill out the "Written Application" form, detailing their resume in China (including the original unit where they studied and worked), their experience of coming to the United States, their life and identity in the United States, and the contact addresses and telephone numbers of relatives and friends in the country. If you have a "Birth Notarization Certificate" issued by a domestic notary public, please also provide it.

9a800f5399be19151c91bf3fbbd2b90c3fe199d4.sourceText: （2）有护照者，须提供护照原件，填写《书面申请》表。
9a800f5399be19151c91bf3fbbd2b90c3fe199d4.translatedText: (2) Those who have a passport must provide the original passport and fill in the "Written Application" form.

8f1cc416e1e9770ef6383369d95773a728b50536.sourceText: 6. 领事官员认为申请人有必要提交的其他材料。
8f1cc416e1e9770ef6383369d95773a728b50536.translatedText: 6. Other materials that the consular officer deems necessary for the applicant to submit.

f486b9b189bd4a41a52ae57be6c600714c0abdba.sourceText: 三、 邮寄方法及收费标准

25e46625c7c2ad53e77fc97906a9f1b42c380f78.sourceText: 1、凡经领事官员见过面并在申请表上签字的申请资料，可邮寄至我馆办理护照换发或补发。
25e46625c7c2ad53e77fc97906a9f1b42c380f78.translatedText: 1. All application materials that have been met by a consular officer and signed on the application form can be mailed to our embassy for passport renewal or reissue.

74c35127fe0e3492bfe3cd309d120db68c841158.sourceText: 2、领馆在收到材料后，有可能根据实际情况要求申请人提交一些补充材料，请遵照执行。
74c35127fe0e3492bfe3cd309d120db68c841158.translatedText: 2. After receiving the materials, the consulate may require the applicant to submit some supplementary materials based on the actual situation. Please comply.

3999906ff8df60c2c7ee846a2612ed82be32ba14.translatedText: 3. The mailing address of the consulate is:

7ce557189b3d66d7f9cccb17af5d9578a2d5e41c.sourceText: 4 、请寄来申请材料、支票、回邮信封。
7ce557189b3d66d7f9cccb17af5d9578a2d5e41c.translatedText: 4. Please send application materials, check, and return envelope.

d2c70e7df5274656249e3f7b54ee43fd74965d4a.sourceText: 关于支票，我馆只接收银行汇票或MONEY ORDER，抬头请写：CHINESE CONSULATE。请填写相应数额，不设找赎， 不收现金。
d2c70e7df5274656249e3f7b54ee43fd74965d4a.translatedText: Regarding checks, our library only accepts bank drafts or MONEY ORDER. Please write payable to: CHINESE CONSULATE. Please fill in the corresponding amount. No change is required and no cash will be accepted.

1b03a5dfc179e782806d74902fca63d75ed27141.sourceText: 信封上 务必 写清申请人收件地址及联系电话，回邮信封只接受PRIORITY MAIL或EXPRESS MAIL，请贴足邮票。我们会用您的回邮信封将办好的护照回寄给您。
1b03a5dfc179e782806d74902fca63d75ed27141.translatedText: Be sure to clearly write down the applicant's receiving address and contact number on the envelope. Only PRIORITY MAIL or EXPRESS MAIL is accepted on the return envelope. Please affix enough stamps. We will send the completed passport back to you in your self-addressed envelope.

2c0d9ec78c0ff8a4eb179ee6be12e23dca0b4c6a.translatedText: 5. The normal passport renewal fee is:

dcd60b5fe499a2de7a51711f0089848469ccae64.sourceText: 55美元/人+5美元 （邮寄手续费） +回邮信封

9010887cddd6278c7246667384d28570987e7003.sourceText: 护照非正常换发或补发费用为：
9010887cddd6278c7246667384d28570987e7003.translatedText: The abnormal passport renewal or reissue fee is:

b3f270f00e9cbef11ed6e4baaf4f441f442799ac.sourceText: 105美元/人+5美元 （邮寄手续费） +回邮信封

5ba7f49808f6397057d6044eb5eda6bc96e7d262.sourceText: 如果您想两人或两人以上使用同一个回邮信封邮寄护照，最好是办证情况都属于正常换发，因为非正常换发或补发护照的办理时间长短无法确定。
5ba7f49808f6397057d6044eb5eda6bc96e7d262.translatedText: If you want two or more people to use the same self-addressed envelope to mail their passports, it is best to apply for a normal passport renewal, because the processing time for abnormal renewal or passport reissue cannot be determined.

06d5ec0268b46b82c91521b73417e3eeec440b7b.sourceText: 四、 办理证件所需时间
06d5ec0268b46b82c91521b73417e3eeec440b7b.translatedText: 4. The time required to apply for the certificate

3307fd29386830eec5add16aa48a50457e7ad7db.sourceText: 正常换发的护照：按收到邮件日期为准，约30个工作日+回邮时间。
3307fd29386830eec5add16aa48a50457e7ad7db.translatedText: Normally renewed passport: based on the date of receipt of the email, about 30 working days + return mail time.

84a0cb3eb47536e463fe1dcf14e7c8d001f77f54.sourceText: 非正常换发或补发的护照：时间无法确定，一旦办好，我们会在第一时间回寄给您。
84a0cb3eb47536e463fe1dcf14e7c8d001f77f54.translatedText: Abnormally renewed or reissued passport: The time cannot be determined. Once the application is processed, we will send it back to you as soon as possible.

2825be2c8b7bde712c7d38ed925b305f03f50e48.sourceText: 中国国民党主席、现任台湾当局领导人马英九１９日在其竞选连任办公室举行记者会，宣布吴敦义为其参选下届台湾地区领导人的副手。
2825be2c8b7bde712c7d38ed925b305f03f50e48.translatedText: Ma Ying-jeou, chairman of the Chinese Kuomintang and current leader of the Taiwan authorities, held a press conference at his re-election office on the 19th to announce Wu Dunyi as his deputy for the next Taiwan leader.

98b5cd53996628200c6e18c7e6df7f57988dfcbb.sourceText: 吴敦义现为台当局行政机构负责人，曾任台湾南投县县长、高雄市市长，及民意代表和中国国民党秘书长等，２００９年９月接任台当局行政机构负责人。
98b5cd53996628200c6e18c7e6df7f57988dfcbb.translatedText: > Wu Dunyi is currently the head of the administrative agency of the Taiwan authorities. He once served as the county magistrate of Nantou County, Mayor of Kaohsiung City, public opinion representative and secretary-general of the Chinese Kuomintang. In September 2009, he took over as the head of the administrative agency of the Taiwan authorities.

7fc54c095c5155833e0e919b754b481f2c57e66a.sourceText: 马英九已于４月２７日获得中国国民党中常会提名，将代表国民党参选下届台湾地区领导人。这项提名尚须交由将于６月２５日召开的国民党第十八次全代会第二次会议通过。
7fc54c095c5155833e0e919b754b481f2c57e66a.translatedText: Ma Ying-jeou was nominated by the Central Standing Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang on April 27 and will represent the Kuomintang in the election of the next leader of the Taiwan region. This nomination still needs to be approved by the second session of the 18th National Congress of the Kuomintang to be held on June 25.

b0669a7534aed3f2696c4c873ab8d37a2a378d19.sourceText: 下届台湾地区领导人选举预定于２０１２年１月举行。目前，将代表民进党参选的蔡英文尚未确定其副手人选。
b0669a7534aed3f2696c4c873ab8d37a2a378d19.translatedText: The next Taiwan leader election is scheduled to be held in January 2012. Currently, Tsai Ing-wen, who will run on behalf of the Democratic Progressive Party, has not yet determined her deputy.

864a25f4928e6b2b7dd6cf2fe0858ba2dc1fbeee.translatedText: Exclusive | Chen Guanming, a three-wheeled bicycle traveler around the world, arrives in Phoenix On April 27, 2015, this three-wheeled bicycle parked in Phoenix Chinatown instantly attracted a lot of attention...

40dd787ffd6341fe7d2b03428fa1dae1ee6da0cb.sourceText: ２０１５年４月２７日，这辆停在凤凰城中国城的三轮自行车瞬间吸引了很多眼球。骑自行车环游世界的来自中国的陈冠明当日抵达了凤凰城。
40dd787ffd6341fe7d2b03428fa1dae1ee6da0cb.translatedText: On April 27th, 2015, this three-wheeled bicycle parked in Phoenix Chinatown instantly attracted a lot of attention. Chen Guanming from China, who has traveled around the world by bicycle, arrived in Phoenix that day.

a6f3d83227be7361b1e3dce0fe1a9890b271475a.sourceText: 凤凰城的市民黄谊成 庄淑华夫妇，告诉记者，周一他们夫妇去欣欣超市买菜，看到了这辆三轮车。庄淑华赶紧让先生停车，说在香港是就见过这两三轮车，就是陈冠明先生来到了凤凰城。
a6f3d83227be7361b1e3dce0fe1a9890b271475a.translatedText: Phoenix citizens Huang Yicheng and Zhuang Shuhua told reporters that they went to Xinxin Supermarket to buy groceries on Monday and saw this tricycle. Zhuang Shuhua quickly asked her husband to stop the car, saying that she had seen these two and three-wheelers in Hong Kong, and it was Mr. Chen Guanming who came to Phoenix City.

7a7fcd985103e586f98c0f90fc750d82328d1dd6.sourceText: 黄谊成 庄淑华夫妇与陈冠明合影
7a7fcd985103e586f98c0f90fc750d82328d1dd6.translatedText: >Huang Yicheng, Zhuang Shuhua and his wife took a group photo with Chen Guanming

4adfba0661fd3b23dd22e74aa9b80c5c2083d8bb.sourceText: 黄先生和太太说陈先生太有毅力为了宣传环保，骑行全球，执意想为他提供帮助。可都被陈先生婉言谢绝。陈冠明说他在中国文化中心等当地的宋磊先生，但是宋磊先生他也第一次见。
4adfba0661fd3b23dd22e74aa9b80c5c2083d8bb.translatedText: Mr. Huang and his wife said that Mr. Chen was too determined to ride around the world in order to promote environmental protection, and they insisted on providing help to him. But they were all politely declined by Mr. Chen. Chen Guanming said that he was waiting for the local Mr. Song Lei at the Chinese Cultural Center, but it was also his first time to meet Mr. Song Lei.

172b6ce1614d72d23442bfcf9c6c6e1675707cad.sourceText: 今晚记者联系到宋磊。宋磊一直在关注陈冠明在亚利桑那的动态。他说现在陈冠明已经骑行在凤凰城到flagstaff的路上。预计明天晚上会到达。宋磊帮助陈冠明查询了从凤凰城到Flagstaff的路线，连哪段是上坡多，哪段是下坡都做了详细的记录。陈冠明一迷路，总会给宋磊发来坐标图，让宋磊帮助他找路。因为不太会使用ＧＰＳ等现代化的工具，陈冠明一路上走了很多的弯路。从凤凰城出发，到现在陈冠明告诉宋磊，他的车已经爆了两次胎。陈冠明随车都带了维修工具，现在正在安全前行中。宋磊还在Flagstaff联系了中餐馆，希望陈冠明到达目的地能吃到地道的中国饭菜。
172b6ce1614d72d23442bfcf9c6c6e1675707cad.translatedText: The reporter contacted Song Lei tonight. Song Lei has been paying attention to Chen Guanming's activities in Arizona. He said that Chen Guanming is now riding on the road from Phoenix to Flagstaff. Expected to arrive tomorrow evening. Song Lei helped Chen Guanming look up the route from Phoenix to Flagstaff, and even made detailed records of which sections were uphill and which were downhill. Whenever Chen Guanming gets lost, he always sends coordinate maps to Song Lei and asks Song Lei to help him find his way. Because he was not very good at using modern tools such as GPS, Chen Guanming took many detours along the way. From Phoenix City, Chen Guanming told Song Lei that his car had blown out two tires. Chen Guanming brought maintenance tools with him and is now driving safely. Song Lei also contacted Chinese restaurants in Flagstaff, hoping that Chen Guanming could eat authentic Chinese food when he arrived at his destination.

09b2f8d67d726d5d4e5c485ddb4de6b48af63f5e.translatedText: >Song Lei and Chen Guanming took a photo

772e2719bbbfdf45ea8e26c36e71e2f9ca82df16.sourceText: 当记者问宋磊跟陈冠明是什么关系时，宋磊说他在网络上看到陈冠明要抵达凤凰城的消息，觉得很佩服他的毅力，希望能在当地为他提供一些帮助。于是他联系了陈冠明先生，并邀请他在凤凰城一起进餐，还为陈先生补充了路上所需的食品。
772e2719bbbfdf45ea8e26c36e71e2f9ca82df16.translatedText: When reporters asked Song Lei what his relationship was with Chen Guanming, Song Lei said that he saw the news on the Internet that Chen Guanming was arriving in Phoenix, and felt that he admired his perseverance and hoped to provide him with some help locally. So he contacted Mr. Chen Guanming and invited him to have a meal together in Phoenix City. He also replenished Mr. Chen with the food he needed on the road.

0c07db577c4b31b51213e9c55591aff38192c31b.sourceText: 陈冠明一路骑行，累了就在车上休息。手机没有额外充电设备，所以一般情况下，他的手机都是关机。现在亚利桑那华人网正在联系陈冠明，争取尽快带来更加详实的陈冠明在亚利桑那骑行的报道。
0c07db577c4b31b51213e9c55591aff38192c31b.translatedText: Chen Guanming rode all the way and rested in the car when he got tired. There is no additional charging device for mobile phones, so under normal circumstances, his mobile phone is turned off. Now Arizona Chinese Network is contacting Chen Guanming and trying to bring more detailed reports on Chen Guanming’s riding in Arizona as soon as possible.

0c2070780934620fa970558470973a07d9c9dbfe.sourceText: 在此亚利桑那华人网也非常感谢像黄谊成 庄淑华，宋磊当地华人，为陈冠明提供的热心帮助，正是因为这些好心人，陈冠明的环球之旅才能走得如此顺利。
0c2070780934620fa970558470973a07d9c9dbfe.translatedText: Here, the Arizona Chinese Network is also very grateful to local Chinese people like Huang Yicheng, Zhuang Shuhua, and Song Lei for their enthusiastic help to Chen Guanming. It is precisely because of these kind people that Chen Guanming's global journey can go so smoothly.

94185381483cea1845a6054f53354aa55da8f19f.sourceText: 江苏省徐州铜山县张集乡二陈集村普通农民。为宣传”和平与环保”的理念，立志20年骑三轮车走遍全世界，从2001年起，他脚登三轮车走遍全中国，游走世界。他风雨无阻，历经艰辛，沿途矢志不渝宣传奥运精神，宣传环保，爱护家园。他已成为”骑三轮车走完全中国第一人”。2012年7月9日从法国坐船抵达了英国他已年过六旬
94185381483cea1845a6054f53354aa55da8f19f.translatedText: An ordinary farmer in Erchenji Village, Zhangji Township, Tongshan County, Xuzhou, Jiangsu Province. In order to promote the concept of "peace and environmental protection", he determined to ride a tricycle around the world in 20 years. Since 2001, he has traveled all over China and around the world on a tricycle. He weathered rain or shine, went through hardships, and was determined to promote the Olympic spirit, environmental protection, and care for his homeland along the way. He has become "the first person to ride a tricycle all over China." On July 9, 2012, he arrived in the UK by boat from France. He was over sixty years old

fdda1f445038c231087947b6e53d24408a07b20a.sourceText: 骑三轮车走完全中国第一人 从2001年北京申奥成功开始走，陈冠明已经走了10年，走完了全中国，走了巴基斯坦等10多个国家，从未停止过。11年，14万公里，三轮车行过中国80%省份，上过7200米珠峰；
fdda1f445038c231087947b6e53d24408a07b20a.translatedText: The first person to ride a tricycle across China. Starting from Beijing’s successful bid for the Olympic Games in 2001, Chen Guanming has been walking for 10 years. He has traveled all over China and more than 10 countries including Pakistan, and has never stopped. In 11 years and 140,000 kilometers, tricycles traveled through 80% of China’s provinces and climbed the 7,200-meter Mount Everest;

ab1490e6a4a6851ecec90b84895abad57e28e59e.sourceText: ”我就是想为奥运做点事，我有的就是一辆三轮车”。陈冠明一个人偷偷摸摸地骑着自己最珍贵的家当一辆三轮车离开了村口，他并不是如家人朋友以为的去修车，他要骑车环游中国，并在北京奥运前到达北京。”怎么说来着，就是先斩后奏吧！你说支持，农村人哪有这个觉悟？他们当然反对。我一个月后到了杭州才告诉他们我是出来骑车支持奥运去的！ ” 这疯狂的念头他在脑海中只酝酿了五天2001年7月13日北京申奥成功那一刻，他就激动地想着自己能为奥运做点什么：”我吧，要钱没钱，也没有什么手艺。想来，也就只有一辆三轮车。奥运总要做广告，要宣传嘛！那我就骑三轮车去北京，去宣传奥运！ ”
ab1490e6a4a6851ecec90b84895abad57e28e59e.translatedText: "I just want to do something for the Olympics. All I have is a tricycle." Chen Guanming secretly left the village entrance on his most precious possession, a tricycle. He was not going to repair the car as his family and friends thought. He wanted to ride around China and arrive in Beijing before the Beijing Olympics. "What do you mean, let's cut it off first and then tell it later! You said you support it, but how can the rural people have this consciousness? Of course they are against it. I didn't tell them until I arrived in Hangzhou a month later that I came out to ride a bike to support the Olympics! " This crazy idea only brewed in his mind for five days. The moment Beijing's bid for the Olympics was successful on July 13, 2001, he excitedly thought about what he could do for the Olympics: "Me, I have no money and no skills. Come to think of it, I only have a tricycle. The Olympics always need advertising and publicity! Then I will ride a tricycle to Beijing to promote the Olympics!" "

60f39f2a53e63ab26e2fa34afc9d65752d09c6de.sourceText: 问及这一路三轮骑行，一人面对孤独，又省吃俭用风餐露宿，有没有后悔过？有没有怕过什么？陈冠明说：”没有。我有三轮车，没钱吧可以载客赚点钱。一路也有好心人帮忙，给我塞东西。最怕就是不能赶在奥运会开幕之前到达。赶不上了，不就没意义了么！ ”很幸运，陈冠明在北京奥运开幕前十几天到了北京。
60f39f2a53e63ab26e2fa34afc9d65752d09c6de.translatedText: Asked about this three-wheeled ride, faced with loneliness alone, and frugally lived in the open air. Do you have any regrets? Have you ever been afraid of anything? Chen Guanming said: "No. I have a tricycle. If I don't have any money, I can make some money by carrying passengers. There are kind people who help me along the way and stuff things for me. My biggest fear is that I can't arrive before the opening of the Olympic Games. If I can't catch up, it will be meaningless!" Fortunately, Chen Guanming arrived in Beijing more than ten days before the opening of the Beijing Olympics.

554c0a22375e6336f45799f225e288dac794afd4.sourceText: 下一站2016年巴西 伦敦并非陈冠明环游骑行追随奥运的终点站。他说都骑了半个地球了，不还有北美洲南美洲没去了么？做事讲求完美的他，说奥运之后，就买张船票，带着他的三轮，去加拿大。然后赶在2016年到达巴西下一届奥运的主办地。
554c0a22375e6336f45799f225e288dac794afd4.translatedText: The next stop is Brazil in 2016. London is not the final stop for Chen Guanming’s cycling around the world to follow the Olympics. He said he has traveled halfway around the world, isn’t there still North and South America that he hasn’t visited yet? He, who values ​​perfection in everything he does, said that after the Olympics, he would buy a boat ticket and take his three-wheeler to Canada. Then arrive in 2016 to host the next Olympic Games in Brazil.

7bd51e951ee820ffc314b7b81b7b01f55f573fc4.sourceText: 央行货币政策委员会：把握好货币政策节奏和力度 新华网 日前召开的中国人民银行货币政策委员会２０１１年第二季…
7bd51e951ee820ffc314b7b81b7b01f55f573fc4.translatedText: The Monetary Policy Committee of the Central Bank: Grasp the rhythm and intensity of monetary policy Xinhuanet The Monetary Policy Committee of the People's Bank of China held a regular meeting for the second quarter of 2011 recently...

621fe2e26dcf825941a2c99fca11e5e6e495b5de.sourceText: 日前召开的中国人民银行货币政策委员会２０１１年第二季度例会强调，要贯彻实施稳健货币政策，注意把握政策的稳定性、针对性和灵活性，把握好政策节奏和力度。
621fe2e26dcf825941a2c99fca11e5e6e495b5de.translatedText: The Monetary Policy Committee of the People's Bank of China held a regular meeting for the second quarter of 2011 recently, emphasizing the need to implement a sound monetary policy, pay attention to the stability, pertinence and flexibility of the policy, and grasp the rhythm and intensity of the policy.

483ffa28e7517b80c8d0cb8146bdc049536001c6.sourceText: 会议指出，要综合运用多种货币政策工具，健全宏观审慎政策框架，有效管理流动性，保持合理的社会融资规模和货币总量。要着力优化信贷结构，引导商业银行加大对重点领域和薄弱环节的信贷支持，特别是对”三农”、中小企业的信贷支持。要继续发挥直接融资的作用，更好地满足多样化投融资需求。进一步完善人民币汇率形成机制，保持人民币汇率在合理均衡水平的基本稳定。
483ffa28e7517b80c8d0cb8146bdc049536001c6.translatedText: The meeting pointed out that it is necessary to comprehensively use a variety of monetary policy tools, improve the macro-prudential policy framework, effectively manage liquidity, and maintain a reasonable scale of social financing and total currency. Efforts should be made to optimize the credit structure and guide commercial banks to increase credit support for key areas and weak links, especially credit support for "agriculture, rural areas and farmers" and small and medium-sized enterprises. It is necessary to continue to play the role of direct financing to better meet diversified investment and financing needs. Further improve the RMB exchange rate formation mechanism and maintain the basic stability of the RMB exchange rate at a reasonable and balanced level.

60eedbbabad1074474facef31bde2ea9bf8b52c7.sourceText: 会议分析了当前国内外经济金融形势。会议认为，当前我国经济金融运行正向宏观调控预定的方向发展，但经济金融发展面临的形势依然复杂，世界经济继续缓慢复苏，但面临的风险因素仍然较多；我国经济继续平稳较快发展，但通胀压力仍然处在高位。
60eedbbabad1074474facef31bde2ea9bf8b52c7.translatedText: The meeting analyzed the current domestic and international economic and financial situations. The meeting held that my country's current economic and financial operations are developing in the direction predetermined by macro-control, but the situation facing economic and financial development is still complex. The world economy continues to recover slowly, but there are still many risk factors; my country's economy continues to develop steadily and rapidly, but inflationary pressure is still at a high level.

4f42a7cb657352dca8b90da992ffee473bd4ac58.sourceText: 央行货币政策委员会例会会后声明释放怎样的信号?
4f42a7cb657352dca8b90da992ffee473bd4ac58.translatedText: >What kind of signal does the central bank's monetary policy committee statement release after the regular meeting?

1577b4277f310ecdf285133b85073a573e3470f1.sourceText: 日前召开的中国人民银行货币政策委员会第二季度例会指出，要贯彻实施稳健货币政策，注意把握政策的稳定性、针对性和灵活性，把握好政策节奏和力度。
1577b4277f310ecdf285133b85073a573e3470f1.translatedText: The second quarter regular meeting of the People's Bank of China's monetary policy committee held recently pointed out that it is necessary to implement a sound monetary policy, pay attention to the stability, pertinence and flexibility of the policy, and grasp the pace and intensity of the policy.

f6534ef129dd53a1a52a356106012d9461c5841e.sourceText: 记者注意到，与上次例会的会后声明相比，此次例会在提出了要继续”实施稳健货币政策”的同时，首次提出要把握好政策的节奏和力度。与此同时，与一季度例会声明相比，二季度例会加大了对中小企业融资问题的关照。会议强调：要着力优化信贷结构，引导商业银行加大对重点领域和薄弱环节的信贷支持，特别是对”三农”、中小企业的信贷支持。
f6534ef129dd53a1a52a356106012d9461c5841e.translatedText: The reporter noticed that compared with the post-meeting statement of the last regular meeting, this regular meeting proposed for the first time to continue to "implement a sound monetary policy" and at the same time, it was proposed to grasp the rhythm and intensity of the policy. At the same time, compared with the statement of the first-quarter regular meeting, the second-quarter regular meeting paid more attention to the financing issues of small and medium-sized enterprises. The meeting emphasized that efforts should be made to optimize the credit structure and guide commercial banks to increase credit support for key areas and weak links, especially credit support for "agriculture, rural areas and farmers" and small and medium-sized enterprises.

8ee4116ac6ac0d5b67b47adfb1dba19520771ca1.sourceText: ”这是央行根据当前经济形势中的微妙变化所作出的合理决策。” 中央财经大学金融学院中国银行业研究中心主任郭田勇分析认为，在当前的宏观经济条件下，我国稳健货币政策的基调不宜发生变化，但考虑到经济发展中中小企业融资难、资金链紧张等问题正不断恶化，下一步货币政策的力度和节奏实施过程中将更为审慎。
8ee4116ac6ac0d5b67b47adfb1dba19520771ca1.translatedText: "This is a reasonable decision made by the central bank based on subtle changes in the current economic situation." Guo Tianyong, director of the China Banking Research Center at the School of Finance, Central University of Finance and Economics, analyzed that under the current macroeconomic conditions, the tone of my country's prudent monetary policy should not change. However, considering that problems such as financing difficulties for small and medium-sized enterprises and tight capital chains in economic development are deteriorating, the intensity and pace of monetary policy implementation will be more prudent in the next step.

03b3e059da10ef2f0ccbbb6486948e6b502d11a3.sourceText: 央行：我国通胀压力仍处高位
03b3e059da10ef2f0ccbbb6486948e6b502d11a3.translatedText: Central Bank: Inflation pressure in my country is still at a high level

3eaad7e52ae2a499e1907c73c4c2e088937976d9.sourceText: 中国人民银行货币政策委员会2011年第二季度例会日前在北京召开。会议认为，当前通胀压力仍处在高位，要贯彻实施稳健货币政策。分析人士认为，从此次会议所传递出的信息显示，未来通胀走势不容乐观，短期内政策难见转向，央行7月有可能继续加息。
3eaad7e52ae2a499e1907c73c4c2e088937976d9.translatedText: The 2011 second quarter regular meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee of the People's Bank of China was held in Beijing a few days ago. The meeting held that the current inflationary pressure is still at a high level and prudent monetary policy must be implemented. Analysts believe that the information conveyed from this meeting shows that the future inflation trend is not optimistic, and it is difficult to see a policy change in the short term. The central bank is likely to continue to raise interest rates in July.
