149f784ba08dbf5c36b7b02bfd18955dc55206a0.sourceText: ”占领华尔街” 像无头苍蝇，象征性地把无奈发泄给制度腐败的受益者 自９月１７日”占领华尔街”活动爆发以来，该活动已持续整两个月，尽管多地出现血腥清场，然而占领运动大有越挫越勇之势，继从纽约起蔓延到100多个城市，从城区拓展到港口，大学校园再回到华尔街。11月17日，运动开始整整两月之际，上千人的华尔街抗议者喊出要关闭华尔街的口号。 然而美国”占领华尔街”运动给人的印象像是无头苍蝇一样东一榔头西一棒槌，诉求太多就等于失去诉求。运动失去焦点的关键是因为人们感到社会不公，却没有看到社会不公的根源，触及问题的本质。 1. 美国百姓为啥跟华尔街过不去 08年金融危机，许多企业高管把企业搞垮了，却并不影响他的个人收入，这些高管包括经营不善而离职的遣散费，一年的收入竟然超过上亿美元。据《世界报》2011年8月31日报道，在美国年薪最高的100位首席执行官（CEO）中，有25位去年的薪水超过他所在公司的纳税金额。美国首席执行官的平均年收入相对普通工人的平均年收入已经从上世纪60年代的不到50倍上升到现在的大约350倍。这种掠夺式的分配不公或者说合理合法的腐败，恐怕是世界上任何贪官都羡慕不已的，是啊，能合法腐败，谁又愿意担惊受怕偷着摸着去腐败呢。 美国老百姓跟华尔街过不去是冰冻三尺绝非一日之寒。一方面，美国失业率高居不下，许多家庭陷入困顿，难以为继；另一方面，美国最有钱那部分人却没有后顾之忧，他们掌握着”大到倒不起”的资产，经济再不好有国家给兜着。美国最富裕的1% 的人口拥有全社会35%的净财富，而占人口80%的中低收入阶层只拥有15%的社会净财富。金融危机爆发以来，美国最富裕人口拥有社会财富的比例不但没有下降，反而上升了。 美国的政界和商界有一个旋转门，双方人才很容易互相转换。美国政府官员本身也不是像中国媒体精英们描述的那么清廉，都坐经济舱。看一款美国前众议院议长南希 佩 洛西的旧闻：”南希 佩 洛西过去两年内仅在乘坐空军飞机往返的旅行途中，佩洛西享受的巧克力草莓等美食服务就花费了国家10万美元。在这份长达2000页的账单上，佩洛西担任议长期间，103次乘军机代表国会出访，31次带了自己的家人。其中一次账单上所列的食物美酒足以用来举办一场大型学生聚会。 组织负责人菲顿说：尽管媒体多次炮轰佩洛西滥用空军飞机，但她依然将空军当作自己的私人旅行服务机构厖 ”。其实美国人的骄奢淫逸才是世界富人和贪官污吏们仰慕的榜样。 2008年华尔街金融大鳄们甚至用国家的解困资金给自己发奖金红包，过着穷奢极欲的生活。深陷困境的美洲银行向其近700名管理人员发放了36亿美元的年终奖金。奥巴马政府对陷入困境的美国国际集团(AIG)发放1.65亿美元奖金的行为表示愤慨，但美国政府同时承认，虽然联邦政府对这家保险业巨头提供了大规模资金援助，但却无法阻止其奖金发放行为。从百姓到总统这种巨大的无助感是什么造成的呢？
149f784ba08dbf5c36b7b02bfd18955dc55206a0.translatedText: ”Occupy Wall Street” is like a headless fly, symbolically venting its helplessness to the beneficiaries of systemic corruption. Since the "Occupy Wall Street" movement broke out on September 17, the movement has lasted for two full months. Despite bloody clearings in many places, the Occupy movement has gained strength and strength. It has spread from New York to more than 100 cities, from urban areas to ports, to university campuses, and back to Wall Street. On November 17, exactly two months after the movement began, thousands of Wall Street protesters shouted slogans to shut down Wall Street. However, the "Occupy Wall Street" movement in the United States gives people the impression of being like a headless fly, hitting here and there with a hammer and a stick. Too many demands mean that they lose their demands. The key to the movement losing focus is because people feel social injustice, but fail to see the root causes of social injustice and get to the essence of the problem. 1. Why Americans can’t live with Wall Street. During the 2008 financial crisis, many corporate executives brought down their companies, but it did not affect their personal income. Including severance pay for those executives who resigned due to poor management, their annual income exceeded hundreds of millions of dollars. According to a report by Le Monde on August 31, 2011, among the 100 highest-paid chief executive officers (CEOs) in the United States, 25 last year's salary exceeded the tax amount of their company. The average annual income of U.S. CEOs has risen from less than 50 times the average annual income of ordinary workers in the 1960s to about 350 times now. This kind of predatory unfair distribution, or reasonable and legal corruption, is probably the envy of any corrupt official in the world. Yes, if you can corrupt legally, who wants to be afraid of being corrupt secretly? The American people's struggle with Wall Street is not going to change overnight. On the one hand, the unemployment rate in the United States remains high, and many families are in trouble and unable to survive; on the other hand, the richest people in the United States have no worries. They control assets that are "too big to afford to fail." No matter how bad the economy is, the country will take care of it. The richest 1% of the population in the United States owns 35% of the net wealth of the entire society, while the low- and middle-income groups, which account for 80% of the population, only own 15% of the net wealth of the society. Since the outbreak of the financial crisis, the proportion of social wealth owned by the richest people in the United States has not only not declined, but has actually increased. There is a revolving door in American politics and business, and talents from both sides can easily switch to each other. U.S. government officials themselves are not as incorruptible as Chinese media elites describe, and they all fly economy class. Let’s look at an old news item about Nancy Pelosi, the former Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives: “In the past two years, Nancy Pelosi’s gourmet services such as chocolate-covered strawberries cost the country $100,000 during her round-trip travel on an Air Force plane. In this 2,000-page bill, during her tenure as Speaker, Pelosi traveled to Congress 103 times by military aircraft and brought her own family 31 times. The food and wine listed on one of the bills was enough to host a large student party. Fitton, the head of the organization, said: Although the media has repeatedly bombarded Pelosi for abusing Air Force aircraft, she still uses the Air Force as her own private travel service agency." In fact, Americans' arrogance and extravagance are the role models that the world's rich and corrupt officials look up to. In 2008, Wall Street financial giants even used the country's relief funds to give themselves bonuses and red envelopes, leading a luxurious and luxurious life. Troubled Bank of America handed out $3.6 billion in year-end bonuses to its nearly 700 managers. The Obama administration has expressed outrage over the $165 million in bonuses handed out by embattled American International Group (AIG), but it also acknowledged that despite a massive federal bailout of the insurance giant, it was unable to stop the bonuses. What causes this huge sense of helplessness from ordinary people to the president?

0502dcf03f0a339eec5cac6db4c94a5e08172ec1.sourceText: 2. 美国华丽的民主制度掩盖着制度性剥削的本质 美国这种1%人口对99%人口的压榨是建立在自由民主法制基础上的，是人民自己选择的政府在自己的脖子上套上一层层枷锁。美国这种合法腐败的制度是人民一票一票自己选出的政府建立的，怨谁？当人们把愤怒发泄到那些制度的收益者身上时，却没有反思现行民主制度的缺陷。
0502dcf03f0a339eec5cac6db4c94a5e08172ec1.translatedText: 2. The gorgeous democratic system of the United States conceals the nature of systemic exploitation. The oppression of 99% of the population by 1% of the population in the United States is based on liberal democracy and the legal system. It is the government chosen by the people that puts layers of shackles on their necks. This legal and corrupt system in the United States was established by a government elected by the people one by one. Who is to blame? When people vent their anger on the beneficiaries of those systems, they fail to reflect on the shortcomings of the current democratic system.

ee120031f78640dd65a84e75e6eb3b29e157673b.sourceText: 美国的草根老百姓长期生活在光鲜亮丽天堂的阴暗角落里，经济好的时候，社会虽然不公平，但大家衣食无忧，相安无事。当经济长期笼罩在衰退阴影里时，最先受到伤害的就是普通百姓。美国是个寅吃卯粮高消费的国家，从政府到个人家庭都靠借贷过日子，个人很少存款。一旦失业，家庭失去经济来源，面对房贷，车贷，财产税，水电气费，医疗保险，学费，汽油等高额的生活费用一样也少不了，生活立刻陷入窘境。虽然有美国政府的临时失业救济可以勉强维持生计，但长期找不到工作，一旦超过政府失业救济时限，面临的将是交不起贷款和各种税费最终导致家庭破产。世界许多地方的人可能不理解，住着洋房开着汽车怎么叫贫困？其实这才是问题的症结所在。在发展中国家，普通失业者不需要太多的费用就可以生活下去，美国则不同，房子汽车是贷款买的，由于居住分散，公共交通不发达，许多人离了汽车连基本的生活都无法保证，建在空旷原野上的独立住宅，没有充足的能源冬天可能就会冻死。 在世界最富裕的美国，社会分配不公的矛盾在08年金融危机后长期低迷的经济环境下变得更加尖锐，造反不是穷国的专利，美国老百姓被逼无奈也会揭竿而起。 奇怪的是像郎咸平这样的留美财经精英，对美国显而易见的社会问题及其根源避而不谈，却在国内到处渲染美国制度的完美性。看看郎咸平在清华的演讲， http://v.youku.com/v_show/id_XMjg3Njk5ODA=.html 一方面引经据典，把美国现行社会描绘的像天堂一样；另方面把中国30年的改革说得一无是处，朗咸平到底要干什么？ 近期卸任回国投入总统大选，一直战斗在”对敌斗争”第一线的美国前驻华大使洪博培不小心一语道出美国可做不可说的国家战略。 http://bbs.wforum.com/guns/bbsviewer.php?trd_id=149234 11月15日在总统竞选活动中称：美国没有必要和中国打一场贸易战，美国必须依靠”我们在中国内部的盟友和支持者 ”扳倒中国，只有中国倒下去，美国才有夺回制造业的机会。
ee120031f78640dd65a84e75e6eb3b29e157673b.translatedText: The grassroots people in the United States have long lived in the dark corners of the glamorous paradise. When the economy is good, although the society is unfair, everyone has food and clothing, and lives in peace. When the economy is shrouded in the shadow of recession for a long time, ordinary people are the first to be harmed. The United States is a country where food is scarce and consumption is high. From the government to individual families, everyone relies on borrowing to live, and individuals rarely save. Once a family loses its job and loses its source of income, it is faced with high living expenses such as mortgages, car loans, property taxes, water and electricity bills, medical insurance, tuition fees, gasoline, etc., and life immediately falls into trouble. Although the U.S. government’s temporary unemployment benefits can make ends meet, if you cannot find a job for a long time, once the government’s unemployment benefits exceed the time limit, you will be faced with being unable to pay loans and various taxes, which will eventually lead to family bankruptcy. People in many parts of the world may not understand, how can living in a bungalow and driving a car be called poverty? In fact, this is the crux of the problem. In developing countries, ordinary unemployed people can live without much expense. This is different in the United States. Houses and cars are bought with loans. Due to scattered residences and underdeveloped public transportation, many people cannot even guarantee a basic life without cars. Independent houses built in open fields may freeze to death in winter without sufficient energy. In the United States, the richest country in the world, the contradiction of unfair social distribution has become more acute in the long-term sluggish economic environment after the 2008 financial crisis. Rebellion is not exclusive to poor countries, and American people will rise up if they are forced to do nothing. What is strange is that financial elites like Lang Xianping who are studying in the United States avoid talking about the obvious social problems and their root causes in the United States, but they exaggerate the perfection of the American system everywhere in China. Take a look at Lang Xianping's speech at Tsinghua University, http://v.youku.com/v_show/id_XMjg3Njk5ODA=.html On the one hand, he quoted scriptures and described the current American society as being like paradise; on the other hand, he described China's 30 years of reforms as useless. What on earth is Lang Xianping going to do? Former U.S. Ambassador to China Huntsman, who recently left office and returned to China to participate in the presidential election, and has been fighting on the front line of the "fight against the enemy" accidentally made a statement about the U.S. national strategy that can be done or not said. http://bbs.wforum.com/guns/bbsviewer.php?trd_id=149234 On November 15, he said during the presidential campaign: There is no need for the United States to fight a trade war with China. The United States must rely on "our allies and supporters within China" to bring down China. Only when China falls will the United States have the opportunity to regain its manufacturing industry.

f7d1f2086e6889573b250471ff479b90d9f0bd1a.sourceText: 在全球经济危机的大背景下，世界普遍看好和羡慕中国，但中国内部却莫名其妙地广泛弥漫着建国以来前所未有地失败主义情绪，这难道只是物价房价高涨，腐败长期得不到有效遏制滋长出的情绪吗？洪博培上述辩论等于直白地告诉那些不懂外交和美国国家战略的总统竞选者们，你们不懂得如何对付中国，推倒中国靠的不是贸易战，货币战，冷战，热战，靠的是5亿年轻的网民。要不是主持人打断洪博培的说辞，洪博培还不定如何显摆他这个中国通呢。洪博培的表白既是对自己在中国工作的肯定，又是对大大小小郎咸平们表彰。 当美国陷入制度性不公泥潭，产业结构性失衡难以自拔自救的时候，美国能做的就是让自己的盟国比自己更惨，敌国去死。一波又一波的欧元区财政危机，都离不开美国从中使坏的影子，而对于美国认定的头号竞争对手，必将是置之死地而后快。2011美国大部分重要的外交活动都是打着重返亚洲的旗号调动一切可以调动的力量对付中国。挑起中国周边国家围攻中国，在各种国际场合都忘不了逼人民币升值，尤为重要的是不惜血本地花巨大力气在中国和海外华人中培植”盟友和支持者”，从内部搞乱中国。美国目的就是奥巴马说的”美国永远不做老二”。只要中国，欧洲自乱阵脚，美国就达到不战而屈人之兵的目的，只有分裂了欧洲和中国，把世界变成除美国之外都是一盘散沙不团结的小国，美国才能永远保住世界老大的地位。 有一天中国跨了，美国保住世界老大的地位，郎咸平们，你们功不可没啊！ 其实可怕的不是中国有几个郎咸平，可怕的是”党的喉舌”新华社竟如此报道洪博培上述言论的：《美前驻华大使洪博培批美政客煽动反华情绪》： http://news.sina.com.cn/w/2011-11-16/093723474477.shtml 。真不知新华社的编导们如何从洪博培的只言片语中得这个结论的。中国许多媒体精英们：你们不是在美国有家有业的郎咸平，你们也不是美国公民，你们知道自己在做什么吗？
f7d1f2086e6889573b250471ff479b90d9f0bd1a.translatedText: Against the backdrop of the global economic crisis, the world is generally optimistic and envious of China, but within China there is an inexplicable and widespread defeatist sentiment unprecedented since the founding of the People's Republic of China. Is this just a sentiment fostered by rising prices and housing, and the long-term failure to effectively curb corruption? Huntsman's above-mentioned debate bluntly told those presidential candidates who do not understand diplomacy and US national strategy that they do not know how to deal with China. To bring down China does not rely on trade wars, currency wars, cold wars, or hot wars, but on 500 million young Internet users. If the host hadn't interrupted Huntsman's speech, Huntsman wouldn't have been able to show off his China expertise. Huntsman's confession is not only an affirmation of his work in China, but also a commendation to everyone, big and small. When the United States falls into the quagmire of systemic injustice and finds it difficult to extricate itself from structural imbalances in industry, all the United States can do is to make its allies worse off than itself and to let its enemies die. Wave after wave of financial crises in the Eurozone are inseparable from the shadow of the United States causing harm, and the top competitor identified by the United States will definitely be put to death quickly. Most of the important diplomatic activities of the United States in 2011 were to mobilize all available forces to deal with China under the banner of returning to Asia. It provokes China's neighboring countries to besiege China, and never forgets to force the RMB to appreciate on various international occasions. What is particularly important is that it spends huge efforts to cultivate "allies and supporters" among China and overseas Chinese at all costs, and disrupts China from within. The purpose of the United States is what Obama said: "The United States will never be the second best." As long as China and Europe are in disarray, the United States will achieve its goal of defeating others without a fight. Only by dividing Europe and China and turning the world into a fragmented and ununited small country, except the United States, can the United States forever maintain its position as the world's leader. One day, China is overthrown, and the United States retains its position as the world leader. Lang Xianping and others, you are indispensable! In fact, the scary thing is not that there are a few Lang Xianpings in China. What is scary is that the "party mouthpiece" Xinhua News Agency actually reported Huntsman's above remarks like this: "Former US Ambassador to China Huntsman criticized US politicians for inciting anti-China sentiment": http://news.sina.com.cn/w/2011-11-16/093723474477.shtml. I really don’t know how the editors and directors of Xinhua News Agency came to this conclusion from Huntsman’s few words. Many media elites in China: You are not Lang Xianping, who has a family and business in the United States, and you are not an American citizen. Do you know what you are doing?

bf6a24b2ca1b709ac23c5d69b7022ea62feba8b6.sourceText: 亚利桑那进入季风季节

65b21e3ad64ac869d964ce46ca7370c5f4174153.sourceText: 亚利桑那进入季风季节 季风改变天气的模式。季风季节典型的是刮风，从西部或者西南部来的风，使整个亚利桑那的气…
65b21e3ad64ac869d964ce46ca7370c5f4174153.translatedText: Arizona Enters Monsoon Season Monsoons change weather patterns. The monsoon season is typically windy, with winds coming from the west or southwest causing the air throughout Arizona...

fda82d011143da3e9fa1239b5519ea73610817db.sourceText: 季风改变天气的模式。季风季节典型的是刮风，从西部或者西南部来的风，使整个亚利桑那的气候会比较干燥。然而也会从东部，或者东南部刮来的风会带来墨西哥湾的湿气，这些湿气遇到亚利桑那的热空气就会变成雷阵雨和暴雨。今年季风与往年相比没有太大的变化，唯一需要提的是，可能会减慢厄尔尼诺现象。
fda82d011143da3e9fa1239b5519ea73610817db.translatedText: Monsoons change weather patterns. The monsoon season is typically windy, coming from the west or southwest, making the climate throughout Arizona drier. However, winds blowing from the east or southeast will bring moisture from the Gulf of Mexico. When this moisture meets the hot air in Arizona, it will turn into thundershowers and heavy rains. This year's monsoon has not changed much compared to previous years. The only thing that needs to be mentioned is that it may slow down the El Niño phenomenon.

0a1a773d02e8bcbc3413ec4d01c96389f27afad5.sourceText: 根据全国气象服务记录。1984年亚利桑那降水9.56英寸，是最湿的一次季风季候。最近几年，最湿的一次季风气候发生在2014年，降水大约6.34英寸，名列历史第七。最干的季风季节在1924年，仅降水0.35英寸。最近最干的年份在2007，仅降水0.74英寸。名列历史第五。
0a1a773d02e8bcbc3413ec4d01c96389f27afad5.translatedText: Based on National Weather Service records. In 1984, Arizona received 9.56 inches of precipitation, making it the wettest monsoon season. In recent years, the wettest monsoon occurred in 2014, with approximately 6.34 inches of precipitation, ranking seventh in history. The driest monsoon season was 1924, with only 0.35 inches of precipitation. The driest recent year was 2007, with only 0.74 inches of precipitation. Ranked fifth in history.

dda74d8e68b1740041b2d44a064087009948ad15.sourceText: 气象人员预计下周四和周五将会有降雨，其余的时间六月都会比较干燥。
dda74d8e68b1740041b2d44a064087009948ad15.translatedText: Forecasters expect rain next Thursday and Friday, with the rest of June expected to be dry.

061d7959c37742bc8e5195728e2d4863ec2ad5c4.sourceText: 全美乘坐公交车上下班的人数去年上升到历史第二高。全美公交协会主席梅拉尼菲（Michael Melaniphy）星期一说，如果不是因为超级风暴珊迪袭击东岸造成多处捷运系统瘫痪，公交车乘客数量还会更高。
061d7959c37742bc8e5195728e2d4863ec2ad5c4.translatedText: The number of people commuting by bus nationwide rose to the second-highest level in history last year. Michael Melaniphy, president of the National Transit Association, said Monday that bus ridership numbers would have been higher had it not been for Superstorm Sandy, which hit the East Coast and knocked out many transit systems.

e860bd7d85a700d2c5b2ad3f1dca3fec79d8d3b8.sourceText: 据路透社报道，全美公交协会的报告说，随着更多人找到工作，去年全美乘坐地铁列车、大巴、轻轨等捷运系统的人次达到105.2亿，上升1.49%。
e860bd7d85a700d2c5b2ad3f1dca3fec79d8d3b8.translatedText: According to Reuters, the National Transit Association reported that as more people find jobs, the number of people taking subway trains, buses, light rail and other rapid transit systems in the United States last year reached 10.52 billion, an increase of 1.49%.

8393ae51152bf73d4d9ec4e650be69363e13b5cb.sourceText: 另据《今日美国》报道，全国州议会大会2012年的一份报告说，如果一个人放弃开车、改乘公交车上下班，一年可节省1万美元。
8393ae51152bf73d4d9ec4e650be69363e13b5cb.translatedText: According to USA Today, a 2012 report from the National Conference of State Legislatures said that if a person gave up driving and instead commuted by bus, he could save $10,000 a year.

87dacf76035a426b0eb7696ee6b7dd8613374149.sourceText: 不管是哪种公交车辆，乘客人数都在增长。路透社说，同2011年相比，地铁等重轨铁路列车乘客上升1.42%，轻轨乘客上升4.47%，通勤列车乘客上升0.52%，大巴乘客上升1.2%。有些城市轻轨系统扩大或增加线路，乘客上升较快。
87dacf76035a426b0eb7696ee6b7dd8613374149.translatedText: Regardless of the type of bus, the number of passengers is growing. Reuters said that compared with 2011, the number of passengers on heavy rail trains such as subways increased by 1.42%, that of light rail trains increased by 4.47%, that of commuter trains increased by 0.52%, and that of buses increased by 1.2%. Some urban light rail systems have expanded or added lines, and the number of passengers has increased rapidly.

c1eee260d1acdea14994118117b8e8c9f96a8533.sourceText: 去年最高一个季度，公交车乘客数量低于2011年同期，显示超级风暴珊迪造成的影响巨大。去年11月，纽约和新泽西因为飓风失业人数上升4.16万。
c1eee260d1acdea14994118117b8e8c9f96a8533.translatedText: During the highest quarter last year, the number of bus passengers was lower than during the same period in 2011, showing the huge impact of Superstorm Sandy. In November last year, the number of unemployed people in New York and New Jersey increased by 41,600 due to hurricanes.

115440e942bf65cbc04bb85401a34ca2e3e6165f.sourceText: 汽油价格上升和不喜欢堵车造成公交车乘客出现2008年以来的最大幅度增长。2008年是1957年以来的公交车乘客人数最高纪录。
115440e942bf65cbc04bb85401a34ca2e3e6165f.translatedText: Rising gasoline prices and a dislike of traffic jams have caused the largest increase in bus ridership since 2008. 2008 was the highest number of bus passengers since 1957.

1b64bcb16fd1447d58148b977759fbe9e5ed6f1f.sourceText: 梅拉尼菲说，将近60%的公交车乘客都是上班族。
1b64bcb16fd1447d58148b977759fbe9e5ed6f1f.translatedText: Melanifee said that nearly 60% of bus passengers are office workers.

e2e31c67f7cb9db01d90a963ef9e4a0a739f81f0.sourceText: 尽管经济学家认为美国失业率仍然高于健康水平，但失业率一年多来一直在下降。去年年底失业率为7.8%，低于2011年底的8.5%。
e2e31c67f7cb9db01d90a963ef9e4a0a739f81f0.translatedText: The U.S. unemployment rate has been falling for more than a year, although economists believe it remains above healthy levels. The unemployment rate at the end of last year was 7.8%, down from 8.5% at the end of 2011.

a5c97d483c6578372abe34aa44c97927f5dc85cf.sourceText: 公交协会指出，西雅图和华盛顿公交系统乘客人数上升11.8%，而这些城市新增就业超过3万人。
a5c97d483c6578372abe34aa44c97927f5dc85cf.translatedText: The Transit Association pointed out that the number of passengers on the Seattle and Washington bus systems increased by 11.8%, and more than 30,000 new jobs were created in these cities.

240af6b9bedd8f4129c9785ebfb22956aaca0fa4.sourceText: 至少15家捷运系统去年乘客创新记录。目前，捷运行业的问题就是公交系统能否满足需要。从传统上看，车票收入仅仅相当于公交系统资本和营运开支的一部分，联邦、州和地方政府要提供大量补贴。
240af6b9bedd8f4129c9785ebfb22956aaca0fa4.translatedText: At least 15 MRT systems set new passenger records last year. At present, the problem in the MRT industry is whether the bus system can meet the needs. Traditionally, fare revenue represents only a portion of a transit system's capital and operating expenses, requiring substantial subsidies from federal, state, and local governments.

87f47b6614544a4eff8c844b4b9ef4fdd25bada6.sourceText: 梅拉尼菲指出，全美付诸投票的62项措施当中，49项都是提高捷运税。该协会自从2000年以来还没有看到对资助公交系统这么高的支持率。
87f47b6614544a4eff8c844b4b9ef4fdd25bada6.translatedText: Melanifee pointed out that among the 62 measures put on the ballot across the United States, 49 are to increase the rapid transit tax. The association hasn't seen such high support for funding bus systems since 2000.

67b31380a5e2590ffbea2f9b544c4de776d1f913.sourceText: 国会去年通过人们期待已久的地面交通资助授权法案。它包括为捷运系统提供贷款、资助和拨款，用于维修和更新设备。那一项目因为资金来自联邦汽油税，不受联邦自动削减开支项目影响。
67b31380a5e2590ffbea2f9b544c4de776d1f913.translatedText: Congress passed the long-awaited Surface Transportation Funding Authorization Act last year. It includes loans, grants and grants for rapid transit systems to repair and upgrade equipment. That program is not affected by federal sequester cuts because it is funded by the federal gas tax.

607a3dce6ca32f8cdf398272bae032aac5dd21f4.sourceText: 澳门将在台湾设立办事处
607a3dce6ca32f8cdf398272bae032aac5dd21f4.translatedText: Macau will set up an office in Taiwan

97a9589741419a6555cd97b77631e4652559a12e.sourceText: 澳门将在台湾设立办事处 新华网 澳门特区政府发言人谭俊荣４日宣布，澳门特区政府将在台北设立”澳…
97a9589741419a6555cd97b77631e4652559a12e.translatedText: Macau will set up an office in Taiwan Xinhuanet Macau SAR Government Spokesperson Alex Tam announced on the 4th that the Macau SAR Government will establish a "Macau...

638f6b797c9661aa2a8b9624cb2172bb26c6514c.sourceText: 澳门特区政府发言人谭俊荣４日宣布，澳门特区政府将在台北设立”澳门经济文化办事处”，为澳门居民在台工作、学习、旅游、商务和生活等方面提供综合性服务。

5fa31cb19d88077c7b89f769f62bda1ccc185cd9.sourceText: 特区政府与台湾当局经过多个月深入磋商，就两地设立综合性办事机构一事达成共识。澳门特区政府在台湾设立”澳门经济文化办事处”，特区政府同意在澳门的”台北经济文化中心”更名为”台北经济文化办事处”。
5fa31cb19d88077c7b89f769f62bda1ccc185cd9.translatedText: After many months of in-depth consultations, the Macao SAR government and the Taiwan authorities reached a consensus on the establishment of a comprehensive office in Taiwan, and the Macao SAR government agreed to establish the "Taipei Economic and Cultural Center" in Macao. "Changed its name to "Taipei Economic and Cultural Office".

95b9ed546e5b741bf7f07fa3b73009953f9c26b3.sourceText: 据悉，澳门特区设在台湾的经济文化办事处的业务功能主要有三方面：为澳门居民在台工作、学习、旅游、商务和生活，以及文书验证与紧急事件提供服务与协助；促进澳台经贸旅游、科技环保、教育、医疗卫生、文化创意、学术出版、专业技术、社会福利及其他领域的交流与合作；加强澳台两地共同打击犯罪以及司法互助合作等。
95b9ed546e5b741bf7f07fa3b73009953f9c26b3.translatedText: It is reported that the business functions of the Macao SAR Economic and Cultural Office in Taiwan mainly have three aspects: to provide services and assistance for Macao residents to work, study, travel, business and life in Taiwan, as well as document verification and emergency events; to promote Macao and Taiwan Exchanges and cooperation in economics, trade, tourism, science and technology, environmental protection, education, medical and health, cultural creativity, academic publishing, professional technology, social welfare and other fields; strengthening Macao and Taiwan's joint fight against crime and mutual judicial assistance cooperation, etc.

f137f25b456a54ee28898748a01e84e7aab4b377.sourceText: 谭俊荣表示，澳门在台设立经济文化办事处是特区政府施政的重大突破，澳台两地之间的经济、文化、教育、医疗卫生及社会服务等领域的合作将会进一步深化，澳台关系将迈上新的台阶。
f137f25b456a54ee28898748a01e84e7aab4b377.translatedText: Tam Chung-rong said that Macao's establishment of an economic and cultural office in Taiwan is a special zone. With the major breakthrough in government policy, cooperation between Macao and Taiwan in the fields of economy, culture, education, medical care and social services will be further deepened, and Macao-Taiwan relations will reach a new level.

ff2e24c60480e6156aaac38c93f61f6000cde82e.sourceText: 谭俊荣表示，特区政府正积极开展在台澳门经济文化办事处的筹设工作，预计在今年年底正式启用运作。办事处人员编制为１０至１５人，将从政府不同部门征调，组建一支优秀工作团队。必要时，办事处会在台湾当地聘用适量工作人员。
ff2e24c60480e6156aaac38c93f61f6000cde82e.translatedText: Tam Chung-rong said that the SAR government is actively carrying out preparations for the establishment of the Macao Economic and Cultural Office in Taiwan. , is expected to be officially put into operation at the end of this year. The staff of the office will be 10 to 15, and an excellent work team will be recruited from different government departments. If necessary, the office will hire an appropriate number of staff in Taiwan.

8b15a2099e97ee8bc1309b350f11a0040038f15a.sourceText: 另据了解，”台北经济文化中心”更名为”台北经济文化办事处”之后，将继续作为一个综合性办事机构，业务功能与澳门经济文化办事处相似，同时保留现有协助办理澳门居民赴台所需各项相关手续的业务。
8b15a2099e97ee8bc1309b350f11a0040038f15a.translatedText: It is also understood that the "Taipei Economic and Cultural Center" will be renamed. After the "Taipei Economic and Cultural Office", it will continue to serve as a comprehensive office with similar business functions to the Macao Economic and Cultural Office, while retaining the existing business of assisting Macao residents to handle various relevant procedures required to travel to Taiwan.

ed742ee8634d007650a8509ac430054f4815355a.sourceText: 谭俊荣指出，澳门在台湾现有超过４０００名学生，还有不少澳门居民在台生活、旅游、经商，而台湾每年到澳门的旅客将近１３０万人次，众多台商对投资澳门及葡语国家感兴趣，今后澳台将更加紧密地携手为两地同胞提供服务和协助，更好地促进两地的繁荣发展，增进澳台两地民众的福祉。
ed742ee8634d007650a8509ac430054f4815355a.translatedText: Tam Junrong pointed out that Macao currently has more than 4,000 people in Taiwan Students and many Macao residents live, travel and do business in Taiwan. There are nearly 1.3 million tourists from Taiwan to Macao every year. Many Taiwanese businessmen are interested in investing in Macao and Portuguese-speaking countries. In the future, Macao and Taiwan will work more closely to provide services and assistance to compatriots in the two places, better promote the prosperity and development of the two places, and enhance the well-being of the people in Macao and Taiwan.

927d4645480f51454d84502ad56a215ea8142721.sourceText: 一个侨社活动能够几十年地长期地举办下去，这表明是个有意义的活动，凤凰城华人年复一年地举办庆祝美国国庆，就是这样的一个活动。 举办​​这个活动要有一个平台，这个平台就是鳯凰城侨联总会，在这个平台上，华侨先辈通过庆祝美国国庆的活动形式，来诉求我们华人也是生活在这个社会，不应受到岐视。华人通过活动来显示自身的团结，用平台来弘扬中华文化，用选美来让下一代参与，而且也用这个平台，争取到联邦政府拨款兴建康宁和康乐大厦等各种权益。 侨联的平台需要建立。数十年来，侨联属下的十多个团体一直是依靠力量，每个社团年年出钱出力，通力合作办好一个又一个活动，不但做了公益事业，活跃侨社，也取得了成绩。支撑着这个平台的有不少的侨领和骨干，而更多的是义工，历史上没有留下他们的名字，但没有他们将一事无成，让我们再次给他们掌声。 近年的国庆与选美活动，都会发行国庆纪念册。今年的纪念册图文并茂，文章并以中英文刊登，作为侨社继往开来的刋物，从去年起，我们开辟了”侨联年度纪事”专栏，各个团体的年度照片和社区活动也留下了历史的剪影在文章方面，本期关于华侨历史的有”百年侨路说华商”，”凤凰城有过唐人街”;人物介绍的有”资深侨领余文劲”，”才艺小姐余爱莲”;在教育方面的则有”青少年人才的培养”，为侨社今后培养出好的接班人。 侨联成立以来，今年首次由侨联主席率团前往罗省中华会馆拜会和带领选美佳丽到凤凰卫视参观学习。侨联安排佳丽们参加各类型的公益活动，让她们不但拥有外在美，也提升内在美，这些内容在纪念册中也作了精彩的报道。值得一提的还有，今年举办的选美活动选择了新的剧场，其地点，环境及舞台都比较理想，而选美节目内容亦有新创意，尝试用中西文化结合的艺术形式来表达，除通过用专业舞蹈老师和专用场地对佳丽进行培训外，亦邀请到经验丰富的专家来作舞台和舞蹈设计，而整个选美过程以”京典花木兰，魅彩美人鱼，魔幻俏公主，秀慧灰姑娘”等四个主题来连贯，力求用美丽，歌舞，灯光，声响，幻景，营造出动漫，浪漫与梦幻的氛围，让观众能有个全新的视听享受。 其实，全美国能举办选美活动的单位大多都有财团支持，或有商业目的的团体​​赞助，而凤凰城侨联数十年来一直依靠的是我们自身华人侨社的力量，这在美国华人社区中是绝无仅有的，这活动已成为鳯凰城侨联的传统任务，也成为了我们值得骄傲的本土文化。 今年的国庆和选美，比往年更有观赏性，最大的亮点之一，是舞台和舞蹈的设计富于浪漫和有梦幻的色彩。欢迎大家踊跃购票观看，请注意今年已换新的演出场地，具体资讯如下：
927d4645480f51454d84502ad56a215ea8142721.translatedText: An overseas Chinese community event can be held for decades, which shows that it is a meaningful event. The Phoenix Chinese community holds such an event year after year to celebrate the National Day of the United States. To hold this event, there must be a platform, and this platform is the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation. On this platform, the overseas Chinese ancestors used the celebration of the National Day of the United States to appeal that we Chinese also live in this society and should not be discriminated against. The Chinese use activities to show their unity, use platforms to promote Chinese culture, and use beauty pageants to engage the next generation. They also use this platform to win funding from the federal government for the construction of Kangning and Kangle Buildings and other rights. The platform of the Overseas Chinese Federation needs to be established. For decades, more than ten groups affiliated to the Overseas Chinese Federation have been relying on their own strength. Each group contributes money and efforts every year, and works together to organize one event after another. It not only does public welfare and activates the overseas Chinese community, but also achieves results. There are many overseas Chinese leaders and backbones who support this platform, and even more are volunteers. Their names have not been left in history, but without them nothing would have been accomplished. Let us applaud them again. In recent years, National Day commemorative albums have been issued for National Day and beauty pageants. This year’s commemorative album is full of pictures and texts, and the articles are published in Chinese and English. As a reminder of the past and future of the overseas Chinese community, since last year, we have opened a column of "Annual Chronicles of the Overseas Chinese Federation". The annual photos and community activities of various groups have also left a snapshot of history. In terms of articles, this issue focuses on Regarding the history of overseas Chinese, there are "A Hundred Years of Overseas Chinese Businessmen" and "Phoenix City had Chinatown"; character introductions include "Senior Overseas Chinese Leader Yu Wenjin" and "Talented Miss Yu Ailian"; in terms of education, there is "Cultivation of Young Talents" to cultivate good successors for the overseas Chinese community in the future. Since the establishment of the Overseas Chinese Federation, this year, for the first time, the Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation led a delegation to pay a visit to the Luo Provincial Chinese Association and led the beauty contestants to visit and study at Phoenix TV. The Overseas Chinese Federation arranges beauties to participate in various charity activities, so that they can not only have external beauty, but also enhance inner beauty. These contents are also wonderfully reported in the commemorative book. It is worth mentioning that a new theater was chosen for this year’s beauty pageant. Its location, environment and stage are ideal. The content of the beauty pageant also has new ideas, trying to use an art form that combines Chinese and Western cultures. In addition to training the beauties with professional dance teachers and dedicated venues, we also invite experienced dancers. Rich experts are responsible for the stage and dance design, and the entire beauty pageant process is connected with four themes: "Mulan, the charming mermaid, the magical princess, and the beautiful Cinderella". We strive to use beauty, singing and dancing, lights, sounds, and illusions to create an animation, romantic and dreamy atmosphere, so that the audience can have a new audio-visual enjoyment. In fact, most of the organizations that can organize beauty pageants in the United States are supported by consortiums or sponsored by groups with commercial purposes. For decades, the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation has relied on the strength of our own Chinese overseas community. This is unique among the Chinese communities in the United States. This event has become the traditional mission of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation and has become a local culture that we are proud of. This year's National Day and beauty pageant are more entertaining than in previous years. One of the biggest highlights is the romantic and dreamy design of the stage and dance. Everyone is welcome to buy tickets and watch. Please note that the performance venue has been changed to a new one this year. The specific information is as follows:

9b3c49f7b90f92397b1ecf10e457f9661c200d18.translatedText: On the evening of May 23, the Asian Chinese Restaurant will be held at Hibachi Buffet solemnly celebrates the honorary retirement of Huang Lijing, Chinese Commissioner of the Alberta Health Bureau.

2b490fb4a48c9765a19d0ab0bae5125b5ef31ee9.sourceText: 黄丽憬原来就职于中餐馆行业，后来进入亚省卫生局工作，为亚利桑那中餐馆发展起到重要作用。她精通中英文，非常流利地传达卫生局的信息，同时为中餐馆员工培训，卫生稽查等起到了积极的促进作用。黄丽憬在卫生局就职多年，她说稽查不是为了打击餐馆行业，目的是帮助中餐馆健康积极的成长，惩罚不是目的，协调好卫生局和餐馆的关系，达到双赢，才是餐馆协会和卫生局合作的蓝图。
2b490fb4a48c9765a19d0ab0bae5125b5ef31ee9.translatedText: >Huang Lijin originally worked in the Chinese restaurant industry, and later joined the Alberta Health Bureau and played an important role in the development of Chinese restaurants in Arizona. She is proficient in Chinese and English and can convey the information of the Health Bureau very fluently. At the same time, she plays an active role in promoting the training of Chinese restaurant staff and health inspections. Huang Lijing has worked in the Health Bureau for many years. She said that the purpose of the inspection is not to crack down on the restaurant industry, but to help Chinese restaurants grow healthily and positively. Punishment is not the purpose. Coordinating the relationship between the Health Bureau and restaurants to achieve a win-win situation is the blueprint for cooperation between the Restaurant Association and the Health Bureau.

d482f28e897373018169fd0e592b735462adb45c.sourceText: 餐馆会主席张华芳表示，都是因为有餐馆会和卫生局的良好关系，才能让现在亚省中餐行业做到如此繁荣。感谢黄丽憬十几年如一日的努力。希望未来有更好的合作。
d482f28e897373018169fd0e592b735462adb45c.translatedText: Restaurant Association Chairman Zhang Huafang said that it is only because of the good relationship between the Restaurant Association and the Health Bureau that the Chinese food industry in Alberta is now so prosperous. Thanks to Huang Lijin for her hard work for more than ten years. Hope there will be better cooperation in the future.

61d17eae549aed3df3eceef88218a850498ec765.sourceText: 本次活动是由徐国富和梅树德组织，所有餐馆协会的理事都积极参与。宴会上有琴歌劲舞，有美酒佳餚，还有精美蛋糕。大家素知丽憬人美歌甜，掌声过后，又听到她那悠情如水美好的歌声。其后，多位朋友纷纷合唱、独唱，把心中的歌送给了她。当夜最兴奋的还有，多年来曾一起为中餐馆服务过的董事们，又能相聚在一起把酒言欢叙旧。岁月流逝，友情不改，廿七年风雨同路，留下这一张张的相片，也就成就为历史回味的一段佳话。
61d17eae549aed3df3eceef88218a850498ec765.translatedText: This event was organized by Xu Guofu and Mei Shude, and all directors of the restaurant association actively participated. The banquet included music, singing, dancing, fine wine, delicious food, and exquisite cakes. Everyone knew that Li was beautiful and sweet. After the applause, we heard her beautiful singing voice. Afterwards, many friends sang in chorus and solo, giving her the songs in their hearts. The most exciting part of the night was that the directors who had worked together in Chinese restaurants over the years were able to get together again and reminisce about old times over wine. As time goes by, friendship remains unchanged. We have been together through thick and thin for twenty-seven years, and the photos left behind have become a good story that history will remember.

634242a30075a46c474bf246267fa91dd0306277.sourceText: 橙县华侨文教服务中心于1月4日举办新旧主任交接典礼，由驻洛杉矶办事处副处长刘克裕进行监交。橙县各侨领代表当晚联合举行欢送洛杉矶办事处领事杨爵鸿、橙县华侨文教服务中心主任王鼎元暨欢迎新任高家富主任餐会，侨界颁发感谢状及献花，答谢王主任任内不遗馀力，替海外侨胞服务，同时欢迎高家富主任到任，场面热闹温馨。 荣调返台的王鼎元主任表达对侨界的感谢和祝福，王主任表示，橙县华侨文教中心因有各侨社的踊跃参与及志工协助，才能使得在推广侨务上，更加得心应手，非常感谢侨民的支持与配合，高家富主任在餐会中亦感谢在橙侨中心耕耘多年的王鼎元主任，并表示将在既有的良好基础上，继续推展橙县、圣地牙哥、凤凰城之侨务工作，并期盼和侨社保持密切联繫，服务侨胞。 该项欢送与欢迎餐会由侨务谘询委员吕耀勳召集，参加的侨界代表包括侨务委员邱垂煌及林英郎，侨务顾问许正雄、蔡玟慧、吕众英、徐湛生，侨务促进委员康秋霞、张亦珍，柑县台湾医师及牙医师公会会长郭素容，柑县台湾同乡会会长锺和易，橙县华人商会会长何武权，南加卅台湾旅馆业同业公会理事长许清松及会长汪蔚兴、建中校友会会长李欣生，莘莘中文学校校长孙霭云，以及柑县台美商会、柑县台湾人公共事务会、橙县华人狮子会等社团代表40馀人。
634242a30075a46c474bf246267fa91dd0306277.translatedText: The Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center held a handover ceremony for the new and old directors on January 4, and Liu Keyu, deputy director of the Los Angeles Office, supervised the handover. Representatives of the overseas Chinese leaders in Orange County jointly held a farewell dinner that evening for Yang Juehong, the consul of the Los Angeles office, and Wang Dingyuan, director of the Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center, and to welcome the new director Gao Jiafu. The overseas Chinese community issued certificates of appreciation and presented flowers to express their gratitude to Director Wang for sparing no effort in serving overseas Chinese during his tenure. They also welcomed Director Gao Jiafu to take office. The scene was lively and warm. Director Wang Dingyuan, who returned to Taiwan after being transferred to Taiwan, expressed his gratitude and blessings to the overseas Chinese community. Director Wang said that the Orange County Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Center has the active participation of various overseas Chinese societies and the assistance of volunteers, which makes it easier to promote overseas Chinese affairs. He is very grateful to the overseas Chinese for their support and cooperation. During the dinner, Director Gao Jiafu also thanked Director Wang Dingyuan, who has worked hard at the Orange Overseas Chinese Center for many years, and said that he would continue to promote overseas Chinese affairs in Orange County, San Diego, and Phoenix based on the existing good foundation, and looked forward to maintaining close contact with overseas Chinese communities and serving overseas Chinese. The farewell and welcome dinner was convened by Lu Yaoxun, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee. Representatives from the overseas Chinese community who attended included Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee members Qiu Chuihuang and Lin Yinglang, Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisors Xu Zhengxiong, Cai Minhui, Lu Zhongying, Xu Zhansheng, Overseas Chinese Affairs Promotion Committee members Kang Qiuxia and Zhang Yizhen, Gan County Taiwan Physicians and Dentists Association President Kuo Surong, Gan County Taiwan Association President Zhong Heyi, President of the Orange County Chinese Chamber of Commerce He Wuquan, Chairman Xu Qingsong and President Wang Weixing of the Taiwan Hotel Industry Association of Southern California, President Li Xinsheng of the Jianzhong Alumni Association, Principal Sun Aiyun of Xinxin Chinese School, and more than 40 representatives from the Taiwan American Chamber of Commerce in Orange County, the Taiwanese Public Affairs Association of Orange County, and the Orange County Chinese Lions Club.

eeddbea465253ecc3a00ab5ae1587486853d7d54.sourceText: 主讲人：少君博士 少君博士，最早在中文网络上写作的作家。曾就读北京大学声学物理专业、 美国德州大学经济学专业，曾任职中国《经济日报》记者、美国匹兹堡大学研究员，并兼任中国厦门大学、华侨大学、同济大学教授等职务。四十岁盛年退休，退隐于美国凤凰城南山下。著有散文、杂文、小说、诗歌、纪实文学等多种体裁作品，出版了《凤凰城閒话》、《未名湖》、《怀念母亲》 、《人生自白》、《大陆人》、《奋斗与平等》、《阅读成都》等四十馀部著作。
eeddbea465253ecc3a00ab5ae1587486853d7d54.translatedText: Speaker: Dr. Shaojun Dr. Shaojun is the earliest writer to write on the Chinese Internet. He studied acoustic physics at Peking University and economics at the University of Texas in the United States. He has worked as a reporter for China's Economic Daily, a researcher at the University of Pittsburgh, and a professor at Xiamen University, Huaqiao University, and Tongji University in China. He retired at the age of forty and retired to the foot of Nanshan Mountain in Phoenix, USA. He is the author of prose, essays, novels, poetry, documentary literature and other genres. He has published more than 40 works such as "Phoenix City Gossip", "Unnamed Lake", "Missing Mother", "Confessions of Life", "Mainlanders", "Struggle and Equality", "Reading Chengdu".

ccffc81c5ca2560784f4f8f685126d69ee61d8df.sourceText: 美籍华人，国际著名活动家，文化艺术经纪人，男高音歌唱家。毕业于中国西南大学音乐学院并获得硕士学位，1993年赴美密西西比大学学习，并获得声乐博士学位。1995年以杰出艺术家获得美国移民局特批美国永久留居权。1996年他在美国成立了美国爱克威金国际文化传播有限公司。目前任美国贝瀚文大学声乐教授、吉林艺术学院/云南艺术学院/山东艺术学院等大学客座教授。
ccffc81c5ca2560784f4f8f685126d69ee61d8df.translatedText: is a Chinese-American, internationally renowned activist, cultural and art agent, and tenor singer. He graduated from the School of Music of Southwest University in China with a master's degree. In 1993, he went to the University of Mississippi in the United States to study and received a doctorate in vocal music. In 1995, he was granted permanent residence in the United States by the US Immigration Service as an outstanding artist. In 1996, he established American Aikeweijing International Cultural Communication Co., Ltd. in the United States. He is currently a professor of vocal music at Beihanwen University in the United States and a visiting professor at Jilin University of the Arts/Yunnan University of the Arts/Shandong University of the Arts and other universities.

e0c36956a52072f9a56495cecd24c61c39004070.sourceText: 贺卡往事：默默无闻的我，祝福同样默默无闻的你们 潘啸皋 从某种意义上来说，人的一生就是靠友谊和情感来支撑的。人与生俱来就渴望得到同伴、亲友或周围人的关怀、呵护、同情、赞誉、欣赏、惦念、思恋、支持和帮助等等。这些心理倾向都是构成人类情感和友谊的至关重要的因素。一个每年在圣诞节、岁末新春常常能如期收到许多寄自祖国或世界各地亲友贺年卡的人，他的内心一定是非常幸福、愉悦和充实的。尽管科学技术的进步与发展，已经给贺年卡产生了质的变化，不再是停留在传统的华丽信封上贴着纪念邮票，内芯是彩色的图片，都是应人而宜的创作，或自制、或购买，图案可以动画卡通、山水风光，亦可中国古色古香的水墨，文字恭正，用词得体。如今计算机键盘一敲，再明亮美丽的多媒体都可以制作。无论对方近在咫尺或远在天涯，一瞬间便完成了从前我们需要写信、邮寄的功能，简单方便快捷，当然，每一年 我的panxiaogao@yahoo.cn 信箱里总是吃得饱饱的。但我总觉得电子邮件少了一份文化人追求的恬淡悠然的雅意，少了一份细腻温暖的情致，少了一份婉约绵长的心怀，也少了一份收信读信的欢欣满怀的喜悦. 然而，不管怎样，你送出的是一片真心实意。正是在这个意义上我们说，新年祝贺，实在是人类友谊和温情的象征。 这也许就是人类之间本身所具有的价值、魅力和底蕴吧。 在圣诞节或者新年里每收到一份来自远方的贺年卡，我都会久久凝视，激动不已。尽管我已经到了不太容易激动的年龄了。贺年卡上大多一二句话，十来个字，传递出的信息却有着春风般的温暖和诚挚。它至少说明这个世界上还有人惦记着你，希望你活得好一些，潇洒一些，同样；我在写贺年卡的时候，心里也漾满了对朋友、对师长的美好祝愿，由衷祝愿他们万事如意，心想事成。 今年，当我在美国再写贺年卡时，不禁使我想起三年前在上海发生的一件往事：我在工作的饭余茶后，也向外地书报杂志投寄了一些作品，常有样报样刊和稿费寄来，和收发室交往多了，我才发现贺年卡远不是所想象的那么纯洁，那么神圣。许多贺年卡上甚至明显地弥漫着一股趋附权贵的气味，像一群群追逐势利的鸟儿，哪里官高权大它们就朝着哪里奋飞。 从圣诞节一直到中国新年的一段时间里，如果把收发室每天收到的几百份贺年卡按名单排列出来，你就会发现一个事实，数量的多寡决定于官职和权力的大小。 如果某人去年还能收到300份，今年却只有20份，这个人肯定已经离开了权位，换了个可有可无的闲职了；这个人一旦退休，如果 每年还能收到二三或者五六份的话，则说明他在位时的人缘，是相当不错的。 所在出版大楼里，有五种人我从没见他们收到过贺年卡，即门卫、水电维修工、清洁工，看车棚的师傅和负责收发的那位下岗职工。他们离权力很远，离友情也就不可能太近。现在巳有很多人，被彻头彻尾商品化和利益化了。 虽然我们身外依然是世俗的繁华和从俗的喜悦。但是在我岁月的深处，依然单纯、任性、固执。总想要一些纯粹的东西，尽管会屡要屡失，但屡失还是屡要，就因为天真，就因为前方的路还闪烁着依稀的新绿。 出于一种仁爱之心，及来路不明的反叛世俗眼光的心理，我想每个人在上帝面前都是平等的，没有贵贱之分，尽管不同的处境会带来不同的职业、不同的地位，但是，作为一个有良知的人，他们都与你一样棗有血有肉有感情，是你的弟兄、是你的姐妹，你理应尊重他们，关心他们。所以，在临近新年的时候，我给他们分别寄去了一份贺年卡。 贺词： 默默无闻的我，祝福同样默默无闻的你们，新年里健康、快乐! 署名： 尊重你们的人 。 贴上邮票就投入马路边的邮筒。 贺年卡到达他们手中，是在二天以后。大楼里只有我注意到了他们的变化，微妙，感人。那四个清洁工往常都是各忙各的，今天却破天荒凑到了一起，围成了一个圈，中心是那张普普通通的贺年卡。她们小声议论著，表情里有一种令人感慨的兴奋，她们不时茫然四顾，大概是在搜寻有可能寄给她们这张卡片的人。她们并没注意到我，可我心里仍然像灌了蜜。这一天，一个清洁工在拖地板时甚至哼起了小调，这可是过去从没有过的情景。 这次经历告诉我，我还有用，还能给这些生活在社会底层的人一点点慰藉，如同我的文章，记录的全是小事，却能够验证我的良知。 但愿岁岁年年人类的友谊、真情和幸福与他们相随相伴，直到永远
e0c36956a52072f9a56495cecd24c61c39004070.translatedText: Greeting Card Past: I, who is unknown, wish you all the same, who are also unknown. Pan Xiaogao In a sense, a person's life is supported by friendship and emotion. People are born with the desire to receive care, care, sympathy, praise, appreciation, longing, longing, support, help, etc. from their companions, relatives, friends, or people around them. These psychological tendencies are crucial factors that constitute human emotions and friendship. A person who often receives many New Year's cards from relatives and friends from his motherland or around the world as scheduled every year at Christmas, the end of the year, and the New Year must be very happy, joyful, and fulfilled in his heart. Although the advancement and development of science and technology have brought about qualitative changes in New Year's greeting cards, they are no longer the traditional gorgeous envelopes with commemorative stamps on them. The inner core is a colorful picture. They are all creations suitable for people, either homemade or purchased. The patterns can be animated cartoons, landscapes, or Chinese antique ink. The text is respectful and the words are appropriate. Nowadays, any bright and beautiful multimedia can be produced with just a few clicks on the computer keyboard. No matter whether the other party is close at hand or far away, the functions that we needed to write and mail in the past are completed in an instant. It is simple, convenient and fast. Of course, my panxiaogao@yahoo.cn mailbox is always full of food every year. But I always feel that e-mail lacks the calm and leisurely elegance that cultural people pursue, lacks the delicate and warm sentiments, lacks the graceful and long-lasting heart, and lacks the joy of receiving and reading letters. However, no matter what, what you send is sincere. It is in this sense that we say that New Year greetings are really a symbol of human friendship and warmth. This may be the value, charm and heritage inherent in human beings. Every time I receive a New Year's card from afar during Christmas or New Year, I stare at it for a long time and get very excited. Although I have reached an age where I am less easily excited. Most of the New Year cards contain one or two sentences or a dozen words, but the message conveyed is as warm and sincere as the spring breeze. It at least shows that there are still people in this world who are thinking about you and hope that you can live a better and more unrestrained life. Likewise, when I wrote the New Year's card, my heart was filled with good wishes for my friends and teachers. I sincerely wish them all the best and all their wishes come true. This year, when I was writing New Year's cards again in the United States, I couldn't help but think of an incident that happened in Shanghai three years ago: After dinner at work, I also sent some works to books, newspapers and magazines from other places. I often received sample newspapers and manuscript fees. After interacting with the mailroom a lot, I discovered that New Year's cards are far from being as pure and sacred as I imagined. Many New Year's cards even have an obvious smell of pursuing the powerful, like a flock of birds pursuing snobbery. They fly towards wherever the officials are high and powerful. From Christmas to Chinese New Year, if you list the hundreds of New Year's cards received in the mailroom every day, you will find the fact that the number depends on the official position and power. If someone still received 300 copies last year but only 20 this year, this person must have left his position of power and changed to a dispensable sinecure; once this person retires, if he can still receive two, three or five or six copies every year, it means that his popularity when he was in office was quite good. In the publishing building where I work, there are five types of people who I have never seen receive New Year's cards, namely, the janitor, the water and electricity maintenance worker, the cleaner, the carport attendant, and the laid-off worker in charge of sending and receiving. They are far away from power and cannot be too close to friendship. Nowadays, many people have been completely commercialized and profit-oriented. Although there is still worldly prosperity and secular joy outside us. But deep down in my years, I am still simple, willful and stubborn. I always want something pure, even though I will lose it again and again, I still want it again and again, just because I am naive, and because the road ahead is still shining with faint new green. Out of a heart of love and an unknown rebellion against worldly vision, I believe that everyone is equal before God, and there is no distinction between high and low. Although different situations will bring different professions and different statuses, as a person with conscience, they are all flesh and blood and have feelings like you. They are your brothers and sisters. You should respect them and care for them. So, as the New Year approached, I sent each of them a New Year's card. Congratulatory message: I, who are unknown, wish you, who are also unknown, good health and happiness in the new year! Signature: People who respect you. Put the stamp on it and put it in the mailbox on the side of the road. The New Year's cards arrived in their hands two days later. I was the only one in the building who noticed their changes, which were subtle and touching. The four cleaners were usually busy with their own affairs, but today they came together for the first time and formed a circle, with the ordinary New Year's card in the center. They were talking quietly, with a kind of touching excitement in their expressions. They looked around blankly from time to time, probably searching for someone who might send them this card. They didn't notice me, but I still felt like I was filled with honey. On this day, one of the cleaners even hummed a tune while mopping the floor. This was something that had never happened before. This experience taught me that I am still useful and can give a little comfort to those living at the bottom of society. Just like my articles, they record only small things, but they can verify my conscience. I hope that human friendship, true love and happiness will accompany them year after year, forever

70b7af56342aafc71af768efa4e4a3c592f47ddd.sourceText: 长期以来，不少在亚历桑那州创业和生活的华人华侨，由于工作繁忙，无暇顾及为自己开办的公司和居住的别墅选购适合的绘画艺术装饰品，特别是由于中西文化和艺术的差异，面对各种琳琅满目价格差异悬殊的各种艺术绘画作品，常常感到难以把握和决择。 为此，在这新春之际，美西中国美术家协会特意安排此次漫步欣赏艺术画廊。
70b7af56342aafc71af768efa4e4a3c592f47ddd.translatedText: For a long time, many overseas Chinese who started businesses and lived in Arizona, due to their busy work, had no time to consider purchasing suitable paintings and art decorations for their companies and villas. Especially due to the differences between Chinese and Western culture and art, faced with a variety of art paintings with widely varying prices, it was often difficult to grasp and make a decision. For this reason, on the occasion of the New Year, the American-Western Chinese Artists Association specially arranged this walk to appreciate the art gallery.

6b98728b2157815e559376374d335d6ef82797f6.sourceText: 凤凰城保龄球比赛颁奖晚会 亚省时报 2011年度鳯凰城华人保龄球会的总决赛已于5月16日晚举行，结果是六福酒定队员发挥超水平，力压餐馆会A队，荣获冠军，颁奖已于5月23日在六福酒家举行，球员与嘉宾轻松共聚一堂，场面热闹。 按华人保龄球会创立已超过六十年的历史，鉴于早期华人不多，各为生意、生活而奔劳，没有一个定期可相聚交流的活动，于是在工余后每周固定一晚组队较研球技亦可联络感情外又可舒缓工作上的压力，锻练身体而成立至今。目前球员遍及各行业，包括律师、医生、会计师、政府人员，当然还有很多饮食业的员工都到来参加比赛，而且普遍年青化，球技更为出色。 亚省餐馆协会近年都有组织（由会员员工组成的）A队参加比赛，举办训练班，有专人负责指导。 欢迎对保龄球有兴趣的员工参加 时间：每周二晚上九时半开始 地点：AMF保龄球场(19 Ave.夹Bethany Home Rd, Phoenix) 联络及详情：请电巫宜钊623-341-5032
6b98728b2157815e559376374d335d6ef82797f6.translatedText: Phoenix City Bowling Competition Awards Night Alberta Times The finals of the 2011 Phoenix City Chinese Bowling Club were held on the evening of May 16th. As a result, the Lukfook Jiuding team played to their best and beat Team A of the Restaurant Club to win the championship. The awards were held at Lukfook Restaurant on May 23rd. The players and guests gathered together in a lively atmosphere. The Chinese Bowling Club has a history of more than 60 years. In view of the fact that there were not many Chinese in the early days, they were all working hard for business and life, and there was no regular activity where they could gather and communicate. Therefore, after work, they formed a team one night a week to study their skills, bond emotionally, relieve work pressure, and exercise their bodies. Since then, it has been established to this day. At present, players from all walks of life, including lawyers, doctors, accountants, government officials, and of course many employees in the catering industry, come to participate in the competition, and they are generally younger and have better skills. In recent years, the Alberta Restaurant Association has organized Team A (composed of member employees) to participate in competitions and hold training classes, with dedicated personnel responsible for guidance. Employees who are interested in bowling are welcome to participate. Time: Every Tuesday starting at 9:30 pm Location: AMF Bowling Alley (19 Ave. and Bethany Home Rd, Phoenix) Contact and details: Please call Wu Yizhao at 623-341-5032

1654da7f167a00a84795bc9b9439212cf7e4868c.sourceText: 位於凤凰城市区的斐匿中文学校是凤凰城地区早期建立的一所提供华文教学和传播中华文化的学校，隶属于凤凰城侨联。该校设有国语，广东话, 绘画，武术，民族舞蹈等科目。本学期春季班定於2013年元月五日（星期六）开学，中午十二点半开始登记註册。请家长偕同学生按时前往。除原有学生外，本校春季班扩招新生，欢迎愿意学习中文和中华文化的朋友前来参加。新学生可免费试读两週。 本学期学校还增设成人班，开办中国歷史研究课，聘请余文绰先生用英文主讲。余文绰先生毕业于芝加哥大学政治科学系（中国），在芝加哥Byola 大学获市场行政管理硕士学位，对中国歷史，地理和经济有深入研究。本课程将研究新石器时代文化起至今的中国歷史，文化的发展渊源，具有很大的知识性和趣味性。成人班同日下午十二点半登记註册，每週一点半至两点半上课，共十六课。学费一百元。 最近，该校董事会邀请有关关心学校的侨界人士讨论了学校发展的相关事宜。学校将针对所在地区的特点，开展多方位的中华文化传承教育，开办各种成人短期学习班，满足民眾的需要。我们希望社会各界提出对我们的要求。 本校原校址自支持康乐老人公寓的建造后，一直借用华人耆英会会所的空閒时间 （734 W.Elm Street，Phoenix AZ 85013）作為学校的临时课堂，本学期仍将在该会所上课。 学校有关事宜，请电话 602-285-5670 联繫。 校长： 崔增祁（ David Cui），副校长：邓军泉（Tony Tang）
1654da7f167a00a84795bc9b9439212cf7e4868c.translatedText: Fenia Chinese School, located in the Phoenix area, was an early school established in the Phoenix area to provide Chinese teaching and spread Chinese culture. It is affiliated to the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation. The school offers subjects such as Mandarin, Cantonese, painting, martial arts, and folk dance. The spring classes of this semester are scheduled to start on January 5, 2013 (Saturday), and registration will begin at 12:30 noon. Parents and students are asked to arrive on time. In addition to the original students, our school is recruiting new students for the spring class. Friends who are willing to learn Chinese and Chinese culture are welcome to join. New students get a free two-week trial. This semester, the school has also added an adult class and launched a Chinese history research course, and hired Mr. Yu Wenchuo to give lectures in English. Mr. Yu Wenchuo graduated from the Department of Political Science (China) of the University of Chicago and received a master's degree in marketing administration from Byola University in Chicago. He has in-depth research on Chinese history, geography and economy. This course will study the history of China from the Neolithic Age to the present and the origin of cultural development, which is very informative and interesting. The adult class registers at 12:30 p.m. on the same day and has classes from 1:30 to 2:30 every week, with a total of 16 classes. Tuition fee is one hundred yuan. Recently, the school's board of directors invited people from the overseas Chinese community who care about the school to discuss matters related to the school's development. The school will carry out multi-faceted Chinese cultural inheritance education based on the characteristics of the area where it is located, and open various short-term adult learning classes to meet the needs of the public. We hope that all sectors of society will make demands on us. Since the original campus of our school supported the construction of the Kangle Apartment for the Elderly, we have been using the free time of the Chinese Senior Citizens Association (734 W. Elm Street, Phoenix AZ 85013) as a temporary classroom for the school. Classes will still be held at the club this semester. For school-related matters, please contact 602-285-5670. Principal: David Cui, Vice Principal: Tony Tang

dd9cfc8a2923bb4dca0a13b66f86251ea9838781.sourceText: 阿琪：中国式哄抢 凤凰城 阿琪 从电视上看到了一组中国式哄抢的新闻，心中真不是滋味。入冬以来，祖国的大地上…
dd9cfc8a2923bb4dca0a13b66f86251ea9838781.translatedText: Aqi: Chinese-style looting Phoenix City Aqi saw a group of news on Chinese-style looting on TV, and she felt really bad. Since the beginning of winter, on the land of the motherland...

b216fd85ef439293901aa6676acac6f22726f30f.sourceText: 从电视上看到了一组中国式哄抢的新闻，心中真不是滋味。入冬以来，祖国的大地上，群众哄抢事件不断发生。途经河南的一辆运送苹菓的汽车翻倒，附近村民闻讯赶来，大包小包的装回家去; 一辆拉着菠萝的汽车途经广东，菠萝散落在高速公路上，上百村民前来哄抢，30吨菠萝被拿走20吨；一辆途经兰州附近的卡车侧翻，车上的葡萄被村民一抢而光，画靣上展现的是，人们整筺整筺的把葡萄端走；无独有偶，叧一輌满载着瓜子的货车因轮胎爆裂,瓜子撒落在公路上，一群人跑来”拣”瓜子，一袋一袋的往家里扛。还有广东的运海鲜的车被哄抢，陕西的日用百货车被哄抢等等。更有甚者，有人做好事也被哄抢。郑州一男子免费为有困难的农民工送过冬的衣服，不料也有人闻讯赶来哄抢，竟然一个人抢走了满满一个大编织袋的冬衣；安徽一些新婚夫妻举行集体婚礼时放生一百隻白鸽，婚礼刚结束，有些人就去哄抢白鸽，以解口馋之忧；成都一家包子舗开张，本想第一天早上免费送饱子讨个彩头，结果人们哄抢弄得满地碎饱，桌翻椅倒，狼藉满地，只留下老闆站在那里发呆；还有人争抢民工不慎撒落的百元大钞，那是他一年辛苦赚来的血汗钱哪！
b216fd85ef439293901aa6676acac6f22726f30f.translatedText: I saw a group of news about Chinese-style looting on TV, which really made me feel uncomfortable. Since the beginning of winter, looting incidents have continued to occur across the land of the motherland. A car transporting apples overturned while passing through Henan. After hearing the news, nearby villagers rushed over and packed their bags home. A car pulling pineapples passed through Guangdong. The pineapples were scattered on the highway. Hundreds of villagers came to snatch them. 20 tons of 30 tons of pineapples were taken away. A truck passing near Lanzhou overturned and the grapes on the car were robbed by villagers. The painting shows people carrying away the grapes neatly. Coincidentally, a truck full of melon seeds burst because of a tire burst, and the melon seeds were scattered on the road. A group of people came to "pick" the melon seeds and carried them home one by one. There were also looting of seafood transport trucks in Guangdong, and looting of daily necessities trucks in Shaanxi, etc. What's more, some people are robbed of their good deeds. A man in Zhengzhou gave free winter clothes to migrant workers in need. Unexpectedly, some people came to rob them after hearing the news. One man snatched a big woven bag full of winter clothes. Some newlyweds in Anhui released a hundred white pigeons during a collective wedding. As soon as the wedding was over, some people went to rob the pigeons to satisfy their greed. When a steamed stuffed bun shop in Chengdu opened, it wanted to give away free steamed stuffed buns on the first morning to get some luck. However, people looted and the dumplings were scattered all over the floor. Tables overturned and chairs fell over, leaving a mess all over the floor. The boss was left standing there in a daze. There were also people fighting for the hundred-yuan bills carelessly scattered by the migrant workers, which were his hard-earned money for a year!

a44a7b462b22839aa38ce20d6e9e6a2fa3ebf246.sourceText: 在美国，这样公开的哄抢没有见到，但在华人社会中，也有类似的不当行为。前些天报上描述旧金山的一些中国人反复排队抢领政府发放给有困难居民食物，有人把不需要的东西挑出来放在马路边，引起路人𣎴满。一些人把中国的哄抢风出口到国外了。仔细想想类似的情况在我们身边也时有发生。华人耆英中心每星期四免费分发一点蔬菜水菓，每人一份。有些人就喜欢去哄抢，甚至多拿几份，以至有的人分不到。有时大家在一起聚会，大家欢欢喜喜的去取自己喜爱的食品，总有一些人喜欢哄抢，拿了一份又一份，把好好的气氛弄得倒胃口。鳯凰城也有许多给低收入民众免费分发衣物和食品的塲所，有些人就是永远领不够。有的人家里都培养出博士、教授，也不给自家的孩子留点靣子。还有的人说起道理来呱呱叫，天天给人传经讲道，拿起东西来没完没了，真给中国人丢份子。
a44a7b462b22839aa38ce20d6e9e6a2fa3ebf246.translatedText: In the United States, we have never seen such public looting, but in Chinese society, there are similar inappropriate behaviors. A few days ago, newspapers described how some Chinese people in San Francisco repeatedly lined up to get food distributed by the government to needy residents. Some people picked out unnecessary items and placed them on the side of the road, causing crowds of passers-by. Some people have exported China's looting trend abroad. Think carefully about similar situations happening around us from time to time. The Chinese Senior Citizens Center distributes free vegetables and fruits every Thursday, one serving per person. Some people like to rob, and even get a few more portions, so that some people can't get a share. Sometimes everyone gathers together, and everyone happily goes to get their favorite food. There are always some people who like to snatch one portion after another, making the good atmosphere unappetizing. There are also many places in Huangcheng that distribute free clothing and food to low-income people, but some people just can't get enough. Some people's families have produced doctors and professors, but they don't leave any spoiled children to their children. There are also people who croak when talking about truth, preach scriptures and sermons to people every day, and pick up things endlessly. They really embarrass the Chinese people.

3f22d6c35e2f496d2a980a70a752d58bf5ad76c8.sourceText: 哄抢之风在中国历史上屡有发生。封建时代灾民飢肠辘辘，哄抢食粥，是出于生命需求；抗战时期，曾有民众哄抢空投救济品，亦可祘作生活所迫；革命时期，农民哄抢地主粮仓，那是阶级斗争；如今参与哄抢的人不是衣衫褴褛，飢不择食，从穿戴可以看出个个都己丰衣足食。那究竟是为了什么？
3f22d6c35e2f496d2a980a70a752d58bf5ad76c8.translatedText: Robbery has occurred frequently in Chinese history. In the feudal era, victims were hungry and snatched porridge out of necessity for life; during the Anti-Japanese War, people looted air-dropped relief supplies to cope with the pressure of life; during the revolutionary period, farmers looted landlords' granaries, which was a class struggle; now, the people participating in looting are not ragged and hungry, but it can be seen from their clothing that they are well-fed and well-fed. What is that for?

5ec30ff9725dc14f8845f73a6a978be00a13e60c.sourceText: 哄抢源于自私和贪婪。自私是人的一种天性，是人类与生俱来并赖以生存和发展的基因。但人类用道德和法律使自私控制在规定范围内，维繫着人类社会的共处和发展，使其不形成破坏社会发展的贪婪。道德方面是以不损害他人利益为底线，従法律上讲则私人财産受国家保护。无论车辆洒落的是苹菓、葡萄、瓜子、海鲜，都是人家的私有财产，哄抢别人财物属违法行为；无节制的占有属不道德行为。
5ec30ff9725dc14f8845f73a6a978be00a13e60c.translatedText: The looting stems from selfishness and greed. Selfishness is a human nature, a gene that humans are born with and rely on for survival and development. However, human beings use morality and law to control selfishness within prescribed limits, maintaining the coexistence and development of human society and preventing it from forming greed that undermines social development. In terms of ethics, the bottom line is not harming the interests of others. Legally speaking, private property is protected by the state. Regardless of whether the vehicle spills apples, grapes, melon seeds, or seafood, they are the private property of others. It is illegal to rob other people's property; unrestrained possession is immoral.

76383893810694f90aabac15f67f8f0b4253bd5f.sourceText: 这些现象在当今中国普遍发生是在于道德教育的严重缺失。忠孝仁爱，礼义廉耻这夲不属于政党的道德观念被遗弃了；孔孟及宗教的伦理道德观念被打倒了；当人们还没有弄清楚什么是新道德观念的时候，一个”一切向钱看”的社会展现在面前。人人都为自己打算，想怎样先富起来。于是，八仙过海，各显神通。哄抢者只认为遇到了一个小小的得利机会，并没有顾及法律和道德的约束。有人甚至还为自己的行为辩解说，当官的哄抢国家大量财富，我们拾点瓜子祘什么？这话虽无道理，也道出了一些真情。贪污和哄抢同源于道德缺失。
76383893810694f90aabac15f67f8f0b4253bd5f.translatedText: These phenomena commonly occur in China today because of the serious lack of moral education. Moral concepts such as loyalty, filial piety, benevolence, propriety, justice, integrity and shame, which are not part of the political party, have been abandoned; the ethics and moral concepts of Confucius, Mencius and religion have been overthrown; when people have not yet figured out what the new moral concepts are, a society in which "everything is about money" is unfolding in front of them. Everyone has their own plans for how to get rich first. So, the Eight Immortals crossed the sea and each showed their magical powers. The looters only thought they had encountered a small profit opportunity and did not take into account legal and moral constraints. Some people even defended their actions by saying that officials are robbing the country of a large amount of wealth, so why should we just pick up some melon seeds? Although this statement makes no sense, it also expresses some truth. Corruption and looting stem from a lack of morality.

7de94b2acb3340c7127275da0270d677b30b301d.sourceText: 中华民族正在走向复兴之路。在经济复兴的同时，道德复兴是一项更加重要而且更加艰巨的任务。道德复兴是民族复兴的基本保障。不可设想，一个道德严重缺失的民族能够站立在世界民族之前列。
7de94b2acb3340c7127275da0270d677b30b301d.translatedText: The Chinese nation is on the road to rejuvenation. Along with economic revival, moral revival is a more important and more difficult task. Moral rejuvenation is the basic guarantee for national rejuvenation. It is unimaginable that a nation with serious moral deficiencies can stand at the forefront of the world's nations.

94342436f8a013197fc89f2e53fb5fd99f353de1.sourceText: 耶鲁大学校长在上海交大研究生毕业典礼上谈中美学生差异
94342436f8a013197fc89f2e53fb5fd99f353de1.translatedText: The President of Yale University talked about the differences between Chinese and American students at the graduate graduation ceremony of Shanghai Jiao Tong University

a9ce6749545ced9de8a81d6106eae8f7b57e4ba0.sourceText: 耶鲁大学校长在上海交大研究生毕业典礼上谈中美学生差异 上海交通大学2014年研究生毕业典礼暨学位授予仪式1…
a9ce6749545ced9de8a81d6106eae8f7b57e4ba0.translatedText: The President of Yale University talked about the differences between Chinese and American students at the graduate graduation ceremony of Shanghai Jiao Tong University Shanghai Jiao Tong University 2014 Graduate Graduation Ceremony and Degree Awarding Ceremony 1…

7af7575da2e9eb8d7cb20a207401c0a110fdbe13.sourceText: 上海交通大学2014年研究生毕业典礼暨学位授予仪式19日在上海举行。典礼上，耶鲁大学校长彼得 沙洛维（Peter Salovey）获授予上海交大名誉博士学位。
7af7575da2e9eb8d7cb20a207401c0a110fdbe13.translatedText: Shanghai Jiao Tong University 2014 Graduate Graduation Ceremony and Degree Awarding Ceremony was held in Shanghai on the 19th. At the ceremony, Yale University President Peter Salovey was awarded an honorary doctorate from Shanghai Jiao Tong University.

4286aec16ae0f74fe4137e8cd939987017a0f091.sourceText: 彼得 沙洛维在致辞中回顾了上海交大与耶鲁大学的渊源。他说，交大校友、中国历史上首位赴美留学生容闳就毕业于耶鲁大学，此后一代又一代的中国留学生来到耶鲁就读。这段佳话不仅让人忆及国际学生交流的重要性，更是对耶鲁和交大关系的赞颂。
4286aec16ae0f74fe4137e8cd939987017a0f091.translatedText: Peter Salovey reviewed the relationship between Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Yale University in his speech. He said that Rong Hong, an alumnus of Jiaotong University and the first Chinese student to study in the United States, graduated from Yale University. Since then, generations of Chinese students have come to study at Yale. This anecdote not only reminds people of the importance of international student exchanges, but also praises the relationship between Yale and SJTU.

585433b1863e25332b5f9c2e6feedb26d2cce78f.sourceText: 他表示，近年来，耶鲁与交大的合作关系日新月异，包括学生暑期课程、学者合作项目课题研究，耶鲁和交大的教授们正齐心协力攻克癌细胞免疫原性难题。
585433b1863e25332b5f9c2e6feedb26d2cce78f.translatedText: He said that in recent years, the cooperative relationship between Yale and Jiaotong University has been developing rapidly, including student summer courses and scholar cooperation project research. Professors from Yale and Jiaotong University are working together to overcome the problem of cancer cell immunogenicity.

62af4f248071e5e3aff64ec130b074905eaa7ebb.sourceText: 彼得沙洛维寄语毕业生，智商和情商对于生活和事业成功来说缺一不可。通过教育课程，学生学会如何分析复杂问题并提供解决方案，但同时，还要学会感知、了解和控制情绪的能力。谈及中美学生差异，彼得沙洛维说，北美学生往往更关注焦点细节，亚洲学生更关注宏观背景，很难评述二者的优劣。在耶鲁，东西方学生都相处得非常融洽。
62af4f248071e5e3aff64ec130b074905eaa7ebb.translatedText: Peter Salovey’s message to graduates: IQ and EQ are indispensable for success in life and career. Through educational courses, students learn how to analyze complex problems and provide solutions, but at the same time, also develop the ability to sense, understand and control emotions. Talking about the differences between Chinese and American students, Peter Salovey said that North American students tend to pay more attention to focus details, while Asian students pay more attention to the macro background. It is difficult to comment on the advantages and disadvantages of the two. At Yale, both Eastern and Western students get along very well.

e98839ba9693570260b35c3101854ab6b80f0378.sourceText: 当天，上海交大耶鲁生物统计中心同时成立，两校签署校际合作框架协议，双方拟在公共卫生、通识教育等领域开展更深层次的合作与交流。
e98839ba9693570260b35c3101854ab6b80f0378.translatedText: On the same day, the Yale Biostatistics Center of Shanghai Jiao Tong University was established at the same time. The two schools signed an inter-school cooperation framework agreement. The two parties plan to carry out deeper cooperation and exchanges in the fields of public health, general education and other fields.

3e476f37e04b64edeea6d05f084344753290cbc4.sourceText: 上海交大与耶鲁大学的校级合作有多年的良好基础。2012年，上海交通大学校长张杰访问耶鲁大学，与当时还是教务长的 Peter Salovey深度会晤，并代表上海交通大学与耶鲁大学签署了校际合作框架协议，双方拟在公共卫生、通识教育等领域开展更深层次的合作与交流。
3e476f37e04b64edeea6d05f084344753290cbc4.translatedText: The school-level cooperation between Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Yale University has a good foundation for many years. In 2012, Zhang Jie, President of Shanghai Jiao Tong University, visited Yale University and had an in-depth meeting with Peter Salovey, who was the provost at the time. On behalf of Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Yale University, he signed an inter-school cooperation framework agreement. The two parties plan to carry out deeper cooperation and exchanges in the fields of public health, general education and other fields.

111f959ab29d4f17d593d1185ccc480ce10eea2a.sourceText: 经过两年多的筹备，当初的框架协议内容不断深入推进，并以交大耶鲁联合中心的方式落地，开展实质性的全方位合作。
111f959ab29d4f17d593d1185ccc480ce10eea2a.translatedText: After more than two years of preparation, the content of the original framework agreement has been continuously advanced and implemented in the form of the Jiaotong University-Yale Joint Center to carry out substantive all-round cooperation.

2bded04c9fb27eaa774ffcfa27452b0341229845.sourceText: 双方希望，交大耶鲁联合中心成为耶鲁与中国高校合作的标志性载体，上海交大与耶鲁的合作由此进入实质性的深度融合阶段。作为两校全方位、跨学科合作平台，中心将汇聚中美两国最优秀的科研人员，聚焦人类发展的前沿问题，以一流的师资、先进的理念和卓越的管理实现中心的战略意义，打造中外
2bded04c9fb27eaa774ffcfa27452b0341229845.translatedText: Both parties hope that the Jiaotong University-Yale Joint Center will become an iconic carrier for cooperation between Yale and Chinese universities, and that the cooperation between Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Yale will enter a stage of substantial and in-depth integration. As a comprehensive and interdisciplinary cooperation platform between the two universities, the center will bring together the best scientific researchers from China and the United States, focus on cutting-edge issues of human development, realize the strategic significance of the center with first-class teachers, advanced concepts and excellent management, and create a model of school-level cooperation between Chinese and foreign

bde662dd4bbbf21a4a59461b55617bcd3e7fab55.sourceText: 高校校级合作的典范。双方还希望，通过共同努力，交大耶;鲁联合中心能在新的合作领域培育出最新的成果，为人类的未来做出实质性的贡献，成为中美高校深度合作的里程碑。
bde662dd4bbbf21a4a59461b55617bcd3e7fab55.translatedText: > universities. Both parties also hope that through joint efforts, the Jiaotong University-Yellow Joint Center can cultivate the latest results in new areas of cooperation, make substantial contributions to the future of mankind, and become a milestone in the in-depth cooperation between Chinese and American universities.

e8df814faad1fa3ea3778f222063905e77997e50.sourceText: 19日下午，彼得・沙洛维在上海交通大学2014年研究生毕业典礼暨学位授予仪式现场与学子们分享为学、为人的心得。当他站在上海交通大学 2014年研究生毕业典礼的发言席上。上海交大学子雷鸣般的掌声，着实让这位远道而来的学者有些”受宠若惊”。同时，他还被授予上海交大的名誉博士学位。
e8df814faad1fa3ea3778f222063905e77997e50.translatedText: On the afternoon of the 19th, Peter Salovey shared his thoughts on learning and being a human being with the students at the 2014 graduate graduation ceremony and degree awarding ceremony of Shanghai Jiao Tong University. When he stood at the speech box at the 2014 graduate graduation ceremony of Shanghai Jiao Tong University. The thunderous applause from the students of Shanghai Jiao Tong University really made this scholar who came from afar feel a little "flattered". At the same time, he was also awarded an honorary doctorate from Shanghai Jiao Tong University.

34f6c68215ef72393b863a5b91a78b72447448c9.sourceText: 谈中美学生：中国学生更擅长理解宏观背景
34f6c68215ef72393b863a5b91a78b72447448c9.translatedText: Talking about Chinese and American students: Chinese students are better at understanding the macro background

3c09051e12f3ea6d540c42d93107f710c8960967.sourceText: 随着国际学术交流合作的不断深入，越来越多的中国学生慕名到耶鲁大学求学。那么，作为耶鲁大学新任校长，沙洛维认为，中美学生共同点多于差异性。
3c09051e12f3ea6d540c42d93107f710c8960967.translatedText: With the deepening of international academic exchanges and cooperation, more and more Chinese students are attracted to study at Yale University. Well, as the new president of Yale University, Salovey believes that Chinese and American students have more similarities than differences.

8a978420ead45e5b12a7fd148bafb2e1ea47edc1.sourceText: 在耶鲁大学里，中美学生有许多相同点，但在学习的过程中，由于思维习惯上的一些差距，在学术的关注点上有所不同，”中国或是亚洲学生，更擅长理解宏观背景；美国或是北美的学生，则更擅长关注问题的焦点。”
8a978420ead45e5b12a7fd148bafb2e1ea47edc1.translatedText: At Yale University, Chinese and American students have many similarities, but during the learning process, due to some differences in thinking habits, their academic focus is different. "Chinese or Asian students are better at understanding the macro background; American or North American students are better at focusing on the focus of the problem."

0bfadcd7147fb2beebf4715b2d4de10b7d08ab76.sourceText: 与此同时，在耶鲁大学里，中国学生的比例越来越高，他们和其他来自世界各地的学生们一样，给耶鲁带来了不同的文化氛围，让课堂变得更丰富、更生动。
0bfadcd7147fb2beebf4715b2d4de10b7d08ab76.translatedText: At the same time, the proportion of Chinese students at Yale University is getting higher and higher. Like other students from all over the world, they bring a different cultural atmosphere to Yale, making the classroom richer and more lively.

b5b75e47c2c57a35feacdc8a9c5901dc6c385ff5.sourceText: 另外，作为耶鲁大学从事学术及管理工作近三十年、曾多次访问清华、北大、交大等中国高等学府的沙洛维，对于中美教育的差异也有自己的视角。”从历史来看，中美教育的发展确实走了两条不同的路径。但很有趣的一点是，现在中美教育的发展路径却越来越趋同，汇聚到了一起。”沙洛维提及，现在的中美教育，都不约而同关注到了新技术在教育中的应用，”比如慕课、网络教育、翻转课堂等”；同样，在中国和美国，更自由地去学习这样的理念，也在教育领域越来越受到重视和强调。
b5b75e47c2c57a35feacdc8a9c5901dc6c385ff5.translatedText: In addition, Salovey, who has been engaged in academic and management work at Yale University for nearly 30 years and has visited Tsinghua University, Peking University, Jiaotong University and other Chinese institutions of higher learning many times, also has his own perspective on the differences between Chinese and American education. "Historically, the development of education in China and the United States has indeed taken two different paths. But what is very interesting is that the development paths of education in China and the United States are now becoming more and more converging and coming together." Salovey mentioned that today's education in China and the United States are all paying attention to the application of new technologies in education, "such as MOOCs, online education, flipped classrooms, etc."; similarly, in China and the United States, the concept of freer learning is also increasingly valued and emphasized in the field of education.

2cb029c985cccc8c7c9c2bd9b338dedc201ded04.sourceText: ”可以这么说，现在，中美之间在教育领域，比如学生和老师之间，有了越来越多的交流和互动。世界也因此变得越来越小了。”沙洛维说道。
2cb029c985cccc8c7c9c2bd9b338dedc201ded04.translatedText: "It can be said that now, there are more and more exchanges and interactions between China and the United States in the field of education, such as between students and teachers. As a result, the world has become smaller and smaller," Salovey said.

d77b6918805bf0e2d929599f6422a644d9842b69.sourceText: 值得一提的是，彼得沙洛维的另一个身份是心理学家，现在广为提及的”情商”概念正是由他提出19日天，彼得沙洛维和交大学子共话”情商”与成功。
d77b6918805bf0e2d929599f6422a644d9842b69.translatedText: It is worth mentioning that Peter Salovey's other identity is a psychologist, and it was he who proposed the now widely mentioned concept of "emotional intelligence". On the 19th, Peter Salovey and students from Jiaotong University talked about "emotional intelligence" and success.

57a0f770485230654a53747a6ce3fa9e27acec71.sourceText: 彼得沙洛维表示，利用情绪帮助思考、决策也是情商的组成部分，而一直以来，人们被灌输的思想都是，情绪会影响决定，情感会干扰理智。但是研究结果显示，情绪对于思想也会产生积极影响。彼得沙洛维打个比方，人在情绪有些低落时编辑文章其实更容易发现错误，文章质量更高；而心情舒畅能让人更富创造力。
57a0f770485230654a53747a6ce3fa9e27acec71.translatedText: Peter Salovey said that using emotions to help thinking and decision-making is also a component of emotional intelligence. People have always been indoctrinated with the idea that emotions will affect decisions and emotions will interfere with reason. But research shows that emotions can also have a positive impact on thoughts. Peter Salovey made an analogy: when people are in a low mood, it is actually easier to find errors when editing articles, and the quality of the articles will be higher; and being in a good mood can make people more creative.

4d252a36dcb6111af65058a6f92085099a935133.sourceText: 他告诉学生，智商和情商对于生活和事业成功来说，二者缺一不可。在竞争激烈的大学入学考试中脱颖而出，成功步入大学校门，就足以证明学生们的天资。但仅有高智商并不够。情商高的人生活更加富足，在生活中拥有更多的挚友。和他们一起工作时，团队的产出更加高效。这部分人往往有更多善举，比如，即使没有任何回报，也会帮助邻里，为社区无私贡献。
4d252a36dcb6111af65058a6f92085099a935133.translatedText: He told students that IQ and EQ are indispensable for success in life and career. Standing out in the highly competitive university entrance examination and successfully entering the university is enough to prove the students' talent. But high IQ alone is not enough. People with high emotional intelligence live richer lives and have more close friends in their lives. When working with them, the team's output is more efficient. These people tend to do more good deeds. For example, they will help their neighbors and make selfless contributions to the community even if they don't get anything in return.

ed622739aa51fdb3f4098140557085de043b2d33.sourceText: 彼得沙洛维表示，如果缺乏部分情感能力，其实完全可以通过学习来获得。比如不擅于感知别人的情绪，那么可以先学着感知基本情绪。比方说，为了了解对方的情绪，可以问一些搜集信息的问题，如”我刚才说的，你有什么不太赞成的地方吗？”
ed622739aa51fdb3f4098140557085de043b2d33.translatedText: Peter Salovey said that if you lack some emotional abilities, you can actually acquire them through learning. For example, if you are not good at sensing other people's emotions, you can first learn to sense basic emotions. For example, in order to understand the other person's emotions, you can ask some information-gathering questions, such as "Is there anything you don't agree with about what I just said?"

28dc1c14366d9cde79def11cb8f848612b413807.sourceText: 三，准备回邮信封不需要贴邮票。
