3e6bee3dce9a7e7b3746ae32e93785da3a2edc01.translatedText: The Olympic Games are coming to an end, and it is a foregone conclusion that the United States will win more medals.

3ab795a56dfa5b69fe08bf0a7d8f6cf56c2b260f.sourceText: 奥运进入尾声美奖牌超中成定局 伦敦奥运会9日决出22块金牌，中国军团获得1金2银，37金24银19铜，共8…
3ab795a56dfa5b69fe08bf0a7d8f6cf56c2b260f.translatedText: The Olympic Games are coming to an end, and it is a foregone conclusion that the United States will win a medal. 22 gold medals were awarded at the London Olympics on the 9th. The Chinese Legion won 1 gold, 2 silver, 37 gold, 24 silver, and 19 bronze, for a total of 8...

a7d7feeb88cc51ff3e6c30acee56c7d29f222f94.sourceText: 中国军团目前比美国少两块金牌、10块奖牌。由于美国此后三天还有男篮、女篮、女排、田径等多个夺金点，而中国军团的冲金点已非常有限，因此美国已基本确立在伦敦奥运会金牌榜上的胜势。
a7d7feeb88cc51ff3e6c30acee56c7d29f222f94.translatedText: The Chinese Legion currently has two gold medals and 10 medals less than the United States. Since the United States still has many gold medal points in the next three days for men's basketball, women's basketball, women's volleyball, track and field, etc., and the Chinese Legion's gold points are very limited, the United States has basically established its victory in the London Olympics gold medal list.

d05d6a4a84a3ac2e3bbe7fc1d1f6c793befade35.sourceText: 中 国选手9日的两枚银牌都是输给东道主英国选手。在首次进入奥运赛场的女子拳击比赛中，世界排名第一的任灿灿以7：16不敌亚当斯。在跆拳道女子57公斤级 决赛中，侯玉琢连续被罚分，最终以4：6落败。这两位女将在对方主场观众山呼海啸的疯狂吶喊声中，几乎没有获得太多机会。
d05d6a4a84a3ac2e3bbe7fc1d1f6c793befade35.translatedText: Chinese players lost two silver medals on the 9th to the host British players. In the women's boxing competition that entered the Olympics for the first time, world number one Ren Cancan lost to Adams 7:16. In the women's taekwondo 57kg final, Hou Yuzhuo received consecutive penalty points and ultimately lost 4:6. The two female players barely got many chances amid the wild cheers of the opposing home crowd.

5c251c38833da0cb0cc343f83071062ad9a6f744.sourceText: 美国实现反超的金牌来自女足赛场。美国队以2：1击败去年女足世界杯冠军日本队后，将连续三届奥运会的女足金牌捧回家中。此外，美国的金牌还来自女子水球、女子拳击和田径赛场。9日进行的女排和女篮准决赛，美国队也全部进入决赛，夺金可期。
5c251c38833da0cb0cc343f83071062ad9a6f744.translatedText: The U.S.’s comeback gold medal came from the women’s football field. After defeating last year's Women's World Cup champion Japan 2-1, the United States team took home the women's football gold medal in three consecutive Olympic Games. In addition, the United States also won gold medals in women's water polo, women's boxing and track and field. In the women's volleyball and women's basketball semi-finals held on the 9th, the US team also all entered the finals and can expect to win gold.

cdf82ab4038ba5b51d9ee98a2b3ffab4d6280ddd.sourceText: 伦敦奥运会开赛以来，中美两国在奖牌榜上一直居于前列。8月4日，当美国队金牌数一度超越中国而名列第一时，一直为竞选奔波的奥巴马总统特意将当天的每周电视讲话话题落在伦敦奥运会上，说”美国为名列奖牌榜之首而奋力竞争并不令人惊奇”，并再次为美国队鼓劲加油。
cdf82ab4038ba5b51d9ee98a2b3ffab4d6280ddd.translatedText: Since the start of the London Olympics, China and the United States have been at the forefront of the medal list. On August 4, when the U.S. team once surpassed China in gold medals and ranked first, President Obama, who has been running for election, specifically focused on the London Olympics in his weekly TV speech that day, saying, "It is not surprising that the United States is competing hard to be at the top of the medal table," and once again cheered for the U.S. team.

bd9fa494a735f77dfe3f339a079890cbf7ccbe17.translatedText: Traditional advantages continue to be maintained

92d86d6d6805434718ea26146aba5bbf46f57143.sourceText: 在游泳项目中，美国获得16金9银6铜；在网球项目上，美国获得女单、女双和男双冠军，还获得混双铜牌
92d86d6d6805434718ea26146aba5bbf46f57143.translatedText: In swimming, the United States won 16 golds, 9 silvers and 6 bronzes; in tennis, the United States won the women's singles, women's doubles and men's doubles championships, and also won a bronze medal in mixed doubles

5f29993a6dab3a427707a9fde04f8d1d44d890d0.sourceText: 游泳项目是金牌大户，也是美国队强势项目。本届奥运会上，美国队在游泳项目中共获得16金9银6铜。继2008年北京奥运会之后，菲尔普斯依然是美国游泳队最大亮点。他在伦敦奥运会上一共夺得4金2银，从而使个人金牌总数达到18枚，奖牌总数达到22枚，成为奥运会历史上夺得金牌和奖牌数量最多的人。此外，美国泳坛新秀不容小觑。年仅17岁的女选手富兰克林大放异彩，一举夺得4金1银，并在女子200米仰泳项目上以2分04秒06的惊人成绩夺冠，大幅提高了之前的世界纪录。尽管美国在奥运泳坛地位尚稳，但中国”水军”已发起有力的冲击。
5f29993a6dab3a427707a9fde04f8d1d44d890d0.translatedText: Swimming is a gold medal winner and a strong event for the U.S. team. At this Olympics, the U.S. team won 16 golds, 9 silvers and 6 bronzes in swimming events. Following the 2008 Beijing Olympics, Phelps remains the biggest highlight of the U.S. swimming team. He won a total of 4 gold medals and 2 silver medals at the London Olympics, bringing the total number of individual gold medals to 18 and the total number of medals to 22, making him the person with the most gold medals and medals in the history of the Olympic Games. In addition, the rising stars of American swimming should not be underestimated. The 17-year-old female athlete Franklin shined, winning 4 golds and 1 silver in one fell swoop, and won the women's 200-meter backstroke event with an astonishing time of 2 minutes, 04 seconds and 06, significantly improving the previous world record. Although the United States' position in Olympic swimming is still stable, China's "Navy Army" has launched a powerful attack.

94bcec000a0fefde610726d155449297564bca58.sourceText: 美国网球队延续着传统的优势，在女单、女双和男双上获得冠军，此外还获得一枚混双铜牌，金牌和奖牌数均名列前茅。小威廉姆斯再次成为女单赛场上最耀眼的明星。她在女单项目上获得的金牌使其成为继德国网球女皇格拉芙之后，第二位完成”金满贯”(四大满贯和奥运会单打金牌)的女子选手。人们注意到，小威还完成了所谓的单双打”金满贯”，即在四大满贯和奥运会的单双打比赛中均拿到过冠军，历史上还从未有人取得过如此骄人的战绩。
94bcec000a0fefde610726d155449297564bca58.translatedText: The U.S. tennis team continued its traditional advantages, winning championships in women's singles, women's doubles and men's doubles. In addition, it also won a bronze medal in mixed doubles, ranking among the top in gold medals and medals. Serena Williams once again became the brightest star in the women's singles arena. Her gold medal in the women's singles event made her the second female player to complete the "Golden Slam" (four Grand Slams and Olympic singles gold medals) after German tennis queen Graf. People have noticed that Serena Williams also completed the so-called "Golden Slam" in singles and doubles, that is, she won the championship in the four Grand Slams and the Olympic singles and doubles competitions. No one in history has ever achieved such an impressive record.

b88f7de2c4b233472cd67120e48755881bf0022b.sourceText: 柔道项目赢得首金；美国女子体操队表现抢眼，被誉为继美国男篮之后的另一支”梦之队”
b88f7de2c4b233472cd67120e48755881bf0022b.translatedText: Judo won its first gold medal; the U.S. women's gymnastics team performed well and was hailed as another "dream team" after the U.S. men's basketball team

34f76ba2c70277f17d1f5370ce5d473852550890.sourceText: 伦敦奥运会上，在一些原本不大受美国人关注的竞赛项目中，美国队也有了零的突破。凯拉 哈里森在柔道比赛中为美国赢得了首枚金牌，马蒂 马洛伊则赢得了一枚铜牌。
34f76ba2c70277f17d1f5370ce5d473852550890.translatedText: At the London Olympics, the U.S. team also made zero breakthroughs in some competitions that had not attracted much attention from Americans. Kayla Harrison won the United States' first gold medal in judo, and Marty Malloy won a bronze medal.

00b2489f427e63bfc0971bf08dec49412e0d794e.sourceText: 在射击项目中，一度低迷的美国队正在逐渐复苏。老将金 罗德在女子飞碟双向比赛中以99中平世界纪录夺冠，从而成为第三位连续在五届奥运会都有奖牌入账的射击选手。汉考克则在男子双向飞碟射击中也获金牌。
00b2489f427e63bfc0971bf08dec49412e0d794e.translatedText: In the shooting event, the once sluggish American team is gradually recovering. Veteran Kim Lord won the women's double-sided UFO competition with a world record of 99, becoming the third shooter to win medals in five consecutive Olympic Games. Hancock also won a gold medal in men's skeet shooting.

3b3acf6fd0bb118afcca464d46fa929d8354100c.sourceText: 值得特别指出的是，美国女子体操队在本届奥运上表现格外抢眼，甚至被誉为继美国男篮之后的另一支”梦之队”。华裔教练乔良的高徒加布丽埃勒 道格拉斯获得女子体操全能冠军后，立即成为大受追捧的新星，奥巴马在其电视讲话中也特别提及了这位年纪轻轻的非洲裔女运动员。
3b3acf6fd0bb118afcca464d46fa929d8354100c.translatedText: It is worth mentioning that the U.S. women's gymnastics team performed particularly well in this Olympics and was even hailed as another "dream team" after the U.S. men's basketball team. After Gabrielle Douglas, a disciple of Chinese-American coach Qiao Liang, won the women's all-around gymnastics championship, she immediately became a popular star. Obama also specifically mentioned this young African-American female athlete in his televised speech.

b5d19fa52ddf6a7ed9b3905822c011137a11d46a.sourceText: 在后面的赛事中，美国队仍有后劲。在田径这一吸金大户中，有美国媒体认为美国奥运田径队的目标是至少12枚金牌，与去年世锦赛战绩持平。此外，美国国内最为关注的是男、女篮和女足的金牌争夺。有美国媒体甚至称，”如果美国队没能获得男子和女子的篮球金牌，那将会被视为巨大的失败。”此外，在女排、女子沙滩排球、女子水球、赛艇等项目，美国队都有冲金实力。
b5d19fa52ddf6a7ed9b3905822c011137a11d46a.translatedText: In the following events, the American team still has stamina. Among track and field, a big money-drawer, some American media believe that the U.S. Olympic track and field team’s goal is to win at least 12 gold medals, which is the same as last year’s World Championship record. In addition, what is most concerning in the United States is the gold medal competition between men's and women's basketball and women's football. Some American media even said, "If the U.S. team fails to win the men's and women's basketball gold medals, it will be regarded as a huge failure." In addition, the U.S. team has the gold medal potential in women's volleyball, women's beach volleyball, women's water polo, rowing and other events.

2c55a1a110476ef419a6b424b17181856ebbfb9c.translatedText: Winners are worried about tax bills

38e85a6e8e95d7e437d27b44b8d4b9b27938e93f.sourceText: 菲尔普斯所夺得的4金2银能得到13万美元奖金，但按照目前课税规定，需纳税约4.6万美元
38e85a6e8e95d7e437d27b44b8d4b9b27938e93f.translatedText: The 4 gold medals and 2 silver medals won by Phelps can get a bonus of 130,000 US dollars, but according to the current tax regulations, he needs to pay taxes of about 46,000 US dollars.

6ec7327cc4ebae1192ba8cfed9b777adbac6affc.translatedText: Arizona, USA, launches more tolerant immigration law guidelines The Arizona Attorney's Office last Thursday (September 15, 2016) reached a settlement with immigrant rights groups on the state's...

dc5f41605728911c1dee6a1a3cf0fc59a60f584c.sourceText: 亚利桑那州检察院上周四（2016年9月15日）与移民权利团体，就该州移民法中部分争议性条款达成和解，要求执法人员不能仅因怀疑某人是非法移民而延长盘问时间或拘留对方。
dc5f41605728911c1dee6a1a3cf0fc59a60f584c.translatedText: The Arizona Attorney's Office last Thursday (September 15, 2016) reached a settlement with immigrant rights groups on some controversial provisions of the state's immigration law, requiring law enforcement officers not to extend the questioning time or detain the other person simply because they suspect someone is an illegal immigrant.

0485e6a4bf5c111455920272005dd31812c9e008.sourceText: 据《基督教科学箴言报》报导，周四亚利桑那州总检察长布诺维奇（Mark Brnovich）公布了这项非正式意见，对该州执法人员对待疑似非法移民的做法给予限制，要求执法者不能因怀疑某人可能是非法居民，而断定其不具有合法移民身份，甚至因此拘留对方。
0485e6a4bf5c111455920272005dd31812c9e008.translatedText: According to the "Christian Science Monitor", Arizona Attorney General Mark Brnovich announced this informal opinion on Thursday, placing restrictions on the state's law enforcement officers' approach to suspected illegal immigrants, requiring law enforcement officers not to conclude that someone does not have legal immigration status or even detain the person because they suspect that he or she may be an illegal resident.

27977a3492a7fcf051a91dda00ba970ac8967162.sourceText: 布诺维奇说，与移民权利团体达成这份协议的目的是希望找到合理的解决办法，并保护州内纳税人的权利，同时带动亚利桑那州继续前进。
27977a3492a7fcf051a91dda00ba970ac8967162.translatedText: Brnovich said the purpose of reaching this agreement with immigrant rights groups is to find a reasonable solution and protect the rights of taxpayers in the state, while moving Arizona forward.

aee0f792f37c8e73bd81d85d79b8db6a7ce83852.sourceText: 根据该州2010年通过的SB 1070法案，当地执法人员如果有正当理由怀疑某个人可能是非法移民，他必须检查此人的移民身份状态。
aee0f792f37c8e73bd81d85d79b8db6a7ce83852.translatedText: According to the state's SB 1070 bill passed in 2010, if local law enforcement officers have reasonable grounds to suspect that a person may be an illegal immigrant, he must check the person's immigration status.

1b47eab732a5ee92f2be07460ebeae32e32743d2.sourceText: 当时，州内居民对非法移民可能导致贩毒活动的增加以及抢走当地人的就业机会，产生恐惧，为此，亚利桑那州通过了SB 1070。
1b47eab732a5ee92f2be07460ebeae32e32743d2.translatedText: At that time, Arizona passed SB 1070 amid fears among state residents that illegal immigration could lead to an increase in drug trafficking and take away jobs from locals.

2631bfb2f85f264dd5a8ab548da7ccccdad7058e.sourceText: 作为周四达成和解的一部分，布诺维奇检察官公布了一份还未形成法律效力的指导性准则：执法人员不能仅为核实某人的移民身份而延长扣留或拘押对方的时间，或逮捕对方。同时，执法者也不能把对方的族裔和国籍作为怀疑对方的依据，除非这些属于某犯罪嫌疑犯的特征。在需要的时候，执法者仍可要求对方出示他的身份证件，但这不再是出于法律的要求。
2631bfb2f85f264dd5a8ab548da7ccccdad7058e.translatedText: As part of Thursday's settlement, prosecutors Brnovich released a guideline that has not yet become legally binding: Law enforcement officers cannot extend the detention or detention of a person or arrest him solely for the purpose of verifying a person's immigration status. At the same time, law enforcement officers cannot use the other party's ethnicity and nationality as the basis for suspecting the other party, unless these are characteristics of a certain criminal suspect. When necessary, law enforcement officers can still ask the other party to produce his or her ID, but this is no longer a legal requirement.

efa80bd85cd8e9499c7fa3bc5ebcc0c7a984c795.sourceText: SB 1070于2010年在亚利桑那州众议院以35：21通过，在参议院以17：11通过。多数人认为这项法案的条款是合理的，也有批评说法案涉及了联邦执法权限并可能带来种族歧视问题。
efa80bd85cd8e9499c7fa3bc5ebcc0c7a984c795.translatedText: >SB 1070 passed the Arizona House of Representatives by 35:21 in 2010 and the Senate by 17:11. Most people believe that the provisions of this bill are reasonable, but there are also criticisms that the bill involves federal law enforcement authority and may bring about racial discrimination.

748cd4aeedaf5c89118a980f6cba5307f0dc2ed6.sourceText: 亚利桑那州卫生局隆重庆祝亚太裔传统活动日 五月十一日，具有现代化建筑风格的亚利桑那州卫生局实验大楼会议室里坐满了特别嘉宾和卫生局员工，欢声笑语不断。第五届州卫生局亚太裔传统活动在此隆重举行。本届活动的主题是”我们来自同一个世界。” 来自凤凰城姐妹城市日本姬路市委员会的代表首先介绍了日本地震的情况， 卫生局员工踊跃向地震灾区捐款。新当选的州众议员余艳芬向与会人士讲述了她是如何走上从政道路的，并鼓励各族裔努力实现美国梦。亚省卫生局局长充分肯定了各族裔共同努力所取得的成绩，赞扬了亚太裔的优良文化传统， 并希望明年继续举行此类庆祝活动。 演讲之间穿插着精彩纷呈的文艺表演。穿着艳丽民族服装的孟加拉国裔小姑娘袅袅婷婷地旋转于舞台上；充满浓郁印度乡土气息的铜鼓和风琴齐鸣合奏；来自新东方艺术学校的秋子老师长袖飘飘，宛如仙女下凡；洪平老师和她的优秀弟子们(卫生局的员工)表演了精彩的太极拳和太极剑。观众看得如痴如醉，掌声不断。香气四溢的亚太食品则令大家食指大动，纷纷排队等待品尝美食。
748cd4aeedaf5c89118a980f6cba5307f0dc2ed6.translatedText: The Arizona State Health Department solemnly celebrated the Asian and Pacific Islander Traditional Activities Day. On May 11, the conference room of the Arizona State Health Department Laboratory Building, which has a modern architectural style, was filled with special guests and health department employees, and there was constant laughter and laughter. The fifth State Health Department Asian and Pacific Islander Heritage Event was held here. The theme of this event is "We are from the same world." Representatives from the Himeji City Committee of Phoenix's sister city in Japan first introduced the situation of the earthquake in Japan. Employees of the Health Bureau enthusiastically donated money to the earthquake-stricken areas. Newly elected state representative Yu Yanfen told the attendees how she entered politics and encouraged all ethnic groups to work hard to realize the American dream. The Director of Health of the Province of Alberta fully affirmed the achievements made by the joint efforts of all ethnic groups, praised the fine cultural traditions of Asian and Pacific Islanders, and hoped that such celebrations will continue next year. The speeches were interspersed with wonderful artistic performances. A little Bangladeshi girl in colorful national costumes whirled on the stage; the bronze drum and organ ensemble was full of rich Indian local flavor; Teacher Qiuzi from New Oriental Art School had long sleeves fluttering, like a fairy descending to earth; Teacher Hong Ping and her outstanding disciples (employees of the Health Bureau) performed wonderful Tai Chi and Tai Chi swords. The audience was mesmerized and applauded continuously. The fragrant Asia-Pacific food made everyone excited, and they lined up to wait for a taste of the food.

0533724c41610a721c272a30bba2178d8e4b902b.sourceText: 留学期间，大多海外学子会赶上留学目的地的节日。那么中国留学生如何看待作为文化载体的节日，又是如何通过参加相关节日活动了解当地风俗文化的呢？
0533724c41610a721c272a30bba2178d8e4b902b.translatedText: During their studies abroad, most overseas students will catch up with the festivals of the destination where they study abroad. So how do Chinese international students view festivals as cultural carriers, and how do they learn about local customs and culture by participating in relevant festival activities?

14fce18f2e6a78eb7779bf96212746e459f830a5.sourceText: 李楠茜在美国卡内基梅隆大学就读期间，一般会过圣诞节，偶尔也会在万圣节上”凑凑热闹”。李楠茜说：”这两个节日基本是全民狂欢，气氛特别浓，大街小巷都是节日装饰物。万圣节期间，在街上能看到许多南瓜灯、稻草人的装饰。”
14fce18f2e6a78eb7779bf96212746e459f830a5.translatedText: When Li Nanqian was studying at Carnegie Mellon University in the United States, she usually celebrated Christmas and occasionally "joined in the fun" on Halloween. Li Nanqian said: "These two festivals are basically carnivals for the whole people, and the atmosphere is very strong. The streets and alleys are full of holiday decorations. During Halloween, you can see many pumpkin lanterns and scarecrow decorations on the streets."

c2312a78bc6a7129c42ed7d582dcb4bf43f6713e.sourceText: 相比于需要盛大庆祝的节日，有些具有特殊意义的小节日也受到学子的青睐。在日本一桥大学留学的景珊一般选择过一些小节日，例如森林保护日、敬老日。她说：”选择过这些节日并非刻意，而是受周边环境的影响。遇上这些节日，商店会有宣传，比如发画片儿。市民文化馆也会做活动，当地电视台还会做节日特别报道。”
c2312a78bc6a7129c42ed7d582dcb4bf43f6713e.translatedText: Compared with festivals that require grand celebrations, some small festivals with special significance are also favored by students. Jing Shan, who studies at Hitotsubashi University in Japan, usually chooses to celebrate some small festivals, such as Forest Protection Day and Respect for the Aged Day. She said: "The choice of celebrating these festivals is not intentional, but is influenced by the surrounding environment. During these festivals, stores will promote it, such as distributing pictures. The Civic Cultural Center will also hold activities, and local TV stations will also do special reports on the festival."

a39d090c9f5dd5abda6ad4d78ca7b9f6bf6aea8a.sourceText: 沈颖在日本东京大学留学期间，参加过日本的夏日祭。夏日祭是日本的传统节日，人们一般会穿上和服浴衣，参加节日庆典，在庙会上玩些捞金鱼之类的小游戏。沈颖在夏日祭期间，也穿着和服浴衣去观看花火大会。她说：”夏日祭是个很特别的活动，节日氛围很浓，感觉非常浪漫。”
a39d090c9f5dd5abda6ad4d78ca7b9f6bf6aea8a.translatedText: Shen Ying participated in summer festivals in Japan while studying at the University of Tokyo in Japan. The Summer Festival is a traditional festival in Japan. People usually wear kimonos and yukatas, participate in festival celebrations, and play games such as catching goldfish at temple fairs. Shen Ying also wore a kimono and yukata to watch the fireworks display during the summer festival. She said: "The Summer Festival is a very special event, with a strong festive atmosphere and a very romantic feeling."

1babb65319d41cfe9c2c592121292baafecc3cf8.sourceText: 微微(化名)在美国求学期间过了圣帕特里克节。美国在庆祝该节日时，通常会用黄绿色装饰房间，庆祝者也会身穿绿色的衣服。由于文化差异，微微说：”我在过这个节日的时候会在服装上做一些改变，会穿绿衣服但不会戴绿色的帽子。”
1babb65319d41cfe9c2c592121292baafecc3cf8.translatedText: Weiwei (pseudonym) spent St. Patrick's Day while studying in the United States. When celebrating this holiday in the United States, rooms are usually decorated with yellow and green colors, and celebrants also wear green clothes. Due to cultural differences, Weiwei said: "I will make some changes in my clothing when celebrating this festival. I will wear green clothes but not a green hat."

819a6a1e8449a8d523db9e9b31b87dfc520a5d07.sourceText: 此外，品尝当地传统节日美食，也是庆祝节日的方式之一。沈颖介绍说：”日本有个节日叫”节分”，节日期间会吃一种特色小吃。便利店会提前一天宣传美食，我会去吃吃看，也算是过节。”
819a6a1e8449a8d523db9e9b31b87dfc520a5d07.translatedText: In addition, tasting local traditional festival food is also one of the ways to celebrate the festival. Shen Ying said: "There is a festival in Japan called Setsubun, and a special snack is eaten during the festival. Convenience stores will promote the delicacies one day in advance, and I will go and eat them, which is considered a festival."

30a9031702a61341b95012f3219456b94a8dbf78.translatedText: Learn about local culture through festivals

874551d7035e7e1bacfd976899e0b6ff9d568c28.sourceText: 庆祝海外节日，可以使学子丰富对当地文化的认识。沈颖说：”来日本前，并不知道有”节分”这样的节日。过了一次这个节日后，才对日本的节日文化有了进一步了解。”在加拿大求学的艾子(化名)也有这样的感受：”加拿大的节日气氛浓厚，每次过节都是人潮涌动。这让我感受到加拿大人对个人生活的重视，在工作之余也注重休息与娱乐。”
874551d7035e7e1bacfd976899e0b6ff9d568c28.translatedText: Celebrating overseas festivals can enable students to enrich their understanding of local culture. Shen Ying said: "Before coming to Japan, I didn't know there was a festival like Setsubun. After passing this festival, I had a better understanding of Japanese festival culture." Ai Zi (pseudonym), who is studying in Canada, also has the same feeling: "Canada has a strong festival atmosphere. There are always crowds of people during every festival. This makes me feel that Canadians attach great importance to personal life and pay attention to rest and entertainment after work.”

601f57ecbb02e211f411a485d2d537d051548507.sourceText: 其次，庆祝这些节日也为学子融入当地社会提供了机会。过正月节日的时候，景珊的日本朋友邀请她前往家里做客。朋友准备了寿司、红豆饭之类的美食，与景珊一起庆祝节日。景珊说：”我觉得这是一个融入当地的机会，既能了解真实的日式待客方式，也能交一些朋友。”
601f57ecbb02e211f411a485d2d537d051548507.translatedText: Secondly, celebrating these festivals also provides opportunities for students to integrate into the local society. During the first lunar month festival, Jingshan’s Japanese friend invited her to his home. Friends prepared delicacies such as sushi and red bean rice to celebrate the festival with Jingshan. Jingshan said: "I think this is an opportunity to integrate into the local area. I can not only understand the real Japanese way of hospitality, but also make some friends."

44f07e445c62944ea67fe7a86a4da3db78631095.sourceText: 当然，想融入当地文化是留学生参加节日庆祝活动的前提。如果学子对于当地文化认同感不够，就不会选择过当地节日。在新加坡留学的阿威(化名)一般不过当地节日。”当地除了华人的传统节日外，有些是宗教节日，我一般不参加相关活动。”阿威说。(缪童昕)
44f07e445c62944ea67fe7a86a4da3db78631095.translatedText: Of course, wanting to integrate into the local culture is a prerequisite for international students to participate in festival celebrations. If students do not have enough sense of local cultural identity, they will not choose to celebrate local festivals. Ah Wei (pseudonym), who studies in Singapore, usually attends local festivals. "In addition to traditional Chinese festivals in the local area, some are religious festivals. I generally do not participate in related activities." Awei said. (Miao Tongxin)

1cd427325c9e5371c67076b9101e9042fd80b1b3.translatedText: The Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association and PepsiCo signed a new contract to bring discounts to more Chinese restaurants (Newsletter from the Chinese Restaurant Association) The Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta was established in 1988...

ac99ffbbacabc675a6384ff6310970d7e117b63f.sourceText: (中餐馆会通讯)亚省中国餐馆协会成立于1988年，而第一份中、英文的＂会员通讯＂(NEWSLETTER)，也于 当年5月寄发给各个会员。那时中文部分採取的是手写方式，但仍为今天留下了不少珍贵的讯息。如当年因治安环境欠佳，所以＂会员通讯＂上写有＂1988年5月十一日下午二时，在华美酒楼召开例会，并请到助理警司演讲，内容是＂如何处理及提防抢劫＂。＂会员通讯＂下方是报导中餐馆会成立了＂新委员会＂去执行一个＂重要方桉＂。是什麽样的＂重要方桉＂呢？原来就是今天大家已经很熟悉的＂中国餐馆食品统一採购方桉＂。当时的董事徐国富(Charles Tsui)提到＂此事的接洽已经有很好的效果＂，如成功，＂会员的利润必然会提高＂。
ac99ffbbacabc675a6384ff6310970d7e117b63f.translatedText: (Newsletter from the Chinese Restaurant Association) The Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta was established in 1988, and the first "Member Newsletter" (NEWSLETTER) in Chinese and English was sent to each member in May of that year. At that time, the Chinese part was written by hand, but it still left many precious messages for today. For example, due to the poor public security environment at that time, the "Member Newsletter" stated, "On May 11, 1988, a regular meeting was held at the Huamei Restaurant at 2 pm, and the Assistant Superintendent was invited to give a speech. The content was "How to deal with and guard against robberies." Below the "Member Newsletter" is the report The Chinese Restaurant Association established a "new committee" to implement an "important plan". What kind of "important plan" was it? It turned out to be the "Unified Food Purchasing Plan for Chinese Restaurants" that everyone is familiar with today. Tsui mentioned that "the contact on this matter has had very good results" and if successful, "members' profits will definitely increase."

62c2d5e9e872c83e1c0061d9d22d9711f2f95822.sourceText: 此后，亚省中国餐馆协会和全体会员朝着这个方向一同努力，先后和SYSCO食品公司、百事可乐公司、信用卡公司、毛巾清洗公司、废油回收公司、US FOOD食品公司….等等有关食品与餐馆服务方面的机构都签署过合约，使到数百个餐馆会员得 到过各种优惠。 多年来，亚省中国餐馆协会和百事可乐公司一直合作愉快。 近期，更洽谈新的商机，让会员获取更大的利益。历经多次会议，现已商定：会员中的新客户可获一次性签约费$300元，有免费安装餐饮冷饮机服务，并提供新品种(如Lipton冰茶等)选购，另外，如有会员餐馆要出售瓶装或罐装饮料，签约后可获前10箱免费饮料，可借用小型雪柜，并有销售回扣。对于新开的餐馆，百事可乐公司还给予开张物件上的支持。更多的详情请浏览亚省中国餐馆协会网站：www.craa.us 。 馆会成立廿多年来的宗旨，也是今后继续努力的方向。亚省中国餐馆协会再此感谢全体会员的大力支持，并鼓励更多的新会员加入，团结就是力量，日后可争取到更多的优惠和权益。
62c2d5e9e872c83e1c0061d9d22d9711f2f95822.translatedText: Since then, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association and all members have worked together in this direction, successively working with SYSCO Food Company, PepsiCo, credit card companies, towel cleaning companies, waste oil recycling companies, and US. FOOD Food Company... and other organizations related to food and restaurant services have signed contracts, allowing hundreds of restaurant members to receive various discounts. Over the years, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association and Pepsi-Cola have been cooperating happily. Recently, we have negotiated new business opportunities to allow members to gain greater benefits. After many meetings, it has been agreed that new members will receive a one-time signing fee of $300, free installation of catering cold drink machines, and new varieties (such as Lipton ice tea, etc.) will be provided. In addition, if there are member meals, The restaurant sells bottled or canned drinks. After signing up, you will receive the first 10 boxes of free drinks, you can borrow a small refrigerator, and there will be sales rebates. For more details, please visit the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta website: www.craa.us. . The purpose of the association has been established for more than 20 years, and it is also the direction of continued efforts in the future. The Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association would like to thank all members for their strong support and encourage more new members to join. Unity is strength and we can obtain more discounts and rights in the future.

11c7ec131516c248ca79b17b3760d2188072b2d0.sourceText: 黄慧莉律师法律信箱（十六） 1。 我要怎样才可以符合非法小留学生的缓驱逐二年申请工作许可的条件﹖ 总统在2012年6月15日发布行政命令，符合特定条件的申请人，可以获准延缓驱逐二年，并申请工作许可及请假证，期满还可申请延期。 移民局已经在8月3日公布相关的申请要求，并将从2012年8月15日开始接受申请。 在准备提出申请前，看看你是否符合移民局的要求﹕ 2012年6月15日当天未满31岁(也就是1981年6月16日及以后出生);—要求直接证明– 在16岁生日之前进入美国;—要求直接证明– 2012年6月15日之前非法进入美国，或者在2012年6月15日已经失去合法身份﹐如果你现在才非法就来不及了) 从2007年6月15日至今持续定居在美国； 2012年6月15日当天人在美国，并且提交申请时人也在美国；—要求直接证明– 送件时你必须满15岁(如果你没满15岁，但是在递解程序中，也可以提出申请)。 送件时你正在学校就读，已经从高中毕业或者有高中毕业证，取得了GED证书，或者是美国海岸警卫队或美国军队的退伍军人； —要求直接证明— 没有犯过刑事重罪、严重违法、三次或三次以上违法，并且不会对美国国家安全或公共安全造成威胁。 —要求直接证明 — 移民局的申请费为465美元，申请Deferred Action 同时可以申请工卡.万一移民局拒绝你的申请，是无法要求移民局重开案件或是重新考虑(Motion to reopen or reconsider) 或上诉(Appeal ).移民局批准你的申请后，如果你因为人道因素、求学或工作等因素，可以向移民局申请请假证(Advance Parole). 2。 听说国税局又再一波要查海外帐户及收入﹐是否有此事﹖ 我和我先生在中国工作﹐我们都是美国公民﹐每年回美才一个月﹐免税额为多少﹖ 答﹕自2012年9月1日起，国税局对于住在海外的美国公民（包括有双重国籍者），将开启一套新的海外税务申报程式，申报人只需补报过去三年（2009 -2011）个人税及过去六年（2006-2011）海外银行帐户申报（FBAR）。 如果每年个人欠税不超过1500美元，则符合国税局新提出的低风险评估范畴，给予免刑事及税务处罚的快速通关。 因此，国税局特别提醒低风险特赦计划的申请人，确定自己属于低风险收入再申请特赦，因为一旦被国税局察觉有误，快速通过将转为高风险审查，最长期限可达三年。 2555表外国收入豁免的数额为﹕2011年单身、户主或夫妻分报为9万2900美元，2012年为9万5100美元，夫妻合报加倍。 另外国税局将仿照海外自愿申报计画中的退出者方式处理，包括单独立案进行刑事侦查, 按50%-75%的罚款逐年计算纳税人至少8年（2003至2010年）的资产，及 最多不超过3年的牢狱之灾。 国税局用意非常明显，欢迎尚未浮出水面的海外纳税人自首，符合条件者既往不咎，但对混水摸鱼者则严惩不贷。 纳税人一旦参加2012年9月1日新启程序，将没有资格再参加2011年1月9日开启的第三波海外自愿申报计画。 如果已退出或丧失资格参加海外自愿申报计画，也将无资格参加新的计画。 此外，先前的两波追税，都是由申报人先自报罚款?#36134;单?#65292;由国税局审查核实后再通知付账。 这次新的计画则是随申报即时缴纳欠税和罚款，不再赊账。 2009年10月15日终止的第一次「大赦」使国税局收获22亿税金纳入国库，2011年9月9日终止的二次「大赦」到目前为止使国税局再添28亿进账 。 海外税源已成为国税局新发现的金矿，因此扬言第三波开采没有截止期限。
11c7ec131516c248ca79b17b3760d2188072b2d0.translatedText: Lawyer Huang Huili’s legal mailbox (16) 1. How can I meet the conditions for the two-year deferment of deportation for illegal international students and apply for a work permit? The President issued an executive order on June 15, 2012. Applicants who meet certain conditions can be granted a two-year deferment of deportation and apply for a work permit and leave certificate. Upon expiration, they can also apply for an extension. The Immigration Bureau has announced the relevant application requirements on August 3, and will begin accepting applications from August 15, 2012. Before preparing to apply, check to see if you meet the requirements of the USCIS: Under 31 years old on June 15, 2012 (that is, born on June 16, 1981 or later); - Direct proof required - entered the United States before your 16th birthday; - Direct proof required - illegally entered the United States before June 15, 2012, or lost legal status on June 15, 2012. If you are illegal now, it is too late) You have continued to reside in the United States from June 15, 2007 to the present; you were in the United States on June 15, 2012, and you were also in the United States when you submitted the application; - Direct proof is required - You must be over 15 years old when sending the application (if you are under 15 years old, but you are in deportation proceedings, you can also apply). You are in school at the time of submission, have graduated from high school or have a high school diploma, obtained a GED certificate, or are a veteran of the U.S. Coast Guard or the U.S. Army; - Direct proof is required - Have not committed a criminal felony, serious violation of the law, or three or more violations, and will not pose a threat to U.S. national security or public safety. - Direct proof required - The application fee of the Immigration Bureau is US$465. You can apply for a work permit when applying for Deferred Action. If the Immigration Bureau rejects your application, you cannot ask the Immigration Bureau to reopen the case or reconsider (Motion to reopen or reconsider) or appeal (Appeal). After the Immigration Bureau approves your application, if you are due to humanitarian reasons, study or work, etc., you can apply for an Advance Parole from the Immigration Bureau. 2. I heard that the IRS is once again checking overseas accounts and income. Is this true? My husband and I work in China. We are both American citizens. We only come back to the United States for one month every year. What is the tax exemption? Answer: Starting from September 1, 2012, the Internal Revenue Service will launch a new overseas tax filing process for U.S. citizens living overseas (including those with dual citizenship). Filers only need to file personal taxes for the past three years (2009-2011) and foreign bank account declarations (FBAR) for the past six years (2006-2011). If the annual personal tax debt does not exceed US$1,500, it meets the new low-risk assessment category proposed by the IRS and will be granted fast clearance without criminal and tax penalties. Therefore, the IRS specially reminds applicants of the low-risk amnesty program to confirm that they have low-risk income before applying for amnesty, because once the IRS detects an error, the fast-track review will be converted into a high-risk review, with a maximum period of up to three years. The amount of the Form 2555 foreign earned income exemption is: $92,900 in 2011 for singles, heads of household, or married couples filing separately, and $95,100 for 2012, doubling that for married couples filing jointly. In addition, the IRS will deal with withdrawals in the same manner as in the overseas voluntary declaration program, including criminal investigation in separate cases, fines of 50%-75% calculated year by year on the taxpayer's assets for at least 8 years (2003 to 2010), and no more than 3 years in prison. The intention of the IRS is very obvious. It welcomes overseas taxpayers who have not yet surfaced to surrender. Those who meet the conditions will not be punished, but those who fish in troubled waters will be severely punished. Once taxpayers participate in the new procedures launched on September 1, 2012, they will not be eligible to participate in the third wave of overseas voluntary declaration programs launched on January 9, 2011. If you have withdrawn or become ineligible to participate in the Overseas Voluntary Declaration Program, you will not be eligible to participate in the new program. In addition, in the previous two waves of tax recovery, the filer first self-reported the fine?#36134;The bill?#65292;was reviewed and verified by the IRS before being notified of payment. This new plan is to pay the tax arrears and fines immediately with the declaration and no longer take credit. The first "amnesty" that ended on October 15, 2009 brought the IRS 2.2 billion in tax revenue and put it into the national treasury. The second "amnesty" that ended on September 9, 2011 has so far brought in another 2.8 billion to the IRS. Overseas tax sources have become a newly discovered gold mine for the IRS, so there is no deadline for the third wave of exploitation.

6c6756cb5e14c92a8a49b4255e80335c5fda37f4.sourceText: 一美分硬币目前的成本为2.41美分，比起面值高出一倍多，并且由于原材料价格继续上涨，其成本会更高。专家认为，也许一美分硬币应当退出市场，看来总统奥巴马也同意。
6c6756cb5e14c92a8a49b4255e80335c5fda37f4.translatedText: The current cost of one-cent coins is 2.41 cents, more than double the face value, and its cost will be higher as raw material prices continue to rise. Experts think maybe the penny should be taken off the market, and it seems President Obama agrees.

00eba7998b272ec0bd172dc8254622f05e77b746.sourceText: 据国家广播公司（NBC News）报道，谷歌公司的格林（John Green）上周五对总统奥巴马提问，”澳大利亚、加拿大、新西兰和其它很多国家都取消了一分硬币。我们为何不那么做？” 奥巴马回应说，”任何时候我们把钱花在人们实际上并不使用的东西，那就是我们应当做出改变的某种东西。” NBC说，2012年一美分硬币的制造成本为2.41美分。而制造一分硬币的锌和铜都可能继续涨价，因为中国制造业需要这些材料，成本还会提高。 当然，去年制造一美分硬币的总开支也只有5800万美元，不到联邦2012年开支的0.1%。但是”美国一分硬币退市公民”（Citizens to Retire the U.S. Penny）等团体长期以来都在要求消灭一分硬币。 实际上，美国军方已经决定一美分硬币无用：所有陆军和空军商店都以五分硬币为最低找换单位。 就在两党都寻找削减政府开支方式的时候，停止一美分硬币的制造看来相对没有痛苦，当然起作用也不大。奥巴马承认，华盛顿有很多大事要做。 实际上，国会曾经试图立法禁用一美分硬币。2001年，共和党众议员科尔贝（Jim Kolbe）提出”合法货币现代化法案”，要求让一美分硬币过期，同时要求零售商的现金交易都以5美分为最低单位。但那部法案失败。 在锌成本成倍上升之后，科尔贝2006年再次提出”工业化国家货币改革法”，命运相同。 也许总统不需要经过国会，可以通过改变材料来生产一美分硬币，降低成本。当然，这不是印有林肯头像的硬币首次改变材料：1982年一美分硬币由原来的97.5%的锌和2.5%的铜改为95%的铜和5%的锌组成。
00eba7998b272ec0bd172dc8254622f05e77b746.translatedText: According to NBC News, Google's John Green asked President Obama last Friday, "Australia, Canada, New Zealand and many other countries have eliminated the penny. Why don't we do that?" Obama responded, "Any time we spend money on something that people don't actually use, that's something we should change." NBC said that the manufacturing cost of a one-cent coin in 2012 was 2.41 cents. The zinc and copper used to make one-cent coins are likely to continue to rise in price because China's manufacturing industry needs these materials and the cost will increase. Of course, the total expenditure on manufacturing one-cent coins last year was only $58 million, less than 0.1% of federal expenditures in 2012. But groups like Citizens to Retire the U.S. Penny have long called for the penny to be eliminated. In fact, the U.S. military has decided that pennies are useless: all Army and Air Force stores have a nickel minimum change. At a time when both parties are looking for ways to cut government spending, halting the production of pennies seems relatively painless and certainly not effective. Obama acknowledged that Washington has a lot of big things to do. In fact, Congress once tried to legislate a ban on the penny. In 2001, Republican Congressman Jim Kolbe proposed the "Legal Currency Modernization Act," which required the expiration of one-cent coins and required retailers to have a minimum unit of 5 cents for cash transactions. But that bill failed. After zinc costs doubled, Kolbe again proposed the "Currency Reform Law for Industrialized Countries" in 2006, which suffered the same fate. Perhaps the president could reduce the cost by changing the materials used to produce the one-cent coin without having to go through Congress. Of course, this isn't the first time a Lincoln-like coin has changed material: the 1982 one-cent piece was made from 97.5% zinc and 2.5% copper to 95% copper and 5% zinc.

bf2456ed4f13ff5a3862554d871dd97193368359.translatedText: Descendants of Sun Yat-sen introduced two newly discovered letters from Soong Ching Ling's family in Shanghai Xinhuanet On the 30th, Sun Yat-sen's great-grandson Sun Guosheng introduced Soong Ching Ling's family letters to experts from many countries in Shanghai...

963b3957387c84559522ed2a76cb3ed9f196192a.sourceText: 孙中山曾孙孙国升30日在上海向多国专家介绍了宋庆龄家书研究的一些新发现。他摘要介绍了2009年在整理家中资料时新发现的两封宋庆龄英语家书，其内容客观反映了宋庆龄对第二次世界大战及国内外局势的看法。这两封家书的内容是首次向国际学术界公开。
963b3957387c84559522ed2a76cb3ed9f196192a.translatedText: Sun Yat-sen's great-grandson Sun Guosheng introduced some new findings in the study of Soong Ching Ling's family letters to experts from many countries in Shanghai on the 30th. He briefly introduced two letters from Soong Ching Ling's family in English that were newly discovered in 2009 when sorting out family information. Their contents objectively reflected Soong Ching Ling's views on the Second World War and the situation at home and abroad. The contents of these two letters home are disclosed to the international academic community for the first time.

dbd4fabdfbe0679fd3bbafcbead988cb06ef1e99.sourceText: 30日，在上海举行的”宋庆龄及其时代”国际学术研讨会上，孙国升朗读了两封家书的部分中文译文。
dbd4fabdfbe0679fd3bbafcbead988cb06ef1e99.translatedText: On the 30th, at the "Song Qingling and Her Era" international academic symposium held in Shanghai, Sun Guosheng read aloud some Chinese translations of two letters from home.

b63fdc24e3f5473be8a0d9d659989aa9e543df75.sourceText: 这两封家书均为上世纪40年代宋庆龄致孙治强（孙中山之孙）的信。一封写于1941年4月19日，当时孙治强从美国加州伯克利大学毕业，宋庆龄自香港发出了祝贺信。信中特别提到宋庆龄对第二次世界大战性质的看法。
b63fdc24e3f5473be8a0d9d659989aa9e543df75.translatedText: These two letters home are letters from Soong Ching Ling to Sun Zhiqiang (grandson of Sun Yat-sen) in the 1940s. One letter was written on April 19, 1941, when Sun Zhiqiang graduated from the University of California, Berkeley, and Soong Ching Ling sent a congratulatory letter from Hong Kong. The letter specifically mentioned Soong Ching Ling's views on the nature of World War II.

59c528d065b399d5808e3c2200648ae84457de31.sourceText: 第二封家书写于1942年7月5日。宋庆龄在信中详细介绍了这一年7月4日她在重庆参加陈纳德将军为”飞虎队”所举办的一次野餐。信中还对孙治强等远在海外的孙氏后人表达了思念之情。这封家书成为宋庆龄与孙氏后人关系融洽的一个见证。
59c528d065b399d5808e3c2200648ae84457de31.translatedText: The second family seal was written on July 5, 1942. In her letter, Soong Ching Ling described in detail her participation in a picnic hosted by General Chennault for the "Flying Tigers" in Chongqing on July 4 of that year. The letter also expressed my longing for Sun Zhiqiang and other descendants of the Sun family who are far away overseas. This family letter became a testimony of the harmonious relationship between Soong Ching Ling and the descendants of the Sun family.

fba5dd0c845d5ef752b370bb6338dd69521caffc.sourceText: 孙国升说，尽管自己对曾祖母的了解并不深，但这两封家书的发现有助于自己从家人的角度认识曾祖母，翻译这两封家书也将对学术界的研究有所帮助。
fba5dd0c845d5ef752b370bb6338dd69521caffc.translatedText: Sun Guosheng said that although he did not know his great-grandmother deeply, the discovery of these two family letters helped him understand his great-grandmother from the perspective of his family, and the translation of these two family letters would also be helpful to academic research.

0dede5abc28b955f6eadbabdf236a5798847c3df.sourceText: 今年5月29日是宋庆龄逝世30周年，一批来自海内外的宋庆龄研究新发现和新成果在国内公开出版发行。在上海举行的”宋庆龄及其时代”国际学术研讨会，吸引了中国、日本、俄罗斯等国近200名研究者出席。
0dede5abc28b955f6eadbabdf236a5798847c3df.translatedText: May 29 this year marks the 30th anniversary of Soong Ching Ling’s death. A number of new discoveries and achievements in Soong Ching Ling’s research from home and abroad were published and distributed domestically. The international academic symposium "Song Ching Ling and Her Era" held in Shanghai attracted nearly 200 researchers from China, Japan, Russia and other countries.

9ca723e2a692a2854f1fd5300a495b7beaf4535b.sourceText: 会议期间还首次发布了《宋庆龄致陈志昆夫妇陈燕书信选编》、法籍画家高醇芳新作《风中玫瑰－－回忆我家与孙夫人宋庆龄的友情》、高青回忆录《微笑的眼睛－－我与宋庆龄的少年宫》等最新研究成果，其中部分为中英文对照版。
9ca723e2a692a2854f1fd5300a495b7beaf4535b.translatedText: During the conference, the latest research results such as "Selected Letters from Soong Ching Ling to Chen Zhikun and his wife Chen Yan", French painter Gao Chunfang's new work "Rose in the Wind - Remembering the Friendship between My Family and Mrs. Sun Soong Ching Ling", Gao Qing's memoir "Smiling Eyes - My Children's Palace with Soong Ching Ling" were also released for the first time, some of which are in Chinese and English versions.

ae6140d813281a6ea8cbefc2a1787ea7a05b98a7.sourceText: 伊朗1月28日送猴子上太空是真是假之辩，4日持续延烧。美国国务院质疑太空猴是否存活，甚至质疑是否有发射升空之事。曾高唱「轰炸伊朗」歌曲的2008 年共和党总统候选人麦凯恩参议员藉此开玩笑，把伊朗总统阿曼迪内加比成猴子，引起本党国会众议员艾马许狠批，指马侃「种族歧视」。 国务院发言人卢岚说，这隻猴子曾否进入太空？伊朗宣称的安返地球猴子是否为升入太空的同一隻猴子？这隻猴子是否存活？还有许多疑问。 麦凯恩则在「推特」社群网站写道：「阿曼迪内加想要成为第一个上太空的伊朗人。可是他上个星期不是刚去过吗？」此文并与伊朗上周发射猴子进太空的新闻连结。 某些人士对「如此缺乏外交常识」的玩笑，不以为然，提出批评，76岁的麦凯恩再「推」一文反击：「有关伊朗太空一文：大家轻鬆点，行吗？有人开不起玩笑吗？」 32岁的共和党国会众议员艾马许看不惯，「推」文反驳：「请阁下聪明一点，玩笑勿带种族歧视。」
ae6140d813281a6ea8cbefc2a1787ea7a05b98a7.translatedText: The debate over whether Iran sent monkeys into space on January 28 was true or false continued to rage on the 4th. The U.S. State Department questioned whether the space monkey was alive and even whether it was launched into space. Senator John McCain, the 2008 Republican presidential candidate who once sang the song "Bomb Iran", used this joke to compare Iranian President Amandine Nega to a monkey, which triggered strong criticism from his own party's Congressman Aymash, who accused Ma Kan of being "racist". State Council spokesperson Lu Lan asked, "Has this monkey ever entered space?" Is the monkey Iran claims to have returned to Earth the same monkey that ascended into space? Does the monkey survive? There are still many questions. McCain wrote on the Twitter social networking site: "Amandinega wants to be the first Iranian in space. But didn't he just go there last week?" This article was linked to news about Iran launching a monkey into space last week. Some people disagreed with the joke that was "so lacking in diplomatic common sense" and criticized it. The 76-year-old McCain "tweeted" another article to counter: "The article about Iran's space: Can everyone just relax, okay? Is there anyone who can't take a joke?" 32-year-old Republican Congressman Aimash couldn't stand it. He tweeted to retort: ​​"Please be smart and don't joke racially."

5f06b2dc0904d796cc188c90d1814ce0926ced4b.sourceText: 治粤八年南天王——传奇人物陈济棠（下） 余玉书 （五）通款曲共军绕岭南（下） 突围成功后毛泽东得意地有词为记：”东方欲晚，莫道军行早。踏遍青山人未老，风景这边独好。会昌城外高峰，颠连直接东溟。战士指看南粤，更加郁郁葱葱。”一九三四年十月十二日，总共八万五千人的”红星纵队”向江西广东边境突围时，陈济棠亦相应向属下将领下达命令：”敌不向我射击，不许开枪。敌不向我袭来，不准出击。”二十日共军迅速超过尚未合围的碉堡战线缺口，突破了第一度防线。 蒋介石闻报后惊怒交集，急令陈济棠的南路军与何键的西路军在广东湖南边境的汝城，仁化，至乐昌一线建立第二度防线。陈接到命令后，表面上装模作样，派遣粤北绥靖主任李汉魂率领独三师及警卫旅前往设防。其实李部早接到陈的密令：以”保境安民”为主，任由共军顺利越过二塘小城，很快便离开了广东省境，唯一的接触只有内心对蒋始终忠心不二的余汉谋独二师，不顾一切经龙南，大庚向西追击共军，在延寿附近金樽坳打了一场小胜仗，算是对老蒋有所交待，也开始蒋余之间的因缘。 ”红星纵队”突围后，马不停蹄，直窜到贵州的遵义，一九三五年一月五日开始，连开了十天在中共历史上著名的”遵义会议”，会后毛泽东卷土重来，秦邦宪的总书记撤职，以张闻天代之，毛还兼了本来由周恩来担任的中央军委会主席，周被贬为副主席，此外毛还是政治局委员及常委，可谓集党军政大权于一身，统率共军继续向四川西北部进发。 当老蒋知道由于陈济棠的南路军态度暧昧，致令共军得以轻易突围成功，不禁勃然大怒，一方面打电报怒责陈济棠：”厖平时请饷请械备至，一旦有事则拥兵自重。厖此次按兵不动，任由共匪西窜，贻我国民革命以千秋世莫大之污点。” 另一方面派何健为追击军总司令，辖十五个师，两个旅，七个团，一个支队，共分为五路：第一路司令刘建绪，第二路司令薛岳，第三路司令周浑元，第四路司令李云杰，第五路司令李韫珩。其中第二路司令薛岳亦为粤籍将领，懂兵擅战，率领四个师，两人个旅，一个支队，任务虽然艰巨，但表现最佳，先后在西康西南，及天全，宝兴一带，大破张国焘及徐向前的左路共军，一直追击到甘肃成县，光荣完成任务，继续未完使命的是”西北剿匪”副总司令张学良的爱将于学忠，假如”西安事变”不曾发生，历史肯定重写。
5f06b2dc0904d796cc188c90d1814ce0926ced4b.translatedText: The Southern King of Guangdong for eight years - the legendary Chen Jitang (Part 2) Yu Yushu (5) The communist army marches around Lingnan (Part 2) After the successful breakout, Mao Zedong proudly wrote: "It's too late in the east, but the army of Mo Dao marched early. People who have traveled through the green mountains are still young, and the scenery here is unique. The peaks outside Huichang City are directly connected to the east. The soldiers looked at southern Guangdong, which was even more lush and green." On October 12, 1934, a total of 85,000 people When the "Red Star Column" broke through to the Jiangxi-Guangdong border, Chen Jitang also issued an order to his generals accordingly: "You are not allowed to fire unless the enemy shoots at me. You are not allowed to attack until the enemy attacks me." On the 20th, the Communist army quickly surpassed the gap in the bunker front that had not yet been encircled and broke through the first line of defense. After hearing the report, Chiang Kai-shek was shocked and angry, and urgently ordered Chen Jitang's South Route Army and He Jian's West Route Army to establish a second line of defense from Rucheng, Renhua, to Lechang on the border of Guangdong and Hunan. After receiving the order, Chen pretended to be pretentious and sent Li Hanhun, the director of appeasement in northern Guangdong, to lead the Dusan Division and the security brigade to set up defenses. In fact, Li Bu had already received Chen's secret order: focusing on "protecting the territory and the people", he allowed the Communist army to successfully cross the small town of Ertang, and soon left the border of Guangdong Province. The only contact was his inner loyalty to Chiang Kai-shek. The second Yu Han planned to separate the second division and passed through Longnan at all costs. Da Geng pursued the Communist army westward and fought a small victory at Jinzun Ao near Yanshou. After the "Red Star Column" broke through, they rushed non-stop to Zunyi, Guizhou. Starting on January 5, 1935, the famous "Zunyi Conference" in the history of the Communist Party of China was held for ten consecutive days. After the meeting, Mao Zedong made a comeback and Qin Bangxian was dismissed as General Secretary. Replaced by Zhang Wentian, Mao also served as Chairman of the Central Military Commission, which was originally held by Zhou Enlai. Zhou was demoted to Vice Chairman. In addition, Mao was also a member of the Politburo and the Standing Committee. It can be said that he combined the power of the party, military and government, and led the Communist army to continue to march into northwest Sichuan. When Chiang Kai-shek learned that the ambiguous attitude of Chen Jitang's Southern Route Army had allowed the communist army to break through easily, he was furious. On the one hand, he sent a telegram angrily to Chen Jitang: "Pang usually pays for the troops to be ready, but if something happens, he will support his troops with self-respect. This time, Pang stood still and allowed the communist bandits to flee westward, which has caused a huge stain on our national revolution." On the other hand, He Jian was appointed as the commander-in-chief of the pursuit army, with jurisdiction over fifteen divisions, two brigades, seven regiments and one detachment, divided into five routes: Commander Liu Jianxu of the first route, Xue Yue, commander of the second route, Zhou Hunyuan, commander of the third route, Li Yunjie, commander of the fourth route, and Li Yunheng, commander of the fifth route. Among them, the commander of the second route, Xue Yue, was also a Cantonese general who knew how to fight. He led four divisions, two brigades, and one detachment. Although the task was arduous, he performed the best. He successively defeated Zhang Guotao and Zhang Guotao in the southwest of Xikang, Tianquan, and Baoxing. Xu Qianqian's left-leg communist army pursued them all the way to Chengxian County, Gansu Province, and completed their mission with honor. The person who continued the unfinished mission was Zhang Xueliang's love, Yu Xuezhong, the deputy commander-in-chief of the "Northwestern Bandit Suppression". If the "Xi'an Incident" had not happened, history would have been rewritten.

f1d426f0457e6cafdf1cdb3ae1ad8fda0445789e.sourceText: 每年一度的富豪榜总能吸引不少人的眼球，榜单上的人来人往见证了中国经济的潮起潮落。在２０１２年的中国富豪榜上，有些依旧勇立潮头，有些则已悄然陨落；苦苦挣扎者有之，蓄势待发者亦有之。富豪们身价涨落的背后，从一个侧面见证了中国财富格局的嬗变。
f1d426f0457e6cafdf1cdb3ae1ad8fda0445789e.translatedText: The annual rich list always attracts the attention of many people. The comings and goings of people on the list have witnessed the ups and downs of China's economy. On the 2012 list of China's richest people, some are still at the forefront, while others have quietly fallen; there are those who are struggling, and there are also those who are ready to make progress. Behind the rise and fall of the wealth of the rich, we have witnessed the evolution of China's wealth pattern from one aspect.

b705f20b4247a01a33041128f9f7c4cad65b6ced.translatedText: The "bears" in the stock market dominate the world, and the wealth of the rich has shrunk

647beff81f1a3241754f5eea466bb69c5fb1e562.sourceText: 在２０１２年３月份公布的福布斯”全球富豪榜中”，去年风头正劲的中国富豪们风光不再，中国富豪的上榜人数从去年的１１５人减少为９５名。同时，今年共１１７名富豪跌落全球富豪榜，其中有４０名来自中国，占比超过三分之一，这是”中国富豪近年来首次成为该榜的输家”。
647beff81f1a3241754f5eea466bb69c5fb1e562.translatedText: In the Forbes "World's Richest List" released in March 2012, the Chinese rich who were in the limelight last year are no longer in glory, and the number of Chinese rich on the list has dropped from 115 last year to 95. At the same time, a total of 117 rich people fell off the global rich list this year, 40 of whom are from China, accounting for more than one-third. This is "the first time in recent years that Chinese rich people have become losers on the list."

c419ba7258e55884e8fb1c605f5c121d995319c1.sourceText: 福布斯全球富豪榜是由个人或家族净资产１０亿美元以上的富豪组成的榜单，尽管今年中国富豪的数量有所下降，上榜的富豪总数却在上升。２０１０年共有１０１１人上榜，２０１１年达到１２１０人，增速接近１０％。尽管２０１２年受制于全球经济欠佳，但是富豪数仍然增至１２２６人。两组富豪人数的一减一增，凸显了中国富豪的失落。
c419ba7258e55884e8fb1c605f5c121d995319c1.translatedText: The Forbes Global Rich List is a list of rich people with a personal or family net worth of more than US$1 billion. Although the number of rich people in China has declined this year, the total number of rich people on the list is rising. A total of 1,011 people were on the list in 2010, and the number reached 1,210 in 2011, a growth rate of nearly 10%. Despite the poor global economy in 2012, the number of wealthy people still increased to 1,226. The number of rich people in the two groups decreased and increased, highlighting the loss of China's rich.

0185a42d200fb94d862990eedaaa629db4d40511.sourceText: 下半年先后发布的两份”中国富豪榜”显示，中国富豪的缩水仍在继续。对于今年福布斯榜上排名最靠前的１００位中国富豪来说，他们的总资产较去年缩水７％，降至２２００亿美元。而在统计量更庞大的”胡润百富榜”上，２０１２年上榜的中国富豪平均财富比去年下跌了８．５％，降至５４亿元。而且，今年有４６９位富豪财富缩水，财富暴跌５０％以上的有３７人。
0185a42d200fb94d862990eedaaa629db4d40511.translatedText: The two "China Rich Lists" released in the second half of the year show that the shrinkage of China's rich continues. For the top 100 Chinese billionaires on this year's Forbes list, their total assets shrank by 7% from last year, to US$220 billion. On the "Hurun Rich List", which has a larger statistical volume, the average wealth of China's richest people on the list in 2012 fell by 8.5% from last year to 5.4 billion yuan. Moreover, 469 rich people have seen their wealth shrink this year, and 37 people have seen their wealth plummet by more than 50%.

16a7ed5c50f0ae6b07b86fb066d9954002361e70.sourceText: 由于近两年中国内地股市下跌幅度较大，目前尚未明显回暖，所以导致中国上榜富豪财富缩水。但是，富豪的”抗跌性”明显高于市场，在２０１２年福布斯发布”中国富豪榜”时，与上一年发布榜单时相比，上证综指下跌了约２０％，和这个数字比起来，无论是下降７％还是８．５％都算不错的成绩。
16a7ed5c50f0ae6b07b86fb066d9954002361e70.translatedText: As the stock market in mainland China has fallen sharply in the past two years and has not yet recovered significantly, the wealth of China's richest people on the list has shrunk. However, the "resilience" of the rich is significantly higher than that of the market. When Forbes released the "China Rich List" in 2012, the Shanghai Composite Index fell by about 20% compared with the previous year when the list was released. Compared with this number, whether it is a 7% or 8.5% decline, it is considered a good result.

5820442a8cfe85c0bb16dbbea301df5beee49289.sourceText: 房地产风光渐淡 新能源集体折戟
5820442a8cfe85c0bb16dbbea301df5beee49289.translatedText: The popularity of real estate is fading, and new energy has collectively suffered a setback

f32443a86adf65e130dfb991e3463aeefd1f91d7.sourceText: ２０１２年虽然浮沉变迁，但中国的财富榜上，房地产还是主角之一。在”胡润百富榜”上，前１５名中来自房地产行业的富豪人数达９位，比去年还多２位。在福布斯榜单上，虽然上榜富豪排名有所不同，但进入前１０名的有一半来自房地产行业。
f32443a86adf65e130dfb991e3463aeefd1f91d7.translatedText: Although there have been ups and downs in 2012, real estate is still one of the protagonists on China's wealth list. On the "Hurun Rich List", there are 9 rich people from the real estate industry among the top 15, 2 more than last year. On the Forbes list, although the rankings of the richest people on the list vary, half of the top 10 are from the real estate industry.

5b452b69df8600cad30e2830ad561bc01678443e.sourceText: 如果将时间跨度拉长，１０年内共有４３名富豪持续登上福布斯中国富豪榜，其中有２１名富豪受益于房地产业。毫无疑问，房地产业是过去１０年造富能力最强的行业。
5b452b69df8600cad30e2830ad561bc01678443e.translatedText: If the time span is extended, a total of 43 rich people have continued to appear on the Forbes China Rich List in the past 10 years, of which 21 rich people have benefited from the real estate industry. There is no doubt that the real estate industry has been the industry with the strongest ability to create wealth in the past 10 years.

b5a7e89999fdd2f9745b72997c3579742be63508.sourceText: 但是，在持续严厉的房地产调控政策下，近年来房地产在富豪榜上的地位已经缓步下滑。在今年的两大中国富豪榜上，房地产业均未占据”头把交椅”。２０１２年胡润百富榜显示，前５０位地产富豪平均财富比去年下降５．２％，比５年前减少１７．４％；不仅如此，２０１２年房地产业的入榜富豪数占总数的１９．８％，而十年前这一比例为５０％。
b5a7e89999fdd2f9745b72997c3579742be63508.translatedText: However, under the continued strict real estate control policies, the status of real estate on the rich list has slowly declined in recent years. In this year's two major lists of China's richest people, the real estate industry did not occupy the "top spot". The 2012 Hurun Rich List shows that the average wealth of the top 50 real estate tycoons dropped by 5.2% from last year and 17.4% from five years ago. Not only that, the number of rich people in the real estate industry accounted for 19.8% of the total in 2012, compared with 50% ten years ago.

6a6a52711908360c78b493901168046c65ef3a91.sourceText: 和房地产的”稳中有降”相比，新能源行业则是快速经历了大起大落，尤其是太阳能、风能等产业遭受了极大的冲击。
6a6a52711908360c78b493901168046c65ef3a91.translatedText: Compared with the "stable but declining" real estate industry, the new energy industry has experienced rapid ups and downs, especially solar energy, wind energy and other industries have suffered a huge impact.

97fcf9d5c29ddf8481c48c909477800115c7e8ba.sourceText: 在２０１２的福布斯中国富豪榜上，向日葵的吴建龙、拓日新能的陈五奎、京运通的冯焕培夫妇、超日太阳能的倪开禄、尚德电力的施正荣、吉鑫科技的包士金、华锐风电的韩俊良等在中国新能源领域叱咤风云的人物，纷纷跌出了榜单。同样，”胡润百富榜”上的太阳能产业也成了”重灾区”，吴建龙财富下降６９％，倪开禄、倪娜父女财富下降５９％。２００８年施正荣以２１５亿元排名第八，今年财富仅３０亿元。
97fcf9d5c29ddf8481c48c909477800115c7e8ba.translatedText: In the 2012 Forbes China Rich List, Wu Jianlong of Sunflower, Chen Wukui of Tuori New Energy, Feng Huanpei and his wife of Beijing Express, Ni Kailu of Chaori Solar, Shi Zhengrong of Suntech Power, Bao Shijin of Jixin Technology, Han Junliang of Sinovel Wind Power and other powerful figures in China's new energy field have all fallen off the list. Similarly, the solar energy industry on the "Hurun Rich List" has also become the "hardest hit area", with Wu Jianlong's wealth falling by 69%, and the wealth of Ni Kailu and Ni Na's father and daughter falling by 59%. In 2008, Shi Zhengrong ranked eighth with 21.5 billion yuan. This year, his wealth is only 3 billion yuan.

10bde91c22a0a3e792d273aa7f1d3f330613f217.sourceText: 业内人士分析，中国太阳能光伏业前几年成为产业明星，曾创造了无数的”造富神话”，而尴尬的是，周期性因素、盲目扩张产能、对外依存度过大，加上日益增加的与欧美的贸易摩擦，使其风光不再。
10bde91c22a0a3e792d273aa7f1d3f330613f217.translatedText: Industry insiders analyze that China’s solar photovoltaic industry has become an industry star in the past few years and has created countless “wealth-making myths.” However, embarrassingly, cyclical factors, blind expansion of production capacity, excessive dependence on foreign countries, and increasing trade frictions with Europe and the United States have made it no longer in glory.

9e243eef0a20b607cb692beb4a1e3988bc93e48a.sourceText: 近日来，政府对新能源的扶持政策频频出台，表达了对新能源未来发展的信心。短期来看对新能源行业的复苏会有所帮助，但新能源要发展成为利国富民的产业，还有待市场的检验。 制造企业逐步回归 文化娱乐业渐成新贵
9e243eef0a20b607cb692beb4a1e3988bc93e48a.translatedText: In recent days, the government has frequently introduced policies to support new energy, expressing its confidence in the future development of new energy. In the short term, it will be helpful to the recovery of the new energy industry, but the development of new energy into an industry that benefits the country and enriches the people has yet to be tested by the market. Manufacturing companies are gradually returning and the cultural and entertainment industry is gradually becoming an upstart

6fb4199cbd04ec488aa340e3b3d55c68d9f2bade.sourceText: ２０１２年胡润富豪榜最引人关注的是，制造业超过房地产业成为贡献富豪最多的行业，制造业富豪数量占比２０．５％，比房地产富豪数量多出０．７个百分点。
6fb4199cbd04ec488aa340e3b3d55c68d9f2bade.translatedText: > The most eye-catching thing about the 2012 Hurun Rich List is that manufacturing surpassed the real estate industry to become the industry that contributed the most rich people. The number of manufacturing rich people accounted for 20.5%, which was 0.7 percentage points more than the number of real estate rich people.

7ff7e9b2bcd336a35d158d204c7f9de9aa921628.sourceText: 数据显示，在２０１２年中国５００强企业中，有２７２家来自实体领域的企业，营业收入占到了５００强的４３％，但是利润只占２５％。业内人士认为，在实体经济回归的大环境下，制造业富豪数量的上升是一个积极信号。
7ff7e9b2bcd336a35d158d204c7f9de9aa921628.translatedText: Data show that among China's top 500 companies in 2012, there were 272 companies from the real field. Their operating income accounted for 43% of the top 500 companies, but their profits only accounted for 25%. Industry insiders believe that in the context of the return of the real economy, the increase in the number of manufacturing tycoons is a positive signal.

959e769894aedd925afe19b7521479138c562528.sourceText: 中国富豪榜中透露出另一个重要特点是传媒、文化、娱乐行业的大幅增长。王健林的万达收购全球排名第二的美国ＡＭＣ影院公司就是一个很好的例子。
959e769894aedd925afe19b7521479138c562528.translatedText: Another important feature revealed in China's rich list is the substantial growth of the media, culture, and entertainment industries. Wang Jianlin's Wanda's acquisition of the American AMC Cinema Company, which ranks second in the world, is a good example.

869b91253351bfd0b9cadaad812f588554170727.sourceText: ”这说明中国近十年经济社会大发展，已经到了文化繁荣的阶段，莫言获得诺贝尔文学奖也反映了这种趋势。”福布斯上海分社社长范鲁贤认为，未来文化产业将是中国资本市场上的新亮点。
869b91253351bfd0b9cadaad812f588554170727.translatedText: "This shows that China has experienced great economic and social development in the past ten years and has reached a stage of cultural prosperity. Mo Yan's winning of the Nobel Prize in Literature also reflects this trend." Fan Luxian, president of Forbes Shanghai Branch, believes that the cultural industry will be a new bright spot in China's capital market in the future.

40e32b02d1598c9e55e9782d44e40b1be50aa231.sourceText: 新闻现场：两位华人在凤凰城遇到的不公（图）
40e32b02d1598c9e55e9782d44e40b1be50aa231.translatedText: News scene: The injustice encountered by two Chinese in Phoenix (picture)

73ed029d13c029681a331f514601679eff57ad25.sourceText: 新闻现场：两位华人在凤凰城遇到的不公（图） （安心来稿）7月25日，好不容易给自己放了一天假,想就此一天好…
73ed029d13c029681a331f514601679eff57ad25.translatedText: News scene: The injustice encountered by two Chinese in Phoenix (picture) (Contributed by An Xin) On July 25th, I finally gave myself a day off. I wanted to take this day off...

dd9236f3b167b82aab66f05c80b789fa8477282f.sourceText: （安心来稿）7月25日，好不容易给自己放了一天假,想就此一天好好地放松放松,也在繁忙的工作之余享受惬意的美国生活。我便和老公一大早开始准备，吃过早餐穿戴一新后，我们便驾车前往名牌打折店outlets购物中心游玩,我们给小孙女买了几件物美价廉的衣服,两个人的心情都很愉悦,这样和老公牵手逛街的日子毕竟不多,不知不觉我们已逛到中午,感觉肚子有点饿了,准备吃点东西后再继续逛,今天打算满载而归.
dd9236f3b167b82aab66f05c80b789fa8477282f.translatedText: (Contributed by An Xin) On July 25, I finally gave myself a day off. I wanted to take this day off to relax and enjoy the pleasant American life after busy work. My husband and I started getting ready early in the morning. After having breakfast and dressing up, we drove to the famous brand discount store outlets shopping mall to play. We bought some high-quality and cheap clothes for our little granddaughter. Both of us were in a happy mood. After all, we didn’t have many days of shopping hand in hand with my husband. I don’t know why. We felt that we had gone shopping until noon, and felt a little hungry. We planned to eat something before continuing our shopping. We planned to return home with a full load today.

dde2a5b8310e5a925983c92ba44ea06abdcb1a91.sourceText: 随后,我们便兴致勃勃地到VILLA 买披萨,准备享受一顿意大利美食后再继续逛街.谁料,一个个子高大的服务生将一盘冷冰冰地披萨给我后,就不屑地走开了.我用不太流利的英文说,请帮忙在烤箱里加热一下.他也没说什么,随手将披萨放在一个不太显眼的地方,但很显然,他并没有放进烤箱.一会儿,他将披萨递给我,指着不远处的厕所对我说,Restroom,Restroom.说完，和另一个服务生哈哈大笑。
dde2a5b8310e5a925983c92ba44ea06abdcb1a91.translatedText: After that, we happily went to VILLA I bought pizza and planned to enjoy an Italian meal before continuing shopping. Unexpectedly, a tall waiter handed me a plate of cold pizza and walked away with disdain. I said in less fluent English, please help heat it in the oven. He didn’t say anything, and just His hand placed the pizza in a less conspicuous place, but it was obvious that he did not put it in the oven. After a while, he handed the pizza to me, pointed to the toilet not far away and said to me, Restroom, Restroom. After saying that, he laughed with another waiter.

91214a2588c45def6f7d2090438adb929275bbf0.sourceText: 我顿时惊呆了,我当时并没有问他厕所在哪，难道吃披萨要到厕所去吃吗？我不敢相信这是在美国，我想我一个快60岁的中国女人,在美国辛苦地工作,合理地交税,英语再不好,也不至于受这种侮辱和歧视.我感觉自己的人格受到了极其的侮辱和伤害,我和我丈夫不依了,便和他理论,他气焰很嚣张,噼噼啪啪用英文大说一通,看我们不说话,见我老公拿手机在那拍照，他躲到一边不让拍，没多大一会竟然理直气壮地叫来了保安. 恶人还先告状.这一下我们更来气了,我们想据理力争,但苦于英文不好,没办法,只好通过电话找朋友的女儿帮忙翻译,我们将事情的经过一五一十地告诉了保安.这一下,服务生傻眼了，站在那里说不出话来.
91214a2588c45def6f7d2090438adb929275bbf0.translatedText: I was shocked. I didn’t ask him where the toilet was. Do I have to go to the toilet to eat pizza? I can't believe this is in the United States. I think that as a Chinese woman who is almost 60 years old, I work hard in the United States and pay taxes reasonably. No matter how good my English is, I will not suffer such insults and discrimination. I feel that my personality has been extremely insulted and hurt. My husband and I refused to comply, so we argued with him. He was very arrogant and spoke loudly in English. Seeing that we didn't talk, when I saw my husband taking pictures with his mobile phone, he hid aside to prevent me from taking pictures. After a while, he confidently called the security guard. The villain complained first. Now we were even more angry. We wanted to argue, but because our English was not good, we had no choice but to ask our friend's daughter to help translate over the phone. We told the security guard exactly what happened. At this time, the waiter was dumbfounded and stood up. I was speechless there.

27183e96e330befd74bd22230a64016b454cdd0e.sourceText: 保安了解了事情的真相后,首先就给我们赔礼道歉,然后要那个高个子的服务生给我们赔礼,这家伙很不真诚很不情愿地说了一声:I am sorry.
27183e96e330befd74bd22230a64016b454cdd0e.translatedText: After the security guard learned the truth of the matter, he first apologized to us, and then asked the tall waiter to apologize to us. This guy said very insincerely and reluctantly: I am sorry.

b5abc9ed84f893fc9d8c75f160d1d5b71ddfafc2.sourceText: 好好的心情就这样给破坏掉了，我们非常生气，坚持把付单的披萨退掉后，悻悻然地开车回家了。回家几天后，心情好久都缓和不过来，我一直在想一个问题：平常总是见到很多热石心肠的好人，这次怎么碰到一个这么明目张胆地侮辱我的人？美国不是追求民主、自由、平等吗？他让我一个活生生的人到厕所去吃披萨到底是什么意思？这是我头一遭在美国来碰到这样的事。
b5abc9ed84f893fc9d8c75f160d1d5b71ddfafc2.translatedText: >The good mood was ruined like this. We were very angry. After insisting on returning the pizza we paid for, we drove home angrily. After returning home for a few days, I couldn't calm down for a long time. I kept thinking about a question: I usually meet many kind-hearted people, but why did I meet someone who insulted me so blatantly this time? Doesn’t the United States pursue democracy, freedom, and equality? What did he mean by asking me, a living person, to go to the bathroom and eat pizza? This is the first time I have encountered such a thing in the United States.

dd51be726e529dbd51a388255920c426d650967c.sourceText: 写此文就是想提醒在美国的华人朋友，再碰到这样的事情一定要多留个心眼。不能合法地交了税还受这样的人格侮辱，人要活得有尊严，不管生活在什么地方。如果您对这个新闻有更多评论请留言：
dd51be726e529dbd51a388255920c426d650967c.translatedText: I write this article to remind Chinese friends in the United States that they must be more careful when encountering such a thing again. You cannot pay taxes legally and still suffer such personal insults. People must live with dignity, no matter where they live. If you have more comments about this news please leave a message:

b04536f8029bf7f6b780dd932d98fab1c5617ec1.sourceText: 北京11月27日电 (见习记者 杨月) 近日，美国务院教育和文化事务局与美国国际教育研究所(IIE：Institute of International Education)发布了《2014美国门户开放报告》。该报告发布前一周，美国表示对华学生签证有效期将延长至5年，商业签证延长至10年。中澳也已完成了关于”打工度假安排(WHA)的谈判”，将每年向中国提供5000个打工签证名额。利好政策一出，激起中国留学界千层浪。 专业选择 数学与计算机成新宠 跟张濛联系的时候，她正在从公司回家的路上。在耶鲁大学计算机系毕业后，张濛在美国一家世界500强企业做软件开发工作。她在北京邮电大学读本科时就萌发了赴美读研的想法：”美国计算机类技术世界领先，而且计算机专业就业相对容易。”后来的就业经历也证实了张濛的预期，”我们班里有20个同学，绝大多数都来自印度和中国，毕业后几乎都留在美国就业了，平均年薪大约9万美元。” 《2014美国门户开放报告》显示，经济与管理、工程、数学与计算机是国际学生人数最多的三个专业，与2013年相比，攻读数学与计算机专业的人数涨幅最大，增长了17.9%，总人数91000余人。 北京嘉华世达国际教育交流有限公司美国项目部副总监戴丽丽表示，数学与计算机专业明显升温，主要有两方面原因：一是美国计算机应用与创新和学术研究方面都非常突出。二是在美国的就业市场上，计算机专业学生一直很受欢迎，特别是中国、印度的理工科学生都比较优秀，是美国公司的重点招聘对象，”今后如果想在美国就业或移民，计算机专业是很好的选择。” 戴丽丽建议。 点击图片查看下一页
b04536f8029bf7f6b780dd932d98fab1c5617ec1.translatedText: Beijing, November 27th (Trainee Reporter Yang Yue) Recently, the U.S. Department of State’s Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs and the Institute of International Education (IIE: Institute of International Education) released the 2014 U.S. Open Doors Report. A week before the report was released, the United States said it would extend the validity of student visas to China to five years and business visas to 10 years. China and Australia have also completed negotiations on the "Working Holiday Arrangement (WHA)" and will provide China with 5,000 working visa quotas every year. As soon as the favorable policies came out, it caused a stir in the Chinese study-abroad community. Major Choice Mathematics and Computers Become New Favorites When I contacted Zhang Meng, she was on her way home from the company. After graduating from the Department of Computer Science at Yale University, Zhang Meng worked in software development for a Fortune 500 company in the United States. When she was an undergraduate at Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, she came up with the idea of studying in the United States: "The United States leads the world in computer technology, and it is relatively easy to find a job in computer science." Later employment experience also confirmed Zhang Meng's expectations, "There are 20 classmates in our class, most of whom are from India and China. After graduation, almost all stayed in the United States to work, with an average annual salary of about US$90,000." The "2014 U.S. Open Doors Report" shows that economics and management, engineering, and mathematics and computer science are the three majors with the largest number of international students. Compared with 2013, the number of people majoring in mathematics and computer science has increased the most, an increase of 17.9%, with a total number of more than 91,000 students. Dai Lili, deputy director of the American Project Department of Beijing Jiahua Shida International Education Exchange Co., Ltd., said that the popularity of mathematics and computer majors has increased significantly, mainly for two reasons: First, the United States is very outstanding in computer application and innovation and academic research. Second, in the U.S. job market, computer majors have always been very popular. In particular, science and engineering students from China and India are relatively outstanding and are the key recruitment targets of American companies. "If you want to work or immigrate to the United States in the future, computer majors are a good choice." Dai Lili suggested. Click on the picture to view the next page

34914a7698bf690f8d3f7195f863644fcdb49451.sourceText: 2013、2014年留学生人数对比 攻读数学与计算机专业Tips: 1.专业：数学与计算机专业所要求的数理能力、专业技能比较高，选择时需量力而行。 2.学校：计算机专业在多家美国大学均有开设，选择学校应重点考虑实际课程及就业情况，不能只顾大学的综合排名。 3.申请：近年计算机专业申请难度有所增加，可考虑先上其他专业，后转到计算机专业。 4.课程：如果非计算机背景的学生，需要注意一下申请会有先修课程要求，如果都没学过，那录取的可能性就会很小。 签证政策虽利好 名校依然傲娇 ”以前，申请美国学生签证最长只有1年，所以我在每年假期回国之后，都很担心签证1年有效期截止。”留学美国加州大学的李恒睿说。因此，很多学生一回国就要着手准备返签流程。”我们有些同学为了避免准备返签材料，会选择提早返回美国，挺郁闷的。” 因此，随着新政策的出炉，学生假期回国后无需再担心签证失效。但戴丽丽接受记者采访时表示，学生放弃美国的主要原因大都在于美国的申请要求比较高，而非签证难，”美国的签证率一直都不错，所以签证对于学生人数上的增长变化有待进一步的观察。” 据记者梳理，美国私立大学近年来整体入学人数呈减少态势，有三分之一以上的学校跌幅在5%以上。2012至2013学年被美国高等教育机构录取的中国学生人数从19.4万增加到23.56万，增幅达21%。U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement(联邦移民和海关执法局)报告称，中国留学生占全美国际留学生的比例约为29%，人数超过来自欧洲、南美、非洲、澳大利亚以及北美其他地区的留学生总和，中国留学生已成为美国的最主要生源地之一。
34914a7698bf690f8d3f7195f863644fcdb49451.translatedText: Comparison of the number of international students in 2013 and 2014 Tips for studying mathematics and computer majors: 1. Major: Mathematics and computer majors require relatively high mathematical abilities and professional skills, so you need to choose based on your ability. 2. School: Computer science majors are offered in many American universities. When choosing a school, you should focus on the actual courses and employment situation, not just the overall ranking of the university. 3. Application: In recent years, the difficulty of applying for computer majors has increased. You may consider studying other majors first and then switching to computer majors. 4. Courses: If you are a student with a non-computer background, you need to note that there are prerequisite course requirements when applying. If you have not studied any courses, the possibility of admission will be very small. Although the visa policy is favorable, prestigious schools are still proud of themselves. “In the past, the maximum time to apply for a U.S. student visa was one year, so when I returned to China during the holidays every year, I was worried about the expiration of the one-year visa validity period,” said Li Hengrui, who studied at the University of California in the United States. Therefore, many students must prepare for the return visa process as soon as they return to their country. "Some of our students will choose to return to the United States early to avoid preparing return visa materials, which is quite depressing." Therefore, with the introduction of the new policy, students no longer need to worry about visa expiration after returning to the country during the holidays. However, Dai Lili said in an interview with a reporter that the main reason why students give up the United States is that the application requirements in the United States are relatively high rather than the difficulty of obtaining a visa. "The visa rate in the United States has always been good, so the impact of visas on the growth of the number of students needs further observation." According to the reporter, the overall enrollment of private universities in the United States has been decreasing in recent years, and more than one-third of the schools have experienced a decrease of more than 5%. The number of Chinese students admitted to U.S. higher education institutions increased from 194,000 to 235,600 in the 2012-2013 academic year, an increase of 21%. The U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (Federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement) report states that Chinese students account for approximately 29% of the international students in the United States. Their number exceeds the total number of international students from Europe, South America, Africa, Australia, and other parts of North America. Chinese students have become one of the main sources of students in the United States.

bc63210898c28c0c1e51fd287299520659aea45e.sourceText: ”虽然中国留学生是美国大学的重要收入来源，但美国高端本科名校的大门会越来越难进。?’西奈山国际教育副总经理张立军说。美国《华尔街日报》称，在美国8所常春藤大学中，有7所表示今年秋季的录取率将有所降低，其中哈佛大学的录取率最低，平均每年申请就读哈佛大学本科的人数超过3万人，录取率只有不到6%。 读名校Tips： 1.时间：尽早进行申请咨询，预留充足的时间进行申请材料准备和语言考试，并且更加有针对性地开展相关实践活动，以应对美国名校可能提出的更高录取要求。 2.选择：美国大学对中国籍学生的录取名额有限，哈佛、耶鲁、普林斯顿、麻省理工等名校每年录取中国本科学生几乎都在10人以内，录取比例不超过千分之一，因此最好分散”押宝”，不能全把眼光聚积在几所大学上。 亚利桑那州立大学 中国留学生”巨多” ”感觉亚利桑那这边，中国留学生不是一般的多啊!”百度亚利桑那州立大学吧热议的话题，好多都跟中国留学生住宿问题、换专业问题相关。根据今年的报告，亚利桑那州立大学的留学生涨幅最大，达30.7%。戴丽丽表示，现在中国学生是很多美国大学的留学生主力，因此，很多学校调整政策，扩大招收的规模，”根据我们的经验，这所学校确实相对较容易申请。” 此外，加利福尼亚、纽约、德克萨斯、马塞诸塞和伊利诺伊是国际学生热衷的大学区域选择前五名，该排位表与2013学年一致。十所国际学生人数最多的美国大学分别为：纽约大学，南加州大学，伊利诺伊大学厄本那-香槟分校，哥伦比亚大学，普渡大学，加州大学洛杉矶分校，西北大学，亚利桑那州立大学，密歇根州立大学，华盛顿大学。 申请亚利桑那州立大学Tips： 1.分数：工科本科TOEFL要求79分，大部分专业要求SAT阅读+写作1160分以上;工科研究生院GRE(quant): 718分，GRE (analyt): 631分;商科本科 TOEFL要求 61分，大部分正常专业要求SAT阅读+写作1160分以上;商科研究生院 Average GMAT 要求680分。 2.申请日期：工科研究生院申请截止日期：2月28日;商科研究生院申请截止日期：5月1日。
bc63210898c28c0c1e51fd287299520659aea45e.translatedText: "Although Chinese international students are an important source of income for American universities, it will become more and more difficult to enter the gates of high-end undergraduate universities in the United States." said Zhang Lijun, deputy general manager of Mount Sinai International Education. The Wall Street Journal stated that 7 of the 8 Ivy League universities in the United States said that their admission rates will decrease this fall. Among them, Harvard University has the lowest admission rate. On average, more than 30,000 people apply to study at Harvard University every year, and the admission rate is less than 6%. Tips for studying at prestigious schools: 1. Time: Conduct application consultation as early as possible, reserve sufficient time for application material preparation and language examination, and carry out relevant practical activities in a more targeted manner to cope with the higher admission requirements that prestigious American schools may impose. 2. Choice: The admission quota for Chinese students in American universities is limited. Harvard, Yale, Princeton, MIT and other prestigious universities admit almost no more than 10 Chinese undergraduate students every year, and the admission rate does not exceed one in a thousand. Therefore, it is best to spread your bets and not focus on a few universities. There are "huge" Chinese students at Arizona State University. "It feels like there are not so many Chinese students here in Arizona!" Many of the hot topics on Baidu's Arizona State University forum are related to the issue of accommodation and changing majors for Chinese students. According to this year's report, the number of international students at Arizona State University has increased by the largest amount, reaching 30.7%. Dai Lili said that Chinese students are now the mainstay of international students in many American universities, so many schools have adjusted their policies and expanded their enrollment. "Based on our experience, this school is indeed relatively easy to apply for." ” In addition, California, New York, Texas, Massachusetts and Illinois are the top five regional choices for international students. The ranking is consistent with the 2013 academic year. The ten American universities with the largest number of international students are: New York University, University of Southern California, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, Columbia University, Purdue University, University of California, Los Angeles, Northwestern University, Arizona State University, Michigan State University, and University of Washington. Tips for applying to Arizona State University: 1. Scores: Engineering undergraduate TOEFL requires 79 points, and most majors require SAT reading + writing of 1160 or above; engineering graduate school GRE (quant): 718 points, GRE (analyt): 631 points; business undergraduate TOEFL requires 61 points, most normal majors require SAT reading + writing of 1160 or above; business graduate school average GMAT requires 680 points. 2. Application date: Application deadline for the Graduate School of Engineering: February 28; Application deadline for the Graduate School of Business: May 1.
