ac6d301dccbfc3268be9beff4fa12ef6d198940e.translatedText: Stealing money and people? The three latest bills on high-tech and investment immigration

7064f2daab5b26fa69219f849ef77b9cbfd23f9e.sourceText: 抢钱又抢人？三项有关高技术及投资移民的最新议案 最近美国推出了一系列新议案，旨在鼓励外国投资者、企业家及最…
7064f2daab5b26fa69219f849ef77b9cbfd23f9e.translatedText: steal money and people? Three latest bills related to high-tech and investment immigration. Recently, the United States has introduced a series of new bills, aiming to encourage foreign investors, entrepreneurs and the most...

cf9d07308d0ee32f0f53564c7ec36387913ff6e2.sourceText: 最近美国推出了一系列新议案，旨在鼓励外国投资者、企业家及最优秀的人才继续留在美国以刺激美国经济、创造更多就业机会并追加投资，被大家戏称为”抢钱又抢人”。我所一直密切关注此类信息，以便紧跟形势为大家提供最完备的法律咨询服务。近日来，我所也接到不少询问这些政策走向的客户来电。本文将为大家主要概括并简要解释这些议案。
cf9d07308d0ee32f0f53564c7ec36387913ff6e2.translatedText: Recently, the United States has launched a series of new bills, aiming to encourage foreign investors, entrepreneurs and the best talents to stay in the United States to stimulate the U.S. economy, create more jobs and increase investment. It is jokingly called "robbing money and robbing people." Our firm has been paying close attention to such information in order to keep up with the situation and provide you with the most complete legal consulting services. In recent days, our firm has also received many calls from clients asking about the direction of these policies. This article will mainly summarize and briefly explain these proposals.

bf865fd31e08c32532c8049fc142acf3282405cf.sourceText: 议案一：Immigration Driving Entrepreneurship In America (IDEA) Act of 2011
bf865fd31e08c32532c8049fc142acf3282405cf.translatedText: Proposal 1: Immigration Driving Entrepreneurship In America (IDEA) Act of 2011

e2952fc2fc2d6a8457ba363de0b5f5e6c471eb45.sourceText: 首先，这一议案一旦通过将使理工科类高等学位拥有者获益。该议案倡议在EB-1，也就是一类移民优先之下，新设立一个类别，让从一流大学毕业的科学、技术、工程和数学学科类（STEM）高等学位（硕士或博士）的拥有人能通过这一新类别申请绿卡。然而，前提是该学位拥有人必须已获得工作机会并且其工资超过现行工资标准。同时，对于这些学位拥有人及符合当前EB-1b （杰出教授及研究人员）申请条件的申请人取消每年的配额限制。该立法案还倡导建立”双重意向”机制，以使得雇主在招聘留美外籍学生时无须先要求学生必须拥有H-1B身份或离境办理工作签证；并倡议给予已经申请绿卡的F或L签证持有人临时过渡签证。
e2952fc2fc2d6a8457ba363de0b5f5e6c471eb45.translatedText: First of all, once passed, this bill will benefit holders of advanced degrees in science and engineering. The bill proposes to create a new category under EB-1, the first category of immigrant preference, so that holders of advanced degrees (masters or doctoral degrees) in science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM) who graduated from top universities can apply for green cards through this new category. However, this is only if the degree holder has been offered a job and the salary exceeds the prevailing wage rate. At the same time, the annual quota limit will be lifted for these degree holders and applicants who meet the current EB-1b (outstanding professors and researchers) application conditions. The legislation also advocates the establishment of a "dual intention" mechanism so that when recruiting foreign students in the United States, employers do not need to first require students to have H-1B status or leave the country to apply for a work visa; it also advocates granting temporary transitional visas to F or L visa holders who have applied for a green card.

7d0aaa7310b24668399b6b4fda163c3af192c7eb.sourceText: 这一议案通过后也将惠及企业家。该议案倡议为两类企业家提供绿卡。第一类是从创业投资公司获得50万美金以上资助金额的企业家。他们将先获得为期两年的临时绿卡，两年后，如该企业能为美国公民创造三个全职工作机会并且新增一百万美元以上投资或新设立年收入在一百万美元以上的新企业，该企业家将拥有正式绿卡。第二类是已经在美国创业的企业家，对在美国创造三个全职工作机会的企业家颁发临时绿卡，两年后，若全职美国员工达到10人以上，该企业家将被授予正式绿卡。
7d0aaa7310b24668399b6b4fda163c3af192c7eb.translatedText: This bill will also benefit entrepreneurs after it is passed. The bill proposes providing green cards to two types of entrepreneurs. The first category is entrepreneurs who have received funding of more than US$500,000 from venture capital companies. They will first obtain a two-year temporary green card. After two years, if the enterprise can create three full-time jobs for U.S. citizens and add more than one million U.S. dollars in new investment or establish a new enterprise with an annual income of more than one million U.S. dollars, the entrepreneur will have a formal green card. The second category is for entrepreneurs who have already started a business in the United States. Temporary green cards will be issued to entrepreneurs who create three full-time jobs in the United States. After two years, if there are more than 10 full-time American employees, the entrepreneur will be granted a formal green card.

2a6c048d1ea5b189307f94134d99ae6e0338ac8f.sourceText: 这一议案还包括其他一系列诸如取消配额国别限制、简化申请流程的内容。接下来我们将介绍另一议案。
2a6c048d1ea5b189307f94134d99ae6e0338ac8f.translatedText: This bill also includes a series of other contents such as canceling country restrictions on quotas and simplifying the application process. Next we will introduce another motion.

b102e4bc77349ae3e0eae5936a37245194390da2.sourceText: 议案二：Fairness for High-Skilled Immigrants Act
b102e4bc77349ae3e0eae5936a37245194390da2.translatedText: Motion 2: Fairness for High-Skilled Immigrants Act

110891101e72f54da0017b27dd320c1c211f36bf.sourceText: 这一议案是由议员Chaffetz于今年9月22日提出的，该议案旨在于2015财政年度彻底取消职业移民的国别配额限制。10月27日通过口头表决，这一议案被交由众议院全体讨论。同时，议员Lofgren提出的有关三年过渡期的修正案被接受。接下来几周众议院将就这一议案进行辩论，本所将密切关注。
110891101e72f54da0017b27dd320c1c211f36bf.translatedText: This bill was proposed by Congressman Chaffetz on September 22 this year. This bill aims to completely eliminate national quota restrictions on employment-based immigrants in the 2015 fiscal year. On October 27, by voice vote, the bill was submitted to the full House of Representatives for discussion. At the same time, the amendment proposed by Councilor Lofgren regarding the three-year transition period was accepted. The House of Representatives will debate this bill in the coming weeks, and our firm will be watching closely.

ef15d7a4e2090f8e4ba4803c0a6d9013347b2a9e.sourceText: 议案三： Buy House and Get Green Card （买房拿绿卡）
ef15d7a4e2090f8e4ba4803c0a6d9013347b2a9e.translatedText: Bill 3: Buy House and Get Green Card (Buy a house and get a green card)

2bd0d5bc7f2811a14209eff83006c77e85afa442.sourceText: 这一议案尚未正式提出，不过根据议员Schumer和Lee的提议，投资50万美元在美国购买房产就可以得到每3年更新一次的居留签证绿卡。申请者可以用全部资金购买一套房，也可以花25万美元购买一处住宅，把剩下的资金投资其他房产。不过购房只能用现金，不可以抵押贷款或房屋净值贷款。另外，除非通过传统途径获得工作签证，这一”绿卡”持有者将无法在美国工作，同时，他每年将必须住在美国的家里超过180天，并支付任何国际收入的美国所得税。
2bd0d5bc7f2811a14209eff83006c77e85afa442.translatedText: This bill has not yet been formally proposed, but according to the proposal of Congressmen Schumer and Lee, if you invest US$500,000 in buying real estate in the United States, you can get a green card with a residence visa that is renewed every three years. Applicants can use all the money to buy a house, or they can spend $250,000 to buy a home and invest the remaining money in other properties. However, the home can only be purchased with cash, not a mortgage or home equity loan. In addition, unless a work visa is obtained through traditional channels, this "green card" holder will not be able to work in the United States. At the same time, he will have to live in his home in the United States for more than 180 days per year and pay U.S. income tax on any international income.

35a80ff93e208ec418340cfbbc43e962d358d54b.sourceText: 请注意，这些议案距全体表决、成为最终立法仍遥遥无期。但如此活跃的议案活动却反映出美国政界、商界对外国人才、投资的渴求。 这无疑会对高端移民制造了更宽松的大环境。
35a80ff93e208ec418340cfbbc43e962d358d54b.translatedText: Please note that these bills are still far away from being voted on by the whole body and becoming final legislation. However, such active bill activities reflect the desire of American political and business circles for foreign talents and investment. This will undoubtedly create a more relaxed environment for high-end immigrants.

d089c92d0b09f2cef14901e4e8e89e8193ada210.sourceText: 罗省甄氏宗亲周日户外同乐
d089c92d0b09f2cef14901e4e8e89e8193ada210.translatedText: Clan members of the Zhen family in Luo Province had fun together outdoors on Sunday

9c52509bed9bb81f10a7851a115b447f5a5a0721.sourceText: 罗省甄氏宗亲周日户外同乐 （亚省时报记者甄松伟蒙特利公园市报导） 8月12日罗省甄氏公所组织甄氏宗亲在蒙特利公…
9c52509bed9bb81f10a7851a115b447f5a5a0721.translatedText: Clan members of the Zhen family in Luo Province had fun together outdoors on Sunday (Reported by Alberta Times reporter Zhen Songwei in Monterey Park City) On August 12, the Zhen Clan Office in Luo Province organized a family gathering in Monterey...

6ec7f52e8906400a4a9326d1fe81819ff63b979a.sourceText: （亚省时报记者甄松伟蒙特利公园市报导） 8月12日罗省甄氏公所组织甄氏宗亲在蒙特利公园市嘉伟公共公园（Garvey Ranch Park)户外烧烤活动。 是日艳阳高照，炎热的天气就像宗亲们的热情一样高，上午10时，现任甄氏公所主席甄达腾，上届主席甄机文（Jimmy Gin)以及阿罕布拉市联合学区教育委员会 会员甄铭新（Robert L.Gin) 等十多位宗亲早已来到现场，把野炊烧烤所需的场地及用品准备好。 接着，宗亲们三三两两，扶老携幼陆续到达，大家兴高采烈，谈笑风生，互道家常，场面很是温馨热烈。 移民美国近三十年的甄德先生，特意带着在美国出生已就读中学的儿子前来，为的是让后辈不要忘记自己的根，让他在这里多听听乡音，认识在异国他乡的 叔伯辈，上任甄氏公所主席甄机文非常主动向这位甄氏后辈了​​解学习和学校情况，将自己在美生活几十年的经验与这位后辈交流。 刚刚移民来美不久的甄秀成也带着两个儿子前来， 也让他们在异国他乡认识我们甄氏的父老乡亲，听听他们在美国生活工作的故事，学习为人之道。 罗省甄氏公所已多次走出去，举办户外野炊联欢活动，每次都办得很成功，宗亲们也非常接受这种休闲惬意的户外活动。 甄氏公所已决定 9月23日在洛杉矶华埠举办中秋节联欢活动，初定明年3月9日在海运酒家举办春宴晚会。
6ec7f52e8906400a4a9326d1fe81819ff63b979a.translatedText: (Reported by Alberta Times reporter Zhen Songwei in Monterey Park City) On August 12, the Luo Zhen Family Office organized an outdoor barbecue event for the Zhen family members at Garvey Ranch Park in Monterey Park. The sun was shining brightly that day, and the hot weather was as high as the enthusiasm of the clan members. At 10 a.m., more than a dozen clan members including the current chairman of the Zhen Family Office, Zhen Datang, the previous chairman Zhen Jiwen (Jimmy Gin), and Alhambra Unified School District Education Committee member Zhen Mingxin (Robert L. Gin), had already arrived at the scene to prepare the venue and supplies for the picnic and barbecue. Then, the clan members arrived one after another in twos and threes, supporting the elderly and the young. Everyone was in high spirits, chatting and laughing, and talking to each other about their daily lives. The scene was very warm and lively. Mr. Zhen De, who has immigrated to the United States for nearly 30 years, specially brought his son who was born in the United States and has already attended middle school to come here, so that his descendants will not forget their roots, let him listen to the local accent here, and get to know his uncles in a foreign country. Zhen Jiwen, who was appointed as the chairman of the Zhen Family Office, took the initiative to learn about the study and school conditions of this descendant of the Zhen family, and communicated with him his decades of experience in living in the United States. Zhen Xiucheng, who had just immigrated to the United States, also came with his two sons, allowing them to get to know our Zhen family members in a foreign country, listen to their stories about living and working in the United States, and learn how to be a human being. The Zhen Family Office in Luo Province has gone out many times to hold outdoor picnics and gatherings. Each time it has been a success, and the clan members are very accepting of this leisurely and comfortable outdoor activity. Zhen's Office has decided to hold a Mid-Autumn Festival party in Los Angeles Chinatown on September 23, and has tentatively scheduled to hold a Spring Festival Gala at the Ocean Restaurant on March 9 next year.

7ed6bbe372f2daba22d90e6babf2d8066103ea21.sourceText: 文扬时评： 中国式的现代国家
7ed6bbe372f2daba22d90e6babf2d8066103ea21.translatedText: Wenyang Commentary: A Chinese-style modern country

5cbed9f5e1d9ebe64b762442cda438e9d6db146f.sourceText: 文扬时评： 中国式的现代国家 从历史看，人类社会发展成为今天这样一个以主权国家为单元的世界体系，是一个渐进…
5cbed9f5e1d9ebe64b762442cda438e9d6db146f.translatedText: Wenyang Commentary: A Chinese-style modern country From a historical perspective, the development of human society into today’s world system with sovereign states as its unit is a gradual process...

e2f26279ca1b72e9269f67701037a9187a08af6d.sourceText: 从历史看，人类社会发展成为今天这样一个以主权国家为单元的世界体系，是一个渐进演变的过程。
e2f26279ca1b72e9269f67701037a9187a08af6d.translatedText: From a historical perspective, the development of human society into today’s world system with sovereign states as its unit is a gradual evolution process.

d2e598226549d8cebcee4e8218e1aeea7cbe5448.sourceText: 虽然这个体系现在已基本成型，能建国的地方都已成立了统一制式的现代国家，大大小小近两百个国家共处一个地球。但关于现代国家的本质到底是什么，关于其内容、形式和应有的功能，还并不十分清晰，各个国家都各行其是地实践着各自的国家理念。
d2e598226549d8cebcee4e8218e1aeea7cbe5448.translatedText: Although this system has now basically taken shape, modern countries with a unified system have been established in places where countries can be established. Nearly two hundred countries, large and small, coexist on the same earth. However, it is not very clear what the nature of a modern state is, as well as its content, form and proper functions. Each country implements its own national ideals in its own way.

243baa07e48ffc87baa4f5bd5fc13e1efdd5e2c8.sourceText: 人们曾经相信，国家就是政治利益的集合体，只要确保政治制度实行民主化，实行全国普选、一人一票、政党轮替，其他问题都会自动得到解决。
243baa07e48ffc87baa4f5bd5fc13e1efdd5e2c8.translatedText: People once believed that the country was a collection of political interests. As long as the political system was democratized, national universal suffrage, one person, one vote, and political party rotation were implemented, other problems would be automatically solved.

9f84a4932606bcca5403223d9a7d1394f820246f.sourceText: 源自于启蒙的这个观念，经过两三百年的实践，在今天已遭遇到了越来越多的质疑。
9f84a4932606bcca5403223d9a7d1394f820246f.translatedText: This concept originated from the Enlightenment, and after two to three hundred years of practice, it has encountered more and more doubts today.

86f7be57edeceadb7d9be73c72e845434227a1fa.sourceText: 实行了民主的西方国家，对外却实行强权专制。资本的意志不受任何约束，贪婪无度的巧取豪夺令世界严重分化、四分五裂、冲突四起。当政治权力体现为对外霸权，以分权为本质的民主也就演变成了全民分赃。
86f7be57edeceadb7d9be73c72e845434227a1fa.translatedText: Western countries that have implemented democracy have implemented powerful dictatorships externally. The will of capital is not subject to any restraint, and its greedy and unbridled plunder has caused the world to be severely divided, fragmented, and conflict-ridden. When political power is reflected as external hegemony, democracy with decentralization as its essence also evolves into sharing the spoils among all the people.

bc2e47eafe68eb56fd1bae23dd6825cf59756ab4.sourceText: 而在非西方国家中，众多希望通过照搬西方式民主而实现富强的穷国，结果却适得其反。国家原本就积贫积弱、频遭外国侵犯，靠中央集权和精英治国尚且不能保证一定能够自立自强，移植了分权和民主制度后正好成全了外国势力的插手介入。原本应该体现本民族利益的主权国家，结果成了外国利益的总代理。
bc2e47eafe68eb56fd1bae23dd6825cf59756ab4.translatedText: Among non-Western countries, many poor countries hope to become rich and powerful by copying Western-style democracy, but the results are counterproductive. The country was originally poor and weak, and was frequently invaded by foreign countries. Relying on centralized power and elite governance could not guarantee that it would be self-reliant and self-reliant. The transplantation of decentralized and democratic systems just facilitated the intervention of foreign forces. The sovereign state that was supposed to reflect the interests of its own nation ended up becoming the general agent of foreign interests.

dbc0140a4f934c9132ee6ca8ef9438044afba637.sourceText: 事情就是这样，全球范围愈演愈烈的贫富分化，令国家的本质受到质疑，令国家的功能遭遇挑战。再先进的政治制度，如果不能保障国家自立自强、免遭强国掠夺，就毫无意义。
dbc0140a4f934c9132ee6ca8ef9438044afba637.translatedText: That's what happened. The increasingly severe polarization between rich and poor around the world has questioned the nature of the country and challenged its functions. No matter how advanced a political system is, it is meaningless if it cannot ensure the country's self-reliance and self-reliance and protect it from plunder by powerful countries.

fdda68ed5db4d58a964a81af6aaaabcadfbf1122.sourceText: 而一个原本并不富强的国家，即使政治制度并不先进，只要找到了适合本国国情的发展之路，能够在激烈的国际竞争中不断取胜，逐步接近富强国家的水平，也就是一个成功的现代国家，也就等于是抓住了现代国家的本质。
fdda68ed5db4d58a964a81af6aaaabcadfbf1122.translatedText: A country that is not originally rich and powerful, even if its political system is not advanced, as long as it finds a development path suitable for its national conditions, can continue to win in fierce international competition, and gradually approach the level of a rich and powerful country, that is, it is a successful modern country, which is tantamount to grasping the essence of a modern country.

647e3c1fc72b08a171d84ac2faa7e0a1d349b5dd.sourceText: 这一点可以成为当今世界一个普遍的共识：在这个不平衡的、竞争性的、仍然遵从物竞天择规则的全球化时代，仅仅靠政治制度改革并不能解决国家发展的所有问题。而一旦放弃”政治挂帅”的迷信，丢掉意识形态的包袱，将虚幻的政治理想暂时搁置起来，反倒更容易看清楚一个国家所面对的真正问题是什么，更容易找出本国的道路在哪里，更容易快速地发展起来。
647e3c1fc72b08a171d84ac2faa7e0a1d349b5dd.translatedText: This can become a general consensus in the world today: In this unbalanced, competitive, and still abiding by the rules of natural selection globalization era, political system reform alone cannot solve all problems of national development. Once we give up the superstition of "politics in command", throw away the baggage of ideology, and temporarily shelve illusory political ideals, it will be easier to see clearly what the real problems a country faces are, to find out where the country is heading, and to develop quickly.

667840cf3e3952eb802bb0fab08267161be0aef1.sourceText: 这个道理，有些国家完全懂得，但它们不说，因为让所有人都明白这一点并不符合他们自己的利益。例如那几个一直为现代世界提供思想资源和理论基础的西方国家。
667840cf3e3952eb802bb0fab08267161be0aef1.translatedText: Some countries fully understand this truth, but they do not say it because it is not in their own interests to let everyone understand this. For example, those Western countries have always provided ideological resources and theoretical foundations for the modern world.

f4c005c855d1f54a2db89747da43d11cafd2b693.sourceText: 而已经在实践这个道理的国家，也是不说，因为即使是在这个道理的指引下取得了初步的成功，也还远远没有达到可以总结出成熟理论的程度，更没有达到可以将其宣称为普遍真理的程度。例如今天的中国。
f4c005c855d1f54a2db89747da43d11cafd2b693.translatedText: Countries that are already practicing this principle are not talking about it, because even if they have achieved initial success under the guidance of this principle, they are still far from the level where a mature theory can be summarized, let alone the level where it can be declared as a universal truth. Such as China today.

4050ce44604647cf11ca63d63fa2d0a21e183d93.sourceText: 从辛亥革命算起一百周年，从中华人民共和国算起六十二周年，这其中一以贯之的中国近代历史主题就是：完全中国式的现代国家的建国、富国和强国。
4050ce44604647cf11ca63d63fa2d0a21e183d93.translatedText: Counting the 100th anniversary from the Revolution of 1911 and the 62nd anniversary from the People's Republic of China, the consistent theme of China's modern history is: the founding, enrichment and power of a completely Chinese-style modern country.

a7698843df63c206f11e59b03d9facfc8663a855.sourceText: 国庆日前夕，我正好有机会走在中国大西北的土地上重新审看这个巨大的国家。从当年戈壁滩上”天当被子地当床”艰苦卓绝的屯垦戍边，到今天 ”乘清风以御阴阳”叱咤风云的天宫一号发射，中国人几乎从零开始的现代建国，已经堪称为一个史诗般的非凡伟业。
a7698843df63c206f11e59b03d9facfc8663a855.translatedText: On the eve of National Day, I had the opportunity to walk in the northwest of China and re-examine this huge country. From the arduous cultivation and border garrisoning in the Gobi Desert, where the sky was used as a quilt and the ground was used as a bed, to today's all-powerful launch of Tiangong-1, which is "riding the breeze to control the yin and yang", the Chinese people's modern nation-building almost from scratch has been called an epic and extraordinary achievement.

bcaef368f1e57d392729af1f42550f100f2f5d57.sourceText: 谨以此文庆祝中华人民共和国这个完全中国式的现代国家成立六十二周年。▊
bcaef368f1e57d392729af1f42550f100f2f5d57.translatedText: I would like to write this article to celebrate the 62nd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, a completely Chinese-style modern country. ▊

263cb5303e5776838876fab0c0026a6c79a47ef3.sourceText: 优胜美地国家公园上万人可能感染汉坦病毒 联邦疾病防治中心（CDC）警告说，北加州优胜美地国家公园（Yosemite National Park）今年夏天大约上万名游客有可能接触过致命的汉坦病毒（hantavirus）。 CDC星期五敦促6月到8月曾在优胜美地公园帐篷屋中住过、并出现同汉坦病毒感染相关病症的游客进行实验室测试，同时敦促医生向州卫生局报告相关病例。 作为全美家庭旅游的热门地点，优胜美地的帐篷屋正在带来公共健康危机：由该病毒引起的汉坦病毒肺综合症已经导致两名游客死亡。另外四名名患病的游客预计可以康复。CDC正在评估其它受到调查的可疑病例。 多数受害者都是曾经在最受欢迎的加里村（Curry Village）”品牌帐篷屋”（’Signature Tent Cabins’ ）住宿。CDC说，大约10000人曾经在6月10日到8月24日期间在?#21697;牌帐篷屋?#36807;夜。在那里感染汉坦病毒者大约6个星期出现类似肺炎的症状。 优胜美地官员在发现携带病毒的鹿鼠之后，上周已经关闭所有91所帐篷屋。那种鹿鼠会在地上挖出铅笔橡皮大小的洞，也能在墙壁之间做窝。公园当局星期五说，他们已经同大约3000个游客团组联系，建议他们一旦出现汉坦病毒症状立即就医。 优胜美地每年接纳全世界游客将近400万人，国家公园局官员正在考虑是否对外国也发出警告。 疾病的症状可在受感染六周后出现类似感冒的病症。它的死亡率高达30%，没有特效治疗。目前还没有出现人与人之间的传染。
263cb5303e5776838876fab0c0026a6c79a47ef3.translatedText: > Tens of thousands of people in Yosemite National Park may be infected with hantavirus. The federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) warns that in Yosemite National Park in Northern California (Yosemite National Park), tens of thousands of people may be infected with hantavirus. Tens of thousands of visitors to Yosemite Park may have been exposed to the deadly hantavirus this summer. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention on Friday urged visitors who stayed in tent houses at Yosemite Park from June to August and developed symptoms related to hantavirus infections to get lab tests and doctors to report the cases to the state health department. A popular destination for family vacations across the country, Yosemite’s tent cabins are creating a public health crisis: Two tourists have died from hantavirus pulmonary syndrome, and four other sick tourists are expected to recover. Most of the victims were at the popular ‘Signature Tent Cabins’ under investigation. ) accommodation. The CDC says about 10,000 people who stayed in tent houses overnight between June 10 and August 24 developed pneumonia-like symptoms for about six weeks. Yosemite officials closed all 91 tent houses last week after discovering the virus-carrying deer mice, which dig pencil-rubber-sized holes in the ground and make nests in walls. Park authorities said Friday that they had contacted about 3,000 groups of tourists and advised them to seek medical attention immediately if they showed symptoms of hantavirus. Yosemite, which welcomes nearly 4 million visitors from around the world each year, is considering whether to issue a warning to foreign countries as well. Symptoms of the disease can appear six weeks after infection. The mortality rate is as high as 30%, and there is no specific treatment for human-to-human transmission.

cf9e1715adc65d434619fa4bb1f8946f732c29da.sourceText: “海外青少年中华文化知识竞赛”凤凰城报名开始 【全美中文学校协会来稿】中国国务院侨办再次发起第三届海外华裔青少年中华文化知识竞赛，委托全美中文学校协会组织和承办在美国的比赛。自2007年以来，国侨办在世界范围内已经举办了两届海外华裔青少年中华文化知识竞赛，该比赛因规模大，规格高，已经获得了海外各国中文学校的广泛重视和千千万万华裔青少年的积极响应。 现在全美中文学校协会协会已经向分布全美国的四百多所会员学校发出报名通知。目前全美已经确定了三十多个考点。 亚利桑那州共有两个考点，分别在凤凰城和图桑市。凤凰城考点在三所中文学校设考场，分别是现代中文学校，希望中文学校，凤城华人基督教会中文学校。其中，凤城华人基督教会中文学校考场包括该校考生和凤凰城中文学校考生。 近日，凤凰城地区凤城华人基督教会中文学校李珍校长，现代中文学校中文组负责人沈颢瑾老师，希望中文学校董事会谢明，以及全美中文学校协会副会长帅致若通过电话会议，确定了凤凰城地区的比赛时间为11月19日，20日的周末。 这次比赛所有的参赛者都将得到国侨办奖品。国侨办将为达到一定分数线的考生颁发”合格奖”和”优秀奖”奖状。优秀奖获得者可以参加明年夏季在北京举办的”中华文化知识竞赛优胜者夏令营”。 目前凤凰城参赛报名工作正在以上三所学校进行，报名人数已经超过去年。其它学校或自学中文的初高中学生愿意参赛者，请联系全美中文学校协会副总干事长，凤凰城考点协调人谢明先生： mxieusa@hotmail.com 。报名的截止日期为10月10日。 这次竞赛共100道选择题，百分之九十考题与国侨办组织编写的”中华文化知识复习400题”内容有关。为推动和促进青少年学习中华文化知识，国侨办还组织编写了《中国地理常识》、《中国历史常识》和《中国文化常识》三本丛书。欲了解400道复习题及订购以上书籍，请上全美中文学校协会网站： www.CSAUS.org 或 www.cccee.org/culture 。 去年春天，中国国侨办成功地在全球15个国家举办了第二届海外华裔青少年中华文化知识竞赛，吸引了2.2万名华裔青少年参加，其中获优秀以上成绩者达2000余人。全美中文学校协会在上届比赛中有几百名”优秀奖”获得者。其中的高分获得者并具有中华才艺等方面杰出表现的学生，最近有五名优胜者入选为美国代表队成员，将参加国侨办组织的全球范围”海外华裔青少年中华文化知识竞赛总决赛”。国侨办将资助他们回国参赛的费用，包括国际旅费。总决赛将于10月20日至11月3日在中国陕西省西安市举行。
cf9e1715adc65d434619fa4bb1f8946f732c29da.translatedText: "Overseas Youth Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition" Phoenix Registration Opens [Contribution from the National Association of Chinese Schools] The Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council of China once again launched the third overseas Chinese Youth Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition and entrusted the National Association of Chinese Schools to organize and host the competition in the United States. Since 2007, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council has organized two Chinese cultural knowledge competitions for overseas Chinese teenagers around the world. Due to its large scale and high standards, the competition has received widespread attention from Chinese schools in overseas countries and the positive response of thousands of Chinese teenagers. The National Association of Chinese Schools has now issued registration notices to more than 400 member schools across the United States. At present, more than 30 test centers have been identified across the United States. There are two test centers in Arizona, one in Phoenix and one in Tucson. The Phoenix City Test Center has test rooms at three Chinese schools, namely Modern Chinese School, Hope Chinese School, and Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church Chinese School. Among them, the Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church Chinese School examination room includes candidates from this school and Fengcheng Chinese School candidates. Recently, principal Li Zhen of Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church Chinese School in the Phoenix area, teacher Shen Haojin, head of the Chinese group of the modern Chinese school, Xie Ming, the board of directors of Hope Chinese School, and Shuai Zhiruo, vice president of the National Chinese Schools Association, decided through a telephone conference that the competition time in the Phoenix area will be the weekend of November 19th and 20th. All contestants in this competition will receive prizes from the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council will issue "Qualification Award" and "Excellence Award" certificates to candidates who reach a certain score line. Winners of the Excellence Award can participate in the "Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition Winners Summer Camp" to be held in Beijing next summer. Registration for Phoenix City is currently underway at the above three schools, and the number of applicants has exceeded last year. If middle school and high school students from other schools or self-taught Chinese are willing to participate, please contact Mr. Xie Ming, deputy director-general of the National Association of Chinese Schools and coordinator of the Phoenix Test Center: mxieusa@hotmail.com. The deadline for registration is October 10th. There are a total of 100 multiple-choice questions in this competition, and 90% of the questions are related to the content of the "400 Questions for Review of Chinese Cultural Knowledge" organized by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council. In order to promote and facilitate young people to learn Chinese cultural knowledge, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council also organized and compiled three book series: "Common Knowledge on Chinese Geography", "Common Knowledge on Chinese History" and "Common Knowledge on Chinese Culture". To learn about the 400 review questions and order the above books, please visit the National Association of Chinese Schools’ website: www.CSAUS.org or www.cccee.org/culture. Last spring, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of China successfully held the Second Overseas Chinese Youth Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition in 15 countries around the world, attracting 22,000 Chinese youths to participate, of which more than 2,000 achieved excellent results or above. The National Association of Chinese Schools had hundreds of “Excellence Award” winners in the last competition. Among the students with high scores and outstanding performance in Chinese talents and other aspects, five winners have recently been selected as members of the American team and will participate in the global "Overseas Chinese Youth Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition Finals" organized by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council will fund their expenses for returning to China to compete, including international travel expenses. The finals will be held from October 20th to November 3rd in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, China.

210de5f8e0221111b5ccb1c715a3d7ef4835295c.sourceText: （凤凰城中文学校 来稿）2012年凤凰城中文学校春季班已于一月八日注册开学。上课地点依然是在美莎社区大学 (Mesa Community College)，时间维持每周日下午1:30?3:30。除了中文教学之外，课后还有中国结、篮球、绘画、排舞、吉他等课外活动，今年更特别为七年级以上同学新增开SATII数学班。 凤凰城中文学校不仅着重于中文教学，更藉由多项校内外活动，不仅让学生更了解中华文化，也凝聚师生和家长间的向心力。紧接着在一月二十九日，本校将借美莎社区大学学生活动中心中庭钟塔，于11:00 am?2:30 pm举办春节园游会，不仅有热心家长提供传统中国美食，还有各班老师带领学生表演舞龙舞狮，歌唱和短剧等，欢迎大家莅临指教。 如果您想多认识凤凰城中文学校，或是想加入这个大家庭，请与校长程秀玲联络(480-620-1982) 或参观学校网页(http://clsphoenix.org/)。
210de5f8e0221111b5ccb1c715a3d7ef4835295c.translatedText: (Phoenix Chinese School Contribution) The 2012 spring class of Phoenix Chinese School has been registered and started on January 8th. The class location is still at Mesa Community College, and the time remains every Sunday afternoon from 1:30 to 3:30. In addition to Chinese teaching, there are extracurricular activities such as Chinese knotting, basketball, painting, line dancing, and guitar after class. This year, a new SATII math class is specially opened for students in grade seven and above. Phoenix Chinese School not only focuses on Chinese teaching, but also uses a variety of activities inside and outside the school to not only allow students to better understand Chinese culture, but also to unite teachers, students and parents. Then on January 29, our school will use the clock tower of the atrium of the Student Activity Center of Mesa Community College to hold a Spring Festival garden party from 11:00 am to 2:30 pm. Not only will enthusiastic parents provide traditional Chinese food, but teachers from each class will lead students to perform dragon and lion dances, singing and skits, etc. Everyone is welcome to come and give advice. If you want to know more about Phoenix Chinese School or want to join this big family, please contact the principal Cheng Xiuling (480-620-1982) or visit the school website (http://clsphoenix.org/).

fb65eaa10ed1055eb264683ae43579610a1639f0.sourceText: 选择何种方式卖屋? 当屋主要出售房屋时，通常有两个选择，一个是找房地产经纪人帮屋主打点一切，另一个就是所谓的FSBO(for sale by owner)，由屋主自己来处理一切的销售事宜。 我们身处于互联网发达的世代，屋主们有比以前更多的管道来销售自己的房屋，不必非得透过房地产经纪人不可。如果您要出售房屋，该透过房地产经纪人还是FSBO好呢? 两者皆有利有弊。 For Sale by Owner最明显的优点当然就是可以省下一笔经纪佣金，这也是为什么有很多的屋主宁愿承受较大的风险而选择FSBO。至于FSBO的缺点就是房屋的交易过程、手续通常都需要一点专业知识和经验，大部分的屋主都要上班或打拼自己的事业，要屋主们花时间来学习何为正确的销售手续，陪买家看屋、如何推销自己的房屋、如何交屋过户等，可能很多屋主都不想也没时间来做这样的事，更重要的是如果屋主在售屋的过程中没有遵守相关法律规定或有所疏忽，很可能为自己带来大麻烦。另外值得注意的是，根据统计，买屋者对FSBO的房屋首次出价通常比由经纪人代理的房屋少了5%至10%，因为买屋者知道屋主不用付佣金。若是屋主有时间也愿意学习相关知识及行销技巧，当然可以为自己省下一笔钱。 找房地产经纪人售屋的优点在于省时省力，同时也可确保房屋的销售交易过程是符合专业标准的。房地产经纪人可以帮屋主处理有关售屋的琐事，还可以保护屋主的权益，帮屋主避免交易过程中的疏忽。好的卖方经纪人可以帮屋主带来好买家，让房屋看起来更有吸引力，经纪人还可以透过所属的房屋销售网，将待售的房屋资讯放在此销售网路中，所有的房地产经纪人便可以将这些待售屋的资讯传达给买屋者。相对的，透过房地产经纪人售屋的缺点就是要付佣金，佣金当然是可以协商的，并没有规定屋主该付多少佣金，传统上是房屋售价的6%。屋主可以依据服务的程度与经纪人的公司约定该付多少佣金。 您如果想用FSBO的方式来自己销售房屋，最重要的关键就是要勤做功课，才不会出错，若是想透过经纪人以避免麻烦，便要找一位具专业知识，服务亲切又诚实负责的经纪人，才可以保护您的权益，为您带来最大的利益。如果您有任何房地产方面的问题，非常欢迎您打电话到我的专线(480) 612-4545 或email至Rich@RichLiao.com
fb65eaa10ed1055eb264683ae43579610a1639f0.translatedText: Which method should you choose to sell your house? When a homeowner wants to sell his house, he usually has two options. One is to find a real estate agent to help the homeowner take care of everything, and the other is the so-called FSBO (for sale by owner), where the homeowner handles all sales matters himself. We are in an era with developed Internet. Homeowners have more channels than before to sell their homes, and they no longer have to go through a real estate agent. If you are selling your home, should you go through a real estate agent or a FSBO? There are pros and cons to both. The most obvious advantage of For Sale by Owner is of course that you can save a brokerage commission, which is why many homeowners would rather take greater risks and choose FSBO. The disadvantage of FSBO is that the house transaction process and procedures usually require a bit of professional knowledge and experience. Most homeowners have to go to work or work on their own careers. Homeowners need to spend time learning what the correct sales procedures are, accompanying buyers to view houses, how to market their houses, how to transfer the property, etc. Many homeowners may not want to or have time to do such things. More importantly, if the homeowner fails to comply with relevant laws and regulations or is negligent in the process of selling the house, it may cause big trouble for themselves. It’s also worth noting that according to statistics, homebuyers’ first offer on a FSBO home is typically 5% to 10% less than on a home represented by an agent because the homebuyer knows that the homeowner does not have to pay a commission. If the homeowner has the time and is willing to learn relevant knowledge and marketing techniques, he can certainly save himself a lot of money. The advantage of using a real estate agent to sell your house is that it saves time and effort, and it also ensures that the house sales transaction process meets professional standards. Real estate agents can help homeowners handle the trivial matters related to selling their homes, and can also protect their rights and interests and help them avoid negligence during the transaction. A good selling agent can help homeowners bring good buyers and make the house look more attractive. The agent can also put information on houses for sale in this sales network through the house sales network to which it belongs, and all real estate agents can convey this information about houses for sale to buyers. In contrast, the disadvantage of selling a house through a real estate agent is that you have to pay a commission. The commission is of course negotiable. There is no regulation on how much commission the homeowner should pay. It is traditionally 6% of the selling price of the house. The homeowner can agree with the broker's company how much commission to pay based on the level of service. If you want to use the FSBO method to sell your house by yourself, the most important key is to do your homework diligently to avoid making mistakes. If you want to use an agent to avoid trouble, you must find an agent who has professional knowledge, friendly service, honesty and responsibility, so that he can protect your rights and interests and bring you the greatest benefit. If you have any questions about real estate, you are very welcome to call my hotline (480) 612-4545 or email to Rich@RichLiao.com

b969ad5a8928568f54f2ed990e117afefd62f49a.translatedText: (Chinese Restaurant Association Newsletter) Reported by Zhang Zhaohong) The Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta recently held an emergency meeting to discuss how to deal with the recent cases of member restaurants being robbed by thugs, resulting in physical injuries and loss of money and property, and called on everyone to be more vigilant and take safety precautions in restaurants and themselves.

1d8e5126c479be49eb37afd99c5d92c7caaab7e9.sourceText: 发生被抢事件的地点，是在凤凰城西区的某餐馆的停车场，歹徒是在餐馆收工时候，待到受害人去停车场开车离开时作桉，受害人反应稍慢，便施以恶拳把人打伤，得手后就逃之夭夭。
1d8e5126c479be49eb37afd99c5d92c7caaab7e9.translatedText: The robbery happened in the parking lot of a restaurant in the west area of ​​Phoenix. The gangster was finishing up work in the restaurant. He waited until the victim went to the parking lot and drove away. The victim was a little slow to react, so he punched the person and injured him. After succeeding, he ran away.

952b3b3a1d3db490164ed183caf5d30136436059.sourceText: 这种在停车场发生的劫桉，在以前也时有发生，尤其在餐馆打烊后，餐馆老闆或企抬因身上带有现款，取车时容易成为打劫的对象。劫贼趁着夜色昏暗，行人希少时动手，犯桉时看不清其貌，也无傍人帮助，得手较易，逃脱较快，单枪匹马便可作桉。而华人损失钱财时一般不敢张扬，破财挡灾了事，这也让惯犯屡屡得手，抢劫的钱财用完后，又重施故技。按以往先例，这些桉子可能还会发生，所以要特别提醒大家注意和警惕。比起以往，现时因手机资讯发达，在餐馆作桉较容易被报警及被录影和录音取证，歹徒于是改变手法，停车场便成为犯桉的重灾区。中餐馆会再次提醒大家，晚上放工到停车场时，最好能结伴而行，单独一人时，最好用强光手电照清楚环境，发现有可疑人物，不可贸然上前，如歹徒已经近身，应沉着应付，毕竟钱财是身外之物，要以自己的安全为第一首要，如有可能，尽量认清打劫者的面目，以便日后能出来指证桉犯，让这些危害社会的歹徒能早日绳之于法。
952b3b3a1d3db490164ed183caf5d30136436059.translatedText: This kind of robbery in the parking lot has happened in the past, especially after the restaurant closes. The restaurant owner or waiter has cash on him and is easy to be robbed when he picks up the car. Robbers take advantage of the darkness of night and when there are few pedestrians to attack. When committing crimes, they cannot see clearly and have no one to help them. It is easier for them to get hold of the robbery and to escape faster. They can commit the crime alone. However, Chinese people generally do not dare to show off when they lose money and spend money to avoid disasters. This also allows habitual criminals to succeed frequently. After the money they rob is used up, they will resort to the same tricks again. According to past precedents, these eucalyptus incidents may occur again, so everyone is particularly reminded to pay attention and be vigilant. Compared with the past, due to the development of mobile phone information, it is easier to call the police and have video and audio recordings obtained for committing crimes in restaurants. The criminals have therefore changed their tactics, and parking lots have become the hardest hit areas for crimes. Chinese restaurants will once again remind everyone that when you go to the parking lot after work in the evening, it is best to walk in groups. When you are alone, it is best to use a strong flashlight to clearly illuminate the environment. If you find suspicious people, do not rush forward. If the gangster is close, you should deal with it calmly. After all, money is an external thing, and your own safety should be the first priority. If possible, try to recognize the face of the robber, so that you can come out to testify against the criminal in the future, so that these gangsters who endanger society can be brought to justice as soon as possible.

37e10fdc2793331317eccf50ff6cfe5a17bfed33.sourceText: （亚省希望中文学校校长 田琳撰稿） 2016年1月3日凤凰城地区几所中文学校的负责人在全美中文学校协会凤凰城联络中心负责人帅致若女士的召集下欢聚一堂庆祝新年。我们凤凰城的中文学校近年来有一个传统就是每年夏天在新学年开学之前各校的负责人聚在一起，介绍一下各自学校的最新情况。2015年8月聚会时，每一位到会者都觉得意犹未尽，纷纷表示这样同行之间的聚会不但交流信息，互相启发，而且增进了友谊，大家互相鼓劲，再接再厉为华文教育出力，这样的聚会交流应该至少一年两次。这次新年聚会的主要议题之一就是庆祝斐匿中文学校将于今夏在凤凰城中西部城区复课。 位于凤凰城中心的斐匿中文学校是本地区历史最悠久的中文学校。这次聚会崔增祁校长给大家带来了一个好消息，大凤凰城侨联正在凤凰城中西部寻找合适校舍，学校将于今年秋季复课。与会的各校负责人都向崔校长表示了祝贺，认为斐匿中文学校在中西区上课，使得大凤凰城华文教育布局更加有利于华裔和其它族裔学生就近学习中文，并且各校负责人都表示将为斐匿中文学校提供师资和生源信息以及书籍等方面的支持。 在座的学校负责人各自介绍了学校上学期的活动和下学期的计划。每所学校的活动都各具特色，办学风格多样，这样的交流对中文学校的同仁们来说非常有意义，大家互相剖析问题，分享成功经验。 凤凰城华人基督教会中文学校的沈美京校长介绍了该校的朗诵比赛和传统的春节庆祝活动。舞狮是凤凰城中文学校春节庆祝的亮点，孩子们在锣鼓声中感受到了节日的气氛，学习了中华文化传统。凤凰城华人基督教会中文学校将于1月10日在凤凰城华人基督教会开学。 凤凰城中文学校的程秀玲校长介绍了该校上学期的烤肉聚会活动和团体朗诵比赛。I-movie的比赛让大家耳目一新，学生们用自己拍的短片来展示中文学习成果，这样能寓教于乐，激发学生创造性积极性。程校长还提到新学期将举办春节游园活动，这是该校多年的欢度春节的传统活动，受到家长和社区各界人士的好评。凤凰城中文学校将于1月17日在MCC（梅莎社区大学）开学。 图桑祖筍中文学校陈荣基校长和大家分享了他多年潜心研究的教学理念，陈校长下学期的教学重点是让低年级学生大量快速识字。我们预祝陈校长新的教学方法获得成功，也期待未来陈校长能把他的第一手经验和心得分享给大家。 现代中文学校下学期的重头戏是学校成立20周年校庆。现在校庆的筹委会已经组成，各方面工作都在有条不紊的进行中。田韶薇董事长盛情邀请各中文学校的负责人参加该校的20年庆典。田董事长同时也提到了现代和希望这两所中文学校在过去几年的多次愉快合作和相互帮助，特别感谢希望中文学校田琳校长在上学期开学前帮助解决现代中文学校一名教师缺员问题。作为本地区两所最大的中文学校，现代中文学校和希望中文学校今后还会加强合作，更好地为社区服务。现代中文学校将于1月16日在ASU开学。 希望中文学校的董事长李健博士为这次会议做了认真记录。田琳校长介绍了学校的朗诵比赛，以及11月举办的形式新颖的大型”亲子”游戏聚会活动，介绍了举办这些活动的特色和经验。2016年初秋中国海外交流协会的”专家巡讲团”华文教师培训活动将由希望中文学校主持，希望中文学校负责人将及时收集和反映本地区华文教师的建议和要求，力争使教师们通过这次培训活动获得最新的教育信息和更加实用的教学技能。希望中文学校将于1月16日在MCC（梅莎社区大学）开学。 孟子中文学校校长刘凤霞临时因故未能参加会议。 这次聚会，大家从中文学校未来发展的设想，一直谈到各项工作，具体到学生奖品的发放。四个小时的聚会在不知不觉中就过去了，大家都直呼时间过得太快还有很多话题没有说到。海外华文教育之路从来都不是平平坦坦的，上百年来无数志愿者的心血让海外华文教育这棵大树越来越繁茂；凤凰城华文教育几十年的发展道路充满艰辛挑战、爱心奉献、成绩和希望，作为华文教育队伍中的义工，我们为此付出了一些努力，感到十分愉快而欣慰；我们愿意和本地各界热爱华文教育的人士一起，为在华裔和其它族裔学生传播中文和中华文化而继续出力。 聚会照片：
37e10fdc2793331317eccf50ff6cfe5a17bfed33.translatedText: (Written by Tian Lin, Principal of Hope Chinese School in Alberta) On January 3, 2016, the heads of several Chinese schools in the Phoenix area gathered together to celebrate the New Year under the convocation of Ms. Shuai Zhiruo, the head of the Phoenix Contact Center of the National Association of Chinese Schools. Our Chinese school in Phoenix has had a tradition in recent years that every summer before the start of the new school year, the heads of each school get together to introduce the latest situation of their respective schools. At the gathering in August 2015, every attendee felt that they had more to learn than others. They all said that such gatherings among peers not only exchange information and inspire each other, but also enhance friendship. Everyone encourages each other to continue to contribute to Chinese education. Such gatherings and exchanges should be held at least twice a year. One of the main topics of this New Year's party was to celebrate the resumption of classes at Feinian Chinese School in the central and western part of Phoenix this summer. Feinian Chinese School, located in the heart of Phoenix, is the oldest Chinese school in the area. At this gathering, Principal Cui Zengqi brought good news to everyone. The Overseas Chinese Federation of Greater Phoenix is ​​looking for a suitable school building in the central and western part of Phoenix. The school will resume classes this fall. The heads of each school attending the meeting expressed their congratulations to Principal Cui. They believed that the presence of Feinian Chinese School in the Central and Western District would make the layout of Chinese education in Greater Phoenix more conducive to Chinese and other ethnic students learning Chinese nearby. The heads of each school also expressed their support for Feinian Chinese School in terms of teachers, student information, and books. The school leaders present each introduced the school’s activities last semester and plans for the next semester. Each school has its own unique activities and diverse school running styles. Such exchanges are very meaningful to colleagues in Chinese schools, as they analyze problems and share successful experiences with each other. Principal Shen Meijing of Phoenix Chinese Christian School introduced the school’s recitation competition and traditional Spring Festival celebrations. Lion dance is the highlight of the Spring Festival celebrations at Phoenix Chinese School. The children feel the festive atmosphere and learn about Chinese cultural traditions amidst the sound of gongs and drums. Phoenix Chinese Christian Church Chinese School will open on January 10th at the Phoenix Chinese Christian Church. Principal Cheng Xiuling of Phoenix Chinese School introduced the school’s barbecue party and group recitation competition last semester. The I-movie competition is refreshing for everyone. Students use their own short films to show their Chinese learning achievements, which can educate and entertain and stimulate students' creativity and enthusiasm. Principal Cheng also mentioned that the Spring Festival garden activity will be held in the new semester. This is the school’s traditional activity to celebrate the Spring Festival for many years and has been well received by parents and people from all walks of life in the community. Phoenix Chinese School will start school at MCC (Mesa Community College) on January 17th. Principal Chen Rongji of Tucson Zusun Chinese School shared with everyone the teaching philosophy he has studied with great concentration for many years. Principal Chen’s teaching focus for the next semester is to enable low-grade students to quickly learn literacy in large numbers. We wish Principal Chen’s new teaching methods success, and look forward to Principal Chen sharing his first-hand experience and insights with everyone in the future. The highlight of the next semester of Modern Chinese School is the 20th anniversary of the founding of the school. Now the organizing committee for the school anniversary has been formed, and all aspects of work are being carried out in an orderly manner. Chairman Tian Shaowei warmly invited the heads of each Chinese school to participate in the school’s 20th anniversary celebration. Chairman Tian also mentioned the happy cooperation and mutual help between Modern Chinese School and Hope Chinese School in the past few years. He especially thanked Principal Tian Lin of Hope Chinese School for helping solve the shortage of a teacher at Modern Chinese School before the start of last semester. As the two largest Chinese schools in the region, Modern Chinese School and Hope Chinese School will strengthen cooperation in the future to better serve the community. The Modern Chinese School will start at ASU on January 16th. I hope Dr. Li Jian, the chairman of the Hope Chinese School, took careful notes of this meeting. Principal Tian Lin introduced the school’s recitation competition and the novel large-scale “parent-child” game party held in November, and introduced the characteristics and experience of organizing these activities. In the early autumn of 2016, the China Overseas Exchange Association's "Expert Tour" Chinese teacher training event will be hosted by Hope Chinese School. The person in charge of Hope Chinese School will promptly collect and reflect the suggestions and requirements of Chinese teachers in the region, striving to enable teachers to obtain the latest educational information and more practical teaching skills through this training event. Hope Chinese School will open at MCC (Mesa Community College) on January 16th. Liu Fengxia, the principal of Mencius Chinese School, was unable to attend the meeting due to temporary reasons. At this gathering, everyone started talking about the future development of the Chinese school, and talked about various tasks, including the distribution of student prizes. The four-hour party passed without realizing it. Everyone said that time passed too fast and there were still many topics that were not discussed. The road to overseas Chinese education has never been smooth. Over the past hundred years, the hard work of countless volunteers has made the tree of overseas Chinese education more and more prosperous. The decades of development of Chinese education in Phoenix have been full of arduous challenges, loving dedication, achievements and hope. As volunteers in the Chinese education team, we have made some efforts for this and feel very happy and gratified. We are willing to work with people from all walks of life in the local area who love Chinese education to continue to contribute to the spread of Chinese and Chinese culture among Chinese and other ethnic students. 17c9605390a87e7340c7db5e4a8a71bcfd85e7fb.sourceText: 易建联的凤凰城情缘(图) 谢成彦 2010年 1月21日晚7点，凤凰城太阳队的主场来了160多华人，可是他们都是为客场新泽西网队的易建联加油助威的。在训练时段，易建联一上场就迎来的全场的呼声：”易建联，加油，易建联，加油！” 很多球迷都要求阿联合个影。 易建联在几轮投球训练后，也非常爽快的答应。在一片尖叫声中，球迷们拿着五星红旗和易建联合影留念。 其实早在2001年易建联就跟随国家青年队来到凤凰城训练，还在当年的老侨家居住过，所以易建联和凤凰城有一段罕为人知的情缘。当年照顾易建联的老乔家庭是凤凰城希望中文学校的校长张巧萍。时隔9年，张巧萍来到比赛的现场和易建联见面。一走进赛场，易建联的眼神就在客场休息区后面定了定。张巧萍跟在场的记者说，他看到我了。易建联仍然平静的运球，投篮，坐着赛前练习。大约十几分钟后，就见他在工作人员的陪同下，走到赛场边，一个温馨的拥抱，就看出易建联和这位”妈妈”的感情。在张妈妈面前，易建联还像个腼腆的孩子，张妈妈则心疼的说：”怎么这么瘦呀厖”。因为比赛的原因，易建联并没有很多时间跟张妈妈长聊，可是赛后，易建联表示这是他到凤凰城最大的惊喜。 （ 中，张巧萍，右，易建联） 比赛期间，张妈妈和记者谈起一些当年的小故事。张妈妈说第一次听说易建联要来的时候，觉得运动员应该会高，所以她在家给易建联准备了个king size的床，觉得应该够了，可是直到易建联要离开她们家的时候，才发现，睡在king size的床上，这孩子的大半个腿都必须放在床外，没想到这孩子这么高。可是易建联在这样的床上睡了几晚，却什么也没有说，非常懂事。还有一次，张妈妈带易建联出门去买相机，到了卖场，不知道相机在什么地方，正打算问问营业员相机陈列区在哪，易建联马上拉住张妈妈说：”在那里，在那里” 因为这个大个子小孩的身高早就超过了各种货架，一眼就看到了相机放的地方，真是帮了个大忙。尴尬的是带易建联去Arizona Mall 买衣服，转了整个大商场，就是买不到他的衣服，还不断被围观，怎么有个这么高的孩子呀。这次来看比赛，张巧萍特地准备了一本珍贵的影集送给易建联，其中包括易建联13岁时在张妈妈家的照片，以及现在张妈妈的全家福。易建联说这次来能见到张妈妈非常的高兴，当年来美国最开心的就是能在张妈妈家讲广东话，就像在自己家一样。在离开凤凰城后，易建联还把自己的球衣送给张妈妈做纪念，也时常写信，后来因为一直搬家，张妈妈家的联系方式不甚丢失，而失去了联系，现在重新见面，太好了，他说现在又可以重新联系了。这份失而复得的情缘应该是易建联此次凤凰城之行的最大收获。 NBA的比赛依然是精彩纷呈，虽然篮网客场94-118不敌太阳惨遭9连败。易建联10投5中，得到14分6个篮板送出3次助攻，表现的可圈可点。第二节开始不久，易建联飙中两球，篮网以35-34反超。本节过半时两队几度战成平手。本节还有2分56秒时易建联两罚一中，篮网再度超出。
17c9605390a87e7340c7db5e4a8a71bcfd85e7fb.translatedText: Yi Jianlian's Love in Phoenix (Photo) Xie Chengyan 2010 At 7 p.m. on January 21, more than 160 Chinese people came to the home court of the Phoenix Suns, but they were all cheering for Yi Jianlian of the visiting New Jersey Nets. During the training period, as soon as Yi Jianlian came on the court, the audience cheered: "Yi Jianlian, come on, Yi Jianlian, come on!" Many fans asked Yi Jianlian to take a picture. After several rounds of pitching training, Yi Jianlian readily agreed. Amid screams, fans took photos with Yi Jianlian holding the five-star red flag. In fact, as early as 2001, Yi Jianlian came to Phoenix for training with the national youth team, and also lived in the old overseas Chinese's home, so Yi Jianlian and Phoenix have a relationship that is rarely known. The Lao Qiao family who took care of Yi Jianlian back then was Zhang Qiaoping, the principal of Phoenix Hope Chinese School. After 9 years, Zhang Qiaoping came to the competition site to meet Yi Jianlian. As soon as he entered the stadium, Yi Jianlian's eyes were fixed behind the away dugout. Zhang Qiaoping told reporters present that he saw me. Yi Jianlian still calmly dribbles, shoots, and sits for pre-game practice. About ten minutes later, I saw him walking to the side of the field accompanied by the staff. A warm hug showed the affection between Yi Jianlian and this "mother". In front of Zhang's mother, Yi Jianlian still looked like a shy child, but Zhang's mother said distressedly: "Why are you so thin?" Because of the competition, Yi Jianlian didn't have much time to chat with Zhang's mother, but after the game, Yi Jianlian said that this was the biggest surprise for him in Phoenix. (Middle, Zhang Qiaoping, right, Yi Jianlian) During the competition, Zhang’s mother talked to reporters about some short stories from that year. Zhang's mother said that when she first heard that Yi Jianlian was coming, she thought athletes should be tall, so she prepared a king-size bed for Yi Jianlian at home, thinking it would be enough. However, it was not until Yi Jianlian was leaving their home that she discovered that most of the child's legs had to be placed outside the bed to sleep on the king-size bed. She did not expect the child to be so tall. But Yi Jianlian slept on such a bed for several nights without saying anything, he was very sensible. Another time, Zhang’s mother took Yi Jianlian out to buy a camera. When they arrived at the store, they didn’t know where the camera was. They were about to ask the salesperson where the camera display area was. Yi Jianlian immediately grabbed Zhang’s mother and said, “There, there.” Because this big kid’s height had already exceeded the various shelves, it was really a big help to see where the camera was placed at a glance. What was embarrassing was that I took Yi Jianlian to the Arizona Mall to buy clothes. I went around the whole mall, but couldn't buy his clothes. He was constantly being watched. How could he have such a tall child? This time to watch the competition, Zhang Qiaoping specially prepared a precious photo album for Yi Jianlian, including photos of Yi Jianlian at Zhang's mother's house when he was 13 years old, as well as Zhang's mother's family portrait now. Yi Jianlian said that he was very happy to meet Zhang’s mother this time. The happiest thing about coming to the United States was being able to speak Cantonese at Zhang’s mother’s house, just like at home. After leaving Phoenix City, Yi Jianlian gave his jersey to Zhang’s mother as a souvenir, and often wrote letters. Later, because he kept moving, the contact information of Zhang’s mother’s family was not lost, so he lost contact. Now they meet again, it’s great, he said that now we can contact her again. This lost and found love should be Yi Jianlian’s biggest gain from this trip to Phoenix. NBA games are still exciting, although the Nets lost 94-118 to the Suns in an away game and suffered a 9-game losing streak. Yi Jianlian made 5 of 10 shots, scored 14 points, 6 rebounds and 3 assists. His performance was remarkable. Shortly after the start of the second quarter, Yi Jianlian scored two goals and the Nets took the lead 35-34. The two teams were tied several times in the middle of this quarter. With 2 minutes and 56 seconds left in this quarter, Yi Jianlian made one of two free throws and the Nets went over again.

42f7ecf0eb80d821e389e5d4c8258dbdd9201ed8.sourceText: 在过去的四年中，凤凰城的现金买家一直占着主导地位，一直到现在。 现金买家大部分是投资者，过去四年，市场都是被他们所左右，但是本周的一个报告显示，上个月有2188栋房屋成交，其中只有44笔交易是现金。 凤凰城将面临着长期住宅销售短缺的问题，现金买家的退出，对贷款买房者是个大好机会。报告还指出现金买家退出是因为房屋价格持续回升，而市场上供销售的房子很有限，讨价还价的余地很小，短售屋，破产屋价格优惠的房子也非常少，让投资者逐渐退出市场。 实际上销售房屋的供给，每年都在以7%的速度下降。上个月只有5960套房屋在市场上。然而上个月的销售数量则比二月上涨了24%。 这是一个购房旺季的信号。 与此同时，房屋供应问题也牵动房屋价格上涨，上个月房屋每平方英尺的价格已经突破了百元大关。这是至2008年9月来的首次突破。 尽管现金买家逐渐退出，但是投资者仍然会是一支重要力量，现金买家所占的比例依然还是比较高。 在三月， 现金买家的销售额占房屋销售额的36%。一年前占41.5%。这个数据依然会让人惊呼，因为2008年3月，现金买家只有16.1%。更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的Tinna (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
42f7ecf0eb80d821e389e5d4c8258dbdd9201ed8.translatedText: Cash buyers have been dominant in Phoenix for the past four years and still are today. Cash buyers, mostly investors, have dominated the market for the past four years, but a report this week showed that of the 2,188 homes sold last month, only 44 were cash. Phoenix will face a long-term housing sales shortage, and the withdrawal of cash buyers will be a great opportunity for mortgage buyers. The report also pointed out that cash buyers are withdrawing because house prices continue to rise, while the number of houses for sale on the market is very limited, leaving little room for bargaining. There are also very few short-sold houses and bankrupt houses with favorable prices, causing investors to gradually withdraw from the market. In fact, the supply of homes for sale is declining at a rate of 7% every year. Only 5,960 homes were on the market last month. However, the number of sales last month increased by 24% compared with February. This is a sign of peak home buying season. At the same time, housing supply issues have also affected housing prices, with the price per square foot exceeding the $100 mark last month. This is the first breakthrough since September 2008. Although cash buyers are gradually withdrawing, investors will still be an important force, and the proportion of cash buyers is still relatively high. In March, sales to cash buyers accounted for 36% of home sales. It accounted for 41.5% a year ago. This data is still surprising, because in March 2008, only 16.1% were cash buyers. ef89ca56fbee9faa5f549233811c701addd51da1.translatedText: China's most beautiful chess queen and husband of Qatar's royal family Current status: Once looked down upon, now happy and happy Zhu Chen is known as China's most beautiful chess queen. She is China's second international chess...

728c46cfe2df69a1a203fe6d46dab9722072289d.sourceText: 诸宸被誉为中国最美棋后，她是中国第二个国际象棋世界冠军，成绩出色、长相甜美的她拥有很高的人气。不过她的婚姻生活却备受争议，因为她的丈夫阿尔.默罕默德是卡塔尔皇室的一员，不少网友认为远嫁阿拉伯的诸宸过的并不幸福，但她本人却觉得生活很美好。
728c46cfe2df69a1a203fe6d46dab9722072289d.translatedText: Zhu Chen is known as China's most beautiful chess queen. She is China's second world chess champion. She is very popular because of her outstanding performance and sweet appearance. However, her married life is controversial because her husband Al Mohammed is a member of the Qatari royal family. Many netizens believe that Zhu Chen, who is married to an Arab, is not living a happy life, but she herself feels that life is very beautiful.

f6c2b917a6ea106aedc4cc8a0cc3485b9993e36e.sourceText: 1976年诸宸出生于杭州，7岁的时候开始学棋，天赋过人的她很快脱颖而出，12岁时就夺得了国际象棋世锦赛12岁组冠军。26岁时成为首个集世界少年组冠军、青年组冠军和世界冠军于一身的女棋手，同时她还曾战胜过男子世界冠军波诺马谬夫，是不折不扣的天才选手。
f6c2b917a6ea106aedc4cc8a0cc3485b9993e36e.translatedText: Zhu Chen was born in Hangzhou in 1976. She started learning chess when she was 7 years old. She quickly stood out due to her extraordinary talent. At the age of 12, she won the 12-year-old World Chess Championship championship. At the age of 26, she became the first female chess player to combine the world's junior championship, youth championship and world championship. At the same time, she also defeated the men's world champion Pono Mamufu. She is an out-and-out genius player.

ea1b9602907c8cd83ff8983dcb60dfb5cade1222.sourceText: 而她的丈夫阿尔.默罕默德是卡塔尔皇室的一员，被誉为”二十世纪阿拉伯最佳棋手”，他们因为相同的兴趣爱好走到一起，并陷入热恋。不过他们的感情生活却遭遇了不少困难，除了语言、文化、距离等因素之外，还有许多卡塔尔人认为诸宸配不上默罕默德，好在默罕默德坚定的表示：”我非她不娶。”
ea1b9602907c8cd83ff8983dcb60dfb5cade1222.translatedText: Her husband Al Mohammed is a member of the Qatari royal family and is known as "the best Arab chess player of the 20th century". They came together because of the same interests and hobbies and fell in love. However, their love life encountered many difficulties. In addition to factors such as language, culture, and distance, many Qataris believed that Zhu Chen was not worthy of Mohammed. Fortunately, Mohammed firmly said: "I will not marry her unless she is her."

9049067b6a3edfca76d8a4996e2b4c70336ec7a8.sourceText: 最终他们克服重重困难，在1999年低调结婚，随后诸宸跟随丈夫默罕默德远赴卡塔尔生活，并加入了卡塔尔国籍。虽然当地实行一夫多妻制，但默罕默德只迎娶了诸宸一位妻子。婚后他们育有两个孩子，诸宸认为自己目前的生活十分幸福。
9049067b6a3edfca76d8a4996e2b4c70336ec7a8.translatedText: In the end, they overcame many difficulties and got married in a low-key manner in 1999. Later, Zhu Chen followed her husband Mohammed to live in Qatar and became a Qatari citizen. Although polygamy was practiced in the area, Muhammad only married one wife, Zhu Chen. After their marriage, they had two children, and Zhu Chen thought his current life was very happy.

46b941def69c20bca683a78a2c77b3b516676c85.sourceText: 近日，电影《白鹿原》的部分剧照曝光，《白鹿原》的导演换了又换，终于落到王全安身上。张雨绮在片中饰演女主角田小娥，与吴刚、段奕宏均有大尺度的激情戏。足足把陕北风情服饰穿出了”欲望”。
46b941def69c20bca683a78a2c77b3b516676c85.translatedText: Recently, some stills from the movie "White Deer Plain" were exposed. The director of "White Deer Plain" changed again and again, and finally fell on Wang Quanan. Zhang Yuqi plays the heroine Tian Xiao'e in the film, and has large-scale passionate scenes with Wu Gang and Duan Yihong. It fully embodies the "desire" in northern Shaanxi style clothing.

6dff4f512df44a3509ab71cfee0e00b8b542ec90.sourceText: 改编自陈忠实同名小说，由王全安执导，集结了张丰毅、张雨绮、吴刚、段奕宏、成泰燊、刘威、郭涛等国内一线影星的电影《白鹿原》，即将于 9 月 13 日全国上映。从目前透露的电影情节和剧照来看，张雨绮这次实在是大尺度激情上演，并将陕北服饰穿出了醉人的”欲望”。从大花袄到绣花鞋，再从羊角辫到大红肚兜，足足给了观众们不少惊喜。
6dff4f512df44a3509ab71cfee0e00b8b542ec90.translatedText: Adapted from Chen Zhongshi’s novel of the same name and directed by Wang Quanan, the movie "White Deer Plain" brings together domestic first-line movie stars such as Zhang Fengyi, Zhang Yuqi, Wu Gang, Duan Yihong, Cheng Taishen, Liu Wei, Guo Tao, etc., and will be released nationwide on September 13. Judging from the plot and stills of the movie revealed so far, Zhang Yuqi is really passionate on a large scale this time, and she wears northern Shaanxi costumes with an intoxicating "desire". From large flowered jackets to embroidered shoes, and from horn braids to red bellybands, the audience was given a lot of surprises.

91ddd1e72260eb1a2903ab046a399f1c729c2ea3.sourceText: 在戏中，张雨绮不仅有风情万种的姨太太装扮，在入境白鹿原后，即是落魄苦命也同样是白鹿原上一点红，这不禁让人想起了张艺谋《红高粱》里面的巩俐，同样体现着原始吸引的女性魅力，让土地上的汉子拜倒在她的石榴裙下。用民俗服饰展现了”中国式的性感”。
91ddd1e72260eb1a2903ab046a399f1c729c2ea3.translatedText: In the play, Zhang Yuqi not only dresses up as a charming concubine, but after entering Bailuyuan, even though she is down and out, she is still a bit popular in Bailuyuan. This reminds people of Gong Li in Zhang Yimou's "Red Sorghum", which also embodies the original attractive female charm, making the men of the land fall under her pomegranate skirt. Using folk costumes to show "Chinese sexy".

bb82c069e0d83e3a6297bdb875600b57584eb86c.sourceText: 魅力陕北 别样粗旷的民俗美
bb82c069e0d83e3a6297bdb875600b57584eb86c.translatedText: >Charming Northern Shaanxi, unique and rough folk beauty

7597e61094633d37699cac3e10897c8b28e90f28.sourceText: 服饰文化是一个历史久远而又崭新的大文章，是一个既缓慢悠长却又会突变求奇的历史时空的演化变迁的现实体。近现代，陕北人的衣着服饰注重简朴、实用、大方。男人上衣，不论单衫、夹衣、棉袄，一律低领对襟式，方言叫”对门门”，纽扣是布条挽制的”核桃疙瘩”；女人上衣则是低领偏襟式，俗称长襟襟，纽扣也是”核桃疙瘩”。男女裤皆为大裆裤，白布为腰，相当宽大，前不开口，穿时折叠系布带或线织裤带，这种服装通用于男女老幼。后来女孩子开始自己缝衣服，用红布缝成夹层菱形的”红肚兜”，手巧的还在上面绣花，用它挂在身前护腹，代替衬衣，避免腹部受凉，这也是男女老幼通用的。现在，红肚兜只偶尔见于儿童们在舞台上表演用。
7597e61094633d37699cac3e10897c8b28e90f28.translatedText: Clothing culture is a long-standing yet brand-new article. It is a reality that is both slow and long, yet subject to sudden and surprising changes in historical time and space. In modern times, people in northern Shaanxi pay attention to simplicity, practicality and elegance in their clothing. Men's tops, whether single shirts, jackets or cotton-padded jackets, are all low-collared and double-breasted, which is called "duimenmen" in dialect, and the buttons are "walnut knots" made of strips of cloth. Women's tops are low-collared and part-breasted, commonly known as long lapels, and the buttons are also "walnut knots". Both men's and women's trousers are large-crotch trousers with a white cloth waist. They are quite wide and have no front opening. When worn, they are folded and tied with cloth belts or thread woven belts. This kind of clothing is suitable for men, women, old and young. Later, girls began to sew their own clothes, using red cloth to sew a sandwiched diamond-shaped "red bellyband". The dexterous ones also embroidered on it and hung it in front of the body to protect their abdomen, instead of a shirt, to prevent the abdomen from getting cold. This is also suitable for both men and women, old and young. Nowadays, red bellybands are only occasionally seen by children performing on stage.

b4328a5bd6048bbc5a5500995b16be138c32e8d5.sourceText: 陕北的传统服饰 演绎当地特色
b4328a5bd6048bbc5a5500995b16be138c32e8d5.translatedText: Traditional clothing in northern Shaanxi, interpreting local characteristics

bc966af59e5af192bc185586c237891f88be80fc.sourceText: 肚兜是关中和陕北传统的贴身服饰，形状像背心的前襟，上面用布带系在脖劲上，下面两边有带子系于腰间。它的实用价值是避免肚子着凉。成年有肚兜贴身不外露，小孩在热天露在外面显得天真烂漫。肚兜里外两层，两边有开口处，可以贴身放钱物。小孩肚兜的外面用料多为红布，成人多为黑布，里子多用白布。向外的面料上绣有五颜六色的各种图案，如小孩肚兜上绣有虎头像、”五毒”图案，新婚夫妇肚兜上绣有鸳鸯戏水，象征夫妻恩爱。
bc966af59e5af192bc185586c237891f88be80fc.translatedText: Dudou is a traditional close-fitting clothing in Guanzhong and northern Shaanxi. It is shaped like the front of a vest, with a cloth belt on the top tied around the neck, and two belts on the bottom tied around the waist. Its practical value is to avoid catching a cold in the stomach. Adults have bellybands that fit close to the body and are not exposed, while children look innocent when exposed in hot weather. The bellyband has two layers inside and outside, with openings on both sides, so you can put money and things close to your body. The outer material of children's bellybands is mostly red cloth, while adults' bellybands are mostly made of black cloth, while the lining is mostly made of white cloth. The outer fabric is embroidered with various colorful patterns, such as tiger heads and "five poisons" patterns embroidered on the bellybands of children, and mandarin ducks playing in the water on the bellybands of newlyweds, symbolizing the love between husband and wife.

630f40d957397fc0ac738939db26e38f29c7fd26.sourceText: 现在的棉都是形式上的棉，薄才是真正的主题。热量可以，最主要的是不会影响身段，款式可以为你遮掩修塑体形。我也不是刻意地将自己扔在鲜花和亮丽堆丛，靠这些附加的东西来渲染和混充。我只是希望在万物枯萎沉寂，经济一落千丈的时节，有柔的花的彩的暖的相偎相伴，我们依旧可以人面桃花，甜笑着，被宠爱着，轻松积极地抗御来自不同方向的负重。
630f40d957397fc0ac738939db26e38f29c7fd26.translatedText: Cotton nowadays is cotton in form, and thinness is the real theme. The heat is ok, but the most important thing is that it won't affect your figure, and the style can cover up and shape your body. I don’t deliberately throw myself into flowers and bright flowers, and rely on these additional things to embellish and fill it up. I just hope that in the season when everything is withered and silent and the economy is plummeting, with the soft colors and warmth of flowers cuddling together, we can still have peach blossom faces, smile sweetly, be pampered, and easily and actively resist the burdens from different directions.

56a87265afcd369a8fca9f389a69dde0d5666678.sourceText: 陕北和晋西北地区特殊的地形地貌，是白羊肚手巾产生发展的外部因素。由于风沙经常性的肆虐，外出劳作的人们便需要随身携带一些物品来擦拭头顶、脸上和脖颈灰尘和沙砾，白羊肚头巾是陕北文化的一个鉴证和缩影，在其中能够领略到许许多多无法用言语传承的东西，它们和其它一些独特的东西，例如民歌、窑洞，共同构成了陕北的人文风景。
56a87265afcd369a8fca9f389a69dde0d5666678.translatedText: The special topography of northern Shaanxi and northwestern Shanxi is an external factor for the development of white sheep belly towels. Due to the frequent raging wind and sand, people who go out to work need to carry some items with them to wipe the dust and gravel on their heads, faces and necks. The white sheep belly scarf is a testimony and epitome of northern Shaanxi culture. In it, you can appreciate many things that cannot be passed down in words. They and other unique things, such as folk songs and cave dwellings, together constitute the cultural landscape of northern Shaanxi.

cf98296cf9d342a5b9d16e50cee4ce35b0ef160e.sourceText: 美墨边境隧道再现 （亚省新闻） 上周，执法人员在道格拉斯发现一个不寻常景象：一个房间内发现一个大洞，洞的两头分别是美国和墨西哥边境。他们相信这是不法分子用来走私毒品的。 这是本州不到两周内发现的第二条走私隧道。联邦执法官员担心，越来越多走私分子使用隧道走私毒品到美国，以逃避日益严查的边境安全。 今年夏天，边境巡逻队完成诺格拉斯的新围栏安装，美墨双方巡逻队都能看到对方，使人蛇更容易发现。近年来，边境巡逻队在沿着亚利桑那州与墨西哥边境已安装了超过300英里围栏和增设汽车检查站，增加数百个执法队员。 据边境巡逻队在图森市的总部称，到本财政年度7月止，共发现了8个走私隧道，比去年同期增加了三个。（这数字不包括过去两周内发现的两个。） 隧道位于道格拉斯的一所房子，离墨西哥边境只有数码之遥。隧道倒塌，走私者重新发掘时被警方发现。虽然执法人员把房子内的污物清走，但墨西哥当局无法找到南面边境的入口。 挖掘边境隧道工程浩大，需要昂贵的设备，如锯、推进器、灯光、发电机和木材，这些东西对走私集团来说仿佛易如反掌。 此前一周，8月16日，执法者在诺格拉斯发现一个复杂的药物隧道，长90英尺，宽3英尺，高3英尺，从墨境索诺拉州进入诺格拉斯。隧道里头还包含了通风管，工具和电线。 警方相信，隧道的主要目的是走私毒品，而不是人口走私。
cf98296cf9d342a5b9d16e50cee4ce35b0ef160e.translatedText: U.S.-Mexico border tunnel reappears (Alberta News) Last week, law enforcement officers discovered an unusual sight in Douglas: a large hole was found in a room, with the U.S.-Mexico border at both ends of the hole. They believe it is used by criminals to smuggle drugs. This is the second smuggling tunnel discovered in the state in less than two weeks. Federal law enforcement officials are concerned that smugglers are increasingly using tunnels to smuggle drugs into the United States to evade increasingly tight border security. This summer, the Border Patrol completed the installation of a new fence in Nograles that will allow U.S. and Mexican patrols to see each other, making it easier for smugglers to detect. In recent years, the Border Patrol has installed more than 300 miles of fencing and added vehicle inspection stations along the Arizona-Mexico border, adding hundreds of law enforcement agents. According to the Border Patrol's headquarters in Tucson, eight smuggling tunnels were discovered through July of this fiscal year, three more than the same period last year. (That number does not include two discovered in the past two weeks.) The tunnel is located at a house in Douglas, just yards from the Mexican border. The tunnel collapsed and the smugglers were discovered by police when they re-excavated the tunnel. Although law enforcement officers cleared the house of debris, Mexican authorities were unable to find the southern border entrance. Digging a border tunnel is a huge undertaking and requires expensive equipment such as saws, propellers, lights, generators and wood, all of which appear to be a piece of cake for smuggling syndicates. The week before, on August 16, law enforcement officers discovered a complex drug tunnel in Nogueira, 90 feet long, 3 feet wide, and 3 feet high, entering Nogueira from the Mexican state of Sonora. The tunnel also contains ventilation ducts, tools and electrical wiring. Police believe the main purpose of the tunnel is to smuggle drugs, not people.

75933db1d7e69205df22070d44cdf41dd580686e.sourceText: 四月二十一日(周六)中午，亚省亚太健康促进会创办人徐凯莱(左2)及徐德之夫人(左4)，约会社区侨界人士余文劲(左3)、甄硕钦后左3、佳叔夫妇 (左5、6) 、黄玮王亭(后左5)、康明义律师(后左2) 、余文焯(后左4) 等等, 在新世界海鲜酒楼召开茶话会，讨论参加筹备即将在五月十二日（周六）举行的亚太健康促进会第6週年筹款的活动。
