As a result of the punishment for the fraudulent listing case, Wanfu Biotech, its executives and related intermediaries were all severely punished. Among them, the penalty imposed on the sponsor Ping An Securities was the most severe fine issued to a sponsor since the introduction of the sponsorship system in 2004.

9692a6a88321d0b4de802af9a55ab617ff2c6c76.sourceText: 证监会新闻发言人当日强调，万福生科案突出反映了相关发行人和中介机构诚信意识淡薄、职业操守存在严重缺陷，既有违信息披露基本要求和市场”三公”原则，又严重损害了投资者利益，相关发行人、中介机构及有关责任人员均将被追究刑事或行政责任。
9692a6a88321d0b4de802af9a55ab617ff2c6c76.translatedText: A spokesman for the China Securities Regulatory Commission emphasized on the same day that the Wanfu Biotech case highlighted the weak awareness of integrity and serious flaws in professional ethics of the relevant issuers and intermediaries. It not only violated the basic requirements for information disclosure and the market's "three fair principles", but also seriously damaged the interests of investors. The relevant issuers, intermediaries and relevant responsible personnel will be held criminally or administratively responsible.

7c25afc196d6a7c3f0063346a927aac2c362e7ba.sourceText: 本网记者获悉，证监会近期还将公布多起涉及资本市场的重大案件处罚结果，依照”从严从快”的原则依法打击资本市场的各类违法违规行为，以最大力量、最大程度地保护投资者尤其是中小投资者的权益。山西天能、新大地，河南天丰等案件已进入立案调查阶段，将根据案情进展将会及时向公众披露。
7c25afc196d6a7c3f0063346a927aac2c362e7ba.translatedText: Our reporter learned that the China Securities Regulatory Commission will announce the punishment results of many major cases involving the capital market in the near future, and will crack down on various illegal activities in the capital market in accordance with the principle of "strict and expeditious" to protect the rights and interests of investors, especially small and medium-sized investors, to the greatest extent possible. Shanxi Tianneng, Xindadi, Henan Tianfeng and other cases have entered the investigation stage, and will be disclosed to the public in a timely manner based on the progress of the cases.

4531992f04f20d9a9b7780dcd687c49631bcd5b9.sourceText: 万福生科造假令人触目惊心 造假5年账目有三本
4531992f04f20d9a9b7780dcd687c49631bcd5b9.translatedText: Wanfu Biotech's fraud is shocking. There are three falsified accounts for five years

41842452081ffaccc35aa9a285686d14be3b3aba.sourceText: 万福生科被称为创业板造假上市第一案，其财务造假之恶劣令人触目惊心，记者获悉的一个细节：在万福生科遭调查期间，其拿出的账目竟有三本之多，这让调查人员都相当诧异。而在造假行径被曝光后，其董事长龚永福也很痛快地承认了财务造假的事实。
41842452081ffaccc35aa9a285686d14be3b3aba.translatedText: Wanfu Biotech is known as the first case of fraudulent listing on the GEM. Its financial fraud is shocking. The reporter learned a detail: During the investigation of Wanfu Biotech, it produced as many as three books of accounts, which surprised the investigators. After the fraud was exposed, its chairman Gong Yongfu also readily admitted the fact of financial fraud.

515fd975df35f51e7517dc113492e8148ec61eb9.sourceText: 据证监会公布的调查结果，为了达到公开发行股票并上市条件，根据董事长兼总经理龚永福决策并经财务总监覃学军安排人员执行，万福生科2008年至2010年分别虚增销售收入约12000万元、15000万元、19000万元，虚增营业利润约2851万元、3857万元、4590万元。
515fd975df35f51e7517dc113492e8148ec61eb9.translatedText: According to the investigation results announced by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, in order to meet the conditions for public issuance of stocks and listing, according to the decision of Chairman and General Manager Gong Yongfu and the arrangement of personnel by Chief Financial Officer Qin Xuejun, From 2008 to 2010, Wanfu Biotech inflated sales revenue by approximately 120 million yuan, 150 million yuan, and 190 million yuan respectively, and inflated operating profits by approximately 28.51 million yuan, 38.57 million yuan, and 45.9 million yuan.

fe7ad842c149a0b31f74b83e8c8926efe1b8c5ed.sourceText: 此外，万福生科2011年年度报告、2012年半年度报告存在虚假记载，其披露的2011年年报和2012年半年报虚增销售收入28000万元和16500万元，虚增营业利润6635万元和3435万元。
fe7ad842c149a0b31f74b83e8c8926efe1b8c5ed.translatedText: In addition, Wanfu Biotech's 2011 annual report and 2012 semi-annual report contained false records. The 2011 annual report and 2012 semi-annual report disclosed by it inflated sales revenue by 280 million yuan and 165 million yuan, and inflated operating profits by 66.35 million yuan and 34.35 million yuan.

119743c57b71924c2ca21898c56d197f79e5eb85.sourceText: 证监会此次对包括万福生科董事长在内的20名高管均进行了处罚，处罚广度之大为史上罕见，而万福生科、龚永福、覃学军的欺诈发行及虚假记载行为涉嫌犯罪，已移送公安机关追究刑事责任。
119743c57b71924c2ca21898c56d197f79e5eb85.translatedText: The China Securities Regulatory Commission has punished 20 senior executives, including the chairman of Wanfu Biotech. The breadth of the punishment is unprecedented in history. Wanfu Biotech, Gong Yongfu, and Qin Xuejun are suspected of committing fraudulent issuances and false records and have been transferred to the public security organs for criminal liability.

e3ce3a151c254c2498d772f8d26d076c66c0671c.sourceText: 《亚省时报》由半月报到週报，如今一週两报，不断加快见报的时效，尽可能地跟随飞跃发展的时势。不少读者来电来函来稿，支持编辑部能够识时务，看准当今华人社区多元化结构的需要，促进中文媒体素质的提高，提昇为当地华人社区服务的水准。 每期週三版，送报到发行点，行销一空。本地和外州读者纷纷新订或加订週三报。面对大的鼓励，编辑部将在加强週三版下功夫，拟在原有”国际””中国””港澳台湾””健康，养生””社区消息”等基础上，再增加”亚省简明新闻”’美西南新闻’ ，”社区动态””国际名厨拿手菜”等专栏，更全面地为当地华人侨胞服务。 为了让读者分享一週两报效益，从10月份起，己赠寄给每一订户週三出版的报纸多期。从现在起，欢迎各订户加订或新订。优惠：原订户加订週三报，一年只加$15； 新订户，一週寄二期，全年共104期，只$50。零取，週三报10￠，週五报25 ￠。
e3ce3a151c254c2498d772f8d26d076c66c0671c.translatedText: The "Alberta Times" has gone from bimonthly to weekly, and now publishes twice a week, constantly accelerating the timeliness of newspaper publication, and trying its best to follow the rapid development of the times. Many readers have called and written to support the editorial department in being aware of current affairs and the needs of the diversified structure of today's Chinese community, promoting the improvement of the quality of Chinese media, and improving the level of service to the local Chinese community. Every Wednesday edition is delivered to the distribution point and sold out. Local and out-of-state readers have added new or additional subscriptions to the Wednesday newspaper. In the face of great encouragement, the editorial department will work hard to strengthen the Wednesday edition, and plans to add columns such as "Alberta Concise News", "Southwest News", "Community Updates" and "International Famous Chef Specialties" on the basis of the original "International", "China", "Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan", "Health, Wellness" and "Community News" to more comprehensively serve local Chinese and overseas Chinese. In order to allow readers to share the benefits of having two newspapers a week, multiple issues of the newspaper published on Wednesdays will be sent to each subscriber starting from October. From now on, all subscribers are welcome to add or make new subscriptions. Discount: Original subscribers can add Wednesday newspapers for only $15 for a year; new subscribers can receive two issues a week for a total of 104 issues throughout the year for only $50. If it is zero, it will be quoted at 10￠ on Wednesday and 25￠ on Friday.

885892ed9a9b9a7d4fc06c979d94f8e48cf31990.sourceText: 十八大之年的中共震荡
885892ed9a9b9a7d4fc06c979d94f8e48cf31990.translatedText: The CCP’s shock in the year of the 18th National Congress

e6c3a574d8c0305b444253d92fb89e95ea538576.sourceText: 《华盛顿邮报》称，在中共高层震荡（shakeup）中，薄熙来被解雇，中国国务院副总理张德江将兼任重庆市委书记职位。《时代周刊》称，中国政治在最佳时期是朦胧的，但是薄熙来被免职正值中共领导层更迭这一敏感期，因为这段时期中共更神秘，决策往往都是幕后的。但王立军事件却将这种幕后操纵公开化。
e6c3a574d8c0305b444253d92fb89e95ea538576.translatedText: The Washington Post said that amid the shakeup at the top level of the CCP, Bo Xilai was fired and Zhang Dejiang, Vice Premier of the State Council of China, will concurrently serve as Secretary of the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee. "Times" said that Chinese politics is hazy at the best of times, but Bo Xilai's removal coincided with a sensitive period of leadership change in the CCP, because during this period the CCP was more mysterious and decisions were often made behind the scenes. But the Wang Lijun incident made this behind-the-scenes manipulation public.

1bc9ecf72dfc8e6011a0f415c13e30636c993d8f.sourceText: 路透社称，张德江保留副总理职位的同时接替薄熙来。该媒体引述北京学者话称，而且，现在看，温家宝14日的讲话代表了中共高层的集体观点：薄熙来需要离开。这将影响十八大大领导政治，因为谁将会当选十八大常委又出现新的不确定性。
1bc9ecf72dfc8e6011a0f415c13e30636c993d8f.translatedText: Reuters stated that Zhang Dejiang will retain the position of deputy prime minister while replacing Bo Xilai. The media quoted Beijing scholars as saying that, looking at it now, Wen Jiabao's speech on the 14th represents the collective view of the top leaders of the CCP: Bo Xilai needs to leave. This will affect the leadership politics of the 18th National Congress, because there will be new uncertainties about who will be elected to the Standing Committee of the 18th National Congress.

d843cae090a692c9705b2e250f87c9252941b55e.sourceText: 《纽约时报》题为”自命不凡（upstart）的中国领导人被罢黜”报道详细报道了薄熙来选任王立军到王立军接受调查的过程，称性急（brash）的薄熙来被免去重庆市职位是”（王立军）丑闻终结薄熙来政治雄心”的肯定迹象（unmistakable sign），这使得今秋中共权力更迭复杂化。
d843cae090a692c9705b2e250f87c9252941b55e.translatedText: The New York Times reported in detail the process from Bo Xilai's selection of Wang Lijun to Wang Lijun's investigation, titled "Upstart China Leader Deposed", saying that the dismissal of the brash Bo Xilai from his post in Chongqing was an "unmistakable sign that the (Wang Lijun) scandal ended Bo Xilai's political ambitions", which complicates the change of power in the CCP this autumn.

a23426bf838e961ecda78b6e3451aea7db1ac90d.sourceText: 一位接近中共高层的北京分析师称，他已经听说薄熙来会因王立军案件被调查并被指控违纪，但针对薄熙来的指控如何开展目前尚不明晰，可能要持续数月时间。该分析师认为，薄熙来目前无权无职。
a23426bf838e961ecda78b6e3451aea7db1ac90d.translatedText: A Beijing-based analyst close to the top leadership of the CCP said that he has heard that Bo Xilai will be investigated and charged with disciplinary violations in connection with the Wang Lijun case, but it is unclear how the charges against Bo Xilai will be carried out and may last for several months. The analyst believes that Bo Xilai currently has no power or position.

d8c6182beb5dab053f45ba84ad80d3f2680f5c50.sourceText: 不过，该报称，此类评价不可能随即得以证实，没有新的任命之前，薄熙来仍然有可能继续自己的政治生涯。
d8c6182beb5dab053f45ba84ad80d3f2680f5c50.translatedText: However, the newspaper stated that such an assessment could not be confirmed immediately, and that Bo Xilai may still continue his political career without a new appointment.

c5be7712905d9e9030d988f059bf739e0603085c.sourceText: 纽约时报还特别关注大陆新浪微博反应，称不乏嘲笑薄熙来的声音，但也有网友支持薄熙来为促进重庆市经济增长、改善农民收入和缩小收入差距所作出的努力。
c5be7712905d9e9030d988f059bf739e0603085c.translatedText: The New York Times also paid special attention to the reaction on mainland China's Sina Weibo, saying that there were many voices mocking Bo Xilai, but there were also netizens who supported Bo Xilai's efforts to promote economic growth in Chongqing, improve farmers' income and narrow the income gap.

b7fa8cece04e73b1ac3ed6218767aeb20066240f.sourceText: 中共领导更替突然转入高度戏剧化时期
b7fa8cece04e73b1ac3ed6218767aeb20066240f.translatedText: The leadership change of the CCP suddenly entered a period of high drama

5b414a0bb07fa10734a3069e846165517f1aaafb.sourceText: 《卫报》称，薄熙来被解职这一事件令人惊讶，因为在十八大举行前，中共尤其注重保持稳定和避免意外的发生。随着十八大热门人选（薄熙来）在（王立军）变节丑闻?#22768;中被”推翻”，中共领导更替突然转入极其戏剧化时期。中国取代（ousts)薄熙来重庆市委书记一职，可以说是中国政界最具戏剧化的事件。
5b414a0bb07fa10734a3069e846165517f1aaafb.translatedText: The Guardian said that Bo Xilai’s dismissal was surprising because before the 18th National Congress, the CCP paid special attention to maintaining stability and avoiding accidents. With the popular candidate for the 18th National Congress (Bo Xilai) being "overthrown" in the betrayal scandal (Wang Lijun), the leadership change of the CCP suddenly entered an extremely dramatic period. China's replacement of Bo Xilai as secretary of the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee can be said to be the most dramatic event in Chinese politics.

ff2624170cd3d497b1914720c4a65c132c367a63.sourceText: 该媒体还评价薄熙来是一位非常容易”造成不和”（divisive）的人物，其打黑运动虽然获得公众的高度欢迎，但也有人说，薄熙来践踏了法律，担心他成为一名铁腕人物。而且，温家宝总理在薄熙来被解职前1天还批评重庆市委要从王立军事件中汲取教训。而薄熙来本人在前几天坚称王立军事件是一孤立事件。
ff2624170cd3d497b1914720c4a65c132c367a63.translatedText: The media also commented that Bo Xilai is a figure who is very likely to "cause discord" (divisive). Although his anti-gang campaign has been highly welcomed by the public, some people say that Bo Xilai has trampled on the law and are worried that he will become a strongman. Moreover, one day before Bo Xilai was dismissed, Premier Wen Jiabao criticized the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee for learning lessons from the Wang Lijun incident. Bo Xilai himself insisted a few days ago that the Wang Lijun incident was an isolated incident.

e381351f618b502d1c14fc9b1956b0ee4da68a65.sourceText: 温家宝公开批评极其少见
e381351f618b502d1c14fc9b1956b0ee4da68a65.translatedText: >Wen Jiabao's public criticism is extremely rare

4e3681e646263dd7cfad35b061004bb994b02e85.sourceText: 中国国务院总理温家宝在14日记者会上表示，”粉碎’四人帮’以后，我们党虽然作出了若干历史问题的决议，实行了改革开放。但是”文革”的错误和封建的影响，并没有完全清除”。
4e3681e646263dd7cfad35b061004bb994b02e85.translatedText: > Chinese Premier Wen Jiabao said at a press conference on the 14th, "After smashing the 'Gang of Four,' although our party has made resolutions on a number of historical issues and implemented reform and opening up, the mistakes of the 'Cultural Revolution' and the influence of feudalism have not been completely eliminated."

2ee0f42a84aa94f0748c202a55fc3ddc7bb7cfb9.sourceText: 温家宝称，没有政治体制改革的成功，经济体制改革不可能进行到底，已经取得的成果还有可能得而复失，社会上新产生的问题，也不能从根本上得到解决，文化大革命这样的历史悲剧还有可能重新发生。
2ee0f42a84aa94f0748c202a55fc3ddc7bb7cfb9.translatedText: Wen Jiabao said that without the success of the political reform, the economic reform cannot be carried out to the end. The results that have been achieved may be lost again. New problems in society cannot be fundamentally solved. Historical tragedies such as the Cultural Revolution may happen again.

e3007c7106a90b7f29b83ed8c3748fd5088734ac.sourceText: 每个有责任的党员和领导干部都应该有紧迫感。
e3007c7106a90b7f29b83ed8c3748fd5088734ac.translatedText: Every responsible party member and leading cadre should have a sense of urgency.

827bf7a79e31760b24a4ed837ad84dae464d69b2.sourceText: 《金融时报》14日引述内部消息人士话称，中共官媒宣布薄熙来被解职正好时10天人大会议结束后第2天，而中共高层13日晚就已作出这一决定。13日当天，温家宝总理在记者会上对中共保守派官员予以警告，称开展政治改革要有紧迫感，否则中国可能面临第二次文化大革命。即将退休的温家宝在记者会上回应王立军事件，直接瞄准薄熙来，对薄予以公开批评，这在中共高层是极其少有的。王立军案件目前仍在调查当中，而曾在朝鲜学习的经济学家、副总理张德江接替薄熙来。
827bf7a79e31760b24a4ed837ad84dae464d69b2.translatedText: The Financial Times quoted internal sources on the 14th as saying that the Chinese Communist Party’s official media announced Bo Xilai’s dismissal just two days after the 10-day National People’s Congress ended, and the CCP’s senior leadership had already made this decision on the evening of the 13th. On the 13th, Premier Wen Jiabao warned conservative officials of the Chinese Communist Party at a press conference, saying that there must be a sense of urgency in carrying out political reforms, otherwise China may face a second Cultural Revolution. Wen Jiabao, who is about to retire, responded to the Wang Lijun incident at a press conference, directly targeting Bo Xilai and publicly criticizing Bo, which is extremely rare among senior leaders of the CCP. Wang Lijun's case is still under investigation, and Zhang Dejiang, an economist and deputy prime minister who studied in North Korea, succeeded Bo Xilai.

96d63a3450d44e2e443be3bc9de82c9db0dfb9a2.sourceText: 《华尔街日报》称，中共高层公开互相指责，即便是拐弯抹角地指责，也极其少见。所以，温家宝在记者会上的讲话可以被视为是针对薄熙来，以及薄所代表的政府模式的支持者的一大直接攻击（direct attack）。
96d63a3450d44e2e443be3bc9de82c9db0dfb9a2.translatedText: The Wall Street Journal stated that it is extremely rare for senior leaders of the Chinese Communist Party to publicly accuse each other, even if they are oblique. Therefore, Wen Jiabao's speech at the press conference can be regarded as a direct attack on Bo Xilai and the supporters of the government model that Bo represents.

d0a16476a60e4ff84efaf7cb17d9c27b60269771.sourceText: 西方媒体中，《华尔街日报》（该媒体3月14日曾对温家宝记者会进行网络博客文字直播）最早报道薄熙来被免职的消息，随后《彭博社》和《路透社》等相继转述中共官媒报道并予以评述。
d0a16476a60e4ff84efaf7cb17d9c27b60269771.translatedText: Among the Western media, the Wall Street Journal (which conducted a live broadcast of Wen Jiabao's press conference on March 14) was the first to report the news of Bo Xilai's dismissal. Subsequently, Bloomberg and Reuters successively reported and commented on the CCP official media reports.

ed7ef60958119e73e2ac23416a83c8521569ad98.sourceText: 《华尔街日报》称，自王立军事件以来，薄熙来就已卷入这场政治丑闻。而在周三（3月14日），中国国务院总理温家宝”露骨地抨击”（thinly veiled swipe at）了薄熙来，称重庆市官员必须从王立军事件中认真反思和汲取教训。更新报道后，该媒体称，在温总理最后一次公开记者会上对薄熙来进行了”不寻常”（unusual）指责的公开指责后，薄熙来这位引领和重振毛主义意识形态的中共领导人被解除了重庆市职位。而且，温家宝就王立军事件的回应”明显打击”（clear blow）了自由派阵营。
ed7ef60958119e73e2ac23416a83c8521569ad98.translatedText: The Wall Street Journal stated that Bo Xilai has been involved in this political scandal since the Wang Lijun incident. On Wednesday (March 14), Chinese Premier Wen Jiabao "thinly veiled swipe at" Bo Xilai, saying that Chongqing officials must seriously reflect on and learn lessons from the Wang Lijun incident. After updating the report, the media said that Bo Xilai, the CCP leader who pioneered and revived Maoist ideology, was dismissed from his position in Chongqing after Premier Wen made an "unusual" accusation against Bo Xilai at his last public press conference. Moreover, Wen Jiabao's response to the Wang Lijun incident "clearly blew" the liberal camp.

0b9748b4788be87911338f04c3f3003bbf78ec62.sourceText: 该报称，温家宝此番讲话前，分析人士认为薄很有可能在继续留在中央政治局，但很难成为常委。但是，目前看来，尽管薄熙来可能仍然留在政治局（新华社声明也未提及接触其政治局委员职位），但他的政治生涯实际上结束了。该媒体还注意到，温家宝在记者会末尾还提到文革，而在2011年，温家宝也曾首次提及自己父亲曾在文革期间受到迫害。《华尔街日报》随后一篇报道分析称，薄熙来被免去重庆市职位暴露出中共内部精英在今秋十八大前的”深度裂痕”（deep rifts)。
0b9748b4788be87911338f04c3f3003bbf78ec62.translatedText: The newspaper said that before Wen Jiabao's speech, analysts believed that Bo was likely to remain in the Politburo, but it would be difficult for him to become a member of the Standing Committee. However, it currently appears that while Bo Xilai may still remain in the Politburo (the Xinhua statement did not mention contact with his Politburo membership), his political career is effectively over. The media also noticed that Wen Jiabao mentioned the Cultural Revolution at the end of the press conference. In 2011, Wen Jiabao also mentioned for the first time that his father had been persecuted during the Cultural Revolution. A subsequent report in the Wall Street Journal analyzed that Bo Xilai's removal from his position in Chongqing exposed "deep rifts" within the CCP's internal elite before the 18th National Congress this fall.

0ef30199a18877469df36a5eb1ba4a129826bd91.sourceText: BBC也提到温家宝记者会上要求重庆市委反思王立军事件。该媒体称，薄熙来被解职正好是今年中国人大会议闭幕后第二天，在两会期间，薄熙来有时缺席会议则引发他未来仕途的猜测。后来，薄熙来告诉记者，对王立军事件，他自己也没有想到，非常意外，他用人不察。
0ef30199a18877469df36a5eb1ba4a129826bd91.translatedText: The BBC also mentioned that Wen Jiabao asked the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee to reflect on the Wang Lijun incident at the press conference. The media stated that Bo Xilai's dismissal happened to be the day after the conclusion of this year's National People's Congress. During the two sessions, Bo Xilai's sometimes absence from meetings triggered speculation about his future career. Later, Bo Xilai told reporters that he had not thought of the Wang Lijun incident and was very surprised. He did not pay attention to the personnel he employed.

86c79dfe4d32983ed5820e4f7170a753ea861945.translatedText: Bo Xilai has no hope of promotion

5be28532f0e2ae535177a5a24da959cac42e481d.sourceText: 路透社称，从薄熙来被”突然免职”（abrupt removal）可以看出，他有可能保留某种职位直至今年十八大，但是，他得到升迁的机会已经没有。
5be28532f0e2ae535177a5a24da959cac42e481d.translatedText: Reuters said that from Bo Xilai's "abrupt removal", it can be seen that he may retain some kind of position until the 18th National Congress this year, but his chance of promotion is gone.

219df4aaf24bd72bf03148b224220b8d42546f20.sourceText: 《时代周刊》称，薄熙来在重庆掀起的”唱红打黑运动”使得其国内外名声大振，但是，批评人士认为，薄熙来的打黑运动是对公民权利的冷酷对待，而”唱红运动”则使得某些人想起文化大革命。中国国务院总理温家宝在14日记者会上就提到”文革”的错误和封建的影响，并没有完全清除。
219df4aaf24bd72bf03148b224220b8d42546f20.translatedText: "Times" stated that Bo Xilai's "Singing Reds and Fighting Gangs Campaign" launched in Chongqing has made him famous at home and abroad. However, critics believe that Bo Xilai's "Crackdown on Gangs" campaign is a cruel treatment of civil rights, and the "Singing Reds Campaign" reminds some people of the Cultural Revolution. Chinese Premier Wen Jiabao mentioned at the press conference on the 14th that the mistakes of the "Cultural Revolution" and the feudal influence have not been completely eliminated.

1b5bed7ad659d31a9954045649ffca8f071ca484.sourceText: 该刊还提到，政治分析人士此前推测，薄熙来可能被予以某种名誉性职位，可能在人大担任某种职位。虽然中共官媒没有暗示薄熙来未来职位去向，但可以确定的是，薄熙来不会得到升迁。
1b5bed7ad659d31a9954045649ffca8f071ca484.translatedText: The magazine also mentioned that political analysts had previously speculated that Bo Xilai might be given some kind of honorary position and might hold some kind of position in the National People's Congress. Although the Chinese Communist Party’s official media did not hint at Bo Xilai’s future position, it is certain that Bo Xilai will not be promoted.

eb70dc9abac2f6e7a0017a6e5efc7920f4e097c4.sourceText: 《每日电讯报》称，目前尚不清楚薄熙来是否是自己请辞还是被迫免职。替代薄熙来的张德江是经济学领域的专家，曾在浙江和广东等地主政多年。
eb70dc9abac2f6e7a0017a6e5efc7920f4e097c4.translatedText: The Daily Telegraph stated that it is unclear whether Bo Xilai resigned on his own or was forced to be removed from office. Zhang Dejiang, who replaced Bo Xilai, is an expert in the field of economics and has been in power in Zhejiang and Guangdong for many years.

a763be0e35f5c5c409f0a82eaa07f41de8bdb675.sourceText: 美联社题为”王立军事件后，薄熙来遭解职”报道称，薄熙来是中共内部”最具雄心且异常绚丽”（most highly ambitious and unusually flamboyant）的官员之一，重庆职位被替换看来实际上是他政治生涯的结束。薄熙来被免职后，中共内部就18大常委的争夺很有可能更加激烈。但是中国国内有关薄熙来未来仕途的猜想基本可以歇一歇了。
a763be0e35f5c5c409f0a82eaa07f41de8bdb675.translatedText: The Associated Press report entitled "Bo Xilai was fired after the Wang Lijun incident" stated that Bo Xilai was one of the "most highly ambitious and unusually flamboyant" officials within the CCP, and his replacement in Chongqing seemed to actually be the end of his political career. After Bo Xilai was dismissed, the competition within the CCP for the 18th National Congress Standing Committee is likely to become more intense. But domestic speculation about Bo Xilai's future career can basically be put to rest.

62318a640870a208f4fd7a7c228aef983f97781d.sourceText: 房屋旺季的卖房技巧 三月底大凤凰城市区新上了27000个待售房屋，有人预计3月到6月会是房地产销售的旺季。 那么需要卖房子的人都有哪些技巧可寻呢？ 第一争取在30分钟内，收拾好房子让买家可以来看房。第二定价准确。如果房子有明显的优点和条件，建议在定价的时候高出市场价格5%到10%。如果没有什么特别的地方，一上市就盯准市场价，做到?#30701;拼快?#12290;让房屋的价格吸引顾客，获得购买合同。第三注重照片的展示。花一些钱，拍上25-30张的专业照片，放到每个需要销售的房屋信息栏内。照片是房屋给买家的第一印象，整洁大方，还要注意房屋结构的体现。 第四与房屋经纪有充分的沟通。第一次与房屋经纪交谈大约30-60分钟，了解目前房屋市场的情况。告诉经纪人自己房屋的特点，了解房屋交易中自己不懂的专业名词。第五关注买家的经济情况，特别是现金买家的银行存款证明，以及贷款买家的贷款证明。对于没有能力支付的买家，要降低期望值。第六除了房地产专业网站，还应该将房屋信息放到尽可能多的相关媒体上，创造接触买家的机会。更多地产新闻请咨询金信地产 Tinna 电话480-287-0180 E-mail：goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
62318a640870a208f4fd7a7c228aef983f97781d.translatedText: Tips for selling houses during the peak housing season. At the end of March, there were 27,000 new houses for sale in the greater Phoenix area. Some people expect that March to June will be the peak season for real estate sales. So what are some tips for people who need to sell a house? First, strive to pack up the house within 30 minutes so that buyers can view the house. Second, the pricing is accurate. If the house has obvious advantages and conditions, it is recommended to price it 5% to 10% higher than the market price. If there is nothing special, keep an eye on the market price as soon as it is listed, and make the price of the house attractive to customers and obtain a purchase contract. The third is to pay attention to the display of photos. Spend some money, take 25-30 professional photos, and put them in the information column of each house you want to sell. Photos are the first impression of a house to buyers. It should be neat and tidy, and attention should also be paid to the structure of the house. Fourth, have adequate communication with the housing agent. The first conversation with the real estate agent will take about 30-60 minutes to understand the current housing market situation. Tell the agent about the characteristics of your house and understand the professional terms that you don’t understand in house transactions. Fifth, pay attention to the buyer’s financial situation, especially the bank deposit certificate of the cash buyer and the loan certificate of the loan buyer. For buyers who cannot afford to pay, lower your expectations. Sixth, in addition to professional real estate websites, housing information should also be placed on as many relevant media as possible to create opportunities to contact buyers. 6a0864fb6d0d28d25c167cdf47315cfe03a356f1.translatedText: Colleges and universities require freshmen to sign a "suicide liability waiver", causing controversy

8d06cc87b2367c1d9b534d427f0fa147f19f690b.sourceText: 高校要求新生签“自杀免责书”引争议 昨日，广东东莞理工学院城市学院5000多名新生完成报到，他们踏入校园的…

Yesterday, more than 5,000 freshmen from Guangdong Dongguan Institute of Technology City College completed their registration, and they stepped into the campus...

efcbd8f778d388c8ff7aaddf616349f4cb9921b0.sourceText: 高校要求新生签“自杀免责书”引争议 昨日，广东东莞理工学院城市学院5000多名新生完成报到，他们踏入校园的第一件事，就是与校方签订《学生管理与学生自律协议书》。协议书明确：”学生本人对自杀、自伤引起的后果承担责任”。 进校园先交协议书 一个月前，来自潮州的李军收到录取通知书，发现一同寄来的还有《学生管理与学生自律协议书》。协议书第三章第二十七条共列举了5种由学生承担责任的情况，其中第5项协议规定，学生本人对自杀、自伤引起的后果承担责任。 这位大一新生很反感：”这个就相当于学校给你提供吃、住的场所，但不顾你是否健康成长。我们在学校出事了，学校难道没有一点责任？”在14日和昨日开学报到的两天里，5000多名新生同时把这份由学生与家长签订好的协议书交给校方。 条款引起学生热议 不久前，在东莞理工学院城市学院，一名男生因求爱不成而在宿舍里刀捅女生。为此，协议书引起了新生的议论。一名新生说，”我觉得怪怪的，觉得学校缺乏人文关怀，只会用冷冰冰的协议来推卸责任。”一名新生家长对这项规定表示不满，他说，自己把孩子送到这里，是希望学校有个安全的环境，让家长放心，放手让孩子成长，”如果孩子在学校出事了，我们第一反应会找学校要说法，毕竟我们信任这个学校，才将孩子送到这里。” 不过，也有学生表示理解，因为大学生自杀和自伤可以由很多因素造成，例如感情问题、家庭问题、人际问题等，这些因素不一定全是学校造成的。大学生过了18周岁就成年了，有对自己负责的义务。大部分学校会提供心理健康咨询，但有些同学有自闭倾向，不愿咨询。这些同学如果有自杀、自伤行为，就应该自己负责。 校方称签协议早存在 记者就此事采访了校方相关负责人。该负责人告诉记者，协议的意义类似”温馨提示”，是对学生的文明约定，目的是告知新生在宿舍需要注意的事项，从而实现要求自律的目的。例如，学生不遵守宿舍纪律，攀爬阳台而掉到楼下了受伤，那就要自负责任了。 该负责人表示，这份协议书的条款存在多年了，并非针对不久前发生的”情伤事件”。事实上，没有这样一份协议书，学生违反了纪律，也会受到相应处罚，而学校要负起的责任，也不会因为这份协议书随意地推卸。 此类条款是无效的 ”关乎生命的事情，怎么能拿来协议？” 21世纪教育研究院副院长熊丙奇告诉记者，这样的条款并非东莞理工学院城市学院一家独有，很多高校都存在类似的”自杀免责”条款，而实际上此类条款是无效的。 熊丙奇建议说，如果真从学生健康出发，大学首要考虑的不是万一出现伤害事故怎样免责，而应从完善学校的管理，为学生创造良好的学习生活环境着手。”签订协议书被认为是一种安全教育方式，可见学校对学生教育的方式多么简单、粗暴，这与家长不给孩子讲道理、循循善诱，就让孩子签订不犯错误协议书，有何差别呢？” 相关阅读： 熊丙奇：”免责”式教育让教育缺乏人性 有关调查显示，这种”教育方式”有在中小学蔓延之势，而”免责式”教育之所以流行，主要有两方面原因。其一，教育严重行政化，学校办学完全采取对上负责的方式，由于上级主管部门将校园安全事故作为考核学校领导、评价学校办学的重要指标，因此，学校上下层层落实安全责任，大家在安全责任的压力之下，宁可不尊重教育规律，也不想得领导”差评”影响职位和饭碗。 ” 自杀免责书”更像一种道德绑架 中国人历来讲究一个吉祥如意，刚进大学门就要签”生死协议”，多少都让人感到很别扭，恰如饭碗里吃到了一只苍蝇。其实，只要学生在校园里发生自杀、自伤事件，即便签署了这样的免责书，校方也难辞其咎，因为免责书涉嫌霸王条款，所以校方难脱干系，相信公正的法律不会罔顾事实，置学生的生命于不顾。
efcbd8f778d388c8ff7aaddf616349f4cb9921b0.translatedText: Colleges and universities require freshmen to sign a "suicide exemption form" causing controversy. Yesterday, more than 5,000 freshmen from the City College of Dongguan Institute of Technology in Guangdong completed their registration. The first thing they did when they stepped onto campus was to sign a "Student Management and Student Self-Discipline Agreement" with the school. The agreement clearly states: "The students themselves bear responsibility for the consequences of suicide and self-injury." Submit the agreement before entering the campus. A month ago, Li Jun from Chaozhou received the admission notice and found that it also came with the "Student Management and Student Self-Discipline Agreement." Chapter 3, Article 27 of the agreement lists five situations in which students bear responsibility. The fifth agreement stipulates that students themselves bear responsibility for the consequences of suicide and self-injury. This freshman was very disgusted: "This is equivalent to the school providing you with food and accommodation, but not caring about whether you grow up healthily. If something happens to us at school, doesn't the school have any responsibility?" During the two days of registration on the 14th and yesterday, more than 5,000 freshmen simultaneously handed over the agreement signed by the students and their parents to the school. The clause caused heated discussion among students. Not long ago, at the City College of Dongguan Institute of Technology, a boy stabbed a girl in the dormitory because he failed to court her. For this reason, the agreement has aroused renewed discussion. A new student said, "I find it strange. I feel that the school lacks humanistic care and only uses cold agreements to shirk responsibility." A parent of a new student expressed dissatisfaction with this rule. He said that he sent his children here because he hoped that the school would have a safe environment so that parents could rest assured and let their children grow up. "If something happens to the child at school, our first reaction will be to find an explanation from the school. After all, we trust this school and that is why we send our children here." However, some students expressed their understanding because college students' suicide and self-injury can be caused by many factors, such as emotional problems, family problems, interpersonal problems, etc., and these factors are not necessarily caused by the school. College students become adults after they turn 18 and have the obligation to take responsibility for themselves. Most schools will provide mental health consultation, but some students have autistic tendencies and are unwilling to seek consultation. If these students commit suicide or self-injury, they should take responsibility themselves. The school claimed that the signed agreement had existed for a long time. The reporter interviewed the relevant person in charge of the school on this matter. The person in charge told reporters that the meaning of the agreement is similar to a "warm reminder" and is a civilized agreement for students. The purpose is to inform freshmen of matters they need to pay attention to in the dormitory, so as to achieve the purpose of requiring self-discipline. For example, if a student fails to abide by the dormitory rules and climbs on the balcony and falls downstairs and gets injured, he or she will be responsible for it. The person in charge said that the terms of this agreement have existed for many years and are not aimed at the "emotional injury incident" that occurred not long ago. In fact, without such an agreement, students who violate discipline will be punished accordingly, and the school will not shirk its responsibilities because of this agreement. Such clauses are invalid. "How can we reach an agreement on matters related to life?" Xiong Bingqi, deputy director of the 21st Century Education Research Institute, told reporters that such clauses are not unique to Dongguan Institute of Technology City College. Many universities have similar "suicide exemption" clauses. In fact, such clauses are invalid. Xiong Bingqi suggested that if students’ health is truly taken into consideration, the university’s first priority is not how to exempt students from liability in the event of an injury, but should start by improving the school’s management and creating a good learning and living environment for students. "Signing an agreement is considered a safe education method, which shows how simple and rude the school's way of educating students is. How is this different from parents who do not reason with their children and ask them to sign an agreement not to make mistakes?" Related reading: Xiong Bingqi: "Exemption-free" education makes education less humane. Relevant surveys show that this "education method" has a tendency to spread in primary and secondary schools, and there are two main reasons why "exemption-free" education is popular. First, education is heavily administrativeized, and schools are run in a completely upward-responsible manner. Because higher-level authorities regard campus safety incidents as an important indicator for assessing school leaders and evaluating school operations, safety responsibilities are implemented at all levels of the school. Under the pressure of safety responsibilities, everyone would rather not respect the laws of education than get a "bad review" from the leader that would affect their position and job. "Suicide exemption form" is more like a kind of moral kidnapping. Chinese people have always been particular about auspiciousness, and they have to sign a "life and death agreement" when they first enter university. This makes people feel awkward, just like eating a fly in the rice bowl. In fact, as long as a student commits suicide or self-injury on campus, even if he signs such a liability waiver, the school cannot absolve himself of the blame. Because the liability waiver is suspected of having an overbearing clause, it is difficult for the school to escape involvement. I believe that fair laws will not ignore the facts and disregard the lives of students.

d502863d50132017e73c160d97bb0e8c19fd9e39.sourceText: 金信地产新闻：老年人，年轻人对房屋价格的影响 婴儿潮出生的老年人，以及现在的孩子，在未来20年里对全国的房地产发展趋势有重大的影响。在一个最新的报道”美国房屋市场的人口挑战和机遇”中，研究人员通过研究人口数据的发展趋势，来预测未来住房的影响，以及房屋拥有率。 婴儿潮出生的美国中老年人，年龄子在65岁以上的，在未来会增加30万，人口的转变可能会有利于房屋供给，因为65岁以上的人口通常会占有比他们自身消费能力的更多的房屋。 全国房地产经纪人协会首席经济学家劳伦斯云说：”东北部和中西部最有可能看到大量老龄业主出售房屋给年轻业主”。 这种供应量增加，可能意味着年轻人有更多买进机会。年轻一代人将吸收库存量的75-80％到2020年。 年轻一代包括1981年和1995年之间出生的近65万人。全国房地产经纪人协会的分析说明了这一代人的需求，”住房，就业和经济密不可分，”云说。 ”具有良好的住房市场条件下的强劲复苏将鼓励年轻家庭的大幅增长，这将有助于吸收当前的空置库存和稳定住宅建筑的条件。市场在一个合理的恢复的情况下，约12万个新的家庭将在未来十年内形成，需要建设15万个新公屋单位。” 全国房地产经纪人协会主席的萌Veissi注意到，”作为出租房屋​​的供应量会持续下降，租金增加，”他说”同时，具有刚性需求的自住屋的买家，也会增加。” 更多地产新闻请谘询金信地产Tinna电话480-287-0180E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com 。
d502863d50132017e73c160d97bb0e8c19fd9e39.translatedText: Jinxin Real Estate News: The Impact of Old People, Young People on House Prices Older people born in the baby boom, as well as today’s children, will have a significant impact on the country’s real estate development trends in the next 20 years. In a new report, "Demographic Challenges and Opportunities in the U.S. Housing Market," researchers looked at trends in demographic data to predict the future impact of housing, as well as homeownership rates. The number of middle-aged and elderly Americans born by baby boomers, those aged 65 and over, will increase by 300,000 in the future. The demographic transition may be beneficial to housing supply, because people over 65 years old usually occupy more houses than their own consumption capacity. "The Northeast and Midwest are most likely to see a large number of older owners selling to younger owners," said Lawrence Yun, chief economist for the National Association of Realtors. This increase in supply may mean more buying opportunities for young people. The younger generation will absorb 75-80% of the inventory by 2020. The younger generation includes nearly 650,000 people born between 1981 and 1995. The National Association of Realtors' analysis illustrates the needs of this generation, "housing, employment and the economy are inseparable," Yun said. "A strong recovery with good housing market conditions will encourage substantial growth in young households, which will help absorb the current vacancy stock and stabilize residential building conditions. In the case of a reasonable market recovery, about 120,000 new households will be formed over the next decade, requiring the construction of 150,000 new public housing units." Meng Veissi, president of the National Association of Realtors, noted that "as the supply of rental housing will continue to decline, rents will increase," he said. "At the same time, buyers of owner-occupied houses with rigid demand will also increase." c51f8c0360c7c9f12a42c9e8efb27f5d52b3a713.sourceText: 据大公网报道，最近有传闻，原中国铁道部部长刘志军以及总后勤部原副部长谷俊山将被双双判处死刑。
c51f8c0360c7c9f12a42c9e8efb27f5d52b3a713.translatedText: According to Dagong.com, there are recent rumors that Liu Zhijun, the former Minister of Railways of China, and Gu Junshan, the former Deputy Minister of the General Logistics Department, will both be sentenced to death.

2815d9c6ca8f101a510e1b626ddbde5dbce1a627.sourceText: 因刘志军被抓，铁道部的贪腐黑幕被揭开。其贪污和挪用公款、违规收费获利、账外存放资金、弄虚作假骗取拆迁补偿等黑幕陆续被曝光。
2815d9c6ca8f101a510e1b626ddbde5dbce1a627.translatedText: Due to the arrest of Liu Zhijun, the corruption scandal of the Ministry of Railways was revealed. Its corruption and misappropriation of public funds, profits from illegal charges, depositing funds outside the accounts, and fraud to obtain demolition compensation have been exposed one after another.

85278bd3f8c20b6c9e7d1c94358d069b104e1b8b.sourceText: 刘志军在铁道部部长任上，将几万亿元人民币的铁路建设基金当作自己的小金库，将关系国计民生的铁路工程作为巴结权贵、升官晋爵的桥梁，更与一些奸商内外勾结，套取几十亿元的民脂民膏，使一些铁路工程沦为豆腐渣。
85278bd3f8c20b6c9e7d1c94358d069b104e1b8b.translatedText: When Liu Zhijun was the Minister of Railways, he used the railway construction fund worth several trillion yuan as his own treasury, and used railway projects related to the national economy and people's livelihood as a bridge to curry favor with the powerful and get promoted. He also colluded with some profiteers, both internal and external, to siphon off billions of yuan of people's wealth, turning some railway projects into rubbish.

643d29c1b80315a7b4ccd724fb33e9ef64deddc7.sourceText: 至于谷俊山，曾掌握全军的土地基建大权，在军用土地的征用、置换过程中，获利巨大。他在北京打造豪华的将军府，家中藏有的茅台酒多达上万瓶。
643d29c1b80315a7b4ccd724fb33e9ef64deddc7.translatedText: As for Gu Junshan, he once controlled the land and infrastructure construction of the entire army and made huge profits in the process of expropriation and replacement of military land. He built a luxurious general's mansion in Beijing, and kept tens of thousands of bottles of Maotai liquor in his home.

8c4cb4982dccd48344d7cdfd8bc0c20b7c3277c4.sourceText: 习近平上台伊始即与中纪委书记王岐山联手导演了一场反腐风暴，军队反腐更是他关注的重中之重。
8c4cb4982dccd48344d7cdfd8bc0c20b7c3277c4.translatedText: When Xi Jinping came to power, he jointly directed an anti-corruption storm with Wang Qishan, Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and anti-corruption in the military was his top priority.

6f9e802ae60195e0787c8aef8e0e488dd3d07165.sourceText: 谷俊山，男，1956年10月出生，河南濮阳人。
6f9e802ae60195e0787c8aef8e0e488dd3d07165.translatedText: Gu Junshan, male, born in October 1956, from Puyang, Henan.

6921d4ca93f305405d1304d8d5f00083b1e34a32.sourceText: 曾任总后基建营房部办公室主任、营房土地管理局局长，总后勤部基建营房部副部长。
6921d4ca93f305405d1304d8d5f00083b1e34a32.translatedText: He served as the director of the General Logistics Department’s Infrastructure and Barracks Department Office, the director of the Barracks Land Management Bureau, and the deputy director of the General Logistics Department’s Infrastructure and Barracks Department.

bbdd68cba6553eb9c06a4c45dcf8dbaf83a1a39e.sourceText: 2007年6月任总后勤部基建营房部部长，全军绿化委员会办公室主任、全军房改办公室主任等职。
bbdd68cba6553eb9c06a4c45dcf8dbaf83a1a39e.translatedText: In June 2007, he served as the director of the Infrastructure and Barracks Department of the General Logistics Department, the director of the Office of the Army Greening Committee, and the director of the Army Housing Reform Office.

3d4a9cf0601e741cd868db68cbcf454019614d24.translatedText: In December 2009, he was appointed as Deputy Minister of the General Logistics Department.

08585374978de1eb2845892f32f731a0d9f5cc83.sourceText: 2003年7月晋升为少将军衔。2011年晋升为中将军衔。
08585374978de1eb2845892f32f731a0d9f5cc83.translatedText: Promoted to the rank of major general in July 2003. In 2011, he was promoted to the rank of lieutenant general.

ee3059100737b979e01d565235e182ec774cc8f9.sourceText: 2012年2月11日，解放军总后勤部进行人事调整，55岁的谷俊山不再担任副部长一职。
ee3059100737b979e01d565235e182ec774cc8f9.translatedText: On February 11, 2012, the PLA General Logistics Department made personnel adjustments, and 55-year-old Gu Junshan no longer served as deputy minister.

ca061072ba52c103a9b285e7525c4f93e8f89dfd.sourceText: 男，汉族，湖北鄂州人。中央党校研究生学历，工程师。曾任中华人民共和国铁道部部长。
ca061072ba52c103a9b285e7525c4f93e8f89dfd.translatedText: Male, Han nationality, from Ezhou, Hubei Province. Postgraduate degree from the Party School of the Central Committee, engineer. Served as the Ministry of Railways of the People's Republic of China Director.

2d9d935d26dd109041fab5fe9c6c33002d850491.sourceText: 2011年2月，因涉嫌严重违纪，被免去其党组书记职务。2月15日，全国人大常委会免去其铁道部部长职务。
2d9d935d26dd109041fab5fe9c6c33002d850491.translatedText: In February 2011, he was dismissed from his position as Party Secretary. On February 15, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress dismissed him from the position of Minister of Railways.

300858c97dfb924831927d131b5fc88ffeeb2ce7.sourceText: 2011年12月28日上午，国务院常务会议作出了对”7 23”甬温线特别重大铁路交通事故的处理决定：原铁道部部长刘志军负主要责任，因涉嫌严重违纪违法问题，另案一并处理。

Due to suspected serious violations of discipline and law, a separate case was handled together.

dfbfd5af523de2552e8bdbd4b13ae4a5d52d24ac.translatedText: Treasury Secretary visits Arizona to visit Intel (Alberta Times) U.S. Treasury Secretary Gaynor visited Arizona on Tuesday and visited the Intel factory in Chandler. Gaynor stressed the importance of investing in domestic production, such as Intel's new factory in Chandler. Intel officials say they have invested billions of dollars in Arizona to build factories to make high-tech products. "Infrastructure investment provides one of the most powerful ways to help hundreds of thousands of Americans who have lost their jobs during the housing crisis, especially construction workers, get back to work," said the U.S. Treasury Secretary. The Treasury secretary was visiting to promote President Obama's job creation bill and met with local business leaders to discuss ways to lower taxes.

05c4569f2c5dd1f58717a830c70073fae8425ee5.translatedText: Holding the 50 million yuan cooperation letter of intent just signed with the mainland travel agency, Wang Shihao, associate manager of the Mainland Travel Division of Taiwan Southeast Travel Agency, said with joy: " The prospects for cross-strait tourism cooperation are very promising, and Taiwan is looking forward to the upcoming opening of individual tours. "

cf85d2f53b641231da3bb426815c7645556457ec.sourceText: 在黑龙江举行的第二届亚布力两岸经贸论坛上，多家台湾旅行社来到黑龙江与大陆旅游行业同仁对接洽谈、签订合作协议。台湾旅游界人士表示，即将于６月２８日启动的大陆居民赴台个人游有利于两岸人民增进交流了解，也将促进台湾旅游业向精致化方向发展。
cf85d2f53b641231da3bb426815c7645556457ec.translatedText: At the second Yabuli Cross-Strait Economic and Trade Forum held in Heilongjiang, a number of Taiwanese travel agencies came to Heilongjiang to negotiate and sign cooperation agreements with colleagues in the mainland tourism industry. People in Taiwan's tourism industry said that the upcoming individual tours for mainland residents to Taiwan, which will be launched on June 28, will help enhance exchanges and understanding between people on both sides of the Taiwan Strait and will also promote the development of Taiwan's tourism industry in a more refined direction.

7bb98653a8fe936e735a776ed1ff2bed050ba612.sourceText: ”过去团体旅游都是团进团出，受限较多，个人游相对更加自由，对台湾既是机遇也是挑战。”王士豪说，个人游推动下，台湾的旅游线路以及餐饮服务业都将更加精致。
7bb98653a8fe936e735a776ed1ff2bed050ba612.translatedText: "In the past, group travel was in and out of groups, which was more restricted. Individual travel is relatively more free, which is both an opportunity and a challenge for Taiwan." Wang Shihao said that with the promotion of individual travel, Taiwan's tourism routes and catering service industry will become more refined.

167367d5c8df12fd4d19bb65f8ee0be65553ac74.sourceText: 台湾观光主管部门日前发布的预测显示，大陆居民赴台个人游开放后，以每日５００人停留７－１５天、每人日均消费２４５．４３美元计算，一年将迎来游客１８．２５万人次，为岛内相关产业带进收益９１亿至１９５亿元新台币。
167367d5c8df12fd4d19bb65f8ee0be65553ac74.translatedText: A forecast recently released by Taiwan's tourism authorities shows that after the opening of individual travel to Taiwan by mainland residents, assuming that 500 people stay for 7-15 days per day and the average daily consumption per person is US$245.43, there will be 182,500 tourists a year, bringing revenue of NT$9.1 billion to NT$19.5 billion to related industries on the island.

fd760e2c717835a3545f5466b97c5ac0c21e0270.sourceText: 人们一直认为个人游肯定比旅游团量更大，台湾的官方、民间、旅行社都在努力做好一切准备。
fd760e2c717835a3545f5466b97c5ac0c21e0270.translatedText: People have always believed that individual tours must be larger than tour groups. Taiwan's official, private and travel agencies are working hard to make all preparations.

ef89036a91897168466c33e17749685f06d6962b.sourceText: 总统大选 亚利桑那州在摇摆中 今年是大选年，大至问鼎白宫、国会议员，小至校区监督，林林总总的拉票令人眼花缭乱，说到底只是共和党和民主党的较量。亚利桑那州，一直以来作为共和党的强健票仓，殊不知也在悄悄改变中。 落基山民调上周末发布一个调查显示，在参议院候选人中，民主党和共和党的支持率相差无几，这种现象很长一段时间内在本州实属少见。根据调查，本州有44%选民支持奥巴马，共和党人罗姆尼支持率为42%，竞争激烈。 种种数据表明，亚利桑那州跟以往大选不一样，已成为摇摆州。造成这种现象，是大量拉丁美裔加入选民行列，并且成为重要票源。 根据这次民调的负责伯格分析，在本州，77%拉丁美裔选民支持奥巴马，罗姆尼只有10%，49%白人选民青睐罗姆尼，33%选奥巴马。在共和党执政的亚利桑那，移民政策则是这次失票的主要原因。 得摇摆者得白宫，离11月6日投票日还有20天，强劲的拉丁美裔票源会不会助民主党稳住白宫宝座？很快就揭晓。
ef89036a91897168466c33e17749685f06d6962b.translatedText: Presidential election, Arizona is swinging This year is an election year. From aspiring for the White House and members of Congress to as small as school district supervision, the various canvassing for votes is dazzling. In the final analysis, it is just a contest between the Republicans and the Democrats. Arizona, which has always been a strong vote base for the Republican Party, is also quietly changing. A survey released by Rocky Mountain Poll last weekend showed that the Democratic and Republican support rates for Senate candidates are almost the same. This phenomenon has been rare in this state for a long time. According to the survey, 44% of voters in this state support Obama, while Republican Romney's support rate is 42%. The competition is fierce. Various data show that Arizona, unlike previous general elections, has become a swing state. This phenomenon is caused by a large number of Latinos joining the electorate and becoming an important source of votes. According to the analysis of Berg, who is responsible for this poll, in this state, 77% of Latino voters support Obama, while only 10% of Romney. 49% of white voters favor Romney, and 33% choose Obama. In Republican-governed Arizona, immigration policy was the main reason for the vote loss. The swinger will win the White House. There are still 20 days before the voting day on November 6. Will the strong Latino vote help the Democratic Party secure the White House? It will be revealed soon.

b9e4bc63a7d348f03080a777e076beb5615496f2.sourceText: 凤凰城华裔女审判长邓周雅定成为亚利桑那四十八位最有魅力女性之一 （亚省时报译） 在亚利桑那建州百年的系列活动中，凤凰城华裔女审判长邓周雅定（ Roxanne Song Ong）被评选为亚利桑那州四十八位最有魅力女性之一。2005年邓周雅定成为凤凰城市法院第一位首席华裔女审判长。 她拥有很多的殊荣，亚利桑那的法学家，Sandra Day O’Connor (Ret) Supreme Court法院大法官，美国最高法院的第一位女性，服务于州参议原的主要女领袖。 这四十八位获奖女性的名单被列在 www.48women.org 上，其中包括华裔女众议院余艳芬以及前州长Rose Mofford, Jane D. Hull and Janet Napolitano,美国联邦最高法院大法官Sandra Day O’Connor,以及美国众议员Gabrielle Giffords等等。 另外本次评选活动的主席科尼（Connie Robinson）说：”选委员会知道很多亚利桑那的女性每天都非常努力工作，为了提高他人的生活质量，让亚利桑那变得更美好。这次全州参与提名的女性的数量和质量都证明了这些。他们的工作和信念是非常了不起的。”
b9e4bc63a7d348f03080a777e076beb5615496f2.translatedText: Roxanne Song Ong, a Chinese-American female judge in Phoenix City, was selected as one of the 48 most attractive women in Arizona (Translated by the Alberta Times) In a series of events commemorating the 100th anniversary of the founding of the state of Arizona, Roxanne Song Ong, a Chinese-American female judge in Phoenix City, was selected as one of the 48 most attractive women in Arizona. In 2005, Zhou Yading Deng became the first Chinese-American female chief judge of the Phoenix City Court. She has many honors, Arizona jurist, Sandra Day O’Connor (Ret) Supreme Court Justice, the first woman on the U.S. Supreme Court, and a major female leader serving in the state Senate. The list of the 48 award-winning women is listed on www.48women.org, including Chinese-American female House of Representatives Yu Yanfen and former governors Rose Mofford, Jane D. Hull and Janet Napolitano, U.S. Supreme Court Justice Sandra Day O’Connor, and U.S. Representative Gabrielle Giffords, etc. In addition, Connie Robinson, chairman of this selection event, said: "The selection committee knows that many Arizona women work very hard every day to improve the quality of life for others and make Arizona a better place. The number and quality of women nominated this time across the state prove this. Their work and belief are extraordinary."

1753bf809c919545b9c4d3ab92809fd618d34622.sourceText: 送舊迎新又一年 送舊迎新又一年 鳳凰城 氣如虹 「又一年了 ！ 」 當冬 至 節吃過香甜的湯 圓， 當欣 賞 過聖 誕 的輝 煌 燈 飾， 廳 堂 已換 上 新的日 曆 、月 曆， 感 慨 時 光 飛逝 ， 免 不了 輕輕嘆 息： 「又一年了 ！ 」 時光飛逝不留人 ， 即 使 喜 歡 或不喜 歡， 地 球 永 遠 旋 轉， 日 子 不停向 前 邁 進。 回 顧 去 年 迎 接 2017 降 臨， 我在鳳 凰 城六福酒 家， 筵開四 席， 邀 請 親 友 出 席 跨 年 宴 會 ， 同 時 作為兒 媳婦 保燕初來美 國 的見 面禮， 親 友 聯歡聚 首， 舉 杯 暢 飲， 接 續 是送舊迎新的倒 數 活 動， 無 比 興 奮， 記 憶 猶在 ， 不旋 踵 又是一年了 。 今回迎 接 2018 年 ， 我沒 有 參 加 倒 數 活 動， 只出 席 女 兒 國欣安 排 的歡 聚 晚宴 ， 地點在美莎市新世 界 酒 家； 國欣偕夫 婿 光漢 ， 攜 帶 外孫 女 慧嫺到 場， 打 算 三代同 堂 送舊迎新 ， 聯歡聚會 ； 由 於 事 先 各有節 目 預 約， 未能全部蒞 臨； 只 有 老二國風、瓊 瑤 一家五口齊齊赴 會， 那就很好了 ， 足 以 令我夫 婦 老懷高興 ， 因 為 這 樣 子 ， 三個內孫 ： 子龍、子洋和美思 ， 加 上 外孫女 ， 總共四個小孫聚 合 一起嬉 戲， 實 在 難 得； 而孩 提 趣緻 ， 天 真 活 潑， 讓我兩老在送舊迎新時 刻， 能 夠 弄孫作樂 ， 開懷嘻 笑， 安慰無 限， 沒 有必 要再等 待 倒 數 的十秒哩 ！ 何 況， 今 年 增 添 的兩個孫女 ， 外 孫 女慧嫺九個月大 ， 內孫女美思剛過兩個月 ， 都要早些回 家 休 息 睡眠 ， 不適 宜 拖 延 至深 夜 狂 歡。 所 以， 九時多就宣 佈 散席 ， 互 相 揮 手 道別 ， 我順 便 向在酒 家 遇 到 的幾位朋 友 說聲再會 ， 還 有 是要感 謝 內兄陳財順 ， 他身 體 不舒 服， 仍 然 到 來 相聚 ， 特 地 送禮 物 給侄孫們 ， 讓他 們 快 樂 迎新 。 驪 歌 奏起 ， 握 手 抱拳 ， 告 別 在即 ， 明 天 是新年 ， 各 人 都脫 口而出： 「又一年了 ！ 」 的 確， 又一年了 ！ 我一路駕 車 回 家， 沿 途 見 到 、聽 到 零 星 的煙 花 沖 天 景 象， 人 們 都為送舊迎新發 出 呼叫 聲。 我夫 婦 今 晚 很高興 ， 回味着剛 才 幾個孫 兒 的逗 笑 活 潑 動 態， 真 的 很可愛 ， 想想也不期然泛 起 微 笑， 帶着愉 快 的心 情， 沒打 算 再去熱 鬧 地 方 擠 迫 倒 數 了 。 直 接 回 到 家中 ， 開 啟 電 視 機 ， 觀 看 翡 翠 台的報 導， 香港維港的煙 花 綻放 ， 台 灣 一零一大 樓 的煙 花 噴 射， 都在螢 光幕 中輝 煌 展 現， 在在顯 示 新的一年就到 來， 全 世界 都迎 接 2018 。 期 望 新年新機運 ， 國 際 和 平， 萬民幸 福。 我一邊看電 視， 一邊又聽 到 外面燃 放 煙 花 的迫卜響 聲， 引 起 我一陣感想 ， 引 起 我回 顧 一下現 實 的生 活 過 程， 引 起 我的一段回 憶。 記 得 學 生 時 代， 擁 有 過一本精 美 的「華 僑 日記」 ， 每 月 都有一篇警 世 文 章， 其 中 十二月 份 的一篇 是： 〈檢 討 過去 ， 策 勵 將 來 〉 ， 規 勸 我 們 在一年的盡 頭， 仔 細 檢 討 過 去 的優 劣， 從 而 訂 定 未 來 一年的行 動 大計 ， 勵 精圖治， 奔 向 前 程。 因 而， 此 後 我都在新年來 臨 時 ， 立 下 新願 望， 預定新計 畫， 只可惜生逢亂 世， 碰 上 最殘 酷 的越戰時 代， 從年幼開 始 的半個世 紀， 歷 經 法屬、日據、美援、越戰以 至 共 產 專政等 等， 一 連串 動 盪 不安的日 子， 正 是 人在江 湖， 身 不由己， 大好青 年 無用武之地 ， 難 以 實踐自 己 的理 想 計 畫， 環 境 逼 人， 只能為着迎 合 局 勢 謀 生， 無 可奈何。 有機 會 移 民 美 國 時 ， 却將 近 花甲年華 ， 人地生 疏， 環 境 不熟 ， 語 言 不通 ， 習 俗 不 同， 文 化 衝 激， 又要從零開 始， 從頭再起 ， 真個滿 腹 煩 難， 艱 澀 渡日 。 直至退 休 後 ， 才算安 穩 下 來， 但已 經 進 入 夕 陽 斜 照 的耆 老 境 界， 還 有 什 麼 勁 力 發 揮 呢 ？ 惟 有 休 閒 渡日 ， 閱 報 上網 ， 隨筆素 描， 吟詩作文 ， 打發漫 長 的日子 ； 或 者 含笑弄孫 ， 與兒 女 歡 聚 同樂 ， 是長者的寶 貴 時 刻。 經 濟 許 可 的時 候， 回 歸 越 南 故 里， 探親訪友 ， 知足為樂 。 偶 爾 興 起， 則到 處 旅 遊， 享 受 夕 陽餘暉， 自得其樂 。 值 得 告 慰 的是 ， 到目 前 為 止， 我夫 婦 雖 然 年過古 稀， 體康還算良好 ， 可 以 隨 處 去 ， 仍可 以 和大 家 一 起 歡 樂 團 聚， 送舊迎新 。 如 今是 新的一年到 來， 希 望 新年行好運 ， 只 是 免 不了 循 例 的一聲慨 嘆： 「這 麼 快又一年了 ！ 」
1753bf809c919545b9c4d3ab92809fd618d34622.translatedText: Farewell to the old and usher in the new for another year Farewell to the old and usher in the new for another year Phoenix City is full of energy "Another year!" When we have eaten sweet dumplings during the Winter Solstice and admired the brilliant Christmas lights, the halls have been replaced with new calendars and monthly calendars. As time flies by, we can't help but sigh softly: "It's another year!" Time flies and leaves no one behind. Even if you like it or not, the earth will always rotate and the days will keep moving forward. Looking back on last year, when 2017 came, I held a four-party banquet at Luk Foo Restaurant in Phoenix, inviting relatives and friends to attend the New Year’s Eve banquet. At the same time, as a meeting gift for my daughter-in-law Baoyan when she first came to the United States, relatives and friends gathered together, raised glasses, and drank. It’s a countdown activity to see off the old and welcome the new. I’m extremely excited, the memories are still there, and it’s already another year. This time to welcome 2018, I did not participate in the countdown event. I only attended the reunion dinner arranged by my daughter Guoxin, which was held at the New World Restaurant in Meisha City. Guoxin and her husband-in-law Guanghan and their granddaughter Hui Xian were there, and they planned to have a party for the three generations to see off the old and welcome the new. ; Due to their respective program reservations in advance, not all of them could come; only the second eldest brother Guofeng and Qiong Yao’s family of five attended the party together, which was great and enough to make me and my wife very happy, because in this way, the three grandchildren: Zilong, Ziyang and Meisi, plus the granddaughter, a total of four grandchildren gathered together. It is really rare to play together; and children are fun, innocent and lively, so that when we say goodbye to the old and welcome the new, we can have fun, laugh and feel infinite comfort. There is no need to wait for the countdown of ten seconds! What's more, the two granddaughters added this year, granddaughter Huixian is nine months old, and granddaughter Meisi is just over two months old. They have to go home early to rest and sleep. It is not appropriate to postpone the party until late at night. Therefore, we called it quits at around nine o'clock and waved goodbye to each other. I also said goodbye to a few friends I met at the restaurant, and also wanted to thank my brother-in-law Chen Caishun. Happy to welcome the new year. The Li song played, people shook hands and cupped their fists, saying goodbye. Tomorrow is the New Year, and everyone blurted out: "It's another year!" Indeed, it's another year! As I drove home, I saw and heard sporadic fireworks shooting into the sky along the way, and people cheered to bid farewell to the old and welcome the new. My husband and I are very happy tonight, recalling the funny and lively activities of our grandchildren just now. They are really cute. Just thinking about it makes us smile unexpectedly. With a happy mood, we have no intention of going to crowded places and counting down. Go back home directly, turn on the TV, and watch the Jade Channel's report. The fireworks in Hong Kong's Victoria Harbor and the fireworks in Taiwan's 101st Floor are all displayed brilliantly on the screen, showing that the new year is coming and the whole world is welcoming 2018. . I wish you new luck in the new year, international peace, and happiness for all people. While I was watching TV, I heard the sound of fireworks being set off outside, which aroused my feelings, caused me to review the real life process, and caused me to have a memory. I remember that when I was a student, I had an exquisite "Overseas Chinese Diary", which had a cautionary article every month. One of the articles in December was: "Review the past and encourage the future", which advised us to carefully review the pros and cons of the past at the end of the year, so as to Formulate action plans for the next year, work hard, and move forward. Therefore, from then on, I always made new wishes and made new plans on the New Year's Eve. Unfortunately, I was born in troubled times and encountered the most brutal era of the Vietnam War. The half century that started at a young age went through the French occupation, Japanese occupation, US aid, Vietnam War, and even the Communist dictatorship, etc., a series of turbulent days. It is people who are in the arena and cannot help themselves. Good young people have no place to use their talents and find it difficult to implement their ideal plans. The environment is pressing and they can only make a living to cater to the situation. There is no choice. When I had the opportunity to immigrate to the United States, I was nearly 60 years old. I was unfamiliar with the place, the environment, the language, the customs, and the culture. I had to start from scratch, and it was really difficult to get through life. It wasn't until retirement that he finally settled down, but he had already entered the realm of the elderly where the setting sun slanted down his face. What else could he do to exert his energy? Only spending the days leisurely, reading newspapers, surfing the Internet, writing essays and sketches, reciting poems and compositions, to pass the long days; or teasing the grandchildren with a smile, and having fun together with the children are precious moments for the elderly. When finances permit, I will return to my hometown in Vietnam, visit relatives and friends, and be content with what I have. Occasionally, if I get up, I will travel around, enjoy the afterglow of the sunset, and enjoy myself. What is worth comforting is that so far, although my husband and I are over seventy years old, we are still in good health and can go anywhere. We can still have a happy reunion with everyone to see off the old and welcome the new. Now is the arrival of a new year. I wish you good luck in the new year, but you cannot avoid the usual sigh: "It's been another year so soon!"

259900ce0143aa017a57d655fec4ee7c3f3b21a3.sourceText: 凤凰城凤鸣：回国探亲的一路见闻与感恩（五） 乘船环护城河游泉城与感恩 时间飞快地走过一个月，到了要返回的日子，心中实在不舍。有女儿在身边陪伴左右的一个月，真的很欣慰，很幸福。她帶我看医生，陪我去北京，乘坐了中国最快的高铁，只一个多小时就到北京，还抽时间去了北京东郊的国际名牌专卖店，只要是我看中的衣服，马上为我买下来。还插空帶我做头发，去饭店吃大闸蟹，泰国餐，济南的家乡名吃等。最后三天更是请了年假陪伴我，在我走的前一天，又帶我们哥、嫂、姐四人，乘船环护城河游泉城。环护城河游泉城，价格不非，每张门票人民币100元，不过等游完全程下来也觉得值。 作为一条由泉水汇集的河流，济南护城河是泉城特色标志区〝一城、一湖、一环〞的重要组成部分，沿线历史悠久、名胜荟萃，整个护城河通航工程历时四年，从2007年初开始实施，全线通航使济南成为全国唯一可乘船环游老城区特色风貎帶的城市。通航工程新建了周公祠桥、黑北路桥、小东湖桥；重建了五龙潭桥、少年桥、兴华门桥、白石泉桥等眾多景观，栽植乔灌木、常绿及水生植物等近20万株，地被植物约100万株，安装夜晚景观照明灯具5万多余盏。工程还完城了五龙潭秦琼祠建设、《济南八景》、《娥英水长》浮雕、《老水磨坊》场景雕塑，南门桥《舜田门遗址》石刻等文化景观。泉水浴场作为工程的重要组成部分也已基本建成。 全线通航后的济南护城河，全程6.9公里，是国內唯一一条全部由泉水汇流而成的河，它将黑虎泉、趵突泉、五龙潭、珍珠泉四大泉群连为一体。沿途可观赏到多处著名景区（点）和济南的代表性景观，如蔚为壮观的觧放阁、龙吟虎啸的黑虎泉、济南大客厅泉城广场、天下第一泉趵突泉、步移景异的五龙潭、泉城明珠大明湖以及东护城河河道湿地、老水电站、泉水浴场等景观，可谓〝一水连百景，构成了全国独一無二的泉水游览景观。我们乘船观看了两岸绚丽多彩的风景，两岸垂柳依依，植被错落有致，栈道与水榭相伴的湿地景观美丽动人、美不胜收，沿途經过了西门、南门、北门和老东门等济南老城的四大门。山大南路延长线桥下用LED点缀屏，通过电脑控制，显现出像柳树、荷花以及魚在水中游的各种五彩缤纷的图案。航途中由于河段的水位有落差，还經过了两次关闸、开闸，就像三峡大坝关闸、开闸一样，只不过是不如三峡壮观，但这工程还是不简单，我们也一睹关闸、開闸的景观。下了游览船，我们顺着大明湖南门向东走，是大明湖新开发区。走过无数新建的桥和景点，哥、嫂、姐姐都累了，他（她）们坐在路边石条磴上等我，女儿陪我去找45年前，我在省机械厅工作时居住过的两层小楼。功夫不负有心人，那幢二层小楼还真被我们找到了，只是已面貌一新。有六间房的二层小楼，南面向大明湖，凭窗而望，与大明湖中的历下亭摇相呼应、隔水相望，它记录了我刚参加工作时的全部，我工作初期8年的华丽年华，都是在那里度过，留下了我许多美好的记忆。現在小楼已翻盖一新，黑灰的砖由白灰抹缝，看上去干净、漂亮，墙壁上爬满了绿色的爬墙虎，看着这翻建一新的旧址，不由思绪万千。感谢 神！借着我这次回国的机会，让我看到我的故乡翻天覆地的发展、变化，也回到了我曾經工作过、居住过、有过许多梦想的小楼，旧地重游别有一番心情。感叹青春一去不复返，但我不后悔，因为在我最迷惑不解人生时，是神找到了我，把永生的生命白白赐给我，让我感觉到生存的意义和价值，耶稣基督把复活的生命赐给我，我也要遵照主的旨意，把这上好的信息，传给我所认识的亲朋好友和渴慕神的人，来感谢神的慈爱和怜悯！把一切荣耀、赞美都归给至高至遵的神！
259900ce0143aa017a57d655fec4ee7c3f3b21a3.translatedText: Phoenix City Fengming: What I have learned and be grateful for on my way back to China to visit my relatives (5) Take a boat tour around the moat of Quancheng and give thanks. Time flies by for a month, and when the day comes to return, I feel really reluctant to leave. I am really happy and happy to have my daughter by my side for a month. She took me to see a doctor and accompanied me to Beijing. She took the fastest high-speed train in China and arrived in Beijing in just over an hour. She also took time to go to an international brand-name store in the eastern suburbs of Beijing and immediately bought me any clothes I liked. He even took the time to take me to get my hair done, go to a restaurant to eat hairy crabs, Thai food, famous local delicacies in Jinan, etc. In the last three days, he took annual leave to accompany me. The day before I left, he took our brother, sister-in-law and sister on a boat tour around the moat of Quancheng. Touring Quancheng around the moat is expensive, with each ticket costing RMB 100, but it's worth it once the tour is complete. As a river gathered by springs, Jinan Moat is an important part of the "One City, One Lake, One Ring" characteristic landmark area of ​​Quancheng. It has a long history and a collection of scenic spots. The entire moat navigation project lasted four years and was implemented since the beginning of 2007. The full navigation has made Jinan the only city in the country where you can take a boat tour around the characteristic wind belt of the old city. The navigation project built the Zhougong Temple Bridge, Heibei Road Bridge, and Xiaodong Lake Bridge; rebuilt many landscapes such as Wulongtan Bridge, Teenager Bridge, Xinghuamen Bridge, and Baishiquan Bridge. Nearly 200,000 trees, shrubs, evergreens, and aquatic plants were planted, and about 1 million ground cover plants were installed. More than 50,000 night landscape lighting fixtures were installed. The project also completed the construction of Qin Qiong Temple in Wulongtan, the "Eight Scenes of Jinan", the reliefs of "Eying Water Changer", the scene sculptures of "Old Water Mill", and the stone carvings of "Shuntian Gate Ruins" of Nanmen Bridge and other cultural landscapes. As an important part of the project, the spring bath has also been basically completed. The Jinan Moat, which is fully navigable, has a total length of 6.9 kilometers. It is the only river in China that is entirely formed by the confluence of springs. It connects the four major springs of Black Tiger Spring, Baotu Spring, Wulongtan and Pearl Spring into one. Along the way, you can see many famous scenic spots (spots) and representative landscapes of Jinan, such as the spectacular Jiefang Pavilion, Black Tiger Spring where dragons roar and tigers roar, Jinan Living Room Quancheng Square, the best spring in the world Baotu Spring, Wulongtan with different scenery every step of the way, and Quancheng Pearl. Daming Lake and the East Moat wetland, old hydropower station, spring baths and other landscapes can be said to be "one water connects hundreds of sceneries, forming a unique spring sightseeing landscape in the country." We took a boat to watch the colorful scenery on both sides of the strait, with weeping willows on both sides. The vegetation is well-proportioned, and the wetland landscape accompanied by plank roads and waterside pavilions is beautiful and beautiful. Along the way, it passes the four gates of Jinan Old City, including the West Gate, South Gate, North Gate and Old East Gate. LED screens are decorated under the bridge of the extension line of Sanda South Road, and through the electricity. Through brain control, various colorful patterns like willow trees, lotus flowers and fish swimming in the water appeared. Due to the water level difference in the river section, the gate was closed and opened twice, just like the closing and opening of the Three Gorges Dam, but it was not as good as the other. The Three Gorges is spectacular, but this project is still not simple. We also got a glimpse of the scenery of lock closing and opening. After getting off the tour boat, we walked eastward along the south gate of Daming Lake, which is the new development zone of Daming Lake. My brother, sister-in-law, and sister all passed by. When we were tired, they sat on the stone curb by the roadside and waited for me. My daughter accompanied me to find the two-story building where I lived when I was working in the Provincial Machinery Department 45 years ago. The hard work paid off. We actually found the two-story building, but it had changed its appearance. New. A two-story building with six rooms, facing Daming Lake in the south. Looking out of the window, it echoes the Lixia Pavilion in Daming Lake and faces each other across the water. It records everything when I first started working, and the eight glorious years of my early working life were all there. It has left me with many wonderful memories. Now the small building has been renovated. The black and gray bricks are jointed with white ash. It looks clean and beautiful. The walls are covered with green wall crawlers. Looking at the renovated old site, I can't help but think a lot. Thank you. God! By taking this opportunity to return to China, I have seen the earth-shaking development and changes in my hometown. I have also returned to the small building where I once worked, lived, and had many dreams. It’s a unique feeling to visit the old place. I lament that my youth is gone forever, but I don’t regret it, because it was God who found me when I was most confused in life. Give me eternal life for free, let me feel the meaning and value of existence. Jesus Christ has given me the resurrection life. I will also follow the Lord’s will and spread this good news to the relatives and friends I know and those who long for God, to thank God for His love and mercy. All glory and praise must be given to the supreme and obedient God!

fed3bd70d909049cc2a99acf88ea19052c0ae200.translatedText: After the New York terrorist attack, Trump demanded the abolition of the lottery immigration policy.

f03a21d563cf53bfde0b2b67c38a627ec84d10c5.translatedText: After the New York terrorist attack, Trump demanded the abolition of the lottery immigration policy. Video: A pickup truck hit a person in New York. The US prosecutor formally charged the attacker. Source: CCTV News...
