8fb0340467ece10ab585fdfcc0c2fcd188dda3c3.sourceText: 麦凯恩议员指卡扎菲政权早该瓦解 本州岛的国会参议员约翰 麦凯恩表示，他非常希望看到美国在利比亚冲突中发挥更大的军事作用，他同时担忧美国人对美国在阿富汗的军事努力的支持正在减弱。 在福克斯新闻频道” 星期天和克里斯 华莱士在一起” 的访谈节目中露面时，亚利桑那州共和党籍参议员约翰 麦凯恩表示，他对北约联军推翻卡扎菲，结束利比亚领导人的军队和反政府武装之间僵持局面的努力感到不满。 他说：” 在利比亚的土地上，人们在失去生命。如果我们全力使用美国的空中力量和能力，以及美国军队所拥有的特殊技能的话，这些人本应该可以活着。” 美国、英国和法国从 3 月开始为建立一个经过联合国授权的禁飞区，而对利比亚展开空袭。美国总统奥巴马上周在法国召开 8 国集团峰会上讲话的时候表示，只要卡扎菲仍然掌权，指挥军队对利比亚人民采取攻击行动，联合国授权的人道保护使命就无法完成。 而英国和法国一直促请美国更多地参与北约领导的针对利比亚的行动。麦凯恩说” 卡扎菲会垮台。他会垮台。但是，如果我们使用美国的空军力量全力打击他，这个结果本来早就可以实现了。 这真是不幸。” 麦凯恩还表示，他希望美国正式承认利比亚反对派的全国过渡委员会。 上周，一名美国外交官表示，利比亚全国过渡委员会接受了美国总统奥巴马的邀请，在华盛顿开设一个代表处。但是美国并没有给予这个组织正式的承认。 另外，随着本 拉登一个月前丧命，一些美国议员们正在推动美国军队更快地从 2001 年 911 事件的策源地 — 阿富汗撤出。 麦凯恩说，他担心美国人对美国在阿富汗发挥作用的支持正在减弱。麦凯恩说：” 我非常担心，这倒和本. 拉登被除掉与否没有多大关系。我担心的是美国人的厌战情绪。” 上周，美国众议院以 204 票支持对 215 票反对的表决结果，使得一项美国更快撤军的议案没有获得通过。这是美国特种突击队在巴基斯坦击毙本. 拉登之后，国会针对阿富汗问题的首次投票。 美国总统奥巴马今年 7 月将开始撤出驻阿富汗 10 万美军的部分军队，所有的美国战斗部队将在 2014 年之前撤出阿富汗。
8fb0340467ece10ab585fdfcc0c2fcd188dda3c3.translatedText: Senator John McCain said the Gaddafi regime should have collapsed long ago. Senator John McCain of the state said that he very much wants to see the United States play a greater military role in the Libyan conflict. He is also concerned that American support for the US military effort in Afghanistan is waning. In an appearance on Fox News Channel's "Sundays with Chris Wallace," Arizona Republican Sen. John McCain said he was dissatisfied with the NATO coalition's efforts to oust Muammar Gaddafi and end a stalemate between the Libyan leader's troops and rebels. He said: "People are losing their lives on Libyan soil. If we had used the full force of American air power and capabilities and the special skills of the American military, these people should be alive." The United States, Britain and France began air strikes in Libya in March to establish a United Nations-authorized no-fly zone. When U.S. President Obama spoke at the G8 summit in France last week, he said that as long as Gaddafi is still in power and directs the military to carry out attacks on the Libyan people, the humanitarian protection mission authorized by the United Nations cannot be completed. Britain and France have been urging the United States to become more involved in the NATO-led operation against Libya. McCain said, "Gaddafi will fall. He will fall. But if we had used the full force of American air power to attack him, this result would have been achieved long ago. It is really unfortunate." McCain also said that he hopes the United States will formally recognize the National Transitional Council of the Libyan opposition. Last week, a U.S. diplomat said Libya's National Transitional Council had accepted an invitation from U.S. President Obama to open a representative office in Washington. But the United States has not given the organization formal recognition. Separately, with bin Laden's death a month ago, some U.S. lawmakers are pushing for a faster withdrawal of U.S. troops from Afghanistan, the epicenter of the 9/11 attacks in 2001. McCain said he was concerned that American support for the U.S. role in Afghanistan was waning. McCain said: "I am very worried, and this has little to do with whether bin Laden has been eliminated. What I am worried about is the war weariness of the American people." Last week, the U.S. House of Representatives voted 204 in favor to 215 against, preventing the passage of a bill to withdraw U.S. troops faster. This is the first vote in Congress on the Afghan issue after the US special commandos killed bin Laden in Pakistan. U.S. President Obama will begin withdrawing some of the 100,000 U.S. troops in Afghanistan in July this year, and all U.S. combat troops will be withdrawn from Afghanistan by 2014.

88ab328bc032379855d63d3d79cff6fefe4559b0.translatedText: In addition, those who wish to receive application information via email or text message must submit Form G-1145 (E-Notification of Application/Petitioner Acceptance, http://www.uscis.gov/files/form/g-1145.pdf).

69e0c97423bc3b2b8f62338cb903ee97e75e73e6.sourceText: 梅奥卡斯说，工作人员已经做好处理潮水般涌来的申请，但这并不代表非移们一定可以得到完全合法的居住权。该局是行使裁量权，对每一个申请都是个案处理。遭否决的都无法再上诉。他并表示，申请没有时间限制，未满 15 岁的，可以等满 15 岁时再提出申 请。他说，申请人只要来美时未满 16 岁，可以是自行来美，当初不必随同父母入境。新办法为鼓励学习，即使目前没有在学，只要申请时在学即符合资格。
69e0c97423bc3b2b8f62338cb903ee97e75e73e6.translatedText: Mayorkas said that staff are ready to handle the influx of applications, but this does not mean that non-immigrants will definitely get fully legal residency rights. The Bureau exercises its discretion and handles each application on a case-by-case basis. Those who are rejected can no longer appeal. He also said that there is no time limit for application, and those under the age of 15 can wait until they turn 15 before applying. He said that as long as the applicant is under 16 years old when coming to the United States, he can come to the United States on his own and does not need to accompany his parents when entering the United States. The new approach is to encourage learning. Even if you are not currently studying, you will be eligible as long as you are studying when you apply.

9f0ade009a8667790b546f40da176c01c33f9d7a.sourceText: 国家安全官员称，在潮水般的申请中，有部分申请是造假的，但工作人员一定会将这些造假者揪出。造假问题会威胁到国家安全，并给造假者留下严重的犯罪案底。分析人士指出，这些造假问题将会对奥巴马即将到来的11月总统大选产生极其不良影响。在此之前，应经有共和党人谴责奥巴马绕开国会为非法移民”开后门”提供”庇护”。
9f0ade009a8667790b546f40da176c01c33f9d7a.translatedText: National security officials said that in the flood of applications, some are fake, but staff will definitely find these fakers. Counterfeiting threatens national security and leaves counterfeiters with serious criminal records. Analysts pointed out that these fraud issues will have an extremely negative impact on Obama's upcoming presidential election in November. Prior to this, some Republicans should have accused Obama of bypassing Congress to "open a back door" and provide "asylum" for illegal immigrants.

c3f6ad374f3673a98a091ab145c78573476a7cc6.sourceText: 批评者称欧巴马此举纯粹是选举买票的选举动作，形同一次未经国会同意的特赦行为，鼓励非法变合法。同时，在美国失业率高达 8.3% 之际，突然再释出 100 多万的年轻劳工进入就业市场，等于在此艰难时刻，变相剥夺合法人民的工作机会。
c3f6ad374f3673a98a091ab145c78573476a7cc6.translatedText: Critics said Obama's move was purely an electoral move to buy votes, tantamount to an amnesty without the consent of Congress, and encouraged the illegal to become legal. At the same time, when the unemployment rate in the United States is as high as 8.3%, suddenly releasing more than 1 million young workers into the job market is tantamount to depriving legal people of job opportunities in disguise during this difficult time.

39f7e1c20caaf0bad88cd0c4beffbdcb3dce2ab3.sourceText: 同时也增加政府经办此案的支出，因为都是逐案批准，耗费人力。但国内安全部表示，申请人所缴申请费应可应付支出。
39f7e1c20caaf0bad88cd0c4beffbdcb3dce2ab3.translatedText: At the same time, it also increases the government's expenditure on handling this case, because approval is done on a case-by-case basis, which is labor-intensive. However, the Ministry of Homeland Security said the application fee paid by the applicant should be enough to cover expenses.

b098dc0017aa4f092d6a2494547ec7ac43c51960.sourceText: 美国大批非法移民开始涌至各地移民权益单位或领事馆寻求信息，申请在美合法工作。
b098dc0017aa4f092d6a2494547ec7ac43c51960.translatedText: A large number of illegal immigrants in the United States began to flock to immigration rights units or consulates in various places to seek information and apply for legal work in the United States.

a6e77b3d5ce9bbe321e65d2869618159965e2065.sourceText: 而且即使共和党罗穆尼当选上台后，善待非法移民的欧巴马政策新规仍将继续实施。反对非法移民的华府智库”移民政策中心”主任克果瑞安 (Mark Krikorian) 表示，罗穆尼上台也不敢取消此一新规，至少对已经申请到暂缓驱逐的人而言是不用担心了。
a6e77b3d5ce9bbe321e65d2869618159965e2065.translatedText: And even after Republican Romney is elected to power, Obama's new policies that treat illegal immigrants well will continue to be implemented. Mark Krikorian, director of the Immigration Policy Center, a Washington think tank that opposes illegal immigration, said Romney would not dare to cancel this new rule even after taking office, at least for those who have already applied for a stay of deportation.

507b8b3195ef91690ae609871b76703e8efa40ab.sourceText: 亚利桑那华人历史协会 张肇鸿 在美国西部，有中国女性被称为“中国玛丽”，但很难找到她们的真实的姓名。19世纪和…
507b8b3195ef91690ae609871b76703e8efa40ab.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association Zhang Zhaohong In the western United States, there are Chinese women called "Chinese Mary", but it is difficult to find their real names. In the 19th century and...

26e05113d3f92c4f96f5e16592fcacb2c1158f77.sourceText: 亚利桑那华人历史协会 张肇鸿
26e05113d3f92c4f96f5e16592fcacb2c1158f77.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association Zhang Zhaohong

91ebb95b17288d201629e9538cd8c60f3a8778d9.sourceText: 在美国西部，有中国女性被称为“中国玛丽”，但很难找到她们的真实的姓名。19世纪和20世纪的种族主义偏见意味着中国人经常被排除在外，或者在报纸或书面报道中没有名字。在历史记录中，中国妇女更是隐形的。
91ebb95b17288d201629e9538cd8c60f3a8778d9.translatedText: In the western United States, there were Chinese women called "China Marys", but it is difficult to find their real names. Racist prejudice in the 19th and 20th centuries meant that Chinese people were often excluded or had no names in newspapers or written reports. In historical records, Chinese women are even more invisible.

ba7d16c8a8361c75716557be6fb3ce6d5fba2a84.sourceText: 大多数美国人在生活中，常常把中国男人称为“约翰”，把中国女人称为“玛丽”，而不是称呼他们的中文名字的译音。有一位“中国玛丽”在亚利桑那州的墓碑镇，成为了该镇华人社区的“唐人街的女皇”。
ba7d16c8a8361c75716557be6fb3ce6d5fba2a84.translatedText: In their daily lives, most Americans often refer to Chinese men as "John" and Chinese women as "Mary" instead of calling them the transliterations of their Chinese names. There was a "China Mary" in Tombstone, Arizona, who became the "Queen of Chinatown" in the town's Chinese community.

96f09ed977990167a57fec68cdbbf40db060b893.sourceText: 在怀俄明州的埃文斯顿镇，也有一位“中国玛丽”，她被确认为“阿袁” （Ah Yuen）。“袁”（Yuen)是广东人的姓氏。由于中国人把姓氏放在名字之前，所以姓氏经常被错误地列为官方文件上的名字。“阿”是一个中文前缀，加上人名的缩写来表示熟悉，基于此，“阿袁”很可能不是她的名字。
96f09ed977990167a57fec68cdbbf40db060b893.translatedText: In the town of Evanston, Wyoming, there is also a "Chinese Mary", who is identified as "Ah Yuen". "Yuen" is a Cantonese surname. Because the Chinese place the surname before the first name, the surname is often incorrectly listed as the first name on official documents. "A" is a Chinese prefix, plus the abbreviation of a person's name to indicate familiarity. Based on this, "A Yuan" is probably not her name.

2b4c63b234a9bfcccd7e5a1a9e72ea5a4dfd4185.sourceText: 正如犹他州历史部的Christopher Merritt在“阿袁”的传记中所解释的那样，美国联邦人口普查局的记录显示，她大约在1863年左右抵达美国。她可能在1848年至1854年间出生在中国南方。这将使她在美国长途旅行时显得相当年轻。
2b4c63b234a9bfcccd7e5a1a9e72ea5a4dfd4185.translatedText: As Christopher Merritt of the Utah Department of History explains in "A Yuan's" biography, U.S. Census Bureau records show that she arrived in the United States around 1863. She was probably born in southern China between 1848 and 1854. This will make her look quite young during her long trip to the United States.

dc2fd9fd64c4b6b454d2e194b080aefff03d2132.sourceText: 阿袁的美国之旅很可能并不愉快。中国移民通常坐在驾驶舱里，驾驶舱是存放货物的船的下层甲板。这些乘客往往被数百人安置在一个大货舱里。床通常是一排排大的共用铺位，铺着稻草床垫，没有床单。旅行者的隐私和安全受到限制，卫生条件不足，食物匮乏。这次航行可能需要几个星期。
dc2fd9fd64c4b6b454d2e194b080aefff03d2132.translatedText: >A Yuan’s trip to the United States was probably not a pleasant one. Chinese immigrants often sat in the cockpit, the lower deck of the ship where cargo was stored. These passengers are often packed into hundreds of people in a large cargo hold. The beds are usually rows of large shared bunks with straw mattresses and no sheets. Travelers' privacy and security are limited, sanitation is inadequate, and food is scarce. The voyage may take several weeks.

c953c90765f1d91f812ab7978ddadc82324b3011.sourceText: 她为什么来美国还不清楚。我们确实知道，19世纪40年代至19世纪60年代，生活在中国的人们正面临着内战、失业猖獗、土地和财富被剥夺、饥荒以及沿海城市人口过剩带来的暴力。中国的女孩处于更不利的地位。
c953c90765f1d91f812ab7978ddadc82324b3011.translatedText: Why she came to the United States is unclear. We do know that between the 1840s and the 1860s, people living in China faced violence from civil war, rampant unemployment, dispossession of land and wealth, famine, and overpopulation in coastal cities. Girls in China are even more disadvantaged.

e5df594f3d30f1c63ae19262476b705dff1e6a31.sourceText: 中国面临经济困难和饥饿的家庭往往决定把女儿卖到海外，不仅是为了生存，也是希望给她们更好生活的机会。在这种情况下，大多数女孩出于孝顺而接受了家人的决定，并允许自己被卖给中国的“劳务承包商”。也许阿袁就是其中一个女孩？她的出生和移民日期与那个时期一致。
e5df594f3d30f1c63ae19262476b705dff1e6a31.translatedText: Chinese families facing financial difficulties and hunger often decide to sell their daughters overseas, not only to survive, but also to give them a chance at a better life. In this case, most girls accepted their family's decision out of filial piety and allowed themselves to be sold to Chinese "labor contractors." Maybe A Yuan is one of the girls? Her birth and immigration dates are consistent with that period.

ba1c3aee6b8f9d19d75b902376702aed8aac72f3.sourceText: 由于女儿无法提供养家糊口或继承祖名所需的艰苦体力劳动，她们被认为不如儿子，因此是可以牺牲的。随着越来越多的中国男人在没有妻子的情况下移民到美国，一个自然的卖淫市场应运而生。
ba1c3aee6b8f9d19d75b902376702aed8aac72f3.translatedText: Because daughters could not provide the hard physical labor required to support a family or carry on the ancestral name, they were considered inferior to sons and therefore expendable. As more and more Chinese men immigrated to the United States without wives, a natural prostitution market emerged.

425a594a7305c3b51e505c7b8b0b98be7a56231e.sourceText: 一些更有魅力的女孩没有被迫卖淫，而是“幸运”地成为富有主人的妾氏，这些主人可能会对她们很体面，尽管如果她们不讨好，她们的主人可以把她们送回拍卖场。然而，大多数女孩确实忍受了卖淫，最终进了为中国男性保留的高级妓院，或者在“小屋”里，她们以25到50美分的价格为从水手到十几岁的男孩再到醉汉的任何人提供服务。
425a594a7305c3b51e505c7b8b0b98be7a56231e.translatedText: Some of the more attractive girls are not forced into prostitution, but are "lucky" to become concubines of wealthy owners, who may treat them decently, although their owners can send them back to the auction block if they are undesirable. Most girls did endure prostitution, however, ending up in high-end brothels reserved for Chinese men, or in "huts," where they served anyone from sailors to teenage boys to drunkards for 25 to 50 cents.

128c322517a899082003e2a4edef89c85ad4a3df.sourceText: 阿袁可能是其中一个幸运儿。根据怀俄明州档案馆的一本工程进展管理局时代的传记，她是一位异常美丽的女性。据说这是阿袁的照片。位置和日期未知。图片来自怀俄明州埃文斯顿尤因塔县博物馆的藏品。
128c322517a899082003e2a4edef89c85ad4a3df.translatedText: >A Yuan may be one of the lucky ones. She was an exceptionally beautiful woman, according to a Works Progress Administration-era biography in the Wyoming State Archives. It is said that this is a photo of A Yuan. Location and date unknown. Image from the collection of the Uinta County Museum, Evanston, Wyoming.

6b128b25b2d19b42cb27c6829611c82962c6bc07.sourceText: 阿袁的人生故事表明，她和许多中国移民一样，在旧金山开始了她的美国之旅。在某个时候，她在丹佛，但她的那段历史仍然是个谜。
6b128b25b2d19b42cb27c6829611c82962c6bc07.translatedText: A Yuan’s life story shows that she, like many Chinese immigrants, began her journey to the United States in San Francisco. At some point, she was in Denver, but that part of her history remains a mystery.

08b9e038d769f8f15c1b304fcb2b6d14e0900335.sourceText: 1868年，她在怀俄明州的贝尔河市当厨师。此时，她可能已经结婚，是嫁给了一名铁路工人，因为在横贯大陆铁路的建设过程中，贝尔河是一个轨道尽头的城镇。她回忆说，1868年11月19日，在一名为铁路工作的谋杀嫌疑人被私刑处死后，她目睹了现在被称为“熊河城暴乱”的事件。这名被私刑处死的男子的朋友反抗治安维持者，小镇爆发暴力冲突。16人死亡。在以后的生活中，她会向感兴趣的人展示一条埋葬尸体的长沟。
08b9e038d769f8f15c1b304fcb2b6d14e0900335.translatedText: In 1868, she was working as a cook in Bear River, Wyoming. She was probably married at this time, to a railroad worker, as Bear River was an end-of-track town during the construction of the Transcontinental Railroad. She recalled witnessing what is now known as the Bear River Riot on November 19, 1868, following the lynching of a murder suspect who worked for the railroad. The town erupts into violence when friends of the lynched man resist the vigilantes. 16 people died. Later in life, she would show interested parties a long trench where bodies were buried.

0c8355ab8073aa17379da2c3983dbbeada4807a6.sourceText: 到19世纪80年代，她住在犹他州的帕克城，当第一条进入该市的铁路部分由中国工人建造时，那里就形成了唐人街。阿袁和丈夫开了一家商店，向当地劳工和欧洲裔美国人出售中国商品。那里的生活可能让这对夫妇感到不安。根据《犹他州历史百科全书》上的一篇文章，早在20世纪头十年，帕克城的华人就成了零星的、受种族偏见的受害者。
0c8355ab8073aa17379da2c3983dbbeada4807a6.translatedText: By the 1880s, she was living in Park City, Utah, where Chinatown formed when parts of the first railroad into the city were built by Chinese workers. A Yuan and her husband opened a store selling Chinese goods to local laborers and European Americans. Life there may have been unsettling for the couple. According to an article in the Encyclopedia of Utah History, as early as the first decade of the 20th century, Park City's Chinese were sporadic victims of racial prejudice.

436b58838e4333bd735e61fdc454a1ed70a0cbee.sourceText: 在这位丈夫去世后，阿袁于1900年左右搬到了怀俄明州埃文斯顿以东约65英里的地方。她可能已经40多岁或50出头了。为什么选择埃文斯顿？也许是机会在召唤。这座城市已经失去了野性。
436b58838e4333bd735e61fdc454a1ed70a0cbee.translatedText: After the death of her husband, Ayuan moved to a place about 65 miles east of Evanston, Wyoming around 1900. She may be in her late 40s or early 50s. Why Evanston? Maybe opportunity is calling. The city has lost its wildness.

e5f17fcb5e612aaa6017d489f9d5729b34a41637.sourceText: 当阿袁到达时，联合太平洋公司与太平洋水果公司合作，在铁轨和熊河之间开发了一个冰库。联合太平洋公司还建造了一个砖砌仓库来取代第一个木制仓库。不久之后，埃文斯顿就有了联邦法院和邮局。该镇甚至拥有美国为数不多的中国寺庙之一，被称为“乔斯之家”，它建于1894年。1922年，当埃文斯顿的唐人街被烧毁时，大火烧毁了这个中国寺庙。许多华人此时已经离开了埃文斯顿，但阿袁是少数留下来的华人之一。
e5f17fcb5e612aaa6017d489f9d5729b34a41637.translatedText: When Ayuan arrived, Union Pacific worked with the Pacific Fruit Company to develop an icehouse between the railroad tracks and the Bear River. Union Pacific also built a brick warehouse to replace the first wooden warehouse. Soon after, Evanston had a federal courthouse and post office. The town even has one of the few Chinese temples in the United States, known as the "Joseph House," which was built in 1894. In 1922, fire destroyed this Chinese temple when Evanston's Chinatown burned down. Many Chinese had left Evanston by this time, but Ayuan was one of the few who stayed.

a13895a912a8da01fe23b874b3dddf2f2548be32.sourceText: 搬到怀俄明州的埃文斯顿之后、阿袁再度两次结婚。她最后的丈夫是一名园丁，被称为“摩门教徒查理”，她可能在20世纪20年代末结婚的。他的名字被记录为洛克龙聪（或钟），他的出生年份为1862年。 Findagrave网站上有一个条目，他被赋予了“因为他很好地融入了当地人”的绰号。他于1881年移民到美国。他被描述为一个身材矮小的人，因为用两根长杆支撑的篮子在镇上运送大量蔬菜而被人们铭记。有时他会让孩子们坐在篮子里。他很受欢迎和信任，以至于他被允许在人们晚上外出时，可以进入他们家而留下蔬菜。
a13895a912a8da01fe23b874b3dddf2f2548be32.translatedText: After moving to Evanston, Wyoming, Ayuan got married twice more. Her last husband was a gardener known as "Mormon Charlie," whom she probably married in the late 1920s. His name is recorded as Lok Long Cong (or Zhong) and his year of birth is 1862. There is an entry on the Findagrave website where he was given the nickname "because he blended in well with the locals". He immigrated to the United States in 1881. Described as a small man, he is remembered for carrying large quantities of vegetables around town in a basket supported by two long poles. Sometimes he would let the children sit in the basket. He was so popular and trusted that he was allowed to enter people's homes while they were out at night and leave vegetables behind.

9a1b0baca95cf61ce1f6ff527a21e5fea2bf220e.sourceText: WPA的传记指出，阿袁性格开朗，英语说得很流利，在旧金山、丹佛和帕克城听她演讲的人都很高兴。她成了埃文斯顿镇上的人物之一。游客们要求给她拍照，她为此收取了10美分。反过来，她又付给埃文斯顿的孩子们一角钱，因为他们从熊河带来了鱼给她。她喜欢赌博，甚至在去世前接受了多年的县府的援助。传记中说，她有三个孩子，但没有提及他们的名字或下落。
9a1b0baca95cf61ce1f6ff527a21e5fea2bf220e.translatedText: WPA's biography states that Ayuan has a cheerful personality and speaks English fluently, and the people who listened to her speeches in San Francisco, Denver and Park City were very happy. She became one of the town characters in Evanston. Tourists asked to take pictures of her, for which she charged 10 cents. In turn, she paid the Evanston children a dime for bringing her fish from the Bear River. She enjoyed gambling and even received assistance from the county for many years before her death. The biography states that she had three children, but does not mention their names or whereabouts.

8495d55f52afcaba5b7f18b0f3a1104d47a2a5ed.sourceText: 阿袁与她的第三任丈夫，约1930年。图片档案：中国玛丽，美国怀俄明州大学美国遗产中心。
8495d55f52afcaba5b7f18b0f3a1104d47a2a5ed.translatedText: A Yuan and her third husband, circa 1930. Photo archive: China Mary, American Heritage Center, University of Wyoming, USA.

4b71f1b8ba9371eca349cbe2fd6777cc4bb21cce.sourceText: 在埃文斯顿度过了她的余生，直到1939年1月13日在她的小房子里去世。她在埃文斯顿是一位受人爱戴的人物，她的追悼会上有许多镇上的居民参加，尽管她的墓地在埃文斯顿公墓的贫民区，但她的坟墓是有标记的，这是城市提供的。这里并且有一条“中国玛丽路”。
4b71f1b8ba9371eca349cbe2fd6777cc4bb21cce.translatedText: lived the rest of her life in Evanston until her death in her small home on January 13, 1939. She was a beloved figure in Evanston, and her memorial service was attended by many town residents, and although her grave is in the ghetto section of Evanston Cemetery, her grave is marked, provided by the city. There is also a "Chinese Mary Road" here.

e884366ea9d53f535f0a1817885060d2c1c9bc11.sourceText: 阿袁故事虽然在很多方面都很神秘，很难想象阿袁在祖国和在美国所经历的艰辛。无论如何，她带着良好的精神和对生活的明显热情踏上了旅程。
e884366ea9d53f535f0a1817885060d2c1c9bc11.translatedText: Although the story of A Yuan is mysterious in many aspects, it is difficult to imagine the hardships A Yuan experienced in his motherland and in the United States. Regardless, she embarks on the journey with good spirits and an obvious zest for life.

4412869be25e02994f17a5436b615b8e51caf3cc.sourceText: （本文由AHC Simpson档案管理员Leslie Waggener提供。）
4412869be25e02994f17a5436b615b8e51caf3cc.translatedText: (This article was provided by AHC Simpson Archivist Leslie Waggener.)

18ee3ae4f779b72d7dd603a9d3c7ec04108b5308.translatedText: Original author: Ahcadmin, compiled by Zhang Zhaohong

0ce3cd50e72c81cccc35046be10d012687bfff76.sourceText: 编者按：看到上面这张相片总有种似曾相识的感觉。我想起了 亚利桑那“中国玛丽”，她在墓碑镇并没有留下文字资科和相片，但却有一张留传甚广的相片被人们所熟知，并广泛应用在报刊杂志以及纪录片等媒体之中，虽然这只是一个文学创造的形象，但早已经是深人民心。
0ce3cd50e72c81cccc35046be10d012687bfff76.translatedText: Editor's note: Seeing the photo above always gives me a feeling of déjà vu. I'm reminded of Arizona's "China Mary". She left no written information or photos in Tombstone, but one photo that has been widely circulated has become well-known and widely used in newspapers, magazines, documentaries and other media. Although this is just an image created by literature, it has already been deeply rooted in the hearts of the people.

1c7128b24f0c6a04aee8e8be6b5c2bb1a07ccf21.sourceText: 那么，这个墓碑镇“中国玛丽”的原型是谁呢？当看到上面这位或者已经有七十岁的怀俄明洲的“中国玛丽”时，她依然是那么的雍容华丽，如果倒退廿年，五十岁的她，与墓碑镇的“中国玛丽”是不是有着神似甚至形似的美丽外貌?!
1c7128b24f0c6a04aee8e8be6b5c2bb1a07ccf21.translatedText: So, who is the prototype of this "Chinese Mary" in Tombstone Town? When you see the "Chinese Mary" from Wyoming who is already seventy years old, she is still so graceful and graceful. If you go back twenty years, at fifty years old, would she have a similar beautiful appearance to the "Chinese Mary" from Tombstone?!

1deb5be5ccef0dde4f09bc89bf2b2d4e23f32982.sourceText: 这两位来自中国的玛丽，有着许多相同的经历，都是华人成功的移民典范。如果怀俄明州埃文斯顿的“阿袁”真是亚利桑那州墓碑镇“中国玛丽”的原型，那就是最好不过的艺术形象！
1deb5be5ccef0dde4f09bc89bf2b2d4e23f32982.translatedText: These two Marys from China have many similar experiences and are both successful examples of Chinese immigrants. If "A Yuan" of Evanston, Wyoming is really the prototype of "China Mary" of Tombstone, Arizona, that would be the best artistic image!

483053372664d16e6fb8b13b3ac60500eea5e967.sourceText: 采访雅库美国公司经理Shelby
483053372664d16e6fb8b13b3ac60500eea5e967.translatedText: Interview with Shelby, Manager of Jaku USA Company

7c5fb3fdc669eb84ec64d4712b6e86e15c715553.sourceText: 凤凰卫视专访皮纳尔郡长
7c5fb3fdc669eb84ec64d4712b6e86e15c715553.translatedText: Phoenix TV's exclusive interview with Pinal County Sheriff

513c3c5c0bfdaa2e765fae6b2e9cb7a1ab8ee5a1.sourceText: 八月中旬的凤凰城，骄阳似火，恰似凤凰卫视美洲台新闻小组前来采访的热情。 早在八月初，凯萨城市政府官方宣布了凤凰商贸城项目，凤凰卫视得知消息后，积极联络美亚资源集团商榷采访事宜， 采访小组在凤凰卫视副台长曾世平带领下，一行四 人风尘仆仆来到凤凰城，采访正在进行中的凤凰商贸城项目及其合作伙伴，体现崭新的商业如何改变城市，展现凤凰城新移民的生活风貌。 采访首先从雅库集团收购的Casa Grande Outlet Mall 开始，雅库美国的经理Shelby接受采访时说：作为最大的酒店供应商，雅库美国公司将在凯萨城开始他们的商品展示厅，建立美国 电子商务平台，直接为餐饮及酒店客户提供价廉质优的商品。 雅库为终端客户去除了通过多级代理经销商层层添加的额外成本，整合了物流资源，为终端客户至少节省了30%的采购成本。 亚利桑那区域中心的律师也在节目中介绍了凤凰商贸城项目的综合优势：相较于其他区域中心EB-5项目，该项目是集移民，经商，就业为一体，为新移民提供在美经商， 就业的机会，为其快速融入美国社会提供捷径。 随着移民家庭的到来，将会带来新的商业与​​文化的碰撞和冲击，对此，新闻小组还拜访了皮纳尔郡长和凯萨城市长。 当地政府对项目和新移民都表示非常欢迎。 当地的教育局还把在学校增设中文课程提上了议事日程。 新闻小组还采访了凤凰商贸城的合作伙伴高立国际(Colliers)公司。 高力国际将以市场领先的品牌形象，最富经验的物业顾问团队，创新的市场推广概念，尽显具备国际化的业务覆盖网络和专业的服务中标参与凤凰商贸城的运营管理。 观众可以随着凤凰卫视的摄像镜头尽情浏览凤凰城雄浑壮丽的自然风光和优越宜人的生活环境。 后续报导，请关注凤凰卫视的节目预告。
513c3c5c0bfdaa2e765fae6b2e9cb7a1ab8ee5a1.translatedText: In Phoenix in mid-August, the sun was blazing, just like the enthusiasm of Phoenix TV America's news team who came for the interview. As early as early August, the Kaiser City Government officially announced the Phoenix Trade City project. After Phoenix TV learned of the news, it actively contacted Meiya Resources Group to discuss the interview. The interview team, led by Phoenix TV deputy director Zeng Shiping, came to Phoenix with a group of four people to interview the ongoing Phoenix Trade City project and its partners, reflecting how new businesses are changing the city and showing the life style of new immigrants in Phoenix. The interview first started with the Casa Grande Outlet Mall acquired by Yaku Group. Shelby, the manager of Yaku America, said in the interview: As the largest hotel supplier, Yaku America will start their product showroom in Caesar City and establish an American e-commerce platform to directly provide catering and hotel customers with low-cost and high-quality products. Yaku has eliminated the additional costs added through multi-level agents and dealers for end customers, integrated logistics resources, and saved at least 30% of procurement costs for end customers. Lawyers from the Arizona Regional Center also introduced the comprehensive advantages of the Phoenix Trade City project in the program: Compared with other regional center EB-5 projects, this project integrates immigration, business, and employment, providing new immigrants with opportunities to do business and employment in the United States, and providing a shortcut for them to quickly integrate into American society. With the arrival of immigrant families, there will be new business and cultural collisions and impacts. In this regard, the news team also visited the County Mayor of Pinal and the Mayor of Caesar City. The local government welcomes both the project and the new immigrants. The local education bureau has also put on the agenda the addition of Chinese courses in schools. The news team also interviewed Colliers, a partner of Phoenix Trade City. Colliers International will participate in the operation and management of Phoenix Trade City with its market-leading brand image, the most experienced property consulting team, innovative marketing concepts, international business coverage network and professional services. Viewers can enjoy Phoenix's majestic natural scenery and superior and pleasant living environment with Phoenix TV's cameras. For follow-up reports, please pay attention to Phoenix TV’s program preview.

440ee6a6d9425e5a7651b202bec986137fffed50.sourceText: 舞蹈宴会 大放异彩！ 上周末长假 ，九月二日星期六，闻玲琳老师在皇冠大酒家举办了集排舞和国标舞一堂，把衆美女聚…
440ee6a6d9425e5a7651b202bec986137fffed50.translatedText: The dance banquet is a blast! During the long holiday last weekend, on Saturday, September 2nd, teacher Wen Linglin held a line dance and ballroom dance at the Crown Restaurant, bringing together all the beauties...

fb40ce60c0d1639cdfe9e0d707e64a4dea1d9bcc.sourceText: 上周末长假 ，九月二日星期六，闻玲琳老师在皇冠大酒家举办了集排舞和国标舞一堂，把衆美女聚于一齐 坐满三桌，享用丰盛佳餚，并尽情舞出精彩的舞宴。 一如往常，老师还特请我们精心把自己打扮得特美，或优雅或可爱或特殊…..让平常忙于工作、家庭的女士，当晩都美美地赴宴，一来减压二来敍旧三来更可以认识新朋友；座上我们分享自己的经历或聆听别人的趣闻，丰富人生的精彩，又可舞动健康。在排舞中，我们尽情舒展最大的活力，把青春岁月再次舞出生命的力量。 再说国标舞 ，陈老师现今在亚省艺术学院每周日下午都有排练；原来，苗条瘦身，优雅婉约都与跳舞有不可分离的情结，它提升我们的气质，曼妙形体，心情开朗，身体自然更健康，活出满满的花容姿态。 其间玲琳老师和陈老师还共舞一曲伦巴，美翻了，掌声、尖叫声也high翻了全场。我们尽兴的舞得香汗淋漓，把一切精神压力都随着汗流满頬的豁出去了。哈哈，舞宴、大放异彩。迫不期待下次的再欢聚。 10/28 星期六，万圣节变装舞会，详情预约订位，请联络玲琳480-516-8868
fb40ce60c0d1639cdfe9e0d707e64a4dea1d9bcc.translatedText: During the long holiday last weekend, on Saturday, September 2nd, teacher Wen Linglin held a line dance and ballroom dance at the Crown Restaurant, bringing all the beauties together to fill three tables, enjoy sumptuous meals, and dance to their heart's content. As usual, the teacher also specially asked us to dress ourselves up to be beautiful, elegant, cute or special... Let the ladies who are usually busy with work and family have a beautiful dinner that night, to relieve stress, reminisce about old times, and make new friends. We can share our own experiences or listen to other people's anecdotes, enriching the splendor of life, and dancing healthily. In line dance, we exert our utmost vitality and dance our youthful years with the power of life again. Let’s talk about ballroom dance. Teacher Chen now has rehearsals every Sunday afternoon at the Art Institute of Alberta. It turns out that slimness, elegance and grace are all inseparable from dancing. It enhances our temperament, graceful figure, cheerful mood, naturally healthier body, and full of beautiful appearance in life. During this time, Teacher Ling Lin and Teacher Chen also danced a rumba together, which was so beautiful that the audience was filled with applause and screams. We danced so happily that we were dripping with sweat, and we threw away all the mental pressure with the sweat. Haha, dance and shine. Can't wait to see you again next time. 10/28 Saturday, Halloween costume party, for details and reservations, please contact Linglin 480-516-8868

e6877c73b318dcfdc871077c003665e2183143b9.sourceText: 大凤凰城豪宅销售逆势异军突起
e6877c73b318dcfdc871077c003665e2183143b9.translatedText: The sales of luxury homes in Greater Phoenix bucked the trend and suddenly surged

10f1d33a5095e63bab82555c375d2a6108b79168.sourceText: 大凤凰城豪宅销售逆势异军突起 价格在两百万以上的房子比2013年8月销售量增长了63%。高端房屋销售量的增…
10f1d33a5095e63bab82555c375d2a6108b79168.translatedText: The sales of luxury homes in Greater Phoenix bucked the trend and surged. The sales volume of houses priced at more than 2 million increased by 63% compared with August 2013. The increase in sales of high-end houses...

b67c52f9bbf82391c35a7a45bd76fc38b0bd12bc.sourceText: 价格在两百万以上的房子比2013年8月销售量增长了63%。高端房屋销售量的增加，吸引了一些知名的豪宅上市。名人堂成员棒球明星兰迪约翰逊销售他的豪宅。棒球左传手销售他在凤凰城的豪宅，要价两千五百万，爵士歌手乔治本森销售他天堂谷的房产近三百万。 今年8月有超过18个两百万以上的房子被销售，去年八月出售11栋。在凤凰城东北部，8月一共销售了238栋50万以上的房子，比7月下降了17%， 比去年8月下降了9%。豪宅的价格因大小，位置差别很大。现在的平均销售价格是每平方尺254美金，比2011年8月上涨了19%。大凤凰城地区房屋的均价为每平方尺124美金。 更多有关房地产的信息请咨询Tinna (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
b67c52f9bbf82391c35a7a45bd76fc38b0bd12bc.translatedText: The sales volume of houses priced above two million has increased by 63% compared with August 2013. Increased sales of high-end homes have attracted some high-profile luxury properties to the market. Hall of Fame baseball star Randy Johnson is selling his mansion. The baseball left fielder is selling his Phoenix mansion for $25 million, and jazz singer George Benson is selling his Paradise Valley home for nearly $3 million. More than 18 homes worth more than $2 million were sold in August this year, compared with 11 last August. In Northeast Phoenix, a total of 238 houses priced at more than $500,000 were sold in August, down 17% from July and down 9% from August last year. The price of luxury homes varies greatly depending on size and location. The current average sales price is US$254 per square foot, a 19% increase from August 2011. The average price of a home in the greater Phoenix area is $124 per square foot. For more information about real estate, please contact Tinna (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

63d87b65d04d05fc0229b3282253791dced9bf0e.sourceText: 美国务院宣布台湾为赴美免签地区
63d87b65d04d05fc0229b3282253791dced9bf0e.translatedText: The U.S. State Department announced Taiwan as a visa-free area for travel to the United States

a2ac49fc2cdacf9916b975f979e14a1486b6866b.sourceText: 美国务院宣布台湾为赴美免签地区 据台湾”中央社”10月2日消息，美国国务卿希拉里将…
a2ac49fc2cdacf9916b975f979e14a1486b6866b.translatedText: The U.S. State Department announced Taiwan as a visa-free area for travel to the United States. According to Taiwan's "Central News Agency" on October 2, U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton will...

64b3ce9e72347991679935ff8b845a97d349e22c.sourceText: 为提升美国经济和旅游业竞争力，希拉里将在国务院第3次全球观光旅游会议，与副国务卿奈兹以及白宫官员共同宣布，台湾将成为全球第37个获得美国免签待遇的地区。一名美方官员向台湾媒体提示，国务院将在2日有重要宣布。
64b3ce9e72347991679935ff8b845a97d349e22c.translatedText: In order to enhance the competitiveness of the U.S. economy and tourism industry, Hillary will announce at the 3rd Global Tourism Conference of the State Department, together with Deputy Secretary of State Nitz and White House officials, that Taiwan will become the 37th region in the world to receive visa-free treatment from the United States. A US official reminded Taiwanese media that the State Council will make an important announcement on the 2nd.

94cae56523ffb08cf720c977b2ec2cbb451245b1.sourceText: 据报道，根据美国务院会议通知，包括国务院、运输部、商务部、国土安全部等50多个政府部门、美国航空业、万豪国际集团、迪斯尼集团等重要民间旅游机构150多名代表将出席会议。
94cae56523ffb08cf720c977b2ec2cbb451245b1.translatedText: According to reports, according to the meeting notice of the U.S. State Department, more than 150 representatives from more than 50 government departments including the State Council, Department of Transportation, Department of Commerce, and Department of Homeland Security, as well as important private tourism organizations such as the U.S. aviation industry, Marriott International Group, and Disney Group will attend the meeting.

a2e048333dea826a0b5c6e11a8088bffda3d473a.sourceText: 美方和台湾官员已多次表示，国土安全部已完成台湾免签验证程序，最快会在10月宣布台湾纳入免签计划。
a2e048333dea826a0b5c6e11a8088bffda3d473a.translatedText: U.S. and Taiwanese officials have stated many times that the Department of Homeland Security has completed Taiwan’s visa-free verification process and will announce Taiwan’s inclusion in the visa-free program as soon as October.

0dda8cf7c4ecef33e094d087af532e3fdadffbfb.translatedText: Three schools in Yuma were cordoned off by police after a report that a student was carrying a gun

8d6e29710f86c76c71de8842d992fd1fec29da7d.sourceText: 尤马三学校因学生携枪线报被警方封锁 周二早晨，尤马市有3所学校被警方封锁，因为有人报告说，某学生可能携带了…
8d6e29710f86c76c71de8842d992fd1fec29da7d.translatedText: > Three schools in Yuma were cordoned off by police after a report that a student was carrying a gun. Three schools in Yuma were cordoned off by police Tuesday morning after reports that a student might be carrying...

e89fd9bf9b8fbd7b07bccaf0967eb1716fddc432.sourceText: 周二早晨，尤马市有 3 所学校被警方封锁，因为有人报告说，某学生可能携带了一把枪。
e89fd9bf9b8fbd7b07bccaf0967eb1716fddc432.translatedText: Three schools in Yuma were cordoned off by police Tuesday morning after reports that a student might be carrying a gun.

6a40519456b98da57490289244bb4fbf6d4f5abd.sourceText: 据 雅虎新闻社报道，尤马警察局的一名发言人对雅虎新闻社说，在上午 9 点 55 分左右，警方接到线报后赶往当地的一所小学（ Rancho Viejo Elementary School ）。警方将该学校连同其附近的另外两所学校 Salida Del Sol Elementary School 和 WACOG Preschool 都被警方封锁。
6a40519456b98da57490289244bb4fbf6d4f5abd.translatedText: According to Yahoo News, a spokesperson for the Yuma Police Department told Yahoo News that at around 9:55 a.m., the police received a tip and rushed to a local elementary school (Rancho Viejo Elementary School). The school, along with two other nearby schools, Salida Del Sol Elementary School and WACOG Preschool, were placed on lockdown by police.

18d64e6b12c19c6d08f174c3b7f9a072a8a25214.sourceText: 据现场目击者称， Salida Del Sol 小学的学生们排队进入学校餐厅，他们的双手放在头上并在武装警察前面走过。
18d64e6b12c19c6d08f174c3b7f9a072a8a25214.translatedText: Students at Salida Del Sol Elementary School lined up to enter the school cafeteria, put their hands on their heads and walked in front of armed police, according to witnesses at the scene.

f929f43c7d69595a4cf9f25f194abda68f55c115.sourceText: Rancho Viejo 小学的学生由巴士运载至另外一所小学（ H.L. Suverkrup ）。学生的家长们可在该小学接回他们的孩子，与此同时，警察继续进行他们的调查。周二下午，警方取消了对其他学校的封锁。警方没有发现武器。
f929f43c7d69595a4cf9f25f194abda68f55c115.translatedText: Students from Rancho Viejo Elementary School are transported by bus to another elementary school (H.L. Suverkrup). Parents of the students were able to pick up their children at the elementary school while police continued their investigation. Police lifted lockdowns at other schools on Tuesday afternoon. Police found no weapons.

89242d3b14fdf79ccc2e0a361f22312fa3ae86b5.sourceText: 亚省华人榜中榜:总统学者奖 国际音乐奖 国会美术奖

0879017c2f0023caee35bb4ca5926f0296a6e6ee.sourceText: 亚省华人榜中榜:总统学者奖 国际音乐奖 国会美术奖 Allison Z. Zhen Hamilton高中的华裔…
0879017c2f0023caee35bb4ca5926f0296a6e6ee.translatedText: Chinese on the list in Alberta: Presidential Scholar Award, International Music Award, Congressional Fine Arts Award Allison Z. Zhen, a Chinese from Hamilton High School...

41f55233cc846d30ab0537d907618c51525055ac.sourceText: Hamilton高中的华裔Allison Z. Chen获得了今年的总统学者奖，她不仅学习成绩，还在各种社会活动中表现突出。 Allison Z. Zhen 也同时被耶鲁大学录取。 今年亚利桑那州一共只有两名学生获此殊荣。
41f55233cc846d30ab0537d907618c51525055ac.translatedText: Allison Z. Chen, a Chinese from Hamilton High School, won this year's Presidential Scholar Award. She not only has academic performance, but also has outstanding performance in various social activities. Allison Z. Zhen was also admitted to Yale University at the same time. Only two students from Arizona received this honor this year.

8717c05449ac5ff431eccfc274861daa06782cce.sourceText: 教育部长狄弗斯(Betsy DeVos)恭喜得奖人及其导师，她表示，”今天的总统学者是明日的领袖，我相信他们在步入下一个学习阶段，将继续成为闪亮典范,”共有5100名应届毕业高中生因学术成就取得第一关入围资格，161位总统学者奖得主和他们选的一名师长，将于6月18日前往白宫领奖。
8717c05449ac5ff431eccfc274861daa06782cce.translatedText: Secretary of Education Betsy DeVos congratulated the winners and their mentors. She said, "Today's Presidential Scholars are tomorrow's leaders, and I believe they will continue to be shining examples as they enter the next stage of study." A total of 5,100 graduating high school students have qualified for the first round due to their academic achievements. 161 Presidential Scholar Award winners and a teacher selected by them will go to the White House on June 18 to receive the award.

bd44723aafd8a7770edba0a571629baad1b43d91.sourceText: 马利科巴西语选民卡印错投票日期 马里科巴县在其西班牙语版本的选民登记卡上印错了投票日期，这一事件可能让地方政府与拉丁裔居民之间本已紧张的关系变得更为复杂。 负责选举事务的郡官员说，他们寄出了近200万份这样的新选民登记卡。 但是，在其办公室的柜台上所发出的这种选民登记卡中仅有约50张存在错误。 在西班牙语版本的选民登记卡上，大选日子印的不是11月6日，而是11月8日。 马里科巴县有关部门在一份声明中说，有关部分已经得到更新，因此在英语和西班牙语版本中投票时间都是正确的日子。 非营利组织维权组织Promise Arizona in Action说，伤害已经造成了。 人们要付出很多的努力才能让选民明确知道什么才是正确的日子。
bd44723aafd8a7770edba0a571629baad1b43d91.translatedText: > Malico Brazilian Voter Card Prints Wrong Voting Date Maricopa County printed the wrong voting dates on Spanish-language versions of its voter registration cards, an incident that threatens to complicate an already tense relationship between local governments and Latino residents. County officials in charge of elections say they have mailed out nearly 2 million of these new voter registration cards. However, only about 50 such voter registration cards issued on the counter of his office contained errors. On the Spanish version of the voter registration card, the election date is not printed on November 6, but on November 8. Maricopa County authorities said in a statement that the relevant sections have been updated so voting times are on the correct days in both the English and Spanish versions. Promise Arizona in Action, a nonprofit advocacy group, said the damage has been done. It takes a lot of effort to make it clear to voters what the correct day is.

05cf3edcdbbf7bce9163d182be8897f915729122.sourceText: –参观伦敦”莎士比亚环球剧场”

887d8cfa01a4e1a444cb0fc44f4758d3f4fe7506.sourceText: 伦敦的莎士比亚环球剧院（Shakespeare’s Globe）是专门演出莎士比亚戏剧的地方。从最初的历史追溯起，环球剧院建于四百多年前，很多莎士比亚最伟大的戏剧都在这里演出过。有很长历史而且专门演沙翁的剧作，这两条是环球剧院的显著特点；我看它最大的特点，最经典的传统，就是在剧院中央有个露天的大院子，可以容纳近千名观众买便宜票站着看戏。这个传统从起始一直延续到现在。
887d8cfa01a4e1a444cb0fc44f4758d3f4fe7506.translatedText: London’s Shakespeare’s Globe Theater (Shakespeare’s Globe) is a place dedicated to performing Shakespeare’s plays. Dating back to its earliest days, the Globe Theater was built over four hundred years ago and is where many of Shakespeare's greatest plays have been performed. It has a long history and specializes in performing Shakespeare's plays. These two are the distinctive features of the Globe Theatre. In my opinion, its biggest feature and the most classic tradition is that there is a large open-air courtyard in the center of the theater, which can accommodate nearly a thousand spectators who can buy cheap tickets and watch the show standing up. This tradition continues from the beginning to the present.

b72ab5f7e3e8d17a942dec9b1bc8169440522601.sourceText: 我和我先生在2012年6月的一天来到剧场，登记后要按规定的时间分批参观；于是我们先走到剧院外面，看看它周围的环境。
b72ab5f7e3e8d17a942dec9b1bc8169440522601.translatedText: My husband and I came to the theater one day in June 2012. After registration, we had to visit in batches according to the specified time; so we first walked outside the theater to take a look at its surrounding environment.

4addc28f09d7548c7a5ad4edf603ab433f95752e.sourceText: 环球剧院紧靠泰晤士河，位于它的的南岸。这一带河面很宽，泰晤士河水在这里平缓地流淌，视野十分开阔。许多历史建筑和超现代的摩天大厦，巧妙地发布在泰晤士河两岸，与河流、河堤自然景物相得益彰。站在环球剧院前面的河堤望北看，世界第二大穹顶的圣保罗教堂的大圆顶在阳光下非常醒目。沿河边往西走，附近有老发电厂改成、有高耸烟囱的泰德现代画廊和泰晤士河畔画廊；站在位於滑铁卢桥和伦敦桥之间的”千禧年步行桥”上，往下游看，号称伦敦新地标的夏德塔的水晶尖塔在蓝天白云的衬托下，熠熠生辉。往东走，远有”伦敦桥”展览，就是脍炙人口的英文儿歌”伦敦桥要塌下来！(London bridge is falling down)”歌词里的伦敦桥。现在这里是新建的伦敦桥；老的伦敦桥在七十年代被英国人拆除，一个美国石油大亨买下拆除的伦敦桥，全部搬迁到美国，然后又组装起来放到亚历桑那州的Lake Havasu。美国人自己没有多长的历史，羡慕英国人的老古董，花钱买点历史感也是值得的。
4addc28f09d7548c7a5ad4edf603ab433f95752e.translatedText: The Globe Theater is close to the Thames River and is located on its south bank. The river in this area is very wide, the Thames flows gently here, and the view is very broad. Many historical buildings and ultra-modern skyscrapers are cleverly placed on both sides of the Thames, complementing the natural scenery of the river and embankments. Standing on the embankment in front of the Globe Theater and looking north, the dome of St. Paul's Church, the second largest dome in the world, is very eye-catching in the sun. Walking west along the river, there are Tate Modern Gallery and Thamesside Gallery, which were converted from old power plants with towering chimneys. Standing on the Millennium Pedestrian Bridge between Waterloo Bridge and London Bridge, looking downstream, the crystal spiers of the Shard Tower, known as London's new landmark, shine brightly against the blue sky and white clouds. Going east, there is the "London Bridge" exhibition in the distance, which is the London Bridge in the lyrics of the popular English children's song "London bridge is falling down!" Now here is the newly built London Bridge; the old London Bridge was demolished by the British in the 1970s. An American oil tycoon bought the demolished London Bridge, moved it all to the United States, and then assembled it and placed it in Lake Havasu, Arizona. Americans themselves don’t have a long history, so they envy the British for their antiques. It’s worth spending money to buy a sense of history.

d4eba344e84108493828de6409c13f3039327cb4.sourceText: 我们跟着一位瘦削精干的老太太讲解员进入了环球剧院，她带我们绕剧院里外上下走一圈，给我们讲解环球剧院的历史现状。
d4eba344e84108493828de6409c13f3039327cb4.translatedText: We followed a thin and capable old lady guide into the Globe Theater. She took us up and down the theater and explained to us the history and current situation of the Globe Theatre.

fc7210d243001f4238b9649c48bfbd7f075cbcc7.sourceText: 最初的环球剧院建于1599年，离现在的位置约二百米的地方。在1613年的一场演出时，茅草屋顶失火，剧院烧成了废墟；后来虽然重新建成，但掌握了政权的英格兰清教徒对娱乐活动很排斥，在1642年把它关掉；两年后这个剧院就被彻底毁掉了。
fc7210d243001f4238b9649c48bfbd7f075cbcc7.translatedText: The original Globe Theater was built in 1599, about 200 meters away from its current location. During a performance in 1613, the thatched roof caught fire and the theater burned to ruins; although it was later rebuilt, the English Puritans who took power were disgusted with entertainment activities and closed it down in 1642; the theater was completely destroyed two years later.

e60c8f51546bb48bcc44bfef46a0361daa5a873b.sourceText: 又过了三百年，到了1949年，热衷演出莎翁剧的美国演员华纳麦克（Sam Wanamaker）来到了伦敦。他发现环球剧院遗址上只有一个墙上的青铜片上的记号能让人想起伟大的莎士比亚，华纳麦克很失望和伤心。
e60c8f51546bb48bcc44bfef46a0361daa5a873b.translatedText: Three hundred years later, in 1949, American actor Sam Wanamaker, who was keen on performing Shakespeare plays, came to London. Warner Mac was disappointed and heartbroken when he discovered that there was only one bronze plaque on the wall at the Globe Theater that had markings reminiscent of the great Shakespeare.

34414e4feafc5e83176466eabb3d11071a744977.sourceText: 他回到美国后，于1970年创办了后来被称为”莎士比亚环球信托基金会”的组织，一直在筹集资金准备重建剧院和教育、展览中心。华纳麦克为此孜孜不倦地努力了二十三年，一直到老年有病，他还在为筹集钱款辛苦操劳。剧院及辅助性建筑终于在1997年，即华纳麦克去世三年半之后，才顺利完工。
34414e4feafc5e83176466eabb3d11071a744977.translatedText: After returning to the United States, he founded an organization later known as the "Shakespeare Globe Trust" in 1970 and has been raising funds to rebuild theaters and education and exhibition centers. Warner Mac worked tirelessly for twenty-three years. Even when he was old and ill, he was still working hard to raise money. The theater and supporting buildings were finally completed in 1997, three and a half years after Warner Mac's death.

4e9ffcd1c0ab0c151efe50977212393519604ee1.sourceText: 重建的剧院是完全按照剧院遗址的出土文物作为样本建造的，按照16世纪的风格对橡木进行雕琢；将板条、石膏、石灰按当年的工艺混合；材料以砖瓦和木材为主；在芦苇茅草的屋顶上增加了现代的洒水设备防止火灾。
4e9ffcd1c0ab0c151efe50977212393519604ee1.translatedText: The reconstructed theater was built entirely according to the samples of unearthed cultural relics from the theater site. The oak wood was carved in the style of the 16th century; lath, gypsum, and lime were mixed according to the craftsmanship of that year; the materials were mainly bricks and wood; modern sprinkler equipment was added to the reed thatched roof to prevent fires.

1f749e2058fe8d6b62792705f5185e251bb9305c.sourceText: 现在的剧院基本上保留了原来剧院的风格。整个剧院是环状结构，观众席有三层，木制的座位和栏杆呈环形围绕着舞台；最靠近舞台楼上的小包厢算是”绅士包房”，富人戏迷可以在这里舒适地”听戏”，因为在舞台侧面，这里的视角并不能看到舞台的全貌；这些绅士贵妇也许最在乎的是全场近二千观众对他们华丽衣饰的关注，而不是舞台上的演出。
1f749e2058fe8d6b62792705f5185e251bb9305c.translatedText: The current theater basically retains the style of the original theater. The entire theater is a ring-shaped structure, with three levels of auditoriums, and wooden seats and railings surrounding the stage in a ring; the small box upstairs closest to the stage is considered a "gentleman's private room", where wealthy theater fans can "listen to the play" comfortably, because from the side of the stage, the full view of the stage cannot be seen; these gentlemen and ladies may care most about the attention of the nearly 2,000 audience members on their gorgeous clothes, rather than the performance on the stage.

4bdb5f56237f767b4c9e5d46a2971f27e47599b9.sourceText: 舞台台面是普通地板，地板中间有个活动木门。木门下面就相当于地狱，魔鬼、女巫就从这里窜上舞台。两边的柱子也是木制的，而且显得很原始简陋。整个舞台布景相当简单，与观众席之间没有屏障，充分让观众与戏剧融合为一。
4bdb5f56237f767b4c9e5d46a2971f27e47599b9.translatedText: The stage surface is an ordinary floor with a movable wooden door in the middle of the floor. Under the wooden door is the equivalent of hell, where devils and witches come onto the stage. The pillars on both sides are also made of wood and look very primitive and crude. The entire stage setting is quite simple, with no barrier between the audience and the audience, fully allowing the audience to become one with the drama.

fecbde9257715baf04d91706516e691d54b84e34.sourceText: 环形座席的中间是一个很大的院子，是露天的，因为可以采用自然光线代替舞台灯光。现在的院子可以容纳七百名花5英镑买廉价票的观众站着看戏。而莎士比亚时代，那时可以挤满一千人。
fecbde9257715baf04d91706516e691d54b84e34.translatedText: In the middle of the circular seats is a large courtyard, which is open-air because natural light can be used instead of stage lights. The current courtyard can accommodate 700 spectators who paid £5 for cheap tickets to watch the play standing up. In Shakespeare's day, a thousand people could be packed in.

1dbd154ff764feb59f755bc8dddad820da29a72b.sourceText: 据讲解员说，当年只要花一便士就可以站着看戏，一便士在那时可以买两品脱的啤酒和一长条面包；买这种廉价票的观众就被称为”Penny Stinkards”，即”一便士的臭家伙们”。我们可以想象，那时的贩夫走卒、屠夫苦力干完了活，又不像现在有淋浴洗澡；他们端着啤酒，夹着面包就赶来看戏；英国羊多，英国人又爱吃羊肚杂碎，再加上大蒜葱头；1000人挤在一起，进出十分不便；内急起来，讲解员说还有就地方便的，能不臭哄哄吗？但至少，四百年前英国劳苦民众很爱看戏，他们是莎翁的粉丝；而莎翁也爱他们，当年盖剧场时就留了个露天院子让他们也能买便宜的票享受看戏。
1dbd154ff764feb59f755bc8dddad820da29a72b.translatedText: According to the commentator, you only had to pay one penny to watch the theater while standing, and one penny could buy two pints of beer and a loaf of bread at that time. Audiences who bought such cheap tickets were called "Penny Stinkards", which means "penny stinkards". We can imagine that after the work was done, the peddlers and butchers and coolies did not have showers like they do now; they rushed to watch the show with beer and bread; there were many sheep in the UK, and the British loved to eat haggis, plus garlic and onions; 1,000 people were crowded together, making it very inconvenient to get in and out; when there was an emergency, the commentator said that there was something more convenient on the spot, could it not stink? But at least four hundred years ago, the working people in Britain loved to go to the theater. They were fans of Shakespeare; and Shakespeare loved them too. When the theater was built, an open-air yard was left so that they could buy cheap tickets and enjoy the theater.

41ec1f233e8ede053401b644d15e3078a18066b1.sourceText: 莎士比亚环球剧场这个出售便宜站票的传统从1599年初建一直保留到今天；现在英国的各大剧院，包括皇家剧院都延续了这个传统；甚至欧洲很多国家的剧院都有这种站席，满足普通观众购买便宜票或游客临时买站票看戏。很多年前我们住在欧洲，我随着大学的学生旅行团到了维也纳；我们一群穷学生就排了三小时的队买站票进了著名的维也纳歌剧院”听”歌剧，也只能算听，因为太远了，基本看不清舞台上的人脸，但在那么好的氛围中享受了美妙的音乐，我至今印象深刻。因此，我特别赞赏英国乃至欧洲这种出售站票传统，我是尝过甜头的。
41ec1f233e8ede053401b644d15e3078a18066b1.translatedText: >Shakespeare’s Globe Theater’s tradition of selling cheap standing tickets has been preserved to this day since it was first built in 1599. Now major theaters in the UK, including the Royal Theater, have continued this tradition; even theaters in many European countries have such standing seats to satisfy ordinary audiences to buy cheap tickets or tourists to temporarily buy standing tickets to watch the show. Many years ago when we lived in Europe, I went to Vienna with a university student tour group. A group of us poor students queued for three hours to buy standing tickets and entered the famous Vienna Opera House to "listen" to operas. It could only be regarded as listening to operas because it was too far away and we could hardly see the faces on the stage. However, we enjoyed wonderful music in such a good atmosphere, and I am still deeply impressed. Therefore, I especially appreciate the tradition of selling standing tickets in the UK and even Europe. I have tasted the benefits.

5a2c4465064eb92744c3ca41333fa70e4c2d9fee.sourceText: 那天我们参观环球剧场时，舞台上正在演出试排，导游让我们在空档时进入，然后悄悄地坐下看他们排练。我们也算在环球剧院坐着看过折子戏了。
5a2c4465064eb92744c3ca41333fa70e4c2d9fee.translatedText: When we visited the Globe Theater that day, there was a trial rehearsal of a performance on the stage. The tour guide let us enter during the break, and then quietly sat down to watch them rehearse. We also sat and watched the excerpts at the Globe Theater.

782264cbc3f5a4429352a244ca6cb59297a95c0b.sourceText: 记得回中国时在报刊上读过一则短文，国内某明星说在伦敦的环球剧院演出，登上了豪华的舞台云云；文中把环球剧场简朴的舞台描述得很豪华高级，似乎能衬托演出的档次。其实发起重建剧场的华纳麦克的初衷是还原剧场简朴的原样，认为它的历史感比豪华更有价值。
782264cbc3f5a4429352a244ca6cb59297a95c0b.translatedText: I remember reading a short article in a newspaper when I returned to China. A certain domestic star said that he performed at the Globe Theater in London and was on a luxurious stage. The article described the simple stage of the Globe Theater as luxurious and high-end, which seemed to set off the quality of the performance. In fact, the original intention of Warner Mac, which initiated the reconstruction of the theater, was to restore the theater to its original simplicity, believing that its sense of history is more valuable than luxury.

30c088d89e8fbcb7ecc96deb28a4a2ccfdb5a00a.sourceText: 我的老同学住在伦敦，得知我去了环球剧院，他告诉我，环球剧场还上演过中文的莎士比亚剧。可见现在中文热的程度！同时我也好奇，用中文念台词是否能保留莎剧的味道。
30c088d89e8fbcb7ecc96deb28a4a2ccfdb5a00a.translatedText: My old classmate lives in London and learned that I went to the Globe Theatre. He told me that the Globe Theater also performed Chinese Shakespeare plays. This shows how popular Chinese is now! At the same time, I am also curious whether reading the lines in Chinese can retain the flavor of Shakespeare's drama.

d50726cf4b30e62618cff4a16aff5f9112748b32.sourceText: 我们这次在伦敦待的时间比较长，跑了不少地方，使我印象很深的还是环球剧场。但这次还是留下了一个遗憾，没在环球剧院看沙翁的戏剧。因为那几天演的是”亨利八世” 这齣舞台剧，剧情侧重于政治角力、宗教改革，因为这齣剧是莎翁的旧式英文，据说现在一般的英国人也不一定能完全听懂。英国人可是从小就在学校里必修莎士比亚文学的，因此我不想凑这个热闹。
d50726cf4b30e62618cff4a16aff5f9112748b32.translatedText: We stayed in London for a long time this time and visited many places. The one that impressed me deeply was the Globe Theatre. But this time I still have one regret, not watching the Shakespeare play at the Globe Theatre. Because the stage play "Henry VIII" was performed in those days, the plot focused on political wrestling and religious reform. Because this play was Shakespeare's old-style English, it is said that ordinary British people may not be able to fully understand it. British people have been required to study Shakespeare in school since childhood, so I didn't want to join in the fun.

c8b9a62790a95ba0c013dbc1dba3c5ec877cd4eb.sourceText: 盼望有一天再到伦敦，特地去买环球剧场的站票，在蒙蒙细雨中，与七百名观众挤在露天的院子里，让汗水混合着雨水流下，听舞台上的哈姆雷特的不带麦克的浑厚的声音用中文念出最著名的一段独白：”生存还是毁灭，这是个问题。”（To be, or not to be; that’s the question）”，那才过瘾呢！
c8b9a62790a95ba0c013dbc1dba3c5ec877cd4eb.translatedText: I look forward to returning to London one day. I went to buy standing tickets for the Globe Theater. In the drizzle, I squeezed in the open-air courtyard with 700 spectators, letting the sweat mix with the rain. I listened to Hamlet’s rich voice without a microphone on the stage read the most famous soliloquy in Chinese: “To be, or not to be; that’s the question.” (To be, or not to be; that’s the question.) question)", that would be so enjoyable!

41e328eb8798b49b4f1c6d2a4e527d9be59e4f92.translatedText: The theater faces the Millennium Bridge on the Thames River (Photographed by Wen Ruo in June 2012)

b288f48cb4d53a5b2e51453ed08b316fc7d96054.sourceText: 中国的美食闻名遐迩，主要是它的丰富性和多样性。尽管古人云：味不分南北，食不论东西，但随着时代的变迁和民众的生活文化的不同，再加上在一定的区域内，由于气候、地理、历史和风俗的差异，经过漫长历史演变而形成的一整套自成体系的烹饪技艺和风味，并被全国各地所承认的地方菜肴。中华各大菜系和流派也相继产生，按省划分为 鲁、粤、川、苏、闽、浙、湘、徽，即被人们常说的中国”八大菜系”。按文化流派划分为东北菜、北京菜、冀鲁菜、胶辽菜、山西菜、中原菜、西北菜、上江菜、江淮菜、江浙菜、江西菜、四川菜、湖南菜、福建菜、客家菜、广东菜。
b288f48cb4d53a5b2e51453ed08b316fc7d96054.translatedText: China's cuisine is famous for its richness and diversity. Although the ancients said that taste does not distinguish between north and south, and food does not matter east or west, with the changes of the times and the differences in people's living culture, coupled with the differences in climate, geography, history and customs in a certain area, a set of self-contained cooking techniques and flavors have been formed after a long historical evolution, and are recognized as local dishes across the country. The major Chinese cuisines and schools have also emerged one after another. They are divided by province into Shandong, Guangdong, Sichuan, Jiangsu, Fujian, Zhejiang, Hunan and Hunan, which are often referred to as the "eight major cuisines" of China. According to cultural genres, it is divided into Northeastern cuisine, Beijing cuisine, Hebei and Shandong cuisine, Jiaoliao cuisine, Shanxi cuisine, Central Plains cuisine, Northwest cuisine, Shangjiang cuisine, Jianghuai cuisine, Jiangsu and Zhejiang cuisine, Jiangxi cuisine, Sichuan cuisine, Hunan cuisine, Fujian cuisine, Hakka cuisine, and Cantonese cuisine.

5b8ca99b768d43097d968ee243827cc85197f0ad.sourceText: 以前每次出去旅游时，除了领略祖国的大好河山外，再就是品尝当地的特色美食，游山玩水和风味小吃两者如影相随，让旅途充满了无限的乐趣。久而久之， 也渐渐地分辨出南北不同的口味来了（其实很容易分辨）。与之相比较，我更喜欢按文化流派划分的菜，它分得较细，不那么笼统。其实区域不同，风味菜就各异，品尝得多了，就能在细嚼慢咽中慢慢品出不同的口感。
5b8ca99b768d43097d968ee243827cc85197f0ad.translatedText: In the past, every time I traveled, in addition to appreciating the great rivers and mountains of the motherland, I also tasted the local specialties. Traveling and enjoying local snacks went hand in hand, making the journey full of infinite fun. Over time, I gradually began to distinguish the different tastes of the north and the south (actually it is very easy to distinguish). In comparison, I prefer dishes divided by cultural genres, which are more detailed and less general. In fact, different regions have different flavor dishes. The more you taste them, the different textures you can slowly taste while chewing them slowly.

8311b355e909e10368232675d9ab3f9e49de9093.sourceText: 2009年初次到美国，我们几个朋友驾车出去旅游，沿途的自然风光和到处可见的野生动物让人感叹造物主的不公平，上帝似乎太偏爱美国了。你见过那么浑然天成的大峡谷吗？那要经过多少年的风蚀和地壳运动才形成如此壮观的景象。不仅仅是大峡谷，只要不经意的一瞥，每一处都如诗如画，那蓝天白云，以及新鲜的空气，如诗如画，让人如置于梦中的仙境之中。
8311b355e909e10368232675d9ab3f9e49de9093.translatedText: I came to the United States for the first time in 2009. Several of our friends drove out for a trip. The natural scenery and wild animals everywhere along the way made people lament the injustice of the Creator. God seemed to be too partial to the United States. Have you ever seen such a natural Grand Canyon? It took many years of wind erosion and crustal movement to form such a spectacular scene. Not only the Grand Canyon, but with a casual glance, every place is picturesque. The blue sky, white clouds, and fresh air are so picturesque that it makes people feel like they are in a fairyland in their dreams.

4124bea8ee881582130c39117e5e7186c7fd19fd.sourceText: 一天的观光旅游下来，按习惯我们开始品尝当地的美食了，中午时为节约时间，我们一般用西餐快餐解决问题，西餐的单一性远没有丰富的中国美食让我们一饱口福，我们的中国胃很快厌倦了太多奶油的西餐。晚上我们好不容易找到一家中餐馆，在一个安静的角落坐后，像在国内一样，准备慢慢地品尝美食。我们点了最具川味的”宫保鸡丁”和湘菜”水煮回头鱼”等等，等菜上桌的时候，我们完全傻了眼，名字叫的一样，但颜色完全没有国内的鲜艳。红干辣椒换成了新鲜的青椒，鱼滑腻腻的柔若无骨。我小心翼翼地尝了一口，跟想象中的差距实在太遥远了，我们一下子没有了食欲，心情也变得有点沮丧。当地的临时导游告诉我们，他说在美国，想吃到百分百正宗的中国菜，这比造长城还难。因为老中为了迎合老美的口味，所有的中国菜都变成”中式美味”。
4124bea8ee881582130c39117e5e7186c7fd19fd.translatedText: After a day of sightseeing, we started to taste the local food as usual. In order to save time at noon, we usually eat Western fast food to solve the problem. The singleness of Western food is far less satisfying than the rich Chinese food, and our Chinese stomachs quickly get tired of too much creamy Western food. We finally found a Chinese restaurant in the evening, sat down in a quiet corner, and prepared to enjoy the delicious food slowly just like we did in China. We ordered the most Sichuan-style "Kung Pao Chicken" and Hunan cuisine "Boiled Fish", etc. When the dishes were served, we were completely dumbfounded. The names were the same, but the colors were not as bright as those in China. The dried red peppers were replaced with fresh green peppers, and the fish was as smooth as boneless. I tasted it cautiously, and the difference was so far away from what I had imagined. We suddenly lost our appetite and became a little depressed. The local temporary tour guide told us that in the United States, it is more difficult to eat 100% authentic Chinese food than to build the Great Wall. Because in order to cater to the tastes of Laos and Americans, all Chinese dishes have become "Chinese delicacies."

e69e798497af62166cb798460c8a61ec1ac10e47.sourceText: 原来如此，看来想找到原先在国内的完美组合”旅游+美食”，看来在这里毫无希望了。接下来的几天，我们开始尝试全用西餐，但几顿下来，我们失去了刚来的精气神，习惯了中餐的胃口一下子适应不过来，由反胃到胃痛，最后到一蹶不振。美国的浪漫气息和造物主制造的仙境对我们失去了吸引力，我们准备打道回府。没有美食的旅游还有什么意义呢？回国之前，一个随行的朋友约我去亚利桑那州凤凰城去看她儿子，我想最后瞥一眼美国也无妨。我们驾了六个小时的车，一路上的风景似乎还是那个风景，但对我已经没有多大的吸引力了。我希望快点回国，和朋友们海吃一顿，把这几天的胃口补偿回来。
e69e798497af62166cb798460c8a61ec1ac10e47.translatedText: So, it seems that if you want to find the perfect combination of "tourism + food" in China, there is no hope here. In the next few days, we tried to eat all Western food, but after a few meals, we lost the energy we had just gained, and our appetites that were accustomed to Chinese food suddenly couldn't adapt. We went from nausea to stomach pain, and finally fell into despair. The romantic atmosphere of America and the wonderland created by the Creator have lost their appeal to us, and we are ready to return home. What’s the point of traveling without food? Before returning to China, a friend who was accompanying me asked me to go to Phoenix, Arizona, to see her son. I thought it wouldn’t hurt to take a last look at the United States. We drove for six hours, and the scenery along the way seemed to be the same, but it no longer had much appeal to me. I hope to return to China soon and have a big meal with my friends to make up for the appetite I have lost in the past few days.

0794087e263ac1c7193aeb57886b0188bd2049a4.sourceText: 我们刚到她儿子的公寓门口，小伙子已经在那里迎接我们了。我想母子俩叙旧时，我就躺在床上睡大觉。没想到她儿子见到亲人，兴奋不已，直接拉我们下楼。我们糊里糊涂地被他拉进车里。大约半小时后，车从一个十字路口拐进去，停在一个建筑物前。小伙子将我们领进建筑物旁边的一家”东北小厨”餐馆里，我想”东北菜”尽管也是中国东北的一大特色菜，但它此时生在美国，可能也早就变成美国餐了。我想这最后的晚餐正不正宗已经无所谓了，最后来一次”中式美餐”也无妨。
0794087e263ac1c7193aeb57886b0188bd2049a4.translatedText: We just arrived at the door of her son's apartment, and the young man was already there to greet us. I think while mother and son were reminiscing about old times, I would lie in bed and sleep. Unexpectedly, her son was so excited to see his relatives that he directly pulled us downstairs. We were pulled into the car by him in a daze. About half an hour later, the car turned into an intersection and stopped in front of a building. The young man took us into a "Northeast Chef" restaurant next to the building. I thought that although "Northeastern cuisine" is also a major specialty of Northeast China, it was born in the United States at this time and may have already become American food. I think it doesn't matter whether this last supper is authentic or not, it doesn't hurt to have a "Chinese meal" one last time.

462641141bb26ca07cf81e239baeef13faa92548.sourceText: 餐馆里有面食和炒菜，我是南方人，不太喜欢吃面食，我就点了一个我在国内最爱吃的”水煮鱼片”，他们点了”地三鲜”、”东北乱炖”和”夫妻肺片”，没有主食，就另外点了”水晶包”、”韭菜盒子”。
462641141bb26ca07cf81e239baeef13faa92548.translatedText: There are pasta and stir-fry dishes in the restaurant. I'm from the south and don't like pasta very much, so I ordered the "boiled fish fillet" which is my favorite in China. They ordered "Di San Xian", "Northeast Stew" and "Couple's Pork Slices". There was no staple food, so I ordered "Crystal Bun" and "Leek Box".

3a0b79b12596c254d13f6d6784a5242c5f4d1ef9.sourceText: 里面的人很多，大部分是华人，也有一些老外。我们的菜很快就上了桌。小伙子看着桌上的菜，激动地说，我就等着你们来美国吃地道的中国菜棗东北菜，我们学校的学生三天两头往这跑，他们说，在这里吃饭，就感觉像在国内一样，这里的菜能解我们的思乡之情。我先是小心翼翼地尝了尝我点的菜，尝了尝”地三鲜”里的土豆和茄子，又尝了尝”水煮鱼片”，里面的麻、辣、鲜终于勾起了我的食欲，似曾相识的美味又出现了，几盘菜很快就被我们消灭掉了，第一次在异国他乡让我这么”吃得过瘾”。
3a0b79b12596c254d13f6d6784a5242c5f4d1ef9.translatedText: There are many people inside, most of them are Chinese, and there are also some foreigners. Our dishes arrived quickly. The young man looked at the food on the table and said excitedly, "I'm waiting for you to come to the United States to eat authentic Chinese cuisine from Northeastern China. Students from our school come here every day. They said that eating here makes us feel like we are at home. The food here can relieve our homesickness." I first carefully tasted the dishes I ordered, the potatoes and eggplants in the "Di San Xian", and then the "boiled fish fillets". The spicy, spicy and fresh taste finally aroused my appetite, and the familiar delicacies appeared again. We quickly finished several dishes. It was the first time that I was so "satisfied" in a foreign country.

3e82c68182e5e47fa989a97c5ab60ffa33f4ca78.sourceText: 终于在美国吃到正宗的中国菜了，几天旅途的疲劳和沮丧一扫而光。我们很好奇他们怎么做到那么正宗的，小伙子的同学兼司机说，为了让这边的华人吃到正宗的中国菜，他们很多调料和干货都是直接从国内空运过来的，我们一旦想家了，就结伴到这里来吃、、、、、、在这几个年轻人的感染下，我们也变得异常开心，吃到很晚才回公寓。
3e82c68182e5e47fa989a97c5ab60ffa33f4ca78.translatedText: Finally had authentic Chinese food in the United States, and the fatigue and frustration of several days of travel were gone. We were very curious about how they made it so authentic. The young man’s classmate and driver said that in order to let the Chinese people here eat authentic Chinese food, many of their seasonings and dry goods were flown directly from China. Once we got homesick, we would come here to eat together... Under the influence of these young people, we also became extremely happy and did not return to the apartment until very late.

5b2cb2308a2fb846bd54be368df0105456d1296f.sourceText: 经常听人调侃：人生最大的幸福莫过于吃中国的美食，娶日本的老婆，住英国的房子，挣美国的钞票。在我看来，旅游和美食相辅相成，缺一不可。精彩的旅游有了美食相伴，才显得更加精彩纷呈。其实人生的幸事莫过如此，人的年龄越大，越能沉淀出吃出来的快乐哲学。
5b2cb2308a2fb846bd54be368df0105456d1296f.translatedText: I often hear people ridicule: The greatest happiness in life is to eat Chinese food, marry a Japanese wife, live in a British house, and earn American money. In my opinion, tourism and food complement each other and are indispensable. Wonderful travel becomes more exciting when accompanied by delicious food. In fact, there is nothing more fortunate than this in life. The older a person gets, the more he can develop the philosophy of happiness through eating.

7766819779f884ae2a90436676e5a97a54783b91.sourceText: 大小贪官应对近期反腐大势的三个动向
7766819779f884ae2a90436676e5a97a54783b91.translatedText: Three trends for corrupt officials, large and small, to respond to the recent anti-corruption trend

3600fbbf4d008b31547e716c1bcf0d6798477e58.sourceText: 大小贪官应对近期反腐大势的三个动向 我国是否开始实施官员财产公示，也许将成为今年两会的主要看点。这个议题在…
3600fbbf4d008b31547e716c1bcf0d6798477e58.translatedText: Three trends for corrupt officials, large and small, to respond to the recent anti-corruption trend. Whether my country will begin to implement official asset disclosure may become the main focus of this year's Two Sessions. This issue is...

43618d81364677bcb1302a62809fadd458bbc564.sourceText: 我国是否开始实施官员财产公示，也许将成为今年两会的主要看点。这个议题在我国已经有20年”难产”历史，不仅引起越来越多人的注意，实际上也已经成为政府是否真有决心反腐的试金石和突破点。
43618d81364677bcb1302a62809fadd458bbc564.translatedText: Whether my country has begun to implement official asset disclosure may become the main focus of this year's Two Sessions. This issue has a history of being "difficult" in our country for 20 years. It has not only attracted more and more people's attention, but has actually become a touchstone and breakthrough point for whether the government is really determined to fight corruption.

973e9362157d7b7ad346a06b306ef94cec2c9811.sourceText: 说难，其实也不难，就看”上梁”能不能起带头作用。以”三公消费”问题为例，早有明确政策，但是屡禁不止，今年的行情却大不一样了，为什么？就是因为”上梁”带头了。”上梁”一带头，”下梁”也就自动效仿，有没有明文规定并不重要。
973e9362157d7b7ad346a06b306ef94cec2c9811.translatedText: It is difficult, but it is not difficult at all. It just depends on whether the "top beam" can take the lead. Take the issue of "three public consumption" as an example. There have been clear policies for a long time, but repeated prohibitions have continued. However, the market situation this year is very different. Why? It's because "Shang Liang" took the lead. As soon as the "upper beam" takes the lead, the "lower beam" will automatically follow suit. It doesn't matter whether there are explicit provisions.

c837c705f7aa9f201ca68cdd9428ed2e458b4166.sourceText: 往年大、小贪官对于”财产公示”根本不放在眼里，因为知道这事在中国行不通。但是今年行情也和往年大不相同了，一是往年媒体总是回避这个敏感话题，今年似乎不再回避；二是领导很可能带头公示财产；三是房地产信息全国大联网，藏不住了。
c837c705f7aa9f201ca68cdd9428ed2e458b4166.translatedText: In previous years, corrupt officials, both big and small, paid no attention to "property disclosure" because they knew it would not work in China. However, the market situation this year is also very different from previous years. First, in the past, the media always avoided this sensitive topic, but this year it seems that it no longer avoids it; second, leaders are likely to take the lead in publicizing properties; third, real estate information is networked across the country and cannot be hidden.

ead56a90ed203c1b3e02b68924ee57d8fcacdbe9.sourceText: 广东一个年薪仅1万元的处级小官，被爆有20多套房产。爆料者，是房地产信息网的工作人员，而那位”房叔”也很快被”双规”。这件事情，说明即便没有财产公示这样的硬性规定，民间也已经开始用房地产信息网搜索官员财产，或花钱购买信息，用”泄露信息”的方式公示出来，其结果是爆炸性的，后果十分严重，想盖也盖不住。与其让民间不断爆料，政府有可能尽快实现官员公示财产，以争取主动。
ead56a90ed203c1b3e02b68924ee57d8fcacdbe9.translatedText: A department-level official in Guangdong with an annual salary of only 10,000 yuan was revealed to own more than 20 properties. The person who broke the news was a staff member of the Real Estate Information Network, and the "Uncle Fang" was quickly "double-regulated". This incident shows that even if there is no such rigid rule as property disclosure, people have begun to use real estate information networks to search for officials’ properties, or spend money to purchase information and publicize it by “leaking information.” The results are explosive and the consequences are so serious that they cannot be covered up even if they want to. Rather than letting the public continue to reveal information, the government may quickly realize the disclosure of assets by officials in order to gain the initiative.

f9ee81805f0f99ddba0792e1ab05faf089db6eb6.sourceText: 在美国，房地产信息是公开的。到网上查询房地产产权和税务信息是很普通的事情，不存在保密或泄密的问题。中国早晚也会如此。
f9ee81805f0f99ddba0792e1ab05faf089db6eb6.translatedText: In the United States, real estate information is public. It is very common to look up real estate title and tax information online, and there is no issue of confidentiality or leakage. China will do the same sooner or later.

32efd4f2600d6900fec983cbc7ac66307e48173c.sourceText: 有鉴于此，嗅觉十分灵敏的大小贪官已经行动起来，最近出现三个重要动向，一是急急抛售名下的房地产或将资产过户转名；二是大量向境外转移资金；三是自己索性外逃不归。
32efd4f2600d6900fec983cbc7ac66307e48173c.translatedText: In view of this, corrupt officials, big and small, with a very keen sense of smell have already taken action. Three important trends have appeared recently. One is to sell real estate under their names or transfer assets to another name; second, to transfer a large amount of funds overseas; third, to simply flee without returning.

ffce12e36f703636d8016b0bdb896731be0f1fd3.sourceText: 从媒体揭露的情况来看，真是触目惊心（点击这里）。据估计，今年1月份上半月，北京市的二手房”网签”交易量是去年同期的三倍半；今年的外逃资金可能达到15000亿美元之巨（相当于国家外汇储备总额的半数）；去年中秋和十一期间出国的官员，有1100人没有按时回来，有714人已经确定为外逃。
ffce12e36f703636d8016b0bdb896731be0f1fd3.translatedText: Judging from the situation revealed by the media, it is really shocking (click here). It is estimated that in the first half of January this year, Beijing's "online signing" transaction volume for second-hand houses was three and a half times that of the same period last year; this year's outflow of funds may reach a huge US$1.5 trillion (equivalent to half of the country's total foreign exchange reserves); 1,100 officials who went abroad during the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day last year did not return on time, and 714 have been confirmed to have fled.

e740fedd037ec425836bd30cea92e070d6dc559a.sourceText: 这三个动向，至少说明反腐大潮形势很好，已经引起大小贪官的恐慌。
e740fedd037ec425836bd30cea92e070d6dc559a.translatedText: These three trends at least show that the anti-corruption trend is in good shape and have caused panic among corrupt officials, big and small.

96b9ae0a881addb745cae85bfbe36557d9e1fd28.sourceText: 奥巴马连任致本州枪支销量猛增 （亚省时报） 奥巴马再次当选总统后，美国枪支销售量猛增。有分析认为，这是因为民众担心奥巴马在第二任期内可能会加强枪支管理。 枪支销售商报告称，AK-47突击步枪就像”刚出炉的蛋糕”一样，非常热销。据了解，今年10月，当局对申请购买枪支者的背景调查数量增加了18.4%，这个数据从侧面反映了未来枪支的销售量。 在亚利桑那州，一位从公路巡警转行做枪支销售的东主说，奥巴马总统连任成功至刚过去的感恩节假期，他的枪支销售业绩提高了150%。 ”我做了25年，我必须说实话，比尔克林顿和奥巴马当政是我最好的时光。为什么？因为人们恐惧。” 民众积极购买枪支是担心奥巴马在其第二任期内会加强对枪支的管理。2008年，奥巴马首次当选总统时，美国也发生了类似情况，有人戏称奥巴马是最佳枪支推销员。
96b9ae0a881addb745cae85bfbe36557d9e1fd28.translatedText: Obama's re-election led to a surge in gun sales in the state (Alberta Times) After Obama was re-elected as president, gun sales in the United States surged. Some analysts believe this is because people are worried that Obama may tighten gun control during his second term. Gun sellers report that AK-47 assault rifles are selling like "fresh out of the oven." It is understood that in October this year, the number of background checks conducted by the authorities on applicants applying to purchase firearms increased by 18.4%. This data reflects future gun sales. In Arizona, a highway patrolman turned gun sales proprietor said his gun sales increased by 150% between President Obama's re-election and the past Thanksgiving holiday. "I've been doing this for 25 years, and I have to be honest, Bill Clinton and Obama were my best years. Why? Because people are afraid." People are actively buying guns out of fear that Obama will tighten gun regulations during his second term. In 2008, when Obama was first elected president, a similar situation happened in the United States. Some people jokingly called Obama the best gun salesman.
