76fef15d2847b99c77be0bcd1a093483cb1bf9f8.translatedText: Hotspot｜Children born in the United States who do not return to the country for two years are deemed to have automatically given up their Chinese nationality and cannot apply for a travel permit

8c0932aeeebd0b5c0fd31c015313485f251deb75.sourceText: 热点｜在美出生儿童两年不回国视为自动放弃中国籍,不能办旅行证 由于本人刚给小孩办了旅行证，所以对这个2015/…
8c0932aeeebd0b5c0fd31c015313485f251deb75.translatedText: Hotspot｜Children born in the United States who do not return to the country for two years are deemed to have automatically given up their Chinese nationality and cannot apply for a travel permit Since I have just applied for a travel permit for my child, I am particularly concerned about the new policy that was implemented on 2015/03/27.

64bbb21cc4902f30254ff7b169f5cccb2bbc15ef.sourceText: 由于本人刚给小孩办了旅行证，所以对这个2015/03/27刚执行的新政策特别关注。第一时间分析了大量案例，在细则还未公布在中国使领馆的网页之前，抢先为大家理清了来龙去脉：
64bbb21cc4902f30254ff7b169f5cccb2bbc15ef.translatedText: We immediately analyzed a large number of cases and clarified the ins and outs for everyone before the detailed rules were published on the Chinese embassy and consulates’ webpages:

2a2fb5912a4b3f423f1e397fa1bbe9ccec076ed9.sourceText: 首先，父母为中国籍没有在国外定居的国外出生儿童，具有中国国籍，回国需办理旅行证。 这一条规定实行已久，大家都知道。
2a2fb5912a4b3f423f1e397fa1bbe9ccec076ed9.translatedText: First of all, children born abroad whose parents are Chinese and have not settled abroad have Chinese nationality and need to apply for a travel permit when returning to the country. This rule has been in place for a long time and everyone knows it.

5b880b8f41509df1b162cef9c543cd5688cfcd0b.sourceText: 新规定： 1， 小孩如在两岁前未回过中国的，视为自动放弃中国国籍，回国必须办中国签证。这一新规定已经多个网友案例确认。实施日期为2015/03/27，即昨天。但各个领馆对这个?#20004;岁?#30340;判定不完全一样，旧金山领馆为24个月，洛杉矶为18个月。 [Ref 1] http://www.mitbbs.com/article_t/Returnee/13525999.html [Ref 2] http://forums.huaren.us/showtopic.aspx?topicid=1802278 [Ref 3] http://www.mitbbs.com/article_t/NextGeneration/36809277.html
5b880b8f41509df1b162cef9c543cd5688cfcd0b.translatedText: > New regulations: 1. If a child has not returned to China before the age of two, he or she will be deemed to have automatically given up Chinese nationality and must apply for a Chinese visa when returning to China. This new regulation has been confirmed by multiple netizen cases. The implementation date is 2015/03/27, which is yesterday. However, different consulates do not have exactly the same determination of age. The consulate in San Francisco is 24 months and the consulate in Los Angeles is 18 months. [Ref 1] http://www.mitbbs.com/article_t/Returnee/13525999.html [Ref 2] http://forums.huaren.us/showtopic.aspx?topicid=1802278 [Ref 3] http://www.mitbbs.com/article_t/NextGeneration/36809277.html

1ba45186e979cc21c930cdfb354fd7b396bf37e7.sourceText: 2, 另据网友案例汇报，即便两岁前回过国，再旅行至美国，居住超过两年的，也被视为放弃中国国籍。不能续签旅行证，只能申请中国签证。 [Ref 4] http://forums.huaren.us/showtopic.aspx?topicid=1802643&postid=66901516#66901516
1ba45186e979cc21c930cdfb354fd7b396bf37e7.translatedText: 2, According to case reports from netizens, even if you have returned to China before the age of two and then traveled to the United States for more than two years, you will be deemed to have given up your Chinese nationality. You cannot renew your travel permit and can only apply for a Chinese visa. [Ref 4] http://forums.huaren.us/showtopic.aspx?topicid=1802643&postid=66901516#66901516

4df15f7f5b270a37d6561ff4e58434378e255523.sourceText: 3, 新规定根据的是最新的国籍法补充办法，最终解释权归领事所有。 这个所有给小孩办过旅行证的的父母都知道。旅行证申请是最严格的，必须由领事亲自”接见”子，才能确认并签字通过。
4df15f7f5b270a37d6561ff4e58434378e255523.translatedText: 3, the new regulations are based on the latest supplementary measures to the Nationality Law, and the final right of interpretation belongs to the consul. All parents who have applied for a travel permit for their children know this. The application for a travel permit is the most stringent and must be "visited" by the consul in person before it can be confirmed and signed.

6161952aa5da55958fc4a85e054a755faba55d9b.sourceText: 本人刚去给孩子续签了旅行证，幸好她两岁前回过国，这次在美国待的时间也不到两年，才能顺利领证。感叹好幸运啊！
6161952aa5da55958fc4a85e054a755faba55d9b.translatedText: I just went to renew my child’s travel permit. Fortunately, she returned to China before she was two years old, and she only stayed in the United States for less than two years before she could successfully obtain the permit. I feel so lucky!

c2919bcd380c8706bc4ca812432d263d04ada9ad.sourceText: 父母还没绿卡又想给孩子国内办个国内户口的，赶快在孩子两岁前申请旅行证回国吧。。。
c2919bcd380c8706bc4ca812432d263d04ada9ad.translatedText: If your parents do not have a green card and want to apply for a domestic household registration for their children in China, they should apply for a travel permit to return to the country before their children turn two years old. . .

7c7a7a6fdbead845dc37ecf5e4a59d6aad0b96d2.sourceText: ～～～～～旅行证申请全攻略～～～～～ 看了旅行证新政策原文后，很多朋友都来问我办子女旅行证的细节。所以决定写一篇我在旧金山办旅行证的全攻略，希望对大家有用。
7c7a7a6fdbead845dc37ecf5e4a59d6aad0b96d2.translatedText: ~~~~~A guide to applying for a travel permit~~~~~ After reading the original text of the new travel permit policy, many friends came to ask me about the details of applying for a travel permit for their children. So I decided to write a complete guide on how to apply for a travel permit in San Francisco. I hope it will be useful to everyone.

24fc4c61b50f67a0bc21d9c4949490bc844ae752.sourceText: 1， 材料准备，这是整个过程中最费时的一步 1.1， 小孩材料： 出生证，美国护照，旧的旅行证（如有）。全都需要原件和复印件 1.2， 父母材料： 结婚证（或结婚公证）原件和复印件，护照原件和非空白页复印件，新版I94打印件或老版的原件和复印件，父母在美身份证明（I797, I140, 绿卡相关文件等）的原件和复印件。 请确认带好小孩出身时的父母身份文件。 1.3, 复印件如有遗漏，领馆里有收quarter的复印机。 2， 填表 2.1， 表格在这里下载： http://www.chinaconsulatesf.org/chn/qianzhen/t554559.htm 2.2， 关键选项： – 第一次办证原证件情况可按美国护照填写。如续签，按过期的旅行证填写。 – 拼音姓名需与原证件拼写保持一致，不一定要和中文名拼写一致。 – 国内户籍地址填父母户籍地址。 – 外国国籍填否，外国护照填是。备注里写”美国出生” 3， 照片 3.1， 一套四张，小二寸。可自己制作：对着白底或浅蓝底的背景拍张大头照，传到http://www.epassportphoto.com/， 尺寸选China passport，网站会帮你排版。 3.2， 如嫌麻烦，旧金山领馆里可以当场拍照。但有时机器会坏。 4， 地址和泊车 使馆地址为1450 Laguna St, San Francisco, CA 94115。车可以停在旁边的Cleary Ct上，位子足够，不过坡略陡。
24fc4c61b50f67a0bc21d9c4949490bc844ae752.translatedText: 1. Material preparation, this is the most time-consuming step in the whole process. 1.1. Child materials: birth certificate, US passport, old travel permit (if any). All require originals and copies. 1.2. Parents’ materials: Original and copy of marriage certificate (or marriage notarization), original and copy of passport, new version of I94 printout or original and copy of old version, original and copy of parents’ identity certificate in the United States (I797, I140, green card related documents, etc.). Please make sure you have your child's parent identity documents with you. 1.3. If there are any missing copies, there is a quarter copy machine in the consulate. 2. Fill in the form 2.1. Download the form here: http://www.chinaconsulatesf.org/chn/qianzhen/t554559.htm 2.2. Key options: – For the first time application, the original document can be filled in according to the US passport. If renewing, fill in the form for the expired travel certificate. – The pinyin name must be consistent with the spelling on the original document, not necessarily the Chinese name. – For domestic household registration address, fill in the parents’ household registration address. – Fill in “No” for foreign nationality and “Yes” for foreign passport. The remarks say "Born in the United States" 3. Photo 3.1, a set of four, 2 inches smaller. You can make it yourself: take a photo of your head against a white or light blue background, upload it to http://www.epassportphoto.com/, select China passport as the size, and the website will help you format it. 3.2. If you find it troublesome, you can take photos on the spot at the Consulate in San Francisco. But sometimes machines break. 4. Address and Parking The Embassy address is 1450 Laguna St, San Francisco, CA 94115. The car can be parked on Cleary Ct next to it. There is enough space, but the slope is slightly steep.

9ae61e6a2e708f33eac246f1a531a9f590cabdda.sourceText: 5， 申请，付费，和领证 5.1, 如果决定几天后去领馆自取的，那恭喜你，直接领号办理吧。收信用卡。 5.2, 如果打算让领馆给你寄回家的，领馆不收信用卡，请先去旁边的邮局买好一个已贴邮资的回邮信封，一张$35 Money order申请费，一张$5 Money order回邮费。
9ae61e6a2e708f33eac246f1a531a9f590cabdda.translatedText: 5. Application, payment, and collection 5.1. If you decide to go to the consulate to pick up the certificate in a few days, congratulations, just get the number directly. Take credit cards. 5.2. If you plan to ask the consulate to send it home to you, and the consulate does not accept credit cards, please go to the nearby post office and buy a stamped return envelope, which costs $35 for the Money order application fee and $5 for the Money order return postage.

2a0b05704b657b7dd872008e6650172aa0111f75.sourceText: 6, 面试见领事 父母面试好后需要等领事亲自面见小孩后才能签字通过申请。领事一般两三小时出来一次。所以要回邮先麻利点去邮局买好money order, 不然一耽误就是三小时。
2a0b05704b657b7dd872008e6650172aa0111f75.translatedText: 6. Interview with the consul. After the parents have completed the interview, they need to wait for the consul to interview the child in person before they can sign and approve the application. The consul usually comes out every two to three hours. So if you want to reply, go to the post office quickly and buy the money order, otherwise the delay will be three hours.

3926216cf4b1a419e9700b2dae68e1b5107efe12.sourceText: 这些就是我能提供的最全攻略，如有遗漏错误，请大家留言指正，我直接在帖子里改。 Bless！
3926216cf4b1a419e9700b2dae68e1b5107efe12.translatedText: These are the most complete guides I can provide. If there are any omissions or errors, please leave a message and I will correct them directly in the post. Bless!

8f8af7efe5adcf690fb42003523ba8ee695086ab.sourceText: 中评社香港9月21日电／据中国经济周刊报道，一个在美国廉租房里长大的华裔男孩，祖父是有钱人家的杂役，父亲是中餐馆老板。 如今这个华裔男孩长大成人，带着家小来到北京。
8f8af7efe5adcf690fb42003523ba8ee695086ab.translatedText: China Review News Service, Hong Kong, September 21 / According to China Economic Weekly, a Chinese boy who grew up in a low-rent house in the United States, his grandfather was a handyman for a wealthy family, and his father was a Chinese restaurant owner. Now this Chinese boy has grown up and brought his family to Beijing.

b592dba46b123c25ac84517d8ae8b62fae9e8445.sourceText: 而此时的他，并不是一个普通的游客或返乡者。 他的身份是美国驻华大使。
b592dba46b123c25ac84517d8ae8b62fae9e8445.translatedText: At this time, he was not an ordinary tourist or returnee. His identity is the U.S. Ambassador to China.

b3920ad881e12f3e93503b1164aeeff1c7136375.translatedText: The old boy who "returns to his hometown with honor"

6b5a589946132516f3da1b289ecc5a07b34fdbe0.sourceText: 当记者在央视《对话》栏目的演播室见到骆家辉时，感到他看上去比照片上更具沧桑感。 大部分头发显然是染黑过的，只留下了两鬓的斑白，每当微笑时，眼角就露出深深的鱼尾纹。
6b5a589946132516f3da1b289ecc5a07b34fdbe0.translatedText: When the reporter saw Locke Jiahui in the studio of CCTV's "Dialogue" column, he felt that he looked more aged than in the photos. Most of his hair has obviously been dyed black, leaving only gray on his temples. Whenever he smiles, deep crow's feet appear at the corners of his eyes.

8eb8a0ca217db3556185cb1a49bf8d383d307fc2.sourceText: ”’作为华裔美国人，我很自豪能够成为驻华大使，回到祖先的家园。我最希望的是我的父亲还在世，他一定会感到很自豪。”忆起刚刚去世不到一年的父亲 ，骆家辉流露出一股难以掩饰的遗憾。
8eb8a0ca217db3556185cb1a49bf8d383d307fc2.translatedText: "'As a Chinese-American, I am very proud to be the ambassador to China and return to the homeland of my ancestors. What I hope most is that my father is still alive, and he will be very proud." Recalling his father who had just passed away less than a year ago, Locke showed an unconcealable regret.

7cc76081926a257a2a656bf9ddf6855f93240ca9.sourceText: 骆家辉曾经两次回到家乡广东台山祭祖。 第一次是1997年，他刚刚当选华盛顿州州长，带着父母和妻子回到故乡，当时闻讯赶来的同乡有好几万人，人们从村口的公路一直排到了水步镇。 第二次是2006年，据在场人回忆，骆家辉在祖屋里进厅入房、爬上爬下，用数码相机对祖屋里里外外拍个不停，并不时向在美国长大 的夫人李蒙做手势进行耐心讲解。 临行前，骆家辉专门前往祖父工作过的店铺参观，还掏钱购买了两个国产单车铃带回去留念。
7cc76081926a257a2a656bf9ddf6855f93240ca9.translatedText: Locke has returned to his hometown of Taishan, Guangdong twice to worship his ancestors. The first time was in 1997, when he had just been elected governor of Washington State and returned to his hometown with his parents and wife. At that time, tens of thousands of fellow villagers came after hearing the news. People lined up from the road at the entrance of the village to Shuibu Town. The second time was in 2006. According to the memories of those present, Locke entered the ancestral house, climbed up and down, and used a digital camera to take pictures of the inside and outside of the ancestral house. From time to time, he made gestures to his wife Li Meng, who grew up in the United States, and patiently explained. Before leaving, Locke specially visited the shop where his grandfather worked, and also spent money to buy two domestic bicycle bells to take back as a souvenir.

14f9531b919414a3fa1846dbd737ee16c80bc108.sourceText: ”中国是这么大的一个国家，拥有这么多人口，但还有很多农村人生活条件很差，这一点我1997年返乡时已经有所了解，2006年的探访更让我感受深刻。所以 很显然我作为驻华大使的任务之一，就是到各地去推动发展更密切的美中关系。因为包括抗击疾病、应对气候变化、能源等问题，都需要中美两国共同努力协作才能解决， 这对两国人民都将带来益处。”骆家辉感慨道。
14f9531b919414a3fa1846dbd737ee16c80bc108.translatedText: " China is such a big country with such a large population, but there are still many rural people with poor living conditions. I already knew this when I returned home in 1997, and my visit in 2006 made me feel even more deeply. So obviously one of my tasks as the ambassador to China is to go to various places to promote the development of closer U.S.-China relations. Because issues including the fight against disease, climate change, energy, etc., all require joint efforts and collaboration between China and the United States to solve, This will bring benefits to the people of both countries," Locke said with emotion.

0f65bb8214f00f0ebfb0e6e4a13371a569ecfb8e.sourceText: 孙杨开启灿烂篇章 或接力刘翔成新偶像
0f65bb8214f00f0ebfb0e6e4a13371a569ecfb8e.translatedText: Sun Yang opens a brilliant chapter, or takes over from Liu Xiang to become a new idol

b7d12818f091ecae843c1e76132d515517f89036.sourceText: 孙杨开启灿烂篇章 或接力刘翔成新偶像 2012年伦敦奥运会的口号是”激励一代人”，…
b7d12818f091ecae843c1e76132d515517f89036.translatedText: Sun Yang opens a brilliant chapter, or takes over from Liu Xiang to become a new idol The slogan of the 2012 London Olympics is "Inspiring a Generation"...

abff521922dda503699ef53ba2141d79edf98eac.sourceText: 2012年伦敦奥运会的口号是”激励一代人”，为中国游泳实现了诸多突破、打破一项世界、收获2金1银1铜的孙杨，也许会”接力”克服困难重返110米跨栏赛道的刘翔，成为激励新一代年轻人的最好榜样。
abff521922dda503699ef53ba2141d79edf98eac.translatedText: The slogan of the 2012 London Olympics is "Inspiring a Generation". Sun Yang, who has achieved many breakthroughs for Chinese swimming, broke a world record, and won 2 golds, 1 silver and 1 bronze, may "relay" Liu Xiang, who overcame difficulties and returned to the 110-meter hurdles track, to become the best example to inspire a new generation of young people.

516d8bc778bb7e55712a128b6946ce7a7469ecf8.sourceText: 从竞技层面和对中国体育历史的贡献而言，孙杨的成绩已经比肩甚至超越了在雅典奥运会上一举夺金的刘翔。孙杨的每一块奥运奖牌，都具有历史突破意义棗他的400米金牌，是中国男子游泳史上第一枚奥运金牌；他的200米自由泳银牌，是中国男子在短距离项目的第一块奖牌；他率领中国男队拼得的4?00米接力铜牌，是中国男子游泳队的第一块接力奖牌，证明了中国男子游泳整体实力的提升；他的1500米自由泳，是中国男子第一次在奥运会上打破世界纪录
516d8bc778bb7e55712a128b6946ce7a7469ecf8.translatedText: In terms of competitiveness and contribution to Chinese sports history, Sun Yang's performance has been comparable to or even surpassed that of Liu Xiang, who won the gold medal at the Athens Olympics. Each of Sun Yang's Olympic medals has a historical breakthrough significance - his 400-meter gold medal is the first Olympic gold medal in the history of Chinese men's swimming; his 200-meter freestyle silver medal is the first medal for Chinese men in short-distance events; the 4.00-meter relay bronze medal he led the Chinese men's team to win is the first relay medal for the Chinese men's swimming team, proving that The overall strength of Chinese men's swimming has improved; his 1,500-meter freestyle was the first time a Chinese man broke a world record at the Olympics

8fcf5221ee883daa0d136475517e87690fe3e4ac.sourceText: 21岁的孙杨，是中国奥运史上在田径和游泳这样的基础大项中获得”双金王”的第一人，为中国体育史开启了灿烂的华丽篇章。 Mitbbs.com 中国男子游泳曾经在50年代冲击过高峰，穆祥雄、戚烈云等人打破过世界纪录，然而由于种种原因没能参加奥运会；此后中国男子长期沉寂，只能眼看着”五朵金花”在1992年巴塞罗那奥运会绽放。1996年奥运会，蒋丞稷两次名列第四，2008年北京奥运会，张琳获得亚军，都在当时创造了历史最佳。在伦敦，孙杨终于为中国游泳人实现了长久以往的奥运梦想！ Mitbbs.com 从体育精神的层面，孙杨堪比刘翔。在伦敦水上中心，孙杨表现出”不服输、不放弃”的冠军气质，面对媒体间炒作的各种传闻，朴泰桓决赛资格的失而复得，他淡然处之，但是他在夺冠后用怒吼和挥拳，证明了”中国人可以赢得漂亮”！此后，孙杨力挺被外媒刁难的小将叶诗文，并在接力赛中凭借闪电速度，从接棒时的第五，一路狂追到第三名，反超强大的德国和澳大利亚等队，获得中国游泳历史上的第一次男子接力奖牌。比赛结束后，他累得瘫倒在地上，半天提不起力气。孙杨坦言：”游接力比我自己游单项，比游1500米累多了。为了集体的荣誉，我拼了！” Mitbbs.com 即使在1500米自由泳决赛因为现场太吵，听不到声音而率先出发的小插曲，也没有打乱孙杨坚定的夺金信念，他把90后的个性鲜明、敢拼敢闯、有个性又有集体观念的性格特征表现得淋漓尽致，在世界泳坛仿佛初升的太阳般灿烂耀眼。 Mitbbs.com 而刘翔经历了雅典奥运会的辉煌，北京奥运会的退赛低谷，伤病磨难后的复出，一步步重新塑造形象和竞技状态最高潮，显示出了不同寻常的抗压能力和坚韧不拔的意志。伦敦奥运会，刘翔依然遭遇伤病的侵扰，不管他能否在110米栏赛道上获得成功，他都是经历过风雨见过彩虹的英雄。
8fcf5221ee883daa0d136475517e87690fe3e4ac.translatedText: 21-year-old Sun Yang is the first person in Chinese Olympic history to win the "Double Gold" in basic sports such as track and field and swimming, opening a brilliant and gorgeous chapter in the history of Chinese sports. Mitbbs.com Chinese men's swimming reached its peak in the 1950s. Mu Xiangxiong, Qi Lieyun and others broke world records. However, due to various reasons, they were unable to participate in the Olympic Games. After that, Chinese men were silent for a long time and could only watch the "Five Golden Flowers" bloom at the 1992 Barcelona Olympics. In the 1996 Olympics, Jiang Chengji ranked fourth twice, and in the 2008 Beijing Olympics, Zhang Lin won the runner-up, both of which were the best in history at the time. In London, Sun Yang finally realized the long-standing Olympic dream for Chinese swimmers! Mitbbs.com From a sportsmanship perspective, Sun Yang is comparable to Liu Xiang. At the London Aquatic Center, Sun Yang showed his champion temperament of "not admitting defeat and never giving up". Faced with various rumors hyped by the media, he took it indifferently when Park Tae-hwan regained his qualification for the finals. However, he roared and pumped his fists after winning the championship, proving that "the Chinese can win beautifully"! After that, Sun Yang supported Ye Shiwen, a young player who was being challenged by foreign media. With lightning speed in the relay race, he went from fifth place when taking over the baton to third place, overtaking the powerful teams of Germany and Australia, and won the first men's relay medal in the history of Chinese swimming. After the game, he was so tired that he collapsed on the ground, unable to lift his strength for a long time. Sun Yang said frankly: "Swimming the relay is much more tiring than swimming the individual events on my own, and is much more tiring than swimming the 1,500 meters. For the collective honor, I fought hard!" Mitbbs.com Even in the 1,500-meter freestyle final, when he started first because the scene was too noisy and could not hear the sound, it did not disrupt Sun Yang's firm belief in winning the gold. He vividly displayed the characteristics of the post-90s generation with a distinctive personality, the courage to fight, and the individuality and collective concept. He was as bright and dazzling in the world of swimming as the rising sun. Mitbbs.com Liu Xiang has experienced the glory of the Athens Olympics, the trough of withdrawal from the Beijing Olympics, the comeback after injuries and hardships, step by step reshaping his image and the climax of competitive status, showing his unusual ability to withstand pressure and perseverance. At the London Olympics, Liu Xiang was still plagued by injuries. Regardless of whether he could succeed on the 110-meter hurdles track, he was a hero who had experienced ups and downs and seen rainbows.

b91e7e08326c7abd8c8bff8dc27d96fcc7f554cf.sourceText: 从外在形象和性格标签来看，刘翔和孙杨都具有超级偶像的共同特质：阳刚、帅气的外表，谦逊、时尚的性格，善于接受新事物，以及强大的亲和力。另外，和以往中国运动员不善言辞相比，他们乐于接受采访，说话幽默，个性十足，体现出了当代中国运动员的风采，和成熟、自信、开放的心态。 Mitbbs.com 在2010年广州亚运会时，孙杨有”爱哭哥”的称号，赢也哭输也哭；当他真的在伦敦奥运会1500米自由泳夺冠后，他再次泪撒泳池。虽说”英雄有泪不轻弹”，但是真情流露的孙杨更让人感动。”刚开始出发只有我一个人跳入水中，在空中时我的脑子一片空白，完全不知道发生了什么。好在我能够继续比赛，并且迅速调整了自己的情绪。我想证明，美国人、欧洲人可以打破世界纪录并且赢得奥运冠军，中国人同样也能做到！”孙杨掷地有声地说。 Mitbbs.com 在国际认普遍可的体育项目中，中国选手一般缺乏话语权，只有姚明、刘翔、李娜和其所从事的运动项目能够入围。伦敦奥运会后，中国体育新一轮的”偶像接力棒”传到了孙杨手里。论实力、年龄以及项目统治力，90后的孙杨完全可以在今后很长一段时间里保持”中国太阳永不落”的优势。
b91e7e08326c7abd8c8bff8dc27d96fcc7f554cf.translatedText: From the perspective of external image and personality labels, both Liu Xiang and Sun Yang have the common traits of super idols: masculine and handsome appearance, humble and fashionable personality, good at accepting new things, and strong affinity. In addition, compared with Chinese athletes in the past who were not good at talking, they are willing to be interviewed, speak humorously and have full personality, which reflects the style of contemporary Chinese athletes and their maturity, confidence and open mind. Mitbbs.com At the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games, Sun Yang was known as the "Crying Brother" and cried when he won and lost. When he really won the 1500-meter freestyle at the London Olympics, he burst into tears in the swimming pool again. Although it is said that "a hero never sheds tears easily", Sun Yang's true feelings are even more touching. "At the beginning, I was the only one jumping into the water. When I was in the air, my mind went blank and I had no idea what was happening. Fortunately, I was able to continue the game and quickly adjusted my emotions. I want to prove that Americans and Europeans can break world records and win Olympic championships, and the Chinese can do the same!" Sun Yang said loudly. Mitbbs.com In internationally recognized sports, Chinese players generally lack the right to speak. Only Yao Ming, Liu Xiang, Li Na and their sports can be shortlisted. After the London Olympics, a new round of "idol baton" in Chinese sports was passed to Sun Yang. In terms of strength, age and project dominance, Sun Yang, born in the 1990s, can definitely maintain the advantage of "China's sun never sets" for a long time to come.

ada4d2471eb951a218481115e5070da62dcb5cb2.sourceText: 孙杨的成功已经在家乡杭州、浙江乃至范围内引发了学习游泳的热潮。曾经走出过罗雪娟、孙杨、叶诗文等奥运冠军和世界级选手吴鹏的杭州陈经纶体校每天下午，门口站满了等候训练的孩子和家长。 Mitbbs.com 泳池外，孙杨不需要和刘翔对比，也不需要和索普甚至菲尔普斯相比，他要做的，就是做好自己，用他每一次的拼搏，每一次的努力付出，去激励一代人。 Mitbbs.com ”我才刚刚起步。我的下一个目标是2016年里约奥运会！”这是孙杨在1500米自由泳夺冠后发出的雄心壮志。 Mitbbs.com
ada4d2471eb951a218481115e5070da62dcb5cb2.translatedText: Sun Yang's success has triggered a craze for swimming learning in his hometown of Hangzhou, Zhejiang and even throughout the country. Hangzhou Chen Jinglun Sports School, which has produced Olympic champions such as Luo Xuejuan, Sun Yang, and Ye Shiwen, as well as world-class player Wu Peng, has its doors lined with children and parents waiting for training every afternoon. Mitbbs.com Outside the swimming pool, Sun Yang does not need to compare with Liu Xiang, nor does he need to be compared with Thorpe or even Phelps. What he has to do is to be himself and use his every struggle and every effort to inspire a generation. Mitbbs.com "I have just started. My next goal is the 2016 Rio Olympics!" This is Sun Yang's ambition after winning the 1500-meter freestyle. Mitbbs.com

197182591d3fd55df7b8e70661e5f6be9a1ad195.sourceText: 1500米自由泳孙杨破纪录 收奥运第二金 Mitbbs.com
197182591d3fd55df7b8e70661e5f6be9a1ad195.translatedText: Sun Yang breaks record in 1500m freestyle and collects second Olympic gold medal Mitbbs.com

d527aa2b1f3a722e1a8f9eec429d73c3c70b096b.sourceText: 北京时间8月5日消息，2012年伦敦奥运会游泳比赛进入最后一天，中国队又收获一枚金牌。在男子1500米自由泳决赛中，孙杨一路领先以14分31秒02的成绩夺取金牌，同时创造了新的世界纪录。这是中国代表团在本届奥运会的第24枚金牌，也是中国游泳队在本届奥运会的第五金，这创造了中国游泳队在奥运会上的最佳战绩。 Mitbbs.com
d527aa2b1f3a722e1a8f9eec429d73c3c70b096b.translatedText: News on August 5, Beijing time, the 2012 London Olympics swimming competition entered the final day, and the Chinese team won another gold medal. In the men's 1500-meter freestyle final, Sun Yang led the way and won the gold medal with a time of 14 minutes, 31 seconds and 02 seconds, setting a new world record at the same time. This is the 24th gold medal for the Chinese delegation at this Olympics and the fifth gold medal for the Chinese swimming team at this Olympics. This creates the best record of the Chinese swimming team at the Olympics. Mitbbs.com

f2232821b1bea8e2184b2e3708d95485f285eaa0.sourceText: 孙杨称霸1500米泳池 破纪录再夺一枚金牌 Mitbbs.com
f2232821b1bea8e2184b2e3708d95485f285eaa0.translatedText: Sun Yang dominated the 1,500-meter swimming pool, breaking the record and winning another gold medal. Mitbbs.com

d6150765f4e3657bba79dc4b6ea69a530ad8020f.sourceText: 孙杨是男子1500米自由泳世界纪录保持者，去年的上海世锦赛他夺取该项目金牌。预赛中孙杨游出14分43秒25排名首位，决赛中他排在第4泳道。孙杨的主要竞争对手是2008年北京奥运会冠军突尼斯的梅洛里、韩国的朴泰桓和加拿大的科奇拉尼，科奇拉尼、梅洛里和朴泰桓分别排在第3泳道、第5泳道和第7泳道。 Mitbbs.com
d6150765f4e3657bba79dc4b6ea69a530ad8020f.translatedText: Sun Yang is the world record holder in the men's 1,500-meter freestyle. He won the gold medal in this event at the Shanghai World Championships last year. In the preliminaries, Sun Yang ranked first with a time of 14 minutes, 43 seconds and 25 seconds. In the finals, he ranked in lane 4. Sun Yang's main competitors are Tunisia's Melori, the 2008 Beijing Olympic champion, South Korea's Park Tae-hwan, and Canada's Kochilani. Kochilani, Melori, and Park Tae-hwan are ranked in lanes 3, 5, and 7 respectively. Mitbbs.com

270a20205795560f960fb3d6825e9b78a83db5f4.sourceText: 比赛开始因为发枪出现问题，只有孙杨跳入水中，在水中的孙杨显得有些无辜。返回出发台的孙杨示意暂停，坐在凳子上稍微调整了一下，稳定一下情绪。第二次发枪比赛正式开始，前50米朴泰桓处于领先位置，孙杨排名第二位。150米过后，孙杨已经升至首位，朴泰桓位列第二。之后孙杨保持领先，200米时他的成绩是1分54秒31继续领先，朴泰桓仍紧随其后。300米结束时孙杨依旧领先，朴泰桓和加拿大的科奇拉尼分列二三位，他们三人组成了第一阵营。 Mitbbs.com
270a20205795560f960fb3d6825e9b78a83db5f4.translatedText: There was a problem with the gun at the beginning of the game. Only Sun Yang jumped into the water. Sun Yang in the water looked a little innocent. Sun Yang, who returned to the starting platform, signaled a pause, sat on a stool and adjusted a little to stabilize his mood. The second firing competition officially started. Park Tae-hwan took the lead in the first 50 meters, and Sun Yang ranked second. After 150 meters, Sun Yang has risen to the first place, and Park Tae-hwan ranks second. After that, Sun Yang maintained the lead. In the 200 meters, his time was 1 minute, 54 seconds and 31 seconds, and he continued to lead, with Park Tae-hwan still closely behind. At the end of the 300 meters, Sun Yang was still in the lead. Park Tae-hwan and Canada's Kochlani ranked second and third. The three of them formed the first camp. Mitbbs.com

45a184b7443fe5bd060ec029bdb6c5e30cab4ac2.sourceText: 400米转身时孙杨的成绩是3分51秒50，他游得很平稳，滑水的实效相当好，朴泰桓和科奇拉尼还是排在二三位。550米时孙杨依旧匹马领先，朴泰桓和科奇拉尼的成绩相仿，他们仍跟随着孙杨。600米转身时孙杨逐渐拉开了和朴泰桓、科奇拉尼的距离，他的成绩还是领先着世界纪录。 Mitbbs.com
45a184b7443fe5bd060ec029bdb6c5e30cab4ac2.translatedText: Sun Yang's time in the 400-meter turn was 3 minutes, 51 seconds and 50 seconds. He swam very smoothly and his water skiing was quite effective. Park Tae-hwan and Kochlani were still ranked second and third. At 550 meters, Sun Yang was still leading by one horse. Park Tae-hwan and Kochlani had similar results, and they were still following Sun Yang. When turning around in the 600 meters, Sun Yang gradually opened up the distance between Park Tae-hwan and Kochlani, and his result was still ahead of the world record. Mitbbs.com

4eee7b9e10366f02c1e537935443704867139fcf.sourceText: 随着比赛的进行，孙杨在身体控制上依旧很出色，他腿部打出的水花是最小的，赛程过半时他以7分16秒15领先，科奇拉尼超越朴泰桓升至第二位。 Mitbbs.com
4eee7b9e10366f02c1e537935443704867139fcf.translatedText: As the game progressed, Sun Yang was still very good in body control, and the splash on his legs was the smallest. At the halfway point of the race, he led with 7 minutes, 16 seconds and 15 seconds. Kochilani surpassed Park Tae-hwan and rose to second place. Mitbbs.com

0388043aa46497f950f3a8197410bdd52aa0d76b.sourceText: 800米孙杨稳稳地占据领先位置，他的成绩领先世界纪录2秒，排名第二的科奇拉尼距离孙杨有近两个身位的距离。900米后孙杨在场上继续领先，科奇拉尼排名第二，朴泰桓已经慢慢落后，他被梅洛里超越跌至第四位。 Mitbbs.com
0388043aa46497f950f3a8197410bdd52aa0d76b.translatedText: 800m Sun Yang firmly occupies the leading position. His result is 2 seconds ahead of the world record. The second-ranked Kochilani is nearly two body positions away from Sun Yang. After 900 meters, Sun Yang continued to lead on the field. Kochlani ranked second. Park Tae-hwan had slowly fallen behind. He was overtaken by Melori and fell to fourth place. Mitbbs.com

a3e054b88f8b115685724c074708f26abaadeffb.sourceText: 1000米时孙杨的成绩是9分43秒10，他领先优势明显，科奇拉尼和梅洛里分居二三位。1100米转身时孙杨成绩是10分41秒73，他远远甩开另外三位竞争对手。 Mitbbs.com
a3e054b88f8b115685724c074708f26abaadeffb.translatedText: >Sun Yang's time in the 1,000 meters was 9 minutes, 43 seconds and 10 seconds. He had a clear lead, with Kochilani and Melori in second and third place. When Sun Yang turned around at 1,100 meters, his time was 10 minutes, 41 seconds and 73. He was far ahead of the other three competitors. Mitbbs.com

e841e8e406c76a32b615ec1d63788063f7596ee3.sourceText: 在1200米转身时孙杨的优势无可撼动，科奇拉尼和梅洛里在为第二名展开激烈争夺，朴泰桓与他们两人也形成明显的差距。在1300米时，孙杨的成绩是12分39秒00，领先世界纪录2秒16，他的滑水实效非常好，游得也很轻松。在1400米转身时，孙杨的成绩是13分37秒53，他遥遥领先其他对手。 Mitbbs.com
e841e8e406c76a32b615ec1d63788063f7596ee3.translatedText: Sun Yang's advantage was unshakable when turning around at 1,200 meters. Kochlani and Melori were competing fiercely for second place, and there was a clear gap between Park Tae-hwan and the two of them. At 1,300 meters, Sun Yang's time was 12 minutes, 39 seconds, 2 seconds 16 ahead of the world record. His water skiing was very effective and he swam very easily. When turning around at 1,400 meters, Sun Yang's time was 13 minutes, 37 seconds and 53 seconds. He was far ahead of other opponents. Mitbbs.com

e35caa0bf6764506a8ec60331dfbd0c3d395b603.sourceText: 最后100米冲刺，孙杨的双腿加快了打水，他的滑水速度也明显加快，他完全甩开其他对手，以14分31秒02创造了新的世界纪录，并夺取金牌，他拿到本届奥运会上个人的第二金。 Mitbbs.com
e35caa0bf6764506a8ec60331dfbd0c3d395b603.translatedText: In the last 100 meters of sprint, Sun Yang's legs accelerated the water, and his water skiing speed also increased significantly. He completely left behind other opponents, setting a new world record in 14 minutes, 31 seconds and 02 seconds, and won the gold medal. He won his second gold medal in this Olympic Games. Mitbbs.com

6df5791a040de375ebc01ba0161409a013bbe6f1.sourceText: 夺冠后的孙杨兴奋得喜极而泣，他双拳敲打着水面，卫冕失败的梅洛里也上前祝贺他。科奇拉尼以14分39秒63获得银牌，梅洛里以14分40秒31摘得铜牌，朴泰桓以14分50秒61获得第四名。 Mitbbs.com
6df5791a040de375ebc01ba0161409a013bbe6f1.translatedText: After winning the championship, Sun Yang was so excited that he cried with joy. He hit the water with his fists. Melori, who failed to defend the title, also came forward to congratulate him. Kochlani won the silver medal in 14:39.63, Melori won the bronze in 14:40.31, and Park Tae-hwan finished fourth in 14:50.61. Mitbbs.com

6973b2be09b5b56e5bd334890a24a0b55f195e21.sourceText: 2015年2月21日正月初三，下午1时，亚省希望中文学校春节庙会隆重举办。一说”庙会”吸引大家的就是各种各样的有趣创意和传统美食。那么希望中文学校的样子是怎样的呢？
6973b2be09b5b56e5bd334890a24a0b55f195e21.translatedText: On the third day of the first lunar month, February 21, 2015, at 1:00 pm, the Spring Festival Temple Fair of Hope Chinese School in Alberta was grandly held. When it comes to "temple fairs", what attracts everyone is the variety of interesting ideas and traditional food. So what do you want a Chinese school to look like?

f55fc54be4bb96c38c385bb319241c83a8753ae2.sourceText: 要把自己学校的庙会办出特色孩子们可是出力了。这是他们自己做的巴浪鼓：羊年属相做图像，前后摇晃就可以听到拨浪鼓的声音，形象生动又体现东方文化色彩，每个拿到巴浪鼓的小朋友，都开心极了。
f55fc54be4bb96c38c385bb319241c83a8753ae2.translatedText: The children who want to make their school’s temple fair unique have worked hard. This is the balang drum they made themselves: the image of the zodiac sign of the Year of the Sheep is used. When you shake it back and forth, you can hear the sound of the rattle. The image is vivid and reflects the color of oriental culture. Every child who gets the balang drum is very happy.

89dc4696c3c2b1561f4ed0f51f4eb603d3affcb7.sourceText: 学生会的特别活动策划
89dc4696c3c2b1561f4ed0f51f4eb603d3affcb7.translatedText: >Special event planning of the Student Union

2ef5f9ec5356f4260005bacde67c33d0447f5b80.translatedText: Mr. Ding Yunyan, a famous domestic calligrapher, wrote Spring Festival couplets with splashes of ink on the spot

42191aea64d1cf96eacc54b43990899ce3a894a9.sourceText: 校长田琳主持了本次活动，她安排每个班级都轮流上台，因为庙会是孩子们向老师朋友拜年的好机会。小朋友或是儿歌，或是演唱，或是中国拜年的中文段子，把大拜年活动演绎的热闹喜庆。
42191aea64d1cf96eacc54b43990899ce3a894a9.translatedText: Principal Tian Lin presided over this event. She arranged for each class to take turns on stage, because the temple fair is a good opportunity for children to pay New Year greetings to their teachers and friends. The children sang children's songs, sang, or sang Chinese New Year greetings, making the New Year's greeting event lively and festive.

838d66ee09dd86c289b09abd378a99adbe17a489.translatedText: (Left) Representative of Mesa Community College (right) Principal Tian Lin

5fcd1719648180175f29344262bc61d9d02466e7.sourceText: 希望中文学校的前校长们给拜完年的孩子发红包。这是全场上下最欢腾的时刻，唐孝先，帅致若，黄欣馨，赵彩红校长又一次和孩子们亲切接触，送上了新一年的美好祝福。
5fcd1719648180175f29344262bc61d9d02466e7.translatedText: hopes that the former principals of Chinese schools will give red envelopes to children who celebrate the New Year. This was the most jubilant moment for the entire audience. Principals Tang Xiaoxian, Shuai Zhiruo, Huang Xinxin and Zhao Caihong once again had cordial contact with the children and sent their best wishes for the new year.

e856e91232fde65148a28b8f312fe88dab6bc60b.sourceText: 丰盛的新年美食，让所有参加活动的朋友大快朵颐！
e856e91232fde65148a28b8f312fe88dab6bc60b.translatedText: The sumptuous New Year delicacies will be a feast for all friends participating in the event!

f9df2fbc5afd80f6a4da60344e45b3ee155984ff.sourceText: 好吃，好玩，好祝福！您参加了希望中文学校的活动吗？如果没有，那就耐心等待，明年再来！

681e134b182276d6343cc03ea7dbd92043812b05.translatedText: Apple may launch a cash-for-cash service for old mobile phones as early as next month. In order to attract more consumers to buy iPhones, Apple manufacturers will provide mobile phone replacement services, allowing users to use...

6a10bb8e1715dbefcdb96ac43509b7caa3bbf45f.sourceText: 苹果或推旧手机换现金服务最早下月 为了招揽更多消费者购买iPhone，苹果厂商将提供手机置换服务，允许使用旧iPhone手机的用户以低价置换新手机。 据科技网站TechCrunch介绍，该服务将在几周后在各大苹果商店开始实施。消费者可以将自己老的苹果手机拿到店里，根据手机的新旧和使用状况换取现金。比如iphone4或者iphone4s可以换得最高约200美金，iphone5可以换得高达250美金。 预计该置换项目最早将于下月推行。此举将大大增加苹果商店直销手机的力度。
6a10bb8e1715dbefcdb96ac43509b7caa3bbf45f.translatedText: Apple may launch a cash-for-cash service for old mobile phones as early as next month. In order to attract more consumers to buy iPhones, Apple manufacturers will provide mobile phone replacement services, allowing users of old iPhones to exchange for new phones at low prices. According to technology website TechCrunch, the service will be implemented in major Apple stores in a few weeks. Consumers can take their old Apple phones to the store and exchange them for cash based on the phone's condition and condition. For example, iPhone 4 or iPhone 4S can be exchanged for up to about 200 US dollars, and iPhone 5 can be exchanged for up to 250 US dollars. The replacement project is expected to be implemented as early as next month. This move will greatly increase the direct sales of mobile phones in Apple stores.

c244457d0798ae705c4b65695bb12f28150773de.sourceText: 国民党中央组织发展委员会主委苏俊宾、海外部主任夏大明、国民党发言人殷玮一行三人应邀出席《国民党美国亚利桑那直属分部》成立一周年庆祝大会 亚利桑那州从来没有独立的直属国民党中央的党部，去年成立了，亚利桑那州从来没有国民党中央高层主管来访过；而国民党中央组织发展委员会主委苏俊宾、海外部主任夏大明、国民党 发言人殷玮一行三人将应邀出席《国民党美国亚利桑那直属分部》八月月二十日成立一周年庆祝大会，无论层级、人数、及代表性，均令《国民党美国亚利桑那直属分部》至 感殊荣。 《国民党美国亚利桑那直属分部》自从去年成立以来，即积极参与中华民国总统大选辅选马英九总统连任的工作。 六月成立《亚利桑那马英九吴敦义后援会》并成立《亚利桑那台湾加油站》、八月起连续举办数场《海外侨胞返国投票说明会》、九月起洽联旅行社及航空公司安排最廉价机票 及住宿鼓励亚利桑那州侨胞返国投票支持马英九、总共召集了50多名党员及支持者返台投票、十一月更招募热心义工返国参加《中国国民党101年总统暨立委选举海外助选团 》、2012年一月一行十二人返国参加《中国国民党101年总统暨立委选举海外助选团》、一月十四日晚于台北《马英九吴敦义竞选总部》前参与开票及胜选 之夜。 该分部订于八月月二十日(星期一)上午十时三十分，在凤凰城康乐大厦（3930 N 24TH AVE, PHOENIX, AZ 85015)举办《国民党美国亚利桑那直属分部》成立一周年 庆祝大会，，届时将有午餐供应，欢迎新旧党员共襄盛举，同时感谢大家的支持、鼓励、与指教。 详情请洽筹备会义工李问浙(602)793-1325、曹嘉仪(480)540-4462、邓凯蒂(602)478-5709、杨永慧(480) 220-3723、梁嘉莉(480)252-9280、 王玮王亭(480)899-7059、(928)300-0915。 《国民党美国亚利桑那直属分部》筹备会电子邮件email: kmt.arizona@gmail.com （资料提供：《国民党美国亚利桑那直属分部》）
c244457d0798ae705c4b65695bb12f28150773de.translatedText: Su Junbin, chairman of the KMT Central Organization Development Committee, Xia Daming, director of the Overseas Department, and Yin Wei, spokesperson of the KMT, were invited to attend the first anniversary celebration of the establishment of the "KMT USA Arizona Branch" Arizona has never had an independent party branch directly under the Central Committee of the Kuomintang. It was established last year. Arizona has never had a high-level executive from the Central Committee of the Kuomintang visit. Su Junbin, chairman of the Organization Development Committee of the Central Committee of the Kuomintang, Xia Daming, director of the Overseas Department, and Yin Wei, spokesperson of the Kuomintang, will be invited to attend the celebration of the first anniversary of the founding of the Arizona Branch of the Kuomintang on August 20. Regardless of the level, number of people, and representativeness, the Arizona Branch of the Kuomintang in the United States is deeply honored. Since its establishment last year, the Arizona Branch of the Kuomintang has actively participated in the presidential election of the Republic of China to assist in the re-election of President Ma Ying-jeou. In June, the "Arizona Ma Ying-jeou Wu Dunyi Support Association" and the "Arizona Taiwan Gas Station" were established. Since August, several "Overseas Chinese Voting Information Seminars" have been held in succession. In September, they have contacted travel agencies and airlines to arrange the cheapest air tickets and accommodation to encourage Arizona overseas Chinese to return to China to vote for Ma Ying-jeou. A total of more than 50 party members and supporters have been summoned to return to Taiwan to vote. In November, enthusiastic volunteers were recruited to return to China to participate in the "Chinese Kuomintang's 101st Presidential and Legislative Election Overseas Support Team" ", a group of twelve people returned to China in January 2012 to participate in the "Overseas Campaign Team for the 101st Presidential and Legislative Elections of the Chinese Kuomintang". On the evening of January 14th, they participated in the vote counting and victory night in front of the "Ma Ying-jeou and Wu Dunyi Campaign Headquarters" in Taipei. The branch is scheduled to hold a celebration meeting for the first anniversary of the founding of the "Kuomintang Arizona Branch of the United States" at 10:30 a.m. on Monday, August 20, at the Phoenix Connaught Building (3930 N 24TH AVE, PHOENIX, AZ 85015). Lunch will be served at that time. New and old party members are welcome to participate in the event, and we would like to thank everyone for their support, encouragement, and advice. For details, please contact preparatory meeting volunteers Li Wenzhe (602) 793-1325, Cao Jiayi (480) 540-4462, Deng Katie (602) 478-5709, Yang Yonghui (480) 220-3723, Liang Jiali (480) 252-9280, Wang Wei Wang Ting (480) 899-7059, (928) 300-0915. Email of the preparatory meeting of "KMT Arizona Branch": kmt.arizona@gmail.com (Information provided by: "KMT Arizona Branch")

935212bb4f925ed1c2e6f56b51658f6334585531.translatedText: Internet celebrity Bai Yansong's commentary article: Why China lacks friends (must read) Why does China help other countries everywhere but lacks friends? Chinese people all have this...

6df7a7295d3bcdeefd666770f4511c71a70d2b2a.sourceText: 为什么中国到处援助别国，却缺少朋友。 中国人都有这样的感慨，为什么我们在国力并不雄厚，人民并不富裕的情况下，宁可自己受穷，倾尽国力去支援一些国家，却并没有得到友谊。中国人勒紧裤带，把最好的物质奉献给我们的朋友，结果往往是反目为仇。当年在我们国家粮食非常紧张的时候，我们用宝贵的外汇购买粮食支援阿尔巴尼亚，但最后两国反目为仇；我们无偿支援越南，最后却兵戎相见；我们支援朝鲜石油、粮食，却发现那是个填不满的无底洞；我们支援外蒙古建设，他们却把中国工人关进监狱；我们支持非洲国家建立工厂，他们却责怪中国设备落后。这些受援国家的政府和平民并没有对中国有好感，中国的牺牲和奉献得不到友谊，难道中国人是天底下最大最大的傻瓜？白岩松告诉了我们为什么。白岩松说，他到美国参观了一家报纸博物馆，这里珍藏了世界主要国家的报纸。美国9.11恐怖袭击后，世界几乎所有9月12号的报纸头条都是关于9.11的报道， 唯一只有中国的报纸头条是领导人的接见活动。白岩松感慨道，中国与世界脱节最大的是普世价值，中国与世界其他国家没有共同的价值观，所以得不到朋友。
6df7a7295d3bcdeefd666770f4511c71a70d2b2a.translatedText: Why does China help other countries everywhere but lacks friends? Chinese people all have this feeling: why do we, when our national strength is not strong and our people are not rich, prefer to suffer poverty and devote all our national strength to support some countries, but we do not get friendship. The Chinese people tighten their belts and dedicate the best materials to our friends, but the result is often hatred. When our country was in very short supply of food, we used our precious foreign exchange to purchase food to support Albania, but in the end the two countries turned against each other; we supported Vietnam for free, but ended up fighting each other; we supported North Korea's oil and food, but found that it was a bottomless pit that could not be filled; we supported the construction of Outer Mongolia, but they imprisoned Chinese workers; we supported African countries to build factories, but they blamed China for backward equipment. The governments and civilians of these aid-recipient countries do not have a good impression of China. China's sacrifice and dedication cannot win friendship. Are the Chinese people the biggest and biggest fools in the world? Bai Yansong tells us why. Bai Yansong said that he visited a newspaper museum in the United States, which collects newspapers from major countries in the world. After the 9.11 terrorist attacks in the United States, almost all newspaper headlines in the world on September 12th were about 9.11. The only headline in Chinese newspapers was about the leaders’ meeting. Bai Yansong lamented that the biggest disconnect between China and the world is universal values. China does not have common values ​​​​with other countries in the world, so it cannot get friends.

7be063933130e2379b12d12e8688967e6d0000cd.sourceText: 9月22号，温家宝在联合国千年发展目标高级会议讲话时说，2009年底，中国免除了50个穷国的256亿元人民币债务。 温家宝还说：2008年6月底，中国累计免除亚非等49个重债穷国和最不发达国家债务247亿元；提供各类援款2065亿元，其中无偿援助908亿元；对 42个最不发达国家的商品给予零关税待遇，税目为736-1115个，占最不发达国家对中国出口贸易额的98％。中国还为非洲培训了15000名各类人才，派遣100名高级农业技术专家，派出医疗队，援建30所医院、100所农村学校，无偿提供防治疟疾药物。2007年底中国为增强非洲的自我发展能力，决定提供23.77亿元的无偿援助和7亿元的无息贷款…… 最近几年来，中国灾难频发，汶川地震、冰雪灾害、西南旱灾、玉树地震、泥石流厖灾害不断。根据相关数据，玉树地震，国家财政拨款5亿元。西南大旱灾，国家拨款1.26亿元厖 2000年10月，在中非合作论坛首届部长级会议上，中国政府首次宣布在两年内减免32个非洲国家总额达100亿人民币的债务。 截至05年底，减免44个发展中国家总计198笔价值约166亿元人民币债务。
7be063933130e2379b12d12e8688967e6d0000cd.translatedText: On September 22, Wen Jiabao said in his speech at the United Nations High-Level Meeting on Millennium Development Goals that at the end of 2009, China canceled 25.6 billion yuan of debt from 50 poor countries. Wen Jiabao also said: By the end of June 2008, China had forgiven a total of 24.7 billion yuan of debts of 49 heavily indebted poor countries and least developed countries in Asia and Africa; provided various aids of 206.5 billion yuan, including 90.8 billion yuan of free aid; and granted zero-tariff treatment to goods from 42 least developed countries, with tax items ranging from 736 to 1,115, accounting for 98% of the least developed countries’ exports to China. China has also trained 15,000 talents of various types for Africa, dispatched 100 senior agricultural technical experts, sent medical teams, assisted in the construction of 30 hospitals and 100 rural schools, and provided free malaria prevention and treatment drugs. At the end of 2007, in order to enhance Africa's self-development capabilities, China decided to provide 2.377 billion yuan in free aid and 700 million yuan in interest-free loans... In recent years, disasters have occurred frequently in China, including the Wenchuan earthquake, ice and snow disasters, southwest drought, Yushu earthquake, and mudslides. According to relevant data, the state finance allocated 500 million yuan for the Yushu earthquake. Due to severe drought in southwest China, the state allocated 126 million yuan. In October 2000, at the first ministerial meeting of the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation, the Chinese government announced for the first time that it would reduce or reduce the debt of 32 African countries totaling 10 billion yuan within two years. By the end of 2005, a total of 198 debts worth approximately 16.6 billion yuan had been forgiven and exempted from 44 developing countries.

10bb136f67f664a34464cfe2e6266250a03aca89.sourceText: 2008年6月，向朝鲜捐赠了5000吨航空油和1亿元人民币，共计1500万美元。 2009年3月，提供阿富汗7500万美元贷款全部转为无偿援助。2009年全年，免除了46个国家的400多亿元债务。 2010年2月，中国国务院批准了减免伊拉克欠华债务的80%，约为68亿美元。当月，由于朝鲜货币改革失败，传中国将向朝鲜提供100亿美元援助。 2010年4月，中国政府向委内瑞拉提供200亿美元贷款。
10bb136f67f664a34464cfe2e6266250a03aca89.translatedText: In June 2008, it donated 5,000 tons of aviation fuel and 100 million yuan to North Korea, totaling US$15 million. In March 2009, all US$75 million in loans provided to Afghanistan were converted into free aid. Throughout 2009, more than 40 billion yuan in debt was forgiven by 46 countries. In February 2010, China's State Council approved the reduction or exemption of 80% of Iraq's debt to China, approximately US$6.8 billion. That month, due to the failure of North Korea’s currency reform, it was rumored that China would provide $10 billion in aid to North Korea. In April 2010, the Chinese government provided a US$20 billion loan to Venezuela.

5a31da17ac0f177202c702ff054c11f1d375fac2.sourceText: 2010年8月，央视新闻联播同时出现两条新闻：一、为支持俄罗斯抗灾，中国将捐赠100万美元现金和价值2000万人民币的物资；二、甘肃舟曲缺乏饮用水和方便面，政府号召大家积极捐款。 评论家夏小强在《如此国际主义为哪般？》的文章中指出：中国的失、辍学儿童人数世界第一；中国是目前世界上唯一还在针对初、中等教育征收高昂学费的大国，而其他大国都免费向她的国民提供；中国九亿农民几乎没有任何医疗社会保障，世界第一。而XX却不顾民众的生活在用大把金钱买他国的欢心。
5a31da17ac0f177202c702ff054c11f1d375fac2.translatedText: In August 2010, two news items appeared simultaneously on the CCTV news broadcast: First, to support Russia’s disaster relief, China would donate US$1 million in cash and materials worth 20 million yuan; second, Zhouqu, Gansu Province was short of drinking water and instant noodles, and the government called on everyone to actively donate. Critic Xia Xiaoqiang wrote in "Why Such Internationalism?" "The article pointed out: China has the largest number of children who have lost or dropped out of school in the world; China is currently the only major country in the world that still charges high tuition fees for primary and secondary education, while other major countries provide it to its citizens for free; China's 900 million farmers have almost no medical and social security, ranking first in the world. However, XX ignores the lives of the people and spends a lot of money to buy the favor of other countries.

33486204efbfdb92f8aad6107e89d7e5c16536e9.sourceText: 有不少网友指问：我国是发达国家了吗？中国有钱吗？有没有钱老百姓说了算。什么时候也可以减免一下自己国内穷人的债务呢？ 还有网友表示，看来政府还是不缺钱，以后捐款要审慎考虑了。
33486204efbfdb92f8aad6107e89d7e5c16536e9.translatedText: Many netizens asked: Is my country a developed country? Does China have money? The people have the final say whether they have money or not. When can we also reduce the debts of our own poor people? Some netizens said that it seems that the government is still not short of money, and donations should be carefully considered in the future.

d973f73e51324c86c7faff1af3044a1cc4f3c798.sourceText: 前几天，中石油给日本捐款3000万，昨天又向日本无偿提供3万吨汽油，真是大手笔！总价已经接近2个亿！日本人感叹了：真是一个不错的慈善家！可四川汶川大地震看看中石油中石化做了什么？ 2005年和2006年，中石化分别获得国家财政补贴100亿元和50亿元，2008年中国石化公告称，公司获得财政补贴123亿元，其中49亿元计入公司2007年补贴收入，74亿元计入2008年第一季度补贴收入。 2007年3月19日中石油昨宣布：去年盈利超1422亿元，再创历史最好水平，中石油在2005年以1333亿元的盈利首次超过汇丰成为亚洲最赚钱公司。中石油集团总经理蒋洁敏在中央企业负责人会议上说：”中石油是亚洲最盈利的公司，不是之一，是第一。” 2007年11月5日中石油在上海证券交易所上市交易，11月19日开始作为权重股计入上证综合指数和沪深300指数。16.7元的网上申购价，48.6 元的开盘价，上市开盘价几乎达到发行价的3倍，中石油A股的上市，让很多人体验到了幸福的一刻。然而乐极生悲，也正是由于中石油高价开盘套牢了数不清的普通投资者。中石油、中石化，拿了那么多说不通的政府补贴，又圈了那么多股民的钱，外加”亚洲最赚钱的企业”的称号，可谓里子、面子全赚足了。国难当头，汶川地震，中国人有钱的出钱、有力的出力，倾举国之力，共渡难关之时，中石油、中石化，仅仅一家拿出1000万捐款。四川地震，全国人民的慷慨解囊，让世人看到大灾之中的大爱，但中石油、中石化，让我们看到的是什么？如今，一个曾经对我国犯过永远不可饶恕罪行的日本受到灾害，死亡人数仅仅是中国汶川地震人数的十分之一，你就连钱带油捐了两个亿！！！而让国内民众却在用世界上几乎最低的工资加着世界上最昂贵的汽油！你们究竟还是不是中国人？这个企业究竟还是不是中国人的企业？！难道日本人是你们的亲爹？要不你们为何 要不你们为何做出如此对敌慈悲对友刁的荒唐事？！只能有一个词可以刻画你们的嘴脸棗卖国贼！ 气愤！！！气愤！！！日本人地震后说我们中国不为它们捐款，居然还当场焚烧中国国旗。。。
d973f73e51324c86c7faff1af3044a1cc4f3c798.translatedText: A few days ago, PetroChina donated 30 million to Japan, and yesterday it provided 30,000 tons of gasoline to Japan for free. What a generous act! The total price is close to 200 million! The Japanese sighed: What a good philanthropist! But what happened after the Wenchuan earthquake in Sichuan? What did PetroChina and Sinopec do? In 2005 and 2006, Sinopec received state financial subsidies of 10 billion yuan and 5 billion yuan respectively. In 2008, Sinopec announced that the company received financial subsidies of 12.3 billion yuan, of which 4.9 billion yuan was included in the company's subsidy income in 2007, and 7.4 billion yuan was included in the subsidy income in the first quarter of 2008. On March 19, 2007, PetroChina announced yesterday that its profit last year exceeded 142.2 billion yuan, setting another record high. In 2005, PetroChina surpassed HSBC for the first time to become the most profitable company in Asia with a profit of 133.3 billion yuan. Jiang Jiemin, general manager of China National Petroleum Corporation, said at a meeting of central enterprise leaders: "PetroChina is the most profitable company in Asia, not one of them, but the first." PetroChina was listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange on November 5, 2007, and began to be included in the Shanghai Composite Index and the Shanghai and Shenzhen 300 Index as a heavyweight stock on November 19. The online subscription price was 16.7 yuan, the opening price was 48.6 yuan, and the listing opening price was almost three times the issue price. The listing of PetroChina A shares made many people experience a moment of happiness. However, great joy brings sorrow, and it is precisely because of the high opening price of PetroChina that locked up countless ordinary investors. PetroChina and Sinopec have received so many unreasonable government subsidies, and have collected so much money from investors. In addition, they have earned the title of "the most profitable company in Asia". It can be said that they have earned enough respect and face. When the national crisis hit, including the Wenchuan earthquake, the wealthy Chinese people contributed money and strength, and devoted all their efforts to overcome the difficulties. PetroChina and Sinopec alone donated 10 million. The Sichuan earthquake and the generosity of people across the country showed the world the great love during the disaster. But what did PetroChina and Sinopec show us? Today, Japan, which has committed ever unforgivable crimes against our country, is hit by a disaster. The death toll is only one-tenth of the number of people killed in the Wenchuan earthquake in China. You even donated 200 million in money and oil! ! ! However, the domestic people are paying almost the lowest wages in the world with the most expensive gasoline in the world! Are you still Chinese? Is this company still a Chinese company? ! Are the Japanese your biological fathers? Why else do you do such ridiculous things of showing kindness to your enemies and being cunning to your friends? ! There is only one word that can describe you - traitors! Angry! ! ! Angry! ! ! After the earthquake, the Japanese said that China would not donate money to them, but actually burned the Chinese flag on the spot. . .

ea1a62dce42808daaa90fc862941ed8c41f723e7.translatedText: The state government wants to increase mental health funds for adoptive families. The Arizona State Senate approved a proposal on Tuesday to allocate funds to adoptive families and adoptees...

61a7a81aa6fb12677a2e4a40a7cd74a2d3b398ec.sourceText: 州政府欲给收养家庭增心理健康基金 亚利桑那州参议会周二批准了一项提案，拨款给收养家庭的收养方和被收养方提供心理辅导。 该法案的发起人，皮奥里亚的共和党籍参议员里克墨菲说，许多收养家庭的父母和孩子在心理上有障碍，需要漫长而艰苦的过程才能接纳对方成为家庭成员。这项法案就是为这些家庭提供心理辅导补贴。绝大部分收养家庭，平均每月获得750美元心理辅导专项补贴，直至被收养方年满18岁。 此外，被收养方也合资格申请州政府的医疗补助计划（AHCCCS），并通过州医疗系统接受心理辅导。虽然许多收养家庭有能力支付被收养子女的私人商业保险，墨菲法案提供的补贴将确保所有被收养的孩子又足够的资金支付心理辅导。 亚利桑那州在上一财政年度为收养家庭支付1.5亿美元补贴款项，其中一半来自联邦拨款。目前尚不清楚墨菲法案将耗资多少，法案没有公布这一数目。
61a7a81aa6fb12677a2e4a40a7cd74a2d3b398ec.translatedText: The state government wants to increase mental health funds for adoptive families. The Arizona State Senate approved a proposal on Tuesday to allocate funds to provide psychological counseling for adoptive families and adoptees. The bill's sponsor, Republican Sen. Rick Murphy of Peoria, said many adoptive parents and children are psychologically disabled and need a long and arduous process to accept each other as family members. This bill provides these families with psychological counseling subsidies. Most adoptive families receive an average of US$750 per month in special subsidies for psychological counseling until the adoptee reaches the age of 18. In addition, adoptees are also eligible to apply for the state's Medicaid program (AHCCCS) and receive psychological counseling through the state health care system. While many adoptive families can afford private commercial insurance for their adopted children, the subsidies provided by Murphy's bill will ensure that all adopted children have sufficient funds to pay for psychological counseling. Arizona paid out $150 million in subsidies to adoptive families last fiscal year, half of which came from federal grants. It's unclear how much Murphy's bill would cost, and the bill did not release that amount.

de135cba88c825fa05d1af341a4be5e98206419d.sourceText: 氦气球将由新墨西哥州南部美国航天港升空，乘客可自由走动，不用穿戴宇宙飞行服及氧气罩。由于气球由高效能聚乙烯膜制成，这项计划的最大挑战是要确保氦气球结构稳定，以及飞行控制测试。专家称，如果频繁升空的太空旅行器能同时搭载科学仪器或小型卫星，可进一步分摊成本，令太空旅行更便宜。（中新网）
de135cba88c825fa05d1af341a4be5e98206419d.translatedText: Helium balloons will be launched from the American Spaceport in southern New Mexico. Passengers can move around freely without wearing spacesuits and oxygen masks. Since the balloon is made of high-performance polyethylene film, the biggest challenge of the project is ensuring the structural stability of the helium balloon and testing its flight controls. Experts say that if frequently launched space vehicles can also carry scientific instruments or small satellites, the cost can be further spread, making space travel cheaper. (China News Service)

308378d41099e43a091e7c6f5b1d19c50d1a6e5b.sourceText: 亚利桑那华人历史协会： 张肇鸿
308378d41099e43a091e7c6f5b1d19c50d1a6e5b.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association: Zhang Zhaohong

e2aa2e4b2eca73e36487946b47e028a6599ee857.sourceText: 亚省华人存留至今最大的两座历史建筑，一座是由邓楷隆始建于一九二六年的＂邓粤昂仓库＂；另一座是由邓安业于一九二九年的＂太阳商业公司＂(Sun Mercantile Company) 。这两座由红砖所建起的仓库风格相同，经历了近百年风雨烈日，仍屹立于凤凰城市中心，成为亚省华人成功创业的地标，为我们华人历史增添浓墨重彩的内容。
e2aa2e4b2eca73e36487946b47e028a6599ee857.translatedText: The two largest historical buildings that have survived to this day among Chinese people in Alberta, one is the "Deng Guangdong Warehouse" built in 1926 by Deng Kailong; the other is the "Sun Mercantile Company" built in 1929 by Deng Anye. These two warehouses built with red bricks have the same style. After nearly a hundred years of ups and downs, they still stand in the center of Phoenix. They have become landmarks for the successful entrepreneurship of Chinese people in Alberta and have added rich content to our Chinese history.

b913f52b8a8daba1468aa0e67da878226dfe07f2.sourceText: 在亚利桑那的华人历史上，邓安业家族无论在经济、军事、法律文化方面，都有过积极的贡献，邓安业（1889-1954）是这个大家族中的一位著名人物。
b913f52b8a8daba1468aa0e67da878226dfe07f2.translatedText: In the history of the Chinese in Arizona, the Deng Anye family has made positive contributions in economic, military, legal and cultural aspects. Deng Anye (1889-1954) is a famous figure in this large family.

cc030ce54e35fc39cb7bcd1a203dec0bb9544c8f.sourceText: 青年时代的邓安业（Shing Tang）
cc030ce54e35fc39cb7bcd1a203dec0bb9544c8f.translatedText: Deng Anye (Shing Tang) in his youth

112c0395657b992c0e459a7281906c7944fa4d3a.sourceText: 1889 年，邓安业在中国出生，他的父亲邓藻遠是最早來到美國鳳凰城的華人先民之一，但是没有留下历史资料。1910年，21岁的邓安业从广州经旧金山来到美国凤凰城，所用的英文姓名是“Shing Tang”。他从叔叔邓賢遠手中接过在位于 529 南街和第7大街开的一间杂货店生意，而他的叔叔不久就返回了中国。
112c0395657b992c0e459a7281906c7944fa4d3a.translatedText: In 1889, Deng Anye was born in China. His father, Deng Zaoyuan, was one of the first Chinese ancestors to come to Phoenix, United States, but no historical information was left behind. In 1910, 21-year-old Deng Anye came to Phoenix, USA from Guangzhou via San Francisco. His English name was "Shing Tang". He took over the grocery store business at 529 South Street and 7th Avenue from his uncle, Deng Xianyuan, who soon returned to China.

685ffe4d4f060a713c00028b861a6924e0a58c26.sourceText: 1912年，邓安业在凤凰城622 南街和第7大街开了一间新的杂货店。1914年，他与在美国出生的Lucy Sing结婚，并在贤妻的帮助下，继续经营杂货店近二十年，成为了一位十分成功的商人。
685ffe4d4f060a713c00028b861a6924e0a58c26.translatedText: In 1912, Deng Anye opened a new grocery store at 622 South Street and 7th Avenue in Phoenix. In 1914, he married Lucy Sing, who was born in the United States. With the help of his good wife, he continued to run the grocery store for nearly twenty years and became a very successful businessman.

12cb203e38fed1ee225835faa154dcc79132d734.sourceText: 在此期间，邓安业建立了“太阳商业大厦”(Sun Mercantile Building)，为周边城镇提供许多的杂货供应食品。1929年4月，太阳商业公司搬进了位于凤凰城杰克逊街和第三大街的新仓库。
12cb203e38fed1ee225835faa154dcc79132d734.translatedText: During this period, Deng Anye established the "Sun Mercantile Building" (Sun Mercantile Building) to provide many groceries and food supplies to surrounding towns. In April 1929, Sun Commercial Company moved into a new warehouse at Jackson Street and Third Avenue in Phoenix.

a0981de477be27a0620f7b57cdce5832a5c8c645.sourceText: 新仓库位于铁轨附近，是20世纪早期开发仓库区的中心带，其意义重大，因为它是中国出生的商人在凤凰城建造的最大的仓库。邓安业聘请建筑师 E. W. Bacon 以流行的芝加哥风格设计了这幢红砖建筑，它配备了连接城市报警系统及自动喷水灭火系统。大仓库各有两个14,000 平方英尺楼层，成为唐人街最大的独立建筑。当时的价值有$80000。盛大的开幕典礼于 1929 年 4 月举行。
a0981de477be27a0620f7b57cdce5832a5c8c645.translatedText: Located near the railroad tracks in the heart of the warehouse district that was developed in the early 20th century, the new warehouse is significant because it was the largest warehouse built by Chinese-born businessmen in Phoenix. Tang hired architect E. W. Bacon to design the red-brick building in the popular Chicago style, which was equipped with a city alarm system and a sprinkler system. The large warehouse has two 14,000-square-foot floors each, making it the largest free-standing building in Chinatown. The value at the time was $80,000. The grand opening took place in April 1929.

1589fa9707cfa6c522c12636275560c5450ce3c5.sourceText: 邓安业成为了当时亚利桑那州德尔蒙产品的第一大销售商，并供应Safeway和Basha’s等大公司的食品货物，使许多其他企业得以建立。德尔蒙食品公司（Del Monte Foods）是总部位于美国加州旧金山著名的食品制造及经销公司。
1589fa9707cfa6c522c12636275560c5450ce3c5.translatedText: > Deng became the number one seller of Del Monte, Arizona products at the time and supplied food goods to major companies such as Safeway and Basha’s, allowing many other businesses to be established. Del Monte Foods is a famous food manufacturing and distribution company headquartered in San Francisco, California, USA.

d30517f267f046ae0b85b885fce2231fd21bc612.sourceText: 太阳商业公司业务的不断发展，成为凤凰城最大的批发杂货企业，从开张到1950 年代，太阳商业公司一直是遍布亚利桑那州的小型杂货店的主要供应商之一。而邓安业作为成功的一位华人企业家，并得到了主流社会的推介，在亚省经济领域上彰显出华人所作出的积极的贡献。
d30517f267f046ae0b85b885fce2231fd21bc612.translatedText: Sun Commercial Company's business continued to grow and became the largest wholesale grocery business in Phoenix. From its opening until the 1950s, Sun Commercial Company was one of the major suppliers to small grocery stores throughout Arizona. As a successful Chinese entrepreneur, Deng Anye has been recommended by mainstream society, demonstrating the positive contributions made by Chinese people in the economic field of Alberta.

dabd6431773dd1c62fa4524912341dfea050d85a.sourceText: 《亚利桑那州共和报》当时报导：＂本报注意到，太阳商业公司是本州货物分门别类最多的普通商品批发货仓”。公司显著的成长史被称为“凤凰城和盐河河谷的业务及发展杰出的一章”。
dabd6431773dd1c62fa4524912341dfea050d85a.translatedText: The "Arizona Republic" reported at the time: "This newspaper noticed that Sun Commercial Company is the general merchandise wholesale warehouse with the most classified goods in the state." The company's remarkable growth history has been called "an outstanding chapter in business and development in Phoenix and the Salt River Valley."

3c6e790eb2064504027ed2ad2f616b96a727baa8.sourceText: 太阳商业公司是凤凰城“第二唐人街”期间（c.1890-c.1960）唯一幸存的遗迹。1985 年 9 月 4 日被为史迹名录。在1987年，成为受保护的历史地标。
3c6e790eb2064504027ed2ad2f616b96a727baa8.translatedText: The Sun Commercial Company is the only surviving relic of Phoenix's "Second Chinatown" period (c.1890-c.1960). Designated on the Register of Historic Places on September 4, 1985. In 1987, it became a protected historic landmark.

b7303ad2b20fa1a50af8bf8be364c5507edb9645.sourceText: 亚利桑那华人历史协会搜集到邓安业的一张图片。虽然因年代久远，图片不太清晰，那么这张图片是如何保留下来的呢？
b7303ad2b20fa1a50af8bf8be364c5507edb9645.translatedText: The Arizona Chinese Historical Association collected a picture of Deng Anye. Although the picture is not very clear due to its age, how was this picture preserved?

91d8489c76f0fcdefb5a18f91ee6f76e91dda8d2.sourceText: 在上世纪三十年代，邓安业已是华人社区的著名侨领，他曾担任过斐匿中华商会的主席。一九四三年抗日战争期间，他担任＂斐匿华人救国后援会＂的执委，为祖国抗日出钱出力，留下了历史记录和图片。当一个人为国家和民族，为华人社区作出过贡献，世上很多事可能会是偶然中的必然，但始终不会被人们忘记。邓安业于1954年去世, 享年65岁。
91d8489c76f0fcdefb5a18f91ee6f76e91dda8d2.translatedText: In the 1930s, Deng An was already a well-known overseas Chinese leader in the Chinese community. He once served as the chairman of the Feini Chinese Chamber of Commerce. During the Anti-Japanese War in 1943, he served as the executive committee member of the "Fei Ni Chinese National Salvation Support Association", contributed money and efforts to the motherland's anti-Japanese war, and left historical records and pictures. When a person has made contributions to the country, the nation, and the Chinese community, many things in the world may be inevitable by accident, but they will never be forgotten. Deng Anye died in 1954 at the age of 65.

08676880399a80f30f76fcfd7c82d5da1e74285f.sourceText: 今年6月，沈河区工商局局长杨晓松醉酒大闹《辽沈晚报》社，扬言找记者单挑，原因是老婆和儿子开的?#38754;包新语?#24215;卖长毛粽子被该报曝光。杨晓松因此被网民戏称为?#21490;上最牛工商局长?#12290;
08676880399a80f30f76fcfd7c82d5da1e74285f.translatedText: In June of this year, Yang Xiaosong, director of the Industrial and Commercial Bureau of Shenhe District, got drunk and made a scene at the "Liaoshen Evening News" office, threatening to challenge reporters because his wife and son's "Bao Xinyu" shop selling long-haired rice dumplings was exposed by the newspaper. As a result, Yang Xiaosong was nicknamed by netizens as?#21490;The most awesome industrial and commercial director?#12290;

54ee682277f19adc38d886c57c12980a8327c9d2.sourceText: 此事发生后，沈阳市工商局党组立即组成调查组，对媒体反映的相关问题进行认真调查。同时，对杨晓松担任区工商局主要领导职务期间的廉政情况进行了全面调查。经查，杨晓松未能正确处理并参与家属和报社记者的争执，在社会上造成了恶劣影响；其在担任区工商局主要领导职务期间，存在利用职务之便为其子和配偶谋取利益的问题，违反了党政领导干部廉洁从政的有关规定。
54ee682277f19adc38d886c57c12980a8327c9d2.translatedText: After this incident, the party group of the Shenyang Municipal Industrial and Commercial Bureau immediately formed an investigation team to conduct a careful investigation of the relevant issues reported by the media. At the same time, a comprehensive investigation was conducted into Yang Xiaosong’s integrity during his tenure as the main leader of the District Industrial and Commercial Bureau. After investigation, Yang Xiaosong failed to correctly handle and participate in the dispute between his family members and newspaper reporters, which caused a bad impact on society; when he served as the main leader of the District Industrial and Commercial Bureau, he used his position to seek benefits for his son and spouse, violating relevant regulations on the integrity of party and government leading cadres.

d400f04307af9748d5894ff2615db794af1c7281.sourceText: 中国国民党亚利桑那直属分部谨定于2016年3月19日上午十一点召开党员会议，特此通知直属分部全体党员在百忙之中抽出时间参加会议。会议主要任务爲投票选举新任党主席和党务工作讨论。
d400f04307af9748d5894ff2615db794af1c7281.translatedText: The Arizona branch of the Chinese Kuomintang would like to hold a party member meeting at 11:00 am on March 19, 2016. All party members of the directly affiliated branch are hereby notified to take time out of their busy schedules to attend the meeting. The main tasks of the meeting were to vote for the new party chairman and discuss party affairs.

efb022106df9968e6c8c17e50df6f31278248773.sourceText: 党员同志们，民主制度政党轮替是正常现象，我们要从失败中看到积极的因素和动力，让我们一起努力进前，擦亮本党的招牌。希望直属分部党员同志们踊跃参加，并爲新任党主席补选投下您神圣的一票。
efb022106df9968e6c8c17e50df6f31278248773.translatedText: > Party members and comrades, the rotation of political parties in a democratic system is a normal phenomenon. We must see positive factors and motivation from failures. Let us work together to move forward and polish the brand of our party. I hope that all party members and comrades directly under the branch will actively participate and cast your sacred vote for the by-election of the new party chairman.

1d0270c98aaa7b340ae5a2edb4c316a305c4c783.sourceText: 【凤凰笔会】阿琪:走出国门的中国工人
1d0270c98aaa7b340ae5a2edb4c316a305c4c783.translatedText: [Phoenix PEN] Aqi: Chinese workers who went abroad

af3f3854801b02926678aed3a32cf245740dbb14.sourceText: 【凤凰笔会】阿琪:走出国门的中国工人 凤凰城 阿琪 八十年代初期，中国打开了关闭已久的大门，实行对外开放，…
af3f3854801b02926678aed3a32cf245740dbb14.translatedText: [Phoenix PEN] Aqi: Chinese workers who went abroad Phoenix City Aqi In the early 1980s, China opened its long-closed door and implemented opening up to the outside world...

cbaf0b13daff9a7c61ab2e3ddfcd8a2bf7e9ba57.sourceText: 八十年代初期，中国打开了关闭已久的大门，实行对外开放，一批洋人洋货进了中国，中国的企业也开始参与国际市塲的竞争。在一次激烈的竞争中，一次偶然的机会，我们公司承包了一项逺在非洲摩洛哥的䢖设项目。我们工人也有了出国的机会。那个时代除了少数国家领导人出国访问，连省长、巿长还没有轮到呢！作为一个工人，有了一个出国机会，大家都争着想去。
cbaf0b13daff9a7c61ab2e3ddfcd8a2bf7e9ba57.translatedText: In the early 1980s, China opened its long-closed door and implemented opening up to the outside world. A number of foreigners and foreign goods entered China, and Chinese companies also began to participate in the competition in the international market. In a fierce competition and by chance, our company contracted a construction project in Morocco, Africa. We workers also have the opportunity to go abroad. At that time, except for a few national leaders who visited abroad, even provincial governors and mayors had not yet had their turn! As a worker, when there is an opportunity to go abroad, everyone is eager to go.

ba3b04582f29b3db83d7ad66e73caee2a7b632f9.sourceText: 我们这些人祖祖辈辈都生活在一个地方，别说出国，有的连村子都没有离开过，上初中的时矦，正赶上文化大革命大串联，学生坐火车不要钱，到那里都有红衞兵免费接待站，我妈拿出她辛苦积穳下来的十块人民币给了我，我就跟着比我大几岁的同学扒火车去过北京，在天安门广场远远地看见过毛主席，称着他挥手，我继续前进，还去了上海和井岗山。我是我们家出逺门最多见识最广的孩子，这次又能出国，那将给我们家的家谱涂上光彩的一笔，我们家的祖坟都会冒出一股清烟，这是一件多么光宗耀祖的事。青年人的好奇心也怂恿着我，真想有机会看看外部的世界是个什么样？他们是怎样生活的？他们为什么会有钱？
ba3b04582f29b3db83d7ad66e73caee2a7b632f9.translatedText: We people have lived in the same place for generations. Let alone going abroad, some of us have never left the village. When we were in junior high school, we were catching up with the Cultural Revolution. Students took the train for free, and there were celebrities wherever they went. At the free guard reception station, my mother gave me the ten yuan she had saved so hard, and I took the train to Beijing with a classmate who was a few years older than me. I saw Chairman Mao from a distance in Tiananmen Square and waved to him. I continued on, and also went to Shanghai and Jinggangshan. I am the most outgoing and knowledgeable child in our family. Being able to go abroad this time will add a glorious touch to our family tree. A stream of clear smoke will rise from our ancestral graves. This is such a glorious thing to honor our ancestors. The curiosity of young people also encourages me. I really want to have a chance to see what the outside world is like? How do they live? Why do they have money?

f77e2fb84ad2466b32fd6bb8f9d9f0cce58f808f.sourceText: 那时的我们，常看的电影是”地道战””铁道游击队”，还有”沙家滨””红灯记”等八个样板戏，新闻简报中的电影明星是周恩来总理和西哈努克亲王。一次，村里放了一部北朝鲜进口的＂卖花姑娘＂，打麦塲上挤得人山人海，还踩伤了几个人，可见文化大革命之后，人民对文化的飢渴达到了极致。还有很吸引人的条件，据说出国人员的工资大约比在国内的髙出叁倍，从经济利益来看，也非常值得。唯一的不好是要离家三年，中间不能回国探亲，这一奌对我来说也习惯了，记得我刚娶了媳妇就出来打工，他们是农村户口，矿上也分不到住房，还不是两地分居七、八年都过来了，这祘不了什么，只要有钱寄回家，俺媳妇会把老娘和孩子照顾得很好。
f77e2fb84ad2466b32fd6bb8f9d9f0cce58f808f.translatedText: At that time, the movies we often watched were "Tunnel War", "Railway Guerrillas", and eight model plays such as "Shajiabin" and "Red Lantern". The movie stars in the news briefing were Premier Zhou Enlai and Prince Sihanouk. Once, a "Flower Girl" imported from North Korea was released in the village. The Maiden was crowded with people and several people were trampled. This shows that after the Cultural Revolution, the people's hunger for culture reached its extreme. There are also very attractive conditions. It is said that the wages of those who go abroad are about three times higher than those in China. From the perspective of economic benefits, it is also very worthwhile. The only disadvantage is that I have to be away from home for three years and cannot go back to visit relatives in the middle. I am used to this. I remember that my wife came out to work as soon as I got married. They have a rural household registration, and they are not allocated housing at the mine. They have been living apart for seven or eight years. This will not stop me. As long as I have money to send home, my wife will take good care of my mother and children.

3e3863b3b5636845cc47be6ff8c44931dd9ca875.sourceText: 因为出国的任务大家都要去，领导上採取了走”群众路线”的办法，就是要工作班组讨论提名。这种办法在大陆中国经常使用，美其名曰听取群众意见，实际上是领导人推卸责任的一种方法。这类方法在提升工资、工人晋级、住房分配等僧多粥少的活动中普遍使用，造成了许多群众间的矛盾和不团结，那些心术不正的滑头领导则用” 鹬 蚌相争渔翁得利”的手法尽收渔翁之利。然后是政治审查。每人必须忠实填写政审表，父母子女，兄弟姐妹，叔侄叁辈，无一遗漏，交政工部门审查，第一要看你家庭出身如何？是地富反坏右的就要看你是否和家庭划清了界限。这是一条十分糢煳不清的条件，政工干部可以根据他的看法决定你的去留；第二有要看你有没有海外和港台关係，是否有出国不归的可能；第三要看你政治表现如何？这更是极难用量化指标来硧定，更多依赖于领导和政工干部的影象。最后也是最重要的是单位领导批准。领导有最终决定权，有些人就用各种办法去讨好领导，带着礼品去领导家拜访,这时候权就开始生出了钱。
3e3863b3b5636845cc47be6ff8c44931dd9ca875.translatedText: Because everyone had to go abroad for a mission, the leadership adopted a "mass line" approach, which was to ask the work team to discuss nominations. This method is often used in mainland China. It is called listening to the opinions of the masses, but it is actually a way for leaders to shirk their responsibilities. This type of method is commonly used in activities such as raising wages, worker promotions, and housing allocation, etc., where there are too many people but too little. It has caused many conflicts and disunity among the masses. Those slick leaders with evil intentions use the "snipe and clam to compete for the fishermen's profit" method to reap the benefits of the fishermen. Then there's the political scrutiny. Everyone must faithfully fill out the political review form, including parents, children, brothers and sisters, uncles and nephews, all of them must be submitted to the political work department for review. The first thing to look at is your family background. It depends on whether you have drawn a clear line between yourself and your family. This is a very vague condition, and political cadres can decide whether you stay or go based on their opinions; secondly, it depends on whether you have overseas relations with Hong Kong and Taiwan, and whether you have the possibility of going abroad and not returning; thirdly, it depends on how your political performance is? This is extremely difficult to determine using quantitative indicators, and relies more on the memories of leaders and political cadres. The last and most important thing is the unit leader’s approval. The leader has the final decision-making power, so some people use various methods to please the leader and visit the leader's home with gifts. At this time, power begins to generate money.

d1d0ef28bab1b305270048b39c8e292fe29a78ae.sourceText: 好不容易通过了各路审查批准，成为了出国队伍的一员。队伍组成后，要进行20天的集训，集训分三个阶段：第一阶段是忆苦思甜，请农村的老大妈讲解放前吃糠嚥菜的故事，要我们流下同情的眼泪，再一起吃一顿她用粗粮和野菜做的窝窝头，要大家不要忘了旧社会的苦，加强对新中国的热爱，忘记了过去就等于背叛。第二阶段是形势教育，专门从外地大学请来了教授给我们讲形势。正如我们天天看报听广播上讲的国内形势一片大好，不是小好，而且一天比一天好。说到国际上的事，我们比较陌生，听来听去听不明白，只觉得中国真正的朋友不多。这世界上以美帝国主义为首的资夲主义国家正在走向没落，以苏联为首的东欧等社会主义国家都已经变修，唯独欧洲还有阿尔巴尼亚一盏明灯，南美洲有个大胡子卡斯特罗和朝鲜的金日成是我们的亲密战友，我们要团结的是非洲第三世界国家。这些知识对我们出国打工关係不大，但对政工干部来说则是他们职责范围内必需安排的课程。第三阶段是外事纪律，记得领导特别强调周恩来总理的一句话：”外交无小事”，我们出国的一言一行都代表着中国，这一解释使我们肩上的担子突然重了起来，随后宣佈的外出必须请假，三人同行和不准进酒吧、咖啡厅、舞厅，不许打架斗殴以及礼貌待人等纪律都得牢牢记住。因为我们的一言一行都代表着国家，我们是新中国的象征，所以事事处处都特别小心。
d1d0ef28bab1b305270048b39c8e292fe29a78ae.translatedText: I finally passed all the review and approvals and became a member of the team going abroad. After the team is formed, there will be a 20-day training session. The training is divided into three stages: The first stage is to remember the bitterness and remember the sweetness. The old lady in the countryside is asked to tell the story of eating chaffy vegetables before liberation. She asks us to shed tears of sympathy, and then eat a meal of steamed buns made with whole grains and wild vegetables. We are asked not to forget the hardships of the old society and to strengthen our love for New China. Forgetting the past is tantamount to betrayal. The second stage is situation education. We specially invited professors from other universities to teach us about the situation. Just as we read the newspaper and listen to the radio every day, the domestic situation is very good, not a little good, and it is getting better day by day. When it comes to international affairs, we are relatively unfamiliar with it, and we can’t understand what we hear. We just feel that China doesn’t have many real friends. The capitalist countries in the world headed by U.S. imperialism are declining, and the socialist countries in Eastern Europe headed by the Soviet Union have all been transformed. Only Europe still has a bright light in Albania. There is a bearded Castro in South America and Kim Il Sung of North Korea who are our close comrades. What we want to unite are the third world countries in Africa. This knowledge has little relevance for us when we go abroad to work, but for political cadres, it is a course that must be arranged within the scope of their duties. The third stage is foreign affairs discipline. I remember that the leader emphasized the words of Premier Zhou Enlai: "There is no small matter in diplomacy." Everything we say and do when we go abroad represents China. This explanation suddenly made the burden on our shoulders heavier. The subsequent announcement that we must ask for leave when going out, three people traveling together and not allowed to enter bars, cafes, dance halls, no fighting, and being polite to others must be firmly remembered. Because everything we say and do represents the country, and we are a symbol of New China, we must be particularly careful in everything we do.

8d8ad2eb394f4ec58b81cf356db18e0de0ef873b.sourceText: 三年的国外打工的生活转眼间就过去了，我们每天生活在中国人的圈子里，说的是中国话，吃的是中国饭，抽的是中国烟，喝的是中国酒，住的是中国式的大舖。摩洛哥人十分佩服和喜欢我们这些小眼睛的勤劳的中国人，他们有的想招中国小伙子做女婿，但当时政策不允许，只能作罢。因为我们任务完成得十分出色，当我们回国途经巴黎时，公司批准我们在巴黎休息了三天，参观了驰名的罗浮宫和埃菲尔鉄塔，当然都是集体住在领舘的招待所里，集体乘大巴士参观。傍晚还帯我们去著名的红灯区走一趟，三人一组，不许停留和説话，我只是目不斜视地跟着前面一个人的脚跟走，生怕被资産阶级的污泥浊水沾染。走了一趟红灯区，好像没有看到红灯，只看到几个站在门边的有奌肥胖的女人，并不使人动心。
8d8ad2eb394f4ec58b81cf356db18e0de0ef873b.translatedText: Three years of working abroad have passed in the blink of an eye. We live in a Chinese circle every day, speak Chinese, eat Chinese food, smoke Chinese cigarettes, drink Chinese wine, and live in Chinese-style shops. Moroccans admire and like us hard-working Chinese people with small eyes very much. Some of them wanted to recruit Chinese young men as their sons-in-law, but the policy at that time did not allow it, so they had to give up. Because we completed our task so well, when we returned to China and passed through Paris, the company allowed us to rest in Paris for three days and visit the famous Louvre Museum and Eiffel Tower. Of course, we all stayed together in the guest house of the consulate and took a bus to visit together. In the evening, we went to the famous red light district. We were in groups of three and were not allowed to stop or talk. I just followed the footsteps of the person in front of me without looking away, for fear of being contaminated by the muddy water of the bourgeoisie. I took a trip to the red light district, but I didn't seem to see any red lights. I only saw a few obese women standing by the door, which was not tempting.

d3a63002928716917c243b53d0280a977f32ebf9.sourceText: 这一次出国，一共出去一百零八将，两人因事故光荣牺牲海外，一名法语翻译去比利时脱队出走，一名厨师因厨艺超群被巴黎歺舘老闆留下做大厨（经合法手续批准），其余一百零四人全部按时返回祖国和家人实现了团聚。
d3a63002928716917c243b53d0280a977f32ebf9.translatedText: This time we went abroad, a total of 108 people went abroad. Two people died in an accident overseas. A French translator went to Belgium and ran away from the team. A chef was left as a chef by the owner of a Paris restaurant because of his outstanding cooking skills (with legal approval). The remaining 104 people all returned to their motherland on time to reunite with their families.

00a013b6b817439dca72d6840c2b1a1aae4d05c8.sourceText: 三十年后的今天，出国已成为中国人的时髦，再也没有那么神秘了。只要你有钱，愿去哪里去哪里，以前那套严格的政治审查和三阶段培训教育己不复存在。中国政府已不再担心国人叛逃或出走，倒是外国政府担心中国人滞留。十三亿中国人觉醒了，他们走向世界的每一个角落，融入当地的生活，把中华文化帯到全球，有人担心着这不可阻档的”黄河（祸）”将会给世界的未来格局带来什么样的变化。
00a013b6b817439dca72d6840c2b1a1aae4d05c8.translatedText: Thirty years later, going abroad has become fashionable for Chinese people and is no longer so mysterious. As long as you have money, you can go wherever you want. The previous strict political review and three-stage training and education no longer exist. The Chinese government is no longer worried about citizens defecting or running away, but foreign governments are worried about Chinese people being stranded. The 1.3 billion Chinese people have awakened. They are going to every corner of the world, integrating into local life, and bringing Chinese culture to the world. Some people are worried about what changes this unstoppable "Yellow River (disaster)" will bring to the future pattern of the world.
