aeb7750f43e38404a4ed216d8555ce124f59daf1.sourceText: 凤鸣：黄金公主号邮轮阿拉斯加探索之旅（四） 第四天起得很早，吃早餐时仍找靠窗位置坐下。在快吃完时，发现一小游船向我们大轮船慢慢驶来，再向前看发现冰川就在前面，这小游船是来接我们大轮船上的人(提前報名) ，去更近距离看冰川。我和先生再無心继续吃饭，拿起相机奔向船头甲板，已有许多人拥挤在甲板上，我同先生慢慢向船舷靠近，我们好不容易等有人拍完照片离开后，终於站在了船舷边，抓紧时间抓拍好的冰川，并请周边的客人邦我们拍了合影，然后把位置让给比我们晚来的人。坐邮轮旅游，就是要亲眼目睹冰川那雄伟壮观，無比优美的奇景，感受阿拉斯加气势磅礴的冰河魅力，今天得愿以尝。这时想起孩子们，赶快给他们打电话，報告好消息。可是他们由於昨晚睡得晚，都还没起床呢！不过还有补救机会。今天下午要下船，从陆地近距离看冰川。 中午10:00am邮轮启航，沿着蜿蜒伸展于阿拉斯加荒原上的崔西海湾(Tracy Arm) 巡航，崔西峡湾是由冰河切割成峡谷之后，冰河消退，海水灌入而成为今日景像。下午2:00pm邮轮仃靠在朱诺 (Juneac) 这个小城。我们下轮船后，冒着小雨搭上开往车站的大巴士，在巴士车站，有好几家經營载客去看冰川和欣赏小城風景的小公司。孩子们找了一家最热情招揽生意的公司，还可以讨价还价，半天终於談妥。这次出门各种准备都齐全，唯独没有预料会下雨，搞得如此狼狈不堪。还好，在等待大巴士时，孩子们去对面的小商店，买了两把雨伞，以觧这燃眉之急。又有一位好心的工昨人员，送了两件红色雨衣。这才有了临时挡风遮雨的工具。一会大巴士汽车来了，我们很快上车，这是一位当地原住民司机，他一面开车，一面講朱诺 (Juneau) 这座小城的历史。朱诺是个依山面海的美丽海港城市，只有坐飞机或乘船才能来到朱诺。积雪的山峰、深海峡湾和森林島屿购成了世上独一無二的风光和特色。在1880年时，有两个人和一个印第安人酋长，来到今天朱诺的一条小溪里，发现了一颗只有黄豆般大小的沙金，导至阿拉斯加淘金热的开始。到1944年间，朱诺金矿已生产了超过8000万美元的黄金。今天这个地方，也以其中一人的名字，命名为朱诺。这三人的名字分别是乔?#26417;诺（Joseph Juneau）和印第安人酋長可威(kowee) 及查理?#21704;利斯(Richard Harris) ，朱诺市就在淘金人潮迅速涌入的情况下，急驟发展成一个新兴的淘金城。大巴士司机帶我们转了几个景点，每个景点十分钟拍拍照，最后把我们放在冰川陆地观看地，说过一个小时来接我们。 从陆地上看冰川虽然距离远，但比在轮船上要近，而且更真实、清楚，冰川旁的瀑布清晰可見，站在冰川前人显得非常渺小，微不足道。在路旁有一瞭望台，我们坐电梯上去，买一个 $3的票，里面有冰川模型及图片，介绍冰川的形成，还有一小型电影院，放映冰川形成及规模。有几个架子上，摆满了纪念品。最主要是站在瞭望台的门外，从上往下看冰川，拉近了人与冰川的距离，冰川似在眼前。听说有人可以买票，坐飞机在冰川上空，更近距离观察冰川。瞭望台的门外有一条小路，我们沿着弯弯曲曲的小路走下瞭望台。外面还下着雨，孩子们徒步去看瀑布还没回来，我们在雨中等待大巴士时，淋湿了衣服，还好我穿了防水的衣服。但还是很冷。好不容易等来大巴士，大家很快登車，在車内稍稍暖合了快凍透的身体。六月天的阿拉斯加真不给面子，我们这一船2600多人，不远万里、不怕艰辛来看它，倒给我们一个下马威。比我们鳳凰城的冬天还冷，在鳯凰城好几年都不穿的防寒衣，现在派上用处。在回船的途中，非常健談的司机，仍在介绍他的家史。他的父亲是他们这一族的最后一个酋长，他的兄弟姊妹几人，现在都有称心如意的工作，他的工作是，在旅游季节出任大巴士司机，过了旅游季节、满山遍野冰天雪地的日子，就去游乐场所唱歌，难怪他有一付好嗓子，一路大声不断的为旅客講觧，嗓子也不哑。 回到船上，换下被雨淋湿的衣服，休息一下就去吃晚饭。饭后有文艺演出，就是隨船的演职人員，大约有30人左右，上场又唱又跳，下场后换另一套衣服再出场。因不懂英语，只是看热闹。看完文艺演出，回房稍事休息洗整后，安安稳稳的睡了一晚。
aeb7750f43e38404a4ed216d8555ce124f59daf1.translatedText: Fengming: Golden Princess Cruise Alaska Discovery Tour (4) I got up very early on the fourth day and still found a seat by the window during breakfast. When we were about to finish eating, we found a small cruise ship slowly approaching our big ship. Looking forward, we found that the glacier was right in front. This small cruise ship was here to pick up the people on our big ship (sign up in advance) to see the glacier more closely. My husband and I were no longer in the mood to continue eating, so we picked up our cameras and ran to the bow deck. There were already many people crowded on the deck. My husband and I slowly approached the side of the ship. After we finally waited for someone to take photos and leave, we finally stood on the side of the ship. We took the time to capture the glacier we had taken, and asked the surrounding guests to take a group photo with us, and then gave our place to those who came later than us. Taking a cruise is to witness the majestic and incomparably beautiful scenery of the glacier and feel the majestic charm of Alaska's glaciers. Today, you can try it. Then I thought of the children and quickly called them to tell them the good news. But because they slept late last night, they haven't gotten up yet! But there are opportunities for redress. We will get off the boat this afternoon and see the glacier up close from land. At 10:00 am, the cruise ship set sail and cruised along Tracy Arm, which stretches out in the Alaskan wilderness. Tracy Arm was cut into a canyon by glaciers, and then the glaciers receded and seawater poured in, creating the scene today. At 2:00pm, the cruise ship docked in the small town of Juneac. After we got off the ship, we braved the light rain and boarded a big bus bound for the bus station. At the bus station, there were several small companies that took passengers to see the glaciers and enjoy the scenery of the small town. The children found a company that was the most enthusiastic about soliciting business, and they were able to bargain, and finally reached an agreement in a long time. We were fully prepared for going out this time, except that it was not expected to rain, which made us so embarrassed. Fortunately, while waiting for the big bus, the children went to the small shop opposite and bought two umbrellas to solve their urgent need. Another kind-hearted worker gave me two red raincoats. Only then did we have a temporary shelter from the wind and rain. After a while, the big bus came, and we quickly got on the bus. This was a local aboriginal driver. While driving, he talked about the history of the small city of Juneau. Juneau is a beautiful seaport city surrounded by mountains and sea. You can only get to Juneau by plane or boat. Snow-capped peaks, deep fjords and forested islands create scenery and character unique to the world. In 1880, two people and an Indian chief came to a creek in today's Juneau and discovered a piece of sand gold the size of a soybean, which led to the beginning of the Alaska Gold Rush. By 1944, the Juneau Gold Mine had produced more than $80 million in gold. Today this place is also named Juneau after one of them. The names of these three people are Joseph Juneau, Indian chiefs Kowee and Richard Harris. With the rapid influx of gold diggers, the city of Juneau has rapidly developed into a new gold mining city. The big bus driver took us around several scenic spots, taking ten minutes to take photos at each scenic spot. Finally, he dropped us at the glacier land viewing area and said he would pick us up in an hour. Although the glacier is far away from the land, it is closer than from the ship, and it is more real and clear. The waterfall next to the glacier is clearly visible, and the person standing in front of the glacier looks very small and insignificant. There is an observation deck on the roadside. We took the elevator up and bought a $3 ticket. There were glacier models and pictures explaining the formation of the glacier. There was also a small cinema showing the formation and scale of the glacier. There are several shelves filled with souvenirs. The most important thing is to stand outside the door of the observatory and look at the glacier from top to bottom, which shortens the distance between people and the glacier, and the glacier seems to be right in front of you. I heard that some people can buy a ticket and fly over the glacier to get a closer look at the glacier. There is a path outside the door of the observatory, and we walked down the winding path to the observatory. It was still raining outside, and the children had not returned from hiking to see the waterfall. While we were waiting for the bus in the rain, our clothes got wet. Fortunately, I wore waterproof clothes. But it was still cold. After finally waiting for the big bus, everyone quickly boarded the bus and warmed up their almost freezing bodies in the car. Alaska in June is really shameless. There are more than 2,600 people in our boat, who have traveled thousands of miles and are not afraid of hardships to see it. We are really impressed. It's colder than our winter in Phoenix City. The cold-proof clothes I haven't worn in Phoenix City for several years now come in handy. On the way back to the ship, the very talkative driver was still introducing his family history. His father was the last chief of their clan. His brothers and sisters now all have satisfying jobs. His job is to work as a bus driver during the tourist season. After the tourist season, when the mountains and fields are full of ice and snow, he goes to the amusement park to sing. No wonder he has a good voice, and he loudly explains to the tourists all the way without losing his voice. Back on the boat, I changed out of my clothes that were soaked by the rain, took a rest and went to have dinner. After the meal there was a theatrical performance, which consisted of about 30 performers and crew accompanying the ship. They sang and danced on the stage, and then changed into another set of clothes and appeared again. Because I don’t understand English, I just watch the excitement. After watching the theatrical performance, I went back to my room to rest and wash myself, and then slept peacefully all night.

a4c7a8ffbdb65dd79bfb2bbd3208c9eda59e16cc.sourceText: 凤凰城云生：又到龙年 在进入二十一世纪的开始，有人就预言，二十一世纪将是中国的世纪，是中华民族的世纪。我们看到，二十一世纪开始的元年2001年就是十二生肖中的龙年。今年2012年也是龙年，是十二生肖的又一个轮回，可以说是中华民族的本命年，是中国人的本命年。 在过去的12年中，中国，中华民族，中国人面对纷繁多变，惊涛骇浪的国际环境，经历了地震，洪水，台风，冰雪等等自然灾害，挺直腰杆，步履坚定，昂首阔步地走完了在21世纪里龙年的第一个轮回，抓住了历史机遇，经受了历史的挑战和考验。这其间,中国的科技发展了,国库丰盈了,人民的幸福指数提高了,交通提速了,老百姓的钱包鼓了,中国的经济发展上了一个新的台阶,成为世界上第二大经济体.龙年给中国带来了民富国强的勃勃生机。 现在，第二个龙年又来到了，中国，中华民族，中国人又迎来了新的历史机遇和挑战。 中国被认为是龙的故乡,中华民族都是龙的传人.这是让全世界的中国人引以自豪的。自古以来，”龙”就被做为中华民族的图腾受到崇拜，在中华文化中占有极其重要的地位。 中国的十二生肖纪年是由12个动物构成的，其中11个动物在世界上都是有实体的，只有”龙”是虚拟神化了的。古人描绘中的”龙”有”九似”的说法；即”龙”的形象是”角似鹿，头似驼，眼似兔，项似蛇，腹似蜃，鳞似鲤，爪似鹰，掌似虎，耳似牛。?正因为”龙”是个虚拟化 的神物,被中国远古时期的各个部落氏族作为图腾来崇拜;有：”黄龙，赤龙，白龙，黑龙，青龙，土龙，水龙，飞龙，居龙，潜龙，降龙，”等等。中华神洲，群龙云集。 在《山海经》《淮南子》等神话书中的”龙”就是雷神，雨神，星神，虹神的别称，使大自然的景象完全进入了”龙”的神化境界。《山海经》说雷神是人头龙身的形态；又说”龙”是雨神，又叫雨师，突出龙能呼风唤雨；星像中又说二十八宿中的东方”苍龙七宿”即龙头角宿，龙颈亢宿，龙胸氏宿，龙股房宿，龙心心宿，龙尾尾宿和箕宿；龙星体见，万物始盛。在农牧社会的古代，对龙及龙代表的诸神的祈祷和对幸福的期望；是一种精神寄托；人们渴望着能”呼风唤雨”的龙带来风调雨顺使人的生存和幸福得到护佑。 歌谣曰：”龙年又到，万众欢笑；祥云飞涌，金风呼啸；飞龙在天，蓄势九霄；吐珠献瑞，雨顺风调。”这是民心对龙年到来的企盼。 纵观天下大势，美债风暴，欧债危机，海湾阴云，南海浪涌。审时度势，让我们清醒地认识到中国的掘起，未来将面临着诸多的挑战。 未来的世界是海洋的世界，中华巨龙不仅要腾飞九霄，还要走向海洋，这是中华掘起的战略大势。”龙归大海”势不可挡！岂是所谓的几道岛链能束缚了的？有话说得好：”顺势者昌！”与龙为友，与龙为伴，与龙共舞，创建和谐的世界才是当今的发展趋势。 2012年1月17日於凤凰城
a4c7a8ffbdb65dd79bfb2bbd3208c9eda59e16cc.translatedText: Yunsheng of Phoenix City: It’s the Year of the Dragon again. At the beginning of the 21st century, some people predicted that the 21st century will be the century of China, the century of the Chinese nation. We see that 2001, the first year of the 21st century, is the Year of the Dragon among the twelve zodiac animals. This year 2012 is also the Year of the Dragon, another reincarnation of the twelve zodiac animals. It can be said to be the natal year of the Chinese nation and the Chinese people. In the past 12 years, China, the Chinese nation, and the Chinese people have faced the ever-changing and turbulent international environment and experienced natural disasters such as earthquakes, floods, typhoons, ice and snow, etc. They have straightened their backs, walked firmly, and walked through the first cycle of the Year of the Dragon in the 21st century with their heads held high, seizing historical opportunities and withstanding historical challenges and tests. During this period, China's science and technology has developed, the national treasury has been enriched, the people's happiness index has increased, transportation has accelerated, and people's wallets have bulged. China's economic development has reached a new level and has become the second largest economy in the world. The Year of the Dragon has brought to China the vitality of a prosperous people and a strong country. Now, the second Year of the Dragon has arrived, and China, the Chinese nation, and the Chinese people are facing new historical opportunities and challenges. China is considered to be the hometown of the dragon, and the Chinese nation are all descendants of the dragon. This makes Chinese people all over the world proud. Since ancient times, "dragon" has been worshiped as a totem of the Chinese nation and occupies an extremely important position in Chinese culture. The Chinese zodiac is composed of 12 animals, 11 of which are physical in the world, and only the "dragon" is virtual and deified. The "dragon" described by the ancients has "nine similarities"; that is, the image of the "dragon" is "antlers like a deer, head like a camel, eyes like a rabbit, neck like a snake, belly like a mirage, scales like a carp, claws like an eagle, palms like a tiger, and ears like an ox." Precisely because "dragon" is a virtual The gods were worshiped as totems by various tribes and clans in ancient China; they include: "yellow dragon, red dragon, white dragon, black dragon, green dragon, earth dragon, water dragon, flying dragon, living dragon, hidden dragon, subdued dragon," and so on. The "dragon" in mythological books such as "The Classic of Mountains and Seas" and "Huainanzi" is another name for the god of thunder, rain, star and rainbow, which makes the natural scene completely enter the deified realm of "dragon"; "The Classic of Mountains and Seas" says that the god of thunder is in the form of a human head and a dragon body; it is also said that the "dragon" is the god of rain, also called the rain master, highlighting that the dragon can call the wind and rain; in the star image, it is also said that there are seven blue dragons in the east among the twenty-eight constellations. The "constellations" are the Spica of the Dragon's Head, the Constellation of the Dragon's Neck, the Constellation of the Dragon's Breast, the Constellation of the Dragon's Quan, the Constellation of the Dragon's Heart, the Constellation of the Dragon's Tail and the Constellation of the Ji. When the Dragon star body is seen, all things begin to prosper. In the ancient farming and pastoral society, prayers to the dragon and the gods represented by the dragon and the expectation of happiness were a kind of spiritual sustenance; people longed for the dragon that could "call the wind and rain" to bring good weather and protect people's survival and happiness. The ballad says: "The Year of the Dragon is here again, and everyone is laughing; auspicious clouds are flying, and the golden wind is roaring; the flying dragon is in the sky, gathering momentum in the sky; it is spitting out beads to offer auspiciousness, and the rain is flowing with the wind. "This is the expectation of the people for the arrival of the Year of the Dragon. Looking at the general trend of the world, there are U.S. debt storms, European debt crises, dark clouds in the Gulf, and surging South Sea waves. Taking stock of the situation, let us clearly realize that China will face many challenges in the future as it rises. The world of the future is a world of oceans. The Chinese dragon will not only soar into the sky, but also move towards the ocean. This is the unstoppable strategic trend of China's "dragon returning to the sea"! How can the so-called island chain be restrained? As the saying goes: "Those who follow the trend will prosper!" "To be friends with dragons, to be companions with dragons, to dance with dragons and to create a harmonious world is today's development trend. January 17, 2012 in Phoenix

ae4573ae9e6f3154a9adcf2c6253632e754533d5.sourceText: 高税负 纽约被评为最不宜做生意州 据克莱恩商业周刊报道：据华盛顿一家研究税收的基金会周二的一份报告显示，全国最适宜发展生意的排行榜中，纽约州位居全美50个州的最后一位。 纽约居高不下的个人收入所得税、物业税和失业保险金是造成其在榜单上排名最后的原因。在该排行榜上，纽约一直位居倒数几名，今年由于纽约州决定将高收入者的个人收入所得税附加费延长至2014年后，排名滑落至最后一名。 新泽西州排名该榜单49位，加州位居第48。 怀俄明州位居排行榜榜首、南达科他、内华达和阿拉斯加等州也因其较低的消费税、个人收入所得税和企业收入所得税位居前几位。 纽约州现行最高个人收入税为8.82%，企业所得税7.1%，消费税7%，人均物业税为2.136美金，为全国最高。 该报告认为高税收会阻碍一个城市商业发展的竞争力。但反对者则认为，从生产总值、收入增长和工作岗位增长等几个指标看，纽约的表现远胜过其他的大多数州。也有人认为，纽约的高税收回流于城市的基建和服务之上，从而使得纽约能在经济萧条期仍能保持强劲的经济增长势头。
ae4573ae9e6f3154a9adcf2c6253632e754533d5.translatedText: High tax burden, New York is rated as the least suitable state to do business. According to Klein Business Weekly: New York ranks last among the 50 states in the nation's ranking of the best places to do business, according to a report Tuesday from a Washington-based tax research foundation. New York's high personal income taxes, property taxes and unemployment insurance are the reasons why it ranks last on the list. New York has always been at the bottom of the rankings, but this year it slipped to last place after the state decided to extend the personal income tax surcharge for high-income earners until 2014. New Jersey ranks 49th on the list, and California ranks 48th. Wyoming tops the list, with states such as South Dakota, Nevada and Alaska also ranking high for their low sales, personal and corporate income taxes. The current highest personal income tax in New York State is 8.82%, the corporate income tax is 7.1%, the consumption tax is 7%, and the per capita property tax is US$2.136, which is the highest in the country. The report concluded that high taxes can hamper a city's competitiveness for business development. But opponents argue that New York's performance far outperforms most other states in terms of gross product, income growth and job growth. Some people also believe that New York's high taxes flow back into the city's infrastructure and services, allowing New York to maintain strong economic growth during the economic depression.

181f972f375752dd33193cb5052fd34b2a3b806a.sourceText: 你的旧金首饰到底值多少钱？ 万维读者网 2011-07-21 22:36:39 万维读者网记者唯一编译报道: CNN Money刊登的文章说，看到黄金价格不断创新高，电视里总是有”收购金首饰”的广告，你是否也想卖掉一些早已不戴的首饰呢？你是否想知道到底这些首饰值多少钱？ 比如Yvette Shirey决定卖掉一些旧首饰，包括一条项链，一些耳环和手镯。她将这些首饰送到一家珠宝店，得到了一千美元。虽然这些首饰有感情价值，但是作为一名失业人士，钱比首饰对她更有用。 对于很多美国人来讲，旧金首饰成了一个经济来源。上星期黄金达到每盎司1600美元的价位，创立了新高。不少人也趁这个机会卖出旧首饰。 不过，Better Business Bureau(简称BBB)提醒消费者在出售旧首饰时小心被骗，目前BBB已经收到对不少收购贵金属店的投诉，在2011年里已经有416个案例。 不论你是将首饰卖给网络上的收购店还是本地珠宝店，你都应该先了解这些首饰到底值多少钱。金饰的重量和纯度决定其价值。10K金由42%的黄金和58%的其它金属组成；14K金中含真金是58%；18K金中含75%的金。因此，一件14K的金首饰应该值928美元，就是58% X $1600 (目前黄金的市场价)；当然买主不一定肯出那么高的价格，他们通常会出价550美元到750美元之间。如果买主不肯出这样的价格，那么消费者就要小心了。 Chubb Personal Insurance的副总Janece White说，珠宝店应该告诉你每盎司或者每克的价格是多少。然后你还应该多走几个店比较。除了货比三家外，消费者应选择卖给本地的名誉比较好的珠宝店。消费者可以到BBB网站去查一下珠宝店的名誉，看看有没有其它消费者的投诉。 另外，消费者还应该注意的是： 1. 了解自己的首饰的重量：计量方法是每盎司的黄金等于31.3克，有些收购站会在重量上做手脚； 2. 清楚首饰的纯度，是10K，14K还是18K，以免上当受骗； 3. 要了解市场上的黄金价格，以保证自己得到公平的收购价格。
181f972f375752dd33193cb5052fd34b2a3b806a.translatedText: How much is your old gold jewelry worth? Wanwei Reader Network 2011-07-21 22:36:39 The only report compiled by Wanwei Reader Network reporter: An article published by CNN Money said that seeing the price of gold continue to hit new highs, there are always advertisements for "buying gold jewelry" on TV. Do you also want to sell some jewelry that you no longer wear? Have you ever wondered how much these pieces of jewelry are worth? For example, Yvette Shirey decided to sell some old jewelry, including a necklace, some earrings and bracelets. She sent the pieces to a jewelry store and was paid a thousand dollars. Although the jewelry has sentimental value, as an unemployed person, money is more useful to her than jewelry. For many Americans, old gold jewelry has become a source of income. Last week gold reached a price of $1,600 an ounce, setting a new high. Many people also took this opportunity to sell their old jewelry. However, the Better Business Bureau (BBB) ​​reminds consumers to be careful of being deceived when selling old jewelry. Currently, the BBB has received complaints about many stores that buy precious metals. In 2011, there have been 416 cases. Whether you're selling your jewelry to an online buyout store or to a local jewelry store, you should first know how much the jewelry is worth. The weight and purity of gold jewelry determine its value. 10K gold is composed of 42% gold and 58% other metals; 14K gold contains 58% real gold; 18K gold contains 75% gold. Therefore, a piece of 14K gold jewelry should be worth $928, which is 58% If buyers are unwilling to pay such a price, then consumers should be careful. Janece White, vice president of Chubb Personal Insurance, said jewelry stores should tell you how much it costs per ounce or gram. Then you should visit a few more stores to compare. In addition to shopping around, consumers should choose to sell to local jewelry stores with a better reputation. Consumers can go to the BBB website to check the reputation of the jewelry store and see if there are any complaints from other consumers. In addition, consumers should also pay attention to the following: 1. Understand the weight of their jewelry: the measurement method is that each ounce of gold is equal to 31.3 grams, and some purchasing stations will manipulate the weight; 2. Know the purity of the jewelry, whether it is 10K, 14K or 18K, to avoid being deceived; 3. Understand the gold price in the market to ensure that you get a fair purchase price.

984c24a36ed597c359af76fd5ffae264e0c2ffd3.sourceText: 世界华文媒体合作联盟（世华）第一期业务研修班开幕 亚省时报 北京时间5月4日晚六时，世界华文媒体合作联盟（世华）第一期业务研修班在北京市侨办白鹭园培训中心隆重举行。 中国新闻社社长刘北宪 ，夏春平出席了开学晚宴，亚省时报副社长甄凯婴，新闻主管谢成彦准时参加了此次培训，来自世界五大洲的其他23家华人媒体，一共30位代表参加了此次活动。 ”最近世界发生的新闻事件很多，最重要的应该有四件，第一件是英国威廉王子大婚了，卡扎菲儿子被炸死了，本 拉登被杀死了，世华研修班开课了”在一个轻松幽默的氛围中，中国新闻社的代表们拉开了本次研修的序幕。中国新闻社副总编辑张明新，夏春平都上台致辞，他们的发言凸显媒体人的本色，言简意赅，第一感谢海外华媒对世华的支持，第二加强合作，共创佳绩，让世界了解真实的中国。本次研修班的课程非常的丰富，而且是在国内都难得一听的知名专家学者的大聚会，比如复旦大学国际关系与公共事务学院院长龙永图， 北京大学新闻传播学院副院长 徐泓，清华大学国际传播中心执行主任司久岳等。课程内容主要关注国际新闻形势，增强华媒在国际传媒界的话语权和竞争力。主办方世华对本次培训计划非常重视，他们打算花巨资，在五年内培训500名海外华媒从业人员。同时，还将相继启动华人媒体从业人员直系亲属回国寻根等相关活动。
984c24a36ed597c359af76fd5ffae264e0c2ffd3.translatedText: The first business training class of the World Chinese Media Cooperation Alliance (Shihua) opens The Alberta Times At 6 pm on May 4th, Beijing time, the first business training class of the World Chinese Media Cooperation Alliance (Shihua) was grandly held at the Bailuyuan Training Center of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Beijing. Liu Beixian, president of China News Service, and Xia Chunping attended the opening dinner. Zhen Kaiying, deputy president of the Alberta Times, and Xie Chengyan, news director, attended the training on time. A total of 30 representatives from 23 other Chinese media outlets from five continents around the world participated in the event. "There have been a lot of news events happening in the world recently, and there are probably four most important ones. The first one is that Britain's Prince William got married, and Gaddafi's son was killed in a bombing. Bin Laden has been killed, and the Shihua training class has begun." In a relaxed and humorous atmosphere, representatives of China News Service kicked off the training. Zhang Mingxin, deputy editor-in-chief of China News Service, and Xia Chunping both came to the stage to deliver speeches. Their speeches highlighted the true nature of media people and were concise and comprehensive. First of all, thank you The overseas Chinese media support Shihua, and secondly, strengthen cooperation to create great achievements and let the world know the real China. The courses of this training class are very rich, and it is a large gathering of well-known experts and scholars that are rare in China, such as Long Yongtu, Dean of the School of International Relations and Public Affairs of Fudan University. Xu Hong, deputy dean of the School of Journalism and Communication at Peking University, Si Jiuyue, executive director of the International Communication Center of Tsinghua University, and others. The course content mainly focuses on the international news situation and enhances the voice and competitiveness of Chinese media in the international media industry. The organizer Shihua attaches great importance to this training plan. They plan to spend huge sums of money to train 500 overseas Chinese media practitioners in five years. At the same time, related activities will also be launched for the immediate relatives of Chinese media practitioners to return to China.

dffb2bccb831af18d705d3f286a8ea311f646185.sourceText: 移民改革及查税问答 1. 奥巴马总统到底对移民政策是否有改革的意愿,可否分析一下? 答:奥巴马总统针对全面性移民改革发表演讲,媒体将大部分的关注放在总统最具有争议性的两个提案︰即边境安全与开放一条能让境内超过一千万非法居民成为美国公民的管道。总统提议自动将绿卡发给在美国大学拿到科学、科技、工程、及数学(STEM Majors)硕士或博士学位的学生，他希望藉由绿卡将高学位人才留在美国，以强化美国经济。若此提议被接受，硕士及博士毕业生便不需要烦恼OPT、H1B、及绿卡问题，可以直接为美国公司工作。另一个改革创新乃是提创一种名叫”Start-Up Visa”的新签证:此签证方便美国投资者集结国外资本家共同来美国开创自己的事业，替美国创造就业机会。Start-Up visa 将让世界各地的企业家能够来美国实践他们的创意，使美国公司能接触世界各地最新的商业信息，为美国打造更全面的经济。对于亲属移民体制的变更, 他希望取消美国公民直系亲属的名额限制，使他们不需等待移民签证排期，立即申请绿卡。其二，他将改变职业移民申请的类别并取消职业移民每个国家的最高限额，加速高科技技术人才办理绿卡的进程。虽然细节尚未决定，但任何有利于高科技人才的法律变动。因此奥巴马总统对于移民改革的展望因该是好的方向 2. 最近很多人都收到查税通知,难道美国政府真是没钱到这种地步了吗? 要如何因应? 答:夏天来临，也就来到了2011年国税局查税季。只能怪美国居高不下的联邦赤字，高收入者税务诈欺频繁，以及经常发生的各类逃漏税，都使国税局深信民众该缴的税和实际付出的税之间有一段差距。 收到查税通知时，应先了解有关现行查税的要点。 当然在此我只能就所知的范围提出几点建议: 国税局现已不再从纳税人的报税表格逐项检查，而改为就特定一两项容易逃漏的项目查税，如捐赠汽车等。纳税人必须就所查的项目提出更多证明文件。 如果你能提出证明所扣减的项目金额属实，可直接将证明文件副本寄给国税局，即可轻松解决。如果查税员对所收到的证明文件不满意，很快就会接到通知上税务法庭，过去面对面查税往往可和查税员周旋一番才可能上法庭。 假如情形不对，你可要求将通讯查税转为与查税员当面对谈，在某些情况下面对面查税对纳税人较有利。例如被查项目与业务开支有关时，可能有必要当面解释为何在你这一行会有这笔不寻常支出，当面说明比教好, 在面对面的查税时应保持冷静和礼貌，如果你表现得太过激动或惊慌，查税员便会觉得其中必有蹊跷，此外情绪也会影响你对查税员谈话的解读。如果你的情况涉及庞大金额及复杂的税务问题,建议你找税务律师或会计师代表你面对查税.
dffb2bccb831af18d705d3f286a8ea311f646185.translatedText: Questions and Answers on Immigration Reform and Tax Inspection 1. Can you analyze whether President Obama is willing to reform immigration policy? Answer: President Obama gave a speech on comprehensive immigration reform. The media focused most of their attention on the president's two most controversial proposals: border security and opening a pipeline that would allow more than 10 million illegal residents in the country to become U.S. citizens. The president proposes to automatically issue green cards to students who have obtained master's or doctoral degrees in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM Majors) from American universities. He hopes to use green cards to keep highly educated talents in the United States to strengthen the American economy. If this proposal is accepted, master's and doctoral graduates will not need to worry about OPT, H1B, and green card issues, and can work directly for American companies. Another reform and innovation is the creation of a new visa called the "Start-Up Visa": This visa allows American investors to gather foreign capitalists to come to the United States to start their own businesses and create jobs in the United States. The Start-Up visa will allow entrepreneurs from around the world to come to the United States to implement their ideas, give American companies access to the latest business information from around the world, and build a more comprehensive economy for the United States. Regarding changes to the family-based immigration system, he hopes to lift the quota limit for immediate relatives of U.S. citizens so that they can apply for green cards immediately without waiting for immigration visas. Second, he will change the categories of employment-based immigration applications and cancel the maximum limit for each country's employment-based immigration, speeding up the process of applying for green cards for high-tech technical talents. While the details have yet to be decided, any legal changes that would benefit high-tech talent. Therefore, President Obama’s outlook on immigration reform should be in a good direction. 2. Many people have received tax audit notices recently. Is the U.S. government really so out of money? How to respond? Answer: Summer is coming, and the 2011 IRS tax audit season has arrived. We can only blame the United States' high federal deficit, frequent tax fraud among high-income earners, and frequent tax evasion of all kinds, which have convinced the IRS that there is a gap between the taxes people should pay and the taxes they actually pay. When you receive a tax audit notice, you should first understand the key points about the current tax audit. Of course, here I can only make a few suggestions based on what I know: The IRS no longer checks taxpayers' tax returns item by item, but instead checks one or two items that are easily evaded, such as donated cars. Taxpayers must provide additional supporting documentation for the items being investigated. If you can prove that the amount of the deduction is true, you can easily resolve it by sending a copy of the supporting documents directly to the IRS. If the tax inspector is not satisfied with the certification documents received, he will soon be notified to go to the tax court. In the past, face-to-face tax inspections often required a lot of dealing with the tax inspector before going to court. If the situation is not right, you can request that the tax audit by communication be changed to a face-to-face interview with the tax inspector. In some cases, a face-to-face tax audit is more beneficial to the taxpayer. For example, when the item under inspection is related to business expenses, it may be necessary to explain in person why there is such an unusual expense in your line of work. It is better to explain in person than to teach. You should remain calm and polite during face-to-face tax inspections. If you act too excited or panicked, the tax inspector will think there is something fishy. In addition, your emotions will also affect your interpretation of the tax inspector's conversation. If your situation involves large amounts and complex tax issues, it is recommended that you find a tax lawyer or accountant to represent you in facing a tax audit.

17ca7468320550b57f550be81cc277ecf3e9cf52.sourceText: 人口普查：亚利桑那的传统家庭成员数量在不断变小 ”我认为有再结婚的可能，但是那并不是我必须要做的事情” 惠特洛克，32岁，一个单身母亲与她的父母住在钱德勒，有一份全职工作正准备申请研究生。像惠特洛克一样的女人并不占少数，新公布的人口普查数据显示，亚利桑那州的家庭结构在不断变化，而且变得更加复杂。 根据2010年人口普查数据，全美国和亚利桑的传统家庭观念都很相似， 一个已婚的男人和女人还有他们的孩子这是一个基本家庭单位。接着的家庭单位就是离婚的人，单亲家庭，丁克和同性恋家庭。几代同堂的家庭变得越来越普遍，因为孩子照顾他们年迈的父母，或自己失去工作后搬到父母家。 专家们说，两个主要因素推动这种趋势的形成。人们，特别是女性，具有大专以上学历，并获得报酬较好的工作，有更多的选择，他们是否要结婚或者保持婚姻。婚姻以外生活在一起的夫妇也很大程度上被接受。即便如此，仍然有大量的人持有传统家庭观念。梅丽莎柯伦，亚利桑那大学家庭与人类研究的教授表示，接受和喜欢还是有很大的差异。2000年，23％亚利桑那州的家庭处于婚姻状态，并与17岁以下的孩子生活在一起。到2010年，这一数字下降到20％以下。已婚夫妇仍然是一个社会的主要部分占家庭总数的47%。 规模较小的家庭明显占据了主要地位。 独自生活，没有孩子的妇女人数已从6.3%攀升至8.1％在亚利桑那州。亚利桑那州和加州有很多家庭是三代同堂，比例超过3.2％，超过其他18个州的2.8％。在亚利桑那州，1.8％的家庭至少有一个继子女，加利福尼亚州为1.5％。保守的亚利桑那州已经成为全国同性恋人群比例最高的州之一。在全国排名第六。调查结果是0.9%，专家说实际数字应该会更高，因为涉及的个人隐私，很多同性夫妇不愿意来界定他们的关系。超过一半的同性伴侣在Apache，Greenlee 和 Graham县，数据显示四分之一的同性恋夫妇会赡养孩子。 （新闻来自The Arizona Republic）
17ca7468320550b57f550be81cc277ecf3e9cf52.translatedText: Census: Arizona's traditional families are getting smaller "I think it's possible to get married again, but it's not something I have to do" Whitlock, a 32-year-old single mother who lives with her parents in Chandler, has a full-time job and is applying to graduate school. Women like Whitlock are not in the minority, and newly released census data shows that family structures in Arizona are changing and becoming more complex, according to 2010 census data. Traditional family values are similar across the United States and in Arizona. A married man and woman and their children are the basic family unit. The next family units are divorced, single parent families, DINK and gay families becoming more common as children take care of their aging parents or move in with their parents after losing their jobs. Experts say two main factors are driving this trend. People, especially women, with college degrees and better-paying jobs have more choices about whether they want to get married or stay married. Even so, a large number of people still hold to traditional family values. , a professor of family and human studies at the University of Arizona, said there is still a big difference in acceptance and liking. In 2000, 23% of Arizona families were married and living with children under the age of 17. By 2010, that number had dropped to less than 20%. Married couples still make up a majority of the society, accounting for 47% of households. Smaller families clearly dominate. The number of women living alone without children has climbed from 6.3% to 8.1% in Arizona. Arizona and California have more than 3.2% of households with three generations, surpassing the 2.8% in 18 other states. In Arizona, 1.8% of households have at least one stepchild, and in California it is 1.5%. Conservative Arizona already has one of the highest percentages of gay people in the country, at 0.9 percent, and experts say the actual number is higher because more than half of same-sex couples in Apache, Greenlee, are reluctant to define their relationships. and Graham County, where data shows one in four gay couples support children (News via The Arizona Republic).

725e565591c1a5f9dc074b4eb7f29a3ddd3fc646.sourceText: 美都会房价 涨幅创新高 美国9月都会房价年涨幅度创2010年7月以来新高，显示房市复苏是美国经济劲道的泉源之一。 追踪全美20大都会区的史坦普/凯斯-席勒(S&P/Case-Shiller)房价指数较去年9月攀升3%，高于8月的2%，并和彭博信息访调29名经济学家的预估中值相符。第三季房价同比攀涨3.6%，也创2010年第二季以来最大涨幅。 史坦普指数委员会主席布利泽(David Blitzer)在声明稿中表示，”房价已连续六个月稳定攀升，可以说我们现在正处于房市复苏期”。 劳动市场好转连同历来最低的房贷利率，都有助于支撑房市购屋需求，也促成营建业愈来愈乐观的现象。在与此同时，联准会决策官员继续推动的货币宽松措施，也成为全美房市复苏和经济扩张的支柱。 康州瑞银证券公司(UBS Securities)经济学家康明斯(Kevin Cummins)在报告出炉前表示，在就业渐有起色的情况下，?#20320;可以见到家庭情况受影响，人们变得宽裕一些，愿意外出试水温。物价稳定和房价攀升的间接效应，正扩散到支出和更广泛的信心?#12290; 彭博信息调查汇整的预估值，介于上涨2.2%和3.6%之间。史坦普/凯斯-席勒指数是依据三个月均价 统计，代表9月的数据会受7月与8月的买卖影响。 这份报告还包含季度全国数据。第三季涵盖全美的房价较去年同期上涨3.6%，涨幅优于第二季的1.6%。若未经季节性调整，全美房价较前季上涨2.2%，但若考虑季节性变动因素，房价季涨1.1%。 若调整季节性变动因素，9月房价和前月相比上涨0.4%，20大都会区中18地呈现上涨。亚特兰大和圣地亚哥都上涨1.7%，芝加哥房价下跌0.7%，佛州天帕持平。未经调整房价月涨0.3%。 指数中20座城市中18座出现年涨幅，以凤凰城大涨20.4%居首。纽约和芝加哥房价都较去年同期降低。年比纪录始于2001年。
725e565591c1a5f9dc074b4eb7f29a3ddd3fc646.translatedText: U.S. metropolitan housing prices rose to a new high. U.S. metropolitan housing prices rose at a record annual rate in September, hitting a new high since July 2010, showing that the recovery of the housing market is one of the sources of U.S. economic strength. The S&P/Case-Shiller home price index, which tracks the nation's 20 largest metropolitan areas, climbed 3% from September last year, up from 2% in August and in line with the median forecast of 29 economists surveyed by Bloomberg Intelligence. House prices rose 3.6% year-on-year in the third quarter, the largest increase since the second quarter of 2010. David Blitzer, chairman of the S&P Index Committee, said in a statement, "House prices have been rising steadily for six consecutive months, and it can be said that we are now in a housing market recovery period." The improving labor market and historically low mortgage interest rates have helped support demand for home purchases and contributed to growing optimism in the construction industry. At the same time, the monetary easing measures continued to be promoted by Federal Reserve policymakers have also become the pillar of the recovery of the U.S. housing market and economic expansion. Kevin Cummins, an economist at UBS Securities in Connecticut, said before the report was released that as employment gradually improves, we can see that family situations are affected and people become more affluent and are willing to go out and test the water temperature. The indirect effects of stable prices and rising home prices are spreading to spending and broader confidence? #12290; Estimates compiled by a Bloomberg Intelligence survey ranged from a rise of 2.2% to 3.6%. The S&P/Case-Shiller index is based on three-month average prices, which means that September's data will be affected by transactions in July and August. The report also includes quarterly national data. House prices across the United States rose 3.6% in the third quarter compared with the same period last year, which was better than the 1.6% increase in the second quarter. Without seasonal adjustment, U.S. home prices rose 2.2% from the previous quarter, but if seasonal changes were taken into account, home prices rose 1.1% quarter-to-quarter. Adjusting for seasonal factors, house prices increased by 0.4% in September compared with the previous month, with 18 of the 20 metropolitan areas showing increases. Atlanta and San Diego both rose 1.7%, Chicago prices fell 0.7%, and Temperature, Florida, was flat. Unadjusted house prices rose 0.3% monthly. 18 of the 20 cities in the index saw year-on-year growth, led by Phoenix, which rose 20.4%. Home prices in New York and Chicago are both lower than this time last year. The year-over-year record began in 2001.

fe012dc5e2f6e9b7e196bfbb35ab121183760f48.sourceText: （崔增祁供稿）四月廿日，一亇春光明媚的早晨，一些华人来到了秀丽的南山北麓，这里是Arizona Law Enforcement Academy 的所在地，他们是报名来参加凤凰城侨联组织的警察经验的一日培训班的学员。这是专门和华人联系的警官查理斯为我们按排的活动，他为大家准备了具有美味的墨西哥特色的风味早歺。简单而风趣的自我介绍以后，一名有十七年经验的警官向学员们介绍了学院的简要概况。这里是警察培训的基地，夲州百分之五十的警察都是经过这个学院的严格培训经攷试合格才能従事警察工作，每三年还要回校进修一次。然后讲述了在与歹徒相遇时人体内各个部位的生理反应和变化，以及警察在什么情况下才可以开枪的常识。
fe012dc5e2f6e9b7e196bfbb35ab121183760f48.translatedText: (Contributed by Cui Zengqi) On April 20th, on a bright spring morning, some Chinese people came to the beautiful northern foothills of Nanshan Mountain. Here is the Arizona Law Enforcement Academy They are students who signed up to participate in the one-day police experience training course organized by the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation. This is an activity arranged for us by Charles, the police officer who specializes in contacting the Chinese. He prepared a delicious breakfast with Mexican characteristics for everyone. After a simple and humorous self-introduction, a police officer with 17 years of experience gave the students a brief overview of the academy. This is the base for police training. Fifty percent of the police in Dizhou have undergone rigorous training in this academy and passed the exam before they can work as police officers. They have to go back to school every three years for further studies. Then he talked about the physiological reactions and changes of various parts of the human body when encountering gangsters, as well as the common sense of the police under what circumstances they can shoot.

d125d6e6123bb439c6a284a6d67fa45424c328e8.translatedText: Some students returned from target practice

a25b16c80adcfb9da907f84fac9a344507303ab3.sourceText: 接下来，分组由不同的教官带领大家实地演习。学员们穿上 了全身防护的的服装进入了训练。当一亇歹徒持刀和你对峙的时矦你如何制服他？当歹徒持抢时你应该何时开枪？如何对待持刀要自杀的人？在汽车追逐中，歹徒弃车逃跑你该怎样捕捉歹徒？一个个只是在电影中看到过的惊险塲面出现在你眼前，如今你身临其境，拿着有子弹的枪（这时是橡皮子弹）要去设法制服歹徒。怎么办？在这短暂的一刻，智慧、反应、判断、集于一身，这时你身上会出现一种从未有过的兴奋的感觉，只有警察这个职业才有的感觉。
a25b16c80adcfb9da907f84fac9a344507303ab3.translatedText: Next, the groups were led by different instructors to conduct field exercises. The trainees put on full-body protective clothing and entered the training. When a gangster confronts you with a knife, how do you subdue him? When should you shoot when a criminal is holding a robbery? How to deal with someone who wants to commit suicide with a knife? In a car chase, the gangster abandons the car and runs away. How do you catch the gangster? Thrilling scenes that you have only seen in movies appear before your eyes. Now you are on the scene, holding a loaded gun (rubber bullets in this case) to try to subdue the gangsters. what to do? In this brief moment, wisdom, reaction, and judgment are all integrated into one. At this time, you will have an unprecedented feeling of excitement, a feeling that can only be found in the police profession.

0a7837061bf706492f8ca815e791bf0e498b60b8.sourceText: 最精彩的还是实弹射撃。教官们简单示范了来福枪、手枪和不同的子弹的射程和作用后，每个学员用手枪实弹射撃。大部份学员都是第一次拿起真枪，心里不免慌张，心跳加快，手在发抖，但是教官手把手的教你，并不断给予鼓励，最后每人都髙兴地拿着自己的成绩单（纪录了枪眼的打靶纸）和打剩的子弹壳回家向亲人和朋友们报告：今天我也打枪了！这一天过得真有意义，真精彩！
0a7837061bf706492f8ca815e791bf0e498b60b8.translatedText: The most exciting thing is the live ammunition shooting. After the instructors briefly demonstrated the range and effects of rifles, pistols and different bullets, each student fired live ammunition from the pistol. It was the first time for most of the students to pick up a real gun. They were panicking, their heartbeats were racing, and their hands were shaking. However, the instructor taught you step by step and continued to encourage you. In the end, everyone happily took their report card (the target paper recording the bullet holes) and the remaining bullet shells home to report to their relatives and friends: I also shot a gun today! This day was so meaningful and wonderful!

894220fdcd491c09ec024d28d1d8b19e5890b013.sourceText: 当人们怀着兴奋而激动的心情离开警校时，许多学员问了一个同样的问题，我们可不可以再来？有没有进一歩的培训班？回答是可以，有。人们期待着侨联再组织一些类似的活动，使我们更好地融入美国社会。
894220fdcd491c09ec024d28d1d8b19e5890b013.translatedText: When people left the police academy with excitement and excitement, many students asked the same question, can we come back again? Are there any further training courses? The answer is yes, yes. People are looking forward to the Overseas Chinese Federation organizing some similar activities to help us better integrate into American society.

530b968a328d288d2f5219e3366a043aef158ed2.sourceText: 服兵役及政庇绿卡问答 １．我儿子初中就来美国书﹐现在将要大学毕业了﹐是美国公民﹐享有台湾及美国双重国籍﹐如果他持美国护照入台湾﹐他还要服兵役吗﹖ 答﹕以下我将转述台北经文处的网站消息﹕ 依据外交部于民国100年6月17日部授领一字第1005117226号函示，凡具有中华民国国籍在台曾设有户籍役男于役龄期间均有履行兵役之义务，无论是否户籍迁出国外或另有其他国国籍，其入出境台湾地区应持中华民国护照；持外国护照入境之侨民役男仍以其入出境纪录列计在台居停留期间，持外国护照入境未具侨民身分者虽具双重国籍仍以一般役男列管，依法应征兵处理时，即应限制其出境至履行兵役义务时止。旅居国外役男倘持美国护照入境中华民国时，出境仍应受兵役管制，尚未履行兵役者凡经查获依法均须服完兵役后方能出境。 ２．问：我于２００１年偷渡来美，在机场被捕，并以同性恋受歧视、迫害为由，成功获得政庇绿卡。但由于父母的压力和中国传统的风俗习惯，我于200５年结婚，并育有２名子女，因为我是家中独子，父母年迈体衰，现在想入籍进而申请父母来美，以便照顾。 我的问题是： 由于我是以同性恋为由获得绿卡，却又育有２名子女，移民官会不会因此多加盘问？会不会因此取消我的绿卡？如果不填写子女的数据，移民局会知道吗？.现在申请入籍，需要多久才会通知面谈？申请父母又要多长时间呢？ 答：填写入籍表格时你必须按事实填写。一般取得绿卡后，除非当事人在申请绿卡时有欺骗、诈欺或不法行为，该当事人的绿卡，才会被取消。依你的情况，当初申请绿卡时，是一位同性恋者，若事实的演变，你不再是同性恋者，并不违反你最初申请的事实。 同时，移民局要取消绿卡时，也须向移民法院提出证明，你当初申请时不是同性恋者，若纯粹以你目前有２个子女的事实，来断定你当年并非同性恋者，在法律上应该也是无法成立的。.申请公民入籍时间，一般大约须等待４个月。公民申请父母来美，大概１年左右﹐并无名额限制。
530b968a328d288d2f5219e3366a043aef158ed2.translatedText: Q&A on Military Service and Political Asylum Green Card 1. My son came to the United States to study in junior high school. Now he is about to graduate from college. He is a U.S. citizen and enjoys dual citizenship of Taiwan and the United States. If he enters Taiwan with a U.S. passport, will he still have to perform military service? Answer: Below I will paraphrase the information from the Taipei Scripture Office’s website: According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Letter No. 1005117226 dated June 17, 1999, all male military servicemen with the nationality of the Republic of China who have registered residence in Taiwan are obliged to perform military service during the service period. Regardless of whether their residence registration has moved abroad or they have other nationalities, they enter and leave Taiwan. The area must hold a passport of the Republic of China; overseas military servicemen who enter with foreign passports will still be listed as staying in Taiwan based on their entry and exit records. Those who enter with foreign passports but do not have overseas national status are still classified as general servicemen despite having dual nationality. When they are subject to military conscription according to law, they should be restricted from leaving the country until they fulfill their military service obligations. If male military servicemen living abroad enter the Republic of China with a U.S. passport, their exit from the country is still subject to military service control. Those who have not yet performed military service must complete their military service before leaving the country if they are found and are found to have completed their military service in accordance with the law. 2． Question: I came to the United States illegally in 2001 and was arrested at the airport. I successfully obtained a political asylum green card on the grounds that homosexuality was subject to discrimination and persecution. However, due to the pressure from my parents and traditional Chinese customs, I got married in 2005 and had two children. Because I am an only child and my parents are old and infirm. Now I want to naturalize and apply for my parents to come to the United States to take care of them. My question is: Since I obtained a green card on the grounds of homosexuality and have two children, will the immigration officer question me more? Will my green card be canceled because of this? If I don’t fill in my child’s data, will the Immigration Bureau know? .If I apply for naturalization now, how long will it take to be notified of the interview? How long does it take to apply as a parent? A: When filling out the naturalization form you must fill it out factually. Generally, after obtaining a green card, the green card of the person will be canceled unless the person commits deception, fraud or illegal behavior when applying for the green card. According to your situation, you were a homosexual when you first applied for a green card. If the facts change and you are no longer a homosexual, it does not violate the facts of your initial application. At the same time, when the Immigration Bureau wants to cancel your green card, it must also provide proof to the Immigration Court that you were not a homosexual when you originally applied. If it is purely based on the fact that you currently have two children, it is legally untenable to conclude that you were not a homosexual. .The time to apply for naturalization usually takes about 4 months. It takes about one year for citizens to apply for their parents to come to the United States, and there is no quota limit.

6217599ada42f138fbf36f0e64c77e7b7aa54601.sourceText: 2013年12月15日喜福会在老四川新店举行圣诞聚餐，超过五十多位的来宾共聚一堂。大家在一起分享2013年的收获和老四川的美食。
6217599ada42f138fbf36f0e64c77e7b7aa54601.translatedText: On December 15, 2013, the Joy Luck Club held a Christmas dinner at its new store in Old Sichuan. More than fifty guests gathered together. Let’s share the harvest of 2013 and the delicacies of old Sichuan.

b2a63db16a21e1cd774d62009ecb0e51ba663fb4.sourceText: 参加活动的朋友大都来自中国大陆江浙一带。他们在凤凰城从事不同行业，有的做贸易，有的做金融，有的是工程师，有的是教授。平时都忙着自己的工作和家庭，难得有这样的机会，聊聊天，叙叙旧。活动把大家分成三桌，每张桌子上的朋友都相谈甚欢。
b2a63db16a21e1cd774d62009ecb0e51ba663fb4.translatedText: Most of the friends participating in the event are from Jiangsu and Zhejiang in mainland China. They are engaged in different industries in Phoenix, some are in trade, some are in finance, some are engineers, and some are professors. I am usually busy with my work and family, so it is rare to have such an opportunity to chat and reminisce about the past. The event divided everyone into three tables, and friends at each table had a great time chatting with each other.

dadb35da8c2e572f678eb449d0a590e025fd111c.sourceText: 活动结束，大家仍然依依不舍。记者还收到参与者的邮件，他表示非常开心，在聚会中看到那么多很久不见的老朋友，感谢组织者的努力，给大家一个欢聚的机会。希望大家在新年幸福快乐，来年再聚。
dadb35da8c2e572f678eb449d0a590e025fd111c.translatedText: The event is over, and everyone is still reluctant to leave. The reporter also received an email from a participant. He expressed that he was very happy to see so many old friends whom he had not seen for a long time at the party. He thanked the organizers for their efforts in giving everyone an opportunity to get together. I hope you all have a happy New Year and see you again next year.

708fb9b3204259ed5ee83f4f892def885876e66c.sourceText: 中国冷处理东京会议 东京–两名中国高层官员将不会出席本周在东京举行的世界金融会议，这一不加掩饰…
708fb9b3204259ed5ee83f4f892def885876e66c.translatedText: > China cold-handles Tokyo meeting Tokyo – Two top Chinese officials will not attend this week’s world financial conference in Tokyo, in a thinly veiled move…

6928326cb84bc0fa8fd716cecb0679528d0e0edb.sourceText: 东京–两名中国高层官员将不会出席本周在东京举行的世界金融会议，这一不加掩饰的拒斥之举是为了表示中国不满日本对两国岛屿主权争端的处理方式。
6928326cb84bc0fa8fd716cecb0679528d0e0edb.translatedText: > Tokyo – Two top Chinese officials will not attend this week’s world financial conference in Tokyo, a thinly veiled rebuff to express China’s dissatisfaction with Japan’s handling of the two countries’ dispute over island sovereignty.

ccf700356fa77f157e85cc90ff839aa54d062f2e.sourceText: 本周三，日本官方确认中方已经在最后一刻做出上述决定，同时，据日本的一家通讯社报道，日本政府可能会首次正式承认中国也对东海海域这些无人居住的岛屿(日本称尖阁诸岛，中国称钓鱼岛)提出了主权要求，试图以此缓和两国之间的僵持局面。
ccf700356fa77f157e85cc90ff839aa54d062f2e.translatedText: On Wednesday, Japanese officials confirmed that China had made the above-mentioned decision at the last minute. At the same time, according to a Japanese news agency, the Japanese government may officially recognize for the first time that China has also made sovereignty claims to these uninhabited islands in the East China Sea (called the Senkaku Islands in Japan and the Diaoyu Islands in China) in an attempt to ease the stalemate between the two countries.

e42f0beed91563a460a5cd2e203136ef4e0dc856.sourceText: 中国财政部长和央行行长将不会出席国际货币基金组织(International Monetary Fund)和世界银行(World Bank)的年度会议。中国的这一决定是一个最新的信号，表明高度不稳定的领土争端正在对中日之间极其广泛的经济联系造成损害。中国和日本分别是世界第二和第三大经济体。
e42f0beed91563a460a5cd2e203136ef4e0dc856.translatedText: China’s finance minister and central bank governor will not attend the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank. China’s decision is the latest sign that a highly volatile territorial dispute is taking a toll on China and Japan’s far-reaching economic ties. China and Japan are the world's second and third largest economies respectively.

97ba4883022a4eca7abc092b5c8609d261aab02f.sourceText: 上个月，日本政府从身为日本公民的岛主手中购买了五座岛屿当中的三座，两国之间的紧张气氛由此逐渐加剧。购岛之举引发了中国各地激烈的游行示威活动，抗议者攻击日本企业，甚至还攻击日本品牌的汽车及其车主。
97ba4883022a4eca7abc092b5c8609d261aab02f.translatedText: Last month, tensions between the two countries increased when the Japanese government purchased three of the five islands from their owners, who are Japanese citizens. The island purchase triggered fierce demonstrations across China, with protesters attacking Japanese companies and even Japanese-brand cars and their owners.

5908bc7fc1acb596f1c4a24b1e54209bfe9fe72f.sourceText: 对日本而言，目前局势的风险尤其高。长期停滞的日本经济越来越依赖中国，因为中国既是日本的生产基地，又是日本商品的高增长市场。由于中国消费者对日本产品的抵制，周三，日本汽车制造商报告称，日本车在中国的销售量出现大幅度下滑。之后，日本的主要股指下跌了2%。
5908bc7fc1acb596f1c4a24b1e54209bfe9fe72f.translatedText: The current situation is particularly risky for Japan. Japan's long-stagnant economy has become increasingly dependent on China, as China is both Japan's production base and a high-growth market for Japanese goods. Japanese automakers reported a sharp decline in sales of Japanese cars in China on Wednesday amid a boycott of Japanese products by Chinese consumers. Afterwards, Japan's main stock index fell 2%.

16532920017e7ae45ea5049ae241f50203b9352d.sourceText: 日本官员称，他们原本预计中国财政部长谢旭人和中国人民银行行长周小川将会出席此次东京会议，与会者还将包括来自180个国家的财政领袖。他们说，本周早些时候，中方突然告知他们，中国代表团将由两名级别较低的官员领衔，一名是央行副行长，另一名是财政部副部长。
16532920017e7ae45ea5049ae241f50203b9352d.translatedText: Japanese officials said they had expected Chinese Finance Minister Xie Xu and People's Bank of China Governor Zhou Xiaochuan to attend the Tokyo meeting, which would also include financial leaders from 180 countries. They said they were suddenly informed earlier this week that the Chinese delegation would be led by two lower-ranking officials, a deputy governor of the central bank and a deputy finance minister.

e4540d97228eefaa7f189abd8f7d5f3ebf917e8d.sourceText: 官员还说，中国工商银行和中国银行等中国四大国有银行的高管都会缺席此次东京会议。
e4540d97228eefaa7f189abd8f7d5f3ebf917e8d.translatedText: Officials also said that executives from China's four major state-owned banks, including the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China and Bank of China, will be absent from the Tokyo meeting.

6943502727e80c7bc028a8eddaa18c0a730f2c25.sourceText: 他们表示自己不清楚中国官员为何取消参会行程，同时拒绝就该决定是否与岛屿争端有关发表意见。不过，日本外相玄叶光一郎(Koichiro Gemba)表示，这个决定”非常令人失望”。
6943502727e80c7bc028a8eddaa18c0a730f2c25.translatedText: They said they did not know why Chinese officials canceled their trip to the meeting, and refused to comment on whether the decision was related to the island dispute. However, Japanese Foreign Minister Koichiro Gemba said the decision was "very disappointing."

4bc9353cd338ffbccdc0663e0d88b9507db708f0.sourceText: 玄叶光一郎告诉记者，”我并不认为，中国会由此获益，想想吧，国际社会将会如何解读这种行为。”
4bc9353cd338ffbccdc0663e0d88b9507db708f0.translatedText: Genba Koichiro told reporters, "I don't think China will benefit from this. Think about how the international community will interpret this behavior."

eb374ab9cf6edab78520b3023f49f76c765f4ae0.sourceText: 日本的政治分析人士称，中国之所以更改既定安排，目的是利用其日益增长的经济影响力来对日本首相野田佳彦(Yoshihiko Noda)施压，迫使后者做出让步。他们说，从两年前开始，中国就逐渐表现出了利用经济施压的意愿，当时，中国停止向日本出口稀土，迫使日本释放了在钓鱼岛附近拘留的中国渔船船长。稀土是日本电子工业的重要原材料之一。
eb374ab9cf6edab78520b3023f49f76c765f4ae0.translatedText: Japanese political analysts said that the reason why China changed the established arrangements was to use its growing economic influence to pressure Japanese Prime Minister Yoshihiko Noda and force the latter to make concessions. They say China has gradually shown a willingness to use economic pressure starting two years ago, when it stopped exporting rare earths to Japan and forced Japan to release a Chinese fishing captain detained near the Senkaku Islands. Rare earths are one of the important raw materials for the Japanese electronics industry.

37a9dbd45b73fe174b82c03ec988804755b251af.sourceText: ”为了操控日本，中国正在把领土争端和财政事宜联系起来，”位于京都的同志社大学(Doshisha University)国际关系教授村田晃嗣(Koji Murata)说。”中国所传达的信息就是，它已经做好准备，要利用自己在国际经济舞台上的影响力来向日本施压。”
37a9dbd45b73fe174b82c03ec988804755b251af.translatedText: "China is linking territorial disputes and financial matters in order to control Japan," said Koji Murata, a professor of international relations at Doshisha University in Kyoto. "The message China has conveyed is that it is ready to use its influence on the international economic stage to put pressure on Japan."

b8e9253f76bb349cd59dbf81d14512f461d776b9.sourceText: 中国还通过另外一种方式向日本施压，从上月开始，他们几乎每天都派未携带武器装备的海监船到争议岛屿附近的海域巡逻。日本的反应则是派出几十艘海上警卫舰艇，到这些位于冲绳和中国之间的岛屿周围巡逻。
b8e9253f76bb349cd59dbf81d14512f461d776b9.translatedText: China has also put pressure on Japan in another way. Since last month, they have sent unarmed maritime surveillance ships to patrol the waters near the disputed islands almost every day. Japan responded by sending dozens of coast guard ships to patrol around the islands, which lie between Okinawa and China.

2543ec7d0d09650e8c81d921d3b8bc5411fda54a.sourceText: 这些岛屿比礁石大不了多少，不过，岛屿周围的海床据信蕴藏着丰富的石油和天然气资源。在中国，恢复岛屿主权成为了广受拥护的爱国诉求，中方认为，日本通过野蛮的帝国主义扩张非法掠夺了这些岛屿，那次扩张过程还驱使它在20世纪30年代入侵中国。
2543ec7d0d09650e8c81d921d3b8bc5411fda54a.translatedText: The islands are little larger than reefs, but the seabed around them is believed to be rich in oil and gas. Restoring sovereignty over the islands has become a widely held patriotic demand in China, which believes Japan illegally plundered the islands through its barbaric imperialist expansion that drove it to invade China in the 1930s.

f6ccd78ce4c447beefb4d788e63371d17d0a25c9.sourceText: 日本在上个月宣布购买岛屿，目的是阻止推行民族主义的东京都知事购买岛屿，以便缓和紧张局势。中国却认为，日本的举动是为了加强对岛屿的控制。
f6ccd78ce4c447beefb4d788e63371d17d0a25c9.translatedText: Japan announced its purchase of the islands last month in an effort to prevent the nationalist governor of Tokyo from buying the islands and to ease tensions. China believes that Japan's move is to strengthen its control over the islands.

436aa7f24448a72f8086c7ae886563aad7b78d84.sourceText: 周三，日本共同社(Kyodo News Agency)报道称，日本政府可能会改变官方拒绝承认存在领土争议的态度，中国官员长期以来对这个立场感到非常恼火。这篇报道或许是一个信号，说明日本可能很快就会采取缓解局势的措施。报道称，日本一方面会坚持否认存在争议，一方面也会做出微小让步，承认中国也提出了主权要求。在此之前，日本政府一直拒绝承认这一点。
436aa7f24448a72f8086c7ae886563aad7b78d84.translatedText: On Wednesday, Kyodo News Agency reported that the Japanese government may change its official refusal to acknowledge the existence of territorial disputes, a stance that Chinese officials have long chafed at. This report may be a signal that Japan may soon take measures to ease the situation. According to reports, Japan will insist on denying the existence of disputes on the one hand, and will make small concessions on the other hand to admit that China has also made sovereignty claims. Until then, the Japanese government had refused to acknowledge this.

616e9f3e5d7adb52ec1c0346fab1ac460ddad52a.sourceText: 周三，在北京的例行新闻发布会上，当被问及日本媒体的报道时，中国外交部发言人洪磊暗示，中国在一定程度上有意谈判。
616e9f3e5d7adb52ec1c0346fab1ac460ddad52a.translatedText: When asked about the Japanese media reports at a regular news conference in Beijing on Wednesday, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman Hong Lei suggested that China was interested in negotiating to a certain extent.

173f40e95fa535ab0b086cfc05dfdba0ccb89387.sourceText: 他说，”日方必须正视现实、承认争议、纠正错误、回到谈判解决问题的道路上来。”
173f40e95fa535ab0b086cfc05dfdba0ccb89387.translatedText: He said, "Japan must face reality, admit disputes, correct mistakes, and return to the path of negotiating to solve problems."

c92d5327b7651dda2e8cfafe9ee483ad7a3918ef.sourceText: Keith Bradsher自香港有报道贡献。
c92d5327b7651dda2e8cfafe9ee483ad7a3918ef.translatedText: Keith Bradsher contributed reporting from Hong Kong.

338d5bebb5bc0277f8fe50958644311595e7b6bc.sourceText: 夲月十四日下午六时在凤城中心的Copper Blues大酒店举行了一场由市政府官员和各界约二百多位人士参加的盛大的酒会，欢送前市政委员Mattox先生圆满完成夲届工作。市长Phil Gordon和即将上任新市长Greg Stanton分别致词，表彰和感谢Mattox先生在夲仼工作上作出的辛劳和贡献，Mattox先生致以答词，大家一齐举杯报以掌声和祝福。
338d5bebb5bc0277f8fe50958644311595e7b6bc.translatedText: A grand cocktail party attended by city officials and more than 200 people from all walks of life was held at the Copper Blues Hotel in the center of Fengcheng at 6 pm on the 14th of January to bid farewell to former city councilor Mr. Mattox for successfully completing his term of work. Mayor Phil Gordon and the incoming new mayor Greg Stanton delivered speeches respectively, commending and thanking Mr. Mattox for his hard work and contribution to the work. Mr. Mattox gave a reply, and everyone raised their glasses in applause and blessings.

92eef8312eb1785a7cb8d85789a623e4a2e6cbd7.sourceText: 接着主持人宣佈由美中文化艺术交流协会的古雅瑜女士、李成先生和陈志钢先生三位代表把画家李成先生（又名范融先生）的一幅骏马图赠送给Mattox先生，并祝他马到成功再创辉煌，Mattox先生十分高兴地热情地和三位代表一一握手，并致词表示衷心的感谢。羸得了与会人士一阵热烈的掌声和欢呼声，在频频地举杯中酒会始终扬溢着愉快、温馨、友好的气氛。
92eef8312eb1785a7cb8d85789a623e4a2e6cbd7.translatedText: Then the host announced that three representatives from the US-China Cultural and Art Exchange Association, Ms. Gu Yayu, Mr. Li Cheng and Mr. Chen Zhigang, would present a horse painting by the painter Mr. Li Cheng (also known as Mr. Fan Rong) to Mr. Mattox, and wished him immediate success and greater glories. Mr. Mattox was very happy to shake hands with the three representatives one by one and gave a speech to express his heartfelt thanks. Lei received a burst of warm applause and cheers from the attendees. With frequent toasts, the reception was always filled with a pleasant, warm and friendly atmosphere.

a58e9599eadae44b731534b08fc2405bfc71c629.translatedText: Photography technology serves the concept of photography - Lecture by photographer Liu Senyun (photo set) The well-known Taiwanese photographer Liu Senyun held a wonderful photography lecture at Mesa Community College at 1:30 pm on March 23 at the warm invitation of the Asian Asian Photography Association of Asia and Phoenix Chinese School...

e978a64eed300dd6d7943a223987c953741ed262.sourceText: 台湾知名摄影家刘森云老师在亚省亚裔摄影协会与凤凰城中文学校的热情邀请下，于三月二十三日下午一点三十分在美莎社区大学举办一场精彩的摄影讲座。”如今的摄影已经不再是数码设备的竞争，而是摄影师摄影理念的竞争”刘森云老师开始讲座的第一句话，就让所有的来宾耳目一新。 刘森云老师通过他在亚利桑那，美国其他城市，以及台湾拍摄的作品，与摄影爱好者共同探讨利用构图，采光等手段来表现摄影者的理念。
e978a64eed300dd6d7943a223987c953741ed262.translatedText: The well-known Taiwanese photographer Mr. Liu Senyun was warmly invited by the Asian Asian Photography Association of Asia and Phoenix Chinese School. "Today's photography is no longer a competition of digital equipment, but a competition of photographers' photography concepts." The first words of Teacher Liu Senyun's lecture were refreshing to all the guests. Through his works shot in Arizona, other cities in the United States, and Taiwan, Mr. Liu Senyun discusses with photography enthusiasts how to use composition, lighting and other means to express the photographer's ideas.

f743eab597b7c94f1946ff62f1200cfc37c0bc96.sourceText: 刘老师（左一）讲述在北美拍摄的一张海景图
f743eab597b7c94f1946ff62f1200cfc37c0bc96.translatedText: Teacher Liu (first from the left) talks about a seascape picture taken in North America

4cae8cdda856e9fc0936d8ec8fceaa7d8c2aa223.sourceText: 这张照片的独特之处是清晰的看到海浪的水纹和沙滩水纹，相互交错，交织缠绕的画面。通常摄影爱好者都喜欢在沙滩上拍海景。这张照片是在大桥上拍海景，不是水平的角度，而是垂直的角度。刘老师向我们展示了不同的视角，来看海。照片上看到的是点，线，面形成的海景。
4cae8cdda856e9fc0936d8ec8fceaa7d8c2aa223.translatedText: The uniqueness of this photo is that you can clearly see the water patterns of the waves and the water patterns on the beach, intertwined and intertwined. Usually photography enthusiasts like to take pictures of seascapes on the beach. This photo was taken of the sea view from the bridge, not from a horizontal angle, but from a vertical angle. Teacher Liu showed us different perspectives to see the sea. What you see in the photo is the seascape formed by points, lines and surfaces.

2f27ca789d85d133718650c1f18c21b058c499d1.sourceText: 介绍北美一City Hall的建筑
2f27ca789d85d133718650c1f18c21b058c499d1.translatedText: Introducing the architecture of a City Hall in North America

6ea7336265b071d21a864c7431ee468ea3bcab0f.sourceText: 这是一个大广角拍摄的建筑内景，拱门形成的透视效果，极具空间感。这是出自建筑专业摄影师刘云森老师之手。让来宾特别感到惊讶的是，大广角不仅把空间感表现的淋漓尽致，而且还未出现物体的变形。刘老师说，是因为他站的角度是在二楼，这个角度可以拉直变形的线条。同时大厅中间，走动的模糊的人像，更是突出了空间的对比，为这个照片起到了画龙点睛的作用。
6ea7336265b071d21a864c7431ee468ea3bcab0f.translatedText: This is a large wide-angle shot of the interior of the building. The perspective effect formed by the arches gives a great sense of space. This is the work of Mr. Liu Yunsen, a professional architectural photographer. What particularly surprised the guests was that the large wide angle not only fully expressed the sense of space, but also did not cause the deformation of objects. Teacher Liu said it was because the angle he was standing on was on the second floor. This angle could straighten the deformed lines. At the same time, in the middle of the hall, the blurred portraits walking around highlight the contrast of the space and serve as the finishing touch to this photo.

ff40c5b22339b433b47c84b1c4b3003aa8e851b6.sourceText: 慢速和快速拍摄都会产生非常不同的效果。这个快速拍摄的照片，如果无限放大，就能看到非常精美的线条。快速拍摄，把水的灵动，跳跃展现地一览无余，拍活了。而慢速拍摄则把运动的水，拍得柔美，梦幻。相同的对象，不同的拍摄手段能表现水的不同品质和视觉情绪。
ff40c5b22339b433b47c84b1c4b3003aa8e851b6.translatedText: Slow-speed and fast-speed shooting will produce very different effects. If you zoom in infinitely on this quick photo, you can see very beautiful lines. Quickly shoot, you can see the agility and jumping of the water at a glance, and the photos are vivid. The slow-speed shooting makes the moving water look soft and dreamy. The same object and different shooting methods can express different qualities and visual emotions of water.

6c371b6b8331e9a77202aa7f9058910abd3b5bee.sourceText: 刘老师的讲座就如他的作品一样朴实真挚，让摄影爱好者通过照片，清晰地体会，拍摄技术为摄影理念服务这一概念。
6c371b6b8331e9a77202aa7f9058910abd3b5bee.translatedText: >Teacher Liu’s lectures are as simple and sincere as his works, allowing photography enthusiasts to clearly understand the concept of photography technology serving the concept of photography through photos.

a85ef07ff5fbbc86f018eec87ce182c18ccc440f.sourceText: 这是刘森云老师第三次来到凤凰城，当记者问及来了凤凰城这么多次都有什么不同的感受时，刘老师微笑的说次次都不同。真正应验了那句话：摄影师眼中总是有一个不同的世界。我们期待亚省摄影协会给摄影爱好者们带来更多更精彩的专业讲座。
a85ef07ff5fbbc86f018eec87ce182c18ccc440f.translatedText: This is the third time Teacher Liu Senyun has come to Phoenix City. When the reporter asked about the different feelings after coming to Phoenix City so many times, Teacher Liu smiled and said that it was different every time. The saying truly comes true: There is always a different world in the eyes of a photographer. We look forward to the Alberta Photography Association bringing more exciting professional lectures to photography enthusiasts.

1d4623751684cbbfdb186a29b9babb73bc2d7c9b.sourceText: 刘森云 1953年出生于台湾苗栗 深爱大自然，从事高山向导20余年。专业建筑摄影25年。
1d4623751684cbbfdb186a29b9babb73bc2d7c9b.translatedText: Liu Senyun was born in Miaoli, Taiwan in 1953. He deeply loves nature and has been a mountain guide for more than 20 years. Professional architectural photography for 25 years.

3e625d92791a2be4559858c8b65593e27fb42335.sourceText: 第三章: 三个设立州政府的城市
3e625d92791a2be4559858c8b65593e27fb42335.translatedText: Chapter 3: Three Cities with State Governments

78a54e2f90140618dc7aabb244ff5224c4f3cc23.sourceText: 亚利桑那州的首府曾有过三次的搬迁。1864年，普雷斯科特（Prescott）被指定为亚利桑那领地的首府。1867年，州政府移至图森（Tucson）。十年后的1877年，州政府搬回普雷斯科特（Prescott）。从1889年起，凤凰城（Phoenix）成为亚利桑那州州政府的所在地。 [74]
78a54e2f90140618dc7aabb244ff5224c4f3cc23.translatedText: The capital of Arizona has been moved three times. In 1864, Prescott was designated the capital of the Arizona Territory. In 1867, state government moved to Tucson. Ten years later, in 1877, state government moved back to Prescott. Since 1889, Phoenix has been the seat of Arizona's state government. [74]

af9daa826f25d7e721e95c827bcedcd1647276b1.sourceText: 第一个设立首府的城市：普雷斯科特 （Prescott ）
af9daa826f25d7e721e95c827bcedcd1647276b1.translatedText: >The first city to establish a capital: Prescott

cc6b7a55c464915399c2a2c9d360a3a9275202d7.sourceText: 新侨民可能不太熟识普雷斯科特（Prescott）。笔者曾探访过这个小城。那里有连绵的群山和辽阔的牧场，有清澈的溪流和湛蓝的湖泊，炎夏的气温要比凤凰城低20度（华氏），是个休闲避署的好地方。
cc6b7a55c464915399c2a2c9d360a3a9275202d7.translatedText: New expats may not be familiar with Prescott. The author has visited this small town. There are rolling mountains and vast pastures, clear streams and blue lakes. The temperature in hot summer is 20 degrees (Fahrenheit) lower than that of Phoenix. It is a good place for leisure and escape.

09d838809c74f499335b07a1407c34850a052773.sourceText: 普雷斯科特（Prescott）是一座历史气息浓郁的城市，在Sharlot Hall博物馆，有社会和自然风貌的文化中心，拥有11座新、老的建筑和历史遗址，还有文物收集和保存研究中心。一年一度的轮换和永久性的展览，用以介绍从更新世时代（14,000年前）到现在的历史和文化。
09d838809c74f499335b07a1407c34850a052773.translatedText: Prescott is a city rich in history. In the Sharlot Hall Museum, there is a cultural center with social and natural features, 11 new and old buildings and historical sites, and a cultural relic collection and preservation research center. Annual rotating and permanent exhibitions present history and culture from the Pleistocene Epoch (14,000 years ago) to the present.

cd3a372a05eff1d1b00c998b4269b8883613e27b.sourceText: 美国在十九世纪完成了全国铁路网，二十世纪完成了全国公路网。所以现在从凤凰城去普雷斯科特（Prescott），只须通过I-17州际公路转69号州际公路，汽车行程约两小时就能到达。
cd3a372a05eff1d1b00c998b4269b8883613e27b.translatedText: The United States completed the national railway network in the 19th century and the national highway network in the 20th century. So now to go from Phoenix to Prescott, you only need to transfer from I-17 to Interstate 69, and it will take about two hours by car.

979ab037d8e449e313e003172af8c9d103817d6b.sourceText: 1860年代，在普雷斯科特（Prescott）南部和东部发现了黄金，随后在羚羊山中也发现了黄金。在1863年的内战中，美国国会通过了亚利桑那领地的立法。由于战争造成了巨大的损失，联邦政府可能受到亚利桑那领地的矿产资源的影响，在1864年5月30日，普雷斯科特（Prescott）被指定为亚利桑那领地的第一个首府。 [75]
979ab037d8e449e313e003172af8c9d103817d6b.translatedText: In the 1860s, gold was discovered south and east of Prescott, and later in the Antelope Mountains. During the Civil War in 1863, the United States Congress passed legislation establishing the Arizona Territory. Due to the great losses caused by the war and the federal government's concern over the Arizona Territory's mineral resources, Prescott was designated as the first capital of the Arizona Territory on May 30, 1864. [75]

95ce677a8bd1c9f622d34f92979f761677e2dc00.sourceText: 普雷斯科特（Prescott）这个名字，是为了纪念历史学家威廉·希克林·普雷斯科特（William Hickling Prescott）而起的。
95ce677a8bd1c9f622d34f92979f761677e2dc00.translatedText: >The name Prescott was given in memory of the historian William Hickling Prescott.

9e603fa9ef7bfd05ce059d510cc7cde8bae06b16.sourceText: 普雷斯科特（Prescott）也是亚瓦派（Yavapai）的县府，在其领土时期是一个边境城镇，常有犯罪，骚乱和枪击的情况。在其他人涌入之前，亚瓦派有着已经占领该地区数百年的土著居民。
9e603fa9ef7bfd05ce059d510cc7cde8bae06b16.translatedText: Prescott is also the county seat of Yavapai and was a frontier town during its territorial days, often associated with crime, riots, and shootings. Before the influx of others, the Yavapai had an indigenous population that had occupied the area for hundreds of years.

38136f0ecababd2f44d0b06c4690a3a79d863fcc.sourceText: 之后，冒险家，挖黄金的矿工，农民和牧场主寻求通过联邦《宅基地法》，在普雷斯科特（Prescott）获得土地。商人，律师和其他寻求新机会的人也来到此地。在威士忌路的两旁，曾遍布沙龙与酒吧，当时的西部淘金热将这座原本无人知晓的安静小城变成了囊括牛仔、赌徒、风尘女子、枪战、宿醉、暴富、破产等戏剧因素的舞台中心。 [76]
38136f0ecababd2f44d0b06c4690a3a79d863fcc.translatedText: Later, adventurers, gold miners, farmers, and ranchers sought to acquire land in Prescott through the federal Homestead Act. Businessmen, lawyers and others seeking new opportunities also came here. Saloons and bars were once dotted on both sides of Whiskey Road. The Western Gold Rush at that time turned this originally unknown and quiet town into the center of a stage that included cowboys, gamblers, promiscuous women, gunfights, hangovers, sudden wealth, bankruptcy and other dramatic elements. [76]

85a1d481d8353745b4309dab8bcd2273db859aa5.sourceText: 1887年7月，普雷斯科特（Prescott）和凤凰铁路通车。到1895年，圣达菲铁路将当地的矿区与南太平洋线连接，促进了经济和商业的发展，并导致建立了新的干货店和采矿供应企业，通讯和公用事业随着交通的发展，在 1889年建造了电灯厂，此后不久接通了电话。同年，亚利桑那州的首府迁往凤凰城，尽管存在政治上的损失，但普雷斯科特（Prescott）还是继续繁荣发展。
85a1d481d8353745b4309dab8bcd2273db859aa5.translatedText: In July 1887, the Prescott and Phoenix Railway opened to traffic. By 1895, the Santa Fe Railroad connected local mining areas to the Southern Pacific Line, spurring economic and commercial development and leading to the establishment of new dry goods stores and mining supply businesses. Communications and utilities grew as transportation developed, with the construction of an electric light factory in 1889 and the telephone shortly thereafter. That same year, the capital of Arizona moved to Phoenix, and despite the political losses, Prescott continued to prosper.

bdd95f3a0d7bcf3cc4a98fbf94821d22033df5c0.sourceText: 1900年7月14日，一场灾难性的大火摧毁了普雷斯科特（Prescott）市中心的四个半街区，商业发展发生了巨大变化。 12家旅馆和20个商业场所消失了。大火过后，市民将这次灾难视为一次机会，採用更多永久性的混凝土，砖石建筑代替了市区常见的旧木建筑，用水泥铺成街道，取代了1800年代尘土飞扬的道路。大火刺激了社会发展和公共领域的进步。
bdd95f3a0d7bcf3cc4a98fbf94821d22033df5c0.translatedText: Commercial development changed dramatically on July 14, 1900, when a catastrophic fire destroyed four and a half blocks of downtown Prescott. Twelve hotels and 20 commercial establishments disappeared. After the fire, citizens saw the disaster as an opportunity to replace the old wooden buildings common in the downtown area with more permanent concrete, masonry buildings, and paved streets with cement, replacing the dusty roads of the 1800s. The fire stimulated social development and progress in the public realm.

328a3781033401843ba291c31a27178c23e34e82.sourceText: 1920年，普雷斯科特（Prescott）的人口约为5,000。一百年后的2019年，人口有42,785，亚裔人口不到1.5%。
328a3781033401843ba291c31a27178c23e34e82.translatedText: In 1920, Prescott's population was approximately 5,000. One hundred years later, in 2019, the population was 42,785, and less than 1.5% of the population was Asian.

2f3ade4ffdfddf16054b7f864253285b65e268f1.sourceText: 1868年，华人已在普雷斯科特（Prescott）采矿。据报道，1868年6月13日，在维肯堡（Wickenburg）附近的秃鹰（Vulture），有矿工刊物的文章指出，二十多位受雇的中国先驱在那儿完成了大部分工作，当发现有金或银矿时，许多人感到心在颤抖。 [77]
2f3ade4ffdfddf16054b7f864253285b65e268f1.translatedText: In 1868, the Chinese were already mining in Prescott. It was reported that on June 13, 1868, at Vulture, near Wickenburg, an article in a miner's publication stated that more than twenty Chinese pioneers were employed there to complete most of the work, and many people felt their hearts tremble when gold or silver mines were discovered. [77]

b89b581a73763f52c58708bc1d694cf631bb4f05.sourceText: 1869年中央太平洋铁路建成后，在定居在普雷斯科特（Prescott）的中国人，其中一些可能是1869年从中央铁路下岗的工人。他们曾担任农作物生产者，矿工，轿车和饭店的厨师，家庭佣人，洗衣店老板，甚至是经销商。
b89b581a73763f52c58708bc1d694cf631bb4f05.translatedText: >After the completion of the Central Pacific Railroad in 1869, some of the Chinese who settled in Prescott may have been workers laid off from the Central Railroad in 1869. They worked as crop producers, miners, chefs in saloons and restaurants, domestic servants, laundromat owners, and even dealers.

1e1b64460604e3f55f17bef6efa30222d05588fe.sourceText: 在佛罗伦斯·C·李斯特和罗伯特·H·李斯特所著的《普里斯科特地区的中国寄居者》一文中，提到在普雷斯科特（Prescott）有位华人，他的姓名是“Quong Clong Gin”（中文译音：金广昌）。 [78]
1e1b64460604e3f55f17bef6efa30222d05588fe.translatedText: In the article "Chinese Sojourners in the Prescott Area" written by Florence C. Lister and Robert H. Lister, it is mentioned that there was a Chinese in Prescott, and his name was "Quong Clong Gin" (Chinese transliteration: Jin Guangchang). [78]

7d5b301998254389b735737fa6636a71e23dcf87.sourceText: 在Rhonda TintleI所著的《中国移民进入亚利桑那地区的历史：美国西部的前锋文化》一书中，也提到了这位“金广昌“的中国人。有根据表明“ Quong Clong Gin “在1882.7的普雷斯科特（Prescott）地图上的第13街区，列出了Quong Clong Gin是该地段10的拥有者“。 [79]
7d5b301998254389b735737fa6636a71e23dcf87.translatedText: The Chinese "Jin Guangchang" was also mentioned in the book "The History of Chinese Immigrants into the Arizona Region: Pioneer Culture in the American West" written by Rhonda TintleI. There is evidence that "Quong Clong Gin" is in Block 13 on the 1882.7 map of Prescott, which lists Quong Clong Gin as the owner of lot 10. [79]

5a269360b7bbff679225d07c79fd52656ad612f5.sourceText: 在1870-1880年之间，普雷斯科特（Prescott）中国居民的房屋和企业集中在花岗岩街(Granite Stree)。 中国人勤于寻找工作。 他们很快成为业主，并且是大储蓄者。 例如有一位名为李山（Sam Lee）的中国商人，在Yavapai县购买了一个农场。李山还将拥有一家餐馆，但后来因试图扩大自己在中国人之中的竞争，最终被另一位中国商业竞争对手所谋杀。 [80]
5a269360b7bbff679225d07c79fd52656ad612f5.translatedText: Between 1870-1880, the houses and businesses of Prescott Chinese residents were concentrated on Granite Street. The Chinese were diligent in their search for work. They soon became property owners and were big savers. For example, there was a Chinese businessman named Sam Lee who purchased a farm in Yavapai County. Li Shan would also own a restaurant, but was eventually murdered by another Chinese business competitor. [80]

c3c334ca85d3380553343720e5590a10170f3820.sourceText: 李山（Sam Lee）还是个引人注目的人物。他出现在Sharlot Hall档案馆，美国地方法院记录1864-1912，国家档案和太平洋地区记录管理局（LagunaNiguel）等资料中。 [81] 其他的中国人在此地开设了餐馆，洗衣店，商店，或者成为了农民。（待续）
c3c334ca85d3380553343720e5590a10170f3820.translatedText: Sam Lee was also a notable figure in Sharlot. Hall Archives, U.S. District Court Records 1864-1912, National Archives and Pacific Records Administration (Laguna Niguel), etc. [81] Other Chinese opened restaurants, laundries, shops, or became farmers here (To be continued)

a2e30c8c4f83ecb1f1ee1d97142720ccb7b4d4ff.sourceText: 男子疑嗑药 肇事后脱光衣服再撞车 （亚省时报） 一名疯狂男子在交通尖峰时间肇事，造成追撞意外后，不知为何扒光全身衣物挟持其他车辆，又造成第二起车祸，全程共七人受伤，其中一人是孕妇。 斯科思岱警方发言人克拉克表示，这名扒衣男的疯狂行径可能与服用药物有关。 根据第一场意外目击者，这名男子驾车撞上一辆保时捷跑车，接著追撞另一辆车，保时捷驾驶身受重伤。 肇事男走下车后一边唱歌并高声喊叫，一边褪去衣物，跳到一辆休旅车上，全身只剩脚上一双袜子，高举双手向大家示威。 结束后拉下车上女驾驶，驾车扬长而去，之后又造成第2起相撞。 目击者看到他驾驶的休旅车翻覆，车子滚了几圈后，他从挡风玻璃弹出，倒地后竟又爬起跑向另外两辆休旅车，意图挟持车辆，但这时警方已赶到将他逮捕，第而起事故中一名孕妇双腿皆撞断。 警方将肇事嫌犯带到附近医院接受药物评估及精神诊断。 克拉克說，这名男子可能遭控劫车和肇事逃逸罪名。
a2e30c8c4f83ecb1f1ee1d97142720ccb7b4d4ff.translatedText: Man suspected of being under the influence of drugs stripped off his clothes before crashing into a car (Alberta Times) A ​​crazy man caused a car accident during rush hour. After causing a collision, he stripped off all his clothes and hijacked other vehicles for unknown reasons. He also caused a second car accident. A total of seven people were injured in the whole process, one of whom was a pregnant woman. Scott Clark, spokesman for the Scottsdale police, said the man's crazy behavior may be related to taking drugs. According to witnesses of the first accident, the man drove his car into a Porsche sports car and then chased another car. The Porsche driver was seriously injured. After getting out of the car, the man who caused the accident sang and shouted loudly, took off his clothes, and jumped into an SUV with only a pair of socks on his feet. He raised his hands in the air to demonstrate to everyone. After that, he got out of the car and got into the female driver's car, and drove away, causing a second collision. Witnesses saw the SUV he was driving overturned. After the car rolled several times, he was ejected from the windshield. After falling to the ground, he got up and ran towards two other SUVs with the intention of hijacking the vehicle. However, by then the police had arrived and arrested him. In the first accident, a pregnant woman had her legs broken. The police took the suspect to a nearby hospital for drug evaluation and psychiatric diagnosis. Clark said the man may be charged with carjacking and hit-and-run.
