65564bb32fcb0f8b20e9abe55655c289875340dc.sourceText: 近来中国大陆新闻，连连曝出雾霾天气的报导，从柬北的哈尔滨、沉阳到西南的成都、重庆，从首都北京和相邻的天津、河北、山西到江南的上海、南京一带，都因雾霾天气造成了高速公路关闭、飞机停飞、学校停课的事情，许多人戴上了口罩，以减少有毒空气的吸入。网民们调侃説严重到蹓狗不见狗，握手不见人的程度，这未免有些过份。但従北京中央电视台附近的一组对比照片真实地反映了雾霾的严重程度。记得在上学的时𡘓，老师曾给我们讲述过’雾伦敦的故事’,那是英国早期的工业革命给人民带来的危害。我们曾发誓不能走老牌帝国主义走过的老路。因此当中国改革开放，经济步入起飞的初期，在研究国家发展计画时就强调指出要走可持续发展的道路，要注重保护人类赖以生存的环境，不要因发展经济给后人带来危害。三十年过去了，中国的经济实现了持续高速发展，换来的是一个几乎遍及全国的雾霾天气。偌大的一个中国，可能除西蔵和少数边远地区，人们很难找到一块干淨的国土（刚刚又听到布达拉宫和海南被雾霾沦陷)。雾伦敦变成了今天的’雾中国’。我们的国家未能摆脱高速经济发展带来的危害，三个代表和科学发展观都未能抵住经济发展这条大虫的侵蚀。人民连新鲜空气都呼吸不到，还谈什麽和谐社会。
65564bb32fcb0f8b20e9abe55655c289875340dc.translatedText: Recently, news in mainland China has exposed reports of smog weather one after another, from Harbin and Shenyang in northern Cambodia to the southwest. In Chengdu and Chongqing, from the capital Beijing and adjacent Tianjin, Hebei, Shanxi to Shanghai and Nanjing in the south of the Yangtze River, highways were closed, planes were grounded, and schools were suspended due to haze weather. Many people wore masks to reduce the inhalation of toxic air. Netizens joked that the situation was so serious that the dog could not be seen when it was stalking a dog, and the person could not be seen shaking hands. This was a bit excessive. But a set of comparative photos taken near Beijing's CCTV truly reflects the severity of the smog. I remember when I was in school, the teacher once told us the "Story of Fog London", which was the harm brought to the people by the early industrial revolution in Britain. We have vowed not to follow the same path of old imperialism. Therefore, when China's reform and opening up and its economy entered the early stage of take-off, when studying the national development plan, it was emphasized that it should follow the path of sustainable development, pay attention to protecting the environment on which mankind depends, and not cause harm to future generations through economic development. Thirty years have passed, and China's economy has achieved sustained and rapid development, but in exchange for this, haze weather has spread almost across the country. In such a huge China, except for Xizang and a few remote areas, it is difficult for people to find a clean land (I just heard that the Potala Palace and Hainan were destroyed by smog). Fog London became today’s ‘Fog China’. Our country has not been able to get rid of the harm caused by rapid economic development. Neither the Three Represents nor the Scientific Outlook on Development can withstand the erosion of the big bug of economic development. How can we talk about a harmonious society when people can't even breathe fresh air?

0c1817fe85f9e4bd9cbac6c9cd3e0d6bff780ffa.sourceText: 贪腐是中国发展中的另一个大害。像雾霾一样，三十年来贪腐越演越烈，侵吞着人民的大量财富，侵蚀着国家机体。揭露出来的事实说明：从村长到县长，従省部级官员到政治局委员，従医护人员到仓库管理员，许多人都利用自己手中的权力和机会，为个人或为小团体谋取私利。过去我们来美国考察，见到美国橱窗里的商品，都觉得贵得炙手，出国零花钱只能买凣块巧克力和小纪念章回去和家人和好朋友分享。曾几何时，中国旅游团已经成为美国名牌店的重要顾客，中国逰客的人均消费超过七千美元。我们这些华侨回国见到老朋友常常觉得囊中羞涩。不可否认，近些年人民收入有很大提高，也有一部分人先富了起来，但大部分人的月工资收入仍不超过一千美元，那能出手如此大方。我相信很多人出国是在用公欵消费，用各种手段在企业或单位报销。全民分贪国家财富几乎形成了一种风气，公欵吃喝，公欵请客送礼比比皆是，少数有权的人倒是提前进入了共产主义，各尽其’能’, 各取所需。记得在五十年代我刚従学校毕业走上工作岗位的时矦，父亲给我买了二十个贴上邮票的信简，要我每月给家寄一封信，并告诫我不能用公用信封和信纸，公私一定要分明。之后，当我有一次便急用了一张公用信笺擦屁股的时矦（那时大部分中国人还没有买手纸的习惯），心里着实有一㮔犯罪感。我父亲是生长在民国时期的一个旧职员，他沿用着中国的传统道德观念教育我们下一代。经历了文化大革命的皓劫，打碎了一个旧世界，新世界没有建立，仁义礼智信的教育已不复存在，公私不分，国民道德教育严重缺失，这是中国当今贪腐之风如此泛滥的历史和社会根源之一。
0c1817fe85f9e4bd9cbac6c9cd3e0d6bff780ffa.translatedText: Corruption is another major hazard in China's development. Like smog, corruption has become more and more intense in the past thirty years, embezzling a large amount of people's wealth and eroding the national body. The exposed facts show that: from village chiefs to county heads, provincial and ministerial officials to Politburo members, medical staff to warehouse managers, many people use the power and opportunities in their hands to seek personal gain for individuals or small groups. In the past, when we came to the United States for inspection, we felt that the products in American showcases were extremely expensive. With our pocket money when we went abroad, we could only buy a piece of chocolate and a small souvenir medal to share with our family and good friends. Once upon a time, Chinese tour groups had become important customers of American brand-name stores, and the per capita consumption of Chinese tourists exceeded US$7,000. We overseas Chinese often feel short of money when we return home to see old friends. It is undeniable that people's income has greatly increased in recent years, and some people have become rich first, but most people's monthly salary income still does not exceed one thousand US dollars, so how can they be so generous. I believe that many people who go abroad use public funds for consumption and use various means to reimburse themselves at companies or units. It has almost become a trend for the whole people to share the national wealth. Everyone eats and drinks, treats guests and gives gifts. However, a few powerful people have entered communism in advance, everyone does his best and gets what he needs. I remember that in the 1950s, when I had just graduated from school and started working, my father bought me twenty stamped letterheads and asked me to send a letter home every month. He also warned me not to use public envelopes and stationery, and that I must distinguish between public and private matters. Later, when I urgently wiped my butt with a piece of public letterhead (most Chinese people didn't have the habit of buying toilet paper at that time), I felt really guilty. My father was an old employee who grew up during the Republic of China. He used traditional Chinese moral concepts to educate the next generation. After experiencing the catastrophe of the Cultural Revolution, an old world was shattered and a new world was not established. The education of benevolence, justice, etiquette, wisdom, and trust no longer existed. There was no distinction between public and private affairs, and national moral education was seriously lacking. This is one of the historical and social roots of the rampant corruption in China today.

ced996f532dbbc6c5b7351a3d876b64f17360205.sourceText: 雾霾和贪腐己成为中国社会前进中的两座大山，已成为实现中国梦的巨大障碍。一座在生活领域，人民天天需要新鲜空气。一座在政治领域，人们需要一个公平公正有道德的社会。坦白地说，问题发展到今天这样普遍和严重，绝不是短期形成的。前任国家领导人对此是负有责任的。希望不要只沉缅于着书立说论述执政时的功绩，也应该反思当政时的不足和失误，检讨自己，以利后人。可以看出，本届政府正在认真扎实地向贪腐宣战，希望能彻底消除毒瘤，还中国一个清新的社会。也愿本届政府摆脱GDP增长的困扰，还人民一个洁淨的赖以生存的良好环境。
ced996f532dbbc6c5b7351a3d876b64f17360205.translatedText: Smog and corruption have become two big mountains in the progress of Chinese society and huge obstacles to the realization of the Chinese Dream. In the field of life, people need fresh air every day. In the political field, people need a fair, just and moral society. Frankly speaking, the fact that the problem has become so widespread and serious today is by no means a short-term development. Former national leaders are responsible for this. I hope that we will not just dwell on writing books and expounding on our achievements when we were in power, but we should also reflect on our shortcomings and mistakes when we were in power, and review ourselves for the benefit of future generations. It can be seen that this government is declaring war on corruption in a serious and solid manner, hoping to completely eliminate the cancer and return China to a clean society. We also hope that this government will get rid of the troubles of GDP growth and give the people a clean and good environment for survival.

35bd303bae561c0dcd62429eb52505d9df7aca58.sourceText: 有惊无险 迷途童子军找到 （亚省时报） 上周末，在一项远足活动中迷路的童子军已经找到，回到父母身边。 童子军上周五下午在通托(Tonto)国家森林举办一项徒步10英里和野营活动，原定周六下午四时返回集合地点。但过了预定时间，有两名童子军和两名成年童子军带队没返回，其中包括前参议会主席罗素皮尔斯的孙子，而且四人只带了当天的粮食和饮用水。 马利科巴郡治安办公室后来出动直升机搜索，最后在周日凌晨一点半左右将他们找到。
35bd303bae561c0dcd62429eb52505d9df7aca58.translatedText: Near miss, lost Boy Scout found (Alberta Times) Last weekend, a Boy Scout lost during a hiking activity has been found and returned to his parents. The Boy Scouts held a 10-mile hike and camping event in the Tonto National Forest last Friday afternoon and were scheduled to return to the meeting point at 4 p.m. Saturday. However, after the scheduled time, two Boy Scouts and two adult Boy Scouts did not return, including the grandson of former Senate President Russell Pierce, and the four of them only brought food and drinking water for the day. The Maricopa County Sheriff's Office later launched a helicopter search and finally found them around 1:30 a.m. Sunday.

92c7f5c11f5d8d2b78e473d9361e148bbe9c902c.sourceText: 记者从正在福建莆田举办的中国（莆田）海峡工艺品博览会了解到，艺博会地有效促进了两岸工艺美术界的交流融合。 在艺博会展馆里，台湾展团的展区格外引人关注。木雕、琉璃、瓷器、玻璃等代表台湾工艺美术行业最高水平的工艺品纷纷亮相，台湾展团中现场制作玻璃、陶瓷 工艺品的展位更是围满了观众。主办方介绍，本届艺博会台湾共有７个工艺美术行业协会参会，展位数达到９２个，是艺博会历史上规模最大的一次。 莆田市经贸委主任王加林表示，艺博会作为海峡两岸工艺美术界规模最大的专业展会，从２００６年举办第一届至今，有效地推进了两岸工艺美术行业的经济文化交流。 ”现单单在莆田工艺美术城，台湾企业家和艺术家开店铺、工作室的就有３０多人。在莆田工艺美术城以交流沉香、檀香木为主的艺术家基本上都是台湾同胞。”王加林说。 两岸艺术品的交流带动了两岸文化的相互交流和融合，而文化上的交流又带来了经济上的交流。王加林告诉记者，艺博会举办以来，不少台湾的企业家和艺术家纷纷来大陆投资工艺美术行业。”目前莆田的台湾工艺美术大师在大陆生意的回报已经超过他们在台湾市场的收益。” 台湾苗栗县三义木雕协会总干事张家琪表示，台湾设计、大陆制造是完全可以融合在一起的。”把两岸的工艺美术推向国际，走上国际化的康庄大道，这是我的梦，也是我的未来。”张家琪说。 第六届中国（莆田）海峡工艺品博览会４月２８日至５月２日在福建莆田举办。
92c7f5c11f5d8d2b78e473d9361e148bbe9c902c.translatedText: The reporter learned from the China (Putian) Straits Arts and Crafts Fair being held in Putian, Fujian that the art fair effectively promoted the exchange and integration of the arts and crafts circles on both sides of the Taiwan Strait. In the art fair pavilion, the Taiwan pavilion's exhibition area attracted special attention. Wood carvings, colored glazes, porcelain, glass and other handicrafts representing the highest level of Taiwan's arts and crafts industry were on display one after another. The Taiwan pavilion's booth where glass and ceramic handicrafts were made on-site was even more crowded with visitors. According to the organizer, a total of 7 Taiwanese arts and crafts industry associations will participate in this art fair, with 92 booths, making it the largest in the history of the art fair. Wang Jialin, director of the Putian Municipal Economic and Trade Commission, said that the art fair, as the largest professional exhibition in the arts and crafts industry on both sides of the Taiwan Strait, has effectively promoted economic and cultural exchanges between the arts and crafts industries on both sides of the Taiwan Strait since its first session in 2006. "In Putian Arts and Crafts City alone, there are more than 30 Taiwanese entrepreneurs and artists who have opened shops and studios. The artists who mainly exchange agarwood and sandalwood in Putian Arts and Crafts City are basically Taiwanese compatriots." Wang Jialin said. The exchange of cross-strait artworks has promoted the mutual exchange and integration of cross-strait cultures, and cultural exchanges have brought about economic exchanges. Wang Jialin told reporters that since the art fair was held, many Taiwanese entrepreneurs and artists have come to mainland China to invest in the arts and crafts industry. "Currently, Putian's Taiwanese arts and crafts masters' return from business in the mainland has exceeded their income from the Taiwan market." Zhang Jiaqi, director general of the Sanyi Woodcarving Association in Miaoli County, Taiwan, said that Taiwanese design and mainland manufacturing can be completely integrated. "It is my dream and my future to promote the arts and crafts from both sides of the Taiwan Strait internationally and embark on the road of internationalization," said Zhang Jiaqi. The 6th China (Putian) Straits Arts and Crafts Expo was held in Putian, Fujian from April 28 to May 2.

78fbe89eab089764b6d6fd758aa01e75fa10556b.sourceText: 凤凰城凤鸣：胜似姊妹的姑姪亲情
78fbe89eab089764b6d6fd758aa01e75fa10556b.translatedText: Phoenix City Fengming: The relationship between aunts and nephews is better than sisters

Her brothers and sisters all have their own playmates. She only has her nephew who is 4 years younger than her...

c83ddaa50ff50e8885959b86e25586c391cb1231.sourceText: 凤凰城凤鸣：胜似姊妹的姑姪亲情 凤儿在家中五个兄弟姊妹中最小，哥哥姐姐都有自己的玩伴，她只有和她小4岁的姪女贞儿一起玩。可是自从贞儿的弟弟不幸妖折以后，贞儿的母亲一直浸深在失去爱子的痛苦中，对贞儿几乎是不管不问，更有时把无名的怨气撒在贞儿身上。贞儿从小在这种母威的威摄下，小心翼翼的生活，对母亲的怨气逆来顺受。凤儿对贞儿的遭遇是看在眼里疼在心上，所以凤儿就总找机会陪姪女贞儿一起玩耍，虽然是姑姪但胜似姐妹。可是好景不长，觧放初期，各地都组织年青人上夜校，贞儿的母亲也上了夜校，不单学了文化，也学了要与父母争取经济独立、行动自由，自己在外租房子，一家三口从大家中搬了出去。是怎么样与父母商议的凤儿不知道，搬家的那天，凤儿只看着姪女贞儿被母亲牵着手，跟在拉傢俱的车后，回头看的可怜眼神，令凤儿难以忘怀。 本来觉得可以给贞儿幼小心灵有所安慰的凤儿，在贞儿一家三人搬走后，到是凤儿自己有些落寞，失去了一个可以一起玩耍的玩伴，进出一个人很是无聊。刚好贞儿搬走后春节快到了，凤儿的父母派她去大哥栋儿家送信，请他们一家子回来过春节。得着这一机会，凤儿这时高兴地不亦乐乎，虽然只有大概的位置，凤儿三蹦两跳一路找寻，功夫不负有心人，在没有具体住址的情况下，贞儿家被凤儿找到了。凤儿见到大哥大嫂，传达了父母之命后，就和贞儿一起玩去了。 凤儿认识贞儿家以后，经常独自一人偷偷去找贞儿玩，有时大人不在家，凤儿就教贞儿做饭玩，到现在仍然清晰记得，当时做得最多的一种饭是白米粥拌白糖，软软懦懦的白米饭拌上雪白的白糖，吃到嘴里即化，那种甜丝丝香喷喷的感觉，就如同掉进了蜜灌里一般，也是儿时最大的享受了。 凤儿终于等到春节，贞儿一家三口搬出以后第一次回家过年，凤儿拉着贞儿满园子跑着玩，玩得正高兴时，被大人叫过去有事要凤儿去办。原来是，在办家宴时盘子不够用，让凤儿和贞儿一起回贞儿家取盘子。两个小女孩手拉手蹦蹦跳跳一路小跑到贞儿家，取了盘子往回走，可能是高兴过头了，不知是什么原因，盘子就落地上了，只听到盘子打被的清脆的响声两个人吓了一跳，贞儿拿起来一看，四个盘子碎了两个，当场就哇哇地哭起来，贞儿恐惧地说：〝妈妈会打我！〞凤儿劝贞儿说：〝你不用怕，就说是我打砰的。〞后来还是被贞儿的母亲识破，恨恨的说凤儿教姪女说谎，不诚实。凤儿一直很同情贞儿的处境，贞儿的母亲一直生活在痛失爱子的阴影中，又因妇科病不能再生育，就把一切怨气都撒到可怜的贞儿身上，贞儿也是时刻在惊恐中长大。这种情况一直持续到贞儿结婚生子，才有所好转。但是贞儿的母亲的格性很强，在家中一切说了算的作风不变，就是先生、女婿也让她三分。这一生对谁都是盛气凌人，所以凤儿对她这个大嫂也是敬而远之。只有凤儿的大哥是到哪也是躲不掉的，大哥又是善良忠厚的老实人，只有逆来顺受，忍耐再忍耐，求得家中风平浪静。 一恍半个多世记过去了，贞儿经历了与父母亲的生死离别，自己也从工作岗位上退休、升级做祖母了，近几次凤儿回国探亲，每次总要与贞儿团聚，回忆童年的难忘经历，叙述胜似姊妹的姑姪情谊。让凤儿欣慰的是，现在看到的贞儿，是一个脱去恐惧的阴影、开朗向上的贞儿，退休在家后，除了操持家务、带好孙子外，手巧的贞儿还有许多新学的业余爱好，如做丝网花、十字绣、鈎各式各样的小饰品。一进贞儿的家，迎面映入眼帘的是各种以假乱真、鲜艳夺目的丝网花装饰品，把整个家布置的生气勃勃、漂亮又温欣。墙上挂着用玻璃镜框装饰好的十字绣，是贞儿用三个多月时间，一针一线精心绣制的，图桉是一只虎虎生威的老虎，是送给他先生的生日礼物。贞儿忙完了一天的家务后，每天晚上去小区广场，跳一个小时的广场舞，健身又娱乐心情。凤儿向她学习了做丝网花、鈎各种小饰品。贞儿现在幸福的生活，充满了温欣与快乐。凤儿真诚地祝愿：贞儿晚年生活幸福、健康、快乐！
c83ddaa50ff50e8885959b86e25586c391cb1231.translatedText: Fengming in Phoenix City: A close relationship between aunts and uncles is better than sisters. Feng'er is the youngest among the five brothers and sisters in the family. Her brothers and sisters all have their own playmates. She only plays with her niece Zhen'er, who is 4 years younger than her. However, since Zhen'er's younger brother unfortunately passed away, Zhen'er's mother has been immersed in the pain of losing her beloved son. She almost ignores Zhen'er and sometimes spreads her nameless resentment on Zhen'er. Zhen'er has been under the intimidation of this mother's power since she was a child, and has lived a careful life, resigned to her mother's resentment. Feng'er saw what happened to Zhen'er and felt pain in her heart, so Feng'er always looked for opportunities to play with her niece Zhen'er. Although she was an aunt, she was better than a sister. But the good times did not last long. In the early days of liberation, young people from all over the country were organized to attend night schools. Zhen'er's mother also attended night schools. Not only did she learn culture, but she also learned how to fight for economic independence and freedom of movement with her parents. She rented a house by herself, and the family of three moved out. Feng'er didn't know how she negotiated with her parents. On the day of moving, Feng'er only watched her niece Zhen'er being held by her mother's hand and following the car pulling furniture. The pitiful look she looked back at was unforgettable. Feng'er, who originally thought she could comfort Zhen'er's young mind, became a little lonely after Zhen'er's family moved away. She lost a playmate to play with, and it was boring to be alone. It happened that the Spring Festival was coming soon after Zhen'er moved away. Feng'er's parents sent her to deliver a letter to her eldest brother Dong'er's house, inviting their family to come back for the Spring Festival. Feng'er was overjoyed to get this opportunity. Although there was only an approximate location, Feng'er jumped around and searched all the way. The hard work paid off. Without a specific address, Feng'er found Zhen'er's home. After Feng'er met her eldest brother and sister-in-law and conveyed her parents' orders, she went to play with Zhen'er. After Feng'er got to know Zhen'er's family, she often went to play with Zhen'er secretly. Sometimes when the adults were not at home, Feng'er taught Zhen'er to cook and play. She still clearly remembers that the most popular meal at that time was white rice porridge mixed with white sugar. The soft and cowardly white rice mixed with snow-white sugar melted in the mouth. The sweet and fragrant feeling was like falling into a honey pot. It was also the greatest enjoyment of childhood. Feng'er finally waited for the Spring Festival, and Zhen'er's family of three went home for the first time to celebrate the New Year after moving out. Feng'er pulled Zhen'er and ran around the garden to play. When she was having fun, an adult called her over and asked Feng'er to do something. It turned out that there were not enough plates during the family dinner, so Feng'er and Zhen'er were asked to go back to Zhen'er's house to get the plates. The two little girls jumped hand in hand and trotted all the way to Zhen'er's house. They took the plate and walked back. Maybe they were too happy. For some reason, the plate fell to the floor. They heard the crisp sound of the plate being hit. They were startled. Zhen'er picked it up and looked around. Two plates were broken, and she burst into tears on the spot. Zhen'er said in fear, "Mom will beat me!" Feng'er advised Zhen'er, "Don't be afraid, just say it was me who hit her." Later, Zhen'er's mother found out and said bitterly that Feng'er had taught her niece to lie and was dishonest. Feng'er has always sympathized with Zhen'er's situation. Zhen'er's mother has been living in the shadow of losing her beloved son, and she can no longer have children due to gynecological diseases, so she vents all her grievances on poor Zhen'er. Zhen'er also grows up in fear all the time. This situation lasted until Zhen'er got married and had children, and then it got better. But Zhen'er's mother has a strong personality, and her style of having the final say in everything at home remains unchanged. Even her husband and son-in-law give her three points. She has always been domineering towards everyone in her life, so Feng'er also kept a distance from her sister-in-law. Only Feng'er's eldest brother could not escape no matter where he went. The eldest brother was also a kind, loyal and honest man. He could only accept the situation and endure it again and again to keep the family at peace. More than half a century passed in a blink of an eye. Zhen'er experienced life and death separation from her parents. She also retired from her job and became a grandmother. Recently, Feng'er returned to China to visit relatives. Each time, Feng'er always reunited with Zhen'er, recalling unforgettable childhood experiences and recounting the relationship between aunts and sisters that is better than sisters. What makes Feng'er happy is that the Zhen'er she sees now is a cheerful and upbeat Zhen'er who has shed the shadow of fear. After retiring at home, in addition to taking care of housework and taking care of her grandchildren, the handy Zhen'er also has many new hobbies, such as making screen flowers, cross-stitch, and crocheting various trinkets. As soon as she entered Zhen'er's home, she was greeted by a variety of silk-mesh flower decorations that looked fake and real, making the whole home lively, beautiful and warm. Hanging on the wall is a cross-stitch decorated with a glass frame. It took Zhen'er more than three months to embroider it carefully, stitch by stitch. The pattern is of a tiger in full force, which was a birthday gift for his husband. After Zhen'er finished her housework for the day, she went to the community square every night and danced for an hour to keep herself fit and entertained. Feng'er learned from her how to make silk screen flowers and crochet various small ornaments. Zhen'er's current happy life is full of warmth and joy. Feng'er sincerely wishes: Zhen'er will live a happy, healthy and happy life in her later years!

ff619b5af6d94ee5fc1ef98f3fc860deff535a51.sourceText: 北大教授贺卫方关于官员犯罪的精彩演讲
ff619b5af6d94ee5fc1ef98f3fc860deff535a51.translatedText: Peking University professor He Weifang's wonderful speech on official crime

77806f8bbb8f5ac284f7ddc4840e28cf0335c3f5.sourceText: 北大教授贺卫方关于官员犯罪的精彩演讲 大家可以比较一下，为什么中国的经济犯罪这么严重，而一些民主国家、一些…
77806f8bbb8f5ac284f7ddc4840e28cf0335c3f5.translatedText: Peking University professor He Weifang's wonderful speech on official crime You can compare why China's economic crimes are so serious, while some democratic countries and some...

f6bb8b3fa9336d1d8cd33a27ba4d568062c9dc35.sourceText: 大家可以比较一下，为什么中国的经济犯罪这么严重，而一些民主国家、一些法治国家没有那么多的经济犯罪？因为我们在前期没有建立有效的制度体系以使官员们在前期不敢犯罪。而后来老百姓看到了，于是就愤怒，政府就拿那些官员出气。有人说：”我们把他杀了怎么样？”老百姓说：”杀了好啊！”政府就开始杀。但是如果前面制度好的话，怎么会有这么多的经济犯罪？美国的官员也不少，为什么很少听说美国的官员因贪污受贿而被判处死刑？因为他们没有办法贪污受贿，他们的政治制度中有三个因素使官员们不得不老老实实地去工作而不敢贪污腐败。
f6bb8b3fa9336d1d8cd33a27ba4d568062c9dc35.translatedText: You can compare why China's economic crimes are so serious, while some democratic countries and some rule of law countries do not have so many economic crimes? Because we did not establish an effective institutional system in the early stage to prevent officials from committing crimes in the early stage. But then the people saw it and became angry, and the government took it out on those officials. Some people said: "How about we kill him?" The people said: "Kill him!" The government started to kill him. But if the previous system was good, how could there be so many economic crimes? There are many officials in the United States. Why do we rarely hear of American officials being sentenced to death for corruption and bribery? Because they have no way to take bribes, there are three factors in their political system that make officials have to work honestly without daring to take bribes.

a1d37e0486a0bd7fabe6d5807bdff54d546e7cb6.sourceText: 第一个是他们的议会制度。议会是干什么的呢？民选代表组成这样一个机构天天监控政府官员，他们只要有一点不符合法律的行为就可能被弹劾。比如英国议会棗最典型的议会制度，这边站着执政党，那边坐着反对党，执政党的问题还能逃过那帮议员们的眼睛？议员的眼睛是贼亮的，他们会将你的所做所为全部揭露。因为他们的政治是竞争性的，他们不仅是市场化的经济，而且是市场化的政治。你如果做不好的话，你就下来，我就上去棗反对党的目标就是：随时准备着，为上台而努力。有时候执政党一个经济上的丑闻，就可能引发人们的不信任，就可能下台，你方唱罢我登场。正是这样一种竞争性的政治，使得官员们必须谨慎行事，绝对不能干那些错事和坏事。议会的监督使得官员们不得不俯首贴耳。
a1d37e0486a0bd7fabe6d5807bdff54d546e7cb6.translatedText: The first is their parliamentary system. What does parliament do? Elected representatives form such a body to monitor government officials every day, and they may be impeached for any behavior that is not in compliance with the law. For example, the British Parliament is the most typical parliamentary system. Here is the ruling party and over there is the opposition party. Can the issues of the ruling party escape the eyes of those MPs? Congressmen have very sharp eyes, and they will expose everything you do. Because their politics are competitive, they are not only market-oriented economies but also market-oriented politics. If you can't do well, you can come down and I can go up. The goal of the opposition party is to be ready at any time and work hard to come to power. Sometimes an economic scandal of the ruling party may cause people's distrust and it may step down. You can sing and I will appear. It is such a competitive politics that officials must act cautiously and never do wrong or bad things. Parliamentary oversight forces officials to be submissive.

dbcb488ab398f96d98f69d041a38137b9ff13ecb.sourceText: 第二个是司法制度，独立的司法制度，独立的司法体系构成了官员们不得不面对的一个巨大的震慑。美国专门为总统设置了特别检查官，前特别检查官斯塔尔先生，对于总统来说是小官，但是这个小官的权力可了得！因为他可以不经司法部长的批准，启动对总统的调查程序。克林顿和莱温斯基之间那点事，说老实话，对于我们国家的好多官员其实算不了什么，在我们这儿，不过体现了无产阶级革命家的浪漫情怀而已（笑声）。斯塔尔先生不惜动用联邦经费5000万元，来调查总统性丑闻，搞得总统颜面尽失，没有任何办法，因为特别检查官这一职不得被任何人罢免，他手下有一帮得力人马。那个总统好当吗？总统尚且受到如此严厉的监督，更不用说下面的那些官员了。天天被司法监控着，一旦有犯罪情况，司法绝不手软啊。尼克松在其担任总统时发生了水门事件，有证据显示尼克松总统也许知道水门事件发生以后的情况。但是尼克松总统说他不了解，法院命令尼克松必须交出他的录音带。尼克松总统有一点僻好，就是天天在他的办公室里边放一个录音机棗即使没人也要放这个东西，只要有人谈话，录音机就会把它全部录下来，他办公室所有的谈话都有录音记录。当法院命令他交出有关事件的三盘录音带时，他拒绝了，他说：”不，我不能交出，这是总统的特权，我不能交给你。”法院问:?#20320;交，还是不交？（笑声）如果你不交出来，就犯防碍司法罪。”在巨大的压力之下，尼克松不得不交出所有的录音带。第二天，他就宣布辞职。所以说美国的行政首脑要服从司法的命令，这些官员都要受到司法的监控。
dbcb488ab398f96d98f69d041a38137b9ff13ecb.translatedText: The second is the judicial system, an independent judicial system. An independent judicial system constitutes a huge deterrent that officials have to face. The United States has specially set up a special prosecutor for the president. The former special prosecutor Mr. Starr is a minor official to the president, but this minor official has incredible power! Because he can launch an investigation into the president without the approval of the attorney general. To be honest, the incident between Clinton and Lewinsky is nothing to many officials in our country. For us, it just embodies the romantic feelings of proletarian revolutionaries (laughter). Mr. Starr did not hesitate to spend 50 million dollars in federal funds to investigate the president's sex scandal, causing the president to lose face. There was no way out, because the position of special prosecutor cannot be removed by anyone, and he has a group of capable people. Is that president good to be? The president is under such strict supervision, let alone the officials below. They are monitored by the judiciary every day. Once there is a crime, the judiciary will not be lenient. The Watergate scandal occurred when Nixon was president, and there is evidence that President Nixon may have known what happened after the Watergate scandal. But President Nixon said he didn't know, and a court ordered Nixon to turn over his tapes. President Nixon had a peculiar hobby. He put a tape recorder in his office every day even if no one was around. As long as someone was talking, the tape recorder would record it all. All conversations in his office were recorded. When the court ordered him to hand over three tapes of the incident, he refused, saying, "No, I can't hand it over. It's the prerogative of the president and I can't hand it over to you." The court asked: "Hand it over, or not hand it over?" (Laughter) If you don't hand it over, you're guilty of obstruction of justice. "Under tremendous pressure, Nixon had to hand over all the tapes. The next day, he announced his resignation. Therefore, the executive heads of the United States must obey the orders of the judiciary, and these officials must be monitored by the judiciary.

e0fac4208e188d8c09adb0a34cd40fa329e88d60.sourceText: 另外一个监控手段是新闻媒体，自由的媒体是官员们廉洁最重要的制度性的保障之一。美国全部的报纸和电视台都是私人办的，还有电台也是私人办的，除了一个电台棗美国之音是美国国务院办的之外。美国之音在播音的时候，有时会说现在播一篇反映美国政府立场的社论。美国之音是政府办的，但是它不允许在美国本土发布信号，所以在美国是听不到美国之音的，要听美国之音还要跑到中国来听（笑声）。之所以他们不允许政府办媒体，是因为政府办媒体就会向人民批发对政府有利的信息，于是整天在造假，说我们的形势一片大好。
e0fac4208e188d8c09adb0a34cd40fa329e88d60.translatedText: Another means of monitoring is the news media. A free media is one of the most important institutional guarantees for officials' integrity. All newspapers and television stations in the United States are privately run, and radio stations are also privately run, with the exception of one radio station: Voice of America, which is run by the U.S. State Department. When the Voice of America is broadcasting, it sometimes says that it will broadcast an editorial that reflects the position of the US government. Voice of America is run by the government, but it is not allowed to broadcast signals in the United States, so you cannot hear Voice of America in the United States. To hear Voice of America, you have to go to China (laughter). The reason why they do not allow government-run media is because the government-run media will wholesale information that is beneficial to the government to the people, so they are making lies all day long, saying that our situation is great.

a31797ac9eef038be72c1c8792279ae88874fc90.sourceText: 我写过一篇文章在中国青年报《冰点》上发表过，叫《善待官员》。我说，我常常想，监狱里面服刑的手扶铁窗的陈希同先生面对国内外人们的挖苦与讽刺，心里是怎么想的。前几天，网上突然出现了一篇文章，题目叫《胡长清临死前谈新闻自由》（笑声）。胡长清说，如果江西省和全国的报纸能像美国记者揭露克林顿丑闻那样揭露我的话，我何至于落到今天这样一个下场啊？何至于面对死刑？我痛苦啊。你们知道在这个国家里，是前倨而后恭。那些现在的省委书记，他们就一点错误都没有吗？报纸每天都在报道他们又在会议上号召广大干部群众学习”三个代表”重要思想，保持共产党员先进性，要牢记”八荣八耻”，天天说那些冠冕堂皇的话，但是只有到了被打倒的时候我们才知道：天啦，这个人这么腐败啊！（笑声）你可以发现，这样的媒体环境对于官员来说是何等的残酷！这让一个人只有成了神以后才能抵御这种诱惑，因为你做的坏事不会被人揭露，那有钱还不得拿着啊？大家想想看，突然听说一个人贪污了800万，觉得数额巨大，挺可怕的，其实在中国做一个县委书记，这钱就哗哗地来，你不能不接受，你要不接受你就干不下去，你就不尽情理，你就不体谅革命群众的心情（笑声）。你得病了，好家伙，人们都去看。人都走了，突然发现床底下全部是钱！（笑声） 官员一到中央党校去学习，下面人就知道要升迁了，急忙提着东西去看。800万，太容易了，所谓”三年清知府，十万雪花银”。所以他们不知不觉就走到死的边缘了。在这样的情况下，谁不去贪啊？谁不喜欢钱啊？?#38065;是催笑草?#65292;一数钱的时候，嘴都笑成这样了（示意，笑声）。钱是多好的东西，谁不需要钱啊？一些领导人小孩出国留学，那钱都是别人包了。谁不喜欢好的车，房子越住越大、车子越坐越小，谁不喜欢美色啊？棗像蒋艳萍，一个女官员，她也喜欢男的啊！（笑声）这是人性使然。人性这个东西你没有什么别的办法，只有强有力的监督机制。只要一有问题就被揭露，那个媒体就盯着你不放，使得你不敢做坏事，使得你不由自主地就成了孔繁森，你不可能成为王宝森。当你第一次把一套房子送给你的情人时，报纸上就吵得沸沸扬扬，你还敢做另一件坏事吗？如果有这样的媒体的话，你连这套房子都不敢送！一点坏事都做不了，你说做雷锋多容易，为什么西方国家没有这样的问题，我们老对自己的官员实行死刑问题还这么严重，而别的国家不是呢？前面的制度没有好好建立，后面就发狠，就像一个不争气的父亲，从小不知道好好教育孩子，长大后犯了错误就打孩子，往死里打，甚至把他打死棗当然我这个比方不太恰当，政府应该是我们的儿子，我说倒了（笑声），邓小平都说过：”我是中国人民的儿子”，也就是我们每个人的儿子（笑声）。
a31797ac9eef038be72c1c8792279ae88874fc90.translatedText: I wrote an article and published it in the China Youth Daily Freezing Point, called "Be Kind to Officials." I said, I often wonder what Mr. Chen Xitong, who is serving his sentence in prison holding the bars, is thinking when faced with the sarcasm and ridicule from people at home and abroad. A few days ago, an article suddenly appeared on the Internet, titled "Hu Changqing Talks about Press Freedom Before He Dies" (laughter). Hu Changqing said, if newspapers in Jiangxi Province and across the country could expose me the way American reporters exposed the Clinton scandal, how could I have ended up like this? Why face the death penalty? I am in pain. You know that in this country, people are arrogant at first and respectful at the end. Those current provincial party committee secretaries, don’t they make any mistakes at all? Newspapers report every day that they called on the cadres and the masses at meetings to learn the important thought of "Three Represents", maintain the advanced nature of Communist Party members, and remember the "Eight Honors and Eight Disgraces". They say those high-sounding words every day, but only when we are knocked down do we know: Oh my God, this person is so corrupt! (Laughter) You can see how cruel this media environment is for officials! This makes a person only able to resist this temptation after becoming a god, because the bad things you do will not be exposed, so why don’t you keep the money? Think about it, everyone. Suddenly I heard that a person had embezzled 8 million yuan. I thought the amount was huge and quite scary. In fact, when you are a county party secretary in China, money comes pouring in. You have to accept it. If you don't accept it, you won't be able to continue, you won't take care of it as much as you can, and you won't understand the feelings of the revolutionary masses (laughter). You're sick, my dear, and people are going to see you. Everyone left, and suddenly I found money all under the bed! (Laughter) As soon as the officials arrived to study at the Central Party School, the people below knew they were about to be promoted and hurriedly picked up their things to take a look. 8 million is too easy. The so-called "three years to clear the prefecture, one hundred thousand snowflakes and silver". So they were on the verge of death before they knew it. Under such circumstances, who wouldn’t be greedy? Who doesn't like money? ?#38065;Is it laughter-inducing grass?#65292;When I counted the money, my mouth started laughing like this (signaling, laughter). Money is such a good thing, who doesn’t need money? When some leaders’ children go to study abroad, others pay for them. Who doesn’t like good cars? The houses get bigger and bigger as we live in them, and the cars get smaller and smaller as we sit in them. Who doesn’t like beauty? Zao looks like Jiang Yanping, a female official. She also likes men! (Laughter) This is human nature. There is no other way to deal with human nature except a strong supervision mechanism. As long as a problem is exposed, the media will keep an eye on you, making you afraid to do bad things, making you involuntarily become Kong Fansen, and you cannot become Wang Baosen. When you first gave a house to your lover and there was a lot of noise in the newspapers, how dare you do another bad thing? If there was such media, you wouldn’t even dare to give away this house! You can't do any bad things. You said it's easy to be Lei Feng. Why don't Western countries have such a problem? We always have such a serious problem of executing our own officials, but other countries don't? The system in the front was not well established, but he became ruthless later on, just like a dissatisfied father who did not know how to educate his children when they were young. When they grow up, they will beat their children when they make mistakes, beat them to death, and even beat them to death. Of course, my analogy is not appropriate. The government should be our son. I said it backwards (laughter). Deng Xiaoping once said: "I am the son of the Chinese people," which is the son of each of us (laughter).

5f7e159a5d9106988f26b33e62d113f0b7b8362f.sourceText: 你前面不建立良好的制度，后面只是震慑，没有用的！你就看这几年来涉案的金额越来越大，人数越来越多，涉案官员级别越来越高。坦率地说现在不敢彻底地去追究，如果彻底追究，如果我们国家司法真变成独立了，那这个国家绝大多数官员都将面临死刑棗要知道贪污受贿判处死刑的起征点很低啊，十几万就可以判死刑了，如果这样的话，恐怕计划生育也不用搞了，（笑声）几千万官员瞬间就没有了。这倒好，但是我们更应当加强制度建设，而不是迷信死刑，或者用死弄来敷衍塞责，敷衍我们的老百姓。
5f7e159a5d9106988f26b33e62d113f0b7b8362f.translatedText: If you don’t establish a good system in the front, it will only be a shock later, which is useless! You can see that in the past few years, the amount of money involved in the case has become larger and larger, the number of people involved has increased, and the level of the officials involved has become higher and higher. Frankly speaking, I dare not pursue the case thoroughly now. If we pursue it thoroughly, and if our country's judiciary really becomes independent, then the vast majority of officials in this country will face the death penalty. You must know that the starting point for the death penalty for corruption and bribery is very low. A few hundred thousand can be sentenced to death. If this is the case, I am afraid that family planning will not be necessary. (Laughter) Tens of millions of officials will be gone in an instant. This is good, but we should strengthen system construction instead of being superstitious about the death penalty, or using death to perfunctory our people.

0107b7d128b9b8651ad596e2e92059643202fba2.sourceText: 以下是马英九总统国际记者会谈话全文
0107b7d128b9b8651ad596e2e92059643202fba2.translatedText: The following is the full text of President Ma Ying-jeou's speech at the International Press Conference

b982b2ec4236c68498e8ba8429be2237f065d3a8.sourceText: 以下是马英九总统国际记者会谈话全文 各位乡亲父老、国人同胞，大家早安，大家好！ 一、 政府关心学生，也关心台湾…
b982b2ec4236c68498e8ba8429be2237f065d3a8.translatedText: The following is the full text of President Ma Ying-jeou's speech at the International Press Conference Dear fellow countrymen, elders and compatriots, good morning, everyone! 1. The government cares about students and Taiwan...

8eaa48fdf3ea285e516954997c37f207f7b82ddc.sourceText: 各位乡亲父老、国人同胞，大家早安，大家好！
8eaa48fdf3ea285e516954997c37f207f7b82ddc.translatedText: Dear fellow countrymen, elders and compatriots, good morning, everyone!

6a734a1b9359d56b034f1cd204e56bfc3cc6d44f.sourceText: 一、 政府关心学生，也关心台湾经济 这几天，全国同胞都在关心学生占领立法院议场、长期抗争的发展，以及对两岸服贸协议的讨论。我跟大家一样关心，也跟大家一样忧心。我今天特别出面，跟大家讲清楚我的看法。
6a734a1b9359d56b034f1cd204e56bfc3cc6d44f.translatedText: 1. The government cares about students and Taiwan's economy. In the past few days, compatriots across the country have been concerned about the development of students' occupation of the Legislative Yuan, the development of long-term protests, and the discussion of the cross-strait trade in services agreement. I share everyone's concerns and share everyone's worries. I came forward today to make my views clear to you.

5fbcffa1c742236889d13fda5bce5a01281a19d9.sourceText: 二、 年轻人关心国是，国家才有前途。 首先，对在立法院议场的学生，我瞭解大家对服贸议题的关注，也肯定各位的热情与出发点。我在大学时代与留学美国时代，也都关心国是，也曾经参加学生运动。我非常瞭解，年轻人关心国是，勇于参与，国家才有前途。
5fbcffa1c742236889d13fda5bce5a01281a19d9.translatedText: 2. Only when young people care about national affairs can the country have a future. First of all, to the students in the Legislative Yuan, I understand your concerns about trade in services issues, and I recognize your enthusiasm and starting point. When I was in college and studying in the United States, I cared about national affairs and participated in student movements. I know very well that only when young people care about national affairs and have the courage to participate can the country have a future.

18eb9a973646a91f67a072acd07ba1656dd64692.sourceText: 三、 台湾民主法治得来不易，不要轻易毁弃 然而，我也必须严肃向国人同胞报告，台湾民主的成果得来不易，20多年来，历经国会全面改选、五次总统直选、七次修宪，现在已是华人社会的民主典范；而法治是民主的基础，没有法治，就没有民主。而坚守法治，是我们立国的根本。 两岸服贸协议还在立法院审议阶段，程序还没有走完，目前也还未定桉，外界对服贸协议有任何意见，未来在审议过程中，都还有充分表达的空间。但学生因为不满国会审查程序，就以违反法律的方式，佔领立法院议场，使国会运作全面瘫痪了五天，对立法、行政等五院的运作，造成严重的影响。
18eb9a973646a91f67a072acd07ba1656dd64692.translatedText: 3. Taiwan’s democracy and rule of law are hard-won, and should not be discarded easily. However, I must also seriously report to my compatriots that the achievements of Taiwan’s democracy are hard-won. Over the past 20 years, after comprehensive re-election of Congress, five direct elections of the president, and seven constitutional amendments, it is now a model of democracy in Chinese society; and the rule of law is the foundation of democracy. Without the rule of law, there is no democracy. Adhering to the rule of law is the foundation of our country. The Cross-Strait Trade in Services Agreement is still under review by the Legislative Yuan, and the procedures have not been completed. It has not been finalized yet. If the outside world has any opinions on the Trade in Services Agreement, there is still room for full expression during the review process in the future. However, because students were dissatisfied with the review process of Congress, they occupied the Legislative Yuan chamber in violation of the law, completely paralyzing the operations of Congress for five days, and seriously affecting the operations of the five chambers, including the legislative and executive chambers.

7532cc6f880a90da34467779c37c25dc59b7e028.sourceText: 让我们冷静想一想，难道这就是我们要的民主吗？一定要用这样的方式来牺牲法治吗？我们不是以台湾的民主法治自傲吗？身为中华民国总统，我必须依据宪法捍卫民主与坚持法治，因为没有法治，民主也将不保， 这是政府不能动摇的基本立场。
7532cc6f880a90da34467779c37c25dc59b7e028.translatedText: Let us calmly think about it, is this the democracy we want? Is it necessary to sacrifice the rule of law in this way? Aren’t we proud of Taiwan’s democracy and rule of law? As the President of the Republic of China, I must defend democracy and uphold the rule of law in accordance with the Constitution, because without the rule of law, democracy will not be preserved. This is the basic position that the government cannot shake.

23b761590e48885e10f27a35e19ed46cb9f6fcc9.sourceText: 四、台湾为什麽要跟大陆签服贸协议？ 这几天很多民众在问，立法院为什麽一定要通过服贸协议？我要再次以负责任的态度向各位报告，这完全是为了台湾经济的未来。 各位都知道，台湾是一个小而开放的经济体，经济成长七成要靠对外贸易。由于我国外交处境困难，各国虽然愿意跟台湾做生意，但对于签订自由贸易协定（FTA）就会犹豫。这就是为什麽我国到现在只签了7个自由贸易协定或经济合作协定（其中主要贸易伙伴只有3个），远远落后新加坡、韩国、日本与大陆，我国出口货品必须缴纳的关税，就比他们的货品高出3-7％。因此，我们一定要尽快洽签赶上，才不会被边缘化。各位同胞，区域经济整合是全球势不可挡的浪潮，我们如果不面对它、加入它，就只能等着被淘汰。为了国家的发展，我们真的没有选择，不能再等了！
23b761590e48885e10f27a35e19ed46cb9f6fcc9.translatedText: 4. Why does Taiwan sign a services trade agreement with the mainland? Many people are asking these days, why must the Legislative Yuan pass the Services Trade Agreement? I want to report to you again in a responsible manner. This is entirely for the future of Taiwan's economy. As everyone knows, Taiwan is a small and open economy, and 70% of its economic growth depends on foreign trade. Due to my country's difficult diplomatic situation, although countries are willing to do business with Taiwan, they are hesitant to sign a free trade agreement (FTA). This is why our country has only signed 7 free trade agreements or economic cooperation agreements so far (of which there are only 3 major trading partners), far behind Singapore, South Korea, Japan and the mainland. The tariffs our country must pay for exported goods are 3-7% higher than their goods. Therefore, we must negotiate and sign as soon as possible to catch up, so as not to be marginalized. Dear compatriots, regional economic integration is an unstoppable global trend. If we do not face it and join it, we will only wait to be eliminated. For the development of the country, we really have no choice and can’t wait any longer!

de78ad5eb3b974186eac6c7690fd8a7b8ca5ac4b.sourceText: 3月11日，韩国与加拿大宣布将签署自由贸易协定（FTA），韩国成为亚洲第一个与加拿大签署FTA的国家。未来，韩国97.5％的货品，包括轿车、汽车零组件、冰箱、洗衣机等，都将享受零关税的优惠、畅行无阻。而我国出口到加拿大的货品，却要缴纳关税，我们怎麽跟韩国竞争呢？
de78ad5eb3b974186eac6c7690fd8a7b8ca5ac4b.translatedText: On March 11, South Korea and Canada announced that they would sign a free trade agreement (FTA). South Korea became the first country in Asia to sign an FTA with Canada. In the future, 97.5% of South Korea's goods, including cars, auto parts, refrigerators, washing machines, etc., will enjoy zero-tariff benefits and travel unimpeded. However, our country's goods exported to Canada have to pay tariffs. How can we compete with South Korea?

a7ba34b0c38ae6c9060a9c93b072f606367842b4.sourceText: 韩国是我们最主要贸易竞争对手，在过去十年间，韩国四任总统，不分党派，朝野合作，从只有1个自由贸易协定，到现在已签了11个，包括欧盟与东协，涵盖40多个国家。韩国的厂商，在世界各地享受开放的市场与优惠的关税，我们的厂商却只能眼睁睁看着自己的竞争力慢慢流失。
a7ba34b0c38ae6c9060a9c93b072f606367842b4.translatedText: South Korea is our most important trade competitor. In the past ten years, South Korea has had four presidents, regardless of party affiliation, and the government and the opposition have cooperated. From only one free trade agreement to now, it has signed 11 free trade agreements, including the European Union and ASEAN, covering more than 40 countries. Korean manufacturers enjoy open markets and preferential tariffs all over the world, but our manufacturers can only watch their competitiveness slowly disappear.

0249465e92d82cffa71e21e2e7b734f7157a7254.sourceText: 我们落后韩国十年，现在追赶都来不及了，怎麽还能口口声声说「不要急」呢？一位首长曾经指出，如果我们的服贸协议通不过，最高兴的就是韩国。更麻烦的是：服贸协议通不过，将严重伤害我国国际信用与贸易自由化的努力，也一定会影响我国加入「跨太平洋伙伴协定」（TPP）与「区域全面经济伙伴协定」（RCEP）的机会。
0249465e92d82cffa71e21e2e7b734f7157a7254.translatedText: We are ten years behind South Korea, and now it is too late to catch up. How can we keep saying "don't rush"? A leader once pointed out that if our trade in services agreement fails, South Korea will be the happiest. What’s even more troublesome is that if the trade in services agreement fails to pass, it will seriously harm my country’s international credit and trade liberalization efforts. It will also definitely affect my country’s chances of joining the Trans-Pacific Partnership (TPP) and the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP).

9d5e6074621ea8ba08ff6b1efd94c26cfc8a6bdc.sourceText: 各位同胞，服务业是我国产业主力，产值佔GDP将近七成、从事服务业的人口将近六成，但服务业出口远远落在新加坡、香港、与韩国之后。台湾服务业有创意、有人才、有品质，却因为市场太小、消费人口有限，无法一展长才。「两岸服贸协议」的通过，就是让大陆对台湾业者进一步开放市场，并给予我国服务业者比外资更优厚的条件。年轻人的梦很大，我们不该把他们绑在台湾，我们要支持他们进入更大的市场、进军全世界。事实上，台湾开放陆资已经将近五年，雇用了9600台湾员工，未来服贸协议通过后，也一样会增加台湾人民的工作机会。
9d5e6074621ea8ba08ff6b1efd94c26cfc8a6bdc.translatedText: Dear compatriots, the service industry is the main force of my country's industry, with output value accounting for nearly 70% of GDP and nearly 60% of the population engaged in the service industry. However, service industry exports lag far behind Singapore, Hong Kong, and South Korea. Taiwan's service industry has creativity, talent, and quality, but because the market is too small and the consumer population is limited, it is unable to develop its talents. The passage of the "Cross-Strait Trade in Services Agreement" will allow the mainland to further open its market to Taiwanese businesses and provide my country's service businesses with more favorable conditions than foreign investment. Young people have big dreams. We should not tie them to Taiwan. We should support them to enter larger markets and expand around the world. In fact, Taiwan has been opening up to Mainland capital for nearly five years, employing 9,600 Taiwanese employees. After the future trade in services agreement is passed, it will also increase job opportunities for Taiwanese people.

8fd9ffe5bb19ff46c5d3b6a2825b4f5526d99ebd.sourceText: 五、 对服贸协议的误解 现在坊间流传很多对服贸协议的误会，例如：说服贸如果通过，大陆劳工与移民就会大举入侵，台湾劳工就会失业；台湾出版业会被大陆把持；服贸协议只照顾大企业，忽视中小企业，大陆的营造业、电信业来台投资，会影响我们的国家安全、大陆对台湾开放的项目不对等等等。我要郑重告诉大家，这些都不是事实。我们根本没有开放大陆劳工、移民或出版业来台。事实上，我们开放陆资来台已经近5年了，我们事前的审查与事后的监督都非常严格，违法的立刻遭到处罚并撤资。
8fd9ffe5bb19ff46c5d3b6a2825b4f5526d99ebd.translatedText: 5. Misunderstandings about the Trade in Services Agreement There are many misunderstandings about the Trade in Services Agreement currently circulating in the public. For example: if the trade agreement is passed, mainland workers and immigrants will invade in large numbers, and Taiwanese workers will lose their jobs; Taiwan’s publishing industry will be controlled by the mainland; the Services Trade Agreement only takes care of large enterprises and ignores small and medium-sized enterprises. Investments in the construction and telecommunications industries from the mainland will affect our national security; the projects that the mainland opens to Taiwan are not right, etc. I want to solemnly tell you that these are not facts. We have not opened up mainland workers, immigrants or the publishing industry to come to Taiwan at all. In fact, it has been nearly five years since we opened mainland investment to Taiwan. Our prior review and subsequent supervision are very strict, and those who break the law will be immediately punished and have their investment withdrawn.

309a4736aa61091d0a624faf819af449c24dda1d.sourceText: 而大陆对台湾开放的80项中，电脑服务，房地产服务、旅行社、市场调查、摄影、翻译、建筑物清洁等等，都适用到台湾中小企业，并不是独厚大企业。整体来看，服贸协议是依据我们「以台湾为主，对人民有利」的原则签订，对台湾是利大于弊的，我希望行政部门能够在未来服贸协议审查的过程中，将实际情况做进一步说明，说清楚。 全世界的国家，面对市场开放，都会担心冲击。但台湾市场的自由化不是从今天才开始，早在民国70年代，美国的服务业就打入台湾市场。当时这些担心都曾有过，结果如何？麦当劳、肯德基、星巴克都进来了，但本土产业很快学习到经营模式，发展出像85度C等台式咖啡连锁店，甚至创意加值，行销世界。事实上，在服贸协议中，台湾开放陆资的64个项目，有27个已经开放2至5年了，例如餐饮、租车、中药批发、图书批发零售等等，对台湾市场的影响很有限。对于可能受到冲击的行业，政府匡列了982亿元，分类进行三种方式处理：振兴辅导、体质调整，与损害救助。协议中还有紧急协商、国安例外、实施检讨，与修正规定等条款，随时都可有效因应各种状况。
309a4736aa61091d0a624faf819af449c24dda1d.translatedText: Among the 80 items open to Taiwan by mainland China, computer services, real estate services, travel agencies, market research, photography, translation, building cleaning, etc. are all applicable to Taiwanese small and medium-sized enterprises, and they are not exclusive to large enterprises. Overall, the trade in services agreement was signed based on our principle of "focusing on Taiwan and benefiting the people." It will do more good than harm to Taiwan. I hope that the administrative department can further explain the actual situation and make it clear during the review process of the trade in services agreement in the future. Countries around the world will be worried about the impact when facing market opening. But the liberalization of Taiwan's market did not start today. As early as the 1970s of the Republic of China, the U.S. service industry entered the Taiwan market. I had all these worries at the time. What was the result? McDonald's, KFC, and Starbucks all came in, but the local industry quickly learned the business model and developed Taiwanese coffee chain stores such as 85 Degree C, which even added creative value and marketed it to the world. In fact, in the trade in services agreement, 27 of the 64 projects that Taiwan has opened to mainland investment have been open for 2 to 5 years, such as catering, car rental, wholesale of traditional Chinese medicine, wholesale and retail of books, etc., and their impact on the Taiwan market is very limited. For industries that may be affected, the government has allocated 98.2 billion yuan and classified them into three methods: revitalization counseling, physical adjustment, and damage relief. The agreement also includes provisions such as emergency consultation, national security exceptions, implementation review, and amendment provisions, which can effectively respond to various situations at any time.

08fe449af911e030442fe098e078db46beb8aff2.sourceText: 六、 服贸协议应逐条审查、逐条表决 学生希望服贸协议逐条审查、逐条表决，前天执政党团已经决议一致支持。我在此要呼吁学生早日撤出立法院议场，让立法院恢复正常运作，这也是多数民意的期望，因为其他四院的法桉与预算都跟立法院关係密切。我也期盼立法院王院长与朝野党团，能够儘速让服贸协议回归正常议事程序，作最妥适的处理。 各位同胞、父老乡亲，英九在这裡，要以无比严肃与诚恳的心情向大家报告，国家必须继续向前走，台湾的经济不能被边缘化。我希望大家讨论服贸问题，要以台湾前途为念，不要只顾政党利益。「以台湾为主，对人民有利」是英九执政以来的基本信念，英九保证，推动服贸协议及其他自由贸易协定，都是为了「帮助人民做生意，提升台湾竞争力」，让我们的下一代有更好的未来。
08fe449af911e030442fe098e078db46beb8aff2.translatedText: 6. The Agreement on Trade in Services should be reviewed and voted on article by article. Students hope that the Agreement on Trade in Services should be reviewed and voted on article by article. The day before yesterday, the ruling party group had decided to unanimously support it. I would like to call on students to withdraw from the Legislative Yuan as soon as possible and allow the Legislative Yuan to resume normal operations. This is also the expectation of the majority of public opinion, because the laws and budgets of the other four houses are closely related to the Legislative Yuan. I also hope that President Wang of the Legislative Yuan and the ruling and opposition parties can return the trade in services agreement to normal procedures as soon as possible and handle it in the most appropriate manner. Dear compatriots and fellow countrymen, Ying-jeou is here to report to you with an extremely serious and sincere mood. The country must continue to move forward, and Taiwan's economy cannot be marginalized. I hope that when everyone discusses the issue of trade in services, they should keep Taiwan's future in mind and not just consider the interests of political parties. "Taiwan takes the lead and is good for the people" has been the basic belief of Ying-jeou since he came to power. Ying-jeou pledged to promote the Trade in Services Agreement and other free trade agreements to "help people do business and enhance Taiwan's competitiveness" so that our next generation will have a better future.

ef74559fa891f741c02128e0ad95582728e5506d.sourceText: ”徐徐回望, 曾属于彼此的晚上。红红仍是你, 赠我的心中艳阳。如流傻泪, 祈望可体恤兼见谅。明晨离别你, 路 也许孤单得漫长”11月28日晚，一场别具怀旧韵味的流行音乐演唱会在广州东方宾馆重新唱响。 听众与歌手近在咫尺，边赏金曲，边品茶点，意随曲走，如痴如醉，生动地再现30多年前广州人最为喜爱的文娱夜生活――音乐茶座的表演情景。 当《上海滩》、《晚秋》、《朋友》这些经典怀旧金曲从当年省港杯歌唱大赛、羊城十大歌手大赛冠军歌手们的口中唱出，激昂高亢、抒情浪漫的歌声回荡在当年全国第 一个音乐茶座，把在场的观众带回了30多年前。 这场”粤语怀旧经典金曲演唱会”由广州市文广新局主办，第八届中国音乐金钟奖群众广场系列活动之一。 上世纪80年代红极一时的流行歌手张燕妮、汤莉、古璇，香港首届未来偶像争霸战冠军李达成等重披华服再次登台，在广州东方宾馆音乐茶座上重新演绎曾经脍炙人口的流行歌曲 。 1978年，广州东方宾馆在花园餐厅首开新时期全国第一家以演唱流行歌曲为主的音乐茶座，听众只要花钱买一张票，就可以坐在歌厅边品茗边听歌，音乐茶座一 推出，即在那个舞厅还未兴起的年代引起轰动，顿时引来高朋满座，歌手如云，广州逐渐形成了一个发展流行音乐的舞台，并在民间流传香港地区和台湾地区的流行音乐。 20世纪80年代广州的第一代流行歌手模仿香港歌星达到乱真的程度。 很多广东歌手就是从音乐茶座走向舞台的。 在全国，茶座歌手拓展了广东音乐人的势力，不少内地的歌迷，都是先听了这些” 翻唱歌”之后才开始接触流行音乐的。 就从那时开始，广州就扛起了流行音乐的大旗。 除了在音乐茶座中演出外，广州的很多音乐团体也在演出商的推动下到全国各地演出，成为人们认识广州这一改革开放前沿城市的重要媒介。 毛宁、杨钰莹、那英等众多知名歌手都曾在广东音乐茶座留下歌声与倩影。 30多年前，传唱港台歌曲是广州年轻人的一种时髦，而音乐茶座则是当时年轻人接触、欣赏港台歌曲最直接的舞台，故也是年轻人常去的地方。 ” 那时的娱乐方式比较单一，很多粤语流行歌手，甚至是从翻唱港台歌曲成名的。” 相声名家黄俊英称，当时他所在的广东音乐曲艺团为了适应这股强大的艺术潮流，将艺术 团拆分为三四个小组，轮流在广州市内的各个音乐茶座表演，” 相声演员学唱港台歌，在当时不是新闻是新潮。”说起自己这段”不务正业”的经历，黄俊英 觉得非常美好。 ” 当音乐响起，真有点恍如隔世的感觉。” 当年以翻唱梅艳芳歌曲走红的汤莉，在音乐茶座驻唱是她的第一份工作，” 那时音乐茶座非常红火，我第一个月 的工资就有150元，而我父母当时的工资也不过六七十元。”汤莉说，刚走出大学校门就走入音乐茶座表演，成就了她的艺术之路。 ” 一举手一投足都从这个小舞台学起。”她在1989年第一届省港杯歌唱大赛中夺得冠军，完全得益于在音乐茶座的一番历练。 东方宾馆是我第一个登台的地方。 今天在这里表演很多感触涌上心头。 当时东方宾馆的音乐茶座占地面积非常之大，舞台设在演出厅中间，在那里演唱就好像在体育馆开演唱会一样。 音乐茶座是一个很能锻炼歌艺的地方，要接受观众点唱，小纸条递上来，你最起码要清唱几句。 因此表演之余，我几乎所有的业余时间都用于练歌，所有港台新歌都要烂熟于心。 ” 我非常珍惜在音乐茶座表演的经历。”1991年省港杯歌唱大赛冠军古璇说，当年东方宾馆音乐茶座的观众只有港澳同胞，还要凭代用券入场，到1986年后，才逐步向 广州市民开放，而且，东方宾馆的伴奏乐团是全市最高水平的伴奏乐团。 此次演唱会主办方负责人表示，希望能够借金钟奖这一契机，将广东音乐茶座再次打响，”经典粤语金曲重登现代舞台，让听众重温当年情怀，追寻美好的回忆。”
ef74559fa891f741c02128e0ad95582728e5506d.translatedText: "Looking back slowly, the night that once belonged to each other. Honghong is still you, giving me the sunshine in my heart. If I shed silly tears, I hope you can be considerate and forgiven. I will leave you tomorrow morning, and the road may be lonely." On the evening of November 28, a pop music concert with a unique nostalgic charm was sung again at the Oriental Hotel in Guangzhou. The audience and the singers were close at hand, enjoying the golden tunes and sipping refreshments, and followed the music, mesmerized, vividly recreating the performance scene of the music teahouse, which was the favorite entertainment nightlife of Guangzhou people more than 30 years ago. When classic nostalgic hits such as "Shanghai Beach", "Late Autumn" and "Friends" were sung by the champion singers of the Provincial Hong Kong Cup Singing Contest and the Yangcheng Top Ten Singers Contest, the passionate, high-pitched, lyrical and romantic songs echoed in the first music cafe in the country, bringing the audience back to more than 30 years ago. This "Cantonese Nostalgic Classic Golden Songs Concert" is hosted by the Guangzhou Municipal Bureau of Culture, Radio and Television and is one of the mass square series activities of the 8th China Music Golden Bell Awards. The popular singers Zhang Yanni, Tang Li, Gu Xuan, and Hong Kong's first Future Idol Contest champion Li Dacheng, who were popular singers in the 1980s, once again put on their costumes and re-interpreted their once-popular pop songs at the Guangzhou Oriental Hotel Music Café. In 1978, the Oriental Hotel in Guangzhou opened the country's first music cafe in the new era, which mainly sang pop songs, in the Garden Restaurant. Audiences only had to pay for a ticket and they could sit and drink tea while listening to songs in the song hall. Once the music cafe was launched, it caused a sensation in the era when dance halls had not yet emerged. It immediately attracted many guests and many singers. Guangzhou gradually formed a stage for the development of pop music, and popular music from Hong Kong and Taiwan was spread among the people. In the 1980s, the first generation of pop singers in Guangzhou imitated Hong Kong singers to the point of being unreal. Many Cantonese singers move from music cafes to the stage. Across the country, Tea House Singers have expanded the influence of Cantonese musicians. Many mainland fans first started to get involved in pop music after listening to these "cover songs". Since then, Guangzhou has taken up the banner of pop music. In addition to performing in music cafes, many music groups in Guangzhou also perform across the country with the promotion of performance companies, becoming an important medium for people to understand Guangzhou, a city at the forefront of reform and opening up. Mao Ning, Yang Yuying, Na Ying and many other well-known singers have left their singing voices and beautiful images at Guangdong Music Teahouse. More than 30 years ago, singing Hong Kong and Taiwan songs was a fashion among young people in Guangzhou, and the music cafe was the most direct stage for young people to contact and appreciate Hong Kong and Taiwan songs, so it was also a place where young people often went. "The entertainment method at that time was relatively simple, and many Cantonese pop singers even became famous by singing covers of Hong Kong and Taiwan songs." Huang Junying, a famous cross talk artist, said that in order to adapt to this powerful artistic trend, the Guangdong Music and Art Troupe he was in at that time split the troupe into three or four groups and took turns performing in various music cafes in Guangzhou. " It was not news at the time that crosstalk actors were learning to sing Hong Kong and Taiwanese songs, but it was a new trend. "Speaking of his experience of not doing his job properly, Huang Junying felt very happy. "When the music starts, it feels like it's like another world." Tang Li, who became famous for her cover of Anita Mui's songs, sang in a music cafe as her first job. "At that time, the music cafe was very prosperous. My first month's salary was 150 yuan, and my parents' salary at that time was only 60 or 70 yuan." Tang Li said that she performed in the music cafe as soon as she stepped out of college, which made her artistic career. "I learned every move and every move from this small stage." She won the championship in the first Provincial and Hong Kong Cup Singing Competition in 1989, which was entirely due to her experience in the music cafe. The Oriental Hotel was the first place I went on stage. A lot of feelings came to my mind when I performed here today. At that time, the music cafe of the Oriental Hotel occupied a very large area, and the stage was located in the middle of the performance hall. Singing there was like holding a concert in a stadium. The music cafe is a place where you can practice your singing skills. You have to accept singing requests from the audience, hand over small notes, and you have to sing a cappella at least a few lines. Therefore, after performing, I spend almost all my spare time practicing singing, and I must know all the new songs from Hong Kong and Taiwan by heart. "I cherish the experience of performing in the Music Cafe very much." Gu Xuan, the champion of the 1991 Provincial-Hong Kong Cup Singing Competition, said that at that time, the audience of the Oriental Hotel Music Cafe was only Hong Kong and Macao compatriots, and they had to use vouchers to enter. After 1986, it was gradually opened to Guangzhou citizens. Moreover, the accompaniment orchestra of the Oriental Hotel is the highest level accompaniment orchestra in the city. The person in charge of the organizer of this concert said that he hopes to take advantage of the Golden Bell Award to launch the Guangdong Music Teahouse again. "Classic Cantonese hits will return to the modern stage, allowing the audience to relive the feelings of the past and pursue beautiful memories."

be688d61452274bfa24e593cc1a3a4c8eb676e77.sourceText: 中共中央和国务院联合发出”领导干部在公共塲所禁烟有关事项的通知”，明令禁止在党政机关办公室、通道及卫生间吸烟，并要求领导干部在公共禁烟塲所帯头禁烟。这是一件利国利民、改善环境、改变社会不良风气、抵制贪污腐败的重要举措。抓得准，抓得好。
be688d61452274bfa24e593cc1a3a4c8eb676e77.translatedText: The Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council jointly issued a "Notice on Matters Related to the Ban on Smoking by Leading Cadres in Public Places", which explicitly prohibits smoking in the offices, passages and bathrooms of party and government agencies, and requires leading cadres to ban smoking in public no-smoking places. This is a matter that benefits the country and the people, improves the environment, and changes society. It is an important measure to eliminate bad habits and resist corruption. Get it right and do it well.

6b872eadf16a09789811095a864cb1d192ed4194.sourceText: 抽烟危害自身健康，也危害周围人的健康，污染环境，也是贪污腐败行为的导火索。资料顕示，中国是世界最大的烟草生産和消费国，拥有3.5亿烟民，佔世界烟民的百分之三十五，中国的男性公民中百分之六十七吸烟，每年死亡于与吸烟有关的疾病人数髙达120万人。
6b872eadf16a09789811095a864cb1d192ed4194.translatedText: Smoking harms your own health, harms the health of those around you, pollutes the environment, and is also a trigger for corruption. Data shows that China is the world's largest tobacco producer and consumer, with 350 million smokers, accounting for 35% of the world's smokers, and 6% of its male citizens. Seventeen years ago, 1.2 million people died from smoking-related diseases every year.

e2cd4c5a6015f148adeebe73571f9bfe7c33d5b7.sourceText: 我也曾经是中国烟民队伍中的一员，在烟民队伍中溷迹了近半个世纪，对祖国的香烟文化有过一些接触和了解。香菸夲是一种精神产品，用于提神和解忧，当然也对身体健康有着极大的副作用。香菸在中华文化中，长期以来，也是交友的工具。我的吸烟史就是从这里开始的。大学毕业后，开始在班组做技术员，每天开始工作前要和工人一起讨论工作安排。工人师傅看到新来的技术员，给我递上一枝烟表示对我的敬重和欢迎。我作为一个新的技术人员，要和工人师傅打成一片，当然不能拒絶。一来二去，总不能只抽别人的香烟，来而不往非礼也。我也得常常去买包香烟和工友们分享，自然地我们成了朋友，我也就正式成为一名烟民了。
e2cd4c5a6015f148adeebe73571f9bfe7c33d5b7.translatedText: I was once a member of the Chinese smokers. I have been among the smokers for nearly half a century and have some contact and understanding of the cigarette culture of my motherland. Cigarettes are a spiritual product that are used to refresh and relieve worries. Of course, cigarettes have great side effects on health in China. In culture, it has long been a tool for making friends. This is where my smoking history began. After graduating from college, I started working as a technician in the team. Before starting work, the master worker would give me a cigarette to express his respect and welcome. As a new technician, I must not refuse. It would be disrespectful to only smoke other people's cigarettes. I would often buy a pack of cigarettes to share with my co-workers, and naturally we became friends, and I officially became a smoker.

d8f0c15c16b9c3354b41a597d9906672082666a5.sourceText: 三年困难时期，香菸供应也出了问题，三角二分的简装前门牌香烟买不到，两角六分的黄金叶也买不过到了。那时又出现了分等级的供给制供应，局级以上干部除肉、油外，还可以买到好烟。我那时刚达到工程师的位置，按科处级，可得到买糖和豆的优惠。因为和普通人稍有区别，工人们称我们是糖豆工程师。香烟供应只能和普通民众一样，买到八分钱一包的双鱼牌香烟，不知道那是用什麽杂草根做的烟。当时陝西民众戏称它为三球烟：刚刚点着就灭球了，抽着抽着炸球了(爆裂了)，再一点着散球了（陝西方言）。这段时期，我曾多次决心戒烟，甚至当众把打火机和香菸扔到楼下，要大家监督，但屡屡失败。文化大革命期间，那亦真亦幻令人困惑的年代，香烟更成了解除烦恼和忧愁的最亲密的战友，是思考和交待问题不可或缺的精神食粮，它陪伴着我渡过了多少漫漫的长亱；在干校下放劳动，接受贫下中农再教育的时期，在弥漫着烟草味的茅屋里，香烟拉近了我和贫下中农的关係。实践证明，香烟在人们的交往中，确实起着十分重要的作用。它可以使人们容易亲近，使陌生人变成朋友，化解矛盾，增进友谊。这些是香烟在历史进步中曾起过的作用。
d8f0c15c16b9c3354b41a597d9906672082666a5.translatedText: During the three difficult years, there was also a problem with the supply of cigarettes. The simple Qianmen brand cigarettes that cost three cents and two cents were not available, and the gold leaves that cost two cents and six cents were not available. At that time, the hierarchical supply system emerged. In addition to meat and oil, cadres at the bureau level and above could also buy good cigarettes. At that time, I had just reached the position of engineer. Because we were slightly different from ordinary people, the workers called us sugar bean engineers. We could only buy Pisces cigarettes for eight cents a pack. I didn’t know what kind of weed roots they were made of. At that time, people in Shaanxi nicknamed them three-ball cigarettes: I just lit them. I destroyed the ball, smoked it until it burst (exploded), and lit it again (Shaanxi dialect). During this period, I made many determinations to quit smoking, and even threw lighters and cigarettes downstairs in public, asking everyone to supervise them, but failed every time. During the Cultural Revolution, a confusing era of reality and illusion, cigarettes became the closest comrade to relieve worries and sorrows, and were indispensable spiritual food for thinking and explaining problems. I spent many long years in the cadre school where I was sent to work and received re-education from the poor and lower-middle peasants. In the hut filled with the smell of tobacco, cigarettes brought me closer to the poor and lower-middle peasants. Practice has proved that cigarettes do play a very important role in people's interactions. It can make people more approachable, make strangers become friends, resolve conflicts, and enhance friendship. These are the roles that cigarettes have played in historical progress.

ae3b3b7af3a1bfae1b0bf035eeff56e75c0e3ba2.sourceText: 八十年代后，在改革开放的大潮中，香菸生意如火如荼地蓬勃发展。烟、酒脱离了民间往来的原本含义，好似脱缰的野马，在市场经济和钱权交易中发挥出无穷的能量。企业到政府审批项目，地方政府官员到上级政府办事，送上烟酒成了不成文的规矩。当你提出一个项目需要上级部门批准，领导上说要研究研究，聪明人马上领会到是要烟酒烟酒。按照烟酒不分家的习俗，送烟酒可以不祘作送礼。但新时代的送烟酒，已非传统上敬上一枝烟和敬一杯酒，而是送烟论条，送酒论箱。烟酒的品牌也非从前的前门和二锅头，动輙最低是大中华，还有云烟、红塔山，五粮液、茅台，洋烟洋酒如万宝路，555和红方、黑方、人头马也加入到行列中来，有时中央领导专用的熊猫牌香烟也能见到。最近，从一位将军的老家查出的礼品和成箱的礼酒就装了四个卡车。好烟好酒的价格一再彪升。现在有的香烟每条高达一千多元，一瓶茅台三千多元，相当和超过百姓一个月的伙食费用。我记得八九民运期间曾流传一段故事：当时有一位木匠出身的国家副总理到天津市集会的学生中和群众交谈，他无意识地坐在台阶上，从口袋里掏出中华烟边抽边聊。有位学生突然发问，总理这烟多少钱一包？一天抽几包？你一个月的工资够抽烟吗？他无言以对，就打岔説，咱不谈这个，还是谈复课吧！这位副总理在六四期间敢于和学生对话，还是很贴近群众的。这段故事只是反映出当时公费送烟的普及和群众的不満意程度。烟酒的交易还不止于此，有的人收到礼烟礼酒太多，自己消费和送朋友都消费不掉，一个新生的回收礼烟礼酒的行业应运而生。一些小商店以低价从官员家里收购送礼的烟酒，再以原价卖给用公欵送礼的人。如此形成了”洗烟酒”的怪圈，实现了贪污的实质。
ae3b3b7af3a1bfae1b0bf035eeff56e75c0e3ba2.translatedText: After the 1980s, amid the tide of reform and opening up, the cigarette business flourished. Tobacco and alcohol have been divorced from the original meaning of folk exchanges and are like wild horses running wild, exerting infinite energy in the market economy and money and power transactions. When enterprises go to the government to approve projects, and local government officials go to higher-level governments to handle matters, it has become an unwritten rule to send them cigarettes and alcohol. When you propose a project that requires approval from a higher-level department, and the leader says that you need to study it, smart people will immediately understand that it requires tobacco, alcohol, and alcohol. According to the custom that tobacco and alcohol do not separate families, giving tobacco and alcohol can be used as gifts. But in the new era, giving cigarettes and wine is no longer the traditional way of offering a cigarette and a glass of wine, but rather giving cigarettes and wine boxes. The brands of cigarettes and alcohol are no longer the former Qianmen and Erguotou. The lowest is Greater China, as well as Yunyan, Hongtashan, Wuliangye, and Maotai. Foreign cigarettes and wines such as Marlboro, 555, Red Label, Black Label, and Remy Martin have also joined the ranks. Sometimes, Panda brand cigarettes used by central leaders can also be seen. Recently, four trucks were loaded with gifts and boxes of gift wine seized from a general's hometown. The prices of good tobacco and good wine have skyrocketed again and again. Nowadays, some cigarettes cost more than 1,000 yuan per carton, and a bottle of Maotai costs more than 3,000 yuan, which is equivalent to or more than the food expenses of ordinary people for a month. I remember a story circulated during the 1989 Democracy Movement: At that time, a carpenter-turned-vice-premier went to the students gathering in Tianjin to talk to the masses. He sat unconsciously on the steps, took out Chinese cigarettes from his pocket and smoked while chatting. A student suddenly asked, how much does a pack of Prime Minister's cigarettes cost? How many packs do you smoke a day? Is your monthly salary enough to smoke? He was speechless, so he interrupted and said, "Let's not talk about this, let's talk about resuming classes!" The deputy prime minister dared to talk to students during the June Fourth Movement and was very close to the masses. This story only reflects the popularity of free cigarettes at that time and the level of dissatisfaction among the people. The trade of tobacco and alcohol does not end there. Some people receive too many gifts of tobacco and liquor, and they cannot consume them either for themselves or as gifts to friends. A new industry of recycling tobacco and liquor has emerged at the historic moment. Some small shops purchase tobacco and alcohol as gifts from officials' homes at low prices, and then sell them at the original price to the people who use the public square to give gifts. In this way, a vicious circle of "washing out tobacco and alcohol" was formed, realizing the essence of corruption.

b90890b6827d9dae0998373119e035160cc01de8.sourceText: 抽烟和敬烟是民间的一种习俗，不是採用行政法规可以限制和消除的。但是领导干部抽的髙级香菸，我相信百分之九十九来自公费。党政机关严禁吸烟、干部带头禁烟等于清除了公费送烟的通道。送两条烟虽然不至于给予行政处罚，但是，千里之堤，溃于蚁穴，一些干部走向贪腐的第一步就是从’烟酒不分家’开始，走向公私不分的。写到这里，我突然想起了群众中流传的讽刺干部喝酒的一段打油诗：
b90890b6827d9dae0998373119e035160cc01de8.translatedText: Smoking and toasting cigarettes are folk customs and cannot be restricted or eliminated by administrative regulations. But I believe that 99% of the high-end cigarettes smoked by leading cadres come from public funds. Smoking is strictly prohibited in party and government agencies, and cadres take the lead in banning smoking, which means that the channel for providing cigarettes at public expense has been eliminated. Although sending two cigarettes will not result in administrative penalties, a thousand-mile dike breaks in an ant nest. The first step for some cadres to become corrupt is to start from "not distinguishing between tobacco and alcohol" and move towards not distinguishing between public and private affairs. As I write this, I suddenly think of a limerick circulated among the masses that satirizes cadres for drinking:

0208c778c97b1c8bbcf4900c85a0c8063013227c.sourceText: 天天喝酒天天醉，喝得老婆背靠背。老婆找到纪检会，纪检会说只管纪律不管醉。老婆找到党委㑹，党委会说能喝不喝也不对。
0208c778c97b1c8bbcf4900c85a0c8063013227c.translatedText: Drinking every day, getting drunk every day, so drunk that my wife is back to back. My wife went to the Disciplinary Inspection Committee, and the Disciplinary Inspection Committee said that she only enforced discipline and did not care about drunkenness. My wife went to the party committee, and the party committee said it was wrong whether she could drink or not.

3b5c414cb1819841e8b688c0ea9f3d22d95ae576.sourceText: 这反映出群众对放縦干部队伍的烟酒之风是何等不满。干部禁烟令是和去年提出的党政机关八项规定相呼应，是党风廉政的深入。我认为中国的许多国有大企业，虽不是政府机关，也是烟酒歪风的重要滋生地，也应该列入整治范畴。
3b5c414cb1819841e8b688c0ea9f3d22d95ae576.translatedText: This reflects how dissatisfied the masses are with the tobacco and alcohol abuse of the cadres. The ban on smoking for cadres echoes the eight regulations on party and government agencies proposed last year and is a further step forward in the party's work style and clean government. I believe that many large state-owned enterprises in China, although not government agencies, are also important breeding grounds for tobacco and alcohol abuse, and should also be included in the scope of rectification.

a3580762e3fc73a11c25864e054d1bce98ac4574.sourceText: 本次活动分为几个部分，第一部分是慈善拍卖。来宾们以慈善竞买的方式，支持美国亚太裔倡导组织。中午 12 时年会正式开始。分会会长王瑞景向来宾致欢迎辞。感谢当地社团对活动的支持。美国亚太裔倡导组织的副主席 Dr. Leslie Moe Kaiser 也向活动的隆重举办表示祝贺，同时也介绍美国亚太裔倡导组织作为华裔社团的精英组织，取得的成绩，希望更多的朋友加入其中，为亚裔社区做出更大的贡献。
a3580762e3fc73a11c25864e054d1bce98ac4574.translatedText: This event is divided into several parts. The first part is a charity auction. Guests supported Asian and Pacific Islander American advocacy organizations through charity bidding. The annual meeting officially begins at 12 noon. Wang Ruijing, president of the branch, delivered a welcome speech to the guests. Thanks to the local community for supporting the event. Dr. Leslie Moe Kaiser, Vice Chairman of the American Asian Pacific American Advocacy Organization, also expressed congratulations on the grand holding of the event. He also introduced the achievements of the American Asian Pacific American Advocacy Organization as an elite organization of the Chinese community. He hoped that more friends would join it and make greater contributions to the Asian community.

e36926a0d12ee0d9c1aa71ef74acbb09256b5c41.sourceText: 三位亚裔年轻人 Nan Aye, Mary Reh, LeAnn Lyons 获得美国亚太裔倡导组织颁发的奖学金。同时 2014 年获得凤凰城华裔小姐的图桑佳丽李博雅（ Laura Lee ）获得了美国亚太裔倡导组织图桑分会颁发的图桑小姐的荣誉称号。前侨联主席邓朝驹和会长王瑞景为李博雅颁发了图桑小姐的桂冠和奖学金。当日正好是一年一度的父亲节，李博雅向所有的父亲致以诚挚问候，特别是自己的父亲，同时也把荣任凤凰城华裔小姐，图桑小姐的经历，参加慈善活动的感受分享给更多的年轻人，希望大家能为社区尽一份自己的力量。
e36926a0d12ee0d9c1aa71ef74acbb09256b5c41.translatedText: Three young Asians, Nan Aye, Mary Reh, and LeAnn Lyons, received scholarships from Asian Pacific American advocacy organizations in the United States. At the same time, Tucson beauty Laura Lee, who won Miss Chinese Phoenix 2014, received the honorary title of Miss Tucson from the Tucson chapter of the Asian Pacific American advocacy organization. Former Overseas Chinese Federation Chairman Deng Chaoju and President Wang Ruijing awarded Li Boya the Miss Toussaint crown and scholarship. That day happened to be the annual Father's Day. Li Boya extended her sincere greetings to all fathers, especially her own father. She also shared her experience of being named Miss Chinese Phoenix, Miss Toussaint, and her feelings about participating in charity activities with more young people. She hopes that everyone can do their part for the community.

080252d4a3d9a9116054f122e079e97d9d75eaa8.translatedText: The American Asian Pacific American Advocacy Organization is an elite group of Chinese Americans across the United States. They have done a lot of practical things to protect the interests of Asian and Pacific Islanders. There is also a branch in Phoenix City, and the president is Ms. Wang Mao. We hope that more young people who are willing to contribute to the community will participate in this organization.
