f40793eb2e7dc5bcb3d868dee01004c31a659f1f.sourceText: 北京情思~相约凤凰城——–北京市侨联艺术团简介 〔亚省华联供稿〕”北京情思~相约凤凰城”2013迎新春综艺联欢会将于2013年2月15日在 Mesa Arts Center 举行。联欢会由北京市侨联和 亚省华联 共同主办，并由当地众多华人华侨组织的参与和支持。 本次赴美国、加拿大慰问演出的艺术团成员由来自中国广播艺术团、中国东方歌舞团、中国铁路文工团和北京风雷京剧团的艺术家们组成。艺术团成员有国家一级演员，多次在国家级比赛中获第一名，代表中国艺术团多次出国访问演出，深受海内外观众的欢迎。有从中央电视台星光大道走出来的蒙古族呼麦表演艺术家。有国家一级魔术师，曾先后出访美国、加拿大、日本、坦桑尼亚、赞比亚、南非、刚果、苏丹、斯里兰卡等20多个国家和地区。有获得第三届全国舞蹈大赛最佳表演奖的中国东方歌舞团青年舞蹈艺术家。有获得国际舞蹈大赛金奖的中国铁路文工团舞蹈演员。有著名口技表演艺术家和著名京剧表演艺术家。 演出节目包括歌曲演唱、舞蹈、口技、呼麦、书法绘画、魔术、京剧等丰富多彩的艺术形式。艺术团阵容强，规格高，无疑将为当地华侨华人带来精彩纷呈的文化艺术盛宴，增添节日的欢乐与喜庆。 设备一流的 Mesa Arts Center 座落于 Mesa 市中心，地址是：1 East Main Street，Mesa，AZ 85201。届时门票一定会热销。此外，艺术团赴美国、加拿大演出期间，北京市侨联还将拜会部分侨团，与当地华侨华人座谈。
f40793eb2e7dc5bcb3d868dee01004c31a659f1f.translatedText: Love in Beijing~Meet in Phoenix——-Introduction to Beijing Federation of Overseas Chinese Art Troupe [Contributed by Alberta Hualian] "Beijing Love~Meet in Phoenix" 2013 New Year Variety Show will be held on February 15, 2013 at the Mesa Arts Center. The party was co-sponsored by the Beijing Overseas Chinese Federation and the Alberta Overseas Chinese Federation, and was participated and supported by many local Chinese and overseas Chinese organizations. The members of the art troupe that went to the United States and Canada to perform condolences are composed of artists from China Broadcasting Art Troupe, China Oriental Song and Dance Troupe, China Railway Art Troupe and Beijing Fenglei Peking Opera Troupe. The members of the art troupe include national first-class actors, who have won first place in national competitions many times. They have visited and performed abroad on behalf of the Chinese Art Troupe many times, and are very popular with audiences at home and abroad. There is a Mongolian Khumai performing artist who came out of CCTV’s Avenue of Stars. There is a national first-level magician who has visited more than 20 countries and regions including the United States, Canada, Japan, Tanzania, Zambia, South Africa, Congo, Sudan, and Sri Lanka. There are young dance artists from China Oriental Song and Dance Troupe who won the Best Performance Award in the 3rd National Dance Competition. There are dancers from the China Railway Art Troupe who have won gold medals in international dance competitions. There are famous ventriloquist artists and famous Peking Opera artists. The performances include singing, dancing, ventriloquism, khumai, calligraphy and painting, magic, Peking opera and other colorful art forms. The art troupe has a strong lineup and high standards, and will undoubtedly bring a wonderful cultural and artistic feast to the local overseas Chinese, adding to the joy and celebration of the festival. The state-of-the-art Mesa Arts Center is located in downtown Mesa at 1 East Main Street, Mesa, AZ 85201. Tickets will definitely be in hot demand by then. In addition, when the art troupe performs in the United States and Canada, the Beijing Overseas Chinese Federation will also visit some overseas Chinese troupes and hold discussions with local overseas Chinese.

7ca30043d89cb0869953871ef3e1d1db4c3b6aad.sourceText: 路透社：中共换届接班暗潮汹涌 不排除出现变数
7ca30043d89cb0869953871ef3e1d1db4c3b6aad.translatedText: Reuters: There is a surging undercurrent in the CCP's succession, and variables cannot be ruled out

98dc48dace43673d23c4b514ff7a7785ea150533.sourceText: 路透社：中共换届接班暗潮汹涌 不排除出现变数 继刊发与多维新闻早前报道的中共7常委名单毫无二致的名单后，路…
98dc48dace43673d23c4b514ff7a7785ea150533.translatedText: Reuters: There is a surging undercurrent in the CCP's succession, and variables cannot be ruled out. Following the publication of a list of seven members of the Standing Committee of the Communist Party of China that is exactly the same as the list of seven members of the Standing Committee of the Communist Party of China reported earlier by Duowei News, Lu...

22dcf7042fb7b6567c9cf6495763285c6bcbba79.sourceText: 继刊发与多维新闻早前报道的中共7常委名单毫无二致的名单后，路透社日前再次发表消息称，中共设法让下月登场的新领导班底接班顺利，但背地却充满整肃、阴谋与牢狱之灾。消息说，中国今年的政坛上可能还会迸出更多意外。
22dcf7042fb7b6567c9cf6495763285c6bcbba79.translatedText: Following the publication of a list of seven members of the Standing Committee of the Communist Party of China that is exactly the same as the list of seven members of the Standing Committee of the Communist Party of China reported by Duowei News earlier, Reuters recently published news that the CCP has managed to smooth the succession of the new leadership team that will debut next month, but behind the scenes it is full of purges, conspiracies and prisons. According to sources, there may be more surprises in China’s political arena this year.

20795b6d2d5b4eb056c54ea936f69eb8c328d287.sourceText: 实际上，早在9月13日，多维新闻《中共十八大政治局常委3.0版》就曾指出，依照过往经验，直到十八大确定常委人选最后一刻，人选名单都有可能发生变化，这种变化来自于突发意外、党内程序与民主投票变化等原因。
20795b6d2d5b4eb056c54ea936f69eb8c328d287.translatedText: In fact, as early as September 13, Duowei News' "Member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China Version 3.0" pointed out that based on past experience, the list of candidates may change until the last moment when the 18th National Congress determines the candidates for the Standing Committee. Such changes come from sudden accidents, changes in intra-party procedures and democratic voting, etc.

3f69b5f01836d808a7062ccfbb87feb850fe8680.sourceText: 还有不到两周的时间，中国十年一次的领导人接班大戏即将登场，不过下届领导班子的整体阵容与议程，还是个未知数，而且仍在秘密磋商之中。极少数几乎能完全确定的决定之一，就是现任国家副主席习近平将于11月8日举行的十八大上接下中共党总书记一职。习近平将于明年3月举行的年度人大会议中，正式成为中国国家主席。
3f69b5f01836d808a7062ccfbb87feb850fe8680.translatedText: In less than two weeks, China's once-in-a-decade leadership succession drama is about to begin. However, the overall lineup and agenda of the next leadership team are still unknown, and are still being negotiated in secret. One of the few decisions that is almost completely certain is that current Vice President Xi Jinping will take over the post of General Secretary of the Communist Party of China at the 18th National Congress on November 8. Xi Jinping will officially become China's president at the annual National People's Congress in March next year.

cbe8f84d6ffdec76053f54a310d7dd76fc76f533.sourceText: 该报道引述消息人士指出，中国权力最大的三人，前国家主席江泽民、现任主席胡锦涛及胡锦涛的接班人习近平，日前已敲定党内最高决策机构中共中央政治局候选人名单，以减少因新名单引发任何内斗。消息还引述华盛顿智库布鲁金斯研究所中国政治专家李成表示：仍可能会有意外出现，磋商是相当复杂的过程。李成说，外界不清楚实际状况，我们仅知道20%的内幕。这次将会出现若干最后一刻改变，甚至连政治局常委会也不例外。
cbe8f84d6ffdec76053f54a310d7dd76fc76f533.translatedText: The report quoted sources as saying that China's three most powerful people, former President Jiang Zemin, current President Hu Jintao and Hu Jintao's successor Xi Jinping, have recently finalized the list of candidates for the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, the party's highest decision-making body, to reduce any infighting caused by the new list. The news also quoted Li Cheng, an expert on Chinese politics at the Brookings Institution, a Washington think tank, as saying: There may still be surprises, and consultations are a very complicated process. Li Cheng said that the outside world does not know the actual situation, and we only know 20% of the inside story. There will be several last-minute changes this time, even to the Politburo Standing Committee.

82eac42ca86cf35253844aac768ba0df1ec6bd3b.sourceText: 江泽民、胡锦涛及习近平列出的政治局常委名单，已经出乎外界所料，特别是名单中剔除了强劲人选、57岁的广东省委书记汪洋。许多西方人士视汪洋为中共政治改革人士。该报分析认为，汪洋的落马可能与薄熙来有间接关系。中共重量级政治人物薄熙来，在中国20年来最重大政治丑闻中遭罢黜。分析认为，江泽民、胡锦涛及习近平不希望因支持汪洋，进一步刺激左派人士。
82eac42ca86cf35253844aac768ba0df1ec6bd3b.translatedText: The list of members of the Politburo Standing Committee listed by Jiang Zemin, Hu Jintao and Xi Jinping has exceeded outside expectations, especially the strong candidate Wang Yang, 57-year-old Secretary of the Guangdong Provincial Party Committee, was removed from the list. Many Westerners regard Wang Yang as a political reformer of the Chinese Communist Party. The newspaper analyzed that Wang Yang's dismissal may be indirectly related to Bo Xilai. Bo Xilai, a heavyweight CCP politician, was ousted in China's biggest political scandal in 20 years. Analysts believe that Jiang Zemin, Hu Jintao and Xi Jinping do not want to further stimulate leftists by supporting Wang Yang.

5c520add5ddd377e875c74927be1455416fa3f70.sourceText: 多维新闻率先在今年5月15日独家披露，若无其他重大意外，政治局常委人数由9人变为7人。9月13日，多维新闻根据多个可靠渠道的信息再加以慎重分析后推出《中共十八大政治局常委3.0版》，认为这7位常委最有可能的人选已经基本定案，由习近平、李克强、张德江、王岐山、李源潮、刘云山和张高丽组成。这7大人选是基于即将继任中共最高领导人习近平的强势推动，各方都给予了支持与让步。而中共前最高领导人江泽民以十八大人事安排”总顾问”的身份给予了大力支持，现任中共最高领导人胡锦涛在充分尊重老同志意见基础上与习近平密切协作，发挥了积极建设性的作用。
5c520add5ddd377e875c74927be1455416fa3f70.translatedText: Duowei News was the first to exclusively disclose on May 15 this year that, barring other major surprises, the number of members of the Politburo Standing Committee has been increased from 9 to 7. On September 13, Duowei News launched the "Political Bureau Standing Committee of the 18th CPC National Congress Version 3.0" based on careful analysis of information from multiple reliable channels. It believed that the seven most likely candidates for the Standing Committee have been basically finalized and are composed of Xi Jinping, Li Keqiang, Zhang Dejiang, Wang Qishan, Li Yuanchao, Liu Yunshan and Zhang Gaoli. The candidates for these seven congresses are based on the strong promotion of Xi Jinping, the incoming top leader of the Communist Party of China, and all parties have given support and concessions. The former top leader of the Communist Party of China, Jiang Zemin, provided strong support as the "general adviser" on personnel arrangements for the 18th National Congress. The current top leader of the Communist Party of China, Hu Jintao, worked closely with Xi Jinping on the basis of fully respecting the opinions of veteran comrades and played a positive and constructive role.

afe7b8fde8061e4bba76bfb52c1eaa16c6f889a2.sourceText: 路透社在10月19日下午的爆料与多维新闻3.0版完全一致。该英国引述3位消息人士的话称，江泽民、胡锦涛和习近平三人已经就十八大7大常委人选达成一致，此举意在数月”混乱”后为十八大顺利交权铺平道路。该英国媒体将人选名单称为”首选名单”（the preferred list），认为其中人选都被视为和江泽民、胡锦涛亲近的人。
afe7b8fde8061e4bba76bfb52c1eaa16c6f889a2.translatedText: Reuters’ revelations on the afternoon of October 19th are completely consistent with Multidimensional News Version 3.0. The British newspaper quoted three sources as saying that Jiang Zemin, Hu Jintao and Xi Jinping have reached an agreement on the candidates for the seven standing committees of the 18th National Congress. This move is intended to pave the way for the smooth transfer of power at the 18th National Congress after months of "chaos." The British media called the list of candidates the "preferred list" and believed that the candidates were all considered to be close to Jiang Zemin and Hu Jintao.

7d87afb1797ecf71a977889772d054110389ddf9.translatedText: Longgang Office held a festive spring banquet in Phoenix. At 7 pm on March 27, Longgang Office held a spring banquet at Lukfu Restaurant in Phoenix. More than one hundred and seventy guests...

d5e73965219dc1fcda4d4a5aea80f500e52eaa12.sourceText: 龙岗公所在凤凰城举行节日春宴 3 月 27 日晚 7 點，龍崗公所劉關張趙四姓在鳳凰城六福酒家舉辦春宴。一百七十多位賓客出席，一片節日喜慶氣氛。首先由醒獅隊瑞獅採青賀歲，在隆隆的鼓聲中掀開了晚宴序幕。隨即表演了中國傳統扇子舞，獲得陣陣掌聲。春宴的主持人文化交流協會的會長張華芳，邀請到了龍崗公所的主席關嬿儀。關嬿儀介紹了來到現場的貴賓，其中就有德高望重的資深僑領余文勁，僑聯主席鄧朝駒，餐館會主席梅樹德等。 在鳳凰城春宴大都內容都是社團成員的娛樂活動，龍崗公所的春宴卻有一些非常獨特的設計。龍崗公所副主席張肇鴻製作了一個視頻短片，為嘉賓們介紹了龍崗公所的歷史。龍崗公所成立於 19 世紀 20 年代，最早是紀念三國時期桃園三結義的親義精神而創立的。鳳凰城的分所成立於 1973 年，鳳凰城第一個僑聯主席關崇瓊和劉汝璋，劉宜人 等人成立，如今來參加春宴的公所成員已經超過百人。張張老照片，呈現了鳳凰城龍崗公所的步伐。龍崗公所不僅有很多的商界傑 ​​ 出人才，還出了很多才子和美女。片中 就提到了關家姐妹花，碧霞以及她的妹妹當選為華裔小姐，華商小姐，並積極參加華人社區的公益活動。 2011 年的春天龍崗公所再次喜慶新年的開始，歡樂的氣氛還是不變的，鳳凰城卡拉行比賽最受歡迎歌手吳雄峰為嘉賓們帶來了精彩的演唱，資深僑領余文勁也被美女們叫上主席台合影留念，僑聯主席鄧朝駒，餐館會主席梅樹德帶領餐館會的董事上台獻歌，獻舞。晚上 9 點半，春宴在歡聲笑語中圓滿結束。
d5e73965219dc1fcda4d4a5aea80f500e52eaa12.translatedText: > Longgang Office held a festive spring banquet in Phoenix City. At 7 pm on March 27, Longgang Office Liu Guan, Zhang and Zhao held a spring banquet at Liufu Restaurant in Phoenix City. More than 170 guests attended, creating a festive atmosphere. First, the lion dance team gathered young lions to celebrate the new year, and the dinner kicked off with the sound of drums. Then they performed a traditional Chinese fan dance and received bursts of applause. The host of the Spring Banquet, Zhang Huafang, president of the Cultural Exchange Association, invited Guan Yanyi, chairman of the Longgang Office. Guan Yanyi introduced the distinguished guests who came to the scene, including the respected senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin, Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Deng Chaoju, Chairman of the Restaurant Association Mei Shude, etc. Most of the spring banquets in Phoenix City are entertainment activities for club members, but the spring banquet at Longgang Office has some very unique designs. Zhang Zhaohong, Vice Chairman of Longgang Office, produced a short video to introduce the history of Longgang Office to the guests. The Longgang Office was established in the 1820s. It was first established to commemorate the spirit of fraternity and fraternity of the Three Brothers in Taoyuan during the Three Kingdoms period. The Phoenix branch was established in 1973 by Guan Chongqiong, the first chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation in Phoenix, Liu Ruzhang, Liu Yiren and others. Today, more than a hundred members of the office have come to attend the Spring Banquet. Old photos show the pace of Longgang Office in Phoenix City. Longgang Office not only has many outstanding talents in the business world, but also has many talented people and beauties. In the film, it is mentioned that the sisters of the Guan family, Bixia and her sister were elected as Miss Chinese and Miss Chinese Business, and actively participated in charity activities in the Chinese community. In the spring of 2011, Longgang Office once again celebrated the beginning of the New Year, and the joyful atmosphere remained unchanged. Wu Xiongfeng, the most popular singer in the Phoenix Karaoke Competition, gave a wonderful performance to the guests. Senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin was also called to the podium by the beauties to take a group photo. Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Deng Chaoju, and Restaurant Association Chairman Mei Shude led the directors of the Restaurant Association to perform songs and dances. At 9:30 pm, the Spring Banquet ended successfully with joy and laughter.

4920ed80f550edcb8b3a595cdee8dbb4a6ea261d.translatedText: Kiosks in Arizona shopping malls were fined for not marking prices

d59e19424fab48587cd9bd55dd67b1741b610ddf.translatedText: Kiosks in Arizona shopping malls were fined for not marking prices. The state Department of Weights and Measures recently conducted a surprise inspection and found that many kiosks in shopping malls marked product prices, violating state law...

78561e5f07b3bd59071c1e14189f310f1cfa3166.sourceText: 亚利桑那购物中心内商亭不标价遭罚 州度量衡部门最近突击检查，发现不少购物中心内的商亭标出商品价格，违反州法律。 部门在七、八月检查了Christown Spectrum Mall，Superstition Springs Mall, Scottsdale Fashion Square和Desert Sky Mall四个购物中心的52个商亭，发现只有一半商亭遵守法律规定，给所有销售商品标明价格。 度量衡部价格总管肖恩马尔克斯说，如消费者在任何商店、商亭发现没有标价的货品，有权拒绝付款，并向该部门举报。
78561e5f07b3bd59071c1e14189f310f1cfa3166.translatedText: Kiosks in Arizona shopping malls were fined for not marking prices. The state Department of Weights and Measures recently conducted a surprise inspection and found that many kiosks in shopping malls marked product prices, violating state law. The department inspected 52 kiosks at four shopping malls, Christown Spectrum Mall, Superstition Springs Mall, Scottsdale Fashion Square and Desert Sky Mall, in July and August and found that only half of the kiosks complied with the law and marked the prices of all goods for sale. Sean Marquez, director of prices at the Department of Weights and Measures, said that if consumers find goods without price tags in any store or kiosk, they have the right to refuse payment and report them to the department.

7cb36c021efdb8ad269f004aec26c9e30cb161c8.sourceText: 中国超美国等国成世界第一大国际旅游消费国 联合国世界旅游组织4日发表声明说，中国2012年已超越美国等国，成为…
7cb36c021efdb8ad269f004aec26c9e30cb161c8.translatedText: China surpassed the United States and other countries to become the world's largest international tourism consumer. The United Nations World Tourism Organization issued a statement on the 4th, saying that China had surpassed the United States and other countries in 2012, becoming...

fce4bb12616a33714960cc668f33f8ed2d432a32.sourceText: 联合国世界旅游组织4日发表声明说，中国2012年已超越美国等国，成为世界第一大国际旅游消费国。
fce4bb12616a33714960cc668f33f8ed2d432a32.translatedText: The United Nations World Tourism Organization issued a statement on the 4th, saying that China had surpassed the United States and other countries in 2012 and became the world's largest international tourism consumer.

34cd28f4ceb75c8e01657b025bb2f11dc040c926.sourceText: 世界旅游组织说，中国人2012年在海外旅游消费额达1020亿美元，创下历史纪录，同时比2011年的730亿美元海外旅游消费额增长了40%。
34cd28f4ceb75c8e01657b025bb2f11dc040c926.translatedText: The World Tourism Organization said that Chinese overseas tourism consumption reached US$102 billion in 2012, setting a historical record and an increase of 40% from the US$73 billion in overseas tourism consumption in 2011.

67295c463e200e65283fe405b64ebf3c8977d358.sourceText: 声明指出，过去10年间，中国国际旅游市场的发展一直是全球最快的，至今依然如此，这要归功于中国城镇化的发展，可支配收入的增长以及对国际旅游限制的放松。
67295c463e200e65283fe405b64ebf3c8977d358.translatedText: The statement pointed out that over the past 10 years, the development of China's international tourism market has been the fastest in the world and remains so today, thanks to the development of China's urbanization, the growth of disposable income and the relaxation of restrictions on international travel.

959fb9c3af6b95620d4de7831b8ac50a3c8eb8df.sourceText: 2000年至2012年间，中国海外旅游的游客人数从1000万增加到了8300万，其旅游消费额增长了近八倍。世界旅游组织指出，以境外旅游消费额来衡量，中国在2005年时排名世界第七，此后陆续超过了意大利、日本、法国和英国，2012年中国更超过此前长期占据前两位的德国和美国，成为世界第一。
959fb9c3af6b95620d4de7831b8ac50a3c8eb8df.translatedText: Between 2000 and 2012, the number of Chinese overseas tourists increased from 10 million to 83 million, and their tourism consumption increased nearly eight times. The World Tourism Organization pointed out that in terms of overseas tourism consumption, China ranked seventh in the world in 2005. Since then, it has successively surpassed Italy, Japan, France and the United Kingdom. In 2012, China surpassed Germany and the United States, which had long occupied the top two positions, and became the first in the world.

ec1187313a1dd7dd2b29937ee4c5d3f9d3c3ba3b.sourceText: 世界旅游组织秘书长瑞法依表示，新兴经济体仍然带动着世界旅游需求的增长，中国和俄罗斯令人瞩目的旅游消费增长显示了两国中产阶级力量的蓬勃壮大，也必然会对全球旅游格局产生新的影响。
ec1187313a1dd7dd2b29937ee4c5d3f9d3c3ba3b.translatedText: Secretary-General of the World Tourism Organization Ruifai said that emerging economies are still driving the growth of world tourism demand. The impressive growth of tourism consumption in China and Russia shows the vigorous growth of the middle class in both countries and will inevitably have a new impact on the global tourism pattern.

6a02d04aa7164501a656c048a22d9c4a796a25cc.sourceText: 除中国外，其他几个新兴经济国家的旅游经济也在振兴中。俄罗斯的境外旅游消费2012年达到430亿美元，比上一年增加32%，跃居世界第五。巴西未能挤进前十名，但也以220亿美元排在第12位，和2005年的第29位相比显著提高。
6a02d04aa7164501a656c048a22d9c4a796a25cc.translatedText: In addition to China, the tourism economy of several other emerging economic countries is also revitalizing. Russia's overseas tourism consumption reached US$43 billion in 2012, an increase of 32% over the previous year, ranking fifth in the world. Brazil failed to crack the top ten, but it ranked 12th with $22 billion, a significant improvement from 29th in 2005.

b9c4b995275d94a8a2e136b6bdebf248423f7a2d.sourceText: 发达国家方面，美国和德国的境外旅游消费额均增长6%，加拿大增长7%，英国增长4%，日本增长3%。但也有部分发达国家的境外旅游消费额下降，如法国下降6%，意大利下降1%。
b9c4b995275d94a8a2e136b6bdebf248423f7a2d.translatedText: In terms of developed countries, the overseas tourism consumption of the United States and Germany increased by 6%, Canada increased by 7%, the United Kingdom increased by 4%, and Japan increased by 3%. However, overseas tourism consumption in some developed countries fell, such as France, which dropped by 6%, and Italy, which fell by 1%.

The baby boomers are gradually withdrawing from the workplace. Many have worked in the United States for more than 40 years. In recent years, the first generation immigrants from Taiwan have...

cb424838b4d48f658e6a3b6fcc54087c1404e340.sourceText: 台湾移民第一代 掀返乡潮 婴儿潮时代逐渐从职场引退，不少在美打拚超过40年，来自台湾的第一代移民，近年来一一返台定居「落叶归根」。台湾完善的医疗制度、便宜的生活费，固然是他们决定回台原因，然回到从小成长的故乡，「人亲、土亲」这分与家乡无法切割的情怀，更是他们「告老还乡」最佳写照。 驻洛杉矶台北经济文化办事处秘书赖韦君表示，今年初至今，申办中华民国护照量增加不少，今年3、4月护照量更上千本，不少人向他们透露「来美40多年，现在举家搬迁回台」。 「跟去年相比，领务的业务量增加了三、四成。」驻旧金山台北经文处领务组长林科扬指出，虽然无法判断这些重办台湾护照者，是否决定回台长住，但是由于有些申办者的台湾护照已过期二、三十年，可见过去数十年都没有使用台湾护照。现在重办，「或许可以推理说，是因为台湾健保福利比较好，大家想回去养老。」 非营利亚美老人服务中心执行主任尹大燕指出，近五年来，中心服务的老人与周围朋友「愈来愈多人返乡定居」，光是今年初至今，身边已有三对婴儿潮退休朋友搬回台湾，不少台侨回到台湾外，也有台侨选择定居上海，「更在上海组成俱乐部，定期聚会」。 尹大燕说，「两边生活费相差太多」是这些退休人士做此决定主要原因，这几年美国经济不景气，薪水少但生活费却不断上涨，相较之下，台湾「便宜与方便」多了。不仅如此，台湾地小人稠，人与人间因距离近多了交流，许多人返台后「活动多多，生活开心」。
cb424838b4d48f658e6a3b6fcc54087c1404e340.translatedText: The first generation of Taiwanese immigrants are starting a wave of returning home. As the baby boomers gradually retire from the workplace, many first-generation immigrants from Taiwan who have worked hard in the United States for more than 40 years have returned to Taiwan one by one in recent years to settle down and "return to their roots." Taiwan's comprehensive medical system and cheap living expenses are certainly the reasons why they decided to return to Taiwan. However, returning to the hometown where they grew up, and the inseparable feelings of "people and locals" that are inseparable from their hometown, is the best portrayal of their "retirement and return to their hometown". Lai Weijun, secretary of the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Los Angeles, said that since the beginning of this year, the number of applications for Republic of China passports has increased a lot. In March and April this year, the number of passports exceeded a thousand. Many people told them that they had been in the United States for more than 40 years and now their families have moved back to Taiwan. "Compared to last year, the volume of consular affairs has increased by 30 to 40%." Lin Keyang, head of the consular affairs team of the Taipei Cultural Affairs Office in San Francisco, pointed out that although it is impossible to judge whether these Taiwanese passport re-issuers have decided to return to Taiwan for a long time, because some applicants' Taiwanese passports have expired for 20 to 30 years, it can be seen that Taiwanese passports have not been used in the past decades. Now that it is being re-opened, "it may be argued that people want to go back to retire because Taiwan's health insurance benefits are better." Yin Dayan, executive director of the non-profit Asia-American Elderly Service Center, pointed out that in the past five years, "more and more people and friends served by the center have returned to their hometowns to settle down." Since the beginning of this year alone, three pairs of baby boomer retired friends have moved back to Taiwan. Many Taiwanese overseas Chinese have returned to Taiwan, and some Taiwanese overseas Chinese have chosen to settle in Shanghai. "They have even formed clubs in Shanghai and have regular gatherings." Yin Dayan said that "the difference in living costs between the two sides" is the main reason for these retirees to make this decision. In recent years, the U.S. economy has been in recession, and wages are low but living costs have been rising. In comparison, Taiwan is "much cheaper and more convenient." Not only that, Taiwan is a small and densely populated place, and people can communicate more easily due to the close distance. Many people "have a lot of activities and live a happy life" after returning to Taiwan.

e24fbe92483ed3cc68926788ac6d56c1736452de.sourceText: （本网讯）2013年10月21日近400中美友人在六福酒家热烈欢迎新任驻洛杉矶台北经济文化办事处（经文处）处长令狐荣达大使，首次到访凤凰城。当日，台湾监察委员尹祚芊也在凤凰城，大家共襄盛举，度过了一个难忘的夜晚。
e24fbe92483ed3cc68926788ac6d56c1736452de.translatedText: (This website's news) On October 21, 2013, nearly 400 Chinese and American friends warmly welcomed Ambassador Linghu Rongda, the newly appointed director of the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office (Scripture Office) in Los Angeles, on his first visit to Phoenix. On that day, Taiwan Supervisory Committee member Yin Zuoqian was also in Phoenix. Everyone participated in the grand event and spent an unforgettable night.

44e9d4aa5e06110c01e9a8fc42da3bfe97b7b592.translatedText: Yin Yanhuan Linghu Rongda Yin Zuoqian (Photography by Zheng Hong)

3fac9067076fe29d8176d3ca31fc175162b22a4a.sourceText: 州务卿肯?#36125;内特 scottsdale市长Jim Lane Gilbert市长John Lewis 州参议员余艳芬夫妇等美国政要也亲临现场。本次活动由大凤凰城地区华人侨团联合总会主办（侨联），侨联主席张华芳上台热情欢迎令狐大使的首次参访。侨务咨询委员余文劲，尹衍桓，高志中，亚利桑那州台湾同乡联谊会王瑞瑾，侨务顾问李玲麟，张晴玲，中华总会主席邱顺雄，前白宫亚太事务委员邓朝驹都到场表示祝贺。
3fac9067076fe29d8176d3ca31fc175162b22a4a.translatedText: Secretary of State Ken Nate, Scottsdale Mayor Jim Lane, Gilbert Mayor John Lewis, State Senator Yu Yanfen and his wife, and other American dignitaries also attended the event. This event was hosted by the Greater Phoenix Area Chinese Overseas Chinese Association (Overseas Chinese Federation). Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Zhang Huafang took the stage to warmly welcome Ambassador Linghu for his first visit. Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee members Yu Wenjin, Yin Yanhuan, Gao Zhizhong, Arizona Taiwanese Association Wang Ruijin, Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisors Li Linglin, Zhang Qingling, Chairman of the Chinese Federation Qiu Shunxiong, and former White House Asia-Pacific Affairs Commissioner Deng Chaoju were all present to express their congratulations.

7dd1522968dd6454278a58e30b7ac5db39beb854.translatedText: (Left to right) Zhang Huafang, Yin Yanhuan, Linghu Rongda, Yu Wenjin, Gao Zhizhong (Photography by Zheng Hong)

4cb83dc8991c1cfdfab3d144f0a8855262479af0.sourceText: 虽然是上任后是第一次来凤凰城，令狐大使表示早在13年前，他就与凤凰城结下不解之缘。因公务在2000年来到凤凰城。当记者问及上任后主要工作重点有哪些时，令狐大使说：帮助侨胞回台，做好办理护照等日常工作依然是重点，要求做到服务效率更高，更便民。令狐大使同时表示与美国政府部门会加强联系，促进经济文化交流和合作项目的更大范围，跟深的合作。看似很官方的回答，但与令狐大使首次到凤凰城的行程相联系，就看到他的工作作风。21日当日上午和下午令狐大使就已经见过了ASU的校长Michael Crow先生，要求加大高校间的交流，其中包括增加留学生规模。22日已经与州长简布鲁尔预约，洽谈经济文化合作交流的事项，短短的行程，他是分秒必争，早就已经将工作项目实实在在地落实下来。
4cb83dc8991c1cfdfab3d144f0a8855262479af0.translatedText: Although this is his first visit to Phoenix after taking office, Ambassador Linghu said that he has forged a close bond with Phoenix as early as 13 years ago. I came to Phoenix in 2000 for official business. When a reporter asked what the main work priorities were after taking office, Ambassador Linghu said: Helping overseas Chinese return to Taiwan and doing daily tasks such as applying for passports are still the focus. It is required to make services more efficient and more convenient for the people. Ambassador Linghu also said that he would strengthen ties with the US government departments to promote economic and cultural exchanges and cooperation projects on a larger scale and deepen cooperation with Shenzhen. It seems to be a very official answer, but in connection with Ambassador Linghu's first trip to Phoenix, we can see his work style. On the morning and afternoon of the 21st, Ambassador Linghu had already met with Mr. Michael Crow, the president of ASU, and requested to increase exchanges between universities, including increasing the number of international students. On the 22nd, he made an appointment with Governor Jane Brewer to discuss economic and cultural cooperation and exchange matters. In the short trip, he was racing against time and had already implemented the work projects.

81745bc625f5fbee54e6e6a3ded1a2783c1ac156.sourceText: 欢迎晚宴于当晚9时半，落下帷幕，凤凰城的台湾友人希望令狐大使以后多光顾凤凰城，为海外的台湾朋友带来更多，更快捷的回台服务。活动当晚，现场嘉宾不仅享受到了六福的中华美食，还欣赏到了由贺绿蒂等四位老师给大家带来的中国古典乐曲。
81745bc625f5fbee54e6e6a3ded1a2783c1ac156.translatedText: The welcome dinner ended at 9:30 that night. Taiwanese friends in Phoenix hope that Ambassador Linghu will visit Phoenix more often in the future to bring more and faster services to Taiwanese friends overseas. On the night of the event, the guests not only enjoyed Luk Fook’s Chinese delicacies, but also enjoyed Chinese classical music performed by four teachers including He Ludi.

166a4a9f811821c49aca508b362c54bf83b8c150.sourceText: 进入12月份，距离12月21日所谓玛雅”世界末日”预言到来的日子已屈指可数。尽管自从这个说法热传以来，就一直遭各国专家否认。然而，据英国媒体11月29日报道，越来越多的英国人担心”末日”来临，私下在各方面做着”避难”的准备，如储备大量食物，尝试使用原始武器，演练打猎维生等。而在美国，有300万左右的人为末日作准备，如在自家游泳池养鱼，许多人在准备奢华的地下避难所，甚至让地产商大发横财。
166a4a9f811821c49aca508b362c54bf83b8c150.translatedText: As we enter December, the days before the so-called Mayan "end of the world" prophecy on December 21 are numbered. Although this statement has been denied by experts from various countries since it became popular. However, according to British media reports on November 29, more and more British people are worried about the coming "doomsday" and are privately making preparations for "escape" in various aspects, such as stockpiling large amounts of food, trying to use primitive weapons, practicing hunting to survive, etc. In the United States, about 3 million people are preparing for the end of the world, such as raising fish in their own swimming pools. Many people are preparing luxurious underground shelters, which have even made real estate developers rich.

95e9a5dc8571e665eb8433910dbdc47200a4ab65.translatedText: Fleeing to the countryside to hunt for a living

0d0de76d79e3f4aa7cd4be844e80cece5975da92.sourceText: 科幻小说作家艾德华?#22885;图尔因担忧”末日”来临，14年前特意离开英国，远赴1000英里之外的斯洛伐克偏远乡下居住，认为这会提升他生存的机会。在那里他练习使用弓箭，学着生火烧烤兔肉果腹。后来遇到了现在的妻子勒娜特，他们有三个孩子，一起帮助他打猎，准备食物。”我在为’黑暗时代’作准备。如果英国断电，断油，一周之内大多数人将会死去，”奥图尔称，”我想提前准备好，让我的孩子们有生存的机会。”
0d0de76d79e3f4aa7cd4be844e80cece5975da92.translatedText: Science fiction writer Edward Toole was worried about the coming "doomsday". He deliberately left the UK 14 years ago and went to live in the remote countryside of Slovakia 1,000 miles away, thinking that this would improve his chances of survival. There he practiced using a bow and arrow, and learned to make a fire and grill rabbit meat to satisfy his hunger. Later he met his current wife, Lenate, and they had three children, and together they helped him hunt and prepare food. "I am preparing for the 'dark ages'. If the UK loses power and oil, most people will die within a week," O'Toole said. "I want to prepare in advance so that my children have a chance to survive."

fa678a544ff4c649563a97719cea0574d6db0b5b.sourceText: 奥图尔还相信英国政府也在秘密地为末日准备。”有很多人在作准备，比如俄罗斯，他们都建造了巨大的地堡。俄罗斯的地堡可以容纳俄罗斯所有的人口。”
fa678a544ff4c649563a97719cea0574d6db0b5b.translatedText: O'Toole also believes that the British government is also secretly preparing for the end of the world. "There are many people preparing, such as Russia. They have built huge bunkers. Russian bunkers can accommodate the entire population of Russia."

e3be7e45b552569e14cad8e3dc57cdff76cef841.sourceText: 退伍士兵迈克?#26705;德森现在和妻子以及两个孩子生活在一起。他准备了一辆拖车，如果灾难发生，他和家人在15分钟内就可以抵达位于威尔士的一处藏身地。桑德森说：”坏事情真的会发生，房子烧掉，洪水袭来。如果你动手太迟，就只有死路一条。”
e3be7e45b552569e14cad8e3dc57cdff76cef841.translatedText: Retired soldier Mike Desen now lives with his wife and two children. He has a trailer ready so that if disaster strikes, he and his family can reach a hideout in Wales within 15 minutes. "Bad things do happen, houses burn down, floods come," Sanderson said. "If you act too late, you're going to die."

3f5f9c896b50b3c16e3a601531a5e12f62708db0.sourceText: 自从几年前看到飓风?#21345;特里娜?#32902;虐美国后，桑德森就开始采取行动。他说：”世界上天天都在发生灾难，但我们总以为不会发生在自己头上。”他准备了一车的物资，够一家人3个月所用，甚至还进行过演练，”最难做的决定将是什么时候动身”。
3f5f9c896b50b3c16e3a601531a5e12f62708db0.translatedText: Sanderson has been taking action since watching Hurricane Trina devastate the United States a few years ago. He said: "Disasters happen every day in the world, but we always think that it will not happen to us." He prepared a truck of supplies, enough for a family for three months, and even conducted a drill. "The most difficult decision will be when to leave."

b070ad7fbc7ea844c8367db6142fcd6ecb03a1f4.sourceText: 桑德森打算用上在军队学到的生存技能。他认为城镇是危险的地方，因为人多、资源少，在险恶的境况下，如果有人来抢东西，他会为保护自己家人而杀人。
b070ad7fbc7ea844c8367db6142fcd6ecb03a1f4.translatedText: Sanderson plans to use the survival skills he learned in the military. He believes that towns are dangerous places because there are many people and few resources. In a dangerous situation, if someone comes to rob something, he will kill to protect his family.

94ac5dfdddc5e639a764bce027eea1a3447d750c.sourceText: 末日不来也可应对经济危机
94ac5dfdddc5e639a764bce027eea1a3447d750c.translatedText: We can cope with the economic crisis even if the apocalypse does not come

926ec2d0ce52659e2fb7ed7947a56ffa151cc193.sourceText: 47岁的西蒙?#29380;龙，早年曾当过兵，如今已是5个孩子的父亲。他专门为应对”末日”而建了一间储藏室，塞满了大米、面粉、大豆、白糖、干肉等。而他的应急食品室已经有足够用一年的食物。他还花了2万英镑，确保这些食物在没有电的条件下也能保存。他自己养鸡，种植水果和蔬菜，并学会了制作罐头以及其他食物保存技巧。
926ec2d0ce52659e2fb7ed7947a56ffa151cc193.translatedText: Simon Long, 47, served as a soldier in his early years and is now the father of five children. He built a storage room specifically to prepare for the "doomsday" and filled it with rice, flour, soybeans, sugar, dried meat, etc. And his emergency pantry already has enough food to last a year. He also spent £20,000 ensuring the food could be preserved without electricity. He raised his own chickens, grew fruits and vegetables, and learned canning and other food preservation techniques.

2be3265bfb2d798ddf8baba8f47ce1d04948811b.sourceText: ”我很同情那些毫无准备的人，我绝不和他们一样。”狄龙称，他的目标不仅是应对末日，还要做到在经济不景气的时候，保障家人渡过难关，特别是要照顾好他的妻子诺琳，妻子偏瘫且患有心脏病。
2be3265bfb2d798ddf8baba8f47ce1d04948811b.translatedText: "I sympathize with those who are unprepared, and I am by no means the same as them." Dillon said that his goal is not only to cope with the doomsday, but also to protect his family from difficulties during the economic downturn, especially to take good care of his wife Noreen, who is hemiplegic and suffers from heart disease.

1dbde57838764de9f011127b6736f28c64f551bc.sourceText: 狄龙称，在食品价格不断飙升，加之极端天气频发，多储备点食物总不是什么坏事，绝对不是”脑子有毛病”，”我觉得养家糊口是我的责任，如果危难时刻一旦来临，我不会依赖政府”。
1dbde57838764de9f011127b6736f28c64f551bc.translatedText: Dillon said that as food prices continue to soar and extreme weather occurs frequently, it is not a bad thing to stock up on more food. a0dff2d82d13666794c4502cd0bd08e140bb3df9.sourceText: 有约300万的美国人不同程度地为”末日”作准备，一个凤凰城的居民在自家游泳池中养了1000尾罗非鱼，他称当强大的太阳电磁脉冲把地球文明”变回石器时代”时，自己准备靠这些鱼生存。而另一对夫妇则在家里储藏了2.5万发子弹，以及足够他们吃半个世纪的食物。
a0dff2d82d13666794c4502cd0bd08e140bb3df9.translatedText: About 3 million Americans are preparing for the "doomsday" to varying degrees. A Phoenix resident raised 1,000 tilapias in his swimming pool. He said that when powerful solar electromagnetic pulses turn the earth's civilization "back to the Stone Age," he is prepared to rely on these fish to survive. Another couple stored 25,000 rounds of ammunition and enough food to last them half a century at home.

0342371c631043a5b36a6ac945839b7d42f8dd8f.translatedText: Arizona's Tim Walston is one of those people. His garage is stuffed with food, purified water, weapons and a trailer so he can have a car if disaster strikes. His stockpile of canned chicken will last for 15 years.

787493af7d53d81c45f624fb1d37c16864f09f43.sourceText: 根据数据统计，现在越来越多的美国人开始租住公寓，简化自己的生活。租房，尤其是在不断增长的市场例如亚利桑那，租住公寓被认为有很多好处。 公寓的处理更加灵活。如果你考虑换工作，移到别的城市或者学校，租住公寓提供了更多的灵活性。 价格更加便宜。公寓的均价比独立屋便宜很多，但是与独立屋比，公寓也有很多意想不到的享受。健身房，泳游池，美丽的绿化环境，还可以有免费的水以及垃圾处理系统。租公寓是性价比较高的居住模式。 维护是个轻而易举的事情。当有问题时，物业会很方便的处理。物业费由房主负责。 没有物业税，作为承租人没有物业税 选择一个好的社区和学区。居住公寓可以选择一个好的学区或者离工作地和商业区比较近一些的。这是非常简约的现代生活方式，大都受到年轻人，以及没有孩子的老年人家庭喜爱。
787493af7d53d81c45f624fb1d37c16864f09f43.translatedText: According to statistics, more and more Americans are now renting apartments to simplify their lives. Renting, especially in growing markets such as Arizona, is considered to have many benefits. Apartments are handled more flexibly. If you're considering changing jobs, moving to another city or school, renting an apartment offers more flexibility. The price is cheaper. The average price of an apartment is much cheaper than a detached house, but compared with a detached house, an apartment also has many unexpected benefits. Gym, swimming pool, beautiful green environment, free water and garbage disposal system. Renting an apartment is a cost-effective way of living. Maintenance is a breeze. When there is a problem, the property will handle it easily. Property fees are the responsibility of the homeowner. No property taxes, no property taxes as a tenant Choose a good neighborhood and school district. To live in an apartment, you can choose a good school district or one that is close to work and business districts. This is a very simple modern lifestyle that is mostly loved by young people and elderly families without children.

fd2978ff0b703ff145ac4537f744e6479122524e.sourceText: 1949年生,辽宁省大连人，曾任中国第一汽车集团公司工会副主席。 担任过的社会职务有吉林省企业文联副主席、长春市文化宫联合会副主席、吉林省摄影协会理事、长春市摄影协会理事、徐悲鸿画院油画院副秘书长。 现任中华艺术研究院摄影院院长，中国美术院影像艺术委员会理事。 于丁在诸多艺术领域有所建树，他的摄影作品曾获吉林省15届摄影艺术作品优秀奖。还曾入编吉林省50年文艺作品选摄影卷画册。另有多幅摄影作品见诸报刊杂志。他创作的歌曲曾在中央电视台播出。他创作的油画曾入选《徐悲鸿画院首届油画展》，他创作的多幅国画作品被美国、韩国、英国的美术爱好者收藏。
fd2978ff0b703ff145ac4537f744e6479122524e.translatedText: Born in 1949 in Dalian, Liaoning Province, he once served as vice chairman of the labor union of China FAW Group Corporation. The social positions he has held include vice chairman of the Jilin Enterprise Federation of Literary and Art Circles, vice chairman of the Changchun Cultural Palace Federation, director of the Jilin Provincial Photography Association, director of the Changchun Photography Association, and deputy secretary-general of the Oil Painting Academy of Xu Beihong Painting Academy. He is currently the dean of the Photography Institute of the China Academy of Art and a director of the Imaging Art Committee of the China Academy of Art. Yu Ding has made achievements in many artistic fields. His photography works have won the 15th Jilin Province Photography Art Works Excellence Award. It has also been included in a photographic album of selected literary and artistic works in Jilin Province over the past 50 years. Many other photographic works have been published in newspapers and magazines. His songs have been broadcast on CCTV. The oil paintings he created were selected into the "First Oil Painting Exhibition of Xu Beihong Painting Academy", and many of his traditional Chinese paintings have been collected by art lovers in the United States, South Korea, and the United Kingdom.

ab520b44e7d30ebcf3299c309942e8024b5f15a6.sourceText: 大公报：民进党政客深知“台独”是“死胡同” 中新网9月8日电 香港《大公报》8日刊文说，民进党”台独”为立党之本，实际上民进党政客自己心知肚明”台独”不过是一件选举工具、一种煽情策略。这是因为”台独”根本就是一条死胡同，陈水扁也不讳言’台独’做不到就是做不到，他做不到，李登辉也做不到”。而陈水扁当年把”入联公投”与”大选”绑在一起，不过是糊弄选民。 文章摘编如下： 去年底”维基解密”网站公布了20多万份美国外交机密文件，英国、加拿大、澳洲、俄罗斯、以色列等多个国家也牵涉其中，引发了国际外交界的大震荡。最近这股?#25581;秘风暴?#21561;到了台湾地区，密件内容不乏蓝绿政客的恩怨情仇，不过，最具震撼性的爆料还是昨天揭示的2007年陈水扁当局抛出”入联公投”原来竟是愚弄民众的选举策略。 ”维基”数据显示，当时美国对扁此举高度紧张与不满，但民进党内人士包括当年选举副手参选人苏贞昌在内，都明确表示?#20844;投?#21482;是选战工具，?#31435;委?#31649;碧玲更对美方直言，如果谢长廷当选，民进党就不会再提这个议题，”一切都将回归现实”。 也许有人质疑?#32500;基解密?#30340;真实性，但在”入联公投”一事上，民进党当事人则间接承认了”维基”所言非虚。管碧玲表示，她是希望美方了解民进党不会让情势失控，所以才会强调选后一切都会回归现实。蔡英文也不否认”入联公投”是选举工具，承认”入联公投”确实在选举中扮演一部分的角色。 一直以来，民进党都以”台独”为立党之本，摆出一副”台独”先锋的模样，以标榜自己是一个”有理念”的政党。实际上民进党政客自己心知肚明”台独”不过是一件选举工具、一种煽情策略，选前”说说”，选后”缩缩”。这是因为”台独”根本就是一条死胡同，陈水扁也不讳言?台独’做不到就是做不到，他做不到，李登辉也做不到”。既然”做不到”，陈水扁”政府”当年竟然还把”入联公投”与”大选”绑在一起，糊弄选民，实在是可恶之极。
ab520b44e7d30ebcf3299c309942e8024b5f15a6.translatedText: Ta Kung Pao: DPP politicians know that "Taiwan independence" is a "dead end." China News Service, September 8. Hong Kong's "Tai Kung Pao" published an article on the 8th that the DPP's "Taiwan independence" is the foundation of the party. In fact, the DPP politicians themselves know very well that "Taiwan independence" is nothing more than an election tool and a sensational tactic. This is because "Taiwan independence" is basically a dead end. Chen Shui-bian also said that if "Taiwan independence" cannot be achieved, it cannot be done. He can't do it, and Lee Teng-hui can't do it." Chen Shui-bian tied the "referendum on UN membership" to the "general election" back then, which was just to fool voters. Excerpts from the article are as follows: At the end of last year, the "WikiLeaks" website published more than 200,000 confidential U.S. diplomatic documents. The United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Russia, Israel and other countries were also involved, causing a major shock in the international diplomatic community. The storm?#21561; has arrived in Taiwan, and the secret documents contain many grievances and grievances between blue and green politicians. However, the most shocking revelation was yesterday's revelation that the "referendum on UN membership" launched by the Chen Shui-bian administration in 2007 was actually an election strategy to fool the people. "Wiki" data shows that the United States was highly nervous and dissatisfied with Bian's move at the time, but people within the Democratic Progressive Party, including Su Zhenchang, who was the deputy candidate in the election that year, made it clear that "voting" was a campaign tool. Committee member Bi Ling even bluntly told the United States that if Hsieh was elected, the Democratic Progressive Party would not raise this issue again and "everything will return to reality." Some people may question the authenticity of the "Germany", but on the matter of the "referendum on UN membership", the DPP parties indirectly admitted that what "Wikipedia" said was true. Guan Biling said that she hoped that the United States would understand that the DPP would not let the situation get out of control, so she emphasized that everything would return to reality after the election. Tsai Ing-wen also did not deny that the "referendum on UN membership" was an election tool, and admitted that the "referendum on UN membership" did play a part in the election. The DPP has always regarded "Taiwan independence" as the foundation of the party, and has presented itself as a "Taiwan independence" pioneer to flaunt itself as a party with "ideas". In fact, the DPP politicians themselves know very well that "Taiwan independence" is nothing more than an election. It is a tool and a sensational tactic, "talking" before the election and "reducing" after the election. This is because "Taiwan independence" is basically a dead end. Chen Shui-bian does not shy away from saying that "Taiwan independence" cannot be done. He can't do it, and Lee Teng-hui can't do it." Since it "can't be done", Chen Shui-bian's "government" actually tied the "referendum on UN membership" to the "general election" to fool the voters, which is really abominable.

82cc4856e70598a718869c8858024a1092e7649a.sourceText: 密州龙卷风 传美军搞鬼 龙卷风摧毁密苏里州乔布尔镇后，一辆军车进入灾区察看灾情。 国家气象局根据最新死亡人数统计指出，今年已成为1950年以来「最致命的龙卷风年」。鉴于今年龙卷风特多，破坏力特大，网络近日盛传「阴谋论」，惊人指称22日密苏里州乔布尔镇(Joplin)死伤惨重的龙卷风灾，不是大自然造成的灾害，而是军方在阿拉斯加州赞助的研究计划造成，该计划把无线电波射至大气上层。 署名「thegreenieye」的网民在「YouTube」贴文指称：「我不知道其他的人如何，但我要把操纵气象之事，告诉每一个我认识和不认识的人。」此人是在响应一段录像时做此表示，该录像报导宣称，亚拉巴马州塔斯卡路沙(Tuscaloosa)上个月死伤惨重的龙卷风灾，也是阿拉斯加州的大气研究造成。 「thegreenieye」写道：「99.5%的人完全不知此事。请把此事告诉你认识和不认识的人，民众需要知道！」 阴谋论并非新鲜事，但最近「爆炸般」流传，而且绘声绘影。据传，龙卷风灾是由海军与陆军赞助的阿拉斯加州大学「高频活跃北极光研究计划」 (High Frequency Active Auroral Research Program)造成，该计划把无线电波发射至大气上层，以研究电波受到何种影响，藉以改善通讯科技。但阴谋论者认为，这是危害地球的「末日装置」。 乔布尔镇官员28日说，22日龙卷风灾的死亡人数现已增至142人，使今年死于龙卷风的总人数达到520人，打破1953年写下的最高纪录519人。1950年以前曾有更高的龙卷风死亡人数，但那些统计是根据估计，而非实际的正确数字。
82cc4856e70598a718869c8858024a1092e7649a.translatedText: Mississippi tornado, rumored to be a trick by the US military. After a tornado destroyed the town of Choble, Missouri, a military vehicle entered the disaster area to inspect the damage. According to the latest death toll statistics from the National Weather Service, this year has become the "deadliest tornado year" since 1950. In view of the large number of tornadoes this year and their destructive power, "conspiracy theories" have been widely circulated on the Internet recently. It is shockingly alleged that the tornado disaster that caused heavy casualties in Joplin, Missouri on the 22nd was not a disaster caused by nature, but was caused by a military-sponsored research project in Alaska, which shot radio waves into the upper atmosphere. A netizen signed by "thegreenieye" posted on YouTube: "I don't know about other people, but I want to tell everyone I know and don't know about weather manipulation." This person made this statement in response to a video reporting that the deadly tornado disaster in Tuscaloosa, Alabama, last month was also caused by Alaska's atmospheric research. "thegreenieye" wrote: "99.5% of people have no idea about this. Please tell people you know and don't know about this. People need to know!" Conspiracy theories are not new, but they have been circulating "explosionally" recently, and they are vivid and vivid. It is said that the tornado disaster was caused by the High Frequency Active Auroral Research Program at the University of Alaska, which is sponsored by the Navy and Army. The program launches radio waves into the upper atmosphere to study the impact of radio waves in order to improve communication technology. But conspiracy theorists believe that this is a "doomsday device" that harms the earth. Jobl Town officials said on the 28th that the death toll from the tornado on the 22nd has now increased to 142, bringing the total number of people killed by tornadoes this year to 520, breaking the previous record of 519 people set in 1953. There were higher tornado death tolls before 1950, but those statistics were based on estimates rather than actual correct numbers.

8abb54349a016e43c3f3c1f3473686bbd4f84313.sourceText: 上海当红“民间笑星”蔡嘎亮凤凰城表演脱口秀（图） 亚省时报 来自上海的可谓家喻户晓的当红”民间笑星”蔡嘎亮，率5人乐队一起首次登陆北美，5月14日、15日晚来到凤凰城，先后在六福酒家与蓝天酒家举办两场演出，观众近四百人。 蔡嘎亮独特的音乐脱口秀表演形式让凤凰城的侨胞大开眼界，他流利的普通话、上海话再加上半咸不淡的广东话，又唱又演又说，带给观众别开生面的快乐，其幽默风趣又充满智能的语言，让观众在捧腹大笑的同时，又能体会人生百味。蔡嘎亮说：我们的生活需要多一点欢笑, 多一点亲情. 所以这次演出的主体是”笑侃人生”–”我与妈妈”–今年母亲节送给妈妈的最好礼物！ ”对在场的任何人都要爱护、尊重，都要给予刺激和快乐，让笑声把大家带到一个美好的境界”蔡嘎亮说这是他的准则，他要做的是：传递笑道、感悟人生，珍惜友谊、传播欢笑。 ”传颂孝道在先，笑看人生在后”这是蔡嘎亮的座右铭，他认为自己以孝为先，他说”我每天都会跟我妈妈说一下晚安，跟她拉拉家常，我每天都祈祷我母亲身体健康。我说我们要发扬中华民族的孝道文化，我觉得我妈妈在我心目当中是至高无上的。” 蔡嘎亮表演的同时还到观众中间，与在座的妈妈们握手，令全场气氛既欢乐融洽又温馨感人！ 最后蔡嘎亮朗诵一首 ”我骄傲，我是中国人”，他那充满热爱祖国情怀的激情朗诵，令人感到心灵的震撼，当他重复朗诵”我骄傲，我是中国人”时，我发现在座不少人包括我自己眼眶被泪水模糊了。。。激动的心情久久不能平复。 这次蔡嘎亮来美国演出主办单位是:美国上海人联谊会 、美国群英会。协办单位:南加州华人社团联合会、美国苏浙沪同乡会、 美国江苏经贸文化联合会美国格兰律师事务所。为丰富本地侨胞的文娱生活，此行他们的演出完全不收费用，由资深侨领余文劲领头发动，继有斐匿余风采堂、斐匿黄氏宗亲会、邓高密公所、龙冈公所、亚省餐馆协会、亚省开平同乡互助会等侨团参与捐助，令此次演出活动成功，受到大家一致好评。
8abb54349a016e43c3f3c1f3473686bbd4f84313.translatedText: Shanghai's popular "folk comedian" Cai Galiang performs a talk show in Phoenix City (picture) Alberta Times Cai Galiang, a well-known "folk comedian" from Shanghai, led a five-member band to North America for the first time. He came to Phoenix on the evening of May 14th and 15th and held two performances at Luk Fook Restaurant and Blue Sky Restaurant, with an audience of nearly 400 people. Cai Galliang's unique music talk show performance has opened the eyes of the overseas Chinese in Phoenix. His fluent Mandarin, Shanghainese and salty Cantonese, he sings, performs and speaks, bringing unique joy to the audience. His humorous and intelligent language allows the audience to laugh while experiencing the various flavors of life. Cai Galiang said: Our lives need more laughter and more family affection. Therefore, the main theme of this performance is "Laughing about Life" - "Mom and Me" - the best gift for my mother on Mother's Day this year! "We must love and respect everyone present, and provide stimulation and happiness, and let laughter bring everyone to a beautiful state." Cai Galliang said that this is his principle. What he wants to do is: convey laughter, understand life, cherish friendship, and spread laughter. "Praise filial piety first, laugh at life later" is Cai Galiang's motto. He believes that he puts filial piety first. He said, "I say good night to my mother every day and chat with her about daily life. I pray for my mother's good health every day." I said that we should carry forward the filial piety culture of the Chinese nation. I think my mother is supreme in my mind. While performing, Cai Galiang also went to the audience and shook hands with the mothers present, making the atmosphere joyful, harmonious, warm and touching! Finally, Cai Galiang recited a song "I am proud, I am Chinese". His passionate recitation full of love for the motherland was shocking to the soul. When he repeated "I am proud, I am Chinese", I found that the eyes of many people present, including myself, were blurred with tears... I could not calm down for a long time with excitement. The organizers of Cai Galliang's performance in the United States are: American Shanghai Friendship Association and American Heroes Association. Co-organizers: Southern California Federation of Chinese Associations, American Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Shanghai Association. The American Jiangsu Economic, Trade and Cultural Association and the American Green Law Firm. In order to enrich the cultural and entertainment life of local overseas Chinese, their performance was completely free of charge. It was led by senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin. Subsequently, overseas Chinese groups such as Fei Niyu Fengcaitang, Fei Nihuang Clan Association, Deng Gaomi Office, Longgang Office, Alberta Restaurant Association, and Kaiping Mutual Aid Association of Alberta participated in the donation, making this performance a success and well received by everyone.

4929608fe64c2787425295738c0d638b6e3dc89c.translatedText: Qi Ruhong: We can’t talk about translation topics enough Phoenix City Qi Ruhong I recently read a few rare local translations in newspapers, which caused me trouble, and I searched for answers; let me once again...

8a2492d54f14e2276b30972aaa1447f4d6d2361b.sourceText: 最近从报章上阅读到几个少见的地方译名，引起困扰，追查答桉；让我再度对翻译题材惹起兴趣，因而和朋友茶聚，或上网閒聊，互相交流近况外，又会涉及到有关翻译的话题。
8a2492d54f14e2276b30972aaa1447f4d6d2361b.translatedText: Recently I read a few rare local translations in newspapers, which caused me trouble and I searched for answers. It made me interested in the subject of translation again, so I would have tea gatherings with friends or chat online to exchange current situations, and would also touch on topics related to translation.

c53eb7b10182372e937b375b4443c9b330930efa.sourceText: 一直以来，我在许多文章撰述中，曾经提及翻译外语的种种场合，似乎言之不尽。由于世界交流日益频繁，各国民族接触增多，往来交际，均须要语言和文字的沟通；而两国间语言不同，文法差异，必须靠翻译；我们中文的方块和外文的鸡肠相差很大，产生多种麻烦。音译的多有相似谐音，意译的可能解释糢煳而搞错，有意无意间製造滑稽话题，相隔不久就会有新的笑料出现。日积月累，搜集起来就有许多趣味无穷的题材。
c53eb7b10182372e937b375b4443c9b330930efa.translatedText: I have mentioned various situations of translating foreign languages ​​in many articles, and it seems endless. Due to the increasingly frequent exchanges in the world and the increasing contact between nationalities of various countries, communication requires language and written communication. However, the two countries have different languages ​​and grammatical differences, which must rely on translation; the squares in our Chinese and the chicken intestines in foreign languages ​​are very different, causing many kinds of troubles. The transliterations often have similar homophonic meanings, while the free translations may lead to vague interpretations and mistakes, intentionally or unintentionally creating funny topics, and new jokes will appear soon. Over time, I have collected many interesting topics.

156684cdaf7288c5ccf171f04f156038be7fe7f4.sourceText: 如所週知，无论中文翻译外文，或外文翻译中文，某些物品的专有名称，国家地名和人的姓名等，大都靠音译，按照其音韵用本国相似的谐音叫唤。华人用方块字，要拣选合适的谐音字去翻译，比不上使用ＡＢＣ字母的国家那么容易，中国各省各县的方言白话又多，语音不一致，各自凭藉本身口音翻译，形成多种不同的译名，造成读者听众的困扰。
156684cdaf7288c5ccf171f04f156038be7fe7f4.translatedText: As we all know, whether Chinese is translated into a foreign language, or a foreign language is translated into Chinese, the proper names of certain items, names of countries and places, and names of people, etc., mostly rely on transliteration, and are called with similar homophones in the country according to their pronunciation. The Chinese use square characters, so it is not as easy as in countries that use the ABC alphabet to choose appropriate homophones for translation. China's provinces and counties have many dialects and inconsistent pronunciation. Each province relies on its own accent to translate, resulting in a variety of different translations, causing confusion for readers and listeners.

c4dbdf0c14cabba023d3722669778308f33c8b78.sourceText: 以前中华民国很重视这个问题，严格翻译，尽量划一使用，通常透过中央社发佈讯息，让世界各地侨报跟随执行，很少溷乱。翻译工作比较有规律，凡是人名，尽量让其中文化，即是有名有姓，如罗斯福、邱吉尔、甘迺迪、詹森、戴高乐、施亚努厖国名地名则採用简洁称呼，凡有意义的尽量意译，如象牙海岸、檀香山、水牛城厖物品名称或特别职守，如有含义的就用意译，如电脑、太空人，有些名称谐音而能夹带意义就更佳，如爱滋病、伟哥、可口可乐厖
c4dbdf0c14cabba023d3722669778308f33c8b78.translatedText: In the past, the Republic of China attached great importance to this issue, strictly translated it, and tried to use it as uniformly as possible. It usually released information through the Central News Agency, and allowed overseas Chinese newspapers around the world to follow suit, and there was little confusion. The translation work is relatively regular. For all names of people, try to make them cultural, that is, have names and surnames, such as Roosevelt, Churchill, Kennedy, Johnson, De Gaulle, and Schianupang. Use concise titles for country and place names. Try to free-translate anything meaningful, such as Ivory Coast, Honolulu, and Buffalo. Use free translation if there is meaning in the names of items or special duties. If there is meaning, use free translation, such as computers. , astronaut, it is better if some names are homophonic and can carry meaning, such as AIDS, Viagra, Coca-Cola Ponder

16ba12a765425923107be9ee56c8e69e5a512f46.sourceText: 译名靠音译，一般来说比较容易，译者将音韵找寻相似的谐音字配合就算完成，即使发生多种译名，只要有关方面能划一处理，则毫无问题。其他的演说谈话或文章着作，必定採取意译，那就困难得多，要求翻译者具备两方面的学问与常识，程度肤浅的就不行。
16ba12a765425923107be9ee56c8e69e5a512f46.translatedText: Translation relies on transliteration. Generally speaking, it is easier. The translator will find similar homophonic words and match them. Even if there are multiple translations, as long as the relevant parties can deal with them uniformly, there will be no problem. Other speeches, conversations or articles must be translated into free form, which is much more difficult. It requires the translator to have knowledge and common sense in both aspects, and a superficial level will not suffice.

28c9d88d4399a1138b7f8d22bfd4a07d49937909.sourceText: 以越文来说，如 Bao b?包装和hạ tiện节俭[t1] ，如果对中越文认识不深，会错译成「包皮」和「下贱」，当场出丑。
28c9d88d4399a1138b7f8d22bfd4a07d49937909.translatedText: In Vietnamese, such as Bao b? packaging and hạ tiện thrift [t1], if you don't know Chinese and Vietnamese deeply, you will mistranslate it into "foreskin" and "mean" and make a fool of yourself on the spot.

de1917d986314c7f255592767c4207e29e7ea27d.sourceText: 英文的场合更要清楚，听说以前有位翻译员，把新春「人山人海」的热闹情景译成people mountain people sea，令主人的老外朋友听到一头雾水，不明不白。老外朋友回头称讚主人太太很美丽，其太太谦虚回应：「哪裡，哪裡。」翻译员竟直译：where? where? 哎呀！老外大为尴尬，打量上下，不知称讚哪裡美丽才恰当。
de1917d986314c7f255592767c4207e29e7ea27d.translatedText: You need to be more clear about the situation in English. I heard that a translator once translated the lively scene of the New Year "people mountain people sea" into people mountain people sea, which made the host's foreigner friends confused and confused. The foreigner friend turned around and praised the host's wife for her beauty, and the wife responded modestly: "Where, where." The translator actually translated it literally: where? where? Oops! The foreigner was greatly embarrassed and looked up and down, wondering where to praise her beauty.

7f71087940d9c07839252496f3c0a9c77730beb6.sourceText: 那位翻译员就是中英文两方面的常识有限，煳裡煳涂的直译，闹出笑话，弄得尴尬。这事有点像传说「江泽民为什么辞职」的笑话那样，都是直译累事。该笑话在网上流传一个时期，我也曾借来谈论过。据传当时江泽民为了国际邦交所需，提议人大代表学习英语会话以便接待外宾，易于沟通。有一天，举行程度测试，江向各代表提问「how are you是什么意思?」人大主席回答：「为什么是你？」江皱眉头，内心嘀咕，这简单的问候语应该熟识才对，何以还要直译，于是再问：「那么，how old are your又怎解呢？」人大主席又回答：「还不简单，多个老字罢了，整句翻译是；为什么老是你！」这一回，江暗暗心惊，原来人大代表并非不懂翻译，原来是言外之意，指责自己恋栈职位，当晚回家经过一番思量，走为上着，第二天就呈送辞职书了。
7f71087940d9c07839252496f3c0a9c77730beb6.translatedText: That translator has limited knowledge in both Chinese and English, and his confused literal translation made him laugh and make him embarrassed. This matter is a bit like the joke about "Why Jiang Zemin resigned", which is a literal translation. This joke has been circulating on the Internet for a while, and I used it to talk about it. It is said that at that time, Jiang Zemin proposed that deputies to the National People's Congress learn conversational English in order to receive foreign guests and communicate easily in order to meet the needs of international diplomatic relations. One day, during a proficiency test, Jiang asked the deputies, "What do you mean by how are you?" The National People's Congress Chairman replied, "Why you?" Jiang frowned and muttered to himself, this simple greeting should be familiar to him, so why should he translate it literally, so he asked again: "Then, how old are you?" How do you explain "your?" The Chairman of the National People's Congress replied: "It's not simple. It's just a lot of old characters. The whole sentence is translated as; Why is it always you!" This time, Jiang was secretly shocked. It turned out that the National People's Congress representative did not know how to translate. It turned out that he was accusing himself of being obsessed with his position. After going home that night, he thought about it and submitted his resignation letter the next day.

ae4215ca8501cd05e826c2026ef952612c9a963f.sourceText: 这当然是个虚构趣事，但证明翻译意义的词句，比较音译的名称要严谨得多，不能乱来。音译方面，我们认为以中文的方块字读音，替代外文拼音有困难，我和朋友閒聊这问题，有人认为彼此一样，外文翻译中文，也遇到这种语音难题，只是外国人较认真，一旦有学者翻译了之后，就以一个译音作标准，收入词典裡面，沿袭使用，不再更改。譬如：Silk丝，是翻译自广州话「丝嚟嘅」，Tea茶，是来自潮州话，Casino开市咯或开始咯，是福建人的语音，Shanghai上海，是译自国语了。至于Macao澳门，传说是出自广东的粗话，葡萄牙佔领澳门的时候，他们询问一位居民大叔，这裡是什么地方，这位大叔已憎恨番鬼佬霸佔自己的国土，满腔怒火的回答：「唔知你讲乜鸠！」最后两字粗话声音提高，葡人误以为他说这裡叫Macao，哈哈！澳门译名是这样得来的。
ae4215ca8501cd05e826c2026ef952612c9a963f.translatedText: This is of course a fictional anecdote, but the words and phrases that prove the meaning of the translation are much more rigorous than the transliterated names and cannot be messed with. In terms of transliteration, we think it is difficult to replace the foreign pinyin with the Chinese square pronunciation. I chatted with my friends about this problem, and some people thought that they were the same. Translating foreign languages ​​into Chinese also encountered this phonetic problem, but foreigners were more serious. Once a scholar translated it, a transliteration would be used as the standard, and it would be included in the dictionary, followed and used without any changes. For example: Silk is translated from the Cantonese dialect "Si Lai Gai", Tea tea is from the Chaozhou dialect, Casino is open or has started, which is the pronunciation of the Fujian people, and Shanghai is translated from the Mandarin. As for Macao, it is said that it comes from Guangdong's swear words. When the Portuguese occupied Macao, they asked a resident uncle where this place was. The uncle already hated the Fangui people for occupying their own land, and replied angrily: "I don't know what you are talking about!" The last two words of the curse were raised in a loud voice, and the Portuguese mistakenly thought that he said this place was called Macao, haha! This is how the translated name of Macao came about.

3cc9b5b0ed33fd20c7331ef8d14dc045df1746d3.sourceText: 看！翻译题材很多很多，茶馀饭后，上网閒聊，永远没完没了。
3cc9b5b0ed33fd20c7331ef8d14dc045df1746d3.translatedText: Look! There are many translation topics, and chatting on the Internet after dinner will never end.

014144c3bf5bdab334fa7a81affc529588b25a71.sourceText: 十一月二十日上午，图森的十五名华裔后代参加了国务院侨办在世界范围内举行的第三届中华文化知识竞赛。
014144c3bf5bdab334fa7a81affc529588b25a71.translatedText: On the morning of November 20th, fifteen Chinese descendants from Tucson participated in the third Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition held worldwide by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council.

c6fb13ed3208c1178da29b08560d7a80ea1c9cdd.sourceText: 这次竞赛得到了图森华裔的大力支持。七月发出将举行第三届中华文化知识竞赛的消息后，两所中文学校决定组织学 生参赛，确定了申请考点等相关事宜。许多学生家长发来电子邮件或打电话询问相关情况及书籍定购等。九月举办竞赛的 通知发出后，各方面都表现出很高的热情。祖筍华人文化中心确认为竞赛提供场地。祖筍中文学校和图森国语教会中文学 校积极鼓励学生报名参赛。有几位学生的家长在收到竞赛通知的第一时间就送来了子女的报名表。University_High_Sc hool和Basis_Oro_Valley_Charter_School的华裔学生知道这一消息后也积极报名参加竞赛。有部分学生一看三本书里 有那么多内容，觉得记不下来，最终放弃了报名，但是仍然对中华文化知识竞赛表现出了极大的热情。他们阅读《中国文 化常识》，《中国历史常识》和《中国地理常识》这三本书，踊跃参加辅导，还表示要多学一些中国的知识，多了解一些 中国的情况，准备下一届竞赛时再参加。
c6fb13ed3208c1178da29b08560d7a80ea1c9cdd.translatedText: This competition has received strong support from Chinese Americans in Tucson. After the news was announced in July that the third Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition would be held, the two Chinese schools decided to organize students to participate and determined application for test sites and other related matters. Many parents of students sent emails or called to inquire about relevant information and book ordering. After the announcement of the competition in September was issued, there was great enthusiasm from all quarters. Zusun Chinese Cultural Center confirmed to provide the venue for the competition. Zusun Chinese School and Tucson Mandarin Chinese School actively encourage students to register for the competition. Several parents of students sent their children's registration forms as soon as they received the notice of the competition. Chinese students from University_High_Sc hool and Basis_Oro_Valley_Charter_School also actively signed up to participate in the competition after learning about the news. Some students felt that there was so much content in the three books that they could not remember it, and finally gave up the registration. However, they still showed great enthusiasm for the Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition. They read the three books "Common Sense of Chinese Culture", "Common Sense of Chinese History" and "Common Sense of Chinese Geography" and actively participated in the tutoring. They also expressed that they wanted to learn more about China and understand more about China's situation, and prepare to participate in the next competition.

fe91520deb5330752cf128869bb49bec43370c04.sourceText: 根据华裔子女和家长的要求，我们决定开设辅导课。为此我们发出了征求辅导志愿者的通知。通知发出后立即就得到 了几位老师的回复，表示愿意为学生们辅导。最后我们邀请了曹佩琴，林广新，商慧明和七十多岁的朱先生为学生们辅导 。从九月底到十一月中旬，我们一共举办了七次辅导课，分别就中国的文化、历史、地理常识和近一两年来中国的时事等 四个方面给学生做了辅导。每一次辅导课以后，都能看到学生们的中国文化常识的水平在提高。这些辅导课让学生们增加 了对中国文化常识的了解、增强了参赛的信心。
fe91520deb5330752cf128869bb49bec43370c04.translatedText: Based on the requirements of Chinese children and parents, we decided to open tutoring classes. To this end, we have issued a call for tutoring volunteers. Immediately after the notice was sent out, several teachers responded and expressed their willingness to provide tutoring for the students. Finally, we invited Cao Peiqin, Lin Guangxin, Shang Huiming and Mr. Zhu, who is in his seventies, to tutor the students. From the end of September to mid-November, we held a total of seven tutoring sessions, providing tutoring to students in four aspects: Chinese culture, history, geographical knowledge, and current affairs in China in the past year or two. After every tutoring session, we can see that the students’ knowledge of Chinese culture is improving. These tutoring sessions allowed students to increase their understanding of Chinese cultural knowledge and enhance their confidence in participating in the competition.

9a7652544f5dd87e9dddf8edec5a89edb59d434f.sourceText: 为了上好辅导课四位老师做了大量的工作,做了精心的准备。曹佩琴、林广新、商慧明三位做常识辅导的老师认真阅读 了《中国文化常识》，《中国历史常识》和《中国地理常识》这三本书。四位老师都查阅了大量的资料，付出自己大量的 时间。曹佩琴、林广新两位老师为学生准备了丰富的幻灯片演示。曹老师以文化为线索带领学生了解中国的民族、民俗、 民风、民情、国粹、奇葩，体验中国文化的博、大、经、深。林老师以历史为脉络，让学生领略了从远古到先秦，从始皇 帝到民主共和中华文化几千年的发展过程。商老师展开了中国地图，让学生来了一次虚拟的中国旅游。从世界之巅珠穆朗 玛峰到长江中下游平原；从巍巍昆仑、戈壁沙漠到武夷山脉、珠江之滨，学生了解了中国的地形地貌；从拉萨、乌鲁木齐 到北京、上海，从冰城哈尔滨到海角天涯海南岛，学生们知道了中国各地的自然资源、气候特点、经济和文化的发展。朱 先生以自己的亲生经历为同学们展现了近年来中国的迅猛发展和国际地位的迅速提高，还从网络上搜索到了丰富的时事资 料，草拟了三十多道练习题，帮助学生们了解近两年来的时事政治。在这里我们要向他们表示深深的敬意！
9a7652544f5dd87e9dddf8edec5a89edb59d434f.translatedText: The four teachers have done a lot of work and made careful preparations in order to give a good tutoring class. Cao Peiqin, Lin Guangxin, and Shang Huiming, the three general knowledge tutors, carefully read the three books "Common Knowledge of Chinese Culture", "Common Knowledge of Chinese History" and "Common Knowledge of Chinese Geography". All four teachers reviewed a large amount of information and devoted a lot of their time. Two teachers, Cao Peiqin and Lin Guangxin, prepared rich slide presentations for the students. Teacher Cao uses culture as a clue to lead students to understand China's nation, folk customs, customs, sentiments, national quintessence, and wonders, and experience the breadth, grandeur, classics, and depth of Chinese culture. Teacher Lin used history as a context to allow students to appreciate the development process of Chinese culture over thousands of years from ancient times to pre-Qin Dynasty, from the First Emperor to the Democratic Republic. Teacher Shang unfolded the map of China and let the students take a virtual tour of China. From Mount Everest, the top of the world, to the plains of the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River; from the towering Kunlun and the Gobi Desert to the Wuyi Mountains and the Pearl River coast, students learned about China's topography; from Lhasa and Urumqi to Beijing and Shanghai, from the ice city of Harbin to the end of the world and Hainan Island, students learned about the natural resources, climate characteristics, economic and cultural development of various parts of China. Mr. Zhu used his own personal experience to show the students China's rapid development and rapid improvement in international status in recent years. He also searched for a wealth of current affairs information from the Internet and drafted more than 30 exercises to help students understand the current affairs and politics of the past two years. Here we would like to express our deep respect to them!

99be5d33dd75b08f0893f1d36e506d0d9090cdfd.sourceText: 组织竞赛有很多具体的事务，例如，书籍发售、辅导和竞赛的场地安排、电子设备的调试准备厖这些事务得到了文 化中心Susan_Chan和中心工作人员的支持和帮助。当需要监考人员时，曹佩琴、张沅、邹继耀、黄志国主动承担了监考 工作。在此特向他们表示深深的谢意！
99be5d33dd75b08f0893f1d36e506d0d9090cdfd.translatedText: There are many specific matters in organizing the competition, such as book sales, tutoring and competition venue arrangements, and preparation for debugging of electronic equipment. These matters have received the support and help of the Cultural Center Susan_Chan and the center staff. When invigilators were needed, Cao Peiqin, Zhang Yuan, Zou Jiyao, and Huang Zhiguo took the initiative to undertake the invigilation work. I would like to express my deep gratitude to them!

c6189a99214a8b6936b49ceb7b503515df48807a.sourceText: 国务院侨办举办的中华文化知识竞赛得到了图森华裔积极响应。广大华人认为这是传播和保持中华文化的好方式。听 到这项赛事将每两年举办一次时，大家都认为这是一件功德无量的事情，有利于中华文化的保留和传承。很多学生家长都 表示要让自己的子女多了解一些中国的情况，关心中国的发展，把中国的文化传统保留住、传下去。在这里我们要向关心 、支持海外华文教育的国务院侨办表示深情的感谢！
c6189a99214a8b6936b49ceb7b503515df48807a.translatedText: The Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition organized by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council received positive responses from Chinese Americans in Tucson. The majority of Chinese believe this is a good way to spread and maintain Chinese culture. When they heard that this event would be held every two years, everyone thought it was a meritorious event that would be conducive to the preservation and inheritance of Chinese culture. Many parents of students expressed that they want their children to know more about China, care about China's development, and preserve and pass on China's cultural traditions. Here we would like to express our deep gratitude to the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council for caring and supporting overseas Chinese education!

710e96f92f1ca2e33d7032b94eee9e97a447cfc6.sourceText: 全美中文学校协会是这次竞赛在美国的承办者。图森考点的竞赛工作受其领导，得到了明确的指导。我们图森的刘芷 若同学在第二届中华文化知识竞赛中取得了优异成绩。今年九月，她通过了全美中文学校协会的选拔，成为美国代表团的 五位代表之一，代表美国的华裔学生参加了十月底在中国西安举行的第二届中华文化知识竞赛总决赛。这是华裔学生的骄 傲。也是全美中文学校协会对我们工作的支持和肯定。在这里我们要向刘芷若同学表示祝贺，向全美中文学校协会表示感 谢！
710e96f92f1ca2e33d7032b94eee9e97a447cfc6.translatedText: The National Association of Chinese Schools is the organizer of this competition in the United States. The competition work at the Tucson test center was under his leadership and received clear guidance. Our student Liu Zhiruo from Tucson achieved excellent results in the second Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition. In September this year, she passed the selection of the National Association of Chinese Schools and became one of the five representatives of the American delegation, representing Chinese students in the United States to participate in the Second Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition Finals held in Xi'an, China, at the end of October. This is the pride of Chinese students. It is also the support and recognition of our work from the National Association of Chinese Schools. Here we would like to congratulate Liu Zhiruo and express our gratitude to the National Association of Chinese Schools!

67706420ac41a17f0d12106af4a6c8df889c0a3c.sourceText: 这次竞赛在图森成功举行离不开学生、家长和广大华裔的支持。我们在此向大家表示诚挚的谢意！我们将加倍努力地 做好华文教育工作，以回报大家的关爱。
67706420ac41a17f0d12106af4a6c8df889c0a3c.translatedText: The success of this competition in Tucson would not have been possible without the support of students, parents and the majority of Chinese Americans. We would like to express our sincere gratitude to everyone! We will redouble our efforts in Chinese education to repay everyone's love.

7e49df872dcbabfc22326ca57c7bad16d4e6de05.sourceText: （感谢图桑华人联络通讯供稿）
7e49df872dcbabfc22326ca57c7bad16d4e6de05.translatedText: (Thanks to the Tucson Chinese Contact Newsletter for the contribution)

67a7fcd2cce632dd52b46b7e0fd370dbeef53807.translatedText: > US visa and passport applications worldwide! Computer glitches have caused delays in issuances around the world. The U.S. State Department recently stated that due to computer system glitches,...

018ee5efdde48a31eeff5cfe235f6e8938503c1e.sourceText: 申请美国签证护照的看过来！电脑故障导致全球范围内延迟发放 美国国务院日前表示，由于计算机系统出现故障，导致美国使领馆用于发放护照和签证等工作的全球数据库崩溃，致使全球范围内很多准备前往美国的旅客行程延误。 美国国务院发言人玛丽哈尔夫（Marie Harf）发表声明称，这个问题最早是在上周六发现的。 受影响的数据库主要是美国国务院用来颁发、记录和打印签证的部门，以及在境外出生的美国公民护照申请部门。此次数据库出现的?#24040;大性能问题?#24050;经对全球的美国使领馆工作造成了重大影响。 哈尔夫进一步表示，虽然目前受此次故障影响的人数还没有具体统计数字。但我们对因为这次故障而受到影响的申请人表示诚挚的歉意。我们正在努力解决该技术问题，并将在最短时间内恢复工作。
018ee5efdde48a31eeff5cfe235f6e8938503c1e.translatedText: For those applying for U.S. visas and passports, take a look! Computer glitches lead to delays in issuing passports and visas around the world. The U.S. State Department recently stated that due to a computer system glitch, the global database used by U.S. embassies and consulates for issuing passports and visas collapsed, causing delays for many travelers around the world who were preparing to go to the United States. U.S. State Department spokesperson Marie Harf issued a statement saying that the problem was first discovered last Saturday. The affected databases are primarily those used by the U.S. Department of State to issue, record and print visas, as well as passport applications for U.S. citizens born abroad. The major performance problem that occurred in the database this time has had a major impact on the work of U.S. embassies and consulates around the world. Harf further stated that although there are currently no specific statistics on the number of people affected by this failure. However, we sincerely apologize to applicants affected by this glitch. We are working hard to resolve the technical issue and will be back to work as soon as possible.
