38f1b4070160101f0951f13564c455e5caa162c7.translatedText: Miss China Universe Contest, the Americas Division Finals can be exciting (Overseas Chinese Federation News) According to Phoenix TV information, as of July 6, the Miss China Universe 2014...

b7e29b0d512c7535223a8ab09cfbbfe13ac66205.sourceText: (侨联通讯)据凤凰卫视资讯，截止到7月6日，2014中华小姐环球大赛组委会已经接到了来自美洲各地很多优秀选手的报名申请，其中不乏哈佛、耶鲁等名校毕业的高材生和美洲各地才貌双全的优秀选手。美东、美西、加东、加西四场初赛的时间地点确定。而中华小姐环球大赛（美洲赛区）总决赛，将于2014年8月10日下午2时，在美国亚利桑那州凤凰城野马赌场酒店拉开帷幕。
b7e29b0d512c7535223a8ab09cfbbfe13ac66205.translatedText: (Overseas Chinese Federation News) According to Phoenix TV information, as of July 6, the organizing committee of the 2014 Miss China Universe Competition has received applications from many outstanding contestants from all over the Americas, including many top students who graduated from prestigious schools such as Harvard and Yale, as well as talented and beautiful contestants from all over the Americas. The time and location of the four preliminary rounds in the US East, US West, Eastern Canada, and Western Canada have been determined. The finals of the Miss Chinese Universe Competition (American Division) will kick off at 2:00 pm on August 10, 2014 at the Wild Horse Casino Hotel in Phoenix, Arizona, USA.

3ddd742a2684eb840908e08defff2c64a22e1aa3.sourceText: 中华小姐环球大赛（美洲赛区）的协办单位凤凰城侨联总会，将举办一场赛前文艺晚会，时间定于8月9日晚，将邀请凤凰卫视及中华小姐美洲区历届才艺小姐做表演嘉宾，并与本地文艺界的精英同台献技，节目精彩不容错过，凤凰卫视将对晚会进行录影。 侨联总会为了感谢侨界和社团历年来的大力支持，今年在＂国庆特刊＂上刊登广告的单位和个人都将获得8月9日晚表演、8月10下午日选美决赛的入场赠券 。由于大赛面向全州的观众，所以仍将有少量8月9日晚的文艺演出的入场券出售，售票地点分别是：六福大酒家、欣欣超市、新东方艺术学校、野马赌场大剧院售票房。由于座位有限，每处出售的普通门票大约只有100张，票价$10，售完即止，购买者将同时获得8月10日下午选美决赛的入场赠券。
3ddd742a2684eb840908e08defff2c64a22e1aa3.translatedText: The Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation, the co-organizer of the Miss China Universe Competition (American Division), will hold a pre-match cultural evening scheduled for the evening of August 9. Phoenix TV and previous Miss China America Division talents will be invited to perform as guest performers and perform on the same stage with elites from the local literary and art circles. The show is not to be missed. Phoenix TV will record the party. In order to thank the overseas Chinese community and associations for their strong support over the years, the Overseas Chinese Federation has announced that units and individuals who place advertisements in the "National Day Special Issue" this year will receive coupons for the performance on the evening of August 9 and the beauty pageant finals on the afternoon of August 10. Since the competition is open to audiences across the state, there will still be a small number of tickets for the theatrical performance on the evening of August 9th. The ticket sales locations are: Luk Fook Restaurant, Xinxin Supermarket, New Oriental Art School, and the box office of the Wild Horse Casino Grand Theater. Due to limited seating, only about 100 general tickets are sold at each location, priced at $10, while supplies last. Purchasers will also receive a coupon for the beauty pageant finals in the afternoon on August 10.

6c41fbc629894569969b5b545b6ab0be17a0e094.sourceText: 仍有少量8月9日的VIP票出售(票价$50)，VIP贵宾将同时获得8月10日下午的入场赠券，并邀请参加赛后庆功酒会，可与选美冠亚桂军合照留念。VIP票请与侨联张肇鸿先生预订，电话(602)788-7808。
6c41fbc629894569969b5b545b6ab0be17a0e094.translatedText: There are still a small number of VIP tickets for sale on August 9th (price $50). VIP guests will also receive admission tickets for the afternoon of August 10th, and are invited to attend the post-match celebration cocktail party, where they can take photos with the beauty pageant champion, runner-up, and runner-up. Please book VIP tickets with Mr. Zhang Zhaohong of the Overseas Chinese Federation, call (602) 788-7808.

7d350c533e4dcf50d63b03345ada214a96fff8fb.sourceText: 大凤凰城地区五所中文学校负责人聚会交流 （帅致若报道）应现代中文学校校长宋良武、希望中文学校董事长黄双双提议，由全美中文学校协会在亚利桑那州的联络人帅致若负责联系，大凤凰城地区五所中文学校负责人在辛苦地忙碌了一学期的工作之后，12月16日在蓝天酒家聚会交流。 当日出席聚会的本城五所中文学校负责人有现代中文学校校长宋良武、副校长朱岩，希望中文学校董事长黄双双、校长赵彩虹、教学校长谢小红，凤凰城中文学校校长程秀玲，凤凰城华人基督教会中文学校校长李珍，斐匿中文学校副校长邓军泉。 各中文学校负责人在聚会中介绍了各自学校的概况、课程设置、教学特色、文化活动、家长活动等各方面情况。大家对各校负责人介绍的情况很感兴趣，不断地询问更详细的信息。各校负责人在交流的过程中，认真探讨了华文教育的思路和措施。通过交流，在场的人员对五所中文学校的历史渊源、人数规模、教材课本、课程设置、学生来源、教师队伍、学校活动等方面的特色有了初步的了解。大家在听了各校负责人的介绍后，都进一步感受到了在多元文化的环境中，各所学校在不同的办学条件下为华文教育和传播中华文化的艰辛付出和坚持努力。宋良武校长表示，大家一起交流办学信息很有意义；并且提议今后各校之间互相推荐优秀的教师，以利于提高教学质量，使我们地区接受华文教育的学生更大范围地受益；与会各中文学校负责人都表示很赞成这样的倡议。 最近刚刚参加了全美中文学校协会第九次全国大会的图桑祖荀中文学校校长陈荣基和协会在亚利桑那州的联络人帅致若将大会颁发给本州有关中文学校的奖状带回了凤凰城。全美中文学校协会在此次大会上表彰了四百多所会员学校中的一百多位中文学校负责人，以奖励近两年来相关学校负责人积极参加协会承办的”中华文化竞赛”、”中国海外交流协会巡回讲学团教师培训”、”中华文化夏令营”等大型活动所作出的杰出贡献。亚利桑那地区因参加以上大型活动的人数和取得的成绩都非常突出，因此本州共有15位华教工作者获得表彰。帅致若向相关学校负责人转交了奖状，并感谢各位学校负责人的积极支持和参与。 最后，出席聚会的中文学校负责人愉快合影，互道节日快乐，新的一年再见。
7d350c533e4dcf50d63b03345ada214a96fff8fb.translatedText: Leaders of five Chinese schools in the greater Phoenix area gathered and communicated (reported by Shuai Zhiruo) At the suggestion of Song Liangwu, principal of Modern Chinese School, and Huang Shuangshuang, chairman of Hope Chinese School, and Shuai Zhiruo, the liaison person of the National Chinese Schools Association in Arizona, the leaders of the five Chinese schools in the greater Phoenix area gathered and communicated at the Blue Sky Restaurant on December 16 after a hard-working semester. The leaders of the five Chinese schools in the city who attended the gathering that day included Modern Chinese School Principal Song Liangwu and Vice Principal Zhu Yan; Hope Chinese School Chairman Huang Shuangshuang, Principal Zhao Caihong, and Teaching Principal Xie Xiaohong; Phoenix Chinese School Principal Cheng Xiuling; Phoenix Chinese Christian Church Chinese School Principal Li Zhen; and Feini Chinese School Vice Principal Deng Junquan. The heads of each Chinese school introduced their respective school’s profile, curriculum, teaching features, cultural activities, parent activities and other aspects at the gathering. Everyone was very interested in the situation introduced by the heads of each school and kept asking for more detailed information. During the exchange process, the leaders of each school carefully discussed the ideas and measures for Chinese education. Through exchanges, those present had a preliminary understanding of the five Chinese schools’ historical origins, population size, teaching materials, curriculum, student sources, teacher teams, school activities and other characteristics. After listening to the introductions by the heads of each school, everyone further felt the hard work and persistence of each school in educating Chinese and spreading Chinese culture under different operating conditions in a multicultural environment. Principal Song Liangwu said that it is very meaningful for everyone to exchange school information together; he also proposed that in the future, each school would recommend excellent teachers to each other to help improve the quality of teaching and benefit students who receive Chinese education in our region on a wider scale. The heads of all Chinese schools present at the meeting expressed their approval of such an initiative. Chen Rongji, principal of Tucson Zuxun Chinese School, who recently attended the ninth national conference of the National Association of Chinese Schools, and Shuai Zhiruo, the association’s contact person in Arizona, brought the certificates awarded to Chinese schools in the state by the conference back to Phoenix. The National Chinese Schools Association commended more than 100 Chinese school leaders from more than 400 member schools at this conference to reward the outstanding contributions made by relevant school leaders in the past two years by actively participating in large-scale activities such as the "Chinese Culture Competition", "China Overseas Exchange Association Touring Lecture Team Teacher Training", and "Chinese Culture Summer Camp" hosted by the association. Due to the outstanding number of people participating in the above large-scale activities and the achievements achieved in the Arizona region, a total of 15 Chinese education workers in the state were commended. Shuai Zhiruo handed over the certificate of award to the heads of relevant schools and thanked them for their active support and participation. Finally, the heads of the Chinese schools who attended the party happily took a group photo and wished each other happy holidays and see you in the new year.

6afb2c67b334fddd6ba9999c67658e69a5873ea6.sourceText: 凤凰城公共图书馆 犯罪新热点
6afb2c67b334fddd6ba9999c67658e69a5873ea6.translatedText: Phoenix Public Library New Crime Hotspot

25d6b8ee85de3540ac2ae5059f84f59826164940.sourceText: 凤凰城公共图书馆 犯罪新热点 （亚省时报） 光天白日之下被吸毒者血腥袭击可能发生在哪里？一条破旧人少的小巷…
25d6b8ee85de3540ac2ae5059f84f59826164940.translatedText: Phoenix Public Library New Crime Hotspot (Alberta Times) Where could a bloody attack by a drug addict take place in broad daylight? A dilapidated alley with few people...

daa4392498bc87b383fdb693124c4a1433fd3dd3.sourceText: 光天白日之下被吸毒者血腥袭击可能发生在哪里？ 一条破旧人少的小巷？ 这是发生在凤凰城公共图书馆的案例之一。 一家本地电视媒体通过一年调查得出结论，公共图书馆不再是安全和安静的地方。 图书馆吸引爱书者的同时，幽雅的环境也让众多盗贼、无家可归者、吸毒者和变态者在此聚集，盗窃、攻击事件时有发生。 望爱书者出入上述地点时注意安全。
daa4392498bc87b383fdb693124c4a1433fd3dd3.translatedText: Where could a bloody attack by a drug addict happen in broad daylight? A shabby alley with few people? This is one of the cases that happened at the Phoenix Public Library. A year-long investigation by a local television outlet has concluded that public libraries are no longer safe and quiet places. While the library attracts bibliophiles, its elegant environment also attracts many thieves, homeless people, drug addicts and perverts to gather here, and thefts and attacks occur from time to time. Bibliophiles are advised to pay attention to safety when entering and exiting the above places.

9a550522eff98ace173d9672e4b8510343287ae3.translatedText: The green card approval rate is as high as 96%

eee83ca52bba71f63c29f800888bdca446a289ef.sourceText: 记者日前从侨外移民广州公司获悉，今年2月，美国移民局开始了一项EIR(Entrepreneurs in Residence)即”企业家居民”的计划，旨在通过多方面支持和便利措施，吸引能够带来经济推动和就业机会创造的新移民企业家。而随着现行美国投资移民EB-5政策即将于今年9月30日到期，美国移民局正积极商议进一步改革措施，并一再表示将提高项目和申请的审批质量和效率。
eee83ca52bba71f63c29f800888bdca446a289ef.translatedText: Reporters recently learned from Qiaowai Immigration Guangzhou Company that in February this year, the US Immigration Service launched an EIR (Entrepreneurs in Residence) program, which aims to attract new immigrant entrepreneurs who can bring economic boost and create job opportunities through various support and convenience measures. As the current U.S. investment immigration EB-5 policy is about to expire on September 30 this year, the U.S. Immigration Service is actively discussing further reform measures and has repeatedly stated that it will improve the quality and efficiency of project and application approval.

e4f83239689b744d32d6c58a6ef359968a2dec05.sourceText: 侨外移民专家丁浩宇分析指出，根据美国移民局4月29日内部数据，在2011财年美国移民局接收总计3805个EB-5投资人(I-526)申请，批准1563个之后，2012财年至3月末，移民局又接收了2771个新的I-526申请，新批准2101个，这个数据显示美国投资移民热持续高涨。同期绿卡条件解除(I-829)数量也达522个，与2011年同样双双保持高达96%的历史高通过率。
e4f83239689b744d32d6c58a6ef359968a2dec05.translatedText: Overseas Chinese immigration expert Ding Haoyu analyzed that according to the internal data of the USCIS on April 29, in the 2011 fiscal year, the USCIS received a total of 3,805 EB-5 investors (I -526) applications, after approving 1,563, from fiscal year 2012 to the end of March, the USCIS received 2,771 new I-526 applications and approved 2,101 new ones. This data shows that the investment immigration boom in the United States continues to rise. During the same period, the number of green card conditions lifted (I-829) also reached 522, maintaining a historically high pass rate of 96% as in 2011.

9a18e45867019a65347c3b4cc345917889f5555f.sourceText: 行业专家透露，大量的I-526申请和相应的批准量，以及超过历史高位的I-829通过率，无不显示即使在EB-5投资移民法案即将到期、后续走势官方尚无明确表态的情势下，美国移民局在强化对项目和申请人审核的同时，对优质背景项目和文件完善的申请人给予了积极配合。一些移民公司的内部数据也显示，移民局对投资人申请审批时间已从常规的6~8个月缩短至3-5个月。
9a18e45867019a65347c3b4cc345917889f5555f.translatedText: Industry experts revealed that the large number of I-526 applications and corresponding approvals, as well as the I-829 approval rate that exceeds historical highs, all show that even when the EB-5 Investment Immigration Act is about to expire and the official position on the follow-up trend has not been clear, the US Citizenship and Immigration Service has strengthened its review of projects and applicants while actively cooperating with applicants with high-quality background projects and complete documents. Internal data from some immigration companies also shows that the Immigration Bureau’s approval time for investor applications has been shortened from the regular 6 to 8 months to 3 to 5 months.

92d161b799b4c163a0ed11c4a5dfec5198fcb01e.sourceText: 今年仅剩约1233个家庭配额
92d161b799b4c163a0ed11c4a5dfec5198fcb01e.translatedText: There are only about 1,233 family quotas left this year

f0b9ad737a552728463caf5fdb70d93f58059580.sourceText: 截至今年3月底，美移民局本财年已获批准的I-526申请高达惊人的2101个，按每个家庭3人签证计算，即会用掉6300余个EB-5签证。而移民局对该签证的配额上限为每年度10000个，而历史上从未达到过该配额上限。不过从现在起，2012年的EB-5签证配额仅余3700个，按家庭预估只剩余约1233个EB-5投资人名额。预测到今年5-7月，美国投资移民将进入优质项目和申请人递件”卡位”的关键时期。
f0b9ad737a552728463caf5fdb70d93f58059580.translatedText: As of the end of March this year, the US Citizenship and Immigration Service has approved an astonishing 2,101 I-526 applications for this fiscal year. Based on the calculation of three visas per family, more than 6,300 EB-5 visas will be used. The Immigration Bureau’s quota for this visa is 10,000 per year, and this quota has never been reached in history. However, from now on, there are only 3,700 EB-5 visa quotas left in 2012, and there are only about 1,233 EB-5 investor quotas left according to family estimates. It is predicted that from May to July this year, U.S. investment immigration will enter a critical period when high-quality projects and applicants are "stuck".

46e9615715dc1b922d93da1da691016b71357f86.sourceText: 米歇尔 奥巴马在民主党大会上演讲，她身着粉色连衣裙，涂灰蓝色指甲油。
46e9615715dc1b922d93da1da691016b71357f86.translatedText: Michelle Obama gave a speech at the Democratic convention, wearing a pink dress and gray-blue nail polish.

86ea01bfd98016ab08845c990195968ae88eab48.sourceText: 第一夫人米歇尔 奥巴马在出席民主党全国代表大会时身着粉色连衣裙，手指甲涂成时尚的灰紫色，引发如潮好评。一夜之间，女性争相订购同款裙装和指甲油。
86ea01bfd98016ab08845c990195968ae88eab48.translatedText: First lady Michelle Obama wore a pink dress and painted her fingernails a fashionable gray-purple when attending the Democratic National Convention, which attracted rave reviews. Overnight, women rushed to order identical dresses and nail polish.

89db398a77ab6f7dcd18f4ae6571ade82f45c9ae.sourceText: 米歇尔的裙装设计师特蕾西 里斯表示，米歇尔当时穿的有淡蓝色裙摆的粉红丝绸提花连衣裙，价格不到500美元，自己正在赶制更多同款裙装。她说，本来计划下季再推出该款裙装，但是现在生产线已经开始赶制，以便更多人可以更早买到这款裙子。她还表示，米歇尔灰紫色的指甲油是出色的装饰物。
89db398a77ab6f7dcd18f4ae6571ade82f45c9ae.translatedText: Michelle's dress designer Tracy Reese said that Michelle was wearing a pink silk jacquard dress with a light blue skirt, which cost less than $500, and that she was rushing to make more dresses of the same style. She said that she originally planned to launch this skirt next season, but now the production line has begun to rush production so that more people can buy this skirt earlier. She also said Michelle's grey-purple nail polish was an excellent decorative addition.

710a4532933b316373a0f5f76e8a055fb65142ef.sourceText: 报道称，米歇尔的这款指甲油引起的关注丝毫不亚于她的裙子，这种色彩很少出现在政治人物身上，在30岁以上女性中也是少有。但是米歇尔一向不跟随时尚潮流，而是重新创造潮流。 目前，美国的时尚人士纷纷猜测米歇尔的指甲油的品牌，一名记者向白宫确认了答案，米歇尔使用的是艺术指甲设计(Artistic Nail Design)的一款指甲油。
710a4532933b316373a0f5f76e8a055fb65142ef.translatedText: reported that Michelle's nail polish attracted as much attention as her skirt. This color rarely appears on politicians and is also rare among women over 30 years old. But Michelle never follows fashion trends, but reinvents them. At present, American fashion people are speculating on the brand of Michelle's nail polish. A reporter confirmed the answer to the White House. Michelle uses a nail polish from Artistic Nail Design.

f217eeb0a4da3615d32c23c8a960acae2e80b847.sourceText: 该品牌的美国总部已接到许多有关该款指甲油的咨询。公司发言人6日说：”单是这种色彩，我们接到的电话就增加了90%。”公司目前有存货1000瓶，但是存货需增加到至少5000瓶才能满足需求。
f217eeb0a4da3615d32c23c8a960acae2e80b847.translatedText: The brand's U.S. headquarters has received many inquiries about this nail polish. A company spokesman said on the 6th: "For this color alone, the calls we received increased by 90%." The company currently has 1,000 bottles in stock, but the inventory needs to be increased to at least 5,000 bottles to meet demand.

4f30080e9f20eb9344724d764f8f380ab2bc2c64.sourceText: 米歇尔使用的这款指甲油价格15.95美元，保持时间长并且防裂，由于这种指甲油需要紫外光源烘干，因此主要是由专业人士进行涂抹。
4f30080e9f20eb9344724d764f8f380ab2bc2c64.translatedText: The nail polish used by Michelle costs US$15.95. It lasts long and is anti-cracking. Since this nail polish requires a UV light source to dry, it is mainly applied by professionals.

The original Grace Valley Chinese Baptist Church has joined forces with the Philippine church and the Spanish church to worship together and changed its name since May...

a9a648ef9ce9832e0e900af8d36c3f87a0da7888.sourceText: 亚省国际浸信会 欢迎您 原恩谷华人浸信会自五月份起与菲律宾教会和西班牙教会合组联合敬拜并更名为亚省国际浸信会.主日崇拜时，由国语传道，英文翻译。 新的组合; 新的气象; 国语牧师蔡汉良博士主理. 蔡牧师相信许多凤城的华人朋友都知道他, 他是少数几位见证凤城基督教成长及茁壮的资深牧师, 蔡牧师不仅在神学方面 的专精更是开通您心灵困惑的最佳导师. 国语经理戴大卫博士不仅是优良的生活讲师更是位万事通先生, 只要提出您的难题交给他, 他总是想方设法帮您解决, 所以华人朋友们别客气; 无论是学业上生活上把您的问题 交给他. 教会将陆续开办多项满足老中青及妇女朋友们的课程; 如篮球联谊队; 吉他初级班(已开班);英语会话班(外籍讲师授课); 烹饪班(南北美食交流), 在此一定 要提一下教会烹饪班的讲师是由蕙质兰心的蔡师母担任, 您知道她是一位知名的营养学家; 非常注重养身及美味. 她会教导您如何吃出健康; 吃出活力; 吃出美丽. 特别介绍教会的电脑班讲师张军龙先生; 他会以深入浅出的方式, 无论是初级入门; 网路; 或软硬体方面的疑难杂症,他都会以最专业的态度与您一同解决. 亚省国际浸信会的地址: 745 N.Alma School Rd, Mesa, AZ85201 联络电话: 602 327 1834 蔡汉良博士, 480 784 7936 大卫博士, 480 559 4713 张军龙先生. 教会活动时间: 主日崇拜 Sun. 9:30 am Worship Service 主日学 Sun. 11:00 am Sunday School 爱宴团契 Sun. 12:00 Pm Lunch Fellowship 周三祷告会 Wed. 7:00 pm Prayer Meeting 专职青团契 Fri. 7:30 pm Young Adults Fellowship 华语团契 Fri. 7:00 pm Mandarin Fellowship 这个大家庭需要您, 欢迎华人朋友; 主内兄弟姊妹一同加入, 共同成就 主的荣耀。
a9a648ef9ce9832e0e900af8d36c3f87a0da7888.translatedText: >Alberta International Baptist Church welcomes you. The original Grace Valley Chinese Baptist Church has joined forces with the Philippine church and the Spanish church in May to worship together and changed its name to the Alberta International Baptist Church. During Sunday worship, the church is preached in Mandarin and translated in English. New combination; new atmosphere; Mandarin pastor Dr. Cai Hanliang is in charge. Pastor Cai believes that many Chinese friends in Fengcheng know him. He is one of the few senior pastors who has witnessed the growth and growth of Christianity in Fengcheng. Pastor Cai is not only expert in theology but also the best mentor to enlighten your spiritual confusion. So don’t be polite, Chinese friends; leave your problems to him whether it’s academic or life issues. The church will successively launch a number of courses to satisfy old, middle-aged, young and female friends; such as basketball team; beginner guitar class (already started); English conversation class (taught by foreign lecturers); cooking class (North-South food exchange). It must be mentioned here that the lecturer of the church’s cooking class is Mrs. Cai of Huizhi Lanxin, who you know is a well-known nutritionist; She pays great attention to health and delicious food. She will teach you how to eat healthily, eat energetically, and eat beautiful. We would like to introduce Mr. Zhang Junlong, the computer class instructor of the church. He will teach you in a simple and easy-to-understand manner. Whether it is basic entry, Internet, or software and hardware problems, he will solve them with you in the most professional manner. The address of the International Baptist Church of Alberta: 745 N.Alma School Rd, Mesa, AZ85201 Contact number: 602 327 1834 Dr. Cai Hanliang, 480 784 7936 Dr. David, 480 559 4713 Mr. Zhang Junlong. a3a178ac459952f8da2b41959102f669bf7ce8af.sourceText: 亚利桑那州博览会主办方说，今年历时三个星期的博览会入场游客刷新了往年纪录。 据博览会数据，有一百万多人次出席了音乐会，使用游乐设施，购买食品，包括全新的三明治和枫叶糖培根甜甜圈。 今年的游客消费超过一万磅糖，四万五千个玉米肠，三千支棉花糖。 博览会展出日期是10月14日至11月6日。 明年的时间暂定为10月12日至11月4日。
a3a178ac459952f8da2b41959102f669bf7ce8af.translatedText: The organizers of the Arizona State Fair said that the number of visitors to this year's three-week fair set a new record in previous years. According to fair data, more than a million people attended the concerts, used the rides and purchased food, including new sandwiches and maple sugar bacon donuts. This year's visitors consumed more than 10,000 pounds of sugar, 45,000 corn sausages, and 3,000 marshmallows. The expo exhibition dates are October 14th to November 6th. Next year's time is tentatively scheduled for October 12th to November 4th.

fb599ff8c9955b2b6c6c0ce7f53ebb251b608271.sourceText: 凤凰城气如虹：选举理念 我在上周的随笔曾经提起，无论做事或娱乐，要面对作选择的时候，必须当机立断，不能迟疑，如果「建屋道旁」，听取太多不同意见，思量又考虑，反而会误事。 碰巧就在当天，即二○一一年十二月九日星期五，我参与凤凰城华人耆英会举行年度会长选举，在四个候选人中，只能选择一位投票，真要当机立断， 绝无时间犹豫，刹那间就要笔锋一圈，择定候选人，把票投入箱内。 「鱼与熊掌」，可舍鱼取熊掌，还算容易，现在多了龙肝凤胆，又不可兼得，确难取舍，拿捏不定会出错，或违背自己原意；看来投票选举也 不是轻松的事。 生活于现世纪，选举已不是什么稀奇的事，如果常参加各团体活动，少不了要选举会长、主席之类职守；即使没有去交际，作为一个公民，也要去投票，选市长、州长啦， 选议员、总统啦，循环不息。 就算弃权不参与，在家中观看电视新闻，到处都有选举消息，亚洲各国尤其热闹，看看台湾、香港的选举，总是争吵不休，甚至发生肢体冲撞。 好像台湾，连芝麻绿豆的里长乡长竞选，也闹得沸腾，令人侧目。 我总觉得，亚洲民众的选举比不上欧美人士的涵养，欧美的候选人竞选时可以互相指责，一旦当选，落选的一方就祝贺对方的成功，以后共同合作，胸襟广阔，等待下次再度参 选，作良性竞争。 但亚洲人多数缺乏这种风度，落选后显得愤愤不平，不肯合作，明知政策的施行合理，亦故意阻挠。 谈及选举的话题很多，回顾我在越南，读小学时期就懂得选举的玩意，四年级时我已获老师与同学提名候选班长，由全班同学举手表决，一直到六年级小学毕业为止， 我一直获选连任班长，没有哪位同学能与我竞争。 我第二次被提名竞选，则是解放南方之后，在西贡解放日报社组织文友联谊会，那时高呼社会主义，总是害怕人心思变，人选内定，投票徒具形式。 文友会原是我主力促成，会长一职非我莫属，但我是旧政权军人，欠缺革命光环，名义上只好屈居副座，但没关系，不是追求名位，尽力服务，则不论正副， 一样受尊重。 至于我第一次履行公民投票权，是一九五九年越南共和国第二任总统选举，人人拿着选举证，大排长龙等待投票，踊跃热烈，结果是吴廷琰大胜。 当年民众不是真正热心拥护候选人，而是担心以后检查纸张，如果发现没有选举，被怀疑为共产党的破坏份子，那就遭殃。 选举理念，不少人认为来自西方国家，属于舶来品。 其实，中国很早就懂得选择人才，只是规则不同罢了。 我们看看古代的《礼记》在〈礼运． 大同〉篇中，有这样的记载：「大道之行也，天下为公。选贤与能，讲信修睦」。 由此可知，中国在孔夫子时期就倡导「选贤与能」，在二千多年前来说，思想很先进，很民主，很实际的选择方式。 在同一时代里，世界上没有哪个国家达到这样的标准，如果能够认真遵循执行，惟才有位，优点多于缺点，相信能把国家治理得很好。 《韩非子》也提到「圣王明君厖内举不避亲，外举不避仇，是在焉，从而举之，非在焉，从而罚之。」为国效劳着重人才，就算是仇家 ，照样要推举，对事不对人，有才干者可治国。 唐代李世民有「贞观之治」的盛世，就是主张「唯贤是举，慎择为先」。 古代的明君任用贤士，胸襟是多么的广阔，比现在一些狭隘思想的投票好得多。 既然中国早就有「选贤与能」，「唯贤是举」，「内举不避亲，外举不避仇」的良好观念，为什么中国没有人民选举政府官员的民主制度呢，这就 关连国情问题。 因为中国地大人多，教育难普及，孔子早就觉察到这一点，所以创立私塾推行平民教育，培养士子出来为国效劳。 平民占多数，贵族占少数，平民知识水准低，如果由一群没有学识的人来管理国事，肯定弄得乱糟糟，所以权力常掌握在饱学之士手中，或推举有才德者执政，不让老百姓 参与，这是主要的原因。 昔日中国特殊国情，发展出科举制度以甄选人才，而没有形成欧美的大众选举理念，原因在此。 事实上，每种制度也有优缺点，而随着国际的形势前进，现在我们许多方面已效法民主选举，从集会结社​​到政府机构，都定期投票选举，虽然有时出现偏差，但毕竟是自由民主 制度，大家可公开研讨，万事能迎刃而解。
fb599ff8c9955b2b6c6c0ce7f53ebb251b608271.translatedText: Phoenix City is full of energy: election philosophy. I mentioned in last week's essay that when faced with making a choice, whether in work or entertainment, you must make a decision immediately and without hesitation. If you "build a house next to the road" and listen to too many different opinions and think over and over again, you will make mistakes. Coincidentally, on that day, Friday, December 9, 2011, I participated in the annual presidential election of the Phoenix Chinese Senior Citizens Association. Among the four candidates, I could only choose one to vote. I really had to make a decision immediately. There was no time to hesitate. I had to write in a flash, choose the candidate, and put my vote in the box. "Fish and bear's paw", it is relatively easy to give up the fish and take the bear's paw. Now that you have the dragon's liver and the phoenix's gall, you cannot have both. It is really difficult to choose. You may make mistakes or go against your original intentions. It seems that voting is not an easy task. Living in this century, elections are no longer uncommon. If you often participate in various group activities, you will inevitably have to elect presidents and other duties. Even if you don't socialize, as a citizen, you still have to vote, elect mayors, governors, congressmen, presidents, etc. The cycle is endless. Even if you abstain from voting and do not participate, you can still watch TV news at home, and there will be election news everywhere. Asian countries are especially lively. Looking at the elections in Taiwan and Hong Kong, there are always quarrels and even physical confrontations. Just like in Taiwan, even the election for the mayor of Sesame and Mung Bean, the village chief, has been agitated and eye-catching. I always feel that the elections of the Asian people are not as sophisticated as those of European and American people. European and American candidates can blame each other during the election. Once elected, the losing party will congratulate the other party's success, cooperate with each other in the future, be broad-minded, and wait for the next election again to engage in healthy competition. However, most Asians lack this kind of grace. After losing the election, they appear aggrieved and unwilling to cooperate. They know that the implementation of the policy is reasonable but deliberately obstruct it. There are many topics about elections. Looking back at my time in Vietnam, I knew about elections when I was in elementary school. When I was in fourth grade, I was nominated by my teachers and classmates to be class president. The whole class voted by a show of hands. Until I graduated from elementary school in sixth grade, I was always re-elected as class president, and no classmates could compete with me. The second time I was nominated for election was after the liberation of the South. I organized a literary friends' association at the Liberation Daily in Saigon. At that time, I shouted for socialism, but I was always afraid of people's change of mind. The candidates were determined by default, and the voting was just a formality. I was the main force in promoting the Literary Friendship Association, and I had to be the president. However, I was a soldier of the old regime and lacked the aura of revolution. I had to take the deputy seat in name. But it didn’t matter. I was not pursuing fame and position. If I served my best, I would be respected regardless of whether I was a deputy or a deputy. As for the first time I exercised my right to vote, it was the second presidential election of the Republic of Vietnam in 1959. Everyone held their election certificates and waited in a long queue to vote. The result was Ngo Dinh Diem's ​​victory. At that time, the people were not really enthusiastic about supporting the candidates, but they were worried about checking the paper in the future. If they found that there was no election and were suspected of being saboteurs of the Communist Party, they would suffer. Many people think that the electoral concept is imported from Western countries. In fact, China has known how to select talents for a long time, but the rules are different. Let's look at the ancient "Book of Rites" in "Li Yun." In the chapter "Datong", there is this record: "In the journey of the great road, the world is for the common good. Select the worthy and capable, keep faith and cultivate harmony." It can be seen from this that China advocated "selecting talents and talents" during the period of Confucius. More than 2,000 years ago, it was a very advanced, democratic, and practical selection method. In the same era, no country in the world has reached such a standard. If it can be followed and implemented seriously, Wei Cai will be in place and the advantages will outweigh the disadvantages. I believe the country can be governed well. "Han Feizi" also mentioned that "the sage king Ming Jun Pang does not avoid relatives when doing internal affairs, and does not avoid enemies when doing external affairs. It is because of the reason, so he can promote it, and because of it, he punishes him." Serving the country emphasizes talents, even if they are enemies, they still have to recommend them, not to people but to things. Talented people can govern the country. In the Tang Dynasty, Li Shimin had the prosperous period of the "Government of Zhenguan", which advocated "only the virtuous should be promoted, and careful selection should be the first". The wise kings in ancient times were so broad-minded in appointing wise men, which is much better than the narrow-minded votes today. Since China has long had the good concepts of "selecting the talented and capable", "promoting only the worthy", and "not avoiding relatives when promoting internally, and not avoiding enemies when promoting externally", why does China not have a democratic system for people to elect government officials? This is related to the national conditions. Because China is a large country with a large population, it is difficult to popularize education. Confucius has long been aware of this, so he founded private schools to promote civilian education and train scholars to serve the country. Common people make up the majority, nobles make up the minority, and the knowledge level of the common people is low. If a group of unlearned people manage state affairs, it will definitely make a mess. Therefore, power is often in the hands of educated people, or talented and virtuous people are elected to govern without allowing the common people to participate. This is the main reason. In the past, China's special national conditions led to the development of the imperial examination system to select talents, but did not form the European and American concept of mass elections. This is the reason. In fact, each system also has its advantages and disadvantages. As the international situation advances, we have now followed the example of democratic elections in many aspects. From assemblies and associations to government agencies, regular voting is conducted. Although there are sometimes deviations, it is a liberal democratic system after all. Everyone can discuss it openly and everything can be solved.

3198d688086007ccd0d6137f42450794d2c03442.sourceText: 1986年12月中下旬，资产阶级自由化思潮一度泛滥，并逐步演变为学生对民主诉求的学潮。方励之在整个学潮过程中对学生的民主诉求没有打压，成为中国学生追求民主自由的精神领袖。本文原题《旗帜鲜明地反对资产阶级自由化》，为1986年12月30日邓小平与几位中央领导同志的谈话。谈话中重点批判资产阶级自由化思潮，并点名批判方励之。随后，方励之被开除中共党籍与中国科学技术大学副校长一职，并被调到北京天文台任研究员。
3198d688086007ccd0d6137f42450794d2c03442.translatedText: In mid-to-late December 1986, the bourgeois liberalization trend became widespread and gradually evolved into a student movement demanding democratic demands. Fang Lizhi did not suppress the students' democratic demands throughout the student unrest and became the spiritual leader of Chinese students in their pursuit of democracy and freedom. The original title of this article, "Taking a Clear-cut Stand against Bourgeois Liberalization," was a conversation between Deng Xiaoping and several central leading comrades on December 30, 1986. The talk focused on criticizing bourgeois liberalization trends and criticized Fang Lizhi by name. Subsequently, Fang Lizhi was expelled from the Chinese Communist Party and from his position as vice president of the University of Science and Technology of China, and was transferred to the Beijing Observatory as a researcher.

aace8014af485f3e1a67764cc0f6e4672e049405.sourceText: 我看了方励之的讲话，根本不象一个共产党员讲的，这样的人留在党内干什么？不是劝退的问题，要开除。有的人并没有放弃他的观点，但这次学生闹事他表示不参加，这就好嘛！你的观点可以保留，只要你没有反党反社会主义行动。上海的王若望猖狂得很，早就说要开除，为什么一直没有办？
aace8014af485f3e1a67764cc0f6e4672e049405.translatedText: I read Fang Lizhi’s speech, and it was not like what a Communist Party member would say. Why would such a person stay in the party? It's not a matter of persuading someone to quit, it's a matter of expulsion. Some people have not given up their views, but this time they said they would not participate in the student riots. That’s good! Your views can be retained as long as you do not take anti-party or anti-socialist actions. Wang Ruowang in Shanghai is very arrogant. He has long said that he would be fired. Why has nothing been done?

63cc1e06c7e2c1cc16717ef9eba4e798862a1cf6.sourceText: 群众中传说中央有个保护层，对是否坚持四项原则，是否要反对自由化，也有两种意见。应该说，从中央到地方，在思想理论战线上是软弱的，丧失了阵地，对于搞资产阶级自由化是个放任的态度，好人得不到支持，坏人猖狂得很。好人没有勇气讲话，好象自己输了理似的。没有什么输理的。四项基本原则必须讲，人民民主专政必须讲。要争取一个安定团结的政治局面，没有人民民主专政不行，不能让那些颠倒是非、混淆黑白、造谣诬蔑的人畅行无阻，煽动群众。前几年，我们不是对那几个搞自由化并且触犯了刑律的人依法处理了吗？难道因此中国的名誉就坏了吗？中国的形象并没有因此而变坏，我们的名誉还是在一天比一天好起来。
63cc1e06c7e2c1cc16717ef9eba4e798862a1cf6.translatedText: It is said among the masses that the central government has a protective layer. There are also two opinions on whether to adhere to the Four Principles and whether to oppose liberalization. It should be said that from the central government to the local governments, they are weak on the ideological and theoretical front, have lost their ground, and have a laissez-faire attitude toward bourgeois liberalization. Good people do not get support, and bad people are very rampant. Good people don't have the courage to speak, as if they have lost their minds. There is no reason to lose. The four basic principles must be emphasized, and the people's democratic dictatorship must be emphasized. To strive for a stable and united political situation, it is impossible without the people's democratic dictatorship. Those who confuse right and wrong, confuse right and wrong, spread rumors and slander can not be allowed to go unimpeded and incite the masses. A few years ago, didn’t we deal with those few people who engaged in liberalization and violated criminal laws in accordance with the law? Has China's reputation been ruined because of this? China's image has not deteriorated because of this, and our reputation is getting better day by day.

2e5144ca88b061e242db046513625a6c60338218.sourceText: 我们讲民主，不能搬用资产阶级的民主，不能搞三权鼎立那一套。我经常批评美国当权者，说他们实际上有三个政府。当然，美国资产阶级对外用这一手来对付其他国家，但对内自己也打架，造成了麻烦。这种办法我们不能采用。
2e5144ca88b061e242db046513625a6c60338218.translatedText: When we talk about democracy, we cannot copy bourgeois democracy, and we cannot engage in the practice of the separation of powers. I often criticize those in power in the United States, saying that they actually have three governments. Of course, the American bourgeoisie uses this method to deal with other countries externally, but it also fights with itself internally, causing trouble. We cannot adopt this approach.

31fc57a557db9e189a9dace01408097418fea019.sourceText: 我们执行对外开放政策，学习外国的技术，利用外贸，这只是社会主义建设的一个补充，而不能离开社会主义道路。我们要发展社会生产力，发展全民所有制，增加全民所得。我们允许一些地区、一些人先富起来，是为了最终达到共同富裕，所以要防止两级分化，这就叫社会主义。我们讲共同富裕，但也允许有差别。
31fc57a557db9e189a9dace01408097418fea019.translatedText: We implement the policy of opening up to the outside world, learn foreign technology, and utilize foreign trade. This is only a supplement to socialist construction and cannot deviate from the socialist road. We must develop social productivity, develop ownership by the whole people, and increase the income of the whole people. We allow some regions and some people to get rich first in order to ultimately achieve common prosperity, so we must prevent polarization. This is called socialism. We talk about common prosperity, but we also allow differences.

d7c7e6286cfcd79dbb8ee7281549af589f8d648a.sourceText: 中国没有共产党的领导、不搞社会主义是没有前途的。这个道理已经得到证明，将来还要得到证明。如果我们搞到人均国民生产总值四千美元，而且是共同富裕的，到那时就能够更好地显示社会主义制度优于资本主义制度，就为人类四分之三的人口指出了奋斗方向，更加证明了马克思主义的正确性。所以，我们要理直气壮地坚持社会主义道路，坚持四项基本原则。
d7c7e6286cfcd79dbb8ee7281549af589f8d648a.translatedText: China will have no future without the leadership of the Communist Party and without socialism. This truth has been proven and will be proven in the future. If we achieve a per capita GNP of US$4,000 and achieve common prosperity, then we will be able to better demonstrate that the socialist system is superior to the capitalist system, and it will point out the direction of struggle for three-quarters of the human population, and further prove the correctness of Marxism. Therefore, we must adhere to the socialist road with confidence and adhere to the four basic principles.

7bd477b94c4f87d4b2b40ee547af2ca287af3939.sourceText: 没有专政手段是不行的。对专政手段，不但要讲，而且必要时要使用。当然，使用时要慎重，抓人要尽量少。但如果有人要制造流血事件，你有什么办法？我们的办法是首先揭露他们的阴谋，尽量避免流血，宁可我们自己人被打伤。但是对为首闹事触犯刑律的要依法处理。不下这个决心是制止不了这场事件的。如果不采取措施，我们后退了，以后麻烦会更多。
7bd477b94c4f87d4b2b40ee547af2ca287af3939.translatedText: It is impossible without dictatorial means. We must not only talk about dictatorship methods, but also use them when necessary. Of course, be careful when using it and arrest as few people as possible. But if someone wants to cause bloodshed, what can you do? Our approach is to expose their conspiracy first, try to avoid bloodshed, and would rather our own people be injured. However, those who lead troubles and violate criminal laws must be dealt with according to law. This incident cannot be stopped unless we make this determination. If no measures are taken and we retreat, we will have more troubles in the future.

ff6a9f63239c138c38b37d3b45d2d77de4a6749b.sourceText: 对于那些明显反对社会主义、反对共产党的，这次就要处理。可能会引起波浪，那也不可怕。对方励之、刘宾雁、王若望处理要坚决，他们狂妄到极点，想改变共产党，他们有什么资格当共产党员？
ff6a9f63239c138c38b37d3b45d2d77de4a6749b.translatedText: Those who are clearly opposed to socialism and the Communist Party will be dealt with this time. It might cause waves, but that's not a big deal. Fang Lizhi, Liu Binyan, and Wang Ruowang must be dealt with resolutely. They are extremely arrogant and want to change the Communist Party. What qualifications do they have to be Communist Party members?

ba48b05764f174a39ae8fd7738583977c0aedba1.sourceText: 在六中全会上我本来不准备讲话，后来我不得不讲了必须写上反对资产阶级自由化那一段话，看来也没起什么作用，听说没有传达。
ba48b05764f174a39ae8fd7738583977c0aedba1.translatedText: I was not planning to speak at the Sixth Plenary Session of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, but later I had to say that I had to write a paragraph about opposing bourgeois liberalization. It seemed that it had no effect. I heard that it was not conveyed.

0864fbbf4a910bcc9dd56fd1c97509e42c367e84.sourceText: 反对精神污染的观点，我至今没有放弃，我同意将我当时在二中全会上的讲话全文收入我的论文集。
0864fbbf4a910bcc9dd56fd1c97509e42c367e84.translatedText: I have not given up my opinion against mental pollution. I agreed to include the full text of my speech at the Second Plenary Session of the Central Committee of the CPC in my collection of papers.

9d337757bd23006d45ed018cdedc57aab47889b5.sourceText: 反对资产阶级自由化至少还要搞二十年。民主只能逐步地发展，不能搬用西方的那一套，要搬那一套，非乱不可。我们的社会主义建设，必 须在安定团结的条件下有领导、有秩序地进行，我特别强调有理想、有纪律，就是这个道理。如果搞资产阶级自由化，就是再来一次折腾。搞资产阶级自由化，脱离了党的领导，十亿人民没有一个凝聚力，就丧失了战斗力。那样的党连个群众团体也不如了，怎么领导人民搞建设？
9d337757bd23006d45ed018cdedc57aab47889b5.translatedText: Opposition to bourgeois liberalization will take at least another twenty years. Democracy can only develop gradually and cannot copy the Western style. To copy that style, chaos is the only way. Our socialist construction must be carried out under leadership and in an orderly manner under conditions of stability and unity. This is why I particularly emphasize ideals and discipline. If we engage in bourgeois liberalization, it will be another setback. Engaging in bourgeois liberalization and breaking away from the leadership of the party, one billion people have no cohesion and have lost their fighting capacity. A party like that is no better than a mass organization, so how can it lead the people in construction?

e9ae8b1ddad4f0527b4e5927354b83f1e657835f.sourceText: 一九五七年反对资产阶级右派的斗争，有太过火的地方，应当平反。但我们对它没有全盘否定。
e9ae8b1ddad4f0527b4e5927354b83f1e657835f.translatedText: The struggle against the bourgeois right in 1957 went too far and should be redressed. But we don’t completely deny it.

dacdf337ce066574de001c2fb6ac92d949a30365.sourceText: 反对资产阶级自由化也是不可缺少的，不要怕外国人说我们损害了自己的名誉。中国要走自己的路，建设有中国特色的社会主义，中国才有希望。要让外国人看到中国政局是稳定的。如果搞得乱七八糟、一盘散沙，那还有什么希望？过去帝国主义欺侮我们，还不是因为我们是一盘散沙？
dacdf337ce066574de001c2fb6ac92d949a30365.translatedText: Opposing bourgeois liberalization is also indispensable. Don’t be afraid that foreigners will say that we have damaged our reputation. China must follow its own path and build socialism with Chinese characteristics. Only then can China have hope. We must let foreigners see that China's political situation is stable. If it's a mess, what hope is there? In the past, the imperialists bullied us, wasn't it because we were a piece of loose sand?

26c1828bfd6c2bf05b894dbba4b78a6f8d04063c.sourceText: 处理学生闹事是一件大事，领导要旗帜鲜明，群众才能擦亮眼睛。《人民日报》三篇文章写得不错，《北京日报》社论《大字报不受法律保 护》写得也不错，李瑞环在天津的讲话也不错。正因为态度鲜明了，给积极分子鼓了气，中间群众才能站过来。
26c1828bfd6c2bf05b894dbba4b78a6f8d04063c.translatedText: Dealing with student troubles is a major matter. Leaders must have a clear-cut stand so that the masses can keep their eyes open. The three articles in the "People's Daily" were well written, the "Beijing Daily" editorial "Big-character posters are not protected by law" was also well written, and Li Ruihuan's speech in Tianjin was also well written. It is precisely because the attitude is clear and the activists are encouraged that the masses in the middle can stand up.

561642d4607d917691fc213d7cb2ff7b317490b3.sourceText: 亚省纪念反法西斯暨抗战胜利七十周会筹委会于四月十二日下午假鳯城酒家举行了第二次会议。筹委会主席邓朝驹主持了会议，25位来自社会各界的人士在团结和谐的气氛中进行了讨论。大家一致同意遵照铭记历史、缅怀先烈、珍视和平、展望未来的方针，做好并支持所有纪念活动，推动社会各界关注、支持、积极参与纪念活动，增进中华民族团结凝聚的力量。 为推动纪念活动的开展，会议硧定成立工作小组，并选出了负责人： 活动协调组：张圣仪 王维咨 新闻组： 崔増祁 帅致若 陈丽君 彭菲 谢成彦 集资组： 邱顺雄 张华芳 邓朝驹 高志中 黄馨民 公关组： 李健 高志中 黄馨民 财务组：陶世諴 Ken陈 黄馨民 赵益衔 各项活动的负责人分别报告了活动准备情况。纪念抗日战争的文章已陆续在各报刋和网上登出；抗战时期啚片展将于4月19日在凤凰城中文学校首次展出，并陆续巡迴展出；青少年绘画比赛已由侨联发出通告，欢迎大家积极参与；百人黄河大合唱正在积极组织人员排练；七月七日举行抗战纪念座谈会（国语） 已基本就绪；八月和九月举办的晚会和歺会、酒会等纪念活动以及抗战电影展等正酝酿筹备中。欢迎大家推出更多的纪念活动，使活动更加丰富多彩。着名画家范融携夫人和两位中医参加了今天的会议并当场作画”马踏㣦冦”表达对纪念活动的支持。 会议讨论并通过：各项纪念活动的主持人为委员会的执行主席。 参加筹委会的各界人士纷纷带头解囊为活动提供资金。㑹议感谢众多支持纪念活动和参加筹备活动的热心人士出钱出力，筹委会已筹得资金伍千多元，希望按照抗战时期提出的’有銭出钱、有力出力’的精神继续得到社会各界人士的赞助和支持。会议决定凡捐款一百美元以上的个人和团体均为委员会荣誉委员，由本会发给証书留念，并在各项纪念活动中给予优惠。所有筹集资金将全部用于支持各项纪念活动，账目公开，并接受社会监督。会议特别感谢华人耆英会广东话合唱团为表达纪念抗战的爱国热忱，集资一千美元支持抗战纪念活动。 会议将于五月十七日（星期日）下午三时在鳯城酒家召开第三次会议，并公布所有赞助人名单。欢迎所有愿意支持纪念活动的朋友参加会议或提供赞助。
561642d4607d917691fc213d7cb2ff7b317490b3.translatedText: The Preparatory Committee of the 70th Weekly Meeting to Commemorate the Victory of the Anti-Fascist and Anti-Japanese War in Alberta held its second meeting in the afternoon of April 12th at the Fengcheng Restaurant. Deng Chaoju, Chairman of the Preparatory Committee, presided over the meeting, and 25 people from all walks of life discussed in a united and harmonious atmosphere. Everyone unanimously agreed to follow the policy of remembering history, honoring martyrs, cherishing peace, and looking forward to the future, carry out and support all commemorative activities, promote attention, support, and active participation in commemorative activities from all walks of life, and enhance the unity and cohesion of the Chinese nation. In order to promote the commemorative activities, the meeting decided to set up a working group and elected the person in charge: Activity coordination group: Zhang Shengyi Wang Weizi News group: Cui Qi Shuai Zhiruo Chen Lijun Peng Fei Xie Chengyan Fund-raising group: Qiu Shunxiong Zhang Huafang Deng Chaoju Gao Zhizhong Huang Xinmin Public relations group: Li Jian Gao Zhizhong Huang Xinmin Finance group: Tao Shichen Ken Chen Huang Xinmin and Zhao Yixian, the persons in charge of various activities, reported on the preparations for the activities respectively. Articles commemorating the Anti-Japanese War have been published in various newspapers and online; an exhibition of anti-Japanese war-era films will be exhibited for the first time at the Phoenix Chinese School on April 19, and will continue to tour; the youth painting competition has been announced by the Overseas Chinese Federation, and everyone is welcome to actively participate; the 100-person Yellow River Cantata is actively organizing personnel rehearsals; a Anti-Japanese War commemoration symposium will be held on July 7 (Mandarin) It is basically ready; preparations are under way for commemorative activities such as evening parties, receptions, and cocktail parties in August and September, as well as the Anti-Japanese War Film Exhibition. Everyone is welcome to launch more commemorative activities to make the activities more colorful. The famous painter Fan Rong, his wife and two traditional Chinese medicine doctors attended today's meeting and painted "Horse Stepping on the Horse" on the spot to express his support for the commemoration event. The meeting discussed and approved: the host of each commemorative event shall be the executive chairman of the committee. People from all walks of life who participated in the organizing committee took the lead in donating money to fund the event. We would like to thank the many enthusiastic people who have supported the commemoration activities and participated in the preparatory activities for their financial support. The preparatory committee has raised more than 5,000 yuan in funds. We hope to continue to receive sponsorship and support from people from all walks of life in accordance with the spirit of "have money and strength" proposed during the Anti-Japanese War. The meeting decided that all individuals and groups who donate more than 100 US dollars will be honored members of the committee, and will be issued certificates by the Association as a souvenir, and will be given preferential treatment in various commemorative activities. All funds raised will be used to support various commemorative activities, and the accounts will be made public and subject to social supervision. The meeting would like to express special thanks to the Cantonese Choir of the Chinese Senior Citizens Association for raising US$1,000 to support the Anti-Japanese War commemoration activities to express their patriotic enthusiasm. The meeting will hold its third meeting at 3:00 pm on Sunday, May 17th at the Fucheng Restaurant, and the list of all sponsors will be announced. All friends who would like to support the commemoration are welcome to attend the meeting or provide sponsorship.

0948ea23d19491e90c42209906135f0fc94ff497.translatedText: See if your school is on the list? Ranking of the ten colleges and universities with the highest student happiness index in the United States On Monday, August 4, the "Princeton Review" announced its annual ranking of American universities. The Princeton Review differs from other authoritative rankings in that it does not rank schools overall. Instead, the rankings were based on a total of 62 aspects of the school's political leanings, quality of life, dormitory conditions, and social life that students care about. The survey questions ranged from "How much financial aid did you receive? Is the food in the hall delicious?" and covered a wide range of topics. The ranking results are not completed by professional institutions, but are derived from a survey of 130,000 students. Vanderbilt University, located in Tennessee, took the lead this year and topped the list. The school's student happiness index ranks first in the United States. Vanderbilt University deserves its No. 1 ranking, and students do have a lot to be happy about: Not only does the school offer huge financial aid, but it's also known as one of the most cost-effective colleges in the country. The ranking of the ten happiest colleges in the United States by the "Princeton Review" is as follows: 1. Vanderbilt University, Nashville, Tenn. 2. Claremont McKenna College, Claremont, Calif. 3. Clemson University, Clemson, S.C. 4. Tulane University, New Orleans, La. Tulane University (New Orleans, Louisiana) 5. Virginia Tech, Blacksburg, Va. Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University (Montgomery, Virginia) 6. Rice University, Houston, Tex. 7. Kansas State University, Manhattan, KS 8. Bowdoin College, Brunswick, Maine 9. Vassar College, Poughkeepsie, NY Vassar College (Posey, New York) 10. Hillsdale College, Hillsdale, Mich. Hillsdale College (Michigan, Hillsdale)

26afd8619d964ab27407690fc3e894324e8fc554.sourceText: 黄慧莉律师法律信箱（九） 2012年7 月份美國勞工移民 排期 優先排期 第一優先 全世界,有名額. 中國大陸: 有名額 第二優先 全世界,01/01/2009. 中國大陸: 沒有名額無法送件 第三優先 全世界,07/22/2006. 中國大陸: 9/22/2005 第四優先 全世界,有名額. 中國大陸:有名額 第五優先 全世界,有名額. 中國大陸:有名額 全世界不包印度,墨西哥,菲律賓 國務院表示，由於職業移民第二優先名額的需求很大，所以2012年7月份的移民排期全世界第二優先出現排期倒退的情況。如果第二優先名額的需求持續增加的話，不排期在今年九月30日前，全世界的第二優先可能出現”無法遞件”的情況。至於中國大陸及印度的第二優先排期，目前已經處於”無法遞件”的情況。在2012年9月30日前不會有名額。 國務院將從2012年10月1日開始開放FY-2013年新財政年度的職業移民申請，屆時第二優先的名額也將重新開放。 2012年7 月份美國 親屬 移民 排期 優先排期 第一優先 全世界,7/08/2005 中國大陸:7/08/2005 第二優先A 全世界,2/15/2010. 中國大陸:2/15/2010 第二優先B 全世界,05/1/2004. 中國大陸:05/1/2004 第三優先 全世界,04/15/2002. 中國大陸:04/15/2002 第四優先 全世界,1/22/2001. 中國大陸:1/08/2001 問：我有一位朋友已獲得來美的移民簽證，打算今年10月來美。 他打算攜帶現金一起赴美， 但不知可攜帶現金數量上限是多少﹖ 答：隨身攜帶貨幣進出美國國境沒有金額限制，法律上也容許，但是在金額超過1萬美金以上時，不管在任何情況下進出美國國境時，攜帶者須填寫一份海關海關表格4790申報。違者將導致法律和刑事處罰，並可能被沒收現金。在九一一事件後頒布的美國愛國法 (USA Patriot Act)對不申報者的處罰更嚴格。暗藏超過一萬美元現金或其他有價證券的闖關者定為犯罪，最高可判坐牢五年，被扣押物可作刑事或民事充公。一旦事情發生了，如果能證明錢的來源是合法的，相當部分的錢還可取回。
26afd8619d964ab27407690fc3e894324e8fc554.translatedText: Huang Huili’s legal mailbox (9) July 2012 U.S. labor immigration schedule Priority first priority All over the world, there are quotas. Mainland China: There are quotas Second priority: Worldwide, 01/01/2009. Mainland China: No quota. No delivery. Third priority: Worldwide, 07/22/2006. Mainland China: 9/22/2005. Fourth priority: Worldwide, quota available. Mainland China: quota available. Fifth priority: Mainland China: quota available. Worldwide, excluding India, Mexico, and the Philippines. The State Council stated that due to the huge demand for the second-priority employment-based immigration quota, the ranking of the second-priority immigrants in the world in July 2012 has been reversed. If the demand for second-priority places continues to increase, there may be a situation where second-priority applications around the world are “unable to deliver” before September 30 this year. As for the second priority schedule for mainland China and India, they are currently in a "undeliverable" situation. There will be no places available before September 30, 2012. The State Council will open employment-based immigration applications for the new fiscal year FY-2013 from October 1, 2012, at which time the second-priority quota will also be reopened. Mainland China: 2/15/2010 Second priority B Worldwide, 05/1/2004. Mainland China: 05/1/2004 Third priority Worldwide, 04/15/2002. Mainland China: 04/15/2002 Fourth priority Worldwide, 1/22/2001. Mainland China: 1/08/2001 Question: I have a friend who has obtained an immigrant visa to the United States and plans to come to the United States in October this year. He plans to bring cash with him to the United States, but he doesn’t know what is the upper limit of the amount of cash he can bring? Answer: There is no limit on the amount of currency carried in and out of the United States, and it is legally allowed. However, when the amount exceeds US$10,000, the carrier must fill out a Customs Form 4790 declaration when entering or exiting the United States under any circumstances. Violations will result in legal and criminal penalties and possible cash forfeiture. The USA Patriot Act, enacted after the 9/11 attacks, imposes stricter penalties on those who fail to declare. It is a crime for anyone who conceals more than $10,000 in cash or other securities and is subject to up to five years in prison, and the seized property may be subject to criminal or civil forfeiture. Once something happens, if it can be proven that the source of the money is legal, a considerable part of the money can be recovered.

62daefc379fcc006ddb573edda6defc2d76cfecb.sourceText: 爬山野餐去——科工专​倾情奉献 2011年5月1日中国科学家工程师专业人士协会凤凰城分会（科工专）组织大家去爬山。聚会时间5月1日周日早上10时，在Lake Pleasant的主入口集合。想要拼车的朋友可以早上9：00AM到Costco (McDowell Rd and NW between I-101 and I-10) 集合，有车可以大家一起走。请带上些饮料，食物和朋友们一起分享。 爬山地点链接： http://www.maricopa.gov/parks/lake_pleasant/Directions.aspx http://www.maricopa.gov/parks/lake_pleasant/trails.aspx 联系人： Qian Xue (623-703-8071) Wen Huang (480-459-7850) Amoy Yang (623-332-5808)
62daefc379fcc006ddb573edda6defc2d76cfecb.translatedText: Go hiking and have a picnic - the Science and Engineering College’s dedication. On May 1, 2011, the Phoenix Branch of the Chinese Professional Association of Scientists and Engineers (Science and Engineering College) organized everyone to go mountain climbing. The gathering will be at 10 a.m. on Sunday, May 1, at the main entrance of Lake Pleasant. Friends who want to carpool can meet at Costco (McDowell Rd and NW between I-101 and I-10) at 9:00 AM. If there is a car, everyone can go together. Please bring some drinks and food to share with friends. Climbing location links: http://www.maricopa.gov/parks/lake_pleasant/Directions.aspx http://www.maricopa.gov/parks/lake_pleasant/trails.aspx Contact: Qian Xue (623-703-8071) Wen Huang (480-459-7850) Amoy Yang (623-332-5808)

5c6962e57e9f02017bf363e6c024213f320a9961.translatedText: Phoenix bowling champion Luk Fook team held a celebration banquet (Newsletter of the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association) On July 11, the Phoenix Bowling Association's 2016 championship team Luk Fook...

f2a9c11eb5a0411b7e64fc8b0ee2fa4bb62939cd.sourceText: （亚省中餐馆会通讯）7月11日，凤凰城保龄球协㑹2016年度总冠军六福队，在六福酒家举行庆功宴，亚省中餐馆会董事特别到来恭贺。据保龄协会主席巫宜钊讲述：保龄协会成立已有75年的历史，老侨们每到星期一晩上在生意打样后，会齐聚一起打球和比赛，活动一直到今天从未间断。为了让更多有兴趣的人仕参与，保龄协会每年都会閞办训练班，在每星期一晚上9：30分在19Ave.和Bethany Home Rd.进行训练活动，欢迎各界参加。详情请电巫宜钊–623-341-5032
f2a9c11eb5a0411b7e64fc8b0ee2fa4bb62939cd.translatedText: (Newsletter of the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association) On July 11th, the Phoenix Bowling Association's 2016 championship team Luk Fook held a celebration banquet at Lukfook Restaurant. The director of the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association came to congratulate them. According to Wu Yizhao, chairman of the Bowling Association, the Bowling Association has a history of 75 years. Every Monday night after doing business, the old overseas Chinese will gather together to play ball and compete. The activities have never stopped to this day. In order to allow more interested people to participate, the Bowling Association holds training classes every year. Training activities are held at 19Ave. and Bethany Home Rd. every Monday at 9:30 pm. All walks of life are welcome to participate. For details, please call Wu Yizhao – 623-341-5032

f383de934d9b88c256e106422b1d87619e2cb109.translatedText: Liu Yifei becomes the heroine of the real-life version of "Mulan", and the super-powerful escort team arouses expectations Since Disney announced that the classic animation "Mulan" will be adapted into a live-action movie, the heroine...

450006a3833b4bb1a9b1a8564c9c6d0dd1f93bdf.sourceText: 迪士尼自宣布经典动画《花木兰》将改编成真人电影后，女主角人选始终是网友关注的焦点。今日，全球娱乐业权威媒体《好莱坞报道》发布新闻，宣布迪士尼已结束全球海选，中国女演员刘亦菲确定饰演传奇巾帼英雄花木兰。
450006a3833b4bb1a9b1a8564c9c6d0dd1f93bdf.translatedText: Since Disney announced that the classic animation "Mulan" will be adapted into a live-action movie, the choice of the heroine has always been the focus of netizens' attention. Today, The Hollywood Reporter, an authoritative media outlet in the global entertainment industry, released news announcing that Disney has concluded global auditions and that Chinese actress Liu Yifei has been confirmed to play the legendary heroine Hua Mulan.

160e0b6c98a577f6e51ec1224454d63d6661a92e.sourceText: 刘亦菲出演《花木兰》 成迪士尼动画改编真人电影女主
160e0b6c98a577f6e51ec1224454d63d6661a92e.translatedText: Liu Yifei starred in "Mulan" and became the heroine of the live-action film adapted from Disney animation

64f7394b310d467a59d4aa81626cd9246f6d6378.sourceText: 花木兰女扮男装、替父从军的故事在中国家喻户晓，1998年迪士尼将这一题材改编成动画片后，使之被全世界观众所熟悉。当年，《花木兰》全球票房突破3亿美元，片中歌曲”自己”（Reflection）也成为人们翻唱必备经典，”花木兰”由中国”超级IP”晋升为”世界IP”，票房潜能巨大。由于动画版《花木兰》故事和形象在美国影响颇深，花木兰成为几代美国人喜爱的人物形象，所以此次观众和媒体对于真人版《花木兰》中这位巾帼英雄的扮演者也是十分关注。今日，《好莱坞报道》终于官方宣布，中国女演员刘亦菲确定为《花木兰》真人版电影女主角，正式出演”花木兰”一角。
64f7394b310d467a59d4aa81626cd9246f6d6378.translatedText: The story of Hua Mulan, a girl who disguised herself as a man and joined the army in place of her father, is a household name in China. After Disney adapted this theme into an animated film in 1998, it became familiar to audiences around the world. That year, the global box office of "Mulan" exceeded US$300 million. The song "Reflection" in the film has also become a must-have classic for people to cover. "Mulan" has been promoted from a Chinese "super IP" to a "world IP", with huge box office potential. Since the story and image of the animated version of "Mulan" have a profound impact in the United States, Mulan has become a favorite character of generations of Americans. Therefore, the audience and the media are also paying close attention to the actor who plays this heroine in the live-action version of "Mulan". Today, "The Hollywood Reporter" finally officially announced that Chinese actress Liu Yifei has been confirmed as the heroine of the live-action version of "Mulan" and will officially star in the role of "Mulan".

0f0e3a86d07899a10d6a0e39b151954c4c2c3efd.sourceText: 此次为寻找既会英文又与花木兰气质相符的合适人选，迪士尼特意举行全球海选，公开征选主演。最终，从接近1000名参与花木兰一角试镜的女演员中选定刘亦菲，刘亦菲亦因此成为首位担纲好莱坞主流电影绝对女主角的中国女明星。
0f0e3a86d07899a10d6a0e39b151954c4c2c3efd.translatedText: This time, in order to find a suitable candidate who can speak English and match the temperament of Mulan, Disney specially held a global audition to openly select the starring role. In the end, Liu Yifei was selected from nearly 1,000 actresses who auditioned for the role of Mulan. As a result, Liu Yifei became the first Chinese female star to play the absolute leading role in a mainstream Hollywood movie.

09003a13783ee4504ea8012f6a4708fd1bc10469.sourceText: 《鲸骑士》导演搭配世界级编剧 超强幕后班底护航引期待
09003a13783ee4504ea8012f6a4708fd1bc10469.translatedText: The director of "Whale Rider" is paired with a world-class screenwriter, and the strong behind-the-scenes team escorts arouses expectations

f36c5baaf4fee498dfc6bb679cc17aa399d5a061.sourceText: 真人版《花木兰》由新西兰女导演尼基.卡罗执导，初期剧本由劳伦.海尼克和伊丽莎白.马丁执笔，《猩球崛起》和《侏罗纪世界》的编剧里克.杰法和阿曼达.斯尔沃进一步改写剧本。这也是第一部真正意义上好莱坞主导的，以中国故事为基础，以女主故事为主线的动画改编真人电影，加之世界顶级创作团队的加持，电影更加令人期待。
f36c5baaf4fee498dfc6bb679cc17aa399d5a061.translatedText: The live-action version of "Mulan" is directed by New Zealand female director Nikki Caro. The initial script was written by Lauren Hynek and Elizabeth Martin. The screenwriters of "Rise of the Planet of the Apes" and "Jurassic World" Rick Jaffa and Amanda Silver further rewrote the script. This is also the first live-action adaptation of animation that is truly Hollywood-led, based on Chinese stories and centered on the heroine’s story. With the blessing of the world’s top creative team, the film is even more exciting.

95c5f60f15ce3cfbc33db123383ea28798d51339.sourceText: 导演尼基.卡罗十分擅长展现女性力量，此前执导的相关题材《鲸骑士》曾获独立精神奖最佳外国电影，13岁的女主演姬莎.卡索-休斯也因该片成为最年轻的奥斯卡最佳女主角获提名者。此次刘亦菲与其合作，两人将会擦出怎样的火花，也同样让人十分期待。
95c5f60f15ce3cfbc33db123383ea28798d51339.translatedText: Director Nikki Caro is very good at showing the power of women. The related theme "Whale Rider" he previously directed won the Independent Spirit Award for Best Foreign Film. The 13-year-old female lead Keisha Cassel-Hughes also became the youngest Oscar nominee for Best Actress for this film. This time Liu Yifei cooperates with her, and people are also looking forward to what kind of sparks the two will create.

3a2b0a66ecd571db6d81ae4e3980a55dc5d876b4.sourceText: 真人版极具挑战 刘亦菲摘下花木兰真本领说话
3a2b0a66ecd571db6d81ae4e3980a55dc5d876b4.translatedText: The live-action version is extremely challenging. Liu Yifei takes off Mulan's true skills and speaks

04117f9dd39dc23d68786b380549b477f1ebb39b.sourceText: 据悉，真人版《花木兰》的故事从民歌《木兰辞》和迪士尼1998年的动画版《花木兰》汲取灵感，讲述花木兰扮成男人，替父从军的故事。这个故事被中国观众、美国观众乃至世界观众熟知，所以主角不仅要展现出花木兰极具东方特色的外貌，还要通过表演展现出花木兰聪明勇敢的性格和擅长骑射，勇于拼杀的英雄气质。可以想像刘亦菲一定经过了严格的试戏和挑选，从接近1000人中被选中，难度可见一斑，没有点真正的表演本领和高能灵动的气质还真不行。
04117f9dd39dc23d68786b380549b477f1ebb39b.translatedText: It is reported that the story of the live-action version of "Mulan" draws inspiration from the folk song "Mulan" and Disney's 1998 animated version of "Mulan". It tells the story of Hua Mulan, who disguises herself as a man and joins the army in place of her father. This story is well-known to Chinese audiences, American audiences and even world audiences, so the protagonist must not only show Mulan’s oriental appearance, but also show Mulan’s smart and brave character and her heroic temperament of being good at riding and shooting, and having the courage to fight through performances. It can be imagined that Liu Yifei must have gone through strict auditions and selections. She was selected from close to 1,000 people. The difficulty is evident. Without some real acting skills and high-energy and agile temperament, it would be impossible.

33abcfa2ac9ddad31b3463ca9f43ccbf6f6b345b.sourceText: 迪士尼真人版《花木兰》将于明年开机，2019年全球上映。
33abcfa2ac9ddad31b3463ca9f43ccbf6f6b345b.translatedText: Disney's live-action version of "Mulan" will start production next year and be released globally in 2019.

c7b93b11b26dea0567ad3f481288f958cf786723.sourceText: 非法移民挺身 巴士之旅请命
c7b93b11b26dea0567ad3f481288f958cf786723.translatedText: Illegal immigrants stand up and ask for help on the bus trip

2950a74f6c4439e6a802f27d19ed94ccc253c1b4.sourceText: 非法移民挺身 巴士之旅请命 决心不再躲藏并「挺身一战」的30名男女非法移民，30日日出自凤凰城出发，展开路…
2950a74f6c4439e6a802f27d19ed94ccc253c1b4.translatedText: Illegal immigrants stand up and ask for help on the bus trip Thirty men and women illegal immigrants who are determined not to hide anymore and "stand up to fight" set out from Phoenix on the 30th and started their journey...

5eb91053fcc41bd904bcac6b20305f618a7cbf5a.sourceText: 决心不再躲藏并「挺身一战」的30名男女非法移民，30日日出自凤凰城出发，展开路线蜿蜒曲折的巴士之旅，希望在9月3日民主党全国代表大会揭幕之日，抵达位于北卡罗来纳州夏洛特市的全代会会场，敦促各界关心非法移民问题，为非法移民请命。
5eb91053fcc41bd904bcac6b20305f618a7cbf5a.translatedText: Thirty men and women illegal immigrants who are determined not to hide anymore and "stand up and fight", on the 30th Departing from Phoenix, the bus journey started with a winding route, hoping to arrive at the National Convention venue in Charlotte, North Carolina, on September 3, the opening day of the Democratic National Convention, urging all walks of life to pay attention to the issue of illegal immigration and plead for illegal immigrants.

1f854512949f4c116490d5041bedcc727f7a264e.sourceText: 这批非法移民固然怪罪国会及共和党拦阻移民改革法，但也认为欧巴马总统没有面对这个问题。他们勇敢打出「没文件，别怕」的口号，近日积极募款买食物、饮水、卫​​生纸等，张罗汽油钱和巴士租金。他们特意规画具有「挑衅」意味的路线，准备驶经「有敌意」的地盘，包括警方获准检查移民身分的乔治亚州和阿拉巴马州；有意却未通过反移民法的路易斯安纳州和密西西比州，还要经过地方警长夸称将协助联邦当局遣返移民的田纳西州。
1f854512949f4c116490d5041bedcc727f7a264e.translatedText: Although this group of illegal immigrants blame Congress and the Republican Party for blocking the immigration reform law, they also believe that President Obama has not faced this problem. They bravely used the slogan "Don't be afraid if you don't have documents" and recently actively raised funds to buy food, drinking water, toilet paper, etc., as well as to collect gas money and bus rental money. They deliberately planned a "provocative" route and prepared to drive through "hostile" territory, including Georgia and Alabama, where police are allowed to check immigration status; Louisiana and Mississippi, which intend to pass anti-immigration laws but have not passed them; and Tennessee, where the local police chief boasted that he would assist federal authorities in deporting immigrants.

359ddb956a2ba302c2b83608b95bc32e5d57d04a.sourceText: 他们不希望被捕，但有被捕的准备，已经筹措了保释基金。 他们希望扩大年轻移民扮演的维权角色，在年轻非法移民的抗议下，奥巴马政府上个月采取了暂免遣返年轻非法移民的政策。参加这次巴士之旅者，有许多是年轻移民的父母。
359ddb956a2ba302c2b83608b95bc32e5d57d04a.translatedText: They do not want to be arrested, but they are prepared to be arrested and have raised bail funds. They hope to expand the rights-defending role played by young immigrants. Following protests from young illegal immigrants, the Obama administration last month adopted a policy of temporarily exempting young illegal immigrants from deportation. Many of the people taking part in the bus tour were parents of young immigrants.

865fe972fa3953303fe5ff828cf240dbc0749dbf.sourceText: 46岁的玛莉亚拉米瑞兹告诉媒体：「我甘愿冒这个风险，因为我希望受到尊重，让别人承认我们是人，像人一样对待我们。」
865fe972fa3953303fe5ff828cf240dbc0749dbf.translatedText: Maria Ramirez, 46, told the media: "I am willing to take this risk because I want to be respected and have others recognize us as human beings and treat us like human beings."

87099ce8bbf14ed8b5bbf3cda265df7011805dde.sourceText: 年纪最轻的巴士乘客是22岁的大卫‧拉米瑞兹，他来自墨西哥，抵达美国时才九岁。他说，他拥有经济学士学位，对他来说，这趟巴士之旅是要展现移民血脉相连的精神，并可获得参与决策的机会。
87099ce8bbf14ed8b5bbf3cda265df7011805dde.translatedText: The youngest bus passenger is 22-year-old David Ramirez, who is from Mexico and was only nine years old when he arrived in the United States. He said that for him, who has a bachelor's degree in economics, the bus trip is about showing the spirit of immigrant blood and giving him a chance to participate in decision-making.

b96749adfdb5df49132024a605f3e104d1ab3081.translatedText: The Phoenix City delegation attended the "Chengdu International Sister Cities Week" (photo)

b8b3b1eb08d7efc8e2a84503aa9d19f0fa058f7f.sourceText: 凤凰城市代表团出席“成都国际友城周”(图) 亚省时报 5月25日凤凰城市代表团一行15人，参加了中国姐妹城…
b8b3b1eb08d7efc8e2a84503aa9d19f0fa058f7f.translatedText: The Phoenix City delegation attended the "Chengdu International Sister Cities Week" (photo) Alberta Times On May 25, a 15-member Phoenix City delegation participated in the China Sister Cities...

8eb539c7b27d72e7b58b17e138042f569905b7ce.sourceText: 5 月 25 日凤凰城市代表团一行 15 人，参加了中国姐妹城市成都举办的”成都国际友城周”活动。凤凰城市议员迈克琼森（ Michael Johnson ），凤凰城成都姐妹市主席刘汝璋，凤凰城成都姐妹市副主任洛奇哥拉德，以及凤凰城姐妹市委员会成员参加了 5 月 26 日晚在成都隆重举行” 成都国际友城周” 开幕式。四川省委常委、成都市委书记李春城，成都市人民对外友好协会常务副会长邱海明等领导与代表团共襄盛举，来自 26 个成都友城代表团的团长一起洽谈并合影留念.
8eb539c7b27d72e7b58b17e138042f569905b7ce.translatedText: On May 25, a Phoenix City delegation of 15 People participated in the "Chengdu International Sister City Week" event held by the Chinese sister city Chengdu. Phoenix City Councilor Michael Johnson, Phoenix Chengdu Sister City Chairman Liu Ruzhang, Phoenix Chengdu Sister City Deputy Director Rocky Golade, and members of the Phoenix Sister City Committee attended the opening ceremony of the "Chengdu International Sister City Week" held in Chengdu on the evening of May 26. Li Chuncheng, member of the Standing Committee of the Sichuan Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Chengdu Municipal Party Committee, Qiu Haiming, executive vice president of the Chengdu People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries and other leaders participated in the grand event with the delegation. Heads of delegations from 26 Chengdu sister cities negotiated and took photos together.

fd254d411b6ba0329d98e0535e35db8aea45a0a8.sourceText: 以” 分享美丽，传承友谊” 为主题的” 成都国际友好城市图片展” ，在成都市宽窄巷举办。 26 日下午代表团成员，前往参观。美国凤凰城市博物馆带到成都很多反应美西特色的精彩图片,沙漠，仙人掌吸引了当地很多市民。特别是印第安少数民族特色的展示，与成都当地的多民族特色非常的相似。
fd254d411b6ba0329d98e0535e35db8aea45a0a8.translatedText: The "Chengdu International Sister Cities Photo Exhibition" with the theme of "Sharing Beauty, Inheriting Friendship" was held in Kuanzhai Alley, Chengdu. On the afternoon of the 26th, members of the delegation went to visit. The Phoenix City Museum of the United States brought to Chengdu many wonderful pictures reflecting the characteristics of the West, such as deserts and cacti, which attracted many local citizens. In particular, the display of the characteristics of the Indian ethnic minorities is very similar to the local multi-ethnic characteristics of Chengdu.

9e5414150c3fb2a156ca83610c4c547fb25e5c3e.sourceText: 凤凰城市议员迈克琼森在友城企业合作论坛市长圆桌会议上做了精彩的演讲，他们对姐妹城市的经济合作充满了信心。
9e5414150c3fb2a156ca83610c4c547fb25e5c3e.translatedText: Phoenix City Councilor Mike Jonson gave a wonderful speech at the Mayors’ Roundtable of the Sister City Enterprise Cooperation Forum. They were full of confidence in the economic cooperation between sister cities.

58d4dbc939cad0c584288dc9c6532079c0a1d3e2.translatedText: The Phoenix City delegation also came to Chongzhou City Wenjingjiang Kindergarten to participate in the opening ceremony. This kindergarten was built after the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake with US$167,000 donated by Phoenix businesses and citizens. It is a testimony of the friendship between sister cities.
