cbca5d820982e2032ac160b874fc0b815e95a6b3.sourceText: 美丽伴健康同行 优雅与快乐永存——汤可茶话晚会纪实 （”太阳鸟”秋香报道） 新东方汤可老师的美丽健康茶话晚会 11月17日晚6点30分，高级肚皮舞教练汤可老师主持的美丽健康茶话晚会伴随着优美的乐曲声在新东方艺术学校拉开帷幕。侨联主席张华芳女士、凤凰城耆英会老年模特队的朋友们以及本地华人社区的四十多位女性朋友欢聚一堂，身着优雅的旗袍，怀着轻松愉悦的心情分享健康与美丽的话题。 现场欢声笑语，气氛热烈。当然，红花的美丽永远离不开绿叶的衬托与赞美，现场还出现了几位”神秘嘉宾”，几位男性朋友亦兴致勃勃地参加了晚会。 晚会以七位老太太的旗袍秀开场的，在《甜蜜蜜》的音乐声中六位老人家身着靓丽的旗袍，款款而行，尽显中国传统服饰与女性的成熟之美。 晚会的形式充满趣味。汤可老师给现场的来宾发了一张纸条，上面写着”金钱、地位、老公听话、孩子有出息、美丽、健康、朋友”几项，让大家选出最关心的两项。结果显示，大家最关心的是”健康”。汤可老师由此引出女性健康的话题，重点介绍了肚皮舞对女性身心健身的好处。作为一种优美的身体艺术，肚皮舞非常适合展现女性身体的阴柔之美，同时也十分有利于女性身体器官的锻炼，永葆青春与活力。 谢红宇女士表演肚皮舞 为了直观地呈现肚皮舞的魅力，学员谢红宇为大家即兴表演了一段。她随着动感的音乐节拍，动作娴熟，姿态美妙，尽显女性的优雅与柔美。可是，令人惊讶的是，她仅仅上了两个月课，前后只学了十个小时，完全没有舞蹈基础的她就可以进行表演了。她对肚皮舞的投入和陶醉，使得身心愉悦，妙不可言。 张华芳女士跟大家分享了关于什么是女性美的心得。她认为：简单平凡的人生最美丽。这个观点得到了在场各位的真心赞同。希望中文学校的董事长黄双双则与大家分享学肚皮舞的心得，还现场表演了一段穿旗袍的女人蹲下捡东西的场景，优雅的姿态极具韵味。来宾做游戏环节，更将晚会的气氛推向高潮。两人一组，猜四字成语，一个比划一个猜，现场笑声不断。或许，我们还可以说：快乐的女人最美丽。 三位”女王”与汤可老师合影 最后，现场评选三位”女王”。”最气质女王”由现场观众选出，老年模特队主持训练的温聚臻老师获此殊荣；七十多岁的于妈妈获得了”心灵美女王”，她热心社区工作，无偿为大家服务。张华芳女士把这个奖颁给了她。最后是”最人气女王”，新东方艺术学校校长吕丽华将该奖颁给了汤可老师，然而汤可却把王冠转给了谢红宇女士，自己执权柄，这一举动获得了大家的掌声。 新东方艺术学校校长吕丽华女士现场高歌《难忘今宵》 晚会在一曲《难忘今宵》中完美落幕。新东方艺术学校吕丽华校长伴随着音乐，即兴高歌，再次将晚会推向高潮。大家在依依不舍中告别。整场晚会持续两个半小时，柔美的舞姿、精致的服饰、欢快的笑声以及美丽的容颜，烘托出本次聚会高雅别致的艺术氛围和生活气息，淋漓尽致彰显着古典美与现代美、身形美与心灵美的完美融合。本次聚会完美地诠释了美丽与魅力的真谛，同时亦寄托着大家美好的心愿：美丽伴健康同行，优雅与快乐永存。 主持人汤可老师（左）与侨联主席张华芳（右）
cbca5d820982e2032ac160b874fc0b815e95a6b3.translatedText: Beauty goes with health, elegance and happiness last forever - Documentary of Tang Ke's Tea Party (reported by "Sunbird" Qiuxiang) New Oriental Teacher Tang Ke's Beautiful and Healthy Tea Party At 6:30 pm on November 17, a beautiful and healthy tea party hosted by senior belly dance instructor Tang Ke kicked off at the New Oriental Art School with beautiful music. Ms. Zhang Huafang, chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, friends from the Phoenix Senior Model Team and more than 40 female friends from the local Chinese community gathered together, dressed in elegant cheongsam, and shared the topic of health and beauty with a relaxed and happy mood. The atmosphere was filled with laughter and enthusiasm. Of course, the beauty of red flowers can never be separated from the contrast and praise of green leaves. Several "mysterious guests" also appeared on the scene, and several male friends also participated in the party with great interest. The party started with the cheongsam show of seven old ladies. To the music of "Sweet Honey", the six elderly people dressed in beautiful cheongsam, showing off the mature beauty of Chinese traditional clothing. The format of the party was full of fun. Teacher Tang Ke sent a note to the guests, which read "money, status, obedient husband, promising children, beauty, health, and friends" and asked everyone to choose the two items they cared about most. The results showed that "health" was what everyone cared about most. But the teacher brought up the topic of women's health and focused on the benefits of belly dance for women's physical and mental fitness. As a beautiful body art, belly dance is very suitable for showing the feminine beauty of the female body. It is also very conducive to the exercise of female body organs and maintaining youth and vitality forever. Ms. Xie Hongyu performed belly dance. In order to intuitively demonstrate the charm of belly dance, student Xie Hongyu performed an impromptu performance for everyone. She followed the dynamic music rhythm with skillful movements and beautiful postures, showing the elegance and grace of a woman. However, what is surprising is that she only took the class for two months and only learned for ten hours before and after, and she was able to perform without any dance foundation. Her devotion and intoxication in belly dance made her physically and mentally happy. Ms. Zhang Huafang shared her thoughts on what female beauty is. She believed that a simple and ordinary life was the most beautiful. This view was sincerely agreed by everyone present. Huang Shuangshuang, the chairman of Hope Chinese School, also shared his experience of learning belly dancing and performed a live performance. The scene of a woman in a cheongsam squatting down to pick up something was very charming. The guests played games, which pushed the atmosphere of the party to a climax. They guessed four-character idioms one by one. Perhaps, we can also say: Happy women are the most beautiful. The three "queens" took a group photo with Teacher Tang Ke Finally, three "Queens" were selected on the spot. The "Queen of the Most Temperament" was selected by the audience. Teacher Wen Juzhen, who hosted the training of the elderly model team, won this honor; Mama Yu, who is in her seventies, won the "Queen of Soul Beauty". She is enthusiastic about community work and serves everyone for free. Ms. Zhang Huafang awarded the award to her. Finally, it was the "Most Popular Queen". Lu Lihua, the principal of New Oriental Art School, awarded the award to Teacher Tang Ke. However, Tang Ke transferred the crown to Ms. Xie Hongyu and took the power herself. This move received applause from everyone. Ms. Lu Lihua, the principal of New Oriental Art School, sang "Unforgettable Tonight" live The party ended perfectly with the song "Unforgettable Tonight". The principal of New Oriental Art School, Lu Lihua, sang impromptu to the music and once again pushed the party to a climax. The whole party lasted for two and a half hours, with beautiful dances, exquisite costumes, cheerful laughter, and beautiful faces. It highlights the elegant and unique artistic atmosphere and life atmosphere of this party, and vividly demonstrates the perfect fusion of classical beauty and modern beauty, body beauty and spiritual beauty. This party perfectly interprets the true meaning of beauty and charm, and also entrusts everyone with their best wishes: beauty is accompanied by health, elegance and happiness last forever. Host teacher Tang Ke (left) and Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Zhang Huafang (right)

8392adc49b639f527b257751e29968f989e2edcf.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院三家孔子课堂开幕典礼 2011年5月6日, 亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院三家孔子课堂在小石溪高中礼堂共同举办了鹿谷学区孔子课堂开幕典礼. 亚利桑那州鹿谷学区的三家孔子课堂是加维兰峰学校(Gavilan Peak School)，钻石谷学校(Diamond Canyon School)及小石溪高中(Boulder Creek High School)。出席该开幕典礼的嘉宾包括亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院院长司马德琳教授，鹿谷学区主管John Kriekard博士，鹿谷学区理事会主席Ann Ordway 女士，小石溪高中校长Lauren Sheahan博士，钻石谷学校校长Mark Oesterle博士及Tara LeCount女士，还有加维兰峰学校校长Mai-Lon Wong博士。开幕典礼于晚上7点正式开始，由鹿谷学区中文项目主管Scott Laurence主持，约有400人参加了此次盛会。 三家孔子课堂的老师及学生为前来出席孔子课堂开幕典礼的嘉宾，同学及家长们准备了丰富精彩的表演。整场开幕典礼是由学生准备的精彩节目及嘉宾的讲话串联在一起的。小石溪高中孔子课堂中文俱乐部的学生为观众们带来了欢快喜庆的舞狮表演，预示着孔子课堂开幕典礼的隆重开始。首先上台致辞的是鹿谷学区主管John Kriekard博士，他对家长们的支持表示感谢。他还提出如何帮助孩子做好准备，面临21世纪的挑战是学区，学校，老师及家长们共同关心的主题。他们会为此做孜孜不倦的努力。接着，加维兰峰学校孔子课堂五六年级及七八年级的学生分别上台表演了他们在中文课上学过的情景对话及角色扮演，包括买卖东西，扮演老师及学生等。在这之后，上台讲话的是鹿谷学区理事会主席Ann Ordway 女士。她回顾了当初钻石谷学校校长Mark Oesterle博士在理事会提议在学区开设孔子课堂，开展中文项目的细节。她表示这是他们为鹿谷学区孩子们做的最好的决定之一。节目中最精彩的看点莫过于加维兰峰中文沉浸项目一年级班小朋友们的集体表演，他们穿着可爱的小唐装，在舞台上齐齐亮相。他们一出场，顿时引起了全场最热烈的掌声，观众们被孩子们天真可爱的模样及仪态深深吸引住。这些金发碧眼的一年级小朋友用标准的中文，字正腔圆地为观众们朗读了故事《蝴蝶飞了》，还演唱了一首童谣《找朋友》。这些孩子每天都有两个半小时浸泡在全中文的环境中学习数学课及科学课。这样，他们不仅掌握了这些学科的知识，还学会了中文。从孩子们的表演中可以看出，虽然中文沉浸项目才开始大半年，孩子们的中文水平已经达到了相当程度。在这些可爱的孩子们表演完后，上台致辞的是亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院院长司马德琳教授。司马德琳教授表示这是暨罗德中学孔子课堂开幕典礼后，她所参加的第二场孔子课堂开幕典礼。她对鹿谷学区三所学校所取得的中文教学成绩表示祝贺。并鼓励学校们不仅要做好中文教学，还要把中国文化带入小区，加强中美两国人民的友谊。她还鼓励孔子课堂加深与中国姊妹学校的交流，开展越来越多越来越好的中美学校交流与合作项目。在司马德​​琳教授致辞后，小石溪孔子课堂校长Lauren Sheahan博士，钻石谷学校校长Mark Oesterle博士及Tara LeCount女士，还有加维兰峰学校校长Mai-Lon Wong博士分别上台发言，为观众播放了他们学校中文项目的精彩看点，并与司马德琳教授正式签下了孔子课堂协议。最后，钻石谷学校孔子课堂的学生及加维兰峰学校孔子课堂的学生来表演抖空竹及舞稠带，欢快的音乐把开幕典礼推向最后的高潮。各位嘉宾上台合影留念，标志着亚利桑那州鹿谷学区加维兰峰学校，钻石谷学校及小石溪高中三家孔子课堂开幕典礼的完满结束！ 开幕典礼结束后，加维兰峰学校，钻石谷学校及小石溪高中三家孔子课堂为来宾们准备了丰富的中式自助餐。大家度过了一个欢乐而难忘的夜晚。
8392adc49b639f527b257751e29968f989e2edcf.translatedText: The opening ceremony of the three Confucius Classrooms of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University On May 6, 2011, the three Confucius Classrooms of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University jointly held the opening ceremony of the Confucius Classroom in the Deer Valley School District in the auditorium of Little Rock Creek High School. The three Confucius Classrooms in the Deer Valley School District in Arizona are Gavilan Peak School, Diamond Canyon School and Boulder Creek High School. Guests attending the opening ceremony included Professor Madelin Sham, Director of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, Dr. John Kriekard, Superintendent of the Deer Valley School District, Ms. Ann Ordway, Chairperson of the Deer Valley School District Board of Trustees, Dr. Lauren Sheahan, Principal of Little Rock Brook High School, Dr. Mark Oesterle and Ms. Tara LeCount, Principals of Diamond Valley School, and Dr. Mai-Lon Wong, Principal of Gavilan Peak School. The opening ceremony officially started at 7 p.m. and was hosted by Scott Laurence, director of the Chinese language program of the Deer Valley School District. About 400 people attended the event. Teachers and students from the three Confucius Classrooms prepared rich and exciting performances for the guests, students and parents who came to attend the opening ceremony of the Confucius Classrooms. The entire opening ceremony was linked together by exciting programs prepared by students and speeches by guests. Students from the Chinese Club of the Confucius Classroom at Little Rock Creek High School presented a cheerful and festive lion dance performance to the audience, heralding the grand start of the opening ceremony of the Confucius Classroom. The first person to deliver a speech was Deer Valley School District Superintendent Dr. John Kriekard, who expressed his gratitude to parents for their support. He also proposed how to prepare children to face the challenges of the 21st century, a topic of common concern to school districts, schools, teachers and parents. They will work tirelessly for this. Then, students in grades 5, 6 and 7 and 8 from the Confucius Classroom at Gavilan Peak School took the stage to perform dialogues and role plays they had learned in Chinese classes, including buying and selling things, playing teachers and students, etc. After that, Ms. Ann Ordway, chairperson of the Deer Valley School District Board of Trustees, took the stage to speak. She recalled the details of Diamond Valley School Principal Dr. Mark Oesterle’s proposal to the board of directors to open a Confucius Classroom in the school district to carry out Chinese language projects. She said it was one of the best decisions they've ever made for the children of the Deer Valley School District. The most exciting aspect of the show was the collective performance of the first-grade children of the Gavilan Peak Chinese Immersion Program. They all appeared on the stage dressed in cute little Tang suits. As soon as they appeared on the stage, they immediately aroused the warmest applause from the audience. The audience was deeply attracted by the children's innocent and cute appearance and manners. These blond and blue-eyed first-grade children read the story "The Butterfly Flies" to the audience in standard Chinese and eloquently, and also sang a nursery rhyme "Looking for Friends". These children spend two and a half hours every day learning math and science classes in an all-Chinese environment. In this way, they not only mastered the knowledge of these subjects, but also learned Chinese. It can be seen from the children's performances that although the Chinese immersion program has only started for half a year, the children's Chinese proficiency has already reached a considerable level. After the performances by these lovely children, Professor Smadelin, Director of the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, took the stage to deliver a speech. Professor Sima Delin said that this was the second Confucius Classroom opening ceremony she had attended after the opening ceremony of the Confucius Classroom at Rhodes Middle School. She congratulated the three schools in the Deer Valley School District for their achievements in Chinese teaching. He also encouraged schools to not only teach Chinese well, but also bring Chinese culture into the community to strengthen the friendship between the people of China and the United States. She also encouraged the Confucius Classroom to deepen exchanges with sister schools in China and carry out more and better exchange and cooperation projects between Chinese and American schools. After Professor Smadelin’s speech, Dr. Lauren Sheahan, principal of Little Rock Creek Confucius Classroom, Dr. Mark Oesterle and Ms. Tara LeCount, principals of Diamond Valley School, and Dr. Mai-Lon Wong, principal of Gavilan Peak School, took the stage to speak respectively, played the highlights of their schools’ Chinese projects for the audience, and officially signed the Confucius Classroom Agreement with Professor Smadelin. Finally, students from the Confucius Classroom at Diamond Valley School and students from the Confucius Classroom at Mount Gavilan School performed diabolo and band dance. The cheerful music pushed the opening ceremony to the final climax. All the guests took the stage for a group photo, marking the successful conclusion of the opening ceremony of the three Confucius Classrooms at Gavilan Peak School, Diamond Valley School and Little Stony Brook High School in Deer Valley School District, Arizona! After the opening ceremony, the three Confucius Classrooms at Gavilan Peak School, Diamond Valley School and Little Rock Creek High School prepared a rich Chinese buffet for the guests. Everyone had a fun and unforgettable evening.

1a7f5a75c8e2c22730d5b518ef5c10c1e645b169.translatedText: > Taiwan Heritage Week Folk Art Troupe performs (Photo) Alberta Times Organized by the Los Angeles Taiwanese Association, Centennial Celebration of the Republic of China Southwestern Region The Taiwan Heritage Week hosted by the preparatory committee came to a lively stage. On the evening of May 12, a folk art troupe composed of students from Zhongzheng Junior High School in Keelung, Taiwan performed "Howling Youth" at the Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center. The folk art troupe performed superbly and has completed performances in Seattle and Portland. Each performance has been well received. Los Angeles is the third stop. On the 11th, it visited Polytechnic School in Pasadena to perform and communicate with students studying Chinese at the school. Tonight, the auditorium of the Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center was packed with seats, and the students’ wonderful performance won rounds of warm applause.

5d4d32be19e36f2aa6305dd2c7eeb0de6ceb786e.translatedText: The first case of West Nile virus infection in Pinal County was confirmed this week. The first human case of West Nile virus infection in the state this year was confirmed in Pinal County. County health officials…

368f856374074fc7db360c590f5146c8e7265020.sourceText: 皮纳尔第一起感染西尼罗病毒确诊 皮纳尔郡本周确诊了今年本州第一起人类感染西尼罗病毒病例。 郡卫生官员说，一名30多岁居住在北福罗伦萨的女子检测呈阳性。 感染程度不深，只有轻微症状。 卫生局官员没有透露女子的姓名。 皮纳尔郡现已在全郡范围内，包括马里科巴、三潭峡谷、亚利桑那市、福罗伦萨和柯立芝等市镇，着手跟踪毒蚊感染个案。 到目前为止，本州今年已有七个人类感染西尼罗病毒个案，其中六个在马利科巴郡。 这种病毒来自蚊子叮咬，引起发烧、恶心、头痛和肌肉酸痛等并发症。 州卫生部数据显示，去年本州有67人感染西尼罗病毒，其中4例致命。
368f856374074fc7db360c590f5146c8e7265020.translatedText: > First case of West Nile virus confirmed in Pinal County Pinal County this week confirmed the first human case of West Nile virus infection in the state this year. County health officials said a woman in her 30s who lives in North Florence tested positive. The infection is not deep and there are only mild symptoms. Health department officials did not release the woman's name. Pinal County is now tracking cases of venomous mosquito infections throughout the county, including in the municipalities of Maricopa, San Tan Canyon, Arizona City, Florence and Coolidge. There have been seven human cases of West Nile virus in the state so far this year, six of them in Maricopa County. The virus comes from mosquito bites and causes complications such as fever, nausea, headaches and muscle aches. State Department of Health data shows 67 people were infected with West Nile virus in the state last year, four of which were fatal.

d744c701a4de583e9221ea5ca1031b620293523b.sourceText: 传承文明，开创未来——–新东方文化讲坛八月内容预告 传承文明，开创未来 新东方文化讲坛八月内容预告 ”’太阳鸟”亚利桑那华人网倾情策划 WWW.SUNBIRDARIZONA.COM 为宏扬中华文化，丰富亚省华人的文化生活，由新东方艺术学校和陈普（绿洲文教）共同主办，”太阳鸟”亚利桑那华人网策划的新东方文化讲坛将于八月隆重推出。第一期讲座将由著名的艺术家徐威东老师以美育教育为主题，分享他的经验。新东方文化讲坛属于公益性质，免费向公众开放，欢迎大家前来。 讲座时间 ：2012年8月18日星期六 晚上7点 主讲人：徐威东 著名艺术家、画家、雕塑家。 从事视觉艺术30余年， 天赋艺术才能和立体想像力， 接受过8年专业艺术教育，学习过美术、雕塑、设计等。并有10年以上的教学经历。早期从事经典的玉石雕刻，礼品设计制作，后又从事卡通产品的开发。近年来则致力于建筑雕塑，有着大量不同行业和领域的工作经验。更多详情请登陆徐威东网站 http://3dsculpturestudio.com/ 讲座内容 ： 如何从生从活中发现美 美学教育对儿童成长的重要性，如何培养孩子的审美情趣。 怎样培养儿童成为一个有主见、有鉴赏力、有修养、有品味的人。 多年美术教学经验分享 讲座地点 ：新东方艺术学校 1100 N Alma School Rd, Suite 18, Chandler AZ在Ray Road and Alma School Road交叉口的西北角，蓝天中餐馆的北面。 咨询电话：602-490-8613；480-319-1098 或者EMAIL至新东方艺术学校邮箱： azeaainfo@gmail.com 徐威东作品欣赏
d744c701a4de583e9221ea5ca1031b620293523b.translatedText: Inheriting civilization and creating the future——New Oriental Culture Forum August content preview Inheriting civilization and creating the future New Oriental Culture Forum August content preview Planned by "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese Network WWW.SUNBIRDARIZONA.COM In order to promote Chinese culture and enrich the cultural life of Chinese people in Alberta, the New Oriental Culture Forum, co-sponsored by New Oriental Art School and Chen Pu (Oasis Culture and Education), and planned by "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese Network, will be grandly launched in August. The first lecture will be held by the famous artist Xu Weidong, who will share his experience on the theme of aesthetic education. The New Oriental Cultural Forum is a public welfare forum and is open to the public free of charge. Everyone is welcome to come. Lecture time: Saturday, August 18, 2012, 7 p.m. Speaker: Xu Weidong, a famous artist, painter, and sculptor. He has been engaged in visual art for more than 30 years. He has natural artistic talent and three-dimensional imagination. He has received 8 years of professional art education and studied art, sculpture, design, etc. And have more than 10 years of teaching experience. In the early days, he was engaged in classic jade carving, gift design and production, and later in the development of cartoon products. In recent years, he has devoted himself to architectural sculpture and has a lot of work experience in different industries and fields. For more details, please visit Xu Weidong's website http://3dsculpturestudio.com/ Lecture content: How to discover beauty in life, the importance of aesthetic education to children's growth, and how to cultivate children's aesthetic taste. How to train children to become independent, appreciative, cultivated and tasteful people. Sharing many years of art teaching experience. Lecture location: New Oriental Art School 1100 N Alma School Rd, Suite 18, Chandler AZ, at the northwest corner of the intersection of Ray Road and Alma School Road, north of Blue Sky Chinese Restaurant. Consultation hotline: 602-490-8613; 480-319-1098 or email to New Oriental Art School email: azeaainfo@gmail.com Appreciation of Xu Weidong’s works

ed1b016c73898eb0dec2a598b94c0137c4a2219a.translatedText: The "most beautiful mother" was named a "hero" by netizens. The girl who fell from the building is still waiting for a miracle July...

77926a0847ffd24f3dd500d9d1ca78149df11eb0.sourceText: 7月3日18时，新浪微博上吴菊萍徒手抱接坠楼童的相关转发已近10000次。网友”pamphlet”感慨：”从物理学上讲几乎是不可能的，但爱的世界没有力学。那一瞬间，一个平凡的女人学会了乾坤大挪移，完成了一个奇迹。”（7月3日摄）。 新华社记者 黄宗治 摄
77926a0847ffd24f3dd500d9d1ca78149df11eb0.translatedText: At 18:00 on July 3, Wu Juping's post on Sina Weibo about picking up a child who fell from a building with her bare hands has been forwarded nearly 10,000 times. Netizen "pamphlet" lamented: "Physically speaking, it is almost impossible, but there is no mechanics in the world of love. At that moment, an ordinary woman learned how to move the universe and completed a miracle." (Photo taken on July 3). Xinhua News Agency reporter Huang Zongzhi Photo

d463e7b6c02e8916775cd7c3246b40d93b2e6694.sourceText: 当同事告诉她，很多关心这件事情的人都通过电话、邮件甚至阿里旺旺询问她的病情，并称她为”英雄妈妈”、”最美妈妈”时，腼腆的吴菊萍笑言有点夸张了，”我根本没想过这些，我只知道孩子对一个家庭的重要性，如果能够换来一个家庭的幸福，我这点付出都是值得的。”
d463e7b6c02e8916775cd7c3246b40d93b2e6694.translatedText: When her colleagues told her that many people who cared about this matter had inquired about her condition through phone calls, emails and even Ali Wangwang, and called her "hero mother" and "the most beautiful mother", the shy Wu Juping said with a smile that it was a bit exaggerated, "I never thought about this at all. , I only know the importance of children to a family. If I can exchange for the happiness of a family, all my efforts are worth it."

07202fbeb3cc362e2529a156cce6c9f1acc720c9.sourceText: 虽然吴菊萍觉得自己的付出微不足道，但是在网友们心目中，她已经成为共同的偶像。腾讯网今天专门开设了关注”英雄妈妈”的专题，许多知名的微博用户都在转发她的事迹，阿里巴巴董事会主席马云也在自己的微博中把她称作”英雄”，阿里巴巴今天还发表声明，奖励吴菊萍２０万元。
07202fbeb3cc362e2529a156cce6c9f1acc720c9.translatedText: Although Wu Juping feels that her contribution is insignificant, she has become a common idol in the minds of netizens. Tencent launched a special topic today to focus on "Hero Mom". Many well-known Weibo users are retweeting her deeds. Jack Ma, chairman of the board of directors of Alibaba, also called her a "hero" on his Weibo. Alibaba also issued a statement today to reward Wu Juping with 200,000 yuan.

7f7ebce8cb9ca22c71e014b0fb7857b54e4df5b1.sourceText: 截至目前，新浪、腾讯等微博上已有数十万网友关注并转发了”最美妈妈”的相关消息，并共同祈祷：这个遭遇不幸的小生命在幸运被救后，能够将好运进行到底，脱离生命危险，从此健康快乐地长大。
7f7ebce8cb9ca22c71e014b0fb7857b54e4df5b1.translatedText: So far, hundreds of thousands of netizens on Sina, Tencent and other Weibo have paid attention to and retweeted the news related to "The Most Beautiful Mother", and prayed together that this unfortunate little life, after being lucky enough to be rescued, can carry on the good luck to the end, escape the danger of life, and grow up healthily and happily.

2788b8aa91722bca7f016d0e7d6be86730ab6b75.sourceText: 一位网友留言说：爱的世界没有力学，所以最美妈妈能够不可思议地接住妞妞；希望爱的世界继续充满奇迹，妞妞会醒来，最美妈妈也会康复！
2788b8aa91722bca7f016d0e7d6be86730ab6b75.translatedText: A netizen left a message saying: There is no mechanics in the world of love, so the most beautiful mother can incredibly catch Niuniu; I hope that the world of love will continue to be full of miracles, Niuniu will wake up, and the most beautiful mother will recover!

9b21d3f1c4c020435a6ebbb021919c17cbae4174.sourceText: 三一集团起诉奥巴马和美国外资委：为尊严而战 新华网北京１０月１８日电（记者 陈玉明）三一集团１８日在京召…
9b21d3f1c4c020435a6ebbb021919c17cbae4174.translatedText: Sany Group sues Obama and the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States: Fighting for dignity Xinhuanet, Beijing, October 18 (Reporter Chen Yuming) Sany Group held a meeting in Beijing on the 18th...

2c02c0fcaa18d95dd30b1238ffbee731737cbed9.sourceText: 今年３月，三一集团在美关联公司罗尔斯公司收购了位于美国俄勒冈州的４个风电场项目。此后，由美国财政部长任主席的外国在美投资委员会（ＣＦＩＵＳ）以涉嫌威胁美国国家安全为由，要求罗尔斯公司立即停工，且在所有设备移除完毕前禁止转让。９月２８日，美国总统 奥巴马 签发总统令，要求中止该风场的风电项目。
2c02c0fcaa18d95dd30b1238ffbee731737cbed9.translatedText: In March this year, Ralls Corporation, a subsidiary of Sany Group in the United States, acquired four wind farm projects in Oregon, USA. Since then, the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States (CFIUS), chaired by the U.S. Secretary of the Treasury, demanded that Ralls immediately cease operations on the grounds that it allegedly threatened U.S. national security and prohibited the transfer of all equipment until all equipment was removed. On September 28, US President Obama issued a presidential order requiring the suspension of the wind power project at the wind farm.

25e6f5c7bd1d6c9884ff85463583fa8c7e2c87f8.sourceText: １０月１日，罗尔斯公司向美国哥伦比亚特区联邦地方分区法院递交诉状，将奥巴马总统和ＣＦＩＵＳ列为共同被告，将其告上法庭。三一集团认为，由于罗尔斯公司控制人为中国公民，奥巴马总统和ＣＦＩＵＳ对罗尔斯公司的风电场项目做出选择性执法，侵犯了罗尔斯公司享有的平等保护的宪法权利。
25e6f5c7bd1d6c9884ff85463583fa8c7e2c87f8.translatedText: On October 1, Rolls & Co. submitted a complaint to the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia, naming President Obama and CFIUS as co-defendants and taking them to court. Sany Group believes that because the controller of Rolls-Royce is a Chinese citizen, President Obama and CFIUS have carried out selective enforcement against Rolls-Rolls' wind farm project, which violated the constitutional rights of equal protection enjoyed by Rolls-Rolls.

a26e579adf0638e0d379e4f48c5757a70fee15ed.sourceText: 中国现代国际关系研究所副所长牛新春认为，美国禁止三一风电场项目不是孤立的个案，背后有经济、政治和选举等多重原因。
a26e579adf0638e0d379e4f48c5757a70fee15ed.translatedText: Niu Xinchun, deputy director of the China Institute of Contemporary International Relations, believes that the U.S. ban on the Sany Wind Farm project is not an isolated case, and there are multiple reasons behind it, including economic, political and electoral reasons.

d6a21a61cac990baf78bdc2f153313bbbea3b588.sourceText: ”从经济因素看，美国禁止的都是有科技含量、我们有竞争优势的行业。从政治因素看，美国一直对我们的政治制度不信任；无论是三一还是最近美国众议院报告主张封杀华为、中兴，美国提出的理由都是认为可能危害美国的国家安全。从选举因素看，禁止外国人投资不利于就业；但在涉及中国问题上，对美国政治家来说，往往是宁左勿右，宁可强硬一点。”牛新春说。
d6a21a61cac990baf78bdc2f153313bbbea3b588.translatedText: ” From the perspective of economic factors, the United States bans industries that have high technological content and where we have competitive advantages. From the perspective of political factors, the United States has always distrusted our political system; whether it is Sanyi or the recent US House of Representatives report, The reasons cited by the United States for banning Huawei and ZTE are that they may endanger the national security of the United States. From an electoral perspective, banning foreign investment is not conducive to employment; but when it comes to issues involving China, American politicians often prefer to be tougher than right," Niu Xinchun said.

bf4f8d765fda21def75d9d5647013c15e99de505.sourceText: ”三一过去没有、将来也不会做任何有损美国国家安全的事情。”三一集团副总经理、罗尔斯公司首席执行官吴佳梁说，”我们之所以在美国土地上 起诉 ＣＦＩＵＳ和奥巴马总统，表明我们对美国的法治抱有充分信心。如果能够赢得这场诉讼：它首先是美国法治的胜利，将证明美国是一个可以让投资者放心投资的国家。”
bf4f8d765fda21def75d9d5647013c15e99de505.translatedText: "Sany has not done and will not do anything that harms U.S. national security in the past." Wu Jialiang, deputy general manager of Sany Group and CEO of Rolls-Royce, said, "The reason why we are suing on U.S. soil is CFIUS and President Obama have shown that we have full confidence in the rule of law in the United States. If we can win this lawsuit: it is first of all a victory for the rule of law in the United States, which will prove that the United States is a country where investors can invest with confidence."

4811a2d3e30f5e40de087ab6e7db29e268f64b61.sourceText: 商务部国际贸易经济合作研究院研究员梅新育认为，美国政府的行为不仅违反了美国自己的法律，也违反了中美两国上世纪８０年代签署的双边投资保护协定，给中美两国双边直接投资的发展投下了非常浓重的阴影。
4811a2d3e30f5e40de087ab6e7db29e268f64b61.translatedText: Mei Xinyu, a researcher at the Institute of International Trade and Economic Cooperation of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, believes that the actions of the US government not only violate the laws of the United States, but also violate the bilateral investment protection agreement signed by China and the United States in the 1980s, casting a very heavy shadow on the development of bilateral direct investment between China and the United States.

8b9c71a5456f0361531358c174e0f596e1ca73af.sourceText: 不过，对于此案的结果，有关法律专家并不乐观。三一风电项目诉讼案律师夏廷康说，这是ＣＦＩＵＳ成立以来，外国公司第一次对该机构提起诉讼，是史无前例的，要打赢这个案子确实存在一定难度。
8b9c71a5456f0361531358c174e0f596e1ca73af.translatedText: However, relevant legal experts are not optimistic about the outcome of this case. Xia Tingkang, lawyer for the Sany Wind Power Project litigation case, said that this is the first time a foreign company has filed a lawsuit against CFIUS since its establishment. It is unprecedented, and it is indeed difficult to win this case.

838c70c0284ec04bcf2939fc2c8ac7de11dd6c9c.sourceText: ”虽然案件结果无法预料，但过程比结果更重要。我们要维护三一的尊严，维护中国企业的尊严；当我们受到不公正待遇时，绝不能一味忍气吞声。”向文波说，”我们坚决反对各种形式的贸易保护主义，但国家之间的市场开放应该遵循对等原则；当美国动辄以国家安全的名义封杀中国公司时，中国对自己的国家安全也不能掉以轻心。”
838c70c0284ec04bcf2939fc2c8ac7de11dd6c9c.translatedText: "Although the outcome of the case is unpredictable, the process is more important than the result. We must safeguard the dignity of Sany and the dignity of Chinese enterprises; when we are treated unfairly, we must not just swallow our anger." Xiang Wenbo said, "We firmly oppose all forms of trade protectionism, but market opening between countries should follow the principle of reciprocity; when the United States frequently blocks Chinese companies in the name of national security, China cannot take its own national security lightly."

707b54eb5ef9667f2923e018ccdc1eff8fb1dc25.sourceText: 有才气的诗人和春天有约，必定春光烁烁，情诗泛滥。若和秋天相遇，再快乐也会从秋山红叶里找出一番成熟的叹息。何况有才气又多愁善感的林黛玉遭遇秋天呢。这妹妹在春天里都会无端地绕回泪水小径，遇上秋天，听着雨打窗帘的淅沥，这关于悲的联想自然就不打一处来了。 其实，写这首东西之前，林妹妹的心情还是好好的呢。原先和宝钗感情有点纠葛，总觉得人家家世好，说话有心藏奸，不是真心的朋友。当然此中也有情敌思维，那林妹妹嘴上虽不说，但情窦初开，就将对眼给了宝玉，潜意识里便把能与宝玉匹配的姑娘,特别是宝钗都认为是潜伏的对手了。但正巧自己有病，宝钗主动来看望。相互谈开了。黛玉才发现自己错怪了人家，心情便多云转晴了。 前几天，黛玉的心情还要好呢。红楼大院里姑娘们赏花吃蟹，间带着吟诗作乐。她的《咏菊》《问菊》《菊梦》都被公认最佳。所以总觉得这妹妹应该开心几天才是。 但林妹妹就是林妹妹，转身回到自己的屋子，听着雨声便又惆怅起来。本来说好宝钗还要来谈话的，现在又不来了。林黛玉此时的多愁善感像水里的墨汁一样化染开来，自己又被纠结进去了。 林妹妹的愁都是很有特点的。只要某个愁点在心里确定，世间的一切事在她眼中都和这点一脉相承。你看她这首《秋窗风雨夕》写的：秋天花草都黄了，在晚上的灯映照下窗上那摇曳的影子都像黄脸婆，你那个冷风却来得这等迅疾，还狠命地打窗纱，把人心都搅凉了。你这个挨千刀的，还我窗棂上美丽的秋景梦幻梦！ 嫌不给力，妹妹还接着愁：那梦境是我的最爱，我拥抱着她不禁泪下如烛油。可叹那香烛越来越短，就似和亲人离别的瞬间那么珍贵—
707b54eb5ef9667f2923e018ccdc1eff8fb1dc25.translatedText: A talented poet has an appointment with spring, and the spring light will surely shine, and love poems will be overflowing. If you meet autumn, no matter how happy you are, you will find a mature sigh in the red leaves of the autumn mountains. What's more, the talented and sentimental Lin Daiyu encountered autumn. This sister would go back to the Trail of Tears for no reason in the spring. In autumn, listening to the patter of rain hitting the curtains, the association of sadness naturally disappeared. In fact, before writing this song, Sister Lin was still in a good mood. My relationship with Baochai was a bit entangled at first. I always felt that she came from a good family and spoke with hidden intentions, so she was not a true friend. Of course, there is also the idea of ​​a love rival. Although Sister Lin didn't say it, she set her sights on Baoyu when she first fell in love. Subconsciously, she regarded girls who could match Baoyu, especially Baochai, as potential rivals. But he happened to be sick, and Baochai took the initiative to visit him. Talked to each other. Daiyu realized that she had wrongly blamed others, and her mood turned from cloudy to sunny. A few days ago, Daiyu was in an even better mood. In the courtyard of the Red Mansion, the girls admired flowers and ate crabs, while reciting poems and having fun. Her "Ying of Chrysanthemums", "Asking for Chrysanthemums" and "Dream of Chrysanthemums" are all recognized as the best. So I always feel that this sister should be happy for a few days. But Sister Lin was Sister Lin. She turned back to her house and felt melancholy again when she heard the sound of rain. Baochai originally promised to come to talk, but now he doesn't come. Lin Daiyu's sentimentality at this time dissipated like ink in water, and she was entangled in it again. Sister Lin's worries are very unique. As long as a certain point of worry is determined in her heart, everything in the world will be consistent with this point in her eyes. Look at her song "Autumn Window Stormy Evening": In autumn, the flowers and grass are all yellow, and the swaying shadows on the windows under the light at night look like a yellow-faced woman. But your cold wind comes so fast, and you open the window screen so hard that it makes people's hearts cold. You, who suffered a thousand cuts, gave me back the beautiful autumn scenery on my window lattice! Thought it was not enough, my sister continued to worry: That dream is my favorite, I hugged her and couldn't help but shed tears like candle wax. It's a pity that the incense candle is getting shorter and shorter, just like the moment of parting with a loved one is so precious -

8c7774c85a3df7e58d4eeb4bdfc26be0ed08c8a6.sourceText: 到这里该结束了吧，但世人安知黛玉愁怀哪，妹妹再要进一步演绎：秋风秋雨无处不在，可只有我这样的贫寒家世的女孩，无依无靠才觉得风更急，雨更凉！连那风雨声都像离别亲人的关切和抽泣！哎呀呀，窗外小院一片汪洋，可那雨水还在滴个不息。风哪雨，别下了吧，你已经让我愁泪打湿了窗纱呀！ 若不是宝玉突兀地进房来，还不定这妹妹会愁到哪里去呢。 也别轻易笑话了这妹妹愁，黛玉的愁也是有根底的。到红楼大院后，黛玉最愁的就是无依无靠。用她在《咏菊》中写的就是你们为菊花写了这么多诗篇文章，但”片言谁解诉秋心”?这个秋心是什么呢？她借《问菊》敞开了自己的心境：我整天孤标傲世的模样，到秋寒之日才开花，实际上在等待我的精神伴侣！我在秋天的院子里独自一人饱尝霜露多寂寞哪，人家大雁南飞昆虫秋鸣都是为了相思伴侣和亲人呀！最后黛玉还鼓足了勇气，说”莫言举世无谈者，解语何妨话片时?”那意思就是对自己心仪的宝玉暗示，不要再说自己没有志同道合的，你懂我只要一句话就行了！ 黛玉为什么总是担心这些呢，因为她比别人更早经历了亲人的生离死别。到了红楼大院虽然有贾母的宠爱，但万一贾母撒手而去，她就成了大院里的孤儿了。然后这妹妹便顺着她一贯的悲哀思路，延伸蔓延开：如果那样我就会像败落的花瓣，没人给我香冢，随秋雨凉水飘流到无尽头的天涯— 小小的年纪整天在悲哀里纠结，怎么会同姐妹们一同嬉戏欢乐呢？ 读懂了几天前赛诗会上她的获奖作品《咏菊》《问菊》《菊梦》，就会知道她心中的郁结所在。她没有为此欣喜，因为大多数人只在欣赏她的遣词造句，少有人读懂她的心，所以，回到屋中听到秋雨打窗棂湿窗纱，黛玉就继续在《秋窗风雨夕》中演绎自己的愁情了。 意思的是，当她写完这首东西时，宝玉正好进来拜读了，这黛玉却一把拽过，放在灯上烧了诗稿。原来，这少女的情怀，即便是愁也罢，不是每个人都能读的。都让别人读懂了这忧愁背后的情思和向往，岂不羞死本姑娘！ 这宝玉依着记性好，说是记住了，但那时他全读懂了吗？ （参看三十八回四十五回）
8c7774c85a3df7e58d4eeb4bdfc26be0ed08c8a6.translatedText: It should be over here, but the world knows that Daiyu is worried, and my sister will further explain: Autumn wind and autumn rain are everywhere, but only a girl from a poor family like me, who has no one to rely on, feels the wind is stronger and the rain is colder! Even the sound of wind and rain is like the concern and sobs of parting relatives! Oops, there is a vast ocean outside the small courtyard outside the window, but the rain is still dripping. No matter how windy or rainy it is, please don’t let it rain. You have already made me wet the window screen with tears of sorrow! If Baoyu hadn't come into the room unexpectedly, I'm not sure where this sister would have been worried. Don't laugh at this sister's worries easily. Daiyu's worries are also well-founded. After arriving at the Red Mansion Courtyard, Daiyu's biggest worry was that she was helpless. What she wrote in "Ying Chrysanthemum" is that you have written so many poems and articles for chrysanthemums, but "who can explain the autumn heart in a few words"? What is this autumn heart? She opened up her state of mind through "Ask the Chrysanthemum": I look lonely and arrogant all day long, and it doesn't bloom until the cold autumn day. In fact, I am waiting for my spiritual partner! How lonely it is for me to be alone in the autumn yard, tasting the frost and dew. The geese flying south and the insects singing in autumn are all for missing my partners and relatives! Finally, Daiyu mustered up the courage and said, "Mo Yan has nothing to say in the world, so why not explain it for a while?" That means to hint to her favorite Baoyu, don't say that she has no like-minded people, you know, I only need one sentence! Why does Daiyu always worry about this? It's because she experienced the death of her relatives earlier than others. Although she was favored by Jia Mu when she arrived at the Red Mansion Courtyard, if Jia Mu let go, she would become an orphan in the compound. Then the sister followed her usual sad thoughts and spread: If that happens, I will be like the fallen petals, no one will give me the incense grave, drifting with the cool autumn rain to the end of the endless world - at such a young age, I am entangled in sorrow all day long, how can I play and have fun with my sisters? After reading her award-winning works "Ying Chrysanthemums", "Asking Chrysanthemums" and "Chrysanthemum Dreams" at the poetry competition held a few days ago, you will know where the frustration lies in her heart. She was not happy about this, because most people only appreciated her words and sentences, and few people understood her heart. Therefore, when she returned to the house and heard the autumn rain hitting the window lattice and wetting the window screen, Daiyu continued to perform her own melancholy in "Autumn Window Stormy Evening". The meaning is that when she finished writing this poem, Baoyu happened to come in to read it, but Daiyu grabbed her and put it on the lamp to burn the poem manuscript. It turns out that not everyone can read this girl's feelings, even if she is sad. It would be embarrassing for me to let others understand the emotions and yearning behind this sadness! Baoyu said he remembered it because of his good memory, but did he understand everything at that time? (See Chapter 38, Chapter 45)

5bd55d5d22406b4a65a96301719732e09cb0cf9f.sourceText: 房价大跌吸引买家 重灾区凤凰城反弹亮眼 （亚省时报） 现在全美房地产经济学家正在研究凤凰城令人惊讶的房市反弹现象，大幅下滑的住房价格已经带进了新买家，不像其他地区大量的待售屋和止赎房正扼杀房市复苏。 正当全美大多数城市住房价格还继续往下跌的时候，一个城市房市开始出现反弹足以让其他地区取经借鉴。 亚利桑那州凤凰城曾是房市萧条的重灾区，从2006年到2011年底房价下跌55％，而且于2009年该州止赎率跃升全美第三。成千上万房主资不抵债，这意味着他们欠下的房贷债务比名下的房产价值还高。 住房经济学家劳勒(Thomas Lawler)表示：?#20964;凰房市已经触底。?#20182;也是6年前第一个警告都市过度建盖将导致价格下降的人。 凤凰城房市成功回弹的配方 全美遭受重创的住房市场面都临着一个困境：没有传统的购房者协助恢复房市，其中许多人没法或不愿意出售现有的住宅房，因为房价跌的太多了，以致没法另购房产。 据《华尔街日报》报导，凤凰城已经找到了一个可行的配方。低房价吸引了首次购屋者和投资租赁的投资者。当地大企业如亚马逊和英特尔等再度招聘职工，进一步刺激对住房的需求。另外，受益于一批来自加拿大的买家，利用有利的汇率在这沙漠城市里掏宝讲价。 据统计，上个月买家中四分之一来自外地，有29%的买家是打算出租的，每25笔交易就有一笔买家属加拿大籍。有地产商甚至到加拿大参加商展吸引买家，据称展位两天就吸引了5000人驻足查询。 当地一般投资人也扮演积极的关键角色。Gerundoy上个月以$50,200美元订下一间两卧康斗公寓，价格只略高于银行挂牌的止赎价。 49岁的Gerundoy过去两年已在凤凰城买了13座住宅房，以每月$950的低价出租。他驾着一辆捷豹(Jaguar)车说，目前做为房东收入很好，因此去年辞掉在新泽西的银行工作。 房价大幅滑落 吸引首次购屋与投资者 根据标普-凯斯-席勒指数跟踪20个城市房价，美国住房价格去年第四季度经季节性调整后下跌2％，而凤凰城价格上涨2％，是全美涨幅最大的城市。就过去一整年度而言，凤凰城房价下跌1.2％，是2006年以来跌幅最小的。 房价大幅滑落是房市回暖的另一个关键，就像凤凰城一样。底特律过去6年来房价下跌46％，目前已经降到1994年的水平。迈阿密的房产销售量也开始爬升，过去五年其房价跌幅超过51％。 当地就业机会亦是关键 随着春季销售季节的到来，其他城市也出现了回暖的迹象。最近底特律的汽车业就业率增长推动了房产销售。华盛顿DC特区受益于政府机关提供更好的就业前景，住房价格的表现优于全美许多地区。 但是，没有足够的就业机会，单靠低廉的房价还是不足以阻止房产泡沫破灭。例如拉斯维加斯，房价自2006年来已下跌62％，过去一年就跌了8.9％。当地的经济严重依赖旅游业和赌博业，都属还没有复苏的产业。 美房市仍存在的隐忧 全美住房需求仍显薄弱，预计今年银拍房的销售会增加，这将对房价造成进一步的压力。许多经济学家估计，明年触底前，全美房价今年可能再降3％左右。大多数经济学家则相信房价将会微涨几年。 凤凰城改善了的住房市场，并没有让前几年前买了房产的居民太好过。根据CoreLogic房产调研数据，超过52％抵押贷款买房的屋主欠下的贷款钱比他们目前的房产价值还多。也不是每个凤凰城居民都相信目前的好景况可以持续，特别是当经济继续疲软或油价还要飙升的时候。 三年前联邦推出购屋税赋抵免优惠，在凤凰城引起购屋狂潮时房价也跟着涨，但优惠截止后，房价又再度下跌。也有人担心，在未来一年会见到银行释出更多的止赎法拍房，再度使市场饱和。 加州欧文市的住宅建设顾问伯恩斯就表示，全美很多市场已经触底，但没见到有像凤凰城一样的复苏景象。
5bd55d5d22406b4a65a96301719732e09cb0cf9f.translatedText: The sharp drop in housing prices attracted buyers, and Phoenix, the hardest-hit area, rebounded brilliantly (Alberta Times) Real estate economists across the country are now studying the surprising housing market rebound in Phoenix. The sharp decline in housing prices has brought in new buyers, unlike other areas where a large number of unsold houses and foreclosures are stifling the housing market recovery. While housing prices continue to fall in most cities across the United States, the rebound in one city's housing market is enough for other regions to learn from the experience. Phoenix, Arizona, was once the hardest-hit area of ​​the housing market recession, with home prices falling 55% from 2006 to the end of 2011. In 2009, the state's foreclosure rate jumped to third in the United States. Thousands of homeowners are insolvent, meaning they owe more on their mortgage than the property they own is worth. Housing economist Thomas Lawler said: The housing market has hit bottom. ?#20182; He was also the first person to warn that over-building in cities would lead to falling prices six years ago. Phoenix's recipe for a successful housing rebound The nation's battered housing markets are facing a dilemma: There are no traditional homebuyers to help revive the housing market, many of whom are unable or unwilling to sell their existing homes because prices have fallen too far to buy another. According to the Wall Street Journal, Phoenix has found a formula that works. Low house prices attract first-time home buyers and investors investing in rental properties. Large local companies such as Amazon and Intel are hiring workers again, further stimulating demand for housing. In addition, thanks to a group of buyers from Canada, they take advantage of the favorable exchange rate to bargain for money in this desert city. According to statistics, a quarter of the buyers last month were from outside the country, 29% of the buyers planned to rent, and one buyer in every 25 transactions was a Canadian. Some real estate developers even went to Canada to participate in trade shows to attract buyers. It is said that the booth attracted 5,000 people to stop and inquire in two days. Local general investors also play an active and key role. Gerundoy paid $50,200 for a two-bedroom condo last month, just above the bank's listed foreclosure price. Gerundoy, 49, has bought 13 residential properties in Phoenix over the past two years and rents them out for as low as $950 a month. Driving a Jaguar, he said that his current income as a landlord was very good, so he quit his bank job in New Jersey last year. House prices fell sharply, attracting first-time home buyers and investors. According to the S&P-Case-Shiller Index tracking house prices in 20 cities, U.S. housing prices fell by 2% seasonally adjusted in the fourth quarter of last year, while prices in Phoenix rose by 2%, the largest increase in the United States. For the past full year, Phoenix home prices fell 1.2%, the smallest decline since 2006. A sharp decline in home prices is another key to the housing market's recovery, as it has been in Phoenix. Detroit home prices have fallen 46% over the past six years and are now down to 1994 levels. Sales are also starting to climb in Miami, where home prices have fallen more than 51% over the past five years. Local jobs also key With the spring selling season underway, other cities are showing signs of recovery. Detroit's recent auto industry job growth has boosted home sales. Washington, D.C., has benefited from better job prospects provided by government agencies and housing prices have outperformed many areas across the country. However, without enough employment opportunities, low housing prices alone are not enough to prevent the housing bubble from bursting. For example, in Las Vegas, home prices have fallen 62% since 2006 and 8.9% in the past year. The local economy relies heavily on tourism and gambling, both of which have not yet recovered. Hidden concerns still exist in the U.S. housing market. Housing demand across the U.S. is still weak. It is expected that sales of silver auction houses will increase this year, which will put further pressure on housing prices. Many economists estimate that U.S. home prices may fall another 3% this year before hitting bottom next year. Most economists believe home prices will rise slightly for several years. Phoenix's improving housing market hasn't made life easy for residents who bought property a few years ago. According to CoreLogic Real Estate Research, more than 52% of homeowners with a mortgage owe more on their loan than their property is currently worth. Not every Phoenix resident believes the good times can last, especially if the economy continues to weaken or oil prices soar. Three years ago, the federal home purchase tax credit was introduced, which caused a housing buying frenzy in Phoenix. Housing prices also rose, but after the discount expired, housing prices fell again. There are also concerns that banks will release more foreclosures in the coming year, saturating the market again. Burns, a residential construction consultant in Irvine, California, said that many markets across the United States have hit the bottom, but they have not seen a recovery like Phoenix.

04e9c41f070910b51ee7fb3ce83fdf71b23b8018.sourceText: 国民党亚利桑那直属分部党庆及圣诞联欢会纪实 （”太阳鸟”秋香报道）今年11月24日…
04e9c41f070910b51ee7fb3ce83fdf71b23b8018.translatedText: Records of the Party Celebration and Christmas Party of the Arizona Branch of the Kuomintang (Reported by "Sunbird" Qiuxiang) November 24 this year...

0bb60fecf16938ce75b704a02b66066ff3bae5b9.sourceText: 国民党亚利桑那直属分部党庆及圣诞联欢会纪实 （”太阳鸟”秋香报道）今年11月24日是中国国民党建党118周年纪念日。2012年12月9日，国民党亚利桑那直属分部在凤凰城康乐大厦举行党庆纪念活动及圣诞联欢会。国民党候补中央委员姚其昌教授专程从洛杉矶赶来参加了活动。 联欢活动历时三个多小时，节奏紧凑，气氛热烈。亚省的党员同志们和一百多位嘉宾共同回顾与畅谈国民党百年来的历史，国民党坚持国父孙中山先生的三民主义理想及带领中华民国走向民主自由发展的道路上所做的努力和贡献。同时，活动中也大力宣传了国民党主席马英九的各项经济政策和外交政策。这次联欢活动，为增强国民党的向心力及对本省及海外海外党员的凝聚力起了很好的作用。 国民党修补中央委员姚其昌教授讲话。他说：”国民党主席马英改革的决心不变，振兴中华民国和中华民族的决心不变！” 国民党员邓锡邦和陈超仁向王玮王亭组委颁发国父孙中山先生当年手书的摂天下为公”的影印本。 国民党亚省直属分部的义工们为大家准备了可口的午餐。餐前已经有多位朋友分享了不久前的回国见闻，提起了大家畅谈的兴致。 在吃午餐的时候，又有人乘兴高歌，有人随乐而舞。必不可少的抽奖环节，将联欢活动推向了高潮。 《一周报》创刊十周年，社长莫邪从王玮王亭手中接过国民党主席马英九寄来的贺辞。同时《一周报》为所有来宾赠送了明年的挂历。
0bb60fecf16938ce75b704a02b66066ff3bae5b9.translatedText: Party Celebration and Christmas Party of the Arizona Branch of the Kuomintang (Reported by "Sunbird" Qiuxiang) November 24 this year is the 118th anniversary of the founding of the Chinese Kuomintang. On December 9, 2012, the Arizona branch of the KMT held a party anniversary commemoration event and a Christmas party at the Kangle Building in Phoenix. Professor Yao Qichang, alternate member of the Central Committee of the Kuomintang, made a special trip from Los Angeles to attend the event. The party lasted for more than three hours, with a tight rhythm and a warm atmosphere. Party members and comrades in Alberta and more than 100 guests reviewed and talked about the history of the Kuomintang over the past century. The Kuomintang adheres to the ideals of the Three People's Principles of the founding father, Dr. Sun Yat-sen, and its efforts and contributions in leading the Republic of China to the path of democratic and free development. At the same time, the event also vigorously promoted various economic and foreign policies of Kuomintang Chairman Ma Ying-jeou. This party played a very good role in enhancing the centripetal force of the Kuomintang and the cohesion of party members in this province and overseas. Professor Yao Qichang, member of the Kuomintang Repair Central Committee, delivered a speech. He said: "Kuomintang Chairman Ma Ying's determination to reform and revitalize the Republic of China and the Chinese nation remains unchanged!" Kuomintang members Deng Xibang and Chen Chaoren presented a photocopy of the "World for the Public" handwritten by the founding father Sun Yat-sen to the Wang Wei Wangting organizing committee. The volunteers of the KMT's provincial branch prepared a delicious lunch for everyone. Before the meal, many friends shared their experiences of returning home recently, which made everyone happy to talk. During the lunch, some people sang and some danced with the music, which brought the party to a climax. On the 10th anniversary of the publication of "Weekly Newspaper", President Mo Xie received a congratulatory message from Kuomintang Chairman Ma Ying-jeou from Wang Wei and Wang Ting. At the same time, "Weekly Newspaper" presented next year's wall calendar to all guests.

1e8945ecb9d7c7d663db5e0045c6ec936cf5a7be.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学中国学生找人替考被捕 将面临“阴谋重罪”的指控
1e8945ecb9d7c7d663db5e0045c6ec936cf5a7be.translatedText: A Chinese student at Arizona State University was arrested for finding someone to take the exam for him and will face charges of "felonious conspiracy"

4f9e5ad8dbecb13d2011bd68109cbe10df6a9757.sourceText: 亚利桑那州立大学中国学生找人替考被捕 将面临“阴谋重罪”的指控 近日，一位来自中国的亚利桑那州立大学学生被指控…
4f9e5ad8dbecb13d2011bd68109cbe10df6a9757.translatedText: A Chinese student at Arizona State University was arrested for finding someone to take the exam for him and will face charges of "felony conspiracy" Recently, an Arizona State University student from China was charged...

5621c5d6311197597bb88a4cd1890f8a0b0ce341.sourceText: 据报道，这名21岁的女大学生名叫程晓萌（Xiaomeng Cheng, 音译），她本月被美国国土安全局逮捕。被捕的还有来自马萨诸塞州和宾夕法尼亚州的三名中国学生。
5621c5d6311197597bb88a4cd1890f8a0b0ce341.translatedText: According to reports, the 21-year-old female college student named Xiaomeng Cheng (transliteration) was arrested by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security this month. Also arrested were three Chinese students from Massachusetts and Pennsylvania.

f31869b0f43dbf6a39b525cc5bd041975aac1a63.sourceText: 本月早些时候，美国国土安全局指控程晓萌在英文考试失败三次后，作弊通过了托福考试。程是亚利桑那大学W.P. 凯瑞商学院会计系学生。她被指控支付了一位名叫王月（Yue Wang, 音译）的中国学生1000美元酬金雇其替考。据悉，王在位于马萨诸塞州剑桥市的霍特国际商学院学习。
f31869b0f43dbf6a39b525cc5bd041975aac1a63.translatedText: Earlier this month, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security accused Cheng Xiaomeng of cheating to pass the TOEFL exam after failing the English test three times. Cheng is an accounting student at the W.P. Carey School of Business at the University of Arizona. She was accused of paying a Chinese student named Yue Wang $1,000 to take the exam for her. It is reported that Wang studied at Hult International Business School in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

7e288f86296f3896f135538b0a6d34c0e092c264.sourceText: 诉讼还说，这一替考行径是在另一名学生身上发现的。考试人员发现一位名为YY的人员为其他学生替考。YY告诉调查人员，是王月找的他，支付了他900美元当”枪手”。据悉，王月因为曾经涉及欺诈性考试被捕而找到YY替考。
7e288f86296f3896f135538b0a6d34c0e092c264.translatedText: The lawsuit also says the practice was discovered on another student. The examiners discovered that a person named YY was taking the exam for other students. YY told investigators that Wang Yue found him and paid him $900 to be the "shooter." It is reported that Wang Yue found YY to take the exam for her because she was once arrested for being involved in fraudulent exams.

2b6b255c745ce0fe82bb67040bc43e95bc464a42.sourceText: 王告诉调查人员，另外至少有两个人雇佣她通过考试。这二人分别是东北大学的24岁学生张世坤（Shikun Zhang) 和宾夕法尼亚州立大学21岁的学生黄乐怡（Leyi Huang)。记录显示，张和黄各支付了王3000美元，二人申请的学校分别要求托福最低分为92分和80分。
2b6b255c745ce0fe82bb67040bc43e95bc464a42.translatedText: Wang told investigators that at least two other people hired her to pass the exam. The two are Shikun Zhang, a 24-year-old student at Northeastern University, and Leyi Huang, a 21-year-old student at Pennsylvania State University. Records show that Zhang and Huang each paid Wang US$3,000. The schools they applied to required minimum TOEFL scores of 92 and 80 respectively.

741eb3a607d1c82eec74a78c647543563e91e89b.sourceText: 美国对替考处罚严重 天价罚款加判刑
741eb3a607d1c82eec74a78c647543563e91e89b.translatedText: The United States imposes severe penalties on taking exams for others. Sky-high fines and prison sentences

7f838695cc11d45817c1536f09e0702fc88124af.sourceText: 事实上，这已经不是第一起中国学生因考试作弊被美国官方调查的事例了。
7f838695cc11d45817c1536f09e0702fc88124af.translatedText: In fact, this is not the first case in which a Chinese student has been investigated by U.S. officials for cheating on exams.

33945c44918e0899de468379ab7fcc2d000e0ab8.sourceText: 就在本月初，4名中国公民因涉嫌在托福考试中雇佣”枪手”作弊被美国联邦警方逮捕。这四人面临”密谋欺骗美国”的罪名指控。一旦罪名成立，4人将被判最高多达5年的有期徒刑、3年监视居住以及25万美元的罚款，刑期结束后还将被遣返回国。
33945c44918e0899de468379ab7fcc2d000e0ab8.translatedText: Just at the beginning of this month, four Chinese citizens were arrested by the US federal police on suspicion of hiring "gunmen" to cheat on the TOEFL exam. The four men face charges of "conspiring to defraud the United States." Once convicted, the four people will be sentenced to up to five years in prison, three years of residential surveillance and a fine of US$250,000. They will also be deported to the country after their sentences.

cdb81357fcc34e95cf445a3e5a3cce4588f2f799.sourceText: 2016年4月，一位名叫邹悦（Yue Zou，译音）的中国籍留美女生为了就读弗吉尼亚理工大学，让另外两名中国女子假扮自己参加大学录取考试。邹悦后被地方法院判处在家监禁6个月并被遣返回国。
cdb81357fcc34e95cf445a3e5a3cce4588f2f799.translatedText: In April 2016, a Chinese student studying in America named Yue Zou (transliteration) asked two other Chinese women to pretend to be herself to take the college admission exam in order to attend Virginia Tech University. Zou Yue was later sentenced to six months of home confinement by the local court and deported to the country.

c5e9810dfdad82dae7cd7807fe6fadb0063e62f6.sourceText: 两年频频出现中国留学生找人代考托福等英语水平考试事件
c5e9810dfdad82dae7cd7807fe6fadb0063e62f6.translatedText: In the past two years, there have been frequent incidents of Chinese students looking for someone to take the TOEFL and other English proficiency exams on their behalf

586dc1e68e7d7ec948c33e979fb7e66eaeb799c4.sourceText: 2015年也发生过一起中国公民在美国合谋”替考”的恶性事件。被起诉的15名中国公民涉嫌利用假护照等方式进入考场，帮助他人获得托福、SAT以及GRE等考试的成绩，有人利用虚假成绩申请美国的大学。根据当时的起诉书，在2011年至2015年期间，15名被告合谋以”替考”的方式欺骗美国教育考试服务中心(ETS)和美国大学理事会，以获取美国大学或研究生院的入学资格。该案涉及的大部分替考事件发生在宾夕法尼亚州西区。
586dc1e68e7d7ec948c33e979fb7e66eaeb799c4.translatedText: In 2015, there was also a vicious incident in which Chinese citizens conspired to take the exam for themselves in the United States. The 15 Chinese citizens who were indicted were suspected of using fake passports and other methods to enter the examination room and help others obtain scores for TOEFL, SAT, GRE and other examinations. Some people used false scores to apply for American universities. According to the indictment at the time, between 2011 and 2015, 15 defendants conspired to deceive the Educational Testing Service (ETS) and the College Board by taking "substitute exams" to obtain admission to U.S. universities or graduate schools. Most of the test-taking incidents involved in this case occurred in the Western District of Pennsylvania.

7f1195070fd3c9f65eefb6431311f9d9fc5d0b17.sourceText: 当时，宾夕法尼亚州联邦检察官对15名被告共发起了35项罪名的指控，其中包括合谋、伪造外国护照、邮政欺诈及电信欺诈等，包括4项联邦重罪。 合谋罪最高可判 5年监禁，并处25万美元罚金；邮政欺诈罪及电信欺诈罪最高可判20年监禁，并处25万美元罚金；伪造外国护照罪最高可判15年监禁，并处25万美元罚金。
7f1195070fd3c9f65eefb6431311f9d9fc5d0b17.translatedText: At that time, the federal prosecutor in Pennsylvania launched a total of 35 charges against 15 defendants, including conspiracy, forgery of foreign passports, postal fraud and wire fraud, including 4 federal felonies. The conspiracy charge carries a maximum sentence of 5 years in prison and a $250,000 fine; the postal fraud and wire fraud charges carry a maximum sentence of 20 years in prison and a $250,000 fine; the forgery of foreign passports carries a maximum sentence of 15 years in prison and a $250,000 fine.

37b1cfec863a71639dc4b843f720dd41933abb18.sourceText: 由此可见，美国对有偿替考的处罚很严重，后果不外乎三种：坐牢、罚款和遣返。
37b1cfec863a71639dc4b843f720dd41933abb18.translatedText: It can be seen that the penalties for paid substitute exams in the United States are very serious, and there are no more than three consequences: jail, fines and deportation.

809e0ddd2229953c5c1bf29016a6da06ca97780d.sourceText: 西方国家对学术造假”零容忍”
809e0ddd2229953c5c1bf29016a6da06ca97780d.translatedText: Western countries have “zero tolerance” for academic fraud

3f33dea6017122043d1f67b0b57bc252717820ef.sourceText: 近些年，随着中国人留学热潮的升温，在申请国外院校的入学测试环节出现了”灰色地带”，一些渴望出国的中国学子因为语言水平和学历背景的欠缺，只有通过造假的方式才能获得国外院校的”入场券”，于是一些中介利用学生的这种心理，充当了欺诈造假的帮凶，并且形成了一条完整的产业链。有的中介可以利用先进的计算机技术，伪造几可乱真的护照，让”枪手”参加TOEFL、GRE、SAT等美国大学和研究生入学测试。
3f33dea6017122043d1f67b0b57bc252717820ef.translatedText: In recent years, as the craze for Chinese people to study abroad has heated up, a "gray area" has emerged in the entrance test process for applying to foreign colleges and universities. Some Chinese students who are eager to go abroad can only obtain "admission tickets" to foreign colleges and universities through fraud due to their lack of language proficiency and academic background. Therefore, some intermediaries take advantage of this mentality of students, act as an accomplice of fraud, and form a complete industrial chain. Some agents can use advanced computer technology to forge almost real passports and let the "shooters" take TOEFL, GRE, SAT and other American university and graduate entrance tests.

aebd0b51039c5ea3833f0ac381cb347fc5c137d9.sourceText: 也许有人会说，美国对替考行为的处罚过于严重，大不了取消考试资格、遣返回国就是了，为什么要上升到刑事责任，甚至还要蹲监狱？这和国内对此类事件的处理方式似乎有天壤之别。事实上，在整个北美范畴，对考试欺诈行为的处罚向来十分严厉，但同为作弊，性质却有轻重之别，”打小抄”之类的个体作弊一般仅被当作个人行为不检点，通常只会受到校内处分，但 倘若有偿替考、贿赂考官，则必定被追究刑责 。
aebd0b51039c5ea3833f0ac381cb347fc5c137d9.translatedText: Some people may say that the penalties for taking exams for others in the United States are too severe. The most serious consequences are cancellation of exam qualifications and deportation to the country. Why should it be elevated to criminal liability or even jail time? This seems to be very different from the way such incidents are handled in China. In fact, throughout North America, the penalties for exam fraud have always been very severe, but they are both cheating, but their nature is different. Individual cheating such as "cheating" is generally regarded as personal misconduct and is usually only punished by the school. However, if you take the exam for a fee or bribe the examiner, you will definitely be held criminally responsible.

75242b0a8e90c475f5fccdf0d6d36d5ab6a56025.sourceText: 西方国家十分看重学术诚信，零容忍考试作弊行为
75242b0a8e90c475f5fccdf0d6d36d5ab6a56025.translatedText: Western countries attach great importance to academic integrity and have zero tolerance for cheating in exams

3c9c58bd6b76fc158e7c270576746f8d50ed772d.sourceText: 之所以会这样，一是因为西方社会十分注重诚信二字。诚信不仅是一种道德约束，也受到法律的监督。在美国，学校十分看重学生的学术诚信，对学术造假的行为往往采取”零容忍”的态度。二是 找人代考违反了美国的移民法，破坏了美国的移民制度 ，因为涉案者是在利用欺诈手段获得假成绩，以骗取美国使领馆颁发的学生签证。美国移民法规定：通过欺诈手段获得美国F-1学生签证者，离境后终生不得再入境美国，除非有相应的豁免条款。
3c9c58bd6b76fc158e7c270576746f8d50ed772d.translatedText: The reason for this is that, first, Western society attaches great importance to the word integrity. Integrity is not only a moral constraint, but also subject to legal supervision. In the United States, schools attach great importance to students' academic integrity and often adopt a "zero tolerance" attitude towards academic fraud. Second, hiring someone to take the exam for you violates U.S. immigration laws and undermines the U.S. immigration system, because the person involved is using fraudulent means to obtain false scores in order to defraud student visas issued by the U.S. embassy and consulates. U.S. immigration law stipulates that those who obtain a U.S. F-1 student visa through fraudulent means will not be allowed to re-enter the United States for life after leaving the country, unless there are corresponding exemptions.

75eb6519338f4df44fe0dc6902458e5b8e8ff825.sourceText: 至于中介机构伪造护照，就更是联邦重罪，依据美国法律，伪造外国护照罪最高可判15年监禁，并处25万美元罚金。
75eb6519338f4df44fe0dc6902458e5b8e8ff825.translatedText: As for the forgery of passports by intermediaries, it is a federal felony. According to U.S. law, the crime of forging a foreign passport is punishable by up to 15 years in prison and a fine of US$250,000.

6d1b572d5d9596c31a83151186883f6a4d10b48d.sourceText: 不仅在美国，英国对于替考行为的处罚也非常严厉。 在英国法律中，代考行为属于诈骗罪，使用假护照也属于较严重的刑事犯罪。 一旦被起诉，将视情节轻重被判处刑期不等的监禁，并会留有案底，情节较轻的将被执行社会服务令。例如，2010年媒体曝光了一位英国华威大学的华人留学生因替人代考英文考试被抓，被判刑6个月。此前也有中国学生涉嫌代考华威大学的入学英文考试，分别被判5个月和6个月监禁。2012年，一名留学英国剑桥大学的中国高材生，因持有伪造护照替非法移民考英语，被判刑一年。
6d1b572d5d9596c31a83151186883f6a4d10b48d.translatedText: Not only in the United States, but also in the United Kingdom, the penalties for taking exams for others are also very severe. Under British law, taking exams on behalf of someone is a crime of fraud, and using a fake passport is also a serious criminal offence. Once prosecuted, they will be sentenced to varying terms of imprisonment depending on the severity of the case, and a criminal record will be kept. If the case is less serious, a social service order will be implemented. For example, in 2010, the media exposed that a Chinese international student at the University of Warwick in the UK was caught taking an English exam for someone else and was sentenced to six months in prison. Previously, Chinese students were also suspected of taking the English test for the entrance to the University of Warwick and were sentenced to 5 months and 6 months in prison respectively. In 2012, a top Chinese student studying at the University of Cambridge in the UK was sentenced to one year in prison for holding a forged passport to take the English test for illegal immigrants.

a67c235b3d327ce539b8fbc4cc2a64a1d743421a.translatedText: New home sales begin to stabilize in Phoenix

376c3fa879444a07975b0b24fd3eb7d51d804494.sourceText: 凤凰城新房屋销售开始稳定 根据最近的房地产销售报告，在凤凰城地区新房子销售出现了稳定信号。 在10月份新房…
376c3fa879444a07975b0b24fd3eb7d51d804494.translatedText: New home sales begin to stabilize in Phoenix There are signs of stabilization in new home sales in the Phoenix area, according to recent real estate sales reports. New Homes in October…

cb9a41f9c681cb969af7d7b2f9ae0398d82bd6c2.sourceText: 凤凰城新房屋销售开始稳定 根据最近的房地产销售报告，在凤凰城地区新房子销售出现了稳定信号。 在10月份新房销售额比上月有所增长，同时与前三月比2010年同期销售的数量也增多。2011年10月584个新房被销售，去年同期是553栋。 新房的销售平均价格为$262,603,旧屋的平均价格为$153，987。新房的中值价格为$219,504，旧房的仅为$110,000。2011年建房许可颁发了543个，一年前仅有485个。新房销售排前三位的是Pulte Homes，DR Horton ，以及Shea Homes。从全国情况看，新房销售数量涨了1.3%，更多房地产新闻，请咨询金信地产Tinna 电话：480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
cb9a41f9c681cb969af7d7b2f9ae0398d82bd6c2.translatedText: New home sales begin to stabilize in Phoenix There are signs of stabilization in new home sales in the Phoenix area, according to a recent real estate sales report. Sales of new homes in October increased compared with the previous month, and the number of sales in the first three months was also higher than in the same period in 2010. In October 2011, 584 new homes were sold, compared with 553 in the same period last year. The average sales price for new homes is $262,603 ​​and the average price for older homes is $153,987. The median price of a new home is $219,504, compared to just $110,000 for an older home. 543 building permits were issued in 2011, compared with 485 a year earlier. The top three new home sales were Pulte Homes, DR Horton, and Shea Homes. Looking at the national situation, the number of new home sales increased by 1.3%. bdb926f1ae859567aa2a2269cae01442f386c814.sourceText: 广东一伙劫匪在抢劫银行时说了一句至理名言： ”通通不许动，钱是国家的，命是自己的！”大家都一声不吭躺倒。
bdb926f1ae859567aa2a2269cae01442f386c814.translatedText: >A group of robbers in Guangdong said a wise saying when they were robbing a bank: "Don't touch anything. The money belongs to the country, but your life is your own!" Everyone lay down without saying a word.

fb971d17613e1859707ad8641e7fa4acf7509443.sourceText: 劫匪望了一眼躺在桌上四肢朝天的出纳小姐，说：”请你躺文明些！这是劫财，又不是劫色！”
fb971d17613e1859707ad8641e7fa4acf7509443.translatedText: The robber glanced at the cashier who was lying on the table with her limbs in the air, and said: "Please lie down in a civilized manner! This is a robbery of wealth, not sex!"

22a0c9802a6618fd61c32e8b9e7b61ee02a158b5.sourceText: 劫匪回去后，其中一个新来的硕士劫匪说，”老大，我们赶快数一下抢了多少。”
22a0c9802a6618fd61c32e8b9e7b61ee02a158b5.translatedText: After the robber returned, , one of the new robbers with a master's degree said, "Boss, let's quickly count how many we robbed."

30a1e89a010e3cffe702b4cc76b10d6ce9344c52.sourceText: 那老劫匪（小学文化）说：”你傻啊？这么多，你要数到什么时候啊？今天晚上看新闻不就知道了吗。”
30a1e89a010e3cffe702b4cc76b10d6ce9344c52.translatedText: The old robber (primary school education) said: "Are you stupid? There are so many, how long are you going to count today?" Wouldn’t you know it just by watching the news at night? "

9cf2fd781e437fffeee862b296e235fe50281a39.sourceText: —-这就叫工作经验，这年头工作经验比学历更重要!
9cf2fd781e437fffeee862b296e235fe50281a39.translatedText: ——This is called work experience. Work experience is more important than academic qualifications these days!

a24812e153290dca95564dcbab788b27f7064445.sourceText: 劫匪走后，行长说，”赶紧报案！”主任刚要走，行长急忙说：”等等！把我们上次私自挪用的那五百万也加上去！”
a24812e153290dca95564dcbab788b27f7064445.translatedText: After the robbers left, the president said," Report the crime quickly!" Just as the director was about to leave, the president hurriedly said: "Wait a minute! Add the five million we embezzled privately last time!"

f5aec5717e8504226bd66cac59cbb47303cf14cb.sourceText: 主任说：”要是劫匪每个月都来抢一回就好了”。
f5aec5717e8504226bd66cac59cbb47303cf14cb.translatedText: The director said: "It would be great if the robbers come here once a month."

e2f1535c55a14860881b06940decace622f8a45c.sourceText: 工作很枯燥，快乐最重要！
e2f1535c55a14860881b06940decace622f8a45c.translatedText: Work is boring, happiness is the most important!

709772991cc63db55e1057c5925178a434266762.sourceText: 第二天新闻联播报道银行被抢了一亿，劫匪数来数去只有两千万。 老大骂道：”妈的，老子拼了一条命才抢了两千万，银行行长动动手指头就赚了八千万，看来这年头还是要读书啊！”
709772991cc63db55e1057c5925178a434266762.translatedText: The next day the news broadcast reported that the bank was robbed of 100 million, but the robbers kept counting and only got 20 million. The boss scolded: "Damn it, I fought for my life to steal 20 million, but the bank president made 80 million with just his fingers. It seems that he still needs to study these days!"

f5a1f026e6fd450123b836cb7356043253d103ec.sourceText: 银行行长看到新闻联播后激动滴对主任说：”妈的，终于通过劫匪把买中石油股票的窟窿补上了。”
f5a1f026e6fd450123b836cb7356043253d103ec.translatedText: The bank president got excited and said to the director after seeing the news broadcast. Said: "Damn, finally the hole in the PetroChina stock purchase was filled through the robbers."

16756ccccd8e30bce52679e6414e39dc85c4609f.sourceText: 窟窿补完后还多出4000万，行长对主任说：”快把这4000W提出买猪去，猪肉看涨。”
16756ccccd8e30bce52679e6414e39dc85c4609f.translatedText: After the hole was filled, there was still 40 million more. The president said to the director: "Quickly put forward the 40 million to buy pigs. The price of pork is bullish."

d4e072fee77873b9cc040cb6066d79a25e51839b.sourceText: 「明月心 台灣情 慶雙十 」大鳳凰城台美商會慶雙十暨中秋聯歡酒會 大鳳凰城台美商會於十月十曰晚上六點在Octillo Country Club高爾夫度假村主辦慶祝中華民國106年雙十國慶暨中秋聯歡酒會。主席大鳳凰城台美商會會長張聖儀首先代表商會致歡迎詞，感謝所有與會佳賓，並簡介商會促成錢德勒市府與台南市前市長頼清德締結姊妹市，致力推廣棒球外交和舉辦經貿論壇，結合主流政要媒體社團及台商僑青共同參與，以落實國民外交宣揚中華民國台灣，讓亜利桑那卅主流社會及僑民支持台灣參與各項國際組織並增加台湾在主流社會的能見度，増進台商會員交流聯誼促進商機，凝聚僑心支持政府。錢德勒市長Jay Tibshraeny 並明令頒 Proclaimed 十月十曰是中華民國臺灣曰。 本次國慶酒會以「明月心 台灣情 慶雙十」為主題播放外交部雙十國慶影片介紹台灣。酒會活動包括切雙十國慶國旗大蛋糕儀式，主流政要致賀辭，表演節目，並備有十道美味前菜，二種義大利麵點和主廚烤牛肉美食餐點，台式月餅綠豆椪，飲料和近百樣高級摸彩獎品，供所有出席主流貴賓媒體，商會理監事會員暨台僑朋友享用。 此次出席盛會的主流政要有美國聯邦國會議員Matt Salmon，亞利桑納州眾議院議長J.D. The Taiwan American Chamber of Commerce in Greater Phoenix hosted a cocktail party to celebrate the 106th National Day of the Republic of China and the Mid-Autumn Festival at the Octillo Country Club Golf Resort on October 10 at 6 p.m. Chairman Zhang Shengyi, President of the Greater Phoenix Taiwanese American Chamber of Commerce, first delivered a welcome speech on behalf of the Chamber of Commerce, thanked all the guests present, and introduced that the Chamber of Commerce has promoted the establishment of a sister city between the Chandler City Government and former Tainan City Mayor Li Qingde, and is committed to promoting baseball diplomacy and holding economic and trade forums, integrating mainstream political media organizations Participate with Taiwanese businessmen and overseas Chinese youth to implement national diplomacy and promote Taiwan, the Republic of China, allow the mainstream society and overseas Chinese in Arizona to support Taiwan's participation in various international organizations and increase Taiwan's visibility in mainstream society, increase exchanges and friendships among Taiwanese business members, promote business opportunities, and rally overseas Chinese to support the government. Chandler Mayor Jay Tibshraeny also issued an order Proclaimed October 10th is Taiwan Day of the Republic of China. This National Day cocktail reception was themed "Ming Yue Heart, Love for Taiwan, Celebrating Double Ten" and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' Double Ten National Day video was played to introduce Taiwan. The reception included a National Day National Flag cake-cutting ceremony, congratulatory speeches from mainstream dignitaries, performances, and ten delicious appetizers, two types of pasta and chef's roast beef delicacies, Taiwanese mooncakes with green bean paste, drinks and nearly a hundred high-end lottery prizes for all attending mainstream VIP media, chamber of commerce supervisors and Taiwanese overseas friends to enjoy. Mainstream dignitaries attending the event include U.S. Congressman Matt Salmon, Arizona House Speaker J.D. e61af3a23061dedb88abff7e396b264fb5f38dbc.translatedText: The Dr. Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall in Hong Kong displays the precious philatelic stamps of the 1911 Revolution Xinhuanet Hong Kong, May 9th (Reporter Zhao Bo) To commemorate the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911, Sun Yat-sen in Hong Kong...

4013ca3c18ed907768efc0880407e5d099f74b3d.sourceText: 香港5月9日电（记者赵博）为纪念辛亥革命100周年，香港孙中山纪念馆9日起举办”有史必有斯人棗辛亥人物邮票展”。展览通过100多件珍贵邮品，缅怀多位革命领导人和革命志士，亦借此向他们无私奉献、为国为民的高尚情操致敬。
4013ca3c18ed907768efc0880407e5d099f74b3d.translatedText: Hong Kong, May 9th (Reporter Zhao Bo) To commemorate the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911, the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall in Hong Kong will hold the "Stamp Exhibition of Must-Historical Figures of Xinhai" from the 9th. The exhibition commemorates many revolutionary leaders and revolutionary patriots through more than 100 precious stamps, and also pays tribute to their noble sentiments of selfless dedication and serving the country and the people.

7b597cb79365bd1817472d6219cbc196c4e3aec0.sourceText: 此次展出的邮品包括1912年发行的”中华民国光复纪念”邮票、民国时期以廖仲恺肖像为主图的”烈士像普通邮票”,1929年南京发行的”孙总理国葬纪念邮票”、1967年发行的”秋瑾烈士肖像邮票”首日封、1979年发行的”名人肖像邮票棗陆皓东”首日封及邮折、1968年发行的”辛亥革命著名领导人物黄兴”纪念邮票及首日封等。
7b597cb79365bd1817472d6219cbc196c4e3aec0.translatedText: The stamps on display include the "Recovery of the Republic of China Commemorative" stamps issued in 1912, the "Martyrs Portraits Ordinary Stamps" with the portrait of Liao Zhongkai as the main image during the Republic of China, and the "State Funeral of Premier Sun" issued in Nanjing in 1929 "Commemorative Stamps", the first-day cover of "Portrait Stamps of Martyr Qiu Jin" issued in 1967, the first-day covers and folds of "Celebrity Portrait Stamps Zao Lu Haodong" issued in 1979, the commemorative stamps and first-day covers of "Huang Xing, a famous leader of the Revolution of 1911" issued in 1968, etc.

de2dd39de5dea8a34ffe563d381237b2e65bb979.sourceText: 坐落于香港中环半山的孙中山纪念馆成立于2006年12月，是香港市民和访港游客缅怀孙中山先生在港革命足迹的重要场所。纪念馆共有两个常设展厅，展出多件珍贵的历史文物，配合多元化的视听节目，全面阐述孙中山生平事迹，以及香港在19世纪末至20世纪初的维新革命运动中所扮演的重要角色。
de2dd39de5dea8a34ffe563d381237b2e65bb979.translatedText: The Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall, located in the Mid-Levels of Central, Hong Kong, was established in December 2006. It is an important place for Hong Kong citizens and tourists visiting Hong Kong to commemorate Dr. Sun Yat-sen’s revolutionary footprints in Hong Kong. The memorial hall has two permanent exhibition halls, displaying a number of precious historical relics and diversified audio-visual programs to comprehensively explain Sun Yat-sen's life and deeds, as well as the important role played by Hong Kong in the reform and revolutionary movement from the late 19th century to the early 20th century.

84773c07c582cc27732a34dd784fbd3bac9ec9fc.sourceText: ”有史必有斯人棗辛亥人物邮票展”将持续至8月18日。为纪念辛亥革命100周年，香港还将举办一系列纪念活动，包括展览、研讨会、歌剧等，让香港市民认识中国近代历史的重要一页。
84773c07c582cc27732a34dd784fbd3bac9ec9fc.translatedText: "Stamp Exhibition of Xinhai Characters in History" will last until August 18. To commemorate the 100th anniversary of the Revolution of 1911, Hong Kong will also hold a series of commemorative activities, including exhibitions, seminars, operas, etc., to allow Hong Kong citizens to understand this important page in China's modern history.
