1f348c1d2a1ffc383a826df1d1aff1e5bc4d310a.translatedText: A Chinese-American girl from a well-known high school in New Jersey died unfortunately. The cause of death is unknown. The school is grieving (picture)…

25eff8122f97b8fb431c4432c20e08f848785ed8.sourceText: 新泽西州北部名校博根郡科技高中(Bergen County Academies，简称BCA)的10年级华裔女生李沁心(Qinxin Li，音译，又名Dana Li)，6日不幸身亡，警方和校方迄今均未公布死因，但她最后被看到在与纽约市相连的华盛顿桥附近独自徘徊。
25eff8122f97b8fb431c4432c20e08f848785ed8.translatedText: > Bergen County Technical High School (Bergen County), a prestigious school in northern New Jersey Qinxin Li (transliteration, also known as Dana Li), a 10th-grade Chinese girl from the Academies (BCA), died on the 6th. Neither the police nor the school have announced the cause of death so far, but she was last seen wandering alone near the Washington Bridge that connects to New York City.

2d9e36ee429f660dda8f1d2e7b13309203a233f6.sourceText: 校长戴维斯(Russell Davis)8日对全校家长发出两封电子信，告诉家长此不幸的消息，并呼吁家长应密切注意子女的日常言行举止，如有任何沮丧或压力现象，应立即采取行动，和学校辅导处联络。
2d9e36ee429f660dda8f1d2e7b13309203a233f6.translatedText: Principal Russell Davis sent two e-mails to parents at the school on the 8th, informing parents of the unfortunate news and calling on parents to pay close attention to their children's daily words and deeds. If they feel any frustration or stress, they should take immediate action and contact the school guidance office.

1fdabf9930a41edf3033837a9c4afc6f5ea14a4c.sourceText: 戴维斯在信中表示，家长应持开放态度和子女倾谈，如有需要，尽快和辅导处或校长本人洽谈。
1fdabf9930a41edf3033837a9c4afc6f5ea14a4c.translatedText: Davis stated in the letter that parents should be open to talking with their children and, if necessary, negotiate with the guidance office or the principal himself as soon as possible.

cca636f0b4ab8b946319f1b91ba447c91ee14ef9.sourceText: 该校学生为纪念李沁心，在脸书上开设纪念专页，8日相约穿着李沁心生前最喜爱的蓝色和绿色衣服上课，并在清晨开始上课前全校沉默致哀。
cca636f0b4ab8b946319f1b91ba447c91ee14ef9.translatedText: To commemorate Li Qinxin, the students of the school set up a memorial page on Facebook. On the 8th, they met to attend class wearing Li Qinxin’s favorite blue and green clothes. The whole school paid silent tribute before starting class in the early morning.

5082111ff89dca32ddb4a020a45fe6104e29af57.sourceText: 戴维斯在信中指出，他在6日早上接获警方询问失踪学生，稍后被告知李沁心已死亡。他表示，校方对此消息深表悲恸。
5082111ff89dca32ddb4a020a45fe6104e29af57.translatedText: Davis pointed out in the letter that he received an inquiry from the police about the missing student on the morning of the 6th, and was later informed that Li Qinxin was dead. He said the school was deeply saddened by the news.

0f9e339a7956d13ced5daa8a67f2e4d666460ebb.sourceText: 虽然警方和校方均未公布死因，但学生们都猜测，是李沁心自己选择了此不幸的悲剧。
0f9e339a7956d13ced5daa8a67f2e4d666460ebb.translatedText: Although neither the police nor the school announced the cause of death, students all speculated that Li Qinxin chose this unfortunate tragedy.

4fd126c5e3e4cdee6b169410f932d30c7ed17104.sourceText: 博根郡科技高中位于汉肯撒克(Hackensack)，招收9至12年级学生，入学经竞争激烈的选拔，该校1000余名学生均是来自博根郡的菁英，去年膺选”美国新闻与世界报导”(U.S.News & World Report)全美最佳高中之一，学生SAT平均成绩高达2100分，为全美高中第二高分。
4fd126c5e3e4cdee6b169410f932d30c7ed17104.translatedText: > Bergen County Technical High School is located in Hackensack, enrolling students from grades 9 to 12. Admissions are highly competitive. The school's more than 1,000 students are all elites from Bergen County. Last year, they were selected as one of the best high schools in the United States by U.S. News & World Report. The average student SAT score is as high as 2100 points, the second highest score among high schools in the United States.

3a86a4a2217e30ab30e89d726079fbf7d3d60f92.sourceText: 该校升学率优异，有长春藤大学的先修班美誉，亚、华裔学生比率较高。
3a86a4a2217e30ab30e89d726079fbf7d3d60f92.translatedText: The school has an excellent admission rate, is known as the preparatory class of Ivy League universities, and has a high proportion of Asian and Chinese students.

acabde9feb184fee6f7933e976532059f8e0c15a.sourceText: 死者父母都是哥大学者，哥大华人圈闻此消息都是唏嘘不已，认为主要还是家长与孩子沟通不够。
acabde9feb184fee6f7933e976532059f8e0c15a.translatedText: The parents of the deceased were both Columbia University scholars. The Chinese community at Columbia were all devastated when they heard the news. They believed that the main reason was insufficient communication between parents and their children.

18aa7a01376521c7967397ec7386b76efdd91ca0.sourceText: 山猫闯民居 虚惊一场 斯格思岱一居民在后院发现了山猫！听起来挺吓人的，原来是只几个星期大的幼崽。 这只幼崽被发现在156th Street和Dynamite附件，目前尚不清楚它如何跑到这户民居。幼崽后来被送往西南野生动物中心喂养。中心管理员说，等幼崽饲养到足够大，将会把它送回野外。 野生动物专家提醒市民，如近距离发现野生动物，切勿慌张，动物判断在人类没有攻击它时一般也不会作出攻击人类的动作。另外，在没有许可证状况下收养野生动物为宠物，在本州是非法行为。
18aa7a01376521c7967397ec7386b76efdd91ca0.translatedText: Bobcat breaks into house, false alarm: A Scottsdale resident found a bobcat in his backyard! It sounded scary, but it turned out to be a cub only a few weeks old. The cub was found near 156th Street and Dynamite, and it's unclear how it ended up at the home. The cub was later taken to the Southwest Wildlife Center for feeding. Center managers said the cub will be returned to the wild once it is old enough. Wildlife experts remind citizens not to panic if they spot wild animals at close range. Animals generally will not attack humans when they judge that humans are not attacking them. In addition, it is illegal in the state to adopt wild animals as pets without a license.

b230f287ed3e02e67d888338b1ff8d49bdc4857a.sourceText: 银河系恒星三次爆炸不灭反亮 亚利桑那大学科学家想破头
b230f287ed3e02e67d888338b1ff8d49bdc4857a.translatedText: The Milky Way star exploded three times and remained bright, scientists at the University of Arizona want to break it

a9b1b6d4f9ec4634d0de00a2c037f84a913d521c.sourceText: 银河系恒星三次爆炸不灭反亮 亚利桑那大学科学家想破头 银河系恒星海山二（Eta Carinae）很让天文学…
a9b1b6d4f9ec4634d0de00a2c037f84a913d521c.translatedText: The Milky Way star exploded three times and stayed bright again. Scientists at the University of Arizona want to break it. The Milky Way star Eta Carinae is very astronomical...

4457bf803f8b29d6925eed9d1fd9d139e830af30.sourceText: 银河系恒星 海山二 （Eta Carinae）很让天文学家伤脑筋，因为这颗恒星至少发生过三次 爆炸 ，每次爆炸后不仅没有像其它爆炸恒星一样崩毁，反而变得更亮，让科学家非常不解，并更卖力进行研究。
4457bf803f8b29d6925eed9d1fd9d139e830af30.translatedText: The Milky Way star Eta Carinae is very troublesome for astronomers, because this star has exploded at least three times. , after each explosion, not only did it not collapse like other exploding stars, but it became brighter, which puzzled scientists and made them work harder to study.

37be234d7c8ab4f49ac5b92d004fb2592d2129fb.sourceText: 海山二 为高光度蓝变星（LBV），位于船底座，含有银河系中已知最亮的天体，距离地球7,500至8,000光年，其中至少有两颗恒星，一颗恒星的质量大约为太阳的150倍，而亮度为太阳的100万倍以上；另一颗恒星质量也巨大，约为太阳的30倍。 美国亚利桑那大学（University of Arizona）的科学家发现海山二的恒星至少发生过三次 爆炸 ，但是无法解释其原因。 Gizmodo澳洲频道9月5日报导，科学家分析一个恒星发生爆炸的条件有两种方式。其一，恒星的核聚变活动停止，无法保持星体的形态而发生崩毁。另一方式为恒星体积缩小成白矮星，最后因过度致密而爆炸死亡。 但是，科学家发现海山二的恒星爆炸原因和前述两种方式完全不吻合。据历史记载，十九世纪中期，海山二发生爆炸，其亮度异常增大，以至于几乎超过天空中所有其它星星，因此被称为”大喷发”（Great Eruption），并在周围形成侏儒星云（ Homonculus nebula）。 但是，海山二系统并未死亡，十九世纪九十年代、二十世纪中期又接连变得更亮。尤其在1998～1999年间，海山二的亮度突然增加一倍。 亚利桑那大学的研究者梅吉安・吉敏基（Megan Kiminki）说：”我们把海山二叫做超新星魔术师。它变亮，意味着喷发大量物质，但是它仍然存在。” 而且，研究者根据天文资料，发现海山二在更久之前也出现爆炸，如分别在十三世纪和十六世纪发生爆炸。 报导说，海山二发生多次爆炸的原因尚未解开，但推测其爆炸一定与宇宙发生的其它事件有联系，也许它是在7,000年前即向我们发送某种信息，而我们却不解其意。
37be234d7c8ab4f49ac5b92d004fb2592d2129fb.translatedText: Eta Carinae is a high-luminosity blue variable star (LBV) located in the constellation Carina. It contains the brightest known objects in the Milky Way, 7,500 to 8,000 light-years away from the Earth. There are at least two stars among them. One star is about 150 times as massive as the sun and more than 1 million times as bright as the sun; the other star is also huge, about 30 times as massive as the sun. Scientists from the University of Arizona found that Eta Carinae's star had exploded at least three times, but could not explain the cause. Gizmodo Australia reported on September 5 that scientists analyze the conditions for a star to explode in two ways. First, the nuclear fusion activity of the star stops, and it cannot maintain the shape of the star and collapses. Another way is that the star shrinks in size into a white dwarf, and finally explodes and dies due to excessive density. However, scientists found that the cause of Eta Carinae's stellar explosion was completely inconsistent with the above two methods. According to historical records, in the mid-19th century, Eta Carinae exploded, and its brightness increased abnormally, so much that it exceeded almost all other stars in the sky, so it was called the "Great Eruption" and formed the Homonculus nebula around it. However, Eta Carinae did not die, and became brighter in the 1890s and mid-2000s. Especially between 1998 and 1999, the brightness of Eta Carinae suddenly doubled. Megan Kiminki, a researcher at the University of Arizona, said: "We call Eta Carinae the supernova magician. It gets brighter, which means it erupts a lot of material, but it still exists." Moreover, based on astronomical data, the researchers found that Eta Carinae also exploded much earlier, such as in the 13th century and the 16th century. The report said that the reason for the multiple explosions of Eta Carinae has not yet been solved, but it is speculated that its explosion must be connected with other events in the universe. Perhaps it sent us some kind of message 7,000 years ago, but we do not understand its meaning.

ea628fa5bb6a62f8344823b3215eeb313217c1da.sourceText: 记忆总是和自己开着不适当的玩笑：当需要时它总是随着时光被渐渐淡忘；而想要抛开它的时候，它又突然跳出来，像个古怪的精灵，用针不停扎着我的心口，提醒我那些在大脑中刻下的痕迹有多深。
ea628fa5bb6a62f8344823b3215eeb313217c1da.translatedText: Memory always makes inappropriate jokes with itself: when needed, it is always gradually forgotten over time; and when I want to put it away, it suddenly jumps out, like a weird elf, pricking my heart with needles, reminding me how deep the traces are engraved in my brain.

6a2fea874ccff2b4772e7765dba648eb1c3882eb.sourceText: 这一刻，我无法入眠-只因为知道了费老师去世的消息。我和他有三年未见，也没有打过电话或通过电子邮件。但是这并不妨碍我和他，也包括他们全家亲人般的感情。我知道他和我在这点上完全一样，总是懒于和老朋友联系。君子之交淡如水，或许是对我们这种懒惰状态的最好托辞。然而这湾淡淡的水被他辞世的消息打乱的时候，我才知道原来一潭清水也可以有如此的深度。和听到消息的大多数人一样，我能做的就是在网上不停地查找更多的消息。网上的消息大部分都是他的学生们的悼念之词，也说着他在学校教书工作各种各样的事情，甚至还有他大学时候的趣事；看着看着，那些和他在亚利桑那共处的无数片段，就如同被风翻开的书本，在我眼前把两年曾经的经历一页页闪现。
6a2fea874ccff2b4772e7765dba648eb1c3882eb.translatedText: At this moment, I couldn't sleep - just because I learned about the death of Teacher Fei. He and I hadn’t seen each other in three years, nor had we had a phone call or email. But this does not hinder the relationship between me and him, including their whole family, as family members. I knew he was exactly the same as me in this regard, always too lazy to keep in touch with old friends. The friendship between gentlemen is as light as water, which may be the best excuse for our lazy state. However, when this shallow water was disturbed by the news of his death, I realized that a clear water can also have such depth. Like most people who heard the news, all I could do was keep searching online for more news. Most of the messages on the Internet were condolences from his students, and also talked about various things about his teaching and work at the school, and even interesting stories from his college days. As I looked at it, the countless fragments of his time in Arizona were like a book opened by the wind, and the experiences of the past two years flashed before my eyes page by page.

63bbb295437b8587e741a79f0359e4ce2b52bea7.sourceText: 说是”老师”，只是因为人人都这么叫他，我心里却从来没有把他当成老师，坦率地说，我只把这个”老师”当作他的另一个更容易叫的名字而已。毕竟他的全名”费剑平”叫的比较拗口。我第一次见到他的时候，他正在屋前一边踱着步一边吞云吐雾，一副很悠闲享受的样子，给我一副完全的背影。等他回过头来，我就看清了他的样子。
63bbb295437b8587e741a79f0359e4ce2b52bea7.translatedText: I say "teacher" just because everyone calls him that, but I never think of him as a teacher in my heart. Frankly speaking, I just regard "teacher" as another name that is easier to call him. After all, his full name "Fei Jianping" is rather difficult to pronounce. The first time I saw him, he was pacing in front of the house, puffing away smoke, looking very leisurely and enjoying himself, giving me a complete back view. When he turned around, I could see his face clearly.

0ef04fcaa2805139eea710196c97e0f30ac36570.sourceText: 那一刻，就是那一刻。现实和记忆的反差如此之大，以至于现在的我完全不能把他和病床和肝癌这种事情联系起来。然而当时光处在那一刻的他，活生生的他，转回身来，对我点了点头，憨憨地笑了笑。
0ef04fcaa2805139eea710196c97e0f30ac36570.translatedText: That moment is that moment. The contrast between reality and memory is so great that now I can't connect him with the hospital bed and liver cancer at all. However, at that moment, he, alive, turned around, nodded to me, and smiled innocently.

56d707e0e3b844720b2d7802ed06fbd9827d6238.sourceText: 浓眉、大眼、高鼻子、高个子、宽肩膀 -他长得应该绝对符合标准古典的审美。然而略为方正的下巴和满腮帮子的胡子茬让他和那些影视里精巧的帅哥分道扬镳，更不用提他当时壮硕得有些臃肿的身材和憨厚的笑容，让他讨巧地挤入了普通人的行列。肥大的套头红色运动衫勉强遮盖了他的腰围；所以最引人注目的还是他的双手。和细小的香烟比起来，他的手非常粗大，几乎给我天天干农活的印象。我礼貌性地打了个招呼，于是，我和这个名叫”费老师”的人，就这么相识了。
56d707e0e3b844720b2d7802ed06fbd9827d6238.translatedText: Thick eyebrows, big eyes, high nose, tall stature, broad shoulders - his appearance should definitely conform to the standard classical aesthetic. However, his slightly square chin and stubble on his cheeks separated him from the smart and handsome guys in movies and TV shows, not to mention his strong and somewhat bloated figure and honest smile at the time, which allowed him to squeeze into the ranks of ordinary people. A baggy red sweatshirt barely covered his waist; so the most noticeable thing was his hands. Compared with the small cigarettes, his hands are very big, almost giving me the impression that he does farm work every day. I said hello politely, and this person named "Teacher Fei" and I got to know each other.

4da9e0502b4cfdb457819bf9a684813dfd7ee436.sourceText: 我和他的关系一开始严格来说只是邻居。在美国这样的地方，邻居可以只是邻居，和国内那种”远亲不如近邻”的邻居有着天壤之别。然而不知道什么时候起，他完全地变成了我的另一个家人一般；更确切地说，他们全家和我家都变成了一家人。这种转变是如此自然，以至于我们丝毫没有觉得有什么特别。我们住的公寓和他们一个楼上一个楼下；我们只要不是工作的时间，有事没事就从我家跑到他家?然后再从他家跑到我家，如此周而复始地构成了我们简单的循环。时间久了，我会觉得我家的居住面积平白增多了一倍；而家人的数量也翻了一番。我和他的接触和网上写得最多的截然不同，是全然生活化的，没有一丝学术气氛和任何的师生关系；哪怕我折腾我的半导体材料他研究他的计量经济学，我和他共同的话题依然是面食和NBA居多。他对面食的爱好和我臭味相投；但是却完全没有我对于美食的起码要求。就本质上来说，只需要一大碗酱油辣椒拌面条，加点葱花，就足以让他动筷子之前说一句：”真香哪”，然后吃完后放下筷子再说一句：”真好吃啊。”我对篮球并不精通，仅仅能够勉强分得出乔丹和奥尼尔的差别。而他对于NBA的球队特点却娓娓道来，一场比赛中听他的评论，对我来说好像油炸花生米一般地香甜，让我很难得地和他一起坐在电视前多看了不少场比赛。当然，过程中他会时不时调调电视天线，力图增加电视图像的清晰度 -虽然往往徒劳无功。他对我的爱好之一围棋也表现了浓厚的兴趣，但是很明显他完全只是初学的水平，和我下过一两盘之后，他就把对围棋的爱好完全局限在和电脑程序对战之中，绝口不提和我再战的事情。
4da9e0502b4cfdb457819bf9a684813dfd7ee436.translatedText: My relationship with him started out as strictly neighbors. In a place like the United States, neighbors can be just neighbors, which is very different from the "distant relatives are not as good as close neighbors" in China. However, I don’t know since when, he has completely become like another family member of mine; more precisely, their whole family and mine have become one family. The transition was so natural that we didn't feel anything special at all. We lived in an apartment upstairs and downstairs from theirs; as long as it was not working time, we would run from my house to his house when we had something to do? Then we would run from his house to my house again, and so on, forming a simple cycle for us. Over time, I will feel that the living area of ​​my home has doubled; and the number of family members has also doubled. My contact with him was completely different from those who have written most about it online. It was completely life-like, without a trace of academic atmosphere or any teacher-student relationship. Even if I was tossing about my semiconductor materials and he was studying his econometrics, the topics he and I shared were mostly pasta and the NBA. His love for pasta is similar to mine; but he doesn’t have my minimum requirements for delicious food. In essence, all it takes is a big bowl of noodles mixed with soy sauce and chili pepper, and some chopped green onion, which is enough to make him say: "It tastes so good" before moving his chopsticks, and then put down his chopsticks after eating and say: "It's delicious." I am not proficient in basketball, and I can barely tell the difference between Jordan and O'Neal. But he spoke eloquently about the characteristics of NBA teams. Listening to his comments during a game was as sweet as fried peanuts to me. It was a rare opportunity for me to sit in front of the TV with him and watch many more games. Of course, he would adjust the TV antenna from time to time during the process, trying to increase the clarity of the TV image - although often in vain. He also showed a strong interest in Go, one of my hobbies, but it was obvious that he was just a beginner. After playing one or two games with me, he completely limited his interest in Go to playing against computer programs, and never mentioned that he would play against me again.

d35a5776aa643f5361cb27c11265e8e4b1e31af0.sourceText: 在美国读书或进修过的人大概都会知道，那段时间的生活总是匆忙的、临时的。每逢有人搬家，费老师照例是一定被抓的壮劳力；当然，他帮助别人也是心甘情愿。我们住的公寓也谈不上条件有多好，家具更是东拼西凑。但是费老师在这样的状态里照样过得其乐融融。他有时候会一边大碗吃面，一边说起小时候没地方去睡大马路，饿着肚子吃不饱饭，然后一副满意极了的神情继续往嘴里吸着面条。当然这里也有他无法忍受的东西，那就是蟑螂。曾经有一次费老师往家里新添了一个大沙发（是旧的），然后他家里开始小强横行。对于杀蟑药这种化学生物制剂，尽管他没有在言辞上有所微词，但是他还是用行动充分表现了他的不满。有一段时间，每天见到他，他的眼睛都是肿的。一问，原来他每天夜深人静，都会突然起身，打开厨房的灯，然后对他视野所及的所有活体动物采用物理攻击；有时候一整晚甚至行动多次，于是他每次所能歼灭的数量日趋减少。但是令人诧异的是蟑螂的数量始终没有接近他满意的程度，于是他在狠动了一番脑筋之后，把那个新添的沙发解剖了一遍。那次的盛况我没有亲眼目睹，不过据他亲口说那次他快要达到了百强斩的程度。在这之后，蟑螂的数量最终下降到他能够忍受的地步，而他也终于能够心安理得的好好睡觉了，重新在脸上写满舒适的表情。
d35a5776aa643f5361cb27c11265e8e4b1e31af0.translatedText: Anyone who has studied or studied in the United States will probably know that life during that period was always rushed and temporary. Whenever someone moves, Teacher Fei is always the one who will be caught. Of course, he is also willing to help others. The apartment we lived in was not in good condition, and the furniture was patchwork. But Teacher Fei still lived happily in this state. Sometimes while eating a big bowl of noodles, he would talk about how he had no place to sleep on the street when he was a child, and how he was hungry and could not eat enough. Then he would continue to suck noodles into his mouth with an expression of great satisfaction. Of course there is something he can't stand, and that's cockroaches. Once, Teacher Fei added a big new sofa (it was old) to his home, and then he started to run rampant in the house. Although he did not criticize chemical and biological agents such as cockroach killers, he fully demonstrated his dissatisfaction with actions. For a while, every day I saw him, his eyes were swollen. Upon questioning, it turned out that every night in the dead of night, he would suddenly get up, turn on the kitchen light, and then use physical attacks on all living animals within his sight; sometimes he would even do this multiple times throughout the night, so the number he could annihilate each time was decreasing day by day. But what was surprising was that the number of cockroaches was never close to the level he was satisfied with, so after thinking hard, he dissected the newly added sofa. I didn't witness the grand occasion with my own eyes, but according to his own words, he was about to reach the level of killing the top 100 people that time. After that, the number of cockroaches finally dropped to a level that he could tolerate, and he was finally able to sleep peacefully with a comfortable expression on his face again.

13034b454e3bb1b63a8b534249c6394b09cfd27c.sourceText: 刚开始相识那段时间，Kevin（费老师的二儿子）还没有出生，我的孩子还小，所以已经能和大人们对话的壮壮（费老师的大儿子）也绝对是每天生活的主角。每次我到他们家里，经常的情景是春霞（就是学生们说的师母）在厨房，壮壮在看”花木兰”或是”狮子王”，而费老师在一台破旧的笔记本电脑前工作。他的桌椅和他的身高并不很搭配，导致他得猫着腰看着屏幕；和他硕大的手指相比，笔记本电脑的键盘显得无比渺小，形成强烈的反差；而旁边几页纸，一支笔基本也只是摆设，大概100%的草稿都在他的脑子里。当然，大多数人也许无法想象，他的大部分工作就是在这样的状态，在迪斯尼动画片的伴奏下完成的。如果我赶上这样的场面，我照例会坐下和壮壮一起津津有味地看动画片。当然我偶尔也瞅过他的电脑屏幕，哪怕我对于半导体物理、量子力学和光电技术有些浅见薄识，但是满屏幕的符咒般的计量经济学的天书让我立刻捡起”隔行如隔山”这句话，在等着吃饭的同时继续我的动画之旅。当然我也带费老师到我们实验室参观过，看着他对我们各式各样的仪器设备一脸的诚惶诚恐，我的心里也在暗暗偷乐。费老师如果从工作中回过神来，经常会和壮壮玩”爬树”的游戏。他抓着壮壮的手，接着壮壮踩着他一步步一直蹬到胸口，接着一个后空翻落地。这个游戏我第一次见的时候目瞪口呆，但不久我也偷师成功，学会了这个危险度颇高的父子体操。
13034b454e3bb1b63a8b534249c6394b09cfd27c.translatedText: When we first met, Kevin (Teacher Fei’s second son) was not born yet, and my child was still young, so Zhuang Zhuang (Teacher Fei’s eldest son), who was already able to talk to adults, was definitely the protagonist of every day life. Every time I go to their home, the usual scene is that Chunxia (the teacher’s wife as the students call her) is in the kitchen, Zhuangzhuang is watching "Mulan" or "The Lion King", and Teacher Fei is working in front of an old laptop. His desk and chair did not match his height very well, so he had to hunker down to look at the screen; compared with his huge fingers, the laptop keyboard looked extremely small, forming a strong contrast; and the few pages of paper and pen next to it were basically just decorations, and probably 100% of the drafts were in his mind. Of course, most people may not be able to imagine that most of his work was completed in this state, accompanied by Disney cartoons. If I catch up with such a scene, I will sit down and watch cartoons with Zhuangzhuang with great interest as usual. Of course, I occasionally looked at his computer screen. Even though I had little knowledge of semiconductor physics, quantum mechanics, and optoelectronic technology, the spell-like econometrics book that filled the screen made me immediately pick up the phrase "every line is like a mountain" and continue my animation journey while waiting for my meal. Of course, I also took Teacher Fei to visit our laboratory. Seeing his frightened face towards our various instruments and equipment, I was secretly happy in my heart. When Teacher Fei comes back to his senses from work, he often plays the game of "tree climbing" with Zhuang Zhuang. He grabbed Zhuang Zhuang's hand, then Zhuang Zhuang stepped on him step by step until he reached his chest, and then landed on the ground with a backflip. I was dumbfounded when I first saw this game, but soon I succeeded and learned this very dangerous father-son gymnastics.

4a1c2876cd391b6fcc49228da70797c85ba241b8.sourceText: 日子一天天过去，后来Kevin也出生了，我们这一大家子过得更加其乐融融。当然要说最高兴的还是一起出去玩。我们开着两辆旧车，把凤凰城附近的风景都扫描了一遍。当然开车的时候，照例是我痛苦地跟在他的车后面。而费老师开车有个显著的特点：只要一握方向盘，似乎就再不愿意踩刹车；每次出行的时候似乎对他来说都是公路拉力赛专门时间。有次去Canyon Lake（峡谷湖），在山路上蜿蜒盘绕，他在前面一骑绝尘，我在后面紧跟慢赶，手心和脑门全是汗。到了目的地之后之后两腿直发软，看着壮壮、我儿子，还有费老师托着Kevin在湖边的草地上高兴地一圈圈打转，我脑袋里也有什么东西在跟着一圈一圈转，然后我倒在草地上就沉沉睡过去，比在家里的床上睡得还香甜。另有一次我们租了辆大车去圣地亚哥，我和费老师换着开车；我当时最满意的一件事就是不用跟在费老师的赛车后边痛苦地追逐了。我两人开的是夜车，而车后三排座上，先是三个小孩子呼呼大睡；过一阵两个母亲也呼呼大睡。我们俩在前面一边聊一边开车，从理想、事业一直聊到哲学。到现在，那次在圣地亚哥玩的事情倒是印象有些淡了，但是和一起费老师开夜车的事情倒是记忆犹新。
4a1c2876cd391b6fcc49228da70797c85ba241b8.translatedText: The days passed, and then Kevin was born, and our family lived more happily. Of course, the happiest thing is hanging out together. We took two old cars and scanned the landscape around Phoenix. Of course, when driving, I followed his car painfully as usual. Mr. Fei has a distinctive characteristic when driving: as soon as he holds the steering wheel, he no longer seems willing to hit the brakes; every time he travels, it seems that it is a dedicated time for road rally racing. Once I went to Canyon Lake and was winding on the mountain road. He was riding ahead and I was following closely behind. My palms and forehead were all sweaty. After arriving at the destination, my legs felt weak. I watched Zhuang Zhuang, my son, and Teacher Fei spinning around happily on the grass by the lake. Something was spinning in my head, and then I fell down on the grass and fell into a deep sleep, which was even more sound than sleeping on the bed at home. Another time we rented a big car to go to San Diego, and Teacher Fei and I switched driving. The most satisfying thing for me at that time was that I no longer had to chase painfully behind Teacher Fei’s car. The two of us were driving at night, and in the three rows of seats behind the car, there were three children sleeping soundly at first; after a while, the two mothers also fell asleep soundly. The two of us were chatting in the front while driving, talking about our ideals, career and philosophy. Up to now, the memory of that time in San Diego is a bit faded, but the memory of burning the midnight oil with Teacher Fei is still fresh in my memory.

8fe385df80315e04c3252a2a78af080378c67024.sourceText: 两年的时间说长不长，说短也不短。等费老师一家真的收拾行囊开始准备回国时，我们还高兴地谈论着将来。可是等离别的一刻真的来到时，我们只能强压着忧伤，而所有女士们的眼泪都多多少少地有些控制不住。送行，挥手，看着他们步入机场 -但是这些远比不上他们真的离去，而我却下意识地又朝楼上走去?隔着窗户看着空荡荡的房间时，才知道费老师再也不会用他的大手托着Kevin牵着壮壮走在我们身边了；那种心理空空的感觉，竟然没有言辞可以形容。
8fe385df80315e04c3252a2a78af080378c67024.translatedText: Two years is not a long time, nor is it a short time. When Teacher Fei and his family really packed their bags and started preparing to return to China, we were still happily talking about the future. But when the moment of departure really comes, we can only suppress our sadness, and all the ladies can't control their tears to a certain extent. Seeing them off, waving, and watching them walk into the airport - but these are far less than when they really left, but I subconsciously walked upstairs again? When I looked at the empty room through the window, I realized that Teacher Fei would no longer hold Kevin and Zhuangzhuang with his big hands and walk beside us; there are no words to describe the feeling of psychological emptiness.

8ad9dd372c600f468200c2ab2613243ce11af285.sourceText: 那一刻都已过去。在这一刻。我在电脑前，絮絮叨叨如老太太一样，不知所云地说着一些事情。事情是关于一个名叫费老师的人，一个和我相处短短两年的人，一个君子之交淡如水的朋友，更是一个我永远的家人。和有些亘古不变的事物相比，生命也许本来短暂，就如风雨中的火苗，扑扑闪闪，不知何时就会熄灭。佛家谈到肉体的生命，不过是一幅皮囊；但是皮囊不具，魂归何处？这一刻的费老师，与我们已天人相隔，再见面也许不知是不是下个生死的轮回。如果那一刻我和他还记得前世，我会告诉他，春霞，壮壮，Kevin，我们一家，他的老师们，他的学生们，还有这个世界上星星点点无数的人无数还燃着的火苗，都很想他。
8ad9dd372c600f468200c2ab2613243ce11af285.translatedText: That moment has passed. at this moment. I was in front of the computer, babbling like an old lady, talking about something incomprehensible. The story is about a person named Teacher Fei, a person who has been with me for just two years, a friend who is as close as a gentleman to me, and a person who is my forever family. Compared with some eternal things, life may be short-lived, just like a flame in the wind and rain, flickering and extinguishing without knowing when. Buddhism talks about physical life, which is nothing more than a skin; but without the skin, where does the soul go? At this moment, Teacher Fei is separated from us by nature. If we meet again, we may not know whether it will be the next reincarnation of life and death. If he and I could still remember our past lives at that moment, I would tell him that Chunxia, ​​Zhuangzhuang, Kevin, our family, his teachers, his students, and countless people in this world who still have their flames burning, all miss him very much.

803cd59674ec7fa06e52a3fe170bb0ff0722b97d.sourceText: 星抛满野夜无终， 烧酒噎喉凉如冻。 隔江掷杯泪成瀑， 对岸当歌舟已空。
803cd59674ec7fa06e52a3fe170bb0ff0722b97d.translatedText: The wild night is filled with stars, and the soju is as cold as the throat. Throwing cups across the river makes a waterfall of tears, while the singing boat on the other side is empty.

38a379eb9d197bf7ddfe346d2958450e928dbeb8.sourceText: 凤凰城 凤鸣 4月18日是受难节，4月20日是耶稣复活节，这期间全世界所有的基督徒都浸沉在纪念和欢乐中。凤凰城华人基督教会，在这期间举行了一系列的纪念活动。从4月18日星期五晚上开始，晚7:30pm受难节圣餐崇拜，4月20日主日上午6:30am-7:30am晨曦礼拜，7:30am-8:30am洗礼崇拜，感谢主有28位肢体在晨曦礼拜中受洗，教会与他们同庆这重生喜乐的日子。在上午9:30am和11:15am分别有两场复活节神剧崇拜，在主日各项聚会均为中英文联合聚会，神剧选曲”各各他之爱”。
38a379eb9d197bf7ddfe346d2958450e928dbeb8.translatedText: Phoenix Fengming April 18th is Good Friday and April 20th is Easter. During this period, all Christians around the world are immersed in commemoration and joy. The Phoenix Chinese Christian Church held a series of commemorative activities during this period. Starting from the evening of Friday, April 18, there will be a Good Friday Eucharist service at 7:30 pm, a morning service from 6:30am-7:30am on Sunday, April 20, and a baptismal service from 7:30am-8:30am. Thank the Lord that 28 members were baptized in the morning service. The church celebrates this joyful day of rebirth with them. There are two Easter Divine Drama services at 9:30am and 11:15am respectively. On the Lord's Day, all services are joint Chinese and English services. The Divine Drama's song "Calvary Love" is selected.

1fa5bd66f0578c06d2959cf34eb94b3b2bb2f47b.sourceText: 我们选择参加第一场复活节主日联合崇拜，自以为到的很早，可是一进停车场，发现停车场已停满了车，找到一靠边靠后的一个空位，停下车急急忙忙一边与熟人打着召呼，一边快步赶往教会崇拜中心，还好在中间找到位子坐下来，台上乐队已错落有绪的就坐，一会的功夫再回头往后看，已是宾朋满座、座无虚席。 9:30am准时开始，由刘牧师和李牧师共同主持联合崇拜开始，祝祷，会众以”欢欣，主为君王”圣诗一起颂赞神，更在乐队伴奏下洪亮高亢的歌声，充满整个大厅，会众以饱满的激情来敬拜伟大、慈爱、怜悯的神！接下来，教会诗班的神剧选曲”各各他之爱”唱响。合唱队和乐队在刘英淑姊妹的指挥下，从”全能真神，永活慈爱全能真神”选曲开始至”主复活，爱的救赎已完成”一连唱了十一首选曲，合唱队在乐队的伴奏下，曲曲都唱出基督徒敬仰主、爱主的心声，感谢他（她）们为敬拜神，精心准备所付出的辛劳！
1fa5bd66f0578c06d2959cf34eb94b3b2bb2f47b.translatedText: We chose to attend the first Easter Sunday joint worship service. We thought we arrived very early, but as soon as we entered the parking lot, we found that the parking lot was full of cars. We found an empty seat near the side and parked. The car hurriedly greeted acquaintances and hurried to the church worship center. Fortunately, I found a seat in the middle and sat down. The band on the stage was already seated in an orderly manner. After a while, I looked back and saw that the seats were full of guests and friends. It started on time at 9:30am. Pastor Liu and Pastor Li co-hosted the joint worship service. They prayed and the congregation praised God together with the hymn "Rejoice, the Lord is King". The loud and high-pitched singing accompanied by the band filled the entire hall. The congregation worshiped the great, loving and merciful God with full passion! Next, the church choir sang the oratorio "Calvary Love". Under the command of Sister Liu Yingshu, the choir and band sang eleven selected songs starting from the selection of "Almighty True God, the Eternally Loving and Loving Almighty True God" to "The Lord is Resurrected, the Redemption of Love Has Been Completed". Accompanied by the band, the choir sang the voices of Christians who admire and love the Lord. They thanked them (her) for their hard work in worshiping God and preparing carefully!

e80f7abb8075f1fcb21e3111d90279c9a530678d.sourceText: 接下来杨光甫牧师有一个生动、感人的讲道，题目是：”永活的爱”。杨牧师先说出一般人都信奉的真理，那就是”死人不能救人”，但他又列出七大证据，证明主耶稣战胜死亡而复活，现在全世界12亿基督徒在今天纪念主的复活。1)空坟墓(Empty Tomb) ；2)超过500多见证人(500+ Witnesses)；3)门徒的改变(Disciples’ Change)；4)教会的成立(Church Established)，15000人信主，相信主复活；5)新约圣经( New Testament) ；6)罗马政权和犾太教领袖(Oppositions)，他们是置耶稣于死地，但他们不能反对耶稣复活的事实；7)历世历代基督徒的见证(Christians in ages) ，这些是不可反驳和抹灭的证据，带给人末大的力量。因耶稣永远活着，他的爱永远不变，使人们从三个方面可以明白：1）他已为我们的罪担负刑罚，永远赦免我们，2）一直不停地为我们祷告，3）永远与我们同在，无伦我们到那里，主的爱永远伴随着我们。他赐智慧给我们，使我们不惧怕、不担心，有生命、有力量、有盼望，主的爱是永远活泼的爱！最后，众人在交响乐团的伴奏下高唱”因他活着”，圆满的结束复活节的圣乐崇拜。 走出大堂，心灵中充满喜乐，这堂复活节主日联合崇拜，不但听到看到美妙的诗歌、各各他神剧，在视觉和听觉上得到满足，更得到灵性上的喂养，教会杨光甫牧师的讲道，总可使人口服心服，得到极大帮助和提升，在此提醒诸位尊敬的读者，星期天一定要拨出时间，到凤凰城华人基督教会来，卸下一切重担，放下一切缠绕，带着一家人，坐在大堂听牧师讲道，无伦是哪位牧师讲道，都可以净化你的心灵，听到世上最好的信息，领受那上好的礼物和福份。凤凤凰城华人基督教会，时刻欢迎大家光临，一起赞美、敬拜神！
e80f7abb8075f1fcb21e3111d90279c9a530678d.translatedText: Next, Pastor Yang Guangfu gave a vivid and touching sermon titled: "Eternal Love". Pastor Yang first stated the truth that most people believe, that is, "the dead cannot save others." But he also listed seven pieces of evidence to prove that the Lord Jesus defeated death and resurrected. Now 1.2 billion Christians around the world commemorate the Lord's resurrection today. 1) Empty Tomb; 2) More than 500 witnesses (500+ Witnesses); 3) Disciples’ Change; 4) Church Established, 15,000 people believed in the Lord and believed in the Lord’s resurrection; 5) New Testament (New Testament) ; 6) The Roman regime and the leaders of the Titanic Church (Oppositions), they put Jesus to death, but they could not oppose the fact of Jesus' resurrection; 7) The testimonies of Christians throughout the ages (Christians in ages), these are irrefutable and obliterable evidence, which bring the greatest power to people. Because Jesus lives forever, his love never changes, so people can understand it from three aspects: 1) He has borne the penalty for our sins and forgives us forever, 2) He has been praying for us all the time, 3) He is always with us, no matter where we go, the love of the Lord will always be with us. He gives us wisdom so that we are not afraid or worried, but have life, strength, and hope. The Lord’s love is an ever-living love! Finally, everyone sang "Because He Lives" accompanied by the symphony orchestra, successfully ending the Easter sacred music worship. Walking out of the lobby, my heart is filled with joy. In this joint Easter Sunday worship service, I not only heard and saw beautiful hymns and the Calvary drama, but also received visual and auditory satisfaction. I also received spiritual nourishment. The sermons of Pastor Yang Guangfu of the church can always make people convinced and receive great help and promotion. I would like to remind everyone Dear readers, be sure to set aside time on Sunday to come to Phoenix Chinese Christian Church, let go of all burdens, let go of all entanglements, take your family, sit in the lobby and listen to the pastor’s sermon. No matter which pastor is preaching, you can purify your heart, hear the best information in the world, and receive the best gifts and blessings. Fenghuang Chinese Christian Church welcomes everyone to come and praise and worship God together!

b80614b284e4e51fb6cab43c5250f01fcb280d17.sourceText: 经济不景气导致虐童案剧增 经济不景气，给本地儿童带来的影响不仅仅是少了玩具，少了出门度假。专家发现，越来越多的虐待儿童案家庭与财务困难有直接关系。 莫拉莫坦西丽每天尽可能多花时间与她心爱的儿子，埃文，在一起。作为一个单身母亲，实属不易。 ” 很难，因为所有的费用” 莫坦西丽说。 ” 我要为他买东西，支付水电费，购买自己所需，一切都需要钱。” 10 岁的艾米和 6 岁的雅各布布就是死于虐待儿童。尽管具体原因尚在调查，但从儿童保护服务和执法机关记录显示，全国儿童受虐案，与父母经济困境有直接链接。父母经济压力大时，孩子的吵闹声加剧了暴力的爆发。 全国许多医院接受的虐童案病人增加了 20% 至 30% ，同时，社工处理的个案也增加了两倍。 凤凰城警方正试图提供帮助，家长可拨打 ChildHelp 热线得到心理调解。警方呼吁有问题的家庭，无论如何，控制自己情绪，不要对他人身体造成伤害。
b80614b284e4e51fb6cab43c5250f01fcb280d17.translatedText: The economic downturn has led to a sharp increase in child abuse cases. The impact of the economic downturn on local children is not only the lack of toys and the lack of vacations. Experts have found a direct link between the growing number of child abuse cases among families and financial difficulties. Maura Motensili spends as much time as possible every day with her beloved son, Evan. Being a single mother is not easy. "It's hard because of all the expenses," Motensili said. "I have to buy things for him, pay utility bills, buy what I need, everything requires money." Amy, 10, and Jacob, 6, died of child abuse. Although the specific causes are still under investigation, records from child protective services and law enforcement agencies show that child abuse cases across the country are directly linked to parents' financial difficulties. When parents are under financial stress, violent outbursts are exacerbated by children's loud noises. Many hospitals across the country are seeing a 20 to 30 percent increase in child abuse patients, while social workers are also seeing a tripling of their caseloads. Phoenix police are trying to help, and parents can call the ChildHelp hotline for counseling. The police appeal to families with problems, no matter what, to control their emotions and not cause physical harm to others.

bec451719b628593b12bc4e5ce4f4ba15e8d0c6e.sourceText: 晚上这几种食物最好不要吃，损害你的健康！
bec451719b628593b12bc4e5ce4f4ba15e8d0c6e.translatedText: It is best not to eat these kinds of foods at night, as they will harm your health!

7fa6511de5831c16d4d141a5508d5c379707b556.sourceText: 晚上这几种食物最好不要吃，损害你的健康！ 现在生活节奏快，很多人只有在晚上才能吃点好的，高蛋白，高热量摄入，长…
7fa6511de5831c16d4d141a5508d5c379707b556.translatedText: It is best not to eat these foods at night, as they may harm your health! Today’s life is fast-paced, and many people can only eat good, high-protein, high-calorie intake at night...

cdf874c4a6c6c8d64c033989981a44dc6aeb855d.sourceText: 现在生活节奏快，很多人只有在晚上才能吃点好的，高蛋白，高热量摄入，长期这样会严重影响你的健康，有几种食物晚上最好不要碰，今天跟大家说一说~
cdf874c4a6c6c8d64c033989981a44dc6aeb855d.translatedText: Nowadays, life is fast-paced, and many people can only eat good, high-protein, high-calorie intake at night. This will seriously affect your health in the long run. There are several foods that are best not to be touched at night. Let me tell you about them today~

1fd8acd7c17e39af80882a6668e0a27831cad7ac.sourceText: 老话说”早上吃姜，胜过吃参汤;晚上吃姜，等于吃砒霜。”是有道理的。
1fd8acd7c17e39af80882a6668e0a27831cad7ac.translatedText: >The old saying "Eating ginger in the morning is better than eating ginseng soup; eating ginger at night is equivalent to eating arsenic." It makes sense.

e7001709c35da161ca5eae006bdbdd6bbf4937ec.sourceText: 生姜味辛性温，含有挥发油、姜辣素、树脂及淀粉等。姜能增强和加速血液回圈，刺激胃液分泌，兴奋肠胃，促进消化，还有抗菌作用。
e7001709c35da161ca5eae006bdbdd6bbf4937ec.translatedText: Ginger is pungent and warm in nature, and contains volatile oil, gingerol, resin and starch. Ginger can enhance and accelerate blood circulation, stimulate gastric juice secretion, stimulate the intestines and stomach, promote digestion, and has antibacterial effects.

0d7838d059a069ddd451e7d19639965ec7e4c5de.sourceText: 早上吃一点姜，有利于阳气升发，对健康有利。但晚上吃，因为姜本来属热，会让人上火，劳命伤身，所以不宜吃。
0d7838d059a069ddd451e7d19639965ec7e4c5de.translatedText: Eating a little ginger in the morning is beneficial to the rise of Yang Qi and is good for health. But eating it at night is not advisable because ginger is inherently hot and can make people suffer from internal heat and cause fatigue and harm to the body.

c8ea73dc10aa2d5cfb788eacfffed33742a02c4d.sourceText: 榴莲所含成分中，有2/3是糖。对于血糖高、有高血压或者低血压、心功能不佳、胃肠道溃疡的人来说，吃榴莲仍需谨慎。
c8ea73dc10aa2d5cfb788eacfffed33742a02c4d.translatedText: 2/3 of the ingredients contained in durian are sugar. For people with high blood sugar, high blood pressure or hypotension, poor heart function, and gastrointestinal ulcers, they still need to be cautious when eating durian.

2e3c63078c99bc50fe666cfa3b7ea7a3dc2f9f41.sourceText: 最好能减饭量再吃榴莲，以免摄入热量超标，加重原有疾病。
2e3c63078c99bc50fe666cfa3b7ea7a3dc2f9f41.translatedText: It is best to reduce your meal intake before eating durian to avoid excessive calorie intake and aggravating existing diseases.

1b20304e51df348f65ad3094bfa9fed513a8a2d7.sourceText: 辣椒所含的辣椒碱等刺激性物质会通过刺激人体舌尖，进而刺激大脑中枢神经和身体各部分的神经末梢，导致心跳加快、体温上升和较长时间的兴奋感；同时，辣椒、花椒、胡椒、大蒜、生姜等食材对肠胃的刺激也很大，并易造成胃有灼烧感；此外，辛辣食物在消化过程中会消耗掉体内的促睡眠介质。这些都是影响睡眠的重要原因。
1b20304e51df348f65ad3094bfa9fed513a8a2d7.translatedText: > The capsaicin and other irritating substances contained in peppers will stimulate the tip of the human tongue, thereby stimulating the central nerves of the brain and nerve endings in various parts of the body, causing the heartbeat to accelerate, the body temperature to rise and a longer period of excitement; at the same time, hot peppers, peppers, peppers, garlic, ginger and other ingredients are also very irritating to the gastrointestinal tract and can easily cause a burning sensation in the stomach; in addition, spicy food will consume sleep-promoting mediators in the body during the digestion process. These are all important reasons that affect sleep.

503a04f7ae18cb7351910b00f20a36ed26e66c2d.sourceText: 美亚裔学生被指怕事常被霸凌 华裔吁勇敢保护自己 美国阿罕布拉学区华裔教委甄铭新表示，一个学生长时间、重复地暴露在一个或多个学生主导的欺负或骚扰行为之中，就是被”霸凌”了。他呼吁亚裔学生要勇敢地保护自己。 据美国《侨报》报道，学生若不能生活在安全、无忧的校园环境中，就无法健康成长。全社会都有责任为下一代建立一个没有”校园霸凌”的环境。美国阿罕布拉学区华裔教委甄铭新表示，一个学生长时间、重复地暴露在一个或多个学生主导的欺负或骚扰行为之中，就是被”霸凌”了。他呼吁亚裔学生要勇敢地保护自己。 一个学生要如何判断自己是否被”校园霸凌”了？阿罕布拉学区”通向成功之路”(GATE WAY TO SUCCESS)工作小组表示，”校园霸凌”是指孩子们之间的欺凌与压迫，它一直长期存在校园中，包括肢体或言语的攻击、人际互动中的抗拒及排挤等等。霸凌行为使被霸凌者在身体、心理、社会适应中(一项或一项以上)受到伤害。 ”通向成功之路”发言人冬妮娅表示，”校园霸凌”成为许多孩子中途休学的重要原因。学区将定期举办如何预防霸凌讨论会，正面应对此问题。亚太裔学生遭霸凌的比例偏高，是由于亚裔学生往往会怕事，不向师长报告，同时身材瘦小也是其中一个原因。 因此，在这个计划实施2年以来，学区特别重视亚裔学生，不但鼓励他们勇敢面对，也特别为他们提供了包括中文在内的多种语言的辅导员，让他们可以更好地与家长及学生沟通。 甄铭新表示，他作为”通向成功之路”工作小组的一分子，将协助学区建立一个更加安全的校园。他认为，学生若不能生活在安全、无忧的校园环境中，就无法健康成长、安心学习。全社会都有责任为下一代建立一个”无霸凌”的校园环境。 甄铭新呼吁亚裔学生要勇敢地寻求帮助，让自己在安全的环境下成长。
503a04f7ae18cb7351910b00f20a36ed26e66c2d.translatedText: Asian-American students are accused of being afraid of things and are often bullied. Chinese-Americans are urged to be brave and protect themselves. Zhen Mingxin, the Chinese-American education committee member of the Alhambra School District in the United States, said that a student who is exposed to bullying or harassment led by one or more students for a long time and repeatedly has been "bullied." He called on Asian students to be brave and protect themselves. According to the American "Qiao Bao" report, if students cannot live in a safe and worry-free campus environment, they will not be able to grow up healthily. The whole society has the responsibility to create an environment free of "school bullying" for the next generation. Zhen Mingxin, the Chinese education committee member of the Alhambra School District in the United States, said that a student who is exposed to bullying or harassment led by one or more students for a long time and repeatedly is "bullied". He called on Asian students to be brave and protect themselves. How can a student determine whether he or she is being bullied on campus? The Alhambra School District's "GATE WAY TO SUCCESS" working group stated that "school bullying" refers to bullying and oppression among children. It has existed in schools for a long time, including physical or verbal attacks, resistance and exclusion in interpersonal interactions, etc. Bullying causes the bullied to be harmed in one or more aspects of physical, psychological, and social adaptation. "Road to Success" spokesperson Tonya said that "school bullying" has become an important reason for many children to drop out of school. The school district will hold regular bullying prevention seminars to address the issue head-on. The rate of bullying among Asian and Pacific Islander students is relatively high. This is because Asian students are often afraid of getting into trouble and do not report it to their teachers. Their thin stature is also one of the reasons. Therefore, in the two years since this plan was implemented, the school district has paid special attention to Asian students. It not only encourages them to face the problem bravely, but also provides them with counselors in multiple languages, including Chinese, so that they can better communicate with parents and students. Zhen Mingxin said that as a member of the "Road to Success" working group, he will assist the school district in building a safer campus. He believes that if students cannot live in a safe and worry-free campus environment, they will not be able to grow up healthily and study with peace of mind. The whole society has the responsibility to establish a "bullying-free" campus environment for the next generation. Zhen Mingxin called on Asian students to be brave enough to seek help so that they can grow up in a safe environment.

ff0eab54108cbb983ce6794b76a19a9b56767c63.sourceText: 母亲节特别策划：妈妈对我的美国式教育法
ff0eab54108cbb983ce6794b76a19a9b56767c63.translatedText: Special Mother's Day plan: My mother's American education method for me

0c8b269a6d6d790e59a1dd6c9837eb14a92d04df.sourceText: 母亲节特别策划：妈妈对我的美国式教育法 凤凰城 李哲 我几十年来常宣称我父母一直不怎么管我。我以为这原因之…
0c8b269a6d6d790e59a1dd6c9837eb14a92d04df.translatedText: Mother's Day special plan: My mother's American education method for me Phoenix City Li Zhe I have often claimed that my parents have not cared much about me for decades. I think this is the reason...

cde5a12a784bc475bb1e4541118cd6cf8cafde97.sourceText: 我几十年来常宣称我父母一直不怎么管我。我以为这原因之一是我自动守规矩，之二是他们忙。最近一些事让我有了新发现：原来他们采用的碰巧是美国方法。
cde5a12a784bc475bb1e4541118cd6cf8cafde97.translatedText: I have often claimed that my parents have never cared about me for decades. I think one reason is that I automatically obey the rules, and the other reason is that they are busy. Something happened recently that made me discover something new: It turns out that they happened to use American methods.

10f8c48f3c0eb31f177d234db1358697be6caa4d.sourceText: 这几年，尤其是这个月，有些小事让我回忆起我少年时代最好的朋友。我和他见面的时间并不太多，但和他的交往对我的成长帮助很大。不仅我从他身上看到了人生更多的光明，至今我还常把他当成做人的楷模。
10f8c48f3c0eb31f177d234db1358697be6caa4d.translatedText: In the past few years, especially this month, some small things have reminded me of my best friend in my teenage years. I didn't get to meet him much, but my interactions with him helped me grow a lot. Not only did I see more light in life from him, I still regard him as a role model to this day.

017485d911c151fb2d4cc8b1b9ec34a350d81c03.sourceText: 我和他之间友谊的发展是和我妈妈分不开的。我妈妈极少干涉我和朋友们的关系，但我记得她很多次评论我的朋友们。她只很赞赏这个最好的朋友，所以我出门或回家晚的原因往往是和他一起。
017485d911c151fb2d4cc8b1b9ec34a350d81c03.translatedText: The development of my friendship with him is inseparable from my mother. My mother rarely interfered in my relationships with my friends, but I remember her commenting on my friends many times. She only admired this best friend, so the reason why I went out or came home late was often because I was with him.

5274a1fb2e481f167adaff4684f7c8193e564bf9.sourceText: 我妈妈这种方法明显不是传统的家长式。我称它为美国式是因为它和美国的国父们的思路很近。他们的着眼点都主要放在自己管不了以后。他们都不迷信自己的主义或思想，所以不用任何教条来进行洗脑。他们都选好长远可以依靠的力量，然后树立这力量的影响力。这是种务实的方法，不是沽名钓誉为自己树碑立传的方法。这是前人栽树为后人乘凉的方法，不是为自己谋利益的方法。虽然他们生前得到的利益相当有限，但他们得到了后人真心的爱戴，远超出三七开或四六开。他们是最可爱的人！
5274a1fb2e481f167adaff4684f7c8193e564bf9.translatedText: My mother's method is obviously not traditional paternalism. I call it American because it is very close to the thinking of the founding fathers of the United States. Their focus is mainly on the future that they cannot control. They are not superstitious about their own doctrines or ideas, so they do not use any dogma to brainwash them. They all choose the power they can rely on in the long run, and then establish the influence of this power. This is a pragmatic approach, not a way to build a reputation and build a reputation for oneself. This is a way for the ancestors to plant trees to provide shade for future generations, not for their own benefit. Although the benefits they received during their lifetime were quite limited, they received sincere love from future generations, far more than 37 or 46. They are the cutest people!

57a760f90527087c70f928f4e6229ec9c957d127.sourceText: 他们客观上是不是真最可爱并不重要。重要的是对他们的爱戴给我的人生带来了更多光明。重要的是我可以把他们当我做人的楷模。重要的是我明白了如何对待我女儿，如何赢得她长久的爱，如何对她的未来充满信心。
57a760f90527087c70f928f4e6229ec9c957d127.translatedText: It doesn't matter whether they are objectively the cutest. The important thing is that my love for them brings more light to my life. The important thing is that I can regard them as my role models. What's important is that I learned how to treat my daughter, how to win her lasting love, and how to have confidence in her future.

fb9587678ca39ad5b76b577b6073d3e780316493.sourceText: 做这种最可爱的人也难也不难。一要谦虚，二要乐观。能看到别人的长处并知道自己有短处，就能谦虚。不怕临时的挫折，就能乐观。有了这两条，在给别人”做嫁衣裳”时权力再大也记住自己不是主角，就差不多了。权力再大也记得自己”为人民服务”的责任，不容易，至少不能别人想要的东西自己也都想要…..
fb9587678ca39ad5b76b577b6073d3e780316493.translatedText: It is not difficult to be the cutest person like this. First, we must be humble, and second, we must be optimistic. Being able to see the strengths in others and knowing your own weaknesses leads to humility. If you are not afraid of temporary setbacks, you can be optimistic. With these two items in mind, when "making wedding clothes" for others, no matter how powerful you are, remember that you are not the protagonist, that's about it. No matter how powerful you are, it is not easy to remember your responsibility to "serve the people". At least you cannot want everything others want...

c31b7680692adab50fd41298997bfbacee14a038.sourceText: 本州邝添权(佳叔)获亲情中华春节晚会《全家福》照片征集二等奖 【亚省时报讯】 亲情中华春节晚会《全家福》照片征集活动颁奖仪式日前在上海举行。加拿大《七天》杂志推荐的海外游子陈国飞获一等奖；本报推荐的凤凰城侨领、本报专栏作家邝添权和南京师范大学副教授、印尼归侨李毓铎两名获二等奖；另有100名海内外华人获优秀作品奖, 其中有旅居加拿大點民頓, 本報特約作家方秀儒。本次颁奖仪式由亲情中华春节晚会的承办单位之一华侨传媒主办。华侨传媒董事长刘蔚、副总经理王丽梅以及澳大利亚新州多元文化广播电台总经理周以太担任了颁奖嘉宾。本报副社长甄凯婴受委托，代表邝添权和《亚省时报》领奖。 本次有奖征集活动得到国内各省市侨联、海内外多家媒体以及广大华侨华人的参与和支持，征集到的照片达数千张，获奖作品由中国摄影协会专家组成的评审团选出，极具意义。 邝添权先生，祖籍广东台山县，1948年移民来美，曾入伍美国国民自卫队参加韩战。退伍后返回香港与朱玉英女士结婚，婚后在本州旗杆埠經營多間餐馆，邝先生为人仗义豪爽，素有旗杆埠”唐人市长”之称。 邝氏夫妇于三十年前移居鳳凰城，开设当时本州著名的中餐馆”中华楼”，十年前, 他才退休。 邝先生退休後，平时爱打麻将娱乐以筆名”佳叔”本报开始《麻将经》专栏，后又有《佳叔漫談》、《鳳凰城人語》、《餐館生意經》等专栏，深受读者欢迎，被乩為亚省华文笔会副会长。 邝氏夫妇育有子女五人，个个学业有成，事业成功，家庭美满，如今儿孙满堂。 邝添权伉俪多年来热心公益，本地慈善从不落后于人，还关心祖国建设，对远在故乡台山的父老乡亲甚为关心，除捐钱捐物外，得他俩资助到美的乡亲不仅其数。为此，在凤凰城得到极佳人缘。 主办单位为表彰本报在此次活动中的精诚合作，特授予《亚省时报》奖状，以示鼓励。华侨传媒董事长刘蔚先生说，本次征集活动得到众多海外华人传媒的支持，獲得成功，2013年的”亲情中华春节晚会”正在筹备中，《全家福》照片征集活动将继续进行。待方案落实后，即向全球华人华侨家庭发出征集邀请，欢迎大家参与。 代邝添权领奖照片 左起华侨传媒董事长刘蔚，本报副社长甄凯婴，澳大利亚新州多元文化广播电台总经理周以太，华侨传媒副总经理王丽梅 佳叔夫妇
c31b7680692adab50fd41298997bfbacee14a038.translatedText: Honzhou Kuang Tianquan (Uncle Jia) won the second prize in the Family Chinese New Year Gala "Family Portrait" photo collection [Alberta Times News] The award ceremony for the Family Chinese Spring Festival Gala "Family Portrait" photo collection was held in Shanghai a few days ago. Chen Guofei, an overseas traveler recommended by Canada's "Seven Days" magazine, won the first prize; Kuang Tianquan, an overseas Chinese leader from Phoenix and our columnist recommended by this newspaper, and Li Yuduo, an associate professor at Nanjing Normal University and a returned Indonesian overseas Chinese, won the second prize; another 100 Chinese at home and abroad won the outstanding work award, including Fang Xiuru, a special writer of this newspaper who lives in Dianminton, Canada. This award ceremony was hosted by Overseas Chinese Media, one of the organizers of the Family China Spring Festival Gala. Liu Wei, Chairman of Overseas Chinese Media, Wang Limei, Deputy General Manager, and Zhou Yitai, General Manager of Australia's New South Wales Multicultural Radio Station, served as award guests. Zhen Kaiying, the deputy president of this newspaper, was entrusted to receive the award on behalf of Tim Kuang and the "Alberta Times". This award-winning collection activity has received the participation and support of the Overseas Chinese Federation of all provinces and cities in China, many media at home and abroad, and the vast number of overseas Chinese. Thousands of photos were collected. The winning photos were selected by a jury composed of experts from the China Photography Association, which is of great significance. Mr. Kuang Tianquan was originally from Taishan County, Guangdong. He immigrated to the United States in 1948 and enlisted in the U.S. National Guard to participate in the Korean War. After retiring from the army, he returned to Hong Kong and married Ms. Zhu Yuying. After his marriage, he ran many restaurants in Flagstaff Port, Honshu. Mr. Kwong was a generous and generous man and was known as the "Tang Mayor" of Flagstaff Port. The Kwong couple moved to Phoenix thirty years ago and opened the famous Chinese restaurant "China House" in the state at the time. He retired only ten years ago. After Mr. Kuang retired, he loved to play mahjong for entertainment. He started the "Mahjong Sutra" column in this newspaper under the pen name "Jia Shu". Later, there were "Jia Shu's Ramblings", "Phoenix People's Talk", "Restaurant Business" and other columns. It was very popular among readers and he was named the vice president of the Chinese PEN Association of Alberta. Mr. and Mrs. Kwong have five children, all of whom have achieved academic success, successful careers, and happy families. Today, they are full of children and grandchildren. Mr. and Mrs. Kwong Tianquan have been enthusiastic about public welfare for many years. They have never lagged behind others in local charity. They also care about the construction of the motherland and are very concerned about their fellow villagers in Taishan, their hometown. In addition to donating money and materials, they have supported many fellow villagers in the United States. For this reason, he gained great popularity in Phoenix. In recognition of this newspaper's sincere cooperation in this event, the organizer awarded the "Alberta Times" a certificate as a token of encouragement. Mr. Liu Wei, chairman of Overseas Chinese Media, said that this solicitation event has received support from many overseas Chinese media and has been successful. The 2013 "Family Chinese New Year Gala" is being prepared, and the "Family Portrait" photo solicitation event will continue. Once the plan is implemented, a collection invitation will be sent to overseas Chinese families around the world, and everyone is welcome to participate. Photos of receiving the award on behalf of Kwong Tim Quan. From left, Chairman of Overseas Chinese Media Liu Wei, Vice President of this newspaper Zhen Kaiying, General Manager of Australian New South Wales Multicultural Radio Zhou Yitai, Deputy General Manager of Overseas Chinese Media Wang Limei, Mr. and Mrs. Jia Shu

b25cc6d199869a5c387a64008940cb886d85f549.sourceText: “水立方杯”中文歌曲大赛亚利桑那赛区比赛综述(图) 【亚利桑那赛区组委会来稿】 中国国务院侨办、北京市侨办、中华全国青年联合会联合主办的2011年”水立方杯”海外华裔青少年中文歌曲大赛亚利桑那赛区比赛于近日顺利告一阶段。 本赛区16位选手获裁判组颁发的”’水立方杯’亚利桑那赛区2011年优秀歌手奖”。裁判组的五位裁判将签署奖状颁发给获奖选手。北京”水立方杯”组委会将颁发证书给16位选手。 本赛区胜出的四位选手将用DVD参加全美大赛的决赛，以便推选出参加北京”水立方杯”海外青少年中文歌曲大赛的选手。 本赛区的比赛选手的出生地有美国、中国、英国和沙特阿拉伯；民族有满族、汉族和回族；年龄段为14岁至26岁。有一家姐妹三人来参加比赛，令人赞叹。还有一位新墨西哥州的学生因该州未设赛区，托她的家长及朋友多方联系加入到本州来参赛。参赛选手中有一位为男生。 这次亚利桑那赛区的参赛人数远高于美国其它赛区，这全靠各方面的积极参与和大力支持。本州的四所中文学校起了关键的作用。图桑祖筍中文学校的雷宏校长在得到比赛消息后，不仅很快将消息通过中文学校的网站以及《图桑华人联络通讯》的渠道发布给图桑的华人社区，还自费把海报印在学校结业典礼的节目单后面，保证每一个家长都能得到通知；他在第一时间电话联系上即将登机回中国的图桑国语教会中文学校刘东校长，因此刘校长作为组委会成员很快将比赛消息发往学校，并且该校也很快推荐了比赛裁判王桂仙老师。现代中文学校在这次比赛发挥了很重要的作用，前任校长魏艺接到比赛消息后，与前任董事长李光煊立即将消息发到全校；现任校长贺春晓得到比赛消息后，很快决定由该校副校长朱岩作为该校协调人进入比赛组委会；该校很快推荐了王楠作为该校的裁判；朱岩副校长是本赛区组委会的主席，她不仅几次通过电子邮件发布比赛消息，而且逐个打电话给该校中文AP班和中文12年级的学生，鼓励学生报名参赛。希望中文学校新一届董事会正副董事长郑铁渝和黄双双得知比赛消息后，立即选派董事会成员谢明进入比赛组委会；谢明不仅很快联系了该校的李国华担任裁判，并且专门打电话联系该校的学生和已毕业的学生报名参赛。组委会的成员、全美中文学校协会副会长帅致若则作为这次比赛的协调人负责与全美大赛组委会进行联系以及本地报刊的宣传。 为了通过此活动更好地传唱中文歌曲，裁判组通过发电子邮件和登报的方式向青少年推荐内容健康，旋律优美的歌曲。广为人知的歌曲”妈呀中国”的作曲者李国华裁判很快选定了十多首歌曲的网上链接；图桑地区的裁判陈益老师也推荐了近十首不同年代，不同曲风，不同唱法的歌曲；组委会的谢明则整理成文送去报社向青少年推荐。 为鼓励青少年参赛，本州赛区此次比赛免收报名费。不仅裁判组和组委会成员乐于为比赛出力，本州社区其它机构和热心人士也为这次比赛义务服务。前侨联主席方慧贤女士及时用电子邮件回答了一些青少年关于此次比赛的询问；她帮助新墨西哥州的学生联系本州组委会；还负责接收邮寄来的参赛录影带。”欣欣超市”的员工帮助接收选手送交的录影带。特别是”八月恋歌”的店主高小姐，不仅免费为11名参赛选手录像，而且为比赛评分活动提供了场地。还值得一提的是有位家长急需歌曲的伴奏乐，但苦于无处可寻。高小姐得知以后利用歌厅的资源以最快的速度解决了这个难题。 本州的”亚省时报”，”亚美报”，”美西侨报”，”太阳鸟” 以及”图桑华人联络通讯”等各华人网站免费为这次活动多次作了宣传报道。 在上周六6月4日评分当天，裁判们从上午10点连续工作到下午2点才用午餐。特别是图桑的两位裁判陈益老师和王桂仙老师，由组委会主席雷宏校长开车很早就出发，按时来到凤凰城。组委会成员朱岩、雷宏、谢明、帅致若当天全程参加了评分活动，并及时解决了比赛中的问题，大家协调配合，努力认真，终于使比赛工作顺利完成。 组委会成员和裁判们初步商定，将配合8月8日大赛优胜者与歌唱明星在”水立方”的演出，请本州参赛歌手们聚会搞一个庆祝活动。 为此， 亚利桑那赛区组委会向所有参赛青少年和支持的家长们表示感谢，向四所中文学校的领导表示感谢，向本州社区的有关机构和热心人士表示感谢，期待大家共同努力，为我们的华裔青少年后代健康的成长而继续奉献。 照片 – 比赛评分结束后工作人员合影
b25cc6d199869a5c387a64008940cb886d85f549.translatedText: "Water Cube Cup" Chinese Song Contest Arizona Division Competition Summary (Picture) [Contribution from the Arizona Division Organizing Committee] The 2011 "Water Cube Cup" Overseas Chinese Youth Chinese Song Contest Arizona Division, jointly sponsored by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council of China, the Beijing Overseas Chinese Affairs Office, and the All-China Youth Federation, has successfully concluded recently. 16 contestants from this division were awarded the "Water Cube Cup" Arizona Division 2011 Outstanding Singer Award" by the judging panel. The five judges on the judging panel will sign certificates and award them to the winning players. The Beijing "Water Cube Cup" organizing committee will issue certificates to 16 contestants. The four winning contestants from this division will use DVDs to participate in the finals of the national competition in order to select contestants for the Beijing "Water Cube Cup" Overseas Youth Chinese Song Contest. The birthplaces of the contestants in this division include the United States, China, the United Kingdom and Saudi Arabia; the nationalities include Manchu, Han and Hui; the age range is 14 to 26 years old. There was a family of three sisters who came to compete, which was amazing. There is also a student from New Mexico who asked her parents and friends to contact her to participate in the state because there is no competition area in the state. One of the contestants is a boy. The number of participants in the Arizona Division this time is much higher than in other divisions in the United States. This is all due to the active participation and strong support from all aspects. The four Chinese schools in the state played a key role. After receiving the news of the competition, Principal Lei Hong of Zusun Chinese School in Tucson not only quickly released the news to the Chinese community in Tucson through the Chinese school website and the "Tucson Chinese Contact Newsletter", but also printed the poster on the back of the program of the school's graduation ceremony at his own expense to ensure that everyone A parent can be notified; he contacted Principal Liu Dong of Tucson Mandarin Church Chinese School by phone as soon as possible, who was about to board a flight back to China. Therefore, Principal Liu, as a member of the organizing committee, quickly sent the competition news to the school, and the school also quickly recommended teacher Wang Guixian, the referee of the competition. Modern Chinese School played a very important role in this competition. After the former principal Wei Yi received the news of the competition, he and the former chairman Li Guangxuan immediately sent the news to the whole school; after the current principal He Chunxiao received the news of the competition, he quickly decided that the school’s vice president Zhu Yan would enter the competition as the school coordinator. The competition organizing committee; the school quickly recommended Wang Nan as the school’s referee; Vice Principal Zhu Yan is the chairperson of the organizing committee of this competition area. She not only released the competition news via email several times, but also called the students in the school’s Chinese AP class and Chinese 12th grade students one by one to encourage students to sign up for the competition. After learning about the competition, Zheng Tieyu and Huang Shuangshuang, the new chairman and vice-chairmen of the board of directors of Hope Chinese School, immediately selected board member Xie Ming to join the competition organizing committee. Xie Ming not only quickly contacted Li Guohua of the school to serve as the referee, but also made a special call to contact the students and graduated students of the school to sign up for the competition. Shuai Zhiruo, a member of the organizing committee and vice president of the National Association of Chinese Schools, served as the coordinator of the competition and was responsible for contacting the organizing committee of the national competition and promoting it in local newspapers. In order to better promote Chinese songs through this activity, the judging team recommended songs with healthy content and beautiful melodies to young people by sending emails and publishing them in newspapers. Referee Li Guohua, the composer of the well-known song "Oh My God, China", quickly selected more than ten online links to the songs. Referee Chen Yi from the Tucson area also recommended nearly ten songs from different eras, different styles, and different singing methods. Xie Ming from the organizing committee compiled a document and sent it to the newspaper to recommend to young people. In order to encourage young people to participate, the registration fee for this competition in the state division is waived. Not only are the referees and organizing committee members happy to contribute to the competition, but other organizations and enthusiasts in the local community also serve voluntarily for this competition. Ms. Fang Huixian, the former president of the Overseas Chinese Federation, responded to some teenagers’ inquiries about the competition via email in a timely manner; she helped New Mexico students contact the state organizing committee; she was also responsible for receiving the competition videos sent by mail. Employees of "Xinxin Supermarket" help receive video tapes submitted by players. In particular, Ms. Gao, the owner of "August Love Song", not only videotaped the 11 contestants for free, but also provided a venue for the competition scoring activities. It is also worth mentioning that one parent urgently needed the accompaniment of a song but could not find it anywhere. After learning about it, Miss Gao used the resources of the karaoke hall to solve this problem as quickly as possible. The state's "Alberta Times", "Asian American News", "Hispanic American News", "Sunbird" and "Tucson Chinese Contact Newsletter" and other Chinese websites have made multiple publicity reports for this event free of charge. On the scoring day last Saturday, June 4, the referees worked continuously from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. before having lunch. In particular, the two referees from Tucson, Teacher Chen Yi and Teacher Wang Guixian, were driven very early by the chairman of the organizing committee, Principal Lei Hong, and arrived in Phoenix on time. Organizing committee members Zhu Yan, Lei Hong, Xie Ming, and Shuai Zhiruo participated in the scoring activities throughout the day and solved problems in the competition in a timely manner. Everyone coordinated and worked hard, and finally the competition was successfully completed. The members of the organizing committee and the judges have initially agreed to invite the participating singers from the state to gather for a celebration in conjunction with the performance of the competition winners and singing stars at the "Water Cube" on August 8. To this end, the Arizona Division Organizing Committee would like to express its gratitude to all participating teenagers and supporting parents, to the leaders of the four Chinese schools, to the relevant institutions and enthusiastic people in the state community, and to look forward to everyone working together to continue to contribute to the healthy growth of our Chinese teenagers. Photo – A group photo of the staff after the competition scoring

654521796854e0e5a5b3d70eec1781efc6382276.sourceText: 下午，美国国家气象局的雷达开始跟踪，暴雨以25到35英里每小时的速度袭击北菲尼克斯地区。 暴风雨包含大风和扬沙天气，影响能见度。 由于这些风暴产生的风，整个凤凰城地区沙尘天气会影响到晚上7点，这是一天中第二次的沙尘天气。 在下午早些时候，沙尘向凤凰城南部移动。 能见度下降到低于半英里。
654521796854e0e5a5b3d70eec1781efc6382276.translatedText: In the afternoon, National Weather Service radar began tracking heavy rain hitting the North Phoenix area at 25 to 35 mph. The storm contained strong winds and blowing sand, affecting visibility. Due to the winds generated by these storms, dust will affect the entire Phoenix area until 7 p.m., the second dust storm of the day. In the early afternoon, the dust moved south of Phoenix. Visibility dropped to less than half a mile.

28ae159c74d6a1ed01e11f4fd2a34ed9777a9fcd.translatedText: The storm could impact Southeast Valley communities such as Chandler, Gilbert, Mesa and Tempe. After a sandstorm, there may be heavy rain. Please try to drive as little as possible at night and keep easily movable items indoors to avoid unnecessary losses.

c2761f611a50eaa262b6856beba51b34fb6093db.sourceText: 周五，预计在上午，下午天气为晴转多云。 周五最高气温是93和97度之间，有阵雨和雷暴的机会为20％。
c2761f611a50eaa262b6856beba51b34fb6093db.translatedText: On Friday, the weather is expected to be sunny to cloudy in the morning and then cloudy in the afternoon. Friday's high will be between 93 and 97 degrees, with a 20 percent chance of showers and thunderstorms.

e26962ee75539182211b318f02457329c001b922.sourceText: 展示一个更加平等的社会远景－李克强的多项承诺
e26962ee75539182211b318f02457329c001b922.translatedText: Demonstrate a more equal social vision - Li Keqiang's many commitments

922ee2dc05df3f48103efda7ff45961e21d3ad66.sourceText: 展示一个更加平等的社会远景－李克强的多项承诺 北京棗李克强以中国新总理的身份第一次公开发表意见，他向民众展…
922ee2dc05df3f48103efda7ff45961e21d3ad66.translatedText: Demonstrate a more equal social vision - Li Keqiang's many commitments Beijing Date Li Keqiang spoke out publicly for the first time as China's new Prime Minister. He showed the public...

a0fdbdbe9f1b7519fd9f65652c03f8922c344571.sourceText: 北京棗李克强以中国新总理的身份第一次公开发表意见，他向民众展示出一个更加平等社会的远景，在这个社会里，环境保护胜过不受制约的增长，政府官员把人民的福利置于自身的经济利益之上。
a0fdbdbe9f1b7519fd9f65652c03f8922c344571.translatedText: Beijing Date Li Keqiang spoke publicly for the first time as China's new Prime Minister. He showed the public the vision of a more equal society, in which environmental protection trumps unchecked growth and government officials put the welfare of the people above their own economic interests.

50fd9d56c74e742e64db63b8b457ef5a6113682a.sourceText: ”腐败和我们政府的信誉应该说水火不容，”他在人民大会堂告诉记者。
50fd9d56c74e742e64db63b8b457ef5a6113682a.translatedText: "Corruption and the credibility of our government should be said to be incompatible," he told reporters at the Great Hall of the People.

4199dad5da3d67531f580d887f22ea6987272b3b.sourceText: 一年一度的全国人民代表大会周日举行了最后一次会议，任命了新一届政府领导人，之后李克强与记者会面，他承诺要减少对私人投资的障碍，控制占据了很多经济领域的强大利益集团，以及缩减臃肿且妨碍过多的官僚机构，他承认这种官僚机构往往让企业家和普通老百姓恼火。
4199dad5da3d67531f580d887f22ea6987272b3b.translatedText: Li Keqiang met with reporters after the annual National People's Congress held its final meeting on Sunday to appoint new government leaders, where he pledged to reduce barriers to private investment, rein in powerful interest groups that dominate many sectors of the economy, and shrink a bloated and overly obstructive bureaucracy that he acknowledged often irritated entrepreneurs and ordinary people.

73c777f9674784f468354a3d74594a3cb2c3eba9.sourceText: 李克强说，在由习近平和中共中央政治局常委领导的新一届政府任期内，将暂停建设新的政府性楼堂馆所，削减公费购车、公费接待和公费旅游的开支。他警告说，为了增加社会福利支出，政府财政供养的庞大人员队伍将被缩减。
73c777f9674784f468354a3d74594a3cb2c3eba9.translatedText: Li Keqiang said that during the term of the new government led by Xi Jinping and members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, the construction of new government buildings and venues will be suspended and expenditures on public-funded car purchases, public-funded receptions and public-funded tourism will be reduced. He warned that in order to increase social welfare expenditures, the large number of personnel supported by the government's finances will be reduced.

ce9e255ad2dc089c83f93e7715e87470ac5b250e.sourceText: 在回答新加坡《联合早报》记者提问时，李克强说，”改革就是要限制政府的权力。这是削权，是自我革命，会很痛，甚至有割腕的感觉。”电视台直播了这次与中外记者的见面会。
ce9e255ad2dc089c83f93e7715e87470ac5b250e.translatedText: When answering a question from a reporter from Singapore's Lianhe Zaobao, Li Keqiang said, "Reform is about limiting the power of the government. This is power reduction and self-revolution. It will be very painful and even feel like cutting your wrists." The TV station broadcast the meeting with Chinese and foreign reporters live.

fee7c9a18478dbd4118ccfbd91bdf802e61f756d.sourceText: 李克强带着中国领导人少见的随意和自然回答了记者的问题，他的话为公众提供了一幅诱人的经济和社会变革面面观，包括承诺改变农村贫困人口的生活，改变中国城市中大批囊中羞涩的农民工的生活，以及改变退休人员的生活，他们为不断增长的物价和负担不起的医疗费而担心。
fee7c9a18478dbd4118ccfbd91bdf802e61f756d.translatedText: Li Keqiang answered reporters' questions with a spontaneity rare among Chinese leaders, offering the public a tantalizing picture of economic and social change, including a promise to change the lives of the rural poor, the vast numbers of cash-strapped migrant workers in China's cities, and retirees worried about rising prices and unaffordable medical bills.

14c1daa0f7a843283a54c19eeca0bb84c60fec4b.sourceText: 他承认，最近几个月里笼罩北京的有毒雾霾，让他感到”心情沉重”，他鼓励新闻媒体和公众追究他的责任，如果他的政府没能清除水污染和保障食品安全。
14c1daa0f7a843283a54c19eeca0bb84c60fec4b.translatedText: He acknowledged that the toxic smog that has enveloped Beijing in recent months has left him with a "heavy heart" and encouraged the news media and the public to hold him accountable if his government fails to clean up water pollution and ensure food safety.

74f44b7c15b8be9ff96d7dfa1ab02ebe0e99b134.sourceText: 他说，”绿水青山贫穷落后不行，但殷实富裕环境恶化也不行。”
74f44b7c15b8be9ff96d7dfa1ab02ebe0e99b134.translatedText: He said, "It is not enough to be poor and backward with clear waters and green mountains, but it is not enough to have a wealthy and wealthy environment with a deteriorating environment."

c9db9a2785c912e57376d38a117f30124ae81443.sourceText: 政治评论员、《中国改革》杂志前社长李伟东说，他”看见李克强对中国的问题有一个正确的了解，而感到欣慰”。
c9db9a2785c912e57376d38a117f30124ae81443.translatedText: Political commentator and former president of "China Reform" magazine Li Weidong said that he was "pleased to see that Li Keqiang has a correct understanding of China's problems."

56ac42ae75c6e2044626059091a10bc1e88cb2c6.sourceText: 李伟东说， ”他作出许多承诺，这显示他有信心，而且他似乎准备好要为与既得利益者做斗争承担责任。”
56ac42ae75c6e2044626059091a10bc1e88cb2c6.translatedText: Li Weidong said, "He has made many promises, which shows that he is confident, and he seems ready to take responsibility for fighting against vested interests."

0fc04b3bc184d5890a65a44c7460d401374c281e.sourceText: 尽管中国的博客写手和政治分析人士对李克强的发言感到振奋，尤其为他切合实际、直言不讳的说话方式所动，他们依然指出，他的承诺缺乏具体的细节。李克强也绕开了政治改革的讨论。自由派知识分子和政策顾问们说，如果中国想解决一些最棘手的问题，那就必须面对政治改革的问题。他们说，相反的是，李克强为共产党控制下的人民代表大会批准的温和行政改革方案作了辩护。
0fc04b3bc184d5890a65a44c7460d401374c281e.translatedText: Although Chinese bloggers and political analysts were heartened by Li Keqiang's speech, especially his practical and outspoken speaking style, they still pointed out that his promises lacked specific details. Li Keqiang also sidestepped discussion of political reform. Liberal intellectuals and policy advisers say China must face political reform if it wants to solve some of its most thorny problems. Instead, they said, Li Keqiang defended a modest administrative reform package approved by the Communist Party-controlled People's Congress.

a2fd9f6e1bd5d0e5c7c0bf9568962cc911e60597.sourceText: 李克强面临着巨大的障碍。力图为农民、农民工和私营企业主增加机会的改革，势必会遇到来自精英集团的阻力，精英们对分享中国经济神奇增长的果实毫无兴趣。他也必须在以共识为导向的集体领导层的局限下行使职权，这个领导层包括由七名成员组成的中共中央政治局常委会，其中保守派占多数。
a2fd9f6e1bd5d0e5c7c0bf9568962cc911e60597.translatedText: Li Keqiang faces huge obstacles. Reforms that seek to increase opportunities for farmers, migrant workers, and private business owners are bound to encounter resistance from an elite group that has no interest in sharing the fruits of China's miraculous economic growth. He must also exercise authority within the constraints of a collective, consensus-oriented leadership that includes the seven-member Politburo Standing Committee, in which conservatives hold a majority.

d789b1d1b095fa595116a8cb6ad2af2c9c4ca9bf.sourceText: 甚至连李克强也承认，在中国三十年市场经济改革中积累了权力和财富的那些人对改革形成潜在的障碍，他说，”现在触动利益往往比触及灵魂还难。”
d789b1d1b095fa595116a8cb6ad2af2c9c4ca9bf.translatedText: Even Li Keqiang admitted that those who have accumulated power and wealth during China's thirty years of market economic reform pose potential obstacles to reform. He said, "It is often harder to touch the interests than the soul now."

efd30d2e14587129d4a338f3e20e9d7adc3f5aab.sourceText: 作为中国国务院的最高长官，李克强负责经济政策、医疗和教育事务；他对城镇化的挑战表达了强烈的兴趣。在回答一位记者的提问时，他说，政府将提供充裕的资金，帮助每年涌入城市的数百万农村居民，出台政策为他们创造良好的发展环境。他说，”还要注意防止城市病，不能一边是高楼林立，一边是棚户连片。”
efd30d2e14587129d4a338f3e20e9d7adc3f5aab.translatedText: As the top official in China's State Council, Li Keqiang is responsible for economic policy, health care and education; he has expressed a strong interest in the challenges of urbanization. In response to a reporter's question, he said that the government will provide sufficient funds to help the millions of rural residents who flock to cities every year and introduce policies to create a good development environment for them. He said, "We must also pay attention to preventing urban diseases. We cannot have high-rise buildings on one side and shantytowns on the other."

7f9c6a0ffeafa7ee28937513661f4353c89ce9f1.sourceText: 中国民众对十年以来的首批新领导们的期待相当高。习近平推动了这一期待的增长，自从去年11月晋升共产党总书记以来，他多次提出要打击腐败，将中国经济增长的重心转向国内消费，减少对出口和基本建设投资的依赖。然而，习近平也引发了一些不安，尤其是在中国的邻国当中，他强调要加强中国军事实力，推动”一个民族的伟大复兴”，这被一些人解读成中国在暗示将采取更加强硬的对外政策。
7f9c6a0ffeafa7ee28937513661f4353c89ce9f1.translatedText: The Chinese people have high expectations for the first batch of new leaders in ten years. That expectation has been fueled by Xi Jinping, who since his promotion to Communist Party general secretary in November has repeatedly pledged to crack down on corruption and shift the focus of China's economic growth toward domestic consumption and reduce reliance on exports and infrastructure investment. However, Xi Jinping has also caused some unease, especially among China's neighbors. His emphasis on strengthening China's military strength and promoting "the great rejuvenation of a nation" has been interpreted by some as a hint that China will adopt a more assertive foreign policy.

4cda74a9cf4b9d810b51af081c0bf6fc331f51a0.sourceText: 周日早些时候，习近平在国家主席的就任讲话中再次谈到了”中国梦”的主题，以民族主义者的口吻，强调了中华文明的伟大，他说，”爱国主义始终是把中华民族坚强团结在一起的精神力量。”
4cda74a9cf4b9d810b51af081c0bf6fc331f51a0.translatedText: Earlier on Sunday, Xi Jinping once again touched on the theme of the "Chinese Dream" in his inauguration speech as president, emphasizing the greatness of Chinese civilization in a nationalist tone, saying, "Patriotism has always been the spiritual force that strongly unites the Chinese nation." "

d2e878cdb363f92f2ca149abd17ba2743babe826.sourceText: 虽然这两人都毫不掩饰地效忠共产党，改革的支持者还是对57岁的李克强寄予不少希望，他曾在北京大学获得法学学士和经济学博士的学位，使他成为中国领导人中学历最高者之一。习近平是所谓的太子党，其父亲是共产党元老，而李克强则不同，他出身寒微。
d2e878cdb363f92f2ca149abd17ba2743babe826.translatedText: Although both men are unabashedly loyal to the Communist Party, reform supporters have high hopes for Li Keqiang, 57, who earned a bachelor's degree in law and a doctorate in economics from Peking University, making him one of the most highly educated among Chinese leaders. Unlike Xi Jinping, a so-called princeling whose father is a Communist Party veteran, Li Keqiang comes from a humble background.

cba0539744d8dd865b6154eb178ea335a932802f.sourceText: 官方媒体已经为李克强塑造了一种形象，把他描绘成一位做事从简的现代派领导人。评论员注意到，他的前任温家宝喜欢用中国古典诗词点缀自己的讲话，而李克强则不同，似乎不用讲话稿，并在空中打着手势以强调讲话的重点。
cba0539744d8dd865b6154eb178ea335a932802f.translatedText: State media have cultivated an image of Li Keqiang as a simple, modernist leader. Commentators have noted that unlike his predecessor Wen Jiabao, who liked to pepper his speeches with classical Chinese poetry, Li Keqiang appears to use no speech scripts and gestures in the air to emphasize key points.

6fda28ef2fb84d7eac816d862ffa53cd4be6b2b4.sourceText: 尽管如此，这次记者招待会并不是一次可自由参加、能即席提问的活动。记者的问题事先已被审查过，而且，因为《纽约时报》曾发过有关温氏家族财富的报道，该报的记者没有接到参加招待会的邀请。
6fda28ef2fb84d7eac816d862ffa53cd4be6b2b4.translatedText: Nonetheless, this press conference is not an event where one can freely attend and ask impromptu questions. Reporters' questions were vetted in advance, and because The New York Times had published stories about the Wen family's wealth, reporters from the newspaper were not invited to the reception.

b08ee79dbfe45bba680e82f1240bd0a2e6440138.sourceText: 当被问到在以美国为目标的网络攻击中，中国政府所起的作用时，李克强用了共产党标准的反驳说辞，称中国也常是黑客攻击的目标，美国应该停止其”没有根据”的指责。
b08ee79dbfe45bba680e82f1240bd0a2e6440138.translatedText: When asked about the Chinese government's role in cyberattacks targeting the United States, Li Keqiang used the Communist Party's standard retort, saying that China was also a frequent target of hackers and that the United States should stop making "unfounded" accusations.

21addba06c396f1d7d2a5a394de250702eae09f9.sourceText: 杰安迪(Andrew Jacobs)是《纽约时报》驻京记者。储百亮( Chris Buckley ) 对本文有报道贡献。 Mia Li 对本文有研究贡献。
21addba06c396f1d7d2a5a394de250702eae09f9.translatedText: > Andrew Jacobs is a Beijing correspondent for The New York Times. Chris Buckley contributed reporting to this article. Mia Li contributed research to this article.

2c59fca54825c3e672a3b4652bfc019b866893d6.sourceText: 星光熠熠，“八月恋歌校园歌手大赛”十强战一触即发 ９月２５日，由ＡＳＵ中国学生学者联谊会主办，八月恋歌ＫＴＶ独家冠名赞助的八月恋歌校园歌手大赛为时两天的海选落下了帷幕。作为ASU中国学生会规模、影响最大的活动之一，这次的校园歌手大赛即将进入最激动人心的十强决赛，同时也引起了各界广泛的关注。 此次的ASUCSSA八月恋歌校园歌手大赛分为报名、海选、决赛三个阶段。随着ASUCSSA举办的歌手大赛进入第三个年头，今年整体的比赛组织更加成熟，比赛水平也有了长足的提高。今年在报名海选的50位选手中，可谓高手迭出，星光熠熠。经过伊怡之、高薇佳、刘然三位专业评委的严格筛选，认真讨论，最终有十名选手脱颖而出。其中有北美快男张也弛，舞台感染力极佳的王思嘉，曾在国内斩获众多声乐奖项的李一然，嗓音高亢具有爆发力的刘维哲，创作才子李一阳，歌声深情款款的林锐斌，上届就曾斩获优异名次的缪莹，颇具大将风范的李睿英，唱功深厚的董乐慧，以及擅长说唱的季奕。 此次大赛的决赛将于10月中下旬举办，决赛分为原色舞台、默契舞台、残酷舞台和我的音乐故事四个部分，由三位专业评委和十位大众评审共同打分，加上人气投票共同为十位选手排定座次。决出的冠亚季军都将获得由八月恋歌提供的丰厚礼品。届时决赛现场还将有抽奖环节，同样会惊喜连连。 更多比赛详情请关注比赛官方网站 www.8ktv.net/KaraokeContest.html 。十位选手的网上人气投票将于10月5日正式开启，请大家登录比赛官网为自己心仪的选手投出宝贵的一票，最佳人气奖的殊荣也将诞生于你们的倾力支持之中。 巅峰之战，一触即发。相信十位选手将联袂为大家献上一份星光熠熠的视听盛宴。
2c59fca54825c3e672a3b4652bfc019b866893d6.translatedText: was star-studded, and the top ten competition of the "August Love Song Campus Singers Contest" was about to begin. On September 25, the two-day audition for the August Love Song Campus Singers Competition, hosted by the ASU Chinese Students and Scholars Association and exclusively sponsored by August Love Song KTV, came to an end. As one of the largest and most influential activities of the ASU Chinese Student Union, this campus singer competition is about to enter the most exciting top ten finals, and it has also attracted widespread attention from all walks of life. The ASUCSSA August Love Song Campus Singer Competition is divided into three stages: registration, audition and finals. As the singer competition held by ASUCSSA enters its third year, the overall competition organization this year is more mature and the competition level has also been greatly improved. Among the 50 contestants who signed up for the audition this year, there are many experts and stars. After strict screening and careful discussion by three professional judges, Yi Yizhi, Gao Weijia and Liu Ran, ten contestants finally stood out. Among them are North American fast boy Zhang Yachi, Wang Sijia with excellent stage appeal, Li Yiran who has won many vocal awards in China, Liu Weizhe with a high-pitched voice and explosive voice, creative genius Li Yiyang, Lin Ruibin with soulful singing, Miao Ying who won an excellent ranking in the last session, Li Ruiying with a general style, Dong Lehui with profound singing skills, and Ji Yi who is good at rapping. The finals of this competition will be held in mid-to-late October. The finals are divided into four parts: the original color stage, the tacit understanding stage, the cruel stage and my music story. Three professional judges and ten public judges will jointly score, and the popularity votes will be used to rank the ten contestants. The first, second and third runners-up will receive generous gifts provided by August Love Song. There will also be a lottery draw at the finals, which will also be full of surprises. For more competition details, please pay attention to the official competition website www.8ktv.net/KaraokeContest.html. The online popularity voting for the ten contestants will officially open on October 5. Please log in to the official website of the competition to cast your precious vote for your favorite contestant. The honor of the Best Popularity Award will also be born with your full support. The peak battle is about to begin. I believe that the ten contestants will work together to present a star-studded audio-visual feast to everyone.
