24f7e1ae7dec421c71f309d10666b7d28be89d5d.sourceText: 恬淡从容清新雅致的秋色秋香下午茶(组图) （太阳鸟浩浩） 赴宴饮酒乃小福气，邀友品茶才是真福分。2011年12月11日，太阳鸟论坛网友”秋色秋香”，在”太阳鸟”亚利桑那华人网站以极品普洱茶为引子，邀请好友一起品茶话道。近30个好友参加了本次聚会，不仅品尝了各种在海外难得一尝的名茶，还领略了中国茶文化的魅力。 近30嘉宾齐聚一谈 品茶话道 美食 香茶一应俱全 陈普老师一身唐装 妙点中国茶文化 活动现场陈普老师的介绍非常有感召力，当他介绍到中国福建的大红袍的时候，介绍了中国武夷山的三株大红袍母树，长在悬崖上，水分是由山体逐渐渗出来的，山间云雾弥漫，常年湿度在80%左右，这个位置的阳光也非常独特，由于山体的遮盖，每天母树只能照到清晨和黄昏的阳光，每天中午特别强烈的阳光都被遮蔽了。正宗的大红袍冲泡后，茶汤清澈艳丽，兼有红茶的甘醇，绿茶的清香，因其香味浓郁，冲泡五六次后余韵犹存，因而是功夫茶的首选。陈普老师带来了第四代的大红袍让来宾品茶。听了介绍的嘉宾们，纷纷起来要求品尝，工作人员拿起茶壶就给大家倒上了茶，大家品得相当入神，结果负责倒茶的妞妞虎，拿着个茶壶走进屋里，告诉大家终于把”大红袍”沏好了。这下来宾才发现被戏弄了一把，他们陶醉品茶的茶不是”大红袍”而是”黄山毛峰”。 大家赶紧把手中的茶，速饮了，又把茶杯送上。 黄光立（右） 吴昭贤（左）夫妇精彩演出 来自ASU的钢琴演奏博士黄光立和夫人吴昭贤在讲座间隙为大家演奏了巴赫的《第二号法国组曲》和法朗克包尔的《前凑、辅格与变凑》。黄老师纤细轻快的演奏将大家带回17世纪的欧洲宫廷，当时只有国王和贵族才能一边品尝来自万里之遥的中国的茶叶，一边欣赏如此轻妙典雅的钢琴曲。古筝艺术家贺绿蒂则为大家带来了风格迥异的古筝名曲《洞庭新歌》，品尝着黄山毛峰，曼妙的琴声仿佛让大家看到千里洞庭的波光荡漾，心情也由衷的喜悦欢娱起来。 古筝艺术家贺绿蒂的曼妙演奏 戴定国先生作为一名资深集邮爱好者，则从另外一个角度来解读茶文化-邮票。他讲得深入浅出又不失趣味性，大家在放松的同时也收获了知识。 戴定国先生分享茶与邮票的故事 三个小时的快乐时光很快过去了，先后品尝了”安吉白茶”，”黄山毛峰”，”碧螺春”，”铁观音”，”普洱”，”大红袍”，”茉莉花”，又欣赏到了精妙的中西经典音乐，这是怎样的听觉，味觉，视觉的盛宴。 参与者是这样评价此次秋香下午茶的：”我们在凤凰城二十年，终于等到了这次茶会。”参与者是这样评价太阳鸟网站的：”每次出门吃饭办事都要先查太阳鸟黄页，生活从此变得方便很多”。为了这样的评价，我们再辛苦也是值得的。 本次活动由太阳鸟华人社区网，亚省时报协办。并得到了新东方艺术学校提供场地方面的帮助，在此感谢。
24f7e1ae7dec421c71f309d10666b7d28be89d5d.translatedText: >Tranquil, calm, fresh and elegant autumn colors and autumn fragrance afternoon tea (photo) (Sunbird Haohao) Going to a banquet and drinking is a small blessing, but inviting friends to drink tea is a real blessing. On December 11, 2011, Sunbird forum user "Autumn Colors and Autumn Fragrance" used the best Pu'er tea as an introduction on the "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese website to invite friends to enjoy tea and talk together. Nearly 30 friends attended this party, not only tasting various famous teas that are rare overseas, but also appreciating the charm of Chinese tea culture. Nearly 30 guests gathered together to talk about tea tasting, gourmet food, and all kinds of fragrant tea. Teacher Chen Pu was dressed in a Tang suit. Wonderful points about Chinese tea culture. Teacher Chen Pu's introduction at the event was very inspiring. When he introduced Dahongpao in Fujian, China, he introduced three Dahongpao mother trees in Wuyi Mountain, China. They grow on the cliffs. The water gradually seeps out from the mountain. The mountains are filled with clouds and mist, and the humidity is about 80% all year round. The sunlight in this location is also very unique. Due to the cover of the mountain, the mother trees can only shine in the morning and evening sunlight every day, and the particularly strong sunlight at noon every day is blocked. After the authentic Dahongpao is brewed, the tea soup is clear and gorgeous, with the sweetness of black tea and the fragrance of green tea. Because of its strong fragrance, the aftertaste remains after brewing five or six times, so it is the first choice for Kung Fu tea. Teacher Chen Pu brought the fourth generation Dahongpao for guests to enjoy tea. After hearing the introduction, the guests stood up and asked to taste it. The staff picked up the teapot and poured tea for everyone. Everyone tasted it with great enthusiasm. As a result, Niu Niuhu, who was responsible for pouring the tea, walked into the room with a teapot and told everyone that the "Dahongpao" was finally brewed. Only then did the guests realize that they had been teased. The tea they were enjoying was not "Da Hong Pao" but "Huangshan Maofeng". Everyone quickly drank the tea in their hands and brought the teacups to them. Huang Guangli (right), Wu Zhaoxian (left) and his wife gave wonderful performances. Huang Guangli, a doctor of piano performance from ASU, and his wife Wu Zhaoxian played Bach's "French Suite No. 2" and Frank Bauer's "Presentative, Complementary and Variations" for everyone during the lecture. Teacher Huang's slender and brisk performance brought everyone back to the European courts of the 17th century. At that time, only kings and nobles could enjoy such light and elegant piano music while tasting tea from China thousands of miles away. Guzheng artist He Ludi brought everyone a different style of famous guzheng song "Dongting New Song". While tasting the Maofeng of Huangshan Mountain, the graceful sound of the piano seemed to make everyone see the waves of the thousands-mile Dongting, and they felt sincerely joyful. The graceful performance of guzheng artist He Ludi. As a senior stamp collector, Mr. Dai Dingguo interprets tea culture - stamps from another perspective. He spoke in a simple and easy-to-understand manner without losing interest. Everyone gained knowledge while relaxing. Mr. Dai Dingguo shared the story of tea and stamps. Three hours of happy time passed quickly. I tasted "Anji White Tea", "Huangshan Maofeng", "Biluochun", "Tieguanyin", "Pu'er", "Dahongpao" and "Jasmine". I also enjoyed exquisite Chinese and Western classic music. What a feast for hearing, taste and vision. Participants commented on the Qiuxiang Afternoon Tea: "We have been in Phoenix for 20 years, and we have finally waited for this tea party." Participants commented on the Sunbird website: "Every time I go out to eat or run errands, I have to check the Sunbird Yellow Pages first, and life has become much more convenient." For such an evaluation, no matter how hard we work, it is worth it. This event is co-organized by the Sunbird Chinese Community Network and the Alberta Times. We also received help from New Oriental Art School in providing the venue, which we would like to express our gratitude to.

80d13cf408171b58e9d5909b0372c6e0c2e4db47.sourceText: 【凤凰笔会】陈鸿鹰：和学生们读“背影” 凤凰城 陈鸿鹰 朱自清先生的”背影”，我自少…
80d13cf408171b58e9d5909b0372c6e0c2e4db47.translatedText: [Phoenix PEN] Chen Hongying: Read "Back View" with students Phoenix City Chen Hongying Mr. Zhu Ziqing's "Back View", I have read it since I was a child...

043e7dcdf5276e713d9990af21a32d29c854af1c.sourceText: 凤凰城 陈鸿鹰 朱自清先生的”背影”，我自少年时代读过，久久不能忘怀。那蕴藏在朴实叙述中的深厚感情，那字里行间的欲说还休，每次重读都能将我深深感动。记得那时有文学赏析文章说， 在文革一切强调”阶级感情”的年代里，这篇文章仍打动所有人的心，冠之以”小资产阶级情调”实在是低估了这篇散文的深度。我深以为然。及至出国后，有一次听一位学中文的韩国朋友说，她非常喜欢”背影”。我更加认同这篇文章的人性深度。
043e7dcdf5276e713d9990af21a32d29c854af1c.translatedText: Phoenix City Chen Hongying Mr. Zhu Ziqing's "Back View", I have read it since my childhood, and I can't forget it for a long time. The deep emotions contained in the simple narrative, and the unspoken words between the lines, deeply moved me every time I reread it. I remember that there was a literary appreciation article at that time that said that in the era of the Cultural Revolution when all emphasis was placed on "class sentiments," this article still touched everyone's hearts. To call it "petty bourgeois sentiment" really underestimates the depth of this prose. I think so. After I went abroad, I once heard a Korean friend who studied Chinese say that she liked "back views" very much. I identify even more with the human depth of this article.

f7b80e780f5da68d8887db0008588dfbdc42b698.sourceText: 基于此，我一直都想将这篇文章介绍给我在北美的学生们，不过一直都很犹豫。因为我知道，作者的时代背景与这些孩子们的生活环境相差何止千万里， 要让这些孩子们能够揣摩 文中的情感与意境的美，实在不是一件容易的事情。但是，我相信这样一篇讲述深沉父爱的文章能跨越时间和空间，也应该能够跨越文化上的鸿沟， 如果给与适当的引导的话。机会终于来了，上个月我特意开设了一次文学赏析课，将这篇文章介绍给我的学生们。
f7b80e780f5da68d8887db0008588dfbdc42b698.translatedText: Based on this, I have always wanted to introduce this article to my students in North America, but I have always been hesitant. Because I know that the author's historical background is thousands of miles apart from the living environment of these children. It is not easy for these children to understand the beauty of the emotions and artistic conception in the article. However, I believe that such an article about deep father's love can span time and space, and it should also be able to span cultural gaps, if given appropriate guidance. The opportunity finally came. Last month I specially held a literary appreciation class to introduce this article to my students.

7fcb9b58765b4f35906191449e34fcc3bd3dcaa6.sourceText: 在提前一周的时间里，我就将文章发给家长，并希望家长有时间和孩子们一起讨论。这篇文章无论两岸三地， 只要是中国人，大概都是耳熟能详。等到学生们来到课堂上，我将文章读了一遍，并用学生们能理解的方式大致解释了一遍。 我说：”这篇文章的作者生活在上个世纪三十年代的中国，当时的中国是什么样子呢？到处都很乱，有点像美国的内战时期，国家将要走向哪里，没有人知道，一个人的前途在哪里，也没有人知道。不像你们现在，知道自己读完中学后会去上大学，大学毕业后会去工作，然后找一个自己喜欢的人建立家庭，开开心心地过完自己的一辈子。那个时候不是这样的。没有人知道自己明天还能不能把学上完，明天还有没有工作。这个作者的爸爸，快到退休的年龄的时候，突然工作没有了，没有退休金，每天只能待在家里，这个时候，作者的祖母去世，而且，家里的房子也保不住了，这个房子可是住过好几代人的祖屋哦。好像，你们当中有一个认识的朋友，现在正在外州上大学，他的爸爸四五十岁了，突然失业了，家里的房子 要被出售了。突然奶奶去世，这位朋友从千里之外坐火车赶回家来参加奶奶的葬礼，看到往日温暖的家现在全是 垃圾，父子俩个人见面的时候，他们的心情是怎样的？你们能够揣摩一下吗？”这样讲着讲着，学生们有点被打动了，因为虽然在读的时候，他们没有太多的感触，这样和他们能够了解的实际生活相联系的时候，他们多少能够明白一些了。
7fcb9b58765b4f35906191449e34fcc3bd3dcaa6.translatedText: I sent the article to parents a week in advance and hoped that parents would have time to discuss it with their children. This article is probably familiar to all Chinese people regardless of whether it is cross-strait or three places. When the students came to class, I read the article and explained it roughly in a way that the students could understand. I said: "The author of this article lived in China in the 1930s. What was China like at that time? Everything was chaotic, a bit like the American Civil War. No one knew where the country was going, and no one knew where a person's future would be. It was not like you now, knowing that you would go to college after high school, work after college, and then find someone you like, start a family, and live your whole life happily. It was not like this at that time. No one knows whether they can finish school tomorrow or whether they will have a job tomorrow. When the author's father was about to retire, he suddenly lost his job and had no pension. He could only stay at home every day. At this time, the author's grandmother passed away, and the house at home could not be saved. This house has been the ancestral home for several generations. It seems that one of you knows a friend who is currently studying in another state. His father is in his forties and fifties and suddenly lost his job. It was going to be sold. Suddenly, my grandma passed away, and this friend rushed home by train from thousands of miles away to attend her funeral. Seeing that the warm home in the past was now full of garbage, how did the father and son feel when they met in person? "As he talked about it, the students were a little moved, because although they didn't have much feelings when they were reading, they could understand it more when it was related to the real life they could understand.

9887ceaae8bb42d911a014faa58c0696805af42a.sourceText: ”这位父亲却并没有太沮丧，”我接着讲下去，”反而安慰他的儿子，让他不要太难过。假如你是这位儿子，有这样的一位父亲，在你感到不能面对一些现实的时候这样安慰你， 你会怎样? ”
9887ceaae8bb42d911a014faa58c0696805af42a.translatedText: "The father was not too depressed," I continued, "but comforted his son and told him not to be too sad. If you were this son and had such a father who comforted you like this when you felt that you could not face some realities, what would you do?"

46c724918b97c06ef9596c57f6284f150b1b5225.sourceText: 学生们似乎更加体味到一些了。虽然他们还只是初高中的孩子，稚气未脱，这些要等到年龄更大一些才会有的人生烦恼，离他们还太远，但从他们脸上浮现的凝重表情，感觉他们似乎进入角色了。
46c724918b97c06ef9596c57f6284f150b1b5225.translatedText: The students seemed to understand it better. Although they are still children in middle and high school and have not shed their childishness, these troubles in life that will only occur when they are older are still too far away from them, but from the solemn expressions on their faces, it feels like they have entered the role.

7ab241f8f7508753640c80a547a288fd628212a2.sourceText: ”后来这位朋友要离开家返回学校了，他的爸爸改变主意一定要亲自去送他到火车站，因为不放心事先托付的人。想一想，你的爸爸本来讲好要他的一位朋友送你去某个地方，后来还是坚持要自己送你，是不是非常的爱你，在乎你呀？”
7ab241f8f7508753640c80a547a288fd628212a2.translatedText: " Later, this friend was leaving home to go back to school. His father changed his mind and had to go to the train station in person because he didn't trust the person he had entrusted to him in advance. Think about it, your father originally agreed to ask one of his friends to send you somewhere, but later he insisted on sending you himself, right? I love you very much and care about you? "

3832a87b478b3e778f3f6eb863a27fdbca057d80.sourceText: ”送你到了火车站，又怕你路上口渴，又想去给你买点水果，可是卖水果的地方离车站有点远，而且还很不容易走过去，需要探身下去又爬上地面，你看着这一幕，会不会感动？”
3832a87b478b3e778f3f6eb863a27fdbca057d80.translatedText: " I sent you to the train station, but I was worried that you would be thirsty on the way, and I wanted to buy you some fruit, but the fruit selling place was a bit far away from the station, and it was not easy to walk there. You had to lean down and climb to the ground. Will you be moved when you look at this scene? "

0c0c9e11c4c548ce12be9dda798b65700752d050.sourceText: 最后，我做了一个民意调查，对学生们说：”如果爱可以衡量，请用1-10 中间的两个数字来分别代表父亲对你的爱和你对父亲的爱。”学生们听了， 纷纷报数字。全班十四个孩子，大概有八个孩子给”父亲对我的爱”打了10分，五个孩子给了7-9 之间的数字，原因是有的爸爸总不在家，有的爸爸太严厉，有一个孩子说人不可能完美，给了爸爸9.9分；但有一个学生给了爸爸11分。在”我对父亲的爱”这一项里，没有一个学生给的分数超过”父亲对我的爱”，给父亲10分的，多半也给自己10分，少数的少一丁点儿。我问他们，”你们认为你们爱你们的父亲胜过你们的父亲爱你们吗？”， ”No!”全班同学的一致回答。 ”父亲做什么让你感到被爱呢? ”答案总结后大致是这样一些：父亲告诉我他爱我；父亲花时间陪我；我失败的时候，父亲鼓励我。
0c0c9e11c4c548ce12be9dda798b65700752d050.translatedText: Finally, I conducted a public opinion survey and said to the students: "If love can be measured, please use the two numbers in the middle of 1-10 to represent your father's love for you and your love for your father respectively." The students listened and reported the numbers one after another. Of the fourteen children in the class, about eight children gave 10 points to "Father's love for me", and five children gave a number between 7 and 9. The reason is that some fathers are always away from home, and some fathers are too strict. One child said that people cannot be perfect and gave his father 9.9 points; but one student gave his father 11 points. In the item "My love for my father", no student gave a score higher than "My father's love for me". Those who gave their father 10 points mostly gave themselves 10 points, and a few gave a little less. I asked them, "Do you think you love your father more than your father loves you?", "No!" The whole class answered unanimously. "What does your father do to make you feel loved?" The answer is summarized as follows: my father tells me that he loves me; my father spends time with me; my father encourages me when I fail.

93c1775bdeef1c8c4caa2df8a41a94c97008f165.sourceText: 我觉得我的文学赏析课算是个尝试。我不期待这些孩子们都能理解， 只希望给他们开一扇窗口。老实说，对于生活在美国这个快餐文化盛行的国家里，什么叫”情郁于中”，什么叫”无言的爱”；对一个生活在物质丰裕的年代的少年人来说，什么叫”人世的悲欢离合，人生的无常变故”，什么叫”在一个动荡的大年代里的颓丧人生”，的确是很难体会的一些东西。但是， 我的心也稍感慰藉， 那个民意调查，就是最好的说明。我盼望，随着学生们的年龄渐长，人生阅历的增加，能够想起从前的中文课上，有老师曾和他们 读过一篇文章，讲述这个世界的另一端，中国近代历史里某个时刻，有这样的一对父与子，分别在即，父亲的寥寥数语，儿子的夺眶而出的眼泪……。
93c1775bdeef1c8c4caa2df8a41a94c97008f165.translatedText: I think my literary appreciation class is an attempt. I don't expect all these children to understand, I just hope to open a window for them. To be honest, for those living in the United States, a country with a popular fast food culture, what is "feeling in love" and what is "silent love"; for a young person living in an era of material abundance, what is "the joys and sorrows of the world, the unpredictable changes in life" and what is "a decadent life in a turbulent era", it is indeed difficult to understand. However, I also feel a little comfort in my heart. That opinion poll is the best explanation. I hope that as the students grow older and gain more life experience, they will be able to recall that in their previous Chinese class, a teacher once read an article to them, telling them about a father and son on the other side of the world, at a certain moment in China’s modern history, who were about to part ways. The father’s few words and the son’s tears came to his eyes...

e3eab9ad8f3a4595c84cfbb3f011275c031869d6.sourceText: （新东方艺术学校供稿）2014年6月7日周六上午，由仝校长主持的暑期演讲俱乐部在新东方艺术学校举行了第一次活动，在两小时的时间里，近四十名学生参加了以”Who Am I”为主题的演讲。孩子们按照年龄被分成三组，经过分组角逐和全体参加者投票，每组都选出了一名冠军。演讲俱乐部暑期还将有七次活动，每次都会有三名优胜者产生。暑期结束后，本期的三名优胜者将会和以后决出的周冠军参加金秋舞蹈艺术节小主持人的选拔。首届2014金秋舞蹈艺术节将于2014年9月14日在Chandler Center For the Arts 剧场举行。新东方艺术学校已经为本场演出选定了一名成年主持人，还将选拔一名学生主持人。 参加本次演讲俱乐部的孩子年龄跨度很大，从四岁到十五岁都有。四岁的刘思齐（David Liu）第一个上台演讲。齐齐小小年纪，表现大方，短短几句话一说完，立刻就获得了全场的掌声。十五岁的彭天悦（Tina Peng）是本次活动中年纪最大的孩子。她在现场的表现沉稳、演说流畅，获得第三组的冠军。第三组经过三次投票，彭天悦与十三岁的唐天鹤票数两度持平。到第三次投票，彭天悦以微弱优势胜出。 演讲现场气氛轻松欢快，虽然是第一次活动，但并没有出现冷场。有的孩子准备很充分，在家里都准备了讲稿；有的孩子没有准备，但也能现场发挥。主持演讲的仝校长对每个孩子的表现都给予了现场点评。仝校长给每个孩子点评之前，都会要孩子们自己先先点评一下演讲者的表现。孩子们在点评别人的同时也找到了自己的不足。通过孩子们的表现，老师和在场的家长都意识到，孩子们的演讲技巧还不是很娴熟，但相信经过一段时间的训练，会有更好的表现。 演讲俱乐部第二次活动将于6月14日上午进十点半到十二点半进行，欢迎家长带孩子继续参加。 咨询电话：（602）490-8613 报名邮件：azeaainfo@gmail.com
e3eab9ad8f3a4595c84cfbb3f011275c031869d6.translatedText: (Contributed by New Oriental Art School) On the morning of Saturday, June 7, 2014, the Summer Speech Club hosted by the same principal held its first event at New Oriental Art School. Within two hours, nearly forty students participated in a speech with the theme of "Who Am I". The children were divided into three groups according to their age. After group competition and voting by all participants, a champion was selected from each group. The Toastmasters Club will have seven more events over the summer, with three winners each time. After the summer vacation, the three winners of this period will participate in the selection of the host of the Golden Autumn Dance Art Festival together with the weekly champion to be determined later. The first 2014 Golden Autumn Dance Art Festival will be held on September 14, 2014 at the Chandler Center For the Arts Theater. New Oriental Art School has selected an adult host for this show and will also select a student host. The children participating in this speech club range in age from four to fifteen years old. Four-year-old David Liu was the first to take the stage to speak. Qi Qi was very generous at a young age. As soon as he finished speaking a few words, he immediately received applause from the audience. Fifteen-year-old Tina Peng is the oldest child in this event. Her performance on the scene was calm and her speech was fluent, and she won the championship in the third group. In the third group, after three votes, Peng Tianyue and 13-year-old Tang Tianhe tied twice in votes. By the third vote, Peng Tianyue won by a narrow margin. The atmosphere at the speech was relaxed and cheerful. Although it was the first event, there was no silence. Some children are well prepared and have prepared speech notes at home; some children are not prepared, but they can also perform on the spot. The principal who gave the speech gave on-the-spot comments on each child's performance. Before the principal evaluates each child, he will ask the children to evaluate the speaker's performance themselves. Children also found their own shortcomings while criticizing others. Through the children's performance, the teachers and parents present realized that the children's speech skills are not yet very proficient, but they believe that after a period of training, they will perform better. The second activity of the Toastmasters Club will be held from 10:30 to 12:30 in the morning on June 14th. Parents are welcome to bring their children to continue to participate. Consultation hotline: (602) 490-8613 Registration email: azeaainfo@gmail.com

18e6bd5f53726b87afb8e06784e35170729e9feb.translatedText: >Zhang Zhaohong: Why did the US Senate apologize to the "Chinese Exclusion Act"? Zhang Zhaohong The U.S. Senate passed a resolution on the 6th to defend the unfair "Chinese Exclusion Act" 130 years ago...

b3d96035c50752544a49aeb5db7766b98486ee29.sourceText: 美国国会参院在6日通过决议，为130前年不公正「排华法案」而道歉。 那么，1882年美国国会通过的「排华法案」(Chinese Exclusion Act of 1882)究竟是一个什么样的法案？ 而在其后再增设的法律条文对当年的中国移民产生了什么样的影响？ 带来什么样的岐视？ 这几年因要编写一些华侨和侨社的历史，看过这方面的资料，现把材料整理后刊登出来，因为如果我们忘记了过去，也就不会有将来。 1882年对旅美华人来说是难忘屈辱一年。 这一年，美国国会第一次通过了移民史上划时代的「排华法案」(Chinese Exclusion Act of 1882)。 法案中规定（一）从是年起，停止华工入境10年；（二）不准已经到美国的华人归化为美国公民，华人一旦回中国探亲，就不能再回美国来；（三）1880 年11月17日前既居留美国并获得海关证明文件之华工，暂时出境后，准予重入美国；（四）持有中国政府英文证件，说明依约有权入美之华人（非华工），准予 进入美国；（五）非经正当途径进入美国之华人，于此法案通过后，将依美国法院之裁判驱逐出境；（六）此后，州法院或联邦法院均不得准许华人归化为美国公民。 此法签订之后，使得许多华工不得不终老异乡。 1882年的「排华法案」只是一个开始。 1884年美国排华补充法案又作了新规定，世界各国华人及其后裔永远以华人看待，不管是否已成为他国公民（如英国籍或法国籍），若要到美国来就必须受到美国排华 补充法案的限制，从哪国来就必须回哪国去。 此后排华行动越演越烈。 1888年美国政府又规定「斯科特法案」(Scott Act)，规定华工离开美国后，不管有无证件，一律不许再回美国。 致使此刻正回中国探亲的二万多名华工不能再返回美国。 这一时期，「排华」成为美国政党争取选票的时髦口号。 至此，赴美国的华人人数急遽下降，到了1887年减到最低，仅仅只有10人。 1892年5月，国会通过「盖尔里法」(Geary Act)，是一项剥夺华人的「人身保护法」。 规定将1882年的排华法案禁止华工入境的法令延长10年。 取消对华人的人身保护令，华人不得申请保释。 该案剥夺了华人的人身保护权(habeas corpus)，完全失去司法上的基本权利。 并且，在该法案通过一年内，在美国的全体华工都必需申请居留证，一年之后仍无居留证者，将被逮捕和递解出境。 若有非法入境者，需囚监五年，监满递解出境。 1893年5月15日，美国联邦最高法院在「邝耀庭诉美国政府」一案的裁决中坚持，美国（通过其国会）绝对或有条件的排斥和驱逐外侨的权利「是每一主权国家和独立 国家所固有的和不可剥夺的权利。」。 1894年清廷与美国签订「禁止华人劳工进入美国十年条约」，此条约至1904年期限届满。 国会又于1904年4月27日立法，把当时应即生效的排华法案（指1894年所签之法）做无限期延长，且禁止华工从夏威夷、菲律宾等美属地区到美洲大陆。 如此一来，导致了历史性的全中国抵制美货的爱国运动。 美国排华运动早期只是零星的暴民式的攻击、劫掠与谋杀，后来演变成为有组织的、制度性的、由官方推行的全面性行动。 排华的主要份子，也由原先只局限于工人阶级而扩展到议会与市府，政客为了争取工人选票，乃牺牲华人利益以取宠。 而被排斥的对象。 这整个行动背后的动力，就是种族歧视。 受了当时社会达尔文主义的影响，十九世纪美国白人相信自己是「优势」的民族，中国人则是「劣等」的民族，所以要排除在美国领土之外，这当然是种族偏见。 但是当时满清政府腐败无能，又有内忧外患，无力保护旅美侨胞，遂使许多海外华人的悲剧，不断上演。 自此之后至1943年废除排华法案期间，华人人数急遽下降，在排华法案通过前的1880年为10万5千4百65人，经过60年的时间，在1940年华人人口已降到 7万7千504人，华人占全美人口比重的0.06%。 另外，我看到由陈汝舟，陈英福所编著的《美国华人沧桑史》中的一段文字：”在亚利桑那省（ARIZONA）宪法中也有同类排华的条文，沿铁路市镇，太阳下山华人一律要离开此市镇，不然便要关进监狱内过夜，待天光才能恢复自由，直到一九八二年祖笋同源会发起请求，省长加斯路方删除此条例。」 美国国会参院能在130年后为当年的不公正而道歉，还中国移民的一个迟来的公道，亦是一种有勇气和负责任的态度。
b3d96035c50752544a49aeb5db7766b98486ee29.translatedText: The U.S. Senate passed a resolution on the 6th to apologize for the unfair "Chinese Exclusion Act" 130 years ago. So, what exactly is the Chinese Exclusion Act of 1882 passed by the U.S. Congress? And what impact did the subsequent legal provisions have on Chinese immigrants at that time? What kind of discrimination does it bring? In the past few years, I have been compiling some histories of overseas Chinese and overseas Chinese communities. I have read some materials in this area, and now I have compiled the materials and published them, because if we forget the past, there will be no future. 1882 was an unforgettable year of humiliation for the Chinese in the United States. This year, the U.S. Congress passed the Chinese Exclusion Act of 1882, an epoch-making event in the history of immigration, for the first time. The bill stipulates that (1) starting from this year, the entry of Chinese workers will be stopped for 10 years; (2) Chinese who have already arrived in the United States will not be allowed to naturalize as American citizens. Once Chinese return to China to visit relatives, they will not be able to return to the United States; (3) 1880 Chinese workers who have resided in the United States before November 17, 2017 and have obtained customs certification documents will be allowed to re-enter the United States after temporarily leaving the country; (4) Chinese (non-Chinese workers) who hold Chinese government documents in English stating that they have the right to enter the United States according to the contract are allowed to enter the United States; (5) Chinese who enter the United States without proper channels will be deported according to the judgment of a U.S. court after the passage of this bill; (6) After that, no state or federal court will allow Chinese to naturalize as U.S. citizens. After this law was signed, many Chinese workers had to live in foreign lands for the rest of their lives. The Chinese Exclusion Act of 1882 was just the beginning. In 1884, the U.S. Chinese Exclusion Supplementary Act made new provisions. Chinese people and their descendants from all over the world will always be treated as Chinese. Regardless of whether they have become citizens of other countries (such as British or French nationality), if they want to come to the United States, they must be subject to the restrictions of the U.S. Chinese Exclusion Supplementary Act, and they must return to the country they came from. Since then, anti-Chinese actions have become more and more intense. In 1888, the U.S. government enacted the "Scott Act", which stipulated that after Chinese workers left the United States, they were not allowed to return to the United States regardless of whether they had documents or not. As a result, more than 20,000 Chinese workers who are currently returning to China to visit relatives cannot return to the United States. During this period, "Chinese exclusion" became a fashionable slogan for American political parties to win votes. At this point, the number of Chinese going to the United States dropped sharply, reaching the lowest level in 1887, with only 10 people. In May 1892, Congress passed the "Geary Act", a "habeas corpus law" that deprived the Chinese. Provision was made to extend the Chinese Exclusion Act of 1882, which prohibited the entry of Chinese laborers, for 10 years. Cancel the habeas corpus order for Chinese people, and Chinese people are not allowed to apply for bail. This case deprived the Chinese of their right to personal protection (habeas corpus) and completely lost their basic judicial rights. Moreover, within one year of the passage of the bill, all Chinese workers in the United States must apply for a residence permit. Those who still do not have a residence permit after one year will be arrested and deported. Anyone who enters the country illegally will be imprisoned for five years and will be deported after serving the sentence. On May 15, 1893, the U.S. Supreme Court held in its ruling in the case of "Kwong Yiu Ting v. Government of the United States" that the right of the United States (through its Congress) to exclude and expel aliens, either absolutely or conditionally, "is an inherent and inalienable right of every sovereign and independent nation." In 1894, the Qing government signed a "Ten-year Treaty Prohibiting Chinese Labor from Entering the United States" with the United States. This treaty expired in 1904. Congress also enacted legislation on April 27, 1904, to indefinitely extend the Chinese Exclusion Act (referring to the law signed in 1894) that should take effect immediately, and prohibit Chinese workers from entering the American continent from Hawaii, the Philippines and other US-controlled areas. This led to the historic patriotic movement across China to boycott American goods. In the early days, the anti-Chinese movement in the United States was just sporadic mob-style attacks, robberies, and murders. Later, it evolved into an organized, institutional, and comprehensive action promoted by the government. The main anti-Chinese elements were originally limited to the working class and expanded to the parliament and city government. In order to win workers' votes, politicians sacrificed the interests of the Chinese to gain favor. And the object of rejection. The driving force behind this entire action is racial discrimination. Influenced by the social Darwinism of the time, white Americans in the 19th century believed that they were the "superior" nation and the Chinese were the "inferior" nation, so they were excluded from American territory. This was of course racial prejudice. However, at that time, the Manchu Qing government was corrupt and incompetent, faced with internal and external troubles, and was unable to protect overseas Chinese in the United States. As a result, tragedies for many overseas Chinese continued to occur. From then until the repeal of the Chinese Exclusion Act in 1943, the number of Chinese declined rapidly. In 1880, before the Chinese Exclusion Act was passed, it was 105,465. After 60 years, the Chinese population had dropped to 77,504 in 1940, accounting for 0.06% of the U.S. population. In addition, I saw a paragraph in "The Vicissitudes of the Chinese in the United States" compiled by Chen Ruzhou and Chen Yingfu: "There is also a similar anti-Chinese provision in the Arizona Constitution. Chinese people along the railway towns must leave the town when the sun goes down. Otherwise, they will be imprisoned for the night and will not be free until daylight. It was not until 1982 when the Ancestral Association of the Same Origin initiated a petition, and Governor Gasol deleted this ordinance." It is also a courageous and responsible attitude for the U.S. Senate to apologize for the injustice 130 years later and return belated justice to Chinese immigrants.

9889c3f741a55593408a631594eaa620d72055b6.translatedText: Conservatives in Arizona push the bill and the governor vetoes China News Service, February 28 According to British media reports on the 27th, Arizona Governor Bruce...

3f2aae901239ca6a326277e6c5c6c5370f896eae.sourceText: 中新网2月28日电 据英国媒体27日报道，美国亚利桑那州州长布鲁尔否决了反同性恋法案。该法案允许企业雇主以宗教信仰为由，拒绝为同性恋顾客提供服务。
3f2aae901239ca6a326277e6c5c6c5370f896eae.translatedText: China News Service, February 28 According to British media reports on the 27th, Arizona Governor Brewer vetoed the anti-gay bill. The bill allows employers to refuse service to gay customers on the basis of religious beliefs.

4653109f115f6776ba449ddd7ed60ababda11235.sourceText: 布鲁尔表示，该法案可能带来”意外和负面的后果”。
4653109f115f6776ba449ddd7ed60ababda11235.translatedText: Brewer said the bill could have "unintended and negative consequences."

909decf7aba673864a19bea2b81518d0a6465af0.sourceText: 反同性恋法案被某些社会保守人士称为保护宗教自由的法案。但反对人士批评说，这是将反同性恋歧视行为合法化。
909decf7aba673864a19bea2b81518d0a6465af0.translatedText: The anti-gay bill is called a bill to protect religious freedom by some social conservatives. But opponents criticized it as legitimizing anti-gay discrimination.

bd0ec97c65bdbe1c3be252265f09cf6b745f1e17.sourceText: 商业团体警告说，法案将对亚利桑那州的声誉带来损害，并会阻碍其它公司将业务搬迁至亚利桑那州。
bd0ec97c65bdbe1c3be252265f09cf6b745f1e17.translatedText: Business groups warned that the bill would harm Arizona's reputation and discourage other companies from moving operations to Arizona.

ad70500b5ebe062ad9ec24f2f134a672d022fa2d.sourceText: 布鲁尔对记者表示，该法案并不解决与亚利桑那州宗教自由有关的问题。
ad70500b5ebe062ad9ec24f2f134a672d022fa2d.translatedText: Brewer told reporters that the bill does not address issues related to religious freedom in Arizona.

0bf1cc7ba38642bc9281626c67000e74c56615b9.sourceText: 她说，从未听说亚利桑那州有企业雇主的宗教自由被侵犯的事情。
0bf1cc7ba38642bc9281626c67000e74c56615b9.translatedText: She said she had never heard of a corporate employer’s religious freedom being violated in Arizona.

90289ead7e050e39c990e9833ed83d8ec970bc8d.sourceText: 布鲁尔说，否决这个法案，是因为她相信该法案”带来的问题比解决的问题更多”，法案可能令亚利桑那州出现分歧，这是令人无法想象，也不希望发生的事情。
90289ead7e050e39c990e9833ed83d8ec970bc8d.translatedText: Brewer said she vetoed the bill because she believed the bill "creates more problems than it solves." The bill could divide Arizona, which is unimaginable and undesirable.

fa1cde83efba89c3d5e42ad590c4a154881f1342.sourceText: 在否决该法案后，布鲁尔将与商业团体在这个问题上的立场一致，这些企业包括英特尔、万豪、美国职棒大联盟、亚利桑那州商会等。
fa1cde83efba89c3d5e42ad590c4a154881f1342.translatedText: In vetoing the bill, Brewer would align himself with business groups on the issue, including Intel, Marriott, Major League Baseball, the Arizona Chamber of Commerce and others.

9e68fa0e83b1aad8c0c2f82220fdb6798e8e0d13.sourceText: 当布鲁尔宣布否决该法案时，亚利桑那州议会大厦立刻爆发出欢呼声。
9e68fa0e83b1aad8c0c2f82220fdb6798e8e0d13.translatedText: When Brewer announced his veto of the bill, the Arizona Capitol immediately erupted in cheers.

635ffd4aaa5a5b8799ffe3267d8c124294146f81.sourceText: 亚利桑那州平等机会主席魏宁格表示，否决反同性恋法案向那些用宗教为借口的人士，发出了一个明确的信息，即”我们已受够了歧视的对待”。
635ffd4aaa5a5b8799ffe3267d8c124294146f81.translatedText: Arizona Equal Opportunity Chairman Weininger said that vetoing the anti-gay bill sends a clear message to those who use religion as an excuse that "we have had enough of discriminatory treatment."

3045ef40ccfbf986d668e916ed80c167d62393ea.translatedText: Chinese capital acquires the sailing ship "Ocean Goddess" to promote marine ecology and environmental protection (pictures) Ocean Goddess...

776fef2f465655675300ea762bd9550eeaa85d7b.sourceText: （AACFY洛杉矶讯）华资企业”龙的船人国际航海俱乐部”收购”海洋女神号”帆船后，将这艘在北美主流社会具有相当知名度的动力帆船，用于航海系列公益活动，宣传海洋生态环保理念。在今年6月南加州主流社区”世界海洋日”宣传活动中，”海洋女神号”帆船当天举办的首航活动，成为华人社区唯一参与的大型团队。活动协办机构为美国《中华商报》和全美中华青年联合会。
776fef2f465655675300ea762bd9550eeaa85d7b.translatedText: (AACFY Los Angeles News) After the Chinese-owned enterprise "Dragon Boatman International Sailing Club" acquired the "Ocean Goddess" sailing ship, it will use this power sailing boat, which is quite well-known in mainstream society in North America, for a series of sailing charity activities to promote the concept of marine ecology and environmental protection. In the "World Oceans Day" promotion event in mainstream communities in Southern California in June this year, the "Ocean Goddess" sailing ship held its maiden voyage on that day and became the only large-scale team from the Chinese community to participate. The co-organizers of the event are the American "China Business Daily" and the National Chinese Youth Federation.

4f7125b1536ce2a3bf6c4bc90d10c84ab94d22b2.sourceText: 凤凰城地区房价有所上涨 独立屋仍低于去年同期 凤凰城地区9月房地产破产屋销售量大幅回落。 亚利桑那州立大学（ASU）凯瑞商学院对此做了研究。 9月份销售量近8000低于八月份大约的9250，比2010年9月的销售量稍微大一些。 ” 仔细研究9月和8月的数据，就能发现销售回落其中43%都是因为破产屋数量的减少”ASU杰巴特教授说。 这些数据也说明，在经济和房市不确定的情况下，正常销售的房屋市场依然薄弱。 同时交易市场显示，投资者成为最主要的买家，而不是自住和第一次买房者，或者是房屋升级的人士。 独立屋均价9月份为125，000美元，8月为120，000美元，价格有所提升但是依然比去年的135，000美元低。 公寓的均价也有所提高，今年是76，700比去年同期增加了1200美元。 价格的提高仍然是与破产屋数量减少有关。 去年9月是555个破产屋，今年市场上上只有325个。 更多房地产问题请咨询Tinna 480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
4f7125b1536ce2a3bf6c4bc90d10c84ab94d22b2.translatedText: Phoenix area home prices have increased, single-family homes are still lower than the same period last year. Real estate bankruptcy sales in the Phoenix area fell sharply in September. Arizona State University (ASU) Carey Business School did a study on this. The nearly 8,000 sales in September were down from about 9,250 in August, and were slightly larger than the sales in September 2010. " A careful study of the data in September and August shows that 43% of the decline in sales is due to the decrease in the number of bankrupt homes," said Professor Jebat of ASU. These data also show that under the circumstances of economic and housing market uncertainty, the normal sales housing market is still weak. At the same time, the transaction market shows that investors have become the main buyers, rather than owner-occupiers and first-time home buyers, or people who are upgrading their homes. The average price of a detached house was $125,000 in September and $120,000 in August. The price has increased but is still lower than last year's $135,000. The average price of an apartment has also increased, which is $76,700 this year, an increase of $1,200 from the same period last year. The increase in prices is still related to the decrease in the number of bankrupt houses. There were 555 bankrupt houses in September last year, and there are only 325 on the market. 1b451eef462961092ac5496733dc04bf80ff122a.sourceText: 美国司机最经常犯的错误？维修汽车要注意
1b451eef462961092ac5496733dc04bf80ff122a.translatedText: The most common mistake American drivers make? What should you pay attention to when repairing your car?

69c230f4429422ab17716d0709e3ab2bb8480a13.sourceText: 美国司机最经常犯的错误？维修汽车要注意 对于大多数消费者来说，汽车是第二最大的投资，但是，很多人不懂得如何…
69c230f4429422ab17716d0709e3ab2bb8480a13.translatedText: What are the most common mistakes made by American drivers? Pay attention to car repairs. For most consumers, cars are the second largest investment, but many people don’t know how to...

1fa409d20cbd8b1a42c447b9d613f471505f011a.sourceText: 对于大多数消费者来说，汽车是第二最大的投资，但是，很多人不懂得如何好好保养汽车，除非出现了任何的问题。
1fa409d20cbd8b1a42c447b9d613f471505f011a.translatedText: For most consumers, cars are the second largest investment, but many people don’t know how to maintain their cars well unless there are any problems.

c048a994be1176a91c8ade8631eb30b2f91a49bc.sourceText: 汽车销售副总裁布莱恩(BrianHafer)说，尤其是年轻的司机，首次拥有汽车的人士，他们更加不懂维护和保养车辆。
c048a994be1176a91c8ade8631eb30b2f91a49bc.translatedText: Brian Hafer, vice president of automobile sales, said that especially young drivers, those who own cars for the first time, do not know how to maintain and maintain their vehicles.

b0c14a6be6774b84240b8ee0f86bc1ed6352aaad.sourceText: 布莱恩说：”很多车主也不会遵守说明书的维护计划，发生任何情况，只会找车行维修，并不会自行查看使用说明书。”
b0c14a6be6774b84240b8ee0f86bc1ed6352aaad.translatedText: Brian said: "Many car owners will not follow the maintenance plan in the manual. If anything happens, they will only go to the car dealer for repairs and will not check the instruction manual themselves."

96769013f985f9edcb909d5c01a6110ee68adbb5.sourceText: 现时的汽车灵件可能更加复杂，忽略汽车显示的警告标志可能会导致汽车磨损，甚至使汽车坏掉。
96769013f985f9edcb909d5c01a6110ee68adbb5.translatedText: Today's car parts may be more complicated. Ignoring the warning signs displayed on the car may cause wear and tear on the car, or even cause the car to break down.

5b4a2f214bcd45a8f843366f9fb345562420e444.sourceText: 网站Bankrate进行一项调查，所有的成本根据汽车网站AutoMD.com，以2010年的本田雅阁2.4EX-L车款来计算，找出汽车坏掉的4种最常见的方法。
5b4a2f214bcd45a8f843366f9fb345562420e444.translatedText: The website Bankrate conducted a survey. All costs were calculated based on the 2010 Honda Accord 2.4EX-L model according to the automotive website AutoMD.com to find out the 4 most common ways the car breaks down.

55c6ad85f6428416a1884b1346f95f2b56a5999b.translatedText: (1) Not checking or changing the car's oil

9623fe691fc1772ca0eab19cabb206c3e26f39bd.sourceText: 布莱恩指出，汽车换油的问题是最常见的，也是较为昂贵的汽车维修问题。
9623fe691fc1772ca0eab19cabb206c3e26f39bd.translatedText: Brian pointed out that car oil change is the most common and expensive car repair problem.

636d6aa0414076d59f8983816073efa57c150d3e.sourceText: 如果汽车不定期更换机油，有机会达到危险的低水平，机油是汽车发动机的命脉。
636d6aa0414076d59f8983816073efa57c150d3e.translatedText: If your car's oil is not changed regularly, there is a chance that it will reach dangerously low levels. Oil is the lifeblood of your car's engine.

8f80777d863b6f92105450aafc4b8c3629ee2d16.sourceText: 每隔几週，应该检查机油的水平，以免油缸水位过低或漏油。
8f80777d863b6f92105450aafc4b8c3629ee2d16.translatedText: Every few weeks, the oil level should be checked to prevent low water levels or oil leakage in the cylinder.

6631a0c5719be5ddef653b0911c81996bbf8be4a.sourceText: 布莱恩说，随著发动机的滚动，机油将会逐渐耗尽，如果没有定期更换机油，发动机将会磨损。
6631a0c5719be5ddef653b0911c81996bbf8be4a.translatedText: Brian said that as the engine rolls, the oil will gradually be used up, and if the oil is not changed regularly, the engine will wear out.

59d38a63b418ee46e98639d328d432967f8d9be4.sourceText: 不同汽车的使用说明书写上更换机油的建议时间，驾驶多少英里或多少个月，必须要更换机油。
59d38a63b418ee46e98639d328d432967f8d9be4.translatedText: The operating instructions of different cars state the recommended time to change the oil, and how many miles or months of driving the oil must be changed.

3a117fbcf1053e6846a7acdfc184fac1c6fe5f6f.sourceText: 汽车维修公司换机油的费用大约为39.99美元。
3a117fbcf1053e6846a7acdfc184fac1c6fe5f6f.translatedText: An oil change at a car repair company costs approximately $39.99.

2428a464f85325b1938a4d436f386f00b1788b54.sourceText: 更换空气过滤器是其他日常的汽车保养琐事，不过，很多车主也不按照使用说明书而忽略了这一项保养。
2428a464f85325b1938a4d436f386f00b1788b54.translatedText: Replacing the air filter is another daily car maintenance chore. However, many car owners do not follow the instruction manual and ignore this maintenance.

f746fe2aeb950b5f06003f1fd8566056a7c4332c.sourceText: 空气滤清器是发动机的气流运作的主要关口，当汽车的气流受到限制，可以降低汽车的性能。
f746fe2aeb950b5f06003f1fd8566056a7c4332c.translatedText: The air filter is the main gateway for the engine's airflow operation. When the car's airflow is restricted, it can reduce the car's performance.

e04d3b6e139bf285f9f589f9d9e90e367e251a32.sourceText: 布莱恩说：”汽车的引擎需要洁净的空气，如果过滤器有污垢，气流受到限制，可能会导致发动机过热，这将要花费更多的维修费用。”
e04d3b6e139bf285f9f589f9d9e90e367e251a32.translatedText: Brian said: "A car's engine needs clean air. If the filter is dirty and the air flow is restricted, it may cause the engine to overheat, which will cost more to repair."

117ea0a1df7c5ebc4956a8a7317f580bb1586691.sourceText: 然而，更换汽车的空气过滤器的成本大约为35美元。
117ea0a1df7c5ebc4956a8a7317f580bb1586691.translatedText: However, the cost of replacing a car's air filter is about $35.

52322b814f2e008da3bb9ab94c754c51c6e7f9ec.sourceText: 如果剎车的时候，发现有响亮的声音，这可能是一个讯号，尽早更换剎车系统。
52322b814f2e008da3bb9ab94c754c51c6e7f9ec.translatedText: If there is a loud sound when braking, this may be a signal to replace the brake system as soon as possible.

0ee5b551ebe54be6724f047d9a0ec34b143f0a54.sourceText: 当剎车系统有问题，最终减慢车轮的转动失效，造成危险。
0ee5b551ebe54be6724f047d9a0ec34b143f0a54.translatedText: When there is a problem with the braking system, it will eventually slow down the rotation of the wheel and cause danger.

47d3d99c309bde3a3186b7fdc8b02ab4a4db2496.sourceText: 布莱恩说：?#24403;剎车的垫使用太多，受到磨损，影响剎车的系统，因此必须定期进行检查。?BR> 由于不同的驾驶习惯，并没有规定的里程来更换剎车系统。
47d3d99c309bde3a3186b7fdc8b02ab4a4db2496.translatedText: Brian said: The brake pads are used too much and are worn, which affects the braking system, so they must be checked regularly. ?BR> Due to different driving habits, there is no specified mileage to replace the brake system.

06f7076c7593f96f9976ad497d8da031eab990ed.sourceText: 但是，布莱恩建议，平均驾驶大约20,000至25,000英里，需要更换剎车系统，一般费用大约250美元。
06f7076c7593f96f9976ad497d8da031eab990ed.translatedText: However, Brian suggested that on average, around 20,000 to 25,000 miles of driving, the brake system will need to be replaced, which typically costs about $250.

1f1f9ba22e177f8d9227ab5abb366be16fe9f36a.sourceText: 无论室外的温度是90度，100度或是低于冰点时，均对汽车的运作有所影响。
1f1f9ba22e177f8d9227ab5abb366be16fe9f36a.translatedText: Whether the outdoor temperature is 90 degrees, 100 degrees or below freezing, it will have an impact on the operation of the car.

78cab1dc52e906fa9298e52aba57a4068253e0ec.sourceText: 布莱恩说，汽车曝露在极端的气温下，可以是汽车杀手，因此，进行定期的汽车保养更加重要。
78cab1dc52e906fa9298e52aba57a4068253e0ec.translatedText: Bryan said that exposure to extreme temperatures can be a car killer, so regular car maintenance is even more important.

92937ed49fd6a4a23e1b18b6bcf95457c26543c6.sourceText: 强烈的阳光和高温下，汽车的外壳将会受到损害，通常也加重冷却系统的压力，增加磨损。
92937ed49fd6a4a23e1b18b6bcf95457c26543c6.translatedText: Under strong sunlight and high temperature, the car's outer shell will be damaged, which usually also increases the pressure on the cooling system and increases wear and tear.

111718fd83568acff67eba1a59f22fb10233c9eb.sourceText: 为汽车加上遮光的玻璃窗，或加上遮光板盖著整个挡风玻璃，可以最大限度地减少汽车内部的损坏。
111718fd83568acff67eba1a59f22fb10233c9eb.translatedText: Adding blackout glass windows to your car, or adding sunshades that cover the entire windshield, can minimize damage to your car's interior.

15121dd361357e47134fae1eaf802ff09b286cef.sourceText: 在极端寒冷的天气下，驾驶之前，应该先让发动机啟动一下，使机油通过发动机而流动顺畅。
15121dd361357e47134fae1eaf802ff09b286cef.translatedText: In extremely cold weather, before driving, you should start the engine to allow the oil to flow smoothly through the engine.

81980a2d2178e9b9d68ea911fb95b7202ebe9e4a.sourceText: 发动机加热器的类型和成本不同，零部件和安装的成本大约为175美元。
81980a2d2178e9b9d68ea911fb95b7202ebe9e4a.translatedText: Engine heaters vary in type and cost, with parts and installation costing approximately $175.

8e781d6a5e9ecc14e551c3daa52ef18602e92e47.sourceText: 另外，每隔24个月至36个月，更换发动机的冷却液，花费大约90美元。
8e781d6a5e9ecc14e551c3daa52ef18602e92e47.translatedText: In addition, it costs about US$90 to replace the engine coolant every 24 months to 36 months.

276763954245eb12eb098e382330fa1cec43dd8e.sourceText: 在极端天气下，汽车停泊在车库内是最佳的解决方案。
276763954245eb12eb098e382330fa1cec43dd8e.translatedText: In extreme weather, parking your car in a garage is the best solution.

a8fd683cb7510324193c7accd5bbc54a9912526a.sourceText: 凤凰城中文学校的春节园游会在二月十日中午於美莎社区大学顺利举行。参加人数多达二百餘人。 上午十一时，宾客已纷纷到场品嚐家长们悉心烹调的正宗中菜和台湾小吃，如油饭、萝卜糕、台式香肠、滷肉饭、肉羹汤、臭豆腐、豆花、滷味、茶叶蛋、波霸奶茶?#31561;等。近正午时，扬声器播出节奏强劲的Red Hot Salsa，火热动感即时爆发，辣妈美女们由闻玲琳老师带领下表演婀娜多姿的排舞，全红的上衣加上熟练的舞步，赢尽全场掌声。接著是醒狮贺岁，贵宾们更是送上红包奖赏祥狮，喜气洋洋。 大会司仪陈彦文先生及夫人黄雅丽女士以中、粤、英文与全场观眾拜年后，正式宣佈园游会表演开始。随即便介绍新一任董事会召集人谢健明先生致词。谢校董先鸣谢VIP贵宾的来临，会场贵宾都是重量级人物，有美莎社区大学校长潘寿安博士，多位侨领侨商如余文劲先生、丘顺雄先生、张华芳女士、邓朝驹先生等，多年慷慨赞助学校的眼科圣手Dr. Mark Page 伉儷，徐凯莱女士 ，亚省时报甄社长及太阳鸟网站代表。更难得的是希望中文学校的董事长黄双双女士, 前董事李建民先生和前校长帅致若也到场支持，可见两间中文学校同气连枝。言谢贵宾后，更多谢校董会的支持，学校行政人员的全力配合、义务工作人员的帮忙，父母们对中文学校的坚持，老师们的贡献和校长的领导。 然后将致词的时间交给”超棒校长”程秀玲女士。為表示对老师的敬意及表扬老师们的贡献，程校长逐一点名介绍每班老师出场列阵。程校长脸上流露一片欣然和自豪，希望学生们能收到尊师重道的讯息。 校长致词后，校方更邀请五位贵宾演讲，首先是潘寿安校长的演说，简洁地交代了美莎社区大学及凤凰城中文学校的关係，潘校长重申会继续全力支持中文学校及推广中华文化。接著是资深侨领余文劲先生，已届八十六高龄的余先生仍然热衷社会活动，对凤凰城中文学校更有一种特殊的情谊，余先生回馈社会的无私精神乃华人典范。第三位出场的丘顺雄先生冠称其餘四位致词贵宾為四大天王，自己的演词并不重要。这种谦厚的态度，尽量发挥了中华传统不浮夸，实事实干的高尚情操。然后是张华芳女士上场，她提醒在美土生土长的孩子不要迷失自己，无论父母祖籍何处，体内流著中华民族的血是一种光荣，龙的传人是优秀的民族，在场华人听得热血沸腾，一种禁不住的优越感油然而生。最后的致词贵宾邓朝驹先生呼唤大家要努力培训下一代的接班人，造就社会， 令华人在美更加发光发亮，达到薪火相传之效。 听罢贵宾的致词，各班学生先后表演，有的唱歌，有的奏乐，有的跳舞，有的绕口令，更有传统民俗童玩介绍及示范，各式各样。虽然各班在台上表演只有短短几分鐘，老师和同学们却已苦练多时。 校方也安排了两位少年武术爱好者，Wilson Wong 及 Justin Lee 表演大刀。习武尚浅的他们挥刀时却已经有板有眼，威风八面。太极名师杨永庆先生也带领多名资深学员到场示范太极拳及太极剑，马步沉稳有劲，拳出时柔时刚，吐纳自如，尽显太极神髓。 经过两个多小时的精采表演，程校长向所有到场的人答谢，并祝贺大家蛇年行大运，园游会在欢乐的气氛下完满结束。 如果您想多认识凤凰城中文学校，或是想加入这个大家庭，请与校长程秀玲联络(480-620-1982) 或参观学校网页( http://clsphoenix.org/ )。
a8fd683cb7510324193c7accd5bbc54a9912526a.translatedText: The Spring Festival garden party of Phoenix Chinese School was successfully held at Mesa Community College at noon on February 10th. There were more than 200 participants. At 11 a.m., guests have arrived to taste the authentic Chinese dishes and Taiwanese snacks carefully prepared by the parents, such as fried rice, carrot cake, Taiwanese sausage, braised pork rice, meat soup, stinky tofu, tofu curd, braised meat, tea eggs, Boba milk tea?#31561;, etc. At nearly noon, the loudspeaker played Red Hot Salsa with a strong rhythm, and the fiery dynamic broke out immediately. The hot beauties, led by teacher Wen Linglin, performed a graceful line dance. Their all-red tops and skillful dance steps won applause from the audience. Then came the lion awakening to celebrate the New Year, and the distinguished guests were filled with joy as they gave red envelopes to reward the auspicious lions. The emcee of the conference, Mr. Chen Yanwen and his wife, Ms. Huang Yali, officially announced the start of the garden party performance after greeting the entire audience in Chinese, Cantonese and English. Then Mr. Xie Jianming, the new convener of the board of directors, was introduced and delivered a speech. Director Xie first thanked the VIP guests for coming. The distinguished guests at the venue were all heavyweights, including Dr. Pan Shou'an, the president of Mesa Community College, many overseas Chinese businessmen such as Mr. Yu Wenjin, Mr. Qiu Shunxiong, Ms. Zhang Huafang, Mr. Deng Chaoju, etc. Dr. Mark Page, the ophthalmologist who has generously sponsored the school for many years, Ms. Xu Kailai, the president of the Alberta Times and the representative of the Sunbird website. What's even more rare is that Ms. Huang Shuangshuang, the chairman of Hope Chinese School, Mr. Li Jianmin, the former director, and Shuai Zhiruo, the former principal, also came to support, which shows that the two Chinese schools are in the same spirit. After thanking the distinguished guests, I would like to thank the school board for its support, the school administrators for their full cooperation, the volunteer staff for their help, the parents for their persistence in the Chinese school, the teachers for their contributions and the principal's leadership. Then the time for the speech was given to the "superb principal" Ms. Cheng Xiuling. In order to show respect to the teachers and praise their contributions, Principal Cheng introduced the teachers of each class one by one to appear in the lineup. Principal Cheng's face showed joy and pride, hoping that students would receive the message of respecting teachers. After the principal's speech, the school invited five distinguished guests to give speeches. First, President Pan Shou'an's speech briefly explained the relationship between Mesa Community College and Phoenix Chinese School. President Pan reiterated that he would continue to fully support Chinese schools and promote Chinese culture. Next is Mr. Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader. At the age of 86, Mr. Yu is still keen on social activities and has a special affection for Phoenix Chinese School. Mr. Yu’s selfless spirit of giving back to the society is a model for the Chinese. Mr. Qiu Shunxiong, who appeared third, called the other four distinguished guests the Four Heavenly Kings. His own speech was not important. This kind of humble attitude maximizes the noble sentiment of the Chinese tradition of not being exaggerated and being practical. Then Ms. Zhang Huafang came on stage. She reminded children born and raised in the United States not to lose themselves. No matter where their parents are from, it is an honor to have the blood of the Chinese nation flowing in their bodies. The descendants of the dragon are an excellent nation. The Chinese people present listened with enthusiasm, and an uncontrollable sense of superiority arose spontaneously. The guest of honor at the end, Mr. Deng Chaoju, called on everyone to work hard to train the next generation of successors and build up society so that the Chinese people in the United States can shine more brightly and achieve the effect of passing on the torch from generation to generation. After listening to the distinguished guest's speech, the students from each class performed one after another, some singing, some playing music, some dancing, some tongue twisters, and even introducing and demonstrating traditional folk children's games. Although each class only performed on stage for a few minutes, the teachers and students had been practicing hard for a long time. The school also arranged for two young martial arts enthusiasts, Wilson Wong and Justin Lee, to perform machete performances. Even though they were relatively new to martial arts, they wielded their swords with determination and authority. Mr. Yang Yongqing, a famous Tai Chi master, also led many senior students to demonstrate Tai Chi and Tai Chi sword. The horse's steps were steady and powerful, the punches were soft and hard when released, and the breathing and breathing were free, fully demonstrating the essence of Tai Chi. After more than two hours of wonderful performances, Principal Cheng thanked everyone present and wished everyone good luck in the Year of the Snake. The garden party ended successfully in a joyful atmosphere. If you want to know more about Phoenix Chinese School or want to join this big family, please contact the principal Cheng Xiuling (480-620-1982) or visit the school website ( http://clsphoenix.org/ ).

a4449ba3b7c69c4d301f72d188af7894e9c55f15.sourceText: 中国多地降雨量破历史极值 中国多地正在遭受新一轮强降雨。截至目前，中国陕西、四川、重庆、贵州、河南、湖北等多省市已出现大范围暴雨，局地雨量破历史极值。中国气象局、国家防汛抗旱总指挥部办公室针对此次降雨分别启动重大气象灾害(暴雨)Ⅲ级应急响应、防汛Ⅳ级应急响应。 气象观测资料显示，25日08时-26日08时，陕西关中地区和东南部、四川东北部、重庆北部、贵州中东部、河南大部、安徽西南部、湖北中西部、湖南西北部和江西北部等地出现暴雨或大暴雨天气，上述大部地区降雨量有50～80毫米。其中，河南中部和西南部达100～247毫米，湖北中部100～181毫米，重庆北部100～179毫米，湖南西北部100～167毫米，陕西关中地区100～127毫米，贵州中部局地100～130毫米。 25日，陕西关中地区、河南中部、湖北中西部局地等34个国家级气象观测站点日降雨量超过历史5月份同期极值。其中，西安市昨日降雨量达到66.5毫米，突破原历史极值57.9毫米(1987年5月25日)，开封市打破了1974年以来5月下旬50毫米的降水纪录。 中央气象台5月26日10时继续发布暴雨黄色预警，预计未来24小时，山东中东部和南部、江苏、安徽、浙江西部、江西大部、湖南东南部、福建西部、广西东部、广东中西部等地的部分地区有暴雨，其中局地有100～200毫米的大暴雨。 据了解，国家防总于26日上午召开商会，对广东、广西、福建、湖南等10多个省份的省、市、县三级防汛值守情况进行了抽查，江西、贵州等省防指和长江、珠江防总先后启动了防汛Ⅳ级应急响应。 与此同时，中央气象台也进行了加密会商，风云二号F星启动高频次区域观测，观测频次为每6分钟一次。湖北、山东、贵州、湖南、江苏、广东等省气象局在接到25日重大气象灾害(暴雨)Ⅲ级应急响应命令后，根据本省对强降水过程的研判进入到相应应急响应级别，并通过多种途径向公众发布暴雨预警信息。 中央气象台首席预报员马学款表示，这次强降水过程影响范围较大，该天气系统从四川盆地东部移出，向东北方向发展，移动速度适中，整个过程持续时间较长，将影响到贵州、江南、华南等地。在西南东部、江南、华南会出雷雨大风和冰雹等强对流天气。
a4449ba3b7c69c4d301f72d188af7894e9c55f15.translatedText: The rainfall in many places in China has exceeded historical extremes. Many places in China are suffering from a new round of heavy rainfall. Up to now, large-scale heavy rains have occurred in many provinces and cities in China, including Shaanxi, Sichuan, Chongqing, Guizhou, Henan, and Hubei, and local rainfall has exceeded historical extremes. The China Meteorological Administration and the Office of the National Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters launched Level III emergency response for major meteorological disasters (heavy rain) and Level IV emergency response for flood control respectively in response to this rainfall. Meteorological observation data show that from 08:00 on the 25th to 08:00 on the 26th, heavy rains or heavy rains occurred in the Guanzhong region and southeastern Shaanxi, northeastern Sichuan, northern Chongqing, central and eastern Guizhou, most of Henan, southwestern Anhui, central and western Hubei, northwestern Hunan and northern Jiangxi. Most of the above areas experienced rainfall of 50 to 80 mm. Among them, it reaches 100-247 mm in central and southwestern Henan, 100-181 mm in central Hubei, 100-179 mm in northern Chongqing, 100-167 mm in northwest Hunan, 100-127 mm in the Guanzhong area of ​​Shaanxi, and 100-130 mm in central Guizhou. On the 25th, the daily rainfall at 34 national-level meteorological observation stations including the Guanzhong area of ​​Shaanxi, central Henan, and central and western Hubei exceeded the historical extreme value for the same period in May. Among them, Xi'an City's rainfall reached 66.5 mm yesterday, breaking the original historical extreme value of 57.9 mm (May 25, 1987). Kaifeng City broke the 50 mm precipitation record in late May since 1974. The Central Meteorological Observatory will continue to issue yellow rainstorm warnings at 10:00 on May 26. It is expected that in the next 24 hours, there will be heavy rains in parts of central and southern Shandong, Jiangsu, Anhui, western Zhejiang, most of Jiangxi, southeastern Hunan, western Fujian, eastern Guangxi, and central and western Guangdong, including local heavy rains of 100 to 200 mm. It is understood that the National Defense Headquarters held a chamber of commerce on the morning of the 26th to conduct spot checks on the provincial, municipal, and county flood control duties in more than 10 provinces, including Guangdong, Guangxi, Fujian, and Hunan. Jiangxi, Guizhou, and other provinces’ flood control headquarters and the Yangtze River and Pearl River Flood Control Headquarters have successively launched flood control level IV emergency responses. At the same time, the Central Meteorological Observatory also conducted intensive discussions, and the Fengyun-2F star launched high-frequency sub-regional observations, with the observation frequency being once every 6 minutes. After receiving the Level III emergency response order for major meteorological disasters (heavy rain) on the 25th, the provincial meteorological bureaus of Hubei, Shandong, Guizhou, Hunan, Jiangsu, and Guangdong entered the corresponding emergency response level based on the province's study and judgment of the heavy precipitation process, and issued heavy rain warning information to the public through various channels. Ma Xuejian, chief forecaster of the Central Meteorological Observatory, said that this heavy precipitation process has a large impact. The weather system moved out of the eastern Sichuan Basin and developed toward the northeast with a moderate moving speed. The entire process lasted for a long time and will affect Guizhou, Jiangnan, South China and other places. Strong convective weather such as thunderstorms, strong winds and hail will occur in the eastern part of the Southwest, Jiangnan, and South China.

cafc07b08be84c901c205287e0fc9decbfee3835.sourceText: （亚利桑那州希望中文学校供稿）中国海外交流协会为了提高华文教学水平，逐步建立起”培训、考核、认证”三位一体的华文教师培训机制，今年又派遣三支《海外华文教育专家巡讲团》到美国各地共15个地区举办华文教师培训活动。全美中文学校协会承办了巡讲团在美国的培训活动
cafc07b08be84c901c205287e0fc9decbfee3835.translatedText: (Contributed by Arizona Hope Chinese School) In order to improve the level of Chinese teaching, the China Overseas Exchange Association has gradually established a trinity of "training, assessment, and certification" Chinese teacher training mechanisms. This year, it dispatched three "overseas Chinese education expert tour groups" to a total of 15 regions across the United States to hold Chinese teacher training activities. The National Association of Chinese Schools undertook the training activities of the tour group in the United States

a7c4c4ecc2327d1fdc0a192f703b6f53bd8680bc.sourceText: 2014年8月24日星期日，由中国海外交流协会选派的四位教育专家莅临凤凰城地区，为本地7所中文学校的中文教师以及热心中文教学的社会人士举行了培训讲座，共有80多位中文教师及热心人士参加了此次讲座。
a7c4c4ecc2327d1fdc0a192f703b6f53bd8680bc.translatedText: On Sunday, August 24, 2014, four education experts selected by the China Overseas Exchange Association visited the Phoenix area and held training lectures for Chinese teachers from 7 local Chinese schools and people who are enthusiastic about Chinese teaching. A total of more than 80 Chinese teachers and enthusiasts attended the lecture.

02245ba1e3882361a3d05697f12af5091ea902c4.sourceText: 以希望中文学校为主、现代中文学校、凤凰城华人基督教会中文学校、斐匿中文学校等配合，承办了在凤凰城的本次教师培训活动。这天一大早，美丽的MCC校园还沉浸在周末的一片静谧之中，参加培训的教师们已经陆续抵达了会场。主办方为各位教师准备了精美丰富的甜点，让大家精神饱满的投入到听课中。
02245ba1e3882361a3d05697f12af5091ea902c4.translatedText: Hope Chinese School, Modern Chinese School, Phoenix Chinese Christian Church Chinese School, Feinian Chinese School, etc. undertook this teacher training event in Phoenix. Early that morning, the beautiful MCC campus was still immersed in the quietness of the weekend, and teachers participating in the training had already arrived at the venue one after another. The organizer prepared exquisite and rich desserts for all the teachers, so that everyone could devote themselves to the lectures with full energy.

d4a88b1a6d940ff8fa0279187c94f586ddbe5158.sourceText: 全美中文学校协会会长帅致若女士首先向大家隆重介绍了本次国侨办的讲师团成员，他们分别是：中国海外交流协会领队谢国桥先生、北京语言大学副教授隋岩博士、北京语言大学副教授程龙博士、北京市翠微小学高级教师张迎春。接着向大家说明了本地的几所会员学校负责人成立的组委会为这次培训活动所做的接待和组织动员工作，介绍了组委会主席周青董事长，五位共同主席：朱岩董事长、田韶微校长、田琳校长、沈美京校长、崔增祁校长，以及孟子中文学校刘凤霞校长等。
d4a88b1a6d940ff8fa0279187c94f586ddbe5158.translatedText: > Ms. Shuai Zhiruo, President of the National Association of Chinese Schools, first introduced to everyone the members of the lecturer group of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council. They are: Mr. Xie Guoqiao, leader of the China Overseas Exchange Association, Dr. Sui Yan, associate professor of Beijing Language and Culture University, Dr. Cheng Long, associate professor of Beijing Language and Culture University, and Zhang Yingchun, senior teacher of Beijing Cuiwei Primary School. Then he explained to everyone the reception and organizational mobilization work done by the organizing committee established by the heads of several local member schools for this training event, and introduced the chairman of the organizing committee, Chairman Zhou Qing, and the five co-chairmen: Chairman Zhu Yan, Principal Tian Shaowei, Principal Tian Lin, Principal Shen Meijing, Principal Cui Zengqi, and Principal Liu Fengxia of Mencius Chinese School, etc.

b22a5cc04227daaa830067c2b31ed12013ea0367.sourceText: 接着，首先由来自北京海淀区的小学教师张迎春给大家讲解小学语文的讲课特点和经验。她介绍了很多符合儿童心理发展的、富有特色的课堂教学设计，以及更容易让低年级学生接受的识字方法、阅读方法，以此激发学生的学习兴趣，提高学习成果。
b22a5cc04227daaa830067c2b31ed12013ea0367.translatedText: Next, Zhang Yingchun, a primary school teacher from Haidian District, Beijing, explained to everyone the characteristics and experience of primary school Chinese teaching. She introduced many distinctive classroom teaching designs that are in line with children's psychological development, as well as literacy methods and reading methods that are easier for lower grade students to accept, so as to stimulate students' interest in learning and improve learning outcomes.

198da7eec3007af750922b70531010050b1c8e50.sourceText: 随后，来自北京语言大学的隋老师给大家讲解了中文教学中的字词理解，以及准确应用。隋老师深厚的文字功底，加上幽默风趣的讲解，不时引来老师们阵阵笑声，针对有些字词的不同理解，在坐的本地中文教师还跟隋老师展开了热烈的讨论。
198da7eec3007af750922b70531010050b1c8e50.translatedText: Later, Teacher Sui from Beijing Language and Culture University explained to everyone the understanding of words in Chinese teaching and their accurate application. Teacher Sui's profound writing skills and humorous explanations made the teachers burst into laughter from time to time. Regarding the different understandings of some words, the local Chinese teachers present also had a lively discussion with Teacher Sui.

cd13cffec7512e492c25c290f897bc5d55917869.sourceText: 最后由北京语言大学副教授程龙博士为大家讲解了不同的文化在中文教育中产生的重大影响。程老师引经据典旁征博引的演说，让老师们沉醉其中，为了能给本地的老师们多讲解一些，他于是提出，他继续讲课，让台下的老师们先吃饭。于是，最后出现了台下老师们一边品尝丰富的午餐，一边津津乐道的听着程老师的讲课，真是精神与美食的双重享受啊。
cd13cffec7512e492c25c290f897bc5d55917869.translatedText: Finally, Dr. Cheng Long, associate professor of Beijing Language and Culture University, explained the significant impact of different cultures on Chinese education. Teacher Cheng's speech, which quoted from classics and classics, made the teachers intoxicated. In order to explain more to the local teachers, he proposed that he should continue the lecture and let the teachers in the audience eat first. So, in the end, the teachers in the audience were enjoying the rich lunch while listening to Teacher Cheng's lectures with relish. It was really a double enjoyment of spirit and food.

01027e3bae4e525817fba4e0402a5f3b1fd16fb1.sourceText: 午餐过后，程老师的讲课临近尾声。但是讲座并没有就此结束，本地的中文老师们向三位授课的老师们提出了他们自己的问题，老师们一一做出了精彩的解答，并不时引起大家的热烈讨论。在热烈的气氛中，本次”巡讲团”中文教师培训讲座顺利结束。
01027e3bae4e525817fba4e0402a5f3b1fd16fb1.translatedText: After lunch, Teacher Cheng’s lecture was coming to an end. But the lecture did not end there. The local Chinese teachers raised their own questions to the three teachers. The teachers gave wonderful answers one by one, which caused heated discussions among everyone from time to time. In a warm atmosphere, this "Lecture Tour" Chinese teacher training lecture ended successfully.

13ab9b407f7606578240d6a6b7779e2de580cb25.translatedText: > Zhu Jingwu, the former President of the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and the President of the Taiwan Comprehensive University System, was awarded the American Inventor...

eb5bab7c6847ac8faa0db9a610af51f32d4b79c8.sourceText: 前香港科技大学校长、台湾综合大学系统总校长朱经武，获颁美国发明家学院院士荣誉。
eb5bab7c6847ac8faa0db9a610af51f32d4b79c8.translatedText: The former President of the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and the President of the Taiwan Comprehensive University System, Zhu Jingwu, was awarded the honor of a Fellow of the American Academy of Inventors.

eb424696a6a6f568ce68089e2ab2ccc04bdc414b.sourceText: 前香港科技大学校长、现任台湾综合大学系统总校长朱经武，获颁美国发明家学院（National Academy of Invertors）院士（NAI Charter Fellow）荣誉。
eb424696a6a6f568ce68089e2ab2ccc04bdc414b.translatedText: Zhu Jingwu, former president of the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and current president of the Taiwan Comprehensive University System, was awarded the honor of NAI Charter Fellow of the National Academy of Invertors.

cd235e9ec0578fc57ab291a65d737be834ad7a9e.sourceText: 两个月前接任台综大首任总校长的朱经武，在高温超导材料的研究领域，屡屡创新，开创高温超导研究及应用的新领域，获高度肯定和推荐，获颁此荣誉，将于2月22日在美国佛罗里达州坦帕市南佛罗里达州大学接受表扬和颁奖。
cd235e9ec0578fc57ab291a65d737be834ad7a9e.translatedText: Zhu Jingwu, who took over as the first president of National Taiwan University of Science and Technology two months ago, has repeatedly innovated in the field of high-temperature superconducting material research and created new fields of high-temperature superconducting research and application. He has been highly recognized and recommended. He has been awarded this honor and will receive recognition and awards on February 22 at the University of South Florida in Tampa, Florida, USA.

4ceb92c22f18dee32f3a8e471c8c6afef6350d72.sourceText: 美国国家发明家学院在2013年共表扬院士头衔101人，获奖者来自54个大学和非营利科研机构，这些卓越杰出的新院士拥有的美国专利总数已经超过3200项；获选的院士都是在学术创新发明领域最专业顶尖的人才，对丰富人类生活质量，促进经济发展和社会福址有显着的贡献和深远的影响。
4ceb92c22f18dee32f3a8e471c8c6afef6350d72.translatedText: The National Academy of Inventors commended a total of 101 academicians in 2013. The winners came from 54 universities and non-profit scientific research institutions. The total number of these outstanding new academicians has exceeded 3,200 U.S. patents. The selected academicians are the most professional and top talents in the field of academic innovation and invention, and have made significant contributions and far-reaching impacts on enriching the quality of human life, promoting economic development and social welfare.

22c985ce8c6a9cf28b2c8dd9b105663ca8d16726.sourceText: 101位美国发明家协会院士的杰出事迹，将发表在本月18日出版的高等教育年刊(The Chronicle of Higher Education)，和2013年元月发明家文摘(Inventors Digest)，以及2013年美国国家科学院论文集中(Proceedings of NAI)。
22c985ce8c6a9cf28b2c8dd9b105663ca8d16726.translatedText: > The outstanding deeds of 101 members of the American Society of Inventors will be published in The Chronicle of Higher Education, published on the 18th of this month, the January 2013 Inventors Digest, and the 2013 Proceedings of NAI.

6be268fc7a215f695699204b28615de9a92a3837.sourceText: 朱经武是成大校友，去年11月以”头号志工”的心情出任台综大总校长。
6be268fc7a215f695699204b28615de9a92a3837.translatedText: > Zhu Jingwu is an alumnus of National Cheng Kung University. In November last year, he took up the post of president of National Taiwan University with the attitude of being a “number one volunteer.”

97da90bbc9f30b883740c045402120b80e1ae9cd.sourceText: 台湾经文处为当地侨民提供领务收件等服务 驻洛杉矶台北经济文化办事处为落实服务辖区侨民，订于日期是11月7日週六下午下午2时30分至4时30分于亚利桑纳州凤凰城之「Best Western Airport Inn」（2425 South 24th Street, Phoenix, AZ85034）提供领务收件，欲申办护照、文件验证及签证之当地侨胞可多加利用。 另因场地时间及人力限制，所有申请文件将携回该处製作完成后再邮寄回申请人。相关资讯可于上班时间电洽该处（TEL:213-389-1215）或上该处网页（ www.taiwanembassy.org/us/lax ）查询。
97da90bbc9f30b883740c045402120b80e1ae9cd.translatedText: The Taiwan Cultural Affairs Office provides consular collection and other services for local overseas Chinese. In order to serve the overseas Chinese in the area, the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Los Angeles will provide consular collection at the "Best Western Airport Inn" in Phoenix, Arizona (2425 South 24th Street, Phoenix, AZ85034) on Saturday, November 7th from 2:30 to 4:30 pm. Local overseas Chinese who want to apply for passports, document verification and visas can take advantage of it. In addition, due to venue time and manpower constraints, all application documents will be brought back to the venue for production and then mailed back to the applicant. For relevant information, please call the office (TEL: 213-389-1215) during business hours or visit the office's website (www.taiwanembassy.org/us/lax).

98d1cfa780c894fa26d7362677c4880b48970d1a.sourceText: 人生大舞台：张琦胜从艺术走进商界 谢成彦 导言： 张琦胜 1989年从北京舞蹈学院来美，在得克萨斯州西南芭蕾舞中心进修，1992年进入亚利桑那芭蕾舞团，并成为该团史上第一位亚裔首席男演员，出演过《罗密欧与朱丽叶 》《胡桃夹子》等经典芭蕾舞剧，受到业界以及观众的高度评价。2001年一场精彩的告别演出，结束了自己的艺术生涯，走上一个全新的舞台。 2001年到2009年美国房地产的风云变幻绝对不亚于一部好莱坞的大片：由于IT行业的泡沫破灭以及911的影响，2001年美国房市处于低潮。2002年美国的低利率开始推升房市，很多中产甚至低产业者都实现自己的美国梦，住上了大房子, 美国房市出现了空前繁荣。2005年美国房市到达顶峰，几年内房价数倍增长的城市层出不穷。2006年房市泡沫破灭，出现了次贷危机，市场全面低迷。张琦胜经历了这一切，也见证了这一切。 ”我很幸运，有很多人一直在支持着我” 2009年10月30日，当记者问及这一场还未结束的房地产业内的浩劫，张琦胜很低调的回答。故事还是要追溯到1996年，满载着芭蕾舞带来的欢乐和荣誉，张琦胜决定要逐渐退出芭蕾舞事业。在一位好友的介绍下，张琦胜成为了凤凰城较早从事房地产交易的亚洲人。1999年他开创了金信房地产公司。从最开始的”光杆司令”，到第一个代理商看着广告找上门来，再到做成第一笔生意，张琦胜说自己很幸运，总是能遇到好人。为什么客人会把自己几年甚至十几年的血汗钱交给他呢？张琦胜说刚开始经营自己公司的时候，没有经验，客人一见他就知道是个新手。别人都用电子邮件和客人谈，和代理商谈，就是这个”新手”总是要自己亲自带着客人去和房主谈。别人都同时处理十几个合同，他就跟准三四个客人，带着他们反复跑，反复和房主面对面的谈。”我当时走了不少弯路，一根筋，就是要代表客人，谈下他们喜欢的房子”对于十几年前，自己的行为，张琦胜很欣慰：”没有当时的弯路，可能也不会有现在的我”。 2007 年chandler 评选出当年最佳建筑设计奖，当选者就是2006 年低落成的，一个占地面积达5500 平方尺的金信地产公司的办公主楼。 从1999年到2009年，金信房地产公司从一个代理商发展到现在三十多个代理商，张琦胜从艺术的舞台成功的走进了商业的舞台。2009年，美国房地产市场依然四面楚歌，很多房地产经纪都挂靠一些大公司，或者暂时在其他行业兼职，然而张琦胜依然很平静：”虽然没有2005，2006年生意那么好，但是一些稳定的老客户，以及他们介绍来的新客户，依然让金信平稳的经历了大环境的冲击”。如果说刚入行的张琦胜是靠勤奋和积累取胜，那么现在的张琦胜更多的是专注。”我不做全，但我一定专”张琦胜认为关注目标客户的需求是最重要的。比如，华人很多是从事高科技行业的，因此金信在Chandler这样的高新技术产业集中区，就下了很大的功夫，比如他们对这一地区的产业结构分布，房源分布，人口比例构成，学区的划分，甚至细微到华人人口比例，华人商业区分布等细节问题都做了很详细的分析。当记者问道，跳舞和做房地产有什么联系没有？张琦胜回答：”台上一分钟，台下十年功，没有快捷方式，只有踏实的练好基本功，为观众提供最精彩的舞蹈，为客户提供最专业的服务”。
98d1cfa780c894fa26d7362677c4880b48970d1a.translatedText: The big stage of life: Zhang Qisheng went from art to business world Xie Chengyan Introduction: Zhang Qisheng came to the United States from the Beijing Dance Academy in 1989 and studied at the Southwest Ballet Center in Texas. In 1992, he joined the Arizona Ballet Company and became the first Asian principal actor in the history of the company. He has starred in classic ballets such as "Romeo and Juliet" and "The Nutcracker", and has been highly praised by the industry and audiences. A wonderful farewell performance in 2001 ended his artistic career and embarked on a new stage. The changes in U.S. real estate from 2001 to 2009 were definitely no less than a Hollywood blockbuster: Due to the bursting of the bubble in the IT industry and the impact of 9/11, the U.S. real estate market was at a low ebb in 2001. In 2002, low interest rates in the United States began to push up the housing market. Many middle-class and even low-income people realized their American dream and lived in big houses. The U.S. housing market experienced unprecedented prosperity. The U.S. housing market reached its peak in 2005, and cities where housing prices increased several times in a few years emerged one after another. In 2006, the housing market bubble burst, the subprime mortgage crisis occurred, and the market was in an overall downturn. Zhang Qisheng has experienced it all and witnessed it all. "I am very lucky, there are many people who have been supporting me." On October 30, 2009, when a reporter asked about the catastrophe in the real estate industry that was not yet over, Zhang Qisheng responded in a low-key manner. The story goes back to 1996. Full of joy and honor brought by ballet, Zhang Qisheng decided to gradually withdraw from the ballet career. With the introduction of a friend, Zhang Qisheng became one of the first Asians to engage in real estate transactions in Phoenix. In 1999, he founded Jinxin Real Estate Company. From the beginning of being a "graceful commander", to the first agent looking at the advertisement, to making the first business, Zhang Qisheng said that he is very lucky and always meets good people. Why would the customer give him their hard-earned money of several years or even more than ten years? Zhang Qisheng said that when he first started running his company, he had no experience. Customers knew he was a novice as soon as they saw him. Others use emails to talk to customers and agents, but this "newbie" always has to personally take the customer to talk to the landlord. While others were dealing with more than a dozen contracts at the same time, he followed three or four prospective customers and took them on repeated trips to have face-to-face talks with the homeowners. "I took a lot of detours at that time. The only thing I wanted to do was to represent the guests and talk about the houses they liked." Zhang Qisheng was very pleased with his behavior more than ten years ago: "Without the detours at that time, I might not be where I am now." In 2007, chandler selected the best architectural design award of the year, and the winner was the main office building of Jinxin Real Estate Company, which was completed in 2006 and covers an area of ​​5,500 square feet. From 1999 to 2009, Jinxin Real Estate Company developed from one agent to more than 30 agents now. Zhang Qisheng successfully entered the commercial stage from the artistic stage. In 2009, the U.S. real estate market was still in turmoil. Many real estate agents were affiliated with some large companies or temporarily worked part-time in other industries. However, Zhang Qisheng remained calm: "Although the business was not as good as in 2005 and 2006, some stable old customers and the new customers they introduced still allowed Jinxin to smoothly experience the impact of the environment." If Zhang Qisheng, who just entered the industry, relied on hard work and accumulation to win, then Zhang Qisheng now relies more on concentration. "I don't do everything, but I will definitely specialize." Zhang Qisheng believes that paying attention to the needs of target customers is the most important thing. For example, many Chinese are engaged in high-tech industries, so Jinxin has put a lot of effort into high-tech industry clusters like Chandler. For example, they have made a detailed analysis of the industrial structure distribution, housing distribution, population composition, school district divisions, and even details such as the proportion of Chinese population and the distribution of Chinese business districts in this area. When the reporter asked, is there any connection between dancing and real estate? Zhang Qisheng replied: "One minute on stage, ten years of hard work off stage, there is no shortcut, we can only practice the basic skills steadily, provide the audience with the most exciting dance, and provide the most professional service to customers."

b7ccc53afae6250d7ae0804c98767387b8e0fd0e.sourceText: 和延倾师傅谈少林功夫 （二） 中国河南嵩山少林寺武僧教头释延倾师傅，12岁进入少林寺武术专修院习文练武，2009年受具足戒出家。他曾获”世界传统武术比赛”一等奖，”少林拳锦标赛”拳术，第一名，刀术，第三名，并于今年出访了德国，法国，奥地利，韩国，马来西亚，澳大利亚，等二十多个国家进行文化交流、表演和教学。现尊方丈（释永信）法旨在美国亚利桑那州做文化交流，传播少林功夫。 问：上期采访，延倾师傅咱们浅谈了少林功夫的整体读解。其中您特别提到少林武术强调的”六合”的原则，这次我想请您比较具体地讲解一下”六合”的原则。 延倾 ： 少林功夫演练时强调手 眼身法步 （内三合）和 精气神力功 （外三合）的协调配合，称之为”六合”。 外三合：手与足合，肘与膝合，肩与胯合。 内三合：心与意合，意与气合，气与力合。相对于”内三合”来说，”外三合”比较”实”，因为有具体的动作相对应。”内三合”其中的”手与足合”就是讲：不仅外形动作要协调配合，而且也要在劲力上相合一致。手与足要是配合得好，劲力必然分散。手与足要是相合，劲力必然顺达，身法也必然灵巧。 ”内三合”的”肘与膝合”也是类似的一种指导：肘与膝是三节中的中节，是动作和劲力的转换之处，中节相合，能使动作轻换灵活。 而”肩与胯合”强调的是：上下根节之合，起到周身稳固作用，不但能使周身动作协调，而且能使劲力传达于未捎，劲力更加完整和集中。 外三合主要在于符合拳的整体结构，以腰为轴，带动身体四肢运动的前提下，发挥协调配合作用。 相对于刚刚我们讲的”外三合”，”内三合”可能更难一些，因为比较虚空一些，要很多琢磨和体会–心与意合，意与气合，气与力合。”心与意合”讲使大脑思维与精神，眼神配合。心与意合了，才能控制手脚的协调动作。也就是心要平静，意念要集中，才能做到心与意合。 ”意与气合”：以意领气，意到气到，气随意行。气的运行受意的指挥，意散，气必散，气散，意必乱。 ”气与力合”：能把全身的力量集中在一处，突然爆发，出出拳如放箭，强而有力。若有气无力，则气无法得到运行和表现，若没有气，力则无从产生。以呼吸配合动作，以气催力，方可增加耐力。 常言道：”有内无外不成拳，有外无内不成术”。”外三合”是基础，”内三合”是效果。”外三合”达到强健筋骨，”内三合”调理脏腑，疏通筋脉，从而达到形意兼备，内外合一，才为”六合”。 （待续） 延倾师傅在 新东方艺术学校 设有多门青少年武术和成人养生功-太极课堂。 有意者请电话询问： 602.490.8613
b7ccc53afae6250d7ae0804c98767387b8e0fd0e.translatedText: Talking about Shaolin Kung Fu with Master Yan Qing (2) Master Shi Yanqing, the martial arts monk instructor of the Shaolin Temple in Songshan, Henan, China, entered the Shaolin Temple Martial Arts Academy to learn martial arts at the age of 12. In 2009, he received full ordination and became a monk. He has won the first prize in the "World Traditional Martial Arts Competition", the first prize in boxing and the third prize in swordsmanship in the "Shaolin Boxing Championship". This year he visited more than 20 countries including Germany, France, Austria, South Korea, Malaysia and Australia for cultural exchanges, performances and teaching. The current abbot (Shi Yongxin) aims to conduct cultural exchanges and spread Shaolin Kung Fu in Arizona, USA. Question: In the last interview, Master Yan Qing briefly talked about the overall interpretation of Shaolin Kung Fu. Among them, you specifically mentioned the principle of "Liuhe" that Shaolin martial arts emphasizes. This time I would like to ask you to explain the principle of "Liuhe" in more detail. Yanqing: Shaolin Kungfu emphasizes the coordination of hands, eyes, body, steps (inner three together) and energy, energy, spirit and power (outer three together), which is called "Liuhe". The three outer joints are: hands and feet, elbows and knees, shoulders and hips. The inner three unions: the heart and mind are united, the mind and Qi are united, and Qi and force are united. Compared with the "inner three-in-one", the "outer three-in-one" is more "real" because there are specific actions corresponding to it. Among the "Internal Three Harmonies", "Hands and Feet Harmony" means that not only the external movements must be coordinated, but also the strength must be consistent. If the hands and feet cooperate well, the strength will inevitably be dispersed. If the hands and feet are in harmony, the strength will be smooth and the movement will be dexterous. The "Elbow and Knee Combination" of the "Inner Three Combinations" is a similar guide: the elbow and knee are the middle section of the three sections, which is where the movement and strength are converted. The combination of the middle section can make the movements light and flexible. The "shoulder and hip combination" emphasizes that the combination of the upper and lower root joints plays a stabilizing role in the whole body. It not only coordinates the movements of the whole body, but also allows the force to be transmitted to the outside, making the force more complete and concentrated. The main purpose of the outer Sanhe is to conform to the overall structure of the boxing, using the waist as the axis to drive the movement of the body's limbs, and to play a coordinated role. Compared with the "outer three combinations" we just talked about, the "inner three combinations" may be more difficult because they are a bit more empty and require a lot of thinking and understanding - the combination of heart and mind, the combination of mind and Qi, and the combination of Qi and force. "Heart and Mind Unity" talks about coordinating the brain's thinking with the spirit and eyes. Only when your heart and mind are in harmony can you control the coordinated movements of your hands and feet. That is to say, the mind must be calm and the mind must be concentrated in order to achieve harmony between heart and mind. "Integration of mind and qi": lead the qi with the mind, and when the qi arrives, the qi will move at will. The movement of Qi is controlled by the mind. If the mind disperses, the Qi will disperse. If the Qi disperses, the mind will become confused. "The combination of Qi and force": The power of the whole body can be concentrated in one place, burst out suddenly, and punch like an arrow, powerful and powerful. If there is no Qi, the Qi cannot be moved and expressed; if there is no Qi, there is no way to generate force. Only by combining breathing with movements and using Qi to promote strength can you increase your endurance. As the saying goes: "If there is an inside but no outside, there is no boxing; if there is an outside but no inside, there is no technique." The "outer three combinations" are the foundation, and the "inner three combinations" are the effects. The "Three External Harmonies" strengthen the muscles and bones, and the "Three Internal Harmonies" regulate the internal organs and dredge the muscles and veins, so as to achieve both form and mind, and the unity of the inside and outside, which is called "Liuhe". (To be continued) Master Yan Qing has a number of youth martial arts and adult health-preserving exercises - Tai Chi classes at New Oriental Art School. If interested, please call: 602.490.8613
