97d0df82604c9bf1e51c5c97098944ab597f30de.sourceText: 2015年10月，在凤凰城地区新近成立的一个非营利组织C3C （全名：Center for Culture, Cultivation, and Commerce）就是这样一个应运而生的组织。C3C的宗旨就是为了帮助我们华裔（包括学生和成人）来提高社交能力，团队合作，沟通，和领导力。
97d0df82604c9bf1e51c5c97098944ab597f30de.translatedText: In October 2015, a newly established non-profit organization in the Phoenix area, C3C (full name: Center for Culture, Cultivation, and Commerce) is such an organization that came into being. The purpose of C3C is to help us Chinese (including students and adults) improve social skills, teamwork, communication, and leadership.

2825dfc5134800818c7423444bbb69e27c9b2042.sourceText: 从10月11日起的一个半月内，我们C3C 组织已经成功地为100多华裔学生举办了3场系列讲座。比如在第一场社交能力的讲座中，年龄大的孩子学会如何尊重他人，自己解决矛盾。年龄小的孩子学会成餐饮礼节 (Table Manner), 而且学会主动和他人打招呼。在第二场的团队合作讲座中，所有参加的孩子通过在户外踢足球的独特讲座方式，领悟到每个队员在团队中起着重要作用, 并让孩子们交了好多新朋友。在第三场的沟通技巧中，他们学会清晰而又准确地(speak clearly and slowly)表达自己的有效方法。有关前3场讲座(社交能力，团队合作,和沟通)的文字，图片，和视频已经整理成网络文章。目前在北美华人圈中广泛流传，在1个半月内，浏览总量超过13，000多。我们收到很多网友送来的反馈。一位家长写到：”你们办的社交能力培训太棒了，你们什么时候可以来我们加卅开课？”我们非常羡慕住在凤凰城的家长们，能有这么好的社交能力的培训机会。希望你们有一天能来图桑做讲座.们中文学校几年前开过礼仪课，请美国老师讲，当时我去找老师，价格非常贵厰。一个网友在仅仅看完我们在网络上，免费向大家提供的讲座幻灯片后, 如此回复: 这个Social Skill （社交技巧讲座） 太实用了。我专门给孩子注了etiquette（礼仪）课，发现这个讲座的内容都覆盖了，那课花了我两娃800银子。 如果你对我们的前三场讲座感兴趣，可浏览我们的主页： http://C3C.weidb.com 。 感兴趣的读者可以直接联系我们. C3C组织的微信号:c3cphx。
2825dfc5134800818c7423444bbb69e27c9b2042.translatedText: Within one and a half months from October 11, our C3C organization has successfully held a series of 3 lectures for more than 100 Chinese students. For example, in the first lecture on social skills, older children learned how to respect others and resolve conflicts on their own. Young children learn table manners and learn to greet others proactively. In the second teamwork lecture, all participating children realized that each team member plays an important role in the team through the unique lecture method of playing football outdoors, and the children made many new friends. In the third session of communication skills, they learned effective ways to express themselves clearly and slowly. The texts, pictures, and videos about the first three lectures (Social Skills, Teamwork, and Communication) have been compiled into online articles. It is currently widely circulated in the Chinese community in North America. Within one and a half months, the total number of views exceeded 13,000. We received a lot of feedback from netizens. One parent wrote: "The social skills training you provide is great. When can you come to us to join the class?" We are very envious of parents living in Phoenix for having such a good social skills training opportunity. I hope you can come to Tucson to give lectures one day. Our Chinese school held an etiquette class a few years ago and asked an American teacher to teach it. At that time, I went to find a teacher and the price was very expensive. After just reading the lecture slides we provide to everyone for free on the Internet, a netizen responded like this: This Social Skill (social skills lecture) is too practical. I specially took an etiquette (etiquette) class for my children and found that the content of this lecture was covered. The class cost me 800 silver for two children. If you are interested in our first three lectures, you can visit our homepage: http://C3C.weidb.com. Interested readers can contact us directly. C3C organization’s WeChat ID: c3cphx.

Delaware St. Chandler AZ 85225)，给华裔学生组织第四场有关?领导力?的讲座。如果你的孩子在7-17岁之间，千万别错过这次由两位都具有20多年丰富经验的老师，来给大家做的公益讲座。其中12-17岁学生的讲座从2：00-3：00pm, 而7-11岁学生的讲座是从3：30-4：30pm。如果孩子错过前三场讲座，不会影响12月6日的听讲。另外，为了进一步锻炼华裔学生的领导力，我们打算于12月13日下午2:00-4:00pm举办C3C学生会Chair 和 Co-Chair的竞选。我们的目的是让我们的孩子，自己来组织并协调一些他们感兴趣的公益活动，类似于童子军的一些活动。在12月13日的同一天，不参与竞选的学生也可以参加演讲活动，其内容可自选。
bc433a396a635f93552bf7d5f9e0b30b4f8e4f58.translatedText: On December 6, C3C once again organized the fourth "Leadership" lecture for Chinese American students for free at the Chandler downtown library (22 S. Delaware St. Chandler AZ 85225). If your child is between 7 and 17 years old, don’t miss this public lecture given by two teachers with more than 20 years of experience. The lectures for students aged 12-17 are from 2:00-3:00pm, while the lectures for students aged 7-11 are from 3:30-4:30pm. If the child misses the first three lectures, it will not affect the lecture on December 6. In addition, in order to further train the leadership of Chinese students, we plan to hold the C3C Student Union Chair and Co-Chair election on December 13th from 2:00 to 4:00 pm. Our purpose is to let our children organize and coordinate some public welfare activities that interest them, similar to some of the activities of the Boy Scouts. On the same day, December 13, students who are not participating in the campaign can also participate in a speaking event of their own choice.

5113aaec56c69636d261f5b59c72c4dc88ceb6da.sourceText: 根据目前的反馈，不少孩子的行为在参加完讲座后，已经发生明显的变化。他们变得更加自信。欢迎各位家长和学生利用C3C组织举办的讲座的机会，让我们大家一起来锻炼和成长。我们明年会继续举办这些特别受欢迎的，服务于华裔学生的讲座。希望我们明年的讲座将会更上一层楼. 另外, 我们借此机会向C3C义工们的辛勤付出和家长们的大力支持表示衷心的惑谢！
5113aaec56c69636d261f5b59c72c4dc88ceb6da.translatedText: According to current feedback, many children's behavior has changed significantly after attending the lecture. They become more confident. Parents and students are welcome to take advantage of the lectures organized by C3C and let us all exercise and grow together. We will continue to hold these particularly popular lectures for Chinese students next year. We hope that our lectures will be even better next year. In addition, we would like to take this opportunity to express our heartfelt thanks to the C3C volunteers for their hard work and the parents for their strong support!

7a8069dcc5d3b5b0e48d6cb575e4295a5923a266.sourceText: 上层的草莓 凤凰城 庄芷 唉！我特别爱吃草莓，但每次买草莓都有上当的感觉。」朋友带着无奈的语气说。 「上当？」身旁的朋友七嘴八舌的问：「买回家才发现草莓不新鲜吗？」「买到的价格太贵了？」 「妳们难道没有同感吗？」她一脸不悦地反问我：「每次看到超市里卖的草莓，一盒一盒的排列整齐，而且盒子里的草莓也都看起来又大、又红、又新鲜，但回家打开吃了以后，就会发现只有摆在上层的草莓是漂漂亮亮的，而小的、或颜色不鲜艳的就被藏在盒底层，所以总会有一种被骗的感觉。」 我听了笑了笑说：「哎吆！这是做生意的『基本常识』嘛！卖水果的当然要把最好、最美的水果摆在上层，不就是希望能激发妳的购买意愿吗？」 「你怎么能说是上当呢？」另一位朋友倒是不以为然的说：「虽然商家总是把看起来又大、又红、又新鲜的草莓放在上层，但超市里卖的草莓都是放在透明的塑料盒子里，妳只要拿起来多看看，就可以看出来放在底层的草莓是大是小、或是新不新鲜，所以妳应该是买回家之前，就已经知道只有上层的草莓，是看起来比较漂亮的，怎么能怪商家骗妳呢？」 「对呀！对呀！」我心有同感的说：「我每次买草莓，都会举起盒子看看放在下层的草莓新不新鲜，虽然常会看到放在下层的，往往不像上层的那么漂亮，但多检查一下，至少可以避免买到下层已经发霉的草莓。」 那位朋友接着说：「所以啊！咱们可不该怪罪商家总是把又大、又红、又新鲜的草莓放在上层，其实是我们太容易被上层的草莓所吸引呢！我们这些爱吃草莓的，不就是姜子牙钓鱼?#24895;者上钩嘛！」 这话一出，大伙儿都笑了。 可不是？ 有时候我们太容易感叹商家的营销手法太过凌厉，让人无法招架，只有乖乖地奉上信用卡被「唰」，而忘记了我们对自己的销费行为也是有责任的。其实各式各类的广告，不就是抓住我们心中的贪念、喜欢追逐外表鲜亮的弱点吗？记得好多年前曾在电视上看见一则广告，画面上先尽是一幕又一幕的让人羡慕的高级房屋与佳肴，以及世界著名的旅游盛地，正觉得搞不清楚是在做什么广告时，突然出现了一位广告美女指着一家银行的招牌，发出轻柔的声音说：「借钱，是一种高贵的行为！」 够犀利的广告吧！难怪「先销费、后付款」的商业广告如此撼动人心，而这些年来也才会发展出「卡奴」这个新名词呢！ 但我们能怪这些广告吗？埋怨说是被他们骗了吗？还是应该说，是因为我们的心，正好和这些广告所推销的内容十分贴切与契合呢？ 看来观照自己的心，还真是重要呢！圣经上箴言：「保守你们的心，胜过保守一切，因为一生的果效是由心发出。」不禁再次期勉自己，活在这多彩多姿的大千世界里，可要时时有颗知足感恩的心哪！

"My friend said with a helpless tone. “Did you get fooled?” Friends around me asked in confusion: “Did you find that the strawberries were not fresh when you bought them home?” “The price you bought was too expensive?” 「妳们难道没有同感吗？」她一脸不悦地反问我：「每次看到超市里卖的草莓，一盒一盒的排列整齐，而且盒子里的草莓也都看起来又大、又红、又新鲜，但回家打开吃了以后，就会发现只有摆在上层的草莓是漂漂亮亮的，而小的、或颜色不鲜艳的就被藏在盒底层，所以总会有一种被骗的感觉。」 我听了笑了笑说：「哎吆！这是做生意的『基本常识』嘛！卖水果的当然要把最好、最美的水果摆在上层，不就是希望能激发妳的购买意愿吗？」 "How can you say you were fooled?" But can we blame these ads? Are you complaining that you were cheated by them? Or should we say, is it because our hearts are very relevant and consistent with the content promoted by these advertisements? f52487a11d61088802edae6f60a36eaca2700805.sourceText: 奥巴马敦促移民改革为“黑户”提供身份 众院年底或有进展 据CNN报道：奥巴马于周四发表演讲，敦促国会加紧立法推进移民改革，尽快为数百万名非法移民提供合法身份。 周三，众议院议长博纳表示对移民改革法案年底在众议院推进表示乐观，称共和党人正在讨论解决这一问题的可能措施。 一名白宫官员说：”正常的移民对国家有好处，它将增长经济、减少财政赤字，一直以来也被共和党和民主党、商人和工人、以及执法者和宗教领袖所支持。” 他表示总统已明确了基本原则，其中包括加强边境安全，为非法移民提供成为合法公民的途径，明确雇主雇佣非法移民时的责任，创建新的移民体系。 随着美国联邦政府关闭的局面于上星期结束，奥巴马说，他将把移民改革议题置于最优先的位置，希望国会在今年年内完成立法。 哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS）于周三发布的一项民意调查显示，民众也十分支持移民改革。 调查发现，大部分民众支持为符合一定条件的无证移民提供公民身份，包括通过移民排期、缴纳罚款、补交税款、通过犯罪背景调查以及学习英语等。 调查同样也发现，更多的民众认为保卫国家的边界安全应该优先于解决无证移民的问题。 今年7月参议院通过一项移民改革的法案后，然而这项法案一直在众议院悬而未决。由共和党控制的众议院表示更倾向于先解决一些更小的法案，而不是一次性通过这么大的移民改革法案。 众议院民主党人也于6月提出了自己的移民改革方案，其中剔除了参议院方案中的扩大边境巡逻队的条款。其他方面与参议院的移民改革法案类似，给全美1100万无证移民提供获得合法身份的途径 。 最具争议性的部分是为无证移民提供为期一年的公民身份。许多共和党人拒绝通过任何途径对违法者进行大赦。
f52487a11d61088802edae6f60a36eaca2700805.translatedText: Obama urges immigration reform to provide identity for "unaccounted immigrants", and there may be progress in the House of Representatives by the end of the year. According to CNN: Obama delivered a speech on Thursday urging Congress to step up legislation to advance immigration reform and provide legal status to millions of illegal immigrants as soon as possible. On Wednesday, House Speaker John Boehner expressed optimism that an immigration reform bill would advance in the House by the end of the year, saying Republicans were discussing possible measures to address the issue. A White House official said: "Regular immigration is good for the country. It will grow the economy, reduce the fiscal deficit, and has always been supported by Republicans and Democrats, businessmen and workers, as well as law enforcement and religious leaders." He said the president has clarified basic principles, which include strengthening border security, providing illegal immigrants with a path to become legal citizens, clarifying the responsibilities of employers when hiring illegal immigrants, and creating a new immigration system. As the U.S. federal government shutdown ended last week, Obama said he would put immigration reform at the top of his priority list and hoped Congress would complete legislation this year. A CBS poll released on Wednesday showed that people also strongly support immigration reform. The survey found that a majority of the public supports providing citizenship to undocumented immigrants who meet certain conditions, including through immigration waiting list, paying fines, paying back taxes, passing criminal background checks, and learning English. The survey also found that more people believe that securing the country's borders should take precedence over solving the problem of undocumented immigrants. After the Senate passed an immigration reform bill in July this year, the bill has been pending in the House of Representatives. The Republican-controlled House of Representatives has indicated that it would prefer to tackle smaller bills first rather than pass such a large immigration reform bill at once. House Democrats also proposed their own immigration reform package in June, which eliminated provisions from the Senate plan to expand the Border Patrol. Other aspects are similar to the Senate's immigration reform bill, which provides a way for the 11 million undocumented immigrants in the United States to obtain legal status. The most controversial part is offering one-year citizenship to undocumented immigrants. Many Republicans reject any avenue for amnesty for offenders.

527436f2907d6edcb5e22731afa24ee9b2f3cf79.sourceText: 4 月 24 日，南方科技大学召开全体师生大会，传达教育部关于同意建立南方科技大学的喜讯。成功” 转正” 后的南科大将积极探索现代大学制度，以国际一流大学为标杆，努力建成国际化高水平研究型大学和我国重大科学技术研究与拔尖创新人才培养基地。 深圳市委副书王穗明表示，深圳南方科技大学经过 5 年的不懈努力，终于成功” 转正” 。去年正式录取的首批 45 名实验班学生已经入校就读，现在教育部正式批准建立，南科大一步一步向前发展。” 南科大的阶段性成功，离不开朱清时校长和他的团队兢兢业业、执着追求、不懈努力，也离不开勇于’ 吃螃蟹’ 的首批教改班的 40 多名学子的信任与支持。” 王穗明说。
527436f2907d6edcb5e22731afa24ee9b2f3cf79.translatedText: April On the 24th, Southern University of Science and Technology held a meeting of all teachers and students to convey the good news that the Ministry of Education agreed to establish Southern University of Science and Technology. After the successful "regularization", SUSTech will actively explore the modern university system, take the world's first-class universities as the benchmark, and strive to build an international high-level research university and a base for my country's major scientific and technological research and top-notch innovative talent training. Wang Suiming, deputy secretary of the Shenzhen Municipal Party Committee, said that after five years of unremitting efforts, Shenzhen Southern University of Science and Technology finally successfully "turned regular." The first batch of 45 experimental class students officially admitted last year have already enrolled in the school. Now that the Ministry of Education has officially approved its establishment, SUSTech is moving forward step by step. "The initial success of SUSTech is inseparable from the dedication, persistent pursuit and unremitting efforts of President Zhu Qingshi and his team, as well as the trust and support of the more than 40 students in the first batch of education reform classes who dared to 'eat crabs'." Wang Suiming said.

0d1c5676e353f274f8a97523b996296765c02d99.sourceText: 南科大从创建初期到今天，学校的软硬件建设取得了阶段性进展，今年内，新校园工程部分教学楼将交付使用，学校有望迎来一批新的学生，更多优秀的教师，南科大的未来发展令人期待。 王穗明希望各个部门继续通力合作，迎难而上，共同呵护、帮助这所年轻的高校进一步改革创新，取得更大的发展。深圳市政府将做南科大的坚强后盾，为南科大早日建成国际化高水平研究型大学做好服务。
0d1c5676e353f274f8a97523b996296765c02d99.translatedText: From the early days of SUSTech's establishment to today, the school's software and hardware construction has made phased progress. Within this year, part of the teaching buildings of the new campus project will be put into use. The school is expected to welcome a new group of students and more excellent teachers. The future development of SUSTech is exciting. Wang Suiming hopes that all departments will continue to work together to face difficulties and jointly protect and help this young university to further reform and innovate and achieve greater development. The Shenzhen Municipal Government will be a strong backing for SUSTech and provide good services for SUSTech to build an international high-level research university at an early date.

2c7af505c611c377e34c06cdb17a51c7c818d2bb.sourceText: 联邦地区法官5日晚做出允许亚利桑那州检查移民身分的裁决，引起民权组织的广泛担忧，认为可能会导致检查身分的执法泛滥，民怨与诉讼会云涌而生，引发人权危机，同时也造成 执法人员的困扰。 联邦最高法院在6月的裁决中，​​维持了亚省移民法检查移民身分的规定，但封杀了窝藏非法移民为犯罪的规定。 联邦地区法官苏姗波顿5日晚裁决，允许执行检查身分的规定。 凤凰城Puente组织的卡萝丝加西亚说：「裁决将只会扩大亚利桑那的人权危机。民众是否遵从种族主义的移民法，决定权完全掌握在其他人手中。我们要求全州各个机构、学校、 城镇和警局回答，你们是遵守移民法中的种族歧视规定，还是站在民权与人权一边？」 欧巴马政府两年前控告亚省移民法，认为只有联邦政府才有权制定移民政策。 反对者说，移民法是对西语裔的歧视。 美国公民自由联盟说，亚省移民法将在十天内实施。 这项法律要求州执法部门在执法中，如果有理由怀疑对方是非法移民，可检查他们的身分。 多数法律专家认为，「有理由怀疑」的规定可能导致种族侦防，并对全州的地方执法部门造成困惑。 加西亚说：「实施移民法后，警察将不再保护我们，不再为社区服务，只会以种族主义的眼光看待我们。」 华人、直系亲属 赴中签证延长 中国驻美国大使馆29日表示，中国将为中国​​公民的外籍配偶、子女，以及所持护照的出生地为中国(含台湾、香港、澳门地区)的美籍华人及配偶、子女，提供长期有效、 多次进入中国的商务、访问签证。 香港中评社援引中国驻美使馆参赞兼总领事陈雄风29日表示，这意味着只要相关人士提供中国境内亲属出具的邀请函及亲属身分证件复印件，以及结婚证书、出生证明等配偶、子女关系证明文件 ，即可申请比现在通行的两年有效期更长的签证。 如果以往申请过中国签证，并能提供相关纪录，将更有助于获得长期多次签证。 陈雄风说，过去几年中国驻美使馆尽力为美国人赴中国旅游、经商、学习、工作申请签证提供便利条件，严格遵守中美两国的协议，为赴中国旅游、商务和留学人员发放一 年多次有效的签证，在此基础上还为美籍华人及其配偶和子女签发两年多次有效签证。 他表示，中方还在符合相关规定的基础上，视实际需要和情况，积极扩大为需要经常往返中国大陆和美国之间的经贸人士、华人群体及其直系亲属发放更长期的签证。 至于外界近来关注的外国访客赴中申请签证被要求出具邀请函或机票、酒店预订单的政策，陈雄风表示，根据中方签证新规定，旅游签证申请人原则上确实应当提供符合要求的邀请函， 但对于赴中从事个人旅游的申请人，如不能提供邀请函，也可提供往返机票和酒店订单。 他解释，邀请函可是手写的，也可是打印的或传真的，也可是扫描的，但需要有邀请人的签名，不能是单纯的电子邮件。 对于一些在中国既没有邀请单位，又没有亲朋好友，就是想到中国去进行个人自助旅行的「背包客」，提交机票订单和酒店订单等行程证明也可以。
2c7af505c611c377e34c06cdb17a51c7c818d2bb.translatedText: A federal district judge's ruling on the evening of the 5th to allow Arizona to check immigration status caused widespread concern among civil rights organizations, believing that it may lead to the proliferation of law enforcement that checks status, and public grievances and lawsuits will arise, triggering a human rights crisis and causing trouble for law enforcement officials. In a June ruling, the federal Supreme Court upheld the requirement in Alberta's immigration law to check immigration status, but blocked the provision that makes harboring illegal immigrants a crime. Federal District Judge Susan Bolton ruled on the evening of the 5th to allow the enforcement of the identity check regulations. "The ruling will only amplify Arizona's human rights crisis," said Carol Garcia of Puente in Phoenix. "The decision of whether people comply with racist immigration laws is entirely in the hands of others. We are asking agencies, schools, towns and police departments across the state to answer, are you complying with racial discrimination in immigration laws, or are you siding with civil rights and human rights?" The Obama administration sued Alberta's immigration laws two years ago, arguing that only the federal government has the authority to set immigration policy. Opponents say the immigration law discriminates against Hispanics. The American Civil Liberties Union says Alberta's immigration laws will be implemented within 10 days. The law requires state law enforcement agencies to check the identity of immigrants if they have reason to suspect they are illegal immigrants. Most legal experts believe the "reasonable suspicion" provision could lead to racial profiling and cause confusion for local law enforcement across the state. Garcia said: "After the immigration law is implemented, the police will no longer protect us, no longer serve the community, and will only view us in a racist light." Visa extension for Chinese and immediate family members to China. The Chinese Embassy in the United States stated on the 29th that China will provide long-term, valid, multiple-entry business and visit visas to China for foreign spouses and children of Chinese citizens, as well as Chinese Americans and their spouses and children whose passports are born in China (including Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macau). Hong Kong's China Review News quoted Chen Xiongfeng, the counselor and consul general of the Chinese Embassy in the United States, as saying on the 29th that this means that as long as the relevant person provides an invitation letter issued by relatives in China and a copy of the relative's identity document, as well as marriage certificates, birth certificates and other documents proving the relationship between spouse and children, they can apply for a visa with a longer validity period than the current two years. If you have applied for a Chinese visa in the past and can provide relevant records, it will be more helpful to obtain a long-term multiple visa. Chen Xiongfeng said that in the past few years, the Chinese Embassy in the United States has tried its best to provide convenient conditions for Americans to apply for visas for tourism, business, study, and work in China. It strictly abides by the agreement between China and the United States and issues one-year, multiple-valid visas to those who go to China for tourism, business, and study abroad. On this basis, it also issues two-year multiple-valid visas to Chinese Americans, their spouses, and children. He said that on the basis of complying with relevant regulations and based on actual needs and circumstances, China is actively expanding the issuance of longer-term visas to economic and trade personnel, Chinese groups and their immediate family members who need to frequently travel between mainland China and the United States. As for the recent concern that foreign visitors to China are required to provide invitation letters or air tickets and hotel reservations when applying for visas, Chen Xiongfeng said that according to China’s new visa regulations, tourist visa applicants should in principle provide invitation letters that meet the requirements. However, for applicants who are going to China for personal tourism, if they cannot provide an invitation letter, they can also provide round-trip air tickets and hotel reservations. He explained that the invitation letter can be handwritten, printed, faxed, or scanned, but it needs the signature of the inviter and cannot be a simple email. For some "backpackers" who have neither inviting organizations nor relatives and friends in China, but want to go on a self-guided trip to China, they can also submit proof of itinerary such as air ticket orders and hotel orders.

60d121128e6b13c4a2698ce736ab2325c6b28286.sourceText: （希望中文学校供稿）8月2日，距离希望中文学校2014学年开学还有2周，但是学校的全体老师和教职员工已经行动起来，通过参加学校的新学年培训会，为新的一个学年做好了充分的准备。会议假座China City Buffet，学校在准备开学工作的同时，还请大家共享了一次美食。 会议在热烈的氛围中开始，大家一边品尝各种美味的食物，一边交流假期里的各种趣事，分享各自对新学期课程的准备心得, 好不热闹。待大家品尝美食后，新任董事长周青女士首先致辞，她总结了中文学校在前任董事和校长的带领下所取得的成绩，并表达了秉承前人继续带领各位老师共同努力办好希望中文学校的决心。
60d121128e6b13c4a2698ce736ab2325c6b28286.translatedText: (Contributed by Hope Chinese School) On August 2, there are still two weeks until the start of the 2014 school year at Hope Chinese School. However, all the teachers and staff of the school have already taken action and are fully prepared for the new school year by participating in the school's new school year training meeting. The conference was held at the China City Buffet. While the school was preparing for the start of the school year, it also invited everyone to share a delicious meal. The meeting started in a warm atmosphere. While everyone tasted various delicious foods, they exchanged various interesting things during the holidays and shared their preparations for the new semester courses. It was very lively. After everyone tasted the delicious food, the new chairman Ms. Zhou Qing gave a speech first. She summarized the achievements of the Chinese school under the leadership of the previous directors and principals, and expressed her determination to continue to lead the teachers to run the Hope Chinese School well in accordance with the predecessors.

c0a918f90b007e1fe6b2f66508e8c8e81512d405.sourceText: 周董事长致辞后，今年新上任的校长田琳女士主持了本次培训会。田校长提醒各位老师，学校将于8月16日正式开学，请各位教师做好开学前的各项准备。随后，她提出了一些本学期的新举措，诸如教室里的家长陪同制度，督促学生有责任心的维护身边的环境卫生，以及教师不要过分依赖TA批改作业等，这样才能对每个学生在课外的学习结果有更好的了解，以便因材施教进一步提高教学质量。老师们必须继续贯彻原定的教师规范条例，必须以更高的教学质量和更规范的教学行为来更好的教育学生，也为学生做出良好的榜样。教师们也就共同维护好学校的环境、增加学生志愿者机会以及学生的安全等各个方面提出了很好的建议。田校长还要求希望中文学校的全体中文教师必须参加即将到来的由国侨办主办的全美中文教师培训，更进一步的提高中文教师的教学水准。
c0a918f90b007e1fe6b2f66508e8c8e81512d405.translatedText: After Chairman Zhou delivered a speech, Ms. Tian Lin, the newly appointed principal this year, presided over the training meeting. Principal Tian reminded all teachers that the school will officially start on August 16th. Please make all preparations before the start of school. Later, she proposed some new measures for this semester, such as the parent-accompaniment system in the classroom, urging students to responsibly maintain the sanitation of the surrounding environment, and teachers not to rely too much on TA to correct homework. Only in this way can we have a better understanding of each student's extracurricular learning results, so that students can be taught in accordance with their aptitude to further improve the quality of teaching. Teachers must continue to implement the original teacher regulations, educate students better with higher teaching quality and more standardized teaching behaviors, and set a good example for students. The teachers also put forward good suggestions on various aspects such as jointly maintaining the school environment, increasing student volunteer opportunities, and student safety. Principal Tian also requested that all Chinese teachers in Hope Chinese School must participate in the upcoming national Chinese teacher training sponsored by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council to further improve the teaching standards of Chinese teachers.

41b470080cbc9a5bb4ddf6b39400d82bb381c30c.sourceText: 每一年，希望中文学校都会精挑细选一些优秀的新教师加入希望的队伍，今年也不例外。他们是毕业于国内师范大学英语系，在国内从事教育工作5年多的王萧莉老师；在现代中文学校执教过六年，以灵活丰富的教学经验和学生喜闻乐见的课堂活动闻名的沈颢瑾老师；研究生就读于内布拉斯加大学林肯分校的教育学院，在林肯和堪萨斯都有过中文教学经历的何舟洲老师；还有具有英文口语和写作教学执照的Robert Bowley老师，他将执教我校的English Writing班。感谢这些优秀人才的加入，使得学校的师资力量始终保持资深教师和新鲜能量的互补状态。
41b470080cbc9a5bb4ddf6b39400d82bb381c30c.translatedText: Every year, Hope Chinese School carefully selects some outstanding new teachers to join the Hope team, and this year is no exception. They are Teacher Wang Xiaoli, who graduated from the English Department of a domestic normal university and has been engaged in education in China for more than five years; Teacher Shen Haojin, who has taught in a modern Chinese school for six years and is famous for her flexible and rich teaching experience and classroom activities that students love; Teacher He Zhouzhou, who studied at the School of Education at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln and has Chinese teaching experience in Lincoln and Kansas; and Teacher Robert Bowley, who has an English speaking and writing teaching license, and will teach our school's English Writing class. Thanks to the addition of these outstanding talents, the school's teaching staff has always maintained a complementary state of senior teachers and fresh energy.

39540f7209b49e464596ee006085974c1541edc0.sourceText: 龚明老师和朱婕老师是本地资深的优秀中文教师，虽然她们因为各种原因，今年不在我校任教，但是学校还是特聘这二位优秀的教师作为我校中文组的顾问，邀她们经常莅临学校与教师交流心得，督促教学工作。在集体会议后的分组讨论里，龚老师和朱老师向新旧中文教师传授她们多年的教学心得，诸如如何提高学生学习的兴趣，如何缓解高年级学生对学习中文的抵触情绪，如何合理使用教材又自行丰富教学内容等等。新老师们也积极提出了自己对教材的困惑以及在教学中可能会碰到的问题。
39540f7209b49e464596ee006085974c1541edc0.translatedText: Mr. Gong Ming and Mr. Zhu Jie are excellent local senior Chinese teachers. Although they will not teach in our school this year due to various reasons, the school still specially hired these two outstanding teachers as consultants for the Chinese group of our school, and invited them to visit the school frequently to exchange experiences with teachers and supervise teaching work. In the group discussions after the group meeting, Teachers Gong and Zhu shared their many years of teaching experience with new and old Chinese teachers, such as how to improve students’ interest in learning, how to alleviate senior students’ resistance to learning Chinese, how to use teaching materials rationally and enrich teaching content themselves, etc. New teachers also actively raised their confusion about the teaching materials and problems they may encounter in teaching.

4ea10c4213d5892e63cbee0962e18e58edc99846.sourceText: 聆听一掬珠露呤落于幽莲之上 （亚省时报楊綺薇） 慢慢行走在深秋的路上，有点寒意的秋风，吹拂着脸庞，很清爽的感觉。路树在秋风的舞动下，枝叶沙沙作响，好像在绵绵絮语；偶尔，秋风携着冷雨漫天飘洒飞扬，翩跹着诗词歌赋里的古典，以平平仄仄的旋律轻凝如水般漾向云海深处。 平常散步常经过一个河塘，不知何时，映红迭翠的莲花开了，河塘边的太阳花也灿烂着，红的、紫的、白的花朵优雅地绽放着，在雾岚中轻举一缕幽幽清韵，轻盈的掠过袅袅黛烟中的流苏，沁来一丝轻寒。 幽僻的河塘流波微漾，莲儿在不为人注意之中，幽幽地悄然盛开了，轻柔婉约，疏影横斜，琴瑟凝寂，暗香浮动。突然，脑海里浮现出周敦颐的《爱莲说》：予独爱莲之出淤泥而不染，濯清涟而不妖，中通外直，不蔓不枝，香远益清，亭亭净直。可远观而不可亵玩焉。 就这样漫步于河畔，任秋风轻拂衣袂，浅足香陌，细细寻觅一枚莲蓬，聆听一掬珠露呤落于碧荷红莲之上，凝结一份悠然恬静的情致，幽情如莲，恍然若梦厖
4ea10c4213d5892e63cbee0962e18e58edc99846.translatedText: Listening to a handful of dew falling on the lotus (Alberta Times Yang Qiwei) Walking slowly on the road in late autumn, the slightly chilly autumn wind blows on your face, which feels very refreshing. Under the dance of the autumn wind, the branches and leaves of the road trees rustle, as if they are whispering; occasionally, the autumn wind carries the cold rain and floats all over the sky, dancing classical poems and songs, with melodies that condense like water and ripple into the depths of the sea of ​​clouds. I often pass by a river pond when I take a walk. I don’t know when the red lotuses bloomed, and the sunflowers beside the river pond were also brilliant. Red, purple, and white flowers bloomed gracefully, a wisp of quiet charm in the mist, lightly passing through the tassels in the curling black smoke, and a hint of coldness. The waves in the secluded river pond are slightly rippling, and the lotus blossoms are blooming quietly without being noticed. They are soft and graceful, with sparse shadows slanting, the piano and harp are silent, and the faint fragrance floats. Suddenly, Zhou Dunyi's "On Loving the Lotus" came to mind: I love the lotus when it emerges from the mud but is not stained; You can watch it from a distance but don't play with it. Just like this, I stroll along the riverside, letting the autumn wind gently caress my clothes. I look for a lotus pod carefully and listen to a handful of dew falling on the green lotus and red lotus. It condenses a leisurely and tranquil feeling, as quiet as a lotus and suddenly like a dream.

As a representative of Chinese culture in the Phoenix area, New Oriental Art School is deeply honored and proud to be based in the Chinese community and move towards a broad American national cultural platform. f758b704efc46d1dbdf4d63c68a22bee1163099f.translatedText: (New York Times Chinese website financial commentator Wang Qiang)

7f25eeb3e4ddd83b3b182c606698a39a6ffb59b5.sourceText: 中国海洋石油（下称中海油）151亿美元收购加拿大尼克森(Nexen)公司一事，极有可能因为牵涉一桩内幕交易案而生变数。果真如此，这对一直希望国际化的中海油来说，将是一次重大打击。
7f25eeb3e4ddd83b3b182c606698a39a6ffb59b5.translatedText: China National Offshore Oil Corporation (hereinafter referred to as CNOOC)’s US$15.1 billion acquisition of Canada’s Nexen Company is very likely to be affected by an insider trading case. If so, this will be a major blow to CNOOC, which has always hoped to internationalize.

d177868ebc84bc94c972184e1c2340280d28b1f0.sourceText: 揭露丑闻的是美国证券交易委员会（Securities and Exchange Commission，简称S.E.C）。今年7月23日，中海油（香港交易所代码：0883）宣布对在美国上市的尼克森公司（纽约交易所代码：NXY）启动收购方案。警觉的S.E.C发现尼克森的股票此前出现异常波动，随之展开调查。
d177868ebc84bc94c972184e1c2340280d28b1f0.translatedText: It was the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (S.E.C) that exposed the scandal. On July 23 this year, CNOOC (Hong Kong Stock Exchange code: 0883) announced the launch of an acquisition plan for Nexen Corporation (New York Stock Exchange code: NXY) listed in the United States. The alert S.E.C discovered that Nexen's stock had experienced abnormal fluctuations before, and subsequently launched an investigation.

e0e2f50e44c24aa618f7ebf6f58335ffaf3778a2.sourceText: 四天后，S.E.C发布了一份调查报告，披露了与中海油有密切生意往来的熔盛重工（香港交易所代码：1101）创始人及大股东张志熔涉嫌利用内幕信息进行内幕交易的事宜，张志熔被指称通过内幕消息获利逾700万美元，随即S.E.C对其账户内的3800万美元资产进行了冻结。
e0e2f50e44c24aa618f7ebf6f58335ffaf3778a2.translatedText: Four days later, the S.E.C issued an investigation report, revealing that Zhang Zhirong, the founder and major shareholder of Rongsheng Heavy Industries (Hong Kong Stock Exchange Code: 1101), which had close business dealings with CNOOC, was suspected of using inside information to conduct insider trading. Zhang Zhirong was alleged to have made more than US$7 million in profits through inside information, and the S.E.C immediately froze US$38 million in assets in his account.

d4284418beae84c2e368957393d7aaccf23deb50.sourceText: S.E.C报告公布后，有分析认为，中国最大民营船企熔盛重工的创始人兼董事局主席张志熔不会因为这700万美元以身犯险，因为其与中海油关系密切，不排除是中海油内部人士想通过此交易获利，而请张志熔代劳。
d4284418beae84c2e368957393d7aaccf23deb50.translatedText: > After the S.E.C report was released, some analysts believed that Zhang Zhirong, the founder and chairman of the board of directors of Rongsheng Heavy Industry, China's largest private shipbuilding company, would not risk his life because of the US$7 million because of his close relationship with CNOOC. It cannot be ruled out that CNOOC insiders wanted to profit from this transaction and asked Zhang Zhirong to do it for him.

935e9fc58ae44a43389198c564eb79ded20532a6.sourceText: 此猜测在某种程度上正得到证实。应S.E.C要求，中海油和涉及交易各方已经就这桩内幕交易案开始进行自查。据《第一财经日报》报道，中海油初步调查结果显示，此次交易涉及上百人，仅中海油就有几十人。
935e9fc58ae44a43389198c564eb79ded20532a6.translatedText: This speculation is being confirmed to some extent. At the request of the S.E.C., CNOOC and all parties involved in the transaction have begun self-examination on this insider trading case. According to China Business News, CNOOC’s preliminary investigation results showed that hundreds of people were involved in this transaction, including dozens of people in CNOOC alone.

d8ce62f1d152d833a31b5ecc58da01795a4a5703.sourceText: 就具体案件来说，显然远未到下结论的时候。人们除了关心内幕交易的细节外，更关心的是，到底谁是操纵内幕交易的人？在这场交易中，中国央企中海油到底哪些人牵涉其中，并扮演了怎样的角色？
d8ce62f1d152d833a31b5ecc58da01795a4a5703.translatedText: As far as the specific case is concerned, it is obviously far from time to draw a conclusion. In addition to caring about the details of insider trading, people are more concerned about who is manipulating insider trading? In this transaction, who is involved in China's central enterprise CNOOC, and what role did they play?

96f0254e12a5caedd2bb16dac388bf55b3008169.sourceText: 目前，中海油只是应S.E.C的要求进行自查，虽然中海油可能由于考虑到国际形象以及今后在跨国收购时仍需美国方面批准，会配合调查，但美国S.E.C毕竟对中国的央企没有直接的法律约束，如涉及到重要人物，中海油能否大义灭亲？
96f0254e12a5caedd2bb16dac388bf55b3008169.translatedText: At present, CNOOC is only conducting a self-examination at the request of the S.E.C. Although CNOOC may cooperate with the investigation due to its international image and the fact that it will still need U.S. approval for future cross-border acquisitions, after all, the U.S. S.E.C. has no direct legal constraints on China’s central enterprises. If important figures are involved, can CNOOC extinguish relatives in a righteous manner?

c436b1f2a9b0a1952707f8391e590503ca035cf3.sourceText: 不论美国是否有借打击内幕给中海油海外收购设置障碍之嫌，美国打击内幕交易的效率和程序设置都值得中国有所借鉴。
c436b1f2a9b0a1952707f8391e590503ca035cf3.translatedText: Regardless of whether the United States is suspected of setting up obstacles to CNOOC's overseas acquisitions by cracking down on insider trading, the efficiency and procedures of the United States' crackdown on insider trading are worth learning from China.

a3efde1eb28105f66dee2ed57e876f3591a5626e.sourceText: 在中国国内，上市公司的重组和并购过程，也是内幕交易的多发时段。就在美国调查张志熔涉嫌内幕交易之际，张志熔在中国可能会面临另一场内幕交易调查。去年4月，熔盛重工宣布对全柴动力（上海交易所代码：600218）进行要约收购。不过，今年8月22日，熔盛重工爽约，称一年内不再重启全柴动力收购。此举引起了投资者的不满，并质疑收购过程中存在内幕交易。
a3efde1eb28105f66dee2ed57e876f3591a5626e.translatedText: In China, the restructuring and merger and acquisition process of listed companies is also a period of frequent insider trading. Just as the United States is investigating Zhang Zhirong for alleged insider trading, Zhang Zhirong may face another insider trading investigation in China. In April last year, Rongsheng Heavy Industry announced a tender offer for Quanchai Power (Shanghai Stock Exchange Code: 600218). However, on August 22 this year, Rongsheng Heavy Industry broke the contract and stated that it would not restart the acquisition of Quanchai Power within one year. The move caused dissatisfaction among investors, who questioned the existence of insider trading in the acquisition process.

c04934437a7f1514e1425ab1ad2439b29f351fe4.sourceText: 《证券时报》报道，有小股东已经向公安部、证监会举报要求相关部门彻查内幕交易可能性。《第一财经日报》也披露，早在2010年4月，有关全柴动力重组有潜在收购方的消息就已经小范围传播。一些投资者还将此次收购中，有关具体参与人员亲属违规买卖股票的情况，向安徽当地的证监局进行了举报。该媒体调查说，”熔盛重工试图从全柴动力全身而退，其原因不仅仅是股价腰斩、造船主业萎缩和资金链紧绷，内幕交易或许才是那团想包住的’火’。”
c04934437a7f1514e1425ab1ad2439b29f351fe4.translatedText: "Securities Times" reported that some small shareholders have reported to the Ministry of Public Security and the China Securities Regulatory Commission, requesting relevant departments to thoroughly investigate the possibility of insider trading. "China Business News" also disclosed that as early as April 2010, news about potential acquirers of Quanchai Power's restructuring had been spread to a small extent. Some investors also reported to the local Anhui Securities Regulatory Bureau about illegal stock buying and selling by relatives of specific participants in the acquisition. The media investigation said, "Rongsheng Heavy Industry is trying to withdraw from Quanchai Power. The reason is not only that the stock price has halved, the main shipbuilding business has shrunk, and the capital chain is tight. Insider trading may be the 'fire' that it wants to contain."

ebe5ceb242cf16385fea62a00a787449659c405f.sourceText: 其实，通过内幕交易获得非法收益的丑闻自中国证券市场建立之日起就存在。1990年代末到本世纪初席卷沪深股市的”基金黑幕”风暴，随后中国股市”黄金十年”中出现的大量老鼠仓，都严重动摇了中国股市的根基。
ebe5ceb242cf16385fea62a00a787449659c405f.translatedText: In fact, the scandal of illegal gains obtained through insider trading has existed since the establishment of China's securities market. The "fund shady" storm that swept through the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets from the late 1990s to the beginning of this century, and the subsequent emergence of a large number of rat positions in the "golden decade" of the Chinese stock market, seriously shook the foundation of the Chinese stock market.

4a6dc8b0c3ff1964d9a5618cf4bedcd1272ff7ec.sourceText: 中国并非没有意识到问题的严重性，过去一些年来，中国也试图通过修改刑法、加强外部监管和增强信息披露制度等做法来限制内幕交易的发生，但是效果不佳。
4a6dc8b0c3ff1964d9a5618cf4bedcd1272ff7ec.translatedText: China is not unaware of the seriousness of the problem. In the past few years, China has also tried to restrict the occurrence of insider trading by amending its criminal law, strengthening external supervision and strengthening the information disclosure system, but the results have been poor.

e0805f6896f324eca926f5f3438896f704f5bd1a.sourceText: 2011年10月底，原中国建设银行股份有限公司党委书记、董事长郭树清履新证监会主席后，更是高调声明对内幕交易坚持”零容忍”，强调对于内幕交易决不手软。从今年7月开始，证监会派出了200人在全国通查内幕交易。市场层面认为，一场极其严厉的监管风暴正在拉开，与当年严打基金黑幕和券商乱局遥相呼应。这可能是中国证券史上规模最大的监管风暴。
e0805f6896f324eca926f5f3438896f704f5bd1a.translatedText: At the end of October 2011, after Guo Shuqing, the former party secretary and chairman of China Construction Bank Co., Ltd., took office as chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, he even made a high-profile statement adhering to "zero tolerance" for insider trading, emphasizing that he would never be soft on insider trading. Starting in July this year, the China Securities Regulatory Commission dispatched 200 people to investigate insider trading across the country. At the market level, it is believed that an extremely severe regulatory storm is unfolding, echoing the crackdown on fund shady practices and the chaos among brokerage firms. This may be the largest regulatory storm in the history of Chinese securities.

911ce820b8b2816867c7d4e8fd7cfc45a6b50b53.sourceText: 郭树清的决心确实开始引起各个层面的反应，过去的一些大牌基金经理受到外部生态的变化，开始收缩甚至退场，而一批内幕交易案件也正处于调查和审理之中，一大批涉案的机构和上市公司开始浮出水面，表面上看，确有一战到底的态势。
911ce820b8b2816867c7d4e8fd7cfc45a6b50b53.translatedText: Guo Shuqing's determination has indeed begun to arouse reactions at all levels. Some big-name fund managers in the past have begun to shrink or even withdraw from the market due to changes in the external ecology. A number of insider trading cases are also under investigation and trial. A large number of institutions and listed companies involved in the case have begun to surface. On the surface, there is indeed a battle to the end.

bc60a508370b4c90f9f6a12a3f8bc769257fa88d.sourceText: 但是，外界和郭树清都清楚，决心与现实之间还隔着一条多么深的沟壑，所谓”零容忍”只不过是施政理想罢了，真正兑现绝非易事。不要说央企等强势集团不敢轻易碰触，即使是针对一些涉案的普通上市公司的处理上，也并未看出惩戒的力度有多大。
bc60a508370b4c90f9f6a12a3f8bc769257fa88d.translatedText: However, both the outside world and Guo Shuqing know how deep the gap is between determination and reality. The so-called "zero tolerance" is just a policy ideal, and it is not easy to realize it. Not to mention that powerful groups such as central enterprises do not dare to touch easily. Even when dealing with some ordinary listed companies involved in the case, it is not clear how strong the punishment will be.

51cb8042dda31f39fc54c911ee645abc46ab969d.sourceText: 比如外界注意到，宁夏新日恒力一案中，该公司董事长肖家守把重组信息泄露给妻子，其妻买卖宁夏恒力股票（上海交易所代码：600165）并获利13万元。结果只是罚款15万元，而不是5倍上限的65万元。违法成本如此之低，如何起到威慑作用？
51cb8042dda31f39fc54c911ee645abc46ab969d.translatedText: For example, the outside world noticed that in the case of Ningxia Xinri Hengli, the company’s chairman Xiao Jiashou leaked restructuring information to his wife, and his wife bought and sold Ningxia Hengli shares (Shanghai Stock Exchange Code: 600165) and made a profit of 130,000 yuan. The result was only a fine of 150,000 yuan, not 650,000 yuan, which was 5 times the upper limit. How can it act as a deterrent when the cost of breaking the law is so low?

44dcb049fbedec339fe481ca8ab629c32fecfe37.sourceText: 更何况，郭树清的对手绝不仅仅是些”小偷小摸”之流。在目前的中国，有很多利益集团凌驾在监管之上或者游离于监管之外，那些权力拥有者或者躲在权力背后的江洋大盗和坐庄者们可以轻松操纵内幕交易而不担心法律的打击。
44dcb049fbedec339fe481ca8ab629c32fecfe37.translatedText: What's more, Guo Shuqing's opponents are by no means just "petty thieves". In today's China, there are many interest groups that are above or outside of regulation. Those power holders or thieves and bankers hiding behind power can easily manipulate insider trading without fear of legal repercussions.

49eebdad003485ee14b9cc5ea568064f0c69adc1.sourceText: 不能说郭树清没有能力，和曾担任过证监会主席的周小川一样，他们都是学者型官员，都有着廓清中国证券市场的远大理想，但周小川的市场化改革最终被认为是黯然收尾。高调的郭树清能否走得更远，市场的期待似乎并不高。
49eebdad003485ee14b9cc5ea568064f0c69adc1.translatedText: It cannot be said that Guo Shuqing is incompetent. Like Zhou Xiaochuan, who once served as chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, they are both scholarly officials and have lofty ideals to clarify China's securities market. However, Zhou Xiaochuan's market-oriented reforms were ultimately considered to have ended sadly. Whether the high-profile Guo Shuqing can go further, the market's expectations do not seem to be high.

723a6ef47c595a51e3dafd4b94d8439c3928ecef.sourceText: 起码目前来看，郭树清绝非幸运之辈。他上任不久，中国股市就跌入谷底，抱怨声不断。已经有不少声音建议郭树清辞职。这些声音不论来自受伤的股民，抑或来自抵制郭树清新政的既得利益集团，都说明郭树清未来的路充满险阻。
723a6ef47c595a51e3dafd4b94d8439c3928ecef.translatedText: At least for now, Guo Shuqing is by no means a lucky person. Not long after he took office, China's stock market hit rock bottom and complaints continued. There have been many voices suggesting that Guo Shuqing resigns. Whether these voices come from injured investors or from vested interest groups that resist Guo Shuqing's administration, they all indicate that Guo Shuqing's future is full of obstacles.

cebf31671847e7813e72417b7713ec8321779e26.sourceText: 研究：草莓蓝莓能降低妇女患心脏病机率 据一项新的研究报告揭示，每周至少吃三次草莓或蓝莓的年轻女性，相比于那些很少吃同类浆果的姐妹们，患心肌梗塞的可能性降低了三分之一。 即使在研究人员调整了研究对象， 比如按照年龄，血压，心肌梗塞家族病史，身体质量指数，运动，吸烟，咖啡因或酒精的摄入量等指标划分群组，食用草莓或蓝莓等浆果的好处也显现得足够强大。研究人员发现，使得蓝莓和草莓具有宝石般色彩的花青素 （anthocyanins），可能对健康有利。花青素有扩张血管和降低粥状动脉硬化斑块积聚的功效。 最新的研究成果报告， ”护士健康研究II”，发表在美国心脏协会的期刊 ”循环” 上。这项研究分析了大约93,600名年龄在25至42岁的妇女在18年期间每四年统计一次的饮食习惯。 在研究期间，有405例心肌梗塞病例发生。这一患病率是较低的，因为这些妇女的年龄较低。但研究对像中每周吃三次或更多草莓和蓝莓者，则比较少吃这类浆果者，患早期心肌梗塞的人数少32% 。即使那些较少吃草莓和蓝莓的妇女也食用丰富的水果和蔬菜，她们患早期心肌梗塞的比率仍高于前者。 上述论文的作者，哈佛大学公共卫生学院营养和流行病学教授埃里克瑞曼指出，这个简单的饮食变化可能起到了积极的预防作用。据他和他的合作者推测，如果在生命的早期就衡量并显示浆果的食用对健康的影响力，那么它对以后的好处 也可能显示出来，比如当女性高龄时其心肌梗塞患病率是接近于男性的。 作者的研究主要是针对美国人普遍食用的草莓和蓝莓作出的。但据他们说，其他的浆果如山莓 （raspberries） 可能也有类似的功效。
cebf31671847e7813e72417b7713ec8321779e26.translatedText: Research: Strawberries and blueberries can reduce the risk of heart disease in women. Young women who eat strawberries or blueberries at least three times a week are one-third less likely to suffer from myocardial infarction than their sisters who rarely eat the same berries, according to a new study. The benefits of eating berries such as strawberries or blueberries remained strong even after the researchers adjusted the study subjects, such as by age, blood pressure, family history of myocardial infarction, body mass index, exercise, smoking, and caffeine or alcohol intake. Researchers have found that anthocyanins, the chemicals that give blueberries and strawberries their jewel-like color, may have health benefits. Anthocyanins have the effect of dilating blood vessels and reducing the accumulation of atherosclerotic plaques. The latest report on the findings, "Nurse Health Study II," was published in Circulation, the American Heart Association's journal. The study analyzed the eating habits of about 93,600 women aged 25 to 42, who were surveyed every four years over an 18-year period. During the study period, 405 cases of myocardial infarction occurred. This prevalence is lower because of the younger age of these women. But study subjects who ate strawberries and blueberries three or more times a week were 32% less likely to suffer early myocardial infarction than those who ate less of these berries. Even among women who ate fewer strawberries and blueberries but also consumed more fruits and vegetables, they still had higher rates of early myocardial infarction. Eric Reiman, author of the above paper and professor of nutrition and epidemiology at the Harvard School of Public Health, points out that this simple dietary change may have a positive preventive effect. He and his collaborators speculate that if the health effects of berry consumption are measured and shown early in life, the benefits may also be shown later in life, such as when women get closer to the rate of myocardial infarction than men do in older age. The author's research focused on strawberries and blueberries, which are commonly consumed by Americans. But according to them, other berries such as raspberries may have similar effects.

9a2819ad04d6b6d9d1808a74ef2a7aa1b1730b52.sourceText: 杨济群：中国人过圣诞 平安夜，相当于中国旧历年的除夕，是人们格外重视的节日。自从来到美国后，入乡随俗，我们也逐渐地重视起圣诞节这个佳节了，一家人和一群中国朋友都会隆重地过圣诞节。 今年的平安夜，照列我们全家人都会在一起，大家动手包饺子，这大概是与美国的家庭最不同的地方了，平时家人都各自忙碌，难得有机会相聚，耶诞节能团聚在一起是件高兴的事，我们一边包着个个像元宝的饺子，一边说笑聊天，其乐融融！我在想，人生就是这样，聚散匆匆，大家都要珍惜相处的时日，我这个将近80岁的老人，更愿意看见下一代，下二代年青人欢乐喜悦的情景，每一个做父母的都希望儿女们团结友爱，互相帮助，彼此理解包容，坦诚相待，这样怕是所有老人的愿望吧！我们家的平安夜，在吃着中国传统食物饺子后，平平安安充满和谐的气氛下过去了。 第二天圣诞日，又一个更大的聚会等着我们，我女婿的外甥女家请了另外六家中国朋友同时到她的巨大的新居去过圣诞，我们全家人又在那里与朋友们在一起，在这个场合，我成了第四代孩子们的老老祖母，看见这么多的年青人（其实也都是40-60以上的人了）热情欢快地相聚在一起，其中有从中北京回凤城家中过节的刘先生和我的儿媳妇，还有从纽约来的崔女士，真是来自五湖四海，共济一堂，七嘴八舌说着各自的见闻，谈天说地道出各种新闻趣事，欢声笑语不绝于耳，这一群中国的有识之士，各自拼搏在美国的各种行业，各自的岗位上，他（她）们都是勇敢的开拓者，看着这群充满活力，充满自信的年青人，不由生出种种感慨，首先是感到自己老矣！生命已经进入倒计时，然而，又从这群欢乐的人群中获得鼓舞与希望，认为自己虽老而不应服老，老而不呆，老而不废，应该尽自己所能做些于人于己都有益的事，正在痴想时，忽听主人请入座吃饭，于是十几个男男女女就坐后，互相碰杯并相互祝福，餐桌上摆满佳肴，三个煤油炉同时燃起，炉上的锅里滚滚鸡汤冒着热气！啊！涮羊肉，又是一顿地道的中国饭，在美国凤城的一角，一群中国人端着盛有各种调料的小碗，涮着羊肉，牛肉，鸡肉，鱼，虾等各种肉类以及各式各样的蔬菜，粉丝，豆腐等，一边说笑，一边互相敬酒，其热烈火爆的情景难以形容，大家都吃得汗流浃背，热气腾腾，饭后是各种甜点，冰激凌，一场中西合璧的大餐直到深夜方告结束。 这里的圣诞虽无烟花爆竹，更没有贴门神，但，每家每户门前却多了五彩缤纷各种造型的美丽彩灯，繁花似锦，令人心醉。今年的圣诞佳节就在这欢乐声中过去了，祝愿明年的圣诞，国家兴旺，人们更加欢乐，轻松愉快地过节。 2011. 12. 27日
9a2819ad04d6b6d9d1808a74ef2a7aa1b1730b52.translatedText: Yang Jiqun: Chinese people celebrate Christmas. Christmas Eve is equivalent to New Year’s Eve in the old Chinese calendar. It is a festival that people pay special attention to. Since coming to the United States, we have followed the local customs, and we have gradually paid more attention to the holiday of Christmas. Our family and a group of Chinese friends will celebrate Christmas grandly. On Christmas Eve this year, our whole family will be together and we will make dumplings. This is probably the most different thing from American families. Family members are usually busy on their own and rarely have the opportunity to get together. It is a joy to be together on Christmas. We make dumplings that look like gold ingots while laughing and chatting. It’s a great time! I was thinking that life is like this, we gather and disperse in a hurry, and everyone should cherish the time we spend together. As an old man who is nearly 80 years old, I would rather see the next generation, the next generation of young people, happy and joyful. Every parent hopes that their children will unite and love each other, help each other, understand and tolerate each other, and treat each other honestly. I am afraid this is the wish of all elderly people! Our family’s Christmas Eve passed peacefully and in a harmonious atmosphere after eating dumplings, a traditional Chinese food. On Christmas Day the next day, another bigger party awaited us. My son-in-law’s niece’s family invited six other Chinese friends to spend Christmas at her huge new home. Our whole family was there with friends again. On this occasion, I became the grandmother of the fourth generation of children. I saw so many young people (actually they are all over 40-60) gathered together enthusiastically and cheerfully. Among them were Mr. Liu who returned to Fengcheng from Beijing to celebrate the holidays. My daughter-in-law, and Ms. Cui from New York, really come from all over the world, and they are all together, talking about their own experiences, talking about all kinds of news and interesting things, and laughing and laughing. This group of Chinese intellectuals They are all brave pioneers working hard in various industries and positions in the United States. Looking at this group of energetic and confident young people, I can't help but have various emotions. First of all, I feel that I am old! Life has entered a countdown. However, I get encouragement and hope from this group of happy people. I think that although I am old, I should not accept old age, do not stay old, and should do my best to do things that are beneficial to others and myself. While I was thinking about it, I suddenly heard the host invite me to sit down for dinner. So a dozen men and women sat down, clinked glasses and blessed each other. ah! Lamb shabu-shabu is another authentic Chinese meal. In a corner of Fengcheng in the United States, a group of Chinese people are holding small bowls filled with various seasonings, shabu-shabu shabu-shabu with mutton, beef, chicken, fish, shrimp and other meats as well as various vegetables, vermicelli, Tofu and others were chatting and joking while toasting each other. The lively scene was indescribable. Everyone was sweating and steaming after eating. After the meal, there were various desserts and ice cream. The feast of Chinese and Western meals ended late at night. Although there are no fireworks or door gods at Christmas here, there are colorful and beautiful lanterns of various shapes in front of every house, and the flowers are blooming, which is enchanting. This year’s Christmas has passed with such joy. I wish that next Christmas, the country will be prosperous and people will be more joyful and spend the holiday in a relaxed and happy way. 2011. 12. 27

9e50832a0de9c1879427e2f5ad523ed3959035db.translatedText: Another incident of a white policeman shooting a black man occurred in the United States. In Arizona, a police officer shot and killed a black suspected drug dealer who was unarmed at the time. Police later found a semi-automatic pistol and a bottle of a substance believed to be marijuana in the deceased's car. —

ea8555a862c31843beec38dc52d08ad9049741cb.sourceText: 被白人警员开枪击毙的34岁黑人布里斯本，2号傍晚，将车停在菲尼克斯一间便利店的门口。有目击者向警员举报他涉嫌贩毒。
ea8555a862c31843beec38dc52d08ad9049741cb.translatedText: The 34-year-old black man in Brisbane, who was shot and killed by a white police officer, parked his car in front of a convenience store in Phoenix on the evening of the 2nd. Witnesses reported to the police that he was suspected of drug trafficking.

ef79269c77b4da344169f4ba021a6d0663dd4ed3.sourceText: 警员随即请求增援， 并看见 布里斯本 把车后座上的东西挪开。警员立即要求 布里斯本 举起双手，但他却跳车逃跑并闯入有小童在场的民居。
ef79269c77b4da344169f4ba021a6d0663dd4ed3.translatedText: The officer immediately called for backup and saw Brisbane moving items from the back seat of the car. The police immediately asked Brisbane to show his hands, but he jumped out of the car and ran away and broke into a house where children were present.

7ba66cf6bb7c704bcef8b21ffde1e43a66485c5c.sourceText: 警方发言人称，由于这名有7年年资的警员，无法捉紧布里斯本收藏在口袋里的左手，加上感觉口袋里藏有手枪，于是连开两枪把他击毙。
7ba66cf6bb7c704bcef8b21ffde1e43a66485c5c.translatedText: A police spokesman said that because the police officer, who had 7 years of experience, could not grasp Brisbane's left hand that was hidden in his pocket, and felt that there was a pistol hidden in his pocket, he shot him dead with two shots.

545ed30ed94e4dceb6a51686e8ed9b604da1c00c.sourceText: 事后证实口袋里只有一樽止痛药，但就在布里斯本的汽车发现手枪，和一瓶相信为大麻的物质。
545ed30ed94e4dceb6a51686e8ed9b604da1c00c.translatedText: It was later confirmed that there was only a bottle of painkillers in his pocket, but a pistol and a bottle of a substance believed to be cannabis were found in the car in Brisbane.

23833225110f4df7faa024cbc2242e9ff028d32b.sourceText: 布里斯本家人的律师就表示， 警员将布里斯本撃毙，使他的4名子女失去父亲，他的太太失去丈夫。警方需要重新评估他们执法的手法，不应将疑犯撃毙。
23833225110f4df7faa024cbc2242e9ff028d32b.translatedText: A lawyer for Brisbane's family said that the police killed Brisbane, leaving his four children without a father and his wife without a husband. The police need to re-evaluate their law enforcement methods and should not kill suspects.

50caea0e984ff04606177b10b133c76ba6271ce0.sourceText: 近半年，多名黑人在警方执法行动中死亡，引发连串示威。总统奥巴马表示，要处理警方使用致命武力的问题，以及改善民众对警方管治的信任
50caea0e984ff04606177b10b133c76ba6271ce0.translatedText: In the past six months, many black people have died during police enforcement operations, triggering a series of demonstrations. President Obama said he needed to address the issue of police use of deadly force and improve public trust in police governance.

1f31e9d75c1fe4432c1d31704d3093dcb7f71d3a.sourceText: 問: 什麼是Home Inspection? 為什麼買屋時還要花個幾百元來做Home Inspection? 答: Home Inspection(房屋檢查)可以讓購屋者對屋況有一個詳細和整體性的瞭解，一位合格的專業房屋檢查員可以為您提供深入、公正的房屋檢查報告，報告上應該要記載關於房屋結構的狀況，列出什麼東西需要修理或更換，並對一些主要設備，諸如冷氣機、暖爐、熱水爐等設備的狀況做出一個評估。在亞利桑那的制式化購屋合約中，已預先列出買屋者在購屋合約成立後的10天內有權利做專業房屋檢查，並依據檢查結果要求售屋者改善，或做出是否購買的決定，所以Home Inspection是對購屋者的一個保障。
1f31e9d75c1fe4432c1d31704d3093dcb7f71d3a.translatedText: Q: What is a Home Inspection? Why do you need to spend hundreds of dollars on a Home Inspection when buying a house? A: A Home Inspection allows buyers to have a detailed and comprehensive understanding of the condition of the house. A qualified professional home inspector can provide you with an in-depth and impartial home inspection report. The report should record the condition of the structure of the house, list what needs to be repaired or replaced, and make an assessment of the condition of some major equipment, such as air conditioners, heaters, water heaters, etc. In Arizona's standardized home purchase contract, it is stated in advance that the home buyer has the right to have a professional home inspection within 10 days after the home purchase contract is established, and based on the inspection results, the home seller will be required to make improvements or make a decision on whether to purchase. Therefore, Home Inspection is a guarantee for home buyers.

6ffb82b77b544578751f67dc2d67454bef879fbd.sourceText: 問: 購屋要慎選地區，請問該如何得知某地區的經濟、治安狀況，環境是否安全等問題? 答: 很多資訊都可以在互聯網上免費取得，像是: www.CrimeReports.com ，www.FamilyWatchDog.us 這兩個網站，只要輸入您想查詢的房屋地址，便會以地圖的方式顯示出附近的犯罪活動地點、性罪犯的照片、罪行及住家地址等資料，至於地區的經濟、人口狀況，則可以在www.BestPlaces.net 這個網站中找到資訊。
6ffb82b77b544578751f67dc2d67454bef879fbd.translatedText: Question: When buying a house, you must choose the area carefully. How can you know the economic and security conditions of a certain area, whether the environment is safe, etc.? Answer: A lot of information can be obtained for free on the Internet, such as: www.CrimeReports.com, www.FamilyWatchDog.us For these two websites, as long as you enter the address of the house you want to check, a map will display nearby criminal activity locations, photos of sex offenders, crimes, home addresses and other information. As for the economic and demographic status of the area, you can find information on the website www.BestPlaces.net.

0836cb9536ad8a1bc061d9f4b1505c2f786e00ba.translatedText: Yawen: Fashion Brand - Bags with Outstanding Style. Xiaomei Yingzi and Juzi are working women. They both work in a large company and often travel to various states and countries. They have broad experience and are very popular. Especially their clothing matching taste is generous and decent. They are not the most high-end brands, but they are the most affordable and high-quality fashion styles, which fully express the bright side of women's charm. It is rare for busy people to steal half a day of leisure in their lives. The two of them met together to go shopping in Las Vegas. They were no longer on a business trip, flying in the morning and flying back in the evening. They could only catch a glimpse of the dazzling lights of the city that never sleeps from the plane window, but to experience a different kind of leisure and enjoyment. Who said gambling is The patent of Vegas, this international metropolis, has been transformed to attract money, and the well-known legal gambling has developed into a diversified nature. Regardless of men, women, old or young, if you set foot in Vegas, even if you are not a gambler, you can also enjoy de-stressing shopping and roaming here. Vegas Avenue can be said to be a feast for the eyes! Day and night, there are crowds of people on both sides of Vegas Avenue. Tourists like them don't visit casinos to make money, play slot machines and listen to the jingling of jingles, or gamble recklessly, but spend time strolling on the leisure streets. It is also a great enjoyment. Look! Street performers are scattered all over the place, all with typical cartoon characters suitable for all ages, such as Captain Jack Sparrow, Planet Man, Robot, Iron Man, Spider-Man, Witch, Snow White, Hello Kitty, animals from Sesame Street, Elvis Presley, Marilyn Monroe, and the famous Broadway character Beauty Dancing girls - for tourists to take pictures or enjoy; the melodious classical violin playing is intoxicating, the young men who imitate Michael Jackson's dance perform vividly, the sound of the harmonium and the saxophone often come from fast-paced music, the noisy cheers, applause and screams will make tourists stop and watch. That day, Xiaomeiyingzi and Juzi were in a rush to buy a treasure. Because it was a direct sales store, the general price was 50% off the market. It happened to be a holiday and the additional 40% off discount was the biggest factor in attracting customers. Vegas! You are a paradise for consumers, and all kinds of temptations cannot attract them, but you set up the direct sales mall so that they can return home happily and with full load! Did you win? Or did they both win?

bae15e7fae3b235cb01ac8f4ad712a9c90fa812e.sourceText: 鸭绿江大桥横跨中朝两国国境，它是一座历史的丰碑，历经抗美援朝战火的洗礼，如今依然能清晰地看到桥梁铁架上的众多弹痕和残留的弹孔，还有边上被美军飞机多次轰炸的一座断桥，只剩下半截，朝鲜一侧只留下光秃秃的几个桥墩。 1950年，志愿军35万人马就是从这座桥上悄悄渡过了鸭绿江，开赴了朝鲜战场的。而联合国军的侦察机在天上飞，地面有先进的电子侦察，都没有发现中国军队的蛛丝马迹。这么大规模的兵力调动，美国人竟然没有侦察到。 中国要出兵，事先已经向美国发出了警告，并且是多次警告，可是杜鲁门、麦克阿瑟们不信。麦克阿瑟断言侵朝战争”是赢定了”，中国出兵参战的”可能性很小”，”不足为患”。 毛泽东和彭德怀非常重视研究麦克阿瑟的性格和作战特点。毛泽东说，麦克阿瑟越狂妄、自负、好大喜功，越对我们有利。”兵者，诡道也”。中国正是充分利用了美国的狂妄和不信，出其不意，攻其不备棗采取秘密方式出兵朝鲜。 毛泽东在致彭德怀、高岗的电报中，为这次战役明确了作战方针，在电报中称一定要”利用敌人完全没有料到的突然性”。事实证明，这一方针成为志愿军初战制胜的关键，是不可替代的高招，美英等国的军事家将此举称为”当代战争史上的奇迹”。 毛泽东甚至对作战战报都作了明确细致的要求。他在11月5日指示彭德怀：”为了迷惑敌人的目的，目前还是不宜以联合司令部的名义发表战报，而应以人民军总司令部的名义发表战报”。 ”在目前几个月内，只做不说”。毛泽东致电各中央局说明此事，说我们采取秘密出兵的方式。志愿军参战十几天，也不在报纸上发消息。直到第二次战役取得重大胜利，朝鲜战局得到了根本扭转，才于12月5日中国正式对外宣布了”中国人民志愿军”的番号及出兵作战的消息。 志愿军总部判断，战局一开，美军必出动轰炸机炸毁鸭绿江大桥，阻挡志愿军后援。于是，决定将4个军15个师分左右两支同时渡江，3个炮兵师分插入左右两路，随步兵过江。彭德怀说，兵法讲究攻敌不备、出敌不意，如能保守我军渡江机密，开局获胜，就有了一半把握。 这种”突然性”，成为联合国军与志愿军交手首战失败的主要因素。正如时任美国国防部长的马歇尔说的：”我们认为什么都知道，而实际上什么也不知道。而对方却一切都知道，于是，战争开始了”。这也正是过后美国人一直感到恼闷的重要理由棗为什么就不听听中国人的话呢？
bae15e7fae3b235cb01ac8f4ad712a9c90fa812e.translatedText: The Yalu River Bridge spans the border between China and North Korea. It is a historical monument. It has been baptized by the war to resist U.S. aggression and aid Korea. Today, you can still clearly see the many bullet marks and remaining bullet holes on the iron frame of the bridge. There is also a broken bridge on the side that was bombed many times by U.S. military aircraft. Only half of it is left. Only a few bare bridge piers are left on the North Korean side. In 1950, 350,000 volunteers quietly crossed the Yalu River from this bridge and headed for the Korean battlefield. However, the United Nations reconnaissance planes flying in the sky and advanced electronic reconnaissance on the ground found no trace of the Chinese army. The Americans did not detect such a large-scale troop mobilization. China had already warned the United States in advance that it was going to send troops, and warned many times, but Truman and MacArthur did not believe it. MacArthur asserted that the war of aggression against Korea "is certain to be won" and that the possibility of China sending troops to participate in the war is "very small" and "not enough to cause trouble." Mao Zedong and Peng Dehuai attached great importance to studying MacArthur's character and combat characteristics. Mao Zedong said that the more arrogant, conceited, and overachieving MacArthur is, the more beneficial it will be to us. "Soldiers are deceitful." China took full advantage of the arrogance and disbelief of the United States, taking it by surprise and taking advantage of it by secretly sending troops to North Korea. In a telegram to Peng Dehuai and Gao Gang, Mao Zedong clarified the combat policy for this battle. In the telegram, he stated that we must "take advantage of the suddenness that the enemy did not expect at all." Facts have proved that this policy became the key to the Volunteer Army's victory in the first battle and was an irreplaceable trick. Military strategists from the United States, Britain and other countries called this move "a miracle in the history of contemporary warfare." Mao Zedong even made clear and detailed requirements for combat reports. He instructed Peng Dehuai on November 5: "In order to confuse the enemy, it is still not appropriate to publish the battle report in the name of the Joint Command, but should publish the battle report in the name of the People's Army General Headquarters." "In the current few months, it's all talk, no action." Mao Zedong called various central bureaus to explain the matter and said that we would send troops secretly. The volunteers participated in the war for more than ten days and did not publish any news in newspapers. It was not until the major victory was achieved in the second battle that the Korean War situation was fundamentally reversed. On December 5, China officially announced the designation of the "Chinese People's Volunteers" and the news of sending troops to fight. The Volunteer Army headquarters judged that once the war started, the US military would send bombers to blow up the Yalu River Bridge and block the Volunteer Army's backup. Therefore, it was decided to divide the 15 divisions of the 4 corps into two left and right divisions to cross the river at the same time. Three artillery divisions were inserted into the left and right divisions to cross the river with the infantry. Peng Dehuai said that the art of war emphasizes attacking the enemy unprepared and surprising the enemy. If we can keep the secret of our army's crossing the river, we will be half sure of winning in the beginning. This "suddenness" became the main factor in the failure of the first battle between the United Nations Army and the Volunteer Army. As Marshall, the then U.S. Secretary of Defense, said: "We thought we knew everything, but in fact we knew nothing. But the other side knew everything, and so the war began." This is also an important reason why Americans have been feeling frustrated afterwards. Why don't they listen to the Chinese?

5779c33116936050f17f30c908c6361e7f2ed23a.sourceText: 经济低迷时漫谈中餐馆 传统三原则保你赚到盆满钵满 佳叔 現在美國經濟衰退，汽油飊漲，不景期間，許多行業都受影響，尤以餐館業打擊最甚。亞利桑那州自從去年立苛辣移民法例以來，許多無身份入境靠勞力賺錢，喜歡食中菜的亞米高被迫離開這裏遷往他處，或返回原居地墨西哥，使中餐館的生意在這經濟低迷的今日，更是雪上加霜。 在這裏的各行小生意中，以餐館是最棘手的行業，每日營業時間長，無週末、無假期、舖租貴、人工又高，未做生意前已先付出一筆大錢做水電、廚房工程費，加上傢俬用具不菲，猶如鑲個金碗去討食，開市後不只面臨行家競爭，還要生意時常保持興盛，如果只是曇花一現，每日入不敷出，一條進數，百條支數，月頭交租，月底出糧（薪），還有水、電、煤氣、雜費，夠你頭痛，因此，在這高租、高薪和物價飛漲下，很多中、西餐館選擇關門。 不過中國人的餐館很多不甘損失資金和血汗，寧守株待兔，打到最後一兵一卒才鳴鼓收兵，希望奇景出現，可是當你做來做去生意依然不前，而且每月還要補注資金，如吸血魔般在這樣無計情況下，你要認真考慮清楚，斬釘截鐵地及早變化不可。 我們要明白，做餐館能達到客如雲來不外是傳統三個基本原則(1)菜餚質佳Savory Food。(2)良好服務Good Service。(3)舒適地方Atmosphere，地位次之，若餐價不是獅子大張大口就可以接受，有的人做餐館做到風生水起，賺到埕滿缽滿，這不是個偶然，也不是他的幸運，他有他的優點，比如他是個好廚師，他不只逢事親力親為，而且每道菜在他監視下煮出合水準，時常做口味都是一樣，又比如他感到現在有些中菜不合時宜，將菜式改良，或創新，造出來的菜式更好，和少油膩，適合西人口味，他的太座（或者有同這樣的人）把餐廳打理得井井有條，喚人迎客，交際廣濶，言語伶俐，生張熟李面面俱圓，使客有如賓至如歸感。 倘若你的餐館沒有以上的條件，兼沒有辦法做到這條，那麼要急流勇退，及早收帆，將它賣出或關閉，短痛好過長痛。 許多西人裝修金碧輝煌的餐館，開業不足一年就關閉，我們鳯凰城曾執中餐館牛耳的華美酒家，旺足三、四十年都逃不過?#22519;笠?#21629;運，所以做生意不幸關門，勿感灰心和耻辱，如果你有鬥志，十年八年後又一條好漢，重出江湖，披衣再戰。
5779c33116936050f17f30c908c6361e7f2ed23a.translatedText: Talking about Chinese restaurants when the economy is in a downturn. The three traditional principles can ensure that you can make a lot of money. Uncle Jia. The U.S. economy is now in recession and gasoline prices are skyrocketing. During the recession, many industries have been affected, especially the restaurant industry. Since Arizona enacted harsh immigration laws last year, many undocumented immigrants have made money through labor. Yamigo, who likes to eat Chinese food, has been forced to leave Arizona and move elsewhere, or return to his native Mexico. This has made the business of Chinese restaurants even worse in today's economic downturn. Among the various small businesses here, restaurants are the most difficult ones. They have long daily business hours, no weekends, no holidays, expensive shop rents, and high labor costs. Before starting business, you have to pay a large sum of money for water, electricity, and kitchen engineering fees. In addition, the furniture and utensils are expensive. It is like setting a golden bowl to beg for food. After the market opens, you will not only face the connoisseurs Competition requires business to always be prosperous. If it is just a flash in the pan and you cannot make ends meet every day, you have to pay the rent at the beginning of the month and the food (salary) at the end of the month, as well as water, electricity, gas, and miscellaneous expenses, it is enough for you to have a headache. Therefore, under the current situation of high rents, high wages, and soaring prices, many Chinese and Western restaurants have chosen to close their doors. However, many Chinese restaurants are unwilling to lose money and blood and sweat. They would rather sit back and wait until the last soldier is beaten before calling back the troops, hoping that a miracle will occur. However, when you do it, the business is still stagnant, and you have to replenish funds every month, like a vampire. In such a desperate situation, you must think carefully and decisively make changes as soon as possible. We must understand that there are three traditional basic principles for a restaurant to achieve the goal of attracting customers: (1) Savory Food with good quality dishes. (2)Good ServiceGood Service. (3) Atmosphere, a comfortable place, comes second in status. If the price of the meal is not something that a lion can eat, it can be accepted. Some people make restaurants prosperous and earn a lot of money. This is not an accident, nor is it their luck. He has his own advantages. For example, he is a good chef. He not only does everything himself, but also cooks every dish to a high standard under his supervision. The taste is always the same, and for example, he feels that some Chinese dishes are out of fashion now, so he improves or innovates the dishes to create better dishes, less greasy, and suitable for Western tastes. His queen (or someone like this) keeps the restaurant in order, greets guests, is communicative, speaks eloquently, and cooks the dishes well, making the guests feel like they are at home. If your restaurant does not have the above conditions, and there is no way to do this, then you should retreat quickly, trim the sails as soon as possible, sell or close it, short-term pain is better than long-term pain. Many Western restaurants with splendid decorations closed within a year after opening. Our Huamei Restaurant in Huanghuang City, which was once the leader in Chinese restaurants, could not escape the bad luck for three or forty years, so it was unfortunate that the business was closed. Don't feel discouraged and humiliated. If you have the fighting spirit, after ten or eight years, another hero will come back to the world and fight again.

75b09381c5cc6fefc45f1a8aa865047f9f6261b3.sourceText: 据台湾《旺报》报道，庆祝新亥百年，台北孙中山纪念馆16日上午在阳明山中山楼举办”第23届孙中山、宋庆龄纪念地联席会议”，邀请大陆内地、香港、日本等地代表及相关人员70余人赴台参加盛会。
75b09381c5cc6fefc45f1a8aa865047f9f6261b3.translatedText: According to Taiwan's "Wang Bao" report, to celebrate the New Hai Centenary, the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall in Taipei held the "23rd Sun Yat-sen and Soong Ching Ling Memorial Site Joint Meeting" at the Zhongshan Building in Yangmingshan on the morning of the 16th. More than 70 representatives and related personnel from the mainland, Hong Kong, Japan and other places were invited to Taiwan to participate in the grand meeting.

06124d8b47eeba94ccfb87c8646bc0803423fd0e.sourceText: 孙中山兄长孙眉的嫡长孙孙必胜与会，希望共同促进全球推展孙中山、宋庆龄纪念活动。
06124d8b47eeba94ccfb87c8646bc0803423fd0e.translatedText: Sun Bisheng, the eldest son of Sun Yat-sen's brother Sun Mei, attended the meeting and hoped to jointly promote the global promotion of commemorative activities for Sun Yat-sen and Soong Ching Ling.

cc325f2348aa6db468f06e228059a501fdd011ad.sourceText: 报道形容大陆隆重参与，据报道，大陆方面包括北京市中山堂管理服务办公室、广东孙中山基金会、北京香山碧云寺孙中山纪念堂、上海市孙中山宋庆龄文物管理委员会、黄花岗起义指挥部旧址纪念馆、重庆宋庆龄旧居陈列馆等单位，近70人赴台参加盛会，孙中山兄长孙眉的嫡长孙孙必胜夫妇与会；但宋家方面则未派代表参加。
cc325f2348aa6db468f06e228059a501fdd011ad.translatedText: The report describes the grand participation of the mainland. According to reports, the mainland includes the Beijing Sun Yat-sen Hall Management Service Office, Guangdong Sun Yat-sen Foundation, Beijing Xiangshan Biyun Temple Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall, Shanghai Sun Yat-sen Nearly 70 people from Soong Ching Ling Cultural Relics Management Committee, Huanghuagang Uprising Headquarters Former Site Memorial Hall, Chongqing Soong Ching Ling Former Residence Exhibition Hall and other units went to Taiwan to attend the grand event. Sun Bisheng, the eldest grandson of Sun Yat-sen's brother Sun Mei, and his wife attended the meeting; however, the Song family did not send representatives to attend.

a1437eb083f2796c384d9818b09b863597f2405a.sourceText: 国民党党史馆主任邵铭煌以”孙中山与台湾”为题，发表演讲，说明孙中山与台湾看似短暂却又影响深远的关系；台湾大学教授邓志松则主讲”孙中山的革命行旅”，剖析孙中山为筹措革命及革命资金而走遍全球，并结合与台湾的关连。
a1437eb083f2796c384d9818b09b863597f2405a.translatedText: Shao Minghuang, director of the Kuomintang Party History Museum, gave a speech titled "Sun Yat-sen and Taiwan", explaining the seemingly short-lived but far-reaching relationship between Sun Yat-sen and Taiwan; Professor Deng Zhisong of National Taiwan University gave a lecture on "Sun Yat-sen's Revolutionary Travels", analyzing Sun Yat-sen's travels around the world to raise revolution and revolutionary funds, and combined with his connection with Taiwan.

99b228f921751b60f0d06463a0525946be15c4ed.sourceText: 台北孙中山纪念馆除在中山楼进行为期2天的联席会议外，还邀请所有出席贵宾一起考察孙中山的事迹、参观台北故宫博物院、台北孙中山纪念馆、新北市八里十三行博物馆、客家文化博物馆、九族文化村等中南部各地，整个参访行程预订5月22日结束。
99b228f921751b60f0d06463a0525946be15c4ed.translatedText: In addition to the two-day joint meeting at the Sun Yat-sen Building in Taipei, the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall in Taipei also invited all attending dignitaries to inspect Sun Yat-sen's deeds and visit the Taipei National Palace Museum, Taipei Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall, New Taipei City Bali Thirteen Lines Museum, Hakka Culture Museum, Formosan Aboriginal Cultural Village and other places in central and southern China. The entire visit is scheduled to end on May 22.

ef96da514ab12c20f9f5127abcef7a5326ee6257.sourceText: 由中华全国归国华侨联合会与广州市归国华侨联合会主办亲情中华演出活动，9月7日在洛杉矶中国城金龙大酒家登场，这次”亲情中华”主题活动是以文化艺术为载体，以亲情为纽带，为海外华侨华人送来家乡的问候，传播中华文化，让更多的人了解中国通过多种形式的对外文化交流与合作，深化中国与世界各地人民的了解和友谊。 ”亲情中华”艺术团是由中国侨联和广州市侨联共同组织主办，广东省文化厅从广东歌舞剧院，南方歌舞团，广东省艺术研究所等专业文艺团体选派精英组成。晚会由南方歌舞团优秀青年歌唱家张朝夕《踏歌起舞》拉开帷幕，曾获”二十一世纪华人音乐奖”和中华优秀歌手大赛金奖的张朝夕感情细腻旋律优美动听；李白一首家喻户晓的经典东北民歌《乌苏里船歌》歌声欢快优美；广东歌舞剧院青年歌唱家，国家一级演员常安，以及声情并茂的蒙古族男高音歌唱家蒋伯芳的歌声都给人们美的享受。琵琶，古筝这两种中国著名的器乐，由星海音乐学院青年教师吴琪和广东省艺术研究所演奏家顾蓓蓓演奏经典名曲《旱天雷》活泼流畅，生机盎然，节奏欢快，琵琶和古筝巧妙的结合，更使乐曲委婉流畅，丝丝入扣。晚会压轴的是由八十年代起已在粤语地区享有盛名，中国著名男高音歌唱家唐彪，这位中国音、乐家协会会员，国家一级演员，把全场观众带来了对家乡的无限怀恋，唱罢一首又一首，特别是清唱粤语歌曲全场一起和唱。 ”亲情中华”艺术团还将到旧金山，休斯顿，迈阿密和巴拿马城演出。
ef96da514ab12c20f9f5127abcef7a5326ee6257.translatedText: The family-friendly Chinese performance hosted by the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese and the Guangzhou Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese was held at the Golden Dragon Winery in Chinatown, Los Angeles on September 7 This "Family China" theme event uses culture and art as the carrier and family ties as the bond to send greetings from home to overseas Chinese, spread Chinese culture, and let more people understand China. Through various forms of foreign cultural exchanges and cooperation, it deepens the understanding and friendship between China and people around the world. The "Family China" Art Troupe is jointly organized and sponsored by the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese and the Guangzhou Overseas Chinese Federation. The Guangdong Provincial Department of Culture selects elites from professional literary and artistic groups such as the Guangdong Song and Dance Theater, the Southern Song and Dance Ensemble, and the Guangdong Provincial Art Institute. The party kicked off with "Song and Dance" by Zhang Chaoxi, an outstanding young singer from the Southern Song and Dance Ensemble. Zhang Chaoxi, who has won the "21st Century Chinese Music Award" and the gold medal of the China Outstanding Singer Competition, has delicate emotions and beautiful melodies; Li Bai's famous poem The well-known Northeastern folk song "Ussuri Boat Song" has a cheerful and beautiful singing voice; the singing voices of Chang An, a young singer from the Guangdong Song and Dance Theater and a national first-class actor, and the Mongolian tenor Jiang Bofang, who has a rich and emotional voice, all give people beautiful enjoyment. Pipa and guzheng, two famous Chinese musical instruments, were performed by Wu Qi, a young teacher at Xinghai Conservatory of Music, and Gu Beibei, a performer from the Guangdong Art Institute. The classic song "Thunder in the Dry Sky" was lively and smooth, full of vitality and cheerful rhythm. The ingenious combination of pipa and guzheng made the music euphemistically smooth and perfect. The finale of the party was the famous Chinese tenor Tang Biao, who has been famous in the Cantonese-speaking area since the 1980s. He is a member of the Chinese Musicians and Musicians Association and a national first-class actor. The "Family China" Art Troupe will also perform in San Francisco, Houston, Miami and Panama City.

4a0e465d3c4348be788918d69ec17f560da3d015.sourceText: “富贵在天 知足常乐” 想到的财富观 王斋先 一、”富贵在天”的观念： 孔子的学生子夏说：”死生由命，富贵在天。”（论语 颜渊篇）我们信上帝（天）的人也当如此。 经上说：”因为你们得货财的力量是上帝所给的。”又说：”上帝所赐的福财，使人富足并不加上忧愁。” 这些经文都告诉我们得货财的力量是创造宇宙万物的上帝给我们的。正如我们中国人的”富贵在天”的观念吻合。所以基督徒应”先求”他的国和他的义。而不必忧愁”吃什么穿什么”的民生问题。对于一般基督生活问题，主耶稣特别儆诫我们：”不要为生命忧虑，吃什么喝什么，为身体忧虑穿什么。生命不胜于饮食么？身体不胜于衣裳么？你们看天上的飞鸟，他不种也不收，也不积蓄谷物在仓里，天上的上帝尚且养活它。你们不比飞鸟贵重得多吗？你们那一个能用思虑使寿命加一刻呢？何必为衣裳忧虑呢？你想野地里的百合花，怎样长起来？它也不劳苦，也不纺线，然而我告诉你们，就是所罗门极荣华的时候，他所穿戴的还不如花一朵呢？你们这小信的人哪，野地里的草，今天还在，明天就丢进炉里。神还给他这样的装饰，何况你们呢？所以不要忧虑说：”吃什么，喝什么，穿什么。”这都是外邦人所求的。你们需用的这一切东西，你们的上帝是知道的。因此你要先求他国和他的义，这些东西都要加给你们了。 二、基督徒的财富观： 有衣有食就当知足。俗话说：”知足常乐”。真的能知足的人，才能享受快乐。因为他能安分守己，与世无争，善尽本份，不抱奢望。于是，无忧无愁的生活便在他们的身边。那些在名利场所你争我夺的人，每天只能过着患得患失的生活，哪有快乐而言？所以经上告诉我们：”敬虔加上知足的心，便是大利了。因为我们没有带什么到世上来，也不能带什么去。只要有衣有食，就当知足。”所罗门王也说：” 怎样从母胎赤身而来，也比照样赤身而去，他所劳碌得来的，手中分毫不能带去。”（传五：15-16）”因此我们不可存心贪爱钱财，要以自己所有的为足。” 俗语说：”金钱能使鬼推磨，”实际推磨的是人不是鬼。所以世人误以为”金钱万能”，那么金钱是万能吗？钱财真是可靠吗？有人说：”钱能叫人万事应心”，但他却不是万能。不错，因为金钱能买华美房屋，却不能买美满家庭。可买戏院、舞厅酒家的门票，却不能买心灵的安息，可买人参、鹿茸、补品，却不能买生命不死。可买上天的机票，却不能买进天堂乐园的门票。富足人的丰满，往往不容他睡觉。劳碌的人，不拘吃多吃少，都能睡得香甜。这样说来富足人的钱财，究竟给他带来福气或是灾祸，就难说了。因此，无论你是基督徒或一般平民百姓，对财富不是你遂意可求可取就能得到，不管你的财富有多有少，你必须知道都是上帝的赏赐，那你要来感谢上帝的恩典，并且要好好使用管理，不然将来主要与你算账。 在此纸醉金迷之年代，人人为了追求财富，废寝忘食，千方百计，但是我们抱有永生盼望的基督徒，当与他们有分别，因为我们的盼望，不在乎今生荣华富贵，而在于将来得救永生之道。
4a0e465d3c4348be788918d69ec17f560da3d015.translatedText: "Wealth and honor is in heaven, contentment is always happiness" The view of wealth that comes to mind Wang Zhaixian 1. The concept of "wealth and honor is in heaven": Zixia, a student of Confucius, said: "Death and life depend on fate, wealth and honor depend on heaven. " (The Analects of Confucius, Yan Yuan Chapter) We who believe in God (Heaven) should do the same. The Bible says: "Because the power you have to obtain wealth is given by God. "Also said: "The blessings given by God make people rich without adding sorrow. " These scriptures tell us that the power to obtain wealth is given to us by God who created the universe. It is consistent with our Chinese concept of "wealth is in heaven". Therefore, Christians should "seek first" his kingdom and his righteousness. They do not have to worry about the livelihood issues of "what to eat and what to wear." Regarding the general issues of Christian life, the Lord Jesus specifically warned us: "Don't worry about your life, what you will eat and drink, and what you will wear for your body." Isn't life more than food? Is not the body more valuable than clothing? Look at the birds in the air. They neither sow nor reap nor gather grain into barns, yet the God of heaven feeds them. Aren't you much more valuable than birds? Which of you can add one moment to your life by thinking? Why worry about clothes? How do you think lilies in the field grow? It neither toils nor spins. Yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his splendor was not clothed as a flower. You who have little faith, the grass of the field is here today, but tomorrow you will be thrown into the furnace. If God gives him such decoration, how much more will he give you? So do not worry about, "What to eat, what to drink, what to wear." These are the things that the Gentiles ask for. Your God knows all the things you need. Therefore seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well. 2. The Christian view of wealth: Be content when you have food and clothing. As the saying goes: "Content is always happy." Only those who are truly content can enjoy happiness. Because he can keep to himself, stay aloof from the world, fulfill his duties well, and have no extravagant expectations. Thus, a carefree life is around them. Those who compete for fame and fortune can only live a life worrying about gains and losses every day. How can they be happy? Therefore, the Bible tells us: "Godliness coupled with contentment is great gain. For we brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out of the world. As long as we have food and clothing, we must be content." King Solomon also said: " Naked as he came from his mother's womb, so he went away naked, and his hands will carry away nothing of what he has worked for." (Ecclesiastes 5:15-16) "Therefore we must not love money and be content with what we have." As the saying goes: "Money makes the grinding mill," but it is actually people who grind the grinding wheels. So the world mistakenly believes that "money is everything", so is money everything? Is money really reliable? Some people say: "Money can make everything possible", but it is not omnipotent. Yes, because money can buy a beautiful house, but it cannot buy a happy family. You can buy tickets to theaters, dance halls and restaurants, but you can't buy peace of mind. You can buy ginseng, deer antlers, and supplements, but you can't buy immortality. You can buy a ticket to heaven, but you cannot buy a ticket to paradise. The fullness of a rich man often does not allow him to sleep. People who work hard can sleep soundly no matter how much or how little they eat. In this way, it is difficult to say whether a wealthy person's money will bring him blessings or disasters. Therefore, whether you are a Christian or an ordinary citizen, wealth cannot be obtained by just asking or getting it. No matter how big or small your wealth is, you must know that it is a gift from God. Then you must thank God for His grace and use it well and manage it well, otherwise the Lord will settle accounts with you in the future. In this decadent age, everyone is trying every possible means to pursue wealth, forgetting sleep and eating, but we Christians who have the hope of eternal life should be different from them, because our hope does not lie in the glory and wealth of this life, but in the way of salvation and eternal life in the future.
