3ce88e7f6808edffa8b3da659670fdb727bb6236.sourceText: 上周日晚，亚省华人合唱团在蓝天酒家举行了自2011年春节创办以来的第一次干事会议。 出席会议的成员除了创办人古雅瑜女士外，还有陈志钢先生，黎景辉先生, 黎瑞芳女士, 闻玲琳女士, 麦耀祺先生, 孙效谨, 陈紫兰女士, 李鸿信, 庄淑华女士，黄益成先生，余咏瑜女士, 唐莉萍女士及黄国熙先生共十四人, 卫琭诗女士因故缺席。 席间，大家不仅回顾了合唱团创办一年多来的经历和成绩，也再次​​强调了合唱团创办的宗旨和目的，既普及合唱音乐，丰富华人文娱生活，提高华人艺术修养。 此次会议特别明确了每位干事的职责和工作。 团长由古雅瑜女士担任，陈志钢先生任副团长，余咏瑜女士负责粤语组英文秘书, 黄国熙先生负责粤语组中文秘书, 黎景辉先生负责国语组中英文秘书及乐务，庄淑华女士和黎瑞芳女士负责 财务, 资料档案由孙效瑾女士负责, 交谊联络由麦耀祺先生和李鸿信先生负责, 新团员接待由闻玲琳女士和陈紫兰负责，服装由唐莉萍女士和黎瑞芳管理。 声部组长由卫琭诗女士，买黛祺女士，黎景辉先生和陈志钢等担任， 最后，古雅瑜女士和大家一起对合唱团今后的发展和排练演出作了具体的计划和安排。 既除了参加参加各种华人的节日庆祝活动外，还要加强与全国各地华人合唱团及各族合唱团的交流学习和演出。 并在明年春天的时候举行专场音乐会。 国语团排练时间地点： 时间：周日，晚7:00-8:30 （每周日同样时间节假日除外） 地点：新东方艺术学校（西北角Ray/Alma School） 粤语团排练时间地点： 时间：周六，早上10:30-11:30 （每周六同样时间节假日除外） 地点：康乐大夏三楼活动庁(3930 24th Ave. Phoenix,I-17 Indian School exit） 联系人： 古雅瑜女士： yayukhoe@yahoo.com 602-214-9793 黎景辉先生: kflai602@yahoo.com 480-203-6807 陈志钢先生： chenzhigang2000@yahoo.com 480-242-7863 闻玲琳女士：480-516-8868 陈紫兰女士：602-233-2135
3ce88e7f6808edffa8b3da659670fdb727bb6236.translatedText: Last Sunday evening, the Chinese Chorus of Alberta held its first meeting of its officers since its establishment during the Spring Festival in 2011 at the Blue Sky Restaurant. In addition to the founder Ms. Gu Yayu, the members attending the meeting included Mr. Chen Zhigang, Mr. Li Jinghui, Ms. Li Ruifang, Ms. Wen Linglin, Mr. Mak Yaoqi, Sun Xiaojin, Ms. Chen Zilan, Li Hongxin, Ms. Zhuang Shuhua, Mr. Huang Yicheng, Ms. Yu Yongyu, Ms. Tang Liping and Mr. Huang Guoxi, a total of fourteen people. Ms. Wei Yanshi was absent for some reason. During the dinner, everyone not only reviewed the experience and achievements of the choir over the past year since its establishment, but also emphasized again the purpose and purpose of the choir's establishment, which is to popularize choral music, enrich the cultural and entertainment life of the Chinese, and improve the artistic accomplishment of the Chinese. This meeting specifically clarified the responsibilities and work of each officer. The group leader is Ms. Gu Yayu, Mr. Chen Zhigang is the deputy group leader, Ms. Yu Yongyu is responsible for the English secretary of the Cantonese group, Mr. Huang Guoxi is responsible for the Chinese secretary of the Cantonese group, Mr. Li Jinghui is responsible for the Chinese and English secretary and music services of the Mandarin group, Ms. Zhuang Shuhua and Ms. Li Ruifang are responsible for the finance, Ms. Sun Xiaojin is responsible for the data files, and Mr. Mak Yiu Kei and Mr. Li Hongxin are responsible for the social liaison. Ms. Wen Linglin and Chen Zilan are responsible for the reception of new members, and Ms. Tang Liping and Li Ruifang are responsible for the clothing management. The vocal group leaders are Ms. Wei Jianshi, Ms. Mai Daiqi, Mr. Li Jinghui and Chen Zhigang. Finally, Ms. Gu Yayu and everyone made specific plans and arrangements for the future development and rehearsal performances of the choir. In addition to participating in various Chinese festival celebrations, we also need to strengthen exchanges, learning and performances with Chinese choirs and choirs of all ethnic groups across the country. And a special concert will be held next spring. Mandarin troupe rehearsal time and place: Time: Sunday, 7:00-8:30 pm (same time every Sunday except holidays) Venue: New Oriental Art School (Ray/Alma School, northwest corner) Cantonese troupe rehearsal time and place: Time: Saturday, 10:30-11:30 am (same time every Saturday, except holidays) Venue: Activity Room on the third floor of Kangle Daxia (3930 24th Ave. Phoenix, I-17 Indian School exit) Contact: Ms. Ku Yayu: yayukhoe@yahoo.com 602-214-9793 Mr. Li Jinghui: kflai602@yahoo.com 480-203-6807 Mr. Chen Zhigang: chenzhigang2000@yahoo.com 480-242-7863 Ms. Wen Linglin: 480-516-8868 Ms. Chen Zilan: 602-233-2135

d52b60465b4b968ccc25540dc46e6fdceec22d9b.sourceText: 亚省中华语文学院及中华书院应邀参加十一月十五日在亚利桑那州立大学所举行的国际多元文化活动,活动十分圆满成功,与亚利桑那州立大学众多师生们 共同缔结国际友谊,进行国民外交与促进多元文化交流. 亚利桑那州立大学的国际多元文化活动是结合各国文化与艺术,提供学生学习与体验多元文化,分享多元文化的特色与历史背景,达到对多元文化的认识,了解与重视,使人与人之间的 相处能更融合与团结,世界更和平和睦.美国是一个世界大熔炉,来自世界各地的文化使美国成为世界上最多元也最丰富的国家,因此多元文化也成为美国的根本与特色. 亚省中华语文学院及中华书院多年来参与和支持亚利桑那州立大学的国际多元文化活动,在活动中宣传中华文化与传统民俗艺术,每年很成功的融入主流,增进与推广多元文化交流. 同时,亚省中华语文学院及中华书院在十一月三日也应邀到千德勒市的Bright Beginning学校共同分享世界文化节,宣传中华文化,与数百位学生,家长及老师们进行美好成功 的多元文化交流. 亚省中华语文学院及中华书院多年来一直持续义务至主流各大中小学与各主流活动宣传中华文化,缔结国际友谊,增进国民外交,与促进多元文化交流.
d52b60465b4b968ccc25540dc46e6fdceec22d9b.translatedText: >The Chinese Language and Literature College of the Province of Alberta and the Chinese Academy of Chinese Language and Literature were invited to participate in the international multicultural event held at Arizona State University on November 15th. The event was a complete success. Together with many teachers and students of Arizona State University, they established international friendships, conducted national diplomacy and promoted multicultural exchanges. Arizona State University's international multicultural activities combine the cultures and arts of various countries to provide students with the opportunity to learn and experience multiculturalism, share the characteristics and historical background of multiculturalism, and achieve understanding, understanding and attention to multiculturalism, so that people can get along with each other more integrated and united, and the world can be more peaceful and harmonious. The United States is a melting pot of the world, and cultures from all over the world make the United States the most diverse and richest country in the world. Therefore, multiculturalism has become the foundation and characteristic of the United States. The Chinese Language Institute of Alberta and the Chinese Academy have participated in and supported Arizona State University’s international multicultural activities for many years, promoting Chinese culture and traditional folk arts in the activities. They have successfully integrated into the mainstream every year and enhanced and promoted multicultural exchanges. At the same time, the Chinese Language Institute of Alberta and the Chinese Academy were also invited to the Bright Beginning School in Chandela City on November 3 to share the World Culture Festival, promote Chinese culture, and have wonderful and successful multicultural exchanges with hundreds of students, parents and teachers. The Chinese Language Institute of Alberta and the Chung Hwa College have been volunteering for many years to major primary and secondary schools and various mainstream activities to promote Chinese culture, build international friendships, enhance people-to-people diplomacy, and promote multicultural exchanges.

9dbcd9fdd64c791ec667c77534ed2c9855efb624.sourceText: 僑聯慶國慶高潮軼起 一浪高一浪，越來越精彩，亞省慶祝建國百年系列活動第三場國慶餐會將訂九月二十七日下午六時在六福酒家舉行，這是由亞省傳統僑社龍頭僑聯總會主辦，在資深僑領余文勁全力支持下，反應熱烈，預期將超過三百人以上參加。 今年國慶餐會主要貴賓是來自千里之外的台灣僑委會副委員任弘與”天下無雙”樂團，該團將在9月28日晚會中做壓軸表演。 當晚餐會將由方大姊與古雅渝二位引領粵語合唱團擔綱做序幕表演，神秘貴賓在聖火隊護衛下高舉聖火開場。很有可能在餐會中看到”才貌雙絕”的明日之星李歐納表演。今年在國慶餐會中訂座的團體都可以收到大會致贈價值一百元的貴賓票一張及國慶酒會貴賓邀請卡一份，餐會每人廿元，訂位請電480-363-9667（高）
9dbcd9fdd64c791ec667c77534ed2c9855efb624.translatedText: The climax of the National Day of the Overseas Chinese Association is getting higher and higher, and it is getting more and more exciting. The third National Day dinner in the series of events celebrating the centenary of the founding of the People's Republic of China will be held at Luk Fook Restaurant at 6 pm on September 27. It is hosted by the Federation of Overseas Chinese Association, the leading traditional overseas Chinese community in Alberta. With the full support of senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin, the response has been enthusiastic, and more than 300 people are expected to attend. The main guests at this year's National Day Dinner are Ren Hong, vice-member of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council of Taiwan, who is from thousands of miles away, and the "Tianxia Wushuang" orchestra, which will perform at the finale of the evening party on September 28. The dinner party will be led by Sister Fang and Gu Yayu, who will lead the Cantonese choir to perform the prelude performance. The mysterious guest will hold the torch high under the escort of the torch team to open the dinner party. It is very likely that you will see Leo Na, a rising star with both talent and appearance, perform at the dinner party. This year, any group that makes a reservation at the National Day Dinner will receive a VIP ticket worth 100 yuan from the conference and a VIP invitation card to the National Day Cocktail Party. The dinner is 20 yuan per person. For reservations, please call 480-363-9667 (high)

abfc99e84b6d61e621a31cb3b5dd740d57fec648.sourceText: ”华东同乡联谊会”是一个绝对联谊性质的活动名称。 在徐烨与顾名峰等人联络召集下，已经有一年多的活动记录。 基本上参加的乡亲以江苏，浙江为主，颇有”两江总督府”的古味。 基本上每个月聚会一次，聊聊家乡事，交换一点工作消息，当然要唱唱家乡小曲助兴。 看似组织松散，但充满温馨与亲切，反而是众多社团最缺少与最值得学习的精神。 8月28日在红锅自助餐店的午餐会是本月份的活动，闲聊之间，还提到州长近期要访问上海的消息。
abfc99e84b6d61e621a31cb3b5dd740d57fec648.translatedText: "East China Fellowship" is the name of an event that is absolutely of a sociable nature. Under the liaison and convening of Xu Ye, Gu Mingfeng and others, there have been records of activities for more than a year. Basically, the folks who participated were mainly from Jiangsu and Zhejiang, and it had an ancient flavor of the "Governor-General's Palace of Two Jiangsu". Basically we meet once a month to chat about hometown affairs, exchange some work news, and of course sing hometown songs to entertain. It seems to be loosely organized, but it is full of warmth and kindness. On the contrary, it is the spirit that many societies lack the most and are worth learning from. The luncheon at the Red Pot Buffet on August 28 was this month’s event. During the chat, the governor’s recent visit to Shanghai was also mentioned.

20c3a44545ed3a64624db4d315288bef4588ce45.sourceText: 亚利桑那大学校长今日宣布将退离亚大 亚利桑那大学校长Robert Shelton今日宣布将退离亚大，接受Fiesta Bowl的Excecutive Dirctor的位置。Shelton校长在发给全校的信中说道，他在亚大五年任职期间，正值亚省经济低谷。他接受了前所未有的挑战，领导全校教职工继续把亚大建设成全国范围内一所高品质的大学。在这五年里，亚大的入学率每年都创新高。新生的整体素质，无论在学业方面还是文化背景多样化方面，也是一年比一年强。在他的倡议下，亚省首次启动教育担保以及多项经济救助项目，帮助亚省的青年学生入学亚大。亚大还启动了全美退伍军人入学项目，并在凤凰城开设了一个医学分部。除此之外，亚大获取的科研资助也不断刷新纪录。两周前刚宣布的Osiris-REx项目就是最好的例子。它表明亚大在月球行星研究领域方面的领先地位。美国自然科学基金会把亚大在物理学研究方面排名第二，仅次于加州理工学院。亚大的人文科学、公共卫生、金融、商业、建筑、工程、法律等学院也为亚省人民的福利作出了巨大贡献。 Shelton校长还在信中提到，他很高兴能有这个机会来领导这个引人注目的经济体。Fiesta Bowl每年组织两次超级足球赛，把数以千记的球迷带到亚省。他特意强调，Fiesta Bowl还是一个慈善机构，帮助亚省的数十个机构组织。Shelton校长最后提到，作为亚大的一员，他和他的夫人(Adrian Shelton)将视自己为终身的wildcat – 野豹，亚大的吉祥动物。他感谢全校师生五年来对他的支持。
20c3a44545ed3a64624db4d315288bef4588ce45.translatedText: The president of the University of Arizona announced today that he will be retiring from the University of Arizona. The president of the University of Arizona, Robert Shelton, announced today that he will be retiring from the University of Arizona to accept the position of Executive Director of the Fiesta Bowl. President Shelton said in a letter sent to the entire school that during his five-year tenure at the University, the province’s economy was at its lowest point. He accepted unprecedented challenges and led the faculty and staff to continue to build Asia University into a high-quality university nationwide. Over the past five years, Asia University’s enrollment has hit new highs every year. The overall quality of freshmen, both academically and in terms of cultural diversity, is getting better year by year. Under his initiative, the province launched education guarantee and a number of financial assistance projects for the first time to help young students from the province enroll in the University of Asia. UA also launched a national veterans admissions program and opened a medical branch in Phoenix. In addition, the scientific research funding received by Asia University continues to set new records. The Osiris-REx project, announced just two weeks ago, is the best example. It demonstrates the University's leading position in the field of lunar and planetary research. The National Science Foundation ranks Asia University second in physics research, second only to the California Institute of Technology. The University’s faculties of humanities, public health, finance, business, architecture, engineering, and law have also made great contributions to the welfare of the people of Alberta. Chancellor Shelton also mentioned in the letter that he is grateful for the opportunity to lead this compelling economy. Fiesta Bowl organizes two super football games every year, bringing thousands of fans to Alberta. He specifically emphasized that the Fiesta Bowl is also a charity that helps dozens of organizations in Alberta. President Shelton finally mentioned that as a member of Asia University, he and his wife (Adrian Shelton) will regard themselves as lifelong wildcats - wild leopards, the mascot animal of Asia University. He thanked all the teachers and students of the school for their support over the past five years.

5a882b82af11ceb2d266980ba2e3babc054732d0.sourceText: 美国第九大城市达拉斯市长星期三宣布紧急状态，加紧努力遏制西尼罗河病毒传播。路透社说，西尼罗河病毒今年在得克萨斯和其它州引发的感染病例超过以往。
5a882b82af11ceb2d266980ba2e3babc054732d0.translatedText: The mayor of Dallas, the ninth largest city in the United States, declared a state of emergency on Wednesday to step up efforts to curb the spread of the West Nile virus. Reuters said West Nile virus has caused more infections in Texas and other states this year than ever before.

0e204efe07aefcc026c1505ab80124ee3d73759a.sourceText: 联邦疾病防治中心（ CDC ）到星期二已经收到 693 人感染蚊子传播的西尼罗河病毒的报告，将近一半都是出现在得克萨斯。该州还有 14 人死亡，也占全美 26 例死亡的一半多。
0e204efe07aefcc026c1505ab80124ee3d73759a.translatedText: The federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has received reports of 693 people infected with the mosquito-borne West Nile virus as of Tuesday, nearly half of them in Texas. The state has also seen 14 deaths, more than half of the 26 deaths nationwide.

a3bf79db0a62ca814a56e09f29af1488fc1cc8c8.sourceText: 市长劳灵斯（ Mike Rawlings ）在宣布紧急状态时说，除非立即采取行动并马上预防，严重疾病和丧失生命的情况很可能发生。
a3bf79db0a62ca814a56e09f29af1488fc1cc8c8.translatedText: In declaring the state of emergency, Mayor Mike Rawlings said that unless immediate action is taken and prevention is carried out, serious illness and loss of life are likely to occur.

d2c4182ffce946f027216b6e6b7b5962ff0287c5.sourceText: 得克萨斯卫生局本周说，该州因感染西尼罗河病毒死亡的人数已经上升到 16 人。劳灵思宣布紧急状态之前，达拉斯县官员上周已经宣布同样措施，为本周飞机开始喷射杀虫剂做好准备。
d2c4182ffce946f027216b6e6b7b5962ff0287c5.translatedText: The death toll from West Nile virus in the state has risen to 16, the Texas Health Department said this week. Rawlings' declaration of emergency comes after Dallas County officials announced the same measure last week in preparation for planes to begin spraying pesticides this week.

3b50d04520059bdcedf6c2e6737ef21fbaf446be.sourceText: 包括纽约市和加州首府沙加缅度的其它地方也开始飞机喷药，消灭传播西尼罗河病毒的蚊虫。官员说，这种喷药是控制蚊虫传播病毒最有效的方式，但民众担心人也会接触到化学杀虫剂。
3b50d04520059bdcedf6c2e6737ef21fbaf446be.translatedText: Other places, including New York City and Sacramento, the capital of California, have also begun spraying from airplanes to eliminate mosquitoes that transmit West Nile virus. Officials say such spraying is the most effective way to control mosquito-borne viruses, but there are concerns that people can also be exposed to chemical pesticides.

c0930b33b5a3d249542669e3c383ed19b607eb35.sourceText: 本月初， CDC 说，西尼罗河病毒感染发生在全美 42 州，也是 2004 年 7 月底以来的最高。感染病例通常在 8 月中达到高峰。
c0930b33b5a3d249542669e3c383ed19b607eb35.translatedText: Earlier this month, the CDC said West Nile virus infections were occurring in 42 states and were the highest since late July 2004. Infections typically peak in mid-August.

db0403ece3d283cfcd9a10030fe2d446c15abcae.sourceText: 卫生官员说，西尼罗河病毒感染增加的原因还不清楚。 CDC 说，天气、蚊虫数量和人类行为都有可能是疾病暴发的主要因素。
db0403ece3d283cfcd9a10030fe2d446c15abcae.translatedText: Health officials say the cause of the increase in West Nile virus infections is unclear. The CDC says weather, mosquito populations and human behavior are all likely factors in outbreaks.

a2ff132ca711c9b352e5d0ea20c965ccba962bd4.sourceText: 唐代长安丽人“复活”游世园(图) 图为唐代屏风仕女壁画的”姊妹画”—-唐长安士人在郊外宴饮壁画，充分反映了盛唐时期长安人的日常生活情景。长安自古多丽人。如今正在西安世园会长安塔上首次公开展览的唐代六扇屏风仕女壁画让游人流连忘返，千余年前的长安丽人在抚琴观舞之际，犹如”复活”一般走出壁画与今人一起郊游赏玩。
a2ff132ca711c9b352e5d0ea20c965ccba962bd4.translatedText: The beauties of Chang'an in the Tang Dynasty were "resurrected" and traveled around the world (pictures) The picture shows the "sister painting" of the Tang Dynasty screen ladies mural - the mural of Tang Chang'an scholars having a banquet in the suburbs, which fully reflects the daily life of Chang'an people during the prosperous Tang Dynasty. Chang'an has many beautiful people since ancient times. The six-screen lady mural from the Tang Dynasty, which is currently on public display for the first time at the Chang'an Tower of the Xi'an World Horticultural Exhibition, fascinates visitors. When the Chang'an beauties played the piano and watched the dance more than a thousand years ago, they stepped out of the mural as if they were "resurrected" and went out to enjoy it with today's people.

7787ea7cbe40e324e71826d19ca73449aba888f0.sourceText: 大约七、八年前，有一天我接到一个姓方的年青人的电话，请我到土桑(Tucson) 市，给他的父亲安装一台中国CCTV4频道的卫星电视。他并未给我具体的地址，只说那地方比较难找，约我星期天在某个地点见面，然后坐我的车一同前往他父母的住处。于是到星期天，我们在约好的地段见面，便开车前往土桑市。青年人名叫方哲，高个子，来自北京，现在某大学担任行政职务。沿途他问了些有关凤凰城华人社区的事情，我们也谈了当时热门的房地产话题，不久就到了土桑市区。前方的路便由方哲指引，汽车走过一段上上落落的道路，便来到了一座两层楼高的房子面前，方哲说到了。进门后，一位老先生在二楼下来，他衣着朴素，看起来有些面善，但一时也想不起在什麽地方见过。老先生得知我是来装卫视的，便告诉我，他现在已有收看免费的CCTV4频道设备，但有消息说CCTV4频道会从免费频道转入到收费的频道，不知是否属实？我回答，据我所知，有关这方面的消息只是传闻，未经証实。老先生说，既然未証实，我们是否过一段时间再考虑安装？大老远的来到，又说暂不安装，我当然有些失望，但也只能是打道回府了。 回途上，方哲说很抱歉，他也听闻CCTV4可能会进入锁码收费的组合频道，因父母每天都要看国内新闻，为了让他们不会中断收视，所以想由自己来付费用，未雨绸缪给家中安装一套收费频道的设备，以保障收视，但却未事先告知父亲，所以才会有这样的误会。我忽然想到一些事情，便问道，你父亲做什麽工作的？他说是大学教授。我问道，他是否就是方励之教授？他说是呀。我说，可能在有关”六四”的报导上看见过你的父亲的照片，刚才一时眼熟，但未能认出，现在才后知后觉，失去一个和他交谈的机会。方哲对我说，日后或还会有机缘呢。为了不让我白跑一趟，方哲便对我说，那就先到我的住所安装吧，反正我刚买下新房子。于是，我便到了他的新居处安装。房屋不大，摆设不豪华但整洁，我问他是否已婚，他说还没有。我们边安装边聊天，我并邀请他参加我们龙冈团体四月的春宴，了解了解当地的侨社文化，他欣然地答应了。回到凤凰城后，我给方哲寄了一张春宴的请帖，他果然应约参加，我把他介绍给许多好朋友认识，其中包括著名作家少君先生。 本以为此事已告已一段落，谁料到过了不久，方哲真的打电话来，说他父亲约我再去一次他家装卫视。于是，我就第二次到了方励之教授的家中去服务。他们家的卫星电视天线安装在二楼的后方，面对东南方向。因上次白来一趟，这次方教授对我很客气，我还见到他的夫人李淑贤女士。其实凤凰城华人对方励之并不陌生，因为早在1992年，本地的《亚利桑那华报》社长黄仕蔚和记者，曾到过土桑的亚利桑那大学，对他作过採访，并在头版作过报导。而当时的方励之仍要受到保护，见面要审查，一般人不容易接近。但事过境迁，现在到了他们的家，感到十分的随和，我也是边安装边和他聊天，谈及卫星电视讯号是由三万公里的定点卫星直接发射下来，覆盖面很广，传递信息很快，中国大陆的消息几乎零时差便可传到这里。我曾向这位天体物理学家请教有关宇宙中”多维空间”的概念，他回答，除了我们所知道的X、Y、Z三维空间外，时间算第四维，但宇宙空间是由更多维数所组成的，如有八维、十一维等理论，这些概念比观察实际的星体要抽象得多，很多推论只能通过数学形式来表达。
7787ea7cbe40e324e71826d19ca73449aba888f0.translatedText: About seven or eight years ago, one day I received a call from a young man named Fang, asking me to go to Tucson to install a Chinese CCTV 4 satellite TV for his father. He didn't give me a specific address, he just said that the place was difficult to find. He asked me to meet at a certain place on Sunday, and then we took my car to his parents' residence. So on Sunday, we met at the appointed location and drove to Tucson. The young man's name is Fang Zhe, a tall man from Beijing who now holds an administrative position in a university. Along the way, he asked some things about the Chinese community in Phoenix, and we also talked about real estate topics that were hot at the time. Soon we arrived in downtown Tucson. The road ahead was guided by Fang Zhe. The car walked through a section of ups and downs and came to a two-story house. Fang Zhe said. After entering the door, an old gentleman came down from the second floor. He was dressed simply and looked kind-hearted, but he couldn't remember where he had seen him before. When the old gentleman learned that I was here to install a satellite TV, he told me that he now has the equipment to watch the free CCTV4 channel. However, there is news that the CCTV4 channel will be transferred from a free channel to a paid channel. Is it true? I replied that as far as I know, the news about this is just rumors and unconfirmed. The old gentleman said, since it has not been confirmed, should we consider the installation again after some time? I came all the way and was told that they would not install it for the time being. Of course I was a little disappointed, but I had no choice but to go back home. On the way back, Fang Zhe said he was sorry. He had also heard that CCTV4 might enter a code-locked and paid combination channel. Since his parents watched domestic news every day, in order to prevent them from interrupting their viewing, he wanted to pay for it himself and installed a set of paid channel equipment at home to ensure viewing. However, he did not inform his father in advance, so there was such a misunderstanding. I suddenly thought of something and asked, what does your father do? He said he was a university professor. I asked, is he Professor Fang Lizhi? He said yes. I said that I might have seen your father’s photo in reports about the June 4th Incident. It looked familiar to me just now, but I didn’t recognize it. Only now did I realize it, and I lost an opportunity to talk to him. Fang Zhe told me that there might be another opportunity in the future. In order to prevent my trip from being in vain, Fang Zhe told me to go to my residence to install it first. Anyway, I just bought a new house. So, I went to his new residence to install it. The house was not big and the furnishings were not luxurious but clean. I asked him if he was married and he said not yet. We chatted while installing it, and I invited him to attend the spring banquet of our Longgang group in April to learn about the local overseas Chinese culture, and he readily agreed. After returning to Phoenix City, I sent an invitation to the Spring Banquet to Fang Zhe, and he indeed accepted the invitation. I introduced him to many good friends, including the famous writer Mr. Shaojun. I thought the matter was over, but I didn't expect that not long after, Fang Zhe really called me and said that his father had invited me to visit his home decoration TV again. So, I went to Professor Fang Lizhi’s home for the second time to serve. Their satellite TV antenna is installed at the back of the second floor, facing the southeast. Because my trip last time was in vain, Professor Fang was very polite to me this time, and I even met his wife, Ms. Li Shuxian. In fact, Chinese people in Phoenix are no strangers to Fang Lizhi, because as early as 1992, Huang Shiwei, the president of the local Arizona Chinese Newspaper, and reporters visited the University of Arizona in Tucson, interviewed him, and reported on his front page. At that time, Fang Lizhi still had to be protected and censored when he met, so it was not easy for ordinary people to get close to him. But things have changed. Now that I have arrived at their home, I feel very easy-going. I also chatted with him while installing it, saying that satellite TV signals are directly transmitted by fixed-point satellites 30,000 kilometers away. I once asked this astrophysicist about the concept of "multidimensional space" in the universe. He replied that in addition to the three-dimensional space of X, Y, and Z that we know, time is the fourth dimension, but the universe is composed of more dimensions, such as eight-dimensional, eleven-dimensional and other theories. These concepts are much more abstract than observing actual stars, and many inferences can only be expressed in mathematical form.

bc3f35e8355af0c0a9ed4e1f2e9738decb22dcdb.sourceText: 时间过得很快，卫视安装调试完毕，便要告辞了。离开时，我打量一下他的家居，印象较深的，是看到楼下的一个窗口外安装了一台大型的”COOLER”设备，COOLER能把带有水气的凉风直接吹入室内，让气温降底之余，也能节省电费，但设备一般会固定在屋顶，放置在窗台上属后加装的。大体说来，当年方教授的家居是简朴的。回程时，我和方哲在P.F Chen餐馆吃了一顿中午饭。 几年过去了，可能是卫视安装无什麽故障，又或者是各忙各的，方哲没有再打过电话给我。直到2007年10月底，忽然看到一篇报导：”10月25日，方励之在亚利桑那大学任职的次子方哲，驾车前往另一个校区途中，被一辆突然左转的小卡车撞个正着，驾车肇事者是一位老太太。事发后警方还出动直升机抢救，但终因伤势太重而不治，方哲得年仅39岁。令大家不胜唏嘘，方哲这个月要和未婚妻结婚，房子都买好了，未婚妻也从圣荷西搬过来，却发生致命车祸，留给生者无限哀痛。”我为方哲的英年早逝感到十分的可惜。但令大家不胜唏嘘还有，有人因方哲开的是小车，而肇事老太开的是大车，结论竟是日后要买大车才能保命。近日又有报导：”1989年被迫离开中国的天体物理学教授方励之，在2012年4月6日早上于美国亚利桑那州图森市寓所逝世，终年76岁。方励之支持北京大学生民主运动，被誉八九学运精神领袖。方励之赴美后于美国亚利桑那大学物理系任教授，至逝世前仍处于学术活跃状态，每年皆有若干学术论文发表；2010年因宇宙学和早期宇宙的物理学方面的重要工作当选为美国物理学会会士，如今逝世，世界上有很多人会悼念他。” 人与人之间的缘份和人与人世间的缘份，其实也是一样的，说来就来，说去就去。我和方励之教授有一面之缘，现把所经历的事平实地写出来，让大家对这位离我们是如此之近，知道又是如此之少的名人，有更多一些的了解。 http://www.paaca.us/
bc3f35e8355af0c0a9ed4e1f2e9738decb22dcdb.translatedText: Time passed very quickly, the installation and commissioning of the satellite TV was completed, and it was time to say goodbye. When I left, I took a look at his home. What impressed me most was that I saw a large "COOLER" device installed outside a window downstairs. The COOLER can blow cool wind with moisture directly into the room, lowering the temperature and saving electricity bills. However, the device is usually fixed on the roof and placed on the windowsill and is installed later. Generally speaking, Professor Fang's home at that time was simple. On the way back, Fang Zhe and I had lunch at P.F Chen restaurant. Several years have passed. Maybe there was nothing wrong with the satellite TV installation, or maybe everyone was busy with their own affairs, but Fang Zhe never called me again. Until the end of October 2007, I suddenly saw a report: "On October 25, Fang Zhe, Fang Lizhi's second son who works at the University of Arizona, was hit by a small truck that suddenly turned left while driving to another campus. The driver was an old lady. After the incident, the police also dispatched a helicopter He was rescued, but his injuries were too severe and he died. Fang Zhe was only 39 years old. This made everyone sad. Fang Zhe was going to marry his fiancée this month. He had bought a house and his fiancée had moved from San Jose, but he was involved in a fatal car accident, leaving the living with endless grief. "I feel very sorry for Fang Zhe's untimely death. But what makes everyone sad is that because Fang Zhe drove a small car and the old lady who caused the accident drove a large car, some people concluded that they should buy a large car in the future to save their lives. Recently there was another report: "Fang Lizhi, a professor of astrophysics who was forced to leave China in 1989, died in his residence in Tucson, Arizona, USA on the morning of April 6, 2012. He was 76 years old. Fang Lizhi supported the democratic movement of college students in Beijing and was known as the spiritual leader of the 1989 student movement. After Fang Lizhi went to the United States, He served as a professor in the Department of Physics at the University of Arizona, and was still academically active until his death. He published several academic papers every year. In 2010, he was elected as a fellow of the American Physical Society for his important work in cosmology and the physics of the early universe. Now that he has passed away, many people around the world will mourn him. " The fate between people and the fate between people in the world are actually the same. They come and go as they come. Professor Fang Lizhi and I have an acquaintance, and now I will write down what I experienced plainly, so that everyone can have a better understanding of this famous person who is so close to us and knows so little about. http://www.paaca.us/

841e69ed068f61e6ec26c2fa47e6d2706d01f1f4.sourceText: 华裔周末大聚会其乐融融——喜福会第四次活动（组图） 12月4日星期日，中午12时到下午5时，亚省华人喜福会在钱德勒组织了欢乐大聚餐，一起分享家常中国美食，聊天，唱卡拉OK，还有丰富的娱乐节目表演。 中午来到了聚餐地点，还没有进门就看到装饰得非常有圣诞气氛的小屋，屋内的中文歌曲，早早就让人闻到了中国的味道。走进大厅，就看见餐台上摆着满满地美味，有炸排骨，可乐鸡翅，炒米饭，荷兰豆炒虾仁，诱人的起士蛋糕，颜色丰富的水果拼盘，还有饮料，茶水和美酒。 各色美食 活动的组织者叫Frank，他说活动的目的非常的鲜明，就是”吃喝玩乐”。Frank介绍，这已经是亚省喜福会第四次组织活动了，而且一次比一次人多，因为大家都很喜欢这样的活动，好玩，朋友拉着朋友，就形成了这么庞大的队伍。那天已经有近70个人参加了活动。 欢快畅谈 活动的第一个项目就是尝尽美食，每个人都可以拿着大盘子，挑选喜欢的食物，平时在家里做饭，口味总觉得单一，今天终于能尝尝百家饭，女士们还坐在一起交流做菜心得。男士们就聊聊哪有乒乓球比赛，网球比赛，什么时候大家聚聚再搞个活动。小朋友们也一下子认识了很多新伙伴，有的画圣诞卡，有的玩电子游戏，个个都忙得很。 小美女们摆Ｐｏｓｅ 小帅哥们忙游戏 酒足饭饱后最精彩的就要数文艺表演了。凤凰城的知名古筝老师贺绿蒂为来宾现场演奏了《何时君再来》《春江花月》等名曲，现场的小朋友还临时点曲目，贺老师马上现场演奏。 贺绿蒂古筝独奏 观众聚焦古筝独奏 赵兵的独唱《我是中国人》曾经在亚利桑那华人卡拉OK比赛中获得第二名。他穿着整齐的军旅服，戴着军帽，加上洪亮的歌喉，让现场一亮，非常有舞台的气氛。当他再唱《云河》的时候，立马就变成了上海滩大少的角色，一个白色老板帽非常风趣幽默。 赵兵独唱 亚省华人喜福会是完全娱乐的民间组织，他们有自己的网站，想加入其中，或者了解更多活动状况请点击： http://www.chinesejoyluck.com/
841e69ed068f61e6ec26c2fa47e6d2706d01f1f4.translatedText: Chinese Americans have a great weekend gathering and have a great time - The Joy Luck Club's fourth event (Photos) On Sunday, December 4, from 12 noon to 5 pm, the Chinese Joy Luck Club of Alberta organized a happy dinner in Chandler to share home-cooked Chinese food, chat, sing karaoke, and have a variety of entertainment performances. We arrived at the dinner venue at noon. Before we even entered the door, we saw a small house decorated with a Christmas atmosphere. The Chinese songs in the house gave people the smell of China early on. When you walk into the hall, you will see the dining table full of delicious food, including fried ribs, cola chicken wings, fried rice, fried shrimps with snow peas, tempting cheese cakes, colorful fruit platters, as well as drinks, tea and wine. Various Foods The organizer of the event is called Frank. He said the purpose of the event is very clear, which is to "eat, drink and have fun". Frank said that this is the fourth time that the Joy Luck Club of Alberta has organized an event, and each time there are more people than ever before, because everyone likes such activities, it is fun, and friends pull friends to form such a huge team. Nearly 70 people had participated in the event that day. Happy Talk The first activity of the event is to taste the food. Everyone can take a big plate and choose the food they like. Usually when cooking at home, the taste always seems to be monotonous. Today I can finally try Baijia Rice. The ladies also sit together and exchange cooking experiences. The men chatted about where there was a table tennis match, a tennis match, and when we could all get together for some activities. The children also met many new friends at once. Some were drawing Christmas cards and some were playing video games. Everyone was very busy. The beauties were posing and the handsome boys were busy playing games. After the feast, the most exciting part was the artistic performance. He Ludi, a well-known guzheng teacher in Phoenix City, performed famous songs such as "When Will You Come Again" and "Spring River Flower Moon" live for the guests. The children at the scene also ordered some songs at the last minute, and Teacher He immediately performed live. He Ludi's Guzheng Solo Audience Focused on Guzheng Solo Zhao Bing's solo "I Am Chinese" once won second place in the Arizona Chinese Karaoke Competition. He was neatly dressed in military uniform and military cap, and his resonant singing voice brightened up the scene, giving him a very stage-like atmosphere. When he sang "River of Clouds" again, he immediately transformed into the role of a young man from Shanghai, wearing a white boss hat and being very funny. Zhao Bing's solo The Chinese Joy Luck Club of Alberta is a completely entertaining non-governmental organization. They have their own website. If you want to join it or learn more about the activities, please click: http://www.chinesejoyluck.com/

Schroeder)邀请我和他一起到凤凰城先民和军人纪念墓园(Pioneer and Military Memorial Park)考察华人墓葬和清明节扫墓习俗。那次我们确认了墓园里唯一的一块邓湘远中文墓碑。 施罗德问了我好多有关华人扫墓的问题，我详细地向他讲述了清明节华人扫墓的风俗习惯。1994年施罗德主编Pioneer and Memorial Park Archaeological Project in Phoenix Arizona 1990-1992，在该书第二卷的第三章和第十七章里，记录下我的讲述。下面是摘录。 1992年4月5日，唐孝先(William Tang)（左）和K. J. Schroeder （右）合影于邓湘远中文墓碑旁。
4c35a1208ec8601c0e4dbefe8e8e8443178c5b0e.translatedText: During the Qingming Festival in 1992, the American archaeologist K. J. Schroeder (K. J. Schroeder invited me to go with him to the Pioneer and Military Memorial Park to inspect Chinese tombs and the Tomb Sweeping Day customs. That time we identified the only Chinese tombstone of Deng Xiangyuan in the cemetery. Schroeder asked me a lot of questions about Chinese tomb sweeping customs and I told him in detail the customs of Chinese tomb sweeping during the Tomb Sweeping Day. In 1994, Schroeder was the editor-in-chief of the Pioneer and Memorial Park Archaeological Project in Phoenix. Arizona 1990-1992, record my story in Chapter 3 and Chapter 17 of the second volume of the book. The following is an excerpt. On April 5, 1992, William Tang (left) and K. J. Schroeder (right) took a photo next to Deng Xiangyuan’s Chinese tombstone.

5f598647fa0f4afd0ce1e83fed71e7326b3456e9.sourceText: 西方的Halloween万圣节是来讨好鬼的，否则为何不叫”万鬼节”而称为”万圣节”呢？ 美国人因为没有人敢阻吓，又要尝试被惊吓的滋味，所以惟有自己吓自己。而万圣节，正是让他们感受这种被吓感觉的特别时光。 中国人七月十四鬼节和西方万圣节的差异，往往是我们称自己为”中国人”，而把对方称为荷兰鬼、英国鬼、美国鬼的；而中国人常常怕鬼，西方人却喜欢扮鬼；中国人画符驱鬼，美国人却用糖果迎鬼；东西方文化差异是”人鬼殊途”。 今年十月初我们去洛杉矶，陪亲戚到过一趟荷李活环球影城。影城平日门票七十九元，但到了星期五、六，却要收一百二十九元，并声明十二岁以下的儿童不得进场，说是万圣节将至，晚上会有勐鬼倾城而出。我们在光天化日进去，已见到”横尸遍野、鲜血淋漓”的景象，可感受如到周末晚上的月黑风高时，被厉鬼惨嚎和前堵后吓的恐怖气氛，影城也将成为鬼影重重、鬼哭神号之城。 凤凰城也是一样，各种各样的万圣节活动，也是早就已经开始，除了不少商店和公共场所有人扮鬼扮马外，居家住所更是摆满鬼脸南瓜，晚上各种幽灵随风飘隐，忽明忽暗的灯火在摇曳，好好的一座房屋偏要挂满上蜘蛛网，门前还堆个假坟，真令人看得心惊胆颤又啼笑皆非。 本地万圣节还有更精彩的内容。十月廿五和廿六日晚，在亚利桑那州斯科茨代市（Scottsdale）的盐河场（Salt River ），举办了”热气球节”。此节庆已举办了两届，今年是笔者首次参加。和中国中秋节的蜡烛小灯笼不同，热气球巨形硕大，气势如虹。 活动从下午五时起至晚上十时。傍晚时分进场之路已严重堵塞，成千上万的人群都涌到这里，不少家庭全家出动，还有为数众多鬼马化妆者参加，平添了不少热闹气氛。是晚有廿多个热气球喷火昇空到十层楼高度，各种动物和蝴蝶造形的气球大而通透，火焰喷射器不时发出呼吼声，金焰璀璨，阵仗庞大，声势夺人，引来无数观众围观和拍照。小孩童更是到处奔跑，欢呼雀跃。场内还有不少儿童乐园、商铺、小食肆等，当然也少不了万圣节＂鬼道巡行＂区域，进行人吓人的鬼把戏。 举办单位倒也细心，对进入”鬼道巡行”的幼童和胆小鬼发放莹光棒，这样在步行过程中，”厉鬼”会放他们一马。我们小心进入，因天黑路弯，常有各种鬼魅跟随或拦路，还尖叫和握手，令人毛骨悚然。有趣的是，去过世界和美国不少地方，中国人随处可见，倒是在这晚这里，看不到有同胞的身影。明年吧，希望能有多些华人带小孩来参加。盐河场的地址是：7555 N. Pima Rd Scottsdale，票价：大人$10，3-12岁儿童$5。
5f598647fa0f4afd0ce1e83fed71e7326b3456e9.translatedText: Halloween in the West is to please ghosts, otherwise why not call it "Halloween" instead of "Halloween"? Americans have no one to scare them, and they want to try to be frightened, so they have no choice but to frighten themselves. And Halloween is a special time for them to feel this feeling of being scared. The difference between Chinese July 14th Ghost Festival and Western Halloween is that we often call ourselves "Chinese" and call each other "Dutch ghosts, British ghosts, and American ghosts"; Chinese people are often afraid of ghosts, but Westerners like to dress up as ghosts; Chinese people draw charms to drive away ghosts, but Americans use candy to welcome ghosts; the cultural difference between the East and the West is that "people and ghosts have different paths." We went to Los Angeles in early October this year and went to Universal Studios Hollywood with relatives. Tickets to the movie theater on weekdays are NT$79, but on Fridays and Saturdays, they charge NT$129. They also state that children under the age of 12 are not allowed to enter. It is said that Halloween is approaching and there will be monsters coming out of the city at night. We entered in broad daylight and saw a scene of "dead bodies everywhere and dripping with blood." We could feel the terrifying atmosphere of howling ghosts and being blocked in front and behind when the moon is dark and the wind is high on a weekend night. The movie theater will also become a city full of ghosts and ghosts crying. The same is true in Phoenix. Various Halloween activities have already begun. In addition to people dressing up as ghosts and horses in many shops and public places, homes and residences are filled with pumpkins with ghost faces. At night, various ghosts float in the wind, lights flicker on and off, and a perfectly good house is covered with spider webs and a fake grave is piled in front of the door. It is really scary and laughable. There’s more to local Halloween. On the evenings of October 25th and 26th, the "Hot Air Balloon Festival" was held at Salt River Field in Scottsdale, Arizona. This festival has been held twice, and this year is the first time for me to participate. Different from the small candle lanterns used during the Chinese Mid-Autumn Festival, hot air balloons are huge and powerful like a rainbow. The event starts from 5pm to 10pm. In the evening, the entrance to the venue was seriously blocked. Thousands of people flocked here. Many families came out with their whole families, and there were also a large number of makeup artists, which added to the lively atmosphere. That night, more than 20 hot air balloons shot up to a height of ten stories. The balloons were large and transparent in the shapes of various animals and butterflies. The flamethrowers roared from time to time, and the golden flames were bright. The formation was huge and impressive, attracting countless spectators to watch and take photos. Children were running around and cheering. There are also many children's playgrounds, shops, snack bars, etc. in the venue. Of course, there is also the Halloween "Ghost Parade" area, where scary ghost tricks are performed. The organizer is very attentive and distributes glowing sticks to young children and cowards who enter the "ghost parade", so that the "evil ghosts" will let them go during the walk. We entered carefully because it was dark and the road was winding, and there were often various ghosts following or blocking the way, screaming and shaking hands, which was creepy. Interestingly, I have been to many places in the world and the United States, and Chinese people can be seen everywhere, but here tonight, I can't see any compatriots. Next year, I hope more Chinese people will come with their children to participate. The address of Salt River Field is: 7555 N. Pima Rd Scottsdale. Tickets are $10 for adults and $5 for children 3-12 years old.

3d4ae6b66f9e355ae7d81d7f522bbfc5fd62b24b.sourceText: 欢度热气球节 临近万圣节，很多居家社区也会在周末举办各类Paty，通常在就近的公园举行午餐，派放糖果，充气游乐园等，美国虽不是儿童天堂，但确也是儿童乐园。 十月廿六日，我们去了一趟凤凰城以北小镇Anthen，在Anthem Community Council中心公园游玩，过一个清新的前期万圣节。这里也为孩子们举办了万圣节的Paty。公园内儿童游玩设施很多，还有小桥流水，湖鸭游嬉，不但风和日丽，风景也美仑美奂，累了还有小火车乘坐，不失为合家旅游的好去处。Anthen小镇从凤凰城出发，沿17号公路以北，约40分钟路程。
3d4ae6b66f9e355ae7d81d7f522bbfc5fd62b24b.translatedText: Celebrate the Hot Air Balloon Festival. As Halloween approaches, many home communities will also hold various parties on the weekends. Usually lunches are held in nearby parks, candies are distributed, and inflatable amusement parks are held. Although the United States is not a children's paradise, it is indeed a children's paradise. On October 26th, we went to Anthen, a small town north of Phoenix, to play in the Anthem Community Council Central Park and have a refreshing early Halloween. A Halloween party is also held here for children. There are many children's play facilities in the park, as well as small bridges and flowing water, where ducks play in the lake. Not only is the wind and sunshine beautiful, the scenery is also magnificent. If you are tired, you can even ride a small train, making it a good place for family travel. The small town of Anthen is about 40 minutes north of Phoenix on Highway 17.

6507244d429e7e550dc66d0710bc89b015570948.sourceText: Anthem Community Council Park 张肇鸿 摄影 而真正的万圣节(十月卅一日)，我们将飞抵德克萨斯州的侯斯顿市，到时，也会去看看这座城市的”鬼模鬼样”。 十一月初，我们还将乘邮轮去一趟世界有名的玛雅神庙城市，墨西哥的奇琴‧伊察(Chich閚 Itz?) ，寻觅人类中最古老的文明，他们的神鬼更厉害，据说是来自外太空。 有人说，若要长寿，七十以后不出国，八十以后不出城，九十以后不出门，一百以后不下床。我们来改一下吧：七十以后少出国，八十以后少出城，九十以后少出门，一百以后少下床。这样算来，如真要做到，也还须等几十年呢，那时候早已是鸡皮鹤髮了，外貌也不会人模人样，半人半鬼的还差不多。 如果那时你我还健在，见面时彼此说上一句：”今天怎麽啦？大白天活见鬼的！”那将是人生多麽开心的一件事情！
6507244d429e7e550dc66d0710bc89b015570948.translatedText: Anthem Community Council Park Photography by Zhang Zhaohong As for the real Halloween (October 31st), we will fly to Houston, Texas, and then we will also go to see the "ghosts" of this city. In early November, we will also take a cruise to the world-famous Mayan temple city, Chiché Itzá in Mexico, to look for the oldest civilization among humans. Their gods and ghosts are even more powerful and are said to come from outer space. Some people say that if you want to live a long life, you should not leave the country after seventy, not leave the city after eighty, not go out after ninety, and not get out of bed after one hundred. Let’s change it: go abroad less often after 70, go out less often after 80, go out less often after 90, less get out of bed after 100. Calculating this, if we really want to do it, we still have to wait for several decades. By then, we will already have chicken skin and gray hair, and our appearance will not be human, and it will be more like half human and half ghost. If you and I were still alive at that time, we would say to each other when we meet: "What's going on today? Damn it in broad daylight!" What a joyful thing it would be in life!

b72bf05df24f9c0619066eb017aecdd9e87e6ab0.sourceText: 信息时报讯 周杰伦(周董)和最嫩J女郎昆凌的恋情自今年1月就开始传出，周董一直没有承认并叫嚣”拍到照片再说”。昨日出刊的台湾娱乐周刊终于拍到周董和昆凌在法国马赛港口的搂肩背影照。而周杰伦则于昨天下午通过好友微博以调侃的口吻间接认了新恋情。
b72bf05df24f9c0619066eb017aecdd9e87e6ab0.translatedText: News from the Information Times Rumors of the relationship between Jay Chou and the youngest J-girl Quinlivan began in January this year. Jay Chou has never acknowledged it and clamored to "let's talk about it after the photos are taken." Taiwan Entertainment Weekly, which was published yesterday, finally took a photo of Jay Chou and Quinlivan hugging each other's shoulders at the port of Marseille, France. Yesterday afternoon, Jay Chou indirectly confirmed his new relationship in a joking tone through his friend's Weibo.

3f3cdeb2ecc237a6ff1ce3462d54cc6ed9313c28.sourceText: 周董轻搂昆凌背影被拍
3f3cdeb2ecc237a6ff1ce3462d54cc6ed9313c28.translatedText: Jay Chou was photographed hugging Kun Ling's back

41ca28900087e9ecb19db7ac1b40f138ccc30179.sourceText: 今年初周董被拍到出动爱车接送昆凌，但双方抵死不认，8月传出两人偕同周妈妈亲密巴黎同行，但没图没真相，甚至连回台湾都得兵分三路。虽然昆凌被拍到和周妈妈一起下飞机，可是双方依旧只认是”朋友”关系。直到搂肩背影照才让恋情正式浮上水面。对于照片的曝光，台湾媒体表示是从旅客手中获得，但周董粉丝则认为有内鬼，是周董的随行助手或者朋友流出。
41ca28900087e9ecb19db7ac1b40f138ccc30179.translatedText: Earlier this year, Jay Chou was photographed driving his car to pick up Kun Ling, but both parties refused to admit it. In August, it was reported that the two of them were traveling together with Zhou's mother in Paris, but there was no picture or the truth. Even when they returned to Taiwan, they had to be divided into three groups. Although Kunling was photographed getting off the plane with Zhou's mother, the two parties still only considered their relationship to be "friends". It wasn't until the photos were taken of each other hugging each other's shoulders that the relationship officially surfaced. Regarding the exposure of the photos, Taiwanese media stated that they obtained them from tourists, but fans of Jay Chou believed that there was an insider, and that it was Jay Chou's accompanying assistant or friend who leaked the photos.

d863026c9d489fde0c32796d60491388973f8d57.sourceText: 据台湾媒体报道，8月14日下午5时许，身穿白色T恤的周董顶着33℃高温，戴着黑色毛线帽现身，正准备排队下船舱，周董突然伸出右手，轻搂走在最后面的昆凌，两人动作亲昵了一阵子，直到走出船舱口。下船后，有人认出周董身份，上前跟他攀谈，还把周董吓了一大跳。
d863026c9d489fde0c32796d60491388973f8d57.translatedText: According to Taiwanese media reports, at about 5 pm on August 14, Jay Chou, wearing a white T-shirt and a black woolen hat, braved the 33°C temperature and appeared in the queue. As he was about to line up to get off the ship, Jay Chou suddenly stretched out his right hand and gently hugged Kun Ling who was walking at the back. The two were intimate for a while until they walked out of the ship's hatch. After getting off the boat, someone recognized Jay Chou's identity and came up to talk to him, which even shocked Jay Chou.

1e1437ea3ff66fa5b8b24d33690b62de3ebd9032.sourceText: 周董：下次补一张正面的
1e1437ea3ff66fa5b8b24d33690b62de3ebd9032.translatedText: Chou: Next time, please add a positive picture

e387b108e9b0db27cddc42d990c1c30fab8d58fd.sourceText: 对于被拍到轻搂肩的照片一事，周董所属的杰威尔音乐依然不回应。不过2008年，周杰伦曾公布其女友的识别标准：”只要以后有拍到勾手的，除了片场，在街上勾手，很亲密那种。我就一定承认！就一定是我女友！”如今搂肩的亲密度也不亚于勾手。而周董和侯佩岑 (微博) ，之前也是在日本搂肩被拍到，便招了恋情。昨日下午，周杰伦终于通过好友麦烝玮(小麦)的微博回应：”要嘛拍不到，要嘛就拍到背面，真不好意思，下次补一张正面的给你们，哈哈，还是因为我是赌神周润发的儿子(编者注：周杰伦在《满城尽带黄金甲》中扮演周润发儿子)只能拍到背面。”并附上一张赌神周润发的背影照。小麦曾为周董《霍元甲》编舞，而周董则为小麦写了一首同名单曲《麦烝玮》，周杰伦今年5月就曾借小麦的微博，发表金曲奖入围七项的感想，7月底又通过这个微博告诉粉丝其外婆身体康复的消息。此次回应，周董虽然没有直接承认，但却大方承诺”下次补一张正面的”，也算是给了昆凌一个名分。
e387b108e9b0db27cddc42d990c1c30fab8d58fd.translatedText: Regarding the photo of being photographed with a gentle hug on the shoulder, Jay Will Music, which he belongs to, still did not respond. However, in 2008, Jay Chou once announced the criteria for identifying his girlfriend: "As long as there is someone who is photographed holding hands, not only on the set, but also on the street, and it is very intimate. I will definitely admit it! She must be my girlfriend!" Nowadays, the intimacy of shoulder hugs is no less than that of hooking hands. Jay Chou and Patty Hou (Weibo) also started a relationship after they were photographed hugging each other in Japan. Yesterday afternoon, Jay Chou finally responded through his friend Mai Haowei (Wheat)'s Weibo: "Either I can't take a picture, or I can take a picture of the back. I'm so sorry. Next time I'll give you a front view. Haha, it's because I am the son of the gambling god Chow Yun-fat (Editor's note: Jay Chou played Chow Yun-fat's son in "The Golden Jacket") and I can only take a picture of the back." He also attached a photo of the back of the gambling god Chow Yun-fat. Mai once choreographed for Jay Chou's "Huo Yuanjia", and Jay Chou wrote a single of the same name for Mai, "Mai Hao Wei." In May this year, Jay Chou used Mai's Weibo to express his thoughts on being shortlisted for seven Golden Melody Awards. At the end of July, he used this Weibo to tell fans about his grandmother's recovery. In this response, although Jay Chou did not directly admit it, he generously promised to "make up a positive picture next time", which can be regarded as giving Kunling a reputation.

38a9cfa72160590557e2623f8a20634d96fac4fb.sourceText: 相差14岁无代沟 童子心周董追女无敌
38a9cfa72160590557e2623f8a20634d96fac4fb.translatedText: There is no generation gap between them when they are 14 years old. The childlike Jay Chou is invincible in his pursuit of girls

361119650e45e8e0184cb990978aad6ffc3ab19b.sourceText: 32岁的周董和18岁的昆凌相差14岁，相处有没有代沟？周杰伦今年获得金曲奖最佳男歌手后接受采访时就已经给出了答案，他透露年龄18到20岁的女孩最适合做他的女朋友：”其实不太介意年纪，但希望能跟我一样幼稚，不要太成熟，这样才可以跟我一起玩，现在应该蛮适合18~20岁的人，因为我的心智还停留在这个年纪。”
361119650e45e8e0184cb990978aad6ffc3ab19b.translatedText: The 32-year-old Jay Chou and the 18-year-old Quinlivan are 14 years apart. Is there any generation gap in getting along? Jay Chou already gave the answer in an interview after he won the Golden Melody Award for Best Male Singer this year. He revealed that girls aged 18 to 20 are most suitable to be his girlfriend: "Actually, I don't mind age, but I hope she can be as naive as me and not too mature, so that you can play with me. Now it should be quite suitable for people aged 18 to 20, because My mind is still at this age."

03f659720939eb82eb48cfa2119f485289b42054.sourceText: 虽然周董的好友都封口不谈周董与昆凌的恋情，但却认为两人沟通绝对没有问题，小麦说：”因为周杰伦的心境就像个小孩。”小麦透露今年生日时，被周董连整了两天当生日贺礼。8月21日晚先装不知情，约小麦打篮球，事后才转赴KTV帮他庆祝32岁生日，周董伴奏兼合唱《麦烝玮》，小麦说：”他事前都想好了，他怕被狗仔跟，有半年没唱KTV，唱歌他怕尴尬，不喜欢唱自己的歌，都唱张学友《吻别》、张宇《用心良苦》。”第二天，周董更联合妈妈一起整小麦，事先由妈妈先请小麦吃饭，接下来设局让小麦一度以为警察找上门，后来周董才拿出生日蛋糕，小麦说：”我真的以为我会去坐牢！”
03f659720939eb82eb48cfa2119f485289b42054.translatedText: Although Jay Chou's friends have kept silent about Jay Chou's relationship with Kun Ling, they believe that there is absolutely no problem in the communication between the two. Mai Mai said, "Because Jay Chou's state of mind is like a child." Mai Mai revealed that on his birthday this year, Jay Chou spent two days as a birthday gift. On the evening of August 21st, he pretended not to know and asked Xiaomai to play basketball. Later, he went to a KTV to help him celebrate his 32nd birthday. Jay Chou accompanied and sang "Mai Haowei". Xiaomai said: "He had thought about it beforehand. He was afraid of being followed by the paparazzi. He didn't sing in KTV for half a year. He was afraid of being embarrassed when singing and didn't like singing his own songs. They all sang Jacky Cheung's "Kiss Goodbye" and Zhang Yu's "Good Intentions." The next day, Jay Chou even teamed up with his mother to cook Mai. In advance, his mother treated Mai to a meal. Then he set up a trap to make Mai Wheat think the police were coming. Later, Jay Chou brought out the birthday cake, and Mai Mai said, "I really thought I was going to jail!"

28015ba8c11a4e8de4905240da92c0a7fedeaaff.sourceText: 堂哥从奥克兰来，给我带回好多今年5月我们在美国的照片。 其中一张是我们在三藩市的半岛香港粤菜海鲜酒家饮早茶的照片，看着照片，思绪一下子又飞回旧金山，飞回那段亲情洋溢的日子。 旧金山位于美国加里福尼亚州中部，濒临太平洋，是一个面积不太大的半岛，这座三面临水的半岛山城，到处是妩媚的海湾，在一个寒凉有雾的日子，我们在堂 哥的引领下，来到三藩市半岛公园里的香港海鲜酒家饮早茶，共享天伦之乐 酒店的外部装潢是中国园林式的，店内的一桌一椅一杯一蝶都是典型的”广式”，让人在异国他乡倍感温馨亲切。 洁白的餐布和餐桌上鲜艳的插花，给人很宁静温馨的感觉，空灵璀璨的水晶吊灯和若隐若现的烛光，烘托出低调而奢华的用餐氛围，暖色调的灯光在地毯上投射出绰约影子 ，连光线都显得温暖柔情。 大厅正面的落地窗外是一望无垠的海景，影影错错见到金门大桥的婀娜身姿，东面的窗外是码头上如林的恑樯和岛上苍翠的林木，景色非常怡人舒适。 我们坐定后，服务员给每个人斟上一杯茶，虽然不是太好的茶，但比起一般中餐馆提供的”茶水”，已算上乘。 一些操着广东话的服务员推着茶点小车在席间往返穿梭。 不一会儿，虾饺、粉肠、烧卖、风爪、炸鱿鱼脚、蛋塔、榴莲酥、菠萝包、粉蒸小排骨、酱蟹、河粉等等一碟碟、一笼笼、一碗碗地上 来了，琳琅满目摆满一桌。 周围粤语的”声波”掺杂着南腔北调的普通话，一浪接一浪，扑面而来，让人恍惚是回到了国内。 满满的席间，也发现了几桌洋人家庭，很享受地用着中式筷子吃力地夹着点心，在这样一个热闹嘈杂的环境里，他们只能把头凑到一起，互相对着耳朵说话。 饮早茶是广东人的习惯，那是真正的早茶，可以从早上五点半吃到上午十点半，吃早餐、饮茶、看报、会友、谈生意都是早茶的内容。 在三藩市的华裔移民中，有相当一大部分来自广东和香港，因此，这早茶文化也就随之被移来了美国。 很多华人都喜欢饮早茶，就像喜欢任何特色美食一样，带着一种思乡、念旧与品赏的心理，因为毕竟受过那一方水土的浸染，骨子里血液里也积淀着那样一种血脉般的文化。 在三藩市这样悠闲地饮早茶，在这样环境优美的地方一边观赏无敌海景和四周美景，一边品尝精美早点，和亲朋好友海阔天空话家常聊天，如此般幸福的假期生活是多么美好啊！ 这时，突然想起家乡，想起国内的亲人朋友，竟有些心热眼湿。
28015ba8c11a4e8de4905240da92c0a7fedeaaff.translatedText: My cousin came from Auckland and brought me many photos of our trip to the United States in May this year. One of them is a photo of us having morning tea at the Peninsula Hong Kong Cantonese Seafood Restaurant in San Francisco. Looking at the photo, my thoughts suddenly flew back to San Francisco and those days filled with family love. San Francisco is located in the middle of California, USA, on the Pacific Ocean. It is a small peninsula. This peninsula mountain city is surrounded by water on three sides and is full of charming bays. On a cold and foggy day, under the guidance of my cousin, we went to the Hong Kong Seafood Restaurant in San Francisco Peninsula Park to have morning tea and share family happiness. The hotel's exterior decoration is in Chinese garden style, and the tables, chairs, cups and butterflies in the hotel are all typical "Cantonese style", making people feel warm and friendly in a foreign country. The white tablecloths and bright flower arrangements on the dining table give people a very peaceful and warm feeling. The ethereal and bright crystal chandeliers and faint candlelight set off a low-key and luxurious dining atmosphere. The warm-colored lights cast graceful shadows on the carpet, and even the light looks warm and tender. The floor-to-ceiling windows in the front of the hall offer an endless view of the sea, with the graceful figure of the Golden Gate Bridge visible in the shadows. The east window shows the forest of rafters on the pier and the green trees on the island. The scenery is very pleasant and comfortable. After we sat down, the waiter poured each of us a cup of tea. Although the tea was not very good, it was still superior to the "tea" provided by ordinary Chinese restaurants. Some waiters who spoke Cantonese pushed refreshment trolleys back and forth between the tables. After a while, plates, cages, and bowls of shrimp dumplings, rice rolls, siomai, wind claws, fried squid feet, egg tarts, durian cakes, pineapple buns, steamed short ribs, soy crabs, rice noodles, etc. arrived on the floor, filling the table with a dazzling array of items. The surrounding "sound waves" of Cantonese mixed with the Mandarin with southern and northern accents came one after another, making people feel like they were back in China. In the crowded dining room, we also found a few tables of foreign families, happily using Chinese chopsticks to pick up snacks. In such a lively and noisy environment, they could only put their heads together and talk to each other's ears. Drinking morning tea is a habit of Cantonese people. It is real morning tea. It can be eaten from 5:30 to 10:30 in the morning. Breakfast, drinking tea, reading newspapers, meeting friends and discussing business are all included in morning tea. A large number of Chinese immigrants in San Francisco come from Guangdong and Hong Kong. Therefore, this morning tea culture was also moved to the United States. Many Chinese like to drink morning tea, just like any special food, with a sense of nostalgia, nostalgia and appreciation, because after all, they have been immersed in the soil and water of that place, and there is such a blood-like culture accumulated in their bones. Drinking morning tea leisurely in San Francisco, admiring the incomparable sea view and the surrounding beautiful scenery in such a beautiful place, tasting exquisite breakfast, and chatting with family and friends about the vast sea and sky, such a happy holiday life is so wonderful! At this time, I suddenly thought of my hometown and my relatives and friends in China, and I felt a little warm-hearted and wet-eyed.

2de58dfecbd461bc4e865fc8665fad98658ad449.sourceText: 本次讲座的主题是以情商为基础的家庭教育。廖冰指出建立良好的亲子关系尤为重要。怎样来衡量亲子关系状况？可以把一个亲子关系比作情感银行。与孩子的紧张关系相当于取款，亲密关系相当于存款。大家都希望账户里的存款越多越好。可是很多家长的行为却背道而驰，认为自己有经验，希望为孩子选一条自己认为正确的路，一直在透资情感银行，大大折损了亲子关系，还一意孤行认为自己是为孩子好。如果这种行为不及时制止，孩子也许会关闭这个账户，家长连对孩子好的机会都被屏蔽，造成无法挽回的伤害。建立良好的亲子关系是基础，发觉孩子学习的内驱力是核心。观察和发现孩子爱好，并积极帮助和鼓励发展。要接受孩子的不完美，不要勉强孩子去做不喜欢做的事情。孩子不会，不喜欢都是正常的。 听完廖冰博士的讲座，觉得家长们不是要回去怎么”修理”孩子，更是一个家长”自我修理”的过程。情商家庭教育是在教育家长知道自己的情绪，管理自己的情绪，调整教育孩子的角度，能换位思考，从孩子的角度考虑是否愿意这样被家长对待。只有做到以上情商的关键要素，才能建立一个健康的亲子关系。放下考一个好大学的目标，家长的标准要更”高大上”一些，看看孩子是否快乐，培养一个健康的人格比考一个”常春藤名校”重要。亚裔家长的压力还来自社区内部的比较，不要去打听人家家的孩子，别人的孩子优秀与否与你的孩子无关。不要瞎打听，瞎比较，只会对自己和孩子造成伤害，要根据自己孩子的特点，因材施教，培养出一个健康快乐的孩子。
2de58dfecbd461bc4e865fc8665fad98658ad449.translatedText: The theme of this lecture is family education based on emotional intelligence. Liao Bing pointed out that it is particularly important to establish a good parent-child relationship. The relationship between parents and children can be compared to an emotional bank. A tense relationship with a child is equivalent to a deposit. Everyone wants to have more savings in their accounts. However, many parents behave in the opposite direction. They think they have experience and hope to choose a path they think is right for their children. They have been investing in the emotional bank, which has greatly damaged the parent-child relationship. They also insist on thinking that they are doing their best for their children. If this behavior is not stopped in time, the children may close the account. , parents are blocked from even good opportunities for their children, causing irreparable harm. Establishing a good parent-child relationship is the foundation, and discovering the child's inner drive to learn is the core. Observe and discover the child's hobbies, and actively help and encourage their development. Don't force the child to do things they don't like to do. It's normal for the child not to do it. After listening to Dr. Liao Bing's lecture, I feel that parents are not going back to "fix" their children, but it is a process of "self-repair" for parents. Emotional intelligence family education is to educate parents to understand their own emotions, manage their own emotions, adjust the perspective of educating children, and think from the perspective of their children. Only by meeting the above key elements of emotional intelligence can a healthy parent-child relationship be established. Parents' standards should be higher to see if their children are happy. Cultivating a healthy personality is more important than going to an "Ivy League school." The pressure on Asian parents also comes from comparisons within the community. Don't ask about other people's children. Whether other people's children are good or not has nothing to do with your child. Don't ask around and make blind comparisons, which will only cause harm to yourself and your children. You should teach your children in accordance with their aptitude and cultivate a healthy and happy child.

280c16d259d24ce566ada47d8573d84dea32ad83.sourceText: 据日本新闻网9月11日消息，日本当地时间11日上午11时许，日本政府与钓鱼岛（日本称”尖阁诸岛”）的所谓的”拥有者”栗原家族正式签署了岛屿的”买卖合同”，购买金额为20.5亿日元。由此，日本政府对钓鱼岛所谓的”国有化”正式宣告成立。
280c16d259d24ce566ada47d8573d84dea32ad83.translatedText: According to Japan News Network on September 11, at about 11 a.m. local time in Japan on the 11th, the Japanese government and the Kurihara family, the so-called "owners" of the Diaoyu Islands (called "Senkaku Islands" in Japan), officially signed a "sale and purchase contract" for the islands, with a purchase amount of 2.05 billion yen. As a result, the Japanese government's so-called "nationalization" of the Diaoyu Islands was officially announced.

881726412cfa76bd9f4a1f63faef816b4a983c7a.sourceText: 据日本媒体报道，9月11日上午11时（北京时间10时）左右，日本政府与钓鱼岛所谓的”岛主”栗原家族正式签署了岛屿”买卖合同”，”购买”金额为20.5亿日元（约合1.7亿人民币）。自此，日本当局对钓鱼岛实施的”国有化”非法方针正式宣告成立。
881726412cfa76bd9f4a1f63faef816b4a983c7a.translatedText: According to Japanese media reports, at around 11 a.m. on September 11 (10 a.m. Beijing time), the Japanese government and the Kurihara family, the so-called "island owners" of the Diaoyu Islands, formally signed an island "sale and purchase contract" for a "purchase" amount of 2.05 billion yen (approximately 170 million yuan). Since then, the illegal policy of "nationalization" implemented by the Japanese government on the Diaoyu Islands has been officially established.

66ca66beec6263f080360094b26be8f1a6f7fb08.sourceText: 据日本NHK电视台11日当天透露，11日上午，日本政府召开全体内阁成员会议，会上正式决定将从2012年度预算的预备费用中拿出20.5亿日元”购买”钓鱼岛，以实现对钓鱼岛”平稳且安定的管理”。11日上午11时左右，日政府正式与栗原家族在合同上签字，标志着日政府的”国有化”方针正式生效。
66ca66beec6263f080360094b26be8f1a6f7fb08.translatedText: According to Japan's NHK TV station on the 11th, on the morning of the 11th, the Japanese government held a meeting of all cabinet members. At the meeting, it was officially decided to use 2.05 billion yen from the preliminary expenses of the 2012 budget to "purchase" the Diaoyu Islands in order to achieve "smooth and stable management" of the Diaoyu Islands. At around 11 a.m. on the 11th, the Japanese government officially signed the contract with the Kurihara family, marking the official entry into force of the Japanese government’s “nationalization” policy.

11dafa752a73ca1519b55fc10433467574495f14.sourceText: 另据日本《读卖新闻》报道，日本官房长官藤村修在11上午的记者会上就”国有化”方针称：”’购岛’并实施’国有化’方针意味着日本中央政府将所有权从私人手中收回，是对确保岛屿成为’日本领土’一部分的必要手段，这与其他国家和地区之间不应当产生任何问题。”他同时表示，”日方绝不希望此举影响到中日关系大局。日本希望获得中方的理解，避免不必要的误解和不测事态非常重要”，”日本政府会通过外交渠道向中方详细告知日方的态度和意见”。
11dafa752a73ca1519b55fc10433467574495f14.translatedText: According to Japan's "Yomiuri Shimbun", Japan's Chief Cabinet Secretary Osamu Fujimura said at a press conference on the 11th morning regarding the "nationalization" policy: "'Purchasing the island' and implementing the 'nationalization' policy means that the Japanese central government will take back the ownership from private hands, which is an important step in ensuring that the island becomes part of the 'Japanese territory'" This is a necessary means and should not cause any problems with other countries and regions.” He also said, “Japan never wants this move to affect the overall situation of China-Japan relations. Japan hopes to gain China’s understanding and it is very important to avoid unnecessary misunderstandings and unexpected events.” “The Japanese government will inform China in detail of Japan’s attitude and opinions through diplomatic channels.”

4a173c9401e520709aae2bfd87e42c9bd3a24d45.sourceText: 此外，日本外务省11日派遣亚洲大洋洲局局长杉山晋辅紧急前往北京，将就日政府钓鱼岛”国有化”方针同中方交换意见。
4a173c9401e520709aae2bfd87e42c9bd3a24d45.translatedText: In addition, the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs dispatched Shinsuke Sugiyama, Director of the Asia and Oceania Bureau, to Beijing on the 11th to exchange views with China on the Japanese government’s policy of “nationalizing” the Diaoyu Islands.

ecf445aa764547d9a0ca5fb948adf374fb85b793.sourceText: 针对日本当局企图通过非法手段窃取中国岛屿的事实，中国外交部已于10日发表严正声明指出，日本政府不顾中方一再严正交涉，宣布”购买”钓鱼岛及其附属的南小岛和北小岛，实施所谓”国有化”，这是对中国领土主权的严重侵犯，是对13亿中国人民感情的严重伤害，是对历史事实和国际法理的严重践踏。中国政府和人民对此表示坚决反对和强烈抗议。
ecf445aa764547d9a0ca5fb948adf374fb85b793.translatedText: In response to the fact that the Japanese authorities attempted to steal Chinese islands through illegal means, the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a solemn statement on the 10th, pointing out that the Japanese government ignored China's repeated solemn representations and announced the "purchase" of the Diaoyu Islands and its affiliated Nanxiao Island and Beixiao Island, and implemented the so-called "nationalization". This is a serious violation of China's territorial sovereignty, a serious injury to the feelings of the 1.3 billion Chinese people, and a serious trampling of historical facts and international legal principles. The Chinese government and people express firm opposition and strong protest to this.

4d9d071f7f3bc9c9a03084991f1eba6e1befe0d5.sourceText: 钓鱼岛及其附属岛屿自古以来就是中国的神圣领土，有史为凭、有法为据。钓鱼岛从来就不是什么”无主地”，中国是钓鱼岛等岛屿无可争辩的主人。日本政府的”购岛”行为是同维护中日关系大局背道而驰的。
4d9d071f7f3bc9c9a03084991f1eba6e1befe0d5.translatedText: Diaoyu Island and its affiliated islands have been China’s sacred territory since ancient times, and are backed by history and law. The Diaoyu Islands have never been "terra nullius". China is the indisputable owner of the Diaoyu Islands and other islands. The Japanese government's "island purchase" behavior runs counter to the overall interests of maintaining Sino-Japanese relations.

f9835c231ad022b939948148da0be498a3051757.sourceText: 中国政府严正声明，日本政府的所谓”购岛”完全是非法的、无效的，丝毫改变不了日本侵占中国领土的历史事实，丝毫改变不了中国对钓鱼岛及其附属岛屿的领土主权。中华民族任人欺凌的时代已经一去不复返了。中国政府不会坐视领土主权受到侵犯。中方强烈敦促日方立即停止一切损害中国领土主权的行为，不折不扣地回到双方达成的共识和谅解上来，回到谈判解决争议的轨道上来。如果日方一意孤行，由此造成的一切严重后果只能由日方承担。
f9835c231ad022b939948148da0be498a3051757.translatedText: The Chinese government solemnly declares that the so-called "island purchase" by the Japanese government is completely illegal and invalid. It will not change the historical fact of Japan's invasion and occupation of Chinese territory, nor will it change China's territorial sovereignty over the Diaoyu Islands and its affiliated islands. Gone are the days when the Chinese nation was bullied by others. The Chinese government will not sit idly by and allow its territorial sovereignty to be violated. China strongly urges Japan to immediately stop all actions that undermine China's territorial sovereignty, return to the consensus and understanding reached by both parties to the letter, and return to the track of negotiating to resolve disputes. If Japan insists on going its own way, all serious consequences will only be borne by Japan.

b279c4d445ff3cc25b464b68e1d3a5691cbeed5b.sourceText: 七十多年前，双亲是透过媒妁之言、父母之命而结合；直到洞房花烛夜新娘的头巾被掀起，才和新郎见面。因此、家父一生从没有与异性约会的经验。廿七年前母亲病殁后，每日清晨风雪不改，父亲必步往市区附近宁静幽美的墓园，去探望先慈的坟地，在青草堆上点燃一根香烟。直至后来不良于行止，在那四千多个日子，老父孤独晚景因有份执着的寄託，那份怀念心情是我无从理解的。 早期收到二弟来函描述，颇难相信，又很感动；后来当我抵达德国携花扫墓，果然看到石碑前泥土插满烟蒂。试问严父，他澹澹的说，母亲弥留之际对他的遗言是，别破费花钱购那些冥纸，德国阴间也不能通行，要探她就像生时燃根香烟可省事。因此、父亲后来每朝散步，走走行行必然就到了墓园，抽口烟、和老伴「閒话家常」一番。 这种坚持十多年如一日，冬季雪厚路滑，加之糖尿病末期双腿乏力，摔跤多次，二弟才劝止。双腿乏力无计可施，老父从此唯有独处斗室；岁月流转，时光彷若静止，再无任何喜乐悲欢可在他心底扬起涟漪。 多年前我出席曼谷的第二届微型小说研讨会后，在机场与太太婉冰分道，她去新加坡，我独往欧洲。到二弟处住了七星期，倍伴老父，定省晨昏略尽子责。 时值初冬，无飘雪花的早晨，我散步欣赏小城冬景，沿着老父往昔的途径，不觉穿越闹市抵坟场，酷寒气温中人鬼多沉睡，墓园寂静。找到方块字碑石，为墓地清理枯叶残枝野草，烟蒂。回去后、老父知我空手探亡母，翌日持别要我携香前往叩拜，他已戒烟，不然也许就要代他燃烟坟前。 那天、父子俩閒谈，他忽然要检查衣物，指挥我将柜中皮箱收藏的西装、领带、绸帽、皮鞋一件件拿出来让他过目。如数家珍般指出何日何价购买，自是还能行走时逛街买回，从未用过。原先准备返回闽南故乡终老，病弱难实现，这些东西就改变成「寿衣」，说是要去见老伴「赴约」时穿着，并已对二媳妇交待好。想起给我过目，他澹澹的说，心里平静，彷彿在讲着出席宴会时准备的服装。毕生没有赴约，而竟如此隆重细心期待最初亦是最后的约会，推断不出老父内心深处究是何种感受？ 离开德国不到半年，噩讯传来，匆促奔丧，赶到欧洲北德杜鹃花城，当午即往殡仪馆，父亲安详静躺棺椁内，果然穿着自己生前展示过的新装，绸帽放在身旁；我伸手相握，触掌冰冷，难忍盈眶热泪；老父含笑九泉，欢喜去见先走十二年的老伴，共埋一穴，完了赴约之梦。 先父「赴约」转瞬十五年了，每次到客厅瞧见先严遗照，想起都令我好伤感呢!
b279c4d445ff3cc25b464b68e1d3a5691cbeed5b.translatedText: More than seventy years ago, the parents were married through the words of a matchmaker and the orders of their parents; it was not until the night of the bridal chamber that the bride's headscarf was lifted up, and she met the groom. Therefore, my father has never had any experience in dating with the opposite sex in his life. After my mother died of illness twenty-seven years ago, every morning in the wind and snow, my father would walk to a quiet and beautiful cemetery near the city to visit his late father’s grave and light a cigarette on a pile of grass. Until later, when I was unable to behave properly, during those more than 4,000 days, I had a persistent attachment to my father’s loneliness in his later years, and I could not understand the feeling of nostalgia for him. Early on, I received a letter from my second brother describing it, which was hard to believe but also very touching. Later, when I arrived in Germany and brought flowers to visit the grave, I saw that the soil in front of the stone monument was full of cigarette butts. When I asked Yan's father, he said calmly that his mother's last words to him when she was dying were not to spend money to buy those ghost papers. The underworld in Germany is not accessible. It would be easier to visit her than to light a cigarette when she was alive. Therefore, every time my father went for a walk, he would inevitably end up at the cemetery, where he would smoke a cigarette and chat with his wife. This persisted for more than ten years. In winter, the snow was thick and the roads were slippery. In addition, due to the weakness of the legs in the end stage of diabetes, I fell down many times before my second brother stopped me. His legs were weak and there was nothing he could do. From now on, the old father could only stay alone in his small room; as the years went by, time seemed to stand still, and there was no longer any joy or sorrow that could ripple in his heart. Many years ago, after I attended the second Microfiction Seminar in Bangkok, I parted ways with my wife, Wan Bing, at the airport. She went to Singapore, and I went to Europe alone. I stayed with my second brother for seven weeks, spending time with my old father, spending time in the morning and dusk, and fulfilling my son's responsibilities. It was early winter, and on a morning without falling snowflakes, I took a walk to admire the winter scenery of the small town. Following my father's path in the past, I walked through the busy city to the cemetery without realizing it. In the freezing cold temperature, many people and ghosts were sleeping, and the cemetery was silent. Find square stone tablets and clean up dead leaves, branches, weeds and cigarette butts for the cemetery. After returning home, my old father found out that I had visited my late mother empty-handed. The next day, he said goodbye and asked me to bring incense and pay my respects. He had quit smoking, otherwise I might have to burn cigarettes on his behalf at the grave. That day, the father and son were chatting. He suddenly wanted to check the clothes and ordered me to take out the suits, ties, silk hats, and leather shoes stored in the suitcase in the cabinet one by one for him to look at. He pointed out the date and price of the purchase like a treasure, so he could still buy it while walking and never used it. I originally planned to return to my hometown in southern Fujian to die in old age, but it was difficult to do so because of my illness, so these things were changed into "shrouds", which I said I would wear when I went to see my wife for an "appointment", and I had already told my second daughter-in-law. Thinking of showing it to me, he said calmly, feeling calm, as if he was talking about the clothes he had prepared for a banquet. I have never gone to an appointment in my life, but I am looking forward to the first and last appointment so solemnly and carefully. I can't infer what my father feels deep in his heart? Less than half a year after leaving Germany, the bad news came. I rushed to the Azalea City in Northern Germany, and went to the funeral parlor that afternoon. My father was lying peacefully in the coffin. Sure enough, he was wearing the new clothes he had shown before his death, and his silk hat was beside him. I stretched out my hands to hold each other, and the palms were cold to the touch. I couldn't help but burst into tears. My father was smiling, and he happily went to see his wife who had been gone for twelve years. We buried them together and fulfilled our dream of keeping the appointment. It has been fifteen years since my late father "went to an appointment". Every time I go to the living room and see the photo of Xian Yan's death, it makes me very sad to think about it!

d22d8d2a393b31aa8715c3acd636816370cd62f7.sourceText: 天生就能歌善舞的藏族姑娘，用《妈妈的歌》，来演绎她们的生活和她们的爱。这些都是9月23日在美莎艺术中心第三届亚省中秋舞蹈节中，受到好评的成人舞蹈。他们的表演者都是亚利桑那爱好舞蹈的爸爸妈妈们。

These were the adult dances that were well received at the 3rd Alberta Mid-Autumn Festival Dance Festival at the Mesa Arts Center on September 23. Their performers are all Arizona dance-loving moms and dads.

7103a2101bf7ab3ee4fd90345894d3f68b54563e.sourceText: 想起三年前的成人舞蹈《水姑娘》，那时候成人班的演员看着舞蹈视频都说，肯定不行，肯定跳不下来，后来《亚省春晚》演出，《水姑娘》成为了最受瞩目的舞蹈之一，如今的《采薇》《春江花月夜》《妈妈的歌》《西部放歌》《贝鲁特之夜》《最炫民族风》， 成人班的队伍日益强大，她们中很多人都是三四十岁才开始学习舞蹈。每周上课和孩子们一样，压腿，下腰，疼得嗷嗷直叫。无论是什么基本功动作，在这个年龄做起来都不再容易，每周的课，大家都汗流浃背。记动作，更是个十分困难的事情。家长们把上课的时间，从一个半小时加到两个小时，希望更多的汗水能换来观众的认可。功夫不负有心人，您能看出她们中，很多人是第一次登台吗？经过一段时间训练，她们不仅在基本功上进步显著，更是将自己对音乐和舞蹈的理解，贯穿到动作中，让每一个成人舞蹈韵味十足。成人班的姑娘们有的是工程师，有的是公司职员，还有的全职妈妈，不管她们来自什么职业，对演出的细节都精益求精。自己上网去挑选演出服，还有一些甚至自己到中国购买，运回来。修改自己的衣服，头发，发誓等等。每周的课，她们都在时刻在挑战自己，展现一个更美的自己。演出完毕，妈妈们谦虚的说没有天赋，有的是汗水和一个永远年轻的心。
7103a2101bf7ab3ee4fd90345894d3f68b54563e.translatedText: I think of the adult dance "Water Girl" three years ago. At that time, the actors in the adult class Looking at the dance videos, everyone said, "It's definitely not possible, I definitely can't dance." Later, "Water Girl" was performed in "Alberta Spring Festival Gala" and became one of the most watched dances. Today, "Plucking Weird Flowers", "Spring River Flower Moonlight Night", "Mother's Song", "Western Singing", "Beirut Night" and "The Most Dazzling National Style", The adult class team is getting stronger day by day, and many of them started learning dance in their thirties and forties. I go to class every week just like the kids, pressing my legs, bending my waist, and screaming in pain. No matter what basic movements it is, it is no longer easy to do at this age. Everyone is sweating in the weekly classes. Memorizing actions is even more difficult. Parents increased the class time from one and a half hours to two hours, hoping that more sweat would win the recognition of the audience. Hard work pays off, can you tell that many of them are on stage for the first time? After a period of training, they not only made significant progress in basic skills, but also integrated their understanding of music and dance into their movements, making every adult dance full of charm. Some of the girls in the adult class are engineers, some are company employees, and some are stay-at-home mothers. No matter what profession they come from, they strive to improve the details of the performance. You go online to choose performance costumes yourself, and some even go to China to buy them yourself and have them shipped back. Modify your clothes, hair, swear and more. In weekly classes, they are always challenging themselves to show a more beautiful version of themselves. After the performance, the mothers humbly said that they had no talent, but sweat and a forever young heart.

d811444538512b91c4667570b754e971ef4a8a3e.sourceText: （张肇鸿供稿）11月1日晚，亚利桑那华人历史协会假借Harbor Seafood Super Buffet餐馆的独立餐厅，举办《沙漠明珠》第五集新书发佈会暨欢迎《华人历史摄制组莅临凤凰城》的活动。包括有三十多位各界人士和社团体代表，历史攝影制组成员，亚利桑那华人历史协会董事局成员等参加了此次活动。 由“五十八位叔叔”著作者李安女士，华人攝影组周敏导演，阐述此次前来的目的，主要是为寻找在二战期间，58位中国空军在亚利桑那州参加军训和生活方面的经历。 专门由中国无锡前来冯忠先生，将和攝制组、凤凰城远足队成员，一起深入到荒山野岭之中，去寻找他大舅范绍昌空军英烈，八十年前在训练中失事的飞机残骸，甚至希望能找到这位英雄的遗物。 历史协会联系上在二战期间，接待过中国空军的本地侨领关崇琼的第十一位女儿关秀玉关老太，她带来了大量的相片和资料，并讲述许多当年关家和战士们之间互动有趣的历史故事。 二战期间，从中国到美国参加培训的中华民国空军第二批留美战士，在假余期间经常到关家聚会，并送给许多珍贵的相片和资料给关家，成为在那个年代，空军战士们在训练和生活中不可或缺的一个组成部分和历史的印证。 参加此次新书发布会的团体代表包括有：亚利桑那华人历史协会主席张肇鸿、秘书长余民信、董事成员谢文彦、庄淑华，大凤凰城侨联主席邓军泉、顾问余文泽；邓高密公所代表邓洪钺；余风采堂主席余美莲；黄氏宗亲代表黄益成；龙岡亲义公所前主席刘全知；亚省中国餐馆协会前主席张华芳；军人会老兵代表余长存；凤凰导报社长隋旭光，学界代表林涧、张永航；文化界代表周永新，妇女界代表章美玲，远足队队长宋雷等等。 华人历史协会赠送每位与会者《沙漠明珠》新书，并对赞助团体敞开提供给其领导班子所有成员们的新书。 华人历史协会的第一场新书发佈会10月22日在凤凰城东区的“凤凰之夜”举办，赠送新书给先进教师和从政主流政要等，这次活动在西区举行，是要照顾到传统侨社的老侨们出行能够得到方便。 亚利桑那华人历史协会在此对所有支持和鼓励历史协会的团体和个人表达最衷心的感谢！
d811444538512b91c4667570b754e971ef4a8a3e.translatedText: (Contributed by Zhang Zhaohong) On the evening of November 1st, the Arizona Chinese Historical Association used the Harbor Seafood Super The independent restaurant of Buffet Restaurant held a book launch event for the fifth episode of "Pearl of the Desert" and an event to welcome the "Chinese History Film Crew to Phoenix". More than 30 people from all walks of life and community representatives, members of the historical photography crew, and members of the board of directors of the Arizona Chinese Historical Association participated in this event. Ms. Li An, the author of "Fifty-eight Uncles", and director Zhou Min of the Chinese photography team explained the purpose of this visit, which was mainly to find out the experiences of 58 Chinese Air Force personnel participating in military training and life in Arizona during World War II. Mr. Feng Zhong, who came specially from Wuxi, China, will go deep into the wild mountains with the film crew and members of the Phoenix Excursion Team to look for the wreckage of his uncle Fan Shaochang, a hero of the Air Force, who crashed during training 80 years ago. He even hopes to find the hero's relics. The Historical Association contacted Mrs. Guan Xiuyu, the 11th daughter of Guan Chongqiong, a local overseas Chinese leader who received the Chinese Air Force during World War II. She brought a large number of photos and information, and told many interesting historical stories about the interaction between the Guan family and the soldiers. During World War II, the second batch of soldiers from the Republic of China Air Force who came to the United States for training often went to the Guan family for gatherings during their spare time and gave many precious photos and information to the Guan family. This became an indispensable part of the training and life of the Air Force soldiers in that era and a historical confirmation. Group representatives participating in the book launch include: Arizona Chinese Historical Association Chairman Zhang Zhaohong, Secretary General Yu Minxin, board members Xie Wenyan and Zhuang Shuhua; Greater Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation Chairman Deng Junquan and consultant Yu Wenze; Deng Hongyue, representative of Deng Gaomi Office; Yu Meilian, chairman of Yu Fengcaitang; Huang Clan Representative Huang Yicheng; former chairman of Longgang Friendship Office Liu Quanzhi; former chairman of the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta Zhang Huafang; veteran representative of the Military Association Yu Changcun; president of Phoenix Herald Sui Xuguang; academic representatives Lin Jian and Zhang Yonghang; cultural representative Zhou Yongxin, women's representative Zhang Meiling, hiking team leader Song Lei, etc. The Chinese Historical Association will present a new book of "Pearl of the Desert" to each attendee, and is open to sponsoring groups to provide new books to all members of its leadership team. The Chinese Historical Association's first new book launch was held on October 22 at the "Phoenix Night" in the East District of Phoenix City. New books were presented to advanced teachers and mainstream political dignitaries. This event was held in the West District to facilitate the travel of the old overseas Chinese in traditional overseas Chinese communities. The Arizona Chinese Historical Association would like to express its most heartfelt thanks to all groups and individuals who support and encourage the Historical Association!
