59fd5d28492c037c365af4e136a39eb8a5bfa7fb.sourceText: 美国华人书写自己的历史 《美华史记》公开征集 众所周知，美国华人的历史是浸透着泪水和艰辛的奋斗史。 从史料记载…
59fd5d28492c037c365af4e136a39eb8a5bfa7fb.translatedText: Chinese Americans are writing their own history. "Chinese American History" is open for collection. As we all know, the history of Chinese Americans is a history soaked in tears and hard work. From historical records...

9cec63752a0ff3a048feee489afaa54721040ba9.sourceText: 众所周知，美国华人的历史是浸透着泪水和艰辛的奋斗史。
9cec63752a0ff3a048feee489afaa54721040ba9.translatedText: As we all know, the history of Chinese Americans is a history soaked in tears and arduous struggle.

6acfd1a3323cfb549d9628fd2992e9c06f011712.sourceText: 从史料记载可查，最早三或四名中国水手于1785年8月9日乘船抵达巴尔的摩开始，美国大陆上就留下了华人的足迹。他们曾是苦力，因不堪忍受家乡贫困的生活和连年的战乱，签下了赴美长期劳务合同，当时他们最大的愿望是能够挣到钱并活着回家。
6acfd1a3323cfb549d9628fd2992e9c06f011712.translatedText: From historical records, the earliest three or four Chinese sailors arrived in Baltimore by boat on August 9, 1785, leaving Chinese footprints on the American continent. They were once coolies. Unable to bear the poverty and war in their hometown, they signed long-term labor contracts in the United States. Their biggest wish at that time was to make money and return home alive.

0cb37a012ce96b0294949a0603a842d73c7570f1.sourceText: 19世纪中期，华工帮助美国淘金、修铁路、西部开发，为美国国家建设和经济发展做出了巨大贡献。后来，于19世纪末20世纪初，又出现长达六十年的排华法案，成千上万华工还被迫走上了迁往各地的悲惨之旅。无论是作为”华工”来到美国修筑太平洋铁路，参加西部淘金，或者因庚子赔款作为留学生派往美国，随着时代的变迁，美国大地上华人的身影随之增多，与此同时，中华民族也在苦难深重中日益发展强大起来。
0cb37a012ce96b0294949a0603a842d73c7570f1.translatedText: In the mid-19th century, Chinese laborers helped the United States to dig for gold, build railroads, and develop the west, making great contributions to the nation's construction and economic development. Later, at the end of the 19th century and the beginning of the 20th century, the Chinese Exclusion Act came into being that lasted for sixty years, and thousands of Chinese workers were forced to embark on the tragic journey of moving to various places. Whether they came to the United States as "Chinese laborers" to build the Pacific Railway, participated in the gold rush in the West, or were sent to the United States as international students due to the Boxer Indemnity, with the changes of the times, the number of Chinese in the United States has increased. At the same time, the Chinese nation has also grown stronger and stronger amid deep suffering.

1b303c7a50f4d5d34af9139fdad4835666075244.sourceText: 今天，华裔在美国的人口约有500万之多，华人通过一代又一代人的努力，已经取得了应有的社会经济地位，被称为美国的模范少数民族。美国华人在用自己的智慧和勤劳开辟出生存崛起之路时，并没有忘却对这个国家的荣誉、责任和奉献，他们身上一直流淌着中华民族克勤克俭、任劳任怨的性格基因。一路走来，如今的华裔中有国会议员、学界精英、政界领袖、财经大腕、艺体明星等，但还有许许多多为这个社会辛勤劳动、默默奉献的华人草根。
1b303c7a50f4d5d34af9139fdad4835666075244.translatedText: Today, the Chinese population in the United States is about 5 million. Through the efforts of generations, the Chinese have achieved their due socioeconomic status and are known as the model minority in the United States. When Chinese Americans used their wisdom and hard work to carve out a path for survival and rise, they did not forget their honor, responsibility and dedication to this country. They have always been carrying the Chinese nation's character genes of hard work, thrift and hard work. Along the way, today's Chinese Americans include members of Congress, academic elites, political leaders, financial figures, arts and sports stars, etc., but there are also many grassroots Chinese who work hard and contribute silently to this society.

9bbd29165fa8d4130a0456e01a541baa7db0d112.sourceText: 然而，美国华人历史并未记载或包含在美国公共教育系统的教科书里，多数后人对美华历史的了解只能来源于零星文章。直到今天，美国华人历史也没有系统性、连续性地被记录下来，甚至只是一知半解的某个故事、历史事件或历史人物，这为当今华人完整记录美国华人历史留下了需要填补的史料空白。
9bbd29165fa8d4130a0456e01a541baa7db0d112.translatedText: However, the history of Chinese Americans has not been recorded or included in the textbooks of the American public education system. Most future generations’ understanding of Chinese American history can only come from sporadic articles. To this day, the history of the Chinese in the United States has not been recorded systematically and continuously, and there are even only half-understood stories, historical events, or historical figures. This has left gaps in historical materials that need to be filled for the current Chinese to fully record the history of the Chinese in the United States.

c6bf28291a591c153e2b44d7063175fba819497b.sourceText: 于是，一群来自美国各地的华人，包括专业作家、媒体记者、自由撰稿人、历史学家、工程博士、科研人员、医生、律师、教师等等，从2017年4月陆续聚集起来，对美国华人历史怀有一种责任感、义务感、使命感，组成《美华史记》写作小组，在没有任何资金的支持下，凭借志愿者服务意识，以美华联盟为平台，开启了这一令人惊叹的美华历史写作工程。
c6bf28291a591c153e2b44d7063175fba819497b.translatedText: As a result, a group of Chinese from all over the United States, including professional writers, media reporters, freelance writers, historians, engineering PhDs, scientific researchers, doctors, lawyers, teachers, etc., gathered one after another in April 2017 With a sense of responsibility, obligation, and mission for the history of the Chinese in the United States, we formed a writing group for the Chinese American History. Without any financial support, relying on volunteer service awareness and using the Chinese American Alliance as a platform, we started this amazing writing project of Chinese American history.

ae8bb06f74b7593281352dd49bf87166269505d3.sourceText: 在这些来自不同职业、不同学历、不同年龄、不同祖籍的华裔美国人笔下，有华人先辈的生活历程，有不同时代的历史事件，有今昔对比的感悟体会，以”大米社区”公众号为主阵地，籍”美国华人”等公众号已发表了20多篇纪录华人历史的文章，从《美华史记序言》开篇，相继有《回顾沉重的”黄祸”》、《地狱谷的 百年悲鸣》、《旧金山唐人街上的天使》、《美国判例法中的中国和华人》、《21世纪的华人维权：陈建生案》、《加州工人党和排华法案》、《南迁华人在困境中的崛起》、《何亚方辫子案始末》等文章，在美国华人族裔中形成为一种独特的历史文化现象；一些读者的感想《华裔美国人的尊严之战》、《读史鉴今，何去何从》、《美国华人的历史、今天和将来》等文章，引起了华裔族群的普遍关注。
ae8bb06f74b7593281352dd49bf87166269505d3.translatedText: In the writings of these Chinese Americans from different professions, different education levels, different ages, and different ancestral places, there are life experiences of the Chinese ancestors, historical events of different eras, and a sense of comparison between the past and the present. After realizing this, with the "Dami Community" public account as the main platform, public accounts such as "American Chinese" have published more than 20 articles documenting the history of the Chinese. Starting from "Preface to the American Chinese Historical Records", there have been "Reviewing the Heavy "Yellow Peril"" and "Hell Valley" "A Hundred Years of Lament", "Angels in San Francisco's Chinatown", "China and Chinese in American Case Law", "Chinese Rights Defense in the 21st Century: Chen Jiansheng Case", "California Workers' Party and the Chinese Exclusion Act", "The Rise of Southern Chinese Migrants in Difficulties", "The Beginning and End of He Yafang's Braid Case", etc. The article has become a unique historical and cultural phenomenon among the Chinese in the United States; some readers' reflections on articles such as "The Battle for Chinese Americans' Dignity," "Reading History to Learn from the Present, Where to Go," and "The History, Today and Future of Chinese Americans" have aroused widespread concern among the Chinese ethnic group.

2831f5a86b5071b19b5ac7441fce35bda09c8ee3.sourceText: 存续历史是一个民族的责任和义务，尤其是对美国华人的历史而言更是如此，看似这段历史在人类历史长河中并不久长，仅仅200多年，但却存在着极有价值的空间和顺应时势的必然，这也是处于美国各阶层华裔民众人心所向的一大趋势。相信，时代发展的需要，国家实力的增强，民族自信心的增长，为每一位美国华人提供了充分的理由和充足的动力，去记录和写下不能被遗忘的历史。
2831f5a86b5071b19b5ac7441fce35bda09c8ee3.translatedText: Preserving history is the responsibility and obligation of a nation, especially for the history of Chinese Americans. It seems that this period of history is not very long in the long history of mankind, only more than 200 years, but there is extremely valuable space and the necessity to adapt to the times. This is also a major trend that Chinese people from all walks of life in the United States want. I believe that the development needs of the times, the enhancement of national strength, and the growth of national self-confidence have provided every Chinese American with sufficient reasons and sufficient motivation to record and write history that cannot be forgotten.

bf6e63828e2e307ec6d3508a0ff00b50f4a546cd.sourceText: 《美华史记》的目标是回顾历史、警醒后人、教育同胞、思考未来，这是一项任重而道远的工作，意义不言而喻。大家秉承写历史，教育公众，捍卫法治，维护斯文理性态度，从客观公正，没有政治偏见的视角出发，再现华人在美国两百多年的历史，为后世子孙和史学研究留下一笔人文历史的丰厚精神文化财富。
bf6e63828e2e307ec6d3508a0ff00b50f4a546cd.translatedText: The goal of "Historical Records of the United States and China" is to review history, alert future generations, educate compatriots, and think about the future. This is an arduous task with a long way to go, and its significance is self-evident. We adhere to writing history, educating the public, defending the rule of law, and maintaining a polite and rational attitude. From an objective and fair perspective without political bias, we reproduce the history of the Chinese in the United States for more than two hundred years, leaving a rich spiritual and cultural wealth of humanistic history for future generations and historical research.

4040474df994ecb06624b01a0d9010ede8c0ef63.sourceText: ”美华联盟”是该项目发起人，主编是王昶，副主编是Steven Chen和潘秋辰，负责人欣欣然、远方介绍，《美华史记》欢迎海内外不同领域机构、商家合作这项事业，可作为共同发起人，推进项目持续和纵深发展。凡喜爱历史和写作，并感兴趣加入《美华史记》作者组的同仁，请发送电子邮件联系：info@chineseforsocialjustice.org
4040474df994ecb06624b01a0d9010ede8c0ef63.translatedText: "American-Chinese Alliance" is the initiator of this project. The editor-in-chief is Wang Chang, and the deputy editors are Steven Chen and Pan Qiuchen. The person in charge, Xin Xinran, Yuanfang introduced that "American-Chinese Historical Records" welcomes institutions and businesses in different fields at home and abroad to cooperate in this cause, and can serve as a co-sponsor to promote the sustained and in-depth development of the project. For those who love history and writing and are interested in joining the author group of "Historical Records of Chinese Americans", please send an email to contact: info@chineseforsocialjustice.org

3818cf87afdc7de6a124af418edb9624a74bd83f.sourceText: 华裔国会议员封杀高技术绿卡提案 华人反对
3818cf87afdc7de6a124af418edb9624a74bd83f.translatedText: Chinese-American congressmen blocked the high-tech green card proposal. Chinese people opposed

b1f3067ebbe952379a2a9f2cbb0d21abdfe21fd1.sourceText: 华裔国会议员封杀高技术绿卡提案 华人反对 上月底美国国会审议高技术绿卡(STEM)提案，结果在西岸华裔议员…
b1f3067ebbe952379a2a9f2cbb0d21abdfe21fd1.translatedText: Chinese-American congressmen blocked the high-tech green card proposal. The Chinese opposed it. At the end of last month, the U.S. Congress reviewed the high-tech green card (STEM) proposal. As a result, Chinese-American congressmen on the West Coast...

6040f7461b44e333cd325cb262d836b78aaf9d82.sourceText: 这条由共和党提出的议案主要是为科学、科技、工程及数学(Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics ，简称STEM)高等学位毕业生提供5万个绿卡名额，免受十多年的移民排期之苦，但是代价是以5万个绿卡抽签名额(Diversity Visa Program)作为交换，但赵美心去函同袍带头反对此事，结果此案在国会铩羽而归。
6040f7461b44e333cd325cb262d836b78aaf9d82.translatedText: This bill proposed by the Republican Party is mainly for Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics). , referred to as STEM) advanced degree graduates were provided with 50,000 green card quotas to avoid the immigration waiting list of more than ten years, but the price was 50,000 green card lottery quotas (Diversity Visa Program) in exchange. However, Zhao Meixin took the lead in opposing this matter by writing a letter to her colleagues, and the case failed in Congress.

e1764a2bf0481865f27b1403b211cf19ede06443.sourceText: 目前在美国的亚洲留学生多数攻读理工科，此案若然能够通过，众多亚裔生受益，因此前被否决大家极度失望，很多人更在网上指责赵美心。
e1764a2bf0481865f27b1403b211cf19ede06443.translatedText: Currently, most Asian students in the United States are studying science and engineering. If this case is passed, many Asian students will benefit. Because it was rejected before, everyone is extremely disappointed. Many people even criticized Zhao Meixin online.

4608a09453a992615e8e9bcaa2317a363ce20571.sourceText: 就民众的反应赵美心回应说，”我强烈支持STEM签证，这些签证提供机会，吸引全球最有知识的人们移民美国，因此我也连署支持另一条吸引人才议案(Attracting the Best and Brightest Act)。但是共和党否定此案，要求是以5万抽签名额作为交换。绿卡抽签帮助全球每一个地区的人们来到美国改善生活。美国是移民国家，我们不应为一些人开门，但对另一些人关门”
4608a09453a992615e8e9bcaa2317a363ce20571.translatedText: Zhao Meixin responded to the public's response, "I strongly support STEM visas. These visas provide opportunities to attract the most knowledgeable people in the world to immigrate to the United States. Therefore, I also co-signed to support another bill to attract talents (Attracting the Best and Brightest). Act). However, the Republican Party rejected the case and demanded that the green card lottery help people from every region of the world come to the United States to improve their lives. The United States is a country of immigrants, and we should not open the door to some people but close the door to others."

986189ddceadd2adb3b303be7beb4a22f3132f31.sourceText: 不过，纽约中华公所主席吴国基不认同这个理由，他说亚裔社区极度重视教育，这条法案若过关众多高学历留学生都将加入成为亚美大家庭，而且撇开族 裔不谈，对国家而言，这些人能够创造很大的社会经济价值，与靠抽签来美的人很不同。每周四在华埠帮助侨胞入籍的中华总商会董事陈传铭也说，”绿卡抽签的人 没有经过任何的努力，一切就只是靠运气，即使非法移民也在国内努力地工作，两者怎可相提并论。”另据指出，好像中国、印度、南韩、菲律宾等国民俱排除在绿 卡抽签以外，因此并非如赵美心所说”全球每一个地区”的民众都可参加。
986189ddceadd2adb3b303be7beb4a22f3132f31.translatedText: However, Wu Guoji, chairman of the New York Chinese Association, said that the Asian community attaches great importance to education. If this bill is passed, many highly educated international students will join the Asian-American family, regardless of their ethnicity. Regardless of their origin, these people can create great socio-economic value to the country, which is very different from those who come to the United States by lottery. Chen Chuanming, director of the Chinese General Chamber of Commerce who helps overseas Chinese to naturalize in Chinatown every Thursday, also said, "Those who are drawn for green cards have not made any efforts, everything is just luck. Even illegal immigrants are working hard in the country. How can the two be compared." It was also pointed out that nationals from China, India, South Korea, the Philippines, etc. are all excluded from the green card lottery, so not people from "every region of the world" can participate as Zhao Meixin said.

cacc4090eb898f6ed79baa92f0f1c088e151a3f2.sourceText: 会员约有500人的中国旅美科技协会最近才刚庆祝成立20周年，前会长谢家叶博士说，他也认为赵美心的决定欠妥，因为美国若要继续维持高科技发 达国家地位，便须要延揽人才，而且他们有较高的创造经济能力，在此经济环境下更能起作用。他说，如果共和民主党两党能以各自25000个名额作为折衷就最 好，若必须两者择其一，那一定是选择5万个高科技人员。他说，全面移民改革谈判无法达成，起码也不会裹足不前。
cacc4090eb898f6ed79baa92f0f1c088e151a3f2.translatedText: The China Science and Technology Association in the United States, which has about 500 members, recently celebrated its 20th anniversary. Former president Dr. Xie Jiaye said that he also believed that Zhao Meixin’s decision was inappropriate because if the United States wants to continue to maintain its status as a high-tech developed country, it needs to recruit talents, and they have higher creative economic capabilities and are more effective in this economic environment. He said that it would be best if the Republican and Democratic parties could compromise with 25,000 quotas each. If they had to choose one of the two, they would definitely choose 50,000 high-tech personnel. He said that if comprehensive immigration reform negotiations cannot be reached, at least they will not stand still.

24019ddcdb24bd4faf0b48ddda37f9a22e1a3a7a.sourceText: 医疗保健业大旺 哪些工作不需学历又有潜力？
24019ddcdb24bd4faf0b48ddda37f9a22e1a3a7a.translatedText: The healthcare industry is booming. Which jobs do not require academic qualifications but have potential?

7bf730736cad4e7825fa1a142c4b3ffa591fb286.sourceText: 医疗保健业大旺 哪些工作不需学历又有潜力？ 近年，美国的医疗保健行业大旺，加入医保的人数增加，人口老龄化的…
7bf730736cad4e7825fa1a142c4b3ffa591fb286.translatedText: The health care industry is booming. Which jobs do not require academic qualifications but have potential? In recent years, the health care industry in the United States has been booming. The number of people signing up for medical insurance has increased. The aging population...

8e6ae4ae79d0bb0b5c71c636e4a7d47f2ee79b2e.sourceText: 近年，美国的医疗保健行业大旺，加入医保的人数增加，人口老龄化的问题严重，成为一个很有潜力的领域。

1bfee7d26d34c131c8bcb2ef5ea10ca64dfecfdd.sourceText: 去年，美国布鲁金斯学会发现医疗保健行业增长高达22.7%，相比其他劳动力市场只有2.1%的增长，明显有所分别。
1bfee7d26d34c131c8bcb2ef5ea10ca64dfecfdd.translatedText: Last year, the Brookings Institution in the United States found that the health care industry grew as high as 22.7%, compared with only 2.1% growth in other labor markets, which is obviously different.

6468a5daf9fff0ff8afdfe4c0e0710540cadda07.sourceText: 年轻人不妨投资时间和金钱于医疗保健工作，事实上，医护人员不仅是医生和护士，还有不少相关的部门工作。
6468a5daf9fff0ff8afdfe4c0e0710540cadda07.translatedText: Young people may wish to invest time and money in medical care. In fact, medical staff are not only doctors and nurses, but also work in many related departments.

ad1093e8346d8354af9383556624a14d70612480.sourceText: 美国新闻与世界报导的调查指出，2014年美国最理想的100份工作，其中有38项为医疗保健范畴，这些工作并不需要4年制的学位。
ad1093e8346d8354af9383556624a14d70612480.translatedText: A survey by U.S. News and World Report pointed out that among the 100 most desirable jobs in the United States in 2014, 38 were in the health care field. These jobs do not require a four-year degree.

27c33f521bf0daf250abca3b202ac6053f2c999c.sourceText: 人力资源管理协会大卫温切尔(DavidTwitchell)说：”最大的好处是只要高中以上学历的年轻人，已经可以找到自己喜欢工作的领域。”
27c33f521bf0daf250abca3b202ac6053f2c999c.translatedText: David Twitchell of the Association for Human Resource Management said: "The biggest advantage is that young people with a high school degree or above can already find the field they like to work in."

4ca5995d6faff9e6120802bbd6e8a080f1a70c7e.sourceText: 有些职位需要大专学历，完成证书课程或是州政府的许可证。
4ca5995d6faff9e6120802bbd6e8a080f1a70c7e.translatedText: Some positions require a college degree, completion of a certificate program or a license from the state government.

3807b93037dbe589a3da79af6f8d4abac65b6cc3.sourceText: 但是，不同州的要求不尽相同，加入医疗保健的工作，可以在不同的地方工作。
3807b93037dbe589a3da79af6f8d4abac65b6cc3.translatedText: However, the requirements vary from state to state, and you can work in different places to join the health care job.

5ed15ec84b1f0706a1647bbe7e0d90eae4e0c621.sourceText: 如果只有高中文凭，也可以加入医疗保健工作吗？
5ed15ec84b1f0706a1647bbe7e0d90eae4e0c621.translatedText: Can I join the healthcare workforce if I only have a high school diploma?

b4e1aad061a1b1a5a34872ca66ac19f75f7eb5bd.sourceText: 即使是药物学，也有入门级的职位。
b4e1aad061a1b1a5a34872ca66ac19f75f7eb5bd.translatedText: Even in pharmacology, there are entry-level positions.

4ae61b1ddb4bed8b5bb16f1cfccf95bddc8c05dc.sourceText: 有些工作不会支付太多薪金，只是年轻人的入门机会，例如，担任家庭健康助理或个人护理助手。
4ae61b1ddb4bed8b5bb16f1cfccf95bddc8c05dc.translatedText: Some jobs don't pay much and are just entry-level opportunities for young people, such as working as a home health aide or a personal care aide.

e8575a3b1ef5a3486e9d2471d668e2a86928550e.sourceText: 美国新闻与世界报导高级编辑贾达格雷夫斯(JadaGraves)说：”有很多人选择住在家里，不想要搬入安老居所，需要大批的护理助手来照顾他们。”
e8575a3b1ef5a3486e9d2471d668e2a86928550e.translatedText: Jada Graves, senior editor of U.S. News and World Report, said: "There are many people who choose to live at home and do not want to move into senior residences, and a large number of nursing assistants are needed to take care of them."

77d2a38516fc71fa6b5fa4cead561202f6421b72.sourceText: 格雷夫斯说，个人护理助手是医疗保健工作之一，技术上，他可能是照顾病人的助理，工作包括做饭，帮助病人穿衣，洗澡或带他们去看病。
77d2a38516fc71fa6b5fa4cead561202f6421b72.translatedText: Graves said that a personal care assistant is one of the health care jobs. Technically, he may be an assistant who cares for patients. His work includes cooking, helping patients dress, bathe or take them to see a doctor.

9a35911a764a9734037fbca7054eb402059bccfa.sourceText: 家庭健康助理也要参与照顾病人的医疗方面，并由护士监督。
9a35911a764a9734037fbca7054eb402059bccfa.translatedText: Home health aides are also involved in the medical aspects of caring for patients and are supervised by a nurse.

0e53c0560e477be2fbaaf4cb9e9001c4c254d9ec.sourceText: 除了助手的工作，也可能晋升到入门级的医疗助理或秘书等职务。
0e53c0560e477be2fbaaf4cb9e9001c4c254d9ec.translatedText: In addition to working as an assistant, you may also be promoted to entry-level medical assistant or secretary positions.

f97ddf67c4d1f957e552083dac4a715e069bf215.sourceText: 除了以上提及的就业机会，也有一些更快速途径加入的医疗保健工作。
f97ddf67c4d1f957e552083dac4a715e069bf215.translatedText: In addition to the employment opportunities mentioned above, there are also some faster ways to join healthcare jobs.

1f4f1d5298d696ce670174ca4a5102cb25a0d2bd.sourceText: 例如，成为一名按摩治疗师通常需要大约500小时的训练，只需要大约几个月的时间，可能需要获得州政府许可证。
1f4f1d5298d696ce670174ca4a5102cb25a0d2bd.translatedText: For example, becoming a massage therapist typically requires about 500 hours of training, takes only about a few months, and may require a state license.

4305b11c8a815387c86b36e977f9d1a86959b384.sourceText: 或是牙科助理，也是一个相当短时间的入职途径。
4305b11c8a815387c86b36e977f9d1a86959b384.translatedText: or dental assistant, is also a fairly short-term entry path.

1d26cff4497e77e3fc6fd4173282caa107cc7b98.sourceText: 根据劳工统计局的数据，有些州甚至没有正规的教育要求。
1d26cff4497e77e3fc6fd4173282caa107cc7b98.translatedText: Some states don’t even have formal education requirements, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

46a548d30db48080df8392b97e08593458d8a725.sourceText: 另一种选择是成为紧急医疗技术员，提供的培训不到半年。
46a548d30db48080df8392b97e08593458d8a725.translatedText: Another option is to become an emergency medical technician, which provides training in less than half a year.

889372be9e414dd840ca838820da72e702c3f305.sourceText: 切尔说，或是可以成为抽血护士，参加大约一年的培训。
889372be9e414dd840ca838820da72e702c3f305.translatedText: Chel said that you can become a phlebotomy nurse and take about a year of training.

62d6b2f07c51fe22681b3e2d2a611a2f7e3572c5.sourceText: 几乎所有工作培训只需要两年或更短的时间，如果愿意投入时间，金钱和精力，可以赚取相对的回报。
62d6b2f07c51fe22681b3e2d2a611a2f7e3572c5.translatedText: Almost all job training only takes two years or less, and if you are willing to invest time, money and energy, you can earn a relative return.

3a2dacb215664221a823598d10aefef3b44a182d.sourceText: 但是，切尔指出，有一些路径也是漫长而曲折的。
3a2dacb215664221a823598d10aefef3b44a182d.translatedText: But, Chel points out, some paths are also long and winding.

29118434fa70d564d166c35bebce435d8a3e6cf1.sourceText: 例如，想要从药店技术员成为药剂师，必须要获得博士学位。
29118434fa70d564d166c35bebce435d8a3e6cf1.translatedText: For example, if you want to become a pharmacist from a pharmacy technician, you must obtain a doctorate.

3027c33b089d00fbb49607657a77a4b9a621cbe9.sourceText: 同样地，想要从助理成为物理治疗师或职业治疗师，必须要有硕士学位的要求。
3027c33b089d00fbb49607657a77a4b9a621cbe9.translatedText: Similarly, if you want to become a physical therapist or occupational therapist from an assistant, you must have a master's degree.

0acb98393ee1ac364d7a649e9daf76a9bbbc3eee.sourceText: 切尔说：”一般常见的是先成为合格的护士助理，再回到学校进修，成为一名註册护士。”
0acb98393ee1ac364d7a649e9daf76a9bbbc3eee.translatedText: Chel said: "It is generally common to become a qualified nursing assistant first, and then go back to school for further studies to become a registered nurse."

935c0673755eda28e50fad6c0ee171f9f281978b.sourceText: 如果理科成绩不好，也可以考虑成为一名医疗助理或秘书。
935c0673755eda28e50fad6c0ee171f9f281978b.translatedText: If you do not do well in science, you can also consider becoming a medical assistant or secretary.

d98243e0ac14b0df82179a4dd88bb7bef223c57a.sourceText: 切尔说，虽然需要学习有关的医学术语，特别是要转录或开会时，但是，它可能只是一种新的语言。
d98243e0ac14b0df82179a4dd88bb7bef223c57a.translatedText: While there is a need to learn relevant medical terminology, especially when transcribing or attending meetings, it may just be a new language, Chell said.

b7a31963c90485617cf418907f86dcfa6f2eff3d.sourceText: 这项工作更趋向于文书工作，像是管理日程安排，确认会议，问候病人等任务。
b7a31963c90485617cf418907f86dcfa6f2eff3d.translatedText: This job tends to be more clerical, such as managing schedules, confirming meetings, greeting patients and other tasks.

d4162ed14e58574a423f5e9fbff68836d8429157.sourceText: 再者，年轻人也可以考虑成为一个医疗设备维修员，主要是研究或维修医疗机器，而不是患者本身，因此，工程或技术技能更为重要。
d4162ed14e58574a423f5e9fbff68836d8429157.translatedText: Furthermore, young people can also consider becoming a medical equipment repairman, which mainly studies or repairs medical machines rather than the patients themselves. Therefore, engineering or technical skills are more important.

bde35c2a2b121f5c87bb71c1af4f48689b5902ca.sourceText: 一元初始，万象更新。庚子年的的大年初一，恰逢周六，亚省中文学校如期举行了一年一度的新春游园活动。上午九点，位于亚利桑那州立大学主校区的亚省现代中文学校早已装扮一新。一楼中庭中，张灯结彩、喜气洋洋，为孩子们准备的具有浓浓国学元素的活动摊位也早已到位。随着学生和家长们的不断到来，活动气氛逐渐热烈起来。
bde35c2a2b121f5c87bb71c1af4f48689b5902ca.translatedText: One dollar begins, and everything is renewed. The first day of the Lunar New Year of the Year of Gengzi falls on Saturday, and the Chinese School of Alberta held its annual New Year's garden outing as scheduled. At nine o'clock in the morning, the Alberta Modern Chinese School located on the main campus of Arizona State University has already been decorated. The atrium on the first floor was decorated with lanterns and colorful decorations, and the activity stalls with strong Chinese elements for the children were already in place. With the continuous arrival of students and parents, the atmosphere of the event gradually became lively.

070cc0cf88f24e0294bb01f4c22508b796c80e86.sourceText: 上午九点半开始，作为亚省现代中文学校的新春传统项目，在二楼的学校办公室，由董事长陶世诚和校长杨轶伦带领校董会和校委会的部分成员，一起参加了每年的新春团拜仪式。各中文班的孩子们在老师们的带领下，身着喜庆的节日盛装，用孩子独特而有创意的新春贺词，向大家送上了新年祝福。董事长和校长则为孩子们送上了红包和有中国特色的小礼包，祝福孩子们在新的一年里身体健康、学业进步。
070cc0cf88f24e0294bb01f4c22508b796c80e86.translatedText: Starting at 9:30 am, as a traditional Chinese New Year project of the Alberta Modern Chinese School, in the school office on the second floor, Chairman Tao Shicheng and Principal Yang Yilun led some members of the school board and school committee to participate in the annual New Year reunion ceremony. Under the leadership of their teachers, the children in each Chinese class dressed in festive holiday costumes and sent New Year blessings to everyone with their unique and creative New Year greetings. The chairman and principal gave red envelopes and small gift bags with Chinese characteristics to the children, wishing them good health and academic progress in the new year.

c80b8dd64cba0665111eb045e27f9ac36bacb71d.sourceText: 今年，由于受到突发事件的影响，活动参加人数不如往年，活动现场依然热闹熙攘。孩子们身着大红色的中式洋装，兴高采烈地参加着剪纸、拼汉字、猜灯谜等活动。一如以往，学校为参加活动的孩子们准备了大量的小奖品和小礼品。而亚省华人社团的精彩表演，更将整个新春游园活动喜庆吉祥的节日气氛推向了高潮。
c80b8dd64cba0665111eb045e27f9ac36bacb71d.translatedText: This year, due to the impact of emergencies, the number of participants in the event was not as good as in previous years, but the event site was still bustling. The children, dressed in bright red Chinese-style dresses, happily participated in activities such as paper-cutting, spelling Chinese characters, and guessing lantern riddles. As always, the school prepared a large number of small prizes and gifts for the children who participated in the event. The wonderful performance of the Chinese community in Alberta pushed the festive and auspicious atmosphere of the entire New Year garden activity to a climax.

ed09a6a6c2a5c03664d4d1d3a03737b3da493c1b.sourceText: 新春游园活动作为亚省现代中文学校的重要传统活动之一，不仅为华人社区提供了温暖的传统中国家庭式的温馨氛围，更为非华裔族群的人们提供了学习中华文化、习俗和传统的机会，提高了华人社群在整个社会中的认知度和亲和力。值此新春佳节，让我们一起祝福亚省现代中文学校，在新的一年中将华语和中华文化的教育传播得更加红火。
ed09a6a6c2a5c03664d4d1d3a03737b3da493c1b.translatedText: > As one of the important traditional activities of modern Chinese schools in Alberta, the New Year garden outing not only provides the Chinese community with a warm traditional Chinese family atmosphere, but also provides people of non-Chinese ethnic groups with opportunities to learn Chinese culture, customs and traditions, and improves the awareness and affinity of the Chinese community in the entire society. On the occasion of the Chinese New Year, let us wish the Modern Chinese School of Alberta to spread the education of Chinese language and Chinese culture even more prosperously in the new year.

01b611feb6795d43c9e698864c1711f8c2362217.sourceText: “世界环境日”香港举办多彩活动倡环保 ６月５日是一年一度的”世界环境日”。香港环境保护运动委员会当天举办多项活动向市民推广环保意识，呼吁各界合力对抗气候变化。 当天上午，旨在鼓励市民实践低碳生活的”低碳短片ｆｕｎ享比赛”在香港文化中心露天广场举行颁奖礼。此项比赛自２月开展以来，共收到约８０份参赛短片。大会还邀请曾参与南极探险的大学生发表演讲，剖析气候变化带来的威胁，并鼓励青年人身体力行推动环保。 特区政府环境局常任秘书长兼环境保护署署长王倩仪出席该活动时表示，低碳生活可以很简单，只要每人跨出一小步，在生活细节上稍作改变，便可以减少碳排放，为改善环境作出贡献，市民更可将这个概念推广给家人和朋友，为把香港建成一个更绿色、更低碳的城市而努力。 当天下午，一场以”世界环境日”为主题的讲座在香港科学馆举行。作为”全球暖化与气候异变”系列讲座之一，当天的活动邀请了多名环保人士，分别以”人与自然””环保建筑与都市生态”及”香港的生物多样性保育”等为题，与到场观众分享环保心得。
01b611feb6795d43c9e698864c1711f8c2362217.translatedText: "World Environment Day" Hong Kong holds colorful activities to promote environmental protection June 5 is the annual "World Environment Day". The Hong Kong Environmental Campaign Committee held a number of activities that day to promote environmental awareness among the public and called on all walks of life to join forces to fight climate change. On the morning of the same day, the "Low Carbon Short Film Fun Competition", which aims to encourage citizens to practice low-carbon life, held an award ceremony at the Hong Kong Cultural Center Piazza. Since the launch of this competition in February, a total of about 80 short films have been received. The conference also invited college students who have participated in Antarctic expeditions to give speeches to analyze the threats posed by climate change and encourage young people to take action to promote environmental protection. Permanent Secretary for the Environment Bureau and Director of Environmental Protection Department of the SAR Government, Ms Ong Sin-yee, attended the event and said that low-carbon life can be very simple. As long as everyone takes a small step and makes slight changes in the details of life, they can reduce carbon emissions and contribute to improving the environment. Citizens can also promote this concept to their family and friends and work hard to build Hong Kong into a greener and lower-carbon city. In the afternoon of that day, a lecture with the theme of "World Environment Day" was held at the Hong Kong Science Museum. As one of the series of lectures on "Global Warming and Climate Change", the day's event invited a number of environmentalists to share their environmental experiences with the audience on topics such as "Man and Nature", "Environmentally Friendly Buildings and Urban Ecology" and "Hong Kong's Biodiversity Conservation".

a6bbdc5c2d073ca1b2645617947f8ac45f538e24.sourceText: 凤凰城气如虹：十月庆典 今年双十国庆，是中华民国百年大典，刚满一世纪，从风雨飘摇中过来，特别值得珍惜，在台北的政府所在首都，举行隆重庆祝大会，现任总统马英九亲临主持节目，海内外侨胞踊跃参与； 此间凤凰城侨界也组织庞大团体赴约，庆祝完毕还转往越南旅游，真个热闹与尽兴！ 我九月从越南返回凤凰​​城，有不少朋友以为我赶着参加十月庆典，由于阳历十月，盛大节日比较多，难怪有此联想。 而我及时能够参与双十国庆精彩百年，纯粹是适逢其会。 不过，自已真的也有十月庆典，那是接到凤凰城华人耆英会邮寄来的红色邀请函：「您好！本月是您的生日月，我会订于十月七日星期五上午十时 卅分，在本会举行寿星庆祝会厖」信函横批「祝生日快乐」，署名是耆英会主席崔增祁，中心理事长李开泉。 因此十月七日在耆英会的寿星庆祝会，我有份参加，当日由广东歌咏组负责助兴节目，合唱祝生日歌，人老声靓，音韵悠扬，让寿星们开怀。 跟着还有个别的独唱与对唱节目，我因为数月前在蔡戛亮「笑侃人生」晚宴曾客串演唱「笑看风云」，今回又叫我再来一曲，为了大家娱悦，也不好 推辞，让这个宴会，增加欢乐气氛。 说实话，我这时回来，与十月庆典无关，完全是处理家事，因为我的次子国风婚礼，已择吉于二○一一年十一月十一日星期五，在大凤凰城诗歌时代( Scottsdale)市，双轼天堂谷度假胜地(Doubletree Paradise Valley resort)，举行结婚典礼，宴请亲友，我要协助提前送呈请柬，阅览名册，以便安排喜宴事宜。 同时国风购置以备结婚的房屋，装潢修建完毕，象征性地庆祝新厦落成，邀请部份亲友光临参观，简餐招待，做父母的也忙碌一番。 如果把这些活动算在十月庆典内，未尝不可。 话说回来，真正十月庆典，最易让华人提起的，最受重视的，当然是十月十日的中华民国双十节，那是国父孙中山领导的辛亥革命，成功推翻满清帝制，建立亚洲第一个 民主政体，双十国庆，传扬世界，至今届满一百年，值得欢呼，值得庆贺，值得铭记。 另一个让华人高兴的是十月一日，中华人民共和国国庆。 在以往冷战年代，美苏两大阵营对抗，反共声势强劲，海外华人不会庆祝这个日子；但时移势易，今时不同往日，中共实际已放弃无产阶级专政，不嚷工人当家作主，选择 地方建设所谓「经济特区」，正是如假包换的资本主义经营，如此使到国家与人民日益富强起来，国际地位提升，由反抗、不承认转为建立邦交，在联合国还取代了正统的中华 民国位置。 于是，以前「投奔自由」的义士，过去「反共联盟」的斗士，高举青天白日满地红旗帜的社团，如今看风驶艃，纷纷竖起五星红旗，迎风飘扬，高呼「中华人民共和国万岁」 ！ 站在中华民国的立场来说，十月除了双十国庆大典之外，还有十月廿一日的华侨节，是华侨自己的节日。 越南华人在一九七五年之前都有组织庆祝，共产统一后就取消了。 我定居在凤凰城十四年，似乎不见庆祝；加州洛杉矶则仍看见侨团组织大会，今年应该是第五十九届了。 阳历的十月，通常是农历的八、九月间，所以会遇到民间习俗的两大节日，中秋节和重阳节；二○○九年的十月份就先后庆祝中秋团圆和重九登高，去年和 今年只遇上重阳佳节，广东有部份乡村习俗把登高山改为拜山坟，和清明节一般去扫墓，并称为春秋二祭。 重阳节也有人称为敬老节，尊敬长者，而联合国在一九九一年开始，订定十月一日为国际老人日，在这一天希望大家记得老人的存在，尊重银发一族，不过近年来我们华人 在这天忙着庆祝中华人民共和国国庆，国内忙着黄金周假期旅游，国外则忙着筹组国庆，国际老人日就常被忽视。 十月庆典，除了中国的，外国也有，美国有哥伦布日，有万圣节；加拿大的感恩节在十月，过去共产党人提到最多是苏俄的十月革命，当年越南共和国庆也曾是十月廿六，听 说德国近年在十月三日庆祝统一，厖?#24403;然还有更多，只是我们没有留意罢了。 十月十月，真正十月多庆典啊！
a6bbdc5c2d073ca1b2645617947f8ac45f538e24.translatedText: Phoenix City is full of energy: October Celebration. This year’s Double Ten National Day is the 100th anniversary of the Republic of China. It has just turned one century and has come through the ups and downs. It is especially worth cherishing. A grand celebration was held in the capital of Taipei, where the government is located. Current President Ma Ying-jeou came to host the program, and overseas Chinese at home and abroad actively participated. The overseas Chinese community in Phoenix also organized a large group to attend the appointment. After the celebration, they went to Vietnam. It was really lively and enjoyable! I returned to Phoenix from Vietnam in September, and many of my friends thought I was rushing to attend the October celebrations. Since there are many grand festivals in October of the Gregorian calendar, it is no wonder that they made this association. And I was able to participate in the wonderful centenary celebrations of the Double Ten National Day just in time, just by chance. However, I do have an October celebration. I received a red invitation letter from the Phoenix Chinese Senior Citizens Association: "Hello! This month is your birthday month. I will hold a birthday celebration party at our association on Friday, October 7 at 10:30 am." The letter read "Happy Birthday" across the letter, and was signed by Cui Zengqi, chairman of the Senior Citizens Association, and Li Kaiquan, chairman of the center. Therefore, I participated in the birthday celebration at the Senior Citizens Association on October 7. On that day, the Guangdong Singing Group was in charge of the entertainment program. They sang a birthday song with beautiful old voices and melodious music, which made the birthday stars happy. There will also be separate solo and duet performances. Because I guest-sung "Laughing and Watching the Storm" at Cai Jialiang's "Laughing About Life" dinner a few months ago, I was asked to perform one more song this time. For the sake of everyone's entertainment, I couldn't refuse and let this banquet add to the joyful atmosphere. To be honest, my return at this time has nothing to do with the October celebrations, but is purely to deal with family matters, because my second son’s Chinese-style wedding has been chosen to be held on Friday, November 11, 2011, at the Doubletree Paradise Valley resort in Scottsdale, Greater Phoenix. The wedding ceremony will be held and a banquet will be held for relatives and friends. I will help send invitations in advance and read the roster in order to arrange the wedding banquet. At the same time, Guofeng purchased a house for the wedding and completed the decoration and construction. He symbolically celebrated the completion of the new building. He invited some relatives and friends to visit and entertained them with a simple meal. The parents were also busy. It would not be a bad idea if these activities were included in the October celebrations. Having said that, among the real October celebrations, the one that is most easily mentioned by the Chinese and the one that takes the most attention is of course the Double Ten Day of the Republic of China on October 10. It was the Revolution of 1911 led by the founding father Sun Yat-sen, which successfully overthrew the Manchu Empire and established the first democratic government in Asia. The Double Ten National Day has spread to the world. It has been celebrating a hundred years now. It is worth cheering, celebrating and remembering. Another thing that makes the Chinese happy is October 1st, the National Day of the People's Republic of China. In the past Cold War years, when the two major camps of the United States and the Soviet Union were at odds with each other and the anti-communist sentiment was strong, overseas Chinese would not celebrate this day. However, times have changed, and today is different from the past. The CCP has actually given up the dictatorship of the proletariat, no longer calls for workers to be the masters of the country, and has chosen local areas to build so-called "special economic zones." Republic of China location. Therefore, in the past, the martyrs who "descended to freedom", the fighters of the "Anti-Communist Alliance" in the past, and the associations that held high the red flags of the blue sky and white sun on the ground, now see the wind blowing, and they have erected five-star red flags, fluttering in the wind, and shouting "Long live the People's Republic of China"! From the perspective of the Republic of China, in addition to the National Day Ceremony on October 21st, there is also the Overseas Chinese Festival on October 21st, which is the overseas Chinese's own festival. The Chinese in Vietnam had organized celebrations before 1975, but they were canceled after the reunification of the Communist Party. I have lived in Phoenix for fourteen years, but there seems to be no celebration; in Los Angeles, California, I still see the overseas Chinese organization conference, which should be the 59th this year. The tenth month of the Gregorian calendar usually falls between the eighth and ninth months of the lunar calendar, so it encounters two major festivals in folk customs, the Mid-Autumn Festival and the Double Ninth Festival. In October 2009, the Mid-Autumn Festival reunion and the Double Ninth Festival were celebrated successively. Last year and this year, only the Double Ninth Festival was celebrated. Some rural customs in Guangdong changed mountain climbing to visiting mountain tombs, and sweeping tombs in the same way as Qingming Festival, which is called the Spring and Autumn Festival. The Double Ninth Festival is also called the Respect for the Elderly Day, which means respecting the elderly. Since 1991, the United Nations has designated October 1st as the International Day for the Elderly. On this day, we hope that everyone will remember the existence of the elderly and respect the silver-haired people. However, in recent years, we Chinese have been busy celebrating the National Day of the People's Republic of China on this day. The country is busy traveling during the Golden Week holiday, and foreign countries are busy organizing National Day, so the International Day for the Elderly is often ignored. October celebrations are not only held in China, but also in foreign countries. The United States has Columbus Day and Halloween; Canada's Thanksgiving Day is in October. In the past, communists mentioned the October Revolution in Soviet Russia most often. The Republic of Vietnam's Day was also held on October 26th. I heard that Germany celebrated its reunification on October 3rd in recent years. Of course there are more, but we just didn't pay attention. October is October, October is truly full of celebrations!

5455397991737dc2899731be7974673fce6028cf.translatedText: The Governor of Arizona declares May as Asian Heritage Month in Alberta Arizona Governor Doug Ducey declares May every year starting in 2018 as Asian Heritage Month...

caf3174f58c3c42bb46f0f6a8c4b9b2672db2cda.sourceText: 亚利桑那州州长Doug Ducey宣布2018年开始每年5月为亚裔传统月。州长指出亚裔美国人为美国今日的成就做出了伟大贡献。很多移民在19世纪来到美国，在农业和交通行业工作，带来多元文化，多种语言，甚至宗教。亚裔美国人呼唤和平与自由，成为目前增长最快的族裔之一。在今年五月，一起来庆祝我们自己的活动。
caf3174f58c3c42bb46f0f6a8c4b9b2672db2cda.translatedText: Governor Doug Ducey declares May every year starting in 2018 as Asian Heritage Month. The governor noted that Asian Americans have made great contributions to what America is today. Many immigrants came to the United States in the 19th century to work in agriculture and transportation, bringing with them multiculturalism, multiple languages, and even religions. Asian Americans call for peace and freedom and have become one of the fastest-growing ethnic groups. This May, let’s celebrate our own.

213b53a6d5e94f334504bd54894ccf1b09a30566.sourceText: 今天的亚省人物，让我们一同来认识一位来自亚利桑那州的美国散打国家代表队队员潘洋。
213b53a6d5e94f334504bd54894ccf1b09a30566.translatedText: Today’s people in Alberta, let’s get to know Pan Yang, a member of the U.S. Sanda National Team from Arizona.

e109d5364cc379ff1e735ff1039961cae1a0347f.sourceText: 潘洋，美国散打国家代表队队员。24岁才开始学习散打，可是就在短短几年的学习中，他就获得了全美散打第三的好成绩。记者见到潘阳时，他正在为第11届泛美武术锦标赛筹款而四处忙碌。
e109d5364cc379ff1e735ff1039961cae1a0347f.translatedText: >Pan Yang, a member of the American Sanda National Team. He only started to learn Sanda at the age of 24, but in just a few years of study, he achieved the third place in Sanda in the United States. When the reporter met Pan Yang, he was busy raising money for the 11th Pan American Martial Arts Championships.

f175c6fb37871c321b7a24a355f6d3d73582d52b.sourceText: 第11届泛美武术锦标赛，全美少年组锦标赛，美洲锦标赛将于2016年8月11日-14日在德克萨斯州Lubbock举行。泛美武术锦标赛是武术界最高水平的国际赛事之一，仅次于世界武术锦标赛。
f175c6fb37871c321b7a24a355f6d3d73582d52b.translatedText: The 11th Pan American Martial Arts Championships, National Junior Championships, and Americas Championships will be held in Lubbock, Texas from August 11th to 14th, 2016. The Pan American Martial Arts Championships are one of the highest level international events in the martial arts world, second only to the World Martial Arts Championships.

7f15c50de78099d27aa3bab38ff8c41eb6e50d07.sourceText: 身为美国散打国家代表队队员的潘洋师从美国散打总教练李忆元。因为从事散打的特殊经历，在中国留学生在凤凰城轻轨上被打事件发生后，他不仅宣扬中国的武术文化，更是受亚利桑那亚裔枪会的邀请，给亚裔朋友讲个人安全防护。
7f15c50de78099d27aa3bab38ff8c41eb6e50d07.translatedText: As a member of the U.S. Sanda National Team, Pan Yang studied under U.S. Sanda head coach Li Yiyuan. Because of his special experience in Sanda, after the Chinese student was beaten on the Phoenix light rail, he not only promoted Chinese martial arts culture, but was also invited by the Arizona Asian Gun Club to teach Asian friends about personal safety protection.

dad3c7b1cf5a800237dd0a657dfa2c754cd39ce7.sourceText: 因为亚裔经济条件好，不太愿意报警，也不愿意反抗，亚裔经常成为犯罪分子袭击的对象。作为散打专业人员，在讲解个人安全防护的时候，潘洋却没有大力宣传如何去打，反而是告诉大家如何去躲，怎样最快速度的离开犯罪现场。他说当被多人袭击的时候，尽量找墙角，然后找到一个人作为突破口，击倒后，迅速逃离。当与别人发生口角的时候，不要握紧拳头，因为这样会撩起对方袭击的欲望，放松，打开手掌，一方面表示自己没有恶意，另一方面把打开的手放到握拳就能袭击的位置，或者马上就能护头的位置。寻找一切机会离开，不造成身体碰撞和摩擦。不用逞能，逃离现场是最佳方案。
dad3c7b1cf5a800237dd0a657dfa2c754cd39ce7.translatedText: Because Asians have better economic conditions and are less willing to call the police or resist, Asians are often targeted by criminals. As a Sanda professional, when explaining personal safety protection, Pan Yang did not vigorously promote how to fight. Instead, he told everyone how to hide and how to leave the crime scene as quickly as possible. He said that when being attacked by multiple people, try to find a corner, then find one person as a breakthrough point, knock him down, and escape quickly. When you have an argument with someone, don't clench your fists, because this will arouse the other person's desire to attack. Relax and open your palms. On the one hand, you show that you have no malice. On the other hand, put your open hand in a position where you can attack with a fist, or where you can protect your head immediately. Look for every opportunity to leave without causing physical collision or friction. No need to show off, fleeing the scene is the best option.

e744d1366ce1e3f7cdd8c9b1b7d2f9e65712e447.sourceText: 散打和武术是潘阳的爱好。他不仅教授散打，同时他也关注运动健康。他也正在与中医，艺术学校等洽谈运动健康和塑形计划。让每个人都有一个健美的身材。他打算开设减肥塑形课程。希望更多的朋友通过散打和武术获得健康和美丽。
e744d1366ce1e3f7cdd8c9b1b7d2f9e65712e447.translatedText: Sanda and martial arts are Pan Yang's hobbies. He not only teaches Sanda, but he also pays attention to sports health. He is also negotiating with Chinese medicine practitioners, art schools, etc. for sports health and body shaping plans. Let everyone have a fit body. He plans to offer weight loss and body shaping classes. I hope more friends can gain health and beauty through Sanda and martial arts.

915b3343070e812be04f5b62d888763191638a19.translatedText: > The Chinese Chamber of Commerce held the last spring banquet. The Alberta Times. Farewell to the old and welcome the new, the last spring banquet of the Year of the Rabbit in Phoenix was held at 6:30 pm on April 16 at Luk Fook Wine...

6a823e2d841cd058a01911e8a836f8605c62de3a.sourceText: 中华商会举办最后一场春宴 亞省時報 辭舊迎新，鳳凰城兔年最後一場春宴於 4月16日晚6時 30分，在六福酒家舉行。亞利桑那中華商會宴請20桌嘉賓，共同度過了一個令人難忘的夜晚。與其他春宴不同的是當日來了很多當地的政要，其中包括華人眾議院議員余艷芬夫婦，前眾議院黃仕鈞，以及很多西人政要和朋友，僑聯主席鄧朝駒，僑務委員高志中，同源會主席鄧賀錚等當地華人僑領也到現場共同慶賀。 醒獅起舞拜年彩青，帶動了春宴的歡樂吉慶氣氛，首先由中華商會主席鄧艷玲致詞，她代表中華商會向光臨今晚宴會的嘉賓和各位友好人士表示熱烈的歡迎和衷心感謝。在過去的一年，商會的會員共同交流為華人商業的發展創造了很好的環境，借這個辭舊迎新的日子，商會同仁以及各位朋友大家聚在一起交流情感，為創造更多的商機而努力。當晚，中華商會為 7個會員的孩子準備了獎學金，還為現場嘉賓準備了很多抽獎大禮品：有中國傳統的工藝品，也有實用的生活器具及電器。最大的獎項是一台超大屏幕的電視機。很多西人朋友對中國瓷器特別有興趣，一位搖獎得到中國古瓷瓶的女士，非常的激動說這個禮物太漂亮了，很喜歡，會是今晚回家給家人的驚喜。 晚上十時已近，但場面吉慶氣氛甚濃，親友互相寄以美好新年祝愿，春宴晚會在一片喜氣洋洋，吉慶滿堂的歡樂中迎春接福。
6a823e2d841cd058a01911e8a836f8605c62de3a.translatedText: > The Chinese Chamber of Commerce held the last spring banquet. Alberta Times. Farewell to the old and welcome the new, the last spring banquet of the Year of the Rabbit in Phoenix was held at Luk Fook Wine...<<<CA_ZH_SPLIT>> It will be held at 6:30 pm on April 16th at Luk Fook Restaurant. The Arizona Chinese Chamber of Commerce hosted a banquet for 20 guests and spent an unforgettable evening together. Different from other spring banquets, many local dignitaries came on that day, including Chinese House of Representatives member Yu Yanfen and his wife, former House of Representatives Huang Shijun, as well as many Western dignitaries and friends, including Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Deng Chaoju, Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee member Gao Zhizhong, Chairman of the Tongtong Association Deng Hezheng and other local Chinese leaders also came to celebrate together. The lion dance and New Year's greetings brought the happy and auspicious atmosphere of the Spring Banquet. First, Deng Yanling, chairman of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, delivered a speech. On behalf of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, she expressed warm welcome and heartfelt thanks to the guests and friendly people who came to tonight's banquet. In the past year, the members of the Chamber of Commerce have communicated together to create a good environment for the development of Chinese business. On this day of saying goodbye to the old and welcoming the new, colleagues of the Chamber of Commerce and friends gathered together to exchange emotions and work hard to create more business opportunities. That night, the Chinese Chamber of Commerce prepared scholarships for the children of seven members, and also prepared many lucky draw gifts for the guests: traditional Chinese handicrafts, practical household appliances and electrical appliances. The biggest prize is a large-screen television. Many Western friends are particularly interested in Chinese porcelain. A lady who won an ancient Chinese porcelain vase in a lottery was very excited and said that the gift was so beautiful and she liked it very much. It would be a surprise for her family when she went home tonight. It was almost ten o'clock in the evening, but the atmosphere was very auspicious and festive. Relatives and friends sent each other good New Year wishes. The Spring Banquet was filled with joy and auspiciousness to welcome the spring and bring blessings.

aa1fcee063df97bdea7249f7d148fcbc1da25876.sourceText: 亚利桑那“和平颂”大型音乐晚会 为了颂扬世界和平，加强我们华人与其他各族裔间的团结交流，美中文化艺术交流协…
aa1fcee063df97bdea7249f7d148fcbc1da25876.translatedText: Arizona "Ode to Peace" Large Music Gala In order to praise world peace and strengthen the unity and exchanges between the Chinese and other ethnic groups, the U.S.-China Cultural and Art Exchange Association...

1bded2305bd7ebffafa86e4da545658461c5a8c0.sourceText: 为了颂扬世界和平，加强我们华人与其他各族裔间的团结交流，美中文化艺术交流协会积极倡导发起，将在2013年9月15日，在钱德勒市艺术中心举行一场由各族裔社团共同合作，有各族裔合唱团及艺术家联合参与的大型音乐晚会。音乐会将以中华着名合唱作品为主，同时也演唱美国以及其他各国各民族的爱国歌曲，生活及爱情歌曲，并伴有舞蹈和器乐演奏。这将是一台由华人社团和其他族裔社团及艺术家们联合演出的大型音乐会，同时也是一次本地各族裔间一同欢聚，一同庆祝的大典礼。
1bded2305bd7ebffafa86e4da545658461c5a8c0.translatedText: In order to praise world peace and strengthen the unity and exchanges between the Chinese and other ethnic groups, the U.S.-China Cultural and Art Exchange Association actively advocates and launches a large-scale music evening to be held at the Chandler City Art Center on September 15, 2013, with the cooperation of various ethnic groups and the participation of choirs and artists of all ethnic groups. The concert will feature famous Chinese choral works, as well as patriotic songs, life and love songs from the United States and other countries and various ethnic groups, accompanied by dance and instrumental music. This will be a large-scale concert jointly performed by Chinese groups and other ethnic groups and artists. It will also be a grand ceremony for local ethnic groups to gather and celebrate together.

d4ea7e3dcf299beaa08b383e0875b6bf2a4f3cf4.sourceText: 为了搞好这次活动，美中文化艺术交流协会诚挚地邀请凤凰城地区各华人社团于5月12日，週日，下午2点正，在钱德勒市中心公共图书馆Copper厅, 召开此次音乐会活动的筹备会。希望各华人社团都能积极参加，出谋划策，集思广益。
d4ea7e3dcf299beaa08b383e0875b6bf2a4f3cf4.translatedText: In order to make this event a success, the US-China Cultural and Art Exchange Association sincerely invites Chinese associations in the Phoenix area to hold a preparatory meeting for this concert event on Sunday, May 12th, at 2:00 pm, in the Copper Hall of the Chandler City Center Public Library. It is hoped that all Chinese associations can actively participate, make suggestions and brainstorm.

d1c9de469a48492fed994a41c6740cd76576134d.sourceText: 我们相信，通过这次活动，不仅可以展示我们华人的经典音乐作品，高尚的音乐及艺术能力和修养。同时，也向世人再次宣告我们华人爱好和平，崇尚友谊，坚持团结的胸怀。这对于提高我们华人的形象和影响力，加强我们华人与各族裔间的交流和友谊都有很重要的意义。让我们携手并肩，共同努力，使这次活动圆满成功。美中文化艺术交流协会咨询网络地址 www.acacx.com 和 www.facebook.com/acacxorg
d1c9de469a48492fed994a41c6740cd76576134d.translatedText: We believe that through this event, we can not only showcase our Chinese classic music works, but also our noble musical and artistic abilities and accomplishments. At the same time, it also declares to the world once again that we Chinese love peace, advocate friendship, and insist on unity. This is of great significance to improving the image and influence of the Chinese people and strengthening the exchanges and friendship between the Chinese people and various ethnic groups. Let us join hands and work together to make this event a complete success. American Chinese Arts & Culture Exchange Association consultation network address www.acacx.com and www.facebook.com/acacxorg

26f744f5e167bfaeaceff5515a89cfdbbb1aea99.sourceText: 反移民法再挫败 巡迴法院驳回上訴 加州聯邦上訴法院週一駁回亞利桑那州州長提出的上訴，拒絕取消暫時禁止執行亞省在去年四月通過的反非法移民法律。聯邦司法部控告亞省，認為侵犯了聯邦政府執行移民法的權力。一名本州聯邦法官去年下達禁止執行令，直到最高法院做出裁決。 州聯邦第九巡迴上訴法庭的法官週一以2比1的票數，拒絕了州長佈魯爾提出的上訴要求。布魯爾要求上訴法庭取消鳳凰城一聯邦法官在去年下達的停止執行反非法移民法的禁止令。該法律原本應該自去年7月29日起開始生效。 司法部正與州政府進行訴訟，指控本州違反美國憲法，侵犯了聯邦政府執行移民法的權力。布魯爾的律師團表示，長久以來聯邦政府並未認真執行移民法，本州的法律是協助聯邦執法。
26f744f5e167bfaeaceff5515a89cfdbbb1aea99.translatedText: Another setback for anti-immigration law, a circuit court dismissed its appeal. The federal appeals court in California on Monday dismissed an appeal filed by the governor of Arizona, refusing to lift a temporary ban on enforcement of the anti-illegal immigration law passed by the province last April. The federal Department of Justice sued the province, arguing it violated the federal government's power to enforce immigration laws. An in-state federal judge last year issued a restraining order until the Supreme Court rules. Judges on the state's Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals voted 2-1 on Monday to deny Governor Brewer's request to appeal. Brewer asked the appeals court to lift an injunction issued last year by a federal judge in Phoenix that halted enforcement of anti-illegal immigration laws. The law was supposed to take effect on July 29 last year. The Justice Department is in litigation with the state, accusing the state of violating the U.S. Constitution and infringing on the federal government's authority to enforce immigration laws. Brewer's legal team said that the federal government has not seriously enforced immigration laws for a long time, and the state's laws are to assist federal law enforcement.

87755c406b6f93b4bc031d6a446556ef75c7d8e9.sourceText: 全国都跌 亚省油价涨 亚省汽车协会官员表示，亚利桑那州无铅普通汽油上周平均价格为每加仑3.08美元，比前一周涨了4美分。 上周，全美平均油价为3.29美元/加仑，比前一周跌了近2美分。 本 州平均油价最低的地区为图森，2.91/加仑，旗杆埠地区最高，3.26/加仑。 全国来看，犹他州油价最低，平均价格为2.38/加仑，纽约最高，3.73/加仑。
87755c406b6f93b4bc031d6a446556ef75c7d8e9.translatedText: Across the country, gas prices fell in Alberta. Officials with the Alberta Automobile Association said the average price of unleaded regular gasoline in Arizona last week was $3.08 per gallon, an increase of 4 cents from the previous week. Last week, the national average gas price was $3.29 per gallon, down nearly 2 cents from the previous week. The lowest average gas price in the state is in Tucson, at 2.91/gallon, and the highest in Flagstaff, at 3.26/gallon. Nationally, Utah has the lowest gas prices, with an average price of 2.38/gallon, and New York has the highest, at 3.73/gallon.

db31d3ae510b1fb31a5c623e953404066a69462c.translatedText: Editor's note: Because the area around the university is an area where young people gather, the security is not very good. Recently, a shooting occurred near Arizona State University. Many international students considered buying guns for their own safety. So what is the process of buying a gun in Arizona, and what should you pay attention to first? Please pay attention to the article below to see their personal experience.

9ceaf306da048af2d18112235e85a851fe92dddc.sourceText: 此篇文章为在亚利桑那购买手枪完整过程，本人为ASU研究生，F1签证，非移民。 首先强调，AZ买枪不需要公民身份或绿卡以及SSN，只需去沃尔玛买一张hunting license（我买的时候37刀，一年有效期）以及年龄达标（长枪18岁，手枪21岁）。 以下为买枪全过程: 1. 选枪： 首先选好自己想要的枪，我买的枪是cz-75 compact，为朋友推荐的，没买过其他手枪所以不做评价，只给出自己了解的一些参考意见。Glock很有名，可靠耐用，但个人感觉握把不舒服；Beretta 92FS：个人感觉最漂亮，但据说扳机较重（扳机的控制对精度影响很大）；sig p226:传说中的神枪，但较贵。其他的不清楚就不多说了。手枪也分大小，由大到小为full size，compact，sub compact。大的好控制，小的便携。 如果想体验射击可以到射击场（shooting range）租枪（也可以买枪，稍后提及），那里租枪不贵（一般：15$/小时 场地费，15 or 10$/小时 租枪费，护目镜及耳机小于5$,纸靶 1$左右/张），但子弹卖的贵（贵1倍以上），而且往往要求租的枪必须使用他们的子弹。以下是我去过的两个shooting range： Scottsdale Gun Club: 14860 N Northsight Blvd, Scottsdale, AZ 85260 Shooter`s world: 3828 N. 28th Ave Phoenix, AZ 85017 大家也可自行google 如果觉得挑枪麻烦不如就和我买一样的。 2. 网上订枪： 这里说一点，不一定要网上订枪，也可去店里买，但买枪时要签一些文件，大的商店顾客多，店员未必有耐心帮你。我所知道的比较大的户外用品商店有cabelas, sportsman warehouse, bass pro shops，离学校最近的地址分别为 bass pro shops：1133 N Dobson Rd，Mesa, AZ 85201 sportsman warehouse：Greenfield Gateway，1750 S Greenfield Rd，Mesa, AZ 85206 cabelas：9380 W Glendale AveGlendale, AZ 85305 关于网上订枪，shooting range往往都可以，我是在Shooter`s world上订的，网址： http://www.shootersworldonline.com/ 大家可以自己多google几家比比价格，比如 http://arizona-firearms.com/ http://www2.caswells.com/ http://sgcusa.com/ 选好直接下单付款即可。 3. 取枪： 如果你订的枪店里没货，他们会帮你订货，到货后会通知你去取。你需要带上驾照，护照，I-20，I-94（I-94获得方法 https://i94.cbp.dhs.gov/I94/request.html ）到店里签了协议，这之后还不能取走你的枪，他们会check你的背景，需要2天左右，check通过会通知你，这时就可以去店里取走枪了。 4. 子弹： 子弹的规格很多，常用为9mm luger，.40也较常见但后坐力会大些且弹夹容量小，较9mm贵，可以在上面提及的户外商店上买到，有的walmart也有卖。 关于手枪子弹种类分两大类：FMJ（Full metal jacket）和JHP（Jacketed Hollow Point），FMJ为常用的练习弹，便宜；JHP为中空弹，适合防身（停止作用好，弹头打入身体会开花，造成更大伤害），较贵。还有其他类型我不太清楚。按重量常分为115grains, 124grains, 147grains。115grains往往最便宜。关于品牌之间的区别我就了解不多了，往往店里卖的全金属的子弹都没问题。至于价格先在买过的最便宜为11$/50发,remington,在cabelas黑五当天买的，cabelas的子弹要往往比其他两个地方便宜。另外听说买的多可以更便宜，小伙伴们自己网上查查吧。购买子弹年龄为长枪子弹18岁，手枪子弹21岁
9ceaf306da048af2d18112235e85a851fe92dddc.translatedText: This article is the complete process of purchasing a handgun in Arizona. I am an ASU graduate student, F1 visa, non-immigrant. First of all, I would like to emphasize that you do not need citizenship, green card or SSN to buy a gun in AZ. You only need to go to Walmart to buy a hunting license ($37 when I bought it, valid for one year) and meet the age requirements (18 years old for long guns and 21 years old for pistols). The following is the whole process of buying a gun: 1. Choose a gun: First, choose the gun you want. The gun I bought is the cz-75 compact, which was recommended by a friend. I have never bought other pistols, so I will not make an evaluation. I will only give some reference opinions that I know. Glock is very famous, reliable and durable, but I personally feel that the grip is uncomfortable; Beretta 92FS: I personally feel the most beautiful, but it is said that the trigger is heavier (trigger control has a great impact on accuracy); sig p226: a legendary gun, but more expensive. I won’t say much else if I don’t know anything else. Pistols are also divided into sizes, from large to small, full size, compact, and sub compact. The big one is easy to control, the small one is portable. If you want to experience shooting, you can rent a gun at a shooting range (you can also buy a gun, mentioned later). Renting a gun there is not expensive (generally: 15$/hour venue fee, 15 or 10$/hour gun rental fee, goggles and headphones are less than 5$, paper targets are about 1$/piece), but the bullets are expensive (more than twice as expensive), and they often require that the rented gun must use their bullets. The following are two shooting ranges I have been to: Scottsdale Gun Club: 14860 N Northsight Blvd, Scottsdale, AZ 85260 Shooter`s world: 3828 N. 28th Ave Phoenix, AZ 85017 You can also google it yourself. If you find it troublesome to choose a gun, you might as well buy the same one as me. 2. Order a gun online: One point here is that you don’t have to order a gun online. You can also buy it in a store. However, you need to sign some documents when buying a gun. In large stores, there are many customers, and the clerk may not have the patience to help you. The larger outdoor stores I know include cabelas, sportsman warehouse, and bass pro shops. The addresses closest to the school are bass pro shops: 1133 N Dobson Rd, Mesa, AZ 85201 sportsman warehouse: Greenfield Gateway, 1750 S Greenfield Rd, Mesa, AZ 85206 cabelas: 9380 W Glendale AveGlendale, AZ 85305 About online gun ordering, shooting The range is usually available. I ordered it on Shooter`s world, the website is: http://www.shootersworldonline.com/ You can google several to compare prices, such as http://arizona-firearms.com/ http://www2.caswells.com/ http://sgcusa.com/ Just place the order and pay directly after choosing one. 3. Pick up the gun: If the gun you ordered is out of stock, they will order it for you and notify you to pick it up when it arrives. You need to bring your driver's license, passport, I-20, and I-94 (how to obtain I-94 https://i94.cbp.dhs.gov/I94/request.html) to the store to sign the agreement. After that, you cannot take away your gun. They will check your background. It will take about 2 days. If the check is passed, you will be notified. At this time, you can go to the store to pick up the gun. 4. Bullets: There are many specifications of bullets. 9mm luger is commonly used. .40 is also more common but has greater recoil and smaller magazine capacity. It is more expensive than 9mm. It can be bought at the outdoor stores mentioned above, and some Walmarts also sell it. There are two types of pistol bullets: FMJ (Full metal jacket) and JHP (Jacketed Hollow Point). FMJ is a commonly used practice bullet and is cheap; JHP is a hollow bullet suitable for self-defense (it has good stopping effect, and the warhead will bloom when it enters the body, causing more damage) and is more expensive. There are other types that I'm not sure about. According to weight, it is usually divided into 115grains, 124grains and 147grains. 115grains tends to be the cheapest. I don’t know much about the differences between brands. Usually the all-metal bullets sold in stores are fine. As for the price, the cheapest one I bought was 11$/50 rounds, Remington. I bought it on Black Friday at Cabelas. The bullets at Cabelas are often cheaper than the other two places. Also, I heard that the more you buy, the cheaper it will be. Friends, please check online. The age to buy bullets is 18 for long gun bullets and 21 for handgun bullets

5012bb2e42fe8c2a8635d5757279fbc894df4fa2.sourceText: 白天，拉斯維加斯华丽炫彩 广州 杨绮薇 上一篇博文裡寫到賭城拉斯維加斯的夜晚流光溢彩、精彩紛呈，本篇博文裡想說說，拉斯維加斯的白天一樣華麗炫彩、富貴奢華！ 拉斯維加斯(LasVegas)是加州沙漠腹地裡的一個小綠洲，西南距洛杉磯466公里。沙漠的干燥氣候使拉斯維加斯的白天的溫度高達70多度，天氣異常炎熱。但是，溫度再高也沒我們的熱情高，第二天一早，我們就把行李收拾好離開酒店，來到繁華的拉斯維加斯大道上包攬美景。一路上，挺拔偉岸的棕櫚樹、精雕細刻的雕塑群、造型各異的酒店建築、五花八門的大型展會和瓦藍的天空、雪白的雲朵組成了一幅極其美麗的景觀。街道上都是川流不息的車輛和摩肩接踵的遊人。我們夾在人流裡，徜徉在繁華的街道上，仔細觀賞著賭城白天的華麗妝容，鑑賞著那些風格獨特、異彩紛呈的華麗建築，深深陶醉在那些獨一無二的非凡藝術作品之中，流連再三，不捨離去。 我們下榻的巴黎酒店（Paris Las Vegas）位於拉斯維加斯大道上，是一家大型賭場酒店，由哈拉斯娛樂所持有及經營。酒店外仿造的艾菲爾鐵塔高達165米，是真正巴黎鐵塔的一半。還有凱旋門、歌劇院等建築，儼然一個縮小的巴黎。昨晚入住時我們沒看清其?#24300;山真面目?#65292;第二天才得以看清其全貌，當然各個角度拍照留念啦。 突然，眼前出現一抹夢幻飄逸的祖母綠色彩，原來是米高梅酒店外層的玻璃裝飾牆，那嬌嫩的祖母綠色彩玻璃幕牆把米高梅酒店裝飾得如同一個富麗堂皇的夢幻小城；接著，前方出現一個天藍色的金字塔造型，那是金字塔大酒店的建築主體，酒店內的佈置均按照古埃及胡夫金字塔的體例建造了獅身人面像，所有裝飾都是古埃及的韻味風情，就連服務員也穿著古埃及服裝，並可免費與遊人合影留念；而五顏六色的古城堡飯店又讓我們眼前一亮，酒店從外觀到房間擺設、娛樂設施，以至服務員的製服，都帶著濃郁的中世紀歐洲情調，讓人在迷宮一般的城堡房間中品味著童話世界的餘韻厖 據說，世界上最大型豪華的十家度假酒店就有九家設在拉斯維加斯！其中最大的一家就是米高梅大旅館及主題公園MGM Grand Adventure Hotel and Casino，有5005間房呢！陽光下的拉斯維加斯很豪氣很宏偉，每一個酒店都是一個特殊的景觀，酒店前所有的雕像都很形像很逼真，只是比例相對縮小而已，我覺得最具驚嚇係數的是，那凌空破牆而出的超大摩托車和碩大的過山車竟然穿行在建築物的屋頂之上。難怪有人說，拉斯維加斯是世界上最光怪陸離又絢麗多彩的夢幻之城。 如果說，拉斯維加斯是一個充滿誘惑的城市，我覺得一點也不過分。還在鳳凰城，甄先生就曾告訴過我，拉斯維加斯不但是賭博的天堂，還是結婚的聖地。對於情侶來說，結婚的誘惑絕不遜於賭博的誘惑。甄先生說，拉斯維加斯的結婚登記處就像拉斯維加斯的賭場一樣，不管刮風下雨，每天從早8點到夜間24點都開門接受登記，而且服務態度絕對一流。節假日更是24小時開張，不必預約，隨到隨登記。婚禮服務公司也比比皆是，甚至還有專門為舉辦婚禮設的教堂，牧師也隨時恭候。婚禮的檔次豐儉由人，既可以舉辦豪華盛大的婚禮，也可以在幾分鐘之內完成婚禮儀式。據統計，每年大約有100萬對來自世界各地的夫婦在拉斯維加斯登記結婚。 短短兩天的遊覽，讓我感受到，拉斯維加斯的夜晚五光十色、紙醉金迷，而拉斯維加斯的白天，則陽光燦爛、熱情四射，”金融海嘯”好像對拉斯維加斯沒有影響，一些高大的酒店建築照常施工，所有賭場24小時營業，商店顧客盈門，晚上全城燈火輝煌，白天遊人如織。拉斯維加斯這個沙漠中崛起的海市蜃樓，她的美麗與奢華、她的存在與夢幻，都遠遠超出我的想像。我更喜歡陽光下的拉斯維加斯，她展露在我面前的完全是另外一種姿態，另外一種風情。你看，自由女神像、倫敦橋、埃及金字塔、不同風格的教堂，一個有許多彩色洋蔥頭式圓頂的酒店，猶如童話故事裡的城堡在我們面前展現厖這些都讓我對拉斯維加斯的好感漸增，原來，拉斯維加斯除了”賭”之外，還有很多其他內涵。我想，這大概是那麼多不好賭的遊客都愛到拉斯維加斯來的原因吧。
5012bb2e42fe8c2a8635d5757279fbc894df4fa2.translatedText: During the day, Las Vegas is gorgeous and colorful Guangzhou Yang Qiwei In the previous blog post, I wrote that the night in the casino city of Las Vegas is sparkling and colorful. In this blog post, I want to say that Las Vegas is just as gorgeous, colorful, rich and luxurious during the day! Las Vegas is a small oasis in the hinterland of the California desert, 466 kilometers southwest of Los Angeles. The dry climate of the desert makes the daytime temperature in Las Vegas reach more than 70 degrees, making the weather extremely hot. However, no matter how high the temperature was, we were not as enthusiastic as we were. Early the next morning, we packed up our luggage and left the hotel, heading to the bustling Las Vegas Strip to take in the beautiful scenery. Along the way, tall palm trees, intricately carved sculptures, hotel buildings of various shapes, various large-scale exhibitions, and the blue sky and snow-white clouds form an extremely beautiful landscape. The streets are full of vehicles and tourists. We were caught in the flow of people, wandering on the bustling streets, carefully watching the gorgeous makeup of the casino during the day, appreciating the unique and colorful buildings, and being deeply intoxicated by the unique and extraordinary works of art, lingering over and over again, reluctant to leave. The Paris Las Vegas where we stayed is located on the Las Vegas Strip. It is a large casino hotel owned and operated by Harrah's Entertainment. The replica Eiffel Tower outside the hotel is 165 meters high, which is half the size of the real Eiffel Tower in Paris. There are also buildings such as the Arc de Triomphe and the Opera House, making it look like a miniature Paris. We didn't get to see its true face when we checked in last night. It wasn't until the next day that we were able to see its full picture. Of course, we took photos from all angles. Suddenly, a dreamy and elegant emerald color appeared in front of me. It turned out to be the outer glass decorative wall of the MGM Hotel. The delicate emerald colored glass curtain wall decorated the MGM Hotel like a magnificent dream town; then, a sky blue pyramid shape appeared in front, which was the main building of the Pyramid Hotel. The layout of the hotel was built according to the style of the Pyramid of Khufu in ancient Egypt. All the decorations of the Sphinx are in the style of ancient Egypt. Even the waiters are dressed in ancient Egyptian costumes and can take photos with tourists for free. The colorful ancient castle hotel also makes our eyes shine. From the appearance of the hotel to the room furnishings, entertainment facilities, and even the uniforms of the waiters, they all have a strong medieval European atmosphere, allowing people to taste the afterglow of the fairy tale world in the maze-like castle room. It is said that nine of the ten largest and most luxurious resort hotels in the world are located in Las Vegas! The largest one is the MGM Grand Adventure Hotel and Casino, with 5,005 rooms! Las Vegas under the sun is very arrogant and magnificent. Every hotel is a special landscape. All the statues in front of the hotel are very vivid and lifelike, but the scale is relatively small. I think the most frightening thing is that the super large motorcycle that breaks through the wall and the huge roller coaster actually travel on the roof of the building. No wonder some people say that Las Vegas is the most bizarre and colorful dream city in the world. To say that Las Vegas is a city full of temptations is an understatement. When I was still in Phoenix, Mr. Zhen once told me that Las Vegas is not only a paradise for gambling, but also a holy place for marriage. For lovers, the temptation of marriage is no less than the temptation of gambling. Mr. Zhen said that the marriage registration office in Las Vegas is just like the casino in Las Vegas. Regardless of wind or rain, it is open every day from 8 a.m. to 24 p.m. to accept registrations, and the service attitude is absolutely first-class. It is open 24 hours a day on holidays, so no reservation is required, you can sign up at any time. Wedding service companies abound, and there are even churches specially designed for weddings, with priests always on hand. The level of the wedding is up to the individual. It can be a luxurious and grand wedding, or it can be completed in a few minutes. According to statistics, about 1 million couples from all over the world register their marriage in Las Vegas every year. After just two days of visiting, I felt that the night in Las Vegas is colorful and lively, while the day in Las Vegas is bright and enthusiastic. The "financial tsunami" seems to have had no impact on Las Vegas. Some tall hotel buildings are under construction as usual, all casinos are open 24 hours a day, and the shops are full of customers. The city is brightly lit at night and crowded with tourists during the day. Las Vegas, a mirage rising in the desert, its beauty and luxury, its existence and fantasy, are far beyond my imagination. I prefer Las Vegas under the sun. What she showed to me was a completely different attitude and style. You see, the Statue of Liberty, the London Bridge, the Egyptian pyramids, churches of different styles, and a hotel with many colorful onion domes, which are like castles in fairy tales, are displayed in front of us. These all make me like Las Vegas gradually. It turns out that Las Vegas has many other connotations besides "gambling". I think this is probably the reason why so many tourists who don’t like gambling love to come to Las Vegas.

a95d6d707d9fdf04f600d40cfd8b489cd4caefaf.translatedText: Lianhe Zao: Three "unexpected things" about the public trial of Bo Xilai The unexpected openness of the authorities, the unexpected tenacity of Bo Xilai, and the unexpected professionalism of the court not only increased...

61ea059b510357fd3bb2d31e1c6534a268b2383e.sourceText: ”没想到审判薄熙来这么精彩曲折，就象看进口大片”一位朋友昨天难掩兴奋之情，专门给我打电话大谈他对薄熙来出庭的感受。
61ea059b510357fd3bb2d31e1c6534a268b2383e.translatedText: "I didn't expect that Bo Xilai's trial would be so exciting and tortuous, just like watching an imported blockbuster." A friend couldn't hide his excitement yesterday and called me specifically to talk about his feelings about Bo Xilai's appearance in court.

83d581c0acd35922c5897180ffd8a56fb6494fc2.sourceText: 说实话，对举世关注的公审薄熙来，我也有三个”没想到”：没想到官方如此开放，能够及时、详细发布薄熙来庭审的一手资料，任由世人评判；二是没想到薄熙来如此顽强，在老婆、朋友举证自己涉嫌受贿的严密证据链中仍坚决否认指控；没想到在法治水平较低的中国也能出现如此高水准的审理和控辩。
83d581c0acd35922c5897180ffd8a56fb6494fc2.translatedText: To be honest, I had three "unexpected thoughts" about Bo Xilai's public trial, which attracted worldwide attention: I didn't expect the government to be so open and release first-hand information about Bo Xilai's trial in a timely and detailed manner for the world to judge; secondly, I didn't expect Bo Xilai to be so tenacious and firmly deny the accusations despite the tight chain of evidence that his wife and friends testified about his alleged bribery; I didn't expect such a high-level trial and prosecution to occur in China, which has a low level of rule of law.

ea6d50eea26c3d01da05d5b50a0cf791dc4ccc0b.sourceText: 中国上次审判一名前政治局委员是2008年3月25日在天津开庭审理陈良宇。当时官方只是简单地发布了消息，庭审被安排在只能容纳30多人的一间法庭，旁听席还没有坐满。旁听人员主要由中纪委、最高检察院、最高法院等官方人士组成，除了摄像、摄影外，庭审现场没有记者，也没有家属到场。庭审至中午12时暂时休庭，下午1时30分继续开庭，到下午5时，庭审全部结束。陈良宇第二天被押回秦城监狱。在沉寂多日后，4月11日，天津市二中院以受贿罪、滥用职权罪一审判处陈良宇有期徒刑18年。直到陈良宇案尘埃落定，一些媒体才陆续爆出陈良宇的受审过程。
ea6d50eea26c3d01da05d5b50a0cf791dc4ccc0b.translatedText: The last trial of a former Politburo member in China was the trial of Chen Liangyu in Tianjin on March 25, 2008. At that time, the official simply announced that the trial was scheduled in a courtroom that could only accommodate more than 30 people, and the auditorium was not yet full. The auditors were mainly composed of officials from the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, the Supreme Procuratorate, and the Supreme Court. Apart from video and photography, there were no reporters or family members present at the trial. The trial was temporarily adjourned at 12 noon, resumed at 1:30 pm, and ended at 5 pm. Chen Liangyu was taken back to Qincheng Prison the next day. After many days of silence, on April 11, the Tianjin No. 2 Intermediate People's Court sentenced Chen Liangyu to 18 years in prison for bribery and abuse of power. It was not until the Chen Liangyu case was settled that some media outlets gradually broke the news about Chen Liangyu's trial process.

3e5deb61fa5aedc147f83320eca2374704e7780e.sourceText: 2012年8月和9月，官方审判了直接导致薄熙来落马的薄熙来妻子谷开来和重庆市原副市长、公安局长王立军。这两次庭审的公开程度明显超过了陈良宇案，官方不仅预告了审理日期，还在审理当天举行新闻发布会披露相关内容。一些分析人士认为，鉴于薄熙来的政治影响和强硬个性，官方不大可能对他进行公审，最多不过按照审判谷开来、王立军的模式来审判薄熙来，以免场面失控，让官方下不了台。
3e5deb61fa5aedc147f83320eca2374704e7780e.translatedText: In August and September 2012, officials tried Bo Xilai's wife Gu Kailai and Wang Lijun, the former deputy mayor and public security director of Chongqing, who directly led to Bo Xilai's dismissal. These two trials were significantly more public than the Chen Liangyu case. Officials not only announced the trial date, but also held a press conference on the day of the trial to disclose relevant content. Some analysts believe that given Bo Xilai's political influence and tough personality, it is unlikely that the authorities will hold a public trial for him. At most, Bo Xilai will be tried according to the trial model of Gu Kailai and Wang Lijun, so as to prevent the situation from getting out of control and preventing the authorities from stepping down.

f7eb1ef8980bfa40f3436f28691c91e9a2cc0b42.sourceText: 包括法官、控辩双方人员以及证人在法庭上的出色表现，为这场”大戏”的顺利进行提供了保障。经常批评中国法治不彰的知名律师陈有西在博客中说：”薄熙来案的审判，总体上其公开性和公正性都出乎我原先的预期。这是一种令人欣喜的现象。审判、公诉、辩护、被告、证人，各方审判参与人，表现都相当到位而符合法律理性。说明中国的依法治国的基本规则，已经形成。这些年法律人共同的努力和呼喊，已经起了作用。”
f7eb1ef8980bfa40f3436f28691c91e9a2cc0b42.translatedText: The excellent performance in court by the judge, prosecution and defense personnel, and witnesses provided guarantee for the smooth progress of this "big drama". Chen Youxi, a well-known lawyer who often criticizes China's weak rule of law, said in his blog: "The openness and fairness of the Bo Xilai trial in general exceeded my original expectations. This is a gratifying phenomenon. The trial, prosecution, defense, defendants, witnesses, and all participants in the trial all performed well and in line with legal rationality. This shows that China's basic rules for governing the country according to law have been formed. The joint efforts and calls of legal people over the years have had an effect."

8fe910bba9d79a13ffbb72796107725254aa5d46.sourceText: 流感季节 慎防药物过量 最近的流感季节里，已经有很多人可能有发热，咽痛，咳嗽，肌肉酸痛和鼻塞等症状的困扰。可能有人为了治疗各种症状，依照症状开始和严重程度的顺序而服用不同的药物。也许大家可能没有意识到的是，其中有一种成分，对乙酰氨基酚(Acetaminophen)，几乎在每种服用的药物都含有。 对乙酰氨基酚在北美的药店里，通常名称为泰林诺（Tylenol），具有帮助止痛，解热，睡眠，咳嗽，感冒和抗过敏等作用。总体而言，它存在于600多种非处方和处方药中，是美国最常见的药物成分之一。 大卫萨马迪医学博士是纽约市西奈山医学院泌尿外科副主任，他说，当服用正常范围的剂量时，对乙酰氨基酚是安全的。但是，如果服用过量，很可能会导致严重的肝损害。事实上，在美国对乙酰氨基酚是导致急性肝功能衰竭第一号原因。 如果为了治疗感冒或流感的单一症状而分别服用了多种药物，或为了腰痛服用了一种药物，又因为感冒又服用了另一种药物，您可能遇到较高的损害肝脏的风险。 不幸的是，一些肝功能损害的症状可能和流感症状很容易混淆：例如，食欲不振，恶心，呕吐，一般的不舒服或嗜睡等。如果您认为您服用了过多的对乙酰氨基酚，请联系您的医生或立即去急诊室。 据美国国立卫生研究院的建议，一天内不应服用超过4000毫克对乙酰氨基酚。 专家特别提示，如果您每天喝3杯或3杯以上的酒精饮料；或有肝脏疾病；或正在服用血液稀释剂华法林（warfarin），应该去听您医生的建议。家 长应根据药物的使用说明指导小孩服用药物，特别是对2至11岁的儿童应特别注意。两岁和两岁以下的儿童不应该服用对乙酰氨基酚。 最重要的是，同一时间内不要服用一种以上含有对乙酰氨基酚的药物。仔细查找以下的关键字：APAP，acetam，acetamin和其它的对乙酰氨基酚的缩写字。 专家还提醒说，您需要仔细阅读药瓶上的标签说明，并按照说明服用不超过建议量的药物。当有疑问时，就去请教药剂师或医生。
8fe910bba9d79a13ffbb72796107725254aa5d46.translatedText: During flu season, beware of drug overdose. During the recent flu season, many people may have been troubled by symptoms such as fever, sore throat, cough, muscle aches and nasal congestion. Someone may take different medications to treat various symptoms, in order of onset and severity. What you may not realize is that there is an ingredient, acetaminophen, which is contained in almost every drug you take. Acetaminophen, commonly sold as Tylenol in North American pharmacies, is used to help with pain relief, fever, sleep, coughs, colds, and allergies. Overall, it is found in more than 600 over-the-counter and prescription drugs and is one of the most common drug ingredients in the United States. David Samadi, M.D., associate chair of the Department of Urology at Mount Sinai School of Medicine in New York City, said acetaminophen is safe when taken within a normal range of doses. However, if taken in excess, severe liver damage is likely. In fact, acetaminophen is the number one cause of acute liver failure in the United States. If you take multiple medications to treat a single symptom of a cold or flu, or if you take one medication for back pain and another for a cold, you may be at higher risk of damaging your liver. Unfortunately, some symptoms of liver damage can be easily confused with flu symptoms: for example, loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, general discomfort or lethargy. If you think you have taken too much acetaminophen, contact your doctor or go to the emergency room right away. According to recommendations from the National Institutes of Health, no more than 4,000 milligrams of acetaminophen should be taken in a day. Experts advise that if you drink 3 or more alcoholic drinks a day, have liver disease, or are taking the blood thinner warfarin, you should seek advice from your doctor. Parents should guide their children to take medicines according to the instructions for use, especially children aged 2 to 11 years old. Children two years of age and younger should not take acetaminophen. Most importantly, do not take more than one medicine containing acetaminophen at the same time. Look carefully for the following keywords: APAP, acetam, acetamin and other abbreviations for acetaminophen. Experts also caution that you need to read the label instructions on the pill bottle carefully and follow the directions and take no more than the recommended amount of medication. When in doubt, ask a pharmacist or doctor.
