1c020a5aee998353a33b839c2c96591f788367b5.sourceText: 王晓路教授和亚利桑那州非常有缘，他分别曾于2007年和2011年在亚利桑那州立大学做过几场精彩的讲座，例如”中国大陆的仿古街棗当代旅游文化景观”和”从服饰看中国：当代中国社会生活的变迁”，均引起了学生们的热烈讨论，并深受亚利桑那州各方各界的尊敬和爱戴。他在选择本次讲座主题：中国西方观的演进时有以下几点考虑：
1c020a5aee998353a33b839c2c96591f788367b5.translatedText: Professor Wang Xiaolu is very close to Arizona. He was in 2007 and 2011 respectively. He gave several wonderful lectures at Arizona State University in 2011, such as "Antique Streets and Contemporary Tourism Cultural Landscapes in Mainland China" and "Looking at China through Clothing: Changes in Contemporary Chinese Social Life", which aroused heated discussions among students and was deeply respected and loved by all walks of life in Arizona. He had the following considerations when choosing the topic of this lecture: The Evolution of China's Western Views:

07056eee31477a2cb8ad483416d71d332ad11c7f.sourceText: 首先关于研究这个课题的原因，王教授表示，在漫长的历史中，随着社会的变迁，中国和西方关系，主要经历了从固步自封到被迫打开国门，从逐渐正视到重新审视西方，从积极主动进入国际社会到在国际事务中发挥越来越重要的作用等几个过程。一般的百姓对于西方的认识却仍旧存在一些误解。通过对一些中心概念梳理中国的西方观，有利于在中国西方观的问题上多一些理性思考，促进跨文化的互识交流并有利于中国人通过不同的角度更好地认识自己。
07056eee31477a2cb8ad483416d71d332ad11c7f.translatedText: First of all, regarding the reasons for studying this topic, Professor Wang said that in the long history, with the changes in society, the relationship between China and the West has mainly gone through several processes, from being entrenched in self-reliance to being forced to open the country, from gradually facing the West to re-examining the West, from actively entering the international community to playing an increasingly important role in international affairs. Ordinary people still have some misunderstandings about the West. By sorting out some central concepts of China's Western views, it will help to think more rationally on China's Western views, promote cross-cultural mutual understanding and exchanges, and help Chinese people better understand themselves from different perspectives.

7aeadca5a3be40b2a0c0e06d47e32e72f0a39e97.sourceText: 其次，中国对西方的各类称呼是具有历史性的，同时在官方、学术界、民间和媒体上也都有差别。其中不乏对西方的对想象或排斥，而当代又和经济发展、国际贸易、地缘政治的重要性等要素有着密不可分联系。所以，文化误读和跨文化沟通是一个重要的领域。问题本身和看待问题的方式、角度和提供问题的答案则是同样重要的。
7aeadca5a3be40b2a0c0e06d47e32e72f0a39e97.translatedText: Secondly, China's various names for the West are historical, and there are also differences among officials, academia, private citizens and the media. There is no lack of imagination or rejection of the West, and contemporary times are inextricably linked to factors such as economic development, international trade, and the importance of geopolitics. Therefore, cultural misunderstanding and cross-cultural communication is an important area. The question itself is equally important as the way and angle of looking at it and providing the answer to the question.

8f2a5948dca105a9b688ade741c0d445a113dac6.sourceText: 另外，王教授希望，大众媒体应当对中国西方观有好的引领作用，让观众有思考的余地。媒体应当适时介绍这些国际品牌的现代管理理念以及建立良好信誉的职业精神过程等。总之，希望能通过日常生活的变化，将现象背后的文化问题揭示出来，将单一的经济式成功转为文化须面对现代精神开放的发展型导向。
8f2a5948dca105a9b688ade741c0d445a113dac6.translatedText: In addition, Professor Wang hopes that the mass media should play a good leading role in China's view of the West and give the audience room to think. The media should promptly introduce the modern management concepts of these international brands and the professional process of establishing good reputation. In short, it is hoped that through changes in daily life, the cultural issues behind the phenomenon can be revealed, and a single economic success can be transformed into a developmental orientation in which culture must face the modern spiritual openness.

d79286223778eae5b70c2084e02d3d1ca7d0ae77.sourceText: 最后，在本次讲座中，王教授主要将会对中国文化中的”鬼”以及相关的概念进行了梳理，将重点置于自我与非我文化的认知关系上，从其中的一些关键词语，如”夷”、”狄”、”蛮”、”洋鬼子”、”鬼子”以及”老外”等称呼和言说的变化中，呈现中国对外部世界观的逐渐迁移，说明中国文化从内向外的转变进程，以及中国文化在主动进入国际社会的过程中更为包容和开放。
d79286223778eae5b70c2084e02d3d1ca7d0ae77.translatedText: Finally, in this lecture, Professor Wang will mainly sort out "ghost" and related concepts in Chinese culture, focusing on the cognitive relationship between self and non-self culture. From some of the key words, such as "barbarian", " The changes in titles and expressions such as "Di", "Barbarian", "foreign devil", "devil" and "foreigner" show China's gradual migration of the external worldview, indicating the transformation process of Chinese culture from the inside to the outside, and that Chinese culture is becoming more tolerant and open in the process of actively entering the international community.

e6a349b0e3eb3fecfb0d0bb0583633b4bd4ece71.sourceText: 本次讲座是亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院为本地社区提供一个对跨文化研究深入了解的机会。王晓路教授将会用中文演讲。本场讲座定于2014年2月21日下午4：30开始，地点位于亚利桑那州立大学语言与文学楼60教室。讲座之后将会有一个小型招待会并备有精美点心，亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院诚邀亚利桑那州各界朋友参与此次交流。
e6a349b0e3eb3fecfb0d0bb0583633b4bd4ece71.translatedText: This lecture is an opportunity for the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University to provide the local community with an in-depth understanding of cross-cultural research. Professor Wang Xiaolu will give a lecture in Chinese. This lecture is scheduled to start at 4:30 pm on February 21, 2014, and will be located in Classroom 60, Language and Literature Building, Arizona State University. There will be a small reception with exquisite snacks after the lecture. The Confucius Institute at Arizona State University sincerely invites friends from all walks of life in Arizona to participate in this exchange.

737cd449cd5f1135cb0626cdc14bdd0631b690db.sourceText: 波士顿连环爆炸案后续：奥巴马追思中国留学生吕令子 周四，奥巴马总统前往波士顿参加爆炸案公众悼念仪式，仪式上奥巴马特别对于在爆炸案中遇难的中国留学生吕令子表示悼念。 ”我们的心与来自中国的遇难者，23岁的吕令子和她家人同在。吕令子的家人将她送到波士顿大学读书，来让她感受这座城市所能给与她的一切。” ”她的家人和大洋两岸的朋友都为她的遇难感到心碎，此时人性将我们相连。” 中国留学生吕令子是爆炸案最后确认的遇难者。吕令子一年前进入波士顿大学统计系学习，校方评价她是波士顿的杰出学生和一颗科学新星。17日晚，波士顿大学为吕令子举行追悼会。据悉吕令子的家人将很快抵达波士顿。 奥巴马同时哀悼了其他两位遇难者，29岁的坎贝尔(Krystle Campbell)以及8岁的理查德(Martin Richard)。 波士顿15日在举行马拉松比赛时发生连环爆炸，造成包括吕令子在内的3人死亡，170多人受伤，其中仍有人没有脱离生命危险。
737cd449cd5f1135cb0626cdc14bdd0631b690db.translatedText: The aftermath of the Boston serial bombings: Obama commemorated the Chinese student Lu Lingzi On Thursday, President Obama went to Boston to attend a public memorial ceremony for the bombings. During the ceremony, Obama paid special tribute to Lu Lingzi, a Chinese student who was killed in the bombings. "Our hearts go out to the victims from China, 23-year-old Lu Lingzi and her family. Lu Lingzi's family sent her to Boston University to study so that she could experience everything this city can give her." "Her family and friends on both sides of the ocean are heartbroken by her death, and humanity connects us at this time." Chinese student Lu Lingzi was the last confirmed victim of the bombing. Lu Lingzi entered the Department of Statistics at Boston University a year ago. The school evaluated her as an outstanding student in Boston and a rising star in science. On the evening of the 17th, Boston University held a memorial service for Lu Lingzi. It is reported that Lu Lingzi’s family will arrive in Boston soon. Obama also mourned the other two victims, 29-year-old Krystle Campbell and 8-year-old Martin Richard. On the 15th, a series of explosions occurred during a marathon in Boston, killing three people including Lu Lingzi, and injuring more than 170 people, some of whom were still not out of danger.

99d2b31f8e0eb508bafbb34f30434f89891623d2.sourceText: 王澍和他的妻子陆文宇在中国美术学院。后者也是一位建筑师。
99d2b31f8e0eb508bafbb34f30434f89891623d2.translatedText: Wang Shu and his wife Lu Wenyu at the China Academy of Art. The latter is also an architect.

3bc722f5fc517834b3fbbf27f2f6d42e19be901c.sourceText: 王澍是第一位获得普利兹克奖的中国建筑师。几乎每天早上，他都会来到他的工作室，坐在书桌旁。桌上放着几张柔软的淡棕色宣纸，一个用来调墨的杯子和一支毛笔。他先读一会儿唐诗，然后开始练习书法，只见行笔悠悠、落笔生花。他说，这样做能给即将开始的一天带来平静。
3bc722f5fc517834b3fbbf27f2f6d42e19be901c.translatedText: Wang Shu is the first Chinese architect to win the Pritzker Prize. Almost every morning, he comes to his studio and sits at his desk. On the table are several sheets of soft light brown rice paper, a cup for mixing ink and a writing brush. He first read Tang poetry for a while, and then began to practice calligraphy. He could see that his writing was leisurely and flourishing. Doing so, he says, brings peace to the day ahead.

e21f6501f8d64a95a76f121e10e2c75c4332a91b.sourceText: 古代艺术，不是把王澍的作品跟中国城市随处可见的炫目大理石玻璃商业建筑区别开来的唯一因素。他大胆而精致的建筑，循自然之天成，集古今之风格；使用的建筑材料都很便宜，比如可回收的砖瓦。他的工作室名叫”业余建筑工作室”。工作室里没有Mac电脑，桌子上只有几台20世纪90年代的终端机，被一堆旧报纸包围着，布满了灰尘。中国美术学院坐落于宁静、秀美的湖滨城市杭州。王澍的工作室就在美院附近，他的六个助手是他在美院的学生，他们只在需要的时候才来工作室。这个下午，王澍和陆文宇（王澍的妻子兼同事）打开工作室的前门（一大块厚木板），四周空无一人。
e21f6501f8d64a95a76f121e10e2c75c4332a91b.translatedText: Ancient art is not the only thing that distinguishes Wang Shu's work from the dazzling marble-and-glass commercial buildings that populate Chinese cities. His bold and exquisite architecture follows nature and combines ancient and modern styles; he uses cheap building materials, such as recycled bricks and tiles. His studio is called "Amateur Architecture Studio". There are no Macs in the studio, just a few terminals from the 1990s on the desk, surrounded by a pile of old newspapers and gathering dust. The China Academy of Art is located in the quiet and beautiful lakeside city of Hangzhou. Wang Shu's studio is near the Academy of Fine Arts. His six assistants are his students at the Academy of Fine Arts. They only come to the studio when needed. This afternoon, Wang Shu and Lu Wenyu (Wang Shu’s wife and colleague) opened the front door of the studio (a large thick wooden board), and there was no one around.

12153b6fdaf53fabc550e1579907b52aa93deabe.sourceText: 今年2月，评审团把普利兹克奖颁发给了现年48岁的王澍，把这位建筑师推向了舞台的中央。王澍非常不赞同中国的快速城市化进程，并用他独特的建筑风格表明自己的反对态度。王澍在中国的西部边陲新疆长大。在中国的建筑圈里，他是个异类。他只设计过一个公寓楼项目，位于杭州， 由几座高14层的楼房组成，阳台很深。他设计的博物馆、大学、家宅和老式砖瓦垒成的公园，都深受中国古代建筑的影响。5月份，在人民大会堂举办的普利兹克颁奖仪式上，国务院副总理李克强拥抱了王澍，尽管后者对前者掌控下的经济体造就的城市深感厌恶。中国的各大媒体上都是他俩的照片棗一位是很可能在今年秋天当选的总理，另一位是身着黑衣的建筑师。
12153b6fdaf53fabc550e1579907b52aa93deabe.translatedText: In February this year, the jury awarded the Pritzker Prize to 48-year-old Wang Shu, pushing the architect to the center of the stage. Wang Shu strongly disagreed with China's rapid urbanization process and used his unique architectural style to express his opposition. Wang Shu grew up in Xinjiang, China's western border. In China's architectural circles, he is an anomaly. He has only designed one apartment building project, located in Hangzhou, which consists of several 14-story buildings with deep balconies. The museums, universities, homes and old-fashioned brick parks he designed were all deeply influenced by ancient Chinese architecture. In May, at a Pritzker Prize ceremony at the Great Hall of the People, Vice Premier Li Keqiang embraced Wang Shu, despite the latter’s disgust at the cities the former’s economy had created. China's major media are full of photos of the two of them - one is the prime minister who is likely to be elected this fall, and the other is an architect dressed in black.

9617e20cdafb835e9a926abc29ae432c22dc9ea5.sourceText: 急着模仿西方，却将中国的特色弃之如蔽，这是让王澍最恼火的地方。为什么要把中国变成别国的翻版，他问道。”我们想模仿曼哈顿，”在他的工作室附近吃午饭的时候，他说。”我很喜欢曼哈顿，那是个很有趣的地方。但是它是经过200年时间形成的，你想复制它，可太难了。纽约不是设计师设计出来的，它是时间沉淀出来的。”
9617e20cdafb835e9a926abc29ae432c22dc9ea5.translatedText: >He was eager to imitate the West, but abandoned Chinese characteristics. This was what annoyed Wang Shu the most. Why should China be turned into a copy of other countries, he asked. "We wanted to emulate Manhattan," he said over lunch near his studio. "I like Manhattan very much. It is a very interesting place. But it was formed over 200 years, and it is too difficult to replicate it. New York was not designed by designers, it was precipitated by time."

c1d553f5a91b706297a720e337bc425c48bac34b.sourceText: 他批评过度城市化的其中一个原因是，他意识到政府官员和投资者狼狈为奸，拆除旧房子和破烂的公路，腾出地方来建设高速公路、机场、火车站和住宅，从中牟取巨额利润。”60%的政府收入不是来自正常的税收，而是来自卖地的收入，”他说。有些报道说这个比例还要更高。凤凰新媒体是一家同情中国政府的香港媒体，最近引用了国土资源部的一份报告，上面说，2010年政府收入的74.1%来自出售土地，而在1989年，这个比例是零。
c1d553f5a91b706297a720e337bc425c48bac34b.translatedText: One of the reasons why he criticized excessive urbanization is that he realized that government officials and investors colluded to demolish old houses and dilapidated roads to make room for the construction of highways, airports, train stations, and residences, making huge profits from it. "Sixty percent of government revenue does not come from normal taxes, but from land sales," he said. Some reports say the ratio is even higher. Phoenix New Media, a Hong Kong media outlet sympathetic to the Chinese government, recently cited a report from the Ministry of Land and Resources that said 74.1% of government revenue in 2010 came from land sales, compared with zero in 1989.

1b62ffd215b7dd968da441840d369f55dcaced5a.sourceText: 王澍同情贫穷的农民，他们渴望去大城市生活，因为那里有空调，有超市。但他认为，如果有机会用可持续的方法改造农村，农民的生活会富裕起来。他最近的一个项目是劝说杭州附近的一个村庄的党委书记不要推倒房屋，而是用原来的砖瓦进行改造。”人们以为非此即彼，”他说：”但实际上我们有很大的选择空间，用一些简单的方法，就能过上现代而舒适的生活。”
1b62ffd215b7dd968da441840d369f55dcaced5a.translatedText: Wang Shu sympathized with the poor farmers, who longed to live in big cities because they had air conditioning and supermarkets. But he believes that if given the opportunity to transform the countryside using sustainable methods, farmers will become richer. One of his most recent projects involved persuading the party secretary of a village near Hangzhou not to knock down the house but to renovate it with the original bricks and tiles. "People think it's either/or," he said, "but in fact we have a lot of room for choice. With some simple methods, we can live a modern and comfortable life."

1b24877e1a0ad2fe9dc185282c9f92d2188f3fc8.sourceText: 了解王澍作品的两位建筑师强调，王澍特别善于古今结合，中外结合。”可以把王澍的作品看作是一种新的本地化，”哈佛设计研究院的院长莫森 莫斯塔法维(Mohsen Mostafavi)说：”他实际上深深植根于现代主义。他的作品既不是对中国建筑也不是对西方建筑的简单复制，而是两种风格的融合。”
1b24877e1a0ad2fe9dc185282c9f92d2188f3fc8.translatedText: Two architects familiar with Wang Shu's works emphasized that Wang Shu is particularly good at combining ancient and modern, as well as Chinese and foreign. "Wang Shu's work can be seen as a new kind of localization," said Mohsen Mostafavi, dean of the Harvard Graduate School of Design. "He is actually deeply rooted in modernism. His works are neither simple copies of Chinese architecture nor Western architecture, but a fusion of the two styles."

ea1d5dfd249e5c2e28cb5178bf4bda551da504e9.sourceText: 麻省理工学院建筑规划院院长、杰出的华裔建筑师张永和说，王澍能”让我们看到了传统元素在当代文化中的活力，让我们知道现代化不等同于西化”。他称赞王澍身上有一种不同寻常的正直：”在今天的中国，能像王澍那样对抗市场的压力、坚持独立的价值观，不容易。”
ea1d5dfd249e5c2e28cb5178bf4bda551da504e9.translatedText: Zhang Yonghe, dean of the Institute of Architecture and Planning at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and an outstanding Chinese architect, said that Wang Shuneng "allowed us to see the vitality of traditional elements in contemporary culture and let us know that modernization is not the same as Westernization." He praised Wang Shu for his unusual integrity: "In today's China, it is not easy to resist the pressure of the market and adhere to independent values ​​​​like Wang Shu."

a98e50daa9e01475c31d39cf2abdb567a9da99c9.sourceText: 王澍的作品很多元化，包括博物馆、大学和住宅。在荣誉证书中，普利兹克奖的评审团特别提到了宁波历史博物馆，称赞该建筑集”力量、实用和情感于一体”。从远处看，博物馆看起来很厚重；从近处看，灰色、橙色和蓝色的可回收的瓷瓦和老式的砖块给人一种质朴的感觉。位于杭州市象山区的中国美术学院的六个建筑，最显著的特点是白墙，让人想起了中国古典水墨画里的传统中式庭院。苏州大学文正学院图书馆是他2000年的作品，其特色是一个白色的立方体小屋伸入湖中，正面的墙全是玻璃做的。
a98e50daa9e01475c31d39cf2abdb567a9da99c9.translatedText: Wang Shu's works are very diverse, including museums, universities and residences. In the certificate of honor, the Pritzker Prize jury singled out the Ningbo History Museum, praising the building for its "power, practicality and emotion." From a distance, the museum looks heavy; from up close, the gray, orange and blue recycled porcelain tiles and old-fashioned bricks give it a rustic feel. The most striking feature of the six buildings of the China Academy of Art in Xiangshan District, Hangzhou is the white walls, which are reminiscent of traditional Chinese courtyards in classical Chinese ink paintings. The Library of Wenzheng College of Suzhou University is his work in 2000. It features a white cube house extending into the lake, with the front wall made entirely of glass.

eb9b1cf26a1d5811c745bc4984c36c8a945127d4.sourceText: 尽管普利兹克奖给王澍带来了极高的声望，他仍然没有寻求在国外发展。他获奖之后的其中一个项目是美术学院供访问教授们下榻的酒店，是一个夯土建筑。
eb9b1cf26a1d5811c745bc4984c36c8a945127d4.translatedText: Despite the prestige that the Pritzker Prize brought to Wang Shu, he still has not sought development abroad. One of his projects after winning the award was a hotel for visiting professors from the Academy of Fine Arts. It was a rammed earth building.

f1acf504ece081cedb697f764a5b90e9690ca6f6.sourceText: 他总是尽可能使用可回收的建筑材料。20世纪90年代，他在这方面的技艺日臻成熟：他把正式的建筑设计放到一边，跟工匠和施工人员一起，把旧房子改造成画廊、音乐厅或美发店。2000年时，他被任命为中国美术学院建筑系教授，重新回到一流建筑师的队伍，参与竞争，接受委托。
f1acf504ece081cedb697f764a5b90e9690ca6f6.translatedText: He always uses recyclable building materials whenever possible. In the 1990s, he matured in this area: he put aside formal architectural design and worked with craftsmen and builders to transform old houses into galleries, concert halls or hairdressers. In 2000, he was appointed professor of the Department of Architecture at the China Academy of Art, and returned to the ranks of first-class architects, participating in competitions and accepting commissions.

df9feeda2973b1bbce44bba4f738b47a8b3ea5ce.sourceText: 当前些年省政府和大学为新注入的资金兴奋不已、把博物馆和新增的建筑（比如图书馆）委托出去设计时，王澍的想法也成熟了，这些也引起了他的兴趣。他强调中国特色的价值，但他不是新民族主义者。他和妻子喜欢带着11岁的儿子出国旅行。过去几年，他们一起在哈佛设计研究院授课，主题是以中国传统农村为基础构建”质朴”新郊区。
df9feeda2973b1bbce44bba4f738b47a8b3ea5ce.translatedText: In recent years, when the provincial government and universities were excited about the new infusion of funds and commissioned the design of museums and new buildings (such as libraries), Wang Shu's ideas matured, and these also aroused his interest. He emphasizes the value of Chinese characteristics, but he is not a new nationalist. He and his wife enjoy traveling abroad with their 11-year-old son. In the past few years, they have taught together at the Harvard Graduate School of Design, with the theme of building "rustic" new suburbs based on traditional Chinese villages.

0fd556b6206be4f4017ce292b3dfd4149b080885.sourceText: 他们是形影不离的夫妻和工作伙伴。他们的合作看起来很轻松，有时也充满乐趣，而且配合默契。普利兹克奖的评审团曾考虑过把该奖项颁发给他们俩。他们相识在南京工程学院的建筑课上。他注意到那个”穿绿色毛衣的女孩”，他说，结果发现她也来自新疆。”工作中，我更多地负责设计，她更多地负责施工，”他说。王澍个性严肃，有学者风范。陆文宇更加外向。他们相识后，她说，自己提了一个条件：她可以做他的女朋友，但是不会参加他在宿舍里为有兴趣的学生举办的课余研讨会。
0fd556b6206be4f4017ce292b3dfd4149b080885.translatedText: They are an inseparable couple and work partners. Their collaboration seems easy, sometimes fun, and they work well together. The Pritzker Prize jury considered awarding the award to both of them. They met in the architecture class of Nanjing Institute of Technology. He noticed the "girl in the green sweater," he said, and it turned out she was also from Xinjiang. "At work, I am more responsible for the design and she is more responsible for the construction," he said. Wang Shu had a serious personality and the demeanor of a scholar. Lu Wenyu is more outgoing. After they met, she said she made a condition: She could be his girlfriend, but she would not attend the after-school seminars he held in his dormitory for interested students.

dee9588ad8d5654dbd1fff7bc0214623b3882b7d.sourceText: 去年秋天普利兹克奖的评审员参观中国时，印象最深刻的一个作品就是中国美术学院的象山新校区。王澍经常开车带妻子去学校。更准确地说，是妻子开车。王澍没有驾照，坐在乘客的位置上。他们的车是普通的旅行车。有些中国建筑师更青睐保时捷，但王澍不好那一口儿。
dee9588ad8d5654dbd1fff7bc0214623b3882b7d.translatedText: When the judges of the Pritzker Prize visited China last fall, one of the most impressive works was the new Xiangshan Campus of the China Academy of Art. Wang Shu often drives his wife to school. To be more precise, the wife was driving. Wang Shu did not have a driver's license and was sitting in the passenger seat. Their car was a regular station wagon. Some Chinese architects prefer Porsche, but Wang Shu is not convinced.

ec2ccc874543281e18417b0cf529ac6bc7449d4f.sourceText: 在评审团参观校园的时候，赞助普利兹克奖的凯悦基金会主席托马斯J.普利兹克(Thomas J. Pritzker)向王澍询问修建校园的成本，王澍回忆道。”我说第一期是每平方米1500元，第二期是2500元，”王澍说他是这样回答的。在听翻译换算成235美元和392美元之前，普利兹克凭直觉就知道很便宜。”可以说基本上没花钱，”他对同事说。根据香港威宁谢工程咨询公司(Langdon & Seah)的统计，北京著名的写字楼每平方米造价952美元。
ec2ccc874543281e18417b0cf529ac6bc7449d4f.translatedText: When the jury visited the campus, Thomas J. Pritzker, chairman of the Hyatt Foundation, which sponsors the Pritzker Prize, asked Wang Shu about the cost of building the campus, Wang Shu recalled. "I said the first phase is 1,500 yuan per square meter, and the second phase is 2,500 yuan," Wang Shu said he responded. Pritzker knew intuitively that it was a bargain before hearing the translations to $235 and $392. "It basically cost nothing," he told his colleagues. According to statistics from Langdon & Seah, a Hong Kong-based engineering consulting company, Beijing's famous office buildings cost US$952 per square meter.

115a347a971b1a8e0fe20ccff9516213315db068.sourceText: 大学校园那个项目是我梦寐以求的，王澍说。招标要求是在废弃的稻田上用较低的预算，建设一个可容纳5000名学生的、拥有国际化水准的校园。美术学院的院长许江是个艺术家，也是王澍的朋友，这次是他的客户。第一个决定是：尽量不破坏自然环境。把学校建在稻田的边缘上，这样四周有开阔的空间。第二个决定是：不像杭州市中心的美院校区那样在混凝土柱子外面包上大理石，那样太浪费了。这个校园与众不同，莫斯塔法维说，它不受总体规划的束缚。”这里的每幢楼都很独特，聚在一起又有一种整体感，”他说。
115a347a971b1a8e0fe20ccff9516213315db068.translatedText: That project on the university campus was my dream, Wang Shu said. The request for the tender was to build a campus of international standards that could accommodate 5,000 students on an abandoned rice field with a low budget. Xu Jiang, the dean of the Academy of Fine Arts, is an artist and Wang Shu's friend, and this time he is his client. The first decision is: try not to damage the natural environment. Build the school on the edge of the rice fields so there is open space all around. The second decision was: not to cover the concrete pillars with marble like the Academy of Fine Arts campus in downtown Hangzhou. That would be too wasteful. The campus is different, Mostafavi said, in that it is not bound by a master plan. "Each building here is unique, and together they have a sense of unity," he said.

37a6af0d00efdcba0a6535a0f738b514353b49d0.sourceText: 展示校园的时候，王澍承认最后的成品并不完美。校内走廊的外墙上参差不齐地打了很多洞，这样可以看到外面的风景。墙和门取材自当地的紫杉树，颜色微红。”这些树很便宜，而且长得很快，”他说。20年后，这些木头需要换掉。竹子做的围栏的更新时间是5到7年。”这些都是可持续的，”他说：”都很容易替换。”
37a6af0d00efdcba0a6535a0f738b514353b49d0.translatedText: When showing the campus, Wang Shu admitted that the final product was not perfect. Many holes are punched into the exterior walls of the school corridors to allow for views of the outside world. The walls and doors are made from local yew trees and are reddish in color. "These trees are cheap and grow quickly," he said. After 20 years, the wood will need to be replaced. The renewal time for fences made of bamboo is 5 to 7 years. "These are all sustainable," he said: "They are all easy to replace."

e3e14eaf167f3afa7012d1a3f66ac4424865cd47.sourceText: 中国总是欢迎外国的建筑师来设计大城市里的建筑棗包括往届普利兹克奖的获得者诺曼?#31119;斯特(Norman Foster)和扎哈?#21704;迪德(Zaha Hadid)，所以这样一个非主流的设计师获得普利兹克奖震惊了中国建筑界。王澍称他们是”正常的群体”，这个群体对王澍获奖集体沉默。
e3e14eaf167f3afa7012d1a3f66ac4424865cd47.translatedText: China has always welcomed foreign architects to design buildings in big cities, including previous Pritzker Prize winners Norman Foster and Zaha Hadid, so the fact that such a non-mainstream designer won the Pritzker Prize shocked the Chinese architectural community. Wang Shu called them a "normal group" and this group was silent on Wang Shu's award.

296288aaefed5317a450c71888ca8856a59d8452.sourceText: 在颁奖仪式上发表获奖感言时，王澍对体制提出了质疑。很少有人做出这样大胆的举动。是否有可能，他问道，除了保护”自上而下的现代专业建筑体系，也能保护普通人开展自己的建筑活动的权利”？中国真的需要”庞大的、象征性的和标志性的建筑物吗”？有没有”更明智的解决环境和生态问题的方法”？在政府高官面前表达这样的异见很是惊人，持自由立场的新闻杂志《南都周刊》的专栏作家洪晃说，”是这样的声音在改变中国。”
296288aaefed5317a450c71888ca8856a59d8452.translatedText: When delivering his acceptance speech at the award ceremony, Wang Shu questioned the system. Few people make such a bold move. Is it possible, he asks, that in addition to protecting "the modern professional construction system from above, we can also protect the rights of ordinary people to carry out their own architectural activities"? Does China really need "huge, symbolic and iconic buildings"? Are there “smarter ways to solve environmental and ecological problems”? It was surprising to express such dissent in front of senior government officials. Hong Huang, a columnist for the liberal news magazine Nandu Weekly, said, "It is voices like this that are changing China."

984fe89519c1e5eb66f820046a824f4d692876c9.sourceText: 中国年轻的建筑师们受到王澍作品的鼓舞，开始追寻不同的建筑风格。私下里和这些年轻的建筑师在一起的时候，他很健谈。”年轻的建筑师们很高兴，”他说：”他们看到了希望。”
984fe89519c1e5eb66f820046a824f4d692876c9.translatedText: Young Chinese architects were inspired by Wang Shu's works and began to pursue different architectural styles. In private with these young architects, he was very talkative. "The young architects are happy," he said: "They see hope."

fc808107cacb6c3cc0948161e3c3812a74f3489c.sourceText: 感谢Bree Feng对本次采访的帮助。
fc808107cacb6c3cc0948161e3c3812a74f3489c.translatedText: Thanks to Bree Feng for her help with this interview.

6f6a7ac219147cd17d47ba2ab1cb6ce85419e4fe.sourceText: 如何取得优质房屋贷款? –五大步骤,第四步
6f6a7ac219147cd17d47ba2ab1cb6ce85419e4fe.translatedText: How to obtain a high-quality home loan? – Five steps, step four

1169b76f43b50a40b67ae5e78c849ea4d051a3ce.sourceText: 如何取得优质房屋贷款? –五大步骤,第四步 上周我们讲到如何取得优质房屋贷款的第三步，申请贷款的步骤有哪些…
1169b76f43b50a40b67ae5e78c849ea4d051a3ce.translatedText: How to obtain a high-quality home loan? – Five steps, step four Last week we talked about the third step of how to obtain a high-quality home loan, what are the steps to apply for a loan...

b0d8464dbc36da873fc44a87454ca16b1ff37db7.sourceText: 如何取得优质房屋贷款? –五大步骤,第四步 上周我们讲到如何取得优质房屋贷款的第三步，申请贷款的步骤有哪些。下面我们要继续教大家如何取得优质房屋贷款的下一步骤。 第四步：什么是优质贷款？ 1. 贷款专员首先会将您的贷款申请整个过程给您介绍一遍，让您有个概念。 2. 在接受您的贷款申请之前，贷款专员需很认真的阅读您所提供的所有相关文件，并告知所欠缺的文件。 3. 贷款专员应当场用专业计算系统为您进行初步审核。若离贷款合格的要求还有些距离时，应告知您如何进行具可行性及合法性的弥补以至合格。 4. 当贷款专员的专业素质无可质疑时，你需了解： A. 整个贷款的银行部份费用为多少，有无隐藏费用，直接放款机构会当场出具一份具法律效率的贷款费用列表（Good Faith Estimate）。在此GFE列表上所列出之费用以外的任何费用，您可以拒付。 B.咨询利率贷款专员应告知您当时不同年限的不同贷款方案的特点，并让您了解30年或15年等的不同期限，您每年的借款费用会在多少，加上地税，乃至整个房屋上的开支。 C. 将买卖合约带上给贷款专员阅读，请他/她告知您能否在产权公司规定的期限30或45天内完成贷款。并了解此机构审核进度。 5. 贷款专员应查核您最近的信用报告，并认真核查信用报告的每一部份内容，例如：有无迟付供楼费用的记录，若在最近三个月内有迟付记录，您的贷款有可能会不被批准。再例如：有无讨债公司申讨款项（Collection），若有一定要请申请人去处理好此事宜，不然得不到贷款批准。 6. 贷款专员接到您的贷款洽询，会帮您在有关系统内查询您所要藉贷的房子的价值，若与买价基本相符合，即会为您安排预定房屋估价事宜。若反之，申请人会有可能浪费了估价费。 7. 提供优质贷款的贷款专员应是由一开始接受您的申请方案，一直关心整个贷款直至最后一个环节：放款完毕。期间有任何需要补文件或预料之外的实况发生，都会第一时间为您设法解决，直到整个贷款顺利完成，让您拿到房屋的钥匙。 8. 您所取得的优质贷款应该是没有提前还钱的罚款（No Pre-Payment Penalty）。 9. 合格的贷款专员会告知您买卖合约中若有10天的估价撤离条款，10天一旦到期，只要买方未签署撤离条款（Remove Contingency），买方仍可撤离合约及拿回订金。
b0d8464dbc36da873fc44a87454ca16b1ff37db7.translatedText: How to obtain a high-quality home loan? – Five steps, step four Last week we talked about the third step of how to obtain a high-quality home loan, and what are the steps to apply for a loan. Now we’re going to continue teaching you the next steps on how to get a quality home loan. Step 4: What is a prime loan? 1. The loan specialist will first introduce you to the entire process of your loan application to give you an idea. 2. Before accepting your loan application, the loan officer must carefully read all relevant documents provided by you and inform you of any missing documents. 3. The loan specialist should use a professional calculation system to conduct a preliminary review for you on the spot. If you are still far away from the loan qualification requirements, you should be informed of how to make feasible and legal remedies to qualify. 4. When the professional quality of the loan officer is beyond question, you need to know: A. How much the bank's fees are for the entire loan, and whether there are any hidden fees. The direct lending institution will issue a legally valid loan fee list (Good Faith Estimate) on the spot. You may refuse to pay any fees other than those listed on this GFE list. B. Consulting the interest rate loan specialist should inform you of the characteristics of different loan options with different terms at that time, and let you know how much your annual borrowing costs will be for different terms such as 30 years or 15 years, plus local taxes, and even the expenses on the entire house. C. Bring the sales contract to the loan officer to read and ask him/her to tell you whether you can close the loan within the 30 or 45 days specified by the title company. And understand the review progress of this agency. 5. The loan officer should check your latest credit report and carefully check every part of the credit report, such as whether there is any record of late payment of mortgage fees. If there is a record of late payment within the past three months, your loan may not be approved. Another example: whether there is a debt collection company to collect the money (Collection), if so, the applicant must handle this matter, otherwise the loan will not be approved. 6. When the loan specialist receives your loan inquiry, he will help you check the value of the house you want to borrow in the relevant system. If it is basically consistent with the purchase price, he will arrange a scheduled house appraisal for you. Otherwise, the applicant may waste the valuation fee. 7. A loan officer who provides high-quality loans should accept your application from the beginning and care about the entire loan until the last step: the disbursement. During this period, if any documents need to be supplemented or unexpected situations occur, we will try to solve it for you as soon as possible until the entire loan is successfully completed and you get the keys to the house. 8. A good loan you get should have No Pre-Payment Penalty. 9. A qualified loan officer will tell you that if there is a 10-day valuation withdrawal clause in the sales contract, once the 10 days expire, the buyer can still withdraw from the contract and get the deposit back as long as the buyer does not sign the removal clause (Remove Contingency).

36ddad97f48c39a7b638c10dcb00acd7a1a6c671.sourceText: 两岸女人年龄的秘密 中新网 最近作者身边有个28岁的台湾女性被大陆人误认为18岁之后，掀起一股问年龄的浪潮…
36ddad97f48c39a7b638c10dcb00acd7a1a6c671.translatedText: The secret of the age of women on both sides of the Taiwan Strait China News Service Recently, there was a 28-year-old Taiwanese woman next to the author who was mistakenly thought to be 18 years old by mainlanders, which set off a wave of people asking her age...

2c3d104501e1622f623c801df26c31867f182573.sourceText: 最近作者身边有个28岁的台湾女性被大陆人误认为18岁之后，掀起一股问年龄的浪潮，能问的台湾女性几乎都被低估5-10岁左右，一个也许是逢迎 拍马屁的个案，但如果很多的都这样，就值得深入研究。 文章摘编如下： 一个人的年纪，可以从脸上的气色、皮肤紧实的程度及其它外观条件窥知一二，当然这之中不乏娃娃脸或少年老成的异数混淆视听。 但最近身边有个28岁的女性被大陆人误认为18岁之后，掀起一股问年龄的浪潮，能问的台湾女性几乎都被低估5到10岁左右，一个也许是逢迎拍马屁的个案，但 如果很多的都这样，就值得深入研究。 我反复思索，也许和两岸结婚年龄的差距有关系，古代的先成家后立业跟成熟度有所关连，不可否认，一个人的成熟度会在结婚后大跃进，如果生小孩后，成熟度更是 突飞猛进。 大陆25岁女性，在乡下也许已是几个小孩的妈，在都市已​​快成为剩女，25岁的女子各方面早已准备好步入家​​庭，这种由内而外散发的成熟度，脸上 的气色再好，身材再好，最好的情况仍会被称之为”辣妈”。 25岁的台湾女性，开始享受”你大学毕业后就随便你”自由人生2、3年而已，这样的女孩，才刚体验自己做主的璀璨生活，努力朝自己的梦想前进，心境就像个 大顽童，即便皮肤不再像少女一样红润有光泽，在外人看起来就是个气色不好的”少女”。
2c3d104501e1622f623c801df26c31867f182573.translatedText: Recently, there was a 28-year-old Taiwanese woman next to the author who was mistakenly thought to be 18 years old by mainlanders, which set off a wave of people asking her age. Almost all Taiwanese women who can ask are underestimated by about 5-10 years old. One may be a case of flattery, but if many are like this, it is worthy of in-depth study. An excerpt from the article is as follows: A person's age can be gleaned from the complexion of the face, the tightness of the skin and other appearance conditions. Of course, there are many baby faces or young and mature anomalies among them to confuse the audience. But recently, there was a 28-year-old woman around me who was mistakenly thought to be 18 years old by mainlanders, which set off a wave of people asking about her age. Almost all Taiwanese women who could ask were underestimated by about 5 to 10 years old. This may be a case of flattery, but if many are like this, it is worthy of in-depth study. I have repeatedly thought about it, maybe it has something to do with the age gap between marriages between the two sides of the Taiwan Strait. In ancient times, starting a family first and then starting a career was related to maturity. It is undeniable that a person's maturity will make a big leap after getting married, and if you have children, your maturity will advance by leaps and bounds. A 25-year-old woman in Mainland China may already be the mother of several children in the countryside, but has almost become a leftover girl in the city. A 25-year-old woman is already ready to enter the family in all aspects. With this kind of maturity that radiates from the inside out, no matter how good her face is, no matter how good her figure is, she will still be called a "hot mom" in the best case scenario. It has only been 2 or 3 years since a 25-year-old Taiwanese woman began to enjoy the free life of "you can do whatever you want after you graduate from college." Such a girl has just experienced the splendid life of making her own decisions and is working hard to move forward with her dreams. She feels like a big naughty child. Even if her skin is no longer as rosy and shiny as a girl, she looks like a "girl" with a bad complexion to outsiders.

e07b39205b6bd528976bba905687ffe26b6b8cfe.translatedText: Feinian Chinese School Graduation Ceremony (Photos) On May 10, Feinian Chinese School in downtown Phoenix held its semester closing ceremony. Vice Principal Deng Junquan presided over...

4b0c2d51fde2de0a305d02416725159c877d9201.sourceText: 五月十日，地处凤凰城市区的斐匿中文学校举行了学期的结业典礼。邓军泉副校长主持了今天的典礼，并以孟母三迁等成语故事鼓励孩子们认真努力学习中华文化。学校董事长Eva Li 也到㑹作了讲话，她祝贺学生们通过努力在学业上取得了明顕进歩，对全体老师和义工们付出的辛勤劳动表示衷心的感谢，并对侨联总㑹、中歺舘协会对斐匿中文学校长期以来的支持和帮助表示感谢，寄语大家共同努力，使学校得到更好的发展。各班学生结合夲年度学到的知识进行了滙报演出。时值母亲节，孩子们的表演充满了对母亲的祝福，一年级的孩子们学会了用中文演唱”世上只有妈妈好”，还加上奶奶一起表演, 情真意切，十分感人。武术班的四位小朋友表演了两隻小狮子共舞，时而趴下，时而跃起，乐得小朋友个个手舞足蹈。会上，董事长Eva Li 和校长崔増祁向本年度优秀学生和全勤学生颁发了奨状。华人耆英㑹的王培鑫夫妇把自己从中国南京带来的精致的灯笼作为奬品送给了年度优秀学生，侨联顾问张华芳也为老师和义工送来了礼劵。师生和家长还一起品嚐了中歺馆协会为大家准备的精美午歺。结业典礼在家长们跳起的排列舞的欢笑声中结束。大家互祝暑期快乐，相约今年八月九日秋季开学再见。我校位于734 W ELM St. Phoenix AZ 85013, 新学员如欲报名，请电602-258-5670 崔校长或602-295-9651 邓校长联系。（斐匿中文学校来稿）
4b0c2d51fde2de0a305d02416725159c877d9201.translatedText: On May 10th, Feini Chinese School, located in downtown Phoenix City, held its semester graduation ceremony. Vice Principal Deng Junquan presided over today's ceremony and encouraged the children to study Chinese culture seriously and with idiom stories such as Mencius' mother moving three times. Eva Li, the school's chairman, also came to give a speech. She congratulated the students on their academic progress through hard work, expressed her heartfelt thanks to all the teachers and volunteers for their hard work, and expressed her gratitude to the Overseas Chinese Federation General Office and the Chinese Academy of Sciences Association for their long-term support and help to Feini Chinese School. She expressed her wish for everyone to work together to make the school develop better. Students in each class gave presentations and performances based on the knowledge they learned last year. It was Mother's Day, and the children's performance was full of blessings for their mothers. The first-grade children learned to sing "Only Mom is Good in the World" in Chinese, and even performed with their grandma, which was sincere and very touching. Four children from the martial arts class performed a dance between two little lions, sometimes lying down and sometimes jumping up, which made all the children dance with joy. At the meeting, Chairman Eva Li and Principal Cui Changqi issued certificates of honor to outstanding students and perfect attendance students this year. Wang Peixin and his wife, Chinese senior citizens, gave exquisite lanterns they brought from Nanjing, China as prizes to outstanding students of the year. Zhang Huafang, consultant of the Overseas Chinese Federation, also sent gift coupons to teachers and volunteers. Teachers, students and parents also enjoyed the exquisite lunch prepared by the Chinese Academy of Sciences Association. The graduation ceremony ended with the laughter of the parents performing a line dance. Everyone wishes each other a happy summer and see you again on August 9 this year when the fall semester begins. Our school is located at 734 W ELM St. Phoenix AZ 85013. If new students want to register, please call Principal Cui at 602-258-5670 or Principal Deng at 602-295-9651. (Submitted by Feini Chinese School)

a9ef598f46edbfac1e856332f9b62f1f7749a164.sourceText: 破产房屋量正在“大刹车” 亚利桑那2011年上半年申请破产的房屋只有19080间，比去年同一时期减少了7.5%。 从全美破产法院得到的最新消息全州申请破产的房屋已经大量减少。 下面我们来看一些具体的数据。 6月份，被清算的破产房屋（符合Chapter 7），图森558栋，下降了7.5%， 凤凰城2089栋，下降了5.3%，全州2798栋，下降了6.4%。 前半年三个城市平均月破产量刚好都是7.5%。 破产房屋一般会比正常销售的房屋价格低20%，因为大量的破产房屋出现，就会直接影响到市场房屋的价格，去年11月底，正常销售的房屋价格都因破产屋数量的激增大受影响 ，大大跌价。 破产屋的数量的”’大刹车”’，意味着打破市场价格的低价房屋会越来越少，这将会非常有利市场价格的稳定。 如有更多买房的问题可电话咨询金信地产公司的Tinna 4802870180或电子信箱：goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
a9ef598f46edbfac1e856332f9b62f1f7749a164.translatedText: The number of bankrupt houses in Arizona was "bringing to a "big brake". There were only 19,080 houses in Arizona that filed for bankruptcy in the first half of 2011, a decrease of 7.5% from the same period last year. The latest news from bankruptcy courts across the country has seen a significant decline in home bankruptcy filings across the state. Let’s look at some specific data below. In June, the number of liquidated bankrupt homes (eligible for Chapter 7) was 558 in Tucson, a decrease of 7.5%, 2,089 in Phoenix, a decrease of 5.3%, and 2,798 statewide, a decrease of 6.4%. In the first half of the year, the average monthly bankruptcies in the three cities were exactly 7.5%. The price of bankrupt houses is generally 20% lower than that of normally sold houses. Because the emergence of a large number of bankrupt houses will directly affect the price of houses on the market. At the end of November last year, the price of normally sold houses was greatly affected by the surge in the number of bankrupt houses, and the prices dropped significantly. The "big brake" on the number of bankrupt houses means that there will be fewer and fewer low-priced houses that break the market price, which will be very beneficial to the stability of market prices. If you have more questions about buying a house, please call Tinna of Gold Trust Realty Company at 4802870180 or email: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

5d65ec6a2412be1f31c3542ab35fc4f253f6a40c.sourceText: 香港行政长官梁振英在北京与中共中央总书记、国家副主席习近平会面，二人在会面前握手。
5d65ec6a2412be1f31c3542ab35fc4f253f6a40c.translatedText: Hong Kong Chief Executive Leung Chun-ying met with General Secretary of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and Vice President Xi Jinping in Beijing. The two shook hands before the meeting.

757486e869739a9f083a35ac651e3c2ac85f59ba.sourceText: 据香港政府新闻网消息，习近平今日会见到北京述职的梁振英，两人先握手，习近平表示，中央关注新一届特区政府上任以来梁振英团队的工作，表示特区政府工作奋发进取，务实有为，工作繁重而且辛苦，中央对特区政府的工作表示肯定，会继续坚定支持特区政府依法施政。梁振英在会面时感谢总书记的勉励和支持。
757486e869739a9f083a35ac651e3c2ac85f59ba.translatedText: According to the Hong Kong Government News Network, Xi Jinping will meet with Leung Chun-ying, who is reporting on his work in Beijing today. The two shook hands first. Xi Jinping said that the central government is paying attention to the work of Leung Chun-ying's team since the new SAR government took office. He said that the work of the SAR government is enterprising, pragmatic and promising, and the work is heavy and hard. The central government affirms the work of the SAR government and will continue to firmly support the SAR government in administering governance in accordance with the law. During the meeting, Liang Zhenying thanked the General Secretary for his encouragement and support.

8278b0261149ef76c792bc9c95ea33c0ed6a4913.sourceText: 以下是行政长官梁振英今日(12月20日)在北京会见传媒的谈话全文：
8278b0261149ef76c792bc9c95ea33c0ed6a4913.translatedText: The following is the full text of Chief Executive Leung Chun-ying's speech when he met with the media in Beijing today (December 20):

91ec55aa8c18210c72d9da16b6a4cfea07332ce0.sourceText: 行政长官：大家好。今次是我就任后第一次来北京述职。刚刚我向总书记汇报了香港社会、经济与政治的情况，以及特区政府在来年的工作重点。
91ec55aa8c18210c72d9da16b6a4cfea07332ce0.translatedText: Chief Executive: Hello everyone. This is the first time I have come to Beijing to report on my work since taking office. I have just reported to the General Secretary on Hong Kong’s social, economic and political situation, as well as the SAR government’s work priorities in the coming year.

9a22d2bc2f9b3a3aa17d8995fbe7e7ca1e0e7d2e.sourceText: 在会面时，我感谢总书记对新一届政府上任以来工作的肯定。习总书记表示，新政府「奋发进取、务实有为」。他指出，我们的团队工作繁重而且辛苦，但仍然能够积极进取，施政的思路清晰，他对我和我的团队表示信任和有信心。
9a22d2bc2f9b3a3aa17d8995fbe7e7ca1e0e7d2e.translatedText: During the meeting, I thanked the General Secretary for his affirmation of the work of the new government since it took office. General Secretary Xi said that the new government is "forge ahead, pragmatic and promising." He pointed out that our team's work is heavy and hard, but it is still proactive and has clear ideas for governance. He expressed his trust and confidence in me and my team.

682649f0b70c66bfca3126e5f5d4c3336ea1a093.sourceText: 他表示，中央对特区政府的工作会继续坚定支持我们依法施政。总书记亦表示，中央实现领导集团的新老交替后，对港澳的大政方针是没有变化的。中央会贯彻「一国两制」以及尊重和维护《基本法》的权威。
682649f0b70c66bfca3126e5f5d4c3336ea1a093.translatedText: He said that the central government will continue to firmly support the work of the SAR government in our governance in accordance with the law. The general secretary also said that after the central government realizes the replacement of the old and new leadership groups, the major policies for Hong Kong and Macao will not change. The Central Committee will implement "one country, two systems" and respect and safeguard the authority of the Basic Law.

06b6c5f0f6dbca644042fa95934e1c0249f355b0.sourceText: 总书记指出，现时国家的发展形势很好，民族复兴的壮丽前景就在前面，他相信香港同胞念兹在兹，亦都会与全国同胞一样，为复兴民族大业贡献力量。
06b6c5f0f6dbca644042fa95934e1c0249f355b0.translatedText: General Secretary pointed out that the current development situation of the country is very good, and the magnificent prospect of national rejuvenation lies ahead. He believes that Hong Kong compatriots are mindful of this and will contribute to the great cause of national rejuvenation like compatriots across the country.

407b5b9ce4e741117e6a51432b4c543643ad1207.sourceText: 我在会面时感谢总书记的勉励和支持，我提出在前不久的时间，我们在香港仔细阅读了十八大的报告，看到国家未来发展的方向和蓝图，感到非常鼓舞。总书记在十八大会议后对新闻界的讲话，从中我们亦可以看到国家在新一轮发展当中的力量。我指出，香港过去三十多年的经验很清楚地说明，在国家的新一轮发展当中，香港肯定可以从中取得香港社会下一步发展的重要动力。而同样重要的，就是香港亦可以为国家做好下一轮发展应有的贡献。我对我们国家实现国家富强和民族振兴表示充满信心。
407b5b9ce4e741117e6a51432b4c543643ad1207.translatedText: I thanked the General Secretary for his encouragement and support during the meeting. I mentioned that not long ago, we carefully read the report of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China in Hong Kong and were very encouraged to see the direction and blueprint for the country's future development. The General Secretary’s speech to the press after the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, from which we can also see the country’s strength in a new round of development. I pointed out that Hong Kong's experience over the past thirty years clearly shows that in the country's new round of development, Hong Kong will definitely be able to obtain important impetus for the next development of Hong Kong society. And equally important, Hong Kong can also make its due contribution to the country's next round of development. I am confident that our country will achieve national prosperity and national rejuvenation.

dc388950b491550a61d019e734a1bf6a352f12e9.sourceText: 这些就是刚才与总书记和其他中央领导人会面的一个扼要简报。稍后我会在我们的驻京办与在北京和周边地区工作、经商的香港人见面，了解他们在内地的工作和生活情况。我知道中国香港地区商会在国内七个地方有设点的，今晚除了北京的朋友来参加外，还有其他四个地方，即青岛、上海、武汉和成都，这四个地方都有代表来这里与我交换意见。我知道这个参与是第一次，我希望日后有更加多的机会与在内地工作、经商的朋友交流和会面。
dc388950b491550a61d019e734a1bf6a352f12e9.translatedText: This is a brief summary of the meeting with the General Secretary and other central leaders just now. Later, I will meet with Hong Kong people working and doing business in Beijing and surrounding areas at our Beijing Office to learn about their work and living conditions on the mainland. I know that the Hong Kong Chamber of Commerce in China has offices in seven places in the country. In addition to friends from Beijing, there are also four other places, namely Qingdao, Shanghai, Wuhan and Chengdu. Representatives from these four places are here to exchange views with me. I know this is my first time participating in this event, and I hope to have more opportunities to communicate and meet with friends who work and do business in the Mainland in the future.

70b081fbe3560a7060cc43048a40a72af4c6b19a.sourceText: 来到北京后，大家都知道这里的温度比较低，希望大家尤其是在户外工作时，能够注意保暖，保重身体。
70b081fbe3560a7060cc43048a40a72af4c6b19a.translatedText: After arriving in Beijing, everyone knows that the temperature here is relatively low. I hope everyone can pay attention to keeping warm and taking care of themselves, especially when working outdoors.

ac7d3b0677a55ecd82d041d4060f01d9bf12d15f.sourceText: 记者：梁先生，你有没有与主席交代到你的僭建问题呢?以及习近平有没有问你关于僭建的问题?你怎样回答他呢?
ac7d3b0677a55ecd82d041d4060f01d9bf12d15f.translatedText: Reporter: Mr. Liang, did you explain your problem of unauthorized construction to the Chairman? And did Xi Jinping ask you about the problem of unauthorized construction? How did you answer him?

619945e6c86706e6611c3f3f00df5b870fd9d1db.sourceText: 记者∶……未来的施政重点是什么?会不会采取更多的措施来进一步促进香港与内地在金融各个领域上的合作?
619945e6c86706e6611c3f3f00df5b870fd9d1db.translatedText: Reporter: ...What will be the focus of future policy? Will more measures be taken to further promote cooperation between Hong Kong and the Mainland in various financial fields?

27e8be45c5d3f1321b126b1f61fc57567d2b1708.sourceText: 行政长官∶特区政府在未来一段时间包括明年，施政重点有五个方面，一个是经济发展，因为要解决香港长期以来累积的社会问题、民生问题，需要有比较高的经济发展速度，持续比较高的经济发展速度，才可以解决。有四个民生社会问题，一个是贫穷问题、房屋问题、老年社会问题，还有环境保护问题。这五个方面，就一个经济问题加上四个社会民生问题，是特区政府未来一段时间的施政重点。
27e8be45c5d3f1321b126b1f61fc57567d2b1708.translatedText: Chief Executive: Special In the coming period, including next year, the district government will focus on five areas of policy. One is economic development, because to solve the social problems and people's livelihood problems that have accumulated in Hong Kong for a long time, a relatively high economic development speed and a sustained and relatively high economic development speed can be solved. There are four people's livelihood and social issues, one is poverty, housing, social issues for the elderly, and environmental protection. These five aspects, one economic issue plus four social and people's livelihood issues, will be the focus of the SAR government's policy in the coming period.

f01cc29e73f7b75a9fef09b465920850e46ecfd6.sourceText: 记者：……你会如何回应立法会议员准备向你提弹劾动议?
f01cc29e73f7b75a9fef09b465920850e46ecfd6.translatedText: Reporter: ...how would you respond to the members of the Legislative Council preparing to propose an impeachment motion to you?

15ea0ecc60320cf701fd3114ae24d9f616276127.sourceText: 行政长官：我会重视立法会和社会对我工作的不同的意见，下去我会集中精力做好特区的施政工作，务实地与香港人一起，做好香港经济民生各方面建设的工作。
15ea0ecc60320cf701fd3114ae24d9f616276127.translatedText: Chief Executive: I will pay attention to the different opinions of the Legislative Council and society on my work. Going forward, I will concentrate on the administrative work of the SAR and work pragmatically with the people of Hong Kong to do a good job in building all aspects of Hong Kong's economy and people's livelihood.

48755cc893bc05de234af2c116a4a6073b8fa149.sourceText: 行政长官：我非常重视香港与内地在各个方面的关系，尤其是经济发展关系。在香港与内地的关系当中，当然香港与广东的关系一直以来非常密切，将来这方面的潜质也非常大。
48755cc893bc05de234af2c116a4a6073b8fa149.translatedText: Chief Executive: I attach great importance to the relationship between Hong Kong and the Mainland in all aspects, especially the economic development relationship. Among the relations between Hong Kong and the Mainland, of course, the relations between Hong Kong and Guangdong have always been very close, and the potential in this regard is also very great in the future.

051c43d2d595158e1952d460c3b8e0bb4085d871.translatedText: New York declares a state of emergency to prevent hurricanes New York Governor Cuomo declares a state of emergency on Friday to prepare for Hurricane Sandy...

dbfe78b3e6d9b37faea15956929218b8673b3e50.sourceText: 纽约宣布进入紧急状态防范飓风侵袭 纽约州长库莫周五宣布全州进入紧急预警状态以应对飓风”珊迪”来袭。预计届时3.75万纽约市民会被撤离。 根据气象局预告，飓风珊迪最早将于本周日抵达纽约，彭博表示将会在周六晚些时候做出撤离决定。 ”我们正积极采取一切行动，但是目前还很难具体知晓飓风会在何时何地登录。”彭博市长在周五下午的新闻发布会上说道。 彭博表示，将会采取”艾琳”来袭时的相同做法，使用公交车将地势较低区域的人们从医院和看护所中撤离。如果情况严重，周一中小学将停课。 大都会运输署(MTA)主席洛塔(Joseph Lhota)表示在风速到达39英里每小时前，MTA可能考虑再次关闭交通系统。 预计于下周二袭击美东地区的飓风珊迪(Sandy)可能与一个来自西部的冬季暴风，和来自加拿大的冷气团结合，形成一个罕见的”怪兽风暴”(Frankenstorm)，带来强风、洪水、暴雨、甚至暴风雪，专家预期，珊迪的威力远超过去年8月的艾琳飓风，将造成10亿元的损失。新泽西州和纽约市将受到最大的冲击。 珊迪25日已越过海地和牙买加，造成40人死亡，并继续向北行进，气象人员预测，珊迪将在万圣节前的30日上午侵袭新泽西州和纽约市，如果它与冬季暴风和冷空气结合，将会为人口最密集的东岸地区，并直到内陆的俄亥俄州带来重大灾情。 根据气象局周四晚间预报显示，珊迪风力已从2级减弱至1级，并在登陆美国大陆后降级为热带风暴。但警告风暴”会对美国东北部造成威胁。” 政府气象预报人员说，有90%的机会珊迪会从本周日起侵袭东岸，届时可能会有6-8英寸的降雨和时速近40哩的强风，俄亥俄州东部、宾州西南部、维吉尼亚州西部，和席南多山脉可能下雪。
dbfe78b3e6d9b37faea15956929218b8673b3e50.translatedText: New York declares a state of emergency to prevent hurricanes New York Governor Cuomo declares a state of emergency on Friday to prepare for Hurricane Sandy. It is expected that 37,500 New Yorkers will be evacuated by then. According to the Weather Bureau forecast, Hurricane Sandy will arrive in New York as early as Sunday. Bloomberg said that an evacuation decision will be made later on Saturday. "We are actively taking all actions, but it is still difficult to know exactly when and where the hurricane will make landfall." "Mayor Bloomberg said at a press conference on Friday afternoon. Bloomberg said that the same approach will be taken when "Irene" hits, using buses to evacuate people in lower-lying areas from hospitals and nursing homes. If the situation is serious, elementary and middle schools will be closed on Monday. Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA) Chairman Joseph Lhota said that before the wind speed reaches 39 miles per hour, the MTA may consider shutting down the transportation system again. Hurricane Sandy, which is expected to hit the eastern United States next Tuesday, may combine with a winter storm from the west and a cold air mass from Canada to form a rare "Monster Storm" (Frankenstorm), bringing strong winds, flooding, heavy rain, and even blizzards. Experts predict that Sandy will be far more powerful than Hurricane Irene in August last year and will cause $1 billion in damage. New Jersey and New York City will be hardest hit. Sandy has crossed Haiti and Jamaica on the 25th, killing 40 people, and continues to move north. Forecasters predict that Sandy will hit New Jersey and New York City on the morning of the 30th before Halloween. If it combines with winter storms and cold air, it will bring major disasters to the most densely populated East Coast areas and as far as inland Ohio. According to the Weather Bureau's Thursday night forecast, Sandy's winds have weakened from Category 2 to Category 1, and it has been downgraded to a tropical storm after landing in the continental United States, but it warned that the storm "will pose a threat to the northeastern United States." " Government weather forecasters said there is a 90% chance that Sandy will hit the East Coast starting this Sunday. There may be 6-8 inches of rain and strong winds of nearly 40 miles per hour. Snow may fall in eastern Ohio, southwestern Pennsylvania, western Virginia, and the Sinando Mountains.

6b5a694cd34ed4cf714580526cc61653c33cd264.sourceText: 中国希望美安全审查制度进一步公开透明 华尔街日报报道：在中国企业对美投资迅速增长之际，中国商务部长陈德铭呼吁美国国家安全审查能够再公开透明一点。 去年中国对美国的直接投资规模达到纪录水平，分析师称，今年还有大约50亿美元的中国对美投资等待美国监管部门的批准。 双边投资的迅猛增长导致中国企业在监管审查时遇到问题，美国最常用的理由是危及美国国家安全，而中方认为这一理由太过模糊。 陈德铭在全国人大会议的新闻发布会上表示，每个国家都需要自己的安全审查，中国也需要这么做，中国也要学习美国的安全审查。 陈德铭说，同时在跟美国的交往中，中方非常希望这种安全审查能够再公开透明一点，让企业有预见性，因为企业往往不知道所投资项目是否符合美国的国家安全要求。 近期一些中国的海外投资与美国海外投资委员会(Committee on Foreign Investment)发生冲突，最终被联邦监管机构否决。 华为技术有限公司2008年对美国网络安全公司3Com以及2010年对摩托罗拉无线设备业务发起的竞购都因美方的国家安全顾虑而夭折。 去年10月份，美国国会下属的一个委员会在一份报告中警告称，华为和中国中兴通讯股份有限公司生产的电讯设备对美国国家安全构成威胁。两家公司均对这一指控予以否认。 也是在去年10月份，中国重工业巨头三一集团有限公司就该公司投资俄勒冈州一家风力发电厂受阻一事起 诉奥巴马政府，称美国不公平地排斥中国企业。三一还告诫称，美方对该公司竞购作出的裁决将对进一步的海外投资构成威胁。 不过，美国监管机构上月却批准了中国迄今为止规模最大的一笔海外收购交易，即中国海洋石油有限公司斥资151亿美元收购加拿大油气公司尼克森。 美国海外投资委员会还在去年12月底批准了中国华大基因斥资1.18亿美元收购加州山景城的交易，不过该交易仍有待美国反垄断机构和中国监管机构的批准。 陈德铭周五还向记者表示，中国石油化工集团公司在准备收购美国的叶岩气项目，考虑收购这些项目30%-50%的股份。 中石化集团在1月份成功地以25亿美元收购了戴文能源公司的部分权益，将在俄亥俄州和密歇根州开采叶岩气田。这是该公司在美国的首笔并购交易。 据跟踪中国对外投资的纽约咨询公司Rhodium Group提供的数据，去年中国对美国的直接投资创纪录最高水平，完成交易的金额达到65亿美元，较2010年创下的前纪录高点55亿美元增长17%。 Rhodium称，鉴于还有大约50亿美元的中国对美投资等待美国监管部门批准，预计今年对美投资很可能会保持上述增长势头。 Rhodium的分析师Thilo Hanemann在一份报告中称，中国的结构性改革、有利于对外投资的政策环境以及美国经济前景改善将有助于中国资金持续流入美国。
6b5a694cd34ed4cf714580526cc61653c33cd264.translatedText: China hopes that the U.S. security review system will be more open and transparent. The Wall Street Journal reported: As Chinese companies’ investments in the United States are growing rapidly, Chinese Commerce Minister Chen Deming called on the U.S. to make its national security review more open and transparent. China's direct investment in the United States reached a record level last year, and analysts say there are still about $5 billion in Chinese investment in the United States awaiting approval from U.S. regulatory authorities this year. The rapid growth of bilateral investment has caused Chinese companies to encounter problems during regulatory review. The most common reason used by the United States is that it endangers U.S. national security, but China believes that this reason is too vague. Chen Deming said at the press conference of the National People's Congress that every country needs its own security review, China needs to do the same, and China must also learn from the United States' security review. Chen Deming said that at the same time in its interactions with the United States, China very much hopes that this kind of security review can be more open and transparent so that companies can have predictability, because companies often do not know whether the projects they invest in meet the national security requirements of the United States. Some recent Chinese overseas investments have run afoul of the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States and were ultimately blocked by federal regulators. Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd.'s bids for U.S. network security company 3Com in 2008 and Motorola's wireless equipment business in 2010 both failed due to U.S. national security concerns. In October last year, a committee of the U.S. Congress warned in a report that telecommunications equipment produced by Huawei and China's ZTE Corporation posed a threat to U.S. national security. Both companies deny the accusation. Also in October last year, Chinese heavy industry giant Sany Group Co., Ltd. sued the Obama administration over its investment in a wind farm in Oregon, claiming that the United States was unfairly excluding Chinese companies. Sany also warned that the U.S. ruling on the company's bid would pose a threat to further overseas investment. However, U.S. regulators last month approved China's largest overseas acquisition to date, China National Offshore Oil Corporation's $15.1 billion acquisition of Canadian oil and gas company Nexen. The Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States also approved China's BGI's $118 million acquisition of Mountain View, California, at the end of December last year, but the deal still needs approval from U.S. antitrust agencies and Chinese regulators. Chen Deming also told reporters on Friday that China Petrochemical Corporation is preparing to acquire shale gas projects in the United States and is considering acquiring 30%-50% of the shares in these projects. Sinopec Group successfully acquired a partial interest in Devon Energy Company for US$2.5 billion in January and will exploit leaf rock gas fields in Ohio and Michigan. This is the company's first acquisition in the United States. According to data provided by Rhodium Group, a New York consulting firm that tracks China's foreign investment, China's direct investment in the United States hit a record high last year, with the amount of completed transactions reaching $6.5 billion, a 17% increase from the previous record high of $5.5 billion set in 2010. Rhodium said that given that there are still approximately US$5 billion in Chinese investment in the United States awaiting approval from US regulatory authorities, it is expected that investment in the United States is likely to maintain the above-mentioned growth momentum this year. Thilo Hanemann, an analyst at Rhodium, said in a report that China's structural reforms, a policy environment conducive to foreign investment and the improvement of the U.S. economic outlook will help Chinese funds continue to flow into the United States.

80873cc6eefb52e0c95315536c4414acd4d75708.sourceText: (亚省华人华侨联合会供稿) 第七届《凤凰之夜》庆祝中华人民共和国成立64周年国庆招待会暨中秋佳节将于2013年9月22日在亚利桑那州立大学隆重举行。为了筹办这次活动，亚省华人华侨联合会会长王惟咨于8月10日召开了第二次筹备会议。会议由秘书长董斌主持。 王惟咨首先对大家为华人社区活动的无私奉献表示衷心的感谢，并预祝庆祝活动取得圆满成功，并向大家介绍了庆中秋迎国庆系列活动的整体规划和最新进展情况。按照会议议程，各项活动负责人向与会人员汇报了各项工作的准备情况。徐智萍、谭国明汇报了中美文化论坛、青少年海报比赛和摄影比赛活动安排的进展，并邀请到了三位嘉宾在中美文化论坛上做主题演讲。费健向与会人员说明了国庆招待会的具体事项，并介绍了由当地艺术家、Chandler 儿童合唱团和ASU学生表演节目的落实情况。林欣向大家汇报了中秋联谊舞会的准备情况，并号召大家积极邀请亲朋好友，参加于9月22日晚七点至九点，在ASU Memorial Union Arizona Ballroom 举行的大型中秋联谊舞会。目前青少年海报比赛和摄影比赛的准备工作也在进行之中。具体活动安排如下: 1) 中美文化论坛：3:00 PM – 5:00 PM, ASU Memorial Union Turquoise Room 220。 2) 国庆招待会：5:00 PM – 7:00 PM, ASU Memorial Union Arizona Ballroom。 3) 青少年海报和摄影比赛颁奖典礼：5:00 PM – 7:00 PM, ASU Memorial Union Arizona Ballroom。 4) 中秋联谊舞会：7:00 PM – 9:00 PM, ASU Memorial Union Arizona Ballroom。 此次”凤凰之夜”大型系列庆祝活动，由亚省华人华侨联合会和亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院共同主办，并由大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会、亚利桑那州立大学中国学生学者联谊会、亚省现代中文学校、亚省希望中文学校、以及亚省时报协办。组织者都是义务志愿者，他们白天工作，晚上和周末挤出个人的休息时间来参与庆祝活动的筹备工作。在筹备过程中，得到了许多社会团体、志愿者的积极参与和大力支持。大家唯一的心愿就是努力把这次迎中秋庆国庆系列活动办好，给社区和华人华侨交上一份满意的答卷！
80873cc6eefb52e0c95315536c4414acd4d75708.translatedText: (Contributed by the Alberta Chinese Overseas Chinese Federation) The seventh "Phoenix Night" celebration of the 64th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China and the Mid-Autumn Festival will be held grandly at Arizona State University on September 22, 2013. In order to prepare for this event, Wang Weizi, president of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Alberta, held the second preparatory meeting on August 10. The meeting was chaired by Secretary-General Dong Bin. Wang Weizi first expressed his heartfelt thanks to everyone for their selfless dedication to Chinese community activities, and wished the celebration a complete success. He also introduced to everyone the overall planning and latest progress of the series of activities to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival and the National Day. According to the meeting agenda, the person in charge of each activity reported the preparation status of various tasks to the participants. Xu Zhiping and Tan Guoming reported on the progress of the Sino-US Cultural Forum, Youth Poster Competition and Photography Competition, and invited three guests to give keynote speeches at the Sino-US Cultural Forum. Fei Jian explained the specific matters of the National Day reception to the participants and introduced the implementation of the performances by local artists, Chandler Children's Chorus and ASU students. Lin Xin reported to everyone the preparations for the Mid-Autumn Festival Ball, and called on everyone to actively invite relatives and friends to participate in the large-scale Mid-Autumn Ball held at the ASU Memorial Union Arizona Ballroom from 7 to 9 pm on September 22. Preparations for the Youth Poster Competition and Photography Competition are also in progress. The specific event schedule is as follows: 1) Sino-US Cultural Forum: 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM, ASU Memorial Union Turquoise Room 220. 2) National Day Reception: 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM, ASU Memorial Union Arizona Ballroom. 3) Youth Poster and Photography Contest Awards Ceremony: 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM, ASU Memorial Union Arizona Ballroom. 4) Mid-Autumn Festival Dance: 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM, ASU Memorial Union Arizona Ballroom. This large-scale series of "Phoenix Night" celebrations is co-sponsored by the Chinese Overseas Chinese Association of Alberta and the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, and co-organized by the Chinese Overseas Chinese Association of Greater Phoenix, the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of Arizona State University, the Alberta Modern Chinese School, the Alberta Hope Chinese School, and the Alberta Times. The organizers are all volunteers who work during the day and squeeze out their personal breaks in the evenings and weekends to participate in the preparations for the celebrations. During the preparation process, many social groups and volunteers received active participation and strong support. Our only wish is to work hard to successfully organize this series of activities to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day, and provide a satisfactory answer to the community and overseas Chinese!

e496d9ec1c324f2648bfcee12e3cf48ff83e62e5.sourceText: （希望中文学校供稿, 摄影周青，邓筠）11/10星期日, 希望中文学校由校长谢小红带队参加了在美莎市的亚洲节的表演庆祝活动。 师生们全情投入，认真演出。其中有热情奔放, 青春洋溢的《绽放》；天真烂漫, 活泼欢快的少儿歌舞《春晓》；奔放豪迈, 纵横驰骋的《草原母亲》；傣族姑娘水边嬉戏, 舞姿曼妙的《傣族姑娘在水边》。另外中文舞剧表演的国粹《说唱脸谱》集京剧，武术，舞蹈，RAP于一体，及中文舞剧《千古美人》都以其丰富的文化故事，独特的服装造型，惊艳观众。 整个演出精彩纷呈, 掌声阵阵, 笑声洋溢。欢笑中, 我们让各族裔领略到中华舞蹈的独特魅力，感受中华文化的博大精深!
e496d9ec1c324f2648bfcee12e3cf48ff83e62e5.translatedText: (Contributed by Hope Chinese School, photographed by Zhou Qing, Deng Yun) 11/10 Sunday, Hope Chinese School, led by principal Xie Xiaohong, participated in the performance celebration of the Asia Festival in Mesa City. The teachers and students were fully engaged and performed seriously. Among them are the passionate and youthful "Blooming"; the innocent, lively and cheerful children's song and dance "Spring Dawn"; the unrestrained and heroic "Prairie Mother", where the Dai girls play and dance gracefully by the water. In addition, the Chinese dance drama "Rap Mask", the quintessence of Chinese culture, integrates Peking Opera, martial arts, dance, and RAP, and the Chinese dance drama "Eternal Beauty" both amazed the audience with their rich cultural stories and unique costume styles. The whole performance was wonderful, with bursts of applause and laughter. In laughter, we allow all ethnic groups to appreciate the unique charm of Chinese dance and feel the breadth and depth of Chinese culture!

6ca5df35224d3a7ed8b0015d2d7f87b4349519d7.sourceText: 凤儿家是经营中药材的中药店，有趣的是右边邻居，有一对孔姓夫妻开的是西药店。孔先生以经营西药为主，孔太太是助产士，凤儿就是由她接生来到这个世界。凤儿和喜儿两家，各有经营之道，未见两家有任何摩擦。大人和大人、小孩与小孩之间，相处都很融恰。凤儿家有父母亲及5兄妹，孔先生夫妻也有5个孩子。凤儿和孔姓夫妻的三女儿，年龄一般大，她的名子叫”繁玺”，上小学时因不会写太难写的”繁玺”二字的名子，而改名叫”凡一”，这下好了，再不用为难写得名子发愁了，但平时凤儿与她还是用乳名喜儿相称。 喜儿在家中上有两个姐姐下有两个弟弟，属于那种上不被父母崇爱、下不被姐姐弟弟喜欢的受夹板气的那种孩子，所以性格有些内向，只有两个小女孩单独在一起时，才能看到她那少有的开心笑脸。 凤儿和喜儿两家是一墙之隔的邻居，在觧放前家家都挖防空洞的时侯，两家的防空洞就在一牆之下互相通着，如果一家有事，可以从另一家的出口逃出。凤儿的哥哥姐姐与喜儿的姐姐年龄相当，他 (她) 们差不多同读一个中学，凤儿和喜儿同读一所小学，经常结伴一起上学，也经常在一起读些小画书，讲讲故事、说说悄悄话。与大人不能讲的事情，两个小女孩挤到一块，就叽叽喳喳的说个没完没了，回想起那时候小孩子真幸福，大人很少有时间管这些小孩，所以有很多自由的时间，做自己想做的事。星期天或放假不去上学的日子，也挎上小蓝和小朋友们去南郊山下挖野菜，其实也不太认识哪些能吃、哪些不能吃，只是跟着出去跑跑好玩而已，就像和小朋友一起郊游，挖得的野菜分给其它小朋友，高高兴兴回家了。 小学毕业后，凤儿就读铁路职工子弟中学，喜儿不是铁路职工子弟，就读于另一所中学，功课多了两人见面的机会少了，后来凤儿在中等专业技术学校，喜儿考取医学院，很久没有见面的两个女孩，在一个偶然的情况下相遇了。凤儿见喜儿情绪不高、脸色也不太好，就关切地问喜儿有什么事吗？喜儿告诉凤儿说：自己最近身体有病已休学，在家调养一段时间，等病好了再复学。对于喜儿的不幸，凤儿给预极大的同情，安慰她病会很快好的，年轻人没有问题。后来才听说：喜儿是因为上大学期间谈恋爱，被学校开除。那时学校管理很严，严禁在校期间谈恋爱，很为喜儿挽惜。 后来城市建设搞拆迁，凤儿住的那条繁华大街要拓宽街道，整条街道的人家都进行了搬迁，喜儿家也不知迁往何处。多年后，凤儿在街上遇见喜儿的母亲，在攀谈中了觧到，当时学校对喜儿的处理过于严厉，后来对她落实政策，改为医学院肄业，并按排在一家小工厂做厂医，现已结婚有了两个女几儿，做了母亲，现在生活的还不错。凤儿听了以后很为喜儿高兴，她总算可以抬起头来做人，差一点就一失足成千仇恨。本来谈恋爱也不是多大的事，批评教育一下就可以，开除学籍的处理方法，是一棍子将人打死的方法，没有任何回旋的余地，不利于年青人的成长。 同是共同长大的两个小女孩，却经历了不同的生长道路。记得小时侯，去喜儿家玩，她们家墙上挂有耶稣基督受难的油画(当时并不明白) ，也讲逾越节等圣经上的故事，她们家的父母，肯定也是信耶稣基督的基督徒。但是后来政治风云突变，谁也不敢承认自己是基督徒，人们渐渐远离、脱离了基督教，我想喜儿家肯定也在其中。凤儿是在 神的眷顾、保守下，神引领她们全家人来到美国，有机会接触到教会，听到了福音投到主的怀抱，是多么有福气的一家人。祈求神同样也保守、眷顾喜儿一家，也能在大陆的不同环境中，寻找到早年就是主的儿女的喜儿一家人，在百年以后，她们两家人能在天上再相见，一起赞美歌颂神，把一切赞美和荣耀都归给神！
6ca5df35224d3a7ed8b0015d2d7f87b4349519d7.translatedText: Feng'er's family is a traditional Chinese medicine store that sells Chinese medicinal materials. What's interesting is that the neighbor on the right, a couple named Kong, runs a Western medicine store. Mr. Kong mainly deals in Western medicine, and Mrs. Kong is a midwife. It was she who delivered Feng'er into this world. Feng'er and Xi'er each have their own business methods, and there is no friction between the two families. Adults and adults and children get along well with each other. Feng'er's family has parents and five brothers and sisters. Mr. Kong and his wife also have five children. Feng'er and the third daughter of the couple named Kong are about the same age. Her name is "Fan Xi". When she was in elementary school, she changed her name to "Fan Yi" because she couldn't write the word "Fan Xi" which was too difficult to write. Now, she no longer has to worry about writing a name, but Feng'er and she still use their nickname Xi'er. Xi'er has two older sisters and two younger brothers at home. She is a stuck-up child who is not loved by her parents and not liked by her older sisters and younger brothers. Therefore, her personality is somewhat introverted. Her rare happy smile can only be seen when the two little girls are alone together. Feng'er and Xi'er are neighbors separated by a wall. Before liberation, when every family dug air-raid shelters, the air-raid shelters of the two families were connected to each other under the same wall. If something happened to one family, they could escape through the exit of the other family. Feng'er's brother and sister are about the same age as Xi'er's sister. They almost go to the same middle school. Feng'er and Xi'er go to the same elementary school. They often go to school together, and often read little picture books together, tell stories, and whisper. Things that adults cannot talk about, the two little girls crowded together and chatted endlessly. Looking back at that time, children were really happy. Adults rarely had time to care about these children, so they had a lot of free time to do what they wanted to do. On Sundays or days when I don’t go to school during holidays, I would take Xiaolan and her children with me to dig wild vegetables at the foot of the southern suburbs. In fact, I don’t really know which ones are edible and which ones are not. I just go out for a run and have fun. It’s like going on an outing with children. The wild vegetables I dig are distributed to other children, and I go home happily. After graduating from elementary school, Feng'er went to a middle school for the children of railway workers. Xi'er was not a child of railway workers and studied in another middle school. With more homework, the two had fewer opportunities to meet. Later, Feng'er went to a secondary technical school and Xi'er was admitted to medical school. The two girls, who had not seen each other for a long time, met by chance. When Feng'er saw that Xi'er was not in a high mood and didn't look well, she asked Xi'er with concern if something was wrong. Xi'er told Feng'er that she had been sick recently and had stopped going to school. She was recuperating at home for a while and would resume school when she recovered. Feng'er expressed great sympathy for Xi'er's misfortune and comforted her that she would recover soon and that the young man had no problems. Later I heard that Xi'er was expelled from school because she fell in love while in college. At that time, the school management was very strict, and it was strictly forbidden to fall in love during school. I felt sorry for Xi'er. Later, due to urban construction and demolition, the bustling street where Feng'er lived had to be widened, and all the families in the street were relocated. Xi'er's family didn't know where to move. Many years later, Feng'er met Xi'er's mother on the street. During the conversation, she learned that the school's treatment of Xi'er was too harsh at that time. Later, the policy was implemented against Xi'er and she was changed to a medical school dropout and was scheduled to work as a factory doctor in a small factory. She is now married with two daughters and a mother, and her life is pretty good now. After hearing this, Feng'er was very happy for Xi'er. She could finally raise her head and be a human being. She almost made a mistake and was filled with hatred. Originally, falling in love was not a big deal, just some criticism and education was enough. The method of expelling someone from school was like beating someone to death with a stick. There was no room for maneuver and it was not conducive to the growth of young people. The two little girls grew up together, but experienced different growth paths. I remember when I was a child, I went to Xi'er's house to play. There was an oil painting of the Passion of Jesus Christ hanging on the wall of their house (I didn't understand it at the time), and they also told stories from the Bible such as Passover. Their parents must also be Christians who believe in Jesus Christ. But then the political situation changed suddenly, and no one dared to admit that they were Christians. People gradually moved away from Christianity, and I think the Xier family must be among them. Feng'er was under God's care and protection. God led her family to come to the United States. They had the opportunity to come into contact with the church, heard the gospel and fell into the arms of the Lord. What a blessed family they are. Pray that God will also protect and favor Xi’er’s family, and also find Xi’er’s family who were the children of the Lord in their early years in different environments on the mainland. A hundred years later, the two families can meet again in heaven, praise and sing to God together, and give all praise and glory to God!

e30ba19c91f0ce153e07db7d86d2f620a35ff1be.sourceText: 全美航空员工机场抓逃犯 （亚省时报） 警方说，4月22日，全美航空公司的员工在空港机场抓到一名逃离警察监护的犯人。 约翰李贝索当天在两名雅瓦培郡郡警的陪同下，自底特律被引渡到凤凰城。下午5时许，三人从空港机场的三号航站楼走向电梯，李贝索挣脱警员，开始逃跑。当他跑到四号航站楼的停机坪时，被一名全美航空公司雇员发现，将他截停并查问。逃犯谎称他”忘记了”向警方报案。雇员想进一步控制逃犯，但李贝索继续逃跑，并试图盗窃摆渡车。其他全美航空的员工加入围捕逃犯，最后成功将其控制，直至警员赶到。 警方说，逃犯一直戴着电击型脚镣，控制在陪同他的雅瓦培郡警手上。在飞行过程中，警员暂时将脚镣设施解除，下机时也没有将其启动，才导致此出逃跑大戏。幸亏他进入飞机跑道说没有任何航班起降。 李贝索除原有的控罪外，还要面临凤凰城警方两项指控，包括盗窃车辆和违反联邦航空禁区法。
e30ba19c91f0ce153e07db7d86d2f620a35ff1be.translatedText: US Airways employees caught a fugitive at the airport (Alberta Times) Police said that on April 22, US Airways employees at the airport caught a prisoner escaping from police custody. John Liebesso was extradited from Detroit to Phoenix that day, accompanied by two Yavapai County police officers. At about 5 p.m., the three people walked towards the elevator from Terminal 3 of the airport. Liebeso broke away from the police and began to escape. When he ran to the tarmac of Terminal 4, he was spotted by a US Airways employee, who stopped him and questioned him. The fugitive lied that he "forgot" to report the crime to the police. Employees tried to gain further control of the fugitive, but Liebeso continued to escape and attempted to steal the shuttle. Other US Airways employees joined in the roundup and were able to contain the fugitive until police arrived. Police said the fugitive had been wearing electric shock-type shackles and was controlled by Yavapai County police officers who accompanied him. During the flight, the police temporarily removed the shackles and did not activate them when getting off the plane, which led to the escape drama. Fortunately he entered the airstrip and said there were no flights taking off or landing. Liebeso faces two charges from Phoenix police in addition to his original charges, including vehicle theft and violation of federal airspace laws.

90cf564b7c4d1bb525eab89de0254d9b3e68a48f.sourceText: 8月9日下午16时许，合肥市中级法院副院长新闻发言人唐义干，就谷开来、张晓军涉嫌谋杀海伍德案，在合肥市政务新区天鹅湖酒店长江厅举行的国际媒体参加的新闻发布 会上，宣读了一份新闻发布稿，这场发布会并未安排提问环节。
90cf564b7c4d1bb525eab89de0254d9b3e68a48f.translatedText: At about 16:00 on August 9, Tang Yiqian, the spokesman for the deputy director of the Hefei Intermediate Court, held a press conference attended by international media at the Yangtze River Hall of the Swan Lake Hotel in the Hefei Municipal Government New District on the suspected murder of Heywood by Gu Kailai and Zhang Xiaojun. At the meeting, a press release was read out, and there was no question-and-answer session.

482a70cbd9417f93bade5a063931ab6533759984.sourceText: 大约在16时许，在当天庭审结束后​​约一个小时左右，官方新闻新华社就此案迅速发布了通稿，详细描述了检方所指控的，2011年11月13日晚，薄谷开来在重庆市 南山丽景度假酒店16栋1605室，尼尔伍德的住处，毒死尼尔伍德的细节。
482a70cbd9417f93bade5a063931ab6533759984.translatedText: At around 16:00, about an hour after the court hearing ended that day, the official Xinhua News Agency quickly issued a press release on the case, detailing the details of what the prosecutor alleged was that on the evening of November 13, 2011, Bogu Kailai poisoned Neil Wood to death in Room 1605, Building 16, Nanshan Lijing Resort Hotel, Chongqing.

0a39c7e3efc129ea14b93df281fd63a3e8c3cc44.sourceText: 不过，唐衣干的发布稿，与新华社的统发稿中，有微妙的不同。 唐义干的发布稿中，谈到了当天庭审中，谷开来、张晓军的辩护律师发表的辩护意见。 律师认为，谷开来在作案时行为控制能力弱于正常人，并且在检举他人犯罪上有重大立功表现等。
0a39c7e3efc129ea14b93df281fd63a3e8c3cc44.translatedText: However, there are subtle differences between Tang Yiqian's release and Xinhua News Agency's unified release. Tang Yiqian's press release talked about the defense opinions expressed by the defense lawyers of Gu Kailai and Zhang Xiaojun during the trial that day. The lawyer believes that Gu Kailai's ability to control his behavior when committing crimes is weaker than that of normal people, and he has made significant meritorious service in reporting other people's crimes.

5d0e0b3aa49a3a05b9d8dd45d1db23a1025d4a39.sourceText: 唐义干介绍说：”薄谷开来辩护律师认为，海伍德在案件起因上有一定责任，谷开来在作案时行为控制能力弱于正常人，并且在检举他人犯罪上有重大立功表现等，请求法庭判决时综合考虑；张晓军辩护律师提出，张是协从犯，请求法庭依法减轻处罚。” 唐义干最后还强调，庭审过程中，薄谷开来”身体状况良好，情绪稳定”。 薄熙来支持者则质疑，重要证人王立军没有出庭。
5d0e0b3aa49a3a05b9d8dd45d1db23a1025d4a39.translatedText: Tang Yiqian said: "Bogu Kailai's defense lawyer believes that Heywood has a certain responsibility in the cause of the case. Gu Kailai's ability to control behavior when committing the crime is weaker than that of a normal person, and he has made major meritorious service in reporting other people's crimes. He requests that the court take all factors into consideration when making a decision. Zhang Xiaojun's defense lawyer proposes that Zhang is an accomplice and requests the court to reduce the punishment in accordance with the law." Tang Yiqian finally emphasized that during the trial, Bogu Kailai was "in good physical condition and emotionally stable." Bo Xilai supporters questioned that important witness Wang Lijun did not appear in court.

99350352014ecafbd9fad7fd4897d89674beda81.sourceText: 谷开来辩护律师所说的谷开来的”重大立功表现”具体所指及其法律后果，引起了网友许多关注，而谷开来检举”他人重大犯罪”中所指的”他人”具体所 指，更引起讨论。
99350352014ecafbd9fad7fd4897d89674beda81.translatedText: The specific meaning of Gu Kailai's "major meritorious performance" and its legal consequences mentioned by Gu Kailai's defense lawyer have attracted a lot of attention from netizens. The specific meaning of "others" mentioned by Gu Kailai in reporting "serious crimes committed by others" has aroused even more discussion.

67d6b4301af460c617ad55467fd01f2d4e050b3b.sourceText: 法广网援引浦志强律师的话认为，在检举他人犯罪上有重大立功表现上，可能指的是明天将以”徇私枉法罪”在合肥起诉的几位重庆高级警官，包括重庆市公安局原副 局长郭维国、重庆市公安局刑警总队原总队长李阳、重庆市公安局技术侦查总队原总队长兼渝北区公安分局原局长王鹏飞、重庆市公安局沙坪坝区公安分局原常务副局长王 智，他们被起诉的原因是涉嫌在办理尼尔伍德死亡案件中包庇薄谷开来，使其不被刑事追究。
67d6b4301af460c617ad55467fd01f2d4e050b3b.translatedText: France Broadcasting Network quoted lawyer Pu Zhiqiang as saying that the significant meritorious performance in reporting other people's crimes may refer to several senior Chongqing police officers who will be prosecuted in Hefei tomorrow for "bending the law for personal gain", including the former deputy director of the Chongqing Municipal Public Security Bureau. Director Guo Weiguo, former chief of the Criminal Police Corps of Chongqing Public Security Bureau Li Yang, former chief of the Technical Investigation Corps of Chongqing Public Security Bureau and former director of the Yubei District Public Security Bureau Wang Pengfei, and former executive deputy director of the Shapingba District Public Security Bureau of the Chongqing Municipal Public Security Bureau Wang Zhi were prosecuted for allegedly shielding Bogu Kailai from criminal prosecution in the case of Neil Wood's death.

100e166539a803383264ca86d0bafaab1241f75d.sourceText: 美国国会参议院已经通过一项草案，专门打击通过西南部美墨边境隧道走私犯罪活动。 法案由本州共和党籍参议员约翰凯尔和加州民主党籍参议员范士丹起草，内容包括提供更多的工具查找非法越境隧道，识别罪犯，并惩罚那些参与非法活动的执法人员和检察官。 凯尔说，过去10年中，执法人员在边境发现了135条非法隧道，主要连接墨西哥与亚利桑那州、加利福尼亚州或德克萨斯州之间。《边境隧道防治法2011》的主要目的 是查找兴建边境隧道的秘密资金，包括非法隧道的窃听（即使用药物或其他违禁品帮助窃听），厘定边境隧道非法活动，根据现有的没收和洗钱规定，允许当局没收犯罪嫌疑人的资产。 上周五，墨西哥当局查获一个尚未完成的隧道入口，看上去离美国边境有点距离。
100e166539a803383264ca86d0bafaab1241f75d.translatedText: The U.S. Senate has passed a bill to specifically crack down on smuggling criminal activities through the southwest U.S.-Mexico border tunnel. The bill, authored by state Republican Sen. John Kyl and California Democratic Sen. Feinstein, would provide more tools to find illegal border crossings, identify criminals and punish law enforcement officials and prosecutors who participate in illegal activities. Kyle said that in the past 10 years, law enforcement officials have discovered 135 illegal tunnels along the border, mainly connecting Mexico to Arizona, California or Texas. The main purpose of the Border Tunnels Prevention and Control Act 2011 is to detect secret funds for the construction of border tunnels, including illegal tunnel tapping (i.e., the use of drugs or other contraband to facilitate eavesdropping), identify illegal activities in border tunnels, and allow authorities to confiscate the assets of suspects, subject to existing confiscation and money laundering regulations. On Friday, Mexican authorities seized an unfinished tunnel entrance that appeared to be some distance from the U.S. border.

220832427048a4d2a4a2c0572376b7a34872e6ee.sourceText: 人口普查显示 本州岛儿童增长 一直以来，亚利桑那州被视为退休人士的天堂，最近的人口普查数据显示，过去十年，亚利桑那州的儿童增长率大有提高，在此同时，全美人口增长却是负增长。 2010年，10岁以下的亚省儿童有909,000人，较十年前普查增加了18%，在此类数据中排全美第五名。 从2000年到2010年，本州岛岛共增加了137,000名儿童，全美则增加了825,000名，根据人口普查结果，全美10岁以下儿童超过4千万。 亚利桑那州人口增长族群是较年轻的拉丁裔。 亚利桑那州立大学人口学家威廉史库林认为，随着人口增加，幼儿保健，教授和学校建设，贫困居民的医疗补助等服务将持续需求。史库林教授提醒政府正视整个问题。
220832427048a4d2a4a2c0572376b7a34872e6ee.translatedText: Census shows Honshu Island child growth Arizona has always been seen as a paradise for retirees, recent census data show that the child growth rate in Arizona has increased significantly in the past decade, at the same time, the national population growth has been negative. In 2010, there were 909,000 children under the age of 10 in Alberta, an 18% increase from the census ten years ago, ranking fifth in the United States in this category. From 2000 to 2010, there were a total of 137,000 more children on Honshu and 825,000 in the United States. According to census results, there are more than 40 million children under the age of 10 in the United States. Arizona's population growth group is younger Latinos. Arizona State University demographer William Schooling believes that as the population increases, services such as early childhood care, professors and school construction, and Medicaid for poor residents will continue to be in demand. Professor Schooling reminded the government to face up to the entire problem.
