2fe8a413b8c6aed8d1e247b8e4da42c7abbc4025.translatedText: in 26 In the lecture on the same day, Mr. Fan Rong gave a detailed and vivid introduction to Emperor Taizong of the Tang Dynasty, Li Shimin, and his six beloved horses, Lepi, Qingzui, Shifachi, Quanmaojun, Baitiwu, and Saluzi. They made great contributions to the establishment of the Tang Empire. Later, Emperor Taizong ordered that the great painter Yan Liben The students were very interested in the story about the six giant reliefs carved by the great sculptor Yan Lide and erected in the North Tower of Zhaoling. Especially when it was mentioned that the reliefs of six horses separated the two places in the past hundred years of history, everyone was very sad and hoped that one day the six horses would be reunited. Then Mr. Fan Rong introduced the works of famous horse painters from past dynasties. The students listened very attentively. Mr. Fan Rong improvised and splashed ink on the spot. In a moment, a lifelike horse appeared on the paper and won warm applause from all the teachers and students. Then Mr. Fan Rong began to patiently teach the students how to draw horses. These art students were really savvy, and all of them painted seriously and stylishly, and they had a touch of Chinese painting.

89badcac4c8e177b8afe314188e241983aa341e4.sourceText: 两天的讲座结束了，同学们仍沉浸在快乐和兴奋中，依依不舍和老师握手道别，感谢老师的教导， Tabor 女士说这两天的讲座使同学们听到很多有趣的故事，学到许多从前没有接触过的新知识，喜欢上中国画也喜欢上中国，正如校长 Ken James 先生在感谢信中所说，这是一堂在普通的课堂上学不到的最好的中国文化课，增加了孩子们对中华文化的兴趣，也加深了对中国的了解。
89badcac4c8e177b8afe314188e241983aa341e4.translatedText: The two days of lectures are over. The students are still immersed in joy and excitement. They reluctantly shake hands with the teacher and say goodbye, thanking the teacher for his teaching. Ms. Tabor said that these two days of lectures allowed the students to hear many interesting stories and learn a lot of new knowledge that they had never been exposed to before. They fell in love with Chinese painting and China, just like the principal Ken James. The teacher said in his thank-you letter that this was the best Chinese culture class that could not be learned in an ordinary classroom. It increased the children's interest in Chinese culture and deepened their understanding of China.

01e1a874f08aa806223ba201e8d75cf657f3f16c.sourceText: 据知这是范融先生近几年来第三次在 Hamilton High School 演讲中华文化。
01e1a874f08aa806223ba201e8d75cf657f3f16c.translatedText: It is known that this is the third time Mr. Fan Rong has given a lecture on Chinese culture at Hamilton High School in recent years.

d1d2478485ca4d7e4ef0675f6d09b079b8ffd5cf.sourceText: 凤凰笔会 丁鼎 我想谈的并不是荷马史诗或者进击的巨人那些完全虚构的故事。他们是地球上真实存在的，也是真正意义上…
d1d2478485ca4d7e4ef0675f6d09b079b8ffd5cf.translatedText: Phoenix Pen Club Ding Ding What I want to talk about is not the completely fictitious stories of Homer's epics or Attack on Titan. They are real on earth, and in the true sense...

d7d15b7b15ad6a268e0c7530ec2da09221761d40.sourceText: 我想谈的并不是荷马史诗或者进击的巨人那些完全虚构的故事。他们是地球上真实存在的，也是真正意义上的巨人。
d7d15b7b15ad6a268e0c7530ec2da09221761d40.translatedText: What I want to talk about is not the completely fictional stories of Homer's epics or Attack on Titan. They are real and truly giants on Earth.

2eb9564a4f0eb030e373f235be8094c265895bbc.sourceText: 身为Chilula部族的长者和领袖，Minnie Reeves，几乎每次集会时都会再三提及这些巨人是赐予人类的特殊礼物。创世者在创造万物的时候，想要留给孩子们一份特殊的礼物，所以他用所有树木里的灵药，混上每个人的一滴血液，唱诵了一段特殊的歌谣，从而才诞生了这些巨人。“毁灭他们，你就毁灭了众神之爱。如果你毁灭了创世者如此珍爱的事情，那么就是在毁灭人类。”
2eb9564a4f0eb030e373f235be8094c265895bbc.translatedText: As the elder and leader of the Chilula tribe, Minnie Reeves would repeatedly mention these giants as a special gift to mankind in almost every gathering. When the Creator created all things, he wanted to leave a special gift to the children, so he mixed the elixir from all the trees with a drop of blood from everyone, and sang a special song, thus giving birth to these giants. "Destroy them, and you destroy the love of the gods. If you destroy something that the Creator cherishes so much, you are destroying mankind."

5b240719939c9992d12a6facd752b763b0444031.sourceText: 而对于Yurok部族来说，这些巨人们牺牲了自我，而永远矗立在哪里，成为圣地最后的守护者。在他们厚重而粗糙的皮肤下面，是古老而长存的精灵。在人类出现很久之前，他们就已经存在无数个千年；当人们出现后，他们现身并教导了如同婴儿般的人们如何在这个土地上生存，并将他们逝者的尸骸留给人类。人类从此有了房屋，有了舟车。
5b240719939c9992d12a6facd752b763b0444031.translatedText: As for the Yurok tribe, these giants sacrificed themselves and stood there forever, becoming the last guardians of the holy land. Beneath their thick and rough skin lie ancient and everlasting spirits. They existed for countless millennia long before humans appeared; when humans emerged, they showed up and taught the infant-like humans how to survive on this land, leaving the remains of their dead to humans. From then on, human beings had houses and boats.

4c35729e0eb6e7227d7b61783bb180377b79e7af.sourceText: 他们是无比高大的巨人，同时也是无比脆弱的巨人。
4c35729e0eb6e7227d7b61783bb180377b79e7af.translatedText: They are extremely tall giants, but also extremely fragile giants.

ac49dde030722ddb46b4baeeb164253916dcd3e7.sourceText: Minni Reeves，这个和影星基努李维斯（Keanu Reeves）有着同样姓氏的印第安长者，我只在一本扫描过的旧书上查找到她的话语和非常不清楚的照片。书中记载她当时已经有102岁了。原书链接： https://www.waterboards.ca.gov/water_issues/programs/tmdl/records/region_1/2003/ref993.pdf
ac49dde030722ddb46b4baeeb164253916dcd3e7.translatedText: >Minni Reeves, this Indian elder has the same surname as the movie star Keanu Reeves. I only found her words and very unclear photos in a scanned old book. The book records that she was 102 years old at the time. Original book link: https://www.waterboards.ca.gov/water_issues/programs/tmdl/records/region_1/2003/ref993.pdf

b82a44f8a23a32c7f2a034769832880ca328b7b6.sourceText: Chilula号拖船，摄于1960年7月2号。Chilula这个小部族在现今已经几乎是名存实亡了，如果你去网上搜索“Chilula”这个词，更大的可能性是搜到一艘以Chilula命名的海军拖船，在二战前就开始在服役。这艘拖船在1944年退役，最终于1997年被海军作为试射靶而从这个世界上彻底消失。 以历史命名的事物，最终也成了历史。
b82a44f8a23a32c7f2a034769832880ca328b7b6.translatedText: Tugboat Chilula, taken on July 2, 1960. The small tribe Chilula is almost extinct in name only today. If you search for the word "Chilula" on the Internet, you are more likely to find a naval tugboat named after Chilula, which was in service before World War II. The tugboat was decommissioned in 1944 and eventually disappeared from the world in 1997 when it was used as a test target by the Navy. Things named after history eventually become history.

4358c4d0d5a65409e914e536aed5e666fd910f86.sourceText: Yurok部族的木房。Yurok部族会从自然倒落的树木中收集木材来搭建自己的屋子。他们的房子从外部看起来很矮小，但是其实里面的地板是低于地面两米左右的，所以如果真的爬进去看其实一点也不小。
4358c4d0d5a65409e914e536aed5e666fd910f86.translatedText: >The wooden house of the Yurok tribe. The Yurok tribe collects wood from naturally fallen trees to build their houses. Their house looks very small from the outside, but the floor inside is actually about two meters below the ground, so if you really climb in, it is not small at all.

af57f8b5574e7b22bc36f8b22c813774195368c0.sourceText: 儿童身着Yurok部族的服饰。Yurok部族依然存在，而他们的传统文化是当地重要的旅游项目。关于Yurok部族服饰的宣传照片有很多，但是这张里那个小女孩无奈而又好奇的眼神无疑让人印象深刻。
af57f8b5574e7b22bc36f8b22c813774195368c0.translatedText: Children dressed in Yurok tribal costumes. The Yurok tribe still exists, and their traditional culture is an important local tourism project. There are many promotional photos about Yurok tribal costumes, but the helpless and curious eyes of the little girl in this one are undoubtedly impressive.

faa6275014f1b9c4e304d8449a37c9faade247b1.sourceText: 这些巨人，就是北美红衫。
faa6275014f1b9c4e304d8449a37c9faade247b1.translatedText: These giants are the North American red shirts.

a25dcd54ef256aa121e3299fc18df98ec05d6e10.sourceText: 虽然地球上最大生物的席位的争夺经常会有所反复，但是蓝鲸这种级别可以说是远远不够。有一些特别的植物和真菌有着不停复制自身、但又互不分离而成为一个巨大个体的特点，比如在广西和夏威夷常见的榕树林，在严格的生物学意义来说只是一棵巨大的榕树。巴金先生的《鸟的天堂》里描述的一颗榕树独木成林，覆盖面积足超过20亩地。而目前的世界记录保持者则是西澳的一种海草：2022年澳大利亚海洋研究所发表了学术文章正式确认，西澳海岸有整整覆盖了200多平方公里的波西多尼亚海草，其实只是一整棵巨大的海草。如果我们不考虑这种绝对有着作弊嫌疑的巨大化方案，那么最大生物大致只剩了三个候选人：澳大利亚的杏仁桉、北美红杉以及同样分布在北美的巨杉。如果考虑重量和体积的话，拔得头筹的肯定是绝对重量级的巨杉，但是如果我们按照稍微肤浅一点的标准，单纯考虑个头和大长腿的话，那么这顶桂冠最终可能会戴给红杉。
a25dcd54ef256aa121e3299fc18df98ec05d6e10.translatedText: Although the competition for the seat of the largest creature on earth often goes back and forth, it can be said that the level of the blue whale is far from enough. There are some special plants and fungi that have the characteristic of constantly replicating themselves but not separating from each other to form a huge individual. For example, the common banyan forests in Guangxi and Hawaii are just one giant banyan tree in a strict biological sense. Mr. Ba Jin's "Bird's Paradise" describes a single banyan tree that forms a forest, covering an area of ​​more than 20 acres. The current world record holder is a seagrass from Western Australia: in 2022, the Australian Marine Institute published an academic article that officially confirmed that the Posidonia seagrass covering more than 200 square kilometers on the coast of Western Australia is actually just a huge seagrass. If we do not consider this gigantism plan, which is definitely suspected of cheating, then there are roughly only three candidates left for the largest creature: Australian almond eucalyptus, North American redwoods, and giant sequoias also distributed in North America. If you consider weight and volume, the top spot will definitely be the absolutely heavyweight giant sequoia. However, if we follow a slightly superficial standard and simply consider the size and long legs, then this crown may eventually go to the sequoia.

ffcbb2b82d40b5ec14fe200cf1d9b94917e8ad18.sourceText: 红杉的高度可以达到上百米。目前还活着的最高的一棵叫“Hyperion”，是以希腊神话中提坦巨人之一来命名的。出于保护，她的真正地点并不对游客公开。美国植物学家、同时也是攀爬高手Stephen C. Sillett为了能够准确测量，在2006年带了一个超长的尺直接爬到了树顶，把尺子从树顶垂下，最终得出了115.55米（379.1英尺）这样一个精确的高度。这次攀爬被国家地理杂志全程拍摄，发表于2012年12月，题为”Forest Giant”（森林巨人）。而另有一幅经常被引用的高度对比图，里面可以清楚看到至少三个蓝鲸头尾相接才能勉强跟红杉的高度一拼。
ffcbb2b82d40b5ec14fe200cf1d9b94917e8ad18.translatedText: The height of redwood trees can reach hundreds of meters. The tallest tree still alive is called "Hyperion", named after one of the Titans in Greek mythology. Her true location is not open to visitors for conservation reasons. In order to accurately measure, American botanist and climbing expert Stephen C. Sillett brought an extra-long ruler directly to the top of the tree in 2006, hung the ruler from the top of the tree, and finally came up with an accurate height of 115.55 meters (379.1 feet). The entire climb was photographed by National Geographic magazine and published in December 2012 under the title "Forest Giant." There is another height comparison picture that is often quoted, in which it can be clearly seen that at least three blue whales have to be connected head to tail to barely compete with the height of the redwoods.

835d7afb8944140ce8b36b271042d3cab399237c.sourceText: 别被里面的数字弄糊涂了 – 这张对比图里面的高度单位是英尺。里面可以看到人只是很小一点，而红杉右边就是个头矮一些但是体格明显更加敦实的巨杉。
835d7afb8944140ce8b36b271042d3cab399237c.translatedText: Don’t let the numbers confuse you – the heights in this comparison chart are in feet. Inside, you can see that the people are just a little bit smaller, and to the right of the sequoia is a giant sequoia that is shorter but has a significantly stockier build.

15c6a0f8322e928397cf26e4ee98b83cc578ee1f.sourceText: 这些巨人们怎么能长到这么高？他们还能长得更高吗？这些问题回答起来远没那么简单，在问题背后你可以找到植物学、材料力学、生态学、流体力学等多种交叉学科的研究文章，很多都发表在《自然》或《物理评论》这样的高水准学术期刊。大致来说，对于光照的需求会驱使植物长高，但是大部分草本植物的材料强度不够，是不可能长太高的，否则在自身重量下会被压垮。此外，这些巨人一定要长寿，能够有足够的时日让他们可以不停冲击对阳光和高度的渴求。目前已知最老的红杉大概有3500岁（一棵名为Muir Snag的红杉，目前已经死去），而大部分的红杉都有800到1500岁以上 – 也就是说，他们有着充足的时间来突破高度限制。可是就算有了足够的材料强度和足够的生长时间，树木依然不可能无限长高，因为最终限制他们的是水分和营养的输运。在这些巨树的顶端，叶子的生长环境已经开始接近干旱的沙漠了。根据对水分输运的流体力学建模分析，地球上树木的极限高度大概会是400英尺左右（120多米），这和红杉的整体数据大致吻合，说明限制这些巨人身高的应该是“喝水”的困难程度。
15c6a0f8322e928397cf26e4ee98b83cc578ee1f.translatedText: How can these giants grow so tall? Can they still grow taller? The answers to these questions are far from simple. Behind the questions you can find research articles on botany, materials mechanics, ecology, fluid mechanics and other interdisciplinary subjects. Many of them are published in high-level academic journals such as Nature or Physical Review. Generally speaking, the demand for light will drive plants to grow taller, but the materials of most herbaceous plants are not strong enough and they cannot grow too tall, otherwise they will be crushed under their own weight. In addition, these giants must live long enough to continue to satisfy their thirst for sunlight and altitude. The oldest known redwood is about 3,500 years old (a redwood named Muir Snag, which is now dead), and most redwoods are between 800 and 1,500 years old - which means they have plenty of time to break through the height limit. However, even with sufficient material strength and sufficient growth time, trees still cannot grow indefinitely, because what ultimately limits them is the transportation of water and nutrients. At the tops of these giant trees, the growth environment of the leaves has begun to approach that of an arid desert. According to fluid mechanics modeling analysis of water transport, the ultimate height of trees on Earth is about 400 feet (more than 120 meters), which is roughly consistent with the overall data of redwoods, indicating that the difficulty of "drinking water" should limit the height of these giants.

55aa68b58686c261e5f0ca94f0ac8a93799d2f11.sourceText: 当陪伴着红杉巨人的还是印第安部族的时候，人们对红杉木的需求是少量而且良性的。哪怕不考虑神明以及传说这种神秘而内省的理由，使用旧时代的工具去采伐活着的红杉所投入的人力无疑太过巨大，明显是入不敷出的行为。印第安部落只是寻找自然死亡倒塌的巨人，然后制作房子、家具、器具，甚至制作可以出海的独木舟。千百年来，红杉一直无偿地提供给人们这一切，是印第安部族当之无愧的庇护者。
55aa68b58686c261e5f0ca94f0ac8a93799d2f11.translatedText: When the redwood giants were accompanied by Indian tribes, people's demand for redwood trees was small and benign. Even ignoring the mysterious and introspective reasons of gods and legends, the manpower invested in harvesting living redwoods using old-age tools is undoubtedly too huge, and it is obviously an act of making ends meet. The Indian tribes simply looked for giants that had died of natural causes and collapsed, and then made houses, furniture, utensils, and even canoes that could go out to sea. For thousands of years, the redwoods have been providing this to people for free and are well-deserved protectors of the Indian tribes.

d35174d38acfa2ecced4a96f15373fc29776c221.sourceText: 印第安Yurok部落的红杉木小船在Trinity河上
d35174d38acfa2ecced4a96f15373fc29776c221.translatedText: Redwood boat of the Yurok Indian tribe on the Trinity River

e5fd79ce4db0f2fdf177e2f6ab028bfd91a20930.sourceText: 然后这一切被西班牙殖民者的到来一夜间彻底改变。在他们对于这些古老巨人感到惊叹的同时，也会为了仅仅在欧洲各地展示这些巨树，而挑选其中最高大的、最古老的肆意砍伐，只取其中的几段带回去拼接起来参展。在殖民者的屠刀下，红杉精灵们连自身都无法保护，更无法庇护树荫下生存的部族。事实上，大量印第安部族被驱赶、流离失所，连妇女和孩子都遭到成批屠杀。而当时北美上演的悲惨一幕，无疑是电影《阿凡达》的故事原型。
e5fd79ce4db0f2fdf177e2f6ab028bfd91a20930.translatedText: Then all this was completely changed overnight by the arrival of Spanish colonists. While they were amazed by these ancient giants, they would also select the tallest and oldest trees and cut them down indiscriminately just to display these giant trees across Europe, and only take a few sections back to be spliced ​​for exhibition. Under the butcher's knife of the colonists, the redwood elves were unable to protect themselves, let alone the tribes living in the shade. In fact, a large number of Indian tribes were driven out and displaced, and even their women and children were massacred. The tragic scene that took place in North America at that time was undoubtedly the prototype of the movie "Avatar".

6e08579968fb082ef7bdf0f03951d11c9228eb99.sourceText: 而随之而来的移民人口增长使得对于各种资源，也包括对红杉木材的需求也立刻增长。当1850年西部淘金热开始后，无数红着眼睛去淘金的人们没能淘到一星半点黄金，只有留在当地成为了廉价的劳动力。商业上的有利可图加上大量的劳动力，于是各种伐木公司对红杉林长达百年的摧残也就正式开始。
6e08579968fb082ef7bdf0f03951d11c9228eb99.translatedText: The subsequent increase in the immigrant population immediately increased the demand for various resources, including redwood wood. When the gold rush began in the West in 1850, countless people who went to pan for gold failed to find any gold, so they could only stay in the local area and become cheap labor force. Commercially profitable and with a large labor force, the century-long destruction of redwood forests by various logging companies officially began.

3fba27c92512937690d4031a6999a67e1f3a887b.sourceText: 在早期，砍伐巨树依然是个费时费力的活儿。然而随着现代工具甚至自动机械的涌入，砍伐红杉的成本也变得越来越低。取代了马车的铁路，也使得木材运输更加便利，很多铁路的尽头其实就是直接修到了伐木场。一时间，木材砍伐成为了美国西部最大型的工业。当时在伐木公司工作算是个不错的体面职业，换算到现在大体上相当于在亚马逊、谷歌工作的码工们。出于伐木的需求，伪造地契而大量侵占公共土地是很多伐木公司公开的秘密。尽管确实有极少数人被抓，但是大多数的非法侵占并没有受到任何惩罚，反而愈演愈烈。伐木公司之间也在不停竞争：为了越来越薄的利润，伐木公司的开采进度越来越快。到1968年红杉木国家公园成立，美国国家开始立法对红杉和巨杉进行全面保护，已经有超过90%的原始红杉林（估计占地7500平方公里）遭到完全无法复原的砍伐和破坏。
3fba27c92512937690d4031a6999a67e1f3a887b.translatedText: In the early days, felling giant trees was still a time-consuming and laborious task. However, with the influx of modern tools and even automated machinery, the cost of felling redwoods has become increasingly affordable. The railways that replaced horse-drawn carriages also made lumber transportation more convenient. Many railways actually ended directly at the lumberyard. For a time, timber harvesting became the largest industry in the American West. At that time, working in a logging company was considered a good and respectable career. Now, it is roughly equivalent to working as a coder at Amazon and Google. It is an open secret of many logging companies to forge title deeds and encroach on large amounts of public land for the purpose of logging. Although a handful of people were indeed caught, most illegal appropriations went unpunished and intensified. There is also constant competition among logging companies: for increasingly thin profits, logging companies are mining faster and faster. By the establishment of Sequoia National Park in 1968, the United States began to legislate comprehensive protection of sequoias and giant sequoias. More than 90% of the original sequoia forests (estimated to cover an area of ​​7,500 square kilometers) had been felled and destroyed completely and beyond recovery.

d8852e68806c94f5770265a352a486504beb2b81.sourceText: 和倒下的巨人们合影，在当时是当时很风靡的事情。这样的照片在很多地方博物馆、和加州各个大学的历史档案馆都可以搜到。我随手收集了几张来作为这个随笔的结尾，而这些照片里的人，多半已经不在人世。
d8852e68806c94f5770265a352a486504beb2b81.translatedText: Taking photos with the fallen giants was a very popular thing at the time. Such photos can be found in many local museums and historical archives of various California universities. I collected a few random photos to end this essay, and most of the people in these photos are no longer alive.

c29e74ef347314e0b25090249547d0f7a81cf68f.sourceText: 两调查：丰田本田二手车最保值 转卖价最好 最新公布的两个调查显示，在使用五年后，亚洲进口车最保值，转售价值最高…
c29e74ef347314e0b25090249547d0f7a81cf68f.translatedText: Two surveys: Toyota and Honda used cars have the best retention of value and the best resale price. The two latest surveys show that after five years of use, Asian imported cars have the best retention of value and the highest resale value...

0901279e6351297d30c1ce68e770768a09dcf09d.sourceText: 最新公布的两个调查显示，在使用五年后，亚洲进口车最保值，转售价值最高。两个不同的二手车转售价值指标显示，丰田和本田品牌车辆的保值程度优于其他汽车品牌。
0901279e6351297d30c1ce68e770768a09dcf09d.translatedText: The two latest surveys show that after five years of use, Asian imported cars have the best retention of value and the highest resale value. Two different used car resale value indicators show that Toyota and Honda brand vehicles retain their value better than other car brands.

5119f2a2c025367207d1003584b898676802c435.sourceText: 知名的《凯利蓝皮书》（ Kelley Blue Book ， KBB ）二手车价格预测显示， 连续第二年丰田和旗下豪华车品牌雷克萨斯，在转售价值上排名第一。本田和旗下豪华车品牌讴歌则 ALG 调查中排名第一。
5119f2a2c025367207d1003584b898676802c435.translatedText: The well-known Kelley Blue Book (KBB) used car price forecast shows that for the second consecutive year, Toyota and its luxury car brand Lexus rank first in resale value. Honda and its luxury car brand Acura ranked first in the ALG survey.

b4463d53827fdcb842c083b3f328a6e000fba64e.sourceText: 当进一步细分不同汽车款式时，在 KBB 调查显示，本田表现很好，旗下的飞度（ Fit ）、思域（ Civic ）和雅阁（ Accord ）等三款车都是各自领域的领导者。
b4463d53827fdcb842c083b3f328a6e000fba64e.translatedText: When further segmenting different car styles, the KBB survey showed that Honda performed very well, and its three cars, including Fit, Civic and Accord, are leaders in their respective fields.

8c83753af4ab71ed93a6681b783a564b31248a24.sourceText: 在个别款式的排名中，《汽车租赁指南》（ Automotive Lease Guide ， ALG ）给予现代汽车很大的肯定。旗下的伊兰特（ Elantra ）、雅尊（ Azera ）及圣达菲（ Santa Fe ）都是各自领域的佼佼者。
8c83753af4ab71ed93a6681b783a564b31248a24.translatedText: In the ranking of individual models, the Automotive Lease Guide (ALG) gave Hyundai Motors great recognition. Its Elantra, Azera and Santa Fe are all leaders in their respective fields.

40841eae8ba9ed97510d809473ea4e9b6677b5a5.sourceText: KBB 说，总体而言，今天购买的新车五年后的价值仅原来价值的 38.2 ％。这比 2012 年车份汽车五年后的保值率增加了 2.5% 。
40841eae8ba9ed97510d809473ea4e9b6677b5a5.translatedText: Overall, a new car purchased today will be worth just 38.2 percent of its original value five years from now, KBB says. This is a 2.5% increase over the value retention rate of a 2012 car after five years.

82dd9530357af542c9764ce56e3543215d2c94b9.sourceText: 没落帝国 醉诗 世界各地每天都有不少人想着移民或偷渡到美国，这个二十世纪的金元王国也是超级强国，自二战后就崛起，成为地球上最威武的新帝国，在世界舞台上叱咤风云，近所向无敌。 几亿帝国子民的心态，自然是高傲与凌驾他国充满优越感；其生活早已养成挥霍无度，只求享受生命。日常起居浪费资源的坏习惯，随时随地可见。这个帝国的人民，为了方便，人人自驾汽车；家居一旦亮了灯，开了电视，纵已暂时不观看，也绝不肯关闭。阳光普照，洗完了衣服也不肯拿到后园晒干，而是用烤衣机打干。完全没有半丝节约能源，珍惜地球可贵资源的环保心思。 今年四月、我旅美观光期间，不论所到超市、餐厅，都见大量的用着塑料袋、尼龙快餐盒；易拉罐和瓶装水更是堆积如山。德国与瑞士等欧洲国家、十余年前的超市早已弃用塑料袋改换能回收的纸袋。超市门前、都设有自动机回收所有胶瓶和易拉罐。全球包括美国在内的政要，每天都高唤着要环保，要拯救地球？ 动真格的是所有其它大大小小的国家，唯独这个最强大的帝国；原来要世界其他国家人民齐心合力的节约能源，努力环保；好让美国人民继续挥霍？看到各国鼓吹教育公民爱惜地球；民间组织如有名的「台湾慈济功德会」的慈济人，拼命做着环保的功德；可在美国每天每时那几亿帝国人民却依然胡乱消耗着地球资源，包括大大小小的华人餐馆、超市。此消彼长，地球所受灾害能减轻吗？ 为了填补日常消耗能源、唯有去侵略那些拥有大量油田的国家，去掠夺别国资源而美其名为「反恐」？到处搧风点火，引起局部战争；而在一场场战争中养胖了那大班军火商，出兵掠夺的结果往往虎头蛇尾收场。 金融风暴发生以后，往昔无限风光的帝国已显得颟顸，首先冲激的是全国房地产业；许许多多再无力供还房债的人，房屋被银行拍卖；供求定律绝对无情，房地产市场供过于求时，价格一落千丈。破产者越来越多，间接都成了社会负担。也变相成为社会动荡不安的隐忧。 今年至六月，全美竟已倒闭了48家银行。纽约邮报六月十九日报导，根据Discover信用卡每月公布的资料，入不敷出的美国人占42.4%；也就是说全国超过四成人口生活面临困难。(这段资料取自七月一日美国亚省时报B5版。) 去年美国总统奥巴马，为了应付亏空的国库；再不顾美元的黄金本位价值，居然饮鸩止渴的下令库房大量印发美钞？这一阴招中国首当其冲，向美国购买下的那一万亿美元的国债，由于美钞无限量印刷而大大贬值。美元最终可能变成如民国时期的金圆券或关金。 国家大印钞票，等同向全民掠夺；而美国是等同向世界掠夺。美国国债欠下的天文数字，四月份报导，平均每个家庭要负债53万4千元。如一个美国家庭人口三位计算，全国有超过一亿个家庭，也就是一亿多单位乘以53万4千。 在巨债阴影下，十一月八日该国众议院仍然通过了6490亿元的国防预算；其中1190亿元用作伊拉克与阿富汗两个战场的花费。国家巨额赤字的结果，美元必然黯然无光、贬值在所难免。(此段资料取自七月十一日星岛日报国际版) 全国失业率高达9.2%，几近占劳动人口中的一千五百万人失业大军，若无妥善方法处理；很可怕的会步上二战时希特勒发动战争的后尘。用战争去解决国内剩余劳动力、燃烧武器、击落战机、毁坏坦克大炮，可让兵工厂工人大量就业。 掠夺到他国的黄金、原油均可充当空虚国库燃眉之急。 南中国海的几个外围小国，最近莫不为了南沙群岛等无人小岛而敢捋虎须？明眼人都看到有美国在背后撑腰；近日又将与日本、澳洲举办联合军事演习。围堵中国崛起是借口，挑衅而引起局部战争才是美国的主因。 世界和平是一个口号，也是人类的至高理想；对于强大帝国的当政者，最重要的是永远能让其国家屹立，让其人民继续拥有挥霍享乐生活。至于地球是否沉沦，是否要拯救，无非是说来安抚其他「非我族类」吧了？ 中国领导人理应聪明一点，逐步抽离那万亿美元的美国国债；不然、最终是用中国人民的血汗钱去让美国子民享受。当年日不落国早已沉沦，今天美国臃肿身影也已渐见没落了、、、、、。 二零一一年七月十二日于墨尔本。
82dd9530357af542c9764ce56e3543215d2c94b9.translatedText: Decline of the Empire Drunk Poetry Every day, many people around the world think about immigrating or smuggling to the United States. This Jinyuan Kingdom in the 20th century is also a superpower. It has risen since World War II and has become the most powerful new empire on the earth. It is all-powerful on the world stage and is invincible. The mentality of hundreds of millions of people in the empire is naturally arrogant and full of superiority over other countries; their lives have long been cultivated to be extravagant and just to enjoy life. The bad habit of wasting resources in daily life can be seen anytime and anywhere. For the sake of convenience, the people of this empire all drive their own cars; once the lights are turned on at home and the TV is turned on, they will never turn it off even if they are not watching for a while. The sun was shining brightly, so even after washing the clothes, I refused to take them to the backyard to dry. Instead, I used a clothes dryer to dry them. There is absolutely no thought of saving energy and cherishing the precious resources of the earth. During my trip to the United States in April this year, no matter where I went in supermarkets or restaurants, I saw a large number of plastic bags and nylon fast food boxes; cans and bottled water were piled up like mountains. Supermarkets in European countries such as Germany and Switzerland have already abandoned plastic bags and replaced them with recyclable paper bags more than ten years ago. There are automatic machines in front of supermarkets to recycle all plastic bottles and cans. Politicians around the world, including the United States, are calling for environmental protection and saving the earth every day? What really matters is that all other countries, large and small, except this most powerful empire, do you think that the people of other countries in the world should work together to save energy and work hard to protect the environment so that the American people can continue to squander? We see that various countries are advocating educating citizens to care for the earth; non-governmental organizations such as the Tzu Chi people of the famous "Taiwan Tzu Chi Merit Association" are doing their best to do good deeds for environmental protection; but in the United States, hundreds of millions of imperial people are still indiscriminately consuming the earth's resources every day, including large and small Chinese restaurants and supermarkets. As one goes and the other goes, can the disasters on the earth be mitigated? In order to supplement daily energy consumption, the only option is to invade countries with large oil fields and plunder other countries' resources under the euphemistic name of "anti-terrorism"? Fanning the wind and igniting fires everywhere caused local wars; and in each war, a large number of arms dealers were fattened, and the results of sending troops to plunder often ended in an anticlimax. After the financial turmoil, the once glorious empire has become shabby. The first thing affected was the national real estate industry. Many people who were no longer able to repay their mortgage debts had their houses auctioned by banks. The law of supply and demand is absolutely ruthless. When the real estate market is oversupplied, prices plummet. There are more and more bankrupt people, which indirectly becomes a burden on society. It has also become a hidden worry for social unrest in disguise. As of June this year, 48 banks have closed across the United States. The New York Post reported on June 19 that according to data released monthly by Discover Credit Card, 42.4% of Americans cannot make ends meet; that is to say, more than 40% of the country's population is facing difficulties in life. (This information is taken from page B5 of the Alberta Times on July 1.) Last year, in order to cope with the deficit in the national treasury, regardless of the gold standard value of the US dollar, he actually ordered the Treasury to print a large amount of US dollars by drinking poison to quench his thirst? China was the first to bear the brunt of this conspiracy. The trillions of dollars in national debt it purchased from the United States were greatly devalued due to the unlimited printing of U.S. dollar bills. The U.S. dollar may eventually become like the gold yuan notes or customs gold during the Republic of China. The country's large-scale printing of money is tantamount to plundering the entire people; and the United States is tantamount to plundering the world. The U.S. national debt is astronomical. It was reported in April that the average household owes $534,000. For example, if the population of an American family is calculated to three digits, there are more than 100 million families in the country, which is more than 100 million units times 534,000. Under the shadow of huge debt, the country's House of Representatives still passed a defense budget of 649 billion yuan on November 8, of which 119 billion yuan was used for the two battlefields of Iraq and Afghanistan. As a result of the country's huge deficit, the U.S. dollar will inevitably lose its luster and depreciation is inevitable. (This information is taken from the international edition of Sing Tao Daily on July 11) The national unemployment rate is as high as 9.2%, accounting for almost 15 million unemployed people in the working population. If there is no proper way to deal with it, it is terrible that it will follow the footsteps of Hitler's war during World War II. Using war to eliminate domestic surplus labor, burn weapons, shoot down fighter planes, destroy tanks and artillery can create a large number of employment for arsenal workers. The gold and crude oil plundered from other countries can be used as urgent needs for empty national treasury. Are some of the small peripheral countries in the South China Sea trying to fight for uninhabited islands such as the Nansha Islands? Anyone with a discerning eye can see that the United States is behind it; joint military exercises with Japan and Australia will be held in the near future. Containing China's rise is an excuse, and provoking local wars is the main reason for the United States. World peace is a slogan and the highest ideal of mankind; for the rulers of powerful empires, the most important thing is to always keep their country standing and allow its people to continue to live a life of luxury and enjoyment. As for whether the earth is sinking and whether it needs to be saved, is it just to appease other "races other than our own"? Chinese leaders should be smarter and gradually withdraw the trillions of dollars in U.S. national debt; otherwise, they will end up using the hard-earned money of the Chinese people to benefit the American people. The country where the sun never set back then has long since fallen, and today the bloated figure of the United States has gradually declined... Melbourne on July 12, 2011.

24c0c18524e83ddf8dbbee1f9bc883528118196a.sourceText: “新东方文化讲坛”陈普博士与您相约“重阳品茶” 待到重阳日 还来就菊花 ——–”新东方文化讲坛”陈普博士与您相约”重阳品茶” ”太阳鸟”亚利桑那华人网倾情策划 WWW.SUNBIRDARIZONA.COM 故人具鸡黍，邀我至田家。 绿树村边合，青山郭外斜。 开轩面场圃，把酒话桑麻。 待到重阳日，还来就菊花。 ——《过故人庄 》 （ 唐） 孟浩然 独在异乡为异客，每逢佳节倍思亲。 遥知兄弟登高处，遍插茱萸少一人。 ——《九月九日忆山东兄弟》 （唐）王维 中秋刚过，重阳又临。2012年10月23日，是农历九月初九，重阳节。每到这天，人们登高”避灾”，插茱萸、赏菊花，品糕点，吃螃蟹。上面提到的两首唐诗就生动了描述了重阳节这天的情形。可以说，重阳节是历代文人墨客吟咏最多的几个传统节日之一。 ”新东方文化讲坛”将在今年重阳节前夕推出”重阳品茶”的活动。请朋友们一起来品饮菊花茶，品赏自家做的点心，欣聆听中国民族音乐，观赏《红楼梦》中大观园里过重阳节的片断。陈普老师将和朋友们一起分享重阳节的由来、重阳的饮食和活动等知识，陈老师还会谈谈菊花茶的品饮和保健等等。如果你愿意，朋友们也可以带上自已和重阳节有关的故事，与大家同享。 时间：2012年10月20 星期六 6:10-6:30pm 品茶，吃点心，闲聊 6:30-8:00pm 重阳文化讲座，《红楼梦》片断欣赏，等等 地点：新东方艺术学校 （EAA）1100 N Alma School Rd, Suite 18, 咨询电话：(602) 490-8613; (480) 319-1098 或Email至： azeaainfo@gmail.com 备注：”新东方文化讲坛” 由新东方艺术学校和陈普博士的”绿洲文教”共同主持，由”太阳鸟”亚利桑那华人网策划。秉承”传承文明，开创未来”的一贯宗旨，免费向公众开放。
24c0c18524e83ddf8dbbee1f9bc883528118196a.translatedText: "New Oriental Cultural Forum" Dr. Chen Pu makes an appointment with you on "Double Ninth Festival and taste tea" On the Double Ninth Festival, come and drink chrysanthemums ——-"New Oriental Culture Forum" Dr. Chen Pu makes an appointment with you to "Taste Tea on the Double Ninth Festival". Planned by "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese Network WWW.SUNBIRDARIZONA.COM An old friend, Ji Jishu, invited me to Tian's house. The green trees border the village, and the green mountains and hills slope outside. Open a pavilion and a garden, talk about mulberry and hemp over wine. When the Double Ninth Festival comes, there will be chrysanthemums. ——"Passing the Old Friend's Village" (Tang Dynasty) Meng Haoran I am a stranger in a foreign land, and I miss my relatives even more during the festive season. I know from afar that when my brothers climbed to a high place, there was only one less person planting dogwood trees. ——"Remembering Shandong Brothers on September 9th" (Tang Dynasty) Wang Wei Just after the Mid-Autumn Festival, the Double Ninth Festival is approaching again. October 23, 2012 is the ninth day of the ninth lunar month, the Double Ninth Festival. Every day on this day, people climb high to "avoid disasters", plant dogwood trees, admire chrysanthemums, taste cakes and eat crabs. The two Tang poems mentioned above vividly describe the situation on the Double Ninth Festival. It can be said that the Double Ninth Festival is one of the traditional festivals that has been chanted the most by literati throughout the ages. "New Oriental Culture Forum" will launch the "Double Ninth Festival Tea Tasting" activity on the eve of this year's Double Ninth Festival. Invite friends to drink chrysanthemum tea, enjoy home-made snacks, listen to Chinese folk music, and watch the scene of the Double Ninth Festival in the Grand View Garden in "A Dream of Red Mansions". Teacher Chen Pu will share with friends the origin of the Double Ninth Festival, the food and activities of the Double Ninth Festival, etc. Teacher Chen will also talk about the drinking of chrysanthemum tea and health care. If you are willing, friends can also bring their own stories related to the Double Ninth Festival to share with everyone. Time: Saturday, October 20, 2012 6:10-6:30pm Tea tasting, snacks, and chatting 6:30-8:00pm Double Ninth Festival cultural lecture, excerpt appreciation of "Dream of Red Mansions", etc. Location: New Oriental Art School (EAA) 1100 N Alma School Rd, Suite 18, consultation hotline: (602) 490-8613; (480) 319-1098 or email to: azeaainfo@gmail.com Note: "New Oriental Culture Forum" is co-hosted by New Oriental Art School and Dr. Chen Pu's "Oasis Culture and Education", and planned by "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese Network. Adhering to the consistent purpose of "inheriting civilization and creating the future", it is open to the public free of charge.

4c716f3156bfce6486e700fb93157ae34a5a07c8.sourceText: （本网讯）2014年11月15日，为迎接即将到来的2014年感恩节，美中文化艺术交流协会特别在钱德勒市演艺中心举办了一场别开生面的文艺晚会。晚会以歌颂感恩，和平， 爱为主题，完美地结合了来自东方和西方的文化蕴涵， 由中西方各类艺术家为各界人士及广大观众献上了一场精彩的演出。 生命是礼物，奉献是恩典，当年来到美国新大陆追求宗教自由的清教徒，流传下来盛名的民歌有一首名为「简单的礼物」的歌，歌词唱道：人能活得简单，自由就是一个礼物，我们能在哪就在哪裡，真是最好的礼物，当我们找到最简单的自己，就会一切顺利，无忧无虑。不要为勤劳而自卑，弯身的谦卑，一转又一转，付出的爱心，无私的奉献，就是最好的礼物。 「亚省华人合唱团」联合「侬思天才学校」小歌手们一起献唱的「简单的礼物」，百老汇经典音乐剧Carousel插曲，「你永远不会孤单行路」，「奇异恩典」，「不了情」，「阿利路亚」等等名曲。 著名歌唱家Renee Morgan Brooks 独唱「同一力量」
4c716f3156bfce6486e700fb93157ae34a5a07c8.translatedText: (News from this website) On November 15, 2014, in order to welcome the upcoming Thanksgiving Day of 2014, the US-China Cultural and Art Exchange Association held a unique literary evening at the Chandler Performing Arts Center. With the theme of praising gratitude, peace and love, the party perfectly combined the cultural connotations from the East and the West. Various Chinese and Western artists presented a wonderful performance to people from all walks of life and the audience. Life is a gift, and dedication is grace. The Puritans who came to the New World in the United States to pursue religious freedom have a famous folk song called "Simple Gift" that has been handed down. The lyrics sing: People can live simply, and freedom is a gift. We can be wherever we can. It is really the best gift. When we find the simplest version of ourselves, everything will go smoothly and be carefree. Don't feel inferior because of hard work. The humility of bending down, the love and selfless dedication you give are the best gifts. The "Alberta Chinese Choir" and the young singers of the "Non Si Gifted School" sang "A Simple Gift", an episode of the Broadway classic musical Carousel, "You'll Never Walk Alone", "Amazing Grace", "No Love", "Hallelujah" and other famous songs. Famous singer Renee Morgan Brooks soloed "The Same Power"

3086b92a9e9534a29f13f63bda313a9edb4bc2b5.translatedText: What should I do if my hair falls out when I wash my hair? Correct care is very important Most people lose hair when they wash their hair, but the degree is different. Some people lose a few hairs slightly...

2b986c3053e6182fa427a3b4e77226b44368a412.sourceText: 大部分人洗头发的时候都会脱发，只是程度不同而已，有的人是轻微的掉几根头发，而有的人却是十分严重的脱发。那么洗头发的时候头发脱落需要引起我们的重视吗？
2b986c3053e6182fa427a3b4e77226b44368a412.translatedText: Most people lose hair when they wash their hair, but the degree is different. Some people lose a few hairs slightly, while some people have very severe hair loss. So do we need to pay attention to hair falling out when washing our hair?

000f7b16afd5640254c6fe1ca3ce00ac0283e4e6.sourceText: 有什么方法可以改善洗头发时大量脱发的情况呢？朋友们需要认识到的问题是洗头发时掉头发不是一件严重的事情，正常的情况下，掉20根以内的头发，都不需要引起大家的担心。如果大量的脱发和掉发，那么朋友们就要好好的考虑一下，是哪些原因引发了脱发。有些人在洗头发之前有一个不好的习惯，就是先用梳子比较粗暴的梳理头发。
000f7b16afd5640254c6fe1ca3ce00ac0283e4e6.translatedText: Is there any way to improve the situation of massive hair loss when washing hair? What friends need to realize is that hair loss when washing hair is not a serious matter. Under normal circumstances, hair loss of less than 20 strands does not need to cause anyone to worry. If there is a lot of hair loss and hair loss, then friends should carefully consider what causes hair loss. Some people have a bad habit of combing their hair roughly with a comb before washing their hair.

3813cf9d275d11682dae7aa9ccbfd7f6515ccbaa.sourceText: 在这个过程中就有头发大量脱落，只不过是没有被朋友们发现。由于洗发水的顺滑作用，脱落的头发就出现在朋友们的眼前，虽然可能会让你感到吃惊，但是这些脱落的头发并不一定全是在洗头发的那个时刻掉的。因此朋友们在洗头发的过程中，注意动作要轻柔，尤其是女生，不要用长长的指甲去挠自己的头皮，这样很容易损坏毛囊引起头发的脱落。
3813cf9d275d11682dae7aa9ccbfd7f6515ccbaa.translatedText: A lot of hair fell out during this process, but it was just not discovered by my friends. Due to the smoothing effect of shampoo, the falling hair appears in front of your friends. Although it may surprise you, these falling hairs do not necessarily fall out at the moment of washing your hair. Therefore, when washing your hair, friends should pay attention to gentle movements, especially girls, and do not scratch their scalp with long nails. This can easily damage the hair follicles and cause hair loss.

4694fbe321f9290859ec1bc40c9eb2767c3fbd7d.sourceText: 对的洗头发的方式，是先将头发用水打湿，然后将洗发水挤在手掌上，揉出泡沫再涂到头发上。轻轻的按摩自己的头发，揉出更多的泡沫，这样也有助于将头发清洗的更加干净。另外，你要看一下自己使用的洗发水是否太具有刺激性。如果购买的洗护产品质量不过关，或者是不适合自己，那么很容易引起头皮过敏或者发炎。
4694fbe321f9290859ec1bc40c9eb2767c3fbd7d.translatedText: The correct way to wash your hair is to wet your hair with water first, then squeeze the shampoo into your palms, work it into a lather and then apply it to your hair. Gently massage your hair to create more foam, which will also help to wash your hair cleaner. In addition, you should check whether the shampoo you are using is too harsh. If the quality of the care products you buy is not up to par, or if they are not suitable for you, it can easily cause scalp allergies or inflammation.

8e3c4b5e6acdbeaf3da8353a103819a9e0c53326.sourceText: 如果发生了这样的情况，就会有大量健康的头发脱落。如果不及时的停止使用该产品，并到正规的医院去治疗，头发脱落的数量会越来越多。
8e3c4b5e6acdbeaf3da8353a103819a9e0c53326.translatedText: If this happens, a lot of healthy hair will fall out. If you do not stop using this product in time and go to a regular hospital for treatment, more and more hair will fall out.

67c0d310a0bbe849d8eeda49dc178119262a2474.sourceText: 由香港贸易发展局主办的第18届香港时装节春夏系列4日起一连4天在香港会议展览中心举行，吸引来自中国内地、印度、日本和韩国等24个国家及地区超过1300家参展商参加。
67c0d310a0bbe849d8eeda49dc178119262a2474.translatedText: The 18th Hong Kong Fashion Festival Spring and Summer Collection, hosted by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council, will be held at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Center for four consecutive days starting from the 4th, attracting more than 1,300 exhibitors from 24 countries and regions including Mainland China, India, Japan and South Korea.

e9b9798a520bc456dc86ee162f8319c7caf962ca.sourceText: 展览今年新增”牛仔服饰”和”时尚手袋”专区，展出多种以牛仔布制作的时装饰品以及手袋作为时装主要配件之一的崭新设计。大会还将重点推介香港设计新力量，通过举办以”穿梭时光”为题的时装表演，展示10余名本地设计师的最新作品。此外，来自两所香港的大学的学生也将举行专场时装表演。
e9b9798a520bc456dc86ee162f8319c7caf962ca.translatedText: This year, the exhibition has added "Denim Clothing" and "Fashion Handbags" special areas, displaying a variety of fashion accessories made of denim and new designs of handbags as one of the main accessories of fashion. The conference will also focus on promoting Hong Kong's new design forces, and will showcase the latest works of more than 10 local designers through a fashion show with the theme of "Traveling Through Time". In addition, students from two Hong Kong universities will also hold special fashion shows.

1bce2b30b34d2abe9c61fb579858281311992b32.sourceText: 香港贸发局副总裁周启良说，香港本地时装设计师与制衣业相辅相成，同步发展，一方面具备创意和弹性，紧贴市场需要；另一方面，拥有丰富的市场推广经验。
1bce2b30b34d2abe9c61fb579858281311992b32.translatedText: Hong Kong Trade Development Council Vice President Zhou Kailiang said that Hong Kong's local fashion designers and the garment industry complement each other and develop simultaneously. On the one hand, they are creative and flexible to keep up with market needs; on the other hand, they have rich marketing experience.

65411a5f0a35f0ea3d40a56b1858ea3b3e12ce90.sourceText: 同期举行的还有第八届香港夏季礼品、家庭用品及玩具展。共有146个来自70个国家和地区的近6200名买家到两个展览会参与采购。
65411a5f0a35f0ea3d40a56b1858ea3b3e12ce90.translatedText: Also held at the same time is the 8th Hong Kong Summer Gifts, Household Products and Toys Fair. A total of 146 nearly 6,200 buyers from 70 countries and regions participated in the two exhibitions.

ac3c3fcad0a4613fbb17945bcf2d1c2f865c8038.translatedText: The White House may nominate Montana Senator Baucus as the new ambassador to China. On Wednesday, White House officials said that they will appoint Montana Senator Max?#40077;…

6e7184de7b0cc7793d3259f4129ed56b7b1ba480.sourceText: 白宫或提名蒙大拿参议员鲍卡斯为新一任驻华大使 周三，白宫官员表示将任命蒙大拿州参议员马克斯?#40077;卡斯(Max Baucus)为新一届驻华大使。该消息已经得到另一参议员和鲍卡斯一好友的确认。 现年72岁的鲍卡斯曾经表示他不会参加2014年参议员的竞选。 该消息目前还未得到官方确认，鲍卡斯本人也拒绝对此置评。 作为参议院财政委员会主席，鲍卡斯曾参与奥巴马健保法的制定，也曾对健保法的执行提出异议。 鲍卡斯也曾表达希望改革国家税法的愿望。在数十年的争取都失败后，鲍卡斯和来自众议院筹款委员会的戴维 坎普都表示希望在今年能解决这一问题。而提名他为新任 驻华大使的消息可能会使这一愿望继续搁置。
6e7184de7b0cc7793d3259f4129ed56b7b1ba480.translatedText: The White House may nominate Montana Senator Baucus as the new ambassador to China. On Wednesday, White House officials said that they will appoint Montana Senator Max Kass. Baucus) as the new ambassador to China. The news has been confirmed by another senator and a close friend of Baucus. Baucus, 72, has said he will not run for Senate in 2014. The news has not yet been officially confirmed, and Baucus himself declined to comment. As chairman of the Senate Finance Committee, Baucus participated in the formulation of Obama's health care law and also raised objections to its implementation. Baucus has also expressed a desire to reform the nation's tax code. After decades of failed efforts, both Baucus and House Ways and Means Committee Rep. David Kemp expressed hope that the issue could be resolved this year. The news of his nomination as the new ambassador to China may further put this wish on hold.

e58d96154d6689794e78fa4401c28d21558ae599.sourceText: 中国国民党美国亚利桑那直属分部于3月22日上午11时在凤凰城召开直属分部座谈会，就当前《海峡两岸服务贸易协议》(简称服贸)，台湾七合一选举，以及凤城侨务工作，广徵党员同志及侨界先进的看法和意见。中央候补委员姚其川，亚利桑那大学鲍家麟教授，侨务顾问李玲麟，本分部顾问陈超仁牧师，侨界领袖吴亮祖、司徒日贤、余文焯、黄振捷，资深党员邓锡邦、闵中英、詹浩文、游震远等列席指导，或发表见解，或简介所属社团，总计与会人员逾百位。
e58d96154d6689794e78fa4401c28d21558ae599.translatedText: The Arizona branch of the Chinese Kuomintang in the United States held a symposium in Phoenix at 11 a.m. on March 22 to solicit advanced views and opinions from party members and comrades and the overseas Chinese community on the current Cross-Strait Agreement on Trade in Services (referred to as Trade in Services), Taiwan's seven-in-one election, and the work of overseas Chinese in Fengcheng. Alternate member of the Central Committee Yao Qichuan, Professor Bao Jialin of the University of Arizona, Overseas Chinese Affairs Consultant Li Linglin, Pastor Chen Chaoren, consultant of this branch, overseas Chinese leaders Wu Liangzu, Situ Rixian, Yu Wenzhuo, Huang Zhenjie, senior party members Deng Xibang, Min Zhongying, Zhan Haowen, You Zhenyuan, etc. attended the meeting to give guidance, express their opinions, or introduce their associations. A total of more than 100 people attended the meeting.

2c4f98316b761df829f9c0d4bf107462f51d2507.sourceText: 海峡两岸服务贸易协议
2c4f98316b761df829f9c0d4bf107462f51d2507.translatedText: Cross-Strait Agreement on Trade in Services

d10a30cac8b126d285869e30be157a1a17497c2a.translatedText: Professor Yao introduced the "Agreement on Trade in Services"

90349c7d84991ec00729a84b44e302144df61368.sourceText: 姚教授开讲，首论服贸协议，续谈七合一选举。自清朝以来，大陆沿海城市天津、青岛、上海、杭州、广州，皆因贸易通商而繁荣至今，现代国家经济尤仰赖于自由市场之竞争能力，贸易协定与关税优惠乃竞争能力无可或缺之攸关条件，闭关自守，必将自取灭亡。姚教授认为，《海峡两岸经济合作架构协议》（ECFA）係马英九能连任之主要原因之一，若后续之服贸协议再次成功签定，民进党将执政无望，该党怎能不刻意曲解，万般阻挠该协议之达成。 3月18日晚间，反服贸的学生及民众佔领立法院议事厅，要求行政院收回服贸协议，国会运作全面瘫痪，公物惨遭破坏，并拟发起全国罢工、罢课，但无任何建设性之提议，在在显示其自大无知，愚昧盲从。政客伺机煽动唆使，不惜操弄反服贸为政治工具，焦虑到原形毕露地喊出”冻蒜”，全然罔顾整个国家社会有形无形之沉痛损失。 本分部委员谷音电邮指出，绿党假借服贸事件，包围国民党总部，霸佔立法院，欲陷马总统动用警察镇暴，扩大事件成为政治迫害、白色恐怖，拉低国民党的民众支持率，将单纯之经济议题，操弄成意识型态之政治事件，遂行一党私慾，牺牲全民利益。 与会绝大多数发言均体认政府之忍辱负重，祈愿能早日化险为夷，恢复民主法治之运作。但有香港及大陆友人，微词马总统柔弱姑息。另一台湾移民发言，钦佩学生精神，此诚属其个人意见。但全会场尚无一人不认为立法院那位王某某，应有所担当，尽其职责。
90349c7d84991ec00729a84b44e302144df61368.translatedText: Professor Yao started the lecture, first discussing the Agreement on Trade in Services and continuing to talk about the seven-in-one election. Since the Qing Dynasty, the mainland's coastal cities of Tianjin, Qingdao, Shanghai, Hangzhou, and Guangzhou have all prospered due to trade. The modern national economy relies especially on the competitiveness of the free market. Trade agreements and tariff preferences are indispensable and critical conditions for competitiveness. Being closed to the outside world will lead to self-destruction. Professor Yao believes that the Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA) is one of the main reasons why Ma Ying-jeou can be re-elected. If the subsequent services trade agreement is successfully signed again, the DPP will have no hope of governing. How can the party not deliberately misinterpret and obstruct the conclusion of the agreement in every possible way. On the evening of March 18, anti-service trade students and people occupied the legislative chamber of the Legislative Yuan and demanded that the Executive Yuan take back the service trade agreement. The operation of Congress was completely paralyzed, public properties were severely damaged, and they planned to launch a nationwide strike and class strike, but without any constructive suggestions, they showed their arrogance, ignorance, and blind obedience. Politicians are waiting for opportunities to incite and instigate, and they do not hesitate to use anti-service trade as a political tool. They are so anxious that they shout "frozen garlic", completely ignoring the tangible and intangible heavy losses to the entire country and society. Gu Yin, a member of this branch, pointed out in an email that the Green Party used the trade in services incident to surround the KMT headquarters and occupy the Legislative Yuan in an attempt to trap President Ma in using police to suppress violence. They expanded the incident into a political persecution and white terror, lowering the KMT’s public support. They turned a simple economic issue into an ideological political incident, fulfilling the selfish desires of one party and sacrificing the interests of the entire people. Most of the speeches at the meeting recognized the government's humiliation and burden, and prayed that the danger could be turned into safety as soon as possible and the operation of democracy and the rule of law could be restored. However, some friends from Hong Kong and mainland China criticized President Ma for being soft and appeasing. Another Taiwanese immigrant spoke and expressed his admiration for the students' spirit. This is his personal opinion. But there was no one in the meeting who didn’t think that Mr. Wang from the Legislative Yuan should take responsibility and fulfill his duties.

3195cfa9a2634bd9997e5329e3db6655309f55c9.sourceText: 七合一地方公职选举 今年11月29日，台湾将举行史上第一次”七合一”地方公职合併选举。顾名思义，就是除总统与立委以外，其馀七项地方公职人员合併选举，包含最为瞩目的六都市长及市议员。姚教授简介七合一选举主要县市候选人及朝野两党之优劣情势后，强调台湾没有革命环境，人民追求安定富足，不会接受街头运动及暴力路线。马英九以柔克刚，诉之理性感性的应变对策，实有所考量，应予支持。 资深党员詹浩文关心党内提名及初选机制能落实，勿导致脱党分裂而双双败选。闵中英质疑台湾媒体误导社会视听，成天谩骂，毫无基本良知道德。师承台北郝市长”责任选举”论之启发，本分部王常委认为，选举道德暨责任应予秉持，不伦不类地妄称”大明王朝”，应有所解释，加以道歉。无缘无由地要求马总统为败选负责，应先反省自己，检视所有相关人员的责任。
3195cfa9a2634bd9997e5329e3db6655309f55c9.translatedText: Seven-in-one local public office election On November 29 this year, Taiwan will hold the first "seven-in-one" local public office merger election in history. As the name suggests, in addition to the president and legislators, the remaining seven local public officials are merged into elections, including the most eye-catching mayors and city councilors of the six cities. After Professor Yao introduced the pros and cons of the major county and city candidates and the ruling and opposition parties in the seven-in-one election, he emphasized that Taiwan does not have a revolutionary environment. The people pursue stability and prosperity and will not accept street movements and violent lines. Ma Ying-jeou uses softness to overcome strength and appeals for rational and emotional response measures. This is indeed considered and should be supported. Senior party member Zhan Haowen is concerned that the party's nomination and primary election mechanism can be implemented to prevent the party from splitting and both losing the election. Min Chung-ying questioned Taiwan's media for misleading society, hurling abuses all day long, and having no basic conscience and morality. Inspired by Taipei Mayor Hao's "responsible election" theory, Wang, a member of the Standing Committee of this branch, believes that election ethics and responsibilities should be upheld, and those who falsely call the "Ming Dynasty" should be explained and apologized. President Ma is being asked to take responsibility for losing the election without any reason. He should first reflect on himself and examine the responsibilities of all relevant personnel.

5a78caef782f723907be90be08a1af86c1f552e8.sourceText: 凤城侨务工作 侨务顾问坦言直陈，当前侨务工作执行偏差，资源分配不均，屡有双重标准，未能公平公正，侨务政策当然无法贯彻一致、获得支持。审视当前凤凰城台湾侨社，离心离德，公信力渐失，诚良有因也，非三言两语所能道尽。侨务顾问亦进一步指出，侨务工作应含括国民外交及华文教育之推展，侨务工作的困难，侨委会应予协助解决。 资深党员游震远公佈一则寻人启事。本埠王楠医生寻找于1989年在德州达拉斯慷慨资助他一家之张树中先生。时王医师于当地”青叶”餐厅勤工俭学，又值夫人​​待产，张先生两次雪中送炭，无偿资助。其后移居加州，为善不求回报，未留下任何通讯信息，仅知他来自台湾，时与夫人育有两幼儿，专业电脑。廿五年来，王医师铭记在心，不能或忘，今急欲找到这位昔日恩人，恳请大家协助。
5a78caef782f723907be90be08a1af86c1f552e8.translatedText: Overseas Chinese Affairs Consultants in Fengcheng frankly stated that the current overseas Chinese affairs work is implemented deviantly, resources are unevenly distributed, double standards are often used, and it is not fair and just. Of course, the overseas Chinese affairs policy cannot be implemented consistently and gain support. Looking at the current Taiwanese overseas community in Phoenix City, they are alienated from morality and gradually lose credibility. There are reasons for being honest and good, which cannot be explained in a few words. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Consultant further pointed out that overseas Chinese affairs work should include the promotion of national diplomacy and Chinese education. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee should help solve the difficulties in overseas Chinese affairs work. Senior party member You Zhenyuan announced a missing person notice. Local doctor Wang Nan is looking for Mr. Zhang Shuzhong who generously supported his family in Dallas, Texas in 1989. At that time, Dr. Wang was working as a part-time student at the local "Qingye" restaurant, and his wife was expecting a baby. Mr. Zhang twice provided help in times of need and provided free financial support. Later, he moved to California and did good deeds without asking for anything in return. He did not leave any communication information. We only knew that he was from Taiwan. At that time, he and his wife had two young children and he was a computer professional. Over the past twenty-five years, Dr. Wang has been engraved in my heart and cannot be forgotten. Now I am eager to find this former benefactor, and I sincerely ask for your help.

73eac470b349516d138aac9fac75b5df7c917760.translatedText: The state of Hawaii issued Obama's birth certificate, ending the challenge of his birthplace. China News Service, May 23 (Xinhua) According to foreign reports, the US state of Hawaii voted to Arizona...

6d80ce9b23e1b5657d0dcfdb6ced69b9ad58d5bd.sourceText: 中新网5月23日电 据外电报道，美国夏威夷州向亚利桑那州选举委员会主席出具了美国总统奥巴马的出生证明，结束两州持续将近3个月的纷争。
6d80ce9b23e1b5657d0dcfdb6ced69b9ad58d5bd.translatedText: China News Service, May 23 (Xinhua) According to foreign reports, the US state of Hawaii issued US President Obama's birth certificate to the chairman of the Arizona State Election Commission, ending a nearly three-month dispute between the two states.

fc463f4bcb78b4f75183a554cf65862df0151a0b.sourceText: 夏威夷州司法部长的特别助手维斯奇(Joshua Wisch)当地时间22日晚间表示，夏威夷州向亚利桑那州出示了其一直在寻找的奥巴马的出生证明后，事件得到解决。
fc463f4bcb78b4f75183a554cf65862df0151a0b.translatedText: Joshua Wisch, special assistant to the Hawaii Attorney General, said on the evening of the 22nd local time that the incident was resolved after the state of Hawaii showed Arizona the Obama birth certificate it had been looking for.

c2d57f7fb55a6da227473f6906cf2b929a346fd3.sourceText: 夏威夷州曾多次保证奥巴马出生在该州，但起初并没有答应亚利桑那州提出的出具出生证明的要求，引起两州的纷争。
c2d57f7fb55a6da227473f6906cf2b929a346fd3.translatedText: The state of Hawaii has repeatedly guaranteed that Obama was born in the state, but initially did not agree to Arizona's request for a birth certificate, causing disputes between the two states.

6a4947e4faaca1a47f62964ddba42a9b6c12556c.sourceText: 亚利桑那州一名发言人说他收到了证明书，将于星期三(23日)发表评论。
6a4947e4faaca1a47f62964ddba42a9b6c12556c.translatedText: An Arizona spokesman said he had received the certificate and would comment on Wednesday (23rd).

808b82bd8e294861e06d8a5cda4eacf4cd43e56e.sourceText: 奥巴马的出生地问题持续不断遭到质疑。美国白宫在2011年提供了奥巴马出生证明的电子版文件，以证实奥巴马的确出生在美国。
808b82bd8e294861e06d8a5cda4eacf4cd43e56e.translatedText: Obama's birthplace continues to be questioned. The White House provided an electronic version of Obama's birth certificate in 2011 to confirm that Obama was indeed born in the United States.

d9990e206ba15c927e70a0caa1ae6d3ad0a778a4.sourceText: 今年3月1日，美国亚利桑那州一名警长阿尔佩欧声称，他的调查团队发现了奥巴马的美国出生证明系伪造的证据。阿尔佩欧说，他的调查人员认为白宫提供的出生证恐怕是直接制造出来的电子版文件，而不是真正出生证的扫描文件。
d9990e206ba15c927e70a0caa1ae6d3ad0a778a4.translatedText: On March 1 this year, Alpeo, a police chief in Arizona, USA, claimed that his investigation team found evidence that Obama’s American birth certificate was forged. Arpeo said his investigators believe the birth certificate provided by the White House may have been a directly manufactured electronic version of the document, rather than a scan of the actual birth certificate.

663224d45e4163b765119b2472af546a11cd4165.sourceText: 美国宪法规定，唯有出生时是美国公民者方可担任总统。质疑奥巴马出生地的怀疑论者们欲利用此点否定奥巴马的总统资格。
663224d45e4163b765119b2472af546a11cd4165.translatedText: The U.S. Constitution stipulates that only those who were U.S. citizens by birth can serve as president. Skeptics who question Obama's birthplace are trying to use this point to deny Obama's presidential qualifications.

091b661ee29e760fc91b823fca113a60457b9825.translatedText: Photo news: The grand occasion of the Alberta Golden Autumn Dance and Art Festival In 2014, the Golden Autumn Dance Art Festival, co-sponsored by the New Oriental School of Art in Alberta, the Confucius Institute at ASU, and the Arizona Chinese Overseas Chinese Association...

0aa362eb27651fce79b7d3f072a5322d7cde2873.sourceText: ２０１４年由亚省新东方艺术学校，ＡＳＵ孔子学院，亚利桑那华人华侨联合会共同主办的金秋舞蹈艺术节于昨天下午（9/14/2014）在钱德勒艺术中心落下帷幕。辛勤学习一年的同学，为老师，家长，社区的中美朋友交上了圆满的答卷。下面我们用精美的图片展示舞蹈节的盛况。
0aa362eb27651fce79b7d3f072a5322d7cde2873.translatedText: The Golden Autumn Dance Art Festival in 2014, co-sponsored by the New Oriental Art School in Alberta, the Confucius Institute at ASU, and the Arizona Chinese Overseas Chinese Association, came to an end yesterday afternoon (9/14/2014) at the Chandler Art Center. The students who have studied hard for a year have given satisfactory results to teachers, parents, and Chinese and American friends in the community. Below we use exquisite pictures to show the grand occasion of the dance festival.
