98e7e29f6dfff2edefffc03cc8c4f9e5cfda6b30.translatedText: Basic skill report: Ode to the Red Flag

8cc4114ca73b128a5e77a36bafe25b73d195e2a6.sourceText: 刚到凤凰城的时候，凤凰城的中文教育规模还比较小，那时希望中文学校（旧称坦佩中文学校）和现代中文学校加起来学生也不过200人。当时一方面华人社区规模没这么大，另一方面也有不少家庭不重视孩子的中文教育，所以当孩子上中文学校的时候我除了是个积极的家长外，也写过两篇呼吁华人应重视下一代汉语教育的文章，特别是《海外中文教育要珍惜难得的双母语教育环境》在网上曾流传一时。
8cc4114ca73b128a5e77a36bafe25b73d195e2a6.translatedText: When I first arrived in Phoenix, the scale of Chinese education in Phoenix was still relatively small. At that time, Hope Chinese School (formerly known as Tempe Chinese School) and Modern Chinese School had only 200 students combined. At that time, on the one hand, the scale of the Chinese community was not so large, and on the other hand, there were many families who did not attach importance to their children's Chinese education. Therefore, in addition to being an active parent when my children attended Chinese schools, I also wrote two articles calling on the Chinese to pay attention to the Chinese education of the next generation. In particular, "Overseas Chinese Education Should Cherish the Rare Bilingual Education Environment" was circulated on the Internet for a while.

41fa2a7dac56dcc7da8db7b326c200bd27f72536.sourceText: 此文一经刊出还真起了点作用，我周围的一些朋友原来抱着我们又不准备回国，学中文干什么的想法，要让孩子有一个快乐的童年，不逼孩子学习，自然也不去中文学校。后来在我的影响下，虽然住的离中文学校相当远，大家还是carpool坚持把孩子送到中文学校去了，我挺欣慰，也为多几个传承中华文明的华人孩子感到高兴。不经意间十来年过去了，现代和希望两所中文学校各自都有了近千人的规模，给人以中华文化生生不息的感觉。
41fa2a7dac56dcc7da8db7b326c200bd27f72536.translatedText: This article really helped once it was published. Some friends around me originally thought that since we were not planning to return to China, what would we do to learn Chinese? If we want our children to have a happy childhood and do not force them to study, they would naturally not go to Chinese schools. Later, under my influence, everyone insisted on sending their children to a Chinese school even though they lived far away from the Chinese school. I was very pleased and happy to have more Chinese children inheriting Chinese civilization. Inadvertently, more than ten years have passed, and each of the two Chinese schools, Modern Times and Hope, has a scale of nearly a thousand students, giving people a sense that Chinese culture is endless.

6a005a761de10547c6773f44cfc27f6b9372639c.sourceText: 不过前一个周六遇到一位朋友，我问今天没去中文学校吗？她说早不去了，我们几家都不去了。话不投机半句多，为什么不去好像不是我的生意。这儿说”话不投机”来自一句笑话，某些海外华人以骂中国为时尚，特别喜欢在网上挖掘国内的负面消息用做消遣自娱自乐的话题，每次朋友聚会都比着看谁骂中国骂的凶。于是有一个朋友提出一个比较典型的问题，（因为这个问题对事儿不对人非常具有代表性，于是就收入了我的文章）。这个问题是，中国经济繁荣，但是中国没有人权；墨西哥经济萧条毒品泛滥，但墨西哥是民主国家，墨西哥有人权，如果让你选择移民你是选择中国还是选择墨西哥呢？
6a005a761de10547c6773f44cfc27f6b9372639c.translatedText: But I met a friend the previous Saturday and I asked if I didn’t go to Chinese school today? She said she would not go early, and none of our families would go. It's not enough to talk about speculation. Why don't you go? It doesn't seem to be my business. The saying "talking without speculation" comes from a joke. Some overseas Chinese consider it fashionable to scold China. They especially like to dig up negative domestic news on the Internet as a topic for entertainment and entertainment. Every time friends get together, they compete to see who scolds China the most. So a friend asked a relatively typical question (because this question is very representative of the situation and the person, so it was included in my article). The problem is that China's economy is prosperous, but China has no human rights; Mexico's economy is depressed and drugs are rampant, but Mexico is a democratic country and Mexico has human rights. If you were asked to choose to immigrate, would you choose China or Mexico?

7fe039a944f18526d9e69a733cde49f7421b4710.sourceText: 有了这个铺垫大家心里该明白了，都选择去墨西哥了自然用不着再去中文学校。按理说别人上不上中文学校关不上我什么事，但是这事在华人圈里还有一定代表性，特别是我还把他们当朋友，也为孩子们错过这个阶段感到可惜，所以总想写点什么让他们明白一些道理。
7fe039a944f18526d9e69a733cde49f7421b4710.translatedText: With this foreshadowing, everyone should understand that since they have chosen to go to Mexico, there is no need to go to a Chinese school. Logically speaking, whether others can attend Chinese schools has nothing to do with me, but this matter is still representative in the Chinese community, especially since I still regard them as friends, and I feel sorry for the children to miss this stage, so I always want to write something to let them understand some truths.

374b1d5964dcee8e7b1de925e9cc831663c3b974.sourceText: 我教过的学生有来自与中国有生意往来企业的，有准备去中国旅游做生意的，还有娶了华人老婆的，但是最引我注意的还是本身就是华人的学生。
374b1d5964dcee8e7b1de925e9cc831663c3b974.translatedText: Some of the students I have taught come from companies that do business with China, some are planning to travel to China for business, and some are married to Chinese wives. But the students who caught my attention the most are the students who are Chinese themselves.

775154c1d8893b69e6b9e93b7487a310ea93eddf.sourceText: 华人学生占全部学生的1/3左右，大部分父母是粤语老侨，子女顶多能听懂一点粤语，普通话一点都不会。其中有一位只知道自己的中文名字，在Mayo Clinic工作的医生，工作挺忙，不知哪根神经搭错了突然决定要捡回老祖宗的语言，医生不差钱差的自然是时间，由于工作太忙，终于学期快要结束时，知难而退找了一个接口不来了。还有一个马来西亚华侨，不仅自己来了还带着白人老婆一起来学。有一个代理船运报关的公司因为有太多的中国业务一下送来4位员工，其中包括一名华人和一名日本人。
775154c1d8893b69e6b9e93b7487a310ea93eddf.translatedText: Chinese students account for about 1/3 of all students. Most of their parents are Cantonese-speaking seniors. Their children can understand a little bit of Cantonese at most, but not Mandarin at all. One of them only knew his Chinese name and was a doctor working at the Mayo Clinic. He was very busy at work, and he suddenly decided to pick up the language of his ancestors. The only difference between doctors was money and time. Because he was so busy with work, at the end of the semester, he gave up and found an interface that stopped working. There is also an overseas Chinese from Malaysia who not only came here by himself but also brought his white wife to study with him. There was a shipping customs agency that sent four employees, including one Chinese and one Japanese, because it had too much Chinese business.

a318c0f52d92ea6d77da85a0d5b75f42718b1326.sourceText: 成年人学外语难学中文就更难，尽管这些华人多多少少都有一点中文背景，比西人接受中文快一点，但是习惯了拼音文字，要记住象形文字堪比爬高山，没点儿耐力和动力恐怕是不可能的。不像我们当年学外语是为了考大学，出国没办法，即使如此我们大多数都是经过了经年累月地学习，还学了个哑巴英语。在美国成年人学中文能坚持下来的凤毛麟角。
a318c0f52d92ea6d77da85a0d5b75f42718b1326.translatedText: It is difficult for adults to learn foreign languages ​​and it is even more difficult to learn Chinese. Although these Chinese people have more or less Chinese backgrounds and accept Chinese a little faster than Westerners, they are used to pinyin writing. To remember hieroglyphics is like climbing a mountain. Without a little endurance and motivation, it may be impossible. It’s not like when we learned foreign languages ​​in order to take college entrance exams, and there was no way to go abroad. Even so, most of us have learned a mute English after years of studying. Very few adults in the United States can persist in learning Chinese.

54811309fa7674c89b8f209bcddc73b95925dceb.sourceText: 我们成人中文班里有一个未成年初中学生，父亲是从德国再移到美国的海外第三代华人，自然一句中文都不会讲，母亲8岁从台湾移民美国，中文也不是太灵光，但是他们痛定思痛体会到当年他们的父母没有让他们学中文给他们带来的终身遗憾，一定要让自己的孩子会说自己的语言。孩子就是孩子，加上家里母亲那里有一定的语言环境，这个华人孩子是我的学生中学得最快，语言能力最强的。
54811309fa7674c89b8f209bcddc73b95925dceb.translatedText: There is an underage junior high school student in our adult Chinese class. His father is a third-generation overseas Chinese who moved from Germany to the United States. Naturally, he cannot speak a word of Chinese. His mother immigrated to the United States from Taiwan when she was 8 years old. Her Chinese is not very good. However, they have learned the hard way and realized the lifelong regret that their parents did not let them learn Chinese. They must let their children speak their own language. Children are children, and the mother has a certain language environment at home. This Chinese child is the fastest among my students to learn and has the strongest language ability.

afc2bb5c62bfcdba9692c4d91af869bb4383d1df.sourceText: 这也间接告诉我们一个道理，如果你错过了学习语言的最佳年龄，不仅事半功倍，而且几乎是不可能的。我们班上能够坚持下来学习中文的一个成年华人都没有，基本都是学过一个学期就知难而退，再也不来了。倒是有两个岁数比较大，出于爱好，学着玩儿，一直坚持着。还有一名短期在美国工作的印度女孩有非常强的求知欲，还在学着呢，进步也很快。
afc2bb5c62bfcdba9692c4d91af869bb4383d1df.translatedText: This also indirectly tells us that if you miss the best age for learning a language, you will not only get twice the result with half the effort, but it will also be almost impossible. There is not a single adult Chinese person in our class who can persist in learning Chinese. Basically, they give up after one semester and never come back. However, there are two older ones who are learning to play out of hobbies and have persisted. There is also an Indian girl who is working in the United States for a short period of time and has a very strong thirst for knowledge. She is still learning and making rapid progress.

200d9685af5fbc952b94509ad62a9d9a8a2ef760.sourceText: 孩子学不学中文关键在父母，如果父母鼠目寸光或者自己根本就看不起自己的文化，等孩子长大想学的时候可能就晚了，时间流过去是不会再流回来的。忙着给孩子攒钱，但是你攒再多的钱也买不到后悔药。
200d9685af5fbc952b94509ad62a9d9a8a2ef760.translatedText: The key to whether a child learns Chinese or not depends on the parents. If the parents are short-sighted or simply look down on their own culture, it may be too late when the child grows up and wants to learn. Time will not flow back. You are busy saving money for your children, but no matter how much money you save, you cannot buy the medicine for regret.

de6d59c28e2aa180ea5a0e6c33f7bb372503fbd0.sourceText: 海外中文教育要珍惜难得的双母语教育环境
de6d59c28e2aa180ea5a0e6c33f7bb372503fbd0.translatedText: Overseas Chinese education should cherish the rare bi-native language education environment

13b2237cd1da37741062d4791c34a7fd6637dcf6.sourceText: 研究表明，我们的大脑在处理语言学习的过程中童年和成年有着很大不同。童年学习多种语言时，大脑是用同一片区域来处理不同的语言，因而能发展出纯正的双或多母语，而人成年以后再学另外的语言，大脑就必须另外划出一片区域来处理语言学习，学习效率也就大大降低了。作为移民第一代恐怕都有学习外语痛苦的记忆和熔入当地文化艰难的体会。学习语言应该是越早越好，大约9-12岁以前学第二种语言就可以学成不带任何口音的双语 – Truly Bilingual 。
13b2237cd1da37741062d4791c34a7fd6637dcf6.translatedText: Research shows that our brains process language learning differently in childhood and adulthood. When learning multiple languages ​​in childhood, the brain uses the same area to process different languages, and thus can develop pure dual or multiple native languages. When a person learns another language as an adult, the brain must allocate another area to process language learning, and the learning efficiency is greatly reduced. As the first generation of immigrants, I’m afraid they all have memories of the pain of learning a foreign language and the experience of the difficulty of integrating into the local culture. The earlier you learn a language, the better. If you learn a second language before the age of 9-12, you can become bilingual without any accent – ​​Truly Bilingual.

e635337bc4ce8192206664980658253dd990032f.sourceText: 海外华人家庭为子女双语教育提供了一个绝好的语言环境和文化环境，如果能够坚持中文母语教育和母语会话，孩子可以自然而然地掌握纯正的双语能力并必将受益一生。英语和汉语是世界上使用最广泛和使用人口最多的两种语言，正在崛起的中国近年来已经和美国一起成为拉动世界经济增长的火车头或双驾马车。随着中国经济文化对世界影响不断扩大，和无处不在，散布在世界各地占世界人口五分之一的华人的推动，中文在本世纪无疑将成为和英文一样同等重要的语言。
e635337bc4ce8192206664980658253dd990032f.translatedText: Overseas Chinese families provide an excellent language and cultural environment for their children's bilingual education. If they can persist in Chinese mother tongue education and mother tongue conversation, their children can naturally master pure bilingual skills and will benefit from them throughout their lives. English and Chinese are the two most widely spoken and spoken languages ​​in the world. The rising China and the United States have become the locomotive or dual carriage driving world economic growth in recent years. As China's economic and cultural influence on the world continues to expand, and driven by the Chinese people who are everywhere and account for one-fifth of the world's population, Chinese will undoubtedly become as important a language as English in this century.

9e968ad8af10a6e141eccf7c8cc86503390f4307.sourceText: 双语学习在智力，记忆力，逻辑思维能力对孩子的培养方面都具有巨大的帮助。汉字作为像型文字和拼音文字不同，需要大脑不同的功能去处理，就象使用筷子使人的手指更灵巧一样，使用像型文字是人的头脑更机敏，并且在无形中促进大脑多功能的发育。中文有助于逻辑推理是不无道理的。有一位朋友的女儿，以SAT和7门学科SATII近满分和总统奖的优异成绩进入哈佛大学，她总结女儿成功经验有一点特别值得我们华人家庭借鉴，说来很简单，就是让孩子一开始学数学时，就学会用中文九九乘法表算题。
9e968ad8af10a6e141eccf7c8cc86503390f4307.translatedText: Bilingual learning is of great help in developing children's intelligence, memory, and logical thinking skills. Chinese characters as pictorial characters are different from Pinyin characters and require different functions of the brain to process. Just like using chopsticks makes people's fingers more dexterous, using pictorial characters makes people's minds more alert and invisibly promotes the development of multi-functional brains. It makes sense that Chinese is helpful for logical reasoning. A friend’s daughter entered Harvard University with nearly perfect scores on the SAT and SATII in seven subjects, as well as the Presidential Award. She concluded that her daughter’s successful experience has one thing that we Chinese families can learn from. It is very simple. When children start learning mathematics, they must learn to use the Chinese multiplication table to solve problems.

a4bf82135d5e2adc0cbb2053a70f1e9f394fb2e1.sourceText: 孩子刚开始学数学的时候用中文思考还是用英文思考看来是一个与数学好不相干的事情，但其实这里的学问大了。3X5=15，如果用中文去想只要两秒，三五十五， 共4个音节，但是你如果用英文去思考，three times five equal to fifteen, 共13个音节，每两个音节用一秒，加上句子长了中间还要停顿，同样的问题英文思考就需要量8-10秒钟，数学的运算效率就要差4-5倍。由于开始时有中文数学基础，这位朋友的女儿数学天份很快显现出来，连跳两级，从此在同龄人中这种领先的优势一直延续至今。乘法口诀是我们从上小学开始一直到老，无论是大学教授还是市井小贩，只要和数字打交道恐怕都离不开的工具。如果你留心一下中国人和美国人的计算能力的比较，你会发现有惊人的差别，大部分美国人离开计算器恐怕就不会算帐了，而中国随便叫一个不识几个字的小贩，常买菜的老太太，其口算能力都不比美国的数学老师差。另外一个重要的现象就是在国内上过几年小学的孩子，到美国以后，数学都是班上最好的。
a4bf82135d5e2adc0cbb2053a70f1e9f394fb2e1.translatedText: When children first start learning mathematics, whether they think in Chinese or English seems to be a matter that has nothing to do with mathematics, but in fact the knowledge here is bigger. 3X5=15, if you think in Chinese, it only takes two seconds, three times five equal to fifteen, a total of 4 syllables, but if you think in English, three times five equal to fifteen, a total of 13 syllables, one second for every two syllables, plus there is a pause in the middle if the sentence is long, the same problem in English will take 8-10 seconds, and the mathematical calculation efficiency will be 4-5 times worse. Since she had a basic foundation in Chinese mathematics at the beginning, this friend's daughter's talent in mathematics quickly emerged and she jumped two levels in a row. This leading advantage among her peers has continued to this day. The multiplication table is a tool that we can't live without when we are dealing with numbers, whether we are university professors or street vendors, from elementary school to old age. If you pay attention to the comparison of the calculation abilities of Chinese and Americans, you will find that there is an astonishing difference. Most Americans will not be able to calculate accounts without a calculator. However, in China, a hawker who cannot read a few words or an old lady who often buys vegetables has no worse verbal calculation ability than an American math teacher. Another important phenomenon is that children who have attended elementary school for several years in China are the best in their class in mathematics after arriving in the United States.

c49cf20b77bfbaa767535ab5a1d93d53646fa242.sourceText: 在北美华人聚居的地方大都建有周末中文学校，但仍有为数不少的华人家庭不重视子女的中文教育，典型的理由是我们又不准备回中国，学中文有什么用。许多年轻的家长大都不知道，如果孩子将来准备报考好的大学，初三或八年级就必须开始选修一门外语。与其等孩子语言能力已经基本成型后再去痛苦的开始学一门语言，还不如一开始就让他在日常生活中把中文母语学好将来作为学校的外语。掌握一门外语给孩子将来的可能带来更多的机会和更宽广的视野。一个朋友的孩子小学时回国学了一个暑假中文，后来就停了，没想到她现在就读的密西根大学可以参加中文水平考试，她在听，说方面还凑和，写就不行了，抱着试一试的心态去考了一下，居然考得还不错，学校给她免了六个学分，免学分就等于免学费和时间。
c49cf20b77bfbaa767535ab5a1d93d53646fa242.translatedText: Most places where Chinese in North America live have weekend Chinese schools, but there are still a large number of Chinese families who do not pay attention to their children's Chinese education. The typical reason is that we are not planning to go back to China, so what is the use of learning Chinese. Many young parents do not know that if their children are going to apply for a good university in the future, they must start taking a foreign language elective in the third or eighth grade of junior high school. Instead of waiting until the child's language ability has been basically formed before painfully starting to learn a language, it is better to let him learn his native Chinese in daily life from the beginning and use it as a foreign language in school. Mastering a foreign language gives children more opportunities and a broader perspective in their future. A friend’s child went back to China to study Chinese for one summer when she was in elementary school, but then stopped. She didn’t expect that the University of Michigan where she is currently studying would allow her to take the Chinese proficiency test. She was able to do well in listening and speaking, but not in writing. She took the test with the intention of giving it a try, and she actually did well. The school exempted her from six credits. The exemption of credits means tuition and time are exempted.

82ebcb40bd3771c64aa679f348cbd25b8e3fb2cb.sourceText: 还有的说不是不想让孩子学中文，只是孩子不想学，不愿逼他。美国是孩子的天堂，不愿让小时候被逼着学习的痛苦经历在孩子身上重演。周末上中文学校家长和孩子的确都要付出一些代价的，但养成习惯就不觉得辛苦了，而且不论大人还是孩子在中文学校都可以交许多朋友和参与其他社交活动，使生活更充实和丰富。其实美国也不是不逼孩子学习，比如说如果孩子不想上学，你就不让他去，那你就违反了义务教育法了。进入高中以后，学校会给你许多人生的选择，比如你想混个高中毕业，应该还比较容易，课目不多负担不重，不过现在的AIM考试也使许多人混不过去。如果毕业后只想进入社区大学就要多修一点数学和技能课程。如果准备上一般大学，数理化，生物，外语等等是必不可少的。如果要具有一定竞争力的大学，除了要修完高中必修的课程外还须选修一些大学准备课程，荣誉课程，进阶课程，准备PSAT，SAT，ACT什么的。如果你的目标是长春藤大学，你就做好吃大苦耐大劳的准备吧。除了前边提到课程外，四年的高中要准备在三年内读完，并且考完所有SAT，SATII，ACT，最后一年基本用来预修大学课程，高中四年要保持所有高中课程尽可能高的GPA，除此而外，还必需积极参加参与课外Club的活动，尽可能展现领导才能和发展自己的特长，另外还要抽出时间参加每学期至少几十小时的社会公益义务工作。只要你有精力，学校给你无限地挥洒空间。孩子还有时间玩吗？恐怕连睡觉的时间都没有了。从这一点上讲，在美国要上好大学的孩子绝对不比国内只管埋头学习的孩子轻松。不过这是孩子自己的选择，是自己逼自己。
82ebcb40bd3771c64aa679f348cbd25b8e3fb2cb.translatedText: Others say it’s not that they don’t want their children to learn Chinese, but that they just don’t want to learn and don’t want to force them. The United States is a paradise for children, and we don’t want our children to have the painful experience of being forced to study again when they were young. It is true that parents and children have to pay some price to go to Chinese school on weekends, but it is not hard to develop a habit, and both adults and children can make many friends and participate in other social activities in Chinese schools, making life more fulfilling and rich. In fact, it is not that the United States does not force children to study. For example, if a child does not want to go to school and you do not let him go, then you are violating the compulsory education law. After entering high school, the school will give you many choices in life. For example, if you want to graduate from high school, it should be relatively easy. There are not many subjects and the burden is not heavy. However, the current AIM exam also makes it difficult for many people to pass. If you just want to go to community college after graduation, you need to take more math and skills courses. If you plan to go to a general university, mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, foreign languages, etc. are essential. If you want to go to a competitive university, in addition to completing the required high school courses, you must also take some college preparation courses, honors courses, advanced courses, and prepare for PSAT, SAT, ACT, etc. If your goal is to go to an Ivy League school, be prepared to work hard. In addition to the courses mentioned above, four years of high school must be completed within three years, and all SAT, SATII, and ACT exams must be completed. The last year is basically used to prepare for college courses. The four years of high school must maintain a GPA as high as possible in all high school courses. In addition, one must actively participate in extracurricular club activities, demonstrate leadership skills and develop one's own strengths as much as possible, and also find time to participate in at least dozens of hours of voluntary social welfare work every semester. As long as you have the energy, the school will give you unlimited space to exert yourself. Do the children still have time to play? I'm afraid I don't even have time to sleep. From this point of view, it is definitely not easier for children in the United States to go to a good university than for children in China who just immerse themselves in study. But this is the child's own choice and he is forcing himself.

6c5682e25a358d609882d7fcea4378c6b1f2010f.sourceText: 趁早期孩子学习不是太忙的时候，逼他们学学中文，忙一点，养成好的学习习惯，通过学中文，提升记忆能力，到高中真忙起来也比较容易适应。较早的起步更容易培养孩子的乐趣和习惯，如果很大了才开始学，可能会产生比较大的压力。在美国白人相对比较重视教育，黑人就差很多，从最近的犯罪统计来看，黑人中有12.6%的人在30岁以前要在监狱里度过一段时间，而白人这个比例只有1.7%。好的工作绝大部分被白人占了，黑人西班牙裔只能做些低级收入低的工作。我们的孩子应该以谁为伍呢？
6c5682e25a358d609882d7fcea4378c6b1f2010f.translatedText: In the early years, when children are not too busy studying, force them to learn Chinese, be busy, and develop good study habits. By learning Chinese, they can improve their memory skills, and it will be easier for them to adapt when they are really busy in high school. It is easier to cultivate children's fun and habits by starting early. If you start learning at an early age, it may cause greater pressure. In the United States, white people pay relatively more attention to education, but black people are far behind. Judging from recent crime statistics, 12.6% of black people have to spend some time in prison before the age of 30, while the proportion of white people is only 1.7%. Most of the good jobs are occupied by white people, and black Hispanics can only do low-level, low-paying jobs. Who should our children surround themselves with?

8db376a4008273062beebc5a9251ae80853b70c7.sourceText: 还有一种人本身对自己的祖国，自己的母语不屑一顾。自己好不容易摆脱了穷苦落后的中国，怎么可能让自己的下一代有任何一点机会重回苦海。于是在自己的生活中尽可能去中国化，中国什么都不好，美国什么都是好的，就连吃洋人自己都认为的垃圾食品也觉得比中国的山珍海味香。从面子到里子都尽可能把自己打扮的很美国，只恨自己的皮不能染成白的。好象这样一来自己就成了真正的美国人，高出中国人一等。偶然回躺国更要显示自己高贵的身份数落曾用血和汗供养自己出人头地的故土的不是，当然少不了被自己的父兄在忍无可忍的情况下把这个数典忘祖的东西打出去。于是更有理由断了中国的根，发誓不再回中国，不再让自己的下一代再去讲那下等人的语言。对这种只想当洋奴的人，不学中文也就罢了，只可惜了无辜的孩子。
8db376a4008273062beebc5a9251ae80853b70c7.translatedText: There is also a kind of person who disdains his own motherland and his own mother tongue. After finally escaping poverty and backwardness in China, how could it be possible for the next generation to have any chance of returning to poverty? So I tried my best to be as Chinese as possible in my life. Nothing in China is good, and everything in the United States is good. Even the junk food that foreigners think is more delicious than the delicacies of China. From face to face, I try my best to dress myself up as American as possible. I only regret that my skin cannot be dyed white. It seems that in this way, I have become a real American, superior to the Chinese. Occasionally returning to the country would show off one's noble status and criticize those who had used their blood and sweat to support the homeland where one became famous. Of course, one's own father and brother would have to beat him out of the country when they couldn't bear it. Therefore, there is even more reason to cut off the roots of China, vow not to return to China, and never let the next generation speak the language of the inferior people again. For people like this who just want to be foreign slaves, it's fine not to learn Chinese. It's a pity for innocent children.

a877af8c25399ec4782df9ec9c176b6932a2a6d7.sourceText: 有许多领养中国孩子的美国家庭为了不让孩子断了中国根，都尽力把孩子送中文学校学点中文或请个中文家教。他们之中有许多家庭并不富裕却要承担额外的费用和精力使孩子更象中国人。不管孩子的中文教育成效如何，他们这种精神足以让那些不耻于自己文化的人汗颜。这也正是多元化，开放的美国社会成功的重要一面。
a877af8c25399ec4782df9ec9c176b6932a2a6d7.translatedText: Many American families who adopt Chinese children try their best to send their children to Chinese schools to learn some Chinese or hire a Chinese tutor in order to prevent their children from losing their Chinese roots. Many of their families are not wealthy but have to bear the extra cost and energy to make their children more like Chinese. No matter how effective the children's Chinese education is, their spirit is enough to put those who are not ashamed of their own culture to shame. This is also an important aspect of the success of the diverse and open American society.

554b8fcf4496e22730518a49e6dcc1f377ed242a.sourceText: 还有许多家庭虽然也送孩子去中文学校，但和孩子交流时却用英语，不知是自己想多学些英语呢？还是怕孩子到学校忘了怎么讲英文。其结果是自己从孩子那得到的英语十分有限，恐怕永远改不了自己的Chinglish，而孩子的中文母语教育就大打折扣了，得不偿失。
554b8fcf4496e22730518a49e6dcc1f377ed242a.translatedText: Although many families also send their children to Chinese schools, they use English when communicating with their children. I wonder if they want to learn more English? I am still afraid that my children will forget how to speak English when they arrive at school. As a result, the English I received from my children was very limited, and I am afraid I will never be able to change my Chinglish, while my children’s Chinese mother tongue education will be greatly compromised, and the gain outweighs the loss.

0114740bbfd3c364b600de73c3e6154f9234b3d9.sourceText: 重视教育是中华文化的优良传统，把孩子培养成双语人才是我们海外华人不用争取就有的得天独厚的条件，为孩子珍惜这样一个难得的机会吧。又快开学了，如果你的孩子还没有开始学中文，准备准备下学期去中文学校吧，还等什么？
0114740bbfd3c364b600de73c3e6154f9234b3d9.translatedText: Paying attention to education is a fine tradition of Chinese culture. Cultivating children to be bilingual talents is a unique condition that we overseas Chinese have without fighting for. Let’s cherish such a rare opportunity for our children. School is about to start again. If your child has not started learning Chinese yet, prepare to go to a Chinese school next semester. What are you waiting for?

d740380fcec2c6f11489073e57dc4f2bac6f74f3.sourceText: 周日去爬山 享受明媚的春光
d740380fcec2c6f11489073e57dc4f2bac6f74f3.translatedText: Go hiking on Sunday and enjoy the beautiful spring scenery

5f218ffc72fa5346be0418dee5e08f0570dbe5c1.translatedText: Americans are less and less fond of carrying cash

1414005fdec31c0156ab46b5c0f233943c2fe203.translatedText: Americans are less and less fond of carrying cash. [Reported by Kaisen, compiled by Qiaobao, March 23] A new study shows that one in four Americans rarely carry cash with them anymore...

d910199c172e74a775ebbeba80c0f3c03a93288a.sourceText: 【侨报编译凯森3月23日报道】一项新出炉的研究显示，四分之一的美国人已很少带现金出门了，千禧一代（受访者年龄18-35岁）是带动这一趋势的主力军。
d910199c172e74a775ebbeba80c0f3c03a93288a.translatedText: [Reported by Kaisen, compiled by Qiaobao, March 23] A newly released study shows that one in four Americans rarely carry cash with them when going out, and Millennials (respondents aged 18-35) are the main force driving this trend.

5708e04c34ad5916b89e407339f9380cf5d5cb18.sourceText: 据《纽约邮报》报道，第一资本金融公司（Capital One）进行的这一研究对2000名美国成年人的消费习惯进行了调查，发现只有41%的受访者声称他们现在经常带现金出门。
5708e04c34ad5916b89e407339f9380cf5d5cb18.translatedText: According to the New York Post, this study conducted by Capital One surveyed the spending habits of 2,000 American adults and found that only 41% of the respondents claimed that they now often carry cash when going out.

6dd8fc1b2e0dba32303c8096a28e8dc167487341.sourceText: 事实上，人们平均每周使用信用卡消费的钱比使用现金更多，信用卡购买占到总消费量的28%。
6dd8fc1b2e0dba32303c8096a28e8dc167487341.translatedText: In fact, on average, people spend more money using credit cards than cash every week, with credit card purchases accounting for 28% of total consumption.

c72dd58232b6110b772b73894687fbf64eec8125.sourceText: 此外，三分之一的千禧一代声称他们很少或从不带现金出门，这说明千禧一代比其他任何年龄组都更多地在使用信用卡消费。
c72dd58232b6110b772b73894687fbf64eec8125.translatedText: Additionally, one-third of Millennials claim they rarely or never leave the house with cash, indicating that Millennials are using credit cards to spend more than any other age group.

71f3bd88ffe4e52e07dd389d04adacf5599612d8.sourceText: 该研究依据年龄的增长来划分时，发现年轻一代越来越远离现金支出，34%的千禧一代承认他们很少或从不携带现金，而55岁以上的老年人仅有25%持相同立场。
71f3bd88ffe4e52e07dd389d04adacf5599612d8.translatedText: When broken down by age, the study found that younger generations are increasingly moving away from cash spending, with 34% of Millennials admitting they rarely or never carry cash, compared with just 25% of those over 55 years old.

4aeba0cc7045e43bf50531f0d60fc60b0419693a.sourceText: 与其他任何年龄组相比，千禧一代更倾向于认为使用现金”不方便”，也最倾向于认为带现金”没有必要”。同时，千禧一代也更可能是一有现金就花光的群体。
4aeba0cc7045e43bf50531f0d60fc60b0419693a.translatedText: More than any other age group, Millennials are more likely to think using cash is “inconvenient” and most likely to think carrying cash is “unnecessary.” At the same time, Millennials are also more likely to spend their cash as soon as they have it.

d0ecc6ab79faa173c3b7f485d8a8938d33504791.sourceText: 该研究数据显示，2000名受访者中有超过四分之一（29%）很少或从未用过现金。而据受访者自己估计，现金在他们每周购买的总量中占不到四分之一（24%）。
d0ecc6ab79faa173c3b7f485d8a8938d33504791.translatedText: The research data shows that more than a quarter (29%) of the 2,000 respondents rarely or never use cash. Respondents themselves estimate that cash accounts for less than a quarter (24%) of their total weekly purchases.

d8d58f0a373799052ef985ea76af5a2501a895bc.sourceText: 该研究还发现，受访者中六分之一的人表示他们会有一周的时间不用现金购物，只有21%表示现金是他们最常用的支付方式。
d8d58f0a373799052ef985ea76af5a2501a895bc.translatedText: The study also found that one in six respondents said they would go a week without cash, and only 21% said cash was their most common method of payment.

32808ffebda78aa49fec9f99754f4fd73c3ebdd5.sourceText: 这项调查也表明，信用卡消费和其他方式的增长正在影响美国人使用现金的程度。在购买杂货、付汽油费和外出就餐时，刷卡消费已远远超过现金的使用。然而，在支付交通费或服务费时，现金仍占主导地位。对于那些在钱包里携带现金的美国人而言，平均每次携带的数额是25美元。
32808ffebda78aa49fec9f99754f4fd73c3ebdd5.translatedText: The survey also shows that the growth of credit card spending and other methods is affecting the extent to which Americans use cash. When it comes to buying groceries, paying for gas and dining out, credit cards have far surpassed the use of cash. However, cash still dominates when it comes to paying for transportation or services. For those Americans who carry cash in their wallets, the average amount carried per trip is $25.

074cf25112c1f9c175ecc7d45d6f047206a47435.sourceText: 在调查期间，六分之一的受访者身上根本没有现金，而五分之四（39%）的受访者身上的现金不到10美元。调查数据还表明，人们相信信用卡消费实际上能让一个人在财务上保持更良好的水平。44%的受访者认为，如果他们有现金，他们会更喜欢花钱。
074cf25112c1f9c175ecc7d45d6f047206a47435.translatedText: One in six respondents had no cash on them at all at the time of the survey, while four in five (39%) had less than $10 in cash. Survey data also shows that people believe that credit card spending actually leaves a person in a better financial position. 44% of respondents believe they would prefer to spend money if they had cash.

ccca247cbc8455822d14b742e055604e272ec8bc.sourceText: 更多的受访者还认为，与信用卡消费相比，现金是最难追踪的付款方式。对此，第一资本金融公司”US Card”常务副总裁马特恩（Mark Mattern）指出，该研究结果可能表明，爱用信用卡的千禧一代也许更希望监控管理好他们的财务状况。随着信用卡和数字消费的日益突出，61%的美国人认为，现金有一天会完全消失。
ccca247cbc8455822d14b742e055604e272ec8bc.translatedText: More respondents also believe that compared with credit card purchases, cash is the most difficult payment method to track. In this regard, Mark Mattern, executive vice president of Capital One Financial Company's "US Card", pointed out that the research results may indicate that Millennials who like to use credit cards may be more interested in monitoring and managing their financial status. As credit cards and digital spending become more prominent, 61% of Americans believe cash will one day disappear entirely.

d59dea1468bb335e41f925b21204ccf52f87d88b.sourceText: 黑色星期五 成了半夜鸡叫 感恩节来临，对很多人来说，意味着周四晚挚爱亲朋围在一起饱食一顿，装满荷包，准备周五一大早加入抢购行列，为一家大小的圣诞礼物狂拼一番。 然而，今年的疯狂将提早开始。像Target, Kohls和Best Buy等商家已宣布，将于感恩节晚上开店迎客，一些店更早至晚上8点。 这一措施引来员工的反感，认为零售商盗窃了他们的感恩节。已有超过16万人在Change.org网上签署一项名为’Tell Target To Save Thanksgiving’的请愿活动。请愿书以Target为主诉，要求其开放时间退回周五上午5时，而不是午夜。现有人在布告板里提出抗议Kohls和Best Buy。 请愿书说：在感恩节夜晚，和家人分享一个顿美味，一个完整的假期，不仅仅是本民族精英的特权，也是所有美国人该享有的权利。 凤凰城居民蜜雪儿麦克唐纳同意这说法，但她已失业多时，她愿意得到任何工作，即使牺牲于家人共享节日大餐的机会。 Target就请愿发表声明：黑色星期五是年内最繁忙的购物日之一，我们有顾客提出感恩节当晚吃完大餐就购物的要求，我们只是满足客人的需求而已……Target将为感恩节日工作的员工提供假日薪酬。 ”半夜鸡叫”出自高玉宝的同名小说。故事说地主周扒皮为了让长工多干活，半夜起床学鸡叫，催工人起床做工。
d59dea1468bb335e41f925b21204ccf52f87d88b.translatedText: Black Friday has become the rooster crow in the middle of the night. For many people, the arrival of Thanksgiving means that loved ones and friends gather together to have a full meal on Thursday night, fill their wallets, and prepare to join the rush to buy Christmas gifts for the whole family early on Friday morning. This year, however, the madness will start early. Merchants such as Target, Kohls and Best Buy have announced that they will open their stores on Thanksgiving night, with some stores opening as early as 8 p.m. The move sparked resentment from employees who felt the retailer was stealing their Thanksgiving. More than 160,000 people have signed an online petition called 'Tell Target To Save Thanksgiving' on Change.org. The petition calls for Target to move its opening hours back to 5 a.m. on Friday instead of midnight. People are protesting on notice boards at Kohls and Best Buy. The petition states: Sharing a delicious meal and a complete holiday with your family on Thanksgiving night is not only a privilege for the elite of this nation, but also a right for all Americans. Phoenix resident Michelle McDonald agrees, but she's been out of work for a long time and would take any job she can get, even if it sacrifices the chance to share a holiday meal with her family. Target issued a statement on the petition: Black Friday is one of the busiest shopping days of the year. We have customers requesting that they shop after a big meal on Thanksgiving night. We are simply meeting the needs of our customers...Target will provide holiday pay to employees who work on Thanksgiving Day. "The Chicken Crows at Midnight" comes from Gao Yubao's novel of the same name. The story goes that in order to make the long-term workers work more, the landlord Zhou Papi got up in the middle of the night and imitated the crow of chickens to urge the workers to get up and work.

9b40c55bc639f55739a8d949f5a017e219840da8.translatedText: – Remembering the 2015-2016 graduation ceremony of Hope Chinese School in Asia

1bf201292c5ebff9d1987a1173babe05066265f5.sourceText: （ 谭锐撰稿 摄影 艺柳白）五月八号下午，希望中文学校的几百名师生家长在漂亮的Campo Verde High School欢聚一堂，举行了2015-2016学年的毕业典礼。毕业典礼由多才多艺的朱雪薇老师主持，李健董事长和田琳校长致辞，庆祝学生们在中文学习中取得的优异成绩，感谢义工和老师们对学校的奉献，欢送2015-2016 毕业班的同学。
1bf201292c5ebff9d1987a1173babe05066265f5.translatedText: ( Written by Tan Rui and photographed by Yi Liubai) On the afternoon of May 8th, hundreds of teachers, students and parents of Hope Chinese School gathered together at the beautiful Campo Verde High School to hold the graduation ceremony for the 2015-2016 school year. The graduation ceremony was hosted by the versatile teacher Zhu Xuewei. Chairman Li Jian and Principal Tian Lin delivered speeches to celebrate the students' outstanding achievements in Chinese learning, thank the volunteers and teachers for their dedication to the school, and bid farewell to the 2015-2016 graduating class.

03b3e652003e10ed090eb4494e6de26eeac6b346.sourceText: Mesa Community College的校长，潘寿安先生等一行三人，Chandler Gilbert Community College的校长Guerriero博士作为特邀嘉宾出席了毕业典礼。MCC潘寿安校长， MCC community partnerships 的负责人Pat Esparza女生和 Neva Hansen 女士 接受了希望中文学校李健董事长和田琳校长赠送的奖状， 感谢在过去的二十年里MCC对希望中文学校的鼎力支持。潘寿安校长随即发表讲话，大力赞扬希望中文学校为华人社区做出的卓越贡献，并送上美好的祝愿。接着，由李健先生介绍希望中文学校新的合作伙伴Chandler Gilbert Community College。CGCC的校长Guerriero先生首先表达了对中文学校师生和家人的亲切致意，强调了中文学校加盟社区学院的重要意义，祝愿希望中文学校与CGCC新的合作硕果累累。在这具有历史意义的时刻， 希望中文学校全体校董成员登台与CGCC和MCC的校长们共同合影留念.2016秋季希望中文学校将迁入位于Chandler Gilbert Community College，在新的校址希望中文学校将会一如既往的为社区服务，认真办学。
03b3e652003e10ed090eb4494e6de26eeac6b346.translatedText: The principal of Mesa Community College, Mr. Pan Shou'an and three other people, and the principal of Chandler Gilbert Community College, Dr. Guerriero, attended the graduation ceremony as special guests. MCC Principal Pan Shou'an, head of MCC community partnerships Pat Esparza and Ms. Neva Hansen accepted the certificates presented by Hope Chinese School Chairman Li Jian and Principal Tian Lin, thanking MCC for its strong support to Hope Chinese School in the past twenty years. Principal Pan Shou'an immediately delivered a speech, praising Hope Chinese School for its outstanding contributions to the Chinese community and sending his best wishes. Then, Mr. Li Jian introduced Chandler Gilbert Community College, the new partner of Hope Chinese School. Mr. Guerriero, the principal of CGCC, first expressed his cordial greetings to the teachers, students and families of the Chinese school, emphasized the importance of the Chinese school joining the community college, and wished that the new cooperation between the Chinese school and CGCC would be fruitful. At this historic moment, all members of the board of directors of Hope Chinese School took the stage to take a group photo with the principals of CGCC and MCC. In the fall of 2016, Hope Chinese School will move to Chandler Gilbert Community College. At the new site, Hope Chinese School will continue to serve the community and run the school seriously.

67f8c236bd8df5587d8fada8e90f79b4a5b90073.sourceText: 在过去的学年里，我校成功的举办了多项活动。其中之一是三月份举行的一年一度的低年级识字比赛高年级的作文比赛。在毕业典礼上老师们为获奖学生颁发了奖杯。当荣获一等奖，二等奖和三等奖的同学们手捧刻有他们名字的闪光的奖杯，站在毕业典礼台上的时候，孩子们看着父母长辈们，脸上露出灿烂的笑容， 家长们情不自禁的举起相机，手机，为孩子们照相，录影。
67f8c236bd8df5587d8fada8e90f79b4a5b90073.translatedText: In the past school year, our school successfully held a number of activities. One of these is the annual Lower School Literacy Contest and the Upper School Essay Contest held in March. At the graduation ceremony, teachers presented trophies to the winning students. When the students who won the first, second and third prizes stood on the graduation ceremony stage holding glittering trophies with their names on them, the children looked at their parents and elders with bright smiles on their faces. The parents couldn't help but raise their cameras and mobile phones to take photos and videos of their children.

1dcbe4fb4ee855d3832a2471e277c1c80e46ac45.sourceText: 作为北美规模不菲的一所中文学校，我校同学们还积极参加了校外，包括国际范围的作文比赛。在２０１５年鲁迅青少年文学奖海外华裔青少年作文比赛中，北美地区八位获奖学生中，我校何安琪与杨美文两位同学双双获奖。何安琪同学更是脱颖而出，她的作文被评为北美地区500多所中文学校里唯一的一等奖。当全美中文学校协会名誉会长帅致若向何安琪同学（指导老师李素惠）和获得二等奖的杨美文同学（指导老师沈灏瑾）颁发奖杯时，全场掌声不断。 坚持学习中文六年对孩子们是很不容易的，今年的毕业典礼为六年级同学颁发了小学六年级毕业证书。鼓励孩子们的坚持。暨南班和马立平班的六年级同学获得了证书。喜出望外的同学们双手举起这不一般的证书尽情的向他们的爸爸妈妈展示。
1dcbe4fb4ee855d3832a2471e277c1c80e46ac45.translatedText: As a large-scale Chinese school in North America, our students have also actively participated in essay competitions outside the school, including international ones. In the 2015 Lu Xun Youth Literature Award Overseas Chinese Youth Composition Competition, among the eight award-winning students in North America, two students from our school, He Anqi and Yang Meiwen, both won the award. He Anqi stood out even more. Her essay was awarded the only first prize among more than 500 Chinese schools in North America. When Shuai Zhiruo, honorary president of the National Association of Chinese Schools, presented the trophies to He Anqi (instructor Li Suhui) and Yang Meiwen (instructor Shen Haojin) who won the second prize, the audience continued to applaud. It is not easy for children to study Chinese for six years. This year’s graduation ceremony awarded sixth grade students with sixth grade graduation certificates. Encourage children to persevere. Sixth grade students from Jinan class and Ma Liping class received certificates. The overjoyed students raised the unusual certificates with both hands and showed them to their parents.

f3b366328f768cd905775647de0dc587fdd35347.sourceText: 如果说学习中文六年已经很不容易了，那么坚持学习中文十二年就可成为一个里程碑了，希望中文学校十二年级毕业班的于筱淳，高如碧，张爱琳，卢露茜，陈美玲，邹凯文同学终于登上了今年毕业典礼的舞台，从李素惠老师手中接过了得来不易的毕业证书。为表彰十二年级毕业生学习中文的执着精神和优异成绩，李健董事长和田琳校长向他们颁发了希望中文学校奖学金。此时此刻，激动的六名毕业生向学弟学妹们倾诉了学习中文收获无价的肺腑之言，他们流利的中文，动情的表达将毕业典礼又一次推向高潮。
f3b366328f768cd905775647de0dc587fdd35347.translatedText: If learning Chinese for six years is not easy, then persisting in learning Chinese for 12 years can become a milestone. Yu Xiaochun, Gao Rubi, Zhang Ailin, Lu Luxi, Chen Meiling, and Zou Kaiwen of the twelfth grade graduating class of Hope Chinese School finally stepped onto the stage of this year's graduation ceremony and received the hard-won diploma from teacher Li Suhui. In recognition of the twelfth grade graduates’ perseverance and outstanding achievements in learning Chinese, Chairman Li Jian and Principal Tian Lin awarded them the Hope Chinese School Scholarship. At this moment, the six excited graduates expressed their heartfelt words to their junior students about the priceless gains they had gained from learning Chinese. Their fluent Chinese and emotional expressions pushed the graduation ceremony to another climax.

dde039e5c6a8d4867e4844d4319c40b8e6140ede.sourceText: 希望中午学校几十位热爱教学的老师们， 活跃在讲台上，书桌旁，操场上，舞蹈房，为我校的26个中文班， 10个数学班，23个文体美术兴趣班洒下了辛勤汗水， 今天的典礼上，来自不同年级的学生们向老师们送上鲜花，这些美丽的花朵亦是给学生们给老师们的衷心祝愿和感谢。 毕业典礼的演出在四位毕业班同学情意深长的道白中拉开了帷幕。他们即将离校， 却主动请缨，”毕业只是旅途中的一个站点， 但不是学习中文的终点，希望我们的学校更完美。”就这样他们站在了麦克风前。成为了当日文艺演出的主持， 他们是整台演出最受关注的明星们，也为我们的典礼活动增添了一道靓丽的风景。五月八号的毕业典礼恰逢母亲节，孩子们的心声是，”今天不但是我们的毕业典礼也是伟大的母亲节！在此我们祝福所有在座的母亲们！”令人感动的是，到场的每位同学都走上了典礼的舞台，不仅要参与，还要抒自豪。唱，表达心声，舞，展现精彩，台下的爸爸妈妈们实实在在地感受到了孩子们回馈的爱。近几年希望中文学校在举办各种活动的时候都是把学生们推到前面， 尽可能的给学生们提供展示他们才华的机会。 今年的毕业班的同学们在主持整场演出的时候语言通常连贯，妙趣横生，真情流露， 他们的出色表现给大家留下了深刻的印象也给学弟学妹们做了一个好榜样。 由毕业班同学表演器乐奏唱《旗开得胜》拉开了毕业演出的序幕，六个毕业生生机勃勃，充满活力，他们以出色的才艺表演为母亲节献上了一份厚礼，也为他们热爱的中文学校留下了浓浓的一笔。
dde039e5c6a8d4867e4844d4319c40b8e6140ede.translatedText: I hope that dozens of teachers who love teaching at noon school will be active on the podium, at desks, on the playground, and in the dance room, and have worked hard for our school's 26 Chinese classes, 10 math classes, and 23 cultural, sports and art interest classes. At today's ceremony, students from different grades sent flowers to the teachers. These beautiful flowers are also the students' sincere wishes and thanks to the teachers. The graduation ceremony performance kicked off with the affectionate speeches of four graduating students. They were about to leave school, but they took the initiative to say, "Graduation is just a stop on the journey, but it is not the end of learning Chinese. I hope our school will be more perfect." Just like that, they stood in front of the microphone. They became the hosts of the cultural performance that day. They were the most watched stars in the entire performance, and they also added a beautiful scenery to our ceremony. The graduation ceremony on May 8th coincided with Mother's Day, and the children's thoughts were, "Today is not only our graduation ceremony, but also a great Mother's Day! Here we wish all the mothers here!" What is touching is that every student present stepped onto the stage of the ceremony, not only to participate, but also to express their pride. Singing, expressing their feelings, dancing, and showing wonderful performances, the parents in the audience truly felt the love returned by their children. In recent years, I hope that Chinese schools will push students to the front when organizing various activities and provide students with opportunities to showcase their talents as much as possible. When this year's graduating class hosted the entire performance, their language was usually coherent, witty, and true to their feelings. Their outstanding performance left a deep impression on everyone and set a good example for the younger students. The graduating class kicked off the graduation performance by performing instrumental music and singing "Victory". The six graduates were full of vitality and vitality. They presented a great gift to Mother's Day with their outstanding talent performances and left a mark for the Chinese school they love.

42091c1a80447689f80b5876e9d9a5e11f11c8a8.sourceText: 低年级组可爱的娃娃们稚嫩的朗诵并着表演”妈妈是棵大树，我是树上的小鸟，每天在妈妈身边，快活的又蹦又跳”，感动得台下的父母放不下手中的相机，手机，不停地拍照。在蔡善皋老师指挥， 戴玉华老师，何浩老师伴奏，邹笑甜老师领唱下，中年级组的同学们以清纯的童声大合唱《送别》，齐诵《游子吟》，引出了父母心曲的共鸣。高年级同学们别开生面，不仅配以古曲，咏诵唐诗名辞，更以大屏幕上呈现的诗画创作展现了他们对古诗词的诠释。邹笑恬老师的独唱”心动”震惊全场，她充满感情的演唱瞬间感动全场。偌大的剧场里安静的只有邹老师的歌声， 连低年级的小朋友们都在全神贯注的倾听。 我们的小邹老师不光是课教的好歌声更是一流。 希望学校老义工的集体合唱更是为我们的毕业典礼助兴添彩，再一次彰显着希望团结合作的精神。像往年的毕业典礼一样，舞蹈班和武术班的同学们，成人舞蹈班的妈妈们，从来都是给我们带来精彩节目的表演者。今年在蒋琳老师，汤可老师，闻玲琳老师和Grace李老师的指导下又为我们的毕业典礼舞台带来了多个耳目一新的节目，观众席上掌声不断，高潮迭起。人们无不感慨:这满满的都是爱。
42091c1a80447689f80b5876e9d9a5e11f11c8a8.translatedText: The cute dolls in the lower grade group recited and performed "Mom is a big tree, and I am a little bird on the tree. I am by my mother's side every day, jumping happily." The parents in the audience were so moved that they couldn't put down their cameras and mobile phones and kept taking pictures. Under the conductor of Teacher Cai Shangao, the accompaniment of Teachers Dai Yuhua and Teacher He Hao, and the lead singer of Teacher Zou Xiaotian, the students of the middle grade group sang "Farewell" in pure children's voices and recited "Wandering Son's Song" in unison, which resonated with the hearts of their parents. The senior students performed in a unique way. They not only performed ancient songs and recited famous poems from Tang Dynasty, but also demonstrated their interpretation of ancient poems through poetry and painting creations presented on the big screen. Teacher Zou Xiaotian’s solo “Heartbeat” shocked the audience, and her emotional singing instantly moved the audience. The only thing quiet in the huge theater was Teacher Zou's singing. Even the children in the lower grades were listening attentively. Our teacher Xiao Zou not only has a good singing voice but is also top-notch. The collective chorus of the old volunteers of Hope School added to the excitement and splendor of our graduation ceremony, once again demonstrating the spirit of unity and cooperation of Hope School. Just like the graduation ceremonies in previous years, the students in the dance class and martial arts class, and the mothers in the adult dance class, have always been the performers who brought us wonderful performances. This year, under the guidance of Teachers Jiang Lin, Teacher Tang Ke, Teacher Wen Linglin and Teacher Grace Li, they brought many refreshing programs to our graduation ceremony stage. The audience applauded continuously and climaxed one after another. People all sighed: This is full of love.

1aa09d18e3401d80f6afb699031db190c329f3c8.sourceText: 历史舞剧《易水。别兮》取材于以荆轲悲壮赴命的历史故事，沈灏瑾老师和杨汉文同学母子二人出色的表演令台下不少母亲热泪盈眶。少儿舞蹈班表演的舞蹈《为爱点赞》，以舞叙事，在孩子们学习表演舞蹈的同时，了解人间爱的真谛。幼儿舞蹈《吉祥一家>，美丽的旗袍妈妈们表演的《醉美旗袍》和优美的民族舞《美，佳人》像一组舞蹈史诗，寓意了”家最（醉）美”的和谐主题。英姿飒爽的妈妈们表演了活力四射的YMCA集体舞， 音乐动作，帅气煽人，台下的孩子们不禁跟着唱起来， 动起来，气氛十分热烈。儿武术班同学表演的招招式式，透着虎虎生气?- 我们的孩子们追着武术。凤舞丹青班的妈妈们表演的柔美芭蕾形体舞《隐形翅膀》—- 忙碌操持的妈妈们圆的是青春梦。
1aa09d18e3401d80f6afb699031db190c329f3c8.translatedText: Historical dance drama "Yi Shui". "Farewell" is based on the historical story of Jing Ke's tragic death. The outstanding performances of teacher Shen Haojin and classmate Yang Hanwen, mother and son, brought tears to the eyes of many mothers in the audience. The dance "Like for Love" performed by the children's dance class uses dance as a narrative. While the children learn to perform dance, they can understand the true meaning of love in the world. The children's dance "Auspicious Family", the beautiful cheongsam mothers performed "Drunk Beauty Cheongsam" and the beautiful folk dance "Beauty, Beauty" are like a set of dance epics, implying the harmonious theme of "home is the most (drunk) beauty". The heroic mothers performed a energetic YMCA group dance with music and moves that were so handsome and exciting that the children in the audience couldn't help but sing along and move. The atmosphere was very lively. The moves performed by the students in the children's martial arts class are full of vitality? - Our children chase the martial arts. The mothers of the Phoenix Dance Painting Class performed the soft ballet body dance "Invisible Wings" - the busy mothers are fulfilling their dreams of youth.

88cdb42ffacaf71ccb5f966a38970bbd271fb6e3.sourceText: 毕业典礼结束了，但是希望中文学校是留在我们心里的一首歌，她让我们和孩子们一起快乐，她让我们和孩子们一起成长。在离别的时刻，千言万语道不完一声珍重。演出的最后主持人朱雪薇老师再次把每一位毕业生邀请上台。毕业典礼是希望中文学校送给学生们最后的礼物，但来自老师、同学最真挚的祝福与曾经的帮助，才是大家心中最最宝贵、值得永久珍藏的回忆。祝愿六位毕业生能始终坚持梦想，勇敢拼搏，收获更加辉煌的明天！
88cdb42ffacaf71ccb5f966a38970bbd271fb6e3.translatedText: The graduation ceremony is over, but Hope Chinese School is a song that remains in our hearts. It makes us happy with our children, and it makes us grow up with our children. At the moment of farewell, there are too many words to say how much I cherish you. At the end of the performance, the host teacher Zhu Xuewei once again invited every graduate to the stage. The graduation ceremony is the last gift that Hope Chinese School gives to the students, but the most sincere blessings and past help from teachers and classmates are the most precious memories in everyone’s hearts that are worth cherishing forever. I wish the six graduates can always stick to their dreams, work bravely, and gain a more brilliant tomorrow!

55c3fa79d05a1da1b26e5106d8df61821267b520.translatedText: Asia Pacific Community Initiatives, in collaboration with the Maricopa County Department of Public Health Asia Pacific Community Initiatives, in partnership with the Maricopa County Department of Public Health, will be conducting an emergency preparedness drill on April 14th...

780a59fe7d3713fcef5536aec6986d92f340ae85.sourceText: 亚太社区促进会与马瑞柯帕郡公共卫生部共同合作，将于四月十四日星期六上午八时至下午二时 进行一项紧急事件预备演习， 我们正在寻找双语驾驶人士华语/英语﹞参与此项演习. 演习的目的是在遭受模拟生物恐怖 攻击时药物的发放，地点在凤凰城的North Canyon High School ，并备有午餐与二十美元礼物卡. 更多讯息请电洽602-456-1597 或是浏览我们的网站http://apcaaz.org/emergency.htm. 感谢您的参与!
780a59fe7d3713fcef5536aec6986d92f340ae85.translatedText: Asia Pacific Community Initiatives, in partnership with the Maricopa County Department of Public Health, will conduct an emergency preparedness drill on Saturday, April 14th from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m. We are looking for bilingual drivers (Chinese/English) to participate in this exercise. The purpose of the exercise is to distribute medications in the event of a simulated bioterrorism attack. It will be held at North Canyon High School in Phoenix and will include lunch and a $20 gift card. For more information, please call 602-456-1597 or visit our website at http://apcaaz.org/emergency.htm. Thank you for participating!

State Department of Transportation officials said that during the holidays, motorists can safely drive on the state's highways without worrying about being detoured due to road construction...

33a7e02ead448c1984ae01c80aab1918ff143959.sourceText: 亚利桑那州公路重点工程假日停工 州运输部官员说，节日期间，驾车人可以放心在本州高速公路行驶而不用担心因修路而绕道。 但他们说，卡莎格兰德，凤凰城，莫哈维郡的韦基阿，吉拉弯和图森附近有些路段需降速，保持单线行驶。 恶劣的天气也可能使一些路段封闭。 州交通部提醒驾车人在圣诞节和新年周末谨慎驾驶。官员说，去年假日期间，有15人在公路和当地街道的车祸中死亡。 交通部说，赌车可能出现在周末和假期结束前后。驾车人长途驾车前应充分休息和清醒，出行前检查您的爱车。
33a7e02ead448c1984ae01c80aab1918ff143959.translatedText: > Arizona's key highway projects are closed for the holidays. State Department of Transportation officials said that during the holidays, motorists can safely drive on the state's highways without worrying about being detoured due to road construction...<<<CA_ZH_SPLIT>> But they said there are some stretches of road near Casa Grande, Phoenix, Waikia in Mohave County, Gila Bend and Tucson that require reduced speeds and single lanes. Bad weather may also cause some road closures. The state Department of Transportation is reminding motorists to drive with caution over the Christmas and New Year's weekends. Officials said 15 people died in crashes on highways and local streets during last year's holiday season. The transportation department said gambling cars may appear on weekends and around the end of holidays. Drivers should get enough rest and sobriety before driving long distances, and check your car before traveling.

43407e58a607ecfe401fb8c33f7df1a612e31b19.translatedText: New regulations will be issued to strengthen control over opium analgesics

422fabbb8a1ccf532b9757c3413a92d3a4a0376c.sourceText: 鸦片止痛药 颁新规加强管制 联邦食品暨药物管理局(FDA)9日公布了对强力止痛药的安全新规定，要求生产30…
422fabbb8a1ccf532b9757c3413a92d3a4a0376c.translatedText: New regulations will be issued to strengthen control over opium analgesics The Federal Food and Drug Administration (FDA) announced new safety regulations for powerful analgesics on the 9th, requiring the production of 30...

4719ad36bd503321785beeb5d89142f302210d30.sourceText: 联邦食品暨药物管理局(FDA)9日公布了对强力止痛药的安全新规定，要求生产30种长效性鸦片类止痛药的药厂，必须训练医生和其他医疗人员对这类药物安全地开处方，以及对病人解释这类药物的危险性，以减少药物被误用和滥用，避免每年数以万计的人因而死亡。
4719ad36bd503321785beeb5d89142f302210d30.translatedText: The Federal Food and Drug Administration (FDA) announced new safety regulations for powerful analgesics on the 9th. , requiring pharmaceutical companies that produce 30 types of long-acting opioid analgesics to train doctors and other medical personnel to safely prescribe these drugs and explain the dangers of these drugs to patients, so as to reduce the misuse and abuse of drugs and avoid the deaths of tens of thousands of people every year.

260dfe0e3dac032ba575c089fc2dd1f3461a4e51.sourceText: 这类药物包含了各种形式的吗啡、美沙酮(methadone)和羟考酮(oxycodone)，如普度(Purdue)药厂的OxyContin、娇生公司(J&J)的Druages​​ic贴布、辉瑞(Pfizer)药厂的Embeda等。 FDA近年来公布了许多对止痛药的处方警告，但效果不彰，不当使用这类药物在2009年造成42万5000次急诊治疗，和1万5600人死亡。 FDA的新规定要求药厂必须对开处方者提供二至三小时的训练，训练计画由对医疗专业人员持续提供教育的公司主办，不得由药厂主办。这些训练计画须在2013年3月以前提供，将由FDA管制人员加以检查。该局希望在三年内，美国32万个开处方者中，至少60%接受过训练。
260dfe0e3dac032ba575c089fc2dd1f3461a4e51.translatedText: This type of drugs includes various forms of morphine, methadone and oxycodone, such as OxyContin from Purdue Pharmaceuticals, Druagesic patches from J&J, Embeda from Pfizer, etc. The FDA has issued many prescribing warnings on painkillers in recent years, but they have been ineffective. Improper use of these drugs resulted in 425,000 emergency room visits and 15,600 deaths in 2009. The FDA's new rule requires drug companies to provide two to three hours of training to prescribers. The training program must be sponsored by a company that provides ongoing education to medical professionals, and must not be sponsored by the drug company. These training programs must be provided by March 2013 and will be inspected by FDA regulators. The agency hopes that within three years, at least 60% of the nation's 320,000 prescribers will be trained.

afa21527d4826f0defa07ce88e6caead5875f835.sourceText: FDA也规定，药厂必须对病人提供安全小册子，解释这类药物的危险性，和在服药过量后如何寻求急诊治疗。 FDA已用了三年多的时间，配合业界和健康照顾专业人员，共同研发对这类药物的风险管理计画。鸦片类止痛药有天然麻醉剂的效果，通常是开给已经服用止痛药的人，包括癌症病人，以治疗严重的疼痛。 FDA针对的是长时间释放药剂，以达到长期止痛效果的药物，但在医生处方不当，和病人把它当做兴奋剂滥用时，这种强力药效有严重的危险性。 FDA报告说，许多医生对偏头痛者也开这类止痛药，而FDA并未批准此药用于治疗偏头痛，此外，病人有时咀嚼这类应该吞服的药物，以致服药过量。
afa21527d4826f0defa07ce88e6caead5875f835.translatedText: The FDA also stipulates that drug manufacturers must provide patients with safety pamphlets explaining the dangers of such drugs and how to seek emergency treatment after overdose. The FDA has spent more than three years working with industry and health care professionals to develop a risk management plan for this class of drugs. Opioid painkillers have natural narcotic effects and are often prescribed to people already taking painkillers, including cancer patients, to treat severe pain. The FDA is targeting drugs that release drugs over a long period of time to achieve long-term pain relief, but when doctors prescribe them improperly and patients abuse them as stimulants, these powerful drugs can pose serious risks. The FDA reports that many doctors also prescribe this type of painkiller to migraine sufferers, although the drug is not approved by the FDA for the treatment of migraines. In addition, patients sometimes chew the medicine, which is meant to be swallowed, and overdose.

8146b984890145e1196bfaac67086f69dc60ca70.translatedText: Alberta's first Chinese-American female senator, Yu Yanfen, was sworn in (Alberta Times Qingbao) At 12 noon on January 14, Arizona's 20th Legislative District State Senator...

839877c1420caa7ed5fb1384535cfed0d673e5ff.sourceText: （亚省时报 清宝）1月14日中午12时，亚利桑那州第20立法区州参议员余艳芬在州议会宣誓就职。她成为亚利桑那百年历史上首位华裔女参议员。 在最高法院法官丽贝卡的主持下，余艳芬宣誓就职，参与这个仪式的还有余艳芬的先生和家人。在宣誓台上，余艳芬说：”我真的非常荣幸能够成为参议院的一员。”
839877c1420caa7ed5fb1384535cfed0d673e5ff.translatedText: (Alberta Times Qingbao) At 12:00 on January 14, Arizona's 20th Legislative District state senator Yu Yanfen was sworn in at the state House of Assembly. She became the first Chinese-American female senator in Arizona's century-old history. Yu Yanfen was sworn in under the auspices of Supreme Court Justice Rebecca. Yu Yanfen's husband and family members also participated in the ceremony. On the oath stand, Yu Yanfen said: "I am really honored to be a member of the Senate."

c06fad0e62b74a3916fcd30b85f682c632485038.sourceText: 费健当选为新一届华联主席 九位董事会成员共为亚省华人服务（图） 2011年5月22日（星期天）下午2时，亚省华人华侨联合总会（华联）在钱德勒市图书馆库珀房间举行华联会员年度大会。费健当选为新一任华联主席，9位成员当选为董事会成员。 目前，华联共有58位会员，当天下午23位会员，9位非会员到现场参加选举活动。现场提名了13位成员为董事会成员，其中 9位被提名者当选为董事，杨文田，Cindy Lin，吴宁，Leung eng要求退出董事选举。 原董事会成员费健19票，屈宁19票，陶世诚19票，董斌17票高票连任，新的董事会成员李健19票，王惟咨18票，徐强17票，余文焯16票，周丕宣15票全新加入 。新董事会成员在短暂的交流后，选出了本届华联主席费健。华联新的领导班子将在未来两年内为亚利桑那华人服务。整个选举活动在三位监督员的监督下，按章程顺利完成，华联将会向媒体发出正式的公告。 前董事会秘书汪洋主持了本次大会，他首先介绍本次会议的议程：第一部分是前华联主席的工作汇报，第二部分是财务汇报，第三部分是华联章程的修改，第四部分是本次的选举。前华联主席陶世诚做了华联工作的年度报告。陶世诚在发言中重点介绍了在过去一年中华联主办的活动，例如中美文化论坛，国庆招待会，凤凰之夜中秋国庆舞会 ，青少年作文有奖比赛，蔡嘎亮的Talk show。陶世诚非常感谢在这些活动中付出了很多努力的志愿者们，特别提到在凤凰之夜中秋国庆舞会中，因为音响故障，出来救场的李国华，他不仅给现场观众带来了精彩的表演，还为现场抢修赢得了宝贵的时间，而且在华联举办的各种活动中，这样的李国华很多，他就没有一一列举了。正是在众多华人朋友的大力支持下，华联走到了今天，他也真心希望亚利桑那的华人朋友一如既往地支持华联，加入华联。 前华联财务负责人吴宁向会员们做了财务汇报。吴宁表示在过去了四年中华联的主要收入是华人捐款赞助和活动门票收入。他特别感谢杨文田为华联捐款高达2500美元，以及其他为华联捐资的朋友。 华联的章程总是与时俱进，根据华联的发展状况，华联对部分章程提出了修改议案，当天也在年会上与会员们商议。前华联副主席廖峰，对章程修改议案与大家进行了交流，其中部分内容引起了热议，在4.4有关董事会成员的任期，连任的时间和要求上，有成员提出异议，新条款规定：董事会成员任期两年，新选的董事会必须保留几名上届的董事会成员。会员质疑：1”几名 a few”的定义不清，到底是几名，一名两名还是三名。2”a few”数学上不成立， 将来选举时会引起混乱 3现任董事会成员任期已超过两年，怎么算。最后异议由现场投票裁决，该项修改意见以14票赞成5票反对顺利通过。大部分会员认为投票是选举的决定因素，条文上名额的限制应该更宽泛一些，依然保持模糊的数字概念。 在华联年会中，看到大部分代表表达自己的意见和建议，当然也听到了少部分不同的声音，民主总是在具体事件的实践过程中逐渐实现的，华联的大选仍然让大家看到，无论是什么样的声音都是希望华联能团结起来，为更广大的华人服务。 本届新会长费健表示会执行更加透明的民主政策 费健简介： 北京人, 1977年考入原北京钢铁学院(现北京科技大学)自动化系. 毕业后留校任教. 1985年来美读研究生. 1991年获Syracuse大学电机工程博士学位. 曾在肯塔基大学(University of Kentucky)做研究工作三年。从1994年起在凤凰城地区多家公司任职, 包括Motorola Life Sciences(contractor), GE Healthcare, 独立软件承包商. 现为Medtronic自动化工程师. 2000-2001任现代中文学校董事长, 2001-2002任现代中文学校校长. 从2008年5月至今任华联董事。 部分华联会员合影
c06fad0e62b74a3916fcd30b85f682c632485038.translatedText: Fei Jian was elected as the new chairman of the Hualien. The nine board members serve the Chinese in Alberta (picture). At 2:00 pm on May 22, 2011 (Sunday), the Chinese Federation of Alberta (Hualian) held the annual general meeting of Hualian members in the Cooper Room of the Chandler City Library. Fei Jian was elected as the new chairman of Hualian, and 9 members were elected as board members. Currently, Hualian has a total of 58 members. That afternoon, 23 members and 9 non-members came to participate in the election event. Thirteen members were nominated as board members on the spot, and 9 of the nominees were elected as directors. Yang Wentian, Cindy Lin, Wu Ning, and Leung Eng requested to withdraw from the director election. Original board members Fei Jian had 19 votes, Qu Ning had 19 votes, Tao Shicheng had 19 votes, and Dong Bin had 17 votes for re-election. New board members Li Jian had 19 votes, Wang Weizi had 18 votes, Xu Qiang had 17 votes, Yu Wenzhuo had 16 votes, and Zhou Pixuan had newly joined with 15 votes. After a brief exchange, the new board members elected Fei Jian, the current chairman of Hualian. Hualian’s new leadership team will serve the Chinese community in Arizona over the next two years. The entire election activity was successfully completed in accordance with the charter under the supervision of three supervisors, and Hualian will issue a formal announcement to the media. Former Board Secretary Wang Yang presided over this meeting. He first introduced the agenda of this meeting: the first part is the work report of the former Hualian Chairman, the second part is the financial report, the third part is the modification of the Hualian Articles of Association, and the fourth part is this election. Former Hualian Chairman Tao Shicheng gave an annual report on the work of Hualian. In his speech, Tao Shicheng focused on the activities hosted by the Chinese Federation in the past year, such as the Sino-US Cultural Forum, National Day Reception, Phoenix Night Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day Dance, Youth Essay Prize-winning Competition, and Cai Galliang’s Talk Show. Tao Shicheng was very grateful to the volunteers who put in a lot of effort in these activities. He especially mentioned Li Guohua, who came to the rescue due to a sound failure at the Phoenix Night Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day Dance. He not only gave the audience a wonderful performance, but also bought valuable time for on-site emergency repairs. There were many such Li Guohua in various activities held by Hualian, and he did not list them all. It is with the strong support of many Chinese friends that Hualian has reached what it is today. He also sincerely hopes that Chinese friends in Arizona will continue to support Hualian and join Hualian. Wu Ning, the former financial director of Hualian, made a financial report to the members. Wu Ning said that in the past four years, the main income of the Chinese Federation has been Chinese donation sponsorship and event ticket income. He especially thanked Yang Wentian for donating up to US$2,500 to Hualian, as well as other friends who donated money to Hualian. The articles of association of Hualian always keep pace with the times. According to the development of Hualian, Hualian proposed amendments to some of the articles of association and discussed them with members at the annual meeting that day. Liao Feng, former vice chairman of Hualian, communicated with everyone about the charter amendment proposal. Some of the contents aroused heated discussion. In 4.4, some members raised objections regarding the term, time and requirements for re-election of board members. The new clause stipulated that the term of board members is two years, and the newly elected board of directors must retain several members of the previous board of directors. Members questioned: 1. The definition of "a few" is unclear. Is it a few, one, two, or three. 2 "a few" is not mathematically valid and will cause confusion in future elections. 3 The current board members have been in office for more than two years, how to calculate it. The final objection was decided by on-site voting, and the amendment was successfully passed with 14 votes in favor and 5 votes against. Most members believe that voting is the decisive factor in the election, and the quota limit in the article should be wider, while the vague concept of numbers should still be maintained. At the Hualian Annual Meeting, we saw most of the representatives expressing their opinions and suggestions. Of course, we also heard a small number of different voices. Democracy is always gradually realized in the practice of specific events. The general election of Hualian still allows everyone to see that no matter what kind of voice they are, they hope that Hualian can unite and serve the greater number of Chinese people. Fei Jian, the new president of this term, said that he would implement a more transparent democratic policy. Fei Jian's profile: A native of Beijing, he was admitted to the Automation Department of the former Beijing Iron and Steel Institute (now the University of Science and Technology Beijing) in 1977. After graduation, he stayed at the school to teach. In 1985, he came to the United States to study for graduate school. In 1991, he received a doctorate in electrical engineering from Syracuse University. He worked as a researcher at the University of Kentucky for three years. Since 1994, he has worked for many companies in the Phoenix area, including Motorola Life Sciences (contractor), GE Healthcare, and independent software contractors. He is currently an automation engineer at Medtronic. He served as the chairman of Modern Chinese School from 2000 to 2001 and the principal of Modern Chinese School from 2001 to 2002. From May 2008 to the present, he has served as a director of Hualian. Group photo of some Hualian members

442e04bc298dff4cac437e0e6a63efefc4ba5e5c.sourceText: 苹果总部 Cupertino 日前向公众公布了有关苹果新总部详细规划图，早在今年6月，尚在人世的乔布斯便向库珀蒂诺市议会宣讲了苹果新总部的计划。这一总部因为外形酷似宇宙飞船，而被外界戏称为”飞船总部”。苹果的”飞船总部”设计理念中最为关键的就是安全，包括员工和产品技术等在内的各类安全，其次新总部将采用全植被覆盖的超高绿化模式来为员工创造一个完美温馨的办公环境。
442e04bc298dff4cac437e0e6a63efefc4ba5e5c.translatedText: Apple Headquarters Cupertino recently announced to the public a detailed plan for Apple's new headquarters. As early as June this year, Steve Jobs, who was still alive, announced Apple's new headquarters plan to the Cupertino City Council. This headquarters is nicknamed "Spaceship Headquarters" by the outside world because it looks like a spaceship. The most critical aspect of Apple's "spaceship headquarters" design concept is safety, including the safety of employees and product technology. Secondly, the new headquarters will adopt an ultra-high greening model covered by vegetation to create a perfect and warm office environment for employees.

d87fe347f27eac4cacd77f33d69d70ffb6415903.sourceText: 最佳退休城市多在西南部 图森上榜 福布斯7日公布该杂志评选的2012年美国25个最佳退休城市榜，这些城市大多位于西部和南部，因为那里气候宜人、税赋低、生活方式健康。 这些城市包括北卡罗来纳州艾许维尔、佛罗里达州珊瑚角、德州奥斯汀、新墨西哥州阿布奎基，和本州的图森。 福布斯执行主编珍妮特．诺瓦克说：「这些地点存在气候温暖的因素。仅管如此，我们也评选出一些气候较冷的城市，因为当地经济良好或犯罪率低。我们还考虑了医疗服务因素。」 该杂志考虑的因素包括生活成本、犯罪率、赋税、社交活跃和做义工的机会、医疗服务、房价等。今年选出的城市分布于18个州。 图森上榜的理由是：自2006年房地产泡沫破灭后，住宅平均价下跌50%。图森的住宅平均价为12.6万，州税4.54%，人口520,100。 早在二月，Top Retirements网站评选的全美十大退休城市就将图森列在第四位，本州另一城市普雷思格(Prescott)列为第十位。
d87fe347f27eac4cacd77f33d69d70ffb6415903.translatedText: Most of the best retirement cities are in the Southwest. Tucson is on the list. Forbes announced on the 7th the magazine's list of the 25 best retirement cities in the United States in 2012. Most of these cities are located in the west and south because of their pleasant climate, low taxes and healthy lifestyles. These cities include Ashville, North Carolina, Cape Coral, Florida, Austin, Texas, Albuquerque, New Mexico, and Tucson in this state. Forbes executive editor Janet. "There's an element of warm weather in these locations," Novak said. "That said, we also selected some cities with cooler climates because they have a good economy or low crime rates. We also looked at health services." The magazine considered factors such as cost of living, crime rates, taxes, opportunities to be active and volunteer, health services, housing prices, and more. The cities selected this year are located in 18 states. The reason Tucson is on the list: Since the housing bubble burst in 2006, the average home price has dropped by 50%. The average home price in Tucson is $126,000, the state tax is 4.54%, and the population is 520,100. As early as February, the Top Retirements website ranked Tucson fourth in the nation's top ten retirement cities, and Prescott, another city in the state, ranked tenth.

3455f11fab15c3bfac0cacf44fb7f143bac96434.sourceText: 血本无归 餐馆转让纠纷多 洛杉矶报导 南加中餐馆常有转让消息，孳生纠纷也不少。 有些以双方退一步大和解收场，有些却闹到法院，没完没了。 在河滨县西裔社区经营中式快餐馆的方先生说，一年多前看到当地一个宣称「收入稳、业主因回国无意经营、低价廉让中餐馆」广告，后以10万元买 下设备及经营权，并承接租约。 「当时业主拿出餐馆进出帐目跟我说，每个月营业额2万元左右，扣掉成本等杂项开销，一年后就可回本。」 但接手后，前三个月都入不敷出，认为前业主欺骗他。 后来因为宣称告老返国的前业主同意赔偿4万元，双方以和解收场。 但在橙县一个主流社区买下中餐馆的陈先生就没那么幸运，原从事中餐馆生意的他说，卖家显然在收银机做假帐，让他误以为生意很好，结果以30万 元顶下，接手后生意却不是那么回事。 拟控告原业主及中间的地产经纪。 对方后来同意偿还他6万元，但一名律师获悉该案后表示，可替他要回至少12万元。 「现在不但连6万元拿不到，还倒付律师更多诉讼费。最糟糕的是餐馆连半价都卖不掉。」陈先生透露，目前正在洽商其他律师回头控告原业主欺诈，以及律师 失职。 地产律师萧沛夫指出，由买卖中餐馆引发的诉讼，最典型的案例是新东家生意不好，认为是旧东家虚报营业额，因此回头控告旧东家。 但若举证不足，有时陪审团会认为是新东家不懂得经营餐馆，让生意下降。 也有纠纷肇因于新东家改变菜单让生意变差，新东家却混然不觉，怪罪到旧东家。 如有人买下四川餐馆后改成广式餐馆，有可能让老客人流失。 他建议，购买中餐馆前，应要求查看对方过去三年申报的所得税表、营业损益表等书面资料。 除做好功课，最好聘请专业地产经纪、会计师及律师协助完成交易，确保自身利益。 美国中餐协会执行长龚权伟说，买餐馆除要求查看对方信用刷卡营业纪录，最好也明察暗访，如周末前往对方餐馆查看顾客流，以免被对方夸大营业额。 但餐馆是否能成功，地点很重要。 此外，也看业者如何包装产品、如何监督流程。
3455f11fab15c3bfac0cacf44fb7f143bac96434.translatedText: lost all their money. There are many disputes over restaurant transfers. Report from Los Angeles. There are often news of transfers of Chinese restaurants in Southern California, and there are also many disputes. Some cases end with the two parties taking a step back and settling, while others end up in court without end. Mr. Fang, who runs a Chinese fast-food restaurant in a Hispanic community in Riverside County, said that more than a year ago he saw a local advertisement claiming that "the income is stable, the owner has no intention of running the business because he returned to China, and the Chinese restaurant is sold at a low price." He later bought the equipment and operating rights for 100,000 yuan, and took over the lease. "At that time, the owner took out the restaurant's income and expenditure accounts and told me that the monthly turnover was about 20,000 yuan. After deducting costs and other miscellaneous expenses, the money would be recovered in one year." But after taking over, he couldn't make ends meet in the first three months, and he thought the previous owner had deceived him. Later, the former owner, who claimed to have retired and returned to China, agreed to compensate 40,000 yuan, and the two parties ended in a settlement. But Mr. Chen, who bought a Chinese restaurant in a mainstream community in Orange County, was not so lucky. He was originally engaged in the Chinese restaurant business. He said that the seller apparently made false accounts at the cash register, making him mistakenly believe that the business was very good. As a result, he paid 300,000 yuan for the business, but after taking over the business, the business was not the same. Plans to sue the original owner and the real estate agent in the middle. The other party later agreed to repay him NT$60,000, but after learning of the case, a lawyer said he could get at least NT$120,000 back on his behalf. "Now not only can't we get 60,000 yuan, but we have to pay the lawyer more legal fees. The worst part is that the restaurant can't even be sold at half price." Mr. Chen revealed that he is currently negotiating with other lawyers to sue the original owner for fraud and lawyer negligence. Real estate lawyer Xiao Peifu pointed out that the most typical case of lawsuits arising from the purchase and sale of Chinese restaurants is that the new owner's business is not good, and he thinks that the old owner has falsely reported sales, so he goes back to sue the old owner. However, if there is insufficient evidence, sometimes the jury will think that the new owner does not know how to run the restaurant and the business has declined. There are also disputes when the new owner changes the menu and business deteriorates, but the new owner is oblivious and blames the old owner. If someone buys a Sichuan restaurant and then changes it to a Cantonese-style restaurant, it may cause the loss of old customers. He suggested that before buying a Chinese restaurant, you should ask to see the other party’s income tax forms, operating profit and loss statements and other written information filed in the past three years. In addition to doing your homework, it is best to hire professional real estate agents, accountants and lawyers to help complete the transaction and protect your own interests. Gong Quanwei, CEO of the American Chinese Restaurant Association, said that when buying a restaurant, in addition to asking to check the other party’s credit card business records, it is best to also conduct overt and covert visits, such as going to the other restaurant on weekends to check the customer flow, so as to avoid being exaggerated by the other party. But location matters to a restaurant's success. In addition, it also depends on how the industry packages the products and supervises the process.

18c069f43d60e1a9bf84b21395c3c194392496c2.sourceText: 武则天让唐朝更精彩 周泾渭 在千唐志斎文中，提到今日洛阳变得那么现代化，感觉到如今彷佛只有伊水边上的龙门石窟，还保存一点北朝随唐的余光。 今天文章的主角是武则天，也要从龙门西山的奉先寺讲起。 奉先寺内有尊卢舍那大佛高17.14米，站在这座巨型佛像前，你绝对没有那种识惶诚恐的压迫感，它是真正盛唐风格，它健朗丰满，端庄秀丽，洋溢着温煦可掬的人情味。面对着这样的微笑，你不会跪倒在地面前自舍自弃，但会产生对美的欣 赏和响往。 据说卢舍那大佛是以武则天为模特儿塑造，这点值得后人怀疑，因制作的工匠们恐怕不可能亲眼目睹皇后天颜，但极有可能塑造了一尊符合武则天本人审美趣味的雕像。 这尊大佛像洋溢着只有那个时代才有的大自信和大安详。武则天是个敢想敢干的女人，且敢把这些写在自己的旗帜上，连阴谋也被她玩得那样嘹亮而堂皇。她不需要犹抱琵琶半遮面式的羞羞答答，精彩绝艳的盛唐文明赋与了她中国历史上罕见的女姓自觉，这与唐李宗室有鲜卑血统有关。 武则天后来无论在”垂帘听政”还是”乾坤独断”她都表现了史无前例的离经叛道。 她就这样大度微笑着，骆宾王在讨伐她的檄文中把她骂得狗血淋头，她不过冷笑一声说：那又怎样呢？当臣读完檄文，她居然有心思赞赏作者的才华，说这样的人不用，是宰相的过失。 有位叫朱敬则的臣子，上疏谏止她”选美纵欲”，话说得不但不恭敬，说得白一点，面子也不给武则天，”陛下内竉有薛怀义，张易之，宗昌矣！近又闻尚食柳模自言，其子良宾洁白美须眉，长史候祥云，阳道壮伟，堪充寝内供奉”。这话直指女皇帷幕之内，床第之上见不得人的隐私。武则天看后非但不生气，反而淡淡一笑，赐上书人锦缎百段说：”卿不闻此言”。今天我们不知道这句话究竟是赞赏上书人的勇气还是感谢他提供了”堪充寝内供奉”的美男子的信息。反正她那淡然一笑真够大度的，大度得令人颤栗亦令人心折。 看到刘晓庆主演的电视连续剧，也有段牡丹花的故事。有种流传颇广的说法是武则天生日时，百花竞相开放，只有牡丹骄矜不发，武则天一怒之下降旨百花齐放而牡丹停开三年，后又贬牡丹于洛阳。这样的传说虽属不经，郄很符合铁女人的性格，她就有这样专横阔大的气魄。 在另一面，武则天和天下所有母亲没有两样，对自己的孩子充满温情，严加管教，还为儿子将来作好长远打算，在显庆四年的冬天，唐高宗和武则天要巡幸东都洛阳，把八岁长子李弘留在长安监国，李弘虽然聪明伶俐，毕竟是孩子，昼夜哭啼思念父母，唐高宗和武则天知道后立马停下来，把儿子接到身边，一家人一同前往东都。 李显小时候，多病多灾，武则天在龙门开凿石窟造佛像，为他祈福消灾。 这位集妻子，母亲多重角色于一身的天后，在每个方面都表现的非常杰出。相对其他中国朝代，唐朝的历史并不复杂，可以说唐朝若不是加了武则天，相对便没有那么精彩。 武则天留给后人一个无字天碑，倒真是对她是最好的批注。
18c069f43d60e1a9bf84b21395c3c194392496c2.translatedText: Wu Zetian made the Tang Dynasty more exciting Zhou Jingwei In the Qiantang Zhize article, it was mentioned that Luoyang has become so modernized today, and it seems that now only the Longmen Grottoes on the edge of the Yishui River still retains a little bit of the Northern Dynasty that followed the Tang Dynasty. The protagonist of today’s article is Wu Zetian, and we must start from Fengxian Temple in Longmen Xishan. There is a 17.14-meter-high Lu Shena Buddha in Fengxian Temple. Standing in front of this giant Buddha statue, you will definitely not feel that sense of fear and oppression. It is in the true style of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. It is strong, plump, dignified and beautiful, and is filled with warm and warm human touch. Facing such a smile, you will not kneel down in front of the ground and give up on yourself, but you will have an appreciation and yearning for beauty. It is said that the Lucena Buddha was modeled after Wu Zetian. This is doubtful by future generations, because the craftsmen who made it may not have seen the queen's beauty with their own eyes, but it is very possible that they created a statue that conforms to Wu Zetian's own aesthetic taste. This large Buddha statue is filled with great confidence and serenity that could only be found in that era. Wu Zetian was a woman who dared to think and act, and she dared to write these on her banner. Even her conspiracy was played out so loudly and grandly. She didn't need to be shy and half-hidden while holding the pipa. The splendid Tang Dynasty civilization gave her a rare female surname consciousness in Chinese history. This was related to the fact that the Li clan of the Tang Dynasty had Xianbei ancestry. Wu Zetian later showed unprecedented deviance in both "listening to politics behind the curtain" and "arbitrary actions". She smiled magnanimously like this. King Luo Bin scolded her bloody in his crusade against her, but she just sneered and said: So what? When the minister finished reading the message, she actually had the intention to appreciate the author's talent and said that it was the prime minister's fault that such a person was not used. A minister named Zhu Jingze remonstrated with her to stop her "beauty pageants and indulgences". The words were not only disrespectful, but also plain and did not give Wu Zetian face, "Your Majesty has Xue Huaiyi and Zhang Yizhi in his palace, Zong Chang! Recently, I heard that Shangshi Liumo said that his son was a good guest with a white beard and beautiful eyebrows, a long history, auspicious clouds, and a majestic Yangdao, worthy of being worshiped in the bedroom." These words pointed directly at the hidden privacy behind the Queen's curtain and above the bed. After seeing this, Wu Zetian, instead of being angry, smiled faintly, gave the petitioner a hundred pieces of brocade and said, "You didn't hear this." Today we don’t know whether this sentence is an appreciation of the courage of the petitioner or a thank you for providing information about a handsome man who is “worthy of being enshrined in his bed.” Anyway, her indifferent smile was really generous, so generous that it made people tremble and feel heartbroken. I saw a TV series starring Liu Xiaoqing, and there was also a story about peony flowers. There is a widely circulated saying that on Wu Zetian's birthday, all flowers bloomed, but peonies were the only ones who were proud and reserved. Wu Zetian was angry and ordered that all flowers bloom, but the peonies stopped blooming for three years, and then peonies were demoted to Luoyang. Although such a legend is unheard of, it fits the character of the Iron Woman very well. She has such a domineering and majestic spirit. On the other hand, Wu Zetian was no different from all mothers in the world. She was full of tenderness and strict discipline for her children, and she also made long-term plans for her son's future. In the winter of the fourth year of Xianqing, Tang Gaozong and Wu Zetian were going to visit Luoyang, the eastern capital. , leaving their eight-year-old eldest son Li Hong in Chang'an to supervise the country. Although Li Hong was smart, he was still a child. He cried and missed his parents day and night. When Tang Gaozong and Wu Zetian knew about it, they immediately stopped, picked up their son, and the family went to Dongdu together. When Li Xian was a child, he suffered from many illnesses and disasters. Wu Zetian dug a grotto and built a Buddha statue in Longmen to pray for him and eliminate disasters. This queen, who has multiple roles as a wife and mother, has performed extremely well in every aspect. Compared with other Chinese dynasties, the history of the Tang Dynasty is not complicated. It can be said that if Wu Zetian had not been added to the Tang Dynasty, it would not be so exciting. Wu Zetian left a wordless monument to future generations, which is really the best comment on her.
