d2e11adc50d43ab898c2e0f34fbf1381a8da961e.sourceText: 现在开车得更加小心，若有警察在路肩执行公务时没有及时转换车道或尽量减速，或没有礼让正在路边工作的加州交通局工人，都会被开罚单。不知者无罪等理由再也难以蒙混过关。 留学生小张日前开车经过10号公路，习惯性开在最右侧车道，看到路肩有警车和拖车正在处理一起交通事故，心想事不关己的小张继续踩油门前行，没开多远就从后视镜看到一辆闪灯警车紧随其后。小张赶紧开下高速公路靠边停车，正在纳闷自己究竟犯了什么错，却被告知违反「让路法」（Move Over Law）而吃罚单，郁闷不已。 不情愿交罚单的小张回家上网留言希望找高手指点迷津，却发现有不少同病相怜的「难友」，有北加州网友爆料，曾因类似情况在高速公路上被开罚单，被罚数百元，还被扣分。 有网友调侃「严苛法律」之下「合法抢钱」，有人抱怨「开车越来越难」，但也有民众认为，「其实根本不需要为此订定法律，这属于基本的道路礼仪和常识，不仅是警车，遇到拖车，或者坏在路边车辆，也最好这么做。」 其实，加州政府已从去年开始实施修订后的「让路法」，如果遇到公路旁停有正闪亮着红色或黄色警告灯的紧急车辆，包括警车、救护车、拖车和交通局车辆，驾驶者不能在紧急车辆旁的行车道经过，必须移到第二条行车道越过紧急车辆。如果公路交通情况而不能移到第二条行车道，必需减速，以低于20哩时速的车速慢慢经过该紧急车辆。违者罚款50元，但若计入出庭费等额外开支，可能高达200元以上。 可惜至今仍有不少华裔市民对此法案认识不深，甚至不知此法。在各州宣传「让路法」的网站（moveoveramerica.com）数据统计，全国有71%的民众没有听说过「让路法」。 加州公路巡警局（CHP）现已开出2200张违反让路法的罚单。据统计2003年至2008年间，共有大约225名执行公务的人员在高速路上遭汽车撞击死。 自今年5月以来，加州已有三名交通局工人因交通意外而死亡。最近在南加州各高速公路经常可以看到「为工人减速或让路。这是法律。」（Slow or Move Over for Workers. It’s the Law）的巨幅电子标志牌，呼吁公众开车更加小心，留意在路边工作的工人。 此外，为进一步宣传让路法，当局将通过广告、公共电视服务公告、Facebook和Twitter等社交网站等推广交通安全倡导运动。加州公路巡警局、交通局与车管局也都共同参与，密切关注是否有车辆驾驶违反这项法律。
d2e11adc50d43ab898c2e0f34fbf1381a8da961e.translatedText: Now you have to drive more carefully. If a police officer fails to change lanes in time or slow down as much as possible when performing official duties on the shoulder of the road, or fails to yield to Caltrans workers working on the roadside, they will be ticketed. It is no longer possible to get away with excuses such as ignorance. Xiao Zhang, an international student, was driving through Highway 10 a few days ago. He habitually drove in the rightmost lane. He saw a police car and a tow truck on the shoulder of the road dealing with a traffic accident. Thinking that it had nothing to do with him, Xiao Zhang continued to step on the accelerator and drove forward. After not driving far, he saw a police car with flashing lights following him in the rearview mirror. Xiao Zhang quickly drove off the highway and pulled over. He was wondering what mistake he had made, but was told that he violated the "Move Over Law" and was fined. He was very depressed. Reluctant to pay the ticket, Xiao Zhang went home and left a message online, hoping to find experts for guidance. However, he found that there were many "comrades" who had the same problem. A netizen from Northern California revealed that he had been ticketed on the highway for a similar situation and was fined hundreds of dollars and had points deducted. Some netizens ridiculed the "legal money grabbing" under the "strict laws", and some complained that "driving is getting more and more difficult." However, some people believed that "in fact, there is no need to make laws for this at all. This is basic road etiquette and common sense. It is not only police cars, but also best to do this when encountering tow trucks or broken down vehicles on the roadside." In fact, the California government has implemented the revised "Give Way Law" since last year. If there are emergency vehicles parked on the side of the road with red or yellow warning lights flashing, including police cars, ambulances, tow trucks and Department of Transportation vehicles, drivers cannot pass in the lane next to the emergency vehicle and must move to the second lane to pass the emergency vehicle. If traffic conditions prevent you from moving to the second lane, you must slow down and pass the emergency vehicle slowly at less than 20 mph. Violators are fined 50 yuan, but if additional expenses such as court fees are included, the fine may be as high as 200 yuan or more. Unfortunately, there are still many Chinese citizens who do not have a deep understanding of this bill, or even do not know it. According to statistics from a website (moveoveramerica.com) that promotes "give-way laws" in various states, 71% of people across the country have not heard of "give-way laws." The California Highway Patrol (CHP) has issued 2,200 tickets for violations of the yield law. According to statistics, between 2003 and 2008, a total of about 225 officers on duty were killed by cars on the highway. Since May of this year, three DOT workers have died in traffic accidents in California. Recently, huge electronic signs with the slogan “Slow or Move Over for Workers. It’s the Law” can often be seen on highways in Southern California, calling on the public to drive more carefully and pay attention to workers working on the roadside. In addition, to further promote the Give Way Law, the authorities will promote traffic safety advocacy campaigns through advertisements, public television service announcements, and social networking sites such as Facebook and Twitter. The California Highway Patrol, the Department of Transportation and the Department of Motor Vehicles are also involved in closely monitoring whether any vehicles are being driven in violation of this law.

0460fe2e963e0d2febaebe8c67b32a8b795b87ee.sourceText: 共和党推动校工携枪护卫校园 （亚省时报） 亚利桑那州总检察长汤姆霍恩和共正和党立法议员一起，推动一项法案，让本州公立学校校长、教师和校工携带枪支，以保护校园安全。 提出这项提案的是共和党籍众议员戴维史蒂文斯。史蒂文斯说，他的目标是确保公立学校的安全性，让更多的教师员工通过培训，参与到保卫校园的工作中来。 史蒂文斯表示，此提案若通过，比官方向全州2000公立学校派遣武装警察更可行，预算也相对低廉的多。州政府有意向每所公立学校派遣武装警察一名，但在预算上遭到压力。 亚利桑那州教育协会会长安德鲁莫里尔对此表示反对。他认为这是一个错误的决定，学校员工无法经过短短24小时培训就可以上岗代替训练有素的纪律部队成员。 也有反对者认为，如果这些校长、教员们平日佩带枪支行走在校园，会不会对学生带来恐慌？谁来保证这些佩枪的校工们没有杀人动机？ 州总监察长汤姆霍恩对提案表示支持。他解释，校工们并不是佩枪上班，枪支平日是锁在校园特定的地方，一旦发生恐怖事件，持枪校工可立即取出武器对抗恐怖分子。 霍恩说，目前不少退休警务人员、退伍军人在学校担任安全保卫工作。他希望发挥这些人的特长，并为州政府解决退伍军人就业提供多个选择。 评：貌似退休警员、退伍军人在近年持枪杀人案中占分量不轻，总检察官大人，让他们进驻学校？您家孩子肯定不是公立学校吧？
0460fe2e963e0d2febaebe8c67b32a8b795b87ee.translatedText: The Republicans push school employees to carry guns to protect schools (Alberta Times) Arizona Attorney General Tom Horn and Republican Party legislators are pushing a bill to allow the state's public school principals, teachers and school staff to carry guns to protect school safety. The proposal was sponsored by Republican Congressman David Stevens. Stevens said his goal is to ensure the safety of public schools and get more teachers and staff trained to participate in the work of protecting campuses. Stevens said that if this proposal passes, it will be more feasible and less expensive than sending armed police officers to 2,000 public schools across the state. The state government wants to send an armed police officer to every public school, but has faced budget pressures. Andrew Morrill, president of the Arizona Education Association, objected. He believes this is a wrong decision and that school staff cannot be put on duty with as little as 24 hours of training to replace well-trained members of the disciplined forces. Some opponents also believe that if these principals and teachers walk around campus wearing guns on weekdays, will they cause panic to students? Who can guarantee that these school guards armed with guns have no motive to kill? State Inspector General Tom Horn expressed support for the proposal. He explained that school janitors do not carry guns to work. The guns are usually locked in specific places on campus. In the event of a terrorist incident, school janitors with guns can immediately take out their weapons to fight against terrorists. Horn said that many retired police officers and veterans are currently working as security guards in schools. He hopes to leverage the strengths of these people and provide multiple options for the state government to address employment opportunities for veterans. Comment: It seems that retired police officers and veterans have played a large role in gun homicides in recent years. Mr. Attorney General, do you want them to be stationed in schools? Your child must not be in a public school, right?

6714d0129c0671f46cbff443daf088b9d31dcc5b.sourceText: 亚太社区促进会创会十周年盛会（多图） （亚省时报讯） 在亚太社区最受关注的慈善盛宴，亚太社区促进会慈善筹款义卖晚宴于５月12日下午5时30分在斯科茨代尔（Scottsdale） 两棵树（Doubletree）酒店隆重举行。这也是亚太社区促进会为亚裔社区服务十年的纪念。本次筹款晚宴，富国银行（Wells Fargo Bank）APS，Gilead Sciences鼎力支持，亚裔侨领，商人，医生也是这次筹款的主力，资深侨领余文劲，众议院余艳芬夫妇，亚省时报社长甄硕钦，前白宫亚太事务委员邓朝驹，侨联主席张华芳，近300慈善人士应邀出席活动。 5时30分慈善静拍卖在鸡尾酒会中举行，来自中国，韩国，泰国，日本等亚裔国家的宾客身着节日的盛装，在拍卖展厅内欣赏有亚裔特色的艺术品和生活用品，并在自己喜欢的作品前写下拍卖价格。众多精致的东方艺术品都花落慈善者囊中。 7时慈善晚宴正式开始, 亚太社区促进会执行委员会主席阿尔伯特(Albert Celoza)致辞并介绍亚太社区促进会为社区做的服务。在过去的十年当中，亚太社区促进会为成千上万的亚利桑那民众提供了乙肝测试，疫苗接种，感冒疫苗接种，糖尿病筛查，癌症教育以及医疗转诊。当然除此这些日常的健康筛查工作以外，还有很多针对少数族裔的特别的项目在进行，例如文化桥梁项目，就是通过语言来帮助那些英文不好的少数族裔进行问诊和咨询。 今年台湾佛教慈济基金会和小企业主伦纳 索海因为长期坚持从事慈善事业而被亚太社区促进会表彰。亚太社区促进会创始人徐凯莱女士 为Kayla Dong颁发2012年Evita Saquilayan 护士奖学金。 每年的社区促进会慈善筹款晚宴都是华裔医生们的大聚会，大家平时都很忙，难得一聚。他们不仅能为慈善事业进一些微薄之力，还能借这一时机相互叙叙旧。现场美食，歌曲，舞蹈，亚裔艺术家们精彩的表演，将活动推向了最高潮，来宾都慷慨解囊，为亚太社区促进会捐款。 （从左至右）亚省时报社长甄硕钦 资深侨领余文劲 亚太社区促进会创始人徐凯莱 州众议员余艳芬 资深侨领徐德之夫人彭树霞 侨联主席张华芳 部分亚利桑那华裔医生 支持亚太社区促进会的华裔友人 宴会赞助商杨桐医生（后排右二）以及友人 筹款晚宴上精彩的娱乐活动：夏威夷风情舞
6714d0129c0671f46cbff443daf088b9d31dcc5b.translatedText: The 10th Anniversary Gala of the Asia-Pacific Community Promotion Association (multiple photos) (Asia Times News) The most watched charity event in the Asia-Pacific community, the Asia-Pacific Community Promotion Association Charity Fundraising Bazaar Dinner was held at 5:30 pm on May 12 at the Doubletree Hotel in Scottsdale. This is also the anniversary of the Asian Pacific Community Advancement Association’s ten years of service to the Asian community. This fundraising dinner was fully supported by Wells Fargo Bank APS and Gilead Sciences. Asian overseas Chinese leaders, businessmen, and doctors were also the main contributors to this fundraising. Senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin, House of Representatives Yu Yanfen and his wife, Alberta Times President Zhen Shuoqin, former White House Asia-Pacific Affairs Commissioner Deng Chaoju, and Chairman of the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese Zhang Huafang, nearly 300 philanthropists were invited to attend the event. At 5:30, the charity silent auction was held in the cocktail party. Guests from China, South Korea, Thailand, Japan and other Asian countries dressed in festive costumes admired artworks and daily necessities with Asian characteristics in the auction exhibition hall, and wrote down the auction prices in front of their favorite works. Many exquisite oriental works of art have been collected by philanthropists. The charity dinner officially started at 7 o'clock. Albert Celoza, Chairman of the Executive Committee of the Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association, delivered a speech and introduced the services provided by the Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association to the community. Over the past decade, APCA has provided hepatitis B testing, vaccinations, cold shots, diabetes screenings, cancer education and medical referrals to thousands of Arizonans. Of course, in addition to these daily health screenings, there are also many special projects for ethnic minorities being carried out, such as the cultural bridge project, which uses language to help ethnic minorities who are not good in English to conduct consultations and consultations. This year, the Taiwan Buddhist Tzu Chi Foundation and small business owner Renner Sohai were commended by the Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association for their long-term persistence in philanthropy. Ms. Xu Kailai, founder of the Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association, awarded the 2012 Evita Saquilayan Nurse Scholarship to Kayla Dong. The annual charity fundraising dinner of the Community Promotion Association is a big gathering of Chinese doctors. Everyone is usually very busy, so it is rare to get together. Not only can they contribute a small amount to charity, but they can also take this opportunity to catch up with each other. Live food, songs, dances, and wonderful performances by Asian artists pushed the event to the climax. Guests generously donated money to the Asian Pacific Community Promotion Association. (From left to right) Zhen Shuoqin, President of the Alberta Times, Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader, Xu Kailai, founder of the Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association, State Representative Yu Yanfen, Peng Shuxia, wife of Xu Dezhi, a senior overseas Chinese leader, Zhang Huafang, Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, some Chinese Arizona doctors, Chinese friends who support the Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association, banquet sponsor Dr. Yang Tong (second from right in the back row) and friends. Wonderful entertainment at the fundraising dinner: Hawaiian style dance

608a0dc56aef4c6be6d92d5d2f57e7d0d3f8dfcc.sourceText: 1月30日上午，凤凰城的16th街与Glendale大道交界的办公楼内发生枪击事件。 在结束一场调解会议后，70岁的枪手哈蒙拔枪射杀，枪战中一名48岁的男子当场死亡，另有一男一女受伤送医，男子在31日因伤势过重身亡。31日上午，警方在美莎市发现一具尸体，相信是周三制造枪击案的嫌犯。警方证实嫌犯死于枪击，嫌犯的车也在附近发现。 警方相信这不是随机事件，而是有预谋的。枪手只有一人。 案发的办公大楼主要是几家医药相关的公司。枪声让公司员工们吓破了胆，纷纷反锁办公室大门，远离窗户。特警队也搜查了整座大楼。 事件发生后的数分钟内，附近的数家学校进入警备状态，警方也到场维持治安，防止有人趁机制造事端。虽然后来证实枪战没有延漫至学校，但附近居民对警方的做法表示支持。 2月1日下午，位于凤凰城南部的14街和Roeser路交界同样发生枪战，造成一人死亡三人受伤的惨剧。 据警方消息，四名受害者当时聚在一家前院聊天，一辆深绿色2002-2006年份的福特车载着四名男子停下来，其中一名男子下车扫射，导致一名50多数女人伤重身亡，另有一名40多岁男子和两名40多数女人受重伤。枪手在射杀后逃去无踪。 警方事后封锁现场附近区域调查，并没有找到枪手。警方称可能跟黑帮仇杀有关。 该区居民说，出事地点是一个不太平社区，经常有治安事件发生。 2月2日，一名16岁男孩和一名22岁男子在7街和Indian School大道遭到枪击。警方消息，16岁男孩受伤较重，另一名伤者没有生命危险。 亚省的广东老侨习惯将Phoenix翻译成”匪匿”，曾被外省侨民调侃为”土匪匿藏之地”。短短数天内发生三起枪战，凤凰城的治安令人担忧。
608a0dc56aef4c6be6d92d5d2f57e7d0d3f8dfcc.translatedText: On the morning of January 30, a shooting occurred in an office building at the intersection of 16th Street and Glendale Avenue in Phoenix. After a mediation meeting, the 70-year-old gunman Harmon drew his gun and killed him. During the shootout, a 48-year-old man died on the spot. Another man and a woman were injured and sent to the hospital. The man died of his injuries on the 31st. On the morning of the 31st, the police found a body in Mesa City, believed to be the suspect who committed the shooting on Wednesday. Police confirmed that the suspect died from gunfire and the suspect's car was also found nearby. Police believe this was not a random incident but was premeditated. There was only one shooter. The office building where the crime occurred mainly houses several pharmaceutical-related companies. The gunfire frightened the company's employees, who locked their office doors and stayed away from the windows. SWAT teams also searched the entire building. Within minutes after the incident, several nearby schools were put on alert, and the police were also present to maintain law and order to prevent anyone from taking the opportunity to cause trouble. Although it was later confirmed that the shootout did not extend to the school, nearby residents expressed support for the police's actions. On the afternoon of February 1, a shootout also occurred at the intersection of 14th Street and Roeser Road in south Phoenix, resulting in one person dead and three others injured. According to police sources, four victims were gathering in a front yard to chat. A dark green 2002-2006 Ford carrying four men stopped. One of the men got out of the car and started shooting, causing a woman in her 50s to die. Another man in his 40s and two women in their 40s were seriously injured. The gunman fled without a trace after shooting. The police later cordoned off the area near the scene for investigation, but did not find the gunman. Police said it may be related to a gang vendetta. Residents in the area said that the location of the incident was an unstable community where security incidents often occurred. On February 2, a 16-year-old boy and a 22-year-old man were shot at 7th Street and Indian School Avenue. According to police, the 16-year-old boy was seriously injured, while the other victim's injuries were not life-threatening. Old Cantonese overseas Chinese in Alberta are used to translating Phoenix as "bandit hiding place", and they were once ridiculed by overseas Chinese as "a hiding place for bandits". Three gun battles occurred in just a few days, and the security situation in Phoenix is ​​worrying.

480894e0bf3d46be568f5d1a6fddf65ce382f485.sourceText: （凤凰城中文学校 来稿） 凤凰城中文学校于十一月三日下午1:45，举办五至十一年级学生的认字比赛。学校举办认字比赛的宗旨是，让每一位参加的同学可以藉由游戏中，学习中文和团队合作。比赛前用抽籤方式，将五到十一年级学生平均分为五组，分别是红、黄、蓝、白、黑五种颜色的队伍，每一队约6人。 今年比赛主题是以中国节庆为主，高年级六位老师每人分配一个节日，分别有元宵节、端午节、新年、中秋节、教师节和母亲节。老师们根据分配的节日准备十五个字词和五道问题。最后筛选比赛题库为六十个字词及十五题问题。另外，负责元宵节的潘老师还特别提供了许多有趣的灯谜，后来比赛题库也加了五题灯谜。
480894e0bf3d46be568f5d1a6fddf65ce382f485.translatedText: (Contributed by Phoenix Chinese School) Phoenix Chinese School will hold a word recognition competition for students in grades five to eleven on November 3 at 1:45 pm. The purpose of the school's literacy competition is to allow every participating student to learn Chinese and teamwork through the game. Before the game, students from grades 5 to 11 were divided into five teams by drawing lots, with teams of five colors: red, yellow, blue, white and black. Each team has about 6 people. The theme of this year's competition is mainly Chinese festivals. Each of the six teachers in the senior grade is assigned a festival, including Lantern Festival, Dragon Boat Festival, New Year, Mid-Autumn Festival, Teachers' Day and Mother's Day. Teachers prepare fifteen words and five questions based on the assigned festival. The final screening competition question bank consisted of 60 words and 15 questions. In addition, Teacher Pan, who is in charge of the Lantern Festival, also provided many interesting lantern riddles. Later, five lantern riddles were added to the competition question bank.

f2c97863107a8a31d8b52618646ae7660056d652.sourceText: 主持人卢贞玲老师讲比赛规则 在比赛正式开始之前，首先由主持人─ 卢贞玲老师，讲解比赛规则，然后分配各队组员答题顺序。首轮由红队先开始，每人可选一到六十号任何数字，揭开字词后，要正确唸出此字。每人给十秒回答时间，无法回答时，可向队友求救，但是会被扣分。若是完全无法回答，主持人就数到三，选出最快举手的人答题。然后再轮下一组选题回答。字词轮过各组三次后，就换答问题部份。问题部份轮过一次后，再轮回字词题，如此重覆至回答完所有问题。
f2c97863107a8a31d8b52618646ae7660056d652.translatedText: The host, Teacher Lu Zhenling, explains the rules of the competition. Before the competition officially begins, the host, Teacher Lu Zhenling, first explains the rules of the competition, and then assigns the order of answering questions to each team member. In the first round, the red team starts first. Each person can choose any number from one to sixty. After revealing the word, they must pronounce the word correctly. Each person is given ten seconds to answer. If unable to answer, they can ask for help from their teammates, but points will be deducted. If the person cannot answer the question at all, the host will count to three and choose the person who raises his or her hand the fastest to answer the question. Then it’s time to answer the next group of questions. After the words have been passed through each group three times, switch to the question part. After the question part is repeated once, the word questions are repeated again, and the process is repeated until all questions are answered.

af66c942c85ca9091343aee6c52ae3252602bd9e.sourceText: 比赛正在进行中 比赛一开始，气氛就显得紧张而热络。小朋友很认真地回答问题，家长们也关心地在旁边观战。当有的小朋友不会答题时，队友和别组的小朋友都想抢答，纷纷忙着举手，就把比赛带向了高潮。有的小朋友因为选了自己的幸运号码，而得到简单的问题，就高兴地手舞足蹈；有的小朋友选到了比较难的题目，就只有摇头叹气，请队友帮忙；有的小朋友看起来胸有成竹，每一题都会回答，一旁的裁判和观众就会鼓掌给予嘉勉。学生们都很喜欢猜谜的题目，每一题都被原答题者答对了，没有抢答的机会，让其他的小朋友觉得有一点儿失望。比赛在紧张而不失欢乐的气氛下进行了一个多小时。
af66c942c85ca9091343aee6c52ae3252602bd9e.translatedText: The game is in progress. As soon as the game started, the atmosphere seemed tense and warm. The children answered the questions seriously, and the parents watched with concern. When some children couldn't answer the questions, their teammates and children from other groups all wanted to rush to answer and raised their hands, bringing the competition to a climax. Some children danced happily because they picked their lucky numbers and got simple questions; some children picked a more difficult question, so they just shook their heads and sighed, asking for help from their teammates; some children looked confident and answered every question, and the judges and the audience applauded and praised them. The students all liked the riddle questions. Every question was answered correctly by the original answerer. There was no chance to rush to answer, which made other children feel a little disappointed. The game lasted for more than an hour in a tense yet joyful atmosphere.

45a73c9e44e32cbb88113ae6ebd041f50e857580.sourceText: 集体书写 最后，因为各组的积分非常接近，主持人临时决定再加一项写字题。抽籤出来的组员必须写对主持人说的字词才能得分。比赛最后由黑队获得胜利，每一位同学获得一张电影票。第二名的黄队每人得到一张礼品卡，其馀的参赛者也都得到一份奖品和主持人准备的糖果。虽然比赛一定有输赢，但是这次每位同学的表现都非常杰出，赢得老师和家长的肯定和喝采。
45a73c9e44e32cbb88113ae6ebd041f50e857580.translatedText: Group Writing Finally, because the scores of each group were very close, the host temporarily decided to add another writing question. The team members drawn by lot must write the words spoken to the host in order to score points. At the end of the game, the black team won, and each student received a movie ticket. The second-place yellow team each received a gift card, and the remaining contestants also received a prize and candies prepared by the host. Although there must be winners and losers in the competition, every student's performance this time was outstanding, winning recognition and applause from teachers and parents.

fb5460d32eacdb22a08578d110d6809b745247fe.sourceText: 黑队获胜者与校长程秀玲（左一）合影留念 校方特别感谢五至十一年级的六位老师，和教务共同讨论，拟订比赛方式及规则，并在比赛前利用各式各样的方法，让同学们努力地练习字词和问题。希望藉由这次比赛建立学生的信心，和引燃学习中文的兴趣。 如果您想多认识凤凰城中文学校，或是想加入这个大家庭，请与校长程秀玲联络(480-620-1982) 或参观学校网页(http://clsphoenix.org/)。
fb5460d32eacdb22a08578d110d6809b745247fe.translatedText: The winner of the black team took a group photo with principal Cheng Xiuling (first from left). The school is particularly grateful to the six teachers from grades five to eleven for discussing with the academic affairs department to formulate the competition methods and rules, and using various methods before the competition to allow the students to practice words and questions diligently. We hope that through this competition we can build students’ confidence and ignite their interest in learning Chinese. If you want to know more about Phoenix Chinese School or want to join this big family, please contact the principal Cheng Xiuling (480-620-1982) or visit the school website (http://clsphoenix.org/).

a6f12f4dc147e3e7006270ed85915880f866d756.translatedText: After the police received a call about someone throwing rocks through the fence and a Phoenix patrol car was dispatched, the car was destroyed.

5a478bedf6eb01295309cd0ec8dedb76670f2ac2.sourceText: 警察报告他们到现场后，一个人跑进车里，逃离停车场，并故意撞向巡警车。第二辆巡警车也被犯罪嫌疑人撞毁。警察试图阻止犯罪嫌疑人，但是无法联系到驾驶员。一个在附近的刑警发现犯罪嫌疑人，在短暂的追逐后，当事人被逮捕。 警方说，犯罪嫌疑人是受酒精或者是药物影响的，到目前为止还未确定将被控的罪名。
5a478bedf6eb01295309cd0ec8dedb76670f2ac2.translatedText: Police reported that when they arrived at the scene, a person ran into a car, fled the parking lot, and intentionally rammed a patrol car. A second patrol car was also hit by the suspect. Officers attempted to stop the suspect but were unable to contact the driver. A nearby detective spotted the suspect, and after a brief chase, he was arrested. Police said the suspect was under the influence of alcohol or drugs and so far no charges have been determined.

0804decdde2648f90266ccc88b34029e18bbeff0.sourceText: (侨联通讯)2月9日晚，中华人民共和国驻洛杉矶领事馆刘健总领事、余雄领事、任志芳领事等一行三人，在新世界海鲜酒家举行晚宴，招待凤凰城侨界朋友，有华总、华联和凤凰城侨联的代表出席。 余雄侨务领事在宴前温馨地提示，不必打领带前来参加。刘健总领事在席上随和与健谈，他说今次来亚利桑那州和新州长见面，谈到了方方面面的内容。他说州长十分重视对中国的关係，双方在投资中将互惠双赢。刘总领事还提到，为扩展旅游业，中国可採用包机直飞的形式来进行。 在谈到中美关係时，刘总领事说习近平主席和奥巴马总统2013年在美国长谈了八个小时，去年在中国北京更是长达十个小时，谈了世界上多少事情！中美关係会比以前更好。谈到祖国的经济发展，他说中国去年对外贸易超过5千个亿，虽然有种种压力，但经济仍有7.4%的增长，中国正按照百年经济计划稳步前进。 回到侨社方面的话题，刘总领事说侨社工作要做好＂接地气＂的工作，要全心全意为基层服务。他在洛杉矶已接触过多个侨团，但不和谐的社团织组他不会去，兄弟之间如有矛盾但始终是一家人。他还要在座各位转达他对凤凰城侨胞们的问候！ 刘总领事提议畅所欲言。本地资深侨领余文劲先生热烈欢迎总领事的到访，希望日后如有空能常来。华总主席吴宁、董事徐强、华联主席王惟咨、侨联主席余文泽、顾问邓朝驹等发了言。侨联副主席崔增祁说华人耆英会正在进行＂惠侨工程＂的申请，希望总领馆希望给予这方面的协助。侨联副主席张肇鸿提到已查访到凤凰城最早的华人先民墓地和墓碑，在侨界公祭时希望能邀请到总领馆派员出席仪式。另外，传统侨社推选出邓朝驹组织70周年的抗战胜利纪念活动，华人将不分大陆港澳台及海外华人华侨，大家一齐共同来办好抗战胜利的纪念活动。( 张肇鸿报导)
0804decdde2648f90266ccc88b34029e18bbeff0.translatedText: (Overseas Chinese Federation News) On the evening of February 9, Consul General Liu Jian, Consul Yu Xiong, and Consul Ren Zhifang of the Consulate General of the People's Republic of China in Los Angeles held a dinner at the New World Seafood Restaurant to entertain friends from the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix. Representatives from Huazong, Hualian, and the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation were present. Consul Yu Xiong gave a warm reminder before the banquet that it is not necessary to wear a tie to attend. Consul General Liu Jian was easy-going and talkative at the table. He said that he came to Arizona to meet with the new governor and discussed various aspects. He said that the governor attaches great importance to relations with China and that the two sides will benefit from each other in their investment. Consul General Liu also mentioned that in order to expand tourism, China can adopt direct charter flights. When talking about Sino-US relations, Consul General Liu said that President Xi Jinping and President Obama talked for eight hours in the United States in 2013, and for ten hours in Beijing, China last year. They talked about so many things in the world! Sino-US relations will be better than before. Talking about the economic development of the motherland, he said that China's foreign trade exceeded 500 billion last year. Despite various pressures, the economy still grew by 7.4%. China is making steady progress in accordance with the Centennial Economic Plan. Returning to the topic of overseas Chinese communities, Consul General Liu said that overseas Chinese communities should do a "down-to-earth" job and serve the grassroots wholeheartedly. He has been in contact with many overseas Chinese groups in Los Angeles, but he will not go to discordant groups. If there are conflicts between brothers, they are always a family. He would also like to convey his greetings to the overseas Chinese in Phoenix to everyone present! Consul General Liu suggested speaking freely. Mr. Yu Wenjin, a senior local overseas Chinese leader, warmly welcomed the Consul General’s visit and hoped to come often if he has time in the future. Huazhong Chairman Wu Ning, Director Xu Qiang, Hualian Chairman Wang Weizi, Overseas Chinese Federation Chairman Yu Wenze, consultant Deng Chaoju and others spoke. Cui Zengqi, vice chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, said that the Chinese Senior Citizens Association is currently applying for the "Overseas Chinese Benefit Project" and hopes that the Consulate General will provide assistance in this regard. Zhang Zhaohong, vice chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, mentioned that he had visited the earliest Chinese ancestors’ cemetery and tombstones in Phoenix City, and hoped to invite personnel from the Consulate General to attend the ceremony during the public memorial ceremony for the overseas Chinese community. In addition, the traditional overseas Chinese community elected Deng Chaoju to organize the commemorative activities for the 70th anniversary of the victory of the Anti-Japanese War. Chinese people, regardless of the mainland, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan and overseas Chinese, will work together to organize the commemorative activities for the victory of the Anti-Japanese War. (Reported by Zhang Zhaohong)

dae20b2894659791fb62313d733685dba9509c60.sourceText: 中国外交部回应美国缉捕中国商人:坚决反对单边制裁 中新网4月30日电 中国外交部发言人秦刚30日主持例行记者会，就李克强将访问非洲、日本东京都知事舛添要一访华、美国总统奥巴马亚太之行等答记者问。 以下是外交部网站公布的答问实录： 秦刚首先发布消息： 一、应埃塞俄比亚联邦民主共和国总理海尔马里亚姆、尼日利亚联邦共和国总统乔纳森、安哥拉共和国总统多斯桑托斯、肯尼亚共和国总统肯雅塔邀请，国务院总理李克强将于5月4日至11日对上述四国进行正式访问。 应非洲联盟轮值主席、毛里塔尼亚伊斯兰共和国总统阿齐兹和非洲联盟委员会主席祖马邀请，李克强总理将于5月5日对非盟总部进行正式访问。 应世界经济论坛主席施瓦布邀请，李克强总理将在访尼期间于5月8日出席在尼日利亚首都阿布贾举行的第24届世界经济论坛非洲峰会全会。 二、应哥斯达黎加共和国政府邀请，习近平主席特使、农业部部长韩长赋将于5月7日至8日出席哥斯达黎加总统权力交接仪式。 问：美方昨天宣布缉捕涉嫌非法向伊朗出售导弹零部件的中国商人李方伟。中方对此有何评论？是否了解此人下落？是否会逮捕此人并将其移交给美方？ 答：我们注意到了相关报道。中方坚决反对美援引国内法对中国企业、个人实施单边制裁。美方有关做法无助于问题解决，而且有损双方防扩散合作。我要强调的是，中国政府高度重视防扩散出口管制工作，对任何违反中国防扩散法律法规的行为，都将依法严肃查处。美方的有关关切应通过与中方开展防扩散执法合作予以解决。中方敦促美方停止制裁中国公司、个人的错误做法，回到防扩散合作的正确轨道上来。 问：日本东京都知事舛添要一近日访华，自民党副总裁高村正彦也将来华访问。这是否意味着中日关系开始转圜？ 答：中方对改善和发展中日关系的立场是一贯和明确的。我们敦促日方恪守在中日四个政治文件中作出的承诺，以实际行动消除两国关系发展面临的严重政治障碍，为中日关系回归正确发展轨道作出努力。同时，我们欢迎包括朝野政党在内的日本各界人士为中日关系改善发挥积极作用。 问：美国总统奥巴马亚太之行已结束，中方有何评价？美菲签署的《加强防务合作协议》将加强美在菲军事存在，中方对此有何评论？是否认为这是美方遏制中国的举措？ 答：关于奥巴马总统访问亚太四国，我们已经就涉华的有关问题表明了中方原则立场。 我们认为，有关各方都应为增进本地区国家互信合作、促进地区共同和平、稳定与繁荣作出积极努力，而不是相反。要让太平洋永远是太平的。 我们也认为，维护亚太地区和平与稳定符合地区各方利益，需要各方共同作出努力。人们有理由要求美菲签署的任何协议均符合这一原则，不损害地区国家间相互信任以及本地区和平稳定。 问：捷克外长扎奥拉莱克日前来华访问，昨天两国外交部发表新闻公报。有分析认为，中捷关系逐渐转圜。中方对此访有何评价？ 答：昨天，中捷发表两国外交部新闻公报，公报核心内容为捷方重申坚持一个中国政策，尊重中国主权和领土完整，坚持西藏是中国领土不可分割的一部分，拒绝支持任何形式的?#35199;藏独立?#12290;这是两国间继1999年政府联合公报和2005年政府联合声明之后发表的又一重要政治文件，将对今后中捷关系健康稳定发展发挥重要作用。 近年来，由于涉藏问题，中捷关系受到干扰。捷克政府在此问题上这次作出明确表态，标志着两国关系排除了干扰因素，掀开了新的一页。我们希望捷方在尊重中方核心利益和重大关切基础上，为中捷关系的持续、稳定、健康发展作出积极努力。 问：澳大利亚方面称，搜寻马航失联客机的大多数飞机和船舶已经离开搜寻区域。中方是否也撤离了参与搜寻的飞机和船舶？ 答：下阶段，中方仍将继续积极支持和参与搜寻工作，我们也将同其他有关各方保持密切沟通和配合。 问：关于正在举行的中印边境事务磋商和协调工作机制第六次会议，你能否提供更多信息？ 答：4月28日至30日，中印边境事务磋商和协调工作机制第六次会议在北京举行。中方代表团团长为外交部边界与海洋事务司司长欧阳玉靖，印方代表团团长为外交部东亚司司长班浩然。双方外交、国防等部门代表参加了会谈。会议期间，外交部副部长刘振民会见了印度代表团。 会议在友好、坦诚、务实的气氛中进行。双方就中印边境地区形势深入交换意见，认为两国边境地区总体上保持和平与安宁，同意积极推动《中印边防合作协议》的落实，不断丰富和完善维护边境地区和平安宁的措施，使两国边界成为连接两国人民、造福两国人民的纽带。
dae20b2894659791fb62313d733685dba9509c60.translatedText: China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs responded to the U.S. arrest of Chinese businessmen: resolutely opposed to unilateral sanctions. China News Service, April 30. Chinese Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Qin Gang hosted a regular press conference on the 30th and answered reporters' questions about Li Keqiang's visit to Africa, Japan's Tokyo Governor Kaname Sozo's visit to China, and U.S. President Obama's Asia-Pacific trip. The following is the transcript of the Q&A published on the website of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs: Qin Gang first announced: 1. At the invitation of Prime Minister Hailemariam of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, President Jonathan of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, President Dos Santos of the Republic of Angola, and President Kenyatta of the Republic of Kenya, Premier Li Keqiang of the State Council will pay official visits to the above four countries from May 4 to 11. At the invitation of Aziz, the rotating chairman of the African Union and President of the Islamic Republic of Mauritania, and Zuma, Chairman of the African Union Commission, Premier Li Keqiang will pay an official visit to the AU headquarters on May 5. At the invitation of World Economic Forum Chairman Schwab, Premier Li Keqiang will attend the plenary session of the 24th World Economic Forum Africa Summit in Abuja, the capital of Nigeria, on May 8 during his visit to Nigeria. 2. At the invitation of the government of the Republic of Costa Rica, President Xi Jinping’s Special Envoy and Minister of Agriculture Han Changfu will attend the power transfer ceremony of the President of Costa Rica from May 7th to 8th. Q: The US yesterday announced the arrest of Chinese businessman Li Fangwei on suspicion of illegally selling missile components to Iran. What is China’s comment on this? Do you know the whereabouts of this person? Will this person be arrested and handed over to the United States? A: We have noticed relevant reports. China firmly opposes the United States invoking domestic laws to impose unilateral sanctions on Chinese companies and individuals. The relevant actions of the United States are not conducive to solving the problem and are damaging to non-proliferation cooperation between the two sides. What I want to stress is that the Chinese government attaches great importance to non-proliferation export control, and any violation of China's non-proliferation laws and regulations will be seriously investigated and punished in accordance with the law. The relevant concerns of the United States should be resolved through non-proliferation law enforcement cooperation with China. China urges the United States to stop the wrong practice of sanctioning Chinese companies and individuals and return to the right track of non-proliferation cooperation. Q: Governor of Tokyo, Japan, Kaname Soeichi, visited China recently, and Vice President of the Liberal Democratic Party, Masahiko Komura, will also visit China. Does this mean that Sino-Japanese relations are beginning to take a turn for the better? A: China's position on improving and developing China-Japan relations is consistent and clear. We urge Japan to abide by the commitments made in the four political documents between China and Japan, take practical actions to eliminate serious political obstacles to the development of bilateral relations, and make efforts to return China-Japan relations to the right track of development. At the same time, we welcome people from all walks of life in Japan, including the ruling and opposition parties, to play a positive role in improving Sino-Japanese relations. Q: U.S. President Obama’s Asia-Pacific trip has ended. What is China’s comment? The "Enhancing Defense Cooperation Agreement" signed by the United States and the Philippines will strengthen the US military presence in the Philippines. What is China's comment on this? Do you think this is a measure by the US to contain China? A: Regarding President Obama’s visit to the four Asia-Pacific countries, we have stated China’s principled position on relevant issues related to China. We believe that all relevant parties should make active efforts to enhance mutual trust and cooperation among countries in the region and promote common peace, stability and prosperity in the region, rather than the opposite. Let the Pacific Ocean always be peaceful. We also believe that maintaining peace and stability in the Asia-Pacific region is in the interest of all parties in the region and requires joint efforts from all parties. People have reason to demand that any agreement signed by the United States and the Philippines conforms to this principle and does not undermine mutual trust among regional countries as well as regional peace and stability. Q: Czech Foreign Minister Zaoralek visited China a few days ago. Yesterday, the two foreign ministries issued a press communiqué. Some analysts believe that China-Czech relations are gradually taking a turn for the better. What is China’s comment on this visit? A: Yesterday, China and the Czech Republic issued a press communique between the two foreign ministries. The core content of the communiqué is that the Czech side reaffirms its adherence to the one-China policy, respects China's sovereignty and territorial integrity, insists that Tibet is an inalienable part of China's territory, and refuses to support any form of Tibetan independence. This is another important political document issued between the two countries after the 1999 joint government communiqué and the 2005 government joint statement. It will play an important role in the healthy and stable development of China-Czech relations in the future. In recent years, Sino-Czech relations have been disrupted due to Tibet-related issues. The Czech government's clear stance on this issue marks that the relationship between the two countries has eliminated interfering factors and opened a new page. We hope that the Czech side will make active efforts for the sustained, stable and healthy development of China-Czech relations on the basis of respecting China's core interests and major concerns. Q: Australia said that most of the planes and ships searching for the missing Malaysian Airlines flight have left the search area. Has China also evacuated its aircraft and ships involved in the search? A: In the next stage, China will continue to actively support and participate in the search work, and we will also maintain close communication and cooperation with other relevant parties. Q: Can you provide more information on the ongoing sixth meeting of the China-India Border Affairs Consultation and Coordination Working Mechanism? A: From April 28 to 30, the sixth meeting of the China-India Border Affairs Consultation and Coordination Working Mechanism was held in Beijing. The Chinese delegation is headed by Ouyang Yujing, Director-General of the Department of Boundary and Maritime Affairs of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the Indian delegation is headed by Ban Haoran, Director-General of the East Asia Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Representatives from the foreign affairs, defense and other departments of both sides attended the talks. During the meeting, Vice Foreign Minister Liu Zhenmin met with the Indian delegation. The meeting was held in a friendly, candid and pragmatic atmosphere. The two sides had an in-depth exchange of views on the situation in the border areas between China and India. They believed that the border areas between the two countries generally maintain peace and tranquility, and agreed to actively promote the implementation of the China-India Border Defense Cooperation Agreement, continuously enrich and improve measures to maintain peace and tranquility in the border areas, and make the border between the two countries a link connecting and benefiting the two peoples.

15df71ad7393fdbe573d883bd1ec0310215cb543.sourceText: 邓楷隆在20世紀初漂洋過海到美國謀生。他和妻子马丽卿婚后育有七个孩子。
15df71ad7393fdbe573d883bd1ec0310215cb543.translatedText: Deng Kailong traveled across the ocean to the United States to make a living in the early 20th century. He and his wife Ma Liqing have seven children after marriage.

b848a4864f68809c0e0765f8bfaede624b798da5.sourceText: 1922年，邓楷隆回國，并在广州购房置业。1928年，他们全家搬回中国广州。重视中国传统文化教育把儿子送到名校读书。二儿子邓粵寅就读和寄宿于著名的国立中山大学附中至高中毕业。三儿子邓粤钿就读于广州国立中山大学附中读初三才返回到美国。他们两兄弟的中英文水平俱佳，帮到很多不懂英文的华人和新乡里。
b848a4864f68809c0e0765f8bfaede624b798da5.translatedText: In 1922, Deng Kailong returned to China and purchased a house in Guangzhou. In 1928, the family moved back to Guangzhou, China. He attached great importance to traditional Chinese cultural education and sent his son to a prestigious school. The second son, Deng Yueyin, attended and boarded at the famous high school attached to National Sun Yat-sen University until graduating from high school. The third son, Deng Yuedian, was in the third year of junior high school at the High School Affiliated to National Sun Yat-sen University in Guangzhou before returning to the United States. The two brothers are both excellent in Chinese and English and have helped many Chinese and Xinxiang people who do not understand English.

1cad777d947e17a325f645365277b5f0d881decd.sourceText: 1937年中日战争爆发后，邓楷隆一家计划先后搬回美国。随着广州遭到轰炸，他们回到了开平的家乡避难，之后再前往香港。
1cad777d947e17a325f645365277b5f0d881decd.translatedText: After the Sino-Japanese War broke out in 1937, Deng Kailong and his family planned to move back to the United States. As Guangzhou was bombed, they sought refuge back home in Kaiping before traveling to Hong Kong.

831a938a8fea92365b9d448a806ddf25b1c6813f.sourceText: 1938 年，他们最终离开了香港乘船返回美国。邓楷隆为了每个孩子都能说、读和写中文，他聘请了旧金山的教师，以确保儿女们精通用中文表达。
831a938a8fea92365b9d448a806ddf25b1c6813f.translatedText: In 1938, they finally left Hong Kong and sailed back to the United States. In order for every child to be able to speak, read and write Chinese, Deng Kailong hired teachers from San Francisco to ensure that his children were proficient in expressing themselves in Chinese.

beca5f022fb5b895a566dc5102d30bf2e269da84.sourceText: 邓楷隆作为当时华人社区的侨领，他要求凤凰城中央浸信会教堂开设华人主日学，而凤凰城中央浸信会日后成为亚利桑那州凤凰城第一华人浸信会。
beca5f022fb5b895a566dc5102d30bf2e269da84.translatedText: As the overseas Chinese leader of the Chinese community at that time, Deng Kailong requested the Phoenix Central Baptist Church to open a Chinese Sunday school, and the Phoenix Central Baptist Church later became the First Chinese Baptist Church in Phoenix, Arizona.

1a8b9fd23a039307989b51a468ee6623314b34f9.sourceText: 在1930 年代，为了让更多的华人后裔学到中文，凤凰城华人在唐人街创办中文学校，并聘请在中国岭南学院毕业的Frank T. C. Yue先生来授课。邓楷隆担任中文学校的校董，关心华裔下一代的成长。
1a8b9fd23a039307989b51a468ee6623314b34f9.translatedText: In the 1930s, in order to allow more Chinese descendants to learn Chinese, Phoenix Chinese established a Chinese school in Chinatown and hired Mr. Frank T. C. Yue, who graduated from Lingnan College in China, to teach. Deng Kailong serves as the director of the Chinese school and cares about the growth of the next generation of Chinese Americans.

172befc73a62d99953ec2adef1ec8b3f369a436b.sourceText: 凤凰城唐人街最早的中文学校

6f9b2c7dbeb933c688ccd5cc2f884e4166217265.sourceText: 邓楷隆是中华商会的创会人之一
6f9b2c7dbeb933c688ccd5cc2f884e4166217265.translatedText: Deng Kailong was one of the founders of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce

b4b3d9f50e39c49326b15cd15160376db1ccc057.sourceText: 邓楷隆在1930年代组织政治活动，支持中国国民政府抗日，他被任命为国民党的凤凰支部的领导者，多次成为全美党部大会的代表。
b4b3d9f50e39c49326b15cd15160376db1ccc057.translatedText: Deng Kailong organized political activities in the 1930s to support the Chinese National Government's anti-Japanese resistance. He was appointed as the leader of the Phoenix branch of the Kuomintang and became a representative at the National Party Conference many times.

30750efb9a9edaace0d2d5a4b4bfae2f901adb42.sourceText: 国民党凤凰城支部 (1940年代)

c58e3b21efcbbd711a6435208ca1c9a756299a1d.sourceText: 邓楷隆是亚利桑那州中华商会的八位创会人之一，中华商会成立于1939年，是亚省华人第一个在州政府注册的组织，邓楷隆曾担任中华商会会长。
c58e3b21efcbbd711a6435208ca1c9a756299a1d.translatedText: Deng Kailong was one of the eight founders of the Arizona Chinese Chamber of Commerce. The Chinese Chamber of Commerce was founded in 1939 and was the first Chinese organization in Arizona registered with the state government. Deng Kailong once served as the president of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce.

e3a010418c881a5d93b0827cf248a9b23aa776e0.sourceText: 1943年，在二次大战期间，邓楷隆负责筹组中国救灾基金，资助国民政府。笔者搜集到当年的“凤凰城抗日救亡组织”中有邓楷隆夫妇的照片和名字：邓楷隆（斐匿华商总会创办人、主席；中国国民党美南支部执委、国民政府侨务参议），邓马丽卿（国民党斐匿分部妇女科主任，妇女救国会第三任主席）。邓楷隆夫妇为中国抗战出钱出力。
e3a010418c881a5d93b0827cf248a9b23aa776e0.translatedText: In 1943, during World War II, Deng Kailong was responsible for organizing the China Disaster Relief Fund to fund the National Government. The author collected the photos and names of Deng Kailong and his wife in the "Phoenix City Anti-Japanese National Salvation Organization" of that year: Deng Kailong (founder and chairman of the Fenni Chinese Chamber of Commerce; executive member of the Southern United States Branch of the Chinese Kuomintang, and overseas Chinese affairs counselor of the National Government), and Deng Maliqing (director of the women's section of the Fei Ni branch of the Kuomintang, and the third chairman of the Women's Salvation Association). Deng Kailong and his wife contributed money and efforts to China's Anti-Japanese War.

4ed23ba577e0716d5483d154b2e95e0d89d9436d.sourceText: 邓楷隆所建筑的楼业是华人骄傲。他是一位奋发图强、不断创业的人。作为第一代的华人移民，邓楷隆目光远大，他勤奋好学，有生意头脑，他不懈工作使到他迈向成功，而成功后不忘回馈社会，不忘回馈华人社区，他是当时华人社群中的一位著名的侨领，同时他又是一位慈祥父亲和好前辈。（待续）
4ed23ba577e0716d5483d154b2e95e0d89d9436d.translatedText: The buildings built by Deng Kailong are the pride of the Chinese people. He is a hardworking and entrepreneurial person. As a first-generation Chinese immigrant, Deng Kailong had a far-sighted vision. He was diligent, studious, and business-minded. His tireless work enabled him to achieve success. After success, he never forgot to give back to society and the Chinese community. He was a well-known overseas Chinese leader in the Chinese community at that time, and he was also a kind father and good senior. (to be continued)

9568d3bc3c3da7ed5c5d667e365a55989d979706.sourceText: （亚省时报 记者谢成彦）11月14日中国工程学院院士针灸学专家石学敏受美国5大医学院邀请到美讲学，并应去年众多患者的盛情邀请，石教授会继续回访凤凰城最大的东西医合的东方医疗中心带教就医。 石学敏，中国工程院院士，博士生导师，鬼手神针”醒脑开窍”，跨世纪斐然中西的中国当代针灸大家。世人公认的石学敏”醒脑开窍针刺法”治疗中风病，在取穴、手法、计量学方面刻意创新，创立理论，建树针刺手法”向科学化、规范化的现代针灸发展方向”勇敢引领，成功实践。2010年首次到凤凰城带教就医，来自加拿大，墨西哥，意大利等多个国家的患者，得知石教授来美的消息，慕名而来。石教授用”醒脑开窍”让很多患者获益。 很多人都记得去年，有一位名字叫拜伦的西医医生，因为高血压导致中风，左半身失去行为能力。在中风的两年多时间里，他尝试过各种中西医的治疗，也做过针灸，但是都没有很好的效果。石学敏教授用醒脑开窍针法，给拜伦重新安排了一个针灸诊疗计划，在短短四个月的时间裡，拜伦的左半身，从知觉的恢复，到行为的控制，都有了飞速的进展。在2010年的7月他自己走着，回到了工作岗位。石教授离开后，拜伦在东方诊疗中心刘静医生（石学敏教授的博士研究生）的后续治疗下，恢复的非常好。拜伦表示作为一个医学行业内的专家，对醒脑开窍针灸法的神奇效果感到吃惊。 疼痛治疗也是针灸的强项，椎间盘突出，坐骨神经痛，都是老年人常见病。腰腿扭伤或者是缺钙都可能造成坐骨神经痛。用针灸治疗，第一能够迅速镇痛，第二能熟络经脉，第三坚持长期的保健治疗，重建健康的经脉系统非常重要。因为即使是手术治疗，不良的生活习惯，还都可能导致坐骨神经痛的複发，很多人为此特别头疼。去年来东方医疗中心治疗的老年患者，今年可兴奋地站在了欢迎者的队伍中了，他们已不是患者了，就是准备来感谢欢迎石教授，让更多的人能像他们一样健健康康的生活。 除了中风，疼痛治疗，高血压，帕金森综合徵，运动损伤，石教授负责处理疑难杂症。本次石教授的行程安排的非常紧，在东方医疗中心代教就医的时间从11月14日到12月16日，期间还需要到加州的皇家学院，纽约中医学院，加州中医药大学等学府进行讲座授课，有疑难病症需要石教授就诊的患者请尽快预约，更多石教授在凤凰城的活动请关注亚省时报。
9568d3bc3c3da7ed5c5d667e365a55989d979706.translatedText: (Alberta Times reporter Xie Chengyan) On November 14, acupuncture expert Shi Xuemin, academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, was invited by five major medical schools in the United States to give lectures in the United States. In response to the warm invitation of many patients last year, Professor Shi will continue to visit the largest Oriental Medical Center in Phoenix to provide teaching and treatment. Shi Xuemin, an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, a doctoral supervisor, and a master of contemporary Chinese acupuncture who has made great achievements in both China and the West across the centuries. Shi Xuemin's "Xingnaokaiqiao acupuncture method" is recognized by the world for the treatment of stroke. He deliberately innovated in acupoint selection, techniques, and metrology, established theories, and established acupuncture techniques to "direct the development of scientific and standardized modern acupuncture." He bravely led and successfully practiced it. In 2010, I went to Phoenix for the first time to teach and seek medical treatment. Patients from Canada, Mexico, Italy and other countries came here after hearing the news that Professor Shi had come to the United States. Professor Shi has benefited many patients with his "Xingnaokaiqiao" method. Many people remember that last year, a Western medicine doctor named Byron suffered a stroke due to high blood pressure and lost the ability to move the left half of his body. In the more than two years since his stroke, he tried various treatments of traditional Chinese and Western medicine, as well as acupuncture, but none had good results. Professor Shi Xuemin used the Xingnaokaiqiao acupuncture method to rearrange an acupuncture diagnosis and treatment plan for Byron. In just four months, Byron's left half of the body made rapid progress, from the recovery of consciousness to the control of behavior. In July 2010, he walked on his own and returned to work. After Professor Shi left, Byron recovered very well under the follow-up treatment of Dr. Liu Jing of Oriental Diagnostic and Treatment Center (a doctoral candidate of Professor Shi Xuemin). Byron said that as an expert in the medical industry, he was surprised by the miraculous effects of Xingnaokaiqiao acupuncture. Pain treatment is also the strength of acupuncture. Herniated discs and sciatica are common diseases among the elderly. Sprains of the waist and legs or calcium deficiency may cause sciatica. Acupuncture treatment can, firstly, provide rapid pain relief, secondly, it can familiarize the meridians, and thirdly, it is very important to maintain long-term health care treatment and rebuild a healthy meridian system. Because even surgical treatment and bad living habits may lead to the recurrence of sciatica, many people have a headache due to this. The elderly patients who came to Oriental Medical Center for treatment last year were excited to stand in the welcoming team this year. They were no longer patients, but they were ready to thank Professor Shi for welcoming him, so that more people can live a healthy life like them. In addition to stroke, pain treatment, hypertension, Parkinson's disease, and sports injuries, Professor Shi is responsible for handling difficult and complicated diseases. Professor Shi’s schedule is very tight this time. He will be teaching and treating at Oriental Medical Center from November 14th to December 16th. During this period, he will also need to give lectures at the Royal Academy of California, New York College of Chinese Medicine, California University of Chinese Medicine and other universities. Patients with difficult diseases who need Professor Shi’s treatment should make an appointment as soon as possible. For more about Professor Shi’s activities in Phoenix, please pay attention to the Alberta Times.

f9fc959e1af896a4a1b7f96b6ba17976052fe716.sourceText: 邱绍芳总领事向领区华侨华人拜年 （本报驻洛杉矶记者甄松伟摄影报道） 总领馆愿继续增进联系更好地为侨界服务 1月18日晚，中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆一楼大厅灯火通明，张灯结彩，喜气洋洋，总领事举办2012侨界新春招待会，总领事邱绍芳伉俪双双穿上富有中国民族喜庆特色的红色唐装，站在入口处笑脸相迎来自领区的侨团领袖和华侨华人代表。亚利桑那州中华文化交流协会会长张华芳以及旅美现在凤凰城的原中国中央乐团首席小提琴邱澜在记者的陪同下第一个进入总领馆，受到邱绍芳总领事夫妇迎接的第一位远方来客，大家亲切问候，简短交谈并合影留念。 邱绍芳总领事致辞，向领区广大华侨华人朋友致以节日的问候和美好的祝福，邱总领事表示，2011年是国际形势复杂多变的一年是中国改革发展稳定任务艰巨繁重的一年。中国人民团结一心，开拓前进，取得了令人瞩目的新成就，为全面建设小康社会奠定了坚实基础。中国不断加强同世界各国的友好交流，积极参与国际合作，为维护世界和平，促进人类发展做出了自己的贡献。邱总感慨地说，一年来，领区华侨华人朋友怀着对故乡的深情和热爱，发挥自身优势，参与中国建设，促进两岸交流，推进领区和美国与中国的友好合作，积极支持协助我馆工作。我谨代表总领馆全体同仁，向大家致以诚挚的敬意和衷心感谢。接着他强调，2012年，面对新的机遇和挑战，中国将继续深入贯彻落实科学发展观，努力巩固经济社会发展的良好势头。我和总领馆全体同仁愿继续做大家的真诚朋友，与大家增进联系，更好地为大家服务。 今晚总领馆一楼大厅热闹非凡，一年难得欢聚一起的侨领三三两两畅谈交流，相互祝福。亚利桑那州中华文化交流协会会长张华芳，甫上任龙冈公所主席的双重身份，拜会了中领馆孙伟德副总领事，教育参赞陈准民，侨务领事王鹏，余雄等官员，中领馆官员 很关心凤凰城侨界的情况，也表达了一些中肯的建设性的意见。张华芳还谦虚地拜会了美国国际文化交流学会周媄媄，美中文化协会孙耀宁，中国海外交流协会陈军以及传统侨社至孝笃亲公所陈协平，遡源堂雷树钦，中国统一联合会刘建民，李杨等，大家畅所欲言，交流心得。
f9fc959e1af896a4a1b7f96b6ba17976052fe716.translatedText: Consul General Qiu Shaofang wishes New Year’s greetings to the overseas Chinese in the consular district (Photography and reporting by our reporter in Los Angeles, Zhen Songwei) The Consulate General is willing to continue to enhance contacts and better serve the overseas Chinese community. On the evening of January 18, the lobby on the first floor of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles was brightly lit, decorated with lanterns and colorful, and full of joy. The Consul General held the 2012 Chinese New Year Reception for the Overseas Chinese Community. Consul General Qiu Shaofang and his wife both wore red Tang suits full of Chinese festive characteristics and stood at the entrance to greet the leaders of the overseas Chinese delegation and representatives of the overseas Chinese from the consular district with smiling faces. Zhang Huafang, president of the Arizona Chinese Cultural Exchange Association, and Qiu Lan, the former concertmaster of the Central Orchestra of China who lives in the United States and is now in Phoenix, were the first to enter the Consulate General accompanied by reporters. They were welcomed by Consul General Qiu Shaofang and his wife as the first distant visitors. Everyone greeted them cordially, had a brief conversation and took a group photo. Consul General Qiu Shaofang delivered a speech, extending holiday greetings and best wishes to overseas Chinese friends in the consular district. Consul General Qiu said that 2011 was a year of complex and changeable international situations and an arduous and arduous year for China's reform, development and stability. The Chinese people have united as one, forged ahead and made remarkable new achievements, laying a solid foundation for building a moderately prosperous society in an all-round way. China has continuously strengthened friendly exchanges with other countries around the world, actively participated in international cooperation, and made its own contributions to maintaining world peace and promoting human development. Mr. Qiu said with emotion that over the past year, overseas Chinese friends in the consular district, with deep affection and love for their hometown, have given full play to their own advantages, participated in China's construction, promoted cross-strait exchanges, promoted friendly cooperation between the consular district and the United States and China, and actively supported and assisted the work of our embassy. On behalf of all my colleagues at the Consulate General, I would like to extend my sincere respect and heartfelt thanks to you all. He then emphasized that in 2012, facing new opportunities and challenges, China will continue to thoroughly implement the Scientific Outlook on Development and strive to consolidate the good momentum of economic and social development. All my colleagues at the Consulate General and I are willing to continue to be your sincere friends, enhance contact with you, and serve you better. Tonight, the lobby on the first floor of the Consulate General was very lively. Overseas Chinese leaders, who get together rarely in a year, chatted and exchanged words and wished each other well. Zhang Huafang, president of the Arizona Chinese Cultural Exchange Association, has just assumed the dual role of chairman of the Longgang Office. He met with Deputy Consul General Sun Weide, Education Counselor Chen Zhunmin, Overseas Chinese Consul Wang Peng, Yu Xiong and other officials of the Chinese Consulate. The Chinese Consulate officials were very concerned about the situation of the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix and expressed some pertinent and constructive opinions. Zhang Huafang also humbly paid a courtesy visit to Zhou Yuxuan of the American Society for International Cultural Exchange, Sun Yaoning of the US-China Cultural Association, Chen Jun of the China Overseas Exchange Association, Chen Xieping of the Traditional Overseas Chinese Society Zhixiaodu, Lei Shuqin of Diyuantang, Liu Jianmin and Li Yang of the China Unification Federation, etc. Everyone spoke freely and exchanged their experiences.

9af9a32b5e65d7f066fbed99b3aac64da103a819.sourceText: 中国中医科学院糖尿病专家下月到访凤凰城 【主办单位】 长城中医院中美医学文化交流部 亚省长城中医院是中国中医科学院中国针灸研究所唯一一家在美国的培训代理机构，为了促进中国中医学文化在中美两国之间的交流，致力于中医知识的普及和推广。更好的推动美国替代医学医生到中国去培训学习，并邀请中国中医科学院的权威专家来美国交流，直接为美国在职医师进行再教育培训的同时，还可以让中美医学文化交流项目为美国人民，特别是为亚省的华人提供更广泛的社区服务。 【协办单位】 本次活动属非盈利性质。1. 急需义工5人。2. 特别需要懂中英学英语的义工5人。3. 邀请本省中医师参与讲座后30分钟糖尿病义诊活动。4. 欢迎各界人士及商家为本次社区活动提供赞助（茶点，饮料和奖品等支持）。 【 讲座对象 】 所有华人，可容纳120人。 请各华侨社团来电预留贵宾座位！ 【 讲座收益 】 中文讲座。细致和全面的指导糖尿病的预防和控制，特别是华人饮食和生活习惯中所存在的诱发患糖尿病的潜在隐患，更好地了解糖尿病患者血糖监控及用药的相关知识、生活调理以及长期糖尿病患者会引发的一系列健康问题。 【 特聘专家 】 王宏才 教授 王宏才 教授 中国中医科学院针灸研究所博士生导师，主任医师，世界中医药学会联合会糖尿病专业委员会副秘书长，原世界针灸学会联合会副秘书长，中国北京国际针灸培训中心副主任。王教授从事20余年中西医临床及研究工作，擅长内分泌、代谢等疾病的防治。主持国家多项重点研究，其中包括：”针药结合对糖尿病神经病变的临床和机理研究”，”不同参数电针对糖尿病相关指标影响研究”，”糖耐量受损患者早期干预”等。现已发表学术论文40余篇，其《糖尿病康复之路》，《糖尿病及并发症中西医诊治学》，《糖尿病的根源与应对策略》，《糖尿病专家新见解》等专著享有盛名。多次完成外交部及国家中医药管理局重大医疗任务。项目广州已应邀赴40多个国家和地区去医疗或讲学。 【 讲座内容 】 一． 糖尿病的发病率及西医治疗（高危人群，血糖监测，降糖药物的运用） 二．糖尿病的中医治疗及主要并发症（中医中药针灸的辅助治疗，对疲劳，视力影响，手脚麻木，皮肤病，多尿，性功能障碍，以及后期并发症的防治） 三．中医养身对糖尿病认识（四季食疗，运动，家庭关爱对糖尿病患者的帮助） 【 讲座形式 】可供 120人免费入座,请来电预留座位，提供茶点和抽奖，将有 中西医师及营养师参与会后糖尿病 30 分钟义诊咨询活动。 【 讲座时间 】 2012年5月26号 下午4:00 -5:30 【 讲座地点 】 Scottsdale Mustang Library Auditorium Address: 10101 North 90th Street Scottsdale, AZ 85258 【 活动亮点 】 一等奖：10名， 王宏才教授 专家义诊。 二等奖：10名 欢迎各界人士及商家提供 三等奖：10名 欢迎各界人士及商家提供 【 联系方式 】 英文留言： Tel:480-382-5599 Email:ce@chinesedrs.org 中文咨询： Tel: 480-429-8881 Fax: 480-429-8882 【专家 特诊 】 2012 年5月28日,29日两天 8:30-4:30 诊费：$120(请大家提前挂号预约) Tel: 480-429-8881 【 义诊时间 】 2012 年5月28日上午：8:30-12:30( 一等奖获得者) 【 义诊地点 】 长城中医院 Great Wall Chinese Medicine 肖青松医生也将协助王教授义诊 3337 North Miller Road Suite103 Scottsdale AZ 85251 www.chinesedrs.com 健康系列专题： 压力人群 警惕糖前期 山药与糖尿病 常吃白米患糖尿病风险增高 只吃降糖药不等于治疗糖尿病 特别能吃怎么办 要警惕糖尿病引起的记忆力下降
9af9a32b5e65d7f066fbed99b3aac64da103a819.translatedText: Diabetes experts from the China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences will visit Phoenix next month. [Sponsor] Great Wall Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Sino-US Medical and Cultural Exchange Department. The Great Wall Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine of Alberta is the only training agency in the United States for the Chinese Acupuncture Institute of the Chinese Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences. In order to promote the exchange of Chinese traditional Chinese medicine culture between China and the United States, it is committed to the popularization and promotion of traditional Chinese medicine knowledge. It is better to promote American alternative medicine doctors to go to China for training and study, and invite authoritative experts from the China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences to come to the United States for exchanges. While directly re-education and training for American in-service doctors, the Sino-US medical cultural exchange project can also provide broader community services for the American people, especially the Chinese in Alberta. [Co-organizer] This event is non-profit in nature. 1. Urgent need of 5 volunteers. 2. There is a special need for 5 volunteers who can learn Chinese and English. 3. Invite local Chinese medicine practitioners to participate in the 30-minute free diabetes clinic after the lecture. 4. People and businesses from all walks of life are welcome to provide sponsorship (support for refreshments, drinks, prizes, etc.) for this community event. 【Lecture Audience】All Chinese, can accommodate 120 people. Please call all overseas Chinese associations to reserve VIP seats! [Lecture Proceeds] Chinese lectures. Detailed and comprehensive guidance on the prevention and control of diabetes, especially the potential risks of diabetes in Chinese people's diet and living habits, and a better understanding of blood sugar monitoring and medication related knowledge of diabetic patients, lifestyle adjustments, and a series of health problems caused by long-term diabetic patients. [Distinguished Expert] Professor Wang Hongcai Professor Wang Hongcai is a doctoral supervisor and chief physician of the Institute of Acupuncture and Moxibustion, China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences, deputy secretary-general of the Diabetes Professional Committee of the World Federation of Chinese Medicine Societies, former deputy secretary-general of the World Federation of Acupuncture Societies, and deputy director of the International Acupuncture Training Center in Beijing, China. Professor Wang has been engaged in clinical and research work of traditional Chinese and Western medicine for more than 20 years, and is good at the prevention and treatment of endocrine, metabolic and other diseases. Hosted a number of national key research studies, including: "Clinical and Mechanistic Research on Diabetic Neuropathy by Combination of Acupuncture and Drugs", "Study on the Effects of Different Parameters of Electroacupuncture on Diabetes Related Indicators", "Early Intervention for Patients with Impaired Glucose Tolerance", etc. He has published more than 40 academic papers, and his monographs such as "The Road to Recovery from Diabetes", "Diagnosis and Treatment of Diabetes and Complications with Traditional Chinese and Western Medicine", "The Roots and Coping Strategies of Diabetes", and "New Insights from Diabetes Experts" are well-known. It has completed many major medical tasks of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine. Project Guangzhou has been invited to more than 40 countries and regions for medical treatment or lectures. [Lecture content] 1. The incidence of diabetes and Western medicine treatment (high-risk groups, blood sugar monitoring, use of hypoglycemic drugs) 2. Traditional Chinese medicine treatment of diabetes and its main complications (auxiliary treatment with traditional Chinese medicine and acupuncture, prevention and treatment of fatigue, visual effects, numbness of hands and feet, skin diseases, polyuria, sexual dysfunction, and later complications) 3. Understanding of diabetes from traditional Chinese medicine health care (the help of four-season diet, exercise, and family care for patients with diabetes) [Lecture format] Free seating for 120 people. Please call to reserve a seat. Refreshments and lucky draws will be provided. Chinese and Western doctors and nutritionists will participate in a 30-minute free diabetes consultation event after the meeting. 271f5dc7e674d43dd259cac31ca76ffde5004bf7.translatedText: Zhuang Zhi from Phoenix City: "Insufficient" or "Not needed" "How was your Thanksgiving? Did you participate in the "Black Friday" shopping?" The weekend after Thanksgiving with friends...

3579ab074ef0ec4f95c2d4843dccf8a282e84303.sourceText: 凤凰城庄芷：「不足」或「不需」 「感恩节过得如何？有没有去参加『黑色星期五』的大采购？」感恩节后的周末和朋友巧遇，她笑问着。 「大概年纪大了，只能抱着凑热闹的心态喽！」我摇了摇头说：「再加上我一向很土，好像也没想到什么新鲜的东西需要买。」 「对啊！对啊！我也有同感。」朋友附喝着说：「好奇怪！我们家孩子都列了一大串『必需』买的单子，他们的『必需品』可真多啊！」 「其实不只年轻人，许多成年人的心中不也有很多『必需品』的清单吗？」我边想边说着：「想当年，咱们漂洋过海的来到美国，不就是因为潜意识里把『 留学』当成某种程度的『必需品』嘛！」 「说的太对了！」她马上接腔说：「想当年咱们这些留学生心中的『必需品』大概就是五子登科，那时候帽子(学位)、车子、房子、妻子(家庭)、和儿子(孩子 )好像就是大家努力的目标吧！」 「很多人如今都拥有了这五子，甚至远远超过这些，但心满意足的恐怕不多喔！」我有感而发的说。 「是啊！不少人可是有好几份的『五子』啊！」朋友眨眨眼调皮地说：「不但拥有不只一顶帽子，还有好几辆车子、好几栋房子、好几个孩子、说不定还 有好几个妻子呢！」 说完我俩哄然大笑。 笑完后，朋友悠悠的说：「不过我很想知道，即使拥有好几份『五子登科』的人，会不会就真的活得很快乐呢！」 朋友！ 您说呢？ 相信这个问题的答案，或许我们都已知道吧！ 明代文人朱载堉曾写过一首「十不足」，之所以令人津津乐道，因为说出了许多人心中共同的念想： 终日奔忙只为饥，才得有食又思衣； 置下绫罗身上穿，抬头又嫌房屋低； 盖下高楼并大厦，床前却少美貌妻； 娇妻美妾都娶下，又虑出门没马骑； 将钱买下高头马，马前马后少跟随； 家人招下数十人，有钱没势被人欺： 一诠诠到知县位，又说官小势位低； 一攀攀到阁老位，每日思想要登基； 一日南面坐天下，又想神仙来下棋； 洞宾与他把棋下，又问哪是上天梯； 上天梯子未坐下，阎王发牌鬼来催； 若非此人到限到，上到天上还嫌低。 读完这有一点夸张的「十不足」，是否觉得咱们多多少少也都有一些「不足」的心态呢？ 其实，今日的科技文明、科学发达、以及各种的发明和建设，都是因为人心中的「不足」所激发出来的，然而心中的梦想，可以朝正面地发展成我们不断努力向前的动力， 但也可能朝负面发展而陷入虚荣、自私、或贪婪的漩涡。 或许，有时候真该静下心来，审视一下自己努力的方向，并想想自己心中​​的「不足感」和「必需品」吧！
3579ab074ef0ec4f95c2d4843dccf8a282e84303.translatedText: Zhuang Zhi from Phoenix City: "Not enough" or "Not needed" "How was your Thanksgiving? Did you participate in the Black Friday shopping spree?" She asked with a smile when she met a friend by chance the weekend after Thanksgiving. "I'm probably older, so I can only join in the fun!" I shook my head and said, "Besides, I've always been very rustic, and I don't seem to have thought of anything new to buy." "Yes! Yes! I feel the same way." My friend chimed in and said, "How strange! Our children have made a long list of "necessary" purchases. They have so many "necessities"!" "Actually, not only young people, but many adults also have a list of "necessities" in their minds." I said as I thought, "Back then, when we came across the ocean to the United States, wasn't it because we subconsciously regarded 'study abroad' as a certain level of 'necessities'!" ) seems to be the goal of everyone’s efforts!” “Many people now have these five children, or even far more than these, but I’m afraid not many are satisfied!” I said with emotion. "Yes! Many people have multiple "five sons"!" My friend winked and said mischievously: "Not only do they own more than one hat, but they also have several cars, several houses, several children, and maybe several wives!" After that, we both burst out laughing. After laughing, my friend said leisurely: "But I really want to know whether people who have several "five sons admitted to the imperial examination" will really live a happy life!" Friends! What do you think? I believe that maybe we all know the answer to this question! Zhu Zaiyu, a literati in the Ming Dynasty, once wrote a poem called "Ten Insufficiencies", which is very popular because it expresses the common thoughts in many people's hearts: Running around all day just for hunger, so that I have to eat and think about clothes; I put down silk clothes to wear, but when I raise my head, I feel that the house is low; I build tall buildings and mansions, but there are few beautiful wives in front of my bed; I have married all the beautiful wives and concubines, but I worry about not having a horse to ride on; The money is used to buy a horse with a high head, and there are few followers behind it; the family recruits dozens of people, and they are bullied by others if they have money but no power: once they reach the county magistrate position, they say that the official position is low; once they climb to the senior position of the pavilion, they think about ascending to the throne every day; one day when they are sitting in the south, they want gods to come and play chess; Dong Bin plays chess with him, and asks which is the ladder to heaven; before he sat down on the ladder to heaven, the king of hell issued cards and ghosts came to urge him; If this person had not reached the limit, going up to heaven would still be too low. After reading this somewhat exaggerated "Ten Insufficiencies", do you feel that we all have a "deficiency" mentality to some extent? In fact, today's scientific and technological civilization, scientific development, and various inventions and constructions are all inspired by "insufficiencies" in people's hearts. However, the dreams in our hearts can develop positively and become the driving force for our continuous efforts to move forward, but they can also develop negatively and fall into the vortex of vanity, selfishness, or greed. Perhaps, sometimes you should calm down, examine the direction of your efforts, and think about the "sense of insufficiency" and "necessities" in your heart!

498ca97ce16007b1695775731e320aab72879f25.translatedText: In several major swing states, Obama won the votes of Michigan, Pennsylvania, New Hampshire, Wisconsin and other states, while Romney won the votes of North Carolina and other states. 23c77f1126bcd0986ef787043119d88c61a717ed.translatedText: At around 2 pm Beijing time, the US election will release preliminary exit polls to confirm who wins the current presidential election. Romney and Obama will attend voting day rallies at their respective campaign headquarters in Boston and Chicago that evening, awaiting preliminary results. Regardless of victory or defeat, Obama will deliver a speech in Chicago, Illinois, where the Democratic Party's campaign headquarters is located.

523e287ca85777c59896bb853eb2346938b541b2.translatedText: Romney previously said that his 2012 election campaign was not perfect, but he had no regrets. 87abbf775eb2c477f3a76ba4bbf285285b01f128.sourceText: 当您的购屋合约成立之后，在等待交屋的过程中要注意些什么呢？ 有以下几点是需要注意的。
87abbf775eb2c477f3a76ba4bbf285285b01f128.translatedText: After your house purchase contract is established, what should you pay attention to while waiting for the house to be handed over? There are the following points that need to be noted.

c2ab9ce5f1475f515250c6b05df03eeb03a3a26e.sourceText: 最重要的一点是要维持好自己的贷款资格，通常银行在交屋之前，会再查一次您的信用报告，看看是否还符合贷款条件，您的信用分数是否降低到不符合贷款的标准。 要避免做一些让信用分数降低的行为，例如： 贷款买车、信用卡欠款增加太多、申请其它贷款等等，诸如此类的行为都会拉低您的信用分数，导致银行改变贷款条件，甚至不提供 贷款。 再来，不要忘了通知相关单位您既将搬家，将会有新的地址，像是： 杂志及报纸公司、电话公司、水电公司、往来银行、信用卡公司等等，请他们把您的档案资料 更改到新地址，更要记得向邮局声请邮件转寄服务，到邮局内或邮局网站(www.usps.com) 填申请表，可以向邮局指定几月几日起，某某人的邮件要转 寄到某地址，此项服务是免费的，邮局会代转邮件一年。 还有要把购屋头期款准备好，通常在签约交屋当天，您必须将头期款及其他交屋费用以银行保付支票(Cashier’s Check) 或银行电汇(Wire Transfer) 的方式放到委托 保管帐户(Escrow)，所以记得签约交屋之前先到银行办理。 最后，交屋前要对您所购买的房屋做一次最后的检查，从头到尾、从上到下，再彻底的看一遍，看看各项设备是否运作正常，像是电源插座、水电开关、 家电用品是否运转等等，如果购买的是新建屋，要把尚未完成或必须修理的东西记下来，先约定好完成或修复的日期，请建商的代表签名，如果购买的是二手屋，要 确定之前约定好必须修复、必须清理的东西都已完成，答应留下来、包含在购买合约里的事项都还在。 以上简单说明交屋前该注意事项，如果您有任何房地产方面的问题，非常欢迎您打电话到我的专线(480) 612-4545 或email至 Rich@RichLiao.com 。
c2ab9ce5f1475f515250c6b05df03eeb03a3a26e.translatedText: The most important thing is to maintain your loan qualifications. Usually, before handing over a house, the bank will check your credit report again to see if you still meet the loan conditions and whether your credit score has dropped to the point where you do not meet the loan standards. Avoid doing things that will lower your credit score, such as taking out a car loan, increasing your credit card debt too much, applying for other loans, etc. These actions will lower your credit score and cause the bank to change loan conditions or even not provide a loan. Next, don’t forget to notify the relevant units that you are moving and will have a new address, such as: magazine and newspaper companies, telephone companies, water and electricity companies, banks, credit card companies, etc. Ask them to change your file information to the new address. Also remember to apply for mail forwarding service from the post office. Go to the post office or the post office website (www.usps.com) to fill out the application form. You can specify the month and date from the post office that someone’s mail will be forwarded. If sent to a certain address, this service is free and the post office will forward the mail for one year. You also need to prepare the down payment for purchasing a house. Usually on the day you sign the contract and hand over the house, you must deposit the down payment and other house closing costs into the escrow account (Escrow) in the form of a bank certified check (Cashier’s Check) or bank wire transfer (Wire Transfer), so remember to go to the bank before signing the contract and handing over the house. Finally, before handing over the house, you need to do a final inspection of the house you purchased. Go through it from top to bottom to see if all the equipment is functioning properly, such as power sockets, water and electricity switches, household appliances, etc. If you are buying a new house, write down the things that have not been completed or need to be repaired. Agree on the date for completion or repair first, and ask the builder's representative to sign. If you are buying a second-hand house, you must Make sure that everything you agreed to fix and clean has been completed, and that everything you agreed to keep and included in the purchase contract is still there. The above briefly explains what you should pay attention to before handing over a house. If you have any questions about real estate, you are very welcome to call my hotline (480) 612-4545 or email to Rich@RichLiao.com.

1c4ce82ae77f4c2c356f969260c8eaa804511dfb.sourceText: 凤凰城气如虹：节庆活动 近日来，我夫妇忙碌完儿子的婚礼，恢复悠闲空间，优游自在地过活，没有人闲心不闲的状况，轻松愉快。 其实退休的日子，太过清闲，无所是事，也觉纳闷，有些事情忙碌一下是好的，如果没有家务缠身，找机会参与各项活动，则是最佳的选择。 正因如此，遇到空闲时候，我会留意社区间有什么活动，最为惬意是节庆同乐，开怀欢愉，可以堂堂正正找借口参加。 我夫妇不谙英语，只有在华越社区内行走，范围狭窄，不过，也让我感到满足，能够同声同气与亲朋好友聊天，于愿已足。 令我高兴的是接下来这两三个月，在美国连续有各节日庆典，可谓节节相连，活动频频。 由十月底万圣节开始，到十一月的感恩节长假期，十二月的圣诞节，然后是隆重迎接新年。 再加上中华民族的传统节日，如下元诞、冬至、谢灶神以及欢度农历春节等，那一连串的节庆活动，无论私人的祝贺，或侨团的庆典，都让整体社区充满热闹气氛。 这些节庆活动，通常我都参加，视为欢欣庆祝也好，娱乐消遣也好，打发时光也好，反正能够与众同乐，而且，对于写作方面来说，更是大有帮助，随时可拾取 各种见闻，仔细拣选发生的情节，就可成为文章题材。 就以我在这十一月份的活动来看，真不算少，自从十一月十一日星期五儿子的结婚喜宴刚完满结束，翌日星期六，内表妹秀卿即把握良机提早举办感恩 节联欢，而我小姨一家当日下午就要告别凤凰城，因此联欢聚会宣布中午展开，直落晚间继续进行，各州亲戚共聚一堂，机会难逢，谈笑风生，其乐融融。 跟着是十八日星期五，参加耆英会提前欢度感恩节，将近二百人的聚会，热闹有趣，欣赏广东歌咏组的演唱，观看国语合唱团的歌曲，聆听牧师主讲的感恩意义与吟唱圣诗 ，然后齐齐用午餐，大家聊天问好，我又因刚连任「老爷」职位，获得不少耆老再次道贺，真正感恩不浅。 耆英会的朋友又告诉我，第二天的星期六，歌唱组还有表演节目，是到纪念大厦作为庆祝感恩节交流演出，叫我有空同行，这次我不能参与了，因为恰好这天是 我岳母的忌辰，轮到我自己要搞活动，不是庆祝，而是凭吊，太座说初归媳妇，应该金猪致祭外婆，以示庄重悼念，当晚还邀请参与姻亲共同晚膳，稍作 酬谢。 然后是廿四日星期四的感恩节降临，一连四日的长假期，有的选择出外旅游，有的在家欢宴，有的等待第二天那个「黑色星期五」 ( 记忆中过去称疯狂星期五 )， 准备到商场抢购便宜日用品​​，凤凰城的市区因此比平时恬静。 这长假期我反而没有任何安排，可能是主要的聚会已提前举行，近年来我又旅游过不少地方，现今有一动不如一静的观念，等待随时实现的亲友聚会，这两天真正是只 与朋友亲戚点心品茗，闲话家常。 只有星期六，我两老在家中无聊，儿女又各有去处，我想起康乐大厦的节目，那里有合唱歌啦，打麻雀啦，粤韵演奏啦，都是有益活动，而且还特别组织两餐 美食，中午在多福品尝点心，晚间在红锅自选佳肴，「民以食为天」，我最感兴趣，特去拥护支持，一来是收费便宜长者，二来是家中懒开火爨，第 三可以与众同乐。 节庆活动，能大快朵颐，真个称心如意呀！
1c4ce82ae77f4c2c356f969260c8eaa804511dfb.translatedText: Phoenix City is full of energy: Festivals and Events. Recently, my husband and I have been busy with their son's wedding, and have regained their leisure space, living leisurely and leisurely. No one is too busy, and they are relaxed and happy. In fact, retirement days are too leisurely, with nothing to do, and I feel confused. It is good to be busy with some things. If there are no housework, finding opportunities to participate in various activities is the best choice. Because of this, when I have free time, I will pay attention to what activities are happening in the community. The most pleasant ones are festivals and fun, where I can find excuses to participate openly and happily. My husband and I are not proficient in English, so we can only walk in the Huayue community, which is very narrow. However, it also makes me feel satisfied. I can chat with my relatives and friends with the same voice, which is enough. What makes me happy is that in the next two or three months, there will be various festivals and celebrations in the United States. It can be said that they are connected to each other and there are frequent activities. It starts with Halloween at the end of October, goes to the long Thanksgiving holiday in November, Christmas in December, and then the grand welcome to the New Year. Coupled with the traditional festivals of the Chinese nation, such as the New Year's Day, the Winter Solstice, celebrating the Kitchen God, and celebrating the Lunar New Year, the series of festive activities, whether private congratulations or celebrations of overseas Chinese groups, fill the entire community with a lively atmosphere. I usually participate in these festivals, whether it is a joyous celebration, entertainment, or passing time. Anyway, I can have fun with others. Moreover, it is very helpful for writing. I can pick up various insights at any time and carefully select the plots that occur, which can become the subject of articles. Judging from my activities in November, they were quite a few. Since my son’s wedding reception had just concluded on Friday, November 11th, the next Saturday, my cousin Xiuqing seized the opportunity to hold an early Thanksgiving party. My aunt’s family was leaving Phoenix that afternoon, so the party was announced to start at noon and continue in the evening. Relatives from all over the country gathered together. It was a rare opportunity to talk and laugh happily. Then on Friday the 18th, I attended the Senior Citizens Association to celebrate Thanksgiving in advance. The gathering of nearly 200 people was lively and interesting. They enjoyed the singing of the Cantonese singing group, watched the songs of the Mandarin choir, and listened to the pastor's lecture on the meaning of thanksgiving and the singing of hymns. Then we all had lunch together. Everyone chatted and said hello. Because I had just been re-elected as the "Master", many seniors congratulated me again. I am truly grateful. Friends from the Senior Citizens Association told me that on Saturday the next day, the singing group had a performance at the Memorial Building to celebrate Thanksgiving. I was asked to accompany them if I was free. I couldn't participate this time because it happened to be the anniversary of my mother-in-law's death. It was my turn to organize an event, not to celebrate, but to pay tribute. The throne said that as a newly returned daughter-in-law, a golden pig should be sacrificed to my grandmother as a solemn tribute. That night, the in-laws were also invited to have a dinner together as a small reward. Then came Thanksgiving, Thursday the 24th. During the four-day long holiday, some people chose to travel, some celebrated at home, and some waited for the next day's "Black Friday" (called Mad Friday in my memory) and prepared to go to the mall to buy cheap daily necessities. As a result, the urban area of ​​Phoenix was quieter than usual. I don’t have any plans for this long holiday. It may be that the main gatherings have been held in advance. I have traveled to many places in recent years. Nowadays, I have the concept of being quiet and waiting for the gathering of relatives and friends that can happen at any time. These two days are really just about having snacks and tea with friends and relatives, chatting about homely things. It was only Saturday, and my two elders were bored at home, and our children had their own places to go. I thought of the program at the Hong Le Building. There were choral singing, mahjong playing, and Cantonese rhyme performances. They were all useful activities. They also organized two special meals. They tasted dim sum at Duofu at noon and chose their own delicacies at the Red Pot in the evening. "Food is the most important thing for the people." Third, you can have fun with others. It’s really satisfying to be able to enjoy the festive activities!

c41d40401a2ee6e0d0f4b1108e64b8f7feff2910.sourceText: 年仅15岁的舞者谭晓琳用肢体的语言，描绘了充满生命活力的春色。她低垂甩袖，如春天的杨柳，轻舞飞扬。用自己的绿色，唤醒了万物。她时而旋转，时而平跳，又如绚丽的彩蝶，将最优美的舞姿，奉献给春天。一吸腿，一抬足，个个动作都体现扎实的基本功，迎来全场阵阵掌声。
c41d40401a2ee6e0d0f4b1108e64b8f7feff2910.translatedText: Dancer Tan Xiaolin, who is only 15 years old, uses body language to depict the spring scenery full of vitality. She lowered her sleeves and fluttered, like willows in spring, dancing lightly. Use your own green to awaken all things. Sometimes she spins, sometimes she dances flatly, and like a gorgeous butterfly, she dedicates her most graceful dance to spring. A pump of the legs, a lift of the feet, every movement reflected solid basic skills, and received bursts of applause from the audience.

aacd88e6d25418f0fe3fa5cbacbc88f2de070cce.sourceText: 这是2015春晚演出后，亚省艺术学院的又一次专业舞蹈技能的展示。 继”彭天悦 谢知知 祝梅林 龙心兰”之后，谭晓琳，杨静文等许多小演员又脱颖而出，成为凤凰城中国民族舞的后起之秀。谭晓琳已经学习中国民族舞蹈5年，她除了每周参加正常的舞蹈课以外，还加班加点上小课，短短几个月时间，舞蹈基本功有明显的进步。谭晓琳演出结束后，主持人赶紧上台采访，舞蹈带来的优雅气质，让主持人们认为她将会是未来’凤凰城华裔小姐’非常有实力的争夺者。
aacd88e6d25418f0fe3fa5cbacbc88f2de070cce.translatedText: This is another display of professional dance skills from the Art Institute of Alberta after the 2015 Spring Festival Gala performance. Following "Peng Tianyue, Xie Zhizhi, Zhu Meilin, Long Xinlan", many young actors such as Tan Xiaolin and Yang Jingwen have stood out and become the rising stars of Chinese folk dance in Phoenix City. Tan Xiaolin has been studying Chinese folk dance for 5 years. In addition to attending normal dance classes every week, she also works overtime and takes small classes. In just a few months, her basic dance skills have improved significantly. After Tan Xiaolin's performance, the host rushed to the stage for an interview. The elegance brought by her dance made the hosts think that she would be a very powerful contender for the future "Miss Chinese Phoenix".
