23b05534ecec6edea1180f9985a490f30fef840e.translatedText: U.S. requires Medicare plans to provide birth control coverage The Department of Health and Human Services issued a rule requiring new health insurance plans to provide comprehensive coverage for women's preventive care...

1b04caa22c2775be29527e742694094196417ee8.sourceText: 美国规定医保计划提供生育控制保险 美国卫生和公众服务部颁布规定，要求新的医疗保险计划为妇女预防保健提供全面保险，其中包括避孕。 这些新规定在反对所有避孕的群体中引发争议，比如罗马天主教会以及只允许某种类型避孕的团体。 这些规定要求保险公司制定新的政策，为妇女年度体检、产前和产后护理、检查性传播疾病以及所有美国批准的避孕方式提供保险，其中包括避孕药、宫内节育器以及备受争议的”事后避孕药”。这是指在没有避孕措施的情况下发生性行为后阻止受孕。
1b04caa22c2775be29527e742694094196417ee8.translatedText: U.S. requires Medicare plans to provide birth control coverage The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services issued a rule requiring new health insurance plans to provide comprehensive coverage for women's preventive care, including contraception. The new rules are controversial among groups that oppose all contraception, such as the Roman Catholic Church, and groups that allow only certain types of birth control. The rules require insurance companies to create new policies that provide coverage for women's annual physical exams, prenatal and postpartum care, testing for sexually transmitted diseases, and all U.S.-approved contraceptive methods, including birth control pills, intrauterine devices and the controversial "morning-after pill." This refers to preventing conception after having sex without contraception.

a989128e1fad54a2861fb5274fe27694254293bf.sourceText: 侨报网：关于美国中餐馆 你不知道的几个事实
a989128e1fad54a2861fb5274fe27694254293bf.translatedText: Overseas Chinese News Network: Several facts you don’t know about Chinese restaurants in the United States

6a23c55286566d739a10c2b57d60201d38bc1a28.sourceText: 侨报网：关于美国中餐馆 你不知道的几个事实 中新网12月28日电 美国侨报网编译称，中餐在美国到底有多受欢迎？…
6a23c55286566d739a10c2b57d60201d38bc1a28.translatedText: Overseas Chinese News Network: Several facts you don’t know about Chinese restaurants in the United States. China News Service, December 28. China Overseas Chinese News Network compiled a report saying how popular is Chinese food in the United States? …

1930096a8456d5c254c9eea535730456d63856ea.sourceText: 中新网12月28日电 美国侨报网编译称，中餐在美国到底有多受欢迎？在美国任何一个有些规模的城市里，初来乍到的人至少也能找到一家中餐馆。来自华裔餐馆协会(Asian American Restaurant Association)的数据显示，在美国，中餐馆的数量是麦当劳门店的3倍。
1930096a8456d5c254c9eea535730456d63856ea.translatedText: China News Service, December 28 (Xinhua) Compiled by the American Overseas Chinese News Network, how popular is Chinese food in the United States? In any city of any size in the United States, newcomers can find at least one Chinese restaurant. Data from the Asian American Restaurant Association shows that the number of Chinese restaurants in the United States is three times that of McDonald's stores.

008ed0c106a9c0a970902817005a7f01883e177e.sourceText: 据Snope网站报道，如今，不论你想吃什么，都能够通过送餐服务送达你的门口，而来自Eater.com的报告显示，甚至是在这个令人难以置信的新时代，美国人最常点的食物中，中餐依然傲居第二。
008ed0c106a9c0a970902817005a7f01883e177e.translatedText: According to the Snope website, no matter what you want to eat, it can be delivered to your doorstep through food delivery services. A report from Eater.com shows that even in this incredible new era, Chinese food still ranks second among the most commonly ordered foods by Americans.

9c0646aedac6fe656f47224bf95d04574a8959b0.sourceText: 对于这一如苹果派一样地道的饮食，我们需要知道以下这7个事实：
9c0646aedac6fe656f47224bf95d04574a8959b0.translatedText: For this authentic food like apple pie, we need to know the following 7 facts:

3e6d6ea689a166a70e46ea4ad1ff50e586bbc85e.sourceText: 1. 中餐馆每年什么时候最忙？
3e6d6ea689a166a70e46ea4ad1ff50e586bbc85e.translatedText: 1. When is the busiest time of year for Chinese restaurants?

cf5152f373d365dc4e1b8f4a79cc6cd8d255585a.sourceText: 如果你的答案是圣诞节，那么你是正确的。形成这一事实的原因是很久以前，在圣诞节那天，开门营业的餐馆中大部分都是中餐馆。不过，尽管如今，想要下馆子的人们在圣诞节那天有了更多选择，但对于许多美国家庭来说，节日那天到中餐馆吃饭已成为一种传统，你可以从每年12月24日到31日间的搜素引擎上 ”中餐”的搜索结果中窥见一斑。
cf5152f373d365dc4e1b8f4a79cc6cd8d255585a.translatedText: If your answer is Christmas, you are correct. The reason for this fact is that a long time ago, on Christmas Day, most of the restaurants open were Chinese restaurants. But while people who want to eat out now have more choices on Christmas Day, for many American families, eating at a Chinese restaurant on the holiday has become a tradition, as you can see from the search results for "Chinese food" on search engines between December 24 and 31 every year.

f1f501530989fe8ce555dc75b666ad7eb93a4d50.sourceText: 犹太裔美国人，尤其是那些生活在纽约的人，在这一趋势上尤为领先。2014年12月《大西洋周刊》(Atlantic)上刊登的一篇文章中说到，美国人圣诞节青睐中餐的另一个原因是，犹太人和华人是当时最大的两个非基督徒移民团体，而中餐中，除了奶制品外，很多都可以用来替代的清洁食物。
f1f501530989fe8ce555dc75b666ad7eb93a4d50.translatedText: Jewish Americans, especially those living in New York, are particularly ahead of the curve in this trend. An article published in "The Atlantic" in December 2014 stated that another reason why Americans favor Chinese food at Christmas is that Jews and Chinese were the two largest non-Christian immigrant groups at the time, and in Chinese food, in addition to dairy products, many can be substituted for clean foods.

0a367ee08b5cfe18d0cae12121eeaa04041caf4b.sourceText: 2. 美国为何有如此多的中餐馆？
0a367ee08b5cfe18d0cae12121eeaa04041caf4b.translatedText: 2. Why are there so many Chinese restaurants in the United States?

7706708203442de0587f3aa5bcb19cccef9a0ed8.sourceText: 1882年《排华法案》(Chinese Exclusion Act)颁布后，其中一个意想不到的结果就是有大批中餐馆老板涌入美国。尽管对中国劳工实行了10年的移民禁令，但法律规定，一些人可以”商人身份”进入美国，并且法律还支持其亲属入境。据上海纽约大学历史学家瑟.李(Heather R. Lee)称，1915年，当餐馆老板被给予这种特殊身份之后，美国的中餐馆数量激增。
7706708203442de0587f3aa5bcb19cccef9a0ed8.translatedText: After the Chinese Exclusion Act was enacted in 1882, one of the unexpected results was the influx of Chinese restaurant owners into the United States. Despite the 10-year immigration ban on Chinese workers, the law stipulates that some people can enter the United States as "businessmen" and the law also supports the entry of their relatives. When restaurateurs were given this special status in 1915, the number of Chinese restaurants in the United States exploded, according to Heather R. Lee, a historian at New York University Shanghai.

6c3882f07e5ad09252d5af0bb70ab05213bfb1c5.sourceText: 李表示，中餐馆的年销售额在1920至1930年间翻了一番。”炒杂碎”店(”chop-suey palaces”)超越洗衣店，成为中国劳工的主要雇主。到1943年《排华法案》被取缔时，中餐不仅已被美国接受，还逐渐成为了这个国家最受喜爱的饮食。
6c3882f07e5ad09252d5af0bb70ab05213bfb1c5.translatedText: Annual sales at Chinese restaurants doubled between 1920 and 1930, Li said. "Chop-suey palaces" surpassed laundries as major employers of Chinese labor. By the time the Chinese Exclusion Act was outlawed in 1943, Chinese food had not only become accepted in the United States, it had gradually become the country's most beloved meal.

2142d872f4a96ee76c0e2082622fd9a4f0ff5cf5.sourceText: 3. 第一家中餐馆开在何处？
2142d872f4a96ee76c0e2082622fd9a4f0ff5cf5.translatedText: 3. Where was the first Chinese restaurant opened?

47fcd0cb9fb7fc2c76eb5070c59bad1a4d6cf3a8.sourceText: 1849年，第一家中餐馆?#24191;东餐馆(Canton Restaurant)在旧金山开业。研究亚洲文化的教授刘海明表示，1848年至1849年 ”淘金热”时期，涌入北加州的几千名移民中就有华人，其中大部分来自中国广东，他们也成为了旧金山最早的企业家。广东餐馆并不是当年唯一一家在旧金山开业的中餐馆，但无疑是最大的一家，那里一次可容纳300人用餐。
47fcd0cb9fb7fc2c76eb5070c59bad1a4d6cf3a8.translatedText: In 1849, the first Chinese restaurant?#24191; Canton Restaurant opened in San Francisco. Liu Haiming, a professor who studies Asian culture, said that during the "Gold Rush" period from 1848 to 1849, Chinese were among the thousands of immigrants who poured into Northern California, most of them from Guangdong, China. They also became the earliest entrepreneurs in San Francisco. The Cantonese restaurant was not the only Chinese restaurant to open in San Francisco that year, but it was undoubtedly the largest, with seating for 300 people at a time.

f6ff45702c2a2e7f921227b1b3f27374e8f2bd72.sourceText: 4. 历史最悠久的中餐馆已有多大年岁？
f6ff45702c2a2e7f921227b1b3f27374e8f2bd72.translatedText: 4. How old is the oldest Chinese restaurant?

ac2356eb38e90f40cccb48a5b2206661fbed8dec.sourceText: 位于蒙大拿州比尤特县(Butte)的北京面馆(Pekin Noodle Parlor)2011年迎来了100岁的生日。这家店如今依然供应从牛排到”炒杂碎”等自1911年开业时就有的各类食物。尽管这座大楼位于之前的一个”红灯区”附近，并且这家店的其中一个特点就是内设的17个包厢，而这种设置产生了各种奇闻轶事的传播。
ac2356eb38e90f40cccb48a5b2206661fbed8dec.translatedText: Pekin Noodle Parlor in Butte County, Montana celebrated its 100th birthday in 2011. The store still serves everything from steaks to chop suey that it has had since it opened in 1911. Although the building is located near a former "red light district" and one of the store's features is its 17 private rooms, the setting has spawned all sorts of anecdotes.

6f422716eede8a88999edd9d2b2a35f9ab46075e.sourceText: 5.”炒杂碎”真是在美国发明的吗？
6f422716eede8a88999edd9d2b2a35f9ab46075e.translatedText: 5. Was "chop suey" really invented in the United States?

761a1f37082bcd250c4703d05543996ce995c824.sourceText: 并非如此。尽管传言都说这道菜是由一位华裔厨师突发奇想用肉汤与吃剩的食物混合而成，但如今研究食物的学者们认为，这道菜要么是中国菜肴的美国做法，或者至少也是受中国菜的启发而来。
761a1f37082bcd250c4703d05543996ce995c824.translatedText: > Not so. Although rumors have it that the dish was created by a Chinese chef on a whim by mixing broth with leftover food, food scholars now believe the dish is either an American take on Chinese cuisine, or at least inspired by it.

6c451cdcb9cc517af79b9ce78c095ef5789a852e.translatedText: 6. Where is the origin of Chinese takeout boxes?

70cf1355b6f8f05ed6d04e9b2a6de0249eed9f83.sourceText: 由威尔科克斯(Frederick Weeks Wilcox)在1894年注册的”纸桶”是由一整张纸折叠而成的置物盒，盒子上还有一根绳子作为提手。威尔科克斯把”纸桶”看作是牡蛎桶的改进版，而在那个时代，牡蛎桶都是用木头制成的，被用来盛装牡蛎。
70cf1355b6f8f05ed6d04e9b2a6de0249eed9f83.translatedText: Registered by Frederick Weeks Wilcox in 1894, the "Paper Barrel" is a storage box folded from a whole sheet of paper, with a rope on the box as a handle. Wilcox viewed the "paper bucket" as an improved version of the oyster bucket, which at that time was made of wood and was used to hold oysters.

7b5db9f4b246285cae6a646ae6a75e6bc07a319c.sourceText: 作为首批提供外卖服务的餐馆，中餐馆选择纸桶来盛装外卖食品，这种做法在20世纪中期十分常见。之后，人们给纸桶内加入了塑料涂层，又于1970年首次在纸桶两侧印上了人们熟知的中国宝塔图案。
7b5db9f4b246285cae6a646ae6a75e6bc07a319c.translatedText: As one of the first restaurants to offer takeout services, Chinese restaurants chose paper buckets to hold takeout food, a practice that was very common in the mid-20th century. Later, plastic coating was added to the barrels, and in 1970, the well-known Chinese pagoda pattern was printed on both sides of the barrels for the first time.

5faa9b96cd5f9fd75a99055808602c5498a26bb7.sourceText: 广州 扬绮薇 在美国旧金山，有一个旅游招牌景点,那就是闻名遐迩的渔人码头。据说，每年大约有上千万的游人到此一游。我们当仁不让，也首选到此一游。渔人码头的标志是一个大螃蟹的广告牌，那天，我们随堂哥找到了”大螃蟹”，来到了大名鼎鼎的渔人码头。其实，渔人码头是个统称，这裡一共有41个码头，其中39号码头最大最有名最热闹。据了解，渔人码头的历史起源于19世纪50年代。当时一位商人为了方便自己的木材生意，在这裡修建了一个170平方米左右的码头。没想到，码头一建成就引来众多劳工，廉价的餐馆与酒吧纷纷落成，生意十分火爆。那一时期，活跃在渔人码头的多是意大利移民，他们的淘金梦破灭后，凭着一手捕鱼的好技术，把渔人码头办成了旧金山水产品的集散地。 1978年，39号码头的启动，更是带旺了这一带的观光旅游业。渔人码头是旧金山最充满欢乐气息的地方。码头街两旁随处可见的旅馆、摊贩、海鲜餐厅、露天咖啡馆、纪念品商店等鳞次栉比，让我们有刘姥姥进大观园的感觉。据说这裡汇聚了110家购物中心和14家海景餐厅。我们看到街中心小广场还设有旋转木马、机械骑乘等游乐设施，供游人和儿童玩乐。街头乐师和艺人惊险离奇的表演一个接一个，玩具商店新奇玩具琳琅满目，街上各种鲜美小吃诱人馋涎，咖啡馆飘出爱尔兰咖啡的浓香，直沁人心肺。码头上、海滩旁，街道裡，比肩接踵的游客络绎不绝，处处人头攒动，处处洋溢着欢乐祥和的气息。在码头边，我们看到很多贩卖海鲜的摊子，只见他们把螃蟹、鲜虾放在锅子中煮熟了卖，这也是渔人码头的一景。据说码头附近的沿海盛产鲜美的螃蟹、虾、鲍鱼、枪乌贼、海胆、鲑鱼、鲭鱼和鳕鱼，故这裡有许多闻名遐迩的特色海鲜。走累了，我们随手推开一扇街边海鲜餐厅大门，坐在裡面优雅地观海景，啖螃蟹，吃酸麵包，喝海鲜浓汤。现在的渔人码头，已经没有停泊多少渔船了，主要停泊游艇。蓦然回首，看到离岸稍远处，停靠着一艘三桅帆船，据说是1883年在苏格兰建造的Balclutha号。她曾经承载着由欧洲到这裡的历史，现在，是供游客参观的漂浮博物馆。
5faa9b96cd5f9fd75a99055808602c5498a26bb7.translatedText: Guangzhou Yang Qiwei In San Francisco, the United States, there is a tourist attraction, the famous Fisherman's Wharf. It is said that tens of millions of tourists visit here every year. We did our best to make this trip our first choice. The logo of Fisherman's Wharf is a billboard of a big crab. That day, we followed our cousin to find the "big crab" and came to the famous Fisherman's Wharf. In fact, Fisherman's Wharf is a collective name. There are 41 piers here, among which Pier 39 is the largest, most famous and busiest. It is understood that the history of Fisherman's Wharf originated in the 1850s. At that time, a businessman built a dock of about 170 square meters here to facilitate his timber business. Unexpectedly, as soon as the dock was built, it attracted many workers, cheap restaurants and bars were built one after another, and business was very booming. During that period, most of the people active in Fisherman's Wharf were Italian immigrants. After their gold mining dream was shattered, they relied on their good fishing skills to turn Fisherman's Wharf into a distribution center for aquatic products in San Francisco. In 1978, the opening of Pier 39 boosted the tourism industry in this area. Fisherman's Wharf is the most joyful place in San Francisco. Hotels, vendors, seafood restaurants, open-air cafes, souvenir shops, etc. can be seen everywhere on both sides of Pier Street, making us feel like Grandma Liu entering the Grand View Garden. It is said that there are 110 shopping malls and 14 sea view restaurants here. We saw that the small square in the center of the street also has amusement facilities such as carousels and mechanical rides for tourists and children to have fun. Street musicians and entertainers put on thrilling and bizarre performances one after another, toy shops are filled with a dazzling array of novelty toys, all kinds of delicious snacks on the street are tempting, and the strong aroma of Irish coffee wafts from the cafes, refreshing your heart and lungs. On the pier, next to the beach, and in the streets, there is an endless stream of tourists shoulder to shoulder. There are crowds of people everywhere, and there is a joyful and peaceful atmosphere everywhere. At the pier, we saw many stalls selling seafood. They cooked crabs and shrimps in pots and sold them. This is also a scene at Fisherman's Wharf. It is said that the coast near the pier is rich in delicious crabs, shrimps, abalone, calamari, sea urchins, salmon, mackerel and cod, so there are many famous special seafood here. Tired of walking, we opened the door of a street seafood restaurant, sat inside and elegantly watched the sea view, ate crabs, sourdough bread, and drank seafood soup. Today's Fisherman's Wharf does not have many fishing boats docked, but mainly yachts. Suddenly looking back, I saw a three-masted sailing ship docked a little further away from the shore. It was said to be the Balclutha built in Scotland in 1883. It once carried the history from Europe to here, and now it is a floating museum for tourists to visit.

eb1bfbc982896db0cd9f71b3763c467994b0bde9.sourceText: 大快朵颐之后，我们来到渔人码头西边，这是一条几百米长的海滩，码头上有好几大块浮板，上面躺满了懒惰的海狮，一个个挺着大肚子在晒太阳，有的甚至在停泊的船隻和栈桥上嬉戏。那憨憨的样子好可爱，惹得不少游客纷纷为这些小傢伙拍照呢。还有许多海鸟停在栏杆上，我给它拍照，它似乎也很乐意。一点也不害怕！听当地的老华侨说，渔人码头现在仍保留当年渔民卸货的氛围。每年10月，渔民会依照传统的方式为船队举行祈祷仪式。在元旦午夜钟声敲响之际，码头上所有的船队会一如当年那样汽笛齐鸣，以庆祝新年的降临。
eb1bfbc982896db0cd9f71b3763c467994b0bde9.translatedText: After a delicious meal, we came to the west side of Fisherman's Wharf, which is a beach several hundred meters long. There are several large floating boards on the pier, filled with lazy sea lions lying on them, basking in the sun with their big bellies, and some even playing on the moored boats and piers. Their silly looks are so cute that many tourists take photos of these little guys. There were also many seabirds perched on the railings. I took photos of them and they seemed happy to do so. Not afraid at all! According to local old overseas Chinese, Fisherman's Wharf still retains the atmosphere of when fishermen unloaded goods. Every October, fishermen hold a traditional prayer ceremony for the fleet. When the clock strikes midnight on New Year's Day, all the fleets on the pier will blow their whistles as they did in the past to celebrate the arrival of the New Year.

162ad46fb232a082c05304f9199ff5be5fe6a681.sourceText: 科工专周末户外登山 享受不一样的清凉！
162ad46fb232a082c05304f9199ff5be5fe6a681.translatedText: The College of Science and Engineering goes hiking outdoors on weekends to enjoy a different kind of coolness!

7c48f9d2c5cc5c88db7b7f9873a3e2db76405c4f.sourceText: 科工专周末户外登山 享受不一样的清凉！ 本周末是长周末，中国科学家工程师专业人士协会凤凰城分会（科工专）于…
7c48f9d2c5cc5c88db7b7f9873a3e2db76405c4f.translatedText: College of Science and Engineering enjoy outdoor mountain climbing on weekends to enjoy a different kind of coolness! This weekend is a long weekend. The Phoenix Branch of the Chinese Association of Scientists and Engineers (Science and Engineering) held...

a2e511f093693b29ad6755367387602649617ffe.sourceText: 本周末是长周末，中国科学家工程师专业人士协会凤凰城分会（科工专）于8月31日和9月1日两天，在莱蒙山举办登山，休闲娱乐活动。
a2e511f093693b29ad6755367387602649617ffe.translatedText: This weekend is a long weekend. The Phoenix Branch of the Chinese Association of Scientists and Engineers (Science and Engineering) held mountain climbing, leisure and entertainment activities on August 31st and September 1st at Mount Lemmon.

fc2f1bbe8def44b6a8d49beaf8bc169723f4313a.sourceText: 活动将月８月３１日上午１１点在Ramada Inn（6944 E Tanque Verde Rd, Tucson）集合，爬l莱蒙山（Mt Lemmon ）。酒店提供团体特惠，每个标准间４５美金。会议室３５美金，供大家一起就餐娱乐，酒店还提供泳池，ＳＰＡ，早餐。
fc2f1bbe8def44b6a8d49beaf8bc169723f4313a.translatedText: The event will gather at the Ramada Inn (6944 E Tanque Verde Rd, Tucson) at 11 a.m. on August 31 to climb Mt Lemmon. The hotel offers group discounts at USD 45 per standard room. The conference room costs US$35 for everyone to dine and have fun together. The hotel also provides a swimming pool, SPA, and breakfast.

2662044941ce83a8907257cc32797e333ea7e082.sourceText: 活动内容：登山，分享各家的特色菜，打牌，游戏，表演。
2662044941ce83a8907257cc32797e333ea7e082.translatedText: Activity content: mountain climbing, sharing each family’s specialties, playing cards, games, and performances.

00c21e7f9e6c9c6cbd95cc67d47008b370d6792a.sourceText: 因为酒店要下午三点后才可以入住，上午１１点集中的时候，大家可以把东西放在酒店。
00c21e7f9e6c9c6cbd95cc67d47008b370d6792a.translatedText: Because the hotel cannot be checked in until 3 pm, everyone can leave their things in the hotel when we gather at 11 am.

3a50ecd78420464f5b6826ea8b47da718853b94b.sourceText: ９月１日开始爬一些比较有难度的山。当天回凤凰城。回来之前，会到图桑据说是最好的中餐馆一起就餐。 Bar-Da Chinese restaurant (so-called the best in Tucson)
3a50ecd78420464f5b6826ea8b47da718853b94b.translatedText: On September 1, I started climbing some more difficult mountains. Return to Phoenix the same day. Before coming back, we will eat together at what is said to be the best Chinese restaurant in Tucson. Bar-Da Chinese restaurant (so-called the best in Tucson)

8e7bae374a8aa55a8e7cf20cfa229c06a0f0f1d8.sourceText: 整个旅程大家需要带一些小点心，还有家常菜。科工专提供一些水和一次性刀叉，以及会议室的费用。欢迎更多的朋友一起参加。会员免费，非会员每个成年人３美元，儿童２美元。
8e7bae374a8aa55a8e7cf20cfa229c06a0f0f1d8.translatedText: You need to bring some snacks and home-cooked meals with you throughout the trip. Science and Technology provides some water and disposable cutlery, as well as the cost of the conference room. More friends are welcome to participate. Free for members, $3 per adult and $2 per child for non-members.

18b4bf167d3ad44d26136191357db2cf8f587590.sourceText: 活动的房间有限，想参加活动的人请尽快报名，还欢迎car-pool.
18b4bf167d3ad44d26136191357db2cf8f587590.translatedText: The rooms for the event are limited. Those who want to participate in the event should register as soon as possible. Car-pools are also welcome.

a664ea1134afbf2aa3c6c126c007ad008590443d.sourceText: 郎咸平用清华的招牌洗大学生的脑 九峰 ”占领华尔街”失焦，洪博培失言，郎咸平失信，孔庆…
a664ea1134afbf2aa3c6c126c007ad008590443d.translatedText: Lang Xianping used Tsinghua's brand to wash the brains of college students. Jiufeng's "Occupy Wall Street" lost focus, Huntsman made a mistake, Lang Xianping broke his promise, Kong Qing...

6bbc5700253a918a7e75787d037fd09716464f10.sourceText: ”占领华尔街” 像无头苍蝇，象征性地把无奈发泄给制度腐败的受益者 自９月１７日”占领华尔街”运动爆发以来，该活动已持续整两个月，尽管多地出现血腥清场，然而占领运动大有越挫越勇之势，继从纽约起蔓延到100多个城市，从城区拓展到港口，大学校园再回到华尔街。11月17日，运动开始整整两月之际，上千人的华尔街抗议者喊出要关闭华尔街的口号。 然而美国”占领华尔街”运动给人的印象像是无头苍蝇一样东一榔头西一棒槌，诉求太多就等于失去诉求。运动失去焦点的关键是因为人们感到社会不公，却没有看到社会不公的根源，触及问题的本质。
6bbc5700253a918a7e75787d037fd09716464f10.translatedText: "Occupy Wall Street" is like a headless fly, symbolically venting its helplessness to the beneficiaries of systemic corruption. Since the "Occupy Wall Street" movement broke out on September 17, the activity has lasted for two full months. Although bloody clearances have occurred in many places, the Occupy movement has gained momentum and has become more courageous. It has spread from New York to more than 100 cities, from urban areas to ports, to university campuses, and back to Wall Street. On November 17, exactly two months after the movement began, thousands of Wall Street protesters shouted slogans to shut down Wall Street. However, the "Occupy Wall Street" movement in the United States gives people the impression of being like a headless fly, hitting here and there with a hammer and a stick. Too many demands mean that they lose their demands. The key to the movement losing focus is because people feel social injustice, but fail to see the root causes of social injustice and get to the essence of the problem.

cf91728e99c70c2a58a53b8cfefbdadc7a61c0c9.sourceText: 1. 美国百姓为啥跟华尔街过不去 08年金融危机，许多企业高管把企业搞垮了，却并不影响他的个人收入，这些高管包括经营不善而离职的遣散费，一年的收入竟然超过上亿美元。据《世界报》2011年8月31日报道，在美国年薪最高的100位首席执行官（CEO）中，有25位去年的薪水超过他所在公司的纳税金额。美国首席执行官的平均年收入相对普通工人的平均年收入已经从上世纪60年代的不到50倍上升到现在的大约350倍。这种掠夺式的分配不公或者说合理合法的腐败，恐怕是世界上任何贪官都羡慕不已的，是啊，能合法腐败，谁又愿意担惊受怕偷着摸着去腐败呢。 美国老百姓跟华尔街过不去是冰冻三尺绝非一日之寒。一方面，美国失业率高居不下，许多家庭陷入困顿，难以为继；另一方面，美国最有钱那部分人却没有后顾之忧，他们掌握着”大到倒不起”的资产，经济再不好有国家给兜着。美国最富裕的1% 的人口拥有全社会35%的净财富，而占人口80%的中低收入阶层只拥有15%的社会净财富。金融危机爆发以来，美国最富裕人口拥有社会财富的比例不但没有下降，反而上升了。 美国的政界和商界有一个旋转门，双方人才很容易互相转换。美国政府官员本身也不是像中国媒体精英们描述的那么清廉，都坐经济舱。看一款美国前众议院议长南希?#20329;洛西的旧闻：?#21335;希?#20329;洛西过去两年内仅在乘坐空军飞机往返的旅行途中，佩洛西享受的巧克力草莓等美食服务就花费了国家10万美元。在这份长达2000页的账单上，佩洛西担任议长期间，103次乘军机代表国会出访，31次带了自己的家人。其中一次账单上所列的食物美酒足以用来举办一场大型学生聚会。 组织负责人菲顿说：尽管媒体多次炮轰佩洛西滥用空军飞机，但她依然将空军当作自己的私人旅行服务机构厖?#12290;其实美国人的骄奢淫逸才是世界富人和贪官污吏们仰慕的榜样。 2008年华尔街金融大鳄们甚至用国家的解困资金给自己发奖金红包，过着穷奢极欲的生活。深陷困境的美洲银行向其近700名管理人员发放了36亿美元的年终奖金。奥巴马政府对陷入困境的美国国际集团(AIG)发放1.65亿美元奖金的行为表示愤慨，但美国政府同时承认，虽然联邦政府对这家保险业巨头提供了大规模资金援助，但却无法阻止其奖金发放行为。从百姓到总统这种巨大的无助感是什么造成的呢？
cf91728e99c70c2a58a53b8cfefbdadc7a61c0c9.translatedText: 1. Why do American people have trouble with Wall Street? During the 2008 financial crisis, many corporate executives brought down their companies, but it did not affect their personal income. Including severance pay for those executives who resigned due to poor management, their annual income exceeded hundreds of millions of dollars. According to a report by Le Monde on August 31, 2011, among the 100 highest-paid chief executive officers (CEOs) in the United States, 25 last year's salary exceeded the tax amount of their company. The average annual income of U.S. CEOs has risen from less than 50 times the average annual income of ordinary workers in the 1960s to about 350 times now. This kind of predatory unfair distribution, or reasonable and legal corruption, is probably the envy of any corrupt official in the world. Yes, if you can corrupt legally, who wants to be afraid of being corrupt secretly? The American people's struggle with Wall Street is not going to change overnight. On the one hand, the unemployment rate in the United States remains high, and many families are in trouble and unable to survive; on the other hand, the richest people in the United States have no worries. They control assets that are "too big to afford to fail." No matter how bad the economy is, the country will take care of it. The richest 1% of the population in the United States owns 35% of the net wealth of the entire society, while the low- and middle-income groups, which account for 80% of the population, only own 15% of the net wealth of the society. Since the outbreak of the financial crisis, the proportion of social wealth owned by the richest people in the United States has not only not declined, but has actually increased. There is a revolving door in American politics and business, and talents from both sides can easily switch to each other. U.S. government officials themselves are not as incorruptible as Chinese media elites describe, and they all fly economy class. Take a look at an old news story about former Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives Nancy Losey: In the past two years, Pelosi’s chocolate-covered strawberries and other gourmet services cost the country $100,000 during her round-trip travel on an Air Force plane. In this 2,000-page bill, Pelosi traveled on behalf of Congress 103 times by military aircraft during her tenure as speaker, and brought her own family 31 times. One of the bills included enough food and wine to host a large student party. Fitton, the head of the organization, said: Although the media has repeatedly bombarded Pelosi for abusing Air Force aircraft, she still treats the Air Force as her own private travel service agency? In fact, Americans' arrogance and extravagance are the examples that the world's rich and corrupt officials admire. In 2008, Wall Street financial giants even used the country's relief funds to give themselves bonuses and red envelopes, leading a luxurious and luxurious life. Troubled Bank of America handed out $3.6 billion in year-end bonuses to its nearly 700 managers. The Obama administration has expressed outrage over the $165 million in bonuses handed out by embattled American International Group (AIG), but it also acknowledged that despite a massive federal bailout of the insurance giant, it was unable to stop the bonuses. What causes this huge sense of helplessness from ordinary people to the president?

b483aad4df671c02389dfed563ba8874361b28db.sourceText: 美国的草根老百姓长期生活在光鲜亮丽天堂的阴暗角落里，经济好的时候，社会虽然不公平，但大家衣食无忧，相安无事。当经济长期笼罩在衰退阴影里时，最先受到伤害的就是普通百姓。美国是个寅吃卯粮高消费的国家，从政府到个人家庭都靠借贷过日子，个人很少存款。一旦失业，家庭失去经济来源，面对房贷，车贷，财产税，水电气费，医疗保险，学费，汽油等高额的生活费用一样也少不了，生活立刻陷入窘境。虽然有美国政府的临时失业救济可以勉强维持生计，但长期找不到工作，一旦超过政府失业救济时限，面临的将是交不起贷款和各种税费最终导致家庭破产。世界许多地方的人可能不理解，住着洋房开着汽车怎么叫贫困？其实这才是问题的症结所在。在发展中国家，普通失业者不需要太多的费用就可以生活下去，美国则不同，房子汽车是贷款买的，由于居住分散，公共交通不发达，许多人离了汽车连基本的生活都无法保证，建在空旷原野上的独立住宅，没有充足的能源冬天可能就会冻死。 在世界最富裕的美国，社会分配不公的矛盾在08年金融危机后长期低迷的经济环境下变得更加尖锐，造反不是穷国的专利，美国老百姓被逼无奈也会揭竿而起。 奇怪的是像郎咸平这样的留美财经精英，对美国显而易见的社会问题及其根源避而不谈，却在国内到处渲染美国制度的完美性。看郎咸平在清华演讲， http://v.youku.com/v_show/id_XMjg3Njk5ODA=.html 一方面引经据典，把美国现行社会描绘的像天堂一样；另方面把中国30年的改革说得一无是处，朗咸平到底要干什么？ 近期卸任回国投入总统大选，一直战斗在”对敌斗争”第一线的美国前驻华大使洪博培不小心一语道出美国可做不可说的国家战略。 http://bbs.wforum.com/guns/bbsviewer.php?trd_id=149234 11月15日在总统竞选活动中称：美国没有必要和中国打一场贸易战，美国必须依靠”我们在中国内部的盟友和支持者”扳倒中国，只有中国倒下去，美国才有夺回制造业的机会。
b483aad4df671c02389dfed563ba8874361b28db.translatedText: The grassroots people in the United States have long lived in the dark corners of a bright and beautiful paradise. When the economy is good, although the society is unfair, everyone has food and clothing, and lives in peace. When the economy is shrouded in the shadow of recession for a long time, ordinary people are the first to be harmed. The United States is a country where food is scarce and consumption is high. From the government to individual families, everyone relies on borrowing to live, and individuals rarely save. Once a family loses its job and loses its source of income, it is faced with high living expenses such as mortgages, car loans, property taxes, water and electricity bills, medical insurance, tuition fees, gasoline, etc., and life immediately falls into trouble. Although the U.S. government’s temporary unemployment benefits can make ends meet, if you cannot find a job for a long time, once the government’s unemployment benefits exceed the time limit, you will be faced with being unable to pay loans and various taxes, which will eventually lead to family bankruptcy. People in many parts of the world may not understand, how can living in a bungalow and driving a car be called poverty? In fact, this is the crux of the problem. In developing countries, ordinary unemployed people can live without much expense. This is different in the United States. Houses and cars are bought with loans. Due to scattered residences and underdeveloped public transportation, many people cannot even guarantee a basic life without cars. Independent houses built in open fields may freeze to death in winter without sufficient energy. In the United States, the richest country in the world, the contradiction of unfair social distribution has become more acute in the long-term sluggish economic environment after the 2008 financial crisis. Rebellion is not exclusive to poor countries, and American people will rise up if they are forced to do nothing. What is strange is that financial elites like Lang Xianping who are studying in the United States avoid talking about the obvious social problems and their root causes in the United States, but they exaggerate the perfection of the American system everywhere in China. Watch Lang Xianping's speech at Tsinghua University, http://v.youku.com/v_show/id_XMjg3Njk5ODA=.html On the one hand, he quoted scriptures and described the current American society as being like paradise; on the other hand, he described China's 30 years of reforms as useless. What on earth is Lang Xianping doing? Former U.S. Ambassador to China Huntsman, who recently left office and returned to China to participate in the presidential election, and has been fighting on the front line of the "fight against the enemy" accidentally made a statement about the U.S. national strategy that can be done or not said. http://bbs.wforum.com/guns/bbsviewer.php?trd_id=149234 On November 15, he said during the presidential campaign: There is no need for the United States to fight a trade war with China. The United States must rely on "our allies and supporters within China" to bring down China. Only when China falls will the United States have a chance to regain its manufacturing industry.

7f3769835f8d34b8f527daa7a80c97420eaf83fd.sourceText: 在全球经济危机的大背景下，世界普遍看好和羡慕中国，但中国内部却莫名其妙地广泛弥漫着建国以来前所未有地失败主义情绪，这难道只是物价房价高涨，腐败长期得不到有效遏制滋长出的情绪吗？洪博培上述辩论等于直白地告诉那些不懂外交和美国国家战略的总统竞选者们，你们不懂得如何对付中国，推倒中国靠的不是贸易战，货币战，冷战，热战，靠的是5亿年轻的网民。要不是主持人打断洪博培的说辞，洪博培还不定如何显摆他这个中国通呢。洪博培的表白既是对自己在中国工作的肯定，又是对大大小小郎咸平们表彰。 当美国陷入制度性不公泥潭，产业结构性失衡难以自拔自救的时候，美国能做的就是让自己的盟国比自己更惨，敌国去死。一波又一波的欧元区财政危机，都离不开美国从中使坏的影子，而对于美国认定的头号竞争对手，必将是置之死地而后快。2011美国大部分重要的外交活动都是打着重返亚洲的旗号调动一切可以调动的力量对付中国。挑起中国周边国家围攻中国，在各种国际场合都忘不了逼人民币升值，尤为重要的是不惜血本地花巨大力气在中国和海外华人中培植”盟友和支持者”，从内部搞乱中国。美国目的就是奥巴马说的”美国永远不做老二”。只要中国，欧洲自乱阵脚，美国就达到不战而屈人之兵的目的，只有分裂了欧洲和中国，把世界变成除美国之外都是一盘散沙不团结的小国，美国才能永远保住世界老大的地位。 有一天中国跨了，美国保住世界老大的地位，郎咸平们，你们功不可没啊！ 其实可怕的不是有几个郎咸平，可怕是”党的喉舌”新华社竟如此报道洪博培言论：《美前驻华大使洪博培批美政客煽动反华情绪》： http://news.sina.com.cn/w/2011-11-16/093723474477.shtml 。真不知新华社的编导们如何从洪博培的只言片语中得这个结论的。中国许多媒体精英们：你们不是在美国有家有业的郎咸平，你们也不是美国公民，你们知道自己在做什么吗？
7f3769835f8d34b8f527daa7a80c97420eaf83fd.translatedText: Against the backdrop of the global economic crisis, the world is generally optimistic and envious of China, but within China there is an inexplicable and widespread defeatist sentiment unprecedented since the founding of the People's Republic of China. Is this just a sentiment fostered by rising prices and housing, and the long-term failure to effectively curb corruption? Huntsman's above-mentioned debate bluntly told those presidential candidates who do not understand diplomacy and US national strategy that they do not know how to deal with China. To bring down China does not rely on trade wars, currency wars, cold wars, or hot wars, but on 500 million young Internet users. If the host hadn't interrupted Huntsman's speech, Huntsman wouldn't have been able to show off his China expertise. Huntsman's confession is not only an affirmation of his work in China, but also a commendation to everyone, big and small. When the United States falls into the quagmire of systemic injustice and finds it difficult to extricate itself from structural imbalances in industry, all the United States can do is to make its allies worse off than itself and to let its enemies die. Wave after wave of financial crises in the Eurozone are inseparable from the shadow of the United States causing harm, and the top competitor identified by the United States will definitely be put to death quickly. Most of the important diplomatic activities of the United States in 2011 were to mobilize all available forces to deal with China under the banner of returning to Asia. It provokes China's neighboring countries to besiege China, and never forgets to force the RMB to appreciate on various international occasions. What is particularly important is that it spends huge efforts to cultivate "allies and supporters" among China and overseas Chinese at all costs, and disrupts China from within. The purpose of the United States is what Obama said: "The United States will never be the second best." As long as China and Europe are in disarray, the United States will achieve its goal of defeating others without a fight. Only by dividing Europe and China and turning the world into a fragmented and ununited small country, except the United States, can the United States forever maintain its position as the world's leader. One day, China is overthrown, and the United States retains its position as the world leader. Lang Xianping and others, you are indispensable! In fact, what is scary is not that there are a few Lang Xianpings, but that the "party mouthpiece" Xinhua News Agency reported Huntsman's remarks like this: "Former US Ambassador to China Huntsman criticized US politicians for inciting anti-China sentiment": http://news.sina.com.cn/w/2011-11-16/093723474477.shtml. I really don’t know how the editors and directors of Xinhua News Agency came to this conclusion from Huntsman’s few words. Many media elites in China: You are not Lang Xianping, who has a family and business in the United States, and you are not an American citizen. Do you know what you are doing?

cefb06f177d527c043f87ef7fd9e4a4e63f087bd.sourceText: 国会如不延长失业福利计划后果严重 欧巴马政府估计，如果国会不延长失业福利计划，2012年约有600万人领不到联邦政府的失业福利。 在失业率较高的州，联邦资金可保证失业者领取最多99个周的福利。 如果这项计画结束，新的失业者将只能依靠各州的失业福利，通常只提供26个周。 由于经济不好，失业福利已多次延长。 联邦失业福利能否延长尚不明朗，现已成为两党预算政策之争的焦点。 分析人士警告，取消给数百万失业者的福利金，将对复苏疲软的经济造成伤害。 华盛顿自由派的经济政策研究所负责人米歇尔说：「如果失业者没钱花，消费经济就将下滑。因此，失业福利是创造就业的有效手段之一。」分析人士估计，长期失业者 的福利金若不延长，将使国内生产总值减少0.3%。 但传统基金会等反对延长失业福利的组织认为，失业福利没起到刺激经济的作用，而是鼓励失业者继续寻找实际上并不存在的工作。 经济衰退期间丧失的工作，半数是在制造业和建筑业，其中的多数将不会重现。 传统基金会说，领取失业福利增加到99周，使失业率提高0.5%。 基金会的政策分析师舍克说：「失业者是找与以前类似的工作，但以前的工作已不复存在。因此在失业期间，他们的大部分时间是寻找不可能找到的工作。延长失业 福利的唯一正当理由，是其人道意义。」 在全国1330万失业者中，约43%失业27周以上。 乔治城大学教授霍尔泽说：「多数的长期失业者以前有很好的工作，但已永久丧失。如果他们的失业福利最终用光，该如何选择？」 许多专家认为，失业者的就业重新培训，尤其是建筑业和部分制造业的失业者，对年纪大的人没有必然帮助。 霍尔泽说，年逾50岁的失业者很难重返职场和培训，在55岁拿到新文凭，与25岁拿到毕竟不同。 部分长期失业者的最终结局，可能是找到收入较低的工作，但即使这样的工作也是供不应求，一个职位有4.6人竞争。 米歇尔说：「四名失业者就有三人没有工作机会，在当今劳动力市场，多数失业者是无论怎样努力，最终都将找不到工作。」
cefb06f177d527c043f87ef7fd9e4a4e63f087bd.translatedText: If Congress does not extend the unemployment benefit program, the consequences will be serious. The Obama administration estimates that if Congress does not extend the unemployment benefit program, about 6 million people will not receive unemployment benefits from the federal government in 2012. In states with higher unemployment rates, federal funds guarantee up to 99 weeks of benefits for unemployed people. If the program ends, newly unemployed people will have to rely on state unemployment benefits, which typically only provide 26 weeks. Unemployment benefits have been extended several times due to the bad economy. It is unclear whether federal unemployment benefits will be extended, and it has become a focus of the bipartisan budget policy battle. Analysts warn that canceling welfare benefits for millions of unemployed people will harm the economy as it recovers. Michel, director of the liberal Economic Policy Institute in Washington, said: "If the unemployed have no money to spend, the consumer economy will decline. Therefore, unemployment benefits are one of the effective means of creating jobs." Analysts estimate that if benefits for the long-term unemployed are not extended, GDP will decrease by 0.3%. However, organizations such as the Heritage Foundation that oppose the extension of unemployment benefits believe that unemployment benefits do not stimulate the economy but encourage the unemployed to continue looking for jobs that do not actually exist. Half of the jobs lost during the recession were in manufacturing and construction, and most of them will never come back. The Heritage Foundation said the increase in unemployment benefits to 99 weeks increased the unemployment rate by 0.5%. Shirk, a policy analyst at the foundation, said: "The unemployed are looking for jobs similar to those before, but the previous jobs no longer exist. Therefore, during the period of unemployment, they spend most of their time looking for jobs that are impossible to find. The only legitimate reason for extending unemployment benefits is its humanitarian significance." Among the 13.3 million unemployed people in the country, about 43% have been unemployed for more than 27 weeks. Holzer, a professor at Georgetown University, said: "Most of the long-term unemployed used to have good jobs, but they have lost them permanently. If their unemployment benefits eventually run out, what options should they choose?" Many experts believe that job retraining for the unemployed, especially in the construction industry and some manufacturing industries, will not necessarily help older people. Holzer said that it is difficult for unemployed people over the age of 50 to return to the workplace and get training. Obtaining a new diploma at the age of 55 is different from getting it at the age of 25. The ultimate outcome for some long-term unemployed may be to find lower-paying jobs, but even such jobs are in short supply, with 4.6 people competing for one position. Michel said: "Three out of four unemployed people have no job opportunities. In today's labor market, most unemployed people will eventually be unable to find a job no matter how hard they try."

6b4519498500d3c65a054faafe4ba82667925cbf.sourceText: 阿普：聚会杂感 吃喝玩乐
6b4519498500d3c65a054faafe4ba82667925cbf.translatedText: Apu: Miscellaneous thoughts about a party, eating, drinking, and having fun

ebc79ae7485639bf395a79ab23269386beeb8805.sourceText: 阿普：聚会杂感 吃喝玩乐 编者按：过节了，吃饱了，喝足了，觉得好像真少了点什么………
ebc79ae7485639bf395a79ab23269386beeb8805.translatedText: Apu: Miscellaneous feelings about a party, eating, drinking, and having fun Editor’s note: It’s the festival, I’m full, I’m full, I’ve had enough drink, I feel like something is missing...

d8edff1a8928d842a5ac0aee040e6cbedb999c34.sourceText: 编者按：过节了，吃饱了，喝足了，觉得好像真少了点什么……现在才恍然大悟，就是缺了这点文化味儿。陈普老师常常被称为教育家。什么是教育？就是抓住一分一秒，把生活中的行为和对下一代的影响联系在一起。教育的产生不仅在课堂，他应该像那句话”随风潜入夜 润物细无声”,存在于分分钟的生活里。感谢陈普老师送给华人朋友的新年大礼！
d8edff1a8928d842a5ac0aee040e6cbedb999c34.translatedText: Editor’s note: It’s the festival, I’m full, I’m full, I’ve had enough drink, I feel like something is missing… Only now do I suddenly realize that this cultural flavor is missing. Teacher Chen Pu is often called an educator. What is education? It is to seize every minute and connect the actions in life with the impact on the next generation. Education is not only produced in the classroom, it should exist in every minute of life like the saying "Sneak into the night with the wind and moisten things silently". Thank you Teacher Chen Pu for the New Year gift to our Chinese friends!

d7b9c03a3237a547f05f37f5256229ad2d410b33.sourceText: 自从年前的中秋节、感恩节开始，参加大小聚会二十来次。上周末过元宵节和情人节，再加上总统节，承蒙老友相约，接连又是三个晚宴聚会，好不热闹！晚上回家，因为多喝了些茶，思绪一直没有停下来。于是乎，坐到电脑前，顺手敲下些杂七杂八的感想，与诸友分享。
d7b9c03a3237a547f05f37f5256229ad2d410b33.translatedText: Since the Mid-Autumn Festival and Thanksgiving Day two years ago, I have attended more than 20 gatherings of various sizes. Last weekend we celebrated the Lantern Festival, Valentine's Day, and President's Day. Thanks to old friends, we had three dinner parties in succession. It was so lively! When I went home in the evening, my thoughts never stopped because I drank more tea. So, I sat down in front of the computer and typed out some miscellaneous thoughts to share with my friends.

35ebfd33f6e544fb2cebb7e1d57c015c23f12cb4.sourceText: 民以食为天。先说吃的。咱中国人的餐桌绝对称得上琳琅满目，色香味俱全。到过节时分，更是饕餮大餐。主人精心备下的丰盛菜肴显示了本家的美食品味和烹饪水平，来宾带来的热炒凉拌五花八门各展绝招。再谈喝的。茅台、五粮液、葡萄酒、豆浆、热茶、果汁，林林总总花样繁多。更有玩的。卡拉OK，扑克，麻将，海聊山侃，往往到午夜尚余兴未了。远离故乡的旧雨新知，平时忙于工作，节日里相邀聚会，济济一堂，其乐融融。
35ebfd33f6e544fb2cebb7e1d57c015c23f12cb4.translatedText: Food is the most important thing for people. Let’s talk about food first. Our Chinese dining table is absolutely dazzling, with all kinds of colors, flavors and tastes. During the festival, it’s even more of a feast. The sumptuous dishes carefully prepared by the host show the family's taste in food and cooking skills. The guests brought a variety of stir-fried and cold dishes, each showing their unique skills. Let’s talk about drinks. Moutai, Wuliangye, wine, soy milk, hot tea, juice, there are all kinds of varieties. More fun. Karaoke, poker, mahjong, and chatting all over the place are often not enough fun until midnight. Far away from my hometown, I am always busy with work, but during festivals, we are invited to gather together and have a great time together.

6e90dfa2a583c710f461221d4443d6bbefb632a8.sourceText: 咱中华民族的煌煌文明史逾四千年。单就”吃喝玩乐”而言的文化含量，就不简单。
6e90dfa2a583c710f461221d4443d6bbefb632a8.translatedText: The Chinese nation has a glorious civilization history of more than four thousand years. The cultural content of "eating, drinking and having fun" alone is not simple.

435f14cb949259000f0188be40a60d4270b93e38.sourceText: 鲁粤川湘闽浙苏徽八大菜系各领风骚，更有数不胜数的各地特色菜。大家若能在晚宴聚会时在每道菜肴上插个小小的标示牌，写出菜名，大厨名号，乃至特色等，那真是让人别开眼福。近来宴会上常见高手所制的蛋糕，色香味形俱全，美轮美奂。若配个标示牌，配上几句原创名言，岂不妙哉？近年来，华人在屋前屋后，种瓜点豆的不在少数。自家后院的原生态产品，标出诸如” 某大寨式实验田”及 贫下中富农地主名号之类，岂不有趣？还有一些行家，自制川味腊肉香肠，口感味觉远胜过从店里买来的那些品牌产品。记得有次春节聚会，品尝一道川味蒜苗炒腊肉，其名曰：”腊尽春回”。那真是色香味形”名”俱全，回味无穷呀。自种蒜苗和自制的腊肉，加上妙手烹调，真所谓，此菜只应本处有，世间哪得几回尝。美食还得美食家来欣赏，吃就得吃出与众不同的特色来。
435f14cb949259000f0188be40a60d4270b93e38.translatedText: > The eight major cuisines of Shandong, Guangdong, Sichuan, Hunan, Fujian, Zhejiang, Suzhou and Huizhou each lead the way, and there are countless specialties from various regions. It would be really eye-opening if you could put a small sign on each dish at a dinner party to write the name of the dish, the name of the chef, and even the characteristics. Recently, it is common to see cakes made by masters at banquets, which are full of color, flavor, shape and beauty. Wouldn’t it be nice to have a sign with a few original quotes? In recent years, there have been many Chinese planting melons and beans in front of and behind their houses. Wouldn’t it be interesting to label the original ecological products in your own backyard with labels such as “a certain Dazhai-style experimental field” and the names of poor, lower-middle-class and rich peasant landlords? There are also some connoisseurs who make homemade Sichuan-style bacon sausages that taste far better than those branded products bought from the store. I remember there was a Spring Festival party where we tasted a Sichuan-style fried bacon with garlic sprouts, which was called: "Spring comes back after the end of bacon." It's really full of color, flavor, shape and name, and has endless aftertaste. Home-grown garlic sprouts and homemade bacon, coupled with expert cooking, it is true that this dish should only be found in this place, and how many times in the world can you try it. Food must be appreciated by gourmets, and food must be unique.

45669f2019ebc81e21b9a19a4136960bb234de77.sourceText: ”酒文化”的提法历来已久。有的晚宴似乎是名酒展览。除了国之名酒外，还有外国之名酒，更稀罕的是家酿的青红酒。然而，见喝酒，劝酒，醉酒的多，国内国外都一样，司空见惯。倒很想见识体验一番咱泱泱大国地道的”酒文化”，也许算是某种梦想吧。李白斗酒诗百篇，今人醉酒可有诗？王羲之在” 微醺”之 际挥毫写就千古名作《兰亭序》。举杯邀月，曲水流觞。张颠怀素醉狂草，醉拳醉笔醉八仙。醉卧沙场君莫笑，貂裘换酒也堪豪。青梅煮酒论英雄，醉听清吟胜管弦。 把酒临风作赋，醉里挑灯看剑；等等，等等。从古至今，美酒轰轰烈烈地与无数文人雅士、英雄豪杰相随，又无声无息地放倒无数闻香则喜的各色人等。私下里觉得有了文化的氛围，吃酒才更有味道。
45669f2019ebc81e21b9a19a4136960bb234de77.translatedText: The term “wine culture” has been around for a long time. Some dinners seemed to be wine exhibitions. In addition to the famous national wines, there are also famous foreign wines, and even more rare is the home-brewed green and red wine. However, it is common both at home and abroad to see people drinking and being persuaded to drink, leading to drunkenness. I really want to see and experience the authentic "wine culture" of our huge country. Maybe it is some kind of dream. Li Bai wrote hundreds of poems about drinking wine. Can people today write poems when they are drunk? When Wang Xizhi was "slightly drunk", he wrote the eternal masterpiece "Lanting Preface" with a few strokes of a brush. Raise a cup to invite the moon, drink in the meandering water. Zhang Dianhuai was drunk with grass, drunk with fists and pens, and drunk with eight immortals. Don't laugh at me when you are lying drunk on the battlefield, even if you exchange mink fur for wine, you will be worthy of being rich. Discussing heroes while cooking wine with green plums, listening to the clear singing of the orchestra when drunk. Put wine in the wind as a gift, and read the sword while drunk; wait, wait. From ancient times to the present, fine wine has accompanied countless literati and heroes vigorously, and it has also quietly brought down countless people of all kinds who are delighted by its fragrance. Privately, I feel that having a cultural atmosphere makes eating and drinking more enjoyable.

102b83690537c6d64c5ee1dbaa0c34e5e7136601.sourceText: ”喝”，除了酒，还有许多令人称道的饮料。晚宴上，饮料显现”健商”。近几年来，市场上畅销的高糖高卡饮料已基本淡出了华人的家宴。取而代之的是各式健康饮料，如豆浆，花生浆，奶茶，果浆，菜汁，等等。各家自制的软饮料不断推陈出新，如柑橘，西瓜，草莓，酸枣，桑葚，等制成的新鲜果汁。茶饮在中国文化的地位是不言自明的。寒夜客来茶当酒，草木英华信有神。大餐后来点茶，除了消食助兴，还平添几分雅趣。酒阑更喜团茶苦，将如醉前岂堪夸。茶道与诗词、音乐、文史哲同行，相得益彰。品茗不同于牛饮，加点雅致的风味，多好!
102b83690537c6d64c5ee1dbaa0c34e5e7136601.translatedText: "Drink", in addition to wine, there are many praiseworthy drinks. At the dinner, the drinks showed "health quotient". In recent years, the best-selling high-sugar and high-calorie drinks on the market have basically faded out of Chinese family dinners. Instead, there are various healthy drinks, such as soy milk, peanut milk, milk tea, fruit pulp, vegetable juice, etc. Various homemade soft drinks are constantly being introduced, such as fresh juices made from citrus, watermelon, strawberry, jujube, mulberry, etc. The status of tea in Chinese culture is self-evident. On a cold night, guests come to drink tea and wine, and the beautiful plants and trees believe in the gods. After a big meal, ordering tea not only adds to the fun of digestion, but also adds a bit of elegance. The wine shop enjoys the bitter taste of Tuancha. It will be as good as it was before being drunk. Tea ceremony goes hand in hand with poetry, music, literature, history and philosophy, and complement each other. Drinking tea is different from drinking milk. How good it is to add some elegant flavor!

0ff7b64b6c13c780d20b893f700830655ce54406.sourceText: 晚宴除了吃喝，总得玩点什么。六点开始，大家一股脑装上满满的一盘菜肴，风卷残云一般，半小时过去，便直打饱嗝。虽说是天下没有不散的宴席，那残羹剩菜，杯盘狼藉又岂是办聚会晚宴的初衷？若是一到了八点钟，就起身打道回府，岂不没趣？大家平时忙这忙那，好不容易凑到一块，来一轮两轮八十点或几圈麻将，聊聊天，放松放松，挺好的。再有些朋友在一起谈天说地，海阔天空。从政治时局，股票房情，社会百态，人情世故，乃至柴米油盐，无拘无束侃大山，也算一乐。最忌的就是一桌子十来人，听众仅一二，其他全是清一色的高音喇叭。到头来，谁都不知谁在说啥，弄得说兴汹汹，听兴索然。若能给自己留点听和学的机会，给在行的朋友留点说的空间，那多好！
0ff7b64b6c13c780d20b893f700830655ce54406.translatedText: In addition to eating and drinking, there must be something to do at the dinner party. Starting at six o'clock, everyone loaded up a plate full of dishes, and it was like a storm. After half an hour, they started to hiccup. Although there is no such thing as a banquet in the world, how could the leftovers and messy dishes be the original intention of having a party dinner? Wouldn't it be boring to get up and go home as soon as eight o'clock arrives? Everyone is usually busy here and there, but it’s nice to finally get together and have a round, two rounds of eighty points or a few rounds of mahjong, chat and relax. There are some friends chatting together, the sea and the sky are bright. From the current political situation, stock and real estate conditions, various social trends, worldly feelings, and even daily necessities, talking about the world without restraint is considered a pleasure. The most taboo thing is that there are ten people at a table, only one or two listeners, and the rest are all tweeters. In the end, no one knew who was talking about what, making the conversation uninteresting and the listening uninteresting. It would be great if you could give yourself some opportunities to listen and learn, and give your knowledgeable friends some room to talk!

33a80d394d9ba7f7cbadb29fcdbcec4a23aa4a7b.sourceText: 朋友聚会，有点品位的玩法多得很。比如，有的人家即兴演奏乐器，独奏合奏皆宜，或对着卡拉OK吼几嗓子年轻时唱得上口的歌曲。大人孩子都来露一手，俨然就是个小型音乐会。也有拿与会朋友的名字编成谜语，当场猜谜。还有对对联，对诗，多少带点魏晋唐宋的遗风。还有人选了些比较有偏好的话题，例如，制作美食，栽花种菜，孩子教育，消闲旅游，运动养身，鉴赏玉石，摄影观鸟，书法绘画，等等。谈历史风云，论风流人物，指点江山，挥斥方遒。更有朋友拿出旅游摄影，艺术摄影，或新出的文艺作品与大家分享自己的感受和喜悦。陶陶然，静静然，大家交流知识经验，恰似一小沙龙。玩就玩出品位来。
33a80d394d9ba7f7cbadb29fcdbcec4a23aa4a7b.translatedText: There are many tasteful ways to play with friends when gathering together. For example, some people improvise on musical instruments, suitable for both solo and ensemble, or sing some catchy songs they sang in their youth at karaoke. Adults and children all came to show off their skills, and it was like a small concert. There are also riddles made up of the names of friends attending the meeting and guessing on the spot. There are also pairs of couplets and poems, which are somewhat reminiscent of the Wei, Jin, Tang and Song Dynasties. Others chose more preferred topics, such as making delicious food, growing flowers and vegetables, children's education, leisure travel, sports and health, appreciating jade, photography and bird watching, calligraphy and painting, etc. Talk about historical events, discuss famous figures, point out the country, and criticize Fang Qiu. Some friends even took out travel photography, art photography, or new literary and artistic works to share their feelings and joy with everyone. Tao Taoran, quietly, everyone exchanges knowledge and experience, just like a small salon. Just play with taste.

824d6c3c494b5a365a1c6532255012496611b0f3.sourceText: 谈到聚会的吃喝玩乐，还不得不谈一谈咱民族的一个重要传统–尊老爱幼。每次聚会，总能遇到有人偕老携幼阖家来聚，看了觉得特亲切。借这样的机会跟老人家聊聊，跟孩子们聊聊，是一种福缘。我总在想，如果每次聚会都能让老人谈谈自己的经历，谈谈有关文化的话题，哪怕是谈谈种菜、做菜、带孩子，那有多好。如果每次聚会都能让孩子们别玩电子游戏，积极参与主题活动，也让他们有机会向大家谈谈自己最切身的话题，甚至让他们来组织一部分活动，那有多好。家长、长辈的一言一行对孩子的影响是巨大的，尽管一时半时或许看不出来。栽什么树苗开什么花，撒什么种子结什么瓜。如果能借聚会的机会和孩子们一起猜谜，读诗，对对联，不正是为孩子的传统文化教育提供了最直接的环境吗？有文化、有品位的聚会散发的正能量是影响深远的。这正是入芝兰之室，潜移默化，陶冶性情。这才是文化传承的”好雨知时节”，”润物细无声”。
824d6c3c494b5a365a1c6532255012496611b0f3.translatedText: Talking about eating, drinking and having fun at the party, we also have to talk about an important tradition of our nation – respecting the old and loving the young. Every time we get together, we always meet people coming together with their families, old and young, and they feel very cordial. Taking this opportunity to chat with the elderly and the children is a blessing. I always think about how great it would be if every gathering could allow the elderly to talk about their own experiences and cultural topics, even if it was about growing vegetables, cooking, and raising children. How great would it be if every gathering could get the children to stop playing video games and actively participate in themed activities, and also give them the opportunity to talk to everyone about the topics that matter most to them, and even allow them to organize some of the activities. The words and deeds of parents and elders have a huge impact on children, although they may not be visible for a while. The saplings you plant will bloom, and the seeds you sow will produce melons. If you can take the opportunity of a party to guess riddles, read poems, and couplets with the children, wouldn’t it provide the most direct environment for children’s traditional cultural education? The positive energy emitted by a cultured and tasteful gathering has a far-reaching impact. This is exactly what it means to enter the room of Zhilan and cultivate your temperament in a subtle way. This is the cultural inheritance of "good rain knows the season" and "moistens things silently".

8bd25aa205cecf9140d331dcc4ec809c6cd911f5.sourceText: 独乐乐，何如众乐乐？乐有高低雅俗之别；乐能分享则更乐。乐在美食，当知食材的选择，营养的搭配， 荤素的平衡，食量的调控，进食的方式与时间，自身的需求，等等。乐在玩娱，当知方式的选择，玩友的搭配，度与量的平衡，时空的把握，自身的修养，等等。总之，大体摆正质与量以及时间的关系，就容易达到美学意义上的愉悦。与朋友同享乐趣，与长辈同享乐趣， 与孩子同享乐趣，达到大家同乐的境界。广而推之，使之成为一种风尚，引领整个社区的健康发展。
8bd25aa205cecf9140d331dcc4ec809c6cd911f5.translatedText: >How can it be better to have fun alone than to have fun together? There is a difference between high and low happiness; happiness is even more enjoyable when it can be shared. To enjoy delicious food, you should know the selection of ingredients, the combination of nutrition, the balance of meat and vegetables, the control of food intake, the way and time of eating, your own needs, etc. To enjoy playing, you should know the choice of method, the matching of playmates, the balance between size and quantity, the grasp of time and space, self-cultivation, etc. In short, if the relationship between quality, quantity and time is generally corrected, it will be easy to achieve aesthetic pleasure. Share the fun with your friends, your elders, your children, and achieve a state where everyone has fun together. Promote it widely and make it a trend, leading the healthy development of the entire community.

345070e321cf6b1db4fee3aea3bc84c4180f3b36.sourceText: 敬请大家今后在准备食物的同时，也把精神食粮准备好吧。马年来了，祝大家在新的一年里享受更多的高雅之乐！也祝我们的华人社区增添更多的亲情友情，更多的和谐美好！
345070e321cf6b1db4fee3aea3bc84c4180f3b36.translatedText: Please prepare spiritual food as well as food in the future. The Year of the Horse is here, and I wish you all enjoy more elegant happiness in the new year! I also wish our Chinese community to add more family and friendship, and more harmony and beauty!

ea0aa6f2ac30937eab0c1ca7b184cfc67c7527c2.sourceText: 放眼夜城灯万重。 山谷朦胧，道衢朦胧。 新朋旧友共邀觥。 月在杯中，情在杯中。
ea0aa6f2ac30937eab0c1ca7b184cfc67c7527c2.translatedText: Look at the night city with all the lights. The valley is hazy and the road is hazy. New and old friends are invited to have a toast together. The moon is in the cup, love is in the cup.

2c8df74887d18a2798b5cbcbaffb68f315051652.sourceText: 今天（31日）的北京天气成了大杂烩，雾霾未散，雨雪又起，且混杂着冰粒和冻雨，导致路面湿滑，加上能见度很差，对交通影响很大。目前京承高速发生数十起车祸，机场高速双向约50辆车连环车祸。
2c8df74887d18a2798b5cbcbaffb68f315051652.translatedText: The weather in Beijing today (31st) turned into a mixed bag. The smog has not dispersed, rain and snow have started again, and are mixed with ice particles and freezing rain, making the road surface slippery and visibility is very poor, which has a great impact on traffic. There are currently dozens of car accidents on the Beijing-Chengdu Expressway, and a series of car accidents involving about 50 vehicles in both directions on the Airport Expressway.

411bd13c2a9dcd33c2f310d71cbf5535ef991f26.sourceText: 今晨08时，北京朝阳、丰台等部分地区出现冻雨，其他地区以雪或雨夹雪为主。据北京市气象台统计，30日20时至31日8时，北京降水较均匀，全市平均在0.1毫米，最大为海淀区凤凰岭0.5毫米。
411bd13c2a9dcd33c2f310d71cbf5535ef991f26.translatedText: At 08:00 this morning, freezing rain occurred in some areas such as Chaoyang and Fengtai in Beijing, while other areas were dominated by snow or sleet. According to statistics from the Beijing Meteorological Observatory, from 20:00 on the 30th to 8:00 on the 31st, precipitation in Beijing was relatively uniform, with an average of 0.1 mm in the city, and a maximum of 0.5 mm in Phoenix Ridge, Haidian District.

3f30095886fb69bf57cf5d42733eb2e75d9460fa.sourceText: 北京复杂的天气给交通带来了十分不利的影响。据微博网友反映，由于北京雾霾不散，能见度差，加上路面相当滑，车辆易打滑，京承高速已发生数十起车祸，机场高速双向约有50辆车连环车祸。
3f30095886fb69bf57cf5d42733eb2e75d9460fa.translatedText: >Beijing’s complicated weather has had a very negative impact on traffic. According to Weibo netizens, due to the lingering smog in Beijing, poor visibility, and the slippery road surface, vehicles are prone to skidding. Dozens of car accidents have occurred on the Jingcheng Expressway, and about 50 vehicles have been involved in a series of car accidents in both directions on the Airport Expressway.

a3c69414d936cd8e84e1fdfae7895d74164011d4.sourceText: 降水量不大，路面也并未有明显积雪，为何路面如此湿滑？据北京市专业气象台专家介绍，由于低层存在明显的逆温层，形成的雾霾天气阻碍夜间气温下降，致使今天早间北京各地降水相态不同，雨夹雪、雪、冰粒及冻雨夹杂出现，虽然路面没有明显积雪，但地表温度处于零下，落地结冰，路面十分湿滑。
a3c69414d936cd8e84e1fdfae7895d74164011d4.translatedText: There is not much precipitation, and there is no obvious snow on the road. Why is the road so slippery? According to experts from the Beijing Professional Meteorological Observatory, due to the obvious temperature inversion layer in the lower levels, the haze formed prevents the temperature from falling at night, resulting in different precipitation phases across Beijing this morning. A mixture of sleet, snow, ice particles and freezing rain appeared. Although there was no obvious snow on the road, the surface temperature was below zero, and ice formed on the ground, making the road very slippery.

856ec6a8afc551452770fe404194c7199e37220d.sourceText: 对此，北京市气象台今天08时发布道路结冰黄色预警信号：目前大部分地区已出现降水，且地表气温低于0℃，道路将出现结冰现象，请注意防范。
856ec6a8afc551452770fe404194c7199e37220d.translatedText: In this regard, the Beijing Meteorological Observatory issued a yellow warning signal for road icing at 08:00 today: Precipitation has already occurred in most areas, and the surface temperature is below 0°C. Ice will appear on the roads, so please pay attention to precautions.

cfc29f51256fd3c39996b69c7910d94a727b7864.sourceText: 据北京市气象台预报，今天白天全市阴有小雪，并有雾霾。天气对交通影响较大，提醒大家驾车慢行，保持安全车距，老人小孩尽量减少外出，外出做好防滑措施。
cfc29f51256fd3c39996b69c7910d94a727b7864.translatedText: According to the forecast from the Beijing Meteorological Observatory, there will be light snow and haze in the city during the day today. The weather has a great impact on traffic. We remind everyone to drive slowly and keep a safe distance between cars. The elderly and children should try to avoid going out as much as possible and take anti-skid measures when going out.

5d15d5d2757d04b5f1d9a0e3883bc0a05474082c.sourceText: 冻雨是由过冷水滴组成，与温度低于0℃的物体碰撞立即冻结的降水，是初冬或冬末春初时节见到的一种灾害性天气。
5d15d5d2757d04b5f1d9a0e3883bc0a05474082c.translatedText: Freezing rain is composed of supercooled water droplets that freeze immediately upon collision with objects with a temperature below 0°C. It is a disastrous weather seen in early winter or late winter and early spring.

7dd9a8d1af1e3ff8e6de609233411c2a92534765.sourceText: 低于0℃的雨滴在温度略低于0℃的空气中能够保持过冷状态，其外观同一般雨滴相同，当它落到温度为0℃以下的物体上时，立刻冻结成外表光滑而透明的冰层，称为雨凇。
7dd9a8d1af1e3ff8e6de609233411c2a92534765.translatedText: Raindrops below 0℃ can remain supercooled in air with a temperature slightly below 0℃. Their appearance is the same as ordinary raindrops. When it falls on an object with a temperature below 0℃, it immediately freezes into a smooth and transparent layer of ice, called raindrops.

6a1a65361b9d573dfa265c6ae47c063a4d5f5320.sourceText: 严重的雨凇会压断树木、电线杆，使通讯、供电中止，妨碍公路和铁路交通，威胁飞机的飞行安全。
6a1a65361b9d573dfa265c6ae47c063a4d5f5320.translatedText: Severe rainstorms can break trees and telephone poles, interrupt communications and power supply, hinder highway and railway transportation, and threaten the safety of aircraft flights.

137fee92e078c0fee3187c794e7c66f0096e734d.sourceText: 金信地产新闻：有限的房源导致亚利桑那房价继续攀升 8月凤凰城独立屋的中值价格已经上涨到了$150,000。 比去年同期上涨了33.7%。于此同时，新房的销售上升了55%。 二手房正常销售（不包括倒卖屋，短售屋和破产屋）8月的销售量比去年同期上涨了81%。图桑8月房屋销售比去年上升了24%，价格上涨了16.3%。最近图桑中值价格为$180,193. ASU 凯利商学院的专家们表示，最近的价格与2005年和2006年相比还相差很多。他们说市场正在逐渐恢复中。根据ASU房地产市场的月报，8月的房源比去年同期下降了28%。房源的下降是导致价格上升的原因。还有一小部分房主还在等待价格继续上涨，才卖手中的房屋。目前大量的需求和有限的供给在市场上表现突出。凤凰城的新房库存量，也只为2011年的一半。新房库存量的上涨还需要一段时间，这也将导致买家的竞价，使价格上升。更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的Tinna (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
137fee92e078c0fee3187c794e7c66f0096e734d.translatedText: Jinxin Real Estate News: Limited housing supply causes Arizona housing prices to continue to rise The median price of a single-family home in Phoenix rose to $150,000 in August. It increased by 33.7% compared with the same period last year. At the same time, sales of new homes rose 55%. Normal sales of second-hand houses (excluding flip houses, short-sale houses and bankrupt houses) in August increased by 81% compared with the same period last year. Tucson home sales in August were up 24% from last year, and prices were up 16.3%. The recent median price in Tucson was $180,193. Experts at ASU's Kelley School of Business say recent prices are far from where they were in 2005 and 2006. They say the market is gradually recovering. According to the ASU Real Estate Market Monthly Report, listings in August were down 28% from the same period last year. The decline in listings is responsible for the rise in prices. There are also a small number of homeowners who are still waiting for prices to continue to rise before selling their homes. Massive demand and limited supply currently dominate the market. The inventory of new homes in Phoenix is ​​only half of what it was in 2011. It will take some time for the inventory of new homes to increase, which will also lead to bidding from buyers, pushing prices up. For more information about real estate, please contact Tinna of Goldtrust Realty (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
