49547a0994b6084c6ab6c7d3141961063b105327.sourceText: (侨联通讯)中华小姐环球大赛（美洲赛区）总决赛，将于2014年8月10日下午，在美国亚利桑那州凤凰城野马赌场酒店拉开帷幕。这是中华小姐环球大赛首次在亚省举办，大凤凰城地区侨联总会对此表示热烈的欢迎和衷心的祝贺！ 由凤凰卫视主办的＂中华小姐环球大赛＂今年已进入第十年。历年来，中华小姐比赛是世界选美的一大盛事。参加遴选的佳丽要求高学历、高水准和高品味，而选出来的冠亚季军更是出类拔萃，才貌超群。凤凰卫视每年用不同的主题来培训佳丽，节目製作也是匠心独运。今年选择到亚利桑那州进行，是看中美西独特的地理风貌和历史背景，并溶入印地安的人文艺术元素，将打造出一台热情、浪漫、神祕的选美赛事。 中华小姐环球大赛美洲决赛场地野马赌场（Wild Horse Pass Hotel & Casino)，是在亚省新建的的大赌场，由印地安人经营，位于钱得勒市(Chandler)以南与10号州际公路交界处，建筑风格宏伟，週边环境优美，除赌场外还建有现代化大剧院，舞台设计独特、灯光音响设备精良，将会给观众带来惊艳和美仑美奂的视觉享受。 凤凰城侨联总会去年已和凤凰卫视初步商议有关中华小姐选美事宜，并邀请凤凰卫视工作小组到亚利桑那州北部作景点巡游。经过数月的协商，凤凰城侨联总会现已成为中华小姐环球大赛（美洲赛区）的赞助单位和协办单位，将统筹票务方面的工作。侨联总会还将举办一场赛前文艺晚会，邀请凤凰卫视及中华小姐美洲区历届才艺小姐做表演嘉宾，并与本地文艺界的精英同台献技，时间定于8月9日晚举办，节目精彩可期。 庆祝美国国庆和举办凤凰城小姐选美，是侨联总会历年来的传统活动，今年因举办中华小姐环球大赛美洲赛事，庆祝活动将分开两个日期和两个地点来进行，7月4日的美国国庆活动将在Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints举行，地址：3920 N. 44St Place Phoenix AZ，免费入场及赠送午餐，有多项文体活动举办。 8月9日晚的文艺表演和8月10日下午的中华小姐环球大赛美洲区决赛，将在野马赌场酒店大剧院进行，需凭票进场。 本年度侨联的＂国庆特刊＂将照常出版。为了感谢侨界和社团历年来的大力支持，连年捐赠和刊登广告，让庆祝和选美活动得以顺利进行，侨联决定，凡今年在＂国庆特刊＂上刊登广告的单位和个人，不论新老客户，都将获得8月9日晚表演、8月10日晚选美决赛两个晚上的入场券。由于大赛面向全州的观众，所以仍将有少量8月9日晚的文艺演出入场券出售，购买者将获买一送一的优惠同时获得8月10日晚选美决赛的入场赠券，多买多赠。由于剧院座位有限，恕不免费送票。具体方法请留意侨联的后续报导。 如有佳丽要报名参加中华小姐环球大赛（美洲 赛区）选拔，请登陆下面网址查询： miss.ifengus.com 报名截止日期：2014年7月6日
49547a0994b6084c6ab6c7d3141961063b105327.translatedText: (Overseas Chinese Federation Communications) The finals of the Miss Chinese Universe Contest (American Division) will kick off on the afternoon of August 10, 2014, at the Wild Horse Casino Hotel in Phoenix, Arizona, USA. This is the first time that the Miss China Universe competition has been held in Alberta. The Greater Phoenix Area Overseas Chinese Federation would like to extend its warm welcome and heartfelt congratulations! The "Miss China Universe" hosted by Phoenix TV has entered its tenth year this year. Over the years, the Miss China competition has been a major beauty pageant event in the world. The beauties participating in the selection are required to have high education, high standards and good taste, and the first, second and third runners-up selected are even more outstanding, with outstanding talent and appearance. Phoenix TV uses different themes to train beauties every year, and the program production is also unique. This year we chose Arizona to hold the contest because of the unique geographical features and historical background of the Central and Western United States, and the integration of Indian humanistic and artistic elements to create a passionate, romantic and mysterious beauty pageant. The Wild Horse Pass Hotel & Casino, the venue for the American finals of the Miss Chinese Universe Contest, is a newly built large casino in Alberta. It is run by Indians and is located south of Chandler at the junction of Interstate 10. It has a magnificent architectural style and beautiful surrounding environment. In addition to the casino, there is also a modern grand theater with unique stage design and sophisticated lighting and sound equipment, which will bring stunning and beautiful visual enjoyment to the audience. The Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation had preliminary discussions with Phoenix TV about the Miss China beauty pageant last year and invited the Phoenix TV working group to tour the scenic spots in northern Arizona. After several months of negotiations, the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation has now become the sponsor and co-organizer of the Miss Chinese Universe Contest (American Division) and will coordinate the ticketing work. The Overseas Chinese Federation will also hold a pre-match cultural evening, inviting all previous talents from Phoenix TV and Miss China America as guest performers, and will perform on the same stage with elites from the local literary and art circles. It is scheduled to be held on the evening of August 9th. The program is exciting to look forward to. Celebrating the National Day of the United States and hosting the Miss Phoenix beauty pageant are traditional activities over the years by the Overseas Chinese Federation. This year, due to the hosting of the Miss Chinese Universe Americas competition, the celebrations will be held on two dates and two locations. The National Day event on July 4 will be held at Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints, address: 3920 N. 44St Place Phoenix AZ. Admission is free and lunch is provided. A number of cultural and sports activities will be held. The artistic performance on the evening of August 9th and the American finals of the Miss China Universe contest on the afternoon of August 10th will be held at the Grand Theater of the Wild Horse Casino Hotel, and tickets are required to enter the venue. This year's "National Day Special Issue" of the Overseas Chinese Federation will be published as usual. In order to thank the overseas Chinese community and associations for their strong support over the years, donations and advertisements year after year, so that the celebration and beauty pageant can go smoothly, the Overseas Chinese Federation has decided that all units and individuals who advertise in the "National Day Special Issue" this year, regardless of new and old customers, will receive tickets for the performance on the evening of August 9th and the beauty pageant finals on the evening of August 10th. Since the competition is open to audiences across the state, there will still be a small number of tickets for the theatrical performance on the evening of August 9th. Buyers will receive a buy-one-get-one-free discount and will also receive admission tickets to the beauty pageant finals on the evening of August 10th. The more you buy, the more you get. Due to limited theater seating, no free tickets will be given. Please pay attention to the follow-up reports of the Overseas Chinese Federation for specific methods. If any beauties want to register for the Miss Chinese Global Competition (American Division), please log on to the following website to inquire: miss.ifengus.com Registration deadline: July 6, 2014

ac6e82912a168eefe4c0d803c5a8117a6a3ba580.sourceText: 荣获“南暝出版基金”赞助心水诗集“三月骚动”出版 亚省时报 荣获2010年度雪梨「南溟出版基金」评选出的年度赞助出版著作，是墨尔本诗人心水的「三月骚动」；据悉该出版基金自成立以来，首次赞助诗作的出版。这部诗集收录的150首诗作，是诗人在其300余篇诗稿中选出；共分八辑、总行数达到3121行，超越了征稿要求的三千行。 台湾秀威信息公司继为心水出版了「怒海惊魂30日」这部长篇小说后，再次与心水签订合约、于七月中旬出版了「三月骚动」这部被「南溟出版基金」入选的诗集。 发行后在台湾各大网络、书局皆抄录该书封背刊印对此诗集的介绍如下: 「 为诗人心水的第二部诗集，澳洲南溟出版基金评审委员会对这本入选2010年度著作一书的评语为 全书分为山水、岁月、亲情、花鸟、时事、红尘、汉俳及江湖等八辑，是定居澳洲墨尔本的诗人心水用感性的诗观，所描绘出的多彩人生。其中所收的汉俳与武侠诗是诗人的新创作经验，令读者耳目一新并充满了阅读惊喜。」 南溟出版基金将于十月在雪梨、为这部诗集举办新书发布会，时间与地点将另行通告。届时、诗人心水将到雪梨与作家、诗人及广大读者们见面交流。 墨尔本华侨团体庆祝辛亥革命成功百周年的系列活动，将为「世界华文作家交流协会」秘书长心水，为其长篇著作「怒海惊魂30日」举行隆重发布会，日期地点如下: 8月21日星期日下午二时半，假「墨尔本社团联合服务中心」(Suite 4,26 Rutland Road Box Hill Vic.3128 )。主办人中华青年会刘彪总教练、经于近日发出邀函予有关团体、侨领及作家文友们。 「三月骚动」诗集、「怒海惊魂30日」长篇小说，每册20元，澳洲境内邮寄每本加五元邮资。连系电话: (03) 9569 1472 或电邮「世界华文作家交流协会」 xinshuiwong@gmail.com 墨尔本发布会查询:刘彪 9897 3688 或 0411 380 545
ac6e82912a168eefe4c0d803c5a8117a6a3ba580.translatedText: Won the "Nanming Publishing Fund" to sponsor the publication of his favorite poetry collection "March Riots". The Alberta Times won the 2010 "Nanming Publishing Fund" in Sydney to win the annual sponsored publication of "March Riots", a favorite of Melbourne poets. It is reported that this publishing fund has sponsored the publication of poetry for the first time since its establishment. The 150 poems included in this poetry collection were selected by the poet from more than 300 poem manuscripts; they are divided into eight series, with a total of 3,121 lines, exceeding the 3,000 lines required for submissions. After publishing the novel "30 Days of Fury" for Xinshui, Taiwan Xiuwei Information Company signed a contract with Xinshui again and published "March Riot", a poetry collection selected by the "Nanming Publishing Fund", in mid-July. After its release, it was copied on the back cover of the book and printed in all major Internet and bookstores in Taiwan. The introduction to this collection of poems is as follows: "This is the poet's second collection of poems. The review committee of the Australian Nanming Publishing Fund reviewed this book, which was selected as a 2010 book. The book is divided into eight volumes, including landscapes, years, family love, flowers and birds, current affairs, world of mortals, Chinese haiku and rivers and lakes. It is a poet who lives in Melbourne, Australia, and depicts the colorful life with his emotional poetry. The Chinese haiku and martial arts poems included in it are the poet's new creative experience, which are refreshing and full of reading surprises. " Nanming Publishing Foundation will hold a new book launch party for this poetry collection in Sydney in October. The time and location will be announced separately. By then, the poet's thoughts will come to Sydney to meet and communicate with writers, poets and readers. The series of activities held by overseas Chinese groups in Melbourne to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the successful Revolution of 1911 will hold a grand launch party for the secretary-general of the "World Chinese Writers Exchange Association" and his book "30 Days of Rage". The date and location are as follows: Sunday, August 21, at 2:30 pm, at the "Melbourne Joint Service Center" (Suite 4, 26 Rutland Road Box Hill Vic. 3128). The organizer, Coach Liu Biao of the Chinese Youth Association, has recently sent invitations to relevant groups, overseas Chinese leaders and writers and literary friends. "March Riot" poetry collection and "30 Days of Fury" novel, each volume is NT$20, plus postage of NT$5 per volume within Australia. Contact number: (03) 9569 1472 or email "World Chinese Writers Exchange Association" xinshuiwong@gmail.com Melbourne press conference inquiry: Liu Biao 9897 3688 or 0411 380 545

d89136ef07a3fb50dd8c3ed40041a12cfb7781e1.sourceText: 沙漠明珠 | 美国亚利桑那州华人历史（五十三）第四章：四个华人家族的历史
d89136ef07a3fb50dd8c3ed40041a12cfb7781e1.translatedText: Pearl of the Desert | Chinese History in Arizona, USA (53) Chapter 4: The History of Four Chinese Families

b89fad76a2feb377ea000942febf8012ec113161.sourceText: 亚利桑那华人历史协会：张肇鸿 邓楷隆家族（5） 邓楷隆的第三个儿子邓粤钿（HenryOng)，于1923年出生…
b89fad76a2feb377ea000942febf8012ec113161.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association: Zhang Zhaohong and Deng Kailong families (5) Deng Kailong's third son, Deng Yuetian (HenryOng), was born in 1923...

a14e471ef91d117b86258973e967a591d3c4075d.sourceText: 邓楷隆的第三个儿子邓粤钿（HenryOng)，于1923年出生于美国凤凰城。 1928年，重视中国传统文化教育的父亲将邓粤钿及兄弟送回国读书。邓粤钿就读于广州国立中山大学附中，初三时由于中国抗日战争爆发回到美国。
a14e471ef91d117b86258973e967a591d3c4075d.translatedText: Deng Kailong's third son, Deng Yuetian (HenryOng), was born in Phoenix, USA in 1923. In 1928, his father, who valued traditional Chinese culture and education, sent Deng Yuedian and his brothers back to China to study. Deng Yuedian studied at the High School Affiliated to National Sun Yat-sen University in Guangzhou. When he was in his third year of junior high school, he returned to the United States due to the outbreak of the Anti-Japanese War in China.

e0ba9c0c45018c7292ba7eebd61a446159053974.sourceText: 1942年，日本轰炸美国珍珠港，二次大战爆发。 邓粤钿应徵入伍加入美国空军。他在新墨西哥州的阿拉莫戈多空军基地作最后的训练后，被派往英国，分配到第487轰炸大队的837轰炸中队，驻扎于伦敦南部。B-24是当时的重型轰炸机，机上有多达9位的空军人员联合操作。他们常在夜间执行任务，通常要持续飞行8〜10小时深入敌方轰炸。一次，B-24被德国防空炮火击中，失去了一个发动机。由于飞回自己的基地距离相当远，他们原打算飞往就近的瑞士。二战期间瑞士是中立国家，任何盟军士兵登陆瑞士不会交给德国人，但也不得不呆在那里待到战争结束为止。他们决定不飞瑞士，冒险花了更多的时间飞回英格兰，以便重返战埸。
e0ba9c0c45018c7292ba7eebd61a446159053974.translatedText: In 1942, Japan bombed Pearl Harbor in the United States, and World War II broke out. Deng Yuetian enlisted in the U.S. Air Force. After his final training at Alamogordo Air Force Base in New Mexico, he was sent to the United Kingdom and assigned to the 837th Bomb Squadron of the 487th Bomb Group, stationed south of London. The B-24 was a heavy bomber of the day and was operated jointly by up to nine Air Force personnel. They often perform missions at night and usually have to fly for 8 to 10 hours to bombard the enemy deeply. Once, the B-24 was hit by German anti-aircraft fire and lost an engine. Since it was quite a distance to fly back to their base, they originally planned to fly to nearby Switzerland. Switzerland was a neutral country during World War II. Any Allied soldiers who landed in Switzerland would not be handed over to the Germans, but they would have to stay there until the end of the war. They decided not to fly to Switzerland and took the risk of spending more time flying back to England in order to return to the battlefield.

056ac110a1333faf22ee3afb12cf266922cd98bd.sourceText: 邓粤钿参加过著名的诺曼底战役。后来，他们派往B-17轰炸机去参与战斗。 1944年8月6日，邓粤钿执行第30次任务，轰炸德国柏林的发动机工厂，这次任务完成后，他们就可返回美国进行整编。当炸弹投中目标后，轰炸机却不幸被炮火击中，飞机急坠，机组人员奉命跳伞，但所有士兵被德军所俘。邓粤钿身上有弹片、多处割伤和瘀伤。战友爱德华. 赖歇尔受伤最严重，但因为是犹太血统，德国拒绝为他治疗，结果第二天他就死了。
056ac110a1333faf22ee3afb12cf266922cd98bd.translatedText: Deng Yuedian participated in the famous Battle of Normandy. Later, they sent B-17 bombers to participate in the battle. On August 6, 1944, Deng Yuedian carried out his 30th mission to bomb the engine factory in Berlin, Germany. After this mission was completed, they could return to the United States for reorganization. When the bomb hit the target, the bomber was unfortunately hit by artillery fire. The plane crashed and the crew was ordered to parachute, but all the soldiers were captured by the Germans. Deng Yuetian had shrapnel, multiple cuts and bruises on her body. Comrade Edward Reicher was the most seriously injured, but because he was of Jewish descent, Germany refused to treat him, and he died the next day.

1ba776ea1befaceb0f689b1ecc6ea4eb1666e033.sourceText: 邓粤钿被送往东部一个俘虏营，两厢车中挤满战俘，他们几乎没有任何食物和水，受尽拆磨。 1945年2月，为逃避苏军的攻势，德国人决定步行迁移整个战俘营。邓粤钿与超过一万人的战俘开始了“死亡之旅”，步行了一千英里，从德国东走到西部。因战况不利德军，整个俘虏营又从西部再折返回东部。他们足足步行了一百多天，时值冬天，沿途有不少战俘死于冻饿与疾病，他虽大难不死，却受尽磨难。 1945年5月4日，邓粤钿被英军救出，重获自由。
1ba776ea1befaceb0f689b1ecc6ea4eb1666e033.translatedText: Deng Yuedian was sent to a prison camp in the east. The hatchback was packed with prisoners of war. They had almost no food and water and were tortured. In February 1945, in order to escape the Soviet offensive, the Germans decided to move the entire prisoner of war camp on foot. Deng Yuedian and more than 10,000 prisoners of war began a "death journey" and walked a thousand miles from east to west Germany. Because the war situation was unfavorable to the German army, the entire prisoner camp turned back from the west to the east. They walked for more than a hundred days, and it was winter. Many prisoners of war died of cold, hunger and disease along the way. Although he survived, he suffered a lot. On May 4, 1945, Deng Yuetian was rescued by the British army and regained his freedom.

04d068bb0beb70ab91271edd5d599f64e040d2f9.sourceText: 邓粤钿是亚利桑那州唯一被俘虏的华裔美国人。为表彰他参与在欧洲大陆重大的空袭行动。被授予紫心勋章、战争先锋勋章等多枚奖章。邓粤钿于1945年10月退役。
04d068bb0beb70ab91271edd5d599f64e040d2f9.translatedText: Deng Yuetian was the only Chinese American captured in Arizona. In recognition of his participation in major air raids on the European continent. He was awarded the Purple Heart Medal, War Vanguard Medal and many other medals. Deng Yuetian retired from the army in October 1945.

26bb94e0ec16064759c3d9d989d5d404264cfb8f.sourceText: 退役后，邓粤钿曾就读于加州大学洛杉矶分校，在那里他遇到未来新娘Priscilla (Pat) Fong。他们在1947 年结婚，婚后育有四个孩子。
26bb94e0ec16064759c3d9d989d5d404264cfb8f.translatedText: After retiring, Deng Yuedian studied at the University of California, Los Angeles, where he met his future bride, Priscilla (Pat) Fong. They married in 1947 and had four children.

c6a6137805ffbd717611f29fc80e983274dac1ee.sourceText: 邓粤钿服务社会贡献良多，他担任过美国前战俘副指挥官，也是美国军团 Thomas Tang 50 的创始成员和指挥官。2005年，他入选亚利桑那州退伍军人名人堂（全州只有三名华人）。
c6a6137805ffbd717611f29fc80e983274dac1ee.translatedText: Deng Yuetian has made great contributions to the society. He served as the deputy commander of the former American prisoners of war and was also a founding member and commander of the American Legion Thomas Tang 50. In 2005, he was inducted into the Arizona Veterans Hall of Fame (there are only three Chinese Americans in the state).

847e2689dee9c0aba20254873430fd994be58b2d.sourceText: 市长Phil Gordon向邓粤钿颁奖
847e2689dee9c0aba20254873430fd994be58b2d.translatedText: >Mayor Phil Gordon presented the award to Deng Yuedian

b6963467e73ffb504bed41b9b472275ef9a9fec7.sourceText: 为表彰邓粤钿在二次大战的贡献，2007年，凤凰城市长菲尔·戈登(Phil Gordon) ，把1月16日特定为＂邓粤钿日＂。
b6963467e73ffb504bed41b9b472275ef9a9fec7.translatedText: In recognition of Deng Yuedian's contribution to World War II, in 2007, Phoenix Mayor Phil Gordon designated January 16 as "Deng Yuedian Day".

2123b3a748ac1fdd4c08ca97f89778d53b573262.sourceText: 邓粤钿夫妇是第一华人浸信会的活跃成员，多年来担任主日学教师。积极参与基甸国际圣经事工，在皇家棕榈浸信会教堂担任执事。
2123b3a748ac1fdd4c08ca97f89778d53b573262.translatedText: >Deng Yuetian and his wife are active members of the First Chinese Baptist Church and have served as Sunday school teachers for many years. Actively involved in Gideon International Bible Ministries and serving as a deacon at Royal Palm Baptist Church.

275812adb3dcadfe1efb859ff543693bf341d1dd.sourceText: 邓粤钿先生关心华人社会，服务华人社区，曾担任邓高密公所主席，中华商会主席等职务。他是邓高密公所农历新年宴会的常任司仪，直到他90岁之后。他对家乡也一往情深，多次回家乡探亲，并捐助美金4000元为家乡永安里兴建村前牌楼。
275812adb3dcadfe1efb859ff543693bf341d1dd.translatedText: Mr. Deng Yuedian cares about and serves the Chinese community. He has served as chairman of Deng Gaomi Office and chairman of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce. He was the permanent master of ceremonies for the Lunar New Year banquet of Deng Gaomi's office until after he was 90 years old. He also had a deep love for his hometown. He went back to his hometown many times to visit relatives and donated US$4,000 to build a village archway in Yong'anli, his hometown.

e94c9184d457744760904eabf56be7f2a93d8eb1.sourceText: 邓粤钿尽管远离祖居，身处美国，不论子孙后人是否会明白传承族谱的意义，他毅然地把编写族谱视为己任，因为他曾回国受过中华文化的薰陶，对故乡的一往深情，对自己宗族千百年的忠诚和敬畏，他尽心尽力去把族谱加以延续。中华民族之所以能够源远流长，叶茂根深，始终有著这样一群不忘祖典、承前启后的炎黄子孙！
e94c9184d457744760904eabf56be7f2a93d8eb1.translatedText: Although Deng Yuedian is far away from his ancestral home and is in the United States, regardless of whether his descendants will understand the significance of inheriting the genealogy, he resolutely regards compiling the genealogy as his own responsibility. The reason why the Chinese nation has a long history and deep roots is that it has always had a group of descendants of Yan and Huang who have not forgotten their ancestors and inherited the past and the future!

c4304c77fc15f49f28551734ba1bf35586c7e6d7.sourceText: 多年来，邓粤钿先生一直在帮助我研究本地华人历史，他阅历丰富，九十多岁仍记忆良好，对凤凰城的人文信息，华人社团历史的方方面面，都提供了的不少资料。
c4304c77fc15f49f28551734ba1bf35586c7e6d7.translatedText: Over the years, Mr. Deng Yuetian has been helping me research local Chinese history. He has rich experience and still has a good memory in his nineties. He has provided a lot of information on the humanistic information of Phoenix City and all aspects of the history of Chinese associations.

9f7f19c3d0b3d319033c60f3a9ef4b36fa46cf84.sourceText: 2015年，世界反法西斯和抗战胜利70周年纪念，我再次採访93歲的邓粤钿前辈。他穿上了在二战时期的美国空军制服，依然有著军人的威武和荣耀，令人肃然起敬！
9f7f19c3d0b3d319033c60f3a9ef4b36fa46cf84.translatedText: In 2015, commemorating the 70th anniversary of the victory of the world’s anti-fascist and anti-Japanese war, I once again interviewed the 93-year-old senior Deng Yuedian. He put on the U.S. Air Force uniform from World War II, and still had the majesty and glory of a soldier, which is awe-inspiring!

19563094daddba47c4b15247c19a791be2784d91.sourceText: 鄧粵鈿二戰中的空軍戎裝
19563094daddba47c4b15247c19a791be2784d91.translatedText: >Deng Yuedian’s Air Force uniform in World War II

355218ed9ebf66a142fb12a83b6c681c91df4f9e.sourceText: 同时，鄧粵鈿向笔者提供了在二次大戰時期，美國鳳凰城華人支持祖國抗日救亡的資料：
355218ed9ebf66a142fb12a83b6c681c91df4f9e.translatedText: At the same time, Deng Yuedian provided the author with information about the Chinese people in Phoenix City in the United States who supported the motherland’s anti-Japanese salvation during the Second World War. Death information:

78586f40a05abbf3b6027223cc49f0ea026e2e38.sourceText: 在二次大战时期，美国凤凰城华人成立了＂斐匿华侨救国后援会＂，购买由中国政府发行的＂战争债券＂，积极支持祖国抗日救亡。凤凰城华人支持抗战的团体包括有: 斐匿华商总会，国民党斐匿分部，斐匿妇女救国会，斐匿华侨学校等等。（待续）
78586f40a05abbf3b6027223cc49f0ea026e2e38.translatedText: During the Second World War, the Chinese in Phoenix City, USA, established the "Fei Ni Overseas Chinese National Salvation Support Association" to purchase "war bonds" issued by the Chinese government and actively support the motherland's resistance to Japan and national salvation. Groups of Chinese people in Phoenix who supported the Anti-Japanese War include: Phoenix Chinese Chamber of Commerce, Phoenix Branch of the Kuomintang, Phoenix Women's Salvation Association, Phoenix Overseas Chinese School, etc. (to be continued)

20d8afd657881afa54070c9d9b833b33e9298934.sourceText: 唐孝先:亚利桑那州的中文简称
20d8afd657881afa54070c9d9b833b33e9298934.translatedText: Tang Xiaoxian: The Chinese abbreviation of Arizona

4737b4b344af146e2d314226badc43f652d762b9.sourceText: 唐孝先:亚利桑那州的中文简称 凤凰城 唐孝先 众所周知，加利福尼亚州简称加州，德克萨斯州简称德州，宾夕法…
4737b4b344af146e2d314226badc43f652d762b9.translatedText: Tang Xiaoxian: The Chinese abbreviation of Arizona is Phoenix Tang Xiaoxian As we all know, California is abbreviated as California, Texas is abbreviated as Texas, Pennsylvania...

95ecf803da36c9eaf251af444aa8ede90241685c.sourceText: 唐孝先:亚利桑那州的中文简称 凤凰城 唐孝先 众所周知，加利福尼亚州简称加州，德克萨斯州简称德州，宾夕法尼亚州简称宾州。而我们亚利桑那州的简称，长期以来沿用亚省。 州(state)和省(province)在国家体制中，是完全不同的。中国、加拿大设省，美国联邦政府下是州。亚利桑那州未普遍使用亚州作简称，大概因为亚州与亚洲读音相同、字形相似，容易混淆。 我注意到，北美「世界日报」记者写亚利桑那州的新闻报道时，始终用亚州作为简称。 有识之士陈普先生，几年前就提出，亚利桑那州的简称应该是亚州，严格讲来，简称亚省是不对的。我当时就同意他的观点。 现在当然不需要凡是简称亚省的，都改正为亚州，至少华文媒体、网站上的文章、新闻报道中，用了亚州作为亚利桑那州的中文简称，不要以为人家写错了。
95ecf803da36c9eaf251af444aa8ede90241685c.translatedText: Tang Xiaoxian: The Chinese abbreviation of Arizona is Phoenix Tang Xiaoxian As we all know, California is abbreviated as California, Texas is abbreviated as Texas, and Pennsylvania is abbreviated as Pennsylvania. The abbreviation for our state of Arizona has long been Alberta. In the national system, states and provinces are completely different. China and Canada have provinces, and the United States federal government has states. The abbreviation "Azhou" is not commonly used in Arizona, probably because "Asia" and "Asia" have the same pronunciation and similar glyphs, making it easy to confuse them. I noticed that reporters from the North American "World Journal" always use Asia as the abbreviation when writing news reports about Arizona. Mr. Chen Pu, an insightful man, proposed a few years ago that the abbreviation of Arizona should be Asia. Strictly speaking, the abbreviation of Arizona is wrong. I agreed with him then. Now, of course, there is no need to correct all the abbreviations of Arizona to Yazhou. At least in Chinese media, articles on websites, and news reports, Yazhou is used as the Chinese abbreviation of Arizona. Don’t think that someone has written it wrong.

This year’s Spring Festival Gala will be jointly hosted by New Oriental Art School and the ASU Confucius Institute, and has received the widest support and recognition from all walks of life in the Chinese community.

f0a9a96b05705fb418ad22434a6985bc4556a115.sourceText: 目前，二百多位演职员正在通力合作，力将今年春晚打造成一台集声乐、器乐、舞蹈、武术、技巧等于一体的大型综艺晚会。今年春晚内容丰富，形式多样，综合性与娱乐性极强。除了新东方自己的节目外，美国社区、华人社区及中国艺术家都将加盟。
f0a9a96b05705fb418ad22434a6985bc4556a115.translatedText: Currently, more than 200 cast and crew are working together to turn this year's Spring Festival Gala into a large-scale variety show integrating vocal music, instrumental music, dance, martial arts, and skills. This year’s Spring Festival Gala is rich in content, diverse in form, and highly comprehensive and entertaining. In addition to New Oriental's own programs, the American community, Chinese community and Chinese artists will all join.

6b637e91b1df104d47d0fb87844b1b6222bb8c20.sourceText: 今年的春晚将会在灯光、音响、舞美设计方面有新的突破。观众将会看到传统的中国元素与西方的现代元素在这场晚会中的完美结合。晚会上既有传统的民族歌舞表演，也有现代的西方器乐演奏；既有热闹的武术特技，也有搞笑的音乐小品；既有美国孩子的童声合唱，也有成人演员的歌舞同台。
6b637e91b1df104d47d0fb87844b1b6222bb8c20.translatedText: This year’s Spring Festival Gala will have new breakthroughs in lighting, sound, and stage design. The audience will see the perfect combination of traditional Chinese elements and modern Western elements in this party. At the party, there were both traditional folk song and dance performances and modern Western instrumental music performances; there were lively martial arts stunts and funny musical sketches; there were both children's choruses by American children and adult actors singing and dancing on the same stage.

3b2300bee95ca11cfc3430a6580141c0dea61e2c.sourceText: 去年在CHANDLER大剧场举行的龙年春晚创下了剧场的票房纪录，所有的票卖空之后还不断有人打电话来索票，演出当天有很多观众在剧场外等待。可谓盛况空前。相信观众们年对去年春晚的盛况依然记忆犹新，那么就让我们来共同期待即将来临的蛇年春晚吧！
3b2300bee95ca11cfc3430a6580141c0dea61e2c.translatedText: Last year's Year of the Dragon Spring Festival Gala held at the CHANDLER Grand Theater set a box office record for the theater. It can be described as an unprecedented event. I believe that the audience still remembers the grand occasion of last year’s Spring Festival Gala, so let us look forward to the upcoming Spring Festival Gala of the Year of the Snake!

d923d12014d41ecb29f7f17a062960b62a58c136.sourceText: (秋香供稿)也许您是刚刚来到美国，也许您来美国很久了，但英语毕竟是第二语言，成年后学习一种新的语言到底困难多多。再加上生活、工作、孩子教育等方方面面的压力，如何扬长避短进行表达，如何使用工具书，如何学以致用，从语言学和教育学的角度该如何看问题，从社会交流的角度如何处理问题……敬请带着问题来参与教育学博士陈普老师的学英文讲座吧！

Coupled with the pressures in life, work, children's education and other aspects, how to express your strengths and avoid weaknesses, how to use reference books, how to apply what you have learned, how to look at problems from the perspective of linguistics and education, how to deal with problems from the perspective of social communication... Please bring your questions to participate in the English learning lectures of Mr. Chen Pu, a doctor of education!

b25eca671992df81fe2041330422f8028efaf1da.translatedText: Life is like tea, an empty cup is for tea (Alberta Times) Only an empty cup can hold more things. Giving up does not mean giving up on yourself, but comes from a broader persistence. …

a332fe8e2ffce4662550485e4403d7aed9636357.sourceText: 空了的杯子，才能装下更多的东西。 放弃，不是自暴自弃，是源于更开阔的执着。 当看山不是山，看水不是水时，此境以过，便水落自会石出。。。。。 有禅语道：唐未五代时期，群雄逐鹿，风烟四起。 闽王为了收容人心，稳固江山，也为了消灾祈福，开始笃信佛教。 于是请大禅师出任国师，为其开示佛法，指点迷津。 公元９２８年的一天，闽王在福州西湖拜见扣冰古佛，叩请治国方略。 无论闽王怎样好言讨巧，扣冰古佛却一直保持沉默，自顾喝茶。 闽王之意不在茶，扣冰古佛却不停的向闽王的杯里加茶。 眼看闽王杯里的茶水就要溢出，扣冰古佛却没有停止加茶的意思。 闽王看见茶水流满桌面，一脸讶异， 便问：”?师傅，杯子已经满了，为什么还要加茶呢？?? 扣冰古佛依然不语，继续为其杯中添加茶水。 闽王似有所悟，举起杯中的茶一饮而尽。 于是，扣冰古佛再次为闽王的茶杯里斟满茶，问：”?你会喝茶吗？?? 闽王回答：” 闽王纳闷：??喝茶还要学吗？?? 扣冰古佛说：”你的心就像这个杯子一样，已经装得满满当当的了， 不把茶喝掉，不把杯子倒空，如何装得下别的东西呢？” 只有空的杯子才 可以装水，空的房子才可以住人，空旷的山谷才可以传声… 每一个容器的利用价值在于它的空。 有道是：海纳百川，有容乃大。 空是一种度量和胸怀，空是有的可能和前提，空是有的最初因缘。 于是，佛经里便有?#19968;空万有?#21644;?#30495;空妙有?#30340;禅理。 可见”空”是人生的最高境界。 人生如茶，空杯以对，就有喝不完的好茶，就有装不完的欢喜和感动。 能够懂得放弃是一种智慧，然，每一次放弃都必须是一次升华，否则这种放弃没有意义， 也就无需放弃；每一次选择都必须是一次升华，否则不要选择。 ” 行至水穷成，坐看云起时”当人生的过程来到转折处时， 适时的放弃，明智的选择是比努力更为重要的。 一位哲人说过每个年龄段做不同的事件：二十岁的时候要健康和漂亮，三十岁要有常识， 四十岁要有金钱，五十岁要有智慧。 在人生的这只杯中装的茶就会经常改变。 每一次的失败或成功都装在我们生命的茶杯中， 我们所要做的就是当你的茶杯已经满满的时候， 如果你还想品尝另外的好茶时，就要使你的茶杯 处于空杯的状态。 人生如茶，空杯以对， 就有喝不完的好茶，就有装不完的欢喜和感动….
a332fe8e2ffce4662550485e4403d7aed9636357.translatedText: An empty cup can hold more things. Giving up does not mean giving up on yourself, but comes from a broader persistence. When you look at a mountain but it is not a mountain, and when you look at a water it is not water, once you pass this state, the water will fall and the stone will come out. . . . . There is a Zen saying: During the late Tang Dynasty and the Five Dynasties, heroes were competing for the throne, and wind and smoke were everywhere. In order to accommodate people's hearts, stabilize the country, and also to eliminate disasters and pray for blessings, the King of Fujian began to believe in Buddhism. So he asked the great Zen master to serve as the national teacher to teach him the Dharma and give him guidance. One day in 928 AD, the King of Fujian paid a visit to the ancient Buddha of Kuabing in the West Lake of Fuzhou and asked for strategies for governing the country. No matter how much the King of Fujian tried to flatter him, the ancient Buddha of Kuabing remained silent and drank tea by himself. The King of Min did not care about tea, but the ancient Buddha kept adding tea to the King of Min's cup. Seeing that the tea in King Min's cup was about to overflow, Kuanbing Ancient Buddha had no intention of stopping adding tea. When the King of Min saw the tea flowing all over the table, he looked surprised and asked: "Master, the cup is already full, why do you still need to add tea?" The Ancient Buddha of Kuabing remained silent and continued to add tea to his cup. The King of Min replied: "The King of Min wondered: Do you still need to learn how to drink tea?" The ancient Buddha said: "Your heart is like this cup. It is already full. If you don't drink the tea and empty the cup, how can you hold anything else?" "Only an empty cup can hold water, an empty house can be inhabited, and an empty valley can carry sound... The use value of every container lies in its emptiness. There is a saying: the sea is open to all rivers, and tolerance is great. Emptiness is a kind of measure and mind, emptiness is the possibility and premise of existence, and emptiness is the initial cause and condition of existence. Therefore, there is "empty everything" in the Buddhist scriptures. It can be seen that "empty" is the highest state of life. Life is like tea, and there is endless good tea and endless joy and emotion. Being able to understand that giving up is a kind of wisdom, but every time you give up, it must be a sublimation, otherwise this kind of giving up is meaningless. There is no need to give up; every choice must be a sublimation, otherwise don't choose. "When the water is exhausted, sit back and watch the clouds rise." When the process of life reaches a turning point, giving up at the right time and making wise choices are more important than hard work. A philosopher said that each age group should do different things: be healthy and beautiful at the age of twenty, have common sense at the age of thirty, have money at the age of forty, and have wisdom at the age of fifty. The tea in the cup of life will often change. Every failure or success is contained in the tea cup of our life. All we have to do is to make your tea cup empty when your tea cup is full. If you want to taste another good tea, life is like tea. If the cup is empty, there will be endless good tea and endless joy and excitement...

d5e148664d9337c664d8f8f09d99e248ceca7aaa.sourceText: 但对于很多流浪汉来说，今天对他们来说一定是个开心好日子，因为大家见到了〝龙的传人〞，梦想可成真，免费的午餐就在眼前，已经开始了，什麽也不用准备，排队就可以了。
d5e148664d9337c664d8f8f09d99e248ceca7aaa.translatedText: But for many homeless people, today must be a happy day for them, because everyone has met the "Descendant of the Dragon", and dreams can come true. The free lunch is right in front of you and has already started. You don't need to prepare anything, just line up.

68b1be578253410252433c7d7df1d7670419e225.sourceText: 在凤凰城市中心，Madsion与12Ave之间的”CASS”，是县政府补助的慈善救助单位，内中收容着短暂无家可归的游民。今天服务他们的人是〝龙的传人〞，这些人头上戴着红帽子，身上穿着黄衣裳。在以往的许多年里，这批龙的传人都会在中国农历新年前后，准备好过千份的食物招待他们。
68b1be578253410252433c7d7df1d7670419e225.translatedText: In downtown Phoenix, between Madsion and 12Ave, "CASS" is a charity assistance unit subsidized by the county government, which houses homeless people who are temporarily homeless. The people serving them today are "descendants of the dragon". These people wear red hats and yellow clothes. In the past many years, the descendants of these dragons would prepare more than a thousand portions of food to entertain them around the Chinese New Year.

53460950268855fb75bd6aa4c0b554f23cc93cd1.sourceText: 黄衣人群今天一早就来到了，搬来了炸炉，摆放好桌子，堆好汽水、瓶水和食物。开餐时间一到，他们开始分工合作，各自带上手套，把白米饭，绿兰花，金黄鸡块和春卷，再加上熟牛肉，装满了一碟又一碟，配备上纸巾叉子和饮料，一份一份地递给客人。有时队伍太长，干脆就端起热腾的饭菜，送到队伍后面客人的手中，并告知大家，食物很充足，不够可再加。
53460950268855fb75bd6aa4c0b554f23cc93cd1.translatedText: The crowd in yellow arrived early this morning, brought in the fryer, set up the table, and piled up soda, bottles of water and food. As soon as the meal time came, they began to work together, each put on gloves, filled one plate after another with white rice, green orchids, golden chicken nuggets and spring rolls, plus cooked beef, equipped with paper towels, forks and drinks, and handed them to the guests one by one. Sometimes the queue is too long, so we simply bring hot meals to the guests at the back of the queue and tell everyone that the food is sufficient and if there is not enough, they can add more.

43156767614fd5b41feb6f3fa89a511fc35bc901.sourceText: 龙的传人把这些客人称为〝街友〞，眼神里没有虚伪，也不是同情，有的只是善意和尊重。他们手脚不停地做足几个小时，并不觉累，因为做善事的人会很开心。和往年一样，这次善事由亚省中国餐馆协会举办，再加上一大批有善心和爱心的义工帮忙。
43156767614fd5b41feb6f3fa89a511fc35bc901.translatedText: The descendants of the dragon call these guests "street friends". There is no hypocrisy or sympathy in their eyes, but only kindness and respect. They keep working on their hands and feet for hours without feeling tired, because people who do good deeds will be very happy. As in previous years, this charity event was organized by the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association, with the help of a large number of kind-hearted and loving volunteers.

e80c0b2ac25493059fe4c783052bd5e1aac6193d.sourceText: 天空很蓝，太阳很暖。街友们今天也很开心，因为有爱，因为有温饱，更因为得到了尊重。
e80c0b2ac25493059fe4c783052bd5e1aac6193d.translatedText: The sky is blue and the sun is warm. The street friends are also very happy today because they have love, because they have food and clothing, and because they are respected.

86ebf2bd3531a3723899a2dc6b657e703462ed38.translatedText: "Chinese Golden Overseas Chinese Award" selection activity, you are welcome to actively participate

9e2ecc48ec6ab4ea16379800a1d534ac44117458.sourceText: 「华人金侨奖」徵选活​动，欢迎踊跃参与 中华民国侨务委员会为促进全球华人互动与交流，自2009年起连续五年…
9e2ecc48ec6ab4ea16379800a1d534ac44117458.translatedText: "Chinese Golden Overseas Chinese Award" selection activity, you are welcome to actively participate In order to promote interaction and exchanges among Chinese people around the world, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission of the Republic of China has held the "Chinese Golden Overseas Chinese Award" selection event for five consecutive years since 2009...

c37c66b2206fd2c890ecde47add012e30e376be2.sourceText: 中华民国侨务委员会为促进全球华人互动与交流，自2009年起连续五年举办「华人金侨奖」徵选活动，在华人世界获得热烈迴响。2014华人金侨奖以「记忆青春，典藏感动~侨界故事大募集」为主题，广邀海内外华人，藉由照片或短片记录其在世界各地求学、工作、旅游或移民侨居的故事。
c37c66b2206fd2c890ecde47add012e30e376be2.translatedText: In order to promote interaction and exchanges among Chinese people around the world, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission of the Republic of China has held the "Chinese Golden Overseas Chinese Award" selection event for five consecutive years since 2009, and has received enthusiastic response in the Chinese world. The theme of the 2014 Chinese Golden Overseas Chinese Award is "Memory of Youth, Touched by Collection - Collection of Stories from the Overseas Chinese Community". Chinese people at home and abroad are invited to record their stories of studying, working, traveling or immigrating around the world through photos or short videos.

32e94b7efc29bac04d44de7837d710c8c9355f24.sourceText: 有别往年金侨奖徵件是徵求短片为主，本届金侨奖首度以「照片组」及「短片组」两组别徵件方式，向全球华人募集更多动人的侨界故事，并透过「宏观数位媒体」(ocacmactv.net)网站平台，凝聚全球侨胞目光，让全球华人一起分享过往甜蜜与感动之回忆。 2014华人金侨奖自5月1日起开放全球同步徵件，凡是海内外华人在世界各地求学、工作、移民侨居或侨胞回台求学、工作、探访亲友、寻根的故事，无论人、事、地、物、景，只要主题与「侨务/侨界」相关之真实故事，拍成照片或短片即可参加比赛，本届金侨奖有多达18个奖项，总奖金、奖品逾30万元，欢迎全球华人踊跃参与！
32e94b7efc29bac04d44de7837d710c8c9355f24.translatedText: Different from the previous years where the Golden Overseas Chinese Awards mainly solicited short films, this year’s Golden Overseas Chinese Awards will solicit submissions in two categories: “photo group” and “short film group” for the first time, soliciting more touching overseas Chinese stories from the global Chinese community, and through the “Macro Digital Media” (ocacmactv.net) website platform, gathering the attention of overseas Chinese around the world, allowing Chinese people around the world to share sweet and touching memories of the past. The 2014 Chinese Golden Overseas Chinese Award will be open to simultaneous global call for applications starting from May 1. All stories about Chinese people at home and abroad studying, working, immigrating and residing around the world, or overseas Chinese returning to Taiwan to study, work, visit relatives and friends, and find their roots, no matter who, what, or where. , objects, sceneries, as long as the theme is related to "overseas Chinese affairs/overseas Chinese community" real stories, photos or short films can participate in the competition. This year's Golden Overseas Chinese Awards has as many as 18 awards, with a total bonus and prizes of more than 300,000 yuan. Chinese people around the world are welcome to actively participate!

96448f50de4486fe8b6ac7b2ba68a40650dfde5e.sourceText: 此外，为扩大全球侨胞及侨务委员对华人金侨奖活动之参与，今年奖项设计增设「Early Bird」、「地区奖」、「分享王」等奖项，鼓励全球各地区侨胞踊跃投稿参与活动；另增设「侨务委员奖」，将于本年10月侨务委员会议期间，邀请全球侨务委员共同参与票选，增进侨务工作推广成效及提升与侨界互动。
96448f50de4486fe8b6ac7b2ba68a40650dfde5e.translatedText: In addition, in order to expand the participation of overseas Chinese and Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee members around the world in the Chinese Golden Overseas Chinese Award activities, this year’s award design added “Early Awards such as "Bird", "Regional Award", "Sharing King", etc. encourage overseas Chinese from all over the world to actively contribute to participate in the activities; a new "Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee Award" will be added. During the Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee meeting in October this year, overseas Chinese Affairs Committee members from all over the world will be invited to participate in the voting to enhance the effectiveness of overseas Chinese affairs promotion and enhance interaction with the overseas Chinese community.

04686b1c0f2c11a08387182f408a6bbd59d272c7.sourceText: 「2014华人金侨奖『记忆青春，典藏感动~侨界故事大募集』全球徵件活动」详情，可上网搜寻〔金侨奖〕或至活动网站：video.ocacmactv.net查询，亦可按讚加入「宏观数位媒体」Facebook粉丝团，随时掌握活动最新资讯。
04686b1c0f2c11a08387182f408a6bbd59d272c7.translatedText: "2014 Chinese Golden Overseas Chinese Award "Remembering Youth, Touching Collection ~ Overseas Chinese Stories Collection" Global Collection Campaign" details can be searched online for [Golden Overseas Chinese Award] or go to the event website: video.ocacmactv.net. You can also like and join the "Macro Digital Media" Facebook fan group to keep up with the latest information about the event.

67b47420321decfa582b0ae0b112919ce333e8ba.sourceText: 一技术员恶意传播肝炎病毒 各州展开清查行动 新罕布什尔州某医院一名医疗技术员故意把C型肝炎传染给患者，案件已急速扩大。由于这名技术员曾在其它七州的医院服务，调查人员担心或有数千人受到感染，目前各州已展开清查和筛检行动。 来自密歇根州的33岁医疗技术员奎亚特科斯基(David Kwiatkowski)于2011年至2012年，在新罕布什尔州Exeter医院的心导管检查实验室任职时，涉嫌窃取比吗啡药性更强的麻醉药Fentanyl，自行施打后，再把注射针头让其它患者重复使用。 虽然奎亚特科斯基声称他从2012年5月才感染C型肝炎，但联邦侦探已查出，他至少在2010年6月即已感染。 奎亚特科斯基让患者使用他注射过的针头，即可把感染病毒的血液传染给其它人。他落网后已被控以散布C型肝炎、诈取管制药物，以及破坏消费者产品。 截至目前，已有30名患者被诊断出含有与奎亚特科斯基一模一样的C型肝炎病毒株。由于奎亚特科斯基2011年4月1日至2012年5月25日在Exeter医院工作期间，曾在手术室和加护病房工作，期间在医院动手术或住加护病房的所有人都应验血。该院为查明遭其传染的患者人数，已在23日通知近6000名患者接受C型肝炎筛检。 另外，鉴于奎亚特科斯基在过去五年间，也曾在亚利桑那、纽约、马里兰、密西根、堪萨斯、乔治亚、宾州的医院工作，这些州的卫生当局呼吁曾与奎亚特科斯基接触的患者也能接受C型肝炎筛检。
67b47420321decfa582b0ae0b112919ce333e8ba.translatedText: A technician maliciously spread the hepatitis virus. States launched an investigation operation. A medical technician at a hospital in New Hampshire intentionally transmitted hepatitis C to patients. The case has expanded rapidly. Because the technician worked at hospitals in seven other states, investigators fear thousands of people may have been infected, and states have launched sweeps and screening operations. David Kwiatkowski, a 33-year-old medical technician from Michigan, was suspected of stealing Fentanyl, an anesthetic more potent than morphine, from 2011 to 2012 when he worked at the cardiac catheterization laboratory of Exeter Hospital in New Hampshire, administered it himself, and then reused the injection needle for other patients. Although Kwiatkoski claimed he had been infected with hepatitis C since May 2012, federal detectives have determined that he had been infected since at least June 2010. Kwiatkoski allowed patients to use his injected needles to transmit virus-infected blood to others. After his arrest, he was charged with spreading hepatitis C, defrauding controlled substances, and damaging consumer products. So far, 30 patients have been diagnosed with the exact same strain of hepatitis C virus as Kwiatkoski. Because Kwiatkoski worked in the operating theater and intensive care unit at Exeter Hospital between April 1, 2011, and May 25, 2012, everyone who had surgery or was admitted to the intensive care unit during that period should have their blood tested. In order to find out the number of patients infected by it, the hospital notified nearly 6,000 patients to undergo hepatitis C screening on the 23rd. In addition, given that Kwiatkoski has also worked in hospitals in Arizona, New York, Maryland, Michigan, Kansas, Georgia, and Pennsylvania in the past five years, health authorities in these states are calling on patients who have been in contact with Kwiatkoski to also receive hepatitis C screening.

fd9ce19936122ae8bb3004e22227040d4741d870.translatedText: Photos in a Shoe Box – Did the Gold Medal in the Beauty of Arizona Photography Contest land at your home? (Contributed by the Photographic Association) In the era of developing photos,...

ea605101df4d4834e72e54a8b8a08054210d1c2c.sourceText: （摄影协会来稿）在那冲洗相片的年代，许多美国人将过时的书信和相片收藏在买鞋时装着鞋子的纸盒子里。这些装着珍贵记忆的鞋盒子常被遗忘在衣柜上层或麈封的车库角落，在许多荷里活电影经典中为亲情，友情，刻骨铭心的爱情作见证。
ea605101df4d4834e72e54a8b8a08054210d1c2c.translatedText: (Contributed by the Photographic Association) In the era of developing photos, many Americans stored outdated letters and photos in the cardboard boxes used to store shoes. These shoe boxes containing precious memories are often forgotten in the upper floors of closets or in the corners of closed garages. They bear witness to family, friendship, and unforgettable love in many classic Hollywood movies.

0c2297d546f7a4e21656339420f69cdbbd150849.sourceText: 时空移转，在数码的时代，这代替鞋盒子的可能是家中电脑的硬碟，也可能是您心爱的 iPhone 智能手机。在这科技普及的年代，大相机和令人侧目的长镜头不再是隹作唯一的来源。人人随时随地都能捕捉那”Kodak moment”（柯达时刻）。
0c2297d546f7a4e21656339420f69cdbbd150849.translatedText: Time and space have shifted. In the digital age, the shoe box may be replaced by the hard drive of your computer at home, or it may be your beloved iPhone smartphone. In this era of widespread technology, big cameras and eye-catching long lenses are no longer the only sources of great works. Everyone can capture the "Kodak moment" anytime, anywhere.

1a1ca55c3a9b42fe38c732612ec8d72be9f47c9a.sourceText: 找找您的”鞋盒子”,今天就 e-mail 您的相片。亚历桑那之美摄影比赛头奖单眼相机得主就是您。参加办法请上网 http://www.AZAPC.ORG 提醒您’亚历桑那之美’摄影比赛送件五月二十八日下午四时截止 详情请电 602-430-9251 郑弘 Jeff Jenq

On the road where there is usually constant traffic...

447cf10e0cbef7fe431103bd4bfa6032e25d1ac2.sourceText: 9月18日，北京朝阳区亮马桥路机动车双向全部禁行，平常车流不息的马路上，大批中国民众在日本驻华大使馆门外进行了连日来又一场真正的游行棗虽然中国《宪法》赋予中国公民”有言论、出版、集会、结社、游行、示威的自由”，但真正的游行在中国极为少见。
447cf10e0cbef7fe431103bd4bfa6032e25d1ac2.translatedText: On September 18, all motor vehicles were prohibited on Liangmaqiao Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing. On the way, a large number of Chinese people held another real demonstration in the past few days outside the Japanese Embassy in China. Although China's Constitution grants Chinese citizens "freedom of speech, press, assembly, association, procession, and demonstration," real demonstrations are extremely rare in China.

dfe6fd064092630a5cdb0fb674ed099bec9bdb76.sourceText: 周二，抗议人群举着标语，沿亮马桥路走向日本大使馆
dfe6fd064092630a5cdb0fb674ed099bec9bdb76.translatedText: On Tuesday, protesters held slogans and walked along Liangmaqiao Road towards the Japanese Embassy

65f40609b3ce9c3e2eb59451961e28b066a06388.sourceText: ”钓鱼岛是我们的”，”小日本，滚出去”，”打倒日本帝国主义”，”抵制日货”，抗议的人们高喊口号，自西向东通过日本大使馆门前。日本使馆大门紧闭，门外公安、武警层层设防，使馆墙上尚留着前几天抗议者抛掷鸡蛋和墨水瓶的痕迹。
65f40609b3ce9c3e2eb59451961e28b066a06388.translatedText: "Diaoyu Islands are ours", "Little Japan, get out", "Down with Japanese imperialism", "Boycott Japanese goods", the protesters chanted slogans and passed in front of the Japanese Embassy from west to east. The door of the Japanese embassy is tightly closed, and the public security and armed police outside the door are heavily guarded. There are still traces of eggs and ink bottles thrown by protesters in the past few days on the walls of the embassy.

eaa92934aad2079d7d2ba8345e15329607db0982.sourceText: 人们举着”保钓”、反日内容的标语牌、横幅和漫画，挥舞着大大小小的国旗、毛主席像和中国共产党党旗。每当一批游行的队伍行进到大使馆门前，不时有鸡蛋、饮料瓶从人群中飞向使馆墙内，随即传来一阵欢呼和口哨声，人们纷纷鼓掌大喊”打得好！”
eaa92934aad2079d7d2ba8345e15329607db0982.translatedText: People held placards, banners and cartoons with "Protect Diaoyu" and anti-Japanese content, and waved national flags of all sizes, Chairman Mao's portrait and the Chinese Communist Party flag. Whenever a group of marchers marched in front of the embassy, ​​eggs and drink bottles would fly from the crowd into the embassy wall from time to time. Then there would be a burst of cheers and whistles, and people would applaud and shout "Well done!"

34029a93cec87a233689f2f445ea4c10ae2b47d7.sourceText: 日本使馆内的旗杆上显眼地挂着日本国旗，经过的人们纷纷高喊”降旗”。正午骄阳似火，人群中两名带头喊口号的年轻男子脸晒得通红。他们配合默契，分走在队伍两侧，一个嗓子喊哑了就向另一个点头示意，交替工作。他们领喊”小日本，滚出去”、 ”宣战”、”打倒日本帝国主义”等口号，得到了人群热烈的呼应。
34029a93cec87a233689f2f445ea4c10ae2b47d7.translatedText: The Japanese flag was conspicuously hung on the flagpole in the Japanese embassy, ​​and people passing by shouted "lower the flag." The sun was blazing at noon, and the two young men in the crowd who took the lead in shouting slogans had their faces flushed. They cooperated tacitly and walked on both sides of the team. When one voice became hoarse, he would nod to the other and work alternately. They led slogans such as "Get out, little Japan," "Declare war," and "Down with Japanese imperialism," which received enthusiastic responses from the crowd.

e2a7c1a8aa80ed0f0e56562918df3216dd87cd6b.sourceText: 一位自称38军老兵的老人在身边的人搀扶下，几乎走完了全程。他手持国旗，在人群中高声说：”打日本不能打一半，要打就打倒！”话音一落，叫好声和笑声四起，队伍前排的人们纷纷要求老人站到队伍第一排正中间。很多人一边行进一边请身边的人为自己拍照留念。
e2a7c1a8aa80ed0f0e56562918df3216dd87cd6b.translatedText: An old man who claimed to be a veteran of the 38th Army almost completed the entire journey with the help of people around him. He held the national flag and said loudly in the crowd: "You can't fight Japan half way. If you want to fight, knock it down!" As soon as he finished speaking, cheers and laughter broke out. People in the front row of the team asked the old man to stand in the middle of the first row of the team. Many people ask people around them to take photos of themselves while marching.

7a7f52f61998ce9d40e10e74b789b8c0c43cf337.sourceText: 游行队伍里有私营企业员工、个体经营者、外来务工者。有穿着入时的年轻女孩、白发苍苍的老夫妇、带着小孩的父亲。人群中也有不少学生，但他们大都是分散而来，现场没有出现一所学校学生集体组织的游行队伍。
7a7f52f61998ce9d40e10e74b789b8c0c43cf337.translatedText: There were private enterprise employees, self-employed people, and migrant workers in the parade. There are fashionably dressed young girls, gray-haired old couples, and fathers with children. There were many students in the crowd, but most of them were dispersed. There was no demonstration organized by students from any school at the scene.

110c3bd6b8c8059b9ef548304711ff5daf682d06.sourceText: 香港《世界华人报》的8名大陆职员参加了抗议。他们自己制作了标语牌：”哪怕顿顿瘦肉精，也要出兵灭东瀛”，”哪怕天天被代表，也要收复钓鱼岛”，”哪怕养老没人管，也要占领富士山”，”理性爱国，誓不当爱国贼”等等。
110c3bd6b8c8059b9ef548304711ff5daf682d06.translatedText: Eight mainland staff members of Hong Kong's "World Chinese Newspaper" participated in the protest. They made their own placards: "Even if we only have a meal of clenbuterol, we will send troops to destroy Japan", "Even if we are being represented every day, we will recover the Diaoyu Islands", "Even if there is no one to take care of our elderly care, we will occupy Mount Fuji", "Be rational and patriotic, swear not to be patriotic thieves" and so on.

3976cfc530450a45512dc38e16ddf468ac38735b.sourceText: 一对夫妻模样的上访者也参与其中，其中女子还拄着双拐，在男子的帮助下前行。他们来京两个多月，今天是第四天参加示威。他们也奋力地喊着口号，并说，示威是他们表达情绪的另一种途径。
3976cfc530450a45512dc38e16ddf468ac38735b.translatedText: A couple of petitioners also participated, with the woman walking on crutches with the help of the man. They have been in Beijing for more than two months, and today is their fourth day to participate in demonstrations. They also chanted slogans vigorously and said that demonstrations were another way for them to express their emotions.

c48b0ef064b6fc3f10cf6adda2deae5c50708aeb.sourceText: 几位身着印有保钓爱国字样的T恤的青年说，服装和示威的标语均由公司组织印刷发放。不少游行的民众领到了一条特制的擦汗毛巾，沿途有人免费发放矿泉水。一位头上系着”保卫钓鱼岛”红条的中年男子用电动自行车拉来两竹筐苹果，在路边隔离带外分发给示威的人们。
c48b0ef064b6fc3f10cf6adda2deae5c50708aeb.translatedText: Several young people wearing T-shirts with patriotic words about protecting the Diaoyu Islands said that the clothing and demonstration slogans were printed and distributed by the company. Many marchers received a special sweat towel, and people distributed free mineral water along the way. A middle-aged man with a red stripe on his head that read "Defend the Diaoyu Islands" pulled two bamboo baskets of apples on an electric bicycle and distributed them to demonstrators outside the roadside isolation zone.

c0b11c2d4928e8a6f3c2a7f9e058a86d5e60def5.sourceText: 队伍行进中，有身穿便服手持标有”警察”字样扩音器的人，指点队伍向前或是停下，如何拉举横幅，挥舞旗帜。游行的终点棗亮马桥古玩市场附近有爱国签名横幅，横幅上印有两岸四地的旗帜。人们纷纷涌向横幅签下自己的名字。
c0b11c2d4928e8a6f3c2a7f9e058a86d5e60def5.translatedText: As the team marched, there were people in civilian clothes holding loudspeakers marked with the word "Police", instructing the team to move forward or stop, how to hold up banners and wave flags. At the end of the parade, near the Maqiao Antique Market in Zaoliang, there were patriotic signature banners with the flags of the two sides of the Taiwan Strait and four places printed on them. People flocked to the banners to sign their names.

335de50b8db66945f254f7c8419983814f79b774.sourceText: 游行的队伍虽然情绪激昂，但在大批公安干警的组织和维持下，显得井然有序。除了不时飞向使馆的水瓶，几乎看不到使用暴力的迹象。大批警车停在南北向的朝阳公园路和麦子店街上。游行沿线大约10米有一位警察，靠近日本大使馆处3-5米一位，一架直升飞机不时在人群上空盘旋。
335de50b8db66945f254f7c8419983814f79b774.translatedText: Although the parade was very emotional, it appeared to be orderly under the organization and maintenance of a large number of public security officers. There were few signs of violence, except for water bottles that occasionally flew towards the embassy. A large number of police cars were parked on the north-south Chaoyang Park Road and Maizidian Street. There was one police officer about 10 meters along the parade route, and one officer 3-5 meters away from the Japanese Embassy. A helicopter hovered over the crowd from time to time.

88f354a56d421a61e931e0959cb2e865d4c11f89.sourceText: 高音喇叭里反复播放着警方的呼吁：”日本侵犯我国主权，大家来表达意愿是正当的，我们和大家的心情是一样的，政府已经做出明确表态不会坐视领土主权受到侵害，我们要拥护和支持政府，依法、理性，有序地表达爱国热情，遵守法律法规，不要采取过激行为，不要影响社会秩序，请大家配合我们工作，听从民警指挥疏导，表达意愿后不要在现场滞留，注意安全，有序离开，谢谢大家。”
88f354a56d421a61e931e0959cb2e865d4c11f89.translatedText: The police's appeal was repeatedly played on the loudspeaker: "Japan has violated our country's sovereignty, and it is legitimate for everyone to express their wishes. We feel the same as everyone else. The government has made it clear that it will not sit back and let its territorial sovereignty be violated. We must support and support the government, express patriotic enthusiasm in a legal, rational and orderly manner, and abide by the law." Please comply with laws and regulations, do not take excessive actions, and do not affect social order. Please cooperate with our work, follow the instructions of the police, do not stay at the scene after expressing your wishes, pay attention to safety, and leave in an orderly manner. Thank you. "

2f0584291c77cafe9788da8557889e81b50aa3b0.sourceText: 队伍在警察的引导下，沿着制定的路线行进。游行的人群行进百米，就有警察要求暂停行进，等前方队伍走出一段距离后再放行。越接近日本使馆大门，部署的警力越多。一名手持?#35686;察?#23383;样扩音器的男子对人群喊话：”抬毛主席像的到最前面来！标语放在胸前，队伍靠拢些！让毛主席领导我们前进！”三名举着毛主席像的男子迅速跑到队伍第一排。
2f0584291c77cafe9788da8557889e81b50aa3b0.translatedText: The team marched along the designated route under the guidance of the police. When the marchers marched a hundred meters, a police officer asked them to stop marching and wait until the front group had gone some distance before letting them go. The closer we get to the gate of the Japanese embassy, ​​the more police are deployed. A man holding a loudspeaker shouted to the crowd: "Those carrying Chairman Mao's portrait come to the front! Put the slogan on your chest and move closer together! Let Chairman Mao lead us forward!" Three men holding Chairman Mao's portrait quickly ran to the front row of the line.

ab4dbb239240e0272ebadeaf0c98b5f4f9dbdf39.sourceText: 使馆大门口更是层层布防。最内侧是三层手执盾牌的武警，站在一人多高的临时隔离栅栏后，外面是公安、特警组成的人墙，几乎没有民众和武警发生身体冲撞。不时有围观群众想加入游行队伍，或有示威者想中途离开，警察随即要求其按照指定的路线寻找出入口。
ab4dbb239240e0272ebadeaf0c98b5f4f9dbdf39.translatedText: The gate of the embassy is even more heavily guarded. On the innermost side are three layers of armed policemen holding shields, standing behind a temporary separation fence that is as high as one person. Outside is a human wall composed of public security and special police officers. There are almost no physical collisions between people and the armed police. From time to time, onlookers wanted to join the parade, or demonstrators wanted to leave midway, and the police immediately asked them to find an entrance and exit along the designated route.

99e39012c718848ea66399e59e2c24bf305f0ad1.sourceText: 日本大使馆的南门与中日青年交流中心北门隔亮马桥路相望。中日青年交流中心建筑群（包括21世纪饭店、世纪剧院等）是1984年由日本前首相中曾根康弘与时任中共中央总书记胡耀邦共同倡议兴建，本意是为了促进中日青年友好往来。
99e39012c718848ea66399e59e2c24bf305f0ad1.translatedText: The south gate of the Japanese Embassy faces the north gate of the China-Japan Youth Exchange Center across Liangmaqiao Road. The China-Japan Youth Exchange Center complex (including the 21st Century Hotel, Century Theater, etc.) was jointly initiated and built in 1984 by former Japanese Prime Minister Yasuhiro Nakasone and Hu Yaobang, then General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. It was originally intended to promote friendly exchanges between Chinese and Japanese youths.

332e669b4278f38295b31bd457b8ccf7c34e1af9.sourceText: 这天这里停满了各式公安、武警、机关牌照的车辆，大批公安、武警在院内备勤。门口几辆专业车辆上的监视器，密切地注视着亮马桥路上的抗议情形。院内两名保洁工人抱怨，这两天比平时多出了好多烟头。
332e669b4278f38295b31bd457b8ccf7c34e1af9.translatedText: On this day, the place was full of vehicles with various public security, armed police and government license plates. A large number of public security and armed police were on standby in the hospital. Monitors on several professional vehicles at the entrance closely watched the protests on Liangmaqiao Road. Two cleaning workers in the hospital complained that there were more cigarette butts than usual in the past two days.

18d7549109e64af65d3f356bb8d3137f35124d99.translatedText: Butterfly Paradise - Tropical Rainforest in the Arizona Desert (Photo) (Contributed by Lin Xin) Last weekend our family and friends came to a place in Scottsdale...

9b12980ad2ea47563cfcce6a3fbd29cf8db93ee2.sourceText: （林欣供稿）上周末我们一家和朋友来到了Scottsdale一个叫”蝴蝶天堂”Butterfly Wonderland的地方，这里呈现一个沙漠中的热带雨林，满天飞舞着色彩斑斓的蝴蝶，他们不是”移民”，很多都是亚利桑那”土族”。让我们除了想到仙人掌和红色峡谷外，又看到了亚利桑那鲜活的一面。 茂密的绿色植物，以及满天飞舞的彩蝶，眼前的景观，就给炎热的亚利桑那带来阵阵凉意，刚到目的地孩子们就欢了，冲进了蝴蝶蜕变的展示区。这里有工作人员为我们介绍蝴蝶的常识，孩子们马上安静下来，一起倾听蝴蝶的成长故事。 亚利桑那州是334种蝴蝶的故乡，继德克萨斯州之后全美排名第二。这里是全美最大的蝴蝶展区，有来自南北美洲，非洲，亚洲近800种不同的蝴蝶。2001官方评选的国家蝴蝶”双尾凤蝶”（Papilio multicaudata）就来自亚利桑那。”双尾凤蝶”幼虫区就展现在我们面前。双尾凤蝶的蛹是浅绿色的，头部附近有4个黄色的小点，和两个以蓝色为中心的黄色眼点，当它变成毛毛虫后，脖子上有黑色和黄色的带状，身上有几行小蓝点。他们每天以灌木叶子为食。就当我们认真看这些标本的时候，忽然清脆的”噼啪”声，吸引了观众们的眼球，一只蝴蝶破茧而出！太神奇了，这不是标本，都是正在孵化的蝴蝶。 看完了蝴蝶蜕变过程，我们被带到一个3D电影院。带上眼镜我们就身临其境，黄色的蝶群像一条温暖的围巾，在身边曼妙飞舞，一个15分钟的短片，让我们了解了蝴蝶由北向南迁徙，繁衍的全过程。有人说”飞过沧海的蝴蝶总是要折断翅膀. 蝴蝶飞不过沧海,它太软弱.”这是错的，蝴蝶很坚强，或者说拥有超出生命的毅力。它会用三代蝴蝶的生命来完成迁徙的愿望。 走进热带雨林区，我们真真切切地与这些生命精灵在一起，就在身边，触手可及，太有诱惑力了。在进入区域之前，管理人员就告诉我们怎样和蝴蝶和平相处，要求大家放慢动作，有些蝴蝶会停在地上，不能用手抓或者触摸蝴蝶，要让他们自由地飞翔。茂密的树林，湿润的空气，还有色彩斑斓地蝴蝶，这里完全让我们忘记了亚利桑那的炎热。为了让孩子们认真观察蝴蝶，我们组织了场比赛，看看今天是谁最早能找到”双尾凤蝶”？奖品就是这里礼品店里的任意一份礼物。这下孩子们可卯足了劲，拿着图片一一认真比对。
9b12980ad2ea47563cfcce6a3fbd29cf8db93ee2.translatedText: (Contributed by Lin Xin) Last weekend our family and our friends came to a place in Scottsdale called "Butterfly Paradise" Butterfly Wonderland is a tropical rain forest in the desert, with colorful butterflies flying all over the sky. They are not "immigrants", many of them are Arizona natives. In addition to thinking of cacti and red canyons, we also saw the vivid side of Arizona. The lush green plants and colorful butterflies flying all over the sky brought coolness to the hot Arizona. The children were so happy when they arrived at the destination that they rushed into the butterfly transformation exhibition area. There are staff here who introduce us to the common knowledge of butterflies. The children immediately calm down and listen to the story of the growth of butterflies. Arizona is home to 334 species of butterflies, ranking second in the nation after Texas. This is the largest butterfly exhibition area in the United States, with nearly 800 different species of butterflies from North and South America, Africa, and Asia. The official national butterfly in 2001, Papilio multicaudata, comes from Arizona. The larval area of ​​the "Twin-tailed Swallowtail Butterfly" is displayed in front of us. The pupa of the Papilion butterfly is light green, with four small yellow dots near the head and two yellow eyespots centered on blue. When it turns into a caterpillar, it has black and yellow bands around its neck and several rows of small blue dots on its body. They feed daily on shrub leaves. Just when we were looking at these specimens carefully, a sudden crisp "crackling" sound caught the audience's attention, and a butterfly emerged from its cocoon! It’s amazing, these are not specimens, they are hatching butterflies. After watching the butterfly's transformation process, we were taken to a 3D cinema. Wearing glasses, we are immersed in the scene. The yellow butterflies are like a warm scarf, flying gracefully around us. A 15-minute short film allows us to understand the entire process of butterflies migrating from north to south and reproducing. Some people say, "A butterfly that flies across the sea will always break its wings. A butterfly cannot fly across the sea because it is too weak." This is wrong. Butterflies are very strong, or have perseverance beyond life. It will use the life of three generations of butterflies to fulfill its migration wish. Walking into the tropical rainforest area, we are really with these life elves, right next to us, within reach, it is so tempting. Before entering the area, the management staff told us how to live peacefully with butterflies and asked everyone to slow down. Some butterflies will stop on the ground. We cannot catch or touch the butterflies with our hands. We must let them fly freely. The dense woods, humid air, and colorful butterflies completely made us forget the heat of Arizona. In order to let the children observe butterflies carefully, we organized a competition to see who can find the "Twin-tailed Swallowtail" first today? The prize is any gift from the gift shop here. Now the children were very energetic and compared the pictures one by one carefully.

a6755c7427b8445cdc624914f1f5dfe702124f1a.sourceText: 忽然，儿子用手用力地拽了我一下，顺着他手指的方向，看到朋友的女儿”美美”，她头上的粉色发卡上停了一只金色的蝴蝶。蝴蝶准是把那个色彩鲜艳的发卡当成鲜花了。我们赶紧示意美美蹲下，找出手机想拍下这动人的一刻，可是刚拿出手机，那只金色的蝴蝶就飞了。儿子好失望，视线还是锲而不舍地追随那只金蝴蝶。美美和爸爸妈妈们倒是认出了好多蝴蝶的种类，可就是一直没有看到”双尾凤蝶”。儿子跟随者金色蝴蝶，似乎完全忘了”双尾凤蝶”的事儿啦，就在我们拿他完全没办法的时候，他很得意地来到我身边，说：”妈妈跟我走!”他指着金色的蝴蝶说：”你再往下看！”金色蝴蝶下面真得停了一只大约3英寸的蝴蝶，黄色的翅膀，黑色线条的边沿，每个翅膀上有四条纹路，里边的最长，外边的最短。最美丽的是翅尾有蓝色花纹，这就是我们要找的”双尾凤蝶”，真不愧是国家蝴蝶，每次扑扇翅膀，黄蓝相间的颜色，都耀眼夺目。
a6755c7427b8445cdc624914f1f5dfe702124f1a.translatedText: Suddenly, my son pulled me hard with his hand. Following the direction of his finger, I saw my friend's daughter "Meimei", with a golden butterfly on the pink hairpin on her head. The butterfly must have mistaken that brightly colored hairpin for a flower. We quickly signaled Meimei to squat down and took out our cell phones to take a photo of this touching moment, but as soon as we took out our cell phones, the golden butterfly flew away. The son was so disappointed, but he still followed the golden butterfly with his eyes. Meimei and her parents recognized many types of butterflies, but they never saw the "Twin-tailed Swallowtail". My son followed the golden butterfly and seemed to have completely forgotten about the "double-tailed swallowtail butterfly". Just when we were completely unable to do anything with him, he came to me very proudly and said, "Mom, follow me!" He pointed at the golden butterfly and said, "Look down!" There was really a butterfly about 3 inches below the golden butterfly, with yellow wings and black lines on the edge. There were four stripes on each wing, the inner one was the longest and the outer one was the shortest. The most beautiful thing is the blue pattern on the tail of the wings. This is the "Twin-tailed Swallowtail" we are looking for. It is indeed the national butterfly. Every time it flaps its wings, the yellow and blue colors are dazzling.

eced546fcbca44bc12e8d6818f59b5900844c10c.sourceText: 儿子获得了一个巨大的蝴蝶标本图作为他的礼物。我们一家决定还会再来，这个让我们新认识的蝴蝶天堂！
eced546fcbca44bc12e8d6818f59b5900844c10c.translatedText: The son received a huge butterfly specimen as his gift. Our family decided to come back again, this new butterfly paradise made us acquainted!

d25f789cd0df2f800a546a6e18b227e5a0b24459.sourceText: 凤凰城议会投票修改法案 禁止歧视同性恋 2月26日，凤凰城议会经过五个多小时激烈争论，投票通过一项法案，禁止歧视同性恋（包括男同、女同在内），双性恋和变性居民。 法案禁止任何人在种族、性别、职业、家庭出身、宗教信仰、教育程度、国籍、年龄和婚姻上歧视同性恋人士，禁止任何人（包括宗教组织、小型私营业主、高级住宅、私人会所等）在住房、就业和公共场所，包括餐厅和酒店，对同性恋人士做出有异于异性恋人士的区别，违例者将处以2500美元罚款。 目前，全美已有166个城市和郡通过类似法律。凤凰城在此尚算先行者，早在1992年，凤凰城通过法案，任何与市政府有合约的公司，或雇员超过35人的公司，不得在工作场合歧视男同与女同。这次法案恰好是1992年法案的延伸，将同性恋权益保障扩充到更全面的范围。 虽然凤凰城市长史坦顿投赞成票，市议会以5：3票通过，此项法案也只在凤凰城一市施行，在亚利桑那州，同性恋并没有得到大多数人的认同，本州法律并不承认同性恋婚姻。
d25f789cd0df2f800a546a6e18b227e5a0b24459.translatedText: The Phoenix City Council voted to amend the bill to prohibit discrimination against homosexuals. On February 26, after more than five hours of heated debate, the Phoenix City Council voted to pass a bill banning discrimination against gay (including gay and lesbian), bisexual and transgender residents. The bill prohibits anyone from discriminating against homosexuals on the basis of race, gender, occupation, family origin, religious belief, education, nationality, age and marriage. It prohibits anyone (including religious organizations, small private owners, high-end residences, private clubs, etc.) from making any distinction between homosexuals and heterosexuals in housing, employment and public places, including restaurants and hotels. Violators will be fined $2,500. Currently, 166 cities and counties across the United States have passed similar laws. Phoenix is ​​considered a pioneer here. As early as 1992, Phoenix passed a bill that stipulated that any company that has a contract with the city government, or a company with more than 35 employees, is not allowed to discriminate against gay men and women in the workplace. This bill happens to be an extension of the 1992 bill, extending the protection of gay rights to a more comprehensive scope. Although Phoenix Mayor Stanton voted in favor and the city council passed it with a vote of 5:3, this bill has only been implemented in Phoenix. In Arizona, homosexuality is not recognized by the majority of people and the state's law does not recognize gay marriage.

51074b509ee2b8fd6c18fdc34a53b379f4f01c98.sourceText: （亚省时报 清宝报道） 「世界华人工商妇女企管协会亚利桑那分会」暨「大凤凰城台美商会」为了迎接崭新的一年，于元月五日（星期六）下午四时，在「六福海鲜餐厅」举办新年餐会。会长韩玉华，大凤凰城台美商会会长张晴玲，以及来自洛杉矶的贵宾，台湾贸易中心主任颜木松夫妇，台北经文处商务组专员章远智夫妇，以及世华姐妹及商会会员携眷近140人参加晚宴，共同渡过一个愉快的「新年晚会」。

President Han Yuhua, President of the Greater Phoenix Taiwan-American Chamber of Commerce Zhang Qingling, as well as distinguished guests from Los Angeles, Taiwan Trade Center Director Yan Musong and his wife, Taipei Cultural Affairs Office Commercial Section Commissioner Zhang Yuanzhi and his wife, as well as Shihua sisters and members of the Chamber of Commerce brought nearly 140 people to the dinner and spent a pleasant "New Year Party" together.

e13c276d6328fecdda68f7a31c72c6ff2be28b17.sourceText: 晚会中，著名百货公司Saks Fifth Avenue阿玛尼化妆公司，为来宾带来了工商妇女化妆示范表演。化妆师珍妮弗（Jennifer）为大家介绍了几个简单的化妆步骤。选择和肤色接近的细腻粉底。上腮红时，要把脸颊看成苹果的表面，由高到低。化妆师建议大家将腮红刷上的剩余颜色，均匀的涂在脸轮廓的周围，会让妆容更加自然。
e13c276d6328fecdda68f7a31c72c6ff2be28b17.translatedText: During the party, the famous department store Saks Fifth Avenue Armani Cosmetics Company brought makeup demonstrations by business women to the guests. Makeup artist Jennifer introduces you to a few simple makeup steps. Choose a fine foundation that matches your skin tone. When applying blush, think of your cheeks as the surface of an apple, from high to low. Makeup artists recommend that you apply the remaining color on the blush brush evenly around the contours of the face to make the makeup more natural.

2bc0e579e91792d40955a5ebb175c281c2b6466b.sourceText: 国际名牌服装公司ESCADA为活动准备了亮丽的服装与精彩的解说，所有的模特儿都是来自华裔社区的中年女性友人。首先出场的是时尚职业装。模特徐一春，工程师，身着橙色西装，洋气，大方非常职业。会计师马昌华，一席绿色职业裙，外加小洋装，层次分明，率性，优雅。解说介绍这些服装选用目前国际上流行的高档制服面料，手感柔软、透气，贴身立体裁剪。款式高雅、柔美、大方而而不缺现代女性的风韵。让职业女性在不同的场合中都能展现女性典雅美丽的气质风韵。
2bc0e579e91792d40955a5ebb175c281c2b6466b.translatedText: The international famous brand clothing company ESCADA prepared bright clothes and wonderful explanations for the event. All the models are middle-aged female friends from the Chinese community. The first thing to appear is fashionable business attire. Model Xu Yichun, an engineer, is dressed in an orange suit, looking stylish, elegant and very professional. Accountant Ma Changhua, wearing a green professional skirt and a small dress, has clear layers, straightforwardness and elegance. The explanation introduces that these clothes are made of high-end uniform fabrics that are currently popular in the world. They are soft, breathable and three-dimensionally tailored to the body. The style is elegant, soft and generous without lacking the charm of modern women. Let professional women show their elegant and beautiful temperament in different occasions.

28faf729380835bd1fc23f6d44ceedbde7095357.translatedText: The most stunning part of the show was the dress. Huang Yulian, the next new president of the Arizona branch of the World Chinese Business Women's Business Association, wore a black mermaid dress and slowly walked to the T-stage accompanied by elegant music. The audience applauded and cheered, showing off the elegance and noble temperament of oriental women. Another tall model, Chen Mingqun, was equally stunning in her black dress with off-the-shoulder and trailing tails. Their appearance pushed the event to a climax.

33354e6c1f40a9a96150a815eb7996fa89293ef9.translatedText: Chen Mingqun, Huang Yulian, Director of the Taiwan Trade Center Yan Musong, and Taipei Cultural Affairs Office Commercial Section Commissioner Zhang Yuanzhi delivered speeches to the guests. They promoted Taiwan's high-quality products and also hoped that more friends could participate in the Taiwan Products International Trade Fair. After the fashion show and makeup demonstration program, Luk Fook Seafood Restaurant prepared a delicious dinner for the guests, and the guests also came on stage to draw exciting prizes. Beautiful, delicious food, great views, the guests came back with a full meal at the beginning of the new year.

c2445b9127e214fffa02158b260396bd7f4d8c59.sourceText: 亚利桑那野火过后恐山洪来袭 亚利桑那州历史上规模最大的森林火灾刚被控制，夏季风暴又来临，消防部门正将防灾重点转移到防止山洪破坏方面。 周二，特别消防管理团队在清理东部阿帕奇-司格利夫斯国家森林火场最后工作，完成防火线巡逻后，开始当地森林和白山阿帕奇部落的防汛工作。雨季来临，山洪不可避免。另外两个重大火灾现场也出现同样的担忧。 独立日晚一场小雷雨很快使小科罗拉多河变成汹涌的洪流，但暂时不会发展成洪灾。
c2445b9127e214fffa02158b260396bd7f4d8c59.translatedText: Flash floods feared after Arizona wildfires The largest forest fire in Arizona's history has just been contained and summer storms are approaching again, and fire departments are shifting their disaster prevention focus to preventing flash flood damage. Special fire management teams were working on the final cleanup of a fire in the eastern Apache-Screaves National Forest on Tuesday and completed fire break patrols before beginning flood control efforts in local forests and the White Mountain Apache Tribe. When the rainy season comes, flash floods are inevitable. The same concerns were raised at two other major fire scenes. A small thunderstorm late on Independence Day quickly turned the Little Colorado River into a raging torrent, but it was unlikely to develop into a flood just yet.

5b98a87e4b5015dc88c2bc9127260c44ca3d645a.sourceText: 为了迎接”亚省时报”创刊22周年，本报在2011年扩版为一周两期后，受到广大读者的好评，每周报刊都一抢而空。 为了有针对性的为更多读者服务，本报将在周三版隆重推出餐馆专版。 在餐馆专版中除了有美食专栏，餐馆信息介绍以外，还推出餐馆广告特惠，低价，高服务！ 广告价格低于50%以下，同时在亚省时报和”太阳鸟”亚省华人网 WWW.SUNBIRDARIZONA.COM 上同时刊出。
5b98a87e4b5015dc88c2bc9127260c44ca3d645a.translatedText: In order to welcome the 22nd anniversary of the founding of the "Alberta Times", the newspaper expanded to two issues a week in 2011. It was well received by readers and every week's newspaper was sold out. In order to serve more readers in a targeted manner, this newspaper will launch a special restaurant section in the Wednesday edition. 78f6ca6626ff69ebd6d49d66982e8bbc5810249e.sourceText: 这裡讲的钱氏国学三杰，指钱穆、钱基博和钱锺书父子，他们三人都是江苏无锡人，都是吴越王钱鏐的后裔，同宗不同支。无锡钱氏有两支，钱穆属湖头钱氏，钱基博、钱锺书属堠山钱氏，在惠山有共同的祠堂—钱武肃王祠，供奉世祖钱鏐等三世五王及诸无锡先祖。
78f6ca6626ff69ebd6d49d66982e8bbc5810249e.translatedText: The three masters of Qian's Chinese studies mentioned here refer to Qian Mu, Qian Jibo and Qian Zhongshu's father and son. The three of them are all natives of Wuxi, Jiangsu, and are descendants of King Qian Liu of Wuyue, from the same clan and different branches. There are two Qian clans in Wuxi. Qian Mu belongs to the Qian clan in Hutou, Qian Jibo and Qian Zhongshu belong to the Qian clan in Houshan. They have a common ancestral hall in Huishan - King Qian Wusu Temple, which worships the ancestor Qian Liu and other three generations and five kings as well as the ancestors of Wuxi.

1e36ab0e113013ffa08253bc1b0b15ae71db8858.translatedText: Qian Zhongshu and his father Qian Jibo

fa0451821f6d4200ed879a578ab3323930d1f320.sourceText: 钱锺书、杨绛伉俪 钱穆和钱基博、钱锺书情谊非常。「年大者称叔，年幼者称侄」，钱穆小钱基博12岁，称钱基博为叔；而钱锺书小钱穆15岁，称钱穆为叔。 光绪二十一年（1885年），钱穆（字宾四）出生于江南鱼米之乡的无锡鸿声七房桥的一家书香门第。他是当代着名的经史学家、享誉中外的国学大师、教育家。他自学成才，是一位没有读过大学的大学教授，并先后获得香港大学和美国耶鲁大学授予的名誉博士学位。
fa0451821f6d4200ed879a578ab3323930d1f320.translatedText: Qian Zhongshu and Yang Jiang Qian Mu, Qian Jibo and Qian Zhongshu have a very close friendship. "The older ones are called uncles, and the younger ones are called nephews." Qian Mu, the younger Qian Jibo, was 12 years old, and he called Qian Jibo his uncle; while Qian Zhongshu, the younger Qian Mu, was 15 years old, and he called Qian Mu his uncle. In the 21st year of Guangxu (1885), Qian Mu (zibinsi) was born into a scholarly family in Hongsheng Qifangqiao, Wuxi, a land of fish and rice in the south of the Yangtze River. He is a famous contemporary classics historian, a master of Chinese studies and an educator well-known at home and abroad. He is self-taught and is a university professor who has never attended university. He has received honorary doctorates from the University of Hong Kong and Yale University in the United States.

be8c9a5530ab384f10a06c0a8dc04214160d950f.sourceText: 钱穆在台北寓所「素书楼」编辑定稿的《中国学术思想史论丛》，全套共八册，汇集他 六十年的学术论文，也是他半个多世纪以来研究中国历史、民族文化的总结。
be8c9a5530ab384f10a06c0a8dc04214160d950f.translatedText: > Qian Mu edited and finalized the "History of Chinese Academic Thought Series" at his residence in Taipei, "Su Shulou". The complete set has eight volumes. It is a collection of his sixty years of academic papers and is also a summary of his research on Chinese history and national culture for more than half a century.

33bff8c69b0990fa9a358a545e3b926cb227d777.sourceText: 钱基博（字子泉）先生是钱锺书的父亲，着名的古文专家、国学大师。他的学问浩博无涯，诂经谈史，旁及诸子百家，都能抉择利弊，发其奥秘。钱基博四部皆通，对集部的着作，尤其精通。 父亲的好学、家中的藏书，使钱锺书如海纳百川，利用所有时间巨细无遗读书。钱穆回忆钱锺书时，称讚他早年就「博爱群书，宋以后集部殆无不过目」。他的勤学苦读，为他后来的学问打下良好的基础。 钱基博对子女的教育，重视在实践中提高。他指导钱锺书作文，让他代自己写信，到代自己写文章，因此进步很快。 商务印书馆要出版钱穆的专着《国学概论》，钱穆向钱基博徵序，钱基博竟也让钱锺书代笔。而初生牛犊的钱锺书略为思考后，居然提笔一气呵成。钱基博慎重其事阅读此文数遍，无一字改动。于是将此序以作者钱基博为名，交给钱穆，钱穆非常满意。当时外人、钱穆本人，都没有看出这篇序出自一名十七、八岁的青年之手。 钱穆和钱基博、钱锺书一样，都好学不倦、博闻强识。他们幼年读《三国演义》，也竟能由客任点，即刻背诵下文。故三人意气相投，交往甚密。 1933年夏天，钱锺书与无锡才女杨绛在苏州订婚，因钱基博身体欠佳，简单从事，只在苏州一家菜馆摆下酒席，邀请少数至亲好友赴宴，钱穆在被邀之列。宴席上，钱基博特地把未来的媳妇带到钱穆跟前，向杨绛介绍了「钱宾四先生」。 抗战胜利后，有一年暑假，钱氏三人在常熟的一个讲学会上不期而遇，喜出望外。他们同住一旅馆，朝夕相聚，交谈甚欢。 1949年以后，世事两茫茫，钱基博父子和钱穆再也没有见过面，然而却时常牵挂。钱穆离开大陆先后去了香港、台湾。后来他听说钱基博在湖北武汉去世，深为痛惜。他在《师友杂忆》中写道：然余「在集美、无锡、苏州三处积八年之久，同事逾百人，最敬事者，首推子泉。生平相交，治学之勤，待人之厚，亦首推子泉。」感叹：「继今余年无多，不知何年再得与其他未相见者一面」，言语中隐约流露未能与钱锺书再见面之憾。 1985年，苏州举办建城二千五百周年纪念活动，钱锺书受苏州有关方面委託，曾致书钱穆，邀请他回苏州参加盛会。信全文如下： 宾四宗老大师道座： 契阔暌违，忽五十戴。泰山仰止，鲁殿岿存。远播芳声，时殷遐想。前岁获睹大着忆旧一编，追忆先君，不遗狂简，故谊亲情，感均存殁。明年苏州市将举行建城二千五百年纪念大会，此间人士佥以公虽本贯吾邑，而桑梓与苏接壤，处廉让之间，又卜宅吴门，乃古方志所谓「名贤侨寓」。且于公钦心有素，捧手无缘，盛会适逢，良机难得，窃思届时奉屈贲临，以增光宠，俾遂瞻对。区区之私，正复齐心同愿。旧国旧乡，望之畅然，而况于闻闻见见，庄生至言，当蒙忻许，渴盼惠来。公家别具专信邀请，敬修片楮，聊申劝驾之微帎。衬拳边鼓，力薄而意则深也。即叩春安不备。
33bff8c69b0990fa9a358a545e3b926cb227d777.translatedText: Mr. Qian Jibo (also known as Ziquan) is the father of Qian Zhongshu, a famous expert on ancient Chinese literature and a master of Chinese studies. His knowledge is vast and boundless. He can expound scriptures and talk about history. He can judge the pros and cons and discover the secrets of hundreds of schools of thought. Qian Jibo is familiar with all four works, and is especially proficient in the works of Jibu. Because of his father's studiousness and the collection of books at home, Qian Zhongshu was able to read in detail and use all his time to read. When Qian Mu recalled Qian Zhongshu, he praised him for "loving all kinds of books in his early years, and after the Song Dynasty, he collected almost all books without exception." His diligent study laid a good foundation for his later knowledge. Qian Jibo attaches great importance to the education of his children through practice. He guided Qian Zhongshu in his composition, asking him to write letters for him, and then write articles on his behalf, so he made rapid progress. The Commercial Press wanted to publish Qian Mu's monograph "Introduction to Chinese Studies". Qian Mu asked Qian Jibo for a preface, but Qian Jibo actually asked Qian Zhongshu to ghostwrite it. Qian Zhongshu, a newborn calf, actually finished the work in one go after thinking about it for a while. Qian Jibo carefully read this article several times without changing a word. So this preface was given to Qian Mu in the name of the author Qian Jibo. Qian Mu was very satisfied. At that time, neither outsiders nor Qian Mu himself noticed that this preface was written by a young man of 17 or 18 years old. Qian Mu, like Qian Jibo and Qian Zhongshu, were both eager to learn and knowledgeable. When they read "The Romance of the Three Kingdoms" when they were young, they were able to recite the following text immediately after being asked to read it. Therefore, the three of them have similar minds and have close contacts. In the summer of 1933, Qian Zhongshu got engaged to Yang Jiang, a talented woman from Wuxi, in Suzhou. Because Qian Jibo was in poor health and was simply engaged in work, he only held a banquet in a restaurant in Suzhou and invited a few close relatives and friends to the banquet. Qian Mu was among the invitees. At the banquet, Qian Jibo specially brought his future wife to Qian Mu and introduced "Mr. Qian Binsi" to Yang Jiang. After the victory of the Anti-Japanese War, one summer vacation, the three Qians met by chance at a lecture in Changshu and were overjoyed. They lived in the same hotel, got together day and night, and talked happily. After 1949, the world was in a state of confusion. Qian Jibo, his son and Qian Mu never met again, but they were always concerned about each other. Qian Mu left the mainland and went to Hong Kong and Taiwan. Later, he heard that Qian Jibo had passed away in Wuhan, Hubei Province, and felt deeply saddened. He wrote in "Miscellaneous Memories of Teachers and Friends": However, he "worked in Jimei, Wuxi, and Suzhou for eight years, and worked with more than a hundred people. Among the most respectful people, Ziquan was the first to be praised. He had known him for his life-long friendship, diligence in scholarship, and kindness to others." He sighed: "There are not many years left, and I don't know when I will be able to meet other people I have never met again." His words vaguely revealed the regret of not being able to meet Qian Zhongshu again. In 1985, Suzhou held a commemoration event for the 2,500th anniversary of the founding of the city. Qian Zhongshu was entrusted by relevant parties in Suzhou and wrote to Qian Mu, inviting him to return to Suzhou to attend the event. The full text of the letter is as follows: Visiting the Taoist throne of the old master of the Four Sects: I have violated the agreement, and suddenly I am fifty. Mount Tai stands tall, and the Palace of Lu remains. The fragrant sound spreads far away, and the time is full of reverie. Last year I came across a large book called "Reminiscences of the Past", recalling the memory of our ancestors, without leaving any scraps behind. The old friendship, family ties, and feelings are all still there. Next year Suzhou will hold a commemoration meeting for the 2500th anniversary of the founding of the city. Although the people here are originally from Wuyi, Sangzi borders Suzhou and is located between Lianrang and Buzhai Wumen. It is what ancient local chronicles call "the residence of famous overseas Chinese". Moreover, Yu Gongqin was well aware of the situation and had no chance to hold hands. The grand meeting happened and the opportunity was rare. I secretly thought that Qu Ben would come at that time to increase his honor and favor, so that he could look forward to it. Mere selfishness is restored with one heart and one mind. The old country and the old hometown are full of hope, and what's more, when it comes to hearing, seeing, and seeing, Zhuang Sheng said that he should be grateful and eager for benefits. The official sent a special letter to invite you, to repair the piece of paper, and to talk to you and persuade you to come. Lining the fist with the drum, the strength is weak but the intention is deep. That is to say, the Spring Festival is unprepared.

4e2f5aed7d1801f6090a2ab820e608e806e54efe.translatedText: Zongmo Zhongshu wrote that Yang Jiang was waiting on February 3, 1985.

cef4d0e6c8584423626ee551ac7e48a40cde5ead.sourceText: 钱穆收到信后，因健康原因未能光临苏州盛会。1986年3月，应台北《联合月刊》之请，九十二岁高龄的钱穆发表《丙寅新春看时局》，指出「此下的中国，只有全中国和平统一始是个大前途、大希望。和平统一是本中国的文化精神和民族性的大前途、大理想、大原则之所在」。稍后北京《人民日报》发表了该文的摘要，这是1949年后钱穆的文字首次见诸大陆报刊。钱穆先生高瞻远瞩，对整个中国的未来表达了他的深切关怀。他的的爱国言论，在海峡两岸反应热烈，影响深远。
cef4d0e6c8584423626ee551ac7e48a40cde5ead.translatedText: After Qian Mu received the letter, he was unable to attend the Suzhou event due to health reasons. In March 1986, at the invitation of Taipei's "United Monthly", the 92-year-old Qian Mu published "Looking at the Current Situation in the Bingyin New Year", pointing out that "in China today, only the peaceful reunification of the whole of China is a great future and a great hope. Peaceful reunification is the great future, great ideal, and great principle of China's cultural spirit and national character." Later, Beijing's "People's Daily" published an abstract of the article. This was the first time Qian Mu's writings appeared in mainland newspapers after 1949. Mr. Qian Mu was far-sighted and expressed his deep concern for the future of China as a whole. His patriotic remarks received enthusiastic response from both sides of the Taiwan Strait and had far-reaching influence.
