5c1862ad9a81268df2717f396cefa6e440d28c35.sourceText: 记得六、七岁时，我随父母从大城市搬迁到一个依山傍水的小城镇生活。那里环境清静、民风淳朴。由于父亲是医生、母亲是护士，收入高，人缘也好。常有樵夫和渔家把鲜果与活鱼送卖到家门前，让我们精挑细选，价钱也便宜。有时母亲不想要又不好推托，只好说还未发工资，但他们说不介意，下次一起算。 河畔有茶楼，假日，父母常带我们去饮茶。我记得最爱吃的是叉烧包和萨骑马，尤其是萨骑马，香甜爽脆，每次都吃得津津有味。那时我脸上肥嘟嘟的，母亲就给我起了个别名叫「云吞」。大家都说我有个幸福的童年。 到一九五八年，因有海外关係，属医务高干的父亲下放到干部农场去「改造」，很久才能回家一次，人也变得又黑又瘦。母亲也因而病倒，家境自此一落千丈，十七虚龄的大姐也只有辍学到医院做勤杂，以帮助家计。 那时，大陆已进入大饥荒年代，人间悲剧一幕幕地发生，在医院里，常有「男人变女人，女人变男人」的惨状，那是指男人因水肿大了肚子，女人因严重贫瘦，子宫也下垂了出来。那期间，每人每月配油四两，是糠油：偶尔有肉配给，但要絶早去排队，迟到就没有卖了。墟场上曾有过叉烧包卖，但后来发现是用死人肉做的。 曾经有过一段「看饼的日子」。那时饿了，便到茶楼柜枱上看饼，那里的叉烧包和萨骑马早已消失，换成形形式式的杂粮馒头，还有掺杂着米糠或稻草做的「高级饼」。有些要六角钱一个，相当于大姐一天的工资，所以每次都只能啜着口水，依依不捨地离开。白天看多了，晚上做梦也是父亲带我去茶楼，但吃了半天都吃不饱，醒来更饿，便哭着对妈妈说：「妈，我要吃叉烧包，我要吃萨骑马。」妈搂着我说：「仔仔乖，现在买不到叉烧，家里也没有油…..。」不知从甚麽时候起，妈妈已不叫我「云吞」，其实我瘦得更像「面条」。哭着哭着便停了，因为妈妈的泪水也滴在我脸上，「孩子」，妈说道：「妈想办法给你做萨骑马……。」
5c1862ad9a81268df2717f396cefa6e440d28c35.translatedText: I remember when I was six or seven, I moved with my parents from the big city to live in a small town surrounded by mountains and rivers. The environment there is quiet and the people are simple. Because his father is a doctor and his mother is a nurse, they have high income and good popularity. Woodcutters and fishermen often sell fresh fruits and live fish to our doorsteps, allowing us to choose carefully and at low prices. Sometimes the mother doesn't want it and can't evade it, so she has to say that the salary has not been paid yet, but they say they don't mind and they will figure it out together next time. There was a teahouse by the river, and my parents often took us to drink tea during holidays. I remember that my favorite foods were barbecued pork buns and squid, especially the squid, which was sweet and crispy and I ate it with relish every time. I had a chubby face at that time, so my mother nicknamed me "Wonton". Everyone says I had a happy childhood. By 1958, because of his overseas connections, my father, a senior medical official, was sent to a cadre farm for "rehabilitation." It took him a long time to return home, and he became dark and thin. The mother fell ill as a result, and the family's financial situation plummeted. The seventeen-year-old eldest sister had to drop out and go to the hospital to do odd jobs to help the family. At that time, the mainland had entered the era of great famine, and human tragedies were happening one after another. In hospitals, there were often tragic scenes of "men turning into women, and women turning into men." This meant that men had enlarged bellies due to edema, and women had prolapsed uteruses due to severe poverty. During that period, each person was rationed four taels of oil per month, which was bran oil. Occasionally, meat was rationed, but you had to queue up early. If you were late, it wouldn't be sold. Barbecued pork buns were once sold at the market, but later it was discovered that they were made from dead human flesh. There once was a time of "looking at the bread." I was hungry at that time, so I went to the teahouse counter to look at cakes. The barbecued pork buns and squid buns there had long since disappeared, replaced by various types of multigrain steamed buns, and "high-end cakes" made with rice bran or straw. Some of them cost six cents each, which was equivalent to a day's salary for the eldest sister, so every time I could only sip my saliva and leave reluctantly. I watched too much during the day, and at night I dreamed of my father taking me to a teahouse, but after eating for a long time, I couldn’t eat enough. I woke up even more hungry, so I cried and said to my mother: "Mom, I want to eat barbecued pork buns, and I want to eat squid." Mom hugged me and said, "Hey, dear, I can't buy barbecued pork now, and there is no oil at home..." I don't know when my mother stopped calling me "wontons". In fact, I look more like "noodles". I stopped crying because my mother's tears were also falling on my face. "Son," my mother said, "Mom will try to make a horse-drawn cake for you..."

7694a9c6aa96817fcc59d78d1344dcf92cb36a28.sourceText: 过了些时候，在香港的舅父寄来了几磅花生油，虽然打税很重，妈还是拿了回来，并在我生日那天，真的做起了萨骑马。没有面粉，便用番薯粉代替，加水搓成粉团，并压平切成小薄片，然后用油炸脆，捞起后把油彻底沥乾，再把「古巴糖」和成糖浆，淋在上面，便成了我盼望已久的「萨骑马」了。 糖浆尚未沥乾，我便狼吞虎咽地吃了起来，那味道简直比茶楼的要好上一百倍。但吃着吃着，便感到这东西的顔色和味道与茶楼的萨骑马不一样，便对妈妈说：「妈妈，这不是萨骑马嘛，是甚麽东西啊﹖」妈见我吃得开心，便说道：「这不是萨骑马，是妈做给你的生日礼物，叫’萨骑牛’。」当时母子俩笑成一团，难得高兴了半天。 不久，由于贫病交加，母亲不幸去世了。失去母爱的日子，就像寒冬中没有了太阳，童年的往事不堪回首，只有母亲做的「萨骑牛」还留给我一些甜蜜、温暖的回忆。长大后，直至来到美国，我却没有去重做一次「萨骑牛」，因为我知道，「萨骑牛」，并不会比「萨骑马」更好吃，一个人的感受会随着环境改变而改变。人的一生中会吃过无数的食物，但能像岛屿一样存在脑海中的恐怕不多。食物也许和事物一样，如人们常说的：「往事只能回味」。但我更觉得，我们应该对那个只能用「萨骑牛」，代替「萨骑马」的年代，有着更深刻的认识和反思。 我永远怀念在那苦难的岁月中，母亲做给我的「萨骑牛」。
7694a9c6aa96817fcc59d78d1344dcf92cb36a28.translatedText: After some time, my uncle in Hong Kong sent me a few pounds of peanut oil. Although the tax was heavy, my mother still took it back, and on my birthday, I really started making a horse-drawn cake. If there is no flour, I use sweet potato flour instead, add water and knead it into a dough, flatten it and cut it into small slices, then fry it until crispy, remove it and drain the oil completely, then mix "Cuban sugar" into syrup and pour it on top, and it becomes the "Sasa" that I have been looking forward to for a long time. Before the syrup was drained, I ate it hungrily. The taste was a hundred times better than the one in the teahouse. But as I ate it, I felt that the color and taste of this thing were different from the Sa Qi Niu in the teahouse, so I said to my mother: "Mom, isn't this a Sa Qi Niu? What is it?" When my mother saw that I was eating happily, she said, "This is not a Sa Qi Niu. It is a birthday gift from my mother. It's called 'Sa Qi Niu'." At that time, the mother and son laughed together, and they were rarely happy for a long time. Soon, due to poverty and illness, her mother unfortunately passed away. The days of losing mother's love are like losing the sun in the cold winter. The memories of my childhood are hard to look back on. Only the "Sa Qiu Niu" made by my mother still leaves me some sweet and warm memories. When I grew up, until I came to the United States, I did not try to make "Saqiu Niu" again, because I knew that "Saqiu Niu" would not be more delicious than "Saqiu Niu", and a person's feelings will change as the environment changes. A person will eat countless foods in his life, but probably not many can remain in his mind like an island. Food may be the same as things, as people often say: "The past can only be recalled." But I think we should have a deeper understanding and reflection on the era when we could only use "Sa riding a bull" instead of "Sa riding a horse". I will always miss the "Sa Riding Bull" that my mother made for me during those difficult years.

6cba777570cb963faaf32a635d45866833e57a8c.translatedText: (This article was published in the supplement of "World Journal")

ad0661bfce5c3c541d20afda326b2aa4e2b41dad.sourceText: 【多维财经】据政府公布的指数显示，美国房价出现了六年半以来的最大季度涨幅，这是美国住房市场在经历长期低迷后趋稳的又一迹象。
ad0661bfce5c3c541d20afda326b2aa4e2b41dad.translatedText: [Duowei Finance] According to an index released by the government, U.S. home prices experienced the largest quarterly increase in six and a half years, which is another sign that the U.S. housing market is stabilizing after a long period of downturn.

5a8f504d11741a8d63df7946e2894e353ad3d785.sourceText: 美国联邦住房金融局(Federal Housing Finance Agency, 简称FHFA)周四（8月23日）表示，美国4-6月份房价较第一季度上涨1.8%。这是房价自2005年第四季度以来的最大季度涨幅，当时的涨幅为2.2%。第二季度房价较上年同期上涨3%。
5a8f504d11741a8d63df7946e2894e353ad3d785.translatedText: The Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA) said on Thursday (August 23) that U.S. housing prices rose 1.8% from April to June compared with the first quarter. This was the biggest quarterly gain since the fourth quarter of 2005, when prices rose 2.2%. House prices rose 3% in the second quarter compared with the same period last year.

1f3d0d9634e2a48fc853495c99b5bf5b80a6266c.sourceText: 按月计算，经季节性因素调整后6月份房价较5月份上涨0.7%，涨幅高于预期。接受道琼斯通讯社(Dow Jones Newswires)调查的经济学家此前预计，6月份房价环比上涨0.6%。5月份房价经修正后为环比上涨0.6%，初值为上涨0.8%。 (汪蕾 编辑)
1f3d0d9634e2a48fc853495c99b5bf5b80a6266c.translatedText: On a monthly basis, house prices in June increased by 0.7% compared with May after adjusting for seasonal factors, and the increase was higher than expected. Economists surveyed by Dow Jones Newswires had expected home prices to rise 0.6% in June from the previous month. House prices in May were revised to rise by 0.6% month-on-month, compared with the initial value of 0.8%. (Edited by Wang Lei)

e20124ac349dbd5481345fb0f012f36563205f6e.sourceText: 太多的万圣节糖果怎么办？卖了它换钱。本地一些牙医和牙齿矫正师合作，为2011年万圣节糖果提供回购。5磅以内，每磅糖果1-2元。参加回购糖果的商家超过40家，遍布全州各地。回收的糖果将送给在海外服役的美国大兵。有关参与商家地址详情，请上网： http://www.halloweencandybuyback.com/
e20124ac349dbd5481345fb0f012f36563205f6e.translatedText: What to do with too much Halloween candy? Sold it for money. A group of local dentists and orthodontists have teamed up to offer buy-backs for the 2011 Halloween candy. Candies under 5 pounds cost 1-2 yuan per pound. There are more than 40 merchants participating in the candy buyback, spread across the state. Recycled candy will be given to American soldiers serving overseas. For details of participating merchant addresses, please go online: http://www.halloweencandybuyback.com/

232e42570994b5548fb159153220a8e4a80f6601.translatedText: Peking University formally sued Zou Hengfu, citing three "serious" accusations

6b25efb6ddb9895c75b7d3dc6dc6cb56c313cc70.sourceText: 北大正式起诉邹恒甫 斥以三个“严重” 自8月21日邹恒甫微博发出涉及北京大学的内容之后，北京大学高度重视，…
6b25efb6ddb9895c75b7d3dc6dc6cb56c313cc70.translatedText: Peking University formally sued Zou Hengfu, citing three "serious" accusations. Since Zou Hengfu posted content involving Peking University on Weibo on August 21, Peking University has attached great importance to it...

a4d8c9d71a96b60331b111116bcc7b3044bb2a66.sourceText: 我们认为， 这一罕见的恶劣事件严重损害了北京大学的声誉和教师队伍的形象，严重践踏了北京大学院长、系主任和教授们的尊严，严重伤害了北京大学师生员工和校友们的感情，也伤及了梦桃源餐厅的无辜员工。
a4d8c9d71a96b60331b111116bcc7b3044bb2a66.translatedText: We believe that, This rare and bad incident has seriously damaged the reputation of Peking University and the image of its teaching staff. It has seriously trampled on the dignity of the dean, department heads and professors of Peking University. It has seriously hurt the feelings of teachers, students, employees and alumni of Peking University. It has also hurt the innocent employees of Mengtaoyuan Restaurant.

938c4164a2a07cb78034654148ab81f89f46ecb3.sourceText: 我们认为，十一天以来，邹恒甫歪曲事实、蒙蔽真相，欺骗隐身、误导舆论，转移视线、混淆视听。这种无视法律、愚弄公众的拙劣行径，不仅是极端不负责任的，而且破坏了现代文明社会的基本行为准则，是决不能容忍的。
938c4164a2a07cb78034654148ab81f89f46ecb3.translatedText: We believe that over the past eleven days, Zou Hengfu has distorted facts, obscured the truth, deceived and concealed himself, misled public opinion, diverted attention, and confused the public. This kind of clumsy behavior that ignores the law and fools the public is not only extremely irresponsible, but also undermines the basic behavioral norms of modern civilized society and must not be tolerated.

f6ca350e29eee4078bf4240a3e690965451483e7.sourceText: 我们认为，反观事态的发展过程，邹恒甫的表现越来越成为一场”闹剧”，继续期望他提供所谓”证据”来全面彻底查清事件真相，不仅不切实际，而且毫无意义。
f6ca350e29eee4078bf4240a3e690965451483e7.translatedText: We believe that, looking back at the development of the situation, Zou Hengfu's performance has become more and more a "farce". It is not only unrealistic but also meaningless to continue to expect him to provide so-called "evidence" to fully and thoroughly find out the truth of the incident.

436cec46f5903ca6e71103b578e1542dba3bebda.sourceText: 为此，北京大学授权新闻中心，特发布声明如下：
436cec46f5903ca6e71103b578e1542dba3bebda.translatedText: To this end, the Peking University Authorized News Center has issued the following statement:

3c7b94c46e637e24e32d952a596eaaff0d092349.sourceText: 1.起诉邹恒甫，起诉书已于本日递交法院。
3c7b94c46e637e24e32d952a596eaaff0d092349.translatedText: 1. The indictment against Zou Hengfu has been submitted to the court today.

84d179eb81216dc145cc1f7095d0700646bb0663.sourceText: 2.自本声明发布之日起，相关工作正式进入法律程序。如无特殊情况，不再对此事件做出进一步回应。
84d179eb81216dc145cc1f7095d0700646bb0663.translatedText: 2. From the date of this statement, the relevant work has officially entered the legal process. Unless there are special circumstances, there will be no further response to this incident.

5f6eb8cbc52626e7a7ad6f68995137728871a77f.sourceText: 3.北京大学纪委监察室一如既往欢迎社会各界(包括邹恒甫)继续以负责任的态度依法依规反映问题。
5f6eb8cbc52626e7a7ad6f68995137728871a77f.translatedText: 3. The Discipline Inspection and Supervision Office of Peking University, as always, welcomes all sectors of society (including Zou Hengfu) to continue to report problems in a responsible manner in accordance with the law and regulations.

0c00faf852c8a828e5b556892e02fc07ae8c7771.sourceText: 4.正告仍在侵害北京大学声誉的其他个人或机构，立即停止违法行为。
0c00faf852c8a828e5b556892e02fc07ae8c7771.translatedText: 4. Warn other individuals or institutions that are still damaging the reputation of Peking University to stop illegal activities immediately.

1f1a764f95a480fd5570954f1df422842bd03583.sourceText: 我们希望，司法机关尽快以事实为依据，以法律为准绳，做出公正判决，还事实以真相，还北大以声誉，还网络以秩序，还社会以公道，还受害者以清白。
1f1a764f95a480fd5570954f1df422842bd03583.translatedText: We hope that the judicial organs will make a fair judgment based on facts and the law as soon as possible, return the truth to the facts, restore the reputation of Peking University, restore order to the Internet, restore justice to society, and restore innocence to the victims.

a7f01c3190343fcee219d05304c80108522c2082.sourceText: 受伤女议员将出席观看丈夫航天飞机发射 美国国会女众议员吉福兹，由于在遭受枪击脑受伤的康复情况稳步恢复，已经获得康复医院的许可，亲临现场出席观看航天飞机奋进号发射升空。而她的丈夫就是这次航天任务的指挥官。 宇航员麦克. 凯利告诉哥伦比亚广播公司晚间新闻主播凯蒂. 库瑞克说，吉福兹议员在得克萨斯州休斯顿市的医生说，她可以飞往佛罗里达的卡纳维拉尔角观看星期五奋进号航天飞机发射升空。凯利是这次航天任务的指挥官。美国总统奥巴马和家人也将出席观看奋进号最后一次任务的发射升空。 这将是吉福兹自 1 月 21 日由图森飞往休斯顿的康复中心以来她的第一次旅行。此前她 1 月 8 日被枪击。其他 6 人在那次事件中死亡。遇难者包括一名 9 岁的女孩，一名联邦法官和一名国会工作人员。被指控的枪手、 22 岁的拉夫纳对于袭击衍生的 49 项罪名均表示不认罪。
a7f01c3190343fcee219d05304c80108522c2082.translatedText: The injured congresswoman will attend to watch her husband's space shuttle launch. U.S. Congresswoman Giffords, who is recovering steadily from a brain injury suffered from a gunshot, has obtained permission from the rehabilitation hospital to attend the launch of the space shuttle Endeavor in person. And her husband is the commander of this space mission. Astronaut Mike Kelly told CBS Evening News anchor Katie Couric that Senator Giffords' doctor in Houston, Texas, said she could fly to Cape Canaveral, Florida, to watch Friday's launch of the Space Shuttle Endeavor. Kelly is the commander of the space mission. U.S. President Obama and his family will also attend to watch the launch of Endeavor's final mission. This will be Giffords' first trip since flying from Tucson to a rehab facility in Houston on Jan. 21. She was previously shot on January 8th. Six other people died in that incident. The victims included a 9-year-old girl, a federal judge and a congressional staffer. The accused gunman, 22-year-old Loughner, has pleaded not guilty to 49 counts stemming from the attack.

153a3414300e0953590ed84463ad27bbd23a02a9.sourceText: （亚省华联供稿）为方便和服务广大侨胞，中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆证件组李智敬领事和高雪松领事于2013年4月6日亲临凤凰城，为侨胞现场受理中国护照换发和补发的申请。亚省华联受中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆的委托，邀请大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会一道共同协助办理此次中国护照换发和补发的申请。在亚省华联的统一组织和协调下，在大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会的积极协助下，以及在亚省时报、亚美报、美西侨报、”太阳鸟”亚省华人网、中粮进出口公司凤凰城分公司、环球旅行社、和众多志愿者们的大力支持下，办证服务顺利结束。 两位领事以认真负责的工作态度，耐心解答每一个问题，在办证当天现场受理众多中国护照换发和补发的证件申请，赢得广大侨胞的一致好评！除当地侨胞外，还有从 Show Low 远道而来的侨胞们。总领事馆证件组到当地现场办公服务，的确为侨胞和留学生们解决了实际问题，大大节省了他们亲自到洛杉矶总领事馆办证的时间和各种费用。 志愿者们利用个人的休息时间，进行了具体繁多的事前准备。在办证现场为前来办证的侨胞们提供了一条龙服务，包括：填表、复印、照相。志愿者们齐心协力，相互配合，有始有终，为此次办证服务的顺利进行做了大量工作。侨胞们称，此次办证服务是近两年来最成功的一次。在此，向总领事馆证件组两位领事和义务志愿者：费健、陶世诚、赵益衔、王惟咨、李健、汪阳、张华芳、崔增祁、谢大卫、秋香、Kenny Fung，等表示衷心的谢意！
153a3414300e0953590ed84463ad27bbd23a02a9.translatedText: (Contributed by Alberta Hualian) In order to facilitate and serve the vast number of overseas Chinese, Consul Li Zhijing and Consul Gao Xuesong from the Document Section of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles visited Phoenix on April 6, 2013 to accept applications for Chinese passport renewal and reissue on-site for overseas Chinese. Entrusted by the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, the Hualian Federation of Alberta invited the Greater Phoenix Chinese Overseas Chinese Association to assist in the application for the renewal and reissue of Chinese passports. Under the unified organization and coordination of the Chinese Federation of Alberta, with the active assistance of the Greater Phoenix Chinese Overseas Chinese Association, and with the strong support of the Alberta Times, Asian American News, Western American News, "Sunbird" Chinese Chinese Network, COFCO Import and Export Phoenix Branch, Global Travel Agency, and many volunteers, the certification service was successfully completed. With a serious and responsible work attitude, the two consuls patiently answered every question and accepted numerous applications for Chinese passport renewal and reissue on the day of application, winning unanimous praise from overseas Chinese! In addition to local overseas Chinese, there are also overseas Chinese who come from afar from Show Low. The document team of the Consulate General provides on-site office services in the local area, which has indeed solved practical problems for overseas Chinese and international students, greatly saving them the time and various expenses of going to the Consulate General in Los Angeles to apply for certificates in person. The volunteers used their personal rest time to make detailed and extensive preparations in advance. At the certificate application site, a one-stop service is provided for overseas Chinese who come to apply for certificates, including: filling out forms, copying, and taking photos. The volunteers worked together, cooperated with each other, and continued from beginning to end, and did a lot of work for the smooth progress of this certificate service. The overseas Chinese said that this certificate application service was the most successful in the past two years. Here, I would like to express my heartfelt thanks to the two consuls and volunteer volunteers of the Documentation Section of the Consulate General: Fei Jian, Tao Shicheng, Zhao Yixian, Wang Weizi, Li Jian, Wang Yang, Zhang Huafang, Cui Zengqi, Xie David, Qiuxiang, Kenny Fung, etc.!

ea2138b8e3db4f494e9c26173a96c3d496a91825.sourceText: 明年社会安全金将有七大变化 社会安全金是美国最重要的项目之一。到今年8月，全美有6150万民众享受到了这项福利…
ea2138b8e3db4f494e9c26173a96c3d496a91825.translatedText: > There will be seven major changes in social security benefits next year. Social security benefits are one of the most important programs in the United States. As of August this year, 61.5 million people in the United States have enjoyed this benefit...

85ad848092d0e1e4e10083a8aaa005dcde7e7b01.sourceText: 社会安全金是美国最重要的项目之一。到今年8月，全美有6150万民众享受到了这项福利，其中4200万人是退休劳工。大约有62%的退休劳工每月一半以上的收入来自社会安全金。
85ad848092d0e1e4e10083a8aaa005dcde7e7b01.translatedText: Social security funds are one of the most important programs in the United States. As of August this year, 61.5 million people in the United States have enjoyed this benefit, of which 42 million are retired workers. About 62% of retired workers receive more than half of their monthly income from Social Security benefits.

6ad412376385b07e8002e95f3fba132e5c8c214f.sourceText: 据《今日美国报》报道，2018年，社会安全金将发生7大变化。
6ad412376385b07e8002e95f3fba132e5c8c214f.translatedText: According to USA Today, there will be 7 major changes in social security benefits in 2018.

96adc0b61b9d9f74a2161da1c1806cbaab799b4b.sourceText: 在2018年，由于通货膨胀的原因，享受社会安全福利的退休劳工平均每月可以多领到27美元。这将是6年来增加金额最多的一年。
96adc0b61b9d9f74a2161da1c1806cbaab799b4b.translatedText: In 2018, due to inflation, retired workers who enjoy Social Security benefits can receive an average of US$27 more per month. This will be the largest increase in six years.

9974bd87798ccd5e520679b68e27163739f57a3e.sourceText: 不过，也不要高兴得太早。如果你享受”白卡”福利，2018年”白卡”的支出将增多，而这将影响你可以获得的福利的总额。幸运的是，这项支出增加的幅度小于社安金福利增加的幅度。
9974bd87798ccd5e520679b68e27163739f57a3e.translatedText: However, don’t be too happy too early. If you enjoy "white card" benefits, your "white card" expenses will increase in 2018, and this will affect the total amount of benefits you can receive. Fortunately, this increase in spending is smaller than the increase in Social Security benefits.

6736ca595859f7f3505228686d3847680c3e7f24.translatedText: 2. The upper limit of social security benefits is increased

8d72f7b12b8fee327a7c72390fabe064777c8395.sourceText: 如果你在退休时能满足领取最多数额的社安金的条件，你在2018年领到的社安金将增加。这笔金额在2018年每月将增加101美元，达到每月2788美元。
8d72f7b12b8fee327a7c72390fabe064777c8395.translatedText: If you can meet the conditions for receiving the maximum amount of social security benefits when you retire, the social security benefits you receive in 2018 will increase. This amount will increase by $101 per month in 2018 to $2,788 per month.

24e7ba0c53006b2ba8e90bfbb5c40a090503bdfa.translatedText: 3. The rich should pay more taxes

0750c32501246cf43324158b14c243147914c0be.sourceText: 2017年，劳工收入在1美分到12.72万美元的部分须交12.4%的所得税，这些钱将进入社会安全基金。到2018年，收入上限将从12.72万美元升高到12.87万美元，上升1500美元。
0750c32501246cf43324158b14c243147914c0be.translatedText: In 2017, labor income between 1 cent and 127,200 US dollars must pay an income tax of 12.4%, and the money will go into the social security fund. In 2018, the income limit will increase from $127,200 to $128,700, an increase of $1,500.

857e83fc662cef41516f70dad5fec4e93064fec1.sourceText: 如果被雇用，通常由劳工和雇主分别支付这笔税的一半。这意味着，绝大多数美国民众要交6.2%的所得税，这部分钱会进入社会安全基金。
857e83fc662cef41516f70dad5fec4e93064fec1.translatedText: If employed, half of this tax is usually paid by the worker and half by the employer. This means that the vast majority of Americans have to pay an income tax of 6.2%, and this money will go into the Social Security Fund.

b3877dabbf20a3e9f3f61fa786052ceaa3fd9d95.sourceText: 2018年，随着最高纳税金额升高，收入高于12.87万美元的富人将至少多交93美元的税，这些钱也会进入社会安全基金。
b3877dabbf20a3e9f3f61fa786052ceaa3fd9d95.translatedText: In 2018, as the maximum tax amount increases, wealthy people with incomes above $128,700 will pay at least $93 more in taxes, and this money will also go into the Social Security Fund.

4fec65b69407ee2442702ae83e598667be3cf2bc.translatedText: 4. The full retirement age will increase

0659574447e443ab09e703b4b00a81e07abfdcdc.sourceText: 2018年，新的退休者得等到66岁零4个月，才可以享受完全的退休福利，与2017年相比增加了两个月。
0659574447e443ab09e703b4b00a81e07abfdcdc.translatedText: In 2018, new retirees will have to wait until they are 66 years and 4 months before they can enjoy full retirement benefits, an increase of two months compared with 2017.

0b8c090de6e9781f1243b13056c94ff8c7dbcf4d.translatedText: 5. The deduction point for early recipients will be raised

2bcf2e3aff3120edcdb04521b9f6015bec8801ec.sourceText: 2017年，还没有达到完全退休年龄的人，年收入超过1万6920美元，如果要领取社安金，需要在超过1万6920美元的收入部分每2美元的收入扣减1美元的福利。而在2018年，这个起扣金额将上升到1万7040美元。
2bcf2e3aff3120edcdb04521b9f6015bec8801ec.translatedText: In 2017, for those who have not yet reached full retirement age and whose annual income exceeds US$16,920, if they want to receive Social Security benefits, they need to deduct US$1 in benefits for every US$2 of income above US$16,920. In 2018, this threshold will rise to $17,040.

60d502c8f785817d4bc225318c8be4b06787a299.translatedText: 6. Social Security Benefits for People with Disabilities Slightly Increase

d1a6934930f92478ed52cf5033cb8e785b5db162.sourceText: 如果你从社安金中领取残疾人补助，你能获得的福利将有所增加。2018年，非盲人类别的残疾人每月领取的社安金将增加10美元，达到每月1180美元；盲人的补助金每月将升高20美元，达到每月1970美元。
d1a6934930f92478ed52cf5033cb8e785b5db162.translatedText: If you receive disability benefits from Social Security Funds, the benefits you can receive will increase. In 2018, the monthly Social Security benefit received by non-blind disabled people will increase by US$10 to US$1,180 per month; the benefit for the blind will increase by US$20 per month, to US$1,970 per month.

1bf79e03d212fc6ee47f6f75ab8a228c103f6146.translatedText: 7. The threshold for obtaining social security benefits is raised

60d7a2c5dd43381160c6cf671c2a840059204404.sourceText: 如果要获得社安金和其它福利，需要获得40个工作积分，每年最多可以获得4个积分。
60d7a2c5dd43381160c6cf671c2a840059204404.translatedText: If you want to obtain social security benefits and other benefits, you need to obtain 40 work points, and you can get up to 4 points per year.

8e3c2c9ddee0bf8a5679f8df766abebbcd9adaa6.sourceText: 2017年，每获得1300美元的收入可以获得1个积分，因此年收入达到5200美元可以获得全部4个积分。
8e3c2c9ddee0bf8a5679f8df766abebbcd9adaa6.translatedText: In 2017, you will earn 1 point for every $1,300 in income, so you will earn all 4 points if your annual income reaches $5,200.

647e8e088c5907462629d99b0e13a013bbe0f7b7.sourceText: 不过，到2018年，每获得1320美元的收入才可以获得1个积分，因此年收入达到5280美元裁可以获得全部4个积分。
647e8e088c5907462629d99b0e13a013bbe0f7b7.translatedText: However, in 2018, you will only receive 1 point for every $1,320 in income, so you will receive all 4 points if your annual income reaches $5,280.

262aa1cce7d1132f105a7bf4a8de087321a3658e.sourceText: 亚省侨联换届选举今晚(2012年3月8日晚8时)在耆英会举行，在刚刚结束的投票中，张华芳以21:13的优势顺利当选新一届侨联主席！David Yee当选为第一副主席，崔增祁当选为第二副主席，张肇鸿当选为第三副主席。
262aa1cce7d1132f105a7bf4a8de087321a3658e.translatedText: > The general election of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Alberta was held tonight (8:00 pm on March 8, 2012) at the Senior Citizens Association. In the just-concluded voting, Zhang Huafang was successfully elected as the new chairman of the Federation of Overseas Chinese with an advantage of 21:13! David Yee was elected as the first vice chairman, Cui Zengqi was elected as the second vice chairman, and Zhang Zhaohong was elected as the third vice chairman.

8011bb2dceb0b1d7a396ef57323268233bd44112.sourceText: 大凤凰城侨联总会2012年度新职员表 如下 主席: 张华芳

12fbce63789c7205e52797ab50902d6105d162fb.translatedText: Heavy snow fell in northern cities and hail fell in Phoenix

8c6b1f6758f1f8482dba9330657ea3ce67edd8dd.sourceText: 北部城市迎来大雪 凤凰城下冰雹 今天（周三）凌晨亚利桑那北部城市Flagstaff下起了大雪。西北部下了半…
8c6b1f6758f1f8482dba9330657ea3ce67edd8dd.translatedText: Heavy snow fell in northern cities and hail fell in Phoenix. Heavy snow fell in the northern Arizona city of Flagstaff in the early morning of today (Wednesday). It rained heavily in the northwest...

a75abeb1640ad0bb74a2e4ccf301343efcee6b79.sourceText: 今天（周三）凌晨亚利桑那北部城市Flagstaff下起了大雪。西北部下了半英寸的大雨，部分60号公路被迫关闭。由于大雪的压力，交通部门已经关闭Superior 到 Miami的路段一直到中午。图桑的高尔夫球赛也被迫延迟。到下午两点左右，凤凰城中部下起了大冰雹，Camelback以南17号高速被迫受影响。根据CBS 5的报道，周三的气温比周二速降了近20华氏度。 安全预警：周三晚上7点开始亚利桑那南部地区Pima, Pinal, Santa Cruz, Cochise, Greenlee and Graham将会遭遇大的降雪。交通部门表示亚利桑那东北部的驾驶人员要做好防雨雪驾驶的准备。
a75abeb1640ad0bb74a2e4ccf301343efcee6b79.translatedText: It snowed heavily in the northern Arizona city of Flagstaff early this morning (Wednesday). Half an inch of rain fell in the northwest, closing part of Route 60. Due to heavy snow pressure, the Department of Transportation has closed the Superior to Miami section until noon. Golf tournaments in Tucson were also postponed. By around 2 p.m., heavy hail fell in central Phoenix, affecting Highway 17 south of Camelback. According to CBS 5, temperatures on Wednesday dropped nearly 20 degrees Fahrenheit from Tuesday. Safety Advisory: Pima, Pinal, Santa Cruz, Cochise, Greenlee and Graham in southern Arizona will experience heavy snowfall starting at 7 p.m. Wednesday. The Department of Transportation says drivers in Northeast Arizona should be prepared to drive in rain and snow.

ec08090fbfd8e634c5026d923677fb78d97db3bd.sourceText: ２月２０日下午２时 凤凰城下大冰雹
ec08090fbfd8e634c5026d923677fb78d97db3bd.translatedText: At 2:00 pm on February 20, heavy hail fell in Phoenix

d48a29299a8c4bc561493cc826105aa5fb5bb47e.translatedText: A bizarre traffic accident occurred in California. A car "flyed" into the second floor of a house.

8c6fa1c1fa25a785ce4ba72158a285d20ab3923c.sourceText: 美加州发生离奇交通事故 汽车””飞进””房屋二楼 中新网1…
8c6fa1c1fa25a785ce4ba72158a285d20ab3923c.translatedText: A bizarre traffic accident occurred in California. A car "flyed" into the second floor of a house. China News Service 1...

e5025d6f710d91c2715b6527c2b45b4115378601.sourceText: 中新网1月15日电 据外媒报道，当地时间14日，美国加州圣安娜发生一起严重交通事故，一辆汽车撞入当地一栋房屋，并被卡在了建筑物的二楼。
e5025d6f710d91c2715b6527c2b45b4115378601.translatedText: China News Service, January 15. According to foreign media reports, on the 14th local time, a serious traffic accident occurred in Santa Ana, California, USA. A car crashed into a local house and was stuck on the second floor of the building.

c05629c5d77bcf8c802ba6a99cf9c2738ef80972.sourceText: 据报道，这起事故发生在14日早间。圣安娜警方称，一辆小轿车”飞撞”进一家牙科诊所的二楼，所幸当时这家诊所并未营业。
c05629c5d77bcf8c802ba6a99cf9c2738ef80972.translatedText: According to reports, the accident occurred on the morning of the 14th. Santa Ana police said a car "flighted" into the second floor of a dental clinic, which was not open at the time.

77b2ab2bd469659ecc82e41ac35b802245f9d551.sourceText: 当地时间1月14日，美国加州圣安娜发生一起严重交通事故，一辆汽车撞入了当地移动房屋并被卡在了建筑物的二楼。
77b2ab2bd469659ecc82e41ac35b802245f9d551.translatedText: On January 14, local time, a serious traffic accident occurred in Santa Ana, California, USA. A car crashed into a local mobile home and became stuck on the second floor of the building.

534f5a1a270b2d078386e205a45c16c0004cead4.sourceText: 警方称，消防部门动用专用叉车和清障车移走这辆汽车，车内两名人员中的一人能够自行下车，另一人由急救人员移出。
534f5a1a270b2d078386e205a45c16c0004cead4.translatedText: Police said the fire department used special forklifts and tow trucks to remove the car. One of the two people in the car was able to get out of the car on his own, and the other was removed by emergency personnel.

081ea66d87166bf18b44b0aca251dfcfd22eae8d.sourceText: 汽车司机在事故中受情伤，他承认在车祸发生前曾使用毒品。车上另一名乘客也受轻伤。
081ea66d87166bf18b44b0aca251dfcfd22eae8d.translatedText: The driver of the car was seriously injured in the accident. He admitted that he had used drugs before the accident. Another passenger in the car also suffered minor injuries.

40dffeb768ecc141aa59ad468ac46cab709c38a6.sourceText: 至当地时间14日下午，汽车已经被从房屋二层移走，牙科诊所办公室墙上出现一个巨大破洞。媒体未能联系上诊所所有者。
40dffeb768ecc141aa59ad468ac46cab709c38a6.translatedText: By the afternoon of the 14th local time, the car had been removed from the second floor of the house, and a huge hole appeared in the wall of the dental clinic office. The clinic owner could not be reached by the media.

261c84a3661f9861382c5996f5a5863699d5d403.sourceText: 菲破坏互信 谈判过程数度反覆
261c84a3661f9861382c5996f5a5863699d5d403.translatedText: The Philippines destroyed mutual trust and the negotiation process went back and forth several times

f8c52ace2af41a61a837b0cb94d9a9f93d24f8ff.sourceText: 菲破坏互信 谈判过程数度反覆 （中央社记者蔡和颖台北15日电）中华民国政府处理「广大兴28号桉」，遭遇菲律…
f8c52ace2af41a61a837b0cb94d9a9f93d24f8ff.translatedText: The Philippines destroyed mutual trust and the negotiation process went back and forth several times (Central News Agency reporter Tsai He-ying, Taipei, 15th) The government of the Republic of China encountered the Philippine government's handling of "Guangxing No. 28 Eucalyptus"...

993ad71fb3156635b119e2ba185e628ace78e364.sourceText: （中央社记者蔡和颖台北15日电）中华民国政府处理「广大兴28号桉」，遭遇菲律宾政府态度反覆，参与协商官员均高度不满，府院也痛责菲方「缺乏诚信」、「授权不足」、「反覆闪烁」。
993ad71fb3156635b119e2ba185e628ace78e364.translatedText: (Central News Agency reporter Tsai He-ying, Taipei, 15th) The government of the Republic of China encountered repeated attitudes from the Philippine government in handling "Guangxing No. 28 Eucalyptus." Officials participating in the negotiations were highly dissatisfied. The government also criticized the Philippines for its "lack of integrity," "insufficient authorization," and "repeated flashes."

a99e12ce4f419afd31b11b07244609d072c38de8.sourceText: 「广大兴28号」渔船船员洪石成遭菲律宾公务船扫射身亡，举国震惊，中华民国政府限时72小时要求菲律宾对「正式道歉、调查惩凶、赔偿损失、渔业谈判」四项要求正面回应；菲律宾驻华代表白熙礼昨晚到今天凌晨，与外交部长林永乐进行长达5小时的交涉，菲方最后提出的声明版本，仍未达中华民国政府要求。
a99e12ce4f419afd31b11b07244609d072c38de8.translatedText: >Hong Shih-cheng, a crew member of the "Guang Guang Xing 28" fishing boat, was shot dead by a Philippine official ship. The whole country was shocked. The government of the Republic of China gave a time limit of 72 hours to ask the Philippines to respond positively to four demands: "formal apology, investigation and punishment of the perpetrators, compensation for losses, and fishery negotiations." Philippine Representative to China Bai Xili had a five-hour negotiation with Foreign Minister Lin Yongle last night until early this morning. The final version of the statement proposed by the Philippines did not meet the requirements of the government of the Republic of China.

6fbe5792f4aa1c9a5c75df765d3adc8214d08a90.sourceText: 总统府、行政院、外交部今天分别召开记者会，以「缺乏诚信」、「授权不足」、「反覆闪烁」的强烈用词，表达对菲律宾政府处理「广大兴28号」事件的不满。
6fbe5792f4aa1c9a5c75df765d3adc8214d08a90.translatedText: The Presidential Palace, the Executive Yuan, and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs held separate press conferences today, using strong words such as "lack of integrity," "insufficient authorization," and "repeated flashes" to express their dissatisfaction with the Philippine government's handling of the "Guangxing 28" incident.

8c650e90c092cafacb50593dfcfcf09b837c73ef.sourceText: 中华民国政府限时要求到期前，菲方传来的第1版声明，以「菲国政府之遗憾与道歉」表达，对于「惩凶」部分，承诺立即展开调查、司法部究责及列举可能刑责；有关「赔偿」，违法人员可能须负赔偿责任；「渔业谈判」部分，则承诺菲国农业部召集跨部会平台，邀请台湾共同研商。
8c650e90c092cafacb50593dfcfcf09b837c73ef.translatedText: Before the time limit requirement of the Republic of China government expired, the first version of the statement from the Philippines was expressed as "the regret and apology of the Philippine government". As for the "punishment" part, it promised to immediately launch an investigation, the Ministry of Justice to hold accountable and list possible criminal penalties; regarding "compensation", the offenders may be held liable; for the "fishery negotiation" part, the Philippine Ministry of Agriculture promised to convene an inter-ministerial meeting platform and invite Taiwan to discuss it together.

61736badffa5439862e8a3f512ed5bdadf09a5fb.sourceText: 菲方表现的善意，却在白熙礼真正谈判时带来第二版声明后情势扭转，第二版声明不但改变「政府对政府」道歉字眼，惩凶方面空白，赔偿损失也只剩「人民捐款」，攸关台菲渔业秩序的渔业谈判，改成笼统的「相关单位」，界定为工作层级。
61736badffa5439862e8a3f512ed5bdadf09a5fb.translatedText: The Philippines showed goodwill, but the situation turned around when Bai Xili brought a second version of the statement during the actual negotiations. The second version of the statement not only changed the wording of the "government to government" apology, but left nothing in terms of punishment, and only "people's donations" were left to compensate for losses. The fishery negotiations that are related to the fishery order of Taiwan and the Philippines were changed to a general "relevant unit" and defined as a working level.

35fad43a42f70914b3417de9c0e8103318e0df77.sourceText: 菲方第一版与第二版声明差别如此之大，连交涉人士也不解，原定昨天晚间8时30分召开的记者会，为此一延再延。核心人士指出，这是为何政府认为菲律宾「缺乏诚信」的原因，损害双方互信。
35fad43a42f70914b3417de9c0e8103318e0df77.translatedText: The difference between the Philippines' first version and the second version of the statement is so big that even the negotiators are confused. The press conference originally scheduled to be held at 8:30 yesterday evening was postponed again and again for this reason. Core sources pointed out that this is the reason why the government believes that the Philippines "lacks integrity" and damages mutual trust between the two sides.

f91a0ca5f69e9ccc5087aa9352e54342c4d85a69.sourceText: 菲律宾的「反覆闪烁」，从4个菲方声明版本也可窥知。菲方每个版本都有白熙礼的签名，「签名」即代表确认文件的效力，不容反悔，菲方却连改了4个版本。
f91a0ca5f69e9ccc5087aa9352e54342c4d85a69.translatedText: The Philippines' "repeated flashing" can also be seen from the four versions of the Philippines' statement. Each version of the Philippines has Bai Xili's signature. The "signature" means confirming the validity of the document and there is no room for regret. However, the Philippines has changed 4 versions in a row.

ea1a157bbfda1228c465c3fffcad32eb19595d91.sourceText: 这也反映出白熙礼「授权不足」，所签的文件不能代表菲律宾政府最后决定，也不能达到中华民国政府明确提出的4项严正要求。
ea1a157bbfda1228c465c3fffcad32eb19595d91.translatedText: This also reflects Bai Xili's "insufficient authorization". The document he signed cannot represent the final decision of the Philippine government, nor can it meet the four strict requirements clearly stated by the government of the Republic of China.

05895cfe477c7fb9775655f443c3d44e8cbb190e.sourceText: 菲律宾态度反覆在前，即便马尼拉经济文化办事处主席培瑞斯在外交部以「授权不足」拒见后，立即获得菲国总统府声明授权为总统艾奎诺的「个人代表」，并赶赴外交部说明，但政府决坚持立场，仅由亚太司司长何登煌出面，定调「工作阶层」会面。
05895cfe477c7fb9775655f443c3d44e8cbb190e.translatedText: The Philippines' attitude has been repeated before. Even after the Manila Economic and Cultural Office Chairman Perez was immediately authorized by the Philippine Presidential Palace to be President Aquino's "personal representative" after refusing to meet with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs because of "insufficient authorization", and rushed to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to explain, the government insisted on its position. Only the Director of the Asia-Pacific Department, He Denghuang, came forward to set the tone for the "working class" meeting.

bc1d02f755f934bc740dbee53331d0af5cd7fb4e.sourceText: 强硬的动作，就是要让菲方充分了解，若继续迂迴反覆，不能对提出正面、具体的「新回应」，只是一再拖延，「虚应故意、含煳其词」，中华民国政府和人民绝对不会接受。
bc1d02f755f934bc740dbee53331d0af5cd7fb4e.translatedText: The tough move is to let the Philippines fully understand that if it continues to be roundabout and cannot put forward a positive and specific "new response" to it, but just delays it repeatedly, "deliberately false and vague," the government and people of the Republic of China will never accept it.

988ae33129228e81eb978b17fcfb6ffbe6fdcd2c.translatedText: Charity comes rain or shine, Tzu Chi Phoenix City raises 45,000 yuan (photo gallery) On September 27th, Tzu Chi Foundation Phoenix Liaison Office held a charity fund-raising party for the "Great Love in the World"...

e6198feac8c6901e25fabe51f0394a92a0787be2.sourceText: 九月二十七日慈济基金会凤凰城联络处的「大爱满人间」慈善募款餐会在会所隆重举办。当日大雨倾盆，近百各界大德依然齐聚会所，共募款四万五千多美金，一些大德的善款还在陆续寄往慈济。
e6198feac8c6901e25fabe51f0394a92a0787be2.translatedText: On September 27, Tzu Chi Foundation Phoenix Liaison Office organized a charity fund-raising dinner party for the "Great Love Full World" at the club. It was raining heavily that day, but nearly a hundred eminent persons from all walks of life still gathered at the gathering place and raised a total of more than 45,000 US dollars. Some of the eminent persons’ donations are still being sent to Tzu Chi.

e13de568e4aa309ad13eb50772bb097fa5dd0825.sourceText: 下午６时，凤凰城暴雨过后，慈济凤凰城联络处依然井井有条。慈济的师兄师姊为了保证晚上的膳食能够准时烹饪，在暴雨中搬运食材，一点都不敢怠慢，很多特殊的材料都是欣欣超市从加州专门定制运送到的产品。更多细致的服务更是让人感动。因为大雨，原来的停车空地已经都是积水，师兄师姊们运完食材，就赶紧把车开走，停到别处，把更多方便停车的位置留给今晚前来参加活动的大德们。
e13de568e4aa309ad13eb50772bb097fa5dd0825.translatedText: At 6 pm, after the heavy rain in Phoenix, the Tzu Chi Phoenix Liaison Office was still in good order. In order to ensure that the evening meal could be cooked on time, the brothers and sisters of Tzu Chi did not dare to neglect at all in carrying the ingredients in the heavy rain. Many of the special ingredients were specially customized and delivered by Xinxin Supermarket from California. The more meticulous services are even more touching. Due to heavy rain, the original parking space was already full of water. After the brothers and sisters finished transporting the ingredients, they quickly drove away and parked elsewhere, leaving more convenient parking spaces for the great men who came to participate in the event tonight.

b0010ec329393ff042265a8f5ae09f0f3fc3ad08.sourceText: 师兄师姊在门口迎接各界大德
b0010ec329393ff042265a8f5ae09f0f3fc3ad08.translatedText: >Senior brothers and sisters welcomed eminent figures from all walks of life at the door

3697942f5c914a714c8803390210a6bca4d55a44.sourceText: 赖甲乙师兄和陈慈雨师姊
3697942f5c914a714c8803390210a6bca4d55a44.translatedText: Senior Brother Lai Jiayi and Senior Sister Chen Ciyu

9fc8bc71c08dfc8b1a94d918efc1b079cd2668c1.sourceText: 赖甲乙师兄和陈慈雨师姊主持了本次募款晚宴。慈济凤凰城联络处负责人蔡慈滔师姊向大德们介绍了慈济2014所做的事情。首先是一如既往18年，推动四大志业，慈善，医疗，教育以及人文。低收入家庭每週二、三、五可以到慈济领取到新鲜的食品，每周四还送热的素食到公园给无家可归者。每年都邀请当地的医疗人员，为无医疗保险的人员提供免费的一至两次的体检。精进班教小朋友中文，更是引导市民提倡环保，食素保健康等理念。慈济关注世界的安危，2014台湾高雄气爆侨界纷纷捐款到慈济相助。
9fc8bc71c08dfc8b1a94d918efc1b079cd2668c1.translatedText: Senior Brother Lai Jiayi and Senior Sister Chen Ciyu hosted this fundraising dinner. Sister Cai Citao, the person in charge of Tzu Chi’s Phoenix City Liaison Office, introduced what Tzu Chi had done in 2014 to the eminent disciples. First, as has been the case for 18 years, we have promoted four major undertakings: charity, medical care, education and humanities. Low-income families can go to Tzu Chi to receive fresh food every Tuesday, Wednesday, and Friday, and hot vegetarian food is delivered to the homeless in the park every Thursday. Every year, local medical personnel are invited to provide one or two free physical examinations for people without medical insurance. The intensive class teaches children Chinese and guides citizens to promote concepts such as environmental protection and vegetarianism to protect health. Tzu Chi is concerned about the safety of the world. In 2014, when Kaohsiung, Taiwan was violently angry, the overseas Chinese community donated money to Tzu Chi to help.

585c9d7ba7d71cbf8c675716801e45523b12cb33.sourceText: 慈济凤凰城联络处负责人蔡慈滔师姊
585c9d7ba7d71cbf8c675716801e45523b12cb33.translatedText: Senior Sister Cai Citao, the person in charge of Tzu Chi Phoenix City Liaison Office

905751882d503ae3ced0cfd1529835761d3eefb3.sourceText: 当晚九道美味精致的素食，由慈济的师兄师姊们亲自策划烹饪，给所有大德留下了深刻的印象。
905751882d503ae3ced0cfd1529835761d3eefb3.translatedText: The nine delicious and exquisite vegetarian dishes that night were personally planned and cooked by Tzu Chi senior brothers and sisters, which left a deep impression on all the great virtues.

34e5269d24599c277701d3fe9f07e492f23e62b8.sourceText: 集健康美味为一席，慈济人不断的付出，已深获社会大众的信任与支持，在此也感谢各界大德无畏风雨坚持到现场来捐助善款。更多愿意伸出援手的大德请将支票寄往 2145 W. Elliot Road. Chandler. AZ. 85224，支票请写 Tzu Chi，感恩大家与慈济共同为世上受苦受难之人尽一份心力，共同打造希望的未来，让爱与善的清流滋润心田。
34e5269d24599c277701d3fe9f07e492f23e62b8.translatedText: Integrating health and deliciousness into one dish, Tzu Chi people’s continuous efforts have won the trust and support of the public. We would also like to thank all the virtuous people from all walks of life who persisted in coming to the scene to donate funds despite the storm. For those who are willing to lend a helping hand, please send a check to 2145 W. Elliot Road. Chandler. AZ. 85224. Please write the check to Tzu Chi. We are grateful to you all for working with Tzu Chi to help the suffering people in the world, to jointly build a hopeful future, and to let the clear flow of love and kindness nourish your heart.

0c8ac140024c3548b06875c6f6c817be9702d63d.sourceText: 根据几个房地产市场指标显示，上周，现房和新房销售有所提升，指向住房市场可能最终进入恢复模式。
0c8ac140024c3548b06875c6f6c817be9702d63d.translatedText: According to several real estate market indicators, sales of existing and new homes increased last week, pointing to the fact that the housing market may finally enter recovery mode.

c4d9b271b3ad2f8cd7aba1d544e258b7893aa2d2.sourceText: 在最近人口普查局的一份报告，新房的国内市场继续反弹。十月到十一月新屋销售上升1.6％，销售额比2010年11月增长了近10％。
c4d9b271b3ad2f8cd7aba1d544e258b7893aa2d2.translatedText: In a recent Census Bureau report, the domestic market for new homes continues to rebound. New home sales rose 1.6% from October to November, with sales up nearly 10% from November 2010.

4914b77aba41e98e40df99e43a7cf866c3506d2b.sourceText: 根据人口普查局的报告，全国新房在11月的房屋销售的中间价格为21.41万美元。以当前的销售速度在6个月的供应量，全国新房库存下降。
4914b77aba41e98e40df99e43a7cf866c3506d2b.translatedText: The national median price of new home sales in November was $214,100, according to the Census Bureau. With a 6-month supply at the current sales pace, new home inventory is falling nationwide.

39942b920e130fdc1ede9a9fc3af660b3a81a95f.sourceText: ”新房的库存都非常低：有没有现存的滞留的新房，因此新屋销售增长将直接转化为新的住房建设的开始，”全国住宅建筑商协会的高级经济学家，鲍勃Denk告诉CNNMoney。 ”这意味着把建筑行业的人们重返工作岗位。”
39942b920e130fdc1ede9a9fc3af660b3a81a95f.translatedText: "Inventories of new homes are very low: there are no existing stranded new homes, so new home sales growth will translate directly into the start of new home construction," Bob Denk, senior economist at the National Association of Home Builders, told CNNMoney. "That means putting people in the construction industry back to work."

eb2d22a1af947cec91172e3cce9ddf6880f2935e.sourceText: 其他住房市场最近的好消息：11月现房销售比去年同期增长12％，新屋建设开始增长了近21％，与去年同期相比，贷款利率上周达到了新的低点。更多房地产资讯请咨询金信地产Tinna 480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
eb2d22a1af947cec91172e3cce9ddf6880f2935e.translatedText: Other recent good news for the housing market: Existing home sales were up 12% in November from a year ago, new home construction starts were up nearly 21% compared with a year ago, and loan rates hit new lows last week compared to the same time last year. For more real estate information, please contact Goldtrust Realty Tinna 480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

152e1b6cfc609365f12ee3b50febffb30c3e81fc.translatedText: The Southwest Hong Xiuzhu Support Association of the United States was established

6fcd39e99d0bd70ae269a6ae514b99487c106f03.sourceText: 国民党美国西南支部结合所有支持洪秀柱朋友的力量於6月19日在洛杉磯宣佈成立美国西南洪秀柱后援总会，亚利桑那洪秀柱之友会发啟人之一尹衍桓代表亚利桑那州出席成立大会。 在成立大会上，尹衍桓表示将透过亚利桑那洪秀柱之友会属11个网络战斗小队，与总会同步发动回台投票专案及争取在台青年族群，中间选民认同，支持洪秀柱胜选2016中华民国总统。 支持洪秀柱効应瞬间爆发，一冲飞天不仅在台湾岛内造成胜过2008年马英九胜选的气势，在海外台侨社区更造成一股洪流，成為主流。洛杉磯地区一日之间超过800人登记成為后援会义工，每日成长。 亚利桑那地区在林子宣打嚮第一枪，尹衍桓，王瑞瑾，庄淑华，陈彩屏等分别在凤凰城及土桑利用4个工作天集结137人成立亚利桑那洪秀柱之友会，137位热血朋友成為亚省?#40644;埔一期?的同学，这股洪秀柱旋风带给海外蓝军无比高昂的战斗士气，这是国民党近年耒在台湾选举中未曾见过的情形。 目前亚利桑那支持洪秀柱的婉君(网军)主力耒自ASU及UA两所大学的台湾留学生。
6fcd39e99d0bd70ae269a6ae514b99487c106f03.translatedText: The American Southwest Branch of the Kuomintang combined the power of all friends who support Hong Xiuzhu to announce the establishment of the Southwest Hong Xiuzhu Support Association of the United States in Los Angeles on June 19. Yin Yanhuan, one of the founders of the Arizona Hong Xiuzhu Friends Association, attended the founding meeting on behalf of Arizona. At the founding meeting, Yin Yanhuan stated that he would use the 11 online battle teams of the Arizona Friends of Hong Xiuzhu to launch a return-to-Taiwan voting project simultaneously with the General Association and win the recognition of young people in Taiwan and the recognition of middle voters to support Hong Xiuzhu's victory in the 2016 President of the Republic of China. The effect of supporting Hong Xiuzhu exploded instantly. Not only did it create momentum in Taiwan that was better than Ma Ying-jeou's victory in 2008, it also caused a torrent in the overseas Taiwanese community and became the mainstream. More than 800 people in the Los Angeles area registered as volunteers for the support club in one day, and the number is growing every day. The first shot was fired in Lin Zixuan in Arizona. Yin Yanhuan, Wang Ruijin, Zhuang Shuhua, Chen Caiping and others used 4 working days in Phoenix and Tucson to gather 137 people to establish the Arizona Friends of Hong Xiuzhu. 137 A warm-blooded friend became a classmate of the first phase of the province. This Hong Xiuzhu whirlwind brought extremely high fighting morale to the overseas blue army. This is a situation that the Kuomintang has never seen in Taiwan elections in recent years. Currently, the main force of Wanjun (Net Army) in Arizona who supports Hong Xiuzhu are Taiwanese students from ASU and UA.

fd35be7ddc77bb5fa2ea914738ee3d643f9f9087.translatedText: (This website news) At 8:00 pm on June 7th, the 2013 Miss Chinese Phoenix candidates appeared on Arizona State University's Channel 8 TV program. The five beauties and the princess who was Miss Chinese last year volunteered to answer fundraising calls from viewers during the OMNI weight loss live broadcast. In less than two hours that night, with the efforts of all the call takers, a total of more than 11,000 US dollars was raised for Channel 8.

aad47ced9b4ac1c2a92d9c1d0869141f38c88fc6.sourceText: 六位华裔佳丽 当晚凤凰城华人侨团联合总会主席张华芳也出席了电视直播募款活动，她把亚利桑那华裔每年一度的选美活动，隆重向大家介绍。侨领邓朝驹还为节目组带来美味的食物。八时左右，六位华裔佳丽进入节目的直播间，接听募款观众的电话。本节目是介绍食物与身体的关系，向观众介绍健康的减肥健身方法。打来电话的募款嘉宾能获得60元的减肥DVD，或者是价值144元的系列套装。
aad47ced9b4ac1c2a92d9c1d0869141f38c88fc6.translatedText: >Six Chinese American beauties Zhang Huafang, chairman of the Phoenix Chinese Overseas Chinese Association, also attended the live TV fundraiser that night. She grandly introduced the annual Chinese American beauty pageant in Arizona to everyone. Overseas Chinese leader Deng Chaoju also brought delicious food to the program crew. At around eight o'clock, six Chinese-American beauties entered the live broadcast room of the show to answer calls from viewers for fundraising. This program introduces the relationship between food and the body, and introduces healthy weight loss and fitness methods to the audience. Guests who call to raise funds can receive a weight loss DVD worth 60 yuan, or a series of packages worth 144 yuan.

bb4d131e766c65ee71736a1437c8e02b9ac5d6a6.sourceText: 还是说说当这个芝麻绿豆的村官事吧。
bb4d131e766c65ee71736a1437c8e02b9ac5d6a6.translatedText: Let's talk about being a village official like this Sesame Mung Bean.

338b5d98434fbfa73a427c42c5c61fb90d3070ca.sourceText: 不过，别以为那时当上一个村官就有作威作福的资本了。不，不。在围城外你可以尽情地评头论足前任怎么得没眼光，没魄力，你也可以凭一点知青的知识保留一份文化的清高，心中暗中得意，但在上百口嗷嗷待哺的嘴巴面前，那时的队长还是得事事小心经手，整天担惊受怕。
338b5d98434fbfa73a427c42c5c61fb90d3070ca.translatedText: However, don’t think that becoming a village official at that time will give you the power to dominate. No, no. Outside the siege, you can comment as much as you want on how your predecessors have no vision and courage. You can also retain your cultural nobility with a little knowledge of the educated youth, and feel secretly proud in your heart. But in front of hundreds of people waiting for food, the captain at that time still had to handle everything carefully and be worried all day long.

5943bd46099c8f61517db2b8b53c81387f3f7c69.sourceText: 其实，没有责任，没有无奈的奢望，种田还是很享受的。
5943bd46099c8f61517db2b8b53c81387f3f7c69.translatedText: In fact, farming is still very enjoyable without responsibilities and helpless expectations.

247654403ca20312f7a8eba3658af6bf2cceab79.sourceText: 闲了一冬的农人蓄积了力，铆足了劲，当然也积够了肥料，就是为了开春生这秧苗娃娃的。最好的土地、最好的肥料、最便利的水流以及最勤快的农人统统归秧苗享用，这秧娃子能不自在么？一眨眼的工夫那挺似葱白的小苗，就变成软似绒毛的绿毯了，看着也舒坦。如果不是在晨曦中轻轻拨去罩在苗尖上的露珠，俯下身去捕捉那淡淡的苗香，你还会错过这世间最纯洁和天然无邪的香气。那吃母乳长大的孩子直到十来岁还能让人闻到奶香，这秧苗香也是一样，闻到了让人陶醉充满遐想。
247654403ca20312f7a8eba3658af6bf2cceab79.translatedText: >The farmers who have been idle all winter have accumulated enough energy and energy, and of course they have also accumulated enough fertilizer, just to grow these seedlings in the spring. The best land, the best fertilizer, the most convenient water flow, and the most diligent farmers all belong to the rice seedlings. Can the rice seedlings feel uncomfortable? In the blink of an eye, the green-white seedlings turned into a soft, fluffy green blanket, which looked so comfortable. If you hadn't gently brushed away the dewdrops covering the tops of the seedlings in the morning light and leaned down to catch the faint fragrance of the seedlings, you would have missed the purest and most natural and innocent fragrance in the world. Children who grew up on breast milk can still smell the fragrance of milk until they are ten years old. The same goes for the fragrance of seedlings. Smell it, it makes people intoxicated and full of reverie.

ba0e75ca67b76b32ec06d7dacd1219bd518569a6.sourceText: 待插到大田里，这秧苗就改名为禾苗了，脾性便恣意起来了。那根便露出白生生的触角，试探着霸下更大的地盘。得了新鲜水肥的茎叶也伸手张指的，像那孔雀舞的舞姿那样，想要得到这世界上的一切，却又不知道自己究竟想要什么。
ba0e75ca67b76b32ec06d7dacd1219bd518569a6.translatedText: After being planted in the field, the seedlings were renamed He Miao, and their temperament became wild. That one exposed its white tentacles, testing Ba Xia's larger territory. The stems and leaves that have received fresh water and fertilizer also stretch out their fingers, like the peacock dance, wanting to get everything in the world, but not knowing what they want.

74ddb1923883178b947cbae2014eab4b8dfb07ec.sourceText: 若正有一丝风略过，那青春得意的禾苗们便更加放肆起来了，或而勾肩搭背，你打我闹的，或而聚作一团，悉悉索索说着她们自己永远笑不够的话题。那气息也就随风荡漾了。那是一种充满着浓郁活力的清新味，像那疯天疯地的中学生，脸蛋儿可爱，却满头的脑油味，不管你愿闻还是不愿闻。
74ddb1923883178b947cbae2014eab4b8dfb07ec.translatedText: If there is a hint of wind, the young and proud seedlings will become even more unrestrained, or they will hug each other and make trouble, or they will gather in a group and talk about topics that they can never laugh enough. The breath rippled with the wind. It is a fresh scent full of rich vitality, like that crazy middle school student with a cute face but a head full of oily smell, whether you want to smell it or not.

a3c66f1229acaf7a2dfea8c9ce733c0bcd454807.sourceText: 禾苗真正值得称颂的美丽是在孕穗的时段。那窄窄的叶子慢慢地变宽了，而且一片比一片长。原本看不见的茎干也变粗变挺拔了。农人常说，蛤蟆没颈，细女（方言，指孩子）没腰，现在再也说不到禾苗了。羞羞答答的嫩黄和浅绿也已经被浓浓的墨绿完全替代了，放眼望去，那绿浪翻滚，时不时地反射着太阳耀眼的金光，说那是绿色的海洋真也一点不过分。
a3c66f1229acaf7a2dfea8c9ce733c0bcd454807.translatedText: >The real beauty of the seedlings is during the booting period. The narrow leaves slowly became wider, and each one became longer than the other. The originally invisible stems also became thicker and taller. Farmers often say that toads have no necks and xinu (dialect refers to children) have no waists. Now we can no longer talk about the crops. The shy yellow and light green have been completely replaced by thick dark green. Looking around, the green waves are rolling, reflecting the dazzling golden light of the sun from time to time. It is not an exaggeration to say that it is a green ocean.

3897e4ddfc87e2f9e7b7b5692bbca6fe434cc607.sourceText: 再以后绿色的海洋就被稻穗掀起的一轮淡黄的波浪所代替，让田野、河谷和山坳间立即充满了稻花的香气，进而便收获漫地金黄了。你看，劳作的辛苦很容易被诗情画意淹没了。
3897e4ddfc87e2f9e7b7b5692bbca6fe434cc607.translatedText: After that, the green ocean was replaced by a round of light yellow waves set off by the ears of rice, immediately filling the fields, river valleys and mountains with the fragrance of rice flowers, and then the land was filled with golden harvest. You see, the hard work can easily be overwhelmed by the poetry.

f2d56fc53e7cb0b6cc77b5ea76d664fe23f48d47.sourceText: 可是风不调雨不顺呢，那就是另外的故事了。
f2d56fc53e7cb0b6cc77b5ea76d664fe23f48d47.translatedText: But if the weather is not favorable, that is another story.

825f58f52f808c2494d5cafa2c3f9d525aa6677d.sourceText: 不知怎么搞得，那年春天竟然没雨！那古诗说得”烈日炎炎似火烧”场景竟然在春天出现了，别说没水整理大田了，就连秧田都变成龟裂的龟壳了，那可怜的秧苗就像干枯的小草在等待上天的乞怜。老农在那里敲着旱烟锅，很沧桑地告诉后生，当年也有过这般如此大旱等等，老妇人则在家里，没义务却很虔诚地为老天摆上几支香，保佑平安。那没有担当的后生也来凑热闹，说是某天晚上，一条水桶粗的大蟒从山上下到小溪喝水，吓得他不敢洗澡，裤子落在了溪边 —– 。
825f58f52f808c2494d5cafa2c3f9d525aa6677d.translatedText: Somehow, there was no rain that spring! The scene mentioned in the ancient poem "The scorching sun is like fire" actually appeared in spring. Not to mention the lack of water to clean up the fields, even the rice fields turned into cracked turtle shells. The poor rice plants were like dry grass waiting for God's mercy. The old farmer was banging the dry smoke pot there, and told his descendants with great vicissitudes that there had been such a severe drought in the past, etc. The old woman was at home, having no obligation but piously placing a few sticks of incense for God to bless her peace. The irresponsible young man also came to join in the fun. He said that one night, a big python as big as a bucket came down from the mountain to drink water from the stream. It scared him so much that he did not dare to take a bath and left his pants by the stream.

8c2b38a9e5bb3d1be955871e4d5aaf6be3c14d47.sourceText: 后来小溪也没了水，村里唯一的一口井就成了村民的最爱。这口井虽然很深，但从地势上看却是个好风水之地。高虽高了点，却是两个高坡相交之处。那水夏天喝起来冰凉，冬天却冒着热气，一村人全靠这点水维生。现在连山上的树叶都干得像柴火，有点火种就会烧起来，这地下还会有水吗。所以每天深夜抢水就成了常规的事情。平常再关系好的农伴，在没水的状况下都会变成发疯的水牛。一般农民全家老小一天有一桶水足够，可我们知青十几个人一天就要好多水，所以有点冲突，被人埋怨在那时只能装作听不到，因为谁都不想被渴死。在生存的底线面前，人和动物都是一样的。
8c2b38a9e5bb3d1be955871e4d5aaf6be3c14d47.translatedText: Later, the creek ran out of water, and the only well in the village became the favorite of the villagers. Although this well is very deep, it is a good Feng Shui location from the topography. Although the height is a bit higher, it is the intersection of two high slopes. The water tastes cold in summer, but steaming in winter. A whole village relies on this water to survive. Now even the leaves on the mountain are as dry as firewood. If there is any kind of fire, they will burn. Is there still water in the ground? So grabbing water late every night has become a routine thing. No matter how good the farmers are, they will turn into crazy buffaloes when there is no water. Generally, a bucket of water is enough for the whole family of farmers, but a dozen of us educated youths need a lot of water a day, so there is a bit of conflict. When someone complains, we can only pretend not to hear it, because no one wants to die of thirst. In the face of the bottom line of survival, humans and animals are all the same.

bd2ff6214eff737b42454434f0b0fe265be7484c.sourceText: 作为队长，有时也要调解用水发生的矛盾，比如阔嘴将木瓜排队的水桶扔远了，长兴把苟仔的水桶打烂了等等鸡皮狗毛之事，但他们联合起来反唇相讥，都是你们人太多，抢了我们的水，我常常无言可对。可将我们的水桶丢远了，惹毛的我也不顾队长之尊，破口大骂，是我们愿来这里的吗！我们就不要活了？
bd2ff6214eff737b42454434f0b0fe265be7484c.translatedText: As a team leader, I sometimes have to mediate water conflicts, such as Kuozui throwing the papaya queue's bucket away, Changxing smashing Gouzai's bucket, and other trivial matters. However, they united and retorted, "You have too many people and robbed us of water. I was often speechless." But our buckets were thrown far away, which made me angry. I ignored my respect as the captain and yelled, are we willing to come here? Are we not going to live anymore?

cc6f6aa170fd72778b24571fed53e6885718dc41.sourceText: 气管气，骂管骂，可管事的还要想法子，于是找来了挖井的。据说这挖井的远近有名，会看风水，一点地穴就知道哪里有水。可待他找到了井穴，我才发觉盲目崇拜权威其实是很可悲的。
cc6f6aa170fd72778b24571fed53e6885718dc41.translatedText: He was angry and scolded him, but the person in charge still wanted to find a way, so he called in the well digger. It is said that the wells dug here are famous for their distance, and they can read Feng Shui and know where the water is by looking at the hole in the ground. But after he found the well, I realized that blind worship of authority is actually very sad.

8ee9871343d3dbfb3e612ba04bf266025e6e971e.sourceText: 我们住的村子坐落在山坡上，顺坡而下依次是公共厕所和水塘，尽管厕所就在水塘边，村民都在水塘洗菜洗米洗衣，女人们晚上见没人，还抹几下身子，无人见怪，也无人生病。所以当那个挖井的老法师选定在靠近厕所和水塘边的下方为水穴时，村民们虔诚地雀跃地庆幸了，因为大家都被没水喝吓怕了。我们知青说水源可能被污染等等，但反对也没用。
8ee9871343d3dbfb3e612ba04bf266025e6e971e.translatedText: The village we live in is located on a hillside. Down the slope are public toilets and a pond. Although the toilet is right next to the pond, the villagers are washing vegetables, rice and laundry in the pond. The women see no one at night and wipe their bodies a few times. No one is surprised and no one gets sick. So when the old mage who dug the well chose the water hole at the bottom near the toilet and the pond, the villagers rejoiced devoutly and happily, because everyone was frightened by the lack of water. We educated youth say that water sources may be contaminated, etc., but it is useless to object.

33096333668e8d94ac808302cb78ee269c790ea9.sourceText: 挖下去水井果然是出水如涌，渴急了的村民迫不及待地打水享用。但没几天，上面水塘里的水位就下降了，那公厕有没有肥水下降没人愿去验证。不过村民们在私下议论，这新井的水没有老井的水甜 —– ，我们自然也喝了几天。有水总比被渴死强
33096333668e8d94ac808302cb78ee269c790ea9.translatedText: When the well was dug, water came out in a steady stream, and the thirsty villagers couldn't wait to fetch water for enjoyment. But within a few days, the water level in the pond above dropped. No one wanted to verify whether the public toilets had dropped. However, the villagers were talking privately that the water from the new well was not as sweet as the water from the old well - so naturally we drank it for a few days. Having water is better than dying of thirst

aebe25082cde01de38418bd981c3547c575a6dc8.sourceText: 比井水更难搞定得是田里的水。我所在的生产队有八百亩水田，基本就是靠天吃饭的那种。那里属于亚热带气候，每年二月到六月总是雨水不断，基本上满足了水田作业的需要。但总有几年天公发脾气的时候，现在说起来就是什么厄尔诺现象，那老天会从春天到夏天老是瞪着蓝眼睛，不流一滴眼泪。那时的农民却是欲哭无泪了。没水弄成水田的也就成了沙漠，大风一起就风沙遍地。已经将秧苗插下去的因为没水继续维持，而成了龟壳地，可怜的秧苗就像绿毛龟身上的草丝，无力地摇摆。
aebe25082cde01de38418bd981c3547c575a6dc8.translatedText: Water from the fields is more difficult to get than well water. The production team I work for has 800 acres of paddy fields, which basically depends on the weather. The climate there is subtropical, with constant rain from February to June every year, which basically meets the needs of paddy field operations. But there are always a few years when God loses his temper, and now it is called the Erno phenomenon. Then God will always stare at blue eyes from spring to summer without shedding a drop of tears. At that time, the farmers were on the verge of tears. Without water, paddy fields will become deserts, and strong winds will blow sand everywhere. The seedlings that have been planted have turned into turtle shells because there is no water to maintain them. The poor seedlings are like the grass threads on the green turtle, swaying feebly.

8c64bba2907d967d9c236f934bac7cb4161ea81f.sourceText: 好在村里附近有个本县最大的水库，每当旱季来到水库就放水救田救庄稼。水库虽然是本地老百姓自己无偿堆的，但用水还是要付钱的，因为是年终统算，所以那时没人计较钱的事。一听说今天晚上水库的水归自己队里所用，整个队里的农民都像赶集一样兴奋。那时每个农民还有点自留地，可以种菜，也可以种点水稻，没水大家一样倒霉，可有水呢，农民晚上就像黑夜精灵一样，没一点灯光也可以千方百计地将那远处的水引到自己的一亩三分地上。引了水还要特别小心地潜伏看护，否则，有人悄悄地给你截了流，肥了他人田。
8c64bba2907d967d9c236f934bac7cb4161ea81f.translatedText: Fortunately, there is the largest reservoir in the county near the village. Whenever the reservoir comes during the dry season, water is released to save the fields and crops. Although the reservoirs were built by local people for free, they still had to pay for water use. Because the calculation was done at the end of the year, no one cared about money at that time. As soon as they heard that the water in the reservoir would be used by their team tonight, the farmers in the team were as excited as if they were going to the market. At that time, every farmer still had some private land, where he could grow vegetables or rice. Without water, everyone would be unlucky. But with water, farmers were like night elves at night. Even without any light, they could do everything possible to divert water from far away to their own one-third of an acre. When you divert water, you must be especially careful and watch it, otherwise, someone will quietly intercept the flow for you and enrich other people's fields.

5f2e86b92e001f202ca5529b5cbc4bd1fbf312ae.sourceText: 可管事的就没这般福分了。水库放水是限时限刻的，如果你队的水渠由于常年不疏通，有水权而没有水路，那就怨不得别人了。所以男劳力那晚上就是沿着渠道行走，遇到葛藤砍去，遇到淤塞便挖通。水库放水都是从水库底层放水的，水特冷哪怕是五六月，晚上碰到也是刺骨的寒，而且一晚上都在水里趟着走着，这幸福感就不是语言可以形容的了。后来年纪大了，脚踝上面老是疼，想必就是那时落下的。
5f2e86b92e001f202ca5529b5cbc4bd1fbf312ae.translatedText: >But those in charge are not so blessed. The release of water from the reservoir is limited to a limited time. If your team's canals are not dredged all year round and you have water rights but no waterways, then you can't blame others. Therefore, the male laborers walked along the channel that night, cutting down the kudzu vines and digging through the siltation. The water in the reservoir is released from the bottom of the reservoir. The water is extremely cold, even in May and June. It is bitingly cold at night, and I have been wading in the water all night. The happiness cannot be described in words. Later, when I got older, I always had pain above my ankle, which must have happened at that time.

39a788ae33c892d5202fde225ee4c134647bf826.sourceText: 这还不是最可怕的。那渠道没通水的时候，上有灌木林，下有青草，倒是个荫凉生活的好地方，麂子野鸡都会到此地寻求安乐。当然蛇蛙之类也喜欢这样的生态。但一通水就不安乐了，会飞的会跑的赶快上堤坝，那不会跑跳的就顺流而下了。那时没手电，有也舍不得电池，一般是几个人提一盏煤油灯照明。只听得那边高兴地大叫，我抓到了一条黄鳝！大家正愁没乐子呢，噼里啪啦踩水而去，一看，一条手腕粗的东西被那位攥在手里。眼尖的嘴也快，大叫是蛇。于是又是一阵噼里啪啦，所有乘兴而来的好事者一下作鸟兽散。其实哪有这么好的事，那渠道干了这么久，除了蛇神牛鬼谁会在这里歇凉呢。好在那是条无毒的青蛇。
39a788ae33c892d5202fde225ee4c134647bf826.translatedText: This is not the scariest thing. When there was no water in the channel, there were shrubs above and grass below, making it a good place to live in the shade. Muntjacs and pheasants would come here to seek comfort. Of course, snakes and frogs also like this kind of ecology. But once the water is opened, it is no longer happy. Those who can fly and run quickly go up the embankment, and those who can't run and jump go down the river. There were no flashlights at that time, and we couldn’t bear to give up batteries if we had them. It was usually a few people carrying a kerosene lamp for lighting. I just heard the other side shouting happily, I caught an eel! Everyone was worried about having no fun, so they stepped on the water and walked away. When they saw it, they saw a thick-wristed thing in the hand of the person. The eyes are sharp and the mouth is quick, shouting is a snake. Then there was another burst of crackling, and all the good people who came to take advantage of the excitement suddenly dispersed. In fact, there is no such thing as such a good thing. After working in this channel for so long, who would rest here except snake gods and cow ghosts? Fortunately, it was a non-venomous green snake.

472a0beeb533bc37a2d2d0eabe52e75770be8c05.sourceText: 在小说里看到农民为了争夺水源，不惜付诸以武力，以为那是作家在增添故事情节，下乡后才感到这个情节一点也没杜撰，为了生存，农民确实是什么都会干的。我所在的山区也是属于地广人少的地方，所以有哪个地方想移民过来，通过一定的手续，向周边几个队匀几块地就是另外一个村落了。那时湖南湘潭搞了一个大水利工程，很多湘潭移民到我们附近安家了。那湘潭的人性格都强悍，有吃苦精神，也好与人斗，和那个大救星一样，动不动就其乐无穷地与当地人发生冲突。比方水库放水了，每个队都按照公社的布局有个先来后到，可他们无法无天，只要你人不在，他就敢挖开你的渠道阀门，让水往他那里流去。
472a0beeb533bc37a2d2d0eabe52e75770be8c05.translatedText: In the novel, I saw farmers fighting for water sources, even using force. I thought it was the writer adding plot to the story. After going to the countryside, I realized that this plot was not fabricated at all. In order to survive, farmers will indeed do anything. The mountainous area where I live is also a place with a vast land and few people, so if you want to immigrate to any place, you have to go through certain procedures and spread a few pieces of land to several surrounding teams to become another village. At that time, a large water conservancy project was launched in Xiangtan, Hunan, and many immigrants from Xiangtan settled near us. The people in Xiangtan are all strong-willed, hard-working and willing to fight with others. Just like the great savior, they happily clash with the locals at every turn. For example, when the reservoir releases water, each team has a first-come, first-served basis according to the commune's layout, but they are lawless. As long as you are not there, they dare to dig your channel valves and let the water flow to them.

30f85aa0a858b50a724b26e1ad5516a9935e1eae.sourceText: 所以那水渠阀门看管是个勇气活，也是个智力活。虽然不用夜晚趟水，可村民们哪个都不愿去，说是湖南人会”抠”（点穴道），让人给来一下，会受伤。其实，那也是江西老表的胆怯，湖南人强悍是强悍，未必人人都会此招，就像外国人认为中国人都有功夫一样。给自己壮着胆，本官血气方刚只得亲自上任了。
30f85aa0a858b50a724b26e1ad5516a9935e1eae.translatedText: So taking care of the drain valves is a job of courage and intelligence. Although there is no need to wade through the water at night, the villagers are reluctant to go anywhere, saying that Hunan people are good at "picking" (pointing acupuncture points), and if someone touches it, they will be injured. In fact, that is also the timidity of Jiangxi veterans. Hunan people are tough, but not everyone can do this, just like foreigners think that Chinese people have kung fu. To embolden myself, I have no choice but to take up the post in person.

47fbda7792700ee608cfc7abbf976c731f3442b8.sourceText: 果然不出所料，一个湖南男子坐在水渠分流闸门口，边上横放着一把弯柴刀，虎视眈眈地迎接着我。再一看，水渠被这汉子挖了个口子，而且在通往我村的水口上被他塞满了灌木树枝，水就汩汩地朝他们地里流去。我先礼后兵，温文尔雅地向他解释今天的水权归我们，企图化兵戈纠纷，也让他顺便看看大上海来的知青是什么风度。可是人家湖南人不领你的情，照样操着高亢的湘音和你辩争。那年代，其他方言不懂，可”中国人民站起来了”的湖南腔，全国人民都熟悉。所以我也略懂一点湖南腔，大概就是公社为什么今天没有给他们安排供水的时间。
47fbda7792700ee608cfc7abbf976c731f3442b8.translatedText: As expected, a Hunan man sat at the gate of the canal diversion gate, with a curved hatchet lying beside him, and he greeted me eagerly. Looking again, I saw that the man had dug a hole in the ditch, and filled the entrance leading to my village with shrubs and branches, and the water gurgled toward their fields. I politely explained to him that today's water rights belong to us, trying to defuse the dispute, and also let him take a look at the demeanor of the educated youth from Shanghai. But the Hunan people don't appreciate your kindness, and they still argue with you in high-pitched Xiang accent. At that time, other dialects were not understood, but the Hunan accent of "The Chinese people have stood up" was familiar to people across the country. So I also know a little bit of Hunan accent, which is probably why the commune did not arrange a time for water supply for them today.

1c6a4729988055932245bfb066e82c0c99de09b6.sourceText: 管他呢，那是当官人的事，现在是我的地盘我做主，况且我已经有礼在前了。我捞起阻水的树枝就丢。那位湖南爷也不示弱，抡起弯刀就来制止。可怜我的虎口正当刀刃，顿时血流如注。这战场上有人见血就晕，有人见血便疯，更加玩命，我就是后者。一见爹妈给的血如此流淌，我顺手抄起镢头抵挡过去，大有古代铜锤对钩镰枪的故事。结果那厮自知理亏，落荒而去。于是渠道通畅，不在话下。
1c6a4729988055932245bfb066e82c0c99de09b6.translatedText: What the hell, that's a matter for an official. Now it's my territory and I have the final say. Besides, I'm already polite. I picked up the branches blocking the water and threw them away. The Hunan master didn't show any weakness and came to stop him with his scimitar. Poor me, the tiger's mouth was right at the edge of the knife, and blood suddenly flowed out. On this battlefield, some people faint when they see blood, and some people go crazy when they see blood, even more desperate. I am the latter. When I saw the blood from my parents flowing like this, I picked up the hoe to resist it. There is a story about the ancient bronze hammer and hook and sickle spear. As a result, the guy realized that he was wrong and left in despair. So the channels are smooth and it's a no-brainer.

54b234d8be2b372ca94dce251ec07d24f58eb416.sourceText: 二天，一个老农来看我，顺便主动请战看守渠道。见他手无四两肉，心里有点小看他。结果他守渠的几天内，西线无战事，水源却不断。问他何故，他阴笑着不做声。原来他到了兵家必争之地，先在远远找个荫凉地歇着潜伏着，他看得见人家，人家却看不见他。他算定那湖南汉子一定会在守渠时干点私活，比方砍点柴火带回去。乘人懈怠干私活，他便将阻塞物搬到湖南的缺口去，在人家回来前，又恢复原样。湖南汉子一见水流如故，便放心地回家了。不料我村潜伏哨再次黄昏出动，将湖南汉子的缺口严严堵住，于是一夜水流滚滚，滋润我方田地。
54b234d8be2b372ca94dce251ec07d24f58eb416.translatedText: The next day, an old farmer came to see me and took the initiative to ask me to guard the channel. Seeing that he didn't have four ounces of meat in his hands, I felt a little bit down on him. As a result, during the few days he guarded the canal, there was no fighting on the Western Front, but the water supply continued. Asked him why, he smiled sinisterly and remained silent. It turned out that when he arrived at a battleground for military strategists, he first found a shady place to rest and lurk in the distance. He could see others, but they couldn't see him. He figured that the Hunan man would do some private work while guarding the canal, such as cutting some firewood and bringing it back. Taking advantage of people's slack in doing private work, he moved the obstruction to the gap in Hunan and restored it to its original state before the people came back. As soon as the Hunan man saw that the water flow was as good as before, he went home relieved. Unexpectedly, the latent sentry in our village was dispatched again at dusk and blocked the Hunan man's breach. As a result, the water flowed all night, nourishing our fields.

8f2d2e47e781b85fa6af957696815732c9b8957d.sourceText: 没有一点正面接触，却干了匹夫之勇办不到的事。无怪古代江西尽出学士进士状元，湖南只出武士呢。这湘赣之争也真是其乐无穷呢。
8f2d2e47e781b85fa6af957696815732c9b8957d.translatedText: There was no direct contact, but he did something that a brave man could not do. It is no wonder that in ancient times Jiangxi produced all the bachelors and Jinshi, while Hunan only produced warriors. This dispute between Hunan and Jiangxi is really endless fun.

39e483b24b4661e8bf9a413b17f46b88c12f5c7c.sourceText: 不过天不给力，光靠小伎俩也无济于事，那年八百亩水田干了两百亩，剩下的也半死不活的。虽然天灾，但公粮还要交，所以农民手里真的所剩无几了。那以后吃了一年的南瓜芋头稀饭和没油的菜，现在想想都是健康食品了，也就无怨了。唯独那熟悉的农妇苦笑着对我打趣，”老大，恰尼办（怎么办）？今朝恰啥子么（今天吃什么呀）”至今还在耳边萦绕。现今二十出头的人怎么看还是孩子，那时一当那个劳什子队长怎么成了老大呢？后来看到那个谁一干大了，被叫大大了就明白了。百姓自信不足，期望你带领众生吃饱饭哪。
39e483b24b4661e8bf9a413b17f46b88c12f5c7c.translatedText: However, the weather was not good enough, and little tricks would not help. Two hundred acres of the eight hundred acres of paddy field were harvested that year, and the rest was half dead. Despite the natural disaster, public grain still needs to be paid, so farmers really don’t have much left. After that, I ate pumpkin, taro porridge and oil-free vegetables for a year. Now that I think about it, they are all healthy food, so I have no complaints. Only the familiar peasant woman joked to me with a wry smile, "Boss, what should I do with Chani? What's going on today (what will I eat today)?" It still lingers in my ears. People in their early twenties today are still considered children. How could the captain of Lao Shizi become the boss at that time? Later, when I saw that person, I understood it as soon as I became a big person and was called a big person. The people have insufficient self-confidence and expect you to lead all sentient beings to have enough to eat.

fa8bdbe77375020b379eb6d1632573b85ff1d1a9.sourceText: 咳，可再喊老大还是胜不了天哪。
fa8bdbe77375020b379eb6d1632573b85ff1d1a9.translatedText: Cough, but no matter how much you call me boss, you still can't win.

13dd7838abc6e381b7626b276f07e366319a20f8.translatedText: The housing market is recovering, and the price of foreclosed homes is approaching traditional housing prices. New signs show that it is increasingly difficult for U.S. home buyers to take advantage of bargains on foreclosed homes. Foreclosures...

3a84c498b1ce09006a8e2fc9c8fc7816d27b38fd.sourceText: 房市复苏 法拍屋价格逼近传统房价 新的迹象显示，美国的房屋买主越来越难从法拍屋的讨价还价中占到便宜。法拍屋的折扣变的越来越小，意味着美国房地产市场正在缓慢走向复苏。 根据网站Zillow的分析，在全国范围内，今年9月份，法拍屋平均折扣仅低于市场价值约8％ 。相较于2009年平均降价24％，这是一个显著变化 。 佛罗里达州的房地产经纪发现，在过去的6个月里，房产销售市场回温，很多买家竞相出价竞标买房。 不过，这并不意味着法拍屋在某些市场有很少的交易。根据Zillow，最高的法拍屋折扣可以在匹兹堡发现，高达27％。克利夫兰，辛辛那提和巴尔的摩，平均降价20％ 。 但在许多遭受重创的市场，特别是在住房价格大幅下跌的地区，投资者和购房者猛扑购买，法拍屋的折扣都消失了。 Zillow还发现，在拉斯维加斯和凤凰城，”法拍和非法拍销售”之间没有明显的差异，折扣缩小到不足1％，在萨克拉门托， 迈阿密和劳德代尔堡，差距只有3％，而在洛杉矶也只有4％。华盛顿地区的法拍屋折扣平均为5.5％ 。 根据分析，在全国的许多地方，法拍屋 折扣减少的部份原因是法拍屋的销售萎缩。分析认为，随着经济的好转，更少的房主拖欠他们的抵押贷款。此外，越来越多的银行已经开始转向亏本销售，修改贷款 政策及使用其他的替代品，使房屋尽量避免被法拍而进行昂贵和耗时的过程。与此同时，法拍屋的库存量维持在低水平，使得在许多地方激烈的竞争推动了价格的上涨。
3a84c498b1ce09006a8e2fc9c8fc7816d27b38fd.translatedText: House market recovery, foreclosure prices approach traditional housing prices New signs show that it is increasingly difficult for U.S. home buyers to take advantage of bargains on foreclosures. The discounts on foreclosed homes are getting smaller and smaller, which means that the U.S. real estate market is slowly recovering. Nationally, the average discount on foreclosed homes in September was only about 8% below market value, according to an analysis by the website Zillow. This is a significant change from 2009, when the average price reduction was 24%. Florida real estate agents have seen the sales market pick up over the past six months, with many buyers bidding on homes. However, this does not mean that foreclosures have few transactions in certain markets. According to Zillow, the highest foreclosure discounts can be found in Pittsburgh, up to 27%. Cleveland, Cincinnati and Baltimore saw an average price reduction of 20%. But in many hard-hit markets, especially in areas where home prices have plummeted, foreclosure discounts have disappeared as investors and homebuyers swooped in to buy. Zillow also found no discernible difference between "foreclosure and illegal foreclosure sales," with discounts shrinking to less than 1% in Las Vegas and Phoenix. In Sacramento, Miami and Fort Lauderdale, the gap was just 3%, and in Los Angeles it was only 4%. Foreclosure discounts in the Washington area average 5.5%. In many parts of the country, foreclosure discounts have declined in part because foreclosure sales have shrunk, according to the analysis. Analysts believe that as the economy improves, fewer homeowners are delinquent on their mortgages. In addition, more and more banks have begun to turn to loss sales, modify lending policies and use other alternatives to avoid the expensive and time-consuming process of foreclosure. At the same time, foreclosure inventory remains low, allowing intense competition to drive up prices in many locations.
