53176d669d33c417d440de0913e26b72c6be6fd4.sourceText: 美国房地长市场普遍上扬 凤凰城市场依旧领跑 根据房地产研调机构Zillow对新数据的分析，美国房地产市场总体正在摆脱下滑趋势，但是因地理位置不同而表现出的房价变动差异很大，从而验证了房地产市场的一句格言：地点是最重要的。 《华尔街日报》引述房地产研调公司Zillow对新数据的分析说， 虽然美国各地的房地产市场在住房热潮和崩溃时期同时上升和下跌，但现在各地市场正以不同速度摆脱下滑趋势。 根据美国商务部公布的经季节性调整后的数据，5月份的单户住宅开工量比4月份上升了3.2%，而建筑许可证则增加了 7.9%。5月份现有住宅的销售也是春季销售的关键基准。早期报告显示，许多市场相比一年前的疲弱水平都有所提高。 Zillow 的分析也显示这种复苏是不连续的。抢手的街区，如靠近运输枢纽和拥有一流公立学校的街区，都能找到买家。但在数英里之外的其它街区，包括那些城市远郊的富人住宅区，或者没有完全得到提升的地区，需求仍然很疲弱。 Zillow 公司按照邮政编码对几十个大都市的价格进行了跟踪，并将4月份的价格与3个月前进行比对。该公司采用专有的模型，考虑诸如销售和评估等因素，来确定某一地区的所有住房的价值。其结果显示出市场的复苏是不平均的，某些地区得到提升，而几个街区或几英里远以外却被冷落。Zillow 的首席经济学家汉弗莱斯（Stan Humphries）说，”你其实可以看到复苏的种子按邮政编码开始传播”。 该公司的数据反映了少数市场的广泛复苏。在2月-4月间，约 94%的凤凰城邮区和 90%的丹佛邮区的房产价值得到提升，与去年同期相比，分别上升了5%和 6%。而有些地区却变得更糟。只有6%的纽约州奥尔巴尼邮区出现了上涨，远低于一年前28%的比例。 其结果是价格开始上涨，但经纪公司Redfin的行政长官凯尔曼（Glenn Kelman）说， ”它不是发生在每个邻里”， ”确实是择优而栖” 。 Redfin公司的总部位于西雅图，在18个大都市有营业。 凯尔曼先生说，当具有高品质学校、低犯罪率和有吸引力房子的街区”变得更实惠，在那里你将看到强烈的需求”。他说，买家希望获得”打折的蒂芙尼钻石”。大凤凰城地区由于新经济实体在东南部的进驻，力挺当地房市。
53176d669d33c417d440de0913e26b72c6be6fd4.translatedText: The U.S. real estate market is generally rising, with the Phoenix market still leading the way. According to an analysis of new data by Zillow, a real estate research firm, the U.S. real estate market is generally emerging from a downward trend, but house price changes vary greatly depending on geographical location, thus validating an adage in the real estate market: location is the most important. The Wall Street Journal quoted real estate research firm Zillow's analysis of new data as saying that while real estate markets across the United States rose and fell at the same time during the housing boom and crash, markets are now emerging from the downward trend at different speeds. Single-family housing starts rose 3.2% in May from April, while building permits increased 7.9%, according to seasonally adjusted data released by the Commerce Department. Sales of existing homes in May are also a key benchmark for spring sales. Early reports suggest many markets are improving from weak levels a year ago. Zillow's analysis also shows the recovery is patchy. Buyers can be found in sought-after neighborhoods, such as those close to transportation hubs and with great public schools. But demand remains weak in other neighborhoods miles away, including those in affluent suburbs of the city or in areas that haven't been fully upgraded. Zillow tracked prices by zip code in dozens of metropolitan areas and compared prices in April to three months earlier. The company uses a proprietary model that takes into account factors such as sales and appraisals to determine the value of all homes in an area. The results show that the market's recovery is uneven, with certain areas getting a boost while neighborhoods or miles away are left out in the cold. "You can actually see the seeds of recovery starting to spread by zip code," said Zillow chief economist Stan Humphries. The company's data reflected a broad recovery in a handful of markets. About 94% of Phoenix ZIP codes and 90% of Denver ZIP codes saw an increase in property values ​​between February and April, up 5% and 6% respectively compared to the same period last year. And some areas are getting worse. Only 6% of Albany, N.Y., ZIP codes saw an increase, down from 28% a year ago. As a result, prices started to rise, but "it's not happening in every neighborhood," said Glenn Kelman, chief executive of brokerage Redfin. "It's really cherry-picking." Redfin is headquartered in Seattle and operates in 18 metropolitan areas. Mr Kelman said when neighborhoods with high-quality schools, low crime rates and attractive homes "become more affordable, you're going to see strong demand there". He said buyers wanted to get "Tiffany diamonds at a discount." The greater Phoenix area is supporting the local housing market due to the presence of new economic entities in the Southeast.

e4e10c4f221829944384c088119749f452d850b6.sourceText: 北京大力反腐有非同寻常的代价 或将切实影响中国经济 自北京宣布大力反腐以来，坊间就一直有传闻，暗示反腐正切实影响中国经济。年初，所有在华人士都因一则消息而忍俊不禁：由于担心不再能通过五星级酒店的招牌赚钱，豪华饭店主动试图”降级”。谁都未曾料到会有这种事。 除了出人意料的效果，更多可预见的转变已经发生。例如，各地政府官员举行午宴和晚宴的次数越来越少?#29978;至面对有望投资当地经济的人时亦是如此。即使举办，也远没从前那般铺张奢华。最近，某大型国企一名高管带我去其公司食堂吃午餐，其间他一直强调，午饭成本不到15元。中国政府鼓励厉行节约、反对昂贵饭菜。几乎所有在京人士都至少听说一家高档餐厅关门，在我们位于三里屯的办公室附近就有几家”受害者”。 另一个受到反腐”不利”影响的是奢侈品行业，包括从名表到手包的各种产品销量均受损。 种种此类传闻，加上众多贪官被起诉所引发的不确定性，将对中国经济形成何种影响？美林证券最近预测，反腐将令中国经济在2014年蒙受1000亿美元以上的”损失”，按该国去年的GDP总量计算，已超1%。在任何经济体内?#23588;其是在正费力达到增长目标的中国，这都是非同寻常的数字。 除了短期影响，中国大力反腐还在影响本国投资外流，美国的EB-5投资移民签证计划即是这种影响的晴雨表之一。如今，中国公民在获得此类签证者中的占比已超过80%，而10年前仅为13%。相关咨询律师证实，反腐是此类签证申请增多的关键原因之一。 中国的腐败现象严峻，对许多企业而言，它与知识产权一样，是外商不愿对华投资的关键原因。因此，任何一个在华做生意的人士都在为北京的反腐行动鼓掌。反腐对中国经济乃至对本国投资外流的切实影响已表明，中国开展这场运动有多严肃。(作者杰克 潘考夫斯基)
e4e10c4f221829944384c088119749f452d850b6.translatedText: Beijing's vigorous anti-corruption campaign has an extraordinary cost, which may have a real impact on the Chinese economy. Ever since Beijing announced its vigorous anti-corruption campaign, there have been rumors suggesting that the anti-corruption campaign is actually affecting the Chinese economy. At the beginning of the year, everyone in China couldn’t help laughing because of the news: out of fear that they would no longer be able to make money from the sign of a five-star hotel, luxury hotels actively tried to "downgrade" their hotels. No one expected this to happen. In addition to the unexpected effects, more predictable shifts have occurred. For example, luncheons and dinners are being held less and less frequently for local government officials, even for those looking to invest in the local economy. Even if it is held, it is far less extravagant and luxurious than before. Recently, a senior executive of a large state-owned enterprise took me to his company canteen for lunch. During the process, he kept emphasizing that the cost of lunch was less than 15 yuan. The Chinese government encourages strict frugality and opposes expensive meals. Almost everyone in Beijing has heard of at least one high-end restaurant closing, and there are several "victims" near our office in Sanlitun. Another industry that has been “adversely” affected by the anti-corruption campaign is the luxury goods industry, which has seen sales of products ranging from luxury watches to handbags suffer. What impact will these rumors, coupled with the uncertainty caused by the prosecution of many corrupt officials, have on the Chinese economy? Merrill Lynch recently predicted that the anti-corruption campaign will cause the Chinese economy to suffer a "loss" of more than US$100 billion in 2014, which is more than 1% of the country's total GDP last year. These are extraordinary numbers in any economy, especially China, which is struggling to meet its growth targets. In addition to the short-term impact, China's vigorous anti-corruption campaign is also affecting the outflow of domestic investment. The United States' EB-5 investment immigrant visa program is one of the barometers of this impact. Today, Chinese citizens account for more than 80% of those granted such visas, compared with only 13% 10 years ago. Relevant consulting lawyers confirmed that anti-corruption is one of the key reasons for the increase in such visa applications. Corruption in China is serious. For many companies, it, like intellectual property rights, is a key reason why foreign investors are reluctant to invest in China. Therefore, anyone doing business in China applauds Beijing's anti-corruption campaign. The tangible impact of the anti-corruption campaign on the Chinese economy and even on the outflow of investment from the country has shown how serious China is in carrying out this campaign. (Author Jack Penkovsky)

6ecbc29a413a7baa3200541403e7f5ea68358314.sourceText: 新移民法草案出炉 未遇强烈抵抗 《纽约时报》称，近日，美国参议院移民改革”8人帮”小组公布了一份为1100万非法移民提供获得身份途径的改革法案，新法案并没有招致6年前的强烈反对声浪，一些包括电台脱口秀主持人在内的保守派人士放缓其反对大赦非法移民的强硬态势。 两党移民改革小组在4月16日出台了一份844页的移民改革草案，奥巴马总统和其支持者都希望能在6月初将该法案在参院通过。相关听证会将自19日开始，新的移民改革法案强调进行更为严格的边境管制，同时为1100万非法移民提供获得身份的具体途径。 新移民法案的公布并没有招致6年前的强烈反对声浪，而之前的2007年6月，就在参议院将要对移民改革法案投票的当天，电台脱口秀主持人和反移民组织发起了一场针对国会议员的愤怒电话行动，参议院保安最终宣布电话交换台完全停摆。 虽然一些保守派电台脱口秀主持人仍集结起来，想在国会山再次发起活动反对新移民法案，但其中一些主持人也同时表示，”现在的情况大不相同了，很多听众都认为应该为1100万非法移民提供合法身份，也应该支持相关改革法案。” ”8人帮”小组中的一员，2010年当选的茶党(Tea Party)红人，佛罗里达州共和党参议员马尔科．卢比奥(Marco Rubio)在过去的几个月中，一直在电台节目中，打探他的保守派基础选民对他在此项立法中的表现作何反应，而这些都和他的政治抱负以及该立法提案是否会成功通过息息相关。 少数支持移民改革法案的保守派电台脱口秀节目主持人迈德维也表示，卢比奥的行动有所奏效，他看到了保守派基层选民的一些转变。
6ecbc29a413a7baa3200541403e7f5ea68358314.translatedText: The draft of the new immigration law has been released without strong resistance. The New York Times stated that recently, the U.S. Senate’s “Gang of 8” immigration reform group released a reform bill that would provide a way for 11 million illegal immigrants to obtain status. The new bill did not attract the strong opposition six years ago. Some conservatives, including radio talk show hosts, have slowed down their hard-line stance against amnesty for illegal immigrants. The bipartisan immigration reform group released an 844-page immigration reform draft on April 16. President Obama and his supporters hope to pass the bill in the Senate in early June. Relevant hearings will begin on the 19th. The new immigration reform bill emphasizes stricter border controls while providing specific ways for 11 million illegal immigrants to obtain status. The announcement of the new immigration bill did not lead to the strong opposition six years ago. In June 2007, on the day the Senate was about to vote on the immigration reform bill, radio talk show hosts and anti-immigration groups launched an angry phone call campaign against members of Congress. Senate security finally announced that the telephone exchange was completely shut down. Although some conservative radio talk show hosts are still gathering together to launch another campaign on Capitol Hill to oppose the new immigration bill, some of them also said, "The situation is very different now. Many listeners believe that 11 million illegal immigrants should be provided with legal status and should also support relevant reform bills." A member of the "Gang of 8" group, a Tea Party star elected in 2010, Florida Republican Senator Marco. Marco Rubio has spent the past few months on his radio show trying to gauge how his conservative base will react to his performance on the legislation, which is closely tied to his political ambitions and whether the proposed legislation will pass. Medway, a conservative radio talk show host who is one of the few who supports the immigration reform bill, also said that Rubio's actions have been effective and that he has seen some changes among conservative grassroots voters.

b532292f648573094f25c520fa6a788fc28e41d4.sourceText: （侨联供稿）送走了酷热的夏暑，迎来了美丽的金秋，象徵着凤凰城地区最美好季节的来临，人们将尽情地享受大自然给予的美好时光。在这秋风送爽的日子裡，大凤凰城地区华人侨团联合总会将於今年十一月十七日（星期六）上午11点到下午2 点半在天披市（Tempe）Kiwanis 公园的湖边，举办一次华人华侨金秋大联欢野餐会。届时，中餐馆协会将提供美味的思烧烤野餐，人们可以漫步交谈，钓鱼；参加球类比赛，或参加卡拉OK歌咏比赛，放声纵情歌唱；斐匿中文学校的孩子们还将当天的课堂搬到野餐会上，让学生们切身体验中华文化，他们也将展示他们的学习成果。欢迎本地区华人华侨团体，学校，个人和你们的亲友踊跃前来参加。野餐费每人三美元五十分，五岁以下儿童免费。有团体参加的请於十一月十日前电话或Email报名，以便準备食物。
b532292f648573094f25c520fa6a788fc28e41d4.translatedText: (Contributed by the Federation of Overseas Chinese) Bidding away the scorching summer heat and ushering in the beautiful golden autumn, symbolizing the arrival of the most beautiful season in the Phoenix area, people will enjoy the beautiful time given by nature. In this refreshing autumn day, the Greater Phoenix Area Chinese Overseas Chinese Association will hold a Chinese Overseas Chinese Golden Autumn Picnic at the lakeside of Kiwanis Park in Tempe City from 11 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. on November 17 this year (Saturday). At that time, the Chinese Restaurant Association will provide a delicious Si barbecue picnic, where people can stroll, talk, and fish; participate in ball games or participate in karaoke singing competitions and sing to their heart's content; the children of Feini Chinese School will also move their classes to the picnic that day, so that students can experience Chinese culture first-hand, and they will also show off their learning achievements. We welcome local Chinese and overseas Chinese groups, schools, individuals and your relatives and friends to come and participate. Picnic fee is three dollars and fifty cents per person, children under five years old are free. If you have a group participating, please call or email to register before November 10th so that food can be prepared.

d805f550ab9cce7a4d55b90e5ecd8ef19a525c24.sourceText: 凤凰城气如虹：团体组织 二○一二年三月了，农曆壬辰龙年也进入二月，凤凰城侨界各社团的联欢春宴，仍持续进行着，显示出团体组织的潜在力量并不简单，意义深远，值得大家去拥护支持。 海外侨界集会结社，是传承先辈华人的团结精神。先辈们之所以飘洋过海出外谋生，是当时国内不安定，生活困苦。如果家乡富庶，容易过活，安居乐业，谁愿意冒险离乡背井到人地生疏的外国工作？在别人的国土觅食，种族不同，语言不通，受到欺凌歧视在所难免，只得忍气吞声，怎敢怨天尤人。先辈们明白，惟有团结能凝聚力量，自我联繫，以集会结社方式团结起来，产生力量，互相帮助，济弱扶倾，才能屹立不摇。 集会结社的形成，始初都是志同道合、志趣相投所引起，所谓「物以类聚，人以群分」，先辈们最先的组织，不外是同乡情谊、工友关係和宗亲血缘三大类。 在陌生的国境碰到同声同气的故乡人，「君自故乡来，应知故乡事，」那种喜悦是无法形容的，所谓「久旱逢甘雨，他乡遇故知」，人生一大快事，进而成立同乡会，乡音乡谊，一切比较畅顺。 其次是职业相同，如果大家都是行家，话匣子揭开就容易沟通，题材不绝；或者在一起工作的同事，经常接触，患难扶持，有时被资方欺侮，更须集合一股力量，工会业团组织由此而诞生。 还有是姓氏宗亲，也是华人的传统特色，「先生贵姓？」几乎是早期华侨社交的第一句问话，对方如果同姓，称兄道弟，倍感亲切，姓氏比同乡更明显有血缘关係，五百年前是一家，追本溯源，万姓同宗，所以宗亲会的成立，也是团结象徵。 各个组织是这样分门别类的形成，然后再互相联繫成为侨社一股强大力量。然而，今年春节期间，我却听到一种异常的声音，有位朋友感慨地说：「这些集会结社好是好了，却美中不足，带有自立门户，各自为政的模式。譬如想加入某某同乡会，可是自己不是该乡村的人，不能出席；想参加某个宗亲会，自己又不是那个姓氏，不得其门而入。」他最后是讚扬开平同乡会的组织，附设开平之友，人人都可以参加。 这位朋友的感触，主因在于其同乡人数稀少，其同姓宗亲不多，缺乏可参与的团体组织，故有此言。 相反，我也听到一些意见，认为同乡会就是联络乡谊，宗亲会就是结合宗亲，其他行业如餐馆会、工商会、作协等，目的是联繫该范围的人士，敦睦情谊，巩固会务，互助合作，这样才符合「正名」学说，名正言顺，名副其实。举办联欢宴会时，当然可邀请其他人士参与，交流经验，互相切磋，同欢共聚，毋须附设什麽会社，因为此举变成複杂，失却组织本会的原来宗旨。 民主社会就是这样，见仁见智，见解不同，观点迥异，好与不好，宜或不宜，各有自由，都不是大问题，至于发展结果如何，成绩优劣良莠，惟有等待事实证明，让时间寻求答桉。 最重要的一点，还是海外侨团的组织是否能展示侨社力量，为大众侨胞服务。所有侨团理事的责任重大，不是搞好联欢春宴就算成功，皆大欢喜固然获得鼓掌，但平日随时发挥团结博爱的精神，公尔忘私地互相扶持，尽心尽力地解决难题，热心公益，我为人人，才值得敬重。 团体组织是海外华人不可忽视的力量，经过年年月月，风风雨雨，累积经验，大都稳固下来；随着移民的增加，以前尚未成立的团体，现在也陆续组织起来。只是国际政治环境的转变，两岸实力的消长，影响侨社地位，活动范围不多不少受到阻碍。过去只有一个中华民国，悬挂青天白日满地红旗，有才干的侨领获聘任为侨务委员，不用分心，无须顾虑。自从大陆政权取代中华民国在联合国的位置后，海外侨务发生大变化，侨团组织逐渐分为两派，纠纷争执，意见分歧，这是最令人遗憾的情况。
d805f550ab9cce7a4d55b90e5ecd8ef19a525c24.translatedText: Phoenix City is full of energy: Group Organizations March 2012 is already here, and the Renchen Year of the Dragon in the lunar calendar has entered February. The Spring Banquet of various overseas Chinese associations in Phoenix City is still going on, showing that the potential power of group organizations is not simple, but has far-reaching significance, and is worthy of everyone's support. Overseas Chinese communities gather and form associations to inherit the spirit of unity of our ancestors. The reason why our ancestors traveled across the ocean to make a living was because the country was unstable and life was difficult at that time. If the hometown is rich, easy to live and live in peace and contentment, who is willing to take the risk of leaving the hometown to work in a foreign country with unfamiliar people? Foraging for food in other people's land, with different races and language barriers, it is inevitable to be bullied and discriminated against, so you have to swallow your anger, how dare you blame others. Our ancestors understood that only through unity can we gather strength, connect ourselves, unite through gatherings and associations, generate strength, help each other, and support the weak, can we stand firm. The formation of gatherings and associations was originally caused by like-minded people and like-minded interests. As the saying goes, "birds of a feather flock together, people form groups." The organizations first formed by our ancestors were nothing more than three categories: friendship with fellow villagers, relationships with fellow workers, and kinship. The joy of meeting people from your hometown who share the same sentiments in a strange country is indescribable. "When you come from your hometown, you should know the things about your hometown." The joy is indescribable. As the saying goes, "A long drought is met with sweet rain, and meeting old friends in a foreign land" is one of the great joys in life. Later, a hometown association is established, and local friendship is established, and everything goes smoothly. Secondly, the profession is the same. If everyone is an expert, it will be easier to communicate with each other and the topics will be endless; or colleagues who work together have frequent contact, support in times of trouble, and are sometimes bullied by the management, so they need to unite a force, and the trade union organization was born. There is also the surname clan, which is also a traditional Chinese feature. "Sir, what is your surname?" is almost the first question asked by overseas Chinese in the early days. If the other party has the same surname, they will be called brothers and they will feel more cordial. The surname is more obvious than the blood relationship between the people from the same hometown. Five hundred years ago, we were the same family. Going back to our roots, thousands of people have the same surname. Therefore, the establishment of the clan association is also a symbol of unity. Various organizations are formed in this way, and then interconnected to become a powerful force in the overseas Chinese community. However, during the Spring Festival this year, I heard an unusual sound. A friend said with emotion: "These gatherings and associations are good, but they have shortcomings. They are independent and independent. For example, if you want to join a certain hometown association, but you are not from the village, you can't attend; if you want to join a certain clan association, you are not from that surname, so you can't get in." He finally praised the organization of the Kaiping Township Association, which has the Friends of Kaiping attached to it, and everyone can participate. This friend's feelings were mainly due to the fact that the number of people in his hometown was sparse, there were not many relatives with the same surname, and there was a lack of group organizations to participate in, so he said this. On the contrary, I have also heard some opinions that the purpose of the hometown association is to connect fellow villagers, and the clan association is to unite the clansmen. The purpose of other industries, such as restaurant associations, industrial and commercial associations, writers associations, etc., is to contact people in the same range, harmonize friendship, consolidate association affairs, and help and cooperate with each other. Only in this way can it comply with the theory of "correcting names", making the name legitimate and worthy of its name. When holding a party, of course, you can invite other people to participate, exchange experiences, learn from each other, and have fun together. There is no need to attach any club, because this will become complicated and lose the original purpose of organizing the association. This is what a democratic society is. People have different opinions, different views, good or bad, appropriate or inappropriate, and everyone has their own freedom. It is not a big issue. As for the development results, whether the results are good or bad, we can only wait for the facts to prove it and let time find the answer. The most important point is whether the organization of overseas Chinese groups can demonstrate the strength of overseas Chinese communities and serve the masses of overseas Chinese. All directors of overseas Chinese associations have a heavy responsibility. A successful Spring Festival banquet does not count as a success. Although everyone is happy and applauded, they must display the spirit of unity and fraternity at any time on weekdays, support each other selflessly, do their best to solve problems, and be enthusiastic about public welfare. I am worthy of respect for everyone. Group organizations are a force that overseas Chinese cannot ignore. After years of ups and downs and accumulated experience, most of them have become stable. With the increase of immigrants, groups that were not established before are now being organized one after another. It's just that the changes in the international political environment and the rise and fall of cross-strait strength have affected the status of overseas Chinese communities, and the scope of their activities has been hindered. In the past, there was only one Republic of China, with a clear sky and white sun and red flags all over the ground. Talented overseas Chinese leaders were appointed as Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee members without any distractions or worries. Since the mainland regime replaced the Republic of China's position in the United Nations, overseas Chinese affairs have undergone great changes. The overseas Chinese organizations have gradually divided into two groups, with disputes and differences of opinion. This is the most regrettable situation.

6a178ecf1a8967d971b7b9ea025cc6b564bad2e0.sourceText: 今年是美国国会废止《排华法案》八十周年。 六月十七日，亚利桑那华人历史协会举办“纪念废止《排华法案》八十周年座谈会，有20位历史协会的理事、成员以及学者出席了会议。与会人士热烈发言，从不同的层次和角度发表自己的观点。并通过此次活动加深了对相关历史的认识，提高了思想的维度。这次座谈会规模不大，但意义深远。 出席座谈会成员合照留念 前排左起：冯建华、周燕飞、林涧、闻玲琳、张华芳、庄淑华、王雅鸿、王振梅、梁月园。 后排左起：余民信、李江，张万波、王益成、张肇鸿、邓朝驹、唐孝先、顾菊芳、荟茹、徐强，攝影：袁淑娟、Sean Cotton。
6a178ecf1a8967d971b7b9ea025cc6b564bad2e0.translatedText: This year marks the 80th anniversary of the repeal of the Chinese Exclusion Act by the U.S. Congress. On June 17, the Arizona Chinese Historical Association held a symposium to commemorate the 80th anniversary of the abolition of the Chinese Exclusion Act. 20 directors, members and scholars of the historical association attended the meeting. Participants spoke enthusiastically and expressed their views from different levels and angles. Through this event, they deepened their understanding of relevant history and improved the dimension of their thoughts. The scale of this symposium was small, but it was of far-reaching significance. Members attending the symposium took a group photo as a souvenir. Front row from left: Feng Jianhua, Zhou Yanfei, Lin Jian, Wen Linglin, Zhang Huafang, Zhuang Shuhua, Wang Yahong, Wang Zhenmei, Liang Yueyuan. Back row from left: Yu Minxin, Li Jiang, Zhang Wanbo, Wang Yicheng, Zhang Zhaohong, Deng Chaoju, Tang Xiaoxian, Gu Jufang, Hui Ru, Xu Qiang. Photography: Yuan Shujuan, Sean. Cotton.

6067faa57c1f2a4b60d68127d15b530db152a19c.sourceText: 亚利桑那华人历史协会在会议前做了较充分的准备，会长张肇鸿把不同议题的发言者进行了组织安排。为了更全面深入的了解历史和结合当前的形势和任务，还特别邀请了发起和推动美国国会向《排华法案》道歉活动的第一人，也是美国华人联合会（UCA)创办人薛海培先生作电话连线的发言，以及《再见赛珍珠》的作者徐和平老师作录音播放。 唐孝先老师（左）赠送《美华史记》給华人历史协会会长张肇鸿
6067faa57c1f2a4b60d68127d15b530db152a19c.translatedText: The Arizona Chinese Historical Association made adequate preparations before the meeting. President Zhang Zhaohong organized speakers on different topics in order to have a more comprehensive and in-depth understanding of history and the current situation. and tasks, and also specially invited Mr. Xue Haipei, the first person to initiate and promote the U.S. Congress’ apology campaign for the Chinese Exclusion Act and the founder of the United Chinese in America (UCA), to make a speech on the phone, and Mr. Xu Heping, the author of "Goodbye Pearl Buck", to make a recording. Teacher Tang Xiaoxian (left) presented "American History" to Zhang Zhaohong, President of the Chinese Historical Association

3d7c7c3cd1c50b40f75f03eaf05f4a109c64ec01.sourceText: 座谈会分为四个议题作了讨论。 第一部分：《排华法案》产生的时代背景，以及在法案通过的前后时期，种族主义者对华人的歧视和迫害的案例，这部分内容由华人历史协会副会长唐孝先老师主讲。 1882年，在美国的《排华法案》出台之前，从1859年到1906年，已爆发了近200次驱逐华人事件。1849年至1902年间，洛杉矶官方记载的302件私刑案件中，有200名受害者是亚裔。1852年在埃尔.多拉多，华人被赶出采矿店。1853年，在沙斯塔淘金的三千多的华人被驱逐，到1950年代末，当地华人仅剩160人。1885年，驱逐和杀戳华人的骚乱席卷美国西部。在加州的尤里卡镇，数千暴民围攻并焚烧唐人街。他们搭起绞刑架进行威胁，三百多华人被迫逃亡。在怀俄明州石泉城，至少有38名华人矿工被杀害，有数十名受重伤或失踪，华人住宅遭焚毁。同年11月，华盛顿州塔科马镇镇长伙同500余名武装分子遂户驱赶华人，并火烧唐人街。 唐孝先老师 张肇鸿会长在编辑文稿时作了如下的补充：美国排华从早期的暴民式的攻击、劫掠与謀殺，到后來演变成為有組织的、制度性的、由官方推行的全面性行动。排华的主要份子，也由原先只局限於工人阶級而扩展到议会与市府，州府，最后到国会。政客為了爭取工人选票，乃牺牲华人利益以取宠。這整個行动背后的动力，就是种族歧視，《排华法案》是美国历史上针对单一国家移民所作出的最重大的限制法案。 《棑华法案》通过后，对申请进入美境的华人进行了更严格的限制，最明显的例子是旧金山湾的天使𡷊移民站。从1910年至1940年，此移民站处理了约17.5万的华人， 其中56,113名记录在案华人因各种原因不准进入美国，占其申请入境总人数的三分之一。天使島羁押室的床架窄小，上中下三层要住六人，本来住宿50人的地方，变成任何时候都有200 至 600 人占据。相对而言，对其它欧洲国家的移民则宽限许多。《棑华法案》在实施后，此类华人被歧视的案例可以说是不胜枚举。
3d7c7c3cd1c50b40f75f03eaf05f4a109c64ec01.translatedText: The symposium was divided into four topics for discussion. The first part: the historical background of the emergence of the "Chinese Exclusion Act" and the cases of racist discrimination and persecution of Chinese before and after the passage of the bill. This part was lectured by Teacher Tang Xiaoxian, vice president of the Chinese Historical Association. Before the introduction of the Chinese Exclusion Act in the United States in 1882, nearly 200 expulsions of Chinese had occurred from 1859 to 1906, and 302 lynchings were officially recorded in Los Angeles between 1849 and 1902. In the case, 200 victims were Asian. In 1852, the Chinese were driven out of the mining shop in Shasta. In 1853, more than 3,000 Chinese who were mining for gold in Shasta were expelled. By the end of the 1950s, there were only 1 local Chinese left. 60 people. In 1885, riots to deport and kill Chinese swept across the western United States. Thousands of mobs besieged and burned Chinatown and threatened more than 300 Chinese in Wyoming. In Spring City, at least 38 Chinese miners were killed, dozens more were seriously injured or missing, and Chinese houses were burned down. In November of the same year, the mayor of Tacoma, Washington, and more than 500 armed men drove out Chinese residents and burned Chinatown. Teacher Tang Xiaoxian President Zhang Zhaohong added the following when editing the manuscript: Anti-Chinese anti-Chinese in the United States evolved from mob-style attacks, robberies, and murders in the early days to an organized, institutional, and comprehensive action carried out by the government. The main anti-Chinese elements were also originally limited to the working class. Extending to the Congress, city halls, state capitals, and finally Congress, politicians sacrificed the interests of the Chinese to gain favor in order to win workers' votes. The driving force behind this entire action was racial discrimination. The Chinese Exclusion Act was the most significant restriction on immigration from a single country in the history of the United States. After the passage of the Anti-China Act, stricter restrictions were imposed on Chinese who applied to enter the United States. The most obvious example is the Angel Station in San Francisco Bay. From 1910 to 1940, this immigration station processed approximately 175,000 Chinese. Among them, 56,113 recorded Chinese were not allowed to enter the United States for various reasons, accounting for one-third of the total number of people who applied for entry. The bed frame of the Angel Island detention room is narrow, and six people are accommodated on the upper, middle and lower floors. The place where 50 people were originally accommodated is now occupied by 200 to 600 people at any time. In comparison, immigrants from other European countries are much more lenient. After the implementation of the "China Anti-China Act", there are countless cases of such discrimination against Chinese people.

216b5109dd5d64faec2ee775d0fccfe944b6d55d.sourceText: 第二部分：废除《排华法案》历史背景和过程。二战期间国际环境的变化以及美国正义力量推动，华人先辈通过一系列的奋起抗争运动，令到《排华法案》最终被废止，从而使在美华人能够得到了最起码的公平对待，家庭最终可以团聚，华人可以参政，华商能得到保障和发展。在此抗争过程中，赛珍珠始终是一个坚持要废止《排华法案》的典范。 有关赛珍珠的故事，尤其是她所著的书籍《大地》，华人历史协会理事周燕飞熟读并做好了充足的功课，这与徐和平老师在他的著作《再见赛珍珠》有着相同的了解。 这部分内容，座谈会首先由周燕飞女士发言，然后播放了徐和平老师的电话录音，我们摘录其中的内容来发表。 徐和平老师 周燕飞女士 赛珍珠是一个美国牧师的女儿，三个月大的时候，随父母来到中国江苏镇江。她是中国成长的美国女孩，她学的第一种语言是中文，接受的是孔教，直到15岁时才去上海读中学。之后，她返回美国读大学。结婚后和丈夫再次回到中国。她体验农村生活，积累素材，並在金陵大学、中央大学和东南亚大学教授英语。1931年她出版了《大地》以及《大地》三部曲，之后又写出更多以中国题材小说和传记文学的作品，因此在1938年获得诺貝尔文学奖。《大地》三部曲的英文本一共印行了70多版次共数百万册，她的作品被翻译成140多种文字，改变世界对中国的认知，增加了西方对中国的同情，从而在二战中对中国抗日战争给予极大的声援和支持。 在徐和平老师的录音中，专门提到了赛珍珠首先发起废除美国的《排华法案》经过： “当时，日本军国主义者和汪伪政权为挑拨和离间中美同盟，直接指责美国的排华法案说明了美国的道德伪善。日伪大肆宣传美国政府对华人的歧视：“美国人不要你们。他们只想让你们帮他们打仗。他们的《排华法案》就是针对你们的，说你们没有资格当美国公民……”。 赛珍珠于1942年2月，在纽约阿斯特酒店集会上发言极力呼吁：“假如不放弃白人至上的观念，美国会输掉这场战争。美国必须团结不同肤色族裔国家的人。” 在美国正义力量的强烈要求和社会舆论的强大压力下，美国众议院于1943年5月召开了关于废除《排华法案》的听证会。赛珍珠亲赴国会作证。她慷慨陈词表达必须废除《排华法案》的两大理由： 一、民主是美国人引以为豪的象征，到处宣扬。但民主首先是要求人类平等和公平。而《排华法案》与之相悖，玷污了民主精神，必须加以废除。 二、目前共同抗战的需要。中华民族是勤劳勇敢和热爱和平的伟大民族，现正在对日本帝国主义的入侵和占领进行艰苦卓绝的斗争。当前这场反对德、日法西斯战争能不能取得胜利，正取决于中国抗战的坚持和胜利，取决于美国能不能取得中国人民的信任和支持。 赛珍珠尖锐地指出：“每一个中国人都知道美国有个《排华法案》。中国人再也不能容忍它的存在。 她震撼人心的演说，让美国朝野感到《排华法案》再没有理由继续存在下去。 （未完待续）
216b5109dd5d64faec2ee775d0fccfe944b6d55d.translatedText: Part Two: The historical background and process of repealing the Chinese Exclusion Act. During the Second World War, due to the changes in the international environment and the promotion of the righteous forces of the United States, the Chinese ancestors rose up through a series of resistance movements, and the Chinese Exclusion Act was finally repealed, so that Chinese people in the United States could receive the minimum fair treatment, families could finally be reunited, Chinese people could participate in politics, and Chinese businessmen could be protected and developed. During this struggle, Pearl Buck was always a model who insisted on repealing the Chinese Exclusion Act. Regarding the story of Pearl Buck, especially her book "The Good Earth", Zhou Yanfei, director of the Chinese Historical Association, has read it thoroughly and done sufficient homework. This is the same understanding that teacher Xu Heping had in his book "Goodbye Pearl Buck". In this part of the symposium, Ms. Zhou Yanfei spoke first, and then the phone recording of Teacher Xu Heping was played. We excerpted the content for publication. Teacher Xu Heping Ms. Zhou Yanfei Pearl Buck is the daughter of an American pastor. When she was three months old, she came to Zhenjiang, Jiangsu, China with her parents. She is an American girl who grew up in China. The first language she learned was Chinese and she received Confucianism. She did not go to Shanghai to attend middle school until she was 15 years old. Afterwards, she returned to the United States to attend college. After getting married, my husband and I returned to China again. She experienced rural life, accumulated materials, and taught English at Jinling University, Central University, and Southeast Asian University. In 1931, she published "The Earth" and the "Earth" trilogy, and later wrote more Chinese-themed novels and biographical works, for which she won the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1938. The English version of the "The Good Earth" trilogy has been published in more than 70 editions and millions of copies. Her works have been translated into more than 140 languages, changing the world's understanding of China and increasing the West's sympathy for China, thus giving great solidarity and support to China's Anti-Japanese War during World War II. In the recording of Teacher Xu Heping, he specifically mentioned how Pearl Buck first initiated the repeal of the Chinese Exclusion Act in the United States: "At that time, the Japanese militarists and the Wang Puppet regime, in order to sow discord and alienate the Sino-US alliance, directly accused the US of the Chinese Exclusion Act and demonstrated the moral hypocrisy of the United States. The Japanese and puppets trumpeted the US government's discrimination against the Chinese: "Americans don't want you. They just want you to help them fight the war. Their "Chinese Exclusion Act" is aimed at you, saying that you are not qualified to be American citizens..." In February 1942, Pearl Buck spoke at a rally at the Astor Hotel in New York and strongly appealed: "If we do not give up the concept of white supremacy, the United States will lose this war. America must unite people of all colors and ethnicities. " Under the strong demands of the righteous forces of the United States and the strong pressure of public opinion, the U.S. House of Representatives held a hearing on the abolition of the "Chinese Exclusion Act" in May 1943. Pearl Buck went to Congress to testify in person. She gave an impassioned speech to express the two main reasons for the abolition of the "Chinese Exclusion Act": 1. Democracy is a symbol of pride for Americans and is promoted everywhere. But democracy first requires human equality and fairness. The "Chinese Exclusion Act" is contrary to this and tarnishes the spirit of democracy and must be abolished. 2. The current need for a joint war of resistance. The Chinese nation is a great nation that is industrious, courageous and peace-loving. It is currently engaged in an arduous struggle against the invasion and occupation of Japanese imperialism. Whether the current war against German and Japanese fascism can be won depends on China's persistence and victory in the war of resistance, and whether the United States can win the trust and support of the Chinese people. Pearl Buck pointedly pointed out: "Every Chinese knows that the United States has the Chinese Exclusion Act. The Chinese can no longer tolerate its existence. Her shocking speech made the American government and opposition parties feel that there was no reason for the Chinese Exclusion Act to continue to exist. (To be continued)

97d114e1afdbaa0c34c2fa78645a63ae67e9c505.sourceText: 海外华裔青少年中文教学体会分享-马立平博士主讲 海外华裔青少年中文教学体会分享-马立平博士主讲 马立平博士毕业于斯坦福大学教育学院，从事海外华裔青少年中文教育探索二十年。她通过教学实践编写出的”马立平”教学材料，受到学生和家长的喜爱我们。学校在2008年开始尝试增加”马立平”教材进行教学。如何将该教材的优势发挥其最大的作用，达到最好的教学效果，一直是学校领导和老师探索的目标。经过学校的努力，我们有幸请到了马立平博士亲自来我校进行培训、演讲。她将利用3月21日这一天，不仅为我们的中文老师做一个培训，而且还将与我们凤凰城地区的华人家长进行交流，帮助家长能够更好地辅助学生学好中文。同日，我们还请到了本地教育专家陈普博士为大家讲解中文AP考试的要点。 现将马立平博士和陈普博士的日程安排公布如下： 日期 时间 地点 参加群体 内容 3月21日 9:00am — 11:00am MCC BP-5 所有中文老师 马立平博士将与老师们分享自己多年的中文教学经验，并解答老师们的疑问。 3月21日 1:00pm–3:00pm MCC BP-5 所有家长 马立平博士阐述她的教学理念，答家长疑问。 陈普博士讲解AP中文要点。 由于阶梯教室座位有限，家长只能凭票进入会场，请有兴趣的家长于2月28日和3月7日这两天到”希望中文学校”办公室领取入场券。这次讲座将面向凤凰城地区所有华人家庭，学校仅提供100张入场券，先到先得，赠完为止。
97d114e1afdbaa0c34c2fa78645a63ae67e9c505.translatedText: Sharing of experience in teaching Chinese to overseas Chinese teenagers - Lectured by Dr. Ma Liping Sharing experience in teaching Chinese to overseas Chinese teenagers - Lectured by Dr. Ma Liping. Dr. Ma Liping graduated from the School of Education at Stanford University and has been engaged in the exploration of Chinese education for overseas Chinese teenagers for 20 years. The "Ma Liping" teaching materials she compiled through teaching practice are loved by students and parents. In 2008, the school began to try to add "Ma Liping" teaching materials for teaching. How to maximize the advantages of this textbook and achieve the best teaching effect has always been the goal of school leaders and teachers. Through the efforts of the school, we were fortunate enough to have Dr. Ma Liping come to our school to give training and lectures in person. She will use March 21st not only to provide training for our Chinese teachers, but also to communicate with Chinese parents in the Phoenix area to help parents better assist students to learn Chinese well. On the same day, we also invited local education expert Dr. Chen Pu to explain the key points of the Chinese AP exam. The schedule of Dr. Ma Liping and Dr. Chen Pu is now announced as follows: Date Time Venue Participating Group Content March 21 9:00am — 11:00am MCC BP-5 All Chinese teachers Dr. Ma Liping will share his many years of Chinese teaching experience with the teachers and answer their questions. March 21st 1:00pm–3:00pm MCC BP-5 All Parents Dr. Ma Liping explains her teaching philosophy and answers parents’ questions. Dr. Chen Pu explains the key points of AP Chinese. Due to limited seats in the lecture theater, parents can only enter the venue with tickets. Interested parents are asked to go to the "Hope Chinese School" office on February 28 and March 7 to collect their tickets. This lecture will be open to all Chinese families in the Phoenix area. The school only provides 100 tickets, first come, first served, while supplies last.

f90a1bdfd3db24b25aa2e1b5428c2d87361ce6d9.translatedText: China will launch the largest-scale operation to protect Tibetan antelopes Xinhuanet Starting from May this year, the Hoh Xil Nature Reserve in western China and the national-level Qiangtang in Tibet...

d65b47faf1af226bfced766f2a56b349ade1397a.sourceText: 今年５月起，位于中国西部的可可西里自然保护区、西藏羌塘国家级自然保护区、青海三江源国家级自然保护区和新疆巴州阿尔金山国家级自然保护区将携手展开全国最大规模的保护藏羚羊行动，这也是四大保护区首次联手开展打击盗猎的巡山行动。
d65b47faf1af226bfced766f2a56b349ade1397a.translatedText: Starting from May this year, the Hoh Xil Nature Reserve in western China and the national-level Qiangtang in Tibet have The nature reserve, Qinghai Sanjiangyuan National Nature Reserve and Xinjiang Bazhou Altun Mountain National Nature Reserve will work together to launch the country's largest operation to protect Tibetan antelopes. This is also the first time that the four major reserves have jointly launched a mountain patrol operation to combat poaching.

20699d3c05ad79a0cf237969ac1889ac6a683599.sourceText: 藏羚羊栖息在青藏高原海拔４６００米至６０００米的荒漠草甸和高原草原等环境中，是中国国家一级保护动物。由于其皮毛在国际市场上价格昂贵，上世纪八十年代，这种被称为青藏高原精灵的野生动物遭到毁灭性捕杀。直到本世纪初中国政府在藏羚羊的主要栖息地成立四大保护区，藏羚羊的数量才得到逐步恢复。
20699d3c05ad79a0cf237969ac1889ac6a683599.translatedText: Tibetan antelope inhabits desert meadows and plateau grasslands on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau at an altitude of 4,600 meters to 6,000 meters. It is a national first-level protected animal in China. This wild animal, known as the Elf of the Tibetan Plateau, was destructively hunted in the 1980s because its fur was expensive in the international market. It was not until the Chinese government established four major protected areas in the Tibetan antelope's main habitat at the beginning of this century that the number of Tibetan antelopes gradually recovered.

ad783aa274b5b99858ed8e47f8fbca801120c2b0.sourceText: ”这次联合打击盗猎活动有可能持续１到３个月，按照预想将成为每年的惯例。”可可西里国家级自然保护区管理局党委书记才达说，２０１０年９月７日，四大保护区在青海省会西宁召开藏羚羊保护十年回顾暨中国四大自然保护区研讨会，会上签订了四大保护区联手保护藏羚羊的协议，而即将展开的大规模打击盗猎巡山行动就是这次会议的成果之一。
ad783aa274b5b99858ed8e47f8fbca801120c2b0.translatedText: "This joint anti-poaching campaign is likely to last from 1 to 3 months, and is expected to become an annual practice." Caida, Secretary of the Party Committee of the Hoh Xil National Nature Reserve Administration, said on September 7, 2010. The four major protected areas held a ten-year review of Tibetan antelope protection and a symposium on China's four nature reserves in Xining, the capital of Qinghai Province. At the meeting, the four major protected areas signed an agreement to jointly protect Tibetan antelopes. The upcoming large-scale anti-poaching patrol operation is one of the results of this meeting.

87f9b7c289dc774b567a1b642729b46ab2342f06.sourceText: 据了解，如果这种联合行动每年都固定下来，这将成为中国自上世纪九十年代设立保护区保护藏羚羊以来，展开范围最广、规模最大的保护行动。
87f9b7c289dc774b567a1b642729b46ab2342f06.translatedText: It is understood that if this joint operation is fixed every year, it will become the most extensive and largest conservation operation since China established a protected area to protect Tibetan antelopes in the 1990s.

3d26ddbe53ff93660e90455384ca9f6319595abd.sourceText: ”保护区保护藏羚羊已经十年，盗猎活动得到极大遏制，但又有些新问题迫使四大保护区必须联手行动”西藏羌塘国家级自然保护区森林公安局局长西热说。
3d26ddbe53ff93660e90455384ca9f6319595abd.translatedText: "The reserve has been protecting Tibetan antelopes for ten years, and poaching activities have been greatly curbed. However, some new problems have forced the four major protected areas to join forces," said Xire, director of the Forest Security Bureau of Tibet's Qiangtang National Nature Reserve.

488e856068c76d3f16773e34fa10a8c028420b60.sourceText: 羌塘国家级自然保护区的工作人员介绍说，在保护区大规模巡山行动的打击下，部分盗猎分子开始雇佣当地牧民，在四大保护区的结合部进行小规模盗猎藏羚羊的活动，这种活动比较分散、隐蔽性很强。
488e856068c76d3f16773e34fa10a8c028420b60.translatedText: Staff members of the Qiangtang National Nature Reserve said that under the attack of large-scale mountain patrol operations in the reserve, some poachers began to hire local herdsmen to carry out small-scale poaching activities of Tibetan antelopes at the junction of the four major reserves. This activity is relatively scattered and highly concealed.

dee4a2eaaf0092472bd97781a10cdd01f59fbab4.sourceText: 西热说：”四大保护区的面积太大了，由于行政隶属、人手、经费等各方面问题，给了盗猎分子一些机会。”
dee4a2eaaf0092472bd97781a10cdd01f59fbab4.translatedText: Xire said: "The area of ​​the four major protected areas is too large. Due to various problems such as administrative affiliation, manpower, and funding, poachers have been given some opportunities."

e9ce666cf02b7fb22019d41a74f2e35817b75d61.sourceText: 据介绍，藏羚羊主要活动的四大保护区总面积近５５万平方公里，面积与法国接近。藏羚羊在如此广阔的高原上来回迁徙，使四大保护区的保护工作在结合部位留下了真空地带。
e9ce666cf02b7fb22019d41a74f2e35817b75d61.translatedText: According to reports, the total area of ​​the four major protected areas where Tibetan antelopes mainly roam is nearly 550,000 square kilometers, an area close to that of France. Tibetan antelopes migrate back and forth across such a vast plateau, leaving a vacuum in the combined areas of the four major protected areas.

884a87df5a021b0309d69ddd0dde4dfc6b97b3c7.sourceText: ”过去我们一次巡山需要１到３个月的时间，虽然与相邻保护区有协作意向，但因为没有形成制度，沟通起来费事又费力，往往追踪盗猎分子到了保护区边界就断了线索。”作为有十多年保护经验的老巡山队长，可可西里管理局森林公安局局长罗延海对此感受颇深。
884a87df5a021b0309d69ddd0dde4dfc6b97b3c7.translatedText: "In the past, it took us 1 to 3 months to conduct a mountain patrol. Although we had the intention to cooperate with neighboring protected areas, because there was no system, communication was cumbersome and laborious. We often lost clues when tracking poachers to the boundaries of the protected area." As an old patrol captain with more than ten years of protection experience, Luo Yanhai, director of the Forest Security Bureau of the Hoh Xil Management Bureau, feels this deeply.

c37df6edecad2767cff5448ef0cb3de23c6efd56.sourceText: 才达说，根据去年签订的联合保护协议，四个保护区将建立联防协作轮值制度，加强互访、交流和学习；每年开展联合巡山巡护、栖息地保护、科学研究、人员交流、信息互通、协同办案、生态教育等活动；将建立联络员制度，每季度定期相互通报本保护区阶段工作情况，随时向其他保护区通报本保护区开展的重大活动、案件线索等重要信息。
c37df6edecad2767cff5448ef0cb3de23c6efd56.translatedText: Caida said that according to the joint protection agreement signed last year, the four protected areas will establish a joint protection cooperation rotation system to strengthen mutual visits, exchanges and learning; joint mountain patrols, habitat protection, scientific research, personnel exchanges, information exchange, collaborative case handling, ecological education and other activities will be carried out every year; a liaison system will be established to regularly inform each other of the work status of the protected area every quarter, and inform other protected areas of major activities, case clues and other important information carried out in the protected area at any time.

165936ad792aa36f23e84ab0b769dd86032b4109.sourceText: 尽管困难重重，但中国保护藏羚羊的行动已取得巨大成果。据统计，自１９９０年以来，中国森林公安共破获盗猎藏羚羊案件１００余起，收缴藏羚羊皮１７０００余张，藏羚羊绒１１００余公斤，各种枪支３００余支，子弹１５万发，各种车辆１５３辆，抓获盗猎藏羚羊的犯罪嫌疑人近３０００人。
165936ad792aa36f23e84ab0b769dd86032b4109.translatedText: Despite the difficulties, China's actions to protect Tibetan antelopes have achieved great results. According to statistics, since 1990, China's forest police have uncovered more than 100 Tibetan antelope poaching cases, confiscated more than 17,000 Tibetan antelope skins, more than 1,100 kilograms of Tibetan antelope cashmere, more than 300 firearms, 150,000 rounds of bullets, 153 vehicles of various types, and captured nearly 3,000 suspects of Tibetan antelope poaching.

7dea6868684bb70cd6361c71c73b3eb71ceec827.sourceText: 目前藏羚羊主要栖息地棗羌塘国家级自然保护区内的藏羚羊已由保护前的６万多只恢复到约１２万只，可可西里自然保护区内藏羚羊的数量也由不足２万只恢复到了７万多只。如今在青藏公路沿线，不时可见这些高原精灵曼妙的身姿。
7dea6868684bb70cd6361c71c73b3eb71ceec827.translatedText: At present, the number of Tibetan antelopes in Zaoqiangtang National Nature Reserve, the main habitat of Tibetan antelopes, has recovered from more than 60,000 before protection to about 120,000. The number of Tibetan antelopes in Hoh Xil Nature Reserve has also recovered from less than 20,000 to more than 70,000. Today, along the Qinghai-Tibet Highway, the graceful figures of these plateau elves can be seen from time to time.

87bfaa1d2f28d5008f2e3e3dcb8e3a6b8be6c011.sourceText: 除了保护藏羚羊，四大保护区还将在区域矿产资源保护方面展开协作。西热说，羌塘、可可西里等四大保护区内，不仅有丰富的野生动植物资源，还有非常丰富的矿产资源。按照中国国家级自然保护区相关法律规定，严禁在这些区域开采矿产资源。
87bfaa1d2f28d5008f2e3e3dcb8e3a6b8be6c011.translatedText: In addition to protecting Tibetan antelopes, the four major protected areas will also collaborate on regional mineral resource protection. Xire said that the four major protected areas including Qiangtang and Hoh Xil are not only rich in wild animal and plant resources, but also very rich in mineral resources. According to the relevant laws and regulations of China's national nature reserves, the mining of mineral resources in these areas is strictly prohibited.

1fd79e2073ccf8857e0299b73784edaa3db30a4d.sourceText: ”未来的协作是多方面的，我们一定会保护好青藏高原这片净土。”才达说。
1fd79e2073ccf8857e0299b73784edaa3db30a4d.translatedText: "Future cooperation will be multifaceted, and we will definitely protect the pure land of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau," Caida said.

bb6d289e98b3f8968ceb1e3a4ccae8baa770ec9c.sourceText: 中国国民党亚利桑那直属分部于三月十一日召开党员大会，纪念青年节，缅怀革命先烈先贤。会议包括专题演讲、特别党费及政治献金报告、中国国民党党主席选举联署、以及亚利桑那直属分部常委改选，均按序一一进行，顺利圆满完成，整体会议一再强调－坚持党的信念，团结一致。 1. 专题演讲-革命诗人 少君同志专题演讲，伟大的革命诗人，壮烈的革命诗篇。历史就像天候，时有雾霾，遮蔽了事实真相。然而，雾霾消除之后，仍是晴朗天空。台湾政治雾霾，虽污染一时，但绝对淹没不了中国国民党。我们不要气馁丧志，要坚持信念，要团结向上。从历史看来，人们心中的亮光，总是指引大家朝着嚮往的方向而行，我们要有信心，理想达成之前，必有一时的波折。 国父孙中山带领革命先进，秉持共和的革命理想，历经十次起义失败，最终辛亥革命成功，推翻封建专制，创建中华民国。一九一一年农曆三月廿九日，革命先进黄兴率120馀敢死队员，直扑两广总署，史称黄花岗起义，战斗惨烈，死伤近百，知道姓名的死难烈士就有86人， 仅72人安葬于广州东郊黄花岗。 国父高度评价黄花岗之役，”是役也，碧血横飞，浩气四塞，草木为之含悲，风云为之变色，全国久蛰之人心，乃大兴奋。怨奋所积，如怒涛排壑，不可遏抑，不半载而武昌之大革命以成。则斯役之价值，直可惊天地、泣鬼神，与武昌革命之役并寿。” 黄兴是孙文思想的坚定支持与追随者，也是允文允武的诗人、词人，黄花岗起义前，表达了推翻清专制王朝的决心与信念，曾写下： 妖云瀰漫岭南天，凄绝燕塘碧血鲜。 穷图又见荆卿古，脱剑今逢季箚贤。 七日泣秦终有救，十年兴越岂徒然。 会须劫到金蛇日，百万雄狮直抵燕。 少君解说，这首诗以革命起义不断失败的悲情起，以他日革命胜利的愿景终，表现出诗人愈战愈勇，视死如归的英雄气概。整首诗深沉痛切，极能打动人心，五十六字之力，胜过多少长篇大文。 黄花岗起义失败后，身负重伤的黄兴填《蝶恋花 辛亥秋哭黄花岗诸烈士》词一阙，有血有泪：
bb6d289e98b3f8968ceb1e3a4ccae8baa770ec9c.translatedText: The Arizona branch of the Chinese Kuomintang held a party members' meeting on March 11 to commemorate Youth Day and remember the revolutionary martyrs. The meeting included special speeches, special party dues and political donation reports, joint signatures for the election of the Chinese Kuomintang Party Chairman, and the re-election of the Standing Committee of the Arizona branch, all of which were carried out in order and successfully completed. The overall meeting repeatedly emphasized - adhere to the party's beliefs and unite as one. 1. Special Speech - Revolutionary Poet Comrade Shaojun gave a special speech, a great revolutionary poet and a heroic revolutionary poem. History is like the weather, there is haze from time to time, which obscures the truth. However, after the haze cleared, the sky was still clear. Taiwan's political smog, although polluting for a while, will never drown the Chinese Kuomintang. We should not be discouraged, we must persist in our faith, and we must unite and move forward. From a historical perspective, the light in people's hearts always guides us in the direction we long for. We must have confidence that there will be setbacks before our ideals are achieved. Sun Yat-sen, the founding father, led the revolution and upheld the revolutionary ideal of the Republic. After ten failed uprisings, the Revolution of 1911 finally succeeded, overthrowing the feudal autocracy and establishing the Republic of China. On the 29th day of the third lunar month in 1911, revolutionary leader Huang Xing led more than 120 death squads to attack the General Administration of Guangdong and Guangxi. It was known as the Huanghuagang Uprising in history. The battle was brutal, with nearly a hundred casualties. There were 86 martyrs whose names were known, and only 72 were buried in Huanghuagang, the eastern suburb of Guangzhou. The founding father spoke highly of the Battle of Huanghuagang, "This battle was filled with green blood, majestic energy, grass and trees were sad for it, the wind and clouds changed color, and the hearts of people who had been dormant for a long time in the country were very excited. The accumulated resentment was like a roaring wave, unstoppable, and it took less than half a year for the great revolution in Wuchang to be completed. The value of this battle can shock the heaven and earth, make ghosts and gods weep, and live as long as the Wuchang Revolutionary Battle." Huang Xing was a staunch supporter and follower of Sun Wen's thoughts, and was also a poet and lyricist who was famous for both literature and martial arts. Before the Huanghuagang Uprising, he expressed his determination and belief in overthrowing the Qing autocratic dynasty. He once wrote: Demonic clouds fill the Lingnan sky, and the Yantang River is full of blood. Qiongtu sees Jing Qing again in ancient times, but now he takes off his sword and meets Ji Huixian. Weeping for seven days, Qin will be saved, but ten years of prosperity will be in vain. On the golden snake day, millions of lions will arrive at Yan. Shaojun explained that this poem starts with the sadness of the continuous failure of the revolutionary uprising and ends with the vision of the victory of the revolution in the future. It shows the poet's heroic spirit that he becomes more courageous as he fights and sees death as if he is home. The whole poem is deep and poignant, and it is very touching. The power of fifty-six words is stronger than many long articles. After the failure of the Huanghuagang Uprising, Huang Xing, who was seriously injured, wrote a poem in "Die Lian Hua Weeping for the Martyrs of Huanghuagang in the Autumn of 1911", full of blood and tears:

5dec85caf7aeac73093613c44937603edb914696.sourceText: 转眼黄花看发处，爲嘱西风，暂把香笼住。 待酿满枝清豔露，和风吹上无情墓。 回首羊城三月暮，血肉纷飞，气直吞狂虏。 事败垂成原鼠子，英雄地下长无语。 黄花岗一役，原计划十路进攻，但因海外募款及武器未到，加以陈炯明等鼠子之流，临阵脱逃，黄兴改为四路进攻，牺牲惨烈。 成功未有把握，成仁必有决心，英烈饮恨，夫复何言。民国成立后，陈炯明果真叛变。 2. 特别党费及海外捐款 亚利桑那直属分部募得特别党费及政治献金，总计美金一万元，由谷音及杨永慧返台缴交中央党部。洪主席亲予接见晤谈，感谢我等同志无私无我之奉献与支持，并称这就是国民党再起的动力。特别党费及海外捐款名册，详列捐款同志姓名，党证字号以及捐款金额，附加缴交收据，于会中报告传阅，以昭众信。 3. 中国国民党党主席选举说明暨联署 按中央选举规定，正式成为党主席候选人资格，需取得百分之三（3%）选举党员之联署支持。今有选举意愿者共计洪秀柱，吴敦义，郝龙斌，詹启贤，韩国瑜以及潘为刚等六位。 本分部每位同志就本身认知判断，独立自主联署其所属意之候选人。 4. 亚利桑那直属分部常委任期届满改选 亚利桑那直属分部成立六年，首任常委王玮𤧟，连任一期，两任任期届满，按组织规章，应予改选。经与会党员推荐、附议及投票，选出第三任常委丘仲平。陈超仁牧师加以祝祷，凡事能按神的旨意，完成所担负的光荣使命。王常委致辞说道，这两任任期，是她感到最有意义，最为珍贵，最有使命感的快乐时光。希望同志们莫忘初衷 － 除了团结还是团结。 国民党现况处于低谷，同志仍坚持信念，不离不弃，这就是对中华民国及国民党之感恩与大爱。我们不会怀忧丧志，散了团体。永续传承是我们的职责，谨遵国父的遗志，”革命尚未成功，同志仍需努力”。
5dec85caf7aeac73093613c44937603edb914696.translatedText: In the twinkling of an eye, the yellow flowers looked at their origins, and to remind the west wind, they temporarily held the fragrance. When the branches are full of clear dew, the gentle wind blows on the ruthless tomb. Looking back at the evening of March in Yangcheng, blood and flesh were flying, and the anger was swallowing up the captives. When everything goes wrong, he becomes the original rat, and the hero is left speechless. In the battle of Huanghuagang, a ten-pronged attack was originally planned. However, due to the lack of overseas donations and weapons, Chen Jiongming and other rats fled the battle, Huang Xing changed to a four-pronged attack, and suffered tragic sacrifices. Success is not guaranteed, but success must be determined. Heroes drink hatred, so what can I say? After the founding of the Republic of China, Chen Jiongming really rebelled. 2. Special party dues and overseas donations: The Arizona branch raised special party dues and political donations totaling US$10,000. Gu Yin and Yang Yonghui returned to Taiwan and paid them to the Central Party Committee. Chairman Hong personally met with us and talked with us. He thanked our comrades for their selfless dedication and support, and said that this was the driving force for the Kuomintang's resurgence. A special roster of party dues and overseas donations details the names of comrades who donated, party card numbers and donation amounts, with payment receipts attached, and is reported and circulated during the meeting to show public trust. 3. China Kuomintang Party Chairman Election Instructions and Signatures According to the central election regulations, to officially become a candidate for the party chairmanship, you need to obtain the joint signatures of three percent (3%) of the elected party members. There are currently six people who are willing to vote: Hong Xiuzhu, Wu Dunyi, Hao Longbin, Zhan Qixian, Han Guoyu and Pan Weigang. Each comrade in this branch independently signs the candidate of his choice based on his own knowledge and judgment. 4. The term of the standing committee members of the Arizona branch has expired and been re-elected. The Arizona branch has been established for six years. The first standing committee member, Wang Wei𤧟, was re-elected for one term. When the two terms expire, he should be re-elected according to the organizational regulations. After recommendation, secondment and voting by the party members present, Qiu Zhongping, the third member of the Standing Committee, was elected. Pastor Chen Chaoren prayed that everything could be done according to God’s will and the glorious mission he had undertaken could be completed. Standing Committee Member Wang said in her speech that these two terms were the most meaningful, precious and happy time for her, with the most sense of mission. I hope that comrades will never forget the original intention - not only to unite, but also to unite. The Kuomintang is currently at a low point, but comrades still persist in their faith and never give up. This is the gratitude and great love for the Republic of China and the Kuomintang. We will not lose heart and break up the group. Sustainable inheritance is our responsibility, and we must abide by the founding father's will, "The revolution has not yet succeeded, and comrades still need to work hard."

cf1ac3c2c43db08fb4ee7543d4975a0fa33bdfd2.sourceText: 根据多个地产分析，大凤凰地区的破产屋数量持续减少，是房屋市场缓慢恢复的信号。在七月凤凰城地区的破产屋为3176套，而六月份为3887套。六七月份获得破产通知的房子大约在4000套左右，去年同期大凤凰地区是7800多套。七月份，总的市场上存在的破产屋是23300套，六月为25300，市场分析人员指出，第一破产屋数量减少，第二陆续出来的破产屋还包括是前几个月申请，还为来得及放到市场上的后续房屋。根据市场信息，在未来市场上还将有15850套破产屋会在市场上。在今年后续的几个月里，银行拥有的房屋数量会稳步减少。如有更多买房问题可电话咨询金信地产公司Tinna (480)287-0180 电子邮箱： goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
cf1ac3c2c43db08fb4ee7543d4975a0fa33bdfd2.translatedText: According to multiple real estate analyses, the number of bankrupt houses in the Greater Phoenix area continues to decrease, which is a sign of the slow recovery of the housing market. There were 3,176 bankruptcies in the Phoenix area in July, compared with 3,887 in June. There were approximately 4,000 houses that received bankruptcy notices in June and July, compared with more than 7,800 houses in the greater Phoenix area during the same period last year. In July, the total number of bankrupt houses on the market was 23,300, and in June it was 25,300. Market analysts pointed out that the first number of bankrupt houses decreased, and the second one was that the number of bankrupt houses that came out one after another included those that were applied for in the previous few months and were subsequent houses that had time to be put on the market. According to market information, there will be 15,850 bankrupt houses on the market in the future. The number of bank-owned homes will steadily decrease over the coming months of the year. 2082acb335b47bbe73b70114a02d31949756c138.sourceText: 主讲：林 萱 走近百幅世界风景名画以及教学示范图，林萱老师为您分析讲解绘画构图的基本要素：构图中的几种形式，以及静、动、曲、直，重复、反复、变化中统一等各种表现手法；诠释对色彩的感觉、认知规律和色彩的调配方法。
2082acb335b47bbe73b70114a02d31949756c138.translatedText: Speaker: Lin Xuan After approaching hundreds of world-famous landscape paintings and teaching demonstration pictures, teacher Lin Xuan will analyze and explain to you the basic elements of painting composition: several forms in composition, as well as various expression techniques such as stillness, movement, curve, straightness, repetition, repetition, and unity in change; interpret the feeling of color, cognitive rules and color mixing methods.

1d7245a49dff15051015e9586cc7623d78453691.sourceText: 听众朋友们将和林萱老师一道体验艺术创作之于日常生活的密切联系，让艺术充分感染人们的生活审美， 帮助大家通过了解艺术规律和色彩的调配方法创造自己美好的生活环境。
1d7245a49dff15051015e9586cc7623d78453691.translatedText: Listeners will join Teacher Lin Xuan to experience the close connection between artistic creation and daily life, allowing art to fully infect people's aesthetics of life, and help everyone create their own beautiful living environment by understanding the laws of art and color mixing methods.

68bf953d46536c4b8a3a0a62ef74b096dd6ae1cc.sourceText: 林萱自幼习画。1982 年以优异的成绩毕业于四川美术学院，后留川美任教。
68bf953d46536c4b8a3a0a62ef74b096dd6ae1cc.translatedText: Lin Xuan has been practicing painting since she was a child. He graduated from Sichuan Fine Arts Institute with honors in 1982 and later stayed at Sichuan Fine Arts University to teach.

514f6743f30f2624dbf2a225250333b4736ab7db.sourceText: 1993 年来美，先后在美国的大学任副教授、雕塑设计室雕塑家，目前就任于凤凰城专业美术创作室。从学生时代至今林萱发表了大量的作品，多次举办个人画展并参展世界性的画展；她的作品被世界各国收藏家和美术爱好者和中国国家美术馆收藏。
514f6743f30f2624dbf2a225250333b4736ab7db.translatedText: Came to the United States in 1993 and has served as an associate professor and sculptor in sculpture design studios in American universities. Currently, he works in a professional art studio in Phoenix. Lin Xuan has published a large number of works since her student days, held many personal exhibitions and participated in world-wide art exhibitions; her works are collected by collectors and art lovers around the world and the National Art Museum of China.

f2d47a4a3ddcbcc7a182c4a8b9c3406b83925233.translatedText: The worst-governed states in the U.S. Every year, 24/7 Wall Street conducts a broad survey of all 50 U.S. states, based on data on financial conditions, living standards and government services...

e8c287f6fc61c70720567072d223b4796f2bf996.sourceText: 美国管理最差的州 每年，《24/7华尔街》为美国50个州进行广泛的调查，基于财务状况，生活标准和政府服务的数据，确定每一个州的管理是否完善。 《24/7华尔街》审查了数百个来自不同来源的数据，查看每一个州的债务，收入，支出和赤字，以确定其如何管理财政。并查看税收，出口和GDP的增长，贫困率，失业率，高中毕业率，暴力犯罪和止赎率，来衡量当地居民是否繁荣。 最低排名的州，其失业率也是全美最高之一。2011年，最佳排名的10个州，有9个州的失业率低于7%。 这包括北达科他州，2011年达到全美最低的水平，失业率只有3.6%。2011年全国的平均失业率为8.9%。 其中，亚利桑那州第47位，人均债务：2,188 美元，预算赤字：39.0%，失业率：9.5%，家庭收入中位数：46,709 美元，贫困线以下的百分比：19.0%。 此外，在美国10个最高空置率的城市中，本州的图森市位列第二。房屋空置率：6.9%，每平方英尺的价格中位数：$92，失业率：7.0%。第一位则是密歇根州的底特律。
e8c287f6fc61c70720567072d223b4796f2bf996.translatedText: The worst-governed states in the U.S. Each year, 24/7 Wall Street conducts a broad survey of all 50 U.S. states to determine how well each state is governed based on data on financial conditions, living standards and government services. 24/7 Wall St. reviewed hundreds of data from different sources, looking at each state's debt, revenue, spending and deficits to determine how it is managing its finances. And look at tax revenues, exports and GDP growth, poverty rates, unemployment rates, high school graduation rates, violent crime and foreclosure rates to gauge whether local residents are prospering. The lowest-ranked state also has one of the highest unemployment rates in the country. In 2011, nine of the 10 best-ranked states had unemployment rates below 7%. This includes North Dakota, which in 2011 had the lowest unemployment rate in the country at 3.6%. The national average unemployment rate in 2011 was 8.9%. Among them, Arizona ranks 47th, with per capita debt: $2,188, budget deficit: 39.0%, unemployment rate: 9.5%, median household income: $46,709, and percentage below the poverty line: 19.0%. In addition, Tucson in this state ranks second among the 10 cities with the highest vacancy rates in the United States. Vacancy rate: 6.9%, Median price per square foot: $92, Unemployment rate: 7.0%. The first place is Detroit, Michigan.

188d5074db76cdb78da8d7a9ddb77427bf1ef905.translatedText: Free credit report when buying a house The credit score system is an important basis for measuring personal credit worthiness. Whether banks are willing to lend money to home buyers, the lender’s credit...

f0a468e5f5bd67944d8f4f9c1f956763813622cd.sourceText: 信用评分制度是用来衡量个人信用价值的重要依据，银行是否愿意贷款给购屋者，贷款人的信用报告及分数佔了很大的因素，所以在贷款前，最好先查阅一下自己的信用报告。根据公平及正确信用处理法(Fair and Accurate Credit Transactions Act)，每一个人每年可以免费拿到一次自己的信用报告，此报告分别由三家主要的信用纪录公司提供，这三家公司分别是: Equifax、Experian以及TransUnion，最简单的方法是上网到 AnnualCreditReport.com 去免费申请。
f0a468e5f5bd67944d8f4f9c1f956763813622cd.translatedText: The credit score system is an important basis for measuring personal credit worthiness. Whether banks are willing to lend money to home buyers, the lender’s credit report and score play a big factor, so before taking out a loan, it is best to check your own credit report. According to the Fair and Accurate Credit Transactions Act, everyone can get their own credit report for free once a year. This report is provided by three major credit record companies: Equifax, Experian and TransUnion. The easiest way is to go online to AnnualCreditReport.com to apply for free.

dc85a2e6990c5347c251046f16d5fe5231966a02.sourceText: 在拿到该份信用报告后，请详细检查您的个人资料是否正确，像是: 姓名、住址、年龄等等；是否有不明帐户出现，例如: 您未持有的信用卡帐户、贷款帐户等，以及有无任何帐户是您每期按时缴款，却出现迟缴的纪录，如果有任何错误、您有权向信用纪录公司提出证明，要求更正。信用报告上出现错误，可能导致您付出比别人高的贷款利率，甚至造成银行拒绝您的贷款申请。
dc85a2e6990c5347c251046f16d5fe5231966a02.translatedText: After getting the credit report, please check in detail whether your personal information is correct, such as: name, address, age, etc.; whether there are any unknown accounts, such as: credit card accounts, loan accounts, etc. that you do not hold, and whether there are any accounts where you pay on time every period but have a record of late payment. If there are any errors, you have the right to submit proof to the credit record company and request corrections. Errors on your credit report may cause you to pay a higher loan interest rate than others, or even cause the bank to reject your loan application.

de34d252a7c56c5b7ff8b2c4e9a82b72ee248798.sourceText: 不好的信用纪录会导致银行给贷款者较高的贷款利率，因为对银行来说，贷款者的信用价值(Creditworthiness)较低、风险比较高。银行是如何评估贷款者的信用价值及风险呢? 除了信用报告内容外，银行通常还会使用信用评分来做决策。决定信用评分的公式有几种，但是大部分的贷款银行使用一套称作FICO的公式，它的分数范围介于300-850之间，分数越高代表信用越好，要提高您的信用分数是有方法的。
de34d252a7c56c5b7ff8b2c4e9a82b72ee248798.translatedText: A bad credit record will cause the bank to give the borrower a higher loan interest rate, because to the bank, the borrower's creditworthiness (Creditworthiness) is low and the risk is relatively high. How do banks evaluate the credit worthiness and risk of borrowers? In addition to the content of credit reports, banks usually use credit scores to make decisions. There are several formulas for determining credit scores, but most lending banks use a formula called FICO. Its score range is between 300-850. The higher the score, the better the credit. There are ways to improve your credit score.

396216d4a21ea7020b8c7adcf2fc9dcb800280a0.sourceText: 改善自己的信用纪录及分数，才不会在购屋时比别人付出更高的贷款利率。如果您有任何房地产方面的问题，非常欢迎您打电话到我的专线 (480) 612-4545 或 email至 Rich@RichLiao.com

b2ae54869c516fde65acaaa320cd30a0bd04471b.sourceText: （秦清）最近，”太阳鸟”华人网转载了两条新闻 ：’洋奶粉’进中国需出示’洋身份’认证 和” 中国官方一周内数度发声 重拳打击食品安全犯罪 ”。正逢”母亲节”感慨颇多。作为一个母亲最珍贵的礼物是什么？孩子的健康！ 看了’洋奶粉’进中国需出示’洋身份’认证这篇报道，我想媒体似乎偏移了新闻视角，中国妈妈不是在乎孩子吃的是洋奶粉还是土奶粉，而是在乎孩子吃的是否是营养的健康的奶粉。中国的食品监督体制，竟然连这个都保证不了？那么最好把”母亲节”改为”中国国耻日”更为妥当一些。是不是应该在奶粉的各种认证上下工夫呢？以前难道就完全没有认证吗？如果有，为什么奶粉问题还依然频出？ 我要代表”中国妈妈”向政府要一份母亲节礼物－－”食品监督终身责任制！” 我们不要一项行动，也不仅要惩罚那些食物链条上的犯罪者，更要一个健康的，保证”食品安全”的体系。这个体系，不仅是食品安全法，不仅是那些食品链条上的犯罪者，还有一个非常重要的角色–食品监督者。妈妈们交给了政府审查的权力，如果监督者不在乎老百姓的性命，那么妈妈们也应该让这些渎职者法办。 食品监督有众多环节，例如：采购，加工，运输，零售。每一个被监督的环节，都应该留下实名记录，而且食品监督的责任应该终身制。有些监督者可能因为工作疏忽，有那么几个，或者几十个劣质产品通过检查，还尚可理解。如果是大量劣质产品出现在市场上，那么监督者去干什么了？偶尔的疏忽了？还是同流合污了？对他们的惩罚也不应该是”罚”，也应该上升到”刑”。 在谷歌搜索了”食品监督终身责任制”，只看到对食品犯罪者的惩罚，希望制定这些法律法规的监督者，不要”忘”了自己的责任，只有整个监督系统健全了，运行了，那么食品安全问题才不会成为一项行动或者是运动。 希望下一个母亲节快乐，中国妈妈们真得能获得这份最珍贵的礼物。
b2ae54869c516fde65acaaa320cd30a0bd04471b.translatedText: (Qin Qing) Recently, the "Sunbird" Chinese website reprinted two pieces of news: 'Foreign milk powder' entering China requires a 'foreign identity' certification and" Chinese officials have made several announcements within a week to crack down on food safety crimes." It’s Mother’s Day and I have a lot of emotions. What is the most precious gift of being a mother? Your child's health! After reading the report that "foreign milk powder" needs to show "foreign identity" certification when entering China, I think the media seems to have shifted the news perspective. Chinese mothers do not care whether their children are eating foreign milk powder or local milk powder, but whether their children are eating nutritious and healthy milk powder. China’s food supervision system can’t even guarantee this? Then it would be more appropriate to change "Mother's Day" to "China's National Humiliation Day". Should we work on various certifications for milk powder? Was there no certification at all before? If so, why do milk powder problems still occur so frequently? On behalf of "Chinese Moms", I want to ask the government for a Mother's Day gift - a "lifelong responsibility system for food supervision!" We don't want an action, and we not only want to punish those criminals in the food chain, but also a healthy system that guarantees "food safety." This system is not only food safety law, not only criminals in the food chain, but also has a very important role - food supervisors. Mothers have handed over the power of censorship to the government. If the supervisors do not care about the lives of ordinary people, then mothers should also hold these malfeasancers to justice. Food supervision has many links, such as: procurement, processing, transportation, and retail. Real-name records should be kept for every step being supervised, and food supervision responsibilities should be lifelong. Some supervisors may be negligent in their work, and it is understandable that a few or dozens of inferior products pass inspection. If a large number of inferior products appear on the market, what are the supervisors doing? An occasional oversight? Or are you complicit? Their punishment should not be "punishment", but should be upgraded to "punishment". When I searched Google for "lifetime responsibility system for food supervision", I only saw the punishment for food criminals. I hope that the supervisors who formulate these laws and regulations will not "forget" their responsibilities. Only when the entire supervision system is sound and functioning, then food safety issues will not become an action or movement. I hope that next Mother’s Day is a happy one and that Chinese mothers can really get this most precious gift.

c5d673b4f4a502075def5ed19bea5d0da9aba31c.sourceText: 全美中文学校协会第九次全国代表大会暨华文教育研讨会于12月7-9日在美国俄亥俄州辛辛那提市千禧大酒店胜利召开。以”凝聚力量，拓宽渠道，纵深发展” 为大会主题的研讨会，吸引了来自美国各地的近二百名校董、校长、教务长及教师前来参加。辛辛那提市特地将大会开幕式的12月8日定为辛辛那提市的”全美中文学校协会日”，为大会的召开营造了浓烈气氛，凸显出”中文热”在美国各地已经占居显要地位。
c5d673b4f4a502075def5ed19bea5d0da9aba31c.translatedText: The ninth national congress and Chinese education seminar of the National Association of Chinese Schools was successfully held on December 7-9 at the Millennium Hotel in Cincinnati, Ohio, USA. The seminar with the theme of "Gathering Strength, Broadening Channels, and Deep Development" attracted nearly 200 school directors, principals, provosts and teachers from all over the United States to participate. The city of Cincinnati specially designated December 8, the opening ceremony of the conference, as Cincinnati’s “National Association of Chinese Schools Day”, creating a strong atmosphere for the conference and highlighting that “Chinese fever” has occupied a prominent position throughout the United States.

03e91fd25cc971f3592c8dd5fb6b8c29e2bd1c7a.sourceText: 开幕式上，会长廖启红致开幕词后，特邀贵宾辛辛那提市市长Mark Mallory，俄亥俄州西切斯特华裔市长Lee Wong, 中国国务院侨办文化司司长雷振刚，国务院侨办文化司华文教育处处长邱立国，中国驻纽约总领馆副总领事周立民等并发表讲话；俄亥俄州州长John R. Kasich 特委派代表在大会上发言并授予协会奖状。美国联邦众议员赵美心女士特为大会开幕式发来录像讲话，感谢全美中文学校协会为美国华人团体在各个方面起到积极的带头作用。向大会发来贺函的还有：中国国务院侨务办公室马儒沛副主任，美国国会参议员 Sherrod Brown，俄亥俄州教育厅，北京市人民政府侨务办公室，上海市人民政府侨务办公室，江苏省人民政府侨务办公室，四川省人民政府侨务办公室，辽宁省人民政府侨务办公室，浙江省人民政府侨务办公室，山东省人民政府侨务办公室，全美中文学校联合总会，全美中文教师学会，全美中小学中文教师协会，南京晓庄学院，以及美国华人全国委员会等。协会会长廖启红在大会上作了工作报告，总结了两年来协会工作以及展望协会今后发展新方向。
03e91fd25cc971f3592c8dd5fb6b8c29e2bd1c7a.translatedText: At the opening ceremony, after President Liao Qihong delivered the opening speech, special guests Mark Mallory, Mayor of Cincinnati, Chinese American Mayor Lee Wong of West Chester, Ohio, Lei Zhengang, Director of the Culture Department of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council, Qiu Liguo, Director of the Chinese Education Division of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council, Zhou Limin, Deputy Consul General of the Chinese Consulate General in New York, etc. also delivered speeches; Ohio Governor John R. Kasich Specially appointed representatives spoke at the conference and awarded certificates to the association. U.S. Representative Ms. Zhao Meixin sent a video speech for the opening ceremony of the conference, thanking the National Chinese Schools Association for playing an active leading role in various aspects for Chinese groups in the United States. Also sending congratulatory letters to the conference: Ma Rupei, deputy director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council of China, and U.S. Senator Sherrod Brown, Ohio Department of Education, Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Beijing Municipal People's Government, Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Shanghai Municipal People's Government, Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Jiangsu Provincial People's Government, Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Sichuan Provincial People's Government, Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Liaoning Provincial People's Government, Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Zhejiang Provincial People's Government, Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of Shandong Provincial People's Government, National Federation of Chinese Schools, National Association of Chinese Teachers, National Association of Elementary and Secondary School Chinese Teachers, Nanjing Xiaozhuang College, and the National Council of Chinese Americans, etc. Association President Liao Qihong made a work report at the conference, summarizing the association's work in the past two years and looking forward to the new direction of the association's future development.

a48d1b7adb1f2eb4324a6826fa2b75b6f21f1dcd.sourceText: 美国教育部前助理副部长张君曼女士作为大会演讲嘉宾在开幕式上为大会代表作特邀演讲。张君曼在美国教育部任职期间，对教育多元化体制的建立以及政府资金补助机制的健全建树良多。她在专题讨论中，从政府运作的角度为与会者解读华文教育所面临的机遇和困难，为中文学校申请美国政府资助外语教育的渠道、途径和方法提出了有益的信息和宝贵的建议。
a48d1b7adb1f2eb4324a6826fa2b75b6f21f1dcd.translatedText: Ms. Junman Zhang, former Assistant Deputy Secretary of the U.S. Department of Education, served as a guest speaker at the conference and gave a special speech to the conference delegates at the opening ceremony. During her tenure at the U.S. Department of Education, Zhang Junman made many contributions to the establishment of a diversified education system and the improvement of government funding mechanisms. During the special discussion, she explained to the participants the opportunities and difficulties faced by Chinese education from the perspective of government operations, and provided useful information and valuable suggestions for Chinese schools to apply for the channels, methods and methods for U.S. government funding for foreign language education.

236c02f0aea4efb43bb4aa0a47ced01e047fad20.sourceText: 本届大会的一大亮点是，大会邀请了美国中文教育界另外三大组织的代表参会，即美国中小学中文教师协会(CLASS)会长贾宝才，美国大学中文教师学会(CLTA)执行长陈雅芬，全美中文学校联合总会(繁体字为主的中文学校)会长庞宝生应邀参加了这次大会。他们与参加会议的代表共同举行了座谈会，就协会间相互合作、资源整合与资源共享等问题进行了讨论。全美四大中文教育组织首次齐聚一堂，探讨如何强强联手，互助互补，共商全美华文教育大计，为今后全美中文教育发展奠定了基础，这是一个历史性的聚会。大会主题 ”凝聚力量、拓宽渠道、纵深发展”也因四大兄弟组织的联合而更加富有深远意义，它将美国中文教育推向新高，为中华语言文化发扬光大谱写新的篇章。
236c02f0aea4efb43bb4aa0a47ced01e047fad20.translatedText: One of the highlights of this conference is that the conference invited representatives from three other major organizations in the Chinese education industry in the United States, namely Jia Baocai, president of the Chinese Association of Primary and Secondary School Teachers of America (CLASS), Chen Yafen, CEO of the Chinese College Teachers Association of America (CLTA), and Pang Baosheng, president of the National Association of Chinese Schools (Chinese schools with mainly traditional Chinese characters), were invited to participate in the conference. They held a symposium with representatives attending the meeting and discussed issues such as mutual cooperation, resource integration and resource sharing among associations. For the first time, the four major Chinese education organizations in the United States gathered together to discuss how to join forces, help each other, and discuss plans for Chinese education in the United States, laying the foundation for the future development of Chinese education in the United States. This is a historic gathering. The theme of the conference "Gathering Strength, Broadening Channels, and In-depth Development" is also more far-reaching because of the alliance of the four fraternal organizations. It will push Chinese education in the United States to a new height and write a new chapter for the promotion of Chinese language and culture.

ceac2b536a1f5e8cdb116848b853c5e52fd7c6b0.sourceText: 12月7日晚，大会组委会安排了3个专题演讲会，由大学教授和华文教育专家作专题演讲，演讲内容包括”体演文化教学法” 的成功与演示；介绍现代华文教育集中识字法的特点和成果；美国华文教育研究报告与建言。俄亥俄州立大学东亚语言文学系教授，全美东亚语文资源中心主任吴伟克博士，提出了”体演教学法”理论并当场演示，给在场嘉宾一种全新的角度思考华文教育理念。在大会正式开幕前，与会代表已感受到了浓厚的华文教育学术研讨氛围。
ceac2b536a1f5e8cdb116848b853c5e52fd7c6b0.translatedText: On the evening of December 7, the organizing committee of the conference arranged three special lectures. University professors and Chinese education experts gave special lectures. The speeches included the success and demonstration of the "Performance Cultural Teaching Method"; an introduction to the characteristics and results of the concentrated literacy method in modern Chinese education; and American Chinese education research reports and suggestions. Dr. Wu Weike, professor of the Department of East Asian Languages ​​and Literatures at The Ohio State University and director of the National East Asian Language Resource Center, proposed the theory of "physical performance teaching method" and demonstrated it on the spot, giving the guests present a new perspective to think about the concept of Chinese education. Before the official opening of the conference, the participants had already felt the strong atmosphere of academic seminars on Chinese education.

d87a18d6f134be88fe57b57f02a74a59c7d2864c.sourceText: 8日下午，四个分会场的研讨会全面铺开，40位各地会员学校的演讲人在各分会场分别演讲了40多篇论文；本次会议对美国华文教育的主流化，中文教学经验的交流总结，现代教育手段的开发利用，各大华文教育组织之间的教育资源共享等问题进行了研讨。代表们针对自己学校所面临的问题与挑战，在分组论文报告会上进行了经验交流，展开了积极的讨论，各分会场的学术讨论气氛相当热烈。
d87a18d6f134be88fe57b57f02a74a59c7d2864c.translatedText: On the afternoon of the 8th, the seminars at the four branch venues were fully launched. 40 speakers from member schools from various places delivered more than 40 papers at each branch venue. This conference discussed issues such as the mainstreaming of Chinese education in the United States, the exchange and summary of Chinese teaching experience, the development and utilization of modern education methods, and the sharing of educational resources among major Chinese education organizations. Representatives exchanged experiences and had active discussions in group paper report meetings on the problems and challenges faced by their schools. The academic discussion atmosphere in each branch venue was quite lively.

567ffdce58a35d76af834f88d5ebfd4c5127a92a.sourceText: 大会在8日晚间进行了欢迎晚宴和发奖仪式，向分布在美国各地为华文教育作出杰出贡献的一百多名志愿者颁发奖状、奖牌。晚宴当中，与会代表欣赏了大辛辛那提中文学校的学生和家长为大会准备的精彩文艺节目。
567ffdce58a35d76af834f88d5ebfd4c5127a92a.translatedText: The conference held a welcome dinner and awards ceremony on the evening of the 8th, awarding certificates and medals to more than 100 volunteers across the United States who have made outstanding contributions to Chinese education. During the dinner, the delegates enjoyed the wonderful cultural program prepared by students and parents of Greater Cincinnati Chinese School for the conference.

8c8c9393ca847516df274197c57ea9a38eaf42ab.sourceText: 大会9日上午先是总结了前两天会议讨论的成果，与会代表对协会今后的工作提出了很多有益的建议。协会负责人表示，今后将继续更大范围地开展大型华文教育活动，促成会员学校负责人之间的联系和经验交流，积极推动协会资源共享，共同致力于推动华文教育主流化等目标。
8c8c9393ca847516df274197c57ea9a38eaf42ab.translatedText: On the morning of the 9th, the conference first summarized the results of the discussions in the previous two days. The participants put forward many useful suggestions for the future work of the association. The person in charge of the association said that in the future, they will continue to carry out large-scale Chinese education activities on a larger scale, promote contacts and experience exchanges among the heads of member schools, actively promote the sharing of resources in the association, and work together to promote the mainstreaming of Chinese education and other goals.

220fb748df5f07c5bb730abdc8b24079c0ddc153.sourceText: 9日上午还进行了理事会选举。帅致若、郑良根分别当选为全美中文学校协会正副会长，另有任钢、何振宇，邵艾萍、刘申、倪小鹏、张星钰、江信蓉等七人当选理事，共同组成第十届理事会。至此，全美中文学校协会第九次全国代表大会暨华文教育研讨会在友好、愉快的气氛中圆满结束。
220fb748df5f07c5bb730abdc8b24079c0ddc153.translatedText: A board of directors election was also held on the morning of the 9th. Shuai Zhiruo and Zheng Lianggen were elected as the president and vice president of the National Chinese Schools Association respectively. Seven other directors, including Ren Gang, He Zhenyu, Shao Aiping, Liu Shen, Ni Xiaopeng, Zhang Xingyu and Jiang Xinrong, were elected to form the tenth council. At this point, the Ninth National Congress of the National Association of Chinese Schools and the Chinese Education Seminar were successfully concluded in a friendly and pleasant atmosphere.

82d806dc0164a6e2e21a55a1eef368e668169632.sourceText: 全美中文学校协会是一个非赢利民间组织，协会的410多所会员学校遍布美国43个州，在校学生达10多万人。服务和影响遍及在美的千千万万华裔家庭。作为在美最大的华人组织，该会在多元文化环境中，起到了凝聚华人力量、传播中华文化、促进美中友好的重要作用。(大会秘书处供稿)
82d806dc0164a6e2e21a55a1eef368e668169632.translatedText: The National Association of Chinese Schools is a non-profit non-profit organization with more than 410 member schools in 43 states in the United States, with more than 100,000 students enrolled. Its services and influence reach thousands of Chinese families in the United States. As the largest Chinese organization in the United States, the association plays an important role in uniting the strength of the Chinese people, spreading Chinese culture, and promoting friendship between the United States and China in a multicultural environment. (Contributed by the Conference Secretariat)
