1e6f955cc81970dc4eb63f04928a100a69624d04.sourceText: 亚省百年庆典，中国表演放异彩（组图） （太阳鸟特约记者 冯海燕） 2月12号星期天，在距离亚利桑那州百岁生日前2天，州国会楼前熙熙攘攘，不同颜色、不同文化背景的亚利桑那州人从四方来聚，共贺亚省百年生辰。来自中国的表演更是吸引了众多眼球，为庆典添上了一抹靓丽的色彩。 本次庆典由州政府主办，持续两天，2月11号中午12点到下午10点与2月12号中午12点到下午6点均有庆祝活动。活动主要由分成8部分内容构成：娱乐、饮食、音乐、文化摊、全家游乐区、酒园、工艺品和教育亭子。 中国舞狮（张肇鸿摄影） 中国代表团当天在中央舞台献上了舞狮、武术表演和一场中国舞蹈，赢得了台下观众的阵阵掌声。 ”我是半个月前接到[表演]通知的，”本次舞蹈表演的负责人新东方艺术学校校长吕丽华说到。”我们的小演员们都有好几年的表演经验了，她们不紧张。” 舞蹈现场 （左一）侨联主席邓朝驹 （左二）新东方校长吕丽华 而由DynamicWushu带来的武术表演更是当天表演的一个小高潮，台下观众反应热烈，与演员 积极互动。 除表演外，中国代表团另在文化区拥有2个文化摊，在四、五十个文化摊中占住了一席之地，打出了中国的响亮名片。文化摊一个主推饮食，一个主推文化，摊前驻足的人络绎不绝。 文化推荐（张肇鸿摄影） ”我很喜欢中国菜，很好吃。”一个顾客笑指着摊前的西兰牛肉。 ”像这样的场合我们中国人一定要出席，” 活动主办人凤凰城华人侨团联合总会（侨联）主席邓朝驹说道。”我们是建设亚利桑那州的重要力量。”邓先生说虽然他是3个礼拜前才接到通知，当天的表演也稍微有点仓促，但他对整体的活动效果很满意。 ”当然我们还可以做得更好。”他笑着说道。 欢快的中国民族舞在会场大受欢迎 侨联下属的中国餐馆协会在当天准备了600位VIP席位的饭菜，为本次活动贡献了自己的力量。 另2月14号亚省百岁生辰那天，在州长讲话前中国华人社区将另献上舞龙舞狮，作为开场表演。 亚利桑那州百年庆典官方网站： http://www.az100years.org/ 美国亚省华人百年历史回顾： http://www.paaca.us/100year_az.htm （图片由新东方艺术学校提供）
1e6f955cc81970dc4eb63f04928a100a69624d04.translatedText: Alberta’s centennial celebration, Chinese performances shined (photos) (Sunbird special correspondent Feng Haiyan) On Sunday, February 12, two days before Arizona’s 100th birthday, the front of the state capitol was bustling. Arizonans of different colors and cultural backgrounds came from all over to celebrate Arizona’s 100th birthday. The performance from China attracted a lot of attention and added a beautiful touch of color to the celebration. This celebration is hosted by the state government and will last for two days. There will be celebrations from 12 noon to 10 pm on February 11 and from 12 noon to 6 pm on February 12. The event is mainly divided into 8 parts: entertainment, food, music, cultural stalls, family play area, wine garden, crafts and educational pavilion. Chinese Lion Dance (photo by Zhang Zhaohong) The Chinese delegation presented lion dance, martial arts performances and a Chinese dance on the central stage that day, winning rounds of applause from the audience. "I received the notice [of the performance] half a month ago," said Lu Lihua, the principal of New Oriental Art School, who is in charge of this dance performance. "Our young actors have several years of performance experience, and they are not nervous." Dance scene (first from left) Deng Chaoju, chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation (second from left) Lu Lihua, principal of New Oriental. The martial arts performance presented by Dynamic Wushu was a small climax of the day's performance. The audience responded enthusiastically and actively interacted with the actors. In addition to performances, the Chinese delegation also owns two cultural stalls in the cultural area, occupying a place among the forty or fifty cultural stalls, and playing a famous business card of China. One of the cultural stalls focuses on food and the other focuses on culture. There is an endless stream of people stopping in front of the stalls. Cultural Recommendation (Photography by Zhang Zhaohong) "I like Chinese food very much, it's delicious." A customer smiled and pointed at the broccoli beef in front of the stall. "We Chinese must attend occasions like this," said Deng Chaoju, chairman of the Phoenix Federation of Overseas Chinese Associations (Overseas Chinese Federation), the organizer of the event. "We are an important force in building Arizona." Mr. Deng said that although he only received the notice three weeks ago and the performance that day was a little rushed, he was very satisfied with the overall effect of the event. "Of course we can do better," he said with a smile. The cheerful Chinese folk dance was very popular at the venue. The Chinese Restaurant Association, a subsidiary of the Overseas Chinese Federation, prepared meals for 600 VIP seats that day and contributed to this event. In addition, on February 14th, the 100th birthday of the province, the Chinese community in China will present a dragon and lion dance as the opening performance before the governor’s speech. Official website of the Arizona Centennial Celebration: http://www.az100years.org/ Review of the 100-year history of Chinese in Alberta, USA: http://www.paaca.us/100year_az.htm (Pictures provided by New Oriental Art School)

42129c73419a4fcbc7041fa682b14fdc2da95f46.sourceText: 凤凰城 文若：中华精神民族魂—–观“木兰”功夫舞台剧 凤凰城 文若 十多年前，美国迪斯尼出了一部动画片”木兰”，刺激浓烈的场面令人目不暇给，格调自由奔放；宣传的是个人英雄拯救世界，塑造的是美国式的向往自由的性格；还有木兰在军中演绎爱情的情节；当然片子中不乏优美的配乐与美式的令人捧腹大笑的幽默剧情。 那时，我就在家中讲，可惜了，可惜了！中国历史上这么著名的故事，就被美国人拿去用了；问题是内在的东西走样了，千古流传英雄故事的”魂气”完全没有了，实在可惜！像”花木兰”这样经典的故事如果被懂得中国历史、懂得木兰内在中华精神的艺术家用好的艺术形式表现出来，是会走向世界的。 去年，等我得知凤凰城有一所华人开办的武术学院要演出一台”木兰”功夫舞台剧时，门票早已售罄。可能他们的广告宣传不足，我很遗憾没有早知道这个消息。 我的一位朋友有两个女儿要参加今年”木兰”剧在凤凰城的再次演出。她知道我的遗憾，早早就为我准备了两张入场券。2月2号晚终于看了一场很过瘾的演出。 演出一开始就别出生面：舞台两边不同年龄的小演员轮流出场，左边展示木兰从小到大习武的场景；右边展示木兰学习舞蹈和梳妆打扮的柔性美的一面。这台演出最精彩的就是他们把武术的各种招式非常巧妙地贯穿于始终，再加上中华传统舞蹈展现木兰柔性美的一面；柔中有刚，刚中见柔。随着剧情的发展，刀剑、长枪、棍棒、甩链十八般武艺，中华舞蹈才艺在台上充分展示；整个演出十分流畅，情感的宣泄淋漓尽致。 因为木兰故事家喻户晓，本篇不必专门介绍剧情；至于武术、舞美、音乐、服装、布景、灯光、投影等应由专业人士来分析，这里就不赘叙了。谈谈几处我印象最深的地方。 这所传授中华武术的学校选择”木兰”作为演出剧目，以武术动作为主要的表演语汇，就我的见闻，可能他们是首创，而且是非常合适、非常巧妙的选择。 这所学校的学生来源是”就地取才”，从5、6岁的儿童一直到成人不同年龄的男女学生，甚至还有非华裔学生。编导者按照木兰不同年龄的成长阶段、木兰的女扮男装，把所有的学生都安排到了合适的角色中；非华裔的学生就充当了入侵的”外敌”；编导用心非常周全。 中华民俗文化元素也很巧妙地穿插在表演中。木兰小时候父亲教她玩手影戏，屏幕上出现的是一只硕大公兔和一只纤秀母兔，使人马上联想到《木兰辞》中非常形象的比喻：”雄免脚扑朔，雌兔眼迷离。双兔傍地走，安能辨我是雄雌？”。 其中有一幕：木兰在军中，夜深寒月下，独处篝火旁，冷水就干粮；木兰触摸到她母亲给的一串珠子项链，不由得回忆起年幼在家的情景，这时左边舞台上出现父女二人在玩手影游戏。多么温馨感人，令人心酸动容。 整个演出过程中，穿插着《木兰辞》的中文旁白和英文解说。中文旁白是州大中文讲师朱婕的录音，她的语调紧松有节，舒收有度，声情并茂，很好地烘托了剧情。当旁白唸到：”朔气传金柝，寒光照铁衣。将军百战死，壮士十年归。”，真是催人泪下！ 因为表演使用的是武术动作和舞蹈语汇，加上英文解说，非华裔观众也看得津津乐道。中华历史上著名的故事《花木兰》在其他族裔中也得到了反响。 还值得一提的是，根据我以往的经验，前喊后应、随便走动的混乱场面是以华人观众为主的演出场地的常见现象。但这次演出，全场悄然无声，旁白听得清清楚楚。我们华人变得遵守剧场规矩是一方面，更是因为这次演出环环紧扣，一气呵成，流畅通顺。 这场功夫舞台剧有核心的内容，有精神魂。整个演出贯穿一个主干，表现出中华美德和民族魂：体恤父老，爱护幼弟；抗御外敌，保卫家国；立战功后不恋官位钱财，请求返家孝敬父母。这是整个剧情的精神魂。 看整场演出就像看一幅画一样，要看这幅画整体内涵和画风，再看一笔一划有无瑕疵。这场演出还是有些小的地方需要改进，比如怎样使武打鞋子、一些着装更具有历史感，舞蹈背景音乐的选用等。当然瑕不掩瑜，这台剧经过逐次雕琢，会越来越精致。 这是一出由一群具有中华历史知识、有着艺术文化底蕴的、懂得东西方文化特点并巧妙借用各种艺术手法和高科技手段的专业人士打造出来的新颖形式的舞台剧。据说该剧的编导是一位有着香港演艺背景的专业人员；记得多年前我在北京看过香港艺术家把”清明上河图”搬上了舞台。也许具有东西方文化交融背景的艺术家擅长把古典的内容用现代的手法表现出来。 感谢这群艺术家和武术学院的学生给我们带来一场有着精神魂的”木兰”功夫舞台剧；也感谢我的朋友赠票，使我弥补了遗憾。（写于2013年2月3日）
42129c73419a4fcbc7041fa682b14fdc2da95f46.translatedText: Phoenix City Wenruo: The Chinese Spirit and National Soul - Watch the "Mulan" Kung Fu Stage Play Phoenix City Wenruo More than ten years ago, Disney released a cartoon "Mulan" in the United States. The thrilling scenes were dizzying and the style was free and unrestrained. It promoted a personal hero to save the world and created an American-style character yearning for freedom. There was also a plot of Mulan performing love in the military. Of course, the film had many beautiful soundtracks and American laugh-out-loud humor. At that time, I said at home, what a pity, what a pity! Such a famous story in Chinese history has been used by Americans; the problem is that the inner content is out of shape, and the "soul" of heroic stories passed down through the ages is completely gone. What a pity! If a classic story like "Mulan" is expressed in a good artistic form by an artist who understands Chinese history and the Chinese spirit inherent in Mulan, it will go global. Last year, when I learned that a Chinese-run martial arts academy in Phoenix was going to perform a Kung Fu stage play called "Mulan," the tickets had already been sold out. Maybe they didn't advertise enough, I regret not knowing this news earlier. A friend of mine has two daughters who are attending this year's revival of "Mulan" in Phoenix. She knew my regrets and prepared two tickets for me early. I finally watched a very enjoyable performance on the night of February 2nd. The performance was unique at the beginning: young actors of different ages took turns to appear on both sides of the stage. The left side showed Mulan practicing martial arts from childhood to adulthood; the right side showed Mulan's soft and beautiful side while learning dance and dressing up. The most exciting thing about this performance is that they cleverly integrated various martial arts moves throughout, coupled with the traditional Chinese dance to show Mulan's soft and beautiful side; there is strength in softness, and softness in hardness. As the plot develops, eighteen martial arts skills such as swords, spears, clubs, and chains, as well as Chinese dance talents are fully demonstrated on the stage; the whole performance is very smooth, and the emotions are expressed vividly. Because the story of Mulan is well-known to every household, there is no need to introduce the plot specifically in this article; as for martial arts, choreography, music, costumes, scenery, lighting, projection, etc., they should be analyzed by professionals, so I will not go into details here. Let’s talk about some of the places that impressed me the most. This school that teaches Chinese martial arts chose "Mulan" as its repertoire, using martial arts movements as the main performance vocabulary. From what I have seen, it may be their first, and it is a very appropriate and clever choice. The source of students in this school is "talented locally", ranging from children aged 5 or 6 to adults, male and female students of different ages, and even non-Chinese students. The director arranged all the students into appropriate roles according to Mulan's different age stages of growth and Mulan's disguise as a boy; the non-Chinese students acted as the invading "foreign enemies"; the director was very thoughtful. Elements of Chinese folk culture are also cleverly interspersed in the performance. When Mulan was a child, her father taught her to play shadow play. What appeared on the screen was a huge male rabbit and a slender female rabbit, which immediately reminded people of the very vivid metaphor in "The Song of Mulan": "The male rabbit's feet are fluttering, and the female rabbit's eyes are blurred. Two rabbits are walking next to each other. How can they tell whether I am a male or a female?" There is a scene in which Mulan is in the army, sitting alone by a campfire in the dark night under the cold moon, with cold water and dry food; Mulan touches a string of beads necklace given by her mother, and can't help but recall the scene when she was young at home. At this time, a father and daughter appeared on the left stage playing a hand shadow game. How heartwarming and touching. The entire performance is interspersed with Chinese narration and English commentary of "The Song of Mulan". The Chinese narration is a recording by Zhu Jie, a Chinese lecturer at State University. Her tone of voice is tight and tight, relaxed and relaxed, and her voice is full of emotion, which perfectly sets off the plot. When the narrator reads: "The fresh air spreads to the golden watch, and the cold light shines on the iron clothes. A general dies in a hundred battles, and a strong man returns after ten years." It really makes people tear up! Because the performance uses martial arts movements and dance vocabulary, and is narrated in English, non-Chinese audiences also enjoy watching it. The famous story "Mulan" in Chinese history has also found resonance among other ethnic groups. It is also worth mentioning that based on my past experience, chaotic scenes of shouting and responding and walking around are common phenomena in performance venues with mainly Chinese audiences. But during this performance, the audience was silent and the narration could be heard clearly. We Chinese have become obedient to theater rules not only because this performance is closely linked, completed in one go, and smooth. This Kung Fu stage play has core content and soul. The whole performance runs through a main theme, showing the Chinese virtues and national soul: caring for the elders and caring for the younger brothers; resisting foreign enemies and defending the homeland; after achieving military exploits, not caring about official position and money, asking to return home to honor parents. This is the soul of the entire plot. Watching the entire performance is like watching a painting. You need to look at the overall connotation and style of the painting, and then look at whether there are any flaws in each stroke. There are still some small areas that need improvement in this performance, such as how to make martial arts shoes and some costumes more historical, and the selection of dance background music. Of course, the shortcomings do not hide the good points. This drama will become more and more refined after being refined step by step. This is a novel stage play created by a group of professionals who have knowledge of Chinese history, artistic and cultural heritage, understand the characteristics of Eastern and Western cultures, and skillfully borrow various artistic techniques and high-tech means. It is said that the director of the play is a professional with a Hong Kong performing arts background; I remember many years ago in Beijing I saw Hong Kong artists put "Along the River During the Qingming Festival" on the stage. Perhaps artists with a background of blending Eastern and Western cultures are good at expressing classical content with modern techniques. Thanks to this group of artists and students from the martial arts academy for bringing us a spiritual "Mulan" Kung Fu stage play; I also want to thank my friends for donating tickets, which made me make up for my regrets. (Written on February 3, 2013)

cb86fa410140669464f2fe343d32147244f04d77.sourceText: 凤凰城中文学校毕业典礼(图)

6a6ca60bf57cb9959ac29b87d7f59df342e79173.sourceText: 凤凰城中文学校毕业典礼(图) (凤凰城中文学校 来稿)凤凰城中文学校于五月四日在梅莎社区大学举行了2014…
6a6ca60bf57cb9959ac29b87d7f59df342e79173.translatedText: Phoenix Chinese School Graduation Ceremony (Photo) (Contributed by Phoenix Chinese School) Phoenix Chinese School held its 2014 graduation ceremony at Mesa Community College on May 4th...

60f303c71f513577d566b95a18b38c59649e8f24.sourceText: (凤凰城中文学校 来稿)凤凰城中文学校于五月四日在梅莎社区大学举行了2014年的毕业典礼。下午两点半左右，当进行曲响起时，毕业生整齐地步入礼堂。首先程秀玲校长致词，感谢诸位嘉宾前来参加典礼。她既高兴又感动地表示，今年的几位毕业生中，有些是她十四年前教过的学前班幼儿。他们现在已经都长得比她高大，而且在高中繁重的活动课业中，还能持续多年的中文学习，直到今天的毕业典礼，真的是非常不容易。
60f303c71f513577d566b95a18b38c59649e8f24.translatedText: (Contributed by Phoenix Chinese School) Phoenix Chinese School held its 2014 graduation ceremony at Mesa Community College on May 4th. At around 2:30 in the afternoon, when the marching music played, the graduates walked neatly into the auditorium. First of all, Principal Cheng Xiuling delivered a speech and thanked all the guests for coming to the ceremony. She was both happy and touched that some of this year’s graduates were preschool children she taught fourteen years ago. They are all taller than her now, and it is really not easy for them to continue studying Chinese for many years amidst the heavy activities and homework in high school until today's graduation ceremony.

3458c8186392367eb52930fa1fe45ffc8ec9d00f.sourceText: 校长与董事向黄仕钧先生致赠纪念品
3458c8186392367eb52930fa1fe45ffc8ec9d00f.translatedText: The principal and directors presented souvenirs to Mr. Huang Shijun

d9499cbe2149575bcefcada65c1e30a44397d4bd.sourceText: 接着顾问郑弘先生介绍贵宾出场。学校今年很荣幸能邀请到黄仕钧 (Barry Wong) 先生担任贵宾，并为毕业生致词。黄先生是凤凰城知名的律师事务所法律专家，在1993至2000年期间担任州众议员 (State Representative, Arizona House of Representatives)。2006 年由当时州长提名出任商务委员会委员长 (Arizona Corporation Commissioner) 要职，是一位非常杰出的华裔政治家。黄仕钧先生一开始就先问在场毕业生一个问题，让他们思考一下自己是什麽文化背景的人。然后他谈到自己和毕业生们相似，也是第二代亚洲移民的子女，以及他之后上大学选修中文课程，探索中国文化的经历。黄先生勉励学生们要熟知自己的母语和文化，以便将来进入职场可以利用所学知识，和工作产生互动连结，一展所长。至于他原先问大家「我是哪裡人」的问题，他的回答是两者皆是，既是美国人也是中国人。他表示每位在场学生都要对自己独特的身份感到骄傲，以后踏入地球村的社会，熟悉两种文化将会有很大的助益。黄先生在最后并一一唸出毕业生的名字，并献上他对他们的恭贺以及祝福。
d9499cbe2149575bcefcada65c1e30a44397d4bd.translatedText: Then consultant Mr. Zheng Hong introduced the distinguished guests. The school is honored to have Mr. Barry Wong as the guest of honor this year and to deliver a speech to the graduates. Mr. Huang is a legal expert at a well-known law firm in Phoenix and served as a State Representative (State Representative, Arizona House of Representatives) from 1993 to 2000. In 2006, he was nominated by the then governor to serve as the Arizona Corporation Commissioner. He is a very outstanding Chinese-American politician. Mr. Huang Shijun asked the graduates present a question at the beginning, asking them to think about their cultural background. He then talked about how he was similar to the graduates in that he was also the child of second-generation Asian immigrants, and his subsequent experience in taking Chinese courses in college to explore Chinese culture. Mr. Huang encouraged students to be familiar with their mother tongue and culture so that they can use the knowledge they have learned when entering the workplace, create interactive connections with work, and demonstrate their talents. As for the question he originally asked everyone, "Where am I from?", his answer was both, both American and Chinese. He said that every student present should be proud of his or her unique identity. In the future, when entering the society of the global village, being familiar with both cultures will be of great help. At the end, Mr. Huang read out the names of the graduates one by one and offered his congratulations and blessings to them.

391d576ec2f83aa09fd25b66c9b392100c8f440e.sourceText: 贵宾致词完毕，主持人卢贞玲老师就开始介绍毕业生。今年一共有八位毕业生，分别是王祯萱、张家豪、陈妙琛、朱家瑶、李尚祐、区立荣、王淑俊和柯洋成同学。卢老师先介绍每个人成长过程的投影片，然后请毕业生上台发表毕业感言。每位毕业生在感言中都提到感谢校长、老师，以及校方人员对他们的帮助和鼓励，让他们在学习中文的历程裡留下美好的回忆。毕业生也提到要特别感谢他们的父母，多年来不辞辛劳地带他们来中文学校上课。王祯萱同学更风趣地表示，学中文最大的好处，就是去台湾餐馆点菜时，可以认得菜单上的字，并且替自己点一碗牛肉麵吃。
391d576ec2f83aa09fd25b66c9b392100c8f440e.translatedText: After the distinguished guest delivered his speech, the host teacher Lu Zhenling began to introduce the graduates. There are eight graduates this year, namely Wang Zhenxuan, Zhang Jiahao, Chen Miaochen, Zhu Jiayao, Li Shangyou, Ou Lirong, Wang Shujun and Ke Yangcheng. Teacher Lu first introduced a slideshow of each person’s growth process, and then invited the graduates to come to the stage to deliver their graduation speeches. In their speeches, each graduate expressed their gratitude to the principal, teachers, and school staff for their help and encouragement, which allowed them to leave beautiful memories in the process of learning Chinese. The graduates also mentioned that they would like to express special thanks to their parents, who have worked tirelessly to bring them to Chinese schools over the years. Student Wang Zhenxuan even more humorously said that the biggest advantage of learning Chinese is that when ordering food in a Taiwanese restaurant, she can recognize the words on the menu and order a bowl of beef noodles for herself.

7361799f70d241a86adf544208c4c911c2de8a70.sourceText: 毕业生和贵宾校长及董事合照
7361799f70d241a86adf544208c4c911c2de8a70.translatedText: The graduates took a group photo with the distinguished principals and directors

613662ed78dd9fc66e88cec5269a13d6911271e9.sourceText: 主持人在毕业生说完感言后，表示要给他们一个惊喜，就是邀请他们的家长上台说话。今年毕业生的家庭背景相当多元化，有的在家裡讲广东话，有的父母是越南缅甸华侨背景。所以当这些爸爸妈妈们看到自己的孩子即将毕业，并能以流利的中文发表感言，他们都十分欣慰，也认为学校老师的教导真的是功不可没。其中朱家瑶同学的母亲提到自己已经来凤凰城中文学校超过二十年之久，令校长非常惊讶学校裡竟然有比她资历更悠久的「元老级」家长。另外值得一提的是，应届毕业生家长当中，有多位是学校职员或老师。他们每週日在孩子们上课的同时，也热心参与和义务帮忙学校各项活动，为孩子树立优良的榜样。在毕业生和家长发表完感言后，贵宾黄仕钧先生代表校方颁发毕业礼物给每一位毕业生。最后学校老师们列队与毕业生握手致意，欢送毕业生离场，并祝福他们鹏程万里。
613662ed78dd9fc66e88cec5269a13d6911271e9.translatedText: After the graduates finished their speeches, the host said he wanted to give them a surprise by inviting their parents to speak on stage. The family backgrounds of this year’s graduates are quite diverse. Some speak Cantonese at home, and some have parents with overseas Chinese backgrounds in Vietnam and Myanmar. So when these parents saw that their children were about to graduate and could give speeches in fluent Chinese, they were very pleased and believed that the teachings of the school teachers were really indispensable. Among them, the mother of classmate Zhu Jiayao mentioned that she had been coming to Phoenix Chinese School for more than 20 years. The principal was very surprised that there were "veteran" parents in the school who had more seniority than her. It is also worth mentioning that among the parents of recent graduates, many are school employees or teachers. While the children are in class every Sunday, they also enthusiastically participate in and volunteer to help with various school activities, setting a good example for the children. After the graduates and parents gave speeches, the guest of honor, Mr. Huang Shijun, presented graduation gifts to each graduate on behalf of the school. Finally, the school teachers lined up to shake hands with the graduates, send them off, and wish them a bright future.

b3cfd546ba70428e225d7476fd51e24237e9cb85.sourceText: 对死者的尊敬 慧明 在美国学驾驶时，被告之：美国不像中国，开车可以听凭警车和救护车在身后狂呼乱叫，也不让路。只要听见或者见到呼啸的警铃在后面，你必须靠右道停下，等待通过。因为救活人比什么都重要。 其实，死人也有这样的待遇。本地的驾驶规则中就规定，凡是葬礼车队经过，所有车辆都必须让行。起开始，笔者有点不解。若是婚礼车队来了，后视镜里看到的都是鲜花簇拥，看看也舒服，图个喜庆，让让也就算了。咋一看，后面车上扎满了白花蓝花，还有黑的，还一溜黑车黑衣，糁人的很，就狠踩油门快速逃跑，避避晦气。 可逃不远的。不是路面不好—前面的朋友早就看到车队了，避到边上停下了，路面宽畅得很，你就是跑到前面还得停下。再怎么样，你不愿做个灵车开道的吧。 不过，以后见多了，便理解了。无论生前如何辉煌或潦倒，死了之后在上帝面前都是平等的，都应该得到尊重的。前不久，美国发生枪击，肇事者杀人后自己饮弹自杀。一个美国女孩给被害者送上鲜花后，也给杀人者送上鲜花。原因是，我们没有早一点觉察到你的孤单和异常。送给杀人者鲜花，有人很不理解，但送花者充满爱心，不能不让愤怒的受害者家属和朋友接受了。 如果在中国，这肇事的灵牌都要被砸碎吧。有时不得不承认，这个国家有着现代社会人们都有的贪婪、狡诈、无耻、自大和偏见，但这个国家的先哲们也为后人作出了文明的规范，人人生而平等。有了对活人的尊重，禁止一切歧视，限制特权，才会有今天所有的车都为死者让路，才会有一个无名孩童的墓埋在著名的将军墓边，而一直保留至今。 之所以少有对死者的尊敬，特别是对亲朋之外的死者，是因为我们骨子里少得是对活人的尊敬。有人说，北京纪念堂不是保留到现在了，能说对活人死人不尊敬吗？确实是尊重，但那是对权威的尊重，和生死无多大关系。中国无论什么人都可从自己的地位出发，不尊重任何人，如果有了点权势和财势，就更加厉害。动车车祸发生后，活着的领导竟用张牙舞爪的怪手将活人死人一起推翻埋掉。因为，人活着在他们眼中就像蚂蚁，死了，就更没有通车、经济发展的大局重要了。 所幸，上帝让小伊伊做了一回天使，让她从遇难者堆了爬了出来，告诉那些不尊重死者的人。 老人总喜欢用轻蔑看待年轻人，不愿意接受年轻人的建议，但这次或者下次事故，大人们都会想起小伊伊。
b3cfd546ba70428e225d7476fd51e24237e9cb85.translatedText: Respect for the Dead Huiming When I was learning to drive in the United States, I was told that the United States is not like China. When driving, you can let police cars and ambulances scream behind you without giving way. As soon as you hear or see the siren whistling behind you, you must stop on the right lane and wait to pass. Because saving people's lives is more important than anything else. In fact, dead people also have such treatment. Local driving rules stipulate that when a funeral convoy passes, all vehicles must give way. At first, I was a little confused. If a wedding convoy is coming and all you see in the rearview mirror are flowers, it's comfortable to look at and it's a celebration, so just give in. At first glance, the car behind was covered with white and blue flowers, some were black, and there was also a row of black cars and black clothes. It was very confusing, so I stepped on the accelerator and ran away quickly to avoid bad luck. But there's no way to escape. It's not that the road surface is bad - the friends in front have seen the convoy a long time ago and stopped on the side. The road surface is very wide, and you have to stop even if you run to the front. No matter what, you don't want to be the hearse clearing the way. However, after seeing more of it, I understood it. No matter how glorious or miserable they are in life, they are all equal before God after death and should be respected. Not long ago, a shooting occurred in the United States. The perpetrator killed someone and then committed suicide. After an American girl gave flowers to the victim, she also gave flowers to the murderer. The reason is that we did not realize your loneliness and abnormality earlier. Some people don't understand sending flowers to a murderer, but the sender is full of love and cannot help but be accepted by the angry family and friends of the victim. If we were in China, the magic tablet that caused the accident would have been smashed. Sometimes we have to admit that this country has greed, cunning, shamelessness, arrogance and prejudice that people in modern society have. However, the sages of this country have also set civilized norms for future generations. Everyone is born equal. With respect for the living, prohibition of all discrimination, and restriction of privileges, today all cars will make way for the deceased, and only then will the tomb of an unknown child be buried next to the tomb of a famous general, which has been preserved to this day. The reason why there is so little respect for the dead, especially for those other than relatives and friends, is because in our bones we have so little respect for the living. Some people say that the Beijing Memorial Hall has been preserved to this day. How can it be said that it disrespects the living and the dead? It is indeed respect, but it is respect for authority and has little to do with life and death. No one in China can start from their own status and not respect anyone. If they have some power and wealth, they will be even more powerful. After the high-speed train accident, the living leader used his claws and claws to overthrow the living and the dead and bury them together. Because, in their eyes, people are like ants when they are alive. When they are dead, they are even less important than the overall situation of traffic and economic development. Fortunately, God allowed Xiao Yiyi to be an angel for a time, allowing her to crawl out from the pile of victims and tell those who disrespected the dead. Old people always like to look at young people with contempt and are unwilling to accept young people's suggestions, but this time or the next accident, adults will think of Xiao Yiyi.

376a18f71fb3553d38f594c926219e18400f85b4.sourceText: 张肇鸿：亞省歷史上的傑出華人 亞省歷史上的傑出華人 記 鳳凰城僑聯首届主席、鳳凰城龍岡公所首任主席關崇瓊 (1) ： 張肇鴻 關 崇瓊伉儷 近日，我採訪了 鳳凰城僑聯首届主席、 鳳鳳城龍岡公所創辦人關崇瓊 的家人，受到了熱誠的歡迎。關崇瓊是本地華人早期的一位開拓者，關崇瓊家族對美國主流社會和華人僑界有過積極的貢獻。在這次採訪中，關崇瓊的第六女兒關麗壁 (YIOLET TOY) 和第十一女兒關秀玉 (SHIRLEY TOY) ，提供了相當豐富和有價值資料，這些照片和實物绝大部分未發表過，我們將為這個英雄家族作出分期報導，讓人們進一步了解這個華人典範的家族，也能够對鳳凰城早期的華人貢獻和僑史，有更多的認識和了解。 關崇瓊 (Dea Hong Toy) ，廣東开平人。1893年11月9日出生 。1909 年 10 月 9 日，未滿16岁的他扎着一條清朝時代的長辮，用＂謝鴻星＂假名，冒名頂替地從中國來到美國鳳凰城。在那個年代，美國排華法案已经實施，只有很少数的華人，用＂假纸＂冒充其直係親属的身份，才能來到美國。 關崇瓊來到美國後，曾到鳳凰城當時最早由華人所開設的餐館《花旗餐館》 (American Kitchen) 打工，做的是洗盤碗的工作，以賺取每天五十美分的酬勞。 關崇瓊於一九一五年應徵服役，是亞省參加過第一次世界大戰的兩名華人老兵之一，他留下了目前唯一一張最早期的華裔軍人的戍装相片。 1917 年 10 月，關崇瓊於在紐約完成基本的戰鬥訓練與後，被派往歐洲戰場。他所属的是第 164 步兵團。之後去到法國的梅斯， 1919 年到了法國的尼斯 (Nice) 地區，不幸地，關崇瓊在戰鬥中負了傷。其英文資料是我在其它書籍中尋找到的。 關崇瓊說戰争很殘酷，而且​​一個士兵的生活很孤獨，他知道有好幾個戰友從未接到過任何家中的信件。而在戰争中一個最美好的回憶，是在聖誕節前，他的夥伴們和他一起分享自己的郵件。 停戰之後，他成為美國退伍軍人協會的成員。荣獲了＂紫心動章＂，成為鳳凰城首位華裔軍人獲獎軍功之人。上面相片是他和 164 步兵團的戰友們在日後的重聚。 一九一九年，關崇瓊退役回到亞省鳳凰城。鳳凰城博物館有一張珍貴的照片：＂關崇瓊和他的馬車＂，那時鳳凰城的道路大多數還是泥土的路。深入調查後，發現相片有更深層內容，原來關崇瓊在日照地區 (Sunny lope) ，曾利用馬車運送食物給肺結核病患者，由於結核病有傳染性，在當時的条件下，一旦感染就很難治癒，所以沒有人肯去做，但關崇瓊不懼危險，努力工作。在送貨途中，他還用馬車来露宿過夜。这此，我們可看到關崇瓊的拼博精神。 由於他奮發圖強，克苦耐勞，很快就成為最早的華人創業者之一。他是上世紀初葉最早開設商舖的華人，20年代已開有雜貨舖＂TOY扴 GROCERY＂，經營肉類、瓜菜、水果和汽水，還销售汽車柴油等；30年代又開了另一間＂TOY扴 MARKET＂。這些珍貴的歷史相片，展视出鳳凰城華人旱期的人文風貌。 到了 1950 年，關崇瓊在鳳凰城鴕背街 (Camelback Rd) ，率先建成當時鳳凰城最大的一間餐館：崇瓊樓 — 香格里拉大餐廳 (TOY擲 SHANGRI-LA) ，餐廳占地 1 萬平方米，有 450 人座位。崇瓊樓 1950 年開業，提供高質素的服務，客人中很多是美國人。餐館所用的碗碟也是專門到洛杉磯去訂做的。香格里拉餐廳也是中國傳統家庭所最喜愛的地方，除了婚禮喜慶，鳳凰城的余氏宗親和龍岡劉、關、張、趙四姓宗親等社團組織，也常在崇瓊樓擺設春宴，那是當年鳳凰城最風光的中國餐館。 關崇瓊有個賢慧的太太Lee Chee Toy，他們共育有四男七女，家庭美滿。 1972 年，他們的孩子在崇瓊樓 — 香格里拉餐廳為他們舉辦結婚 60 周年的慶祝宴會。下圖是其中六個女兒和父母、姑母在崇瓊樓內的合照。關崇瓊家族對社會和僑界有過積極的貢獻，我們将繼續報導。
376a18f71fb3553d38f594c926219e18400f85b4.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: Outstanding Chinese in the history of the province Outstanding Chinese in the history of the province Notes Guan Chongqiong, the first chairman of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation and the first chairman of the Phoenix Longgang Office (1): Zhang Zhaohong Guan Chongqiong and his wife Recently, I interviewed the family of Guan Chongqiong, the first chairman of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation and the founder of the Fengfeng Longgang Office, and received a warm welcome. Guan Chongqiong was an early pioneer of the local Chinese. The Guan Chongqiong family had made positive contributions to mainstream American society and the Chinese overseas community. In this interview, Guan Chongqiong's sixth daughter Guan Libi (YIOLET TOY) and eleventh daughter Guan Xiuyu (SHIRLEY TOY) provided quite rich and valuable information. Most of these photos and objects have not been published. We will make installment reports on this heroic family so that people can better understand this Chinese model family and gain more knowledge and understanding of the early Chinese contributions and overseas history in Phoenix. Guan Chongqiong (Dea Hong Toy) is from Kaiping, Guangdong. Born on November 9, 1893. On October 9, 1909, under the age of 16, he came to Phoenix from China under the pseudonym "Xie Hongxing" wearing a long braid from the Qing Dynasty. At that time, the Chinese Exclusion Act had been implemented in the United States, and only a small number of Chinese could come to the United States by using "fake papers" to pretend to be their immediate family members. After Guan Chongqiong came to the United States, she worked at the American Kitchen, the earliest Chinese restaurant in Phoenix, where she washed dishes and earned fifty cents a day. Kwan Chongqiong was drafted into service in 1915. He was one of two Chinese veterans in Alberta who participated in the First World War. He left behind the only photo of the earliest Chinese soldier in uniform. In October 1917, after completing basic combat training in New York, Guan Chongqiong was sent to the European battlefield. He was with the 164th Infantry Regiment. Then he went to Metz, France, and then to the Nice area of ​​France in 1919. Unfortunately, Guan Chongqiong was injured in the battle. The English information was found in other books. Guan Chongqiong said that war was cruel and a soldier's life was lonely. He knew that several comrades had never received any letters from home. One of the best memories of the war was when his partners shared their emails with him before Christmas. After the Armistice he became a member of the American Legion. Won the "Purple Heart Medal" and became the first Chinese-American soldier in Phoenix to receive military merit. The photo above shows him reunited with his comrades from the 164th Infantry Regiment at a later date. In 1919, Guan Chongqiong retired and returned to Phoenix, Alberta. The Phoenix City Museum has a rare photo: "Guan Chongqiong and his carriage." At that time, most of the roads in Phoenix were still dirt roads. After in-depth investigation, it was discovered that the photo had a deeper content. It turned out that Guan Chongqiong had used horse-drawn carriages to deliver food to tuberculosis patients in the Sunny Lopez area. Because tuberculosis was contagious, under the conditions at the time, it was difficult to cure once infected, so no one was willing to do it, but Guan Chongqiong was not afraid of danger and worked hard. During the delivery, he also used the horse-drawn carriage to camp out overnight. Here, we can see Guan Chongqiong’s fighting spirit. Because of his hard work and hard work, he soon became one of the earliest Chinese entrepreneurs. He was the first Chinese to open a shop at the beginning of the last century. In the 1920s, he already opened a grocery store "TOY扴 GROCERY", which sold meat, vegetables, fruits and soda drinks, and also sold automobile diesel, etc. In the 1930s, he opened another "TOY扴 MARKET". These precious historical photos show the cultural features of the Chinese people in Phoenix City during the drought period. In 1950, Guan Chongqiong took the lead in building the largest restaurant in Phoenix at the time: TOY SHANGRI-LA on Camelback Rd in Phoenix. The restaurant covered an area of ​​10,000 square meters and had 450 seats. Chongqiong House opened in 1950 and provided high-quality service. Many of its guests were Americans. The dishes used in the restaurant are also specially made to order in Los Angeles. Shangri-La Restaurant is also a favorite place for traditional Chinese families. In addition to wedding celebrations, social organizations such as the Yu clan in Phoenix City and the Liu, Guan, Zhang and Zhao clan clans in Longgang often hold spring banquets at Chongqiong Tower. It was the most beautiful Chinese restaurant in Phoenix City at that time. Guan Chongqiong has a virtuous wife, Lee Chee Toy. They have a total of four boys and seven girls, and they have a happy family. In 1972, their children held a banquet to celebrate their 60th wedding anniversary at Chongqiong House - Shangri-La Restaurant. The picture below is a photo of six of the daughters with their parents and aunts in Chongqiong Tower. The Guan Chongqiong family has made positive contributions to society and the overseas Chinese community, and we will continue to report on it.

1883d7af28a8bc617a4b8b2d61756feca3ca6d97.sourceText: 留美中国学生回国: 没关系 工作一样难找 《基督教科学箴言报》称，越来越多的中国学生到美国大学就读，但如果他们拿不到名牌大学的学位，回国后找工作照常很困难，这意味着，拉关系在找工作中依旧起着最重要的作用。 星期六晚上，一名姓魏的中国留学生正在新英格兰一所著名文理学院的食堂内吃着披萨和薯条，忙完这些，他和伙伴们马上要去看足球赛，随后还要参加一场聚会。凌晨2点，他回到了自己的房间，浏览着高盛银行，麦肯锡公司，贝恩公司的网页，查看他们的招聘流程和工作申请。他睡不着，因为他担心自己的未来。 小魏说：”我的签证状态和竞争激烈的就业市场使我认为，自己不能在美国可以轻而易举的找到工作。””回到中国，很难找到工作，没有人听说过我上的这所学院的名字棗它听上去不像一所大学，在这样的情况下，我怎么可能获得公司的面试机会？” 小魏来自中国的一个中产阶级家庭，在国内，自己没有人脉关系。在中国和美国的朋友都羡慕他看似光明的未来，但是刚刚毕业的他正面临一个迫在眉睫的挑战棗不辜负自己或者爸妈的期望。 小魏所处的困境体现了中国学生到美国读本科趋势存在内在的矛盾性。 国际教育研究所提供的数据称，在短短的11年里，中国学生到美国读本科的数量翻了10倍，从当初的7500到80000。一些中国的父母卖房，花光自己的积蓄就是为了送孩子出国留学。 10年前，留学回来的人们可能会快速获得成功。但如今，现实情况截然相反：随着越来越多的海归回国，中国公司开始不认可这些人的资质，中国社会又重新回到靠拉关系，走后门找工作时期。 此外，许多独生子女家长对自己的孩子抱有不切实际的期望，这让孩子们倍感压力。刚毕业的大学生小玲说：”父母做出巨大牺牲后，都希望自己的孩子能有出息。””在国内，我可以靠关系在好公司找到一份不错的工作，但是回国后，担心自己不能取得成绩的压力令人恐惧。” 小琳表示，自己很幸运，通过校园招聘在美国找到了一份工作，公司愿意给她解决工作签证。 另外，小琳说，在美国生活的她回国后感觉在社交上很不适应。”当我回到中国后，很难发现自己和高中的朋友有太多的共性。在美国，我努力使自己融入到一个更加开放的社交文化，我去参加派对，看足球赛，但我知道，骨子里自己还是中国人。” 尽管中国的留学生对回国找工作持悲观态度，但一些中国公司的老板还是认识到美国大学教育的价值，Adil Husain就是他们中的一个，从美国留学回来的他在上海创办了一家咨询公司。 毕业于米德伯理学院的Adil Husain说：”我认为，四年文理学院的本科教育比在英国或澳大利亚留学好的多，你可以从全面的教育中学到批判性思维能力，写作能力，和阅读技巧，而这些正是雇主们在招聘时所看重的东西。”
1883d7af28a8bc617a4b8b2d61756feca3ca6d97.translatedText: Chinese students studying in the United States return to China: It doesn’t matter, jobs are still hard to find. The Christian Science Monitor said that more and more Chinese students are studying in American universities, but if they cannot get a degree from a prestigious university, it will still be difficult to find a job after returning to China. This means that building connections still plays the most important role in finding a job. On Saturday night, a Chinese international student surnamed Wei was eating pizza and French fries in the cafeteria of a well-known liberal arts college in New England. After that, he and his friends were going to watch a football game and then attend a party. At 2 a.m., he returned to his room and browsed the websites of Goldman Sachs, McKinsey & Company, and Bain & Company, looking at their recruitment processes and job applications. He couldn't sleep because he was worried about his future. Xiao Wei said: "My visa status and the fiercely competitive job market made me think that I would not be able to easily find a job in the United States." "Back in China, it was difficult to find a job. No one had heard the name of the college I went to. It didn't sound like a university. Under such circumstances, how could I possibly get an interview with a company?" Xiao Wei comes from a middle-class family in China and has no personal connections in China. Friends in China and the United States are envious of his seemingly bright future, but as a recent graduate, he is facing an imminent challenge: not to live up to his own expectations or those of his parents. Xiao Wei's predicament reflects the inherent contradictions in the trend of Chinese students studying in the United States for undergraduate studies. According to data provided by the Institute of International Education, in just 11 years, the number of Chinese students studying in the United States for undergraduate studies has increased tenfold, from the original 7,500 to 80,000. Some Chinese parents sell their houses and spend all their savings just to send their children to study abroad. Ten years ago, people who returned from studying abroad might achieve success quickly. But today, the reality is completely opposite: as more and more overseas returnees return to China, Chinese companies begin not to recognize the qualifications of these people, and Chinese society has returned to the period of relying on connections and finding jobs through the back door. In addition, many parents of only children have unrealistic expectations for their children, which causes them to feel stressed. Xiaoling, a newly graduated college student, said: "After parents have made huge sacrifices, they all hope that their children can have a bright future." "At home, I can rely on connections to find a good job in a good company, but after returning to China, the pressure of worrying that I will not achieve results is scary." Xiaolin said that she was very lucky. She found a job in the United States through campus recruitment, and the company was willing to help her get a work visa. In addition, Xiaolin said that after living in the United States, she felt socially uncomfortable after returning to China. "When I returned to China, it was hard to find that I had too much in common with my high school friends. In the United States, I tried hard to integrate myself into a more open social culture. I went to parties and watched football games, but I knew that I was still Chinese at heart." Although Chinese students are pessimistic about returning to China to find jobs, some Chinese company bosses still recognize the value of an American university education. One of them is Adil Husain, who founded a consulting company in Shanghai after studying in the United States. Adil Husain, who graduated from Middlebury College, said: "I think a four-year undergraduate education in a liberal arts college is much better than studying in the UK or Australia. You can learn critical thinking skills, writing skills, and reading skills from a comprehensive education, and these are what employers value when recruiting."

Attending this event were senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin, Taiwanese Ambassador Linghu Rongda, director of the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Los Angeles (Classical Office), as well as Director Kao Ka-fu’s representative Zhang Qingling, Chandler Vice Mayor Jack Sellers, Congressman Matt Salmon’s representative Lee Huff, Arizona Real Estate Association Commissioner Judy Lowe, National Association of Women of Realtors President Sindy Ready, Arizona Republican Party Chairman Robert Graham, Arizona Governor’s Asian Advisory Committee Chairman Deng Chaoju, and National Asian Real Estate Association Chairman Ivan Choi, and nearly 200 Chinese and American guests.

7dd56f6903eacb3019d0d97718f9388c8eae6bcf.sourceText: 张圣儀成功创立亚省亚裔房地产协会，并出任创会会长。今年她成功的把中国大陆和台湾的热钱引进亚利桑那房地产界，积极配合本州移民投资计划。驻洛杉矶台北经济文化办事处（经文处）处长令狐荣达大使特颁发奖状，祝贺张圣儀的新任要职，并表彰她对台湾和亚利桑那商业合作的贡献。在就职典礼上，钱德勒副市长Jack Sellers，宣布聘请她出任经济发展委员会及外国商业投资部代表。
7dd56f6903eacb3019d0d97718f9388c8eae6bcf.translatedText: Zhang Shengyi successfully founded the Asian Real Estate Association of Asia and served as the founding president. This year she successfully introduced hot money from China and Taiwan into the Arizona real estate industry and actively cooperated with the state's immigration investment plan. Ambassador Linghu Rongda, Director of the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Los Angeles (Classical Office), presented the certificate to congratulate Zhang Shengyi on her new appointment and commend her contribution to business cooperation between Taiwan and Arizona. At the inauguration ceremony, Chandler Deputy Mayor Jack Sellers announced her hiring as a representative of the Economic Development Commission and the Department of Foreign Business Investment.

a39ff20d3afbb97124a10b104475b6789c80b762.sourceText: 大凤凰城台美商会和钱德乐市府公共关係委员会Human Relations Commission于八月二十四下午二点至四时假钱德乐市议会 议场，举行亚太经贸座谈会暨台湾优良产品展剪綵开幕式和新闻发佈茶会。此次主讲嘉宾，特别邀请到美国联邦国会议员暨亚太事务外交委员会主席Congressman Matt Salmon 针对目前美国国会山庄对亚太经贸及相关法桉的最新发展做专题讲座，其中并针对泛太平洋战略经济伙伴关係协议（TPP)最新发展做精闢阐述，并重申支持台湾加入泛太平洋战略经济伙伴关係协议（TPP)。座谈会由亚利桑那卅商会会长Glenn Hamer 主持，驻洛杉矶经文处经济组林若兰副组长，全美菲律宾商会总会长玛丽亚康尼，和大凤凰城台美商会执行长兼理事张圣仪代表该商会会长张晴玲担任主讲嘉宾。座谈会中，张圣仪特别推崇会长张晴玲女士在过去数月来领导商会筹备此次活动的用心与努力，却因母亲辞世回台参加告别式不克出席，并向会长及家属致敬及哀悼之意。
a39ff20d3afbb97124a10b104475b6789c80b762.translatedText: The Greater Phoenix Taiwan-American Chamber of Commerce and the Chandler City Government Public Relations Committee Human Relations Commission held the Asia-Pacific Economic and Trade Symposium and Taiwan Excellent Products Exhibition ribbon-cutting opening ceremony and press conference tea party at the Chandler City Council Hall from 2 to 4 pm on August 24. The guest speaker this time was Congressman Matt Salmon, a member of the U.S. Congress and chairman of the Asia-Pacific Foreign Affairs Committee, who was specially invited to give a special lecture on the latest developments in Asia-Pacific economy, trade and related laws and regulations currently on Capitol Hill in the United States. He also gave an incisive explanation of the latest developments in the Trans-Pacific Strategic Economic Partnership (TPP), and reiterated his support for Taiwan to join the Trans-Pacific Strategic Economic Partnership (TPP). The symposium was hosted by Glenn Hamer, President of the Arizona Thirty Chamber of Commerce. Lin Ruolan, Deputy Leader of the Economic Group of the Economic and Cultural Affairs Office in Los Angeles, Maria Kenney, President of the National Philippine Chamber of Commerce, and Zhang Shengyi, CEO and Director of the Taiwan American Chamber of Commerce in Greater Phoenix, served as guest speakers on behalf of the Chamber of Commerce President Zhang Qingling. During the symposium, Zhang Shengyi especially praised the president, Ms. Zhang Qingling, for her dedication and efforts in leading the chamber of commerce in preparing for this event in the past few months. However, she was unable to attend because her mother passed away and returned to Taiwan to attend the farewell ceremony. She also expressed her condolences and condolences to the president and his family.

Chandelier City Multicultural Manager Leah Powell, Public Relations Committee Member Zhang Shengyi, Greater Phoenix Taiwan-American Chamber of Commerce Founding President Xi Shiying, and Director Huang Yulian represented the acceptance.

I would also like to thank all the directors, volunteers and guests who participated in the event. I am very pleased that the event was a complete success and hope that the Chamber of Commerce will continue to flourish and prosper.

40297ee5be62500191cea5037a5e45a16cac3377.sourceText: 此次出席嘉宾有大凤凰城台美商会理事会员，侨联副主席崔增祈，耆英会道德锟主席，前华联主席王维咨暨各主流商会会长，亚省各族裔商会会长，侨学界，主流政要市府官员议员，厂商代表，主流媒体等候近二百多人出席。会后大鳯凰台美商会并准备精美可口台湾小吃茶点和台湾优良产品福袋给在场佳宾并促进商机交流。
40297ee5be62500191cea5037a5e45a16cac3377.translatedText: Guests attending this event include board members of the Greater Phoenix Taiwan-American Chamber of Commerce, Vice Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Cui Zengqi, Chairman of the Senior Citizens Association Daodekun, former Hualian Chairman Wang Weizi and presidents of mainstream chambers of commerce, presidents of chambers of commerce of all ethnic groups in the province, overseas Chinese and academic circles, mainstream politicians and city officials, representatives of manufacturers, and mainstream media. Nearly 200 people are waiting to attend. After the meeting, the Daluohuang Taiwan American Chamber of Commerce prepared exquisite and delicious Taiwanese snacks and refreshments as well as lucky bags of Taiwan's fine products for the guests present to promote the exchange of business opportunities.

e91198847030115e23f6ab57f94ef20b9959772e.sourceText: 严婕娅是亚利桑那希望中文学校的学生，是当地华侨严洪飞和郑艺娟的女儿。2011年6月4日， 严婕娅 从本州的初赛中获得佳绩，与 蔡雅双、高薇佳、赵诣四位选手代表亚利桑那赛区参加全美国的决赛，并从美国决赛中胜出，将代表美国赛区出赛。
e91198847030115e23f6ab57f94ef20b9959772e.translatedText: organized by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council Yan Jieya is a student at Hope Chinese School in Arizona and the daughter of local overseas Chinese Yan Hongfei and Zheng Yijuan. On June 4, 2011, Yan Jieya achieved good results in the preliminaries of the state, and four players, Cai Yashuang, Gao Weijia, and Zhao Yi, represented the Arizona Division in the All-American Finals. They won the American finals and will represent the American Division.

8cc6003042eaf1a85ffadd8c0fbc233ed42eae7d.translatedText: Pearl of the Desert | Chinese History in Arizona, USA (31) The ninth-ranked city: Tempe (TEMPE)

e5f694c37d093931ba969d68f2f5cd9b67cf3967.sourceText: 亚利桑那州历史协会：张肇鸿 铁路的到来是亚利桑那州历史上的重要里程碑。由于恶劣的环境，山区和崎岖的乡村，私营企…
e5f694c37d093931ba969d68f2f5cd9b67cf3967.translatedText: Arizona Historical Association: Zhang Zhaohong The arrival of the railroad is an important milestone in the history of Arizona. Due to the harsh environment, mountains and rugged countryside, private industry...

f5611e7f4c60e47ec98c6ce97f913431c07a2303.sourceText: 铁路的到来是亚利桑那州历史上的重要里程碑。由于恶劣的环境，山区和崎岖的乡村，私营企业很少，铁路改变了这一切。”为了将坦佩（TEMPE）放置在路线上，连接的铁路线向东移动了三英里，到达今天的马里科帕（MARICOPA），目的是将铁路与TEMPE形成直接的南北对齐。
f5611e7f4c60e47ec98c6ce97f913431c07a2303.translatedText: The arrival of the railroad was an important milestone in Arizona's history. Due to the harsh environment, mountainous and rugged countryside, there was little private enterprise, and the railroad changed all that. "To place TEMPE on the alignment, the connecting railroad line was moved three miles east to present-day MARICOPA, with the goal of placing the railroad in direct north-south alignment with TEMPE.

a15cd617e49cad6afe160cee1ac0f493d797950c.sourceText: 坦佩TEMPE）师范学校于1885 年成立，1958 年更改为“亚利桑那州立大学” （Arizona State University）。这是一所著名的公立研究型大学。ASU的“棕榈大道”有 110 棵扇棕榈，是校园的百年地标。大学有6个校区共22个学院，是美国学生最多的大学之一，有为数不少的华裔和中国留学生就读于ASU。在2020年的人口普查中，TEMPE有180,587人，是亚省排名第九位的城市。
a15cd617e49cad6afe160cee1ac0f493d797950c.translatedText: Tempe Normal School was established in 1885, changing its name to Arizona State University in 1958 University). This is a famous public research university. ASU's "Palm Avenue" has 110 palm trees and is a century-old landmark on the campus. The university has 6 campuses and 22 colleges. It is one of the universities with the largest number of students in the United States. In the 2020 census, TEMPE has a population of 180,587, ranking ninth in the province.

eed2e530093f5e99ab6caef014e983743cd1d9a6.sourceText: 坦佩（Tempe）很早就有华人的在此地谋生。亚利桑那华人历史协会副会长唐孝先，曾任坦佩(Tempe)中文学校的首任校长，他帮助过考古学家K. J. Schroeder寻找华人墓碑的线索，并写有一篇文章：“凤凰城百年前老店广合号店主探秘”，现摘登如下。
eed2e530093f5e99ab6caef014e983743cd1d9a6.translatedText: Chinese people have been making a living here in Tempe for a long time. Tang Xiaoxian, vice president of the Arizona Chinese Historical Association, was the first principal of the Chinese School in Tempe. He helped archaeologist K. J. Schroeder searched for clues about Chinese tombstones and wrote an article: "The Exploration of the Owner of the Centennial-Old Guanghe Store in Phoenix", which is excerpted below.

5708a3f91d0944deb4b50087ffabf692e25372e9.sourceText: “1994年，美国考古学家K. J. 施罗德(Kelly James Schroeder)主编的《1990–1992年亚利桑那州凤凰城先民和军人纪念墓园考古规划第二卷》问世。该书第20页上，有一张早期华商开设的广合号食品杂货店(Quong Hop & Co. Grocery)的照片，店主站在店门口。这张照片摄于1890年左右，由亚利桑那历史学会和矿工协会(Arizona Historical Society and Miners’ Association)提供。
5708a3f91d0944deb4b50087ffabf692e25372e9.translatedText: "In 1994, the second volume of the Archaeological Plan for the Ancestors and Military Memorial Cemetery in Phoenix, Arizona, 1990-1992" was published in 1994. On page 20 of the book, there is a photo of the Quong Hop & Co. Grocery opened by early Chinese businessmen, with the owner standing in front of the store. This photo, taken around 1890, was provided by the Arizona Historical Society and Miners’ Association.

8dfbe172bcada18c7ea1e79dcdf37fbacb93cc1e.sourceText: 广合号食品杂货店店主的中文姓名，现已无从考证。美国政府部门、报纸，以其商号名Quong Hop为其名，我们姑且称他广合老闆吧。
8dfbe172bcada18c7ea1e79dcdf37fbacb93cc1e.translatedText: The Chinese name of the owner of the Guanghe grocery store cannot be verified. U.S. government departments and newspapers are named after their business name, Quong Hop. Let’s call him Quong Hop’s boss.

7774d467b4fb3f8ab118e130be4c346d77e83b77.sourceText: 在书中的第19页纪录华人墓葬圈裡遗骸尚在的23名华人先民中，有广合号老闆Quong Hop。
7774d467b4fb3f8ab118e130be4c346d77e83b77.translatedText: On page 19 of the book, it is recorded that among the 23 Chinese ancestors whose remains are still in the Chinese burial circle, there is Quong Hop, the owner of the Guanghe Hao.

4c9e8e098b13ed6e3dc9bc17fc5f1b674c34a32b.sourceText: 在开拓者公墓协会(Pioneers’Cemetery Association, PCA)中的义工、历史学者唐纳· 卡尔(Donna Carr)，热忱投入华人先民史迹考查。她走遍绿木墓园(Greenwood Memory Lawn)，拍摄所有中文墓碑，让我帮她用汉语拼音写下亡者的姓名，以便编制按汉语拼音字母顺序排列的索引。
4c9e8e098b13ed6e3dc9bc17fc5f1b674c34a32b.translatedText: Donna Carr, a volunteer and historian in the Pioneers’ Cemetery Association (PCA), is enthusiastically involved in the investigation of the historical sites of the Chinese ancestors. She walked around Greenwood Memory Lawn, photographed all the tombstones in Chinese, and asked me to help her write down the names of the deceased in Chinese Pinyin so that she could compile an alphabetical index.

612e2be88a2ae70d75c572f7a340746aa73d3c66.sourceText: 我向唐纳提出请求，能否帮助寻找广合老闆的资料，她竟然找到美国主流社会报纸《亚利桑那共和报》(The Arizona Republic)1903年8月5日第六版和1904年3月9日第三版，上面都有关于广合老闆的报导。我真喜出望外，对唐纳 ·卡尔深表感谢，她的专业精神也让我肃然起敬。
612e2be88a2ae70d75c572f7a340746aa73d3c66.translatedText: I asked Donner if she could help find information about the boss of Guanghe. She actually found the sixth page of the mainstream American social newspaper "The Arizona Republic" on August 5, 1903 and the third page of March 9, 1904, which both had reports about the boss of Guanghe. I am overjoyed, deeply grateful to Donna Carr, and in awe of her professionalism.

b68ec77693ae1641469c2a5b3294859fbf5b01e8.sourceText: 广合老闆是中国广东省开平县人，1836年（清道光十六年）生。1879年（清光绪五年），他43岁，时值中年，因家境驱使，便告别妻子儿女，隻身漂洋过海来到美国。1882年，《排华法案》最终在美国国会通过后，绝大多数华人面临两难的境地：独自留在美国，或者回到中国与家人团聚。广合老闆选择留在美国。他后来在亚利桑那州凤凰城地区，开设杂货店谋生。
b68ec77693ae1641469c2a5b3294859fbf5b01e8.translatedText: The boss of Guanghe is a native of Kaiping County, Guangdong Province, China. He was born in 1836 (the 16th year of Daoguang reign of the Qing Dynasty). In 1879 (the fifth year of the reign of Emperor Guangxu of the Qing Dynasty), he was 43 years old and middle-aged. Driven by family circumstances, he said goodbye to his wife and children and crossed the ocean alone to the United States. After the Chinese Exclusion Act was finally passed by the U.S. Congress in 1882, the vast majority of Chinese faced a dilemma: stay alone in the United States, or return to China to reunite with their families. The boss of Guanghe chose to stay in the United States. He later made a living by opening a grocery store in the Phoenix, Arizona, area.

0ddedcf686529d8a8315e40d9955fe280589c08d.sourceText: 1903年8月5日《亚利桑那共和报》第六版坦佩(TEMPE)新闻栏报导，星期一（1903年8月3日）晚上，正当东坦佩商人广合老闆要关闭店门时，一名墨西哥人走上前来，手持左轮手枪，向广合老闆要钱。持枪抢劫者仅得美金4元2角，实在得不偿失。直到新闻发稿时，那名持枪抢劫者尚未抓获。
0ddedcf686529d8a8315e40d9955fe280589c08d.translatedText: The Arizona Republic's Page 6 Tempe (TEMPE) news column reported on August 5, 1903 that on the evening of Monday (August 3, 1903), just as the owner of the East Tempe businessman Guanghe was about to close his store, a Mexican came forward, holding a revolver, and asked the owner of Guanghe for money. The armed robber only got 4 US dollars and 2 cents, which was really not worth the loss. As of press time, the armed robber had not yet been captured.

e375ec045234bdf86b3c4c517829861e0999426e.sourceText: 1904年3月8日早晨5点钟左右，广合老闆，坦佩（TEMPE）附近年纪最长、最有名望的中国人之一，与世长辞。1904年3月9日《亚利桑那共和报》第三版上，报导广合老闆去世。报导称：一位有名的华人好好先生昨天离世。
e375ec045234bdf86b3c4c517829861e0999426e.translatedText: At about 5 o'clock in the morning on March 8, 1904, the owner of Guanghe, one of the oldest and most famous Chinese people near Tempe (TEMPE), passed away. On the third page of the Arizona Republic on March 9, 1904, it was reported that the owner of Guanghe had passed away. The report said: A well-known Chinese gentleman passed away yesterday.

fa4d1fcae7c4ed11fe46e34e6fd877e505043010.sourceText: 广合老闆来美国25年，大部分时间在盐河谷（SaltRiver valley）度过。这麽些年来，他在坦佩（TEMPE）周边多处经营小生意。三年前至今，他的店开在离乳酪厂大约半英里路程处。
fa4d1fcae7c4ed11fe46e34e6fd877e505043010.translatedText: Boss Guanghe has been in the United States for 25 years and spent most of his time in the Salt River valley. Over the years, he has run many small businesses around Tempe. Three years ago to the present, his store opened about a half-mile from the cheese factory.

8708e079b373a46b4cbe75bde0820c4f7ae73342.sourceText: 他有好多朋友，特别在儿童群裡，他是大家的开心果。他以慷慨大方著称，小朋友到他店裡不管买了什麽东西，总会得到糖果之类的小馈赠。
8708e079b373a46b4cbe75bde0820c4f7ae73342.translatedText: He has many friends, especially among children. He is everyone's happy fruit. He is known for his generosity. No matter what the children buy in his store, they always get small gifts such as candies.

085b19f38bed45168650339510d0cb9fe05c3ac4.sourceText: 他因慷慨大方而生意兴隆，直到他最后一次得病，他的生意已经相当成功。
085b19f38bed45168650339510d0cb9fe05c3ac4.translatedText: His business prospered due to his generosity, and until his last illness, his business was quite successful.

8a46c900e9e7b9fa2e6a2ae797b0aaf4d8fefdd5.sourceText: 广合老闆享年68岁，之前相当一段时间身体欠佳。据说他罹患肺病已久，但是他的死亡原因，可能因年迈和整体体能消耗所致。他病重期一个月左右。
8a46c900e9e7b9fa2e6a2ae797b0aaf4d8fefdd5.translatedText: The boss of Guanghe died at the age of 68. He had been in poor health for quite some time. It is said that he had suffered from lung disease for a long time, but the cause of his death may have been due to old age and overall physical exhaustion. He was seriously ill for about a month.

e13eab051bb72c185de2fab2691bd29c59428f14.sourceText: 那天早上，广合老闆一过世，就有人通知他在凤凰城的表弟海华(Hi Wau译音)。广合老闆的遗体当天下午运抵他表弟处，第二天举行葬礼。广合老闆留下一位妻子和几个孩子在中国。
e13eab051bb72c185de2fab2691bd29c59428f14.translatedText: That morning, as soon as the boss of Guanghe passed away, someone notified his cousin Hi Wau (transliteration) in Phoenix. The body of the Guanghe boss arrived at his cousin's house that afternoon, and the funeral was held the next day. The Guanghe boss left behind a wife and several children in China.

fb02c186c93f8de13df157e6c5150a7fa6945b16.sourceText: 广合老闆在美国生活的年代，社会上对华人的歧视和种族主义十分严重。铁路公司停止招收华工后，美国政府立法，使美国的男性华人与他们的妻子在美团聚非常困难。广合老闆致死未能把家眷从中国广东接来美国。他从中年起，一人在美国孤独、寂寞地度过一生，确实是当时华人的辛酸和遗憾。“
fb02c186c93f8de13df157e6c5150a7fa6945b16.translatedText: When Boss Guanghe lived in the United States, discrimination and racism against Chinese people were very serious in society. After the railroad company stopped recruiting Chinese workers, the U.S. government legislated to make it very difficult for American Chinese men to reunite with their wives in the United States. The boss of Guanghe died unable to bring his family to the United States from Guangdong, China. He spent his whole life alone and lonely in the United States from his middle age, which was indeed the bitterness and regret of the Chinese people at that time. "

2aa92171139f28c1725203551f8348d5cb215c4e.sourceText: 华人在坦佩（TEMPE）经营最多的是杂货铺和餐馆。搜集到一份上世纪六十年代“牛排馆”（THE BEET HOUSE) 的广告, 店老板是邓文幹（Allen M. Dong), 他曾担任过“亚利桑那州中华商会”的主席。
2aa92171139f28c1725203551f8348d5cb215c4e.translatedText: The most Chinese businesses in Tempe are grocery stores and restaurants. We collected an advertisement for "THE BEET HOUSE" in the 1960s. The owner of the store was Allen M. Dong, who once served as the chairman of the "Arizona Chinese Chamber of Commerce."

a371dcc2dbbc57ec879d890437ab50bfe5cc1467.sourceText: 亚省连开数场枪展 枪售继续爆棚 《亚省时报》 康州校园惨案和科州一连串枪击事件后，枪支管制再度成为一个高度争议的话题。不少人赶在政府出台控枪法例前抢购枪支和弹药，造成武器销售业的盛况空前。 就在本周，FBI公布了12月购枪者背景调查数据，又是一个创纪录。全国步枪协会估计，自康州校园枪击案后，该会每天有8000个入会。 尽管全美很多地方的枪支展销会暂停，但本州没有受到影响。亚利桑那州枪支展览将以巡回方式与枪支爱好者见面。本周六，在图森的皮马郡博览会举行，下周末将移师美莎的百年纪念堂，再下周转至凤凰城的亚利桑那博览会。
a371dcc2dbbc57ec879d890437ab50bfe5cc1467.translatedText: Alberta held several gun shows in a row, and gun sales continued to boom "Alberta Times" After the Connecticut school massacre and a series of shootings in Colorado, gun control has once again become a highly controversial topic. Many people rushed to buy guns and ammunition before the government introduced gun control laws, resulting in an unprecedented boom in the arms sales industry. Just this week, the FBI released background check data for gun buyers in December, setting another record. The National Rifle Association estimates that it has had 8,000 members a day since the Connecticut school shooting. Although gun shows and sales have been suspended in many places across the country, the state has not been affected. The Arizona Gun Show will travel to meet gun enthusiasts. It starts this Saturday at the Pima County Fair in Tucson, then moves to Centennial Hall in Mesa next weekend, and the following week to the Arizona Fair in Phoenix.

b72022e49f0cf34f2fed9d7d167aae55df00e1cc.sourceText: 一把紫砂茶壶在手，品品茗茶，可谓悠然自得。最初在太阳鸟论坛发帖，是因为朋友从中国来送了我一包上好的普洱茶，想和在这里的朋友弄个品茶吃点心的ｐａｒｔｙ。后有网友响应，说自家也有上好的茶叶可以拿来和大家一起分享。既然如此，我们不如搞一个大一点的品茶吃点心的活动。一来可以多认识一些朋友，二来可以推广一下中国的茶文化。秋色秋香在这里诚邀各位朋友叫上三五好友，拿来自家的好茶，在本周日共享下午茶的好时光。 茶叶都是各位朋友无偿提供的，有各种红茶和绿茶。在大家品茶的同时，我们会邀请一些对茶文化颇有研究的朋友给大家简单点评一下茶叶的知识。 本次活动得到了新东方艺术学校的大力支持，在此一并表示感谢。 内容：品茶、吃点心， 茶文化讲座 欣赏中国古典音乐，钢琴演奏，古筝演秦 形式：茶与点心的potluck 时间：2011年12月11日，周日，下午1：00－5：00 地点：新东方艺术学校 1100 N Alma School Rd, Suite 18, Chandler AZ在Ray Road and Alma School Road交叉口的西北角，蓝天中餐馆的北面。 大家可以带一些自家做的小点心，水果。有特别好的古典音乐的光盘的朋友也可以带来。对茶文化有心得的朋友也可以和大家一起分享。为统计人数，大家可以在论坛跟帖报名，或者给秋色秋香发邮件，把人数和是否会带茶叶详细告知。
b72022e49f0cf34f2fed9d7d167aae55df00e1cc.translatedText: With a purple clay teapot in hand, sipping tea can be described as leisurely and contented. I first posted on the Sunbird Forum because a friend from China gave me a bag of good Pu'er tea, and I wanted to have a party with my friends here to enjoy tea and snacks. Later, some netizens responded, saying that they also had good tea leaves that they could share with everyone. In this case, we might as well organize a larger tea-tasting and snacks event. Firstly, you can get to know more friends, and secondly, you can promote Chinese tea culture. Autumn Colors and Autumn Fragrances sincerely invites all of you to invite your friends, bring some good tea from home, and share the good time of afternoon tea this Sunday. Tea leaves are provided free of charge by friends, including various black teas and green teas. While everyone is tasting tea, we will invite some friends who are knowledgeable about tea culture to give you a brief review of tea knowledge. This event has received strong support from New Oriental Art School, and I would like to express my gratitude. Content: Tea tasting, snacks, tea culture lectures, appreciation of Chinese classical music, piano performance, guzheng playing Qin Format: Potluck of tea and snacks Time: December 11, 2011, Sunday, 1:00-5:00 pm Location: New Oriental Art School 1100 N Alma School Rd, Suite 18, Chandler AZ is at the northwest corner of the intersection of Ray Road and Alma School Road, north of the Blue Sky Chinese Restaurant. You can bring some home-made snacks and fruits. Friends who have particularly good classical music CDs can also bring them. Friends who have experience in tea culture can also share it with everyone. In order to count the number of people, you can sign up by posting on the forum, or send an email to Qiu Se Qiuxiang to inform you in detail of the number of people and whether you will bring tea.

8942b8f5f5ef20e5327e7d26d23ce7e36e1609fb.sourceText: 本州南部破获毒品走私 输送非法移民团伙 当局说，警方上周四破获一个通过本州南部印第安人保留地作走私大麻和进口非法移民集团。 该集团自2008年，将数以吨计的墨西哥制大麻，通过图森以南的Tohono O’Odham部落保留地运进美国，亚利桑那州总检察长汤姆霍恩说。除毒品之外，还向美国输送非法移民，用来换取现金和武器带返墨西哥。 46个被捕嫌犯中有21个是墨西哥公民，被控走私，合谋，洗黑钱等罪名，霍恩说。集团首脑，Jesus Valencia Rodriguez，仍在逃，据信匿藏在墨西哥。 2008年以来，超过150起毒品案，涉及28,000磅大麻，41起枪械攻击案与该集团有关。最令人不安的是，霍恩说，走私者使用精密检测器材，如夜视设备和对讲机等来躲避美国边防巡逻队。”这给我们执法队伍带来很大的挑战，”霍恩说。”这说明，我们必须提高警戒跟他们打交道。” 州、联邦和自治区当局三方共同努力破获犯罪集团，罪犯主要主要利用美墨自由贸易协议下，两国居民自由出入边境的条约，用Tohono O’Odham部落成员将毒品和非法移民带进美国，霍恩说。被起诉者有些人是Tohono O’Odham部落成员。 ”部落的成员必须能够来回走，因为他们保留在边界两侧，”霍恩说。”所以我们必须要能够检测时，他们不是在从事日常业务合法的部落成员，但实际上走私毒品或其他非法移民。” 保留地面积超过4400平方英里，已成为毒品定期渠道，到凤凰城的非法移民也从原来的北部山区集中到此地越境。Tohono O’Odham主席内德说，部落希望阻止毒品走私，以保护美国和保留。 大麻用背包客，或藏在车厢内，藏在跨境卡车轮胎隐蔽等方法被带到美国。
8942b8f5f5ef20e5327e7d26d23ce7e36e1609fb.translatedText: The southern part of the state busted a drug smuggling and transporting illegal immigrant gang. The authorities said that the police broke up a group last Thursday that smuggled marijuana and imported illegal immigrants through the southern Indian reservation. The group began shipping tons of Mexican-made marijuana into the United States through the Tohono O’Odham tribal reservation south of Tucson in 2008, Arizona Attorney General Tom Horn said. In addition to drugs, illegal immigrants are also transported to the United States in exchange for cash and weapons to be brought back to Mexico. Twenty-one of the 46 arrested suspects were Mexican citizens and were charged with smuggling, conspiracy, money laundering and other crimes, Horn said. The group's leader, Jesus Valencia Rodriguez, remains at large and is believed to be hiding in Mexico. Since 2008, more than 150 drug cases involving 28,000 pounds of marijuana and 41 firearms assaults have been linked to the group. Most disturbingly, Horn said, smugglers use sophisticated detection equipment, such as night vision equipment and walkie-talkies, to evade U.S. Border Patrol agents. "This creates a significant challenge for our law enforcement community," Horn said. “This shows that we have to be more vigilant in dealing with them.” State, federal and autonomous authorities have worked together to uncover criminal groups that mainly used members of the Tohono O’Odham tribe to bring drugs and illegal immigrants into the United States by taking advantage of the free trade agreement between the two countries under the U.S.-Mexico Free Trade Agreement. Some of those charged are members of the Tohono O’Odham tribe. "Members of the tribe have to be able to go back and forth because they remain on both sides of the border," Horn said. "So we have to be able to detect when they are not legitimate tribal members going about their daily business, but are actually smuggling drugs or other illegal immigrants." The reservation covers an area of ​​more than 4,400 square miles and has become a regular conduit for drugs, and illegal immigrants to Phoenix are also concentrated here from the original northern mountains to cross the border. Tohono O’Odham Chairman Ned said the tribe wants to stop drug trafficking to protect the United States and the reservation. Marijuana is brought to the U.S. by backpackers, hidden in cars, hidden under the tires of cross-border trucks, and other methods.

666edd08e71bec977071cdbc11cf8197fe46165d.sourceText: 7月25日晚，位于美国西部亚利桑那州的凤凰城遭特大沙尘暴袭击。滚滚而来的沙尘高1000米，宽度达50公里。紧随沙尘而来的是暴雨和强风，造成当地1.2万户居民断电，众多航班被取消。 这是本月亚利桑那遭遇的第二次特大沙尘暴。气象学家称，每年此时，亚利桑那州都是沙尘暴的”重灾区”。统计数字显示，当地平均每年要遭遇3到4次大型沙尘暴（能见度小于400米）袭击。
666edd08e71bec977071cdbc11cf8197fe46165d.translatedText: On the evening of July 25, Phoenix, Arizona, in the western United States, was hit by a huge sandstorm. The billowing dust is 1,000 meters high and 50 kilometers wide. The dust was followed by heavy rain and strong winds, causing power outages for 12,000 local residents and the cancellation of many flights. This is the second major dust storm to hit Arizona this month. Meteorologists say that at this time of year, Arizona is the "hardest hit area" for dust storms. Statistics show that the local area is hit by large sandstorms (visibility less than 400 meters) an average of 3 to 4 times a year.

In order for Hualian to truly have the broadness, inclusiveness and representativeness planned in its charter, we sincerely invite friends who care about Hualian and the community to join the team of Hualian of Alberta. According to the charter of the Hualian Federation, we will hold the annual meeting of the Hualian Federation of Alberta in May this year to elect a new leadership team. We hope that friends who are willing to make their voices heard in the Chinese community and Hualian organizations will join us before this. Let us work together to make Hualian and the Chinese community better and better. Those who are interested in joining the Alberta Hualian Association should apply in person to one of the following people before April 30, and provide their telephone and email contact information. 7b7463f72abb2b174702bcefc63b66a40c886249.sourceText: 比特网2016年7月5日消息，一名热爱足球的土耳其黑客攻击了包括亚利桑那州立大学、亚利桑那州众议院和亚利桑那州立法机关在内的多家美国政府和官方网站。
7b7463f72abb2b174702bcefc63b66a40c886249.translatedText: Bitnet reported on July 5, 2016 that a football-loving Turkish hacker attacked multiple U.S. government and official websites, including Arizona State University, the Arizona House of Representatives and the Arizona Legislature.

8a0f6e684427b10b865b2e9470f302164712642a.sourceText: 该黑客将将这三个网站的主页换成了带有其个人标志的页面,上面有一条反对美利坚合众国的留言,还有一个属于Eskişehirspor的标志, Eskişehirspo是位于Eskişehir的一家土耳其足球俱乐部。
8a0f6e684427b10b865b2e9470f302164712642a.translatedText: The hacker changed the homepages of the three websites to pages with his personal logo, a message against the United States of America, and a logo belonging to Eskişehirspor, a Turkish football club based in Eskişehir.

f02bbc4fbd8c7b4f2ecc8c147fbfc8bc3583ac7c.sourceText: 这次乱涂与之前阿尔巴尼亚黑客在南约克郡警方网站上留下足球俱乐部标志的事件有些相似,这可能是因为尽管2016年欧洲杯一直在持续,土耳其和美国的足球队却始终没有碰上。
f02bbc4fbd8c7b4f2ecc8c147fbfc8bc3583ac7c.translatedText: This graffiti is somewhat similar to the previous incident in which Albanian hackers left football club logos on the South Yorkshire Police website. This may be because although the Euro 2016 tournament has been ongoing, the Turkish and American football teams have never met.

d3040f8c4ed4f38de0108e3112cd4f5aa01c0b9f.translatedText: Here is a fully compromised page uploaded by the Turkish hacker:

1ef9b2e112e39049cd947691306b6cc618202328.sourceText: 目前还不清楚黑客是如何绕过防卫系统并上传自己的页面的,尤其是考虑到他针对的网站是引人注目的政府机构。但是在看到最近美国医疗数据库发生的泄露后,我们明显感到,美国的网络安全确实较为薄弱。
1ef9b2e112e39049cd947691306b6cc618202328.translatedText: It is unclear how the hacker bypassed the defense system and uploaded his own page, especially considering that the website he targeted was a high-profile government agency. However, after seeing the recent leak of the US medical database, we clearly feel that the US network security is indeed relatively weak.

df4925cfc23a51a34f8511a2a50cb352a3cef4b4.sourceText: 在研究中我们发现,这名黑客自2007年以来一直在丑化各类网站,但此次事件是他造成的最大的一次破坏。我们还发现aLem!与著名的土耳其黑客集团Turk Hack Team有所关联。
df4925cfc23a51a34f8511a2a50cb352a3cef4b4.translatedText: During our research, we found that this hacker has been defaming various websites since 2007, but this incident is the largest damage he has caused. We also discovered that aLem! is associated with the well-known Turkish hacking group Turk Hack Team.

f1b6036e3f462931b79ae09e06812e69ae5d9932.sourceText: 发表这篇文章的时候,所有受到针对的网站已经恢复使用。
f1b6036e3f462931b79ae09e06812e69ae5d9932.translatedText: When this article was published, all targeted websites had been restored.

702f92491d61859319d0674d92f317ecbcdc8c87.sourceText: 天高云淡，湖水碧篮。天庇市(Tempe)的基瓦尼斯湖(kiwanis Lake)是大凤凰城中最美丽的公眾休闲胜地。凤凰城侨联总会的第二届社群联谊野餐活动正在湖边进行。 繁花绿树，环境优雅，正是假日合家欢乐的好去处。11月17日，眾多侨民到此享受假日，情感交流。
702f92491d61859319d0674d92f317ecbcdc8c87.translatedText: The sky is high and the clouds are clear, and the lake is blue. Kiwanis Lake in Tempe is the most beautiful public recreational destination in greater Phoenix. The Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation's second community picnic is taking place by the lake. With lush flowers and green trees and an elegant environment, it is a great place for family fun during the holidays. On November 17, many overseas Chinese came here to enjoy the holiday and communicate emotionally.

76c28370aed3456af1ab53aefd6c8d73a8641c59.sourceText: 10月19日下午3:30社区7位代表和市规划局局长等三人开会。规划局通知大家说True North 在10月18号已经根据规划局10月6号对他换瓦的质疑提交了补充材料，也就是根据规划局的要求，不用Metal roof,改用瓦顶。 True North和市政府的表现都令人吃惊。市政府为何会接受这样的补充材料？都没有要求True North 补充用瓦顶后的效果图，毕竟这是凤凰城的最重要的一条市面马路；True North也表现得非常奇怪，既然还是用瓦，难道这些普通的泥土烧出来的并不结实的residential 的瓦顶会比用特定陶土烧出来的百年大计的瓦更好吗？ 看来，市政府并不珍惜中国文化中心，侭管我们的代表不断地对政府表示这不是一个普通的商业房产，不能按普通房产的审批流程来处理许可证，市政府反复强调这就是一个普通房产。 欢迎大家对以上情况发表意见。我们共同努力，一定要制止和纠正是政府的态度，同时尽快的让True North 面对社区舆论，回到谈判桌上，公平的把文化中心卖给珍惜和爱护文化中心的人。（杨萍供稿）
76c28370aed3456af1ab53aefd6c8d73a8641c59.translatedText: At 3:30 pm on October 19th, 7 representatives of the community and the director of the Municipal Planning Bureau met with three other people. The Planning Bureau informed everyone that on October 18, True North had submitted supplementary materials in response to the Planning Bureau’s question on October 6 about his replacement of tiles. In other words, in accordance with the Planning Bureau’s requirements, the Metal roof was replaced with a tile roof. The performance of both True North and the city has been astonishing. Why would the city government accept such supplementary materials? None of them asked True North to add the renderings after using the tile roof. After all, this is the most important street in Phoenix. True North also behaved very strangely. Since it still uses tiles, would these ordinary clay-fired residential tile roofs that are not strong be better than the centuries-old tiles fired from specific clay? It seems that the city government does not cherish the Chinese Cultural Center. Even though our representatives kept telling the government that this is not an ordinary commercial property and the license cannot be processed according to the approval process of ordinary properties, the city government repeatedly emphasized that this is an ordinary property. Everyone is welcome to express their opinions on the above situation. We work together to stop and correct the government's attitude, and at the same time, let True North face community public opinion as soon as possible, return to the negotiating table, and sell the cultural center fairly to people who cherish and care for the cultural center. (Contributed by Yang Ping)

f738dc7f108235d0ea4340d4620052842b20208e.translatedText: We need more people to send emails to the Municipal Planning Bureau and oppose the issuance of reconstruction permits to True North

da355366e091cd6ec09a38f9bd47c76788d63658.sourceText: 10月19日晚，距离11月3日老四川开庭仅剩两个星期，我们能做什么呢？ 媒体顾问Thomas Simon手把手教授大家如何用Facebook发布现场直播并介绍了在这关键时刻如何给报刊写信，充分发挥纸媒的力量。 来参加学习的二十多位朋友都是护城标兵。为了护城，他们走到一起来了！他们都是从群众中揭竿而起，主动挑梁的”志愿军”。两军对垒，勇者胜；勇者相逢，智者胜。在这个关键时期，他们要拿起笔作刀枪，为挽救中国文化城，再冲锋! Thomas Simon说，启用直播功能就能把最新的新闻热点推送到四海八荒。视频两分钟至五六分钟最为相宜，发送时一定要加上＃Chinese Cultural Center的标签，以便Facebook的关键词功能推送给最合适的广大受众。
da355366e091cd6ec09a38f9bd47c76788d63658.translatedText: On the evening of October 19th, there are only two weeks left before the Old Sichuan court session is held on November 3rd. What can we do? Media consultant Thomas Simon taught everyone how to use Facebook to publish live broadcasts and introduced how to write letters to newspapers and magazines at this critical moment, giving full play to the power of print media. The more than 20 friends who came to participate in the study are all role models in protecting the city. To protect the city, they came together! They are all "volunteer soldiers" who rise up from the masses and take the initiative to take the lead. When two armies confront each other, the brave will win; when the brave meet, the wise will win. At this critical period, they must use their pens as swords and guns to save China Cultural City and charge again! Thomas Simon said that enabling the live broadcast function can push the latest news hot spots to all corners of the world. The video is most suitable for two to five to six minutes. When sending, be sure to add the tag #Chinese Cultural Center so that Facebook’s keyword function can push it to the most appropriate broad audience.

644871c45288630d4d71360892e3b27f5dcb6bfe.sourceText: 运用纸媒的力量是当前任务的重中之重。办法就是给报社的编辑寄信或电邮。要让有关Chinese Cultural Center的信件堆积成山，挤爆他们的工作邮箱，才能引起编辑的高度重视。我们要借用纸媒传递信息，打动人心，达到挽救中国文化城的舆论效果。为此，我们倡议所有护城将士，从即日起至11月3日，以手中的笔或电脑为武器，每人每天一封信开展接力赛，车轮战式轰炸媒体编辑，力图强势抢占报纸版面。文章不必太长，两三个段落足矣，主题一定要明确，一封信从一个角度切入（主题参考如下：多元文化，族裔团结，3D教材，观光旅游，强拆破坏，政府承诺，宗教意义，建筑美学，艺术价值，风水理论，经济愿景，文化中心历史和价值。。。。。。），标题一定要夺人眼球并且加＃Chinese Cultural Center的标签。内容尽量短而精，做到言之有物，言之有理，晓之以情，动之以理。 消息来自Facebook新媒体学习班(蜜董供稿)
644871c45288630d4d71360892e3b27f5dcb6bfe.translatedText: Using the power of print media is the top priority of the current task. The way to do this is to send a letter or email to the editor of the newspaper. Only when letters about the Chinese Cultural Center pile up and overwhelm their work mailboxes can it attract the editor's attention. We must use paper media to convey information, impress people, and achieve the public opinion effect of saving China Cultural City. To this end, we propose that from now until November 3, all city guards use their pens or computers as weapons to start a relay race and write a letter every day, bombarding media editors in a wheel-and-wheel battle, and strive to seize newspaper pages. The article does not need to be too long, two or three paragraphs are enough. The topic must be clear and the letter should be addressed from one angle (theme reference is as follows: multiculturalism, ethnic unity, 3D teaching materials, tourism, forced demolitions, government commitments, religious significance, architectural aesthetics, artistic value, Feng Shui theory, economic vision, the history and value of cultural centers...), and the title must be eye-catching and add the tag #Chinese Cultural Center. The content should be as short and concise as possible, so that it has something to say, makes sense, understands it with emotion, and moves it with reason. The news comes from the Facebook New Media Study Class (provided by Director Mi)

1a9e8bdfb44f244cab496374d2dd2cf811755575.translatedText: The Chinese Kuomintang's overseas "special party dues" and "thousand yuan donation" activities [China...

13f091976344f726e6699c2e579d494921bd4f46.sourceText: [中国国民党亚利桑那直属分部来稿] 民进党上台执政， 挟国会多数席次，成立”不当党产委员会”，未经任何司法判决，黑手直接伸入金融机构，冻结国民党资产，为因应此违法违宪，无理无情的政治追杀，中国国民党中央党部于十月二十二日发起”特别党费”及”仟圆捐募”两项活动，以期团结一心，救亡图存。
13f091976344f726e6699c2e579d494921bd4f46.translatedText: [Article submitted by the Arizona branch of the Chinese Kuomintang] The Democratic Progressive Party came to power, Taking advantage of the majority of seats in Congress, the "Improper Party Assets Committee" was established. Without any judicial judgment, the black hands directly reached into financial institutions and froze the assets of the Kuomintang. In response to this illegal, unconstitutional, and unreasonable and ruthless political pursuit, the Central Party Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang launched two activities, "Special Party Dues" and "Thousand Yuan Donation" on October 22, in the hope of uniting as one to save the nation.

207df97ccaa3e51a4b1d561081fdbe875abcda53.sourceText: 海外党费及政治献金涉及”行管会”汇款规定，中央党部在邮局开设的政治献金专户无法直接收受国外汇款，必须先行汇至海外各地捐款专户，再转汇至中央献金专户。中国国民党组织发展委员会海外部于十月二十七日发文，对此两项活动特加说明。
207df97ccaa3e51a4b1d561081fdbe875abcda53.translatedText: Overseas party dues and political donations involve the remittance regulations of the "Administrative Management Committee". The special political donation account opened by the Central Party Committee at the post office cannot directly accept foreign remittances. It must first be remitted to special donation accounts overseas and then transferred to the special central donation account. The Overseas Department of the Chinese Kuomintang Organization and Development Committee issued a document on October 27, specifically explaining these two activities.

0d70aee537a5ef0d457806f8cc55eb412303ee8d.sourceText: 本次”特别党费”劝缴办法係依据”中国国民党党员缴纳党费办法”之规定办理，收受新台币2000元一次性特别党费，党员得视意愿，自行提高认缴金额，没有上限，亦无任何其它法律疑虑。
0d70aee537a5ef0d457806f8cc55eb412303ee8d.translatedText: This "Special Party Dues" payment method is based on the provisions of the "Measures for Payment of Party Dues by Members of the Chinese Kuomintang". A one-time special party dues of NT$2,000 is accepted. Party members can increase the subscription amount according to their wishes. There is no upper limit and there are no other legal doubts.

7a9cd227be674c625a31c60c560a58871bf71869.sourceText: 海外各级党部必须于十月二十五日至十二月二十五日期间内完成收缴造册后，统一汇入党中央党费专户。 中央将在汇款入帐后，依据名册分别开立收据及复刻版”中华革命党党证纪念券”, 授与每位缴交特别党费之党员留存纪念。
7a9cd227be674c625a31c60c560a58871bf71869.translatedText: Overseas party headquarters at all levels must complete the collection and registration between October 25th and December 25th, and then transfer them to the party dues account of the Party Central Committee. After the remittance is deposited, the central government will issue receipts and replicas of "Chinese Revolutionary Party Certificate Commemorative Vouchers" based on the roster, and grant them to each party member who paid special party dues to keep as a souvenir.

e4a8e4ca6a85089b6bcf817b3b7384eac9302212.sourceText: 至于”仟圆捐募”部分则属政治献金，依”政治献金法”之规范，捐款人 必须为中华民国国民，具有身分证字号以及年满 20岁者。而且单一捐款人每一年度捐给同一政党的总额是新台币30万元。若以在台企业之名捐赠， 每一年度捐款给同一政党之限额为新台币300万元。
e4a8e4ca6a85089b6bcf817b3b7384eac9302212.translatedText: As for the "Thousand Yuan Donation" part, it is a political donation. According to the regulations of the "Political Donation Law", the donor must be a citizen of the Republic of China, have an ID card number, and be over 20 years old. Moreover, the total amount donated by a single donor to the same political party each year is NT$300,000. If the donation is made in the name of a company in Taiwan, the annual donation limit to the same political party is NT$3 million.

dc46570b9e2ee3b406efe4d6faed4e818a0c8ff1.sourceText: 个人或企业捐款，均可在年度限额内，连年行之。 中央亦将捐款入帐后，开立”政治献金收据”与每个人或企业捐款者。
dc46570b9e2ee3b406efe4d6faed4e818a0c8ff1.translatedText: Individual or corporate donations can be made within the annual limit, year after year. The central government will also issue a "political donation receipt" to each individual or corporate donor after the donation is recorded in the account.

831e909578f1510e480a5468c6299bf88a70105c.sourceText: 特别党费及政治献金涉及金钱收受与汇款作业，中国国民党亚利桑那直属分部将开立专户，依照法规处理。 捐款日期，姓名，身分证字号，党政字号，地址及收纳金额均将确实列册，呈报中央。
831e909578f1510e480a5468c6299bf88a70105c.translatedText: Special party dues and political donations involve the collection and remittance of money. The Arizona Branch of the Chinese Kuomintang will open a special account and handle it in accordance with regulations. The donation date, name, ID card number, party and government number, address and amount received will be accurately recorded and reported to the central government.

a117079528fda26a0aacfcbec69ae545444baf78.sourceText: 中国国民党亚利桑那直属分部，谨此代表党中央向所有缴交特别党费或赞助之同志暨侨胞，致上最深的谢意。 联络同志的姓名及电话如下：
