e885867d5303eadea82c098209b4c99ce1f5b983.sourceText: 纽约时间2月14日晚，由世界中国烹饪联合会会长、中国烹饪协会常务副会长杨柳女士率领的中国烹饪文化技艺交流团一行30馀人同美国各州的中餐企业代表近400人在曼明都大酒楼举行中餐技艺交流活动暨中餐业界庆祝农曆新年联欢会。中美餐饮界人士共聚一堂，共话友谊，共谋发展。本次交流活动由世界中国烹饪联合会主办，美国餐饮协会协办。 美国餐饮协会何德兴会长代表协会全体成员致辞欢迎杨会长一行，何先生指出，通过人员往来与技艺交流活动，不仅有助于促进美国中餐业创新发展，更重要的是提升中华美食在美国的地位，推动中华美食向国际进军。 杨会长在致辞中强调，通过在美国的访问与美国餐饮界交流砌磋，有助中华传统美食推陈出新，走向世界，借助于中国美食，传播中华文化，通过美食交流，架起一座中美两国人民友好往来的友谊桥樑。 交流会上，中国着名烹饪大师李启贵先生现场表演了中国传统手工拉面的绝活，大师的精彩表演赢得了在座嘉宾的喝彩，真正体现出了拉面绝活中的三项要素，一要抻不断，二要细如丝，三要能点燃。吴永东大厨即席示范表演了吹面气球等具有中华美食特色的菜式，技惊四座，和观众们的互动，把交流活动氛围推向了高潮。
e885867d5303eadea82c098209b4c99ce1f5b983.translatedText: On the evening of February 14th, New York time, a Chinese cooking culture and skills exchange group of more than 30 people, led by Ms. Yang Liu, President of the World Chinese Cuisine Federation and Executive Vice President of the China Cuisine Association, and nearly 400 representatives of Chinese food companies from various states in the United States held a Chinese food technology exchange event and a Chinese food industry celebration party to celebrate the Lunar New Year at Manmingdu Restaurant. People from the Chinese and American catering circles gathered together to talk about friendship and seek common development. This exchange event is hosted by the World Chinese Culinary Federation and co-organized by the American Restaurant Association. President He Dexing of the American Restaurant Association delivered a speech on behalf of all members of the association to welcome President Yang and his party. Mr. He pointed out that through personnel exchanges and skill exchange activities, it will not only help promote the innovative development of the Chinese food industry in the United States, but more importantly, enhance the status of Chinese food in the United States and promote the international expansion of Chinese food. In his speech, President Yang emphasized that through his visit to the United States, exchanges and consultations with the American catering industry will help traditional Chinese cuisine to innovate and go global, spread Chinese culture with the help of Chinese food, and build a bridge of friendship for friendly exchanges between the people of China and the United States through food exchanges. At the exchange meeting, Mr. Li Qigui, a famous Chinese cooking master, performed the unique skill of traditional Chinese hand-pulled noodles live. The master's wonderful performance won the applause of the guests present, and truly reflected the three elements of the unique skill of ramen. The first is to stretch continuously, the second is to be as thin as silk, and the third is to be ignitable. Chef Wu Yongdong gave an impromptu demonstration of blowing noodle balloons and other dishes with Chinese cuisine characteristics, which amazed everyone. His interaction with the audience pushed the atmosphere of the exchange event to a climax.

On behalf of all the staff and students of the school, Cui Zengqi, the principal of the school, thanked the president of the Overseas Chinese Federation and the major associations under the Overseas Chinese Federation for their long-term support to the Chinese school. He expressed that he would continue to broaden the paths of running Chinese schools, spread Chinese culture in more and more flexible ways, strengthen ties with other Chinese schools, and better serve the overseas Chinese community.

352f731c8e7008043229f90a43d8f9f194cf2fc7.sourceText: 社安福利通知 停止寄发 為了節省開支，聯邦社安署宣布自本月起，改變寄送社安福利預估表(Social Security statements)的方式，將停止寄發此種每一份用掉四張紙的郵件，明年則將只寄給60歲以上者，更多的上班族將透過網路查詢。 目前25歲以上的上班族每年都會在生日前約三個月收到社會安全署寄來的社安福利預估表，說明如果在62歲、66歲或70歲退休，每個月大概可以領到多少錢。但為了節省開支，這項服務將停止。 自1980年代開始，社安署每年向年齡25歲以上的上班族寄送社安福利預估表，列出每年的可稅所得，以便納稅人查核有無錯誤，當然還包括退休時可領到的福利金額。社安署長艾斯楚3月告訴國會參院撥款小組：「每年印製和郵寄這些預估表大約要花7000萬元。」 社安署預期，從4月至9月底本會計年度結束，停止寄發此表將可節省3000萬元。該署計畫明年恢復寄發此表給60歲以上的上班族，預期明年可再節省6000 萬元。其他上班族則需自行上網查閱。艾斯楚說，如果社安署解決上網安全問題，今年底前可望提供網上查閱社安福利資料，如未能解決，則將恢復寄發紙張預估表。 此表每年寄給大約1億5000萬人，對上班族的退休規畫頗有幫助。決定停止寄發此表，與目前危及政府運作的白宮與國會預算爭執無關，但確與該署的運作預算有關，此一預算實際已凍結在2010年數額，而且該署已失去處理給付使用的大約3億5000萬元刺激經濟經費。 維護老年人權益人士說，他們對社安署的預算問題表示同情，但上網查詢有缺點，尤其是許多人不會用電腦或沒有電腦，對這些人而言，具體的紙張才能讓他們對社安福利感到安心。
352f731c8e7008043229f90a43d8f9f194cf2fc7.translatedText: Social Security Benefit Notices Stop sending In order to save costs, the Federal Social Security Administration announced that starting this month, it will change the sending of Social Security Benefit Estimation Forms (Social Security Statements) will stop sending this kind of mail, which uses four pieces of paper each. Next year, it will only be sent to those over 60 years old. More office workers will check online. Currently, office workers over the age of 25 will receive a Social Security Benefit Estimate from the Social Security Administration about three months before their birthday every year, indicating how much they will receive each month if they retire at the age of 62, 66 or 70. However, in order to save money, this service will be discontinued. Since the 1980s, the Social Security Administration has been sending Social Security benefit estimates to working people over the age of 25 every year, listing the annual taxable income so that taxpayers can check for errors, and of course the amount of benefits they will receive in retirement. "It costs about $70 million every year to print and mail these estimates," Social Security Administrator Askew told the Senate Appropriations Panel in March. The Social Security Administration expects that stopping the mailing of this form from April to the end of September will save 30 million yuan. The department plans to resume sending this form to office workers over the age of 60 next year, which is expected to save another 60 million yuan next year. Other office workers will need to check it online. Astra said that if the Internet security problem is solved, the Social Security Administration is expected to provide online access to social security benefit information by the end of this year. If it cannot be solved, it will resume sending paper estimate forms. This form is mailed to approximately 150 million people each year and is very helpful for office workers in their retirement planning. The decision to stop sending this form has nothing to do with the budget dispute between the White House and Congress that is currently jeopardizing the government's operations. It does have to do with the agency's operating budget, which has actually been frozen at the 2010 level, and the agency has lost about $350 million in stimulus funds used to process benefits. Advocates for the elderly say they sympathize with the Social Security Administration's budget problems, but there are drawbacks to searching online, especially since many people don't know how to use computers or don't have computers. For these people, concrete paper can make them feel at ease about Social Security benefits.

ebe0ef569d8111f9c282d82a95b309f681edf63f.sourceText: 母亲节特别策划：【凤凰笔会】阿琪：女人是柔弱的，母亲是坚强的 –献给九泉下的妈妈和活着的母亲们 凤凰城 阿琪 朱自清先生曾这样描写女人：女人有她温柔的空气，如听箫声，如夏玫瑰，如水似密，如烟似雾笼罩着我们。她的一举步，一伸腰，一掠发，一转眼，都如密在流，水在荡……。文人笔下的女人，如花似玉，芬芳娇媚，她散发的芳香醉了男人，醉了季节，也醉了世界。上帝从亚当身上取下的这根肋骨是美丽的化身，也是柔弱的象徵。 同是女人的母亲，却显得无比的坚强，胜过男人千百倍。 在中国辽宁省，一位28岁的女子，在她怀孕八个月的时矦，突患血癌，生育会随时夺去她的生命，医生的决定是停止妊娠，引流孩子，为母亲保住生命。他的丈夫和家人也都认为”留得青山在”是唯一正确的抉择。但是这位母亲却感到在她身上成长了八个月的小生命己和她息息相通，她宁愿失去自己的生命也要保住她的孩子。为了不让孩子受到影响，她坚持自己先不作化疗，她用坚强的意志，冒着随时可能失去生命的危险，硬是坚持和病魔抗争了20多天，终于在医生们的邦助下，迎来了孩子的诞生。 在美国女作家斯陀夫人的笔下，一位黑白混血种的女奴，为了保住自己的孩子不被出卖，毅然在奴隶贩子的追捕下，拚死逃亡。她竟然奇迹般地跳过浮冰密佈的俄亥俄河，逃到了自由州。那是孤注一掷地一跳，被逼上绝路的一跳，为了孩子的生存勇敢地一跳，追捕她的强壮男人居然望而却步。 越是在艰难的条件下，母亲们的坚强越加显露。在唐山地震和汶川地震中，无数母亲用她们的身躯抵住坍塌的屋架，保护了孩子的生命；多少母亲在失去了丈夫以后艰难地把孩子养大送进大学。改革开放前的中国，生活比较困难，妈妈们必须和男人一样坚持每天八小时的工作，外加两小时的政治学习，还要担负起家务的重担；她们在三年困难时期他省下自已的粮食和几两油，宁愿自己饿肚子也要让孩子吃饱；她们为了孩子上一个好学校，不惜冒着酷暑严寒，登门求助，不怕堪受那些冷面孔的非礼和责难；她们给孩子过年换新装，却自已穿着带补丁的旧衣服，她们为了孩子出国留学，不惜卖掉刚刚使用的新冰箱和电视机，为他们准备一奌生活必需的美金。这是大陆一代母亲们坚强生活的真实写照。 有一位失去母亲的孩子，算命先生送走了他母亲的生命。因为抗战胜利后父亲的失业和儿子的顽皮，加上家庭多年积蓄被人欺骗，家运不顺。这位相信命运的妈妈去求助于算命先生，测字的结果是她克夫克子，相信命运的她为了保全儿子的成长，居然决定牺牺她个人的生命。这是一个柔弱女子无奈地选择的一条不该走的路，却也显示了一个母亲的无比坚强。这个失去了妈妈的孩子，再也没有能够享受到人生中最温馨的妈妈的爱。父亲的倍加关怀，继母对她的关心和呵䕶，都不能填补他心灵中的缺失，对妈妈的怀念深深地埋藏在他的心底，永远，永远。她忘不了妈妈离去前那深沉而慈爱的眼神，妈妈用生命的爱换取了他一生的幸运。他时时刻刻感受到母亲在另一个世界的关爱，时时梦见妈妈在梦中的谆谆教导，邦助他渡过生命中的一个个难关。两个世界，形影相依，他仍然和母亲在一起。他真的有点相信算命先生了。 母亲们的坚强来自母爱，这是与生俱来的爱，一种最神圣、最纯淨、最无私的爱，是上天赋予母亲的夲能。正是母爱，使一代又一代的孩子得以健康成长，持续着人类的生存和繁衍。
ebe0ef569d8111f9c282d82a95b309f681edf63f.translatedText: Mother's Day special planning: [Phoenix PEN] Aqi: women are weak, mothers are strong - dedicated to mothers and living mothers Phoenix City Aqi Mr. Zhu Ziqing once described women like this: Women have their gentle air, like listening to the sound of flute, like summer roses, like water and dense, like smoke and fog that surround us. Her every move, every stretch of her waist, every brushstroke of her hair, every blink of an eye, were all like flowing water, swaying water... The women described by literati are like flowers and jade, fragrant and charming. The fragrance she exudes intoxicates men, the season, and the world. The rib God took from Adam is the embodiment of beauty and a symbol of weakness. The mother, who is also a woman, appears to be extremely strong, a thousand times stronger than the man. In Liaoning Province, China, a 28-year-old woman suddenly contracted blood cancer when she was eight months pregnant. Childbirth could take her life at any time. The doctor's decision was to stop the pregnancy and abort the child to save the mother's life. His husband and family also believe that "keeping Qingshan here" is the only right decision. But this mother felt that the little life that had grown up on her for eight months was closely connected with her. She would rather lose her own life to save her child. In order to prevent her child from being affected, she insisted on not undergoing chemotherapy. She used her strong will and risked losing her life at any time to fight the disease for more than 20 days. Finally, with the help of doctors, she welcomed the birth of her child. In the novel of the American female writer Mrs. Stowe, a female slave of black and white race, in order to protect her child from being betrayed, resolutely escaped from the pursuit of slave traders. She miraculously jumped over the ice-covered Ohio River and escaped to a free state. It was a desperate jump, a jump driven to a dead end, a brave jump for the child's survival, but the strong man who was chasing her was actually intimidated. The more difficult the conditions, the more strong mothers are revealed. In the Tangshan earthquake and the Wenchuan earthquake, countless mothers used their bodies to hold up the collapsed roof trusses to protect the lives of their children; many mothers struggled to raise their children and send them to college after losing their husbands. Before the reform and opening up, life in China was relatively difficult. Mothers, like men, had to insist on working eight hours a day, plus two hours of political study, and shouldering the burden of housework. During the three-year difficult period, they saved their own food and a few ounces of oil, preferring to go hungry themselves to feed their children; they went to school for their children. A good school does not hesitate to brave the scorching heat and cold to come to the door for help, and is not afraid of being insulted and criticized by cold faces; they give their children new clothes for the New Year, but they wear old and patched clothes. For their children to study abroad, they do not hesitate to sell their newly used refrigerators and TV sets to prepare a dollar for them to live. This is a true portrayal of the strong life of a generation of mainland mothers. There was a child who lost his mother. The fortune teller took away his mother's life. Because of his father's unemployment after the victory of the Anti-Japanese War, his son's naughty nature, and the fact that the family's savings over the years were deceived, the family's fortunes were not smooth. This mother who believed in fate went to a fortune teller for help, and the result of the fortune teller was that she was a child. Believing in fate, she actually decided to sacrifice her own life in order to preserve the growth of her son. This is a path that a weak woman has no choice but to take, but it also shows the incomparable strength of a mother. This child who lost his mother will never be able to enjoy the love of his most heartwarming mother in his life. Neither his father's extra care nor his stepmother's concern and care for her could fill the gap in his heart. The memory of his mother was deeply buried in his heart, forever and ever. She could not forget her mother's deep and loving eyes before she left. Her mother exchanged her life's love for his life's happiness. He always feels his mother's care in another world, and always dreams of his mother's earnest teachings in his dreams, helping him overcome every difficulty in his life. The two worlds are inseparable, and he is still with his mother. He really kind of believed in the fortune teller. The strength of mothers comes from maternal love, which is innate love. It is the most sacred, pure and selfless love, and it is the power given to mothers by God. It is maternal love that enables generations of children to grow up healthily and sustains the survival and reproduction of mankind.

1828597cc28f4782d43925da460c8e0f924c51e5.sourceText: 应本地两所”海外华文教育示范学校”– 现代中文学校和希望中文学校负责人的倡议，由全美中文学校协会名誉会长、协会凤凰城地区联络中心主任帅致若召集，2015年8月8日凤凰城地区的五所中文学校负责人齐聚一堂交流办学经验，探讨本地中文教育的发展前景。 出席会议的有现代中文学校董事长田韶微女士和副校长王玉兰女士，希望中文学校董事长李健博士和校长田琳女士，凤凰城中文学校董事长谢健明先生，凤城华人基督教会中文学校校长沈美京女士，去年新加入全美中文学校协会的孟子中文学校校长刘凤霞女士，以及全美中文学校协会名誉会长帅致若女士。 凤凰城中文学校谢健明董事 长介绍了学校这几年的发展。凤凰城中文学校近年来积极向非华语社区推广中文课程，目前该校的非华裔学生占学生总数的百分之三十五。能够让更多的非华语家庭的学生到中文学校来学习中文，向主流社会推广中文教育是本地区每一所中文学校的发展目标；通过 谢董事长的介绍和凤凰城中文学校的成功模式大家都看到了双语中文教育的前景。 孟子中文学校的校长刘凤霞女士介绍了该校的夏令营、课后班和幼儿班的情况。该校目前在校生发展到近百人，这些学生全部是来自非华语家庭的学生。刘校长也分享了他们今年办暑期夏令营的经验；由于暑假期间所有的中文学校都放假，孟子中文学校的中文夏令营满足了部分需要暑期学习中文的家长和学生的需求。 凤凰城华人基督教会中文学校成立于１９８３年，是本地区历史最悠久的中文学校之一。沈美京校长向大家介绍了学校的历史和今后的发展。沈校长多次提到了学校对中文教学质量的严格要求，要求所有授课老师都要认真备课亲自批改作业，任课老师需要了解每一个学生的进步和不足以便有针对性地帮助学生。 希望中文学校的李健董事长和田琳校长向在座的同仁们分享了办学经验。”小班授课，精致教学”是希望中文学校的办学理念。丰富多彩的才艺课程与中文教学互相结合，鼓励学生并给学生们提供施展自己才能的舞台极大地鼓励了学生们学习中文的热情。在新的学年，希望中文学校才华横溢的教师们还会拓展更多的思路引起学生的兴趣，把学生们带向中文学习的新高峰。 现代中文学校是亚省规模最大的中文学校。现代中文学校的田韶微董事长和教学副校长王玉兰介绍说该校目前学生注册人数已经很多，强调学校将一如既往的将教学质量放在第一位；她们认为召集这次会议很有必要，使本地区中文学校的负责人在开学能坐到一起进行很有意义的交流，并且希望今后能定期地与本地同仁进行这样的交流。 几所中文学校的负责人还就今后中文教育、学校发展等问题进行了前瞻性的探讨，并且取得了很多共识；在座的中文教育负责人基本上都有着在中文学校亲自任教和管理的经历，各人结合自己的经验体会，对中文学校面临的困难以及今后的发展方向，进行了符合实际的分析和提出了切实可行的一些初步方案。 现代中文学校于8月9号在ASU开学；凤城华人基督教会中文学校将于8月16日下午在凤城华人基督教会开学；希望中文学校将于8月22日下午在美莎社区大学（MCC）开学；凤凰城中文学校将于8月23日下午在美莎社区大学开学。 ８月１６日，现代中文学校将主持由国侨办派来的”专家团”今年在凤凰城地区的中文教师培训活动。田韶微董事长说该校正在积极准备迎接”专家团”工作和周密地安排培训活动；田董事长邀请所有中文学校的教师和热爱华文教育的家长以及本地区其它任教中文的教师都来参加这次培训；培训地点在ASU的LL大楼2号教室，时间为8月16日周日上午10点至下午4点半；本次培训不收任何费用，午餐在大学的MU大楼自行购买；参加培训的人员可获得中英文版的证书；有意参加培训的人员请电邮联系田韶微董事长： shaoweitian@yahoo.com ，以便准备培训证书。
1828597cc28f4782d43925da460c8e0f924c51e5.translatedText: In response to the initiative of the leaders of two local "overseas Chinese education model schools" - Modern Chinese School and Hope Chinese School, convened by Shuai Zhiruo, honorary president of the National Association of Chinese Schools and director of the Association's Phoenix Regional Liaison Center, on August 8, 2015, leaders of five Chinese schools in the Phoenix area gathered together to exchange school experience and explore the development prospects of local Chinese education. Present at the meeting were Modern Chinese School Chairman Ms. Tian Shaowei and Vice Principal Ms. Wang Yulan, Hope Chinese School Chairman Dr. Li Jian and Principal Ms. Tian Lin, Phoenix Chinese School Chairman Mr. Xie Jianming, Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church Chinese School Principal Ms. Shen Meijing, Mencius Chinese School Principal Ms. Liu Fengxia, who newly joined the National Association of Chinese Schools last year, and National Association of Chinese Schools Honorary President Ms. Shuai Zhiruo. Chairman Xie Jianming of Phoenix Chinese School introduced the school’s development in recent years. Phoenix Chinese School has actively promoted Chinese courses to non-Chinese-speaking communities in recent years. Currently, non-Chinese students in the school account for 35% of the total number of students. It is the development goal of every Chinese school in the region to enable more students from non-Chinese-speaking families to learn Chinese in Chinese schools and to promote Chinese education to mainstream society. Through Chairman Xie’s introduction and the successful model of Phoenix Chinese School, everyone has seen the prospects of bilingual Chinese education. Ms. Liu Fengxia, the principal of Mencius Chinese School, introduced the school’s summer camps, after-school classes and kindergarten classes. The school currently has nearly a hundred students enrolled, all of whom are students from non-Chinese-speaking families. Principal Liu also shared their experience in running summer camps this year; since all Chinese schools are on vacation during the summer vacation, the Chinese summer camp of Mencius Chinese School meets the needs of some parents and students who need to learn Chinese during the summer. Phoenix Chinese Christian Church Chinese School was established in 1983 and is one of the oldest Chinese schools in the region. Principal Shen Meijing introduced the school’s history and future development to everyone. Principal Shen repeatedly mentioned the school’s strict requirements for the quality of Chinese teaching, requiring all teachers to prepare lessons carefully and correct homework personally. Teachers need to understand each student’s progress and shortcomings in order to help students in a targeted manner. Chairman Li Jian and Principal Tian Lin of Hope Chinese School shared their experience in running schools with the colleagues present. "Small class teaching, exquisite teaching" is the educational philosophy of Hope Chinese School. The combination of rich and colorful talent courses and Chinese teaching encourages students and provides them with a stage to display their talents, which greatly encourages students' enthusiasm for learning Chinese. In the new school year, I hope that the talented teachers of the Chinese school will expand more ideas to arouse students' interest and take students to a new peak in Chinese learning. Modern Chinese School is the largest Chinese school in Alberta. Modern Chinese School’s Chairman Tian Shaowei and Vice-Principal of Teaching Wang Yulan introduced that the school currently has a large number of registered students, and stressed that the school will continue to put teaching quality first; they believe that it is necessary to convene this meeting so that the heads of Chinese schools in the region can sit together for meaningful exchanges at the beginning of the school year, and hope to have such exchanges with local colleagues on a regular basis in the future. The heads of several Chinese schools also conducted forward-looking discussions on issues such as Chinese education and school development in the future, and achieved a lot of consensus. Basically, the heads of Chinese education here have personal teaching and management experience in Chinese schools. Each person combined their own experience and experience to conduct a realistic analysis of the difficulties faced by Chinese schools and the future development direction and put forward some practical preliminary plans. Modern Chinese School will start at ASU on August 9th; Fengcheng Chinese Christian School will start at Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church on the afternoon of August 16th; Hope Chinese School will start at Mesa Community College (MCC) on the afternoon of August 22nd; Phoenix Chinese School will start at Mesa Community College on the afternoon of August 23rd. On August 16, Modern Chinese School will host an "expert group" sent by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council for this year's Chinese teacher training activities in the Phoenix area. Chairman Tian Shaowei said that the school is actively preparing for the work of the "expert group" and carefully arranging training activities; Chairman Tian invites teachers from all Chinese schools and parents who love Chinese education as well as other Chinese teachers in the region to participate in this training; the training venue is ASU's LL Classroom No. 2 of the building, the time is from 10 am to 4:30 pm on Sunday, August 16th. There is no fee for this training. Lunch can be purchased at the MU building of the university. Those who participate in the training can obtain certificates in Chinese and English. Those who are interested in participating in the training, please contact Chairman Tian Shaowei by email: shaoweitian@yahoo.com in order to prepare the training certificate.

3b0063e2d26db865445106bdeaf2fd7bf0283547.sourceText: 百人参加浴佛仪式 同庆慈济佛诞日，母亲节，全球慈济日 (本网讯)2014年5月11日上午9时30分，慈济凤凰城联络处举办了多达近百人的浴佛仪式，同庆”’慈济佛诞日，母亲节，全球慈济日”。 慈济凤凰城联络处的师兄师姐热情的接待了参加浴佛的朋友。， 「供灯烛、香汤、供花香」司仪声音宏量引导，慈济的两位师姐向大德们演示了浴佛的基本程序。合掌，９０度鞠躬，收沾智慧水，合掌起身，９０度鞠躬，手触花香，合掌起身。 前来参加浴佛活动的人有上至七八十岁的老人，下至七八岁的小朋友，大家整齐地排列在静思堂。大众以整齐划一的动作，以清净心供灯烛、香汤、供花香礼敬诸佛，虔诚合掌仰天祝祷，祈愿天下无灾无难，人心净化祥和。 浴佛身，净自心，庄严的浴佛大典，优雅的歌声中，慢慢接近尾声。佛诞日，母亲节，全球慈济日，”三节”同庆，会众都获得慈济准备的水果和点心，将节日的心情带回家。 慈济师兄师姐们开始浴佛 灯烛 花香准备就绪 浴佛仪式 正在浴佛的家长和孩子
3b0063e2d26db865445106bdeaf2fd7bf0283547.translatedText: Hundred people attended the Buddha Bathing Ceremony Celebrating Tzu Chi Buddha’s Birthday, Mother’s Day, and Global Tzu Chi Day (News from this website) At 9:30 a.m. on May 11, 2014, Tzu Chi Phoenix Liaison Office held a Buddha bathing ceremony for nearly a hundred people to celebrate “Tzu Chi Buddha’s Birthday, Mother’s Day, and Global Tzu Chi Day.” Senior brothers and sisters from the Tzu Chi Phoenix Liaison Office warmly received friends who participated in the Buddha Bathing. "Offer lamps, candles, incense soup, and offer flowers and incense." The emcee's voice guided the ceremony, and two senior sisters from Tzu Chi demonstrated the basic procedures for bathing the Buddha to the great masters. Put your hands together, bow at 90 degrees, collect the water of wisdom, stand up with your hands together, bow at 90 degrees, touch the fragrance of flowers with your hands, and stand up with your hands together. People who came to participate in the Buddha Bathing activity ranged from elderly people in their 70s and 80s to children as young as 78. They all lined up neatly in the Jingsi Hall. With uniform movements, the public offered lamps, candles, incense soup, and flower incense to pay homage to the Buddhas with a pure heart. They clasped their hands together and raised their heads to the sky to pray, hoping that the world would be free from disasters and that people's hearts would be purified and peaceful. Bath the Buddha body and purify your mind. The solemn Buddha bathing ceremony slowly comes to an end amid elegant singing. Buddha’s Birthday, Mother’s Day, and Global Tzu Chi Day were celebrated together. The congregation received fruits and snacks prepared by Tzu Chi to take the festive mood home with them. Tzu Chi brothers and sisters begin to bathe the Buddha. Lights, candles, and flowers are ready. Buddha bathing ceremony. Parents and children bathing the Buddha.

e51012612ea7374a0e05bdb4bb318e8f740b8ea2.sourceText: 声色智艺说佳丽——凤凰选美报道（六） 张肇鸿 历年来，凤凰城选美都不乏美貌与智慧并重的佳丽，而今年参赛的选手更是声色智艺俱全，现不妨让你管中窥豹，先吓你一跳！ 1号扬忠婷，她不但身段好，还弹得一手好钢琴，从小学到大学她都是其中顶尖的高手，获得过不少奖项，和著名乐团或大师级人物共同演奏过钢琴协奏曲，两次代表亚利桑那州出席过青年艺术家钢琴大赛。她还是一个优秀的小提琴手，她们创办的乐队已为老年人和病患者义务演过70场的音乐会，是个音乐界的小天使。 2号高佳薇，出生于西安，从小就是个儿童演员，拍过电视广告，做过日本近代杂志的封面女郎，是网络歌唱比赛中的北京十强歌手之一，也荣获过本州岛州立大学的歌唱大赛冠军，在第五届中国青年绘画比赛中荣获第一名，在美国数学协会的数学竞赛中夺得亚军。目前在亚省创办了第一间卡拉OK专店，堪称多才多艺。 3号胡秋子，成都辣妹子。5岁就开始练舞，10岁在凤凰城中国周登台亮相，是成都姐妹市文化交流代表团中年纪最小的成员。作为中华文化大使，多年来到过法国、西班牙。加拿大和美国多个城市演出。08年她到纽约攻读艺术和文化管理硕士，毕业后，现任新东方艺术学院舞蹈老师。她是个舞者，充满动感且优美。 4号刘兆慈，出生于美国本土，是一位爱好运动的姑娘。她自幼热爱游泳，18岁时已有11年花样游泳的经验，参加过许多公开赛和获奖。2010年她代表美国队参加了国际泳联花样游泳世界青年锦标赛。她在凤城基督教会的青年组和中文学校是个积极成员，心境开朗又乐于助人，她选修心理学和医学，将来要帮助儿童。 5号陈伊恩，西安姑娘，她得到的第一个学位是英国文学学士学位，并在加州的洪堡州立大学获得了第二个国际问题研究的学士学位，目前是亚省州立大学公共管理硕士研究生。她平时乐于为小区服务，毕业后将服务于最需要帮助的弱势社群。她有钻然精神，在选美之夜，将用自创道具来表演富有中国民间特色的舞蹈。 6号程诗懿，出生和成长在广州，来美国四年，一直保留中华文化精神，积极进取，乐于接受任何的挑战。她希望通过选美来拓展社交网络，进一步让人看到她的内在美。选美之夜，她的才艺表演是拉丁舞，她希望把最好的一面呈现出来，请大家投她一票。其实，网络上有很多选栗投给她，是目前人气最旺的得主之一。 7号林怡，出生于亚省，幼年成长在北京。她样貌清纯，现在本州岛大学读三年级，主修土木工程，专攻环境运输和桥梁设计，梦想是建设有如金门大桥般的世界级别工程。她喜欢的名言：不要在尝试之前就放弃。她助人为乐，常到医院作义工。她爱好弹钢琴和吹长笛，在和家人的合奏中，享受家庭所带来的欢乐与温馨。 大家如欲知更多的信息，可上亚利桑那州华人社区网站 www.sunbirdarizona.com 浏览，目前已有近十万个点击和过万的有效票数投了给各位佳丽，凤凰城华裔小姐选美已受到世界注目，创下侨联选美的历史记录。希望大家参加投票，并踊跃购票去观赏7月4日的凤凰城华人庆祝美国国庆和选美！ 佳丽们在八号公共电视台作义工，左起：6号程诗懿 5号陈伊恩 4号刘兆慈 周畅（2010冠军） 1号扬忠婷 3号胡秋子 2号高佳薇
e51012612ea7374a0e05bdb4bb318e8f740b8ea2.translatedText: Beauties talk about beauty, beauty, intelligence and art - Phoenix beauty pageant report (6) Zhang Zhaohong Over the years, the Phoenix City beauty pageant has always had beauties with both beauty and intelligence, and this year's contestants are even more beautiful in appearance, intelligence and art. Now I might as well give you a glimpse of the beauty pageant and scare you first! No. 1 Yang Zhongting, she not only has a good figure, but also plays the piano well. She has been a top player from elementary school to college. She has won many awards, has played piano concertos with famous orchestras or masters, and has represented Arizona twice in the Young Artist Piano Competition. She is also an excellent violinist. The band they founded has performed 70 voluntary concerts for the elderly and patients. She is a little angel in the music industry. No. 2 Gao Jiawei, born in Xi'an, has been a child actor since she was a child. She has filmed TV commercials and been a cover girl for modern Japanese magazines. She is one of the top ten singers in Beijing in online singing competitions. She has also won the championship of Honshu Island State University's singing competition. She won first place in the 5th China Youth Painting Competition and won runner-up in the American Mathematical Association's mathematics competition. Currently, he has opened the first karaoke shop in Alberta, which can be said to be versatile. No. 3 Hu Qiuzi, a hot girl from Chengdu. He started practicing dancing at the age of 5, and made his stage debut at the Phoenix China Week at the age of 10. He was the youngest member of the Chengdu sister city cultural exchange delegation. As a Chinese cultural ambassador, I have been to France and Spain for many years. Performed in many cities across Canada and the United States. In 2008, she went to New York to study for a master's degree in art and cultural management. After graduation, she is now a dance teacher at the New Oriental Art Institute. She is a dancer, dynamic and graceful. No. 4 Liu Zhaoci was born in the United States and is a sports-loving girl. She has loved swimming since she was a child. At the age of 18, she had 11 years of experience in synchronized swimming, participating in many open competitions and winning awards. In 2010, she represented Team USA at the FINA Synchronized Swimming World Youth Championships. She is an active member of the youth group of Fengcheng Christian Church and the Chinese school. She is cheerful and helpful. She majored in psychology and medicine and will help children in the future. No. 5, Ian Chen, is a girl from Xi'an. Her first degree was a bachelor's degree in English literature and her second bachelor's degree in international studies from Humboldt State University in California. She is currently a master's degree student in public administration at Alberta State University. She is usually willing to serve the community. After graduation, she will serve the disadvantaged groups who need the most help. She has a great spirit and will use her own props to perform a dance with Chinese folk characteristics on the night of the beauty pageant. No. 6 Cheng Shiyi was born and raised in Guangzhou. She has been in the United States for four years. She has always retained the spirit of Chinese culture, is proactive, and is willing to accept any challenge. She hopes to expand her social network through beauty pageants and further let people see her inner beauty. On the night of the beauty pageant, her talent show is Latin dance. She hopes to show her best side and asks everyone to vote for her. In fact, there are many candidates voting for her on the Internet, and she is currently one of the most popular winners. No. 7 Lin Yi was born in Alberta and grew up in Beijing. She has an innocent appearance and is currently in her third year at Honshu University, majoring in civil engineering, specializing in environmental transportation and bridge design. Her dream is to build a world-class project like the Golden Gate Bridge. Her favorite quote: Don’t give up before you try. She enjoys helping others and often volunteers at the hospital. She likes to play the piano and flute, and enjoys the joy and warmth brought by her family in the ensemble. If you want more information, you can visit the Arizona Chinese community website www.sunbirdarizona.com. Currently, there have been nearly 100,000 clicks and over 10,000 valid votes cast for the beauties. The Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant has attracted world attention and set a historical record for the Overseas Chinese Federation pageant. I hope everyone will participate in the voting and enthusiastically buy tickets to watch the Phoenix Chinese celebrate the National Day and beauty pageant on July 4th! The beauties are volunteering at Public Television No. 8, from left to right: No. 6 Cheng Shiyi, No. 5 Chen Yian, No. 4 Liu Zhaoci, Zhou Chang (2010 champion), No. 1 Yang Zhongting, No. 3 Hu Qiuzi, No. 2 Gao Jiawei

b6213d10505bcb63d7b6daa0805319d8ffd8a4a6.sourceText: 全美最准时机场 空港机场榜上有名 您可曾有过在机场候机时漫长等待的痛苦经验？在搭机的过程中，乘客除了要预留进出机场的时间，也要忍受等待转机的时间，但最令人诟病的莫过于漫长的航班延误时间。 据聪明旅游网站(smartertravel.com)报导，最新出刊的《旅行休闲指南》(Travel + Leisure)统计了全美航班延误最佳和最差的机场。值得注意的是，即使在西雅图的西雅图-塔科玛机场(Sea-Tac Airport)，荣获今年最准点服务的机场，也有13.1％的航班被延误。不过，这比最差的芝加哥米德韦(Chicago Midway)机场的30％航班延误率好太多了。凤凰城天港(Sky Harbor)国际机场忝陪最佳机场之一。 该指南还罗列出一天中各机场飞行的最好和最坏的时间。这佐证了越早飞行越好的经验法则。在某些情况下真的很早，在芝加哥奥黑尔(O’Hare)机场，准时飞行的最佳时间是上午7时前。 在许多情况下，一个城市同时拥有名单中最差和最佳的机场。例如华盛顿特区，BWI机场是在该国机场延误中排名倒数第二。但是，杜勒斯国际机场（Dulles International Airport）和里根国际机场在准时这一项中，都排在前五名。 以下是十大最差延误机场：1.芝加哥米德韦机场，2.巴尔的摩/华盛顿国际机场，3.旧金山国际机场，4.拉斯维加斯麦卡伦(McCarran)国际机场，5.纽约市约翰肯尼迪国际机场，6.纽瓦克(Newark)国际机场，7.芝加哥奥黑尔机场，8.迈阿密国际机场，9.丹佛(Denver)国际机场，10哈兹菲尔德-杰克逊(Hartsfield-Jackson)亚特兰大国际机场。 以下则是十大最佳准时机场：1.西雅图-塔科玛机场，2.波特兰国际机场，3. 华盛顿特区里根国家机场，4.盐湖城国际机场，5.华盛顿特区杜勒斯国际机场，6.坦帕(Tampa)国际机场，7. 休斯顿乔治布什国际机场，8. 纽约市拉瓜迪亚(LaGuardia)机场，9.夏洛特道格拉斯国际机场，10.凤凰城天港(Sky Harbor)国际机场。
b6213d10505bcb63d7b6daa0805319d8ffd8a4a6.translatedText: The most punctual airport in the U.S. Airport Airport is on the list Have you ever had the painful experience of waiting for a long time at the airport? During the flight, passengers not only have to reserve time to enter and exit the airport, but also have to endure the waiting time for connecting flights. But the most criticized thing is the long flight delay time. According to smartertravel.com, the latest edition of Travel + Leisure has compiled statistics on the airports with the best and worst flight delays in the United States. It’s worth noting that even at Seattle’s Sea-Tac Airport, this year’s winner for on-time service, 13.1% of flights were delayed. Still, that's much better than the 30% delay rate at Chicago Midway, the worst airport. Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport is one of the best airports. The guide also lists the best and worst times of day to fly from each airport. This supports the rule of thumb that the sooner you fly, the better. It’s really early in some cases, and at Chicago O’Hare, the best time to fly on time is before 7 a.m. In many cases, a city has both the worst and best airports on the list. For example, in Washington, D.C., BWI Airport ranks second to last in terms of airport delays in the country. However, Dulles International Airport and Reagan International Airport both ranked in the top five for punctuality. Here are the ten worst airports for delays: 1. Chicago Midway, 2. Baltimore/Washington International, 3. San Francisco International, 4. McCarran International, Las Vegas, 5. New York City's John F. Kennedy International, 6. Newark, 7. Chicago O'Hare, 8. Miami International, 9. Denver International, 10. Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International. The following are the ten best on-time airports: 1. Seattle-Tacoma Airport, 2. Portland International Airport, 3. Washington, D.C. Reagan National Airport, 4. Salt Lake City International Airport, 5. Washington, D.C. Dulles International Airport, 6. Tampa International Airport, 7. Houston George Bush International Airport, 8. New York City LaGuardia Airport, 9. Charlotte Douglas International Airport, 10. 3908dd5f63fb41265cbd32d393b82f8b07c66b1c.sourceText: 文化大革命十年浩劫，结束至今近四十载。家藏名人书画、珍贵古玩，文革中屡遭红卫兵’破四旧’、抄家，早已荡然无存。不久前，在劫后有馀的杂物中，竟发现一幅未裱国画，题赠故叔祖父唐文铭先生。于是请人精工装裱之后，一幅陈摩题款、雪莾作画的仕女图赫然眼前。 癸已年（1943年），在画作上题款的，是中国近代画家陈摩。陈摩（1886年-1945年），字迦盦，别号迦蓝陀，江苏常熟人。清末民初着名画家陆恢弟子，得其笔法，山水、花卉、翎毛、蔬果，挥洒自如，所作花鸟，名重一时。陈摩用笔撷取吴昌硕篆籀之笔及赵悲庵鈎勒之法。 陈摩题款全文如下： 是帧係雪莾先生盛年之作，笔墨秀逸，雅韵欲流，真能洗涤凡尘也。兆镇先生出示，属题为书数语，以志墨缘。 癸已九秋 涵盖 陈摩为 文铭先生记
3908dd5f63fb41265cbd32d393b82f8b07c66b1c.translatedText: The ten-year catastrophe of the Cultural Revolution ended nearly 40 years ago. The family's collection of paintings and calligraphy by famous people and precious antiques have long been gone, as the Red Guards repeatedly 'destroyed the Four Olds' and ransacked their homes during the Cultural Revolution. Not long ago, among the debris left over from the disaster, an unmounted Chinese painting was discovered, which was inscribed as a gift to my late uncle, Mr. Tang Wenming. So after having someone carefully frame it, a picture of a lady inscribed by Chen Mo and painted by Xue Fu came to mind. In the year of Gui Ji (1943), the person who inscribed the painting was Chen Mo, a modern Chinese painter. Chen Mo (1886-1945), also known as Jiayu, also known as Jialantao, was born in Changshu, Jiangsu Province. He was a disciple of Lu Hui, a famous painter in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, and acquired his brushwork. He could freely express landscapes, flowers, feathers, fruits and vegetables, and his paintings of flowers and birds were famous for a while. Chen Mo used his pen to capture Wu Changshuo's seal writing style and Zhao Bei'an's hooking method. The full text of Chen Mo's inscription is as follows: This frame is the work of Mr. Xue Fu in his prime years. The pen and ink are elegant and graceful, and it can really wash away the worldly world. Mr. Zhaozhen showed it, and it was titled Shu Shushu Yuan. Guiji Jiuqiu covers Chen Mowei. Mr. Wen Ming remembered

dd092d4c9c8770cddb31fd94c6eb5b1c7e4fd3f1.sourceText: 雪莾的这幅仕女图，画高髻仕女，长袖遮手，端坐在石鼓凳上，腊梅树旁，背景为一处庭院。仕女身穿朱色衣裳，右手低垂，左手抬起齐眉。面目清秀，体态苗条，举止安详，头部勾勒晕染匀淨，似名门千金。 画脸流丽圆畅，而衣裙则以飘举方折之笔出之。设色浅澹清雅，人物髮髻扎带，用澹蓝色。朱色衣裳配上澹蓝色为底的衣领，与髮髻扎带呼应。朱色上衣与素色长裙，又两相映衬，使画中人愈加显得明丽可人。 这幅仕女图，实为同类绘画中不可多得之佳作。
dd092d4c9c8770cddb31fd94c6eb5b1c7e4fd3f1.translatedText: this painting of a lady in Xue Fu. It depicts a lady with a high bun, long sleeves covering her hands, sitting on a stone drum stool, next to a wintersweet tree, with a courtyard in the background. The lady is wearing red clothes, her right hand is lowered, and her left hand is raised to the level of her eyebrows. She has a delicate face, a slender body, a calm demeanor, and a neatly outlined head, making her look like a daughter of a famous family. The face is smooth and round, while the clothes are drawn with a floating and square stroke. The color is light and elegant, and the character's hair is tied in a bland blue. The red clothes are paired with a light blue collar, which echoes the hair tie. The vermilion top and plain skirt complement each other, making the person in the painting look even more beautiful and lovely. This painting of a lady is truly a rare masterpiece of its kind.

5a891fa8875d136319a0cc1e252b82fe1c620580.translatedText: It has been concluded by archaeologists and historians that there were cats first and then humans on the earth. Dozens of major changes in the earth's crust caused batches of ancient animals on land and sea to become extinct. Only cats survived. Cats' miraculous ability to survive is the only one in ancient times that is astonishing. Cats have an extraordinary and unique tenderness as well as an arrogant and noble demeanor inherent in their nature. The unusual personality of cats has made people adore and love them for thousands of years. Until the ancient Egyptians five thousand years ago promoted her to the status of "god". 793770e49ecd3e68ff448934edd56a6f491c0223.sourceText: 陈普博士讲座：从书法看中国文化 由陈普博士主持的绿洲文教，多年来一直致力于中国传统文化的传承与发扬，在亚省华人社区有着深入而广泛的影响。目前，绿洲文教将推出”陈普谈文化教育”系列讲座，以服务社区和活跃我们的文化生活。本期讲座陈普老师将从中国书法艺术的角度来与大家分享中国传统文化的审美与情趣。 讲座主题：《从书法看中国文化》 主讲人 ：陈普博士 讲座时间：4月13日周六，1:00-3:00pm 讲座地点：希望中文学校 即：美莎社区大学（MCC）

Oasis Culture and Education, chaired by Dr. Chen Pu, has been committed to the inheritance and development of traditional Chinese culture for many years, and has a deep and extensive influence on the Chinese community in Alberta. Currently, Oasis Culture and Education will launch the "Chen Pu Talks on Culture and Education" lecture series to serve the community and activate our cultural life. In this lecture, Mr. Chen Pu will share with you the aesthetics and taste of traditional Chinese culture from the perspective of Chinese calligraphy art. Lecture topic: "Looking at Chinese Culture through Calligraphy" Speaker: Dr. Chen Pu Lecture time: Saturday, April 13, 1:00-3:00pm Lecture location: Hope Chinese School, namely: Mesa Community College (MCC)

62d1f019cc84a7163def70d8a3f429087e4c229c.sourceText: 太阳鸟纪事（二）- 我们四只老天鹅（图） 四天鹅之一张元利供稿 有人说海外生活常在”物质天堂/文化沙漠”中穿行。这是我们许多生活在美国的华人的共同感受。 而新东方艺术学校却为这文化的沙漠注入了一股清泉。 在今年1月21日由新东方艺术学校等单位举办的《亚省春节晚会》上，我们四只老天鹅成为了这股清泉中的一滴水，一不留神在春晚的大舞台上，把上千的中外朋友给’艺术’了一把，让大家见笑了，在这谢谢您的捧场。晚会结束后，我们收到了社会和亲朋好友的祝贺和鼓励，笑谈中数月的排练过程，我们感慨万千。 张元利：”大幕落下，浮想联翩，年轻的时候曾在宣传队等”文艺团体”演出过，来美20年了，没想到以’小天鹅’一角重返舞台，舞蹈不同但舞台很亲切，让我不但找回了曾经的记忆，又丰富了业余文化生活，之前几个月在新东方艺术学校的秘密排练，切磋，一招一式的练习，我们都忘记了自己可能都快步入老天鹅的行列了，学舞让人从头到脚的步入了青春状态，人就是要活的快快乐乐的，才能越来越年轻。” 陈志钢：”我演变脸，大家都知道，通过跳’小天鹅’更加提高了自己的舞台表现力和表演水平。舞蹈教室里邱老师教舞蹈的基本功，教我们小天鹅的舞蹈动作，从中我们体会到许多形体造型，艺术的表演技巧，从另一个角度理解形体动作的塑造力，表现力。收获大大的，收益非浅啊。” 张卫东：”我是平均年龄50岁的四天鹅中年龄最小嫩的，跟小时候学过武术有关，舞蹈动作还有点矫健，平生第一次上舞台，披挂上阵一身清醇的天鹅服装，优美，真诚的’高难度’《天鹅湖》舞蹈片段，感谢几位老大哥的通力合作，感谢新东方艺术学校给我们的平台，让我们得以在1500位观众面前展示，给您节日的生活添上几分欢乐和轻松。” 彭波：”开始接到要排男生舞蹈任务的时候还没有’天鹅’这个节目，是后来主办方考虑到春晚的娱乐性，我们的观众一半是听不懂中国话的，借鉴小品相声等语言类搞笑节目显然不行，晚会的总导演刘洛宏先生想出这个节目，目的是大过年的要让大家笑，欢欢乐乐中国年吗。导演还独出心裁的把我们的节目放在小朋友的节目当中，形成巨大的反差，果然，我们四只小天鹅一出场，观众一片大笑声。这次的经历，不仅使自己发现了原来还能跳这麽”高难度”的舞蹈，还将体重减少了8磅。想减肥的朋友，这可是一个非常好的方法哟，立竿见影”。 我们四只”小天鹅”，诚挚邀请更多的朋友加入我们学舞蹈的行列，锻炼身体，陶冶情操，为给他人带来欢乐，为中华文化的发扬光大。殷切盼望亚利桑那州的春节晚会继续办下去，而且越办越红火。新东方艺术学校这股中国文化艺术的清泉，源源不断的流淌，滋润在美华人生活的文化沙漠。 人在北美，勤到泉边汲水。
62d1f019cc84a7163def70d8a3f429087e4c229c.translatedText: Chronicle of the Sunbird (2) - Our four old swans (picture) Contributed by Zhang Yuanli, one of the four swans Some people say that life abroad is often lived in a "material paradise/cultural desert". This is a common feeling among many Chinese living in the United States, but New Oriental Art School has injected a spring into this cultural desert. At the "Alberta Spring Festival Gala" organized by New Oriental Art School and other units on January 21 this year, our four old swans became a drop of water in this spring. We accidentally gave thousands of Chinese and foreign friends a try on the big stage of the Spring Festival Gala, making everyone laugh. Thank you for your support. After the party, we received congratulations and encouragement from the society, relatives and friends, and we were filled with emotion during the months of rehearsal process. Zhang Yuanli: "As the curtain fell, my imagination began to wander. When I was young, I performed in a publicity team and other "artistic groups." I have been in the United States for 20 years, and I didn't expect to return to the stage as "Little Swan." The dance was different but the stage was very friendly. It not only allowed me to regain my past memories, but also enriched my amateur culture. In life, during the past few months of secret rehearsals, competitions, and practice of every move at the New Oriental Art School, we all forgot that we may have almost entered the ranks of the old swans. Learning to dance puts people in a state of youth from head to toe. People must live happily to become younger and younger. ” Chen Zhigang: “Everyone knows that I changed my face and improved my stage performance and performance level by dancing ‘Little Swan’. In the dance classroom, Teacher Qiu teaches us the basic skills of dance and the dance movements of the little swan, from which we experience many body shapes and artistic performance skills, and understand the shaping and expressive power of body movements from another perspective. The harvest is huge and the benefits are not small. " Zhang Weidong: "I am the youngest among the four swans with an average age of 50 years old. I learned martial arts when I was a child, and my dance moves are a bit vigorous. It was the first time in my life that I went on stage, dressed in a pure swan costume, and performed a beautiful and sincere 'difficult' dance sequence of "Swan Lake". Thank you to several big brothers for their cooperation, and to New Oriental Art School for giving us a platform that allows us to show in front of 1,500 audiences, adding a bit of joy and relaxation to your holiday life." Peng Bo: "When I first received the task of arranging the boys' dance, there was no "Swan" program. Later, the organizer considered the entertainment of the Spring Festival Gala. Half of our audience did not understand Chinese. It was obviously not possible to borrow comedy programs such as sketches and cross talk. Mr. Liu Luohong, the general director of the party, came up with this program. The purpose is to make everyone laugh during the New Year and have a happy Chinese New Year. The director also creatively placed our program among the children's programs, creating a huge contrast. Sure enough, as soon as our four little swans appeared on the stage, the audience burst into laughter. This experience not only made me discover that I could dance such a "difficult" dance, but also reduced my weight by 8 pounds. Friends who want to lose weight, this is a very good method, and you will see immediate results." We four "little swans" sincerely invite more friends to join us in learning dance, exercising their bodies, cultivating their sentiments, bringing joy to others, and promoting Chinese culture. We sincerely hope that the Spring Festival Gala in Arizona will continue to be held and become more and more prosperous. The New Oriental Art School, a spring of Chinese culture and art, will continue to flow and nourish the cultural desert where Chinese people live in the United States. People in North America should go to the spring to draw water.

4f6aebed37faece4912ca07b16589b3e7323926f.sourceText: 中新社华盛顿12月22日电 (记者 刁海洋)美国总统特朗普22日在白宫签署了美国会送交的《减税和就业法案》，如期送出了自己承诺给美国人的”圣诞大礼”。
4f6aebed37faece4912ca07b16589b3e7323926f.translatedText: China News Service, Washington, December 22 (Reporter) Diao Haiyang) U.S. President Trump signed the "Tax Cuts and Jobs Act" sent by the U.S. Congress at the White House on the 22nd, delivering the "Christmas gift" he promised to Americans as scheduled.

d8610ba4955d015a18c0292793af2ebd3622b0dc.sourceText: 特朗普说，税改法案生效后，美国家庭将获得3.2万亿美元的减税。企业所得税率将从35%降至21%。这意味着更多商品将在美国生产，更多公司将选择留在美国。他还表示，预计将有4万亿美元的资本从海外回流。
d8610ba4955d015a18c0292793af2ebd3622b0dc.translatedText: Trump said that after the tax reform bill takes effect, American families will receive $3.2 trillion in tax cuts. The corporate income tax rate will be reduced from 35% to 21%. This means more goods will be produced in the United States and more companies will choose to stay in the United States. He also said that US$4 trillion of capital is expected to flow back from overseas.

5c314994b0ebe38e305603283fffe4b574e068d5.sourceText: 《减税和就业法案》于本月20日在美国会参众两院表决通过。在特朗普签署生效后，该法案将于2018年1月开始实施，大部分美国家庭将从2018年2月起享受到减税带来的好处。
5c314994b0ebe38e305603283fffe4b574e068d5.translatedText: The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act was voted by the U.S. House of Representatives and the Senate on the 20th of this month. After Trump signs it into effect, the bill will be implemented in January 2018, and most American families will enjoy the benefits of tax cuts starting in February 2018.

0d57fd49577d20428b85514360897b3e4016f95d.sourceText: 特朗普22日还签署了一份价值40亿美元的导弹防御系统采购计划。
0d57fd49577d20428b85514360897b3e4016f95d.translatedText: Trump also signed a missile defense system procurement plan worth US$4 billion on the 22nd.

1de5d3e7331da57d9c12e9db02293ab8279a0814.sourceText: 在回答记者有关基础设施建设的提问时，特朗普表示，基础设施建设不是一件难事。他说，由于许多民主党人已表态支持扩大基础设施建设，因此相关事项很容易得到推动和落实。
1de5d3e7331da57d9c12e9db02293ab8279a0814.translatedText: When answering reporters’ questions about infrastructure construction, Trump said that infrastructure construction is not a difficult task. He said that because many Democrats have expressed support for expanding infrastructure construction, related matters can be easily promoted and implemented.

8791b17c368ee3399eb0d43a5326a72f78ae2cb9.sourceText: 当被问及2017年有哪些收获时，特朗普表示，学会与国会打交道是他执政首年的一项重要收获。他说，自己在就任之初并不懂如何与参众两院议员们打交道，但现在他已经与很多议员成为了朋友，对立法程序有了更多了解。(完)
8791b17c368ee3399eb0d43a5326a72f78ae2cb9.translatedText: When asked what he gained in 2017, Trump said that learning to deal with Congress was an important gain in his first year in office. He said that he did not know how to deal with members of the House and Senate when he first took office, but now he has become friends with many members and has a better understanding of the legislative process. (over)

64c6e76a7be751b25cd9a1d18b0ab5a89024fa49.sourceText: 张肇鸿：环保菜园多创意（图） 凤凰城 张肇鸿 很多华人家庭后院都有菜园子，我们也有，而且是一个既环保又有创…
64c6e76a7be751b25cd9a1d18b0ab5a89024fa49.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: The environmentally friendly vegetable garden is full of creativity (pictures) Phoenix City Zhang Zhaohong Many Chinese families have vegetable gardens in their backyards, and we also have one, and it is an environmentally friendly and creative one...

e4eca5021538a88b4ec394d3abd80bad9958de3c.sourceText: 很多华人家庭后院都有菜园子，我们也有，而且是一个既环保又有创意的菜园子，只用家中原本浪费掉的水资源，就可种出天然鲜嫩的蔬菜！
e4eca5021538a88b4ec394d3abd80bad9958de3c.translatedText: Many Chinese families have a vegetable garden in their backyards, and we also have one, and it is an environmentally friendly and creative vegetable garden. We only use the water resources that are originally wasted at home to grow natural and tender vegetables!

193e68b11d8092a75aa7a44e1022b588575fa52f.sourceText: 我家的菜园子原来是片草地，要淋水、施肥、铲草，周而复始。直到去年，我们把草地改为菜地，设计时在四周铺上一圈方砖，用来晨运锻鍊，中间留出一块长方形的地，在其中用砖摆设了一个空心的”中”字，以便给菜苗松土、浇水和採摘。
193e68b11d8092a75aa7a44e1022b588575fa52f.translatedText: My vegetable garden used to be a grassland, which required watering, fertilizing, and weeding, over and over again. Until last year, we changed the grassland into a vegetable plot. During the design, we laid a circle of square bricks around it for morning exercise, and left a rectangular area in the middle, with a hollow "中" character placed in the bricks to facilitate loosening, watering and picking of vegetable seedlings.

ad5a840ac7ee0f97938c4625984741d3df1aee19.sourceText: 人们说十月是收获季节，天气渐转凉。我们却选择这时下菜种，是因为亚利桑那州的夏天太热，冬天却很暖和，适应很多蔬菜生长。我们把菜地分成五小块，每隔一星期下菜种一块，让菜苗先后出土，这样就错开了收获期，保持长期有鲜嫩蔬菜的收成。
ad5a840ac7ee0f97938c4625984741d3df1aee19.translatedText: People say that October is the harvest season and the weather is getting cooler. We chose to plant vegetables at this time because the summers in Arizona are too hot but the winters are very mild, which is suitable for the growth of many vegetables. We divided the vegetable plot into five small plots and planted one plot every other week so that the vegetable seedlings could be unearthed one after another. This way we staggered the harvest period and maintained a long-term harvest of fresh and tender vegetables.

6c8b3281d2eb72e382ea932e3aa1983ff4a2f854.sourceText: 下菜种前，我们把各样的种子，有白菜，油菜、芥菜，菠菜，茼蒿，白菜心等菜种溷杂起来，一点点地放进一个盘中，同时也将有机肥(Steer Manure 俗称牛粪灰)一把把地放入搅伴均匀，最后合成一大盘菜种与肥料的溷合料。
6c8b3281d2eb72e382ea932e3aa1983ff4a2f854.translatedText: Before planting vegetables, we mixed various seeds, including cabbage, rape, mustard, spinach, chrysanthemum, cabbage heart and other vegetable seeds, and put them into a plate little by little. At the same time, we also put organic fertilizer (Steer Manure, commonly known as cow dung ash) in handfuls and stirred evenly, and finally synthesized a large plate of mixed vegetable seeds and fertilizer.

2e1c09d31fc810d72462d887e993525406352b8f.sourceText: 把菜地锄松耙细后，加上有机肥掺合，再淋上水，过夜就能下菜种了。因为菜种溷合肥料的颜色较土壤深色，所以播种时可看到分佈是否均匀。播完种后，还要小心地用花洒浇一遍水，另外，为防止有小鸟来叮食肥料，在周边要挂上几个随风摇曳CD光盘来赶吓小鸟。以后只需每日浇水，每周施些牛粪灰或田园用的氮磷钾溷合肥料(用水稀释)，两个月后，就有了第一次可喜的收获。
2e1c09d31fc810d72462d887e993525406352b8f.translatedText: Hoe and rake the vegetable field, add organic fertilizer and mix it, then pour water on it, and you can plant vegetables overnight. Because the color of mixed fertilizer for vegetable seeds is darker than that of soil, you can see whether the fertilizer is evenly distributed when sowing. After sowing the seeds, carefully water them with a shower head. In addition, in order to prevent birds from eating the fertilizer, hang a few CDs swaying in the wind to scare away the birds. From now on, you only need to water it every day and apply some cow dung ash or a nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium fertilizer for garden use (diluted with water) every week. After two months, you will have your first gratifying harvest.

262731e3449767f962b30f89e65d18ab9c089929.sourceText: 菜苗逐渐长大，需要的水量也日益增加，由于水资源宝贵，我们採用环保用水方法。其一，是把水循序利用：家居厨房都有两个水槽(Sink)，用过的水都从下水道流走了，我们把其中一个用来洗有清洁剂成分的水槽，这部分的水要流进下水道；另一水槽用于盛较干净的水，如洗米、洗蔬菜水果、洗盘碗茶具的水是可回收用的。把水槽下方的水管改动一下，接一个弯管作”水封”后，用根管子通出后院(我们的厨房和后院是一牆之隔)。这样，每天就有了二、三十加仑的水可以用了。
262731e3449767f962b30f89e65d18ab9c089929.translatedText: As the vegetable seedlings grow older, the amount of water they need also increases. Since water resources are precious, we use environmentally friendly water methods. One is to use water sequentially: every home kitchen has two sinks (Sink), and the used water flows away from the sewer. We use one of them to wash the sink containing detergent ingredients, and this part of the water flows into the sewer; the other sink is used to hold cleaner water, such as washing rice, washing vegetables and fruits, and washing dishes, bowls and tea sets. The water can be recycled. Modify the water pipe under the sink, connect a bend to make a "water seal", and use a pipe to lead out to the backyard (our kitchen and the backyard are separated by a wall). In this way, there are twenty to thirty gallons of water available every day.

2d5e0c8325b5b57ae1c2ceb176392f421c450c86.sourceText: 其二，是我们家装有滤水器，但滤水器是很浪费水源的，每过滤一加仑饮用水，便需要用近十倍的自来水，这些水也流入下水道浪费了。我们把滤水器中通到下水道小胶管改为通出外面，这部分的水每天也有十加仑，我们用一大盘来盛这些清水，并把盘子稍为倾斜放置，如水满时，可自动溢出到下面的西洋菜水洼中，再满时又可流至唐芹菜盘子。这样，只要每天把上面这两大盘的水源回收起来，就足够用于浇灌菜园子了。
2d5e0c8325b5b57ae1c2ceb176392f421c450c86.translatedText: Secondly, we have a water filter in our home, but the water filter is a waste of water. For every gallon of drinking water filtered, nearly ten times the tap water is used, and this water also flows into the sewer and is wasted. We changed the small rubber hose from the water filter to the sewer to the outside. This part of the water is also ten gallons per day. We use a large plate to hold the clean water, and place the plate slightly tilted. When the water is full, it will automatically overflow into the watercress puddle below, and when it is full again, it will flow to the celery plate. In this way, as long as the water from the two large trays above is recycled every day, it will be enough to water the vegetable garden.

e375bf9790a4d48ba53cf952d9e20ef7adc83a2b.sourceText: 环保除了开源，还要节流。即使在冬季，凤凰城的阳光有时还是很火热的，为避免菜地中的水份过度蒸发，我们给菜园子设置了木框架，并在上面放上被弃置的纱窗，以减低阳光的照射，这样，不但可延缓蔬菜的生长，拉长收获期，而且种出来的蔬菜也很鲜嫩。另外，在冬季寒潮袭来时，清晨温度也有低于摄时零度的时候，甚至可以冻死花草树木。我们根据天气预报，在必要时盖上塑料布或纸板以防冻害。
e375bf9790a4d48ba53cf952d9e20ef7adc83a2b.translatedText: In addition to increasing revenue, environmental protection also requires cutting expenditure. Even in winter, the sunshine in Phoenix is ​​sometimes very hot. In order to prevent excessive evaporation of water in the vegetable field, we set up a wooden frame for the vegetable garden and put discarded screens on it to reduce the sunlight. This not only slows down the growth of vegetables and prolongs the harvest period, but also makes the vegetables grown very fresh and tender. In addition, when the cold wave hits in winter, the temperature in the early morning may be lower than zero at the time of shooting, which can even freeze flowers, plants and trees to death. Based on the weather forecast, we cover with plastic sheets or cardboard when necessary to prevent freezing damage.

c59db748dd0e682707d85cb90ccd189143c95ded.sourceText: 除了屋后的菜园子外，我们在屋子一侧也开辟出一些地方种上不同的蔬果和植物，其中有西洋菜、雪豆、葱蒜、辣椒、枸杞和芹菜等。因为有围牆挡住阳光，所以围牆下的雪豆生长较慢。因此，我们就设法去增加日光的照射。
c59db748dd0e682707d85cb90ccd189143c95ded.translatedText: In addition to the vegetable garden behind the house, we have also opened up some areas on the side of the house to plant different fruits, vegetables and plants, including watercress, snow peas, onions and garlic, peppers, wolfberries, celery, etc. Because the fence blocks sunlight, the snow peas under the fence grow more slowly. Therefore, we try to increase sunlight exposure.

f069d96f552d35105328c0cd56a656cc2f17c37f.sourceText: 我们在较高的屋檐上装上改良后的卫星碟形天缐，并把它濆上白油漆，用它来反射阳光，又在雪豆背后的围牆上，放置白色的篱笆，用来反射光缐；还在牆上安置了活动支架，根据雪豆生长情况，结下绳网让其爬藤，并勤施肥料，让雪豆长成茎粗叶绿。
f069d96f552d35105328c0cd56a656cc2f17c37f.translatedText: We installed an improved satellite dish-shaped canopy on the higher eaves and painted it with white paint to reflect the sunlight. We also placed a white fence on the wall behind the snow peas to reflect the light. We also installed movable brackets on the wall. According to the growth of the snow peas, we tied a rope net to let it climb. We also applied fertilizer frequently to make the snow peas grow into thick stems and green leaves.

1c390ec17135c02c6d3343c01b2771cdfbb990d1.sourceText: 现在，雪豆已经长成人般高了，并开出了奼紫嫣红的花朵，也结出了雪豆，而茎叶仍在生长中，相信开花时期会有一段长期间，更高兴的是，从厨窗望出来就是这些红花绿叶，令人心旷神怡。比起以前自动浇溉的草地，现在的菜园子不但节约用水，而且还有了蔬菜收成，不用常到很远的华人超市了，减少了汽车的二氧化碳棑放，想不到菜园子对环保还有不少的贡献呢！
1c390ec17135c02c6d3343c01b2771cdfbb990d1.translatedText: Now, the snow peas have grown as tall as a human, and have bloomed colorful flowers and produced snow peas. The stems and leaves are still growing. I believe the flowering period will last for a long time. What is even more gratifying is that you can see these red flowers and green leaves from the kitchen window, which is refreshing. Compared with the automatically irrigated grassland in the past, today's vegetable gardens not only save water, but also produce vegetable harvests. There is no need to go to Chinese supermarkets far away, and the carbon dioxide emissions of cars are reduced. Unexpectedly, vegetable gardens have a lot of contributions to environmental protection!

1311ffd4c3c4cf4126aa9d04abd2b9e24987cb27.sourceText: 有了菜园子，家居环境也变得美丽了。早晨打开窗户，不但可看到泳池中的一泓清彻，在蓝天白云之下，还有一片绿油油的蔬菜映入眼帘，真是美不可言。菜园子让我们热爱生活，乐意出去活动和欣赏，晨运时围绕着菜园慢跑很惬意，每天做田园活并不觉累，还激发起我们的无限创意，生活充实和愉快！现每逢到了回暖天气，整个菜园都是金花灿烂，蜜蜂飞舞。种出来的菜吃不完，就送给亲朋好友，或邀请来家中聚会，开派对，打边炉，还可即摘即洗即炒呢！菜园子让我们都市人也能体会到农家乐趣， 并可品嚐到亲手种植出来的有机蔬菜！
1311ffd4c3c4cf4126aa9d04abd2b9e24987cb27.translatedText: With a vegetable garden, your home environment becomes more beautiful. When you open the window in the morning, you can not only see the clear water in the swimming pool, but also a field of green vegetables under the blue sky and white clouds. It is really beautiful. The vegetable garden makes us love life and be willing to go out for activities and appreciation. It is very pleasant to jog around the vegetable garden during morning exercise. We do not feel tired doing farm work every day. It also stimulates our infinite creativity, making life fulfilling and enjoyable! Now every time the weather gets warmer, the entire vegetable garden is filled with golden flowers and bees flying around. If you can’t finish the vegetables you grow, you can give them to your relatives and friends, or invite them to your home for a party and cook them on the stove. You can pick them, wash them and fry them! The vegetable garden allows us urbanites to experience the fun of farming and taste organic vegetables grown by ourselves!

6dde22326f2db4f16fb907f2fb8d02112eccc1b2.sourceText: 亚利桑那州凤凰城一栋综合商业大楼裡发生一起枪击桉，图为枪桉发生现场外救护车等待救援。美联社
6dde22326f2db4f16fb907f2fb8d02112eccc1b2.translatedText: A shooting occurred in a commercial complex in Phoenix, Arizona. The picture shows an ambulance waiting for rescue outside the scene of the shooting. The Associated Press

8869e3e019d8912410e2fece8ac6106e47d10098.sourceText: 根据亚利桑那州凤凰城警方表示，在距离16街和格伦代尔(Glendale)大道附近的一栋综合商业大楼裡发生一起枪击桉，该枪击桉造成很多人受伤。 根据凤凰城警方发言人Tommy Thompson表示，枪击桉发生在当地时间上午10点半。目击者告诉3TV 记者Kristine Harrington，该枪击桉发生在这栋三层楼高的一楼大厅，有其他目击者表示听到6到7声枪响，有人说可能多达10声。
8869e3e019d8912410e2fece8ac6106e47d10098.translatedText: According to police in Phoenix, Arizona, a shooting occurred in a commercial complex near 16th Street and Glendale Avenue, injuring many people. According to Phoenix police spokesman Tommy Thompson, the shooting occurred at 10:30 a.m. local time. Witnesses told 3TV reporter Kristine Harrington that the shooting occurred in the first-floor lobby of the three-story building. Other witnesses said they heard 6 to 7 gunshots, and some said there may be as many as 10 gunshots.

e79cd884401bb523c457860c1cdd0dc086e24055.sourceText: 据报导，至少有3人遭到枪伤。警方目前还在查清整个案情，警方已驱散大楼的人和寻找开枪的嫌犯。
e79cd884401bb523c457860c1cdd0dc086e24055.translatedText: According to reports, at least three people suffered gunshot wounds. The police are still investigating the entire case. Police have dispersed people from the building and are looking for the suspect who fired the gun.

92edf291ac1b66c8146e1d4938fa8c875e5b948d.translatedText: Phoenix PEN Hongying: Nature∙Childhood∙Education During the festival, I took my two young children to camp in the countryside. For us adults, it’s a bit asking for trouble...

2076f3241639303f701f27a399aa7beadf0ab9b5.sourceText: 凤凰笔会 鸿鹰：自然∙童年∙教育 节日期间，带着两个稚龄的孩子到乡间山野露营。对我们大人来讲，有点自讨苦吃的味道， 露营地远没有家里的洁净和方便。对于孩子们来说，身处大自然，仿佛身处乐园。路边的一朵不起眼的小花，她们要摘来惊讶一番，辫在我的发际；一粒小石子，也要拣起来，说是水晶宝石，当宝贝一样捂在口袋里；拾松果，看小虫，抓蚯蚓，忙得不亦乐乎。刚开始时，我一会担心她们被晒坏，一会怕她们被虫咬到，又顾虑身上会不会弄得很脏，过了不久，就笑自己愚钝，孩子眼里世界的无限惊奇岂是我这心灵已蒙上灰尘的人看得见的呢？ 我只能搜寻自己的记忆，怀想咂摸一番∙∙∙∙∙∙ 记忆中，大自然对于我，似乎有着无穷的吸引力。有时候，觉得它是森严可怕的，天高月黑，大山里松林间如大海波浪般的涛声阵阵回响，会在幼小的心灵引起战栗；有时候，它是妙趣横生的，脚趾间滋冒的软泥，池塘上雨滴溅起的朵朵水花；有时候，它是神秘的，荒野间神出鬼没的蛇虫，无端燃起的野火；有时候，它是愉悦惹人爱的，朝露含笑的花朵，雨后大片的蘑菇伞∙∙∙∙∙∙不能尽道的大自然！ 而大自然的这一切，和孩子的心灵真是相契相合！一边是无言无语，处处充盈着生命的气息，一边是懵懂顽童，充满着好奇心和童趣。二者都无尘世的沾染，世俗的熏陶，功利的计较。可是， 人长大了，看世界的眼睛也变了。每天都在用有用无用衡量着眼见的一切，计较着利益得失。日出日落，我们熟视无睹，头顶的灿烂星辰引不起我们的惊叹，身边的花开花落也不足以让我们感时伤怀。 真的是感激孩子们将我带回久违的记忆，提醒自己也曾有这样一双看世界的眼睛。当我回首往事，童年里大自然的风景成了我人生记忆里最珍贵最纯美的图画，历久而弥新。大自然似乎诉说着爱是何等的博大深沉，阳光，雨水毫无区别的照耀，滋润着一切的生命。诉说着美是何等的气象万千，山有山的雄浑奇秀，气势磅礴；海有海的波澜壮阔，无涯无际；云有云的气定神闲，飘逸多姿；风有风的飘渺迅急，轻盈柔和∙∙∙∙∙∙也诉说着无限量的创造性和可能性，没有两片树叶是相同的，每一个生命都是绝版的杰作，孤本的精品。人随年龄增长而觉得尘世艰辛时，童年的记忆便如深藏在心灵深处的一口井，滋润着我，让我走在人生的长途上不觉得匮乏。 我们人类向往爱，向往美，崇尚珍贵的创造性。教育的最高境界，便是教导人什么是爱，学会去爱，去体会爱，享受美，表达美。我们真是应该多与自然为友，在孩童尚保有童心时，让他们多有自然的熏陶，懂得什么是自然的美，什么是造物的爱，什么是生命的奇迹和独特。
2076f3241639303f701f27a399aa7beadf0ab9b5.translatedText: Phoenix PEN Hongying: Nature ∙ Childhood ∙ Education During the festival, I took my two young children to camp in the countryside. For us adults, it feels like asking for trouble. The campsite is far less clean and convenient than home. For children, being in nature is like being in paradise. They would pick an inconspicuous little flower on the roadside and be surprised, and braid it in my hair; they would also pick up a small pebble, saying it was a crystal gem, and put it in their pocket like a treasure; they would be busy picking up pine cones, looking at bugs, and catching earthworms. At first, I was worried about them being sunburned, sometimes worried about being bitten by insects, and worried about whether they would get dirty. After a while, I laughed at myself for being stupid. How could the infinite wonder of the world in children's eyes be seen by someone like me whose soul has been covered with dust? I can only search my own memory and smack my memories∙∙∙∙∙∙ In my memory, nature seems to have infinite attraction for me. Sometimes, I think it is forbidding and scary, with the sky high and the moon dark, and the sound of waves echoing through the pine forests in the mountains like the waves of the sea, which will cause tremors in the young hearts; sometimes, it is full of fun, with the soft mud growing between the toes and the splashing of raindrops on the pond. The blossoming water splash; sometimes, it is mysterious, elusive snakes and insects in the wilderness, wildfires ignited for no reason; sometimes, it is pleasant and endearing, flowers smiling in the morning dew, large mushroom umbrellas after the rain∙∙∙∙∙∙The inexhaustible nature! And all these things in nature are really in harmony with the hearts of children! One side is speechless and full of life, and the other side is an ignorant urchin, full of curiosity and childishness. Both are free from earthly contamination, worldly influence, and utilitarian considerations. However, as people grow up, their eyes on the world also change. Every day, I weigh everything I see based on its usefulness and futility, and calculate the gains and losses. We turn a blind eye to the sunrise and sunset. The bright stars above our heads cannot arouse our amazement, and the flowers blooming and falling around us are not enough to make us feel sad. I am really grateful to the children for bringing me back long-lost memories and reminding me that I once had such a pair of eyes to see the world. When I look back on the past, the natural scenery of my childhood has become the most precious and pure and beautiful picture in my life memory, which lasts forever. Nature seems to tell how broad and deep love is. Sunshine and rain shine indiscriminately, nourishing all life. It tells how beauty is diverse, the mountains are majestic and majestic; the sea is magnificent and boundless; the clouds are calm and elegant; the wind is misty, swift, light and soft. As people grow older and feel the hardships of the world, the memories of childhood are like a well hidden deep in the soul, nourishing me and allowing me to walk the long journey of life without feeling lacking. We humans yearn for love, yearn for beauty, and admire precious creativity. The highest state of education is to teach people what love is, learn to love, experience love, enjoy beauty, and express beauty. We really should be more friends with nature. While children still have childlike innocence, let them have more influence from nature and understand what is the beauty of nature, what is the love of creation, and what is the miracle and uniqueness of life.

e5985a23b20fdb6cd57e3a04d38c822e409710dd.translatedText: Sunbird Chronicle: Falling in love with table tennis (photo)

a6f026d6b162aaab7f4a87e8ff214d028964feb0.sourceText: 太阳鸟纪事：爱上乒乓球（图） （左）何乐平 （《亚省时报》 清宝报道…
a6f026d6b162aaab7f4a87e8ff214d028964feb0.translatedText: Sunbird Chronicle: Falling in love with table tennis (photo) (left) He Leping ("Alberta Times" Qingbao report...

673e4a696042e8fc5b8b334e442d1ee098a3094e.sourceText: 太阳鸟纪事：爱上乒乓球（图） （左）何乐平 （《亚省时报》 清宝报道）2013年亚利桑那中国周体育比赛刚刚落下帷幕，老到80多岁的教授，小到刚高出球桌的孩子，都为这个小小的乒乓球而疯狂。这里很多中国人，完全可以理解，因为在中国，从小娃娃开始，大家就在学校的水泥乒乓球台上打闹。谁的童年都多多少少与乒乓球有些关系，所以乒乓球在中国被称做”国球”。可是很多事情也有例外，在这里记者还真遇到了一位从五十多岁才开始碰乒乓球的朋友，他叫何乐平。 乐平是某高校研究员，有一份非常稳定的工作，年轻的时候喜欢篮球，网球。上了年纪后这些运动都不太适合了，觉得乒乓球练眼，练脑，练身体，想来试一试。2005年，他第一次来到了凤凰城乒乓球俱乐部。五十多岁要来学一个新的运动可不是个易事。对于事事都要求做得认真，做好的乐平，就更难。因为第一课需要学的就是”认输”。当技不如人的时候，就得咬着牙硬抗，乐平乐滋滋地指着桌子边那些正在练球的队员说：”我以前都输给他们…..”。认输磨练人的耐性，只有有一个好得心态去接受这个输，才有坚持下去获得赢的可能。乒乓球的第二课是卧薪尝胆，苦练基本功。乒乓球走进了乐平的生活，他在自己家买了乒乓球台，发球机，每天一到两小时训练，还请专业老师做指导。每周到乒乓球俱乐部跟朋友们一起打球成了生活中最大的快乐。这么一练就是几年。乐平感叹”那头两年真是太苦了厖” 2007年乐平第一次参加了业余乒乓球比赛。当时他的USATT积分只有1600（美国乒乓球协会积分制）多，那次比赛乐平发挥很好，一直打到很后面，与多个积分在1900多的选手比赛。在USATT积分比赛中，一般积分相差上百的话，技术上就会有明显的差距。在与一位高水平的比赛，给乐平留下了深刻的印象。当时乐平两负一胜，比赛进入第四局，比分还是非常接近，7平，8平，对方有些着急，希望尽快拿下。乐平心里也在变化，一定要坚持！一定要抗下去！才有机会！对方害怕失误打得保守，老何则抑制对方优势，发挥自己的特点，一分一分的突破。乐平守住了这关键的一局。决胜局开场，他就打得很稳，一开始就领先。对手开始加强攻势，进攻激烈，却还是被乐平稳住。双方再次打到9平。通过前四局的总结，对手的强项是弧圈球，为了控制对方，在这个时候乐平发了一个正手的长球，对方还是回了弧圈，失误！乐平又赢了一分。10比9，乐平继续正手长球，对方一个弧圈，这次的弧圈旋转速度锐减，乐平一个大角度反手，一个直线，对手没有跑到位回球，这个三角形的大变化，给比赛画上了完美的句号！现在与乐平再次谈起这次比赛，感觉比赛就在昨天。乐平说打乒乓球是锻炼身体，可是在比赛过程中这种身体和心里的较量，那才是一场盛宴。当你遇到实力相当或者更强的对手，你一次次地突破对方的防线，赢球得分，那种快乐，你一旦品尝过了，就会终身难忘。 乐平现在几乎每天都还练球，他正在积极准备下一场拉斯维加斯的比赛。爱上乒乓球，不仅是一个运动，更是一个挑战自我的心灵之旅。
673e4a696042e8fc5b8b334e442d1ee098a3094e.translatedText: Sunbird Chronicle: Falling in love with table tennis (photo) (left) He Leping ("Alberta Times") Qingbao Report) The 2013 Arizona China Week Sports Competition has just come to an end. Professors in their 80s and children as young as just above the table are all crazy about this little table tennis ball. It is completely understandable that in China, everyone starts from childhood. Just playing on the school’s cement table tennis table. Everyone’s childhood is related to table tennis, so table tennis is called the “national sport” in China. However, there are exceptions to this. Here, the reporter actually met a friend who only started playing table tennis in his fifties. His name is He Leping. Leping is a researcher at a university and has a very stable job. When he was young, he liked basketball and tennis. As he got older, these sports were no longer suitable. He felt that table tennis could train his eyes, brain and body. In 2005, he came to Phoenix Table Tennis for the first time. Club. It is not easy to learn a new sport when you are over 50 years old. It is even harder to do everything well, because the first lesson you need to learn is to "give up" when you are not as good as others. Leping pointed at the table happily. Some players who were practicing said: "I have lost to them before...". Accepting defeat tests one's patience. Only by having a good attitude to accept this loss can you persist and win. The second lesson of table tennis is to work hard and practice basic skills. He bought a table tennis table and ball machine at his home, trained for one to two hours a day, and hired professional teachers to provide guidance. Playing with friends at the table tennis club every week became the greatest joy in his life. He practiced this for several years and said, "The first two years were really hard." Leping participated in an amateur table tennis competition for the first time in 2007. At that time, his USATT points were only over 1,600 (United States Table Tennis Association points system). Leping performed very well in that competition and played against many players with more than 1,900 points. In a USATT point competition, if there is a difference of hundreds of points, there will be a significant gap in skills. Playing against a high-level player left a deep impression on Leping. At that time, Leping lost two and entered the fourth game. The score was still very close, and the opponent was a little anxious, hoping to win as soon as possible. Leping's heart was also changing, and he had to persist! He was afraid of making mistakes and played conservatively, and used his own characteristics to break through one point. Leping held on to the decisive game and took the lead from the beginning. They started to strengthen their offensive and attacked fiercely, but they were still stopped by Leping. After the summary of the first four games, the opponent's strength was the arc ball. At this time, Leping sent a forehand long ball, and the opponent made a mistake! Leping won another point. 10 to 9, Leping continued to make a long forehand ball, and the opponent's arc speed decreased sharply. Leping made a wide angle backhand, and the opponent did not. Running back to the ball, this big change in the triangle brought the game to a perfect end! Now talking about this game with Leping, it feels like the game was just yesterday. Leping said that playing table tennis is to exercise, but the physical and mental competition during the game is a feast. When you encounter an opponent with equal or stronger strength, you break through the opponent's defense and score again and again. Once you have tasted that kind of joy, you will never forget it. Leping still practices ball almost every day, and he is actively preparing for the next game in Las Vegas. Falling in love with table tennis is not only a sport, but also a spiritual journey to challenge himself.

620d14b5d7578562d5f8969559ca0ea6f383cdf1.sourceText: 新房子的四大优点 新潮 安全 节能 维护低 亚省时报 说起新房子，购屋者往往会联想到一栋新颖设计，现代装饰，最新设备以及处处散发出诱人的”新房子”味道的亮丽建筑。的确，根据全美房屋建造商协会的调查，新房子有如下四大优点： 1.新房子从整体规划到室内布局都能体现当今最新潮流和品味，而且设计更合理、实用。如宽敞的客厅、充足的壁橱、主客分用的洗手间，还有洗碗机、洗衣烘干机等，中央空调系统更是必不可少。现代家庭拥有的各种家用电器越来越多，用途越来越广泛，所以必需的电源插座和电话插头等在室内外都已安装就绪。如果买家对新房子的某些布置或室内装饰有自己的特殊要求，还可以向建造商提出，只需很低的费用，这些要求都可以满足。 2.新房子及其配套设施的安全性能更好。据统计，新房子屋主受火灾而伤亡的机会远远小于居住于旧房子的人们。主要原因在于新房子内的每一层甚至每间房间都装有烟火警报器，它们都通过电路彼此相连，只要有一个被引发，它们全都会发出警报讯号。而且它们都配有备用电池，应付万一室内电路出现故障时之需。 由于大多数新房子都是由中央空调提供暖气，因而杜绝了因为电子取暖器和窗式空调机出现故障而引发的灾难。同时建造商业提高了整栋房子电路的设计标准，以符合现代家庭的用电要求。当局部电路超载时，该系统会自动切断该部分的供电，而保证室内其他电器正常工作，不会出现电阻丝烧断时整栋房子处于一片黑暗的困境。 另外，新房子内安装的玻璃，特别是落地大窗和玻璃拉门等，都经过特别强化处理，打破后只会粉碎成细屑而不是尖角的碎片。而且，所有对人体健康产生不良影响的建材，如石棉，含铅的油漆和发出甲醛气味的木板等，都被禁止使用。 3.新房子的主人能节省不少用于能源的开支。近几年来，联邦政府能源、环境部门在节省能源和保护环境方面，促使建造商使用较高档次的建材和配件。新建房屋基本上都装上了带有双层玻璃的窗户，以防止室内冷暖气流失。新颖的建材能够较好地隔绝来自于室外的噪音，阻止由于室内外温差引起的水气进入室内，形成水滴而危害墙面。还有能定时定量的中央空调系统等。这些充满现代理念的设计和建造，使得拥有新房子的能源开支比二三十年的老房子少很多。 4.新房子有品质担保，维修费用较低。新屋建造商或是直接提供房屋品质担保，或是通过向保险公司购买保险来提供类似的保证，一般在十年内出现的建筑上的缺陷都可以得到赔偿。在新房子出售后的头二、三年里，房内的许多配套设施，如地毯、空调系统、冰箱等都由生产厂家提供品质担保，所以屋主们在入住后的最初几年内可以不用作任何维修，只要平常稍加注意，做些简单的保养工作即可。
620d14b5d7578562d5f8969559ca0ea6f383cdf1.translatedText: Four major advantages of new houses: Trendy, safe, energy-saving, low-maintenance. The Alberta Times When it comes to new houses, home buyers often think of a bright building with novel design, modern decoration, the latest equipment and an attractive "new house" smell everywhere. Indeed, according to a survey by the National Association of Home Builders, new houses have the following four major advantages: 1. New houses can reflect today’s latest trends and tastes from overall planning to interior layout, and the design is more reasonable and practical. Such as a spacious living room, ample closets, separate bathrooms for master and guest, dishwashers, washing and drying machines, etc., and a central air-conditioning system is indispensable. Modern families have more and more various household appliances with more and more uses, so the necessary power sockets and telephone plugs are already installed indoors and outdoors. If buyers have their own special requirements for certain layout or interior decoration of the new house, they can also submit them to the builder, and these requirements can be met at a very low cost. 2. The new house and its supporting facilities have better safety performance. According to statistics, owners of new houses are far less likely to be injured or killed by fire than those who live in older houses. The main reason is that there are smoke alarms on every floor and even in every room of the new house. They are all connected to each other through electrical circuits. As long as one is triggered, they will all sound an alarm signal. And they are equipped with backup batteries in case of indoor circuit failure. Since most new homes are heated by central air conditioning, there is no chance of disaster caused by malfunctioning electric heaters and window air conditioners. At the same time, building commercial buildings has raised the standard of designing electrical circuits throughout the house to meet the electrical requirements of modern homes. When a local circuit is overloaded, the system will automatically cut off the power supply to that part, ensuring the normal operation of other indoor appliances and preventing the entire house from being in darkness when the resistance wire burns out. In addition, the glass installed in new houses, especially floor-to-ceiling windows and sliding glass doors, have been specially strengthened and will only shatter into fine shards instead of sharp-edged fragments when broken. Moreover, all building materials that have adverse effects on human health, such as asbestos, lead-based paint, and boards that emit formaldehyde odor, are banned. 3. The owner of a new house can save a lot of money on energy. In recent years, the federal government's energy and environmental departments have urged builders to use higher-grade building materials and accessories in order to save energy and protect the environment. Newly built homes are generally equipped with double-glazed windows to prevent the loss of indoor cooling and heating. New building materials can better isolate noise from the outdoors and prevent water vapor caused by the temperature difference between indoor and outdoor from entering the room and forming water droplets that damage the wall. There is also a central air-conditioning system with timed and quantitative functions. These modern concepts in design and construction make the energy expenditure of owning a new house much lower than that of an old house that is 20 or 30 years old. 4. New houses have quality guarantee and low maintenance costs. New home builders either directly offer a quality warranty or purchase insurance from an insurance company to provide a similar guarantee, which generally covers construction defects that occur within ten years. In the first two or three years after a new house is sold, many supporting facilities in the house, such as carpets, air-conditioning systems, refrigerators, etc., are guaranteed by the manufacturer. Therefore, homeowners do not need to make any repairs in the first few years after moving in. As long as they pay a little attention and do simple maintenance work, it is enough.

8e143fd0ccf21aabae38a95b0d30a1cb7894e62c.sourceText: 大自然的鬼斧神工总是让人叹为观止。日前，美国科罗拉多大峡谷(Grand Canyon)就出现了罕见的”云海”奇观，整个大峡谷被白色的云朵覆盖，景象十分壮观。
8e143fd0ccf21aabae38a95b0d30a1cb7894e62c.translatedText: The miraculous craftsmanship of nature always amazes people. A few days ago, a rare "sea of ​​clouds" spectacle appeared in the Grand Canyon in Colorado. The entire Grand Canyon was covered by white clouds, and the scene was very spectacular.

0aa9f694e729a5290c86859747f353831182992b.sourceText: 位于亚利桑那州(Arizona)的科罗拉多大峡谷日前出现了”云海”奇观。黎明时分，地面迅速释放热量，在大峡中产生一层凉爽、潮湿的冷空气，但是高层热空气阻滞了地面冷空气上扬，从而产生这难得的”逆温”现象。
0aa9f694e729a5290c86859747f353831182992b.translatedText: A "sea of ​​clouds" spectacle recently appeared in the Grand Canyon in Arizona. At dawn, the ground rapidly releases heat, creating a layer of cool, moist cold air in the Grand Canyon. However, the hot air at high levels blocks the rise of cold air on the ground, resulting in this rare "temperature inversion" phenomenon.

84d86e249806b1753fe6861856ff3cf5ab7206df.sourceText: 这种”逆温”现象一般一到两年会发生一次，且仅限于局部地区，而这次科罗拉多大峡谷所出现的如此壮观的景象大约十年才出现一次。美国国家公园管理局拍下了这一美景。
84d86e249806b1753fe6861856ff3cf5ab7206df.translatedText: This kind of "temperature inversion" phenomenon usually occurs once every one to two years and is limited to local areas. However, such a spectacular scene in the Grand Canyon only occurs once in about ten years. The U.S. National Park Service captured this beauty.
