01fd4083c020feb464fa734a4cfc7a0822d5c6e4.sourceText: 全美中文学校协会第十次全国代表大会暨华文教育研讨会自发布征稿启事以来，各中文学校教师和管理人员积极响应，踊跃投稿。 部分作者来电邮反映，创作和整理论文需时较长，建议延长截稿时间。经大会组委会讨论，决定截稿时间由2014年10月31日推迟至11月10日，请各校教师和管理人员继续交稿。 征文注意事项如下： l 本次大会论文只接收中文稿件，目前只需要在网站上提交论文摘要，字数为100-500字。而且可以建立提交论文者的个人帐号，只要先简单输入论文摘要，以后再继续完善，直到11月10日截止期。11月10日后所有的论文摘要就将编入大会手册了。 2 大会主办方重视论文提交者为准备论文付出的精力和时间，尊重作者的智力劳动；因此，提交的论文一般都会被接受。主办方将根据全盘安排，可能希望作者做一些修改增补，也有可能调整到其它组别演讲。 3除了各校代表在论坛会上作口头报告，中文学校还可以带展板到会场展览，展示学校活动的图片和文字材料，以视觉交流的方式展示学校成果、宣传学校特色。 4如果作者希望将论文编入大会论文汇集，需要在11月15日前送交论文定稿，全文限定为1000-2500字。 5目前提交的论文多数集中在第4组”中文教学方法经验交流”。我们提倡论文的多样化，欢迎提交教育教学管理、教育文化环境、学校各类活动、中文学校作为社区活动基地、学校与主流社会的联系等方面的论文。 6有书商、教学软件公司、出版社等大会赞助方除了在大会场设展台推销相关产品外，也提出要求在论坛上演讲介绍产品；组委会将把该类演讲归到专门的组别，供参会的众多华教工作者选择听取这类产品介绍，以获取更多华教资源和信息。 但是研讨会的其它组别，仍然是交流教学、教育经验的场所。 组委会在大会网页上早已说明，研讨会欢迎各类教学方法的研讨，教材和相关软件的介绍，提供给大家交流学习的机会。但是如果主要内容是宣传作者自己的教材或教学软件，组委会将酌情要求该作者作为供应商或展销商，相应地提供展台，并要求交纳大会展台费用。没有作为供应商和展商的作者，如果在宣讲论文时出现有商业宣传的内容，研讨会主持人有权当场提醒直至要求删除商业宣传的内容。 7论文提交网址： http://smileyni.org/CSAUS/conference/ProposalAllInOne.php ，操作简便易行，提交十分快捷方便。 这里强调说明，本次大会聘请了两位华文教育著名专家，讲座在12月12号（星期五）下午4点就开始了，谭大立教授用动态的”清明上河图”做为教具，引导学生”穿入式”地进到宋代环境中学习体验中国古代的人文地理、建筑环境、交通工具、商业市场、风俗民情，讲座别具一格、引人入胜；傍晚6点美国大学理事会AP中文与文化测验主审齐德立教授的讲座”AP中文语言与文化测验以及对中文学校教学的启发”非常精彩，一定不要错过。请参考”大会议程框架表”。 亚利桑那华教工作者和热爱中华文化的各界人士有”近水楼台”的便利条件，大会所有的活动都免费对外开放；特别欢迎大家来参加12月13号上午大会和下午的六个组不同专题的华文教育研讨会，如果13号需要用餐，请到亚利桑那州参会人员的专门网站上注册： http://smileyni.org/CSAUS/conference/RegLocal.php ，以便大会组委会在11月底与旅馆签订餐饮合同，并为注册的参会者准备大会正式名牌。 （全美中文学校协会第十次全国代表大会组委会通稿，2014.10.30）
01fd4083c020feb464fa734a4cfc7a0822d5c6e4.translatedText: Since the National Association of Chinese Schools' Tenth National Congress and Chinese Education Seminar issued a call for papers, teachers and administrators from all Chinese schools have responded positively and enthusiastically submitted papers. Some authors reported via email that it takes a long time to create and organize papers, and suggested extending the deadline. After discussion by the conference organizing committee, it was decided to postpone the deadline from October 31, 2014 to November 10, 2014. Teachers and administrators from all schools are requested to continue submitting their papers. Things to note when soliciting papers are as follows: l This conference only accepts Chinese manuscripts. Currently, you only need to submit the abstract of the paper on the website, with a word count of 100-500 words. It is also possible to create a personal account for the person submitting the paper. Simply enter the abstract of the paper and then continue to improve it until the deadline on November 10. All abstracts of papers after November 10th will be included in the conference manual. 2 The organizers of the conference value the energy and time invested by the paper submitter in preparing the paper and respect the intellectual work of the author; therefore, submitted papers will generally be accepted. The organizer will make some overall arrangements and may want the author to make some modifications and additions, or may adjust the speech to other groups. 3 In addition to the oral reports given by representatives of each school at the forum, Chinese schools can also bring exhibition boards to the venue to display pictures and written materials of school activities, display school results and promote school characteristics through visual communication. 4If the author wants to include the paper in the conference paper collection, he/she needs to submit the final draft of the paper before November 15th, and the full text is limited to 1,000-2,500 words. 5 Most of the papers submitted so far are concentrated in Group 4 "Experience Exchange on Chinese Teaching Methods". We advocate the diversity of papers and welcome papers on education and teaching management, educational and cultural environment, various school activities, Chinese schools as community activity bases, and the connection between schools and mainstream society. 6. In addition to setting up booths at the conference venue to promote related products, conference sponsors such as booksellers, teaching software companies, and publishing houses have also requested to give speeches to introduce products at the forum. The organizing committee will classify such speeches into special groups so that many Chinese education workers participating in the conference can choose to listen to such product introductions to obtain more Chinese education resources and information. However, other groups in the seminar are still a place for exchanging teaching and educational experiences. The organizing committee has already stated on the conference website that the seminar welcomes the discussion of various teaching methods, the introduction of teaching materials and related software, and provides everyone with opportunities to communicate and learn. However, if the main content is to promote the author's own teaching materials or teaching software, the organizing committee will, at its discretion, require the author to act as a supplier or exhibitor, provide a booth accordingly, and require payment of conference booth fees. If an author who is not a supplier or exhibitor contains commercial promotion content when presenting a paper, the seminar host has the right to remind the author on the spot and request the removal of the commercial promotion content. 7 Paper submission website: http://smileyni.org/CSAUS/conference/ProposalAllInOne.php. The operation is simple and easy, and submission is very fast and convenient. It is emphasized here that this conference hired two famous experts in Chinese education. The lecture started at 4 pm on December 12 (Friday). Professor Tan Dali used the dynamic "Riverside Scene during Qingming Festival" as a teaching aid to guide students to "penetrate" into the environment of the Song Dynasty to learn and experience the human geography of ancient China. , built environment, transportation, commercial market, customs and folk customs, the lectures are unique and fascinating; at 6 o'clock in the evening, Professor Qi Deli, the chief examiner of the College Board AP Chinese and Culture Test, "AP Chinese Language and Culture Test and Inspiration for Teaching in Chinese Schools" is very exciting and must not be missed. Please refer to the "Conference Agenda Framework". Arizona Chinese education workers and people from all walks of life who love Chinese culture have the convenience of being "close to the water". All activities of the conference are free and open to the public. Everyone is especially welcome to attend the morning conference on December 13 and the six afternoon Chinese education seminars on different topics. If you need to eat on the 13th, please register on the dedicated website for Arizona participants: http://smileyni.org/CSAUS/conference/RegLocal.php , so that the conference organizing committee can sign a catering contract with the hotel at the end of November and prepare the official nameplate of the conference for registered participants. (Draft from the Organizing Committee of the 10th National Congress of the National Association of Chinese Schools, 2014.10.30)

c3361a7a2652a410556c5642b4ee91b581befc7a.sourceText: 老有所乐庆中秋－记斐匿华人老人中心中秋节庆祝活动 刘国泰 2012年9月28日上午，凤凰城斐匿华人老人中心举办了2012年庆祝中秋节活动。宽敞的大厅今天显得那么拥挤，据不完全统计大约有二百多人参加了这次庆祝活动。 按照中华民族的风俗，中秋节是阖家团圆的节日，全家人在一起吃月饼，赏满月，谈理想，是大家很快乐的节日。我们这些旅居美国凤凰城的华人老人们将耆英会当成了自己的家，在这个?#22823;家?#37324;，我们互相关怀，互相帮助，不是亲人，却胜似亲人。老人们一生除工作外，多有各种业余爱好，今日他们各献技艺，展示才华，其乐融融。 当地侨联及华人知名人士也到场祝贺。侨务委员会咨询委员尹衍恒、 侨联主席张华芳、台灣聯誼會會長万培傑，台湾同乡会会长彩屏及知名僑領高志中等都来参加了这次活动，張主席和尹委員分別向耆英会赠送了禮品和禮金。资深侨领余文劲等僑領为活动购买了炸雞和蛋糕，華人耆英會為每人準備了一塊團圓月餅。 活动在粤语合唱团一曲《珊瑚颂》的歌声中缓缓开始，三十多位老人经过了几个星期的刻苦排练，把他们的成果展现在大家面前，鲜艳的服装透着几分喜庆，特别是那整齐嘹亮的歌声更是打动着大家的心弦。国语合唱团的老人们也唱了《月满西楼》等几首歌曲。他们之中有的是国内著名的学者，有的是大学教授，有的是有名的医生，可在这里，他们都是怀有童心的老年歌唱者，合谐的音律使大家的心在一起跳动，并迎来大家阵阵的掌声。健康舞《爱情恰恰》提示老人们要注意身体健康，活泼的弦律，优美的舞姿给人以美的享受。乐器合奏《平湖秋月 》，高超的演技使老人们如醉如痴，更使人享受到音乐的魄力。多名歌唱爱好者登台献技，美妙的歌声打动人心。伴随着歌曲，有人不由自主的走上舞台翩翩起舞，台上台下融汇成一片。参加时装模特队表演的老人穿着艳丽的长裙伴随着《甜蜜蜜》的乐曲缓缓走上舞台。她们或集体出场，或单独亮相，高雅的气质，优美的走步真是感染了大家，所有在场的人随着她们的舞步也一起唱起了《甜蜜蜜》，台上台下的合谐互动将表演推向高潮。表演即将结束时，模特队的队员们拉出《中秋大团圆》的横幅时，全场给以热烈的掌声。 节目结束后，老人中心还给大家准备了丰盛的午餐，每个人都有一个中秋月饼，有祝福快乐的蛋糕，有予示”吉祥如意”的鸡块，有予意”五谷丰登”的豆、米，那美味可口的豉汁猪排更使人大快朵颐。 庆祝中秋活动结束了，可欢乐依然在老人们的心中荡漾，大家仍然沉浸在大团聚的欢乐之中。有位老人说出了大家的心声：”在这里我们充满了关爱，充满了喜悦，在这里我们老有所乐。耆英会就是我们的家。但愿年年有今天，岁岁有今朝！”大家遥祝祖国的亲人们中秋快乐，万事如意！
c3361a7a2652a410556c5642b4ee91b581befc7a.translatedText: Mid-Autumn Festival celebration for the elderly - Mid-Autumn Festival celebration at Feini Chinese Senior Center Liu Guotai On the morning of September 28, 2012, Phoenix Phoenix Chinese Elderly Center held the 2012 Mid-Autumn Festival celebration event. The spacious hall seemed so crowded today. According to incomplete statistics, about two hundred people attended the celebration. According to the customs of the Chinese nation, the Mid-Autumn Festival is a festival for family reunion. The whole family eats moon cakes, admires the full moon, and talks about their ideals. It is a happy festival for everyone. We old Chinese living in Phoenix, USA, regard the Senior Citizens Association as our home. In this home, we care for each other and help each other. We are not relatives, but we are better than relatives. In addition to working, the elderly often have various hobbies throughout their lives. Today, they are showing off their skills and talents and having fun. The local Overseas Chinese Federation and Chinese celebrities also came to congratulate. Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee Advisory Committee Member Yin Yanheng, Overseas Chinese Federation Chairman Zhang Huafang, Taiwan Friendship Association President Wan Peijie, Taiwan Association President Caiping and well-known overseas Chinese leader Gao Zhizhong all attended the event. Chairman Zhang and Committee Member Yin presented gifts and gifts to the Senior Citizens Association respectively. Senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin and other overseas Chinese leaders purchased fried chicken and cakes for the event, and the Chinese Elders Association prepared a reunion mooncake for each person. The event started slowly with the song "Ode to Coral" by the Cantonese choir. More than 30 elderly people rehearsed hard for several weeks and showed their results in front of everyone. The bright costumes were a bit festive, especially the neat and loud singing, which touched everyone's heartstrings. The elderly members of the Mandarin chorus also sang several songs such as "Moon Full in the West Tower". Some of them are famous domestic scholars, some are university professors, and some are famous doctors, but here, they are all old singers with childlike innocence. Their harmonious tunes make everyone's hearts beat together, and they receive bursts of applause from everyone. The health dance "Love Cha Cha" reminds the elderly to pay attention to their health. The lively rhythm and graceful dance give people a beautiful enjoyment. The musical instrument ensemble "Autumn Moon over a Flat Lake", with its superb acting skills, mesmerized the elderly and made them enjoy the power of the music. Many singing enthusiasts performed on the stage, and their beautiful singing moved people's hearts. Along with the song, some people involuntarily walked onto the stage and danced, and the stage and the audience became one. The old man participating in the fashion model team's performance slowly walked onto the stage wearing a gorgeous long dress and accompanied by the music of "Sweet Honey". They appeared as a group or individually. Their elegant temperament and graceful steps really infected everyone. Everyone present sang "Sweet Honey" along with their dance steps. The harmonious interaction on and off the stage pushed the performance to a climax. At the end of the performance, when the members of the model team pulled out the banner of "Mid-Autumn Festival Reunion", the audience gave them warm applause. After the program, the senior center also prepared a sumptuous lunch for everyone. Everyone had a Mid-Autumn moon cake, a cake with blessings and happiness, chicken nuggets that meant "good luck", beans and rice that meant "abundant grains", and the delicious pork chops with black bean sauce, which made everyone feast. The Mid-Autumn Festival celebrations are over, but joy is still rippling in the hearts of the elderly, and everyone is still immersed in the joy of reunion. An old man expressed everyone's feelings: "Here we are full of care, full of joy, and here we always have fun. The Senior Citizens Association is our home. I hope we can have this day every year, and this day every year!" Everyone wishes our relatives in the motherland a happy Mid-Autumn Festival and all the best!

6a57a2d5ea4b7047a787303566d0ecccf9c651a2.sourceText: 那年儿子去加州读书，在他的陪同下，我们参观了学校的各个教学楼、图书馆和纪念馆，也看了他们的体育场、宿舍和食堂。儿子很兴奋，因为这里是他新生活的开始，像校园前面美丽的草地，可以延伸到很远很远。作为父母的我们也感到很欣慰，美国竟然给了这些年轻人如此优越的条件，所以整个行程我们都笑了又笑，要感恩啊的话语，一直唠叨地挂在嘴边。 待到要告别了，妈妈抱住比自己高一头的儿子，再也止不住的泪水哗哗地流了下来。怕儿子看见自己的窘态，妈妈把头埋在儿子的肩上轻声地呜咽着，劝也劝不住。 儿子毕竟是孩子，大家高高兴兴的，你哭什么呀，他用年轻人的理解安慰着妈妈。他在美好的憧憬中还没有回来。我也不断重复着，不是一切都很好吗，还拍打着太太，用小鸟总要飞出巢的常见道理无力地安慰着她。 可能够安慰得住吗？太太在整个返程的路上，在候机楼，在检票口，在飞机上，甚至在回到家里，在与同事的交谈中都泪留满面…….。 兀地，像被电击一样，我仿佛回到了当年年轻的时候。不同的是，我们那时穿着人家给的破旧军装，脑袋装着伟人的红色浆糊，懵懵懂懂地充满着热望，在西去的列车上向站台下的亲友同学微笑告别。 妈妈一人到车站送我，说是只有一张送客票，爸爸和兄弟姐妹都在站外等待。妈妈眼圈是红的，没有流泪。她说了什么，我没有听见，月台实在太闹了。我想我知道了母亲说的什么，给远行的儿子送行还有什么比得过母亲的眼神的！ 几年以后返沪探亲，听妈妈的同事说，妈妈回到办公室里一直在哭，谁劝也劝不住。 我真的很后悔，当初不懂得母亲的眼泪意味着什么。唐代诗人孟郊的”慈母手中线，游子身上衣，临行密密缝，意恐迟迟归”描绘的正是这种无私博大，不要一点回报的母爱，可惜当时孩童的我只会背诵！ 但我现在觉得很欣慰，终于读懂了一点母亲的眼泪。她可以是甘甜的乳汁，是柔软的手掌，是潺潺语流，也可以是劝告甚至责怪……。 我很庆幸，自己的寸草心，虽然不能报得三春晖，但还可以用来一下拥抱母亲，回报母亲为你流过的眼泪。母亲今年已经93岁了，她能接受不孝之子遥远的寸草心吗？
6a57a2d5ea4b7047a787303566d0ecccf9c651a2.translatedText: That year, my son went to California to study. Accompanied by him, we visited various teaching buildings, libraries and memorial halls of the school, as well as their stadium, dormitories and canteens. The son is very excited because this is the beginning of his new life. Like the beautiful grass in front of the campus, it can extend far and far. As parents, we are also very pleased that the United States has given these young people such excellent conditions, so we laughed and laughed throughout the trip, and the words of gratitude kept nagging on our lips. When it was time to say goodbye, the mother hugged her son, who was a head taller than her, and the tears that could no longer be stopped flowed down. Afraid that her son would see her embarrassment, her mother buried her head on her son's shoulder and sobbed softly, unable to persuade her. After all, the son is a child. Everyone is happy. Why are you crying? He comforted his mother with the understanding of a young man. He has not yet returned in his beautiful longing. I kept repeating, isn't everything fine? I also patted my wife and tried to comfort her with the common truth that birds always fly out of their nests. Can it be comforted? My wife burst into tears during the entire return journey, in the terminal, at the ticket gate, on the plane, even when she returned home, and during conversations with her colleagues... Suddenly, like being shocked by electricity, I seemed to have returned to my youth. The difference is that we were wearing shabby military uniforms given by others, with the red paste of great men on our heads, and we were ignorantly full of longing. On the train heading west, we said goodbye to our relatives, friends and classmates on the platform with a smile. My mother went to the station to see me off alone, saying that I only had one ticket to see me off. My father, brothers and sisters were all waiting outside the station. Mom's eye circles were red, but she didn't shed any tears. I didn't hear what she said. The platform was too noisy. I think I know what my mother said. There is nothing better than the look in my mother's eyes when I say goodbye to my son who is traveling far away! A few years later, I returned to Shanghai to visit relatives. My mother’s colleagues said that my mother kept crying when she returned to the office, and no one could persuade her to stop her. I really regret that I didn't understand the meaning of my mother's tears. Meng Jiao, a poet of the Tang Dynasty, wrote "The thread in the hands of a loving mother, and the clothes on the wanderer's body, which are tightly sewed before leaving, for fear of returning later" depicts this kind of selfless and broad maternal love that does not ask for anything in return. It's a pity that I could only recite it as a child at that time! But now I feel very relieved that I finally understand a little bit of my mother’s tears. She can be sweet milk, soft palms, murmuring words, advice or even blame... I am very fortunate that although my love for a small amount of grass cannot be repaid with three rays of sunshine, it can still be used to hug my mother and repay the tears she shed for you. My mother is 93 years old this year. Can she accept the distant heart of her unfilial son?

717052ac2994e44d5f9959d1cb8703ee6e9fecf5.sourceText: 免费健保 惩罚中产阶级？
717052ac2994e44d5f9959d1cb8703ee6e9fecf5.translatedText: Free health insurance punishes the middle class?

685b7d17d05c67dad6509d5e14dd95a72ac1d469.sourceText: 免费健保 惩罚中产阶级？ （亚省时报） 洛杉矶真是个好地方，如果你是公民或持有绿卡五年以上，但没有健康保险…
685b7d17d05c67dad6509d5e14dd95a72ac1d469.translatedText: Free health insurance to punish the middle class? (Alberta Times) Los Angeles is really a good place. If you are a citizen or have held a green card for more than five years, but do not have health insurance...

02fa908a8b96f70082acd6992337e3de1127825d.sourceText: 洛杉矶真是个好地方，如果你是公民或持有绿卡五年以上，但没有健康保险，只要每人每月收入未达1207元，政府会提供免费医疗服务，看一般门诊、专科医师、挂急诊 、拿处方药，全部不用钱！ 但介于富人与贫民之间的中产阶级人士，对这个免费健保计画不免会有个共同疑问：负债累累的美国各级政府，怎会有钱提供如此慷慨的计画，最终是由谁 来埋单？ 根据洛县卫生局的说法，这个称为「Healthy Way LA」的计画是欧巴马政府「全民健保」的一部分，目前仅在洛县就有2.4万人加入，目前联邦与洛县每年共 支出6亿元，预计未来可造福55万名低收入居民，约相当于5.5%洛县人口。 再进一步估算，如果未来洛县有55万人加入该计画，每年支出至少达137.5亿元，这还只是洛县一个地方的费用，而欧巴马政府全民健保的范围是全美国，政府支出 加起来会是个天文数字。 那么谁来埋单呢？ 一般有三个途径，其一是由纳税人缴更多的税，其二是向外国人借更多的债，其三是由联准会印更多的钞票，让美金贬值。 但纳税人缴的税根本不够填补联邦巨额赤字，说穿了就是债留子孙。 前述每月1207元的收入门槛其实还有个玄机。 如果一个人每周工作40小时，每月工作160小时，按照联邦政府的每小时7.5元最低工资规定，月收入为1200元，恰好可享受免费医疗福利。 换言之，1207元的门槛是跟着联邦最低工资设定。 但以上条件却不适用于加州，因为加州州法规定基本工资为每小时八元，如果你每月工作160小时，月收入为1280元，就不能享受「Healthy Way LA」的福利。 所以吊诡的情况就出现了，在加州拿最低基本工资的全职（每周工作40小时）工作者，必须要自己花钱买健保，或者对雇主提供的健保付出一定比例的自付额。 在贫穷边缘挣扎的中产阶级，不但各种税赋一毛钱都逃不掉，在扣掉健保支出之后，实际收入与享受的福利，可能反倒比1207元月收入门槛以下的人还糟。 这对中产阶级百姓而言，究竟是惩罚还是鼓励？ 此外，自己或雇主出钱买的健保，至少对就医与拿药有若干自付额门槛和限制，以减少不必要的支出。 但类似「Healthy Way LA」的全民健保却大开方便之门，既无次数限制，也难有防弊机制，会不会浪费医疗资源还是一大问号。 全民健保当然是好事，让没有钱看病的人都能得到妥善医疗照顾，是政府的终极责任。 但对于债台高筑的美国而言，全民健保目前只是一个理想，政府只能量力而为，摆明了没有钱却要硬干，将会拖累更多百姓。 欧巴马政府上周末才宣布，健保改革计画中的长期疗护（CLASS）因经费不足而撤销，就是眼前的例证。
02fa908a8b96f70082acd6992337e3de1127825d.translatedText: Los Angeles is really a good place. If you are a citizen or have held a green card for more than five years, but do not have health insurance, as long as the monthly income per person does not reach 1,207 yuan, the government will provide free medical services, including general outpatient visits, specialist doctors, emergency visits, and prescription drugs, all free of charge! But the middle-class people between the rich and the poor will inevitably have a common question about this free health insurance plan: How can the debt-ridden U.S. governments at all levels have the money to provide such a generous plan, and who will ultimately pay the bill? According to the Los Angeles County Health Department, this program called "Healthy Way LA" is part of the Obama administration's "Universal Health Insurance". Currently, 24,000 people are enrolled in Los Angeles County alone. The federal government and Los Angeles County currently spend a total of 600 million yuan annually. It is expected to benefit 550,000 low-income residents in the future, which is approximately equivalent to 5.5% of the Los Angeles County population. Further estimates indicate that if 550,000 people in Los Angeles County join the program in the future, the annual expenditure will reach at least 13.75 billion yuan. This is only the cost for one place in Los Angeles County. The scope of the Obama administration’s universal health insurance covers the entire United States, and the total government expenditure will be an astronomical figure. So who will pay the bill? There are generally three ways. One is for taxpayers to pay more taxes, the other is to borrow more debt from foreigners, and the third is for the Federal Reserve to print more money to devalue the U.S. dollar. But the taxes paid by taxpayers are simply not enough to cover the huge federal deficit. To put it bluntly, the debt is being passed on to future generations. There is actually a mystery to the aforementioned monthly income threshold of 1,207 yuan. If a person works 40 hours a week and 160 hours a month, according to the federal government's minimum wage of 7.5 yuan per hour, the monthly income is 1,200 yuan, which happens to be able to enjoy free medical benefits. In other words, the $1,207 threshold is set with the federal minimum wage. However, the above conditions do not apply to California, because California state law stipulates that the basic wage is eight yuan per hour. If you work 160 hours a month and earn a monthly income of 1,280 yuan, you cannot enjoy the benefits of "Healthy Way LA". So a paradoxical situation arises. Full-time (40 hours per week) workers who earn the minimum basic wage in California must spend their own money to buy health insurance, or pay a certain percentage of the deductible for the health insurance provided by their employer. The middle class struggling on the edge of poverty not only cannot escape a dime of various taxes, but after deducting health insurance expenditures, their actual income and benefits may be worse than those of people below the 1,207 yuan monthly income threshold. Is this a punishment or an encouragement to middle-class people? In addition, health insurance purchased by yourself or your employer will at least have certain deductible thresholds and restrictions on medical treatment and medication to reduce unnecessary expenditures. However, national health insurance like "Healthy Way LA" is very convenient. There is no limit on the number of times and there is no anti-fraud mechanism. There is still a big question mark whether it will waste medical resources. National health insurance is of course a good thing. It is the ultimate responsibility of the government to ensure that people who cannot afford medical treatment can receive proper medical care. But for the United States, which is heavily in debt, universal health insurance is currently just an ideal. The government can only do what it can. It is clear that if it has to work hard without money, it will drag down more people. The Obama administration announced last weekend that the long-term care (CLASS) program in the health care reform plan would be canceled due to insufficient funding, which is an example of this.

0bf827b9ccec734b6240e67dd7b37e3557d45b26.sourceText: 中新网据香港《文汇报》报导，数据显示，今年前三季度，平均每天有3万多对恋人相聚民政部门领取结婚证，2010年，平均每天有5300多对夫妻婚姻画上句号。 有数据显示，北京海淀区法院去年的离婚案件中，以老公”出轨”作为主要原因起诉的比例高达60%，东城法院的离婚案件中亦有两成由于”外遇”引发。 可以说，婚外情已经成为婚姻的最大杀手。 文章摘编如下： 中国向来崇尚”家和万事兴”，然而这一传统家庭观念正受不断飙高的离婚率冲击。 最新数据显示，今年前三季度，平均每天有3万多对恋人相聚民政部门领取结婚证，2010年，平均每天有5300多对夫妻婚姻画上句号。 到底是什么原因致使这么多家庭夫妻劳燕分飞？ 有社会学家直言，婚外情攀高，责任感下滑是主因，而这一切皆源于浮躁。 在这个充满诱惑的现实世界，中国传统优秀的家庭观念能否重拾？ 值得深思。 有数据显示，北京海淀区法院去年的离婚案件中，以老公”出轨”作为主要原因起诉的比例高达60%，东城法院的离婚案件中亦有两成由于”外遇”引发。 可以说，婚外情已经成为婚姻的最大杀手。 中国这个曾号称世界婚姻最稳定的国家，离婚率亦开始”节节攀升”。 专家直言，现实诱惑下的浮躁是根源。 在浮躁风气之下，人们的社会责任感开始下滑，即便人们所不齿的婚外恋亦不再遮遮掩掩。 而”速婚”、”闪婚”、”闪离”等正悄然成为不少年轻人热衷的模式，出现了越来越多”一见钟情，婚了；一怒之下，离了”的现象。 许多人没有意识到，离婚影响的也许不仅仅是两个人，后果可能是多方面的。 最显而易见的是对子女造成的痛苦与伤害，有数据显示，单亲家庭孩子心理问题较多，犯罪率是双亲家庭孩子的3倍。 婚姻的”好聚好散”，显示了人性的解放和自由的发展，是值得肯定的社会进步。 但这并不意味着人们可以轻忽婚姻的严肃与价值，放浪形骸于婚外情，随心所欲于离婚。 中国社会正在经历着剧烈的社会变革与转型，但几千年传承下来的”和气”和对社会对家庭的责任心，不但不应该丧失，还应加强。 因为，唯有”家和”才能”万事兴”。
0bf827b9ccec734b6240e67dd7b37e3557d45b26.translatedText: China News Service, according to Hong Kong's "Wen Wei Po", reported that data showed that in the first three quarters of this year, an average of more than 30,000 couples gathered at the civil affairs department to receive marriage certificates. In 2010, an average of more than 5,300 couples ended their marriages every day. Statistics show that among the divorce cases in Haidian District Court in Beijing last year, the proportion of prosecutions citing the husband's "cheating" as the main reason was as high as 60%, and 20% of the divorce cases in Dongcheng Court were caused by "affair." It can be said that extramarital affairs have become the biggest killer of marriages. An excerpt from the article is as follows: China has always advocated that "everything thrives when the family is harmonious." However, this traditional family concept is being impacted by the rising divorce rate. The latest data shows that in the first three quarters of this year, an average of more than 30,000 couples gathered at the civil affairs department to receive marriage certificates every day. In 2010, an average of more than 5,300 couples ended their marriages every day. What is the reason that causes so many couples to separate their jobs? Some sociologists bluntly said that the main reasons for the increase in extramarital affairs and the decline in responsibility are all due to impetuousness. In this real world full of temptations, can the traditional Chinese excellent family values ​​be restored? Food for thought. Statistics show that among the divorce cases in Haidian District Court in Beijing last year, the proportion of prosecutions citing the husband's "cheating" as the main reason was as high as 60%, and 20% of the divorce cases in Dongcheng Court were caused by "affair." It can be said that extramarital affairs have become the biggest killer of marriages. In China, once known as the country with the most stable marriages in the world, the divorce rate has also begun to "increase." Experts bluntly say that impetuousness under the temptation of reality is the root cause. In the impetuous atmosphere, people's sense of social responsibility has begun to decline, and even extramarital affairs, which are despised by people, are no longer secretive. And "quick marriage", "flash marriage", "flash divorce", etc. are quietly becoming the models that many young people are keen on, and there are more and more phenomena of "falling in love at first sight, getting married; and getting divorced in anger". Many people don’t realize that divorce may affect more than just two people, and the consequences can be multifaceted. The most obvious is the pain and harm caused to children. Statistics show that children from single-parent families have more psychological problems, and the crime rate is three times that of children from two-parent families. The "easy to get together and easy to break up" in marriage shows the liberation of human nature and the development of freedom, which is a social progress worthy of recognition. But this does not mean that people can ignore the seriousness and value of marriage, indulge in extramarital affairs, and divorce as they please. Chinese society is undergoing drastic social changes and transformations, but the "harmony" and sense of responsibility for society and family that have been passed down for thousands of years should not be lost, but should also be strengthened. Because only "family harmony" can "all things prosper".

f43c55e592e599c0b12f48fd5a2689cc3c5afa01.sourceText: 国税 15 日昨公布第三波海外帐户自首计画，会计师指出，国税局这波自首计画强调在海外工作的美籍人士一样要申报海外帐户，定居海外的双重国籍人士也不例外。由于近年来回流定居人数增加，若未放弃美籍，在海外却拥有总值超过 1 万美元的财务帐号，一旦因为汇款来美或被人举报，被国税局发现，将是民刑事伺候。 近年来美国就业机会减少，生活开销比起港澳台却相对较高，以致回流发展或定居的美籍人士不少。 国税局认为在美申报所得税是定居海外的美国公民应尽义务，虽然在海外的美国人在美未申报所得税，不见得被国税局发现，尤其是国税局查税员透露，通常外国帐户会被国税局发现，是因为有人密告。但难保定居海外的美国华侨因为得罪人，或曾汇钱来美，引发国税局查税。建议利用第三波自首申报过去未申报的海外财务帐务，让长痛变成短痛。 事实上，定居海外的美籍人士可利用海外免税额，达到在美少缴所得税目的，因此在美申报所得税不见得对自己不利。 若国税局要求纳税人提供对自己不利的报税资料，纳税人可依照宪法第五修正案拒绝。然而最近一项判例显示，目前推出自首计画的海外帐户未受修正案保护，因为海外帐户须申报是依照 1970 年代生效 ​​ 的银行法执行，并非税法。 根据「外国帐户申报法案」的银行法，规定纳税人前一年若在海外的银行或证券公司的财务帐户总值超过 1 万元，须在 6 月 30 日前另填 TDF90-22.1 表，向财政部申报。 该法最初是为了对付走私贩毒者， 2003 年起才转交国税局严格执行。但罚款仍由金融犯罪执法网络制订，仍是银行法并非税法。
f43c55e592e599c0b12f48fd5a2689cc3c5afa01.translatedText: > National Taxation 15 The third wave of overseas account surrender plans was announced yesterday. Accountants pointed out that the Internal Revenue Service's surrender plan emphasizes that Americans working overseas must also declare overseas accounts, and dual nationals who have settled overseas are no exception. Due to the increase in the number of people returning to settle in recent years, if you have not given up your US citizenship but have financial accounts overseas with a total value of more than US$10,000, once you come to the US for remittances or are reported, and are discovered by the IRS, you will be subject to civil and criminal prosecution. In recent years, job opportunities in the United States have decreased, and the cost of living is relatively high compared to Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan. As a result, many Americans have returned to develop or settle down. The IRS believes that filing income taxes in the United States is an obligation for U.S. citizens who have settled overseas. Although Americans overseas who have not filed income taxes in the United States may not be discovered by the IRS. Especially, IRS inspectors revealed that foreign accounts are usually discovered by the IRS because someone informs them. However, there is no guarantee that overseas Chinese in the United States may have offended someone or sent money to the United States, triggering a tax audit by the Internal Revenue Service. It is recommended to use the third wave of self-reporting to declare overseas financial accounts that have not been reported in the past, so as to turn long-term pain into short-term pain. In fact, Americans who have settled overseas can use the overseas tax exemption to pay less income tax in the United States. Therefore, it is not necessarily disadvantageous for them to declare income tax in the United States. If the IRS requires a taxpayer to provide tax return information that is unfavorable to them, the taxpayer can refuse in accordance with the Fifth Amendment to the Constitution. However, a recent case shows that overseas accounts that are currently subject to surrender plans are not protected by the amendment because the reporting requirements for overseas accounts are implemented in accordance with the banking law that took effect in the 1970s, not the tax law. According to the Banking Law of the "Foreign Account Reporting Act", taxpayers who have financial accounts with overseas banks or securities companies with a total value of more than 10,000 yuan in the previous year must fill out another form TDF90-22.1 before June 30 and report to the Ministry of Finance. The law was originally intended to deal with drug smuggling and traffickers, but was transferred to the Internal Revenue Service for strict enforcement in 2003. But fines are still set by the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network and are still banking laws, not tax laws.

a79c59d65d29e5e7aa2e569d5c14521f28b2c182.sourceText: 多家大型航空公司15日表示，每趟来回机票将最多再涨10元。 这是航空公司4月宣布大幅调涨票价后，又一次的涨价行动。 这次涨价是联合大陆航空公司(United Continental)先宣布将每趟来回机票再涨4到10元，而达美航空(Delta Airlines)立刻跟进。 美利坚航空公司(American Airlines)和捷蓝航空(JetBlue)尚未涨价，其他航空公司未立刻表示意见。 为增加营收和因应燃油上涨，航空公司在2011年前半年六度涨价，上一次大幅涨价是在4月。 过去两周，一些航空公司表示，6月份的空位率比去年同期上升。 机票比价网站FareCompare.com执行长西尼(Rick Seaney)表示，联合大陆航空公司以涨价测试其他航空公司的需求，是否有涨价的实力。 摩根大通(JPMorgan)分析师贝克(Jamie Baker)表示，因为投资人担心需求下滑，航空业股价最近下跌，机票上涨显示航空公司对需求有信心，此举可能使股价回升。 达美航空15日也宣布，因为一些小城市需求不足，该公司飞往小城市的航线不赚钱，该公司将停飞前往24个小城市的航线。 受影响的包括爱阿华、密西根、明尼苏达、密西西比、北达科他和南达科他州的乡村小城市。 目前达美以34架小飞机经营这些航线，但这些飞机将在年底淘汰。 虽然。 达美表示该公司有50座的小飞机可服务小城市，但因为燃油价格过高，即使以50座的小飞机营运，同样会亏钱，该公司小城市航线每年亏损约1400万元。 (世界新闻网)
a79c59d65d29e5e7aa2e569d5c14521f28b2c182.translatedText: Several major airlines said on the 15th that round-trip air tickets would increase by up to 10 yuan each. This is another price increase after the airline announced a substantial increase in fares in April. This time the price increase was initiated by United Continental, which announced that it would increase round-trip air tickets by another 4 to 10 yuan, and Delta Airlines immediately followed suit. American Airlines and JetBlue have yet to raise prices, and other airlines had no immediate comment. In order to increase revenue and respond to rising fuel prices, airlines raised prices six times in the first half of 2011, with the last significant price increase occurring in April. In the past two weeks, some airlines have said that June vacancy rates were higher than the same period last year. Rick Seaney, CEO of fare comparison website FareCompare.com, said United Continental is raising prices to test the demand from other airlines to see if they have the strength to raise prices. Jamie Baker, an analyst at JPMorgan, said that airline industry shares have fallen recently as investors worry about falling demand, and the increase in airfares shows airlines are confident about demand, a move that could lead to a recovery in share prices. Delta Air Lines also announced on the 15th that due to insufficient demand in some small cities, the company's routes to small cities are not profitable, and the company will suspend routes to 24 small cities. Affected include small rural cities in Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, North Dakota and South Dakota. Delta currently operates these routes with 34 small aircraft, but these aircraft will be phased out at the end of the year. Although. Delta stated that it has 50-seat small aircraft that can serve small cities, but due to high fuel prices, even if it operates a 50-seat small aircraft, it will still lose money. The company's annual losses on small city routes are about 14 million yuan. (World News Network)

dea6203b468564241ca9af981ec313cbb295861a.sourceText: 美倒债危机 震垮全球股市 华府国债谈判相持不下，全球股市25日为之下跌；国际货币基金(IMF)更警告美国一旦跳票，全球经济将受到严重震撼；世界各地决策人员则对华府将能打破僵局表示希望和信心。 华府能否达成可行的折衷方案，对拥有将近3兆元美国国债的亚洲国家利害关系重大，而当地决策人员和经济学家预期白宫与国会将在最后一刻达成协议，以免引发危机。 面对华府的政治僵局，世界各地股市全面下跌，资金涌向避险的黄金和瑞士法郎，希腊的二度纾困引发的股市短暂回升为之终结，虽然市场尚未出现恐慌迹象。 但是，再过八天美国政府就可能无法支应各种给付，白宫和国会却互不相让，使国内外各界愈来愈紧张。 IMF即敦促美国赶快提高国债上限，以免美国经济和全球金融市场大乱。 IMF警告说，美国国债今年将达到合美国经济总值的99%，明年更将达到103%。它敦促华府三管齐下，借着削减开支、增加税收和紧缩社会安全计划，维护财政健全。 南韩中央银行主管说，主持外汇存底操作的人现在最紧张，不过没有人认为美国人会明明有解决办法，却自找死路。 刚刚为希腊拟定纾困计划的德国，也认为华府会及时提高国债上限。德国政府发言人说：「我们一直密切关注美国的国债辩论，而我们仍然相信他们会达成折衷办法。」 其他国家却没有这么乐观，谈话也不客气得多。英国商务大臣Vince Cable即宣称：「当前情况很讽刺的是，全球金融体系面对的最大威胁，是来自美国国会几个右翼疯子，而不是欧元区。」 亚洲人士表示美国的问题主要是政治意愿，不像希腊危机那么复杂，还得寻找纾困财源。中国人民银行顾问夏斌即宣称：「他们绝对会达成妥协，不必太担心。」
dea6203b468564241ca9af981ec313cbb295861a.translatedText: The U.S. debt crisis has rocked global stock markets. The government debt negotiations in Washington are at a stalemate, and global stock markets fell on the 25th. The International Monetary Fund (IMF) even warned that if the United States defaults on its bills, the global economy will be severely shocked. Policymakers around the world expressed hope and confidence that Washington will be able to break the deadlock. Whether Washington can reach a workable compromise has great stakes for Asian countries with nearly $3 trillion in U.S. national debt, and local policymakers and economists expect the White House and Congress to reach a last-minute deal to avoid triggering a crisis. In the face of the political deadlock in Washington, stock markets around the world fell across the board, and funds flocked to safe-haven gold and the Swiss franc. The short-lived stock market recovery triggered by Greece's second bailout ended, although there were no signs of panic in the market yet. However, the U.S. government may not be able to meet various payments in eight days. The White House and Congress are refusing to give in, making all walks of life at home and abroad increasingly nervous. The IMF urged the United States to raise the national debt ceiling quickly to avoid chaos in the U.S. economy and global financial markets. The IMF warned that the U.S. national debt will reach 99% of the total value of the U.S. economy this year and 103% next year. It urges Washington to adopt a three-pronged approach to maintain fiscal health by cutting spending, increasing taxes and tightening social security programs. The director of South Korea's central bank said that those in charge of foreign exchange deposit operations are the most nervous now, but no one thinks that Americans will seek their own death even though they have a solution. Germany, which has just drafted a bailout plan for Greece, also believes that Washington will raise the national debt ceiling in time. A spokesman for the German government said: "We have been closely following the national debt debate in the United States, and we remain confident that they will reach a compromise." Other countries were less optimistic and the conversation was much less polite. British Business Secretary Vince Cable declared: "The irony of the current situation is that the biggest threat to the global financial system comes from a few right-wing lunatics in the U.S. Congress, not the euro zone." Asians said that the problem in the United States is mainly political will, and it is not as complicated as the Greek crisis, which also requires finding financial resources for bailout. Xia Bin, an adviser to the People's Bank of China, declared: "They will definitely reach a compromise, so don't worry too much."

bfb291348a1dc0d5a0eaa12afebc8881c4b0df65.sourceText: 鳳凰城莊芷: 懷念感謝甄太 （亚省时报） 十年前，我剛開始耕耘「新新心眼」這塊小園地，第一次在亞美時報的辦公室見到甄太，當時甄社長把我引見給甄太，他一邊帶著稱得上是「崇拜與憐愛」的眼神望著甄太，一邊對我說：「從亞省時報一創刊開始，她就一直擔任總編輯的重任，近來因為身體狀況的影響，才逐漸退休。」 在那一刻，我就深切地體會咱們社長和亞省時報所獲得的成功果實，正是因為背後有著這位默默努力付出的女人。 甄太為人師表幾十年，卻給了我這個「寫作新生」許多鼓勵，讓我這墨汁不足、又缺乏學養的文字初學者，靠著上帝祝福賜下的靈感，本著對周圍人事物的關懷，並在甄太和社長的鼓勵下，持續寫作，後來竟然還能結集出書，實在要感謝社長和甄太多年來的支持。 亞省時報的發展營運方式向來是一步一步的穩定推展，多年前，當年社長計劃要把原本二週出刊一次的亞省時報，改進為每週出刊，於是社長召集了當時的編輯、記者、特約記者等多人開會，鼓勵大家接受挑戰、共同努力，當甄社長正耐心、認真地細細解說我們當前所面臨的困難時，身後忽然傳來甄太溫和、簡節、清晰的提醒：「說重點！」 社長立刻抓住主題，言簡意賅地分配起工作，很快的完成會議，當時看到社長和甄太的互動，覺得他們真是絕配，能夠互幫互補，難怪可以一起並肩承擔起辦報的艱巨工作啊！ 甄太多年來因糖尿病引發的病症，飽受洗腎之苦，而甄社長對妻子的疼愛與照顧可是眾所皆知的，甚至有朋友說應該頒給甄社長一座「鳳凰城最疼老婆男士」的獎牌，所以甄太也該算是很有福氣的人哪！ 鳳凰城著名僑領王瑋婷曾告訴過我，大約二年前有一次，甄太的病情突然轉壞，醫生提醒說有可能會熬不過去，勸家屬要先有心裡準備，甄社長難過得頻頻流淚，老淚縱橫地請求醫生一定要全力救回甄太，瑋婷說她當時在場，也為甄社長對甄太的一片深情感動得淚如雨下。 相信甄太雖是病重，一定是知道社長捨不得她離去，所以才三度從鬼門關前奮勇返回，為要再多和家人們聚聚、也多和老伴說說話，如今甄太已息了世上的勞苦愁煩、也擺脫了身上的病痛，我們雖是萬般不捨，仍然盼甄社長和家人能節哀保重，並得到神所賜下的安慰和平安。 甄太，我感謝您，也懷念您！
bfb291348a1dc0d5a0eaa12afebc8881c4b0df65.translatedText: Phoenix Zhuang Zhi: Missing and grateful to Mrs. Zhen (Alberta Times) Ten years ago, I just started cultivating the small field of "Xin Xin Eyes". I first met Mrs. Zhen in the office of Asia-American Times. At that time, President Zhen introduced me to Mrs. Zhen. While looking at Mrs. Zhen with what can be called "admiration and affection" in his eyes, he said to me: "She has been serving as the editor-in-chief since the first publication of the Alberta Times. Recently, due to the impact of her health, she has gradually retired." At that moment, I deeply realized that the success achieved by our president and the Alberta Times was precisely because of this woman who worked quietly and hard behind the scenes. Mrs. Zhen has been a teacher for decades, but she has given me a lot of encouragement as a "new student in writing". With the inspiration given by God's blessings and the care for the people and things around me, I, a novice writing student with insufficient ink and lack of education, have continued to write with the encouragement of the president, Mrs. Zhen. Later, I was able to publish a book. I really want to thank the president and Mrs. Zhen for their support over the years. The development and operation method of the Alberta Times has always been a step-by-step steady development. Many years ago, the president planned to improve the Alberta Times, which was originally published every two weeks, to a weekly publication. So the president convened a meeting with editors, reporters, special reporters and others at the time to encourage everyone to accept the challenge and work together. When President Zhen was patiently and seriously explaining in detail the difficulties we are currently facing, Mrs. Zhen suddenly came from behind to remind her gently, concisely and clearly: "Tell the important point!" The president immediately grasped the topic, assigned work concisely and concisely, and completed the meeting quickly. When I saw the interaction between the president and Mrs. Zhen, I felt that they were a perfect match and could help each other. No wonder they could shoulder the arduous task of running a newspaper together! Mrs. Zhen has suffered from dialysis due to diabetes for many years. President Zhen's love and care for his wife is well known. Some friends even said that President Zhen should be awarded a medal for "The Most Wife-loving Man in Phoenix", so Mrs. Zhen should be considered a very lucky person! Wang Weiting, a famous overseas Chinese leader in Phoenix City, once told me that about two years ago, Mrs. Zhen’s condition suddenly took a turn for the worse. The doctor warned her that she might not be able to survive the illness, and advised her family members to be mentally prepared. President Zhen was so sad that she frequently shed tears. She begged the doctors to do their best to save Mrs. Zhen. Weiting said that she was present at the time and was moved to tears by President Zhen’s deep affection for Mrs. Zhen. I believe that although Mrs. Zhen was seriously ill, she must have known that the president was reluctant to leave her, so she bravely returned from the gate of hell three times in order to get together with her family more and talk to her wife more. Now that Mrs. Zhen has put an end to the toil and sorrow in the world and has gotten rid of her illness, although we are extremely reluctant to leave, we still hope that President Zhen and his family can take care of themselves and receive the comfort and peace given by God. Mrs. Zhen, I thank you and miss you!

e5c8e58f7486b805f19ba1939529b34a47791c21.sourceText: 黑白二色的围棋，据传发明于尧舜时代。在古代传说中，说有个樵夫在深山看到二位长者在下棋，好奇之下去看个究竟，长者挥之不去，给一丸服下。看完一盘棋后，樵夫发现用于砍柴的斧子木柄经已变朽，回到乡间，已是数十年后的世界了。原来两位长者是神仙，他们下的棋就是围棋。可见围棋虽然只有黑白两色，其下法却是高深莫测，很费功力的，连神仙这样的智者都下得入神，而不管物换星移了。围棋棋盘纵横十九道，任何一个交点都可以着子，广濶的棋盘恰如宇宙，任由想像驰骋。可以推想在产生围棋的时代，是无阶级观念的。 记得读中学的时侯，正值文化大革命的风头火势，因手头有一本名为《黑佈局》的书籍，差点引来批判。因为在那个「火红的年代」，一切都是「红宝书、红像章、红标语」的「红海洋」，与黑有关的只是「黑手、黑帮、黑七类」等「反动对立面」，所以、单是《黑佈局》的书名就引来警训，虽然那隻是一本于围棋的入门书籍，阐述有关围棋中黑子的着法与佈局。自始以后，围棋就与我少了缘份。 自幼喜欢象棋，不学围棋还可以下象棋。文革中的象棋赛有国碎精神，不时也有举行，而围棋直到中国人与日本选手大战时才冒出个高手聂卫平，当年他上山下乡做知青也坚持研究围棋，最终为国争光。中国象棋的特色是等级分明，是中央集权制的产物，所有将士都要保卫统帅，舍卒保车，丢车保帅，为帅战，为帅亡，小兵小卒甚至没有退路。围棋则着重于整体佈局，在攻防战中各方所拥有的地域不属于皇天后土，而是黑白各方戢斗力量的集体所有，在这个意义上，围棋比其它棋类有着更深刻的内涵，富于哲理，给人智慧的啓迪。 家中有本《今奇画集》，是曹今奇教授赠送的。其中有幅「十八段大师」的画，画的是九隻淘气的小猫咪把围棋中的棋子弄翻了。大家知道，围棋大师最高段数为九段，今奇教授把猫咪的棋段加倍，棋盘已不复够用了。是否教授在下棋时，脑海中的猫咪不甘围棋分散了教授对他们的注意力和竉爱，意跑来搅局﹖或是教授把猫咪儗人化，寓意着围棋的吸引力和艺术之美﹖ 今奇教授酷爱下围棋，他对围棋有着一种执着和锺爱，这在他的文章和画集裡均可看到。教授爱好围棋这种黑白间的艺术，或者围棋这种整体佈局的宏观思维，平等，自由发挥落子的技巧，变幻莫测的阵法，已自然而然地渗透在教授的写作和绘画中，画册中不少黑白相映成趣的画面蕴含着围棋那种高深莫测的内涵和美。 下 围棋又称「手谈」，在黑白棋子的一来一往中，均能折射出棋手技术水平，境界素质，道德情怀，甚至宇宙观的。教授认为下围棋和做人一样，应追求”协和”境界，多少高手的棋谱，凡完满对局，都含有”协和”的影子，”和协心态，胜之通也。” 围棋，这种带有东方神秘色彩的艺术，对美国人来说可能还是一本的「天书」，不过围棋黑白棋子的自由平等、海阔天空及勇于进取的下法，与「美国精神」有着共同之处。中学时翻过一下《黑佈局》书中的入门部分，知道围棋最下面三行叫作”地”，在”地”上佈局斯杀并不太难，动机也比较容易看透，但三行以上即称之为”天”，是广幽无垦的”宇宙”，正中央那个交点更被视为「天元」，棋手不轻易下子此处。千百年来，多少人喜欢下围棋，并乐于此道，不为斧柄将朽的时间所动，其中乐趣，下棋人甘之如饴，而其中的哲理，应有其奥妙所在。
e5c8e58f7486b805f19ba1939529b34a47791c21.translatedText: The black and white Go game is said to have been invented in the era of Yao and Shun. In ancient legends, it is said that a woodcutter saw two elders playing chess in the mountains. He was curious to see what was going on. The elder couldn't get rid of it and took a pill. After watching a game of chess, the woodcutter discovered that the wooden handle of the ax used to cut firewood had rotted away. It was already decades later when he returned to the countryside. It turns out that the two elders are gods, and the chess they play is Go. It can be seen that although Go only has two colors: black and white, its playing method is unpredictable and requires a lot of skill. Even wise men like gods can play it in a trance, regardless of whether things have changed or the stars have changed. The Go board has nineteen vertical and horizontal lines, and pieces can be moved at any intersection. The vast board is like the universe, allowing imagination to run wild. It can be inferred that in the era when Go was produced, there was no class concept. I remember that when I was in middle school, at the height of the Cultural Revolution, I almost attracted criticism because I had a book called "Black Layout" on hand. Because in that "red era", everything was a "red sea" of "red books, red badges, red slogans", and black was only related to "reactionary opposites" such as "black hands, gangsters, and the seven black categories". Therefore, the title of the book "Black Layout" alone triggered a warning, although it was only an introductory book on Go, explaining the moves and layout of black stones in Go. Since the beginning, Go has lost its connection with me. I have been fond of chess since I was a child, and I can still play chess without learning Go. During the Cultural Revolution, chess matches were held in the national spirit and were held from time to time. In Go, it was not until the battle between the Chinese and Japanese players that a master Nie Weiping emerged. At that time, he went to the mountains and countryside to work as an educated youth and persisted in studying Go, eventually bringing glory to the country. The characteristic of Chinese chess is that it is hierarchical and is a product of centralization. All soldiers must protect the commander, sacrifice soldiers to protect the rook, lose rooks to protect the commander, fight for the commander, and die for the commander. Small soldiers and small soldiers do not even have a way out. Go focuses on the overall layout. In an offensive and defensive battle, the territory owned by each party does not belong to the emperor and the queen, but is collectively owned by the fighting forces of the black and white parties. In this sense, Go has a deeper connotation than other chess games, is rich in philosophy, and enlightens people with wisdom. There is a copy of "Jinqi Painting Collection" at home, which was given by Professor Cao Jinqi. Among them is a painting by "Eighteen-dan Master", which shows nine naughty kittens knocking over the Go pieces. As we all know, the highest number of steps a Go master can play is nine. Professor Jinqi doubled the number of steps for the cat, and the chessboard was no longer sufficient. Is it possible that when the professor was playing chess, the cat in his mind came to disturb the game, unwilling to be distracted by the chess game that distracted the professor's attention and love for them? Or maybe the professor humanized the cat, implying the appeal and artistic beauty of Go? Professor Jinqi loves to play Go. He has a persistence and love for Go, which can be seen in his articles and paintings. The professor loves Go, a black and white art, or Go, a macro-thinking of the overall layout, equality, free play of skills, and unpredictable formations, which have naturally penetrated into the professor's writing and painting. Many of the contrasting black and white pictures in the album contain the unpredictable connotation and beauty of Go. Playing Go is also known as "talking between hands". The back and forth of black and white chess pieces can reflect the player's technical level, realm quality, moral sentiments, and even cosmology. The professor believes that playing Go, like being a human being, should pursue the realm of "Concord". The chess records of many masters, and every perfect game, contain the shadow of "Concord", "The mentality of peace and harmony leads to victory." Go, an art with an oriental mystery, may still be a "book from heaven" to Americans, but the freedom and equality of the black and white chess pieces of Go, the vast sea and sky, and the courageous and enterprising methods have something in common with the "American spirit". When I was in middle school, I read the introductory part of the book "Black Layout" and learned that the bottom three lines of Go are called "land". It is not too difficult to make a kill on the "land", and the motivation is easier to see. But the three lines and above are called "sky", which is the vast and uncultivated "universe". The intersection in the middle is regarded as the "tianyuan", and chess players do not easily make moves here. For thousands of years, how many people have enjoyed playing Go, and are happy with it, unmoved by the time when the ax handle is about to decay. The fun of it makes players enjoy it, and the philosophy in it should have its mystery.

482c4f78448437ae96c6f45ec3beb3646a9d8d8e.sourceText: 3-5 年级的同学可以更加细腻的描绘图画, 他们把一些代表中国文化的元素, 如太极图, 龙, 长城, 月亮, 月饼等融入到自己的作品里, 同时还有将生活场景艺术加工, 表现出独具特色的江南水乡韵味, 该小组的一等奖获奖作品” 钓鱼归来” 就是描绘了丰富的生活场景, 渔乡的女儿们穿着蜡染的朴素的衣服, 戴着独具特色的帽子, 满载而归, 喜悦之情洋溢在脸上, 温暖在心里。
482c4f78448437ae96c6f45ec3beb3646a9d8d8e.translatedText: Students in grades 3-5 can paint pictures more delicately. They combine some elements that represent Chinese culture, such as Tai Chi diagrams, dragons, the Great Wall, the moon, Moon cakes, etc. are integrated into their works, and they also artistically process life scenes to show the unique charm of the Jiangnan water town. The group's first prize-winning work "Returning from Fishing" depicts rich life scenes. The daughters of the fishing village, wearing simple batik clothes and unique hats, return home with a full load, joy on their faces and warmth in their hearts.

58537e45b3299a030adde2df7a4d9db2729f9af6.sourceText: 6-8 年级的学生绘画功底开始显现, 对主题, 色彩还有文化符号等的表达都更上一层楼, 该小组一等奖获奖作品叫” 鸟瞰上海” 简单的笔墨抓住能体现上海的标志性建筑 – 东方明珠电视塔以及周围无数的摩天大楼, 将上海的现代, 繁荣艺术的呈现在观众面前。
58537e45b3299a030adde2df7a4d9db2729f9af6.translatedText: The painting skills of students in grades 6 to 8 have begun to show, and their expressions of themes, colors, and cultural symbols have improved to a higher level. The first prize-winning work of this group is called "A Bird's Eye View of Shanghai". Simple pen and ink captures the iconic building of Shanghai - the Oriental Pearl TV Tower and countless surrounding skyscrapers, presenting Shanghai's modern and prosperous art to the audience.

4dcc823567bf2944a1ed157cb892cfc042444cf7.sourceText: 9-12 年级的学生的作品显示了非常高的绘画技巧, 钢笔画即使是黑白线条的交织也能表达出丰富的场景, 给人无尽的联想, 油画更是浓墨重彩, 有的描绘出五彩辉煌的宫殿, 有的描绘出栩栩如生的人物, 该小组的一等奖获奖作品” 龙之崛起” 气势磅礴, 色彩绚丽, 写实风格的天坛绽放光芒和充满创意的巨龙向天飞翔, 象征着中国的腾飞。
4dcc823567bf2944a1ed157cb892cfc042444cf7.translatedText: The works of students in grades 9-12 show very high painting skills. Even the interweaving of black and white lines in pen drawings can express rich scenes and give people endless associations. The oil paintings are even more colorful. Some depict colorful palaces, and some depict lifelike characters. The group's first prize-winning work "The Rise of the Dragon" is majestic and colorful. The realistic-style Temple of Heaven blooms with light and the creative dragon flies to the sky, symbolizing China's take-off.

fe579097f2b787ddf02f8dc8283a9f9a89b0e7f0.sourceText: 由于优秀作品太多， 让评委目不暇接, 难以取舍, 最后在四组参赛作品中评出了 4 个 1 等将,2 个二等奖,8 个三等奖, 以及 40 多分优秀作品奖, 值得特别提到的是来自孔子课堂的学生也在这次比赛中获得了不错的成绩, 其中来自马蹄经孔子课堂的学生共获得一个三等奖, 两个优秀作品奖以及六个 HONORABLE MENTION, 另一所加维兰孔子课堂获得了一个优秀作品奖和 7 个 HONORABLE MENTION 。 9 月 18 日, 所有获奖的优胜作品在 ASU 的 MU 大楼进行展出, 同时有隆重的颁奖典礼。由于优秀作品太多, 让评委目不暇接, 难以取舍, 最后在四组参赛作品中评出了 4 个 1 等将,2 个二等奖,8 个三等奖, 以及 40 多分优秀作品奖, 值得特别提到的是来自孔子课堂的学生也在这次比赛中获得了不错的成绩, 其中来自马蹄经孔子课堂的学生共获得一个三等奖, 两个优秀作品奖以及六个 HONORABLE MENTION, 另一所加维兰孔子课堂获得了一个优秀作品奖和 7 个 HONORABLE MENTION 。 9 月 18 日, 所有获奖的优胜作品在 ASU 的 MU 大楼进行展出, 同时有隆重的颁奖典礼。
fe579097f2b787ddf02f8dc8283a9f9a89b0e7f0.translatedText: Due to too many excellent works, the judges were overwhelmed and had difficulty choosing. Finally, among the four groups of entries, 4 first prizes, 2 second prizes, 8 third prizes, and more than 40 points for outstanding works were awarded. It is worth special mentioning that students from the Confucius Classroom also achieved good results in this competition. 85f4d38f5b24ec03ba73d4916f6d2ab6e904a046.sourceText: ”明尼苏达与中国有两个教师交换项目(teacher exchange program)，每年有十个教师可以获签来此教学，但是当学校需要更多教师时，却没有相应签证，”Liberty Ridge和纽波特(Newport)小学所在的833区(District 833)人力资源主管丹尼斯格里菲斯(Denise Griffith)说。并不是所有的汉语教师都是国家批准的，因此在美国本土学校中，普遍存在与汉语教师签署一年合同，并以?#31038;区专家?community experts)的身份教课的情形。而在得不到高质量汉语教师之后，寻找西班牙语教师替代的方案也就不得不被实施。管理者如此表示。 为了应对汉语教师出走留下的空缺，这几所学校也在积极寻找替代教员，但却都无功而返。因为要找到高质量的汉语教师，并非易事。根据明尼苏达教育部的信息显示，除了上述两个学校，其他学校也在招聘汉语教师的问题上面临”无人可用”的尴尬。 纽波特小学初级教育助理主管戴夫本哈德森(Dave Bernhardson)称，他希望能在通知家长改教西班牙语课之前落实教师工作。而Liberty Ridge小学的家长在得知相关信息后反应不一。有家长希望换成西班牙语，但其他家长则表示不希望替换汉语课程。
85f4d38f5b24ec03ba73d4916f6d2ab6e904a046.translatedText: " Minnesota has two teacher exchange programs with China (teacher exchange) program, ten teachers can get a visa to teach here every year, but when the school needs more teachers, there are no visas,” said Denise Griffith, director of human resources for District 833, where Liberty Ridge and Newport elementary schools are located. Not all Chinese teachers are approved by the state, so in local schools in the United States, it is common to sign one-year contracts with Chinese teachers and teach as community experts. After the lack of high-quality Chinese teachers, the plan to find replacement Spanish teachers had to be implemented. Managers said so. In order to cope with the vacancies left by the departure of Chinese teachers, these schools are also actively looking for replacement teachers, but all of them have failed. Because it is not easy to find high-quality Chinese teachers. According to information from the Minnesota Department of Education, in addition to the above two schools, other schools are also facing the embarrassment of "no one available" when it comes to recruiting Chinese teachers. Dave Bernhardson, assistant superintendent of elementary education at Newport Elementary School, said he hopes to have teachers in place before notifying parents about the switch to Spanish classes. Parents at Liberty Ridge Elementary School had mixed reactions after learning the relevant information. Some parents want to switch to Spanish, but other parents say they don’t want to switch to Chinese classes.

All comrades are sincerely grateful. The new standing committee member Qiu Zhongping is about to form a working team and recruit new consultants and members. Enthusiastic comrades are urgently needed to take responsibility, take responsibility, and selflessly participate in branch party affairs operations. I hope that the comrades in our branch will stick to their original intentions, unite as one, and support the Arizona branch of the Chinese Kuomintang. We would like to inform you that all comrades are kindly requested to participate enthusiastically.

ba39cda06ab206a5acfe9f89089e56e8370937ba.sourceText: 道路法落后 亚省交通安全令人担忧 尽管亚利桑那州去年通过了一项新交通安全法，要求年龄较大的儿童加高汽车座椅，但根据日前发布的《高速公路与汽车安全》年度报告，亚利桑那州的道路安全法，仍是全美最糟糕的六个州之一。 这份报告由一个包括保险公司在内的提倡消费者健康和安全组织，根据安全带，分心驾驶，酒后驾驶，青少年驾照和摩托车头盔等15个重点交通安全法，参照15州道路安全法律所作的安全评估。 首先是安全带和摩托头盔，15个州在此项没有及格。全美有32个州实施强制系安全带法律，19个州强制骑摩托车者佩带头盔，偏偏亚利桑那州两个法律都没有。 安全带强制法律包括警察如若发现没有系安全的驾驶人，或车上前排乘客没有系安全带，警察有权提出口头警告、交通罚款单并提出强制执行等执法要求。还有一种安全带法，就是警察在驾驶人触犯其他交通法时，顺带对没系安全带作出处罚，本州属后者。 根据上诉报告，本州在2011年有233人因系安全带而在车祸中逃生，还有97人，报告说，如果系安全带就能挽回生命。 报告说，在2006至2011年，亚利桑那州15岁至20岁的驾驶人有891人因车祸身亡。这个年龄段的年青人可以使用包括某些限制的亚利桑那驾照G类。报告中所列的州都没有对青少年驾照严格要求，令人意外的是亚省在此方面及格。 本州去年提出禁止G类牌照使用者在行车时使用手机收发短信，法案在参议会通过，却在众议会止步不前。 报告对本州的酒驾法律给予很高评价，交警可对行驶中车辆装有敞开酒瓶的驾驶人进行强制酒精测试，并可将车上儿童带走。除亚利桑那州外，全国只有9个州有类似法律。
ba39cda06ab206a5acfe9f89089e56e8370937ba.translatedText: Road laws are lagging behind and traffic safety in Alberta is worrying. Although Arizona passed a new traffic safety law last year that requires booster car seats for older children, Arizona's road safety laws are still one of the six worst states in the country, according to the annual Highway and Auto Safety report released recently. The report, produced by a consumer health and safety advocacy group that includes insurance companies, looked at safety assessments based on 15 state road safety laws based on 15 priority traffic safety laws, including seat belts, distracted driving, drunk driving, teen licenses and motorcycle helmets. The first is seat belts and motorcycle helmets, where 15 states failed. There are 32 states in the United States that have implemented mandatory seat belt laws, and 19 states require motorcycle riders to wear helmets, but Arizona has neither law. Seat belt enforcement laws include that if the police find a driver who is not wearing a seat belt, or a front-seat passenger in a car who is not wearing a seat belt, the police have the right to issue verbal warnings, traffic fines, and enforcement requirements. There is also a seat belt law, which means the police will incidentally punish drivers for not wearing seat belts when they violate other traffic laws. This state falls into the latter category. According to the appeals report, 233 people in the state escaped crashes in 2011 because they were wearing seat belts, and 97 others, the report said, could have saved their lives if they had worn seat belts. The report said that between 2006 and 2011, 891 Arizona drivers between the ages of 15 and 20 were killed in car accidents. Young people in this age group may use an Arizona driver's license Class G, which includes certain restrictions. None of the states listed in the report have strict requirements for teenage driver's licenses, and surprisingly, Alberta passes the mark on this aspect. Last year, the state proposed banning Class G license holders from using mobile phones to send and receive text messages while driving. The bill passed the Senate but stalled in the House of Representatives. The report gave high marks to the state's drunk driving laws, which allow traffic police to conduct mandatory breathalyzer tests on drivers with open bottles of alcohol in their vehicles and to remove children from the vehicle. Except for Arizona, only nine states in the country have similar laws.
