799eae6c9025b061d754fb39e0ec1b2a2ba3f83c.sourceText: 崔增祁： 北京申办冬奥成功联想 凤凰城 崔增祁 北京成為2022年冬季奥运会的举办城市的消息傳来，感到无比兴奋和喜悦，也引起无限睱想。 我知道奥运会这个名词是在我十一岁那年。那是在第二次世界大战结束、也是中国抗战勝利以后举办的首次奥运会，因为两次世界大战，奥运会停办了两屆，1948年倫敦奥运会，是战后的第一次奥运会，人们怀着勝利的喜悦，迎来了象征和平和团结的盛会，共有59个國家和地区选派了 4099名运动员参加。日本和德国作为第二次世界大战的軸心國，是不允許参加奥运会的。那時中国刚刚结束抗日战争，國力尚未恢复，加上國共内战，昔日東亚病夫的帽子尚未摘掉，國窮民弱，更談不上办奥运夢。為配合奥运，1948年5月，國民政府在上海江湾体育场也举行了全国運动会，我記得作为学生参加了童子軍表演。中国作为一个人口大國，作为联合国常任理事国，还是派出了一个33人的代表团参加了倫敦奥运会。参赛的项目有篮球10人、足球18人、田径3人、㳺泳1人、自行车1 人。比赛结果無一勝出，奨牌数是零。那時我在上海，人们也很关心奥运会，因為上海有一位人人㫮知的长跑运动员叫楼文敖，他的长跑成绩多次打破國家纪录，达到31.27秒，很可能拿到世界冠军。傳説他是个哑巴，随父母来到到上海后，父母做清潔工人，他有時跟着一帮人练长跑，拉过黄包車，练得一副好腿力，人们对他寄予厚望。我们這些学生當时在一起議論常說，将来在黄包車夫中选长跑運动员，冠军肯定是中国的，因为外國人没有這个行當。但是比赛结果报纸傳來的消息却令人意外，他在奥运会上是最後一个到达终点的人，简直难以置信。那時的中国，参加奥运会的隊伍經费有限、也没有随行記者和攝影，大概半年后我们才看到了一部苏联拍摄的奥运会的纪录片，纪录了楼文敖比赛中的塲景。萬米长跑比赛前，楼文敖光着脚在赛场坐着，他的敎練為他買來一双新的釘鞋譲他穿上。比赛开始, 他因为是聋子，起步稍慢，但很快進入了第一团隊，保持着良好的成绩。大约在比赛進行到十五分鐘左右，他突然慢了下來，脸上显出十分痛苦的表情，结果一步歩落后，最后一个到达终点。解説员説明是因为釘鞋的釘子向上顶破了他的脚跟。人们紛紛議論是外国人有意害他的，或许就是鞋的质量问题？因为我们小時矦穿的皮鞋經常有后跟的釘子顶岀來。究属何因，已無从考究了。當時的中国，國窮、民弱、体育弱，楼文敖這样的优秀國手，参加奥运会比赛，居然到赛场才買來一双新的釘鞋参赛，内战的一發炮弹就足够買一双鞋了。后来的故事更令人心酸，他参赛后回國的机票是由华僑赞助的，因为他是聾哑人，别人又给他換成船票，赚了差价，讓他坐船到香港，再也没有回到上海。一个极有希望為中国获得第一枚奥运奨牌的优秀運动員就這様默默地消失了，真是民族之悲哀啊！ 七十年后的今天，中国已经成为世界奥运大國，1984年7月，中国在洛杉矶奥运会上取得了十五金八银九铜的成绩，登上了奨牌总数第四的地位，在随后举行的2000悉尼奥运会上，登上了金牌和奨牌总数第三的位置。2008年，实现了一个世纪以来中国人期望已久的在中國举办奥运會的夢想。北京奥运会取得了巨大成功，中国选派了历史上最大的隊伍参加了北京奥运，并取得了金牌总数51枚,金牌总数第一的最好成绩，奥林匹克精神更加深入人心。去年在中國南京成功地举办了青奥会，现在中國北京又取得了2020年冬奥会主办權。奥运的成就増進了中国和世界的广泛接触和了解，推动了中国社会各项事业的前进，也是國家和民族走向强盛的標誌。每一个中华儿女都為祖国取得的進步兴奋而骄傲。今天，七十年前的令人痛心的楼文敖事件再也不会重演，我们已经把東亚病夫这顶洋人送给我们的帽子甩到太平洋里去了。 在成功靣前必须清醒地看到我们的不足和落後于世人的差距，通过举办奥运会推進我们民族和國家的進步。中国人的文明禮貌和道德素质还很差。常常看到国人在飞机上争先恐后搶座位，不尊重服务人员以至相互斗歐的事，在歺厅浪费食物和在公共塲合大声喧哗比比㫮是，甚至有人跑到巴黎羅浮宫门前水池中去泡脚。真是丢尽了國人的颜面。正是這些不大不小的瑣事，使中国人的形象备受争议。另一个是環境和食品安全问题。人们相聚奥运，在欢乐的氣氛中需要清新的空气，潔净的饮水和安全美味的食物，我们绝不能讓冬奥会的白雪沾上塵埃，以目前北京的现状，还存在不少差距。举办奥运，正是提髙國民素质和改进各项工作的良機。祝願北京冬奥会成功，也期望奥运会的举办為全國人民带来福祉,推动整个社会的進步。
799eae6c9025b061d754fb39e0ec1b2a2ba3f83c.translatedText: Cui Zengqi: Beijing’s successful bid to host the Winter Olympics Lenovo Phoenix Cui Zengqi When the news came that Beijing had become the host city for the 2022 Winter Olympics, I felt extremely excited and happy, and it also aroused endless imagination. I knew the term Olympic Games when I was eleven years old. It was the first Olympic Games held after the end of World War II and China's victory in the Anti-Japanese War. Due to the two world wars, the Olympic Games were suspended for two sessions. The 1948 London Olympics was the first Olympic Games after the war. With the joy of victory, people ushered in the grand event symbolizing peace and unity. A total of 59 countries and regions selected 4,099 athletes to participate. Japan and Germany, as the Axis powers of World War II, were not allowed to participate in the Olympics. At that time, China had just ended the Anti-Japanese War, and its national strength had not yet been restored. Coupled with the civil war between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party, China had not yet taken off its reputation as the sick man of East Asia. The country was poor and the people were weak, let alone the dream of hosting the Olympics. In conjunction with the Olympic Games, the National Government also held the National Games at Shanghai Jiangwan Stadium in May 1948. I remember participating in the Boy Scout performance as a student. As a populous country and a permanent member of the United Nations Security Council, China sent a 33-member delegation to the London Olympics. The participating events include 10 people in basketball, 18 people in football, 3 people in track and field, 1 person in swimming, and 1 person in cycling. The result of the game is that no one wins, and the number of cards is zero. I was in Shanghai at that time, and people were also very concerned about the Olympics, because there was a well-known long-distance runner in Shanghai named Lou Wen'ao. His long-distance running performance broke the national record many times, reaching 31.27 seconds, and he was very likely to win the world championship. Legend has it that he was a mute. After he came to Shanghai with his parents, who worked as cleaners, he sometimes practiced long-distance running with a group of people and pulled rickshaws, and developed good leg strength. People had high hopes for him. We students often discussed together that in the future, if we choose long-distance runners among rickshaw drivers, the champion will definitely be Chinese, because foreigners do not have this profession. But the news from the newspaper about the results of the competition was surprising. He was the last person to reach the finish line at the Olympics, which was simply unbelievable. At that time, China's teams participating in the Olympics had limited funds and no accompanying reporters or photographers. About half a year later we saw a documentary filmed by the Soviet Union about the Olympics, which recorded Lou Wen'ao's misfortunes during the competition. Before the 10,000-meter long-distance race, Lou Wen'ao sat barefoot on the field. His coach bought him a new pair of spikes and put them on. At the beginning of the game, he started a little slowly because he was deaf, but he quickly entered the first team and maintained good results. About fifteen minutes into the race, he suddenly slowed down, with a very painful expression on his face. As a result, he fell behind step by step and reached the finish line last. The commentator explained that it was because the nails of the spikes pushed upward and broke his heels. People were talking about foreigners deliberately harming him. Maybe it was the quality of the shoes? Because the leather shoes we wore when we were young often had nails protruding from the heels. It is impossible to find out why. At that time, China was poor, its people were weak, and its sports were weak. When an outstanding national athlete like Lou Wen'ao participated in the Olympic Games, he actually bought a new pair of spikes before arriving at the stadium to compete. One shell from the civil war was enough to buy a pair of shoes. The later story is even more poignant. His air ticket to return to China after the competition was sponsored by overseas Chinese. Because he was deaf-mute, someone else exchanged it for a boat ticket and made a profit on the difference. He took a boat to Hong Kong and never returned to Shanghai. An outstanding athlete who had great hope of winning China's first Olympic medal just disappeared silently. What a tragedy for the nation! Today, seventy years later, China has become a major Olympic power in the world. In July 1984, China won 15 gold medals, eight silver medals and nine bronze medals at the Los Angeles Olympics, ranking fourth in the total number of medals. At the subsequent 2000 Sydney Olympics, China ranked third in the total number of gold medals and medals. In 2008, the Chinese people's long-awaited dream of hosting the Olympic Games in China was realized for a century. The Beijing Olympics was a great success. China selected the largest team in history to participate in the Beijing Olympics and achieved the best result of winning 51 gold medals, ranking first in total. The Olympic spirit has become more deeply rooted in the hearts of the people. The Youth Olympic Games were successfully held in Nanjing, China last year, and now Beijing, China has won the right to host the 2020 Winter Olympics. The achievements of the Olympic Games have increased the extensive contact and understanding between China and the world, promoted the advancement of various undertakings in Chinese society, and are also a symbol of the prosperity of the country and nation. Every Chinese son and daughter is excited and proud of the progress made by the motherland. Today, the heartbreaking Lou Wen'ao incident of 70 years ago will never happen again. We have thrown the hat of "sick man of Asia" given to us by foreigners into the Pacific Ocean. Before success, we must clearly see our shortcomings and the gap behind the rest of the world, and promote the progress of our nation and country by hosting the Olympic Games. The civility, courtesy and moral quality of the Chinese people are still very poor. It is common to see Chinese people scrambling for seats on airplanes, disrespecting service staff and even fighting each other, wasting food in the dining hall and making loud noises in public places. Some people even went to soak their feet in the pool in front of the Louvre Museum in Paris. It’s really a disgrace to our countrymen. It is these trivial matters, both big and small, that make the image of the Chinese people controversial. Another is environmental and food safety issues. People gather at the Olympics and need fresh air, clean drinking water and safe and delicious food in a joyful atmosphere. We must not let the snow of the Winter Olympics be stained with dust. With the current situation in Beijing, there are still many gaps. Hosting the Olympic Games is a good opportunity to improve the quality of the people and improve various tasks. I wish the Beijing Winter Olympics success, and hope that the Olympic Games will bring benefits to the people across the country and promote the progress of the entire society.

b3beebf8e43af322318fdaaaccb41e02860a744e.sourceText: 亚裔政治影响上升 成白宫关键选民
b3beebf8e43af322318fdaaaccb41e02860a744e.translatedText: The political influence of Asian Americans has risen and they have become a key voter in the White House

f1537dcffe57375ffaba038fc79004b4a9be0e15.sourceText: 亚裔政治影响上升 成白宫关键选民 亚裔美国人在政治中的影响日益增长，这也许在星期三最能充分展示：总统奥巴马…
f1537dcffe57375ffaba038fc79004b4a9be0e15.translatedText: >The political influence of Asian Americans has risen and they have become a key voter in the White House. The growing influence of Asian Americans in politics may be best demonstrated on Wednesday: President Obama...

efd788fa7d2033cf3eb4e3fe119aeb5530fd6a3a.sourceText: 《华盛顿邮报》发表的文章说，亚裔美国人为何成为这么关键的政治选民？他们的选票和他们的捐款都起决定作用，尤其是在奥巴马的连任竞选中。
efd788fa7d2033cf3eb4e3fe119aeb5530fd6a3a.translatedText: An article published by the "Washington Post" said, why have Asian Americans become such a key political constituency? Their votes and their donations matter, especially in Obama's re-election campaign.

f4bf663dd7ac35c7a2bacdddc0c5e8f5f2895779.sourceText: 亚裔正在迅速成为民主党核心团体：选后民调显示，奥巴马和拜登在2012年赢得73%的亚裔选票，比2008年高出11个百分点。这也是各族裔中变化最大的，而其他多数族裔在2012年对奥巴马的支持都在减少。
f4bf663dd7ac35c7a2bacdddc0c5e8f5f2895779.translatedText: Asians are quickly becoming the core group of the Democratic Party: post-election polls showed that Obama and Biden won 73% of the Asian votes in 2012, 11 percentage points higher than in 2008. This is also the largest change among all ethnic groups, while support for Obama declined among most other ethnic groups in 2012.

a04e352ad89dfb001ef1ffe1d7d7930e1d7e2500.sourceText: 尽管拉美裔因为数量大，成为全美最重要的票仓而引起公众关注，亚裔美国人在选民中的比例增长更快。
a04e352ad89dfb001ef1ffe1d7d7930e1d7e2500.translatedText: Although Hispanics have attracted public attention because of their large numbers and have become the most important vote base in the United States, the proportion of Asian Americans in the electorate is growing faster.

8ba66a54375cba509789155550e09f57559bff53.sourceText: 亚太美国人国会研究学院院长莫里（Floyd Mori）说，这些事件反映亚裔如何开始行动，尤其是在总统去年最需要的关键州。这些州包括弗吉尼亚、内华达和俄亥俄。
8ba66a54375cba509789155550e09f57559bff53.translatedText: Floyd Mori, dean of the Asian Pacific American Congressional Studies Institute, said these incidents reflect how Asian Americans are beginning to take action, especially in key states where the president needed it most last year. These states include Virginia, Nevada and Ohio.

785c28bc3931d33ae4d7e08e19e3be3ba33e2f1e.sourceText: 今天下午也作为亚裔领袖受到总统会见的莫里说，他们最终得到承认。曾经担任加州民主党议员的莫里说，它已经成为今天谈话的一部分。
785c28bc3931d33ae4d7e08e19e3be3ba33e2f1e.translatedText: Murray, who was also met by the president this afternoon as an Asian leader, said they were finally recognized. Murray, a former California Democratic congressman, said it has become part of the conversation today.

1e0e08bca134bca1bcbeb07bccf6760c412cfeac.sourceText: 亚裔美国人也在奥巴马政府取得重要进展。总统在联邦法官队伍将亚裔美国人和太平洋岛民数量从8人增加到19人，相当于他所提名并获批准法官人数的7%。相比之下，这一群体的法官人数仅占布什和克林顿提名法官人数的1%。斯里瓦桑（Sri Srinivasan）已经获得副检察总长（Deputy Solicitor General）提名，等待参议院批准。他是第一个得到提名进入联邦巡回法庭的南亚美国人。
1e0e08bca134bca1bcbeb07bccf6760c412cfeac.translatedText: Asian Americans have also made important progress during the Obama administration. The president increased the number of Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders on the federal bench from eight to 19, equivalent to 7% of the judges he nominated and approved. By comparison, this group represents only 1% of the judges nominated by Bush and Clinton. Sri Srinivasan has been nominated as Deputy Solicitor General and is awaiting Senate confirmation. He is the first South Asian American nominated to a federal circuit court.

c5d433cb4cb53b47910dd17c868e51cf7c829813.sourceText: 白宫也关注亚裔美国人的具体问题，例如对有工作事故较高风险的亚裔美国人，将职场安全建议翻译成亚洲语言。
c5d433cb4cb53b47910dd17c868e51cf7c829813.translatedText: The White House is also focusing on specific issues for Asian Americans, such as translating workplace safety recommendations into Asian languages ​​for Asian Americans who are at higher risk for workplace accidents.

e85d71a9c8ee72dbfffbf3eadb5f2a32f7763377.sourceText: 但亚裔美国人在一个方面职位减少：奥巴马第一任期内阁成员中有三名亚裔，但第二任期只有一人–退役军人事务部部长辛赛基（Eric Shinseki）。
e85d71a9c8ee72dbfffbf3eadb5f2a32f7763377.translatedText: But Asian Americans have seen fewer positions in one area: There were three Asian-American cabinet members in Obama’s first term, but there was only one in his second term – Secretary of Veterans Affairs Eric Shinseki.

33829569527aa94b2c20ab150a23ff23461c0995.sourceText: 莫里对于那一点并无怨言。谈到第一任期的任命，他说，那超出我们的预料。他还说，亚裔正在推动对较低层次的任命，以便为未来的内阁任命创造基础。
33829569527aa94b2c20ab150a23ff23461c0995.translatedText: Morrie had no complaints about that. "That was beyond our expectations," he said of the first-term appointments. He also said Asian Americans are pushing for lower-level appointments to create a basis for future Cabinet appointments.

b97e162a5f0b2d7b8e0896b5f7ffe05aa3ca6f45.sourceText: 移民问题也将提供亚裔美国人在国内政策辩论中的作用。拜登将在星期三晚上的讲话中谈移民改革，对夏威夷已故参议员丹尼尔?#20117;上（Daniel K. Inouye）致敬。
b97e162a5f0b2d7b8e0896b5f7ffe05aa3ca6f45.translatedText: Immigration issues will also provide insight into the role of Asian Americans in domestic policy debates. Biden will address immigration reform in a speech Wednesday night, paying tribute to the late Hawaii Sen. Daniel K. Inouye.

28ba714907dc0e96867482fbed2c6831fe66b511.sourceText: 针对参议院移民改革方案取消某些家属签证从而为高学历和高技能移民增加名额的条款，莫里等人正在向奥巴马施加压力。他说，家庭在亚洲文化中非常重要。
28ba714907dc0e96867482fbed2c6831fe66b511.translatedText: Murray and others are putting pressure on Obama in response to the Senate immigration reform plan's provision to eliminate certain family visas and increase quotas for highly educated and highly skilled immigrants. Family is very important in Asian culture, he said.

c977a53992d088ff6a0ceb99e7e98030fdeca39d.sourceText: 南亚美国人团结（South Asian Americans Leading Together）和亚太美国人全国理事会主席艾耶（Deepa Iyer）说，同奥巴马及其高级官员的会晤富有成效。
c977a53992d088ff6a0ceb99e7e98030fdeca39d.translatedText: Deepa Iyer, president of South Asian Americans Leading Together and the National Council of Asian and Pacific Americans, said the meeting with Obama and his senior officials was productive.

b381ea82cb2708e06ffdf741eeabaacbcbec1350.sourceText: 据中央人民广播电台报道，又是一年”报税”季！国库亏空、债台高筑，美国政府加紧追查国人海外账户和海外资产的真实性，一旦被查出在海外藏有资产，户主将被施以重罚。提醒想移民美国的华人，今后，移民美国或在美投资可要三思而后行了。
b381ea82cb2708e06ffdf741eeabaacbcbec1350.translatedText: According to the China People's Broadcasting Station, it's the tax filing season again! With the national treasury in deficit and high debt levels, the U.S. government has stepped up efforts to trace the authenticity of Chinese people’s overseas accounts and overseas assets. Once found to have assets hidden overseas, the head of the household will be severely fined. Chinese people who want to immigrate to the United States are reminded to think twice before immigrating or investing in the United States in the future.

028a59c20967e284b9f6e3ab236fd8184ecde6a3.sourceText: 《全球华语广播网》美国观察员余浩说，美国税法规定凡是在美国长期居住的人，不管是美国公民还是持有美国绿卡的外国人，在海外（也就是在美国之外）拥有5万美元以上的资产，或者储蓄在1万美元以上都要跟美国政府申报。其实这个法律早在1971年就有了，但以前并没有严格地执行。
028a59c20967e284b9f6e3ab236fd8184ecde6a3.translatedText: "Global Chinese Broadcasting Network" U.S. observer Yu Hao said that U.S. tax law stipulates that anyone who has lived in the United States for a long time, whether a U.S. citizen or a foreigner holding a U.S. green card, who owns assets of more than $50,000 overseas (that is, outside the United States) or has savings of more than $10,000 must declare to the U.S. government. In fact, this law existed as early as 1971, but it was not strictly enforced before.

e614d85bdcc184b1d0c29acea0a7457beb17fc34.sourceText: 奥巴马政府上台以后，加强了对美国人海外资产的追查，并且两次启动了海外资产主动申报计划，让拥有海外资产的美国人主动坦白交待以获得从宽处理，如果隐匿海外资产拒不申报视为有意逃税，如果被查出来会被处以重罚，严重的还会被判刑入监。
e614d85bdcc184b1d0c29acea0a7457beb17fc34.translatedText: After the Obama administration came to power, it has intensified its pursuit of Americans’ overseas assets, and launched the overseas asset declaration program twice, allowing Americans with overseas assets to confess and confess in order to receive leniency. If you conceal overseas assets and refuse to declare them, it will be deemed as intentional tax evasion. If found out, you will be severely fined, and in serious cases, you will be sentenced to prison.

442bac535dcf24a1adb238579eba5ab3e9436eba.sourceText: 第一轮主动申报到2009年10月15日结束时，美国国税局共收到了1.5万份境外资产申报书，涉及60多个国家的银行，虽然这只是冰山一角，美国政府并不满意，于是发起了第二轮的主动申报计划。以今年的8月31日为最后的期限，在此之前，以保护匿名账户著称的一家瑞士银行因为在一项诉讼中要与美国政府达成和解，从而向美国政府提供了4000多个账户的名字，其中有许多是在海外藏匿资产的富豪。
442bac535dcf24a1adb238579eba5ab3e9436eba.translatedText: By the end of the first round of voluntary declarations on October 15, 2009, the IRS had received a total of 15,000 overseas asset declarations, involving banks in more than 60 countries. Although this was just the tip of the iceberg, the U.S. government was not satisfied, so it launched a second round of voluntary declarations. With August 31 of this year as the deadline, before that, a Swiss bank known for protecting anonymous accounts provided the U.S. government with the names of more than 4,000 accounts, many of which were wealthy people who hid their assets overseas, because they wanted to reach a settlement with the U.S. government in a lawsuit.

383d04fcf81a03f03f263286d1b9afcfd978aeac.sourceText: 这犹如一石激起千层浪，美国政府警告在海外藏匿资产的美国人，不要心存侥幸，因为按照美国通过的海外账户税收遵从法的要求，所有想在美国经营的外国银行从2013年1月1日开始都必须向美国财政部提供客户信息，否则就被视为与美国政府不合作。
383d04fcf81a03f03f263286d1b9afcfd978aeac.translatedText: This is like a stone that stirs up a thousand waves. The U.S. government warns Americans who hide their assets overseas not to take any chances, because in accordance with the requirements of the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act passed by the United States, all foreign banks that want to operate in the United States must provide customer information to the U.S. Treasury Department starting from January 1, 2013, otherwise they will be deemed to be non-cooperative with the U.S. government.

9a43bd752f535b3ce123cdd87aab26e0f1b0eb03.sourceText: 影响 对华人影响大
9a43bd752f535b3ce123cdd87aab26e0f1b0eb03.translatedText: Impact It has a great impact on the Chinese

fefcc5c672abf3f844faf7832466064df3f97fb4.sourceText: 此举又对华人有哪些影响呢？
fefcc5c672abf3f844faf7832466064df3f97fb4.translatedText: What impact will this move have on the Chinese?

07a1320fe5cbaf7b9d6bf838dc74180bfebc48c8.sourceText: 余浩说，对华人的影响可以说是非常的大，因为中国是移民美国的大国，不管是中国内地还是台湾、香港，整个大约有250万的华人是第一代移民，这些人与祖籍地都有或多或少的经济上的联系。美国第一批海外资产自首计划推出以后就有不少的旅美台湾人惶惶不可终日。有不少人为了保住在台湾的资产，宁愿选择放弃美国的国籍或者绿卡。
07a1320fe5cbaf7b9d6bf838dc74180bfebc48c8.translatedText: Yu Hao said that the impact on the Chinese can be said to be very large, because China is a big country that immigrate to the United States. Whether it is mainland China, Taiwan, or Hong Kong, there are about 2.5 million Chinese who are first-generation immigrants. These people have more or less economic ties with their ancestral places. Since the launch of the United States' first batch of overseas asset surrender plan, many Taiwanese people living in the United States have been in panic. Many people would rather give up their U.S. citizenship or green card in order to preserve their assets in Taiwan.

27785a89cfc28c5201ff5837a6e9afc5b76a3f03.sourceText: 但是根据美国税法的规定，即便你放弃美国国籍，美国政府也可追溯5年，要你补交放弃国籍前五年拥有的海外资产隐匿不报而逃避的税收和罚金。美国国税局的规定出台以后，美国的华人会计师事务所生意变得格外好，很多人来打探消息，更多的人是在继续观望。
27785a89cfc28c5201ff5837a6e9afc5b76a3f03.translatedText: However, according to the provisions of the U.S. tax law, even if you give up your U.S. citizenship, the U.S. government can trace it back for 5 years and require you to pay the taxes and penalties you evaded by hiding the overseas assets you owned in the five years before you gave up your citizenship. After the IRS regulations were promulgated, the business of Chinese accounting firms in the United States became particularly good. Many people came to inquire about the information, and even more people continued to wait and see.

2b5cc6e3cdc7c43370e1011100909b4d951c53ce.sourceText: 美国政府为什么要这么做呢？
2b5cc6e3cdc7c43370e1011100909b4d951c53ce.translatedText: Why does the US government do this?

9ab0d42df65bd707a511602394ed6e906ed854d9.sourceText: 余浩表示，这主要是美国政府现在是债台高筑，2011年美国联邦赤字高达1.4万亿美元，未来几年联邦政府的财政赤字总额将达到8.7万亿美元，如此庞大的财务负担解决之道无非是开源节流。节流就要削减各部门的开支这是比较痛苦的事情，而堵塞税收的漏洞可成为开源的重要的手段。
9ab0d42df65bd707a511602394ed6e906ed854d9.translatedText: Yu Hao said that this is mainly because the U.S. government is now heavily in debt. In 2011, the U.S. federal deficit reached 1.4 trillion U.S. dollars. In the next few years, the total fiscal deficit of the federal government will reach 8.7 trillion U.S. dollars. The only way to solve such a huge financial burden is to increase revenue and reduce expenditure. To reduce expenditures, it is necessary to cut the expenditures of various departments, which is a relatively painful thing, and plugging tax loopholes can become an important means of increasing revenue.

690b500fa979e108d6797007becb4aaf607d2149.sourceText: 说到底就是美国人没钱了，现在需要找辙来弄钱。这就是为何原来早有要求申报海外资产的法律但没有严格的实施，而现在开始重拳出击的最主要的原因，因为这是一个大金矿。
690b500fa979e108d6797007becb4aaf607d2149.translatedText: The bottom line is that Americans have no money and now they need to find ways to get money. This is the main reason why there was a law requiring declaration of overseas assets but was not strictly implemented, and now we are starting to crack down hard, because this is a big gold mine.

0dff38a5a21433fe19900ce8e4e65c0bd7c61e4f.sourceText: 阿派奥嘲笑联邦种族成见调查 拒绝合作 （亚省时报） 阿派奥警长又惹麻烦了。一段音频记录显示，阿派奥警长曾在德克萨斯州一个反非法移民团体的集会上声称会在种族成见调查中拒绝合作，并嘲笑试图展开调查的官员，对联邦调查人员表示不屑。 马里科帕郡警长阿派奥2009年作出这一带有蔑视性表态时，联邦司法部已开始对他标志性的移民巡逻展开民权调查，联邦调查局也开始就其调查政敌时存在的滥用职权问题进行审查。 在2009年的休斯顿讲话录音中，阿派奥自称在官员和联邦调查人员开始对其巡逻吹毛求疵后，他逮捕了数百名非法移民。他说自己不会配合调查，但表示会减轻巡逻力度，如果自己被证明错了的话。 ”但我不会’合作’，在他们调查我之后，我们为了出气又逮捕了500人，”自称是”美国最严苛警察局长”的阿派奥说。音频中随后响起了笑声和掌声。 上周四接受采访时，阿派奥为自己在”德克萨斯支持移民改革”（Texans For Immigration Reform）面前的表态辩解，称那是一些幽默的即席发言，仅仅是为了表明他不会屈服于批评的声音。 ”这些不是正式的、宣誓为真的讲话，”阿派奥说。 目前，司法部已表示会对阿派奥违反民权法的行为提出起诉。阿派奥的办公室被指控歧视西裔，并对其移民巡逻政策的批评者实施报复。
0dff38a5a21433fe19900ce8e4e65c0bd7c61e4f.translatedText: Arpaio mocks federal racial stereotype investigation, refuses to cooperate (Alberta Times) Sheriff Arpaio is in trouble again. An audio recording shows Arpaio telling a rally by an anti-illegal immigration group in Texas that he would refuse to cooperate in a racial stereotype investigation, mocking officials who tried to open the investigation and expressing disdain for federal investigators. When Maricopa County Sheriff Arpaio made this disparaging statement in 2009, the federal Justice Department had begun a civil rights investigation into his signature immigration patrols, and the FBI had begun a review of abuses of power in its investigation of political opponents. In a 2009 taped speech in Houston, Arpaio claimed that he arrested hundreds of illegal immigrants after officials and federal investigators began to find fault with his patrols. He said he would not cooperate with the investigation but said he would reduce patrols if he was proven wrong. "But I won't 'cooperate,' and after they investigated me, we arrested 500 more people just to vent their anger," said Arpaio, who calls himself "the toughest police chief in the United States." The audio is followed by laughter and applause. In an interview last Thursday, Arpaio defended his remarks in front of Texans For Immigration Reform, saying they were some humorous impromptu remarks just to show that he would not give in to criticism. "These are not formal, sworn speeches," Arpaio said. At present, the Department of Justice has stated that it will prosecute Arpaio for violating civil rights laws. Arpaio's office has been accused of discriminating against Hispanics and retaliating against critics of his immigration patrol policies.

dc84ee7cf797ad50a4b87f502c73a227ec00efc4.translatedText: Mom, why don't you sing "Miss You"? "Have you ever listened to the recently popular song "Miss You" on the Internet?" My friend asked curiously. "Yes...

ee5245cd85ffa2192027867c43d2c0984b1cae79.sourceText: 妈妈何不唱「念你」？ 「有没在网上听听最近有一首很夯、被炒得很热的『念你』？」朋友好奇的问着。 「有啊！有啊！」我连忙接腔：「我们不都是随着刘家昌的歌长大的吗？如今他儿子都出道了，我们自然也要关心一下，对不？」 「我不懂唱歌，所以也听不出来这歌到底好不好听，听说网上先是一阵如潮的恶评，然后又有人说这是一种成功的逆向打歌宣传，不管是好是坏，反正是把这歌给唱红了，」另一位朋友笑了笑说：「妳们看！连咱们这些海外欧巴桑都听过，到底是这歌实在太夯？还是我们都跟得上流行呢！」 「可见咱们这些『大妈、大婶』，心里可都还揣着年轻的心境啊！」大伙儿会心地一笑。 我满心感慨的说：「我相信一定有不少人和我一样，喜欢『我的字典里没有放弃』这句歌词，因为唱起来自然会带出6几许希望和憧憬的意味。」 「我倒是更喜欢『念你』这个歌名。」朋友说出她的想法：「我老公经常说我这个人，最大的毛病就是喜欢念念叨叨，其实他那儿知道，我这样念呀念呀的，也是一种感情的表达嘛！」 对呀！这话可真是一语惊醒梦中人哪！ 谁说流行歌曲就一定是年轻男女之间「爱恨情仇」的专利呢？ 妈妈们唱流行歌曲，也别有一番「母爱」的情韵哩！ 不信您瞧瞧「念你」的歌词： 「我的字典里没有放弃， 因为已锁定你，我从不写空白的日记， 日记里全是你。 眼前这月亮悄悄溜走， 那个太阳又缓缓升起， 多少个昼夜变换，多少次一年四季， 爱不偷懒、始终如一。」 这歌词，不禁让我想起好友益琳，多年来不但对她那有唐氏症儿子的悉心照顾，也积极地关心家有唐宝宝的父母；也想起澳洲的尼克(Nick Vujicic)，一出生就没有四肢，但他的牧师父母却从不放弃，坚信尼克是上帝手中的杰作，如今他果然成为世界著名的生命斗士与激励大师；还有天生脑性痲痹的黄美廉，在父母的永不放弃的爱心与祷告中成长，后来得到南加洲大学的艺术博士学位，她的每幅作画都如阳光般的璀灿明亮‥‥。 突然间发现古今中外许多伟大的父母，心中不都是有股「念你」歌词中「我的字典里没有放弃」的信念与坚韧吗？ 而像我这种平凡的母亲，把一对平凡的儿女拉拔长大的岁月中，心境上不也是从不因他们的平凡而放弃理想，总是期勉自己，要以感恩的心，和他们一起成长吗？ 看来，「念你」或许还真可以成为妈妈之歌呢！ 不妨想象一下，若是年轻的妈妈怀抱着熟睡的婴儿，口中低吟着「念你」，这场景多美呀！ 而当妈妈面对着叛逆、怒吼、桀骜不驯的青少年儿女，若能摆下身段，柔声轻声唱着「我的字典里没有放弃‥‥，‥‥爱不偷懒、始终如一。」又将会是个什么画面？
ee5245cd85ffa2192027867c43d2c0984b1cae79.translatedText: Why don't mom sing "Miss You"? "Have you ever listened to the recently popular song "Miss You" on the Internet?" My friend asked curiously. "Yes! Yes!" I quickly added: "Didn't we all grow up following Liu Jiachang's songs? Now that his son has made his debut, we naturally have to care about him, right?" "I don't know how to sing, so I can't tell whether this song is good or not. I heard that there was a flood of negative comments on the Internet, and then some people said that this is a successful reverse song promotion. Regardless of whether it is good or bad, it made the song famous." Another friend smiled and said, "Look! Even us overseas oppasans have heard it. Is this song too popular? Or are we all caught up with the popularity!" "It shows that we 'aunts' are still young at heart!" Everyone smiled knowingly. I said with emotion: "I believe there must be many people like me who like the lyrics of "I don't give up in my dictionary" because when you sing it, it will naturally bring out a bit of hope and longing." "I prefer the title of the song "Miss You"." My friend expressed her thoughts: "My husband often says that my biggest problem is that I like to talk about it. In fact, he knows that when I read and recite like this, it is also an expression of emotion!" Yes! These words are really enough to wake people up from their dreams! Who says that pop songs must be the exclusive domain of "love, hate, and hatred" between young men and women? When mothers sing popular songs, they also have a special sense of "maternal love"! If you don't believe me, take a look at the lyrics of "Missing You": "There is no giving up in my dictionary, because I have locked you in, I never write a blank diary, the diary is full of you. The moon in front of me quietly slips away, and the sun slowly rises again, how many days and nights change, how many times throughout the year, love is not lazy and remains the same." This lyrics reminds me of my good friend Yi Lin, who has not only taken good care of her son with Down syndrome for many years, but also actively cares about the parents of babies with Down syndrome; I also think of Nick from Australia. Vujicic), who was born without limbs, but his pastor parents never gave up and firmly believed that Nick was a masterpiece in the hands of God. Now he has indeed become a world-famous life fighter and motivational master; and Huang Meilian, who was born with cerebral palsy, grew up in the love and prayer of her parents who never gave up, and later received a doctorate in art from the University of Southern California. Each of her paintings is as bright as the sun. Suddenly, I discovered that many great parents in ancient and modern times, at home and abroad, don’t all have the faith and tenacity in their hearts that “there is no giving up in my dictionary” in the lyrics of “Miss You”? And when an ordinary mother like me brings up a pair of ordinary children, doesn't she never give up her ideals because of their ordinaryness, and always encourages herself to grow up with them with a grateful heart? It seems that "Missing You" may really become a mother's song! Just imagine how beautiful the scene would be if a young mother held her sleeping baby in her arms and whispered "I miss you"! And when a mother is faced with rebellious, roaring, and unruly teenage children, what will it be like if she can lower her body and sing softly, "There is no giving up in my dictionary, ‥‥love is not lazy, and it is consistent." What will it be like?

a514fdf72eba141a972cf746d985650926fdbcc6.sourceText: 中国国民党党主席补选结果于三月二十六日宣布，立法院前副院长洪秀柱以56.16%得票率，跨越过半门槛，顺利当选新任党主席。党中央规划于三月三十日举办交接典礼，任期到明年七月底。洪秀柱从政资历二十馀年，连任八届立委，党员资历五十年，从国民党区域立委、不分区立委、国民党副秘书长到立法院副院长。具备相当的党政资历，娴熟行政立法的运作。她之所以参选，深知这是一次关键的选举，国民党能否重新再起，全赖新任党主席的作为。
a514fdf72eba141a972cf746d985650926fdbcc6.translatedText: The results of the by-election for the chairman of the Chinese Kuomintang Party were announced on March 26. Hong Xiuzhu, the former vice president of the Legislative Yuan, received 56.16% of the votes, crossing the majority threshold and was successfully elected as the new party chairman. The Party Central Committee plans to hold a handover ceremony on March 30, and the term will last until the end of July next year. Hong Xiuzhu has been in politics for more than 20 years and has been reelected as a legislator for eight terms. He has been a party member for 50 years, ranging from KMT regional legislator, non-district legislator, KMT deputy secretary-general to vice-president of the Legislative Yuan. Have considerable party and government qualifications and be proficient in the operation of administrative legislation. The reason why she ran for office was because she knew that this was a crucial election and whether the Kuomintang could come back again depended entirely on the actions of the new party chairman.

5ad98ecaf99979a4cb65dc5a8e5a4f486801d981.sourceText: 中国国民党亚利桑那直属分部认同洪秀柱两岸关係与国家定位的立场。 在两岸关係上，坚持九二共识、一中各表，并在此基础上签署互利对等之经济、贸易、和平等协定。在国家定位上， 翻转民进党长达二十多年来的”去中国化”、”去1949年前中华民国化”、”李登辉路线”等政治操作。坚决维护中华民国宪法的尊严，捍卫中华民国存在的价值！李登辉对中华民国及国民党的伤害，无需赘述，是洪秀柱在中常会中提桉开除他。
5ad98ecaf99979a4cb65dc5a8e5a4f486801d981.translatedText: The Arizona Branch of the Chinese Kuomintang agrees with Hong Xiuzhu’s position on cross-strait relations and national positioning. In terms of cross-Strait relations, we adhere to the 1992 Consensus and one China, each with different representations, and sign mutually beneficial and reciprocal economic, trade, peace and other agreements on this basis. In terms of national positioning, we must overturn the political operations of the Democratic Progressive Party such as "de-Sinicization", "de-Republicanization of pre-1949", and "Lee Teng-hui's line" that have been carried out for more than 20 years. Resolutely safeguard the dignity of the Constitution of the Republic of China and defend the value of the existence of the Republic of China! There is no need to go into details about Lee Teng-hui's harm to the Republic of China and the Kuomintang. It was Hong Xiuzhu who proposed his dismissal at the Central Committee Standing Committee.

275b14f665d11a967b3b2858d3d0cc651da50e22.translatedText: > comments on the current situation in Taiwan, briefly stated as follows:

e433f8aa2a57a9273c606aa9fe2b081243dffec2.sourceText: 国家定位，要回归正统中华民国，倘若仅仅别有用心，借壳上市，必终 失败。承认九二共识，才能维持现状，持续两岸交流，发展经济，稳定外交。 全民总统不切实际，施政有欠週延，用人未尽其才。立法院上下，失职失能。台北市长及九合一公职选举，已严重失策，总统选举，更是未听取民意，荒腔走板。主流派、本土派、权贵派各拥山头，自私自利。 常言道 ”欲亡其国，先亡其史”，民进党操作媒体、教育、行政、立法、族群，极尽可能地去中国化，明明从 唐山过海而来，但现在都不是中国人。 民进党喊国民党党产不当，国民党自己先赶紧清算。党产从九百多亿只剩二百亿不到，除李登辉与刘泰英以外，还有那些内奸外贼? 我们声援非法党产一分不要， 合法党产一分不放。 二二八事件本省同胞受难者，美丽岛杂志估计十万人，李登辉立碑一万人，外省同胞无一死伤！没有事实，绝不会有公平、正义。愿二二八事件能还原真相，公开于世。 经国时代台湾有经济奇蹟，李扁时代有政治奇蹟。君不见，岩里之”外来政权” ”日本祖国”；水扁之”美国托管” ”建国基金”；王氏之”立院协商”。思之，诚令人无比感概。今逢国父 孙中山先生逝世一百五十週年，”然革命尚未成功，同志仍须努力”。 最后，由惠斌华同志领唱蓝天白云、中华民国颂及梅花。世事变迁，情怀依旧。 同志们咸盼再次的聚会。 期许洪主席重新唤起党德党魂，确立中华民国宪法及三民主义中心思想，带领全党团结同心、浴火重生。 改革的路是艰难的，祝中国国民党改革成功！
e433f8aa2a57a9273c606aa9fe2b081243dffec2.translatedText: The country's positioning is to return to the orthodox Republic of China. If it is just a backdoor listing with ulterior motives, it will eventually fail. Only by recognizing the 1992 Consensus can we maintain the status quo, continue cross-strait exchanges, develop the economy, and stabilize diplomacy. A national president is unrealistic, his administration is not comprehensive, and his people are not using their talents to the best of their ability. The entire Legislative Yuan is derelict and incompetent. The Taipei mayor and nine-in-one public office elections have been seriously misguided. In the presidential election, public opinion has not been listened to and the policy has been ignored. The mainstream faction, the local faction, and the elite faction all have their own interests. As the saying goes, "If you want to destroy your country, you must destroy its history first." The DPP manipulates the media, education, administration, legislation, and ethnic groups to de-Sinicize it as much as possible. It is obvious that they came from Tangshan across the sea, but they are not Chinese now. The DPP claimed that the Kuomintang’s party assets were inappropriate and the Kuomintang should liquidate them first. The party's assets have gone from more than 90 billion to less than 20 billion. Apart from Lee Teng-hui and Liu Taiying, who are the traitors and foreign traitors? We support the illegal party assets and do not let go of any legal party assets. Formosa Magazine estimates that the victims of the February 28 Incident were 100,000 compatriots from our province, and Lee Teng-hui erected a monument to 10,000 people. No compatriots from other provinces were killed or injured! Without facts, there will never be fairness and justice. I hope the truth about the February 28 incident can be restored and made public to the world. Taiwan had an economic miracle during the Ching-guo era, and a political miracle during the Li Bian era. You may not see it, but Iwazato's "foreign regime" and "Japan's motherland"; Shuibian's "American Trusteeship" and "National Founding Fund"; Wang's "legislative consultation". Thinking about it, it makes people extremely impressed. Today marks the 150th anniversary of the death of Dr. Sun Yat-sen, the founding father of the country. "However, the revolution has not yet succeeded, and comrades still have to work hard." Finally, Comrade Hui Binhua led the singing of blue sky and white clouds, Ode to the Republic of China and plum blossoms. Things change, but feelings remain the same. Comrades are looking forward to gathering again. It is hoped that Chairman Hong will reawaken the party's morality and soul, establish the Constitution of the Republic of China and the central ideology of the Three People's Principles, and lead the entire party to unite and rise from the ashes. The road to reform is difficult. I wish the Chinese Kuomintang success in its reform!

0d4f8a1610dd4a51921b6410c0e7b5fff6b9e8d1.sourceText: 亚利桑那州长否决允许带枪进政府大楼法案 布鲁尔州长周二否决了一个有争议的法案。该法案如果通过的话，将允许人们携带枪支进入州政府大楼，而这些政府大楼过去是禁止带枪者进入的。 布鲁尔是连续第二年否决这个受到枪支权利倡导者支持的法案。枪支权利倡导者要求人们有权带枪进入公共建筑。 按照本州目前的法律，州政府当局可禁止人们携带枪支进入诸如图书馆、老年中心及市政厅等公共建筑。这些公共建筑的入口处也有禁止携枪进入的告示牌。 布鲁尔说，在将该法案签署成为法律之前还需要进行更加全面及协作性的讨论。 布鲁尔在她否决该法案的决议中说，在这些极端敏感的地方允许或禁止携带枪支的决定都应该以合作方式做出，并受到广大利益相关方的支持。 亚利桑那公民防卫联盟的共同创始人海勒说：”我们希望她能更多地尊重亚利桑那宪法中的有关保有并携带武器的条款。”法案的反对者称，这一否决是一种对在公共场所携带枪支所做出的”常识性的做法”。 布鲁尔在其否决决定中还说，她担心政府会被迫承担用于限制枪支被带入公共建筑的安全措施所需的财政支出。 全美有9个州完成类似立法，允许携枪者进入政府大楼。
0d4f8a1610dd4a51921b6410c0e7b5fff6b9e8d1.translatedText: Arizona governor vetoes bill to allow guns into government buildings Governor Brewer vetoed a controversial bill on Tuesday. If passed, the bill would allow people to carry guns into state government buildings that were previously off-limits. For the second year in a row, Brewer vetoed the bill, which was backed by gun rights advocates. Gun rights advocates demand the right for people to carry guns into public buildings. Under current state law, state authorities can ban people from carrying guns into public buildings such as libraries, senior centers and city halls. There are also signs at the entrances to these public buildings prohibiting firearms. Brewer said more comprehensive and collaborative discussions are needed before the bill can be signed into law. In her resolution vetoing the bill, Brewer said decisions to allow or ban firearms in these extremely sensitive places should be made collaboratively and with support from a broad range of stakeholders. "We hope she will be more respectful of the keep and bear arms provisions of the Arizona Constitution," said Heller, co-founder of the Arizona Citizens Defense League. Opponents of the bill called the veto a "common sense approach" to carrying guns in public. In her veto decision, Brewer also said she was concerned the government would be forced to shoulder the financial costs of security measures to limit guns from being brought into public buildings. Nine states across the United States have completed similar legislation to allow gun carriers to enter government buildings.

412dd944cd748f322e26a40411cc754433a8d181.sourceText: 干旱仍持续 专家忧食品价格将升高 由于美国中西部的干旱已经伤害了玉米和大豆的供应，专家提醒全美各地的购物者，若迟迟久旱不雨，包括牛奶和肉类等食品价格后续恐有上涨压力。 干旱和高温已损坏了农作物，经济学家担心情况会有进一步的恶化。如果饲料价格上涨，预计今年将持平或下降的牛奶价格可能会上涨。至于干旱的影响如何，要到八月初或九月才会知道。 美国农业部每月都提供食品的估计价格，但6月份的数据显示，在未考虑最近谷物涨价的情况下，关键项目的增长低于5％，如乳制品和肉制品等。而干旱对物价的影响，更新的数字将发布于7月25日。 有经济学家预计，今年的玉米供应会充裕，因为许多在玉米种植地带的种植者－－包括伊利诺伊州、印第安纳州、爱荷华州、内布拉斯加州和明尼苏达州，都加大了玉米的种植面积，以满足日益增长的全球需求，但是现在因为干旱和高温产量将下降。 一蒲式耳玉米的价格，本周在芝加哥贸易交易所达到7.48美元。今年和明年政府的预测数字是一蒲式耳6.40美元。上个月的预测是每蒲式耳为4.20至5美元。 对消费者来说，食品价格预期会上涨不算新闻。美国普渡大学的农业经济学家科琳娜亚历山大解释说：”粮食价格在2011年的通胀率远高于正常。去年超市的食品通货膨胀率是4.8％，今年预期在2％左右。干旱意味着食品价格在2012年到2013年的上涨会超过预期。加工食品如谷类食品，预计不会有大幅上涨，除非有严重短缺，因为去年生产商已经大幅提高了价格。”但她补充说，像食油和沙拉酱这种东西的成本可能会上涨，因为大豆作物也受到影响。
412dd944cd748f322e26a40411cc754433a8d181.translatedText: Drought continues, experts worry food prices will rise As a drought in the U.S. Midwest has hurt the supply of corn and soybeans, experts are reminding shoppers across the country that if there is no rain for a long time, there may be rising pressure on food prices, including milk and meat. Drought and heat have damaged crops, and economists fear the situation will worsen. Milk prices, which are expected to be flat or declining this year, could rise if feed prices rise. As for the impact of the drought, we won't know until early August or September. The USDA provides estimated food prices each month, but the June data showed growth of less than 5% in key items, such as dairy and meat products, without taking into account recent increases in grain prices. As for the impact of drought on prices, updated figures will be released on July 25. Some economists expect corn supplies to be abundant this year as many growers in the Corn Belt, including Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Nebraska and Minnesota, have increased corn planting acreage to meet growing global demand, but now yields will decline due to drought and high temperatures. The price of a bushel of corn reached $7.48 on the Chicago Board of Trade this week. The government's forecast for this year and next is $6.40 a bushel. Last month's forecast was for $4.20 to $5 per bushel. For consumers, the expected rise in food prices is little news. Corinna Alexander, an agricultural economist at Purdue University, explained: "Food price inflation in 2011 was much higher than normal. Last year supermarket food inflation was 4.8%, and this year it is expected to be around 2%. The drought means food prices will be lower in 2012 and 2013." "Processed foods, such as cereals, are not expected to see significant increases because producers have already raised prices significantly last year," she added, but costs for things like cooking oils and salad dressings are likely to increase because soybean crops are also affected.

7b9e7dc3883668275685ebb305df92b0755ada08.sourceText: (凤凰城侨联通讯)美洲第廿五届、全美第廿九届的中华会馆、中华公所、华侨总会联谊会议於2012年8月20日至8月22日在美国洛杉磯举行，全美洲18个国家、数十个城市的83名代表出席了大会。凤凰城侨联副主席张肇鸿出席会议并向大会作了侨情报告。 美国的中华会馆、中华公所过百年的歷史。凤凰城侨联总会和各地的中华会馆和中华公所的地位同等。本届年会是在新的歷史条件下举行，大会宗旨已在宣言中首句点明: ”团结侨社沟通两岸促进互信共创双赢”。预示着各地的中华会馆、中华公所、华侨总会在今后将朝向新的重要工作方向。 宣言指出：一百年前，旅居世界各地的华侨，尤其是美、加地区的华侨，鼎力支持孙中山先生领导的民主革命，发动侨胞筹集革命经费，组织华侨回国参加革命军，歷次起义，从事推翻满清皇朝的封建统治，建立亚洲第一个民主共和国-中华民国。不少华侨為此毁家抒难，捨身成仁。我们回顾歷史事实证明，国父孙中山先生所言「华侨為革命之母」当之无愧，也倍感自豪。 宣言指出：近几年来，日本政府频频施计，意欲侵占祖国领土钓鱼台；菲律宾政府也不断在南沙群岛附近进行干预我国渔民的事件，面对外国的挑衅，台海两岸的同胞同仇敌愾，本届年会期望两岸政府共同為保衞国土主权，不容外国侵犯而作出多方面的努力。 宣言指出：自从中国国民党重新执政以来，在马英九总统主张「不统、不独、不武」的理念、和两岸政府在「九二共识」的政治互信下，两岸关系进入和平蓬勃发展，并积极拓展侨务工作。 本届年会定於今后的任务有： (一)以「协和万邦」的优良传统，努力推进侨胞与居住国的民族和睦相处，帮助新移民适应新环境，谋求新生活。鼓励华侨、华人融入当地的主流社会，大力支持华侨、华人参政，提高社会地位并维护争取合法的权益。(二)加强与台湾、大陆的联络沟通，促进两岸双方合作，為促进两岸经济发展，改善人民生活，推行民主政治，增进社会文明进步作出积极贡献。(叁)弘扬中华文化，在侨社大力推行中文教育，运用高科技，传媒、广播、电视、网路推广中华文化。在青少年方面，多举办寻根问祖活动，提高他们学习兴趣，使中华传统文化能够代代相传。(四)加强中华会馆、中华公所、华侨总会与各地侨社的紧密联繫，取长补短、互助合作、共同进步，為侨胞谋求福祉而努力。 张肇鸿在侨情报告中向大会介绍了凤凰城侨联歷史与近年的活动情况。并向侨务委员长吴英毅先生、大会主席马国威先生、秘书长黄金泉先生以及与会的代表们，赠送了凤凰城侨团歷史书籍”沙漠明珠”，让亚省和凤凰城的先进人物事跡与本土文化艺术，能得到更广泛的宣扬和传播，而华侨协会总会的沈大川先生明确地表示，将会把”沙漠明珠”一书归档到总会的图书馆中。
7b9e7dc3883668275685ebb305df92b0755ada08.translatedText: (Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation Newsletter) The 25th China Association of the Americas and the 29th China Association, China Office, and Overseas Chinese Association Networking Conference in the United States were held in Los Angeles, the United States, from August 20 to August 22, 2012. 83 representatives from 18 countries and dozens of cities in the United States attended the conference. Zhang Zhaohong, vice chairman of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation, attended the meeting and made a report on the overseas Chinese situation at the conference. The Chinese Association and the Chinese Association in the United States have a history of more than a hundred years. The Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation has the same status as the Chinese Associations and Chinese Offices in various places. This annual conference is held under new historical conditions. The purpose of the conference has been stated in the first sentence of the declaration: "Unite the overseas Chinese community, communicate with both sides of the Taiwan Strait, promote mutual trust and create a win-win situation." It indicates that Chinese associations, Chinese offices, and overseas Chinese associations in various places will move towards new and important work directions in the future. The declaration points out: A hundred years ago, overseas Chinese living around the world, especially those in the United States and Canada, fully supported the democratic revolution led by Dr. Sun Yat-sen. They mobilized overseas Chinese to raise funds for the revolution, organized overseas Chinese to return to China to join the revolutionary army, carried out various uprisings, overthrew the feudal rule of the Qing Dynasty, and established Asia's first democratic republic, the Republic of China. Many overseas Chinese destroyed their homes to express their suffering and sacrificed their lives for charity. We look back at the historical facts and prove that the founding father Dr. Sun Yat-sen's words that "overseas Chinese are the mother of the revolution" are well deserved and we are very proud of. The declaration pointed out: In recent years, the Japanese government has frequently made plans to invade and occupy Diaoyutai, the territory of the motherland; the Philippine government has also continued to intervene in incidents involving Chinese fishermen near the Nansha Islands. In the face of foreign provocations, compatriots on both sides of the Taiwan Strait share the same hatred. This annual meeting hopes that the governments on both sides of the Taiwan Strait will jointly make multi-faceted efforts to safeguard territorial sovereignty and not allow foreign aggression. The declaration stated: Since the Chinese Kuomintang returned to power, under President Ma Ying-jeou’s philosophy of “no unification, no independence, and no force” and the political mutual trust between the cross-Strait governments under the “1992 Consensus”, cross-Strait relations have developed peacefully and vigorously, and overseas Chinese affairs have been actively expanded. The tasks set for this annual meeting in the future are: (1) Based on the fine tradition of "harmony among all nations", strive to promote harmonious coexistence between overseas Chinese and the ethnic groups in the country of residence, and help new immigrants adapt to the new environment and pursue a new life. Encourage overseas Chinese and Chinese to integrate into the local mainstream society, vigorously support overseas Chinese and Chinese to participate in politics, improve their social status and safeguard their legitimate rights and interests. (2) Strengthen liaison and communication with Taiwan and the mainland, promote cross-strait cooperation, and make positive contributions to promoting cross-strait economic development, improving people's lives, promoting democratic politics, and promoting social civilization and progress. (3) Promote Chinese culture, vigorously promote Chinese education in overseas Chinese communities, and use high technology, media, radio, television, and the Internet to promote Chinese culture. For young people, more root-searching and ancestor-seeking activities will be held to increase their interest in learning so that traditional Chinese culture can be passed on from generation to generation. (4) Strengthen the close ties between the Chinese Association, the Chinese Office, the Overseas Chinese Association and overseas Chinese communities in various places, learn from each other’s strengths, cooperate with each other, make progress together, and work hard for the well-being of overseas Chinese. In his report on the overseas Chinese situation, Zhang Zhaohong introduced the history and recent activities of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation to the conference. The chairman of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee, Mr. Wu Yingyi, the chairman of the conference, Mr. Ma Guowei, the secretary-general, Mr. Huang Huangquan, and the representatives present at the conference, presented the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Mission’s history book “Pearl of the Desert” to allow the deeds of advanced figures and local culture and art in Alberta and Phoenix to be more widely publicized and disseminated. Mr. Shen Dachuan of the Overseas Chinese Association Federation made it clear that the book “Pearl of the Desert” will be archived in the library of the association.

b9b8a1f6e739c055619b9a37351e6f7dc2e8b4a8.translatedText: I hope the Chinese school's composition will be published: Autumn vacation Author Wang Yuxuan, third grade Our autumn vacation was very happy. Although we didn’t travel, we did a lot of good things...

d41ef60632d5db60f58e19f7af3c77e9d5c90b16.sourceText: 作者 汪瑀瑄 三年级 我们的秋假过得很开心。虽然没有出外旅行，但是也做了不少好玩的事情。 我们去艺术馆参观。艺术馆的义工让小朋友做小丑玩偶。我和妹妹挑自己喜欢的布做小丑的衣服和头发。我还给小丑衣服粘上蕾丝。我们做的小丑样子都不相同。每个完成小丑玩偶的小朋友都能得到一个又红又圆的小丑鼻子。带着小丑鼻子的样子真好笑。 我们还在家里给图画上颜色， 去图书馆借书，跟奶奶去逛街。奶奶还给我买了不少秋季的衣服。秋假虽然过得很开心，我和妹妹还是希望可以快点上学。
d41ef60632d5db60f58e19f7af3c77e9d5c90b16.translatedText: Author Wang Yuxuan, Grade 3 We had a great time during our autumn vacation. Although I didn’t travel, I did a lot of fun things. We went to visit an art gallery. Volunteers from the art museum let children make clown dolls. My sister and I picked the cloth we liked to make the clown’s clothes and hair. I also glued lace on the clown costume. The clowns we make all look different. Each child who completes the clown doll will get a red and round clown nose. It looks so funny with a clown nose. We also colored pictures at home, borrowed books from the library, and went shopping with grandma. Grandma also bought me a lot of autumn clothes. Although we had a great time during the autumn break, my sister and I still hope to go to school as soon as possible.

deae542bf51ad279dd61df9be9c801f5129f25cc.sourceText: 我的Las Vagas 旅行日记 作者 轩轩 三年级 2014年10月2日，我，弟弟，妈妈和爸爸5：00从亚利桑那开车去Las Vagas开始我们的旅行了！到达已经是晚上9：00了，我们去”新光”吃了宵夜然后回到舅公公的家，大家都很累了所以大家都早睡。 10月3号 ，早上妈妈和爸爸已经起来了，舅公公出去了，我和弟弟晚起床，弟弟不喜欢吃那些早餐，妈妈告诉弟弟不要浪费，后来弟弟就吃了。然后我们开车去爬山，路上爸爸说我们爬的山叫”红石山”，到达后一座大山就在我们的眼前！那座山果然是红色的， 而且是由一块一快的巨大的石头堆叠起来的，有的像剑，有的像蘑菇，有的像房子，还有的像老鹰的头！爬到高处的时侯我有一点点怕，可弟弟一点都不怕，于是我也变勇敢了，我们休息的时侯发现高处 的石头像烤了一样有一点一点烧烤的痕迹 ，我还发现了一个怪植物，它又像仙人球又不是。就像一个粉红色的刺球！ 我喜欢这里的风景，我喜欢这里的植物，我喜欢这里的小动物，我更喜欢一家人在这里爬山！
deae542bf51ad279dd61df9be9c801f5129f25cc.translatedText: My Las Vagas Travel Diary Author Xuanxuan Grade 3 On October 2, 2014, my brother, my mother and my father drove from Arizona to Las Vagas at 5:00 to start our trip! It was already 9:00 pm when we arrived. We went to "Xinguang" for a late-night snack and then returned to my uncle's house. Everyone was very tired, so everyone went to bed early. On October 3rd, my mother and father had already gotten up in the morning, my uncle and uncle had gone out, and my brother and I got up late. My brother didn't like to eat those breakfasts, so my mother told him not to waste them, and then my brother ate them. Then we drove to climb the mountain. On the way, my father said that the mountain we climbed was called "Red Rock Mountain". When we arrived, a big mountain was right in front of us! The mountain was indeed red, and it was made up of huge stones stacked up. Some looked like swords, some looked like mushrooms, some looked like houses, and some looked like eagle heads! When we climbed to a high place, I was a little scared, but my brother was not afraid at all, so I became brave. When we were resting, we found that the stones at the high place had little traces of barbecue, as if they were baked. I also found a strange plant, which looked like a cactus but was not. Like a pink spiked ball! I like the scenery here, I like the plants here, I like the small animals here, and I even like climbing mountains here as a family!

5313561d105e9465eb3d404f0f737d50f3b7d850.sourceText: 我 的 秋 假 作者 Jiayi Yu 三年级
5313561d105e9465eb3d404f0f737d50f3b7d850.translatedText: My Autumn Holiday Author Jiayi Yu Third grade

39033b4eab64277ec47bd7792c2551e0abf3f345.sourceText: 我们放假了。 我们去加州洛杉矶玩。第一天大家去了一个小岛。我坐船看见了很多海豚，还有一只鲸鱼。到了岛上，我们先爬山，然后去海滩玩。我发现一个小章鱼。最后我们还看见两只小狐狸。
39033b4eab64277ec47bd7792c2551e0abf3f345.translatedText: We have a holiday. We went to Los Angeles, California. On the first day, everyone went to a small island. I saw many dolphins and a whale on the boat. When we got to the island, we first climbed the mountain and then went to the beach. I found a small octopus. Finally we saw two little foxes.

2f4531bfd8b478e4f27c71f43336ebad47360f6c.sourceText: 第二天，我们去我的朋友毛毛住的旅馆。那儿离海滩很近。大家在海滩上玩了很久。我玩得很高兴。
2f4531bfd8b478e4f27c71f43336ebad47360f6c.translatedText: The next day, we went to the hotel where my friend Maomao was staying. It's very close to the beach. Everyone played on the beach for a long time. I had a great time.

7a38004c1d5b5cffa1e916664606fc762207778c.sourceText: 海边嬉戏 第三天，我们去了自然历史博物馆，看了很多蜘蛛和恐龙化石。
7a38004c1d5b5cffa1e916664606fc762207778c.translatedText: Playing at the seaside On the third day, we went to the Natural History Museum and saw a lot of spiders and dinosaur fossils.

488b6b8cc71d919862f4b4f94e1790bf8112f927.sourceText: 最后一天我们去了一个很漂亮的海滩。我找到了很多的小虫子。我们玩了很长时间。我真喜欢去加州洛杉矶玩。
488b6b8cc71d919862f4b4f94e1790bf8112f927.translatedText: On the last day we went to a beautiful beach. I found a lot of little bugs. We played for a long time. I really love going to Los Angeles, California.

bf7bd5d8500f632c0e7581cccd989b9cd1ef87f8.sourceText: 三虎子比我小两岁，在家里排行老三，本来有挺响亮的名字，大名叫喜贵，小名叫和平，可屯子里的人都叫他三虎子。
bf7bd5d8500f632c0e7581cccd989b9cd1ef87f8.translatedText: San Huzi is two years younger than me, and he is the third eldest child in the family. He originally had a very famous name, his first name is Xigui, and his nickname is Heping, but everyone in the village calls him San Huzi.

a1f9c2aff66af4cd4d202ebf18bba62da58277d9.sourceText: 原来，他打小出奇的淘气，上树逮鸟，下河摸鱼无所不能，就是不愿意念书。为这事他爹没少打他，可他特别抗揍，说个文一点的词，叫抗击打能力强。他爹用裤腰带抽、拿镰刀把抡，三虎子全不在乎。后来他爹得出结论：这小子他妈的，虎啊（东北话就是傻的意思）！从此再也不提让他上学的事，三虎子的名字就叫起来了。
a1f9c2aff66af4cd4d202ebf18bba62da58277d9.translatedText: It turns out that he was extremely naughty when he was young. He could catch birds in trees and fish in rivers, but he just didn't want to study. His father beat him frequently for this matter, but he was particularly resistant to beatings. To put it mildly, he was called strong in resisting beatings. His father whipped him with his belt and swung it with a sickle, but Sanhuzi didn't care at all. Later, his father came to the conclusion: This kid is a fucking tiger (meaning stupid in Northeastern dialect)! From then on, the matter of letting him go to school was never mentioned again, and Sanhuzi's name was called out.

aadde6d3ca2bad403751dcecc05a19f8ff67c3bf.sourceText: 三虎子他爹杨瘸子是大队干部，他不是”一天一只鸡，五天一只羊，村村都有丈母娘。”的恶霸。但经常”身披黄大衣，张嘴妈个逼”。很少见他有笑模样。杨瘸子有点踮脚，走起路来搭在肩上的那件黄大衣摇来摆去的 ，特别威风。
aadde6d3ca2bad403751dcecc05a19f8ff67c3bf.translatedText: Sanhuzi's father, Yang Laizi, is a brigade cadre. He is not a bully who says "a chicken a day, a sheep every five days, and every village has a mother-in-law." But he often "wears a yellow coat and opens his mouth like a motherfucker". It's rare to see him smiling. Yang Laizi stood on tiptoe a little, and the yellow coat swayed on his shoulders when he walked, which was particularly majestic.

318a400475c9e0c77ca989d634cabd969dbbbc87.sourceText: 杨瘸子还有个特点，眼珠子不是同一方向转，而是反着来。两个黑眼球不是相对着挤在鼻梁两侧；就是往两边的太阳穴那使劲。让人看不明白他在看谁，也捉摸不透他在想什么。杨瘸子虽然不是大队一把手，可我们这个屯子里的人都怕他。唯一不怕他的就是三虎子。
318a400475c9e0c77ca989d634cabd969dbbbc87.translatedText: Yang Laizi also has another characteristic. His eyes don't turn in the same direction, but in the opposite direction. The two black eyeballs are either crowded on either side of the bridge of the nose, or they are pushing hard towards the temples on both sides. It's hard to figure out who he's looking at or what he's thinking. Although Yang Laizi is not the leader of the brigade, everyone in our village is afraid of him. The only one who is not afraid of him is San Huzi.

c2df99fe47d6decd7fa461a24ecb976d3fcef93f.sourceText: 三虎子其实特别聪明，只不过他啥事儿都敢照量（尝试），谁都不服不忿。人们管这也叫犯”虎”。
c2df99fe47d6decd7fa461a24ecb976d3fcef93f.translatedText: > San Huzi is actually very smart, but he dares to try anything, and no one is convinced or angry. People call this a "tiger" offense.

62d0d17d90ac1acd28ad41f8c67e7cc159315692.sourceText: 佟五子家杀猪，三虎子和一帮人围着看热闹。佟五子指着一碗刚刚炼出 来，还没有凝固的猪油说：”谁敢把它喝了，我给他买饼干！”三虎子拿过油碗，咚咚咚一饮而尽，正拽着佟五子要上供销社买饼干，沈老球子妈呀一声惊叫：”三虎子，你裤子屁股后面咋有油呢？大伙儿一看，那裤子后面油乎乎的一大片，眼看着那油迹越散越大，都大呼小叫地说：”快回家换裤子去吧！”三虎子冲出人群，一头扎高粱地里，不出来了。
62d0d17d90ac1acd28ad41f8c67e7cc159315692.translatedText: >Tong Wuzi’s family was killing a pig, and Sanhuzi and a group of people gathered around to watch the fun. Tong Wuzi pointed to a bowl that had just been made Come, the lard that has not solidified yet said: "Whoever dares to drink it, I will buy biscuits for him!" Sanhuzi took the oil bowl and drank it all in one gulp. As he was dragging Tong Wuzi to go to the supply and marketing cooperative to buy biscuits, Shen Laoqiuzi said "Oh my god" Exclaimed: "Sanhuzi, why is there oil on the back of your pants? Everyone took a look and saw a large area of oil on the back of the pants. Seeing the oil stain spreading and getting bigger, they all shouted, "Go home and change your pants!" "San Huzi rushed out of the crowd, plunged into the sorghum field, and could not come out.

ebfc1864568a3301cdd77e40e61d2f7097e55969.sourceText: 那年月一碗猪油多金贵啊，佟五子挨了他妈一顿扫帚疙瘩，三虎子可好，晚上把他爷爷的羊皮褥子都给油了。
ebfc1864568a3301cdd77e40e61d2f7097e55969.translatedText: A bowl of lard was so valuable in those days. Tong Wuzi was beaten by his mother's broomstick. San Huzi is so good. He will do it at night.

24e3e7f76e1fd0493f0c32064e8146fe0effacd9.sourceText: 有一回三虎子跟孔老舔的儿子小利挑衅，说：”小利，你要是敢吃十个羊粪球，我给你买一斤饼干！”小利打了个寒颤，说”我不敢！””那你给我买！””凭啥？除非你吃十个！”三虎子二话没说，捡起一把羊粪球，跑井台打上来了一桶水，喝了两口水，一把”球”进去了。小利又打了个寒颤，”你用水漱进去的，不算！要嚼碎了才行！”三虎子又捡起一把”球”，全塞嘴里，嚼的满嘴黑绿，让小利看，小利吓得转身就跑，、、、、、、。
24e3e7f76e1fd0493f0c32064e8146fe0effacd9.translatedText: His grandfather’s sheepskin mattress was all oily. Once, Sanhuzi challenged Kong Laoli’s son, Xiaoli, and said, “Xiaoli, if you dare to eat ten sheep dung balls, I’ll buy you a pound of biscuits!” Xiaoli shuddered and said, "I don't dare!" "Then you buy it for me!" "Why?" Unless you eat ten! "Sanhuzi didn't say anything, picked up a handful of sheep dung balls, ran to the well platform to fetch a bucket of water, drank two mouthfuls of water, and put a handful of "balls" in. Xiaoli shivered again, "You rinsed the balls in with water, it doesn't count! You have to chew it into pieces! "San Huzi picked up a handful of "balls" again, stuffed them all into his mouth, chewed the black and green, and showed it to Xiaoli. Xiaoli was so frightened that he turned and ran away.

c1f5c97764047d8e13834ad35f94e7c2cc1013ce.sourceText: 我和三虎子出生在不同家庭，性格也有挺大反差，不知为什么，我俩特别有缘，成了最好的朋友。
c1f5c97764047d8e13834ad35f94e7c2cc1013ce.translatedText: Sanhuzi and I were born in different families, and our personalities are quite different. For some reason, we were particularly destined and became best friends.

c7fc6bb4e2c0d1f136037c5d400c1fc14af0b8e5.sourceText: 三虎子虽然没我个高，长的也很单薄，但干农活是把好手。它不仅手把手教我，还常常帮我干。
c7fc6bb4e2c0d1f136037c5d400c1fc14af0b8e5.translatedText: Although Sanhuzi is not as tall as me and is very thin, he is good at farm work. He not only taught me step by step, but also often helped me do it.

8184b92e64c45dd6e14b273cd278aac827378821.sourceText: 那时还是年轻，虽然在地里干活累得腰酸腿痛，一收工马上又蹦又跳，在”大消校”前面的篮球场上折腾。我和大弟都爱打篮球，就把三虎子，还有老赵家的大丫头做为重点培养对象。大丫头本来是男孩，据说他妈在他出生之前，连生了好几个女孩。为了辟邪，给他起了个小名叫大丫头。三虎子个头最小，但打球最灵活。一点不把我和大弟，还有大丫头，我们这三个1米八零的大个放在眼里，球场上真像个小老虎。我们4个加上住在我们屯的民兵大队长树发大哥，组成了个篮球队。农闲挂锄时，我们前后屯四处”挑衅”。积累了一些实战经验后，又过江和邻省的公社球队打，和附近劳改农场的干警打。称得上小有名气，那年正好赶上县里篮球比赛。我们公社球队就是以我们屯子这几员大将为主力的。
8184b92e64c45dd6e14b273cd278aac827378821.translatedText: He was still young at that time. Although his back and legs were so tired from working in the fields, he jumped up and down immediately after work, and my eldest brother and I loved playing basketball. The eldest girl of Lao Zhao's family was originally a boy. It is said that his mother gave birth to several girls before he was born. To ward off evil spirits, the three tigers were the smallest, but they were the most flexible in playing. The three of us, 1.80 meters tall, were really like little tigers. Together with Brother Shufa, the captain of the militia team who lived in our village, we formed a basketball team. After accumulating some practical experience, we crossed the river to play with the commune teams in neighboring provinces and with the policemen from the nearby labor camps. We were quite famous, and it happened to coincide with the county basketball game. Our commune team was mainly composed of these generals.

3bccb2e053d0620888d027a707fda235ea13aa23.sourceText: 绝对主力是树发大哥，他弹跳好，投篮也准。树发大哥当过兵，复员后在大队当民兵大队长。他一米八三的大个，浓眉大眼，长得英俊潇洒。三虎子偷着告诉我，原来屯子里最漂亮的姑娘，是赶大车的老韩头家的三闺女，他亲眼看见树发大哥和那丫头在场院的草垛上干那个事儿。为此老韩头还给过树发一鞭子，他家那姑娘也急匆匆地嫁到外地去了。
3bccb2e053d0620888d027a707fda235ea13aa23.translatedText: The absolute main player is Shufa. He has good jumping and accurate shooting. The eldest brother Shufa served as a soldier, and after demobilization, he served as a militia captain in the brigade. He is 1.83 meters tall, with thick eyebrows and big eyes, and is handsome. Sanhuzi secretly told me that it turned out that the most beautiful girl in the village was the third daughter of the old Hantou family who drove the cart. He saw the tree-haired brother and the girl doing that on the haystack in the yard with his own eyes. For this reason, Lao Hantou gave Guoshu a whip, and his girl also hurriedly married away.

2fce88c5f4ce4e4cdaa0f5a097b13424679b3d2c.sourceText: 71年冬天，三虎子听他爹说公社要组织文艺汇演。兴冲冲地告诉我，说：咱组织的剧团呗！因为平时听我总是唱咧咧的，他也跟着学。
2fce88c5f4ce4e4cdaa0f5a097b13424679b3d2c.translatedText: In the winter of 1971, Sanhuzi heard from his father that the commune was going to organize a cultural performance. He told me excitedly, saying: We organized a theater troupe! Because he usually listens to me singing and he also imitates me.

e9ec334185db266a922565ea15c5aa695b388000.sourceText: 我俩跟队长一说，杨七哥也挺支持，特意从大队借来了跳板，在”大消校”搭了个舞台，我信心满满地开始组织排练了。
e9ec334185db266a922565ea15c5aa695b388000.translatedText: We told the team leader, and Brother Yang Qi was very supportive. He borrowed a springboard from the team and set up a stage at the "Daxia School". I started organizing rehearsals with full confidence.

bab2b182d50d066937870feab14dbd2b990f0731.sourceText: 咱毕竟是县城的高中生，在学校一直是班级的文艺委员，跟这些农村孩子比，见识的多一些，没啥说的，编、导、演我就全来了。三虎子是我的坚强后盾，每天像跟屁虫一样跟着我。
bab2b182d50d066937870feab14dbd2b990f0731.translatedText: After all, we are high school students in the county town. We have always been the literary and art committee members of the class in school. Compared with these rural children, we have more experience. I don’t have anything to say. I just wrote, directed and acted. Sanhuzi is my strong supporter and follows me like a follower every day.

00408d2d059b1bb955c75d9d21bf57a2ea1eb0c4.sourceText: 我们屯子小，年轻的更少，下地干活的几个姑娘对文艺也没啥感觉。我就以三虎子、大丫头和我大弟为主力编排了表演唱《贫下中农想念毛主席》、舞蹈《红太阳照边疆》等。老乡们从来没见过大小伙子跳舞，而且跳的有模有样。每天排练时，队部里挤得水泄不通。七八十岁的老头老太太，抱着吃奶孩子的小媳妇，妇女队长大珍子带领的几个大姑娘，当然最高兴的是那些泥球一样的孩子们，稍不注意，就跑上台登登登跑一圈，等你发现了，他早蹦台下去了、、、、、。
00408d2d059b1bb955c75d9d21bf57a2ea1eb0c4.translatedText: Our village is small, there are fewer young people, and the few girls who work in the fields have no feeling for literature and art. With San Huzi, the eldest girl and my eldest brother as the main actors, I arranged the performance singing "The Poor and Lower-Middle Peasants Miss Chairman Mao", the dance "The Red Sun Shines on the Frontier", etc. The fellow villagers have never seen young and old people dancing, and they dance with style. Every day during rehearsals, the team headquarters was packed to the rafters. There are old men and women in their 70s and 80s, their daughters-in-law holding nursing babies, and several older girls led by the women’s captain Dazhenzi. Of course, the happiest ones are the children who are like clay balls. If you don’t pay attention, they will run up and down the stage and run around. By the time you find out, they will have already jumped off the stage...

a62714ceeece5264347895c116b24348182f5c77.sourceText: 我把正在上学的孩子分成两组，其实是两个梯队。读中学的为第二梯队，排了《沙家浜》选场：军民鱼水情，和舞蹈《草原上的红卫兵见到了毛主席》等；小学生是第三梯队，排了《红灯记》选场：斗鸠山，独唱《山丹丹开花红艳艳》等。我觉得我们几个大孩子，所谓的主要演员，应该也演一个样板戏选场，做为压轴，最后选定了《智取威虎山》的打进匪窟一场。我肯定是杨子荣了，三虎子自告奋勇演座山雕。不料这事让我爸知道了，给我一顿臭骂：”你都多大了，还这么不懂事儿，咱们的身份能演杨子荣吗？再说，你也绝不能让三虎子演座山雕啊！人家根正苗红，你让他演反派，这不是招祸吗？那杨瘸子还不收拾你？”
a62714ceeece5264347895c116b24348182f5c77.translatedText: I divided the children who are in school into two groups, actually two echelons. The middle school students were in the second echelon, and they arranged the scene of "Shajiabang": the love between soldiers and civilians, and the dance "The Red Guards on the Prairie Meet Chairman Mao", etc.; the elementary school students were in the third echelon, and they arranged the scene of "Red Lantern": Doujiu Mountain, and the solo "Shandandan Blooms Red and Gorgeous" and so on. I thought that our older children, the so-called main actors, should also act in a model play to select scenes as the finale. Finally, we chose the scene of entering the bandit's den from "Taking Tiger Mountain by Wisdom". I must be Yang Zirong, the three tigers volunteered to play the role of a mountain eagle. Unexpectedly, my dad found out about this and scolded me: "How old are you and you are still so ignorant? How can we play the role of Yang Zirong with our status? Besides, you will never let San Huzi play a mountain eagle! He is a very good man, and you let him play the villain. This Isn’t that causing trouble? Why won’t Cripple Yang take care of you? "

99b1ea69dab5e6504e4c6441a5fbc9972ca9d668.sourceText: 我非常理解父亲，文化中蹲了两年多牛棚，刚刚落实了政策，还留着尾巴不说，又被赶到乡下插队。我的心血来潮很可能惹来麻烦，那就不演吧。我把这事告诉了三虎子，三虎子却来了虎劲儿，非要演不可。那咋办呢？为了不节外生枝，我俩把这个节目的排练转入地下。等别的节目都排完了，看热闹的人走没了，我们才开始排。我买通了妈妈，秘密准备起服装，杨子荣的羊皮大氅，虎皮背心，都偷偷用爸爸的衣服改成了。为了做杨子荣的靴子，妈妈特意打了两板硌礴。三虎子偷来他爷爷的皮袄和毡帽。自己弄好了座山雕的服装，连八大金刚的衣服也都弄好了。
99b1ea69dab5e6504e4c6441a5fbc9972ca9d668.translatedText: I understand my father very well. He has been in the bullpen for more than two years. He just implemented the policy and still kept his tail, and was sent to the countryside to join the queue. My whim is likely to get me into trouble, so I won’t act. I told San Huzi about this, but San Huzi was so excited that he insisted on acting. What to do? In order to avoid unnecessary complications, the two of us moved the rehearsals of this show underground. We waited until all the other programs had been scheduled and all the spectators had left, then we started arranging. I bribed my mother and secretly prepared clothes. Yang Zirong's sheepskin cloak and tiger skin vest were all secretly altered from my father's clothes. In order to make Yang Zirong’s boots, my mother specially made two boards. Sanhuzi stole his grandfather's fur coat and felt hat. I have finished the costumes for the mountain eagle, and even the clothes for the Eight Great Vajras.

402c45ab97e4189cc7a10e6e8832366bb72bbcbd.sourceText: 要彩排了，我心里挺紧张，要是三虎子他爹杨瘸子看见他儿子演座山雕，怪罪下来咋办呢？虽然三虎子一再说，是他愿意演，他爹不会介意，我心里还是七上八下的。彩排那天晚上，我问三虎子：”你爹知不知道咱们今晚的事儿？”三虎子一脸狡黠的坏笑，说：”放心吧，今晚我给俺爹烫了一壶酒，正在家喝着呢！两盅酒下肚，他就觉觉了！”
402c45ab97e4189cc7a10e6e8832366bb72bbcbd.translatedText: Rehearsal is about to start, and I feel very nervous. What if Sanhuzi’s father, Yang Laizi, sees his son acting as a mountain eagle and blames him? Although Sanhuzi repeatedly said that he was willing to act and his father wouldn't mind, I was still worried. On the night of the rehearsal, I asked Sanhuzi: "Does your father know what we are doing tonight?" Sanhuzi said with a sly smile, "Don't worry, I made a pot of wine for my father tonight and he is drinking it at home! After two cups of wine, he fell asleep!"

f48b5844802fe9321872e8cf8d9ea838cc7b4395.sourceText: 彩排开始了，整个屯子开锅了！我们四个小伙的舞蹈开场，第二梯队，第三梯队的节目轮番上阵。又是蒙族舞、又是朝鲜舞、又是陕北民歌，还有样板戏，老乡们哪看过这阵势啊！都看傻了。最后压轴的是我和三虎子的《智取威虎山》，三虎子的座山雕一亮相就满屋子的掌声！
f48b5844802fe9321872e8cf8d9ea838cc7b4395.translatedText: The rehearsal began, and the whole village was boiling! The dance of the four of us started, and the performances of the second and third echelons took turns. There are Mongolian dances, Korean dances, northern Shaanxi folk songs, and model operas. How have you seen this array before! They were all dumbfounded. The finale was "Taking Tiger Mountain Outsmarted" by San Huzi and I. As soon as San Huzi's mountain eagle appeared, the whole room burst into applause!

5c4985b3ba6a9a6b9f78bb077cc4d7d0a8a95827.sourceText: 我刚要上场，天啊，杨瘸子！
5c4985b3ba6a9a6b9f78bb077cc4d7d0a8a95827.translatedText: I was just about to come on, oh my god, Yang Laizi!

a87f11738e3895c6a00d688067792b3e6bce06ed.sourceText: 台南市长赖清德访问凤城 (台美商会供稿)台南市长赖清德将订于五月廿日抵凤城进行为期三天的访问行程。 赖清德市长主政台南政绩斐然，是台湾一颗极为耀眼的政治明星，历任国大代表，立法委员等职，于2010年选举中击败国民党对手苏俊宾，赢得改制后大台南市第一任市长，任职至今。
a87f11738e3895c6a00d688067792b3e6bce06ed.translatedText: Tainan Mayor Lai Ching-te visits Fengcheng (Contributed by the Taiwan American Chamber of Commerce) Tainan Mayor Lai Ching-te will arrive in Fengcheng on May 20 for a three-day visit. Mayor Lai Ching-te has made outstanding achievements in governing Tainan. He is a very dazzling political star in Taiwan. He has served as a representative of the National Congress and a legislator. In the 2010 election, he defeated his KMT opponent Su Junbin and became the first mayor of Tainan City after the restructuring.

6869461d1ea948a903b3ce3f0f69233896fb0140.sourceText: 台南市长赖 赖清德拥有傲人学历，先后毕业于台大医学院，成功大学及哈佛大学硕士班，是民进党中生代精英，与陈菊共称为”南部双霸天”，有问鼎大座的实力。 赖清德的名气必将在凤城华人侨社造成轰动，特别是台籍社团，可谓人未到名先传，当张晴玲，黄玉莲，黄丽憬在第一时间接到通知，兴奋的立即筹组接待团队，并订于五月廿一曰晚六时半假六福酒家举行欢迎晚宴，目前己知动员团体有 台湾同乡会，台美商会，世华工商妇女协会，台湾人公共事务协会，北美洲台湾妇女会，客家同乡会，及台南乡亲等。 这次耒美访问的台南市代表团在赖清德市长率领下，包括市议员，市府官员等共计九位，将先后访问美国职棒道奇，白袜，落矶与凤城的响尾蛇等队，并参观响尾蛇的巨蛋球场与凤城职棒春训基地。 台南市在赖清德市长规划下，将打造成亚太国际棒球训练中心，将耒有棒球王国之称的台湾，它的心脏将在台南市。 这次赖清德访美，备受国际棒协的重视，希望世界少棒大赛在台南举行时，可赶上使用亚太国际棒球村的设施与球埸。 这次参加欢迎赖清德市长的主流单位衆多，计有州商业局，州旅游局，州议会，Scottsdale 市政府，Chandler 市政府，Glendale 市政府，Diamond Back 球队等，均将受邀出席欢迎晚宴。 张晴玲表示，晚宴上大家可以喝到台南土産乌龙茶，台湾啤酒，每人都会收到一份赖清德市长送的文轩伴手礼，”好康” 太多，请尽快向各社团报名或电 6026776819 张晴玲 6024481555 黄玉莲 或 6023699618黄丽憬

ef551a63a153bbd6640030957ea7dbb5eedb9ba4.sourceText: 在科罗拉多大峡谷临渊听风 从红石峡谷景区出来，我们将车上的GPS调整为”科罗拉多大峡谷”，然后一路向西北进发。车子在笔直平坦的高速路疾驰，窗外一晃而过的是广袤的沙漠，甚至是一毛不长的荒漠，远处山峦起伏，连绵不断。大约两多个小时之后，我们来到了闻名遐迩的科罗拉多大峡谷。 景区的汽车入口处竖着一个木牌，写着”每部车子请交$25，欢迎进入享受你的旅行”，感觉门票与其名气相比一点也不贵，而且这话挺有人情味的，让人听了很温馨。进入景区停好车，转乘景区的交通工具来到南缘的景区。这里，人山人海，络绎不断，来自各国的不同肤色的游客在这里汇集、观赏，此刻，科罗拉多大峡谷就像一个热情奔放的印第安少女，正舒展双臂揽我们入怀厖 科罗拉多​​大峡谷（Colorado，the Grand Canyon）是科罗拉多河的杰作。这条河发源于科罗拉多州的落基山，长年洪流奔涌，一泻千里，流经犹他州、亚利桑那州，从加利福尼亚州的加利福尼亚湾入海，全长2320公里。 ”科罗拉多”河夹带着大量的泥沙不舍昼夜地向前奔流，有时开山劈道，有时峰回路转，经过数百万年以上的不断冲蚀、断裂、堆积，在主流与支流的上游刻凿出黑峡谷、峡谷地、格伦峡谷，布鲁斯峡谷等19个峡谷，而最后流经亚利桑那州多岩的凯巴布高原时，更以神来之笔，勾勒出大峡谷这个两山壁立、一水中流的壮观奇景，并使之成为这条水系所有峡谷中无可替代的佼佼者。 科罗拉多​​大峡谷大峡谷横贯亚利桑那州和犹他州之间。全长446公里，平均深度1200米，宽度从0.5公里至29公里不等。美国人喜欢把”科罗拉多”省略掉，直呼Grand Canyon。我想，大概除了科罗拉多大峡谷，再没有其他更大的峡谷可以被他们称作Grand的了吧。 大峡谷的奇岩、红土、峡谷地貌和纯粹的印第安风情以及浩瀚的气魄，可谓首屈一指、举世无双。 1903年，美国总统罗斯福到此游览时，曾深有感触地说：”大峡谷使我充满了敬畏，它无可比拟，无法形容，在这辽阔的世界上，绝无仅有。” 1979年，大峡谷被列入世界遗产。从此，这里就成了美国西部电影的拍摄圣地，常常有一些描绘劫富济贫、惩强扶弱的牛仔豪杰或孤胆英雄的电影，其中一些英雄好汉横枪跃马，驰聘在寸草不生的红土峡谷，冲过激流汹涌的河流的镜头，就是在大峡谷拍摄的。美国西部西南部的四个州棗亚利桑那州、犹他州、科罗拉多州、新墨西哥州也就自然成为旅游者体验西部牛仔生活的理想之地了。 我在科罗拉多大峡谷临渊听风，感受着大峡谷的深邃雄峻和庄严肃穆。对于科罗拉多大峡谷的悬崖壁立和磅礴气势，我一点也不陌生，因为大峡谷的雄奇壮丽早已如雷贯耳，对其辽阔卓绝与非凡风韵，我也了如指掌、并烂熟于心。然而，当我第一次站在大峡谷面前，当大峡谷的疾风撩动我的衣袂、发丝之时，当耳边传来风吟松涛之时，我的内心深处依然感受到一种从未有过的震撼与冲击。我深深感叹大自然在现代文明的征服之下仍然保留着如此壮丽的原始洪荒，我惊讶造物主经过亿万年的雕刻切割，竟赋予大峡谷如此变幻莫测和扑朔迷离的容貌。我突然感到语言和文字的乏力，我无法确切地描绘大峡谷的壮丽​​景色，我只能在站在大峡谷那险峻峭壁和斑斓多彩的岩石面前，临渊听风，用心灵去感受大峡谷的浩淼深邃和奔腾壮阔，朝圣大峡谷的仙姿玉貌和壮美神奇。 临渊岚起。雾霭中，科罗拉多大峡谷犹如一条桀骜不驯的巨蟒，在山岚中蜿蜒曲折呈东西走向匍伏于凯巴布高原之上。大峡谷四周成片长势良好的美国黄松和矮松、刺柏以及黄杉、蓝云杉等树木，犹如巨蟒身上的鳞片与脊鳍，令大峡谷郁郁葱葱，巨蟒虎虎生气。 听风云生。云海下，科罗拉多大峡谷拂起青丝三千，鬟绕成结，翩翩起舞，如痴如醉。我伫立缄默，面对大峡谷的座座岩壁，彷佛打开一幅幅真实的地质画卷，不同地质时期的风风雨雨扑面而来。阳光下，岩壁不断变幻着颜色，时而深蓝，时而棕色，时而又变成赤色，魔幻般的色彩闪闪烁烁，充满神奇与梦幻。据悉，早在5000年前，这里就有土著美洲印第安人居住繁衍。眼前那一个个隐藏的印地安崖居遗迹和硅化木集群，那陨石撞击的巨坑，那像亿万卷图书层层迭迭构成的岩壁和大台阶状的绚彩断层，都以其扑朔迷离、变幻莫测，激发着我们去探寻、去了解、去揭秘。 此刻，天高云淡，蔚蓝的苍穹与大峡谷的壮观瑰丽辉映相溶，纯净无尘。我们徜徉在大峡谷的脊背之上，放松身心，听风吟唱，看云飞渡，尽情享受美国西部风情，饱览美国高原风光。
ef551a63a153bbd6640030957ea7dbb5eedb9ba4.translatedText: Listening to the wind in the Grand Canyon of the Colorado After coming out of the Red Rock Canyon Scenic Area, we adjusted the GPS on the car to "Grand Canyon of the Colorado" and then headed northwest. The car was speeding on a straight and flat highway, and what flashed past the window was a vast desert, even a barren desert, with undulating mountains in the distance. After about two hours, we arrived at the famous Grand Canyon. There is a wooden sign at the car entrance of the scenic spot, which says "Please pay $25 per car, welcome to enter and enjoy your trip." I feel that the tickets are not expensive at all compared to its reputation, and this is very humane and warm to hear. Enter the scenic spot, park your car, and transfer to the scenic spot's transportation to the southern edge of the scenic spot. Here, there is a constant flow of people. Tourists of different colors from all over the world gather here to watch. At this moment, the Grand Canyon is like an enthusiastic Indian girl, stretching her arms to embrace us. The Grand Canyon (Colorado, the Grand Canyon) is a masterpiece of the Colorado River. This river originates from the Rocky Mountains in Colorado. It surges for many years and flows thousands of miles. It flows through Utah and Arizona, and enters the sea from the Gulf of California in California, with a total length of 2,320 kilometers. The "Colorado" River carries a large amount of sediment and flows forward day and night, sometimes cutting through mountains and sometimes turning around. After millions of years of continuous erosion, fracture, and accumulation, it has carved out black canyons, canyons, and Glen Canyon in the upper reaches of the main stream and tributaries. There are 19 canyons including Bruce Canyon, and when it finally flows through the rocky Kaibab Plateau in Arizona, it even more magically outlines the spectacular scenery of the Grand Canyon with two mountain walls and a flowing water, making it an irreplaceable leader among all the canyons in this water system. The Grand Canyon of the Colorado spans between Arizona and Utah. It has a total length of 446 kilometers, an average depth of 1,200 meters, and a width ranging from 0.5 kilometers to 29 kilometers. Americans like to omit "Colorado" and call it Grand Canyon. I think, except for the Grand Canyon, there is no other larger canyon that they can call Grand. The Grand Canyon's strange rocks, red soil, canyon landforms, pure Indian style and vast spirit are second to none and unparalleled in the world. When U.S. President Roosevelt visited here in 1903, he said deeply: "The Grand Canyon fills me with awe. It is incomparable, indescribable, and unique in this vast world." In 1979, the Grand Canyon was listed as a World Heritage Site. Since then, this place has become a mecca for shooting American Western movies. There are often movies depicting cowboy heroes or lone heroes who rob the rich and give to the poor, punish the strong and support the weak. Some of the scenes of heroes leaping on horses, galloping through barren red soil canyons, and rushing through turbulent rivers were shot in the Grand Canyon. The four states in the southwestern United States, Arizona, Utah, Colorado, and New Mexico, have naturally become ideal places for tourists to experience the life of Western cowboys. I listened to the wind in the Grand Canyon of Colorado and felt the depth, majesty and solemnity of the Grand Canyon. I am no stranger to the towering cliffs and majestic momentum of the Grand Canyon, because I have long been aware of its majesty and majesty. I am also familiar with its vastness and extraordinary charm. However, when I stood in front of the Grand Canyon for the first time, when the strong wind of the Grand Canyon stirred my clothes and hair, and when the wind sang in my ears and the pines roared, I still felt an unprecedented shock and impact deep in my heart. I deeply lament that nature still retains such magnificent primitive wilderness despite the conquest of modern civilization. I am amazed that the Creator has given the Grand Canyon such an unpredictable and confusing appearance after hundreds of millions of years of carving and cutting. I suddenly felt weak in language and writing. I could not accurately describe the magnificent scenery of the Grand Canyon. I could only stand in front of the steep cliffs and colorful rocks of the Grand Canyon, listen to the wind in front of the abyss, feel the vastness, depth and majesty of the Grand Canyon with my heart, and make a pilgrimage to the celestial beauty, majesty and magic of the Grand Canyon. Linyuanlan rises. In the mist, the Grand Canyon is like an unruly giant python, twisting and turning in the mountains and crouching on the Kaibab Plateau in an east-west direction. The Grand Canyon is surrounded by acres of well-growing ponderosa pine, dwarf pine, juniper, yellow fir, blue spruce and other trees, which are like the scales and dorsal fins of a giant python, making the Grand Canyon lush and lush, and the python alive. Listen to the situation. Under the sea of ​​clouds, three thousand green hairs are fluttering in the Colorado Grand Canyon, and the servant girls are twisted into knots and dancing gracefully, mesmerizingly. I stood in silence, facing the rock walls of the Grand Canyon, as if I were opening real geological pictures, and the ups and downs of different geological periods were rushing towards me. Under the sun, the rock walls constantly change colors, sometimes dark blue, sometimes brown, sometimes red. Magical colors sparkle, full of magic and fantasy. It is reported that as early as 5,000 years ago, indigenous American Indians lived and multiplied here. The hidden ruins of Indian cliff dwellings and clusters of petrified wood before our eyes, the huge craters created by meteorite impacts, the rock walls and large step-like colorful faults made up of layers of billions of books are all confusing and unpredictable, inspiring us to explore, understand and reveal the secrets. At this moment, the sky is high and the clouds are clear, and the blue sky blends with the grandeur of the Grand Canyon, pure and dust-free. We wandered on the back of the Grand Canyon, relaxing, listening to the wind singing, watching the clouds fly over, enjoying the style of the American West and the scenery of the American plateau.
