26e68d0115911051ed6e54391ea1aa3c99a8dad7.translatedText: Wang Lijun - This incident has been adapted into a blockbuster by Hollywood

7c4e509c8cf6aa75a827896d017d82199cc4a040.sourceText: 王立军-此事被好莱坞改编成大片的精彩片断 以好莱坞的一贯风格，故事情节应该是这样的。 1。王如何摆脱重庆方面的…
7c4e509c8cf6aa75a827896d017d82199cc4a040.translatedText: Wang Lijun - This incident has been adapted into a blockbuster by Hollywood. In the usual Hollywood style, the storyline should be like this. 1. How did Wang get rid of Chongqing...

602ad3659ae7c7a4c64ceccd6566ca3fb431612e.sourceText: 1。王如何摆脱重庆方面的监视？这活对他不难，但应该很精彩。
602ad3659ae7c7a4c64ceccd6566ca3fb431612e.translatedText: 1. How did Wang escape Chongqing surveillance? This job won't be difficult for him, but it should be exciting.

bacf4b205c270e92af15f0312564477c2a7eebfd.sourceText: 2。王如何进入使馆的？混进去的，从后备厢接进去的，暴力进入的。不管何种方式， 计划之周密，心理素质和过程都精彩。
bacf4b205c270e92af15f0312564477c2a7eebfd.translatedText: 2. How did the king enter the embassy? Someone sneaked in, someone got in from the trunk, someone entered violently. Regardless of the method, the planning is thorough, the psychological quality and the process are wonderful.

ce181b12984e1c712abb45c069d8068f4994a4f0.sourceText: 3。王在使馆里面干了什么？常人无人知晓，随便编。
ce181b12984e1c712abb45c069d8068f4994a4f0.translatedText: 3. What was the king doing in the embassy? No one knows about ordinary people, so they just make it up.

5054283c3ec36e805ac7d9a9fee98ac15c45ec84.sourceText: 4。中方是如何知道王在使馆的？美方通报的，还是监控录像发现的。
5054283c3ec36e805ac7d9a9fee98ac15c45ec84.translatedText: 4. How did China know that Wang was in the embassy? What the US reported was discovered through surveillance video.

af7f17a32b9cda692fd14d6cdd3092719a16efdf.sourceText: 5。重庆方面得到消息后的反应。
af7f17a32b9cda692fd14d6cdd3092719a16efdf.translatedText: 5. Chongqing’s reaction after receiving the news.

fd624d5e71517d7467c8fe9e5da76dcc1db158cf.sourceText: 6。其他各方得到消息后的反应。
fd624d5e71517d7467c8fe9e5da76dcc1db158cf.translatedText: 6. The reactions of other parties after receiving the news.

46c575fae73869a94d5a917936e705e72f92fd89.translatedText: 7. Emergency consultations between high-level officials of China and the United States.

bb81675030ccd05eb5ce62343201d7d00d6d0020.sourceText: 8。各方势力制订解决方案，有合作也有防范，有朋友也是对手。
bb81675030ccd05eb5ce62343201d7d00d6d0020.translatedText: 8. All parties have worked out solutions, including cooperation and prevention, and friends and opponents.

01febe872df9c01730326db7b33aaca23e5c89a5.sourceText: 9。城市被交通管制后的混乱和焦虑，大量军警出现在街头的肃杀气氛，普通人正常的 生活被打乱，穿插几个片断，比如孕妇要生产。
01febe872df9c01730326db7b33aaca23e5c89a5.translatedText: 9. The chaos and anxiety after the city was put under traffic control, the chilling atmosphere caused by the presence of a large number of military police on the streets, the normal life of ordinary people being disrupted, interspersed with several scenes, such as a pregnant woman giving birth.

06bdac52b8c49282defbfba0019878712f4cf0f7.sourceText: 10。王为何要离开使馆，被迫的还是自愿的？做出最终决定后的反应。
06bdac52b8c49282defbfba0019878712f4cf0f7.translatedText: 10. Why did the king leave the embassy? Was he forced or voluntary? Reaction after a final decision is made.

2ad9a6001028bfde7a4579beb5c15ce68aa2f217.sourceText: 11。各方严阵以待，都准备在第一时间把王抢到手，各方悄悄派出的狙击手就位，空气 处在静止状态。
2ad9a6001028bfde7a4579beb5c15ce68aa2f217.translatedText: 11. All parties were prepared to seize the king as soon as possible. Snipers quietly sent by all parties were in position, and the air was still.

8190be61fac629dbb8fa154325d3c67d44856202.sourceText: 12。本片之高潮，从王离开使馆，一直到登上飞机，各种危险，截杀和保护的双方相互 渗透，争斗不休，从使馆一直打到机场。埋伏的狙击手在开枪前被消灭，负责保护的人 员也付出了惨重代价。
8190be61fac629dbb8fa154325d3c67d44856202.translatedText: 12. The climax of the film is from the moment Wang leaves the embassy until he gets on the plane. Various dangers, interception and protection are intertwined with each other, and the fight continues from the embassy to the airport. The ambushing snipers were eliminated before they could fire, and the personnel responsible for protecting them also paid a heavy price.

835fbe0e65573bb338aeeb28fca5dd470e12a616.translatedText: Yu Ding: Past Events in Jiangtun (2)

d3451e8c9d59b0bd3b70736cf553d5d03b49d6d1.sourceText: 于丁：江屯往事(二) 后来我们才知道，不让住”大消校”这事儿…
d3451e8c9d59b0bd3b70736cf553d5d03b49d6d1.translatedText: Yu Ding: Past Events in Jiangtun (2) Later we found out that Shen Fu was not allowed to live in the "Daxiao School"...

d6397d9944aceb589946c2c67cdbd86b67f621fc.sourceText: 后来我们才知道，不让住”大消校”这事儿不怪沈富。因为昨天，我父亲单位政工组来人了，说父亲历史问题还没查清，不能给这么好的房子住。人家有句俗话说：扶上马再送一程，这可好，撵下去还得踹一脚。
d6397d9944aceb589946c2c67cdbd86b67f621fc.translatedText: Later we found out that Shen Fu was not to blame for not being allowed to live in the "Daxiao School". Because yesterday, the political work team from my father's work unit came and said that my father's historical issues have not been cleared up and he cannot be given such a good house to live in. There is a saying: It's good to help the horse up and send it for a ride, but you have to kick it if you throw it off.

6a08b38840ef15035d8131bcd2e33847346eb045.sourceText: 这个废弃的猪场建在屯子的北面，阴山背后的。靠西边是七八间废弃的猪圈，东面是饲养员用的三间房。这三间房，一间是煮猪食的，一间是放饲料，中间一间是碾坊。难为沈富了，领着社员昨天忙乎了一天。在我们搬家的车到来之前，刚刚收拾停当，让我们能把家具啥的搬进去。哪有什么像样的家具 ，文革中我家被抄了无数次，看得上眼的物件有的被砸了，有的被拆了，有的丢失了、、、、、、。
6a08b38840ef15035d8131bcd2e33847346eb045.translatedText: This abandoned pig farm is built in the north of the village, behind Yinshan Mountain. To the west are seven or eight abandoned pig pens, and to the east are three rooms used by breeders. Of these three rooms, one is for cooking pig food, one is for storing feed, and the middle one is a mill. It's hard for Shen Fu, who led the members to have a busy day yesterday. Before our moving car arrived, it had just been packed so that we could move the furniture and everything in. There was no decent furniture. During the Cultural Revolution, my house was ransacked countless times. Some of the interesting objects were smashed, dismantled, and lost.

79bb6b63841d33a613fa8e25bb69c4806adc31bb.sourceText: 父母和小弟小妹住西屋，我和大弟住东屋，中间做厨房。刚刚搬来，屋子四面透风，墙上成片成片的霜花，一家人几乎都彻夜未眠。第二天天还没亮，我就醒了，觉得这屋里味道不对。猪场里有猪粪味、猪食味、猪毛味都正常，怎么还有驴粪马粪味啊？我叫醒大弟在屋里转了几圈。觉得中间的那间味儿最大。用锹一挖，底下是一锹深的驴粪。原来这里不是碾坊吗，乡亲们磨米磨面的都是用毛驴，久而久之，地上全是驴粪了。我和大弟费了半天功夫挖出去一大车驴粪。我们跟沈富要了个牛车，拉来一车沙子垫上。这回算是没有异味了，所谓没有异味，就是屋里只有猪粪味、猪食味、猪毛味、、、、、、。
79bb6b63841d33a613fa8e25bb69c4806adc31bb.translatedText: My parents and younger brother and younger sister live in the west room. My eldest brother and I live in the east room, and the kitchen is in the middle. We had just moved in. The house was drafty on all sides and there were patches of frost on the walls. The family almost stayed up all night. The next day, I woke up before dawn and felt something was wrong in the room. The smell of pig manure, pig food, and pig hair is normal in a pig farm. Why is there still a smell of donkey manure and horse manure? I woke up my brother and walked around the house several times. I think the one in the middle has the biggest flavor. Dig with a shovel and you will find a shovelful of donkey manure underneath. It turns out that this is not a mill. The villagers use donkeys to grind rice and flour. Over time, the ground is covered with donkey dung. My eldest brother and I spent a long time digging out a large cart of donkey dung. We asked Shen Fu for a bullock cart and brought a cart of sand to lay on it. This time there is no peculiar smell. The so-called no peculiar smell means that the house only smells of pig manure, pig food, pig hair...,,,,,.

2dab68d3988df28c76a54a20277b8589c1bae80d.sourceText: 我父母由于出身的问题，是历次政治运动的老”运动员”，被整怕了。刚来前姜家，不知道老乡会怎么对待我们，大人孩子也都有些紧张。
2dab68d3988df28c76a54a20277b8589c1bae80d.translatedText: Due to their background, my parents were old "athletes" in previous political movements and were frightened. When we first arrived at Qianjiang’s house, we didn’t know how the fellow villagers would treat us. Both adults and children were a little nervous.

2b5f6933010af8d632dccc19a0655197d9d816b5.sourceText: ”大消校”前面不是有个旗杆吗，伟大领袖哪天又挥巨手了，啥时候又发精神了，都要升国旗。那国旗就在老党员姜老六家放着，升旗都是姜老六的”专利”。
2b5f6933010af8d632dccc19a0655197d9d816b5.translatedText: Isn't there a flagpole in front of the "Daxia School"? Whenever the great leader waves his giant hand again, whenever he becomes energetic again, he must raise the national flag. The flag is placed at the home of veteran party member Jiang Laoliu, and raising the flag is Jiang Laoliu's "patent."

a897ac5ee3e2ab9ea44be0fb2cb46f6a311f5b1d.sourceText: 那天早上，我刚出家门，就看见”五星红旗迎风飘扬”。天哪，那五颗星星怎么跑下面去了！我回家一说，父亲特别紧张，赶紧把门关上，不让我和同在队里干活的大弟出门。我问为啥，父亲说：”为啥？你要是跟人说了国旗挂反了，就得罪了姜老六。人家儿子树发是大队的民兵大队长，都有枪。找个理由给你抓起来，甚至把你给崩了，你都没处说理去。”我说：”那就不说呗！””不说？人家会说，社员看不出来国旗挂的不对劲，有情可原。你个高中生能看不出来吗？说你是有意给国旗增灰，你咋办？、、、、、、”。
a897ac5ee3e2ab9ea44be0fb2cb46f6a311f5b1d.translatedText: That morning, as soon as I left the house, I saw the "five-star red flag fluttering in the wind." Oh my god, why did those five stars go down there? When I came home and told my story, my father was very nervous and quickly closed the door, preventing me and my eldest brother who also worked in the team from going out. I asked why, and my father said: "Why? If you tell people that the national flag is hung upside down, you will offend Jiang Laoliu. His son Shufa is the militia captain of the brigade, and he has a gun. I will find a reason to arrest you, or even kill you, and you have nothing to say." "Go ahead." I said, "Don't tell me." "People will say that it's understandable that the members of the club can't see that there's something wrong with the flag. How can you not tell that you are adding dust to the flag on purpose?"

055e5971fb329a517592402f45f313ffed539166.sourceText: 听父亲这样一说，我心里砰砰直跳，好像是我做错了什么事儿似的。直到听见外面杨三虎子没好声地喊：”快来看呐，国旗挂反了，来晚了看不着了！快来看呐、、、、、、”。杨三虎子他爸杨瘸子是大队干部，人家根正苗红，咋说都没事，我们全家总算松了一口气。
055e5971fb329a517592402f45f313ffed539166.translatedText: When my father said this, my heart pounded, as if I had done something wrong. Until I heard Yang Sanhuzi yelling in a bad voice outside: "Come and see, the national flag is hung upside down. I'm late and can't see it! Come and see...". Yang Sanhuzi’s father, Yang Laizi, was a brigade cadre with a good family background. No matter how you say it, everything was fine. Our whole family finally breathed a sigh of relief.

900a12cf03d603a90ae6c43b72362e88b81ef9f2.sourceText: 那年头生产队是干活大帮哄，人人磨洋工。弄得公鸡不打鸣，母鸡不下蛋的。我们那个屯去年，一个劳力才合几分钱。秋后分完口粮，不少人家不仅没分到钱，还欠生产队的。
900a12cf03d603a90ae6c43b72362e88b81ef9f2.translatedText: In those days, the production team was full of gangs, and everyone worked hard. The roosters won't crow and the hens won't lay eggs. Last year in our village, one laborer only cost a few cents. After the rations were distributed after autumn, many families not only did not receive any money, but also owed money to the production team.

c815b759b9db0802a3b2e5a409cdade6944db826.sourceText: 社员们常年见不着个钱，我父母虽然政治上挨整，每月都有二三百元的工资，这反差太大了。逐渐有乡亲来借钱，有的三元五元，有的一元两元。其实借钱这事儿，从我家搬来的第一天，脚刚沾地儿，就开始了。
c815b759b9db0802a3b2e5a409cdade6944db826.translatedText: The members of the commune have no money all year round. Although my parents are politically suppressed, they still receive a monthly salary of two to three hundred yuan. The contrast is huge. Gradually, villagers came to borrow money, some from three to five yuan, and some from one to two yuan. In fact, borrowing money started on the first day I moved in, as soon as my feet touched the ground.

31d2131d81bf7351b9561ed45d72202631ef7d44.sourceText: 我家搬来那天，帮忙搬家的社员都走了，一个老太太哆哆嗦嗦的站在我家门口，就是不离开。母亲问她有事儿吗？老太太支吾了半天，说要借两元钱，母亲赶紧给了她。老太太这个感动啊，眼泪都要出来了。
31d2131d81bf7351b9561ed45d72202631ef7d44.translatedText: On the day my family moved in, all the members who helped with the move left, and an old lady shivered and stood at the door of my house, refusing to leave. Mother asked her if something was wrong? The old lady hesitated for a long time and said she wanted to borrow two yuan, and her mother quickly gave it to her. The old lady was so moved that she almost burst into tears.

c0d639434496252171047ca5dc14d89bb8da9b5d.sourceText: 后来才知道，这老太太是沈万仁他妈。沈万仁小时候摔坏了一只手，现在只能给队里放羊。前几年他妈给娶了个傻媳妇，傻媳妇又生了两个傻孩子。眼瞅着要换季，他家老大是个傻姑娘，七八岁了，也不能光屁股啊，这两元钱真是解了他家”光腚”之急。
c0d639434496252171047ca5dc14d89bb8da9b5d.translatedText: Later I found out that this old lady was Shen Wanren’s mother. Shen Wanren broke one of his hands when he was a child, and now he can only herd sheep for the team. A few years ago, his mother married a stupid wife, who gave birth to two stupid children. The season is about to change, and the eldest daughter of his family is a stupid girl. She is seven or eight years old and can't bare her buttocks. These two yuan really solved the problem of her family's "buttocks".

e9ce12c05fb3797b7fd5cc1bcf2c228ca6d3a6fe.sourceText: 三虎子跟我说过沈万仁家的秘闻：沈万仁那傻媳妇不解风情，娶到家了，不让沈万仁碰。他家就一间房，两代人住南北炕，中间拉个幔帐。沈万仁本来手就不灵光，那傻媳妇一喊，他就没辙了。后来老太太沉不住气了，说：”沈万仁啊，这屋就你爸你妈，怕啥呀！该咋的就咋的呗！、、、、、、”有老娘做主，沈万仁肯定是该咋的就咋的了，不然不会有这俩傻孩子。
e9ce12c05fb3797b7fd5cc1bcf2c228ca6d3a6fe.translatedText: > Sanhuzi told me the secret of Shen Wanren’s family: Shen Wanren’s silly wife didn’t understand the style, and she married her into a family, so Shen Wanren wouldn’t be allowed to touch her. His family only had one room, and two generations lived on the north and south Kangs, with a curtain in the middle. Shen Wanren was not very good at it, but when the stupid wife shouted, he was at his wits end. Later, the old lady lost her temper and said, "Shen Wanren, your parents are the only ones in this house. What are you afraid of? Just do what you should do!",,,,,,," With my mother in charge, Shen Wanren must do what he should do, otherwise there would not be these two silly children.

96640745b5813deaeb577a9e64860fbc9bff7039.sourceText: 不久，生产队改选，杨万兴当了队长，沈富改当贫协主席了。杨万兴排行老七，人都叫他杨七哥。杨七哥比沈富年轻几岁，长得也挺老相。因为他二女儿兰子是大队书记韩大耳朵的儿媳妇，所以别看杨七哥腰弯弯着，人家腰杆儿可硬着哩。
96640745b5813deaeb577a9e64860fbc9bff7039.translatedText: Soon, the production team was re-elected, Yang Wanxing became the captain, and Shen Fu became the chairman of the Poor People's Association. Yang Wanxing is the seventh eldest, and everyone calls him Brother Yang Qi. Brother Yang Qi is a few years younger than Shen Fu and looks quite old. Because his second daughter Lanzi is the daughter-in-law of brigade secretary Han Big Er, even though Brother Yang Qi is bent over, he has a strong waist.

3c650d6e83ef87b739f9465ff37ab348ae286429.sourceText: 杨七哥头脑灵活，嘴也特别能说，三虎子一般人不服，但就怕他七叔，也就是杨七哥。
3c650d6e83ef87b739f9465ff37ab348ae286429.translatedText: Yang Qi Ge is quick-witted and very eloquent. Most people don’t accept Sanhu Zi, but they are afraid of his seventh uncle, who is Yang Qi Ge.

a618e463c561faae97feaf01a48d5c45c28c7e0d.sourceText: 我家一搬来杨七哥就管我父亲叫大叔，经常来我家串门儿，当上队长的第二天，就来我家借钱，他说的可是个大数目，说要借要给屯子安电。
a618e463c561faae97feaf01a48d5c45c28c7e0d.translatedText: As soon as my family moved here, Brother Yang Qi called my father uncle. He often visited my house. The day after he became captain, he came to my house to borrow money. The amount he mentioned was a large amount, and he wanted to borrow money to install electricity in the village.

cb046cac6acfc6a980e8afd6bda20316b7b2b49a.sourceText: 当时前后屯都有电灯了，就是我们屯，因为没钱买扯电线的杆子，一直没电。虽然天天唱”共产党像太阳，照到哪里哪里亮。”可不买电线杆，晚上就得摸黑儿。这也是我家最不习惯的，父亲没有犹豫就答应了。
cb046cac6acfc6a980e8afd6bda20316b7b2b49a.translatedText: At that time, there were electric lights in the front and back villages, but our village had no electricity because we had no money to buy poles to pull the wires. Even though I sing "The Communist Party is like the sun, it shines wherever it shines" every day, if I don't buy telephone poles, I will have to work in the dark at night. This is what my family is least used to, so my father agreed without hesitation.

be4b1044d70e9ec142ac2338a06d96c35b35377a.sourceText: 花了几百元，就把电引到屯子，家家户户点上了电灯。通电那天晚上，乡亲们这个高兴啊！几乎全屯子的人都跑到我家来道谢，我特意在院子里扯了条临时线，安了个200瓦的大灯泡，这三虎子、老球子耍的，翻跟头打把式的。
be4b1044d70e9ec142ac2338a06d96c35b35377a.translatedText: At a cost of several hundred yuan, electricity was brought to the countryside and every household was lit with electric lights. The folks were so happy that night when the electricity was turned on! Almost everyone in the village came to my house to express their gratitude. I specially pulled a temporary line in the yard and installed a large 200-watt light bulb. The three tigers and the old ball were doing somersaults and tricks.

f07172547e95d6d23981b206137aea68ac609508.sourceText: 我们住的这房子，猪粪味、猪食味、猪毛味渐渐淡了，人情味越来越浓了。
f07172547e95d6d23981b206137aea68ac609508.translatedText: The smell of pig manure, pig food, and pig hair in the house we live in gradually fades away, and the human touch becomes stronger and stronger.

093c8eda2c5e892200d2f8e8f56869aae602b885.sourceText: 杨七哥几乎每天都到我家坐一会，说要给我介绍对象。
093c8eda2c5e892200d2f8e8f56869aae602b885.translatedText: Brother Yang Qi comes to my house to sit for a while almost every day and says he wants to introduce someone to me.

bf84205587d6d662e5516403412e0f4b562fd6e0.sourceText: 社会福利应知应会 曹嘉仪 最近我在医院当医生的女儿对我说，在医院里听说州政府的医疗福利将会有所变动，同时也有读者朋友来电问及此事，经我查询的结果如下：AHCCCS有两种福利，MED及AHCCCS CARE，因州政府的经费冻结，已将这两种福利暂时停止。 MED是给一些收入超过一般AHCCCS的收入标准但因临时生病住医院而医药费太高而DES 批准的一种保险，而这种保险的福利于十月一日停办。 AHCCCS CARE是给一些低收入的人，但不合格一般AHCCCS的申请者的医疗福利，如单身的成年人，不合格年龄的限制六十五岁以下，不是残障，没有怀孕，不是单亲的人，这种福利在七月八号已冻结。AHCCCS将会给一些年长者（六十五岁以上或不满六十五岁而残障者）转为SSIMAO保险，而此种保险将不会被冻结。 DES在结束您福利前会给您三封信；1.在您保险到期前六十天告诉您如何去继续申请。2.若您没完成该办的手续，您的福利将会停止的日期。3.DES将会在月底廿五号寄此信告诉您最后机会必须将申请表格送到DES。 所以您若有以上其中任何一种福利的朋友，一定要尽力的去完成您继续合格的医药保险福利。
bf84205587d6d662e5516403412e0f4b562fd6e0.translatedText: What you need to know about social welfare Cao Jiayi Recently, my daughter who is a doctor in the hospital told me that she heard in the hospital that there will be changes in the state government's medical benefits. At the same time, some readers and friends called to ask about this. The results of my inquiry are as follows: AHCCCS has two benefits, MED and AHCCCS CARE. Due to the state government's funding freeze, these two benefits have been temporarily suspended. MED is an insurance approved by DES for those whose income exceeds the general AHCCCS income standard but whose medical expenses are too high due to temporary illness and hospitalization. The benefits of this insurance will be discontinued on October 1. AHCCCS CARE is a medical benefit for some low-income people who are not eligible for general AHCCCS applicants, such as single adults, those who are not eligible under the age limit of 65 years old, are not disabled, are not pregnant, and are not single parents. This benefit has been frozen on July 8th. AHCCCS will convert some elderly people (those over 65 years old or those under 65 years old with disabilities) to SSIMAO insurance, and this insurance will not be frozen. DES will give you three letters before ending your benefits; 1. Tell you how to continue applying sixty days before your insurance expires. 2. If you do not complete the required procedures, the date on which your benefits will cease. 3. DES will send this letter on the 25th of the month to tell you that you have the last chance to submit the application form to DES. Therefore, if you have friends with any of the above benefits, you must try your best to complete the medical insurance benefits that you continue to qualify for.

8f89530b17337e0cac5a7cc5f5573af68883203d.translatedText: Time has dyed our hair into white temples, and the annual rings have carved wrinkles on our faces. Our life experiences were once so rich and colorful, and our past jobs were even more varied. Now for one With a common wish, we gather happily at the Senior Citizen Association - Senior Citizen Center. Unity and friendship are the purpose of the Senior Citizens Association; joy and care are the spirit of the Senior Citizens Association. What we feel here is the atmosphere of home. Here, the partners around us are not family members but better than family members. Here we learn English, listen to lectures, and seek the essence of learning in old age; here we practice singing and dancing, arrange programs, and explore the charm of having fun;

48e5619ab8c725fee797830f25618b046600413f.sourceText: “巧妆靓颜”美容化妆讲座—-新东方文化讲坛新年特别奉献 美丽是女性恒久的话题。自古以来就有诸如”对镜贴花黄”、”女为悦己者容”之类描述美丽容颜的词句。作为新时代女性，我们又怎么可以落后于古人？即使不需要每天化妆，但总有一些场合例如婚礼、晚宴等需要得体的妆容衬托出女性的外在美。那不懂化妆怎么办呢？别担心，本期的新东方文化讲坛，高级造型师Cindy将会于1月19日晚上7点相约大家于新东方艺术学校举行主题为”巧妆靓颜”的化妆讲座，为姐妹们讲述化妆的重要性，详解化妆步骤，并作妆容示范。 在讲座上，Cindy首先会介绍化妆品的种类，以及化妆的工具。然后会当场随机抽出一名嘉宾来示范妆容。欢迎姐妹们踊跃参加。请参与的姐妹当天一定要做好护肤工作，涂上护肤产品。当晚并不建议带妆参加，但可以化淡妆。这样Cindy可以示范从日常淡妆到晚妆的转换。姐妹们千万不要错过哦！ 主讲人：Cindy Wong 黄欣明，高级造型师。于2008年毕业于 International Academy of Hair Design，并于同年考得亚利桑那高级美容师（Cosmetologist）执照，随后即于国际著名发型机构 Toni & Guy 工作并接受深造培训。于2010年创办?#39749;力造型 Beauty by Cindy?#12290;曾多次为州际选美、婚纱秀选手进行化妆造型。高中毕业于广州美术高中的她，对色彩、造型有着独特的触觉。总能根据各人不同的脸型、身高、职业、发质设计出不同的造型。耐心、细心的她在顾客中留有良好的口碑！ 时间：1月19日 周六7:00pm 地点：新东方艺术学校 （EAA）1100 N Alma School Rd, Suite 18, Chandler, AZ.85224 咨询电话：(602) 490-8613;(480) 319-1098或登录http://www.beautybycindy.net/ 备注：”新东方文化讲坛”’由新东方艺术学校和陈普博士的”绿洲文教”’共同主持，由”太阳鸟”亚利桑那华人网策划。秉承”传承文明，开创未来”的一贯宗旨，免费向公众开放。
48e5619ab8c725fee797830f25618b046600413f.translatedText: "Beautiful Makeup and Beautiful Face" - New Oriental Culture Forum's special New Year dedication. Beauty is a constant topic for women. Since ancient times, there have been expressions such as "the mirror is yellow" and "a woman has a face that pleases her" to describe beautiful appearance. As women in the new era, how can we lag behind the ancients? Even if you don’t need to wear makeup every day, there are always some occasions such as weddings, dinner parties, etc. that require decent makeup to bring out a woman’s external beauty. What should I do if I don’t know how to put on makeup? Don’t worry, in this issue of the New Oriental Culture Forum, senior stylist Cindy will meet with you at 7 pm on January 19 at the New Oriental Art School to hold a makeup lecture with the theme of “Smart Makeup for Beautiful Faces”. She will tell the sisters the importance of makeup, explain the makeup steps in detail, and give makeup demonstrations. In the lecture, Cindy will first introduce the types of cosmetics and makeup tools. Then a guest will be randomly selected on the spot to demonstrate makeup. Sisters are welcome to participate. Sisters who participate are asked to do a good job of skin care and apply skin care products on that day. It is not recommended to wear makeup that night, but you can wear light makeup. In this way, Cindy can demonstrate the transition from daily light makeup to evening makeup. Sisters, don’t miss it! Speaker: Cindy Wong, senior stylist. Graduated from the International Academy of Hair Design in 2008 and obtained the Arizona Cosmetologist license in the same year. Later, she worked at the internationally renowned hairstyling agency Toni & Guy and received advanced training. Founded in 2010, Beauty by Cindy has done makeup and styling for interstate beauty pageants and wedding show contestants many times. She graduated from Guangzhou Fine Arts High School and has a unique sense of color and shape. Different styles can always be designed according to different face shapes, heights, occupations, and hair textures of each person. She is patient and attentive and has a good reputation among customers! Time: January 19, Saturday 7:00pm Location: New Oriental Art School (EAA) 1100 N Alma School Rd, Suite 18, Chandler, AZ.85224 Consultation hotline: (602) 490-8613; (480) 319-1098 or log in to http://www.beautybycindy.net/ Note: "New Oriental Culture Forum" is co-hosted by New Oriental Art School and Dr. Chen Pu's "Oasis Culture and Education", and planned by "Sunbird" Arizona Chinese Network. Adhering to the consistent purpose of "inheriting civilization and creating the future", it is open to the public free of charge.

ce5d4a3a957065f6e4868bef6abaec9f6adef6be.sourceText: 1. 我亲戚的小孩从小在美国念书﹐已经非法﹐最近Obama总统是否有有大赦﹖ 答﹕ Obama 总统在2012 年6月15日发布行政命令，符合特定条件的30岁以下的非法移民，将可以获准延缓驱逐二年，并申请工作许可，期满还可申请延期。 申请人必须符合以下条件﹕ 1.必须在16岁以前来美国。 2.在2012年6月15日当天人在美国，并且已经持续居住在美国5年。 3.目前人正在就学，或已从高中毕业，或已经取得高中同等学历，或曾经当兵 4.未曾被判重罪、严重轻罪、或多个轻罪，也没有对国家机密或公共安全有威胁的人。 5.目前年龄15岁至30 岁。 这对很多从小就在美国读书生活，却因为没有合法身分而担心受怕会被遣返的人而言是个非常好的消息。
ce5d4a3a957065f6e4868bef6abaec9f6adef6be.translatedText: 1. My relative’s child has been studying in the United States illegally since he was a child. Has President Obama issued an amnesty recently? Answer: President Obama issued an executive order on June 15, 2012. Illegal immigrants under the age of 30 who meet certain conditions will be able to delay deportation for two years and apply for a work permit. Upon expiration, they can also apply for an extension. Applicants must meet the following conditions: 1. Must come to the United States before the age of 16. 2. You were in the United States on June 15, 2012, and have been living in the United States continuously for 5 years. 3. The person is currently in school, or has graduated from high school, or has obtained a high school equivalent degree, or has served in the military. 4. The person has not been convicted of a felony, a serious misdemeanor, or multiple misdemeanors, and has not been a threat to state secrets or public security. 5. Current age is 15 to 30 years old. This is very good news for many people who have been studying and living in the United States since childhood, but are worried about being deported because they have no legal status.

8addc92c5e561a24d1f684f478a4850eccbd2bc7.sourceText: 符合上述条件者不仅不会被遣返，还可以申请工作许可。 目前移民局还没有公布详细的申请办法，预计会在60天内公布实施。 目前先不要向移民局报到﹐以免非法身份被曝光。
8addc92c5e561a24d1f684f478a4850eccbd2bc7.translatedText: Those who meet the above conditions will not only not be deported, but can also apply for a work permit. At present, the Immigration Bureau has not announced detailed application methods, and it is expected to be announced and implemented within 60 days. Do not report to the Immigration Bureau yet to avoid having your illegal status exposed.

11fe7d0e6fcbd62530c7b41e5429f06791ade921.sourceText: 2. 我和我先生现在都已75岁，我们在多年前已申请到政府的社会安全生活补助金（SSI），申请时我们与女儿共同拥有一个自住的房子。 可是近年来因经济形势不好，我们所交的地税、管理费、保险费等都大幅上涨，而所领取的SSI仅去年就一次削减200多元（两人），所以我们感到很困难，因此， 我们想把拥有的部分房产转给我女儿，不知这样做是否合法？ 如果转给​​女儿后，是否会失去领取福利资格？ 答： 一般把自己名下房产转给儿子、女儿属于普遍的法律程序，应不致产生其他问题。 有关你领取的社安补助金，是属于社安局提供给年老、失明及残障人士的补助金。 一般申请社安补助金，申请人条件是须有限度的收入及资产，社安局可以调查申请人的财务情况。 你将房地产转给女儿后，可能牵涉有关有限度的资产条件问题。 事实上，即使不是属于豪华型的房产，也可能被社安局视为拥有足够资产而不符合享受社安福利﹐可以联络社安局，讨论实际状况。
11fe7d0e6fcbd62530c7b41e5429f06791ade921.translatedText: 2. My husband and I are now 75 years old. We have applied for the government’s Social Security Income (SSI) many years ago. When we applied, we owned a home together with our daughter. However, due to the poor economic situation in recent years, the local taxes, management fees, insurance premiums, etc. we have paid have increased significantly, and the SSI we received was reduced by more than 200 yuan (for two people) last year alone, so we feel very difficult. Therefore, we want to transfer part of the property we own to my daughter. Is this legal? If it is transferred to my daughter, will I lose my eligibility for benefits? Answer: Generally, it is a common legal procedure to transfer the property under your name to your son or daughter, and it should not cause other problems. The Social Security benefits you receive are benefits provided by the Social Security Bureau to the elderly, blind and disabled. Generally, to apply for social security subsidies, the applicant must have a limited income and assets, and the Social Security Bureau can investigate the applicant's financial situation. After you transfer the real estate to your daughter, there may be issues related to limited asset conditions. In fact, even if it is not a luxury property, it may be deemed by the Social Security Bureau to have sufficient assets and not qualify for social security benefits. You can contact the Social Security Bureau to discuss the actual situation.

dc3b53d5df72bc791daf35657dbb06f321d328d4.sourceText: 大选后美国政治格局走向 11月6日，选民们不仅要选出美国下届总统，还要选出所有的联邦众议员和三分之一的参议员。选举结果显示，民主党仍将掌控参议院，共和党则继续掌控众议院。因此华府的党派僵局仍难以避免。 奥巴马在周二胜出，他仍将领导一个严重分歧的国家，而且不会有多少时间来治愈竞选给两党留下的创伤。因为马上总统就要和国会就税收和预算直接交锋，即在年底面临?#36130;政悬崖(fiscal cliff)问题。 所谓的财政悬崖是指国会和奥巴马在2011年8月承诺，要想办法10年内将预期赤字额降低1.2万亿美元，并通过法案强迫自己采取行动：如果两党达不成协 议，那么2013年1月份就要全面削减支出。这个时间与一系列减税措施的到期日相同，而减税措施到期意味着几乎所有人都面临着税务负担的增加。 奥巴马支持对美国纳税人中收入最高的2%进行增税。罗姆尼则称将给所有人降低税率，而通过限制税务抵免和填补税法漏税来弥补损失的税收。他认为这样可以活络经济，最终增加政府收入。 内阁成员大洗牌 根据惯例，无论谁当选美国下任总统，目前的内阁成员都将经历大洗牌。 据联邦新闻电台报导，布鲁金斯研究所资深研究员斯蒂芬‧海斯分析指出，奥巴马的团队非常稳定，也非常疲劳。服役4年后，奥巴马内阁中的国务院、财政部、国防部和司法部都有可能更换。 实际上，美国现任国务卿希拉里‧克林顿和财政部长蒂莫西‧盖特纳都已经表示不打算留在第二任期。其他内阁成员则还无人公开声明去留计划。但陶森大学政治系教授玛莎‧库马尔认为奥巴马内阁中半数人员会有更换。 最先被任命的将是白宫工作人员，包括幕僚长、人事主管和法律顾问。库马尔则认为白宫人员的任命将为内阁任命打下基础：?#20320;必须做出决定，比如曾经是说客的是否可以被纳入政府中厖奥巴马政府就不允许说客加入，没有例外。?/FONT> 2008年大选后曾担任总务署主任的盖尔‧洛夫莱斯说，该机构在选举日前和双方的竞选团队合都要打交道，原因是时间紧迫，总务署必须确保无论谁当选都能立刻开始运作，而不必被后勤拖后腿。 其他相关法规也保证了总统权力交接的顺利进行。如2004年的情报改革和反恐法案就允许总统候选人在获得提名后提交人员的安全检查名单。2010年通过的选前总统过渡法还允许总务署在提名后立刻提供服务，而不必等到大选日。
dc3b53d5df72bc791daf35657dbb06f321d328d4.translatedText: The trend of the American political landscape after the election. On November 6, voters will not only elect the next president of the United States, but also elect all the federal representatives and one-third of the senators. The election results show that the Democrats will still control the Senate, while the Republicans will continue to control the House of Representatives. Therefore, partisan gridlock in Washington is still inevitable. With Obama's victory on Tuesday, he will still lead a deeply divided country and will have little time to heal the wounds left by the campaign on both parties. Because the president will soon have a direct confrontation with Congress on taxes and the budget, that is, facing the fiscal cliff at the end of the year. The so-called fiscal cliff refers to the commitment by Congress and Obama in August 2011 to find ways to reduce the expected deficit by US$1.2 trillion within 10 years, and to pass a bill to force themselves to take action: if the two parties cannot reach an agreement, then comprehensive spending cuts will be required in January 2013. The timing coincides with the expiration of a series of tax cuts, which means nearly everyone faces an increase in their tax burden. Obama supports raising taxes on the top 2% of American taxpayers. Romney said he would lower tax rates for everyone and make up for the lost tax revenue by limiting tax credits and filling tax loopholes in the tax code. He believes that this can invigorate the economy and ultimately increase government revenue. A major reshuffle of cabinet members According to tradition, no matter who is elected as the next president of the United States, the current cabinet members will undergo a major reshuffle. According to Federal News Radio, Stephen Hayes, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, analyzed that Obama’s team is very stable and very tired. After four years of service, the State Department, Treasury Department, Department of Defense and Department of Justice in Obama's cabinet are all likely to be replaced. In fact, both the current US Secretary of State Hillary Clinton and Treasury Secretary Timothy Geithner have stated that they do not intend to stay in their second term. No other cabinet members have publicly announced their plans to stay or leave. But Martha Kumar, a professor of political science at Towson University, believes that half of Obama’s cabinet will be replaced. The first to be appointed will be White House staff, including the chief of staff, personnel director and legal counsel. Kumar believes that the appointment of White House personnel will lay the foundation for cabinet appointments: Decisions must be made, such as whether lobbyists who have been lobbyists can be included in the government. The Obama administration does not allow lobbyists to join, without exception. ?/FONT> Gayle Lovelace, who served as director of the General Services Administration after the 2008 election, said the agency had to deal with campaign teams from both parties before Election Day because time was tight and the General Services Administration had to ensure that whoever was elected could start operations immediately without being held back by logistics. Other relevant regulations also ensure the smooth transition of presidential power. For example, the Intelligence Reform and Anti-Terrorism Act of 2004 allows presidential candidates to submit security clearance lists of personnel after being nominated. The Pre-Election Presidential Transition Act passed in 2010 also allows the General Services Administration to provide services immediately after a nomination rather than waiting until election day.

e743cf760f34ba9cd74d4fe189254a1c08314a8c.sourceText: 无锡以轻工业城市着称于江南，过去到无锡游览，主要是太湖边的鼋头渚和惠山，锡山。这次导游把我们带到了太湖边的一个新景点—灵山胜景，这裡是九十年代后期开始建设，本世纪才形成的新的旅游景点，我过去从未来过。 灵山的参观由三部分组成：九龙灌浴，灵山大佛和梵宫。 九龙灌浴是一座大型音乐动态群凋，它是以佛祖释迦牟尼出生的故事为原本建造的。据传，释迦牟尼一出生，就会走路，他每走一步，地上就开出一朵莲花，接着，天空出现九条巨龙为他沐浴淨身。每个小时有一场表演。我们来到场地，在庄严悠扬的音乐声中，莲花瓣徐徐张开，释迦牟尼金身从花瓣中缓缓升起，一手指天，一手指地，面对正前方，环视360度，呈现出佛光普照大地的形象，九条巨龙喷出冲天水柱，场面十分壮观。据介绍，释迦牟尼的造型身高7.2米，是用鎏金制成，耗资巨大，在中国这样的动态群雕还是第一座，十分新奇。但凡去过拉斯维加斯的朋友，会感到这九龙灌浴的创意与拉斯维加斯凯撒宫的凯撒大帝的动态群雕有异曲同工之处。 灵山大佛高高的耸立在钟灵毓秀的灵山高处，背靠小灵，左挽青龙，右牵白虎，面临太湖，是一个风水很好的地方。我去过不少知名的庙宇，几乎都处于三山环抱之中，环境十分幽静，步入其中，犹入仙境一般。’依山面水，座北朝南’是风水先生的基本准则之一，这个地方也给我予同样的感觉，我相信一定是许多风水师共同智慧的结晶，此地还曾是唐玄装自西天取经回来后传经的地方。建造灵山大佛是中国佛教协会会长赵朴初先生的主张，他曾提出了东西南北中’五方五佛’的理念。在中国，西有四川的乐山大佛，北有山西的云岗大佛，中有河南的龙门大佛，南有香港的天坛大佛，灵山大佛在1997年11月15日建成开光，完成了他的这个心愿。
e743cf760f34ba9cd74d4fe189254a1c08314a8c.translatedText: > Wuxi is famous as a light industrial city in the south of the Yangtze River. When I visited Wuxi in the past, I mainly visited Yuantouzhu, Huishan and Xishan on the shores of Taihu Lake. This time the tour guide took us to a new scenic spot on the edge of Taihu Lake - Lingshan Scenic Spot. Construction started in the late 1990s and was only formed in this century. I have never been to this new tourist attraction. The visit to Lingshan consists of three parts: Kowloon Bath, Lingshan Giant Buddha and Brahma Palace. The Kowloon Bath is a large-scale musical dynamic group sculpture, which is based on the story of the birth of Buddha Sakyamuni. According to legend, Sakyamuni could walk as soon as he was born. Every time he took a step, a lotus flower bloomed on the ground, and then nine giant dragons appeared in the sky to bathe and purify him. There is a show every hour. We came to the venue, and amid the solemn and melodious music, the lotus petals slowly opened, and the golden body of Sakyamuni slowly rose from the petals. With one finger pointing to the sky and the other pointing to the ground, he faced the front and looked around 360 degrees, showing the image of the Buddha's light shining on the earth. Nine giant dragons sprayed water columns into the sky. The scene was very spectacular. According to reports, the statue of Sakyamuni is 7.2 meters tall and made of gilt gold. It costs a lot of money. It is the first dynamic group sculpture like this in China and is very novel. Anyone who has been to Las Vegas will feel that the creativity of the Kowloon Bath is similar to the dynamic group sculptures of Caesar at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas. The Lingshan Giant Buddha stands high on the beautiful Lingshan Mountain, with Xiaoling on its back, a green dragon on its left, and a white tiger on its right. It faces Taihu Lake. It is a place with good Feng Shui. I have been to many well-known temples, almost all of which are surrounded by three mountains. The environment is very quiet, and walking into them is like entering a fairyland. 'Near mountains and water, sit north and face south' is one of the basic principles of Feng Shui masters. This place also gives me the same feeling. I believe it must be the crystallization of the common wisdom of many Feng Shui masters. This place was also the place where Tang Xuanzang passed on Buddhist scriptures after he returned from the West. The construction of the Lingshan Giant Buddha was the idea of ​​Mr. Zhao Puchu, the president of the Chinese Buddhist Association. He once proposed the concept of "five directions and five Buddhas" in the east, west, south, north, and middle. In China, there is the Leshan Giant Buddha in Sichuan in the west, the Yungang Giant Buddha in Shanxi in the north, the Longmen Giant Buddha in Henan in the middle, and the Tiantan Giant Buddha in Hong Kong in the south. The Lingshan Giant Buddha was completed and consecrated on November 15, 1997, fulfilling his wish.

e051f0aa3e23d242acf3ab2f338528cb41b616f5.translatedText: The Best Palm in the World

a283448d704d30686f902b2dc631c53bef2613c8.sourceText: 我们因为时间所限，没有向山上登去，只在台阶下远处和大佛留了个影，就径直朝庙宇方向走去，庙宇前方有一只’天下第一手’，是按灵山大佛的右手复制而成。人们争相去摸佛手，说是用手顺时针摸三圈，然后放进口袋，你就会发点小财。你甭说，还真灵验，当天晚上，我和太太回旅馆称体重时，恰好都显示77.7kg，这可是个luckey number，果然10天后，在新加坡的casino游玩时，进去点了一下老虎机，一下子出来三个元宝，它自动不停地转，等于送给我北京到新加坡的免费机票。这可以说成灵验，也可以说是巧合，事情就是这样发生的。
a283448d704d30686f902b2dc631c53bef2613c8.translatedText: Due to time constraints, we did not go up the mountain. We only took a shadow of the Buddha in the distance at the bottom of the steps, and then walked straight towards the temple. In front of the temple, there is a "Number One Palm in the World", which is copied from the right hand of the Lingshan Giant Buddha. People rush to touch the Buddha's hand, saying that if you touch it clockwise three times and then put it in your pocket, you will make a little fortune. Don't tell me, it worked. That night, when my wife and I returned to the hotel to weigh ourselves, it happened to show 77.7kg, which was a lucky number. Sure enough, 10 days later, while playing at a casino in Singapore, I entered and clicked on the slot machine, and three ingots came out. It automatically kept spinning, which was equivalent to giving me a free ticket from Beijing to Singapore. This can be said to be a miracle, or it can be said to be a coincidence. This is how things happened.

d7842bbdc1ee8dd2911debe96e7f042d5c305d5e.translatedText: Exterior view of the Vatican Palace

1d642be697a0d2ea42c2507d95f528c23c31a032.sourceText: 梵宫堪称是佛教的最高文化艺术殿堂，他把深厚的佛教文化和瑰丽灿烂的艺术综合于一体。从入口的两座来自缅甸的白玉大象，到巨大穹顶的殿堂佈满了吉祥花纹和佛教故事画，顶部是一幅幅天像图，飞天莲花和敦煌壁画，真是目不暇接。走进里边的大会堂，圆形的屋顶像星光灿烂的天空，站在那裡，好像置身于浩瀚的宇宙之中，感到自己是那么渺小。在这个可容纳1500人的大厅裡，2009年3 月，世界佛教论坛在这里隆重开幕，三天后，移往台北小巨蛋闭幕。这也是两岸文化交流的一件盛事。经过这麽多年两岸频繁的交往，会谈层次已从民间升到半官方以至官方，日前，实现了国民党名誉主席和共产党党主席的直接会见，胡锦涛和吴伯雄见面时握手的镜头近乎拥抱，我真为这一发展高兴。（待续）
1d642be697a0d2ea42c2507d95f528c23c31a032.translatedText: The Vatican Palace can be called the highest cultural and artistic palace of Buddhism. It integrates profound Buddhist culture and magnificent and splendid art. From the two white jade elephants from Myanmar at the entrance to the huge domed hall covered with auspicious patterns and Buddhist story paintings, the top is full of celestial images, flying lotuses and Dunhuang murals. It is really dizzying. Walking into the Great Hall inside, the circular roof looks like a starry sky. Standing there, you feel like you are in the vast universe and feel so small. In this hall that can accommodate 1,500 people, the World Buddhist Forum was grandly opened here in March 2009. Three days later, it was moved to the Taipei Arena for closing. This is also a grand event for cross-strait cultural exchanges. After so many years of frequent exchanges between the two sides, the level of talks has risen from private to semi-official to official. Recently, a direct meeting between the honorary chairman of the Kuomintang and the chairman of the Communist Party was achieved. The shots of Hu Jintao and Wu Boxiong shaking hands when they met were almost hugging. I am really happy for this development. (to be continued)

6f8fe2923d3399f016d08866fe858205cf31afda.sourceText: 但从下届国务院副总理的最新分工来看，现任副总理王岐山还没有接替者，他所负责和分管的行业及部门，将会划分给几位副总理和国务委员，其中金融、商务和市场经济，将会交给新增设的国务委员来分管。
6f8fe2923d3399f016d08866fe858205cf31afda.translatedText: However, judging from the latest division of labor for the next Vice Premier of the State Council, the current Vice Premier Wang Qishan has not yet been replaced. The industries and departments he is responsible for and in charge of will be divided among several vice prime ministers and State Councilors. Among them, finance, commerce and market economy will be handed over to the newly created State Councilor.

fa06f6ea396fbb2c6441801dc3621d158ce4bf0e.sourceText: 在第十一届国务院中，总理温家宝主持国务院全面工作，常务副总理李克强负责国务院常务工作；负责发展和改革、财政税务、国土资源、环境保护、住房和城乡建设、卫生、人口和计划生育、三峡工程、南水北调工程工作。分管国家发展和改革委员会、财政部、国土资源部、环境保护部、住房和城乡建设部、卫生部等部门。
fa06f6ea396fbb2c6441801dc3621d158ce4bf0e.translatedText: In the 11th State Council, Premier Wen Jiabao presided over the overall work of the State Council, and Executive Vice Premier Li Keqiang was responsible for the executive work of the State Council; responsible for development and reform, finance and taxation, land and resources, environmental protection, housing and urban and rural construction, health, population and family planning, the Three Gorges Project, and the South-to-North Water Diversion Project. In charge of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Land and Resources, Ministry of Environmental Protection, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Health and other departments.

8c7cb2f8d84786a6511c9bf1eec4517ef253081d.sourceText: 另外三位副总理中，回良玉负责农村、农业经济、水利、林业、民政等，分管国家民族事务委员会、民政部、水利部、农业部，国家林业局等部门；张德江负责工业经济、交通运输、国有资产、安全生产工作，分管工业和信息化部、铁道部、交通运输部等部门；王岐山负责商务、金融、市场经济、旅游，分管商务部、中国人民银行，海关总署、国家工商行政管理总局等部门。
8c7cb2f8d84786a6511c9bf1eec4517ef253081d.translatedText: Among the other three vice prime ministers, Hui Liangyu is in charge of rural areas, agricultural economy, water conservancy, forestry, civil affairs, etc., and is in charge of the National Ethnic Affairs Commission, Ministry of Civil Affairs, Ministry of Water Resources, Ministry of Agriculture, State Forestry Administration and other departments; Zhang Dejiang is in charge of industrial economy , transportation, state-owned assets, and production safety work, and is in charge of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Railways, the Ministry of Transport and other departments; Wang Qishan is responsible for commerce, finance, market economy, tourism, and is in charge of the Ministry of Commerce, the People's Bank of China, the General Administration of Customs, the State Administration for Industry and Commerce and other departments.

a5ed41628a1936e75339ece81e7563fef67d969e.sourceText: 在下届国务院中，总理李克强主持全面工作，常务副总理张高丽负责国务院常务工作，并将接手李克强的分工；而排在第二位的副总理刘延东，按排名应该是回良玉的继任者，接手分管农林水， 但北京消息人士指出，正是由于刘的业务能力和工作水平都十分有限，导致下届国务院的四位副总理和五位国务委员的分工，都出现了变动。
a5ed41628a1936e75339ece81e7563fef67d969e.translatedText: In the next State Council, Premier Li Keqiang will preside over the overall work, and Executive Vice Premier Zhang Gaoli will be in charge of the executive work of the State Council and will take over Li Keqiang's division of labor; Vice Premier Liu Yandong, who is ranked second, should be Hui Liangyu's successor according to ranking, and will take over the responsibility for agriculture, forestry, water, However, sources in Beijing pointed out that it is precisely because Liu's business capabilities and work level are very limited that the division of labor among the four vice prime ministers and five state councilors of the next State Council has changed.

edd10537eb658cdc05dcc834c39f6d9215765666.sourceText: 据《中国密报》得到的内部消息，十八大后，在安排下届副总理分工时，由于排在第二位的副总理刘延东对其它行业和部门均不熟悉，而且也没有管理各大经济领域和部门的经验，更缺少相对应的工作能力和水平，只能让其继续分管她担任国务委员时所熟悉的科学、文教、体育和卫生等部门。但对刘延东分工的调整，却牵一发而动全身，令汪洋、马凯及几位国务委员的分工都出现了变动。
edd10537eb658cdc05dcc834c39f6d9215765666.translatedText: According to internal information obtained by "China Secret News", after the 18th National Congress, when arranging the division of labor for the next vice premier, because the second-ranked vice premier Liu Yandong was not familiar with other industries and departments, had no experience in managing major economic fields and departments, and lacked the corresponding work ability and level, he could only be allowed to continue to be in charge of the science, culture, education, sports and health departments that she was familiar with when she was the State Councilor. However, the adjustment of Liu Yandong's division of labor had an impact on the whole body, causing changes in the division of labor of Wang Yang, Ma Kai and several State Councilors.

4db2179b8a808092a4a13ac30591245954e525b0.sourceText: 其实刘延东仍旧分管自己熟悉的工作，十八大后就已基本敲定，使她能继续以国务委员的身份，为出任国务院副总理提前进行一番”热身”。
4db2179b8a808092a4a13ac30591245954e525b0.translatedText: In fact, Liu Yandong is still in charge of the work she is familiar with, which has been basically finalized after the 18th National Congress, allowing her to continue to serve as a State Councilor and "warm up" in advance for her appointment as Vice Premier of the State Council.

6d2881070c95a9f8aa9f90cdfa02379d9ed38be5.sourceText: 上述官方报导，已让刘延东在下届国务院的具体分工初现端倪。北京消息人士称，国务院工作人员都知道，刘只有在自己熟悉的分管领域内才能应对自如，若是让她去抓工业、农业或金融，那简直是赶鸭子上架。
6d2881070c95a9f8aa9f90cdfa02379d9ed38be5.translatedText: The above-mentioned official reports have given early clues to Liu Yandong’s specific division of labor in the next State Council. Sources in Beijing said that State Council staff know that Liu can only cope with the situation in the areas she is familiar with. If she were to focus on industry, agriculture or finance, it would be a rush.

7a88331c4170972f4d252132073234910570603e.sourceText: 图片新闻：亚省春晚，蛇年圣宴，东方艺术，精彩呈现 （”太阳鸟”秋香报道 摄影：Linda Wei，福妞） 2012年2月10日下午4点至6点，期待已久的亚省蛇年春节晚会终于在在钱德勒艺术中心圆满落幕。一千五百多名观众在蛇年的大年初一观看了这场演出。此次晚会由ASU孔子学院和新东方艺术学校联合主办。参加晚会演出的演员共有二百三十多人，除了新东方艺术学校的小学员和成人班学员外，还有一些活跃在亚省各文艺团体的资深艺术家们。此外，还有CHANDLER儿童合唱团的八十名孩子参加了演出。晚会节目以歌舞为主，穿插有武术、气功表演，独唱和合唱，以及小提琴、二胡等器乐演奏，等等。整个晚会气氛欢乐、祥和、喜庆、热闹！ 与以往的晚会相比，今年的春晚在灯光、音响、舞美设计方面都有新的突破。传统的中国元素与西方的现代元素在这场晚会中完美结合。晚会上既有传统的民族歌舞表演，也有现代的西方器乐演奏；既有热闹的武术特技，也有搞笑的音乐小品；既有美国孩子的童声合唱，也有成人演员的歌舞同台。 开场舞蹈《金蛇狂舞》，九十多位演员在欢乐、昂扬、奔放的乐曲声中，挥动彩绸，尽兴狂舞，将蛇年来临的喜庆与欢欣表达得淋漓尽致。 新东方艺术学校舞蹈演员陈思的独舞《飞天》。舞者用肢体配合音乐演绎出敦煌壁画中的飞天形象，配合着舞台变幻莫测的灯光色彩，给观众献上一场视觉盛宴。 儿童舞蹈《红灯笼》，最引人注目的是它的道具。一扇极具中国特色的门缓缓打开，穿着袄红裤的孩子们手提着大红灯笼一拥而出。红门、红灯笼、红对联厖传统的中国红一下子就把观众带进了浓浓年味儿里。 CHANDLER儿童合唱团的八十个孩子出现在下半场的第一个节目里。孩子们演唱的中文歌曲《喜迎春》由新东方艺术学校的老师创作，欢快喜庆；第二首美国歌曲《我爱你，亚利桑那》深情庄重。 四位穿着短裙的青春美少女令人耳目一新，她们演奏的小提琴合奏，欢快激越。 滑稽舞蹈《纤夫的爱》是本场晚会最大的笑点。六位成年男性在男生的歌声中做纤夫装束，扮演着河边拉纤的生活。当音乐中女声响起时，六人齐转身，一下子变成身穿红衣红裤的纤纤女子。霎时间，全场观众乐不可支，笑声迭起。 少林寺出家武僧释延倾和他的中外徒弟同台献艺，刀、枪、棍齐上阵，令现场的美国观众不能自已。 杜松岭的二胡独奏《赛马》，在一声响亮的骏马长鸣中开弦，极具震撼。 壮族群舞《走在山水间》，由三十多个身着壮族服装的女孩子演绎，场面恢宏，气势磅礴。刘三姐那脍炙人口的歌曲在山水间回荡；婀娜亮丽的舞姿在田园中翩跹。大型舞蹈《走在山水间》以其突出的主题，整齐化一的动作，绚丽多彩的舞姿，把人们从喧嚣的闹市引入到青山绿水之间，体验着诗情画意般的美好意境。 董蔚的女声独唱《情深意长》歌声甜美，极具人气。三位伴舞的小姑娘身披彩衣，翩跹而动更是抢眼。 晚会开始之前，新东方和ASU孔子学院在剧场前厅举办了一个招待会。招待会由新东方校长吕丽华和孔子学院院长司马德琳博士共同主持。华人社区众多侨领及媒体记者出席了招待会。CHANDLER市长、MESA社区大学校长潘寿安、资深侨领余文劲、邓朝驹、张华芳，等出席并讲话。他们都以热情洋溢的语言高度评价了新东方和孔子学院为传播中国文化及华人社区做出的具大贡献。并预祝晚会取得成功。
7a88331c4170972f4d252132073234910570603e.translatedText: Photo news: Alberta Spring Festival Gala, the Year of the Snake feast, oriental art, wonderful presentation ("Sunbird" Qiuxiang report Photography: Linda Wei, Fu Niu) From 4 to 6 pm on February 10, 2012, the long-awaited Spring Festival Gala of the Year of the Snake in Alberta finally concluded successfully at the Chandler Arts Center. More than 1,500 spectators watched this performance on the first day of the Year of the Snake. The performance was jointly organized by the ASU Confucius Institute and the New Oriental Art School. There were more than 230 performers in the performance, in addition to the New Oriental Art School. In addition to primary school students and adult class students, there were also some senior artists active in various arts groups in Alberta. In addition, 80 children from the CHANDLER Children's Chorus participated in the performance. The evening program was mainly composed of singing and dancing, interspersed with martial arts, qigong performances, solo and chorus performances, as well as violin, erhu and other instrumental music performances. The atmosphere of the entire party was joyful, peaceful, festive and lively! Compared with previous galas, this year's Spring Festival Gala has new breakthroughs in lighting, sound, and stage design. Traditional Chinese elements and modern Western elements are perfectly combined in this gala. There are both traditional ethnic song and dance performances and modern Western instrumental music performances; there are both lively martial arts stunts and funny musical sketches; there are both children's choruses by American children and singing and dancing by adult actors. In the opening dance "Dance of the Golden Snake", more than 90 actors waved colorful silks and danced wildly to the joyful, high-spirited and unrestrained music, vividly expressing the joy and joy of the Year of the Snake. Dancer Chen Si of the New Oriental Art School performed the solo dance "Flying Sky". The dancers used their bodies to match the music to interpret the flying image in the Dunhuang murals, and combined with the unpredictable lighting colors of the stage, presented a visual feast to the audience. The most eye-catching thing about the children's dance "Red Lantern" is its props. A door with Chinese characteristics slowly opened, and children in coats and red trousers rushed out holding big red lanterns. The red door, red lanterns, and red couplets combined with the traditional Chinese red color immediately brought the audience into the strong New Year atmosphere. Eighty children from the CHANDLER Children's Chorus appeared in the first program of the second half. The children sang the Chinese song "Welcome to the Spring", which was composed by teachers from the New Oriental Art School. The funny dance "Tracker's Love" was the biggest laugh of the party. Six adult men dressed up as trackers while the boys sang, and acted out the life of stretching by the river. When the female voice sounded, all six of them turned around and suddenly turned into slender women in red clothes and red trousers. The whole audience was filled with joy and laughter. Shi Yanqing, a monk from the Shaolin Temple, performed on the same stage with his Chinese and foreign disciples, using knives, spears and sticks, which made the American audience unable to control themselves. Du Songling's erhu solo "Horse Racing" opened with a loud roar of a horse, which was very shocking. The Zhuang ethnic dance "Walking among the Landscapes" is performed by more than thirty girls in Zhuang costumes. The scene is magnificent and majestic. Liu Sanjie's popular song echoes in the mountains and rivers; her graceful and beautiful dance moves in the countryside. Wow. With its prominent theme, unified movements, and colorful dance postures, the large-scale dance "Walking among the Mountains and Rivers" brings people from the noisy downtown to the green mountains and rivers, and experiences a poetic and beautiful artistic conception. Dong Wei's female solo "Love Is Long" has a sweet voice and is very popular. The three little girls dancing in the background are even more eye-catching when they are dressed in colorful clothes. Before the party started, New Oriental and the ASU Confucius Institute held a reception in the front hall of the theater. The reception was co-hosted by New Oriental President Lu Lihua and Dr. Sima Delin, Director of the Confucius Institute. Mayor CHANDLER attended the reception. Pan Shou'an, President of MESA Community College, and senior overseas Chinese leaders Yu Wenjin, Deng Chaoju, and Zhang Huafang attended and delivered speeches. They all spoke highly of New Oriental and the Confucius Institute's great contribution to the spread of Chinese culture and the Chinese community in enthusiastic words, and wished the party a success.

b12bf68bc97c1618ff3b8ed386abb42aab5c96b8.sourceText: 法国总统选举第二轮投票6日上午8时（北京时间14时）在法国本土全面展开。法国多家民调机构当晚20时公布的出口调查结果显示，社会党候选人奥朗德在第二轮总统选举投票中获得51.8%至51.9%的有效选票，战胜现任总统萨科齐。 Mitbbs.com
b12bf68bc97c1618ff3b8ed386abb42aab5c96b8.translatedText: The second round of voting in the French presidential election started at 8 a.m. on the 6th (14:00 Beijing time) in mainland France. Exit survey results released by multiple French polling agencies at 20:00 that night showed that Socialist Party candidate Hollande won 51.8% to 51.9% of the valid votes in the second round of presidential election voting, defeating current President Sarkozy. Mitbbs.com

77bb9a3d23d17dda034ac185ec1be3a067fb395a.sourceText: 一场最没有悬念的总统大选将一位没有任何行政经验的政治家棗左翼社会党总统候选人奥朗德送进了爱丽舍宫。这是法国政治生活的一次大地震，也是左翼自1981年密特朗当选以来，在接连三次总统大选失利后的一次”翻盘”。令人印象深刻的是，左翼自2007年以来赢得了法国几乎所有选举的胜利。目前左翼控制着法国总统府、参议院、法国本土22个大区中的21个地方政权厖而6月份将举行的立法选举将很有可能使社会党最终”攻占”国民议会。这样，2012年的法国将是第五共和国建立以来最为”粉色”的，左翼基本上控制了法国的全部国家和地方政权，包括立法权。 Mitbbs.com
77bb9a3d23d17dda034ac185ec1be3a067fb395a.translatedText: A presidential election with the least suspense sent a politician without any administrative experience, the left-wing Socialist Party presidential candidate Hollande, to the Elysee Palace. This was a major earthquake in French political life and a "comeback" for the left wing after losing three consecutive presidential elections since Mitterrand was elected in 1981. Impressively, the left has won almost every election in France since 2007. The left wing currently controls the French presidential palace, the Senate, and 21 local governments in 22 regions in mainland France. The legislative elections to be held in June will most likely enable the Socialist Party to finally "capture" the National Assembly. In this way, France in 2012 will be the most "pink" since the founding of the Fifth Republic, with the left basically controlling all national and local political power in France, including legislative power. Mitbbs.com

95b4e204a933c9db4ed62a5d7866ccbb9861e23d.sourceText: 数日后进行权力交接 Mitbbs.com
95b4e204a933c9db4ed62a5d7866ccbb9861e23d.translatedText: The transfer of power will take place in a few days Mitbbs.com

1728459fd3ae11dd03e19dbf24365545305909a0.sourceText: 理论上说，法国宪法委员会将在5月8日至10日正式宣布奥朗德当选。其后败选的萨科齐将最晚到15日与奥朗德进行权力交接。交接中最为重要的，是在爱丽舍宫 ”朱庇特”地下核战略武器指挥中心进行的核电钮密码交接。法国总统同时也是武装部队总司令，而且是惟一一个有权力发动核战争的法国人。 Mitbbs.com ”朱庇特”核指挥中心建于1969年，是法国核力量的核心部位，总统能够在这里，通过一个只有他本人才知道的核密码来发动核攻击。在其出访时，则有一个”启动核武器密码箱”直接接连这一中心。总统职权移交中最为核心的一环，就是两位总统进入”朱庇特”中心，单独进行核密码交接。从1987年开始，在进行核密码交接的同时，需要更新总统身份认证系统。离任总统将密码交付给新总统后，新总统将单独对密码进行修改、保存，以确保只有他本人知道。至此，核武器交接就算结束。 Mitbbs.com 新总统在政权交接后应做的第一件事，是任命新政府。这将是一届”临时政府”，其主要功能是主持6月10日举行的立法选举。只有在新的立法选举选出新的多数派政党之后，总统才能真正任命一位多数派总理来辅助他执政。 Mitbbs.com 应该指出的是，萨科齐仅仅一个任期就被选下台，这在法兰西第五共和国历史上是第二次。上一次是1981年中右派的德斯坦在首任总统任期结束后，被社会党的密特朗击败。但当时密特朗因为成功地将社会党和法共组成左翼联盟，因而力量空前壮大；而右翼的希拉克则寄望于德斯坦的失败能够为他打开1988年大选的大门，因而没有全力支持他。左右夹击下，德斯坦仅以48.24%对51.76%的劣势功败垂成。而这一次萨科齐以约4个百分点败于奥朗德，这证明，法国选民相对普遍地摒弃萨科齐。 Mitbbs.com
1728459fd3ae11dd03e19dbf24365545305909a0.translatedText: Theoretically, the French Constitutional Committee will officially announce Hollande's election from May 8th to 10th. Sarkozy, who subsequently lost the election, will hand over power to Hollande on the 15th at the latest. The most important thing in the handover was the handover of the nuclear button code at the "Jupiter" underground nuclear strategic weapons command center in the Elysee Palace. The President of France is also the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces and the only Frenchman with the authority to initiate nuclear war. Mitbbs.com The "Jupiter" nuclear command center was built in 1969 and is the core of France's nuclear forces. Here, the president can launch a nuclear attack through a nuclear code that only he knows. During his visit, there was a "codebox to activate nuclear weapons" directly connected to this center. The most core part of the transfer of presidential power is that the two presidents enter the "Jupiter" center to hand over nuclear codes alone. Beginning in 1987, the presidential identity authentication system needed to be updated at the same time as the nuclear code handover was carried out. After the outgoing president delivers the password to the new president, the new president will modify and save the password alone to ensure that only he knows it. At this point, the handover of nuclear weapons is over. Mitbbs.com The first thing the new president should do after the transfer of power is to appoint a new government. This will be an "interim government" whose main function is to preside over the legislative elections to be held on June 10. Only after a new majority party is elected in new legislative elections can the president actually appoint a majority prime minister to assist him in governing. Mitbbs.com It should be noted that Sarkozy was voted out of office after just one term, which was only the second time in the history of the French Fifth Republic. The last time was in 1981 when center-right d'Estaing was defeated by Mitterrand of the Socialist Party at the end of his first term as president. But at that time, Mitterrand was unprecedentedly powerful because he successfully formed a left-wing alliance between the Socialist Party and the French Communist Party; while the right-wing Chirac hoped that d'Estaing's failure would open the door for him to win the 1988 election, so he did not fully support him. Under attack from both sides, Destin only lost 48.24% to 51.76%. This time, Sarkozy lost to Hollande by about 4 percentage points, which proves that French voters generally abandon Sarkozy. Mitbbs.com

2f9b8f9549fa69cc7712fd75eb1a3b3be3f5ef0f.sourceText: 萨科齐5年是非评说 Mitbbs.com
2f9b8f9549fa69cc7712fd75eb1a3b3be3f5ef0f.translatedText: > Sarkozy’s commentary on the rights and wrongs of the past five years Mitbbs.com

5940695e9a412ecb785c0717242f5ca1be0d29fe.sourceText: 应该承认，萨科齐自2007年上台后，尽管在执政和个人风格方面失误连连，但还是在法国越来越难以适应全球化激烈竞争的现行经济体制方面，做了相当多的改革。据统计，改革项目多达931项，其中包括退休、失业以及设立税收上限等多项旨在提高法国经济竞争力的改革；也包括限制移民、限制伊斯兰教（如禁止在公共场合戴合罩头巾）等多个敏感领域的改革。从对法国社会的研究来看，这些改革有的产生了正面效应，但更多的却是引发严重争议，甚至分裂舆论。而从法国近5年的经济状况来看，这些改革的效应极其有限。在萨科齐治下，法国经济增长过低、外贸逆差过大、公共债务过重等经济上的严重问题基本没有得到改善，法国民众的购买力也一直呈下降趋势。 Mitbbs.com
5940695e9a412ecb785c0717242f5ca1be0d29fe.translatedText: It should be admitted that since Sarkozy came to power in 2007, despite repeated mistakes in governance and personal style, he has made considerable reforms in France's current economic system, which is increasingly difficult to adapt to the fierce competition of globalization. According to statistics, there are as many as 931 reform projects, including many reforms aimed at improving France's economic competitiveness such as retirement, unemployment, and the establishment of tax ceilings; it also includes reforms in many sensitive areas such as restrictions on immigration and restrictions on Islam (such as the ban on wearing headscarves in public). Judging from research on French society, some of these reforms have had positive effects, but more often have caused serious controversy and even divided public opinion. Judging from France's economic situation in the past five years, the effects of these reforms are extremely limited. Under Sarkozy, France's serious economic problems such as low economic growth, excessive foreign trade deficit, and excessive public debt have basically not been improved, and the purchasing power of the French people has also been on a downward trend. Mitbbs.com

5ba7e2783d2b2f97fb2c1547ea2f5e1959c5b9b0.sourceText: 历史学家们也承认，萨科齐成功地做了一些有益的政治体制改革。如他主持修改了宪法，使总统任期不得超过两任，这是一个重要的进步。不过这一改革的正面效应，却被萨科齐推出的其他被广泛批评为”反民主”的政策所大大冲淡。法国媒体批评最多的，就是萨科齐亲自任命法国电视台主席一事。这被视为法国民主的一个严重倒退。 Mitbbs.com 最根本的是，萨科齐改革的”政绩”大多被其引起更大争议的对内对外政策和其个人执政风格冲刷得一干二净。对萨科齐个人的反感往往集中在其种种生活细节之中：上台伊始就在富豪常去的”富盖饭店”搞庆祝，上台不久就将总统的工资提升140%，上台数月就宣布离婚、再婚厖诸如此类的个人生活琐事。法国社会之所以在2012年大选前夕弥漫着一股”反萨科齐情绪”，更重要的当然是其对内对外政策。如果说萨科齐对内实施的右翼财政政策（例如给富人减税）、以及某种带有”准种族主义”色彩的少数族裔政策在部分左翼选民中间引起反感的话，他在对外政策中全面背离戴高乐主义，则是招致法国政界、知识界和外交界等部分传统右翼人士非议的主要原因。戴高乐主义的原则是独立外交，萨科齐上台后则高调重返北约军事指挥系统、在中东执行全面亲以政策等，几乎向美国一边倒。这些政策上的失误，进一步导致了萨科齐在法国失去大部分选民的支持。 Mitbbs.com
5ba7e2783d2b2f97fb2c1547ea2f5e1959c5b9b0.translatedText: Historians also admit that Sarkozy successfully made some beneficial political system reforms. For example, he presided over the amendment of the constitution so that the presidential term should not exceed two terms. This was an important progress. However, the positive effect of this reform was greatly diluted by other policies launched by Sarkozy that were widely criticized as "anti-democratic". The French media criticized Sarkozy personally for appointing the chairman of France Television. This was seen as a serious setback for French democracy. Mitbbs.com The most fundamental thing is that most of the "achievements" of Sarkozy's reforms have been completely washed away by his more controversial domestic and foreign policies and his personal governance style. The personal dislike of Sarkozy is often concentrated in various details of his life: when he came to power, he celebrated at the "Fugai Hotel" where the rich often go, he raised the president's salary by 140% soon after he came to power, he announced divorce and remarriage within a few months of coming to power, and other trivial matters in his personal life. The reason why French society was filled with "anti-Sarkozy sentiment" on the eve of the 2012 election was, of course, its domestic and foreign policies. If Sarkozy's internal right-wing fiscal policies (such as tax cuts for the rich) and some "quasi-racist" minority policies have aroused resentment among some left-wing voters, his comprehensive departure from Gaullism in foreign policy is the main reason for the criticism from some traditional right-wing figures in French political, intellectual and diplomatic circles. The principle of Gaullism is independent diplomacy. After Sarkozy came to power, he made a high-profile return to the NATO military command system and implemented a comprehensive pro-Israel policy in the Middle East, almost tilting to the United States. These policy mistakes further led to Sarkozy losing the support of most voters in France. Mitbbs.com

87cfc7d1ee63903e5c1bca9291cd3c099b4e073e.sourceText: 奥朗德”赶鸭子上架”学外交 Mitbbs.com 新总统奥朗德上台伊始，一系列的国际活动便接踵而至：最为紧迫的是5月18日在美国戴维营举办的G8峰会、20日在芝加哥举办的北约峰会、6月18日在墨西哥举办的G20峰会棗这将是奥朗德首次与中国国家主席胡锦涛的会晤，当然还有不可或缺的欧盟峰会厖作为一名外国观察家，2012 年法国大选最令记者吃惊的，显然是国际议题几乎在选举中完全不存在。在整个竞选过程中，法国似乎是一个地球上的孤岛。甚至在5月2日两位候选人的电视辩论中，国际议题也甚少涉及。其中”中国”仅被提及两次，而”美国”：一次！只是在谈及阿富汗撤军时提及三次”奥巴马”。奥朗德已经没有时间来”学习”担任总统。他对国际事务的有限了解是否会成为其执政、特别是早期执政的阻碍，这是此间观察家们普遍提出的一个问题。 Mitbbs.com 最后的一个问号，则是未来法国”第一夫人”问题。奥朗德在与另一位著名女政治家罗亚尔同居近30年、养育了4个子女后，于2007年总统大选期间正式分手。目前奥朗德同居女友是电视记者瓦莱丽里埃维勒。说不定他的首次国事访问，也许会到中国来。届时将在礼宾上还将创下一个”国际难题”。因为在国际外交礼仪上，并不存在”第一同居夫人”的头衔。难道奥朗德将步萨科齐的后尘，成为在爱丽舍宫结婚的第二位法国总统？
87cfc7d1ee63903e5c1bca9291cd3c099b4e073e.translatedText: Hollande "catches ducks to the shelves" to study diplomacy Mitbbs.com When new President Hollande came to power, a series of international events followed: the most urgent ones were the G8 summit held at Camp David in the United States on May 18, the NATO summit held in Chicago on the 20th, the G20 summit held in Mexico on June 18. This will be Hollande’s first meeting with Chinese President Hu Jintao, and of course the indispensable EU summit. As a foreign observer, in 2012 What surprised reporters most about the 2018 French election was that international issues were almost completely absent from the election. Throughout the campaign, France seemed like an island on earth. Even in the televised debate between the two candidates on May 2, international issues were rarely touched upon. Among them, "China" was mentioned only twice, and "United States": once! He only mentioned "Obama" three times when talking about troop withdrawal from Afghanistan. Hollande has no time to "learn" to be president. Whether his limited understanding of international affairs will become an obstacle to his administration, especially in the early years of his administration, is a question commonly raised by observers here. Mitbbs.com The last question mark is the future "First Lady" of France. Hollande officially broke up with Royal, another famous female politician, during the 2007 presidential election after living together for nearly 30 years and raising four children. Hollande's current live-in girlfriend is TV journalist Valerie Rièweiler. Maybe his first state visit may come to China. There will also be an "international problem" in the protocol. Because in international diplomatic etiquette, the title of "First Housewife" does not exist. Will Hollande follow in the footsteps of Sarkozy and become the second French president to get married at the Elysee Palace?

4fc84307e418a83bac56d71c8aaa4a88ab4b359d.sourceText: 当地时间5月6日晚，法国现任总统萨科齐在巴黎举行的选后集会上发表演讲，承认在当天举行的总统选举第二轮投票中败给左翼社会党候选人奥朗德。 Mitbbs.com
4fc84307e418a83bac56d71c8aaa4a88ab4b359d.translatedText: On the evening of May 6, local time, current French President Sarkozy gave a speech at a post-election rally in Paris, admitting that he had lost to left-wing Socialist Party candidate Hollande in the second round of voting in the presidential election held that day. Mitbbs.com

bff06c67501174fbfb02a8e724b9b9b2d1f80119.sourceText: 新华网巴黎5月6日电 法国现任总统、右翼政党人民运动联盟总统候选人尼古拉萨科齐6日晚承认，在当天举行的总统选举第二轮投票中败给左翼社会党候选人弗朗索瓦奥朗德。 Mitbbs.com
bff06c67501174fbfb02a8e724b9b9b2d1f80119.translatedText: Xinhuanet, Paris, May 6 (Xinhua) -- Nicolas Sarkozy, the current French president and presidential candidate of the right-wing Alliance for the Popular Movement, admitted on the evening of the 6th that he had lost to Francois Hollande, the candidate of the left-wing Socialist Party, in the second round of the presidential election held that day. fa4ae335c103274cc73d079a5b7a6b061ca98096.sourceText: 萨科齐当晚在巴黎举行的一个支持者集会上说，奥朗德是法国新一任总统，应受到尊重。法国选民当天已作出”民主及共和”的选择，他本人将为选举失败承担全部责任。他当晚已和奥朗德通过电话，祝贺他当选。但奥朗德将面临严峻考验，他为此祝愿新总统好运。 Mitbbs.com
fa4ae335c103274cc73d079a5b7a6b061ca98096.translatedText: Sarkozy said at a rally of supporters in Paris that night that Hollande was the new president of France and should be respected. French voters made their choice between "democracy and republic" that day, and he himself will bear full responsibility for the election failure. He had spoken to Hollande on the phone that night to congratulate him on his election. But Hollande will face severe tests, for which he wishes the new president good luck. Mitbbs.com

eb64a804d051b2a5d9f82296cb7a86de7400e5e3.sourceText: 法国多家民调机构6日晚公布的出口民调结果显示，奥朗德在总统选举第二轮投票中获得52％至53.3％的有效选票，战胜萨科齐，当选总统已成定局。在4月 22日举行的第一轮投票中，奥朗德和萨科齐分别获得28.63％%和27.18％的有效选票，领先其他8位候选人，进入第二轮角逐。 Mitbbs.com
eb64a804d051b2a5d9f82296cb7a86de7400e5e3.translatedText: Exit poll results released by multiple French polling agencies on the evening of the 6th showed that Hollande won 52% to 53.3% of the valid votes in the second round of the presidential election. He defeated Sarkozy and was a foregone conclusion. In the first round of voting held on April 22, Hollande and Sarkozy received 28.63% and 27.18% of the valid votes respectively, leading the other eight candidates and entering the second round. Mitbbs.com

d6f3912b96ae22667360d28721897c792bdd19f5.translatedText: > Arizona Governor DOUGLAS A. DUCEY declares a proclamation that each May is "Asian Pacific Heritage Month"

21b1c9a9a006fa70a9ddb7a94096a65236e0af9b.sourceText: 鉴于亚裔和太平洋岛民美国人对推进美国成功做出了许多贡献，增加美国的多样性和丰富性;同时很多亚裔移民十九世纪来到了美国在农业和交通行业工作，建设连接东西海岸的第一条横贯大陆的铁路，从而大大地扩大经济增长全国发展;随着时间的推移，其他移民从东亚，东南亚，亚洲次大陆和太平洋岛屿开始了他们的移民之旅;今天，亚裔美国人是我们的人口增长最快的部分之一
21b1c9a9a006fa70a9ddb7a94096a65236e0af9b.translatedText: > In recognition of the many contributions Asian and Pacific Islander Americans have made to advancing America's success, adding to its diversity and richness; while many Asian immigrants came to the United States in the nineteenth century to work in agriculture and transportation industries, building the first transcontinental railroad connecting the east and west coasts, thereby greatly expanding economic growth across the country; over time, other immigrants began their migrations from East Asia, Southeast Asia, the Asian subcontinent, and the Pacific Islands People's Journey; Today, Asian Americans are one of the fastest growing segments of our population

eeb0bedd2281b24f54fcc89bb7cecc05e07553d9.sourceText: 他们同时增加了语言，种族和宗教的多样性;并正在为世界各地的自由与和平事业服务，第一次世界大战开始在美国军方服役;鉴于为亚太美国人对美国的卓越成就，国会根据公法102-450修订本，将每年5月份指定为亚利桑那州”亚太传统月”以此亚利桑那州对亚太移民作出的重大贡献给予表彰和荣誉。表彰亚裔在美国遍及全国各地，包括在商业，科技，医药，农业，以及教育，艺术，公共服务行业的企业家精神和创新精神。
eeb0bedd2281b24f54fcc89bb7cecc05e07553d9.translatedText: They have simultaneously increased linguistic, racial and religious diversity; and are serving the cause of freedom and peace around the world, serving in the U.S. military beginning in World War I; In recognition of the outstanding achievements of Asian Pacific Americans to the United States, Congress, pursuant to Public Law 102-450, as amended, designated May of each year as Arizona's "Asian Pacific Heritage Month" to recognize and honor Arizona's significant contributions to Asian Pacific immigrants. Recognizes the entrepreneurship and innovation of Asian Americans across the country, including in business, technology, medicine, agriculture, education, the arts, and public service.

0c39628707be25a6add2d95aab10d8b9ae379aec.sourceText: 记得小时候，离家不远有个理发馆，横幅招牌，大字楷书：”发人人理”。从左往右念：”发人人理”；从右往左念：”理人人发”。真是好字好招牌。这其中也道出个真理：理发的中心点在于”人人”。不仅自己图个清凉爽快，还得得到大家认可。于是乎，其中的文章大着去了。
0c39628707be25a6add2d95aab10d8b9ae379aec.translatedText: " . This also tells the truth: the key to haircut is to be cool and happy, and to be recognized by everyone. As a result, the article became popular

ec26cf004c6ade52457484937258822d103d2a1c.sourceText: 初来美国便立马发现美国人讲自由，连发型也自由自在，千奇百怪，无不摩登。庞克族（ Punk) 的哥儿们偏爱公鸡式，两边剃得铮亮，寸草不留，中间半尺鸡冠冲天。做起路来，嘎嘎作响，两肋生风，作鸟人状。嬉皮派 (Hippie) 的哥儿们则长发披肩，遥看瀑布挂后川，飞流直下数英尺，属豪放流。更有不少男士脑后扎一小辫儿，或以猴皮筋扎之，毅然决然，一小撮气焰万丈；或百廻千转，雅然有致，如万古青藤。闲暇之际，观赏各式发型于大街小巷，真犹如步入卢浮宫专展，赏心悦目，受益匪浅。
ec26cf004c6ade52457484937258822d103d2a1c.translatedText: When I first came to the United States, I immediately discovered that Americans are free and have all kinds of weird and modern hairstyles. Punk's buddies prefer the rooster style, with the sides cleanly shaved and a half-inch rooster's comb sticking up to the sky. The sides are windy, like a hippie. The guys have long hair shawl, looking at the waterfall hanging in the back stream, flying down several feet, they are bold and unrestrained. There are also many men who tie their hair in a pigtail, or tie it with a monkey leather band, and they are resolute and arrogant; , pleasing to the eye and benefiting a lot.

ccafd4e550e2adebe7bbab0127f2f79a66e515b3.sourceText: 在下同班有理查君，别出心裁：两侧一溜干净，中间宝盖头，呈蘑菇状，背后乃尼亚加拉大瀑布。阳光照耀之下，金发飘飘，璀璨夺目，再配以西装革履，风度翩翩，颇受女士们的青睐。 NAU 的黑人弟兄们不乏能人，每每有新奇招数问世。细卷儿的黑发本整整齐齐，偏用剃刀犁上几道经纬线，作地球仪状。或是随意交叉纵横，或是刻意留白蓄黑，分明勾勒出林海雪原夹皮沟，亚利桑那大峡谷。
ccafd4e550e2adebe7bbab0127f2f79a66e515b3.translatedText: I have Richard in the next class, who is unique: the sides are clean, the hijab in the middle is mushroom-shaped, and the Niagara Falls is behind it. Under the sun, the blond hair is fluttering and dazzling, and paired with suits and leather shoes, he is elegant and popular with ladies. NAU's black brothers often come up with new tricks. Their thin curly black hair is neatly trimmed with a few latitude and longitude lines, which are randomly intersected in the shape of a globe, or deliberately left white and black to clearly outline the forest, snow, and the Grand Canyon.

23c6dc313ca5316cb811a5724a25411504c5b54f.sourceText: 理发上美发馆动辄十数美元。虽每有优惠 Coupon ，降价百分之若干，但初拉乍到的俺留学穷哥儿们囊中羞涩仍不敢问津。这儿的中国大陆弟兄们个个相应他老人家的伟大号召，自力更生，奋发图强。剃头场面着实壮观。只见那操刀者口中念念有词，吐出些令人半懂不懂的美发业专用术 — 一方面为自己壮胆，一方面让受惠者少安毋躁。那被美发者紧紧抓住围脖的旧报纸，不敢越雷池半步，任人宰割，心中但求上帝保佑。围观者则坐山观虎斗，品头论发，各种型号的喇叭一起广播。一两个小时下来，只见忙地发屑乱飞，个个吹胡子瞪眼睛。一副穷酸相，居然变得青春冒烟。哪个不是自我感觉十二万分地好？！难怪太平天国的翼王石达开要给剃头店题联曰：”磨砺以鬚，问天下头颅几许？及锋而试，看老夫手段如何！”
23c6dc313ca5316cb811a5724a25411504c5b54f.translatedText: Hairdressing salons often cost ten dollars. , the price has been reduced by a few percent, but the poor fellows who are new to studying abroad still dare not pay attention. The Chinese brothers here all responded to his great call and worked hard to achieve their goals. The scene of the haircut was really spectacular. On the one hand, it encourages oneself, and on the other hand, it encourages the recipients to stay calm. The old newspaper held tightly by the hairdresser's scarf does not dare to step out of the way, but prays for God's blessing. The onlookers sit on the mountain and watch the fight, and one or two speakers of various types broadcast together. At the end of the day, everyone was busy blowing their beards and glaring at their eyes. They looked so young and sultry. No wonder Shi Dakai, the Yiwang of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, wrote to the barber shop: "If you sharpen your beard, how much does your head look like?" Try it before it's too late and see what I can do! ”

0a6eb2ca4f781358541f8dde30f669a05be5aab4.sourceText: 日前蒙新来李君垂爱，剃了个光辉无比的头，在 NAU 风光一时，大出风头。李君本操刀有道，怎奈来美前奔波打理，数月辍手，一时间受弟兄重托，不免心虚手软。再加围观者鼓励过度，飘飘然，浑浑然中居然大意失荆州，不觉地在额角处多剪了两刀。顿时头顶形势骤变，颇有中原突围，铁流千里之态。于是败走麦城，叫苦不迭。好在在下我原非光辉形象之辈，当下发表紧急备忘录：人非圣贤，孰能无过？有则改之，不须加勉！只见李君前胸冒热气，背脊出冷汗，精心修改，亡羊补牢。无奈积重难返，矫枉须过正。百般权衡之后，一切从短计较。老子曰：祸兮福之所倚。悲极生乐，绝处逢生。五分钟吱吱咔咔过去，天上复归太平。往镜中一照，年轻何止十五岁！真是”不教乱发催人恼，但喜春风满面生”。围观者莫不拍手叫绝：这下子可以出家修行啦！
0a6eb2ca4f781358541f8dde30f669a05be5aab4.translatedText: Recently, the new arrival Li Junchui fell in love with him and shaved his head with great brilliance. At NAU It was a moment of great success. Li Junben was a good surgeon, but he came to the United States to take care of it. He stopped working for a few months and was temporarily trusted by his brothers. In addition, the onlookers encouraged him too much, and he was careless in Jingzhou, and he made two more cuts on his forehead without realizing it. Suddenly, the situation above me suddenly changed. I was defeated in Maicheng and complained endlessly. Fortunately, I was not a person with a glorious image. I immediately issued an urgent memorandum: I am not a sage. How can I change it? There is no need to encourage me! A cold sweat broke out on my back, and I tried to make amends. After all the mistakes were made, I considered the shortcomings. I said: Happiness comes from misfortunes. Five minutes passed, and the sky returned to peace. More than fifteen years old! It's true that "it's annoying to have unruly hair, but it's a joyful face". All the onlookers clapped their hands and exclaimed: Now I can become a monk!

db6e2aaead695e3e64d9ecac335c65fead578773.sourceText: 几日下来，往返于教室宿舍之途，行人侧目；执教于班级 Lab 之中，学生拍案。先生交口，同学啧啧。自己顿觉得身价百倍，俨然大熊猫莅临 NAU 。褒贬由人去，好坏自心知。这高地冬末之风，稍带几分冰雪之气，呼呼地从头顶拂过，一时间竟悟出无上清凉之道来。
db6e2aaead695e3e64d9ecac335c65fead578773.translatedText: After a few days, passers-by looked at me while walking to and from the classroom and dormitory; In the lab, the students slapped the table. The teacher exchanged words, and the classmates clicked their tongues. I suddenly felt that I was worth a hundred times, just like a giant panda came to NAU. It is up to others to judge the good or bad. The wind in the late winter in the highland whizzed by the top of my head, and I suddenly realized the supreme coolness.

f9d01e74a3c16b5264f30602ca6f4a60ee9011f2.sourceText: 孔老夫子有训在先：肤发受之父母。自古以来，人们对头发从不掉以轻心。发愤攻书者，以发悬梁；忧慲悲苦者，挽断白发三千丈；精忠报国者，怒发冲冠。当今世界，人们对头发倍加重视。秃顶戴假发，长发剃光头；曲者拉直，直者熨曲。留辨的，扎花的，染色的，锔油的，不一而足。一会儿披肩流行，一会儿运动式时髦。转眼间风云突变，又是花菜式，又是刺猬型。六盘山，青龙岭；一枝独秀，杂交优势；狮子滚绣球，三毛流浪记。仪态万端，令人眼花缭乱，真不知何年何月有个标准说法。
f9d01e74a3c16b5264f30602ca6f4a60ee9011f2.translatedText: Confucius taught us first: the skin and hair are affected by the parents. Since ancient times, people have never taken their hair lightly. Those who attack the book with anger will hang their hair on a beam; those who are worried and miserable will lose three thousand feet of gray hair; those who serve the country loyally will be angry and crowned. In today's world, people take their hair very seriously. If you are bald, wear a wig, and if you have long hair, you should shave your head; if you have curly hair, you can straighten it, and if you have straight hair, you can iron it. There are many kinds of ones that are left with distinction, decorated with flowers, dyed, and oiled. One moment the shawl is fashionable, the next moment the sporty style is fashionable. In the blink of an eye, the situation changed suddenly, and it changed into a cauliflower type and a hedgehog type again. Liupan Mountain, Qinglong Ridge; unique beauty, hybrid advantage; lion rolling hydrangea, Sanmao's wandering story. The manners are so sophisticated that it is dazzling. I really don’t know what year or month there is a standard term for it.

ba473c957fa79e4e89104b4c9b8817c4677e2135.sourceText: 发型就象历史，反映社会百态。历史社会又如何不象发型，任人扭曲装扮？既然有幸成为人类一员，要么，妆扮历史社会；要么，被妆扮，没啥好说的。除非去当猩猩狒狒，清一色的板寸型，俨然古晋煤老板风度。虽不算清水出芙蓉，但毕竟是去雕饰、纯天然的。纵观当今社会，所谓各界”精英”又有几个当得起”天然纯真”这几个字？
ba473c957fa79e4e89104b4c9b8817c4677e2135.translatedText: Hairstyles are like history, reflecting all aspects of society. How is it that historical society is not like hairstyle, allowing people to distort and dress up? Since we are lucky enough to be a member of the human race, we must either dress up the historical society or be dressed up, there is nothing to say. Unless you want to be an orangutan baboon, they all have a slim body shape and look like a Kuching coal boss. Although it is not a hibiscus from clear water, it is de-carved and purely natural after all. Looking at today's society, how many of the so-called "elites" from all walks of life are worthy of the words "natural and innocent"?

5ff1d82af6d097d6160d809d67215fe3a1c9a566.sourceText: 呜呼，三分人样七分妆，七分发型不用装！这时节，头顶清凉，灵感冒出，剥得陆放翁名诗，凑成打油诗一首。大不敬处，唯祈今天天气哈哈哈：
5ff1d82af6d097d6160d809d67215fe3a1c9a566.translatedText: Woohoo, three-quarters of a person's makeup, three-part hairstyle, no need to pretend! At this time of year, when the head of the head is cool, inspiration comes out, and Lu Fangweng's famous poem is pieced together into a limerick. No disrespect, I’m just praying for the weather today hahaha:

487e9ba4cd2545c4f1e15d634e3f04e08dfa974c.translatedText: I got a haircut to relax,

83fdf5931883d6f72ebbd6f10047aa77213087d2.translatedText: but I don’t share the same sadness.

014ac5c01544fa9e077420af50e6677da13cb376.translatedText: The bald man in the mirror laughs!
