5358eba79ff02b48508a0187a55ac21fe3db2eb7.sourceText: 亚利桑那州中文学校举行“中华文化大赛”统一书面考试 全美中文学校协会各地会员学校于10月26-28日举行统一书面考试 【全美中文学校协会来稿】全美中文学校协会承办中国国侨办海外华裔青少年”中华文化大赛”首届 大赛，全美中文学校协会各地会员学校的书面考试于10月26-28日在美国各地举行。 中国国侨办今年开始举办海外华裔青少年”中华文化大赛”第一届 大赛，这是一项很高规格、很大规模的国际比赛。在世界各国先举行”中华文化大赛”书面考试，书面考试的优胜者将有资格参加明年夏季国侨办在国内主办的”优胜者夏令营”，并在夏令营期间，举行中华才艺表演、中文演讲等项决赛，以决出”中华文化大赛”的综合奖项。 全美中文学校协会已经成功举办了三届”中华文化知识竞赛”。今年受中国国侨办委托，承办新一届的”中华文化大赛”。全美中文学校协会是美国地区唯一的承办单位。协会以郑良根秘书长为总协调，全体理事会成员、往届的会长理事及协会骨干的所在地都成为主要考试中心。全体理事会分工合作，与各会员学校的负责人一起积极迎接这次大赛。现在大赛前的各项准备正有条不紊地进行；近日考卷已寄达各考点。这次考卷包括简、繁体两类。 全美国的书面考试于10月26-28日在各考点举行。国侨办将派出巡考员到有关考场；协会理事会全体成员和各地中文学校负责人分别承办考试工作并负责严格执行考场规则要求。 亚利桑那地区由全美中文学校协会副会长帅致若、协会副总干事长谢明、现代中文学校教学校长沈颢瑾、希望中文学校教学校长谢小红、凤城华人基督教会中文学校校长李珍、图桑祖荀中文学校校长陈荣基、图桑华人基督教会中文学校校长刘大明共同协调本州的考试工作并负责执行考场规则要求。亚利桑那地区以上五所中文学校的书面考试将于本周末按期举行。亚利桑那其它学校因参赛学生人数较少不另设考场，已归入到邻近中文学校参加统一考试。 全美中文学校协会理事会期待亚利桑那地区各所中文学校考试一切顺利，预祝各地中文学校学生在”第一届中华文化大赛”书面考试中获得好成绩。
5358eba79ff02b48508a0187a55ac21fe3db2eb7.translatedText: Chinese schools in Arizona held the unified written examination of the "Chinese Culture Competition" The National Association of Chinese Schools member schools held unified written examinations from October 26 to 28. [Contribution from the National Association of Chinese Schools] The National Association of Chinese Schools hosted the first "Chinese Culture Competition" for overseas Chinese youth organized by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council of China. The written examinations of member schools of the National Association of Chinese Schools were held across the United States from October 26 to 28. This year, the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council of China started organizing the first "Chinese Culture Competition" for overseas Chinese youth. This is a high-standard and large-scale international competition. The "Chinese Culture Competition" written examination will be held first in various countries around the world. The winners of the written examination will be eligible to participate in the "Winners Summer Camp" hosted by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office in China next summer. During the summer camp, Chinese talent performances, Chinese speeches and other finals will be held to determine the comprehensive awards of the "Chinese Culture Competition". The National Association of Chinese Schools has successfully held three “Chinese Culture Knowledge Competitions”. This year, we were entrusted by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of China to host the new "Chinese Culture Competition". The National Association of Chinese Schools is the only organizer in the United States. The association has Secretary-General Zheng Lianggen as the general coordinator, and the locations of all board members, past presidents, directors, and key members of the association have become major examination centers. The entire board of directors worked together and worked together with the heads of member schools to actively welcome this competition. All preparations before the competition are now being carried out in an orderly manner; the test papers have been sent to various test centers recently. This test paper includes both simplified and traditional Chinese. Written exams across the United States will be held at various test centers from October 26-28. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council will send inspectors to the relevant examination rooms; all members of the association's board of directors and the heads of local Chinese schools will undertake the examination work and be responsible for strictly enforcing the rules and requirements of the examination rooms. In the Arizona region, Shuai Zhiruo, vice president of the National Chinese Schools Association, Xie Ming, deputy director-general of the association, Shen Haojin, teaching principal of Modern Chinese School, Xie Xiaohong, teaching principal of Hope Chinese School, Li Zhen, principal of Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church Chinese School, Chen Rongji, principal of Tucson Zuxun Chinese School, and Liu Daming, principal of Tucson Chinese Christian Church Chinese School, jointly coordinate the state's examination work and are responsible for implementing the examination room rules and requirements. The written exams for the above five Chinese schools in Arizona will be held as scheduled this weekend. Other schools in Arizona do not have separate examination rooms due to the small number of participating students, and have been assigned to nearby Chinese schools to participate in the unified examination. The National Association of Chinese Schools Council looks forward to all the success in the exams of all Chinese schools in Arizona and wishes students from Chinese schools everywhere to achieve good results in the "First Chinese Culture Competition" written exam.

4cbd158a1eddc61067d2bf9f9ff1a5b10124bf4c.sourceText: “凤凰之夜”因你而完美 (可可报道) 2011年9月18日第五届”凤凰之夜”中秋国庆系列活动落下了帷幕。 有数百华人亲自参与到这个活动中，是新老华侨首次联手打造，以及美国主流社会最关注的一次华人活动。 ” 凤凰之夜”中秋国庆系列活动从一年前开始准备，已经记不清开了多少次筹备会议了。 主办方亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会（华联）主席费健在会上介绍自己的时候，总是说他是活动的志愿者，另一个主办方​​亚利桑那孔子学院负责人徐智萍拉着先生唐国明，都 加入了筹备工作，为了寻找到最合适的论坛主题绞尽脑汁。 只要参加了这次论坛的人，都会体会到他们的用心良苦。招待会来了很多重要嘉宾，他们都是华联和州长亚太裔顾问邓朝驹邀请来的。 资深侨领余文劲，也大力支持，带领着老侨们捐款，还邀请了10余名老侨一起出席现场活动。 孔子学院，名列世界500强的大型企业AVNET，李军先生，李雪女士，更是大力出资，让负责财务的大赵快乐而辛苦着。 联络嘉宾，接嘉宾，送嘉宾，放海报，准备食物，音响，财务等等，现场每个细节都是华联筹备会中一次又一次需要探讨的问题。 美中文化交流协会陈志钢，古雅瑜负责节目，东方艺术学校的校长吕丽华，Cindy负责舞会。 王欣欣负责食品，面对日益渐涨的物价，王欣欣可是想尽办法把食物的品质提上去，打扫卫生人的劳动量降下来。 ASU学生学者联合会帮助接待来宾，搬运食品。 孔子学院组织绘画比赛，需要评选300多幅作品，作品评出来了，还要装裱，在MU摆放整齐，展出结束，还要让小朋友顺利八作品领回去。 两位主持人董斌，Cindy都是华联的会员，早好几个星期就开始对稿，对来宾名单。 节目结束了，给主持人Cindy电话，她还在紧张问，今天活动怎样呀？ 会不会乱？ 话筒好像出问题了，急死我们了，舞会大家觉得音乐如何，等等。 还有很多志愿者为这次活动出力，文章中无法一一提到。 志愿者们做了这么多事情，不是为了表扬，只是让大家一起来分享他们努力的成果。 在论坛上，记者被一位来自Honeywell的工程师拉住，他说：”我从来没有参加过中国华侨组织的活动，这次来听你们的论坛，太精彩了，太精彩了，我来自中国台湾， 下次这样的活动，我很希望参加。”在招待会上2年级以下组冠军Song Tianou小朋友，拉着记者给他们全家拍照。 不仅爸爸来了，奶奶也来参加这个快乐的节日。 小家伙非常神气地走上领奖台，举起自己的奖杯。 在活动的现场，有很多第一次参加”凤凰之夜”的朋友，他们或是陪孩子来看画的，或是自己来听论坛的，或是来跳舞唱歌的。我们要感谢中美政府官员对亚利桑那华人社区活动的支持，也要感谢那些为了这次活动在四处奔走，筹款的朋友，更要感谢，那些带着家人朋友来参加活动的朋友，正是每位华人参与， 才让”凤凰之夜”得以完美。
4cbd158a1eddc61067d2bf9f9ff1a5b10124bf4c.translatedText: "Phoenix Night" is perfect because of you (Coco Report) On September 18, 2011, the fifth "Phoenix Night" Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day series of activities came to an end. Hundreds of Chinese people personally participated in this event. It was the first time that new and old overseas Chinese jointly created it, and it was a Chinese event that attracted the most attention from mainstream society in the United States. The preparations for the "Phoenix Night" Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day series of activities began a year ago, and I have lost count of how many preparatory meetings were held. When Fei Jian, chairman of the Arizona Chinese Federation (Hualian), the organizer, introduced himself at the meeting, he always said that he was a volunteer for the event. Xu Zhiping, director of the Arizona Confucius Institute, another organizer, and her husband Tang Guoming, all joined in the preparations and racked their brains to find the most suitable theme for the forum. Anyone who has participated in this forum will appreciate their good intentions. There were many important guests at the reception, all of whom were invited by Hualian and the governor’s Asian and Pacific Islander advisor Deng Chaoju. Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader, also gave strong support and led the overseas Chinese to donate money. He also invited more than 10 overseas Chinese to attend the on-site event. The Confucius Institute and AVNET, a large enterprise ranked among the top 500 companies in the world, Mr. Li Jun and Ms. Li Xue have invested heavily to make Da Zhao, who is responsible for finance, happy and hard-working. Contact guests, pick up guests, send guests off, put up posters, prepare food, sound, finance, etc. Every detail on the scene is an issue that needs to be discussed again and again in the Hualien preparatory meeting. Chen Zhigang and Gu Yayu of the US-China Cultural Exchange Association are in charge of the program, and Lu Lihua and Cindy, the principals of the Oriental Art School, are in charge of the dance. Wang Xinxin is in charge of food. Faced with the rising prices, Wang Xinxin tries her best to improve the quality of the food and reduce the workload of the cleaning staff. The ASU Student and Scholar Association helped receive guests and carry food. The Confucius Institute organizes a painting competition and needs to select more than 300 works. Once the works have been selected, they need to be framed and placed neatly in MU. After the exhibition is over, the children have to take home the eight works smoothly. The two hosts, Dong Bin and Cindy, are both members of Hualian, and they started reviewing drafts and guest lists several weeks in advance. After the show ended, I called the host Cindy. She was still nervous and asked, how was today's event? Will it be messy? There seems to be something wrong with the microphone, which makes us anxious. What do you think of the music at the dance, etc. There are many other volunteers who contribute to this event, too many to mention in this article. The volunteers have done so many things, not for praise, but for everyone to share the results of their efforts. At the forum, the reporter was grabbed by an engineer from Honeywell. He said, "I have never participated in an event organized by Chinese overseas Chinese. Coming to listen to your forum this time is so exciting, so exciting. I am from Taiwan, China. I hope to participate in such an event next time." At the reception, Song Tianou, the champion of the under-2 grade group, pulled the reporter to take photos of their family. Not only dad is here, but grandma is also here to participate in this happy festival. The little guy walked up to the podium very proudly and raised his trophy. At the event, there were many friends who participated in "Phoenix Night" for the first time. They either accompanied their children to watch the paintings, or came to listen to the forum by themselves, or came to dance and sing. We would like to thank the Chinese and American government officials for their support of the activities of the Chinese community in Arizona. We would also like to thank those friends who have traveled around to raise funds for this event. We would also like to thank those friends who brought their families and friends to participate in the event. It is the participation of every Chinese that makes "Phoenix Night" perfect.

9d216ff1c1d0e36debc2f094dffe199f6a98cf51.sourceText: （亚利桑华人历史协会通讯）2017年5月27日，亚利桑那历史协会在银龙酒家召开了首次理事会议，会议上确定理事成员的分工，具体任务，以及协会未来的发展方向。 会议由会长张肇鸿主持， 他在发言中表示，经过两年多的筹划，「亚利桑那华人历史协会」在广大华人华侨的支持下，已正式成立。协会将积极做好美国和亚省华人历史的搜集、研究和传承的工作。由于历史的原因，华人先民的客观记载十分匮乏。华人是美国移民群体的一部分，与其他移民一起构成了美国社会。华人华侨不仅用智慧、才能和艰苦奋斗的精神，为美国社会的发展做出了不可磨灭的历史贡献，更带去了中国优良的文化思想和教育理念，丰富了美国的政治、人文、经济生活。但我们无法接受历史上一些对华人歪曲和贬低的记载，历史需要还原本来的面目。现在越来越多的华人意识到，发掘、保护和完善华人移民历史的重要性，从而推动对华人历史及华人的正确认识和评价。目前，美国已有多个州城市相继成立了华人历史研究团体和组织。 张肇鸿会长三十年来，以古道热肠去搜集和整理亚省的华人历史，至目前已经出版了有关华人奋斗历史的两本印刷版和多本电子版《沙漠明珠》书集。在20多年前，亚省作家和学者唐孝先最早报道出关于寻找华人墓碑资料的信息，但当时要找谈何容易？张会长当时工作繁重，只能把信息先保留起来，但他从未放弃思索和收集资料， 直到近年才终于破解了这个”墓碑之谜”，华人褔利会并为凤凰城华人先民建立了纪念墓碑。在此过程中，他和唐孝先先生结下了不解之缘，共同商量如何建立一个华人历史协会，并希望通过这个协会去凝聚亚省侨学界的力量，把发掘和研究亚省华人历史工作做好。 副会长唐孝先在发言中指出，成立华人历史协会不仅在当地华人社区引起强烈反响，也获得海外华人的热评和发来贺信。亚省华人历史协会的成立是侨界的一件大事和好事。华人历史总要有人开拓，有人纪录和有人来传承。这是沉甸甸的历史之重，人文之责。他相信在大家的齐心协力下，协会不会有负众望。 秘书长余民信对协会工作展开信心满满，现在他着手翻译张肇鸿所写的亚省华人百年历史丛书《沙漠明珠》的第三集，书中内容纪录了亚省历史上杰出华人的事迹，他认为内容很有份量，也很有意义。他查看了许多历史文人献，力求尊重和翻译好原文，让中、英文的新书今年与读者见面，也让华裔和主流社会能看到华人先民对亚省历史的贡献。 会务理事阮霭明，几十年如一日无微不至的帮助中国留学生，在华人社区传为佳话，她对协会的发展提出了建设性意见。公关理事徐强希望协会在秉承华人历史工作的同时，也可以作为中华文化艺术交流的合作平台，促进中华文化在美国多元文化社会发挥的积极作用，提升华人在美国的社会地位。中国人提倡和谐的思想，越来越让美国人民意识到只有和谐相处才能共同发展的道理。 理事梁月园，黄丽容，谢成彦和陈丽君就协会的信息资源共享，资金管理和运作，媒体宣传和互动，海内外联络及兄弟社团交流，举办华人历史讲座和主题活动等议题发表了看法。会上大家畅所欲言，献计献策，气氛活跃，对协会的发展充满信心，也深感责任重大。亚利桑那华人历史协会认为， 找回被遗忘的华人历史，发掘华人对美国社会的贡献，任重而道远， 需要更多人的支持和参与， 因为只有了解过去， 才会有更美好的未来。（陈丽君撰文， 谢成彦摄影）
9d216ff1c1d0e36debc2f094dffe199f6a98cf51.translatedText: (Newsletter of the Arizona Chinese Historical Society) On May 27, 2017, the Arizona Historical Society held its first board of directors meeting at the Silver Dragon Restaurant. At the meeting, the division of labor, specific tasks of the board members, and the future development direction of the association were determined. The meeting was chaired by President Zhang Zhaohong. In his speech, he said that after more than two years of planning, the "Arizona Chinese Historical Association" has been officially established with the support of the majority of overseas Chinese. The association will actively carry out the work of collecting, researching and passing on Chinese history in the United States and Alberta. Due to historical reasons, objective records of the Chinese ancestors are very scarce. The Chinese are part of the immigrant community in the United States and, together with other immigrants, make up American society. Overseas Chinese have not only made indelible historical contributions to the development of American society with their wisdom, talent and spirit of hard work, but have also brought with them China's excellent cultural thoughts and educational concepts, enriching the political, humanistic and economic life of the United States. But we cannot accept some distorted and derogatory records of the Chinese in history. History needs to be restored to its true colors. Now more and more Chinese are aware of the importance of discovering, protecting and improving the history of Chinese immigration, thereby promoting a correct understanding and evaluation of Chinese history and Chinese people. Currently, Chinese history research groups and organizations have been established in many states and cities in the United States. President Zhang Zhaohong has been collecting and organizing the history of the Chinese in Alberta for thirty years. So far, he has published two printed and multiple electronic versions of the "Pearl of the Desert" book collection on the history of the Chinese people's struggle. More than 20 years ago, Alberta writer and scholar Tang Xiaoxian first reported information about finding information on Chinese tombstones. But how easy was it to find them at that time? President Zhang had a heavy workload at the time and could only keep the information first, but he never gave up thinking and collecting information. It was not until recent years that he finally solved the "mystery of the tombstone." The Chinese Welfare Association also built a commemorative tombstone for the Chinese ancestors in Phoenix City. During this process, he and Mr. Tang Xiaoxian formed an indissoluble bond, and they discussed together how to establish a Chinese history association, and hoped that through this association, they could unite the strength of the overseas Chinese community in Alberta and do a good job in discovering and researching the history of Chinese people in Alberta. Vice President Tang Xiaoxian pointed out in his speech that the establishment of the Chinese Historical Association not only aroused strong responses from the local Chinese community, but also received warm praise and congratulatory letters from overseas Chinese. The establishment of the Alberta Chinese Historical Association is a major event and a good thing for the overseas Chinese community. Chinese history always needs someone to develop it, someone to record it and someone to pass it on. This is a heavy historical burden and a humanistic responsibility. He believed that with the concerted efforts of everyone, the association would not disappoint. Secretary-General Yu Minxin is full of confidence in the work of the association. Now he is translating the third volume of the "Pearl of the Desert" series on the century-old history of Chinese in Alberta written by Zhang Zhaohong. The content in the book records the deeds of outstanding Chinese in the history of Alberta. He believes that the content is very weighty and meaningful. He has reviewed many historical documents and strives to respect and translate the original texts so that new books in Chinese and English can be introduced to readers this year, and also allow Chinese Americans and mainstream society to see the contribution of Chinese ancestors to the history of Alberta. Ruan Aiming, the director of the association, has been helping Chinese students in every possible way for decades and has become a good story in the Chinese community. She has put forward constructive suggestions for the development of the association. Public Relations Director Xu Qiang hopes that while adhering to the work of Chinese history, the association can also serve as a cooperation platform for Chinese cultural and artistic exchanges, promote the positive role of Chinese culture in the multicultural society of the United States, and enhance the social status of Chinese in the United States. The Chinese advocate the idea of ​​harmony, which increasingly makes the American people realize that only by living in harmony can common development be achieved. Directors Liang Yueyuan, Huang Lilong, Xie Chengyan and Chen Lijun expressed their views on the association's information resource sharing, fund management and operation, media promotion and interaction, domestic and overseas liaison and exchanges with fraternal societies, and organizing Chinese history lectures and theme activities. At the meeting, everyone spoke freely, offered ideas and suggestions, and the atmosphere was lively. They were full of confidence in the development of the association and deeply felt the great responsibility. The Arizona Chinese Historical Association believes that retrieving the forgotten Chinese history and discovering the Chinese contributions to American society has a long way to go and requires the support and participation of more people, because only by understanding the past can we have a better future. (Written by Chen Lijun, photographed by Xie Chengyan)

a7a88b08101ef08a6ecd736e1f5bbd680aabe13f.sourceText: 沈宁，祖籍浙江嘉兴，外公为现代史著名历史人物、蒋介石的文胆陶希圣，伯父即为现代史著名”七君子”之一、全国人大副委员长、全国政协副主席沈钧儒。沈宁1977年考入西安西北大学，毕业后任陕西电视台导演。1983年赴美国留学，曾任美国之音新闻主播，美国空军学校教官等。目前已出版《美国十五年》、《战争地带-目击美国中小学》、《商业眼》、《点击美国中小学教育》、《美军教官笔记》及长篇传记小说《唢呐烟尘》、《百世门风》、《一个家族记忆中的政要名流》等，叙述了许多与其家庭有渊源的民国人物的难忘故事，如蔡元培、郁达夫、杜月笙、蒋介石、胡适、陈布雷、蒋纬国等，用他的话说就是”抢救真实的历史”。
a7a88b08101ef08a6ecd736e1f5bbd680aabe13f.translatedText: Shen Ning was born in Jiaxing, Zhejiang Province. His grandfather was a famous historical figure in modern history and Chiang Kai-shek's literary daring Tao Xisheng. His uncle was Shen Junru, one of the famous "Seven Gentlemen" in modern history, Vice Chairman of the National People's Congress and Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. Shen Ning was admitted to Northwest University in Xi'an in 1977 and served as the director of Shaanxi TV Station after graduation. In 1983, he went to the United States to study and served as a news anchor for Voice of America and an instructor at the U.S. Air Force School. Currently, he has published "Fifteen Years in the United States", "War Zone - Witnessing American Primary and Secondary Schools", "Business Eyes", "Click on American Primary and Secondary School Education", "US Military Instructor's Notes" and full-length biographical novels "Suona Smoke and Dust", "A Hundred Generations of Family Style", "A Family" "Political Celebrities in Memory" and so on, which narrate many unforgettable stories of figures of the Republic of China who have connections with their families, such as Cai Yuanpei, Yu Dafu, Du Yuesheng, Chiang Kai-shek, Hu Shi, Chen Bulei, Jiang Weiguo, etc. In his words, it is "rescuing the true history."

917ed661bee492578a5229852a718bb99e531b1c.sourceText: 我的朋友开了家公司﹐但都报亏损﹐国税局查到他逃税20几万美元﹐他会不会影响他的绿卡身份﹖
917ed661bee492578a5229852a718bb99e531b1c.translatedText: My friend opened a company, but reported losses. The IRS found that he evaded more than 200,000 US dollars in taxes. Will this affect his green card status?

9686ac663f9a3368a443e086b925834a064d1c94.sourceText: 要看你朋友逃漏税是属于哪种﹐无心的过失还是故意诈欺而定。1992年，加州居民日裔川岛夫妇申报其拥有的日本尼康公司（Nikon Serbutsu Kagaku Center Inc.）股票亏损，结果逃税24万5126元。国税局经查证发现，其申报属于税务欺诈，移民局法官1997年判其犯下联邦重罪（Felonies），吊销其绿卡，驱除出境。川岛夫妇随即提出上述，被联邦第九巡迴上诉法院驳回，川岛夫妇再上诉至联邦最高法院。最高法院于2011年11月7日受理并展开激辩，最后以六比三通过维持原判，于今年2月21日宣判吊销川岛夫妇绿卡并限期离境返回日本。最高法院引用的26 U.S. C 7206(1)与7206(2)条款，指控川岛先生签署不实税表，而川岛太太则被指控为「合谋」「炮製」不实税表。对于明知故犯（Willfully）的不实税表申报人及其「帮凶」（Aid or Assistance），如果意图逃税金额超过一万美元，其欺诈行为（Fraud or Deceit）将构成并判以重罪。 如果你的朋友只是因为知识不够没有报上正确的报税数额﹐只要补交因该没有刑罚或吊销绿卡的问题。
9686ac663f9a3368a443e086b925834a064d1c94.translatedText: It depends on whether your friend’s tax evasion is an honest mistake or intentional fraud. In 1992, the Japanese-born Kawashima couple, residents of California, declared a loss on the shares of Nikon Serbutsu Kagaku Center Inc. they owned, resulting in a tax evasion of $245,126. After investigation by the Internal Revenue Service, it was discovered that his declaration was tax fraud. In 1997, an immigration judge convicted him of committing a federal felony (Felonies), revoked his green card, and deported him. The Kawashima couple immediately proposed the above, which was rejected by the Federal Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals. The Kawashima couple appealed to the Federal Supreme Court. The Supreme Court accepted the case on November 7, 2011 and launched a heated debate. Finally, it upheld the original verdict by a vote of 6 to 3. On February 21 this year, it was sentenced to revoke the Kawashima couple's green cards and to leave the country and return to Japan within a time limit. The Supreme Court cited 26 U.S. C 7206(1) and 7206(2), accusing Mr. Kawashima of signing false tax returns, while Mrs. Kawashima was accused of "conspiracy" and "concocting" false tax returns. For willfully false tax return filers and their "aid or assistance", if the amount of tax evasion exceeds $10,000, their fraud (Fraud or Deceit) will constitute and be punished as a felony. If your friend fails to report the correct tax amount simply because of lack of knowledge, there should be no penalty or revocation of his green card as long as he makes a supplementary payment.

0d78dc35261d4bc33563581520cd4d9ba44f4327.sourceText: ”先恋爱后结婚”的习惯说法也许要被全美新现实所取代：先上大学再有好工作，随后有房有存款，才能谈婚论嫁。但分析人士认为，以上四条具备也许把婚姻变成”奢侈品”。
0d78dc35261d4bc33563581520cd4d9ba44f4327.translatedText: The customary saying of "fall in love first, then get married" may be replaced by the new reality in the United States: first go to college and then get a good job, and then you can have a house and savings before you can talk about marriage. However, analysts believe that the above four conditions may turn marriage into a "luxury product."

27414c8e6a22a0546ac9c6ffcf4d54676f1dcfdb.sourceText: 工作量增工资减少 外籍劳工权益受侵明显 最新的调查显示，许多美国人认为，疲弱的经济迫使他们的工作量增加，但所得不变，甚至减少。 NBC新闻网报导，近半数领取时薪的美国工人将表示，他们的雇主有时违反有关加班的规定。约49%受 访的美国工人表示，他们对加班的工作时数满意，另外43%美国工人说，他们希望增加工时。 这项由哈里斯互动公司(Harris Interactive)为人力资源公司Kronos Inc.所做的调查显示，投诉雇主违反薪资和工时的美国工人有暴增的趋势，这些投诉包括超时工作，以及加班薪资计算错误。根据Seyfarth &Shaw法律公司的估计，今年截至至今，逾7000人根据《公平劳工标准法》(Fair Labor Standards Act)对雇主提出诉讼。但十年前，控讼雇主的案件只有2000件。 约三分之二外国领取时薪的工人表示，他们的雇主有时违反有关加班的规定。这些受访对象包括英国、法国、澳洲、中国、加拿大、墨西哥、印度和巴西等国家的时薪工人。 最可能投诉权益遭侵犯的工人为中国、印度和英国的时薪工人。大部分受访的时薪工人愿意加班工作，因为他们希望获得较多报酬。 这项调查的访查对象包括666名美国人和1700位其他国家领取时薪的工人。
27414c8e6a22a0546ac9c6ffcf4d54676f1dcfdb.translatedText: Increased workload, reduced wages, obvious violation of foreign workers' rights. The latest survey shows that many Americans believe that the weak economy has forced their workload to increase, but their income remains unchanged or even reduced. NBC News reports that nearly half of U.S. workers who receive hourly wages say their employers sometimes violate overtime rules. About 49% of American workers surveyed said they were satisfied with the number of overtime hours they worked, and another 43% said they wanted to increase their working hours. The survey, conducted by Harris Interactive for staffing firm Kronos Inc., showed a surge in U.S. workers filing complaints against their employers for wage and hour violations, including overtime work and miscalculations of overtime pay. So far this year, more than 7,000 people have filed lawsuits against their employers under the Fair Labor Standards Act, according to estimates from the law firm Seyfarth & Shaw. But ten years ago, there were only 2,000 cases against employers. About two-thirds of foreign hourly wage workers said their employers sometimes violate overtime rules. Those interviewed included hourly wage workers in countries including the United Kingdom, France, Australia, China, Canada, Mexico, India and Brazil. The workers most likely to complain about rights violations are hourly wage workers in China, India and the United Kingdom. Most of the hourly workers interviewed were willing to work overtime because they wanted to be paid more. The survey included 666 Americans and 1,700 hourly wage workers from other countries.

After adding test sites, it has recently begun recruiting testers for a new phase of the experiment. The company is looking for people with driver's licenses in Arizona who will be paid $20 an hour to work six to eight hours a day. The job content is to sit in the left car to experience the performance of the self-driving car, and then write a report to the engineering staff. However, for the quality of the report, Google also requires applicants to have a university degree and good communication skills. But I feel like this is also the easiest way to join Google~

3ae1adf267cc6789249cb79cc70c6a33e154d630.sourceText: 新东方艺术学校开设暑期英文演讲俱乐部，由知名的英文老师仝校长(Dr. Fawzia Mai Tung)主持，仝校长义务为俱乐部服务，俱乐部免费向孩子们开放。仝校长将帮助孩子们掌握英文演讲技巧，在短期内快速扩大孩子们的英语词汇量和提高孩子们的语言组织能力和口头表达能力。俱乐部每周活动一次，每次两小时。仝校长将根据孩子们的年龄分成不同的小组和选择适合的演讲主题。

aa313b0cc331c83a29fd31816fa25f9fcf64d104.sourceText: 亚洲消费降温 全球经济感冒 每当对美国和欧洲出口减缓时，亚洲各国强劲的消费能力向来能支撑经济持续成长，不过近来的迹象显示，亚洲消费者的支出呈现降温迹象，这对全球经济仅存的少数亮点是坏消息。 韩国人购买汽车数量减少，中国消费者也紧缩买新衣服的支出。香港路易威登(Louis Vuitton)精品店外排队的购物者人数已不如以往。澳门和新加坡赌场百家乐赌桌的押注金额增长比过去三年慢。 部分经济学家说，近几个月来亚洲许多国家原本表现突出的行业，成长开始减缓。许多店家和企业主说，他们已感受消费者转趋审慎的效应。 投资数家意大利餐厅的香港主厨伊姆兰(Shawkat Imran)说：”消费力已不如以往。有时候顾客共享一份食物，以前会点葡萄酒的顾客，现在只要开水。” 伊姆兰说，顾客人数没有减少，但他们分享菜肴，每笔账单支出减少约20%。 消费者信心的转变并不明显，尚未出现像西班牙和希腊支出急剧减少的迹象，但在许多亚洲经济体，支出成长已从高水位退潮。如果欧美经济持续滑落，亚洲贸易前景恶化，亚洲消费者将被迫更大幅削减支出。 在亚洲最大经济体中国，7月零售销售比去年同期成长13%，仍然相当强劲，但比过去几年超过20%减缓许多。为提振销售，中国政府已推出鼓励购买家电的税务奖励措施。 在仰赖出口贸易的韩国，消费已陷于停滞，百货公司销售与汽车销售呈现萎缩，住宅价格开始下跌、政府推出一连串支持消费的措施，包括更宽松的房屋贷款条件，且正研议大规模刺激经济方案。
aa313b0cc331c83a29fd31816fa25f9fcf64d104.translatedText: Asian consumption is cooling, the global economy is catching a cold Whenever exports to the United States and Europe slow down, the strong consumption power of Asian countries has always supported continued economic growth. However, recent signs show that Asian consumer spending is showing signs of cooling, which is bad news for the few remaining bright spots in the global economy. South Koreans are buying fewer cars, and Chinese consumers are cutting back on spending on new clothes. There are not as many shoppers queuing outside the Louis Vuitton boutique in Hong Kong as before. Betting on baccarat tables in casinos in Macau and Singapore has grown more slowly than in the past three years. Some economists say growth in industries that had been outstanding performers in many Asian countries has begun to slow in recent months. Many stores and business owners say they are already feeling the effects of consumers becoming more cautious. Shawkat Imran, a Hong Kong chef who invests in several Italian restaurants, said: "Consumption power is not what it used to be. Sometimes customers share a meal, and customers who used to order wine now only need boiling water." Imran said that the number of customers has not decreased, but they share dishes, and each bill is reduced by about 20%. The shift in consumer confidence has been less pronounced and there are no signs yet of the sharp decline in spending seen in Spain and Greece, but in many Asian economies spending growth has receded from high water levels. If the European and American economies continue to decline and Asia's trade prospects worsen, Asian consumers will be forced to cut spending even more. In China, Asia's largest economy, retail sales increased by 13% in July compared with the same period last year, which is still quite strong, but much slower than the more than 20% in the past few years. To boost sales, the Chinese government has introduced tax incentives to encourage the purchase of home appliances. In South Korea, which relies on export trade, consumption has stagnated, department store sales and automobile sales have shrunk, and housing prices have begun to fall. The government has launched a series of measures to support consumption, including easier housing loan conditions, and is deliberating a large-scale economic stimulus plan.

0e196f66b0a93aa8f55c9a5c134a782c07557dc1.sourceText: 亚省艺术学院继成功举办了2018年亚省春晚后，其高水平的表演受到凤凰城各界的青睐。春节前后各项庆典活动纷纷邀请该校节目参演。
0e196f66b0a93aa8f55c9a5c134a782c07557dc1.translatedText: The Alberta College of the Arts has successfully held the 2018 Alberta Spring Festival Gala, and its high-level performances have been favored by all walks of life in Phoenix. The school’s programs have been invited to participate in various celebrations before and after the Spring Festival.

65391919b32a5bc344fb5f5eb5d86d03b38e00ba.sourceText: 多年的亚省春晚在社会上渐渐产生了一定影响，今年的晚会更是精彩纷呈，让越来越多的美国人喜爱上了中国艺术。春节前后凤凰城几所公立高中、初中及小学便邀请亚省艺术学院的老师前去辅导中国舞蹈及舞龙舞狮。一所高中的舞蹈队常年训练美国舞蹈，今年邀请亚省艺术学院杰西卡和邱晓榕老师前去辅导，引入了中国”扇子”元素，舞起来格外新颖好看。女孩舞龙舞狮在中国极为罕见，而美国女生却没什么禁忌，经过亚省艺术学院老师的教学辅导，舞起来似模似样。”手绢舞”是儿童的最爱，几节课下来能将手绢转成伞状，那种喜悦连家长看了都惊奇不已，小学生更是爱不释手。
65391919b32a5bc344fb5f5eb5d86d03b38e00ba.translatedText: Over the years, the Alberta Spring Festival Gala has gradually had a certain impact on society. This year's gala was even more exciting, making more and more Americans fall in love with Chinese art. Around the Spring Festival, several public high schools, junior high schools and elementary schools in Phoenix invited teachers from the Art Institute of Alberta to teach Chinese dance, dragon and lion dance. A high school dance team has been training American dance all year round. This year, teachers Jessica and Qiu Xiaorong from the Art College of Alberta were invited to provide coaching. They introduced the Chinese "fan" element and the dance was particularly novel and beautiful. It is extremely rare for girls to dance dragon and lion dances in China, but there are no taboos for American girls. After the teaching and guidance of teachers from the Art Institute of Alberta, they can dance with ease. "Handkerchief Dance" is children's favorite. After a few classes, they can turn a handkerchief into an umbrella shape. Even parents are surprised by the joy, and primary school students can't put it down.

47cb40f9fd1f9d263ec7c019935fc91ae02bc331.sourceText: 艺术，是世界共通的语言。优秀的艺术总能得到各个族群的喜爱。多年来，亚省艺术学院在传播中国优秀文化艺术方面做出了不懈的努力。除了完成本职教学外，还深入到各个学校、社区及社会团体，演出、教学中国民族民间艺术，为广泛传播中国文化艺术不遗余力。2018年的中国周，新春晚会，在亚省州立大学举办的国际母语日等各种活动中，亚省艺术学院的节目受到观众们的热烈欢迎。一份耕耘一份收获，亚省艺术学院在亚利桑那播下中国艺术的种子，必将迎来春暖花开。
47cb40f9fd1f9d263ec7c019935fc91ae02bc331.translatedText: Art is a common language in the world. Excellent art can always be loved by all ethnic groups. Over the years, the Alberta College of Art has made unremitting efforts in spreading China’s excellent culture and art. In addition to completing his teaching duties, he also went to various schools, communities and social groups to perform and teach Chinese folk arts, sparing no effort to widely disseminate Chinese culture and art. In various activities such as China Week in 2018, the New Year Gala, and the International Mother Language Day held at Alberta State University, the programs of the Alberta College of Art were warmly welcomed by the audience. With hard work and hard work, the Art Institute of Alberta has sown the seeds of Chinese art in Arizona, and the flowers will bloom in the spring.

54f5a6c89e04775383e37c957edc91508702552d.sourceText: 在刚刚结束的纪念美国阵亡军人的绘画大赛上，来自Desert Vista High School 的艾米同学，以其优美的构图和出色的绘画技艺，在激烈的竞争中脱颖而出，荣获亚省第一名，并获得二千美元的高额奖金。
54f5a6c89e04775383e37c957edc91508702552d.translatedText: In the just-concluded painting competition to commemorate the fallen American soldiers, from Desert Vista High School Student Amy, with her beautiful composition and excellent painting skills, stood out in the fierce competition, won first place in the province, and received a high prize of US$2,000.

9750a4317d7539bb09f1604a731c05ae6bc06671.sourceText: 艾米（左三）领奖现场照片 艾米同学的作品描绘的是一位年轻的母亲即将踏上征程，与女儿紧紧相拥，依依难舍的离别场面。母亲脸上洋溢着幸福与眷念、自豪与无畏，展现出一个母亲对女儿的最朴实的母爱和对祖国和人民的热爱。她心中充满了自豪和对献出青春和生命的无畏，她将为美国的和平和自由而战！画面的背景是一批年轻的战士，背负沉重的武器，穿梭在战火弥漫、 烈焰翻腾的硝烟中，无所畏惧，奔赴前线。。。美国 的国鹰扇动着它那矫健有力的翅膀，仿佛在为英雄们助威呐喊。高高飘扬的国旗，展示出一个伟大民族的正义、 勇猛、强大与坚韧不拔。
9750a4317d7539bb09f1604a731c05ae6bc06671.translatedText: Photos of Amy (third from left) receiving the award. Amy’s work depicts a young mother who is about to embark on a journey, hugging her daughter tightly and reluctant to leave. The mother's face is filled with happiness, nostalgia, pride and fearlessness, showing a mother's most simple maternal love for her daughter and her love for the motherland and people. Her heart is filled with pride and the fearlessness to sacrifice her youth and life to fight for peace and freedom in the United States! The background of the picture is a group of young soldiers, carrying heavy weapons on their backs, shuttled through the flames of war and smoke, rushing to the front line fearlessly. . . The American national eagle flaps its strong and powerful wings, as if cheering for the heroes. The national flag flying high demonstrates the justice, bravery, strength and perseverance of a great nation.

d6d73a4a626cd8fa80bbdfd4046c922a58744b12.sourceText: 艾米这幅艺术创作是采用水彩色完成的，极具穿透力和浓郁色彩，让人们仿佛置身于血雨腥的战场上。以母亲和战士为主线和题材，将英雄们的生离死别，英勇无畏的情感紧紧地融汇在画面中，而母亲与女儿紧密相拥所表达出的那种亲情和爱，更是震撼和感动着每位观赏者。 颁奖会上， 许多军人和他们的家属纷纷向艾米同学表达了自己对这张画喜爱和深受的感动。 并请求合影留念。
d6d73a4a626cd8fa80bbdfd4046c922a58744b12.translatedText: Amy's artistic creation is done in watercolor, which is very penetrating and rich in color, making people feel like they are on a bloody battlefield. Taking mothers and warriors as the main thread and subject matter, the heroes' life and death, heroic and fearless emotions are tightly integrated into the picture, and the affection and love expressed by the mother and daughter's close embrace shock and move every viewer. At the award ceremony, many soldiers and their family members expressed their love for this painting and how deeply moved they were to Amy. And asked to take a group photo.

aa50f6225197a46320bd7afe2c5b4572b41d11dd.sourceText: 本次大赛亚省仅有三名学生获奖，其余二位分别夺得第二和第三名。多年来利用业余时间跟随林峰画家学习绘画的艾米同学，特别喜好中国的水墨画和西洋的水彩画， 并多次在各项绘画比赛中夺得佳绩。
aa50f6225197a46320bd7afe2c5b4572b41d11dd.translatedText: Only three students from Asia Province won the prize in this competition, and the remaining two won the second and third place respectively. Amy, who has been studying painting with painter Lin Feng in her spare time for many years, is particularly fond of Chinese ink painting and Western watercolor painting, and has won good results in various painting competitions many times.

3d65643ff50f65d188f7adeb1b6da864c07939d3.sourceText: 假日寄信包裹 损坏有何保障？
3d65643ff50f65d188f7adeb1b6da864c07939d3.translatedText: What protection is there for damage to packages sent during the holidays?

fba8c96cd058dda848a5c459b13134e93a2b3d5a.sourceText: 假日寄信包裹 损坏有何保障？ 现正值冬季圣诞节日期间，意味著邮递业将会十分繁忙。 今年，UPS预计…
fba8c96cd058dda848a5c459b13134e93a2b3d5a.translatedText: What is the guarantee for damage to packages sent during holidays? It's the winter and Christmas holidays, which means the postal industry will be very busy. This year, UPS expects...

fe9448c3810efe49d39c7cb61b82259fbd70e496.sourceText: 现正值冬季圣诞节日期间，意味著邮递业将会十分繁忙。
fe9448c3810efe49d39c7cb61b82259fbd70e496.translatedText: It is the winter Christmas holiday period, which means the postal industry will be very busy.

74f55ae0543a4f39e20eac788c3009f409426b41.sourceText: 今年，UPS预计将会运送5.27亿个包裹，只是在感恩节和圣诞节之间，击败去年创纪录的4.8亿个包裹。
74f55ae0543a4f39e20eac788c3009f409426b41.translatedText: This year, UPS expects to ship 527 million packages, just between Thanksgiving and Christmas, beating last year's record 480 million packages.

00cf3fc73d9c3f53878ce47dec9c5df8ea039e5e.sourceText: 在同一时间内，联邦快递预计运送超过2.8亿个包裹，美国邮政局估计将处理超过170亿张节日贺卡，信件和包裹。
00cf3fc73d9c3f53878ce47dec9c5df8ea039e5e.translatedText: During the same time frame, FedEx is expected to ship more than 280 million packages, and the U.S. Postal Service estimates it will handle more than 17 billion holiday cards, letters and packages.

f9f0413a751668b11dd56036adb50aff78c7b6cf.sourceText: 在线营销总监埃里克纳什(Eric Nash)说：”这三个运送经营商是非常可靠的。”
f9f0413a751668b11dd56036adb50aff78c7b6cf.translatedText: Eric Nash, director of online marketing, said: "These three shipping operators are very reliable."

f1f48216a8f2507815f8e18d1ff1b482b27f9024.sourceText: 但是，三大运营商也承认，有些时候，事情也会出错。 有些人考虑是否为寄送的包裹购买保险，邮寄保险服务 副总裁阿里尔(Ariel Shmorak)说：”这取决于包裹的价值，以及托运人的风险承受能力。”
f1f48216a8f2507815f8e18d1ff1b482b27f9024.translatedText: However, the three major operators also admit that sometimes, things can go wrong. Some people consider whether to purchase insurance for packages they send, said Ariel Shmorak, vice president of mailing insurance services: "It depends on the value of the package, and the risk tolerance of the shipper."

6bbdd034e0521158a259499c4cf4fa3163c599df.sourceText: 他指出，当涉及到电子产品和昂贵的项目，消费者应考虑保险的覆盖。
6bbdd034e0521158a259499c4cf4fa3163c599df.translatedText: He noted that when it comes to electronics and expensive items, consumers should consider insurance coverage.

5bd82b3ccef9ccac7059c3456198cf55690f971c.sourceText: 当购买邮寄运送的保险，应该知道以下5项事情。 （一）有些邮件包裹会自动覆盖
5bd82b3ccef9ccac7059c3456198cf55690f971c.translatedText: When purchasing mail shipping insurance, you should know the following 5 things. (1) Some mail packages are automatically covered

8c816648f49e3ec85df6bb3299b8c4826296010c.sourceText: 如果你的包裹价值100美元或更少，你可能已经被保险覆盖。
8c816648f49e3ec85df6bb3299b8c4826296010c.translatedText: If your package is worth $100 or less, you may already be covered by insurance.

d938529342704cba94110e341ed7179f3203347b.sourceText: 每个美国国内运送的UPS包裹，只要价值100美元或以下，若有遗失或损坏，可获得自动保险的覆盖。但是，邮政局的服务并不一样的，只提供特快专递100美元的自动覆盖。
d938529342704cba94110e341ed7179f3203347b.translatedText: Every UPS package shipped within the United States, as long as the value is US$100 or less, will be covered by automatic insurance if it is lost or damaged. However, the Postal Service's service is different and only provides automatic coverage of $100 for express mail.

22f65fa679f7de35435f4697cb613f2d0a2c89f0.sourceText: 三大运营商均提供申报价值的覆盖范围，而不是保险。
22f65fa679f7de35435f4697cb613f2d0a2c89f0.translatedText: All three major carriers offer coverage for a declared value rather than insurance.

81140f9d99088589a56ea5bbbb0fa2d2695ddca1.sourceText: 这代表如果邮包价值超过100美元，必须写下包裹的价值。如果不这样做的话，运营商的最大赔偿责任是100美元，即使包裹价值1,000美元。
81140f9d99088589a56ea5bbbb0fa2d2695ddca1.translatedText: This means that if the value of the package exceeds 100 US dollars, the value of the package must be written down. If this is not done, the carrier's maximum liability is $100, even if the package is worth $1,000.

a1fb05a853129eb866d0b4c1b62a022569662a4b.sourceText: 如果需要额外的保障，必须要支付更多的保险费用。 （二）邮寄运送保险的注意事项
a1fb05a853129eb866d0b4c1b62a022569662a4b.translatedText: If you need additional protection, you must pay more insurance fees. (2) Notes on shipping insurance

c1ee715e6e2c3c3c260472c7dfafac2952defbee.sourceText: 务必要仔细阅读所有的条款，然后才运送包裹。阿里尔说：”消费者需要确保什么是不覆盖的。”
c1ee715e6e2c3c3c260472c7dfafac2952defbee.translatedText: > Be sure to read all the terms carefully before shipping the package. "Consumers need to make sure what's not covered," Ariel said.

b6420363a3e68a5ffe513ab57bc0f8e30efe9856.sourceText: 例如，UPS并不覆盖硬币，现金或宝石，只是仅举几例。联邦快递和美国邮政总局也有类似的情况。
b6420363a3e68a5ffe513ab57bc0f8e30efe9856.translatedText: For example, UPS doesn't cover coins, cash or gemstones, just to name a few. FedEx and the U.S. Postal Service are in a similar situation.

4fcfb53d7abcda6bba9b1021a0d5de5cf809c438.sourceText: 此外，运营商也不覆盖某些地方，如果是国际邮件，应该找出那些地点不覆盖。
4fcfb53d7abcda6bba9b1021a0d5de5cf809c438.translatedText: In addition, the operator does not cover certain places. If it is an international mail, you should find out which places are not covered.

ba1010c74737b226c26ce4d252ceba350c798305.sourceText: 此外，有一些项目也被限制于特定的申报价值。例如，联邦快递限制艺术品，等离子电视和古董的申报价值超过1,000美元。
ba1010c74737b226c26ce4d252ceba350c798305.translatedText: In addition, some projects are also limited to specific declared values. For example, FedEx limits the declared value of art, plasma televisions and antiques to more than $1,000.

ac82bdd5e3e4e6ddba9d9d7cbd0361a20932b689.sourceText: 再者，包装的要求也是严格的，运营商不会覆盖包装不妥当的邮件。阿里尔说：”不要随便把花瓶，放入塑料袋，然后运送包裹。” （三）提出索赔要求
ac82bdd5e3e4e6ddba9d9d7cbd0361a20932b689.translatedText: Furthermore, the packaging requirements are also strict, and the carrier will not cover improperly packaged mail. Ariel said: "Don't just put the vase into a plastic bag and then ship the package." (3) File a claim

fa75879cad4a80a335fc023bc49ea4519c1cc1ab.sourceText: 如果包裹被损坏，丢失或是被盗，必须要填写赔偿的文件。
fa75879cad4a80a335fc023bc49ea4519c1cc1ab.translatedText: If the package is damaged, lost or stolen, you must fill out a compensation document.

073efaa667a074a27c33445f1c2e1e835fbc8653.sourceText: 阿里尔说：”各大运营商不会承认错误，自行寄出支票，因此，必须要自行寄出要求赔偿的资料。”
073efaa667a074a27c33445f1c2e1e835fbc8653.translatedText: Ariel said: "The major operators will not admit their mistakes and send checks by themselves. Therefore, they must send the information requesting compensation by themselves."

bc17d89df34f89d555db69447fceddf018a44439.sourceText: 而且，必须要尽快申报，三大运营商均有不同的截止申请期。美国邮政总局推荐申报的邮寄日期，限于6个月之内。
bc17d89df34f89d555db69447fceddf018a44439.translatedText: Moreover, the application must be made as soon as possible. The three major operators have different application deadlines. The U.S. Postal Service recommends that the filing date be within 6 months.

9132bf4b5eb87450268d8ebf8bdd2de1a423e49a.sourceText: 联邦快递要求提交的索赔，若有损坏，购买邮运服务60天之内，若没有收到包裹，可于9个月之内，申请索赔。
9132bf4b5eb87450268d8ebf8bdd2de1a423e49a.translatedText: > FedEx requires a claim to be submitted. If there is damage, you can apply for a claim within 60 days of purchasing the postal service. If you do not receive the package, you can apply for a claim within 9 months.

463d21c71f27195d3dea0f983897a79d838cba37.sourceText: 确保持有任何索赔的文件，阿里尔说：”要告诉他们，邮寄运送的内容，证明有关的价值。”
463d21c71f27195d3dea0f983897a79d838cba37.translatedText: Make sure you have documentation for any claim, Ariel said: "Tell them what is being mailed and prove the value."

0b505b42e26439ea860416cd9fdbed1c1bdc5da0.sourceText: 施特罗尔补充说：”一般来说，为每一个邮寄的项目，拍下照片，这也是明智的做法。”
0b505b42e26439ea860416cd9fdbed1c1bdc5da0.translatedText: Stroll added: "Generally speaking, it is also wise to take photos of every item that is mailed."

378f3895c56b51f831bec36d1fde0c76363975ec.sourceText: 某些情况下，需要维修估计的费用。
378f3895c56b51f831bec36d1fde0c76363975ec.translatedText: In some cases, an estimated cost of repairs is required.

3ed20d83ff9d7d1c996b874f988fb9d4d41dd7e2.sourceText: 如果损坏的物件可以修复的话，承运人将不给支付该项目的全部金额，例如，如果在运输过程中，一台电脑的视频卡坏了，承运人可能会赔偿部份的现金，不会支付整个电脑。 （五）等待时间
3ed20d83ff9d7d1c996b874f988fb9d4d41dd7e2.translatedText: If the damaged item can be repaired, the carrier will not pay the full amount of the item. For example, if a computer's video card breaks during transportation, the carrier may compensate part of the cash but not the entire computer. (5) Waiting time

7ef79e02e82fd90071677fcb004e96bc73cfaad5.sourceText: 整个过程可能需要一段时间。阿里尔说：”有一些运营商比其他慢了一点，尤其是大型公司，例如，联邦快递（FedEx），UPS和邮政总局。”
7ef79e02e82fd90071677fcb004e96bc73cfaad5.translatedText: The whole process may take some time. Ariel said: "There are some operators that are a little slower than others, especially large companies, such as FedEx, UPS and the Postal Service."

66af727cb7b5bf9d92150fafbdcbd748c04d03dd.sourceText: 例如，UPS要求7至10个工作日，查看被报失踪的包裹，如果UPS无法找到包裹，将致函予申报者，再填写资料要求赔偿。
66af727cb7b5bf9d92150fafbdcbd748c04d03dd.translatedText: For example, UPS requires 7 to 10 working days to check for a package that has been reported missing. If UPS cannot find the package, it will send a letter to the declarer and fill in the information to request compensation.

3c1f961557758862cd79b40c103f784134ff91fe.sourceText: 但是，一旦收到文件，处理的过程比较快，大多数情况下，3至5天内解决。
3c1f961557758862cd79b40c103f784134ff91fe.translatedText: However, once the file is received, the processing process is relatively fast, and in most cases, it is resolved within 3 to 5 days.

b6fc80f181417a44d2b970446cb17f27d4f1ae58.sourceText: 联邦快递指出，大多数情况下都要5到7天来处理，美国邮政局需要更长的时间，大概是30日内支付赔偿。
b6fc80f181417a44d2b970446cb17f27d4f1ae58.translatedText: FedEx pointed out that in most cases it takes 5 to 7 days to process, and the US Postal Service takes longer, probably within 30 days to pay compensation.

2c090234330b445491ed476274242281e9e59e73.sourceText: 吳英蕃先生訪問華人耆英會 （耆英會報導） 九月二十二日中午，陽光明媚，年屆九十七歲的華人耆英會永遠名譽顧問吳英蕃先生高興地來到了華人耆英會，這是他長期支持和關心的地方。二十多年來，他給了耆英會大量的幫助，他是耆英會會所擴建的主要贊助人之一；他關心老年人的身體健康，捐款購買健身設施，建立了吳英蕃健康鍛練室；耆英會會議室有一套漂亮的會議圓桌和書櫃，也是他贊助的；他還把家裡保存的一些名人字畫，送給耆英會拍賣。他每年定期捐助耆英會三千元，作為老人們的活動經費，今年，他上半年捐贈了三千元，最近又第二次慷慨捐贈耆英會七千元。對吳老先生的善舉，耆英會的會員們由衷的感謝。今天，當吳英蕃先生來到耆英會的時候，大家站起來熱烈歡迎,並報以熱烈鼓掌。大家興致勃勃地圍在吳老先生周圍，和他一起照相留念，並祝老人家身心愉快，健康長壽。吳老先生也高興地和大家交談，參觀了耆英會的各項活動地點，並希望耆英會辦得越來越好。 会员们和吴老合影 参观健康锻炼室
2c090234330b445491ed476274242281e9e59e73.translatedText: Mr. Wu Yingfan visited the Chinese Senior Citizens Association (Reported by the Senior Citizens Association) At noon on September 22, the sun was shining brightly. Mr. Wu Yingfan, the 97-year-old permanent honorary advisor of the Chinese Senior Citizens Association, happily came to the Chinese Senior Citizens Association, a place he has long supported and cared about. For more than 20 years, he has given a lot of help to the Senior Citizens Association, and he is one of the main sponsors of the expansion of the Senior Citizens Association; he cares about the health of the elderly, donated money to purchase fitness facilities, and established the Wu Yingfan Health Training Room; the Senior Citizens Association conference room has a beautiful round conference table and bookcase, which he also sponsored; he also gave some famous calligraphy and paintings saved at home to the Senior Citizens Association for auction. He regularly donates 3,000 yuan to the Senior Citizens Association every year to fund activities for the elderly. This year, he donated 3,000 yuan in the first half of the year, and recently made a generous donation of 7,000 yuan to the Senior Citizens Association for the second time. The members of the Senior Citizens Association expressed their sincere gratitude to Mr. Wu for his kind deeds. Today, when Mr. Wu Yingfan came to the Senior Citizens Association, everyone stood up to warmly welcome him and applauded warmly. Everyone enthusiastically gathered around Mr. Wu, took photos with him, and wished the old man happiness, health and longevity. Mr. Wu was also happy to chat with everyone, visited various activity locations of the Senior Citizens Association, and hoped that the Senior Citizens Association would get better and better. Members took photos with Mr. Wu and visited the health exercise room

505c7b3bc0da1b357aa3151429f0adb07f417661.sourceText: 中国好声音秒杀央视秋晚 网友感叹“好凄凉”
505c7b3bc0da1b357aa3151429f0adb07f417661.translatedText: The Voice of China beats the CCTV Autumn Gala in seconds and netizens lamented that it was “so desolate”

16c85fd853dbd1f375997328153232d15fa21f7b.sourceText: 中国好声音秒杀央视秋晚 网友感叹“好凄凉” 有了”中国好声音”决赛直播，你还会看央…
16c85fd853dbd1f375997328153232d15fa21f7b.translatedText: The Voice of China beat the CCTV Autumn Gala in seconds and netizens lamented that it is “so desolate” With the live broadcast of the finals of "The Voice of China", you will also watch CCTV...

04f6c440500a7b231bdb375d9faf05ce852fbc7c.sourceText: 其实昨晚的央视”秋晚”也是明星云集，其不仅有宋祖英、毛阿敏、谭晶、杨洪基等老将，也有蔡依林、萧敬腾、张信哲、张韶涵等人气偶像，甚至还有泰国人气偶像马里奥和pchy撑场。但是，”中国好声音”显然赢在了关注度。
04f6c440500a7b231bdb375d9faf05ce852fbc7c.translatedText: In fact, last night's CCTV "Autumn Gala" was also star-studded, not only veterans such as Song Zuying, Mao Amin, Tan Jing, Yang Hongji, but also popular idols such as Jolin Tsai, Jam Hsiao, Zhang Xinzhe, Angela Chang, and even popular Thai idols Mario and pchy. However, "The Voice of China" has clearly won attention.

9b99731438bf90398784c8f40967d31c7752e266.sourceText: 记者在微博、论坛看到，大多数网友都在关注”中国好声音”，包括许多名人和明星，而央视”秋晚”显然被遗忘了，连蔡依林的粉丝都是在”中国好声音”的广告间隙瞄两眼，只等偶像的部分。不少网友在微博直呼”央视好凄凉”，好事者更表示希望第二天能看到”央视秋晚和中国好声音各自的收视率”。有网友开玩笑称，”中国好声音昨天把金鸡百花电影节闭幕式搅和了！今天又把央视中秋晚会搅和了！”而著名导演李少红更一针见血，”今晚央视歇了，其他卫视都歇了。”（记者张聪）
9b99731438bf90398784c8f40967d31c7752e266.translatedText: The reporter saw on Weibo and forums that most netizens are paying attention to "The Voice of China", including many celebrities and stars, while CCTV's "Autumn Gala" has obviously been forgotten. Even Jolin Tsai's fans glanced at the "Voice of China" advertisements, only waiting for the idol part. Many netizens called out on Weibo that "CCTV is so miserable", and the good guys even expressed their hope to see "the respective ratings of CCTV Autumn Gala and The Voice of China" the next day. Some netizens joked, "The Voice of China disrupted the closing ceremony of the Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival yesterday! Today, it disrupted the CCTV Mid-Autumn Festival Gala!" And the famous director Li Shaohong hit the nail on the head, "CCTV is closed tonight, and all other satellite TVs are closed." (Reporter Zhang Cong)

dcb0f487bed902e132abbafcc3e0ffa331d0a5fd.sourceText: 张肇鸿先生对“侨社人物邓朝泽”一文的补充及更正
dcb0f487bed902e132abbafcc3e0ffa331d0a5fd.translatedText: Mr. Zhang Zhaohong’s supplements and corrections to the article “Deng Chaoze, a figure in overseas Chinese communities”

34157464aac4319e53a0132ba23687e30742e870.sourceText: 张肇鸿先生对“侨社人物邓朝泽”一文的补充及更正 張肇鴻 能把過去僑社的先進人物的事跡重新介紹給大家，是件好…
34157464aac4319e53a0132ba23687e30742e870.translatedText: Mr. Zhang Zhaohong’s supplements and corrections to the article “Deng Chaoze, a figure in overseas Chinese communities” Zhang Zhaohong It is a good thing to be able to re-introduce to everyone the deeds of the advanced figures in the overseas Chinese community in the past...

d96ae3241a8c10e30fe263adb70bc2161ea951a0.sourceText: 能把過去僑社的先進人物的事跡重新介紹給大家，是件好事，應該鼓勵。但文中有處出錯，須更正: 〝一九八六年，华人邓伟利竞选美莎市参议员。他(指邓朝泽)即以侨团联合总会主席身份发动当地侨胞给予支持，很快筹得一笔竞选经费。〞 查得鄧朝澤 (Robert Tom)先生做過一任的鳳凰城僑聯總會主席，年份是一九八零年至一九八一年，而一九八六年的鳳凰城僑聯總會主席并不是鄧朝澤，而應該是余文裕(Willie Yee)先生。 鄧朝澤先生對華人僑社貢獻良多，下面是他在上世紀七十年代寫過的文章中其中的一篇手稿，還有兩幅肖像，(彩色照片已放上近作《沙漠明珠》一書之中)。 他的文章讓我們知道僑聯早期活動更多的資訊。
d96ae3241a8c10e30fe263adb70bc2161ea951a0.translatedText: It is a good thing to be able to re-introduce the deeds of the advanced figures in the overseas Chinese community to everyone and should be encouraged. However, there are errors in the article and need to be corrected: "In 1986, Chinese Deng Weili ran for the Senate in Mesa City. As chairman of the Federation of Overseas Chinese Associations, he (referring to Deng Chaoze) mobilized local overseas Chinese to provide support and quickly raised a campaign fund." After checking Deng Chaoze (Robert Mr. Tom served as the chairman of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation from 1980 to 1981. The chairman of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation in 1986 was not Deng Chaoze, but Mr. Willie Yee. Mr. Deng Chaoze has made great contributions to the Chinese overseas community. Below is a manuscript of one of the articles he wrote in the 1970s, as well as two portraits (the color photos have been included in his recent book "Pearl of the Desert"). His article lets us know more about the early activities of the Overseas Chinese Federation.

a12f754abf00e1dc2444f47159f47b600dbc7fbb.sourceText: 中国无技术劳工排期 终于起步 四月移民截期，亲属移民类第三、四优先进展缓慢。中国出生的职业移民第三优先其他类，终于开始往前移动。 亲属移民类：第一优先(公民的成年未婚子女)：移前三周。 第二优先：2朅类(永久居民的配偶及未成年子女)：移进三周。 2朆类(永久居民的成年未婚子女)：移前五周。 第三优先(公民已婚子女)：移进一周。 第四优先(成年公民的兄弟姐妹)：移进一周。 职业移民类：中国出生的第二优先(具高等学位或特殊能力者）：移进六周。 世界第三优先一般类(技术劳工、专业人员)：移前八周。中国出生的第三优先一般类：移前三月。 世界第三优先其他类(无技术劳工如保母、管家)：移进八周。中国出生的第三优先其他类：移进七周。
a12f754abf00e1dc2444f47159f47b600dbc7fbb.translatedText: China's unskilled labor queue has finally started. With the April immigration deadline, the third and fourth priority family immigration categories are progressing slowly. The third preference category for Chinese-born professional immigrants, other categories, has finally begun to move forward. Relative-based immigration category: First priority (unmarried adult children of citizens): three weeks before immigration. Second priority: Category 2 (spouse and minor children of permanent residents): three weeks of immigration. Category 2 (unmarried adult children of permanent residents): five weeks before transfer. Third priority (married children of citizens): Move forward one week. Fourth priority (siblings of adult citizens): Move forward one week. Occupational immigration category: Second priority for those born in China (those with advanced degrees or special abilities): six weeks for immigration. The world's third priority general category (skilled workers, professionals): moved forward eight weeks. Third priority general category for those born in China: three months before transfer. The third priority category in the world (other categories (unskilled workers such as nannies and housekeepers)): move in for eight weeks. Third preference for other categories born in China: move in seven weeks.

53e1128200fc05c4aa324c41bf258949f0d0d6b3.sourceText: 答：你若持B1/B2观光签证入境打算停留在美国发展，应向移民局申请转换签证，否则逾期居留六个月后，一旦出境，就三年不得再入境美国。 一般而言，即使你没有合法身分，你还是可以买房子及商业买卖。 唯你若要申请贷款，可能会遭遇一些困难。 你在可以筹组公司营业，不过，除了也须申请社安报税号码外，你也需要申请转换成其他合法工作的签证，才能在自己的公司工作。 因为B1/B2签证不能有工作的权利。 一般筹组公司从事商业活动，可达到节税及避免个人责任的目的。 唯须注意公司须依法营运，资金齐全完整，及独立于个人的经营作业。 若个人股东与公司营运操作无法分辨，利益输送，而且法律上有不公平及欺诈行为，个人股东也可列为诉讼官司的对象，上述情形可能都牵涉到各种不同的联邦及州法的问题。 除咨询会计师外，也请洽询你的律师。
53e1128200fc05c4aa324c41bf258949f0d0d6b3.translatedText: Answer: If you enter the United States with a B1/B2 tourist visa and plan to stay in the United States for development, you should apply to the Immigration Bureau for a visa conversion. Otherwise, after overstaying for six months, once you leave the country, you will not be allowed to re-enter the United States for three years. Generally speaking, you can still buy a house and buy a business even if you have no legal status. But if you want to apply for a loan, you may encounter some difficulties. You can set up a company to start a business, but in addition to applying for a Social Security tax filing number, you also need to apply for a visa to convert to other legal jobs before you can work in your own company. Because B1/B2 visa does not have the right to work. Generally, setting up a company to engage in commercial activities can achieve tax savings and avoid personal liability. However, it must be noted that the company must operate in accordance with the law, have complete and complete funds, and be independent of individual business operations. If individual shareholders cannot be distinguished from the company's operations, there is a transfer of interests, and there is unfair or fraudulent behavior in the law, individual shareholders may also be the subject of lawsuits. The above situations may involve various issues under federal and state laws. In addition to consulting your accountant, please also consult your attorney.

b0cf78ad6a6c6b4cb0d8cbac37665e43ed94941a.sourceText: 向往南邦 气如虹 「来越南，就要搵食，就要去玩！」常听到许多亲朋同样说出这些话，证明越南是个值得吃喝玩乐的地方，怪不得西贡范伍老街头经常熙熙攘攘，充斥着西方背包游客，他们不少来自欧洲各国的平民阶级，只有几天假期也飞来胡志明市逛逛，以一欧元兑换接近三万越币使用，总是感到便宜，尽情享受，痛快开支，直到荷包清光，带着满足的心情返回自己的国家，继续为生活奋斗，筹备下次的旅费。 越南在东南亚的地理位置很有利，海岸线漫长，如果当年不是战乱，和平后不错误采用包给制度，早已成为亚洲经济强盛的小龙国家。试回顾一下，即使在越战期间，也建设了规模完善的越南纺织厂，属于非常先进的工业，扬名海外；就连堤岸广肇医院所建设的殡仪馆，为死亡服务，当时也是地区内最辉煌宏伟的场所。只可惜在一九七五至一九八五的十年间，总总人为措施，让国家陷入「不进则退」的公式，落后于他国。幸好及时醒觉，自我检讨，革新思维，才扭转颓势，形成今日的进展局面，逐渐吸引众多游客。 最值得一提的，是当年不顾一切大逃亡的侨胞，如今都以体谅的心态回归故里，甚至投资建设家园；所以，现在回来的不完全是旅行者，其中不少是有任务在身，或探亲访友，或寻找伴侣，或设厂投资，或探索商情，或经营贸易。 我夫妇这次回来越南，并不是一般朋友们所想象那样子回来游玩的，主要是视察自己的楼宇，查核租房业务以及经营杂货店的情况，有些兴革事项须要亲自策划，不能完全假手属下处理。另外要办理的是协助儿子选购婚礼必需品，太座以其丰富经验提供宝贵意见，容易达成任务。还有最重要的一环，是远在澳洲的姻亲表弟妹，有的当年在越分别，相隔卅多年至今还没有会晤过，这次预约而来聚合，若不及时把握机会，「苏州过后」，再度难逢。同住于凤凰城的老襟楚荣夫妇与其妹秀卿，也排除阻碍特地请假到来相聚，亲戚如此，我们在堤岸有屋有舍，条件都顺利，当然也要到来！ 我决定提早五月飞来胡志明市时，可没有料到能遇到这么多亲友，除了儿子的一对是事先安排的，澳洲十一人与老襟三人是早已预约的，其他是不约而来，有的是无意碰上，有的是凑巧相遇厖因此聚会堤城的亲友破了纪录，我进出新山一国际机场的次数，也是历年来最多的一次。 总的来说，前前后后接触到回越的亲友，以旅游观光占多数，其他个别不同任务较少。然而，无论是谁，无论干什么，无论来自何方，美国也好，澳洲也好，台湾也好，人人都把握机会旅行游览，即使逗留日期有限，也在附近的景点观光一下，尽情游乐；其中最注重是饮食方面，品尝越南美食，吃顿地道菜肴，以及特产水果。 「千山万水飞来越南，不趁机会好好玩个痛快，吃个痛快，回来干吗？」 亲友们总是振振有词，以一千零一个理由说明这最佳主意。越南地道餐饮美食，别具一格，有其吸引之处；各种亚热带特式水果，色泽亮丽，新鲜可口，价钱便宜，引人垂涎；还有各类海产，鱼虾螃蟹，蚬蚌螺蚶，烹煮煎烤，悉随尊便，任君选择。越南美食可口，海岸风光优美，游览观光有趣，加上越南美女温柔体态，婀娜多姿，都是游客喜好来越吃喝玩乐的理由。 虽然，这两年越南廉价时代已过去,，物价开始高涨，日常生活指数攀升，受薪阶级叫苦连天，尤其高档消费价格贵得可怕，令人咋舌。但一般中下等级的价码与外国相比，还算低廉，而且这里的茶楼酒馆，服务行业，大都招呼周到，殷勤待客，让人乐意光临，付账之余，不吝赏金。难怪不少民众埋怨和暗骂：「妈的！都是受越侨所累！我们明明喊贵，他们却说便宜；我们要减价，他们还要赏赐！气死人！物价显然是受他们影响而抬高的。」 论调听起来似乎不合理，细细思量确实有其因素所在。就以理发行业来说，过去都以服务民众出发点，男士理发习惯上全套是剪发兼剃面，价钱平民化，现在因应新形势，竟分开两部份价钱计算，合共至少也收四、五万越元，几乎花去普通劳工的一天工资，所以低收入者尽量节约，非到毛发刺耳地步不去修理。越侨感觉完全不同：「哗！不过两三美元，太便宜啦！」高兴地加赏小费，看在当地劳动者眼里，是不是气得「吹胡子瞪眼睛」呢！ 这样的情况很难解释，各人有不同的环境，各自不同的观感，生活问题就起着完全迥异的态度；越南近年也出现很多富商，其挥霍的豪爽就让我们这等越侨退避三舍。无论如何，对于旅游越南，目前仍然畅旺，全世界许多游客，还是向往南邦的！ 完稿于越南堤城二○一一年七月廿四日
b0cf78ad6a6c6b4cb0d8cbac37665e43ed94941a.translatedText: Yearning for Lampang, the energy is like a rainbow "When you come to Vietnam, you have to eat and play!" I often hear many relatives and friends say the same thing, which proves that Vietnam is a place worth eating, drinking and having fun. No wonder the old streets of Pham Ngu in Saigon are often bustling with Western backpackers, many of whom are civilians from European countries. Even though I only had a few days of vacation, I flew to Ho Chi Minh City to visit. I exchanged one euro for nearly 30,000 Vietnamese dollars. I always felt cheap. I enjoyed myself and spent happily until my wallet was empty. I returned to my country with a satisfied mood and continued to fight for life and prepare for the next trip. Vietnam's geographical location in Southeast Asia is very favorable, with a long coastline. If it were not for the war back then and if it had not mistakenly adopted the subsidy system after peace, it would have already become an economically powerful Xiaolong country in Asia. Let’s look back. Even during the Vietnam War, Vietnamese textile factories were built on a large scale, which was a very advanced industry and became famous overseas. Even the funeral parlor built by the Guangzhao Hospital in Ditan served the dead and was the most glorious and magnificent place in the region at that time. It is a pity that in the ten years from 1975 to 1985, all artificial measures were taken to make the country fall into the "advance or retreat" formula and lag behind other countries. Fortunately, we woke up in time, self-examined, and innovated our thinking, so we were able to reverse the decline and form today's development situation, gradually attracting many tourists. What is most worth mentioning is that the overseas Chinese who fled desperately back then are now returning to their hometowns with a considerate attitude, and even investing in building their homes. Therefore, not all those who have returned now are travelers. Many of them have missions, such as visiting relatives and friends, looking for partners, setting up factories to invest, exploring business opportunities, or running trades. This time my husband and I came back to Vietnam, not as many friends imagined. They mainly inspected their own buildings, checked the rental business and the running of grocery stores. Some reform matters need to be planned personally and cannot be handled completely by subordinates. Another thing to do was to assist his son in purchasing necessities for the wedding. Tai Zuo provided valuable advice with his rich experience, which made it easy to accomplish the task. And the most important part is the in-laws and cousins ​​who are far away in Australia. Some of them were separated in Vietnam and have not met each other for more than 30 years. We made an appointment to get together this time. If we don't seize the opportunity in time, "after Suzhou", we will never meet again. Chu Rong, his wife, and his younger sister Xiu Qing, who live together in Phoenix City, also took time off to come and get together despite the obstacles. Relatives like this, we have a house and a house on the embankment, and everything is going well, so of course we have to come! When I decided to fly to Ho Chi Minh City early in May, I didn't expect to meet so many relatives and friends. Except for my son's couple, who had been arranged in advance, and the eleven people from Australia and my wife, who had already made reservations, the others came unexpectedly, some by accident, and some by chance. So the number of relatives and friends gathered in Tuicheng broke the record. The number of times I entered and exited Tan Son Nhat International Airport was also the most in the past. Generally speaking, most of the visits to relatives and friends who have returned to Vietnam are for tourism, and there are fewer other individual tasks. However, no matter who you are, no matter what you do, no matter where you come from, whether it is the United States, Australia, or Taiwan, everyone takes the opportunity to travel. Even if your stay is limited, you can visit nearby attractions and have fun. The most important thing is food, taste Vietnamese food, eat authentic dishes, and special fruits. "After flying all the way to Vietnam, why not come back if you don't take the opportunity to have fun and eat to your heart's content?" Relatives and friends always give a thousand and one reasons to explain this is the best idea. Vietnamese authentic food and beverages are unique and attractive; a variety of subtropical special fruits are bright in color, fresh and delicious, cheap and mouth-watering; there are also various types of seafood, including fish, shrimps, crabs, clams, clams, snails, cooked, fried and grilled, you can choose whatever you like. Vietnamese food is delicious, the coast scenery is beautiful, sightseeing is interesting, and Vietnamese beauties are gentle and graceful. These are all reasons why tourists like to come to Vietnam to eat, drink and have fun. Although the cheap era in Vietnam has passed in the past two years, prices have begun to rise, daily life index has climbed, and the salaried class has been complaining, especially high-end consumer prices are horribly expensive and staggering. But in general, the prices of the middle and lower classes are relatively low compared with those in foreign countries. Moreover, most of the teahouses, pubs, and service industries here are considerate and hospitable to guests, making people happy to come and not shying away from the reward after paying the bill. No wonder many people complained and secretly cursed: "Damn! It's all because of the Vietnamese! We clearly call it expensive, but they say it's cheap; we want to reduce prices, but they still want rewards! It's so annoying! Prices are obviously driven up by their influence." The argument may sound unreasonable, but if you think about it carefully, there are indeed factors. As for the barbering industry, it used to be based on serving the public. Men's haircuts were customarily a complete set of haircuts and facial shaves, and the prices were affordable. Now, in response to the new situation, the prices are divided into two parts. The total charge is at least 40,000 to 50,000 VND, which almost costs an ordinary worker's day's wages. Therefore, low-income people try to save as much as possible and do not repair the hair until the hair is irritated. The Vietnamese feel completely different: "Wow! It's only two or three dollars, so cheap!" They are happy to tip more, but in the eyes of the local workers, they are so angry that they "blow their beards and stare"! It is difficult to explain this situation. Everyone has a different environment, different perceptions, and a completely different attitude towards life issues. In recent years, many wealthy businessmen have appeared in Vietnam, and their lavish spending has made overseas Vietnamese like us shy away. In any case, tourism in Vietnam is still booming, and many tourists from all over the world still yearn for Lampang! Completed on July 24, 2011 in Dicheng, Vietnam

5262ce4528a22fbf379122b4070ce80489f05122.sourceText: 图桑慧明：错了就是错了 人都喜欢争个面子，做个伪强人、伪富人或者伪善人。所以明明很潦倒了，却喜欢开着老爷车（老牌的古董车）到处招摇；明明在家里吃着泡面，却爱挎着名牌包满大街上显摆。可我却见过另一种场面。 两个人为着某一个问题，剑拔弩张地像西部牛仔那样，几乎要掏出枪来教训对方了。只见其中的一位很不给面子地再说了一句，对手竟然像被武林高手点中了命脉，即刻变脸，和颜悦色地道歉起来了，连刚挣来的面子也不要了。 我所在城市的医学院门前是个大型的环形车道，车道有两条环线：内线供暂停者上下病人方便，外线供正常行驶。那天内线停满了车，没了空位，想要继续停车的只能在外道一遍一遍地绕行，寻找机会插入内道泊车。 我前面的车主是位很强悍的女士，见前面车在外道停下了车，便按了喇叭。在美国车道行驶是不作兴按喇叭的，除非前面的车严重违反交通规则，后面的车想警告一下他。这次也是。我后面有急性子的也附和地按了喇叭。美国流行得理不让人，看来大家都对那个挡道的车不满。 但那个挡道的非但不让开，反而将两边的车门同时打开，驾驶者先下来，高大彪悍无比，气冲冲地走到后面，比喇叭更大声地吼叫：为什么按喇叭！？ 我想大概是我们旁观者该出手相助的时候了。 然而，从挡位的车门另一边先出来两根拐棍，然后一个女士撑着双拐走出来了。我前面很气愤很强悍的女人马上走出车门，向两位道歉，一脸真诚。 我也在车里摆着手，向发吼者表示歉意。我后面的那些美国哥儿们此刻也一致哑然无声。因为在美国尊重和礼让残疾人是起码的文明，刚才后面的人全错怪停车人了。 又一次我乘儿子的车去游泳池。儿子那时刚拿到驾照一星期，很想立马炫耀一下自以为是的驾车技巧，一进停车场便朝左手最近的停车位转车进去。但在副驾驶位的我却看到左前方一辆车正在等待这个车位。 原来人家为了礼貌等待我们进来再泊车，谁知儿子一个机灵先占了位置。我赶紧对儿子说，这样很过分，开车还要学会礼貌等等。那位等位的自然很不乐意，岂止是不乐意，简直成怒了，骂骂咧咧地找另外的位子了。 在更衣室里，那位人高马大的径直向我走来，那手几乎指到我的鼻子上，对我进行文明礼貌教育—他大概也知道中国”子不教，父之过”的古训。我本来是很想马上道歉的，但听到最后那句”我为中国人感到羞耻”感到很不爽，很窝火，怒气上来了。我们是错了，但你老白凭什么用种族来说事? 我穿着泳裤，赤裸着上身，在泳池边找到了那位，外表很冷静，但心里怒火在燃烧：先生，孩子刚拿到驾照，不知道停车规矩是我父亲的错，我向你道歉。但是，我不喜欢你那样说中国人。虽然那厮高我一头，但在泳池边上我不怵他，话不投机没关系，大不了咱们到水里演一回浪里白条玩李逵。 但假想剧情没有出现，倒是那位憋得朱红色的脸先舒展开来，主动伸出手来向我言和，我也很僵硬地伸出了手—-那劲本来是留着给那位池中灌水用的。 一场风波就这样云消雾散了。 都说在美国处理人际关系简单（当然指面对面的交际关系，公司学界勾心斗角不在此列），想想也是这个道理。因为大家底线都很清楚，在文明、规则和法律的基础上人人平等。人人可以很强势，得理不让人，但人人也应该很弱势，认理也让人。 很多时候，这个世界缺乏的就是后者，特别是财大气粗之后，靠着几艘航母和钞票，指那打那，张扬得很。那日本、德国和现在的美国都经历过这些，现在都变得有点低眉顺眼了，尽管还时不时地说一句，你们也有错，但毕竟在反省自己了。 反省自己是有前途的，而且要像上面的例子，立马改正，和谐就顿现了。如果死要面子呢，就会像地铁公交车里的口角那样，演化成揪发扯耳的战争，城市和国家形象都会丢了去。 所以，有时生活中错了就是错了，坦诚相待后反而会一片蓝天。
5262ce4528a22fbf379122b4070ce80489f05122.translatedText: Tusang Huiming: If you are wrong, you are wrong. People like to save face and be a fake strong person, a fake rich person or a hypocritical person. So even though he is very poor, he still likes to drive around in a classic car (an old antique car) and show off everywhere; even though he is eating instant noodles at home, he still likes to show off on the streets carrying brand-name bags. But I have seen another scene. The two people were at war with each other over a certain issue, like cowboys in the West, and almost took out their guns to teach each other a lesson. I saw one of them say something very shameless, and the opponent suddenly changed his face as if being touched by a martial arts master, and apologized cheerfully, not even giving up the face he had just earned. There is a large circular driveway in front of the medical school in my city. The driveway has two loops: the inner lane is for people who are suspended to get on and off patients, and the outer lane is for normal driving. The inner lane was full of cars that day, and there were no spaces left. Those who wanted to continue parking had to go around the outer lane over and over again, looking for opportunities to park in the inner lane. The car owner in front of me was a very tough lady. When she saw the car in front of me stopped in the outer lane, she honked the horn. It is forbidden to honk your horn when driving in American lanes, unless the car in front of you seriously violates traffic rules and the car behind you wants to warn you. This time too. The impatient guy behind me also honked his horn in agreement. It's so popular in the United States that everyone seems to be dissatisfied with the car blocking the road. But instead of getting out of the way, the man blocking the road opened the doors on both sides at the same time. The driver got out first, tall and tough, walked angrily to the back, and shouted louder than the horn: Why are you honking! ? I think it's time for us bystanders to help. However, two crutches came out from the other side of the gear door first, and then a woman walked out with crutches. The very angry and strong woman in front of me immediately walked out of the car door and apologized to both of them with a sincere look on her face. I also waved my hands in the car to apologize to the person who yelled. The American guys behind me were also silent at this moment. Because in the United States, respecting and being courteous to disabled people is the basic form of civilization. The people behind me just now wrongly blamed the parking person. Another time I took my son’s car to the swimming pool. My son had just gotten his driver's license for a week and wanted to show off his driving skills right away. As soon as he entered the parking lot, he turned towards the nearest parking space on the left and entered. But from the passenger seat, I saw a car on the left front waiting for this parking space. It turned out that they were waiting for us to come in and park the car out of politeness, but my son cleverly occupied the spot first. I quickly told my son that this was too much, and he should learn to be polite when driving. The person waiting for a seat was naturally very unhappy. Not only was he unhappy, he even got angry. He cursed and looked for another seat. In the locker room, the tall man walked straight towards me, his hand almost pointed to my nose, and educated me on civility and courtesy - he probably also knew the ancient Chinese saying that "if a son fails to teach, it is the father's fault." I originally wanted to apologize immediately, but when I heard the last sentence "I am ashamed of the Chinese", I felt very unhappy and angry. We were wrong, but why do you use race to talk about things? I was wearing swimming trunks and topless, and found the man by the pool. He looked calm on the outside, but the anger was burning in his heart: Sir, the child just got his driver's license and it was my father's fault that he didn't know the parking rules. I apologize to you. However, I don't like when you say that about Chinese people. Although that guy is a head taller than me, I am not afraid of him at the edge of the swimming pool. It doesn't matter if we don't talk to each other. The worst we can do is play Li Kui in the water. But the imaginary plot did not appear, but the person whose face was red from holding back relaxed, and took the initiative to reach out his hand to make peace with me. I also stretched out my hand stiffly - the energy was originally reserved for that person to fill the pool with water. The storm just disappeared. It is said that it is easy to deal with interpersonal relationships in the United States (of course, this refers to face-to-face communication, not the intrigues between companies and academia), and this is also true when you think about it. Because everyone’s bottom line is very clear, everyone is equal on the basis of civilization, rules and laws. Everyone can be very strong and be reasonable and not let others get away with it, but everyone should also be weak and be able to be reasonable and not let others get away with it. Many times, what this world lacks is the latter, especially when people with a lot of money can rely on a few aircraft carriers and banknotes to point their fingers at this and that, and they are very flamboyant. Japan, Germany, and now the United States have all experienced this, and now they have become a little bit submissive. Although they still say from time to time that you are also wrong, after all, you are reflecting on yourself. There is a future if you reflect on yourself, and if you correct it immediately like the above example, harmony will suddenly appear. If you insist on saving face, it will turn into a quarrel like a quarrel in a subway bus, and the image of the city and the country will be lost. Therefore, sometimes in life, a mistake is a mistake, but after being honest with each other, the sky will be clear.

5396139535a85f4541a0239ac39fa748129e08c4.translatedText: Arizona State University professor becomes new dean of University of Illinois at Chicago (Alberta Times) The University of Illinois at Chicago (UIC) has appointed a new dean of the School of Business Administration. The University of Illinois at Chicago announced Tuesday the hiring of Michael Hail, a professor in the College of Business and director of the School of Accountancy at Arizona State University. His appointment still requires approval by the University of Illinois Board of Trustees. Under his leadership, ASU's School of Accountancy added ethics, accountability and professional introduction to its required freshman courses. Retention rates for freshmen attending their first year are significantly higher than the school average. Prior to Arizona State University, he served as an assistant professor and associate professor at Duke University's Graduate School of Business. He was also the Theodore Miller Career Development Assistant Professor at the Massachusetts Technical School of Management.

baccc13de213f1fcc9d913e17ec14afa7f99a1f9.sourceText: 洛杉矶古冬：清酒也醉人 一如所料,清酒终于飘离日本海,流向世界各国。 抱鼓卧花、一滴入魂、寒中梅、天狗舞、醉仙、李白厖然后以鸿飞鸾舞的笔势,把这些立体的短句,生动的形容词,熟稔的名字,狂挥在一个个也 古也今、趣味盎然的瓶子上,就构成了日本清酒的无限魅力。 深受武士道文化困囿的日本酿酒技术,严谨而划一。 既不像中国的大麴、俄国的伏尔加那样具有爆发般的烈性,也不若法国的干邑、加州匿帕盆地的红酒一般芬芳馥郁,香气扑鼻,倒是有意无意之中,把日本人表面 规规矩矩、内心愤世嫉俗的双重性格,巧妙地给装进瓶子里,变成一个个小小的日本。 而这,对于一位不很懂得酒性,又不甚了解日本民情的陌生过客来说,倒如手上那本简明的旅游指南,不啻是个不错的媒介。 所谓清酒,其实就是米酒,不以葡萄为原料,而以米的精纯度来厘定酒的质量与等级。 如将米的表层杂质(米糠)研去40%的,精米比率即为60%。 四大名酿(吟酿、大吟酿、纯米酒、本酿造)八个品种之中的吟酿、纯米大吟酿、特别纯米酒、特别本酿造等,都是属于这个级数的清酒。 当然精米比率愈高(数字愈小)的,香味便愈浓,酒质也愈清。 如只有50%的大吟酿与纯米大吟酿,即被视为奢侈的日本酒;而高达70%(仅磨去30%)的纯米酒和本酿造,便相对的比较便宜了。 此外,由于酿造与储藏的方法有所不同,清酒又分普通酒、原酒、生酒、浊酒、生一本酒与古酒等多种。 不过原料还是米,衡量酒的品质,也依然以精米比率为依据。 每一瓶清酒,都有一个明晰的标签。 酒的浓淡度、酸度与甘辛度,均由1至6为数值,而酒精的含量,则多在15%至16%之间,即使未经稀释和过滤的原酒,也不超过20%。 因此一些饮惯烈酒的人,会觉得清酒淡而无味,有时就连日本人也难免有此错觉, 以致不觉间饮多了几杯, 弄得醉倒街头。 精米率较高,味道较香滑细致的吟酿与大吟酿,最好冷饮。 盛在半透明的玻璃 杯中,薄薄的浮着一层雾气,已有一份沁人的清凉,及至饮上一口,清香甘畅,就真个是爽神兼而醒胃了!相反,精米率较低,酒质较 扎实浓重的纯米酒与本酿造,就宜温饮。 摄氏60度左右的温度,最有利于酒香的散发。 特别是在冬天,把厚厚的陶制杯子捧在手中,缓缓地呷上两口,会如拙作「干杯」中说的,一股热流暖洋洋的流通全身,令人无比舒畅。 这就是清酒的魅力所在,也是一般葡萄酒所欠奉的东西。 那么,清酒有没有可以挑剔的地方呢?这回日本人倒是意外的老实,劈头那个「清」字,已经不打自招。 因为清了,就不免薄,不免寡,也就是前头所说的淡而无味。 你知道,由于饮惯了浓酒,我们常把酒叫作黄汤。 顾名思义,不论质还是量,汤都要比酒来得实在,来得丰厚。 日本人大概也意识到这一点,于是出了一种浊酒,即在酿制时刻意把米渣留下来,加以压榨,用我们的话来说,就是把酒变成白汤,这样饮用起来,就会有点质感, 而不再是清淡无物。 岂有此理的是,他们管这种酒叫李白浊酒,难道我们的大诗人会是如此之「浊」吗? 许多时候,人们都喜欢把酒和女人扯在一起。 说起来,清酒倒又真有几分似日 本的女子,不是一饮就醉,一触即热,而是娇柔婉约,情深款款,安于做一个平平淡淡的妻子,而不去做一名轰轰烈烈的情人。 然而不知何故,日本的男人宁可要一杯清清淡淡的酒,而不要一个柔柔绵绵的女人。 他们晚晚去买醉,完全置老婆于不顾,倘使清酒果能畅销世界各国的话,则天下的女人,惨哉!
baccc13de213f1fcc9d913e17ec14afa7f99a1f9.translatedText: Los Angeles Gudong: Sake is also intoxicating As expected, sake finally drifted away from the Sea of ​​Japan and flowed to countries around the world. The three-dimensional short sentences, vivid adjectives, and familiar names are splashed on bottles that are both ancient and modern, and full of interest, which constitute the infinite charm of Japanese sake. Japanese brewing technology, deeply constrained by Bushido culture, is rigorous and uniform. It is not as explosive and potent as Chinese koji or Russian Volga, nor is it as fragrant and fragrant as French Cognac or California's Nipa Basin red wine. Instead, intentionally or unintentionally, the Japanese's dual character of being well-behaved on the surface and cynical on the inside has been cleverly put into bottles, turning them into small Japans. And this, for a stranger who doesn't know much about the nature of alcohol and Japanese people's customs, is like the concise travel guide in his hand, which is a good medium. The so-called sake is actually rice wine. It does not use grapes as its raw material, but the quality and grade of the wine are determined by the purity of the rice. If 40% of the surface impurities (rice bran) of the rice are ground away, the rice polishing ratio is 60%. Among the eight varieties of the four major sake breweries (ginjo, daiginjo, junmai sake, and honshu), ginjo, junmai daiginjo, special junmai sake, and special honshu, etc., all belong to this level of sake. Of course, the higher the rice polishing ratio (the smaller the number), the stronger the aroma and the clearer the wine quality. For example, if there is only 50% Daiginjo and Junmai Daiginjo, it is considered a luxury Japanese sake; while as high as 70% (only 30% is removed), Junmai sake and Honjozo are relatively cheap. In addition, due to different brewing and storage methods, sake is divided into ordinary sake, original sake, raw sake, mud sake, raw sake, and ancient sake. However, the raw material is still rice, and the quality of wine is still based on the ratio of polished rice. Every bottle of sake has a clear label. The density, acidity and spiciness of wine are all measured from 1 to 6, while the alcohol content is mostly between 15% and 16%. Even if the original wine is not diluted and filtered, it does not exceed 20%. Therefore, some people who are used to drinking strong liquor may feel that sake is bland and tasteless. Sometimes even Japanese people may have this illusion and end up drinking a few too many glasses without realizing it and end up drunk on the streets. Ginjo and Daiginjo, which have a higher rice polishing rate and have a smoother and more delicate taste, are best served cold. When it is served in a translucent glass, there is a thin layer of mist floating on it, which already has a refreshing coolness. When you take a sip, the fragrance is sweet and refreshing, which really refreshes your mind and wakes up your stomach! On the contrary, junmai sake and honjozo, which have a lower rice polishing rate and a more solid and heavy alcohol quality, should be drunk warm. A temperature of about 60 degrees Celsius is most conducive to the dispersion of wine aroma. Especially in winter, if you hold a thick earthenware cup in your hands and take a few sips slowly, as mentioned in my book "Cheers", a warm current will flow through your whole body, making you extremely comfortable. This is the charm of sake, and it is also something that ordinary wine lacks. So, is there anything we can be picky about about sake? This time, the Japanese are surprisingly honest, and the word "clear" at the beginning is no longer self-defeating. Because if it is clear, it will inevitably be thin and sparse, which is what I mentioned above and will be bland and tasteless. You know, because we are used to drinking strong wine, we often call wine yellow soup. As the name suggests, soup is more substantial and rich than wine in terms of quality and quantity. The Japanese were probably aware of this, so they created a kind of turbid sake, which is to deliberately leave the rice residue during brewing and press it. In our words, it turns the wine into white soup. In this way, when you drink it, it will have a texture instead of being bland. What makes no sense is that they call this kind of wine Li Bai turbid wine. Could it be that our great poet is so "turbid"? Many times, people like to associate wine with women. Speaking of which, sake is indeed a bit like Japanese women. They don't get drunk as soon as they drink it, or become hot when they touch it. Instead, they are delicate, graceful, and affectionate. They are content to be an ordinary wife instead of a vigorous lover. However, for some reason, Japanese men would rather have a glass of light wine than a soft and soft woman. They go out to get drunk every night, completely ignoring their wives. If sake can be sold all over the world, women in the world will be miserable!
