6eae0ae571d96c7923a46fea3ec5a465fe7e9822.sourceText: 每年一度的亚省青少年鸭邮绘画大赛于昨天揭晓。来自亚省的亚裔青少年以精湛的画技囊括了总共87个奖项的绝大多数。其中有来自小苏画室（Xiao Su Studio）的共51位学生获奖，包括7名荣获各年龄组的第一名。这些学生都自幼酷爱绘画，目前每周利用课外时间在小苏画室学习绘画。由美国内政部举办的颁奖仪式将于四月四号上午11点在凤城的Nina Mason Pulliam Rio Salado Audubon Center举办，并且对公众开放。亚省所有获奖名单可参见： http://www.xiaosustudio.com/AZJDS15.html
6eae0ae571d96c7923a46fea3ec5a465fe7e9822.translatedText: The annual Alberta Youth Duck Post Painting Competition was announced yesterday. Asian teenagers from Alberta won the vast majority of a total of 87 awards for their superb painting skills. A total of 51 students from Xiao Su Studio won awards, including 7 who won first place in each age group. These students have been passionate about painting since childhood and currently use their extracurricular time to study painting in Xiao Su's studio every week. The awards ceremony hosted by the U.S. Department of the Interior will be held at 11 a.m. on April 4 at the Nina Mason Pulliam Rio Salado Audubon Center in Fengcheng and is open to the public. The list of all winners in Alberta can be found at: http://www.xiaosustudio.com/AZJDS15.html

e1591085a7020a275c9bcaf46b3e118355d2c081.sourceText: 有二十多年历史的每年一度的全国鸭邮绘画比赛是美国国会立法由内政部举办的绘画比赛，其宗旨主要是促进自然环境保护，及其教育等。每年三月份各州产生一名最佳绘画及环保讯息优胜者，进而进行全国范围的最终大赛。全国的最佳优胜者除了奖金外，其作品还将被印制成美国邮票流通发行。
e1591085a7020a275c9bcaf46b3e118355d2c081.translatedText: The annual National Duck Post Painting Competition with a history of more than 20 years is a painting competition organized by the Department of the Interior legislated by the U.S. Congress. Its purpose is mainly to promote the protection of the natural environment and education. Each state selects a winner for the best painting and environmental message in March each year, and then conducts the final nationwide competition. In addition to the prize money, the best national winner will also have their work printed on a U.S. stamp for circulation.

d64309936b38284db9e2a2712c0306c114594737.sourceText: 近日，据美国《侨报》报道，特朗普政府已经有了新计划，将废除H-1B签证持有者的配偶(H-4签证)在美国的工作许可。据华尔街日报报道，特朗普政府加强对H-1B工作签证申请人的审查。
d64309936b38284db9e2a2712c0306c114594737.translatedText: Recently, according to the US "Qiao Bao" report, the Trump administration has a new plan to abolish the work permit in the United States for the spouses of H-1B visa holders (H-4 visa). According to the Wall Street Journal, the Trump administration has stepped up scrutiny of H-1B work visa applicants.

10e1c9a2e21e6c71e3fbb8f77b471f9c0f799379.sourceText: 数据显示，从2015年10月到2016年9月，有41526名H-4签证持有者获得了工作许可。
10e1c9a2e21e6c71e3fbb8f77b471f9c0f799379.translatedText: Data show that from October 2015 to September 2016, 41,526 H-4 visa holders obtained work permits.

6304c27f599470141fdc78eb8f2bfaf550abe872.sourceText: 奥巴马政府曾于2015年提出，已经完成绿卡申请(I-140获批)，并处于等待期的H-1B签证持有者的配偶(H-4签证)，可以申请工作许可，获得社会安全号，并在美国合法工作。
6304c27f599470141fdc78eb8f2bfaf550abe872.translatedText: The Obama administration proposed in 2015 that spouses of H-1B visa holders (H-4 visa) who have completed their green card application (I-140 approved) and are in the waiting period can apply for a work permit, obtain a Social Security number, and work legally in the United States.

aa741debb39285af36ffbd60d3e803dfed3cbe74.sourceText: 美国总统特朗普上任后，通过一系列措施，不断收紧移民以及签证事项。从严格审核签证申请，到收紧H-1B签证计划，从宣布支持”改革美国移民制度强化就业”草案，到收紧合法移民数量。从扩大签证申请面谈范围到打击逾期滞留。他提倡”积极促进和使用美国制造商品，保证雇佣美国劳动力去工作”，力争实现美国优先的承诺。
aa741debb39285af36ffbd60d3e803dfed3cbe74.translatedText: After taking office, U.S. President Trump has adopted a series of measures to continuously tighten immigration and visa matters. From strictly reviewing visa applications, to tightening the H-1B visa program, from announcing support for the "Reforming the U.S. Immigration System to Strengthen Employment" draft, to tightening the number of legal immigrants. From expanding interviews for visa applications to cracking down on overstays. He advocates "actively promoting and using American-made goods and ensuring that American labor is employed to work" and strives to realize the commitment of America first.

e91593f80191b6b1b7de07bb976c7920f2313bb8.sourceText: ”我最近刚拿到美国杰出人才签证，开始以导演和电影剪辑师身份申请，但是因为签证成功率问题，我最后以电影剪辑师身份拿到了这个签证。”在美国洛杉矶从事电影相关工作的杨梦昉说，”准备签证过程也是一波三折，由于签证难度变大，需要不断地按要求递交材料。”
e91593f80191b6b1b7de07bb976c7920f2313bb8.translatedText: "I recently received the American Outstanding Talent Visa and started applying as a director and film editor. However, due to issues with the visa success rate, I finally got this visa as a film editor." Yang, who is engaged in film-related work in Los Angeles, USA Mengfang said, "The process of preparing for the visa is also full of twists and turns. As the difficulty of getting the visa becomes more difficult, we need to constantly submit materials as required."

360d4f0fe1f9bb925136ee542c1ff423cc199f52.sourceText: 除了杰出人才签证，特朗普政府目前还在严格审查高技能外籍劳工的H-1B工作签证。根据美国公民及移民服务局的调查数据显示，2017年1月至8月期间，每4件申请案超过一件被驳回，要求申请人”提供进一步证明”。
360d4f0fe1f9bb925136ee542c1ff423cc199f52.translatedText: In addition to the outstanding talent visa, the Trump administration is currently also strictly reviewing the H-1B work visa for high-skilled foreign workers. According to survey data from the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services, between January and August 2017, more than one out of every four applications was rejected, requiring applicants to "provide further evidence."

80f3a3a3f4dced78bb541afdd73ce45afd8809a0.sourceText: ”我认为持有H-1B签证的外籍工作者抢了我们的工作，如果他们配偶(H-4签证)也能工作的话，这对我们本地人找工作太不公平了。”在旧金山土生土长的美国人大卫林登说。
80f3a3a3f4dced78bb541afdd73ce45afd8809a0.translatedText: "I think foreign workers holding H-1B visas are taking our jobs. If their spouses (H-4 visas) can also work, this is too unfair for our locals to find jobs." David Linden, an American born and raised in San Francisco, said.

0f290a879e8d28f83dfbaaf538690036c41effdb.sourceText: 美国是一个典型的移民国家，为何频频调整移民以及签证政策，加大留美难度？
0f290a879e8d28f83dfbaaf538690036c41effdb.translatedText: The United States is a typical immigration country. Why does it frequently adjust immigration and visa policies to make it more difficult to stay in the United States?

4da2207b1c94ab9508989b38f39fdd4e4cc4cbaf.sourceText: ”特朗普政府主要是为了实现自己的竞选诺言，通过增加美国人就业率，让美国再次强大。从统计数字来看，美国人的就业机会增多了。在僧多粥少的状态下，牺牲的当然是外国劳工的利益。”在纽约工作的孙澜涛律师说，”此外，H-4签证持有者政治影响力较弱，国会中没有代言人，抗争力量非常薄弱，不容易形成气候。”
4da2207b1c94ab9508989b38f39fdd4e4cc4cbaf.translatedText: ” The Trump administration is mainly trying to fulfill its campaign promise to make the United States strong again by increasing the employment rate of Americans. From a statistical point of view, the number of job opportunities for Americans has increased. In a state of scarcity, the interests of foreign workers are of course sacrificed. "Lawyer Sun Lantao who works in New York said, "In addition, H-4 visa holders have weak political influence and have no spokesperson in Congress, so their resistance is very weak and it is not easy to form a climate. "

20528e770012df1c0f35ed5864f3486a1af0a74f.sourceText: 移民门槛不断提高，签证审核流程繁琐，难度加大。印证出”美国优先”的思想，体现出强烈的保护主义色彩。
20528e770012df1c0f35ed5864f3486a1af0a74f.translatedText: Immigration thresholds are constantly increasing, and the visa review process is cumbersome and more difficult. It confirms the idea of ​​"America First" and reflects a strong color of protectionism.

2d3301e09929f6889658be2a79197ac25450fb59.sourceText: ”如果H-4签证政策改变，会形成类似风向标的作用。这也反映出特朗普政府以及移民局的一种保护就业的倾向，未来一段时间，H-1B签证审查会更加严苛。工作场所的核查、税收证明、补充材料证明等。”在洛杉矶工作的华人律师张军说，”在移民局的审查过程中，会现场询问雇佣公司，在同等学历的条件下，为什么不尽最大努力，雇佣美国员工。”
2d3301e09929f6889658be2a79197ac25450fb59.translatedText: "If the H-4 visa policy changes, it will act like a weathervane. This also reflects the tendency of the Trump administration and the Immigration Service to protect employment. In the future, H-1B visa review will be more stringent. Workplace verification, tax certificates, supplementary material certificates, etc." Zhang Jun, a Chinese lawyer working in Los Angeles, said, "During the Immigration Bureau's review process, the hiring company will be asked on-site why it does not try its best to hire American employees under the same academic qualifications."

6e445ea06f0898f6b93975abff2cfa6041b7d1e7.sourceText: 据美国移民局发言人称，签证审查的缩紧是为了防止诈欺及签证滥用。美国移民局专注于谨慎和公平的裁决确保移民体系的完整性，同时保护美国工人的利益。
6e445ea06f0898f6b93975abff2cfa6041b7d1e7.translatedText: According to a spokesperson for the U.S. Immigration Service, the tightening of visa review is to prevent fraud and visa abuse. USCIS is focused on careful and fair adjudication to ensure the integrity of the immigration system while protecting the interests of American workers.

6dcea3ce77bc3c49f15eca7ca18c3273808ad292.translatedText: There are many hidden worries behind it

7b57c777684fa6512afc7a002ec612ea54c04c91.sourceText: 特朗普政府对移民以及签证政策频频调整，虽然还没有对工作签证项目进行全方位调整，但就目前情况来看，外国工人进入美国工作更加困难。
7b57c777684fa6512afc7a002ec612ea54c04c91.translatedText: The Trump administration has frequently made adjustments to immigration and visa policies. Although it has not made comprehensive adjustments to the work visa program, judging from the current situation, it is more difficult for foreign workers to enter the United States to work.

26722b662c4fbfdee432020a82b0fd014c1a3bf1.sourceText: ”特朗普政府未来将减少合法移民数量，推动积分制，在未来一段时间内，潜在的与美国员工竞争的工作签证都会加强监管。”张军指出，”像L1跨国公司经理签证，北美自由贸易协定制定的TN身份等其他工作签证，也会严苛审查。”
26722b662c4fbfdee432020a82b0fd014c1a3bf1.translatedText: "The Trump administration will reduce the number of legal immigrants in the future and promote a points system. In the future, work visas that potentially compete with American employees will be subject to enhanced supervision." Zhang Jun pointed out, "Such as the L1 multinational company manager visa, NAFTA Customized TN status and other work visas will also be subject to strict review. "

0890c647b5a7840e92a320df5f001c6ce2685961.sourceText: 孙澜涛律师认为，如果H-4配偶工作许可废除，但可以继续申请H-4身份来美，只是不能在美工作，这是移民法的一贯政策。
0890c647b5a7840e92a320df5f001c6ce2685961.translatedText: Lawyer Sun Lantao believes that if the H-4 spouse work permit is revoked, you can continue to apply for H-4 status to come to the United States, but you will not be able to work in the United States. This is the consistent policy of immigration law.

2e20cd96512456dd552081ba2773b94047679a67.sourceText: 此外，与移民签证相关的政策法规，同时也牵动着在美华人的心。
2e20cd96512456dd552081ba2773b94047679a67.translatedText: In addition, policies and regulations related to immigrant visas also affect the hearts of Chinese in the United States.

88e7586ab67975b78fdd9d3bfe27cbaef3a1ac10.sourceText: ”美国中部地区失业率比较高，特朗普政府这样做虽然可以提高就业率，但另一方面，H-1B签证难度加大，美国一些外籍学生或学者留美工作会更加困难。此外，收紧签证以及移民政策，对于华侨华人社团成长以及更新换代都会产生影响。”在美国旧金山生活多年的蔡文耀说，”如果取消配偶(H-4签证)工作许可的话，会增加很多变数，持有H-1B工作签证的华人也需要考量更多的因素。”
88e7586ab67975b78fdd9d3bfe27cbaef3a1ac10.translatedText: " The unemployment rate is relatively high in the central region of the United States. Although the Trump administration can increase the employment rate by doing this, on the other hand, it will become more difficult for H-1B visas. It will be more difficult for some foreign students or scholars in the United States to work in the United States. In addition, the tightening of visas and immigration Citizenship policies will have an impact on the growth and renewal of overseas Chinese communities," said Cai Wenyao, who has lived in San Francisco for many years. "If the spouse (H-4 visa) work permit is cancelled, many variables will be added, and Chinese people holding H-1B work visas will also need to consider more factors."

32ee8eb1d5c8e6feab00519c78640ebcbcc79a3b.sourceText: 人民网：薄熙来雷政富当政时大言炎炎私下却蝇营狗苟
32ee8eb1d5c8e6feab00519c78640ebcbcc79a3b.translatedText: People's Daily Online: When Bo Xilai and Lei Zhengfu were in power, they spoke arrogantly, but in private they acted like dogs.

440d1cf63c5c5364d35246f3a958d1babd4e74cb.sourceText: 人民网：薄熙来雷政富当政时大言炎炎私下却蝇营狗苟 十八大之后，新一届领导人的最初亮相，就让人耳目一新。比如…
440d1cf63c5c5364d35246f3a958d1babd4e74cb.translatedText: People's Daily: When Bo Xilai and Lei Zhengfu were in power, they spoke arrogantly but in private they acted like dogs. After the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the first appearance of the new leadership was refreshing. For example...

0dbdfba14c3ec3a26f33be0e7d52963108798313.sourceText: 新领导集体上任15天，有媒体敏感地发现的诸多”新”意往往和表达有关。习近平总书记说话的平实，李克强副总理开会时的务实，对草根意见的重视，对官员照本宣科的”零容忍”，把形式主义的危害与贪污腐败相提并论厖这一切意味着什么，习近平一语道破”空谈误国，实干兴邦”。
0dbdfba14c3ec3a26f33be0e7d52963108798313.translatedText: It has been 15 days since the new leadership took office. The media has sensitively discovered that many "new" ideas are often related to expressions. General Secretary Xi Jinping’s plain speaking, Vice Premier Li Keqiang’s pragmatism during meetings, his emphasis on grassroots opinions, his “zero tolerance” for officials’ scripted speeches, and his comparison of the dangers of formalism with corruption. What does it all mean?

c09873dc95239c34e2c9047600f9aa88f6b5b8d4.sourceText: 国人向来重视表达。所谓听其言观其行，表达几乎总是和行动紧密相连。空谈之所以误国，其弊有四：
c09873dc95239c34e2c9047600f9aa88f6b5b8d4.translatedText: Chinese people have always valued expression. As the saying goes, listen to his words and watch his actions. Expression is almost always closely linked to action. The reason why empty talk harms the country has four disadvantages:

3969b2e3399577cda90e03257508112c60a83844.sourceText: 其一，空谈掩盖的是价值观的空洞，语言平庸意味着思想的平庸。解放思想才能解放表达，这是颠扑不破之理。缺乏创新思维，缺乏改革锐气，观念的保守落后，必继之以乏味空洞的表达。毛泽东当年在延安的窑洞里，面对纷飞的战火，却大张旗鼓地”反对党八股”，按他的说法：”不反对老八股和老教条主义，中国人民的思想就不能从老八股和老教条主义的束缚下面获得解放，中国就不会有自由独立的希望”。同样，现在如果不扬弃空谈，不解放思想，中国民族也不会有复兴发展的希望，误国之深，莫此为甚！
3969b2e3399577cda90e03257508112c60a83844.translatedText: First, empty talk covers up the emptiness of values, and mediocre language means mediocre thoughts. Only by liberating the mind can we liberate expression. This is an irrefutable principle. The lack of innovative thinking, lack of reform spirit, conservative and backward concepts will inevitably lead to boring and empty expressions. When Mao Zedong was in a cave dwelling in Yan'an, facing the raging war, he vigorously "opposed the party's stereotyped writing". According to his words: "If we do not oppose the stereotyped writing and old dogmatism, the Chinese people's minds will not be liberated from the constraints of the stereotyped writing and old dogmatism, and China will have no hope of freedom and independence." Similarly, if we do not abandon empty talk and do not emancipate our minds, the Chinese nation will have no hope of rejuvenation and development. This is a serious mistake for the country!

76d6d02e0fcf5abbb5340f63de3ea818ef0ab893.sourceText: 其二，空谈筑就了专横与特权之墙。中国封建社会统治阶级自古以来的故弄玄虚、自我隔绝之法，就是臆造出有特权的表达方式，比如书面语与口语的严重脱节，以及通过教育垄断维系的文字垄断即表达垄断。五四的白话文运动最大的意义，就是打破了表达上的专横与特权，由此解放了大众的思想。现在，一些地方官场八股式表达，仿佛根深蒂固，台上的官员一开口，套话空话便自来水般滔滔不绝，仿佛用篱笆墙自我隔绝于大众，维系一种虚妄的、高高在上的优越感，败坏了党群之间、官民之间的互信、共识与鱼水关系。误国之深，莫此为甚！
76d6d02e0fcf5abbb5340f63de3ea818ef0ab893.translatedText: Second, empty talk builds a wall of tyranny and privilege. The ruling class of China’s feudal society has used mythology and self-isolation since ancient times to create privileged ways of expression, such as the serious disconnect between written language and spoken language, and the monopoly of writing, that is, the monopoly of expression, maintained through the monopoly of education. The greatest significance of the May Fourth vernacular movement was to break the tyranny and privilege of expression, thereby liberating the minds of the public. Nowadays, stereotyped expressions in some local officialdoms seem to be deeply ingrained. As soon as officials on the stage open their mouths, they will spout out empty words like running water, as if they are isolating themselves from the public with a fence, maintaining a false and superior sense of superiority, and destroying the mutual trust, consensus and relationship between the party and the masses, and between the government and the people. This is a serious mistake for the country!

15016e0f440459b7fe8c723ce5a020e38e00ff51.sourceText: 其三，空谈屏蔽了真相，纵容了虚伪。薄熙来、雷政富等一干贪官污吏当政之时，都大言炎炎，冠冕堂皇，仿佛天下正义尽在掌握，私下却蝇营狗苟、伤天害理。一些官员也把言行不一当成了天经地义，习以为常。此种风习还在四处蔓延，甚至影响到了孩子们，作文中的”假大空”和电视镜头中的”标准化表情与表达”，让下一代的失真与失实成为常态，毒化了纯真朴实的民族气质，让人为之一窒。误国之深，莫此为甚！
15016e0f440459b7fe8c723ce5a020e38e00ff51.translatedText: Third, empty talk obscures the truth and condones hypocrisy. When Bo Xilai, Lei Zhengfu and other corrupt officials were in power, they spoke arrogantly and high-soundingly, as if they had the justice of the world under their control, but in private they acted like dogs and acted against the laws of nature. Some officials also take the inconsistency between words and deeds as a matter of course and take it for granted. This kind of custom is still spreading everywhere, even affecting children. The "fake empty space" in compositions and the "standardized expressions and expressions" in TV shots have made distortion and inaccuracy the norm for the next generation, poisoning the pure and simple national temperament and suffocating people. This is a serious mistake for the country!

a2d432d3fd313fb63f17fe0f5964d9e9efec6e77.sourceText: 其四，空谈放任了懒政之风。一些主政官员习惯于秘书和下级准备讲稿，安于成为会议和讲话”道具”，甘当不动脑子、不察民情、不干实事的”三不”官员。久而久之，懒政、怠政、惰政成了官场流行病，漫天花架子，乏人做实事。误国之深，莫此为甚！
a2d432d3fd313fb63f17fe0f5964d9e9efec6e77.translatedText: Fourth, empty talk has allowed laziness to prevail. Some officials in charge are accustomed to having their secretaries and subordinates prepare speeches, and are content to become "props" for meetings and speeches. They are willing to be officials who do not use their brains, do not pay attention to the public sentiment, and do not do practical things. Over time, laziness, indolence, and laziness in governance have become an epidemic in the officialdom, with all the airs and ostentation but few people doing practical work. This is a serious mistake for the country!

9ca3aba6bdf7424a944f3e3fdfbb042288f60e17.sourceText: 从这个意义上说，新一届领导人在表达上的率先垂范，对空谈误国的深恶痛绝，切中时弊，直捣官场积习。短短15天扬起的表达新风，拉近了和百姓的距离，让国人看到了兴邦的希望。
9ca3aba6bdf7424a944f3e3fdfbb042288f60e17.translatedText: In this sense, the new leaders have set an example in terms of expression. They deeply hate the empty talk that harms the country, cut into the current shortcomings, and attack the old habits of the officialdom. The new trend of expression that emerged in just 15 days has brought the country closer to the people and allowed the Chinese people to see the hope of rejuvenating the country.

2e3ab8e564d6c214cac86bfb7a9ea0184ce85a1d.translatedText: Put an end to empty talk, there is no greater good!

b638f123d0e6a8d99994e75c2e30eed132de40a1.sourceText: （侨联供稿）在凤凰城Deer Valley的一个边远地区，这裡曾是印第安人和西部牛仔生活的地方，这裡的人们从来都是用英文和西班牙文教学，现在却不时传出中文的读书声和歌声，这就是 Deer Valley Unified School District。凤凰城侨联的几位朋友有幸被邀请访问了这所学校。这个学校的孩子，从幼儿班起每天就有45分鐘的中文课，他们针对孩子们的年龄特点，寓教於乐，从歌唱和游戏中学讲中国话（国语）。从一年级到四年级有百分之五十的课程是用中国话教学，数学和科学课都用中文授课，一直到十二年级都设有各类中文课，这样，学生们自幼就掌握了用中文会话和阅读写作能力。 这个学校之所以採用这样的教学方式有很大的前瞻性。他们的理由是全世界有8.73亿人口的第一语言是中国国语；中国的国民生產总值已仅次於美国成為世界第二；中国是当今美国的最大贸易伙伴，全球500大企业有480家已在中国落户；大约57000家美国企业在中国经营。可见下一代年青人掌握和应用中国国语对於他们未来的就业和发展前途有多麼重要。我们敬佩他们敏锐的洞察力的战略眼光。 我们走进了教室，每个班级有大约25名学生，每人都有一个中文名字。我们看著这些高鼻子的洋娃娃用标準清晰的中国话表示欢迎，準确的背诵著一到百位数，讲述著我喜欢什麼和不喜欢什麼，报告日期和气候，真的不相信我们正置身于美国的学堂。当孩子们唱起了”两隻老虎，两隻老虎”和”我是一个最聪明的小花咪”等我们熟悉的中国歌曲时，我们不禁也跟著唱了起来。 短暂的两小时访问给我们留下了十分美好的回忆和啟迪，侨联的朋友也和学校的领导，教师共同探讨了在华人社区活动和中文教育方面进行合作和交流的途径。 走出去看看这个变化着的世界，不断更新我们的思维，将会增长不少知识和灵感。
b638f123d0e6a8d99994e75c2e30eed132de40a1.translatedText: (Contributed by the Overseas Chinese Federation) In a remote area of ​​Deer Valley in Phoenix, this was once a place where Indians and western cowboys lived. People here have always taught in English and Spanish, but now the sound of reading and singing in Chinese can be heard from time to time. This is the Deer Valley Unified School District. Several friends from the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation were fortunate enough to be invited to visit this school. Children in this school have 45 minutes of Chinese classes every day starting from kindergarten. They teach and entertain based on the age characteristics of the children, and learn to speak Chinese (Mandarin) through singing and games. Fifty percent of the courses from grade one to grade four are taught in Chinese, and math and science classes are all taught in Chinese. There are various Chinese classes until grade 12. In this way, students have mastered the ability to speak, read and write in Chinese from an early age. The reason why this school adopts this teaching method is very forward-looking. Their reasons are that the first language of 873 million people in the world is Chinese Mandarin; China's GDP has become the second largest in the world after the United States; China is the largest trading partner of the United States today, and 480 of the world's top 500 companies have settled in China; about 57,000 American companies operate in China. This shows how important it is for the next generation of young people to master and use Chinese Mandarin for their future employment and development prospects. We admire their keen strategic vision. We walked into the classroom. There were about 25 students in each class, and each one had a Chinese name. We watched these tall-nosed dolls express their welcome in standard and clear Chinese, accurately reciting numbers from one to a hundred, telling what I like and don't like, reporting the date and climate. We really didn't believe that we were in an American school. When the children sang familiar Chinese songs such as "Two Tigers, Two Tigers" and "I am the Smartest Little Flower", we couldn't help but sing along. The short two-hour visit left us with very good memories and inspirations. Friends from the Overseas Chinese Federation also discussed ways of cooperation and exchanges with school leaders and teachers in Chinese community activities and Chinese education. Going out to see this changing world and constantly updating our thinking will increase a lot of knowledge and inspiration.

1eeb4a9d8330cab1f5f0db4ca449af150efda7a5.sourceText: 高科技绿卡案成移民改革试金石 国会众议院将于29、30日审议”放宽高科技人才移民”一案，这个又被称为”科技绿卡”的提案，成为总统大选后两党在广泛移民改革法案上是否协力合作的第一个试金石。但白宫及民主党议员28日已表明反对废除广受欢迎的”多元化抽签移民”，来换取高科技人才的移民配额。 早先期待此案为两党全面移民改革合作铺路的希望，在第一回合上就变得黯淡，不知两天内能否有转机。 以共和党为多数的众院程序委员会28日傍晚就”科技绿卡”一案举行听证。会中否决了民主党议员提出的民主党版”高科技绿卡案”，也否决了民主党欲将”投资绿卡”(EB5)”区域中心”投资办法由目前短期措施转为永久化等案。 众院程序委员会通过司法委员会主席，共和党人史密斯(Lamar Smith)提出撤销现行的”抽签绿卡”(多样化乐透移民)一案，将每年5万5000个”抽签绿卡”名额，供给外籍高科技博士的”科技绿卡”。博士用不完的再给硕士。”科技绿卡案”还允许美国永久居民的配偶及未成年子女，在取得永久居民资格一年后，来美国等绿卡。但这些人不得在美工作或享受福利。 两党法案最大的不同是，民主党版本的”高科技绿卡案”将维持现行的”抽签绿卡”计划，而共和党案则取消”抽签绿卡”。 白宫在听证前，以共和党案将撤销”抽签绿卡”计划为由，表示反对。 ”科技绿卡案”曾于大选前在众院院会表决失败。而这次以不同的表决方式卷土重来，可望在共和党掌控的众院过关。但由于参院以民主党为多数，在众院送达参院的并非两党妥协的版本，因此估计也不可能在参院通过。除非两党有意重启协商，否则”科技绿卡案”将再次因政党对立，无疾而终。这应该算是两党在全面的移民改革立法努力的第一块试金石，双方都在盘算各自实力，做为下次交手的准备。
1eeb4a9d8330cab1f5f0db4ca449af150efda7a5.translatedText: The High-Tech Green Card Case Becomes a Touchstone for Immigration Reform The House of Representatives will consider the case of "relaxing high-tech talent immigration" on the 29th and 30th. This proposal, also known as the "Technology Green Card," has become the first litmus test for whether the two parties will work together on a broad immigration reform bill after the presidential election. However, the White House and Democratic lawmakers expressed their opposition to abolishing the popular "diversity lottery immigration" in exchange for immigration quotas for high-tech talents on the 28th. Early hopes that the case would pave the way for bipartisan cooperation on comprehensive immigration reform dimmed in the first round, and it was unclear whether there would be a turnaround within two days. The House of Representatives Procedure Committee, with Republicans as the majority, held a hearing on the "Technology Green Card" case on the evening of the 28th. During the meeting, the Democratic Party's version of the "High-tech Green Card Case" proposed by Democratic Party members was rejected. It also rejected the Democratic Party's plan to convert the "Investment Green Card" (EB5) and "Regional Center" investment methods from the current short-term measures to permanent ones. The House of Representatives Procedural Committee approved the Judiciary Committee Chairman, Republican Lamar Smith, to propose the cancellation of the current "lottery green card" (diversity lottery immigration). The annual 55,000 "lottery green card" quota will be provided to the "technology green card" of foreign high-tech PhDs. Whatever the PhD can’t use will be given to the MA. The "Technology Green Card Case" also allows the spouses and minor children of U.S. permanent residents to come to the United States to wait for their green cards one year after obtaining permanent resident status. However, these people are not allowed to work in the United States or receive benefits. The biggest difference between the bills of the two parties is that the Democratic version of the "High-tech Green Card Case" will maintain the current "Green Card Lottery" program, while the Republican version will cancel the "Green Card Lottery" program. Before the hearing, the White House expressed opposition on the grounds that the Republican bill would revoke the "green card lottery" program. The "Technology Green Card Case" failed in a vote in the House of Representatives before the election. This time it comes back with a different voting method and is expected to pass in the Republican-controlled House of Representatives. However, since the Democratic Party is the majority in the Senate, the version sent to the Senate in the House of Representatives is not a compromise between the two parties, so it is unlikely to be passed in the Senate. Unless the two parties intend to restart negotiations, the "Technology Green Card Case" will once again end in vain due to political party opposition. This should be regarded as the first touchstone for the two parties in their comprehensive immigration reform legislative efforts. Both parties are calculating their respective strengths and preparing for the next confrontation.

40924beaa1a094dc7fda7d1c91f301e79eaddc86.sourceText: 移民来美越久 “富贵病”越多
40924beaa1a094dc7fda7d1c91f301e79eaddc86.translatedText: The longer immigrants have been in the United States, the more "affluenza" they have.

7eb00623870ddcfeffbdcb3ec0d04e13a32c9740.sourceText: 移民来美越久 “富贵病”越多 对移民死亡数据的研究显示，生活在美国愈久的移民，患心脏病、高血压、糖尿病的机…
7eb00623870ddcfeffbdcb3ec0d04e13a32c9740.translatedText: The longer immigrants have been in the United States, the more "affluenza" they have. A study of immigrant death data shows that the longer immigrants live in the United States, the more likely they are to suffer from heart disease, high blood pressure, and diabetes...

dd148861edc8178ed63c89169a456715b10c42fa.sourceText: 对移民死亡数据的研究显示，生活在美国愈久的移民，患心脏病、高血压、糖尿病的机率愈高。他们在美出生的子女可能收入更高，但寿命可能低于父母一代。
dd148861edc8178ed63c89169a456715b10c42fa.translatedText: A study of immigrant death data shows that the longer immigrants live in the United States, the higher their chances of suffering from heart disease, high blood pressure, and diabetes. Their children born in the United States may have higher incomes but may live longer than their parents did a generation ago.

642fd5b923ab98739e29a8f7dbd68a82b01fef91.sourceText: 今年41岁的安吉丽丝（Esther Angeles）已经患糖尿病，希望7岁的女儿戈梅兹（Johanna Marisol Gomez）能保持健康。（《纽约时报》图）
642fd5b923ab98739e29a8f7dbd68a82b01fef91.translatedText: Esther Angeles, 41, is already suffering from diabetes and hopes that her 7-year-old daughter Johanna Marisol Gomez can stay healthy. (Photo from The New York Times)

41215b676b73171285fd44397270084b52bb5f3c.sourceText: 据《纽约时报》报道，这种研究结果和人们的常识相反：许多人以为，移民到美国，生活的各个层面都会改善。这种研究结果也显示，同化1100万在美的非法移民也许是个错误–至少在健康上如此。
41215b676b73171285fd44397270084b52bb5f3c.translatedText: According to the New York Times, this research result is contrary to common sense: Many people believe that immigrating to the United States will improve all aspects of life. The findings also suggest that assimilating the 11 million illegal immigrants in the United States may be a mistake - at least from a health perspective.

22fe902c8bdc4d098e8e53e0d6303c5db4c30601.sourceText: 奥斯汀得克萨斯大学社会认可学家哈默（Robert A. Hummer）说，美国生活中某些方面不利于健康。
22fe902c8bdc4d098e8e53e0d6303c5db4c30601.translatedText: Robert A. Hummer, a social recognition scientist at the University of Texas at Austin, said that certain aspects of American life are not conducive to health.

0effa1407331132f9d92fc4d31e32200a8f73303.sourceText: 日增的移民寿命研究显示，虽然移民的子女可能赚钱更多，他们可能比父母短命。对于全美最大的少数族裔来说，在外国出生的拉美裔往往比在美国出生的后代寿命要长3岁。
0effa1407331132f9d92fc4d31e32200a8f73303.translatedText: Growing research on immigrant longevity shows that while the children of immigrants may make more money, they may live shorter lives than their parents. For the nation's largest minority group, foreign-born Hispanics tend to live three years longer than their U.S.-born counterparts.

7106f72dbade0b77b94cbdd85ed844389c1534e6.sourceText: 有些人会问，美国的医疗技术先进、个人工资高，为何美国人的健康会那么差？最新研究指出，?#32618;魁祸首?#23601;是美国人的行为和生活方式：抽烟、喝酒、吃高热量食物、久坐不动。移民来到美国的各种优势，很快就被染上这种生活方式抵销了。
7106f72dbade0b77b94cbdd85ed844389c1534e6.translatedText: Some people may ask, with advanced medical technology and high personal wages in the United States, why is the health of Americans so poor? The latest research points out that the main culprit is Americans' behaviors and lifestyles: smoking, drinking, eating high-calorie foods, and being sedentary. The advantages that immigrants had in coming to America were quickly offset by the lifestyle they adopted.

4c9f17fb8f4ad6d8f18f69f46e505ede8303a2e4.sourceText: 例如，破败的边境城市布朗斯维尔（Brownsville）就有很多快餐店。美国食物对移民有巨大诱惑力。在美国，火腿肉和面包都是甜的，来自墨西哥的儿童很快就不吃仙人掌和豆子之类的本国传统食物。
4c9f17fb8f4ad6d8f18f69f46e505ede8303a2e4.translatedText: For example, the rundown border city of Brownsville has many fast food restaurants. American food is a huge temptation for immigrants. In the United States, ham and bread are both sweet, and children from Mexico quickly stop eating traditional foods like cactus and beans.

0a42deb027c31255bebaa92dee5ec88ba855ffa9.sourceText: 新到美国的移民发现，美国食物丰富、方便，随时吃得到快餐，代表这个国家真是”机会之国”。15年前来到美国的墨西哥女孩安吉丽丝（Esther Angeles）说，她刚到美国时，看到美国的汉堡大到跟盘子的大小差不多，十分惊喜。
0a42deb027c31255bebaa92dee5ec88ba855ffa9.translatedText: New immigrants to the United States have discovered that American food is abundant and convenient, and fast food is available at any time, which means that this country is really a "land of opportunity." Esther Angeles, a Mexican girl who came to the United States 15 years ago, said that when she first arrived in the United States, she was surprised to see that American burgers were almost as big as a plate.

5fb4b989a3791da181615a34073b7953b102fdef.sourceText: 对移民而言，速食不仅好吃，而且代表成就，一家人去速食店打牙祭，象征收入不错。忙碌的美国职场又迫使更多年轻移民更加依赖速食，很多人忙到用汉堡做正餐。种种因素加在一起，使移民子女这一代体型慢慢加胖，慢性病也逐渐上身。
5fb4b989a3791da181615a34073b7953b102fdef.translatedText: For immigrants, fast food is not only delicious, but also represents achievement. Going to a fast food restaurant as a family to have a toothpaste symbolizes good income. The busy American workplace has forced more young immigrants to rely more on fast food, and many are so busy that they eat hamburgers for dinner. The combination of various factors has caused the generation of immigrant children to gradually gain weight and develop chronic diseases.

82526a210de604548c8bea95da9dc17194a7ed4c.sourceText: 安吉丽丝对于丰盛食品的激动逐步消失了，而美国职场的快节奏很快成为焦点。她自己吃汉堡包越来越多，因为她作为保姆每周工作78个小时。而作为单亲妈妈，她很少和女儿一起吃饭，也失去了对女儿的饮食控制。今年41岁的安吉丽丝（Esther Angeles）已经患糖尿病，希望7岁的女儿戈梅兹（Johanna Marisol Gomez）能保持健康。
82526a210de604548c8bea95da9dc17194a7ed4c.translatedText: >Angeles' excitement for sumptuous food faded, and the fast pace of the American workplace soon took center stage. She eats more and more hamburgers herself as she works 78 hours a week as a nanny. As a single mother, she rarely ate with her daughter and lost control of her daughter's diet. Esther Angeles, 41, is already suffering from diabetes and hopes that her 7-year-old daughter Johanna Marisol Gomez can stay healthy.

b8354020d7721645bbd0ea17704545108f569218.sourceText: 移民改革论战之际，许多人担心，让1100万无证移民合法化，他们会与美国同化吗？这些研究显示，至少在生活方式层面，他们不必担心，移民同化得太快了。
b8354020d7721645bbd0ea17704545108f569218.translatedText: During the debate on immigration reform, many people are worried that if the 11 million undocumented immigrants are legalized, will they assimilate with the United States? These studies suggest that, at least at the level of lifestyle, they need not worry that immigrants are assimilating too quickly.

7c231590e43219ca440ce1946f7bcf9a63980e28.sourceText: “人为财死 鸟为食亡” 小谈现代金钱观 王斋先 古人说：”人为财死，鸟为食亡。”果然不错。在这认钱不认命，人人向钱看的邪恶时代里，我们时常在新闻和电视上所听到看到的有不少的人拼着自己宝贵的生命去杀人，抢夺银行、金库、组合药局、金铺，甚至有的被钱迷惑了良心，为了遗产将自己的父母杀害埋藏，还有为了产业把亲兄弟朋友杀害，更有些年轻人，为了钱，加入黑社会和帮派，最后不是自杀就是他杀；若是再将光天化日下，抢夺路人或晚夜抢夺个人金钱财宝的案件算在内，真不知道有多少抢夺案，恐难胜数矣！虽然常发生经济风暴，但仍有很多国家经济仍是繁荣，生活普遍提高之。现在，抢劫案发生这么多，究竟为了何故？若遭饥荒，三餐不继之时，为了果腹之需而冒险，抢夺财物或情有可原，容易了解其动机，然而，今天人人收入丰足之现在，仍然有此舍命枪财之刑案之发生，岂不是为了应验人为财死的古人名言了。这些犯案者，最后难逃法网，终被逮捕，有的被枪决，有的被判死刑，或在起诉中。如此可见，钱财魔力之大，使人明知是虎口、火坑，还是前仆后继的向此火炕跳，陷阱投奔，宛如飞蛾扑火般地丧命！ 真的钱财有那么大的魔力值得我们去卖命争取的么？虽然”有金钱能使鬼推磨”之俗语。经上也说：”钱能叫万事应心。”（传十：19）但钱财无能为力的事很多很多！ 金钱能买华美房屋，不能买美满家庭； 金钱能买剧场门票，不能买心灵的安宁； 金钱能买营养补品，不能买生命不死； 金钱能买上天飞机，不能买天堂门票； 金钱能， 金钱不能。 所以经上又说：”你要嘱咐那些今世富足的人，不要自高，也不要靠无定的钱财，只要倚靠那厚赐百物给我们享受的上帝。”（提后六：7） 贪财是万恶之根，有人贪恋钱财就被引诱离了真道，用许多愁苦把自己刺透了。所以圣经教训我们：”敬虔加上知足的心便是大利了。因为我们没有带什么到世上来，也不能带什么去，只要有衣有食，就当知足。因为那些想要发财的人，就陷在迷惑，落在网罗，和许多无知有害的私欲里；叫人沉在败坏和灭亡中。”（提前六：6-10） 俗语说：”知足常乐”，唯有知足的人，才是世界上最富足的人。愿我们大家都靠着那加给我们力量的上帝，做个凡事知足既以自己所有为足的知足人。
7c231590e43219ca440ce1946f7bcf9a63980e28.translatedText: "Man-made money dies, and birds die for food." A short talk about the modern view of money Wang Zhaixian The ancients said: "Man perishes for wealth, and birds perish for food." It's true. In this evil era where money is more important than life, and everyone is focused on money, we often hear and see on the news and TV that many people risk their precious lives to kill people, rob banks, treasuries, drugstores, and gold shops. Some are even confused by money and have their own parents killed and buried for the sake of inheritance. Hiding, and killing brothers and friends for property, and some young people, for money, joined the underworld and gangs, and ended up either committing suicide or committing suicide. If we include cases of robbing passers-by in broad daylight or snatching personal money and treasure at night, I don’t know how many robberies there are, it’s probably hard to count! Although economic storms often occur, there are still many countries where the economy is still prosperous and living standards are generally improving. Why are so many robberies happening now? If you are suffering from famine and do not have three meals a day, it may be excusable to take risks and rob property for the sake of food. It is easy to understand the motivation. However, today, when everyone has abundant income, there are still such criminal cases that sacrifice life, gun and wealth. Isn’t it to fulfill the ancient saying that people die for wealth. These perpetrators were eventually arrested, some were shot, some were sentenced to death, or were being prosecuted. It can be seen from this that the magic power of money is so great that people know that it is a tiger's mouth or a pit of fire, but they still jump into the fire pit one after another, and fall into the trap, and die like moths to the flames! Is money really so magical that we should work hard to fight for it? Although there is a saying that "Money can make the world go round". The Bible also says: "Money can make all things happen." (Ecclesiastes 10:19) But there are many things that money cannot do! Money can buy gorgeous houses, but not a happy family; money can buy theater tickets, but not peace of mind; money can buy nutritional supplements, but not immortality; money can buy airplanes, but not tickets to heaven; money can, but money cannot. Therefore, the Bible also says: "Charge those who are rich in this world not to be puffed up or to rely on uncertain money, but to trust in God who richly provides us with all things for our enjoyment." (2 Timothy 6:7) The love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. Some people who love money are tempted away from the truth and pierce themselves with many sorrows. Therefore, the Bible teaches us: "Godliness with contentment is great gain. For we brought nothing into the world, and we can carry nothing out, but let us be content, as long as we have food and clothing. For those who want to get rich fall into temptation and a snare and into many foolish and harmful desires, which lead to destruction and destruction." (1 Timothy 6:6-10) As the saying goes: "Content is always happy." Only those who are content are the richest people in the world. May we all rely on God who gives us strength and be contented people who are content with everything and are content with what we have.

c0969f4e5f32ee362ef5f9787327be0358ff4018.sourceText: 国风中国表演艺术家书画展 （亚省时报驻洛杉矶记者甄松伟摄影报导） 中国著名表演艺术家姜昆，唐国强，张铁林，郁钧剑等，应联合国书画会邀请，经中国文联挑选特邀2月2日在纽约联合国总部举办《国 风国表演艺术家书画展》，此次访美的艺术家都是中国家喻户晓的超级明星，他们不仅德艺双馨，在演艺界取得举世瞩目的成就，也是学养深厚，，技艺高超的著名书画家 。 这次在联合国和洛杉矶举行书画展，堪称中国艺术界对外交流的一盛事。 中国艺术家一行3日到达洛杉矶，为一睹中国著名的表演艺术家的风采，洛杉矶地区侨胞3日晚共聚一堂，与前来洛杉矶举办书画展的艺术家们共度春节，欢迎晚宴在洛杉矶御珍楼举行 ，出席晚宴的有中国总领馆文化参赞车兆和，新闻领事乐利文，洛杉矶县政委员安东诺维奇以及夫人胡惠玲，名人政要，侨领侨胞近300人出席。 晚宴上姜昆表演了精彩的相声小段，唐国强为大家再现了《三国演义》诸葛亮出山的片段，张铁林与卞小贞来一段现代京剧《沙家浜》，郁钧剑演唱了一首中国民歌，博得现场 侨胞阵阵掌声，艺术家们还现场即席挥毫，赠送给抽奖的观众。 姜昆在接受媒体采访时表示，老一辈艺术家基本上都是琴棋书画样样精通，可见艺术爱好在沟通人的情感，激发人的文化情趣，甚至艺术创作灵感方面。 曾在英国留学的张铁林表示，文化传承是一个过程，也是文化工作者的一种职责，我虽然多次扮演皇帝，但是我的书画方面还是个”小兵”。 据了解，这次访美参加书画展的除了姜昆，唐国强，张铁林，郁钧剑，还有中国文联副主席著名书画家覃志刚，徐沛东，每人均展出多年来创作的15幅字画作品，这几位 中国著名的表演艺术家不仅在表演艺术领域成就卓著，在书画艺术方面也有很深的造诣。
c0969f4e5f32ee362ef5f9787327be0358ff4018.translatedText: Calligraphy and painting exhibition by Chinese performing artists with photogenic style (Photography and reporting by Zhen Songwei, reporter of The Alberta Times in Los Angeles) Famous Chinese performing artists Jiang Kun, Tang Guoqiang, Zhang Tielin, Yu Junjian, etc., were invited by the United Nations Calligraphy and Painting Association and selected by the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles to hold the "Guofeng Chinese Performing Artists Calligraphy and Painting Exhibition" at the United Nations Headquarters in New York on February 2. The artists visiting the United States this time are all well-known superstars in China. They are not only good at virtue and art, and have made world-renowned achievements in the entertainment industry, but they are also well-known calligraphers and painters with profound knowledge and superb skills. This calligraphy and painting exhibition held at the United Nations and Los Angeles can be regarded as a grand event for the Chinese art world's foreign exchanges. A group of Chinese artists arrived in Los Angeles on the 3rd. In order to see the famous Chinese performing artists, overseas Chinese in the Los Angeles area gathered together on the evening of the 3rd to spend the Spring Festival with the artists who came to Los Angeles to hold a calligraphy and painting exhibition. The welcome dinner was held at the Yuzhen Building in Los Angeles. The dinner was attended by Che Zhaohe, cultural counselor of the Chinese Consulate General, Le Liwen, the press consul, Antonovich, the Los Angeles County Supervisor, his wife Hu Huiling, celebrities and dignitaries, and nearly 300 overseas Chinese leaders. At the dinner, Jiang Kun performed a wonderful cross talk segment, Tang Guoqiang recreated the scene of Zhuge Liang's appearance in "The Romance of the Three Kingdoms", Zhang Tielin and Bian Xiaozhen performed a modern Peking opera "Shajiabang", and Yu Junjian sang a Chinese folk song, which won bursts of applause from the overseas Chinese at the scene. The artists also improvised on the spot and gave them to the audience for the lottery. Jiang Kun said in an interview with the media that the older generation of artists are basically proficient in all kinds of music, chess, calligraphy and painting. It can be seen that art hobbies can communicate people's emotions, stimulate people's cultural interests, and even inspire artistic creation. Zhang Tielin, who once studied in the UK, said that cultural inheritance is a process and a responsibility of cultural workers. Although I have played the role of emperor many times, I am still a "little soldier" in calligraphy and painting. It is understood that in addition to Jiang Kun, Tang Guoqiang, Zhang Tielin, and Yu Junjian who visited the United States to participate in the calligraphy and painting exhibition, there are also famous calligraphers and painters Qin Zhigang and Xu Peidong, vice presidents of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles. Each of them exhibited 15 calligraphy and painting works created over the years. These famous Chinese performing artists not only have outstanding achievements in the field of performing arts, but also have profound attainments in calligraphy and painting.

b80ae8151c409fb7be0f4779dbeb8b68570e7878.sourceText: Jack N.Yee在1942年2月加入美国陆军，经过训练后，成为一名在食品方面的后勤军士。
b80ae8151c409fb7be0f4779dbeb8b68570e7878.translatedText: Jack N. Yee joined the U.S. Army in February 1942. After training, he became a logistics sergeant in food.

984bc610868fbaa6189fadec881a72e6bada630d.sourceText: 1944年，当时担任盟军中国战区参谋长兼中缅印战区美军司令约瑟夫 史迪威将军，需要有能讲会写的华裔军人，派往中国昆明进行中美双方人员的通讯和沟通工作。于是，有400华裔军人派被往密西里州的克罗德军营，进行通讯方面的培训，Jack N.Yee是其中的一名。
984bc610868fbaa6189fadec881a72e6bada630d.translatedText: In 1944, General Joseph Stilwell, who was the Chief of Staff of the Allied Forces in China Theater and Commander of the U.S. Army in the China-Burma-India Theater, needed Chinese soldiers who could speak and write and sent him to Kunming, China, to carry out communications between Chinese and American personnel. As a result, 400 Chinese soldiers were sent to Croder Army Camp in Missouri for communications training, and Jack N. Yee was one of them.

f9ef2fc354c4729963d6bf242c01d734aa0392be.sourceText: 1944年7月，Jack N.Yee在密苏里州的克罗德营地（Camp Crowder）完成培训后，和400名华裔军人一起被派去31437th 信号服务公司（ signal service company），之后，他们坐船通过苏伊士运河，经中国去到印度。到达印度达孟买之后，被派到加尔各答。其中有300名训练有素的华裔军人被派去中国担任通信员，而Jack N.Yee和其余99人则送去印首都新德里作后备。就在他们等待命令的时候，二次大战宣布结束。Jack N.Yee在二次大战获得3枚奖章(Medal)，并于1945年9月8日从军中退役。
f9ef2fc354c4729963d6bf242c01d734aa0392be.translatedText: In July 1944, after completing training at Camp Crowder in Missouri, Jack N. Yee was sent to the 31437th signal service company (signal service company) together with 400 Chinese soldiers. After that, they took a boat through the Suez Canal and went to India via China. After reaching Bombay, India, he was posted to Calcutta. Among them, 300 well-trained Chinese soldiers were sent to China as correspondents, while Jack N. Yee and the remaining 99 people were sent to New Delhi, the capital of India, as backup. While they were waiting for orders, World War II was declared over. Jack N. Yee won 3 medals (Medal) in World War II and retired from the army on September 8, 1945.

cb26df1b7ec1e0304e0c5e3d85f640b2c7f8ca67.sourceText: 英文附件中的Camp Crowder即克罗德营地能够查到资料，这是一个训练军营，位于密西里州，在1941-42构建作为美国陆军信号军团培训中心。该营地以诺克劳德将军命名，诺克劳德将军出生于1859年，是密苏里州一位着名的军事律师。在二战期间克罗德营指定为美国陆军通信兵置换培训中心，陆军部队后勤培训中心，培训了数千名文员，无线电操作员，摄影师和报务员，还有用于战场上的信鸽部队。
cb26df1b7ec1e0304e0c5e3d85f640b2c7f8ca67.translatedText: Information can be found on Camp Crowder in the English attachment. This is a training camp located in Mississippi. It was built in 1941-42 as a training center for the U.S. Army Signal Corps. The camp was named for General Northcloud, a prominent Missouri military lawyer who was born in 1859. During World War II, Camp Crowder was designated as the U.S. Army Signal Corps Replacement Training Center, an Army Corps logistics training center that trained thousands of clerks, radio operators, photographers and telegraph operators, as well as homing pigeon units for use on the battlefield.

32e88449b59031ff7d72a5340f097f7eb73f599b.sourceText: 约瑟夫 史迪威（Joseph Stilwell）1904年西点军校毕业，珍珠港事件后，史迪威被派到中国，先后担任中国战区参谋长、中缅印战区美军总司令、东南亚盟军司令部副司令、中国驻印军司令。
32e88449b59031ff7d72a5340f097f7eb73f599b.translatedText: Joseph Stilwell Stilwell graduated from West Point Military Academy in 1904. After the Pearl Harbor incident, Stilwell was sent to China and served successively as chief of staff of the China Theater, commander-in-chief of the U.S. Army in the China-Burma-India Theater, deputy commander of the Southeast Asia Allied Forces Command, and commander of the Chinese Army in India.

9f48a17c55cd079f98573c9db85057c2568c4269.sourceText: 抗战爆发后，日军妄想在三个月内灭亡中国，从战争一开始就封锁了中国沿海，占领了天津、上海、广州三大港口，中国有限的沿海工业受到严重的破坏。日军在切断了陇海线、粤汉铁路等交通干线后，又占领广西、越南，切断了滇越铁路。德国进攻苏联后，苏联援华物资的西北运输线也宣告中断。到1941年，在中国经济处于崩溃的边缘，中国抗战赖以生存的外援线仅剩下一条滇缅公路，可是，日军从越南河内派出轰炸机对滇缅公路进行了无数次狂轰滥炸。为了保证抗战的外援线，国民政府1941年8月份组建了以美国退役军官陈纳德为首的援华志愿航空队，以便保卫滇缅公路，保证援华物资的运输。美国还开辟了驼峰航线，向中国战场运送战略物资，可是，驼峰航线每运送一吨汽油，就有飞机、飞行员失事。
9f48a17c55cd079f98573c9db85057c2568c4269.translatedText: After the outbreak of the Anti-Japanese War, the Japanese army wanted to destroy China within three months. From the beginning of the war, they blocked China's coast and occupied the three major ports of Tianjin, Shanghai and Guangzhou. China's limited coastal industries were severely damaged. After cutting off the Longhai Line, Guangdong-Hankou Railway and other major transportation lines, the Japanese army occupied Guangxi and Vietnam and cut off the Yunnan-Vietnam Railway. After Germany attacked the Soviet Union, the northwest transportation line for Soviet aid supplies to China was also interrupted. By 1941, China's economy was on the verge of collapse, and the only foreign aid line China relied on for the survival of the war of resistance was the Burma Highway. However, the Japanese army sent bombers from Hanoi, Vietnam, to carry out numerous indiscriminate bombings on the Burma Highway. In order to ensure the foreign aid line for the Anti-Japanese War, the Nationalist Government established a volunteer air force to aid China in August 1941, headed by retired American military officer Chennault, in order to protect the Burma Highway and ensure the transportation of aid supplies to China. The United States also opened a hump route to transport strategic materials to the Chinese battlefield. However, for every ton of gasoline transported by the hump route, planes and pilots crashed.

d296ba04d259931fe8a13d378393821c3b8f5cc0.sourceText: 国民政府1941年2月组建了中印勘测队，史迪威将军徒步带领小分队到达印度，为打通中印公路开展漫长而艰苦的旅程。1942年12月，史迪威将军组织中、美、英、印、缅军民发起了缅北滇西开路大战。日军的战略企图与中美盟军是针锋相对的，中美盟军是要?#36890;?#65292;日军是要?#26029;?#65292;日军集中优势兵力，相继实施了三期?#26029;路?#20316;战。中美盟军和中国民众浴血奋战，共同打通中印公路。1945年1月，盟军滇缅反攻战役完胜，同时中印公路通车，与驼峰航线一起将堆积在印度的军用物资源源不断地运送到中国抗日战场，沿着公路还从印度铺设了一条通到中国昆明的输油管。为纪念史迪威将军的卓越贡献，和在他领导下的盟军以及中国军队对缅甸战役发挥的巨大作用，这条公路被命名为?#21490;迪威公路?#12290;
d296ba04d259931fe8a13d378393821c3b8f5cc0.translatedText: The Nationalist Government established the China-India Survey Team in February 1941. General Stilwell led the team to India on foot, embarking on a long and arduous journey to open the China-India Highway. In December 1942, General Stilwell organized the military and civilians of China, the United States, Britain, India, and Myanmar to launch the Road Opening War in northern Burma and western Yunnan. The strategic intentions of the Japanese army were tit-for-tat with those of the Chinese and American Allied forces. The Chinese and American Allied forces wanted the Japanese army to concentrate their superior forces and launched three phases of road battles one after another. The Sino-US allied forces and the Chinese people fought bloody battles to open the China-India highway. In January 1945, the Allied counterattack in Burma was victorious. At the same time, the China-India Highway was opened to traffic. Together with the Hump Route, military supplies accumulated in India were continuously transported to the anti-Japanese battlefield in China. An oil pipeline was also laid along the highway from India to Kunming, China. To commemorate the outstanding contribution of General Stilwell and the great role played by the Allied forces and the Chinese army under his leadership in the Burma Campaign, this road was named the Stilwell Highway?#12290;

718ffde953b3e1805532f318485e5b57caff7dfd.sourceText: 1944年7月，史迪威被晋升为四星上将。同年10月，史迪威将军被罗斯福总统召回美国，被任命为太平洋战场美国第10军司令，于1945年8月在琉球群岛接受10多万日军的投降。1945年9月出席在?#23494;苏里号?#25112;列舰上举行的日本投降签字仪式。1946年10月12日，史迪威将军因患胃癌逝世，终年63岁。去世前一天，根据他的请求授予他一枚步兵战斗纪念章。这是一种极普通的奖章，但只有在第一线战斗的步兵才能获得。
718ffde953b3e1805532f318485e5b57caff7dfd.translatedText: In July 1944, Stilwell was promoted to a four-star general. In October of the same year, General Stilwell was recalled to the United States by President Roosevelt and appointed commander of the U.S. 10th Army in the Pacific Theater. In August 1945, he accepted the surrender of more than 100,000 Japanese troops in the Ryukyu Islands. In September 1945, he attended the Japanese surrender signing ceremony held on the battleship Suri. General Stilwell died of stomach cancer on October 12, 1946, at the age of 63. The day before his death, he was awarded an Infantry Combat Medal at his request. This is a very common medal, but it can only be obtained by infantry fighting on the front line.

c68d673d5fed7a862073f52f2efa586a46f163df.sourceText: 史迪威具有多方面令人敬慕的才干，他到过中国很多地方，中文非常流利，有时写日记不用英文而用中文。更为重要的是，他对英勇顽强、吃苦耐劳的中国农民充满信心。他深信，经过一定的训练，加上很好的领导，中国军队能与世界上任何军队匹敌。他集中400名美国华裔军人进行通信培训，就是要让他们到中国后，对中美双方人员能作更有效的沟通，达到强兵中国的目的。
c68d673d5fed7a862073f52f2efa586a46f163df.translatedText: Stilwell had many admirable talents. He had been to many places in China and was very fluent in Chinese. Sometimes he wrote diaries in Chinese instead of English. More importantly, he has full confidence in the brave, tenacious, hard-working Chinese farmers. He firmly believes that with certain training and good leadership, the Chinese army can rival any army in the world. He concentrated 400 Chinese-American soldiers for communication training, with the aim of enabling them to communicate more effectively with Chinese and American personnel after arriving in China, so as to achieve the purpose of strengthening China's military.

8fa9f2f3775fefb6707afc704ce53d995b4e1273.sourceText: 移民问答：移民投资的根本性变革 1.请问最近50万投资有任何变化吗? 答:.美国移民局(USCIS)最近宣布将要对于投资移民项目（也就是EB-5项目）的管理进行重大改进，简化项目审理，创造就业机会。国会于1990年创立了EB-5投资移民项目旨在吸引全球投资者和企业家来美国创造就业机会。投资移民(EB-5)项目每年允许10,000个投资移民进入美国，在商业领域进行投资并创造至少10个美国本土就业机会。这些投资移民可以由个人申请或者作为美国移民局指定的区域中心项目成员进行申请,移民局计划对审理EB-5区域中心项目申请作出以下三个方面的根本性变革： 1) 移民局会加快审理那些已经充分设计并可以直接实施的创业项目。移民局还给EB-5投资移民申请人提供了优先快速审理服务(Premium Processing Service)。这项服务收取额外费用，在15个工作日内作出审理决定。 2)移民局将由精通经济分析和投资移民要求的专家组成新的特别小组。投资移民区域中心项目申请人将可以通过电子邮件的方式直接和这些特别小组专家们进行沟通，简化争议的解决，以及快速处理申请人的相关疑问或者需求。 3)移民局将召集一个专家决策董事会，对于投资移民区域项目的申请作出决定。决策董事会将由一个经济学家以及审裁官们组成，并专业律师的协助。 2.我用区域中心50万投资拿到了绿卡,请问我在中国的收入也要报税吗? 答:按照美国税法的要求，绿卡持有者必须披露其在海外持有的公司股份。同时必须申报其海外拥有的金融账户，包括银行账户、投资账户、人寿保险账户以及自己控制的公司的银行账户。很多人取得临时绿卡之后才发现自己需要申报公司和账户。但他们不愿意申报。如果不申报，如果被国税局发现漏报一个公司或者一个账户，会被课以1万美元的罚款，甚至追究刑事责任。取得临时绿卡之后，如果新移民出售国内的房产，就会发现自己就售房的利润在美国缴纳20%的税款。如果在移民之前就做税务安排，可以提前将房产出售，或者过户给家人，就可以避免出一大笔冤枉钱了。不申报人的常见心态是，「美国国税局怎么可以查到我在中国有公司股份呢？」事实上，随着信息技术的发展，国税局的侦查能力也在不断的提高。例如，临时绿卡的持有人都会从自己投资的地区中心收到国税局表格K-1，或者其他类似的报税证明，国税局应该很容易判断一个报税人是一个新的投资移民，从而对其进行重点调查。在取得绿卡之前，投资人常常以商务签证来美国考察。如果某一年度在美国停留时间超过了183天，那么按照美国税法，投资人就变成了美国税法意义上的居民，要和普通美国公民一样纳税。经常来美国的商务出差的人应该记录自己在美天数，从而规避美国税法的管辖。 要注意的是，183天测试是以三年为测试范围的。即当年在美天数，加上去年在美天数的三分之一，再加上前年在美天数的六分之一。如，持多次往返商务签证出入美国，2008年在美120天，2009年在美120天，2010年在美124天，那么2010年他的测试天数为120/6+120/3+124 =184天，变成了一个美国税法居民。 美国居民如果在海外连续工作一年以上，就有可能享受9万美元的免税额。这个免税额只适用于工作收入或者经商所得，不适用于投资收入，即股票投资、利息和买卖房屋的所得等。
8fa9f2f3775fefb6707afc704ce53d995b4e1273.translatedText: Immigration Q&A: Fundamental changes in immigration investment 1. Are there any changes to the recent 500,000 investment? Answer: The United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) recently announced that it will make major improvements to the management of the investment immigration project (also known as the EB-5 project), simplify project review, and create job opportunities. Congress created the EB-5 investment immigration program in 1990 to attract global investors and entrepreneurs to create jobs in the United States. The Investment Immigrant (EB-5) program allows 10,000 investment immigrants to enter the United States each year to invest in business and create at least 10 American jobs. These investment immigrants can apply individually or as members of the regional center project designated by the US Citizenship and Immigration Service. The USCIS plans to make the following three fundamental changes in the processing of EB-5 regional center project applications: 1) The USCIS will speed up the review of entrepreneurial projects that have been fully designed and can be directly implemented. The Immigration Bureau also provides EB-5 investment immigration applicants with priority processing service (Premium Processing Service). There is an additional fee for this service, and a decision is made within 15 working days. 2) The Immigration Bureau will form a new special team composed of experts who are proficient in economic analysis and investment immigration requirements. Applicants for the Investment Immigration Regional Center project will be able to communicate directly with these special team experts via email, simplifying dispute resolution and quickly handling applicants' related questions or needs. 3) The Immigration Bureau will convene an expert decision-making board to make a decision on the application for the investment immigration regional project. The decision-making board will be composed of an economist and adjudicators, assisted by professional lawyers. 2. I used a regional center investment of 500,000 to get a green card. Do I need to file a tax return on my income in China? Answer: According to the requirements of US tax law, green card holders must disclose their overseas company shares. At the same time, they must declare their overseas financial accounts, including bank accounts, investment accounts, life insurance accounts, and bank accounts of companies they control. Many people only find out that they need to declare companies and accounts after obtaining a temporary green card. But they are unwilling to declare. If you fail to declare, if you are found by the IRS to have omitted to report a company or an account, you will be fined $10,000 and may even be held criminally responsible. After obtaining a temporary green card, if a new immigrant sells a home in the country, he or she will find that he or she has to pay 20% tax in the United States on the profit from the sale of the home. If you make tax arrangements before immigrating, you can sell the property in advance or transfer it to a family member, so you can avoid paying a large sum of money. The common mentality of non-filers is, "How can the IRS find out that I have shares in companies in China?" In fact, with the development of information technology, the IRS's investigative capabilities are also constantly improving. For example, temporary green card holders will receive IRS Form K-1 or other similar tax filing certificates from the regional center where they invested. The IRS should easily determine that a tax filer is a new investment immigrant and conduct a focused investigation. Before obtaining a green card, investors often come to the United States for inspection on a business visa. If the investor stays in the United States for more than 183 days in a certain year, then according to U.S. tax law, the investor becomes a resident within the meaning of U.S. tax law and must pay taxes like ordinary U.S. citizens. People who frequently come to the United States for business trips should record the number of days they are in the United States to avoid the jurisdiction of U.S. tax laws. It should be noted that the 183-day test is based on a three-year test range. That is, the number of days in the United States in the current year, plus one-third of the number of days in the United States last year, plus one-sixth of the number of days in the United States in the previous year. For example, if a person enters and leaves the United States with a multiple-entry business visa and stays in the United States for 120 days in 2008, 120 days in 2009, and 124 days in 2010, then the number of test days in 2010 is 120/6+120/3+124 =184 days, and he becomes a U.S. tax resident. U.S. residents who work abroad continuously for more than one year may enjoy a tax exemption of US$90,000. This tax exemption only applies to work income or business income, and does not apply to investment income, that is, stock investment, interest and income from the sale of houses, etc.
