bc7617ce824baf91645855eb2d6a43f87799f4fe.sourceText: 纽约州中餐馆遭遇“内​​忧外患” 业者叹生存难为继 中新网消息：在全美遍地开花的中餐馆是新移民在美国赖以生存的重要行业之一。 但近年来，一片兴旺的中餐业却面临严重的困境。 业主们在经济萧条中苦苦挣扎，在联邦、州执法惩罚力度加强中提心吊胆地经营，许多地方餐馆转让有价无市。 业界人士表示，中餐馆已经走在了十字路口，何去何从是摆在业界人士面前无法绕过的问题。 2008年金融危机爆发至今，经济未见复苏，餐饮业是受到冲击最大的行业之一。 2008年在纽约布鲁克林班森贺地区开日餐馆，顾客以白人为主的李先生表示，金融危机爆发后，生意迅速下降了一半。 曾在布朗士区经营中餐馆的林慈飞说，他当初所在的那个街区有3家中餐外卖店，日前重回旧地看到只剩下一家惨淡经营。 一边是营业额的大幅下降，一边却是食材价格的不断上涨。 李先生说，餐馆用得最多的油，从原先每桶17元涨到36元。 食材的成本以前占成本30%，现在升到40%。 而餐馆涨价只敢两毛五、五毛地涨，根本赶不上原料涨价的速度。 如果营业额下降、食材上涨已让中餐业主疲于应对，那么联邦、州加强对违规雇主的惩罚，更是中餐行业的严重外患。 在纽约的中餐业者对去年10月联邦执法部门联手在长岛、康州等地对中餐馆、职业介绍所清查非法移民雇员行动仍心有余悸。 一名在此次行动中被控罪的业主表示，中餐馆是非法移民在美国赖以生存的重要行业，以往外州检查紧，纽约查得松，很多无证人士就躲在纽约打工。 现在，雇用他们雇主要面临坐牢的风险，虽然有的餐馆还在雇用非法移民，但一直提心吊胆。 纽约州在今年4月生效的《劳资盗窃防止法》，加大对雇主欠薪的惩罚力度，近来，雇员状告雇主的案件不断增加。 律师陈恒表示，这些案例中，有些确实是老板苛扣员工，有些却是雇员恶意提告，但因华人雇主一向忽视遵守劳工法，被告后，在法庭上拿不出工人没有超时工作、 自己没有欠薪的证明材料，即便没有违法，也只能吃哑巴亏。 李先生说，近日他的日餐馆被一名2008年在餐馆做工的西语裔员工以欠薪告上法庭，李先生说：?#25105;们根本没有欠他的薪水，如果欠了，他会几年 后再告吗？他自己也说，是看到一名西语裔律师专门帮人讨薪，不成功不收钱的广告后找上门的。他一来就提出要我们赔2万，这明明 是恶意敲诈。但餐馆没有打卡，我们无法拿出他没有超时工作的证据，只能自认倒霉。 内忧外患中，很多想进入这行的人变得更加小心谨慎，中餐馆转让率大大下降。 李先生说，自己的餐馆3年前就想转让了，可一直到现在，都卖不出去。
bc7617ce824baf91645855eb2d6a43f87799f4fe.translatedText: Chinese restaurants in New York State have encountered "internal and external troubles," and the operators have lamented that it is difficult to survive. China News Service: The Chinese restaurants that are popping up all over the United States are one of the important industries that new immigrants in the United States rely on to survive. However, in recent years, the prosperous Chinese restaurant industry has faced serious difficulties. Owners are struggling in the economic recession and operating on tenterhooks amid intensified federal and state enforcement penalties. Many local restaurants are being transferred at a price but without a market. Industry insiders say that Chinese restaurants are at a crossroads, and where to go is an unavoidable question facing them. Since the financial crisis broke out in 2008, the economy has not recovered, and the catering industry is one of the industries that has been hardest hit. Mr. Li, who opened a Japanese restaurant in the Benson District of Brooklyn, New York, in 2008, and whose customers were mainly white, said that after the financial crisis, his business dropped by half. Lin Cifei, who once ran a Chinese restaurant in the Bronx, said that there were three Chinese takeout restaurants in the neighborhood where he was. Recently, when he returned to the old place, he saw that only one was operating poorly. On the one hand, there is a sharp decline in turnover, and on the other hand, the price of food ingredients continues to rise. Mr. Li said that oil, the most commonly used oil in restaurants, has increased from 17 yuan per barrel to 36 yuan. The cost of ingredients used to account for 30% of the cost, but now it has risen to 40%. However, restaurants only dare to increase prices by 25 cents or 50 cents, which cannot keep up with the price increase of raw materials. If Chinese restaurant owners are struggling to cope with declining sales and rising food ingredients, then the tightening of federal and state penalties on illegal employers will be a serious external threat to the Chinese restaurant industry. Chinese restaurant operators in New York are still frightened by the actions last October by federal law enforcement agencies in Long Island, Connecticut and other places to track down illegal immigrant employees in Chinese restaurants and employment agencies. An owner who was charged in this operation said that Chinese restaurants are an important industry for illegal immigrants to survive in the United States. In the past, inspections in other states were tight, but inspections in New York were loose. Many undocumented people hid in New York to work. Now, employers who hire them face the risk of jail time. Although some restaurants still hire illegal immigrants, they are always on guard. New York State’s Labor Theft Prevention Act, which took effect in April this year, has increased penalties for employers’ unpaid wages. Recently, there has been an increase in the number of cases where employees sue their employers. Lawyer Chen Heng said that in some of these cases, it is true that the bosses severely punished the employees, and in some cases the employees made malicious complaints. However, because the Chinese employers have always neglected to comply with labor laws, after being sued, they could not produce proof in court that the workers did not work overtime and that they were not owed wages. Even if there was no violation of the law, they could only suffer the consequences. Mr. Li said that his Japanese restaurant was recently sued by a Hispanic employee who worked in the restaurant in 2008 for unpaid wages. Mr. Li said: We did not owe him wages at all. If we did, would he sue again in a few years? He himself said that he came to him after seeing an advertisement about a Hispanic lawyer who specializes in helping people ask for wages and does not charge money if he fails. As soon as he arrived, he demanded that we pay 20,000 yuan, which was obviously malicious extortion. But the restaurant didn't clock in, so we couldn't produce evidence that he didn't work overtime, so we could only admit that we were unlucky. Amid internal and external troubles, many people who want to enter the industry have become more cautious, and the transfer rate of Chinese restaurants has dropped significantly. Mr. Li said that he wanted to transfer his restaurant three years ago, but until now, he has been unable to sell it.

3ec3936225cf84d612ddbc744b72117913a98c7b.sourceText: 国家主席胡锦涛昨午在石岗军营，进行一场「天安门式」阅兵仪式，海陆空先进武器尽出，一声声「同志们」震慑港人；值得关注是中央电视台更播放有解放军在中环市区进行「反恐」演练的片段。有军事评论员指出，今次阅兵规格达至省级，除宣示主权，并藉军力结合爱国爱党力量，支持民望低迷政府施政；有评论则指，中央此举只会惹来港人反感及忧虑。 Mitbbs.com 身兼军委会主席的胡锦涛昨午4时许在石岗军营检阅解放军驻港部队，胡站在吉普车上，检阅仪仗队及海陆空军等共3,000多人。阅兵路线全长一公里。候任特首梁振英、候任政务司司长林郑月娥等新班子官员亦有出席，全国政协副主席董建华、多名港区人大代表及政协委员亦在场。 Mitbbs.com 记者现场所见，胡锦涛经过方队时，高喊「同志们好」、「同志们辛苦了」，方队回应「首长好」、「为人民服务」，与北京天安门阅兵同出一辙，将共产党的极权场面带到香港。胡阅兵后，到机务站看望官兵，特首曾荫权在旁陪坐。 Mitbbs.com 另外，央视播放今次阅兵装备，其中有一段解放军在中环进行「反恐搜索」演练的片段，显示驻港部队对香港的防务，也包括了「反恐」任务。 Mitbbs.com 澳门国际军事研究学会研究员黄东指出，今次阅兵等同省级，展示了先进军备武器，在政治意义上，除宣示主权外，藉着强大的军事实力，整合人大、政协委员等爱国爱党力量，支持民望低迷的特区政府施政。在军事层面为驻港部打气，以及向海南邻国宣示实力，「胡今年底喺中共十八大卸任总书记同交出军权，今次咁大阵仗，军方为胡表示『隆重送别』」。时事评论员刘锐绍指出，中央示军威目的打击外国势力介入本港社运，会惹来港人担心。 Mitbbs.com 胡今次是第二次来港阅兵，首次是07年回归10周年在昂船洲，当时只有六个方队约1,900官兵，今次多达3,000人。有分析指09年「十一」大阅兵，胡锦涛被「退而不休」的江泽民抢尽风头，今次大有「显威出气」之嫌。
3ec3936225cf84d612ddbc744b72117913a98c7b.translatedText: President Hu Jintao held a "Tiananmen-style" military parade at Shek Kong Military Camp yesterday afternoon. Advanced weapons from the sea, land and air were displayed, and the words "comrades" shocked Hong Kong people. It is noteworthy that CCTV also broadcast a clip of the People's Liberation Army conducting an "anti-terrorism" drill in the Central District. Some military commentators pointed out that this time the military parade reached the provincial level. In addition to declaring sovereignty, it also used military force to combine patriotism and party strength to support the policies of the government with low popularity. Some commentators said that the central government's move will only arouse resentment and worry among Hong Kong people. Mitbbs.com Hu Jintao, who is also Chairman of the Military Commission, reviewed the People's Liberation Army Hong Kong Garrison at Shigang Military Camp at 4 o'clock yesterday afternoon. Hu stood on a jeep and inspected the guard of honor and the navy, army and air force, a total of more than 3,000 people. The parade route is one kilometer long. Chief Executive-designate Leung Chun-ying, Chief Secretary for Administration-designate Carrie Lam Cheng Yuet-ngor and other new team officials were also present, as were Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference Tung Chee-hwa, a number of Hong Kong National People's Congress deputies and CPPCC members. Mitbbs.com reporters saw at the scene that Hu Jintao shouted "Hello, comrades" and "Comrades for your hard work" as he passed by the formation. The formation responded with "Hello, Chief" and "Serve the people". This was the same as Beijing's Tiananmen military parade, which brought the totalitarian scene of the Communist Party to Hong Kong. After the military parade, Hu went to the maintenance station to visit the officers and soldiers. Chief Executive Donald Tsang sat with him. Mitbbs.com In addition, CCTV broadcast the equipment of this military parade, including a clip of the People's Liberation Army conducting an "anti-terrorism search" drill in Central, showing that the defense of Hong Kong by the Hong Kong Garrison also includes "anti-terrorism" tasks. Mitbbs.com Huang Dong, a researcher at the Macau International Military Studies Association, pointed out that this military parade is equivalent to the provincial level and displays advanced military weapons. In a political sense, in addition to declaring sovereignty, it also uses strong military strength to integrate patriotic and party-loving forces such as members of the National People's Congress and the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference to support the administration of the SAR government, which has low public popularity. At the military level, it encouraged the Ministry of Defense in Hong Kong and declared its strength to Hainan's neighboring countries. "Hu will hand over military power at the end of this year when he steps down as General Secretary at the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China. In this big battle, the military expressed a 'grand farewell' to Hu." Current affairs commentator Liu Ruishuo pointed out that the central government's demonstration of military power to attack foreign forces' interference in Hong Kong's social movements will cause worries among Hong Kong people. Mitbbs.com This is Hu's second military parade in Hong Kong. The first time was on Stonecutters Island in 2007 on the 10th anniversary of the handover. At that time, there were only six formations with about 1,900 officers and soldiers, but this time there are as many as 3,000. Some analysts pointed out that during the National Day military parade in 2009, Hu Jintao was stolen from the limelight by Jiang Zemin, who had "retired without rest". This time, it was suspected of "showing off his power".

91a74f158d7001344d116208fbdf1ce6ca8f882a.sourceText: 2016年1月4日至2016年1月16日 1/4日， 凤凰城经洛杉矶(或旧金山)飞泰国曼谷(Bangkok) 1/6日 ，抵曼谷半日游，夜宿曼谷。 1/7日 ，从曼谷飞普吉岛(Phuket Island)，普吉镇市区观光，下午建议体验世界顶级精油SPA疗程，设施完善进入犹如皇家宫院的Sukkao Cultural Spa & Wellness( www.sukkospa.com)，价格顶级套装120分钟约50～70美元，普通级约20～30美元。晚上赴阿佛洛狄忒人妖表演(Aphrodite Cabaret Show)最新建成开幕，世界级灯光音效舞台，表演溶入欧美，中日韩文化元素，看上去就是女性，性感但不色情，人妖美的让女人都动心，可合照约40泰币(1美元换34泰币)，但人妖抓你手去摸奶，就要收100泰币，座第一排观众要留神，会被请上舞台与人妖艶舞(有许多志愿抢上台)，剧院供应自助餐非常豊富，夜宿普吉岛酒店。 1/8日 ，普吉岛观光，攀牙湾(Ao Phang-Nga National Park)这是世界级景点奇异海景岩石举世少见，007电影曾在此拍摄，海中小岛也被称为007岛，乘座皮划艇在溶洞及岩石中穿梭徜徉在红树林中，一生一次值回票价(船费一天约700至1200泰币)，卡伦海滩，晚上赴宴幻多奇乐园(Phuket FantaSea)具有赌城拉斯维加斯国际灯光効果，是普吉岛主题乐园，以介绍泰国文化为主是普吉岛夜间游乐园代表，内附餐厅，可享生勐海産，夜宿普吉岛酒店。 1/9日，普吉岛观光，皇帝岛(Racha Yai Island)这是泰国最美的海滩，海水清澈见游渔，远处又呈蓝色海洋人间仙境美不胜收，浮潜捉渔一日仅160泰币，当然用手捉不到但乐趣无穷，出海一日约500泰币，若你喜欢夏威夷海滩，那皇帝岛可加10倍美的想象力，除了海水美，渔美，人跟文化也美，是到普吉岛绝不可错过的胜地，下午到芭东海滩(Patong Beach)，晚上逛芭东夜市享生勐海産，在人行徒步区採购小礼物，这里按摩泰弍浴及美容也是人间天堂，夜宿普吉岛酒店。 1/10日，飞曼谷转台北(Taipei)，首赴米淇淋厨艺的晶华酒店 (www.regenttaipei.com)品尝誉享国际、代表台湾的美食，夜宿台北酒店。 1/11日，拜会立法院(台湾政坛运作核心，太阳花学运现场)及政府单位，接受官方午宴招待(可深度交流)。 下午拜会朱立伦竞选总部，蔡英文竞选总部，宋楚瑜竞选总部，鼎泰豊晚宴。 1/12日，赴台中日月潭(Sun Moon Lake)，九族民俗村，体验台湾最美的人与景，夜宿台中。 1/13日，赴高雄(KaoHsiung)，参加台湾南部民主选举造势大会，观光高雄爱河，深入永安区(www.yungan.gov.tw)领先世界的台湾石斑鱼养殖场，享受石斑大餐，夜宿高雄酒店。 1/14日，早起赴嘉义阿里山(Ali Mountain)，乘小火车上山，看神木，云海，站山之巅鸟瞰全台，展望台湾未来何去何从，夜宿嘉义。 1/15日，返台北，参加台湾北部民主选举造势大会，观光台北101大楼等。 1/16日，搭机返美，见証了台湾的世纪总统大选，体验到台湾民主政治的成长过程，也结束了美丽蓝色海洋的普吉岛及台湾独步华人美食世界的知性之旅，今天又回到自己甜密的家。 注，美国护照者，赴泰国，台湾均免签証。中国护照者赴泰国免签，但赴台湾需申请签証。 机票可自购或代购，目前全程往返约1050美元，但11月底应可取得更低价。 全程团费由雄狮及世兴等多家报价中，粗估应在600～800美元内(不含三次特别晚餐，每餐约30至50美元及SPA)。 本团为非商业旅游团，不得营利，收取费用若有结馀全数退回。 本团由旅游达人高志中(报名电话4803639667) 随团服务。报名截止日期2015年11月30日。
91a74f158d7001344d116208fbdf1ce6ca8f882a.translatedText: From January 4, 2016 to January 16, 2016. On 1/4, fly from Phoenix to Bangkok, Thailand via Los Angeles (or San Francisco). On 1/6, arrive in Bangkok for a half-day tour and stay overnight in Bangkok. On January 7th, we flew from Bangkok to Phuket Island and went sightseeing in Phuket Town. In the afternoon, it is recommended to experience the world's top essential oil SPA treatment. The facilities are as complete as a royal palace and enter the Sukkao Cultural Spa & Wellness (www.sukkospa.com). The price is about US$50-70 for the top-level package for 120 minutes, and about US$20-30 for the ordinary level. At night, go to Aphrodite Cabaret Show) was recently completed and opened. It has a world-class light and sound stage. The performance incorporates European, American, Chinese, Japanese and Korean cultural elements. It looks like a woman, sexy but not erotic. Shemale beauty is so beautiful that all women are tempted. You can take a group photo for about 40 Thai dollars (1 US dollar in exchange for it) 34 Thai dollars), but if a ladyboy grabs your hand to touch your breasts, you will be charged 100 Thai dollars. Audiences in the first row should be careful, they will be invited to the stage to dance with the ladyboy (there are many volunteers to get on the stage). The buffet provided by the theater is very rich. Overnight in Phuket hotel. 1/8th, Phuket sightseeing, Ao Phang-Nga National Park) is a world-class scenic spot with rare sea views and rocks. The James Bond movie was filmed here. The small island in the sea is also called 007 Island. You can kayak through the caves and rocks and wander through the mangroves. This is a once in a lifetime value for money (the boat fare is about 700 to 1,200 Thai dollars a day), Karon Beach, and dinner at Phuket in the evening. FantaSea) is a theme park in Phuket with the international lighting effects of Las Vegas. It mainly introduces Thai culture and is a representative night amusement park in Phuket. It has a restaurant inside, where you can enjoy fresh seafood and stay overnight in a Phuket hotel. Day 1/9, Phuket sightseeing, Racha Yai Island) This is the most beautiful beach in Thailand. The water is crystal clear, and the blue ocean in the distance is so beautiful. Snorkeling and catching fish only costs 160 Thai dollars for a day. Of course, you can’t catch it with your hands, but it is endless fun. Going out to sea for about 500 Thai dollars a day. If you like Hawaiian beaches, then Emperor Island can add 10 times the beauty of your imagination. In addition to beautiful sea water, beautiful fisheries, and beautiful people and culture, it is a must-see attraction in Phuket. In the afternoon, go to Patong Beach Beach), visit Patong Night Market in the evening to enjoy fresh seafood, and purchase small gifts in the pedestrian area. Massage, Thai bath and beauty treatment here are also paradise on earth. Overnight in Phuket hotel. On January 10th, we flew to Bangkok and transferred to Taipei (Taipei). We first went to the Regent Hotel (www.regenttaipei.com), where the rice cookers are famous, to taste the internationally renowned and representative Taiwanese food, and stayed overnight in the Taipei hotel. On January 11, we visited the Legislative Yuan (the center of Taiwan’s political operations and the site of the Sunflower Student Movement) and government units, and received an official luncheon (allowing for in-depth exchanges). In the afternoon, we visited Zhu Lilun’s campaign headquarters, Tsai Ing-wen’s campaign headquarters, James Soong’s campaign headquarters, and Ding Tai Feng dinner. On January 12th, we went to Taichung Sun Moon Lake (Sun Moon Lake) and Formosan Folk Village to experience the most beautiful people and scenery in Taiwan. We stayed overnight in Taichung. On January 13th, we went to Kaohsiung (KaoHsiung) to participate in the democratic election rally in southern Taiwan, visit the Kaohsiung Love River, go deep into the world-leading Taiwanese grouper farm in Yongan District (www.yungan.gov.tw), enjoy a grouper dinner, and stay overnight in a Kaohsiung hotel. On January 14th, I got up early and went to Ali Mountain in Chiayi. I took a small train up the mountain to see the sacred trees and the sea of ​​clouds. I stood on the top of the mountain and had a bird's eye view of Taiwan. I looked forward to where Taiwan will go in the future. Overnight in Chiayi. On January 15th, we returned to Taipei to participate in the democratic election rally in northern Taiwan, visit the Taipei 101 building, etc. On January 16th, I took a flight back to the United States, witnessed Taiwan’s presidential election of the century, experienced the growth process of Taiwan’s democratic politics, and ended my intellectual journey to the beautiful blue ocean of Phuket and Taiwan’s unique Chinese food world. Today I returned to my sweet home. Note: US passport holders are visa-free when traveling to Thailand and Taiwan. Chinese passport holders are exempt from visa requirements when traveling to Thailand, but they need to apply for a visa when traveling to Taiwan. The full tour fee was quoted by Lion and Shixing, etc., and the rough estimate should be between 600 and 800 US dollars (excluding three special dinners, each meal is about 30 to 50 US dollars, and SPA). This group is a non-commercial tour group and is not allowed to make a profit. Any remaining balance of the collected fees will be fully refunded. This group is provided by travel expert Gao Zhizhong (registration phone: 4803639667). The deadline for registration is November 30, 2015.

ee6dbf076e353137937a9ffaef47867ad3f466d8.sourceText: 靠退休金收入生活的耆老，必须精打细算过日子，避免健康状况有问题时影响财务。 美联社采访个人理财专家，为银发退休族在新的一年改善财务提供如下建议： 一、制订预算。 如果不设定预算，即使觉得已够节衣缩食，但仍可能入不敷出，具体的财务预算应包括每月的开支和预计从储蓄帐户提款额度。 非营利机构CFA机构投资教育总监Bob Stammers表示：「开销和投资目标越具体，越有可能实现财务稳定。」 二、还清债务。 退休族若「滥用刷卡自由」，难免导致信用卡债台高筑，纽约财务规画师Michael Kresh建议，退休族可动用定期存款或灵活投资帐户资金，偿还信用卡债，因为存款利息和投资回报通常远低于信用卡利息 。 在还清卡债后，退休族平常最好使用一张信用卡，并每月还清卡债。 三、投资分红股。 据Bankrate.com数据，目前储蓄帐户利息平均不到1%，五年期定存利息最高1.95%，10年期国债孳息约2%。 相比之下，付股息的蓝筹股可提供稳定的分红，长远来看股价上涨可带来较高回报。 标普资深分析师Howard Silverblatt说，2011年付股息股票平均回报为2.1%，而通用电气(GE)、辉瑞制药等蓝筹股则回报率在4%左右。 四、订立遗嘱。 根据新的税法核对和修改遗嘱和财务文件，遗嘱文件应包括遗嘱(will)、生前遗嘱(living will)、永久授权书(durable power of attorney)、医疗委托(health-care proxy)等，同时可 在全美个人财务顾问协会网站(http://findanadvisor.napfa.org/Home.aspx)搜寻可靠的财务规画师。 五、慈善捐赠。 在不影响税率的前提下，退休族每年最多可捐赠晚辈1万3000元，佛州迈阿密信托律师Michael Dribin建议，老人们可购买慈善捐赠年金(charitable gift annuity)，不但可捐助大型慈善机构，同时 可获得终生定期回报。 六、购买保险。 据全美长期护理保险协会(American Association for Long-Term Care Insurance)数据，约五分之一购买长期护理保险者年龄超过65岁，但越早购买保费越低，65岁的夫妇购买长期护理保险 每年约需4000元，但70岁后才购买保费翻倍。 七、健身强体。 纽约Montefiore医疗中心老年人医师Amy Ehrlich说，老年人应多活动筋骨，走路、游泳或水中有氧运动都有助增强活力，益智游戏、阅读以及在学校、社团做义工，则利于保持脑力和 心理健康。
ee6dbf076e353137937a9ffaef47867ad3f466d8.translatedText: Elderly people who rely on pension income must live a careful life to avoid financial problems if their health problems arise. The Associated Press interviewed personal finance experts and provided the following suggestions for senior retirees to improve their finances in the new year: 1. Develop a budget. If you don't set a budget, you may still be unable to make ends meet even if you think you've saved enough. A specific financial budget should include your monthly expenses and expected withdrawals from your savings account. Bob Stammers, director of institutional investment education at the nonprofit CFA, said: "The more specific your spending and investment goals are, the more likely you are to achieve financial stability." 2. Pay off debt. If retirees "abuse the freedom to swipe their cards", they will inevitably lead to high credit card debt. New York financial planner Michael Kresh suggests that retirees can use time deposits or flexible investment account funds to repay credit card debt, because deposit interest and investment returns are usually much lower than credit card interest. After paying off the card debt, retirees are usually best to use a credit card and pay off the card debt every month. 3. Invest in dividend stocks. According to data from Bankrate.com, the current average interest rate on savings accounts is less than 1%, the highest interest rate on five-year time deposits is 1.95%, and the interest rate on 10-year Treasury bonds is about 2%. In contrast, dividend-paying blue-chip stocks can provide stable dividends and higher returns over the long term from rising share prices. S&P senior analyst Howard Silverblatt said the average return on dividend stocks in 2011 was 2.1%, while blue-chip stocks such as General Electric (GE) and Pfizer Pharmaceuticals returned about 4%. 4. Make a will. Check and modify wills and financial documents in accordance with the new tax laws. Wills and documents should include a will, a living will, a durable power of attorney, a health-care proxy, etc. You can also search for a reliable financial planner on the National Association of Personal Financial Advisors website (http://findanadvisor.napfa.org/Home.aspx). 5. Charitable donations. Without affecting the tax rate, retirees can donate up to $13,000 to their juniors each year. Michael Dribin, a trust lawyer in Miami, Florida, suggests that seniors can purchase a charitable gift annuity. Not only can they donate to large charities, but they can also receive regular returns throughout their lives. 6. Purchase insurance. According to data from the American Association for Long-Term Care Insurance, about one-fifth of those who buy long-term care insurance are over the age of 65, but the earlier they buy, the lower the premium. For a 65-year-old couple, buying long-term care insurance costs about 4,000 yuan per year, but the premium doubles if you buy it after the age of 70. 7. Keep fit and strong. Amy Ehrlich, a geriatrician at Montefiore Medical Center in New York, said that older people should move their muscles more. Walking, swimming or water aerobics can help increase their vitality. Educational games, reading, and volunteering in schools and clubs can help maintain brain power and mental health.

91001c28f2bcb005973193aaedb1751fc7c6ad21.sourceText: 州長訪問中國進行招商引資 州長辦公室亞太裔顧問委員會在主席鄧朝駒召集下，於九月六日在州長辦公室舉行2011年第四季會議。亞裔社區計有：越南、日本、韓國、菲律賓、印度、新加坡及華裔代表鄧朝駒、高志中、陶世誠等人參加。州長Jan Brewer率商業局主管Fernando Jimenez與Hank Marshall出席。 州長在會中表示州政府的施政理念是”小政府大經濟”。在她任內將全力發展經濟與促進國際貿易。州長在會中宣佈將於9月14日至9月24日率領商業訪問團赴中國進行招商引貿交流活動。陶世誠代表本地華人對州長的訪華行程表示熱烈歡迎。目前中國是本州第三大貿易國，僅次於墨西哥與加拿大，與中國雙邊貿易額每年近十億美元。（高志中来稿）
91001c28f2bcb005973193aaedb1751fc7c6ad21.translatedText: The Governor visited China to attract investment. The Asian and Pacific Islander Advisory Committee of the Governor's Office held its fourth quarter meeting of 2011 on September 6 in the Governor's Office, convened by Chairman Deng Chaoju. The Asian community includes Vietnamese, Japanese, Korean, Filipino, Indian, Singaporean and Chinese representatives including Deng Chaoju, Gao Zhizhong, Tao Shicheng and others. Governor Jan Brewer and Bureau of Commerce Directors Fernando Jimenez and Hank Marshall attended. During the meeting, the governor stated that the state government’s policy philosophy is “small government, big economy”. During her tenure, she will make every effort to develop the economy and promote international trade. During the meeting, the governor announced that he would lead a business delegation to China from September 14th to September 24th to conduct investment promotion and trade exchange activities. On behalf of the local Chinese community, Tao Shicheng extended a warm welcome to the governor's visit to China. Currently, China is the state's third largest trading country, second only to Mexico and Canada, and the bilateral trade volume with China is nearly one billion US dollars per year. (Contributed by Gao Zhizhong)

c320d1dd196f624ddbb604a3cc45fb056ecf2e5f.sourceText: （编者语）在某个时间，某个空间，我们在这里，美国亚利桑那州，有的人留下来了，有的人海归了，在时间和空间的交界点中，有很多分秒组成的故事，在太阳鸟亚省华人网中，我们看到张肇鸿，气如虹，文若，慧明，凤鸣，心水等很多老侨用文字记录他们的生活，首先感谢他们的记录，让我们看到了一代移民的成长足迹。在凤凰城还有一些在高科技区忙碌的新移民，以及来学习的留学生，他们带着７０后，８０后，９０后的华裔的气息，来到这里，他们面对的人生变化和选择，正在发生。”太阳鸟亚省华人网”希望能记录下这些，调动采访力量来记录这个时间和空间里的故事。如果你身边有有意思的人，或者有意思的故事，请与我们联系，一起分享《太阳鸟纪事》。
c320d1dd196f624ddbb604a3cc45fb056ecf2e5f.translatedText: (Editor's note) At a certain time, in a certain space, we are here, Arizona, USA. Some people have stayed, and some have returned from overseas. In time At the intersection of space and space, there are many stories composed of minutes and seconds. In the Sunbird Asia Chinese Network, we see Zhang Zhaohong, Qi Ruhong, Wen Ruo, Huiming, Fengming, Xinshui and many other old overseas Chinese recording their lives in words. First of all, we would like to thank them for their records, which allow us to see the growth footprint of a generation of immigrants. In Phoenix, there are also some new immigrants who are busy in the high-tech district, as well as international students who come to study. They come here with the aura of Chinese people born in the 1970s, 1980s, and 1990s. The life changes and choices they face are happening now. "Sunbird Asia Chinese Network" hopes to record these and mobilize the power of interviews to record the stories in this time and space. If you have interesting people or interesting stories around you, please contact us and share "Sunbird Chronicles" together.

51906ca0ed604b6eb6e58684841b43efa56085f6.sourceText: （亚省时报 谢成彦报道） 5 月 5 日， 由加州大学洛杉矶分校孔子学院和中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆协同主办西南地区的” 汉语桥” 选拔赛 ，在加州大学洛杉矶分校 Popper 剧院 顺利闭幕。代表亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院的 丹强尼 （ Jonny Dangerfield ）和 马麟 （ Zach Marin ）荣获了第一名和第二名的佳绩。丹强尼表演的单口相声《哭笑不得》让所有的来宾笑得前俯后仰。中国驻洛杉矶教育部领事负责人陈准民领事, 教育部领事许翠英都表示对亚利桑那州立大学孔子学院的选手给他们留下的印象非常深刻。
51906ca0ed604b6eb6e58684841b43efa56085f6.translatedText: (Reported by Chengyan Xie of the Alberta Times) On May 5, the “Chinese Bridge” audition competition in the southwest region, co-sponsored by the Confucius Institute at UCLA and the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles, concluded successfully at the Popper Theater at UCLA. Jonny Dangerfield and Zach Marin, representing the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University, won first and second place. Dan Johnny performed a stand-up comedy called "Laughing and Crying" that made all the guests laugh out loud. Consul Chen Zhunmin, head of the Chinese Consulate of the Ministry of Education in Los Angeles, and Xu Cuiying, consul of the Ministry of Education, both expressed that they were very impressed by the contestants from the Confucius Institute at Arizona State University.

a5815027326638922e00cd84a44e31ae9aec19f9.sourceText: 丹强尼说当他第一次看”汉语桥”以前的节目时，他就心跳就”嘭 嘭 嘭”加速，他觉得自己这一辈子就在等待这个时刻：走上舞台，给大家带来欢乐。他非常享受这种感觉。当问到在整个比赛中是不是紧张，他说有一点：”刚开始的一分钟的时间里，我有点紧张，后来就觉得特别享受，特别是看到大家哈哈大笑，我就知道自己做到了，达到了我的目标。”记者问丹强尼当知道自己获得了比赛的第一名是不是最高兴的时刻，他说”知道自己得了第一当然非常高兴，但是不如站在舞台上给大家带来快乐的那一个时刻，那才是我的原动力！”
a5815027326638922e00cd84a44e31ae9aec19f9.translatedText: Dan Johnny said that when he first watched the previous program of "Chinese Bridge", his heart beat "bang bang." Bang" accelerated, and he felt that he had been waiting for this moment his whole life: to step onto the stage and bring joy to everyone. He enjoyed this feeling very much. When asked if he was nervous during the entire competition, he said one thing: "I was a little nervous for the first minute, but then I felt very enjoyable, especially when I saw everyone laughing. I knew I had done it and achieved my goal." The reporter asked Dan Johnny if it was the happiest moment when he knew he won the first place in the competition. , he said, "Of course I am very happy to know that I won the first place, but it is not as good as standing on the stage and bringing happiness to everyone. That is my driving force!"

d6507c645cc0bdc6cb1951a08efcc59077acb6f7.sourceText: 丹强尼大约从两年前开始学习中文，印象最深的就是他参加了孔子学院和四川大学的交换培训。在四川大学生活学习了两个月，”那时候，交换生都喜欢到外面餐厅吃饭，可是我喜欢在食堂吃饭，因为食堂的菜也很好，更重要的是可以跟当地的同学聊天，我就会问他们挂在墙上的中国字是什么，然后注音，写下来。学习中文就像同时学习三门外语，例如声调，中文字符，还有拼音，都是完全独立的，我也学过西班牙文，没有这么难。”在四川的时候，他就听过相声，看到所有的同学看着”两个人说话”，现场就爆发出哄堂大笑，当时他听不懂，也不知道是什么。后来学习了中文，看了”大山”的单口相声，他就决定在孔子课堂的春节活动中也表演一下，没想到非常成功，全场的人都笑翻了，后来他就迷上了相声这门艺术。当被问及学好中文有什么窍门吗？丹强尼说：”当然有，在决定学中文最开始的两个月，他就开始主动认识中国朋友，和他们在一起玩，认识他们的朋友。”他说这样可以很快了解他们的文化，也可以迅速提高中文水平。说到”坚持”这个事情，丹强尼说，学习一个新的语言，经常会很苦恼和失望，觉得进展不快，可是一想到身边的这些通过中文认识的朋友，就觉得非常值得。
d6507c645cc0bdc6cb1951a08efcc59077acb6f7.translatedText: Dan Johnny started learning Chinese about two years ago. What impressed me most was that he participated in the exchange training between the Confucius Institute and Sichuan University. I lived and studied at Sichuan University for two months. "At that time, all the exchange students liked to eat out in restaurants, but I liked to eat in the cafeteria because the food in the cafeteria was also very good. More importantly, I could chat with local classmates. I would ask them what the Chinese characters hanging on the wall were, and then notate them and write them down. Learning Chinese is like a fellow student I learned three foreign languages at the same time, such as tones, Chinese characters, and pinyin, which are all completely independent. I also learned Spanish, and it was not that difficult. "When he was in Sichuan, he heard cross talk, and when he saw all the classmates watching "two people talking," the whole room burst into laughter. At the time, he didn't understand it and didn't know what it was. Later, after learning Chinese and watching the stand-up comedy "Da Shan", he decided to perform it in the Spring Festival activities of the Confucius Classroom. Unexpectedly, it was very successful and everyone in the audience laughed. Later, he became obsessed with the art of cross talk. When asked, do you have any tips for learning Chinese well? Dan Johnny said: "Of course there is. In the first two months when he decided to learn Chinese, he began to take the initiative to meet Chinese friends, play with them, and get to know their friends." He said that this way he could quickly understand their culture and improve his Chinese level quickly. When it comes to "persistence", Dan Johnny said that when learning a new language, he is often very distressed and disappointed, and feels that the progress is not fast, but when he thinks of the friends around him who have met through Chinese, he feels that it is very worthwhile.

9252ad478e6bd425a8864ca63f4add9d72410a21.sourceText: 丹强尼说他很享受用中文讲相声的感觉，那就是他希望做的，现在他正在准备下一论的比赛，希望能到中国参加总决赛，实现他的中文相声梦.
9252ad478e6bd425a8864ca63f4add9d72410a21.translatedText: Dan Johnny said that he enjoys speaking cross talk in Chinese, and that is what he hopes to do. Now he is preparing for the next competition, hoping to go to China to participate in the finals and realize his Chinese cross talk dream.

3bdbd29bc540df8d3821e6639a8b4a27baccea21.sourceText: 凤凰城凤鸣：懵懵懂懂踏入社会 结束四年技术专业学校的学习和生活，走出校门懵懵懂懂地踏入社会。我与四位同学，被分配到省机械厅人事处待分配。那一日我随同学一起去报道，有同学拿着介绍信，我只是有心无意地一同前往，对於分配到何地工作，并没有特别要求，抱着服从分配的思想，到哪儿工作都一样，并没有考虑到社会上的复杂和艰辛。 省机械厅座落在大明湖畔，串过大街走过小巷，来到一个水面开阔的大明湖南岸，左边是省图书馆，右面是我要去报道的省机械厅。省机械厅座北朝南，面向大明湖北岸，站在机关门前向南望去，是一片非常开阔的湖面，历下亭就在湖中央亭亭玉立，真是一个工作、生活的好环境。我们一行五人拿着介绍信到人事处，人事处的赵处长亲自接待我们，给我们讲了要服从分配的大道理，可能以德州、惠民、聊城三个专区的下属机械厂为目标，让我们回去等消息。当时我表态服从分配，到哪儿工作都行，只提出在等分配期间去部队探亲，处长同意了我的请求。回家向父亲讲：〝我可能要去外地县城工作，在等消息期间，处长同意我先去探亲，回来以后再去报道上班。〞父亲为我准备好一个漂亮的行李箱。 万万没想到的是，在我探亲的半个月期间，四位同学分别被分配到县城农机修配厂工作。探亲回来再去省厅人事处时，赵处长告诉我：”你被留在机械厅农机修配处工作，我这就带你去修配处见你们刘处长”。我简直不敢相信自己的耳朵，怎么会有这么好的结果，是因为我表态服从分配？还是因为我是军人家属（我先生在毕业前夕参了军），这是一万种可能以外的结果，我和赵处长素不相识，那时更不懂得托关系走后门，就是上班以后也没有上门答谢。后来不久听说，赵处长报名参加支援西藏建设，带领全家踏上了去西藏的路程，他是我参加工作以来，遇到的最值得敬佩的领导。 第一天上班，对厅、局机关没有任何观念，听说是〝农业机诫修配处〞，依为也就是个修理农业机械的地方。我穿了在工厂实习时的工装服去上班，处长和同事们一见我的穿着打扮都笑了，我更是很尴尬。处长先和我谈活，说明了农机修配处的工作内容，是掌管全省农业机械厂和农业机械维修站的工作，有时会下到基层农机厂和维修站指导工作，解决问题，至此我才明白了我的工作任务。我主管那时全省九个地区，五个县级市、及107个县的农机修配厂和农机维修站的农机维修工作。每旬一次电话联系，书写工作旬报，上报中央八机部农机司，有一些同事只在电话上联系工作，几年下来也未见其人。这种酷燥乏味的工作，让我一个二十岁出头，好高骛远的年青人做，实在是一种折磨，一心想去工厂做设计工作，可又不知道应怎样改变现状。 在中国1961年是三年自然灾害中的一年，分配在机械厅工作唯一的好处，是不用离开家，机关还能经常发一些农付产品（下属企业送给上级主管的贡品），正好弥补灾荒年粮食不足的问题，一家人逃脱了挨饿得水肿的危险，父母亲很高兴，我能有这样一份体面的好工作，不用离开家到外地工作，又可照顾家中年老的父母，哥哥姐姐都已成家单过，我成了唯一留在家中的孩子，照顾年老的父母亲也是我的责任。二十世纪六十年代的年青人，不懂人情事故，我在神的保佑下，懵懵懂懂地踏入社会，开始了我八年的省级机关的机关干部的工作和生活，套用現在的时尚用语，就是国家公务员。
3bdbd29bc540df8d3821e6639a8b4a27baccea21.translatedText: Fengming of Phoenix City: Entering the society ignorantly. After four years of studying and living in a technical vocational school, I walked out of school and entered the society ignorantly. Four classmates and I were assigned to the Human Resources Department of the Provincial Machinery Department to be assigned. That day, I went to report with my classmates. One of the classmates took a letter of introduction. I just went with him intentionally or unintentionally. I had no special requirements for where I was assigned to work. I had the idea of ​​obeying the assignment and the work would be the same wherever I went. I did not take into account the complexity and hardship in society. The Provincial Machinery Department is located on the bank of Daming Lake. Walking through the streets and alleys, you come to the south bank of Daming Lake with open water. On the left is the Provincial Library, and on the right is the Provincial Machinery Department where I want to report. The Provincial Machinery Department faces south, facing the north bank of Daming Lake. Standing in front of the agency door and looking south, you can see a very open lake. Lixia Pavilion stands tall and graceful in the middle of the lake. It is really a good environment for working and living. A group of five of us took our letters of introduction to the Human Resources Department. Director Zhao of the Human Resources Department personally received us and told us the principle of obeying the distribution. We might target the subordinate machinery factories in the three districts of Dezhou, Huimin, and Liaocheng, and asked us to go back and wait for news. At that time, I stated that I would obey the assignment and work anywhere. I only proposed to visit relatives in the army while waiting for the assignment, and the director agreed to my request. I went home and told my father, "I may be going to another county to work. While I'm waiting for news, the director agreed that I should visit my relatives first and report to work when I get back." My father prepared a beautiful suitcase for me. What I never expected was that during my half-month visit to relatives, four classmates were assigned to work in the county agricultural machinery repair factory. When I returned from visiting relatives and went to the Human Resources Department of the Provincial Department, Director Zhao told me: "You have been left to work in the Agricultural Machinery Repair Department of the Machinery Department. I will take you to the repair department to meet your Director Liu." I couldn't believe my ears. How could there be such a good result? Was it because I said I obeyed the assignment? Or because I am a military family member (my husband joined the army on the eve of graduation), this is a result beyond 10,000 possibilities. Director Zhao and I have never met each other. At that time, we did not know how to rely on relationships and go through the back door. Even after going to work, I did not come to thank you. Soon after, I heard that Director Zhao signed up to support the construction of Tibet and led his family on the journey to Tibet. He is the most admirable leader I have encountered since I started working. On my first day at work, I had no idea about the department or bureau. I heard it was the "Agricultural Machinery Repair Department," and I thought it was just a place to repair agricultural machinery. I wore the overalls I wore during my internship at the factory to work. The director and colleagues all laughed when they saw my attire, and I was even more embarrassed. The director first talked to me about the work and explained the work content of the Agricultural Machinery Repair and Repair Department, which is in charge of the work of agricultural machinery factories and agricultural machinery maintenance stations across the province. Sometimes it goes down to grassroots agricultural machinery factories and maintenance stations to guide work and solve problems. Only then did I understand my work tasks. I was in charge of agricultural machinery maintenance work in agricultural machinery repair factories and agricultural machinery maintenance stations in nine regions, five county-level cities, and 107 counties in the province at that time. We have phone calls every ten days, write ten-day work reports, and report them to the Agricultural Machinery Department of the Eighth Machinery Department of the Central Committee. Some colleagues only contact work on the phone and have not seen them for several years. This kind of cool and boring job is really a kind of torture for me, a young man in his early twenties who is very ambitious and wants to go to a factory to do design work, but I don't know how to change the current situation. In China, 1961 was one of the three years of natural disasters. The only advantage of being assigned to work in the Machinery Department was that you did not have to leave home, and the agency could often distribute some agricultural products (tributes sent to superior supervisors by subordinate companies), which just made up for the shortage of food in the famine years. The family escaped. My parents were very happy because I could have such a good and decent job. I didn't have to leave home to work in other places, and I could take care of my elderly parents at home. My brothers and sisters were all married and single, so I became the only child staying at home. It was also my responsibility to take care of my elderly parents. Young people in the 1960s did not understand human affairs. With the blessing of God, I entered society ignorantly and began my eight years of work and life as a provincial cadre. To use the current fashionable terminology, I am a national civil servant.

06da8bd0850eb58674451c904643dfc29d288b35.sourceText: 有细心的网民12月6日将2010年和2011年3月份5、6、10、13、14和15日的《人民日报》经过对比，发现从版面、所报事件、人物姿势、讲话内容等几乎完全一致，有的仅差一个字或一分钟。有网民惊呼：太创新、太稳定了，应评为2011年最强新闻。 天涯论坛名为 Kevin Towne的网友12月6日发表一帧图片和短文”两年同一天的人民日报，绝对吓你一跳。”Kevin Towne在文中表示：”友人送来一个网页，’两年前同一天的人民日报’，仔细看过才相信，这不是恶作剧，也不是PS。官僚体制下，不必再谈什么创新了，也不必再谈什么文化事业了。”
06da8bd0850eb58674451c904643dfc29d288b35.translatedText: Careful netizens will mark 2010 on December 6th... After comparison with the People's Daily on March 5, 6, 10, 13, 14 and 15 of March 2011, it was found that the layout, reported events, character postures, speech content, etc. are almost identical, with some differences of only one word or one minute. Some netizens exclaimed: It is so innovative and stable that it should be rated as the strongest news in 2011. A netizen named Kevin Towne on the Tianya Forum published a picture and short article on December 6, "The People's Daily published on the same day two years ago will definitely shock you." Kevin Towne said in the article: "A friend sent me a webpage, 'People's Daily' on the same day two years ago. After reading it carefully, I believed that it was not a prank or PS. Under the bureaucracy, there is no need to talk about innovation or cultural undertakings."

4f635a66779e522c33ee2c25b2d6cae2523d3299.sourceText: 有网友评论称，《人民日报》太稳定了，两年同一天所报导的大会内容居然没有变化。唯一不同的是，大会闭幕的时间2011年的比2010年早了1分钟。 该帖一经发表，立即引起许多网民的兴趣，一天之内，点击量超过18万。有网友讽刺称，我们国家的文化”复兴”有望了，这就是我们国家文化大发展的最重要标志？ 网友”春花秋月怨风流”说：太讽刺了，不得不说这是2011年度最幽默的趣闻，我仔细看了，居然跟电子版一样，绝对一模一样，非PS。这就是最高级别的党的喉舌。太滑稽了，无法形容。 网友”翩翩孤舟”讽刺道：版面一样还算正常。牛逼的是内容也基本可以做到一致，包括领导接见的姿势，这正说明了以”不变应万变、止步不前、天下无敌。” 网友”发条柚”忧心地表示：很久没看过《新闻联播》了，不过家里老人在看，所以动不动耳边就传来”中华民族的伟大复兴”！炎黄子孙都快给搞没了，还复兴？靠老头老太太复兴？
4f635a66779e522c33ee2c25b2d6cae2523d3299.translatedText: Some netizens commented that the "People's Daily" is too stable, and the content of the conference reported on the same day two years has not changed. The only difference is that the closing time of the conference was 1 minute earlier in 2011 than in 2010. As soon as the post was published, it immediately aroused the interest of many netizens. Within one day, it received more than 180,000 views. Some netizens sarcastically said that our country's cultural "revival" is expected. Is this the most important sign of our country's cultural development? Netizen "Chunhua Qiuyue Resentful Romance" said: It's so ironic. I have to say this is the most humorous anecdote in 2011. I looked carefully and found that it is the same as the electronic version. It is absolutely the same, not PS. This is the mouthpiece of the party at the highest level. It's too funny to describe. Netizen "Pianpian Guzhou" sarcastically said: The layout is still normal. The cool thing is that the content is basically the same, including the attitude of the leaders when they receive the interview. This just shows that "one should remain unchanged to adapt to changes, stand still and be invincible in the world." Netizen "Clockwork You" expressed worriedly: I haven't watched "Xinwen Lianbo" for a long time, but the elderly at home are watching, so I hear "the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation" in my ears every time! The descendants of Yan and Huang were almost wiped out, but they are still recovering? Relying on old men and old ladies to revive?

24b92dfe8d32d223b991ac195582806a5831d438.sourceText: 《人民日报》2011年3月15日的报导内容：

d1817f9ffcc704f34c641a1031824e0816798f21.sourceText: 新华社北京3月14日电 第十一届全国人民代表大会第四次会议在批准政府工作报告、”十二五”规划纲要、全国人大常委会工作报告及其他报告，圆满完成各项议程后，14日上午在人民大会堂闭幕。 今天的人民大会堂气氛庄重热烈。2882名代表出席闭幕会，符合法定人数。 闭幕会由大会主席团常务主席、执行主席、全国人大常委会委员长吴邦国主持。 胡锦涛、温家宝、贾庆林、李长春、习近平、李克强、贺国强、周永康等和大会主席团成员在主席台就座。 大会主席团常务主席、执行主席王兆国、路甬祥、乌云其木格、韩启德、华建敏、陈至立、周铁农、李建国、司马义?铁力瓦尔地、蒋树声、陈昌智、严隽琪、桑国卫等在执行主席席就座。 上午9时，吴邦国宣布会议开始。 ….. 上午9时27分，全场起立，高唱国歌。吴邦国宣布：第十一届全国人民代表大会第四次会议胜利闭幕。
d1817f9ffcc704f34c641a1031824e0816798f21.translatedText: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, March 14 The fourth session of the 11th National People's Congress closed at the Great Hall of the People on the morning of the 14th after approving the government work report, the "Twelfth Five-Year Plan" outline, the National People's Congress Standing Committee work report and other reports, and successfully completing various agendas. The atmosphere in the Great Hall of the People today was solemn and warm. 2,882 representatives attended the closing meeting, meeting the quorum. The closing meeting was chaired by Wu Bangguo, executive chairman of the presidium of the conference, executive chairman and chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. Hu Jintao, Wen Jiabao, Jia Qinglin, Li Changchun, Xi Jinping, Li Keqiang, He Guoqiang, Zhou Yongkang and other members of the presidium of the conference took their seats on the rostrum. The executive chairman of the presidium and executive chairman of the conference Wang Zhaoguo, Lu Yongxiang, Wu Yunqimuge, Han Qide, Hua Jianmin, Chen Zhili, Zhou Tienong, Li Jianguo, Sima Yi Tieli Waldi, Jiang Shusheng, Chen Changzhi, Yan Junqi, Sang Guowei and others were seated at the executive chairman's seat. At 9 a.m., Wu Bangguo announced the start of the meeting. ….. At 9:27 a.m., everyone stood up and sang the national anthem. Wu Bangguo announced: The fourth session of the 11th National People's Congress concluded successfully.

564eb30002a82335b9bf29704ca68c80122e1793.sourceText: 戒 暗夜裏，靈魂與理智作鬥爭，理智揮舞著一把長戈，將心底的欲望之草、情感之苗，一一戧割，便是戒。 人非聖賢，貪念之心時時探頭。那些欲望之苗在心田裏蠢蠢欲動，拔節生長。那株長勢良好的叫名譽草，它高傲地微揚著頭，理直氣壯地傲視著其他的幾株；那株枝葉粗壯的叫利益草，它儼然有功之臣地占著一席之地。那株分外妖嬈的，卻象藤蔓般，葡伏在地，羞於見人，欲抱琵琶半遮面的樣子，這便是傳說中的情感之草吧？凡塵紛擾，它也不甘寂寞地前來湊熱鬧。這些草們挨挨擠擠地，彼此不讓步，一幅要長成參天大樹的樣子。雜草紛長，人便徒生痛苦，暗夜裏，理智便與靈魂做著鬥爭。 人始終繞不過去的，從來都是自己吧？心總是在有了貪念之後，才會痛苦，才會不滿足，才會不自信。所謂得寸進尺，得朧望蜀。 所以，人終其一生，不過是自我鬥爭。
564eb30002a82335b9bf29704ca68c80122e1793.translatedText: Quiet In the dark night, the soul fights with reason. Reason wields a long sword and cuts off the grass of desire and the seedlings of emotion in the heart one by one, which is quit. No one is a sage, and greed is always on his mind. Those seeds of desire are ready to stir and grow in my heart. The one that is growing well is called the honorary grass. It raises its head slightly and proudly, looking down at the other plants with confidence. The one with thick branches and leaves is called the benefit grass, and it occupies its place as if it is a meritorious official. That one is particularly enchanting, but like a vine, it lies on the ground, shy to see people, half-hiding its face as if it were holding a pipa. Is this the legendary grass of emotion? Even in the chaos of the world, it comes to join in the fun. These grasses are crowded together, refusing to give in to each other, and they look like they will grow into towering trees. When weeds grow, people suffer in vain. In the dark night, reason fights with the soul. What people can't get around is always themselves, right? It is only after the heart has greed that it becomes painful, dissatisfied, and unconfident. The so-called extravagance means getting a hazy look at Shu. Therefore, a person's whole life is nothing but self-struggle.

0cd6f88650c9743ed68a8bee0c3cfdc8686b89d8.sourceText: 聲 以耳傾聽，自然界的鳴鍾振玉之聲，絲竹之聲、花開之聲、鳥語之聲、泉水叮鐺環佩之聲，這些天簌之音，聲聲入耳，讓人感然心動，讓人神馳神往，是一種多麽美妙的聽覺享受。如聽覺的盛宴。 一直以爲，聲音其實有形的，有的似堅硬無比的利器，有的若重磅炸彈，有的卻柔如水，象棉花糖。 聲音傳遞一份情感，讓人高興、憂慮、憐憫、愛與恨。固有《孟子。梁惠王上》：”聞其聲不忍食其肉。”，正如俗語所說：好言一句三冬暖，惡語一句酷暑寒。每個人的聲音，都是獨一無二的。久不聯繫的朋友，也許只是一個電話，你便能很快辯出她的聲音，雙方都會因爲被對方記得，而覺心底溫暖。 而情人之間的呢喃細語，應是這世上最美的樂音罷？讓人如沐春風。讓人恨不能融化在其中。 歲月流傳，回憶輾轉，誰記得誰的淺唱低吟？誰記得誰的魂思情動？ 愛 胸中捧著一顆跳動的心，這便是繁體的愛字。對人對事有很深的感情，才可以言愛。可是，現代的簡化字把中間的這顆最重要的心字簡化掉了，不過只剩了些友情似的喜歡。於是，這個字便開始被濫用，被褻瀆。 可是，心若不在，何以言愛？所以，便有了一夜情等速食式的速食情感，有了一枝紅杏出牆的咨意，有了小三、小四的跳踉不止。 佛說：”愛是恒久忍耐又有慈恩，愛是凡事相信，凡事盼望。” 可是，我說：愛若佛理，最高境界便是無言。
0cd6f88650c9743ed68a8bee0c3cfdc8686b89d8.translatedText: Sounds Listen with your ears, the sounds of bells and jade in nature, the sound of silk and bamboo, the sound of flowers blooming, the chirping of birds, the sound of springs jingling and rings, these sounds of nature, when they enter the ears, make people feel moved and fascinated, what a wonderful auditory enjoyment it is. It's like a feast for the ears. I have always thought that sounds are actually tangible, some are like extremely hard sharp weapons, some are like heavy bombs, and some are as soft as water, like marshmallows. Sound conveys an emotion, making people happy, worried, pity, love and hate. Inherent in "Mencius." "King Hui of Liang, Part 1": "I can't bear to eat its meat when I hear its voice.", as the saying goes: a good word will warm you in the winter, and a bad word will make the summer cold. Everyone's voice is unique. With a friend you haven't contacted for a long time, you can quickly recognize her voice with just a phone call, and both parties will feel warm in their hearts because they are remembered by the other party. And the whispers between lovers should be the most beautiful music in the world? It makes people feel like a spring breeze. It makes people want to melt into it. As time goes by, memories come and go, who remembers whose singing and crooning? Who remembers whose soul is moved? Love Holding a beating heart in your chest is the traditional Chinese word for love. Only when you have deep feelings for people and things can you express love. However, modern simplified characters have simplified the most important word "heart" in the middle, leaving only some friendship-like love. As a result, this word began to be abused and blasphemed. However, if the heart is not there, how can we express love? Therefore, there are instant emotions such as one-night stands, the desire to have sex with a branch of red apricot, and the incessant dancing of mistresses and mistresses. The Buddha said: "Love is long-suffering and kind, love believes in everything and hopes for everything." However, I said: If love is a Buddhist principle, the highest state is speechlessness.

213792839fdfe556db90de3fbe81ee3e652d7c4d.sourceText: 信 人守住自己所言，謂：”信”。 信守承諾，講信用。所謂”君子一言，駟馬難追。””言必信 ，行必果。” 可是，要做到一個信字，何其難也？古之氓，抱布貿絲。信誓旦旦，不思其反。是一個典型的負心漢形象。 不要太相信那些華麗的語言，就象漂亮的蘑菇有毒。華麗的語言也有毒罷？所以老子說：”信言不美，美言不信。” 對人誠信以待，人便不忍心欺我；對事物誠信以待，便沒有做不成的事。 佛蘭克林說過：”失足，你可以馬上恢復站立；失信，你也許永難挽回。” 儘量地做到”忠爲衣兮信爲裳。”不求名不貪利，只求以信用立于人世。 累 一個小小的人物，頭上壓著一畝待耕種的薄田，一些待織成綿緞的蠶絲，能不合成一個”累”字嗎？這種累，也許是體力上的，是形累，但如果是勞力活，那麽，可能心形俱累了。 而這種累，並非就會被壓垮，並非就沒有希望，相反的，有點蓄勢待發的味道了，你瞧那”蓄”字，用草將蠶絲與田悄悄掩蓋好，分明有一個驚喜在那兒藏著呢。只假以時日，便可以收穫多多。人生苦短，也許在不得已的時候放棄過，但既然看准一個目標，選擇了一條路，別管有多艱辛，只管走下去罷！苦也好，累也好，能堅持就好！ 安 所有的漢字中，最喜歡的，便是這一個”安”字。如一位通古博今的知性女子，恬淡安靜地坐在屋子裏，有著一種大氣和從容，萬象更替，卻能有以不變應萬變的沈著、從容。 然而細看之下，”安”又似一位英姿颯爽的女子，無拘無束立於天地之間。讓人想起”安能辯我是雄雌”的花木蘭，”誰料紗帽罩蟬絹”的女駙馬，實乃剛柔並濟，安靜中蘊含著無盡的力量。 心安即爲富足、心安即爲幸福，女子心安則天下安！ 疑 疑字如手舉一把尖銳的劈匕，矢地便是一個人的心窩。看起來外形穩穩當當，內心卻恰如利劍高懸，形寧而心不寧。周瑜多疑，故而心病難醫，氣短身絕。 一個人懷有疑慮，便如同抽去了主心骨，坐臥不寧，憂思如黑暗中的蝙蝠，在胸口肆意妄爲地撞來撞去。任是堅強的體魄，也經受不住這種摸不著頭腦、看不到邊際，亦得不著求證的碰撞。 心生疑，疑生病，心病終需心治，正如一個人所言：”粉碎一顆心必定要用另一顆，否則，怎麽能夠？”
213792839fdfe556db90de3fbe81ee3e652d7c4d.translatedText: Belief: A person who sticks to what he says is said to be "faithful". Keep your promises and keep your word. As the saying goes, "A gentleman's words are hard to follow." "What you say must be true, and what you do must be resounding." However, how difficult is it to be true to one word? The hooligans of ancient times hold cloth and trade silk. Be true to your word and never think about the opposite. He is a typical image of a heartless man. Don't believe too much in those gorgeous words, just like beautiful mushrooms that are poisonous. Isn’t gorgeous language also poisonous? That’s why Lao Tzu said: “Believe what you say is not beautiful, and what you say is good cannot be believed.” If you treat people with integrity, they won’t have the heart to deceive you; if you treat things with integrity, there will be nothing you can’t accomplish. Franklin once said: "If you make a mistake, you can get back on your feet immediately; if you break a promise, you may never recover." Try your best to achieve "loyalty is the clothing and trust is the clothing." Do not seek fame or greed for profit, but only seek to establish yourself in the world with trustworthiness. "Tired" A small person, with an acre of thin fields waiting to be cultivated and some silk waiting to be woven into satin, on his head, can it not be combined into the word "tired"? This kind of tiredness may be physical or physical, but if it is from hard work, then it may be mentally and physically tired. And this kind of tiredness does not mean that you will be crushed, and it does not mean that there is no hope. On the contrary, it feels like you are ready to go. Look at the word "accumulate". The silk and fields are quietly covered with grass. It is clear that there is a surprise hidden there. Just given time, you can gain a lot. Life is short, and you may have given up when you had to, but since you have set your sights on a goal and chosen a path, no matter how difficult it is, just keep walking! It doesn’t matter whether it’s hard or tiring, as long as you can persevere! An Among all the Chinese characters, my favorite is the character "安". Like an intellectual woman who knows the past and the present, sitting calmly and quietly in the room, she has a kind of grandeur and calmness. Everything is changing, but she can remain calm and calm to cope with the changes. However, upon closer inspection, "An" looks like a heroic woman, standing unrestrained between heaven and earth. Reminiscent of Hua Mulan, who "can tell whether I am a male or a female", and the female consort, who "unexpectedly wears a gauze hat and cicada silk", is actually a combination of strength and softness, and her silence contains endless power. Peace of mind means wealth, peace of mind means happiness, and a woman's peace of mind means peace in the world! The word "suspicious" is like holding a sharp dagger in your hand, and the target is the heart of a person. It looks stable on the outside, but it's like a sharp sword hanging high on the inside. The appearance is peaceful but the heart is restless. Zhou Yu was suspicious, so he suffered from heart disease that was difficult to treat and suffered from shortness of breath and death. When a person has doubts, it is as if his backbone has been removed, and he is restless. Worry is like a bat in the dark, banging around in his chest wantonly. No matter how strong your body is, you can't withstand this kind of collision where you can't figure it out, can't see the edge, and can't get any verification. The heart has doubts, doubts are sick, and heart diseases eventually need to be cured by the heart. As one person said: "To break one heart, you must use another. Otherwise, how can it be done?"

6564a7e3cd074a421fed7e115d46e566190b7a50.sourceText: 沙漠明珠 | 美国亚利桑那州华人历史（七十五）历史原创书籍与刊物–9.《沙漠中的金山》
6564a7e3cd074a421fed7e115d46e566190b7a50.translatedText: Pearl of the Desert | Chinese History in Arizona, USA (75) Original historical books and publications – 9. "Golden Mountain in the Desert"

83f0073a381cf7b220f3ec6d349f43fb208c0045.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association Zhang Zhaohong 9. "Golden Mountain in the Desert" "Golden Mountain in the Desert" The first group photo of the new book: Welfare Association establishes "Chinese...

af74fe1454d5dad7b6799aa3709e4a49b24a0869.sourceText: 新书第一张团体照片：福利会建立“华人先民纪念碑”
af74fe1454d5dad7b6799aa3709e4a49b24a0869.translatedText: The first group photo in the new book: The Welfare Association established the "Chinese Ancestors Monument"

6e3424c6bde588f82c19fc876b7d257b1bdb1cf3.sourceText: 1968年，“斐匿侨团联合总会”成立，日后改名为“大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会”。半个世纪以来，侨联总会出版过不少的年度特刊。而《沙漠中的金山》（GOLD MOUNTAIN IN THE DESERT），是侨联总会第一本编撰的历史新书，并于2022年7月23日出版发行。
6e3424c6bde588f82c19fc876b7d257b1bdb1cf3.translatedText: In 1968, the "Fei Ni Federation of Overseas Chinese Federation" was established and later renamed the "Greater Phoenix Chinese Federation." Over the past half century, the Federation of Overseas Chinese has published many annual special issues. DESERT), is the first new historical book compiled by the Overseas Chinese Federation, and was published on July 23, 2022.

76cdabb51bf5633199d5085ca8b47d3e9ee713fe.sourceText: 亚利桑那华人历史协会对大凤凰城侨联总会出版“沙漠中的金山”书籍表示热烈的祝贺！
76cdabb51bf5633199d5085ca8b47d3e9ee713fe.translatedText: The Arizona Chinese Historical Association expresses warm congratulations to the Greater Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation for publishing the book "Golden Mountain in the Desert"!

fb30c59afa6786424d6821e7da89990781880b02.sourceText: 新书为英文版本，共有224 页，记录了1872 年至今的大凤凰城华人历史，其中包括了34 位杰出和先进人物，多家本地企业的历史，还有侨联属下团体的介绍。新书有中文的前言：
fb30c59afa6786424d6821e7da89990781880b02.translatedText: The new book is in English, with a total of 224 pages, recording the history of the Chinese in Greater Phoenix from 1872 to the present, including 34 chapters. The new book has a Chinese preface:

80c3833aab721d883764490c8453a53d34feb35b.sourceText: “像西部的许多城镇一样，凤凰城几乎从一开始就只有很少的中国人口。起初，中国人是来自加利福尼亚和其它西部州的旅居者，但最终他们在这座不断发展的沙漠城市中看到了独特的机会。凤凰城的华人社区人口从未超过总人口的10%，所以在当地历史上经常被忽视。
80c3833aab721d883764490c8453a53d34feb35b.translatedText: Like many towns in the West, Phoenix had a small Chinese population almost from the beginning. Initially, the Chinese were sojourners from California and other western states, but eventually they saw a unique opportunity in the growing desert city. Phoenix's Chinese community has never exceeded 10% of the total population, so it is often overlooked in local history.

ab3654b00ad42ae15d38a686f2cc5b24912deab3.sourceText: “本书旨在通过突出的知名先驱者如邓盛（Shing Tang ）和余康中 （Sing Yee ）等的生平和成功，以及一些几乎被遗忘的人的生活和成功来改变这种状况。来自凤凰城的华裔美国人参加了第一次和第二次世界大战，以及之后每一次的战争冲突。
ab3654b00ad42ae15d38a686f2cc5b24912deab3.translatedText: "This book aims to highlight the well-known pioneers such as Shing Tang and Sing Yee ), and the lives and successes of some nearly forgotten men to change that. Chinese Americans from Phoenix fought in World Wars I and II, and every conflict since.

c0c5e9ece8f645d70274514cef92fc875925ff4e.sourceText: “在1950年代和1970年代，来自中国大陆、台湾和亚洲其他国家的新一波移民潮增强了凤凰城最初的华人社区。两者共同为太阳谷高科技和国防工业的惊人增长做出了贡献，并在这些行业中留下了自己的印记。
c0c5e9ece8f645d70274514cef92fc875925ff4e.translatedText: "In the 1950s and 1970s, new waves of immigrants from China, Taiwan, and other Asian countries strengthened Phoenix's original Chinese community. Together, the two have contributed to Sun Valley's phenomenal growth in high-tech and defense industries and have left their mark on these industries.

cd94273bd6f407cb2942a7752623a92cbb11a68a.sourceText: “今天，大凤凰城的华人社区集中在 Mesa-Chandler-Gilbert地区，年轻的企业家在那裡开设了各种各样的企业，迎合每个亚洲人的口味。
cd94273bd6f407cb2942a7752623a92cbb11a68a.translatedText: "Today, Greater Phoenix's Chinese community is concentrated in the Mesa-Chandler-Gilbert area, where young entrepreneurs have opened a variety of businesses catering to every Asian taste.

fd6c2bf27fd791e4cfce5957ee2117a39eb80038.sourceText: 了解这个充满活力的文化及其历史旅程……，从中国到亚利桑那的Sonoran 沙漠!“
fd6c2bf27fd791e4cfce5957ee2117a39eb80038.translatedText: Learn about this vibrant culture and its historical journey..., from China to the Sonoran Desert of Arizona!"

7f559dcd72227d1cd714ee14c4e85234c0b44167.sourceText: 华人的历史都是珍贵的。早期凤凰城华人并不多，能有记载的华人和企业就更少，大部分的纪录多数由主流媒体或历史学者留下来的，如凤凰城历史上两个时段的“唐人街”的资料和地图等等。
7f559dcd72227d1cd714ee14c4e85234c0b44167.translatedText: Chinese history is precious. There were not many Chinese in Phoenix in the early days, and there were even fewer Chinese and companies that could be recorded. Most of the records were left by mainstream media or historical scholars, such as information and maps of "Chinatown" during two periods of Phoenix's history.

cd617193af8dbb9b8daa0558746ec9b0f7ecc022.sourceText: 我们的华侨先辈十分珍惜自身的历史，他们提供自己的家史、团体历史以及先进人物的资料和照片，加上在网上搜集到的文献，经过整理后撰编成“沙漠中的金山”一书，这对凤凰华人历史的发掘和增添都是一大贡献。
cd617193af8dbb9b8daa0558746ec9b0f7ecc022.translatedText: Our overseas Chinese ancestors cherish their own history very much. They provided their family history, group history, and information and photos of advanced figures, plus documents collected from the Internet, and compiled them into the book "Golden Mountain in the Desert". This is a great contribution to the discovery and addition of the history of the Chinese people in Phoenix.

570b3f21febd3b05d6002f604b90129253813b78.sourceText: 《沙漠中的金山》 记载了凤凰城早期的华人历史；杰出的华人侨领，包括有余康中、邓盛、关崇琼、邓楷隆、邓悦宁、邓心平、邓达明、邓文华、邓桐臻、余文裕、余文劲、方慧贤……，也有现在的华裔代表人物余艳芬、黄仕均、邓朝驹等，还有多位侨联总会主席的资料。在华人企业方面，有早期的华人餐厅如花旗餐馆，还有太阳商业大厦，邓粤昂仓库等等。
570b3f21febd3b05d6002f604b90129253813b78.translatedText: "Golden Mountain in the Desert" It records the early Chinese history in Phoenix; outstanding Chinese overseas leaders, including Yu Kangzhong, Deng Sheng, Guan Chongqiong, Deng Kailong, Deng Yuening, Deng Xinping, Deng Daming, Deng Wenhua, Deng Tongzhen, Yu Wenyu, Yu Wenjin, Fang Huixian... There are also current Chinese representatives Yu Yanfen, Huang Shijun, Deng Chaoju, etc., as well as information on many presidents of the Overseas Chinese Federation. In terms of Chinese enterprises, there are early Chinese restaurants such as Citi Restaurant, Sun Commercial Building, Deng Yue'ang Warehouse, etc.

014166e5ed1bf617f80319ac35d0f026e3e03c7a.sourceText: 《沙漠中的金山》收录了大凤凰侨联总会属下团体的历史。书中还有较大编幅描叙了凤凰城文化艺术方面的情况，尤其以近年的为多，如侨联举办的国庆活动，以及中国周，中国城及评价。
014166e5ed1bf617f80319ac35d0f026e3e03c7a.translatedText: "Golden Mountain in the Desert" contains the history of the groups under the Greater Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation. The book also describes the cultural and artistic situation in Phoenix in a large space, especially in recent years, such as the National Day activities organized by the Overseas Chinese Federation, as well as China Week, China Town and its evaluation.

fe6213ebcf1b5fd0e04dc548bdcdc89c29b9d262.sourceText: 新书的封面相片，是“贺兰一家”的合照，贺兰是最早来到凤凰城的华人家庭之一。他们的历史 “The Holland Family of Phoenix, 1878-1934”，是由历史学者唐娜.卡尔（Donna L. Carr）所编写，历史协会的唐孝先先生曾把文章翻译成中文发表在报纸和杂志上。
fe6213ebcf1b5fd0e04dc548bdcdc89c29b9d262.translatedText: The cover photo of the new book is a group photo of the "Helan Family". Helan was one of the first Chinese families to come to Phoenix. Their history, "The Holland Family of Phoenix, 1878-1934," was written by historian Donna L. Carr. Mr. Tang Xiaoxian of the Historical Association translated the article into Chinese and published it in newspapers and magazines.

b36c30d79d131ecb4d93356530341473966bed95.sourceText: 唐娜.卡尔博士是《沙漠中的金山》的作者。她是P&MMP纪念墓園的义工，可以提供很多已故华人的历史资料，她多年来与侨联总会合作无间。十多年前，笔者为了破解“墓碑迷团”而探访纪念墓園，得到唐娜.卡尔不少的帮助。第一集“沙漠明珠”出版后，笔者把书赠送了给她。
b36c30d79d131ecb4d93356530341473966bed95.translatedText: Dr. Donna Carr is the author of "Golden Mountains in the Desert". She is a volunteer at the P&MMP Memorial Cemetery and can provide a lot of historical information on deceased Chinese. She has worked closely with the Overseas Chinese Federation for many years. More than ten years ago, the author visited the memorial cemetery in order to solve the "tombstone mystery" and received a lot of help from Donna Carr. After the first episode, "Pearl of the Desert," was published, the author gave the book to her.

7e51da212b2c1e03b9dddbded18d28ce7192798a.sourceText: 《沙漠中的金山》编写时，现任侨联主席邓军泉征求资料，笔者提供了凤凰城龙岡亲义公所和华人福利会两个团体的历史。新书中有多幅餐馆、会馆、社团合照以及龙舟賽等相片由张肇鸿攝影和历史协会所提供，多为第一次公布。
7e51da212b2c1e03b9dddbded18d28ce7192798a.translatedText: When "Golden Mountain in the Desert" was written, Deng Junquan, the current chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, solicited information. The author provided the history of two groups, Longgang Qinyi Office and the Chinese Welfare Association in Phoenix City. In the new book, there are many photos of restaurants, clubs, community groups and dragon boat races provided by the Zhang Zhaohong Photography and Historical Association, most of which are published for the first time.

1c97a4c2fca292680efad289c637db6d8a6880e8.sourceText: 多年来，侨联总会大力支持“沙漠明珠”的出版，共有九位侨联主席分别以贺词、撰文和写序作为勉励。这次侨联总会出书，亚省华人历史协会把四集“沙漠明珠”全部提供，以作为参考之用，并对新书出版给予赞助。（照片：龙舟賽；“上海楼”餐馆；由历史协会提供）
1c97a4c2fca292680efad289c637db6d8a6880e8.translatedText: Over the years, the Federation of Overseas Chinese has strongly supported the publication of "Pearl of the Desert". A total of nine presidents of the Federation of Overseas Chinese have encouraged it with congratulatory messages, articles and prefaces. This time the Overseas Chinese Federation published a book, and the Chinese Historical Association of Alberta provided all four episodes of "Pearl of the Desert" for reference and sponsored the publication of the new book. 869efe5ac6f4d1921a3bac8d9115c535af63c48e.sourceText: 黄慧莉律师法律信箱（六） 1。 我目前在申请劳工绿卡﹐ 听说因为美国高失业率非常难申请﹐是否有此事﹖ 答﹕ 最近劳工部对 非常多的限制。 我们要提醒PERM 的申请人，收到劳工部Audit 的要求时，一定要回覆，不能放着不管。 如果你做了劳工部要求的广告活动，但是没有完全符合劳工部的要求，大不了PERM 的申请被拒绝，重新提出PERM 的申请。 如果不回覆，可能导致雇主被罚禁止为员工申请劳工证，处罚期限不超过二年。 在回覆劳工部的Audit 后，劳工部可能再发通知要求雇主在劳工部监督下重新启动招聘过程，也就是说重新打广告征人，并求申请人将履历表寄到劳工部指定的地址。 如果依照劳工部的要求做了征人活动后，还是没有合格的申请人，PERM 还是会获得批准。 如果雇主被要求在劳工部监督下重新启动招聘过程，千万不要不回覆或者是撤销申请。 在被劳工部Audit后，劳工部可能会批准雇主在劳工部监督的招聘过程中撤销PERM申请的请求。 而且该雇主仍可以继续提出满足所有常规要求的新申请，为撤销申请的外国员工重新申主请，但是该公司提出PERM的招聘活动将会受到劳工部的监督。 此外，如果劳工部认定有必要，该雇主以后提出的所有其他外国员工的PERM申请或者工作机会都可能受到劳工部的监督。 如果在接受劳工部监督的招聘中，公司多次要求撤销PERM申请的请求会被劳工部严格审查。 如果证明该雇主未能遵守监督招聘过程的相关要求，可导致该雇主被罚禁止申请劳工证，处罚期限不超过三年。 2。 我几年前买了一个co-op (合作公寓)，我想把房子分租给别人﹐但管理委员会的人说不可以﹐我想卖换个地方住住﹐但把房子放在市场上已有一 年之久，也有买家想买我的房子，一连下了三次合同，可是每次都在买家与管理委员会人员面试时被拒批﹐我任为非常不合理﹐要如何处理﹖ 答﹕ 对于CO-OP的住房﹐事实上你是买MEMBERSHIP.但你必须遵守管委会所有的规定﹐如果不能租人﹐你就不能租﹐但一般而言你可一自由买卖﹐我建议你还是好好 与管委会的主管人员好好沟通一下﹐否则你可以依照你们的会员书内的规定进一步就争执的部份依照程序解决。
869efe5ac6f4d1921a3bac8d9115c535af63c48e.translatedText: > Lawyer Huang Huili’s legal mailbox (6) 1. I am currently applying for a labor green card. I heard that it is very difficult to apply because of the high unemployment rate in the United States. Is this true? Answer: Recently, the Ministry of Labor has imposed many restrictions. We would like to remind PERM applicants that when receiving an audit request from the Department of Labor, they must respond and cannot just ignore it. If you do the advertising activities required by the Department of Labor, but do not fully comply with the requirements of the Department of Labor, the worst case scenario is that your PERM application will be rejected and you will need to resubmit your PERM application. Failure to respond may result in the employer being fined and prohibited from applying for a labor certificate for the employee, with the penalty period not exceeding two years. After replying to the Ministry of Labor's Audit, the Ministry of Labor may issue another notice requiring the employer to restart the recruitment process under the supervision of the Ministry of Labor, which means re-advertising for candidates and requiring applicants to send their resumes to the address designated by the Ministry of Labor. If there are still no qualified applicants after conducting recruitment activities in accordance with the requirements of the Department of Labor, PERM will still be approved. If an employer is asked to restart the hiring process under the supervision of the Department of Labor, do not fail to respond or withdraw the application. After being audited by the Department of Labor, the Department of Labor may grant the employer's request to withdraw the PERM application during the hiring process overseen by the Department of Labor. And the employer can still continue to submit a new application that meets all the regular requirements and reapply for the foreign employee who has withdrawn the application, but the company's recruitment activities for PERM will be supervised by the Department of Labor. In addition, all subsequent PERM applications or job offers for foreign employees made by the employer may be subject to oversight by the Department of Labor if the Department determines it is necessary. If a company repeatedly requests to withdraw its PERM application during recruitment supervised by the Department of Labor, it will be strictly reviewed by the Department of Labor. If it is proven that the employer failed to comply with relevant requirements for supervising the recruitment process, the employer may be prohibited from applying for a labor certification for a period of not more than three years. 2. I bought a co-op (co-op) a few years ago. I want to sublet the house to others, but the management committee said it is not possible. I want to sell it and move to another place to live, but the house has been on the market for a year. There are also buyers who want to buy my house. They have made three contracts in a row, but each time they were rejected during the interview between the buyer and the management committee. I acted very unreasonably. How should I deal with it? Answer: For CO-OP housing, you are actually buying MEMBERSHIP. But you must abide by all the regulations of the management committee. If you can't rent, you can't rent. But generally speaking, you can buy and sell freely. I suggest that you have a good communication with the management committee's supervisor. Otherwise, you can further resolve the dispute according to the procedures in accordance with the provisions in your membership letter.

d648961aca78b953c1e32ab7250adb01b29833d5.sourceText: 凤凰城 唐孝先 一百零二年前的1914年2月13日，星期五，凤凰城出了一桩华人枪击毙命的桉子，从2月14日至3月13日一个月间，《亚利桑那共和报》（当时报纸名：The Arizona Republican）、《图森公民日报》(Tucson Daily Citizen)和《比斯比每日评论报》(The Bisbee Daily Review)，连续十次报导此桉，引起社会各界广泛注意。 案情似乎简单，不过扑朔迷离，因缺乏直接证据，自杀还是他杀，至今仍是悬桉。 中国人黄方（Wong Fong音译），男，生于1891年（清光绪十七年），1909年（清宣统元年）背井离乡，来到美国亚利桑那，起初住在南部城镇格洛布(Globe)。在那裡他皈依基督教，入路德教会。 >>> 1913年初，黄方搬到凤凰城麦迪逊东路220号(220 East Madison Street)伯父的房子里，与堂兄黄飞（Wong Fie音译）、堂嫂’杰西’?帼仰（’Jassie’ Quock Young音译）同住。他自己开理髮店谋生。 黄飞，时年五十岁，是位博客（gambler），手头有钱。他太太帼仰，年轻漂亮，芳龄才二十上下，是通过图森华人婚姻介绍所经纪人娶得的。 黄方睡在用屏风遮隔的大门间裡，慢慢与堂嫂熟悉起来，日久生情，竟然坠入爱河。 当时美国西部，华人妇女少如凤毛麟角，只有富有的华人男子才有幸能娶上太太。所以这些男人，特别嫉妒别的男人垂涎他们的女人。 1914年2月的一天，黄飞的少妻给他两张纸，上面用中文写着字，纸还包着三枚铜钱，其中一枚铜钱断裂成两半。黄飞不识中文，他拿了纸去找朋友。朋友告诉他，纸上写着帼仰不想再和他一起过了，她提出离婚。 帼仰见多识广，并非等閒之辈。1909年之前，她住在旧金山唐纳丁娜?卡梅伦(Donaldina Cameron)小姐办的长老会救赎传道所。卡梅伦小姐曾从旧金山的妓院裡，解救出数百名华人女孩，把她们教养成基督徒。那些女孩在她那裡，学会说英语，学会读写英文，学会烹饪、缝纫、持家。她们有了这些特长，广受西部华人单身汉的青睐。正因为帼仰在传道所住过数年，她知道在美国离婚是可能的。 也许黄飞早已担心少妻会弃他而去，当他看到那对情人一意孤行，迷途难返，心裡就作打算。 而黄方呢，也对生命深感忧虑。他关了理髮店，店外贴上告示，称店主有病，暂时停业，躲藏了三天。他同时写了一张条子给朋友，上面说：「要是我死了，把黄飞抓起来！」(When I am killed, have Wong Fie arrested!)。 就是这三天裡，黄飞乘火车去外地，好像去找当初的婚姻介绍人商量。1914年2月13日（星期五）晚上很迟回到凤凰城，半夜11点40分左右去看了一位朋友。 从子夜到凌晨1时这段时间裡，黄方的尸体在他平时睡觉的屏风后门厅裡发现。他头部中了一颗子弹而毙命。地板上身旁有一支32号口径左轮手枪，一颗用过的子弹。钱财、物件无缺。 警察约翰 麦克格拉思(John McGrath)调查了这起命桉。他发现门厅外地上有十馀个弹药筒，还有一把撬开门的螺丝起子。由于枪杀命桉事实不明，警察带走黄飞、帼仰审查。 帼仰先编造了一个动听的故事。她说，几年前，她尚未认识黄飞，就与黄方订婚了。两人分开一段时间，竟然在凤凰城重逢。她声称，她和她情人有过约定，假如黄飞不同意离婚，他们就双双自杀殉情。她认为，黄方信守诺言而先自杀了。不过警察否定这种说法，因为从子弹射入的角度判断，那样自杀几乎不可能。从现场迹象分析，有人进入屋子，趁黄方熟睡行凶。 帼仰听警察这麽说，就提供线索说，她先生从山谷银行(Valley Bank)提取1,000美元现钞，很可能到外地僱人杀他的情敌。然而黄飞坚称，他是因生意正常外出，他不可能是凶手，并且黄方死亡时，他和朋友在一起。 由于一切都属间接证据(circumstantial evidence)，黄飞的朋友还提供了他不在场证明，警察决定不起诉黄飞或帼仰，将他们释放了。 警察又很快重新逮捕帼仰，控告她非法入境美国。 事情结果不管怎样，帼仰确信凤凰城待不下去了。她给唐纳丁娜?卡梅伦发电报，告知她的境遇。卡梅伦小姐立即来到凤凰城，确认帼仰是她以前的学生后，将她带回旧金山。 黄方的遗体，经法医约翰斯通(C. W. Johnstone)验尸后，埋葬在凤凰城的卢斯利公墓(Loosely Cemetery)，现在该公墓已併入先民和军人纪念墓园。 1914年3月中旬，格洛布路德教会法朗特斯牧师(Rev. I. F. G. Flanders)、凤凰城弗雷牧师(Rev. Frey)，因不满警方处理他们的教友黄方命桉无所作为，就率成千教友写信给《亚利桑那共和报》，表达他们的关切。 几天以后，副警长比利 沃尔夫(Billy Wolfe)公开答覆，说经过警察侦查，没有找出可能的行凶嫌犯。
d648961aca78b953c1e32ab7250adb01b29833d5.translatedText: Phoenix Tang Xiaoxian One hundred and two years ago, on Friday, February 13, 1914, a Chinese man was shot and killed in Phoenix City. From February 14 to March 13, one month later, the Arizona Republic (the name of the newspaper at the time: The Arizona Republican), the Tucson Daily Citizen and the Bisbee Daily Review Review), which reported this story ten times in a row, attracting widespread attention from all walks of life. The case seems simple, but it is confusing. Due to the lack of direct evidence, it is still unsolved whether it was suicide or homicide. Chinese Huang Fang (transliteration of Wong Fong), male, was born in 1891 (the seventeenth year of Guangxu in the Qing Dynasty). He left his hometown in 1909 (the first year of Xuantong in the Qing Dynasty) and came to Arizona, USA. At first, he lived in the southern town of Globe. There he converted to Christianity and entered the Lutheran Church. >>> In early 1913, Huang Fang moved to his uncle's house at 220 East Madison Street in Phoenix, living with his cousin Wong Fie (transliteration) and cousin 'Jassie' Quock Young (transliteration). He opened his own barber shop to make a living. Huang Fei, who was fifty years old at the time, was a blogger (gambler) and had money on hand. His wife is an upright, young and beautiful woman, only around 20 years old. She was married to him through a Chinese marriage agency in Tucson. Huang Fang slept in a large door room separated by a screen, and gradually became familiar with his cousin-in-law. Over time, they fell in love, and actually fell in love. At that time, there were very few Chinese women in the western United States, and only wealthy Chinese men were lucky enough to marry wives. So these men are particularly jealous that other men covet their women. One day in February 1914, Huang Fei's young wife gave him two pieces of paper with Chinese characters written on them. The paper was also wrapped with three copper coins, one of which broke into two halves. Huang Fei didn't know Chinese, so he took the paper to find his friend. His friend told him that it was written on the paper that Guoyang didn't want to be with him anymore, so she filed for divorce. Guoyang is well-informed and is not an idle person. Before 1909, she lived in San Francisco at the Presbyterian Redemption Mission run by Miss Donaldina Cameron. Miss Cameron rescued hundreds of Chinese girls from San Francisco's brothels and educated them as Christians. Those girls learned to speak English, learn to read and write English, learn to cook, sew, and run a household while she was there. With these specialties, they are widely favored by Chinese bachelors in the west. Because Guoyang had lived in the mission house for several years, she knew that divorce was possible in the United States. Perhaps Huang Fei was already worried that his young wife would abandon him. When he saw that the lovers were going their own way and were lost, he made a plan in his heart. As for Huang Fang, he was also deeply worried about his life. He closed the barber shop and put a notice outside the shop saying that the owner was sick and was temporarily closed. He went into hiding for three days. He also wrote a note to his friend, which said: "When I am killed, have Wong Fie arrested!" (When I am killed, have Wong Fie arrested!). In these three days, Huang Fei took a train to other places, seemingly to discuss with the original marriage introducer. Returned to Phoenix late on Friday night, February 13, 1914, and visited a friend around 11:40 midnight. From midnight to 1 a.m., Huang Fang's body was found in the hall behind the screen where he usually slept. He was killed by a bullet to the head. Next to him on the floor was a 32-gauge revolver with a spent bullet. Money and objects are intact. Police Constable John McGrath investigated the murder. He found more than ten cartridges on the ground outside the foyer, as well as a screwdriver used to pry open the door. Since the facts of the shooting were unknown, the police took Huang Fei and Guoyang away for investigation. Guoyang first made up a touching story. She said that she got engaged to Huang Fang a few years ago before she even met Huang Fei. The two separated for a while and unexpectedly reunited in Phoenix City. She claimed that she and her lover had an agreement that if Huang Fei did not agree to divorce, they would both commit suicide. She believed that Huang Fang kept his promise and committed suicide first. However, the police denied this statement because judging from the angle of bullet entry, it was almost impossible to commit suicide in that way. From the analysis of signs at the scene, someone entered the house and committed the murder while Huang Fang was sleeping. After Guo Yang heard what the police said, she provided clues that her husband had withdrawn $1,000 in cash from Valley Bank and was probably out of town hiring someone to kill his love rival. However, Huang Fei insisted that he was out for business and could not be the murderer, and that he was with his friends when Huang Fang died. Since everything was circumstantial evidence, and Huang Fei's friends also provided evidence of his alibi, the police decided not to prosecute Huang Fei or Guoyang and released them. The police quickly rearrested Guo Yang and charged her with illegally entering the United States. No matter how things turned out, Guoyang was convinced that he couldn't stay in Phoenix City anymore. She sent a telegram to Donaldina Cameron informing her of her situation. Miss Cameron immediately came to Phoenix and after confirming that Guoyang was her former student, she took her back to San Francisco. After an autopsy by medical examiner C. W. Johnstone, Huang Fang's body was buried in Loosely Cemetery in Phoenix, which has now been incorporated into the Veterans and Military Memorial Cemetery. In mid-March 1914, Rev. I. F. G. Flanders and Rev. Frey of the Globe Lutheran Church were dissatisfied with the inaction of the police in dealing with their church member Huang Fangming. They led thousands of church members to write to the Arizona Republic to express their concerns. A few days later, Deputy Chief Billy Wolfe responded publicly, saying that after police investigation, no possible suspects had been identified.
