The person in charge of the relevant department of the Ministry of Railways said, "The safety of China's high-speed railways is completely guaranteed."

968dcba41b5d5657b3c7e5d87af46406848a4231.sourceText: 针对我国长大距离的高铁将从原来的时速350公里降到300公里，有人怀疑”这种降速是不是铁路部门对长大高铁的安全运行没有信心”这一说法，铁道部总工程师何华武说，京沪高速铁路是按照时速350公里的技术标准设计建造的，我们在开通运营前所做的动态验收、初步验收和安全评估。实验表明，CRH380新一代高速列车在牵引供电、通信信号以及轨道和轨下基础等方面，均满足了我们目标的安全性和平稳性要求。”通过大量的实验数据，可以肯定地讲，中国高铁的安全是完全有保证的。”
968dcba41b5d5657b3c7e5d87af46406848a4231.translatedText: In view of the fact that my country's long-distance high-speed railway will be reduced from the original 350 kilometers per hour to 300 kilometers per hour, some people doubt that "this speed reduction is because the railway department has no confidence in the safe operation of the long-distance high-speed railway." He Huawu, chief engineer of the Ministry of Railways, said that the Beijing-Shanghai high-speed railway was designed and built in accordance with the technical standards of 350 kilometers per hour. We conducted dynamic acceptance, preliminary acceptance and safety assessment before opening the operation. Experiments show that the CRH380 new generation high-speed train meets our target safety and stability requirements in terms of traction power supply, communication signals, and track and under-track foundations. "Through a large amount of experimental data, it can be said with certainty that the safety of China's high-speed rail is completely guaranteed."

f97e66189928e0bf23b9d30c26073eee12a0289e.sourceText: 京沪高铁将实行时速300公里和时速250公里混跑这种运行方式，铁道部运输局综合部主任李军解释，根据我们的分析研究，长大高铁在目前的阶段实施时速300公里和250公里的混跑模式是最好的选择。京津、沪杭相对独立的城际线路比较短，实施时速350公里是最好的选择。
f97e66189928e0bf23b9d30c26073eee12a0289e.translatedText: The Beijing-Shanghai High-speed Railway will implement a mixed operation mode of 300 kilometers per hour and 250 kilometers per hour. Li Jun, director of the General Department of the Transportation Bureau of the Ministry of Railways, explained that based on our analysis and research, it is the best choice for the Changchun-Changchang High-speed Railway to implement a mixed operation mode of 300 kilometers per hour and 250 kilometers per hour at the current stage. The relatively independent intercity lines between Beijing, Tianjin and Shanghai and Hangzhou are relatively short, so implementing a speed limit of 350 kilometers per hour is the best option.

d0a68bcea84593d75e3bcd40f2da2c9dbc8f46b7.sourceText: 关于京沪高铁票价问题，李军称，高铁票价产生的基本依据是由高铁公司根据《价格法》的规定，综合考虑建设运营成本、社会承受能力以及其他运输方式的价格因素来制定试行价格，并报国家发改委和铁道部备案。不论即将开通运营的京沪高铁，还是已经开通的其他高铁线路，现在已经公布的时速300公里的动车组列车票价比时速350公里动车组的票价水平下调5%左右。在此基础上，相关的高铁公司在运价政策权限内，根据市场的状况，可以自主确定浮动票价。
d0a68bcea84593d75e3bcd40f2da2c9dbc8f46b7.translatedText: Regarding the issue of Beijing-Shanghai high-speed rail fares, Li Jun said that the basic basis for high-speed rail fares is that high-speed rail companies, in accordance with the provisions of the Price Law, comprehensively consider construction and operation costs, social affordability, and other transportation mode price factors to set trial prices and report them to the National Development and Reform Commission and the Ministry of Railways for filing. Regardless of the soon-to-be-opened Beijing-Shanghai high-speed rail or other high-speed rail lines that have already been opened, the fares of the 300 kilometers per hour EMU trains that have been announced are about 5% lower than the fare levels of the 350 kilometers per hour EMUs. On this basis, relevant high-speed rail companies can independently determine floating fares based on market conditions within the scope of freight policy authority.

a6e87dac99280cee82936248d6a1d9312d79e913.sourceText: 信用纪录对贷款购屋的影响 Richard Liao 除非您是用现金购买房子，否则在购屋前先做好贷款的准备工…
a6e87dac99280cee82936248d6a1d9312d79e913.translatedText: The impact of credit history on home loan Richard Liao Unless you are buying a house with cash, it is important to make preparations for a loan before buying a house...

94348d95fbefad252b9394be0ebdc9907e48a6ae.sourceText: 除非您是用现金购买房子，否则在购屋前先做好贷款的准备工作是很重要的。 首先请您先调查一下自己的信用纪录，因为对银行来说，信用纪录和分数是用来衡量个人信用价值的重要依据，银行是否愿意贷款给您，您拿到的利率是高是低，个人 的信用纪录和分数占了很大的因素。
94348d95fbefad252b9394be0ebdc9907e48a6ae.translatedText: Unless you are buying a house with cash, it is important to make preparations for a loan before buying a house. First of all, please investigate your own credit record, because for banks, credit record and score are important basis for measuring personal credit value. Whether the bank is willing to lend to you and whether the interest rate you get is high or low, personal credit record and score play a big factor.

afb86f41021f26e44a229b08be735f9305e83005.sourceText: 根据公平及正确信用处理法(Fair and Accurate Credit Transactions Act)，每一个人每年可以免费拿到一次自己的信用纪录报告，此报告分别由三家主要的信用报告公司提供，这三家公司分别是: Equifax、 Experian以及TransUnion，最简单的方法是上网到AnnualCreditReport.com 去免费申请。 若要知道自己的信用分数(Credit Score)，则需要花钱购买，目前市面上有很多代理商提供查询整合方案，每年只要花一百多块就可以无限制查询自己的信用报告和分数，请 放心，查询自己的信用纪录不会影响到您的信用分数，所以为了了解自己的信用状况，也为了避免在贷款购屋时出现意外，建议您至少每隔几个月要查一下自己的信用纪录， 同时也可以避免自己成为信用窃盗的受害者。
afb86f41021f26e44a229b08be735f9305e83005.translatedText: According to the Fair and Accurate Credit Transactions Act, everyone can get their own credit record report for free once a year. This report is provided by three major credit reporting companies: Equifax, Experian and TransUnion. The easiest way is to go online to AnnualCreditReport.com to apply for free. If you want to know your credit score (Credit Score), you need to spend money to purchase it. Currently, there are many agencies on the market that provide integrated inquiry solutions. You only need to spend more than 100 yuan per year to inquire your credit report and score without limit. Please rest assured that inquiry of your own credit record will not affect your credit score. Therefore, in order to understand your credit status and avoid surprises when purchasing a house with a loan, it is recommended that you check your credit record at least every few months, and at the same time, you can avoid becoming a victim of credit theft.

39cebab1ae67d9b498335fbc6a046745d8cbc82a.sourceText: 在拿到信用报告后，请详细检查个人资料是否正确，像是: 姓名、住址、生日等等；是否有不明帐户出现，例如: 您未持有的信用卡帐户、贷款帐户等，以及有没有任何 帐户是您每期按时缴款，却出现迟缴的纪录，如果有任何错误、您有权向他们提出证明，要求更正。 不良的信用报告，可能会让您的贷款利率比别人高，甚至造成银行拒绝您的贷款申请。
39cebab1ae67d9b498335fbc6a046745d8cbc82a.translatedText: After getting the credit report, please check in detail whether the personal information is correct, such as: name, address, birthday, etc.; whether there are any unknown accounts, such as: credit card accounts, loan accounts, etc. that you do not hold, and whether there are any accounts where you pay on time every period but have a record of late payment. If there are any errors, you have the right to submit proof to them and request corrections. A bad credit report may make your loan interest rate higher than others, or even cause the bank to reject your loan application.

3010444d2bdcab0c8517328a0407413760014d09.sourceText: 张肇鸿：余氏風采耀鳳城
3010444d2bdcab0c8517328a0407413760014d09.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: The Yu family's style shines in Fengcheng

78345c92f9cf29036fd9e7d19c18bfec860ef044.sourceText: 张肇鸿：余氏風采耀鳳城 根據史科，余氏之先世，是黃帝之子玄囂。而被余氏公奉為太祖的余靖忠襄公，是宋朝廣東韶…
78345c92f9cf29036fd9e7d19c18bfec860ef044.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: The Yu family's style shines in Fengcheng According to historical records, the ancestor of the Yu family was Xuan Xiao, the son of the Yellow Emperor. And Duke Yu Jing Zhongxiang, who was regarded as the Taizu by the Yu family, was from Guangdong Shao in the Song Dynasty...

a33da8253249e967f0e80b6b3f9d9204dc482164.sourceText: 根據史科，余氏之先世，是黃帝之子玄囂。而被余氏公奉為太祖的余靖忠襄公，是宋朝廣東韶關人，少以文學稱，登進士第。後至工部尚書，與歐陽修等齊名。當年的諫官蔡襄有詩贊賢臣余靖：”必有謀臣裨帝右，更加風采動朝端。”這是《余風采堂》”風采”一詞之來由。因韶關有一河流名曰 ”武溪”，余靖用此為號，并出過文集，故”武溪”又成為了余風采堂的另一個別稱。 余風采堂起緣之國內而發展於海外，一百多年前，美國的余氏宗親就在美國地區成立了 ”余風采堂”，而且在衆多的僑社團體中是個大的宗親組織。 斐匿余風采堂成立於一九六一年，並於一九八八年置下堂所，自此祭祖香火不斷，宗親聯誼年年舉行。余氏大家庭老少和諧合作，堂務發展，並對本地僑社有著重要的貢獻。 最早的《花旗餐館》 斐匿的余氏人家來斐匿已有近百年的歷史。早在七、八十年前，余氏家族中的余康中先生就經營過一間《花旗餐館》，餐館位於市區繁華的中央街 (Central)，是當其時極少數的中式餐館之一。余先生學貫中英，經營有方，與當時的政商關係良好，不少初到埠的余氏宗親被收留工作或得其幫助，落腳生根，是斐匿余氏家族的開埠功臣之一。 開辦最早的中文學校 六十多年前，鳳凰城僑社已經開辦起了中文學校。從廣東嶺南大學畢業移民來美的余子春先生，國學基礎甚好，除在本埠開設家庭式貨倉之外，還擔任起中文學校校長。當其時斐匿已有一定數量的華人，華裔子女普遍受的是英文教育，為了使下一代承傳中華文化，不忘祖國鄉情，余子春先生運用自己的國學知識教授學生，炎炎的沙漠之城從始响起了朗朗的中文讀書聲，這是本埠最早的中文學校。 最早的余氏”超市” 到了上世紀四十年代，又有余賞和與余永享兩位先生開了一間在當時可稱之為”超市”的”星光孖結”，孖結是四邑話，即英文”Market”。也有了余明德先生開的二間貨倉。余明德先生是當時僑社的活躍人物，也是創立早期余風采堂的重要功臣。而星光孖結的東主余賞和先生最為熱心，長期服務余氏宗親，在斐匿余風采堂成立後又長期担任主席，財政、書記數職。早期的僑社身兼數職並不是甚麼”大權獨攬”，而且百分百的出錢出力、出時間，沒有奉獻宗族親邦的精神，難以為繼。根據資料，到了六十年代，余氏巳經有十二間貨倉在斐匿經營。 最快籌款購置堂所的團體 一九八八年，斐匿余風采堂決定購置堂所，宗親們積極响應，在一星期內即集資到十五萬元，以後又因要擴建堂所再把籌款額推高至二十三萬元。因籌款已夠置業，所以總行撥給的二萬元也一分錢未有領取，讓給其它更有需要的會館。 最自力更生完成的堂所 籌到錢後，余氏宗親馬上開始擴建堂所，大家興奮非常，以余氏第二代”土紙仔”以余銳滾等為首，一幫男女後生卷起衫袖，磨拳擦掌全盤策劃，自己動手砌地台油油漆，裝修禮堂和廚房設備，短時間內一個新的堂所已經落成。在余氏宗親的眼中，新建的”余風采堂”美觀實用，而後裔的積極參與更令人振奮。以後每年祭祖都香火鼎盛，余氏男女老少踴躍參加，由族人每年自動捐出的六隻燒豬在祭祖後全部”太公分豬肉”人人有份，盛況連年。 最多ABC參與的宗親堂所 時至今日，斐匿余風采堂的堂務巳由中、青一代接管打理，十年來的堂務會議都是英文進行，新的一代尊敬老僑，發展會務，熱心社會。而當今許多宗親組織都有人員減少，後繼無人的憂慮，而斐匿余風采堂卻令人看到了薪火相傳，蓬勃發展的景象，為僑社樹立了一個榜樣。
a33da8253249e967f0e80b6b3f9d9204dc482164.translatedText: According to historical records, the ancestor of the Yu family was Xuan Xiao, the son of the Yellow Emperor. And Duke Yu Jingzhong, who was regarded as the Taizu by the Yu family, was a native of Shaoguan, Guangdong in the Song Dynasty. He was rarely known as a literary scholar and became a Jinshi. Later he became Minister of the Ministry of Industry and became as famous as Ouyang Xiu and others. Cai Xiang, the admonisher at that time, wrote a poem praising the virtuous minister Yu Jing: "There must be advisers who can help the emperor at his right and move the court with more grace." This is the origin of the word "style" in "Yu Fengcaitang". Because there is a river in Shaoguan named "Wuxi", Yu Jing used this as his nickname and published an anthology of essays, so "Wuxi" became another nickname for Yu Fengcaitang. Yu Feng Caitang originated in China and developed overseas. More than a hundred years ago, the Yu clan in the United States established the "Yu Feng Caitang" in the United States, and it is a large clan organization among many overseas Chinese communities. Fei Niyu Fengcai Hall was established in 1961 and the lower hall was built in 1988. Since then, ancestor worship has continued and family reunions have been held every year. The Yu family, old and young, cooperate harmoniously to develop the church affairs and make important contributions to the local overseas Chinese community. The earliest "Citi Restaurant" The Yu family of Feini has been in Feini for nearly a hundred years. As early as 70 or 80 years ago, Mr. Yu Kangzhong of the Yu family ran a "Citi Restaurant". The restaurant was located on the bustling Central Street in the city. It was one of the very few Chinese restaurants at that time. Mr. Yu was well versed in both Chinese and English, was a good businessman, and had good relations with the political and business circles at that time. Many of the Yu family members who had just arrived in the port were taken in to work or helped to settle down and take root. He was one of the heroes of the Fei Ni Yu family who opened the port. The earliest Chinese school opened More than 60 years ago, the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Community opened a Chinese school. Mr. Yu Zichun, who graduated from Lingnan University in Guangdong and immigrated to the United States, has a good foundation in Chinese studies. In addition to opening a family-style warehouse in his hometown, he also served as the principal of a Chinese school. At that time, there were a certain number of Chinese in Feini, and Chinese children generally received English education. In order to enable the next generation to inherit Chinese culture and not forget the nostalgia of the motherland, Mr. Yu Zichun used his knowledge of Chinese studies to teach students. From the beginning, the sound of Chinese reading rang out in the hot desert city. This was the earliest Chinese school in this city. The earliest Yu's "Supermarket" In the 1940s, two other gentlemen, Yu Shanghe and Yu Yongxiang, opened a "Xingguang Margin" which could be called a "supermarket" at that time. Margin is the word "Market" in Siyi dialect. There are also two warehouses opened by Mr. Yu Mingde. Mr. Yu Mingde was an active figure in the overseas Chinese community at that time and an important contributor to the establishment of the early Yu Fengcaitang. Mr. Yu Shanghe, the proprietor of Xingguang Margin, is the most enthusiastic. He has served the Yu family for a long time. After the establishment of Fei Niyu Fengcai Hall, he served as chairman, treasurer and secretary for a long time. The early overseas Chinese communities held multiple positions and were not "monopoly", and they devoted 100% of their money, effort, and time without the spirit of dedication to their clans and relatives, so it was difficult to survive. According to information, by the 1960s, the Yu family already had twelve warehouses operating in Fei Ni. The fastest group to raise funds to purchase a church hall. In 1988, Fei Niyu Fengcai Church decided to purchase a church hall. The clan members responded positively and raised NT$150,000 within one week. Later, the amount was raised to NT$230,000 due to the expansion of the church hall. Since the funds raised were enough to buy a house, not a penny of the 20,000 yuan allocated by the head office was received, and was given to other clubs in greater need. The Most Self-Reliant Hall After raising the money, the Yu clan immediately started to expand the hall. Everyone was very excited. Led by Yu Ruigun, the second generation of the Yu family, a group of young men and women rolled up their sleeves and started planning. They built the floor, painted the floor, and decorated the auditorium and kitchen equipment. In a short period of time, a new hall was completed. In the eyes of the Yu clan, the newly built "Yu Fengcaitang" is beautiful and practical, and the active participation of the descendants is even more exciting. From then on, the ancestor worship was very popular every year, and the Yu family's men, women, old and young actively participated. The six roast pigs donated by the tribe every year were all "too much pork" for everyone after the ancestor worship, and the event continued year after year. The clan hall with the most ABC participation. Today, the church affairs of Fei Niyu Fengcai Hall have been taken over by the middle and younger generations. Church meetings for the past ten years have been held in English. The new generation respects the old overseas Chinese, develops conference affairs, and is enthusiastic about society. Nowadays, many kinship organizations are worried about having fewer members and no successors, but Fei Niyu Fengcaitang has allowed people to see a scene of vigorous development and passed down the work from generation to generation, setting an example for overseas Chinese communities.

5458b150375d7f3b73f52ddaee9653dad1f5c24c.sourceText: 最能干的婦女部 余家有一批夫人不但持家有道，而且對參與族務也不為人後，早期的銳滾夫人、碧雲、文介夫人、偉光夫人、夢覺夫人、樹棠夫人、國寧夫人，以後的錦添夫人、文偉夫人、金堂夫人、篤俊夫人…等等所組成的婦女部，(婦女冠以丈夫之名才讓人辨別，并不是重男輕女，而是”僑社文化”的一種現象)，無論是祭祖、春宴或者郊游，大少具体體事務都是盡心盡力地辦好辦妥，屢受族人稱贊。 最全面的獎學金 余氏家族人材輩出，和他們重視培養下一代息息相關，余風采堂連年發放奬學金，人數最多也最為全面，無論是學英文或學中文的學生，只要是成績優秀，他們都會盡力栽培。我們在這些莘莘學子的感言中領悟到，余氏宗族的努力已經春華秋實，得到累累的碩果。 最早的全美才藝小姐冠軍 余氏第一位選美”雙料”皇后是余海倫小姐，她是一九七七年參選佳麗中的冠軍。當年第一次設立才藝小姐獎項，余海倫小姐用武術獲評判青睞，成為雙料冠軍。1978年又贏得了全美才藝小姐冠軍。 最模範堂所 在全美的余氏宗親堂所中，斐匿余風采堂也是個模範堂所，在對祖國故鄉建設方面，無論是堂所或個人，斐匿余氏宗親的一片桑梓深情有目共睹。重修故鄉宗祠，開支五百余萬港幣，美國余風采堂總行集資超過一百萬，斐匿余氏宗親捐出了廿六萬，而余文勁伉儷就捐款了十萬港幣，余氏在開平荻海的祖宗祠堂，修建得十分美侖美奐和宏偉堂煌。 最有價值的僑領 余氏家族的人才俊傑，對斐匿僑社和全美國甚至世界余氏宗親都有過積極的貢獻。文裕先生做過斐匿各重要僑社組織包括僑聯的領導，余風釆堂美西會總長；文勁先生除上面職稱外，年紀輕輕已是全美余風釆堂的元老，十屆廿年國府僑務顧問，直至台灣政党輪替後才自己辭去，二零零零年又榮膺世界余氏宗親總會創會副會長，現任總會名譽會長。 在耆英樂園《康樂大廈》内外，大家可看到由余文勁伉儷捐贈壹萬圓，為記念慈母余黃月明太夫人所建起的《月明亭》；由余文裕夫人捐贈壹萬圓，將康樂大廈一樓大廳命名為《余文裕廳》，以記念夫婿余文裕先生；由余文偉夫人捐贈壹萬圓，將康樂大廈二樓廳堂命名《余文偉廳》，以記念夫婿余文偉先生；將三樓廳堂命名《余毓淋廳》，以記念家翁余毓淋先生。他們的積德行善，對中華文化傳統美德的傳承，對祖國和故鄉，以及對本地僑社的積極貢獻，令人欽佩。
5458b150375d7f3b73f52ddaee9653dad1f5c24c.translatedText: The most capable women's department There are a group of ladies in the Yu family who are not only good at running the house, but also unconventional in participating in family affairs. In the early days, Mrs. Ruigun, Biyun, Mrs. Wenjie, Mrs. Weiguang, Mrs. Mengjue, Mrs. Shutang, Mrs. Guoning, and later Mrs. Jintian, Mrs. Wenwei, Mrs. Jintang, Mrs. Dujun... The women's department composed of others, (women are distinguished by their husband's name, which is not a preference for boys, but a phenomenon of "overseas Chinese community culture"), whether it is ancestor worship, spring banquets or outings, all specific affairs of the young and old are handled with all their heart and soul, and are often praised by the tribe. The Most Comprehensive Scholarship The Yu family has a large number of talented people, which is closely related to their emphasis on cultivating the next generation. Yu Fengcaitang has issued scholarships year after year, with the largest number and the most comprehensive. Whether they are students studying English or Chinese, as long as they have excellent grades, they will do their best to cultivate them. From the testimonials of these students, we realized that the efforts of the Yu family have been fruitful and have yielded numerous fruits. The earliest Miss Talent America winner. The first "double" queen in the Yu family beauty pageant was Miss Helen Yu. She was the champion among the contestants in 1977. That year, the Miss Talent Award was established for the first time. Ms. Helen Yu won the favor of the judges with her martial arts and became a double champion. In 1978, she won the Miss Talent America title. The Most Model Hall Among the Yu family halls in the United States, Fei Niyu Fengcai Hall is also a model church. In terms of the construction of the motherland, whether it is a church or an individual, the deep love of the Fei Niyu family for their family is obvious to all. It cost more than 5 million Hong Kong dollars to rebuild the ancestral hall in his hometown. The head office of Yu Fengcaitang in the United States raised more than 1 million. Fei Ni Yu's clan donated 260,000 Hong Kong dollars, and Yu Wenjin and his wife donated 100,000 Hong Kong dollars. The Yu family's ancestral hall in Dihai, Kaiping, was built very beautifully and magnificently. The Most Valuable Overseas Chinese Leaders The Yu family is a talented group of people who have made positive contributions to the Feinie Overseas Chinese Community and the Yu family throughout the United States and even the world. Mr. Wenyu served as the leader of various important overseas Chinese organizations in Fei Ni, including the Federation of Overseas Chinese, and was the president of the Yu Fengtang Association in the United States. In addition to the above professional titles, Mr. Wen Jin was already a veteran of the Yufengtang Association in the United States at a young age. He served as the Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisor to the National Government for 10 years. He did not resign until Taiwan’s political parties changed. In 2000, he was awarded the founding vice president of the World Yu Clan Association and is currently the honorary president of the association. Inside and outside the "Kangle Building" in the Senior Citizen Paradise, you can see the "Moonlight Pavilion" built by Mr. and Mrs. Yu Wenjin with a donation of 10,000 yuan to commemorate his loving mother, Mrs. Yu Huangyue Mingtai; Mrs. Yu Wenyu donated 10,000 yuan and named the lobby on the first floor of the Leisure Building "Yu Wen "Yue Hall" in memory of her husband, Mr. Yu Wenyu; Mrs. Yu Wenwei donated 10,000 yuan, and the hall on the second floor of the Hongle Building was named "Yu Wenwei Hall" in memory of her husband, Mr. Yu Wenwei; and the hall on the third floor was named "Yu Yulin Hall" in memory of the family patriarch, Mr. Yu Yulin. Their good deeds, inheritance of the traditional virtues of Chinese culture, and positive contributions to their motherland and hometown, as well as to the local overseas Chinese community, are admirable.

6218652a197ded6732df1498260a84999fa3cfb9.translatedText: Poor climate reduces apple production and prices rise (Alberta Times) There is a serious shortage of apples in the country's apple market this year, but not for Apple's iPhone and other series of products...

36e2a07a7840082fc93e69510cb34311fbf81c59.sourceText: 全国今年的苹果市场严重短缺，但不是苹果公司的iPhone等系列产品，而是果树因受春天寒流的影响，苹果收成比去年减产14%，为1986年以来的最低。 今年3月的早春导致果树提前开花，但4月的寒流却使花蕊凋谢。 美国苹果协会说，恶劣的气候毁掉了纽约州52%的苹果收成，密西根州的苹果损失更达近90%，从加拿大到北卡罗来纳州的苹果产区都受到了影响。 苹果减产将促使价格上扬，部分品种的零售价每磅将升高一元，果汁价将提高20%以上。 沃尔玛(Walmart)、好市多(Costco)和克罗格(Kroger)等店的苹果供应商Crunch Pak公司说，今年底和明年初的苹果价格上涨，在中西部和东北部地区可能将更严峻 ，因为届时的苹果储量将减少。 纽约州议会考虑紧急削减苹果种植商的税赋，部分果园的苹果汁价格达一加仑八元，比全国汽油平均价还高出一倍。 部分州的Empire等优质果品的减产损失更大，果园不得不削减路摊水果销售，和减少民众的果园采摘活动。 纽约州苹果协会发言人说：「从1940年代以来，几代种植商都没见过这么大的减产损失。」 纽约州Sterling镇果园主欧莱特说，他的20%减产损失将透过涨价弥补，「因为市场需求大」。 密西根州的第四代果园主杨吉斯特说，今年的苹果产量只有7000蒲式耳，而好年景的收成为12万蒲式耳。 如果没有苹果第一大州华盛顿州的丰收，全国苹果供应将更加严峻。 华州今年的苹果收成可能近1亿900万蒲式耳，为史上第二高。 州苹果委员会说：「我们通常占全国市场的50%到60%，但今年可达80%。」
36e2a07a7840082fc93e69510cb34311fbf81c59.translatedText: There is a serious shortage of apples in the country's apple market this year, but not for Apple's iPhone and other series of products. Due to the impact of the spring cold wave, the apple harvest has dropped by 14% from last year, the lowest since 1986. The early spring in March this year caused the fruit trees to bloom early, but the cold snap in April caused the flower stamens to wither. The U.S. Apple Association said that the harsh weather destroyed 52% of the apple harvest in New York State, and nearly 90% of the apple harvest in Michigan. Apple-producing areas from Canada to North Carolina were affected. The reduction in apple production will cause prices to rise. The retail price of some varieties will increase by one yuan per pound, and the price of juice will increase by more than 20%. Crunch Pak, an apple supplier to stores such as Walmart, Costco and Kroger, said rising apple prices late this year and early next year may be more severe in the Midwest and Northeast because apple reserves will be reduced by then. The New York State Legislature is considering emergency cuts to taxes on apple growers. In some orchards, apple juice costs as much as $8 a gallon, twice the national average price of gasoline. In some states, high-quality fruits such as Empire have suffered greater losses due to production losses. Orchards have had to cut back on fruit sales at street stalls and reduce people’s orchard picking activities. A spokesman for the New York State Apple Association said: "Generations of growers have not seen such a large loss in production since the 1940s." Ouellette, an orchardist in Sterling, New York, said that his 20% loss in production will be made up by price increases "because of the huge market demand." Young Gister, a fourth-generation orchardist in Michigan, said that this year’s apple production is only 7,000 bushels, compared with 120,000 bushels in good years. Without a bumper harvest in Washington state, the largest apple state, the national apple supply will be even more severe. This year's apple harvest in Washington is likely to be nearly 109 million bushels, the second-highest in history. "We usually have 50 to 60 percent of the national market, but this year it's up to 80 percent," the state apple committee said.

21f4f1cea6ee8dee6169e0ae824aefe1f10bab2b.translatedText: Phoenix Chinese School Spring Festival Garden Party - Celebrate the New Year in the Year of the Horse (contributed by Phoenix Chinese School) Phoenix Chinese School's 2014 Spring Festival Garden Party, in February...

94e25ea2733a2590fb12b7556e7b34e1ca9ce53d.sourceText: （凤凰城中文学校 来稿） 凤凰城中文学校2014年春节园游会，在二月九日上午十一点，于美莎社区大学校区举行。今年因为校园中庭整修，地点改在户外大型帐篷内。醒目的建筑，内有社区大学校方提供的桌椅设备，加上工作人员搭设的舞台，今年的春节园游会别具特色。
94e25ea2733a2590fb12b7556e7b34e1ca9ce53d.translatedText: (contributed by Phoenix Chinese School) Phoenix Chinese School’s 2014 Spring Festival Garden Party will be held at 11 a.m. on February 9th at the Mesa Community College campus. This year, due to the renovation of the campus atrium, the venue was changed to a large outdoor tent. The eye-catching building contains tables and chairs provided by the community college and a stage set up by the staff. This year’s Spring Festival garden party is unique.

dd7abc225a1615fe3e67338725707ecf662a9eb0.sourceText: 通过入口处招待来宾的义工们后步入帐篷中，阵阵扑鼻的美食香味令人胃口大开。家长们用心准备的台湾道地菜，有萝卜糕、肉羹汤、炒饭、滷味、茶叶蛋和豆花等等。学生代联会摆设的西式比萨饼和波霸奶茶，也是另一项选择。享受完了美食，接近中午时，音乐声响起，由闻玲琳老师指导的舞蹈表演 「狐狸说什么」，劲歌热舞为今年的精彩节目揭开了序目。接下来讨喜的舞狮表演，纵横全场再掀高潮。
dd7abc225a1615fe3e67338725707ecf662a9eb0.translatedText: After passing the volunteers who entertained the guests at the entrance, they walked into the tent. The aroma of delicious food whetted their appetites. The local Taiwanese dishes carefully prepared by the parents include carrot cake, meat soup, fried rice, braised meat, tea eggs, tofu pudding, etc. The Western-style pizza and boba milk tea displayed by the Student Generation Association are also another option. After enjoying the delicious food, near noon, the music started playing, and the dance performance "What Did the Fox Say" directed by teacher Wen Linglin, with vigorous singing and dancing, kicked off this year's exciting program. What followed was a delightful lion dance performance that captivated the audience.

01f8724747a43e939d0f09131730fa75d0868230.translatedText: The lion welcomes guests in the New Year

6ac519ebe080ad1de36a721f0e57f0f24c296fc3.sourceText: 主持人郑弘先生出场向观众拜年。随后董事会召集人谢健明先生和程秀玲校长分别致词，感谢各位来宾对学校的支持，并献上新年祝福。这次与会的贵宾包括美莎社区大学校长潘寿安先生，美莎社区大学负责语文学校业务的 Ms. Pat Esparza，美莎市警察局长Mr. Mark Wesellmen，中华民国侨务委员会侨务咨询委员张晴玲女士，侨务顾问邱顺雄夫妇，林睿雄、黄玉莲夫妇，徐凯莱女士，王文修医师伉俪，希望中文学校董事长何世江先生及前校长帅致若女士等。
6ac519ebe080ad1de36a721f0e57f0f24c296fc3.translatedText: The host Mr. Zheng Hong came on stage to greet the audience. Later, Mr. Xie Jianming, convener of the board of directors, and Principal Cheng Xiuling delivered speeches respectively, thanking all guests for their support of the school and extending New Year blessings. The distinguished guests attending this meeting include Mr. Pan Shou'an, the president of Mesa Community College, Ms. Pat Esparza, who is in charge of the Chinese language school business of Mesa Community College, and Mr. Mark, the chief of police of Mesa City. Wesellmen, Ms. Zhang Qingling, Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisory Committee member of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission of the Republic of China, Mr. and Mrs. Qiu Shunxiong, Overseas Chinese Affairs Consultant, Mr. and Mrs. Lin Ruixiong and Huang Yulian, Ms. Xu Kailai, Dr. Wang Wenxiu and his wife, Mr. He Shijiang, Chairman of Hope Chinese School, and Ms. Shuai Zhiruo, former principal, etc.

3831c25c82e4008704d11df292cc159f7cba25c4.sourceText: 随后几位贵宾上台致词包括美莎社区大学校长潘寿安校长美莎市警察局长Mr. Mark Wesellmen及邱顺雄侨务顾问。贵宾们对凤凰城中文学校推广中文教育和传承中华文化均表高度得肯定。
3831c25c82e4008704d11df292cc159f7cba25c4.translatedText: Several distinguished guests then took the stage to deliver speeches, including President Pan Shou'an of Mesa Community College, Mesa City Police Chief Mr. Mark Wesellmen and Overseas Chinese Affairs Advisor Qiu Shunxiong. The distinguished guests spoke highly of Phoenix Chinese School’s promotion of Chinese education and inheritance of Chinese culture.

bb309574e77dcd747187e34ed907b7ead56632fa.sourceText: 接着进行的是各班学生的表演。幼儿学前班的小小孩们，早就打扮好在舞台旁准备上台。响亮的歌声配合着动作，孩子们可爱的演出，让家长们忍不住不停地拍照。五、七、八/九年级班级合唱「爱因为在心中」，除了歌唱，还有谢晓岚同学精彩的舞蹈表演。由廖桂樱老师指导的话剧社表演的「傻鹅皮杜妮」，以及四年级庄世卿老师指导的话剧”新年故事– 年兽”，除特製服装外，更动用了许多大型道具。同学们的精彩造型，都是老师及家长的精心杰作。演出时动作自然，台词流利，相信他们一定花了很多时间来准备。叫好又叫座的还有武术和太极拳的演出。八年级黄志威同学的大刀表演虎虎生风劲道十足。太极名师杨永庆先生带领着他的资深学员为现场观众示范刚柔并济的太极拳演出。
bb309574e77dcd747187e34ed907b7ead56632fa.translatedText: The next step was the performances of students from each class. The little children in the preschool class have already been dressed up and ready to go on stage. The loud singing combined with the movements and the children's cute performances made parents unable to help but take pictures. The fifth, seventh, eighth and ninth grade classes sang "Love is in the Heart". In addition to singing, there was also a wonderful dance performance by classmate Xie Xiaolan. The drama club performed "Silly Goose Skin" directed by teacher Liao Guiying, and the drama "New Year's Story - Nian Beast" directed by fourth grade teacher Zhuang Shiqing used many large-scale props in addition to special costumes. The wonderful looks of the students are all carefully crafted by teachers and parents. The movements during the performance were natural and the lines were fluent. I believe they must have spent a lot of time preparing. Also popular and well-received were the performances of martial arts and Tai Chi. Eighth-grade classmate Huang Zhiwei’s machete performance was very powerful. Mr. Yang Yongqing, a famous Tai Chi master, led his senior students to demonstrate a Tai Chi performance that combines strength and softness for the audience.

18d93c0e792be6ff2e93756190059456adfa79c3.translatedText: The drama club performed 'Silly Goose Skin'

3735f46cbf058c0693ab3417db6cf0c55e6406eb.sourceText: 今年度凤凰城中文学校为非华语家庭设立了不同年级的课程，在这次园游会中，也看到这些非华裔学生们，为学习中文所付出的努力。尤其是二年级阎正伦老师的班级，每位学生除了画出自己想像中的年兽，还能背诵出他们所写的短文。真的要给这些学生们大大的讚赏和鼓励。
3735f46cbf058c0693ab3417db6cf0c55e6406eb.translatedText: This year Phoenix Chinese School has set up different grade courses for non-Chinese speaking families. During this garden party, we also saw the efforts of these non-Chinese students in learning Chinese. Especially in second grade teacher Yan Zhenglun’s class, each student not only drew the Nian beast in their imagination, but also recited the short essay they wrote. I really want to give these students a lot of praise and encouragement.

48f7c74d66752ab9022f8963da7488c86312c5bd.sourceText: 凤凰城中文学校马年的春节园游会，在美食、表演、抽奖及欢笑声结束。中文学校要特别感谢美莎社区大学Mesa Community College给予最大的支持与配合，让此次春节园游会能顺利举办。此外所有默默帮忙的义工家长们更是功不可没。
48f7c74d66752ab9022f8963da7488c86312c5bd.translatedText: Phoenix Chinese School’s Spring Festival Garden Party in the Year of the Horse ended with food, performances, lucky draws and laughter. The Chinese school would like to express special thanks to Mesa Community College for its greatest support and cooperation, which enabled the Spring Festival Garden Party to be held smoothly. In addition, all the volunteer parents who silently help are indispensable.

4c7933c009df70e818a2513cc94d1106c77ba9d7.sourceText: 中国驻洛杉矶总领馆邱绍芳总领事与总领馆各组别官员 1 月 4 日在中领馆举行新春媒体招待会。 邱总领事致辞时表示， 2011 年是中国和平发展进程取得新的重要进展的一年，也是中美关系保持总体稳定的一年。 中国国家主席胡锦涛年初成功访美，开启了中美建设相互尊重，互利共赢的合作伙伴关系的新阶段。 8 月拜登副总统成功访华，进一步推动落实两国领导人达成的共识。 胡锦涛主席访美期间与奥巴马总统共同宣布建立的中美省州长论坛机制，得到中美两国各地方政府的积极响应和参与，省州地方合作日益成为推动两国关系发展的生力军。 邱总领事接着说，中美两国共同利益不断扩大，合作领域不断拓展。 据中国海关统计，去年 1-11 月中美两国进出口贸易额达 405 ​​ 4.34 亿美元，比同期上升 16.9% ，其中中国出口同比增长 14.8% ，进口同比增长 22.7% ，美对华出口增长远高 于其他国家的出口增速。 中美双向人员交流也逐年大幅增加，仅去年 1-10 月就已近 300 万人次，同比增长 27% ，这极大地拉动在美消费和投资，带动相关产业快速发展。 邱总领事还表示，在过去的一年里，总领馆积极拓展与领区内美各界的友好交往与务实合作，取得积极成效，亚利桑那州州长布鲁尔，夏威夷州副州长沙茨和洛杉矶市 市长维拉莱构沙的成功访华，各地方政府的互访，都取得了积极的成效。 接着，教育参赞陈准民，商务参赞舒骆玫，侨务领事王鹏等各组别负责人一一上台对工作作简要介绍。
4c7933c009df70e818a2513cc94d1106c77ba9d7.translatedText: Consul General Qiu Shaofang of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles and officials from various consulate general groups January 4 Japan held a New Year media reception at the Chinese Consulate. Consul General Qiu said in his speech that 2011 was a year in which China achieved new and important progress in its peaceful development process, and was also a year in which China-US relations maintained overall stability. Chinese President Hu Jintao successfully visited the United States at the beginning of the year, ushering in a new stage of building a cooperative partnership of mutual respect, mutual benefit and win-win between China and the United States. Vice President Biden's successful visit to China in August further promoted the implementation of the consensus reached by the leaders of the two countries. During President Hu Jintao's visit to the United States, he and President Obama jointly announced the establishment of the Sino-US Provincial Governors Forum mechanism, which received active response and participation from local governments in China and the United States. Provincial, state and local cooperation has increasingly become a new force in promoting the development of relations between the two countries. Consul General Qiu went on to say that the common interests between China and the United States are constantly expanding, and the areas of cooperation are constantly expanding. According to Chinese customs statistics, the import and export trade volume between China and the United States from January to November last year reached 40.5434 billion U.S. dollars, an increase of 16.9% over the same period. Among them, China's exports increased by 14.8% year-on-year, and imports increased by 22.7% year-on-year. The growth rate of U.S. exports to China was much higher than the export growth rate of other countries. The two-way personnel exchanges between China and the United States have also increased significantly year by year. From January to October last year alone, there were nearly 3 million people, a year-on-year increase of 27%. This has greatly boosted consumption and investment in the United States and led to the rapid development of related industries. Consul General Qiu also said that in the past year, the Consulate General has actively expanded friendly exchanges and pragmatic cooperation with all walks of life in the United States in the consular district and achieved positive results. Arizona Governor Brewer, Hawaii Lieutenant Governor Schatz and Los Angeles Mayor Villaraigosa successfully visited China, and the exchange of visits between local governments all achieved positive results. 接着，教育参赞陈准民，商务参赞舒骆玫，侨务领事王鹏等各组别负责人一一上台对工作作简要介绍。

1cf5810a5820d4f6f52bb4d80a71b4ba916d511c.sourceText: 中新网10月9日电 据美国《世界日报》报道，当地时间10月4日，2017年世界体操锦标赛在加拿大蒙特娄举行，在10月6日的体操比赛中，16岁美国华裔选手摩根‧赫尔德(中文昵称”夏松”) 获得了女子全能冠军，以55.232的高比分，帮助美国队实现了该项目的五连冠。
1cf5810a5820d4f6f52bb4d80a71b4ba916d511c.translatedText: China News Service, October 9 According to the US "World Journal" report, on October 4, local time, the 2017 World Gymnastics Championships were held in Montreal, Canada. In the gymnastics competition on October 6, 16-year-old Chinese-American athlete Morgan Held (Chinese nickname "Xia Song") won the women's all-around championship, with a high score of 55.232, helping the US team achieve its fifth consecutive championship in this event.

310946c16c47855092c5db5973a97e5759fd809d.sourceText: 据悉，赫尔德是一名华人孤儿。2001年7月18日出生在广西梧州，因被父母遗弃，在孤儿院度过婴幼儿期，两岁时被德拉瓦州的一个家庭收养，从此定居美国。这是她首次登上世锦赛的舞台，此次夺冠令她欢喜雀跃，而她身上与中国剪不断的联系，也受到了多方的关注。
310946c16c47855092c5db5973a97e5759fd809d.translatedText: It is reported that Held is a Chinese orphan. Born in Wuzhou, Guangxi on July 18, 2001, he was abandoned by his parents and spent his infancy in an orphanage. He was adopted by a family in Delaware when he was two years old and has since settled in the United States. This is her first time on the stage of the World Championships. She is very happy to win this championship, and her constant connection with Chinese shearing has also attracted much attention.

b0948de7ab5d0b8631be5343e1061c20ef3a5e90.sourceText: 据悉，由于赫尔德相貌酷似中国体操名将商春松，因此中国体操迷给她起了一个昵称–夏松加上巴西姑娘席尔瓦(秋松)，和俄罗斯选手梅里科娃(冬松)，并称世界女子体操的”春夏秋冬四松”。
b0948de7ab5d0b8631be5343e1061c20ef3a5e90.translatedText: It is reported that because Herder looks exactly like the famous Chinese gymnast Shang Chunsong, Chinese gymnastics fans gave her a nickname - Xia Song, Brazilian girl Silva (Qiu Song), and Russian player Merikova (Dong Song), and they are called the "four springs, summer, autumn and winter" of world women's gymnastics.

b46db39ae3abcb12ed24069e2d769551423ae92e.sourceText: 不知是天性好动还是其它原因，妈妈Sherri在夏松三岁时送她进体操房，原本只是希望孩子跟小朋友玩耍嬉戏，但夏松却展现了良好的天赋。六年后，她达到了美国业余体操第四级。2014年，13岁的夏松在”柳金杯”比赛中，达到了专业十级。经过两年的青少年组磨练之后，她一路过关斩将，最终进入了”成年国际精英级”除体操外，夏松也曾尝试过滑冰、棒球和足球等其它项目，但因为身材比较瘦小，在直接对抗性项目上非常吃亏，加之对体操情有独钟，最终她决定主攻体操。2017年，夏松进入成年组后表现跌宕起伏，在斯图加特世界杯拿下全能第三名，但随后在意大利耶索洛杯赛上跌落到第十。她在两场国内赛的表现也不够理想，幸而在选拔营中找到感觉。2017年9月，在全美的两场比赛中发挥稳定，排名第六，最终拿到了世锦赛的参赛名额。
b46db39ae3abcb12ed24069e2d769551423ae92e.translatedText: I don’t know whether it was because of her active nature or other reasons, but her mother Sherri sent Xia Song to the gymnastics room when she was three years old. She originally just wanted her to play with other children, but Xia Song showed great talent. Six years later, she reached Level 4 in U.S. Amateur Gymnastics. In 2014, 13-year-old Xia Song reached professional level 10 in the "Liujin Cup" competition. After two years of training in the youth group, she passed all the way and finally entered the "Adult International Elite Level". In addition to gymnastics, Xia Song also tried other sports such as skating, baseball and football. However, due to her relatively thin body, she suffered greatly in direct confrontation sports. In addition, she had a soft spot for gymnastics, so she finally decided to focus on gymnastics. In 2017, Xia Song's performance was ups and downs after entering the adult group. He won third place in the all-around at the Stuttgart World Cup, but then fell to tenth in the Jesolo Cup in Italy. Her performance in the two domestic competitions was not ideal, but fortunately she found the feeling in the selection camp. In September 2017, he performed stably in two competitions across the United States, ranking sixth, and finally got a spot in the World Championships.

0628f33ce7360d0b56d2e1d71a6e5cab6a941d87.sourceText: 虽然身型瘦小，但在自由体操项目中，夏松完成了难度达到H组的团身720旋，此外在平衡木和高低杠也掌握了难度非常高的下法。这些成就得益于中国血统的灵巧优势，她的身体柔韧性相当出色，尤其是平衡木的跳步开度和幅度，与队友相比明显占优，这些都是随着年龄增长能继续提高的部分。
0628f33ce7360d0b56d2e1d71a6e5cab6a941d87.translatedText: Although he is thin, in the floor exercise event, Xia Song completed 720 group body spins that reached the level of group H. In addition, he also mastered very difficult moves on the balance beam and uneven bars. These achievements are due to the dexterity advantage of Chinese descent. Her body flexibility is quite excellent, especially the jump opening and amplitude of the balance beam, which is obviously superior to her teammates. These are parts that can continue to improve as she grows older.

9169e78b03cbe883d4ee65baa6a9a6f56601e7f3.sourceText: 早早看出夏松未来潜力的粉丝们，从2015年开始就对其全方位关注，随着成绩的逐步提升，美国一家著名体操网站 flogymnastics 也为她撰文造势，指出她大有希望入选2020年东京奥运会的美国队阵容，这几乎意味着至少一枚团体金牌。在2017年10月4日在世锦赛上，夏松提前实现了世界冠军梦。
9169e78b03cbe883d4ee65baa6a9a6f56601e7f3.translatedText: Fans who saw Xia Song's future potential early on have paid close attention to her since 2015. As her performance gradually improved, a well-known American gymnastics website, flogymnastics, also wrote an article to build momentum for her, pointing out that she has great hope of being selected for the US team lineup at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, which almost means at least a team gold medal. At the World Championships on October 4, 2017, Xia Song realized his dream of world championship ahead of schedule.

3205347c401d5eb9e6fd77a6b24aab23fc501f56.sourceText: 课程目的: 初级课程，为摄影爱好者讲解拍摄原理，并结合实际拍摄掌握基本拍摄技巧。以摆脱相机的自动（傻瓜）功能，进而控制和掌握相机的基本的使用。同时教大家识别好照片的技巧，如何使自己的照片成为好照片。本次课程将首次涉及手机摄影内容，教大家如何构图，和如何抓住精彩瞬间。
3205347c401d5eb9e6fd77a6b24aab23fc501f56.translatedText: Course Purpose: An entry-level course to explain the principles of photography to photography enthusiasts and master basic shooting techniques based on actual shooting. To get rid of the automatic (point-and-shoot) function of the camera, and then control and master the basic use of the camera. At the same time, we will teach you the skills to identify good photos and how to make your own photos good photos. This course will cover mobile phone photography for the first time, teaching you how to compose pictures and how to capture wonderful moments.

8d94b160f6ce93996dfd2c4d99df3fe9e7d5974c.sourceText: 课程长度：四次课，每次二小时。 上课时间：三月二十六日开始，每周六 3：00?5：00PM 课程内容： 第一次，讲解摄影的基础知识和原理。 第二次，介绍相机的功能，解答相机的使用中的实际问题。 第三次，在校园或其他地方进行现场拍摄指导，人物、风景、建筑、动物植物、微距等。 第四次，讲评拍摄结果，学会拍出好照片的技巧。
8d94b160f6ce93996dfd2c4d99df3fe9e7d5974c.translatedText: Course length: four classes, two hours each. Class time: Starting from March 26th, every Saturday from 3:00 to 5:00PM. Course content: For the first time, the basic knowledge and principles of photography will be explained. The second time, we will introduce the functions of the camera and answer practical questions in the use of the camera. The third time, on-site shooting guidance on campus or other places, including people, landscapes, buildings, animals and plants, macro, etc. The fourth time, comment on the shooting results and learn the skills to take good photos.

7a3c71d06ed6b1ad2363f86c5a482b7b97e9ec1d.sourceText: 授课老师简历 李力，网名艺柳白。在北京广告公司从事商业摄影十余年。 2004年，中央电视台《青海行》摄制组风光摄影师。 2007年，北京市政府为08年奥运拍摄制作的画册《璀璨京城》，为其做策划编辑和专职摄影。 2008年，云南省《魅力女性》选美活动做策划和摄影。 2010年，为圆明园风景区和《大众摄影》杂志社联合举办的《魅力荷花》摄影大赛担任策划和评委。 2012年，新浪网主办的中国建筑摄影大赛担任评委。
7a3c71d06ed6b1ad2363f86c5a482b7b97e9ec1d.translatedText: Teacher resume Li Li, whose online name is Yi Liubai. Engaged in commercial photography in Beijing advertising company for more than ten years. In 2004, he was a landscape photographer for the crew of CCTV's "Qinghai Tour". In 2007, the Beijing Municipal Government did planning, editing and full-time photography for the picture album "Bright Beijing" produced for the 2008 Olympic Games. In 2008, planned and photographed the "Charming Women" beauty pageant in Yunnan Province. In 2010, he served as a planner and judge for the "Charming Lotus" photography competition jointly organized by the Old Summer Palace Scenic Area and "Popular Photography" magazine. In 2012, he served as a judge for the China Architectural Photography Competition hosted by Sina.com.

05e12063d07ea1b0decdd4892137acd775470347.sourceText: 为亚省时报创刋廿周年见证 佳叔 报纸在中国人造纸未发明前人们已用竹简刻字传递，现在做报纸既有纸的发明，又有印刷机和邮政托寄，报纸容易做，所以报纸、杂志很多，种类有政治、经济、医学、娱乐和宗教?.等，有大型的国际报和小型的地方报，大型报纸营销全国和国外，有财团和人脉支持，财雄势大，有现代先进计算机，印刷器材，作者广告户多，大多报纸赚钱，小型报是地方报纸，它没有大型报俱备的条件，祇可在某地范围内活动，传播地方新闻，如某侨团选举、春宴、某商号新张，扩充，某户婚嫁，弥月，某人做寿，去世等都有报导，也许有些人说地方报 ”冇嘢睇” 对那些不关心侨社新闻和不涉及自己事的人是事实，但大型外来报除了多点中、港、台新闻外，其他的新闻对鳯凰城人也变旧闻，亦”冇嘢睇”. 廿年前，鳯凰城未有地方报时，侨社的一切新闻全靠人与人间奔走互告或电话通知，那些热心为侨社服务和做过公益慈善的男女侨胞都得不到拍照宣扬表彰，后来，就在这个极需地方报纸的时候，鳯凰城第一间报纸，亚省时报像耶稣般降生，它负起侨社以上的责任，义务报导，使侨胞方便许多，得益不少，亚省时报为侨社贡献很大。 廿年前，记得亚省时报创刋时，甄先生击鼓，甄太太打锣，唱歌人 (作者) 有头厨金余文劲，画家曹今奇，福伯陈英福，关宗任和佳叔邝添权厖.等几人，如街头耍技赚蝇头小钱，当年鳯凰城的华侨不多，两岸政府的政治复杂，故未有财团和政府资助，亚省时报在这样辛苦困难下，然能保立言论自由，持正不阿，后来华人逐渐增多，得到侨社各界人士支持，此乃是亚省时报能生存的因素。 廿年了，亚省时报在风雨中渡过廿个寒暑已非吾下阿蒙，现在它有自己编辑工场，计算机十部，八部，优秀工作人员众多，非夫妇档了，现在的作者由当时几个老华侨增至一百几十人，其中很多是著名作家，来自五湖四海，现在亚省时报已增到20-22页，内容广泛，有文艺、诗对、游记、娱乐，宗教、小说、历史厖.等，谈经济、地产、论法律、医学、开辟学生园地、风笛诗社和英文版、西厨专栏，让那些小作家过瘾，文人泼墨和使新移民学习一技之长，还有新华社供给的中港澳消息，亚省时报有这么多的数据，适合各界人士口味，因此读者遍及全州各埠，国内和国外也有很多，此又是亚省时报生存的因素。 廿年了，廿年裁培，亚省时报当年像个牙牙学语的婴儿，现在已长成大孩，但大孩然需读书教育，又如枝树苗，现在长成大树，但大树然需洒水施肥，亚省时报还需作者、读者、广告户和侨社各界人士支持，正是”好花仍需绿叶扶”。
05e12063d07ea1b0decdd4892137acd775470347.translatedText: Witnessing the 20th anniversary of the founding of The Alberta Times Uncle Jia Before the invention of artificial paper in China, people had already used bamboo slips to deliver newspapers. Nowadays, making newspapers requires the invention of paper, printing presses and postal mail. Newspapers are easy to make, so there are many newspapers and magazines, including politics, economics, medicine, entertainment and religion. There are large international newspapers and small local newspapers. Large newspapers are marketed across the country and abroad, and are supported by consortiums and connections. Financial They are powerful, with modern advanced computers and printing equipment, many authors and advertisers, and most newspapers make money. Small newspapers are local newspapers. They do not have the conditions of large newspapers. They can only operate within a certain area and spread local news, such as the election of a certain overseas Chinese group, the spring banquet, the new business of a certain business, expansion, a wedding of a certain family, a month old, a birthday of a certain person, death, etc., some people may say that local newspapers "Nothing to watch" is a fact for those who don't care about overseas Chinese news and those who don't care about their own affairs. However, in addition to more news about China, Hong Kong and Taiwan in large foreign newspapers, other news has become old news to the people of Huangcheng, and "nothing to watch". Twenty years ago, there was no place to tell the time in Huanghuang City. All news in the overseas Chinese community depended on people telling each other or calling each other. Those male and female overseas Chinese who enthusiastically served the overseas Chinese community and did charity were not allowed to be photographed and praised. Later, At this time when local newspapers are in great need, the first newspaper in Phoenix, the Alberta Times, was born like Jesus. It shouldered the responsibilities above the overseas Chinese community and provided voluntary reporting, making it much more convenient for the overseas Chinese and benefiting a lot. The Alberta Times made a great contribution to the overseas Chinese community. Twenty years ago, I remember when the Alberta Times was founded, Mr. Zhen played the drums, Mrs. Zhen played the gongs, and the singer (author) Top chef Jin Yu Wenjin, painter Cao Jinqi, Forbes Chen Yingfu, Guan Zongren and his uncle Kuang Tianquan Pang, etc., made a small amount of money by performing tricks on the street. At that time, there were not many overseas Chinese in Huangcheng, and the politics of the cross-strait governments were complicated, so it was not With funding from consortiums and the government, the Alberta Times was able to maintain freedom of speech and uphold integrity despite such hardships. Later, the number of Chinese people gradually increased, and it received support from people from all walks of life in the overseas Chinese community. This is the factor that allows the Alberta Times to survive. Twenty years have passed, and the Alberta Times has weathered twenty winters and summers in the wind and rain. Now it has its own editing workshop, ten or eight computer departments, and many outstanding staff, not just a couple. The number of authors has increased from a few old overseas Chinese at that time to more than a hundred and dozens, many of whom are famous writers from all over the world. Now the Alberta Times has expanded to 20-22 pages, with a wide range of content, including literature and art, poetry pairs, travel notes, entertainment, religion, novels, etc. Talking about economics, real estate, law, medicine, opening up a student garden, bagpipe poetry club and English version, Western cooking column, etc., it makes those young writers happy, literati splash ink and allows new immigrants to learn a skill, as well as the news from China, Hong Kong and Macao provided by Xinhua News Agency. The Alberta Times has so much data, suitable for the tastes of people from all walks of life, so readers are all over the state, and there are many at home and abroad. This is another factor for the survival of the Alberta Times. Twenty years have passed since its establishment. The Alberta Times was like a babbling baby. Now it has grown into a big child. However, the big child still needs education and education. It is also like a sapling. Now it has grown into a big tree, but the big tree still needs watering and fertilization. The Alberta Times still needs the support of authors, readers, advertisers and people from all walks of life in the overseas Chinese community. It is just like "a good flower still needs green leaves to support it."

4180ff9e6c9602a78069c5f875ed4237f1f7271b.translatedText: Community voice: The following are community comments and support for Huang Xinmin's candidacy for Chandler, Arizona, in 2014. Community comments and support. (Excerpted from the original text of the support email)

0306b12b59af4c2bbb9446c92288c74eb9396c04.sourceText: 8/26日，当我们注视初选开票结果，在最低端有位华裔候选人黄馨民，可能引不起更多人注意，因他再度落选。 我们可以蔑视任何落选人，但决不能用轻松的态度无视他的落选。 他在我们华人心目中，他只是尚未赢，而他的胜利之时就在2016年。二年之内，他二度参选，第一次得6700票，第二次得11000票。 他个人的努力，替华裔新侨在东区打破零参选的记录，今天虽以11000高票败选，但已让主流深感惊讶并敬佩。
0306b12b59af4c2bbb9446c92288c74eb9396c04.translatedText: On August 26, when we looked at the results of the primary election, there was a Chinese candidate at the bottom, Huang Xinmin, who may not attract more people's attention, because he was defeated again. We can despise any loser, but we must not ignore his loss with a relaxed attitude. In the minds of us Chinese, he just hasn't won yet, and his victory was in 2016. Within two years, he ran for office twice, receiving 6,700 votes the first time and 11,000 votes the second time. With his personal efforts, he broke the record of zero candidates for the new Chinese overseas in the Eastern District. Although he lost the election with a high vote of 11,000 today, he has deeply surprised and admired the mainstream.

7da7982bca743d0ef9b6358820007c1fc8a6de42.sourceText: 不信华裔不能赢，决战就在2016年，希望黄馨民的感谢餐会就是2016竞选活动的第一天。 黄馨民没有输，而胜利之日就在2016年，让我们向自己发出集结号令，支持黄馨民，支持华裔候选人再战2016 ！
7da7982bca743d0ef9b6358820007c1fc8a6de42.translatedText: If you don’t believe that Chinese Americans cannot win, the decisive battle will be in 2016. I hope Huang Xinmin’s thank you dinner will be the first day of the 2016 election campaign. Huang Xinmin did not lose, and the day of victory is in 2016. Let us issue a rallying call to ourselves, support Huang Xinmin, and support Chinese candidates to fight again in 2016!

4c685ff485ec908b7dd8d51166a0ea919f13442a.sourceText: 谢谢高大哥，Uncle Albert Lin, 秋子，Helen, 各位兄弟姐妹们的支持和鼔励，以及在竞选过程中所提供的各种帮助。很抱歉没能当选，辜负了大家的期望，但是我们选得并不难看。这一切荣耀，归于所有的支持者。
4c685ff485ec908b7dd8d51166a0ea919f13442a.translatedText: Thank you to Brother Gao, Uncle Albert Lin, Qiuzi, Helen, and all brothers and sisters for their support and encouragement, as well as all the help provided during the campaign. I'm sorry that we were not elected and failed to live up to everyone's expectations, but our election was not ugly. All this glory goes to all supporters.

9c4ea0d56680b2eb84c082fa31a1519ec7c0d98f.sourceText: 借这个机会，还有些心理话想和大家说一下。
9c4ea0d56680b2eb84c082fa31a1519ec7c0d98f.translatedText: Taking this opportunity, I would like to share some psychological words with you.

a77d979174ee539b775243bea9cbbc8c633cdd7e.sourceText: 二度参选，消耗了大量的时间、精力、和金钱。我的背景是教育，名利于我如浮云。服务社会有很多方法，参政只是其中之一，但却是非常有力的方式，我希望能够藉由这个职位，从政治上，为大家做更有力的服务。
a77d979174ee539b775243bea9cbbc8c633cdd7e.translatedText: Running for election for the second time has consumed a lot of time, energy, and money. My background is in education, and fame has been a blessing to me. There are many ways to serve society, and participating in politics is only one of them, but it is a very powerful way. I hope to use this position to serve everyone more effectively politically.

c4e940a923220056d858e1aba1aa2a06d5d0d1f4.sourceText: 馨民是个脸皮薄，重视个人隐私的人。虽然我有政治抱负和理想，但是参选让我失去穿着的自由，必须天天刮鬍子，还要厚起脸皮去拉票、募款，而且失去了个人隐私；过程中我遇到过言语羞辱、英文报纸记者乱写和诋毁、还有对手派人来做政治威胁和逼退。馨民曾经有过退选的念头。但是参选也让我认识了不少好朋友，扩大了我的视野，并在无形中拉近了亚裔各族群以及主流社会的距离。
c4e940a923220056d858e1aba1aa2a06d5d0d1f4.translatedText: Xinmin is a thin-skinned person who values ​​personal privacy. Although I have political ambitions and ideals, running for the election made me lose the freedom to dress. I had to shave every day, and I had to be shameless to canvass votes and fundraisers. I also lost my personal privacy. During the process, I encountered verbal humiliation, English newspaper reporters wrote and slandered me, and my opponents sent people to make political threats and force me to withdraw. Xinmin once thought about withdrawing from the election. But running for the election also made me meet many good friends, broadened my horizons, and invisibly brought me closer to the various Asian ethnic groups and mainstream society.

eb593414d8274fb0c78b6cb04e7f60f33aa878e0.sourceText: 如果我们仔细计算，在Chandler 的亚裔票数全部不会超过一千张（扣掉不是公民，未满十八岁，没有注册，没去投票），这些票不见得会全部投给我。换句话说，这一万二百张票裡，有至少九千张是来自非亚裔族群。我们只差再二千零五十张票就能取得席位，所以，我们确实在地方政治上为亚裔族群建立了一个滩头堡、里程碑。
eb593414d8274fb0c78b6cb04e7f60f33aa878e0.translatedText: If we calculate carefully, the total number of Asian votes in Chandler will not exceed 1,000 (excluding those who are not citizens, under 18 years old, not registered, and did not vote). These votes may not all be cast for me. In other words, of the 1,200 votes, at least 9,000 were from non-Asian groups. We're only 2,050 votes away from taking the seat, so we've really established a beachhead, a milestone for the Asian community in local politics.

9e89ee954a100c253c7a1e82b14b9e3171b823e4.sourceText: 然而，如果我们就此放弃，二年后，人们就会忘记了这件事，一切努力归于乌有，什麽滩头堡、里程碑通通消失。以后即使还有人想出来，也只能从头开始。我们华裔或亚裔，无论个人多麽的优秀，依然缺乏政治地位，只能扮演可有可无的配角。我觉得这样真的太可惜了。
9e89ee954a100c253c7a1e82b14b9e3171b823e4.translatedText: However, if we give up here, people will forget about it two years later, all efforts will be in vain, and all beachheads and milestones will disappear. Even if someone else figures it out in the future, they will have to start from scratch. We Chinese or Asians, no matter how outstanding we are as individuals, still lack political status and can only play a dispensable supporting role. I think this is really a pity.

3f8c6f7ed783034a16b3b3cc45efb8b737d87c9c.sourceText: 所以，小弟斗胆向各位请求，请再给我一次机会，让我们一起在现有的基础上，再冲刺一次。Chandler 是亚历桑那州第二富有的城市，市政府每天花掉的钱，超过二百万美元，我们只需要分到一点点，就可以办很多有意义的活动。只需要稍微提高一下效率，和减少浪费，就可以省下不少税。
3f8c6f7ed783034a16b3b3cc45efb8b737d87c9c.translatedText: So, I boldly ask you all, please give me another chance, let us make another sprint together on the basis of the current situation. Chandler is the second-richest city in Arizona. The city government spends more than two million dollars every day. We only need a little bit to hold many meaningful activities. Just by slightly improving efficiency and reducing waste, you can save a lot of tax.

77bf1fcc378ed26e0d327ac0821d392710e86eb6.sourceText: 市政府所制订的政策和管理的项目，和市民的经济以及生活品质，习习相关。Chandler City Council 的选区比州议员的选区大，council members 所直接掌握的资源也比州议员多。州议员一任二年，但Council member 一任四年，小弟如果能够当选，扣掉竞选的时间，至少有三年半能够站在市民的角度，为大家谋福利。
77bf1fcc378ed26e0d327ac0821d392710e86eb6.translatedText: The policies and management projects formulated by the municipal government are closely related to the economy and quality of life of citizens. Chandler City Council's districts are larger than those of state legislators, and council members have more direct resources than state legislators. State legislators serve a term of two years, but Council members serve a term of four years. If I can be elected, excluding the time for campaigning, I will have at least three and a half years to stand from the perspective of citizens and work for everyone's welfare.

a7c5139e5c1d57856c6093caca06f0d65096c3d8.sourceText: ” 服务社会有很多方法，参政只是其中之一，但却是非常有力的方式，我希望能够藉由这个职位，从政治上，为大家做更有力的服务。” 由你这句话，我们两年后一定再支持你。不要气馁，只要你的意愿是为大衆谋福利， 你的政见有建设性，定会得到大衆的支持。
a7c5139e5c1d57856c6093caca06f0d65096c3d8.translatedText: "There are many ways to serve the society, and participating in politics is only one of them, but it is a very powerful way. I hope to use this position to serve everyone more politically." From your words, we will definitely support you again in two years. Don't be discouraged, as long as your intention is to benefit the public and your political opinions are constructive, you will definitely get the support of the public.

d0eeb9382bc41142709772a9565769a630aa9b8c.sourceText: ”失败为成功之母” 咱们就由 失败中学习教训吧。不要忘了在这两年内找机会让Chandler的市民，不论是亚裔或其他民族，认识你。Good luck in 2016.
d0eeb9382bc41142709772a9565769a630aa9b8c.translatedText: "Failure is the mother of success" Let's learn lessons from failure. Don’t forget to look for opportunities within these two years to let the citizens of Chandler, whether Asian or other ethnic groups, get to know you. Good luck in 2016.

d2157378b6ac7decdf55b78efd6db9ccc222dfd6.sourceText: 这些亿万富豪直接质疑国会，他们认为美国的移民政策对本国的公民造成了打击。”美国人应该更好，”他们认为。并且，富豪们认为应该通过一项法案，能够不管对方的政治观点如何，而将它接纳为美国公民。
d2157378b6ac7decdf55b78efd6db9ccc222dfd6.translatedText: These billionaires directly questioned Congress. They believed that the U.S. immigration policy has dealt a blow to their own citizens. "Americans deserve better," they thought. Moreover, the wealthy believe that a bill should be passed that would allow them to be admitted as American citizens regardless of their political views.

3b08cea715c2f652500592b85f5cbb0cf32d176b.sourceText: ”国会并没能解决现在存在的问题，如果我们的立法者不能采取一些行动来改变一些东西，那么反对派们就会把状况锁死，并造成对美国国家利益的威胁，我们不认为几乎所有的企业高管都是美国人，是一件很正常的事情。”这些亿万富翁写道。
3b08cea715c2f652500592b85f5cbb0cf32d176b.translatedText: "Congress has failed to solve the existing problems. If our legislators cannot take some actions to change something, then the opposition will lock the situation and pose a threat to the national interests of the United States. We do not think it is normal for almost all corporate executives to be Americans," the billionaires wrote.

d1b845d0679eeb375522c32bae4dc11ac59ec86b.sourceText: 盖茨，巴菲特和阿德尔森认为，大多数美国人认为移民条例草案是为了维护美国公民和美国移民的利益而修订，它应该可以满足不同人群之间的差异，而现在的美国移民政策并没有真正地做到这一点。
d1b845d0679eeb375522c32bae4dc11ac59ec86b.translatedText: Gates, Buffett and Adelson believe that most Americans believe that the immigration bill was revised to safeguard the interests of U.S. citizens and U.S. immigrants. It should be able to meet the differences between different groups, but the current U.S. immigration policy does not really do this.

cb2bf31adfe4ad525db20b889282ff2b9d1678a7.sourceText: 阳光总在风雨后 观亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会选举 留山供稿 5月22日亚利桑那华人华侨联合总会选举，陶来了，杨也来了，这是自2011年1月16日杨成立”新董事会”以来，两位首次在华联组织的会议中碰面，本身就是一个新闻热点。华联从一月份开始的风波，真得让很多人说那句让我们自己都觉得很惭愧的话：”华人就爱窝里斗”，华联真让很多人看了笑话。 杀无赦 估计陶和杨的恩怨就是让他们在一起三天三夜都说不清，其他人要断也断不明，任何事情都不可能有一方是完全对的，另一方是完全错的。大家都拿着自己对的方面来说对方错的方面，怎么说都没有终点。笔者对任何一方都不了解，也不想去分清谁对谁错，但是绝对是旗帜鲜明的站在陶一面。因为杨，为华人做了再多事情，有再多功劳和苦劳，但是在这个事情上犯了 杀无赦 罪行。没有规矩不成方圆，华联作为一个组织，怎么可以找几个人就成立一个新董事会呢？这是真正的篡夺权利。就算陶做了一万件对不起华联的事情，也应该按华联的章程进行惩罚，或者弹劾，何况他没有。如果要说他做的不好，其他人做的更好，那也必须通过章程来限制他的权限，如果说章程有问题，做不到，那么杨第一件要做的事情就是争取人修改章程，然后再达到限制权限或者撤职的目的。杨，或者杨的好友们都该反省，要先明白游戏规则才能来玩游戏。还有那些试图来调节矛盾，要求双方坐下来谈谈的人，有没有想过，这是不可以给任何机会的谈判。有人有意见或者分歧是不是都可以来跟大家选出来的主席谈条件的？破例了一会，以后这个章程就再也站不住了。这是杀无赦的罪行，不能有任何回旋余地。就如中国和台湾谈判，什么都可以谈，但是前提是一个中国，没有这个前提一切免谈。 学无涯 杨是华联的创始人，他曾经为华联付出的心力和财力早有耳闻，他组织的活动也参加过，但是不多，比如汶川地震的救灾演出，那是本人看到凤凰城华人精英们聚得最齐的一次，很成功。2011年洛杉矶总领馆新大使到凤凰城来看望华侨，他也是坐在总领事身边的第一把交椅。老侨们恨得牙根痒痒，因为现场的确还有华人圈子中辈分非常高的资深代表。在这一点上不得不服，杨能做到这点是他的本事。”这能说明什么？又代表什么？华联就是需要愿意为华人付出时间踏实干活的人，其他的都是空的”曾经就有华联的董事表示过这样的观点。这是错误的！作为一个志愿者或者普通的华联会员，踏实干活就是我们的职责，但是作为华联的领头人以这样的观点作为己任问题就大了。华联是一个非盈利组织，但是没有钱的日子怎么过？华联的董事们就是家长，就应该像杨一样，发动各种能力，建设各种关系去要钱（要想当好侨领，这是基本本领），例如找中国政府，当地生意人等等，踏踏实实干活有很多人，华联的董事们就是开拓一切能力去创收（中文学校，ASU学生会的代表另算），为志愿者们创造最好的条件做好工作，把活动办好。 得民心 2011年4月9日和10日洛杉矶大使馆到凤凰城办护照，引起当地华人的轩然大波。往年的办护照是由当地华联来协助办理，没有收任何的手续费，今年除了办护照的60美元以外，有手续费加邮递费80美元。很多华人朋友对这样的收费无法接受。那么总领馆这次选择一个夏威夷旅行社来办理这个业务，而与当地的侨社和旅行社没有任何联系，这跟华联内部出现的问题，没有关系吗？当华人的利益真正受到损害的时候，代表华人利益的团体在哪里？在解决华联内部问题时，有人反复强调，华联的代表性不强，因为华联会员只有几十个，怎么来代表亚利桑那近十万华人？华联的代表性要靠什么来实现？不是做做宣传就能得到，是只有当华人利益受到损失时，它能挺身而出帮助大家解决实际问题，赢得了民心，才会获得。要增强所谓的华联代表性，不是一个杨，一个陶，一个费能解决的，是要经过时间的考验，实践的考验，是一代一代华联为之努力的目标。 华联明朗化的内部矛盾，换护照都是危机问题，也是真正检验一个成熟社团的关键，能者借­­­­这些事件就上位，不能者就下位，个个华人心中都有明镜，民主的进程也是这样建立起来的。华联又重新上路了，不怕被别人耻笑过，只要华联人能从这些事件中学到点什么，跟斗就没白栽。得民心者，得天下，希望四岁的华联学会成长。
cb2bf31adfe4ad525db20b889282ff2b9d1678a7.translatedText: Sunshine always comes after the storm. Watch the Arizona Chinese Federation election. Contributed by Liushan. On May 22, in the Arizona Chinese Federation election, Tao came, and so did Yang. This was the first time that the two met at a meeting organized by the Chinese Federation since Yang established the "new board of directors" on January 16, 2011. It was a news hot spot in itself. The turmoil in Hualian that started in January really made many people say something that made us feel very ashamed: "Chinese people just love fighting among themselves." Hualian really made many people laugh. Kill without mercy. It is estimated that the grudge between Tao and Yang is that they have been together for three days and three nights, and they can't tell the difference. The others can't tell the difference even if they want to. It is impossible for one party to be completely right and the other party to be completely wrong in anything. Everyone uses what they are right to say what the other person is wrong about, and there is no end point no matter how you say it. The author doesn’t know either side well, and I don’t want to distinguish who is right and who is wrong, but I definitely side with Tao with a clear-cut stance. Because Yang, no matter how much he has done for the Chinese, no matter how much credit and hard work he has done, he committed the crime of "killing without mercy" in this matter. There is no rule without rules. As an organization, how can Hualian establish a new board of directors with just a few people? This is a true usurpation of rights. Even if Tao did 10,000 things that were sorry for Hualian, he should be punished according to Hualian's charter or impeached, not to mention he didn't. If you want to say that what he did was not good and others did better, then his authority must be limited through the charter. If there is a problem with the charter and it cannot be done, then the first thing Yang has to do is to get people to amend the charter, and then achieve the purpose of limiting authority or removing him. Yang, or Yang's friends, should reflect and understand the rules of the game before playing the game. There are also those who are trying to mediate conflicts and ask both parties to sit down and talk. Have you ever thought that this is a negotiation that cannot be given any chance? If anyone has opinions or differences, can they come and negotiate terms with the elected chairman? After making exceptions for a while, this charter could no longer stand. This is an unpardonable crime and there is no room for maneuver. Just like the negotiations between China and Taiwan, anything can be discussed, but the prerequisite is one China. Without this prerequisite, nothing can be discussed. Xue Wuya Yang is the founder of Hualian. We have long heard about the efforts and financial resources he has devoted to Hualian. He has also participated in the activities organized by him, but not many, such as the Wenchuan earthquake relief performance. It was the most gathering of Chinese elites in Phoenix City that I have seen, and it was very successful. In 2011, the new ambassador of the Consulate General in Los Angeles came to Phoenix to visit overseas Chinese, and he was also the first person to sit next to the Consul General. The old overseas Chinese were furious because there were indeed very senior representatives of the Chinese community present. I have to admit at this point, Yang can do this because of his ability. "What does this mean? What does it mean? Hualian needs people who are willing to spend time and work hard for the Chinese people. Everything else is empty." A director of Hualian once expressed this view. This is wrong! As volunteers or ordinary Hualian members, it is our duty to work hard, but as the leader of Hualian, it is a big problem to take such a view as our own responsibility. Hualian is a non-profit organization, but how can we live without money? The directors of Hualian are parents, and they should be like Yang, mobilizing various abilities and building various relationships to ask for money (this is a basic skill if you want to be a good overseas Chinese leader), such as finding the Chinese government, local businessmen, etc. There are many people who work hard. The directors of Hualian should develop all their abilities to generate income (representatives of Chinese schools and ASU student unions are not included), create the best conditions for volunteers to do their jobs well, and organize activities well. Winning the hearts of the people On April 9 and 10, 2011, the Los Angeles Embassy went to Phoenix to apply for passports, causing an uproar among the local Chinese. In previous years, the local Hualian assisted in applying for a passport, and there was no handling fee. This year, in addition to the $60 fee for applying for a passport, there is a handling fee plus postage of $80. Many Chinese friends cannot accept such charges. So the Consulate General chose a Hawaii travel agency to handle this business this time, but has no contact with local overseas Chinese agencies and travel agencies. Doesn't this have anything to do with the problems within Hualian? When the interests of the Chinese are really harmed, where are the groups representing the interests of the Chinese? When solving the internal problems of the Hualian, some people repeatedly emphasized that the representativeness of the Hualian is not strong, because there are only a few dozen members of the Hualian. How can it represent the nearly 100,000 Chinese people in Arizona? What does Hualian rely on to achieve its representativeness? It can't be obtained by doing propaganda. It can only be obtained by standing up to help everyone solve practical problems and winning the hearts and minds of the people when the interests of the Chinese people are harmed. To enhance the so-called representativeness of Hualian, it cannot be solved by Yang, Tao or Fei. It must pass the test of time and practice. It is the goal that Hualian has worked hard for generation after generation. The clarified internal conflicts of Hualian and changing passports are all crisis issues, and they are also the key to truly testing a mature society. Those who can use these events will rise to the top, and those who cannot will fall. Every Chinese has a clear mirror in their hearts, and the democratic process is also established in this way. Hualian is on the road again, not afraid of being ridiculed by others. As long as Hualian people can learn something from these incidents, the fight will not be in vain. Those who win the hearts of the people win the world. I hope that the four-year-old Hualian will learn to grow.

4a98e2ce65f3124fc4d622baed3e419b10ee6342.sourceText: 核心提示：骆家辉2月9日下午在北京宣布，自2月13日起，美国驻华使团将开始实施一项简化签证审理手续的试行计划。一些合格的非移民签证申请人，如果在之前持有的签证失效48个月(即4年)内续签，且签证种类与上次相同，则可以为他们免去面谈，予以续签。
4a98e2ce65f3124fc4d622baed3e419b10ee6342.translatedText: Core tip: Locke announced in Beijing on the afternoon of February 9 that starting from February 13, the U.S. Mission in China will begin to implement a pilot plan to simplify visa processing procedures. If some qualified non-immigrant visa applicants renew their visa within 48 months (i.e. 4 years) of expiration, and the visa type is the same as last time, they can be renewed without an interview.

7c7bcc9b707db814d799d8b256f4c7f5a1acff64.sourceText: 美国驻华大使骆家辉2月9日下午在北京宣布，自2月13日起，美国驻华使团将开始实施一项简化签证审理手续的试行计划。一些合格的非移民签证申请人，如果在之前持有的签证失效48个月(即4年)内续签，且签证种类与上次相同，则可以为他们免去面谈，予以续签。
7c7bcc9b707db814d799d8b256f4c7f5a1acff64.translatedText: U.S. Ambassador to China Gary Locke announced in Beijing on the afternoon of February 9 that starting from February 13, the U.S. Mission in China will begin implementing a pilot plan to simplify visa processing procedures. If some qualified non-immigrant visa applicants renew their visa within 48 months (i.e. 4 years) of expiration, and the visa type is the same as last time, they can be renewed without an interview.

2265961018a9b2967ddb19e4072dd617723d6847.sourceText: 据介绍，在中国，该计划将涉及到之前持有B(临时商务及旅游访问者)、C1(过境)、D(机组、船组人员)、F(学生)、J(交流访问)、M(非学术学生)以及O(特殊才能)签证的人员。
2265961018a9b2967ddb19e4072dd617723d6847.translatedText: According to reports, in China, the plan will involve people who have previously held B (temporary business and tourist visitors), C1 (transit), D (crew, crew members), F (students), J (exchange visits), M (non-academic students) and O (special talents) visas.

d9aac59e087090c06bae0f796cd9d902bf111fa2.sourceText: 这一新的举措也将使首次签证申请人受惠，在一年时间内，能够为他们增加多达10万个面谈机会。不过骆家辉也指出，美国领事官员仍然有权面谈任何他们判定需要亲自面谈的申请人。
d9aac59e087090c06bae0f796cd9d902bf111fa2.translatedText: This new initiative will also benefit first-time visa applicants, providing them with up to 100,000 additional interview opportunities within one year. However, Locke also pointed out that U.S. consular officials still have the authority to interview any applicant they determine needs to be interviewed in person.

cff26fbb3807b15eeb518447ac25b7a3aca11013.sourceText: 此外，骆家辉还介绍了美国驻华使团在加强领事业务方面所做的新工作。为满足2012年及随后日益增长的需求，美国正派出50名新的领事官员到中国，并将在几个月内重新开放位于北京第一外交区的原美国使馆领事设施。”重新开放此设施将使我们在北京的面谈能力增加50%。”骆家辉大使说。
cff26fbb3807b15eeb518447ac25b7a3aca11013.translatedText: In addition, Locke also introduced the new work done by the US Mission in China to strengthen consular services. To meet growing demand in 2012 and beyond, the United States is sending 50 new consular officers to China and will reopen the former U.S. Embassy consular facility in Beijing's First Diplomatic District within months. "Reopening this facility will increase our interview capacity in Beijing by 50%," said Ambassador Locke.

3dfb7f31b5b8e073b878b09a10625c27cd89bdcd.sourceText: 美国驻华使团还在广州和上海开放了新的领事设施以扩大处理签证审理能力。
3dfb7f31b5b8e073b878b09a10625c27cd89bdcd.translatedText: The U.S. Mission in China also opened new consular facilities in Guangzhou and Shanghai to expand its visa processing capacity.

b1834a9796e4d5ac585801da64daca0de325d0e7.sourceText: 骆家辉大使表示：”赴美旅行将促进我们两个文化和人民间更好地了解。我们乐于迎接随着满足对我们签证需求爆炸式增长而带来的挑战。”
b1834a9796e4d5ac585801da64daca0de325d0e7.translatedText: Ambassador Locke said: "Travel to the United States will promote a better understanding between our two cultures and peoples. We welcome the challenges that come with meeting the explosive growth in demand for our visas."

a145a114e6d8bcb666a72035c4da9a79eaa22fc9.sourceText: 2011年，美国使领馆在中国处理了超过100万份签证申请，比之前一年增加34%。在2012财年的前几个月中，美国使领馆在中国已经处理的签证数量比2011年同期增加48%。与此同时，美国驻华使领馆大幅减少了在中国的面谈等候时间。截至2月8日，在驻华使领馆的等候面谈时间都少于6天。
a145a114e6d8bcb666a72035c4da9a79eaa22fc9.translatedText: In 2011, U.S. embassies and consulates processed more than 1 million visa applications in China, a 34% increase from the previous year. In the first few months of fiscal year 2012, the number of visas processed by U.S. embassies and consulates in China increased by 48% compared with the same period in 2011. At the same time, the U.S. embassy and consulates in China have significantly reduced waiting times for interviews in China. As of February 8, the waiting time for interviews at the embassy and consulates in China was less than 6 days.

f62c70f7e55f81c8aec3f995c9e6834264210bae.sourceText: 2012年1月19日，美国总统奥巴马签署行政命令以促进美国旅游业发展，其中包括下令美国务院和国土安全部着手简化和加速非移民签证的申请程序。在中国的目标是在2012年将中国的签证处理能力提高40%。
f62c70f7e55f81c8aec3f995c9e6834264210bae.translatedText: On January 19, 2012, U.S. President Obama signed an executive order to promote the development of U.S. tourism, including ordering the U.S. Department of State and Department of Homeland Security to simplify and accelerate the application process for non-immigrant visas. The goal in China is to increase China's visa processing capacity by 40% in 2012.

a7e76326a508fbd610e440648271ac3983c1cff1.sourceText: 近年来，中国购房者海外投资的热情日益高涨，2013年10月3日，记者实地探访了美国加州多地的房地产市场，跟拍了不少来自中国的看房团的行程。
a7e76326a508fbd610e440648271ac3983c1cff1.translatedText: In recent years, Chinese home buyers have become increasingly enthusiastic about investing overseas. On October 3, 2013, the reporter visited the real estate markets in many places in California, USA, and followed the itineraries of many home viewing groups from China.

e0d2b80bf0cf2485240334fa3a44ba3f6b96fe63.sourceText: 巴洛阿图市DeLeonRealty公司的经纪人说：”海外投资者将竞争提升到新水平。有些人来湾区学习，然后留下来。有些是持旅游或投资签证来的新贵。还有来度个周末的高端买家，看好了下单就走。三到四成买家全部付现，他们买投资房产，几乎一上市什么都买。”
e0d2b80bf0cf2485240334fa3a44ba3f6b96fe63.translatedText: A broker from DeLeonRealty in Balo Alto City said: "Overseas investors have raised competition to a new level. Some come to the Bay Area to study and then stay. Some are upstarts who come with tourist or investment visas. There are also high-end buyers who come for a weekend and leave after making a promising purchase. Thirty to forty percent of buyers pay all in cash. They buy investment properties and almost everything as soon as they come on the market."

be1be2d26a808018734825e05ea165322a15f0fc.sourceText: 郡卫生局和亚省中国餐馆协会近期召开工作会议。新任卫生局长Andy Linton率领十位高级行政区主管，及特派专员王丽憬到场。亚省中餐馆会主席张华芳及董事局成员和餐馆业代表等十一人出席会议。 会议上，卫生局长谈及日后的卫生核查和管理方法, 卫生核查将有调整，如以往餐馆卫生工作由业主负责，日后可以由指定的卫生经理去处理，由经理去纠正员工的错失。还有, 以前䬸馆卫生检查不合格, 会当即评分留底，甚至见报上电视，日后会宽限三天时间, 让餐馆去改正。叧外，餐馆也可请卫生局派员到会员餐馆上课。有关如此种种题都在会议上得到交流。 中餐馆会参加座谈会的有主席张华芳, 董事局成员杨振纲、陆少明、高志中、頼甲乙、关兆峰，巫宜钊、张肇鸿、任达宏等，餐馆代表有Tony tang、 Andy Wong 、Tony diep等。新的卫生管理方法，日后会由卫生局以中、英文文件转交餐馆会员。更多资讯可浏览中国餐馆协会网站 http://www.craa.us
be1be2d26a808018734825e05ea165322a15f0fc.translatedText: The County Health Bureau and the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association recently held a working meeting. The new Director of Health, Andy Linton, led ten senior administrative district directors and special commissioner Wang Lijing to attend. Eleven people including Zhang Huafang, chairman of the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association, board members and restaurant industry representatives attended the meeting. At the meeting, the Director of Health talked about the future sanitation inspection and management methods. The sanitation inspection will be adjusted. For example, in the past, the restaurant sanitation work was the responsibility of the owner. In the future, it can be handled by the designated sanitation manager, who will correct the mistakes of employees. Also, in the past, if a restaurant failed to pass the health inspection, it would be given a negative rating immediately, and it would even be reported in the newspaper and on TV. In the future, the restaurant would be given three days to make corrections. In addition, restaurants can also ask the Health Bureau to send personnel to teach classes at member restaurants. Various issues related to this were discussed at the meeting. Chinese restaurants will attend the symposium including Chairman Zhang Huafang, board members Yang Zhengang, Lu Shaoming, Gao Zhizhong, Li Jiayi, Guan Zhaofeng, Wu Yizhao, Zhang Zhaohong, Ren Dahong, etc. Restaurant representatives include Tony tang, Andy Wong, Tony diep, etc. The new hygiene management methods will be forwarded to restaurant members in Chinese and English documents by the Health Bureau in the future. For more information, please visit the Chinese Restaurant Association website http://www.craa.us

206b0cbdd71323645b1728fd8d67a25cc3471658.sourceText: 为节省开支 邮政局拟关闭数千邮局 去年亏损80亿美元、目前已陷入财政困境的美国邮政总局，正在研拟关闭数千个地方邮局的方案，以期节省开支。 检讨各地邮局的存废 据美联社报导，在面临被检讨或关闭的大约3,600个邮局中，大多数都在乡村地区，但邮政官员表示，他们正在考虑替代服务，如将邮局安插在当地的商店、市政厅或社区中心中。在这些情况下，所谓的乡村邮局将替代被关闭的邮局。而且，被纳入检讨的邮局并不一定意味着会被关闭。 邮政总局在1月份宣布，将对1,400个考虑要关闭的邮局进行检讨。到目前为止，已有280个被关闭，200个经检讨后仍继续营业，620个仍在检讨中，还有300个将挪入新的检讨名单之列。 一旦某个邮局被选中进行检讨，由该邮局提供服务的顾客将有60天时间递交他们的意见，如果一个邮局将要被关闭，他们将可以向独立的邮政管理委员会申诉。 目前，美国邮政系统有31,000多个地方邮局、邮政分局及邮政站在运营，而10年前却有38,000个。 采行其它方案降低成本 正当经济衰退造成广告邮件大量滑落之际，邮政总局一直苦于应付互联网的发展对邮件带来的损失。 去年，估计有50%的帐单是通过互联网而非邮件寄送，而这种情况在10年前仅有5%。另外，邮政总局在过去几年中还大量裁员，减少了数十亿美元的成本。 同时，它还请求国会允许其减少工作时间至一周五天递送邮件，并放宽其年金支付的条件，此每年55亿美元的付款为未来退休人员的健康福利提供资金。
206b0cbdd71323645b1728fd8d67a25cc3471658.translatedText: To save money, the Postal Service plans to close thousands of post offices. The U.S. Postal Service, which lost $8 billion last year and is now in financial trouble, is working on a plan to close thousands of local post offices in order to save money. According to the Associated Press, most of the approximately 3,600 post offices facing review or closure are in rural areas, but postal officials said they are considering alternative services, such as placing post offices in local stores, city halls or community centers. In these cases, so-called rural post offices will replace the closed ones. And just because a post office is included in the review does not necessarily mean it will be closed. The Postal Service announced in January that it would review 1,400 post offices that were being considered for closure. So far, 280 have been closed, 200 are still open after review, 620 are still under review, and 300 will be moved to the new review list. Once a post office is selected for review, customers served by the post office will have 60 days to submit their views and, if a post office is to be closed, they will be able to appeal to the independent Postal Regulatory Commission. Currently, the U.S. Postal System operates more than 31,000 local post offices, branch offices and postal stations, up from 38,000 10 years ago. Adopt other solutions to reduce costs Just as the economic recession has caused a large decline in advertising mail, the Postal Service has been struggling to cope with the losses caused by the development of the Internet. Last year, an estimated 50% of bills were sent over the Internet rather than by mail, up from just 5% a decade ago. In addition, the Postal Service has made significant layoffs over the past few years, reducing costs by billions of dollars. It is also asking Congress to allow it to reduce its hours to deliver mail five days a week and to relax the terms of its annuity payments, a $5.5 billion annual payment that funds future retiree health benefits.
