bc97b79342feac131560e6e8f5527c29854679de.translatedText: Reporter Chen Cihui reports from Los Angeles

91604415b09b3ea7ac7bc4e4ff321dff4870fa56.sourceText: 政府预算捉襟见肘，纽约州府从前年底迄今先后展开两波大规模的联邦医疗补助（Medicaid）诈欺调查。 多元化的洛杉矶也山雨欲来？ 洛杉矶县检察官办公室发言人吉伯森（Sandi Gibbons）表示，长期以来查缉各类诈欺案件均是该单位重点工作，包括联邦医疗补助诈欺，但洛县并未像纽约州一样展开联邦医疗补助诈欺特别 调查计画。 不过，华裔「装穷」贪领医疗福利便宜，最后得不偿失或身后房产须优先清偿医疗债务的案例不少，值得华裔警惕借镜。 吉伯森说，通常是根据检举或主动侦办进行联邦医疗补助诈欺案调查，每年查缉的联邦医疗诈欺案不在少数，追回可观的政府医疗补助金。 「纽约时报」报导，由于经济衰退，加上大批雇主缩减公司提供的健保福利，许多州的医疗补助计画申请人数，均快速激增，在过去一年多内，很多州享受Medicaid福利人数增加5 %至10%。 保险经纪张国兴表示，虽然目前加州相关单位尚未主动出击查缉医疗补助诈欺案，但据加州保险局统计，去年各类诈欺案件诈领的保险理赔或补助，让每位加州纳税居民平均负担已高达875 元，在政府赤字预算缺口愈来愈大下，的确有必要加强监控社会福利的滥用或诈用。 保险经纪裴克文说，美国从1776年立国以来，即建立课税制度，对低收入或弱势族群也提供立意良好的社会福利制度，但有些投机者就玩藏匿财产，假扮穷人、诈领医疗 及社会福利，但诈领福利仅能诈骗一时，不可能永远。 红蓝白卡（Medi-Medi）申请人虽也限低收入者，但允许拥有一栋房地产者申请。 住在蒙特利公园市的王先生，15年前移民洛杉矶后，在老人中心朋友的介绍下，委请一家代办公司申请红蓝白卡，住着华屋却享领不花一分一毫的 医疗补助，结果老人家过世后，名下房地产第一顺位即须清偿医疗债务。 住在圣盖博租屋的张姓老夫妇，收入不高，银行存款也有限，今年初申请加州白卡（MediCal）却被拒绝。 原因是这几年美国房地产价下滑，中国大陆亲友想在洛杉矶买房，去年就从中国汇了28万美元，进入张先生的银行帐户，以张先生的名义在哈冈买了一户城市 屋（Townhouse），再过户给中国大陆的亲友。 未实质拥有房地产的张先生，因有购屋纪录，丧失申请加州白卡的资格。 裴克文表示，红蓝白卡或白卡（Medicaid）的设计目的，均在帮助照护贫穷者的健康，依照规定，红蓝白卡持卡人过世前30个月内的房地产，医疗债务有 第一顺位的债权。 白卡申请人在申请前30个月内，名下不能拥有任何房地产。 本身为律师的罗省中华会馆副主席谭君隆表示，诈领联邦医疗补助触犯刑法，轻则缴回补助金，重者甚至可能要坐牢，被查缉到诈领医疗补助者，最好配合行政处理程序 ，尽快缴回补助金。
91604415b09b3ea7ac7bc4e4ff321dff4870fa56.translatedText: The government budget is stretched thin, and the New York State government has launched two waves of large-scale federal Medicaid (Medicaid) fraud investigations since the end of last year. Is trouble coming to diverse Los Angeles? Sandi Gibbons, a spokesperson for the Los Angeles County Prosecutor's Office, said that detecting various fraud cases has long been a priority of the unit, including federal Medicaid fraud, but Los Angeles County has not launched a special federal Medicaid fraud investigation program like New York State. However, there are many cases where Chinese Americans "pretend to be poor" in order to get cheaper medical benefits, and end up losing more than they gain, or the property after their death has to give priority to paying off medical debts. This is a warning for Chinese Americans to learn from. Gibson said that federal Medicaid fraud cases are usually investigated based on reports or proactive investigations. There are not a few federal health care fraud cases investigated every year, and considerable government Medicaid funds are recovered. The New York Times reported that due to the economic recession and a large number of employers reducing the health insurance benefits provided by their companies, the number of applicants for Medicaid programs in many states has surged rapidly. In the past year or so, the number of people receiving Medicaid benefits has increased by 5% to 10% in many states. Insurance broker Zhang Guoxing said that although relevant departments in California have not yet taken the initiative to investigate cases of Medicaid fraud, according to statistics from the California Department of Insurance, the average cost of insurance claims or subsidies fraudulently claimed by various fraud cases last year was as high as 875 yuan for each California taxpayer. With the government deficit budget gap getting wider and wider, it is indeed necessary to strengthen monitoring of the abuse or fraudulent use of social welfare. Insurance broker Pei Kewen said that since the founding of the United States in 1776, the United States has established a tax system and provided well-intentioned social welfare systems for low-income or disadvantaged groups. However, some speculators hide their property, pretend to be poor, and fraudulently receive medical and social welfare benefits. However, fraudulent welfare can only defraud for a while, not forever. Although applicants for the red, blue and white card (Medi-Medi) are also limited to low-income people, those who own a real estate are allowed to apply. Mr. Wang, who lives in Monterey Park, immigrated to Los Angeles 15 years ago. After being introduced by a friend at the senior center, he hired an agency to apply for a red, blue, and white card. He lived in a luxury house but received medical subsidies at no cost. As a result, after the old man passed away, the first real estate in his name had to pay off his medical debt. The elderly couple named Zhang, who lives in a rental house in San Gabriel, has a low income and limited bank savings. Their application for MediCal at the beginning of this year was rejected. The reason is that real estate prices in the United States have declined in recent years, and relatives and friends in mainland China want to buy a house in Los Angeles. Last year, they remitted US$280,000 from China to Mr. Zhang's bank account, bought a townhouse in Hagang in Mr. Zhang's name, and then transferred the title to relatives and friends in mainland China. Mr. Zhang, who does not actually own real estate, is disqualified from applying for a California White Card because of his home purchase record. Pei Kewen said that the red, blue, and white card or white card (Medicaid) is designed to help take care of the health of the poor. According to regulations, the real estate and medical debts of the red, blue, and white card holder within the 30 months before his death have first priority. White card applicants cannot own any real estate in their name within 30 months before application. Tan Junlong, vice chairman of the Chinese Association of Luo Province, who is a lawyer himself, said that fraudulently receiving federal medical subsidies violates the criminal law. In mild cases, the subsidy will be repaid, and in serious cases, he may even be imprisoned. Those who are found to have fraudulently received medical subsidies are best to cooperate with the administrative procedures and repay the subsidy as soon as possible.

7069bc82fca04c659d029e5d01bc228843a65d4c.sourceText: 老年人看中国舞汇演 （华人耆英会供稿） 10月22日晚，华人耆英会有10几位老人到Mesa一所中学礼堂观看了东方艺术学校金秋十月中国舞汇演。 去看演出之前，东方艺术学校的校长曾在电话中告诉我们，这只是一场基本功训练的汇报演出，不要抱太高的期望。 但看了以后，却人人赞不绝口，称赞这是一场难得的好晚会。 1. 按时开演。 一改华人聚会时常晚点的不良习惯。 2. 节目紧凑。 一个半钟头的演出，一场接一场，没有分秒的浪费，使你感到在短短的时间内享用了一份丰盛的文化大餐。 即使是演出中出现的小失误和不一致，也被孩子们的天真所弥补，引发出阵阵欢乐的笑声。 3. 舞蹈表演和基本功训练表演穿插得天衣无缝，特别是加入的两个美国中学的宣扬中华文化的节目，把中美文化表演方式组合在一起，令人们耳目一新，极富创造性。 4. 看到孩子们在美国能有机会得到这样好的文化训练机会，我们真为他们庆幸。 我们知道，这些孩子长大后，大部分不会从事文艺专业，但是这些训练却会受用终身，既锻练了身体，培养了道德，也增强了做事的反映能力和社交能力。 即使到了老龄退休以后，你会发现，这些训练会放射出更加灿烂的光辉，陪伴你度过幸福的晚年。 我们耆英会的许多文娱积极份子就是当年的你们。 谢谢你们给我们的演出，祝愿东方艺术学校不断壮大并取得新的成功！
7069bc82fca04c659d029e5d01bc228843a65d4c.translatedText: The elderly watched the Chinese dance performance (Contributed by the Chinese Senior Citizens Association) On the evening of October 22, more than a dozen senior citizens from the Chinese Senior Citizens Association went to the auditorium of a middle school in Mesa to watch the Golden Autumn Chinese Dance Performance of the Oriental Art School. Before going to see the performance, the principal of the Oriental Art School told us on the phone that this was just a report performance for basic skills training, so don’t have high expectations. But after watching it, everyone was full of praise and praised it as a rare and good party. 1. Start the show on time. Change the bad habit of Chinese people being late for gatherings. 2. The program is compact. One and a half hours of performances, one after another, without wasting a second, making you feel that you have enjoyed a sumptuous cultural meal in a short period of time. Even the small mistakes and inconsistencies in the performance were made up for by the children's innocence, triggering bursts of joyful laughter. 3. The dance performances and basic skills training performances were seamlessly interspersed, especially the two American middle school programs that promoted Chinese culture. The combination of Chinese and American cultural performance methods was refreshing and very creative. 4. We are really happy for our children to see that they have the opportunity to receive such good cultural training opportunities in the United States. We know that most of these children will not engage in literature and art majors when they grow up, but these trainings will be used throughout their lives. They not only exercise their bodies, cultivate their morals, but also enhance their ability to reflect and socialize. Even after you reach old age and retire, you will find that these trainings will radiate more brilliantly and accompany you through your happy old age. Many of the entertainment activists in our Senior Citizens Association were you back then. Thank you for the performance you gave us, and I wish the Oriental Art School continues to grow and achieve new successes!

48f107acf55434011dc172afc4b9ac53e67e7a34.sourceText: 国会参众两院14日晚间就延长社安税 (payroll tax)减税方案，达成协议，根据达成的共识，对年所得5万元的纳税人，今年每周减税额为20元。 国会议员定于15日公布细节，并在本周将法案送交欧巴马总统签署生效。 国会通过的社安税减税方案将延长到今年底，减税幅度为2%。 通过这项方案后，将增加赤字1000亿元。 长期失业者的失业福利补助也将恢复，通过这项方案后，将增加赤字300亿元；联邦政府将以拍卖无线电频道，以及要求联邦员工负担更多退休金的方式，筹措所需的财源。 欧巴马去年9月宣布创造就业方案，而延长社安税减税和恢复长期失业者的失业福利补助是该方案的重点。 社安税减税嘉惠1亿6000万美国人，对年所得10万元的纳税人，今年可减税2000元；对年所得5万元的纳税人，每周减税额为20元。 对于欧巴马而言，通过社安税减税方案不只是一项重大的胜利，同时也把这个议题，从秋季总统大选的议题中剔除，使欧巴马面临的压力减少。 国会议员达成的协议也使提供联邦医疗保险(Medicare)的医生，免于受到医疗服务费遭到大幅删减的窘境。 共和党国会助理表示，国会幕僚人员正在修改有关失业福利相关法令。 根据达成的协议，在大部分州，失业者最多只能领到63周的失业补助金。 失业率较高的州，其失业者将可领到额外的失业补助。 目前在失业率较高的州，失业者最多可领到99周的失业补助金。 14日晚间达成协议，对于西语裔社区也是一项胜利。 本来共和党要求申请儿童退税的低收入家庭，提供社安号码，但共和党国会议员同意取消此方案。
48f107acf55434011dc172afc4b9ac53e67e7a34.translatedText: The House and Senate reached an agreement on the evening of the 14th on extending the Social Security tax (payroll tax) reduction plan. According to the consensus reached, for taxpayers with an annual income of 50,000 yuan, the weekly tax reduction this year will be 20 yuan. Members of Congress are scheduled to announce details on the 15th and send the bill to President Obama for his signature this week. The Social Security tax reduction plan passed by Congress will be extended to the end of this year, with a tax reduction of 2%. After passing this plan, the deficit will increase by 100 billion yuan. Unemployment benefits for the long-term unemployed will also be restored. After passing this plan, the deficit will increase by 30 billion yuan; the federal government will raise the necessary financial resources by auctioning radio channels and requiring federal employees to pay more for their pensions. Obama announced a job creation plan in September last year, and the extension of Social Security tax cuts and the restoration of unemployment benefits for the long-term unemployed are the focus of the plan. The Social Security tax cut will benefit 160 million Americans. For taxpayers with an annual income of $100,000, the tax will be reduced by $2,000 this year; for taxpayers with an annual income of $50,000, the weekly tax reduction will be $20. For Obama, passing the Social Security tax cut plan is not only a major victory, but also removes this issue from the agenda of the fall presidential election, reducing the pressure on Obama. The agreement reached by lawmakers also spares doctors who provide Medicare from significant cuts in fees for medical services. Republican congressional aides said congressional staff are revising legislation related to unemployment benefits. According to the agreement reached, in most states, the unemployed can only receive unemployment benefits for up to 63 weeks. The unemployed in states with higher unemployment rates will receive additional unemployment benefits. Currently, in states with higher unemployment rates, unemployed people can receive up to 99 weeks of unemployment benefits. The agreement reached on the evening of the 14th was also a victory for the Hispanic community. Republicans originally required low-income families applying for the child tax credit to provide Social Security numbers, but Republican congressmen agreed to cancel the program.

1f560f6b22c6e642e046a0205ab9321336dda199.sourceText: 近几年，在国务院侨办和中国新闻社的安排下，走访了中国很多地方。在先后去过西藏、甘肃和新疆之后，今年又走了滇西和川西两地，几次行程下来，算是对于中国西部边疆有了一些亲临实地的观察。
1f560f6b22c6e642e046a0205ab9321336dda199.translatedText: In recent years, under the arrangement of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council and the China News Service, I have visited many places in China. After traveling to Tibet, Gansu and Xinjiang, this year I traveled to western Yunnan and western Sichuan. After several trips, I had some on-the-spot observations of China's western frontier.

9da738fdef7cb9b15ec4e9b8fcd88e111206986f.sourceText: 西部边疆，地域之辽阔，风光之壮美，景色之秀丽自不待言，尤其令我着迷的，还是西部各少数民族的传统文化，以及少数民族与大汉民族之间、边疆地区与中原地区之间在历史和文化上的复杂关系。
9da738fdef7cb9b15ec4e9b8fcd88e111206986f.translatedText: The western frontier is self-evidently vast in territory, magnificent in scenery, and beautiful in scenery. What fascinates me in particular is the traditional culture of the ethnic minorities in the west, as well as the complex historical and cultural relationships between the ethnic minorities and the Han people, and between the border areas and the Central Plains.

8e3443cdf41cc0a12273287cf89fb4a02f21a3d0.sourceText: 在历史上，这种关系有一条清晰的主线，叫做”以夏变夷”，即中原的汉族文化是”夏”，东南西北各地的非汉族文化都是”夷”。数千年中华文明史，夏文化一直都是主流文化，夷文化是边缘文化，最重要的是，一直都是夏文化改变夷文化，融合夷文化。
8e3443cdf41cc0a12273287cf89fb4a02f21a3d0.translatedText: Historically, this relationship has a clear main line, which is called "changing Yi from Xia", that is, the Han culture in the Central Plains is "Xia", and the non-Han culture in the southeast and northwest are all "Yi". In the history of Chinese civilization for thousands of years, Xia culture has always been the mainstream culture, while Yi culture is a marginal culture. The most important thing is that it has always been Xia culture that changed and integrated Yi culture.

797482d3e93de6a7bffb88c1662a93c2723ff866.sourceText: 夏文化从黄河中下游很小的一块地方开始，逐渐越来越扩大，从西周到西汉一千年时间，就已经扩大到了今日中国版图的大部分地区。到了清朝，达到了极盛，成了一个覆盖一千多万平方公里、包括了几十个民族的超大国家。无论有多少战乱，人口的迁徙、疆域的变更、王朝的兴亡，都没有逆转?#20197;夏变夷?#36825;个宏大过程，甚至越是在乱世时期，夏文化和汉民族越是猛烈地双双扩大。
797482d3e93de6a7bffb88c1662a93c2723ff866.translatedText: The Xia culture started from a small area in the middle and lower reaches of the Yellow River and gradually expanded. Within a thousand years from the Western Zhou Dynasty to the Western Han Dynasty, it had expanded to most of the territory of today's China. By the Qing Dynasty, it reached its peak and became a super-large country covering more than 10 million square kilometers and including dozens of ethnic groups. No matter how many wars, population migrations, territorial changes, and the rise and fall of dynasties, the grand process of Xia becoming Yi has not been reversed. Even during the troubled times, Xia culture and the Han nation expanded more violently.

266559e8541d710aab1a8853a1049fa24fa4c032.sourceText: 早在孟子的时代，就曾有”吾闻用夏变夷者，未闻变于夷者也”的断言，理由很简单，因为夏文化高高在上，强盛辉煌，夷文化低低在下，落后原始，用孟子的话说叫做”吾闻出于幽谷迁于乔木者，未闻下乔木而入于幽谷者”。
266559e8541d710aab1a8853a1049fa24fa4c032.translatedText: As early as the time of Mencius, there was an assertion that "I have heard of those who used Xia to transform the barbarians, but I have not heard of those who descended from the trees and entered the deep valley."

35d7b07bcf9b537c55510e5a2141b6f5db097716.sourceText: 犹如乔木相对于幽谷一般不容置疑、不容挑战的文化优势，甚至足以抵消夷民族靠战争取得的政治优势和军事优势。历史作证，每一个征服了中原地区并成为中国统治者的夷民族，最终都在文化上被夏文化所征服，成为夏文化新的传人。
35d7b07bcf9b537c55510e5a2141b6f5db097716.translatedText: The cultural advantage that is as unquestionable and unchallengeable as a tree over a deep valley is even enough to offset the political and military advantages that the Yi people gained through war. History testifies that every Yi nation that conquered the Central Plains and became the ruler of China was eventually culturally conquered by Xia culture and became a new descendant of Xia culture.

5983aaab5531b0500be0738161cb5ebca43fbf3a.sourceText: 夏文化超强的同化能力、”变夷”能力，使得汉民族从来无需靠血缘来使自己与其他民族区别开来，历史上也从未发生过基于血统观念的种族战争。中国历史上的战争在”夷夏之辨”、”夷夏之防”的边界上频频发生，而一旦文化上的”以夏变夷”成功实现，大家就都成了”华夏民族”，不分彼此了。
5983aaab5531b0500be0738161cb5ebca43fbf3a.translatedText: The Xia culture's super ability to assimilate and "transform" has meant that the Han nation has never had to rely on blood to distinguish itself from other ethnic groups, and there has never been a racial war based on the concept of blood in history. War in Chinese history occurred frequently on the borders of "Differentiation between Yi and Xia" and "Defense between Yi and Xia". Once the cultural "transformation of Yi from Xia into Yi" was successfully realized, everyone would become a "Chinese nation" and there would be no distinction between them.

9302d68dc20df36dca8f4831050e02b444724956.sourceText: 犹太民族在世界各地有着各不相同的历史命运，但在中国的命运最为特殊棗像落入了大熔炉一样融合在大汉民族当中，消失得无影无踪了。
9302d68dc20df36dca8f4831050e02b444724956.translatedText: The Jewish nation has different historical destinies around the world, but the fate in China is the most special. It merged into the Han nation like falling into a melting pot and disappeared without a trace.

9d3ff254f6ea171fbe7c5c9595423d599c67c3af.sourceText: 延续了近三千年的”以夏变夷”，终于在 18 世纪之后遭遇了真正的挑战，来自欧美的西夷不仅武力上更为强大，在精神上和文化上也更为强大。从西学东渐再到西力东渐， 19 世纪中叶的鸦片战争之后，”以夏变夷”终于逆转成了”以夷变夏’，三千年来傲视寰宇从未屈尊的老师终于变成了虚心好学的学生，”全盘西化”虽然未被当作口号也还是成了全民族的集体行动。
9d3ff254f6ea171fbe7c5c9595423d599c67c3af.translatedText: The "Xia transformed the barbarians" that lasted for nearly three thousand years finally encountered a real challenge after the 18th century. The Western barbarians from Europe and the United States were not only more powerful in terms of force, but also spiritually and culturally. From the spread of Western learning to the east and then to the spread of Western power to the east, after the Opium War in the mid-19th century, the "transformation of barbarians from Xia to Xia" finally reversed into "transformation of barbarians into Xia". The teachers who had been proud of the world for three thousand years and never condescended finally turned into students who were open-minded and eager to learn. Although "total Westernization" was not used as a slogan, it became a collective action of the entire nation.

deaaa64a484d4af2de417da47ea22c72f899fc31.sourceText: 历史进入了 21 世纪，浴火重生之后，中国再次崛起为一个世界强国，一个新的形势悄然出现了：当中国人从世界上最好的老师变成了世界上最好的学生，当大汉民族也成了世界上最精于现代化、最精于科学技术、最精于市场经济的民族之一，当夏文化也成功转型为现代文化并在?#20197;夷变夏?#30340;过程中获得了新的活力之后，中国历史上大汉民族与周边少数民族之间的夏夷关系，也开始发生新变化。
deaaa64a484d4af2de417da47ea22c72f899fc31.translatedText: History has entered the 21st century century, after rebirth from the ashes, China once again emerged as a world power, and a new situation quietly emerged: when the Chinese people changed from the best teachers in the world to the best students in the world, when the Han nation also became the most proficient in modernization, science and technology, and As one of the ethnic groups with a market economy, when the Xia culture successfully transformed into modern culture and gained new vitality in the process of the transformation of the barbarians into the Xia, the relationship between the Xia and barbarians in Chinese history between the Han nation and the surrounding ethnic minorities also began to undergo new changes.

70999636e6942a3f587d2fd6934171cafedf0114.sourceText: 现在，对于尚未完成现代化转型、尚未进入科学社会和市场经济社会的边疆地区少数民族来说，大汉民族的夏文化又再次拥有了不容置疑、不容挑战的优势。今日的汉人，代表了与世界接轨的新观念、新思想、新知识、新技术，代表了经济增长和社会发展的神奇动力，代表了先进社会对于落后社会的提携救助、共同发展。
70999636e6942a3f587d2fd6934171cafedf0114.translatedText: Now, for the ethnic minorities in border areas who have not yet completed the modernization transformation and have not yet entered the scientific society and market economy society, the Xia culture of the Han nation once again has an unquestionable and unchallengeable advantage. Today's Han people represent new concepts, new ideas, new knowledge, and new technologies that are in line with the world. They represent the magical power of economic growth and social development. They represent the support and common development of advanced societies for backward societies.

3bce2dbee8f92d0f7c296011a4c3f66acefb58e5.sourceText: 这是新时代的夏夷之变，也就是传统夏文化在经历了世界先进文化的改造之后，又再次以先进文化的优势对周边的诸夷进行”以夏变夷”。
3bce2dbee8f92d0f7c296011a4c3f66acefb58e5.translatedText: This is the Xia-Yi change in the new era, that is, after the traditional Xia culture has experienced the transformation of the world's advanced culture, it once again uses the advantages of advanced culture to "transform the Xia-Yi" into the surrounding barbarians.

8c31eb2b57e7f0388508dab81a90e92d13ac7808.sourceText: 从大西北到大西南，”西部大开发”的工程项目处处可见，其规模历史空前。汶川大地震之后，在中央政府的安排下，开发力度进一步加大，由沿海发达省份对西部地区进行对口援建，一步进入现代、”一夜跨千年”的故事到处上演。
8c31eb2b57e7f0388508dab81a90e92d13ac7808.translatedText: From the northwest to the southwest, engineering projects of the “Western Development” can be seen everywhere, and their scale is unprecedented in history. After the Wenchuan Earthquake, under the arrangement of the central government, development efforts were further intensified. The developed coastal provinces provided counterpart assistance to the western region, and the story of one step into modern times and "one night spanning a thousand years" was repeated everywhere.

3c9d60a2bf889e5846dad17baec2305d5f1c4fe5.sourceText: 这也是新的史诗。诸夏与诸夷数千年历史关系，在新的国家体系之内和新的历史时期的全新篇章。
3c9d60a2bf889e5846dad17baec2305d5f1c4fe5.translatedText: This is also a new epic. The thousands-year-old historical relationship between Zhuxia and Zhuyi is a new chapter within the new national system and in the new historical period.

7d6e9cfdf176942c81920f90e42c4321ba771291.sourceText: (本报讯) 美莎市 (Mesa City)姐妹市组成友好团将于本月23日出发，前往广东开平市作为期五天的参观访问。出发前，本週六(8日))晚上．在钱得乐市(Chandler)香格里拉餐馆举行筹备餐会。亚省开平同乡会对于当地友好人士前往本会成员的家乡访问交流，表示热情讚赏和支持。 美莎市)姐妹市在筹备组团访问广东开平市过程中，主动地与成立不久的亚省开平同乡会进行联络。指导美莎市姐妹市工作的、 亚利桑那州国际友好城市协调员安妮．别莱茨基(Anne Bielecki ) 、美莎国际友好城市会长安娜、美莎－开平姐妹市会主席黄世哲等，主动找亚省开平同乡会的理事会进行联络、会面，并参加了开平同乡会等十团体9月10日在凤城酒家举办的中秋联欢晚会活动，从而知道在大凤凰城的开平人状况、了解开平市内经济文化发展和风士人情等概况，为前往开平作参观访问作准备。 5日中午，州协调员安妮参加了开平同乡会在六福酒家举行的常务理事会议。会上，同乡会常务理事们表示，热烈讚赏这次由州协调员安妮亲身参加，由美莎市姐妹市主席黄世哲带队，16位中西社会人士参加,，前往开平市作为期五天的参观访问。预期将受到开平市政府的热烈欢迎。开平市对外交流会, 市外事侨务部门将具体安排该团参观当地经济发展状况，比如水龙头製造、牛仔衭生产，翠山新开发区等项目，以及着名的世界历史文物遗产─碉楼，立园景区. 等等。相信通过这次民间的交流访问，对于推动两地的经济和文化的发展, 将发挥很好的作用。 为支持美莎市(Mesa City)姐妹市的友好交流活动．开平同乡会表示．由荣誉会长关宗任，常务理事司徒秤等参加本週六晚在钱得乐市香格里拉餐馆举行的筹款餐会．将在当场表示参与赞助该会活动经费诚意。日后，在两地进行文化交流，互派学生到当地学习生活，同乡会将尽力作协助。 开平同乡会10月5 日常务理事会议留影, 前排左起:荣誉会长关宗任、州协调员安妮、会长甄硕钦、会长关兆峰、后排常务理事司秤、黄焕胜、司徒日贤、关昆容、余江英。
7d6e9cfdf176942c81920f90e42c4321ba771291.translatedText: (News from this newspaper) A friendship group formed by sister cities of Mesa City will depart on the 23rd of this month for a five-day visit to Kaiping City, Guangdong. Before departure, this Saturday (8th) evening. A preparatory dinner was held at Shangri-La Restaurant in Chandler. The Kaiping Association of Alberta Province expresses warm appreciation and support for local friendly people to visit and exchange in the hometowns of members of the association. In the process of preparing for the group visit to Kaiping City, Guangdong, the sister city of Mesa City took the initiative to contact the Kaiping Association of Alberta, which was established recently. Anne., Arizona International Sister City Coordinator, directs the work of sister cities in Mesa City. Anne Bielecki , Anna, the president of Meisha International Sister City, and Huang Shizhe, the chairman of Mesa-Kaiping Sister City Association, took the initiative to contact and meet with the board of directors of the Kaiping Association of Kaiping, Alberta, and participated in the Mid-Autumn Festival Gala held by ten groups including the Kaiping Association on September 10 at Fengcheng Restaurant. They learned about the situation of Kaiping people in Greater Phoenix City, the economic and cultural development of Kaiping City, and the general situation of people, and prepared for a visit to Kaiping. At noon on the 5th, state coordinator Anne attended the executive council meeting of the Kaiping Association held at Lukfu Restaurant. At the meeting, the executive directors of the hometown association expressed their warm appreciation for the five-day visit to Kaiping City, which was attended by State Coordinator Anne and led by Huang Shizhe, Chairman of Sister City of Mesa City, and 16 Chinese and Western people. It is expected to be warmly welcomed by the Kaiping Municipal Government. At the Kaiping Foreign Exchange Conference, the Municipal Foreign Affairs and Overseas Chinese Affairs Department will specifically arrange for the group to visit the local economic development, such as faucet manufacturing, denim and raffia production, Cuishan New Development Zone and other projects, as well as the famous world historical and cultural heritage - Diaolou, Liyuan Scenic Area, etc. I believe that this non-governmental exchange visit will play a very good role in promoting the economic and cultural development of the two places. In order to support the friendly exchange activities between sister cities of Mesa City. The Kaiping Association expressed. Honorary President Guan Zongren, Executive Director Situ Heng and others attended the fundraising dinner held at Shangri-La Restaurant in Chandelak City this Saturday night. We will express our sincerity on the spot to participate in sponsoring the activities of the association. In the future, the two places will carry out cultural exchanges and send students to each other to study and live there, and fellow students will do their best to assist. Kaiping Association took photos at the executive council meeting on October 5, front row from left: honorary president Guan Zongren, state coordinator Anne, president Zhen Shuoqin, president Guan Zhaofeng, back row executive directors Si Heng, Huang Huansheng, Situ Rixian, Guan Kunrong and Yu Jiangying.

06ff168b54697e6948850d5d2c2e6c98f6e85e9b.sourceText: 4月16日成都市人民政府外事辦公室劉靜蓉處長帶著成都傳媒集團，成都電視台，商報等媒體一行8人，來到鳳凰城姐妹市參觀訪問。本次訪問團是為5月成都20個世界姐妹城市活動做準備。他們將在世界姐妹城市中介紹鳳凰城的特色，並把鳳凰城推介給成都市民，以及世界其他城市的市民。
06ff168b54697e6948850d5d2c2e6c98f6e85e9b.translatedText: On April 16th, Liu Jingrong, Director of the Foreign Affairs Office of the Chengdu Municipal People's Government, led a delegation of 8 people from the Chengdu Media Group, Chengdu TV Station, Commercial Daily and other media to visit the sister city of Phoenix. This visit is to prepare for the Chengdu 20 World Sister Cities event in May. They will introduce the characteristics of Phoenix among sister cities around the world, and promote Phoenix to the citizens of Chengdu and other cities around the world.

f445219a4764dbf921ce88f18c710c7dffa20b49.sourceText: 媒體團在鳳凰城三天的行程安排得非常滿，姐妹市主席劉汝璋幾乎是全程陪同，爭取在很短的時間內讓媒體團抓住鳳凰城的特色。姐妹市政府部門的接洽，到鳳凰城當地支柱高薪企業英特爾訪問，以及到有地域特色的植物園都是本次訪問團的主要內容。鳳凰城和成都都有很特別的地域文化。成都地處中國西南方，有很多的少數民族，所以多民族風情就是非常吸引遊客的地方。然而亞利桑那或者更具體的說鳳凰城也有非常富裕的印第安原住民風情。媒體團來到了Heard博物館。看到了上萬件反應當地原住民的收藏品：生活中吃住的器皿，房屋，穀物，祭祀神像，結婚的禮服和嫁妝等等。最讓人印象深刻的是，這些日用品上的花紋，都和水有關係。畫的絲絲的雨滴，有曲折的閃電，它們都是乞求雨水的象徵。這也看出在鳳凰城這樣的沙漠地帶水在居民心中的重要性。更有意思的是印第安民族也有像中國農曆裡的冬至和夏至等節氣，而且不同的節氣都有不同的神靈來保佑。
f445219a4764dbf921ce88f18c710c7dffa20b49.translatedText: The media group's three-day schedule in Phoenix was very full. Sister City Chairman Liu Ruzhang accompanied them almost the whole time, striving to allow the media group to grasp the characteristics of Phoenix in a short period of time. Contact with sister city government departments, a visit to Intel, a local pillar and high-paying company in Phoenix, and a visit to a botanical garden with regional characteristics are the main contents of this delegation. Both Phoenix City and Chengdu have very special regional cultures. Chengdu is located in the southwest of China and has many ethnic minorities, so its multi-ethnic style is very attractive to tourists. Yet Arizona, or more specifically Phoenix, also has a very wealthy Native American feel. The media group came to the Heard Museum. I saw tens of thousands of collections that reflected the local aboriginal people: utensils for food and housing in daily life, houses, grains, statues for worshiping gods, wedding dresses and dowries, etc. The most impressive thing is that the patterns on these daily necessities are all related to water. The silky raindrops and zigzag lightnings in the painting are all symbols of begging for rain. This also shows the importance of water in the hearts of residents in desert areas like Phoenix. What’s more interesting is that the Indian people also have solar terms such as the winter solstice and summer solstice in the Chinese lunar calendar, and different solar terms have different gods to bless them.

7f39116f1b64886a95674a982798e994b455ed25.sourceText: 农历新年是全世界亚裔一个重要的假期，中国的春节，韩国的Scolnal节，越南的Tet节，包括蒙古西藏都庆祝它。
7f39116f1b64886a95674a982798e994b455ed25.translatedText: The Lunar New Year is an important holiday for Asians around the world. China’s Spring Festival, South Korea’s Scolnal Festival, Vietnam’s Tet Festival, including Mongolia and Tibet all celebrate it.

fbb6f9e07f783df73878df4434d03eb50db8d1b1.sourceText: 农历新年是衣蛾吉祥的开始或者说是个人生活，生意，政府，社区的辞旧迎新。
fbb6f9e07f783df73878df4434d03eb50db8d1b1.translatedText: The Lunar New Year is the auspicious beginning of the New Year, or the end of the old and the new in personal life, business, government, and community.

1bafabec4e46336a7189fa2f53ceb9fb30e23e6e.sourceText: 新年爆竹声声，舞龙灯，跳彩狮，锣鼓震天给新年带来繁荣，幸福和健康
1bafabec4e46336a7189fa2f53ceb9fb30e23e6e.translatedText: The sound of New Year firecrackers, dragon lanterns, colorful lions, and gongs and drums bring prosperity, happiness and health to the New Year

c3eeaa1d898c677ddc54c6d2d73c73b5082c6d2b.sourceText: 根据农历是根据月相周期而定的，农历新年一般是在1月21到2月20日之间。今年新月是在1月28日，是新年的第一天。农历都是跟十二生肖联系在一起的，今年是鸡年。
c3eeaa1d898c677ddc54c6d2d73c73b5082c6d2b.translatedText: According to the lunar calendar, which is based on the moon phase cycle, the Lunar New Year is generally between January 21st and February 20th. This year the new moon falls on January 28, the first day of the new year. The lunar calendar is linked to the twelve zodiac animals, and this year is the Year of the Rooster.

9f0b7fce8d3282202f16d9396d56cc7a8320305b.sourceText: 与亲人朋友一起庆祝新年，交换礼物，准备丰盛的美食，给老人们拜年，祭拜祖先。亚利桑那有很多亚裔的后裔，移民，他们带来的富足文化使亚利桑那的文化更加多元，他们继续保留传统，庆祝农历新年。
9f0b7fce8d3282202f16d9396d56cc7a8320305b.translatedText: Celebrate the New Year with relatives and friends, exchange gifts, prepare sumptuous food, pay New Year greetings to the elderly, and worship ancestors. Arizona has many Asian descendants and immigrants. The rich culture they brought has made Arizona's culture more diverse. They continue to preserve their traditions and celebrate the Lunar New Year.

a2c402217339273bab0622b433609b60ffc9ecfb.sourceText: 我，亚利桑那州长 Doug Ducey特此宣布，1月28日定为”亚裔农历新年日”，鼓励亚利桑那居民一起来庆祝金鸡新年！
a2c402217339273bab0622b433609b60ffc9ecfb.translatedText: I, Governor Doug Ducey of Arizona, hereby declare January 28th as "Asian Lunar New Year Day" and encourage Arizona residents to celebrate the New Year of the Golden Rooster together!

962804903198b0d3eeb11c26f14322a802391f0c.sourceText: 于此同时，亚盛春晚也将当晚在美莎艺术中心举行，今年主办方亚省艺术学院协同现代中文学校，希望中文学校， 孟子中文学校更是将中文，中国书法， 中国画等不同的艺术形式带到现场。 亚省小朋友对自己文化的传承和理解将会用他们的艺术作品向观众们展示！从1月28日晚5: 00pm开始您就能在美莎艺术中心看到中国小朋友的绘画作品展，书法作品展， 还能跟老师们学写中国字，翻译自己的中国名。浓浓的亚盛农历新年味儿，就会从那一天开始在亚利桑那蔓延开。
962804903198b0d3eeb11c26f14322a802391f0c.translatedText: At the same time, the Asia Sheng Spring Festival Gala will also be held at the Meisha Art Center that night. This year, the organizer, the Art Institute of Alberta, collaborates with the Modern Chinese School, Hope Chinese School, and Mencius Chinese School to bring different art forms such as Chinese, Chinese calligraphy, and Chinese painting to the scene. The children of Alberta will use their artistic works to show their cultural heritage and understanding to the audience! Starting from 5:00pm on January 28th, you can see Chinese children's painting and calligraphy exhibitions at the Meisha Art Center. You can also learn to write Chinese characters and translate your Chinese name with the teachers. The strong flavor of the Yasheng Lunar New Year will spread in Arizona from that day on.

c5db8253362bccda25144a1615746ffbd31a79dc.sourceText: (一)丝绸silk 中国是养蚕大国,丝绸的故乡。瓷器和丝绸始终是古代中国对外贸易的绝密技术和看家商品,直到鸦片战争前,英国进口到广州的钢琴,还干不过珠光宝气的丝绸。”silk”的发音,显然是汉语的音译,这个词代表了中国高超的工艺技术和贸易强势。即便现在,丝绸仍在现代生活中充当雍容华丽、典雅高贵的象征。 (二)茶tea 这个词,又是英国人从拗口的闽南话里偷走的。茶,和丝绸、瓷器比肩,堪称古代中国对外贸易的拳头产品。目前,品茶代表了一种生活方式和文化品位,中国人对人生的思考,几乎都能在袅袅茶烟里找到。据萧干的《茶在英国》介绍:”茶叶似乎是17世纪初由葡萄牙人最早引到欧洲的厖英国的茶叶起初是东印度公司从厦门引进的,17世纪40年代,英人在印度殖民地开始试种茶叶,那时,可能就养成了在茶中加糖的习惯。”据说,即使在”二战”那样物资困乏的时期,法国人定量配给咖啡,英国人则要的是茶,还有一点点糖。茶成了欧洲人的”主心骨”,他们只能跟着茶香如醉如痴地行走,这不是本土的历史与遗传;而是异域文化的征服和同化。18世纪的柴斯特顿勋爵干脆在《训子家书》里写道:”尽管茶来自东方,它毕竟是绅士气味的;而可可则是个痞子、懦夫,一头粗野的猛兽。” (三)世外桃源Shangrila(Xanadu) 这是两个近意词。都有世外桃源的意思。”Shangrila”出自西藏的传说之地棗香格里拉,”Xanadu”则是蒙古的元上都。如果要表达”世外桃源”,通常采用”Xanadu”这个词。看来,以出世自居的美国作家梭罗,白白地在瓦尔登湖旁边,做了那么久的”隐士”。讲究”寄情山水、超然物外”的哲学,中国人是当之无愧的开山鼻祖。 (四)风水FengShui 风水,还是音译。它凝聚了古代中国在活人住宅和死人墓地方面的集体智慧。尽管有人打着所谓”科学”的旗号,指斥风水是封建迷信;但是,迷信所谓”科学”,故步自封,则是另外一种迷信。风水的整体原则是”趋利避害”,这也是安全生存最起码的信条。近年来,风水在美国红极一时,从中国人唇齿之间发出的音节,已经成为当代人急需探究的学问。 (五)茶点dimsum 一听发音,就知道,这个略带小资情调的词儿,来自闽粤。英国人有喝下午茶的习惯,几杯印度红茶,常就一碟甜点。英语原本有表示蛋糕、点心的词,偏偏不用,硬要拽一个来自汉语的生僻字。恐怕多少也有与时尚接轨、和东方同步的优越感吧。中国是茶的故乡,茶点也摇身一变,成为登堂入室的英语外来词。 (六)走狗runningdogs 中国式英语贴切地表达了一种见利忘义、供人驱使的”下三烂”。无从考证,最先运用这个词的是中国人,还是英国人;重要的是,英语世界接纳了?#36208;狗?并以汉语的思维抚育这个”外来词”。接纳词汇的同时,无形中也接受了中国人的价值观。 (七)纸老虎papertiger 这是最令人难忘和扬眉吐气的一个新词。缔造者应该是伟大的民族英雄棗毛泽东!他老人家是博学的诗人、雄才大略的政治家、运筹帷幄的军事天才。美国人硬不硬?苏联人牛不牛?原子弹厉害不厉害?厖在他眼里,都是色厉内荏的”纸老虎”。只要跟中国人作对,老子就得碰碰硬,看天下”谁主沉浮”。上世纪50年代的”美帝国主义”、六七十年代的”苏修”,都变成了毛泽东嘲笑的”纸老虎”。这种蔑视强敌、自强不息的精神,当然是中国人对世界文明的贡献。谈笑风声缔造了一个词,足令中国的敌手躲在角落里发抖了。 (八)大款、巨亨tycoon 这种称呼是近些年才流行街巷的,指有钱有势的商人或者企业家,中国传统的叫法是”大掌柜”。被英语拿走,又是闽粤之地的音译。可见,鸦片战争前,中国商人名声在外,马可波罗在书里描写的东方,物阜民丰,黄金铺地。来中国走一遭,就像现在某些”假洋鬼子”上趟拉斯韦加斯一样。 (九)赌场Casino 这个词,似乎是地道的西方舶来品,发音”Casino”竟是福建话的音译,可是,为什么英语要拿它表示”赌场”的意思呢?据传,很久以前,移民到美国的福建民工,拿到一点微薄的工资,便在无聊之际,聚众赌博,试试运气。每次开局,都会嚷嚷:”开始了!开始了!”想不到,阴差阳错地搭给英语一个现代词汇。 (十)小费,赏钱Cumshaw 这个词是闽南话，为了给人一点酬劳,在钞票上意思意思。英语世界也像喜欢”money”一样,渴望”Cumshaw”这个油水丰厚的单词。尽管中国人没有给小费的习惯,但是,对于钱,却并非一毛不拔,甚至比西方人出手还大方。偷走”Cumshaw”这个”鸡蛋字”的欧洲人,一定见过,中国人曾如何挥金似土。其实,东西方对待金钱并没有本质的不同。
c5db8253362bccda25144a1615746ffbd31a79dc.translatedText: (1) Silk silk China is a major sericulture country and the hometown of silk. Porcelain and silk have always been top-secret technologies and prized commodities in ancient China's foreign trade. Until the Opium War, the pianos imported from Britain to Guangzhou could not match the jeweled silk. The pronunciation of "silk" is obviously a Chinese transliteration. This word represents China's superb craftsmanship and trade strength. Even now, silk still serves as a symbol of grace, elegance and nobility in modern life. (2) The word tea was stolen by the British from the difficult-to-pronounce Hokkien dialect. Tea, along with silk and porcelain, was the flagship product of ancient China's foreign trade. At present, tea tasting represents a way of life and cultural taste. Chinese people’s thinking about life can almost be found in the curls of tea cigarettes. According to Xiao Qian's "Tea in Britain": "Tea seems to have been introduced to Europe by the Portuguese in the early 17th century. British tea was first introduced from Xiamen by the East India Company. In the 1640s, the British began to experiment with growing tea in the Indian colonies. At that time, they may have developed the habit of adding sugar to tea." It is said that even in a period of material scarcity like the "World War II", the French rationed coffee, while the British wanted tea and a little sugar. Tea has become the "backbone" of Europeans, and they can only follow the fragrance of tea intoxicatedly. This is not the local history and inheritance; it is the conquest and assimilation of foreign cultures. In the 18th century, Lord Chesterton simply wrote in "Books from the Family": "Although tea comes from the East, it smells like a gentleman after all; while cocoa is a ruffian, a coward, and a rough beast." (3) Shangrila (Xanadu), the paradise of paradise, are two synonyms. They all have the meaning of paradise. "Shangrila" comes from the legendary land of Shangri-La in Tibet, and "Xanadu" refers to the Yuan Dynasty in Mongolia. If you want to express "Xanadu", the word "Xanadu" is usually used. It seems that Thoreau, an American writer who regarded himself as a worldly man, spent so long as a "hermit" beside Walden Pond in vain. The Chinese are the well-deserved originators of the philosophy of "paying attention to mountains and rivers and transcending things outside". (4) Feng Shui Feng Shui Feng Shui is still a transliteration. It embodies the collective wisdom of ancient China in terms of residences for the living and cemeteries for the dead. Although some people denounce Feng Shui as feudal superstition under the banner of so-called "science"; however, being superstitious about so-called "science" and being complacent is another kind of superstition. The overall principle of Feng Shui is "seeking advantages and avoiding disadvantages", which is also the minimum tenet for safe survival. In recent years, Feng Shui has become very popular in the United States. The syllables emanating from the lips and teeth of Chinese people have become a knowledge that contemporary people urgently need to explore. (5) Refreshment dimsum As soon as you hear the pronunciation, you will know that this slightly bourgeois word comes from Fujian and Guangdong. British people have the habit of drinking afternoon tea, which consists of several cups of Indian black tea and often just a plate of dessert. English originally has words for cakes and snacks, but we don’t use them. We insist on using a rare word from Chinese. I'm afraid there is a certain sense of superiority in being in line with fashion and keeping pace with the East. China is the hometown of tea, and tea snacks have also become an English loanword that enters the home. (6) Runningdogs Chinese English aptly expresses a kind of "lower three bad things" that are driven by others and are driven by others. There is no way to verify whether it was the Chinese or the British who first used this word; the important thing is that the English-speaking world accepted the "dog" and cultivated this "foreign word" with Chinese thinking. While accepting the vocabulary, I also implicitly accepted the Chinese values. (7) paper tiger This is the most unforgettable and proud new word. The founder should be the great national hero Mao Zedong! He was a erudite poet, a brilliant politician, and a strategizing military genius. Are the Americans tough? Are the Soviets awesome? Are the atomic bombs powerful? In his eyes, they are all "paper tigers" who are fierce in appearance but soft in heart. As long as I go against the Chinese, I will have to fight hard to see who is in charge of the world. "U.S. imperialism" in the 1950s and "Soviet revisionism" in the 1960s and 1970s have all become the "paper tigers" that Mao Zedong ridiculed. This spirit of contempt for powerful enemies and constant self-improvement is of course the Chinese people's contribution to world civilization. A word was coined in the chatter and laughter, which is enough to make China's opponents hide in the corner and tremble. (8) Tycoon, a tycoon. This term has only become popular in recent years. It refers to a wealthy and powerful businessman or entrepreneur. The traditional Chinese term is "big shopkeeper". It was taken away by English and became the transliteration of the land of Fujian and Guangdong. It can be seen that before the Opium War, Chinese merchants were well-known. The East described by Marco Polo in his book was full of goods and people, and the land was paved with gold. A visit to China is like a visit to Las Vegas by some "fake foreign devils" nowadays. (9) Casino The word Casino seems to be an authentic Western import. The pronunciation "Casino" is actually a transliteration of Fujian dialect. However, why does English use it to mean "casino"? It is said that a long time ago, Fujian migrant workers who immigrated to the United States received a meager salary, so when they were bored, they gathered together to gamble and try their luck. Every time the game starts, people will shout: "It's begun! It's begun!" Unexpectedly, a strange combination of circumstances gave English a modern word. (10) Tips, money reward Cumshaw is a Hokkien word. It means giving someone a little reward, and it means something on the banknote. The English-speaking world also likes "money" and longs for the rich word "Cumshaw". Although Chinese people do not have the habit of tipping, they are not generous with their money and are even more generous than Westerners. The Europeans who stole the "egg character" "Cumshaw" must have seen how the Chinese used to spend money like water. In fact, there is no essential difference between the East and the West when it comes to money.

5b242a8bfbadbdfc11e4d3786775dbb1bd43f4dd.sourceText: 就近日网曝某乳企的牛奶中含有牛尿一事，中国乳协理事长宋昆冈说，他个人认为此事不可能发生。他认为，加入牛尿的牛奶很难通过乳品厂的检验，并且，目前乳品企业支付奶价是根据牛奶中所含的干物质量综合考虑的，所以加牛尿的行为在经济上得不到什么好处。.com
5b242a8bfbadbdfc11e4d3786775dbb1bd43f4dd.translatedText: Regarding the recent revelation on the Internet that the milk of a certain dairy company contains cow urine, Song Kungang, chairman of the China Dairy Association, said that he personally believes that this matter is impossible to happen. He believes that it is difficult for milk added with cow urine to pass the inspection of dairy plants. Moreover, the current price paid by dairy companies is based on the quality of dry matter contained in the milk, so adding cow urine will not bring any economic benefits. .com

8b0dc55fddd105236b1054068654392066f81d8f.sourceText: 就近日网曝蒙牛牛奶添加牛尿一事，中国乳制品工业协会理事长宋昆冈说，他个人认为此事不可能发生。 Mitbbs.com 宋昆冈介绍，目前乳品企业生产过程全部采用集中机械化挤奶，并直接进入奶罐；在牛奶运送到工厂的过程中，奶罐上要打铅封，防止在途中人为做手脚。原料奶到了工厂之后，还要经过两道程序，第一道是感官的检验，要通过收奶工的舌头这一关；第二道程序就是上机，通过机器设备对里边的成分进行化验。往牛奶中加牛尿的话，很难过这两关。 Mitbbs.com 宋昆冈说，从经济角度考虑牛奶里加牛尿一说也很难成立。目前乳品企业支付奶价是根据牛奶中所含的干物质量综合考虑的。所谓干物质，就是把牛奶里边的水分蒸发干，剩下的脂肪、蛋白质、碳水化合物、矿物质等物质，牛尿不含这些基本成分，所以在经济上得不到什么好处。
8b0dc55fddd105236b1054068654392066f81d8f.translatedText: Regarding the recent revelation on the Internet that cow urine is added to Mengniu milk, Song Kungang, chairman of the China Dairy Industry Association, said that he personally believes that this matter is impossible to happen. Mitbbs.com Song Kungang said that at present, the production process of dairy companies all adopts centralized mechanized milking and directly enters the milk tank; during the process of transporting the milk to the factory, the milk tank must be sealed with a lead to prevent human manipulation on the way. After the raw milk arrives at the factory, it has to go through two procedures. The first is a sensory inspection, which has to pass the milk collector's tongue. The second procedure is to get on the machine and use the machine to test the ingredients inside. If you add cow urine to milk, it will be difficult to pass these two tests. Mitbbs.com Song Kungang said that from an economic point of view, it is difficult to justify adding cow urine to milk. At present, the price paid by dairy companies for milk is based on the quality of dry matter contained in the milk. The so-called dry matter is the fat, protein, carbohydrate, minerals and other substances left after the water in the milk has been evaporated. Cow urine does not contain these basic ingredients, so it does not gain much economic benefit.

355e901244585553ef41a17fdfef259f7a2f18bd.sourceText: 据了解，网曝的蒙牛乳业滦南有限责任公司2003年建厂，2004年正式投产，目前共有120多个牧场和牧场化小区。记者就牛奶添加牛尿一事向该公司求证时，公司否认说，无论2008年之前还是之后都没有发生过牛奶中添加牛尿这类事情。 Mitbbs.com
355e901244585553ef41a17fdfef259f7a2f18bd.translatedText: It is understood that the Mengniu Dairy Luannan Co., Ltd. exposed on the Internet was established in 2003 and officially put into production in 2004. It currently has more than 120 pastures and pasture-based communities. When reporters asked the company for confirmation about the addition of cow urine to milk, the company denied that such incidents had never occurred before or since 2008. Mitbbs.com

c16c968f4829cb9361b5917d1ef8f4e408859926.sourceText: 新闻链接 Mitbbs.com 蒙牛否认牛奶中加牛尿 爆料人称是08年之前事情 Mitbbs.com 蒙牛乳业已于5月24日中午发布官方微博声明，称蒙牛全部采用集中机械化挤奶，此过程全封闭无添加异物 可能。同时蒙牛对原奶会进行滋气味品尝、近20项理化指标和40多项安全指标检测，合格后才能进厂，检测不合格的牛奶，蒙牛全部予以拒收。 Mitbbs.com 针对有网友如此曝料，专家表示现在不可能通过检测 Mitbbs.com 据中广网报道，近日，网络曝光蒙牛添加牛尿，中国牛奶再次陷入质量门。中国知名牛奶品牌蒙牛被网友在微博中曝光，利益驱使奶农会给牛奶添加牛尿，因为如果添加水会稀释牛奶。蒙牛公司回应添加牛尿根本不可能，纯属谣言。 Mitbbs.com 蒙牛换帅后又出质量风波，网友”缆逻驼庶”日前发微博爆料：”家乡河北某县，在2008年前农村大量养殖奶牛，由于利益的驱使，很多养殖户直接往牛奶中添加大量牛尿，如果掺水，牛奶被稀释了，检验会不合格，往里掺”牛尿”就不会稀释，而且合格。牛尿奶如何躲得过检查?因为企业检查不严格，甚至走过场。网友的这一曝料受到网友广泛关注。 Mitbbs.com 对此，乳业专家表示，掺了牛尿的原奶不可能通过大企业的检测。 Mitbbs.com 中国食品科学技术学会理事兼青年委员李兴峰介绍说：第一，从技术角度来说，蒙牛等国内大型乳企目前普遍是通过养殖小区和规模化牧场获取原奶，都是采用机械化的集中挤奶模式，已经没有分散人工挤奶再送到企业的情况了。在收奶过程中，还有严格的检测把关，牛尿等其他非牛乳添加物属于安全指标，是必检项目。因此企业很容易就能检测出掺尿行为。第二，从成本角度来看，现在国家包括卫生部在内的多个机构对制假、掺假的打击力度相当大，企业掺假或容许掺假的成本很高，也不可能通过国家相关单位的检查。 Mitbbs.com 李兴峰告诉记者：掺牛尿这种行为确实在十几二十年前在中国乳业刚起步的时候出现过，但是随着企业检测手段的提高，这种手法从气味、感官方面来看，都很容易被查出来，所以很早就几乎被杜绝，对于正规企业来说，现在这种情况可以说”是不可能出现的，除了大企业，连小企业也不会这么做”! Mitbbs.com 擂台赛 Mitbbs.com 蒙牛：挤奶过程全封闭无添加可能 Mitbbs.com 网友：我讲的是2008年之前的事 Mitbbs.com 蒙牛乳业已于5月24日中午发布官方微博声明，称蒙牛全部采用集中机械化挤奶，此过程全封闭无添加异物可能。同时蒙牛对原奶会进行滋气味品尝、近20项理化指标和40多项安全指标检测，合格后才能进厂，检测不合格的牛奶，蒙牛全部予以拒收。 Mitbbs.com 据了解，蒙牛每天所收原奶约8000吨来自牧场及牧场化小区，其他少量原奶来自奶农，蒙牛签约奶农全部是到奶站集中挤奶。蒙牛对合作奶站都有统一准入要求，全部采用机械化挤奶。蒙牛集团在之前接受媒体采访时也表示，企业在全力帮助奶农逐步转为牧场小区，取消奶站供奶模式。 Mitbbs.com 在蒙牛发出官方微博声明一个半小时以后，最早发出”原奶掺牛尿”这条微博的网友@史记人生也发布微博回复：”是谣言不用粉粹，不是谣言也粉粹不了!”。@史记人生在微博中称：”我讲的是2008年之前的事情，这个情况可以到当地去走访调查，问一问奶农们2008年之前的那些事!现在你们有固定的奶站、养殖点，也有严密的原奶进厂检测机制和检测手段，这个非常好，希望你们真正对中国人民的身体健康负起责来，强大我们这个已经伤痕累累的民族!” Mitbbs.com
c16c968f4829cb9361b5917d1ef8f4e408859926.translatedText: News Links Mitbbs.com Mengniu denies the addition of cow urine to milk. The whistleblower said it happened before 2008. Mitbbs.com Mengniu Dairy issued an official Weibo statement at noon on May 24, stating that Mengniu uses centralized mechanized milking, and this process is fully closed and there is no possibility of adding foreign matter. At the same time, Mengniu will test the taste, smell, nearly 20 physical and chemical indicators, and more than 40 safety indicators of the raw milk. Only those that pass the test can enter the factory. If the milk fails the test, Mengniu will reject all milk. Mitbbs.com In response to the revelation by some netizens, experts said it is now impossible to pass the test. Mitbbs.com According to China Broadcasting Network, recently, it was exposed on the Internet that Mengniu added cow urine, and Chinese milk has once again fallen into the quality gate. Mengniu, a well-known Chinese milk brand, was exposed by netizens on Weibo that profit-driven dairy farmers would add cow urine to milk because adding water would dilute the milk. Mengniu responded that adding cow urine is impossible and is purely a rumor. Mitbbs.com After Mengniu changed its leadership, there was another quality crisis. Netizen "Lianluo Tuosu" recently posted on Weibo and broke the news: "In a county in my hometown in Hebei Province, a large number of dairy cows were raised in rural areas before 2008. Driven by profit, many farmers directly added large amounts of cow urine to the milk, such as If it is mixed with water, the milk will be diluted and it will fail the inspection. If it is mixed with "cow urine", it will not be diluted and it will pass the test. How can cow urine milk avoid inspection? Because the company's inspection is not strict, this revelation by netizens has attracted widespread attention. Mitbbs.com In this regard, dairy industry experts said that it is impossible for raw milk adulterated with cow urine to pass the testing of large companies. Li Xingfeng, director and youth member of the China Society of Food Science and Technology, said: First, from a technical point of view, large domestic dairy companies such as Mengniu currently obtain raw milk through breeding communities and large-scale pastures. They all adopt a mechanized centralized milking model. There is no longer a situation where manual milking is carried out and then sent to the company. During the milk collection process, there are strict inspections. In addition, cow urine and other non-milk additives are safety indicators and must be inspected. Therefore, companies can easily detect urine adulteration. Secondly, from a cost perspective, many national agencies, including the Ministry of Health, are now cracking down on counterfeiting and adulteration. The cost for companies to adulterate or allow adulteration is very high, and it is impossible to pass inspections by relevant national units. Mitbbs.com Li Xingfeng told reporters: The practice of mixing cow urine did appear more than ten or twenty years ago when China's dairy industry just started. However, with the improvement of enterprise detection methods, this method is easy to detect in terms of smell and senses, so it was almost eliminated very early. For regular enterprises, this situation can be said to be "impossible. Except for large enterprises, even small enterprises will not do this"! Mitbbs.com Challenge Mitbbs.com Mengniu: The milking process is completely closed and there is no possibility of adding anything. Mitbbs.com Netizen: I'm talking about things before 2008. Mitbbs.com Mengniu Dairy issued an official Weibo statement at noon on May 24, saying that all Mengniu milking is centralized and mechanized, and the process is completely closed and there is no possibility of adding foreign matter. At the same time, Mengniu will taste the raw milk, nearly 20 physical and chemical indicators, and more than 40 safety indicators. Only those that pass the test can be entered into the factory. All milk that fails the test will be rejected by Mengniu. It is understood that Mengniu collects about 8,000 tons of raw milk every day from pastures and pasture-based communities, and a small amount of other raw milk comes from dairy farmers. All dairy farmers contracted by Mengniu have unified access requirements for cooperative milking stations, and all milking is mechanized. Mengniu Group also stated in a previous interview with the media that the company is doing its best to help dairy farmers gradually transform into pasture communities and cancel the milk supply model at milk stations. An hour and a half after Mengniu issued its official Weibo statement, the netizen who first tweeted about "raw milk mixed with cow urine" also posted a reply on Weibo: "You don't need to fan it out if it's a rumor, but you can't fan it out if it's not a rumor!" @Shijisheng said on Weibo: "I'm talking about things before 2008. This situation can be corrected." Go to the local area to visit and investigate, and ask the dairy farmers about what happened before 2008! Now you have fixed milk stations and breeding sites, as well as strict inspection mechanisms and methods for raw milk entering the factory. This is very good. I hope you will truly take responsibility for the health of the Chinese people and strengthen our already scarred nation!" Mitbbs.com

7c6889768128816f94baad6eb895b9a3cf8917b9.translatedText: Phoenix City encountered a sandstorm again on Friday (Photo) A sandstorm hit Phoenix again. Some planes at Phoenix Mesa Airport were temporarily grounded, leaving about 2,000 passengers stranded...

0ac79bb9b19649cb229a3b16b4d42c75d9bf5545.sourceText: 沙尘暴再次袭击凤凰城，凤凰城美莎机场部分飞机暂时停飞，大约有2000乘客滞留。 电视画面显示一些移动房屋被移动，凤凰城南部的一些树被连根拔起。 目前还不知道多少航班被影响。美莎机场周五下午两点恢复正常运作。
0ac79bb9b19649cb229a3b16b4d42c75d9bf5545.translatedText: A sandstorm hit Phoenix again. Some planes at Phoenix Mesa Airport were temporarily grounded, leaving about 2,000 passengers stranded. Television footage showed mobile homes being moved and trees uprooted in south Phoenix. It is not yet known how many flights were affected. Mesa Airport will resume normal operations at 2 p.m. Friday.

efdcea9cb7ea9745cb2944cc76702346c7321f0e.sourceText: 新年伊始，有人看球赛，有人睡大觉，而在斯格思岱尔，数千人选择参加 5 公里长跑来庆祝 2013 年的到来。
efdcea9cb7ea9745cb2944cc76702346c7321f0e.translatedText: As the new year begins, some watch football, some take a nap, but in Scottsdale, thousands choose to celebrate 2013 by participating in a 5K run.

3983148d8289476620c91a013796b16e3fbe15b7.sourceText: 1 月 2 日上午，数千人聚集在斯格思岱尔市政中心，开始 5 公里长跑。据悉，当日在全美有 25 个城市举行类似的长跑活动，提醒居民注意身体健康。
3983148d8289476620c91a013796b16e3fbe15b7.translatedText: Thousands of people gathered at the Scottsdale Civic Center on the morning of January 2 to begin a 5K run. It is reported that similar long-distance running events were held in 25 cities across the United States that day to remind residents to pay attention to their health.

7bb2ad13f1c8596e3ecbf366364dd111061e9174.sourceText: 朱立伦：两岸不能再变成敌意关係 朱立伦于11月10日到达洛杉矶，开始了其选前的”美国之旅&#8…
7bb2ad13f1c8596e3ecbf366364dd111061e9174.translatedText: Chu Lilun: The relationship between the two sides can no longer become hostile Julian Chu arrived in Los Angeles on November 10 and began his pre-election "tour of the United States"...

c1019517a84f8a0407d2fc74f5cd993dfb43e62a.sourceText: 朱立伦于11月10日到达洛杉矶，开始了其选前的”美国之旅”。10日下午，朱立伦在下榻的酒店旅馆，会见了美国国会外事委员会主席罗伊斯（Ed Royce）、美国国会华裔议员赵美心（Judy Chu）及洛杉矶郡郡长安东诺维奇等美国政要后，在洛杉矶圣盖博Hilton举办了记者招待会。
c1019517a84f8a0407d2fc74f5cd993dfb43e62a.translatedText: Julian Chu arrived in Los Angeles on November 10 and began his "tour of the United States" before the election. On the afternoon of the 10th, at the hotel where he stayed, Julian Chu met with Ed Royce, Chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the U.S. Congress, and Judy Zhao, a Chinese member of the U.S. Congress. Chu, Los Angeles County Sheriff Antonovich and other U.S. dignitaries later held a press conference at the San Gabriel Hilton in Los Angeles

4962ba46892ac119620c9bf3d120020daf28d1c5.sourceText: ”因为这个礼拜美国国会休会。他们特别到饭店来看我。都非常关心几个议题。一是TPP和台美之间的经贸合作；二是台湾参加国际组织；也提到’马习会’；我们的老朋友。长期对’中华民国’，对台湾的支持。也谢谢这些老朋友们对朱立伦的鼓励。””’ 朱立伦说。
4962ba46892ac119620c9bf3d120020daf28d1c5.translatedText: " Because the U.S. Congress is on recess this week. They especially came to the hotel to see me. They are very concerned about several issues. The first is the TPP and the economic and trade cooperation between Taiwan and the United States; the second is Taiwan's participation in international organizations; it also mentioned the 'Ma Xi meeting'; our old friends. Long-term support for the Republic of China and Taiwan. Thank you also to these old friends for their encouragement to Zhu Lilun. ""' Zhu Lilun said.

0d0d8691ecf7b5d1e7164514b8282573702d0f5d.sourceText: 朱立伦强调：关于”马习会”，我相信美国朋友也都从媒体中看到了内容。我还是就一些方面给大家做一个说明。但是这不是我此行的主要目的！我此行的主要目的是表达：国民党以及朱立伦如果能当选的话，未来仍让台美关係发展或延续，并是两岸关係的一个和平的维持者。让美方朋友能够了解，我将怎麽样来做一个和平的维持者。
0d0d8691ecf7b5d1e7164514b8282573702d0f5d.translatedText: Zhu Lilun emphasized: Regarding the "Ma Xi meeting", I believe that American friends have also seen the content from the media. Let me give you some explanations on some aspects. But this is not the main purpose of my trip! The main purpose of my trip is to express that if the Kuomintang and Zhu Lilun are elected, they will continue to develop or continue Taiwan-US relations in the future and be a peaceful maintainer of cross-strait relations. Let American friends understand how I will be a peacekeeper.

d9c5ae8c06143fb59ac39d8f0c589defa91de84b.sourceText: 朱立伦说：国民党在两岸关係上面是扮演一个和平、维持和推动的重要的角色。同样未来我们也希望，在整个台美关係上面，不管是我们的经贸关係，或者是我们的安全合作，或者是各项的友谊，都能够延续。希望这次的访问，大家能够给我们多加油，鼓励。在未来的选战中，能够获得各方的力量，大家共同对我们协助和支持。
d9c5ae8c06143fb59ac39d8f0c589defa91de84b.translatedText: > Zhu Lilun said: The Kuomintang plays an important role in peace, maintenance and promotion of cross-strait relations. Similarly, in the future, we also hope that in the entire Taiwan-US relationship, whether it is our economic and trade relations, our security cooperation, or various friendships, we can continue. I hope that during this visit, everyone can give us more cheer and encouragement. In the future elections, we can gain the strength of all parties and everyone will help and support us.

25c2281db0c1b7712060ad6ffd86f59b8135a7b2.sourceText: 朱立伦说：”马习会”最重要的一个意义就是两岸领导人能够经过六十几年之后，能够在一个对等尊严，在全世界大家共同见证之下，能够会面而且能够坐下来谈。当然很多各方都有期待。但是我是觉得最重要的基础就是确立两岸希望以和平发展走向合作双赢，互利双赢。这个过程当中，很重要的一步就是大家彼此能够降低敌意。我觉得这个才是真正的关键重点。大家能够彼此降低敌意，能够增进互信，所有的议题就能够逐渐的让双方走向互信双赢。所以我想这个是?#39532;习会?#26412;身非常重要的一个意义。
25c2281db0c1b7712060ad6ffd86f59b8135a7b2.translatedText: Zhu Lilun said: The most important significance of the "Ma Xi meeting" is that after more than 60 years, the leaders of both sides of the Taiwan Strait can meet and sit down to talk with equal dignity and under the witness of everyone around the world. Of course many parties have expectations. But I think the most important foundation is to establish the hope that both sides of the Taiwan Strait will achieve win-win cooperation and mutual benefit through peaceful development. In this process, a very important step is for everyone to reduce hostility to each other. I think this is the real key focus. We can reduce hostility to each other and enhance mutual trust, and all issues can gradually lead to mutual trust and a win-win situation for both parties. So I think this is a very important meaning of "Xi Hui".

76014a406287b22425dcf91ee5cc6a408ad8cee9.sourceText: 朱立伦说：我也提过几次，对的事情就去做，不必去思考。两岸的最高领导人经过66年之后，能够会面，能够坐下来，一起谈。那就是非常重要的一个里程碑。如果能够延续的话，将来不管谁当选”中华民国总统”。能够持续这样做，对两岸的和平发展或者是合作双赢，绝对是正面的。如果朱立伦当选，我相信这件事是绝对会延续的。那我也非常期待大家都能够建立这样的共识，两岸不能够再走回头路，不能够再变成一个对抗的、一个敌意的关係。在这样一个共同基础之上发展两岸关係是非常重要的。所以我想”马习会”最重要的意义就在这裡。所以当马”总统”跟我提到说，他要跟习近平见面这件事，我都是非常正面的去解读。完全没有去考虑，此与选举有什麽样的直接或者说影响的关係。 朱立伦说：我出访前有跟”总统”见面，我们谈了很多的事情。当然也包括”马习会”。昨天（9日）还有通电话。”总统”对于这次出访很关心，这也表达了我们对于台美关係的重视。
76014a406287b22425dcf91ee5cc6a408ad8cee9.translatedText: Zhu Lilun said: I have mentioned it several times, just do the right thing without thinking about it. After 66 years, the top leaders of both sides of the Taiwan Strait can meet, sit down and talk together. That is a very important milestone. If it can be continued, no matter who is elected "President of the Republic of China" in the future. Being able to continue to do this will definitely be positive for the peaceful development or win-win cooperation between the two sides of the Taiwan Strait. If Julian Chu is elected, I believe this matter will definitely continue. Then I very much hope that everyone can establish such a consensus that the two sides of the Taiwan Straits can no longer go back and become a confrontational or hostile relationship. It is very important to develop cross-strait relations on such a common basis. So I think the most important meaning of "Ma Xi Meeting" is here. So when "President Ma" mentioned to me that he was going to meet with Xi Jinping, I interpreted it very positively. I didn't even think about the direct relationship or impact this has with the election. Zhu Lilun said: I met with the "President" before my trip, and we talked about many things. Of course, this also includes the "Ma Xi Meeting". There was another phone call yesterday (9th). The "President" is very concerned about this visit, which also expresses the importance we attach to Taiwan-US relations.

10826f1080f971f3f37ceeb655cbfd4f2e75192a.sourceText: 朱立伦表示：而我这次来美国访问。当然会传达一下国民党对两岸政策的一个立场。如果有美方的朋友关心到”马习会”，我也会把我刚才一样的message传达给美方的朋友。但是更重要的就是希望我们要表达未来如果国民党能够继续执政的话。在台美关係上面，我们会扮演一个什麽样的角色。同样在两岸关係上面我们一定是一个和平稳定的维持者。
10826f1080f971f3f37ceeb655cbfd4f2e75192a.translatedText: Zhu Lilun said: This time I am visiting the United States. Of course, I will convey the KMT’s position on cross-strait policy. If there are friends from the US who are concerned about the "Ma Xi meeting", I will also convey the same message I just gave to the friends from the US. But more importantly, we hope that we can express what we will do if the Kuomintang can continue to be in power in the future. What role will we play in Taiwan-US relations? Likewise, we must be a maintainer of peace and stability in cross-Strait relations.

2a6e2c6f699597a747ad16fba9a8ffb9bdba8a35.sourceText: 朱立伦表示：台美关係非常重要，台湾非常关心能够加入第二回合TPP的谈判，对于未来台湾的经贸发展非常的重要。谢谢美方，在上个礼拜通过了对于我们加入国际刑警组织的支持。希望美方能够全力的继续支持我们协助我们。
2a6e2c6f699597a747ad16fba9a8ffb9bdba8a35.translatedText: Zhu Lilun said: Taiwan-US relations are very important. Taiwan is very concerned about joining the second round of TPP negotiations, which is very important for Taiwan's future economic and trade development. Thank you to the United States for passing its support for our joining Interpol last week. We hope that the United States can continue to fully support and assist us.

9510b7aaa3c642e72b3df910430ee3f4cdfcfbff.sourceText: 朱立伦说：当然美方的朋友也会很关心未来台湾在整个安全维护上面跟美国可以合作的部分，我们要有什麽样的一个策略。当然，更重要的是美国非常关心两岸关係，尤其是”马习会”之后。未来如果朱立伦能够当选的话，我们要怎麽样在这样的一个基础之上来做发展。
9510b7aaa3c642e72b3df910430ee3f4cdfcfbff.translatedText: > Zhu Lilun said: Of course, friends from the United States will also be very concerned about the future cooperation between Taiwan and the United States in overall security maintenance, and what kind of strategy we should have. Of course, what is more important is that the United States is very concerned about cross-strait relations, especially after the "Ma-Xi meeting." If Zhu Lilun can be elected in the future, how can we develop on such a basis?

9ecca337ff5d5575a3dc43ca2c4ad7702d8cadb5.sourceText: 朱立伦表示：美中台的关係，是一个非常重要的合作关係。两岸关係的稳定会直接影响到美国跟大陆，美国跟台湾的关係。台湾跟美国的关係非常稳定，而同样的美国跟大陆的关係也非常稳定，也会促成两岸关係更为稳定的发展。一个很稳定的三边的关係，不管是从政治的角度或者是从经济的角度来看都是非常重要的。
9ecca337ff5d5575a3dc43ca2c4ad7702d8cadb5.translatedText: > Zhu Lilun said: The relationship between the United States, China and Taiwan is a very important cooperative relationship. The stability of cross-strait relations will directly affect the relationship between the United States and the mainland and the United States and Taiwan. The relationship between Taiwan and the United States is very stable, and the relationship between the United States and the mainland is also very stable, which will also promote the development of more stable cross-strait relations. A very stable trilateral relationship is very important from a political or economic perspective.

1f805198a80ebeed7757595ed9b889309c6002fb.sourceText: 朱立伦强调：对台湾来讲，我们跟中国大陆的贸易占27%。如果再加上香港的话几乎是43%。我们现在是美国的第10大的Trading partners。那国是我们的第三大的Trading partners。两边都是我们非常重要的贸易伙伴。在整个区域经济的合作上面我们是缺一不可。同样的美国跟大陆现在的贸易关係现在也非常的重要。这三边现在都是希望在一个稳定的发展状况之下，能够持续做好所有的贸易跟经济上的合作。另外在过去的产业合作上面，我们知道美方一些高科技产业，逐步的移到亚洲四小龙生产，尤其是台湾。那台湾这几年的代工移到中国大陆去。那我们这三边的合作关係，就是怎麽样在创新研发管理或者是到生产还有市场营销上面，三边的一个分工合作，也是我们未来大家要共同考量的。所以这是三者缺一不可，这是很密切的关係。 朱立伦还说：我从来没有说过我们鸡蛋会全部放在大陆这个篮子裡面。包括我做市长的这段期间。最明显的一件事情，我们的突破就是包括我们的投资和招商。都在双赢方面的努力。我一再强调双赢就是指东协的印尼，当然是包括周边的。因为印尼是最大的。还包括印度。其实台湾整个的经贸布局一定是全球化的。但是大陆这块市场绝对是不可以缺少的。所以我才会讲说台湾必须要加入整个经贸组织，包括TPP跟RCEP这个是毫无疑问的。
1f805198a80ebeed7757595ed9b889309c6002fb.translatedText: > Zhu Lilun emphasized: For Taiwan, our trade with mainland China accounts for 27%. If Hong Kong is included, it is almost 43%. We are now the 10th largest trading partners in the United States. That country is our third largest trading partner. Both sides are our very important trading partners. We are indispensable for the cooperation of the entire regional economy. Similarly, the current trade relationship between the United States and mainland China is also very important now. The three parties now hope to continue all trade and economic cooperation under a stable development situation. In addition, in terms of past industrial cooperation, we know that some high-tech industries in the United States have gradually moved to the four Asian Tigers for production, especially Taiwan. In recent years, Taiwan's OEM has moved to mainland China. Then our three-party cooperation relationship is about how to cooperate in innovative R&D management or production and marketing. The division of labor among the three parties is also something we all need to consider together in the future. So these three are indispensable, and this is a very close relationship. Zhu Lilun also said: I never said that all our eggs would be placed in the mainland basket. Including the period when I was mayor. The most obvious thing, our breakthrough is our investment and investment promotion. It’s all about win-win efforts. I have repeatedly emphasized that win-win refers to Indonesia in ASEAN, including neighboring countries. Because Indonesia is the largest. Also includes India. In fact, Taiwan's entire economic and trade layout must be globalized. But the mainland market is absolutely indispensable. That's why I say that Taiwan must join all economic and trade organizations, including TPP and RCEP. There is no doubt about it.

1d3ac6f10fc7c08346bcd00b96ee4bb25ad17938.sourceText: 朱立伦表示：年轻世代我们怎麽样去突破？怎麽样在软体在服务上面的创新研发？政府要怎麽样设置一些平台？我已经提过非常多次了。包括我们从教育的改革，从基础教育。但是怎麽样跟产业链接。我要花半个小时的时间解释。这个是非常重要的。毕竟要给我们年轻人更多的希望。我们年轻人同样也不要骂挑战。我一直强调一件事情，台湾要把门开放出来。要面对全世界。只有门打开我们面对全世界，台湾的机会就在全世界。
1d3ac6f10fc7c08346bcd00b96ee4bb25ad17938.translatedText: Zhu Lilun said: How can we, the young generation, make breakthroughs? How about innovative research and development in software and services? How can the government set up some platforms? I've mentioned it many times. This includes our education reform and basic education. But how to connect with the industry? It will take me half an hour to explain. This is very important. After all, we must give our young people more hope. We young people should also not criticize challenges. I have always emphasized one thing: Taiwan must open its door. To face the whole world. As long as the door is opened and we face the whole world, Taiwan's opportunities will be all over the world.

a0e77400e709b24ad92b115dd89d945e2f79e534.sourceText: 朱立伦还谈及怎麽样推动”国会”改革的事情。
a0e77400e709b24ad92b115dd89d945e2f79e534.translatedText: > Zhu Lilun also talked about how to promote the reform of the "Congress".

ed1aec267023acb1583db93b30d8f74c727e97bb.sourceText: 朱立伦最后说：我们团结整个党是非常重要的一块。因为我们要争取全民的支持，团结我们的党是非常重要的。我们只有在凝聚共识之后，全力争取民众对我们的支持，去争取最后的胜选。同样的包括两岸政策也好，包括台美关係也好，包括各项政策，我们都逐步地推出，也跟民进党的参选人有明显的不同。民众就逐渐可以做出判断和选择。
ed1aec267023acb1583db93b30d8f74c727e97bb.translatedText: Zhu Lilun finally said: It is very important for us to unite the entire party. Because we want to win the support of the whole people, it is very important to unite our party. Only after building a consensus, we can do our best to win the public's support for us and win the final election. The same applies to cross-strait policies, Taiwan-US relations, and various policies. We have gradually introduced them, and they are obviously different from the candidates of the Democratic Progressive Party. People will gradually be able to make judgments and choices.
