78737d2fec3619f25c0bdcc7fabf3946f6567f56.translatedText: Changing the Environment Phoenix City Qi Ruhong

ce9453657d1e5ea120280f41ac2122f554e332dd.sourceText: 谈起退休计划，不少超龄朋友总会抱怨环境不许可，或时机未到，要勉强干下去，总是归咎环境造成。其实如果不是要求太高，生活简朴，保健知足，一切量入為出，轻鬆度日，可改变环境，随时都享受夕阳餘暉。 以我為例，回顾在二○○六年未到六月，工作刚刚足够四十季度，就叫儿子查阅状况，看看合格退休，立即辞职不干，由女儿替我向工厂申请辞职，说明原委，宣佈退休。当年六月一日，工厂临时将午餐时间延长，為我举办欢送宴会；那位管工者是个墨西哥妇人，平日对待属下倒算公允，无分族裔，一视同仁，听说我决定退休，也替我高兴，提议数十同事每人合凑五元，装置会场和订购美食，还购买一个精美新颖的电子时鐘，赠送為纪念品；我太座则贡献拿手的越南炸春卷，让大家品嚐。 中午退休联欢宴会虽然短暂，但所有同事都能尽兴，首先进行美食餐饮，继而聊天畅谈，并播放音乐助兴，几个喜欢跳舞的墨西哥女郎，无拘无束地随著音乐起舞，还欣然拉我共跳渣查！分手时更来个热情拥抱，让我在退休联欢会上留下难忘印象。 毕竟，我由一九九九年开始，进入这家专门製造电阻器的工厂，到二○○六年，前后八年，日子不算短。虽然美国老板，墨西哥管工，以及各美、墨同事，都因我的不諳美语而难以沟通，但我的工作表现良好，待人接物亲切和睦，获得大家好感，还有华、越员工的帮助，必要时替我翻译，总能渡过难关，不经不觉做到退休之日，联欢宴会自然充满愉快气氛。 在电阻器工厂干什麼呢？工序大致包括：发动机器綑卷定量的铜线，用胶布粘贴扎紧，烧焊两端妥当，最后是检测成品的标準度数。电阻器用来限制电流量，也用来调整电压，可使电能转换為热能之性质，还有其他的一些功能。几乎所有电器用具从日光管到电视电脑等设备，都须要安装电阻器元件，这家工厂专门替各公司加工生產，不同的类型，圆方尖扁形状，大中幼小都有，供应给「模特老啦」公司為主力。电阻器元件构造都须要靠铜线綑绕，这家工厂的名称就叫做亚利桑那线圈构造厂(Coil tec of Arizona Cty)。 这工厂僱用员工并不苛求，只要努力工作，起货快速，又不弄坏物资就可以了。厂裡有越南工人佔三分一以上，随时可帮助解决语言的不便。还有一点最宽容处，是愿意聘用夫妇、父子、母女或兄弟姊妹，许多工厂担心发生弊端，拒绝任用至亲关系的。我进厂工作不久，太座也申请进入，夫妇一同上班，一辆车就解决交通问题，最為怯意；惟一美中不足，也最不好的，是工厂没有替工人购买医疗保险。 工厂裡有位越南女同事，名叫吴娘，比我大四岁，是资深工人，年纪日渐老迈，手脚越来越迟钝，起货常不达指标或出错，屡遭责备，做得不开心，总是长嗟短叹，和她一起共事的工友则连累遭殃，因她自恃老资格和英语流利，常将过失推諉於人，不少同事都与她结怨，保持距离。但她不敢欺负我夫妇，反而态度很好，无话不谈。 这次见我的退休联欢搞得很高兴，表示非常羡慕，我就趁机规劝她，好应该退休回家，安享晚年，可以同我一样，组织告别欢宴，高兴愉快地离开工厂。可是她一味诉苦，说什麼家庭经济不稳，要帮助儿子供屋，要协助外孙零用钱，一大堆不能放下担子的理由。我瞭解他的家庭，各儿女都有稳定的工作，要不是喜欢抽烟嗜酒的话，足以过著小康生活，根本就不用老太婆上班捱苦。当时我还开玩笑说：「其实是你过份忧虑，都七十岁老人了，还担心儿女的经济干吗？说句不好听，如果你上西天了，难道他们无法过日子？」她显得无奈地回答：「没办法呀！见步行步，捱到两脚伸直為止。」 两脚伸直，一死了之，倒无所谓，最怕是缠绵病榻，累及子孙。果然，我退休后不到两个月，有一天突然不见吴娘上班，整个星期无踪影，太座打听得悉，原来请了病假。星期日我夫妇登门探望，才知她血压高昇，双脚疼痛，身体孱弱，无法工作，医生批示以后不能再上班。我惟有安慰她好好养病，也不忘数说憋在心中的话：「你看！上次我叫你退休，像我一样有个联欢宴会，愉快引退，大家高兴，你不听。现在呢，还不是痛苦的被迫退休？而且静静退出，多麼不值得呀！」她闷闷不乐地笞：「谁想到会这样呢，都是瓖境造成！」 环境造成，许多事情真正是环境造成，但也有不少应该自己预计到大概的后果，可面对现实，避重就轻，逢凶化吉，尽量改变环境。上次我说「如果你上西天」，早已暗示她要注意老迈躯体了，希望扭转以命运註定為藉口，改变环境，总是归咎环境造成，结局就是以疾病来逼使退休了。
ce9453657d1e5ea120280f41ac2122f554e332dd.translatedText: When talking about retirement plans, many over-age friends always complain that the environment does not allow it, or that the time has not come yet, and they have to forcefully continue to work. They always blame the environment. In fact, if the requirements are not too high, life is simple, health care is contented, everything is within one's means, and life is relaxed, you can change the environment and enjoy the sunset at any time. Take me as an example. Looking back, before June of 2006, when I had just completed 40 quarters of work, I asked my son to check the status to see if he was eligible for retirement, and he immediately resigned. My daughter applied to the factory for me to resign, explained the whole story, and announced my retirement. On June 1 of that year, the factory temporarily extended the lunch hour and held a farewell party in my honor. The foreman was a Mexican woman who treated her subordinates fairly and equally regardless of race. When they heard that I had decided to retire, they were happy for me and suggested that dozens of colleagues pool five yuan each to install the venue, order delicious food, and buy a beautiful and novel electronic clock as a souvenir. My mother-in-law contributed her signature Vietnamese fried spring rolls for everyone to try. Although the retirement party at noon was short, all colleagues had a good time. First, they had delicious food and drinks, and then chatted and played music to entertain. Several Mexican girls who like to dance danced to the music freely, and even happily invited me to dance the zacha! They gave me a warm hug when we parted, leaving an unforgettable impression on me at the retirement party. After all, I started working in this factory specializing in manufacturing resistors in 1999, and it lasted eight years until 2006. It was not a short time. Although it was difficult for me to communicate with my American boss, Mexican foreman, and colleagues from the United States and Mexico because of my lack of proficiency in American English, I performed well at work and treated people cordially and harmoniously, winning everyone's favor. I also had the help of Chinese and Vietnamese employees who translated for me when necessary. What do you do in a resistor factory? The process generally includes: rolling a certain amount of copper wire into the machine, pasting it tightly with tape, welding both ends properly, and finally testing the standard degree of the finished product. Resistors are used to limit the amount of current, adjust voltage, convert electrical energy into thermal energy, and have other functions. Almost all electrical appliances, from fluorescent tubes to televisions and computers, need to be equipped with resistor components. This factory specializes in processing and producing resistors for various companies. Different types are available in round, square, pointed and flat shapes, large, medium and small. They are mainly supplied to the "Model Lao La" company. The resistor component structure needs to be wrapped with copper wire. The name of this factory is called Coil tec of Arizona Cty. There are no strict requirements for hiring employees in this factory, as long as they work hard, get goods quickly, and don't damage the materials. There are more than one-third Vietnamese workers in the factory, and they are always available to help solve language inconveniences. Another point that is most tolerant is that they are willing to hire couples, fathers and sons, mothers and daughters, or brothers and sisters. Many factories are afraid of disadvantages and refuse to hire close relatives. Not long after I started working in the factory, my wife also applied to join. My husband and I work together, and one car solves the transportation problem, which is most timid. The only flaw, and the worst thing, is that the factory does not buy medical insurance for the workers. There is a Vietnamese female colleague in the factory named Wu Niang, who is four years older than me. She is a senior worker. She is getting older and her hands and feet are getting slower and slower. She often fails to meet the target or makes mistakes when picking up goods. She is often criticized and unhappy with her work. She always complains and sighs. The workers who work with her suffer. Because she relies on her seniority and fluent English, she often blames others for her faults. Many colleagues have grudges and keep a distance from her. But she didn't dare to bully me and my wife. Instead, she had a very good attitude and talked about everything. She was very happy to see my retirement party this time and expressed great envy. I took the opportunity to persuade her that she should retire home and enjoy her old age. She could organize a farewell party like me and leave the factory happily. But she kept complaining, saying that her family's finances were unstable, she had to help her son pay for the house, and she had to help her grandson with pocket money. There were a lot of reasons why she couldn't let go of her burden. I know his family well. Each of his children has a stable job. If he didn't like smoking and drinking, he would be able to live a well-off life, and there would be no need for the old woman to work hard. At that time, I joked: "Actually, you are overly worried. You are already seventy years old. Why are you still worrying about your children's finances? To put it bluntly, if you go to the West, won't they be able to live a good life?" She seemed helpless and replied: "There is no way! You can walk until your legs are straight." It doesn't matter if you die with your legs straight, but the worst thing is that you will be lingering on the hospital bed and affecting your children and grandchildren. Sure enough, less than two months after I retired, Wu Niang suddenly disappeared from work one day. She was nowhere to be seen for a whole week. When the Queen inquired, she learned that she had taken sick leave. On Sunday, my husband and I came to visit her and found out that her blood pressure was high, her feet were in pain, her body was weak, and she was unable to work. The doctor ordered her not to work again in the future. I could only comfort her to take good care of her health, and did not forget to say what I was holding in my heart: "Look! Last time I asked you to retire, there was a party like me, and you retired happily, and everyone was happy, but you didn't listen. Now, aren't you forced to retire in pain? And quitting quietly, how unworthy it is!" She said gloomily: "Who would have thought that this would happen, it is all caused by the disease!" Many things are caused by the environment, but there are also many things that you should anticipate the approximate consequences of. You can face the reality, avoid the important and take the easy, turn danger into good, and try to change the environment. Last time I said "If you go to the West", I had already hinted that she should pay attention to her aging body, hoping to change the excuse of destiny and change the environment. She always blamed the environment, and the end result was that she was forced to retire due to illness.

a4065dad6eba4c591c89ec39df6f6c43992da387.sourceText: 为何人们不愿回国做精英 而是愿呆在问题多的美国
a4065dad6eba4c591c89ec39df6f6c43992da387.translatedText: Why do people don’t want to go back to China and become elites, but prefer to stay in the United States, which has many problems?

764a7e55c785558913c1e1a021723527edef47c0.sourceText: 为何人们不愿回国做精英 而是愿呆在问题多的美国 （凤凰网） 为何人们还是愿意呆在问题多的美国？ ―…
764a7e55c785558913c1e1a021723527edef47c0.translatedText: Why do people don’t want to return to China and become elites, but prefer to stay in the United States, which has many problems? (Ifeng.com) Why do people still want to stay in the United States, which has many problems? ―…

b15d3f1cf159d606119a89c227f34448d883c603.sourceText: 为何人们还是愿意呆在问题多的美国？ ―――而不愿意学我们社会的部分精英拿美国绿卡而在国内赚大钱 对中国人在美国的思想状况而不理解！
b15d3f1cf159d606119a89c227f34448d883c603.translatedText: Why do people still want to stay in the United States, which has so many problems? ——They are not willing to follow the example of some elites in our society who get American green cards and make a lot of money at home. They do not understand the ideological status of the Chinese in the United States!

b4d9c994928a02f02bea8d34bab2413138ed2670.sourceText: 今天碰到加州某大学的一些华人，他们说正在参加抗议活动；一方面是学生的学费高涨，而另一方面却是教工的工资不变；所以他们华人也积极参加。我说国内的高校是收入最高的单位之一，你们为何不回去呢？要知道你们这海归可吃香呀，说不定比美国的收入还高呀。
b4d9c994928a02f02bea8d34bab2413138ed2670.translatedText: Today I met some Chinese from a university in California. They said they were participating in protests. On the one hand, students' tuition fees were rising, but on the other hand, faculty salaries remained unchanged. Therefore, the Chinese were also actively participating. I said that domestic universities are among the highest paying institutions, so why don’t you go back? You must know that you returnees from overseas are very popular, and your income may be higher than that in the United States.

eac6a89a679af1154d8f5aa53b324d0c1fe0bf9a.sourceText: 他们说美国虽然问题多多，然而却是平等的社会；所以在美国不担心不公平，就连抗议也是公平的表现。然而国内却是关系社会，没有关系就没有公平；至于那些拿了美国绿卡再回国赚钱的人，肯定是投机分子。因为国内有关系，所以才回国赚大钱；如果国内不好，马上就会到美国来。而我们这些没有关系的人，还是愿意留在美国凭自己的能力生活；因为我们不愿意回到被别人摆布命运的社会。正因为如此，回国的是投机分子；而留在美国的才是想凭自己能力生存的人。
eac6a89a679af1154d8f5aa53b324d0c1fe0bf9a.translatedText: They say that although the United States has many problems, it is an equal society; therefore, there is no need to worry about unfairness in the United States, and even protests are fair. However, domestic society is about relationships. Without relationships, there is no fairness; as for those who get American green cards and then return to China to make money, they are definitely speculators. Because I have connections at home, I return to my country to make a lot of money; if things are not going well at home, I will come to the United States immediately. And those of us who have no connections are still willing to stay in the United States and live according to our own abilities; because we do not want to return to a society where our destiny is dictated by others. Because of this, those who return home are speculators; those who stay in the United States are those who want to survive by their own abilities.

3614577de69659d8db0c8989b2e90da6c4581e49.sourceText: 如果我们从抗议活动看，肯定中国才是全世界最安定的社会；因为这里没有游行，更没有抗议活动；好一派和谐的社会。然而美国不一样，到处是抗议活动；这说明美国比中国的问题多。如果没有问题，能有这么多的人抗议吗？然而我们这些在美国的华人很不可思议，他们就是不愿意回到和谐的中国；而是千方百计地留在美国；这好像很不符合逻辑，为何华人不愿意好呢？
3614577de69659d8db0c8989b2e90da6c4581e49.translatedText: If we look at the protests, China is definitely the most stable society in the world; because there are no parades here, let alone protests; it is a harmonious society. However, the United States is different. There are protests everywhere; this shows that the United States has more problems than China. If there were no problems, could so many people protest? However, we Chinese in the United States are incredible. They are just unwilling to return to a harmonious China; instead, they are trying every possible means to stay in the United States. This seems very illogical. Why don't the Chinese want to do well?

1c4954630d88ad252af0af26a0939b9006fc796b.sourceText: 是啊！那些从美国回来的人基本是我们社会的精英，他们的高收入是我们老百姓遥望而不可及的。然而这些人并不愿意放弃在美国的绿卡，好像这里才是他们的归宿。在没有来美国之前我很不理解，这些人究竟是何思维呢？现在听美国的华人一说才知道，原来这些人是投机分子；哪里的利益最大就到哪里去。他们拿美国绿卡是看中美国的不变体制，他们回国赚钱是看到国内的权利体制；他们就是利用这个原则，来实现自己的利益最大化。
1c4954630d88ad252af0af26a0939b9006fc796b.translatedText: >Yes! Those who come back from the United States are basically the elite of our society, and their high incomes are beyond the reach of us ordinary people. However, these people are not willing to give up their green cards in the United States, as if this is their destination. Before I came to the United States, I didn't understand how these people were thinking. Now when I listen to the Chinese in the United States, I realize that these people are speculators; they will go wherever their interests are greatest. They get American green cards because they see the stable system in the United States, and when they return to their country to make money, they see the domestic rights system; they use this principle to maximize their own interests.

82a320c47b4dbc7a4bb907e174ddda6e380d50ef.sourceText: 在今天的社会生存原则中，能力应该是第一要素。然而我们社会正好相反，能力不是原则。因为我们是由领导安排命运的社会，领导要你发财就发财；领导要你升官就升官。它不取决于你的实际能力，因为能力也是领导评定的。正因为如此，我们社会有能力而与领导关系不好的人实际入另册了；比如说我们社会的下岗和末位淘汰，实际就是领导的特权。也因为如此，所以有能力出国的人是不想回国的；因为能力强的人刚好是不会搞关系的人。为何华人多愿意留在问题多的美国社会，而不愿意回到和谐的和没有问题的中国社会；主要原因就是因为生存不依靠能力，这才是最可怕的；而回国的人正好相反，他们拥有关系；而对自己的能力没有信心，所以美国绿卡也要；却要回中国发展。
82a320c47b4dbc7a4bb907e174ddda6e380d50ef.translatedText: In today's social survival principles, ability should be the first element. However, our society is just the opposite. Ability is not a principle. Because we are a society in which leaders determine our destiny. If the leader wants you to get rich, you will get rich; if the leader wants you to be promoted, you will be promoted. It does not depend on your actual ability, because ability is also assessed by the leader. Because of this, in our society, those who are capable but have a bad relationship with leaders are actually placed in a separate register; for example, being laid off and eliminated from the bottom position in our society are actually the prerogatives of leaders. Because of this, people who have the ability to go abroad don't want to return to China; because people with strong ability happen to be people who don't know how to have relationships. Why are many Chinese people willing to stay in the American society with many problems, but are unwilling to return to the harmonious and problem-free Chinese society? The main reason is because survival does not rely on ability, which is the most terrifying thing. People who return to China are just the opposite. They have connections and have no confidence in their own abilities, so they also want a US green card, but they want to return to China for development.

72fae2616a5092568d9684860a1fb5d8c1783f7b.sourceText: 在这里我遇到印度人最多，问他们愿意回国吗？大家没有愿意回去的。因为印度国内没有中国这样关系赚大钱的现象，所以他们在美国的收入肯定比国内高；从而印度人读书就是为了出国，而出国就是为了绿卡；这是他们共同的目标，所以大家没有忌讳。
72fae2616a5092568d9684860a1fb5d8c1783f7b.translatedText: I met the most Indians here and asked them if they would like to return to China? No one wants to go back. Because there is no big money-making phenomenon in India like China, their income in the United States is definitely higher than at home. Therefore, Indians study to go abroad, and go abroad for a green card. This is their common goal, so there is no taboo.

e6c78ec3014327b95b03854a1e2049cd33154bfc.sourceText: 为何问题多的美国反而是人们向往的社会，这是难以叫人理解；然实际生存质量告诉人们，人们的选择却是对的。这究竟是人们的观念出了问题，还是我们的社会概念出了问题；反正是不合常规思维。然而实际生活却是真实的，留在美国的选择还是正确的；这就是人们争相涌入美国，因为这里还是以能力为生存原则的社会；所以有能力的人才千方百计地想留在美国。
e6c78ec3014327b95b03854a1e2049cd33154bfc.translatedText: It is difficult for people to understand why the United States, which has many problems, is the society that people long for. However, the actual quality of life tells people that people's choice is right. Is this a problem with people's ideas or a problem with our social concepts? Anyway, it is unconventional thinking. However, real life is real, and the choice to stay in the United States is still the right one; this is why people are rushing to the United States, because this is still a society based on ability as the survival principle; so capable talents are doing everything possible to stay in the United States.

34430bb68b950e3cb20447fb814e2920ca92033d.sourceText: 为何美国的问题多，原来美国是一个人人会提问题的社会；虽然美国人之间没有任何意见，可对社会的问题却有共同语言。所以美国的问题很明显，因为它解决问题的程序很复杂。正因为如此，美国的问题多却人们还是喜欢它；这就是今天的美国和美国人。
34430bb68b950e3cb20447fb814e2920ca92033d.translatedText: Why does the United States have so many problems? It turns out that the United States is a society where everyone asks questions. Although Americans do not have any opinions among themselves, they have a common language on social problems. So the problem in the United States is obvious because its procedures for solving the problem are complicated. Because of this, America has many problems but people still like it; this is America and Americans today.

a545583595a8ad4b2024a7a1ab955d0ce1aeb929.sourceText: 省钱、抢钱 观光预算增减两极
a545583595a8ad4b2024a7a1ab955d0ce1aeb929.translatedText: Save money and grab money. Tourism budgets are increasing and decreasing at extremes

2704e9acfecd3bbd5810898205c2c260712bb6b6.sourceText: 省钱、抢钱 观光预算增减两极 税收减少、预算赤字严重已导致许多州削减观光经费。华盛顿州本周末将关闭观光局，…
2704e9acfecd3bbd5810898205c2c260712bb6b6.translatedText: Save money and grab money. Tourism budgets are increasing and decreasing. Decreasing tax revenues and serious budget deficits have led many states to cut tourism funding. Washington State will close its tourism bureau this weekend...

d1fa1f23d1e935197468cbf558e3292dd0730569.sourceText: 省钱、抢钱 观光预算增减两极 税收减少、预算赤字严重已导致许多州削减观光经费。华盛顿州本周末将关闭观光局，不再花钱宣传本州岛的优美观光景点藉以招徕游客。但是，各州的盘算未必相同。美国旅游协会(U.S. Travel Association)指出，全美约半数州正缩减推广观光的预算，但另外的半数州则在增加观光经费。 该协会指出，纽约州的推广观光开支减少60%，降至550万元；亚利桑那州缩减40%，降至800万元。甚至全球数一数二的吸引观光客地点夏威夷州也设法把观光经费移做其他用途，像是社会计划、环境保护及改善基础设施。 去年至今年最大幅增加观光经费的州则是：阿拉斯加、刘易斯安纳及密执安州。有些州建立政府与民间伙伴关系，分担宣传本州岛观光的费用。 其他的州另有想法。有些州认为，观光业是有助经济反弹的重要行业，密执安州就是例子。尽管密州的失业率持续在全美居 冠，即使其他服务削减，它认为，观光仍值得投入大笔经费，计划今年花费约2500万元推广观光，旨在取得优势，争取消费者在旅游中的小额现金花费。毕竟，密执安州周围有风景秀丽的大湖，可以吸引观光客。
d1fa1f23d1e935197468cbf558e3292dd0730569.translatedText: Save money, grab money. Tourism budget increases and decreases. Reduced tax revenue and serious budget deficits have led many states to cut tourism funding. Washington state will close its tourism bureau this weekend and will no longer spend money promoting the state's beautiful tourist attractions to attract tourists. However, states may not necessarily have the same calculations. The U.S. Travel Association pointed out that about half of the states in the United States are reducing their budgets for tourism promotion, but the other half are increasing tourism expenditures. The association pointed out that New York State’s tourism promotion expenses decreased by 60% to 5.5 million yuan; Arizona decreased by 40% to 8 million yuan. Even the state of Hawaii, one of the world's top tourist attractions, has managed to divert tourism dollars to other uses, such as social programs, environmental protection and improving infrastructure. The states with the largest increases in tourism spending from last year to this year are: Alaska, Louisiana and Michigan. Some states have established government-private partnerships to share the costs of promoting their island's tourism. Other states have other ideas. Some states believe that tourism is an important industry that will help the economy rebound, such as Michigan. Although Michigan's unemployment rate continues to be the highest in the United States, and even if other services are cut, it believes that tourism is still worth investing a large amount of money. It plans to spend about 25 million yuan to promote tourism this year, aiming to gain an advantage and win over consumers' small cash expenditures on travel. After all, Michigan is surrounded by beautiful lakes that attract tourists.

9bd5911a85f4af47d0c665b4f0f051f682ee0527.sourceText: 温州动车事故遇难家属艰难索赔路
9bd5911a85f4af47d0c665b4f0f051f682ee0527.translatedText: The families of the victims of the Wenzhou high-speed train accident have a difficult road to claim compensation

cde447e116dd20ce780019bd9e4d9a4f02b96830.sourceText: 温州动车事故遇难家属艰难索赔路 美籍华人兄弟曹立宇（左）和曹立衡在去年温州高铁事故发生地。事故中，他们的父母遇…
cde447e116dd20ce780019bd9e4d9a4f02b96830.translatedText: The families of the victims of the Wenzhou high-speed train accident have a difficult road to claim compensation. Chinese-American brothers Cao Liyu (left) and Cao Liheng are at the place where the Wenzhou high-speed rail accident occurred last year. In the accident, their parents met...

2dc43482df4cacfd3c096fdca73a30b95459e937.sourceText: 美籍华人兄弟曹立宇（左）和曹立衡在去年温州高铁事故发生地。事故中，他们的父母遇难，曹立衡身受重伤
2dc43482df4cacfd3c096fdca73a30b95459e937.translatedText: Chinese-American brothers Cao Liyu (left) and Cao Liheng were at the site of the Wenzhou high-speed rail accident last year. In the accident, their parents were killed and Cao Liheng was seriously injured

46fcd8fd4948b340ef1f5d8a62010eaf75a19ac6.sourceText: 上海棗对去年夏天中国东部城市温州发生的那场高铁追尾事故，乘客曹立衡(Henry Cao)只有一些模糊的记忆：舒服的催人欲睡的摇晃突然变成了天崩地裂般的剧烈震动，车厢内一片黑暗，感觉自己随着车厢一起，从30米高的铁路桥上坠落。
46fcd8fd4948b340ef1f5d8a62010eaf75a19ac6.translatedText: Shanghai Zao About the high-speed train rear-end accident that occurred in Wenzhou, eastern China, last summer, passenger Henry Cao only had some vague memories: the comfortable and drowsy shaking suddenly turned into a violent vibration like earth shattering, the car was dark, and he felt like he was falling from a 30-meter-high railway bridge along with the car.

db9356be3ab95c75ca8f0484e94e7b15e55ff8b6.sourceText: 他说，”我们像布娃娃一样飞了起来。”
db9356be3ab95c75ca8f0484e94e7b15e55ff8b6.translatedText: He said, "We are flying like rag dolls."

d7d6ad9b125b960d4a78616f0fed5cd2d7055ba7.sourceText: 事故共造成40名乘客死亡，191人受伤，动摇了中国对雄心勃勃的高速铁路系统的信心。科罗拉多州33岁的美籍华裔进口商曹立衡勉强得以生存，他失去了一个肾和脾，头部的伤情使他陷入持续性的眩晕，每隔一两个小时就会昏睡过去一次。曹立衡的父母早年移民美国，获得了美国国籍，他们带着儿子荣归故里，两人却在事故中遇难。
d7d6ad9b125b960d4a78616f0fed5cd2d7055ba7.translatedText: The accident killed 40 passengers and injured 191 others, shaking China's confidence in its ambitious high-speed rail system. Cao Liheng, a 33-year-old Chinese-American importer in Colorado, barely survived. He lost a kidney and spleen. The head injury caused him to fall into persistent dizziness and fall asleep every one or two hours. Cao Liheng's parents immigrated to the United States in his early years and obtained American citizenship. They returned home with their son, but both of them were killed in the accident.

fb57a110a82b07919e163a493b3bd1fb6d3570dd.sourceText: 过去的一年，在曹立衡艰难的康复过程中，另一场斗争也令他精疲力尽：努力从铁道部拿到赔偿金，这是一个庞大而固执的政府部门，还不习惯和不屈不挠的外国人打交道。
fb57a110a82b07919e163a493b3bd1fb6d3570dd.translatedText: Over the past year, during Cao Liheng's difficult recovery, he was also exhausted by another struggle: trying to get compensation from the Ministry of Railways, a large and stubborn government agency unaccustomed to dealing with unrelenting foreigners.

9fc59f0208869c00256999402eb3f289469f263d.sourceText: 事故发生后，曹立衡在本月首次回到中国。他和弟弟曹立宇(Leo Cao)此次回国处理父母的遗体，以及加紧与铁道部的谈判。”他们知道怎样拖垮你，”30岁的曹立宇说，”首先，他们会让你喊叫咆哮，然后他们就会拖延时间，最后他们会说一些含糊其辞的话。现在他们说，’你们能得到一点赔偿，已经很幸运了。”’
9fc59f0208869c00256999402eb3f289469f263d.translatedText: After the accident, Cao Liheng returned to China for the first time this month. He and his younger brother Leo Cao returned to China this time to dispose of their parents' remains and step up negotiations with the Ministry of Railways. "They know how to bring you down," said Cao Liyu, 30. "First, they make you shout and roar, then they delay, and finally they say something vague. Now they say, 'You're lucky to get some compensation.' ”’

8886e9e9d31a9c2a279c600b462561295a91524e.sourceText: 他们痛苦的、充满政治含义的经历凸显了这个无所不能的国家部委的工作方式，铁道部的工作人员超过200万，其规模和影响力堪比中国军队。对曹氏兄弟来说，这样的经历让他们感到迷惑。20年前，他们在少年时代离开了中国。”这个地方已经不是我记忆中的样子了，”曹立衡微弱的说道，他的目光闪烁不定，有点茫然。”每个人都忙着赚钱。在这里，生命很廉价。”
8886e9e9d31a9c2a279c600b462561295a91524e.translatedText: Their painful, politically charged experience highlights the workings of the all-powerful state ministry, which employs more than 2 million people and rivals China’s military in size and influence. For the Cao brothers, the experience was confusing. They left China as teenagers 20 years ago. "This place is no longer what I remember," Cao Liheng said weakly, his eyes flickering and feeling a little confused. "Everyone is busy making money. Life is cheap here."

22491c5fb4a9d4911932d53f2ab814651ea58bde.sourceText: 铁道部拥有自己的司法系统，很大程度上不受监督。长期以来，铁道部一直受到腐败的指控。在事故发生前五个月，前铁道部长刘志军被免职。他被指控受贿几百万美元和其他未指明的”违纪”行为，有可能会在下个月接受审判。
22491c5fb4a9d4911932d53f2ab814651ea58bde.translatedText: The Ministry of Railways has its own judicial system, which is largely unsupervised. The Railways Ministry has long been the subject of accusations of corruption. Five months before the accident, former Railways Minister Liu Zhijun was dismissed. He is accused of taking millions of dollars in bribes and other unspecified "disciplinary" violations and is likely to go on trial next month.

631438273446cbc55475071284afc4ef30ab8388.sourceText: 一位乘客曾因掌掴列车员被判服刑三年，该乘客的律师张凯称，铁道部是一个”计划经济时代遗留下来的怪兽”，他们抗拒改革，抵制对其权威的挑战。张凯说，”大家都知道，铁道部负责创造最大利润，而且只有它自己监督自己。”
631438273446cbc55475071284afc4ef30ab8388.translatedText: Zhang Kai, the lawyer for a passenger who was sentenced to three years in prison for slapping a train conductor, said the Ministry of Railways is a "monster left over from the planned economy era" that resists reform and challenges to its authority. Zhang Kai said, "Everyone knows that the Ministry of Railways is responsible for creating maximum profits, and only it supervises itself."

897d572b33896aa108381039a5fb68934b8768ca.sourceText: 12月份公布的一份报告显示，政府调查人员将温州火车追尾事故的原因归咎于信号故障。调查人员表示，铁道部急于建设世界上最大的高速铁路网而忽略了安全管理。
897d572b33896aa108381039a5fb68934b8768ca.translatedText: A report released in December showed that government investigators blamed the Wenzhou train rear-end collision on a signal failure. Investigators say the Ministry of Railways has neglected safety management in its rush to build the world's largest high-speed rail network.

dda5a7012bdacffe563fbf321ecec3c8e62ee550.sourceText: 这对兄弟的父母棗曹尔新和妻子陈增容都是56岁。对他们来说，那次回乡之旅算是给他们在纽约血汗工厂和餐馆厨房的辛苦打工生活画上一个句号。夫妻二人都只接受过中学教育，他们带着孩子离开福建省，自学英语，并挣钱在皇后区买了一套房子。去世时，他们是拉瓜迪亚机场(La Guardia Airport)的管理员。
dda5a7012bdacffe563fbf321ecec3c8e62ee550.translatedText: The brothers’ parents, Zao Cao Erxin and his wife Chen Zengrong, are both 56 years old. For them, the trip was an end to a life of hard work in New York sweatshops and restaurant kitchens. The couple, both with only a middle school education, left Fujian Province with their children, taught themselves English and earned enough money to buy a house in Queens. At the time of their deaths, they were administrators at La Guardia Airport.

d7c9a8a2587854c27e62505977883c8510bc02a9.sourceText: 曹立宇说，”他们终于觉得经济状况比较稳定，可以休假了，这是他们第一次休假。”
d7c9a8a2587854c27e62505977883c8510bc02a9.translatedText: Cao Liyu said, "They finally felt that their financial situation was relatively stable and they could take a vacation. This was their first vacation."

61ec310cc468e652ec837425b8000ff0cdeb3cdb.sourceText: 他的父亲当场死亡，母亲也在几小时后身亡，留下了一些尚未解答、挥之不去的问题：她得到充分的医疗护理了吗？是谁无情的从她绑在腰间的包里偷走了1万美元？
61ec310cc468e652ec837425b8000ff0cdeb3cdb.translatedText: His father died at the scene and his mother died hours later, leaving lingering questions unanswered: Did she receive adequate medical care? Who ruthlessly stole $10,000 from the bag tied to her waist?

124c02da780954532118430583b3e1d928495d2e.sourceText: 在共产党矫饰的说辞中，7月23日已经成为一个”敏感的纪念日”棗报纸编辑和评论员应该忽略的一天。事发后几天，相关报道铺天盖地，内容涉及拙劣的救援行动和试图掩埋火车车厢的举动。之后，新闻审查部门屏蔽了微博上相关话题的讨论。上个月，遇难者的家人被警告不得进行公开悼念活动。
124c02da780954532118430583b3e1d928495d2e.translatedText: In Communist rhetoric, July 23 has become a "sensitive anniversary" - a day that newspaper editors and commentators should ignore. In the days following the incident, reports abounded about the botched rescue operation and attempts to bury the train cars. Afterwards, the news censorship department blocked discussions on related topics on Weibo. Last month, families of the victims were warned against holding public memorials.

9f5c59e6c35f2ce97bb4cd740938bbb2043fd207.sourceText: 但曹氏兄弟对此类警告毫不在乎，他们一直在寻求经济补偿，进而成了政府的眼中钉、肉中刺。
9f5c59e6c35f2ce97bb4cd740938bbb2043fd207.translatedText: But the Cao brothers paid no attention to such warnings. They have been seeking financial compensation and have become a thorn in the government's side.

a43b02b70ec484ce9af87fb05c5f0dc86ffe97d5.sourceText: 他们说，经过一系列会谈，铁道部官员答应为他们父母的死亡支付28万美元的赔偿金，为曹立衡的人身损害赔付8.5万美元。而曹氏兄弟提出的赔偿金额共计500万美元，他们说，这是按照他们父母以及曹立衡在美国工作20多年所能获得的薪资计算的。
a43b02b70ec484ce9af87fb05c5f0dc86ffe97d5.translatedText: They said that after a series of talks, Railway Ministry officials agreed to pay $280,000 in compensation for their parents' deaths and $85,000 in compensation for Cao Liheng's personal injuries. The Cao brothers proposed a total compensation amount of US$5 million, which they said was calculated based on the salaries that their parents and Cao Liheng could have earned after working in the United States for more than 20 years.

a679197f79fa0bd1040d37cb8c37afa12b6e239e.sourceText: 他们的律师表示，铁道部无视一项国家法律，即要按照事故受害人在其居住地的收入能力来确定赔付金额。而铁道部则以自己的内部规定为依据，按照事故发生省份的一般工资水平来确定赔付金额。
a679197f79fa0bd1040d37cb8c37afa12b6e239e.translatedText: Their lawyers said the Railway Ministry ignored a national law that requires accident victims to determine compensation amounts based on their earning capacity where they live. The Ministry of Railways determines the amount of compensation based on its own internal regulations and the general wage level in the province where the accident occurred.

b35fbcfdb7c68ad113b5b79f610de7501fa6109f.sourceText: ”他们的代表告诉我们，没有商量的余地，”曹氏兄弟的律师田杰说，”就连他们也承认，不清楚是谁说了算。”
b35fbcfdb7c68ad113b5b79f610de7501fa6109f.translatedText: "Their representatives told us there was no room for negotiation," said Tian Jie, a lawyer for the Cao brothers. "Even they admitted that they didn't know who had the final say."

351a77b172754e945dcf478487455a16fcca00f4.sourceText: 铁道部官员没有回复采访的传真，上周打给铁道部的政治部宣传部的多个电话也无人应答。
351a77b172754e945dcf478487455a16fcca00f4.translatedText: Railway Ministry officials did not respond to faxes for interviews, and multiple calls last week to the ministry's political propaganda department went unanswered.

ac606fbf310d5839ef934d5f33cb40887a49be82.sourceText: 曹立宇说，哥哥的伤势过于严重，不能继续工作。他有四个年幼的孩子需要抚养，而且还要支付医疗费用，赔偿所得的8.5万美元根本支持不了多久。曹立宇说，”表面上看来，我哥哥比较正常，但他现在只能抵他原来的一半。”
ac606fbf310d5839ef934d5f33cb40887a49be82.translatedText: Cao Liyu said that his brother's injury was too serious and he could not continue to work. He has four young children to support and medical bills to pay, so the $85,000 in compensation won't last long. Cao Liyu said, "On the surface, my brother seems normal, but now he can only earn half of his original value."

e922d86ea9fcf292baeec3ed0b6a681e1192f98f.sourceText: 铁道部的陪护人员和兄弟俩住在同一家宾馆，为他们支付食宿费，还帮他们拿行李，但经常会打电话了解曹氏兄弟的行踪。交涉人员曾发出警告，接受记者采访可能会带来”麻烦”。
e922d86ea9fcf292baeec3ed0b6a681e1192f98f.translatedText: The Ministry of Railways escorts live in the same hotel as the brothers, paying for their room and board and helping them carry their luggage, but they often call to learn about the Cao brothers' whereabouts. Negotiators have warned that speaking to reporters could cause "trouble."

4d16944e9b66a865855c043afe993d51af383581.sourceText: 本月，当两兄弟在温州一个停尸房里对着父母的灵柩恸哭时，铁道部的人员尴尬地聚在一起。”如果把我们跟丢了，他们就会受到批评，” 曹立宇之后在采访中疲惫而无奈地说道。
4d16944e9b66a865855c043afe993d51af383581.translatedText: This month, officials from the Ministry of Railways gathered awkwardly as two brothers wept over their parents' coffins in a morgue in Wenzhou. "If they lose us, they will be criticized," Cao Liyu said tiredly and helplessly in the interview later.

0f197303f8f306b9464868e31bc1c81e1c5f814b.sourceText: 事故发生几小时之后，铁道部的交涉人员就赶到了各个停尸房和医院，速度之快，医生还没来得及给伤者缝合伤口。他们四五人一组，将遇难者的亲属安排到不同的宾馆，冷酷无情地提出赔偿方案，这些方案到最后都大同小异：每个遇难者获赔14万美元左右。
0f197303f8f306b9464868e31bc1c81e1c5f814b.translatedText: A few hours after the accident, negotiators from the Ministry of Railways rushed to various morgues and hospitals so fast that doctors had not had time to suture the wounds of the injured. They worked in groups of four or five, arranged the victims' relatives to different hotels, and ruthlessly proposed compensation plans. In the end, these plans were similar: each victim received about 140,000 US dollars in compensation.

1cc221a62ea1448c1523b69461e3230b65de3073.sourceText: 去年，曹氏兄弟因为拒绝把父母的遗体从停尸房中带走，惹怒了政府官员。事故发生的时候，曹立宇正在攻读信息科学的博士学位，他说，照顾哥哥康复占去了他很多精力。
1cc221a62ea1448c1523b69461e3230b65de3073.translatedText: Last year, the Cao brothers angered government officials when they refused to remove their parents' bodies from the morgue. At the time of the accident, Cao Liyu was studying for a doctorate in information science. He said that taking care of his brother's recovery took up a lot of his energy.

ec9a840996f6cab4ac8f555f2856460587150f99.sourceText: 然而，他仍希望延迟移走父母的遗体，能够说服铁道部妥协，允许他们在福建老家举办一个丧葬仪式。官员拒绝了他们的请求，也许是因为担心会引来其他不满的幸存者。
ec9a840996f6cab4ac8f555f2856460587150f99.translatedText: However, he still hopes that the delay in removing his parents' remains will persuade the Railway Ministry to compromise and allow them to hold a funeral ceremony in their hometown in Fujian. Officials rejected their request, perhaps fearing it would attract other disgruntled survivors.

4c550709dfbdcdda68d0a0d854c36853d0d83687.sourceText: 但曹氏兄弟还是在停尸房草草举行了一个丧葬仪式，并在事故发生的地点稍作停留。上周三，他们安排将遗体送往纽约。本周六在皇后区举办的葬礼，将会吸引几百名福建籍移民前来参加。
4c550709dfbdcdda68d0a0d854c36853d0d83687.translatedText: But the Cao brothers still held a hasty funeral ceremony in the morgue and stopped for a while at the location of the accident. Last Wednesday, they made arrangements to send the body to New York. The funeral to be held in Queens this Saturday will attract hundreds of Fujian immigrants.

b7c01a3a8cabd1db72677a46a44cc0dbbebe8b5c.sourceText: 谈判缓慢而艰难，曹立衡也越来越沉默。他说，自己对钱已经不感兴趣了，只想早点回家。他在中国最后的时光，大部分都在旅店的房间里阅读关于苦难和救赎的《圣经》故事。他盯着地板说，”我希望生活继续。”
b7c01a3a8cabd1db72677a46a44cc0dbbebe8b5c.translatedText: The negotiations were slow and difficult, and Cao Liheng became increasingly silent. He said that he was no longer interested in money and just wanted to go home early. He spent most of his last days in China reading biblical stories about suffering and redemption in his hotel room. He stared at the floor and said, "I hope life goes on."

796239ee3229464929e31b535054a1498ea0aa98.sourceText: 但是目前，弟弟曹立宇还坚决表示要继续斗争，他说，自己已经做好准备，要向中国的法庭提起诉讼，虽然好几个律师都告诫他，这样做很可能是徒劳。”这不仅是钱的问题，” 曹立宇说，”我要的是正义。”
796239ee3229464929e31b535054a1498ea0aa98.translatedText: But at present, his younger brother Cao Liyu is still determined to continue the fight. He said that he is ready to file a lawsuit in a Chinese court, although several lawyers have warned him that doing so is likely to be in vain. "This is not just a matter of money," Cao Liyu said, "I want justice."

03504d6277562e48cb8bb638c2c8df9ab5918957.sourceText: 这是他们的父亲第一次也是最后一次来中国度假，从父亲的iPhone里找到的几百张照片中，有一张格外引人注目。画面上是列车车厢里的液晶显示器，炫耀着列车每小时303公里的行驶速度。照片因为摇晃而有些发虚。
03504d6277562e48cb8bb638c2c8df9ab5918957.translatedText: This was their father's first and last vacation in China, and among the hundreds of photos found on his iPhone, one stood out. On the screen is an LCD display in the train carriage, showing off the train's traveling speed of 303 kilometers per hour. The photo is a bit blurry due to shaking.

1948bf019cd5411756eebe392ce09734010bfab6.sourceText: ”我父亲为中国的进步感到非常自豪，”曹立宇说。”不幸的是，正是这种进步夺走了我父母的生命。”
1948bf019cd5411756eebe392ce09734010bfab6.translatedText: "My father is very proud of China's progress," Cao Liyu said. "Unfortunately, it was this progress that took away the lives of my parents."

7ec8d1654137f2cf3e517b333c8cf0a42ee0a911.sourceText: 杰安迪(Andrew Jacobs)是《纽约时报》驻京记者。Mia Li自北京对本文有研究贡献。
7ec8d1654137f2cf3e517b333c8cf0a42ee0a911.translatedText: Andrew Jacobs is the Beijing correspondent of the New York Times. Mia Li contributed research to this article from Beijing.

b970ec7a645b14153191e56120028fedb80d69fb.sourceText: 在美亚裔日趋彰显政治成就
b970ec7a645b14153191e56120028fedb80d69fb.translatedText: Asians in the United States are increasingly demonstrating their political achievements

9fb91d6a089812b028e84ee33086444df1e13747.sourceText: 在美亚裔日趋彰显政治成就 据《洛杉矶时报》报导，亚裔可能是美国人口增长最快、教育程度和平均收入最高的族裔，…
9fb91d6a089812b028e84ee33086444df1e13747.translatedText: Asians in the United States are increasingly demonstrating their political achievements. According to the Los Angeles Times, Asians may be the ethnic group with the fastest growing population, highest educational attainment and average income in the United States...

23a29339f796b0ea27ea2d223df58aaa6b226512.sourceText: 在美亚裔日趋彰显政治成就 据《洛杉矶时报》报导，亚裔可能是美国人口增长最快、教育程度和平均收入最高的族裔，但过去亚裔在政治上，无论是在民主党或共和党内，几乎默默无闻。但出席民主党全国代表大会的亚裔领袖3日表示，这种状况正在变化，今年两党候选人的胜出幅度很小，昭显亚太裔选民的重要性。 民主党亚太裔党团主席梁吴美琪(Bel Leong Hong)在北卡州夏洛特会议中心表示：”我们的新议题是胜出幅度”，亚裔”对两党选票箱越来越重要”。 亚裔领袖欢呼亚裔的民选官员人数增多，越来越参与美国政治。2008年只有约100名亚裔在丹佛出席民主党全代会，今年这个数字上升到300多人。虽然亚裔有钱人成为共和党和民主党的金主，广大的亚裔却不像拉美裔、非裔等族裔那样受到重视。 近年来，民主党已深入到亚太裔发展。丕优中心年初的民调显示，超过50%的亚裔选民登记为民主党，只有约30%登记为共和党。该中心2008年民调发现，超过60%亚裔投欧巴马的票，只有约35%支持马侃。 但各项民调也显示，许多亚裔选民未登记成为民主党或共和党，给两党留下巨大的发展空间。 在上午举行的民主党党团会议上，亚裔领袖表示，欧巴马总统任命的亚裔政府官员人数创下历史纪录，亚裔联邦法官增加一倍，达18人，能源部长朱棣文等三人进入内阁。 最新人口普查数据显示，美国有1820万亚裔，占全国人口约6%。超过60%的亚裔在外国出生，一半以上亚裔是有投票资格的美国公民。丕优中心的分析显示，2009年来，每年新来美国的亚洲移民人数已超过拉美裔。 加州国会众议员本田(Mike Honda)表示，在内华达、维吉尼亚等竞争激烈的州，亚裔人口有大量增长，”以前政客们认为亚裔人口少，不值得重视，于是亚裔被边缘化。现在，这个边缘化的群体决定选战的胜利”。 加州主计长江俊辉(John Chiang)表示，两党正在大力争取亚裔选票，包括最近的州长选举。他说：”这显然是一个很大的群体，存在令人难以置信的多样化。两党需要了解亚裔的文化与背景的差异。”
23a29339f796b0ea27ea2d223df58aaa6b226512.translatedText: Asians in the United States are increasingly demonstrating their political achievements. According to the Los Angeles Times, Asians may be the fastest-growing ethnic group in the United States, with the highest educational level and average income. However, in the past, Asians were almost unknown in politics, whether in the Democratic or Republican parties. However, Asian leaders attending the Democratic National Convention said on the 3rd that this situation is changing. This year, the winning margins of candidates from both parties are very small, demonstrating the importance of Asian and Pacific American voters. Bel Leong Hong, chairwoman of the Democratic Asian Pacific American Caucus, said at the Charlotte Convention Center in North Carolina: "Our new issue is the margin of victory" and Asian Americans are "increasingly important to the ballot box of both parties." Asian leaders have hailed the growing number of Asian-American elected officials and their increasing participation in American politics. In 2008, only about 100 Asians attended the Democratic National Convention in Denver. This year, the number rose to more than 300. Although wealthy Asians have become donors to the Republican and Democratic parties, the majority of Asians are not as valued as Hispanics, African Americans and other ethnic groups. In recent years, the Democratic Party has reached out to Asian and Pacific Islanders. Polls conducted by the Piyou Center at the beginning of the year showed that more than 50% of Asian voters were registered as Democrats, and only about 30% were registered as Republicans. The center's 2008 poll found that more than 60% of Asians voted for Obama, while only about 35% supported John McCain. However, various polls also show that many Asian voters are not registered as Democrats or Republicans, leaving huge room for development for both parties. At the Democratic caucus meeting held in the morning, Asian leaders said that the number of Asian government officials appointed by President Obama hit a record. The number of Asian federal judges doubled to 18, and Energy Secretary Steven Chu and three other people entered the cabinet. The latest census data shows that there are 18.2 million Asians in the United States, accounting for about 6% of the national population. More than 60% of Asians were born abroad, and more than half of Asians are U.S. citizens eligible to vote. Analysis by the Pioneer Center shows that since 2009, the number of new Asian immigrants coming to the United States every year has exceeded that of Hispanics. California Congressman Mike Honda said that in fiercely competitive states such as Nevada and Virginia, the Asian population has grown significantly. "In the past, politicians believed that the Asian population was small and not worthy of attention, so Asians were marginalized. Now, this marginalized group determines the victory of the election." California Comptroller John Chiang said both parties are vigorously pursuing Asian votes, including in the recent gubernatorial election. "This is obviously a large group and incredibly diverse," he said. "Both parties need to understand the differences in Asian cultures and backgrounds."

83690fb3ce76254bfeb1fd1562b9abcf8ed6b7b1.translatedText: Jinxin Real Estate News: First Time Home Investment Strategies (Part 1)

59621feeb13d5fdc89659220fea76d3a871bb58b.translatedText: Jinxin Real Estate News: First Time Home Investment Strategies (Part 1) Home ownership in the United States has become more fragile than it was a few years ago, and more and more Americans no longer own homes as...

a1cdd3b9e1a073fe6b82249c75a13f44fc3cb77f.sourceText: 金信地产新闻：首次房屋投资计策(上) 在美国房屋拥有权变得比几年前脆弱，越来越多的美国人不再拥有房屋成为了租客，所以投资房屋出租成为了一个正在兴起的行业。 房屋出租行业有很多需要考虑的问题。首先就是投资资金问题，放多少首付？ 每个月收多少房租你可以付月供？当你没有收入，房屋又空置的时候，怎么处理？很多人会考虑提前申请房屋投资贷款（an investment property loan），来处理这些临时发生的问题。 地点是房屋投资最重要的地方。需要考虑的因素是交通，购物，学校，甚至地区的犯罪率。这跟自己买房子一样。然后是目标客户，你想出租的对象是单身，还是家庭？这样就考虑买公寓还是独立屋，或者是度假屋。 房屋类型决定后，固定准备一些钱做房屋的维护和整修。然后根据自己屋内的设备，例如电器和家具，评估出一个合理的出租价格。在下期专栏中我们将会谈租赁房屋的管理和市场。更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的Tinna (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com 。
a1cdd3b9e1a073fe6b82249c75a13f44fc3cb77f.translatedText: Jinxin Real Estate News: First Time Home Investment Strategies (Part 1) Homeownership in the United States has become more tenuous than it was just a few years ago, with more Americans no longer owning their homes and becoming renters, so investing in home rentals is a rising industry. The rental industry has a lot to consider. The first is the issue of investment funds. How much down payment is required? How much rent can you charge each month to pay the monthly payment? What do you do when you have no income and your house is vacant? Many people will consider applying for an investment property loan in advance to deal with these temporary problems. Location is the most important aspect of home investment. Factors to consider are transportation, shopping, schools, and even the crime rate in the area. It’s the same as buying your own house. Then there is the target customer. Do you want to rent to a single person or a family? In this way, consider whether to buy an apartment, a house, or a vacation home. After deciding on the type of house, always prepare some money for house maintenance and renovation. Then evaluate a reasonable rental price based on the equipment in your house, such as appliances and furniture. In the next column we will talk about the management and market of rental housing. For more information about real estate, please contact Tinna of Goldtrust Realty (480)287-0180 E-mail: Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com.

9afc96b490b25ee810ef23e3de089f97f331dcbb.sourceText: 上海市向台北市让渡花博会展园“海韵园”
9afc96b490b25ee810ef23e3de089f97f331dcbb.translatedText: Shanghai City transfers the Flower Expo Exhibition Park "Haiyun Garden" to Taipei City

193fabd9b45a157177de290659e1f2666f3fbccf.sourceText: 上海市向台北市让渡花博会展园“海韵园” 新华网 上海市政府的代表24日在2010台北国际花卉博览会营运总部…
193fabd9b45a157177de290659e1f2666f3fbccf.translatedText: Shanghai City transfers the Flower Expo Exhibition Park "Haiyun Garden" to Taipei City Xinhuanet Representatives of the Shanghai Municipal Government were at the 2010 Taipei International Flower Expo Operations Headquarters on the 24th...

563c4a51da0ac322d472c7b786741f8cf482e7b5.sourceText: 上海市政府的代表24日在2010台北国际花卉博览会营运总部，将花博会上海展园”海韵园”让渡给台北市政府。”海韵园”将在花博会闭幕后原样保存，供台北市民、游客继续观赏，成为上海、台北两座姐妹城市友谊的象征。
563c4a51da0ac322d472c7b786741f8cf482e7b5.translatedText: Representatives of the Shanghai Municipal Government were at the 2010 Taipei International Flower Expo Operations Headquarters on the 24th to transfer the Flower Expo Shanghai Exhibition Garden "Haiyun Garden" to the Taipei City Government. "Haiyun Garden" will be preserved as it is after the Flower Expo, for Taipei citizens and tourists to continue to enjoy, becoming a symbol of friendship between the two sister cities of Shanghai and Taipei.

a7539365359e9c9c71d07f51a9ab2aa4638bb77a.sourceText: 台北花博会总执行长陈雄文在让渡仪式上，对上海市对台北花博会的支持表示感谢。他说，”海韵园”展示了上海的文化、传统和花卉，是本届花博会非常亮眼的景点，受到台北市民的喜爱，增进了两市市民的了解。”海韵园”从此刻起落户台北，台北市将维持原来的设计理念、风貌及其传达的意象，继续向游客开放。
a7539365359e9c9c71d07f51a9ab2aa4638bb77a.translatedText: Taipei Flower Expo CEO Chen Xiongwen expressed his gratitude to Shanghai for its support to the Taipei Flower Expo at the transfer ceremony. He said that "Haiyun Garden" showcases Shanghai's culture, tradition and flowers. It is a very eye-catching attraction at this flower expo. It is loved by Taipei citizens and has enhanced the understanding between the citizens of the two cities. "Haiyun Garden" will be settled in Taipei from now on. Taipei City will maintain the original design concept, style and the image it conveys, and will continue to be open to tourists.

8b5d9595fd60ca41e445e1bc220ca2711d13b9f0.sourceText: 上海市台办、园林管理部门负责人出席了让渡仪式和捐赠仪式。
8b5d9595fd60ca41e445e1bc220ca2711d13b9f0.translatedText: The heads of Shanghai Taiwan Affairs Office and Garden Management Department attended the transfer ceremony and donation ceremony.

93d5912c2718718757b3fa979835a9cb741359a1.sourceText: ”海韵园”位于台北花博会圆山公园区，具有浓郁的上海风情，迄今吸引超过280万人次的游客参观。
93d5912c2718718757b3fa979835a9cb741359a1.translatedText: "Haiyun Garden" is located in the Yuanshan Park area of ​​the Taipei Flower Expo. It has a rich Shanghai style and has attracted more than 2.8 million tourists so far.

da1b76e262095213e899b09cd862abbca6f65319.sourceText: 台北花博会2010年11月6日在台北市４个主要公园区开幕，将于今年4月2日闭幕。截至4月23日，游园人数达865.6371万人次。主办方预计闭幕时，入园总人数有望突破880万人次。
da1b76e262095213e899b09cd862abbca6f65319.translatedText: The Taipei Flower Expo opened on November 6, 2010 in four major park areas in Taipei City and will close on April 2 this year. As of April 23, the number of visitors to the park reached 8,656,371. Organizers expect the total number of visitors to the park to exceed 8.8 million when it closes.

979efcf95e7648930a2232d22afc5dec5e838058.sourceText: 据悉，类似的情况也发生在南加州的精英学府、著名的文理学院克莱蒙特?#40614;肯纳学院(Claremont McKenna)。今年，校方承认自2006年起便在学生的SAT成绩上造假，最新的排名显示，该校美国文理学院中排名第9。事件曝光后，《美国新闻与世界报道》杂志的排名并未更改，但Kiplinger杂志将其从2012年大学榜单中除名。
979efcf95e7648930a2232d22afc5dec5e838058.translatedText: It is reported that a similar situation also occurred at Claremont McKenna, an elite institution in Southern California and a well-known liberal arts college. This year, the school admitted that it had been falsifying students' SAT scores since 2006. The latest rankings show that the school ranks 9th among American liberal arts colleges. After the incident was exposed, U.S. News & World Report magazine's rankings did not change, but Kiplinger magazine removed it from the 2012 college list.

0cf126618eea6ff48da8a1126b35eac8104e5511.sourceText: 其他曝出作假丑闻的学校还有于纽约的新罗谢尔市爱纳学院(Iona College)、得克萨斯贝勒大学(Baylor University)、维拉诺瓦大学(Villanova University )法学院、和伊利诺伊大学(University of Illinois)。
0cf126618eea6ff48da8a1126b35eac8104e5511.translatedText: Other schools exposed to fraud scandals include Iona College in New Rochelle, New York, Baylor University in Texas, Villanova University School of Law, and the University of Illinois.

d26f01a828b98f4948b6b90127900e59932914b4.sourceText: 真正让人震惊的不是问题大学的数量，而是它们层出不穷的造假花招。贝勒大学2008年承认对新生提供金钱奖励，鼓励其收回自己的ACT成绩，这样学校的平均录取分就会提高。2009年，大批大学被曝出夸大全职教授的比例，而全职教授比例是大学排名系统中的重要参考数据。爱纳学院(Iona College)在2011年秋天承认不仅在考试成绩方面造假，还谎报了毕业率、新生保有率、学生教员比例、录取率以及校友捐赠金额。各校招生负责人表示，有些学校将低分学生的录取时间推迟至来年1月，从而不用把这些学生计入9月份入学学生的平均分，而有的学校则寻求更多的申请人，以降低录取比例。
d26f01a828b98f4948b6b90127900e59932914b4.translatedText: What is really shocking is not the number of problem universities, but their endless fraud tactics. Baylor University admitted in 2008 that it would provide financial incentives to freshmen to encourage them to withdraw their ACT scores, so that the school's average admission score would increase. In 2009, it was revealed that a large number of universities had exaggerated the proportion of full-time professors, which is an important reference data in university ranking systems. Iona College admitted in the fall of 2011 that it had falsified not only its test scores but also its graduation rate, freshman retention rate, student-to-faculty ratio, enrollment rate and alumni donations. Directors of admissions at each school said that some schools postponed the admission of low-scoring students until January of the following year, so that these students do not need to be included in the average score of students admitted in September, while some schools are seeking more applicants to reduce the admission ratio.

fb140149d6773318521d6f17f68adddeefea84ce.sourceText: 芝加哥市德保罗大学(DePaul University)主管招生的助理副校长乔恩?#21338;肯斯泰特(Jon Boeckenstedt)说：”人们对大学排名的依赖已难以控制。将一所大学的高等教育价值与另一个大学相比较是一件模棱两可的事情，因此家长、学生、咨询顾问都只关注那些他们以为精确、而实际上是假象的东西。”
fb140149d6773318521d6f17f68adddeefea84ce.translatedText: Jon Boeckenstedt, assistant vice president for admissions at DePaul University in Chicago, said: "People's reliance on college rankings has become uncontrollable. Comparing the value of higher education at one college to another is an ambiguous thing, so parents, students and counselors only focus on what they think is accurate, but in fact it is an illusion."

d8a047f11a740f61254c72508808773f8642dedb.sourceText: 中国经济走软 下行速度加快
d8a047f11a740f61254c72508808773f8642dedb.translatedText: China's economy is weakening and the downward trend is accelerating

6fc40680cbb94fdc0a8ce7730497805b040c8d28.sourceText: 中国经济走软 下行速度加快 中国经济发展进一步放缓，8月份的制造业采购经理人指数急剧下滑至9个月来的低点，…
6fc40680cbb94fdc0a8ce7730497805b040c8d28.translatedText: China's economy is weakening and the downward trend is accelerating China's economic development has further slowed down, and the manufacturing purchasing managers' index in August fell sharply to a nine-month low...

1dd14d40f1af21132102916f911c2660b1366e27.translatedText: * China's August PMI fell to a nine-month low*

2dbe15a98aeb94f7e63280204c42c404e49814e2.sourceText: 汇丰银行23日发表的最新数据显示，中国8月份的制造业采购经理人指数（PMI）（预览）从7月的49.3跌至47.8。这是中国PMI连续10个月低于50。PMI低于50表明收缩，大于50表明扩张。
2dbe15a98aeb94f7e63280204c42c404e49814e2.translatedText: The latest data released by HSBC on the 23rd showed that China's manufacturing purchasing managers' index (PMI) (preview) in August fell to 47.8 from 49.3 in July. This is the 10th consecutive month that China’s PMI has been below 50. A PMI below 50 indicates contraction, while a PMI above 50 indicates expansion.

83f9af0bb8ce90e963c09f2a36ca4568d9ea08d5.sourceText: 汇丰首席经济学家屈宏斌指出，中国制造业持续受到全球负面因素的冲击，中国出口承受的压力，需要政府在未来几个月要进一步放松政策，增加基础设施投入，才能实现稳增长、稳就业的政策目标。
83f9af0bb8ce90e963c09f2a36ca4568d9ea08d5.translatedText: Qu Hongbin, chief economist of HSBC, pointed out that China's manufacturing industry continues to be impacted by global negative factors, and the pressure on China's exports requires the government to further relax policies and increase investment in infrastructure in the next few months to achieve the policy goals of stabilizing growth and employment.

6077758d09539aa2490b56270dfbcc8538ced747.sourceText: *PMI持续下滑预示着经济的麻烦*
6077758d09539aa2490b56270dfbcc8538ced747.translatedText: *The continued decline in PMI indicates economic trouble*

0e55c1b48732123a76caf2fba72cfce308e6afc7.sourceText: 此前，很多分析人士预计，8月份的PMI指数将会趋稳，甚至可能微幅上升，但结果令人大为失望。法国兴业银行（香港）的中国经济学家姚伟说，结果”真的很糟糕”。他说，8月PMI出人意料地大幅下跌，逆转了7月份的回升。这种程度的下降，指数低于50，毫无疑问预示着麻烦。
0e55c1b48732123a76caf2fba72cfce308e6afc7.translatedText: Previously, many analysts expected that the PMI index in August would stabilize or even rise slightly, but the results were disappointing. Yao Wei, China economist at Societe Generale Hong Kong, said the results were "really bad". He said the PMI unexpectedly fell sharply in August, reversing the recovery in July. A decline of this magnitude, with the index below 50, certainly portends trouble.

cb06a3bbd2786ce34d7f714ddbbab17a2fcff6b1.sourceText: 美联社说，中国PMI持续下滑显示，中国经济的恢复将需要更长的时间，恢复的强劲程度，由于欧美等主要市场进口需求出人意料地疲软，比原来预测的要弱。
cb06a3bbd2786ce34d7f714ddbbab17a2fcff6b1.translatedText: The Associated Press said that the continued decline of China's PMI showed that the recovery of China's economy will take longer and the strength of the recovery is weaker than originally predicted due to unexpectedly weak import demand in major markets such as Europe and the United States.

a83f9deccdca8beee6de134fbd33ff750e76004b.sourceText: *加大投资保增长 紧缩信贷抑通胀*
a83f9deccdca8beee6de134fbd33ff750e76004b.translatedText: *Increase investment to maintain growth and tighten credit to suppress inflation*

1eff865792d11e4da11914e61890c9c327f3f717.sourceText: 中国政府为了减缓尤其是欧美等国经济疲软给中国带来的影响，从6月1日开始已经两度降低利率，并加大对基础设施的投资，向经济注入更多的资金。不过，中国当局在放宽货币政策方面非常谨慎，因为此前中国为了应对2008年的世界金融危机而推出庞大的刺激计划，引发了通货膨胀和房市泡沫。
1eff865792d11e4da11914e61890c9c327f3f717.translatedText: In order to slow down the impact of economic weakness in China, especially in Europe and the United States, the Chinese government has lowered interest rates twice since June 1, increased investment in infrastructure, and injected more funds into the economy. However, Chinese authorities are very cautious in easing monetary policy after the country launched a huge stimulus plan in response to the 2008 world financial crisis, which triggered inflation and housing bubbles.

d87a7e8998d5a60a67869066e04832cf68483e0e.sourceText: *经济增长放缓为三年来低点*
d87a7e8998d5a60a67869066e04832cf68483e0e.translatedText: * Economic growth slowed to a three-year low*

30056a9f8b547da7891e97d1c9e5e99b56ea651a.sourceText: 中国在2010年至2011年开始紧缩信贷和投资，给过热的经济和通胀降温。此后，中国经济增长势头逐渐放缓，从多年来两位数增长，下降今年第二季度的7.6%，为过去三年来的低点。中国预计今年的经济增长为7.5%。
30056a9f8b547da7891e97d1c9e5e99b56ea651a.translatedText: China began to tighten credit and investment from 2010 to 2011 to cool down an overheated economy and inflation. Since then, China's economic growth momentum has gradually slowed down, from double-digit growth for many years to 7.6% in the second quarter of this year, the lowest level in the past three years. China expects economic growth this year to be 7.5%.

d3494f6e87b01120241f09129e769fec18a7b664.sourceText: *中国出口下降连带影响亚洲经济体*
d3494f6e87b01120241f09129e769fec18a7b664.translatedText: *The decline in China's exports has also affected Asian economies*

13ec999728f2dc3342c62770329a4f4b96b53175.sourceText: 华尔街日报引述野村证券中国经济学家张智威的话说，中国经济走软将给亚洲出口导向型的经济体韩国、日本和台湾造成很大负面影响，因为很多中国出口产品的零部件来自这些经济体。中国出口增速放缓，整个亚洲的出口形势都将在近期受到严峻挑战。
13ec999728f2dc3342c62770329a4f4b96b53175.translatedText: The Wall Street Journal quoted Nomura Securities China economist Zhang Zhiwei as saying that the weakening of China's economy will have a great negative impact on Asia's export-oriented economies South Korea, Japan and Taiwan, because many parts of China's export products come from these economies. China's export growth is slowing down, and the export situation across Asia will be severely challenged in the near future.

8ebd7ef3633d392dd4ab3a631eced0c48cb09e78.sourceText: 汇丰公布的数据显示，8月份的出口订单指数也从7月份的46.7下降到44.7，是过去3年半以来的新低。全球对中国产品需求的急剧下降，导致中国出口商遭受重创，破产的出口企业数以千计。
8ebd7ef3633d392dd4ab3a631eced0c48cb09e78.translatedText: Data released by HSBC showed that the export order index in August also dropped to 44.7 from 46.7 in July, a new low in the past three and a half years. The sharp decline in global demand for Chinese products has caused heavy losses to Chinese exporters, and thousands of export companies have gone bankrupt.

1c701ba4a4e4ad16b3f20b448e046b1b6afc6339.sourceText: 摩根大通在一份报告中说，不景气的外部环境将继续对中国的出口行业造成压力。这可能会是中国主要的风险因素。
1c701ba4a4e4ad16b3f20b448e046b1b6afc6339.translatedText: JPMorgan Chase said in a report that the sluggish external environment will continue to put pressure on China's export industry. This may be a major risk factor for China.

079b88bc0a9450d6dd54511e87713f9b1de667b3.sourceText: *政治改革：制约中国经济发展的关键*
079b88bc0a9450d6dd54511e87713f9b1de667b3.translatedText: *Political reform: the key to restricting China's economic development*

38e5d1df1c61cbb2bea472604cbfaa70d9297409.sourceText: 美国俄亥俄州托莱多大学亚洲研究中心主任、经济学教授张欣说，目前中国经济已经不是用增加政府开支去解决宏观需求不足，用收紧银根去抑制通货膨胀的时候了。中国经济已没有继续发展势头的力量。他说，目前一系列问题在制约着中国经济的发展。
38e5d1df1c61cbb2bea472604cbfaa70d9297409.translatedText: Zhang Xin, director of the Asia Research Center and professor of economics at the University of Toledo in Ohio, USA, said that it is no longer time for China's economy to increase government spending to solve insufficient macro demand and tighten money to curb inflation. China's economy no longer has the strength to continue its development momentum. He said that a series of problems are currently restricting China's economic development.

2e9c560258bdd8737d810314f377b9f80a114cd3.sourceText: ”第一，保护经济发展的法制系统，中国没有解决好，包括对私有产权的保护，对知识产权的保护。所以造成了去年到今年几千亿美元的出逃。 第二，现在中国的腐败已经全面化了，包括科学界、学术界。 如果这样的话，市场没有办法很好地运行。 第三，经济的发展需要财政的透明，公民的参与以及政府对其行为的负责任。”
2e9c560258bdd8737d810314f377b9f80a114cd3.translatedText: "First, China has not solved the legal system to protect economic development, including the protection of private property rights and intellectual property rights. This resulted in the flight of hundreds of billions of dollars from last year to this year. Second, corruption in China has now become comprehensive, including in the scientific community and academia. If this is the case, the market will not be able to operate well. Third, economic development requires fiscal transparency, citizen participation and the government's responsibility for its actions. "

3b39852d93ccb0b722f3e63782031c521610ee68.sourceText: 张欣教授说，这些问题都是目前处在中等发展程度的中国必须迈过的门槛和陷阱，而中国目前的状况恰恰反映了深陷这种陷阱的困境。 因此，单靠财政经济的手段，已无法扭转局面，非实行政治改革不可。 他强调，没有政治改革，中国经济要继续维持高速增长是不可能的。
3b39852d93ccb0b722f3e63782031c521610ee68.translatedText: Professor Zhang Xin said that these problems are thresholds and traps that China, which is currently at a medium level of development, must overcome, and China's current situation exactly reflects the dilemma of falling into this trap. Therefore, fiscal and economic means alone can no longer reverse the situation, and political reforms must be implemented. He emphasized that without political reform, it is impossible for China's economy to continue to maintain rapid growth.

c746169f79c60496fb9a3e7fbf08d13672d9d961.sourceText: *企业倒闭失业增加危及社会稳定*
c746169f79c60496fb9a3e7fbf08d13672d9d961.translatedText: *Business closures and increased unemployment endanger social stability*

ea18a95ff180d931ae9b5233ab59d8238b526bb1.sourceText: 中国制造业增长乏力，出口下降导致的大量企业倒闭，经济增速在7.5%上下徘徊，致使就业指数连续六个月低于50。8月份的就业指数为47.7。
ea18a95ff180d931ae9b5233ab59d8238b526bb1.translatedText: China's manufacturing industry has sluggish growth, a large number of companies have closed down due to declining exports, and the economic growth rate has hovered around 7.5%, causing the employment index to be below 50 for six consecutive months. The employment index in August was 47.7.

f356742677c09eede28b424ad6581c2794ccfb2e.sourceText: 张肇鸿：《沙漠明珠》新文章将陆续上网
f356742677c09eede28b424ad6581c2794ccfb2e.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: New articles on "Pearl of the Desert" will be online one after another

a0b3a6fcdc3cfafa9e0cac69025b0309fc132d9e.sourceText: 张肇鸿：《沙漠明珠》新文章将陆续上网 新书”沙漠明珠&#8221…
a0b3a6fcdc3cfafa9e0cac69025b0309fc132d9e.translatedText: Zhaohong Zhang: New articles on "Pearl of the Desert" will be online one after another. The new book "Pearl of the Desert"...

99667bfa1d002ec24176d49f7303d868e12cfbd7.sourceText: 新书”沙漠明珠”是一本反映亚省华人奋斗斗历史和凤凰城侨团人物故事和本土文化的书籍。 自发行以来广受好评，并已收辑在部分图书馆中。 为了回馈侨联和社会贤达的支持和赞助，书籍面世后即以赠送形式分发给侨联属下十七个团体和凤凰城-成都姐妹市、亚省亚裔摄影协会，以及社会贤达和长期关心此书 的朋友。 ”沙漠明珠”曾在七月四号侨联庆祝美国国庆日中义卖，作者并把所得款项捐助给侨联；并向参加国庆写作、绘画活动的四十名优胜学生赠送此书籍；此书亦送给 了世界日报、星岛日报及本地各报社媒体、太阳鸟网站、新东方艺术学校、中文学校等社会文化教育单位；在罗省召开的美洲、全美的中华会馆年会上，向中华民国侨务委员长吴 英毅、大会主席马国威、秘书长黄金泉、洛侨文教中心主任高家富以及与会的代表们赠送了此书，华侨协会总会的沈大川明确地表示，将会把”沙漠明珠”一书归档到 总会的图书馆中。 在支持华人参政筹款会上，在全美黄氏代表大会上，在纪念九一八抗战座谈会上，亦进行了义卖和赠送。 在凤凰城华人庆祝中华人民共和国成立六十三周年的活动中，作者向卞立新副总领事，许翠英领事、白东石领事及中国驻罗省总领馆赠送了”沙漠明珠”。 而ASU亚利桑那州州立大学图书馆在获得此书后，副研究员何乐平特告知此书已订立在世界最大的书目数据库中( http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WorldCat ) ，将显示在 亚利桑那州立大学图书馆的在线目录上，另外，”风采季刋”也刋出了相关文章，亚省和凤凰城华侨先进人物事迹与本土文化已得到了更广泛的宣扬和传播。 ” 沙漠明珠”一书由张肇鸿经过多年的搜集编著而成，资深侨领余文劲、邓朝驹、关宗任、黄定江等鼎力支持，上百位侨社人士提供过资料，侨联主席张华芳、前主席高志中、艺术 大家今奇教授、旅美作家吕宝华为此书作序，书法家陈普为封面提字。 作者对此书设计提供过宝贵意见的浓娜工作室、曹今奇教授、方慧贤、吉人、郑弘先生、毕威廉先生等深表谢忱！ ”沙漠明珠璀璨，华侨历史光荣”。 目前，作者已把”沙漠明珠”一书放上了网际网络，网路版比印刷板传播更为广泛，书中大多数相片也还原为彩色，今后，读者可上”凤凰艺文网”www.paaca.us查询资料和阅读全文。 另外，网路版的”沙漠明珠”(2) 近期亦正在编辑之中，新的文章将会陆续放于网上。
99667bfa1d002ec24176d49f7303d868e12cfbd7.translatedText: The new book "Pearl of the Desert" is a book that reflects the struggle history of the Chinese in Alberta and the stories of characters from the overseas Chinese community in Phoenix and local culture. It has been widely praised since its release and has been collected in some libraries. In order to repay the support and sponsorship of the Overseas Chinese Federation and social elites, the book was distributed as gifts to seventeen groups affiliated to the Overseas Chinese Federation, Phoenix-Chengdu Sister Cities, the Asian Photography Association of Asia, as well as social elites and friends who have long cared about the book. At the World Daily, Sing Tao Daily and local newspapers and media, Sunbird website, New Oriental Art School, Chinese school and other social and cultural education units; at the annual meeting of the Chinese Association of the Americas and the United States held in Luo Province, I paid tribute to Wu, Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission of the Republic of China. Ying Yi, chairman of the conference Ma Guowei, secretary-general Huang Huangquan, director of the Luoqiao Cultural and Educational Center Gao Jiafu and other representatives present presented the book. Shen Dachuan of the Overseas Chinese Association Federation made it clear that the book "Pearl of the Desert" would be archived in the library of the association. Charity sales and gifts were also held at fund-raising meetings to support Chinese participation in politics, at the National Huang Congress, and at the symposium commemorating the September 18th Anti-Japanese War. During the celebration of the 63rd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China by Chinese people in Phoenix, the author presented the "Pearl of the Desert" to Deputy Consul General Bian Lixin, Consul Xu Cuiying, Consul General Bai Dongshi and the Chinese Consulate General in Luohan Province. After the ASU Arizona State University Library obtained the book, associate researcher He Lepingte informed that the book has been included in the world's largest bibliographic database (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WorldCat) and will be displayed. In addition, relevant articles have been published in the online catalog of the Arizona State University Library, and the deeds and local culture of advanced overseas Chinese figures in Alberta and Phoenix have been more widely publicized and disseminated. " The book "Pearl of the Desert" was compiled and compiled by Zhang Zhaohong after many years of collection, with strong support from senior overseas Chinese leaders Yu Wenjin, Deng Chaoju, Guan Zongren, Huang Dingjiang and others. Hundreds of overseas Chinese community members have provided information. Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Zhang Huafang, former chairman Gao Zhizhong, art master Professor Jin Qi, and American writer Lu Baohua wrote the preface to the book, and calligrapher Chen Pu wrote the words for the cover. The author expresses his deep gratitude to Nong Na Studio, Professor Cao Jinqi, Fang Huixian, Ji Ren, Mr. Zheng Hong, and Mr. Bi William! "The Pearl of the Desert is dazzling and the history of overseas Chinese is glorious." At present, the author has put the book "Pearl of the Desert" on the Internet. The online version is more widely disseminated than the printed version, and most of the photos in the book have been restored to color. In the future, readers can check the information and read the full text on the "Phoenix Art and Literature Network" www.paaca.us. In addition, the online version of "Pearl of the Desert" (2) is currently being edited, and new articles will be posted online one after another.

4cff9c3686befc0f8e71cf3fc365f0fe4903ccc0.sourceText: 美政治风向转变有利移民改革
4cff9c3686befc0f8e71cf3fc365f0fe4903ccc0.translatedText: The U.S. political winds have changed in favor of immigration reform

9f889e46ef7a2f9203377298bc409faf45f8369d.sourceText: 美政治风向转变有利移民改革 六年前的本月，路易斯安那州国会参议员兰德里欧（Mary L. Landrieu…
9f889e46ef7a2f9203377298bc409faf45f8369d.translatedText: The U.S. political winds have changed in favor of immigration reform Six years ago this month, Louisiana Congress Senator Mary L. Landrieu...

e62a5c72c5d6a16e00f083e0874049662abced16.sourceText: 六年前的本月，路易斯安那州国会参议员兰德里欧（Mary L. Landrieu）随着连任竞选的压力，伙同另外15名民主党参议员打掉移民改革法案，声称为违背法律进入美国的人提供入籍道路是鼓励”非法行为”。
e62a5c72c5d6a16e00f083e0874049662abced16.translatedText: Six years ago this month, Louisiana Congress Senator Mary L. Landrieu, with the pressure of his re-election campaign, joined 15 other Democratic senators to kill the immigration reform bill, claiming that providing a path to naturalization for those who entered the United States in violation of the law would encourage "illegal behavior."

e868c2ccb8dd11ec24e015ea02856f4bedb6b0c4.sourceText: 中国高房价让年轻人暮气沉沉
e868c2ccb8dd11ec24e015ea02856f4bedb6b0c4.translatedText: China's high housing prices are making young people feel depressed

46fbac4371588da515c94018352b5b567c69cdab.sourceText: 中国高房价让年轻人暮气沉沉 近日来，有媒体称80后暮气沉沉，引发广泛讨论。年轻人的精神状态备受社会瞩目，这…
46fbac4371588da515c94018352b5b567c69cdab.translatedText: > China's high housing prices are making young people feel depressed. Recently, some media said that the post-80s generation is feeling depressed, triggering widespread discussion. The mental state of young people has attracted much attention from society. This...

a36552f8969390627499d93294684d8325df23cc.sourceText: 新京报”京报调查”(新京报《评论周刊》与清研咨询联合推出)的调查结果显示，整体上来看，对于80后的精神状态，近七成受访者抱持肯定态度。仅13.6%的受访者认为80后没有朝气，49.3%的受访者认为80后大部分有活力，小部分暮气沉沉，20.3%的受访者则认为80后很有活力。还有16.8%的受访者认为80后大部分暮气沉沉，小部分有活力。这说明，认为80后暮气沉沉并非是确定的结论。
a36552f8969390627499d93294684d8325df23cc.translatedText: The results of the Beijing News' "Beijing News Survey" (jointly launched by the Beijing News' "Review Weekly" and Qingyan Consulting) show that, overall, nearly 70% of the respondents have a positive attitude towards the mental state of the post-80s generation. Only 13.6% of the respondents believe that the post-80s generation has no vitality, 49.3% of the respondents believe that most of the post-80s generation are energetic, and a small number are lifeless. 20.3% of the respondents believe that the post-80s generation is very energetic. There are also 16.8% of the respondents who believe that most people born in the 1980s are lifeless, while a small number of them are energetic. This shows that it is not a definite conclusion that the post-80s generation is in decline.

52d24e87c6b02a8fbc107edea407d59dbfa39a03.sourceText: 本该充满活力的年轻人却显得暮气沉沉，原因是什么呢？76.5%的受访者认为是”社会原因，生活压力太大”所致，12.8%的受访者则认为是”个人原因，性格问题”，9.9%的人认为是”周围环境所致”。可见，因生活压力导致年轻人精神状态发生改变的观点得到大部分人的认同。
52d24e87c6b02a8fbc107edea407d59dbfa39a03.translatedText: Young people who should be full of energy appear to be lifeless. What is the reason? 76.5% of the respondents believed that it was caused by "social reasons and too much pressure in life", 12.8% of the respondents believed that it was caused by "personal reasons and personality problems", and 9.9% believed that it was "caused by the surrounding environment". It can be seen that the view that the mental state of young people changes due to life stress is recognized by most people.

fb09ce7aa8be7f1143ab70a60a82f6d23b68a324.sourceText: 那么，究竟哪些具体的压力让年轻人容易变得暮气沉沉呢？高房价、工作竞争和生活经济问题成为压力源中的前三位，其中85.6%选择了”高房价”，成为当仁不让的首位。
fb09ce7aa8be7f1143ab70a60a82f6d23b68a324.translatedText: So, what specific pressures make young people easily become sluggish? High housing prices, job competition and life and economic problems have become the top three sources of stress, with 85.6% choosing "high housing prices" as the top priority.

d7046b44deaf3d1af71ba96e083c514789965d82.sourceText: 如何缓解年轻人的压力？71.5%的受访者认为应该”进一步完善社会公共福利体系”，68.2%的人选择”学会自我调适，增强抗压能力”，67.4%的人认为”社会环境宽松一些，给年轻人更多成长空间”。
d7046b44deaf3d1af71ba96e083c514789965d82.translatedText: How to relieve the stress of young people? 71.5% of the respondents believed that the social and public welfare system should be "further improved", 68.2% chose "learn to adjust themselves and enhance their ability to withstand stress", and 67.4% believed that "the social environment should be more relaxed to give young people more room to grow".

940048994fca8b1a0aa896240e6da6c30a34f180.sourceText: 希望中文学校学生演出“木兰出征”的台上幕后
940048994fca8b1a0aa896240e6da6c30a34f180.translatedText: I hope Chinese school students will perform "Mulan Goes Out" on stage and behind the scenes

6089b7ce8b24216d8545b760e5e31f902fa81e88.translatedText: I hope Chinese school students will perform "Mulan Goes Out" on stage and behind the scenes - and write poems and inscriptions for Dr. Chen Pu to praise the performance...
