ac9ceb93168b169aad0561335817e0848f95c9c6.translatedText: - Also write poems and inscriptions for Dr. Chen Pu to praise the performance and praise him

040f014d8c84942073f68005584820e4dfecca7b.sourceText: 凤凰笔会 帅致若 2014年5月，为准备在全美中文学校协会第10次全国代表大会上的演出，本城五所中文学校负责人和我一起开会讨论节目的基本定调和要求。会上决定节目要体现学生们学习中华语言文化的成果。希望中文学校的董事长周青和校长田琳当时不约而同在脑中想到的就是改编排练”木兰出征”舞蹈剧，并加强语言表现部分；这一点是节目的编导蒋琳老师最近告诉我的。 2014年12月13日晚上，全美中文学校协会全国大会举行颁奖典礼之后，演出的第一个节目是希望中文学校的”木兰出征”；以近二十个学生的齐声朗诵”木兰辞”为开场，身着战衣、英姿飒爽的十多个古代女战士在急促的音乐声中一个个大跳跃出场；瞬时，原本说笑喧嚣的会场一下子安静下来，全被吸引住了；5分钟的演出节目，形式独特、环节紧扣、情节完整、内容饱满；在场的华教人士来自美国各地乃至中国华文教育部门，个个可谓见多识广，但看到这个节目，个个赞不绝口，惊叹一所以教授中华语言为主的周末学校，竟然排出了如此激昂大气、令人震撼的舞蹈剧！
040f014d8c84942073f68005584820e4dfecca7b.translatedText: Phoenix PEN Shuai Zhiruo In May 2014, in preparation for the performance at the 10th National Congress of the National Association of Chinese Schools, the heads of five Chinese schools in this city met with me to discuss the basic tone and requirements of the program. At the meeting, it was decided that the program should reflect the students’ achievements in learning Chinese language and culture. Zhou Qing, the chairman of Hope Chinese School, and Tian Lin, the principal, all had in mind the idea of ​​adapting and rehearsing the "Mulan Goes Out" dance drama and enhancing the language performance; this is what the program's choreographer Jiang Lin recently told me. On the evening of December 13, 2014, after the awards ceremony at the National Convention of the National Association of Chinese Schools, the first program performed was "Mulan Goes Out" by Hope Chinese Schools. It started with nearly twenty students reciting "Mulan's Song" in unison. More than a dozen ancient female warriors in battle uniforms and heroic figures jumped out one by one amidst the rapid music. In an instant, the venue, which was originally bustling with laughter, suddenly disappeared. After quieting down, everyone was fascinated; the 5-minute performance had a unique form, closely linked links, complete plot, and full content. The Chinese education professionals present came from all over the United States and even the Chinese education department of China. They were all well-informed, but after seeing this show, everyone was full of praise and marveled that a weekend school that mainly teaches Chinese language could produce such an exciting and shocking dance drama!

f6197357785abe7744285880397d71d3fcf03bfe.sourceText: 照片说明：在2014年12月全美中文学校协会全国大会上演出（江沛堃摄影）
f6197357785abe7744285880397d71d3fcf03bfe.translatedText: Photo description: Performed at the National Convention of the National Association of Chinese Schools in December 2014 (Photography by Jiang Peikun)

8a01d3b055215d9da4d77f4d324d73b037bac4e7.sourceText: 2月初，希望中文学校的负责人告知，”木兰出征”将在钱德勒艺术中心的大剧场演出，节目加强了，人员增多了，舞台变大了，吸引着我赶到剧场亲睹为快。2月15日演出当天，看到不仅舞蹈组学生身着特制的古装，朗诵队伍的学生们都换上了专门定购的含有中华元素的传统服装，实在敬佩希望中文学校对孩子们的活动是如此之重视。
8a01d3b055215d9da4d77f4d324d73b037bac4e7.translatedText: In early February, the person in charge of Hope Chinese School informed that "Mulan Goes Out" will be performed in the grand theater of the Chandler Art Center. The program has been strengthened, the number of people has increased, and the stage has become larger, attracting me to rush to the theater to see it in person. On the day of the performance on February 15, I saw that not only the students in the dance group were wearing special costumes, but also the students in the recitation team were wearing specially ordered traditional costumes containing Chinese elements. I really admired the Chinese school for paying so much attention to children's activities.

965937a0f7b3bfe7b23d1d388f3dc0b1adfd01fb.sourceText: ”木兰出征”在2014年12月全美中文学校协会全国大会上演出（江沛堃摄影）
965937a0f7b3bfe7b23d1d388f3dc0b1adfd01fb.translatedText: "Mulan Goes to the Expedition" was performed at the National Convention of the National Association of Chinese Schools in December 2014 (Photography by Jiang Peikun)

42d0e36f00651fc6c9d1aabbe58f926a37a409d5.sourceText: 演出开始，希望中文学校的”木兰出征”首先大阵势登场。二十四名男女学生在悠扬的音乐声中，用标准清晰的发音朗诵”木兰辞”的第一段，交代了民族女英雄代父出征的背景；接着快速的音乐声响起，锣鼓声声急，军情紧迫、战事告急！朗诵声又起：”东市买骏马……”四句铺排，形容木兰紧张地购买战马和马具；接着在激昂的音乐声中以木兰为首的十二名古代将士大跨越出场，扬鞭策马，飞越一道道关口，一座座高山，直奔战场。音乐又变缓，朗诵声再起”黄河流水鸣溅溅””燕山胡骑鸣啾啾”，场上的将士展示了思乡思亲之柔情。接着在激扬兴奋的音乐声中，将士们凯旋而归；音乐声变沉重，朗诵再起”将军百战死，壮士十年归”，形容战斗之激烈，战争之旷久，将士之悲壮。最后一节，木兰用一个利落的脱帽动作，还原了她的女儿身；朗诵声又起：”雄兔脚扑朔，雌兔眼迷离；双兔傍地走，安能辨我是雄雌？”，孩子们借用比喻的句子作结尾，形容木兰女扮男装不易被发现的奥秘。
42d0e36f00651fc6c9d1aabbe58f926a37a409d5.translatedText: The performance started, and I hope that the Chinese school's "Mulan Goes to the Go" will be the first to make a grand appearance. In the melodious music, twenty-four male and female students recited the first paragraph of "Mulan Ci" with standard and clear pronunciation, explaining the background of the national heroine's expedition on her father's behalf; then fast music sounded, gongs and drums sounded urgently, indicating that the military situation was urgent and the war was urgent! The recitation started again: "Buying horses in the East Market..." The four sentences were laid out to describe Mulan's nervous purchase of war horses and harnesses. Then, amid the passionate music, twelve ancient soldiers led by Mulan strode out, whipped their horses, flew over pass after pass, and went straight to the battlefield. The music slowed down again, and the recitations started again: "The water of the Yellow River roars and splashes" and "The barbarians in Yanshan chirp and chirp." The soldiers on the field showed their tenderness of missing their homes and relatives. Then, amid the excitement of the music, the soldiers returned in triumph; the music became heavier, and the recitation began again: "Generals die in a hundred battles, and heroes return in ten years." This describes the fierce battle, the protracted war, and the tragedy of the soldiers. In the last section, Mulan used a neat action of taking off her hat to restore her female body; the recitation started again: "The male rabbit's feet are twitching, and the female rabbit's eyes are blurred; two rabbits are walking next to each other, how can they tell whether I am a male or a female?" The children ended with a metaphorical sentence to describe the mystery of Mulan's disguise as a man, which is not easy to be discovered.

496c5c2c5b84ee3df57a8c0d0f3799d75afe6eba.sourceText: ”木兰出征”在钱德勒艺术中心演出（帅致若摄影） 这组三十六名年龄7-15岁的孩子们用朗诵加舞蹈的形式，在短短6分钟的时间内，演出了中华历史上脍炙人口传奇故事；不仅演出技巧娴熟，形式奇特，最可贵的是，这是一出精神上扬的节目，是一出饱含亲情、乡情，歌颂中华传统美德，体现抗拒外敌，保卫家国精神的节目，是一出有健康精神内核的节目。我想，辅导他们的教师，支持他们的家长，关注他们的师长，看到稚嫩的孩子们演出如此大气魄的节目，不仅是欣慰，可能感动得眼泪都要流出来。
496c5c2c5b84ee3df57a8c0d0f3799d75afe6eba.translatedText: "Mulan Goes to the Battle" performed at Chandler Center for the Arts (Photography by Shuai Zhiruo) This group of thirty-six children aged 7-15 used recitation and dance to perform a popular legendary story in Chinese history in just 6 minutes. Not only were the performances skillful and the form unique, the most valuable thing was that it was a spiritually uplifting program, full of family affection and nostalgia, praising traditional Chinese virtues, embodying the spirit of resisting foreign enemies and defending the country. It was a program with a healthy spiritual core. I think the teachers who coach them, the parents who support them, and the teachers who pay attention to them are not only happy to see the young children perform such a magnificent performance, but may also be moved to tears.

52a46a54683c03084e264946c8a3ab0e51c6c2bb.sourceText: ”木兰出征”在钱德勒艺术中心演出，朗诵学生群体（丁允衍教授摄影） 这出舞蹈诗是由希望中文学校的艺术课教师蒋琳老师编排的。蒋琳老师也是亚太地区管乐协会会员，形象培训老师；她曾组建中国首支女子外来工管乐团，也曾多年策划晚会和舞蹈编排工作；蒋琳老师任教舞蹈多年，教学耐心细致，有很强的亲和力。 节目的朗诵部分是由希望中文学校的中文教师史敬嵬老师辅导的，史老师毕业于人民大学，曾在中央电视台工作过，说一口字正腔圆的普通话。 演出后，我与两位老师交谈，听她们讲述编排的思路和辅导的过程，倍感老师们工作的辛苦，深为佩服老师们创造性的构思和运用教育学原理的灵活性。”木兰出征”朗诵部分选了”木兰辞”六段中的四段，并选择编辑了十分恰当的音乐，强烈地烘托了剧情。 蒋老师说，以前她在舞蹈班上排过一个”木兰”的舞蹈。她的教学理念是让孩子们除了学舞蹈，也让他们通过舞蹈了解中国文化。《木兰》的题材很好，按现在流行话来说是充满正能量。编排《木兰出征》的创作初衷，就是在已经排练过的舞蹈基础上，排一个有情节有内容规模大的舞蹈剧。 两位老师介绍，她们在家长的大力配合下，给孩子们看”木兰”视频、动画，帮助孩子们理解剧情；史老师在朗诵词上加了拼音，帮助孩子们朗读记忆；她们给学生们讲解，”唧唧复唧唧”，是古代织布机的声音；”阿爷无大儿”，阿爷就是爸爸；因为中国地域很大，地方语言多，有的地方称爸爸为爹爹，称妈妈为娘。于是孩子们通过学习朗诵和表演，不仅背下了”木兰辞”，还学习了有关中华文化的内容。有的学生从一开始不太情愿，到后来学习了木兰的故事觉得很有趣，再后来参加集体排练和演出就对木兰辞的内容知道更多了，同时也很自豪，一是中国古代有这样一位女英雄，二是自己的表演受到那么多赞赏。 希望中文学校编排演出”木兰出征”，不仅成功地打造了一个少年儿童的优秀剧目，更是成功运用先进教育理论的实例。美国著名教育学家杜威提倡的”在做中学习”现代教育理论，即是要充分利用孩子们的游戏本能，提倡学生们在活动中学习；目前主流学校语言教学课堂上运用的”浸入式”教学法，也是强调进入一种语言学习的环境。而”木兰出征”的排练和演出过程，就是灵活运用上述教育理论一种非常有效的实践教学。 相信学生们通过”木兰出征”的排练和演出，会对他们学习中华语言文化产生非常积极有效的促进，甚至会在他们的脑海中留下长久的美好的记忆，对他们的成长产生潜移默化的良好影响；小小年龄的学生从”织布机”、”阿爷”、”女扮男装”这些简单概念开始，相信他们今后还有机会学习”木兰辞”中更深的内容，并将不断地加深对中华文化的理解，这也是符合”螺旋式上升”学习原理的。 附上”木兰出征”的录音，即使只听这个节目的音乐和朗诵，也会感受到强烈的震撼力的。笔者就是在听着这个节目的录音中，一气呵成写下了此文。我对”木兰辞”非常偏好，附上近几年我的关于”木兰辞”的文章在”太阳鸟”网站的链接： 凤凰城 文若：中华精神民族魂—–观”木兰”功夫舞台剧 http://www.sunbirdarizona.com/News-Detail.asp?keyno=4436 【凤凰笔会】文若：再诵”木兰辞” http://www.sunbirdarizona.com/News-Detail.asp?keyno=5112 （写于2015年3月1日）
52a46a54683c03084e264946c8a3ab0e51c6c2bb.translatedText: "Mulan Goes Out" was performed at the Chandler Arts Center and recited by a group of students (photographed by Professor Ding Yunyan). This dance poem was choreographed by Jiang Lin, an art teacher at Hope Chinese School. Teacher Jiang Lin is also a member of the Asia-Pacific Wind Band Association and an image training teacher; she once formed China's first female migrant work band, and has planned evening parties and dance choreography for many years; Teacher Jiang Lin has taught dance for many years, and her teaching is patient and meticulous, and she has a strong affinity. The recitation part of the program was tutored by Mr. Shi Jingwei, a Chinese teacher at Hope Chinese School. Mr. Shi graduated from Renmin University and worked at CCTV. He speaks fluent Mandarin. After the performance, I talked with the two teachers and listened to them talk about the arrangement ideas and the tutoring process. I felt the hard work of the teachers and deeply admired the teachers' creative ideas and flexibility in applying pedagogical principles. The recital part of "Mulan's Expedition" selected four of the six paragraphs of "Mulan's Ci", and selected and edited very appropriate music, which strongly enhanced the plot. Teacher Jiang said that she had rehearsed a "Mulan" dance in her dance class before. Her teaching philosophy is to let children not only learn dance, but also let them understand Chinese culture through dance. The subject matter of "Mulan" is very good, and according to current popular words, it is full of positive energy. The original intention of choreographing "Mulan's Expedition" is to create a large-scale dance drama with plot and content based on the dances that have been rehearsed. The two teachers said that with the strong cooperation of parents, they showed the children "Mulan" videos and animations to help them understand the plot; Teacher Shi added pinyin to the recited words to help the children read and memorize; they explained to the students that "chirp again chirp" is the sound of ancient looms; "I have no older children", grandpa is the father; because China has a large area and many local languages, some places call father daddy and mother mother. So by learning recitation and performance, the children not only memorized the "Mulan Ci", but also learned about Chinese culture. Some students were reluctant at first, but later learned the story of Mulan and found it interesting. Later, they participated in group rehearsals and performances and learned more about the content of Mulan's poem. At the same time, they were also very proud. First, there was such a heroine in ancient China, and second, their performance was so praised. It is hoped that the Chinese school's arrangement of the performance "Mulan's Expedition" will not only successfully create an excellent play for children, but also an example of the successful application of advanced educational theories. The modern educational theory of "learning by doing" advocated by the famous American educator Dewey is to make full use of children's play instinct and encourage students to learn through activities. The "immersion" teaching method currently used in language teaching classes in mainstream schools also emphasizes entering a language learning environment. The rehearsal and performance process of "Mulan's Expedition" is a very effective practical teaching that uses the above educational theory flexibly. I believe that the students' rehearsal and performance of "Mulan's Expedition" will have a very positive and effective promotion for their learning of Chinese language and culture, and will even leave long-lasting beautiful memories in their minds, exerting a subtle and good influence on their growth; at such a young age Students started with simple concepts such as "loom", "grandpa" and "women disguised as men". I believe they will have the opportunity to learn deeper content in "Mulan Ci" in the future and will continue to deepen their understanding of Chinese culture. This is also in line with the "spiral upward" learning principle. Attached is the recording of "Mulan Goes to the Battle". Even if you only listen to the music and recitation of this program, you will feel the strong shock. The author wrote this article in one breath while listening to the recording of this program. I have a strong preference for "Mulan Ci". f0ad8b9a70accda89e9a58a6e7b756a5d4d7fc31.sourceText: 作者：帅致若，在师范大学主修物理学、教育学和心理学。80年代末到欧洲留学。90年代在加州大学和亚利桑那州立大学学习中国现代文学和古汉语。十多年来，在希望中文学校任教中文，任职校长、董事会成员、董事会顾问；多年来在全美中文学校协会担任季刊主编、协会理事、副会长、会长，现为全美中文学校协会名誉会长；2014年在世界华文教育大会上被授予”海外华文教育杰出人士”荣誉。 自幼在文风笃厚的大家族中成长，耳濡目染，酷爱文学艺术历史地理，出国后，多年来在丰富的旅行生活中永远以好奇心观察世界，以好学之心记录、阅读和写作，作品以记叙文、散文为主，大量文章特别是教育类文章发表于中国、美国的报章和文学刊物。十多年前与文友同道发起成立”凤凰笔会”，现为世界华文作家协会北美”凤凰笔会”会长。
f0ad8b9a70accda89e9a58a6e7b756a5d4d7fc31.translatedText: Author: Shuai Zhiruo, majored in physics, education and psychology at Normal University. Went to Europe to study in the late 1980s. In the 1990s, he studied modern Chinese literature and ancient Chinese at the University of California and Arizona State University. For more than ten years, he has taught Chinese at Hope Chinese School, serving as principal, board member, and board consultant; for many years, he has served as quarterly editor, association director, vice president, and president of the National Association of Chinese Schools, and is currently the honorary president of the National Association of Chinese Schools; in 2014, he was awarded the honor of "Outstanding Person in Overseas Chinese Education" at the World Chinese Education Conference. Growing up in a big family with a strong literary style, I have been deeply influenced by literature, art, history and geography. After going abroad, I have always observed the world with curiosity in my rich travel life for many years, and recorded, read and written with a studious heart. My works are mainly narratives and essays, and a large number of articles, especially educational articles, have been published in newspapers and literary journals in China and the United States. More than ten years ago, he initiated the establishment of "Phoenix PEN" with fellow literary friends, and is now the president of the North American "Phoenix PEN" of the World Chinese Writers Association.

24aa87d1b1a6636cf6b21e2210bc9716013cd5cc.sourceText: 陈普博士诗词书法： 观”木兰出征” 铁衣金柝旌旗奋，诗诵木兰气入云。莫道乡关十万里，传薪自有后来人。 –乙未新春观《木兰出征》演出有感。～ 阿普
24aa87d1b1a6636cf6b21e2210bc9716013cd5cc.translatedText: Dr. Chen Pu's poetry and calligraphy: Watching "Mulan Goes to the Battle" The iron clothes and gold flags are flying, and the poem reciting Mulan's energy reaches the clouds. Mo Dao's hometown is hundreds of thousands of miles away, and there are descendants who will pass on the salary. – Yiwei’s thoughts on the performance of “Mulan’s Expedition” during the New Year. ~ Apu

f311e767793a74a0282d83a75a8603d26d7c6224.sourceText: 陈普，笔名阿普。出生于中国福州。福建师大77级，英语学士、硕士。82年毕业后留系任教。1989年求学于美国北亚利桑那大学，获应用语言学硕士、教育领导学博士。先后就职于大中小学和亚利桑那州教育厅。曾任州教育厅Arizona Principals Academy主管，《APA通讯》主编，Creighton 学区Research & Evaluation Department主管，Roosevelt学区教育顾问，中文学校校长、董事长及教师等职。 现执教于亚利桑那州，兼任福建师大、福州大学等高校客座教授。 幼承庭训，惠及终身。对文史哲艺和大自然兴趣尤浓。文学创作侧重于中国古典诗词、散文及英文诗。作品散见于报刊书集，如：《世界和平诗词集》，《百年绝句大典》，《中国词人辞典》，《沱牌杯》国庆50周年征联（二等奖），THE COLORS OF LIFE-The International Library of Poetry，The International WHO’s WHO IN POETRY，等。所创中文诗词，多以古体格律作品为主，凡所取材，则提炼自对生活经历的感悟及读书心得。书法初学柳，再习王颜歐褚，后涉魏隶碑石及苏黄米诸家。书法兼采前贤之长，以成自身特色，擅行、隶、楷体。近二十年来，书作多以自撰诗词为内容，行笔沉着酣畅，结体硬朗隽秀，既涵晋唐宋法帖之风，又具魏隶金石之骨，追古而出新。书法作品偶发表于省市、全国和国际书法展赛以及书报刊 物。
f311e767793a74a0282d83a75a8603d26d7c6224.translatedText: >Chen Pu, pen name Apu. Born in Fuzhou, China. Graduated from Fujian Normal University in 1977, bachelor's and master's degrees in English. After graduating in 1982, he stayed in the department to teach. In 1989, he studied at Northern Arizona University in the United States and received a master's degree in applied linguistics and a doctorate in educational leadership. He has worked in universities, middle schools, primary schools and the Arizona Department of Education. He once served as director of the Arizona Principals Academy in the state Department of Education, editor-in-chief of "APA Newsletter", director of the Research & Evaluation Department of the Creighton School District, education consultant of the Roosevelt School District, principal, chairman and teacher of a Chinese school. Currently teaching in Arizona, and serving as a visiting professor at Fujian Normal University, Fuzhou University and other universities. Inheriting court training at a young age will benefit you throughout your life. Especially interested in literature, history, philosophy, art and nature. Literary creation focuses on Chinese classical poetry, prose and English poetry. His works are scattered in newspapers, periodicals and book collections, such as: "World Peace Poetry Collection", "Centennial Quatrain Collection", "Chinese Poetry Dictionary", "Tuopai Cup" National Day 50th Anniversary Competition (Second Prize), THE COLORS OF LIFE-The International Library of Poetry, The International WHO’s WHO IN POETRY, etc. Most of the Chinese poems he creates are based on classical rhythmic works, and all the materials used are extracted from his insights into life experiences and reading experiences. He first studied calligraphy from Liu, and then studied calligraphy from Wang Yan and Ou Chu. Later, he studied calligraphy from Wei Li and Su Huangmi. Calligraphy adopts the strengths of previous sages to form its own characteristics, and is good at Xing, Li and Kai styles. In the past twenty years, most of the books have been based on self-composed poems. The writing is calm and smooth, and the structure is strong and elegant. It not only embodies the style of Jin, Tang and Song Dynasties, but also has the bones of Wei Li Jinshi, pursuing the ancient and creating the new. His calligraphy works are occasionally published in provincial, municipal, national and international calligraphy exhibitions and competitions, as well as in books, newspapers and periodicals.

a98efb377a9d828be21200a643a657504c122a3a.translatedText: Hong Kong plans to establish the Insurance Regulatory Authority

e0fba4fbdd6d99a80c54a93f09470542782c7c9a.sourceText: 香港拟成立保监局 新华社讯 香港特区政府日前公布针对成立独立保险业监管局的咨询结果。咨询显示公众普遍对香港…
e0fba4fbdd6d99a80c54a93f09470542782c7c9a.translatedText: Hong Kong plans to establish the Insurance Regulatory Authority Xinhua News Agency The Hong Kong SAR government recently announced the results of the consultation on the establishment of an independent Insurance Regulatory Authority. The consultation shows that the public generally has a negative attitude towards Hong Kong...

96bc2cb423f4d3189f73c5dd5fd38c7a256d96b1.sourceText: 香港特区政府日前公布针对成立独立 保险 业监管局的咨询结果。咨询显示公众普遍对香港成立保监局持赞同态度，特区政府会继续推进相关工作，成立后的保监局将具有调查、检控与责罚权力。
96bc2cb423f4d3189f73c5dd5fd38c7a256d96b1.translatedText: The Hong Kong SAR government recently announced the results of the consultation on the establishment of an independent Insurance Regulatory Authority. The consultation shows that the public generally supports the establishment of the Insurance Authority in Hong Kong. The SAR government will continue to promote relevant work. After the establishment, the Insurance Authority will have the power to investigate, prosecute and punish.

e4b9955c01aa79b31df986af9119d9bda8277f5b.sourceText: 特区政府此前针对成立保监局进行公众咨询。特区政府在咨询文件中建议，赋予保监局明确权力，其中包括展开调查、获取资料、提出检控及就不当行为施加规管罚则等。
e4b9955c01aa79b31df986af9119d9bda8277f5b.translatedText: The SAR government had previously conducted public consultation on the establishment of the Insurance Regulatory Bureau. In the consultation document, the SAR government recommended that the Insurance Regulatory Authority be given clear powers, including conducting investigations, obtaining information, initiating prosecutions and imposing regulatory penalties for misconduct.

b843abc3a42a50d95e02ab51782cba337ac2105b.sourceText: 在银行销售保险事宜方面，保监局将与目前银行的主要监管机构香港金融管理局紧密合作，并在需要时把指定权力授予金管局，以使其发挥前线监管功能。
b843abc3a42a50d95e02ab51782cba337ac2105b.translatedText: Regarding the sale of insurance by banks, the Insurance Authority will work closely with the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, the current main regulator of banks, and when necessary, delegate designated powers to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority so that it can perform its front-line supervisory function.

9e728ac32e28bdce360ba32901d1ed25f4ae56d3.sourceText: 在财政机制方面，特区政府会提供一笔5亿港元的资助，并建议保监局在成立第6年收回全部成本。
9e728ac32e28bdce360ba32901d1ed25f4ae56d3.translatedText: In terms of financial mechanisms, the SAR government will provide a subsidy of HK$500 million and recommends that the Insurance Authority recover all costs in the sixth year of its establishment.

70f4289219de4d272504275e888d7f34422f91e2.sourceText: 特区政府财经事务及库务局局长陈家强表示，保监局将按照国际监管原则，在运作和财政上均独立于政府及业界，在不降低规管标准的情况下，方便市场创新，维持业界竞争力。
70f4289219de4d272504275e888d7f34422f91e2.translatedText: Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau Chan Ka-keung of the SAR Government stated that the Insurance Authority will be operationally and financially independent from the government and the industry in accordance with international regulatory principles, and will facilitate market innovation and maintain the competitiveness of the industry without lowering regulatory standards.

a614080b7132e535bb6e1dc7a3367ab23eb855a9.sourceText: 特区政府计划在2012年初完成相关法例主要条文的拟稿。
a614080b7132e535bb6e1dc7a3367ab23eb855a9.translatedText: The SAR government plans to complete the draft of the main provisions of the relevant legislation in early 2012.

b10a79b12df822f3bb02f3dc8aad6386ed35b9fa.sourceText: 鹤立集团国际部在凤凰城成立 是悲是喜？
b10a79b12df822f3bb02f3dc8aad6386ed35b9fa.translatedText: The International Department of Heli Group was established in Phoenix. Is it sad or happy?

e3b6027f745189f48d4a67170a03351a069b8d26.sourceText: 鹤立集团国际部在凤凰城成立 是悲是喜？ 2015年6月5日在亚省知名华人媒体刊出消息，中国鹤立教育集团国际…
e3b6027f745189f48d4a67170a03351a069b8d26.translatedText: The international department of Heli Group was established in Phoenix. Is it sad or happy? On June 5, 2015, news was published in well-known Chinese media in Alberta that China Heli Education Group International...

7388c93f9ede2ad523f0ba8f89ae55a0f8c1afd1.sourceText: 2015年6月5日在亚省知名华人媒体刊出消息，中国鹤立教育集团国际部5月成立，总部设在美国，鹤立教育国际部的负责人为于华（Hua Yu），亚利桑那新东方艺术学校股东之一，秋香（网名） 实名：和晓航（Vivian Max），新东方艺术学校员工。关注华文教育，致力于中国文化在海外的传承发展，在美国凤凰城新成立海外部，着实让当地部分华人兴奋了一下。可是就在国际部刚刚成立的几天后，6月9日中国鹤立教育集团成为了，新华网，中新社，人民网，人民法制网，北京晚报几十家权威媒体的焦点。这次媒体关注的并不是中国鹤立教育集团的教育品质，而是老师针扎幼儿，虐待儿童事件。北京房山区鹤立幼儿园5名老师被警方刑事拘留，其中4名老师承认使用大头针扎伤儿童。
7388c93f9ede2ad523f0ba8f89ae55a0f8c1afd1.translatedText: News was published in well-known Chinese media in Alberta on June 5, 2015 that China Heli Education Group International Department was established in May and is headquartered in the United States. The person in charge of Heli Education International Department is Hua Yu, one of the shareholders of Arizona New Oriental Art School, Qiuxiang (screen name) Real name: Vivian Max, employee of New Oriental Art School. Paying attention to Chinese education and committing to the inheritance and development of Chinese culture overseas, the newly established overseas department in Phoenix, USA, has really excited some local Chinese. However, just a few days after the International Department was established, on June 9, China Heli Education Group became the focus of dozens of authoritative media outlets including Xinhuanet, China News Service, People's Daily Online, People's Legal Network, and Beijing Evening News. This time, the media is not focusing on the educational quality of China Heli Education Group, but on incidents of teachers stabbing children with needles and abusing children. Five teachers from Heli Kindergarten in Fangshan District, Beijing were criminally detained by the police, and four of them admitted to pricking children with needles.

f5b3fc84dea9b0b09eca9ccaecf5307511cf5a44.translatedText: Picture reproduced from Beijing Evening News

2b1fd8fd60d0b5cf8f103c7628ef46171c66f704.sourceText: 可就在老师已经承认恶劣行为后，法人代表张鹤立，依然对官方发布的调查结果持怀疑态度。她相信”这些老师在培训期都收到了良好的师德教育”张鹤立称，暂不会对此事有进一步处理措施。她称，这些幼儿园教师在鹤立旗下幼师学校培训后，来各地幼儿园实习，确实无相关幼师资质。实习结束后她们会拿到毕业证，进而考取幼师**书。（转自新京报）
2b1fd8fd60d0b5cf8f103c7628ef46171c66f704.translatedText: But even after the teacher admitted the bad behavior, legal representative Zhang Heli was still skeptical of the official investigation results. She believes that "these teachers have received good moral education during the training period," Zhang Heli said, and there will be no further measures to deal with the matter for the time being. She said that these kindergarten teachers went to various kindergartens for internships after training at Heli’s kindergarten teachers’ school, and indeed they did not have relevant kindergarten teacher qualifications. After the internship, they will receive a diploma and then obtain a certificate as a kindergarten teacher. (Reprinted from Beijing News)

273ea937117fc5dbd1c8c070b9c3118231c3d6d7.sourceText: 然而鹤立幼儿园虐待孩子的案例还有前科，早在2012年6月27日，腾讯，网易就曾报道郑州市鹤立幼儿园教师让孩子互扇耳光 众家长集体声讨鹤立幼儿园暴力教育的行为。
273ea937117fc5dbd1c8c070b9c3118231c3d6d7.translatedText: However, there is a history of child abuse in Heli Kindergarten. As early as June 27, 2012, Tencent and NetEase reported that teachers in Zhengzhou Heli Kindergarten asked children to slap each other in the face. Parents collectively denounced the violent education in Heli Kindergarten.

f38add7bf9e7ca0876e2df7c06b51a30ce22b3b4.translatedText: The picture is reproduced from NetEase News

8ff6ec2250406676330b1499beec2f055f1f0c42.sourceText: 关注儿童身心健康是每一个教育者的天职，在法律依然还在完善的中国，相关责任人已经受到了法律制裁。家长们也从此事件中意识到，教育机构经营者资质和教职人员素质，是孩子接受教育最基本的保障。
8ff6ec2250406676330b1499beec2f055f1f0c42.translatedText: It is the bounden duty of every educator to pay attention to the physical and mental health of children. In China, where the law is still improving, the relevant responsible persons have been punished by law. Parents also realized from this incident that the qualifications of educational institution operators and the quality of teaching staff are the most basic guarantees for their children to receive education.

fd87fd6d8d382d0c3ffd34fd71c73f2f76260374.sourceText: 鹤立教育集团转战海外，并非常荣幸落户在凤凰城。这个鹤立教育集团国际部是否有注册，法人代表是谁，企业英文名是什么，公司注册地址在哪?整个成立公告只字未提。万一该公司组织的活动出事了，除了能知道两位负责人的名字，家长孩子们还能找谁负责？ 有如此背景的教育集团是否依然符合美国教育机构的要求，记者正在与相关部门联系,希望能够给读者带来更多详尽的消息。
fd87fd6d8d382d0c3ffd34fd71c73f2f76260374.translatedText: Heli Education Group has moved overseas and is very honored to settle in Phoenix. Is the International Department of Heli Education Group registered, who is the legal representative, what is the English name of the company, and where is the company's registered address? The entire establishment announcement did not mention a word. If something goes wrong at an event organized by the company, besides knowing the names of the two people in charge, who else can parents and children turn to to take responsibility? Whether an education group with such a background still meets the requirements of American educational institutions, the reporter is contacting the relevant departments, hoping to bring more detailed information to readers.

6acedf150f65a89edccee7aff77ffd8a11b86881.sourceText: 据记者了解到，鹤立集团2015曾经与亚利桑那的权威中文教育机构联系合作，由于教育理念和中文教学法差异，被该中文教育机构拒绝合作。根据目前了解到最新消息，鹤立教育国际部正在如火如荼举办首届”立杯”中文阅读比赛。呼吁家长们引起重视，孩子参加的各种活动中，先核实组办单位的资质，教职人员素质，让孩子在一个安全，健康的环境下学习中国文化。
6acedf150f65a89edccee7aff77ffd8a11b86881.translatedText: According to the reporter’s understanding, Heli Group contacted and cooperated with an authoritative Chinese education institution in Arizona in 2015. Due to differences in educational concepts and Chinese teaching methods, the Chinese education institution refused to cooperate. According to the latest news, Heli Education International Department is in full swing to hold the first "Leg Cup" Chinese Reading Competition. We call on parents to pay attention and verify the qualifications of the organizing unit and the quality of the teaching staff before their children participate in various activities, so that their children can learn Chinese culture in a safe and healthy environment.

680e1981e8c15f93aeeb16eb1b211573658110e6.sourceText: 凤凰城市政府经贸部举办国际高科技经贸交流活动
680e1981e8c15f93aeeb16eb1b211573658110e6.translatedText: The Department of Economic and Trade of the Phoenix City Government held an international high-tech economic and trade exchange event

acf03c72cfe1627b8323b0f0f037cc650b934820.sourceText: 凤凰城市政府经贸部举办国际高科技经贸交流活动 （凤凰城市政府国际姊妹会供稿） 凤凰城市政府经贸部门于五月十六…
acf03c72cfe1627b8323b0f0f037cc650b934820.translatedText: The Department of Economic and Trade of the Phoenix City Government held an international high-tech economic and trade exchange event (contributed by the Phoenix City Government International Sisters Association) The economic and trade department of the Phoenix City Government held an international high-tech economic and trade exchange event on May 16th...

8d48bf9edf53da49fa46985db5724ca260e87b21.sourceText: （凤凰城市政府国际姊妹会供稿） 凤凰城市政府经贸部门于五月十六日至十八日在凤凰城市政展览会馆Phoenix Convention Center会议室举办国际高科技经贸交流活动,特别邀请凤凰城国际姊妹城市的高科技经贸代表及本地高科技 公司业者参加,共同宣传产品,促进高科技经贸合作与交流,活动十分圆满成功. 台湾科技图片展览Taiwan Plugging Into The World亦配合此凤凰城市政府经贸部的国际高科技经贸交流活动在凤凰城市政展览会馆会议大厅展出多幅台湾高科技图片,宣传台湾高科技的发展,贡献, 与成就,及台湾各项高科技与世界交流与接轨. 五月十七日下午五时至七时凤凰城市议员Thelda Williams与凤凰城经贸部主任Michael Sheldon 特别主持接待会,邀请国际姊妹会各姊妹城市主席与国际及本地高科技代表及厂商进行联谊,在 九个国际姊妹城市中特别有来自墨西哥的总领事及四位商界代表,来自加拿大的代表,及来自台湾的制造电动公共汽车代表等,共同促进国际高科技的多元与交流. 凤凰城市政府的经贸部举办的成功的国际高科技经贸交流合作活动,相信会为凤凰城市带来经济,商机与经贸繁荣.
8d48bf9edf53da49fa46985db5724ca260e87b21.translatedText: (contributed by the Phoenix City Government International Sisters Association) The economic and trade department of the Phoenix City Government held an international high-tech economic and trade exchange event at the Phoenix Convention Center from May 16th to 18th at the Phoenix Municipal Government Exhibition Hall. The Center conference room held an international high-tech economic and trade exchange event. High-tech economic and trade representatives from Phoenix's international sister cities and local high-tech company operators were specially invited to participate in the event to jointly promote products and promote high-tech economic and trade cooperation and exchanges. The event was a complete success. Taiwan Plugging Into The World also cooperated with this international high-tech economic and trade exchange event of the Phoenix City Government Department of Economics and Trade. A number of Taiwan high-tech pictures were displayed in the conference hall of the Phoenix Municipal Exhibition Hall to promote the development and contribution of Taiwan's high-tech. and achievements, as well as Taiwan's various high-tech exchanges and integration with the world. On May 17, from 5 to 7 pm, Phoenix City Councilor Thelda Williams and Phoenix Economic and Trade Director Michael Sheldon specially hosted a reception, inviting the chairmen of each sister city of the International Sisters Association to network with international and local high-tech representatives and manufacturers. Among the nine international sister cities, there were especially the Consul General from Mexico and four business representatives, representatives from Canada, and representatives from manufacturing electric buses from Taiwan to jointly promote the diversity and exchange of international high-tech. The successful international high-tech economic and trade exchange and cooperation activities organized by the Department of Economic and Trade of the Phoenix City Government are believed to bring economic, business opportunities and economic and trade prosperity to Phoenix City.

1cc71eb94e79a425768499a9ca6d226ef10e63ca.sourceText: 台湾：江蕙镜花水月 惊喜不断无冷场
1cc71eb94e79a425768499a9ca6d226ef10e63ca.translatedText: Taiwan: Jiang Hui’s Mirror, Flowers and Moon, constant surprises and no dull moments

84a145b4f4ab05a768926048f635e9ec7f629f49.sourceText: 台湾：江蕙镜花水月 惊喜不断无冷场 （中央社记者徐卉台北18日电）江蕙「镜花水月」演唱会18日晚登场，整场惊喜…
84a145b4f4ab05a768926048f635e9ec7f629f49.translatedText: Taiwan: Jiang Hui’s Mirror, Flowers and Moon, constant surprises and no dull moments (Central News Agency reporter Xu Hui, Taipei, 18th) Jiang Hui’s "Through the Looking Glass" concert came on the evening of the 18th, and the whole performance was a surprise...

40ee96071a1d1fc8da725d9304b555afd9329c71.sourceText: （中央社记者徐卉台北18日电）江蕙「镜花水月」演唱会18日晚登场，整场惊喜巧思不断，二姐服装一套换一套，阿妹、李安也分别以口白、文字参与演出，2个半小时无冷场。
40ee96071a1d1fc8da725d9304b555afd9329c71.translatedText: (Central News Agency reporter Xu Hui, Taipei 18th) Japan) Jiang Hui's "Through the Looking Glass" concert was held on the evening of the 18th. The whole concert was full of surprises and ingenuity. The second sister changed her costumes from one to another, and A-Mei and Ang Lee also participated in the performance with their spoken words and texts respectively. There was no interruption for 2 and a half hours.

09da6a06bd82535ac2bcec6f3aa28cafdbdb3114.sourceText: 「二姐」江蕙今晚举办「镜花水月」演唱会，一开场即以一身黄金镜面女王般的服装，站在高吊台上现身，搭配背后的镜面舞台灯，并以高亢嗓音唱出「空笑梦」，全场歌迷都为她的美丽与歌声而屏息， 江蕙接着将黄金外衣脱去，底下穿着轻薄的红纱长裙，一双修长大腿若隐若现，秀出好身材，欢呼声不绝于耳。
09da6a06bd82535ac2bcec6f3aa28cafdbdb3114.translatedText: "Second Sister" Jiang Hui held the "Through the Looking Glass" concert tonight. At the beginning, she appeared on a high platform in a golden mirror queen-like costume, with a mirror stage light behind her, and sang "Laughing in the Sky" with a high-pitched voice. All the fans in the audience held their breath for her beauty and singing voice. Jiang Hui then took off her gold coat and wore a thin red gauze skirt underneath. A pair of slender thighs were looming, showing off her good figure, and there were endless cheers.

09e98b711587f7ad965cf28b167f914449bce416.sourceText: 二姐唱完「半醉半清醒」后说，「你们好热情噢，大家都好有元气，我最近真的很忙，但是忙得非常充实，都是因为你们，我也要把身体保养的很好」。
09e98b711587f7ad965cf28b167f914449bce416.translatedText: After the second sister finished singing "Half Drunk and Half Sober", she said, "You are so enthusiastic and everyone is so energetic. I have been really busy recently, but I am very busy. It is all because of you. I also have to take good care of my body."

5c59de0fa11816dd9e159c64d4169d465434de27.sourceText: 故意比出姿势秀身材，二姐还拨开腿前的红纱频用眼神放电，现场气氛瞬间沸腾，她笑说「有没有看到脚啦，这隻脚真不得了」。
5c59de0fa11816dd9e159c64d4169d465434de27.translatedText: Deliberately posing to show off her figure, the second sister also opened the red gauze in front of her legs and flashed her eyes. The atmosphere at the scene instantly boiled. She laughed and said, "Have you seen the feet? This foot is really amazing."

8087ca5677f883f3e0c70d277892eaaf94afcf4d.sourceText: 歌坛老将二姐也抵挡不住演唱会前的紧张，她在台上说，还没有看到歌迷前，其实她有点紧张。
8087ca5677f883f3e0c70d277892eaaf94afcf4d.translatedText: The second sister, a veteran singer in the music industry, could not resist the nervousness before the concert. She said on the stage that she was actually a little nervous before seeing the fans.

31e1c6559410a0f90f6b15ee38d6aea06ccabb98.sourceText: 二姐演唱「无关爱情」时，台湾第一位被太阳剧团选入的舞者张逸军也乘着高吊圈现身、飞上空中，并在歌曲尾段将二姐也接上高吊圈。两人以双人舞的方式在高空旋转，二姐更完全信任张逸军把双手放开，上演一场唯美的互动。
31e1c6559410a0f90f6b15ee38d6aea06ccabb98.translatedText: When the second sister sang "Nothing About Love", Zhang Yijun, Taiwan's first dancer selected by Cirque du Soleil, also appeared on a hoop, flew into the air, and picked up the second sister on the hoop at the end of the song. The two danced high in the sky in a pas de deux. The second sister completely trusted Zhang Yijun to let go of her hands and staged a beautiful interaction.

76a4db21ae4b59bdb082d83fddc5ac98e27c8d9e.sourceText: 江蕙紧接着以全白如花仙子的服装现身，日文演唱「苹果花」，中间并插入张惠妹（阿妹）事前为二姐录製的VCR。阿妹全白髮型及特殊化妆，搭配后製加上的动画效果，花草在阿妹脸上生长、飘落，带来不一样的视觉效果。 二姐之后再度把白色长裙摘去，秀出底下的连身小短裙，更首次挑战吊台环绕，搭着蒲公英造型的吊台满场飞。
76a4db21ae4b59bdb082d83fddc5ac98e27c8d9e.translatedText: Jiang Hui then appeared in an all-white fairy costume, singing "Apple Blossom" in Japanese, with a VCR recorded by Zhang Huimei (A-Mei) for her second sister in advance. A-mei has a completely white hair style and special makeup, combined with animation effects added in post-production. Flowers and plants grow and fall on A-mei’s face, bringing a different visual effect. The second sister later took off her white dress again, showing off the short one-piece dress underneath, and even challenged the hanging platform for the first time, flying around on a dandelion-shaped platform.

7f7d6874b6ad960e783f1fac1827c01bbc0ed26d.sourceText: 唱完一连串抒情歌后，江蕙向大家说「刚刚都是抒情歌，现在要把小巨蛋当成卡拉ok」，并演唱多首动感十足的歌曲。
7f7d6874b6ad960e783f1fac1827c01bbc0ed26d.translatedText: After singing a series of ballads, Jiang Hui told everyone, "Just now we were all ballads, now we have to treat the Arena as a karaoke" and sang a number of dynamic songs.

0aadb0b728a4486d06cbb7c642a530a5475b4fa6.sourceText: 整场演唱会惊喜不断，舞台前方忽然落下水幕，二姐一身银色流苏短裙演唱「歌声满天下」、「追追追」等歌。
0aadb0b728a4486d06cbb7c642a530a5475b4fa6.translatedText: The entire concert was full of surprises. A curtain of water suddenly fell in front of the stage, and the second sister, wearing a silver fringed skirt, sang songs such as "Singing All Over the World" and "Chasing Chase".

d311580662e52c2b5afd16fd2cf1fec5a02a0ecc.sourceText: 当江蕙介绍嘉宾「费玉清」时，没想到是模彷小哥出名的林俊逸，两人合唱「雨夜花」，艺人康康也忽然现身，以男高音方式加入，笑料连连。
d311580662e52c2b5afd16fd2cf1fec5a02a0ecc.translatedText: When Jiang Hui introduced the guest "Fei Yuqing", she didn't expect that she was imitating the famous Lin Junyi. The two sang "Rainy Night Flowers", and the artist Kang Kang suddenly appeared and joined in as a tenor, which was full of jokes.

f2fd876570054dc143b74f3f5443e5c501c5ec32.sourceText: 二姐之后更大秀舞技，演唱经典歌曲「酒后的心声」时，带领全场万名观众大合唱，如雷歌声环绕全场。
f2fd876570054dc143b74f3f5443e5c501c5ec32.translatedText: The second sister then showed off her dancing skills even more. When she sang the classic song "Drunken Heart", she led the audience of 10,000 people in a chorus, and the sound of thunderous singing surrounded the whole place.

59930256c285d4a947855f4eec6e8ccf6fb0c741.sourceText: 整场演唱会的大惊喜，则是导演李安写的一番话，字字句句都是游子对故乡的思念，全场静静的看着文字在萤幕上流动，令人感动。
59930256c285d4a947855f4eec6e8ccf6fb0c741.translatedText: The biggest surprise of the whole concert was the words written by director Ang Lee. Every word was the wanderer's longing for his hometown. The whole audience watched the words flow on the screen in silence, which was touching.

78889832a5574c5ad4da9cf3d0f4c95845516595.sourceText: 在李安的文字后，二姐也唱了多首代表故乡情的歌曲，包括「落雨声」、「家后」、「故乡的歌」、「黄昏的故乡」等。这场精彩绝伦的「镜花水月」演唱会首场演出，最后就在二姐充满感情的歌声中划下句点。
78889832a5574c5ad4da9cf3d0f4c95845516595.translatedText: After Ang Lee's words, the second sister also sang a number of songs representing hometown feelings, including "Sound of Falling Rain", "Behind Home", "Song of Hometown", "Hometown at Dusk", etc. This wonderful first performance of the "Through the Looking Glass" concert ended with the second sister's emotional singing.

eb412841ba08e04cd3420a389a1d3276b724737d.sourceText: 亚省少年绘画作品：画由心生 画为心声
eb412841ba08e04cd3420a389a1d3276b724737d.translatedText: Paintings by young people in Alberta: Paintings come from the heart, paintings are the voice of the heart

6bed7ddc6c6341db663ecd48bbdbe6f456d3cc3f.sourceText: 亚省少年绘画作品：画由心生 画为心声 (吴晓玲供稿)同学们以认真积极的态度，发挥平日所学的绘画本领，用最好…
6bed7ddc6c6341db663ecd48bbdbe6f456d3cc3f.translatedText: > Paintings by young people in Alberta: Paintings come from the heart, paintings are the voice of the heart (Contributed by Wu Xiaoling) The students used a serious and positive attitude to develop the painting skills they have learned in daily life, and used their best...

3fc0c69658c84797cd01891fc0ba2285ebd99561.sourceText: (吴晓玲供稿)同学们以认真积极的态度，发挥平日所学的绘画本领，用最好的创作参加了这次侨联举办的青少年绘画比赛。他们的作品向社会展示出快乐积极的心态和对亚利桑那这片土地的热爱。在参与这个活动的过程中，孩子们的热情自始至终都得到侨联崔增祁、万培杰等先生的热情鼓励和肯定，今天他们能够取得这么优异的成绩，离不开自身的努力，也离不开组织者多方的支持和帮助。
3fc0c69658c84797cd01891fc0ba2285ebd99561.translatedText: (Contributed by Wu Xiaoling) The students used a serious and positive attitude to develop the painting skills they have learned in daily life, and used their best creations to participate in this youth painting competition organized by the Overseas Chinese Federation. Their works show the community a happy and positive attitude and love for the land of Arizona. In the process of participating in this activity, the children's enthusiasm has been enthusiastically encouraged and affirmed by Mr. Cui Zengqi and Wan Peijie of the Overseas Chinese Federation from beginning to end. They can achieve such excellent results today, which is inseparable from their own efforts and the support and help of the organizers.

8f234f0a9d1f0a0ab7e42ef7cc1469f9f012662e.sourceText: 借这次活动的东风，侨联和太阳鸟网共同开辟了”青少年绘画作品专栏”，这是个很有意义的举措，它将为孩子们提供一个展示绘画才能的平台，也将为活跃华人社区的文化生活发挥积极作用，我们将非常乐意参与这个专栏的作品展示、观点的讨论与互动。
8f234f0a9d1f0a0ab7e42ef7cc1469f9f012662e.translatedText: Taking advantage of this event, the Overseas Chinese Federation and Sunbird Network jointly launched the "Youth Painting Column". This is a very meaningful initiative. It will provide a platform for children to display their painting talents, and will also play an active role in activating the cultural life of the Chinese community. We will be very happy to participate in the display of works, discussion and interaction of opinions in this column.

825d90af95fce554c401b4a98cac17a7a387d999.sourceText: 作为一名绘画老师，近二十年的教学使我坚信：学习绘画，有利于孩子们观察力、想象力、创造力和欣赏能力的培养与提高。作为一种心灵的表达方式，它对丰富孩子们的人生必定产生潜移默化的影响。画由心生，画为心声。形式固然重要，没有线条、色彩、构图也就无所谓绘画，但有了这些也还不是绘画，只有把”意”立于”形”中，”形”才有存在的意义。”立意”使绘画形式获得生命，它远比形式夲身更为重要。
825d90af95fce554c401b4a98cac17a7a387d999.translatedText: As a painting teacher, nearly twenty years of teaching have convinced me that learning painting is conducive to the cultivation and improvement of children's observation, imagination, creativity and appreciation abilities. As a way of expressing the soul, it must have a subtle impact on enriching children's lives. Paintings are born from the heart, and paintings are the voice of the heart. Form is of course important. Without lines, colors, and composition, there is no painting. But with these, it is not painting. Only when "meaning" is established in "shape" can "shape" have the meaning of existence. "Conception" brings life to the painting form, which is far more important than the form itself.

aed1ebddd5b7e90aaeb79b02b60c8883d2c5c2e0.sourceText: 未来安检站不用脱衣摸身 在航空业致力于加强旅客的飞行安全，却引发乘客对安检过程中不当触摸抱怨连连之际，眼球扫描和未来的安全信道，可能很快将成为机场安检的标准程序。 国际空运协会(IATA)7日在新加坡展示了有「未来检查站」之称的机场安检信道模型，被区分为不具安全威胁的乘客，在走过20呎长的高科技安检信道期间，鞋子和手提箱可迅速接受扫描，信道还能查出液体和爆炸物。 美国联邦运输安全局长皮斯托认为，IATA准备在五年内实施的这一安全通道「是个好主意」。他说，「这种设施早该有了，我们虽还没达到未来检查站的地步，但一直在朝此方向努力，最终会推出类似的设施」。 IATA会长比斯加尼说：「乘客应当有尊严地走到登机口。这一安检通道意味着他们不用脱衣或解开行李，也肯定没有摸身。」 许多乘客因为受不了机场的长时间和烦人安检措施而放弃飞行，改乘火车、轮船或开车出行，各航空公司在想尽一切办法，希望重新赢回乘客。IATA预计，航空业界的赢利，将从去年的180亿元降至今年的40亿元。 运输安全局过去六个月在开发一种安检体系，可识别没有安全威胁的乘客，从而减少不必要的安检程序，皮斯托说：「一种安检方式不能适用于所有人」。 运安局今年可能在某些机场推出先期计划，允许经常飞行或安全背景无虞的旅客，只接受最低限度的安检。
aed1ebddd5b7e90aaeb79b02b60c8883d2c5c2e0.translatedText: There will be no need to strip and touch your body at security checkpoints in the future. As the aviation industry strives to improve flight safety for passengers, but it has triggered a series of complaints from passengers about inappropriate touching during security checks, eye scanning and future security channels may soon become standard procedures for airport security checks. The International Air Transport Association (IATA) demonstrated an airport security channel model, known as the "Checkpoint of the Future" in Singapore on the 7th. Passengers are classified as non-security threats. During the 20-foot-long high-tech security channel, shoes and suitcases can be quickly scanned, and the channel can also detect liquids and explosives. U.S. Federal Transportation Safety Administrator Pistor believes that the safety channel that IATA plans to implement within five years is "a good idea." He said, "This kind of facility is long overdue. Although we have not reached the point of future checkpoints, we have been working in this direction and will eventually launch similar facilities." IATA President Bisgani said: "Passengers should walk to the boarding gate with dignity. This security check channel means they do not have to take off their clothes or unpack their luggage, and they certainly do not touch their bodies." Many passengers have given up flying because they cannot stand the long and annoying security measures at the airport, and instead travel by train, ship or car. Airlines are trying every means to win back passengers. IATA predicts that the aviation industry's profits will drop from 18 billion yuan last year to 4 billion yuan this year. The Transportation Security Administration has spent the past six months developing a screening system that can identify passengers who are not a security threat, thereby reducing unnecessary screening procedures. "One size does not fit all," Pisto said. The Transportation Security Administration may launch an early plan at some airports this year to allow passengers who fly frequently or have a clear security background to undergo only minimal security checks.

74003e572fb68316e0495c5c93e060b3db35d507.sourceText: 周末在鳯凰城，什么地方人潮最拥挤？ 令大家意想不到的地方就是”凤城儿童博物馆”，这 是鳯凰城去年最新完成的社区服务计划。 鳯城儿童博物馆内充满了”童趣”的游乐​​设备，包括小小厨房等。 越来越多的父母亲在周末带孩子到儿童博物馆游乐与学习，纲上报名登记是不收门票费用，该馆提供场地举办生日派对，甚至可包下整栋房子来庆祝儿童的生日，生日 派对的费用均相当合理。 邓朝驹是唯一华裔董事，将于9月10 日9:00am邀请华裔社区领袖及中文学校负责人参观博物馆。 活动辄博物馆官网址为： www.childrensmuseumofphoenix.org 。
74003e572fb68316e0495c5c93e060b3db35d507.translatedText: In Huangcheng on weekends, which place is the most crowded? The most unexpected place is the "Fengcheng Children's Museum", which is the latest community service project completed by Fenghuang City last year. The Fun City Children's Museum is full of "childlike" play equipment, including a small kitchen. More and more parents are taking their children to play and study at the Children's Museum on weekends. There is no entrance fee for registration. The museum provides a venue to hold birthday parties, and even rents out the entire house to celebrate children's birthdays. The fees for birthday parties are quite reasonable. Deng Chaoju, the only Chinese director, will invite Chinese community leaders and Chinese school leaders to visit the museum at 9:00am on September 10. The official website of the Activities Museum is: www.childrensmuseumofphoenix.org.

9503c84fbc5c0de7b130cc5614d05009a7868cd0.sourceText: 法律问答 1。我爸爸持有美国绿卡，他想回中国﹐怎么样才能保持绿卡身分。他是否每半年必须来美一次，每次必须待多久？这与要入藉美国的要求有什么不一样？如果放弃绿卡，需要办理什么手续？ 听说国外年收入低于9万2000元不用在美上税，如果在国外有低的退休金，如年退休金是9200元，是否还要报税？国外收入报税时，是否要国外收入证明或已纳税证明？ 放弃绿卡身分，是否会影响他以后来美签证？ 答：如果你的爸爸想保持他的美永久居民身分，并想在美境外长期滞留，建议他在离境前办理回美证。办了回美证，一来证明他没有放弃美永久居民的意向，二来也可以让他在境外持续停留，只要不要超过两年。但如果他想入籍，我们建议他从获得绿卡起到递交入籍申请表之前要连续在美住满五年。如他曾经住满过五年，但近期又因长期（六个月到一年以上）在境外滞留，那么他在递交入籍申请之前要在美国至少连续住满30个月以上，补足他过去在境外滞留的时间，才可以申请入籍。 如果你爸爸在美国境外超过一年﹐那么他必须从最近一次进来的日期4年又一天以后﹐才可以申请﹐也必须符合30个月的居住规定﹐如果放弃绿卡，最简单的方法就是不再回美国，等到自己的绿卡过期了，就算自动放弃了。 在美国没有收入的人可以不报税，但低收入者是要报税的，但可能不要交税。你爸爸在中国获取的年退休金是9200元，按照美国税局的规定，如果他在中国没有交税，他在美国就要报税，但可能不须要交税，因为收入低。如果持绿卡者在中国的收入较高并且按中国税法已交了所得税，美国国税局也不会让这类人交两次税。所以，在美报税时就必须提供在中国交税记录，以达到在美不再重复交税的目的（指境外收入不超过9万2000元者）。如果在美国没有积累到40个工作点，到退休时就拿不到社安金如绿卡持有者在国外没有交税，那么就要在美国报税。至于交不交税要以此人境外收入而定。 放弃了美国绿卡一般不会影响到他今后的非移民签证。 2。2年前，我的一朋友向我借了2000元。她告诉我说家里遇到急事，急需钱用。她感激涕零并再三告诉我说两、三个月内一定全数归还。但半年后，我再见到这位朋友时，她连提都不提欠钱的事。我向她讨还我先前借给她的2000元。她保证一个星期后亲自给我送来。可是没见她的影子。她打电话她连我的电话都不接。我去她家找她，早已人去楼空。一晃2年过去了，前几天我去超市看见她。我走上前去向她要钱并指责她，她恼羞成怒，与我发生口角。我一生气就抓住她的手臂要她与我一同去警察局。她不肯，我们就扭打起来。她拿出手机报警。警察来后问了一下情况，不但没有对她指责，反而把我拷起来带到警察局关了起来。第二天我被放了出来，但通知我要在一个月后上庭﹐我朋友欠钱不还，做错了事，可是却没有受到惩罚，为何我要出庭，天理何在?我应该怎么办? 答﹕美国是一个法治的国家，犯了法就要受到法律上的制裁。在美国，各级法庭根据相关法律处理不同的案件，从大的角度来讲，分民事和刑事两大类，所以有民事法庭与刑事法庭。欠钱不还应该属于民事。因为所欠数额没有超过2500元，你若有她的欠条，可以到当地的小额法庭去告她。但因你一时气愤，当众抓住她的手臂，你可能犯了刑法。因为你没有动手打你的朋友，应该出庭付罚款单或上课而已，否则你还有可能遇到更大的麻烦。你一定要在规定的出庭时间出庭，付罚款。如果逃庭，你的事可能会升级。法官有可能因你的逃庭而对你发通缉令
9503c84fbc5c0de7b130cc5614d05009a7868cd0.translatedText: Legal Questions and Answers 1. My father holds a green card in the United States. He wants to return to China. How can he maintain his green card status? Does he have to come to the United States every six months and how long does he have to stay each time? How is this different from the requirements to immigrate to the United States? What procedures do I need to go through if I give up my green card? I heard that if your annual income abroad is less than 92,000 yuan, you don’t have to pay taxes in the United States. If you have a low pension abroad, for example, the annual pension is 9,200 yuan, do you still have to file a tax return? When filing tax returns for foreign income, do I need proof of foreign income or proof of tax payment? Will giving up his green card status affect his future visa to the United States? Answer: If your father wants to maintain his U.S. permanent resident status and stay outside the United States for a long time, it is recommended that he apply for a re-entry permit before leaving the country. Applying for a reentry permit not only proves that he has no intention of giving up being a permanent resident of the United States, but also allows him to continue to stay abroad as long as it does not exceed two years. But if he wants to naturalize, we recommend that he must live in the United States for five consecutive years from the time he obtains his green card to the time he submits the naturalization application form. If he has lived in the United States for five years, but has recently stayed abroad for a long period of time (six months to more than a year), he must have lived in the United States for at least 30 consecutive months before submitting a naturalization application to make up for the time he spent abroad before he can apply for naturalization. If your father has been outside the United States for more than one year, he must apply 4 years and one day after the last date he came in. He must also meet the 30-month residence requirement. If you give up your green card, the easiest way is to not return to the United States until your green card expires, and you will automatically give up. People with no income in the United States do not need to file taxes, but low-income people are required to file taxes, but they may not pay taxes. Your father's annual pension in China is 9,200 yuan. According to the regulations of the US Internal Revenue Service, if he does not pay taxes in China, he will have to file a tax return in the United States, but he may not need to pay taxes because his income is low. If a green card holder has a high income in China and has already paid income tax according to Chinese tax laws, the US IRS will not let such people pay taxes twice. Therefore, when filing taxes in the United States, you must provide tax payment records in China to achieve the purpose of not paying taxes repeatedly in the United States (referring to those whose overseas income does not exceed 92,000 yuan). If you have not accumulated 40 working points in the United States, you will not receive social security benefits when you retire. If a green card holder does not pay taxes abroad, you will have to file taxes in the United States. Whether or not to pay tax depends on the person's overseas income. Giving up a U.S. green card will generally not affect his future non-immigrant visas. 2. Two years ago, a friend of mine borrowed 2,000 yuan from me. She told me that there was a family emergency and she needed money urgently. She burst into tears of gratitude and repeatedly told me that she would return it all within two or three months. But six months later, when I saw this friend again, she didn’t even mention the money she owed. I asked her to return the 2,000 yuan I lent her earlier. She promised to deliver it to me personally in a week. But there was no sign of her. She called and she didn't even answer my call. I went to her house to look for her, but the building was already empty. Fast forward 2 years, I went to the supermarket a few days ago and saw her. I walked up to her and asked for money and accused her. She became angry and had a quarrel with me. When I got angry, I grabbed her arm and asked her to go to the police station with me. She refused and we started fighting. She took out her cell phone and called the police. When the police arrived, they asked about the situation. Instead of blaming her, they handcuffed me and took me to the police station and locked me up. I was released the next day, but was informed that I would have to go to court in a month. My friend did not pay back the money he owed and did something wrong, but he was not punished. Why did I have to go to court? What is the justice? What should I do? Answer: The United States is a country governed by the rule of law. If you break the law, you will be punished by law. In the United States, courts at all levels handle different cases according to relevant laws. From a broad perspective, they are divided into two categories: civil and criminal, so there are civil courts and criminal courts. Repaying money owed should not be considered a civil matter. Because the amount owed does not exceed 2,500 yuan, if you have an IOU from her, you can go to the local small claims court to sue her. But because you were angry and grabbed her arm in public, you may have violated the criminal law. Because you didn't hit your friend, you should just go to court to pay the fine or go to class, otherwise you might get into bigger trouble. You must appear at the court date and pay the fine. If you skip court, your matter may escalate. The judge may issue a warrant for your arrest for absconding from court.

16df4d2e7340d66f5d11022ea5d96cb7d5f0e101.sourceText: 太阳鸟衔来橄榄枝 广州 杨绮薇 中秋小长假一溜烟就过去了。三天过得还挺充实的：10日，邀请朋友在家里简单而隆重地庆祝了自己的结婚纪念日；11日，接待了来自市局的一众好友，尽情享受了友情的愉悦，当天，还发了新博，做了圈务管理；12日是中秋节，一家人坐在一起，新老成员开心欢聚，美酒佳肴，对花赏月，共度一个愉快的中秋之夜。然而，最开心的还不是这些，最让我高兴的是，在这个中秋佳节，我收获了一份沉甸甸的礼物棗大洋彼岸的太阳鸟向我衔来了橄榄枝！ 中秋节之前，曾接到美国亚利桑那州《亚省时报》社社长甄硕钦的电话，言及要聘请我当他们报社在广州的特约记者。蔷薇自知不才，几番推却婉谢，但社长执意聘请，蔷薇被这位报业老前辈的真诚所打动，深知却之不恭，只好答应下来。之后，社长多次来电，指导蔷薇的具体工作。 9月3日，《亚省时报》社总编邓凌从美国飞回广州，处理有关事务。之后，她给我来电，约我9月10日中午11点半在广州华夏大酒店见面。10日中午，我应邀来到广州海珠广场的华厦大酒店，在三楼的宴会厅，美丽精干的女主编邓凌已经等候在那里了，旁边还有一些美国朋友，都是三个月前我在凤凰城见过的一些好朋友。邓主编简要地向我传达了社长的旨意，并把聘书和名片交给我，吩咐我以《亚省时报》社广州特约记者的身份，出席广东省政府侨办9月20-24日在广州、中山、韶关、河源等地举办的”海外华媒看广东”系列活动。 《亚省时报》是美国亚利桑那州首份有影响力的华文报纸，创刊于1990年4月。该报二十一年的办报理念是，弘扬中华文化，充实华人精神生活，提升华人在当地社会的政治、文化地位，帮助华人提高在美国的社会生活能力，为海外华人开拓一方广阔的文化新天地。据我所知，居住在已经开发的亚利桑那大沙漠的华人已有百余年的历史，但由于长期没有一份华文报纸，亚利桑那州的华人犹如生活在”文化荒漠”里。于是，《亚省时报》应运而生。该报创始人、社长甄硕钦凭着一颗火热的中国心和正确的办报理念，在时报兴办之初就把”拥有读者”作为办报的第一目标，同时，报社善于凝聚华人民众对中华文化的爱心，形成办报的力量。报社克服重重困难，冲破层层藩篱，不断扩展编写队伍，目前，《亚省时报》拥有作家、诗人、画家、书法家、特约记者、特约通讯员、自由撰稿人以及侨领、当地”文胆”等百余人，众志成城，《亚省时报》一步步走向成功，报纸从小到大，版式从单一到丰富，读者越来越多。 《亚省时报》为周二刊，逢周三、周五出版，每期对开16版至20版。目前版面分为：”要闻”、”华人社区”、”本地简明新闻”、”美国国际新闻”、”中国大陆港澳台新闻”、”经济生活”、”见闻”、”评论”、”华人生活”、”文艺副刊”、”文史”、”娱乐休闲”、”教育健康”、”百花园”和”广告天地”等，每期二版均有新华社提供的中港澳消息专稿。 地处亚利桑那州凤凰城的《亚省时报》，其网络版（ http://www.sunbirdarizona.com ）有个很美丽的名字太阳鸟，传说中，凤凰为了拯救被后羿射落在地的、受了重伤的第十个太阳，让光明重回人间，不惜燃烧自己，用强大的火力助推太阳升空。凤凰的涅槃，让太阳重回天上，让人间重现光明！因此，凤凰又有一个更美丽的名字”太阳鸟”。 中秋之夜，皎洁的明月亲吻着片片白云，美丽的太阳鸟向我衔来吉祥的橄榄枝，我凭栏望月，沐浴在澄澈的清辉里，心，浸润在一片温婉的月色中。
16df4d2e7340d66f5d11022ea5d96cb7d5f0e101.translatedText: The sunbird brought an olive branch Guangzhou Yang Qiwei The Mid-Autumn Festival holiday passed in a flash. The three days were quite fulfilling: on the 10th, I invited friends to celebrate my wedding anniversary simply and grandly at home; on the 11th, I received a group of friends from the city bureau and enjoyed the joy of friendship. On the same day, I posted a new blog and did circle management; on the 12th, it was the Mid-Autumn Festival, and the family sat together. The old and new members happily gathered together, drank and ate, admired the flowers and the moon, and spent a pleasant Mid-Autumn night. However, these are not the happiest things. What makes me happiest is that during this Mid-Autumn Festival, I received a heavy gift - the sunbird on the other side of the ocean brought me an olive branch! Before the Mid-Autumn Festival, I received a call from Zhen Shuoqin, the president of the "Alberta Times" in Arizona, USA, saying that he wanted to hire me as their newspaper's special correspondent in Guangzhou. Qiangwei knew that she was not talented, so she declined the offer several times, but the president insisted on hiring her. Qiangwei was moved by the sincerity of this veteran in the newspaper industry and knew that it would be disrespectful to refuse, so she had no choice but to agree. After that, the president called Qiangwei many times to guide her on her specific work. On September 3, Deng Ling, editor-in-chief of the "Alberta Times", flew back to Guangzhou from the United States to handle related matters. After that, she called me and asked me to meet at Guangzhou Huaxia Hotel at 11:30 noon on September 10th. At noon on the 10th, I was invited to the Landmark Hotel in Haizhu Plaza, Guangzhou. In the banquet hall on the third floor, the beautiful and capable female editor-in-chief Deng Ling was already waiting there, along with some American friends who I met in Phoenix three months ago. Editor-in-chief Deng briefly conveyed the president's message to me, handed me the letter of appointment and business card, and asked me, as the Guangzhou special correspondent of the "Alberta Times", to attend the "Overseas Chinese Media Seeing Guangdong" series of activities held by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the Guangdong Provincial Government in Guangzhou, Zhongshan, Shaoguan, Heyuan and other places from September 20 to 24. "Alberta Times" is the first influential Chinese-language newspaper in Arizona, USA. It was founded in April 1990. The newspaper's 21-year running philosophy is to promote Chinese culture, enrich the spiritual life of the Chinese, enhance the political and cultural status of the Chinese in local society, help the Chinese improve their ability to live in the United States, and open up a vast new cultural world for overseas Chinese. As far as I know, the Chinese have lived in the developed Arizona desert for more than a hundred years. However, because there has been no Chinese newspaper for a long time, the Chinese in Arizona seem to be living in a "cultural desert." Thus, the "Alberta Times" came into being. The founder and president of the newspaper, Zhen Shuoqin, with his passionate Chinese heart and correct newspaper running philosophy, took "having readers" as the first goal of running the newspaper when the Times was first founded. At the same time, the newspaper is good at gathering the love of the Chinese people for Chinese culture and forming the power of running the newspaper. The newspaper has overcome many difficulties, broken through layers of barriers, and continuously expanded its writing team. Currently, the "Alberta Times" has more than 100 people including writers, poets, painters, calligraphers, special reporters, special correspondents, freelance writers, overseas Chinese leaders, and local "literary talents". Together, the "Alberta Times" has become successful step by step. The newspaper has grown from small to large, the layout has changed from simple to rich, and the number of readers is increasing. The "Alberta Times" is a Tuesday issue, published every Wednesday and Friday, with pages 16 to 20 in each issue. The current pages are divided into: "Headline News", "Chinese Community", "Local Concise News", "U.S. International News", "News from Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan", "Economic Life", "Information", "Comments", "Chinese Life", "Literary Supplement", "Literature and History", "Entertainment and Leisure", "Education and Health", "Hundred Gardens" and "Advertising World". The second page of each issue has news articles from China, Hong Kong and Macao provided by Xinhua News Agency. The "Alberta Times" is located in Phoenix, Arizona. Its online version (http://www.sunbirdarizona.com) has a very beautiful name: Sunbird. According to legend, in order to save the seriously injured tenth sun that was shot to the ground by Hou Yi, the phoenix did not hesitate to burn itself and used powerful firepower to help the sun rise into the sky in order to bring light back to the world. The Nirvana of the Phoenix brings the sun back to the sky and brings light back to the world! Therefore, the Phoenix has a more beautiful name "Sunbird". On the night of the Mid-Autumn Festival, the bright moon kissed the white clouds, and the beautiful sunbird brought an auspicious olive branch to me. I leaned on the railing and looked at the moon, bathing in the clear light, and my heart was immersed in the gentle moonlight.

ebe8f418405f4ff4fa0dd3921cd14d684442bf70.sourceText: 人生何处去 王斋先 环观世界，有巍峨的高山峻岭。大小走兽，昆虫栖居期间；有蜿蜒的江河流经山谷，滋润大地。浩瀚汪洋的大海湖泊，其中有大小各色各样的水族，有如茵的平原，各色各样的植物滋生不息，覆盖大地；有一望无垠的沙漠，飞沙黄尘随风飘扬，成为不毛之地，又有碧蓝的天空，各式各样的飞鸟翱翔着，和煦的太阳按时赠送世界以光明与热气，月亮、星辰分担照明黑夜的职责。又有空气轻轻地吹拂树梢，发出丝丝的风声，雨水滋润地上，孕育各样五谷、果蔬、青草, 其间散居着”万物之灵”的人类，住在他们所建各式各样的房屋里，他们乘驾着他们所发明制造的舟、车、船舰、飞机，穿梭往来于地面、海上、空中，绘成一副绮丽的图画，都显出美好的景象。因为上帝创造天地时，就曾这样说：”上帝观看他所造的一切，都是美好的。”（创一：31） 戴维被圣灵感动作诗说：观看你手指头所造的天，并你所陈设的月亮、星宿，便说：人算什么，你竟顾念他？世人算什么，你竟眷顾他？你叫他比天使微小一点，并赐他荣耀尊贵为冠冕。你派他管理你所手造的，使万物，就是一切的牛羊，田野的兽，空中的鸟，海里的鱼，凡经行海道的，都服在他的脚下。（诗八篇） 人，无疑的是由父母所生，天地所养，有生命气息在里头，促使他们身体与智慧日渐成长，无生命气息，就无生活，亦无成长。但人的生命就如圣经所说：”日子短少，多有患难，出来如花，美丽鲜艳，又被割下，凋残枯零，飞去如影，又如雪雾，出现少时就不见了。”（伯十四：1）尽管在世上如何往来钻营奔走，经过无数十字路口，似有遥远前途，但早晚终须走进各人的坟场，了断充满劳苦愁烦的生命。 在这有限的生涯里，神的仆人保罗指教我们当以这至暂至短的苦楚、成就、极重无比永远的荣耀。原来我们不是顾念所见的，乃是顾念所不见的，因为所见的是暂时的，所不见的是永远的。（林后四：17-18）什么是暂时的？苦难是暂时的，是神对人的考验，也可能是一个管教。另是所见的物质世界是暂时的，到未来的日子，必都毁坏。经上说：”那日天必大有响声废去，有形的都必被烈火销化，地和其上的物都要烧尽了。”（彼后三：16）因此物质的世界是不值得贪爱的。那么什么是永远的？”天上的赏赐是永远的荣耀，在那里要得不朽坏的冠冕，是好得无比的。”（林前九：5） 所不见的天国是不能朽坏的，不能玷污，不能衰残，为我们存留在天上的基业，在那里不再有死亡，一切都更新了。（彼前一：4） 我们当善用神所赐给我们的良知，查考圣经，思想其中神所记载的话语，所指明的”生命之路，永生之道。趁着还有今日转步走进这条引导永生的门路。”（太七：13）才不致盲从世俗奢华宴乐，庸庸碌碌，毫无目标，浑浑噩噩地虚度这仅有一次的短暂黄金时代。 因此趁此时期，你要纪念你的上帝，就是造天地万物，也是造你父母亲和你生命的主，才不至于使其后的青年、中年、老年各阶段的生活所筹划，努力的一切，误入歧途，迷失了人生正确的方向。 ”世人哪！生命主已指示你何为善，祂向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。”（弥六：8） 这是生命的正轨，你若行驶其上，不偏左右，这轨道必引导你进入神国，享受世上所不能享受的”永远的生命”。 人类主已降临世界，为世上众人付出了赎价，他就是降世为人的耶稣基督，他非同世人必为死所困，他已经从坟墓死亡中复活，被天父接到高天，证实在暂短生命的人类之外，尚有”永生神”的存在。他应许一切信从他教训的人都有永生。 神在世界末日所要施行的审判是人生终点前站，在他左右有千千万万的天使侍立。有些人要往永刑里去，那些义人要往永生里去。（太二十五：46）。亲爱的朋友，你现在的脚步是走再哪条路上？一步一步，轻忽不得，因一失足成千古恨者多有人在。请你掉转脚步，走进主耶稣为使你得永生，享永福所开的路上吧！已走进者，请坚定你的脚。
ebe8f418405f4ff4fa0dd3921cd14d684442bf70.translatedText: Where to Go in Life Wang Zhaixian Looking around the world, there are towering mountains and ridges. During this period, animals and insects of all sizes lived; there were winding rivers flowing through the valleys, nourishing the earth. There are vast seas and lakes, in which there are aquatic animals of all sizes, and there are grassy plains where all kinds of plants grow endlessly and cover the earth; there are endless deserts where flying sand and yellow dust blow in the wind, becoming a barren land; there are also blue skies where all kinds of birds are soaring; the warm sun gives light and heat to the world on time; the moon and stars share the responsibility of lighting up the dark night. There is air gently blowing on the treetops, making a slight sound of wind, and the rain moistens the ground, giving birth to all kinds of grains, fruits, vegetables, and grasses. Human beings, the "spirits of all things", are scattered among them, living in various houses built by them. They ride on the boats, cars, ships, and airplanes they invented and manufactured, shuttled back and forth on the ground, at sea, and in the air, painting a beautiful picture, all showing beautiful scenes. Because when God created the heavens and the earth, he said this: "God saw everything he had made, and it was good." (Genesis 1:31) David was inspired by the Holy Spirit to write a poem: Looking at the heavens which your fingers had made, and the moon and the stars where you had set them, he said, "Who is man, that you care about him?" Who is this worldly man that you care for him? You made him a little lower than the angels and crowned him with glory and honor. You have given him dominion over the works of your hands, to put everything under his feet: all cattle and sheep, and all the beasts of the field, and the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, and everything that passes by the way of the sea. (Psalm 8) Human beings are undoubtedly born from their parents and nourished by heaven and earth. They have the breath of life inside them, which prompts their bodies and wisdom to grow day by day. Without the breath of life, there is no life and no growth. But human life is just like what the Bible says: "The days are short and full of tribulations. They come out like flowers, beautiful and bright, then they are cut off and wither, they fly away like shadows, and like snow and fog, they appear for a short time and then disappear." (Job 14:1) No matter how we run back and forth in the world, pass through countless crossroads, and seem to have a far-off future, sooner or later we must enter each person's graveyard and end a life full of toil and sorrow. In this limited life, God’s servant Paul teaches us that we should use this short-lived suffering, accomplishment, and incomparable eternal glory. It turns out that we do not care about what is seen, but about what is unseen, because what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal. (2 Corinthians 4:17-18) What is temporary? Suffering is temporary, a test from God to man, and it may also be a discipline. The other is that the material world we see is temporary and will be destroyed in the days to come. The Bible says: "On that day the heavens will pass away with a loud noise, and all things corporeal will be consumed by fire, and the earth and everything in it will be burned up." (2 Peter 3:16) Therefore, the material world is not worth coveting. So what is forever? "The reward in heaven is everlasting glory; there is a crown of incorruption, which is infinitely better." (1 Corinthians 9:5) The invisible kingdom of heaven is incorruptible, undefiled, and unfading. It is an inheritance reserved for us in heaven, where there is no more death, and everything is made new. (1 Peter 1:4) We should make good use of the conscience given to us by God, search the Bible, and think about the words recorded by God in it, which indicate "the way of life, the way of eternal life. While there is still today, turn around and enter this doorway that leads to eternal life." (Matthew 7:13) In order not to blindly follow the worldly luxury and enjoyment, be mediocre, aimless, and waste this short golden age that only happens once. Therefore, during this period, you should remember your God, who is the creator of heaven and earth and all things, as well as the creator of your parents and your life, so that all your plans and efforts in the subsequent stages of youth, middle age, and old age will not go astray and lose the correct direction of life. "O man! The Lord of life has shown you what is good, and what does He require of you? To do justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God." (Micah 6:8) This is the right track of life. If you travel on it and do not turn to the right or left, this track will lead you to enter the kingdom of God and enjoy "eternal life" that cannot be enjoyed in the world. The Lord of mankind has come to the world and paid a ransom for everyone in the world. He is Jesus Christ who came into the world as a man. He is different from the world and must be trapped by death. He has been resurrected from the death of the grave and was taken up to heaven by the Father, proving that there is an "eternal God" besides the short-lived human beings. He promised eternal life to all who believed in His teachings. The judgment that God will carry out at the end of the world is to stand before the end of life, with thousands of angels standing on his left and right. Some people will go to eternal punishment, and those who are righteous will go to eternal life. (Matthew 25:46). Dear friend, which road are you taking now? One step at a time cannot be ignored, because there are many people who will hate you for eternity if you make one mistake. Please turn around and walk into the road opened by the Lord Jesus for you to have eternal life and enjoy eternal blessings! Those who have entered, please stand firm.

55d61230f409700f613d2be54569382c7bdb10ba.sourceText: 2011年7月2日11时59分，凤凰城华裔小姐选美网络投票即将结束，目前是网络票选最激烈的阶段。截止到6月22日12pm，太阳鸟亚利桑那华人社区网（ WWW.SUNBIRDARIZONA.COM ）统计，暂时领先的是：5号选手陈伊恩25071，她的网络热度超过了14万人。排名第二的是2号高薇佳22216票，第三是6号程诗懿15561票。1号 杨忠婷，3号胡秋子，4号 刘兆慈，7号 林怡也在做最后的冲刺。
55d61230f409700f613d2be54569382c7bdb10ba.translatedText: At 11:59 on July 2, 2011, the online voting for the Miss Chinese in Phoenix beauty pageant is about to end. It is currently the most intense stage of online voting. As of 12pm on June 22, according to statistics from the Sunbird Arizona Chinese Community Network (WWW.SUNBIRDARIZONA.COM), the current leader is: Contestant No. 5 Chen Yan 25071, her online popularity exceeds 140,000. Ranking second is No. 2 Gao Weijia with 22,216 votes, and third is No. 6 Cheng Shiyi with 15,561 votes. No. 1 Yang Zhongting, No. 3 Hu Qiuzi, No. 4 Liu Zhaoci, and No. 7 Lin Yi are also making the final sprint.

d89a4a457600d44b80e624fb0d6f5563aac20a7d.sourceText: 这是自凤凰城有华裔小姐选美比赛以来，首次加入网络票选，票选结果将占最后结果的10%。从2011年6月5日零时开始，在短短二十多天的时间里，凤凰城华裔小姐选美活动受到全世界各个国家华人的关注。网页的日点击量超1200多个IP。当日最高访问量超过3000个IP。点击率最高的地区来自美国和中国大陆。中国大陆，港澳台的所有省市都在网络上参与投票。美国最集中的地区在亚利桑那州，加州，纽约等华人聚集度高的地区。然而这次票选的影响远远不仅如此，据网络的最新统计，凤凰城华裔小姐选美的影响已经扩大到了世界范围，加拿大，丹麦，澳大利亚，英国，哥斯达黎加，日本，挪威等二十多个国家的朋友都在网站上投了选票，选出了自己喜欢的华裔小姐。
d89a4a457600d44b80e624fb0d6f5563aac20a7d.translatedText: This is the first time since the Miss Chinese Beauty Pageant in Phoenix that online voting has been added, and the voting results will account for 10% of the final result. Starting from 0:00 on June 5, 2011, in just over 20 days, the Miss Chinese Phoenix Beauty Pageant attracted the attention of Chinese people from all over the world. The daily clicks on the web page exceed more than 1,200 IPs. The highest number of visits that day exceeded 3,000 IPs. The regions with the highest click-through rates are from the United States and mainland China. All provinces and cities in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan are participating in voting online. The most concentrated areas in the United States are in Arizona, California, New York and other areas with a high concentration of Chinese. However, the impact of this vote goes far beyond that. According to the latest statistics from the Internet, the influence of the Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant has expanded to the world. Friends from more than 20 countries including Canada, Denmark, Australia, the United Kingdom, Costa Rica, Japan, and Norway have all voted on the website to select their favorite Miss Chinese.

2723e14537ca5431943a0f6926ebee616a7b934b.sourceText: 第三十届凤凰城华裔小姐选美的网络票选如火如荼，很多朋友都希望看看华裔小姐的桂冠最后花落谁家。7月4日现场的比赛应该是最精彩的。组委会将在比赛现场，从选中本届比赛冠军的投票者中，随机抽取三名幸运投票者进行奖励。请投票者投票完毕之后点击网页上方的?#21442;加抽奖?#22635;写相关信息。第一名将获得柯达数码相机一台，第二名获得价值$50的礼券，第三名将获得价值$20的餐券。
2723e14537ca5431943a0f6926ebee616a7b934b.translatedText: The online voting for the 30th Miss Chinese Phoenix Pageant is in full swing. Many friends want to see who will be crowned Miss Chinese in the end. The live game on July 4th should be the most exciting. The organizing committee will randomly select three lucky voters at the competition site from the voters who selected the winner of this competition to reward them. After voting, voters are asked to click on the "Add Lucky Draw" button at the top of the page to write relevant information. The first place will receive a Kodak digital camera, the second place will receive a $50 gift certificate, and the third place will receive a $20 meal certificate.

4e5d7fdac6a303b52305b93238cdda2092f619d3.translatedText: Vice President Xi Jinping spoke at a dinner hosted by overseas Chinese

c27b108592649c4432409db9a4de60abbf84a264.sourceText: 16日晚，洛杉矶华侨华人欢迎中国国家副主席习近平晚宴，在洛杉矶城中区万豪大酒店（JW.)三楼宴会厅举行，达两 万英尺的宴会大厅是日装饰得富丽堂皇，大红背景的主席台上方”洛杉矶华侨华人欢迎习近平副主席访问洛杉矶晚宴”字样的格外醒目，十面中美两国国旗两边排列，鲜花簇 簇，大红黄色图案的地毯更显祥和喜庆。 主席台前以红色基调布置的长方形主桌30位主嘉宾，20席VIP贵宾两边排开，其余30席侨界各侨团代表，出席宴会530人（包括习近平副主席随行人员70人） 。 晚宴以乐队高奏中美两国国歌开始，侨界代表张素久女士致欢迎词，她说，欢迎并感谢习近平副主席一行在密集访美行程中，抽出时间与华人华侨相聚，她回顾 了洛杉矶华人华侨在庆祝中国国庆，支持北京奥运，上海世博，维护两岸统一，抗震救灾等方面的工作，她表示，为自己是华人而骄傲，为拥有一个​​强大的祖国而骄傲，为能参加祖国 发展建设而骄傲。 她以”欢迎您再来”结束发言。 习近平副主席在晚宴上发表了热情洋溢的讲话，他回顾了此次访美取得的成果，介绍了中国国内的政治经济发展情势，感谢华人华侨在促进中美友好与两国合作方面 的突出贡献。 他还向侨胞提出三点殷切希望，1，继续发扬中华民族”以和为贵，协和万邦”的优良传统，努力成为与驻在国人民和睦相处的典范；2，继续发挥熟悉驻在国， 了解祖籍国的独特优势，努力成为促进中国现代化建设，与世界人民友好相处的典范；3，继续发挥了解中华文化的独特优势，努力弘扬中华文化和促进中华文化交流的典范。
c27b108592649c4432409db9a4de60abbf84a264.translatedText: On the evening of the 16th, the overseas Chinese in Los Angeles welcomed Chinese Vice President Xi Jinping to a dinner, which was held in the banquet hall on the third floor of the Marriott Hotel (JW.) in the downtown area of Los Angeles and lasted for two The 10,000-foot banquet hall was magnificently decorated on the day. The words "Los Angeles Overseas Chinese Welcome Vice Chairman Xi Jinping's Visit to Los Angeles Dinner" were particularly eye-catching above the rostrum with a bright red background. Ten national flags of China and the United States were arranged on both sides, with clusters of flowers, and the bright red and yellow patterned carpet made it more peaceful and festive. There were 30 chief guests at the rectangular main table decorated in red tone in front of the rostrum, 20 VIP seats were lined up on both sides, and the remaining 30 seats were representatives of various overseas Chinese groups. 530 people attended the banquet (including 70 people accompanying Vice Chairman Xi Jinping). The dinner started with the band playing the national anthems of China and the United States. Ms. Zhang Sujiu, a representative of the overseas Chinese community, gave a welcome speech. She said that she welcomed and thanked Vice President Xi Jinping and his delegation for taking time to gather with overseas Chinese during their intensive visit to the United States. She reviewed the work of the Chinese and overseas Chinese in Los Angeles in celebrating China's National Day, supporting the Beijing Olympics, Shanghai World Expo, safeguarding cross-strait reunification, and earthquake relief. She said that she was proud to be Chinese, proud to have a strong motherland, and proud to participate in the motherland. We are proud of our development and construction. She ended her speech with "Welcome again." Vice President Xi Jinping delivered a warm speech at the dinner. He reviewed the results of his visit to the United States, introduced China's domestic political and economic development, and thanked the Chinese and overseas Chinese for their outstanding contributions in promoting Sino-US friendship and cooperation between the two countries. He also put forward three ardent hopes to the overseas Chinese: 1. Continue to carry forward the fine tradition of the Chinese nation of "valuing peace and harmonizing all nations" and strive to become a model of living in harmony with the people of the host country; 2. Continue to leverage the unique advantages of being familiar with the host country and understanding the country of origin, and strive to become a model of promoting China's modernization drive and getting along well with people around the world; 3. Continue to leverage the unique advantages of understanding Chinese culture, strive to promote Chinese culture and promote Chinese cultural exchanges.

28a7e5a0e75fb75ded8e82e1052dd8b62ae5077b.sourceText: 出席晚宴的还有中国外交部长杨洁篪，教育部长袁贵仁，农业部长韩长赋，侨办主任李海峰，商务部副部长兼国际贸易谈判代表高虎诚， 中国驻美大使张业遂等，这是习近平副主席访美行程唯一的一次参加侨宴。 晚宴的菜色为西式，包括开胃沙拉，烤鸡胸脯，三文鱼，蔬菜和甜点，饮料是咖啡，茶和加州红酒。 整个晚宴穿插着文艺演出，有腰鼓，芭蕾舞，器乐弹奏，独唱等等，整个晚宴两小时，气氛热烈祥和。 中国国务院侨办主任李海峰一行已于15日抵达洛杉矶，李海峰此行主要是协助总领事馆和侨社组织这次欢迎晚宴，李海峰刚一抵达，就前往晚宴举办地万豪酒店现场 慰问参加欢迎活动的华人华侨和留学生。 为搞好这次侨界欢迎习近平副主席活动，洛杉矶华人华侨和中国留学生组成”南加州欢迎习近平副主席访洛总指挥部”。”指挥部”已于15日午后开始运作，， 在习近平副主席下榻的万豪酒店前24小时站岗，一直到17日午后，并另请专业华人保安游动，守夜行动全天候轮班马拉松式展开。
28a7e5a0e75fb75ded8e82e1052dd8b62ae5077b.translatedText: Also present at the dinner were Chinese Foreign Minister Yang Jiechi, Education Minister Yuan Guiren, Agriculture Minister Han Changfu, Director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office Li Haifeng, Vice Minister of Commerce and International Trade Negotiator Gao Hucheng, Chinese Ambassador to the United States Zhang Yesui, etc. This was the only overseas Chinese banquet attended by Vice President Xi Jinping during his visit to the United States. The dinner menu is Western-style, including appetizer salad, grilled chicken breast, salmon, vegetables and desserts. The drinks are coffee, tea and California red wine. The entire dinner was interspersed with theatrical performances, including waist drum, ballet, instrumental music, solo singing, etc. The entire dinner lasted for two hours, and the atmosphere was warm and peaceful. Li Haifeng, director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council of China, and his delegation arrived in Los Angeles on the 15th. Li Haifeng's trip was mainly to assist the Consulate General and overseas Chinese associations in organizing the welcome dinner. As soon as Li Haifeng arrived, he went to the Marriott Hotel where the dinner was held to express condolences to the overseas Chinese and international students attending the welcome event. In order to carry out this activity of the overseas Chinese community welcoming Vice Chairman Xi Jinping, the Chinese overseas Chinese in Los Angeles and Chinese students studying abroad formed the "Southern California Welcomes Vice Chairman Xi Jinping's Visit to Los Angeles Headquarters". The "Command Headquarters" began operations in the afternoon of the 15th and stood guard 24 hours a day in front of the Marriott Hotel where Vice Chairman Xi Jinping stayed until the afternoon of the 17th. Professional Chinese security guards were also invited to patrol, and the vigil operation was carried out in marathon shifts around the clock.
