f463085ba7bd2cdafc6a39e1bade508f14ad44f4.sourceText: 习近平副主席16日下午1时40分抵达洛杉矶国际机场，加州州长布朗，洛杉矶市市长维拉莱构沙和中国驻洛杉矶总领事馆总领事邱绍芳大使等中美官员和华人华侨，留学生， 中资机构代表到机场迎接。 习近平副主席到达后，立即由加州州长布朗，洛杉矶市长维拉莱构沙，中海运集团董事长李绍德等中美官员陪同前往参观考察了中海运西港码头，并亲切会见中海运”欧洲 号”货轮的船员。 习近平副主席参观后表示，中海运在洛杉矶港口的成功，再次印证了中美经贸合作双赢的本质，展现了双方在资源领域的合作潜力，也说明中美双方只要抓住机遇相向而行 ，就一定能创造更多的合作亮点。 在习近平副主席到达洛杉矶之前，省市长经贸代表团已提前一日到达洛杉矶，受到有关机构和侨界的欢迎。 福建省省长苏树林率领30人的经贸代表团进行合作投资​​多领域的洽谈；重庆市原由市长黄奇帆率领，因故无法成行，由中国国际投资促进会副会长暨重庆市对外贸易经济委员会 主任王毅率领15人代表团，据王毅透露，代表团将在洛杉矶签订13.9亿美元的合作项目，并正式缔结金兰，结盟姐妹友好城市以及在洛杉矶国际机场高层商谈双向直航事宜进行会谈。 习近平副主席为期五天的访美行程，是应副总统拜登的邀请，这次访问​​是今年中美间的一次重要的高层交往，旨在落实两国元首达成的重要共识，推进中 美合作伙伴关系的建设，访问洛杉矶最大的亮点是经贸合作和文化交流。 17日，习近平副主席一行离开美国，前往爱尔兰和土耳其访问。
f463085ba7bd2cdafc6a39e1bade508f14ad44f4.translatedText: Vice President Xi Jinping arrived at the Los Angeles International Airport at 1:40 pm on the 16th. California Governor Brown, Los Angeles Mayor Villaraigosa, Ambassador Qiu Shaofang, Consul General of the Chinese Consulate General in Los Angeles and other Chinese and American officials, overseas Chinese, overseas students, and representatives of Chinese-funded institutions came to greet him at the airport. Immediately after Vice Chairman Xi Jinping arrived, he was accompanied by Chinese and American officials such as California Governor Brown, Los Angeles Mayor Villaraigosa, China Shipping Group Chairman Li Shaode, and visited China Shipping Westport Terminal, and cordially met with the crew of China Shipping's "Europe" cargo ship. After the visit, Vice Chairman Xi Jinping said that China Shipping’s success at the Port of Los Angeles once again confirmed the win-win nature of Sino-US economic and trade cooperation, demonstrated the potential for cooperation between the two sides in the field of resources, and also showed that as long as China and the United States seize the opportunity and move toward each other, they will surely create more cooperation highlights. Before Vice President Xi Jinping arrived in Los Angeles, the provincial and mayoral economic and trade delegation had arrived in Los Angeles one day in advance and was welcomed by relevant institutions and the overseas Chinese community. Su Shulin, Governor of Fujian Province, led a 30-member economic and trade delegation to negotiate cooperation and investment in various fields; Chongqing was originally led by Mayor Huang Qifan, but was unable to make the trip for some reason. Director Wang Yi leads a 15-member delegation. According to Wang Yi, the delegation will sign a US$1.39 billion cooperation project in Los Angeles, formally establish a sister city alliance with Camlan, and hold high-level talks on two-way direct flights at Los Angeles International Airport. Vice President Xi Jinping's five-day visit to the United States was at the invitation of Vice President Biden. This visit is an important high-level exchange between China and the United States this year. It aims to implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state and promote the construction of Sino-US cooperative partnership. The biggest highlight of the visit to Los Angeles is economic and trade cooperation and cultural exchanges. On the 17th, Vice President Xi Jinping and his delegation left the United States for visits to Ireland and Türkiye.

6e2b0f7000993bc780af833201e13746f38b6ba3.translatedText: Our reporter Deng Ling's photo report:

7c7005f21035182ee08671c92d057f536aa80aeb.sourceText: 2月23日晚六福酒家内摆出了38桌大红宴席，斐匿邓高密公所迎来了380多位嘉宾，举办2013年春宴联欢，让家族宗亲以及凤凰城 的侨领，亲朋汇聚一堂。 出席宴会的侨界人士其中有资深侨领余文劲，侨联主席张华芳，前白宫亚太事务顾问邓朝驹，前Superior市长邓鼎奇（Michael Ong Hing）阖家，余氏宗亲、黄氏宗亲等都来到了现场庆贺 ，满堂喜庆。 宴会厅的正中央挂着一幅刚劲有力的对联：”东汉家声好，南阳世泽昌”体现了邓氏家族增增日上的景象。 三藩市的全美邓氏宗亲总会元老邓海波，代表三藩市邓高密公所为全场嘉宾带来每人一支印有”三藩市邓高密公所”字样的圆珠笔，以表对凤凰城 宗亲及到会朋友的新春问候。 是日晚7时左右，在一轮精彩的醒狮表演之后，斐匿邓高密公所元老邓粤钿宣布晚会开始，主席邓丰沾致欢迎词，美国土生土长的邓丰沾先用不算流利但颇为标准的 台山话发言，接着再用英文对所有到场的嘉宾表示热烈欢迎，并祝大家蛇年万事胜意，身体健康！ 斐匿邓高密公所的主席及两位副主席向大家祝酒敬贺之后，四位应届高中毕业的优秀学生获颁发奖学金，分别是Alton Hing, Sarah Tang, Kaitlyn Ong 和Johnathan Tse。 四位优秀学生的父母、祖父母都被邀请上台合影留念。 会上提到加州和亚利桑那州的邓高密公所将于今年7月19日至22日联合举办夏令营活动，这项活动旨在开发和推广年轻的邓氏子弟在社区担任领导职务，加强邓氏宗 亲之间的思想交流和促进关系。 如有意参加者，请电凤凰城地区的以下联络人：邓贺铮623-628-1313；邓朝驹602-380-1618；邓军泉602-295-9651. 晚会上还有丰富奖品的礼物抽奖活动，获奖的嘉宾都笑逐颜开，晚上9时半，宴会依然热闹非凡，全场嘉宾一起道贺新年，希望新年心想事成，大吉大利，晚会在一派 喜气洋洋的气氛中圆满结束。
7c7005f21035182ee08671c92d057f536aa80aeb.translatedText: On the evening of February 23rd, 38 tables of red banquets were arranged in Lukfook Restaurant. Feini Deng Gaomi Office welcomed more than 380 guests and held the 2013 Spring Banquet, bringing together family members, overseas Chinese leaders in Phoenix, relatives and friends. Among the overseas Chinese who attended the banquet were senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin, Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation Zhang Huafang, former White House Asia-Pacific Affairs Advisor Deng Chaoju, former Superior Mayor Michael Ong Hing and his family, Yu family members, Huang family members, etc. all came to the scene to celebrate, and the whole house was full of joy. In the center of the banquet hall hangs a powerful couplet: "The family reputation in the Eastern Han Dynasty is good, and the world of Nanyang is prosperous", which reflects the growth of the Deng family. Deng Haibo, the veteran of the National Deng Clan Association in San Francisco, on behalf of the San Francisco Deng Gaomi Office, brought each guest a ballpoint pen with the words "San Francisco Deng Gaomi Office" printed on it to express New Year greetings to the Phoenix Clan and friends attending the meeting. At about 7 pm that day, after a wonderful lion dance performance, Deng Yuetian, the veteran of Fei Ni Deng Gaomi Office, announced the start of the party. Chairman Deng Fengzhan delivered a welcome speech. Deng Fengzhan, a native of the United States, first spoke in Taishan dialect that was not fluent but quite standard. Then he expressed a warm welcome to all the guests in English and wished everyone good luck and good health in the Year of the Snake! After the Chairman and the two Vice-Chairmen of Phenideng Gaomi Office toasted to everyone, four outstanding students who graduated from high school were awarded scholarships, namely Alton Hing, Sarah Tang, Kaitlyn Ong and Johnathan Tse. The parents and grandparents of the four outstanding students were invited to the stage to take photos. It was mentioned at the meeting that the Deng Gaomi Offices in California and Arizona will jointly host summer camp activities from July 19 to 22 this year. This activity aims to develop and promote young Deng descendants to take up leadership positions in the community, strengthen the exchange of ideas and promote relationships among Deng family members. If you are interested in participating, please call the following contact persons in the Phoenix area: Deng Hezheng 623-628-1313; Deng Chaoju 602-380-1618; Deng Junquan 602-295-9651. There was also a gift lottery with rich prizes at the party. The winning guests were all smiles. At 9:30 in the evening, the banquet was still very lively. All the guests congratulated the New Year and hoped that all their wishes in the New Year would come true and good luck. The party ended successfully in a joyful atmosphere.

6ed5336de658a784e9b9f9edff579e7f4f5963b3.translatedText: Sang Lan agrees with Haiming's resignation, saying that the unauthorized release of sexual assault testimony has caused him to lose face [Overseas Chinese News reporter Zou Bin reported in New York on September 15] Sang Lan's lawsuit in the United States has recently emerged...

ed21cf7494176c589f479c07e2f9328cc0bd3d7c.sourceText: 【侨报记者邹斌9月15日纽约报道】桑兰赴美诉讼案日前又出现新变数，在经历连续波折后，其代理律师海明9月初更是向纽约联邦南区法院申请辞职动议，而法官要求原告和被告方在9月16日给予回复。而根据桑兰15日向法庭提交的文件显示，桑兰表示同意海明辞职。这份文件中还透露了很多不为人知的细节，同时，桑兰要求海明向她未来的新律师提供与本案有关的所有文件。
ed21cf7494176c589f479c07e2f9328cc0bd3d7c.translatedText: [Overseas Chinese News reporter Zou Bin reported in New York on September 15] New variables have emerged in Sang Lan's lawsuit in the United States. After experiencing continuous twists and turns, his attorney Hai Ming applied for a resignation motion to the Federal Southern District Court of New York in early September, and the judge required the plaintiff and defendant to respond on September 16. According to the documents Sang Lan submitted to the court on the 15th, Sang Lan expressed his agreement with Haiming's resignation. The document also revealed many unknown details. At the same time, Sang Lan asked Haiming to provide her future new lawyer with all documents related to the case.

2e83084cf5b33da3383f8baefd87d5ecc20b8697.sourceText: 此前传出桑兰将在16日不辞而别返回北京。桑兰经纪人黄健15日对本报记者表示，桑兰回国日程不便透露。但就桑兰递交法院的答辩书一事，黄健向记者表示，任何法律诉讼都应该在法庭上完成，而不是媒体或网络上，任何诉讼双方都应本着认真负责的态度完成。关于桑兰诉讼案的下一步进展，黄健表示一切都会继续，但目前不能发表任何言论。
2e83084cf5b33da3383f8baefd87d5ecc20b8697.translatedText: It was previously reported that Sang Lan would leave and return to Beijing on the 16th without saying goodbye. Sang Lan's agent Huang Jian told this reporter on the 15th that it was not convenient to disclose Sang Lan's return schedule. However, regarding Sang Lan's submission to the court, Huang Jian told reporters that any legal proceedings should be completed in court, not in the media or on the Internet, and both parties to any litigation should be completed in a serious and responsible manner. Regarding the next development of Sang Lan's lawsuit, Huang Jian said that everything will continue, but he cannot make any comments at the moment.

945520f584025c2edb6169b992a30c35fe651e57.sourceText: 桑兰15日在递交给法院的这份长达五页纸的答辩中，就海明辞职动议中的11项一一作出回应。首先她表示同意海明不再担任她的代理律师，而桑兰揭露，关于性侵害的刑事案件，海明在她未抵美国之前就向检控机构报案，并敦促她尽快赴美。
945520f584025c2edb6169b992a30c35fe651e57.translatedText: In the five-page reply submitted to the court on the 15th, Sang Lan responded to 11 items in Haiming's resignation motion one by one. First, she agreed that Haiming would no longer serve as her attorney. Sang Lan revealed that regarding the criminal case of sexual assault, Haiming reported the case to the prosecution before she arrived in the United States and urged her to go to the United States as soon as possible.

477944ac3125a29236342ff9fa65e805da7bd11c.sourceText: 答辩书中最引人注目的就是，海明在今年5月5日就已经向地方法院报性侵案，而当时人在北京的桑兰并没有授权海明这么做。另外桑兰还称，海明在未经授权下就公布了她的性侵证词，令她颜面扫地。
477944ac3125a29236342ff9fa65e805da7bd11c.translatedText: The most eye-catching thing in the defense is that Haiming reported the sexual assault case to the local court on May 5 this year, but Sang Lan, who was in Beijing at the time, did not authorize Haiming to do so. In addition, Sang Lan also claimed that Haiming published her sexual assault testimony without authorization, which embarrassed her.

6192cd7cda335600fd0a8027fb71b9a40c84fbd0.sourceText: 值得关注的是，桑兰强调是海明在今年5月5日向地方检察机构报性侵刑事案，其中有书信为证，桑兰称并未授权律师海明这么做。桑兰的经纪人黄健5月24日收到海明的邮件，催促他们尽快申请赴美签证。
6192cd7cda335600fd0a8027fb71b9a40c84fbd0.translatedText: What is noteworthy is that Sang Lan emphasized that it was Haiming who reported the criminal sexual assault case to the local prosecutor's office on May 5 this year, which was evidenced by letters. Sang Lan said that he did not authorize lawyer Haiming to do so. Sang Lan's agent Huang Jian received an email from Hai Ming on May 24, urging them to apply for a visa to the United States as soon as possible.

5dd83bcd98367ba76d3e98504be5d7e53aa855a5.sourceText: 桑兰还指出，根据法律，性侵案的证词应是保密的，但海明在未经授权下就公布了她的性侵证词，令她颜面扫地。另外关于和保险公司的保密协议，桑兰指出海明从来没有完全地向她解释所有条款，并且也没有给她提供保密协议条款的副本。在桑兰的回复中，还揭露了部分和海明关于律师费和住宿安排的通信往来。
5dd83bcd98367ba76d3e98504be5d7e53aa855a5.translatedText: Sang Lan also pointed out that according to the law, testimonies in sexual assault cases should be confidential, but Haiming published her sexual assault testimony without authorization, which embarrassed her. Regarding the confidentiality agreement with the insurance company, Sang Lan pointed out that Haiming never fully explained all the terms to her and did not provide her with a copy of the terms of the confidentiality agreement. In Sang Lan's reply, some of his correspondence with Haiming regarding legal fees and accommodation arrangements were also revealed.

5317e9a19c0ea0d18df8d6f71c1d715d1fed163e.sourceText: 美国中文网的网友在博客上贴出了海明对桑兰答辩书的回应：”狠心的桑兰13日向联邦法庭上交了几百页的文件，包括她宣誓的证词，对我横加指责，诬蔑，想下杀手。她要换律师，继续把刘谢莫告下去。声称没有同意与搞懂和美国保险公司的和解，没有同意和莫虎和解。”
5317e9a19c0ea0d18df8d6f71c1d715d1fed163e.translatedText: A netizen on the American Chinese website posted Haiming's response to Sang Lan's defense statement on the blog: "The cruel Sang Lan submitted hundreds of pages of documents to the federal court on the 13th, including her sworn testimony, accusing me, slandering me, and wanting to kill me. She wants to change lawyers and continue to sue Liu Xiemo. She claims that she did not agree or understand the settlement with the American insurance company, and did not agree with me. Mo Hu settled. "

1bf061d909b6dcf853ebbd5060296eac6a9ff32e.sourceText: 法官方面提出代理律师须在9月23日前对原告答复给出回应，鉴于被告方律师莫虎此前表示不反对海明辞去代理律师意见、目前原告方桑兰也同意海明的辞职，法官应会批准海明终止代理的要求，但被告方律师对海明的惩罚动议不会因此受到影响。
1bf061d909b6dcf853ebbd5060296eac6a9ff32e.translatedText: The judge proposed that the attorney must respond to the plaintiff's reply before September 23. Since the defendant's attorney Mo Hu previously expressed no objection to Haiming's resignation as attorney, and the plaintiff Fang Sanglan currently agrees with Haiming's resignation, the judge should approve Haiming's request to terminate the agency, but the defendant's attorney's motion for punishment against Haiming will not be affected.

8f29fee529d1674ef582d6b471772ccfa4523233.sourceText: （亚省时报 周宜申）二月十七日晚十时卅分，亚省中国餐馆协会(CRAA)的二百五十位餐饮界同仁共聚六福大酒家，庆祝农曆新年宴会暨联欢晚会。六福大酒家张灯结綵，精心佈置的廿五桌酒席座无虚席。玛瑞库帕县卫生局局长David、联合採购合作伙伴等嘉宾应邀参加了这次活动。晚会气氛热烈、喜庆；节目丰富多彩。抽奖、舞蹈等节目更将晚会推向高潮。 晚会伊始，该会会长关兆峰致辞。关会长总结了亚省中国餐馆协会一年来的工作。他对全体会员的精诚团结及对协会工作的支持表示感谢，并期待今年的工作将更上一层楼。接着，协会领导层集体亮相向与会宾客拜年。会长关兆峰及理事邓朝驹、高志中、张华芳、杨振纲、梅树德、赖甲乙、徐国富、巫宜钊和陆少明等举杯向与会宾客致敬。 亚省中国餐馆协会开展本行业工作之馀，关怀会员子女发展。该会领导们鼓励会员子女刻苦学习，积极向上，努力融入当地社会，准备为社会做贡献。该会特别选出五位品学兼优的会员子女，并为他们每人提供300美元的奖学金，以资鼓励。他们是Golden Rice 毕广桃和苏丽娟的孩子毕凯贤；Wokee Express邓以和、黄敏静的孩子邓心儿；World/Jumbo Buffet张明雨和张华芳的孩子张嘉颖；Lucky抯 King Wah华少玲的孩子杜建峰和Pink Lotus Express胡程清和麦惠霞的孩子胡可怡。 亚省中国餐馆协会的工作成就与政府部门的支持是分不开的。为表达对政府部门支持的感谢和敬意，创建会长邓朝驹及理事们代表该会向县卫生局局长David赠送中国国粹精品景泰蓝工艺花瓶。 晚会现场好戏联台。凤城华人基督教会舞蹈团表演的舞蹈”好收成”和”茉莉花”为晚会增添了色彩，活跃了晚会气氛。晚会最后的抽奖活动则将晚会带入高潮。晚会组织者准备了包括橄榄油、维他命、茶叶、咖啡机等日常用品作为奖品。一时间叫号声、应号声和笑声此起彼伏，令晚会热闹非凡。虽然已近午夜，但是忙碌了一天的餐饮业同仁们，依然兴致勃勃，欢声笑语不断。宾客们一边品尝着美味大餐，一边与同行朋友们联络友情，共叙家常，显示了亚省中国餐馆协会，这个餐饮界大家庭的凝聚力和亲和力。 凌晨零点卅分，历时两个钟头的宴会暨联欢晚会在宾朋的依依惜别声中降下帷幕。
8f29fee529d1674ef582d6b471772ccfa4523233.translatedText: (Alberta Times Zhou Yishen) At 10:30 pm on February 17, 250 colleagues in the catering industry of the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta (CRAA) gathered at Luk Fook Restaurant to celebrate the Lunar New Year banquet and gala. The Luk Fook Restaurant was decorated with lanterns and colorful decorations, and the twenty-five tables of banquets carefully arranged were packed with people. Guests including David, director of the Maricupa County Health Department, joint purchasing partners and other guests were invited to attend the event. The atmosphere of the party was warm and festive; the program was rich and colorful. Lucky draws, dances and other programs pushed the party to a climax. At the beginning of the party, Guan Zhaofeng, the president of the association, delivered a speech. President Guan summarized the work of the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association over the past year. He expressed his gratitude to all members for their sincere unity and support for the work of the association, and looked forward to reaching a higher level of work this year. Then, the leadership of the association made a collective appearance to wish the guests a happy New Year. President Guan Zhaofeng and directors Deng Chaoju, Gao Zhizhong, Zhang Huafang, Yang Zhengang, Mei Shude, Lai Jiayi, Xu Guofu, Wu Yizhao and Lu Shaoming toasted to the guests. In addition to carrying out its work in the industry, the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association also cares about the development of the children of its members. The leaders of the association encourage the children of members to study hard, be positive, strive to integrate into the local society, and prepare to contribute to society. The association specially selected five children of its members who have excellent academic performance and provided each of them with a scholarship of US$300 to encourage them. They are Bi Kaixian, the child of Bi Guangtao and Su Lijuan of Golden Rice; Deng Xin'er, the child of Wokee Express Deng Yihe and Huang Minjing; Zhang Jiaying, the child of Zhang Mingyu and Zhang Huafang of World/Jumbo Buffet; Du Jianfeng, the child of Lucky's King Wah Hua Shaoling, and Hu Keyi, the child of Hu Chengqing and Mai Huixia of Pink Lotus Express. The achievements of the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association are inseparable from the support of government departments. In order to express their gratitude and respect for the support of the government departments, the founding president Deng Chaoju and the directors presented the Chinese quintessence cloisonné craft vase to David, director of the County Health Bureau, on behalf of the association. There was a good show at the party. The dances "Good Harvest" and "Jasmine" performed by the Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church Dance Troupe added color to the party and enlivened the atmosphere of the party. The lucky draw at the end of the party brought the party to a climax. The party organizers prepared daily necessities including olive oil, vitamins, tea, coffee machines and other prizes as prizes. The sound of trumpets, responses to trumpets and laughter came one after another, making the party lively. Although it was almost midnight, colleagues in the catering industry were still in high spirits and laughing after a busy day. While enjoying the delicious meal, the guests kept in touch with their colleagues and chatted about home life, which showed the cohesion and affinity of the Alberta Chinese Restaurant Association, a big family in the catering industry. At 0:30 in the morning, the two-hour banquet and gala ended with the farewells of guests and friends.

5a0cc0dbef8e35c852b9058a607f43d5dea193bc.sourceText: 阿派奥坚称奥巴马出生证是伪造 阿派奥警长在周二下午的新闻发布会上，曝光了马利科巴郡警长办公室对奥巴马总统出生证的第二份调查结果。阿派奥坚称，现存在夏威夷卫生署的这份出生证是伪造的。 ”考虑到夏威夷似乎对其居民出生证明管理的宽松程度，有可能，但没有证据指证，奥巴马总统，通过他个人的行为，得到这份出生证，以证明他美国公民身份，”阿派奥的调查员麦克佐罗说。 根据佐罗的报告，夏威夷卫生署采用联邦政府制定的编码系统为出生证分类和编码。这个过程涉及到具体数字代码，用铅笔手写在出生证上的相关信息。”总统出生证明看到的数字格式与联邦政府要求相匹配的信息编码并不一致。”MCSO报告说，总统出生证有被更改或修订的可能。 调查人员找到了奥巴马出生证的录入者，现年95岁的贝尔纳光丽，据称是她在1961年8月8日签署了这份文件。纳光丽提供的信息是，1961年的那天，奥巴马在卡皮欧拉尼妇产医院出生。调查员还走访了夏威夷卫生署，总检察长办公室等地方，在要求会见夏威夷助理总检察长吉尔长峰时遭拒绝，长峰并拒绝出示出生证的原本。夏威夷州总检察长特别助理约书亚维奇周二在一份声明州说，MSCO的指控是”不真实的，误导和误解了夏威夷的法律。” 阿派奥再次呼吁奥巴马出来澄清，但白宫没有对此事发表意见。
5a0cc0dbef8e35c852b9058a607f43d5dea193bc.translatedText: Arpaio insisted that Obama's birth certificate was a forgery. Sheriff Arpaio exposed the results of the second investigation of President Obama's birth certificate by the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office at a press conference on Tuesday afternoon. Apao insists that the birth certificate now with the Hawaii Department of Health is a forgery. "Given how lax Hawaii appears to be in regulating the birth certificates of its residents, it is possible, but not proven, that President Obama, through his own actions, obtained this birth certificate to prove his U.S. citizenship," said Arpaio investigator Mike Zorro. According to Zorro's report, the Hawaii Department of Health uses a coding system established by the federal government to classify and code birth certificates. The process involves specific numeric codes, pertinent information handwritten in pencil on the birth certificate. "The numeric format seen on the Presidential Birth Certificate is not consistent with the encoding of information required by the federal government to match." MCSO reports that there is a possibility that the Presidential Birth Certificate may have been altered or revised. Investigators found the person who entered Obama's birth certificate, 95-year-old Bernard Guangli, who allegedly signed the document on August 8, 1961. The information provided by Na Guangli is that on that day in 1961, Obama was born at Kapiolani Maternity Hospital. The investigators also visited the Hawaii Department of Health, the Attorney General's Office and other places. When they requested to meet with Hawaii Assistant Attorney General Gil Changfeng, they were refused. Changfeng also refused to produce the original birth certificate. Joshua Veitch, special assistant to the Hawaii Attorney General, said in a statement to the state on Tuesday that MSCO's accusations are "untrue, misleading and misunderstand Hawaii's laws." Arpaio again called on Obama to come forward to clarify, but the White House has not commented on the matter.

31f8e38f9222e882c6325ca0d4e05932a0fd8803.sourceText: 芝加哥：父母将虐儿相放上网遭指控 （亚省时报） 上周，一对居住在本州北部的夫妇被指控虐待儿童，原因是他们用胶带将自己两名孩童捆绑拍照，并将照片放上facebook上供人浏览。 科肯尼诺郡警员说，2岁和10个月大的孩子被胶带绑着手腕和脚踝周围，并用胶带封住嘴巴。一名儿童被倒挂在一台运动机械上。孩子们的父母将这些照片作为笑话放上Facebook。 早几个星期前，一个芝加哥父亲也因为将自己女儿用胶带捆绑的照片放上FB而遭被捕，科肯诺警员说，没有证据证明被捕的父母受了芝加哥父亲的影响。 ”我认为，社交媒体正在成为刑事和民事案件证据，”本地辩护律师吉姆贝兰格说。 ”它可以用来协助调查，但没有任何人认领的照片或无人负责的事件很难起诉。” 科肯尼诺警员说，两个孩子的身体没有受伤。他们现在与其他家庭成员在一起。这对夫妇仍在监狱，他们将每人面临两项虐待儿童的罪名。
31f8e38f9222e882c6325ca0d4e05932a0fd8803.translatedText: Chicago: Parents accused of posting child abuse photos online (Alberta Times) Last week, a couple living in the northern part of the state were charged with child abuse after they tied up their two children with duct tape and took photos and posted the photos on Facebook for people to view. Cokeneno County police said the 2-year-old and 10-month-old children had duct tape tied around their wrists and ankles, and their mouths were taped shut. A child was hung upside down from a sports machine. The children's parents posted the photos on Facebook as a joke. A few weeks ago, a Chicago father was arrested for posting a photo of his daughter bound with tape on Facebook. Officer Cokenno said there was no evidence that the arrested parents were influenced by the Chicago father. "I think social media is becoming evidence in criminal and civil cases," said local defense attorney Jim Bellanger. "It can be used to assist investigations, but it's difficult to prosecute without any claimed photos or incidents where no one is responsible." Constable Cokenino said the two children were not physically injured. They are now with other family members. The couple remain in jail, where they each face two counts of child abuse.

45d12d94b088415dc948c9431b3004a9a7918cd5.sourceText: 亚省中华语文学院，中华书院，及凤凰城台北姊妹市委员会结合美国主流社会和各主流学校共同举办2012年祥龙迎新春中华节庆贺新年的一连串文化交流活动,宣传中华文化与台湾民俗及促进 东西多元文化交流,每项活动都非常圆满成功。 亚省中华语文学院，中华书院，及凤凰城台北姊妹市委员会自一月十一日至二十七日一直陆续忙碌的应邀至美国各主流学校指导中华文化与节庆，和介绍农历新年的历史及 典故,并提供民俗艺术才艺指导，与老师们和学生们一起欢度吉祥如意的龙年,所应邀访问的学校为：快乐谷学校各班级，林肯学习中心学校各班级，爱帕基学校各班级， 理查密乐学校各班级，蒙特苏理学校各班级，驼峰学校各班级，以及其他公私立学校和教会学校等，为老师们学生们介绍农历新年，及进行文化交流。 另外，亚省中华语文学院，中华书院，及凤凰城台北姊妹市委员会又应邀至MIM， Musical Instrument Museum，位于凤凰城市的音乐乐器博物馆，是美国最大的，也是最具国际性的。音乐乐器博物馆负责 一月二十八日上午十一时至下午五时，在博物馆创办大听所举行的庆祝龙年新年活动，包含有中华文化与台湾民俗艺术展示，指导大人与孩童农历新年美劳艺术，制做 春节灯笼,吉祥如意灯笼，祥龙献瑞迎新岁舞龙手工艺,各种折纸与剪纸艺术，音乐风车，和书法之美，活动老少咸宜，受到大人与孩童的喜爱，整个大厅内一直是挤得满 满人潮，非常热闹。 同时，一月二十八日在创办大厅内一整天都播放着由洛杉矶经济文化办事处新闻组所提供的宣传台湾录影带，包括有在这片土地上台湾4季DVD，台湾音乐向前走 DVD，以及台湾四季情小提琴演凑，乡音四韵管玄乐曲等优美的台湾音乐欣赏，配合音乐乐器博物馆的主题，共同与大家欢渡龙年农历新年。 祥龙迎新春中华节庆活动是由李玲麟与邱文琪赞助,和带领全家人参与投入,以及所有义工们的协助,使各项活动都能杰出顺利圆满成功,达到宣传中华文化与台湾民俗,和促进东西 多元文化交流。
45d12d94b088415dc948c9431b3004a9a7918cd5.translatedText: The Chinese Language and Literature College of Alberta, Chung Hwa Academy, and the Phoenix-Taipei Sister City Committee, in conjunction with the mainstream society in the United States and mainstream schools, jointly organized a series of cultural exchange activities in 2012 to celebrate the Chinese New Year, the Chinese Dragon Festival, and promote Chinese culture and Taiwanese folk customs. Multicultural exchanges between East and West, every activity was a complete success. The Chinese Language Institute of Alberta, Chung Hwa College, and the Phoenix-Taipei Sister City Committee have been busy from January 11 to 27, being invited to mainstream schools in the United States to teach about Chinese culture and festivals, and introduce the history of the Lunar New Year and Allusions, and provide guidance on folk art and talent, and celebrate the auspicious Year of the Dragon with teachers and students. The schools invited to visit are: classes at Happy Valley School, classes at Lincoln Learning Center School, classes at Aipaki School, classes at Richard Mille School, classes at Montesori School, classes at Camelback School, as well as other public and private schools and church schools, etc., to introduce the Chinese New Year to teachers and students and conduct cultural exchanges. In addition, the Chinese Language Institute of Alberta, Chung Hwa College, and the Phoenix-Taipei Sister City Committee were invited to MIM, the Musical Instrument Museum, located in Phoenix. It is the largest and most international music instrument museum in the United States. The Museum of Musical Instruments is responsible for celebrating the Year of the Dragon at the Museum’s Founding Hall from 11 am to 5 pm on January 28, including exhibitions of Chinese culture and Taiwanese folk art, guidance for adults and children on Lunar New Year arts and crafts, and production Spring Festival lanterns, auspicious lanterns, auspicious dragons and dragon dance crafts to welcome the new year, various origami and paper-cut arts, musical windmills, and the beauty of calligraphy. The activities are suitable for all ages and are loved by adults and children. The entire hall is always packed with people and very lively. At the same time, all day long on January 28, promotional Taiwan videos provided by the Los Angeles Economic and Cultural Office News Team were played in the founding hall, including Taiwan 4 Seasons DVD, Taiwan Music Forward DVD, Taiwan Four Seasons Violin Ensemble, Xiangyin Four Rhymes Guanxuan Music and other beautiful Taiwanese music appreciation, in line with the theme of the Musical Instrument Museum, to celebrate the Lunar New Year in the Year of the Dragon with everyone. The Xianglong New Year Chinese Festival event is sponsored by Li Linglin and Qiu Wenqi, and the participation of the whole family, as well as the assistance of all volunteers, makes all activities a smooth and successful success, promoting Chinese culture and Taiwanese folk customs, and promoting multicultural exchanges between the East and the West.

657dc4207a0084f674e92ead61c9d7f4447c9ce6.sourceText: 早晨，离开希尔顿旅馆，又把行李搬上旅行车，今日是向尼加拉瀑布区出发。 路程遥远，在经过的途中，旅行社安排两个参观点，第一站是赫氏朱古力世界 （好时巧克力世界），第二站是康宁玻璃中心（康宁玻璃中心）。 车子经过一段时间奔驰，抵达宾夕凡尼亚州的哈里斯堡，停留在赫氏朱古力世 界的广场，我们下车参观，这时天气阴凉，人人愉悦。朱古力是译音名词，又叫巧 克力，这种产品色泽深赭，我认为广东人译作朱古力，包含色素意义在内，比巧克 力的名称更贴切传神。 为了珍惜宝贵时间，陈导游在车上就详细介绍这间著名朱古力厂的历史，该厂 建立于十九世纪，创办人赫氏是在这里出生长大，那个时代，朱古力价格高昂，穷 人很难享用，他又非常喜欢吃这类香甜可口的糖果，立志要学习制作 ，普遍生产，终于如愿以偿，在这小镇建设起工厂，产品销量越来越大，他就在镇 里建造公寓，学校，图书馆，医院和剧院，让员工能安定生活。他没有子女，将赚 取的钱慷慨捐给慈善机构，’ 取诸社会，用诸社会?’ ，收养穷家子女及孤儿，供书 教育，成长后可进入工厂就业，真正 ‘ 为善最乐 ‘ 。 赫氏著名品牌货色：可口香甜糖果朱古力，在全美大小商场都有出售我们这。 次亲临参观，则是随美东经典旅游行程的机会。 赫氏朱古力世界装潢相当美观夺目，大门外楼房造型高三层，由阔而窄，最高 层是罗马数字的时钟，带有古典韵味; 招牌布置在宽敞低层门楣上，安置三类不同 形状的朱古力图案，像迪士尼卡通画面的谐趣，甜蜜地欢迎着客人的光临。 我们一行廿二人进内参观，登上公司特别设置的一列阅览车，慢慢旋转不停的 座厢，与吊缆车的运作相似，穿梭于厂内，游客坐着随处观看，可见到自动化生产 制作的全程工序。朱古力原料是可可豆，最初是加水加香料作为饮料，后来又加糖 加可可脂成为可咀嚼的硬块。我们现在循序观看最先压榨成液体，搅拌，然后凝结 成块，到最后包装，全部都是机械自动操作，很少见到工人，兜了一圈之后，便要 急忙离开列车，因为列车并不完全停驶，将近到站时放缓速度而已。 下车的场地就是热闹的售卖区，这里人山海，大家忙着选购自己喜爱的货色， 回去让家人品尝。有人说外面商场随处可买，何必在这里购买，还有两天旅程，走 遥远的路，还要搭乘飞机，经过安检麻烦。但大部份人皆认为这里是正宗的公司， 货品如假包换，机会难逢，多多少少也会购买一些。 跟着就出门外再拍照录影，四周景色美丽，处处都有朱古力的形象，还有个主 题游乐园，听说有动物园，植物园，过山车和水上娱乐，可惜时间所限，未能在此 尽兴。 告别赫氏朱古力世界，继续前往康宁玻璃中心，走了一段路，先要解决饮食问 题，午餐的地点停留在文曼斯文曼斯商场。这个商场庞大，有菜肉街市，有服 装店，工艺精品店，踏入正门转右是广阔的饮食区，林林总总的中西餐饮尽在这 里，美味飘香，令人垂涎欲滴。最前的摊位是日本寿司，对面是披萨薄饼，进内是 自选中餐，侧面有汉堡包，还有咖啡，绿茶，雪糕等等，吃饱饮够，去逛狂市场， 顺便买些饼干留待早餐食用。
657dc4207a0084f674e92ead61c9d7f4447c9ce6.translatedText: In the morning, I left the Hilton Hotel and loaded my luggage into the station wagon. Today I am heading to the Niagara Falls area. The journey is long, and on the way, the travel agency arranged two visit points. The first stop was Hershey's Chocolate World (Hershey's Chocolate World), and the second stop was the Corning Glass Center (Corning Glass Center). After a while, the car arrived in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, and stopped at the square of Hearst Chocolate World. We got off the car to visit. The weather was cool and everyone was happy. Chocolate is a transliterated noun, also called chocolate. This product has a deep ocher color. I think Cantonese people translate it as chocolate, which includes the meaning of pigments and is more appropriate and expressive than the name chocolate. In order to cherish precious time, Tour Guide Chen introduced the history of this famous chocolate factory in detail in the car. The factory was established in the 19th century. The founder Hearst was born and raised here. At that time, the price of chocolate was high and it was difficult for the poor to enjoy it. He also liked eating these sweet and delicious candies very much, and determined to learn how to make them and produce them widely. Finally, he got his wish. A factory was built in this small town, and the sales of his products were increasing. He was in the town. Apartments, schools, libraries, hospitals and theaters are built here to allow employees to live a stable life. He has no children, so he generously donates the money he earns to charitable organizations, "take it from the society, use it for the society?", adopt children from poor families and orphans, and provide books and education. When they grow up, they can enter the factory for employment. He truly "does good and is the happiest." Hershey's famous brand products: delicious and sweet candy chocolate, are sold in stores all over the United States. This first visit in person is an opportunity to follow the classic travel itinerary of the Eastern United States. The decoration of Hearst's Chocolate World is very beautiful and eye-catching. The building outside the main entrance is three stories high, ranging from wide to narrow. The top floor is a clock with Roman numerals, which has a classical charm; the signboard is placed on the spacious low-rise lintel, with three types of different shapes of chocolate patterns, like the humor of Disney cartoons, sweetly welcoming guests. A group of 22 of us went inside to visit and boarded a reading car specially set up by the company. The slowly rotating seats were similar to the operation of a cable car. They shuttled through the factory. Visitors could sit and watch everywhere, and they could see the entire process of automated production. The raw material of chocolate is cocoa beans. It was originally added with water and spices as a drink, and later added with sugar and cocoa butter to become chewable hard lumps. We now watch in sequence the process of first squeezing into liquid, stirring, then condensing into lumps, and finally packaging, all of which are mechanically automated. We rarely see workers. After going around for a while, we have to leave the train in a hurry, because the train does not stop completely and only slows down when it is approaching the station. The place where you get off the bus is the lively sales area, which is crowded with people. Everyone is busy buying their favorite products and letting their families taste them when they go back. Some people say there is no need to buy it here when you can buy it everywhere in shopping malls outside. There are still two days to travel, a long way to go, a plane ride, and the hassle of going through security checks. But most people think this is an authentic company, and the products are guaranteed to be genuine, so they will buy more or less if they get the chance. Then I went outside to take photos and videos. The surrounding scenery was beautiful, and there were images of chocolate everywhere. There was also a theme amusement park. I heard that it had a zoo, a botanical garden, a roller coaster and water entertainment. Unfortunately, due to time constraints, I couldn't enjoy it to the fullest. Say goodbye to Hearst Chocolate World and continue to the Corning Glass Center. After walking for a while, we have to solve the food problem first. We stop at Wenmans Wenmans Mall for lunch. This shopping mall is huge, with a vegetable and meat market, clothing stores, and handicraft boutiques. When you step into the main entrance and turn right, you will find a vast dining area, where you can find a variety of Chinese and Western restaurants, all delicious and mouth-watering. The stall at the front is Japanese sushi, opposite is pizza pizza. Inside is a buffet, with hamburgers on the side, coffee, green tea, ice cream, etc. After eating and drinking enough, go to the market and buy some biscuits for breakfast.

e3be13c7247633a86fb23d4c4ee1024a97f9d0e3.sourceText: 吃饱了，购买了干粮，再参观康宁玻璃中心，比较轻松愉快。该中心位于一个 简洁高雅的小城，格调独特，在纽约州内，是美国玻璃工业的中心。近代玻璃器材 进步神速，玻璃技术进展惊人，光纤的发明更是令人咋舌，目前用于通信中的光纤 主要就是玻璃纤维。 这个康宁玻璃中心，也是玻璃制品博物馆，可以欣赏很多美丽又具巧思的玻 璃制品展示，有人物，水果，花木 … … 光彩灿烂，晶莹剔透，整体布置充满魔幻境 界，间隔墙壁，屏风与地面砖块，都是玻璃工艺的杰作，令人叹为观止。游客还可 以轮流进入高温的玻璃熔炉厂房，亲眼目睹整个制作过程。 我自少在玻璃厂当童工，用细长的圆钢管往炉中挠绕玻璃熔液出来吹气，用铁 钳子间口或拉剪，已经是古老的手法，对我来说并不新奇，但所有设施皆革新，制 造技巧则先进得多，毕竟，在时间上相隔了整个甲子，当然大有进展。不过最引起 我的注意，反而是那位站在炉边讲解工匠吹制情况的老美，竟然说的是中国普通 话，让人佩服。 参观完精美的玻璃艺术中心，有些团友也购买一些细小的玻璃精致产品，或回家摆设，或做手信赠品。 旅游车又继续开行，前往尼加拉瀑布，预计在下午时刻到达目的地。
e3be13c7247633a86fb23d4c4ee1024a97f9d0e3.translatedText: After eating, I bought some dry food and then visited the Corning Glass Center, which was more relaxing and enjoyable. The center is located in a simple and elegant small town with unique style. It is the center of the American glass industry in New York State. Modern glass equipment has made rapid progress, glass technology has made astonishing progress, and the invention of optical fiber is even more staggering. The optical fiber currently used in communications is mainly glass fiber. The Corning Glass Center is also a museum of glass products. You can enjoy many beautiful and ingenious glass displays, including figures, fruits, flowers and trees... They are brilliant and crystal clear. The overall layout is full of magical realm. The partition walls, screens and floor tiles are all masterpieces of glass craftsmanship, which is breathtaking. Visitors can also take turns entering the high-temperature glass furnace building to witness the entire production process with their own eyes. I have been a child laborer in a glass factory since I was a child. I used slender round steel pipes to twist the molten glass into the furnace to blow air out of it, and used iron pliers to cut or pull and shear. These are already ancient techniques and are not new to me. However, all the facilities have been innovative, and the manufacturing techniques are much more advanced. After all, we are separated by a whole century in time, so of course there has been great progress. But what caught my attention the most was the old beauty who stood by the fire and explained the craftsmen's blowing conditions. She actually spoke Chinese Mandarin, which is admirable. After visiting the exquisite glass art center, some group members also bought some small exquisite glass products, either for display at home or as souvenirs. The tourist bus continued its journey to Niagara Falls and was expected to arrive at its destination in the afternoon.

3c702b4133d7510e8dcd1f85b920178822b33f22.sourceText: 我所知在侨乡的一些腐败 佳叔 旧时四邑的华侨出国多年千辛万苦，节衣缩食，才积累到一些钱，好不容易才返回乡做三件事：建屋；买田；嫁女或娶媳妇。因为经济缘故，很多人只能返一次，但经常有大量侨汇进入侨乡。他们汇回和带回的美币可换数倍的金额，从而对侨乡的经济起了极大促进。 侨乡的繁荣而衍生出一种社会现状，华侨因与家人聚少离多，生下的儿女，大多有娘生，无爹教。华侨子女惯养溺爱，产生一批执袴子弟叫纨裤子弟。他们终日食饱懒做，游手好闲的人。我们侨乡有句”牛耕田，马食榖，老 窦（父）赚钱仔享福”民谣，这正是侨乡当年真实写照。 现在侨乡子弟腐败情形更甚，由于港澳与内地地缘关系，很多港澳侨乡回乡捐款或投资建设，频繁出入和很多四邑新移民回国探亲会友，所以很多侨汇涌入，带来侨乡经济繁荣各行兴盛。如茶楼，食肄，五星酒家，高楼洋房，金银首饰，绫纙绸缎店到处林立。 在另方面，侨汇经济带来负面腐败风化,在侨乡台山和开平，因黑道横行，勾结官僚，殴打抢劫，屡见不鲜，烟赌林立为供食肄。要末不少人明目张胆开动电力摩托，上农村偷狗偷猫，在学校引诱少年入会卖毒或交会费，无法无天。 佳叔有位侨乡朋友，他的孙儿在学校被黑社会迫入会要交会费，有次给爷爷追问下才得真相。当爷爷和那些黑社会人交涉，惹上被人打伤头部，叫来公安拉人，可是，翌日那个被拉的人又在街头重操故技。 又，佳叔有位村中兄弟，在村中聚赌，被公安部人员渗入拉人，罚款三千元，不经法院审判，不用发收据。 佳叔早几年回乡，遇到两位县府官员，一位是芝麻细小的文官，他向佳叔打听想用投资条件移民去美国。另一位是公安人，他说去过几次美国，走遍旧金山，洛杉矶，维斯域加市，纽约等。哪处好玩，哪处好食，说到口沫横飞。当佳叔没有到，奇怪，在侨乡做个芝麻绿豆小官的钱从哪里来呢?
3c702b4133d7510e8dcd1f85b920178822b33f22.translatedText: Some corruption in the hometown of overseas Chinese Uncle Jia In the old days, the overseas Chinese in Siyi went abroad for many years and worked hard and scrimped on food and clothing before they accumulated some money. After much difficulty, they returned to their hometown to do three things: build a house, buy a field, and marry a daughter or a wife. Due to economic reasons, many people can only return once, but a large amount of overseas remittances often flow into their hometowns. The U.S. dollars they remitted and brought back could be exchanged for several times the amount, which greatly promoted the economy of the overseas Chinese hometown. The prosperity of overseas Chinese hometowns has led to a social status quo. Overseas Chinese have less time with their families and are more separated from each other. Most of the children they have are born to their mothers and not to their fathers. Overseas Chinese children are pampered and pampered, resulting in a group of children who stick to their clothes and are called dandy boys. They are lazy and idle people who are full of food all day long. There is a folk saying in our hometown of overseas Chinese, "Cows plow the fields, horses eat grains, Old Dou (father) makes money and his children enjoy happiness." This is a true portrayal of the hometown of overseas Chinese in those days. Nowadays, the situation of corruption among the children of overseas Chinese is even worse. Due to the geographical relationship between Hong Kong and Macao and the mainland, many overseas Chinese from Hong Kong and Macao return to their hometowns to donate money or invest in construction. They travel frequently and many new immigrants from Siyi return to visit relatives and friends. Therefore, a lot of overseas remittances pour in, which brings economic prosperity to all walks of life in the hometown of overseas Chinese. Such as teahouses, restaurants, five-star restaurants, high-rise bungalows, gold and silver jewelry, and silk and satin shops are everywhere. On the other hand, the remittance economy has brought about a negative culture of corruption. In Taishan and Kaiping, the hometowns of overseas Chinese, gangsters are rampant, colluding with bureaucrats, beatings and robberies are common, and cigarettes and gambling are everywhere. Or many people blatantly drive electric motorcycles, go to rural areas to steal dogs and cats, and lure teenagers to join gangs in schools to sell drugs or pay membership fees, which is lawless. Uncle Jia has a friend from his hometown. His grandson was forced by the underworld to join a gang at school and had to pay membership fees. Once, he asked his grandpa to find out the truth. When my grandfather negotiated with those gangsters, he was hit on the head and the police were called to pull him away. However, the next day, the man who was pulled away was back to his old tricks on the street. Also, Uncle Jia had a brother from the village who was gathering for gambling in the village. He was infiltrated by the Ministry of Public Security and arrested. He was fined 3,000 yuan without going through a court trial or issuing a receipt. Uncle Jia returned to his hometown a few years ago and met two county officials. One was a small civil servant. He asked Uncle Jia about immigrating to the United States using investment conditions. Another person is a police officer. He said he has been to the United States several times, including San Francisco, Los Angeles, West Virginia, New York, etc. Which places are fun and which places are good to eat? Talk about it and you will be frothing at the mouth. When Uncle Jia didn't arrive, I was wondering, where did the money come from to be a minor official in the hometown of overseas Chinese?

f671d677a39efbd90859d0c586def23528d77d6d.sourceText: 洛杉矶古冬：龙舟与作家 一 龙舟来了 外国人也许还不大会欣赏我们的粽子，但龙舟的鼓声，已咚咚的在外洋响起。 谁也没有见过龙，不过龙几乎是我们的图腾，它代表着一种精神，一种力量，是神秘、神武、神圣的象征。因此我们自诩为龙的传人，并竭力以种种形式试图把它形象化。可惜至目前为止，能栩栩如生地将之雕塑出来的，似乎只有龙舟而已。连中秋和新年的舞龙，也是稍欠完美。端午赛龙就不同，不仅是一种表演，更是一种竞技。一艘制作精巧的龙船，在碧波上轻轻摆荡，已然神气十足，唬唬生威，一俟锣鼓敲响，百桨齐挥，人们立即为之振奋，为之欢呼喝彩。原因除了造形独特之外，主要的，还在于那份来自整体的心和力的展现。因为只要其中一个人分了神，乱了拍，龙舟马上就落后，就可能翻侧，勇士们甚至会掉进海里去。龙舟就是凭着这种神奇的力量，勇猛地闯进外国的海域，并为外国人所欣赏，而渐渐成为一项别开生面的群众性体育运动。可以说，这是中国文化一次最特殊、最成功的输出，也是龙的精神一次最凸出、最精彩的发挥。 二 惭愧 讲到龙文化，不由使人想到文学。有些海外华文作家，干脆自称文化人，甚至 自命为文化使者，是弘扬中华文明的旗手。不过其实，作家们能做点什么，或可以从中得到点什么，大家都了然于胸。我们的脸皮太薄，不大愿意提及不太光彩的事，可惜别人并未因为这样就对我们额外开恩。如不久前洛杉矶有个书画联展，请了不少名人来为开幕礼剪彩，大家在书与画之间寒暄酬应，场面不知多么温馨热闹，可就是没有一个人正眼瞧一瞧身边的展品！作为作家协会的会长，我感触殊多，恨不得逐一扯住他们的衣角，恳求说：请看看我们的作品啦！那么，文学是否真的沦落了？我想应当说，好的作品，如好的小说和剧本，还是有人看、有人买的。中国和美国，都出了不少响当当的作家，不行的，恐怕就是我们这几个平庸之辈而已。原因许多，致命的有两个，一个是市场有问题，一个是我们自己有问题。市场问题我们虽然无能为力，至少还可以设法迎合一下，自已的问​​题就怕是咎由自取，自作自受了。以洛杉矶为例，所谓作家也者，打响锣来找，也不出七、八十个人，可是类似作家协会的组织，竟有五、六个之多！这已经是个大笑话，我们还不知自重，老在你们怎么怎么、我们怎么怎么的，不是互相攻讦，就是自我标榜。如此的不「文」，又如何教人瞧得起你呢！ 这些都属于后天失调，再加上先天不足，就真是无可救药了。原来不论说得多么冠冕堂皇，当初搞这一类组织的人，多少就有点小圈子的意味，目的外想把一些志趣相投的朋友拉到一块来，无聊时可以互相吹吹牛皮。到后来，当一些人发觉和另一些人合不来，要另起炉灶，也就无可厚非。问题是，分庭而仍能相对行礼的，又有几个人做得到呢？ 谢天谢地，洛杉矶、圣谷和拉斯维加斯终于传来了喜讯：三个作家协会联手搞起特刊来了！这样的好事，但愿会如三水佬看走马灯——陆续有来！特记之。
f671d677a39efbd90859d0c586def23528d77d6d.translatedText: Los Angeles Gudong: Dragon Boats and Writers 1 The Dragon Boats are Coming Foreigners may not appreciate our rice dumplings yet, but the sound of dragon boat drums has been heard overseas. No one has ever seen a dragon, but the dragon is almost our totem. It represents a spirit, a kind of power, and is a symbol of mystery, power, and sanctity. Therefore, we call ourselves the descendants of the dragon and try our best to visualize it in various forms. Unfortunately, so far, only dragon boats seem to be the only ones that can sculpt it lifelikely. Even the dragon dances during the Mid-Autumn Festival and New Year are a little less than perfect. The Dragon Boat Festival is different. It is not only a performance, but also a competition. An exquisitely crafted dragon boat swayed gently on the blue waves, already full of air and power. As soon as the gongs and drums sounded and hundreds of oars were waved, people were immediately excited and cheered for it. In addition to the unique shape, the main reason lies in the display of heart and strength from the whole. Because as long as one of them is distracted and takes pictures randomly, the dragon boat will fall behind immediately, it may overturn, and the warriors may even fall into the sea. It is with this magical power that dragon boats bravely break into foreign waters and are appreciated by foreigners, and gradually become a unique mass sport. It can be said that this is the most special and successful export of Chinese culture, and it is also the most outstanding and wonderful display of the dragon spirit. 2. Ashamed When talking about dragon culture, people can’t help but think of literature. Some overseas Chinese-language writers simply call themselves intellectuals, or even claim to be cultural messengers and standard-bearers for promoting Chinese civilization. But in fact, everyone knows what writers can do or get from it. We are too thin-skinned and reluctant to mention the less honorable things, but unfortunately others do not show extra kindness to us because of this. For example, there was a joint exhibition of calligraphy and painting in Los Angeles not long ago. Many celebrities were invited to cut the ribbon for the opening ceremony. Everyone chatted and socialized among the books and paintings. The scene was so warm and lively, but no one took a serious look at the exhibits around them! As the president of the Writers Association, I feel so much that I can’t wait to grab their clothes one by one and plead: Please take a look at our works! So, has literature really declined? I think it should be said that good works, such as good novels and scripts, are still read and bought by people. Both China and the United States have produced many well-known writers. The ones who are not good are probably mediocre people like us. There are many reasons, but there are two fatal ones: one is a problem in the market, and the other is a problem within ourselves. Although there is nothing we can do about market problems, we can at least try to cater to them. We are afraid that we are to blame for our own problems. Take Los Angeles as an example. If you ring the gong and look for so-called writers, there are only seventy or eighty of them. However, there are as many as five or six organizations similar to the Writers Guild! This is already a big joke. We still don’t know how to respect ourselves. We are always doing what you do and what we do. We are either criticizing each other or flaunting ourselves. How can you teach people to think highly of you if you are so uncivilized? These are acquired disorders, coupled with congenital deficiencies, it is really hopeless. It turns out that no matter how high-sounding the words are, the people who started this type of organization were somewhat of a small circle. The purpose was not only to bring some friends with similar interests together so that they could brag to each other when they were bored. Later, when some people find that they can't get along with others and want to start a new one, there is nothing wrong with it. The question is, how many people can do this when they are in separate courts and can still bow to each other? Thank God, good news finally came from Los Angeles, the Sacred Valley, and Las Vegas: the three writers’ associations have joined forces to create a special issue! I hope such good things will come one after another like Sanshui Lao watching a revolving lantern! Special note.

7a4341090dbe53d593a022d6fbafc641b44d767f.sourceText: 你的旧金首饰到底值多少钱？ （亚省时报） CNN Money刊登的文章说，看到黄金价格不断创新高，电视里总是有”收购金首饰”的广告，你是否也想卖掉一些早已不戴的首饰呢？你是否想知道到底这些首饰值多少钱？ 比如Yvette Shirey决定卖掉一些旧首饰，包括一条项链，一些耳环和手镯。她将这些首饰送到一家珠宝店，得到了一千美元。虽然这些首饰有感情价值，但是作为一名失业人士，钱比首饰对她更有用。 对于很多美国人来讲，旧金首饰成了一个经济来源。上星期黄金达到每盎司1600美元的价位，创立了新高。不少人也趁这个机会卖出旧首饰。 不过，Better Business Bureau(简称BBB)提醒消费者在出售旧首饰时小心被骗，目前BBB已经收到对不少收购贵金属店的投诉，在2011年里已经有416个案例。 不论你是将首饰卖给网络上的收购店还是本地珠宝店，你都应该先了解这些首饰到底值多少钱。金饰的重量和纯度决定其价值。10K金由42%的黄金和58%的其它金属组成；14K金中含真金是58%；18K金中含75%的金。因此，一件14K的金首饰应该值928美元，就是58% X $1600 (目前黄金的市场价)；当然买主不一定肯出那么高的价格，他们通常会出价550美元到750美元之间。如果买主不肯出这样的价格，那么消费者就要小心了。 Chubb Personal Insurance的副总Janece White说，珠宝店应该告诉你每盎司或者每克的价格是多少。然后你还应该多走几个店比较。除了货比三家外，消费者应选择卖给本地的名誉比较好的珠宝店。消费者可以到BBB网站去查一下珠宝店的名誉，看看有没有其它消费者的投诉。 另外，消费者还应该注意的是： 1. 了解自己的首饰的重量：计量方法是每盎司的黄金等于31.3克，有些收购站会在重量上做手脚； 2. 清楚首饰的纯度，是10K，14K还是18K，以免上当受骗； 3. 要了解市场上的黄金价格，以保证自己得到公平的收购价格。
7a4341090dbe53d593a022d6fbafc641b44d767f.translatedText: How much is your old gold jewelry worth? (Alberta Times) An article published by CNN Money said that as the price of gold continues to hit new highs, and there are always advertisements on TV to "buy gold jewelry," do you also want to sell some jewelry that you no longer wear? Have you ever wondered how much these pieces of jewelry are worth? For example, Yvette Shirey decided to sell some old jewelry, including a necklace, some earrings and bracelets. She sent the pieces to a jewelry store and was paid a thousand dollars. Although the jewelry has sentimental value, as an unemployed person, money is more useful to her than jewelry. For many Americans, old gold jewelry has become a source of income. Last week gold reached a price of $1,600 an ounce, setting a new high. Many people also took this opportunity to sell their old jewelry. However, the Better Business Bureau (BBB) ​​reminds consumers to be careful of being deceived when selling old jewelry. Currently, the BBB has received complaints about many stores that buy precious metals. In 2011, there have been 416 cases. Whether you're selling your jewelry to an online buyout store or to a local jewelry store, you should first know how much the jewelry is worth. The weight and purity of gold jewelry determine its value. 10K gold is composed of 42% gold and 58% other metals; 14K gold contains 58% real gold; 18K gold contains 75% gold. Therefore, a piece of 14K gold jewelry should be worth $928, which is 58% If buyers are unwilling to pay such a price, then consumers should be careful. Janece White, vice president of Chubb Personal Insurance, said jewelry stores should tell you how much it costs per ounce or gram. Then you should visit a few more stores to compare. In addition to shopping around, consumers should choose to sell to local jewelry stores with a better reputation. Consumers can go to the BBB website to check the reputation of the jewelry store and see if there are any complaints from other consumers. In addition, consumers should also pay attention to the following: 1. Understand the weight of their jewelry: the measurement method is that each ounce of gold is equal to 31.3 grams, and some purchasing stations will manipulate the weight; 2. Know the purity of the jewelry, whether it is 10K, 14K or 18K, to avoid being deceived; 3. Understand the gold price in the market to ensure that you get a fair purchase price.

48aa7e073f8b43ec8e0939eb900a230e5a62dd08.sourceText: 凤凰城儿童博物馆位于鳯凰城市中心区，是一座三层楼高的建筑。 建于1913年，曾是一座小学和其它用途的楼宇。 2007年改建，有太多太多的人为这座博物馆贡献创意和作义工，其中有许多具有时代意义和内涵的设施，其实用性、启蒙性和环保概念，都十分值得带小孩去领略、游乐 、学习和欣赏。 博物馆的主旨是让儿童本身作为主角，让孩童充分自我肯定，通过对种种游戏，设备的操作，启发出自身的潜能和创造性。 这里绝大部分的游乐器具都属于原创，很多艺术品来自日常生活的用品，出其不意，又十分传神，令人拍案叫绝。 譬如向15000个学童征集到的CD光碟、用义工捐出的旧鞋、匙、叉、衣物等等，创造了各式各样的动、植物，不但神似，也十分活灵活现。 用塑胶管、工具等创作的各种乐器也可奏出另类音乐。 还有，包括小小厨房，小小杂货店，油漆仿等，让儿童去作主角，他们都十分投入，也十分享受这种工作过程。 不同年龄的孩童都会在其中找到属于自我世界的天地，他们都玩得十分开心，连父辈爷辈也能乐在其中，可预期，越来越多的父母亲将会带孩子到儿童博物馆来。 该场馆还提供场地举办生日派对，甚至可包下房子来为儿童庆祝生日。 侨联主席邓朝驹是这座儿童博物馆的唯一华裔董事。 9月10日，华人社区领导及中文学校负责人去参观了博物馆。 馆长带领大家参观和专门讲解，现场气氛热烈，耆英会主席崔增祁对馆长说，按照我们的中华传统文化，我们这些六七十岁的老人，减去一甲子，其实也是孩童，所以会带公公 婆婆来参观学习。 馆长十分惊奇，中国人这种年龄层面的概念十分有智慧。 她们非常欢迎华人华裔一齐带儿童来博物馆参观和游乐。 凤城儿童博物馆网址: www.childrensmuseumofphoenix.org 。
48aa7e073f8b43ec8e0939eb900a230e5a62dd08.translatedText: The Phoenix Children's Museum is located in the center of Phoenix City. It is a three-story building. Built in 1913, it served as a primary school and other buildings. It was renovated in 2007. There are so many people who have contributed creativity and volunteers to this museum. There are many facilities with contemporary significance and connotation. Their practicality, enlightenment and environmental protection concepts are very worthy of taking children to experience, play, learn and appreciate. The purpose of the museum is to allow children to be the protagonists, to fully affirm themselves, and to inspire their own potential and creativity through the operation of various games and equipment. Most of the amusement equipment here are original, and many of the artworks come from daily necessities. They are unexpected, vivid, and amazing. For example, CDs were collected from 15,000 school children, and old shoes, spoons, forks, clothes, etc. donated by volunteers were used to create a variety of animals and plants, which are not only similar in appearance, but also very vivid. Various musical instruments created using plastic pipes, tools, etc. can also play alternative music. Also, including a small kitchen, a small grocery store, paint imitation, etc., children were allowed to be the protagonists. They were very involved and enjoyed this kind of work process. Children of different ages will find their own world in it, and they all have a great time. Even their parents can enjoy it. It is expected that more and more parents will bring their children to the Children's Museum. The venue also offers space for birthday parties and can even book out the house to celebrate children's birthdays. Deng Chaoju, chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, is the only Chinese director of this children's museum. On September 10, Chinese community leaders and Chinese school leaders visited the museum. The curator led everyone to visit and gave special explanations. The atmosphere was warm. Cui Zengqi, chairman of the Senior Citizens Association, told the curator that according to our traditional Chinese culture, those of us in our 60s and 70s are still children minus a year, so we will bring our parents-in-law to visit and study. The curator was very surprised that the Chinese people are very wise in their concept of age. They very much welcome Chinese people to bring their children to visit and play in the museum. Fengcheng Children’s Museum website: www.childrensmuseumofphoenix.org.

81882464fbc48dd5af21559fcdadd0db7f976ef3.sourceText: 新闻周刊：中国梦将产生深远影响
81882464fbc48dd5af21559fcdadd0db7f976ef3.translatedText: Newsweek: The Chinese Dream will have a far-reaching impact

33cc71dedcfcfe68acd2d3e0cbceea8289456cc2.sourceText: 新闻周刊：中国梦将产生深远影响 美国《新闻周刊》12月30日刊发原题为中国的伟大梦想的文章： 对长期习…
33cc71dedcfcfe68acd2d3e0cbceea8289456cc2.translatedText: Newsweek: The Chinese Dream will have a far-reaching impact. The US Newsweek published an article originally titled China's Great Dream on December 30: For the long-term Xi...

91f4709d302f9f7faab4d7f79667031c2ebd4278.sourceText: 对长期习惯官方庄严盛大场面的中国民众而言，中共新一届领导人展现出的轻松气氛着实出乎预料。来自中共高层的信息很明确：实干兴邦。
91f4709d302f9f7faab4d7f79667031c2ebd4278.translatedText: For the Chinese people who have long been accustomed to official solemn and grand occasions, the relaxed atmosphere displayed by the new leaders of the Communist Party of China is really unexpected. The message from the top leadership of the CCP is clear: hard work will make the country prosperous.

d0d2fdfae9b807c4b2e5b864cf918e3ff568af15.sourceText: 在打击腐败和减少官员排场及官僚作风的同时，习近平还鼓励民众追逐中华民族的伟大复兴和最伟大的中国梦。至少从某些关键领域来看，习近平准备改变中国的经济和政治改革现状。如果持续下去，这些变化将对国内外产生深远影响。
d0d2fdfae9b807c4b2e5b864cf918e3ff568af15.translatedText: While cracking down on corruption and reducing official pomp and bureaucracy, Xi Jinping also encourages the people to pursue the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation and the greatest Chinese dream. At least in some key areas, Xi Jinping is poised to change China’s economic and political reform status quo. If sustained, these changes will have far-reaching consequences at home and abroad.

f50e1800c2915b011618619e30d5e3332804985d.sourceText: 最近几周，大量地方官员相继落马表明中纪委确实重视反腐行动。北京正准备实施更多实质性的变革。习近平还承诺加强法治建设并表示：我们要依法公正对待人民群众的诉求，努力让人民群众在每一个司法案件中都能感受到公平正义。
f50e1800c2915b011618619e30d5e3332804985d.translatedText: In recent weeks, a large number of local officials have been sacked, indicating that the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection really takes the anti-corruption campaign seriously. Beijing is preparing to implement more substantive changes. Xi Jinping also promised to strengthen the rule of law and said: We must treat the people's demands fairly and in accordance with the law, and strive to make the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case.

a995853fe3135696068f86854c0f9da94b90fd9d.sourceText: 习近平有关民族复兴和中国梦的讲话引起中国公众的关注。中国人民大学的周孝正教授将此解读为对实施改革，摒弃文革的（意识形态）理论，努力工作和重振中国光辉史的一种捍卫。然而，在外部世界看来，此中存在一个大问题：中国梦的确切含义是什么？这种说法具有极强的象征意义但缺乏细节。北京理工大学的胡星斗认为，中国梦不同于关注个人成就的美国梦，我们主要强调国家实力和尊严。
a995853fe3135696068f86854c0f9da94b90fd9d.translatedText: Xi Jinping’s speech on national rejuvenation and the Chinese dream aroused the attention of the Chinese public. Professor Zhou Xiaozheng of Renmin University of China interpreted this as a defense of implementing reforms, abandoning the (ideological) theory of the Cultural Revolution, working hard and reviving China's glorious history. To the outside world, however, there's a big question: What exactly does the Chinese Dream mean? This statement is highly symbolic but lacking in detail. Hu Xingdou of Beijing Institute of Technology believes that the Chinese Dream is different from the American Dream that focuses on personal achievement. We mainly emphasize national strength and dignity.

7967dff117945ccea1e592ebd658c1d0ec5a702b.sourceText: 即便中国新一届领导层能重塑公众信心，也无法破除外部世界对中国梦含义的担忧。民间与日俱增的民族主义情绪，迫使北京在与日本等国的领土争端中日益强硬。这些摩擦恰逢华盛顿重新转向亚洲。美国在该地区的存在已激起中国人的民族主义情绪，清华大学国际问题研究所的赵可金表示，中国并不认为将与美国进行一场新冷战，但美国应该说明为何发展与缅泰柬等国的关系。否则，人们可能认为美国想要遏制中国。
7967dff117945ccea1e592ebd658c1d0ec5a702b.translatedText: Even if China’s new leadership can restore public confidence, it will not be able to eliminate the concerns of the outside world about the meaning of the Chinese Dream. Growing nationalist sentiment among the people has forced Beijing to become increasingly assertive in territorial disputes with Japan and other countries. These frictions coincide with Washington's renewed pivot to Asia. The U.S. presence in the region has aroused nationalist sentiments among the Chinese. Zhao Kejin of Tsinghua University's Institute of International Studies said China does not believe it will engage in a new Cold War with the United States, but the United States should explain why it is developing relations with countries such as Myanmar, Thailand, and Cambodia. Otherwise, people may think that the United States wants to contain China.

3017d8eddb44e1fc2b379511ce76341aeb900805.sourceText: 莫非矜而不争的我这么早就要写自己的回忆录了吗？莫非泰而不骄的我要不得不表扬自己了吗？
3017d8eddb44e1fc2b379511ce76341aeb900805.translatedText: Could it be that I am so reserved and uncompetitive that I want to write my own memoirs so early? Do I have to praise myself for being humble but not arrogant?

7342ea4d01fba9307e9620c0c79078461a398da3.sourceText: 认识我的人都知道，我只是个普通人，处世清淡，有些愤世嫉俗，喜欢简单随性的自由生活。但因为嫁给了方舟子，我也显得”特殊”起来。
7342ea4d01fba9307e9620c0c79078461a398da3.translatedText: Everyone who knows me knows that I am just an ordinary person, simple in life, somewhat cynical, and like to live a simple and free life. But because I am married to Fang Zhouzi, I also seem "special".

44abdb47d239e6da61c9b94109c4499198e75e73.sourceText: 从十年前起，各种关于我的谣言就开始在方黑网上传播了，没有丝毫根据，完全瞎编，又污秽又弱智，他们自己人都不当回事棗今天却有人说这是”质疑”，有一点点常识没有？随着方舟子得罪的人越来越多，醉心于此的人也越来越多。这是一种网络暴力，但我早就说过，把这种暴力用在电脑键盘上比用在羊角锤上更让我安心。最近，这些谣言忽然爆发了，越臭气熏天越离谱越有人转。前几天有个网名得意洋洋地说：”她还用抹黑吗？她早就和乌鸦一样黑了。”呵呵，本人倒不在意别人看我有多黑，下场雨，谁黑谁白就一清二楚了，只是时间的问题。所以我一直不屑和网上的各种谣言以及谣言的孙子做斗争。
44abdb47d239e6da61c9b94109c4499198e75e73.translatedText: Since ten years ago, all kinds of rumors about me have been spreading on Fanghei.com. They have no basis at all, are completely made up, are filthy and retarded, and none of them take them seriously. But today, some people say this is a "question". Do you have any common sense? As Fang Zhouzi offended more and more people, more and more people became obsessed with it. This is a form of cyberbullying, but as I've long said, I feel more at ease when this kind of violence is used on a computer keyboard than with a claw hammer. Recently, these rumors suddenly broke out, and the more stinky and outrageous they became, the more people spread them. A few days ago, an internet user said proudly: "Does she still use slander? She has long been as black as a crow." Haha, I don't care how black others see me. When it rains, it will be clear who is black and who is white. It's just a matter of time. So I have never bothered to fight against various rumors and rumors on the Internet.

e5e08d774d476c1e35fc3696c91dc5fdcbaa3587.sourceText: 我不是也无意于成为一个公众人物，但树欲静而风不止。虽然我喜欢安静自由的生活，若真有恶风恶雨，我也不怕。待到雪化时，更见松高洁呀。陶世龙老先生今天在微博上说：”这类造谣攻击，在’虹桥科教论坛’、西安翻译学院及其校友网和扬子晚报网上早有出现，是在毒化社会。我一直主张严加追究，不要受君子不与小人斗的影响。”既然一切谣言的目的都是要败坏方舟子的声誉，这使得我又有了公开说几句的必要。下面我要如实自夸了啊。
e5e08d774d476c1e35fc3696c91dc5fdcbaa3587.translatedText: I am not and do not intend to become a public figure, but the tree wants to be quiet but the wind does not stop. Although I like a quiet and free life, I am not afraid if there is bad wind and rain. When the snow melts, you can see the high and clean pines. Mr. Tao Shilong said on Weibo today: "Such rumors and attacks have long appeared in the Hongqiao Science and Education Forum, Xi'an Translation College and its alumni network, and the Yangtze Evening News. They are poisoning society. I have always advocated strict investigation and should not be affected by the fact that a gentleman does not fight against villains." Since the purpose of all rumors is to ruin Fang Zhouzi's reputation, this makes it necessary for me to say something publicly. Now I am going to brag truthfully.

face2d66c1fdc6d65328d232115ea217d1ac229f.sourceText: 首先，”初中没毕业当保姆”，这个故事是怎么第一次从某个黑方编剧家脑子里冒出来的？是不是因为我的名字土？再土也是父母给的，寄托了老人家的期望，我自己很珍视，就这么着吧。
face2d66c1fdc6d65328d232115ea217d1ac229f.translatedText: First of all, how did this story "Become a nanny before graduating from junior high school" first come from the mind of a certain black screenwriter? Is it because my name is stupid? No matter how hard it is, it was given to me by my parents, and it placed the expectations of the elderly on it. I value it very much, so let’s just live with it.

6a54324a5883feed652a153de7d8010e719bd9f6.sourceText: 咱好歹从小被称为才女，还是特有思想的那种棗顺便说一句，谁小时候没装过深沉？但本才女绝对装不出中年妇女的阅历和腔调。遥想少年时，咱作为理科女，全年级第一舍我其谁，高考前贪玩不小心得了全年级第二那都是意外。本科自己作主，读了文理兼收的哲学系，因为我那时崇拜的作家几乎全是哲学出身。当是时也，咱高等数学和数理逻辑那叫一个顶哌哌棗因为好多同学觉得太难了，本才女却经常跷课还一考就考个九十多分。话说回来，智商不高也欣赏不了方舟子，哈哈。本人本科毕业论文”才情可见”（论文指导老师语），不小心得了个优秀棗这点我在《问心无愧》里就说过了，但方黑视而不见，愣歪曲成我说自己的硕士论文优秀，其黑手法可见一斑。
6a54324a5883feed652a153de7d8010e719bd9f6.translatedText: After all, we have been called talented girls since we were young, and we are still the kind of people with unique ideas. By the way, who didn't pretend to be deep when they were young? But a talented woman can never pretend to have the experience and tone of a middle-aged woman. I think back to when I was a teenager. As a girl majoring in science, we were ranked first in the whole grade. Who else would be the first in the grade? It was all an accident that we were playful before the college entrance examination and accidentally ranked second in the grade. I made my own decision for my undergraduate degree and studied philosophy in a liberal arts and sciences department, because almost all the writers I admired at that time were from philosophy. At that time, our advanced mathematics and mathematical logic were criticized because many students found them too difficult, but talented women often skipped classes and scored over 90 points on the first test. Having said that, even if you don’t have a high IQ, you won’t be able to appreciate Fang Zhouzi, haha. My undergraduate thesis was "talent is visible" (the words of my thesis advisor), and I accidentally got an excellent date. I mentioned this in "A Clear Conscience", but Fang Hei turned a blind eye and distorted it into me saying that my master's thesis was excellent. His dirty tricks are evident.

f9075e0d4b52ac98c9cd3c69b99c24bd37e38e1a.sourceText: 好多网名要我晒大学毕业证，我就不晒。晒毕业证不是唯一的证明方式。智商不够或装煳涂，晒了也没用。智商够或会独立思考，用不着晒。如果我晒了，方黑岂不就有更多素材造新谣？我生性懒散，不喜与人争论，一向很少在网上留痕，所以方黑的资料搜集也就到这种程度了。什么搜搜百科、百度百科之类的，很多内容是根据方黑的素材弄的，错误一大堆，不靠谱。
f9075e0d4b52ac98c9cd3c69b99c24bd37e38e1a.translatedText: Many internet names want me to post my university diploma, but I won’t. Showing your diploma is not the only way to prove it. If you don't have enough IQ or you are pretending to be confused, it will be useless if you expose yourself to it. If you have enough IQ or can think independently, there is no need to show off. If I exposed it, wouldn’t Fang Hei have more material to make new rumors? I am lazy by nature and don't like to argue with others. I rarely leave any traces on the Internet, so Fang Hei's information collection can only go to this extent. A lot of content in Sosou Encyclopedia, Baidu Encyclopedia, etc. is based on Fang Hei's materials, and there are a lot of mistakes and unreliability.

0751b9d04fbfacdf3bdf97786fdabafc8baa5314.sourceText: 其次，作为一个太有思想的现代女性，在认识方舟子之前，我几乎没有谈过一场正儿八经的恋爱。我环顾四周，心目中的他影儿都不见，我甚至无望地想，那个人可能都还没出生，在这个世界上根本不存在。当时，寻找童话的方舟子也心如死灰，绝望地等待着他又美又纯的女孩。就这样，我们都抱着独身的念头相遇了，我发现了另外一个我自己，真是太喜欢他的诗文了。他的眼睛也足够灵光，也一眼认出了我，这是命定的重逢。
0751b9d04fbfacdf3bdf97786fdabafc8baa5314.translatedText: Secondly, as a very thoughtful modern woman, before I met Fang Zhouzi, I had almost never been in a serious relationship. I looked around, but there was no trace of him in my mind. I even thought hopelessly that that person might not have been born yet and did not exist in this world at all. At that time, Fang Zhouzi, who was looking for a fairy tale, was despairing and waiting desperately for his beautiful and pure girl. In this way, we both met with the idea of ​​being single, and I discovered another version of myself. I really liked his poetry. His eyes were bright enough and he recognized me at a glance. This was a fateful reunion.

1131e1edbd2be265cd390fa5ef4689001e489ff4.sourceText: 世上又美又纯的女孩，如果我不算，那就真没有了。孤标傲世偕谁隐，一样花开为底迟？棗为了执手方舟子，呵呵。这个人，五十年之后我们再看他。无论为他承受多少侮辱和谩骂，都值得。因为有了他，我的生活更美满幸福。因为支持他，我的生命更有意义。我家小宝宝，很爱很爱爸爸，她长大了，也必定会为爸爸感到自豪。
1131e1edbd2be265cd390fa5ef4689001e489ff4.translatedText: There are really no beautiful and pure girls in the world, if I don’t count them. Who can hide together with the lonely and proud people? Is it too late for the same flowers to bloom? Zao wanted to hold Fang Zhouzi’s hand, haha. Let’s look at this man again fifty years later. No matter how much insult and abuse I endured for him, it was all worth it. Because of him, my life is happier and happier. My life has more meaning because I support him. My little baby loves her father very much. When she grows up, she will definitely be proud of her father.

75670199ca7edb17ddaa047689955ff426734727.sourceText: 第三，我的家世清贫，很多年在社会的最底层挣扎，后来孩子们都陆续考上大学，状况才好一点。我的父亲一辈子没说过一句瞎话，一点处世之道都不懂，只知道什么是真，什么是善，只知道尽其所能急人之难、解人之困。他就像山里的一块石头，不通世故地朴实地过了一生，实心实意，历尽坎坷。去世时乡邻皆为之悲，自发来送葬，路过的人惊奇地问：”这是谁家的老人家？阵势这么大。”
75670199ca7edb17ddaa047689955ff426734727.translatedText: Thirdly, my family comes from a poor family and I struggled at the bottom of society for many years. Later, my children all went to college one after another, and the situation became better. My father has never told a lie in his life, and he doesn't understand any way of life. He only knows what is true and what is good, and he only knows how to alleviate people's difficulties and solve their difficulties to the best of his ability. He is like a stone in the mountains, living a simple life without any knowledge of the world, being sincere and sincere, and going through all the ups and downs. When he died, his neighbors were all grieved and spontaneously came to pay homage to him. People passing by were surprised and asked, "Whose old man is this? The battle was so huge."

ecffbe922144cb0f059942d5bdb378828aea9474.sourceText: 一归乡老翁尔。作为国民党起义过来的解放牌离休干部，父亲本来属于老家凤毛麟角的”人才”，但他的耿直和善良太不合时宜了，就和方舟子一样。后来他被平反了，去世时?#20139;受?#21103;处级工资。我一生中最重要的两个男人都是这样因无欲无求干干净净而不容于世，命耶？文革时，因为父亲不愿意昧着良心指控右派院长，被划为”右派的狗腿子”而遭到开除。以这样的身份回到家乡，生活的艰难可想而知。于是，父亲带着母亲，背着一卷铺盖跑去了新疆。我就是在新疆的戈壁荒滩疯长大的，至今怀念一排排大雁自由自在飞过秋日湛蓝洁净的天空，叫声清亮高远。网络上的喧嚣，对我都是过眼烟云。人生很短，怎么有时间做恶？那不是自己折磨自己吗？用那些造谣、害人的时间，去陪陪自己的孩子吧。
ecffbe922144cb0f059942d5bdb378828aea9474.translatedText: As soon as Old Weng Er returned home. As a retired cadre of the Jiefang brand after the Kuomintang uprising, my father was originally one of the rare "talents" in his hometown, but his uprightness and kindness were too out of place, just like Fang Zhouzi. Later he was rehabilitated and received a director-level salary when he died. The two most important men in my life are like this and are not allowed to live in the world because they have no desires and requirements. Are they destined to live in this world? During the Cultural Revolution, because his father was unwilling to accuse the right-wing dean without conscience, he was classified as a "right-wing dog legion" and was expelled. When you return to your hometown with this status, you can imagine how difficult life is. So, my father took my mother and ran to Xinjiang with a roll of bedding on their backs. I grew up in the Gobi Desert in Xinjiang, and I still miss the rows of wild geese flying freely across the clear blue sky in autumn, with their clear and high calls. The hustle and bustle on the Internet is just a passing thing to me. Life is short, how can you have time to do evil? Isn’t that torturing yourself? Use the time you spend spreading rumors and harming others to spend time with your children.

5645c976126a8dd2546beb892a2a1cde003f0f27.sourceText: 第四，关于硕士论文，我已经专门写过一篇《问心无愧》。我的态度没有变，不论此事结局如何，我都会全部笑纳。多说一句，在2002年，我那篇低水平的硕士论文，是一篇合格的硕士论文，社科院关于”全文文字复制比在40%以上（含40%）的”相关规定，是在我毕业多年后才出台的。如果说不要搞双重标准，那就应该把当年毕业的所有硕士论文都搞一遍，先生们女士们，你们觉得有必要吗？154，别再丢人了吧，你们的后代子孙会为你们感到害臊。
5645c976126a8dd2546beb892a2a1cde003f0f27.translatedText: Fourth, regarding my master's thesis, I have written a special article called "A Clear Conscience." My attitude has not changed, no matter how this matter ends, I will accept it all. One more thing, in 2002, my low-level master's thesis was a qualified master's thesis. The relevant regulations of the Academy of Social Sciences on "the full-text text copy ratio is more than 40% (inclusive)" were introduced many years after I graduated. If we say that we should not engage in double standards, then we should review all the master's theses that we graduated that year. Ladies and gentlemen, do you think it is necessary? 154. Stop being embarrassed. Your descendants will be ashamed of you.

cea36cbb20e171062ff12d79e988d4bb35707cda.sourceText: 第五，关于绿坝，简单说几句，我已经不耐烦再看见各种胡说八道，后果不管了。有我署名的关于绿坝的通稿，共有4篇，都完全没有问题。前两篇（一个分析一个消息）是事件刚开始时播发的，我那时刚开始接手工信部口，正处在工作将接未接之时，同事好心地署了我的名，稿子上天时我看都没看棗这个不重要，重要的是绿坝当时是国家多个部委合推的事，我们新华社公开稿不可能唱反调，谁写都是这个路数，而且内容都是工信部提供的，谁写都是那个内容。后来中/宣/部要求正面宣传的单子雪片一样飞来，任务落到我头上，我这才去认真研究了一下事情的来龙去脉，然后立即给头儿打电话说，这个稿子我不能写，如果写，我要求不署名。在新华社工作的同事可以作证，我这么做是多轴的一件事，简直前无古人后无来者，谁让我是在戈壁滩上疯长大的呢？头儿把这事上报，值班领导给我打电话，我就跟他解释了绿坝如何有致命的安全漏洞，由这些漏洞又可以引发别的漏洞，安装了这个软件的电脑，会成为僵尸网络的一部分，被黑客控制，如果全国电脑统一安装，可能对国家信息安全造成威胁。值班领导让我赶紧写个内参。为这个参，我忙了两天，采访了各方当事人，最后熬夜写了一篇4500字的稿，什么都没谈，就谈安全问题棗别的问题我也没有能力采访透彻，现在都没搞清楚水有多深，而我也不可能把道听途说写到稿子里。部门领导签稿时说：”你活生生把一个正面报道弄成内参了。”后来因为事情太敏感，参编辑改写成1500字，还让我专门去确认终稿。此稿一发，宣宣再也没下过单子，也再没有部委公开挺绿坝了。
cea36cbb20e171062ff12d79e988d4bb35707cda.translatedText: Fifth, regarding the Green Dam, I would like to say a few words. I am impatient to see all kinds of nonsense again, and I don’t care about the consequences. There are 4 drafts about Green Dam signed by me, and there are no problems at all. The first two articles (one analysis and one news) were broadcast at the beginning of the incident. I had just started to take charge of the Ministry of Letters and was about to receive work. My colleague kindly signed my name. I didn’t even read the article when it was uploaded. This is not important. The important thing is that Green Dam was a matter promoted by multiple ministries of the country at that time. Our Xinhua News Agency’s public version cannot be negative. Whoever writes it uses this method, and the content is provided by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and whoever writes it has the same content. Later, orders from the Central Propaganda Department requesting positive publicity came flying in, and the task fell on me. Only then did I study the whole story carefully, and then immediately called the boss and said that I could not write this article, and if I did, I would not sign it. Colleagues who work at Xinhua News Agency can testify that what I did was a multi-axis thing. It was unprecedented and unprecedented. Who told me that I grew up in the Gobi Desert? The boss reported this matter, and the leader on duty called me. I explained to him how Green Dam had fatal security vulnerabilities, which could lead to other vulnerabilities. Computers with this software installed would become part of a botnet and be controlled by hackers. If computers were installed uniformly across the country, it might pose a threat to national information security. The leader on duty asked me to quickly write an internal reference. For this participation, I was busy for two days, interviewing all parties involved, and finally stayed up late to write a 4,500-word manuscript. I didn’t talk about anything except safety issues. I didn’t have the ability to conduct thorough interviews on other issues. I still don’t know how deep the water is, and I couldn’t include hearsay in the manuscript. When signing the manuscript, the department leader said: "You have turned a positive report into an internal reference." Later, because the matter was too sensitive, the editor rewritten it to 1,500 words, and asked me to confirm the final draft. As soon as this article was published, Xuanxuan never placed an order again, and no ministry or commission publicly supported Green Dam.

7835adc113a6b1a7e2be9bd4ebbeb7f420c55be5.sourceText: 后来的两条通稿，都是在国务院新闻办举办的新闻发布会上，工信部被问到这个问题并作答，我们根据问答及工信部提供的材料发的稿。难道天下记者都发得，就我们发不得？尤其是最后一条，一共三段，全是工信部怎么说，我本来不想发这篇，但工信部说在国新办发布会结束时有媒体问了，怕被别的媒体歪曲原意，请求我发个通稿，考虑到报道工信部的声音本来也是我的职责，于是就发了。真看不出我哪儿支持绿坝了，欲加之罪强说辞啊。最可笑的是，在2009年主题为”保障儿童网上安全”的世界电信日，我发了一篇关于保障儿童网上安全的评论，只字未提绿坝，也被用来做我支持绿坝的罪证。天下人那天都在谈这个话题，就我谈不得，这是要钳我之口吗？
7835adc113a6b1a7e2be9bd4ebbeb7f420c55be5.translatedText: The two subsequent drafts were both asked and answered by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office. We issued the draft based on the questions and answers and materials provided by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. Could it be that all the reporters in the world can publish it, but we can’t? Especially the last one, which has three paragraphs in total, is all about what the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology said. I didn’t want to post this article originally, but the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology said that some media asked about it at the end of the press conference of the State Council Information Office. They were afraid of being distorted by other media and asked me to send a press release. Considering that it is also my duty to report the voice of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, I sent it. I really don’t see how I support Green Dam. I’m just trying to make excuses. The most ridiculous thing is that on World Telecommunications Day in 2009 with the theme of "Keeping Children Safe Online", I posted a comment about keeping children safe online without mentioning Green Dam at all. This was also used as evidence that I supported Green Dam. Everyone in the world was talking about this topic that day, but I couldn’t talk about it. Are you trying to silence me?

6734341d3eb448b168b8c74edd85bc4e6ff3b015.sourceText: 说起来，我在新华社上班，也荒唐地成了方舟子的一条罪证。起初看到有人在方舟子的微博后面留言说，仅仅因为他老婆是新华社的，就感觉比他有道德优越感，我忍不住笑了，心想说这话的人一定人格不健全，或者说大脑还没发育好。但后来，当我看到名牌大学的著名教授说”大领导表扬方舟子”，看到南方报系的知名记者造谣方舟子向李群道歉时，问他来源，他说”新华社家属，你懂的。”我感到很可怕，看到人性的丑恶、凶残、阴险。讽刺的是，这些人反说方舟子构陷谁谁谁棗可见，网友们坚持独立思考是多么得重要。还有说我的”官媒”背景帮方舟子成名的，我要有这么大本事，早不在这里待了。说实话，我还真没兴趣做那种帮丈夫成名的事，我所喜欢的，读书写字罢了。最近还看到，方舟子被问到孩子多大了，方舟子说几岁吧，本来是不想透露孩子年龄，却有著名政治人士据此说，方舟子不爱自己的孩子，连孩子多大都不记得。恐怕不爱自己孩子的人，才会这样解读方舟子吧。把方舟子解读成变态，你们的变态言行就正当了吗？
6734341d3eb448b168b8c74edd85bc4e6ff3b015.translatedText: Speaking of which, I worked at Xinhua News Agency, which absurdly became a piece of evidence against Fang Zhouzi. At first, I saw someone leaving a message on Fang Zhouzi’s Weibo saying that just because his wife is from Xinhua News Agency, he feels morally superior to him. I couldn’t help but laugh. I thought that the person who said this must have an unsound personality or his brain is not well developed. But later, when I saw a famous professor from a prestigious university saying, "Big leaders praise Fang Zhouzi," and I saw a well-known reporter from the Southern Newspaper spreading rumors that Fang Zhouzi apologized to Li Qun, and when I asked him the source, he said, "Xinhua News Agency family members, you know." I felt terrible, seeing the ugliness, cruelty, and insidiousness of human nature. Ironically, these people said that it is obvious that Fang Zhouzi framed so and so, and how important it is for netizens to insist on independent thinking. Some people say that my "official media" background helped Fang Zhouzi become famous. If I were so capable, I would no longer be here. To be honest, I really have no interest in doing things that help my husband become famous. What I like is just reading and writing. Recently, I also saw that Fang Zhouzi was asked how old his child was. Fang Zhouzi said how old he was. Originally, he did not want to disclose the child's age, but a famous politician said that Fang Zhouzi did not love his child and did not even remember how old the child was. I'm afraid only people who don't love their children would interpret Fang Zhouzi this way. If you interpret Fang Zhouzi as a pervert, are your perverted words and deeds justified?

0f43107c4f32140e6dbd782ba13307673415b9b3.sourceText: 太高人愈妒，过洁世同嫌。其实我本人太微不足道了，之所以成为热点，是因为把我搞得背景神秘，就可以构陷方舟子是五毛是所谓”傀儡”，方舟子批评的人也就有了正当性。方舟子堂堂男儿，顶天立地，谁控制得了他？就算把方舟子和舟子妻抹得墨一样黑，假的还是假的，对不对？到头来，看谁被后世唾骂！
0f43107c4f32140e6dbd782ba13307673415b9b3.translatedText: People who are too high will be more jealous, and people who are too clean will be resented. In fact, I am too insignificant. The reason why I became a hot topic is because by making me have a mysterious background, I can frame Fang Zhouzi as a fifty cents and a so-called "puppet", and the people Fang Zhouzi criticizes will be justified. Fang Zhouzi is a man, indomitable, who can control him? Even if Fang Zhouzi and Zhouzi's wife are painted as black as ink, the fake ones will still be fake, right? In the end, let’s see who will be reviled by future generations!

dcfdd4975f7248050a22d295b0d5a78b0c936f02.sourceText: 还有些话，我在以前的文章里都说过了，附上链接，大家感兴趣就去看。我所有这些话，都不是说给造假者、造谣者和政治投机客听的，是说给还心存良知、爱这个不可爱国家的中国人听的，你们是方舟子的坚强后盾和真正的后台
dcfdd4975f7248050a22d295b0d5a78b0c936f02.translatedText: There are also some things that I have said in previous articles. I have attached a link. If you are interested, you can read it. All these words of mine are not for the counterfeiters, rumor makers and political speculators. They are for the Chinese people who still have a conscience and love this unlovable country. You are Fang Zhouzi’s strong backing and real backstage.
