58b6213a619ecfbc3b762743455b53592a293f3d.sourceText: 中央经济工作会议将召开 “习李组合”首次联袂主导 2013年中央经济工作会议将于本周在京举行。会议将分析国际国内经济形势，提出2014年经济工作总体要求和主要任务，重点是落实十八届三中全会提出的改革任务。”稳中求进”将继续成为明年经济工作总基调。 与去年中央经济工作会议相比，今年会议在参会阵容和指导思路方面都发生了重大变化。今年两会之后，除了国家领导人换届之外，各部委、地方各省市以及军队都进行了大规模人事调整。因而此次是习李全面接班后的第一次经济工作会议。 据悉，习近平总书记将在经济工作会议上发表重要讲话，提出明年经济工作要求和任务。李克强总理将就明年经济工作作出部署。这也是习李二人首次以总书记、总理的搭档组合主导经济工作会议。 其次，在指导思路方面，十八届三中全会确定了未来改革发展的总目标、路线图、时间表。明年经济工作将紧紧围绕三中全会的改革部署来开局。 继续稳中求进总基调 相关的预热工作已经提前举行。12月3日，中央政治局召开会议，分析研究2014年经济工作。会议多次强调”改革”，提出要”继续坚持稳中求进工作总基调，把改革贯穿于经济社会发展各个领域各个环节”。 关于稳中求进的总基调，国家信息中心经济预测部主任祝宝良分析指出，所谓”稳”就是保持经济增速和就业基本稳定，防止出现大的风险；所谓”进”，就是改革要有突破、结构调整要取得进展、民生要有改善。 近期一系列数据支撑了决策层有关经济稳中向好的判断。海关总署最新发布的数据显示贸易顺差创五年来新高。国家统计局数据显示，11月份PMI为51.4%，表明制造业继续稳中向好。 多家官方及民间研究机构近期也都纷纷发表年终报告。国泰君安预测2014年的GDP增速为7.5%。中金公司报告则认为，可以达到7.6%。国家信息中心报告预测则是7%。祝宝良认为这样的目标能较好地协调经济增长、就业、物价三者的关系。另一方面，经济增长预期目标留有一定余地，可以引导政府、企业把经济工作的重点放在加快推进经济体制改革和加快转变经济发展方式上。 国务院发展研究中心主任李伟近日表示，预计2014年全球经济增速将略高于今年，中国出口增长将小幅改善。在居民消费升级、政府增加民生支出等带动下，文化体育、商务服务、节能环保、批发零售等产业投资有望继续高增长。 按照月初政治局会议透露的工作框架，明年经济工作的重点将包括扩大内需战略，加快培育消费新增长点，积极拓展出口市场，加快发展现代农业，加快实施创新驱动战略，坚持绿色低碳清洁发展，新型城镇化道路，推进海洋强国建设，做好住房保障和房地产市场调控工作等。
58b6213a619ecfbc3b762743455b53592a293f3d.translatedText: The Central Economic Work Conference will be held. The "Xi-Li combination" will jointly lead the 2013 Central Economic Work Conference for the first time in Beijing this week. The meeting will analyze the international and domestic economic situation, put forward the overall requirements and main tasks of economic work in 2014, and focus on implementing the reform tasks put forward by the Third Plenary Session of the 18th CPC Central Committee. "Making progress while maintaining stability" will continue to be the general tone of economic work next year. Compared with last year's Central Economic Work Conference, this year's conference has undergone major changes in terms of participant lineup and guiding ideas. After the two sessions this year, in addition to the change of national leaders, various ministries, local provinces, cities, and the military have made large-scale personnel adjustments. Therefore, this is the first economic work conference after Xi and Li took over. It is reported that General Secretary Xi Jinping will deliver an important speech at the economic work conference and propose economic work requirements and tasks for next year. Premier Li Keqiang will make arrangements for next year's economic work. This is also the first time that Xi and Li have led an economic work meeting as a partnership of general secretary and prime minister. Secondly, in terms of guiding ideas, the Third Plenary Session of the 18th CPC Central Committee determined the overall goals, roadmap, and timetable for future reform and development. Next year's economic work will start closely around the reform arrangements of the Third Plenary Session of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. The general tone is to continue to seek progress while maintaining stability. Relevant warm-up work has been carried out in advance. On December 3, the Political Bureau of the Central Committee held a meeting to analyze and study the economic work in 2014. The meeting emphasized "reform" many times and proposed that "continue to adhere to the general tone of seeking progress while maintaining stability and implement reform throughout all aspects of economic and social development." Regarding the general tone of pursuing progress while maintaining stability, Zhu Baoliang, director of the Economic Forecasting Department of the National Information Center, analyzed and pointed out that the so-called "stability" means maintaining the basic stability of economic growth and employment and preventing major risks; the so-called "advance" means breakthroughs in reform, progress in structural adjustment, and improvements in people's livelihood. A series of recent data support decision-makers' judgment that the economy is stable and improving. The latest data released by the General Administration of Customs showed that the trade surplus hit a five-year high. Data from the National Bureau of Statistics showed that the PMI in November was 51.4%, indicating that the manufacturing industry continues to stabilize and improve. Many official and private research institutions have recently published year-end reports. Guotai Junan predicts GDP growth in 2014 to be 7.5%. The CICC report believes that it can reach 7.6%. The National Information Center report predicts 7%. Zhu Baoliang believes that such a goal can better coordinate the relationship between economic growth, employment, and prices. On the other hand, the expected economic growth target leaves a certain amount of leeway, which can guide the government and enterprises to focus their economic work on accelerating the reform of the economic system and accelerating the transformation of the economic development model. Li Wei, director of the Development Research Center of the State Council, said recently that global economic growth in 2014 is expected to be slightly higher than this year, and China's export growth will improve slightly. Driven by the upgrade of residents' consumption and the government's increase in people's livelihood expenditures, investment in industries such as culture and sports, business services, energy conservation and environmental protection, wholesale and retail is expected to continue to grow at a high rate. According to the work framework disclosed at the Politburo meeting at the beginning of the month, the focus of economic work next year will include the strategy of expanding domestic demand, accelerating the cultivation of new growth points of consumption, actively expanding the export market, accelerating the development of modern agriculture, accelerating the implementation of innovation-driven strategies, adhering to green, low-carbon and clean development, new urbanization paths, promoting the construction of a maritime power, and doing a good job in housing security and real estate market regulation.

1f20e228467749bb2df36605b4deb18173b66478.sourceText: 春天在这里 (亞省時報) 伴着铿锵有力的鼓点，醒狮气宇轩昂地上场。踩着鼓点，一会儿眨眨眼睛，一会儿摆摆尾巴。这些表演者都是七、八十岁的老人，令人无法相信。只见锣鼓越敲越响 ，舞狮的也越舞越有劲。 欢乐的锣鼓声中，一队美女，迈着轻盈的步子出现了，她们手提灯笼，一袭红衣，矫健的身段，古典优美的舞姿。又有谁能” 美丽春天”，喜庆的歌声一首接着一首回荡在夜空，又是这些精神抖擞，中气十足，充满自信的老公公，老婆婆们，放开嗓门，唱出心中的快乐，吐出胸中的热情。为大家送来吉祥瑞气，浓浓的年味。 还有很多很多，唱粤剧的，唱京剧的，如少女般活泼跳跃， 表演节奏明快的舞蹈的厖 这就是凤城华人耆英会老人们的精彩生活。三月十三日，他们在六福海鲜酒家大摆春宴，举办吉虎迎新春节联欢会。当晚，共有三百多人出席。各个侨团首领也都应邀赴宴，共度美好时光。一时间，宾客盈门，喜气洋洋。到处都洋溢着节日的气氛。耆英会的醒狮队，舞蹈团，国语合唱团，粤语合唱团等自也就有多高兴，多卖力了。 耆英会的人高兴还有更重要的理由。凤凰城华人耆英会一向是全国先进模范单位。耆英会本届主席崔增祁在致欢迎词中说得清清楚楚：”我们的工作目标是团结华人耆英，增进会员福利，把耆英会办成团结欢乐的大家庭。” 但是，即便是这样有益于老人身心健康快乐的地方，处在目前举国上下的经济危机之中，同样也正面临着失去政府经费的危险。 幸运的是，经过多方奔走要求，市政府预算中，耆英会的经费以最后仅减少百分之十而通过。难怪凤凰城市政府民众服务部副主任，马绍尔夫人也在致词中说，今年是市政府最困难的年头，因为知道大众的要求，仍然保持耆英会的预算，但她一再告诫大家要时刻保持清醒的头脑，要继续努力，把耆英会办得更好。虽然，她对华人耆英会也一直是赞赏有加，引以为荣的。她甚至说，她一定要以华人耆英会的名义去芝加哥拿个奖状。 会上，崔主席，邓情芬副主席，胡樵副主席还一起向所有会员，侨界领袖，政府工作人员的支持和帮助表示衷心的感谢。他们表示一定要按照新时代的要求，按照会员的需求，同心协力发展耆英会。大会还对那些为耆英会作出杰出贡献的人进行了表彰。 她们是：邓情芬、范钱翠月 、林月莺、陈秀容、邓绮霏，会议为她们颁发了服务奖。会议也肯定与表扬了华人耆英会中心主任裴霞云的工作成绩。并对赞助人表示感谢，如，资深侨领余文劲 为鼓励华人耆英会舞蹈团，这次与余文裕夫人，余文伟夫人，余文泽一起捐了二百元给她们。还祝她们身体健康，乐舞越有劲。 春风化雨育新人，耆英老人们不仅生活得愉快，她们也非常重视子孙的教育， 十分关心下一代的成长。会议的另一项奖励是给学习优异的孩子们颁发奖学金。这次共有七名学生获得奖学金。他们分别是：头奖一名：邓丽桃；二奖两名：王盈盈与Jiamin Huang；三桨两名：娄祺与邝瑞文；以及题名奖两名：Katie Tam 与 Tyler Tang.。 当耆英会2010年的全体新职员一同举杯向大家贺新年时，会议达到了高潮。最后的抽奖活动是压轴戏。它让大家喜笑颜开，一次次爆发出欢呼声。所有的奖品都来自侨界捐助，有餐馆的，有超市的，多种多样。
1f20e228467749bb2df36605b4deb18173b66478.translatedText: Spring is here (Alberta Times) Accompanied by the sonorous and powerful drums, the lion wakes up and takes the stage majestically. Stepping on the drums, blinking his eyes and wagging his tail. These performers are all in their seventies or eighties, which is unbelievable. The gongs and drums were beating louder and louder, and the lion dancers were dancing more vigorously. Amid the joyful sound of gongs and drums, a group of beauties appeared with light steps. They carried lanterns, dressed in red, with strong figures and classical and graceful dancing postures. Who else can "Beautiful Spring", the festive songs echo in the night sky one after another, and these energetic, energetic and confident old men and women open their voices, sing out the joy in their hearts, and spit out the enthusiasm in their chests. Sending everyone auspiciousness and a strong flavor of the New Year. There are many, many more, including Cantonese opera singers, Peking opera singers, lively and jumping girls, and Pang performing fast-paced dances. This is the wonderful life of the elderly people of the Fengcheng Chinese Senior Citizens Association. On March 13, they held a grand Spring Banquet at Luk Fook Seafood Restaurant and held the Jihu New Year Party. That night, more than 300 people attended. Leaders of various overseas Chinese groups were also invited to the banquet and spent a good time together. For a time, the door was full of guests, beaming with joy. There is a festive atmosphere everywhere. The Lion Dance Troupe, Dance Troupe, Mandarin Choir, Cantonese Choir, etc. of the Senior Citizens Association are naturally very happy and work hard. There is a more important reason for the people of the Senior Citizens Association to be happy. The Phoenix Chinese Senior Citizens Association has always been an advanced model unit in the country. Cui Zengqi, the current chairman of the Senior Citizens Association, made it clear in his welcome speech: "Our work goal is to unite the Chinese senior citizens, improve member welfare, and turn the Senior Citizens Association into a united and happy family." However, even such a place that is beneficial to the physical and mental health and happiness of the elderly is also facing the danger of losing government funding amid the current economic crisis across the country. Fortunately, after many requests from various parties, the funding for the Senior Citizens Association in the city government's budget was approved with only a 10% reduction. No wonder Mrs. Marshall, deputy director of the Department of Human Services of the Phoenix City Government, also said in her speech that this year is the most difficult year for the city government. Because she is aware of the public's demands, she still maintains the budget of the Senior Citizen Association. However, she has repeatedly warned everyone to keep a clear mind at all times and continue to work hard to make the Senior Citizen Association better. Although, she has always admired and been proud of the Chinese Senior Citizens Association. She even said that she must go to Chicago to get a certificate in the name of the Chinese Senior Citizens Association. At the meeting, Chairman Cui, Vice Chairman Deng Qingfen, and Vice Chairman Hu Qiao also expressed their heartfelt thanks to all members, overseas Chinese leaders, and government staff for their support and help. They expressed that they must work together to develop the Senior Citizens Association in accordance with the requirements of the new era and the needs of members. The conference also commended those who have made outstanding contributions to the Senior Citizens Association. They are: Deng Qingfen, Fan Qiancuiyue, Lin Yueying, Chen Xiurong, and Deng Qifei. The meeting awarded them service awards. The meeting also affirmed and praised the work achievements of Pei Xiayun, director of the Chinese Senior Citizens Association Center. He also expressed his gratitude to the sponsors. For example, senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin donated 200 yuan to them together with Mrs. Yu Wenyu, Mrs. Yu Wenwei and Yu Wenze to encourage the dance troupe of the Chinese Senior Citizens Association. I also wish them good health and more energetic music and dance. The spring breeze turns into rain and nurtures new people. Not only do the senior citizens live happily, they also attach great importance to the education of their children and grandchildren and are very concerned about the growth of the next generation. Another award at the conference is the award of scholarships to children with outstanding academic performance. A total of seven students received scholarships this time. They are: one first prize: Deng Litao; two second prizes: Wang Yingying and Jiamin Huang; two third prizes: Lou Qi and Kuang Ruiwen; and two nomination prizes: Katie Tam and Tyler Tang. The meeting reached its climax when all the new staff of the Senior Citizens Association in 2010 raised their glasses to wish everyone a happy New Year. The final raffle is the grand finale. It made everyone smile and burst into cheers again and again. All prizes come from donations from the overseas Chinese community, from restaurants to supermarkets, etc.

a180fbaf58f15c8721442c60ae599454f2cff81d.sourceText: 好一个充实愉快的暑假 —- 记新东方暑期班教学汇演（图） 新东方艺术学校(EAA) 供稿 在这个酷日炎炎的夏季, 怎么样让小朋友度过一个有意义家长又省心的暑假? 新东方艺术学校(EAA)暑期夏令营六月的教学汇报也许会给您一个新的思路. 7月1日星期五下午六点, 几十位从四岁到十三岁的小朋友向爸爸妈妈们展示了他们在暑期班里的中国文化课, 健身舞蹈课, 合唱表演课和美术绘画课上所学到的’胜利果实’. 宽敞的舞蹈教室被布置一新, 墙上装饰着五颜六色的花和气球, 还有小朋友们可爱的绘画作品, 家长专座也成排成行地布置整齐, 观众区和表演区泾渭分明, 麻雀虽小, 可五脏俱全. 学校准备了丰盛的食物和饮料, 大家在大快朵颐之后, 6点半陆陆续续地进入主教室一一坐好, 表演正式开始. 夏令营中学员们正在表演节目 首先登场的是中英文歌曲表演唱, 小朋友们咿咿呀呀地边唱边比手划脚, 像模像样的姿态甚是可爱. 接下来是儿歌和诗词朗诵的环节, 五六首稚气十足的儿歌后紧接着宋代大词人苏轼的名作, 大一点的孩子们记忆力惊人, 全篇背下来一字不漏, 让家长们真是惊喜不已. 接着进入到了本次教学汇报的高潮—-儿童短剧和舞蹈表演的环节了. 孙婷老师指导的戏剧片段 让大部分小朋友首次尝试到了戏剧表演的滋味, 孩子们一板一眼的模样让家长们忍俊不禁. 胡秋子(Vanessa Qiuzi Hu)老师所教的三支Hip Hop舞蹈, 让小朋友们既锻炼了体质, 更开发了孩子们天真活泼的创造力, 爸爸妈妈也被小朋友的活力所感染,大家一致称赞暑期班办得太好了，短短一个月的时间，孩子的中文简直是一个飞跃。一些在家里不讲中文的孩子，开始来暑期班时只会一些简单的你好，再见等，汇报演出上几首中文儿歌有板有眼，字正腔圆，看呆了在场的爷爷奶奶爸爸妈妈们，观众席上不时爆发出一阵阵热烈的掌声。 在全部表演结束后, 本次的教学汇演进入了热烈的亲子互动环节.有的家长在交流育儿经验，有的还在仔细的欣赏孩子的美术作品，更为热闹的是妈妈，儿子女儿一同涌向舞蹈教室，大家在健身舞Zumba老师何春玲的带领下, 齐齐跳着动着闹着, 坐了一个星期办公室的家长们，逮着个舒展筋骨的机会。几支Zumba舞曲跳下来，一身大汗淋漓的妈妈们尝到了甜头，纷纷咨询星期几有Zumba课，准备长期上课了。新东方艺术学校的首次暑假班迷你汇报演出在愉快的气氛中成功结束了. 家长们对小朋友的表演都赞不绝口, 小朋友也流连忘返, 大家纷纷表示希望学校7月份的暑期教学内容更加精彩.
a180fbaf58f15c8721442c60ae599454f2cff81d.translatedText: What a fulfilling and happy summer vacation - a memory of the teaching performance of the New Oriental Summer School (pictures) Contributed by New Oriental Art School (EAA) In this scorching summer, how can we let children spend a summer vacation that is meaningful and worry-free for parents? The June teaching report of the New Oriental Art School (EAA) summer camp may give you a new idea. At 6 pm on Friday, July 1, dozens of children from four to thirteen years old showed their parents the ‘fruits of victory’ they learned in the Chinese culture class, fitness dance class, choral performance class and art painting class in the summer school. The spacious dance classroom was newly decorated, with colorful flowers and balloons on the walls, as well as lovely paintings by children. The parents' seats were neatly arranged in rows, and the audience area and performance area were clearly separated. Although the sparrow was small, it had all the necessary organs. The school prepared a sumptuous meal and drinks. After enjoying the meal, everyone entered the main classroom one by one and took their seats at 6:30, and the performance officially began. The students in the summer camp are performing a program. The first stage is a performance of Chinese and English songs. The children are babbling and gesticulating while singing, and their postures are very cute. Next is the recitation of children's songs and poems. Five or six childish children's songs are followed by the masterpieces of Su Shi, a great poet in the Song Dynasty. The older children have amazing memories and have memorized the whole poem without missing a word, which really surprises the parents. Then we entered the climax of this teaching report - children's short plays and dance performances. The drama clips directed by Teacher Sun Ting gave most of the children a taste of drama performances for the first time. The children's serious appearance made parents laugh. The three Hip Hop dances taught by Teacher Vanessa Qiuzi Hu allowed the children to not only exercise their physical fitness, but also develop their innocent and lively creativity. Parents were also infected by the children's vitality. Everyone praised the summer school for how well it was run. In just one month, the children's Chinese language skills made a huge leap forward. Some children who did not speak Chinese at home could only say simple hello, goodbye, etc. when they first came to the summer school. The Chinese children's songs in the report performance were well-organized and well-written. The grandparents and parents present were stunned, and bursts of warm applause broke out from time to time in the audience. After all the performances, the teaching performance entered a lively parent-child interaction session. Some parents were exchanging parenting experiences, and some were still carefully appreciating their children's art works. Even more lively were mothers, sons and daughters who flocked to the dance classroom together. Under the leadership of fitness dance Zumba teacher He Chunling, everyone danced and made noise together. Parents who had been sitting in the office for a week took a chance to stretch their muscles. After a few Zumba dance songs, the mothers who were dripping with sweat tasted the sweetness and asked about the days of the week when there were Zumba classes, preparing to take long-term classes. New Oriental Art School's first summer class mini report performance ended successfully in a happy atmosphere. Parents were full of praise for the children's performance, and the children also lingered over it. Everyone expressed their hope that the school's summer teaching content in July would be more exciting.

32d37f21972cbf60528d354475da0980070c3a45.sourceText: 乌鸦队主帅约翰-哈勃和49人队主帅吉姆-哈勃是兄弟，此次弟弟战胜哥哥。
32d37f21972cbf60528d354475da0980070c3a45.translatedText: Ravens coach John Harbaugh and 49ers coach Jim Harbaugh are brothers, and this time the younger brother defeated his older brother.

e77272543dcf050e173009922e13c2899a827ed2.sourceText: 中场碧昂斯热力四射的表演后突然停电。
e77272543dcf050e173009922e13c2899a827ed2.translatedText: There was a blackout after Beyoncé’s fiery performance at midfield.

4a5aeda320ed8c7047c12b6948785e9ddd4273ca.sourceText: 最新的数据显示：全美城市有48.1%的家庭收看了CBS电视台周日晚上直播的超级碗决赛，创超级碗收视率历史新高。此前的纪录是福克斯在2011年直播绿湾包装工队与匹兹堡钢人队决赛时创造的47.9%。
4a5aeda320ed8c7047c12b6948785e9ddd4273ca.translatedText: The latest data shows: 48.1% of households in cities across the United States watched the Super Bowl finals broadcast live on CBS on Sunday night, setting a record high in Super Bowl ratings. The previous record was 47.9% set by Fox during the 2011 finals broadcast between the Green Bay Packers and the Pittsburgh Steelers.

7fc68c35177680f77437055db0fccf0ad3f3ec7a.sourceText: 巴尔的摩是收视率最高的城市，有59.6％的家庭收看。
7fc68c35177680f77437055db0fccf0ad3f3ec7a.translatedText: Baltimore was the most-watched city, with 59.6% of households tuning in.

95308217ae92e73f0ff2459af088502f33b570be.sourceText: 收视第二高为主办城市新奥尔良（57.1％），其次是华盛顿DC（56.9）。旧金山反而不在10个收视率最高的城市之中。
95308217ae92e73f0ff2459af088502f33b570be.translatedText: The second highest viewership is the host city New Orleans (57.1%), followed by Washington DC (56.9). San Francisco, on the other hand, is not among the 10 cities with the highest ratings.

2d30a6ebd29990b1408db21023952882c9642be2.sourceText: 碧昂斯劲猛演唱造成停电
2d30a6ebd29990b1408db21023952882c9642be2.translatedText: Beyoncé’s intense performance caused a power outage

32cbb17775a7df497e9eebe19a58c7236089ca3c.sourceText: 碧昂斯表演烟雾太大，触动体育场警报系统，警报系统自动切断电源，超级碗停电37分钟。
32cbb17775a7df497e9eebe19a58c7236089ca3c.translatedText: Beyoncé’s performance was so smokey that it triggered the stadium’s alarm system, which automatically cut off the power supply. The Super Bowl was blacked out for 37 minutes.

abe4f8e5e24bf4b48727c2c40db1f9d73b2e9cfc.sourceText: 第47届超级碗热闹非凡，场上也是状况不断，巴尔的摩乌鸦与旧金山49人打得火爆，打到刘易斯安纳超级碗体育馆也跳电。比赛因此暂停了半个小时，经过紧急抢修之后，在10点10分左右比赛重新展开。
abe4f8e5e24bf4b48727c2c40db1f9d73b2e9cfc.translatedText: The 47th Super Bowl was bustling with excitement, and there were constant situations on the field. The Baltimore Ravens and the San Francisco 49ers had a heated battle, and the Super Bowl Stadium in Louisiana was electrified. The game was suspended for half an hour. After emergency repairs, the game resumed at around 10:10.

dff93728201c99f33cb5b272a43875f76c19d4ad.sourceText: 在中场碧昂斯热力四射的表演之后，下半场一开赛，乌鸦的琼斯接到49人的开球，回跑109码直接达阵，创下超级碗最长的踢球回跑达阵的纪录，第三节只有开始11秒钟，乌鸦再将他们的领先优势，扩大到28比6。
dff93728201c99f33cb5b272a43875f76c19d4ad.translatedText: After midfielder Beyoncé's passionate performance, at the beginning of the second half, the Ravens' Jones received the 49ers' kickoff and ran back 109 yards for a touchdown, setting a record for the longest kick return touchdown in the Super Bowl. Only 11 seconds into the third quarter, the Ravens expanded their lead to 28-6.

cf645d44b48ebae5d0527ff798f8458f70c7af5e.sourceText: 不过接下来体院馆就发生跳电情形，先是49人这半边暗掉，再来是乌鸦的那半边，然后整个球场全灭，两队球员回到场边，比赛暂停，时间是第三节的13分22秒。
cf645d44b48ebae5d0527ff798f8458f70c7af5e.translatedText: But then a power outage occurred in the gymnasium. First the 49ers' half went dark, then the Ravens' half, and then the entire stadium went dark. Players from both teams returned to the sidelines and the game was suspended at 13 minutes and 22 seconds of the third quarter.

bcdcb8e9f13917a04e450eae3a936201839edd28.sourceText: 在网络上有许多球迷猜测，下半场一开始球场就跳电，很可能跟碧昂斯中场炫丽的舞台效果耗电太大有关，不过官方还没提出正式的说法。
bcdcb8e9f13917a04e450eae3a936201839edd28.translatedText: Many fans on the Internet speculated that the stadium's electricity went off at the beginning of the second half, which was probably related to Beyoncé's dazzling midfield stage effect that consumed too much power, but the official has not made a formal statement.

abce5f0675b1b1e1dc5472cac8ba4a2c5d669b9d.sourceText: 赛事吸引全球1亿1000万观众收看
abce5f0675b1b1e1dc5472cac8ba4a2c5d669b9d.translatedText: The event attracted 110 million viewers around the world

932046c6db856036eff94de040cde4fb8f6ddb6a.sourceText: 2月3日晚6:30，NFL第47届超级碗在新奥尔良穹顶体育馆进行， 这场超级赛事吸引了全球1亿1000万观众收看， 这也是 新奥尔良穹顶体育馆 及纽奥良在2005年遭受卡翠纳飓风重创后，首度举办超级杯，象征灾后重生。巴尔的摩乌鸦队上半场就三次达阵得分确立领先优势，在经历了停电事件后旧金山49人队下半场疯狂反扑，一度把差距缩小到只有2分，但他们还是功亏一篑，乌鸦队以34比31险胜夺取超级碗。乌鸦队四分卫弗拉科当选MVP，雷神雷-刘易斯生涯第二次夺取超级碗，他用最完美的方式给职业生涯划上圆满的句号。
932046c6db856036eff94de040cde4fb8f6ddb6a.translatedText: At 6:30 pm on February 3, the 47th NFL Super Bowl was held at the New Orleans Dome. This super event attracted 110 million viewers around the world. This is also the New Orleans Dome. After New Orleans was hit hard by Hurricane Katrina in 2005, it hosted the Super Bowl for the first time, symbolizing rebirth after the disaster. The Baltimore Ravens scored three touchdowns in the first half to establish their lead. After experiencing a power outage, the San Francisco 49ers made a crazy counterattack in the second half and once narrowed the gap to only 2 points. However, they still fell short. The Ravens narrowly won the Super Bowl 34-31. Ravens quarterback Flacco was elected MVP, and Ray Lewis won the Super Bowl for the second time in his career. He ended his career in the most perfect way.

26fb294bc7f81ea1108649d1455803a7ded911a2.sourceText: 旧金山49人队在四分卫卡佩尼克的带领下赢得国联决赛，他们以28比24淘汰了国联1号种子亚特兰大猎鹰队。而巴尔的摩乌鸦队在美联决赛中客场28比13战胜了夺冠热门新英格兰爱国者队，这让今年的超级碗变成?#20804;弟碗?#65292;乌鸦队主帅约翰-哈勃和49人队主帅吉姆-哈勃相遇。对于乌鸦队来说，他们也希望用夺取超级碗来为本赛季后退役的传奇线卫雷-刘易斯送上最好的告别礼物。
26fb294bc7f81ea1108649d1455803a7ded911a2.translatedText: The San Francisco 49ers, led by quarterback Kaepernick, won the NFC finals. They eliminated the NFC No. 1 seed Atlanta Falcons 28-24. The Baltimore Ravens defeated the favorite New England Patriots 28-13 in the American League Finals, making this year's Super Bowl a meeting between Ravens coach John Harbaugh and 49ers coach Jim Harbaugh. For the Ravens, they also hope to use winning the Super Bowl to give the best farewell gift to legendary linebacker Ray Lewis who retires after this season.

7753246871e3a29ee24fb92b3eb1265b2b0ab21f.sourceText: 49人队在比赛中率先进攻，可惜他们在第二次推进时四档进攻都没能完成前进10码，进攻权转交给乌鸦队。在弗拉科的组织下，乌鸦队的进攻快速而有效，他们只用了三次进攻就已经推进到49人队的19码线。弗拉科两次试图传给队友没有成功，不过49人队的布鲁克斯防守越位，乌鸦队重新组织第三档进攻。首节还有10分36秒时，弗拉科冷静地找到成功切入对方端区的外接手博尔丁，弗拉科直接送出一个直传，博尔丁完成接球达阵。罚球也顺利踢进，乌鸦队以7比0领先。
7753246871e3a29ee24fb92b3eb1265b2b0ab21f.translatedText: The 49ers took the lead in the game. Unfortunately, they failed to advance 10 yards in four offenses during their second push, and the offensive power was transferred to the Ravens. Under Flacco's organization, the Ravens' offense was fast and effective. They only used three offenses to advance to the 49ers' 19-yard line. Flacco tried to pass to his teammates twice without success, but the 49ers' Brooks defended offside and the Ravens reorganized the third offense. With 10 minutes and 36 seconds left in the first quarter, Flacco calmly found the wide receiver Boldin who successfully cut into the opponent's end zone. Flacco directly sent a direct pass, and Boldin completed the touchdown. The free throw was also successfully scored, and the Ravens led 7-0.

4d4f769be55b1d0231c02ea729965b8b1d82fa39.sourceText: 比分落后的49人队旋即组织进攻反扑，他们虽然成功推进到乌鸦队的8码线，但卡佩尼克在第三档进攻时未能找到合适的传球队友被擒杀。49人队选择更稳妥的方式，阿克尔斯把球踢入拿到3分，49人队以3比7落后。首节剩余时间里，49人队逐渐找到防守感觉，他们有效抑制住乌鸦队的进攻，没有让对手再得分。首节战罢乌鸦队7比3领先。
4d4f769be55b1d0231c02ea729965b8b1d82fa39.translatedText: The 49ers, who were lagging behind, immediately organized an offensive counterattack. Although they successfully advanced to the Ravens' 8-yard line, Kaepernick was sacked when he failed to find a suitable passing teammate during the third offense. The 49ers chose a more secure approach. Akers kicked the ball in and scored 3 points. The 49ers fell behind 3-7. During the remainder of the first quarter, the 49ers gradually found their defensive feel. They effectively suppressed the Ravens' offense and did not allow their opponents to score again. The Ravens led 7-3 after the first quarter.

c4260d80fa009928db4332813c16945b6582cde1.sourceText: 第二节开始乌鸦队选择了弃踢，进攻权转交给49人队，但他们没有把握住机会，在攻到乌鸦队24码线时，詹姆斯出现了掉球失误，进攻权又回到乌鸦队。在弗拉科的组织下，乌鸦队利用三次进攻就推进到49人队29码线。下一档进攻，弗拉科找到了队友迪克森，他在8码线被对手拉倒，裁判商议判罚49人队的惠特纳有拉头盔犯规动作，乌鸦队前进4码组织进攻。新一波进攻，乌鸦队的莱斯在1码线被扑倒，他们距离第二次达阵已相当接近。第二节还有7分10秒时，弗拉科后退组织进攻，他找到了闯入对手端区的近端锋皮塔，直接把球传入皮塔完成接球达阵，加罚踢进，乌鸦队以14比3领先。
c4260d80fa009928db4332813c16945b6582cde1.translatedText: At the beginning of the second quarter, the Ravens chose to punt, and the offensive power was transferred to the 49ers, but they did not seize the opportunity. When they reached the Ravens 24-yard line, James made a fumble and the offensive power returned to the Ravens. Under Flacco's organization, the Ravens used three offenses to advance to the 49ers 29-yard line. On the next offense, Flacco found his teammate Dixon. He was pulled down by his opponent at the 8-yard line. The referee discussed and penalized the 49ers' Whitner for pulling his helmet for a foul. The Ravens advanced 4 yards to organize the offense. In a new wave of offense, the Ravens' Rice was knocked down at the 1-yard line, and they were very close to their second touchdown. With 7 minutes and 10 seconds left in the second quarter, Flacco retreated to organize the attack. He found tight end Pita who broke into the opponent's end zone, and directly passed the ball to Pita to complete the touchdown. He kicked the extra penalty and the Ravens led 14-3.

2a1bfddeb85bab0f13fa1e440debabbd039316bd.sourceText: 急于追分的49人队欲速则不达，他们之后两轮攻势都无功而返。乌鸦队则气势如虹，在本方44码线两次进攻无果后，弗拉科一记47码的长传准确交给琼斯，琼斯接球后背部着地，他立即起身突破两三位49人队防守球员的包围圈完成达阵，加罚踢进，乌鸦队以21比3领先。弗拉科也成为18年来第一位在上半场传出三次达阵的四分卫。第二节最后时刻49人队的阿克尔斯利用踢球追回3分，半场战罢乌鸦队以21比6领先。
2a1bfddeb85bab0f13fa1e440debabbd039316bd.translatedText: The 49ers were eager to chase points, but waste time in haste. Their subsequent two rounds of offensive efforts were in vain. The Ravens were full of momentum. After two fruitless attacks at their own 44-yard line, Flacco accurately passed a 47-yard long pass to Jones. Jones landed on his back after receiving the ball. He immediately got up and broke through the circle of two or three 49ers defenders to complete the touchdown and kicked the extra penalty. The Ravens led 21-3. Flacco also became the first quarterback in 18 years to pass three touchdowns in the first half. At the end of the second quarter, the 49ers' Akers used the kick to recover 3 points. The Ravens led 21-6 at halftime.

f5ba702bd064cb45c6767fc2674123f584d10192.sourceText: 第三节一开始，乌鸦队就上演不可思议一幕扩大优势。49人开球，琼斯在本方端区接到球后开始加速狂奔，他穿越了49人队的防守线，成功完成接踢球回攻达阵，108码的回攻达阵平了NFL历史纪录，创造了超级碗的纪录。乌鸦队加罚踢进，他们把比分扩大为28比6。就在49人队组织进攻试图追分时，现场却突发状况，穹顶体育馆上空的照明灯突然熄灭，这让比赛不得不中断。
f5ba702bd064cb45c6767fc2674123f584d10192.translatedText: At the beginning of the third quarter, the Ravens staged an incredible scene to expand their advantage. When the 49ers kicked off, Jones started to accelerate after receiving the ball in his own end zone. He crossed the 49ers' defensive line and successfully returned the kick for a touchdown. The 108-yard return touchdown tied the NFL's historical record and set a Super Bowl record. The Ravens kicked an extra penalty and they expanded the score to 28-6. Just when the 49ers were organizing an offense to try to chase points, an unexpected situation occurred at the scene. The lights above the dome suddenly went out, which forced the game to be interrupted.

5979d1b145744a6dee58f4ae8445cab876473f1a.sourceText: 停电事故让比赛中断了36分钟，重新开始后两队各有一波进攻没有得分。这时49人队在场上渐入佳境，他们用三组进攻攻至乌鸦队31码线。在本节还有7分28秒时，卡佩尼克用一个16码传球交给科拉布特里，两名乌鸦队防守球员一前一后撞到他，在正反冲击下科拉布特里反而保持住平衡能够继续进攻，他甩开对方球员完成达阵，阿克尔斯加罚踢进，49人队追至13比28。
5979d1b145744a6dee58f4ae8445cab876473f1a.translatedText: The power outage interrupted the game for 36 minutes. After the restart, both teams had a wave of attacks without scoring. At this time, the 49ers were getting better on the field. They used three sets of offense to attack the Ravens 31-yard line. With 7 minutes and 28 seconds left in this quarter, Kaepernick passed a 16-yard pass to Corabutree. Two Ravens defensive players bumped into him one after another. Under the forward and reverse impact, Corabutri maintained his balance and continued to attack. He threw away the opponent's players to complete the touchdown. Ackers kicked the penalty, and the 49ers chased to 13-28.

0794a39d4da57721564f4ed3ed6f2e5691bbdd31.sourceText: 军心大振的49人队让乌鸦队的进攻只维持了1分33秒，他们在乌鸦队的第三档进攻成功擒杀了弗拉科，乌鸦队只能选择弃踢。在对方20码线发动进攻的49人队由卡佩尼克把球传给戴维斯，他攻至对方的6码线。利用队友的掩护，戈尔接球绕过乌鸦队的防守线成功完成达阵，加罚踢进，49人队追至20比28。
0794a39d4da57721564f4ed3ed6f2e5691bbdd31.translatedText: The highly motivated 49ers allowed the Ravens' offense to last only 1 minute and 33 seconds. They successfully sacked Flacco on the Ravens' third offense, and the Ravens had no choice but to punt. The 49ers launched an offense at the opponent's 20-yard line. Kaepernick passed the ball to Davis, and he attacked the opponent's 6-yard line. Using the cover of his teammates, Gore caught the ball and bypassed the Ravens' defensive line to successfully complete the touchdown. He kicked the extra penalty and the 49ers chased to 20-28.

76464247809e63bfdb5858d02a9e1b832b62a77f.sourceText: 连续让对手达阵让乌鸦队有些阵脚大乱，莱斯竟然出现掉球失误，进攻权又交到49人队手上。这一次乌鸦队的防守终于止血成功，他们没有让49人队的达阵攻势继续，阿克尔斯最后只能通过踢球方式再追3分，前三节结束49人队以23比28落后。
76464247809e63bfdb5858d02a9e1b832b62a77f.translatedText: > The opponent's consecutive touchdowns made the Ravens a little confused. Rice unexpectedly made a fumble and the offensive power was handed over to the 49ers. This time the Ravens defense finally succeeded in stopping the bleeding. They did not allow the 49ers' touchdown offensive to continue. In the end, Akers could only chase another 3 points through kicking. At the end of the first three quarters, the 49ers trailed 23-28.

3ac35c230117bf7364dae2a1f0d134b179df46b8.sourceText: 乌鸦队在第四节开始后虽然攻至49人队的1码线，但他们三次达阵尝试都没有成功，最终只能用踢球破门拿到3分，场上比分改写为31比23。49人队重新进攻保持高效状态，他们很快就攻到乌鸦队的15码线。第四节还有10分4秒时，利用队友们的掩护，卡佩尼克在没有找到合适接球人的情况下，选择自己单干，他抓住乌鸦队的防守漏洞完成了15码的冲跑达阵，这创造了四分卫在超级碗历史上的最长冲跑达阵码数，原纪录是乔-蒙塔纳的6码冲跑达阵。落后2分的49人队没有选择常规加罚，而是选择了2分附加进攻，可惜卡佩尼克传给莫斯没有成功，他们以29比31落后。
3ac35c230117bf7364dae2a1f0d134b179df46b8.translatedText: Although the Ravens attacked the 49ers' 1-yard line after the start of the fourth quarter, their three touchdown attempts were unsuccessful. In the end, they could only score 3 points with a kick, and the score was rewritten to 31-23. The 49ers resumed their offense to maintain an efficient state, and they quickly reached the Ravens' 15-yard line. With 10 minutes and 4 seconds left in the fourth quarter, Kaepernick took advantage of the cover of his teammates and chose to go it alone without finding a suitable receiver. He took advantage of the Ravens' defensive vulnerability and completed a 15-yard touchdown run. This created the longest touchdown run by a quarterback in the history of the Super Bowl. The original record was Joe Montana's 6-yard run touchdown. The 49ers, who were trailing by 2 points, did not choose to add a regular penalty, but chose a 2-point additional offense. Unfortunately, Kaepernick's pass to Moss was unsuccessful and they fell behind 29-31.

15168df3d6040841e73427953dafaa79eae56d0e.sourceText: 压力之下乌鸦队虽然把进攻推至对手20码线，但弗拉科把球传给皮塔，后者未能接住，他们无法完成10码推进，只能选择踢球进攻拿到3分，乌鸦队以34比29领先。轮到49人队进攻，他们稳扎稳打推进至乌鸦队的7码线。在一个暂停后卡佩尼克把球传给科拉布特里，他在5码线被对手扑倒。终场前1分55秒时49人队请求暂停，可惜科拉布特里的边路策应接球进攻被对手扑倒。没有选择的49人队第四档只能继续进攻，卡佩尼克高抛传入端区，可惜科拉布特里在对手的干扰下没能把球接住。49人队主帅吉姆-哈勃认为对手有犯规动作，但根据规定他这时不能申请挑战。
15168df3d6040841e73427953dafaa79eae56d0e.translatedText: Under pressure, although the Ravens pushed the offense to the opponent's 20-yard line, Flacco passed the ball to Pitta, who failed to catch it. They were unable to complete the 10-yard advance and could only choose to kick the ball and score 3 points. The Ravens led 34-29. It was the 49ers' turn to attack, and they advanced steadily to the Ravens' 7-yard line. After a timeout, Kaepernick passed the ball to Corabutrie, who was tackled by his opponent at the 5-yard line. The 49ers requested a timeout with 1 minute and 55 seconds left before the end, but unfortunately Corabutrie's wing support attack was knocked down by his opponent. The 49ers had no choice but to continue attacking in the fourth gear. Kaepernick threw a high pass into the end zone. Unfortunately, Corabutrie failed to catch the ball due to interference from his opponent. 49ers coach Jim Harbaugh believed that his opponent had committed a foul, but according to regulations, he could not apply for a challenge at this time.

4827482e27747064fb3fc8def664da34b4ca7fa0.sourceText: 手握5分领先的乌鸦队在终场前1分46秒时握有进攻权，他们选择用地面攻势来消耗时间。比赛还有12秒时，科赫端区内接球都没有选择踢球，而是主动送给对手2分的安全分，终场前4秒时49人队以31比34落后。49人队换上基恩一搏，他接球回跑突破了乌鸦队的两道防守线，可惜在50码线被扑倒，49人队功亏一篑，乌鸦队以34比31获胜夺取超级碗。
4827482e27747064fb3fc8def664da34b4ca7fa0.translatedText: The Ravens, who held a 5-point lead, had the right to attack with 1 minute and 46 seconds before the end, and they chose to use a ground attack to waste time. With 12 seconds left in the game, Koch did not choose to kick the ball when he caught the ball in the end zone, but took the initiative to give his opponent a 2-point safety score. With 4 seconds before the end, the 49ers trailed 31 to 34. The 49ers replaced Keane for a try. He caught the ball and ran back and broke through the two defensive lines of the Ravens. Unfortunately, he was knocked down at the 50-yard line. The 49ers fell short, and the Ravens won 34-31 to win the Super Bowl.

03922592235733ceb070060fb9ab6a8aa6e0c43a.sourceText: (一首好听的曲，曾经被时代赋予扭曲的词。实在不忍心，便改了过来。)

When can I see your true face? The sea and sky are the same color, nostalgia spreads, and the birds are singing softly. 14c8edb2d308e905a94c6679620033c6091f3f6a.sourceText: 地方政府 连续七个月裁员 在一个健全的经济复苏中，州和地方会开始雇员、扩大服务，和协助促进国家的成长，但2011年的复苏并非如此，美国经济已向前迈进，但州和地方政府仍困在 衰退中，5月连续第七个月实施裁员，共裁去3万个工作，不但未促进，反而减缓国家经济的成长，老百姓最能体会，因为教师、警察和消防员都减少了。 「大衰退」(Great Recession)已在两年前的2009年6月正式结束了，在先前的复苏中，复苏两年后州和地方政府已是成长的火车头，例如在1990-91年的衰退结 束两年后，州和地方政府增加了43万个工作；在2001年的衰退结束后，州和地方政府增加了24万9000个工作；但这次不同，2009年6月后，州和地 方政府裁减了46万7000个工作，包括18万8000名教师。 专家不认为这种痛苦会很快消失，富国证券公司资深经济学家韦特纳预期，州和地方政府还会每月削减2万至3万个工作，直到2012年中。Moody’s Analytics公司估计，每个州与地方政府的工作，会在全国支持增加1.3个工作。 1930 年代后最长和最严重的经济下滑─2007年至2009年的大衰退，使州与地方政府的税收枯竭；社会福利计划，如医疗补助计划(Medicaid)和失业福 利的需求增加；各州的准备金也被侵蚀。联邦政府的刺激经济支出一度对州与地方的财务略有小补，但这笔钱已经用完，再拨款的可能性不大。 分析家也指出州政府可能即将回春，全国州长协会和全国州预算官员协会上周提出的报告预测，7月1日开始的新会计年度，州税收会增加2.1%。不过29州表示，他们2012年的支出仍会比2008年少。各地方政府仍在等待因房价下跌而损失的税收回升，专家表示，地方政府收入的下降可能尚未探底，回升可能仍需一年 的时间。
14c8edb2d308e905a94c6679620033c6091f3f6a.translatedText: Local governments have laid off employees for seven consecutive months. In a healthy economic recovery, states and localities will begin to hire employees, expand services, and help promote the country's growth. However, the recovery in 2011 is not the case. The U.S. economy has moved forward, but state and local governments are still stuck in recession. May implemented layoffs for the seventh consecutive month, eliminating a total of 30,000 jobs. Instead of promoting, it actually slowed down the country's economic growth. Ordinary people can feel it best, because there have been fewer teachers, police officers, and firefighters. The "Great Recession" officially ended two years ago in June 2009. In previous recoveries, state and local governments have been the locomotive of growth two years after the recovery. For example, two years after the end of the 1990-91 recession, state and local governments added 430,000 jobs; after the end of the 2001 recession, state and local governments added 249,000 jobs; but this time is different. After June 2009, state and local governments added 430,000 jobs. The Chinese government has cut 467,000 jobs, including 188,000 teachers. Experts don't think the pain will go away soon. Wells Fargo Securities senior economist Weitner predicts that state and local governments will cut 20,000 to 30,000 jobs per month until mid-2012. Moody’s Analytics estimates that each state and local government job would support an additional 1.3 jobs nationwide. The Great Recession of 2007-2009, the longest and most severe economic downturn since the 1930s, dried up tax revenue for state and local governments; increased demand for social welfare programs such as Medicaid and unemployment benefits; and eroded state reserves. The federal government's stimulus spending once provided a small boost to state and local finances, but the money has been used up and further appropriations are unlikely. Analysts also point to a possible resurgence in state government, with a report last week from the National Governors Association and the National Association of State Budget Officials predicting a 2.1% increase in state tax revenues for the new fiscal year that begins July 1. However, 29 states said they would still spend less in 2012 than in 2008. Local governments are still waiting for tax revenue lost due to falling housing prices to recover. Experts say the decline in local government revenue may not have bottomed out yet, and it may still take a year for the recovery to pick up.

46e60ee661ad166d4521646b586aaceef28fb7bc.sourceText: 橙县台湾传统周系列活动-台菜烹饪教学 延续近一个月的橙县台湾传统周系列活动于5月20日进行一项颇具台湾特色的活动「台菜烹饪实作教学」，吸引近200位乡亲前来橙县侨教中心观摩学习，将 现场挤得水泻不通。 本届橙侨台湾传统周活动召集人吕耀勋、林翠云、黄河芬表示，许多旅居海外的侨民对于家乡小吃都是怀念不已，为了将台湾美食发扬光大，且让怀乡的侨民们能透过「DIY」 烹饪法自作自用，让全家人都能在美国享受到地的台湾小吃，因此特地在传统周活动中开辟「台菜烹饪实作教学」。 有鉴于现代人皆注重养生保健，本次烹饪教学特别教授养生素食：智慧糕、吉利卷、心田阿给，主办单位邀请此间著名素食餐点「悦意心田」名厨罗慧利、纪凤逸、雷文郁 前来进行示范讲学并提供来宾制作食谱。 大厨们精湛的手艺及诙谐的解说，令现场充满了香味及笑声。 其间并播放短片，介绍素食的营养和好处，并教授大家如何认识酱油及选择炒菜油，最后并把现场示范教学新鲜出炉的养生食品和全体来宾一起分享。 橙侨台湾传统周7大项系列活动在5月21日晚间国立台湾艺术大学「大观舞集」舞蹈团队在Irvine Barclay Theater的盛大公演后顺利圆满闭幕。
46e60ee661ad166d4521646b586aaceef28fb7bc.translatedText: Orange County Taiwanese Traditional Week Series of Activities - Taiwanese Cuisine Cooking Teaching The Orange County Taiwanese Heritage Week series of activities, which lasted for nearly a month, held an activity with Taiwanese characteristics "Taiwanese cooking practical teaching" on May 20, which attracted nearly 200 folks to come to the Orange County Overseas Chinese Education Center to observe and learn, and the venue was packed to the rafters. The conveners of this year's Orange Taiwan Heritage Week, Lu Yaoxun, Lin Cuiyun, and Huang Hefen, said that many overseas Chinese are nostalgic for the snacks of their hometown. In order to carry forward Taiwanese cuisine and allow the nostalgic overseas Chinese to make their own meals through "DIY" cooking methods, so that the whole family can enjoy local Taiwanese snacks in the United States, "Taiwanese cooking practical teaching" was specially launched during the Traditional Week activities. In view of the fact that modern people pay attention to health care, this cooking class specifically teaches health-preserving vegetarian food: Wisdom Cake, Geely Rolls, and Xintian Ajie. The organizer invited famous chefs Luo Huili, Ji Fengyi, and Lei Wenyu of the famous vegetarian restaurant "Yueyi Xintian" to come to give demonstrations and provide recipes for guests to make. The chefs’ exquisite craftsmanship and witty explanations filled the scene with fragrance and laughter. During this period, a short video was played to introduce the nutrition and benefits of vegetarianism, and teach everyone how to understand soy sauce and choose cooking oil. Finally, a live demonstration of freshly baked health food was shared with all the guests. The 7 major events of the Orange Taiwan Heritage Week came to a successful conclusion on the evening of May 21 after the grand performance by the National Taiwan University of Arts' "Grand View Dance Theater" dance team at the Irvine Barclay Theater.

ecbc27a095934fbf3fce7a7dd1ccbbb6a747d345.sourceText: 中国越来越富强了。俗话说，安身才能立命，懂得这个道理的中国人先是一窝蜂地坐拥城市繁华，接着一窝蜂地享受田园风光。到如今，打房声四起，眼看中国的房市hold不住了，中国人又飘洋过海，寻寻觅觅，当然，隔壁的名古屋没法买，于是飘到美国，正好赶上美国房市筑底，乘以6点3之后出奇的便宜。腰缠万贯的中国人心里说：抄她的底赚钱，再用炒房来扰乱她的市场，一举两得。
ecbc27a095934fbf3fce7a7dd1ccbbb6a747d345.translatedText: >China is becoming more and more prosperous and powerful. As the saying goes, only by settling down can you build your life. Chinese people who understand this truth first swarm to enjoy the prosperity of the city, and then swarm to enjoy the pastoral scenery. Nowadays, the sound of house hunting is everywhere. Seeing that China's housing market can no longer hold, the Chinese people have traveled across the ocean to look for it. Of course, they can't buy it in Nagoya next door, so they moved to the United States, just in time for the U.S. housing market to bottom out. After multiplying by 6:3, it is surprisingly cheap. The rich Chinese people think in their hearts: Make money by copying her, and then use real estate speculation to disrupt her market, killing two birds with one stone.

b285091b982b372cae73adbac2dc1bf2ed73fb43.sourceText: 中国人是如何在美抢购华屋的呢？他们的标准和喜好又是怎样的呢？ 中国人在美国买屋呢，最要紧的就是新。中国人喜新厌旧，不破不立，看到旧的房子，想到将来要住在这样的房子里，顿时颜面尽失，捂着眼睛赶紧离开。美国人并不嫌弃旧，有时候还以旧为荣，觉得他们懂得保存和欣赏传统的设计和工艺。有的老房子出售时，专门凸显该房有近百年的悠久历史，强调原本的风格得以保留。这下好了，中美两国的购屋者各求所需，成了互补。 中国人在美国买屋呢，第二最要紧的就是地大。对于只拥有70年使用权、从未拥有过土地所有权的中国人来说，土地是何等的神圣！词后面加个”公”才足以表达敬意。有人把美国的荒地拿到中国拍卖，立即引起轰动和抢购，殊不知，可利用的土地就像钻石，不可利用的土地就像玻璃，一钱不值。在购买独立屋的时候，土地的确比较值钱，因为土地大就有加建的空间（可利用）；土地大容易保护隐私；土地大绿化好，也使环境更怡人。怪不得，当年欧阳修买房子的时候，也是先问经纪人”庭院深深深几许？”不过，好区地大成本就高，购买时应综合考量。 中国人在美国买屋呢，第三最要紧的就是外表气派。中国人生活的哲学叫面子哲学。房屋的外表就是面子，外表平庸会让人矮三分、挂不住。但中国人气派的标准与美国人不尽相同，中国人的气派常指欧式的建筑风格，尤其欣赏维多利亚式的风格，有装饰、有华柱、有圆拱，有尖顶，挑高，多窗，线条繁复多变。这样的外形当然豪华典雅。不过要面子，也要里子，有的夸张外形会影响内部的格局，例如一些?#39640;尖端?#30340;建筑，上层会出现倾斜天花板式的阁楼空间，相当浪费和别扭。所以，关注外表的同时也要关注内部的格局。 中国人在美国买屋呢，第四最要紧的就是学校好、华人多。为了有好邻居和好学校，孟母三迁。孟母若离乡背井，完成第四迁的壮举来到美国，却不能让孟子上一个更好的学校，那孟母还不手持剪刀、找掏钱买房的孟父算账？但令孟母迷惑的是，美国高品质的生活地区学校都不错，可是成绩好的学校并不一定是高品质的生活地区。这就像有前途的学生成绩都不错，但成绩不错的学生并不见得都有前途一样。所以孟子忍不住对他妈说，生活为重，成绩次之。来到美国的中国人听了孟子这番言论，拼命找寻华人聚居的城市，认为这样才有方便舒适的生活。中国话是不能不说滴，中国胃是无法改变滴，除了华人城市，哪儿能满足这样的条件？此外，现在华人城市的房价hold住了，比起跌跌不休的其他城市，华人区的房价最坚挺。中国人在很多方面是一盘散沙，可是在居住方面是相当有凝聚力滴。 中国人在美国买屋呢，第五最要紧的就是方位。中国人习惯于坐北朝南，生活的阴暗面看得太多，实在已经受不了了。原则上，早上的阳光是不可少的，下午的西晒是不能有的。但美国房子里众多的卧室及客厅分布在不同的方向，这个房间朝南，那个房间可能就朝东了。这时候，抓住主要矛盾就是中国人的拿手绝活了。 中国人在美国买屋呢，第六最要紧的就是砍价。美国佬对中国的购屋者是既爱又恨，爱的是中国买家有钱，恨的是凶狠的砍价习惯。中国人喜欢忽悠，能把20元钱的商品，标成2000元来卖，最后一刀见骨地砍下去，700元成交。买者觉得爽，卖者也窃喜。忽悠多了，真理的标准出现轻度的模糊。因此到了美国买屋，仍豪气不改，200万的房子，出价109万，几乎将卖家劈成两半。碰壁之后，下次见到200万的房子，终于放下屠刀、立地成佛，扭扭捏捏出价150万。
b285091b982b372cae73adbac2dc1bf2ed73fb43.translatedText: How do Chinese people snap up luxury houses in the United States? What are their standards and preferences? When Chinese people buy a house in the United States, the most important thing is newness. Chinese people like the new and hate the old. They don’t want to build things up, but when they see an old house and think about living in such a house in the future, they immediately lose their face and cover their eyes and leave quickly. Americans do not dislike the old, and sometimes are proud of it. They feel that they know how to preserve and appreciate traditional designs and craftsmanship. When some old houses are sold, they specifically emphasize that the house has a long history of nearly a hundred years and emphasize that the original style has been preserved. Now, homebuyers from China and the United States have different needs and have become complementary to each other. When Chinese people buy a house in the United States, the second most important thing is the size of the land. For the Chinese who only have 70 years of use rights and have never owned land, how sacred the land is! Adding "公" after the word is enough to express respect. Someone took American wasteland to China for auction, which immediately caused a sensation and rush to buy it. As everyone knows, usable land is like diamonds, and unusable land is like glass, worthless. When buying a detached house, land is indeed more valuable, because the land is large and there is room for expansion (available); the land is easy to protect privacy; the land is green and green, which also makes the environment more pleasant. No wonder, when Ouyang Xiu bought a house, he first asked the agent, "How deep is the courtyard?" However, the cost of a good area is high, so you should consider it comprehensively when buying. When Chinese people buy a house in the United States, the third most important thing is the appearance. The philosophy of Chinese people’s life is called face philosophy. The appearance of a house is the face of a house. A mediocre appearance will make a person look shorter and unattractive. However, Chinese standards of style are different from Americans. Chinese style often refers to European architectural styles, especially the Victorian style, which has decorations, ornate columns, round arches, spires, high ceilings, multiple windows, and complex and changeable lines. This appearance is certainly luxurious and elegant. However, you need both face and interior. Some exaggerated shapes will affect the internal layout. For example, in some cutting-edge buildings, there will be an attic space with a sloping ceiling on the upper floor, which is quite wasteful and awkward. Therefore, while paying attention to the appearance, you should also pay attention to the internal layout. When Chinese people buy a house in the United States, the fourth most important thing is good schools and a large number of Chinese people. In order to have good neighbors and good schools, Meng's mother moved three times. If Meng's mother left her hometown and completed the fourth move to the United States, but could not let Mencius go to a better school, then Meng's mother would not hold scissors and settle the score with Meng's father who paid for the house? But what confuses Meng's mother is that the schools in high-quality living areas in the United States are all good, but schools with good scores are not necessarily high-quality living areas. This is just like promising students with good grades, but not all students with good grades have a future. So Mencius couldn't help but tell his mother that life is the most important thing, and grades are secondary. The Chinese who came to the United States listened to Mencius's remarks and desperately looked for cities where Chinese people lived together, thinking that only in this way could they have a convenient and comfortable life. We must speak Chinese, and our Chinese stomach cannot be changed. Where else can such conditions be met except in Chinese cities? In addition, housing prices in Chinese cities are now holding up. Compared with other cities that are constantly falling, housing prices in Chinese districts are the strongest. The Chinese people are scattered in many ways, but they are quite cohesive when it comes to living. When Chinese people buy a house in the United States, the fifth most important thing is location. Chinese people are accustomed to sitting north and facing south. They have seen so many dark sides of life that they can no longer stand it. In principle, morning sunlight is indispensable, and afternoon western sun is not allowed. However, many bedrooms and living rooms in American houses are distributed in different directions. This room faces south, and that room may face east. At this time, grasping the main contradiction is a unique skill of the Chinese. When Chinese people buy a house in the United States, the sixth most important thing is to negotiate the price. Americans love and hate Chinese home buyers. They love them because they are rich, but they hate them because of their aggressive bargaining habits. Chinese people like to deceive. They can mark a product worth 20 yuan as 2,000 yuan and sell it, then cut it off with a sharp knife, and the deal is sold for 700 yuan. Buyers feel happy, and sellers are also happy. With too much deception, the standard of truth becomes slightly blurred. Therefore, when he came to the United States to buy a house, he still maintained his arrogance. For a house worth 2 million, he offered 1.09 million, which almost split the seller in half. After hitting a wall, the next time I saw a house worth 2 million, I finally put down my butcher knife, became a Buddha on the spot, and reluctantly bid 1.5 million.

1d741a07a19488428101a824d0bdc373da66e2b9.sourceText: 美国人做生意忽悠不忽悠？也忽悠，但不会把自己忽悠到市场范围之外。经纪人在卖主确定房价之前，一般都要提供一份市场分析报告，价格是根据同一地区最近销售的统计来确定的，当然上下也有空间，但定价太高，房子可能完全无人问津。正确的做法是，在抽刀之前，先让经纪人提供一份市场分析，看看这个房子的定价是低于市场、还是高于市场，若是高于市场，高多少？根据这个数字，再加上实地考察的感觉，再加上挥刀猛砍的惯性，给出一个砍肉不砍骨的价钱。 以上就是中国人来美买屋的特点，总的来说是英明的，但也掺杂者迷思。 相比之下，美国人买屋大多遵循他们自己的简单黄金定律：地点、地点、还是地点。你可以这么理解，头一个地点是大的区域范围，例如要选气候宜人、有山有海、房价跌幅较深的地区，可能会选南加州或佛罗里达州。第二个地点是城市和社区。第三个地点是地段、街区和房屋的具体位置。但你也可以这么理解，美国人没有几千年的文化，讲不出个所以然，只好重复这个词：地点、地点、地点。 美国加州购屋秘笈之一：现款买屋要做哪些准备？
1d741a07a19488428101a824d0bdc373da66e2b9.translatedText: Do Americans cheat when doing business? They also deceive, but they will not deceive themselves beyond the scope of the market. Before the seller determines the house price, the agent usually provides a market analysis report. The price is determined based on recent sales statistics in the same area. Of course, there is room for higher and lower prices, but if the price is too high, the house may be completely uninterested. The correct approach is to ask the agent to provide a market analysis before taking the knife to see if the house is priced lower than the market or higher than the market. If it is higher than the market, by how much? Based on this number, coupled with the feeling of on-the-spot investigation, and the inertia of slashing with a knife, a price is given for cutting the meat without cutting the bones. The above are the characteristics of Chinese people coming to the United States to buy houses. Generally speaking, they are wise, but they are also mixed with myths. By contrast, Americans mostly follow their own simple golden rule when buying a home: location, location, location. You can understand that the first location is a large area. For example, if you want to choose an area with a pleasant climate, mountains and seas, and a deep decline in housing prices, you may choose Southern California or Florida. The second location is cities and communities. The third location is the specific location of the lot, neighborhood, and house. But you can also understand it this way. Americans don’t have thousands of years of culture, so they can’t explain why. They have to repeat this word: place, place, place. One of the tips for buying a house in California, USA: What preparations should be made to buy a house with cash?

ff46e9d80de3e0391c22fb568162a8a5f93fcda2.sourceText: （1） 押金支票。押金一般是房价的1%到3%之间，出价时先不会兑现，只向卖家提供支票影印本。买卖双方谈完条件、互相接受之后，这张支票才会真正存入过户公证公司。所以到了美国，应该先在当地凭护照开一个银行账户。 （2） 银行存款证明。美国现款买房，为了证明有支付能力，一般都要提供银行存款证明，简单的操作就是自己上网到账户中打印。中国国内银行的流水单也可以，但最好经过银行盖章。 美国加州购屋秘笈之二：现款买屋的程序如何？ （1） 找当地可靠又有经验的房地产经纪人。 （2） 经纪人带去看房。 （3） 看中了房子，由经纪人帮助分析房价，填写出价合约，加上押金支票影印本和银行存款证明一起递交给卖方经纪人。 （4） 双方经纪人之间谈判包括价钱在内的各种条件，讨价还价。 （5） 双方达成一致之后，展开过户，押金支票交给过户公司兑现。 （6） 买方了解和调查屋况、产权、环境、屋主协会规定等等。 （7） 签署过户文件，填写各类表格。 （8） 若没有大问题，则去除退出条款。 （9） 完成承诺的各项协议内容（例如修理）。 （10） 电汇尾款。 （11） 最后再检查一遍房屋。 （12） 政府登记，完成过户手续。 （13） 交钥匙。 美国加州购屋秘笈之三：现款买屋有何费用？
ff46e9d80de3e0391c22fb568162a8a5f93fcda2.translatedText: (1) Deposit check. The deposit is generally between 1% and 3% of the house price. It will not be cashed when making an offer, and only a copy of the check will be provided to the seller. After the buyer and seller negotiate the terms and accept each other, the check will actually be deposited into the transfer notary company. So when you arrive in the United States, you should first open a bank account there with your passport. (2) Bank deposit certificate. When buying a house with cash in the United States, in order to prove your ability to pay, you generally need to provide a bank deposit certificate. The simple operation is to go online and print it from your account. A statement from a domestic bank in China is also acceptable, but it is best to have it stamped by the bank. Tip 2 for buying a house in California, USA: What is the procedure for buying a house with cash? (1) Find a reliable and experienced local real estate agent. (2) The agent takes you to see the property. (3) After you have taken a fancy to the house, the agent will help analyze the house price, fill out the offer contract, and submit it to the seller's agent together with a copy of the deposit check and bank deposit certificate. (4) The brokers of both parties negotiate various conditions including price and bargain. (5) After both parties reach an agreement, the transfer will begin and the deposit check will be handed over to the transfer company for cashing. (6) The buyer understands and investigates the condition of the house, property rights, environment, homeowners association regulations, etc. (7) Sign transfer documents and fill in various forms. (8) If there are no major problems, remove the exit clause. (9) Complete all promised agreement contents (such as repairs). (10) Final payment via wire transfer. (11) Check the house one last time. (12) Government registration and completion of transfer procedures. (13) Turnkey. Tip 3 on buying a house in California, USA: What are the costs of buying a house with cash?

cbf83a9b20880a2185b072cfbbe5f38956fed747.sourceText: 买屋除了房价之外还有各类手续费，买家需要支付的费用有过户费、保险费，房屋检查费，等等。买家绝对不需要付的是佣金（由卖家来付）。有的费用，例如交易税、环境灾害报告费、屋主协会手续费、杀白蚁、房屋保修等，都是可以谈判决定由谁负担的。另外，房地产税和屋主协会月费需要按过户时间来分割缴纳自己的部分。以一个50万美元的房子为例，买家要付的手续费（若不算房地产税和屋主协会月费分割），可能是两千到四千美元之间。 美国加州购屋秘笈之四：现款买下房屋后，后续维持的费用有哪些？
cbf83a9b20880a2185b072cfbbe5f38956fed747.translatedText: In addition to the house price, there are various handling fees. The fees that buyers need to pay include transfer fees, insurance premiums, home inspection fees, etc. What the buyer absolutely does not have to pay is the commission (which is paid by the seller). Some fees, such as transaction taxes, environmental hazard reporting fees, homeowners association fees, termite removal, home warranty, etc., can be negotiated to determine who pays. In addition, real estate taxes and homeowners association monthly fees need to be divided and paid according to the transfer time. Taking a $500,000 home as an example, the fees a buyer has to pay (not counting real estate taxes and monthly homeowners association fees) may be between $2,000 and $4,000. Tip 4 for buying a house in California, USA: After buying a house with cash, what are the subsequent maintenance costs?

3d279aaaeb2537b461c79b405c7db7d20db02f0c.sourceText: 大凤凰城城区新房的均价从五月的$305000降低到$292000. 新房或者二手房的卖家都降低了自己的逾期。全凤凰城，二手房的销售均价最近徘徊在$205000。 房地产分析师表示他们没有对新房价格持续飙升，抱很大希望，除非买房需求发生大的变化。六月Meritage Homes销售95个新房，成为凤凰城销售最好的建筑商，位于东南部 San Tan Valley 社区的新房最受买家欢迎。 与此同时 房屋租金在缓慢上升。 现在签署出租合同，就已经不太容易。六月公寓的租金为$820每个月，而同样的公寓五月$817.2013年6月租金仅为$783。租金的价格有可能会比较快稳定下来，因为越来越多的新公寓正在建设。去年大约2900套的公寓在凤凰城建设。今年5500个公寓建成以及在建设中。租金上涨的趋势，应该会很快稳定下来。更多地产新闻请咨询Tinna 电话 480-287-0180 E-mail： goldtrustrealty2010@ gmail.com
3d279aaaeb2537b461c79b405c7db7d20db02f0c.translatedText: The average price of new homes in the greater Phoenix area has dropped from $305,000 in May to $292,000. Sellers of new or existing homes have lowered their past dues. Across Phoenix, the average sales price of a second-hand home has recently hovered at $205,000. Real estate analysts say they don't have high hopes that new home prices will continue to surge unless demand for homes changes significantly. Meritage Homes sold 95 new homes in June, making it the top-selling builder in Phoenix, with new homes in the southeastern San Tan Valley neighborhood the most popular among buyers. At the same time, housing rents are slowly rising. Signing a rental contract is no longer easy. The rent for an apartment in June was $820 per month, while the same apartment rented for $817 in May. The rent in June 2013 was only $783. Rental prices are likely to stabilize relatively quickly because more and more new apartments are being built. About 2,900 apartments were built in Phoenix last year. This year 5,500 apartments were built and under construction. The trend of rising rents should stabilize soon. 9f38be3958eb214c2dcd3865a787d920214fe719.sourceText: 手提行李超重 国内航线拟收费 节日期间飞行的旅客，手提行李若装满了礼物就要三思，以避免交纳行李托运费。 航空公司除规定详尽的托运费外，有的公司还严查手提行李是否超重，如在登机口查出超重，旅客可能受到重罚。 手提行李的重量限制通常主要是国际航班执行，但机票观察专家霍比卡说，国内航线对手提行李收取的超重费，可能为期已不遥远。 手提行李限重的实际原因，就是万一发生事故时，可限制航空公司的责任，如较重的行李跌落后砸了某人。 航空公司总有增加收入的办法。面对国会的压力，主要航空公司今年初发誓决不对手提行李收费，但他们不排除对手提行李的限重趋严。 对于国内航班的手提行李，没有一家主要航空公司规定了重量高限。但许多国际航线都有，如联航(United)规定，飞往亚洲和中东地区的班机，手提行李限重44磅。美航(American)是飞往加勒比海和拉美的航班，手提行李限重50磅。航空公司对国际航班的一件托运行李不收费，但托运一件行李后手提行李若仍超重，就可能遇到麻烦。托运第二件行李可能要60或70元。 英国和德国航空公司对手提行李都有限重规定，从18磅到50磅不等，但多数公司规定可免费托运一件行李。 有的航空公司规定了手提行李的限重，和托运一件行李也要收费。如夏威夷航空公司飞往北美地区的航班，规定手提行李不能超过25磅，托运一件行李收费25元。 节日期间哪怕行李不超重，航空公司也会让旅客托运更多的行李，以清出机舱空间。因此旅客要把行李中的贵重物品提前包好，以便万一行李需要托运时，可随时取出随身携带，避免托运期间可能丢失。
9f38be3958eb214c2dcd3865a787d920214fe719.translatedText: Domestic routes plan to charge fees for overweight hand luggage Passengers flying during the holidays should think twice if their hand luggage is filled with gifts to avoid paying baggage check fees. In addition to stipulating detailed checked fees, airlines also strictly check whether hand luggage is overweight. If overweight is found at the boarding gate, passengers may be severely fined. The weight limit for carry-on baggage is usually enforced mainly on international flights, but ticket observer expert Hobika said that the overweight fee charged for carry-on baggage on domestic routes may not be far away. The practical reason for carry-on baggage limits is to limit the airline's liability in the event of an accident, such as a heavier bag falling and hitting someone. Airlines always have ways to increase revenue. Facing pressure from Congress, major airlines vowed earlier this year never to charge for carry-on baggage, but they have not ruled out tightening baggage weight limits. No major airline has a maximum weight limit for carry-on luggage on domestic flights. But many international routes have it. For example, United Airlines (United) stipulates that flights to Asia and the Middle East have a carry-on baggage limit of 44 pounds. American Airlines (American) flies to the Caribbean and Latin America, and the carry-on baggage limit is 50 pounds. Airlines don't charge for a checked bag on international flights, but if your carry-on bag is still overweight after checking one bag, you could run into trouble. It may cost 60 or 70 yuan to check a second bag. British and German airlines have weight limits for carry-on luggage, ranging from 18 pounds to 50 pounds, but most companies allow one checked bag to be checked for free. Some airlines have set weight limits for carry-on luggage and charge for checking a piece of luggage. For example, Hawaiian Airlines' flights to North America stipulate that hand luggage cannot exceed 25 pounds, and a checked baggage fee is 25 yuan. Even if the luggage is not overweight during the holidays, airlines will let passengers check in more luggage to clear space in the cabin. Therefore, passengers should pack the valuables in their luggage in advance so that if their luggage needs to be checked in, they can take it out with them at any time to avoid possible loss during check-in.

3178b8bad48c73736680f5ae0a988712c43679e8.sourceText: 金信地产：调查揭示买房的五个秘密 如今买房者都希望清楚了解到房地产市场的真实情况，但是有一些问题，在购买过程中还是让买家困惑，一项新的调查在Zillow网站进行，对1000个潜在的买房者进行了调查。调查揭示了如下五个秘密。 1 升值 有42%的买房者相信房子的价值每年升值7%，实际上房屋价值在普通的市场情况下升值每年2-5%。 2 按揭保险 41%的买家认为他们不得不购买按揭保险，无论他们的首付是多少。实际上只有首付低于20%的买家才需要购买个人按揭保险。 3 房屋评估 56%的买家说房屋评估的目的就是看看所购买的房屋是否处于良好的状态。实际上，这只是房屋评估的一个目的，还有一个更重要的目的是评估交易价格是否符合现在的市场价值，房屋交易价格高于房屋本身的市场价值，买家可以退出交易。 4 房主保险 37%的买家认为购买房主保险是一个选项，实际上是贷款公司要求房主购买房主保险。 5 所有权 47%的买家认为在签完购买合同后，他们就拥有的房子。实际上，签署购买合同只是这个变更所有权的开始，直到买家真正获得所有权还需要一段时间。更多房地产信息请咨询Tinna （480）287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
3178b8bad48c73736680f5ae0a988712c43679e8.translatedText: Jinxin Real Estate: Investigation reveals five secrets of buying a house Today's homebuyers want a clear picture of what's going on in the real estate market, but there are some issues that still confuse buyers during the buying process, according to a new Zillow survey of 1,000 potential homebuyers. The investigation revealed the following five secrets. 1 Appreciation: 42% of home buyers believe that the value of the house will appreciate by 7% per year. In fact, the value of the house will appreciate by 2-5% per year under ordinary market conditions. 2 Mortgage Insurance 41% of buyers feel they have to purchase mortgage insurance regardless of the size of their down payment. In fact, only buyers with a down payment of less than 20% are required to purchase personal mortgage insurance. 3 Home Appraisal 56% of buyers said the purpose of a home appraisal is to see if the home they are buying is in good condition. In fact, this is just one purpose of house appraisal. There is also a more important purpose to evaluate whether the transaction price is in line with the current market value. The transaction price of the house is higher than the market value of the house itself, and the buyer can withdraw from the transaction. 4. Homeowner’s Insurance: 37% of buyers think that purchasing homeowners insurance is an option, but in fact, the mortgage company requires homeowners to purchase homeowners insurance. 5 Ownership 47% of buyers believe they own the home after signing the purchase contract. In fact, signing the purchase contract is just the beginning of this change of ownership, and it will take some time until the buyer actually takes ownership. 58a618dceaa1c4fd9640aba862bc97b50c28ca09.translatedText: Phoenix Chinese Center for Senior Citizens celebrates Thanksgiving (Contributed by Cui Zengqi) The annual Thanksgiving Day is here again. The Chinese Senior Citizens Center held an event ahead of schedule on October 19th...

765e59bab233beaae963130316d655d378218936.sourceText: （崔增祁供稿）一年一度的感恩节又到了。华人耆英中心提前在10月19日举行了热闹的庆祝活动，老人们聚集在明朗的大厅里，穿上节日的服装，照例广东话合唱团和国语合唱团分别献唱了为节日准备的赞颂和感恩的歌曲，一些个人独唱和小提琴演奏等精彩节目穿插其中，人们欢欣地跳起了排列舞，参加跳舞的人越来越多，人们挤在一起，随着音乐节拍，忽而向左，忽而向右，忽而跳跃转身，忽而婀娜摇曳，人们忘记了自己的年龄，一张张笑脸展示出他们内心的无比喜悦。是啊，老人们生活在美国无忧无虑，多麽幸福！感恩苍天！感恩上帝！感恩美国！感恩养育我们成长的祖国。中午，厨师们为大家准备了精心的午餐。主菜当然是火鸡，配上绿色的江豆，还有南瓜派和蛋糕，这是典型的感恩节大餐，再加上耆英会手工组的朋友们用做手工积累的钱为每人送上一块炸鸡。说句实话，这一天的火鳮做得味道特别鲜美，这一切让人们把平时对伙食不满的意见都暂时忘却了。 感恩节对大多数华人来讲过去都不太知道，在中国时没有感恩节，在美国却是一个大的节日。全国放徦两天，家庭团聚、Mercy彩车𨔼行、黑色星期五的大减价、人们争相採购，好不热闹。有点像中国的中秋节或是春节，但又不全像。 说”’感恩”，那是人类共同的良知，是生活中的大智慧。无论你是东方人还是西方人，无论你是甚麽肤色，信奉甚麽教义， 人们都懂得感谢苍天和大自然的给予，感谢父母的含莘茹苦，感谢兄弟手足之情和朋友同事的真诚的关怀和友谊。”知恩图报”、”滴水之恩，涌泉相报”、”吃水不忘掘井人”等中国人留传的这些美言佳句正是体现了感恩的真情。在生活中，享受着美好的’给予’，也要努力去回报社会、回报朋友，克制贪婪之心，譲生活更美好和谐。感恩是一种真情，不应被误导变成对上级对领导人拍马屁以至送礼受贿的工具。封建时期盛行的”皇恩浩荡”、”谢主隆恩”。流传至今人民要感谢党，感谢政府，感谢上级领导等本不应在感恩范畴之列。在美国，我没有听到过美国人感谢民主党、感谢共和党和感谢政府这些谀美之词，更多的倒是批评和指责。他们认为从国家领导人到每一个公职人员都是纳税人供养的，做好工作是他们的职责所在。不同国家和地区的文化差异的表现竟然会如此根深蒂固，我们华人身在美国仍有人时不时地把这些传统观念带入到了现实生活中。
765e59bab233beaae963130316d655d378218936.translatedText: (Contributed by Cui Zengqi) The annual Thanksgiving Day is here again. The Chinese Elderly Center held a lively celebration in advance on October 19th. The elderly gathered in the bright hall and put on festive costumes. As usual, the Cantonese choir and the Mandarin choir sang songs of praise and thanksgiving prepared for the festival respectively. Some individual solos and violin performances were also exciting. Interspersed with the program, people danced the array dance happily, and more and more people participated in the dance. People crowded together, and followed the beat of the music, sometimes turning to the left, sometimes to the right, jumping and turning, and sometimes swaying gracefully. People forgot their age, and the smiling faces showed the incomparable joy in their hearts. Yes, the old people live carefree in the United States, how happy they are! Thank you heaven! Thank God! Thank you America! Thanks to the motherland that raised us. At noon, the chefs prepared a delicious lunch for everyone. The main dish is of course turkey, with green beans, pumpkin pie and cake. This is a typical Thanksgiving meal. In addition, friends from the craft group of the Senior Citizens Association use the money accumulated from crafting to give each person a piece of fried chicken. To be honest, the hotpot cooked on this day tasted particularly delicious, which made people temporarily forget their usual dissatisfaction with the food. Most Chinese people didn’t know much about Thanksgiving in the past. There was no Thanksgiving in China, but it is a big holiday in the United States. There is a two-day national holiday, family reunions, Mercy float parades, Black Friday sales, and people rushing to buy, it's so lively. It's a bit like the Chinese Mid-Autumn Festival or the Spring Festival, but not exactly the same. Saying "Thanksgiving" is the common conscience of mankind and the great wisdom in life. No matter you are an Easterner or a Westerner, no matter what your skin color is, or what creed you believe in, people all know how to thank heaven and nature for their blessings, their parents for their hardships, their brotherhood, and their friends and colleagues’ sincere care and friendship. These beautiful words passed down by Chinese people such as "Repay kindness with kindness", "Repay kindness with a drop of water with a spring of spring", "Never forget the man who dug the well when drinking water", embody the true feelings of gratitude. In life, while enjoying the wonderful "giving", we must also work hard to repay society and friends, restrain our greed, and live a more beautiful and harmonious life. Gratitude is a true feeling and should not be misled into a tool for flattering superiors and leaders or even giving gifts and accepting bribes. "The emperor's favor is mighty" and "Thanks to the Lord for his kindness" that were popular in the feudal period. It has been passed down to this day that people want to thank the party, the government, and superior leaders, which should not be included in the category of gratitude. In the United States, I have never heard flattering words from Americans thanking the Democratic Party, the Republican Party, or the government. Instead, I have heard more criticism and accusations. They believe that every public official, from national leaders to every public official, is supported by taxpayers and it is their duty to do a good job. The cultural differences between different countries and regions are so deep-rooted that some of us Chinese in the United States still bring these traditional concepts into real life from time to time.

427a488e049075795599f736dd7c6797a7f78179.sourceText: 一年一度的”中国周”传统排球赛事落下帷幕。6支球队经过15轮激烈的比赛冠亚军各归其主。TCBC连续第三年夺得冠军，Rocky Point 球队获得第二名。赛后，许多参赛队员意犹未尽，都希望每年能够举行2-3次这样的比赛。
427a488e049075795599f736dd7c6797a7f78179.translatedText: The annual "China Week" traditional volleyball event has come to an end. After 15 rounds of fierce competition, the 6 teams won the championship and the runner-up. TCBC won the championship for the third consecutive year, with the Rocky Point team finishing second. After the game, many participating team members were still unsatisfied and hoped to hold such competitions 2-3 times a year.

4fa20b947fad8b5e00004764fbaf9aa950b93904.sourceText: 亚省时报参加海外华文媒体人员业务研修班 为了加强世界华文媒体之间的联系，提高华人媒体的竞争力，最终能为提升中国国际传播能力，增强中国国家文化软实力和国际话语权作出独特贡献，世界华文媒体合作联盟与中国新闻社在国务院侨办的直接指导下，将于 5 月 4 日举办 2011 年第一期海外华文媒体采编人员业务研修班。亚省时报副社长甄凯婴，新闻主管谢成彦将赴北京，成都参加此次培训，为期 11 天。培训分为专题讲座，理论教学，采访考察三个部分。采访考察部分，所有学员将深入汶川震区探访灾区民众，关注灾后重建的成果，届时还将发回学习和采访的相关文章。
4fa20b947fad8b5e00004764fbaf9aa950b93904.translatedText: The Alberta Times participates in the business training class for overseas Chinese media personnel. In order to strengthen the connections between Chinese media in the world, improve the competitiveness of Chinese media, and ultimately make a unique contribution to improving China’s international communication capabilities and enhancing China’s national cultural soft power and international discourse power, the World Chinese Media Cooperation Alliance and China News Service, under the direct guidance of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council, will hold the first business training class for overseas Chinese media acquisition and editing personnel on May 4, 2011. The deputy president of the Alberta Times, Zhen Kaiying, and the news director, Xie Chengyan, will go to Beijing and Chengdu to participate in this training for 11 days. The training is divided into three parts: special lectures, theoretical teaching, and interviews. In the interview and inspection part, all trainees will go deep into the Wenchuan earthquake area to visit people in the disaster area and pay attention to the results of post-disaster reconstruction. Articles related to their studies and interviews will also be sent back.

05982a2b90a4c32b0ed5e1f5309ba5cf02058014.sourceText: 金信地产：选一个好社区需要考虑的问题 大部分人在买房子都只注意户型，房屋价格常常忽略了社区问题。社区环境将直接影响房屋的价值。买房时，选一个好社区非常重要，在买房的时候如何做社区的研究呢？需求，无论是个人的需求，还是社会习惯的需求。这些因素都将影响你居住的质量。 首先，社区的安全性。 例如，在很多昂贵的社区，与一些出租屋或者公寓相邻，并不是说这样就会出问题，但是一些盗窃，或者破坏的小犯罪，就比较容易发生，购买者最好到警察局查询犯罪率。 接着需要查询的就是性侵害犯罪，看看是否有性侵犯的罪犯住在这个小区。这可能也不一定说明这里就会发生，但是了解到更多的事实，可以帮助做一个明智的决定。 第三确定学区。孩子上学是非常关键的问题，它也与房屋保值性有紧密的关系。例如钱德勒的凯伦社区就是一知名的学校著称，保值率一直都很好。 第四个需要咨询的问题就是购物场所，作为家庭经常买菜，买生活用品的超市，加油站是否在附近，或者是自己喜欢的健身中心或娱乐中心。 为了选到好的社区，买家应该尽量收集多的事实，例如这个社区内房屋的跌价率，有多少房子在亏欠，出租的房屋多，还是自住的房屋多等等，这些因素都会影响未来房屋价格的走向。 最后你最好到社区亲自看看，问问已经居住在那里的屋主，在这个小区生活感觉如何，如果你幸运的话，会收集到很多非常有参考价值的信息。更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的Tinna(480)287-0180E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com。
05982a2b90a4c32b0ed5e1f5309ba5cf02058014.translatedText: Jinxin Real Estate: Issues to consider when choosing a good community Most people only pay attention to the size of the apartment when buying a house, and the price of the house often ignores community issues. The community environment will directly affect the value of the home. When buying a house, it is very important to choose a good community. How to do community research when buying a house? Needs, whether personal needs or social customary needs. These factors will affect the quality of your residence. First, the safety of the community. For example, in many expensive communities, being adjacent to some rental houses or apartments does not mean that this will cause problems, but some minor crimes such as theft or vandalism are more likely to occur. Buyers are advised to go to the police station to check the crime rate. The next thing you need to check is sexual assault crimes to see if there are any sexual assault criminals living in this community. This may not necessarily mean that it will happen here, but knowing more facts can help make an informed decision. Third determine the school district. Children's schooling is a very critical issue, and it is also closely related to the value preservation of the house. For example, Karen Community in Chandler is known for its well-known schools and has always had a very good value retention rate. The fourth question that needs to be consulted is the shopping place. As a family, whether the supermarket where you often buy food and daily necessities, the gas station is nearby, or whether it is your favorite fitness center or entertainment center. In order to choose a good community, buyers should try to collect as many facts as possible, such as the price decline rate of houses in this community, how many houses are in debt, whether there are more rental houses or owner-occupied houses, etc. These factors will affect the future direction of house prices. Finally, you'd better go to the community to see for yourself and ask the homeowners who already live there how it feels to live in this community. If you are lucky, you will collect a lot of very valuable information. For more information about real estate, please contact Tinna of Goldtrust Realty (480) 287-0180E-mail: Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com.

c0a4e5c48f0d468c3e49a2004093c7d7d818e104.sourceText: 有亚利桑那州交通委员会成员提醒，今年夏天以来的沙尘暴不仅对本州环境造成极大破坏，也对交通带来不便，10号州际公路因沙尘暴造成的致命车祸应该引起大家注意。 交委会成员史提夫克里斯蒂在上周的一次会议告诉他的同僚，驾车人士和地主有权提前知道沙尘暴的来源和方向，以减少事故发生。 亚利桑那州运输部下属一个”沙尘专责小组”正在寻找各种解决方案，包括查明事故易发地点，提高风暴预测，安装粉尘检测和扬沙警告等。 克里斯蒂自三年前加入委员会以来，一直推动这个议题。今年10月一场沙尘暴在10号公路导致包括两名青少年在内的三人死亡车祸更坚定了他争取这个计划实施的决心。
c0a4e5c48f0d468c3e49a2004093c7d7d818e104.translatedText: A member of the Arizona Transportation Commission reminded that the sandstorms this summer have not only caused great damage to the state's environment, but also caused inconvenience to transportation. The fatal car accident caused by sandstorms on Interstate 10 should attract everyone's attention. TTC member Steve Christie told his colleagues at a meeting last week that motorists and landowners have the right to know the source and direction of dust storms in advance to reduce accidents. A "Dust Task Force" affiliated with the Arizona Department of Transportation is looking for a variety of solutions, including identifying accident-prone locations, improving storm forecasts, and installing dust detection and blowing sand warnings. Christie has pushed the issue since joining the committee three years ago. In October this year, a sandstorm killed three people, including two teenagers, in a car accident on Highway 10, which strengthened his determination to implement the plan.

aed7deb7a4f6a79191514bb3160b2e19924cc36e.sourceText: 百人同庆美国亚省开平同乡互助会成立一周年（组图） 两个巨型大蛋糕 八只烧猪，近十种美食 无数精彩节目 百人同庆美国亚省开平同乡互助会成立一周年 （亚省时报） 4月1日下午1时，数百开平同乡会成员及好友来到凤凰城耆英会庆祝美国亚省开平同乡互助会成立一周年暨2012年开平同乡会春宴。资深侨领余文劲，开平同乡会名誉会长关宗任，会长甄硕钦，华裔女众议院余艳芬，台湾驻洛杉矶台北经济文化办事处主任高家富主任，大凤凰城华人侨团总会前会长邓朝驹，会长张华芳，国民党亚利桑那直属分部常务委员王玮王亭，美莎开平姐妹市主席黄智杰，亚省中餐馆会会长杨振纲等嘉宾都参加了活动。美食，精彩节目伴随大家度过了一个愉快的下午，也为2012年带来了好兆头。 雄壮威武的醒狮舞揭开了活动的序幕，主持人张华芳，关兆峰邀请了资深侨领余文劲上台致辞，余文劲说在侨社能有八只烧猪来款待嘉宾的春宴还是第一回，实在是个大礼，非常难得，也预祝一岁的开平同乡会如耆英会的老人一样长命百岁。华裔女众议院余艳芬也表示非常感谢大家邀请她参加这么有传统意义的活动。会长甄硕钦感谢来宾对开平同乡会的支持，这是一个很幼嫩的组织，也更希望大家多提宝贵意见，让这些协会更健康的成长起来。甄会长表示以前宗亲聚会都是分烧猪祭祖，现在时代变了，依然可以保持分烧猪庆祝节日的传统，难能可贵。八只烧猪被分为若干小块，让每家每户都可以尝到这个广东特色菜，开平同乡会秘书长余江英，多那之糕饼店送来了两个共百人食用的生日大蛋糕。台湾挺马助选后援团的美女们把《阿里山的姑娘》唱到了会场，他们整齐着装，边唱边跳，和嘉宾们一起合影留念，非常热闹。开平的特色小曲”欢迎你到开平来”是将方言和音乐结合起来了，让来宾听听八个音调的乡音小调。在聚会中开平同乡会还评出了5位优秀的开平年轻人，获得开平同乡会的奖学金。 下午3时多，来宾们仍旧沉浸在美妙的粤曲中，依依不舍，还是要相互告别，相约中秋大家再欢聚。 美国开平同乡互助会是去年4月成立的凤凰城社团，创始人开平同乡会现任主席甄硕钦。在去年中秋举办了近400人的中秋聚会，社区凡响热烈。开平同乡会致力于同乡互助，交流友情，是在社区非常活跃的团体。
aed7deb7a4f6a79191514bb3160b2e19924cc36e.translatedText: Hundreds of people celebrate the first anniversary of the Kaiping Mutual Aid Association in the U.S. Province of Alberta (photo) Two giant cakes, eight roast pigs, nearly ten kinds of delicacies, countless exciting programs Hundreds of people celebrate the first anniversary of the Kaiping Mutual Aid Association in the U.S. Province of Alberta (Alberta Times) At 1 p.m. on April 1, hundreds of members and friends of the Kaiping Association came to the Phoenix Senior Citizens Association to celebrate the first anniversary of the Kaiping Mutual Aid Association of Alberta and the 2012 Kaiping Association Spring Banquet. Senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin, honorary president of the Kaiping Association Guan Zongren, president Zhen Shuoqin, Chinese-American female member of the House of Representatives Yu Yanfen, director of the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Los Angeles, Director Gao Jiafu, former president of the Chinese Overseas Chinese Association of Greater Phoenix City Deng Chaoju, president Zhang Huafang, standing committee member of the Arizona branch of the Kuomintang Wang Wei Wangting, Mesa Kaiping sister city chairman Huang Zhijie, and the president of the Chinese Restaurant Association of Alberta Yang Zhengang and other guests attended the event. Everyone spent a pleasant afternoon with delicious food and exciting programs, which also brought good omens for 2012. The majestic lion dance kicked off the event. Hosts Zhang Huafang and Guan Zhaofeng invited senior overseas Chinese leader Yu Wenjin to give a speech. Yu Wenjin said that this was the first spring banquet in the overseas Chinese community where eight roast pigs were entertained for the guests. It was a great gift and very rare. He also wished the one-year-old Kaiping Association a long life like the elders of the Senior Citizens Association. Yu Yanfen, a Chinese-American female member of the House of Representatives, also expressed her gratitude to everyone for inviting her to participate in such a traditional event. President Zhen Shuoqin thanked the guests for their support of the Kaiping Association. This is a very young organization, and he also hopes that everyone can provide more valuable opinions to help these associations grow more healthily. Chairman Zhen said that in the past, when clan gatherings were held, pigs were roasted to worship ancestors. Now that times have changed, it is commendable that the tradition of roasting pigs to celebrate festivals can still be maintained. Eight roast pigs were divided into small pieces so that every household can taste this Cantonese specialty. Yu Jiangying, secretary-general of the Kaiping Association, and Donazhi Pastry Shop sent two large birthday cakes that could be eaten by a hundred people. The beauties from the Taiwan Horse Racing Support Group sang "Girls from Alishan" to the venue. They were neatly dressed, sang and danced, and took photos with the guests. It was very lively. Kaiping's characteristic ditty "Welcome to Kaiping" combines dialect and music, allowing guests to listen to the eight-tone local ditty. During the gathering, the Kaiping Association also selected five outstanding young people from Kaiping who received scholarships from the Kaiping Association. At around 3 o'clock in the afternoon, the guests were still immersed in the wonderful Cantonese opera, reluctant to leave each other, and still wanted to say goodbye to each other and meet again during the Mid-Autumn Festival. The Kaiping Mutual Aid Association of the United States is a Phoenix society established in April last year. The founder of the Kaiping Mutual Aid Association is Zhen Shuoqin, the current chairman of the Kaiping Association. During last year's Mid-Autumn Festival, a Mid-Autumn Festival party for nearly 400 people was held, which was very popular in the community. The Kaiping Association is dedicated to helping fellow villagers and exchanging friendships. It is a very active group in the community.
