05bd98cc8df132b5734b4524be6ad410840b9822.sourceText: 华裔老年人在凤凰城 （亚省时报） 无疑美国是一个非常多元化的国家。在美国，你随处可见各种肤色的人，领略不同的文化。大部分在美国生活过的人都会觉得美国的生活很平静。的确，表面上你所能看到的美国是交织的高速，飞驰的汽车，空荡的街道，林立的高楼。然而，在这背后，你很难想像到这样一群人的挣扎与无助。 首先，介绍一下我自己。我来自四川凉山。2009年9月来美国做高中交换学生。目前是是亚利桑那州立大学克朗凯特新闻学院的大二学生。从我上大学的第一学期起，我有幸能加入亚利桑那州立大学社会工作学系助理教授孙飞博士的关于华人家庭如何照料阿尔茨海默患者的研究项目。可能和其他很多来美国学习的中国学生一样，我一直以为在美国的华人都应该过着比较富足的生活。然而，并不是所有移民来美国的华人都能够过上所谓的富足的美国生活。相反，很多华人，特别是一些老人，都过着非常艰苦的生活。对于一些家中有阿尔茨海默病人的华人来说，生活更是充满挑战。 为了研究需要，我们需要至少25个正在照料阿尔茨海默病人的家庭照料者。起初，我不敢想像我们能够在凤凰城找到这么多的家庭。一是因为，我对这个疾病了解的很少，认为这个不常见。二是，我以为在凤凰城的华人社区里这样的家庭应该不多。当然，寻找这样的家庭不容易，因为在这边华人都很分散。 为了找到这样的家庭，我们联系了很多华人机构，也接触了很多老年人。因为语言幛碍，文化差异,在这边的老年人，除了去教会或者老年中心，就是待在家里。他们没有更多可以做的。他们也不能像国内的老年人一样享受与家人的天伦之乐，因为在美国，子女都忙于谋生。事实上，绝大部分华裔老人都是自己生活。可想而知，他们是多么的孤独与无助。对于家里有阿尔茨海默症患者的家庭，我们更是无法想象他们的生活有多困难。 在过去的一年里，我接触到了一些这样的家庭照料者。他们大多都是年纪较长的华人,在照顾家里患有阿尔茨海默症的老人。在采访中，我感到如此的震惊。我从来没有想到，在美国，在这个如此安乐，祥和的城市里，有这么一群老人过着这么艰难的生活。他们不仅要照顾自己，还要照顾他们患有阿尔茨海默疾病的家人。 孝敬父母，为父母养老是中华民族的传统美德。然而，在美国，在竞争如此激烈的社会，年轻人需要更多的时间关注自己的事业。同时，受中国文化的影响，大部分华人都不愿像美国人一样把老人送去养老院，即使患有阿尔茨海默疾病。因此，照料病人的责任落到了老年人自己身上。家庭照料者所经历的困难与承受的压力是我们不可想像的。我们试图通过访谈了解他们的困难与压力，为他们提供有用的社会资源，并帮助他们缓解压力。当然，为了给他们提供有用的信息与缓解压力的方法，我们必须知道他们的困难是什么，压力来自哪里。 照料者的困难有很多。首先是身体上的，我们可以想象老年人照顾老年人是多么的难。有的患者根本不能动，有的根本不知道自己在做什么，照料者必须得担负起所有的生活起居，包括一日三餐，上洗手间，清洗，穿衣等。不可想象，照料者承担这么多照料工作，更何况很多照料者自己的身体都不是很健康。其次，经济上的困难也是很普遍的。大多数家庭都依靠一点点退休金生活，更多的家庭是靠政府的社会保障，养老金等生活。他们的压力还来自于心理上的，很多照料者不肯相信他们的亲人变成这样。很多病人不断地重复问过的问题，有的甚至已经不认识他们的家人,这给照料者带来很大的心理压力。照料者还承受着许多不同的压力，比如说家庭关系，时间冲突，社交生活等。 老年人是社会的责任，患有阿尔茨海默症的老年人更是社会的责任。我们可能暂时还不能防止阿尔茨海默疾病，但是我们有责任，社会有责任去帮助这些老年人，帮助他们的照料者缓解压力，为他们提供有用的社会资源。正是因为这样，我们的研究项目正努力为凤凰城的华人家庭照料者提供关于社会资源的信息和缓解压力的办法。 如果你正在照顾患有阿尔茨海默氏症的家人，或者你身边有这样的人，请联系我们。我的邮箱是： bywangcong@gmail.com.
05bd98cc8df132b5734b4524be6ad410840b9822.translatedText: Chinese seniors in Phoenix (Alberta Times) There is no doubt that the United States is a very diverse country. In the United States, you can see people of all colors everywhere and experience different cultures. Most people who have lived in the United States find life in the United States very peaceful. Indeed, what you can see in the United States on the surface is intertwined highways, speeding cars, empty streets, and tall buildings. However, behind the scenes, it is difficult to imagine the struggle and helplessness of such a group of people. First, let me introduce myself. I'm from Liangshan, Sichuan. In September 2009, he came to the United States as a high school exchange student. Currently a sophomore at the Cronkite School of Journalism at Arizona State University. Since my first semester in college, I have been fortunate enough to join Dr. Fei Sun, an assistant professor in the Department of Social Work at Arizona State University, in his research project on how Chinese families care for Alzheimer’s patients. Perhaps like many other Chinese students who come to the United States to study, I always thought that Chinese in the United States should live a relatively prosperous life. However, not all Chinese immigrants to the United States can live the so-called prosperous American life. On the contrary, many Chinese, especially some elderly people, live a very difficult life. For some Chinese whose families have Alzheimer’s patients, life is even more challenging. For research purposes, we need at least 25 family caregivers who are currently caring for Alzheimer's patients. At first, I couldn’t imagine that we would be able to find so many families in Phoenix. Firstly, I know very little about this disease and think it is uncommon. Second, I thought there were not many families like this in the Chinese community in Phoenix. Of course, it is not easy to find such a family because the Chinese here are very scattered. In order to find such families, we contacted many Chinese institutions and contacted many elderly people. Because of language barriers and cultural differences, the elderly here stay at home except for going to church or senior centers. There's nothing more they can do. They also cannot enjoy family time with their families like the elderly in China, because in the United States, their children are busy making a living. In fact, the vast majority of Chinese elderly people live on their own. One can imagine how lonely and helpless they feel. For families with Alzheimer’s disease at home, we can’t imagine how difficult their lives are. Over the past year, I have come into contact with a number of these family caregivers. Most of them are older Chinese, taking care of elderly people at home suffering from Alzheimer's disease. During the interview, I was so shocked. I never thought that in the United States, in this peaceful and peaceful city, there would be such a group of old people living such a difficult life. Not only do they have to take care of themselves, but they also have to take care of their family members who have Alzheimer's disease. Honoring parents and taking care of them in their old age are traditional virtues of the Chinese nation. However, in the United States, in such a competitive society, young people need more time to focus on their careers. At the same time, influenced by Chinese culture, most Chinese are unwilling to send their elderly to nursing homes like Americans, even if they suffer from Alzheimer's disease. Therefore, the responsibility for caring for the sick falls on the elderly themselves. The difficulties and stress experienced by family caregivers are unimaginable. We try to understand their difficulties and pressures through interviews, provide them with useful social resources, and help them relieve their pressure. Of course, in order to provide them with useful information and ways to relieve stress, we must know what their difficulties are and where their stress comes from. Difficulties for caregivers are many. The first is physical. We can imagine how difficult it is for the elderly to take care of the elderly. Some patients cannot move at all, and some do not know what they are doing at all. Caregivers must be responsible for all daily life, including three meals a day, going to the bathroom, cleaning, dressing, etc. It is unimaginable that caregivers should bear so much care work, not to mention that many caregivers themselves are not very healthy. Second, financial difficulties are also common. Most families rely on a little pension, and even more families rely on government social security, pensions, etc. Their stress also comes from psychological aspects. Many caregivers refuse to believe that their loved ones have become like this. Many patients keep repeating the questions they have asked, and some even no longer recognize their family members, which brings great psychological pressure to caregivers. Caregivers are also under many different pressures, such as family relationships, time conflicts, social life, etc. The elderly are society's responsibility, and the elderly suffering from Alzheimer's disease are society's responsibility even more. We may not be able to prevent Alzheimer's disease yet, but we have a responsibility and society has a responsibility to help these elderly people, help their caregivers relieve stress, and provide them with useful social resources. That's why our research project is working to provide Chinese family caregivers in Phoenix with information about social resources and ways to relieve stress. If you are caring for a family member with Alzheimer’s disease, or know someone close to you, please contact us. My email is: bywangcong@gmail.com.

fa49ca4a4f10435d51311be5083d8570bf0c59fd.sourceText: 风笛笛友凤凰城度假 亚省时报 风光无限的五月，凤城迎来了远方的朋友。本报风笛专页负责人，来自芝加哥的笛长荣惠伦夫妇携子这次来西部度假访问。沿途受到笛兄弟姐妹的热烈欢迎。十四日抵达凤凰城，除了会见风笛成员外，荣惠伦夫妇还拜访了本报社长老真，并向社长、及本报主笔少君、主编孙涧萍分别赠送了越裔华人洛杉矶女作家梁柳英的新作《艺文荟萃》及凤凰城诗词作家温日强的新作《聚集》。 晚上，宾主又一起在六福酒家雅聚，也正好观看了为庆祝母亲节， 在六福酒家举办的，著名表演家蔡嘎亮的音乐脱口秀表演， 《风笛协会》是以越裔华人为核心组织的，遍及全世纪的一个诗词创作团体，目前，这支队伍不断壮大，作家已不仅仅只是局限于越南华人。而《风笛凤凰专页》是他们每月一次特为本报创作的专页。在这个物欲横流，风行快速文化的世界里，他们能几年来如一日，坚持发扬光大中国古典文学的精髓，坚持创作交流，实为弥足珍贵。 身居凤凰城的笛长气如虹在当晚文艺晚会上还小露一手。他参加了客串歌唱演出，荣惠伦与温日强一左一右上台为他助兴。快乐的主宾一起度过了一个难忘的夜晚。
fa49ca4a4f10435d51311be5083d8570bf0c59fd.translatedText: Bagpipe friends are on vacation in Phoenix. The Alberta Times In the glorious month of May, Fengcheng welcomes friends from far away. The person in charge of this newspaper's bagpipe page, flutist Ron Whalen from Chicago, and his wife came to the West for a vacation this time. Along the way, I was warmly welcomed by the Di brothers and sisters. Arriving in Phoenix on the 14th, in addition to meeting the bagpipe members, Rong Huilun and his wife also visited the newspaper's editor-in-chief, Zhang Zhen, and presented the new work "Art and Literature" by Vietnamese-Chinese Los Angeles female writer Liang Liuying and the new work "Gathering" by Phoenix poetry writer Wen Riqiang to the president, the newspaper's chief writer Shaojun, and editor-in-chief Sun Jianping respectively. In the evening, the guests and hosts gathered together at the Luk Fook Restaurant, and happened to watch the famous performer Cai Galliang's musical talk show held at the Luk Fook Restaurant to celebrate Mother's Day. The Bagpipe Association is a poetry writing group organized with Vietnamese Chinese as the core and has spread throughout the century. Currently, this team continues to grow, and writers are no longer limited to Vietnamese Chinese. The "Bagpipe Phoenix Page" is a special page they create for this newspaper once a month. In this world where materialism prevails and fast culture prevails, it is truly precious that they have persisted in carrying forward the essence of Chinese classical literature and persisted in creative exchanges for several years. The flute player Qi Ruhong, who lives in Phoenix City, made a small appearance at the cultural evening party that night. He participated in a guest singing performance, and Rong Huilun and Wen Riqiang came on stage to cheer him up. The happy guests of honor spent an unforgettable evening together.

8b32b584b314329ba96e90e8b2beafc8856592a3.sourceText: （新东方艺术学校供稿）一年一度的中秋佳节，汇聚了千家万户的大团圆，也将久居海外的华人凝聚一起，和远方的亲人共赏圆月一轮，渡过属于我们民族的传统节日。 新东方艺术学校借此中秋佳节之际，全体师生经过数月的准备，将一台囊括了中国多个民族独特的舞蹈技巧和艺术神韵的中国舞献给大家。 这次晚会一是庆祝中秋，再有就是学校的教学成果汇报。不同于春节晚会的是，此场演出作为每年的教学汇报演出，重点体现学生的学习成果，舞蹈的技术技巧和艺术表演水平。 学生经过数年的舞蹈学习和多次大型晚会的锻炼，舞蹈的表演水平大大的提高。这次的晚会将有部分学生表演个人的独舞和小组舞。 为更快地提高舞蹈的基本功，许多同学选择舞蹈的基本功加强班。她们不辞辛苦的每周加倍时间的练习，使这些同学具备了舞蹈技术技巧明显的突出表演能力。这次晚会，她们将以不同凡响的表现，呈现给家长和观众。 敬请期待中秋的中国舞盛会。 演出时间： 9月14日 晚 7:00 （ 星期六） 演出地点： Mesa Art Center (美莎艺术中心) 赞助票： $ 5 详情请电： 602-490-8613
8b32b584b314329ba96e90e8b2beafc8856592a3.translatedText: (Contributed by New Oriental Art School) The annual Mid-Autumn Festival brings together the great reunions of thousands of families, and also brings together Chinese people who have lived overseas for a long time to enjoy the full moon with their relatives far away and spend a traditional festival belonging to our nation. New Oriental Art School takes advantage of the Mid-Autumn Festival. After several months of preparation, all teachers and students presented a Chinese dance that encompasses the unique dance skills and artistic charm of many ethnic groups in China. This party was to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival and to report on the school’s teaching results. Different from the Spring Festival Gala, this performance is an annual teaching report performance, focusing on students' learning results, dance technical skills and artistic performance levels. After several years of dance study and many large-scale evening exercises, the students' dance performance level has been greatly improved. This evening, some students will perform solo and group dances. In order to improve the basic skills of dance more quickly, many students choose basic dance skills strengthening classes. They worked tirelessly to practice twice as long every week, so that these students have outstanding performance abilities with obvious dance technical skills. At this party, they will present their extraordinary performance to parents and the audience. Please look forward to the Chinese dance event during the Mid-Autumn Festival. Performance time: September 14, 7:00 pm (Saturday) Performance location: Mesa Art Center (Mesa Art Center) Sponsorship ticket: $5 For details, please call: 602-490-8613

6340a5b37915a30e12629e52a13d036885742c45.sourceText: 美参议院通过对《排华法案》道歉案 华社吁继续努力（图） （AACYF洛杉矶讯） 美国参议院6日深夜一致通过一项由加州民主党联邦参议员黛安 范因斯坦推动的《排华法案》道歉案，就1882年美国国会制定的这项歧视性法案向全体美国华人致歉。道歉案认为，对这些排斥华人的法律与其造成的不公正，参议院表示深深的歉意，并表示将致力于保护华人等少数族裔享有与其他美国国民相同的民权与宪法权利。 该法案的另一主要推动者、马萨诸塞州的联邦参议员斯科特朗发表声明表示：”通过这项议案，参议院表达了我们国家对美国华裔的贡献的感激，并承认他们是美国社会不可或缺的一部分。” 2011年10月8日上午，一直关心并推动此道歉案的华人社区领袖在洛杉矶中国城表示深受鼓舞，并商定将继续发动全美各地的华裔选民向所在选区的国会众议员写信，恳请他们支持该道歉案在众院通过。 罗省台山宁阳会馆主席伍尚齐表示，这是全美各地华人和各界人士共同团结努力的成就，也是华裔参与政治和公共事务的一个重要成果。参议院通过道歉案是成为正式法案的第一步，下一步需众议院通过该法案，最后由美国总统奥巴马签发正式的声明或公告，正式向全体美国华人道歉。 全美中华青年联合会会长任向东介绍，今年上半年开始，各大华裔社团在全美各地发动华裔、以及持该道歉案的各族裔朋友向所在选区国会参、众议员发信要求支持该法案以来，全美各地大约有6万9千多名包括华裔在内的多族裔选民向所在选区的参、众议员发出了信函。现在参议院已经通过该道歉案，各大社团将继续联合向各地的华裔、以及各族裔选民发出呼吁，向所在选区的国会众议员发出信函，请求他们支持在众议院通过该道歉案。 罗省中华会馆副监事长聂泽英认为，通过这次活动，向美国社会展示了华裔族群凭借现行制度、不分政治立场、团结合作维护自身权益的一个范例。而参院的全票通过，也反映了主流社会对华裔在美角色日趋重要的高度认同。 全美伍胥山总公所美西总长伍侠山、美华国际青年商会会长朱冰峰、罗省保安堂主席刘健峰、南加省开平同乡会副会长罗如珍、罗省凯旋音乐社社长艳桃红、罗省秉公堂司徒达、伍伟亨夫人、北美海峡两岸文化交流协会陈洁、北美深圳青年联合总会任钰婷、以及美国美亚国际总商会、美国广东联谊会的代表出席了当天的活动。 据悉，华裔众议员赵美心将力争促使众议院在明年5月美国亚太裔传统月结束前通过此法案，因为美国众议院当年通过《排华法案》也是在5月份。
6340a5b37915a30e12629e52a13d036885742c45.translatedText: The U.S. Senate passed an apology bill for the "Chinese Exclusion Act" and Chinese news agencies called for continued efforts (Photo) (AACYF Los Angeles News) Late at night on the 6th, the U.S. Senate unanimously passed an apology bill for the "Chinese Exclusion Act" promoted by California Democratic Senator Dianne Feinstein, apologizing to all Chinese Americans for this discriminatory bill enacted by the U.S. Congress in 1882. The apology bill stated that the Senate expressed deep regret for these laws that excluded Chinese people and the injustice they caused, and stated that it was committed to protecting Chinese and other ethnic minorities from enjoying the same civil and constitutional rights as other American citizens. Another major sponsor of the bill, U.S. Senator Scott Long of Massachusetts, issued a statement saying: "By passing this bill, the Senate expresses our country's gratitude to Chinese Americans for their contributions and recognizes that they are an integral part of American society." On the morning of October 8, 2011, Chinese community leaders who had been caring about and promoting the apology case expressed their deep encouragement in Chinatown, Los Angeles, and agreed to continue mobilizing Chinese voters across the United States to write letters to the congressmen in their districts, imploring them to support the passage of the apology bill in the House of Representatives. Wu Shangqi, chairman of the Ningyang Association in Taishan, Luozhou, said that this is an achievement achieved through the joint efforts of Chinese people from all over the United States and people from all walks of life. It is also an important result of Chinese Americans' participation in political and public affairs. The Senate's passage of the apology bill is the first step toward becoming a formal bill. The next step is for the House of Representatives to pass the bill. Finally, U.S. President Obama issues a formal statement or announcement to formally apologize to all Chinese Americans. Ren Xiangdong, president of the National Chinese Youth Federation, said that since the first half of this year, major Chinese associations across the United States have mobilized Chinese Americans and friends of all ethnic groups who support the apology case to send letters to congressional senators and representatives in their districts asking to support the bill. Since then, more than 69,000 multi-ethnic voters across the United States, including Chinese Americans, have sent letters to senators and representatives in their districts. Now that the Senate has passed the apology bill, major associations will continue to jointly appeal to Chinese Americans and voters of all ethnic groups everywhere, and send letters to members of Congress in their districts, requesting their support in passing the apology bill in the House of Representatives. Nie Zeying, deputy director of the Luo Zhonghua Association, believes that through this event, it shows the American society an example of the Chinese community relying on the current system and uniting and cooperating to safeguard their rights and interests regardless of political stance. The unanimous approval by the Senate also reflects the mainstream society's recognition of the increasingly important role of Chinese Americans in the United States. Wu Xiashan, President of the Western United States of the National Wuxushan Office, Zhu Bingfeng, President of the International Youth Chamber of Commerce in the United States, Liu Jianfeng, Chairman of the Luo Province Security Hall, Luo Ruzhen, Vice President of the Kaiping Association of Southern California, Yan Taohong, President of the Luo Province Triumph Music Club, and Luo Shengbing Kongtang Situ Da, Mrs. Wu Weiheng, North American Cross-Strait Cultural Exchange Association Chen Jie, North American Shenzhen Youth Federation Ren Yuting, as well as representatives of the American and Asian International Chamber of Commerce and the American Guangdong Association attended the day's event. It is reported that Chinese-American Representative Zhao Meixin will strive to urge the House of Representatives to pass this bill before the end of Asian Pacific American Heritage Month in May next year, because the U.S. House of Representatives passed the "Chinese Exclusion Act" in May that year.

45a5506c20f35bb4fe527c671234cfb13ea20016.sourceText: 美国亚利桑那州将金币和银币批准为法定货币
45a5506c20f35bb4fe527c671234cfb13ea20016.translatedText: The US state of Arizona approves gold and silver coins as legal tender

40efef149548ff344850581159b4330d01ae0033.sourceText: 美国亚利桑那州将金币和银币批准为法定货币 据港媒报道，正当美联储主席伯南克指现时经济仍未达标，暗示量宽措施…
40efef149548ff344850581159b4330d01ae0033.translatedText: The US state of Arizona approves gold and silver coins as legal tender. According to Hong Kong media reports, just as Federal Reserve Chairman Bernanke pointed out that the current economy is still not up to standard, implying quantitative easing measures...

09643cf1e904ff3acd522dd1540d35d9d9f5f642.sourceText: 亚利桑那州议会日前通过，批准黄金及白银币成为该州分的法定货币，而不受资产税项及法例规限；法案最快明年起生效。若商户接受，消费者便可使用该两种 贵金属 货币 购物 。
09643cf1e904ff3acd522dd1540d35d9d9f5f642.translatedText: The Arizona State Assembly recently passed the approval of gold and silver coins to become legal tender in the state, without being subject to asset taxes and regulations; the bill will take effect as soon as next year. If the merchant accepts it, consumers can use the two precious metal currencies to make purchases.

d7a219d26b8bf737899a831b3bba1c5ef6dc3c2c.sourceText: 事实上，近年美联储不断向市场泵水，早已触发市场对通胀的忧虑。有支持法案的人士指，亚利桑那州通过黄金及白银币成为法定货币，当美元完全失去价值时，该州分的 金融 体系可避过一劫。
d7a219d26b8bf737899a831b3bba1c5ef6dc3c2c.translatedText: In fact, in recent years, the Federal Reserve has continued to pump water into the market, which has already triggered market concerns about inflation. Supporters of the bill pointed out that Arizona has adopted gold and silver coins as legal tender. When the U.S. dollar completely loses its value, the state's financial system can avoid disaster.

427013a6d5502cd4dd3415afe165ad7bd857b5d1.translatedText: Worry that QE will eventually bring down the US dollar

3e9974d43503e798498503f537f635fc43623523.sourceText: 另有分析指出，有关措施是由较激进的茶党人士提出，实际的用途不大，主要目的是对伯南克推行QE表示不满，忧虑政府或伯南克及美联储推行的政策将会引发通胀，最终将拖垮美元。
3e9974d43503e798498503f537f635fc43623523.translatedText: Other analysts pointed out that the relevant measures were proposed by the more radical Tea Party people and have little practical use. The main purpose is to express dissatisfaction with Bernanke's implementation of QE and worry that the policies implemented by the government or Bernanke and the Federal Reserve will trigger inflation and eventually bring down the US dollar.

8f887d6972ee922986869b52ec1ab9f1a15ec09d.sourceText: 犹他州早于2011年已通过有关法案，不过在该州分仍然未能用金币购买日常用品；而堪萨斯州、南卡罗来纳州等亦正讨论推行有关政策。但有关法例只容许商户接受由联邦政府发行的金银币作交易。
8f887d6972ee922986869b52ec1ab9f1a15ec09d.translatedText: Utah passed the relevant bill as early as 2011, but it is still not possible to use gold coins to purchase daily necessities in this state; Kansas, South Carolina and other states are also discussing the implementation of relevant policies. However, the relevant laws only allow merchants to accept gold and silver coins issued by the federal government for transactions.

e2fa69bf1cec5e8223ceba35863ebc9917de293e.sourceText: 而德州政府则正考虑设立德州金条存库，储存价值10亿美元的金条。该批金条属于德州大学投资管理公司的，现时存放于纽约联储银行仓库。分析指，行动亦显示出州政府不信任纽约联储银行，忧虑一旦储局的QE最终拖累当地货币及政治系统崩塌，德州将未能取回黄金。
e2fa69bf1cec5e8223ceba35863ebc9917de293e.translatedText: The Texas government is considering setting up the Texas Gold Bar Depository to store gold bars worth US$1 billion. This batch of gold bars belongs to the University of Texas Investment Management Company and is currently stored in the warehouse of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York. Analysts pointed out that the action also showed that the state government did not trust the New York Federal Reserve Bank, and was worried that Texas would not be able to get its gold back once the Reserve Bank's QE eventually led to the collapse of the local currency and political system.

ac62a5e9382ff3f4934a36ee8fb7372491383bba.translatedText: Officials said they could stop bond purchases early

a88d80cdd6733ed0d19c1f49025db3158378320e.sourceText: 伯南克日前仍力撑全球央行放水行动，暗示美联储将持续推行QE。不过，多个联储局官员表示美联储可提早停止买债，其中圣路易斯储行行长布拉德(James Bullard)昨预期，经济会持续改善，美联储将逐步减少买债。
a88d80cdd6733ed0d19c1f49025db3158378320e.translatedText: Bernanke still supports the global central bank's water release, suggesting that the Federal Reserve will continue to implement QE. However, several Federal Reserve officials have said that the Fed can stop buying bonds early. Among them, St. Louis Reserve Bank President James Bullard yesterday predicted that the economy will continue to improve and the Fed will gradually reduce its bond purchases.

efd2f1a4d8d98529494488bb183e17676a360f59.sourceText: 他又预期首季增长将稍为高于1月的估计，表示愿意减少QE规模。而美联储副主席耶伦上周亦表示，美联储 应按劳工市场前景，减慢购买资产的速度。
efd2f1a4d8d98529494488bb183e17676a360f59.translatedText: He also expected first-quarter growth to be slightly higher than the January estimate and expressed his willingness to reduce the scale of QE. Federal Reserve Vice Chairman Yellen also said last week that the Fed should slow down its asset purchases based on the outlook for the labor market.

16cf0b5606a3aa31c3934358236e7237324e95b8.sourceText: 贝莱德固定收益投资部门主里德尔(Rick Rieder)则表示，美联储的政策扭曲投资者的资产分配计划，要求储局每月减少买债400亿至450亿美元。他表示，虽然失业率仍高达7.6%，劳工市场亦面对一系列的负面影响，美联储应趁现时经济尚算稳健而减少买债。贝莱德预期失业率将缓慢下跌，直至2015年底前将不会加息。
16cf0b5606a3aa31c3934358236e7237324e95b8.translatedText: Rick Rieder, head of BlackRock's fixed income investment department, said that the Federal Reserve's policies distort investors' asset allocation plans and require the Reserve Bank to reduce bond purchases by US$40 billion to US$45 billion per month. He said that although the unemployment rate is still as high as 7.6% and the labor market is also facing a series of negative impacts, the Fed should take advantage of the fact that the economy is still relatively stable and reduce bond purchases. BlackRock expects the unemployment rate to fall slowly and will not raise interest rates until the end of 2015.

2e817405312f47717624f569d618f09981818c0e.sourceText: 婚姻十戒 大至国家民族,小至社团商号,为了巩固自己的权益,总要制定一些严刑酷法, 或者清规律例,要人们认…
2e817405312f47717624f569d618f09981818c0e.translatedText: > The Ten Commandments of Marriage, whether it is a country or a nation, or a company or a company, in order to consolidate its own rights and interests, it is always necessary to formulate some harsh laws, or rules and regulations, and ask people to abide by them...

e4d9e243b3f0d112b900880904a75e829bf33565.sourceText: 大至国家民族,小至社团商号,为了巩固自己的权益,总要制定一些严刑酷法, 或者清规律例,要人们认真遵守。 婚姻法就是国家的大法之一。 有了这条法律,就把人和动物区分开来,并为社会基层奠下一个比较健全和谐的次序。 然而法律并非法宝,纵使你从不枉法逾规,也不等于就能保证婚姻美满,家庭幸福。 婚姻是人类生活中一个至关重要又十分微妙的结合,就像我们写文章,只懂得语法修词是远远不够的。 事前最好先给自己弄个大纲,订些戒条,将来摸索起来就可能事半功倍。 试拟 「婚姻十戒」如下,谨供参考。 一、戒与人工美女结婚。 如今科技发达,你要眼睛多大,鼻子多高,胸部多挺,腰肢多细,臀部多隆,简直如捏人面儿,大可随心所欲。 听说有个男人娶了位美人做老婆,不知多么骄傲,以为拥有美眷就是成功的标志。 等到老婆大了肚子,更是乐不可支,捉摸着很快又有个像娇妻一般标致可爱的孩子,家庭将会何等幸福!不料小东西生下来,又黑又丑,吓得做爸爸的任是 不敢相信,这个魔鬼似的怪物,怎么可能是自己的骨肉!后来扭上官府,老婆不得不承认,孩子像妈,老娘原本就是这个样子的! 二、戒与同性同志结婚。 道理很简单,人人都学你们,人类迟早会像恐龙,要从地球上消失。 为了不让世界幻灭,请留下种子! 三、戒为结婚而结婚。 这种情形也许不​​多,可也不是没有。 眼见同侪好友们一个个都成家立室了,渐渐感到孤寂难耐,心里头一急,就把择偶的条件一降再降,结果便成了年晚煎堆,人有我有。 等到醒觉这碗饭哽不下去时,无奈米已成炊,为时晚矣! 四、戒纯为财貌而结婚。 或者应该说,别为表面风光所惑。 按理,郎财女貌, 天经地义,我们也不必自鸣清高了。 要说的是,品格、德行、学养也很重要,不要不分皂白,见到一个钱窿,一个美眉,就不顾一切一头栽进去,免得到时软玉温香,抱的却是绣花枕头一个! 五、戒为报复而结婚。 你甩我?以为没有人要我吗?再回头,本小姐才不要你!一赌气,月下货霎时变成了时尚,把手一扣,就是一个现成的新郎官。 到头来呢?哑子吃黄连,有苦自己知! 六、戒为逃避结婚而结婚。 这种情形,多半是为了成全你心爱的人,或者要躲开一个无法接受的人,而草草找一个并非心仪的人来成婚。 无疑,情操是高尚的,心地是善良的,可是吃苦的将不只你一个人,而是四个人! 七、戒做蚀本的婚事。 你要的是美色,她要的是财宝,等如以货易货,公平买卖,只要两不拖欠,外人根本管不着。 至于为了攀龙附凤,不惜以身体为阶梯,以灵魂做跳板的,则应戒之。 不过人人都这么做了,多你一个也无所谓,唯有提醒自己,陷阱处处,可不要赔了老本才好! 八、戒迟婚。 早婚的人己不多,迟婚倒​​成了风气。 人生苦短,不好好享受青春的欢乐,等于没让空中的烟火爆发,没让它把最灿烂的光彩展现出来。 你自己损失事小,儿孙们因为来迟了而未能得享应有的福乐,事大矣! 九、戒与志趣不相投者结婚。 常言说:道不同,不相为谋。 又说:酒逢知己千杯少,话不投机半句多。 试想一个埋首三坟五典,一个终日二索六桐,牛头不对马嘴,如何能够「对碰」吃糊!年轻时各忙各的,还好,等到垂垂老矣,二人寸步不离,竟然半天也扯不上一句投契的话,日子怎么过! 十、戒为礼金、嫁妆、酒席讨价还价。 一辈子的事,如果条件许可,铺张一下也是应该。 但假若因贪婪而生龃龉,令亲家变成冤家,或为了面子而去举债,使财政濒于崩溃,那你们是把好事办成坏事了! 但愿有情人终成眷属,鹣鲽情长!
e4d9e243b3f0d112b900880904a75e829bf33565.translatedText: In order to consolidate its rights and interests, whether it is a country or a nation, or a company or a company, it must formulate some harsh laws, or rules and regulations, and people must abide by them seriously. Marriage law is one of the country's major laws. With this law, humans and animals are distinguished and a relatively sound and harmonious order is laid at the grassroots level of society. However, the law is not a magic weapon. Even if you never break the law or break the rules, it does not mean that you can guarantee a happy marriage and a happy family. Marriage is a vital and subtle union in human life. Just like when we write an article, it is not enough to only know the grammar and word modification. It is best to make an outline for yourself and set some rules beforehand, so that you can get twice the result with half the effort in the future. Here is a draft of the "Ten Commandments of Marriage" for your reference. 1. Avoid marrying artificial beauties. Nowadays, with the advanced technology, you can make your eyes as big as you want, as high as your nose, as tall as your chest, as thin as your waist, and as big as your buttocks. It’s like pinching a person’s face. I heard that there was a man who married a beautiful woman as his wife. I don’t know how proud he was, thinking that having a beautiful wife was a sign of success. When my wife became pregnant, she was even more excited, hoping that soon she would have a child as beautiful and lovely as my beloved wife, and how happy the family would be! Unexpectedly, the little thing was born, black and ugly, and the father Ren Shi was so frightened that he couldn't believe how this devil-like monster could be his own flesh and blood! Later, when he went to the government, the wife had to admit that the child looked like her mother, and she was originally like this! 2. Stop marrying same-sex couples. The reason is very simple. If everyone follows your example, sooner or later human beings will be like dinosaurs and disappear from the earth. In order to prevent the world from being disillusioned, please leave the seeds! 3. Avoid getting married for the sake of getting married. This situation may not be common, but it is not impossible. Seeing that all my friends in the same field are getting married one by one, I gradually feel lonely and unbearable. I feel anxious, so I lower the conditions for choosing a spouse again and again. When you wake up and realize that the bowl of rice is choked, it is already too late! 4. Stop marrying purely for wealth and appearance. Or should I say, don’t be fooled by the superficial beauty. It stands to reason that it is natural for a man to be rich and a woman to be beautiful, so we don’t need to boast about being arrogant. What I want to say is that character, virtue, and education are also very important. Don't be indiscriminate and jump into a money hole or a beautiful girl at all costs, lest you end up with a warm and fragrant nephrite but an embroidered pillow! 5. Avoid getting married for revenge. Are you dumping me? Do you think no one wants me? If you look back, I don’t want you! When you get angry, the goods under the moon suddenly become fashionable. With a click of your hand, you are a ready-made groom. What will happen in the end? A dumb person who eats Coptidis chinensis knows the suffering! 6. Avoid getting married just to avoid getting married. In this case, it is mostly because you want to marry the person you love, or to avoid an unacceptable person, and hastily find someone to marry who is not your favorite. Undoubtedly, your sentiments are noble and your heart is kind, but you will not be the only one who will suffer, but four people! 7. Avoid making a loss-making marriage. What you want is beauty, what she wants is treasure, it's like bartering, fair trade, as long as both parties don't default, outsiders have no control at all. As for those who do not hesitate to use the body as a ladder and the soul as a springboard in order to climb the dragon and the phoenix, you should avoid it. But everyone has done it, and it doesn’t matter if you are one more. Just remind yourself that there are traps everywhere, so don’t lose your money! 8. Stop marrying late. Not many people get married early, but late marriage has become a trend. Life is short, and if you don’t enjoy the joy of youth, you won’t let the fireworks in the sky explode and show their most brilliant brilliance. It is a small loss for you, but it is a big loss for your children and grandchildren who are unable to enjoy the happiness they deserve because they are late! 9. Avoid marrying someone who does not share your interests. As the saying goes: People with different paths do not seek each other. He also said: A thousand cups of wine is too little to meet a close friend, but half a sentence is too much to talk without speculation. Just imagine how one person can bury his head in three graves and five scriptures, and the other can only pick up six tung trees all day long, but he is wrong and the horse is talking about the wrong thing. How can he get confused by "butting up"! When he was young, he was busy with his own affairs. Fortunately, when he grew old, the two of them were inseparable, and they couldn't even exchange a word of speculation for a long time. How could they live their lives! 10. Don't bargain for gifts, dowries, and banquets. It's a lifetime thing, and if conditions permit, it's okay to splurge. But if there is discord due to greed, and the in-laws become enemies, or if you borrow money for the sake of face and bring your finances to the brink of collapse, then you have turned a good thing into a bad thing! I hope lovers will eventually get married and their love will last forever!

27ea5281f930c343554950c52b3189dca0257ac7.sourceText: 马航引爆全球新闻战 中国媒体败北暴硬伤
27ea5281f930c343554950c52b3189dca0257ac7.translatedText: Malaysia Airlines triggered a global news war, and the Chinese media was defeated and severely injured

ad6cd3c84289ff64adb9f8a30abed349f0672248.sourceText: 马航引爆全球新闻战 中国媒体败北暴硬伤 事关154名中国人的身家性命，马航事件真相截至目前几经反复才终于在…
ad6cd3c84289ff64adb9f8a30abed349f0672248.translatedText: Malaysian Airlines triggered a global news war, and the Chinese media were defeated and severely injured It is about the wealth and lives of 154 Chinese people. The truth about the Malaysia Airlines incident has been repeated many times until now...

652b3ced44d2c724f06d6304ba44d5821558f180.sourceText: 事关154名中国人的身家性命，马航事件真相截至目前几经反复才终于在西方媒体的逼问下才逐步还原。在此中，中国媒体却再度暴露出自己在专业媒体素养以及职业操守上的软肋，引发舆论界的不满与反思，甚至被讽刺”中国媒体有三宝：转发、蜡烛和祈祷”。包括亚洲新闻社社长将徐静波等职业媒体人和民间舆论纷纷撰文炮轰中国媒体的表现。诚然，中国媒体的败落似可大部分归咎于中共舆论体制以及国家实力，但这并不足以成为为其开脱的理由。
652b3ced44d2c724f06d6304ba44d5821558f180.translatedText: It is about the wealth and lives of 154 Chinese people. The truth about the Malaysia Airlines incident has been repeated many times until now, and it has finally been gradually revealed under the pressure of the Western media. In this process, the Chinese media has once again exposed its weaknesses in professional media literacy and professional ethics, triggering dissatisfaction and reflection in the public opinion circle. It was even ridiculed that "Chinese media has three treasures: forwarding, candles and prayers." Professional media outlets including General Xu Jingbo, president of Asia News Agency, and public opinion members have written articles criticizing the performance of the Chinese media. It is true that the decline of Chinese media seems to be largely attributed to the Chinese Communist Party’s public opinion system and national strength, but this is not enough to excuse it.

887fcadf754567b877a34b22b21f50937a48836d.sourceText: 3月17日17时30分在马来西亚召开的例行新闻发布会上马来西亚交通部长希山慕丁承认”仍有相关信息未透露”，这一发言证实了此前西方媒体一系列推测。事实上，早在3月15日马来西亚总理纳吉布紧急回应西方媒体揭示失联马航航班远不只是简单的飞机失事的时候，中国媒体”沉溺”于对善后事宜的关注以及对遇难者家属看似悲情实则冷漠的报道便逐渐显露其令人失望的迹象。而且在这场中国媒体与世界媒体赛跑的轮番”爆料”中，独独缺少马航失联客机154名中国人所在国的中国媒体”独家信息”的身影。
887fcadf754567b877a34b22b21f50937a48836d.translatedText: At a regular press conference held in Malaysia at 17:30 on March 17, Malaysian Transport Minister Hishammuddin admitted that "there is still relevant information that has not been disclosed." This statement confirmed a series of previous speculations by Western media. In fact, as early as March 15, when Malaysian Prime Minister Najib responded urgently to Western media revealing that the missing Malaysian Airlines flight was far more than a simple plane crash, the Chinese media was "indulged" in paying attention to the aftermath and reporting on the families of the victims that seemed tragic but actually indifferent, gradually showed signs of disappointment. Moreover, in this race between the Chinese media and the world’s media in the rounds of “revelation”, the only missing figure is the “exclusive information” of the Chinese media in the country where the 154 Chinese nationals on the missing Malaysia Airlines flight are located.

e32f7bb21dbf7885d62be98ca496d3e9df3ebcf1.sourceText: 此次马航失联客机事件的扑朔迷离，着实让全球各路媒体经历了一场无硝烟的新闻战。而因为失联客机乘客中154名中国人的存在，中国媒体的表现也倍受瞩目。我们看到的是，中国媒体的确站在安排失联乘客家属的丽都酒店的第一线，他们也站在了北京首都机场马航新闻发布会的第一线，但他们的报道大多要么局限在新闻发布会说了什么、家属什么表情、发言人和负责人的表现云云，要么陶醉在肤浅的煽情主义，在报端网格中”抒发一下情怀”。而真正的，诸如”客机失联是劫机还是事故？””失联客机是降落还是空中解体？””客机失联事件是谁策划？乘客或机组人员或其他？”…..这些新闻出现在中国媒体的报道却变成了”据CNN报道””路透社的最新消息说””《纽约时报》透露”…….也就是说，除了站在新闻发布会、除了在机场拍摄机长悲愤家属的照片外，中国媒体”毫无有价值的作为”。
e32f7bb21dbf7885d62be98ca496d3e9df3ebcf1.translatedText: The confusing incident surrounding the missing Malaysian Airlines flight has indeed caused media outlets around the world to experience a smokeless news war. The performance of the Chinese media has also attracted much attention because of the presence of 154 Chinese among the passengers of the missing flight. What we have seen is that the Chinese media were indeed on the front line of the Lido Hotel where the families of the missing passengers were accommodated, and they were also on the front line of the Malaysia Airlines press conference at Beijing Capital Airport. However, most of their reports were either limited to what was said at the press conference, the expressions of the family members, the performance of the spokesperson and the person in charge, etc., or they were intoxicated with superficial sensationalism and "expressed their feelings" in the newspaper grid. As for the real questions, such as "Is the missing passenger plane a hijack or an accident?" "Did the missing passenger plane land or break up in the air?" "Who planned the missing passenger plane? Passengers or crew or others?"... These news reports in the Chinese media have become "according to CNN reports", "Reuters' latest news said", "The New York Times revealed"... In other words, apart from standing at the press conference and taking photos of the captain's grieving family at the airport, the Chinese media "have done nothing of value".

1a2239a2d6e1f98c079f51e796f9ed7c0478e9a3.sourceText: 亚洲通讯社社长徐静波在其《中国媒体在马航客机新闻战中为何失败》的文章中分析了中国媒体失败的原因。原因一：中国媒体没有强大的数据情报网。英美新闻媒体的爆料大多来自军方、卫星公司、情报机构。不过，中国媒体显然不能如此无孔不入。徐静破说，中国政治下形成的中国媒体，他们一直是在被动中成长并已经习惯这种模式，”他们已经丧失了主动出击的能力。也就是说，”听传达”变成了职业，而’挖消息’变成了大忌。这就注定，中国央媒是养尊处优的公主，而不是四处寻生的小贩。”
1a2239a2d6e1f98c079f51e796f9ed7c0478e9a3.translatedText: Asia News Agency President Xu Jingbo analyzed the reasons for the failure of the Chinese media in his article "Why the Chinese Media Failed in the News War on the Malaysian Airlines Flight". Reason one: Chinese media does not have a strong data intelligence network. Most of the revelations from the British and American news media came from the military, satellite companies, and intelligence agencies. However, Chinese media obviously cannot be so pervasive. Xu Jingpo said that the Chinese media formed under Chinese politics have always grown in passivity and have become accustomed to this model. "They have lost the ability to take the initiative. In other words, "listening and conveying" has become a profession, while "digging for news" has become a taboo. This is destined to make China's central media a pampered princess. Not a hawker looking for a living."

d069db0f93dcd6e793368a48426ae2042b2f19c6.sourceText: 3月16日中国中央电视在电话连线中透露，MH370上有一名非常值得怀疑的乘客：中国出生，土耳其受教育，在英国教了两年书，去瑞士学了飞机发动机知识。但此”可疑人物”的出现是在事发后的第天后，未免过于”姗姗来迟”。在此之前，西方媒体早已经将目光转向劫机以及更为可疑机长、副驾驶。舆论质问这无疑更突显了央视跟在人身后的、被人牵着鼻子走的被动姿态。
d069db0f93dcd6e793368a48426ae2042b2f19c6.translatedText: China Central Television revealed in a telephone connection on March 16 that there was a very suspicious passenger on MH370: born in China, educated in Turkey, taught in the UK for two years, and went to Switzerland to learn about aircraft engines. However, this "suspicious person" appeared only the day after the incident, which was too late. Prior to this, the Western media had already turned their attention to the hijacking and the more suspicious captain and co-pilot. Public opinion questioning this undoubtedly highlights CCTV's passive attitude of following people and being led by the nose.

53082eaeb281b61090f3865199447539512a91d3.sourceText: 一位媒体人在朋友间聊天时称，自马航事件发生后，他的路线就是丽都酒店、北京首都机场、发布会，而这路线还不包括报社。如若碰到诸如3月15日新闻发布会取消的情况，这位摄影记者朋友只能悻悻然与其他媒体同行跑到咖啡馆”蹭蹭免费WiFi”，然后询问着彼此”你们那儿有爆料么？”彼此间默然以对，然后加上，”最新消息”说了什么，而这些”最新消息”往往是来自英美媒体，如CNN、BBC、路透社、《纽约时报》…….然后彼此再尴尬的笑笑，”当然，大家都知道了’，再然后，转移话题。
53082eaeb281b61090f3865199447539512a91d3.translatedText: A media person said in a chat among friends that since the Malaysia Airlines incident, his route has been the Lido Hotel, Beijing Capital Airport, and press conferences, and this route does not include newspaper offices. If there is a situation such as the cancellation of the press conference on March 15, this photojournalist friend can only run to the cafe with other media colleagues to "use the free WiFi", and then ask each other, "Do you have any revelations there?" They respond in silence, and then add, what is the "latest news", and these "latest news" often come from British and American media, such as CNN, BBC, Reuters, and the New York Times. 》…….Then they smiled awkwardly at each other, “Of course, everyone knows,” and then changed the subject.

ab218db2e3883caab2c0fd9bbbaea537abc0b332.sourceText: 徐静波列举的第二个原因是：中国媒体没有专家型记者，吃”年轻饭”。徐静波举例称，《纽约时报》在3月8日马航失联事件发生1天后调集了30名资深记者成了报道团队，在第一时间写出了18篇报道与分析文章。徐静波不无无奈的呃表示，此后的事件演变，证明了纽约时报和华尔街日报、CNN、BBC、金融时报等英美新闻大鳄的实力棗从卫星数据到通讯记录，从飞行轨迹到飞行时间，一件件搞到手，一件件抖露出来，虽然马来西亚一次次否认，最终还是纸包不住火，在15日的总理记者会上，承认了媒体报道的众多事实。
ab218db2e3883caab2c0fd9bbbaea537abc0b332.translatedText: The second reason cited by Xu Jingbo is that the Chinese media does not have expert reporters and is eating “young people.” Xu Jingbo gave an example, the New York Times mobilized 30 senior reporters to form a reporting team one day after the Malaysia Airlines missing incident on March 8, and wrote as soon as possible 18 reports and analysis articles were published. Xu Jingbo said helplessly that the subsequent evolution of events proved the strength of British and American news giants such as the New York Times, the Wall Street Journal, CNN, the BBC, and the Financial Times. From satellite data to communication records, from flight trajectories to flight times, one by one was obtained and exposed one by one. Although Malaysia denied it time and time again, in the end it could not contain the fire. In the Prime Minister's Notes on the 15th At the press conference, many facts reported by the media were admitted.

1caecea1e6a241daef90dbcde98a565d309013ad.sourceText: 反观中国媒体，3月13日《法制晚报》发布《直击：5大疑点指向马航曾折返马六甲》，文章中的措辞是”马来西亚官方已经公布14份声明，但法晚记者梳理发现””有最新消息显示””据《华尔街日报》报道”…..3月17日《中国青年报》在其《四大疑点指向失联航班机长》文章中的措辞是”美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）15日称美国情报部门””英国有影响的大报《镜报》、《每日邮报》16日均报道””据英国《每日电讯报》16日报道称””与此同时，菲律宾媒体16日也援引菲民航署消息称””据马来西亚当地媒体《马来邮报》3月14日报道说”…..从中发现，其中的”解析””疑点”其实仅仅是之前媒体报道的”在解读”而已，并无”独家”，并无”新意”，更不需要马航方面、马来西亚官方”承认”和”证实”什么。俨然，中国媒体变成了”跟屁虫”。
1caecea1e6a241daef90dbcde98a565d309013ad.translatedText: Looking back at the Chinese media, on March 13, the Legal Evening News published "Direct Attack: Five major doubts point to Malaysia Airlines returning to Malacca." The wording in the article was "Malaysian officials have released 14 statements, but the French Evening News reporter combed and found that "there is the latest news," according to the "Wall Street Journal"... March 17 "China Youth Daily" in its article "Four Major Suspicions Point to the Captain of the Missing Flight" stated that "CNN said on the 15th that the US intelligence agency" and "the influential British major newspapers "Mirror" and "Daily Mail" both reported on the 16th. "According to the British "Daily Telegraph" reported on the 16th. The Malay Mail reported on March 14 that "...it was found that the "analysis" and "doubtful points" were actually just "interpretations" of previous media reports. There was no "exclusive" and no "new ideas", and there was no need for Malaysia Airlines or Malaysian officials to "recognize" or "confirm" anything. It seems that the Chinese media have become "followers."

295fd76e58b74d706c6cff945220a2eab2d5a884.sourceText: 其实中国媒体这种”败北”这种现象并非马航失联事件引发的新闻战独有，在中国官方尚未明确周永康案时，3月2日政协会议首次记者会上，香港记者提出了周永康的”敏感问题”，中国大陆媒体显出”弱势”；在3月13日中国国务院总理李克强记者会上一片”和谐”，对于媒体关注的周案闭口不提，中国媒体噤声，外媒却在事先被会务组新闻官”打招呼”，明确要求勿提”你懂的”（即周永康）问题，越线将列黑名单，外国记者以后不给工作签证。《纽约时报》记者在推特发文，抱怨两会开始还有新闻发言人说”你懂的”，但结束”啥都没懂”。另有美国记者感叹，”没有昆明，没有周永康，没有西藏，中国总理记者会，新闻死了。”
295fd76e58b74d706c6cff945220a2eab2d5a884.translatedText: In fact, the Chinese media is such a "failure" This phenomenon is not unique to the news war caused by the disappearance of Malaysian Airlines. Before Chinese officials had yet to clarify Zhou Yongkang's case, Hong Kong reporters raised Zhou Yongkang's "sensitive issues" at the first press conference of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference on March 2, and the Chinese mainland media showed a "weakness"; at the press conference of Chinese Premier Li Keqiang on March 13, there was "harmony", and the Zhou case that the media paid attention to was silent. The Chinese media kept silent, but the foreign media did. He was first "greeted" by the press officer of the conference affairs team and was explicitly asked not to raise the issue of "you know" (i.e. Zhou Yongkang). If he crosses the line, he will be blacklisted and foreign journalists will not be given work visas in the future. The New York Times reporter posted on Twitter, complaining that the press secretary said "you know" at the beginning of the two sessions, but "didn't understand anything" at the end. Another American reporter lamented, "There is no Kunming, no Zhou Yongkang, no Tibet, the Chinese Prime Minister's press conference, the news is dead." "

e072e05330b1e22e9454e20b56a87fe6c8ec2f43.sourceText: 敢于实名举报原国家发改委副主任刘铁男的原《财经》杂志副主编罗昌平评论称，围观马航失联事件，CCN、美联社、路透社、纽约时报等，基本垄断了关键信息的发布权，并对马来西亚形成倒逼反证，从而拼凑相对完整的信息流。从这种意义讲，中国没有一家真正的国际媒体，自然提供不了核心信源。信息时代，所谓大国，以及软实力，拥有一个国际媒体组合也应该是大国的标配，利大于弊。也许可以说，”你懂的”，其信息量涵盖量大到让人”无法真正懂的”
e072e05330b1e22e9454e20b56a87fe6c8ec2f43.translatedText: Luo Changping, the former deputy editor-in-chief of Caijing magazine who dared to report Liu Tienan, the former deputy director of the National Development and Reform Commission, with his real name, commented that CCN, the Associated Press, Reuters, the New York Times, etc., who watched the missing Malaysian Airlines, basically monopolized the right to publish key information and formed counter-evidence against Malaysia, thereby piecing together Relatively complete information flow. In this sense, China does not have a truly international media, so it naturally cannot provide core information sources. In the information age, the so-called big country, as well as soft power, should also have an international media portfolio. The advantages outweigh the disadvantages. Perhaps it can be said that "you know", the amount of information covered is so large that "you can't really understand it."

7020ae9fd49e04bcde5e0ca1d002429e9ae12f36.sourceText: 慧明：躺着连中枪 图桑 慧明 ”躺着也中枪”是最近出现的网络用语，说的是那种和事件没…
7020ae9fd49e04bcde5e0ca1d002429e9ae12f36.translatedText: Huiming: Shot even while lying down Tusang Huiming "Being shot even while lying down" is a recent Internet term, which refers to the kind of incident that has nothing to do with it...

c00e6f6a51d2dce80e6121bc7acf02c7b4a3c620.sourceText: 慧明：躺着连中枪 图桑 慧明 ”躺着也中枪”是最近出现的网络用语，说的是那种和事件没什么关联的人，却莫名其妙地被牵连上了。从语言学上说，这类语言出现是很有意义的。因为它的出现让人感到生活中已经有了很多这样的原型积淀，被语言高人表达出来了。于是便想起了许多事情。 家父抗战之后，沿长江东行，一路以教书为生。到了南京，经朋友介绍到当时的国民党遗族子弟学校教书。这个遗族学校基本上是抗战时阵亡的国民党将士的子女。对于书生的父亲来说，虽然手无缚鸡之力，不能上战场杀敌，但能为这些孩子尽一点力也算告慰抗战的英雄了。这也许是一介书生心底的念想吧。 谁知到了中国的反右和文革时代，这种念想随着个人档案都被挖掘出来，因为掌权的已经是国民党的对头了。诸如这样的问题首先被提出来了：你可以有很多选择，为什么偏偏要到国民党的遗族学校教书？这些问题提出之前，中国的读书人已经领教了新当局多年的教育，知道国民党抗战在大陆是不可以提的（现在可以了），所以在回答这样的质问时，常常以混口饭吃搪塞过去。 但搪塞是过不了关的。大陆当时最流行的准则一是毛语录，二是有罪推定。认为你有罪了，问你问题只是走个形式而已。所以那个时代中国的老一代读书人科学家都在不同部位中了枪――被送到劳改营、被批斗等等。 这种冤枉被中枪的事也经常在身边发生。一个人正好经过超市，见到另一人从内跑出，他断定是窃贼逃跑，便施了拳脚对付。警察来了反而将他铐起来了，因为他制服的是超市的工作人员，有协助窃贼逃跑的嫌疑。维护正义反被正义误，看来在不同的时代真有不同的中枪部位。 最近我也有了点躺着中枪的感觉。前些天有朋友告诉，说我最近进入某个华人组织的领导层了，要我请客。我寻思肯定是这位搞错了。过去在国内虽然也有个一官半职的，但自己从来遵循不入组织、不赴酒席，不请示、不汇报，不犯错误的信条，现在也就是写点东西罢了，没和什么人有联络哪。后来上网一看，还真发现兄弟的名字挂在那儿。不过想想人家也是为本地华人干事，要我干事写东西呢，我有何必这么不待见呢？挂个名就挂着吧。而且，亚里桑那那么大，谁在乎你挂不挂名呢。 原想暗中一小枪，就悄悄地这样过去算了。谁知还偏有人看见，说是你现在在主编亚省的《华人生活年鉴》，怎么能偏颇一方等等。其实主编这书是个为大家服务的苦差事，要想在一本书里显示本地华人的千人千面，本身就是要准备好中枪的。但没想到的是，出师未捷便又中枪了。 其实，亚省《华人生活年鉴》是一本反映华人自己故事的书，你的故事我的故事汇在一起就成了亚省华人自己的历史。在这本书里没有炫耀，没有攀比，没有地域和政治之别，只有平等和个人的故事。不至于主编是女性，所有的男性都不投稿了吧。 不过，躺着中枪也是你目标太大了的原因。中国红十字会在这次四川地震中少了许多捐助资金恐怕和那个郭美美成天在那里炫富有关系吧。人家不反省可以，自己的事情却必须自我反省，我们只是小心翼翼地为亚省全体华人竭诚服务而已，仅此仅此。 所以，想想中枪也有中枪的好处呀。
c00e6f6a51d2dce80e6121bc7acf02c7b4a3c620.translatedText: Huiming: Shot even while lying down Tusang Huiming "Getting shot even while lying down" is a term that has recently appeared on the Internet. It refers to the kind of people who have nothing to do with the incident, but are inexplicably implicated. Linguistically speaking, the emergence of this type of language is very significant. Because its appearance makes people feel that there are already many such prototypes in life, expressed by language experts. Then I thought of many things. After the Anti-Japanese War, my father traveled eastward along the Yangtze River and made a living by teaching along the way. When he arrived in Nanjing, he was introduced by a friend to teach at the school for the children of Kuomintang survivors. This bereaved school is basically for the children of Kuomintang soldiers who died during the Anti-Japanese War. For the father of the scholar, although he was powerless and could not go to the battlefield to kill the enemy, he could do something for these children and it would be considered a consolation to the heroes of the Anti-Japanese War. This may be what a scholar thinks deep in his heart. Unexpectedly, during China's anti-rightist and Cultural Revolution era, these thoughts were unearthed along with personal files, because those in power were already enemies of the Kuomintang. Questions such as this were first raised: You have many choices, why do you choose to teach in a school for the survivors of the Kuomintang? Before these questions were raised, Chinese scholars had already received many years of education from the new authorities and knew that the Kuomintang’s war of resistance could not be mentioned on the mainland (it is now allowed), so when answering such questions, they often excused themselves by saying that they were just trying to make ends meet. But prevarication will not pass the test. The most popular principles in mainland China at that time were Mao's Quotations and the presumption of guilt. I think you are guilty and asking you questions is just a formality. Therefore, the older generation of scholars and scientists in China at that time were shot in different places - they were sent to labor camps, criticized, etc. This kind of unjust accusation and being shot often happens around us. A man happened to be passing by the supermarket and saw another man running out. He concluded that it was a thief who had escaped, so he punched and kicked him. When the police came, they handcuffed him because he was subduing a supermarket employee and was suspected of helping the thieves escape. Uphold justice and be wronged by justice. It seems that there are really different places to be shot in different eras. Recently, I've been feeling a bit like I've been shot while lying down. A few days ago, a friend told me that I had recently entered the leadership of a Chinese organization and asked me to treat him. I thought this person must have made a mistake. Although there was a part-time official in China in the past, I always followed the creed of not joining the organization, not going to banquets, not asking for instructions, not reporting, and not making mistakes. Now I just write something and have no contact with anyone. Later, when I looked online, I actually found my brother’s name hanging there. But considering that they also work for local Chinese people, and they want me to write something, why should I be so unwelcome? Just put your name on it. Besides, Arizona is so big, who cares whether you have a name or not. I originally wanted to take a small shot in the dark, so I just let it pass quietly. Unexpectedly, someone saw it and said that you are now the editor-in-chief of the "Chinese Life Yearbook" in Alberta. How can you be biased and so on? In fact, editing this book is a hard job to serve everyone. If you want to show the thousands of local Chinese people in a book, you have to be prepared to be shot. But what he didn't expect was that he was shot again before he left the army. In fact, the "Yearbook of Chinese Life in Alberta" is a book that reflects the stories of the Chinese people themselves. Your story and my story together become the history of the Chinese people in Alberta. There is no showing off, no comparison, no geographical or political differences in this book, only equality and personal stories. It’s not like the editor-in-chief is a woman, so all men will stop submitting articles. However, getting shot while lying down is also the reason why your target is too big. The Red Cross Society of China lost a lot of donation funds during the Sichuan earthquake, which may have something to do with Guo Meimei showing off her wealth all day long. It's okay for others not to reflect, but you must reflect on your own affairs. We are just cautiously serving all Chinese people in Alberta, nothing more. So, think about the benefits of being shot.

6117a3df4e5aaed00f39ff205143b3cd3cf030ac.sourceText: 十大汽车失窃地 驾车去加州得小心 如果你开车去加州，记得锁好车子。据美国家保险犯罪局最新报告显示，2010年全美前十大汽车失窃城市，加州入榜八个。其中，中谷地区便包办了前三名。 加州入榜城市从前年的六个，上升到了八个。榜首是佛斯卢（Fresno），平均每10万人中，有812宗汽车失窃案。据麻州不动产投资顾问公司Location Inc资料显示，加州的汽车失窃率几乎是全美平均的两倍。 据美国的全国犯罪资料显示，加州每平方英里发生187起犯罪案件，远高于全国中位数的49.6起；每千人有36起财产犯罪案件，也高于全国平均的34起。加州每178人中，就有1人成为暴力犯罪受害者。 加州边境城镇以及位于中心的城市如士德顿（Stockton），往往是走私毒品、金钱及武器的转运点。据2010年FBI的犯罪报告显示，去年沙加缅度 （Sacramento）、奥克兰（Oakland）及士德顿是全美暴力犯罪率（不包括汽车失窃）最高的地区。士德顿及维加斯（Vegas）也被司法部认 定为墨西哥贩毒集团的转运站。 国家保险犯罪局发言人斯卡费迪表示，加州犯罪如此猖獗的原因不一而足，人口多加上汽车拥有率高是很重要的因素，人口密度也是关键。 另外，加州温暖的气候，驾驶人习惯开窗或打开敞篷，也给予窃贼可乘之机。 好消息是，当局说汽车失窃率已连续第七年下降。据FBI上月公布的2010年初步犯罪统计，与2009年相比，汽车失窃率下降了7.2%。若估计正确，至今秋正式报告出炉时，汽车失窃率将是自1967年以来的最低点。不幸的是，前五大汽车失窃地却是例外，失窃率反呈上升趋势。 全美十大汽车失窃之都： 1. 加州佛斯卢（Fresno, Calif.） 2. 加州莫迪斯托（Modesto, Calif.） 3. 加州贝克斯菲-迪拉诺（Bakersfield-Delano, Calif.） 4. 华盛顿州斯波坎（Spokane, Wash.） 5. 加州瓦里豪-费菲尔（Vallejo-Fairfield, Calif.） 6. 加州沙加缅度、亚登-亚凯德至罗斯维尔（Sacramento/Arden-Arcade/Roseville, Calif.） 7. 加州士德顿（Stockton, Calif.） 8. 加州维萨里亚-波特维尔（Visalia-Porterville, Calif.） 9. 加州旧金山-奥克兰-菲蒙地区（San Francisco/Oakland/Fremont, Calif.） 10. 华盛顿州雅基玛（Yakima, Wash.）
6117a3df4e5aaed00f39ff205143b3cd3cf030ac.translatedText: >Be careful when driving to California. If you drive to California, remember to lock your car. According to the latest report from the National Insurance Crime Bureau, eight of the top ten cities in the United States for car theft in 2010 were California. Among them, the Zhonggu area took the top three places. The number of California cities on the list increased from six the year before to eight. Topping the list is Fresno, with 812 car thefts per 100,000 people. According to data from Location Inc, a real estate investment advisory company in Massachusetts, the car theft rate in California is nearly twice the national average. According to national crime data in the United States, California has 187 crime cases per square mile, much higher than the national median of 49.6; there are 36 property crime cases per 1,000 people, also higher than the national average of 34. In California, 1 in 178 people is a victim of violent crime. California's border towns and central cities like Stockton are often transit points for smuggled drugs, money and weapons. According to the 2010 FBI crime report, Sacramento, Oakland and Stockton had the highest violent crime rates (excluding car theft) in the United States last year. Stockton and Vegas have also been identified by the Department of Justice as transfer points for Mexican drug cartels. Scafidi, a spokesman for the National Insurance Crime Bureau, said there are many reasons why crime is so rampant in California. Large population and high car ownership rate are important factors. Population density is also key. In addition, California’s warm climate and drivers’ habit of leaving windows or hoods open also give thieves an opportunity. The good news is that authorities say car theft has dropped for the seventh consecutive year. According to preliminary 2010 crime statistics released by the FBI last month, the car theft rate dropped 7.2% compared with 2009. If the estimate is correct, when the official report is released this fall, the car theft rate will be the lowest since 1967. 0da58161ea149b3cf1ed5fc14a6bcee1cfbdbf53.sourceText: 广州杨绮薇：“奥数”是天使还是妖魔？ 为了进入更好的大学，很多学生和家长都热衷奥数，认为奥数是跨进知名高校的”敲门砖”，无论如何都要抓在手中。事实上，因为奥赛突出而被被加分保送到高校或是获得自主招生资格的事例比比皆是，因此，很多学生和家长都把升学的希望寄托在奥数上。 但是，最近奥数热开始降温，原因主要是”第三届中国小学数学教育峰会”提出，从2014年开始，奥赛获奖者都不再有大学保送资格，全国各省教育部门也陆续叫停各种涉及”奥数”的培训。这瓢冷水泼下来，有人叫好，有人担忧。叫停”全民奥数”到底好不好？奥数是天使还是妖魔？一时众说纷纭，莫衷一是。 依我看，奥数本身并不是坏事，说白了也就是中学生数学竞赛，至少它可以帮助发掘一部分学生的特殊智力和数学兴趣，如果学生是真正出于兴趣学习奥数，那也无可厚非。只不过许多事情到了中国，总会改变味道，好事会变成坏事，以至于成为家长为子女加分，考取名牌大学的敲门砖，这样一来，奥数就有害了。事实上，一个奥数得奖的学生参加高考的数学成绩肯定不会差，为什么还要特殊照顾呢，这不是让学生产生一种保险心态和侥幸思想吗？ 奥数加分的结果不仅对学生没好处，也败坏了奥数的名声。国际数学奥林匹克竞赛崇尚的是奥林匹克精神”重要的不在于取胜，而在于参加”，其目的是”发现鼓励世界上具有数学天分的青少年，为各国进行科学教育交流创造条件，增进各国师生间的友好关系”。然而，在中国，本应该是少数”天才”课外甜点的奥数却成了全民大餐，学校和家长盲目推崇升学率和名校效应，让奥数沦为妖魔。 美国哈佛大学教授、曾获”数学界诺贝尔奖”菲尔茨奖的数学家丘成桐曾多次在不同场合公开呼吁，取消高校免试保送国际奥数竞赛金牌选手。他说，奥数在中国被”职业化”了，在美国，学生只是把奥数当兴趣来”玩”。在中国，学生只要在奥数竞赛中获奖，就可享受免试录取，于是很多不喜欢学奥数的学生被逼着学奥数，一旦目标实现了，便会放弃思考，放弃数学。丘成桐教授认为，中国多年来培养出那么多位国际奥数竞赛金牌选手，却迄今为止没有一位能获得菲尔茨奖，这足以说明，”奥数热”并没有为中国选拔出真正的数学人才。更多的专家更是指出，”全民奥数”让绝大多数学生成了陪练，毁掉了他们学习数学的兴趣。 纵观奥数历史，确实出现过一些著名数学家。如斯坦福大学数学系教授李骏就曾获上海市数学竞赛的冠军。菲尔茨奖得主,华裔数学家陶哲轩，也是奥数冠军出身。 19世纪后期、20世纪前半叶最伟大的数学家亨利庞加莱，以他名字命名的 ”庞加莱猜想的证明”，使他获得三枚菲尔茨奖牌(数学诺贝尔)，这位伟大的数学家，恰恰是两届法国中学生数学竞赛冠军，并因此被保送进了大学。可见，奥数出人才，奥数造就大师。只是到了中国，奥数加分政策使其成了考取名牌大学的敲门砖，加分的诱惑增加了广大学生、家长和学校的精神负担，降低了竞争的公平性，也败坏了奥数的名声。 因此，专家认为，奥数虽然不是天使，但也不是妖魔，治理奥数并不是制止奥数，取消奥数，奥数可以继续办，但要让奥数回归本质，要抛开一切功利性的因素，让那些真正对数学有兴趣、智力超群的学生学习奥数，而且，必须取消奥数加分政策，奥数仅仅作为参考分数。还要改变考试方式，给学生提供多次机会，不要再一考定终身，可以借鉴美国的SAT（学业能力评估考试），让学生有更多的成长空间。
0da58161ea149b3cf1ed5fc14a6bcee1cfbdbf53.translatedText: Guangzhou Yang Qiwei: Is the "Mathly Olympiad" an angel or a demon? In order to enter a better university, many students and parents are keen on the Mathematical Olympiad. They believe that the Mathematical Olympiad is a "stepping stone" to enter well-known universities, and they must grasp it no matter what. In fact, there are many examples of students who were recommended to colleges and universities with extra points or obtained independent admission qualifications because of their outstanding performance in the Olympiad. Therefore, many students and parents have pinned their hopes for further studies on the Mathematical Olympiad. However, the Mathematical Olympiad craze has begun to cool down recently. The main reason is that the "Third China Primary School Mathematics Education Summit" proposed that starting from 2014, Olympiad winners will no longer be eligible for university admission, and provincial education departments across the country have also successively suspended various trainings involving "Mathematical Olympiad". When this ladle of cold water was poured down, some people cheered and some were worried. Is it a good idea to stop the National Mathematical Olympiad? Is Olympiad an angel or a demon? For a time, there were divergent opinions and no consensus. In my opinion, the Mathematical Olympiad itself is not a bad thing. To put it bluntly, it is a mathematics competition for middle school students. At least it can help discover the special intelligence and mathematical interests of some students. If students really learn Mathematical Olympiad out of interest, there is nothing wrong with it. It's just that many things will always change their taste when they come to China, and good things will turn into bad things, so that it becomes a stepping stone for parents to add points to their children and get into prestigious universities. In this way, Mathematical Olympiad is harmful. In fact, a student who has won the Mathematical Olympiad will certainly not have a bad math score when taking the college entrance examination. Why should we take special care? Doesn’t this give students an insurance mentality and a sense of luck? The result of extra points in Mathematical Olympiad is not only bad for students, but also ruins the reputation of Mathematical Olympiad. The International Mathematical Olympiad upholds the Olympic spirit of "the important thing is not winning, but participating", and its purpose is to "discover and encourage young people with mathematical talents in the world, create conditions for scientific education exchanges between countries, and enhance friendly relations between teachers and students in various countries." However, in China, the Mathematical Olympiad, which should have been an extracurricular dessert for a few "geniuses", has become a feast for all. Schools and parents blindly promote the admission rate and the effect of prestigious schools, turning the Mathematical Olympiad into a monster. Mathematician Yau Shing-tung, a professor at Harvard University in the United States and winner of the Fields Medal, the "Nobel Prize in Mathematics", has publicly called on many times on different occasions to cancel the exemption from examinations in colleges and universities and to recommend gold medalists in the International Mathematical Olympiad competition. He said that the Mathematical Olympiad has been "professionalized" in China, while in the United States, students just "play" the Mathematical Olympiad as a hobby. In China, as long as students win the Mathematical Olympiad competition, they can enjoy admission without examination. Therefore, many students who do not like to learn Mathematical Olympiad are forced to learn Mathematical Olympiad. Once the goal is achieved, they will give up thinking and mathematics. Professor Qiu Chengtong believes that China has trained so many gold medalists in the International Mathematical Olympiad competition over the years, but so far none of them has won the Fields Medal. This is enough to show that the "Math Olympiad fever" has not selected real mathematical talents for China. More experts pointed out that the "National Mathematical Olympiad" has turned most students into sparring partners and destroyed their interest in learning mathematics. Throughout the history of Mathematical Olympiad, there have indeed been some famous mathematicians. For example, Li Jun, a professor in the Department of Mathematics at Stanford University, once won the championship in the Shanghai Mathematics Competition. Fields Medal winner, Chinese-American mathematician Terence Tao, is also a former Mathematical Olympiad champion. Henri Poincaré, the greatest mathematician in the late 19th century and the first half of the 20th century, had the "Proof of the Poincaré Conjecture" named after him, which won him three Fields Medals (Nobel Prize in Mathematics). This great mathematician happened to be the champion of the French middle school mathematics competition twice, and was recommended for admission to university. It can be seen that the Mathematical Olympiad produces talents, and the Mathematical Olympiad creates masters. But in China, the extra-point policy for the Mathematical Olympiad has made it a stepping stone for admission to prestigious universities. The temptation of extra points has increased the mental burden on students, parents and schools, reduced the fairness of competition, and tarnished the reputation of the Mathematical Olympiad. Therefore, experts believe that although the Mathematical Olympiad is not an angel, it is not a demon either. Managing the Mathematical Olympiad does not mean to stop the Mathematical Olympiad and cancel the Mathematical Olympiad. The Mathematical Olympiad can continue to be held, but to return the Mathematical Olympiad to its essence, we must put aside all utilitarian factors and allow those students who are truly interested in mathematics and have superior intelligence to learn the Mathematical Olympiad. Moreover, the bonus point policy for the Mathematical Olympiad must be abolished, and the Mathematical Olympiad is only used as a reference score. It is also necessary to change the examination method and provide students with multiple opportunities. Instead of taking one test to determine their life, we can learn from the American SAT (Academic Ability Assessment Test) to give students more room for growth.

63bd7e56f6826ea109c16917beadaf13c6e11f02.sourceText: 因为日本的电影在海外并未大规模的公开，所以日本女性的美丽一直不为人知。但是作为日本美人代表的深田恭子曾在《Manolith》被公开介绍过。

94ca4f01b13b9c3f1717c59e926f129da807e9d3.sourceText: 寒冷的俄罗斯的女性非常热情，英语的发音也非常性感。
94ca4f01b13b9c3f1717c59e926f129da807e9d3.translatedText: Women in cold Russia are very enthusiastic and their English pronunciation is also very sexy.

f0cd7f2cf022428473c81e5871930275d067cc60.sourceText: 男性们都想去走访一下的国家就是泰国。兼人气女星和超级名模于一身的PANCAKE-Khemanit Jamikorn就是泰国女性美丽的代表。

24d3b905ad2081d228bbd68717f35f4e24a2780d.sourceText: 人们鄙视他人模仿自己或者伟人说话都喜欢拿鹦鹉说事，中国还有一句成语 ”鹦鹉学舌”， 就专门讽刺那种人云亦云的人。鹦鹉栖在树上自然就先中枪了。
24d3b905ad2081d228bbd68717f35f4e24a2780d.translatedText: It specifically satirizes people who follow what others say. The parrot perched on the tree was naturally shot first.

b9cc328588c26ac569276e263b1d90442b726d5f.sourceText: 鹦鹉中弹也是不可避免的。谁让他长得这么大个，还见天用花里胡俏的羽毛打扮自己呢。当然也是自己原本的沙哑粗粝叫声太有个性了。不过声音独特也不是它的错，但用当下的网络语言来说，你出来吓人就是你的不对了。想必鹦鹉知道这点，一打森林归化人间，便发奋学习人的语言，跟上认定的主弦率、正能量，每天努力，辍耕不息。
b9cc328588c26ac569276e263b1d90442b726d5f.translatedText: It is inevitable that the parrot will be shot. Who made him grow so big and dress himself up with colorful feathers every day? Of course, his original hoarse and rough voice is so unique. However, it’s not its fault that the voice is unique, but in today’s Internet language, it’s your fault if you come out to scare people. The parrot must know this. As soon as the forest is naturalized in the human world, it will work hard to learn human language, keep up with the recognized main rhythm and positive energy, work hard every day, and never stop farming.

b2e2c4d98e81264415af28cd4c17ca7b40512479.sourceText: 所以，鹦鹉进入人类社会基本上是受欢迎的。因为”你好””吃了没有？”这样的话出于一个异族之嘴，还是挺逗的。但不逗的是，这鹦鹉太喜欢察言观色，一看人类对它的模仿喜形于色，便变本加厉地模仿它听到的所有的语言了，不该学的和不该听的也学了，久之，便有了上述成语。而且表现欲望也太强，学了几句新词，便喜欢不看场合的显摆，这就讨人嫌了。
b2e2c4d98e81264415af28cd4c17ca7b40512479.translatedText: Therefore, parrots are basically welcome to enter human society. Because "Hello" and "Have you eaten?" are quite funny coming from a foreigner. But what's not funny is that this parrot likes to watch people's words too much. When it sees humans imitating it, it becomes happy and imitates all the languages ​​​​it hears. It also learns the words it shouldn't learn and the things it shouldn't listen to. Over time, the above-mentioned idioms were born. Moreover, the desire to express is too strong. After learning a few new words, he likes to show off regardless of the occasion, which is annoying.

ee3ccf056339ba46fb8017cb0c00f10fd706c36b.sourceText: 其实，世间学舌的生物多去了，也没有遭人嫌，还落个成语段位。比如八哥也学人话，但人家长的俏，虽然一身黑，但黑得泛蓝，那小喙还一抹嫩黄，所以还有个”俏八哥”的美称。我家小区有一类小鸟，每年春夏之交从早到晚，甚至半夜也叫。与见到的任何鸟不同，这鸟每隔几分钟学叫一种鸟声，惟妙惟肖，统计一下大概有二十种上下不同的鸟叫都被它囊括去了。因为模仿的多了我至今没弄懂它的本色是何种声调。邻居都叫它拷贝鸟，一谈起小鸟都喜形于色，为本小区有这样可爱的小精灵而自豪。我倒见过一次这小家伙，长得灰不溜秋，不怎么起眼，可人家内涵胜过外表，没有招人嫌。
ee3ccf056339ba46fb8017cb0c00f10fd706c36b.translatedText: In fact, there are many creatures who imitate tongues in the world, but they are not disliked by others and even fall into the idiom rank. For example, the myna also learns human language, but the parent has a pretty face. Although he is dressed in black, it is so black that it is bluish, and his little beak has a touch of yellow, so he is also known as the "pretty myna". There is a small bird in my neighborhood that sings from morning to night, even in the middle of the night, every spring and summer. Unlike any bird I have ever seen, this bird learns to call a bird song every few minutes, which is so vivid that it counts about twenty different kinds of bird calls. Because I've imitated it so many times, I still haven't figured out what its true tone is. Neighbors call it a copycat, and they all light up when talking about the little bird. They are proud to have such a cute little elf in our community. I have seen this little guy once. He looks gray and unremarkable, but his inner qualities are better than his appearance and he is not objectionable.

e93f2aa2a281e83c39ebb51d4fd74c441f98bcad.sourceText: 人间的学舌更多了，孩童跟妈妈学舌、学生跟老师学舌、员工跟老板学舌、下级跟上级学舌都是此类，虽然后两种有溜须之嫌，但都是讨生活所致，也无可厚非。现在有了智能手机，玩起了微信，学舌变成转发了，花样和用意就更多了。无论吃穿玩乐、警句箴言、悲闻乐事都要分享一下，不分享就对不起朋友，像时下流行的酒风一样，你不喝就是不给面子。于是，我有大笑你不笑不行，我感动了你至少要流几滴泪；点个赞说明你心里有我，加个评论说明你够意思，有品位，弄得看个手机不知不觉地被人洗了脑，懵懵懂懂地也进入升级版的学舌—-转发了。
e93f2aa2a281e83c39ebb51d4fd74c441f98bcad.translatedText: There are more people copying words in the world, children copying words from their mothers, students copying words from teachers, employees copying words from bosses, and subordinates copying words from superiors. Although the latter two are suspected of slipping, they are all caused by the pursuit of life and are understandable. Now that we have smartphones and play with WeChat, copycatting has turned into forwarding, and there are even more tricks and intentions. No matter food, clothing, entertainment, aphorisms, sad news or joy, you should share it. If you don't share it, you will be sorry for your friends. Just like the popular drinking trend nowadays, if you don't drink, you won't give face. So, if I laugh, you can’t help but shed a few tears if I touch you; a like shows that you have me in your heart, and a comment shows that you are interesting and tasteful, so that when you look at your phone, you are unknowingly brainwashed, and you ignorantly enter into an upgraded version of imitation—reposting.

e28ed1f78061e15b397eb2a0aa5edc7e468cae12.sourceText: 老板和领导自然不甘落后，也拿着”阿爱风6”，见天给下属转发”员工应该具备怎样的素质””’教师的早餐应吃什么”，仿佛不如此就不能让人看到自己的境界和责任一样。要不，拖来那个文人骚客的无病呻吟，转给狐党狼群，显示自己的品位云云。
e28ed1f78061e15b397eb2a0aa5edc7e468cae12.translatedText: Bosses and leaders are naturally not to be outdone. They also use "Aai Feng 6" to forward to their subordinates "What qualities should employees have" and "What should teachers eat for breakfast", as if otherwise they cannot let others see their realm and responsibilities. Otherwise, drag the literati and slut's innocent moans and pass them on to the wolves of the Fox Party to show your taste.

6b9a8ab828f80e1a9ce7543c2349e13f1ef2a1dd.sourceText: 可不知怎么的，笔者没有感恩戴德，鹦鹉学舌那个成语反倒在此时冒出来了。其实，与其想着学舌怎样教育别人，不如看看书，思索一下自己，更能提高自身素质。
6b9a8ab828f80e1a9ce7543c2349e13f1ef2a1dd.translatedText: But somehow, instead of being grateful, the idiom of parroting came up at this time. In fact, instead of thinking about learning how to educate others, it is better to read books and think about yourself, which can improve your own quality.

5130172d668539ae4e17310900383c7f79b8afd6.sourceText: 一走进活动大厅，就看见旗帜飞扬，很多人的脖子或者胸前都带着党员丝巾。直属分部常务委员，后援会会长王玮王亭上台讲话，感谢大家的支持，同时表示本次动员了六十多位朋友回台湾支持马英九，其中12位参加助选团将在台湾进行为期10天的拉票助选活动。目前，投票形势依然严峻，但是后援会一定会全力以赴，力挺到底。直属分部的主持人蔡先生表示，今天有这样的活动是非常多志工和友人的奉献，其中周琼华，徐彭树霞，朱家佑是幕后的大功臣。很多志愿者也表示希望以后能为直属分部做更多的事情。 1月份很多朋友都要回台助选了，大家都非常欣喜和激动，纷纷唱起了台湾的革命歌曲《中华民国颂》《 梅花》 还有《蓝天白云》，常务委员王玮王亭”做得总是比说的更好”，她亲自烹饪的6菜2汤在联谊会上更是受到大家的强赞！很多志工把家里原生态的水果摘下来和朋友们一起分享。现场台上台下融合成一片欢乐的海洋，温馨鼓舞。
5130172d668539ae4e17310900383c7f79b8afd6.translatedText: As soon as they entered the event hall, they saw flags flying, and many people wore party member scarves around their necks or chests. Wang Wei and Wang Ting, standing member of the directly affiliated branch and president of the support association, took the stage to speak, thanking everyone for their support. He also said that more than 60 friends have been mobilized to return to Taiwan to support Ma Ying-jeou, and 12 of them will participate in the election team to conduct a 10-day canvassing campaign in Taiwan. At present, the voting situation is still grim, but the support club will definitely go all out to support it to the end. Mr. Cai, the host of the directly affiliated branch, said that such an event today is the result of the dedication of many volunteers and friends, among whom Zhou Qionghua, Xu Pengshuxia, and Zhu Jiayou are the major contributors behind the scenes. Many volunteers also expressed their hope to do more for the directly affiliated branch in the future. Many friends will return to Taiwan to support the election in January. Everyone is very happy and excited. They sang Taiwan's revolutionary songs "Ode to the Republic of China", "Plum Blossom" and "Blue Sky and White Clouds". Standing Committee Member Wang Wei and Wang Ting "always do better than they say". The 6 dishes and 2 soups she cooked personally were highly praised by everyone at the party! 6b79a2892929fdb975edbba54e9410b0035504e0.sourceText: 餐馆也争取接受食品券 美国农业部的记录显示，从2005年到2010年，美国接受食品券的企业数量增加三分之一，因为从便利店、折扣店、加油站到药店都加入接受对穷人的补助项目。 现在，一直没有参加该项目的餐馆也在游说，希望得到救济项目的一份。 根据联邦游说记录，总部设在路易斯维尔的百胜集团（Yum! Brands）正在试图让旗下餐馆参与。 百胜集团下属连锁餐馆包括塔克贝尔（Taco Bell）、肯德基炸鸡（KFC）、龙江席尔瓦（Long John Silver’s）和必胜客（Pizza Hut）。 那是反饥饿权益人士所欢迎的趋势，但它却让现有的食品券零售商和公共卫生人士感到担忧。 联邦规则本来禁止使用食品券购买现成食品。 食品券是美国农业部分发的补充营养救济项目。 但1970年的法规有一条款允许各州让餐馆为使用食品券的残疾人、老人和无家可归者服务。 从2005年到2010年，得到补充营养救济项目证书的企业从15.6万增加到20.9万家。 而农业部的记录显示，同期食品券救济资金从285亿美元增加到647亿美元。 四个州已经允许餐馆接受食品券，其中佛罗里达是最新加入该项目的。 百胜集团发言人布鲁姆（Jonathan Blum）说，在加州、亚利桑那和密歇根都发挥很好作用的项目完全应当扩大，帮助无家可归者、老人和残疾人使用食品券购买现成食品。 全国餐馆协会也支持百胜集团的做法。 但全国便利店协会反对。 便利店协会发言人列那德（Jeff Lenard）说，饼只有这么大，没有人想看到把饼切薄。 也不能肯定它符合公共健康利益。 耶鲁卢德食品政策和肥胖中心主任布朗内尔（Kelly Brownell）说，鼓励快餐消费对人们的健康不好。 类似百胜集团这样的公司甚至考虑加入补充营养的项目都是很荒谬的。
6b79a2892929fdb975edbba54e9410b0035504e0.translatedText: Restaurants are also fighting to accept food stamps. USDA records show that from 2005 to 2010, the number of businesses in the United States that accept food stamps increased by one-third, as convenience stores, discount stores, gas stations and pharmacies all joined the program to accept subsidies for the poor. Now, restaurants that have been outside the program are lobbying for a piece of the relief package. Louisville-based Yum! Brands is trying to get its restaurants to participate, according to federal lobbying records. Yum Brands’ restaurant chains include Taco Bell, KFC, Long John Silver’s and Pizza Hut. That's a trend welcomed by anti-hunger rights activists, but one that worries existing food stamp retailers and public health advocates. Federal rules would have prohibited the use of food stamps to purchase ready-made foods. Food stamps are a supplemental nutrition relief program distributed by the United States Department of Agriculture. But the 1970 statute includes a provision that allows states to let restaurants serve disabled, elderly and homeless people who use food stamps. From 2005 to 2010, the number of enterprises receiving supplementary nutrition relief program certificates increased from 156,000 to 209,000. Department of Agriculture records show that food stamp relief funding increased from $28.5 billion to $64.7 billion during the same period. Four states already allow restaurants to accept food stamps, with Florida the latest to join the program. Yum spokesman Jonathan Blum said programs that have worked well in California, Arizona and Michigan should be expanded to help homeless, elderly and disabled people use food stamps to buy ready-made food. The National Restaurant Association also supports Yum! But the National Association of Convenience Stores opposed it. Convenience Store Association spokesman Jeff Lenard said the pie is only so big and no one wants to see the pie sliced ​​thin. Nor is it certain that it is in the public health interest. Kelly Brownell, director of the Rudd Center for Food Policy and Obesity at Yale, said encouraging fast food consumption is bad for people's health. It's ridiculous that a company like Yum Brands would even consider adding a nutritional supplement program.
