d2f4b6134981c26c5ee94640415bcb5bcfa16744.sourceText: （亚利桑那华人历史协会通讯）2017年5月13日，亚利桑那华人历史协会在凤凰城的凤城酒家举行成立大会，来自亚省各社团的负责人、学术界知名教授、作家、艺术家和热心人士近四十人参加了成立大会。 新成立的亚利桑那华人历史协会，是由资深侨领余文劲、关宗任担任荣誉会长，邓朝驹、邓洪钺、 曹今奇、 David Yee、Albert Lin任名誉顾问；陈怀宇（ASU历史教授）、吴疆（亚大教授）、杨立博士（图桑历史学家）、刘倩博士（ASU大学东亚图书馆）、何乐平（ASU图书馆研究员）任学术顾问，以及亚利桑那华人历史协会理事和会员所组成。首任会长由张肇鸿担任，唐孝先为副会长，余民信为秘书长，理事成员包括有：徐强、阮霭明、谢成彦和陈丽君。 成立大会由副会长唐孝先主持，他热烈地欢迎侨学界先进和热心人士前来出席成立大会，感谢大家给予的大力支持和鼓励。他指出，亚省华人历史协会是一个由本州华人组成的非营利组织，日后会联络专业历史学家和业馀历史爱好者，共同收集、研究、整理在美华人的历史，立足本州、联合全美华人的相关团体和机构，为华人和主流社会作出应有的贡献。 会长张肇鸿在致辞中阐明了协会成立的宗旨：协会将研究二百年来在美华人的历史状况，着重发掘本州华人历史与文化，缅怀华人先民对美国社会作出的贡献，警惕和扺制社会上仍残存的种族歧视现象，褒扬各界华人中的杰出英才等。秘书长余民信在会上作了积极的发言，理事徐强、阮霭明也发表了热情洋溢的讲话，希望更多华人立志研究、学习华人历史并加入协会。 美国华人联合总会（United Chinese American ，UCA）主席薛海培为大会发来了贺信。资深侨领余文劲 先生热烈祝贺亚利桑那华人历史协会的成立！参会的各界代表先后致辞，钱德勒市黄馨民议员呼吁华人积极参政在市政府争取更多席位，以史为鉴，为争取华人的权益而努力；侨联总会前主席余文泽希望协会在新的历史时期为侨社作出贡献；华联会长李健期许协会与本州其他史学界、华人侨社在历史文化项目的合作上积极互动。 名誉顾问林子宣强调了华裔在亚裔族群的重要性，华裔应继续保持与其他亚裔族群友好合作，增强亚裔在本州的凝聚力。来自图森的华人历史学家杨立博士希望协会不但要纪念和反思华人遭到的不公正待遇，正视华人的历史贡献，更要积极开展学术研究和学术交流活动。张文武代表州立大学孙飞教授发言，希望协会积极与本州大学开展学术课题研究；文物收藏爱好者韩豫展示了五张反映19世纪中末期华人生活的珍贵照片。知名画家高映霞代表云南同乡会发言，希望能够促进协会和同乡会的历史文化交流活动。工程师程明以美国历史上华人参政事迹为例子，激励新一代的年轻华人敢于担当、勇于参政。 参加成立大会还有余风采堂主席余自重，耆英会主席尹凤影 ，代表翁江庭，前华联会长陶世诚，亚省华联代表赵彩虹，州立大学教授Ally ，凤凰城侨联代表余文卓、闻玲琳，台湾同乡会前主席陈彩屏，微信群主邓凌和黄震捷，作家汪静玉，钱晓吾和夫人杨萍，历史文物收藏者韩豫，林泉 ，徐薇 ，王小丽，亚省华人历史基金赞助人梁月圆等。大家 期许协会今后为整编华人历史，面向未来，继承和弘扬中华民族的优良传统，发挥桥樑和纽带作用，不断书写华人华侨奋斗历史的新篇章！会议结束后，来宾们合影留念。至目前，亚利桑那华人历史协会已筹集到基金五千多元。 （黄丽容报道 艺柳白摄影）
d2f4b6134981c26c5ee94640415bcb5bcfa16744.translatedText: (Newsletter of the Arizona Chinese Historical Association) On May 13, 2017, the Arizona Chinese Historical Association held its inaugural meeting at the Fengcheng Restaurant in Phoenix. Nearly forty people from various associations in the province, well-known academic professors, writers, artists and enthusiasts attended the inaugural meeting. The newly established Arizona Chinese Historical Association has senior overseas Chinese leaders Yu Wenjin and Guan Zongren as honorary presidents, and Deng Chaoju, Deng Hongyue, Cao Jinqi, David Yee, Albert Lin serves as the honorary advisor; Chen Huaiyu (ASU history professor), Wu Jiang (ASU professor), Dr. Yang Li (Tucson historian), Dr. Liu Qian (ASU University East Asian Library), He Leping (ASU library researcher) serve as academic advisors, as well as directors and members of the Arizona Chinese Historical Association. The first president is Zhang Zhaohong, Tang Xiaoxian is the vice president, and Yu Minxin is the secretary-general. The board members include: Xu Qiang, Ruan Aiming, Xie Chengyan and Chen Lijun. The founding meeting was presided over by Vice President Tang Xiaoxian. He warmly welcomed advanced and enthusiastic people from the overseas Chinese academic circles to attend the founding meeting, and thanked everyone for their strong support and encouragement. He pointed out that the Alberta Chinese Historical Association is a non-profit organization composed of Chinese in the state. In the future, it will contact professional historians and amateur history enthusiasts to jointly collect, research, and organize the history of Chinese in the United States. It will be based in the state and unite relevant Chinese groups and institutions across the United States to make due contributions to the Chinese and mainstream society. In his speech, President Zhang Zhaohong clarified the purpose of the establishment of the association: The association will study the historical situation of Chinese in the United States over the past two hundred years, focus on exploring the history and culture of the Chinese in the state, commemorate the contributions made by the Chinese ancestors to American society, be vigilant and curb the remaining racial discrimination in society, and praise outstanding talents among Chinese from all walks of life. Secretary-General Yu Minxin made a positive speech at the meeting, and directors Xu Qiang and Ruan Aiming also delivered enthusiastic speeches, hoping that more Chinese would be determined to study and learn Chinese history and join the association. Xue Haipei, chairman of the United Chinese American (UCA), sent a congratulatory letter to the conference. Senior overseas Chinese leader Mr. Yu Wenjin warmly congratulates the establishment of the Arizona Chinese Historical Association! Representatives from all walks of life who participated in the meeting delivered speeches. Chandler City Councilor Huang Xinmin called on the Chinese to actively participate in politics and strive for more seats in the city government, learn from history, and work hard to fight for the rights and interests of the Chinese; Yu Wenze, former chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, hopes that the association will contribute to the overseas Chinese community in the new historical period; Li Jian, president of the Overseas Chinese Federation, hopes that the association will actively interact with other historical circles and Chinese overseas Chinese communities in the state on cooperation in historical and cultural projects. Honorary consultant Lin Zixuan emphasized the importance of Chinese among the Asian ethnic groups. Chinese Americans should continue to maintain friendly cooperation with other Asian ethnic groups to enhance the cohesion of Asians in the state. Dr. Yang Li, a Chinese historian from Tucson, hopes that the association will not only commemorate and reflect on the unfair treatment of the Chinese, face up to the historical contributions of the Chinese, but also actively carry out academic research and academic exchange activities. Zhang Wenwu spoke on behalf of Professor Sun Fei of the State University, hoping that the association would actively carry out academic research with the state's universities; cultural relic collection enthusiast Han Yu showed five precious photos reflecting the life of the Chinese in the mid-to-late 19th century. Well-known painter Gao Yingxia spoke on behalf of the Yunnan Association, hoping to promote historical and cultural exchange activities between the association and the association. Engineer Cheng Ming used the examples of Chinese political participation in American history to inspire a new generation of young Chinese to take responsibility and participate in politics. Also attending the founding meeting were Yu Zizhong, chairman of Yu Fengcai Hall, Yin Fengying, chairman of the Senior Citizens Association, representative Weng Jiangting, former Hualien president Tao Shicheng, Zhao Caihong, a representative of the Chinese Federation of Alberta, professor Ally from a state university, Yu Wenzhuo and Wen Linglin, representatives of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation, Chen Caiping, former chairman of the Taiwan Association, WeChat group owners Deng Ling and Huang Zhenjie, writers Wang Jingyu, Qian Xiaowu and his wife Yang Ping, historical relic collectors Han Yu, Lin Quan, Xu Wei , Wang Xiaoli, Liang Yueyuan, sponsor of the Alberta Chinese History Fund, etc. Everyone hopes that the association will reorganize Chinese history, face the future, inherit and carry forward the fine traditions of the Chinese nation, play the role of bridge and link, and continue to write new chapters in the history of the struggle of Chinese and overseas Chinese! After the meeting, the guests took photos. So far, the Arizona Chinese Historical Association has raised more than 5,000 yuan in funds. (Reported by Huang Lilong and photographed by Yi Liubai)

6c3226966d22f59a3d17acefcce560a755208eb2.sourceText: 《凤凰笔会》慧明:听声度人品 图桑 慧明 这两天总统选举如火如荼，好不热闹。小民不懂阶级斗争党派纠葛，也不愿参与政治，却喜欢听声音，以声度人品，一解暑气。 搞音乐的都在乎基本功，比如唱功发声什么的。这搞政治的就不讲究这些，只管口出狂言，恨不得用口水灭了人家才好。但男人用女人腔搞嘴巴阶级斗争往往是不能得人心的。 比如川普出口惊人，指哪骂哪，好像很有见地，也有不少人气。但声音嘛实在不敢恭维，听着有点像漏风的萨克斯，挤着想发点高亢的时代强音，但底气不足，嘴型又不怎样，总让人听见沙沙的漏气声。以前的克林顿也是这样，人高马大的，一开口却是娘娘腔。此类人相貌堂堂，也聪明，常有惊人之举，还真会吹萨克斯，但终究敌不过母虎镇家，荒废了一身武艺。比如写一本自传，也絮絮叨叨，充满娘气。 现任总统也是个会说事的高亢喉咙，死驴可以吹成个活马来，也真的将GM这种行将垂死的驴吹活了。尽管觉得说得比做得多，但听了八年，毕竟耳顺了，所以人们对他差评少了些，最多说他执行力差点云云。 那希拉里的声音却是个另类。本是女性却不好好做女人，却老喜欢用男人的嗓子唱自己的歌。欺负别人在民主党大会上没有话语权，便大言不惭地把什么好事都往自己脸上贴金。明明满心贪婪，却装着老成斯文，慢条斯理地叙述谎言，听着让人别扭。 大凡没修养，扯着嗓子辩白的或许真有委屈，不访且行且听。而那故作镇静，面面俱到的，肚里往往藏着龌龊，不听也罢。 其实都是不懂发声闹腾的。很多演讲绝对是佳文，是幕后高手静心调制的。若是换了朗诵家表演，也许他就是未来的总统了。哪怕化作了自己的精神，以情动人，至少粉丝会更多点。咳，现今想当总统的都是玩钱玩腻的，或是玩法律很精的那种，就是没有练唱歌或者当老师经历的，若懂得点发声技巧的，想必不会一开始就输在声调的起跑线上的。 不过，有迷人的声音也未必能在政坛上大有作为。小布什的声音倒还中听，可惜像兄弟口拙，又喜欢一根筋走到底，在伊拉克像个鸵鸟，一头扎进沙堆，至今灰头土脸的。这次他老弟筹了千金万金，声音听上去还忠厚，准备今年大干一场，但不料出师不利，想必就是占了小布什的霉气。 桑德斯的声音虽是饱经风霜，也有不少关爱之情，可惜那太沧桑的老调，只能吸引年轻的姑娘和小伙，在崇拜满身刺青的强壮社会中，故乡的路永远只能是梦想。 还有那副总统拜登的声音也本分真诚，让人感到了温暖。明知在美国禁不了枪，还在各方游说；明知关爱美国穷苦百姓不可能，但还是做足了无用功。真是不错。人都说为什么他不参加竞选呢？ 选战中还有一种声音不能忽视，那就是拥趸的呼声，特别在本党本派关门大会上，那种山呼海啸，涕泪交横的气势直逼当年三呼万岁的朝拜。不过听着听着便觉得五味俱全了。 民族主义的寨旗首先是要高高举起的。比如尽管手里拿的旗帜，会场上空的气球都是中国制造的，但从中国手中夺回制造业权利的口号一定会得到排山倒海的回应呼叫。 歧视他人他族的口吻也是必不可少的。你家里出了个败类，越了境爬了墙了，或者丢了个炸弹，连你全家全族全国都伐个死光光。特别这时又提起军队什么的，欢呼选民的声浪便充满了打遍天下都不怕的自豪。 个人崇拜旗帜虽然不好意思公开张开，但混迹于国家和民族的旗帜之中，就是被觉察，人也不好意思反对。但在旁人听来总觉得让人不舒服，还没到最后大选的时候，怎么两位越听就越有朕即天下的味道了呢？ 对没有经过封建社会和专制统治的美国民众来说，充满热望的眼泪是对信仰的专一，对英雄的崇拜，可对见过风雨的人来说，这和朝鲜哭脸迎书记的做法何其相似。有时不禁扪心自问，这是民主社会吗？这真是民主社会的腔调吗? 哦，哦，打住吧。再说下去就不是本篇议论的范畴了。还是这句话，喉咙里挤出来的爱意是抵挡不住来自内心的真诚善良的。
6c3226966d22f59a3d17acefcce560a755208eb2.translatedText: "Phoenix PEN" Huiming: Listen to the voice to judge the character. Tusang Huiming The presidential election has been in full swing for the past two days, which is very lively. The common people do not understand the entanglements of class struggle and partisanship, and do not want to participate in politics, but they like to listen to voices, which can judge their character and relieve the heat. Musicians all care about basic skills, such as singing and vocal skills. Those who engage in politics don't pay attention to these things. They just talk arrogantly and wish they could kill others with their saliva. But men who use a feminine accent to talk about class warfare are often unpopular. For example, Trump’s words are amazing, he criticizes whatever he wants, he seems to be very insightful, and he also has a lot of popularity. But I really can’t compliment the sound. It sounds a bit like a saxophone that is leaking air. I am trying to make a high-pitched and strong sound of the times, but I don’t have enough confidence and my mouth shape is not good. I always hear the rustling sound of air leaking. Clinton was like this in the past. He was tall and strong, but when he opened his mouth, he sounded like a sissy. Such people are handsome, smart, and often do amazing things. They can really play the saxophone, but in the end they are no match for Tigress Zhenjia, and they waste all their martial arts skills. For example, writing an autobiography is also verbose and full of girlishness. The current president is also a good talker with a high-pitched voice. He can turn a dead donkey into a living horse, and he has really brought a dying donkey like GM back to life. Although I feel that he talks more than he does, after eight years of listening, his ears have become more familiar, so people have less negative comments about him. At most, they say that his execution ability is poor. Hillary's voice is different. I am a woman but I don't know how to be a woman, but I always like to sing my own songs with a man's voice. Bullying others has no say in the Democratic Party convention, so they brazenly put every good thing in their own faces. He is obviously full of greed, but he pretends to be sophisticated and narrates lies slowly, which makes people uncomfortable. Those who are generally uncultivated and argue at the top of their lungs may be really aggrieved and do nothing but listen. And those who pretend to be calm and considerate often have dirty things hidden in their belly, so they won't listen. In fact, they all don’t know how to make noise. Many of the speeches are absolutely excellent, composed carefully by masters behind the scenes. If the reciter had performed differently, maybe he would have been the future president. Even if it turns into his own spirit and moves people with his emotions, at least he will have more fans. Well, those who want to be president these days are those who are tired of playing around with money, or are good at law, and have no experience in singing or being a teacher. If they know some vocal skills, they will not lose at the starting line of tone at the beginning. However, having a charming voice may not necessarily lead to success in politics. The voice of George W. Bush is quite pleasant, but unfortunately he is like his brother who is clumsy and likes to go all the way. In Iraq, he was like an ostrich, diving headlong into the sand. He is now disgraced. This time his brother raised tens of thousands of dollars, and his voice sounded loyal. He was planning to do something big this year, but unexpectedly he got off to a bad start, presumably because of George W. Bush's bad luck. Although Sanders's voice is weathered, there is also a lot of caring. Unfortunately, the old tune that is too time-worn can only attract young girls and boys. In a society that worships the strong and covered with tattoos, the road to his hometown can only be a dream. And Vice President Biden's voice is also sincere and makes people feel warm. Knowing that guns cannot be banned in the United States, they are still lobbying from all sides; knowing that it is impossible to care for the poor people in the United States, but still doing enough to be useless. Really good. People ask why he doesn’t run for office? There is another voice that cannot be ignored in the election campaign, and that is the voice of the supporters. Especially at the closing rallies of our own party, the momentum of roaring mountains, tsunamis, and tears is comparable to the three cheers of long live worship. But after listening to it, I feel that I have all the five tastes. The flag of nationalism must first be raised high. For example, even though the flags in hand and the balloons flying over the venue are all made in China, the slogan of taking back manufacturing rights from China will definitely receive an overwhelming response. The tone of discriminating against others and other races is also essential. There is a scoundrel in your family who has crossed the border and climbed the wall, or dropped a bomb and killed all your family members and the whole country. Especially when the army was brought up, the cheers of the voters were full of pride that would not be afraid of fighting in the world. Although the flag of personality worship is too embarrassed to be displayed publicly, it is mixed among the flags of the country and nation. Even if it is noticed, people will be too embarrassed to object. But it always sounds uncomfortable to others. It’s not even the final election yet, so why do you think the more you listen to it, the more you think I am the world’s leader? For the American people who have not experienced feudal society and autocratic rule, tears full of passion are a sign of devotion to faith and worship of heroes. But for those who have seen the storm, this is very similar to North Korea's crying face to welcome the secretary. Sometimes I can’t help but ask myself, is this a democratic society? Is this really the tone of a democratic society? Oh, oh, stop it. To go any further is beyond the scope of this discussion. Still saying this, the love squeezed out of the throat cannot resist the sincerity and kindness from the heart.

d886362d1b4ac294e51c33cfeab6a9874c6f8667.sourceText: 混合式学习 未来将倚重网络 教育部资深顾问罗宾斯强调，学校是「混合式学习」中的一个环节，而小区组织更能动员校外资源帮助低学力学生跨越障碍。 联邦教育部为提高全美中小学生的学业成绩，特别成立「邻里联盟中心」，鼓励非营利小区组织与宗教团体跟学校合作，帮助学生学习，尤其是帮助低学力学校的学生，并扩大小区组织与宗教团体对学校的捐款。 教育部资深顾问罗宾斯（Michael Robbins）19日在旧金山演讲时指出，教育部「邻里联盟中心」是跟白宫合作，推出行动方案提高学生出勤率、改善学生行为、提升学生成绩。希望每所学校都能指定一位熟悉小区人士，负责跟宗教团体与非营利组织联系，协助学校募款，并找寻义工帮助学校处理杂务。 教育部也在规画「混合式学习」的教学模式，除了传统的课堂教学之外，还可以藉助网络科技进行数字式教学。这种教学模式，很需要小区组织协助，让学生在家中、学校、图书馆、博物馆、网络社群，随时随地都能够学习。 罗宾斯指出，教育部将在今年8月公布「混合式学习」的课程设计与评估，盼望能够获得小区组织的大力支持。 罗宾斯举例说，有一个小区组织成立「大哥大姊义务老师团」，「兄姊」每天都要对自己辅导的学生提出三个问题：「你今天在学校做了些什么？」「你今天的家庭作业是什么？」「你最需要帮助的地方在哪里？」他们并不完全依赖学生回答这些问题，跟学生的老师们都以电子邮件联系，因此这些「兄姊」知道自己辅导的学生有哪些功课要作、有哪些地方不懂，甚至数学老师还会透过电子邮件告诉学生在小区组织里的「兄姊」，这名学生乘法不熟悉，电子邮件里附带一个连结，直接连到一堆乘法的题目。 教育专家们认为，「混合式学习」将可助学生认真学习，帮助他们找出未来的可能职业，知道如何规画未来，也更知道自己需要学些什么。罗宾斯建议有兴趣的家长与教师上网站 www.goorulearning.com 深入了解如何利用21世纪的科技帮助学生学习。
d886362d1b4ac294e51c33cfeab6a9874c6f8667.translatedText: Blended learning will rely heavily on the Internet in the future. Robins, a senior consultant with the Ministry of Education, emphasized that schools are a link in "blended learning", and community organizations can better mobilize external resources to help low-achieving students overcome obstacles. In order to improve the academic performance of primary and secondary school students across the United States, the federal Department of Education has specially established the "Neighborhood Alliance Center" to encourage non-profit community organizations and religious groups to cooperate with schools to help students learn, especially students in low-achieving schools, and to expand donations to schools from community organizations and religious groups. Michael Robbins, senior adviser to the Department of Education, pointed out in a speech in San Francisco on the 19th that the Department of Education’s “Neighborhood Alliance Center” cooperates with the White House to launch action plans to improve student attendance, improve student behavior, and improve student performance. It is hoped that each school can designate a person who is familiar with the community to be responsible for contacting religious groups and non-profit organizations, assisting the school in raising funds, and finding volunteers to help with school chores. The Ministry of Education is also planning a "blended learning" teaching model. In addition to traditional classroom teaching, digital teaching can also be carried out with the help of network technology. This teaching model requires the assistance of community organizations so that students can learn at home, school, library, museum, and online community anytime and anywhere. Robbins pointed out that the Ministry of Education will announce the curriculum design and evaluation of "blended learning" in August this year, and hopes to receive strong support from community organizations. Robbins gave an example of a community organization that established a "Big Brothers and Big Sisters" volunteer teacher group. The "brothers and sisters" ask three questions to the students they tutor every day: "What did you do in school today?" "What was your homework today?" "Where do you need help most?" They do not rely entirely on the students to answer these questions. The students' teachers are all contacted by email, so these "brothers and sisters" know what homework the students they tutor have to do and what they don't understand. The math teacher will even tell the student's "brothers and sisters" in the community organization through email that the student is not familiar with multiplication. The email contains a link directly to a bunch of multiplication problems. Education experts believe that "blended learning" will help students study seriously, help them find out possible future careers, know how to plan for the future, and better understand what they need to learn. Robbins recommends interested parents and teachers visit www.goorulearning.com to learn more about how to use 21st century technology to help students learn.

7e7f13fa89ee7f765f1efcacf30af824521a5925.sourceText: 5月2日，财富杂志访谈活动在美国内布拉斯加州立大学奥马哈校区举行。虽然本此访谈主题是关于女性在美国经济地位影响力的探讨，但在访谈会中，当被问到一直走低的黄金问题上，巴菲特称他不会买入。根据《福布斯》与3月发布的2013年全球亿万富豪榜显示，巴菲特仅次于时尚品牌创始人阿曼西奥-奥特加， 居于全球第三大富豪位置，其净资产达到570美元。
7e7f13fa89ee7f765f1efcacf30af824521a5925.translatedText: On May 2, the Fortune magazine interview was held at the Omaha campus of the University of Nebraska State University. Although the topic of this interview is about the influence of women on the US economic status, during the interview, when asked about the issue of gold, which has been falling, Buffett said that he would not buy it. According to Forbes and the 2013 Global Billionaires List released in March, Buffett is the third richest person in the world after fashion brand founder Amancio Ortega, with a net worth of US$570.

ba226482002cc561de9587ca362d30b3eea05c70.sourceText: 作为投资界中的佼佼者，巴菲特称，”即使跌倒1000美金一盎司，甚至是800美元，我也不会买入，我觉得黄金除了看之外，其实也没什么用处了” 。而在过去的投资中，可口可乐和富国银行为其主要投资项目，却被巴菲特比喻为好比一只”会生蛋的鸡”，能源源不断产生经济效益，而黄金却是一只”不会生蛋的鸡”。
ba226482002cc561de9587ca362d30b3eea05c70.translatedText: As a leader in the investment community, Buffett said, "Even if the price falls to 1,000 US dollars per ounce, or even 800 US dollars, I will not buy it. I think gold has no use except for looking at it." In past investments, Coca-Cola and Wells Fargo were its main investment projects, but Buffett compared them to a "chicken that lays eggs." Energy continuously produces economic benefits, while gold is a "chicken that cannot lay eggs."

706bbf8e504710cd501307d88311effca0dba062.sourceText: 今年十二月十八日星期日早晨六时半，在寒风的吹袭下，老襟楚荣与其妹秀卿，已分别接载我夫妇和林镜明夫妇，抵达耆英会的外面，天色朦胧中，只见很多耆老拖着行李齐集一起，等待「专门为你旅游」（Especially 4-U Tours）的大旅行车到来，前往拉斯维加斯外围的普里娒（Primm），参加威士忌皮特赌场（Whiskey Pete Casino）三日游。 不久，旅行车到来了，放置行李妥当，大家列队上车，只见车上已有一批会员坐在头位，优哉悠哉，好不舒服，原来第一站是纪念大厦，佔了优势，我们是第二站，中间位置，也算不错，居住康乐康宁的朋友就比较委屈，要敬陪末座。没关係，车子座位就是如此，必定有前后，大家无分彼此，毋庸计较，开怀高兴，踏上旅程。 一直到七时十五分，在康乐大楼完成最后的登车次序，美国女导游很谨慎地吩咐大家安坐，遵守秩序，仔细点数足够人数，宣佈启程直通威士忌皮特赌场。沿途有什麽特别景观，或停站歇息，女导游都清楚说明，中文翻译则由耆老团长司徒存担任，他通常是长话短说，或快语慢述，尤其加插半咸不澹的国语普通话，令人忍俊不禁，惹得整车游客哈哈大笑，可说是风趣的旅程。 这次去威士忌皮特赌场，让人有陌生的感觉。因为提起「威士忌」这个名称，稍为认识酒水的就联想到着名的威士忌，据字典的解释，都是通称所有以穀物为原料所製造蒸馏出来的酒，我几乎认为威士忌就是酒，或者专门售卖威士忌酒的场所，完全不知道加上「皮特」在后面成为一所赌场的招牌。我更孤陋寡闻是从未听说过，在离维加斯赌城外围四十多英里有个普里娒的市镇。 一切都感新鲜、新奇，很吸引，很有趣，何况只收费五十九元，另加六元小费，住宿两晚，免费三顿自助餐，优惠合适，非常便宜，，所以最先听到有这个旅程，太座就催促我及时报名，还相邀亲友共同玩乐。大约各耆英会员也是人同此心吧，五十多个座位早已满座，迟来的要安排另外一辆巴士，与老美同车，不能和我们一起嘻嘻哈哈的胡闹，减低了风趣行程。 从亚利桑那州凤凰城康乐大楼出发，直去内华达州睹城郊区外的普里娒山谷渡假村（Primm Valley Resort），路途遥远，大约三百英里，需时六个钟头，旅客在车厢中早有心理准备，各有表现，所以不觉纳闷；有的闭目养神，有的欣赏野外的景色，有的倾听音乐，有的互相谈话，有的拿出饼糖分发品嚐，有的独自在手机上操作….余江英还有备而来，带了一隻广东歌曲光碟播放，让大家欣赏，使旅途不感寂寞。 我最喜欢瞭望沿途的美景，途中有一处丛生许多特别的仙人掌，矮小而长出的叶块像箭猪鬆动的毛刺，据说二百棵雌性才有一棵雄性，雄性的树非常吃香。还有一处是古代火山爆发后的遗迹，留下奇形怪状的山谷地势。最让我意外是接近普里娒市镇的路段，两旁无人居住，狭小漫长，寂静无车，在约半小时奔驰，只见三四辆车经过，实在可怕，万一在此坏车，不知如何是好。 此次长途车程，半路上只在两个地方歇息，一处是维肯堡（Wickenburg）一处是金幔(Kingman)，让大家解决憋抑在肚子裡的不快，也可抚慰口齿喉舌的需求，并且鬆弛筋骨，舒缓久座的屁股与疲累的双脚，鼻孔则畅快呼吸新鲜空气。 终于，下午三时多抵达威士忌皮特赌场，赌场派代表招待我们这批长途跋涉的游客，可惜没有让我们品嚐威士忌名酒，只是赠送每人三张十元饮食券，以及一本赌场内的各项服务优惠券，总算让大家欢喜！
706bbf8e504710cd501307d88311effca0dba062.translatedText: At 6:30 in the morning on Sunday, December 18 this year, under the cold wind, Under the blow, my husband Chu Rong and his sister Xiu Qing had picked up my wife and I and Lin Jingming and his wife respectively, and arrived outside the Senior Citizens Association. In the hazy sky, I saw many senior citizens gathered together with their luggage, waiting for the "Especially for You" (Travel Specially for You) 4-U Tours arrived and headed to Primm, outside Las Vegas, for a three-day tour of Whiskey Pete Casino. Soon, the station wagon arrived, and the luggage was placed properly. Everyone lined up to get on the bus, and saw a group of members sitting in the front seats. It was so leisurely and comfortable. It turned out that the first stop was the Memorial Building, which had an advantage. We were the second stop, and the middle position was not bad. Friends who lived in Kangyuekangning felt aggrieved and had to accompany the last seat. It doesn't matter, that's how the car seats are, there must be front and back, everyone is indistinguishable from each other, there is no need to care, just be happy and embark on the journey. It was not until 7:15 that the final boarding order was completed at the Recreation Building. The American female tour guide carefully asked everyone to sit down and obey the order. She carefully counted the number of people and announced that we would set off directly to the Whiskey Pete Casino. Any special sights or stops along the way were clearly explained by the female tour guide. The Chinese translator was provided by the senior group leader Situ Cun. He usually told short stories or spoke quickly and slowly, especially with his salty Mandarin. It made people laugh and made the entire busload of tourists laugh. It was a fun journey. Going to Whiskey Pete Casino this time gave people a strange feeling. Because when the name "whiskey" is mentioned, those who know a little bit about alcohol will think of the famous whiskey. According to the dictionary, it is a general term for all distilled wines made from grains. I almost thought that whiskey is wine, or a place that specializes in selling whiskey. I had no idea that adding "Pete" at the end would become the sign of a casino. I am even more ignorant because I have never heard of the town of Privat, which is more than forty miles outside of Vegas. Everything feels fresh, novel, attractive, and interesting, not to mention that it only costs 59 yuan, plus a tip of 6 yuan, two nights' accommodation, three free buffet meals, the discount is suitable, and it is very cheap. So when I first heard about this trip, Taizu urged me to sign up in time, and also invited relatives and friends to join in the fun. Probably all the senior members share the same sentiments. More than 50 seats have already been taken. Those who are late will have to arrange another bus to share the bus with the old Americans. They can't laugh and joke with us, which reduces the interesting itinerary. Starting from the Phoenix Recreation Complex in Arizona, go straight to Primm Valley Resort outside Phoenix, Nevada. Resort), the journey is long, about three hundred miles, and takes six hours. The passengers are mentally prepared in the carriage, and each has his own performance, so he is not confused; some close their eyes to relax, some enjoy the wild scenery, some listen to music, some talk to each other, some take out cookies and distribute them to taste, and some operate alone on their mobile phones... Yu Jiangying came prepared and brought a Cantonese song CD to play for everyone to enjoy, so that the journey would not feel lonely. I like to look at the beautiful scenery along the way. There is a cluster of special cacti on the way. The leaves are short and grow like the loose burrs of a porcupine. It is said that there is only one male in 200 female trees. The male trees are very popular. There is also a relic after an ancient volcanic eruption, leaving a strange valley terrain. What surprised me the most was the section of road close to the town of Puli. There were no people living on both sides, it was narrow and long, quiet and car-free. After driving for about half an hour, I saw only three or four cars passing by. It was really scary. If my car breaks down here, I don’t know what to do. During this long drive, we only rested at two places halfway, one was at Wickenburg and the other at Kingman. They allowed everyone to relieve the unhappiness that had been suppressed in their stomachs, soothe the needs of their mouths and mouths, relax their muscles and bones, soothe their buttocks and tired feet after sitting for a long time, and let their nostrils breathe fresh air. Finally, we arrived at Whiskey Pete Casino at around three in the afternoon. The casino sent a representative to entertain us, a group of tourists who had traveled a long way. Unfortunately, we were not allowed to taste famous whiskeys. They only gave us three 10-yuan food and beverage coupons per person, as well as a book of coupons for various services in the casino. Finally, everyone was happy!

20b690620a01f10ad72c10c4a46781e4cbec0a82.sourceText: 凤凰城 唐孝先 故叔祖父唐文铭先生，江苏无锡人士，生前喜爱书画文物，收藏大量名人字画、册页、折扇、扇面，以及象牙、玉石、翡翠凋刻製作的艺术品。文革中的1966年8月，遭无锡市第十中学、柴油机厂技校、红专技工学校红卫兵非法查抄，几近殆尽。 中国文化史上最黑暗的十年文革，结束近四十年了。最近国内家里竟屡屡发现劫后有馀的珍贵书画，真是奇蹟，莫非祖先显灵。 其中一幅单条（见所附照片），是中国清代书画名家、篆刻艺术家赵之谦书法真蹟。 赵之谦，浙江会稽（现绍兴）人，生于道光九年（1829年），卒于光绪十年（1884年）。初字益甫，号冷君；后改字撝叔，号悲庵、梅庵、无闷等。书法全才，篆、隶、楷、行无所不精，尤以独特的「北魏书」最引人注目。 该条幅赵之谦用其独创的魏体行书书写，内容节选东汉王符《潜夫论》里的「论荣」。 「由余生于五狄，越蒙产于八蛮，而功施齐、 秦，德立诸夏，令名美誉，载于图书。」 这幅单条，笔力遒劲而朴茂风神益显，用笔沉着凝重，上下疏密均匀，给人以端庄肃穆、雍容朴厚的感觉，实为不可多得的书法佳作。
20b690620a01f10ad72c10c4a46781e4cbec0a82.translatedText: Phoenix City Tang Xiaoxian My great-uncle, Mr. Tang Wenming, was a native of Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. He loved calligraphy and painting cultural relics during his lifetime, and collected a large number of famous calligraphy and paintings, albums, folding fans, fans, and works of art made from ivory, jade, and jade carvings. In August 1966 during the Cultural Revolution, they were illegally raided by Red Guards from Wuxi No. 10 Middle School, Diesel Engine Factory Technical School, and Red Technical School, and almost all of them were destroyed. The Cultural Revolution, the darkest decade in Chinese cultural history, has ended nearly 40 years ago. Recently, precious paintings and calligraphy leftover from disasters have been repeatedly discovered in homes across the country. It’s truly a miracle. Could it be that the ancestors showed up? One of the single pieces (see attached photo) is an authentic calligraphy work by Zhao Zhiqian, a famous calligraphy and painting artist and seal cutting artist in the Qing Dynasty. Zhao Zhiqian, a native of Kuaiji (now Shaoxing), Zhejiang, was born in the ninth year of Daoguang (1829) and died in the tenth year of Guangxu (1884). The first name was Yifu, and the nickname was Lengjun; later the name was changed to Lushu, and the names were Beian, Mei'an, Wumen, etc. He is a versatile calligrapher, and is good at seal script, official script, regular script and xing script. His unique "Northern Wei calligraphy" is the most eye-catching. The banner was written by Zhao Zhiqian in his original Wei style running script, and the content is an excerpt from "On Rong" in "Qian Fu Lun" by Wang Fu of the Eastern Han Dynasty. "Yu Yu was born in Wu Di, Yue Mongolia was born in Baman, and he contributed to Qi and Qin, and established the Xia Dynasty with virtue. His reputation is recorded in books." This single piece has a strong and vigorous brushwork and a simple and majestic style. The brushwork is calm and dignified, and the top and bottom are evenly spaced. It gives people a dignified, solemn, graceful and simple feeling. It is really a rare masterpiece of calligraphy.

80e87672062a28c98e84d1277a2e6bde53b62a46.sourceText: 华裔多种方式迎美独立日 带着故土文化融入美国 编者按：将移民从原文化带入美国文化中，是美国历史的重要部分。…
80e87672062a28c98e84d1277a2e6bde53b62a46.translatedText: Chinese Americans welcome the American Independence Day in various ways and integrate their native culture into the United States Editor’s note: Bringing immigrants from their original culture into American culture is an important part of American history. …

dde1354dac83a593d58cf3b9bc37158363095bee.sourceText: 华裔多种方式迎美独立日 带着故土文化融入美国 编者按：将移民从原文化带入美国文化中，是美国历史的重要部分。正如众多移民庆祝美国独立日的方式，既保留有本土文化的痕迹，也加入了当地传统。 报道援引《迈阿密先驱报》(The Miami Herald)消息指出，在南佛罗里达州美国独立日当天，华裔家庭会前往公园享受一顿传统的甜点汤，尼加拉瓜裔家庭会在家中品尝烤牛肉(carne asada)和红豆饭(gallo pinto)，而巴基斯坦裔家庭则边欣赏着烟火边大口吃着咖喱鸡肉饭。 巴西裔移民卡洛斯博格斯(Carlos Borges)赴美已经超过20年。他称，”迈阿密生活着来自世界各地的人，来自不同国家的移民带着他们特有的食物、色彩和文化来到美国。”这些移民将南佛罗里达州视作自己的家，全美庆祝的大日子对他们同样意义重大。很多人在以传统方式庆祝节日的时候，加入了各自原文化的特色，通常体现在节日大餐的菜单上。 来自尼加拉瓜的移民艾达吉隆(Edda Jiron)称，”这个国家对所有希望融入进来的人敞开大门。’独立性’对我至关重要，我觉得美国赋予了我权利，我可以投票也可以回馈社区。” 独立日临近，《迈阿密先驱报》采访了华裔移民，听他们讲述独立日对他们的意义和他们庆祝节日的独有方式。 华裔移民带着故土文化融入美国 50岁的一代华裔移民温妮唐(音译)在形容美国给她的感觉时用了一个比喻的说法：她是一棵在中国种下的树，现在深深根植于美国的土壤里。 唐称，”我们在美国生活，这里就是我们的家，我们应该成为这里的一分子，而非一个永远的外来者。”正因如此，唐在每一年独立日都跟其他华裔一起在好莱坞的Topeekeegee Yugnee公园度过。他们对着烤鸡肉、热狗和汉堡大快朵颐，而后细细品味中国的特色消暑甜品绿豆汤或杏仁豆腐。 ”庆祝独立日是华裔群体表达自己能融入这个国家感激之情的方式，我们在这一天表达爱和尊重。”唐如此表示。 1978年，唐随父母一起从澳门移民至美国。1987年，唐搬家至南佛罗里达州，现在她在一家家庭护理公司任办公室经理，同时在”佛罗里达亚裔联盟”(Asian American Federation of Florida)和”佛罗里达华裔协会”(United Chinese Association of Florida)等社区组织中任职。唐的中英文交流水平俱佳，她觉得自己是联系华裔社区和美国社会的桥梁。她在社区的职责是帮助其他华裔向美式生活转变：寻找学校，获得工作许可证以及融入到华裔社区之中。 唐称，很多中年华裔移民在初到美国时，都抱有有朝一日荣归故里的想法，不过在幼年就移民至美国的唐并不这样想。”我们应该融入进现在的环境中，而不是遥远的故乡，”唐称，”远水不解近渴，就是这个道理。”
dde1354dac83a593d58cf3b9bc37158363095bee.translatedText: Chinese Americans welcome the American Independence Day in various ways and integrate their native culture into the United States. Editor’s note: Bringing immigrants from their original culture into American culture is an important part of American history. Just like how many immigrants celebrate American Independence Day, they retain traces of their native culture and incorporate local traditions. The report quoted "The Miami Herald" as saying that on Independence Day in South Florida, Chinese families will go to the park to enjoy a traditional dessert soup, Nicaraguan families will taste roast beef (carne asada) and red bean rice (gallo pinto) at home, while Pakistani families will eat curry chicken rice while admiring the fireworks. Carlos Borges, a Brazilian immigrant, has been in the United States for more than 20 years. He said, "Miami is home to people from all over the world. Immigrants from different countries came to the United States with their unique food, color and culture." These immigrants regard South Florida as their home, and the big day celebrated across the United States is equally meaningful to them. When many people celebrate the festival in traditional ways, they add characteristics of their original culture, which are usually reflected in the menu of holiday meals. Edda Jiron, an immigrant from Nicaragua, said, "This country opens its doors to anyone who wants to integrate. 'Independence' is very important to me, and I feel that the United States has given me the right to vote and give back to the community." As Independence Day approaches, the Miami Herald interviewed Chinese immigrants to hear their stories about what Independence Day means to them and their unique ways of celebrating the holiday. Chinese immigrants integrate their native culture into the United States. Winnie Tang (transliteration), a 50-year-old first-generation Chinese immigrant, used a metaphor to describe the feeling that the United States gives her: She is a tree planted in China and is now deeply rooted in the soil of the United States. Tang said, "We live in the United States, this is our home, and we should become a part of it, not a permanent outsider." Because of this, Tang spends every Independence Day with other Chinese Americans at Topeekeegee Yugnee Park in Hollywood. They feasted on grilled chicken, hot dogs and hamburgers, and then savored Chinese signature summer desserts, mung bean soup or almond tofu. "Celebrating Independence Day is a way for the Chinese-American community to express their gratitude for being able to integrate into this country. We express love and respect on this day." Tang said. In 1978, Tang immigrated to the United States from Macau with his parents. In 1987, Tang moved to South Florida, where she now works as an office manager for a home care company and serves in community organizations such as the Asian American Federation of Florida and the United Chinese Association of Florida. Tang has excellent communication skills in both Chinese and English. She feels that she is a bridge between the Chinese community and American society. Her role in the community is to help other Chinese-Americans transition to American life: find schools, obtain work permits and integrate into the Chinese-American community. Tang said that when many middle-aged Chinese immigrants first arrived in the United States, they had the idea of ​​​​returning to their hometowns one day. However, Tang, who immigrated to the United States at a young age, did not think so. "We should integrate into the current environment, not the distant hometown," Tang said. "Far water cannot quench the near thirst, that's the truth."

367b82a087583e70e606f1f79803fabd116ec424.sourceText: 图桑慧明：这里有家中国民间文化博物馆？（组图） 图桑 慧明 从外表看，和美国西部的许多建筑一样，这个街面房…
367b82a087583e70e606f1f79803fabd116ec424.translatedText: Tu Sang Huiming: Is there a Chinese Folk Culture Museum here? (Photos) Tucson Huiming From the outside, like many buildings in the western United States, this street house...

085dfb76221976ad1a19e5ba2b805f341a6b1bc9.sourceText: 从外表看，和美国西部的许多建筑一样，这个街面房子灰头土脸的，说它像个仓库倒一点也没有人怀疑。 但一旦踏上她的台阶，你就会被仓库里的陈设惊的目瞪口呆：怎么来图桑这么多年，竟然没有发现这里有座博物馆，里面的物件还全部都是来自中国的！ 馆内的摆设有点凌乱，所有的展品都混杂地散乱在大厅的各个角落―――美国经理怎么会知道唐宋元明清，乃至更早的朝代呢。但也就是这看似的凌乱，才让参观者有峰回路转，柳暗花明的感觉，才会瞬间拥有淘宝般的惊喜。 给人印象最深的是中国古代的家具。在这里你不但可以看到明代简约优雅的弧线，也可以欣赏清代从宫廷里流传下来的，细致也不乏繁琐的精美；你不但可以看到带有中国北方民风的淳朴大气，也可以看到南方家具的秀美和细腻。你甚至可以从这些雕栏镂花中嗅到大山和海洋的味道，窥得身着蓝地白花围裙的厨娘忙里忙外――― 这是中国宁波的架子床。
085dfb76221976ad1a19e5ba2b805f341a6b1bc9.translatedText: From the outside, like many buildings in the western United States, this street house is dusty. No one would doubt that it looks like a warehouse. But once you step on her steps, you will be stunned by the furnishings in the warehouse: How come you have been in Tucson for so many years, but you didn’t realize that there is a museum here, and all the objects in it are from China! The furnishings in the museum are a bit messy, and all the exhibits are scattered in various corners of the hall - how could the American manager know about the Tang, Song, Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties, or even earlier dynasties. But it is this seeming mess that gives visitors a sense of twists and turns, and a Taobao-like surprise in an instant. The most impressive thing is the ancient Chinese furniture. Here you can not only see the simple and elegant curves of the Ming Dynasty, but also appreciate the meticulous and cumbersome exquisiteness passed down from the palace in the Qing Dynasty; you can not only see the simple atmosphere with the folk customs of northern China, but also the beauty and delicacy of southern furniture. You can even smell the scent of mountains and oceans from these carved railings, and catch a glimpse of the busy cook in a blue-ground and white-flowered apron - this is a canopy bed from Ningbo, China.

6ca0b1966f95797636be2b9935a8550511f60531.sourceText: 此床虽然沿循了清代家具的雕龙画凤的风格，但却选了民间的传说故事为题材。漆色为朱红，符合当地追求喜庆的风俗喜好。不知睡在里面会有什么样的感觉？至少坐在床沿上的应该是一对披红戴绿的新人吧。 这个是标准的明代座椅，中国俗称” 太师椅” 这种座椅起源于宋代，奢华止于清代。虽然清代的座椅背后有大理石花纹的靠背，有玲珑剔透的雕花扶手，但比起明代座椅成熟的实用造型来说，似乎后者更受人欢迎。 好的座椅有用花梨木制的，更好的还有红木紫檀木的，但用不着这样奢侈的。你看，那紫红的色面不正代表着一种文化的积淀么？那圆润柔和的线条、坚实平滑的靠背和宽舒的坐板是不是有让人想试坐一回的冲动？现今的电脑族坐在这椅子上想必没了腰椎酸疼。 下面这个看上去旧了一点，但在造型上似乎靠近清代，也更有民间古风的味道。仔细看那靠背中央是龙凤交织的雕刻，大概平民百姓有时也会冒一点”皇帝轮流坐”的想法吧。 再看看中国的彩陶和雕塑吧。
6ca0b1966f95797636be2b9935a8550511f60531.translatedText: Although this bed follows the style of Qing Dynasty furniture with carved dragons and painted phoenixes, it uses folk legends as its theme. The paint color is vermilion, which is in line with the local customs and preferences of pursuing celebration. I wonder what it would be like to sleep in it? At least sitting on the edge of the bed should be a newlywed couple dressed in red and green. This is a standard Ming Dynasty chair, commonly known as "Taishi chair" in China. This kind of chair originated in the Song Dynasty, and its luxury ended in the Qing Dynasty. Although the seats in the Qing Dynasty had marble-patterned backrests and exquisitely carved armrests, the latter seemed to be more popular than the mature and practical shapes of the seats in the Ming Dynasty. Good seats are made of rosewood, and even better ones are made of mahogany and rosewood, but there is no need for such luxury. Look, doesn’t the purple-red color represent the accumulation of a culture? Do the rounded and soft lines, the solid and smooth backrest and the wide and comfortable seat make you want to try sitting on it? Today's computer geeks must have no pain in their lumbar spine when sitting on this chair. The one below looks a little older, but it seems to be closer to the Qing Dynasty in style, and has more of a folk antique feel. Look carefully at the carving of dragons and phoenixes intertwined in the center of the backrest. Maybe ordinary people sometimes have the idea of ​​​​"emperors taking turns to sit". Let’s look at Chinese painted pottery and sculptures.

40a8b9c8f9997bb561f1184fdcd2622e5d956ddd.sourceText: 这是著名的唐三彩。因为烧制时在物体各个部位加放了不同的釉料而呈现出黄绿白不同的色彩而名扬天下。这种唐代的动物陶器雕塑直到清朝修铁路时才被挖掘发现，想不到现在已经出现在美国西部简陋的案桌上了。幸亏这里的老美不太知道这陶器的价值，我们才有缘和今天这样美丽的照片相见。 人物的雕塑也各有特色。下面的女俑雕塑估计是唐末和五代时的造型，发髻一如唐朝，但没有唐初那般繁琐纠结，较为简单实用；衣者胡风气息浓，束腰高，开胸低，符合当时受西域影响的女装风格。不解的是，那两女俑垂袖挽手，交谈甚欢，是念及主人的恩典，还是感叹今日的世态炎凉？
40a8b9c8f9997bb561f1184fdcd2622e5d956ddd.translatedText: This is the famous Tang Sancai. It is famous all over the world because different glazes are added to various parts of the object during firing to produce different colors of yellow, green and white. This kind of animal pottery sculpture from the Tang Dynasty was not discovered until the Qing Dynasty when the railways were being built. Unexpectedly, it has now appeared on simple desks in the western United States. Fortunately, the old Americans here don’t know much about the value of this pottery, so we had the chance to meet such beautiful photos today. The sculptures of the characters also have their own characteristics. The female figurine sculptures below are probably from the late Tang Dynasty and the Five Dynasties. The bun is the same as the Tang Dynasty, but not as complicated and complicated as the early Tang Dynasty. It is simpler and more practical. The dress is rich in Hu style, with a high waist and a low bust, which is in line with the women's clothing style influenced by the Western Regions at that time. What I don't understand is that the two female figurines lowered their sleeves and held hands, chatting happily. Are they thinking of their master's grace, or are they lamenting the harshness of today's world?

27269ab0d516513cb2296f0ca3dcf39e46ac0ea2.sourceText: 眉目更清秀点，符合现今审美观念的女性雕塑也有：
27269ab0d516513cb2296f0ca3dcf39e46ac0ea2.translatedText: Female sculptures with more delicate features and in line with today’s aesthetic concepts include:

8e1e75b34a876b7b137964d14bd2ccd26decf1fc.sourceText: 上边这尊大家都熟悉，佛家菩萨观音，从来是点石成金，普度众生。民间百姓见她和颜悦色善解人意，便传她能保佑传宗接代，故又称送子观音。美国民众对此形象也不陌生， 华人车窗上常有挂件，保佑观音时而隔窗而见。 下边这位身材也与观音相当，但体态和外饰却与前者大有不同，发髻卷了，衣着少了，神情比前者少了一份安详，多了一份期盼，腿也交叉换站了。标签上虽然写着”陕西女神”，但感觉上有点距离，莫非雕刻匠当年走神一次，原本给观音的膜拜一不小心改为对自己女性偶像的崇拜了。无论古今，走世俗路线总是能吸引眼珠的。 还有各种各样不知道从中国哪里冒出来的民间雕像，堂而皇之地站在美国的土地上。下面第一张图片虽然五官还端正，但斑驳陆离的，好像不大耐看。看了说明才知道，这可是中国哪一地的虚拟地方官―――土地爷。这爷长得不怎么样，可也算神仙级别，是地方的保护神，尽管人们常说，别拿土地爷不当神仙，可今天面壁而立实在有点委屈了。
8e1e75b34a876b7b137964d14bd2ccd26decf1fc.translatedText: Everyone is familiar with the statue above. The Buddhist Bodhisattva Guanyin has always turned stones into gold and saved all living beings. Seeing her pleasant appearance and understanding, the people said that she could protect and carry on the family line, so she was also called Guanyin. The American people are also familiar with this image. Chinese people often have pendants on their car windows, and the Blessing Guanyin can sometimes be seen through the window. The figure below is also similar in stature to Guanyin, but her posture and appearance are very different from the former. Her hair is curled up, she wears less clothes, her expression is less peaceful and more expectant than the former, and her legs are crossed and changed. Although the label says "Shaanxi Goddess", it feels a bit distant. Could it be that the carver was distracted once and accidentally worshiped Guanyin instead of worshiping his own female idol. Regardless of ancient or modern times, taking the secular route always attracts attention. There are also various folk statues that appear from nowhere in China and stand majestically on the soil of the United States. Although the facial features in the first picture below are still straight, they are mottled and seem unattractive. After reading the description, I realized that this was the virtual local official of a certain place in China - the Lord of the Land. This guy doesn't look very good, but he can be considered a god, and he is the protector of the place. Although people often say, don't treat the earth god as a god, but standing in front of the wall today is a bit aggrieved.

8bae026b846ad02b4bb53330702c3ef229da7e3b.sourceText: 上边这个脸如满月，眉目清秀，一看便是那种考遍科举试，最后捧着如意做个小官的功名成功人士，估计是明代才子一类。虽然在地方上也算个人物，但有事没事还要参拜左面的这位。左右级别大致相当，但人家土地爷毕竟是神仙，精神领袖是也。不知老美识货否？ 下面这些也不错。
8bae026b846ad02b4bb53330702c3ef229da7e3b.translatedText: The face above is like a full moon, with handsome features. At first glance, he looks like the kind of successful person who passed the imperial examination and finally became a minor official with a wish. He is probably a type of talent from the Ming Dynasty. Although he is considered a figure in the local area, he still has to pay homage to the one on the left no matter what. The levels of the left and right are roughly the same, but after all, the land master is a god and a spiritual leader. I wonder if Americans know their stuff? These below are also good.

0a42b08d93240718233e5a83fa250a8f8aa99b49.sourceText: 《三字经》在中国很有名，虽然版本很多，解释的也很多，但熟读的人却不多，能将其用工整的欧体书写的人就更少了。欧体字体被人称为”于平正中见险绝”，初学似容易，但后代超过唐代欧阳询的几乎没有。不是心静如水，善于克己规划之人，是绝对写不出这样的字的。笔者曾见过中国总理周恩来年轻时练的欧体，虽然不能比肩欧阳老，但个字如斗，实为一绝。欧体只能小楷临之，中楷摹之，周却大楷书之，无怪人家日后做宰相了呢。说远了，见见书法除了狂草奔放的嘴脸外，还有工整规矩的面容和那刷子一样的笔对老美也许是一种惊讶和茫然，但对生活在这里的华人来说，却是凭添了一份亲切和喜悦。 听经理说，来这里欣赏和商谈买卖的都是美国人，不知道为什么没有华人。我想主要是不知道吧，也不是所有的华人都青睐西式家具和雕饰的。不信？如果有套仿红木的全套中式家具，保准货到就被人运走了呢。 权当广告一番，没准你会被打动，暗喜一回？ （地址：242 S.Park ave Tucson）
0a42b08d93240718233e5a83fa250a8f8aa99b49.translatedText: The Three Character Classic is very famous in China. Although there are many versions and many explanations, not many people read it well, and even fewer people can write it in neat European style. European style fonts are known as "dangerous in the middle of peace". It seems easy for beginners to learn, but few descendants have surpassed Ouyang Xun of the Tang Dynasty. People who are not as calm as water and good at self-denial and planning will never be able to write such words. The author once saw Chinese Prime Minister Zhou Enlai practicing European sports when he was young. Although he is not as old as Ouyang, his words are like a fight and he is really unique. The European style can only be copied in small regular script and medium regular script, but the Zhou Dynasty can be copied in large regular script. No wonder he became the prime minister in the future. Far from it, seeing calligraphy not only have wild and unrestrained faces, but also neat and regular faces and brush-like pens may be a surprise and confusion to the old Americans, but to the Chinese living here, it adds a sense of intimacy and joy. I heard from the manager that the people who come here to appreciate and discuss business are all Americans. I don’t know why there are no Chinese. I think the main reason is that they don’t know. Not all Chinese people like Western-style furniture and carvings. Don’t believe it? If there is a complete set of Chinese-style furniture imitating mahogany, it will be shipped away as soon as it arrives. Just use it as an advertisement, maybe you will be moved and secretly happy? (Address: 242 S. Park ave Tucson)

cd73e13c5f736cf75bfde0cb4ff5261529576562.sourceText: 洛杉矶古冬： 日本人的饺子 最近日本饮食界连续发生了三件事,令人深感失落,深感遗憾,彷彿六本木的铁塔忽然坍塌了,东京从此黯澹无光似的。 事件之一, 是日本快餐王国「吉野家」宣佈,由于发现疯牛症, 名下的986家店号, 同时停止供应每日大约一百万碗的王牌产品牛肉饭;事件之二, 是一家开在涉谷玄坂,已有五十年历史,但只有八个座位的饺子店,不知何故不开门了;事件之三,是一家开了四十年的着名咖啡连锁店,生意仍然蒸蒸日上,老板却认为服务水准每下愈况,同他原先的要求越走越远,而居然决定不干了!事情或多或少反映了部份日本人有趣的一面,所以不妨一记。 咖啡店已写过,这儿就不累赘。280丹(约美金二元半)一碗的牛肉饭不卖了,则唯有大破悭囊,吃400丹一碗的猪肉饭。这是大公司一个万全之策,不但保住了自身的利益,同时也为阁下的平安写下了保单,说是与民众共渡时艰焉! 你当然可以不吃,否则除了强忍割肉之痛之外,想不出还有什可做!倒是吃了数十年的饺子忽然没有着落了,就好比孩提断了奶,真有点不是味儿! 于是一些喜欢寻根究柢的人, 穷追不捨,不时到店前来遛转遛转,希望能探得个究竟。一家感同身受,并且一样八卦的报纸, 经过明查暗访,终于得知端委:做饺子的师傅死了,死前却把做饺子的秘方卖了给别人,因而店子开不下去了! 有这样的事情吗?咱家的女人谁个不会做饺子? 随便一招手,要多少个有多少个,怎麽一间巴掌般大的小店子,死了一个师傅就做不成了? 不错,因为这裡只卖最好的饺子;可是如果没有最好的师傅,又怎麽能做得出最好的饺子呢! 日本的饺子,其实就是我们的锅贴,跟云吞麵一样,一种街坊小吃而已,店子搞得再像样, 也不可能成为大雅之堂。 奇怪的是,这些店子可以很小,甚至可以没有店名, 却一定要把「饺子」二字写得大大的。 我们说的这家也不例外,远远就能把它认出来。不过走近点一看, 裡面非但狭小阴暗,而且简陋陈旧,见惯了大场面的外国游客, 只怕不屑一顾。可是偏偏,日本不少名店都是这个样子,大家吃的并不是它的装潢和排场, 而是它的名气和历史。他们也会说「室雅何须大,有麝自然香」。 饺子店以靓饺子招徕,历五十年不改,日久岁长, 吃它几个已经成为不少人生活的一部份,捨它莫属了。 认真点讲,日本饺子的馅料,要比锅贴单调得多,至少用羊肉和韭菜做的就不多见 。但是无可否认,日本人的手艺要比我们略胜一筹,饺子的皮做得又薄又白,样子也较细緻。而玄坂这家小店,尤为出色,不论何时光顾,总能保持好味多汁,新鲜香脆。人们斩钉截铁的说,它是全世界最好吃的一家了! 孤岛小民,既没有深厚的文化,又没有丰富的资源,每一样外来的东西都是得之不易,自然倍加珍惜,以致连小小一只饺子,也被视为天物,甚至硬把成吉思汗拉上来, 直指它是英雄的化身, 所以才能自古 至今,由东亚至土耳其,长期控制着人们的肚皮! 然而,假若英雄不死,也不过七百多岁而已,而饺子攻陷人类的肚子,又岂止千年历史? 在这漫长的岁月中, 物换星移, 不知道有多少饺子店开了又关,关了又开,不知道有多少饺子师傅来了又走,走了又来,从来只怕没有生意做,哪愁没有人开工,更没听说过什麽祕方不秘方的！可是哪裡想得到, 一家只有八个座位的小店子,死了一个老师傅,居然真的就开不下去了!日本人是不是太傻痴、太懵懂了？
cd73e13c5f736cf75bfde0cb4ff5261529576562.translatedText: Los Angeles Gudong: Japanese Dumplings Recently, three events have happened in Japan's food industry in a row, which makes people feel deeply disappointed and regretful. It's as if the Iron Tower in Roppongi suddenly collapsed and Tokyo has been in darkness ever since. One of the incidents is that the Japanese fast food kingdom "Yoshinoya" announced that due to the discovery of mad cow disease, its 986 stores will also stop supplying about one million bowls of its flagship product beef rice every day; the second incident, It is a dumpling shop that has been open in Genzaka, Shibuya for 50 years, but has only eight seats. It is closed for some reason. The third incident is a famous coffee chain that has been open for 40 years. The business is still booming, but the boss thinks that the service level is getting worse and worse, and it is going further and further away from his original requirements, so he decided to quit! This incident more or less reflects the interesting side of some Japanese people, so you might as well note it. I have already written about the coffee shop, so I won’t go into details here. The beef rice that costs 280 Dan (about two and a half U.S. dollars) a bowl is no longer available, so the only option is to save money and eat a bowl of pork rice that costs 400 Dan. This is a foolproof strategy for big companies. It not only protects its own interests, but also writes an insurance policy for your safety, saying that it is to tide over the hard times with the people! Of course you don't have to eat, otherwise you can't think of anything else to do except endure the pain of cutting the flesh! But the dumplings that have been eaten for decades are suddenly missing, just like a child being weaned from the breast, which is really a bit unpleasant! So some people who like to explore, I kept chasing after him and walked around the store from time to time, hoping to find out what happened. A newspaper that felt the same and shared the same gossip finally learned the truth after an open and secret investigation: the master who made dumplings died, but he sold the secret recipe for making dumplings to others before he died, so the store could not continue to operate! Is there such a thing? Who of the women in our family can't make dumplings? Just wave your hand, and there will be as many as you want. How can a small shop as big as the palm of a hand not be able to make it after the death of one of the masters? Yes, because only the best dumplings are sold here; but if you don’t have the best chef, how can you make the best dumplings! Japanese dumplings are actually our pot stickers, just like wonton noodles, they are just a neighborhood snack. No matter how decent the store is, it cannot become an elegant restaurant. The strange thing is that these shops can be very small or even have no shop name, but they must write the word "dumpling" in big letters. The one we are talking about is no exception, you can recognize it from a distance. But taking a closer look, the inside is not only small and dark, but also shabby and old. Foreign tourists who are used to big scenes will probably look down upon it. But unfortunately, many famous restaurants in Japan are like this. What everyone eats is not its decoration and ostentation, but its reputation and history. They will also say, "Why should a room be so elegant? It has the natural fragrance of musk." The dumpling shop attracts customers with its delicious dumplings, which have remained unchanged for fifty years. As time goes by, eating a few of them has become a part of many people's lives, and it is impossible to live without them. To be serious, the fillings of Japanese dumplings are much more monotonous than those of pot stickers, at least the ones made with mutton and leeks are rare. But it is undeniable that the Japanese's craftsmanship is slightly better than ours. The skin of the dumplings is made thin and white, and the appearance is more delicate. The small shop in Xuanzaka is particularly outstanding. No matter when you visit, the food is always delicious, juicy, fresh and crispy. People categorically say that it is the most delicious one in the world! The people of the isolated island have neither a deep culture nor rich resources. Every foreign thing is hard-earned, so they naturally cherish it. Even a small dumpling is regarded as a natural gift. They even dragged Genghis Khan to it, pointing out that it is the embodiment of a hero, so it has been able to control people's belly from ancient times to the present, from East Asia to Turkey! However, if the hero does not die, he is only over 700 years old, and dumplings have conquered human beings for more than a thousand years? In these long years, things have changed, and countless dumpling shops have opened and closed, closed and opened again, and countless dumpling masters have come and gone. But who would have thought that a small shop with only eight seats would really not be able to survive after the death of a senior chef! Are the Japanese too stupid and ignorant?

90e853a31cd41737897c0571813029351e75b981.sourceText: 筑梦高歌 砥砺前行 （亚省希望中文学校供稿） 1 月 13 日，希望中文学校迎来了新学期开学第一天。沐浴着和煦的阳光，经过短暂的冬假的学生们又回到了实习的校园。带着新的好奇，激动和憧憬迎来了又一个特殊而美好的新学期，在这里筑梦高歌，砥砺前行。新学期，新起点；新征程，新希望。 义工们早早的来到了自己的岗位做好准备工作 ， 不管是课程注册还是教科书发售都是有条不紊， 家长们无需长时间等候就能交学费买教材。 今年学校的各项活动非常多，春节庙会，朗诵比赛，毕业典礼等。 各个活动的负责老师们在放假期间就开始策划， 大家都卯足了劲要把庙会办的红红火火，把毕业典礼做的一年比一年精彩。 教学质量永远是学校的重头戏， 上个学期学校付费鼓励老师们积极参加各种网络教学培训， 通过培训许多老师在教学技巧和课堂管理方面都有所提高。 提高老师的业务技能和专业培训还将是我们的工作重点。 在提高教学质量的同时学校还十分注重各种丰富多彩的娱乐活动。 2017年秋季 学期除了以往的运动会和每个学期两次的换奖品的活动，在学期的最后一天整个校园充满了惊喜 – 圣诞老人来到了每间教室，给每个孩子都送上了礼物并鼓励他们要好好学中文。学生会的大孩子们热心学校活动， 两年前他们自己开始通过义卖的方式筹款每个月组织一次” student of the month” 奖励活动，这个活动一直延续至今。 全校家长积极支持各种义卖， 大孩子奖励小孩子认真学习以身示范的效果非常温馨也非常有说服力。 ” 希望之家，快乐之家”， 希望中文学校就是一个你中有我我中有你的大家庭，这个大家庭里大家互相帮助，齐心协力办学校，做文化的传承者让孩子们都能热爱中华文化，为自己的文化背景而骄傲。
90e853a31cd41737897c0571813029351e75b981.translatedText: Building dreams, singing high and forging ahead (Contributed by Hope Chinese School of Alberta) On January 13, Hope Chinese School ushered in the first day of the new semester. Bathed in the warm sunshine, the students returned to the campus for internship after a short winter break. With new curiosity, excitement and longing, we welcome another special and beautiful new semester, where we can build dreams, sing, and move forward. New semester, new starting point; new journey, new hope. The volunteers came to their posts early to make preparations. Whether it was course registration or textbook sales, everything was in order. Parents could pay tuition and buy textbooks without waiting for a long time. There are many activities in the school this year, such as the Spring Festival temple fair, recitation competition, graduation ceremony, etc. The teachers in charge of each activity started planning during the holidays. Everyone worked hard to make the temple fair a prosperous event and make the graduation ceremony more exciting every year. Teaching quality is always a priority for the school. Last semester, the school paid to encourage teachers to actively participate in various online teaching trainings. Through training, many teachers have improved in teaching skills and classroom management. Improving teachers’ business skills and professional training will also be our focus. While improving the quality of teaching, the school also attaches great importance to various colorful entertainment activities. In the fall semester of 2017, in addition to previous sports meets and prize exchange activities twice each semester, the entire campus was full of surprises on the last day of the semester – Santa Claus came to every classroom, gave gifts to every child and encouraged them to learn Chinese well. The older children in the student union are enthusiastic about school activities. Two years ago, they began to raise money through charity sales to organize a "student of the month" award event every month. This event continues to this day. All parents in the school actively support various charity sales, and the effect of the older children rewarding the younger children by setting an example by their own example is very heartwarming and very convincing. "House of Hope, Home of Happiness", Hope Chinese School is a big family where you are among me and you are among me. In this big family, everyone helps each other and works together to run the school and be the inheritor of culture so that children can love Chinese culture and be proud of their cultural background.

4eb7f51eebb9d66ab5e1b8e2bcc5da51a07fb67d.sourceText: 移民研究中心智库（CMS）周四发布的一份报告显示，2016年，美国非法移民从2010年的1172.5万人减少到了1079万人，人数是2003年以来的最少的。
4eb7f51eebb9d66ab5e1b8e2bcc5da51a07fb67d.translatedText: A report released by the Center for Immigration Studies (CMS) think tank on Thursday showed that in 2016, the number of illegal immigrants in the United States dropped from 11.725 million in 2010 to 10.79 million, the smallest number since 2003.

1f620998a34f6a50a08b91ed77b49d0eef91ecc1.sourceText: 这6年减少的将近100万人主要是来自墨西哥的非法移民，他们从2010年的660万人减少到了2016年的570万人。而同一时期，来自中国的非法移民却从29.5万人增加到了38万人。
1f620998a34f6a50a08b91ed77b49d0eef91ecc1.translatedText: The nearly 1 million decrease in the past six years is mainly illegal immigrants from Mexico, who dropped from 6.6 million in 2010 to 5.7 million in 2016. During the same period, the number of illegal immigrants from China increased from 295,000 to 380,000.

6fd94ea753fe03a649957462fea9622f0da6cbd0.sourceText: 这期间，来自中美洲的非法移民也有所增加，其中来自洪都拉斯的非法移民增加了10万人，来自危地马拉的非法移民增加了5万人。
6fd94ea753fe03a649957462fea9622f0da6cbd0.translatedText: During this period, the number of illegal immigrants from Central America also increased, including an increase of 100,000 illegal immigrants from Honduras and an increase of 50,000 illegal immigrants from Guatemala.

000ce1e1cfd67610c24053093788729ca1a40f78.sourceText: 另外，来自印度的非法移民也有所增加，从2010年的36.5万人增加到了2016年的47.5万人。
000ce1e1cfd67610c24053093788729ca1a40f78.translatedText: In addition, illegal immigrants from India have also increased, from 365,000 in 2010 to 475,000 in 2016.

4ffab36f4c26671f6b304171f2c2237c6e1c29d0.sourceText: 这份报告的结论指出，过去6年，美国非法移民人数持续下降，这是没有办法否定的事实。
4ffab36f4c26671f6b304171f2c2237c6e1c29d0.translatedText: The conclusion of this report points out that the number of illegal immigrants in the United States has continued to decline over the past six years. This is a fact that cannot be denied. The

c29601304b758ab5a6e3bea6c51c26f4f8edefd6.sourceText: 报告估计了2016年居住在美国的非法移民人数的数据。自2010年以来，来自大多数国家的非法移民人数持续下降。从下降的数量看，来自墨西哥的非法移民减少最多，约少了100万人。
c29601304b758ab5a6e3bea6c51c26f4f8edefd6.translatedText: report provides estimates of the number of illegal immigrants living in the United States in 2016. The number of illegal immigrants from most countries has continued to decline since 2010. Judging from the decline in numbers, illegal immigrants from Mexico decreased the most, with about 1 million fewer people.

f9f974161f5be58c3be480420cd2504834650288.sourceText: 从下降比例看，来自波兰（-47%）、秘鲁（-40%）、厄瓜多尔（-31%）、哥伦比亚（-29%）和韩国（-27%）的非法移民降幅最大。
f9f974161f5be58c3be480420cd2504834650288.translatedText: In terms of the proportion of decline, illegal immigrants from Poland (-47%), Peru (-40%), Ecuador (-31%), Colombia (-29%) and South Korea (-27%) experienced the largest declines.

bbd2c9feec9569e5fd6939ed3b89182e609c34ff.sourceText: 在全美各州中，伊利诺伊（-20%）、北卡罗来纳（-16%）、加州（-13%）、纽约（-13%）、亚利桑那（-12%）和佐治亚（-11%）的非法移民都出现了10%以上的降幅，只有得克萨斯州（+2%）的非法移民出现了增加。
bbd2c9feec9569e5fd6939ed3b89182e609c34ff.translatedText: Among states across the country, illegal immigration in Illinois (-20%), North Carolina (-16%), California (-13%), New York (-13%), Arizona (-12%) and Georgia (-11%) all experienced a decrease of more than 10%. Only Texas (+2%) saw an increase in illegal immigration.

1489ab7ca7d41c66cd95ebd6ba13fe64ed148b87.sourceText: 报告显示，来自中国的非法移民人数呈现增长的态势。数据显示，在1990年，来自中国的非法移民约有7万人，这一数字再2010年成长至29.5万，而在2016年成长至38万。
1489ab7ca7d41c66cd95ebd6ba13fe64ed148b87.translatedText: The report shows that the number of illegal immigrants from China is increasing. Data show that in 1990, there were approximately 70,000 illegal immigrants from China. This number grew to 295,000 in 2010 and 380,000 in 2016.

777f7b65cc56d3e14ffebcc37b45e3def37b3632.sourceText: 在这项研究所调查的主要国家中，除了中国，来自印度、洪都拉斯、危地马拉、萨尔瓦多和多米尼加的非法移民在2010至2016年间也出现成长。
777f7b65cc56d3e14ffebcc37b45e3def37b3632.translatedText: Among the major countries surveyed by this study, in addition to China, illegal immigration from India, Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador and Dominica also increased between 2010 and 2016.

f8d35d096f181282feecef87ba12bf329e38aa28.sourceText: 从非法移民的来源看，来自北美洲、南美洲和欧洲的非法移民减少了14%到23%，而来自亚洲、非洲和中美洲的增长了8%到10%。其中亚洲的增加也主要是因为来自中国和印度的非法移民增加。
f8d35d096f181282feecef87ba12bf329e38aa28.translatedText: Looking at the sources of illegal immigrants, illegal immigrants from North America, South America and Europe decreased by 14% to 23%, while those from Asia, Africa and Central America increased by 8% to 10%. The increase in Asia is mainly due to the increase in illegal immigrants from China and India.

9eb98d47ba0bd554a310233ddf516d143ff20503.sourceText: 从各州的非法移民人数来看，只有得州（增4万）和内布拉斯加州（增1.2万）出现了超过1万人以上的增长，而非法移民人数较多的加州（降26.7万）、伊利诺伊（降11.8万）和纽约（降11.5万）都出现非法移民大幅减少的情况。在所有的州中，阿拉巴马下降比例最大，达37%。
9eb98d47ba0bd554a310233ddf516d143ff20503.translatedText: Looking at the number of illegal immigrants in each state, only Texas (increased by 40,000) and Nebraska (increased by 12,000) experienced an increase of more than 10,000, while California (down by 267,000), Illinois (down by 118,000) and New York (down by 115,000), which have a larger number of illegal immigrants, all saw significant decreases in illegal immigrants. Of all the states, Alabama had the largest decline, at 37%.

69ebf619e3228eca1a8f36aa0965776e2fc46852.translatedText: An Iraqi pilot's fighter jet crashed in Arizona during a flight training. The U.S. military said the body of an Iraqi general was found near the U.S.-Mexico border...

70808cfd65f735d7aa63cd2996555af48361de9d.sourceText: 美国军方说，一名伊拉克将军的遗体在美国与墨西哥的边境附近被发现。该将军的战斗机在夜间训练时在亚利桑那的沙漠中坠毁。
70808cfd65f735d7aa63cd2996555af48361de9d.translatedText: The U.S. military said the body of an Iraqi general was found near the U.S.-Mexico border. The general's fighter jet crashed in the Arizona desert during night training.

c027f67a4468e71513853de328847cb633e937aa.sourceText: 据路透社报道，美国和伊拉克政府官员说，搜救人员在道格拉斯市政机场（Douglas Municipal Airport）以东约5英里处的坠机地点发现了哈桑（Rasid Mohammed Sadiq Hasan）准将的遗体。
c027f67a4468e71513853de328847cb633e937aa.translatedText: According to Reuters, U.S. and Iraqi government officials said search and rescue personnel found the body of Brigadier General Rasid Mohammed Sadiq Hasan at the crash site about five miles east of Douglas Municipal Airport.

d1a57840f38cf00f99bf264fbffa9002375a9f1a.sourceText: 哈桑当时独自一人在一架由伊拉克军方拥有的F-16猎鹰战斗机中。该战斗机是在周三晚上8点左右坠毁的，并引发了一场火灾。
d1a57840f38cf00f99bf264fbffa9002375a9f1a.translatedText: Hassan was alone in an F-16 Falcon fighter jet owned by the Iraqi military. The fighter jet crashed around 8pm on Wednesday and caused a fire.

2df0b93cf03c3654e0564aa5e44382492bb16f2d.sourceText: 该坠机引发的野草火灾在几个小时内被扑灭。在坠机地点没有其它的伤亡报告。
2df0b93cf03c3654e0564aa5e44382492bb16f2d.translatedText: A grass fire caused by the crash was extinguished within hours. No other injuries were reported at the crash site.

0fa84f20383f31420a8ffd3113cd71df5a065c00.sourceText: 哈桑是在图森市的飞行员培训计划中的学员。这些学员来自9个不同的国家，训练他们的是亚利桑那州空军国民警卫队第162联队。
0fa84f20383f31420a8ffd3113cd71df5a065c00.translatedText: Hassan is a student in the pilot training program in Tucson. These trainees come from nine different countries and are trained by the 162nd Wing of the Arizona Air National Guard.

09bb5e1e217e4be6561b9025838eed98f5b0efb2.sourceText: 美军当局说，由美国空军训练的伊拉克飞行员是首批使用属于伊拉克的F-16战机的飞行员。他们将驾机与伊斯兰国军事集团作战。
09bb5e1e217e4be6561b9025838eed98f5b0efb2.translatedText: >U.S. military authorities said that Iraqi pilots trained by the U.S. Air Force were the first to fly F-16 fighter jets belonging to Iraq. They will fly aircraft to fight against the Islamic State military group.

89d79bd7832bb6904ab0968bc8d6572b0f8931f2.sourceText: 美国中央指挥部司令奥斯汀（Lloyd Austin）将军向哈桑的家人表示慰问。
89d79bd7832bb6904ab0968bc8d6572b0f8931f2.translatedText: General Lloyd Austin, commander of the U.S. Central Command, expressed condolences to Hassan’s family.

b1203c22edabd9b2265d24f54d9ef698e0877b4d.sourceText: 他在一份声明中说：”在这个困难的时刻，我们与伙伴们及伊拉克人民一同哀悼。”
b1203c22edabd9b2265d24f54d9ef698e0877b4d.translatedText: He said in a statement: "We mourn with our partners and the Iraqi people at this difficult time."

c1a9a48836c0c5085306f4d4389aca6573b90c13.sourceText: 美国军方说，空军方面正在调查此次事故的原因。
c1a9a48836c0c5085306f4d4389aca6573b90c13.translatedText: The U.S. military said the Air Force was investigating the cause of the accident.

f8368c5008b52dd6fca214a24ac879f732d877b2.translatedText: Teacher training for the new school year at Hope Chinese School (photo) (Contributed by Hope Chinese School) On August 3, there are still two weeks before the start of the 2013 school year at Hope Chinese School...

9d2564b394aa258d68248cc115e35a66460139f4.sourceText: （希望中文学校供稿）8月3日，距离希望中文学校2013学年开学还有2周，但是学校的全体老师和教职员工已经行动起来，通过参加学校的教师培训，为新的一个学年做好了充分的准备。培训假座China City Buffet，学校在培训教师的同时，还请大家共享了一次美食。
9d2564b394aa258d68248cc115e35a66460139f4.translatedText: (Contributed by Hope Chinese School) On August 3, there are still two weeks before the start of the 2013 school year at Hope Chinese School, but all the teachers and staff of the school have already taken action and are fully prepared for the new school year by participating in the school's teacher training. The training was held at the China City Buffet. While the school was training teachers, it also invited everyone to share a delicious meal.

eb19d61f81172f6da6600850daf1a4fa651f4c97.sourceText: 培训在热烈的氛围中开始，大家一边品尝各种美味的食物，一边交流假期里的各种趣事，分享各自对新学期课程的准备心得, 好不热闹。待大家品尝美食后，董事长何世江首先作了简短的致辞，表达了带领各位老师共同努力继续办好希望中文学校的决心。
eb19d61f81172f6da6600850daf1a4fa651f4c97.translatedText: The training started in a warm atmosphere. While everyone tasted a variety of delicious food, they exchanged various interesting things about the holidays and shared their preparations for the new semester courses. It was very lively. After everyone tasted the delicious food, Chairman He Shijiang first gave a brief speech, expressing his determination to lead all teachers to work together to continue to run Hope Chinese School well.

bbf3dddb7ee31f582f6b41a78bb6b248480fe018.sourceText: 希望中文学校管理委员会成员
bbf3dddb7ee31f582f6b41a78bb6b248480fe018.translatedText: Hope Chinese School Management Committee member

9b5410f8aab14299a7bb7a4385359c7d28699e60.sourceText: 随后校长谢小红主持了本次培训。谢校长提醒各位老师，学校将于8月17日正式开学，请各位教师做好开学前的各项准备。随后，她介绍了各个教学组的组长以及几位下学期即将加入到希望中文学校教学活动中的新教师，使得学校的师资力量始终保持资深教师和新鲜能量的互补状态。谢校长也介绍和强调了新的教师章程，规范了教师的各种教学制度，希望能够以更高的教学质量和更规范的教学行为来更好的教育学生，也为学生做出良好的榜样。教师们也就共同维护好学校的环境、增加学生志愿者机会以及学生的安全等各个方面提出了很好的建议。谢校长还要求希望中文学校的全体中文教师参加即将到来的由国侨办主办的全美中文教师培训，更进一步的提高中文教师的教学水准。
9b5410f8aab14299a7bb7a4385359c7d28699e60.translatedText: Then the principal Xie Xiaohong presided over the training. Principal Xie reminded all teachers that the school will officially open on August 17th. Please make all preparations before the start of school. Then, she introduced the leaders of each teaching group and several new teachers who will join the teaching activities of Hope Chinese School next semester, so that the school’s teaching staff always maintains a complementary state of senior teachers and fresh energy. Principal Xie also introduced and emphasized the new teacher charter, which standardizes various teaching systems for teachers, hoping to better educate students with higher teaching quality and more standardized teaching behaviors, and also set a good example for students. The teachers also put forward good suggestions on various aspects such as jointly maintaining the school environment, increasing student volunteer opportunities, and student safety. Principal Xie also requested all Chinese teachers in Hope Chinese schools to participate in the upcoming national Chinese teacher training hosted by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council to further improve the teaching standards of Chinese teachers.

964b0d6593f03327ca38f806f25fcbcbfbcd7211.sourceText: 集体会议后，教师们又分成中文组、数学组、才艺组继续更有针对性的讨论。资深中文教师杨京生老师在中文组分组会议里，对她任职的公立高中中文资格考试的情况做了一个图文并茂的介绍。虽然是目前公立高中的一个中文资格考试，但是通过对这个考试的形式、内容、以及考题范围的了解，对我们中文学校老师平时的教学也有很大的启发和帮助。杨京生老师向大家展示了她在课堂上的教学视频，让老师们了解了不少可以参考的教学工具和资源，受益匪浅。她还将代表希望中文学校，在ACTFL Conference全美外语教师会议上发表演说。
964b0d6593f03327ca38f806f25fcbcbfbcd7211.translatedText: After the group meeting, the teachers were divided into Chinese group, mathematics group, and talent group to continue more targeted discussions. Senior Chinese teacher Yang Jingsheng gave a illustrated introduction to the Chinese Qualification Examination of the public high school where she works in the Chinese group meeting. Although it is currently a Chinese qualification test for public high schools, understanding the form, content, and scope of the test questions will also be very inspiring and helpful to our Chinese school teachers in their daily teaching. Teacher Yang Jingsheng showed everyone her teaching videos in class, allowing teachers to learn about many teaching tools and resources that they could refer to, and they benefited a lot. She will also represent Hope Chinese School and deliver a speech at the ACTFL Conference, a national conference for foreign language teachers.

c726210826d58c1976286d581e5b63d143a290eb.sourceText: 杨京生老师在做公立高中中文资格考试的情况
c726210826d58c1976286d581e5b63d143a290eb.translatedText: >Teacher Yang Jingsheng’s performance in the public high school Chinese Qualification Examination

139235fcb6fd07ec90cd3ecf405fb63f58531b13.sourceText: 数学组和才艺组也在各自组长的带领下，制订了新学期的教学目标，以及各项活动的组织，并交流了各自的教学经验。在热烈的提问和讨论中，本次教师培训圆满结束。
139235fcb6fd07ec90cd3ecf405fb63f58531b13.translatedText: The mathematics group and the talent group also, under the leadership of their respective team leaders, formulated teaching goals for the new semester, organized various activities, and exchanged their respective teaching experiences. In the lively questions and discussions, this teacher training ended successfully.

f5afe1e17871f3f0d92c7c416cc5fe23148c0db9.sourceText: 希望中文学校将一如既往，向学生传授中文知识和中华文化，同时开拓创新更多丰富多彩的校外课, 包括中文, 数学AP班，Math-Count，SAT英文阅读 & SAT英文写作，英文写作,儿童和成人民族舞, 现代舞蹈, 美术，绘画，围棋，国际像棋，武术, 太极等课程，并积极展开各种教学活动和竞赛。学校将于2013年8月17日开学。目前网上报名注册已经开始，大家可登陆学校网站 http://www.azhopechineseschool.org 进行报名注册。
f5afe1e17871f3f0d92c7c416cc5fe23148c0db9.translatedText: I hope that the Chinese school will continue to teach Chinese knowledge and culture to students, and at the same time develop and innovate more colorful extracurricular courses, including Chinese, mathematics AP classes, Math-Count, SAT English Reading & SAT English Writing, English writing, children and adult folk dance, modern dance, art, painting, Go, chess, martial arts, Tai Chi and other courses, and actively carry out various teaching activities and competitions. The school will start on August 17, 2013. Currently, online registration has begun. You can log on to the school website http://www.azhopechineseschool.org to register.

02669a6b9916eecc924b217dfa82c1c35d0db4e8.sourceText: 乱市求生 投资专家提对策 股市惨跌，美国再度陷入经济衰退的风险大增，投资人必须跟着调整投资组合。民众应该再次评估拥有的国内外股票类型、对新兴市场、现金和美国公债的看法，甚至是持有黄金的理由，好让手中的投资安然度过成长放缓或甚至是零成长的经济环境。 CNN与「金钱」杂志报导，以下是在市场动荡中持盈保泰的四个投资要诀： 1.检视手中的持股 股民现在拥抱传统的「抗衰退」、股利丰厚的股票，像是公用事业、健康照护和消费必需品类股。在这些类股中，找寻股息收益率高于平均水平的企业，而且企业需现金充沛，销售人们所需但不受经济景气下滑影响的商品和服务。 在最好的情况下，稳健的企业能受惠于对手转弱而扩张市占率，并且能在走出经济低迷时让公司体质更为强劲。经济学家罗森伯格表示，更老练的投资人，会减持风险较高的资产，像是小型成长股。 2.留意中国与新兴市场 如果美国陷入衰退，股票投资者预料将看到新兴市场进一步拉回。新兴市场专家海利表示：「新兴市场和美国的连结关系非常紧密，美国仍是全球最大的市场， 也是新兴国家的最大消费者。」 海利指出，如果美国再次衰退导致中国成长降温，将有害对商品的投资兴趣，而使巴西受创尤深。中国已取代美国，成为巴西最大的贸易伙伴，中国也是石油、天然气、煤和矿产的最大的买家之一。 Frontier策略集团主管拉瑟夫表示：「和美国关系紧密的贸易伙伴受伤会最重。」 3.拥抱美国公债和公司债 根据分析师和债券经理人表示，美国公债已经吸引规避风险的投资人，仍然是投资人心目中上选的资金避风港。而风险较高的高收益债券或垃圾债券，可能会像先前衰退时期一样出现价格下跌。同时，由基本面稳健、投资评等较高的企业所发行的投资级债券，则会跟进公债的涨势。 MFS投资管理公司首席投资策略师史旺森表示：「如果选择买债券，就要买美国公债，因为它们过去在衰退时期中表现非常好。」 金融专家芮霍兹指出，持有一点现金也无妨。他说：「处于长期熊市中，投资人的工作是管理风险和保有资金。」他建议，50%的投资组合分配要平分给现金和债券，剩下的部分则配置于股票和商品。 4.投资黄金 黄金在最近至少两波的美国经济衰退中，都成为资金的避险天堂。2007年12月至2009年6月是二次大战后最长的衰退期，期间黄金期货劲扬18%，道琼工业指数则大跌37%。在2001年3月至11月的衰退期间，金价上涨3.3%，道琼则下跌5.7%。 投资组合经理人柯迪尔表示：「我们正濒临二次衰退，黄金仍是民众恐慌时买进的标的。」他表示，衰退将导致欧洲和美国继续维持趋近零的利率，导致货币贬值，被视为「终极保值」的黄金仍将在衰退的环境中表现良好。
02669a6b9916eecc924b217dfa82c1c35d0db4e8.translatedText: Investment experts offer countermeasures to survive in a chaotic market. The stock market has plummeted, and the risk of the United States falling into another economic recession has greatly increased. Investors must adjust their investment portfolios accordingly. People should reassess the types of domestic and foreign equities they own, their views on emerging markets, cash and U.S. Treasuries, and even their reasons for owning gold, so that their investments can weather an economic environment of slower or even zero growth. CNN and Money magazine reported that the following are four investment tips for staying profitable amid market turmoil: 1. Review your holdings. Investors are now embracing traditional "recession-resistant", dividend-rich stocks, such as utilities, health care and consumer staples stocks. Within these groups, look for companies with above-average dividend yields, cash-rich companies that sell goods and services that people need but are not affected by economic downturns. In the best cases, healthy companies can benefit from weakening rivals and expand market share, and emerge from the economic downturn stronger. Economist Rosenberg said that more sophisticated investors will reduce their holdings of riskier assets, such as small-cap growth stocks. 2. Pay attention to China and emerging markets. If the United States falls into recession, stock investors can expect to see emerging markets pull back further. Emerging market expert Haley said: "The connection between emerging markets and the United States is very close. The United States is still the world's largest market and the largest consumer of emerging countries." Haley pointed out that if the United States declines again and China's growth cools down, it will harm investment interest in commodities, and Brazil will be particularly hard-hit. China has replaced the United States as Brazil's largest trading partner and is also one of the largest buyers of oil, natural gas, coal and minerals. "Trading partners with close ties to the United States will be hurt the most," said Rusev, director of Frontier Strategy Group. 3. Embrace U.S. Treasuries and Corporate Bonds According to analysts and bond managers, U.S. Treasuries have attracted risk-averse investors and remain the preferred safe haven for investors. Riskier high-yield or junk bonds may see price declines as they did during previous recessions. At the same time, investment-grade bonds issued by companies with sound fundamentals and high investment ratings will follow the rise in public bonds. Swanson, chief investment strategist at MFS Investment Management, said: "If you choose to buy bonds, you have to buy U.S. Treasuries because they have performed very well in recessions in the past." Financial expert Reiholtz pointed out that it doesn't hurt to hold a little cash. "In a secular bear market, the investor's job is to manage risk and preserve capital," he said. He suggested that a 50% portfolio allocation be split evenly between cash and bonds, with the remainder allocated to stocks and commodities. 4. Invest in gold. Gold has become a safe haven for funds during at least two recent waves of U.S. economic recession. The period from December 2007 to June 2009 was the longest recession period since World War II. During this period, gold futures surged by 18%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell by 37%. During the recession from March to November 2001, gold prices rose 3.3% while the Dow Jones fell 5.7%. Portfolio manager Cordier said: "We are on the verge of a second recession, and gold is still the target to buy when people are panicking." He said that the recession will cause Europe and the United States to continue to maintain interest rates close to zero, leading to currency depreciation. Gold, which is regarded as the "ultimate store of value," will still perform well in a recessionary environment.
