ad3e37782fbf625d95a2800290436466c1b919c4.sourceText: 中国国民党亚利桑那直属分部于三月十九日，假凤凰城中华自助餐厅，举行中央党主席补选投票暨党员座谈会。上午十一时，会议开始，分部常委王玮𤧟报告，强调一切补选事宜，必须依照党中央相关规定，谨慎进行，”务求公正、公平、公开”。潘文慧委员解说领票、圈选、投票等作业流程。严瑜委员特别宣佈，”洪秀柱后援会基金”的捐款在会后即时退还。 随即进行投票，约于中午十二时，顺利完成。 午餐后，座谈会主席少君博士致词，略述历任四位总统执政，关係国民党之盛衰。蒋经国总统励精图治，推行民主法治和十大建设，创造台湾奇蹟，号召以三民主义统一中国，是国民党在台湾全盛时期。惜李登辉继任后，以本土化之名，行台独之实，操弄国民党为外来政权， 离间分化，终致新党及亲民党出走，国民党由盛而衰。 陈水扁两任八年，变更历史、教育，运作立法、媒体，不遗馀力地去中国化，台独不成，但民粹日盛。国民党此时此地，尚能坚持信念，努力不懈。马英九赢回政权，为做全民总统，处处让步妥协，没有立场。国民党不再秉持中心思想，党员不再团结一心。八年施政, 考量不周，加上媒体蓄意曲解，反对党恶意抵制；台北市长、九合一公职以及总统选举，严重失策，今日溃败，乃是必然。少君 期许新任党主席，能回归党的中心理念， 重振党徳党魂，东山再起。 座谈会历时约两小时，同志发言踊跃，言之有物。对台湾当前政治，经济，教育，社会及军事之忧虑，溢于言表。 未及发言同志，或以书面陈述，或私下讨论，兹综合整理如下: 政党之成立与发展，必定基于中心思想。今民进党主张台湾独立，国民党却不敢宣示统一理念， 但对争取选票毫无助益，更失去原有忠诚支持者。”不统、不独、不武”消极含煳，无实质作用，仅能妥协一时，而非长久之计。去掉中国，改成?’弯国民党”或”国民党”，乃是不顾国民党成立历史渊源的无稽之谈。白话直说，何不另起炉灶或加入民进党。 两岸离合是民族大事，不能不审慎为之。就现实之政治、外交、经济等国内外情势，以及同文同种的民族大义而言，台湾独立能否成功？又何去何从？盼两岸都能以大智慧、大襟怀处理统合问题，借镜中国历史或大英国协制度。邦联或联邦制，以及国号、国旗、国歌等等，也不都曾提出讨论过吗？ 以九二共识为基础，解决一切的问题和困难。 国民党党产有其时代背景，是百年累积而成，绝不能以”不当”笼统概括之。难到没想到党员血汗努力？ 国民党撤退大陆，运来数百吨黄金，稳定台湾经济；随从菁英人才，治理国政； 六十万大军悍卫台湾；多少外省先辈五十年来未曾返家，奉献一生给台湾；对国民党的牺牲付出，是否应当也算ㄧ算？ 故宫无价国宝，是否亦应返还？民进党应该追讨陈水扁的”海角七亿”，其中一半充作建国基金，一半发送老人年金， 岂不内外皆顾，两全其美。 二二八事件，不乏中外研究，是外力介入煽动下之阴谋暴动，本省同胞与外省同胞皆有受难者。连日本人都获得赔偿，却对外省同胞血泪交织的残酷受难，偏颇漠视。如此泯灭良知，非但不能疗伤止痛，只有徒增仇恨！谈什麽和解、和解、再和解。居然订为国定纪念日，纪念什麽？岁岁年年，无休止地利用。 废除国父遗像，变更中正纪念堂，毁坏蒋公铜像, 是民进党台独主张下荒诞行径，本足为奇。圆山忠烈祠是奉祀先烈之处，让后代子孙瞻仰效法，是国魂表徵，庄严神圣。而财政部提议外包民营化，这仅是政府怠懈职责，更是轻忽烈士，损害全民意志和感情，万万使不得。倘能如此，乾脆採用陈水扁主张，台湾是美国託管地， 台湾全盘外包，不是更为直接省事。
ad3e37782fbf625d95a2800290436466c1b919c4.translatedText: At 11 o'clock in the morning, the meeting began. Wang Wei, member of the branch standing committee, made a report, emphasizing that all by-election matters must be carried out carefully in accordance with the relevant regulations of the Party Central Committee, "to ensure fairness, fairness and openness." Committee member Pan Wenhui explained the work procedures such as ticket collection, circle selection, and voting. Member Yan Yu specially announced that the donations to the "Hong Xiuzhu Supporters' Association Fund" will be returned immediately after the meeting. The voting took place immediately and was successfully completed at approximately 12 noon. After lunch, Dr. Shaojun, the chairman of the symposium, delivered a speech, briefly describing the relationship between the four presidents’ administration and the rise and fall of the Kuomintang. President Chiang Ching-kuo worked hard to govern, promoted democracy and the rule of law and the Ten Major Constructions, created the miracle of Taiwan, and called for the unification of China with the Three People's Principles. This was the heyday of the Kuomintang in Taiwan. Unfortunately, after Lee Teng-hui took over, in the name of localization, he pursued Taiwan independence and manipulated the Kuomintang into a foreign political power. Chen Shui-bian served two terms for eight years, changing history, education, operating legislation, and the media, and sparing no effort to de-Sinicize Taiwan. Although Taiwan independence failed, populism grew stronger. At this time and place, the Kuomintang can still persist in its beliefs and make unremitting efforts. Ma Ying-jeou won back power and made concessions everywhere in order to be the president of the people. He had no position. The Kuomintang no longer adheres to the central idea, and party members are no longer united. After eight years of governance, poor consideration, deliberate misinterpretation by the media, and malicious boycott by the opposition parties; Taipei mayor, nine-in-one public offices, and presidential elections were grossly misguided. Today's defeat is inevitable. Shaojun hopes that the new party chairman can return to the party’s central philosophy, reinvigorate the party’s moral character and make a comeback. The symposium lasted about two hours, and the comrades spoke enthusiastically and meaningfully. Concerns about Taiwan's current politics, economy, education, society and military are palpable. Comrades who have not yet spoken, either in written statements or in private discussions, hereby summarize it as follows: The establishment and development of a political party must be based on the central idea. Today, the Democratic Progressive Party advocates Taiwan's independence, but the Kuomintang dares not declare the concept of reunification. However, this does not help win votes, and it has lost its original loyal supporters. "No unification, no independence, no force" is negative and vague, has no real effect, and can only be a temporary compromise, not a long-term solution. Removing China and changing it to "Kuomintang" or "Kuomintang" is nonsense that ignores the historical origins of the founding of the Kuomintang. To put it bluntly, why not start a new one or join the Democratic Progressive Party. Cross-Strait separation is a national matter and must be done cautiously. In terms of the current political, diplomatic, economic and other domestic and international situations, as well as the national interests of the same people, can Taiwan's independence be successful? Where will it go? We hope that both sides of the Taiwan Strait can deal with the integration issue with great wisdom and broad mind. Have we not discussed confederation or federalism, as well as the national title, national flag, national anthem, etc.? Use the 1992 Consensus as the basis to solve all problems and difficulties. The Kuomintang’s party assets have their own historical background, accumulated over hundreds of years, and cannot be summed up as “improper”. Is it possible that the Kuomintang did not expect the hard work of the party members? The Kuomintang retreated from the mainland, transported hundreds of tons of gold, stabilized Taiwan’s economy; Should the priceless national treasure of the Forbidden City be returned? The DPP should pursue Chen Shui-bian's "Cape 700 million", half of which should be used as a nation-building fund and half of which should be given to the elderly. Wouldn't it take care of both internal and external issues and get the best of both worlds? There is no lack of Chinese and foreign research on the 228 Incident. It was a conspiracy and riot instigated by external forces. Both compatriots in this province and compatriots in other provinces suffered. Even the Japanese were compensated, but they ignored the cruel suffering of compatriots in other provinces. Not only does it not heal the pain, but it only increases hatred! What is it to commemorate as a national day? Abolish the portrait of the founding father, renovate the Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall, destroy the bronze statue of Chiang Kai-shek, It is an absurd act initiated by the Democratic Progressive Party for Taiwan independence. The Martyrs' Shrine in Yuanshan is a place where the martyrs are worshiped and emulated by future generations. It is a solemn and sacred symbol of the country's soul. However, the Ministry of Finance's proposal to privatize outsourcing is only a neglect of the martyrs and damages the will and sentiments of the people. If this is the case, it is not more straightforward and trouble-free to simply adopt Chen Shui-bian's suggestion that Taiwan is a trusteeship of the United States and that Taiwan should be fully outsourced.

210ade53416ec5a2c9aa8681049753e78603c034.sourceText: 美拒绝向带有纹身的移民签发绿卡 针对国内暴力事件频发，为维护美国国内治安秩序，ICE在7月12日表示，将拒绝向有纹身的 移民 签发绿卡。 据悉，美国官员由于担心外国犯罪团伙在美实施犯罪行为，因此拒绝向大量带有刺身的移民签发在美永久居住证，值得注意的是，这些移民当中，有很多人与犯罪团伙并无任何关联。 纹身检查已经诱捕了许多来自拉丁美洲的移民，纵使他们此前并无任何犯罪记录。然而，美国国务院一位发言人却软化了对此事的口径表示：”美国政府目前在签发绿卡过程中，将纹身视为一种衡量标准。” 2006年，美国国务院拒绝向两类人签发绿卡：一类是暴力团伙成员，一类是集团犯罪成员。据统计，2010年，美国政府拒绝为82位同犯罪集团有关联的人颁发绿卡。
210ade53416ec5a2c9aa8681049753e78603c034.translatedText: The United States refuses to issue green cards to immigrants with tattoos. In response to the frequent domestic violence and in order to maintain public security and order in the United States, ICE stated on July 12 that it would refuse to issue green cards to immigrants with tattoos. It is reported that U.S. officials are worried about foreign criminal gangs committing crimes in the United States, so they refuse to issue permanent residence permits to a large number of immigrants with tattoos in the United States. It is worth noting that many of these immigrants have no connection with criminal gangs. Tattoo checks have ensnared many immigrants from Latin America even if they had no prior criminal record. However, a spokesperson for the U.S. State Department softened its tone on the matter and said: "The U.S. government currently considers tattoos as a criterion in the process of issuing green cards." In 2006, the U.S. State Department refused to issue green cards to two categories of people: members of violent gangs and members of organized crime. According to statistics, in 2010, the U.S. government refused to issue green cards to 82 people with ties to criminal groups.

ac8da9441c4ac757fe5112c944c00fe4a169c4f6.sourceText: 吕宝华先生近日旅美走访本地侨社(图） 曾在中国文化部任职，现是多份报刊和杂志的专栏作家吕宝华先生，从北京旅美到凤凰城。他近日走访本地侨社，访问了康宁大厦、康乐大厦、华人耆英会、斐匿中文学校、黄氏宗亲会馆、余风采堂等地方，并向康乐大厦、斐匿中文学校赠送了他的著作。吕宝华先生对本地华侨奋门历史、侨领和社团对社会所作贡献很感兴趣，认为很有代表性，也很有价值。吕先生将把搜集到的侨社资料和华侨事迹带回北京，将作研究和向有关部门推介。他在行程中受到本地侨领余文劲、方慧贤、黄定江、邓军泉等亲切会见和接待，张肇鸿全程陪同。
ac8da9441c4ac757fe5112c944c00fe4a169c4f6.translatedText: Mr. Lu Baohua recently traveled to the United States to visit local overseas Chinese communities (photo). Mr. Lu Baohua, who once worked in the Ministry of Culture of China and is now a columnist for many newspapers and magazines, traveled to the United States from Beijing to Phoenix. He recently visited local overseas Chinese communities and visited places such as Kang Ning Building, Kang Le Building, Chinese Senior Citizens Association, Fei Ni Chinese School, Huang Clan Association, Yu Feng Cai Tang, etc., and presented his books to Kang Le Building and Fei Ni Chinese School. Mr. Lu Baohua is very interested in the history of local overseas Chinese in Fenmen and the contributions of overseas Chinese leaders and associations to society. He thinks it is very representative and valuable. Mr. Lu will bring the collected information on overseas Chinese communities and deeds of overseas Chinese back to Beijing, where he will conduct research and promote it to relevant departments. During the trip, he was cordially met and received by local overseas Chinese leaders Yu Wenjin, Fang Huixian, Huang Dingjiang, Deng Junquan and others, and Zhang Zhaohong accompanied him throughout the journey.

957693878c89da2a0251c43064c2ca36dc086abf.sourceText: （凤凰城汉字文化节供稿） 2012年凤凰城汉字文化节是由亚省中华语文学院,中华书院主办,结合凤凰城姊妹会台北姊妹市委员会,以及美国主流各大,中,小学校和本地中文学校共同推广精彩丰富多元的汉字文化与宣传台湾中华文化,及促进多元文化交流。 2012年凤凰城汉字文化节陆续到各个美国主流学校指导台湾中华文化与民俗艺术,举办中华节庆活动和展览,介绍汉字的起源与历史,展示书法与国画之美,以及用智慧与双手创造与启发摺纸与剪纸的美妙和神奇.书法,国画,摺纸与剪纸都是中华民俗与文化艺术,含有丰盛的想像力量和创作意境,可以开启真善美的心灵,同时训练身心专注,手脑并用,全神贯注投入用心和耐心,培养文化与艺术的涵养,使作品达到美轮美奂。 2012年凤凰城汉字文化节举办美国学校学生的我爱台湾节庆绘图比赛,参加学生十分踊跃,有七十五位学生获得优胜奖,每人得到奖牌一面,其中有三位获得特优奖,各得到学用品书包.应学校与学生要求,将在七月份再举办一次我爱台湾的中华文化比赛活动. 2012年凤凰城汉字文化节举行中文学校高年级组学生正体字台湾景点数位设计比赛;中年级组学生正体字数位卡片设计比赛;以及幼年级组学生正体字数位绘图比赛.凤凰城中文学校学生参加,有十二位学生成绩优异,作品杰出成功,三组学生各获得第一名,第二名,第三名,和佳作奖项,每位学生获得奖牌,奖状,及学用书包与组合文具手提包奖品. 2012年凤凰城汉字文化节活动将继续举办至七月份.五月至七月将结合主流各大文化活动推广汉字文化.每年的凤凰城汉字文化节活动都吸引两万五千多学生学习汉字文化,宣传台湾中华文化,及进行多元文化交流.有关汉字文化节活动,请洽亚省中华语文学院,中华书院李玲麟校长602-418-8895或 azcmca@hotmail.com 。
957693878c89da2a0251c43064c2ca36dc086abf.translatedText: (provided by the Phoenix Chinese Character Cultural Festival) The 2012 Phoenix Chinese Character Culture Festival was hosted by the Chinese Language Institute of Alberta and the Chung Hwa Academy, in conjunction with the Taipei Sister City Committee of the Phoenix Sisters, as well as major, primary, secondary and local schools in the United States and local Chinese schools to jointly promote the wonderful, rich and diverse Chinese character culture, promote Taiwanese Chinese culture, and promote multicultural exchanges. In 2012, the Phoenix Chinese Character Culture Festival went to various mainstream schools in the United States to instruct Taiwanese Chinese culture and folk art, held Chinese festivals and exhibitions, introduced the origin and history of Chinese characters, displayed the beauty of calligraphy and traditional Chinese painting, and used wisdom and hands to create and inspire the beauty and magic of origami and paper-cutting. Calligraphy, traditional Chinese painting, origami and paper-cutting are all Chinese folk customs and cultural arts. They contain rich imagination and creative artistic conception, which can open up the mind of truth, goodness and beauty. At the same time, they can train the mind and body to focus, use both hands and brain, devote all their attention and patience, cultivate cultural and artistic cultivation, and make the works beautiful. In 2012, the Phoenix Chinese Character Cultural Festival held the I Love Taiwan Festival Drawing Competition for American school students. The participating students were very enthusiastic. Seventy-five students won the winning prize, and each received a medal. Three of them won the special award, and each received school supplies and schoolbags. At the request of the school and students, another I Love Taiwan Chinese Culture Competition will be held in July. The 2012 Phoenix Chinese Character Culture Festival held a digital design competition for Taiwan scenic spots in traditional Chinese characters for senior students of Chinese schools; a digital card design competition for traditional Chinese characters for middle-grade students; and a digital drawing competition for traditional Chinese characters for elementary students. Phoenix Chinese School students participated. Twelve students participated with excellent results and outstanding and successful works. Three groups of students each won first, second, third, and masterpiece awards. Each student received medals, certificates, and prizes such as school bags and stationery handbags. The 2012 Phoenix Chinese Character Cultural Festival will continue to be held until July. From May to July, various mainstream cultural activities will be combined to promote Chinese character culture. Every year, the Phoenix Chinese Character Cultural Festival attracts more than 25,000 students to learn Chinese character culture, promote Taiwanese Chinese culture, and conduct multicultural exchanges. For information about the Chinese Character Cultural Festival, please contact the Chinese Language and Literature College of Alberta, President Li Linglin of Chung Hwa College at 602-418-8895 or azcmca@hotmail.com .

4cad5ef7538d5422170e7f17168ac56745a2e32a.sourceText: 看上去很美！中国学生海外游学突发状况多 了解法律很重要 来自上海的大二学生于洋来纽约进行暑期游学，但仅半个月内就在寄宿家中两次被盗，损失数千元。报案后警察置之不理，此番遭遇让他决定提前结束游学之旅，即日启程回国。丢失的电脑、相机还有里面很多珍藏的大学时期影像资料一去不复返，好在中介校方英孚教育对此十分重视，在与保险公司协商决定后，将对于洋的财物损失进行理赔。 记者日前拨通了英孚教育中国校方的电话，针对寄宿家庭的选择等问题提出疑问。 要确认他们是否符合我们的一些要求包括如何提供住宿和餐饮还有其他的一些协助，他才能够提交一份完整的申请，申请之后校方还回做最后的审核。 她也表示以后校方将会对寄宿家庭的选择提高审核标准，避免类似事件的再次发生，并且在游学期间会强烈建议学生购买保险，防范于未然。而关于游学期间的安全事项，我们也咨询了律师，律师建议，在报名时最好选择住在学校宿舍，熟悉情况并亲自察看后可以再调整到寄宿家庭居住。 在学校里住下来之后如果想去体验一下美国的民风和文化就可以考虑寄宿家庭，不过事先要亲自考察看看适不适合自己居住。 律师也提醒如果发生财物被盗等案件，当事人必须第一时间报警，如果英文不好的学生一定要找朋友提供翻译的帮助，并在警察来之前保护好现场，拍照片取证。申请暑期游学本是一件好事，但是来到不同的国家在语言和文化上的差异会造成困难或者一些意想不到的事情，所以游学生本身也需要了解所在过国家的法律，提高应变能力。
4cad5ef7538d5422170e7f17168ac56745a2e32a.translatedText: Looks beautiful! There are many emergencies for Chinese students studying abroad. It is important to understand the law. Yu Yang, a sophomore from Shanghai, came to New York for a summer study tour. However, he was robbed twice at his boarding house in just half a month, resulting in a loss of thousands of dollars. After reporting the crime, the police ignored him. This encounter made him decide to end his study tour early and return to China today. The lost computer, camera, and many of the treasured college imaging materials inside are gone forever. Fortunately, the agency, EF Education First, attaches great importance to this matter. After consulting with the insurance company, it will compensate for Yang's property losses. The reporter recently dialed the phone number of EF Education First in China and asked questions about the choice of homestay families. To confirm whether they meet some of our requirements, including how to provide accommodation, meals, and other assistance, he can submit a complete application. After the application, the school will do a final review. She also said that the school will improve the review standards for the selection of homestay families in the future to avoid similar incidents from happening again, and will strongly recommend students to purchase insurance during the study tour to prevent problems in the future. Regarding safety matters during the study tour, we also consulted a lawyer. The lawyer suggested that it is best to choose to live in the school dormitory when registering. After getting familiar with the situation and inspecting it personally, you can then adjust to live with a host family. After living on campus, if you want to experience the American customs and culture, you can consider a homestay, but you should check in advance to see if it is suitable for you. The lawyer also reminded that if property is stolen or other cases occur, the parties involved must report to the police as soon as possible. Students who are not good at English must find friends to provide translation help, protect the scene before the police arrive, and take photos to collect evidence. Applying for a summer study tour is a good thing, but the differences in language and culture when coming to different countries can cause difficulties or some unexpected things. Therefore, the traveling students themselves also need to understand the laws of the countries they have visited and improve their adaptability.

b3d62feeb56821b6b34f550a10d597d82dc98663.sourceText: 为什么不好信用纪录使银行给您较高的贷款利率? 因为对银行来说，您的信用价值(Creditworthiness)较低、风险比较高。 银行是如何评估您的信用价值及风险呢? 除了信用报告外，银行还会使用信用评分来做决策。 决定信用评分的公式有几种，但是大部分的贷款银行使用一套称作FICO的公式，它的分数范围介于300-850分之间，分数越高代表信用越好，要提高您的信用 分数是有方法的。
b3d62feeb56821b6b34f550a10d597d82dc98663.translatedText: Why does a bad credit record make the bank give you a higher loan interest rate? Because to the bank, your creditworthiness is low and the risk is relatively high. How do banks assess your credit worthiness and risk? In addition to credit reports, banks also use credit scores to make decisions. There are several formulas for determining credit scores, but most lending banks use a formula called FICO. Its score range is between 300-850 points. The higher the score, the better the credit. There are ways to improve your credit score.

713ad79ce89597f6ac5e846c2310b80b5b97b7d8.sourceText: （亚省华联供稿）四月十三日晚上，亚省华联会长李健，前会长陶世诚，费健，王惟咨受邀出席洛杉矶总领事馆主办的亚省侨学界欢迎崔大使的晚宴。晚宴于晚七点在”合顺园”正式开始。当崔天凯大使一行步入宴会厅时，全体与会人员起立鼓掌热烈欢迎。入座后，王雷副总领事首先请八十九岁高龄的著名侨领余文劲先生讲话，接下来介绍华总名誉会长杨文田发言，随后邀请华联会长李健致欢迎词。
713ad79ce89597f6ac5e846c2310b80b5b97b7d8.translatedText: (Contributed by the Alberta Hualian) On the evening of April 13, Li Jian, president of the Alberta Hualian, and former presidents Tao Shicheng, Fei Jian, and Wang Weizi were invited to attend a banquet hosted by the Consulate General of Los Angeles for the Overseas Chinese Scholars in Alberta to welcome Ambassador Cui. The dinner officially started at "Hop Shun Garden" at 7pm. When Ambassador Cui Tiankai and his entourage entered the banquet hall, all the participants stood up and applauded to warmly welcome them. After taking their seats, Deputy Consul General Wang Lei first invited the 89-year-old famous overseas Chinese leader Mr. Yu Wenjin to speak, then introduced Yang Wentian, honorary president of the Hua Association, to speak, and then invited Li Jian, president of the Hualian Association, to give a welcome speech.

919c2d281b804ad90ecee0cd65f2a999b06be107.sourceText: 李会长首先代表亚省华联对崔大使一行到访亚省表示热烈欢迎，代表受邀出席的华联成员，希望中文学校和现代中文学校的负责人受邀表示衷心的感谢。李会长回顾了过去几年华联团结社区各个团体多次组织大型社区活动。特别提到华联成功主办 2015 年中秋国庆暨世界反法西斯战争胜利七十周年庆祝活动和晚宴，新侨老侨近三百人参加。亚省新侨团近年有了长足的发展，华联今年春节期间还特为新侨举办了圆宵茶话会，有两百多人参加。李会长作为希望中文学校的董事长还特别提到希望和现代这两所亚省最大的中文学校二十年来首次成功联合举办了春节联欢，有八百多人参加。洛杉矶总领事馆领侨组王学政组长见证了这一盛况。李会长特别提到去年九月在西雅图聆听习主席的重要讲话。特别赞同中美两国是世界上最重要的国家，中美两国关系是世界上最重要的关系，华人华侨要做好中美两国友谊的桥梁，讲好中国故事。
919c2d281b804ad90ecee0cd65f2a999b06be107.translatedText: President Li first expressed a warm welcome to Ambassador Cui and his delegation on behalf of the Hualien of Hualian Province for their visit to the province. On behalf of the members of the Hualian who were invited to attend, he hoped that the heads of Chinese schools and modern Chinese schools would be invited to express his heartfelt thanks. President Li reviewed the past few years when Hualian united various groups in the community to organize many large-scale community activities. Special mention was made of Hualian’s successful hosting of the 2015 Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day and the 70th Anniversary of the Victory of the World Anti-Fascist War celebrations and dinner, attended by nearly 300 new and old overseas Chinese. The New Overseas Chinese League in Alberta has made great progress in recent years. During the Spring Festival this year, Hualian held a tea party for the New Overseas Chinese, with more than 200 people in attendance. As the chairman of Hope Chinese School, President Li also specifically mentioned that Hope and Modern, the two largest Chinese schools in Alberta, successfully jointly held the Spring Festival Gala for the first time in 20 years, with more than 800 people participating. Wang Xuezheng, leader of the consular section of the Consulate General in Los Angeles, witnessed this grand occasion. President Li specifically mentioned listening to President Xi’s important speech in Seattle last September. I particularly agree that China and the United States are the most important countries in the world, and the relationship between China and the United States is the most important relationship in the world. Chinese and overseas Chinese must serve as a bridge of friendship between China and the United States and tell the story of China well.

d06f16576c6b6f0ece90392079f37f212da4bc41.sourceText: 最后，崔大使发表讲话。崔大使从中国的发展，未来的发展前景和目标，中美两国关系的重要性，华人华侨对当地的贡献与中美两国关系发展的联系做了明确详细的阐述。对亚省华人社团传播中国文化方面的贡献给与了充分肯定。崔大使和蔼可亲，侃侃而谈，生动流畅给与会人员留下了深刻的印象。
d06f16576c6b6f0ece90392079f37f212da4bc41.translatedText: Finally, Ambassador Cui delivered a speech. Ambassador Cui gave a clear and detailed explanation of China's development, future development prospects and goals, the importance of Sino-US relations, the contribution of overseas Chinese to the local area and the development of Sino-US relations. The contribution of the Chinese community in Alberta to the spread of Chinese culture was fully affirmed. Ambassador Cui was amiable, eloquent and lively, which left a deep impression on the attendees.

bfc53d95efea38a0fcbf483d29446d4550bf0ee6.sourceText: 中国首次发表司法改革白皮书 司法制度是政治制度的重要组成部分，司法公正是社会公正的重要保障。国务院新闻办公室９日发表了《中国的司法改革》白皮书。这是中国首次就司法改革问题发布白皮书。 这个大约１８０００字的白皮书，第一次全面、系统地向国内外介绍了中国司法改革的基本情况和主要成就，表明中国致力于推进依法治国基本方略的态度和决心，增进国内外对中国司法改革以及法治建设的了解、认同和支持。 白皮书分为前言、司法制度和改革进程、维护社会公平正义、加强人权保障、提高司法能力、践行司法为民、结束语等部分。 白皮书指出，新中国成立特别是改革开放以来，中国坚持从国情出发，在承继中国传统法律文化优秀成果、借鉴人类法治文明的基础上，探索建立并不断完善中国特色社会主义司法制度，维护了社会公正，为人类法治文明作出了重要贡献。 白皮书指出，改革开放以来，中国经济社会快速发展，社会公众的法治意识显著增强，司法环境发生深刻变化，司法工作遇到许多新情况、新问题， 现行司法体制和工作机制中存在的不完善、不适应问题日益凸显，需要在改革中逐步完善和发展。近些年来，中国积极、稳妥、务实地推进司法体制和工作机制改 革，以维护司法公正为目标，以优化司法职权配置、加强人权保障、提高司法能力、践行司法为民为重点，进一步完善中国特色社会主义司法制度，扩大司法民主， 推行司法公开，保证司法公正，为中国经济发展和社会和谐稳定提供了有力的司法保障。 白皮书强调，中国司法改革的根本目标是保障人民法院、人民检察院依法独立公正地行使审判权和检察权，建设公正高效权威的社会主义司法制度，为维护人民群众合法权益、维护社会公平正义、维护国家长治久安提供坚强可靠的司法保障。 白皮书强调，中国司法改革始终坚持从国情出发，既博采众长、又不照抄照搬，既与时俱进、又不盲目冒进；坚持群众路线，充分体现人民的意愿， 着眼于解决民众不满意的问题，自觉接受人民的监督和检验，真正做到改革为了人民、依靠人民、惠及人民；坚持依法推进，以宪法和法律规定为依据，凡是与现行 法律相冲突的，应在修改法律后实施；坚持统筹协调、总体规划、循序渐进、分步推进。 白皮书强调，司法改革是中国政治体制改革的重要组成部分，是中国特色社会主义司法制度的自我完善和发展，是一项长期而艰巨的任务，还将随着经济社会的发展而逐步深化。 据了解，白皮书中文版已由人民出版社出版，英文版已由外文出版社出版，即日起在全国新华书店发行 。
bfc53d95efea38a0fcbf483d29446d4550bf0ee6.translatedText: China publishes its first white paper on judicial reform. The judicial system is an important part of the political system, and judicial fairness is an important guarantee for social justice. The State Council Information Office published a white paper on "China's Judicial Reform" on the 9th. This is the first time that China has issued a white paper on judicial reform. This white paper of approximately 18,000 words provides the first comprehensive and systematic introduction to the basic situation and major achievements of China's judicial reform at home and abroad. It demonstrates China's attitude and determination to promote the basic strategy of governing the country according to law, and enhances domestic and foreign understanding, recognition and support for China's judicial reform and rule of law construction. The white paper is divided into preface, judicial system and reform process, maintaining social fairness and justice, strengthening human rights protection, improving judicial capabilities, practicing justice for the people, and conclusion. The white paper points out that since the founding of the People's Republic of China, especially since the reform and opening up, China has persisted in proceeding from its national conditions, inherited the outstanding achievements of traditional Chinese legal culture, and learned from human rule of law civilization, explored the establishment and continuously improved the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics, safeguarded social justice, and made important contributions to human rule of law civilization. The white paper points out that since the reform and opening up, China's economy and society have developed rapidly, the public's awareness of the rule of law has increased significantly, and the judicial environment has undergone profound changes. Judicial work has encountered many new situations and new problems. The imperfections and inadaptations in the current judicial system and working mechanisms have become increasingly prominent, and they need to be gradually improved and developed during the reform. In recent years, China has actively, steadily and pragmatically promoted the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms, with the goal of maintaining judicial fairness, focusing on optimizing the allocation of judicial powers, strengthening human rights protection, improving judicial capabilities, and practicing justice for the people. It has further improved the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics, expanded judicial democracy, promoted judicial openness, and ensured judicial fairness, which has provided a strong judicial guarantee for China's economic development and social harmony and stability. The white paper emphasizes that the fundamental goal of China's judicial reform is to ensure that the people's courts and people's procuratorates can independently and impartially exercise judicial and procuratorial powers in accordance with the law, build a fair, efficient and authoritative socialist judicial system, and provide a strong and reliable judicial guarantee for safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of the people, safeguarding social fairness and justice, and safeguarding the long-term stability of the country. The white paper emphasizes that China's judicial reform always insists on proceeding from the national conditions, drawing on the strengths of others without copying them, and advancing with the times without blindly advancing. It adheres to the mass line, fully embodies the will of the people, focuses on solving problems that the people are dissatisfied with, consciously accepts the supervision and testing of the people, and truly makes the reform for the people, relies on the people, and benefits the people. It insists on advancing in accordance with the law, based on the Constitution and legal provisions, and everything that is in line with the current situation. If there is a conflict between laws, they should be implemented after the laws are revised; overall coordination, overall planning, step-by-step, and step-by-step advancement should be adhered to. The white paper emphasizes that judicial reform is an important part of China's political system reform and the self-improvement and development of the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics. It is a long-term and arduous task that will gradually deepen with economic and social development. It is understood that the Chinese version of the white paper has been published by the People's Publishing House, and the English version has been published by the Foreign Languages ​​Publishing House and will be distributed in Xinhua Bookstores nationwide from now on.

71673ea7a07ba219c326ffa125d0b153d57633c4.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: Story of the Stone

86a41c1c9de8ec0cec700b9906f4f0c7fc0a1c79.sourceText: 张肇鸿：石头记 那年游桂林，朋友都说那裡的田螺味道不错，不妨一试。 待入夜后，食街的灯光与炉火相互辉映…
86a41c1c9de8ec0cec700b9906f4f0c7fc0a1c79.translatedText: Zhang Zhaohong: Story of the Stone When I visited Guilin that year, my friends said that the snails there tasted good, so I might as well give it a try. After dark, the lights and fires in the food street complement each other...

aae95ac42728213fcd53ea17d01b8c35c8fce877.sourceText: 那年游桂林，朋友都说那裡的田螺味道不错，不妨一试。
aae95ac42728213fcd53ea17d01b8c35c8fce877.translatedText: When I visited Guilin that year, my friends said that the snails there were delicious, so you might as well give it a try.

f46df6c825fedc8dd2720010f0a5ca3da501bb52.sourceText: 待入夜后，食街的灯光与炉火相互辉映，一时间，炒螺声、盘碗声，声声入耳；薑葱味、豉椒味，味味撩人。垂涎欲滴之际，忙找个食肆坐下，哥们都要了碗炒螺。
f46df6c825fedc8dd2720010f0a5ca3da501bb52.translatedText: After night falls, the lights and fires in the food street complement each other. For a while, the sound of frying snails and dishes is heard; the smell of ginger, green onion and black pepper is tantalizing. With my mouth watering, I hurriedly found a restaurant to sit down, and my buddy asked for a bowl of fried snails.

34e55a345b6796f4a8edcb22b57feaf74c681a7c.sourceText: 桂林田螺的个头虽然不大，却是味道鲜美，搭配红椒、黄薑、紫苏、黑豉，香辣扑鼻。正食指大动之时，忽然吮著块小石头。听到哥们的议论，老板娘前来对我连声道歉：「对不起哟，石子田螺一般大，炒来翻去地看不清，别生气哟厖」随著话到勺到，添了小半勺炒螺。那时大陆改革开放不久，下海经商的人来自各行各业，虽然是龙蛇混杂，但大多数人还是靠本事和勤奋挣钱，讲口碑信誉，少见现时有黑心货和过海即神仙的现象。在边吃边谈中，发觉老板娘是个健谈之人，看上去像个弃教从商的知识分子。她还风趣地对我们说，要问石子从何来？请听我来唱山歌：「阿哥田裡摸田螺，阿妹田边慢走过，阿哥抬头望阿妹，错把石头摸入篓厖。」
34e55a345b6796f4a8edcb22b57feaf74c681a7c.translatedText: Although the Guilin snail is not big in size, it is delicious. It is spicy and tangy when paired with red pepper, turmeric, perilla and black black soybean. Just as he was moving his index finger, he suddenly sucked a small stone. After hearing my brother's discussion, the boss's wife came to me and apologized repeatedly: "I'm sorry, the pebbles are as big as snails. I can't see clearly when I stir fry them. Don't be angry." As he spoke, he added half a spoonful of fried snails. At that time, the reform and opening up in mainland China was not long ago, and people doing business in the sea came from all walks of life. Although there was a mix of dragons and snakes, most of them still relied on their ability and hard work to make money, and they talked about reputation and credibility. It is rare to see shady goods and immortals after crossing the sea. While chatting while eating, I found that the landlady was a talkative person, and she looked like an intellectual who abandoned education and went into business. She also said to us humorously, "Where do the stones come from?" Please listen to me singing a folk song: "My brother was touching snails in the field, and my sister was walking slowly by the field. My brother raised his head to look at her, and mistakenly touched the stone into the basket."

f93d3975f5f9136e1d8d4d56945fd45e232640ec.sourceText: 来美国多年，已不复记当年桂林田螺的美味，唯独这「石头的故事」未曾忘却。尤其是初来干上餐馆业这一行，当上了比炒螺更加忙碌的角色，服务对象也比当年「行街一族」来得广泛。在摸爬滚打之后，自己也当上了小餐馆的老板。
f93d3975f5f9136e1d8d4d56945fd45e232640ec.translatedText: After coming to the United States for many years, I no longer remember the deliciousness of Guilin's snails, but this "story of the stone" has never been forgotten. Especially when I first started working in the restaurant industry, I became a busier role than a snail cook, and my service target was wider than the "street people" in the past. After a lot of hard work, he became the owner of a small restaurant.

29b4acf0516f902b6ba8d83abc2d5bfec177b88f.sourceText: 日复一日，在盘来碟去中，难免也有「错把石头放入篓」的时刻，此时，会即时给客人重炒一碟补上，口中也是「对不起啊」、「别生气哟」地道歉一番，银码当然亦是随之减去。通常此类状况在如此这般后，大都能得到谅解，相安无事的日子确实也过去不少。
29b4acf0516f902b6ba8d83abc2d5bfec177b88f.translatedText: Day after day, when going from dish to dish, there will inevitably be moments when "I put the stone in the basket by mistake". At this time, I will immediately give the guest another dish to make up for it, and apologize with "I'm sorry" and "Don't be angry". Of course, the money will be reduced accordingly. Usually after such a situation, most people can be forgiven, and the days of peace and harmony have indeed passed.

6afb2d74f39d030110175fc22369a98cb6b4d241.sourceText: 但「石头的故事」似乎并未结束，就在一个夏天，又发生了一起「石头事件」。一女顾客买了个外卖回去后，不久便打电话来投诉，说外卖鸡汤中有颗小石子，以至在喝汤时把她的牙齿给弄断了，并言明一定会「秋后」算帐。翌日，她把石子带来「验明正身」。望著这粒如米粒般大小的黄色硬物，真不知道它是如何混进「篓」的，更是天晓得会把伊人的牙齿弄断。但在这个顾客至上的国度，為求息事寧人，还是承担起责任，并通知了保险公司。
6afb2d74f39d030110175fc22369a98cb6b4d241.translatedText: But the "story of the stone" did not seem to be over. Just one summer, another "stone incident" occurred. After a female customer bought a takeaway, she called and complained shortly after, saying that there was a pebble in the takeaway chicken soup, which broke her teeth while drinking the soup, and she promised that she would settle the matter "after the fall". The next day, she brought the stone to "prove her identity." Looking at this yellow hard object as big as a grain of rice, I really don't know how it got into the "basket", and God knows it will break the lady's teeth. But in a country where the customer comes first, in order to calm the situation, he still took responsibility and notified the insurance company.

2e78d1e53e45b54f423541435c2d476151b2943c.sourceText: 几天后，保险公司打来了电话，说这女顾客曾经补过牙，这颗小石子很不幸地碰撞到这颗脆弱牙齿上，引起了断裂。為什麼要声明「秋后」才算帐呢？因為她现在有了身孕，為保护胎儿，不能拍摄牙齿的X光照片，所以赔偿不是现在，大约在冬季…。
2e78d1e53e45b54f423541435c2d476151b2943c.translatedText: A few days later, the insurance company called and said that the female customer had had her teeth filled, and unfortunately, this pebble collided with the fragile tooth, causing it to break. Why do we have to declare "Autumn Queen" to settle accounts? Because she is pregnant now, in order to protect the fetus, X-ray photos of the teeth cannot be taken, so the compensation will not be now, but around winter...

9fdc73f1d663932b702b244dcfaabb7f5f8e39ae.sourceText: 看来，有饮食业的一天，这些事情就不会结束。时时提防「错把石头摸入篓」，才能做到「前事不忘，后事之师」。於是，為自己，也為餐馆同业，写下这段「石头记」。
9fdc73f1d663932b702b244dcfaabb7f5f8e39ae.translatedText: It seems that these things will not end as long as there is a catering industry. Always beware of "putting the wrong stone into the basket", so that you can "never forget the past and be the teacher of the future". So, I wrote this "story in stone" for myself and for the rest of the restaurant industry.

83debeb8b19ad8946265f05671329c0ef5dd57d7.sourceText: (本文刊登於2013年2月2日013《世界日报》世界副刊)
83debeb8b19ad8946265f05671329c0ef5dd57d7.translatedText: (This article was published in the World Supplement of "World Daily" on February 2, 2013 013)

31228d9431bb0d9f0c169696b06c866d07907669.translatedText: International Antiques and Art Expo displays over 10,000 treasures in Hong Kong Xinhuanet The largest "International Antiques and Art Expo 2011 (Hong Kong)" in Asia &...

0a7dbdf625aafdb0879a8d8d99c82fa3cb410fe6.sourceText: 亚洲区最大规模的”国际古玩艺术博览2011（香港）”28日至30日在香港国际机场亚洲国际博览馆举行。
0a7dbdf625aafdb0879a8d8d99c82fa3cb410fe6.translatedText: The largest "International Antiques and Art Expo 2011 (Hong Kong)" in Asia will be held at the Hong Kong International Airport from the 28th to the 30th Held at the International Expo.

ada297def6aa80402085d4f6ce07447913fc6ff4.sourceText: 这次展览共展出1万多件不同年代的艺术珍品，包括瓷器、杂项、家具、书画等，估计总值高达数亿港元。共有约50家分别来自香港、内地、欧美等地的参展商参与，吸引来自全球各地的古董爱好者会聚香港，交流业界最新信息和收藏心得。
ada297def6aa80402085d4f6ce07447913fc6ff4.translatedText: This exhibition displays more than 10,000 art treasures from different eras, including porcelain, miscellaneous items, furniture, calligraphy and paintings, etc., with an estimated total value of hundreds of millions of Hong Kong dollars. There are a total of about 50 items from Hong Kong and the Mainland. Exhibitors from China, Europe and the United States participated, attracting antique enthusiasts from all over the world to gather in Hong Kong to exchange the latest information in the industry and collection experiences.

0d9ae466e39c8857c4816fa240823b7395a811a6.sourceText: 展览设有免费古玩鉴定服务，为市民提供一个学习古玩文化的入门机会。
0d9ae466e39c8857c4816fa240823b7395a811a6.translatedText: The exhibition provides free antique appraisal services to provide citizens with a way to learn antique culture.

d1ba42ff17aec18e288c58f558391822bcd20905.sourceText: 据香港媒体报道，这次艺博公开展出多件珍贵古玩艺术品，包括估值约1500万港元的清乾隆粉彩无量寿佛像、15世纪铜鎏金财宝天王等。
d1ba42ff17aec18e288c58f558391822bcd20905.translatedText: According to Hong Kong media reports, this art fair will publicly display a number of precious antiques and artworks, including the Qianlong pastel Amitayus Buddha statue from the Qing Dynasty with an estimated value of approximately HK$15 million, and the 15th-century gilt copper treasure Tianwang.

5f36676cb9b7ae888bf6406dfa65ffc7755a8ecf.sourceText: 香港人真正热爱的艺术：那只死而复生的大黄鸭（图）
5f36676cb9b7ae888bf6406dfa65ffc7755a8ecf.translatedText: The art that Hong Kong people really love: the big yellow duck that came back from the dead (picture)

243748749c9b824d5b39554a908cca273d15138a.sourceText: 香港人真正热爱的艺术：那只死而复生的大黄鸭（图） 香港棗以下是一则普通香港居民本周最关心的与艺术相关…
243748749c9b824d5b39554a908cca273d15138a.translatedText: The art that Hong Kong people really love: the big yellow duck that came back from the dead (picture) Hong Kong Date The following is an art-related news that ordinary Hong Kong residents are most concerned about this week...

6696702988bbc2942414bb3b21f146f8f0905ed4.sourceText: 香港棗以下是一则普通香港居民本周最关心的与艺术相关的新闻：巨型塑料鸭”大黄鸭”复活了。
6696702988bbc2942414bb3b21f146f8f0905ed4.translatedText: Hong Kong Date The following is an art-related news that ordinary Hong Kong residents are most concerned about this week: the giant plastic duck "Big Yellow Duck" is resurrected.

fcb50da94f1765d5d6aff721f11f863273a7f4c1.sourceText: 亿万富翁收藏家可能已到达这里参加香港巴塞尔艺术展( Art Basel Hong Kong )的开幕式，这是这家瑞士展会首次进入亚洲。画廊和名流可能打开了数以千计的香槟，来庆祝这次以艺术为主题的盛会。
fcb50da94f1765d5d6aff721f11f863273a7f4c1.translatedText: The billionaire collector may have arrived for the opening of Art Basel Hong Kong, the Swiss fair's first foray into Asia. Galleries and celebrities probably popped open thousands of bottles of champagne to celebrate the art-themed event.

cefcf369015f7a02e12ef35e559ca2bd69c7191c.sourceText: 但对香港700万居民中的很多人来说，毕加索(Picasso)画作拍卖和贵宾休息室像是另一个世界，他们主要关心的是”向世界传播快乐”(Spreading Joy Around the World)这件事，这是荷兰艺术家弗洛伦丁候夫曼(Florentijn Hofman)创作的”小黄鸭”。”小黄鸭”是童年浴缸中最受喜爱的玩具，而一只六层楼高的”大黄鸭”于本月初被放浮在香江里，迎接被非正式称为”香港艺术周”的活动。尽管艺术周以年度艺术展为核心，但这也是每年香港展示其最好的文化作品和文化活动的时机。
cefcf369015f7a02e12ef35e559ca2bd69c7191c.translatedText: But to many of Hong Kong's 7 million residents, the Picasso auction and VIP lounge are like another world. Their main concern is "Spreading Joy Around the World," a "little yellow duck" created by Dutch artist Florentijn Hofman. A favorite childhood bathtub toy, a six-story-tall duck was floated in the Hong Kong River earlier this month for what is unofficially known as Hong Kong Art Week. Although Art Week is centered around annual art exhibitions, it is also the time of year when Hong Kong showcases its best cultural works and events.

8a51d68f172a796013056de50fadb37c62da2285.sourceText: 几件大型的充气艺术作品已经在公共场所上空出现，反映着香港不敬、怪异和批判性的一面，这一面可能不会出现在艺术展更严谨保守的场合。
8a51d68f172a796013056de50fadb37c62da2285.translatedText: Several large-scale inflatable art works have appeared above public spaces, reflecting an irreverent, weird and critical side of Hong Kong that might not appear in the more conservative settings of art exhibitions.

a8dd63be72c04c4bc0bb00ac8e98e4e60cd3b64e.sourceText: 5月2日大黄鸭首次亮相时，上千人聚集在江边观看。打那以后，数不清的与鸭子有关的产品在商店和餐馆出现。青少年穿起了黄鸭套装，旅游商亭卖起了黄鸭明信片。就连在一个远处岛屿上举办的有200年传统的长洲太平清醮上，也能看到大黄鸭的笑脸。
a8dd63be72c04c4bc0bb00ac8e98e4e60cd3b64e.translatedText: When the big yellow duck made its debut on May 2, thousands of people gathered on the riverside to watch. Since then, countless duck-related products have appeared in stores and restaurants. Teenagers are wearing yellow duck suits, and tourist kiosks are selling yellow duck postcards. Even at the 200-year-old Cheung Chau Tai Ping Jiao Festival held on a distant island, the smiling face of the big yellow duck can be seen.

0a8634a488938a1e9d31f6a8f3925a87045f42d3.sourceText: 香港主要的英语大报《南华早报》已经对大黄鸭发表了不少于19篇的报道、评论和博文。其中一篇社论《大黄鸭让香港团结起来》(Giant Rubber Duck has United the City)指出，大黄鸭比政府最近提升士气的举措更能鼓舞港人。
0a8634a488938a1e9d31f6a8f3925a87045f42d3.translatedText: Hong Kong's major English-language newspaper "South China Morning Post" has published no less than 19 reports, comments and blog posts on the big yellow duck. One of the editorials, "Giant Rubber Duck has United the City," pointed out that the duck is more inspiring to Hong Kong people than the government's recent efforts to boost morale.

315c761b170bba546d24462bd841ec719655fd35.sourceText: 网民们则乐了一把，他们用大黄鸭的笑脸来发表政治评论。”中国人民解放军最大的噩梦，”某人在一幅大黄鸭逼近其他船只的图片下写道，他指的是一项不受欢迎的政府计划，政府把一片新填成的海滨重新规划为军事用途，给了中国人民解放军。（民众最初以为这一地带将被用于修建公园或步行大道）。
315c761b170bba546d24462bd841ec719655fd35.translatedText: Netizens had a lot of fun, using the smiling faces of big yellow ducks to make political comments. “The People’s Liberation Army’s biggest nightmare,” someone wrote under an image of a large yellow duck approaching other ships, referring to an unpopular government plan to repurpose a newly reclaimed beachfront for military use to the People’s Liberation Army. (People initially thought the area would be used for a park or pedestrian walkway).

f5a1a7043e4933928096a8ed93174f21f65a47ee.sourceText: 5月15日，让观众大吃一惊的是，大黄鸭歪了下去，它跌倒在自己的鸭嘴上，然后慢慢漏气，最后变成了鲜黄的一滩。另一份香港报纸《英文虎报》(The Standard)形容公众反应为”十分沮丧”。
f5a1a7043e4933928096a8ed93174f21f65a47ee.translatedText: On May 15, what surprised the audience was that the big yellow duck tilted and fell on its own bill, then slowly leaked air and finally turned into a bright yellow puddle. Another Hong Kong newspaper, The Standard, described the public reaction as "very frustrating".

e965137af549fcdaf1d37b6174fbb4288d133515.sourceText: 大黄鸭殒命显示出该城市的种种焦虑：一个博客作者琢磨，也许大黄鸭被珠江三角洲臭名昭著的糟糕空气污染导致肺病而死。网上开始疯转大黄鸭戴口罩的图片，口罩在2003年的SARS（非典型肺炎）危机时随处可见。其他一些人则猜测大黄鸭是否死于中国新发现的致命禽流感病毒株。香港大学的研究人员发现该病毒可以通过空气传播给猪，这个发现已经《科学》( Science )杂志发表。
e965137af549fcdaf1d37b6174fbb4288d133515.translatedText: The death of the duck illustrates the anxiety in the city: One blogger speculated that the duck might have been killed by lung disease caused by the Pearl River Delta's notoriously bad air pollution. Pictures of big yellow ducks wearing masks began to go viral on the Internet. Masks were widely seen during the SARS crisis in 2003. Others speculated whether the ducks died from a deadly new strain of bird flu discovered in China. Researchers at the University of Hong Kong discovered that the virus can be transmitted to pigs through the air, a finding published in the journal Science.

40192388b05b3fdf2d9d2e2ad9eb4226f7f637e7.sourceText: 有谣言称，大黄鸭是被大陆游客所杀，香港欢迎大陆游客的购买力，但批评他们不礼貌的行为。这种谣言相当盛行，以至于中国官方媒体中央电视台认为有必要出面澄清：
40192388b05b3fdf2d9d2e2ad9eb4226f7f637e7.translatedText: There are rumors that the big yellow duck was killed by mainland tourists. Hong Kong welcomes the purchasing power of mainland tourists but criticizes their impolite behavior. This rumor is so popular that China's state-run media CCTV felt the need to clarify:

f1d62e9bc3c2bc020c549b8a03529a18587a014f.sourceText: ”今天有传言称香港大黄鸭被沈阳游客扔30颗烟头’烧死’。今天香港证实大黄鸭非人为损坏。泄气由于主办方对大黄鸭进行例行体检。”
f1d62e9bc3c2bc020c549b8a03529a18587a014f.translatedText: "Today there are rumors that Hong Kong's big yellow duck was 'burned to death' by tourists from Shenyang throwing 30 cigarette butts. Today Hong Kong confirmed that the big yellow duck was not man-made damage. The frustration is due to the organizers conducting a routine physical examination of the big yellow duck."

6cf842fbc7d8e5b702f48a9196abe9849245a62f.sourceText: 然而在周二晚上，也就是巴塞尔艺术展(这可能是香港近年最大的艺术活动)开幕的前夜，重新充满气的大黄鸭，在数百名旁观者发出的欢呼声中，令人曙目地再现。
6cf842fbc7d8e5b702f48a9196abe9849245a62f.translatedText: Yet on Tuesday night, the eve of the opening of Art Basel, perhaps Hong Kong's biggest art event in recent years, the re-inflated duck made a stunning reappearance to the cheers of hundreds of onlookers.

7e6bb32df8e335b77f43d1b2889060acb117ac9a.sourceText: 尽管巴塞尔艺术展和当地政府作出种种努力，但香港人的想象力还是被当地一家商场组织的一个装置艺术展示给捕获了。
7e6bb32df8e335b77f43d1b2889060acb117ac9a.translatedText: Despite the efforts of Art Basel and the local government, the imagination of Hong Kong people was captured by an installation art display organized by a local shopping mall.

d5061e3640f767b31547d50968ed012cd4e07373.translatedText: Feinic Chinese School held a semester closing ceremony and Christmas party (Photos) (Contributed by Feini Chinese School) On December 7, Feini Chinese School ushered in the autumn of this year...

dd7ec58ed2e9bf51b86a745172ea3cb2f416328b.sourceText: （斐匿中文学校供稿）十二月七日，斐匿中文学校迎来了今年秋季的最后一天课程，各班同学在老师的带领下完成了期终攷试后，欢欢喜喜来到了中心会场。一些家长和学校的义工已经把中歺馆协会为同学们准备好的食品放在现塲, 墙上挂着绘画班小朋友们创作的充满生机和童趣的图画。人们品尝着美食，观赏和评论着孩子们的作品，家长们和老师自由地交谈着，孩子们在一旁追逐玩耍，会场洋溢着一片欢乐喜庆的节日气氛。四个月的紧张学习结束了，老师带领学生表演一些短小节目展示学习成果。广东话一二年级的学生用广东话演出了我爱妈妈和中国梦两首歌。在座的家长和来宾为之惊喜的说孩子们都开始唱响了中国梦，我们得快快跟上。国语班一年级的学生向在12月出生的老师和同学献上了生日快乐歌；孩子们的逰戏表演，寓数字教育于玩乐中，天真无邪，笑得人们合不拢嘴; 二年级学生背诵了王之涣的登黄鹊楼和李白的静夜思，字字发音准确，音调略带阴阳顿挫，引得了满堂喝彩; 三年级同学则集体用中国话介绍了自己的班级，并表演了写字比赛，班上的美国女学生维多莉亚，用纯正的中国发音演唱了一首台湾流行歌曲。 她特别喜欢唱歌，己能熟练地演唱好几十首中国民歌。成人中国话会话班的学员则以十四不是四十的绕口令表现了他们区辨高难度发音的能力。当武术班的小朋友披着两个色彩斑斓的小狮子在场上舞动时，孩子们兴奋地叫着跳着，每个人都想自己也到狮子肚子下面去跳两下。
dd7ec58ed2e9bf51b86a745172ea3cb2f416328b.translatedText: (Contributed by Feini Chinese School) On December 7, Feini Chinese School ushered in the last day of classes this autumn. After completing the final exam under the leadership of the teacher, the students from each class came to the central venue happily. Some parents and school volunteers have put the food prepared by the Chinese Children's Museum Association for the students on site, and the walls are hung with vibrant and childlike pictures created by the children in the painting class. People tasted the delicious food, watched and commented on the children's works, parents and teachers chatted freely, and the children chased and played. The venue was filled with a joyful and festive atmosphere. After four months of intense study, the teacher led the students to perform some short performances to show their learning results. Cantonese first and second grade students performed two songs: I Love Mom and Chinese Dream in Cantonese. The parents and guests present were pleasantly surprised and said that the children had begun to sing the Chinese Dream, and we had to catch up quickly. The first-grade students in the Mandarin language class presented a happy birthday song to their teachers and classmates who were born in December; the children’s performance of Xixi opera, which incorporated digital education into play, was so innocent that it made people laugh from ear to ear; the second-grade students recited Wang Zhihuan’s Ascent of the Yellow Magpie Tower and Li Bai’s Thoughts on a Quiet Night, with accurate pronunciation of each word and a slight yin-yang tone, which attracted applause from the whole hall; The third-grade students collectively introduced their class in Chinese and performed a writing competition. Victoria, an American female student in the class, sang a Taiwanese pop song with pure Chinese pronunciation. She especially likes singing and can sing dozens of Chinese folk songs skillfully. Students in the adult Chinese conversation class demonstrated their ability to distinguish difficult pronunciations by using the tongue twister "Fourteen is not forty". When the children in the martial arts class danced on the field wearing two colorful little lions, the children screamed and jumped excitedly. Everyone wanted to jump under the belly of the lion.

4f8e1c48be7bfe5719fc438fd53486b22f0aac5d.sourceText: 斐匿中文学校是凤凰城侨联在凤凰城市区建立最早中文学校，侨联的领导历来对中文学校教育十分重视和支持。在圣诞季节十分忙碌的时候，侨领余文劲，邓朝驹先生都挤出时间来和家长孩子们共同度过这欢乐时光，并发表了讲话，他们祝大家圣诞快乐，新年快乐。再次强调了教育好下一代和传承发扬中华文化的重要性，希望中文学校办得更好。侨联主席张华芳女士和侨联副主席张肇鸿先生也专门前来参加了庆祝会，他们代表侨联向长期为中文学校免费供应餐饮的中餐馆协会和提供学校场所的华人耆英会表示感谢，向辛勤培育孩子的老师和为学校工作的义工表示深切的谢意，并赠送了礼物。学校领导也为老师，义工和学生赠送了圣诞礼物。
4f8e1c48be7bfe5719fc438fd53486b22f0aac5d.translatedText: > Feini Chinese School is the earliest Chinese school established by the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation in downtown Phoenix. The leaders of the Overseas Chinese Federation have always attached great importance to and supported Chinese school education. During the very busy Christmas season, overseas Chinese leaders Yu Wenjin and Mr. Deng Chaoju found time to spend this happy time with parents and children and delivered speeches. They wished everyone a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year. He once again emphasized the importance of educating the next generation and inheriting and promoting Chinese culture, and hoped that Chinese schools would run better. Ms. Zhang Huafang, Chairman of the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, and Mr. Zhang Zhaohong, Vice Chairman of the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese also came to attend the celebration. On behalf of the Federation of Overseas Chinese, they expressed their gratitude to the Chinese Restaurant Association, which has long provided free meals to Chinese schools, and the Chinese Senior Citizens Association, which provides school venues. They also expressed their deep gratitude to the teachers who work hard to nurture children and the volunteers who work for the school, and presented gifts. School leaders also gave Christmas gifts to teachers, volunteers and students.

40721210c1cb9591712b72f2a515d711a3ede302.sourceText: 在一片欢笑声中，人们相互预祝圣诞快乐，珍重告别，相约在2014年1月11日开学再见。
40721210c1cb9591712b72f2a515d711a3ede302.translatedText: In the midst of laughter, people wished each other a merry Christmas, cherished their farewells, and met again at the start of school on January 11, 2014.

9ce0a1998b03cd2daacafc6b570333528c61464b.translatedText: The Phoenix Motorcycle Sales Center will be converted into a catering center. Friends who hope to buy a house in north-central Phoenix, please note that the large motorcycle sales center north of Seventh Street and Missouri Road...

a9f8a4b6900c3ff668d864f5c215f922b02a61c0.sourceText: 希望在凤凰城中北部买房子的朋友注意了，第七街和密苏里路以北的大片摩托车销售中心，将会改建成餐饮采购中心。这个摩托车销售中心已于三年前关闭，购物餐饮中心开发商山姆福克斯和沃斯科将花 800 万美元，在这里进行改造。这里至少会有五家餐厅。福克斯表示将会有海鲜餐厅以及非常流行的酒吧。餐厅之间的空间有 2000 平方英尺，一些咖啡馆可以优先在这些地方入驻。在凤凰城市中心，社区餐饮中心仍然是比较新的概念。上一个类似的项目在 40 街和坎贝尔大街（ Campbell ）建成。一个名为 Spinato 的度假村计划在街对面建成。这里的基本设施都会因为餐饮购物中心的改建而改善。开发商福克斯的总部在凤凰城，他们已经在亚利桑那，加州，科罗拉多州，德克萨斯州和堪萨斯州有了 30 多家餐厅。凤凰城中部的这个餐饮中心最快将于今年的二月或三月建成。更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的 Tinna (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
a9f8a4b6900c3ff668d864f5c215f922b02a61c0.translatedText: Friends who hope to buy a house in north-central Phoenix, please note that the large motorcycle sales center north of Seventh Street and Missouri Road will be transformed into a catering purchasing center. The motorcycle sales center closed three years ago and will be revamped by shopping and dining center developer Sam Fox and Wasco for $8 million. There will be at least five restaurants here. Fox said there will be seafood restaurants as well as very popular bars. There will be 2,000 square feet of space between restaurants, where some cafes will be given priority. Community dining centers are still a relatively new concept in downtown Phoenix. A previous similar project was built at 40th Street and Campbell Avenue. A resort called Spinato is planned across the street. The basic facilities here will be improved due to the renovation of the restaurant shopping mall. Developer Fox, based in Phoenix, already has more than 30 restaurants in Arizona, California, Colorado, Texas and Kansas. The central Phoenix dining center could be ready as soon as February or March of this year. For more information about real estate, please contact Tinna of Goldtrust Realty (480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com

b865bb7e5f2b67ff0df8675850377a2573cec841.translatedText: Financial Times: The United States has lost a lot by banning Huawei

9a9d03c0d274d2cc790b33fc0fbdbe7d2de8ae1a.sourceText: 金融时报:美封杀华为因小失大 英国《金融时报》 社评指出，美国国会将企业列入黑名单，这种事情不常发生。而美…
9a9d03c0d274d2cc790b33fc0fbdbe7d2de8ae1a.translatedText: Financial Times: The US has lost a lot by banning Huawei. The British "Financial Times" editorial pointed out that the U.S. Congress blacklists companies. This kind of thing does not happen often. And the United States...

5f8ee1ca1d09f018e42fb9966a5a9f80f4176e61.sourceText: 可是华为对自身产权结构仍然讳莫如深。其创始人曾是中国解放军(PLA)军官，其董事长以前和国安部有关联，这个部门负责监控中国网络上的一切信息棗从邮件到文本。尽管华为否认与政府有关系，但来自美国方面的指控还是带来了困扰。即便是已经批准采用华为设备的国家，包括英国，也对该公司设备在本国网络中的无所不在感到了担忧。华为表示，美国众院情报委员会的报告是根据传闻编写的。就此而言，华为就更有必要提高透明度了。
5f8ee1ca1d09f018e42fb9966a5a9f80f4176e61.translatedText: But Huawei is still secretive about its own property rights structure. Its founder is a former Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) officer, and its chairman was previously associated with the Ministry of State Security, the agency responsible for monitoring everything on China's Internet, from emails to texts. Although Huawei denies ties to the government, the accusations from the United States still cause trouble. Even countries that have approved the use of Huawei equipment, including the United Kingdom, are concerned about the ubiquity of the company's equipment in their networks. Huawei said the U.S. House of Representatives Intelligence Committee report was based on hearsay. In this regard, it is even more necessary for Huawei to improve its transparency.

d5d28e1c5708e2de6fe5824d608b2a6bd166756a.sourceText: 但美国国会和白宫也必须分清孰轻孰重。上述报告建议在政府采购中排除华为和中兴通讯，并禁止两家公司参与任何并购活动。那样一来，身为世界第二大和第四大电信设备供应商的华为和中兴在美国这个全球最大市场将只能吃到一小块蛋糕。而中国则有可能对思科(Cisco)等美国电信设备供应商采取报复措施。当前总体政治形势对事态也没有帮助。
d5d28e1c5708e2de6fe5824d608b2a6bd166756a.translatedText: But the U.S. Congress and the White House must also distinguish what is more important. The above-mentioned report recommended excluding Huawei and ZTE from government procurement and prohibiting the two companies from participating in any mergers and acquisitions. As a result, Huawei and ZTE, the world's second- and fourth-largest telecom equipment suppliers, will only have a small piece of the cake in the United States, the world's largest market. China may take retaliatory measures against US telecommunications equipment suppliers such as Cisco. The current general political situation isn't helping matters either.

da3bf2ca99361ff746befa90595a1b6b76904124.sourceText: 中国和美国国内，分别在上演两种完全不同类型的权力交替，与此同时，世界经济正在放缓。两国都无法承担此类贸易摩擦带来的后果。上周，巴拉克?#22885;巴马(Barack Obama)禁止一家中国企业收购美国的4家风电厂，理由是风电厂的位置靠近一个无人机试验场所。这是22年来头一回发生这样的事情。两周前，奥巴马向世界贸易组织(WTO)申诉，指控中国政府为本国汽车零部件供应商提供出口补贴。米特?#32599;姆尼(Mitt Romney)承诺，他上任后头一件事就是宣布中国为汇率操纵国。罗姆尼还指控中国大量盗窃知识产权。
da3bf2ca99361ff746befa90595a1b6b76904124.translatedText: China and the United States are respectively performing two completely different types of power transitions. At the same time, the world economy is slowing down. Neither country can afford the consequences of such trade friction. Last week, Barack Obama banned a Chinese company from acquiring four wind farms in the United States because the plants were located near a drone testing site. This is the first time in 22 years that this has happened. Two weeks ago, Obama filed a complaint with the World Trade Organization (WTO), accusing the Chinese government of providing export subsidies to its auto parts suppliers. Mitt Romney promised that the first thing he would do after taking office would be to declare China a currency manipulator. Romney also accused China of massive theft of intellectual property.

e9e58613f3f6c159387692a56c329cf39d37d6c9.sourceText: 以上检查在正规医疗结构都价格不菲，希望大家互相转告，珍惜获得免费检查的机会。
e9e58613f3f6c159387692a56c329cf39d37d6c9.translatedText: The above examinations are expensive in formal medical institutions. I hope everyone will tell each other and cherish the opportunity to get free examinations.

33e00d4dc65ab1ce5410f0cfdbd9456751bcd53c.sourceText: 报道援引《今日美国报》消息指出，奥巴马总统上个月宣布对中国加速处理签证程序，可能导致中国游客进一步增加，为美国旅游业和零售业带来渴望已久的巨大财源。
33e00d4dc65ab1ce5410f0cfdbd9456751bcd53c.translatedText: The report quoted sources from USA Today as saying that President Obama’s announcement last month to speed up visa processing for China may lead to a further increase in Chinese tourists and bring long-awaited huge financial resources to the U.S. tourism and retail industries.

b7be6504d415665a2469503239325777c9a887bf.sourceText: 中国旅游市场潜力非常惊人，因此美国的旅馆业、航空公司、大城市，甚至购物商场，纷纷派代表到中国招揽生意。他们到大部分美国人闻所未闻的中国二、三级城市向旅游业者做倡导，美国旅馆也推出粥品等中式早餐，并为接待宾客的柜台和电话总机找懂中文的员工，以让中国游客宾至如归。
b7be6504d415665a2469503239325777c9a887bf.translatedText: The potential of China's tourism market is amazing. Therefore, the hotel industry, airlines, big cities, and even shopping malls in the United States have sent representatives to China to solicit business. They went to second- and third-tier cities in China that most Americans had never heard of to advocate to tourism industry players. American hotels also introduced Chinese-style breakfasts such as porridge, and found Chinese-speaking employees for guest reception desks and telephone switchboards to make Chinese tourists feel at home.

a474c7f756b6cf8138aa72d446fc91fa4732f9d3.sourceText: 美国商务部国贸局的统计显示，去年前10个月共有94万名中国客到美国旅游，比前一年激增36%。2010年中国访客在美国的花费已达到50亿元，比2009年暴增39%，成长率超过所有其它国家游客。中国游客在美国的花费已超过法国，在世界各国中排名第七。
a474c7f756b6cf8138aa72d446fc91fa4732f9d3.translatedText: Statistics from the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of International Trade show that a total of 940,000 Chinese tourists visited the United States in the first 10 months of last year, a 36% increase from the previous year. In 2010, Chinese visitors spent 5 billion yuan in the United States, a 39% increase from 2009, and the growth rate exceeded that of tourists from all other countries. Chinese tourists spend more in the United States than France, ranking seventh among countries in the world.

28c784a8dc494f077ffb88da4584a2e88c5a42ba.sourceText: 但是，这些数字虽然很可观，旅游业者对中国的市场潜力更感兴趣。
28c784a8dc494f077ffb88da4584a2e88c5a42ba.translatedText: However, although these figures are impressive, tourism industry players are more interested in China's market potential.

3048f49ebf3116a53be6d84ae0f4c7867d8b2861.sourceText: 中国人很多年前就开始到美国旅游，大部分是有钱人或商务旅客，可是一直到2007年中国给予美国”核准旅游目的地”资格，才闸门大开。这种资格让美国可以到中国宣传观光活动，也引发中国赴美旅游团热潮，吸引首次出国而又精打细算的游客。
3048f49ebf3116a53be6d84ae0f4c7867d8b2861.translatedText: Chinese people began to travel to the United States many years ago, mostly wealthy people or business travelers. However, it was not until 2007 that China granted the United States "approved tourist destination" status that the floodgates opened. This qualification allows the United States to go to China to promote tourism activities, and has also triggered a boom in Chinese tour groups to the United States, attracting first-time overseas tourists who are budget-conscious.

4d652fcc61f2bd87a3d2a73b479ce3402865d427.sourceText: 业者表示，中国游客约有九成仍选择随团旅行，在短期内游览好几个地点，并投宿平价旅馆。但是，他们在美国停留的时间仍超过欧洲游客，而且他们很喜欢买东西，花钱更出奇大方。2010年到纽约的中国游客，平均每人花费3197元，超过其它外国旅行团。
4d652fcc61f2bd87a3d2a73b479ce3402865d427.translatedText: According to the industry, about 90% of Chinese tourists still choose to travel in group tours, visit several locations in a short period of time, and stay in affordable hotels. However, they still stay in the United States longer than European tourists, and they love shopping and are surprisingly generous with their money. In 2010, Chinese tourists to New York spent an average of 3,197 yuan per person, more than other foreign tour groups.

cf15928c91454a4e5873b0b100f19ed48d8d15b4.sourceText: 争睹日环食 民众派对疯倒数 （亚省时报） 21日出现日环食，天文迷在美国西岸各处举办派对，兴奋地为日环食倒数计时，尽管日环食高潮”火环”现象仅持续4分钟，有幸窥见稀罕天文美景的幸运儿仍直呼不可思议。 日环食进行到高潮时，群聚犹他州的数千名群众倒抽一口气，接着报以热烈掌声和欢呼，还有民众高声狂吼。 某些类型的日食几乎每年发生，但美国本地民众从1994年以后就没有看过日环食，下次日环食要等到2023年。美国国家航空暨太空总署科学家纽玛克说，这是因为日环食起于特殊的轨道活动。 日环食首先可见于南亚地区，接着往太平洋移动。俄勒冈州、内华达州、犹他州、亚利桑那州、新墨西哥州和德州可依序看见日环食，最后随着落日消失无踪。 不过日环食的高潮─”火环”现象仅持续约4分钟，也只有部分位于日食路径中线上的民众有幸得见。 官员表示，卡纳拉维尔镇外，还有数千名爱好天文的旅客预料将参加犹他州其他地方举办的”观日派对”，包括齐昂国家公园（Zion National Park）、布莱斯峡谷国家公园（Bryce Canyon National Park）和锡达布雷克斯国家保护区（Cedar Breaks National Monument）。
cf15928c91454a4e5873b0b100f19ed48d8d15b4.translatedText: People are partying and counting down to the annular solar eclipse (Alberta Times) An annular solar eclipse occurred on the 21st. Astronomy fans held parties all over the West Coast of the United States and counted down excitedly to the annular solar eclipse. Although the "ring of fire" phenomenon at the climax of the annular eclipse only lasted 4 minutes, the lucky ones who were lucky enough to glimpse the rare astronomical beauty still said it was incredible. As the eclipse reached its climax, thousands of people gathered in Utah gasped, then applauded, cheered, and roared. Certain types of solar eclipses occur almost every year, but local people in the United States have not seen an annular solar eclipse since 1994, and the next annular solar eclipse will not occur until 2023. Newmark, a scientist at NASA, said this is because the annular solar eclipse results from special orbital activity. The annular solar eclipse will first be visible in South Asia and then move towards the Pacific Ocean. Oregon, Nevada, Utah, Arizona, New Mexico and Texas can see the annular solar eclipse in sequence, before disappearing without a trace as the sun sets. However, the climax of the annular solar eclipse, the "ring of fire" phenomenon, only lasted about 4 minutes, and only some people on the midline of the eclipse path were lucky enough to see it. Officials said thousands of astronomy-loving travelers outside Canaraville are expected to attend "sunwatch parties" held elsewhere in Utah, including Zion National Park, Bryce Canyon National Park and Cedar Breaks National Monument.

b7042c8ecdafffe56e1760b4da7e2be4922f1906.translatedText: Lawyer Huang Huili’s legal mailbox (18) 1. I want to gift real estate to my children. Because I am old, I must consider this legal issue. What are the ways to gift real estate? …

9a41275f14be4e5fc9b29c31b38804b659bd5b21.sourceText: 1。 我想赠送房产给孩子﹐因为年事已高，必须考律这个问题﹐赠送房产有哪些方式﹖ 答﹕第一个方式是维持原状。 很多人想在自己的房子里终老。 由于2012年的遗产税豁免额是512万元，假如今年去世，房子纳税基数是当时的市场价格，只要房屋价格低于豁免额，子女不需交任何联邦遗产税。 第二个方式是赠予孩子。 可以搬出自己房屋，把房子送给孩子。 但是，父母可能必须动用512万元的赠与豁免额。 父母两人每年可向儿子媳妇每人送1万3000元，合在一起每年可以赠与5万1200元，而无任何赠予税。 假如总资产低于512万元，就不用担心这个赠与会影响以后的遗产税。 不过，这个办法有两个缺陷。 一﹐子女的房产纳税基数将是这栋房产的原始成本。 假如子女以后出售房产，可能增值很多，他们必须缴纳许多税。 二、父母已经用掉一些遗产税的豁免额。 第三个方式是低价出售。 假如把房子低价卖给一个陌生人，尽管吃亏了，国税局不管。 不过，假如把房子卖给一个亲戚，那结果就不一样。 卖价和市场价格之间的差价就是赠送礼物的价格。 第四个方式是市价出售、父母借钱给孩子。 除了低价出售房屋给子女外，还有一个方式是按照市场价格出售但是买方分期付款。 这个方法其实常比低价出售更好。 这个借条要是正式的。 清楚说明每个月要支付多少钱。 父母要收至少等于联邦贷款的利息。 只要确定这个借条按照法定程式来设定，子女就能抵付符合房贷利息。
9a41275f14be4e5fc9b29c31b38804b659bd5b21.translatedText: 1. I want to gift real estate to my children. Because I am old, I must consider this legal issue. What are the ways to gift real estate? Answer: The first way is to maintain the status quo. Many people want to live in their own homes for the rest of their lives. Since the estate tax exemption amount in 2012 is 5.12 million yuan, if you die this year, the tax base of the house will be the market price at that time. As long as the house price is lower than the exemption amount, the children will not need to pay any federal estate tax. The second way is to give it to a child. You can move out of your own house and give it to your children. However, parents may have to use the $5.12 million gift exemption. Parents can give each of their sons and daughters-in-law $13,000 per year, and together they can give $51,200 per year without any gift tax. If the total assets are less than 5.12 million yuan, there is no need to worry that this gift will affect future inheritance taxes. However, this approach has two drawbacks. One, the child’s property tax base will be the original cost of the property. If the children later sell the property, it may increase in value a lot, and they will have to pay a lot of taxes. 2. The parents have used up some of the inheritance tax exemption. The third way is to sell at a low price. If you sell your house to a stranger at a low price, even if you suffer a loss, the IRS will not care. However, if the house is sold to a relative, the result will be different. The difference between the selling price and the market price is the price of the gift. The fourth way is to sell at market price and parents lend money to their children. In addition to selling the house at a low price to the children, another way is to sell it at market price but the buyer pays in installments. This method is often better than selling at a low price. This IOU needs to be formal. Clearly state how much you will pay each month. Parents are charged interest at least equal to the federal loan. As long as you make sure that the IOU is set up in accordance with legal procedures, your children will be able to pay the mortgage interest.

042c5987c5eac6243ca2d9d4b85baddf687df4ed.sourceText: 2。 问：我母亲已为她在大陆的弟弟全家申请了移民，但由于我母亲的弟弟及弟妹身体不好得重病无法移民，我母亲想办理领养她弟弟的儿子，孩子今年底将满14岁， 请问在大陆及美国怎么办理领养？ 需要什么资料？ 办理领养大概费用是多少？ 答：1.根据海牙国际领养公约，领养小孩要在16岁以前提出申请；唯中国法律规定领养应在小孩14岁时完成。 2.你母亲想要领养她弟弟的小孩，可能需要到中国提出申请。 唯领养理由须以父母身体不好，无法照顾小孩提出。 你母亲可能须寻求中国有关法律的咨询，并须尽快提出申请，才能符合中国必须在小孩子14岁之前完成收养手续的条件。 3.一旦你母亲在中国完成办理领养的程序，在美国毋须再办理，除非是小孩子现在已入境美国，你母亲才可以在美国向法院提出领养申请。 一般在美国，要享受移民法的领养受益福利，领养须在小孩16岁前完成，普遍而言，在美国办理领养手续，并不复杂，只是如何让孩子入境美国，有很大难度。 你母亲必须和小孩住满2年﹐才可以替小孩申请绿卡。 4.一般在中国申请领养小孩等待期间大约八个月至一年﹐费用你可以请教当地律师。
042c5987c5eac6243ca2d9d4b85baddf687df4ed.translatedText: 2. Question: My mother has applied for immigration for her younger brother and his family in mainland China. However, because my mother’s younger brother and younger siblings are in poor health and are seriously ill and unable to immigrate, my mother wants to adopt her younger brother’s son. The child will be 14 years old at the end of this year. How can I apply for adoption in mainland China and the United States? What information is needed? How much does it cost to adopt? Answer: 1. According to the Hague International Adoption Convention, application for adoption of a child must be made before the age of 16; however, Chinese law stipulates that adoption should be completed when the child is 14 years old. 2. If your mother wants to adopt her brother's child, she may need to apply in China. The only reason for adoption must be that the parents are in poor health and cannot take care of the child. Your mother may need to seek legal advice in China and apply as soon as possible in order to meet China's requirement that adoption procedures be completed before the child turns 14. 3. Once your mother completes the adoption procedures in China, she does not need to apply for adoption in the United States. Unless the child has entered the United States, your mother can apply to the court for adoption in the United States. Generally speaking, in the United States, to enjoy the adoption benefits of immigration law, the adoption must be completed before the child is 16 years old. Generally speaking, the adoption procedures in the United States are not complicated, but how to get the child to enter the United States is very difficult. Your mother must live with the child for 2 years before she can apply for a green card for the child. 4. Generally, the waiting period for applying to adopt a child in China is about eight months to one year. You can consult a local lawyer for the cost.

b5a9f52ce88e73aef1b05fa90d0fb055577b637e.sourceText: 文 扬:从台湾大选中可以总结出什么？ (亚省时报) 2012年台湾大选顺利结束了。 获胜者马英九在胜选致辞中说，”这是我们一条追求和平与繁荣的台湾路线的胜利”。落败者蔡英文在败选致辞中说，”虽然我们很努力，但是，我们要完成最后的理想，这条路比我们想象得更漫长”。 两人都提到了”路”，都表达了大选的胜败主要不是人的胜败而是”路”的胜败这个意思。马英九胜了，脚下的路显得宽广通达；蔡英文败了，她说我们距离山顶还差一里路。 得票的结果，51.6%对45.6%，似乎也表达了这个意思：就是这样了，即便是马英九的政绩再好一些，马吴配的得票也高不到哪里去，即便是苏嘉全的丑闻再多一些，蔡苏配的得票也低不到哪里去。 归根结底，这就是在台湾社会中铺开的、以中国大陆为地标的、两条完全不同的路。平常的时候，这两条路总是被层层叠叠疏疏密密的”议题”树荫遮掩着，令人们很难看清，到了大选投票的时候，其轮廓和走向就显露出来了。 马英九的蓝色道路，脚下这一段很明确，叫做”不统不独不武”，但远方目标很模糊，不敢说终极独立，也不敢说终极统一。 蔡英文的绿色道路，远方目标很明确，就是台湾独立建国，但脚下这一段很模糊，怎么往独立的方向走，没有路线图。 蓝色道路，本质上属于现实主义，或民生主义，或和平主义，靠强调眼前、强调实惠、强调安全吸引人。民众中只图平平安安过好日子多挣点钱的人都看得明白，听得清楚，一解释就跟着点头，一挥手就跟着走。 绿色道路，本质上属于彼岸主义，或激进主义，或冒险主义，靠眺望远景、英勇奋斗、前赴后继吸引人。民众中生性不安份一定要追求点政治理想的人会受其感召，追随其后，听到口号就跟着激动，受点鼓舞就干劲冲天。 再简化一点。蓝色道路，也可以叫”企业型”，把整个台湾当作一个企业来经营，GDP多少，通胀率多少，失业率多少，只要逐年有改善，就是正确路线，就可以继续往下走。 绿色道路，也可以叫”事业型”，把整个台湾当作一个事业来奋斗，理想是什么，主义是什么，政体是什么，只要说辞上能打动人，就总有人跟着走，就可以继续前进。 一般来说，民众中这两种人棗只图平平安安过好日子多挣点钱的人，和生性不安份一定要追求点政治理想的人，都会各占一定比例。在任何一个数量足够大的人群中，都不可能只有其中一种类型的人而没有另一种类型的人。 在经济学和心理学中，早有”风险厌恶型”对”风险喜好型”的二分法，据此做出的经济行为预测常常很准确。不难设想，按照类似的科学方法，也可以在民意研究中做出”经济实惠型””政治追求型”，或”企业偏好型”对”事业偏好型”之类的基本划分，一旦测出了民众中不同类型的比例，也就比较容易设计政治议题，取得理想的支持度。 从近几年的情况看，台湾民众中”经济实惠型”（同时也是企业偏好，风险厌恶）和”政治追求型”（同时也是事业偏好，风险喜好），大概是一半对一半的比例。因此，蓝营和绿营各自所代表的道路哪一个比较吸引民众，全看选前这段时间哪一边的吸引力更大一些。 若大陆在经济方面加大了力度，代表”经济实惠型”的蓝色道路就更吸引人一些，蓝营领导人就上台；若大陆在政治方面加大了压力，代表”政治追求型”的绿色道路就更吸引人一些，绿营领导人就上台。 关注这个规律，恐怕比关注具体的领导人、具体的政策表述更有意义。 民主政治的经验，总是一点一点总结出来的。为此，要感谢台湾人民
b5a9f52ce88e73aef1b05fa90d0fb055577b637e.translatedText: > Wen Yang: What can be concluded from the Taiwan election? (Alberta Times) The 2012 Taiwan general election ended successfully. The winner, Ma Ying-jeou, said in his victory speech, "This is a victory for our Taiwan line that pursues peace and prosperity." The loser, Tsai Ing-wen, said in her defeat speech, "Although we work hard, the road to achieving our final ideal is longer than we imagined." Both men mentioned "road" and both expressed the idea that the victory or defeat of the general election is not mainly about the victory or defeat of people but the victory or defeat of "road". Ma Ying-jeou won, and the road under her feet seemed broad and accessible; Tsai Ing-wen lost, and she said we are still one mile away from the top of the mountain. The result of the vote, 51.6% to 45.6%, seems to express this meaning: That's it. Even if Ma Ying-jeou's political performance is better, Ma Wupei's vote won't be much higher. Even if Su Jiaquan has more scandals, Cai Subei's vote won't be much lower. In the final analysis, these are two completely different roads being paved in Taiwanese society, with mainland China as the landmark. Normally, these two roads are always covered by layers of dense "issue" trees, making it difficult for people to see clearly. But when it comes time to vote in the general election, their outlines and directions are revealed. Ma Ying-jeou's blue road is very clear at the foot of the road, which is called "no unification, no independence, no force." But the distant goal is very vague, and he dare not say ultimate independence, nor ultimate unity. Tsai Ing-wen's green road has a clear goal in the distance, which is the independence and establishment of Taiwan, but the section below is very vague. There is no road map for how to move in the direction of independence. The blue road is essentially realism, people's livelihood, or pacifism. It relies on emphasizing the immediate, the benefits, and the safety to attract people. Those among the people who just want to live a good life in peace and earn more money can see and hear clearly. They nod along with the explanation and follow with a wave of their hands. The green road essentially belongs to the other side of the world, or radicalism, or adventurism. It attracts people by looking at the distant future, struggling bravely, and going forward one after another. People who are restless by nature and must pursue some political ideals will be inspired by it and follow it. They will be excited when they hear the slogans, and they will be motivated to the sky after being inspired. Simplify it a little more. The blue path can also be called "enterprise type", which treats Taiwan as a whole as an enterprise. No matter what the GDP, inflation rate, and unemployment rate are, as long as there is improvement year by year, it is the right path, and you can continue down the road. The green path can also be called "career-oriented". We strive for the whole of Taiwan as a cause. What is the ideal, what is the doctrine, what is the political system. As long as the rhetoric can impress people, there will always be people who will follow, and we can continue to move forward. Generally speaking, there are two types of people among the people: those who just want to live a good life in peace and make more money, and those who are restless by nature and must pursue some political ideals, each will account for a certain proportion. In any sufficiently large group of people, it is impossible to have one type of people but not the other. In economics and psychology, there has long been a dichotomy between "risk-averse" and "risk-loving", and the economic behavior predictions based on this are often very accurate. It is not difficult to imagine that following similar scientific methods, basic divisions such as "affordable" and "politically pursuing", or "enterprise-preferring" and "career-preferring" can be made in public opinion research. Once the proportions of different types among the public are measured, it will be easier to design political issues and obtain ideal support. Judging from the situation in recent years, the ratio between the "affordable" type (also a business preference and risk aversion) and the "political pursuit type" (also a career preference and risk preference) among the Taiwanese people is about half to half. Therefore, which of the paths represented by the blue camp and the green camp is more attractive to the public depends on which side is more attractive during the pre-election period. If the mainland increases its efforts on the economic front, the blue path representing the "affordable approach" will become more attractive, and the leaders of the blue camp will come to power; if the mainland increases the pressure on the political front, the green path representing the "political pursuit" will become more attractive, and the leaders of the green camp will come to power. Paying attention to this pattern is probably more meaningful than paying attention to specific leaders and specific policy statements. The experience of democratic politics is always summed up bit by bit. For this, I would like to thank the people of Taiwan

9bb51c1d30c4f33ab5ff36f0556a8f01bd87466e.sourceText: 埃文岱尔市长就任拉全国城市联盟主席 （亚省时报） 本州埃文岱尔(Avondale)市长玛丽洛浦罗杰斯本月就任全国城市联盟主席，任期一年。 全国城市联盟(National League of Cities)是一个协作倡议组织，成立于1926年，当时只有37个州，21个城市参与。随着时间的推移，该组织成员已扩大到全国49州，有19000个城市、城镇和村落会员。 64岁的罗杰斯是联盟25年来第一位拉丁裔主席。本州上一位担任该职位的前州总检察长泰瑞高德。高德1988年担任联盟主席时，亚利桑那州政治陷入纷争，当时的州长埃文梅卡姆决定撤销马丁路德金日为法定假日，后来在1992年获得选民批准再次定为假日。 罗杰斯如今也面临一大堆问题。SB1070立法以来，亚利桑那州被认为反拉美裔和反移民的强硬堡垒，紧接着，州长布鲁尔手指奥巴马总统被全国媒体炒得沸沸扬扬。还有阿派奥警长被司法部指控，阿派奥警长对奥巴马总统出生证紧咬不放等一系列矛盾对本州产生负面影响。 罗杰斯说，她上任后将致力倡议移民改革，解决边界纷争和供水问题。
9bb51c1d30c4f33ab5ff36f0556a8f01bd87466e.translatedText: > Mayor Avondale is sworn in as chairman of the National League of Cities (Alberta Times) Avondale Mayor Mary Looper Rogers took office this month as president of the National League of Cities for a one-year term. The National League of Cities is a collaborative initiative founded in 1926 with only 37 states and 21 cities participating. Over time, the organization's membership has expanded to 49 states across the country, with 19,000 cities, towns and village members. Rogers, 64, is the league's first Latino president in 25 years. The last person in the state to hold the position was former state Attorney General Terry Gold. When Gaude was president of the alliance in 1988, Arizona politics was engulfed in strife when then-Governor Evan Mecum decided to revoke Martin Luther King Jr. Day as a statutory holiday, which was later made a holiday again with voter approval in 1992. Rogers also faces a lot of problems now. Since the legislation of SB1070, Arizona has been considered a stronghold of anti-Hispanics and anti-immigration. Then, Governor Brewer’s accusation of President Obama was stirred up by the national media. Sheriff Arpaio was also accused by the Department of Justice, and Sheriff Arpaio insisted on clinging to President Obama’s birth certificate. A series of contradictions have had a negative impact on the state. Rogers said that after taking office, she will work to advocate immigration reform and resolve border disputes and water supply issues.

cf72db26e68a77d871370e88545872dfdc707c08.translatedText: When Weiwei met her life partner Keith Gilray, they formed a happy relationship. After marriage, they had two lively and lovely boys. In order to make it easier to take care of our grandchildren, we bought a house near our daughter so that our daughter and son-in-law can work without worries. Weiwei takes good care of her children and takes care of them lovingly and wholeheartedly. She is a rare good wife and mother.

1ec18448d9e0f6da1a876c5717159217513d733d.sourceText: 她培养孩子们善心仁厚，学会有礼貌和守规矩。夫妻并鼓励孩子们的兴趣，弹钢琴，吹笛，唱歌，排话剧，这方面要花的钱薇薇从不吝惜。孩子们表演时，不但全家老少去捧场，还录像保留。花钱并不是唯一，抽时间陪伴孩子成长才是最重要。
1ec18448d9e0f6da1a876c5717159217513d733d.translatedText: She cultivates children to be kind-hearted, polite and well-behaved. The couple also encouraged their children's interests in playing the piano, flute, singing, and arranging dramas. Weiwei never spared the money spent on this. When the children performed, not only did the whole family come to support them, but they also recorded the performances. Spending money is not the only thing, taking time to accompany your children's growth is the most important thing.

8818c7d6e6e7e34167b0c5454e258b31556d3130.sourceText: 薇薇的猝然去世，让我们感到万分的悲伤！让她的亲朋好友无比的痛惜，让许许多多聋哑者为她哭泣！她把器官全部捐赠，让身体化作一缕青烟，骨灰撒还自然。她就如一位走下凡尘的仙女，用善良爱心和真诚，在帮助无数聋哑人和小动物后，回到天界，离开时不带走一丝云彩！
8818c7d6e6e7e34167b0c5454e258b31556d3130.translatedText: The sudden death of Weiwei makes us feel extremely sad! Her relatives and friends felt extremely sad, and many deaf-mute people cried for her! She donated all her organs, turned her body into a plume of smoke, and scattered her ashes naturally. She is like a fairy who came down from the mortal world. With kindness, love and sincerity, after helping countless deaf-mute people and small animals, she returns to the heaven, leaving without a trace of clouds!

21bede3df7796e84f2d4f67ae62f5589701d9959.sourceText: 而她的善行和大爱也在社会人间引起了广泛的反响。从她的辞世到丧礼只有十天时间，但她的生平却在网络和微信群中得到广泛的传播至今。在来自国内外的数百条讯息中，不少人为薮薇至哀和祈福，不少人对她的品行进行赞美，还有不少人对她的家庭进行帮助。
21bede3df7796e84f2d4f67ae62f5589701d9959.translatedText: And her good deeds and great love have also aroused widespread repercussions in society. There were only ten days between her death and the funeral, but her life has been widely circulated on the Internet and WeChat groups to this day. Among the hundreds of messages from home and abroad, many expressed their condolences and prayed for her, many praised her character, and many offered help to her family.

ae6e207990640485bbbb214511d5c23d90485612.sourceText: 南加州广府人会是最早为薮薇家庭发起捐款接龙的团体，截止到1月20日，有四十位善心人士参加，其中包括张素久、陈灿培等全美侨界知名的侨领。捐助由南加州广府人联谊会的谢顾问（Angie）倡议，会长梅宁大力支持，梁玉霞女士悉心操办，（其中有多位是参加过“加州淘金之旅”的朋友），善款已经寄出。我们在此表达万二分的感谢！
