dfd37b6c1f1fe0f712cff88fb69bf5efe509207c.translatedText: Yin Yanliang won the highest honor in Russia, the "Order of Outstanding Engineering". Only two medals have been issued in the world

3848fa1b5c346e203fa9e02ea3039d9fed7a8ac1.sourceText: 尹衍樑获俄罗斯最高荣誉「杰出工程勳章」 全球仅发出二枚 台湾科技大学邀请俄罗斯工程院院长古罗夫赴台进行学术…
3848fa1b5c346e203fa9e02ea3039d9fed7a8ac1.translatedText: Yin Yanliang has received the highest honor in Russia, the "Order of Outstanding Engineering". Only two medals have been issued in the world. Taiwan University of Science and Technology invites Director Gurov of the Russian Academy of Engineering to Taiwan for academic exchanges...

c2d630885e8d9e94ae18b0259f4a1c42ccf0414f.sourceText: 台湾科技大学邀请俄罗斯工程院院长古罗夫赴台进行学术交流，进行与永续发展创造建材以及废料利用解决生态问题的专题演讲，而古罗夫此行也代表俄罗斯工程院向台湾润泰集团总裁授予俄罗斯工程院最高荣誉─杰出工程勳章，感谢尹衍樑愿意将专利技术授权给俄罗斯产业界免费使用。
c2d630885e8d9e94ae18b0259f4a1c42ccf0414f.translatedText: National Taiwan University of Science and Technology invites Director Gurov of the Russian Academy of Engineering to Taiwan for academic exchanges and gives a special lecture on sustainable development, creating building materials and waste utilization to solve ecological problems. During this trip, Gurov also represented the Russian Academy of Engineering to award the Russian Academy of Engineering's highest honor, the Medal of Outstanding Engineering, to the president of Taiwan Runtai Group. He thanked Yin Yanliang for his willingness to license patented technology to the Russian industry for free use.

5a9f1e89b969334d2ed3967ee0bf0afa7c508513.sourceText: 古罗夫表示，尹衍樑授权俄罗斯使用的「五螺箍技术」，已经取得台湾、欧、美、日等超过10国的专利技术，此项技术让原本只能用于圆柱的强化钢筋溷凝土工法得已突破，成功应用在方柱上，因此能够大规模的应用在桥墩或是房屋等场景，能够增进安全、强化耐用、防震以及节省材料等多项好处，对于世界上所有的人类来说，有非常大的贡献。
5a9f1e89b969334d2ed3967ee0bf0afa7c508513.translatedText: Gurov said that the "five-screw technology" authorized by Yin Yanliang to Russia has been patented by more than 10 countries including Taiwan, Europe, the United States, and Japan. This technology allows the reinforced steel bars that were originally only used for columns to be mixed. The concrete construction method has made breakthroughs and has been successfully applied to square columns. Therefore, it can be widely used in scenes such as bridge piers or houses. It can improve safety, enhance durability, earthquake resistance, save materials and many other benefits. It has made a great contribution to all human beings in the world.

f47999dc54c7c6319ac4dc5169359ed654b77dd9.sourceText: 国家地震工程研究中心主任张国镇曾经协助透过破坏大型溷凝土柱实验，对「五螺箍技术」进行试验，后来证实此技术的确能够有效地减少地震对建物造成的损伤，张国镇也表示，目前此项技术也已经出口至新加坡等国家，台湾和中国的建物也大多已经落实使用了。
f47999dc54c7c6319ac4dc5169359ed654b77dd9.translatedText: > Zhang Guozhen, director of the National Earthquake Engineering Research Center, once assisted in testing the "five-hoop technology" by destroying large-scale concrete columns. It was later confirmed that this technology can effectively reduce the damage to buildings caused by earthquakes. Zhang Guozhen also said that this technology has also been exported to countries such as Singapore, and most buildings in Taiwan and China have also implemented it.

9a542d9aaa4f7e380cb3f8da03a1f03fba0a795f.sourceText: 台湾溷凝土学会前理事长张大鹏则说，催生出此技术主要就是因为台湾本身就位处在强震带上，加上有921等大地震发生，让台湾人很早就看见建筑物梁柱的箍筋如果效能不足，只要一有地震，就会付出大量人命的惨痛代价。
9a542d9aaa4f7e380cb3f8da03a1f03fba0a795f.translatedText: Zhang Dapeng, former chairman of the Taiwan Concrete Society, said that the main reason why this technology was developed is because Taiwan itself is located in a strong earthquake zone, and with the occurrence of major earthquakes such as 921, Taiwanese people have long seen that if the stirrups of building beams and columns are not effective enough, as long as there is an earthquake, a large number of human lives will be paid.

a285263748efa416ac6c26cf43fe6ff61aec7331.sourceText: 俄罗斯工程院院长古罗夫所颁发的杰出工程勳章，是俄罗斯工程院的最高荣誉，至今仅发出过两枚。
a285263748efa416ac6c26cf43fe6ff61aec7331.translatedText: The Outstanding Engineering Medal awarded by Director Gurov of the Russian Academy of Engineering is the highest honor of the Russian Academy of Engineering. Only two have been issued so far.

c08cd285582ea80224eb65a042d354df20c9292d.sourceText: 美国运输部保护航空旅客的新规定 8 月 23 日生效，将给予航班超额定位而被迫不能登机、以及航班误点的乘客更多赔偿。 运输部为了提高航空旅客的保障，公告的新规定也要求对行李丢失的乘 ​​ 客退还行李费，不过行李送达 延误 并没有退费。 航空公司主张，即使行李延误他们还是要收费，因为他们并不保证行李会与乘客同一航班。 （要求行李与主人一起上机的安全规定已不复存，因为所有的行李必须通过炸弹筛查。） 根据新规定，持有机票却被拒绝登机的乘客，可以从航空公司得到更多的赔偿。如果是国内航线，航空公司必须让你在两小时内搭乘另一个航班，国际航线要在四小时内，否则你可以拿到你票价 4 倍的补偿，上限为 1,300 美元。旧的规定是票价的两倍，最高 800 美元。 （如果航空公司让你在一到两小时内搭乘其他国内航班，或一至四个小时内搭乘其他国际航班离开，你可以得到票价双倍的赔偿，上限为 650 美元。旧规定是补偿机票价格，上限 400 元。） 对于没有座位乘客的补偿是根据该航班票价计算，而非来回票价。最重要的是，航空公司必须当场支付旅客现金，而不是让你拿兑换券以后搭机用。记得要他们现场开支票。 航空公司给乘客的补偿越高，就越不可能会超卖机票。运输部最近几年把补偿金额大幅提高两次。此外，较高的补偿金额也会使航空公司对自愿让出座位的乘客提出更好的条件，以避免座位不足造成更高的赔偿。 新规定要求航空公司对费用做更多的披露，主要是要求他们在网站上让客人更容易找到这些信息。今年一月起，乘客也可以保留定位 24 小时或 24 小时内取消订位而不受惩罚。许多大型航空公司 10 年前就自动这样做，运输部现在明文规定。 国际航班现在在美国机场受制于四个小时的误点规定，这包括美国和外国的航空公司。不过安全、保安和空中交通管制的考虑则属例外情况。误点两小时后，航空公司必须提供足够的食物、饮水、洗手间及必要的医疗。超过 4 小时就可能被严重罚款，就按每名乘客支付 2 万 7,000 元给政府。 《今日美国》报导，运输部提出的新规定不只这些。不过航空公司抱怨说，他们需要更多的时间来适应。所以运输部同意把下列规定延后到明年 1 月 24 日实施。明年的规定要求航空公司遵守以下几点： 如果航班取消或误点超过 30 分钟，要实时在登机口、航空公司网站、电话预订系统告知乘客。 广告的机票价格要包含所有的政府规费及税，航空公司一般把这些费用额外列出。 客户买进机票后不能调高价格，除非由于政府规费和税的调整，而且乘客同意接受涨价。
c08cd285582ea80224eb65a042d354df20c9292d.translatedText: The U.S. Department of Transportation’s new rules to protect air passengers, which take effect on August 23, will provide more compensation to passengers whose flights are overbooked and forced to be unable to board, or whose flights are delayed. In order to improve the protection of air passengers, the Ministry of Transport announced new regulations that also require baggage fees to be refunded to passengers whose baggage is lost. However, there are no refunds for baggage delivery delays. Airlines argue that they still have to charge even if the bag is delayed because they don't guarantee that the bag will be on the same flight as the passenger. (Security rules requiring luggage to be on board with its owner are no longer in place, as all luggage must pass bomb screening.) Under the new rules, passengers with tickets who are denied boarding could receive more compensation from airlines. The airline must put you on another flight within two hours for domestic routes and within four hours for international routes, or you can be reimbursed four times your fare, up to a maximum of $1,300. The old rule was twice the ticket price, up to $800. (If the airline lets you take another domestic flight within one to two hours, or another international flight within one to four hours, you can be compensated for double the fare, up to a maximum of $650. The old rule was to compensate the ticket price, up to a maximum of $400.) Compensation for passengers without a seat is calculated based on the fare of that flight, not the round-trip fare. Most importantly, airlines must pay passengers in cash on the spot, rather than asking you to get a voucher to use on a later flight. Remember to ask them to write a check on the spot. The more airlines compensate passengers, the less likely they are to overbook tickets. The Department of Transportation has significantly increased the compensation amount twice in recent years. In addition, a higher compensation amount will also enable airlines to offer better conditions to passengers who voluntarily give up their seats to avoid higher compensation due to insufficient seats. The new rules require airlines to make more disclosures about fees, essentially requiring them to make the information easier for guests to find on their websites. Starting in January this year, passengers will also be able to reserve their reservation for 24 hours or cancel within 24 hours without penalty. Many major airlines did this automatically 10 years ago, and the Department of Transportation now makes it explicit. International flights are now subject to a four-hour delay rule at U.S. airports, including U.S. and foreign airlines. However, safety, security and air traffic control considerations are exceptions. After a two-hour delay, airlines must provide adequate food, drinking water, restrooms and necessary medical treatment. Traveling for more than 4 hours may result in severe fines, with each passenger paying NT$27,000 to the government. "USA Today" reported that the new regulations proposed by the Department of Transportation are not the only ones. But airlines complain they need more time to adapt. Therefore, the Department of Transportation agreed to postpone the implementation of the following regulations until January 24 next year. Next year's regulations require airlines to comply with the following points: If a flight is canceled or delayed by more than 30 minutes, passengers must be notified in real time at the boarding gate, on the airline's website, or in the telephone reservation system. The advertised ticket price must include all government fees and taxes, and airlines generally list these fees as additional items. Customers cannot increase the price after purchasing a ticket, unless due to adjustments in government fees and taxes, and the passenger agrees to accept the price increase.

940d7fd27445edba4f8f7df56a458006e67a83f8.sourceText: 川贝枇杷膏在美国走红 中医药应该如何走出去？
940d7fd27445edba4f8f7df56a458006e67a83f8.translatedText: Chuanbei loquat ointment has become popular in the United States. How should traditional Chinese medicine go global?

0b7a192a25a875f604146a0c89bb29450466ae33.translatedText: >Chuanbei loquat ointment has become popular in the United States. How should traditional Chinese medicine go global? Feng Xixi, special Beijing correspondent of Yangcheng Evening News. Recently, Chuanbei loquat ointment has become popular in the United States, attracting attention...

aad5d36faca01d78b3f8a3c3e3f490caf53434de.sourceText: 羊城晚报特派北京记者 丰西西
aad5d36faca01d78b3f8a3c3e3f490caf53434de.translatedText: Feng Xixi, special Beijing reporter of Yangcheng Evening News

dfb7c05d9d1e4c4b87162e0342881f60b7856a64.sourceText: 日前，川贝枇杷膏在美国走红，引发关注。3月3日，在全国两会的”部长通道”上，国家中医药管理局局长王国强表示，中医药”走出去”不只是止咳糖浆，中医药已传播到世界183个国家和地区。
dfb7c05d9d1e4c4b87162e0342881f60b7856a64.translatedText: Recently, Chuanbei loquat ointment has become popular in the United States, attracting attention. On March 3, at the "Ministerial Channel" of the National Two Sessions, Wang Guoqiang, director of the State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, said that "going global" of traditional Chinese medicine is not just about cough syrup. Traditional Chinese medicine has spread to 183 countries and regions around the world.

5748a691dd384f08f320978e4be8428f9fc11db8.sourceText: 如何让更多中医药”走出去”？不少全国政协委员也关注到了这一话题。全国政协委员、中国工程院院士黄璐琦表示，中医药”走出去”需要制定使用标准，让国际社会相信中医疗效；全国政协委员、广东省中医院副院长卢传坚则认为需要利用现代先进技术手段将中医药研究成果呈现出来，传播出去。
5748a691dd384f08f320978e4be8428f9fc11db8.translatedText: How to let more Chinese medicine “go out”? Many members of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference have also paid attention to this topic. Huang Luqi, a member of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference and an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, said that for traditional Chinese medicine to "go global", standards for use need to be formulated to convince the international community of the efficacy of traditional Chinese medicine. Lu Chuanjian, a member of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference and deputy director of the Guangdong Provincial Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine, believes that modern advanced technological means need to be used to present and disseminate the results of traditional Chinese medicine research.

d60ee0e45cd2a56a7f68488ca8cdd18b3f079717.translatedText: Scientific research must strengthen international cooperation

ff5a504d3c6c3296e9a28e97f78c63a780745111.sourceText: 卢传坚则表示，中医药走出去有两个层面的问题，因此提出两个方面的建议。
ff5a504d3c6c3296e9a28e97f78c63a780745111.translatedText: Lu Chuanjian said that there are two levels of problems for traditional Chinese medicine going global, so he put forward two suggestions.

539fa8a37b8dd5327aca242f577a69b762283dce.sourceText: 首先，是从科学研究层面走向国际，建议用现代技术呈现中医药研究成果。她说，中医药发源于我国，历史悠久，这门古老的学科在历史长河中不断发展并在现代社会得到进一步弘扬，目前走向国际已成为历史必然，其深奥的理论内涵、治病道理及其对人类健康保障所发挥的作用等一系列科学问题，需要调动行业内外、国内外对中医药感兴趣的专家学者的积极性来共同研究，需要借助和引进现代技术手段，用现代语言加以阐释，让现代人能够接受和理解，使呈现出来的研究成果得到广泛认同，走向国际。
539fa8a37b8dd5327aca242f577a69b762283dce.translatedText: First of all, it is to go international from the scientific research level, and it is recommended to use modern technology to present the research results of traditional Chinese medicine. She said that traditional Chinese medicine originated in my country and has a long history. This ancient discipline has continued to develop in the long history and has been further promoted in modern society. Now it has become a historical necessity to go international. Its profound theoretical connotation, treatment principles and its role in human health protection and a series of scientific It is necessary to mobilize the enthusiasm of experts and scholars who are interested in traditional Chinese medicine both inside and outside the industry and at home and abroad to jointly study it. It is necessary to use and introduce modern technological means and explain it in modern language so that modern people can accept and understand it, so that the presented research results can be widely recognized and go international.

618114301bd8129c8208f5a9ef273399ed2c8892.sourceText: 对于中医药如何加快从科学研究层面走向国际，卢传坚提出了自己的建议。她提出，首先要以”我”为主，加强国际合作。”国际上有很多先进技术，有很多站在科学前沿的科研机构和团队，他们对中医药感兴趣，我们可以团结他们一起开展中医药研究，但主体必须是我们，引进技术是为我们所用，目标就是用现代技术手段揭示中医药的科学内涵。”
618114301bd8129c8208f5a9ef273399ed2c8892.translatedText: Lu Chuanjian put forward his own suggestions on how to accelerate the transition of traditional Chinese medicine from scientific research to international level. She proposed that we should first focus on "me" and strengthen international cooperation. "There are many advanced technologies in the world, and there are many scientific research institutions and teams at the forefront of science. They are interested in traditional Chinese medicine. We can unite them to carry out traditional Chinese medicine research, but the subject must be us. The introduction of technology is for our use. The goal is to use modern technological means to reveal traditional Chinese medicine. The scientific connotation of medicine. "

a6e6e7661ee27e923bc1e456cee08257ebda23d3.sourceText: 技术标准要掌握话语权
a6e6e7661ee27e923bc1e456cee08257ebda23d3.translatedText: Technical standards must have a say

90b9bd0643016c7245e7d0a18e3a1eddf674b4ed.sourceText: 第二，是从医疗服务的层面走向国际，建议制定中医药技术标准规范，并把握中医药话语权。她指出，我国中医药走向国际已经有很长的历程。目前中医药传播到183个国家和地区，据世界卫生组织统计，目前有103个会员国认可使用针灸，其中29个设立了传统医学的法律法规，18个将针灸纳入医疗保险体系。我国与相关国家和国际组织签订了86个中医药合作协议。国家实施”一带一路”建设以来，截至2016年底，在”一带一路”沿线国家建立了16个中医药海外中心。
90b9bd0643016c7245e7d0a18e3a1eddf674b4ed.translatedText: Secondly, from the level of medical services to the international level, it is recommended to formulate technical standards and specifications for traditional Chinese medicine and have a say in traditional Chinese medicine. She pointed out that my country’s traditional Chinese medicine has a long history of going global. Currently, traditional Chinese medicine has spread to 183 countries and regions. According to statistics from the World Health Organization, 103 member states currently recognize the use of acupuncture, 29 of which have established laws and regulations on traditional medicine, and 18 have included acupuncture in their medical insurance systems. my country has signed 86 traditional Chinese medicine cooperation agreements with relevant countries and international organizations. Since the country implemented the "Belt and Road" construction, as of the end of 2016, 16 overseas centers of traditional Chinese medicine have been established in countries along the "Belt and Road".

c9a99a00ee9b958bb22f38035360598c3b61d463.sourceText: 她建议，可以通过申请非物质文化遗产保护等知识产权保护方式奠定我国中医药在国际上的主导地位。另一方面，她指出，应当制定中医药技术标准规范，包括常见病的诊疗指南及常用技术操作规范。据她介绍，世界卫生组织目前已经与广东省中医院达成合作意向，依托广东省中医院建设的广东省国际传统医学临床指南研究院，在传统医学临床指南的制定方面起到示范作用。”制定技术标准规范，让更多的人可以学习和应用，在诊疗过程中有规可循，出了问题也容易追溯，这是中医药走向国际的安全保障。”另一方面，服务和管理层面的标准和规范同样很重要，应该建立中医药机构和从业人员的准入标准及监管标准，以规范中医药医疗行为，保障医疗质量。
c9a99a00ee9b958bb22f38035360598c3b61d463.translatedText: She suggested that my country’s traditional Chinese medicine can establish its leading position in the world by applying for intangible cultural heritage protection and other intellectual property protection methods. On the other hand, she pointed out that technical standards and specifications for traditional Chinese medicine should be formulated, including guidelines for diagnosis and treatment of common diseases and common technical operating specifications. According to her, the World Health Organization has reached a cooperation intention with the Guangdong Provincial Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine. The Guangdong International Traditional Medicine Clinical Guidelines Research Institute, built by the Guangdong Provincial Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine, will play a demonstration role in the formulation of clinical guidelines for traditional medicine. "Develop technical standards and specifications so that more people can learn and apply them. There are rules to follow in the diagnosis and treatment process, and problems can be easily traced. This is the safety guarantee for traditional Chinese medicine to go global." On the other hand, standards and specifications at the service and management levels are also very important. Access standards and supervision standards for traditional Chinese medicine institutions and practitioners should be established to standardize traditional Chinese medicine medical practices and ensure medical quality.

72fcbce03a72be3b3716b2f23a4fb696eb1a9669.sourceText: 医疗机构要规范化管理

81ab6f48dfe40e2b5452e2cf83d917f2ea731d23.sourceText: 卢传坚还建议，借助”一带一路”建设，希望能推动沿线国家加强中医药规范化管理，并逐渐走向中医药立法。她指出，目前全球的中医医疗机构和从业人员、服务质量良莠不齐的现象非常普遍，”出了问题都算到中医药头上。如果能够规范管理，建立长效机制，我们可以定期组织专家出去讲学，让全世界的中医从业人员都得到教育培训的机会，规范国际中医药医疗行为，推动中医药更好为人类健康服务。”
81ab6f48dfe40e2b5452e2cf83d917f2ea731d23.translatedText: Lu Chuanjian also suggested that with the help of the "One Belt and One Road" construction, he hopes to promote the countries along the route to strengthen the standardized management of traditional Chinese medicine and gradually move towards legislation on traditional Chinese medicine. She pointed out that the current phenomenon of uneven quality of TCM medical institutions, practitioners and services around the world is very common. "Whenever problems arise, TCM medicine is blamed. If management can be standardized and a long-term mechanism can be established, we can regularly organize experts to give lectures, so that TCM practitioners around the world can get education and training opportunities, standardize international TCM medical practices, and promote TCM to better serve human health."

e473eed7b829f1fa1972f9e666b0b224358673cf.sourceText: 借助”一带一路”和大湾区 推动中医药”走出去”
e473eed7b829f1fa1972f9e666b0b224358673cf.translatedText: With the help of the "Belt and Road" and the Greater Bay Area Promote the "going out" of traditional Chinese medicine

82b6b76fdee6848dbdfca3f13c3ec7e411085bf9.sourceText: 推动中医药”走出去”，广东一直在行动。羊城晚报记者从广东省中医药管理局了解到，目前《广东省促进中医药”一带一路”发展行动计划》(简称”计划”)已经印发，到2020年，广东将建立2-3个中医药国际合作平台、4-6个中医药海外中心、2-4个中医药国际交流合作基地和1-3个中医药国际出版传播基地。在海外注册一批中药产品，建成2家具有国际水准的区域中医医疗中心、3-5个国家级中医药养生旅游示范区、一批国家级示范基地和示范项目。
82b6b76fdee6848dbdfca3f13c3ec7e411085bf9.translatedText: Promote the "going out" of traditional Chinese medicine. Guangdong has been taking action. A reporter from the Yangcheng Evening News learned from the Guangdong Provincial Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine that the "Guangdong Provincial Action Plan to Promote the Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine "Belt and Road" (referred to as the "Plan") has been issued. By 2020, Guangdong will establish 2-3 international cooperation platforms for traditional Chinese medicine, 4-6 overseas traditional Chinese medicine centers, 2-4 international exchange and cooperation bases for traditional Chinese medicine, and 1-3 international publishing and communication bases for traditional Chinese medicine. Register a batch of traditional Chinese medicine products overseas, build 2 regional TCM medical centers with international standards, 3-5 national TCM health tourism demonstration zones, and a number of national demonstration bases and demonstration projects.

d8b0ec7c00ccfa14769561a3c45d632e780a1f9b.sourceText: 这些年，广东中医药参与”一带一路”建设和粤港澳大湾区中医药合作与交流也不断推进。中国棗多哥、中国棗马拉维复方青蒿素清除疟疾、中国棗柬埔寨特色药用植物研究与开发、美国麻省总医院中国医院等项目取得突破性进展。粤澳合作中医药科技产业园平台作用不断增强，全省中医药机构与30多个国家相关机构建立长期合作关系，2016年全省”中药材及中成药”出口额达到16981万美元，同比增长8.41%。
d8b0ec7c00ccfa14769561a3c45d632e780a1f9b.translatedText: In recent years, Guangdong Traditional Chinese Medicine’s participation in the “Belt and Road” construction and the cooperation and exchange of Traditional Chinese Medicine in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area have also continued to advance. Projects such as Chinese Date Togo, Chinese Date Malawi Compound Artemisinin to Eliminate Malaria, Chinese Date Cambodian Special Medicinal Plant Research and Development, and the Chinese Hospital of Massachusetts General Hospital in the United States have made breakthrough progress. The role of the Guangdong-Macao Cooperation Traditional Chinese Medicine Science and Technology Industrial Park platform continues to increase. The province’s traditional Chinese medicine institutions have established long-term cooperative relationships with relevant institutions in more than 30 countries. In 2016, the province’s export volume of “Chinese medicinal materials and proprietary Chinese medicines” reached US$169.81 million, a year-on-year increase of 8.41%.

2a69c3b5ce9a18ae453c960356baadabbe2f2993.sourceText: 此次计划也明确，将建立长效机制，为港澳来粤设立独资、合资、合作门诊的企业和个人提供指导和方便。同时，将充分结合”一带一路”沿线国家常见病、多发病、慢性病以及重大疑难疾病诊治需求，通过资源整合提高中医药海外研发和服务能力；还将充分利用广东优质中医药教育资源，与沿线知名大学合作办学，逐步将中医药学科建设纳入沿线国家高等教育体系，建成国际中医药合作办学特色学院，扩大中医药在沿线国家的学历教育和继续教育规模。
2a69c3b5ce9a18ae453c960356baadabbe2f2993.translatedText: This plan also makes it clear that a long-term mechanism will be established to provide guidance and convenience for enterprises and individuals from Hong Kong and Macao to set up wholly-owned, joint venture, or cooperative clinics in Guangdong. At the same time, it will fully integrate the diagnosis and treatment needs of common diseases, frequently-occurring diseases, chronic diseases and major and difficult diseases in countries along the "One Belt and One Road", and improve the overseas research and development and service capabilities of traditional Chinese medicine through resource integration; it will also make full use of Guangdong's high-quality traditional Chinese medicine education resources, cooperate with well-known universities along the route to run schools, gradually integrate the discipline construction of traditional Chinese medicine into the higher education system of the countries along the route, build a special college for international cooperative education of traditional Chinese medicine, and expand the scale of academic education and continuing education of traditional Chinese medicine in countries along the route.

4f960dbf91c1dd429376878c8381a54df9a9b7ee.sourceText: 让中医药”走出去”，广东企业也一直在努力。2014年广东新南方集团通过推行”复方青蒿素快速清除疟疾项目”，用原创复方青蒿素药物，成功拯救了数百万非洲人民的生命，赢得了非洲人民的信任，成为援非的”中国名片”。
4f960dbf91c1dd429376878c8381a54df9a9b7ee.translatedText: Guangdong enterprises have also been working hard to allow traditional Chinese medicine to "go global". In 2014, Guangdong New South Group implemented the "Compound Artemisinin Rapid Malaria Elimination Project" and used original compound artemisinin drugs to successfully save the lives of millions of African people, win the trust of the African people, and become China's "business card" in aiding Africa.

c5db8e37db094733839eeda25b22e13890fcbdb3.sourceText: 随着外国学生来美国留学人数连续创下历史记录，研究人员和美国官员表示，新一波双重国籍的浪潮就要到来，更多的美国家庭的成员来自不同的国家。此外，全球化已经侵蚀了旧有的效忠某一国家的观念。美国国务院领事事务局主管律师贝坦库说，美国政府不鼓励双重国籍但是承认它，部分原因是不想和允许双重国籍的国家起冲突。 贝坦库说：” 如果某人拥有双重国籍。我们不会在他的名字下面做记号。” 他说：” 我们只关注是否这个人是美国公民。” 包括亚美尼亚、加纳、菲律宾和肯尼亚近年都开始允许双重国籍，这样该国政府仍然可以保持和那些选择去外国寻求更好的教育和生活的公民的关系。 据研究全球移民趋势的智库’ 移民政策研究中心’2 008 年的一份研究发现，逾半的国家允许某种形式的双重国籍。今年海地也朝这个方向迈出一步。 在冷战时期，拥有两本护照几乎是不可想象的。政府害怕这会导致间谍或者这会阻止移民融入新国家。 对于双重国籍的统计数据难以获得。但是估计数以千计的美国公民拥有一本以上的护照。他们的权利和责任不同：一些国家允许住在外国的公民投票，但是其他一些国家可能要求他们缴税或者服兵役。一般为了成为双重公民，人们需要申请，填写表格，缴纳费用，类似于美国那样需要考试。 尽管双重国籍人数增加，许多国家如：中国和丹麦仍然不允许。一些政府害怕外国人影响本国事务。 在美国，批评者说，双重国籍阻碍新公民充分投入到他们的新国家。纽约城市大学的政治科学教授任松（ Stanley Renshon ）说，美国应该禁止双重国籍者投票、服役或在海外担任民选官员，并且鼓励双重国籍公民集中精力在新国家。 移民们表示，他们寻求双重国籍有实际和情感的理由。他们自豪于他们的美国公民身份，但是也希望方便回国旅行、购置物业和投资。 对于发展中国家，双重国籍的好处是显著的。富裕移民可以回国投资，创造就业和促进旅游业。 部分人士表示，双重国籍令国界失去意义，人们自由选择在何处生活，影响到对国家的忠诚。 ” 好处和坏处都不是那么显著或不是都那么清楚。” 移民政策研究中心总裁帕帕德美说，他任他的希腊护照过期，因为他不需要它。 亚美尼亚裔移民科克言说，拥有两个护照对她是很自然的事情。她喜欢美国的感恩节及治安良好。但是她怀念她的祖国（亚美尼亚），那儿朋友和亲戚间可以随时彼此拜访，他们在新年交换礼物而不是在圣诞节。
c5db8e37db094733839eeda25b22e13890fcbdb3.translatedText: As foreign students come to the United States to study in record numbers, researchers and U.S. officials say a new wave of dual citizenship is coming, with more American families having members from different countries. Furthermore, globalization has eroded old notions of allegiance to one country. Betancu, a lawyer in charge of the U.S. State Department's Bureau of Consular Affairs, said the U.S. government does not encourage dual citizenship but recognizes it, in part because it does not want to conflict with countries that allow dual citizenship. Betancu said: "If someone has dual citizenship, we will not put a mark under his name." He said: "We only pay attention to whether this person is a U.S. citizen." Armenia, Ghana, the Philippines and Kenya have all begun to allow dual citizenship in recent years so that their governments can still maintain relations with citizens who choose to go abroad to seek a better education and life. A 2008 study by the Center for Migration Policy Research, a think tank that studies global migration trends, found that more than half of countries allow some form of dual citizenship. This year Haiti also took a step in this direction. During the Cold War, having two passports was almost unthinkable. Governments fear this could lead to spies or that it could prevent immigrants from integrating into their new country. Statistics on dual citizenship are difficult to obtain. But it's estimated that thousands of U.S. citizens have more than one passport. Their rights and responsibilities differ: Some countries allow citizens living abroad to vote, but others may require them to pay taxes or perform military service. Generally, in order to become a dual citizen, people need to apply, fill out forms, pay fees, and take exams similar to those in the United States. Despite the increase in dual citizenship, many countries such as China and Denmark still do not allow it. Some governments fear foreigners' influence on their affairs. In the United States, critics say dual citizenship prevents new citizens from fully engaging in their new country. Stanley Renshon, a political science professor at City University of New York, said the United States should ban dual nationals from voting, serving or serving as elected officials overseas and encourage dual citizens to focus on their new country. Immigrants say they have practical and emotional reasons for seeking dual citizenship. They are proud of their U.S. citizenship, but also want to make it easier to travel, buy property and invest in their home countries. For developing countries, the benefits of dual citizenship are significant. Wealthy immigrants can return home to invest, creating jobs and boosting tourism. Some people say that dual citizenship makes national borders meaningless and allows people to freely choose where to live, affecting their loyalty to the country. “Neither the benefits nor the disadvantages are all that significant or clear.” Papademe, president of the Center for Migration Policy Research, said he let his Greek passport expire because he didn’t need it. Kokyan, an Armenian immigrant, said that having two passports is natural for her. She likes Thanksgiving and the good security in America. But she missed her home country (Armenia), where friends and relatives could visit each other at any time and exchange gifts at New Year instead of at Christmas.

aa878ae98c369bdba82cfa5f53ba946cdb12849f.sourceText: 我们旅游的第三个地方是号称东方威尼斯和素有天堂之称的苏州。苏州，就其名称，”苏”字草头下面是”鱼”和”禾”，就能想到这裡自古就是鱼米之乡，富裕之都。 苏州，可以说是我的又一个故乡，因为我现在的家人，我的继母和我的两个妹妹一个弟弟一直工作生活在这裡, 我对这裡的街道，景点，以及人文，特产都非常熟悉。旅游车傍晚时分到达苏州，直驶观前街。观前街历来是苏州的商业中心区，正值元旦假期，街上人头簇拥，热闹非凡。四，五十年代，这条街是卵石舖成的马路，人们乘坐马车行驶其间；后来改成柏油马路，行驶公共汽车；八十年代起，这条街就改成了人行街，禁止车辆行驶。久负盛名的苏州特产店，采芝斋，叶受和，黄天源等依然屹立在那裡，但麦当劳，肯塔基，披萨hut 也占领了一席之地。街上店铺林立，五颜六色的霓虹灯散发出诱人的闪亮，吸引着顾客的目光。我漫步其间，出售的商品几乎都是世界名牌，精品，价格不菲，衣服鞋帽每件都要上千元人民币，人们不知哪儿来的这麽高的购买力。我看到一个中年男子，在两位女士的陪同下，试穿一套丝织睡衣，要价2400人民币，那男子对着镜子上下打量了一下，毫不犹豫地说，买一件家裡随便穿穿吧。好轻鬆的一句话，在我心裡确怔了一下，2400元是现在一个技术工人一个月的工资，是最低收入标准的八倍，这位男子的钱肯定来得容易。市场上卖的东西大部分是洋货，中国人喜欢洋货，洋货好卖，利润大，这无可非议，美国的市场上不是到处都是Made in China 吗？这应该是开放市场经济的自然现象。如果我们还用过去的”抵制日货”，”抵制洋货”的观点去谈爱国主义，那就不合时宜了。只是洋货卖得太贵，中国货卖得太便宜，洋人赚了牌子钱。说起买东西，还有一点值得一提的是，五，六十年代以前，中国市场买东西都是不讨价还价的。曾几何时，大概是从福建有了一个闻名全国的走私市场叫石狮的小镇带头，讨价还价风靡全国。我很不习惯这样，买东西如坐针毡，先要探究是真是假，然后还价，还少了怕吃亏，还多了又怕人说你不懂行，马上给你个脸色看。旧社会听说苏州人买东西杀半价，如今有人教我先杀百分之八十，真叫人无奈。为什麽要用这种互相欺骗和不信任的方式做买卖？在美国和西欧资本主义商业发达国家倒是处处明码标价，即使减价百分之五十，也是写的明明白白，用不着那麽累。我不想买什麽东西，更不想费那个脑子，乾脆进庙裡看看。 玄妙观是观前街上着名的寺庙，观前街就是由此而得名的，也是烧香拜佛的信徒们带动了这裡的经济发展。玄妙观的香火依然十分旺盛，据传，观裡的道士博学多才，静居庙中，洞察世事。许多人生活中遇到困难和不解，到这裡问津指点，十分灵验。所以庙的周围还有一些算命拆字先生在那裡摆摊，他们中间也许有老道士的子孙后代，但相信他们的人不多了，人们倒是更相信那不会说话的菩萨。在烟香缭绕的典堂裡，有年迈的老人，也有穿着西装的青年男女，各自带着不同的困惑和愿望，祈求每天会更好。玄妙观的两侧都是小商店，经营的都是苏州的手工艺品，价钱不贵，买点礼品送朋友，不外是很好的选择，但也别忘了还价。
aa878ae98c369bdba82cfa5f53ba946cdb12849f.translatedText: The third place we traveled to was Suzhou, known as the Venice of the East and known as paradise. Suzhou, as its name suggests, the word "Su" under the grass is "fish" and "grain". You can imagine that this place has been a land of plenty and a wealthy city since ancient times. Suzhou can be said to be another hometown of mine, because my current family, my stepmother, my two sisters and one brother have been working and living here. I am very familiar with the streets, scenic spots, humanities and specialties here. The tourist bus arrived in Suzhou in the evening and drove straight to Guanqian Street. Guanqian Street has always been the central business district of Suzhou. It is the New Year's Day holiday and the street is crowded and lively. In the 1940s and 1950s, this street was a cobblestone road, and people rode horse-drawn carriages along it. Later, it was turned into an asphalt road, and buses were used. Since the 1980s, this street has been turned into a pedestrian street, and vehicles are prohibited. The famous Suzhou specialty stores, Caizhizhai, Ye Shouhe, Huang Tianyuan, etc. are still standing there, but McDonald's, Kentucky, and pizza hut have also taken their place. There are many shops on the street, and the colorful neon lights exude an attractive shine, attracting the attention of customers. As I walked around, I saw that almost all of the goods for sale were world-famous brands, high-quality goods, and expensive. Clothes, shoes and hats each cost thousands of yuan. I don’t know where people get such high purchasing power. I saw a middle-aged man, accompanied by two ladies, trying on a set of silk pajamas for 2,400 yuan. The man looked up and down in the mirror and said without hesitation, buy one to wear at home. Such a relaxing sentence, I was stunned for a moment. 2,400 yuan is the current monthly salary of a skilled worker, which is eight times the minimum income standard. This man must have had easy money. Most of the things sold in the market are foreign goods. Chinese people like foreign goods. Foreign goods are easy to sell and have high profits. This is understandable. Aren’t Made in China everywhere in the American market? This should be a natural phenomenon of an open market economy. If we still use the old concepts of "boycott Japanese goods" and "boycott foreign goods" to talk about patriotism, it will be out of date. It's just that foreign goods are sold too expensive, Chinese goods are sold too cheap, and foreigners make money from the brand. Speaking of shopping, another thing worth mentioning is that before the 1950s and 1960s, there was no bargaining when buying things in the Chinese market. Once upon a time, there was probably a small town called Shishi in Fujian that had a nationally famous smuggling market, and bargaining became popular all over the country. I'm not used to this. Buying something is like sitting on pins and needles. First, I have to find out whether it's true or false, and then bargain. I'm afraid of losing money if I pay too little, and if I pay too much, I'm afraid that people will say you don't know what you're doing and they'll give you a look right away. In the old society, people in Suzhou heard that people in Suzhou would buy things at half price, but now someone teaches me to kill 80% first, which is really helpless. Why do business with such mutual deception and distrust? In the developed capitalist and commercial countries of the United States and Western Europe, prices are clearly marked everywhere. Even if the price is reduced by 50%, it is clearly written, so there is no need to be so tired. I didn't want to buy anything, let alone waste my brain, so I just went to the temple to have a look. Xuanmiao Temple is a famous temple on Guanqian Street, which is where Guanqian Street gets its name. It is also the believers who burn incense and worship Buddha that drive the economic development here. The incense of Xuanmiao Temple is still very strong. It is said that the Taoist priests in the temple are knowledgeable and talented. They live quietly in the temple and have insight into world affairs. Many people encounter difficulties and confusions in life and come here to ask for advice, which is very effective. Therefore, there are some fortune tellers setting up stalls around the temple. There may be descendants of old Taoist priests among them, but not many people believe in them. People believe in the silent Bodhisattva more. In the hall filled with smoke, there are old people and young men and women in suits, each with different confusions and wishes, praying for a better day. There are small shops on both sides of Xuanmiao Temple, selling handicrafts from Suzhou. The prices are not expensive. It is a good choice to buy some gifts for friends, but don't forget to bargain.

669aff0c62007f0aa36aa3a7ac9932c33ef8f850.sourceText: 晚饭后，去苏州河游船，这是过去乾隆皇帝下江南时乘坐的那种小木船，只是改用了马达驱动，每条船坐20人左右。我们的船行走的河正是皇帝南巡的京杭运河的一段，资料显示，京杭运河全长1747公里，是世界上最长的人工运河，是世界有名的苏伊士运河的16倍，是巴拿马运河的33倍，与万里长城同为世界着名文化遗产。这条运河从春秋战国时期时期即公元前466年始建，于公元1293年全线通航，历时1779年，之后，历朝历代都进行了整治，可谓形成于隋，繁荣于唐宋，取直于元，疏通于明清，整治迄今，这条运河促进了南北文化和经济交流，是中华文化的重要组成。过去皇帝下江南行程需90多天，三月从北京出发，七月再起程回驾，也真够皇上辛苦的。我们游船从胥门出发，到蟠门返回，大约一个小时。观赏两岸夜景，聆听美女弹奏和演唱苏州评弹，那优雅的琵琶琴声和着美妙动听的歌声，使人犹如进入了仙境，远远又传来寒山寺那抑扬的钟声，唤醒我们回到了人间。真如歌中唱的，”江南美，江南山水美，物产丰富人更美”难怪乾隆皇帝要六下江南，留下了人们写不尽的风流韵事和民间传说。但我相信乾隆下江南主要还是办公事，不然怎麽会出现乾隆盛世呢！当时，江浙两省上交朝廷的赋银和赋粮占全国的20%和30%，两省的关税则是全国的一半。这样重要的地方，作为领导人，当然要特别关注。
669aff0c62007f0aa36aa3a7ac9932c33ef8f850.translatedText: After dinner, we went on a boat cruise on the Suzhou River. This is the kind of small wooden boat that Emperor Qianlong took when he went to the south of the Yangtze River in the past. It is just that it is driven by a motor. Each boat can seat about 20 people. The river our boat was traveling on was a section of the Beijing-Hangzhou Canal that the emperor visited during his southern tour. According to data, the Beijing-Hangzhou Canal is 1,747 kilometers long and is the longest man-made canal in the world. It is 16 times longer than the world-famous Suez Canal and 33 times longer than the Panama Canal. It is a world-famous cultural heritage along with the Great Wall. This canal was built in the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods, that is, in 466 BC. It was opened to navigation in 1293 AD and lasted for 1779. After that, successive dynasties carried out renovations. It can be said that it was formed in the Sui Dynasty, prospered in the Tang and Song Dynasties, was established in the Yuan Dynasty, and was dredged in the Ming and Qing Dynasties. Up to now, this canal has promoted cultural and economic exchanges between the north and the south, and is an important part of Chinese culture. In the past, the emperor's trip to the south of the Yangtze River took more than 90 days. He started from Beijing in March and returned in July, which was really hard work for the emperor. Our cruise departed from Xumen and returned to Panmen, which took about an hour. Watching the night view on both sides of the Taiwan Strait, listening to beautiful women playing and singing Suzhou Pingtan, the elegant pipa sound and the beautiful singing make people feel like they have entered a fairyland. The melodious bells of Hanshan Temple can be heard in the distance, waking us up and returning to the human world. As the song goes, "Jiangnan is beautiful, the mountains and rivers of Jiangnan are beautiful, and the rich products and people are even more beautiful." No wonder Emperor Qianlong visited Jiangnan six times, leaving behind endless anecdotes and folklore. But I believe that Qianlong's visit to Jiangnan was mainly for business, otherwise how could the prosperous age of Qianlong have happened? At that time, Jiangsu and Zhejiang provinces accounted for 20% and 30% of the country's total in silver and grain payments to the court, and their tariffs were half of the country's. Of course, as a leader, we must pay special attention to such an important place.

ca4cca82fffa1f40b39e36ac5fec7433e2f40e02.translatedText: A brief analysis of Dr. Wu Jianwen's Clinic Everyone finds it very convenient to live in the United States, but what gives many immigrants a headache is seeing a doctor. First of all, we need to understand some symptoms...

5352b735a30d8310e2e87cee5e356cb6a210ac65.sourceText: 到美国生活大家都觉得很方便，可是让很多移民感到头疼的就是看医生。首先要了解一些症状的单词，还要介绍自己的病史，所以很多人都喜欢找华人医生，有个头疼脑热可以自由地进行交流。
5352b735a30d8310e2e87cee5e356cb6a210ac65.translatedText: Everyone finds it very convenient to live in the United States, but what gives many immigrants a headache is seeing a doctor. First of all, you need to understand some symptom words and introduce your medical history. Therefore, many people like to find Chinese doctors. If they have a headache or brain fever, they can communicate freely.

1abf06cbb9e564f39ec0f15a06c6bfb1e3e6375a.sourceText: 吴建文医生2008年在Chandler开设家庭诊所。吴医生是美国药理学博士。曾经在约翰霍普金斯大学做博士后。1999年获得美国医生执照。与很多医生相比，他的独特之处是丰富的临床经验，在中国和美国都做临床，并还有非常强的医学研究的背景。很多人会质疑这跟看病有什么关系呢？做医学研究的人，在看资料，处理资料时都特别认真。边看”认真”两个字说起来简单，可有些时候就人命关天。很多身体的小变化，如果误诊，后果不堪设想。两年前，吴医生来了个新病人需要普通体检，因为有高血压，吴医生给他做了一个心电图，心电图有点不正常，吴医生就要去患者去找心脏专科医生。当患者到心脏专科一查，发现有严重的冠心病，很多主要血管都已经堵塞，再不及时治疗，就会有生命危险。
1abf06cbb9e564f39ec0f15a06c6bfb1e3e6375a.translatedText: Dr. Wu Jianwen opened a family clinic in Chandler in 2008. Dr. Wu is a doctor of pharmacology from the United States. Was a postdoctoral fellow at Johns Hopkins University. Obtained U.S. medical license in 1999. Compared with many doctors, his uniqueness is his rich clinical experience, having done clinical work in both China and the United States, and he also has a very strong medical research background. Many people will question what this has to do with medical treatment. People who do medical research are particularly careful when reading and processing data. While watching, the word "serious" sounds easy to say, but sometimes people's lives are at stake. Many small changes in the body can have disastrous consequences if misdiagnosed. Two years ago, Dr. Wu had a new patient who needed a general physical examination because he had high blood pressure. Dr. Wu did an electrocardiogram on him. The electrocardiogram was a little abnormal, so Dr. Wu had to go to the patient to see a cardiologist. When the patient went to a cardiologist for a check-up, he was found to have severe coronary heart disease and many major blood vessels had been blocked. If not treated in time, his life would be in danger.

61c267997010612d431513aa766741e93b037d92.sourceText: 最近吴医生又看了一个新病人，其主诉是长期脚部水肿，该病人曾经做过很多检查，都没有发现原因，吴医生仔细收集了这个病人的病史，结果发现这个病人在吃一种钙离子拮抗剂。这类药的一种副反应就是脚部水肿，吴医生把这个药换去之后，病人的脚肿很快就消失了。家庭医生的认真和细致，会让病人在早期发现疾病征兆，及时治疗。另外，心脏病，高血压，高血脂，肝炎都是亚裔的常见病，吴医生提醒大家要注意饮食习惯，不要吃太多的白米饭，多吃蔬菜水果，多锻炼身体，对我们的身体有很大的好处。
61c267997010612d431513aa766741e93b037d92.translatedText: Recently, Dr. Wu saw a new patient whose main complaint was long-term foot edema. The patient had undergone many examinations, but no cause was found. Dr. Wu carefully collected the patient's medical history and found that the patient was taking a calcium ion antagonist. One side effect of this type of medicine is foot edema. After Dr. Wu replaced this medicine, the patient's foot swelling disappeared quickly. The conscientiousness and meticulousness of a family doctor will allow patients to detect signs of disease at an early stage and provide timely treatment. In addition, heart disease, high blood pressure, hyperlipidemia, and hepatitis are all common diseases in Asians. Dr. Wu reminds everyone to pay attention to eating habits, not to eat too much white rice, eat more fruits and vegetables, and exercise more, which is of great benefit to our bodies.

e0c10b4f60faa56da73f268583eaf891e963cac9.sourceText: 吴医生和太太杨玉凤都是文革后中国最早的一批大学生，他们在中国考了医学院，一起做了六七年的消化科的医生。来美后吴医生继续深造拿医生执照，有多年临床经验的太太就成为了诊所里最内行的管理人员，她甚至担任美国医生的中文翻译。
e0c10b4f60faa56da73f268583eaf891e963cac9.translatedText: Dr. Wu and his wife Yang Yufeng were among the first batch of college students in China after the Cultural Revolution. They attended medical school in China and worked together as gastroenterologists for six or seven years. After coming to the United States, Dr. Wu continued his studies to obtain a medical license. His wife, who has many years of clinical experience, became the most experienced manager in the clinic. She even served as a Chinese translator for American doctors.

7a02d8a0476afc784d97f9089f19c0be39ada9d1.sourceText: 现在吴医生诊所的专业性不仅吸引了很多中国人，越来越多的美国患者都慕名而来。
7a02d8a0476afc784d97f9089f19c0be39ada9d1.translatedText: Now the professionalism of Dr. Wu’s clinic not only attracts many Chinese, but also more and more American patients.

87b7465518b748874df336401cfa45b1483f1be5.sourceText: (凤凰城中文学校 来稿)新年到，鸿运当空照！凤凰城中文学校祝福大家小龙年新年快乐，好运连连！并邀请您於二月十日11:00 am –2:30 pm，蒞临美莎社区大学学生活动中心中庭 (Mesa Community College Kirk Student Center Courtyard) ，参加本校所举办的春节园游会；观看表演，享用美食，与我们一同欢渡农历新年。 凤凰城中文学校除了教授中文听、说、读、写之外，更著重於教导学生传统的中华文化。尤其是在这裡长大的小孩，对於為什麼有农历年？ 过年过节的风俗习惯有那些，可以说是完全陌生。老师们藉由这个机会跟同学介绍”年”的由来，并介绍各种过年的习俗，中文学校更是每年都以举办春节园游会的方式，让大家在此感受一下过年的气氛。 今年除了传统的舞狮表演之外，老师们更是精心策划了歌唱、短剧、民俗童玩等表演。在场也设有中国结、摺纸和游戏摊位。学生家长更是热心提供各式各样中式美食：炒米粉、肉燥饭、凤梨酥、豆花、波霸奶茶，各式热炒，小菜，羹汤，甜点；也有应景的萝卜糕、发糕，年糕，菜色繁多，不胜枚举。现场以发售点劵来购买食物，每张0.5元。欢迎大家一同来过年！ 如果您想多认识凤凰城中文学校，或是想加入这个大家庭，请与校长程秀玲联络(480-620-1982) 或参观学校网页(http://clsphoenix.org/)。
87b7465518b748874df336401cfa45b1483f1be5.translatedText: (Contributed by Phoenix Chinese School) With the new year coming, good luck will shine in the sky! Phoenix Chinese School wishes everyone a Happy New Year and good luck in the Year of the Dragon! We invite you to visit the Mesa Community College Kirk Student Center Courtyard on February 10th from 11:00 am to 2:30 pm to participate in the Spring Festival Garden Party held by our school; watch performances, enjoy delicious food, and celebrate the Lunar New Year with us. In addition to teaching Chinese listening, speaking, reading and writing, Phoenix Chinese School also focuses on teaching students traditional Chinese culture. Especially for children who grew up here, they wonder why there is a Lunar New Year? There are some customs and habits during the New Year and festivals, which can be said to be completely unfamiliar. Teachers took this opportunity to introduce the origin of "Nian" to students and introduce various New Year customs. The Chinese school even holds a Spring Festival garden party every year to let everyone feel the atmosphere of the New Year. This year, in addition to traditional lion dance performances, teachers also carefully planned performances such as singing, short plays, and folk children's games. There are also Chinese knot, origami and game stalls on site. Parents of students are even more enthusiastic in providing a variety of Chinese delicacies: fried rice noodles, minced meat rice, pineapple cakes, tofu pudding, boba milk tea, various stir-fried dishes, side dishes, soups, and desserts; there are also carrot cakes, steamed rice cakes, and rice cakes for the occasion, and there are so many dishes to mention. Food can be purchased on-site using coupons for 0.5 yuan each. Welcome everyone to celebrate the New Year! If you want to know more about Phoenix Chinese School or want to join this big family, please contact the principal Cheng Xiuling (480-620-1982) or visit the school website (http://clsphoenix.org/).

11c732b88dcdac08a15397b44ba3ab6dc172df14.translatedText: Missed lover - is there a dragonfly on your shoulder? (Alberta Times) In a very quiet and beautiful small town, there is a pair of very loving lovers. They...

cad557b958bedc91e4319b610d59faa777ee21f3.sourceText: 在一个非常宁静而美丽的小城，有一对非常恩爱的恋人， 他们每天都去海边看日出，晚上去海边送夕阳，每个见过他们的人都向他们投来羡慕的目光。 可是有一天，在一场车祸中，女孩不幸受了重伤，她静静地躺在医院的病床上，几天几夜都没有醒过来。 白天，男孩就守在床前不停地呼唤毫无知觉的恋人； 晚上，他就跑到小城的教堂里向上帝祷告，他已经哭干了眼泪。 一个月过去了，女孩仍然昏睡着，而男孩早已憔悴不堪了，但他仍苦苦地支撑着。 终于有一天，上帝被这个痴情的男孩感动了。 于是他决定给这个执着的男孩一个例外 上帝问他：”?你愿意用自己的生命作为交换吗？?? 男孩毫不犹豫地回答：”?我愿意！?? 上帝说：”那好吧，我可以让你的恋人很快醒过来， 但你要答应化作三年的蜻蜓，你愿意吗？” 天亮了，男孩已经变成了一只漂亮的蜻蜓，他告别了上帝便匆匆地飞到了医院。 女孩真的醒了，而且她还在跟身旁的一位医生交谈着什么，可惜他听不到。 几天后，女孩便康复出院了，但是她并不快乐。 她四处打听着男孩的下落，但没有人知道男孩究竟去了哪里。 女孩整天不停地寻找着，然而早已化身成蜻蜓的男孩却无时无刻不围绕在她身边， 只是他不会呼喊，不会拥抱，他只能默默地承受着她的视而不见。 夏天过去了，秋天的凉风吹落了树叶，蜻蜓不得不离开这里。 于是他最后一次飞落在女孩的肩上,他想用自己的翅膀抚摸她的脸， 用细小的嘴来亲吻她的额头，然而他弱小的身体还是不足以被她发现。 转眼间，春天来了，蜻蜓迫不及待地飞回来寻找自己的恋人。 然而，她那熟悉的身影旁站着一个高大而英俊的​​男人， 那一刹那，蜻蜓几乎快从半空中坠落下来。 人们讲起车祸后女孩病得多么的严重， 描述着那名男医生有多么的善良、可爱，还描述着他们的爱情有多么的理所当然， 当然也描述了女孩已经快乐如从前。 蜻蜓伤心极了 在接下来的几天中，他常常会看到那个男人带着自己的恋人在海边看日出， 晚上又在海边看日落，而他自己除了偶尔能停落在她的肩上以外， 什么也做不了。 这一年的夏天特别长，蜻蜓每天痛苦地低飞着， 他已经没有勇气接近自己昔日的恋人。 她和那男人之间的喃喃细语， 他和她快乐的笑声，都令他窒息。 第三年的夏天，蜻蜓已不再常常去看望自己的恋人了。 她的肩被男医生轻拥着，脸被男医生轻轻地吻着， 根本没有时间去留意一只伤心的蜻蜓，更没有心情去怀念过去。 上帝约定的三年期限很快就要到了。 就在最后一天，蜻蜓昔日的恋人跟那个男医生举行了婚礼。 蜻蜓悄悄地飞进教堂，落在上帝的肩膀上， 他听到下面的恋人对上帝发誓说：我愿意！ 他看着那个男医生把戒指戴到昔日恋人的手上，然后看着他们甜蜜地亲吻着。 蜻蜓流下了伤心的泪水。 上帝叹息着：?#20320;后悔了吗？?#34619;蜓擦干了眼泪：”?没有?? 上帝又带着一丝愉悦说：”?那么，明天你就可以变回你自己了。?? 蜻蜓摇了摇头：”?就让我做一辈子蜻蜓吧厖?? 有些缘分是注定要失去的，有些缘分是永远不会有好结果的。 爱一个人不一定要拥有，但拥有一个人就一定要好好去爱他。 你的肩上有蜻蜓吗？
cad557b958bedc91e4319b610d59faa777ee21f3.translatedText: In a very quiet and beautiful small town, there is a pair of very loving lovers. They go to the beach to watch the sunrise every day and to see the sunset at the beach. Everyone who sees them casts envious eyes on them. But one day, in a car accident, the girl was unfortunately seriously injured. She lay quietly on the hospital bed and did not wake up for several days and nights. During the day, the boy stayed in front of the bed and kept calling for his unconscious lover; at night, he went to the church in the small town to pray to God. He had cried all his tears. A month has passed, and the girl is still asleep, while the boy is already haggard, but he is still struggling to support himself. Finally one day, God was moved by this infatuated boy. So he decided to give this persistent boy an exception. God asked him: "Are you willing to use your life in exchange?" The boy replied without hesitation: "I do!" ?? God said: "Okay, I can make your lover wake up soon, but you have to agree to turn into a dragonfly for three years, are you willing?" At dawn, the boy had turned into a beautiful dragonfly. He said goodbye to God and flew to the hospital in a hurry. The girl really woke up, and she was still talking to a doctor next to her, but unfortunately he couldn't hear her. A few days later, the girl recovered and was discharged from the hospital, but she was not happy. She asked around about the boy's whereabouts, but no one knew where the boy had gone. The girl kept looking all day long, but the boy who had turned into a dragonfly was around her all the time, but he could not shout or hug, so he could only suffer her turning a blind eye silently. Summer has passed, the cool autumn wind blows off the leaves, and the dragonflies have to leave here. So he flew down on the girl's shoulder for the last time. He wanted to touch her face with his wings and kiss her forehead with his small mouth, but his weak body was still not enough for her to notice. In a blink of an eye, spring is here, and the dragonfly can't wait to fly back to find his lover. However, a tall and handsome man stood next to her familiar figure. At that moment, the dragonfly almost fell from the air. People talked about how seriously ill the girl became after the car accident, described how kind and cute the male doctor was, and how natural their love was. Of course, they also described how the girl was as happy as before. Dragonfly was extremely sad. In the next few days, he would often see the man taking his lover to watch the sunrise at the beach, and watch the sunset at the beach at night, but he himself could do nothing except occasionally resting on her shoulder. This year's summer was particularly long, and the dragonfly flew painfully low every day. He no longer had the courage to get close to his former lover. The whispers between her and the man, the happy laughter between him and her, took his breath away. In the summer of the third year, Dragonfly no longer visited her lover often. Her shoulders were gently hugged by the male doctor, and her face was gently kissed by the male doctor. She had no time to pay attention to a sad dragonfly, and she was not in the mood to miss the past. God's three-year deadline is coming soon. On the last day, Dragonfly's former lover held a wedding with the male doctor. The dragonfly flew quietly into the church and landed on God's shoulder. He heard the lovers below swear to God: I do! He watched the male doctor put the ring on his former lover's hand, and then watched them kiss sweetly. The dragonfly shed tears of sadness. God sighed:?#20320;Do you regret it? ?#34619; Ting wiped away her tears: "No?" God said with a hint of joy: "Then, you can become yourself again tomorrow." ?? The dragonfly shook his head: "? Let me be a dragonfly for the rest of my life, Pang?? Some fates are destined to be lost, and some fates will never have good results. You don't have to own someone to love someone, but you must love them well if you have someone. Is there a dragonfly on your shoulder?"

0553d23889460d1562914720baba2a1ac8d493a7.sourceText: 销售税加码征集民意 （亚省时报） 一个民间团体正在为为本州增加一美分销售税收集民意，务求赶上十一月大…
0553d23889460d1562914720baba2a1ac8d493a7.translatedText: Gathering public opinion for a one-cent sales tax increase (Alberta Times) A ​​civil society group is collecting public opinion for a one-cent sales tax increase in the state, in order to catch up with the November election...

45d294a8e996c7ae331579165589970845050f13.sourceText: 销售税加码征集民意 （亚省时报） 一个民间团体正在为为本州增加一美分销售税收集民意，务求赶上十一月大选班车，让选民投票。 这个名为”教育素质和人才教育竞选”的组织声称已收集到超过17万5千个支持者签名。立法规定，支持者要不低于172,809才能作为提案，交选民投票。组织负责人安依华彼得森说，他们将继续收集签名，以抵消无效签名。 彼得森说，销售税增加所得的资金，将用于教育、保健和其他本州服务。如果立法成功，将在州长签署的临时销售税至2013年中到期后生效。
45d294a8e996c7ae331579165589970845050f13.translatedText: Gathering public opinion for a sales tax increase (Alberta Times) A ​​civil society group is collecting public opinion for a one-cent sales tax increase for the state, in order to catch up with the November election bus and allow voters to vote. The group, Campaign for Quality and Talent Education, claims to have collected more than 175,000 signatures from supporters. The legislation stipulates that a proposal must have at least 172,809 supporters before it can be put to voters for a vote. The group's director, Anya Peterson, said they would continue to collect signatures to counteract invalid signatures. Funds raised from the sales tax increase will be used for education, health care and other state services, Peterson said. If successful, the legislation would take effect after the temporary sales tax signed by the governor expires in mid-2013.

46c1c5da5a19e80b18305b6aac79147a4194a98b.translatedText: "Immediate relatives of illegal immigrants" who are U.S. citizens can stay in the U.S. to apply for immigration

bc0912c860e1edb8b3b65b8f0d65118bbfc860f9.translatedText: "Immediate relatives of illegal immigrants" who are U.S. citizens can stay in the U.S. and apply for immigration San Francisco, January 2. In order to reunite U.S. citizens and illegal immigrant family members as soon as possible, Obama...

e95926e7fd50b8ecf8bab2705fc66489fd0be8d3.sourceText: 旧金山1月2日电为了让美国公民与非法移民家庭成员尽快团聚，奥巴马政府周三宣布，数以万计没有合法移民身份的美国公民之配偶、子女或者父母，在申请绿卡期间可与其亲人一起住在美国境内。
e95926e7fd50b8ecf8bab2705fc66489fd0be8d3.translatedText: San Francisco, January 2. In order to reunite U.S. citizens and illegal immigrant family members as soon as possible, the Obama administration announced on Wednesday that tens of thousands of spouses, children or parents of U.S. citizens without legal immigration status can live with their relatives in the United States while they apply for green cards.

515d35e43eae26ec3c508044da8305a780d14d41.sourceText: 美国公民与移民服务局局长Alejandro Mayorkas称该项政策可以”减少美国公民与其亲属的长期分离”。
515d35e43eae26ec3c508044da8305a780d14d41.translatedText: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services Director Alejandro Mayorkas said the policy could "reduce the long-term separation of U.S. citizens and their relatives."

6e143da9580985b8a54e71c99b698a8193b05f78.sourceText: 长期以来，成千上万没有合法移民身份的美国公民的配偶、子女或者父母不得不在申请绿卡的过程中回到本国居住，忍受与亲人长达数月甚至数年两地分居的生活。
6e143da9580985b8a54e71c99b698a8193b05f78.translatedText: For a long time, thousands of spouses, children or parents of U.S. citizens without legal immigration status have had to return to their home country to live in the process of applying for a green card, enduring a life of separation from their relatives in two places for months or even years.

3b20a4d287233beb1a637fe946f1cf64cab3cf10.sourceText: 根据现行法律，美国公民的非法移民配偶、子女或者父母可以利用”601豁免条款”，申请留在美国等待调整身分，理由是一旦家人离境便会遭受极度困难。美国每年有2万人申请豁免。
3b20a4d287233beb1a637fe946f1cf64cab3cf10.translatedText: According to current law, illegal immigrant spouses, children or parents of U.S. citizens can use the "601 exemption provision" to apply to stay in the United States and wait to adjust their status on the grounds that they will suffer extreme hardship once their family members leave the country. 20,000 people in the United States apply for exemptions every year.

2058bef228640707397acb080c045a318fd814c7.sourceText: 旧金山湾区移民律师Maria Rivera说新政策让许多湾区移民松了口气。她说：”新政策完全是为了避免家人的长期分离。我认为政府已经意识到了这些家庭所经历的苦难。”
2058bef228640707397acb080c045a318fd814c7.translatedText: San Francisco Bay Area immigration lawyer Maria Rivera said the new policy has given many Bay Area immigrants a sigh of relief. She said: "The new policy is all about avoiding the long-term separation of families. I think the government has realized the suffering that these families have experienced."

e8997212f0ca887584d758593ec87e9869268dd2.sourceText: 奥巴马政府早在2012年初就公布了该项提案，历经数月的公示讨论，该项政策将于本周四在联邦登记公布，并于3月4日生效。
e8997212f0ca887584d758593ec87e9869268dd2.translatedText: The Obama administration announced the proposal as early as early 2012. After months of public discussion, the policy will be announced in the federal register this Thursday and take effect on March 4.

61c4abab3377a0016ca6ecddfd9df85220924bf1.translatedText: It is possible to give up the green card and immigrate again after eight years

e719f5961e20b9d0b5f93d56abc62550195d3c35.sourceText: 放弃绿卡 八年后再移民可行 一对夫妇问：我和妻子是美国永久居民，与大女儿住在一起，并帮她料理家务。她的一双儿女…
e719f5961e20b9d0b5f93d56abc62550195d3c35.translatedText: It is possible to give up the green card and immigrate again after eight years. A couple asked: My wife and I are permanent residents of the United States. We live with our eldest daughter and help her with the housework. Her two children...

ea43c474558ae7dd8636ca3815859d35d72c3ec8.sourceText: 你计画放弃绿卡返回中国和你的小女儿同住，直到你大女儿为她申请的兄弟姐妹类别移民排期到了再移民是可行的，只要你大女儿愿意在未来重新担保你们二人。 当然，你大女儿需是美国公民身分，并有足够的经济能力担保你们。 如果她没有足够的经济能力，她可以找一位可靠的共同担保人一起保证并担保你们。
ea43c474558ae7dd8636ca3815859d35d72c3ec8.translatedText: You plan to give up your green card and return to China to live with your younger daughter. It is feasible to immigrate again until the sibling category immigration application your eldest daughter applied for for her is up, as long as your eldest daughter is willing to re-sponsor the two of you in the future. Of course, your eldest daughter needs to be a U.S. citizen and have enough financial ability to sponsor you. If she does not have sufficient financial resources, she can find a reliable co-guarantor to guarantee and guarantee you together.

1ec30f9eaef5d94ecdd06d70bd7a9087cff4f303.translatedText: Arizona Historical Association: Zhang Zhaohong Chinese labor and American railroads inherit each other In 1879, the Southern Pacific Railway was opened to Maricopa...

d2ba0fcf72ca30d9bfd8f332dcd3e2b2ca828780.sourceText: 华工和美国铁路相互相承
d2ba0fcf72ca30d9bfd8f332dcd3e2b2ca828780.translatedText: Chinese and American railways inherited each other

146044285623fb24fc148b0fcb79a72903a1c35b.sourceText: 1879年，南太平洋铁路已开通到马里科帕（Maricopa)，但并没有通到凤凰城。北面的大西洋–太平洋铁路亦一样，没有去到当时的亚利桑那州的首府普雷斯科特（Prescott）。
146044285623fb24fc148b0fcb79a72903a1c35b.translatedText: In 1879, the Southern Pacific Railway was opened to Maricopa (Maricopa), but it did not reach Phoenix. The same goes for the Atlantic-Pacific Railway to the north, which did not go to Prescott, the capital of Arizona at the time.

3b3eae67759e93c0c7eebf3cb582ab2a066cb6a2.sourceText: 为了建设亚利桑那州公共承运的铁路，不同的铁路营运公司有过多次组合，在两条东西向的跨州的铁路之间修建了一条南北向的铁路（SFP＆P），并建有多条其他的铁路支线，把许多矿场和伐木公司，以及州内州外的城镇连接起来，大大地促进了亚利桑那地区的经济发展。 [66]
3b3eae67759e93c0c7eebf3cb582ab2a066cb6a2.translatedText: In order to build public railways in Arizona, different railway operating companies have combined many times to build a north-south railway (SFP&P) between two east-west interstate railways, and built multiple other railway branch lines, connecting many mining fields and logging companies, as well as towns within and outside the state, which greatly promoted the economic development of the Arizona region. [66]

9caec0a22ff6290ec407b05a3bc6aaf1f33ebb4a.sourceText: 当南太平洋铁路修到了亚利桑那时，凤凰城居民就开始大声疾呼要修建铁路。尽管每年在全国范围内铺设数千英里的铁路，但在从马里科帕到凤凰城的铁路线建成之前的十年中，有七家铁路公司曾组织修建铁路，但都破了产。 [68]
9caec0a22ff6290ec407b05a3bc6aaf1f33ebb4a.translatedText: When the Southern Pacific Railroad reached Arizona, Phoenix residents began clamoring for a railroad. Although thousands of miles of track were being laid across the country each year, seven railroad companies that had organized to build the line went bankrupt in the decade before the line from Maricopa to Phoenix was built. [68]

788b2b67761aed016eb1eefd983be8873f338d4b.sourceText: 修建这条铁路困难重重，天气酷热，炎热的夏日阳光使铁轨变得太热而无法搬运。工人穿上厚重的鹿皮手套工作，进度缓慢。拥有部分通行权的皮马（Pima）印第安原住民，和铁路公司之间发生了争执，谈判持续了大约六个星期，之后达成和解。1886年11月1日，开通Maricopa和Phoenix铁路被特许，工作才得以恢复。通过吉拉河和盐河的铁路桥梁是在旧金山建造的，运到现场后再进行最终的组装。 [69]
788b2b67761aed016eb1eefd983be8873f338d4b.translatedText: Building this railway was fraught with difficulties, as the weather was extremely hot and the hot summer sun made the rails too hot to carry. The workers donned heavy deerskin gloves and worked slowly. A dispute ensued between the Pima Indians, who owned part of the right-of-way, and the railroad, and negotiations lasted about six weeks before a settlement was reached. On November 1, 1886, the Maricopa and Phoenix Railroad was chartered and work resumed. The railroad bridge over the Gila and Salt Rivers was constructed in San Francisco and shipped to the site for final assembly. [69]

8d04e3fbe7af7c0a9c07d6b65d6109160815fbf0.sourceText: 传言称该铁路将在6月1日到达凤凰城，在坦佩（Tempe）和凤凰城（Phoenix）已修建了火车站，在PapagoButtes的南端已经削砍了铁路两边山头的坡度。一种兴奋感席卷了整个小镇，房地产开发商正急切地准备从繁荣中获利。
8d04e3fbe7af7c0a9c07d6b65d6109160815fbf0.translatedText: It is rumored that the railway will arrive in Phoenix on June 1. Railway stations have been built in Tempe and Phoenix, and the slopes of the hills on both sides of the railway have been cut at the southern end of Papago Buttes. A sense of excitement has swept through the town as real estate developers are eager to cash in on the boom.

573caeb31ed8c4b410ff9738ecf69451524070ae.sourceText: 1887年6月，一种侧面涂有“ Phoenix”字的新机车开进了坦佩（Tempe）。但因为有罢工，铁路没有人来上班，因此不得不雇用新的工人。直到在7月3日，最后一根铁轨“被铺设并固定了”。
573caeb31ed8c4b410ff9738ecf69451524070ae.translatedText: In June 1887, a new locomotive with the word "Phoenix" painted on the side rolled into Tempe. But because of the strike, no one came to work at the railroad, so new workers had to be hired. It was not until July 3 that the last track was "laid and secured."

dded2ce28c3768dba8d244e4d3c724897fc63056.sourceText: 1887年7月4日，美国国庆日，火车终于开到了凤凰城。 [70]
dded2ce28c3768dba8d244e4d3c724897fc63056.translatedText: On July 4, 1887, the Fourth of July, the train finally arrived in Phoenix. [70]

979d2499f459c10a668d1648ad9e0671291ca803.sourceText: 凤凰城附近城镇的发展更多是得益于南太平洋铁路（SP)。从坦佩（Tempe）向南通往凯里涅（Kyrene）的SP铁路支线，是通往凤凰城的第一条直达铁路。凤凰城，坦佩的铁路从M＆T向东分支，然后前往梅萨（Mesa），这两条铁路都成为SP的一部分。钱德勒（Chandler）铁路也曾经在SP的北部干线上。
979d2499f459c10a668d1648ad9e0671291ca803.translatedText: >The development of towns near Phoenix was more due to the Southern Pacific Railroad (SP). The SP rail branch, which runs south from Tempe to Kyrene, is the first direct rail line to Phoenix. The Phoenix-Tempe railroad branches east from the M&T and then to Mesa, both railroads becoming part of the SP. The Chandler Railroad was also on the SP's Northern Main Line.

8cae25bf9c12d8b074f684f04b6926c3c400a504.sourceText: 凤凰城联合车站建于1923年，它是多条铁路支线交汇的地方。历史上，铁路旅行在达到顶峰时，每天有多达18列的火车服务。凤凰联合车站于1996年停运， 已成为美国国家史迹名录。 [69] 美国国铁（Amtrak）在亚利桑那州不同的地方，一共有八个火车站。 [71]
8cae25bf9c12d8b074f684f04b6926c3c400a504.translatedText: Phoenix Union Station was built in 1923. It is the place where multiple railway branches meet. Historically, at its peak rail travel had as many as 18 train services per day. Phoenix Union Station closed in 1996 and is listed on the National Register of Historic Places. [69] Amtrak has a total of eight train stations in different places in Arizona. [71]

a68c39506aac9a5677645bc3e86cebff4654d82f.sourceText: 为了纪念美国铁路的建设和保护重要的铁路遗产，亚利桑那州钱德勒（Chandler）市设立了铁路博物馆。（地址： 330 E Ryan Rd,Chandler, AZ），博物馆展览了美国西南部和亚利桑那铁路的历史和文化，收集了早期已退役的火車，很多具有歷史價值且超過百年。请大家带上孩子们去参观，向他们讲述当年中国人修建铁路所作出的伟大贡献，让下一代多了解华工和美国的历史。
a68c39506aac9a5677645bc3e86cebff4654d82f.translatedText: In order to commemorate the construction of American railroads and protect important railroad heritage, the city of Chandler, Arizona, established a railroad museum. (Address: 330 E Ryan Rd, Chandler, AZ), the museum exhibits the history and culture of the American Southwest and Arizona Railroads, and collects early retired trains, many of which have historical value and are over a century old. Please bring your children to visit and tell them about the great contributions made by the Chinese in building railroads, so that the next generation can learn more about the history of Chinese labor and the United States.

1bba342b41325d020ce183e632fc9e4d7ba162e5.sourceText: 2020年2月25日，亞利桑那华人历史协会和吉尔伯特（Gilbert）市历史博物馆，联合举办了“华工对美国铁路的贡献”讲座。由亚利桑那华人历史协会理事杨萍和钱晓吾博士主讲，与会的成员讨论了当年的中国移民如何帮助修建导致美国发展的铁路。 讨论还包括吉尔伯特（Gilbert）铁路的历史，定居在这里的中国移民的历史，以及不断扩大的华人对社区的影响。
1bba342b41325d020ce183e632fc9e4d7ba162e5.translatedText: On February 25, 2020, the Arizona Chinese Historical Association and the Gilbert City Historical Museum jointly held a lecture on "The Contribution of Chinese Workers to American Railways". Led by Arizona Chinese Historical Association directors Yang Ping and Dr. Qian Xiaowu, attendees discussed how Chinese immigrants helped build the railroads that led to the development of the United States. Discussion also included the history of the Gilbert Railroad, the history of the Chinese immigrants who settled here, and the expanding Chinese influence on the community.

78cc208fea64e1eea9f277c9b54dc97c2173d4ba.sourceText: 在完成本文第二章“两条跨州铁路”的叙述时，我们用“华人建设了铁路，铁路彰显了华人”来作为结语。这个概括客观地说明中国人和美国铁路之间的相互相承的关系：中国人用血汗和生命，参与建设了对美国具有巨大贡献的铁路网，华人也随着铁路进入到沿线的城镇，在华人聚居的地方还形成了“唐人街”。华人在这些地方繁衍和发展，并为美国社会日后的繁荣继续发挥自身的力量，也为之后的华人社区的壮大带来了一个最早期的基础。
78cc208fea64e1eea9f277c9b54dc97c2173d4ba.translatedText: When completing the description of the second chapter of this article "Two Cross-State Railways", we concluded with "The Chinese built the railways, and the railways highlighted the Chinese". This summary objectively illustrates the mutual inheritance relationship between the Chinese and American railroads: the Chinese used their blood, sweat and lives to participate in the construction of the railroad network that made a huge contribution to the United States. The Chinese also followed the railroads into the towns along the lines, and "Chinatowns" were formed in places where the Chinese lived together. The Chinese multiplied and developed in these places, and continued to exert their own strength for the future prosperity of American society, and also brought the earliest foundation for the subsequent growth of the Chinese community.

9af535083f33e79081806440718928a883407750.sourceText: 文扬：钓鱼岛失土历史上的“如果” 政府的言辞坚定严厉，军队的演习密集凶猛，国民的游行规模空前。回顾历史，中国在钓鱼岛一次次丢掉、一步步丧失的一百多年里，从来不曾像今天这样强硬，这样寸土必争寸步不让！ 不用说，主要是实力强了，日本有的手段中国有，日本没有的手段中国也有，手里握着的大牌和王牌，是当年的李鸿章、袁世凯、蒋介石等在弱国时代不得不屈服日本压力的中国领袖们做梦也不敢想的。 这么看，似乎百年中日关系就是实力对比关系，谁的拳头硬，谁就在争吵中有理，在谈判中占先，在博弈中得利。 虽然表面如此，但就此得出这个结论，还是不太完全，因为在整个过程中，日本也并不是一直都比中国实力强。在日本最初染指钓鱼岛的19世纪80年代，当时的大清，无论从硬实力还是软实力上讲，都比日本强大很多。其他不论，简单比较一下当时两国各自使用的东亚地图，大清的绘制水平至少比日本先进一百年。 再有就是二战结束后的最初阶段，当时的日本几乎成了废墟，主要生产指标大都不到战前水平的三分之一，虽然其时中国也处在战后复苏阶段，但综合实力上，并不输日本。 然而，历史见证，恰恰在中国本应该有所作为的关键时期，尤其是二战战后中国国际地位空前提高，日本在政治、经济、军事各方面全面陷入低谷的这段时间里，中国却因为自身的问题，丧失了黄金机会，并激励了日本进一步占有钓鱼岛。 六十多年过去了，面对钓鱼岛争端再起的最新形势，有必要再次反思一下这段历史。 如果中国没有直接陷入内战，或者，在实施了战后对日索赔、对日占领之后再转入国内斗争，整个情况会怎样？不要说一个小小的无人岛钓鱼岛，就是整个琉球群岛及其他一些日本附属岛屿，也有很大可能归中国所有。 1945年《波茨坦公告》第8条说得明明白白：The terms of the Cairo Declaration shall be carried out and Japanese sovereignty shall be limited to the islands of Honshu, Hokkaido, Kyushu, Shikoku and such minor islands as we determine. 其中的”我们”，就是美英中三国，是”我们”来决定日本四个大岛之外的附属小岛哪些可以由日本保留，哪些日本必须放弃。而放弃的标准，则在1943年《开罗宣言》中清楚地划定：all the territories Japan has stolen from the Chinese, such as Manchuria, Formosa, and the Pescadores, shall be restored to the Republic of China. 也就是说，自日本明治时代开始对外扩张时算起，日本从中国”偷走”了多少地方，就统统都要如数还给中国。 简直比白日梦还美！可叹的是，中国人的劫数还没尽，那时候不会有这么便宜的事落在中国头上。 正是因为没有抓住这个利用战胜国地位收复全部失土的大好时机，后面的事情就越来越难办了。朝鲜战争爆发，美国决心重新扶植日本，于是推翻了《开罗宣言》和《波茨坦公告》确立的体制，重新与日本签订对日本非常有利的《旧金山和约》，并安排日本与台湾单独签订了基本精神一致的《中日和约》。 美国与日本单独签约，为的是在东亚建构冷战体系，而台湾政权宁肯牺牲中国有利日本也同意与日本签订《中日和约》，为的是力争自身的合法性。和约签署之后，时任中华民国外交部长的叶公超在回答立法院质询时说：”在现行情况下，日本没有权利把台湾和澎湖群岛转移给我们，即使日本有意如此，我们也不能接受?’能想象吗？短短几年，当初那个高高在上有权决定日本命运的”我们”就沦落成了现在这个可怜兮兮连自己的命运都无力掌握的”我们”！ 到了这个时候，全世界都看见了，日本成了笑到最后的人。 再到1971年美日签署将钓鱼岛也包括在内的《归还冲绳协定》时，大陆和台湾两岸同声抗议。这还能有什么用？台湾碍于和美国的友好关系，只是表示”惊愕”、”绝对不能接受”；而正处于”文革”内乱时期的大陆则在外交部声明中高喊”中国人民一定要解放台湾！中国人民也一定要收复钓鱼岛等台湾的附属岛屿！”。 一个永远都在内斗的民族，再有实力也没用，没有人会真的畏惧，甚至根本就不把你当回事。 今天，钓鱼岛争端再起，但愿中国人能真正做到毋忘历史，毋忘日本犯华历史，也毋忘国人兄弟阋墙自取外侮的历史，在喊出”今天的中国，已不是九一八事变时的中国；今天的中国军队，更不是甲午年间的北洋水师！”这响亮口号的同时，也喊出：今天的两岸，已不是内斗时期的两岸了！ 还记得英国历史上每到大战降临，各党派会自动停止党争，各选出代表联合组建集权的”战时内阁”。中国人的政治什么时候能够成熟到这个程度，中国的真正实力，也就能够最完整地展现出来，中国对日本的实力优势，也必定能够稳固地保持下去。 钓鱼岛失土历史上的”如果”所揭示的，不过就是这一点。 2012年9月22日
9af535083f33e79081806440718928a883407750.translatedText: Wen Yang: The "what if" in the history of the Diaoyu Islands' loss of land. The government's rhetoric was firm and severe, the military's exercises were intensive and fierce, and the citizens' demonstrations were unprecedented in scale. Looking back on history, in the more than 100 years since China lost the Diaoyu Islands again and again and lost them step by step, it has never been as tough as it is today, fighting for every inch of land and refusing to give in! Needless to say, the main reason is that China has become stronger. China has the means that Japan has, and China also has means that Japan does not have. The big cards and trump cards in its hands are things that Li Hongzhang, Yuan Shikai, Chiang Kai-shek and other Chinese leaders who had to give in to Japanese pressure in the era of weak countries could not even dream of. Looking at it this way, it seems that the century-old Sino-Japanese relationship is a relationship of strength comparison. Whoever has a stronger fist will be justified in the quarrel, take the lead in the negotiation, and gain in the game. Although this appears to be the case, it is still incomplete to draw this conclusion, because throughout the entire process, Japan has not always been stronger than China. In the 1880s, when Japan first invaded the Diaoyu Islands, the Qing Dynasty at that time was much stronger than Japan in terms of both hard and soft power. Regardless of anything else, a simple comparison of the maps of East Asia used by the two countries at that time shows that the mapping level of the Qing Dynasty was at least a hundred years advanced than Japan's. Then there was the initial stage after the end of World War II, when Japan was almost in ruins, and most of its main production indicators were less than one-third of the pre-war level. Although China was also in the post-war recovery stage at that time, its overall strength was not inferior to Japan's. However, history has witnessed that precisely during the critical period when China should have made a difference, especially during the period after World War II when China's international status was unprecedentedly improved and Japan was in a trough in all aspects of politics, economy, and military, China lost its golden opportunity due to its own problems and encouraged Japan to further occupy the Diaoyu Islands. More than sixty years have passed, and in the face of the latest situation of the resurgence of the Diaoyu Islands dispute, it is necessary to reflect on this period of history again. What would have happened if China had not fallen directly into civil war, or if it had implemented post-war claims against Japan and occupied Japan and then turned to domestic struggle? Not to mention the small uninhabited island Diaoyu Island, the entire Ryukyu Islands and some other Japanese-affiliated islands are very likely to be owned by China. Article 8 of the 1945 Potsdam Declaration makes it clear: The terms of the Cairo Declaration shall be carried out and Japanese sovereignty shall be limited to the islands of Honshu, Hokkaido, Kyushu, Shikoku and such minor islands as we determine. The "we" among them are the United States, Britain and China. It is "we" who decide which of the small affiliated islands other than Japan's four large islands can be retained by Japan and which Japan must give up. The criteria for abandonment were clearly defined in the 1943 Cairo Declaration: all the territories Japan has stolen from the Chinese, such as Manchuria, Formosa, and the Pescadores, shall be restored to the Republic of China. In other words, counting from the time when Japan began its external expansion in the Meiji era, all the territories Japan has "stolen" from China must be returned to China. It’s even more beautiful than a daydream! Sadly, the Chinese people's misfortune is not over yet, and nothing so cheap will happen to China at that time. Precisely because we did not seize this great opportunity to use our status as a victorious nation to regain all the lost territory, the following things became increasingly difficult to handle. When the Korean War broke out, the United States was determined to re-support Japan, so it overturned the system established by the Cairo Declaration and the Potsdam Proclamation, re-signed the San Francisco Peace Treaty with Japan, which was very beneficial to Japan, and arranged for Japan and Taiwan to separately sign the Sino-Japanese Peace Treaty with basically the same spirit. The United States signed a separate contract with Japan in order to build a Cold War system in East Asia, while the Taiwan regime would rather sacrifice China to benefit Japan and agreed to sign the Sino-Japanese Peace Treaty with Japan in order to strive for its own legitimacy. After the signing of the peace treaty, Ye Gongchao, then Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of China, said in response to a question from the Legislative Yuan: "Under the current circumstances, Japan has no right to transfer Taiwan and the Penghu Islands to us. Even if Japan intends to do so, we cannot accept it?" Can you imagine? In just a few years, the "we" who were aloof and had the power to decide Japan's fate were reduced to the pitiful "we" who are now unable to even control their own destiny! By this time, the whole world had seen it, and Japan had the last laugh. When the United States and Japan signed the "Return of Okinawa Agreement" in 1971, which also included the Diaoyu Islands, the mainland and Taiwan protested together. What use was this? Taiwan only expressed "surprise" and "absolutely unacceptable" due to its friendly relations with the United States; while the mainland, which was in the midst of the "Cultural Revolution" and civil strife, shouted in a statement from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs that "the Chinese people must liberate Taiwan!" The Chinese people must also regain the Diaoyu Islands and other Taiwan-affiliated islands! ". It is useless for a nation that is always fighting among itself. No matter how strong it is, no one will really be afraid of you, or even take you seriously. Today, the Diaoyu Islands dispute has arisen again. I hope the Chinese people can truly never Don't forget history, the history of Japan's invasion of China, and the history of our fellow countrymen's resistance to foreign aggression. We are shouting "Today's China is no longer the China during the September 18th Incident; today's Chinese army is not the Beiyang Navy during the Sino-Japanese War of 1891! " This loud slogan also shouted: Today's cross-strait is no longer the cross-strait during the period of civil war! Remember that in British history, whenever a war came, all parties would automatically stop party fighting, and elected representatives from each party to jointly form a centralized "war cabinet." When the Chinese people's politics will mature to this level, China's true strength will be most completely demonstrated, and China's strength advantage over Japan will surely be firmly maintained. What the "what if" in the history of the Diaoyu Islands lost is nothing more than this on September 22, 2012.

7f5d476beb1fdc2f7eee7d493152931379026a3f.sourceText: 退休金和移民排期 1. 我现在62岁想提早领社会安全退休金,因为我怕美国政府没钱以后领不到,这是否明智之举? 答:对退休者而言，社安金是重要收入。因为不论活多久或经济景气好坏，社安金支票总会每月准时寄达，金额随通货膨胀调整。但如能多等几年再领，才能享受最高可能金额。不过不必撑过70岁，因为70岁以后金额不会再增加，再做没好处。 据员工福利研究院 (Employee Benefit Research Institute, EBRI)2011年退休信心调查，只有42%的人实际计算过需准备多少退休金，另外42%的人只大略估计，但估计的金额大多偏低。70、80岁时用尽储蓄，被迫搬去与子女同住。许多人一退休即开始提领401(K)或其他退休储蓄账户的钱，却没考虑到这些钱要供未来20多年的生活所需。由保险精算师协会所作的2009年退休风险调查显示大多数人太早花用退休储蓄，最后自尝苦果。 但调查也显示，11%的退休者依照计划每月只领利息或少部分本金，另外还有11%的人只领退休金的投资收益所得。因此将401(K)、IRA等退休储蓄账户中的钱进行适当的投资，也是退休后生活无虞的最佳方式。 因此你是否要提早领退休金是见人见智的问题完全看你除了社安金之外,你是否有其他的退休储蓄账户而能够你往后20-30年的生活. 2. 2011年7 月份美国劳工移民 排期(6/10/2011 updated) 优先排期 第一优先 全世界,有名额. 中国大陆:有名额 第二优先 全世界,有名额. 中国大陆:03/08/2007 第三优先 全世界,10/08/2005. 中国大陆:07/01/2004 第四优先 全世界,有名额. 中国大陆:有名额 第五优先 全世界,有名额. 中国大陆:有名额 全世界不包印度,墨西哥,菲律宾 注： 第一优先为杰出人才，跨国公司主管，优秀研究人员和教授等； 第二优先为拥有硕士或以上高学位人士或特殊人才等； 第三优先为有技能工人，专业人士和其它工人； 第四优先为一些特殊移民； 第五优先为投资移民和工作机会创造者。 2011年7 月份美国亲属移民 排期(6/10/2011 updated) 优先排期 第一优先 全世界,05/01/2004 中国大陆:05/01/2004 第二优先A 全世界,03/22/2008. 中国大陆:03/22/2008 第二优先B 全世界,07/01/2003. 中国大陆:07/01/2003 第三优先 全世界,07/15/2001. 中国大陆:07/15/2001 第四优先 全世界,03/08/2000. 中国大陆:03/08/2000 全世界不包印度,墨西哥,菲律宾 注： 第一优先为美国公民之未婚子女； 第二A优先为美国永久居民之配偶与子女； 第二B优先为美国永久居民之21岁以上未婚子女； 第三优先为美国公民之已婚子女； 第四优先为美国公民之兄弟姐妹。
7f5d476beb1fdc2f7eee7d493152931379026a3f.translatedText: > Pension and Immigration Scheduling 1. I am now 62 years old and want to receive my Social Security Pension early because I am afraid that I will not be able to receive it after the U.S. Government runs out of money. Is this a wise move? Answer: For retirees, Social Security benefits are important income. Because no matter how long you live or whether the economy is good or bad, your Social Security check will always arrive on time every month, with the amount adjusted for inflation. But if you can wait a few more years to receive it, you can enjoy the maximum possible amount. But you don’t have to live beyond the age of 70, because the amount will not increase after the age of 70, and there is no benefit in doing it again. According to the 2011 Retirement Confidence Survey by the Employee Benefit Research Institute (EBRI), only 42% of people have actually calculated how much they need to prepare for retirement, and the other 42% only make rough estimates, but most of the estimated amounts are low. When I was 70 or 80 years old, I ran out of savings and was forced to move in with my children. Many people start withdrawing money from their 401(k) or other retirement savings accounts as soon as they retire, without considering that the money will be needed to cover their living needs for the next 20-plus years. The 2009 Retirement Risk Survey conducted by the Society of Actuaries shows that most people spend their retirement savings too early and reap the consequences. However, the survey also shows that 11% of retirees only receive interest or a small part of the principal every month according to the plan, and 11% only receive investment income from retirement pensions. Therefore, investing the money in retirement savings accounts such as 401(k) and IRA appropriately is also the best way to live a safe life after retirement. Therefore, whether you want to collect your retirement pension early is a matter of opinion. It depends entirely on whether you have other retirement savings accounts in addition to social security funds that can support your life for the next 20-30 years. 2.
