a774e99bbac3d8f2d4aa334b815417f2525d7f36.sourceText: （新东方艺术学校供稿 秋香撰文）10月18日周六傍晚，二十多位新老朋友齐聚新东方艺术学校，与陈普博士一起渡过了愉快的品茶时光。品茶小聚是从一曲悠扬的古筝名曲《渔舟唱晚》中开始的。陈普博士携来多种好茶，现场冲泡，在缕缕茶香中同大家切磋与茶有关的知识。朋友们在陈普博士的指点下，先后细品茉莉花茶与大红袍的美味。品茗的同时，相互间还品尝了各自家制的拿手点心。
a774e99bbac3d8f2d4aa334b815417f2525d7f36.translatedText: (Contributed by New Oriental Art School) Written by Qiuxiang) On the evening of Saturday, October 18, more than 20 old and new friends gathered at the New Oriental Art School and spent a pleasant tea time with Dr. Chen Pu. The tea-tasting gathering started with a melodious guzheng song called "Fishing Boats Sing Evening". Dr. Chen Pu brought a variety of good teas, brewed them on site, and discussed tea-related knowledge with everyone amidst the scent of tea. Under the guidance of Dr. Chen Pu, the friends tasted the deliciousness of jasmine tea and Dahongpao. While drinking tea, each other also tasted their own homemade snacks.

3f33f728a7127eaa5b62480c5457e1135a7556ae.sourceText: 来到现场的朋友，有些分享了独特的饮茶经历，也给大家留下了深刻的印象。陈普博士讲了自己多年前游历武夷山大红袍茶树三株母树所在的山顶的经历，他对武夷山大红袍茶树周遭环境和他上山经历的描述，让朋友们感觉在自己舌尖上滚动的茶水充满了岩香味。孙女士说起，年轻时无意品过一次好茶，多年四处寻找，品茗无数，却再没有发现记忆中的那种茶味。有的朋友还分享了自己在蒙古包中亲见牧民们用鲜奶熬煮奶茶的情景，沟起了朋友们对异域风情的向往。
3f33f728a7127eaa5b62480c5457e1135a7556ae.translatedText: Some of the friends who came to the scene shared their unique tea drinking experiences, which also left a deep impression on everyone. Dr. Chen Pu talked about his experience many years ago when he visited the top of the mountain where the three mother trees of the Dahongpao tea tree are located in Wuyi Mountain. His description of the surrounding environment of the Dahongpao tea tree in Wuyi Mountain and his experience on the mountain made his friends feel that the tea rolling on their tongues was full of rock flavor. Ms. Sun said that she accidentally tasted good tea once when she was young. She had been searching for it for many years and had countless teas, but she never found the tea flavor in her memory. Some friends also shared the scene of seeing herders making milk tea with fresh milk in a yurt, which aroused their friends' longing for exotic customs.

d6a9e2b4edead137909bdaeb30bda79d478fb443.sourceText: 品茶的同时，凤凰城知名的音乐教师陈志钢老师带来了两种少数民族乐器巴乌和葫芦丝，并进行了现场演奏。年轻的古筝老师文坤璐演奏了《渔舟唱晚》。陈普博士点评说，品茶如品人，听音乐、品名茶、会友聊天，乃人生之乐，惬意无比。
d6a9e2b4edead137909bdaeb30bda79d478fb443.translatedText: While enjoying tea, Mr. Chen Zhigang, a well-known music teacher in Phoenix City, brought two ethnic musical instruments, Bawu and Hulusi, and performed them live. Young guzheng teacher Wen Kunlu played "Fishing Boats Sing Evening". Dr. Chen Pu commented that drinking tea is like tasting people. Listening to music, tasting famous tea, and chatting with friends are the joys of life and are extremely comfortable.

4a1a5c92631c40dc6757cbdbd98ccf0b6ae5e905.sourceText: 临别前，朋友们意犹未尽，有意再聚。陈普博士建议把品茶活动搞成一个常规的文化沙龙，服务大众，以茶会友。时值金秋，初冬不远，是品普洱茶的好时机。下次品茶小聚初步定在十一月中旬，以普洱茶为主题，陈普博士请大家品尝他收藏的极品普洱茶，同时也将与大家详尽分享普洱茶的知识。希望能有更多的朋友能与我们相约品茶，笑谈人生。
4a1a5c92631c40dc6757cbdbd98ccf0b6ae5e905.translatedText: Before we say goodbye, friends still have unfinished business and intend to get together again. Dr. Chen Pu suggested that the tea tasting event should be turned into a regular cultural salon to serve the public and make friends with tea. It’s golden autumn and early winter is not far away, so it’s a good time to taste Pu’er tea. The next tea tasting gathering is initially scheduled for mid-November, with Pu'er tea as the theme. Dr. Chen Pu invites everyone to taste the best Pu'er tea in his collection, and will also share the knowledge of Pu'er tea with everyone in detail. I hope more friends can meet with us to have tea and laugh about life.

5fc2047c60a5e182a52d5ab33871b8bf8a5bf98c.sourceText: 亚省侨领见证百辆哈雷创历史（图） （亚省时报） 一百二十多輛哈雷機車蓄勢待發 在南加州共同慶祝中華民國一百年 中華民國一百年九月二十四日，洛杉磯台灣同鄉聯誼會與中華民國建國一百年慶祝活動美西南地區籌備委員會，共同辦理百輛哈雷慶百年活動，當天超過一百二十輛哈雷機車，在僑委會副委員長任弘全程參與下，繞行了南加州多個城市。多位來自亞利桑那州鳳凰城的僑領出席了這次哈雷護旗活動，中國國民黨亞利桑那省直屬分部常委王瑋(王亭)率領多位委員抵達洛杉磯，並在車上高掛國旗，隨哈雷車隊一同馳騁，參與了這項歷史性的活動。在哈雷震天價響引擎聲的陪襯下，車隊沿途獲得許多民眾的喝采，看見中華民國國旗在海外飛揚，展現國威，這群愛國的亞利桑那地區僑領都相當激動。 為了慶祝中華民國建國一百年，主辦單位今年特別設計了建國百年哈雷紀念衫，大大的國旗，建國百年的Logo以及中華民國四個中文大字，相當的醒目。這場大型活動共號召了一百二十多輛哈雷重型機車共同參與，現場播放著重金屬音樂，讓這項慶祝建國百年的活動格外的酷。現場許多騎士提前抵達集合現場，早早將國旗懸掛在車後，也有騎士將國旗當成披風，發揮哈雷騎士好自由的本色，用各種想得到的方式，表達今天對中華民國的支持。包括中華民國僑務委員會副委員長任弘，洛杉磯華僑文教服務中心主任簡許邦，副主任丘昌生也提前抵達會場給予這群騎士鼓勵。 中國國民黨亞省直屬分部常委王瑋 ( 王 亭 ) 率全體委員與副委員長任弘 ( 右四 ) 在建國百年紀念哈雷機車前合影 這一輛以中華民國國旗以及建國一百年為主體的哈雷紀念款機車，出自僑商曹至中之手，全車一體成形的設計，無論是國徽或是建國一百的標誌，手工精細程度令人驚艷，獲得副委員長任弘以及現場人士一致讚許。副委員長也特別與這群遠道而來支持百年慶典活動的亞省僑領在百年紀念車前合影。 副委員長任弘以中英文致詞時特別向在場這群熱血愛國的華僑們以及對支持中華民國的各族裔騎士們表達感謝，在任副委員長的正式宣佈活動正式開始後，一百多輛哈雷齊發動引擎，轟隆作響氣勢磅礡。 洛杉磯台灣同鄉聯誼會會長吳程遠表示，為了確保騎士們騎乘安全，雇用多輛前導車進行交通管制及維安任務，同時這也是洛杉磯台聯會第二年舉辦護旗活動，美國許多道路路面寬廣，尤其南加州氣候宜人，在客觀條件上辦理這項活動，可說是得天獨厚，看著各款車型的哈雷機車掛滿中華民國國旗馳騁，副委員長不時揮舞著國旗，雖然由一百二十多輛的哈雷組成的車隊綿延相當長，但行進間整齊一致遵守紀律，更是將哈雷精神充分展現。同時也非常感謝亞利桑那州的僑領們此次的共襄盛舉，並在哈雷機車隊後方全程提供保護。 行經十多個城市以及四十多英哩的距離，抵達終點站洛杉磯華僑文教服務中心時，受到現場僑胞們揮舞國旗熱情歡迎，包括駐洛杉磯台北經濟文化辦事處處長龔中誠，洛僑中心主任簡許邦，副主任丘昌生，全美台聯會會長鄭長祥，僑務委員李秉信，高啟正等都在現場迎接，所有哈雷機車將洛僑中心的停車場擠得水洩不通，熱鬧非常。騎士們共同高喊中華民國萬歲以及台灣加油讚!的口號，相約明年再見。
5fc2047c60a5e182a52d5ab33871b8bf8a5bf98c.translatedText: Overseas Chinese leaders in Alberta witness the creation of 100 Harley-Davidson motorcycles making history (Photo) (Alberta Times) More than 120 Harley-Davidson motorcycles are ready to go out to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the Republic of China in Southern California On September 24, the 100th anniversary of the Republic of China, the Taiwanese Association of Los Angeles and the Southwestern United States Preparatory Committee for the 100th Celebration of the Founding of the Republic of China jointly organized a 100-bike Centenary Celebration Event. On that day, more than 120 Harley-Davidson motorcycles, with the full participation of Ren Hong, vice chairman of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council, detoured through many cities in Southern California. Many overseas Chinese leaders from Phoenix, Arizona attended the Harley flag-protecting event. Wang Wei (Wang Ting), member of the Standing Committee of the Arizona Provincial Branch of the Chinese Kuomintang, led many members to arrive in Los Angeles. They hung the national flag on their cars and rode with the Harley fleet to participate in this historic event. Accompanied by the roar of the Harley-Davidson engine, the convoy received applause from many people along the way. Seeing the flag of the Republic of China flying overseas, showing the country's majesty, this group of patriotic overseas Chinese leaders in Arizona were very excited. In order to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Republic of China, the organizer specially designed a Harley-Davidson commemorative shirt for the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Republic of China this year, with a large national flag, the logo of the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Republic of China and the four Chinese characters of the Republic of China, which are quite eye-catching. This large-scale event called for the participation of more than 120 Harley-Davidson heavy-duty motorcycles, and heavy metal music was played live, making this event to celebrate the centenary of the founding of the People's Republic of China particularly cool. Many knights arrived at the assembly site early and hung the national flag on the back of their cars early. Some knights used the national flag as a cloak, showing the free nature of Harley riders and using various imaginable ways to express their support for the Republic of China today. Including Ren Hong, vice chairman of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission of the Republic of China, Jian Xubang, director of the Los Angeles Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center, and Qiu Changsheng, deputy director, also arrived at the venue in advance to encourage the knights. Wang Wei (Wang Ting), member of the Standing Committee of the sub-provincial branch of the Chinese Kuomintang, led all members and Vice Chairman Ren Hong (fourth from right) to take a group photo in front of the Harley-Davidson motorcycle commemorating the centenary of the founding of the People's Republic of China This Harley-Davidson commemorative motorcycle, which features the national flag of the Republic of China and the 100th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, was designed by overseas Chinese businessman Cao Zhizhong. The design of the entire motorcycle is one-piece. Whether it is the national emblem or the symbol of the 100th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, the craftsmanship is amazing. It was unanimously praised by Vice Chairman Ren Hong and the people present. The Vice Chairman also specially took a group photo in front of the Centennial Commemorative Car with this group of overseas Chinese leaders from Alberta who came from afar to support the Centennial Celebration. In his speech in Chinese and English, Vice Chairman Ren Hong expressed his gratitude to the ardent and patriotic overseas Chinese present and to the knights of all ethnic groups who supported the Republic of China. After the official announcement of the appointment of the Vice Chairman, more than a hundred Harley-Davidsons started their engines and rumbled majesticly. Wu Chengyuan, president of the Taiwanese Association of Los Angeles, said that in order to ensure the safety of riders, multiple leading vehicles are hired for traffic control and security tasks. This is also the second year that the Taiwanese Association of Los Angeles has held a flag protection event. Many roads in the United States are wide, especially Southern California’s pleasant climate. In terms of objective conditions, It can be said that we are uniquely blessed to host this event. Watching Harley-Davidson motorcycles of various models galloping with the national flag of the Republic of China, and the Vice Chairman waving the national flag from time to time. Although the convoy of more than 120 Harley-Davidson vehicles stretches for a long time, they march in an orderly and consistent manner and abide by discipline, which fully demonstrates the Harley spirit. At the same time, I am also very grateful to the overseas Chinese leaders in Arizona for participating in this grand event and providing protection behind the Harley motorcycle team throughout the entire process. After traveling through more than a dozen cities and a distance of more than 40 miles, when they arrived at the terminal station of the Overseas Chinese Cultural and Educational Service Center in Los Angeles, they were warmly welcomed by overseas Chinese with national flags waving on site, including Director of the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Los Angeles Gong Zhongcheng, Director of the Overseas Chinese Center in Los Angeles Jian Xubang, Deputy Director Qiu Changsheng, President of the National Taiwan Federation Zheng Changxiang, Overseas Chinese Affairs Committee members Li Bingxin, Gao Qizheng, etc. were all on site to greet them. All Harley motorcycles crowded the parking lot of the Overseas Chinese Center in Los Angeles, and it was very lively. The knights collectively shouted the slogans "Long Live the Republic of China" and "Come on Taiwan!" and met again next year.

4124c88ed49e3999f6348035d77bfbe2afee8ed0.sourceText: 雷电惹火 两峡谷道路关闭 （亚省时报） 7月1日，通往科科尼诺国家森林公园的87号公路因森林野火再度封闭。 上周五，公园东北约15英里的蓝岭水库附近的森林被雷电击中，引起火灾，火焰覆盖超过5000英亩，火势一度烧到森林公园的马路对面，当局在周六紧急封闭87号公路，周日一度解封，基于浓烟对行车和人不利，当局很快又再封闭道路。 当局没有下令疏散该地居民。 87号公路是通往科科尼诺国家森林，萨当那和蒙特苏马堡国家纪念碑的必经之路，风景优美，是本州旅游最佳线路。 7月2日，萨福德西南约11英里的野火还在继续燃烧，大火已经烧焦了60英亩森林。 大火在弗莱峡谷和阿什河之间，消防局关闭了包括环山、弗莱峡谷、阿什河以及亡者等登山道路，森林道路307和阿什河附近的露营地也遭关闭，并建议有呼吸道疾病人士尽量避开此地。 萨福德野火在上周四因雷电引起，目前有140名消防员，四台发动机，四架直升机参与灭火。萨福德位于本州东南部。
4124c88ed49e3999f6348035d77bfbe2afee8ed0.translatedText: Thunder and lightning caused roads to close in two canyons (Alberta Times) On July 1, Highway 87 leading to Coconino National Forest Park was closed again due to wildfires. Last Friday, the forest near the Blue Ridge Reservoir, about 15 miles northeast of the park, was struck by lightning, causing a fire. The flames covered more than 5,000 acres. The fire once burned across the road in the Forest Park. The authorities urgently closed Highway 87 on Saturday and once unblocked it on Sunday. Because the thick smoke was detrimental to driving and people, the authorities quickly closed the road again. Authorities did not order an evacuation of residents. Highway 87 is the only way to the Coconino National Forest, Salada and Fort Montezuma National Monument. It has beautiful scenery and is the best tourist route in the state. On July 2, a wildfire about 11 miles southwest of Safford continued to burn, and the fire had scorched 60 acres of forest. The fire is between Frye Canyon and the Ashe River. The fire department has closed hiking roads including the Ring Mountain, Frye Canyon, Ashe River and Dead Man. Campgrounds near Forest Road 307 and the Ashe River have also been closed, and people with respiratory illnesses are advised to avoid this area. The Safford wildfire was caused by lightning last Thursday. Currently, 140 firefighters, four engines, and four helicopters are involved in fighting the fire. Safford is located in the southeastern part of the state.

bb8c8e7d6193da8a0b4acc380071133b14ee891c.sourceText: 永怀赤子心 琦君阿姨是爱护晚 辈、提携后进的文坛前辈，她八十几岁时，还耳聪目明皮肤白皙，声音像十八岁的小姑娘清脆甜美。我最喜欢听她说话，不只是听觉上的享受，更有与君一席谈胜读 十年书的感叹。虽然分住在美国的东西两岸，却常常和她煲电话粥，永远有说不完的话。她喜欢在电话里讲笑话给我听，而她的每个笑话都是有诗为证，好听得很。  「中国文字真是妙，我举个笑话的例子给你听。」她就说了「醉翁之意不在酒」的故事，又说了「画个圈儿替」的传说。「快写出来分享更多人。」我把这种感觉告 诉她，平常都是她鼓励我们多写，好「报上见」，自从她膝盖痛之后写得少，倒是我们每次和她打电话的时候，频频要她写下来，我们都是从小读她文章长大的。 每次她出一本新书都会特别寄赠给我一本，像她以前的散文那样充满了爱心，永远怀有赤子之情。旧文学根底好，随口吟出一首诗顺手一篇好文章，读来让人觉得世间多温情。她以真情写出的文章特别能感动人，用敦厚仁爱的心看待每件事，日子过得格外快乐。 而我更喜欢她文章里的豁达和幽默，〈忘掉了也好〉一文中的「要能修炼得忘掉，而不是记得，才能保持心境的澄明。」因为先生迷上计算机，她对计算机的观感是： 「计算机计算机，何必自寻烦恼。」说到牙齿的真假，她的笑语频频「老太太打哈欠，一望无涯（牙）」，「当年不知保养，如今是无齿之耻，是耻也」。 她更用四句有趣的顺口溜来保持好心情：「不气不气不要气，气坏身子没人替。你要生气我不气，我如生气中你计。」 琦君阿姨曾经对我说过她之所以有一颗爱心，最受大妈妈的感召，才对人性又充满希望。「对人要爱，不要恨，就会快乐。」是她常说的话。 而她的菩萨心肠是人 人称道的，记得有一次和文友坐在她纽泽西州家的客厅，她忙着招呼我们，到厨房倒饮料却半天没出来，原来是洗碗槽上有几个蚂蚁，只见她用一张纸在那儿耐心地 引导牠们出去，不想伤害一个小生命，「来来，从这儿走。」 那几只蚂蚁还真听话地走了。她事后说：「蚂蚁是无辜的，牠们也是兢兢业业地工作，不知道自己妨譺了我们人类，我们不一定要马上置牠们于死地。」她的爱心惠及小小生命令人感动。 琦君阿姨的记忆力特别好，父亲与好友相聚，她在一旁竟然记得他们吟诗作对的句子，而且一记七十年，父亲吟: [雪梅已是十分春，却笑晨翁诗未成]，她小小年纪能接口道：「高格孤芳难着墨，无如诗酒两忘情。」还包括前人的诗：「有梅无雪不精神，有雪无诗俗了人。日 暮诗成天又雪，与梅添作十分春。」她能改大人的诗，别人称她才女的时候，她又幽默地说是帮妈妈在厨房煮饭添柴的「柴女」。 永远保持愉快的心境，和许多年轻朋友成为忘年之交，我想是琦君阿姨的养生之道。她有一篇文章说的和老朋友是：「一回相见一回老」，我倒是觉得和她打电话， 觉得她：「一回谈话一回小」，天真漫澜。她总带着我回她乡间的童年，爱小动物爱小玩意的兴致没变，而她随时都快乐的心情是在享受二度童年，如今她走了，对它怀念特别多。
bb8c8e7d6193da8a0b4acc380071133b14ee891c.translatedText: Always have a pure heart Aunt Qijun is a literary senior who loves and supports the younger generation. A senior figure in the literary world who supports and supports the underachievers. When she was in her eighties, she was still as bright and fair as an eighteen-year-old girl. Her voice was as clear and sweet as that of an eighteen-year-old girl. What I like most is listening to her talk. Not only is it an auditory enjoyment, but I also feel that one conversation with you is worth ten years of reading. Although we live on both sides of the United States, we often talk on the phone with her, and we always have endless things to talk about. She likes to tell me jokes on the phone, and each of her jokes is backed by poetry, which is very good.  "Chinese characters are really wonderful. Let me give you an example of a joke." She told the story of "The drunkard's intention is not to drink" and the legend of "Drawing a Circle". "Write it quickly and share it with more people." I told her this feeling. She usually encourages us to write more so that we can "see you in the newspaper." But since she suffered from knee pain, she has written less. But every time we call her, we frequently ask her to write it down. We have all grown up reading her articles.  Every time she publishes a new book, she will send a special copy to me. It is as full of love as her previous prose, and she will always cherish the innocence. He has a good foundation in old literature, and he can recite a poem or a good article casually, which makes people feel how tender the world is. The articles she writes with true feelings are particularly touching. She looks at everything with a kind and honest heart, and her life is extremely happy. And I like the open-mindedness and humor in her articles even more. In the article "It's OK to Forget", "You must practice forgetting instead of remembering to maintain a clear mind." Because her husband is obsessed with computers, her perception of computers is: "Computer, computer, why bother yourself." When talking about the authenticity of teeth, she often laughed and said, "The old lady yawned, and her teeth were endless." She also used four interesting jingles to keep her in a good mood: "Don't be angry, don't be angry, there is no one to take care of you. If you are angry, I won't be angry. If I am angry, I will fall into your trap."  Aunt Qijun once told me that the reason why she has a loving heart is that she was most inspired by her eldest mother, and that is why she is full of hope for humanity. "Love people, don't hate them, and you will be happy." This is what she often says. Her bodhisattva heart is praised by everyone. I remember once sitting with a literary friend in the living room of her home in New Jersey. She was busy greeting us and went to the kitchen to pour drinks but didn't come out for a long time. It turned out that there were some ants on the sink. I saw her patiently guiding them out with a piece of paper, not wanting to hurt a little life. "Come on, let's go from here." Those ants really walked away obediently. She said afterwards: "Ants are innocent, and they work conscientiously. They don't know that they are harming us humans. We don't necessarily have to kill them immediately." Her love for benefiting small lives is touching.  Aunt Qijun’s memory is particularly good. When her father was gathering with his friends, she actually remembered the sentences they recited poems. She also remembered that seventy years ago, her father recited: [The plum blossoms in the snow are already very spring, but the poem about the smiling morning old man has not yet been completed]. At a young age, she was able to say: "It is difficult to write ink with high style and solitary beauty. It is better to forget love with poetry and wine." It also includes the poems of the predecessors: "With plums, there is no snow, but there is no spirit, and there is snow without poetry, which is vulgar." The poems at dusk are snowy all day long, and the poems written with plum blossoms are very spring." She can change the poems written by adults. When others call her a talented woman, she humorously calls her the "firewood girl" who helps her mother cook in the kitchen. Always maintain a happy mood and become lifelong friends with many young friends. I think this is Aunt Qijun’s way of maintaining good health. In one of her articles, she said that with old friends, "every time we meet, we grow old again." I actually feel that when I talk to her on the phone, she says, "every time we talk, we grow old again." It's so innocent. She always takes me back to her childhood in the countryside. Her interest in loving small animals and gadgets has not changed, and her happy mood at all times is that she is enjoying a second childhood. Now that she is gone, she misses it very much.

8da54c72d14eb097450776dcac9cc7d7e6fece6b.sourceText: 1984年，耆英会派方慧贤参加联邦政府举办的申请建筑老人公寓补助款的资讯大会。康宁大厦兴建计划开启。找到了现在康宁大厦的位置。一共五英亩，成交价为四十二万，如申请不成功，一万元订金作废，买卖合同取消。于是，耆英会马上设立“康宁支助团”，以$5,000为一股，收集了51股，共计有$255,000。
8da54c72d14eb097450776dcac9cc7d7e6fece6b.translatedText: In 1984, the Senior Citizens Association sent Fang Huixian to participate in an information conference held by the federal government to apply for subsidies for building apartments for the elderly. The construction plan of Corning Building begins. Found the current location of the Corning Building. There are five acres in total, and the transaction price is 420,000 yuan. If the application is unsuccessful, the 10,000 yuan deposit will be void and the sales contract will be cancelled. Therefore, the Senior Citizens Association immediately set up a "Corning Support Group" and collected 51 shares at $5,000 per share, totaling $255,000.

7242e1a5fe115341ef688e2b13c9d6d07a3c9d62.sourceText: 1985年， 获联邦政府批准，得到连土地二万元在内的约二百一十万元。康宁大厦于1987年7月25日奠基，至1988 年12月30日竣工，花费了五的时间。这是一桩巨资项目，每位领导人在讨论时的心情都是忑不安，但大事总算成功了。康宁大厦有两层43间单人房，15间工作坊共58个单位，可供六十岁以上或无年龄限制的残障人士居住。耆英会做了一件非常值得骄傲的事业。 “建楼委员会” 九位成员为康乐大厦破土动工
7242e1a5fe115341ef688e2b13c9d6d07a3c9d62.translatedText: In 1985, it was approved by the federal government and received about 2.1 million yuan including land of 20,000 yuan. The cornerstone of the Corning Building was laid on July 25, 1987, and it was completed on December 30, 1988, which took five years. This was a hugely expensive project, and every leader felt uneasy when discussing it, but it was a success. The Corning Building has 43 single rooms on two floors and 15 workshops, with a total of 58 units, which can accommodate people with disabilities over the age of 60 or without age restrictions. The Senior Citizens Association has done a very proud thing. Nine members of the "Building Committee" broke ground for the Connaught Building

1b982bf15cbb27dd34ce05593786f996e233088b.sourceText: 2007年6月，另外一座老人公寓 “康大乐厦” 兴建计划开启。华人耆英会协助主办单位，向联邦政府市区房屋发展部，申请建筑老人大厦的预算基金。一份一百多页的申请书总算没有浪费时间与精神。2009年，接到联邦政府通知，获得建筑款项$5,117.484的佳音，令人欢喜若狂。
1b982bf15cbb27dd34ce05593786f996e233088b.translatedText: In June 2007, the construction plan of another elderly apartment "Conn Lok Building" was launched. The Chinese Senior Citizens Association assisted the organizer in applying to the federal government’s Department of Urban Housing Development for budget funds for building a senior citizen building. An application of more than one hundred pages finally did not waste time and energy. In 2009, I received a notification from the federal government that $5,117.484 in construction funds had been received, which made me very happy.

9036b347fc820da741f66f6572d818a28558cb18.sourceText: 地皮款项是侨联总会的三万元，加台湾侨委会赠金七万元，一共十万元买来的。当时这些款项本来是为协助耆英会还清当年“康宁支助团”的借款，也是为了开办斐匿中文学校。耆英会把卖地得来的钱，还清了当年“康事支助团”的借款。
9036b347fc820da741f66f6572d818a28558cb18.translatedText: The land was purchased with 30,000 yuan from the Overseas Chinese Federation and a 70,000 yuan donation from the Taiwan Overseas Chinese Affairs Council, for a total of 100,000 yuan. At that time, these funds were originally used to help the Senior Citizens Association pay off the loan of the "Kang Ning Support Group" and to open the Feinian Chinese School. Qiyinghui used the money from selling the land to pay off the loan from the "Health Support Group" that year.

3ed78dc29435cca7f5f5d9695ed24b275b396fe5.sourceText: 经过三年多建设，康乐大厦于2011年1月落成，大厦共有三层，41间1房1厅的公寓，11间 储物室，还有办公室，公厕，洗衣房等。每间公寓有中式抽油烟机，有紧急报警设备，超大浴室，无线电视线路，私人空调。楼下大会客厅备有厨房，地板用无胶贴上防滑木材制造。二楼设有电脑室，三楼有麻将厅，全楼有4部大型电视，两部万首歌储卡拉机，还有饮水机器等等。
3ed78dc29435cca7f5f5d9695ed24b275b396fe5.translatedText: After more than three years of construction, the Kang Le Building was completed in January 2011. The building has three floors, 41 apartments with one bedroom and one living room, 11 storage rooms, offices, public toilets, laundry rooms, etc. Each apartment has a Chinese-style range hood, emergency alarm equipment, an oversized bathroom, wireless TV lines, and private air conditioning. The conference room downstairs is equipped with a kitchen, and the floor is made of glue-free and non-slip wood. There is a computer room on the second floor and a mahjong hall on the third floor. There are 4 large TVs in the whole building, two karaoke machines with 10,000 songs, and drinking machines.

91e9b76b2cc285f3ef100ab394ab1a37c6917d3f.sourceText: 康乐大厦拥有中式化的装潢，门前的房号，公厕的指示牌，都是特别设计。如沿走廊的特厚扶手与灯饰，地上沿牆的超高板块。 花园内的佳质瓦斯烧烤设备，都采用美观实用的材料。花园内有余文劲先生为纪念亡母余月明而捐建的“月明亭”。大厦会客厅门楣上悬挂著“余文裕厅”镜框，是余夫人为纪念亡夫文裕先生捐赠所建。二楼电脑室与三楼的娱乐室门楣上有”余文伟厅“及”余毓淋厅“的镜框，是余文伟夫人为纪念亡夫及家翁捐赠所建。
91e9b76b2cc285f3ef100ab394ab1a37c6917d3f.translatedText: Kangle Building has a Chinese-style decoration. The room number in front of the door and the signs of the public toilets are all specially designed. Such as the extra-thick handrails and lighting along the corridor, and the super-high panels on the floor and along the wall. High-quality gas barbecue equipment in the garden is made of beautiful and practical materials. In the garden, there is the "Yue Ming Pavilion" donated and built by Mr. Yu Wenjin in memory of his late mother Yu Yueming. The "Yue Wenyu Hall" frame hangs on the lintel of the reception room of the building, which was donated and built by Mrs. Yu in memory of her late husband, Mr. Wenyu. On the lintels of the computer room on the second floor and the entertainment room on the third floor are the frames of "Yu Wenwei Hall" and "Yu Yulin Hall", which were donated by Mrs. Yu Wenwei in memory of her late husband and family father.

a5d8eacb9ab59ba916c1d56ed3b4d2c9d87deb0a.sourceText: 会客厅门口对正的“造福乡梓”大型匾，是台湾侨务委会长吴英毅鼓励华侨的礼物。孙中山先生遗像是著名作家黄国熙(永泰)先生的绘画。祝贺耆老长春不老的云石桃花盘栽，是蔡念礼夫妇送给康乐的纪念品。康乐大厦大门的对联是书法家陈普先生的墨宝。四隻石狮子是杨桐骨科医师的大礼。
a5d8eacb9ab59ba916c1d56ed3b4d2c9d87deb0a.translatedText: >The large plaque "Benefiting Hometown" facing the entrance of the living room is a gift from Wu Yingyi, chairman of the Taiwan Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission, to encourage overseas Chinese. The portrait of Dr. Sun Yat-sen is a painting by the famous writer Mr. Huang Guoxi (Yongtai). The marble peach blossom plant was a souvenir given to Kang Le by Cai Nianli and his wife to congratulate the elderly on everlasting life. The couplets on the gate of Kangle Building are the calligraphy of Mr. Chen Pu, a calligrapher. The four stone lions are a gift from orthopedic surgeon Yang Tong.

671ebc7b98eea8e677b9d7aca7088ed3ec62fe06.sourceText: 这本书是方慧贤四十年亲身体验到的记载，文章是以简洁方式完成，总结了华人耆英会在过去四十年内的丰厚成果，而这些都是前辈为华人福利努力奋斗得到的果实，希望优秀的中华儿女传承传统孝顺美德，怀念和尊敬每一位前辈。
671ebc7b98eea8e677b9d7aca7088ed3ec62fe06.translatedText: This book is a record of Fang Huixian's personal experience over the past forty years. The article is written in a concise way, summarizing the fruitful achievements of the Chinese Senior Citizens Association in the past forty years. These are the fruits of the hard work of the predecessors for the welfare of the Chinese people. I hope that outstanding Chinese sons and daughters will inherit the traditional virtues of filial piety, miss and respect every predecessor.

9fc33dbda132ba74947f52e7e439f3ab9296c06a.sourceText: 书中衷心感谢每一位有过贡献的善长仁翁。华人耆英会的不动产，包括康宁大康、康乐大厦、耆英中心和停车场等等，在2018年时，其市值已在一千二百万以上。
9fc33dbda132ba74947f52e7e439f3ab9296c06a.translatedText: The book sincerely thanks every benevolent person who has made contributions. The real estate of the Chinese Senior Citizens Association, including Corning Dakang, Connaught Building, Senior Citizens Center and parking lots, etc., had a market value of more than 12 million in 2018.

e6abb8b02f42a202c18107915ae958a5e084fe47.sourceText: 在建设和扩建华人耆英会馆和兴建康宁大厦中，方慧贤虽然并不在最高的领导层，但她却是一位忠实执行者和最有力的支持者。在方方面面为华人争取到实在的利益。
e6abb8b02f42a202c18107915ae958a5e084fe47.translatedText: In the construction and expansion of the Chinese Senior Citizens Association and the construction of Kangning Building, although Fang Huixian was not at the highest leadership level, she was a loyal executor and the most powerful supporter. Strive for real benefits for the Chinese in all aspects.

5c9d0603b21033ba3af32342ab5588211039a6d2.sourceText: 方慧贤作为建楼委员会的耆英会代表，为康乐大厦增加了不少中国特色的元素，入住的华人耆英在相同的文化氛围下生活愉快。
5c9d0603b21033ba3af32342ab5588211039a6d2.translatedText: As the representative of the Senior Citizens Association on the building committee, Fang Huixian added many elements with Chinese characteristics to the Connaught Building. The Chinese senior citizens who moved in lived happily in the same cultural atmosphere.

2c7cf0086d71cb58955152e1f00d002dc265fd9e.sourceText: 1988年，方慧贤侨出任侨联主席，并前后担任过6届侨联主席，对华人社区有过不少的贡献。
2c7cf0086d71cb58955152e1f00d002dc265fd9e.translatedText: In 1988, Fang Huixian, an overseas Chinese, became the chairman of the Federation of Overseas Chinese and served as the chairman of the Federation of Overseas Chinese for six terms, making many contributions to the Chinese community.

98e896eecf2595cd30c4b6e1a31c5ebab5a3beb3.sourceText: 美就业回春 至少等十年 尽管美国经济看似已经从谷底爬升，但根据一项统计显示，美国主要城市要回到两年前的就业水平，至少得等到2021年。 纽约时报报导，20日公布的调查显示，全美有将近50个主要城市，也就是超过七分之一的中大型城市，过去两年因为经济衰退造成大量就业机会流失，要想回到两年前的水平，至少得再等十年。 这份20日公布的「全美市长会议」(USConference of Mayors)报告，是由「环球透视」(IHS Global Insight)撰写，针对全美363个主要都会进行劳动力调查研究。这363个城市占全美就业人口的86%。 根据报告，在2011年末尾前，全美70个大都会地区的失业率，将困于十位数的高点。根据报告，这363个城市受到经济衰退影响，流失的就业机会总数达730万个。要回到就业巅峰时期，也就是2008年第1季的1亿1830万个就业机会，至少得等到2014年上半年。 其中六个失业率最高的城市均在加州，分别为：史托克顿(Stockton)、莫德斯度(Modesto)、佛瑞斯诺(Fresno)、贝兢克斯菲(Bakersfield)、河滨(Riverside)和加州首府沙加缅度(Sacramento)。 高失业率城市数量第二名的州是佛罗里达州，包括五座城市：麦耶堡(Fort Myers)、湖地(Lakeland)、迈阿密(Miami)、墨尔本(Melbourne) 和坦帕-圣彼得堡市(Tampa-St. Petersburg)。 更糟的是，报导指出位于工业区的五个大都市?#24213;特律、克里夫兰、德顿(Dayton)、托雷多(Toledo)和俄州青年镇(Youngstown)，就业情况恐怕在2021年前均无法恢复。 该报告预测，到今年末尾全美失业率将降至8.6%，但至少再另两年之内，失业率不会落至8%以下。依照另一份IHSGlobalInsights的报告，美国69个大都市的失业率，直到2012年末，均将为持在10%以上。
98e896eecf2595cd30c4b6e1a31c5ebab5a3beb3.translatedText: U.S. jobs have to wait for at least ten years to come back. Although the U.S. economy seems to have climbed from the bottom, according to one statistic, it will take at least 2021 for major U.S. cities to return to the employment levels of two years ago. The New York Times reported that a survey released on the 20th showed that nearly 50 major cities in the United States, which is more than one-seventh of medium and large cities, have lost a large number of job opportunities due to the economic recession in the past two years. It will take at least another ten years to return to the level of two years ago. The "USConference of Mayors" report released on the 20th was written by "Global Insight" (IHS Global Insight) and conducted labor force survey research on 363 major cities in the United States. These 363 cities account for 86% of the US employment population. According to the report, before the end of 2011, the unemployment rate in 70 metropolitan areas across the United States will be stuck in the high teens. According to the report, these 363 cities were affected by the economic recession, and a total of 7.3 million job opportunities were lost. To return to the peak of employment, which was 118.3 million jobs in the first quarter of 2008, we have to wait until at least the first half of 2014. Six of the cities with the highest unemployment rates are all in California: Stockton, Modesto, Fresno, Bakersfield, Riverside and Sacramento, the capital of California. The second-highest number of cities with high unemployment rates is Florida, which includes five cities: Fort Myers, Lakeland, Miami, Melbourne and Tampa-St. Petersburg. To make matters worse, reports indicate that the employment situation in five large cities located in industrial areas - Detroit, Cleveland, Dayton, Toledo and Youngstown, Ohio - may not recover before 2021. The report predicts that the U.S. unemployment rate will fall to 8.6% by the end of this year, but will not fall below 8% for at least another two years. According to another IHS Global Insights report, the unemployment rate in 69 metropolitan areas in the United States will remain above 10% until the end of 2012.

79569a9c4c94c210d4aa22c79b31e787400844c3.sourceText: 过去，跨州就读大学的学生须付出比在本州念书更高昂的学费，让许多负担不起的学生与家长一听到外州大学就打退堂鼓，但金融危机后情势逆转，现在不少外州大学的 学费甚至比本州还便宜。 「美国新闻与世界报导」杂志指出，不少著名公立大学在金融危机后，面临本州政府预算删减，但申请就读者却有增无减下，大胆调高学费，让本州学生所需付出的 学费节节攀升。 过去，不少就读公立大学的本州生付出的学费不到1万5000元，这其中还包括通勤费用。 但金融危机后，许多在加州、宾州和伊利诺州的公立大学纷纷调涨学费，造成本州生学杂费超过2万元的状况。 看准这点，不少大学纷纷减免或取消跨州就读附加费用，以招揽优秀学生，甚至有些位于较偏远地区的学校还把提供优惠给成绩次等的学生，就担心收不到学生。 其中，许多学校对本州生或外州生皆收取同样学费，例如东俄勒冈州大学(Eastern Oregon University)，包括通勤费与书本费用在内，不超过1万8000元。 此外，有些学校只要学生在该校居住超过半年，就能申请适用本州学生缴费，像是南伊利诺大学(South Illinois University)、和北密西根大学(Northern Michigan University)等皆有此种优惠 。 有些学校对成绩中上的学生也免除跨州就读附加费用，像路易斯安纳大学(The University of Louisiana)就对ACT考试有23分(或SAT1060分)与总体成绩GDP至少2.5的学生提供优惠，在 该州就读一年花费仅需1万2000元。
79569a9c4c94c210d4aa22c79b31e787400844c3.translatedText: In the past, students who studied in out-of-state universities had to pay higher tuition than those who studied in-state. Many students and parents who could not afford it were discouraged when they heard about out-of-state universities. However, the situation reversed after the financial crisis. Now many out-of-state universities have tuition fees that are even cheaper than in-state universities. "U.S. News & World Report" magazine pointed out that many well-known public universities faced state government budget cuts after the financial crisis, but the number of applicants for admission continued to increase, and they boldly raised tuition fees, causing the tuition fees required by state students to continue to rise. In the past, many local students attending public universities paid less than $15,000 in tuition, including commuting costs. However, after the financial crisis, many public universities in California, Pennsylvania and Illinois have raised tuition fees, causing tuition and fees for in-state students to exceed 20,000 yuan. In view of this, many universities have reduced or canceled the additional fees for interstate study in order to attract outstanding students. Some schools in more remote areas even provide discounts to students with lower grades because they are worried that they will not be able to recruit students. Among them, many schools charge the same tuition for in-state and out-of-state students. For example, Eastern Oregon University charges no more than 18,000 yuan, including commuting fees and book fees. In addition, some schools can apply for in-state student fees as long as students live there for more than half a year, such as Southern Illinois University and Northern Michigan University, etc. all have such discounts. Some schools also waive additional fees for interstate study for students with average or above-average grades. The University of Louisiana, for example, offers discounts to students with an ACT score of 23 (or SAT score of 1060) and an overall GDP score of at least 2.5. The cost of studying in the state for one year is only 12,000 yuan.

309eaa1670bff74ba2756b6f1a002474f8e2798a.sourceText: 妊娠早期接种流感疫苗没有风险 妊娠早期接种流感疫苗没有风险 一项新的研究发现，给孕妇接种流感疫苗与胎儿发生严重的生理缺陷无关。 据Reuters Health报道，这项研究包括了近9000名接受过流感疫苗接种的孕妇。结果发现，这些孕妇中大约有2%的人生下了有严重缺陷的宝宝。 这些严重的缺陷包括心脏畸形或唇裂。这一比例与几乎7万7000名在妊娠时没有接种该疫苗的孕妇所产畸形婴儿的比例相同。 此外，研究人员还发现，接种该疫苗的孕妇发生胎儿死产的机会要比没有接种疫苗者低：0.3% vs. 0.6%。而且，接种疫苗的孕妇产下的新生儿的死亡率也较低：0.2% vs. 0.4%。但人们不清楚，这些较低的死产率和新生儿死亡率是否与接种疫苗有关。 但这项研究的主要研究者谢菲尔德医生说，有可能该疫苗防止了严重流感病例的出现。谢菲尔德是达拉斯德州大学西南医学中心的妇产科教授。 她说，我们是否能够肯定这是疫苗带来的好处？No。但她补充说，这些发现至少表明，该疫苗是安全的，它可能还有抵御死产的裨益。 谢菲尔德及其同事在《妇产科学》杂志上报告了他们的发现。联邦疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）和其它团体建议所有的孕妇都应该接种季节性流感疫苗。这是因为孕妇会比同龄但没有怀孕的女性更容易罹患严重的流感或出现诸如肺炎等并发症。
309eaa1670bff74ba2756b6f1a002474f8e2798a.translatedText: There is no risk to getting the flu vaccine in early pregnancy There are no risks to getting the flu vaccine in early pregnancy A new study finds that giving the flu vaccine to pregnant women is not associated with serious physical defects in the fetus. According to Reuters Health, the study included nearly 9,000 pregnant women who had received influenza vaccinations. It was found that about 2% of these pregnant women gave birth to babies with serious defects. These serious defects include heart malformations or cleft lip. That's the same rate as the nearly 77,000 babies with malformations who were not vaccinated during pregnancy. In addition, the researchers found that pregnant women who received the vaccine had a lower chance of stillbirth than those who did not receive the vaccine: 0.3% vs. 0.6%. Furthermore, newborns born to pregnant women who received the vaccine had a lower mortality rate: 0.2% vs. 0.4%. But it's unclear whether these lower stillbirth and neonatal mortality rates are related to vaccination. But Dr. Sheffield, the study's lead researcher, said it was possible the vaccine prevented severe cases of the flu. Sheffield is a professor of obstetrics and gynecology at UT Southwestern Medical Center in Dallas. Can we be certain, she said, that this is a benefit of the vaccine? No. But she added that the findings at least suggest the vaccine is safe and may also be beneficial in protecting against stillbirths. Sheffield and colleagues report their findings in the journal Obstetrics and Gynecology. The federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and other groups recommend that all pregnant women get the seasonal flu vaccine. This is because pregnant women are more likely to get a severe case of the flu or develop complications such as pneumonia than women of the same age who are not pregnant.

0d2bd1cbbb9bfcd89a5111892a8683459bae1e70.sourceText: 坠崖危机解除 协议细节 《亚省时报》 自动增税6000亿美元与减支机制启动大限前数小时，参议院于12月31日晚达成协议，以避免所谓的”财政悬崖”。 总统奥巴马警告，这项临时协议仍有”待解决的问题”，且协议仍需要参院和由共和党主导的众院批准通过。 以下是协议细节：长期失业福利将延长一年；国防和内政计画削减支出1110亿元，则延后两个月执行，以继续进行更广泛的减支谈判。 根据参院的协议，年收入为40 万元以上的个人，和年收入为45万元以上的家庭，所得税率将提高为39.6%；收入为25万元以上的个人，和收入为30万元 以上的家庭，其列举扣除额将设上限，个人免税额也将逐渐废除，这是主张对富人增税的奥巴马的明显胜利。 协议中也包括让社安薪资税从4.2%恢复到原来的6.2%；遗产税最高税率则从35%，提高为40%，个人遗产免税额为500万元，家庭遗产免税额为1000万元 ；资本利得和股息超过40万元的个人和超过45万元的家庭，税率从15%提高为20%；永久按通货膨胀调整另计最低税的征收，以防止近3000万中上收入的纳税 人缴付此税；把儿童抵税、工作所得抵税和大学学费最高2500元抵税延长五年等；研发免税额、风力发电免税额延长至2013年底。 50%红利折旧延长1年；把对联邦医疗保险医生(Medicare)的给付削减27%，延缓执行一年。
0d2bd1cbbb9bfcd89a5111892a8683459bae1e70.translatedText: Cliff crisis lifted Agreement details "Alberta Times" Hours before the deadline for automatic tax increases of $600 billion and the start of the spending cuts mechanism, the Senate reached an agreement on the evening of December 31 to avoid the so-called "fiscal cliff." President Obama warned that there were still "issues to be resolved" on the tentative deal, which still needs to be approved by the Senate and the Republican-dominated House of Representatives. Here are the details of the agreement: long-term unemployment benefits will be extended for one year; the defense and interior spending cuts of 111 billion yuan will be postponed for two months to continue negotiations on broader spending reductions. According to the Senate agreement, the income tax rate will be increased to 39.6% for individuals with an annual income of more than 400,000 yuan, and for families with an annual income of more than 450,000 yuan; for individuals with an annual income of more than 250,000 yuan, and for families with an annual income of more than 300,000 yuan, their itemized deductions will be capped, and personal tax exemptions will also be gradually abolished. This is a clear victory for Obama, who advocates increasing taxes on the rich. The agreement also includes restoring the Social Security payroll tax from 4.2% to the original 6.2%; raising the top estate tax rate from 35% to 40%; the personal estate tax exemption is 5 million yuan, and the family inheritance tax exemption is 10 million yuan. ; The tax rate for individuals with capital gains and dividends exceeding 400,000 yuan and families exceeding 450,000 yuan will be increased from 15% to 20%; the additional minimum tax will be permanently adjusted for inflation to prevent nearly 30 million middle- and upper-income taxpayers from paying this tax; the child tax credit, the earned income tax credit and the college tuition tax credit of up to 2,500 yuan will be extended for five years; the research and development tax exemption and the wind power generation tax exemption will be extended to the end of 2013. The 50% bonus depreciation will be extended for one year; the payment to Medicare doctors will be reduced by 27% and implemented for one year.

5915c9386dd7e0365b8040f88584e27e734f2d77.sourceText: 马利科巴郡社区大学全面禁烟 （亚省时报） 明年起，马利科巴郡社区学院系统将禁止所有烟草产品，以帮助提高学生和工作人员的健康和保持校园清洁。 按原规定，校园内所有建筑物内严禁吸烟，但学院有指定的吸烟区。截止至7月1日，任何烟草产品不能出现在10个校区，包括分校和两个技能训练中心，坦佩的学院总办公室。 在本州，四分之一的年龄在18至24岁为吸烟者，比该年龄组的全国平均水平高。2006年，本州选民通过全州公共场所禁烟，亚利桑那州无烟法案2007年正式生效。 马利科巴郡10家社区学院约有14万2名学生，8800名全职、兼职教师和工作人员。郡社区学院委员会希望此举能激励吸烟者戒除烟瘾，也能减少二手烟的传播。
5915c9386dd7e0365b8040f88584e27e734f2d77.translatedText: > Maricopa County Community College has completely banned smoking (Alberta Times) Starting next year, the Maricopa County Community College System will ban all tobacco products to help improve the health of students and staff and keep campuses clean. According to the original regulations, smoking was strictly prohibited in all buildings on campus, but the college had designated smoking areas. As of July 1, no tobacco products can be found on 10 campuses, including branch campuses and two skills training centers, and the college's main office in Tempe. In the state, one in four people aged 18 to 24 are smokers, which is higher than the national average for this age group. In 2006, state voters approved a statewide ban on smoking in public places, and the Arizona Smoke-Free Act officially took effect in 2007. Maricopa County's 10 community colleges have approximately 142,000 students and 8,800 full-time and part-time teachers and staff. The county community college board hopes the move will inspire smokers to kick the habit and reduce the spread of secondhand smoke.

c5571bbeb8b48ae21f89707f5e14207d2654463e.sourceText: 俄罗斯食肉毒品“鳄鱼”入侵美国 亚利桑那惊现两起 亚利桑那州传出，有2起吸毒者因为吸食自制廉价海洛因”Krokodil”(音同’鳄鱼’)后，发生皮肉由体内开始向外腐烂的桉例。美国政府正高度重视这2起案例，并全力防堵其他毒瘾者使用。图为第一名发现吸食者全身伤口溃烂样子，让人惊恐。 这种由吸毒者自己调和而成的鸡尾酒式毒品’鳄鱼’，一年多前曾在俄罗斯短暂流行，由于效果强大，但副作用极为恐怖，被人体吸收后肌肉会从体内开始向外腐烂，直到露出骨骼，持续使用者还会导致体内血管爆开，皮肤会变得像是鳄鱼皮一般长满坏疽，俄国早已强力禁止，但仍流传进美国。’鳄鱼’是将可待因(Codeine)加入汽油，经由过滤后注入人体。
c5571bbeb8b48ae21f89707f5e14207d2654463e.translatedText: The Russian carnivorous drug "Alligator" has invaded the United States, and two cases have been reported in Arizona. It was reported in Arizona that there were two cases of drug addicts whose skin and flesh began to rot from the inside out after taking the homemade cheap heroin "Krokodil" (pronounced the same as "crocodile"). The U.S. government is attaching great importance to these two cases and is making every effort to prevent other drug addicts from using it. The picture shows the horrifying appearance of the first person who found wounds all over the body of the addict. This cocktail-style drug called Crocodile, which was mixed by drug users themselves, was briefly popular in Russia more than a year ago. Due to its powerful effects, the side effects are extremely scary. After being absorbed by the human body, the muscles will begin to rot outwards from the body until the bones are exposed. Continued use will also cause blood vessels in the body to burst, and the skin will become like crocodile skin and covered with gangrene. Russia has long banned it, but it is still spread to the United States. ‘Crocodile’ is made by adding codeine to gasoline, filtering it and then injecting it into the human body.

f0793b6fae03b9758bc9c2d36221a94f7f5a185a.sourceText: 前一阵有个段子说，过完了国庆，就意味着过完了2017所有的法定假日厖不过不要心塞，一个月后，还有一个节日等着你，那就是”双11”！然而今年的”剁手”来得可能没有以往那么惬意了，因为最近两家快递巨头都宣布涨价！
f0793b6fae03b9758bc9c2d36221a94f7f5a185a.translatedText: There was a joke a while ago that after celebrating the National Day, it means that all the statutory holidays in 2017 have been celebrated. But don’t worry, one month later, there will be another festival waiting for you, that is "Double 11"! However, this year’s shopping may not be as pleasant as before, because recently both express delivery giants announced price increases!

3bc6c2f9221dd48f18aedbaeac2f19fe8add2891.sourceText: 10月10日，中通表示，因受运输、人工、原材料成本增加等原因影响，即日起对快递价格进行上调。10月11日，韵达也发布公告称，将上调快递价格。
3bc6c2f9221dd48f18aedbaeac2f19fe8add2891.translatedText: On October 10, ZTO stated that due to factors such as increased transportation, labor, and raw material costs, it would increase express delivery prices with immediate effect. On October 11, Yunda also announced that it would increase express delivery prices.

4250783b001536df1bb488b6ad2fba4b1749c15e.sourceText: 说起如今让全国人民”喜闻乐见”的快递，就不得不提一个人。她就是和丈夫白手起家，创办申通快递，人称快递女王的陈小英↓↓
4250783b001536df1bb488b6ad2fba4b1749c15e.translatedText: Speaking of express delivery that is now "loved" by people across the country, one person must be mentioned. She started from scratch with her husband and founded STO Express. She is known as the queen of express delivery, Chen Xiaoying↓↓

2e06a4b121567a03a3935ce2d30758894d074084.sourceText: 之前有人爆料过，占据国内快递市场半壁江山的”三通一达”都和这位陈小英有关↓↓
2e06a4b121567a03a3935ce2d30758894d074084.translatedText: Some people have revealed before that the "three links and one connection" that account for half of the domestic express delivery market are all related to this Chen Xiaoying↓↓

ec571231ecf2f61d2624ce98c274a292715b99b3.sourceText: 看出陈小英的厉害了吧！那为啥所有的快递公司都和她有关？她怎么就成了中国快递的”中心人物”呢？
ec571231ecf2f61d2624ce98c274a292715b99b3.translatedText: You can see how powerful Chen Xiaoying is! Then why are all the courier companies related to her? How did she become the "central figure" of China Express?

90772def25df6f02edf5eb249bc8413b8acc6393.sourceText: 其实，成为快递”霸道总裁”以前， 陈小英经历过一段贫寒的岁月。
90772def25df6f02edf5eb249bc8413b8acc6393.translatedText: In fact, before becoming the "overbearing president" of express delivery, Chen Xiaoying experienced a period of poverty.

3063edf27ceba4839e8324eef87ec16af56cb4b1.sourceText: 陈小英出生在”快递之乡”浙江桐庐县，《富春山居图》画的正是这里的景色。
3063edf27ceba4839e8324eef87ec16af56cb4b1.translatedText: Chen Xiaoying was born in Tonglu County, Zhejiang Province, the "hometown of express delivery". It is the scenery here that is painted in "Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains".

3c0ae46737c46c0725089cc088c23238d94cb00c.sourceText: 父亲在她很小的时候生病离世，留下她和妈妈、哥哥相依为命。
3c0ae46737c46c0725089cc088c23238d94cb00c.translatedText: Her father fell ill and passed away when she was very young, leaving her with her mother and brother to depend on each other.

db213c51231e7009a06b3b7ba806f7383dc9cd21.sourceText: 一家人每日往返于田地、猪圈、茶园，往往劳碌了一年，收入只有几百块。陈小英的哥哥陈德军初中毕业就去学木匠，每月30元的工资全用来贴补家用。
db213c51231e7009a06b3b7ba806f7383dc9cd21.translatedText: The family travels to and from fields, pig pens, and tea gardens every day. They often work hard for a year and earn only a few hundred yuan. Chen Xiaoying's brother Chen Dejun studied carpentry after graduating from junior high school, and his monthly salary of 30 yuan was used to supplement the family's income.

6edcb8df73c3d1aca049c3f450b696c1f4183991.translatedText: >Brothers and sisters Chen Dejun and Chen Xiaoying

845e697eeba191c1e10efad67f4a859498bedc05.sourceText: 陈小英也是十几岁就外出打工，在杭州的一家印染厂做工人，并在那里认识了丈夫聂腾飞。
845e697eeba191c1e10efad67f4a859498bedc05.translatedText: Chen Xiaoying also went out to work as a teenager in a printing and dyeing factory in Hangzhou, where she met her husband Nie Tengfei.

97f835b2bc26e72bd85638dc3770a171b6e12d2f.sourceText: 因为桐庐人特别能吃苦，许多桐庐人做起了别人不愿意做的快递生意。当时杭州进出口贸易火得不得了，往来沪杭间的外贸公司遇到了一个难题棗”报关单必须次日抵达港口，但走EMS需要三天”。
97f835b2bc26e72bd85638dc3770a171b6e12d2f.translatedText: Because Tonglu people are particularly hard-working, many Tonglu people have started express delivery businesses that others are unwilling to do. At that time, Hangzhou's import and export trade was booming, and foreign trade companies traveling between Shanghai and Hangzhou encountered a problem: "Customs declaration forms must arrive at the port the next day, but it takes three days to go through EMS."

3ce1c7f76c27c9fc85a0c86edf17fee5cd75aa61.sourceText: 聂腾飞和好友詹际盛发现，帮这些老板送报关单也许是个不错的活：一个人每天凌晨坐火车从杭州去上海，另一个人在火车站接到货后送往市区，一单100元，扣除来回的车费，一单最少能赚70元厖
3ce1c7f76c27c9fc85a0c86edf17fee5cd75aa61.translatedText: Nie Tengfei and his friend Zhan Jisheng discovered that it might be a good job to help these bosses deliver customs declaration forms: one person takes the train from Hangzhou to Shanghai every early morning, and the other person receives the goods at the train station and sends them to the city for 100 yuan per order. After deducting the round-trip fare, you can earn at least 70 yuan from one order

db9bbf28f93b7df2286f23b66628eb1cd4758e30.sourceText: 1993年，聂腾飞开办了一家私人快递公司盛彤公司，这就是申通的前身。当时，申通的办公室在杭州市湖墅北路的一间破屋子里，全公司只有一副桌椅，一个沙发，六七个人。
db9bbf28f93b7df2286f23b66628eb1cd4758e30.translatedText: In 1993, Nie Tengfei opened a private express delivery company, Shengtong Company, which was the predecessor of STO. At that time, STO's office was in a shabby room on Hushu North Road, Hangzhou. The company only had one desk, chair, one sofa, and six or seven people.

24c4b6c16eac35099ad860e2591b0d6c9e70bc93.sourceText: 公司成立不久，陈小英加入进来，负责接电话发展业务。那时候，陈小英每天工作十六七个小时，经常累得倒下就睡，可她不觉得苦，”那个时候生活得非常充实，觉得未来的发展很有希望”。
24c4b6c16eac35099ad860e2591b0d6c9e70bc93.translatedText: Not long after the company was established, Chen Xiaoying joined and was responsible for answering phone calls and developing business. At that time, Chen Xiaoying worked sixteen or seventeen hours a day and was often so tired that she fell asleep, but she did not feel bitter. "My life was very fulfilling at that time, and I felt that my future development was very promising."

c72dee2403e3682b448f786c2547cf4c91b9c94f.sourceText: 一年下来，公司赚了2万元，这是他们的”第一桶金”。
c72dee2403e3682b448f786c2547cf4c91b9c94f.translatedText: After one year, the company earned 20,000 yuan, which was their "first pot of gold."

3a5c76d0bad07d3239171475f838a9861ae14e07.sourceText: 随着快递业务量扩大，聂腾飞又发动弟弟聂腾云（韵达快递创始人）、陈小英的哥哥陈德军等亲朋好友都加入进来。
3a5c76d0bad07d3239171475f838a9861ae14e07.translatedText: As the volume of express delivery business expanded, Nie Tengfei mobilized his younger brother Nie Tengyun (the founder of Yunda Express), Chen Xiaoying's brother Chen Dejun and other relatives and friends to join in.

213d3f93e342d5e59501495c7f3953b29a55f3be.sourceText: 为了熟悉送货地形，一群人翻破了无数张地图，吃尽了苦头，把江浙沪的每条大街小巷走了个遍。
213d3f93e342d5e59501495c7f3953b29a55f3be.translatedText: In order to familiarize themselves with the delivery terrain, a group of people dug through countless maps and went through all kinds of hardships, visiting every street and alley in Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Shanghai.

3bbda303b45b36b0ec9cc80dc8a0c02b40945706.sourceText: 几年后，公司规模不断壮大。可就在这时，聂腾飞在出差途中遭遇车祸离世，公司一片混乱，还没从悲痛中走出来的陈小英不得不接手申通快递。
3bbda303b45b36b0ec9cc80dc8a0c02b40945706.translatedText: A few years later, the company has continued to grow in size. But at this moment, Nie Tengfei died in a car accident while on a business trip. The company was in chaos. Chen Xiaoying, who had not yet recovered from her grief, had to take over STO Express.

0651c0473f51dc3878352bc5307301c36dca5b7b.sourceText: 也是从那时起，曾经的合伙人先后离开申通，另起炉灶。
0651c0473f51dc3878352bc5307301c36dca5b7b.translatedText: Since then, the former partners have left STO one after another to start new businesses.

0ff6eed58536843beb5c5a614812b4c3b65b8e8b.sourceText: 1999年，聂腾云离开申通，成立了韵达快递。
0ff6eed58536843beb5c5a614812b4c3b65b8e8b.translatedText: In 1999, Nie Tengyun left STO and established Yunda Express.

ca94c0f5de1f1697b35bed15a5922d7a5859d9be.sourceText: 2000年，陈德军的初中同学、曾任申通财务的张小娟与丈夫创办了圆通速递。
ca94c0f5de1f1697b35bed15a5922d7a5859d9be.translatedText: In 2000, Zhang Xiaojuan, Chen Dejun's junior high school classmate and former STO financial officer, founded YTO Express with her husband.

8b171c295e9060d21d4fd2289ef52e6076700c71.sourceText: 2002年，原任申通快递分公司经理的桑学兵与陈德军的朋友赖梅松成立了中通快递。
8b171c295e9060d21d4fd2289ef52e6076700c71.translatedText: In 2002, Sang Xuebing, the former branch manager of STO Express, and Lai Meisong, a friend of Chen Dejun, established ZTO Express.

cc4b8bdc0f6df687641fb405d887c9a39821fd21.sourceText: 2003年5月，汇通快运成立，两年后被桐庐商人徐建荣收购，又在2010年被百世网络收购，成为百世汇通。
cc4b8bdc0f6df687641fb405d887c9a39821fd21.translatedText: In May 2003, Huitong Express was established. Two years later, it was acquired by Tonglu businessman Xu Jianrong. In 2010, it was acquired by Best Network and became Best Huitong.

9865599c75f26b258f5250cd68b567da49833259.sourceText: 逐渐地，桐庐县成了快递之乡。除了王卫的顺丰快递，和陈平创立的宅急送，几个来自桐庐的年轻人完全颠覆了中国的物流业。
9865599c75f26b258f5250cd68b567da49833259.translatedText: Gradually, Tonglu County became the hometown of express delivery. In addition to Wang Wei’s SF Express and Chen Ping’s Home Delivery, a few young people from Tonglu have completely subverted China’s logistics industry.

6a5b11810e0ecdc00e6fc0832e814792e139856d.sourceText: 有媒体曾在2015年做过统计，全国由桐庐籍民营企业家创办和管理的快递企业已达2500余家，占据全国快递行业将近60%的市场份额。”我们村里小孩子生下来就会做快递，看都看会了，听也听会了。”中国快递业几乎被桐庐人”承包”了。
6a5b11810e0ecdc00e6fc0832e814792e139856d.translatedText: Some media made statistics in 2015, showing that there are more than 2,500 express delivery companies founded and managed by private entrepreneurs from Tonglu in the country, accounting for nearly 60% of the national express delivery industry's market share. "Children in our village know how to do express delivery when they are born. They can see and listen well." China's express delivery industry is almost "contracted" by Tonglu people.

41c36d3edd2545eee4f51af09ec6b6d0727475b5.sourceText: 很快，干快递的老乡之间也开始了赛跑。
41c36d3edd2545eee4f51af09ec6b6d0727475b5.translatedText: Soon, the race began among fellow couriers.

4e2e6faabf92d4894c1eb9b30960dbb0c8ae86d5.sourceText: 申通的发展”武器”是加盟制，加盟制的特点是网点除了向总部缴纳保证金等费用，从上到下自负盈亏，自己做”老板”。
4e2e6faabf92d4894c1eb9b30960dbb0c8ae86d5.translatedText: STO's development "weapon" is the franchise system. The characteristic of the franchise system is that in addition to paying deposits and other fees to the headquarters, outlets are responsible for their own profits and losses from top to bottom and become their own "boss".

0e227be4a21ee702f66692fedd04dd6f27dc7d30.sourceText: 有人总结了加盟制的优势，”忙的时候，加盟商加钱，快递员就能带动全家一起送货。加盟网络机制灵活，有发动群众的爆发力。”
0e227be4a21ee702f66692fedd04dd6f27dc7d30.translatedText: Someone summarized the advantages of the franchise system, "When the franchisee adds money, the courier can lead the whole family to deliver goods together. The franchise network mechanism is flexible and has the explosive power to mobilize the masses."

69921c0ead0346eeebefc27380ccfd210594867e.sourceText: 凭借着加盟制，申通迅速铺开网点。而韵达、圆通、中通也完全复制了申通的模式。
69921c0ead0346eeebefc27380ccfd210594867e.translatedText: With the franchise system, STO quickly expanded its outlets. Yunda, Yuantong, and Zhongtong also completely copied STO's model.

f5ad4f307c5c241c22646914c1fe8a789bc100fc.sourceText: 虽然”三通一达”同为”桐庐帮”，但他们之间的合作却不多。韵达一位元老级高管曾说，”走出大山以后，他们相互之间是不沟通的，自己做自己的生意”。
f5ad4f307c5c241c22646914c1fe8a789bc100fc.translatedText: Although the "three links and one reach" are both from the "Tonglu Gang", there is not much cooperation between them. A senior executive of Yunda once said, "After leaving the mountains, they do not communicate with each other and do their own business."

c71663846dba9e0395fdaee0d7b63ba2a756c72b.sourceText: 利益的竞争让这些昔日的老乡也难免形同陌路，行业的割据态势也因此逐渐形成，但申通依然是行业中的佼佼者。
c71663846dba9e0395fdaee0d7b63ba2a756c72b.translatedText: The competition for interests has inevitably made these former fellow villagers feel like strangers, and the industry has gradually become fragmented. However, STO is still the leader in the industry.

95e3a9aa18580f9e7c29cc35b05f3e516c9172c5.sourceText: 十几年下来，陈小英的申通快递已成为国内快递业的巨头，每6个包裹中，就有1个是申通快递寄送的。
95e3a9aa18580f9e7c29cc35b05f3e516c9172c5.translatedText: Over the past ten years, Chen Xiaoying's STO Express has become a giant in the domestic express delivery industry. One in every six packages is sent by STO Express.

bc0cc5ac2cab9ab2a80886bd4657ec25977a0113.sourceText: 2012年，申通快递1.6亿元收购了詹际盛和弟弟创办的天天快递，由陈小英的第二任丈夫、原申通快递总裁奚春阳出任天天快递董事长兼CEO。
bc0cc5ac2cab9ab2a80886bd4657ec25977a0113.translatedText: In 2012, STO Express acquired Tiantian Express founded by Zhan Jisheng and his brother for 160 million yuan. Chen Xiaoying’s second husband, Xi Chunyang, the former president of STO Express, became the chairman and CEO of Tiantian Express.

cf89fed497c1d89c1c7f8115547f7664fadf3353.sourceText: 企业做得大了，不如弄成上市公司，大家每年拿分红更开心。为此，申通又一次成了第一个吃螃蟹的人。
cf89fed497c1d89c1c7f8115547f7664fadf3353.translatedText: When a company becomes big, it is better to become a listed company. Everyone will be happier with dividends every year. For this reason, Shentong once again became the first to eat crabs.

6e96f315cc22c711ae6d940a6ef28bbedec1f775.sourceText: 2016年的最后一个交易日，申通快递正式登陆深交所。根据当天收盘市值，陈德军、陈小英兄妹持有的申通快递股份市值约为273.8亿元。
6e96f315cc22c711ae6d940a6ef28bbedec1f775.translatedText: On the last trading day of 2016, STO Express officially landed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange. According to the closing market value of the day, the market value of STO Express shares held by brothers Chen Dejun and Chen Xiaoying is approximately 27.38 billion yuan.

aa1c97c07d39f10565758dfbbc352479e0ba2fed.sourceText: 当大家买买买的时候，陈小英从打工小妹变成了”快递女王”，身家上百亿，还做起了房地产、实业、投资、计算机网络技术等，跨界玩儿得风生水起。同样身为马云爸爸背后的女人，这”差距”咋就这么大涅厖
aa1c97c07d39f10565758dfbbc352479e0ba2fed.translatedText: While everyone was shopping, Chen Xiaoying turned from a working girl into a "Queen of Express Delivery" with a net worth of tens of billions. She also engaged in real estate, industry, investment, computer network technology, etc., and she flourished across industries. As the woman behind Jack Ma's father, why is this "gap" so big?

817f08a4d4d530d999bfb350f7f0f20c39144465.sourceText: 然而人生赢家陈小英，最近却做了一件出人意料的事。
817f08a4d4d530d999bfb350f7f0f20c39144465.translatedText: However, Chen Xiaoying, the winner in life, did something unexpected recently.

c213174399d41d4d1a7da06ff605f8bcdb0eb9e6.sourceText: 今年9月27日，陈小英向申通公司提交辞呈，因个人原因辞去公司副董事长、董事等职务↓↓
c213174399d41d4d1a7da06ff605f8bcdb0eb9e6.translatedText: On September 27 this year, Chen Xiaoying submitted her resignation to STO Company, resigning from the company's vice chairman, director and other positions due to personal reasons ↓↓

3325822af1a1a5b756f3c85fcfbb3dcdfadb601b.sourceText: 如今，陈小英走下高位，下一步她又有何打算？让我们边等快递边期待吧。
3325822af1a1a5b756f3c85fcfbb3dcdfadb601b.translatedText: Now that Chen Xiaoying has stepped down from her high position, what are her next plans? Let's look forward to it while waiting for the express delivery.

43559f1564a4c993bffbfb7c78f5b1f931563a9a.sourceText: 亚利桑那被枪杀人数比车祸丧生人数多 （亚省时报） 根据暴力控制中心报告，亚利桑那州被枪杀的人数比在车祸中丧生的人数多。当地安全倡导者要求立法者重新考虑本州的枪支管理法例。 据有关资料， 2009 年数据最完整，当年有 856 人被枪杀，同年，车祸中丧生的人数为 809 ，使亚利桑那州成为全国因枪支死亡人数最多的第九大州。 ”这个问题在亚利桑那州非常严峻，”亚利桑那枪支安全组织的主席海蒂萨柔说。”这个报告没有告诉我们有什么办法解决它。” 萨柔说，在交通部门的监督下，加强宣传，如强制使用安全带和儿童约束，已经收到良好的效应。她说，同样的监管法例适用于枪支管理。 但并非所有人同意她的看法，图森籍州众议员弗兰克安东尼认为，萨柔的组织目标明确，就是禁枪。而亚利桑那州一向遵循美国宪法第二修正条例，生活在狂野的西部，人们明白枪支的用途。安东尼补充说，使用暴力控制中心这种”伪科学”数据不能达到公平公正评价因枪支死亡人数。 此外，亚省步枪与手枪协会表示，他们支持限枪法律，以便保护更多的孩子远离枪支伤害。
43559f1564a4c993bffbfb7c78f5b1f931563a9a.translatedText: More people are shot in Arizona than killed in car crashes (Alberta Times) More people are shot in Arizona than killed in car crashes, according to a report from the Violence Control Center. Local safety advocates are asking lawmakers to reconsider the state's gun control laws. According to relevant information, in 2009, the most complete data available, 856 people were shot and killed that year. In the same year, 809 people were killed in car accidents, making Arizona the ninth state with the most gun deaths in the country. "This problem is very serious in Arizona," said Heidi Saro, president of Arizona Gun Safety. "This report doesn't tell us what we can do to solve it." Saro said that under the supervision of the transportation department, increased publicity, such as the mandatory use of seat belts and child restraints, has had good effects. She said the same regulations apply to gun control. But not everyone agrees with her. State Rep. Frank Anthony of Tucson believes that Saro's organization has a clear goal of banning guns. Arizona has always followed the Second Amendment to the U.S. Constitution and lives in the Wild West, where people understand the purpose of guns. Anthony added that using “pseudo-scientific” data like the Violence Control Center’s does not allow for a fair and impartial assessment of gun deaths. In addition, the Alberta Rifle and Pistol Association said they support gun restrictions to protect more children from gun harm.

249462d7fdeeba6c67384bf06190d1c56c8a4fca.translatedText: The excerpt of the article is as follows:

65d787b3dfcb7e55e6f368f76318ca065e971455.sourceText: 追踪世界各地假日商机的”全国今日网”指出，由于美国经济表现好，预计今年的”黑五”将是史上销售量最大的一次。”美国零售联合会”也指出，从现在开始到12月，平均每个美国人将花费967美元。这将是自从该会15年前开始进行此项调查以来最高的数字。
65d787b3dfcb7e55e6f368f76318ca065e971455.translatedText: "National Today", which tracks holiday business opportunities around the world, pointed out that due to the good economic performance of the United States, this year's "Black Friday" is expected to have the largest sales volume in history. The National Retail Federation also noted that the average American will spend $967 between now and December. This would be the highest number since the survey began 15 years ago.

c613e59cf1b8323a7a23876de8a675e84091315f.sourceText: 在美国经济中，消费占70%左右，是GDP第一大组成部分，因此消费增长对美国整体经济增长尤为重要。去年三季度以来美国GDP见底反弹，复苏势头有所回升，但消费增长却并无明显起色。如果本次购物季能够带动消费增长，将给美国经济注入一剂强心针。
c613e59cf1b8323a7a23876de8a675e84091315f.translatedText: In the U.S. economy, consumption accounts for about 70% and is the largest component of GDP. Therefore, consumption growth is particularly important to the overall economic growth of the United States. Since the third quarter of last year, U.S. GDP has bottomed out and rebounded, and the recovery momentum has picked up, but consumption growth has not improved significantly. If this shopping season can drive consumption growth, it will give a shot in the arm to the U.S. economy.

30e468424eb7f89dc6b0089c639ec536404fe8e9.sourceText: 特朗普在感恩节时在社交媒体发文，夸耀美国就业岗位回流，有史以来最高的股票牛市，以及17年来最低失业率。当然，特普朗是把功劳都记入了自己的账上。
30e468424eb7f89dc6b0089c639ec536404fe8e9.translatedText: Trump posted on social media on Thanksgiving Day, boasting about the return of American jobs, the highest stock bull market in history, and the lowest unemployment rate in 17 years. Of course, Trump takes all the credit in his own account.

83bbd6082582a27250cabb1b3098a13da746438c.sourceText: 对经济的乐观情绪确实在蔓延。从股市这个晴雨表来看，美股在感恩节假期前创出历史新高。高盛之前预计未来12个月美股有六成概率跌入熊市，而最近突然改变立场，发表报告称美股牛市至少持续三年。也就是说，牛市将持续整个特朗普任期。
83bbd6082582a27250cabb1b3098a13da746438c.translatedText: Optimism about the economy is indeed spreading. Judging from the barometer of the stock market, U.S. stocks hit record highs before the Thanksgiving holiday. Goldman Sachs previously predicted that there is a 60% chance that U.S. stocks will fall into a bear market in the next 12 months. However, it suddenly changed its stance recently and issued a report saying that the bull market in U.S. stocks will last at least three years. In other words, the bull market will continue throughout Trump’s term.

87ed28704625c30e4f8710635e749ea59a5775e6.sourceText: 从总体来看，全球经济正经历着自金融危机以来最为强劲的同步复苏。原因主要是G3经济体(即美国、欧盟和日本)公司部门资本支出增长的加速，去杠杆基本完成，消化了量化宽松带来的负面影响，这将有力地支撑可持续的企业盈利与生产力增长。
87ed28704625c30e4f8710635e749ea59a5775e6.translatedText: Overall, the global economy is experiencing the strongest synchronized recovery since the financial crisis. The main reason is the acceleration of capital expenditure growth in the corporate sector of the G3 economies (i.e. the United States, the European Union and Japan). Deleveraging has been basically completed, digesting the negative impact of quantitative easing, which will strongly support sustainable corporate earnings and productivity growth.

e39848056a18b958c4c993ba7de349713b20f6a1.sourceText: 当然，在玫瑰色背后，美国经济隐忧尚存。最大的不确定因素就是”特朗普税改”的前景。美国税收过高是公认的事实，美国35%的企业税是发达国家中税率水平最高的。这产生了两大负面结果。一是压制美国企业的投资意愿；二是导致美国企业资金流向海外。
e39848056a18b958c4c993ba7de349713b20f6a1.translatedText: Of course, behind the rose color, there are still hidden worries about the US economy. The biggest uncertainty is the prospect of Trump’s tax reform. It is a recognized fact that U.S. taxes are too high. The U.S. corporate tax rate of 35% is the highest among developed countries. This had two major negative consequences. The first is to suppress the investment willingness of American companies; the second is to cause the funds of American companies to flow overseas.

14aa66c811f2cfa9e7fbe76266ca1011a83ba962.sourceText: 特朗普税改有三个基本的目标，即公司税减为20%、对中产阶级大幅减税以及简化税制。在未来十年减税约1.5万亿美元。从总体来看，税改对企业是一个利好。高盛预测，税改案若通过， 2018年标普每股收益将提升5个百分点。但如果税改案未通过，预计标普近期将下跌5%，跌至2450点。
14aa66c811f2cfa9e7fbe76266ca1011a83ba962.translatedText: Trump’s tax reform has three basic goals, namely reducing corporate tax to 20%, significantly reducing taxes for the middle class and simplifying the tax system. Cut taxes by approximately $1.5 trillion over the next decade. Overall, tax reform is a boon to businesses. Goldman Sachs predicts that if the tax reform bill is passed, S&P earnings per share will increase by 5 percentage points in 2018. However, if the tax reform bill is not passed, the S&P is expected to fall by 5% in the near future to 2,450 points.

e96810bae61bcc144da942976b39d64e039eb4f7.sourceText: 目前，众议院已经在11月16日通过《减税及就业法》，参议院财政委员会也表决通过了共和党参议员提出的税改法案。特朗普希望税改法案能成为今年送给美国民众的圣诞礼物。但依然有许多阻力和变数。
e96810bae61bcc144da942976b39d64e039eb4f7.translatedText: Currently, the House of Representatives has passed the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act on November 16, and the Senate Finance Committee has also voted to pass the tax reform bill proposed by Republican senators. Trump hopes the tax reform bill will be this year's Christmas gift to the American people. But there are still many obstacles and variables.

64bac8f96d856b73618714f641509c62a2fa19b4.sourceText: 再者，虽然总体经济乐观，但美国经济多年积累的结构性问题仍未缓解。比如贫富悬殊，以及与此相关的中产阶级的萎缩问题。同时，美国最底层约一成九的家庭正陷入财务困境，家庭为零资产甚至是负资产，其中多数为少数族裔家庭；如30%的非裔家庭和27%的拉丁裔没有财富或负债。
64bac8f96d856b73618714f641509c62a2fa19b4.translatedText: Furthermore, although the overall economy is optimistic, the structural problems accumulated in the U.S. economy over the years have not yet been alleviated. For example, the gap between rich and poor, and the related shrinkage of the middle class. At the same time, about 19% of the bottom families in the United States are in financial difficulties. Their families have zero or even negative assets, and most of them are minority families; for example, 30% of African-American families and 27% of Latino families have no wealth or debt.

3d542cf7304b2853b8642aadac8fa96e19c312a3.sourceText: ”中产阶级的愤怒”是特朗普得以上台的重要原因，如果美国经济只是总体改善，但成果没有落到普通民众，尤其是中产阶级身上，那这样的增长是没有多大意义的。这也是乐观的购物季中，人们必须保持清醒的理由。
3d542cf7304b2853b8642aadac8fa96e19c312a3.translatedText: "The anger of the middle class" is an important reason why Trump came to power. If the U.S. economy only improves overall, but the results do not fall on ordinary people, especially the middle class, then such growth will not make much sense. This is also the reason why people must stay awake during the optimistic shopping season.

6a075f738c4d96d15b2abb7728a7bd3603ae7d5b.sourceText: 蒋介石日记曾记载与陈洁如亲密细节（图） 据台湾《中国时报》报道，蒋介石与陈洁如的关系，在国民党党史中，向来被视为敏感禁区的档案，不过，根据美国斯坦福大学”胡佛研究所”2006年首批对外开放蒋氏1927年至1931年的日记，蒋介石本人确曾记载他与陈洁如亲密生活的记事。 据国民党党史馆主任邵铭煌在《蒋介石的亲情、爱情与友情》文章提到，他曾在检视蒋介石日记时，特别留意，曾出现”昨夜又与洁如缠扰。英雄气短，自古皆然。””早醒，与洁如缠扰，七时后起床办公。””以后两星期，戒与洁如交媾，保重病体。”等私密记事。 邵铭煌说，蒋的日记里首见”洁如”，是1922年11月27日的记载：”下午，访洁如。”此后，日记出现”洁如”频率俱增。 当年，蒋率军北伐，还不时写信，并寄照片给”璐妹”(陈洁如本名)，表达思念；陈炯明叛变之际，蒋奉孙中山电报催促，尚置身上海，蒋记道：”晚，与璐妹并坐汽车，游览夜景，以粤难无法解救，聊以写我忧耳。” 资料图：2009年3月19日，蒋介石和陈洁如结婚时用的五门橱从陈洁如原淡水路居所迁出，移至上海福寿园人文纪念馆，成为上海清明月纪念展的重要藏品之一。图为85岁高龄、陈洁如的养女陈瑶光在家门口捐赠其母”陪嫁”并作”惜别”留影。据介绍，1921年12月5日，陈洁如与蒋介石在上海举行婚礼。这件五门橱就是陈洁如母亲当年送给陈洁如的一套陪嫁家具之一。
6a075f738c4d96d15b2abb7728a7bd3603ae7d5b.translatedText: Chiang Kai-shek's diary once recorded intimate details with Chen Jieru (picture) According to Taiwan's China Times, the relationship between Chiang Kai-shek and Chen Jieru has always been regarded as a sensitive restricted area in the history of the Kuomintang. However, according to the first batch of Chiang's diaries from 1927 to 1931 released to the public by the Hoover Institution of Stanford University in 2006, Chiang Kai-shek himself did record his intimate life with Chen Jieru. According to Shao Minghuang, director of the Kuomintang Party History Museum, he mentioned in the article "Chiang Kai-shek's Family, Love and Friendship" that when he reviewed Chiang Kai-shek's diary, he paid special attention to private notes such as "I was pestering Jieru again last night. Heroes are short of breath since ancient times." Shao Minghuang said that the first appearance of "Jieru" in Chiang Kai-shek's diary was recorded on November 27, 1922: "In the afternoon, I visited Jieru." Since then, the frequency of "Jieru" appearing in the diary has increased. At that time, Jiang led his army on the Northern Expedition, and wrote letters and photos from time to time to "Lumei" (Chen Jieru's real name) to express his longing for her. When Chen Jiongming rebelled, Jiang was urged by Sun Yat-sen's telegram to go to Shanghai. Jiang recorded: "In the evening, I rode in a car with Lumei and visited the night scene. I couldn't save the trouble in Guangdong, so I wrote about my worries." Data map: On March 19, 2009, the five-door cabinet used by Chiang Kai-shek and Chen Jieru when they got married was moved from Chen Jieru’s original Tamsui Road residence to the Shanghai Fu Shou Yuan Humanities Memorial Hall, where it became one of the important collections of the Shanghai Qingming Moon Memorial Exhibition. The picture shows Chen Yaoguang, the 85-year-old adopted daughter of Chen Jieru, donating her mother's "dowry" and taking a "farewell" photo in front of her home. According to reports, on December 5, 1921, Chen Jieru and Chiang Kai-shek held a wedding in Shanghai. This five-door cabinet is one of the dowry furniture given to Chen Jieru by Chen Jieru's mother.

This is China's overseas exchange...

cfd88f2e7332a34871be2b6f9d65be7392a43fda.sourceText: 今年8月8日至27日有幸参加《全美海外华文教育名师巡讲团》赴美讲学。这是中国海外交流协会主办、全美中文学校协会承办的项目。短短20天时间经历8个陌生的城市、接触了数百位华文教育工作者，让我对海外华文教育有了更深入的认知。随时记下所到之处的感动、感慨、感叹，感激、感铭、感恩，不敢专私一得，愿与君分享正之。
cfd88f2e7332a34871be2b6f9d65be7392a43fda.translatedText: From August 8th to 27th this year, I was honored to participate in the "National Overseas Chinese Education Famous Teachers Tour" to give lectures in the United States. This is a project sponsored by the China Overseas Exchange Association and undertaken by the National Association of Chinese Schools. In just 20 days, I experienced eight unfamiliar cities and met hundreds of Chinese educators, which gave me a deeper understanding of overseas Chinese education. Always write down the emotions, emotions, sighs, gratitude, remembrances, and thanksgiving wherever you go. I don’t dare to take it personally, but I am willing to share it with you.

a503e4f665551bbc2c42df056c13d35576fe498f.sourceText: 其一、赠休斯敦华夏中文学校① 休戚与共华夏缘，② 斯人天涯德馨传。③ 敦厚尔雅育才俊，④ 中文学校普新篇。 ①诗内藏着”休斯顿中文学校谱新篇” ②国内对海外华文教育的牵挂体现了华夏子孙的那份割舍不断的情缘。 ③休斯顿华夏中文学校设备简陋、租用校舍，所以引用〈陋室铭〉中”斯是陋室，唯吾德馨”的话与华校教师共勉。 ④《礼记 经解》：”其为人也，温柔敦厚，《诗》教也。”《尔雅》是中国古代第一部词典，儒家十三经之一，是使语言接近标准之意。
a503e4f665551bbc2c42df056c13d35576fe498f.translatedText: First, give it to Huaxia Chinese School in Houston ① to share the fate of China through thick and thin, ② to pass on the virtues of this person to the end of the world. ③ Honesty, elegance and talent cultivation, ④ Chinese school popularization chapter. ① The poem contains "Houston Chinese School writes a new chapter" ② The domestic concern for overseas Chinese education reflects the continuous love of Chinese descendants. ③Huaxia Chinese School in Houston has poor equipment and rents a school building, so I quoted the words from the "Inscription on the Humble Room", "This is a humble room, but I am virtuous and kind" to encourage the teachers of the Chinese school. ④ "Book of Rites Jingjie": "He is a man, gentle and honest, and the "Shi" teaches." "Erya" is the first dictionary in ancient China and one of the Thirteen Confucian Classics. It means to bring the language closer to the standard.

75c83cb28b9a8f972c102e3a5150e9dd8e571a3c.sourceText: 其二、赠圣路易斯现代中文学校 圣言四海皆兄弟，① 路遥日久鉴情真。② 易水长风歌壮士，③ 斯是陋室传德馨。④ 中华今古承远脉，⑤ 文明西东融比邻。⑥ 大爱无声滋万物， 使命有功献童心。⑦ ①被誉为圣人的孔子曾说”四海之内皆兄弟” ②路遥知马力、日久见人心。 ③华校教师当年远涉重洋、历经磨难，至今仍在异国他乡奔忙打拼之中，不由得联想到荆轲西行慷慨悲歌壮举。抛去刺秦不说，单论舍身取义也足令人感动。去国之情，悲壮之举，任何时代都非轻而易举。 ④《陋室铭》有”斯是陋室，唯吾德馨” ⑤中华文化源远流长 ⑥东西方文化的接触与融合。 ⑦知识分子的社会责任和历史使命需要一颗净化的童心。
75c83cb28b9a8f972c102e3a5150e9dd8e571a3c.translatedText: Second, presented to St. Louis Modern Chinese School. The Holy Word is that we are brothers everywhere, ① The road is far away and the time passes, the true love is revealed. ② The winds and winds of Yi River sing the songs of heroes, ③ This is a humble house where virtue is conveyed. ④ China has a long history from the past to the present, ⑤ civilizations from the west to the east are close to each other. ⑥ Great love nourishes all things silently, and the mission is full of merit and childishness. ⑦ ①Confucius, who is known as a saint, once said, "We are all brothers within the four seas." ②A horse's power can be seen from a distance, and a person's heart can be seen from time to time. ③The Chinese school teachers traveled across the ocean and went through many hardships, and are still working hard in a foreign country. They can’t help but think of Jing Ke’s generous and tragic feat in his journey to the west. Leaving aside the story of assassinating Qin, just talking about sacrificing one's life for righteousness is enough to move people. The feeling of leaving one's country and the tragic act are never easy in any era. ④The "Inscription on the Humble House" contains "This is a shabby house, but I am virtuous and kind" ⑤Chinese culture has a long history ⑥The contact and integration of Eastern and Western cultures. ⑦The social responsibility and historical mission of intellectuals require a purified childlike innocence.

ac928dc6cb2c632e22c4783413dbcd762b57fd63.sourceText: 其三、赠辛辛那提中文学校① 辛苦奉献寄深情， 城外青山山外峰。 华夏文明通四海， 校园学子颂真经。② 更新理念传快乐， 树人立业享人生。③ 高风亮节承师表，④ 标新化异大道行。⑤ ①诗中藏”辛城华校更树高标”八字，希望华文教育事业不断兴旺发达。 ②华校开展”经典诵读”传承中华文明，丰富了教学内容，深受学生和家长欢迎。 ③十年树木、百年树人 ④语出《三国志 魏志 文帝纪》：”昔仲尼大圣之才,怀帝王之器,……可谓命世之大圣,亿载之师表者也。” 清康熙皇帝亲自写了”万世师表”匾额挂在孔庙大成殿梁。 ⑤ 标新”化异”而非”立异”，意在包容和转化。《礼记》”大道之行也天下为公”。

632ee93370968a2bd91884441c301d1e6828f02d.sourceText: 其四、赠哥伦布中文学校全体同仁 哥翁遗产划时代，① 探索发现强国魂。② 华文教育新天地， 光荣梦想任诸君。③ ①哥伦布发现美洲，做出了划时代的贡献。此次讲座题目特别改定为〈华文教育的发现之旅〉，意在继承哥伦布的创新探索精神，努力发现华文教育的规律。 ②探索发现既是美国作为超级大国的”国魂”，也是我们文化复兴，和平崛起的国魂。 ③在华文教育事业领域，实现”海阔凭鱼跃、天高任鸟飞”的光荣与梦想。

013e33a0c88130c1504d1d2058c5c6fe0326dff1.sourceText: 其五、赠克利夫兰城现代中文学校： 马不停蹄游美中，① 似曾相识超时空。 蓝天深邃儿时乐，② 绿野连绵务农情。③ 跨洋求索强国梦， 离乡牵挂故园兴。 华文教育通四海， 众志成城大道行。④ ①”美中”指美国中部。 ②看到美国的天高云淡不禁想起儿时故乡的蓝天白云。戏言”今天的美国蓝天相当于半个世纪前的中国乡村”，一笑。 ③我与克利夫兰当代中文学校汤年发校董及同行的青岛大学徐宏力副校长都有过下乡务农的经历，难免对未开发的连绵绿野频生感慨。 ④《礼记》有”大道之行也，天下为公”

He joked that "the blue sky in the United States today is equivalent to the Chinese countryside half a century ago." ③Both Tang Nianfa, Director of Cleveland Contemporary Chinese School, and Xu Hongli, Vice President of Qingdao University, and I have had the experience of going to the countryside to work in the countryside. 59f593480b19dd909631fb02ca372c579ca3db82.sourceText: 其六、赠底特律华文教师 现代工业领军者， 久负盛名汽车城。 破产传闻皆瞩目。 华校境况倍关情。① 风高云淡美国梦， 心静志远神州龙。② 敬业守常知天命， 文化承传谈笑中。③ ①四海之内皆兄弟，天下华人一家亲。祖国大陆格外关注海外华校。 ②以淡定之心处变不惊是中国文化传统修炼一种人生境界。 ③苏轼的《念奴娇 赤壁怀古》有”遥想公谨当年，小乔初嫁了，雄姿英发，羽扇纶巾。谈笑间，樯橹灰飞烟灭。”

18f8de68f29ccfa276be62ec177e9bf3c3da650a.sourceText: 其七、赠印第安纳华文学校 文明发祥数千载， 多元文化有渊源。 四通八达交汇处，① 古往今来独厚田。② 市场经济讲诚信，③ 人际交往重语言。 华文教育本土化， 融会贯通谱新篇。④ ①印第安纳地理位置四通八达。 ②绿野广袤，一望无际，堪称得天独厚。 ③孔子《论语》有”人而无信不知其可也”和”民无信不立”的名言，汉字构形”人言为信”，”诚信”表现在言语行为中。 ④”本土化”的寓意既有对华语华文的融会贯通，也含有对东西方文化之间的融会贯通。

9fbd6980de1f131fcd3b8ec3ee876792c9c936e9.sourceText: 其八、赠芝加哥华文教师 华校巡礼美中游，① 天高云淡艳阳秋。 开拓创新皆才俊，② 承前启后尽名流。③ 有缘千里修高速，④ 不拘一格献良筹。 社区华教连四海，⑤ 资源共享惠五洲。 ①”美中”指美国中部地区 ②改革开放后出国的人多是具有开拓创新精神的一代青年才俊，是那种敢吃螃蟹的人。 ③创办海外华校坚持传承中华文化人中有许多名人之后。当得知开车接送我们华校领导是《西游记》导演杨洁的女儿时，心中感动和敬意油然而生。 ④共享资源平台就是华文教育的信息高速公路。 ⑤共享资源平台让全球社区华校关联互动和谐发展。

Those who pioneer and innovate are all talented people, ② those who carry forward the past and link up the future are all celebrities. ③ It is destined to build a highway thousands of miles away, ④ It is an eclectic offering of good ideas. Chinese education in the community connects the world, ⑤ resource sharing benefits five continents. ① "U.S.-China" refers to the central region of the United States ② The people who went abroad after the reform and opening up were mostly young talents with a pioneering and innovative spirit, the kind of people who dare to eat crabs. ③After many famous people founded overseas Chinese schools and insisted on inheriting Chinese culture. When I learned that the leader of the Chinese school who drove us was the daughter of Yang Jie, the director of "Journey to the West", I was moved and respected. ④The shared resource platform is the information highway for Chinese education. ⑤The shared resource platform allows Chinese schools in the global community to interact and develop harmoniously.

5b818ef6db27d078b7b23c6ef6db6abdd0c1f676.sourceText: 后记 20天美国中部八个城市华文教师培训巡讲，既是华文教育的追梦之旅，又是一次难忘的”跨文化”之旅。在东西方文化交互对比中深入了解了美国华文教育的现状，了解了华校教师们的工作方式、教学环境和敬业精神。收获多多，感动多多，难以尽述。 随着改革开放的深入发展，旅美华人的数量逐年增加。华文教育的师资、教材、教辅读物的供应，华文教育的学术研究、资源建设、网络平台的开发和利用等等，都需要适应新情况、取得新发展、上到新水平。这就需要国内相关领域的同仁积极关注、协同创新，汇集各方面的聪明才智，为华文教育事业做出新贡献。 汶川地震时，一句”因为我有一个强大的祖国”鼓舞和感动了所有国人。每当想起这句话就不禁涌起一股热烈的冲动，整个身心都感受到一种非凡的力量。 从大洋彼岸回到首都机场，看到熙熙攘攘的旅行者，脑海中回荡的就是这句话，的确，强大的祖国就是我们的依靠。我们是相亲相爱的一家人，美国华文教育的追梦之旅一定会在手足兄弟的同心支持下，早日梦想成真。这正是： 同源同种同血脉，华文华语四海一。 追梦何惜路修远，好梦成真会有期。
5b818ef6db27d078b7b23c6ef6db6abdd0c1f676.translatedText: Postscript The 20-day Chinese teacher training tour in eight cities in central America was not only a dream-chasing journey for Chinese education, but also an unforgettable "cross-cultural" journey. Through the interactive comparison of Eastern and Western cultures, I gained an in-depth understanding of the current situation of Chinese education in the United States, and learned about the working methods, teaching environment and professionalism of teachers in Chinese schools. I have gained so much and been touched so much that it is difficult to describe it all. With the deepening of reform and opening up, the number of Chinese in the United States has increased year by year. The supply of teachers, teaching materials, and supplementary reading materials for Chinese education, academic research, resource construction, and development and utilization of network platforms for Chinese education, etc., all need to adapt to new situations, achieve new developments, and reach new levels. This requires colleagues in related fields in China to actively pay attention, collaborate and innovate, and bring together talents from all aspects to make new contributions to the cause of Chinese education. During the Wenchuan earthquake, the sentence "Because I have a strong motherland" inspired and moved all Chinese people. Whenever I think of this sentence, I can't help but feel a warm impulse, and my whole body and mind feel an extraordinary power. Returning to the Capital Airport from the other side of the ocean, when I saw the bustling travelers, this sentence echoed in my mind. Indeed, our strong motherland is our support. We are a family that loves each other, and our dream journey of pursuing Chinese education in the United States will surely come true as soon as possible with the support of our brothers and sisters. This is exactly what we mean: the same origin, the same species, the same blood, the Chinese language and the Chinese language are the same throughout the world. There is no need to worry about the long way to go when chasing dreams. There will be a time when dreams come true.
