e7af139d6ba0ac2a358741583896cfa077bdd1c8.sourceText: 法官开绿灯准予执行 亚省警察将可查移民身份 美国联邦法官裁决，亚利桑那州可以执行该州移民法中最有争议的条款，也就是在执行其它公务时可以对可疑人物核查移民身份。 美国联邦法官5日裁决，亚利桑那州可以执行该州移民法中最有争议的条款，也就是在执行其它公务时可以对可疑人物核查移民身份。 美国地区法官博尔顿这一裁定为警方扫清障碍，令他们可以执行该州2010年通过的移民法中的核心条款，在进行其它执法时，可以对那些他们怀疑是非法移民的人查询他们的移民身份。亚州州长布雷维尔的办公室表示，预计该条款会很快生效。这一条款在两年来的法律战均是争拗的核心问题。到今年6月，联邦最高法院裁定，允许执行该条款。 之后，反对者要求博尔顿法官阻止该条款实施，称一旦开始执行该条款，将会导致系统性的种族歧视，并且会造成西裔被不合理长时间监禁。州布雷维尔敦促法官让此条款生效。她表示，该法律的反对者仅仅是凭想象以为会导致种族歧视。而警察已经接受培训以避免种族歧视。 亚州移民法中没有太多争议的条款已于2010年7月底开始生效，但是很少使用。
e7af139d6ba0ac2a358741583896cfa077bdd1c8.translatedText: The judge gave the green light to allow enforcement, and the Alberta police will be able to check immigration status. A U.S. federal judge has ruled that Arizona can enforce the most controversial provision of the state's immigration law, which allows it to check the immigration status of suspicious people while performing other official duties. A U.S. federal judge ruled on the 5th that Arizona can enforce the most controversial provision of the state's immigration law, which is that it can check the immigration status of suspicious people when performing other official duties. The ruling by U.S. District Judge Bolton clears the way for police to enforce core provisions of the state's 2010 immigration law and, among other enforcement, to inquire about the immigration status of people they suspect are illegal immigrants. Breville's office said it expected the provision to take effect soon. This provision has been at the heart of a two-year legal battle. By June this year, the Federal Supreme Court ruled that enforcement of this clause was allowed. Afterwards, opponents asked Judge Bolton to block the implementation of this provision, saying that once it is implemented, it will lead to systemic racial discrimination and cause Hispanics to be imprisoned for unreasonably long periods of time. State Breville urged the judge to let the provision take effect. She said opponents of the law simply imagined it would lead to racial discrimination. And police officers are already trained to avoid racial discrimination. A less controversial provision of Asian immigration law came into effect at the end of July 2010, but is rarely used.

a1bf8a617d89140fa10fd98e947828d2a8e7a423.sourceText: 从低年级开始，注音班的儿歌：”水果桶”和”捕鱼歌”；学前唱游班小朋友演唱的儿歌Children Songs”找朋友”，稚嫩的嗓音、有趣的表情，大家不由得以热情的掌声，鼓励他（他）们；紧接着儿童舞蹈班的小同学，表演中国儿童舞蹈Chinese Folk Dance；中简幼儿班同学，表演儿歌：”老师祝福您”和”八哥鸟”；简体一班的小同学表演的十二生肖故事，每个小朋饰演一种属相的动物，用讲故事的形式，把十二生肖的来源述说给会众，他（她）们也从中学习到许多知识。简体二班的同学的诗朗诵和歌曲Poetry recitation；双语班学生的儿歌：”手指歌”和”我是一个好小孩”。节目中又串插颁奖：由中文学校汤学文副校长，分别给9名得作文比赛奖的同学和9名得识字比赛奖的同学颁奖并合影！随后简体六班的同学表演了绕口令和歌曲。最让人鼓舞的是三位外国朋友，用生硬不流利的汉语表演”生活对话”，虽然生硬而又不流利，但是从中看到他（她）们努力学习的精以及对中国和中国文化的热爱，让人十分敬佩，更以热情的掌声祝贺和鼓励他（她）们。正体、简体班的同学，表演歌曲”我要向高山举目”和”歌声与微笑”两首歌曲；简体四班同学的宋词朗诵等，最后由青少年舞蹈班同学，表演的舞蹈”欢天喜地”，整个毕业与结业典礼，在欢乐声中园满落幕结束。
a1bf8a617d89140fa10fd98e947828d2a8e7a423.translatedText: Starting from the lower grades, the children’s songs of the phonetic class: “Fruit Bucket” and “Fishing Song”; the children’s songs sung by the children in the preschool singing class Children Songs "Looking for Friends", with young voices and interesting expressions, everyone couldn't help but enthusiastically applaud and encourage them; then the little students from the children's dance class performed the Chinese Folk Dance for children. Dance; students from the Chinese-Simplified Chinese kindergarten class performed children's songs: "Teacher Bless You" and "Myna Bird"; the children from the Simplified Chinese Class 1 performed a story about the twelve zodiac signs. Each child played an animal of the Chinese zodiac and told the audience the origin of the twelve zodiac signs in the form of storytelling, and they also learned a lot of knowledge from it. Poetry recitations and songs by students from the Simplified Chinese Class 2; children’s songs by students from the bilingual class: “Finger Song” and “I am a good boy”. The program also included awards presentations: Tang Xuewen, the vice-principal of the Chinese school, presented awards to the 9 students who won the composition competition award and the 9 students who won the literacy competition award and took a group photo! Then the students from Simplified Chinese Class 6 performed tongue twisters and songs. The most encouraging thing is that three foreign friends performed "Life Dialogue" in blunt and not fluent Chinese. Although they were stiff and not fluent, they saw their hard work and love for China and Chinese culture. It was very admirable, and they were congratulated and encouraged with warm applause. Students from the Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese classes performed the songs "I Want to Raise My Eyes to the Mountains" and "Singing and Smiling"; students from the Simplified Chinese Class 4 recited Song lyrics, and finally, students from the Youth Dance Class performed the dance "Happily Ever After". The entire graduation and graduation ceremony ended with joy.

8622c2884541c2002f40181ba96cc590b9e6a080.sourceText: 颁奖合影 同学们经过一年刻苦、努力的学习，他（她）们都高兴地收获了优异成绩和丰富的知识。在这个毕业与结业典礼上，欢天喜地的向老师和家长们回报他（她）们的学习成绩，并向为学生们无私奉献和付出、辛勤努力工作的老师们，表示真挚的感谢！ 凤凰城华人基督教会中文学校，下一学年在2013年8月4日下午1:30pm～3:30pm开始注册，2013年8月11日下午1:30pm开学。欢迎希望让孩子学习中文和中国文化的家长们，带孩子们报名，好好学习中文和中国文化！请上学校网站了觧详情。学校网站地址： http://WWW.gpccs.org
8622c2884541c2002f40181ba96cc590b9e6a080.translatedText: Award group photo After a year of hard study, the students were happy to gain excellent results and rich knowledge. At this graduation and completion ceremony, I happily report to the teachers and parents their academic achievements, and express my sincere gratitude to the teachers who have selflessly dedicated and worked hard for the students! Phoenix Chinese Christian School Chinese School will start registration for the next school year from 1:30pm to 3:30pm on August 4, 2013, and will start at 1:30pm on August 11, 2013. Parents who want their children to learn Chinese and Chinese culture are welcome to sign up with their children and learn Chinese and Chinese culture! Please go to the school website for details. School website address: http://WWW.gpccs.org

7fe651771ddea7f4a599428c9a008c423aa73320.translatedText: Water is the sweetness of my hometown, and Taiwanese food touches my nostalgia!——Fengcheng Taiwanese Food and Cooking Show

cc94a3322a37683b280ee0bb726a837ea04027d1.sourceText: 水是故乡甜 台湾美食牵动了我的乡愁!——凤城台湾美食厨艺表演 (本网讯)新竹米粉配上台湾啤酒，哇!不要…
cc94a3322a37683b280ee0bb726a837ea04027d1.translatedText: Water is the sweetness of my hometown, and Taiwanese food makes me feel homesick!——Fengcheng Taiwanese Food and Cooking Show (This website news) Hsinchu rice noodles paired with Taiwan beer, wow! No...

b14de196d836b8f0257022faa82c3460a6660b83.sourceText: (本网讯)新竹米粉配上台湾啤酒，哇!不要笑我，我兴奋的想哭，那怕我刚从台湾回耒。 这纯醇的台湾味让我今夜有乡愁，李玉泉 王丽玉在这对夫妻在台湾美食厨艺表演的豪宴上感性脱口而出，但这也是全埸朋友的共同心声。 潘盟仁，骆进汉两位誉满台湾大师级名厨，受侨委会委託担任台湾传统週台湾美食巡迴讲座的主厨。凤凰城是首站，这让台湾传统週主办负责人张晴玲与黄丽憬压力大增，只能成功不能失败，两位在接桉之时是没有任何把握。
b14de196d836b8f0257022faa82c3460a6660b83.translatedText: (This website news) Hsinchu rice noodles paired with Taiwan beer, wow! Don’t laugh at me, I am so excited that I want to cry, even though I just returned from Taiwan. This pure and mellow Taiwanese flavor makes me feel homesick tonight, Li Yuquan and Wang Liyu blurted out this emotion at the banquet where the couple performed a Taiwanese food and cooking show, but this is also the common sentiment of friends all over the place. Pan Mengren and Luo Jinhan are two well-known master chefs in Taiwan. They were entrusted by the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council to serve as chefs for the Taiwanese Food Lecture Tour during the Taiwan Heritage Week. Phoenix was the first stop, which put great pressure on the organizers of Taiwan Heritage Week, Zhang Qingling and Huang Lijing. They had to succeed but not fail. They had no confidence when they took over.

17dcb9833b8d8b4e2092de4dd228da15a7d0f163.sourceText: 潘盟仁（右）骆进汉（左）两位誉满台湾大师级名厨
17dcb9833b8d8b4e2092de4dd228da15a7d0f163.translatedText: >Pan Mengren (right) and Luo Jinhan (left) are two well-known Taiwanese master chefs

48a037882413b8f3b6f1906e9006c64fceb42c6b.sourceText: 黄丽憬 骆进汉 张晴玲 潘盟仁 林慧懿 李玲麟
48a037882413b8f3b6f1906e9006c64fceb42c6b.translatedText: Huang Lijing, Luo Jinhan, Zhang Qingling, Pan Mengren, Lin Huiyi, Li Linglin

e9cd2f89881e2af85ee7fad0e70ede38a6eda8b0.sourceText: 徐爱妮与李玲麟分别联系了Tempe 与Phoenix 的姊妹市委员会，2013年凤凰城台美人传统週活动在两个姊妹市协办下，隆重推出。
e9cd2f89881e2af85ee7fad0e70ede38a6eda8b0.translatedText: Xu Aini and Li Linglin contacted Tempe and Phoenix respectively. The sister city committees of the Phoenix City Taiwanese Heritage Week 2013 were co-organized by the two sister cities and were grandly launched.

19f58082cc89a0c3685568b7a9908016e1257a23.sourceText: 让大家惊艳的是在五月一日凤凰城Iron Chef 的PK 决赛表演与五月二日坦佩市的豪宴”台湾之夜” ，在美食专家林慧懿主持下，两埸活动都不仅成功，更让”台湾” 元素在主流社会造成轰动。 侨委会橙县文教中心主任高家富与凤城市长Greg Stanton同台受邀出任PK决赛裁判，虽然台菜大获全胜，但高主任表示全靠潘，骆两位大师的精緻厨艺，是市长一面倒支持台菜。凤城市长预计十月应邀访台，传统週活动功不可灭。 五月二日的豪宴充满台湾元素，张晴玲说: 怎么名字都起的这么美啊! 当全场在品嚐美食时都主动喝台湾啤酒，真正醉的人是张晴玲，是黄丽憬，李玉泉，王丽玉……. Tempe市姊妹会主席 Richard Neuheisal 没喝醉，但激动的走上舞台，向张晴玲及全体贵宾喧佈，Tempe 一定要与台湾建立姊妹市! 台美人传统週落幕，但潘，骆两位大师及所有工作义工留给大家的除了喜悦，是乡愁。 故乡水最甜，故乡月更明。
19f58082cc89a0c3685568b7a9908016e1257a23.translatedText: What surprised everyone was the PK final performance of Iron Chef in Phoenix on May 1st and the grand banquet "Taiwan Night" in Tempe on May 2nd. Hosted by food expert Lin Huiyi, both events were not only successful, but also made the "Taiwan" element cause a sensation in mainstream society. Gao Jiafu, director of the Orange County Cultural and Educational Center of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Council, and Greg Stanton, mayor of Fengcheng City, were invited to serve as judges in the PK final. Although Taiwanese cuisine won a great victory, Director Gao said that it was all due to the exquisite cooking skills of Pan and Luo, and the mayor overwhelmingly supported Taiwanese cuisine. The mayor of Fengcheng City is expected to be invited to visit Taiwan in October, and the Traditional Week activities will be indispensable. The grand banquet on May 2nd was full of Taiwanese elements. Zhang Qingling said: How come the names are so beautiful! When everyone was tasting the food, they took the initiative to drink Taiwanese beer. The really drunk people were Zhang Qingling, Huang Lijing, Li Yuquan, Wang Liyu... Richard Neuheisal, the chairman of the Tempe City Sisters Association, was not drunk, but he walked onto the stage excitedly and announced to Zhang Qingling and all the distinguished guests that Tempe must establish a sister city with Taiwan! The Taiwanese Beauty Heritage Week has come to an end, but the two masters Pan and Luo and all the working volunteers left everyone with not only joy but also nostalgia. The water in my hometown is the sweetest, and the moon in my hometown is brighter.

2e4662a6b75113ec450ccc4498bcd3138c06b398.sourceText: 台湾美食厨艺教学/晚宴

bfa859832191e957741cbdeb5a30f81f9c35f952.sourceText: 接着五月一日观看了潘盟仁和骆进汉两大师傅很成功的䥫厨友谊赛后，五月二日是我们的机会由不是只有眼睛的享受，而是加上鼻子和舌头的嚮宴。单是菜单的名字就令人流口水了。
bfa859832191e957741cbdeb5a30f81f9c35f952.translatedText: After watching the successful cooking competition between chefs Pan Mengren and Luo Jinhan on May 1st, May 2nd is our chance to enjoy the feast not just for the eyes, but also for the nose and tongue. The name of the menu alone makes you drool.

bb2b3e709f2cf6c71581d6470c95db61f13a7d07.sourceText: 各大”厨神”共同献艺 要在美国式的厨房做中餐的厨艺表演加上晚宴是很不容易的事。徐爱妮找了好几个厨艺学校终于到我们决定在天庇市的姊妹会Hackett House 的厨艺教室。我们也很幸运的找到了高志中答应来当我们的厨房总监。頼甲乙也让我们在他市场内的厨房做准备。黄丽憬更是初试春啼包了做甜点。李麟玲也设计了别出心的奖座和奖章。有这些福星加上无数人的帮忙，包括天庇市姊妹会成员：大学讲师，退休工程师，家庭主妇来充当酒保，服务人员。
bb2b3e709f2cf6c71581d6470c95db61f13a7d07.translatedText: All the major "chef gods" perform together It is not easy to do a Chinese cooking show plus a dinner party in an American-style kitchen. Xu Aini looked for several cooking schools and finally we decided on the cooking class of Hackett House, a sister club in Tianpi City. We were also very lucky to find Gao Zhizhong who agreed to be our kitchen director. Li Jiayi also let us prepare food in his kitchen in the market. Huang Lijing even tried Chunxiang Bao as a dessert for the first time. Li Linling also designed unique trophies and medals. With these lucky stars and the help of countless people, including members of the Tempi Sisterhood: university lecturers, retired engineers, and housewives who served as bartenders and service staff.

c3dcf1b3acd630a9fd9dca2859819e6d2526474e.sourceText: 当晚六点开始，席开八桌。酒吧备有台湾啤酒，荔枝酒，白，红酒。点心则是酱烧牛肉小烧饼。
c3dcf1b3acd630a9fd9dca2859819e6d2526474e.translatedText: Starting at six o'clock that night, eight tables were opened. The bar stocks Taiwanese beer, lychee wine, white and red wine. The dim sum is braised beef pancakes with soy sauce.

020e58ea91d72e027456d5eadc64932cf78ca172.sourceText: 六点半由Hackett House 的晚会负责人Kathy Andrews 介绍名厨师，美食评论家林慧懿老师。林老师写了十五本食谱也是李安拍饮食男女，少年PI 内食物出现时，那就是她的杰作。林老师是我们当晚的节目主持和翻译。 林老师中英法文都流利，能言善道，在翻译之馀穿插很多食物的小故事，使得气氛十分热络。
020e58ea91d72e027456d5eadc64932cf78ca172.translatedText: At 6:30, Hackett House party director Kathy Andrews will introduce the famous chef and food critic Lin Huiyi. Teacher Lin has written fifteen cookbooks, which are also her masterpieces when food appears in Young Pi. Teacher Lin was our program host and translator that night. Teacher Lin is fluent in Chinese, English and French and is eloquent. He interspersed many short stories about food with his translations, making the atmosphere very lively.

fe096ccce5139e13a560bb2f964341640db5d85e.sourceText: 潘师傅说是有多出来的材料，所以加了在菜单外的牛肉萝卜汤。 所以这餐前汤姑且命名为：新北投白玉清汤。
fe096ccce5139e13a560bb2f964341640db5d85e.translatedText: Master Pan said that he had extra ingredients, so he added beef and radish soup that was not on the menu. Therefore, this pre-meal soup is tentatively named: New Beitou White Jade Clear Soup.

0bd89e3672e6c9730b25b612bd771ff8b9900dbb.sourceText: 第一道菜是：宜兰，噶玛兰的思念 潘师傅把 Rib Eye steak 外面煎了之后，切成薄片做成玫瑰花。 特大号的干贝裹了细麵包粉炸得外面香碎里面鲜嫩放在上了甜美乃兹的lettice 上。
0bd89e3672e6c9730b25b612bd771ff8b9900dbb.translatedText: The first dish is: Yilan, Missing Kavalan. After frying the outside of Rib Eye steak, Chef Pan cut it into thin slices to make roses. Extra-large scallops are coated in fine bread flour and fried until they are fragrant on the outside and tender on the inside. They are placed on a lettice topped with sweet naise.

394db747118115293047d3a435049c0cf0fce4f7.sourceText: 笫二道：台南漳王爷的煇煌 骆师傅说这是三杯鸡的做法，要窍在先炒香作料只加台湾米酒不加水。酱油要金兰的。
394db747118115293047d3a435049c0cf0fce4f7.translatedText: >Two: The Glory of Prince Zhang of Tainan Master Luo said that this is how to make three-cup chicken. The trick is to stir-fry the seasonings first and only add Taiwanese rice wine without adding water. The soy sauce needs to be from Jinlan.

d4e4e0205cf37ed5771e344bdea675557227bba1.sourceText: 第三道：新竹城煌爷的威𩆜 新竹炒米粉，只顅吃忘了骆师傅说什麽了
d4e4e0205cf37ed5771e344bdea675557227bba1.translatedText: Course 3: Hsinchu Chenghuang Ye’s Power 𩆜 Hsinchu Fried Rice Noodles, I just ate it and forgot what Master Luo said

abe64802d59f384a13976ea56fad8e061f486a23.sourceText: 第四道：南投手心中的名月 牛里肌steak 在一盘切得很细又白又紫的葱头沙拉上。牛肉很嫩沙拉很清爽。不知道潘师傅怎麽做的。
abe64802d59f384a13976ea56fad8e061f486a23.translatedText: Course 4: The famous name in the hearts of southern pitchers. Beef tenderloin steak on a plate of finely chopped white and purple onion salad. The beef was tender and the salad was refreshing. I don’t know how Master Pan did it.

0b5207aa5ffab4c0f1d422ea6f2c21979006eaf6.sourceText: 第五道：台湾，故鄕的浓情蜜意。 红豆果冻有绿色薄荷叶相伴。我们都感受到了由大师傅们从故乡带来的浓情蜜意。所以黄丽憬做了这一道代表我们大家对侨委会，师傅们及林老师表示谢意。
0b5207aa5ffab4c0f1d422ea6f2c21979006eaf6.translatedText: The fifth track: Taiwan, the deep love of our hometown. Red bean jelly is accompanied by green mint leaves. We all felt the deep love brought by the masters from their hometown. So Huang Lijing made this to express our gratitude to the Overseas Chinese Committee, the masters and Teacher Lin on behalf of all of us.

8040b41d3a1abbb4dff7090cf4a7fefa5ea140bc.sourceText: 出席的客人中，有前国会议员Harry Mitchell 夫妇，前全美姊妹市委员会会长也是现任天庇市姊妹会会长Richard Neuheisal 夫妇。Neuheisal 先生并表示他认为以美食为媒介与外国的城巿结姊妹是他要做的国民外交。他也希望能和台湾的都市结姊妹。
8040b41d3a1abbb4dff7090cf4a7fefa5ea140bc.translatedText: Among the guests present were former Congressman Harry Mitchell and his wife, former president of the National Sister City Committee and current president of the Tempe City Sisterhood, Richard Neuheisal and his wife. Mr. Neuheisal also said that he believes that using food as a medium to establish sisterhood with foreign cities is his national diplomacy. He also hopes to become sisters with cities in Taiwan.

42109bcc347502f6c83f6a6664cd145dba9cfebe.sourceText: 主办方协办方，尊贵的客人们合影留念 在全体工作人员的努力下，餐会在温馨的环境，圆满结束。
42109bcc347502f6c83f6a6664cd145dba9cfebe.translatedText: The organizer and co-organizer, the distinguished guests took a group photo. With the efforts of all the staff, the dinner ended successfully in a warm environment.

ddd93adc56ded5bd85d6ff8732f82a64f1e43812.translatedText: Remember the joyful celebration——the thanksgiving worship hall dedication ceremony Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church Student Center [Phoenix City Fengming Report] July 21, 1:00 pm…

99d0a474af6f7e7ddd4ff42e81c3a331011179fb.sourceText: 鳳城华人基督教会學生中心
99d0a474af6f7e7ddd4ff42e81c3a331011179fb.translatedText: Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church Student Center

b1d6248f8da0a2f15fe10e94f87cd60b49dfc90f.sourceText: 【鳳凰城 鳳鸣報道】 7月21日下午1:30 Pm，在鳳城华人基督在新购买装修的教学生中心，举行了感恩崇拜曁献堂典礼。同学们与前来祝贺的教会的弟兄姊妹，欢聚一堂一起庆贺献堂。和年青人在一起就是不一样，满场的气氛是欢快的积极向上的，充满了年青人的朝气蓬勃。
b1d6248f8da0a2f15fe10e94f87cd60b49dfc90f.translatedText: Phoenix City Fengming Report] At 1:30 pm on July 21st, a thanksgiving worship and dedication ceremony was held at the newly purchased and renovated teaching and student center of Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church. The students and the brothers and sisters from the church who came to congratulate me gathered together to celebrate the dedication of the church. Being with young people is different. The atmosphere in the venue is cheerful and positive, full of the vitality of young people.

12776c5bc2292a7d49505d4d57c2373937276a3c.sourceText: 在这充满欢乐的庆典上，每个人的脸上都帶着自豪的微笑，朗朗的笑声覆盖着全场，发言人的诙谐语言，更是频频逗笑全场。今天楊牧师传講的信息：”活水江诃”更是将会众帶入自信、自強、自豪之中。今天搬入了崭新的学生中心，和大家一起引水思源，回顾了学生中心走过的45年艰辛的历程。从1968年在ASU校園内开始的学生查經班事工，45年来从未间断，目前学生中心有英语、华语的学生團契，由林圣智实习传道和林海琴实习传道分别帶领，郑盛林执事配搭服事，都在學生中心聚会，颇有一番新气象。从这个事工发展的历史来看，它可以被称为活水江河的事工，事工的人虽然每一年陆续更换，但是事工却源远流長。楊牧师在宣講信息中，引用圣經使徒行传13:1～3，”在安提阿的教会中，有几位先知和教师，就是巴拿巴和称呼尼结的西面，古利奈人路求，与分封之王希律同养的马念，并扫罗。他们事奉主，禁食的时侯，圣灵说：”要为我分派巴拿巴和扫罗，去作我召他们所作的工。”于是禁食禱告，按手在他们头上，就打发他们去了。”安提阿教会就是一亇活水江河的教会。所以我们要把学生中心，办成一个活水江河的事工。
12776c5bc2292a7d49505d4d57c2373937276a3c.translatedText: In this joyful celebration, everyone had a proud smile on their face, and the laughter covered the entire audience. The speaker's humorous words frequently made the audience laugh. The message Pastor Yang preached today: "Living Water Jianghe" brought the audience into confidence, self-improvement, and pride. Today I moved into the brand-new student center. Together with everyone, I looked back at the 45 years of arduous history the student center has gone through. The student Bible study ministry started on the ASU campus in 1968 and has continued uninterrupted for 45 years. Currently, there are English and Chinese student fellowships in the student center. They are led by intern preachers Lin Shengzhi and Lin Haiqin respectively, and are coordinated by Deacon Zheng Shenglin. They all meet in the student center, which is quite a new atmosphere. Judging from the history of the development of this ministry, it can be called the ministry of living water and rivers. Although the people who serve in the ministry change one after another every year, the ministry has a long history. Pastor Yang quoted the Bible Acts 13:1-3 in his preaching message, "In the church at Antioch, there were certain prophets and teachers, namely Barnabas and Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen who was raised by Herod the tetrarch, and Saul. While they were serving the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, "Separate for me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them." "So he fasted and prayed, laid his hands on their heads, and sent them away." The church in Antioch is a church with rivers of living water. Therefore, we must turn the student center into a ministry of living water.

42fcb03f4fb634ff073a2a025898e80d876cd24a.sourceText: 要想把学生中心的事工，办成活水江河的事工，首先活水江河的事工是國度的事工，要求凡是参与學生事工的同工，必须要有國度的观念，虽然每人都因着毕业终会离开，若是有国度的观念，知道我们所作的都不徒然，乃是为神的國度儲备人才，心中就充满喜乐，所以，我们必须要顺服圣灵的帶领，做神百般恩赐的好管家。其二，活水江河的事工也是團队的事工，楊牧师講：他有一个梦想，有太多的例子，我自己的儿女也告诉我，当华人的子弟上大学时，他们大多选泽去韓国人的大学生崇拜聚会，很少选泽去华人的大学生崇拜聚会。我梦想我们的学生中心的学生崇拜将会不一样，未来不管华语崇拜还是英语崇拜，都要吸引我们的下一代来参加，不只是我们的下一代，只要是講华语和英语的大学生，都想参加。我们拥有这样好的资源、设备，华语学生团契和英语学生团契，都要有弹性的配搭，鼓励大家湧跃參与。第三，活水江河的事工也是门徒训练的事奉。学生们在校学习，長可7年，短则一年，都要毕业。因着学生的流动性大，我们服事的同工必须要有危机感，每年总要抓紧时间培训新的信徒，使他们成为门徒。因此，我们的事工在秋季（新生来的季节）的重点是传福音，而春季（在新生来之前）的重点是门徒培训。总之，我们务要抓紧时间，予备未来的同工。
42fcb03f4fb634ff073a2a025898e80d876cd24a.translatedText: In order to turn the student-centered ministry into the ministry of Living Water Rivers, first of all, the ministry of Living Water Rivers is the ministry of the kingdom. All co-workers involved in student ministry must have the concept of the kingdom. Although Everyone will eventually leave after graduation. If we have the concept of the kingdom and know that what we do is not in vain, but is to reserve talents for the kingdom of God, our hearts will be filled with joy. Therefore, we must obey the leadership of the Holy Spirit and be good stewards of God’s various gifts. Secondly, the ministry of Living Water River is also a team ministry. Pastor Yang said: He has a dream, and there are too many examples. My own children also told me that when Chinese children go to college, most of them choose to go to Korean college student worship gatherings, and rarely choose to go to Chinese college student worship gatherings. I dream that student worship in our student center will be different. In the future, whether Chinese worship or English worship, our next generation will be attracted to participate. Not only our next generation, but also college students who speak Chinese and English will want to participate. We have such good resources and equipment. The Chinese Student Fellowship and the English Student Fellowship must be flexibly matched to encourage everyone to participate. Third, the ministry of rivers of living water is also a ministry of discipleship. Students study in school for as long as seven years or as short as one year before graduating. Due to the high mobility of students, our serving co-workers must have a sense of crisis and must seize the time to train new believers every year and make them disciples. Therefore, our ministry focuses on evangelism in the fall (the season when new students arrive) and on discipleship in the spring (before new students arrive). In short, we must seize the time to prepare future co-workers.

bb15f0428c46c2c55ddc744c534cbe859cbcd622.sourceText: 这个新的学生中心，一切都是新的，连闻起来都有新味道。希望同工们要好好保养它，最重要的是，要尽量使用它，为的是把福音传给周围的学生，把学生的信徒建造成耶稣基督的门徒。学生事工是神托付给教会的事工，学生中心是神托付给教会的产业。现在，神既然已經广开福音的门，也提供丰富的资源，让我们忠心信实的、建造學生事工为活水江河的事工，帶领学生们进入救恩，也为神國培植人才，使神得着一切的荣耀！
bb15f0428c46c2c55ddc744c534cbe859cbcd622.translatedText: In this new student center, everything is new, even it smells new. I hope that the co-workers will take good care of it and, most importantly, use it as much as possible in order to spread the gospel to the surrounding students and build the student believers into disciples of Jesus Christ. Student ministry is a ministry entrusted to the church by God, and the student center is an inheritance entrusted to the church by God. Now, since God has opened the door to the gospel widely and provided abundant resources, let us be faithful and faithful, build the student ministry into a river of living water, lead the students into salvation, and cultivate talents for the kingdom of God, so that God can gain all the glory!

204644effd5566a9afe5105568539364ab29b15e.sourceText: 庆典结束后，有丰盛的茶点和水果，会众们兴致勃勃地談論和赞美，神的大能成就了如此美事，大家有信心把学生中心，办成一个讨神喜悅的活水江河，让更多的学生在此认识神，得到神的真理和神的爱。阿们！
204644effd5566a9afe5105568539364ab29b15e.translatedText: After the celebration, there were sumptuous refreshments and fruits. The congregants talked and praised enthusiastically. God’s power has accomplished such beautiful things. Everyone has the confidence to turn the student center into a river of living water that pleases God, allowing more students to know God and gain God’s truth and God’s love. Amen!

3b7032c1572e8b8e05dd735fdba2274973dcc959.sourceText: 孙如新：我的悬念 ，我的梦——九一八事变，八十一周年纪念的省思

85379e827237ac6260b140ad3af764acd1662604.sourceText: 孙如新：我的悬念 ，我的梦——九一八事变，八十一周年纪念的省思 我的悬念 我的梦 九一八事变，八十一周年纪念的省思 我是一个已年近八十的中国人，在我一生的前十年从出生到日本投降都生长在日军侵华惨绝人寰的悲惨世界里，我能说什么？几个中国人?#36827;去?#20102;钓鱼台几次（查查历史，中国比日本当然祘得上是主权所有国）就惊动了日，美二国，在日，美安保的旗帜下一起开始吹起走夜路的哨子了。（凤凰卫视的世纪大讲堂最近有一集钓鱼台风云，由罗援将军主讲，值得一看。 比起日本在中国不请自来?#36827;出了八年，杀人放火，无恶不作，如今居然躲在美国的大腿后面，自称卫护地区和平，频频联合军演，真是寡廉鲜耻，不知羞耻为何物！不但举世有识之大引以为耻，更使大多数善良，务实的日本人民在国际社会上丢尽了脸。 大陆在硬实力突飞猛进的同时应积极进行软实力的建设，期能发展成一个现代化的大国。请问，谁敢欺侮俄国及韩国？ 中国人应发挥民族宏观的大智慧，打破中国人是一盘散沙的诅咒。 针对美，日，韩，印度及澳洲的所谓第一，二战略岛链及相关对领土有争议的岛屿，中国及台湾应共同建立一个有份量的战略中心，在历史上，经济上，国际法及国际海洋法上，（军事）战略上，深入广泛研讨，求得最佳策略，然后很有默契地少说多做，才能有实际，持久的效果。 一个国家，民族如果语言，文字，文化不能充分沟通则无从发挥统合力量，当然不易进步，成为一个强大的现代化国家。所以汉字一统，及文化的传承及发扬光大都是中华民族的一等根本大事。最近我常看一个?#25991;明之旅?#30340;节目，现场中有北大，清华的学生及欧，美，日，韩的学者，大家专心听讲热烈讨论，连我这个坐在电视机前的老头子也像在爷爷脚下听故事的孩子一样，听得悠然神往，觉得无尚光荣。 中华民族，不管来自海内外何方，属于什么侨国，都有一个最大公约数（一个共同的交集），那就是我们子孙的永续生存及中华民族的强大兴盛。老友崔增祁先生嘱我写一点九一八感想，想这想那，说这说那，不如我们卷起袖子来，大家一起尽我们应有的本份，DO IT, JUST DO IT! 孙如新
85379e827237ac6260b140ad3af764acd1662604.translatedText: Sun Ruxin: My suspense , My Dream - September 18th Incident, Reflections on the 81st Anniversary My Suspense My Dream September 18th Incident, Reflections on the 81st Anniversary I am a Chinese who is nearly eighty years old. In the first ten years of my life, from birth to Japan's surrender, I grew up in the tragic world of the Japanese invasion of China. What can I say? A few Chinese people went to Diaoyutai a few times (check history, China is certainly more sovereign than Japan), which alarmed Japan and the United States. Under the banner of Japanese and American security, they began to blow whistles at night. (Phoenix TV’s Century Lecture Hall recently had an episode of Diaoyutai Storm, delivered by General Luo Yuan, which is worth watching. Compared with Japan, which has been in China uninvited for eight years, committing murder and arson, and committing all kinds of evil, now it is hiding behind the thigh of the United States, claiming to protect regional peace, and conducting frequent joint military exercises. It is really shameless and shameless! While China's hard power is advancing by leaps and bounds, it should actively build its soft power in order to develop into a modern power. Who dares to bully Russia and South Korea? The Chinese should use the great wisdom of the nation to break the curse that the Chinese are a piece of sand. Regarding the so-called first and second strategic island chains of the United States, Japan, South Korea, India and Australia, as well as related islands with disputed territories, China and Taiwan should jointly establish a strategic center with significant weight. They should conduct in-depth and extensive discussions on history, economy, international law and international law of the sea, and (military) strategy to find the best strategy, and then talk less and do more in a tacit understanding, so that practical and lasting results can be achieved. If a country or nation cannot fully communicate in language, writing, and culture, it will not be able to exert its unifying power, and of course it will not be easy to progress and become a strong modern country. Therefore, the unification of Chinese characters, the inheritance and promotion of culture are the first-class fundamental issues of the Chinese nation. Recently I often read?#25. 991;Ming Dynasty Journey?#30340; program, there were students from Peking University, Tsinghua University and scholars from Europe, the United States, Japan and Korea. Everyone listened attentively to the lectures and had lively discussions. Even me, an old man sitting in front of the TV, was like a child listening to a story at the feet of his grandfather. He listened leisurely and fascinated and felt it was extremely glorious. The Chinese nation, no matter where they come from at home or abroad, and what country they belong to, have one greatest common denominator (a common intersection), which is the sustainable survival of our descendants and the strong prosperity of the Chinese nation. My old friend Mr. Cui Zengqi asked me to write down some thoughts on September 18th. If I think about this and that, why don’t we roll up our sleeves and do our part together, DO IT, JUST DO IT! Sun Ruxin

b714f7ba40f706b9c33c62c2ae5f8bcfe2a35238.sourceText: 问：我的房子就快要被银行收去法拍了?对于我后来第二贷款拿出5万美金做生意那部分是否仍要负责,第一个银行如果卖不够的部份,我是否也仍要 负责?另外有朋友告诉我,可以用银行无法提出我原来的借贷文件(Promissory note) 而作为抗告,让银行无法顺利收取我的房子,真有此事吗? 答:Arizona州有Anti-deficiency statute, 意即如果第一个银行怕卖你的房子后不够赔偿,不能再向你追溯你不足的部份,但你的第二个银行的部份不能受到保障, 你仍要负责 对于你的”Show me the Note” 这种抗告,已经有至少2个Arizona的法院认为不管用,银行仍然可以收回你的房子.
b714f7ba40f706b9c33c62c2ae5f8bcfe2a35238.translatedText: Question: My house is about to be taken over by the bank for foreclosure. Am I still responsible for the portion of the $50,000 I took out for the second loan to start my business? If the first bank sells the insufficient portion, am I still responsible? In addition, a friend told me that I can use the bank’s inability to submit my original loan document (promissory note) as a protest to prevent the bank from successfully collecting my house. Is this true? Answer: Arizona has an Anti-deficiency statute. This means that if the first bank is afraid of not being able to compensate you enough after selling your house, it can no longer trace your shortfall to you, but your second bank's part cannot be protected, and you are still responsible. Regarding your "Show me the Note" appeal, at least two Arizona courts have found that it is not valid, and the bank can still repossess your house.

6b87defed53e82f290dad5edc62a4f4e01e647ac.sourceText: 谷歌自动驾驶汽车测试扩大至亚利桑那州
6b87defed53e82f290dad5edc62a4f4e01e647ac.translatedText: Google's self-driving car test expands to Arizona

acdba47aa54b6c60a62d03c46f0f597260414197.sourceText: 谷歌自动驾驶汽车测试扩大至亚利桑那州 据路透社报道，最近谷歌母公司Alphabet表示，将自动驾驶汽车测试扩大…
acdba47aa54b6c60a62d03c46f0f597260414197.translatedText: Google's self-driving car test expands to Arizona According to Reuters, Google's parent company Alphabet recently said it would expand self-driving car testing...

b9b05701e8ef58606328bb4b523041c786acafd7.sourceText: 据路透社报道，最近 谷歌 母公司Alphabet表示，将自动驾驶汽车测试扩大至亚利桑那州菲尼克斯大都市区，使该城市成为谷歌第四个自动驾驶汽车试验地。6年来谷歌已经在加州山景、德克萨斯州奥斯汀和华盛顿州柯克兰测试自动驾驶汽车。
b9b05701e8ef58606328bb4b523041c786acafd7.translatedText: According to Reuters, Google's parent company Alphabet said it would expand self-driving car testing to the Phoenix, Arizona, metropolitan area, making the city Google's fourth self-driving car test site. Google has been testing self-driving cars in Mountain View, California, Austin, Texas, and Kirkland, Washington for six years.

d3e542c4062101eba3c2003b65eb8d8aed5183a4.sourceText: 各大汽车制造商和科技公司都在争相开发和销售自动驾驶汽车，但他们都抱怨道路安全法规阻碍了这种车辆的测试和部署。谷歌自动驾驶汽车行驶了150万英里（240万公里），多数测试发生在加州。从去年12月起，谷歌就公开反对该州政府拟议的要求在路上测试自动驾驶汽车安装方向盘、刹车板并安排司机的法规。
d3e542c4062101eba3c2003b65eb8d8aed5183a4.translatedText: Major automakers and technology companies are rushing to develop and sell self-driving cars, but they all complain that road safety regulations have hindered the testing and deployment of such vehicles. Google's self-driving cars have driven 1.5 million miles (2.4 million kilometers), with most of the testing taking place in California. Since December, Google has publicly opposed the state's proposed regulations that would require self-driving cars to be tested on the road to be equipped with steering wheels, brake pads and drivers.

e9101c414374821392ed175cd87aa73a1cb97ef5.sourceText: 谷歌自动驾驶汽车项目业务运营主管詹妮弗?#21704;龙（Jennifer Haroon）表示：”亚利桑那州以欢迎研发而著名，这能推动创新，使公司能立足。菲尼克斯都市区有与众不同的沙漠气候，可帮助我们更好地了解传感器和汽车处理极端温度和空中沙尘如何。”谷歌称，测试司机最近开始在菲尼克斯都市区周围驾驶四辆雷克萨斯RX450h SUV，以制作详细的包含街道、道路标志、交通信号和限高信息的地图。
e9101c414374821392ed175cd87aa73a1cb97ef5.translatedText: Jennifer Long, head of business operations for Google’s self-driving car project "Arizona is known for welcoming research and development, which drives innovation and enables companies to gain a foothold," said Haroon. "The Phoenix metropolitan area has a distinctive desert climate that helps us better understand how sensors and cars handle extreme temperatures and airborne dust." Google said test drivers recently began driving four Lexus RX450h SUVs around the Phoenix metropolitan area to create detailed maps of streets, road signs, traffic signals and height limit information.

3dfc67e06af42e7b35f0dd8e5b5325126f495392.sourceText: 谷歌自动驾驶汽车2月14日在山景市撞到一辆公共汽车，谷歌称将为此事故承担”部分责任”，这是谷歌自动驾驶汽车首次因故障发生事故。该公司称，将修改软件以避免再次发生事故。美国国家公路交通安全管理局1月表示，正在为希望在7月前推出产品的州和汽车制造商研究制定新的自动驾驶汽车指南。该机构周五将在华盛顿举行自动驾驶指南首次公开听证会。
3dfc67e06af42e7b35f0dd8e5b5325126f495392.translatedText: A Google self-driving car hit a bus in Mountain View on February 14. Google said it would bear "partial responsibility" for the accident. This was the first time a Google self-driving car had an accident due to malfunction. The company said it would modify the software to avoid another incident. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said in January it was working on new self-driving vehicle guidelines for states and automakers hoping to launch products by July. The agency will hold its first public hearing on self-driving guidelines in Washington on Friday.

c90991cc0045bc486569f5a30c8a9ba8f31b8809.sourceText: 今年2月该机构表示，按照联邦法律，驾驶谷歌汽车的人工智能系统应被视为司机，为批准自动驾驶汽车最终上路行驶迈出重要一步。（木秀林）
c90991cc0045bc486569f5a30c8a9ba8f31b8809.translatedText: In February this year, the agency said that in accordance with federal law, the artificial intelligence system driving Google's car should be considered a driver, taking an important step towards approving self-driving cars to eventually hit the road. (Mu Xiulin)

a8e7e02a3ba8d6444abf5d116680f66d287fd846.sourceText: 金龙起舞庆龙年。三月十日，一条请自土桑市，由龙冈刘家班舞起的十五尺的长龙，在六福酒家给各位嘉宾拜年，揭开了凤凰城龙冈公所春宴的序幕。龙冈团体由刘、关、张、赵四姓组成，本身就是一个华人社区大家庭的宿影。历年来，参加龙冈春宴的贵宾，除四姓亲人外，不乏各界朋友和社会贤达前来道贺，宾主一起渡过温馨愉快的迎春联谊之夜。这话并不虚言，近日，就有已超过百年历史的美国龙冈总公所，其属下刊物《龙冈季刊》撰文，把本埠资深侨领余文劲先生称为是最好的”龙冈之友”，并向全美及世界四姓乡亲广为介绍，亦令到我本地的龙冈团体亦增色不少。故此，本届主席张华芳在春宴致辞时，不忘衷心感谢历年来这些古道热肠的朋友，对我们龙冈公所给予的热心扶持和关怀帮助，席中除了有外埠客人、阖家齐贺、老友团体、旧雨新知外，还有余文劲先生、邓朝驹先生、余长存先生厖等等，多不胜数。主席张华芳还对本埠龙冈创始人刘汝璋、关锡樵、关宗任以及龙冈团队进行表扬，勉励大家日后对龙冈和华人社区作出更大的贡献。
a8e7e02a3ba8d6444abf5d116680f66d287fd846.translatedText: The golden dragon dances to celebrate the Year of the Dragon. On March 10th, a 15-foot long dragon danced by the Longgang Liu Family Troupe from Tucson City greeted the guests at Luk Fook Restaurant, kicking off the Spring Banquet of Longgang Office in Phoenix City. The Longgang group consists of the four surnames Liu, Guan, Zhang and Zhao, and is itself the shadow of a large Chinese community family. Over the years, in addition to relatives of the four surnames, many distinguished guests attending the Longgang Spring Banquet, including friends from all walks of life and social figures, came to express their congratulations. The guests and hosts spent a warm and joyful Spring Festival evening together. This is true. Recently, the Longgang General Office of the United States, which has a history of more than a century, wrote an article in its subsidiary publication "Longgang Quarterly", calling Mr. Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader in this city, the best "Friend of Longgang". He has widely introduced it to fellow citizens of all four surnames in the United States and the world, and it has also added a lot to my local Longgang group. Therefore, when the current Chairman Zhang Huafang delivered his speech at the Spring Banquet, he did not forget to express his heartfelt thanks to these warm-hearted friends over the years for their enthusiastic support and care for our Longgang Office. In addition to guests from out of town, family members, old friend groups, old friends and new acquaintances, there were also Mr. Yu Wenjin, Mr. Deng Chaoju, Mr. Yu Changcun, Pang, and so on. Chairman Zhang Huafang also praised the founders of Longgang, Liu Ruzhang, Guan Xiqiao, Guan Zongren, and the Longgang team, and encouraged everyone to make greater contributions to Longgang and the Chinese community in the future.

d58e481dee06240c9f24dba862abca7f977168d9.sourceText: 凤凰城龙冈公所的春宴，素来都是缤纷热闹，年年新鲜。今年请来凤凰选美大公主陈伊恩小姐，门前迎宾展笑脸；耆英会一班”老友记”，粉墨登场，服装抢眼鲜艳，歌声美妙舞翩翩；主席华芳之女芳菲年华，连弹带唱歌声甜，引来掌声不断。更具吸引力的，当然还少不了抽奖悬念：六福酒家送出了实惠餐券；关宗任老先生所赠十块银洋光芒凸显；刘全知副主席捐高清电视，SONY名牌三十二吋，中奖者惊喜频上脸；刘汝璋顾问从怀中掏出那双人双程机票，到温哥华之旅绝非虚言。抽中的幸运儿都皆大欢喜，席中的客人也哄闹连连，司仪关嬿仪端庄中不忘嬉戏台山方言，全过程欢乐流涟。不知不觉中又到祝福时刻，主席带领全体董事，以茶代酒逐檯道谢美言。筵席将散大家声声道别，闪光灯中留下倩影串串。有道是「龙冈龙年迎贵客，四姓百姓渡新年」，凤凰城龙冈公所在此再次多谢各位嘉宾的莅临，我们再会明年！
d58e481dee06240c9f24dba862abca7f977168d9.translatedText: The spring banquet of Longgang Office in Phoenix City has always been colorful and lively, fresh every year. This year, Miss Chen Yiyan, the princess of the Phoenix pageant, was invited to greet guests at the door with a smiling face; a group of "Old Friends" from the Senior Youth Association appeared on stage, with eye-catching and bright costumes, and beautiful singing and dancing; the daughter of Chairman Hua Fang, who is still young, sang sweetly and sang with sweet music, which attracted continuous applause. What was even more attractive, of course, was the suspense of the lottery: Luk Fook Restaurant gave away affordable meal coupons; Mr. Guan Zongren’s gift of ten pieces of silver was highlighted; Vice Chairman Liu Quanzhi donated a high-definition TV, a 32-inch SONY brand, and the winner was always surprised; Consultant Liu Ruzhang took out the round-trip air tickets for two people from his arms, and the trip to Vancouver was no lie. The lucky ones who were drawn were all very happy, and the guests at the banquet were also noisy. The master of ceremony, Guan Yanyi, was dignified but did not forget to play with the Taishan dialect, and the whole process was full of joy. Unknowingly, it was time to give blessings again. The chairman led all the directors to express their kind words of thanks one by one with tea instead of wine. As the banquet was about to break up, everyone said goodbye, leaving behind a string of beautiful figures in the flashing lights. There is a saying that "Longgang welcomes distinguished guests in the Year of the Dragon, and ordinary people of all four surnames celebrate the New Year." Longgang Office in Phoenix City would like to thank all the guests again for coming. See you next year!

8dda7a6fb3e832aeb82642ee7205ee96cc9945c9.sourceText: 邓文迪的人生样板戏 2011年7月19日，深陷”窃听门”丑闻的传媒帝国&#8221…
8dda7a6fb3e832aeb82642ee7205ee96cc9945c9.translatedText: Wendi Deng's life model drama On July 19, 2011, the media empire was deeply involved in the "wiretapping scandal"...

49a150b1aabb41c9cd2f71291d51d772f0095060.sourceText: 虽然因此举而名扬英国朝野，邓文迪的人生传奇对读者来说却早已不陌生。 2010年全球十大超级富豪太太榜首、2011年全球十大顶级豪门阔太第五棗人们用”中国最富有的女人”、”一个传奇的中国女人”等语言指称这个来自中国济南的传奇女子自然不足为过。 好心夫妇的尴尬结局 邓文迪原名邓文革，1984年考入广州医学院之前在济南和徐州生活。她命运的转折点发生于1987年与一对美国夫妇的相识。50岁的Jake Cherry先生在广州一家企业工作，妻子随行。Cherry夫妇不仅帮助邓文迪练习英文，更为她留学美国直至成为世界传媒帝国之后铺平了第一步道路。
49a150b1aabb41c9cd2f71291d51d772f0095060.translatedText: Although it became famous in the British government and the public for this incident, Wendi Deng's life legend is no longer unfamiliar to readers. Ranked first among the world's top ten super-rich wives in 2010 and fifth among the world's top ten wealthy wives in 2011, it is not an exaggeration to refer to this legendary woman from Jinan, China, with words such as "China's richest woman" and "a legendary Chinese woman". The embarrassing ending of a well-intentioned couple. Wendi Deng, formerly known as Deng Wenge, lived in Jinan and Xuzhou before being admitted to Guangzhou Medical College in 1984. The turning point in her fate occurred when she met an American couple in 1987. Mr. Jake Cherry, 50, works in a company in Guangzhou, and his wife is accompanying him. The Cherry couple not only helped Wendi Deng practice English, but also paved the way for her to study in the United States and become a world media empire.

3fb52c80e8f6241fa8c4dc070b2106c804fcb26b.sourceText: 1988年2月，邓文迪在Cherry夫妇的帮助下获得学生签证，进入美国加州州立大学学习经济。与众多求学美国的中国学生相比，邓文迪无疑是幸运的。Cherry夫妇甚至让邓文迪和自己五岁大的女儿合用一间卧室，并且承诺资助她的学习费用。
3fb52c80e8f6241fa8c4dc070b2106c804fcb26b.translatedText: In February 1988, Wendi Deng obtained a student visa with the help of Cherry and his wife and entered California State University to study economics. Compared with many Chinese students studying in the United States, Wendi Deng is undoubtedly lucky. The Cherrys even let Wendi share a bedroom with their five-year-old daughter and promised to fund her study expenses.

41f0e8213d365028e5466354902ebfbcf8f87e8f.sourceText: 然而很对，事情却发生了令人尴尬的变局。Cherry太太发现丈夫与邓文迪有染，肃然他们的年龄相差30岁。1990年2月，邓文迪与Jake Cherry结婚，向美国社会又迈进了一步。获得美国绿卡需要在美工作和生活至少两年，两年零七个月后，邓文迪和Cherry先生的婚姻走到了尽头。而按照Cherry先生的说法，他们的关系在婚后四个月就已破裂，原因是他发现邓文迪另有情人。 嫁入豪门登上人生巅峰 1996年，邓文迪从耶鲁大学商学院毕业，准备谋求到香港发展。在飞往香港的飞机上，邓文迪坐到了默多克新闻集团的董事Bruce Churchill旁边。飞机还没到香港，邓文迪已轻而易举地谋到了卫星电视公司总部实习生的工作。自1998年初，邓文迪以默多克上海、北京之行的随行译员身份出现在这位传媒大王的身边。很快，她与年长自己38岁的默多克的暧昧关系已成公开的秘密。 1998年5月，默多克与他结婚31年的妻子安娜分手。第二年6月，他们正式签定离婚协议，之后仅仅17天，邓文迪与默多克举行了婚礼，成为这位传媒大王的第三任妻子。 安娜与默多克的离婚协议有一个条件：默多克死后，作为妻子的邓文迪无权继承他的任何遗产，除非她与默多克育有子女，邓文迪才能在子女未成年的情况下对其继承的财产予以监护。安娜很清楚，默多克被诊断患有初期前列腺癌，必须进行放射治疗，同时失去了生育能力。但安娜没有想到，默多克在接受化疗前，早已将自己的精子抽取并冷冻。2001年11月19日，依靠试管婴儿技术，邓文迪生下了她和默多克的第一个孩子，并在两年后生下了另一个孩子。
41f0e8213d365028e5466354902ebfbcf8f87e8f.translatedText: However, things took an embarrassing turn. Mrs. Cherry discovered that her husband was having an affair with Wendi Deng, and she was awestruck by the 30-year age difference between them. In February 1990, Wendi Deng married Jake Cherry, taking another step forward into American society. To obtain a U.S. green card, you need to work and live in the United States for at least two years. After two years and seven months, the marriage of Wendi Deng and Mr. Cherry came to an end. According to Mr. Cherry, their relationship broke down four months after their marriage because he discovered that Wendi Deng had another lover. Marrying into a wealthy family and reaching the pinnacle of life. In 1996, Wendi Deng graduated from Yale University Business School and prepared to seek development in Hong Kong. On the plane to Hong Kong, Wendi Deng sat next to Bruce Churchill, director of Murdoch News Corporation. Before the plane arrived in Hong Kong, Wendi Deng had easily found a job as an intern at the headquarters of a satellite TV company. Since the beginning of 1998, Wendi Deng has appeared by Murdoch's side as an interpreter during his trips to Shanghai and Beijing. Soon, her affair with Murdoch, who was 38 years her senior, became an open secret. In May 1998, Murdoch split from Anna, his wife of 31 years. In June of the following year, they officially signed a divorce agreement. Just 17 days later, Wendi Deng held a wedding with Rupert Murdoch and became the media mogul's third wife. Anna's divorce agreement with Murdoch has a condition: After Murdoch's death, Wendi Deng, as his wife, has no right to inherit any of his estate. Unless she has children with Murdoch, Wendi Deng can take custody of the inherited property when the children are minors. Anna was well aware that Murdoch had been diagnosed with early-stage prostate cancer and had to undergo radiation therapy, as well as losing his fertility. But Anna did not expect that Murdoch had already extracted and frozen his sperm before undergoing chemotherapy. On November 19, 2001, relying on in vitro fertilization technology, Wendi Deng gave birth to her and Murdoch's first child, and gave birth to another child two years later.

a44c888a88066faf23c626418c65ce691675c8c2.sourceText: 西方媒体对邓文迪的报道措辞奈人回味。The Telegraph转述默多克自己的《华尔街日报》的报道称为对Cherry太太帮助自己离开中国的回报，时年21的邓文迪夺取了她53岁的丈夫。但婚后四个月，Cherry先生就指责邓文迪与一个年轻人有私情。题为《吃人妻子如何控制默多克》的文章中，Gawker引述《纽约时报》称邓文迪甚至直接阅读默多克的私人电子邮件。
a44c888a88066faf23c626418c65ce691675c8c2.translatedText: The wording of Western media reports on Wendi Deng is evocative. The Telegraph paraphrased Murdoch's own Wall Street Journal report as saying that in return for Mrs. Cherry's help in leaving China, 21-year-old Wendi Deng took away her 53-year-old husband. But four months after the marriage, Mr. Cherry accused Wendi of having an affair with a young man. In the article titled "How a Cannibal Wife Controls Murdoch," Gawker quoted the New York Times as saying that Wendi Deng even directly read Murdoch's private emails.

1292f308705ebca3b6687247cf690c0da67854a4.sourceText: 默多克想来以强力销售和敢于冒险著称，为了进军拥有13亿人的中国市场，默多克在中央党校发表演讲，积极谋取进入中国媒体界。为了维持与政府的关系，他将播放中国负面新闻的英国广播公司（BBC）逐出他的亚洲星空卫视系统。人们热议默多克行为的媒体伦理，甚至有报道直接批评默多克的福克斯新闻（Fox），《中共掌控福克斯新闻》（Fox Owned by Communist China）。
1292f308705ebca3b6687247cf690c0da67854a4.translatedText: Murdoch is known for his strong sales and courage to take risks. In order to enter the Chinese market of 1.3 billion people, Murdoch gave a speech at the Central Party School and actively sought to enter the Chinese media industry. In order to maintain relations with the government, he expelled the BBC, which broadcast negative news about China, from his Asia Star TV system. People are hotly discussing the media ethics of Murdoch's behavior, and there are even reports directly criticizing Murdoch's Fox News, "Fox Owned by Communist China".

eb0d8ec8c42acbaa0b83b25633e98b5a4e6b4a0b.sourceText: 亚省艺术学院第一周年年庆 – 竞技才艺表演

6ebdc6479ae5fbdf4ea07a9b8f2bcdbcb9bb134b.sourceText: 亚省艺术学院第一周年年庆 – 竞技才艺表演 转眼之间，亚省艺术学院已经成立一周年了。 在短短一…
6ebdc6479ae5fbdf4ea07a9b8f2bcdbcb9bb134b.translatedText: The First Anniversary Celebration of the Alberta College of Art – The Competitive Talent Show In the blink of an eye, the first anniversary of the establishment of the Alberta College of Art has been celebrated. In just a short time...

9c0e755ed5bb9e6f1a0dc849c90023134256243b.sourceText: 转眼之间，亚省艺术学院已经成立一周年了。 在短短一年时间中，亚省艺术学院主办的活动”2015亚省春晚”,”亚省纪念抗战胜利７０周年文艺演出”引起巨大的反响。学院受邀参加侨联主办的美国国庆演出，华美专业协会年会演出，学生的精湛技艺，受到了广泛的肯定，有些学生更是在国际中国民族舞蹈比赛中斩获大。
9c0e755ed5bb9e6f1a0dc849c90023134256243b.translatedText: In the blink of an eye, the Alberta College of Art has celebrated its first anniversary. In just one year, the events hosted by the Art Institute of Alberta, "2015 Alberta Spring Festival Gala" and "Alberta Cultural Performance to Commemorate the 70th Anniversary of the Victory of the Anti-Japanese War" have aroused huge response. The college was invited to participate in the National Day performance hosted by the Overseas Chinese Federation and the annual meeting of the Chinese American Professional Association. The students' superb skills have been widely recognized, and some students have even won big prizes in international Chinese folk dance competitions.

b07ed6b8b28b2b87c604e1158b4d013f972983ae.sourceText: 学校规模不断壮大。亚省艺术学院从最早的两个大舞蹈教室，扩大为三个专业舞蹈教室，所有教学设施按照美国专业舞蹈教室的标准。亚省艺术学院不仅加强巩固了最有特色的中国民族舞蹈课，还开设了专业基本功课，肚皮舞课，交谊舞课等等。群众性舞蹈健身操，广场舞也让社区的健身气氛如火如荼。芭蕾，爵士舞也正在与新的美国舞蹈老师洽谈中，武术，双截棍这些新课程很快就会和大家见面。今年9月受广大家长的要求，亚省艺术学院在Scottsdale开设了分校。大受家长和孩子们的欢迎。为了丰富社区生活，亚省艺术学院为社区合唱团，专业讲座免费提供场所。
b07ed6b8b28b2b87c604e1158b4d013f972983ae.translatedText: The school continues to grow in size. The Art Institute of Alberta has expanded from its earliest two large dance studios to three professional dance studios. All teaching facilities are in accordance with the standards of American professional dance studios. The Art Institute of Alberta not only strengthens and consolidates the most distinctive Chinese folk dance classes, but also offers basic professional courses, belly dance classes, ballroom dance classes, etc. Mass dance aerobics and square dancing also make the community fitness atmosphere in full swing. Ballet and jazz dance are also being negotiated with new American dance teachers, and new courses such as martial arts and nunchuck will be available to everyone soon. In September this year, at the request of parents, the Art Institute of Alberta opened a branch in Scottsdale. Very popular with parents and children. In order to enrich community life, the Art Institute of Alberta provides free venues for community choirs and professional lectures.

8f77736d09762ad55bf3d68da4ccfbfede3b1b71.sourceText: 庆祝亚省艺术学院的年庆，同时感谢一年来社区同仁的支持，学院将准备一些美食小点心，与社区同仁，家长和孩子们欢聚一堂，在学校举办一场竞技才艺表演。
8f77736d09762ad55bf3d68da4ccfbfede3b1b71.translatedText: To celebrate the anniversary of the Art College of Alberta, and to thank the community colleagues for their support over the past year, the college will prepare some delicious snacks, gather with community colleagues, parents and children, and hold a competitive talent show at the school.

cce7743a66f28379fcd08df9baf7025ffb3b92a2.sourceText: 才艺表演不限年龄和节目形式。节目形式可以是舞蹈， 唱歌， 乐器等等， 只要你敢秀，我们就提供舞台。让我们把艺术和欢乐带到您的身边。
cce7743a66f28379fcd08df9baf7025ffb3b92a2.translatedText: Talent performances are not limited to age or program format. The program can be dance, singing, musical instruments, etc. As long as you dare to show off, we will provide a stage. Let us bring art and joy to you.

04aa8f335e0798813efd20ef43638b4974cabad6.sourceText: 希望社区同学们踊跃参加，更欢迎以家庭的形式报名参加，秀出每个人的精彩！每个参与者都有一份礼物。学院还将通过观众投票的方式选出最受欢迎奖。获奖者将得到非常特别的大礼。
04aa8f335e0798813efd20ef43638b4974cabad6.translatedText: We hope that students from the community will actively participate, and you are more welcome to sign up as a family to show off everyone's wonderfulness! Each participant gets a gift. The Academy will also select the Most Popular Award via audience voting. The winners will receive a very special gift.

f92c6cb484c0030aea0616de88129c9a759d1a22.sourceText: 凤凰城气如虹：天灾横祸 正当凤凰城侨界各社团的联欢春宴续进行，欢欣共聚的时候，各传播媒体如电视、广播、网路、报纸却发佈了连串不幸消息，就是龙捲风侵袭中西部几个州，后来有的州还未及时善后，再被暴雪覆盖，真个祸不单行，令人感叹。 从电视镜头看到的天灾，的确残酷。画面展示在观众的眼前，是强风吹打夹杂着冰雹袭击，房屋倒塌，车辆损毁，人们是无可奈何地逃难，有的不幸丧生，真正悲惨！有的地区房屋倒塌了，正待清理，又受一轮暴风雪进攻，厚厚的白雪覆盖着残垣断壁，此情此景，主人真个欲哭无泪。 据报导美国中西部有好几个州被龙捲风吹袭，包括爱荷华、明尼苏达、堪萨斯、奥克拉荷马以及伊利诺州和德州部分地区。其中爱荷华州中部的帕克斯堡，人口只有两千的城镇，星期日直接遭到龙捲风席捲，人们被困在倒塌的建筑物内。附近几个地区也遭殃，不仅树木倒塌、电力中断，强风还夹杂着冰雹，导致至少七人死亡，五十多人受伤。在明尼苏达州，灾情亦相当严重，龙捲风吹毁近两百间房屋，满目疮痍，造成廿多人受伤，据报有一名两岁孩童死亡，更因瓦斯外洩，迫使当地数百居民疏散。跟着还有的地方再遭暴风雪袭击，已不是雪上加霜的寒冷，而是强风吹毁暴雪盖，天灾重重。 龙捲风这个名称，小时候我在越南就听说过，而且亲眼目睹，那时在堤岸郊野游玩，雨季时节，天乌地暗，忽然刮起一阵巨风，将大量沙尘捲起成堆抛向天际，遮蔽整个大地，听见大人们高呼：「龙捲风呀！快逃避呀！」大家都跑进房屋躲藏，一阵哗啦过后，处处沙尘飞扬，没有什麽损伤。所以对于龙捲风，以往我总认为不过如此，无须惊惧。 随着年龄增长，见识增多，从各方面新闻报导，才晓得强劲的龙捲风是那麽的摧残人类，实在可怕，而小时候看到的是否龙捲风，始终成为一个疑问了。 原来龙捲风是非常勐烈的强风，属于天然气象变化，有人传说是天上的龙吸水，才形成这股庞大的力量，又有人传说是搅风搅雨的掘尾龙大发神威所致。翻阅一般科学资料描述，龙捲风是一股围绕强烈低压中心而急速旋转上升，造成斜立中空的漏斗形气流。轻微的在半空旋转，捲起沙尘；或在水面掀起波浪，威力不大；最严重的是强烈活跃的冷锋活动，在地面强烈受热，导致气流急速昇起移动，登陆时带来骤雨，并发挥其「天雨粟」的神奇威力，时速强势由一百多公里甚至高达三百公里，能捲走各种物件，破坏力极勐烈而广阔。 这次美国中西部几省的灾情严重，就证明其袭击的破坏力量不容忽视，而从各项研究消息报导，龙捲风到处都有，南极洲陆地、亚洲东部和中南部，澳大利亚和纽西兰部分地区、欧洲各处、非洲南部、南美洲中东部和加拿大南部等，都时常出现，但不知何故，美国遭受龙捲风则比其他任何国家和地区都要多，真是无可奈何的天灾横祸。 天！为什麽世界有那麽多的灾难！令人叫苦连天，有人向天发问：为什麽降下这裡多灾祸？这几年来，天灾真是越来越频繁，风灾、水灾、旱灾、地震、海啸厖动辄伤亡惨重，令人憷目惊心。 天！究竟有没有主宰？究竟有没有神灵，为什麽要接二连三降下灾难？让人受痛苦折磨？「人定胜天」，读书课本曾这样教育和勉励学生，但无情的天灾几乎否决这个理论，天灾来临人们束手无策。世界越来越发达，科技越来越高超，登陆月球，探测太空，远征宇宙，可是人类居住的地球仍然多灾多难，无法倖免。美国是世界的超级强国，对强风侵袭，竟不能阻挡，其他弱势的国土与人民，就更难对抗各种天灾横祸了。
f92c6cb484c0030aea0616de88129c9a759d1a22.translatedText: Phoenix City is in full swing: a natural disaster. While the Spring Festival banquet of various overseas Chinese associations in Phoenix City continues and they gather together happily, various media such as TV, radio, the Internet, and newspapers have released a series of unfortunate news, that is, tornadoes have invaded several states in the central and western regions. Later, some states did not deal with the aftermath in time, and were covered by blizzards. It is really sad that misfortunes never come singly. The natural disasters seen through TV cameras are indeed cruel. The picture is displayed in front of the audience. It is strong winds and hail attacks. Houses collapsed and vehicles were damaged. People had no choice but to flee, and some unfortunately lost their lives. It is truly tragic! In some areas, houses collapsed and were waiting to be cleaned up. Another blizzard hit. Thick white snow covered the ruins. This scene made the owner really want to cry. Tornadoes were reported to have hit several states in the Midwest, including Iowa, Minnesota, Kansas, Oklahoma, and parts of Illinois and Texas. Among them, Parkersburg in central Iowa, a town with a population of only 2,000, was directly swept by a tornado on Sunday, and people were trapped in collapsed buildings. Several nearby areas were also hit, with downed trees and power outages. Strong winds were also mixed with hail, killing at least seven people and injuring more than 50 people. In Minnesota, the disaster was also quite serious. The tornado destroyed nearly 200 houses, leaving them devastated, injuring more than 20 people, and a two-year-old child was reported dead. Hundreds of local residents were forced to evacuate due to gas leaks. As other places were hit by snowstorms again, it was no longer the cold that made the weather worse, but the strong winds that destroyed the snow cover, causing many natural disasters. I had heard the name "tornado" when I was a child in Vietnam, and witnessed it with my own eyes. At that time, I was playing in the countryside on the embankment. During the rainy season, the sky was dark, and a huge wind suddenly blew up, throwing a large amount of sand and dust into the sky, covering the entire earth. I heard the adults shouting: "Tornado! Run away!" Everyone ran into the house to hide. After a burst of noise, dust was flying everywhere, and there was no damage. So in the past, I always thought that tornadoes were nothing more than that and there was no need to be afraid. As I grow older and gain more knowledge, I realize from various news reports that powerful tornadoes can devastate humans and are truly terrifying. Whether the tornadoes I saw when I was a child has always been a question. It turns out that tornadoes are very strong winds, which are changes in natural gas phenomena. Some people say that a dragon in the sky absorbs water to form this huge force, and some people say that it is caused by the great power of a dragon that stirs up wind and rain. Looking through general scientific information, a tornado is a rapidly rotating and rising airflow around a strong low-pressure center, creating an oblique and hollow funnel-shaped airflow. It spins slightly in mid-air, kicking up sand and dust; or it stirs up waves on the water surface, which is not very powerful; the most serious is the activity of a strong and active cold front, which is strongly heated on the ground, causing the airflow to rise and move rapidly, bringing showers when it lands, and exerting its magical power of "raindrops from the sky". The speed is strong from more than 100 kilometers per hour or even up to 300 kilometers per hour, and can sweep away various objects. The destructive power is extremely fierce and extensive. The severe disasters in several provinces in the midwestern United States this time prove that the destructive power of their attacks cannot be ignored. According to various research reports, tornadoes occur everywhere, in Antarctica, eastern and south-central Asia, parts of Australia and New Zealand, various parts of Europe, southern Africa, central and eastern South America, and southern Canada. However, for some reason, the United States suffers more tornadoes than any other country and region. It is really a helpless natural disaster. sky! Why are there so many disasters in the world! People were complaining so much that some people asked the sky: Why are there so many disasters here? In recent years, natural disasters have become more and more frequent. Winds, floods, droughts, earthquakes, and tsunamis often cause heavy casualties, which is shocking. sky! Is there a master? Are there gods? Why do they bring disasters one after another? Make people suffer? "Man can conquer nature," textbooks once taught and encouraged students, but ruthless natural disasters have almost overturned this theory, and people are helpless when natural disasters come. The world is becoming more and more developed, and technology is becoming more and more advanced. We have landed on the moon, explored space, and gone on expeditions into the universe. However, the earth inhabited by humans is still troubled by disasters and cannot be spared. The United States is the world's superpower, but it is unable to stop strong winds. It is even more difficult for other vulnerable countries and people to fight against various natural disasters.

55e47188d4c4303f28ddee956204a48eb37fa845.sourceText: 媒体指中国权贵控制房源推高房价 ”当户口腐败反复出现在房产丑闻中，中国人愤怒了”，…
55e47188d4c4303f28ddee956204a48eb37fa845.translatedText: The media accuses China’s elites controlling housing supply and driving up housing prices. "When household registration corruption appears repeatedly in real estate scandals, Chinese people are angry",...

18ab68c40be7e732aa6611ae394d1c9e8a2fc682.sourceText: ”中国权贵的双重人格综合征”，亚洲通讯社6日以此为题报道称，最新被爆出类似丑闻的是广东省陆丰市公安系统的高官赵海滨，他的两个身份证照片甚至都一样，据称在当地无人不知。《卫报》说，赵海滨被指认非法拥有192套房子，”这是令人震惊的、创纪录的数字”，他也被愤怒的中国网民们称为”房爷”。此前同样利用假身份证拥有41套住房、房产总估价超过10亿元人民币的陕西省神木县银行副行长龚爱爱已经被拘留，她被称为”房姐”。而已被拘捕、家族拥有约30套住房的河南省郑州市某区房管局原局长翟振锋则被称为”房叔”。报道称，贪官利用假身份证逃避规制、囤积房地产成为目前中国社会议论的热门话题，坐拥几十套住房者无不拥有”双重身份”，而没有政府背景或警方的关系渠道，是难以进行身份伪造的。
18ab68c40be7e732aa6611ae394d1c9e8a2fc682.translatedText: "Dual Personality Syndrome of China's powerful people", Asia News Agency reported on the 6th under the title that the latest person to be exposed in a similar scandal is Zhao Haibin, a senior official in the public security system of Lufeng City, Guangdong Province. His two ID cards even have the same photo, which is said to be unknown to everyone in the local area. The Guardian said that Zhao Haibin was accused of illegally owning 192 houses, "which is a shocking and record-breaking number." He was also called "Fang Ye" by angry Chinese netizens. Gong Aiai, the deputy president of the bank in Shenmu County, Shaanxi Province, who also used a fake ID to own 41 houses with a total real estate value of more than 1 billion yuan, has been detained. She is called the "Fang Sister". Zhai Zhenfeng, the former director of the housing management bureau of a district in Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, who has been arrested and whose family owns about 30 houses, is known as "Uncle Fang." According to reports, corrupt officials' use of fake IDs to evade regulations and hoard real estate has become a hot topic in Chinese society. People who own dozens of houses all have "dual identities." Without government background or police connections, it is difficult to forge identities.

c865528c6d08d12972e70687cb166c57b9f4e4d8.sourceText: 《华尔街日报》6日说，中国的户口制度本身就因强行控制人口的地域流动、制造城乡差别而饱受诟病，而现在假身份证被恣意伪造，警方协助特权阶层弄虚作假，更激起了社会对于户口制度的不满和批评。美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）6日说，最新被曝光的”房爷”赵海滨被认为是中国公安部门内部腐败的反映之一。尽管中国公安部表示近年已经处理了违法办理户口的民警121人，但外界认为，这一系统及制度内存在的毒瘤”远远没有被摘除”。
c865528c6d08d12972e70687cb166c57b9f4e4d8.translatedText: The Wall Street Journal said on the 6th that China's household registration system itself has been criticized for forcibly controlling the geographical flow of the population and creating differences between urban and rural areas. Now fake ID cards are being forged at will, and the police are assisting the privileged class in committing fraud, which has aroused social dissatisfaction and criticism of the household registration system. CNN said on the 6th that the latest exposed "Fang Ye" Zhao Haibin is considered to be one of the reflections of internal corruption in China's public security department. Although China's Ministry of Public Security stated that it has dealt with 121 police officers who illegally registered household registration in recent years, outsiders believe that the system and the cancer within it are "far from being removed."

2464b267ebb53ffd2608a1e8e510a6388db59c85.sourceText: 路透社6日报道说，中国民众对于”房爷”和”房姐”们的愤怒因房价的居高不下而更加高涨。房价和炒房问题是中国当下最为敏感的话题，即将于今年3月任期届满的中国政府一直表示将努力控制房价，但是限购令并不能阻止一些人通过各种手段弄虚作假。在过去的数月，中国的房地产价格快速回暖，一二线城市房价重新进入上升的节奏。有消息说，北京等一线城市将于3月份推出新的房地产限令，但也有很多人对这些政策的效果不抱希望。《卫报》称，中国社会上存在着大量坐拥房产作为财富保值，或以投机炒房为生的人群，”房爷”和”房姐”们控制大量房源，进一步推高了房价，也使得中国社会内部业已存在的收入鸿沟和心态裂痕进一步扩大，”中国日益拉大的贫富差距，已经反映为大量无房者和少数拥有很多房产的特权阶层的差距”。
2464b267ebb53ffd2608a1e8e510a6388db59c85.translatedText: Reuters reported on the 6th that the Chinese people's anger towards "fang lords" and "fang sisters" has become even higher because of the high housing prices. Housing prices and real estate speculation are the most sensitive topics in China at the moment. The Chinese government, which is about to expire in March this year, has always stated that it will work hard to control housing prices. However, the purchase restriction order cannot prevent some people from using various means to cheat. In the past few months, China's real estate prices have recovered rapidly, and housing prices in first- and second-tier cities have returned to an upward trend. There is news that first-tier cities such as Beijing will introduce new real estate restrictions in March, but many people have no hope for the effectiveness of these policies. The Guardian stated that there are a large number of people in Chinese society who own real estate as a store of wealth, or who make a living by speculating in real estate. "Fang Lords" and "Fang Sisters" control a large number of houses, further pushing up housing prices, and further widening the existing income gap and psychological rifts within Chinese society. "China's widening gap between rich and poor has been reflected in the gap between the large number of people without houses and the small number of privileged classes who own many houses."

e990ed79d11345b3505ef3b399d787159e07c927.sourceText: ”中国官员违法聚敛房产的丑闻让外界进一步关注官员腐败和中国繁荣的房地产市场之间的关系”，《华尔街日报》6日说，房价已经和中国愈演愈烈的反腐问题紧密联系在一起。《日本经济新闻》6日报道说，中国正在刮起反腐风暴，人们希望那些腐败官员被尽快揪出来。不过，不断爆出的官员丑闻也在考验执政党在民众当中的公信力。一些学者呼吁中国应该向美国和日本学习，严令官员披露财产信息，并且开征房产税，在上海、广东已经采取了类似的试点，但也有政府官员和专家指出目前尚难以全面实施这些措施。
e990ed79d11345b3505ef3b399d787159e07c927.translatedText: "The scandal of Chinese officials illegally amassing real estate has further focused the outside world on the relationship between official corruption and China's booming real estate market." The Wall Street Journal said on the 6th that housing prices have been closely linked to China's intensifying anti-corruption problem. "Nihon Keizai Shimbun" reported on the 6th that an anti-corruption storm is brewing in China, and people hope that corrupt officials will be uncovered as soon as possible. However, the official scandals that continue to break out are also testing the credibility of the ruling party among the people. Some scholars have called on China to learn from the United States and Japan, strictly require officials to disclose property information, and impose property taxes. Similar pilot projects have been adopted in Shanghai and Guangdong, but some government officials and experts point out that it is still difficult to fully implement these measures.
