d7116b8bd8832bd1906a2de56574251f45eee2d6.sourceText: 出租房子时，还可以利用「红利折旧」（Bonus Depreciation）来省税，联邦政府今年延长了该税法的有效期，对屋主非常有利。房屋每年都有折旧，在作出租用时，折旧部分可以比正常折旧额高不 少，这样，从租金收入中扣除的折旧、维修等支出部分就多了，屋主要为租金所得而支付的税就少了。换而言之，屋主从出租中所得的收入就高了。
d7116b8bd8832bd1906a2de56574251f45eee2d6.translatedText: When renting out a home, you can also use "Bonus Depreciation" to save taxes. The federal government has extended the validity period of this tax law this year, which is very beneficial to homeowners. Houses are depreciated every year. When renting, the depreciation part can be much higher than the normal depreciation amount. In this way, more depreciation, maintenance and other expenses will be deducted from the rental income, and the tax the landlord has to pay on the rental income will be less. In other words, the homeowner’s income from renting is higher.

658513d6a87e925f9b00c86789a2e1533e2bbcbc.sourceText: 如果有人打算卖掉手头的房子，再买进新的房子，就可以利用「1031」延税办法，这是利用「卖」与「买」房屋交易的时间差延迟交税。举例来说，以前 10万元买的房子，现在25万元卖出，赚了15万元，如果国税局按30%的比率收税，屋主就需要交5万元税。如果利用「1031」的方法，在规定的时间内 买了另一幢房子，那这5万元税就不需要现在付了，可以留到以后卖这幢房的时候再付。当然「1031」延税方法要符合不少要求，比如必须是投资用房换投资用 房，不能换自住房；交易必须在规定的时间内完成；新购的房子必须等同或大于旧房子的价值等。使用「1031」延税必须提早准备，并在税务专家的指导下严格 按照「1031」要求进行交换，以免造成不必要的损失。
658513d6a87e925f9b00c86789a2e1533e2bbcbc.translatedText: If someone plans to sell the house on hand and buy a new house, they can use the "1031" tax deferral method, which uses the time difference between the "selling" and "buying" transactions to delay paying taxes. For example, if a house bought for 100,000 yuan is now sold for 250,000 yuan and a profit of 150,000 yuan is made, if the Internal Revenue Service charges a tax at a rate of 30%, the homeowner will need to pay a tax of 50,000 yuan. If you use the "1031" method to buy another house within the specified time, then the tax of 50,000 yuan does not need to be paid now, and can be paid later when the house is sold. Of course, the "1031" tax deferral method must meet many requirements. For example, the investment house must be exchanged for an investment house and cannot be exchanged for a home; the transaction must be completed within the specified time; the newly purchased house must be equal to or greater than the value of the old house, etc. To use "1031" tax deferral, you must prepare in advance and strictly follow the "1031" requirements for exchange under the guidance of tax experts to avoid unnecessary losses.

511b4e20c122be99e6086e48f589db91b913501e.sourceText: 带什么本事来美国？ 陈晚 萨马兰奇有句话，说的特别简单而深刻。他说，人类有五种通用语言，金钱，战争，艺术，性和体育。萨翁的这句话，对我们大有启发。 出国留洋，就怕孤苦零丁如浮萍。但如果你能在萨翁所言的艺术和体育方面有所追求，来到美国之后，你就不会太孤单。因为艺术和体育是人类共同的语言，在这两个领域，你很容易在异国他乡找到你心仪的同路人。 你可以不富有，你可以没有性伙伴，但被艺术气息和体育爱好装备的人，比起那些对此毫无兴趣的人而言，更容易摆脱留学时的寂寞和荒凉。比如一场电影或者一场音乐会，或者一场与人共享的球赛，就可以挤走你的寂寞。难道不是这样吗？ 人们总说要融入美国主流，但又不知从何下手。当美国人侃侃而谈一部电影，或者当他们议论一场球赛时，我们呆若木鸡，仿佛是鸡听鸭讲。其实无论在世界何地，要想入乡随俗，一定要熟悉当地老百姓喜欢的话题才行。而这些，和学业是否精深关系并不大，和SAT满分也没什么关连。 在美国主流社会中游荡的人，不一定精通阿基米德定律和立体几何。但美国主流社会中的人，甚至仅是青涩的美国中小学生，他们大多数会在艺术或体育领域有着发自内心的兴趣。有些美国孩子，甚至可以达到艺术和体育一起开花。 美国学校里的戏剧表演，交响乐队，歌唱团，诗歌俱乐部，读书会，画展等，无疑都属于艺术范畴。而美国学校里各种大众球类运动，中长跑，冰球，体育拉拉队等，当属萨翁谈及的体育活动。其实我们这些美国华人家长，每天忙忙碌碌为孩子操心的，除了关心学业，就是应付孩子艺术和体育方面的训练与培养。学钢琴学提琴，学游泳学打球，就是在这两方面的具体体现。 中国孩子向来不怕考试，能出国的孩子，智商也不会太差。要想在美国如鱼得水，留学生不妨参照一下萨翁的”人类五种语言论”，努力加强自己在艺术和体育方面的修养。修养良好的人，也容易自信。而自信，是我们万万需要的。尤其是漂洋过海的留学生，自信显得尤其重要。
511b4e20c122be99e6086e48f589db91b913501e.translatedText: What skills did you bring to the United States? Chen Wan Samaranch has a saying that is very simple and profound. He said that humans have five universal languages, money, war, art, sex and sports. Savon's words are of great inspiration to us. When you go abroad to study abroad, you are afraid of being alone like duckweed. But if you can pursue the arts and sports that Savon mentioned, you won't be too alone after coming to the United States. Because art and sports are the common languages ​​of mankind, in these two fields, you can easily find your favorite fellow travelers in foreign countries. You don’t have to be rich, you don’t have to have sexual partners, but people who are equipped with artistic atmosphere and sports hobbies can more easily get rid of the loneliness and desolation when studying abroad than those who have no interest in it. For example, a movie or a concert, or a shared ball game can squeeze away your loneliness. Isn't that so? People always talk about wanting to integrate into mainstream America, but they don’t know where to start. When Americans talk about a movie, or when they talk about a football game, we are dumbstruck, as if we are listening to what is being said. In fact, no matter where you are in the world, if you want to do as the locals do, you must be familiar with the topics that the local people like. And these have little to do with academic proficiency, nor do they have anything to do with perfect SAT scores. People wandering around in mainstream American society are not necessarily proficient in Archimedes' laws and solid geometry. But most people in mainstream American society, or even just young American elementary and middle school students, have a sincere interest in the fields of art or sports. Some American children can even reach the point where arts and sports blossom together. Drama performances, symphony bands, singing groups, poetry clubs, book clubs, art exhibitions, etc. in American schools undoubtedly belong to the category of art. The various popular ball games in American schools, middle and long-distance running, ice hockey, sports cheerleading, etc. are undoubtedly the sports activities that Savon talked about. In fact, we Chinese American parents are busy worrying about our children every day. In addition to caring about academics, we also deal with the training and cultivation of our children in art and sports. Learning piano and violin, learning swimming and playing ball are the concrete manifestations of these two aspects. Chinese children have never been afraid of exams, and children who can go abroad will not have too bad IQs. If they want to thrive in the United States, international students may wish to refer to Savon's "Theory of Five Human Languages" and strive to strengthen their cultivation in art and sports. People who are well-educated are also prone to self-confidence. And confidence is what we absolutely need. Especially for international students who have traveled across the ocean, self-confidence is particularly important.

ddd4732b4cb4518adbeca81e75251d715d486b0e.sourceText: 又到清明回潮祭祖时（图） 广州 楊綺薇 清明节，一个踏青缅怀先人的节日，我和先生又回到他的故乡潮州祭祖。 潮州，是一个很传统很怀旧的小城。潮州古八景：凤凰时雨、北阁佛灯、西湖鱼筏、鳄渡秋风厖无不蒙着一丝丝的伤感。走在潮州的大街小巷，随处可见一些满脸沧桑、眉宇间蕴含着淡淡忧伤的老人，闲坐静品功夫茶，老电影里见过的的人力三轮车，在这里比比皆是，车夫一边敲着老式车铃，一边”叮叮当当”地穿梭于蜂拥的车流人流之中，让人有穿越之感，恍如置身于上个世纪厖 先生告诉我，在潮州，你过年可以不回来，但清明祭祖扫墓一定要回来，不然定会被视为忘根疏亲，遭人非议。所以，近几年，我们总会在清明前安排好广州的工作和家事，尽量赶回家乡祭祖扫墓。 清明前后的潮州，满街可见摆卖的各种祭拜的贡品、纸钱、香烛和鲜花，小城到处洋溢着一股浓浓的哀思和淡淡的乡愁。大伯在海外，不能回来。我们与二伯三伯还有侄子、外甥们约好上山的日子，由二伯负责准备好祭拜的各种物品和鲜花。在潮州，一直流传下来的习惯是，清明节之前上山祭拜祖先，清明节正日在家中设坛祭奠。 按照潮州习惯，在清明节前一天，我们就上山拜祭。一早，我们开车前往城外的山坟墓地，到了山脚，停好车子，带上祭品鲜花，艰难跋涉，在没有路的山上，拨开高高的野草，艰难攀登，辗转爬上陡峭的山上，最终在专门引导拜山的山民指引下，寻找到公公婆婆的坟墓，众人便分头忙着除草、培土、撒纸钱、描墓碑、摆供品，烧纸钱、燃香、跪拜、祈祷厖 立在修整一新的墓前，我双手合十，默默地怀念着公公婆婆在世时的容颜和他们二老对我的种种好。公公婆婆生前都是老实本分的人，虽然没有传奇的人生和伟大的事迹，却一生温良敦厚，乐善好施，而且教子有术，治家有方，备受邻里和后辈的敬仰。现在二老合祌长眠在山里，希望他们的灵魂不会太寂寞，作为子嗣后代，每年的清明，我们都会带上贡品，上山为二老扫墓，缅怀悼念他们！ 拜祭完公公婆婆，我们摸索着、搀扶着下山，然后驱车前往松林古寺和另两处墓地，去拜祭二伯母、和祖母。短短一个上午，我们就跑了四个地方，拜祭了五位已故亲人。 4月4日，清明节正日，潮州家家户户都在自己家中设坛拜祭祖先。我们一早就坐三轮车来到二伯家，二伯已经把拜祭的物品准备好了，我们坐着聊了一会儿，等三伯、侄子们来了，就开始轮番给祖先磕头拜祭，大家都神情凝重，毕恭毕敬的，就连侄子的儿子也很懂事地跪拜，大家都沉浸在思念故人、感恩生活的氛围里。 四月，清明，这真是一个缅怀先人的时节。在这个时节里，我们思念昨天、思念故人，我们感恩祖先，感恩生活，在长辈的身体力行之下，传统的礼俗就这样熏陶着一代又一代人….
ddd4732b4cb4518adbeca81e75251d715d486b0e.translatedText: It’s time to worship ancestors again during the Qingming Festival (Photo) Yang Qiwei, Guangzhou Qingming Festival is a festival for outings to remember ancestors. My husband and I returned to his hometown of Chaozhou to worship ancestors. Chaozhou is a very traditional and nostalgic town. The eight ancient sceneries of Chaozhou: Phoenix Rainfall, Beige Buddha Lantern, West Lake Fish Raft, and Crocodile Crossing the Autumn Wind are all covered with a trace of sadness. Walking in the streets and alleys of Chaozhou, you can see old people with aged faces and a hint of sadness in their brows everywhere, sitting quietly and sipping Kung Fu tea. The human-powered tricycles seen in old movies are everywhere here. The driver jingles the old-fashioned bell while weaving through the swarming traffic, which makes people feel like they have traveled back in time, as if they are in the huge city of the last century. My husband told me that in Chaozhou, you don’t have to come back during the Chinese New Year, but you must come back during the Qingming Festival to worship ancestors and sweep their tombs. Otherwise, you will be regarded as forgetting your roots and alienating relatives, and will be criticized by others. Therefore, in recent years, we always arrange our work and family affairs in Guangzhou before the Qingming Festival, and try our best to return to our hometown to pay homage to our ancestors and sweep their tombs. Around the Qingming Festival in Chaozhou, all kinds of tributes, paper money, incense candles and flowers can be seen on the street. The small town is filled with a deep sadness and a touch of nostalgia. My uncle is overseas and cannot come back. We made an appointment with our second uncle, third uncle, and nephews on a day to go up the mountain. The second uncle was responsible for preparing various items and flowers for worship. In Chaozhou, the custom that has been passed down is to go to the mountains to worship ancestors before Qingming Festival, and to set up altars at home on Qingming Festival. According to Chaozhou custom, we go up the mountain to worship on the day before Qingming Festival. Early in the morning, we drove to the mountain cemetery outside the city. When we got to the foot of the mountain, we parked the car, brought sacrificial flowers, and trudged hard on the roadless mountain, pushing aside the tall weeds and climbing up the steep mountain. Finally, under the guidance of the mountain people who specially guided people to worship the mountain, we found the tombs of our father-in-law and mother-in-law. Everyone was busy weeding, cultivating the soil, spreading paper money, tracing tombstones, placing offerings, burning paper money, burning incense, kneeling down, and praying. Standing in front of the newly renovated tomb, I clasped my hands and silently missed my father-in-law and mother-in-law's appearance when they were still alive and all the kindness they had to me. My father-in-law and mother-in-law were both honest and responsible people during their lifetime. Although they did not have a legendary life or great deeds, they were gentle and kind-hearted throughout their lives. They were also good at educating children and managing the family well, and were highly respected by their neighbors and descendants. Now the two elders are sleeping together in the mountains. I hope their souls will not be too lonely. As descendants, we will bring tributes and go up the mountain to sweep the graves of the two elders every year during the Qingming Festival to remember and mourn them! After paying homage to our father-in-law and mother-in-law, we groped and helped us down the mountain, and then drove to Songlin Ancient Temple and two other cemeteries to pay homage to our second aunt and grandmother. In just one morning, we visited four places and paid homage to five deceased relatives. On April 4, the official day of Qingming Festival, every household in Chaozhou sets up an altar in their homes to worship their ancestors. We arrived at the second uncle's house by tricycle early in the morning. The second uncle had already prepared the items for worship. We sat and chatted for a while. When the third uncle and nephews arrived, we started to kowtow to our ancestors in turn. Everyone looked solemn and respectful. Even the nephew's son knelt down in a sensible way. Everyone was immersed in the atmosphere of missing their old friends and being grateful for life. April, Qingming Festival, is really a time to remember our ancestors. In this season, we miss yesterday and old friends. We are grateful to our ancestors and grateful to life. With the practice of our elders, traditional etiquette and customs have been edifying generations after generations...

cb63028fbfb733a21296ee9fe8f413c058e31e66.translatedText: Federal investigators: Trump has turned the United States into the "global champion of wealth inequality" A homeless man is on the streets of Los Angeles. (Comprehensive report on the 15th) United Nations...

58437731ce6e020d26245f34637c3718ab389145.sourceText: （综合十五日电）联合国赤贫与人权特别报告员艾尔斯顿（Philip Alston）在美国进行两周的正式访问后，15日发表一份严厉批评川普政府的报告并召开记者会，谴责川普总统和共和党的国会企图把美国变成「贫富不均的世界冠军」。 这在美国国会即将通过一项独厚企业和富人的税改法案之际，不啻一记当头棒喝。
58437731ce6e020d26245f34637c3718ab389145.translatedText: (Comprehensive report on the 15th) After a two-week official visit to the United States, Philip Alston, the United Nations Special Rapporteur on extreme poverty and human rights, issued a report severely criticizing the Trump administration and held a press conference on the 15th, condemning President Trump and the Republican Congress for trying to turn the United States into a "world champion of wealth inequality." This is nothing less than a wake-up call at a time when the U.S. Congress is about to pass a tax reform bill that benefits only corporations and the wealthy.

a4224a104dcff06b1242d6d05676cbd9ffded8b4.sourceText: 法新社报导，艾尔斯顿在华府的记者会上表示，超过八分之一美国人是穷人，其中将近一半「极贫穷」，而且大部分无法脱贫。
a4224a104dcff06b1242d6d05676cbd9ffded8b4.translatedText: Agence France-Presse reported that Elston said at a press conference in Washington that more than one-eighth of Americans are poor, nearly half of them are "extremely poor", and most of them cannot escape poverty.

0456ba8280a426f754b8b4dbbfffc444c24982ef.sourceText: 他不仅警告美国国会準备仓促通过的税改法案将大幅加剧原本已极大的贫富差距，甚至谴责川普和他的共和党有意识地扭曲美国社会形态，为了让美国「成为全球最不平等的社会」。
0456ba8280a426f754b8b4dbbfffc444c24982ef.translatedText: Not only did he warn that the tax reform bill that the U.S. Congress is preparing to pass hastily will significantly exacerbate the already huge gap between rich and poor, he even accused Trump and his Republican Party of consciously distorting the American social structure in order to make the United States "the most unequal society in the world."

3c9f014dfb7aed62bab502afbeef455b8860df21.sourceText: 艾尔斯顿最近访问美国一些贫穷地区，包括加州流浪汉营地、南方小镇和遭风灾肆虐的波多黎各。
3c9f014dfb7aed62bab502afbeef455b8860df21.translatedText: Elston has recently visited some poor areas of the United States, including homeless camps in California, small towns in the South and hurricane-ravaged Puerto Rico.

9ede607ea73432374fef574229765309295c93a7.sourceText: 联合国人权委员会指派艾尔斯顿检视全球贫穷状况，有关美国的完整报告明年春才会出炉，艾尔斯顿在记者会上提出这份报告的重点。
9ede607ea73432374fef574229765309295c93a7.translatedText: The United Nations Human Rights Commission assigned Elston to review global poverty. A complete report on the United States will not be released until next spring. Elston raised the key points of the report at a press conference.

9de455bda75a5deaa61bc941e1e22e548cc05239.sourceText: 他说，美国的贫穷和贫富差距是多年政策累积的结果，但川普的税改、削减福利和健保计画，将使情况恶化。
9de455bda75a5deaa61bc941e1e22e548cc05239.translatedText: He said that poverty and the gap between rich and poor in the United States are the result of years of accumulated policies, but Trump's tax reform, welfare cuts and health care plans will worsen the situation.

b235c813b5b77cbc03d938461b961eacf00a2ad0.sourceText: 艾尔斯顿说，美国国会即将通过造福企业和富人的税改法案，将创造「贫富差距的单一最大增幅」。
b235c813b5b77cbc03d938461b961eacf00a2ad0.translatedText: Elston said that the U.S. Congress is about to pass a tax reform bill that will benefit corporations and the wealthy, which will create "the single largest increase in the gap between rich and poor."

afa3cd5d20f8d05d83dc295788b84db3c1007818.sourceText: 美国国会共和党人表示，将削减福利和健保以弥补减税造成的财政损失，艾尔斯顿警告，这将摧毁原已坑坑洞洞的穷人安全网，「贫富差距将飙高」。
afa3cd5d20f8d05d83dc295788b84db3c1007818.translatedText: Republicans in the U.S. Congress said they would cut welfare and health insurance to make up for the financial losses caused by tax cuts. Elston warned that this would destroy the already holed safety net for the poor and "the gap between the rich and the poor will soar."

9d219211cd28aef1f1e99c758d52dbd9a8bd0755.sourceText: 他说，美国可怕的贫穷和贫富差距的现象之一是再度出现寄生在十二指肠的钩虫，南方地方政府未提供乾净的水和卫生设备，民众必须自己花钱买。
9d219211cd28aef1f1e99c758d52dbd9a8bd0755.translatedText: He said that one of the terrible phenomena of poverty and wealth disparity in the United States is the reappearance of hookworms parasitic in the duodenum. Local governments in the south have not provided clean water and sanitation facilities, and people must pay for them themselves.

55912ddaebb7b0b235efc28a0c9c88d16f5d054a.sourceText: 他说，统计数字显示14%美国人生活在贫穷线以下，但有更多人在贫穷边缘，更实际的数字应是20%美国人是穷人。
55912ddaebb7b0b235efc28a0c9c88d16f5d054a.translatedText: He said that statistics show that 14% of Americans live below the poverty line, but there are more people on the edge of poverty. A more realistic figure should be that 20% of Americans are poor.

262a13af6715527ed1fb8706bee37d71563b2a4e.sourceText: 艾尔斯顿指出，沃尔玛百货员工的全职薪水不能餬口，必须仰赖政府发的食物券。
262a13af6715527ed1fb8706bee37d71563b2a4e.translatedText: Elston pointed out that Wal-Mart employees cannot live on their full-time salary and must rely on food stamps issued by the government.

fd8a160282713d2658ced9eb6a1741399b29514b.sourceText: 他说，美国的社会流动率在富国中敬陪末座，意味「美国梦正快速成为美国幻影」。「在今天的美国，穷人家的孩子几乎没有机会脱贫。穷人的声音没有机会被听到，穷人没有机会影响公共政策」。
fd8a160282713d2658ced9eb6a1741399b29514b.translatedText: He said that the social mobility rate in the United States ranks last among rich countries, which means that "the American dream is quickly becoming an American phantom." "In today's America, children from poor families have almost no chance of escaping poverty. The voices of the poor have no chance to be heard, and the poor have no chance to influence public policy."

5aca188cf4755fe1715baea80bced9fd82ba992a.sourceText: （侨联通讯）由大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会及亚省亚裔摄影协会联合举办，庆祝美国国庆”亚利桑那之美”摄影比赛圆满落下帷幕。 洪铨簇 Timothy Horng的作品”Make a wish”获得了第一名。吕宝华作品” 天公倾彩”荣获第二名。赖永发作品”马上争锋”荣获第三名。
5aca188cf4755fe1715baea80bced9fd82ba992a.translatedText: (Overseas Chinese Association Newsletter) Jointly organized by the Chinese Overseas Chinese Association of Greater Phoenix and the Asian American Photography Association of Asia, the "Beauty of Arizona" photography competition to celebrate the National Day of the United States came to a successful conclusion. Timothy Horng's work "Make a wish" won first place. Lu Baohua's work "God's Love" won the second place. Lai Yongfa's work "Right Now" won the third place.

f5323cd095194978b02ddbc43eb9f9f774fb8934.translatedText: Make a wish (photographed by Hong Quancu)

f95a8c8dfb4098e2553eb73ca0e18a53c8f514d1.translatedText: Let’s compete immediately (photographed by Lai Yongfa)

e40f388ddcc8ef41ee91ec19ea6d7bad3db93f45.sourceText: 本次比赛共二十人参加。年龄从十二岁到七十六岁，创作工具包括手机，携带型，单眼相机。 所有相片以匿名方式呈现给William Wong，林原，Linda Wei 三位评审。两阶段评审。第一阶段初选，第二阶段每张作品三位评委各给予1至5分，并充分讨论优缺点。最后以总得分在七十一张作品中决定一二三名及五个入选奖。接下来是入选奖的获奖名单和作品链接。
e40f388ddcc8ef41ee91ec19ea6d7bad3db93f45.translatedText: A total of twenty people participated in this competition. Their ages range from twelve to seventy-six, and their creative tools include mobile phones, portable cameras, and single-lens cameras. All photos were presented anonymously to three judges: William Wong, Lin Yuan, and Linda Wei. Two-stage review. In the first stage of preliminary selection, in the second stage, three judges will each give each work 1 to 5 points, and fully discuss the advantages and disadvantages. In the end, the total score will be used to determine the first, second, third and five selection prizes among the 71 works. Next is the list of winners of the selection awards and links to their works.

c0e8aff3eaa67e5492c6810f19e3df078cbd43a4.sourceText: 由大凤凰城侨联总会和亚省亚裔摄影协会联合主办的《亚歷桑那之美》摄影比赛已圆满结束。本次活动旨在丰富本地华人社区的文化艺术生活，增加国庆庆典活动內容，并通过比赛普及和提高摄影爱好者摄影水平和技巧。我们感谢社会各界人士的积极参与，感谢亚省亚裔摄影协会郑弘会长及会员们的大力支持，各位评判的专业指导。我们感谢侨联总会对本赛事的重视和关注，我们更要感谢一批为本次活动慷慨解囊，赞助经费的团体和个人，并上榜表彰，他们是：余文劲先生、余文伟夫人、余明德夫人、邓达明家人、关宗任先生、胡寿柏先生、刘全知先生、关昆容女士、张肇鸿先生及斐匿华人福利会。
c0e8aff3eaa67e5492c6810f19e3df078cbd43a4.translatedText: The "Beauty of Arizona" photography competition co-sponsored by the Overseas Chinese Federation of Greater Phoenix and the Asian Photography Association of Asia has successfully concluded. This event aims to enrich the cultural and artistic life of the local Chinese community, add content to the National Day celebrations, and popularize and improve the photography skills and skills of photography enthusiasts through the competition. We would like to thank people from all walks of life for their active participation, President Hong Zheng and members of the Asian Photography Association of Asia for their strong support, and all judges for their professional guidance. We are grateful to the Overseas Chinese Federation for attaching great importance to and paying attention to this event. We would also like to thank a group of groups and individuals who generously donated funds and funds for this event and were listed for recognition. They are: Mr. Yu Wenjin, Mrs. Yu Wenwei, Mrs. Yu Mingde, Deng Daming family, Mr. Guan Zongren, Mr. Hu Shoubai, Mr. Liu Quanzhi, Ms. Guan Kunrong, Mr. Zhang Zhaohong and the Fei Ni Chinese Welfare Association.

46661c3640bfaaa664c7e92b7b382ee0ffd55f9d.sourceText: 中华人民共和国驻洛杉矶领事馆电子信箱回复亚省时报 April 20, 2011;15 1;53pm 電子信箱回覆亞省時報 甄先生：你好！ 關於信中提到，有人稱，”領事館與亞省時報勾結，收黑錢．分贓”等，總領館認為，上述說法完全是無中生有，不符合事實。 就XX報登《換證­風波》及其編輯部文章本報編輯部答讀者問 本地ＸＸ報4月15日整版刊登《中國領事館亞省換證­風波》、《不懂事的ASU留學生》、在當地僑社攪起滿城­風雨。目前，眾說紛紜，讀者來電向本報提出詢問，編輯部根據實情作此回答澄清： 問:ＸＸ報《­風波》文說：”灰色衣服之流從我們口袋裡榨來的高額費用，一部分分給頂頭大上司─使館，一部分還­要封上媒體的嘴” 究竟是真？還是假？ 答；請看總領館的回覆郵件。十多年來，對這種便民服務，本報從來沒有收過任何費用，包括廣告費。 問:報社真的沒有得益，為何要請辦證組吃飯？ 答:證件組領事走出辦公室，遠程到僑社，為僑­胞及留學生服務。駐洛總領館這一”便民措施”在1993年就開始，起初是一年兩次。十多年來，老報人一直加入僑社的歡迎行列。直到2009年，報社還派記者到現場去，協助維持秩序、發表格、覆印、照相，等等。最後，聯絡舉辦慶功會(四十多位僑領自費用餐，辦證組和記者由本報社付費)。近兩年，有人負責聯絡辦證組，本報也少不了多次刊登消息。這次，本報又聯絡二十人與辦證組一起用餐，全部餐費由一位資深僑領與本報共同支付。我­們是期望總領館能把這項”便民措施”堅持不懈做下去，越做越好。 問:：ＸＸ報為什麼把矛頭也指向亞省時報？他­們這樣做真能達到他­們的目的嗎？ 答：的確ＸＸ報是在煽動，玩弄炒作新聞，意在打擊別人，擡高自己。其手段是，無中生有，造謠惑眾。可惜謠言是往往不攻自破。他們所謂的記者連辦証處的大門都沒有能跨得進去，竟爆出這麼多聳人聽聞的消息。證據是在哪裏？事實又在­哪裏？只憑捏造謊言，捕風捉影，惡意諷刺，指名攻擊本報、人民日報、領館和使館，完全違背新聞界的職業道德規範，踐踏了媒體的社會責任感。本報表示，保留追究XX報誹謗亞省時報，破壞名譽，造成嚴­重損失的法律責任。
46661c3640bfaaa664c7e92b7b382ee0ffd55f9d.translatedText: The Consulate of the People's Republic of China in Los Angeles replied to the Alberta Times via email April 20, 2011;15 1;53pm Replied to the Alberta Times via email Mr. Zhen: Hello! Regarding the letter mentioned, some people claimed that "the consulate colluded with the Alberta Times to collect black money and divide the stolen goods", etc., the Consulate General believes that the above statement is completely fabricated and does not conform to the facts. The editorial office of this newspaper answers questions from readers regarding the "Certificate Renewal Controversy" published by XX newspaper and its editorial article. On April 15, the local XX newspaper published a full page of "Certificate Renewal Controversy at the Chinese Consulate in Alberta" and "Ignorant ASU International Students", causing a stir in the local overseas Chinese community. At present, there are various opinions. Readers called this newspaper to ask questions. The editorial department gave this answer based on the actual situation to clarify: Question: The XX newspaper's "Fengpao" article said: "The high fees that the gray clothes and the like squeezed out of our pockets were partly distributed to the top boss, the embassy, ​​and partly to silence the media." Is this true? Or fake? Answer: Please see the reply email from the Consulate General. For more than ten years, this newspaper has never charged any fees, including advertising fees, for this convenient service. Question: The newspaper office really has no profit, so why should it invite the certification team to have a meal? Answer: The consuls from the document team walked out of the office and went to overseas Chinese communities remotely to serve overseas Chinese and international students. This "convenience measure" of the Consulate General in Los Angeles began in 1993, initially twice a year. For more than ten years, veteran newspaper people have been joining the ranks of the overseas Chinese community. Until 2009, the newspaper still sent reporters to the scene to help maintain order, publish forms, make copies, take photos, etc. Finally, we contacted and held a celebration party (more than 40 overseas Chinese paid for their own meals, and the certification team and reporters were paid by this newspaper). In the past two years, someone has been responsible for contacting the certification team, and this newspaper has published news many times. This time, this newspaper contacted another 20 people to have a meal with the certificate processing team. All meal expenses were paid by a senior overseas Chinese leader and this newspaper. We hope that the Consulate General can continue to implement this "convenience measure" and do better and better. Question: Why did the XX newspaper also target the Alberta Times? Can they really achieve their goals by doing this? Answer: It is true that the XX newspaper is inciting and sensationalizing news with the intention of attacking others and promoting itself. The method is to create rumors out of nothing and confuse the public. Unfortunately, rumors often fail themselves. Their so-called reporters couldn't even get through the door of the certification office, but they broke so many sensational news. Where is the evidence? Where are the facts? Merely fabricating lies, making false accusations, malicious satire, and attacking this newspaper, People's Daily, consulates and embassies by name completely violates the professional ethics of the press and tramples on the media's sense of social responsibility. This newspaper stated that it reserves the right to pursue the legal responsibility of XX newspaper for defaming the Alberta Times, damaging its reputation and causing serious losses.

36e02aa10dab61dd81f5b15811515d08d087a31a.sourceText: 最高法院 26 日以五票对三票裁决，维持亚利桑纳州移民法的规定，要求企业核查所有员工的合法身分，维护了本州岛加强执行联邦移民法的努力。 最高法院的裁决显示，多数大法官愿给各州进行移民问题试验的更多空间，尽管其中没有提到亚利桑那移民法中，包括赋予警方检查非法移民的更广泛权力等部分。 最高法院裁决指出，按联邦法的规定，在联邦政府无法对员工身分进行电子核查时，法律并没禁止各州代行。亚利桑那移民法的规定指的是企业的经营许可，所以没有抵触联邦政府。 首席大法官罗伯兹说：「亚利桑那移民法的规定是执行国会的禁令，国会要求各州执行企业许可的法律。鉴于国会特别规定了各州的这项权力，因此，国会不会妨碍各州采用适当手段，履行赋予他们的权力。」 自国会 1996 年授权启用以来，核查移民身分的电子身分认证系统 (E-Verify) 一直争议不断。企业可向政府登记自愿参加，通过 E-Verify 系统核查求职者的社安号和工作资格。 布莱尔、桑妮亚．萨多马友和金斯柏三位大法官持不同意见，艾莉娜．凯根大法官没有投票。布莱尔说，允许各州根据 E-Verify 系统做出裁决会导致出现更多错误， E-Verify 系统本身便易于出错。 萨多马友大法官说，国会制定 E-Verify 系统时，可规定企业必须遵守，但国会没有这样要求，意味着使用该系统是自愿性质，所以亚省移民法的规定是僭权行为。 国会众院司法委员会主席史密斯赞扬最高法院的裁决，他准备提出议案，规定全国必须执行 ​​ E-Verify 系统。他说：「亚省移民法不仅符合宪法，而且是常识，美国的工作机会应留给美国人和合法工人。」
36e02aa10dab61dd81f5b15811515d08d087a31a.translatedText: The Supreme Court ruled by a vote of five to three on the 26th that it upheld the provisions of Arizona's immigration law, requiring companies to verify the legal status of all employees, and upholding the state's efforts to strengthen the enforcement of federal immigration laws. The Supreme Court's ruling showed that the majority was willing to give states more room to experiment on immigration issues, although it did not mention parts of Arizona's immigration law that include broader powers to police to check illegal immigrants. The Supreme Court ruled that federal law does not prohibit states from electronically verifying employee identities when the federal government is unable to do so. The provisions of Arizona immigration law refer to a business's license to operate, so they do not conflict with the federal government. Chief Justice Roberts said: "The provisions of Arizona's immigration law are to implement Congress's prohibition, Congress requires states to implement business licensing laws. Since Congress specifically provided for this power of states, Congress will not prevent states from using appropriate means to fulfill the power vested in them." Since Congress authorized its use in 1996, the Electronic Identity Verification System (E-Verify) to verify immigration status has been controversial. Companies can register with the government to voluntarily participate and verify job applicants’ Social Security numbers and job qualifications through the E-Verify system. Blair, Sonya. Justices Sadomayo and Ginsburg dissented, with Alina. Justice Kagan did not vote. Blair said allowing states to make rulings based on the E-Verify system, which is itself error-prone, would lead to more errors. Justice Sadomayo said that when Parliament enacted the E-Verify system, it could stipulate that companies must comply, but Parliament did not require such a requirement, which means that use of the system is voluntary, so the provisions of the Alberta Immigration Act are arbitrariness. Smith, chairman of the House Judiciary Committee, praised the Supreme Court's ruling and is preparing to introduce a bill to make the E-Verify system mandatory nationwide. "Alberta's immigration laws are not only constitutional, they are common sense and American jobs should be reserved for Americans and legal workers," he said.

56b714e8fccd7cde61faffd70ae9bb2b87441618.sourceText: (亚省华联供稿) 亚省华联于2013年5月19日，在承德乐市图书馆 (Sunset Library) 召开了年度大会。大会由秘书长李健主持。 首先，会长费健向会员和与会者汇报了过去一年来所做的工作和取得的成绩，同时代表亚省华联向为各项工作做出无私奉献的每一位志愿者、各华人华侨团体、当地报刊媒体以及朋友们表示衷心的谢意。负责财务的赵益衔向大家做了财务报告。廖丰代表亚省华联向会员们介绍了亚省华联章程修改和补充草案；参会会员们对此进行了认真讨论，并对之进行了表决通过。 接下来进行了董事会换届选举。在三位监票人王馨欣、胡小江、Jim Chou 的监督下，选举产生了新一届董事会。董事会由九位成员组成，他们是：董斌，费健，李光煊，李健，廖丰，屈宁，陶世诚，王惟咨，赵益衔。这次董事会选举以及章程的修改补充都是本着民主、公开、公平、公正、透明的原则运作和进行，标志着亚省华联更进一步走向成熟。 经过新董事会推荐，会员们一致通过，王惟咨当选为新一任亚省华联会长。王惟咨衷心希望各华人华侨团体和各界朋友在日后的工作中给予大力支持，并欢迎更多的朋友加入到亚省华联的队伍中来。亚省华联年度大会在掌声中圆满落下帷幕。
56b714e8fccd7cde61faffd70ae9bb2b87441618.translatedText: (Contributed by Hualian of Alberta) The Hualian Association of Alberta held its annual general meeting on May 19, 2013 at the Sunset Library in Chengde. The meeting was chaired by Secretary-General Li Jian. First of all, President Fei Jian reported to members and participants the work done and achievements achieved in the past year. At the same time, on behalf of the Hualian Federation of Alberta, he expressed his sincere gratitude to every volunteer, overseas Chinese groups, local newspapers, media and friends who have made selfless contributions to various tasks. Express my heartfelt thanks. Zhao Yixian, who is in charge of finance, made a financial report to everyone. On behalf of the Hualian Federation of Asia, Liao Feng introduced the revised and supplementary draft of the charter of the Hualian Federation of Alberta to the members; the participating members discussed it carefully and voted on it. Next, the general election of the board of directors was held among the three scrutineers Wang Xinxin, Hu Xiaojiang, and Jim Chou. Under the supervision of the Board of Directors, a new board of directors was elected. The board of directors consists of nine members, namely: Dong Bin, Fei Jian, Li Guangxuan, Li Jian, Liao Feng, Qu Ning, Tao Shicheng, Wang Weizi, and Zhao Yixian. This election of the board of directors and the amendment and addition of the articles of association are operated and carried out in accordance with the principles of democracy, openness, fairness, justice, and transparency, marking the further maturity of the Hualian Province. After being recommended by the new board of directors and unanimously approved by the members, Wang Weizi was elected as the new president of the Chinese Federation of Asia. Wang Weizi sincerely hopes that all Chinese overseas groups and friends from all walks of life will provide strong support in future work, and welcomes more friends to join the team of the Chinese Federation of Asia.

cf93a2aab37af66b2d42b399b821ecc865264dd8.sourceText: 北京市侨联主席李昭玲给侨联的贺信 北京市归国华侨联合会 亚利桑那州华人华侨联合总会 尊敬的费健会长、陶世诚董事: 欣闻贵会将与亚利桑那州立大学共同举办中秋与国庆双庆活动，我谨代表北京市侨联向贵会表示衷心的祝贺， 并向联合会各位侨胞表示亲切的慰问。 亚利桑那州华人华侨联合总会(华联)成立5 年来，以促进中美之间的经贸、科技、文化交流合作为目标，以服务侨社为宗旨，为当地及家乡的经济建设和社会发展做了大量卓有成效的工作。5 年来， 贵会成功举办了”凤凰之夜”、ACUA 乒乓球公开赛、中美建交30周年图片展等各类晚会、比赛、论坛和展览等一系列活动，积极组织和协调领事馆为当地华侨华人提供便利的领事服务，为繁荣华人社区、提高华侨华人良好形象、帮助华人融入当地社会、维护侨胞合法权益、促进中美两国经济社会和文化发展、增进中美人民友好起到了积极重要的作用。 海外华侨华人是中国连接世界的桥梁和纽带。中国改革开放几十年来所取得的发展成就离不开广大海外侨胞的大力支持与参与。希望今后贵会继续利用自身跨文化的独特优势，坚持发扬中华民族和衷共济、和谐发展的优良文化传统， 以侨胞利益为重、以侨社发展为先，不断增进团结、凝聚力量、加强协作，为促进中国的经济社会发展，推动中华文化的传承和弘扬，增进中美两国人民友谊和交流合作做出新的更大贡献。 因我会今年九月换届及国庆筹备工作繁忙，很遗憾不能应邀参加贵会双庆活动。我们殷切期望在明年春节期间组团前往亚利桑那什| 参加贵会新春联欢活动、慰问当地侨胞。 预祝本次中秋国庆双庆活动取得圆满成功。 中国侨联副主席 北京市侨联主席 李昭玲 2012年7月16日
cf93a2aab37af66b2d42b399b821ecc865264dd8.translatedText: Congratulatory letter from Beijing Overseas Chinese Federation Chairman Li Zhaoling to the Overseas Chinese Federation Beijing Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese Arizona Chinese Federation Dear President Fei Jian and Director Tao Shicheng: I am pleased to hear that your association will co-organize the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day celebrations with Arizona State University. On behalf of the Beijing Overseas Chinese Federation, I would like to express my heartfelt congratulations to your association and my cordial condolences to all the overseas Chinese in the federation. In the five years since its establishment, the Arizona Overseas Chinese Federation (Hualian) has aimed to promote economic, trade, technological, and cultural exchanges and cooperation between China and the United States, and has served the overseas Chinese community as its purpose. It has done a lot of fruitful work for the economic construction and social development of the local area and hometown. Over the past five years, your association has successfully held a series of activities such as "Phoenix Night", the ACUA Table Tennis Open, and the 30th Anniversary Photo Exhibition of the Establishment of Diplomatic Relations between China and the United States. It has actively organized and coordinated the consulate to provide convenient consular services to the local overseas Chinese, and has played an active and important role in prospering the Chinese community, improving the good image of the overseas Chinese, helping the Chinese integrate into the local society, safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of overseas Chinese, promoting the economic, social and cultural development of China and the United States, and enhancing the friendship between the Chinese and American peoples. Overseas Chinese are the bridge and link between China and the world. China's development achievements over the past decades of reform and opening up cannot be achieved without the strong support and participation of overseas Chinese. I hope that in the future, your association will continue to make use of its unique cross-cultural advantages, adhere to the fine cultural tradition of the Chinese nation's unity and harmonious development, put the interests of overseas Chinese first and the development of overseas Chinese communities first, continue to enhance unity, gather strength, strengthen collaboration, and make new and greater contributions to promoting China's economic and social development, promoting the inheritance and promotion of Chinese culture, and enhancing the friendship, exchanges and cooperation between the peoples of China and the United States. As our association is busy with the re-election and National Day preparations in September this year, we regret that we cannot be invited to attend your association’s double celebration activities. We sincerely hope to organize a delegation to Arizona during the Spring Festival next year to participate in your association's New Year celebrations and express our condolences to the local overseas Chinese. I wish this Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day celebrations a complete success. Vice Chairman of the China Overseas Chinese Federation and Chairman of the Beijing Overseas Chinese Federation Li Zhaoling July 16, 2012

cf790588792af306ab02c27f54d87bad770b16d9.sourceText: 治粤八年南天王——传奇人物陈济棠 余玉书 （四）倡经教育惹风浪（下） 由于许崇清是新派教育家，又受美国实用主义哲学家杜威的影响，当然认为读经是复古，辜且不管其书的真伪，总言之就是违反潮流，金曾澄亦有同感。卢允衡曾三次亲访许氏露骨地表示：读经是陈老总的意思，并暗示会以教育厅长一职为酬，令其东山复出，并以若干股出版《孝经新诂》一书的出版股票送给他。许不听还好，一听之下，不禁怒火中烧，决定不顾一切秉公办理，拟就了一篇《孝经新诂教本审查意见书》呈交”西南政务委员会”，该会立即由监察委员萧佛成召开会议，陈济棠也亲自出席，其他出席委员尚有黄季陆、邓泽如等。 当秘书丘锦贤在会议中宣读了审查意见书之后，与会者听后沉默了一阵子，无人提出反驳，因为报告书中说明了现代教育的观念，是以科学为理据，而”德育为学校教育之最高目的，道德为社会发展之至上原理，非参稽科学新造诣，不足以发其微，尺尽其用也。”许氏进一步指出：”以讲习经旨，记诵德目为道德教育之唯一途径者，其理论以地球为中心Herhart之心理学为依归。”可是这是心理学是进化论面世以前的学说：”久矣乎已成历史之陈迹，其不足信固已征验于欧美诸国。” 原籍四川，脸如弥陀佛的黄季陆首先站起发言，认为言之有理。党国元老邓泽如立即加上一句：”既然言之有理，就应该予以通过。”主席萧佛成见在座其他委员包括陈济棠在内，都沉默无语，就连忙说：”既然有理，又无异议，就予以通过。” 于是卢允衡苦心策划的出版《孝经新诂》计划也就成了泡影。不过该书虽然未能通过在广东全省的中小学中采用，不过却由广州市教育局下令全市中小学列《孝经》为必修课目，而《孝经新诂》则列为范本。一时五羊城内，学子们诵读《孝经》之声，不绝于耳；”子曰。孝子之事亲也，居则致其敬。养则致其乐。病败致其忧，丧则致其哀。祭则致其严。五者备矣，然后能事亲。厖”（纪孝行章第十）。虽是汉心人所托的伪书，并非出自孔子手笔，不过描拟《论语》的句法，倒是描拟得很像，而内容也并非一无可取。尤其是在北美洲的学校，当教育当局为传授科学知识而教育，始作俑者美国甘西迪总统将宗教及德育逐出校门之外，华裔家长心中不满之余，大概有点缅怀故国的道德文化来。 许崇清不允即被免去广东省政务委员的职务，直至一九三六年陈济棠下野，”西南政务委员会”解体，才再度被蒋介石任命为广东省教育厅长，而从那时开始广州市的中小学生也不必再诵读《孝经》。
cf790588792af306ab02c27f54d87bad770b16d9.translatedText: The Southern Heavenly King who ruled Guangdong for eight years - the legendary figures Chen Jitang and Yu Yushu (4) Promoting classics education caused trouble (Part 2) Since Xu Chongqing was a new-school educator and was influenced by the American pragmatist philosopher John Dewey, he certainly believed that reading classics was a retro style, regardless of the authenticity of his books. In short, it was against the trend. Jin Zengcheng also felt the same way. Lu Yunheng visited Xu in person three times and stated openly that reading the Bible was Mr. Chen's wish. He also hinted that he would use the post of Director of Education as a reward to make his comeback and give him several shares of publishing stock for the book "New Exegesis of the Classic of Filial Piety". It was okay for Xu not to listen, but when he heard it, he couldn't help but get angry and decided to deal with it impartially regardless of everything. He drafted a "Review Opinion on the New Exegesis of the Classic of Filial Piety" and submitted it to the "Southwestern Political Affairs Committee". The committee immediately convened a meeting by Supervisory Committee member Xiao Focheng. Chen Jitang also attended in person. Other members present included Huang Jilu, Deng Zeru, etc. When Secretary Qiu Jinxian read out the review opinion at the meeting, the participants were silent for a while, and no one raised any objection, because the report explained that the concept of modern education is based on science, and "moral education is the highest purpose of school education, and morality is the supreme principle of social development. Without reference to new scientific achievements, it is not enough." The ruler is used to its fullest extent." Xu further pointed out: "The theory of those who regard teaching the scriptures and memorizing virtues as the only way to educate them is based on the earth-centered psychology of Herhart." However, this is a theory before the emergence of the theory of evolution: "It has become a trace of history for a long time, and its lack of credibility has been proven in European and American countries." Huang Jilu, who is originally from Sichuan and has a face like Amitabha Buddha, stood up and spoke first, thinking that his words made sense. Party and state veteran Deng Zeru immediately added: "Since it makes sense, it should be approved." Chairman Xiao Fuchen saw that other members present, including Chen Jitang, were silent, so he quickly said: "Since it makes sense and there are no objections, it should be approved." So Lu Yunheng's painstakingly planned plan to publish "New Exegesis of the Classic of Filial Piety" came to nothing. However, although the book failed to be adopted in primary and secondary schools in Guangdong Province, the Guangzhou Municipal Education Bureau ordered all primary and secondary schools in the city to include "The Classic of Filial Piety" as a compulsory subject, and "New Exegesis of the Classic of Filial Piety" as a model. At that time, in Wuyang City, the sound of students reciting the "Book of Filial Piety" could be heard all the time; "The Master said: A filial son is a filial son, and living in a home is to show respect to him. To raise him is to bring him happiness. If he is ill, he is worried, and to be mourned is to make him sad. Sacrifice is to make him strict. Five things are prepared, and then he can be a kinsman. Pang" (Ji Xiaoxing Chapter 10). Although it is a fake book entrusted by Han people and was not written by Confucius, the syntax of the Analects is very similar, and the content is not without merit. Especially in schools in North America, when the educational authorities started to educate for the purpose of imparting scientific knowledge, and the initiator, President John Gansidi of the United States, expelled religious and moral education from the schools, Chinese parents were dissatisfied and probably missed the moral culture of their motherland. Xu Chongqing was dismissed from the post of Guangdong Provincial Political Affairs Councilor when he refused. It was not until 1936 when Chen Jitang stepped down and the "Southwestern Political Affairs Committee" was disintegrated that he was again appointed Director of the Guangdong Provincial Education Department by Chiang Kai-shek. From then on, primary and secondary school students in Guangzhou no longer had to recite the "Book of Filial Piety".

e5a9c43d5d088116d28a087314260be36675078b.sourceText: 硅谷心脏选出华裔市长 旧金山湾区华人参政踊跃(图) 旧金山湾区是全美最早的华人定居点之一，当地的华人参政氛围浓厚，除了旧金山和奥克兰两大城市现任市长都是华裔以外，有硅谷心脏之称的库伯提诺（Cupertino）3日也选出了新任华裔市长黄少雄（Gilbert Wong）。 黄少雄是该市1955年建市以来第四位华裔市长，这也是他的第二个市长任期。 旧金山南湾小城库伯提诺（Cupertino）被称为硅谷的心脏，许多世界级IT公司比如苹果、甲骨文、希捷等都将总部大楼或工业园区设立于此。曾经先后担任该市市长、副市长的华裔候选人黄少雄（Gilbert Wong），再次当选为新任库伯提诺市长，并进行了就职宣誓。 在圣塔克拉拉（Santa Clara）县警长史密斯的监证下，黄少雄再次就任为库伯提诺市长。库伯提诺市亚裔人口占63%以上，该市议会由五人组成，市长则按照议员的资历，经投票表决后选出。黄少雄是该市1955年建市以来第四位华裔市长，这也是他的第二个市长任期。 黄少雄在接受美国中文电视记者采访时表示，他为再度当选为库伯提诺市长而感到十分激动，三年前他曾担任过这一职位。那时候也是很令人振奋的，因为苹果创始人乔布斯曾来到市议会向其陈述计划兴建的苹果新总部太空船项目。而一个月前的11月15日，该市议会在时任副市长的黄少雄主持下，通过了这项计划，接下来这项工程将让他的市长工作充满挑战。 中国驻旧金山总领馆政治组长刘震领事出席了就职典礼。刘震向记者说：”我们很高兴看到黄少雄先生再次当选库伯提诺市长，我们也很高兴看到越来越多的华人在湾区参政，更好地融入美国的主流社会，也更好地为美国的华人社会服务。” 作为全美华裔历史最悠久的地区之一，旧金山湾区的华裔从政比例相较于其他地区高一些。除了现任的旧金山市长李孟贤（Ed Lee）、奥克兰市长关丽珍（Jean Quan）、还有比德蒙（Piedmont）市长蒋其益（John Chiang）、坎贝尔（Campbell）市长罗达伦（Evan Low）和苗必达（Milpitas）市长艾和谐（Jose Esteve）都是华裔。
e5a9c43d5d088116d28a087314260be36675078b.translatedText: A Chinese-American mayor was elected in the heart of Silicon Valley. Chinese people in the San Francisco Bay Area are actively participating in politics (photo). The San Francisco Bay Area is one of the earliest Chinese settlements in the United States, and there is a strong atmosphere for Chinese participation in politics. In addition to the current mayors of the two major cities of San Francisco and Oakland, both of whom are Chinese, Cupertino, known as the heart of Silicon Valley, also elected its new Chinese-American mayor Gilbert Wong on the 3rd. Huang Shaoxiong is the fourth Chinese-American mayor of the city since its establishment in 1955. This is also his second term as mayor. Cupertino, a small town in San Francisco's South Bay, is known as the heart of Silicon Valley. Many world-class IT companies such as Apple, Oracle, Seagate, etc. have established their headquarters buildings or industrial parks here. Gilbert Wong, a Chinese candidate who has served as mayor and vice mayor of the city, was re-elected as the new mayor of Cupertino and took the oath of office. Under the supervision of Santa Clara County Sheriff Smith, Huang Shaoxiong was re-appointed as the mayor of Cupertino. Cupertino's Asian population accounts for more than 63%. The city's council is composed of five people, and the mayor is elected by vote based on the members' seniority. Huang Shaoxiong is the fourth Chinese-American mayor of the city since its establishment in 1955. This is also his second term as mayor. In an interview with an American Chinese TV reporter, Huang Shaoxiong said that he was very excited to be re-elected as the mayor of Cupertino, a position he held three years ago. It was also very exciting at that time, because Apple founder Steve Jobs came to the city council to present the planned spaceship project for Apple's new headquarters. A month ago, on November 15, the city council approved this plan under the chairmanship of then deputy mayor Huang Shaoxiong. The next project will make his mayor's job full of challenges. Consul Liu Zhen, political team leader of the Chinese Consulate General in San Francisco, attended the inauguration ceremony. Liu Zhen told reporters: "We are very happy to see Mr. Huang Shaoxiong re-elected as mayor of Cupertino. We are also very happy to see more and more Chinese participating in politics in the Bay Area, better integrating into mainstream society in the United States, and better serving the Chinese society in the United States." As one of the regions with the longest history of Chinese Americans in the United States, the proportion of Chinese Americans in politics in the San Francisco Bay Area is higher than in other regions. In addition to the current San Francisco Mayor Ed Lee and Oakland Mayor Jean Quan, there are also Piedmont Mayor John Chiang, Campbell Mayor Evan Low and Milpitas Mayor Jose Esteve, all of Chinese descent.

5332c4dbed6c9874012955a224a7f6f6f9b86020.sourceText: 立法院访问团参观美空军基地 美西侨报何大河 由台立法院国防外交委员会六位立法委员及国防部、外交部官员联合组成的代表团于七月六日至八日抵鳯凰城在美军Luke空军基地进行访问，并参观F16作战轰炸示范。代表团长为李明星委员，随团立委计有帅化民、徐少萍、廖婉如、郭素春、涂醒哲五位。在本地侨委会代表尹衍桓陪同下，亦拜会州政府与州议会，并邀请州长等近期访问台湾。 立法委员帅化民表示，这趟行程包括洛杉矶、鳯凰城，最后将赴东岸华府与纽约，除了参观F16空军基地，也向美国政府表达购买F16CD的强烈意愿。 代表团于7月8日离开鳯凰城，7月9日在洛杉矶举行侨宴，本地代表万培杰、王瑞瑾应邀赴洛出席。
5332c4dbed6c9874012955a224a7f6f6f9b86020.translatedText: The Legislative Yuan delegation visited the US Air Force Base. The Spanish overseas Chinese reported on He Dahe. A delegation composed of six legislators from the National Defense and Foreign Affairs Committee of the Taiwan Legislative Yuan and officials from the Ministry of National Defense and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs arrived in Huangcheng from July 6 to 8 for a visit to the US Army's Luke Air Force Base and visited an F16 combat bombing demonstration. The leader of the delegation is Member Li Mingxing, accompanied by five legislators: Shuai Huamin, Xu Shaoping, Liao Wanru, Guo Suchun, and Tu Xingzhe. Accompanied by Yin Yanhuan, a representative of the local Overseas Chinese Affairs Council, he also visited the state government and state assembly, and invited the governor and others to visit Taiwan in the near future. Legislator Shuai Huamin said that this trip will include Los Angeles, Phoenix City, and finally will go to Washington, D.C. and New York on the East Coast. In addition to visiting the F16 Air Force Base, he also expressed his strong intention to purchase F16CD to the US government. The delegation left Phoenix City on July 8 and held an overseas Chinese banquet in Los Angeles on July 9. Local representatives Wan Peijie and Wang Ruijin were invited to Los Angeles to attend.

c2d3f3a7f5ea2d642944dfd4c0a8fb1ccc57aa73.sourceText: 新东方艺术学校供稿 秋香撰文 2014亚省马年春晚的大型演出中，新东方艺术学校的几个舞蹈节目给现场观众留下了深刻印象。观众们之所以喜欢这些舞蹈节目，除了孩子们的表演精湛和现场的音乐灯光展现的场景绚丽动人之外，最重要的原因就是，这些舞蹈本身也都包含着丰富众多的中国元素。人们在欣赏节目的同时，也欣赏和回味了中国文明与文化的魅力。 众多舞蹈中，最有代表性的是汉族舞蹈《百家姓》。《百家姓》是中国古代幼儿的启蒙读物，几乎每个中国人都能念上几句。在这个舞蹈中，除了音乐、富有韵律的歌词和道白之外，还有传统的汉族服饰、中国红扇子、中国汉字、姓氏，等等。这一切都 通过孩子们的肢体语言向观众传递着中国传统文化的内涵与魅力。孩子们在新东方学习舞蹈，其实也是学习中国文化和了解中国文明的过程。 小白兔与大灰狼的故事，自古就被演绎出无数的版本。我们每个中国人都会唱”小兔子乖乖，把门开开”的歌词。而今年，则被新东方艺术学校搬上春晚的舞台。儿童舞蹈《兔气扬眉》由二十多个小朋友带来，它更象一场小型的儿童舞蹈剧，有唱歌也有对白。不仅小观众们喜欢，就连大人们也无法抗拒，而孩子们的可爱表演更令观众们回想起自己当年听大人们讲故事的情形。这个舞蹈一出场就获得了现场老幼的喜爱。几个五六岁的男孩子在舞蹈中扮演着兔子弟弟，他们跟女孩子们扮演的兔子姐姐们同大灰狼斗智斗勇，表演非常可爱。尤其值得一提的是，这个舞蹈中有一家三个孩子同台演出。大姐扮演大灰狼，二姐是兔子妹妹，五岁的弟弟则扮演了一只小兔弟弟。 中国有56个民族。不同民族的都有各自的文化艺术和迷人风采。而观看民族歌舞当然可以最直观地了解少数民族风情。所以春晚的舞台上总是少不了少数民族的舞蹈。今年春晚中上演的舞蹈《佤寨》，则以舞蹈的形式描述了中南方佤族的生活与劳作场景。最具特色的是女孩子们上穿坎肩式无领无袖贯头衣，下着短筒裙，佩戴银头箍、项圈、项链、腰箍、手镯等首饰，非常漂亮。。 另有独舞《敦煌映像》为中国古典舞蹈，音乐动听，独舞演员舞技很高，表演到位，带给观众的现场感极强，仿佛是敦煌壁画中的飞天仙女从画中走入人间。 在美国长大的中国家庭的孩子，了解中国与中国文化的途径是多样的，学习中国舞蹈不失为一种好的选择。因为孩子们学到的不仅仅是舞蹈本身，更多的则是学习了舞蹈中所包含丰富多彩的中国元素。
c2d3f3a7f5ea2d642944dfd4c0a8fb1ccc57aa73.translatedText: > Contributed by New Oriental Art School Written by Qiu Xiang In the large-scale performance of the 2014 Alberta Year of the Horse Spring Festival Gala, several dance programs of the New Oriental Art School left a deep impression on the audience. The most important reason why the audience likes these dance shows is that, in addition to the children's superb performances and the gorgeous scenes presented by the live music and lighting, the dances themselves also contain rich and numerous Chinese elements. While enjoying the program, people also appreciated and recalled the charm of Chinese civilization and culture. Among the many dances, the most representative is the Han dance "Hundred Family Surnames". "One Hundred Family Surnames" is an enlightenment book for children in ancient China. Almost every Chinese can read a few sentences. In this dance, in addition to music, rhythmic lyrics and dialogue, there are also traditional Han costumes, Chinese red fans, Chinese characters, surnames, etc. All of this conveys the connotation and charm of traditional Chinese culture to the audience through the children's body language. Children learning dance at New Oriental is actually a process of learning Chinese culture and understanding Chinese civilization. The story of the little white rabbit and the big bad wolf has been interpreted in countless versions since ancient times. Every one of us Chinese can sing the lyrics "Little rabbit, be good, open the door." This year, it was put on the stage of the Spring Festival Gala by New Oriental Art School. The children's dance "Rabbit Spirit Raising Eyebrows" was performed by more than 20 children. It is more like a small children's dance drama, with singing and dialogue. Not only did the young audiences like it, but even adults couldn't resist. The children's cute performances reminded the audience of the time when they listened to adults telling stories. This dance won the love of young and old alike as soon as it appeared. Several boys aged five or six played the role of rabbit brothers in the dance. They and the girls played the role of rabbit sisters fighting wits and courage against the big bad wolf. The performance was very cute. What is particularly worth mentioning is that there are three children from a family performing on the same stage in this dance. The eldest sister plays the big bad wolf, the second sister is the rabbit sister, and the five-year-old brother plays the little rabbit brother. There are 56 ethnic groups in China. Different ethnic groups have their own culture, art and charming style. Of course, watching ethnic songs and dances can provide the most intuitive understanding of ethnic minority customs. Therefore, the dances of ethnic minorities are always indispensable on the stage of the Spring Festival Gala. The dance "Wa Village" performed in this year's Spring Festival Gala uses dance to describe the life and work scenes of the Wa people in central and southern China. The most distinctive thing is that the girls wear waistcoat-style collarless and sleeveless tops, short skirts, and silver headbands, necklaces, necklaces, waist hoops, bracelets and other jewelry. They are very beautiful. . There is also a solo dance "Image of Dunhuang" which is a Chinese classical dance with beautiful music. The solo dancer is very skilled and performs well, giving the audience a strong sense of presence, as if the flying fairies in the Dunhuang murals have walked into the world from the paintings. Children of Chinese families who grow up in the United States have many ways to understand China and Chinese culture, and learning Chinese dance is a good choice. Because the children learned not only the dance itself, but also the rich and colorful Chinese elements contained in the dance.

e2225c7ea8ccbc13c0c9b9f69180447f236d0d52.sourceText: 华人社团从两董之争到两会之争–“正名正身”后传 夏白 ”正名正身”是九叔从两董之争就开始强调的事情。请问您的正名和正身怎么实现？是要到华人家庭里走家串户，抓着大家的手画押，支持谁呢？还是发个公告凡是支持某社团者，全家包吃包住，每月按时发粮饷？ 任何社团都是一个成长的过程，你一个动员，别人就跟你啦？你去学校说说”学生会跟我们一起搞活”，你就代表学生啦？被挂上个活动的名号就支持了？说实话，就这些被挂名的，自己都还不知道怎么回事呢？就被代表啦？您所说的所谓”正名和正身”都是什么呀？！更广泛的民主不是说出来的，是做出来的，更广泛的民主，不是在他们吵架和争夺”会长””总会”的时候需要”正”的。 凤凰城华人在今年4月份最牛，办护照的事情在MITBBS网站赢得了全北美华人的关注，可是当华人利益真正受到损害的时候，哪个”总”出现了？我敢说，那时候哪个”总”出现，哪个总就可以赢得民心。现在欢度国庆了，就在看谁请到的中国”皇亲国戚”多为荣！当海外华人是傻子，现在来谈”正名正身”？只能”正”臭名和贱身！ 国庆活动，就是华人相互聚会，联络感情的一个方法，就是找个借口大家聚聚。比什么？越比越傻！别想着代表所有华人，哪个社团都不要把位置定高了，就抱个低姿态，小民主好了，踏踏实实做好自己社团喜欢做的事情，团结好身边的志趣相投的朋友就好，努力为华人朋友服务，只要你能坚持下去，就能实现真正的”正名和正身”。
e2225c7ea8ccbc13c0c9b9f69180447f236d0d52.translatedText: From the struggle between the two directors to the struggle between the two associations of the Chinese community - "Rectifying the name and rectifying the body" Xia Bai "Rectifying the name and rectifying the body" is something that Uncle Jiu has been emphasizing since the struggle between the two directors. How can you rectify your name and identity? Is it going to go from house to house in Chinese families, grabbing everyone’s hands and making pledges? Who should I support? Or should we issue an announcement that all those who support a certain association will receive food and accommodation for their whole family, and will receive food and stipends on time every month? Any association is a process of growth. Once you mobilize, others will follow you? If you go to school and say, "Students will join us in getting active," do you represent the students? Is it supported by the name of an event? To be honest, I don’t even know what happened to these people who were named? Are you being represented? What do you mean by "rectifying one's name and rectifying one's body"? ! Broader democracy does not need to be said, but done. Broader democracy does not require "correctness" when they quarrel and compete for "president" and "general meeting". The Chinese in Phoenix were the most popular in April this year. The matter of applying for a passport won the attention of Chinese in North America on the MITBBS website. But when the interests of the Chinese were really harmed, which "general" showed up? I dare say that whichever "president" appears at that time will win the hearts and minds of the people. Now that we are celebrating the National Day, we are waiting to see how proud the Chinese "royal relatives" will be! You think overseas Chinese are fools, now let’s talk about “rectifying their names”? We can only "rectify" our bad reputation and low status! National Day activities are a way for Chinese people to get together and bond with each other. They find an excuse to get together. Compared to what? The more you compare, the stupider you get! Don't think about representing all Chinese people. Don't set your position high in any association. Just keep a low profile and have a small democracy. Just do what your association likes to do in a down-to-earth manner. Just unite the like-minded friends around you and work hard to serve the Chinese friends. As long as you can persist, you can achieve true "rights of name and identity."

a5b29dcd88d2032549c3eb532ab56060724ec834.translatedText: *Congressmen said free trade is not disorderly trading*

4edeced8ba1461b724ef05d6442dad462fa11ec6.sourceText: 由民主党参议员罗恩 怀登(Ron Wyden)和默克里(Senator Jeff Merkley)领头的八人美国议员团批评美国政府部门做出的利于中国产品的决定。
4edeced8ba1461b724ef05d6442dad462fa11ec6.translatedText: By Democratic Senators Ron Wyden and Senator Jeff Merkley Merkley, an eight-member group of U.S. lawmakers criticized U.S. government agencies for decisions that favor Chinese products.

44a3b5db79daf3cf3963f8fd3fceab0c72b07d72.sourceText: 美国商务部此前宣布，撤销对价值数十亿美元的中国太阳能板征收30%的初步反倾销和反补贴关税。商务部将在10月10日公布其决定。
44a3b5db79daf3cf3963f8fd3fceab0c72b07d72.translatedText: The U.S. Department of Commerce previously announced that it would withdraw the 30% preliminary anti-dumping and countervailing duties imposed on Chinese solar panels worth billions of dollars. The Ministry of Commerce will announce its decision on October 10.

f8e7b272d72cc4f89903cdb59cc3295166272bab.sourceText: 美国议员称，这些太阳能产品包括在其他国家生产的电池，其原材料来源于中国，太阳能板的成品也在中国组装，这引发中国通过外包来逃避美国关税的指称。议员还说，美国商务部的决定”将纵容(中国厂商)逃避反倾销和对抗关税行为”。
f8e7b272d72cc4f89903cdb59cc3295166272bab.translatedText: U.S. lawmakers said that these solar products include batteries produced in other countries, with raw materials sourced from China, and finished solar panels also assembled in China, triggering accusations that China uses outsourcing to evade U.S. tariffs. The congressman also said that the U.S. Department of Commerce’s decision “will allow (Chinese manufacturers) to evade anti-dumping and counter-tariffs.”

471b58cb073b041085d244a4b5ca6223dfd31519.sourceText: 参议员怀登在声明中说：”自由贸易并不等于无序交易。”美国商务部在今年早些时候的调查报告中称，中国太阳能板厂商和出口商以低于市场31.14%到249.96%的价格幅度向美国市场倾销产品。
471b58cb073b041085d244a4b5ca6223dfd31519.translatedText: Senator Wyden said in a statement: "Free trade does not mean disorderly trading." The U.S. Department of Commerce said in an investigation report earlier this year that Chinese solar panel manufacturers and exporters dumped products into the U.S. market at prices ranging from 31.14% to 249.96% below the market.

d1a80518a3e2ff5ecfa0d9731fb6445dcbe06119.sourceText: 美国加州的太阳能产品公司Solyndra、纽约的”光伏公司”(SpectraWatt) 和马塞诸塞州的”艾格太阳能”(Evergreen) 等三家太阳能产品公司于去年8月和9月相继提交了破产保护申请。
d1a80518a3e2ff5ecfa0d9731fb6445dcbe06119.translatedText: Three solar product companies, including California-based Solyndra, New York-based SpectraWatt and Massachusetts-based Evergreen, filed for bankruptcy protection in August and September last year.

db0da8ca6bc76093be3ce3cb2099e016a696d5af.sourceText: 美国国际贸易委员会 (the U.S. International Commission) 将最终决定是否征收这类关税。
db0da8ca6bc76093be3ce3cb2099e016a696d5af.translatedText: The U.S. International Commission will ultimately decide whether to impose such tariffs.

c12ec415592159d5d65408e304ae7660899af0c7.sourceText: 中国的”北京大军智库经济咨询有限公司”主任仲大军对美国之音表示， 从中方而言，中国企业近年来不断耗资来应对国际上的反倾销指控，加大了企业成本；太阳能版行业尤其承受竞争日趋激烈、成本上升和出口下降的巨大挑战。
c12ec415592159d5d65408e304ae7660899af0c7.translatedText: Zhong Dajun, director of China’s Beijing Dajun Think Tank Economic Consulting Co., Ltd., told VOA that from the Chinese side, Chinese companies have continued to spend money to respond to international anti-dumping accusations in recent years, which has increased corporate costs; the solar industry, in particular, is facing huge challenges from increasingly fierce competition, rising costs and declining exports.

da62581fc26a11888713232909e9418adbb6e034.sourceText: 仲大军说：”中国企业花钱应诉，无形中消耗了大量经营成本，贸易磨擦给企业带来的损失很大。太阳能板行业很多都是私企，而且这个产业并非高新技术也没有垄断，往往民营企业见到有利可图便立即上马，几乎都在微薄的利润中经营。”
da62581fc26a11888713232909e9418adbb6e034.translatedText: Zhong Dajun said: "Chinese companies spend money to respond to lawsuits, which invisibly consumes a lot of operating costs, and trade frictions bring great losses to companies. Many in the solar panel industry are private companies, and this industry is not high-tech and has no monopoly. Private companies often see advantages. Ketu immediately launched, almost all operating on slim profits. "

7cba38e3e9f07de8ebf9995173f3f0084043d682.sourceText: 美国国际贸易委员会将在10月3日就太阳能进口产品举行听证会，以确定美国生产商是否因低廉中国产品的涌入而受到重大打击或者威胁。如果得出的结论利于中方，美方将退还中国厂商此前根据初步关税规定向美方缴纳的保证金或者押金。
7cba38e3e9f07de8ebf9995173f3f0084043d682.translatedText: The U.S. International Trade Commission will hold a hearing on solar energy imports on October 3 to determine whether U.S. manufacturers have been severely hit or threatened by the influx of cheap Chinese products. If the conclusion is drawn in favor of China, the United States will refund the deposit or deposit previously paid by Chinese manufacturers to the United States in accordance with the preliminary tariff regulations.

4f9b3f6afb6546a405a0123fa5a3426134ec61a9.sourceText: 在美国，随着从中国进口的太阳能产品近年来急剧增加，其进口量从2008年的五亿1000多万美元上升到2011年的31亿美元。欧洲是太阳能板的最大用户，从中国进口太阳能板的数量为美国的五倍。
4f9b3f6afb6546a405a0123fa5a3426134ec61a9.translatedText: In the United States, imports of solar products from China have increased dramatically in recent years, with imports rising from more than $510 million in 2008 to $3.1 billion in 2011. Europe is the largest user of solar panels, importing five times as many panels from China as the United States.

e71c24af32bacdff0f3cd63a5fbe64db1400c0a2.sourceText: “第一届海外华裔青少年中华文化大赛”笔试在图森顺利举行 祖筍中文学校校长陈荣基 图文报道 在美国西南边陲的图森市，虽然华人只占该市人口总数的百分之一以下，加上在亚利桑那大学留学的中国学生，华人总数也只有几千人，但是中华文化氛围浓厚，与中国文化相关的活动常年不断。九月份以来，图森市华人社区活动繁多，中国文化节、中华健康日、中国武术日、诗歌朗诵会、汉语日、中秋音乐会厖。这些活动中文学校的师生都积极参与。十月中旬图森的多元文化节（Tucson Meet Yourself）中文学校还做了一台专场演出。这些活动大大影响了同学们准备这次比赛。更严重的是当地的中学在10月27日的这个周末还有一些重要的活动和比赛，使一些报了名的学生无法前来参赛。尽管困难重重，图森考点的比赛仍然如期在文化中心举行,两所中文学校的同学参加了笔试。 下面是图森考点的图片报道。 2012 年首届海外华裔青少年中华文化知识大赛图森考点的学生正在进行笔试 她在第三届中华文化知识竞赛中取得了好成绩这次要考得更好
e71c24af32bacdff0f3cd63a5fbe64db1400c0a2.translatedText: The written examination of the "First Overseas Chinese Youth Chinese Culture Competition" was successfully held in Tucson. Graphic report by Chen Rongji, principal of Zusun Chinese School. In the city of Tucson on the southwest border of the United States, although the Chinese account for less than one percent of the city's total population, and including the Chinese students studying at the University of Arizona, the total number of Chinese is only a few thousand, but there is a strong Chinese cultural atmosphere, and activities related to Chinese culture continue all year round. Since September, there have been many activities in the Chinese community in Tucson, including the Chinese Culture Festival, Chinese Health Day, Chinese Martial Arts Day, Poetry Recital, Chinese Language Day, and Mid-Autumn Festival Concert. Teachers and students of Chinese schools actively participated in these activities. In mid-October, the Chinese school also performed a special performance at the Tucson Meet Yourself festival. These activities greatly affected the students' preparation for this competition. What's more serious is that the local middle school has some important activities and competitions on the weekend of October 27, which makes it impossible for some registered students to come to participate. Despite the difficulties, the competition at the Tucson test center was still held at the cultural center as scheduled, and students from two Chinese schools participated in the written test. Below is a photo report of the Tucson test center. A student at the Tucson test center of the 2012 First Overseas Chinese Youth Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition is taking a written test. She achieved good results in the 3rd Chinese Culture Knowledge Competition and will do better this time.

106af1d28cd90d372dcc58c1dce339492e9a058a.sourceText: 凤城华裔小姐场内训练如火如荼 场外安排有条不紊（图） 本报讯 张肇鸿摄影 张肇鸿摄影 5月21日星期六上午10：30 ，凤凰城华裔小姐候选佳丽训练在新东方艺术学校顺利开始，凤城华裔小姐到洛杉矶的宣传活动，以及确定新比赛场地等相关内容安排就绪。 候选佳丽的训练活动在新东方艺术学校里进行全封闭训练。 所有佳丽的走位和动作已经基本确定，大家正在努力追求精益求精，奉献一出美轮美奂的演出。这次训练来了一位新的台步教练陈思。陈思参加了2009年凤城华裔小姐的比赛并且获得了第二名，目前是一名学习平面设计的大学生，同时也是一名职业的签约模特。 所有的佳丽在陈思的带领下进行 了台步专业训练。看似简单的模特台步，其真正的难度不亚于舞蹈表演，步子的大小，节奏，身体和头部的位置，都有很多的讲究。佳丽纷纷表示本次训练受益匪浅。 场内的训练如火如荼，场外的安排也在有条不紊的进行。5月30日，参赛的佳丽们将会在洛杉矶接受凤凰卫视的采访和培训，并将拜会中华商会。洛城之行的行程，住宿已全部安排到位。另外，比赛的场地也准备就绪。初步定在Arcadia High School (4703 E. Indian School Road, Phoenix)，这个新场地灯光和音响设施都非常专业，面积也比去年的大很多，因此场地费用增加2000多美元。侨联今年花了巨资来打造本次华裔小姐比赛，是为了华人社区奉献一场高品质的专业赛事，从观赏性，娱乐性等多方面来全面提升华裔选美品牌。本网站也将配合本次活动，推出佳丽的详细背景介绍，以及网络投票等相关活动，届时网络投票将占选举最后投票的20%，最受网络欢迎奖也将从本网站评出。
106af1d28cd90d372dcc58c1dce339492e9a058a.translatedText: Miss Chinese Fengcheng’s on-field training is in full swing, and off-site arrangements are in order (pictures) News from this newspaper Zhang Zhaohong Photography Zhang Zhaohong Photography At 10:30 a.m. on Saturday, May 21, the training for Miss Chinese Phoenix Phoenix candidates began smoothly at the New Oriental Art School. The promotional activities for Miss Chinese Phoenix in Los Angeles, as well as the determination of the new competition venue and other related arrangements were in place. The training activities for the beauties are conducted in a closed environment at the New Oriental Art School. The positions and movements of all the beauties have been basically determined, and everyone is working hard to strive for excellence and deliver a beautiful performance. A new step coach, Chen Si, came to this training. Chen Si participated in the 2009 Miss Chinese in Fengcheng competition and won second place. She is currently a college student studying graphic design and a professional contracted model. All the beauties received professional training on stage steps under the leadership of Chen Si. The seemingly simple steps of a model are actually as difficult as a dance performance. The size of the steps, rhythm, and the position of the body and head all have a lot to pay attention to. The beauties all expressed that they benefited a lot from this training. The training on the field is in full swing, and the arrangements off the field are also proceeding in an orderly manner. On May 30, the contestants will receive interviews and training from Phoenix TV in Los Angeles and will visit the Chinese Chamber of Commerce. All the itinerary and accommodation for the trip to Los Angeles have been arranged. In addition, the venue for the competition is also ready. The venue is initially set to be Arcadia High School (4703 E. Indian School Road, Phoenix). The lighting and sound facilities of this new venue are very professional, and the area is much larger than last year. Therefore, the venue cost has increased by more than US$2,000. The Overseas Chinese Federation has spent a huge amount of money to create this Miss Chinese competition this year. It is to provide a high-quality professional event to the Chinese community and comprehensively enhance the Chinese beauty pageant brand from many aspects such as viewing and entertainment. This website will also cooperate with this event to launch a detailed background introduction of the beauties, as well as online voting and other related activities. Online voting will account for 20% of the final vote in the election, and the most popular online award will also be judged on this website.

61155befc1ec84349b4746bbad193cc51c561d53.sourceText: 亚太健康促进会让您认知肝炎从五月开始 每年中央疾病管制预防中心订五月为肝炎认知月，这对亚裔美国人而言极为重要，因每十位亚裔美国人当中就有一人感染B型肝炎，相对其他的美国族群感染率为每一千人中仅有一人。 大多数的亚裔美国人从未接受简单的B型肝炎抽血检测，而许多已感染B型肝炎者大多数不知道自己被感染，B型肝炎可能潜伏多年， 甚至数十年，都没有症状，等到有症状时，有效的治疗已太迟，因此早期诊断与接受治疗极为重要，目前新的疗法能有效地延缓病毒在肝脏内的繁殖。 亚太健康促进会为本地一非营利健康机构，自２００５年起为本地的亚太健康促进会提供免费的B型肝炎教育与抽血检测服务，到目前为止有两千五百位以上人士接受此项检测，其中一百五十位的检验结果为阳性。 亚太健康促进会鼓励所有居住在马瑞柯帕郡的亚太裔人士接受B型肝炎检测，有健康保险的人士可要求您的医生为您做此项检测，没有健康保险的人士请致电亚太健康促进会 ，电话(602) 265-4598，取得免费B型肝炎检测讯息，或请浏览亚太健康促进会网站 www.apcaaz.org 。
61155befc1ec84349b4746bbad193cc51c561d53.translatedText: Asia-Pacific Health Promotion will help you learn about hepatitis starting in May. Every year, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention designates May as Hepatitis Awareness Month, which is extremely important for Asian Americans because one in ten Asian Americans are infected with hepatitis B, compared to only one in every thousand people in other American groups. Most Asian Americans have never received a simple blood test for hepatitis B, and many people who have been infected with hepatitis B do not know that they are infected. Hepatitis B may lie dormant for years, even decades, without symptoms. By the time symptoms appear, it is too late for effective treatment. Therefore, early diagnosis and treatment are extremely important. New treatments can effectively delay the reproduction of the virus in the liver. The Asia Pacific Health Promotion Association is a local non-profit health organization that has provided free hepatitis B education and blood testing services to the local Asia Pacific Health Promotion Association since 2005. So far, more than 2,500 people have received this test, of which 150 have tested positive. APHA encourages all Asian and Pacific Islanders living in Maricopa County to get tested for hepatitis B. If you have health insurance, you can ask your doctor to do this test for you. If you do not have health insurance, please call APCA at (602) 265-4598 for free hepatitis B testing information, or visit the APCA website at www.apcaaz.org.

5994de66f43e3783586a0089721fc5e98bc2b90b.sourceText: 黄慧莉律师法律信箱（十三） 1． 我听说投资移民区域中心今年9月30日就没了﹐是否真有此事﹖ 答﹕美国EB-5 投资移民要求申请人投资100 万美金并在拿到绿卡后二年内创造10 个全职的就业机会。 如果是属于高失业区的投资(高于美国平均失业率的50%)， 则只要求申请人投50万美金即可。 除了自己开公司创造10 个就业机会外，目前也有很多人是透过EB-5 区域中心项目投资50 万的方式提出EB-5 投资移民的申请。 EB-5 区域中心投资项目将于2012年9月30日到期，但延期的可能性非常大。 但是，如果区域中心项目没有获得延期，那么在9月30日以后移民局将不会再接受基于区域中心项目的新的投资移民申请或者修正请求。 通过区域中心提出投资移民申请，投资者的I-526申请必须在9月30日之前寄到移民局。 移民局确认按时收到申请之后，投资者需要等待大约六到八个月的时间才能收到I-526的批准。 以后即使区域中心项目关闭，EB-5投资移民项目仍然存在，有意提出投资民申请的投资人仍然可以按照相关规定通过在美国自己成立公司或投资项目获得绿卡。 除非区域中心项目获得延期，否则在国会采取进一步行动之前，移民局将会搁置在9月30日之前收到的未裁决的区域中心I-924申请以及区域中心相关的I-526申请。 如果国会不再重新许可区域中心项目，对于这些搁置的申请的最终裁决将取决于创造直接就业机会的证据。 决定会基于已经提交的首次申请或者回复补件要求的证据。 所有还在等待的区域中心提案也都会被否决。 如果区域中心项目最终遭到关闭，那么不仅仅是外国投资者的移民申请会受到负面影响，美国经济也将会受到严重影响。 虽然未来EB-5 区域中心项目可能通过单独立法或者作为将来的全面移民改革立法成为永久项目，但是目前为止，区域中心项目是否能获得延期或者永久化仍是未知数。 2． 我先生是绿卡﹐有2个美国公民的小孩﹐我们有I130批准﹐但我非法居留3年﹐他又考不过公民﹐我何时可以申请豁免﹖ 答﹕移民法规定，非法入境并在美国非法居留超过180天或一年的非法移民，一旦出境就会受到3年或10年不准再入境的处罚。 如果他们与美国公民或绿卡结婚，他们必须回到原来的国家申请移民签证。 这样，他们就面临不能很快回到美国的风险。 3月30日，移民局提出一个解决办法，即允许美国公民的亲属在美国递交临时豁免申请（I-601）有资格的亲属并不一定是申请人﹐且极端困难必须证明可以提交任何证据来 证明如果被拒绝入境美国，美国公民配偶或父母会遇到的极端困难﹐其因素可包括但不限于下列项目： 健康状况：身体或精神病态正在进行中或需专业治疗，在国外治疗的可行性和条件，预期医疗的时间，慢性或急性，长期或短期。 财务方面：未来的就业机会，特殊需求的费用，如有特殊需要的儿童特殊教育或培训费用，照顾家人(老人和生病的父母)的费用。 教育方面：丧失接受高等教育的机会，教育选择的范围素质低或有限，目前的计画受到破坏，要接受外国语言和文化的教育，不但费时并损失学分，特殊需求的可得性，如具体 领域的培训课程或实习。 个人因素：在美国的近亲，美国出生或入籍，将与配偶或子女分离，有关人士的年纪，在美国居住的时间长短和与社区的关联。 特殊因素：在美国的近亲，美国出生或入籍，人身伤害或损害，社会的排斥或污名，可得到（或无法得到）社会机构或结构（官方或非官方）的支持、指导或保护。 这样的申请﹐也许再不久的将来可以开始接受申请﹐请注意移民局官方网站 WWW.USCIS.GOV
5994de66f43e3783586a0089721fc5e98bc2b90b.translatedText: > Lawyer Huang Huili’s legal mailbox (13) 1. I heard that the Investment Immigration Regional Center ceased operations on September 30 this year. Is this true? Answer: The US EB-5 investment immigration requires applicants to invest US$1 million and create 10 full-time jobs within two years after receiving the green card. If the investment is in a high-unemployment area (higher than 50% of the U.S. average unemployment rate), the applicant is only required to invest US$500,000. In addition to opening their own companies and creating 10 job opportunities, many people are currently applying for EB-5 investment immigration by investing 500,000 in the EB-5 regional center project. The EB-5 Regional Center Investment Project will expire on September 30, 2012, but the possibility of extension is very high. However, if the regional center project is not extended, the USCIS will no longer accept new investment immigration applications or amendment requests based on the regional center project after September 30. To apply for investment immigration through the regional center, the investor's I-526 application must be sent to the USCIS before September 30. After the USCIS confirms receipt of the application on time, investors need to wait approximately six to eight months to receive I-526 approval. Even if the regional center project is closed in the future, the EB-5 investment immigration project will still exist, and investors who intend to apply for investment can still obtain a green card by establishing a company or investing in a project in the United States in accordance with relevant regulations. Unless the regional center program is extended, USCIS will put pending regional center I-924 petitions and regional center-related I-526 petitions received before September 30 on hold pending further action by Congress. If Congress does not reauthorize the regional center program, final determinations on these pending applications will depend on evidence of direct job creation. Decisions will be based on evidence that has been submitted for the first application or in response to a request for additional documentation. All pending regional center proposals would also be rejected. If the regional center program is ultimately closed, not only will foreign investors’ immigration applications be negatively affected, but the U.S. economy will also be severely affected. Although the EB-5 regional center program may become permanent in the future through separate legislation or as part of future comprehensive immigration reform legislation, it is currently unknown whether the regional center program can be extended or made permanent. 2． My husband has a green card and has 2 children who are US citizens. We have I130 approval, but I have stayed illegally for 3 years and he failed the citizenship test. When can I apply for exemption? Answer: Immigration laws stipulate that illegal immigrants who enter the United States illegally and stay illegally for more than 180 days or one year will be punished by not being allowed to re-enter for 3 years or 10 years once they leave the country. If they are married to a U.S. citizen or green card holder, they must return to their original country to apply for an immigrant visa. In this way, they risk not being able to return to the United States soon. On March 30, the USCIS proposed a solution, which is to allow relatives of US citizens to submit temporary exemption applications (I-601) in the United States. Eligible relatives are not necessarily the applicants, and extreme hardship must be proved. Any evidence can be submitted to prove the extreme hardship that the spouse or parents of US citizens will encounter if they are denied entry to the United States. The factors may include but are not limited to the following items: Health status: Ongoing physical or mental illness or requiring professional treatment, availability and conditions for treatment abroad, expected duration of medical treatment, chronic or acute, long-term or short-term. Financial aspects: future employment opportunities, expenses for special needs, such as special education or training expenses for children with special needs, expenses for caring for family members (elderly and sick parents). Education: Loss of access to higher education, low-quality or limited range of educational options, disruption of current plans, time-consuming and loss of credits in foreign languages ​​and cultures, availability of special needs, such as training courses or internships in specific fields. Personal factors: close relative in the United States, U.S. birth or naturalization, separation from spouse or children, age of the person concerned, length of residence in the United States and ties to the community. Special factors: close relatives in the United States, U.S. birth or naturalization, personal injury or damage, social ostracism or stigmatization, access (or inability) to support, guidance, or protection from social institutions or structures (official or unofficial). Such applications may be accepted in the near future. Please pay attention to the official website of the USCIS WWW.USCIS.GOV

7d8339da25a6cbb5738998f901fdd4471302e7bb.sourceText: 凤凰城鉴慈：心境 ” 兵”者，国之大事、生死之事，存亡之道，不可不察也！ 一国之体制可以改变，但一国之民族永不能消灭。 远的像纳粹想消灭犹太民族，近的像阿富汗、伊拉克体制的改变。 宣布战争与否，最终是决定由人民选出来的领导人或是由团队选出来的最高决策人决定。 民意的倾向只是反映一部份人的意思，再由经过深思熟虑的团队的最高决策人或国家领导人决定。 现今整个亚洲西太平洋沿岸掀起的岛屿风波，使到亚洲各国各自充满敌意。 经济促使繁荣，战争促使衰败。 中国的版图数元、清最大，明朝的版图只局限长城以南，东部和东南部，中部只有黄河、长江的中游。 而满清的版图是现中国版图，包括今天的蒙古共和国和俄罗斯的西伯利亚，可谓相当大的一个版图国家。 中国是汉人的国家，如果是所谓反清复明的话，版图只有最初国民政府的三分之一，而论及五族共和版图岂止是现今的版图。 国大好战必亡，相反忘战必危。 大多数人都明白这个道理，一个在地球上小如一粒细沙、全无人烟的荒岛，却被一些别有用心的政客热炒热卖，而牵动到十六亿人的神经，被感动到热血奔腾。 什么是保卫领土完整，什么是寸土必争，什么是血战到底，真是值得这样气愤吗？ 双方没有必胜把握，无需大搞动作，保持原先的状态，让两国人民共享平安快乐，双方人民切记千万别上了自私自利政客的当。 ” 岛链”是美军的一种策略，”陆链”在弱势中可起抗衡作用。 钱学森曾经说过，一支火箭只需五至六分钟就可以从美东飞到美西去。 中国的洲际导弹飞弹可以发射到一万多公里以外的地方，覆盖半个地球，亦即是由东面或是由西面发射可覆盖整个地球。 不谈原子核子，普通弹头杀伤力非常巨大，美国的更不用说它的厉害。 日本因疾忌中国的发展，而听从别人的梳摆，借此想打垮中国的经济地位。 如果日本极右政客罔顾后果，想和中国较量的话，中国军民会以谨记二战时的屈辱，愤慨的心情奉陪到底。 战争可以分小战大战，小战可以保持实力，亦可以用谈判取得和平结束，大战就像日本海军不要命狂炸珍珠港的美海军，造成不宣而战的严重后果，最后，恶果自食 。 神州大陆，地大辽阔，大和四岛不及神州一大省，最重要，日本核子发电所，遍布全国，需有防御飞弹保护，但总有防不胜防，后果堪虑，理应三思。
7d8339da25a6cbb5738998f901fdd4471302e7bb.translatedText: Phoenix City Jianci: Those with a "war" mentality must observe the major events of the country, matters of life and death, and the path to survival! A country's system can be changed, but its nation can never be eliminated. It is as far away as the Nazis wanting to eliminate the Jewish nation, and as recent as the changes in the institutions in Afghanistan and Iraq. Whether to declare war or not is ultimately decided by the leaders elected by the people or the top decision-maker selected by the team. The tendency of public opinion only reflects the opinions of some people, and is determined by the top decision-maker or national leader of the team after careful consideration. The current island turmoil along the western Pacific coast of Asia has made all Asian countries full of hostility. Economy promotes prosperity, war promotes decline. China's territory was the largest in the Yuan Dynasty and Qing Dynasty. The territory of the Ming Dynasty was limited to the south of the Great Wall, the east and southeast, and the middle reaches of the Yellow River and the Yangtze River in the central part. The territory of the Manchu Qing Dynasty is the current territory of China, including today's Republic of Mongolia and Siberia of Russia. It can be said to be a fairly large territory. China is a country of the Han people. If it is the so-called anti-Qing and restoration of the Ming Dynasty, the territory will only be one-third of the original National Government. When it comes to the territory of the Five Nationalities Republic, it will not only be the current territory. A country that loves war will perish, but a country that forgets to fight will be in danger. Most people understand this truth. A desert island, which is as small as a grain of sand on earth and completely uninhabited, has been promoted by some politicians with ulterior motives, and has affected the nerves of 1.6 billion people, and has been moved to the point of running with passion. What is defending territorial integrity, what is fighting for every inch of territory, and what is bloody fighting to the end? Is it really worth being so angry? Both sides are not sure of victory and do not need to make any big moves. They should maintain the original status quo and let the people of the two countries share peace and happiness. People on both sides must remember not to be fooled by selfish politicians. The "island chain" is a strategy of the US military, and the "land chain" can play a countervailing role when it is weak. Qian Xuesen once said that a rocket can fly from the East to the West in just five to six minutes. China's intercontinental missiles can be launched more than 10,000 kilometers away, covering half of the earth. That is, they can cover the entire earth if launched from the east or west. Leaving aside atomic nuclei, the destructive power of ordinary warheads is very huge, not to mention the power of American warheads. Because Japan is wary of China's development, it listens to others' advice in order to destroy China's economic status. If Japan's far-right politicians ignore the consequences and want to compete with China, the Chinese military and civilians will bear in mind the humiliation during World War II and stay with them with indignation. War can be divided into small wars and big wars. Small wars can maintain strength, or they can be ended peacefully through negotiation. A war can be like the Japanese Navy's desperate bombing of Pearl Harbor by the U.S. Navy, causing serious consequences of undeclared war. In the end, you will reap the consequences. The mainland of China is vast. The four islands of Yamato are not as large as the province of China. Most importantly, Japan's nuclear power plants are spread across the country. They need to be protected by defensive missiles. However, there are always things that cannot be guarded against, and the consequences are dire. You should think twice.
