cabd95c30f25a2d86fe749e13d0206b386d2fb5d.sourceText: 美莎姐妹市副主席Marcus Newton向帕莎老师赠送了献花，欢迎她的到来，并将给大家带来精彩的舞蹈课程。帕莎老师将从明天开始（１０月２日）在新东方艺术学校教授新疆舞。帕莎此次的亚利桑那之旅将为期十天。这是她第三次到访凤凰城，为凤凰城的朋友带来舞蹈课程。
cabd95c30f25a2d86fe749e13d0206b386d2fb5d.translatedText: Meisha Sisters City Vice Chairman Marcus Newton presented flowers to Teacher Pasha, welcoming her arrival and will bring wonderful dance lessons to everyone. Teacher Pasha will teach Xinjiang dance at New Oriental Art School starting tomorrow (October 2). Pasha's trip to Arizona will last ten days. This is her third visit to Phoenix to bring dance classes to friends in Phoenix.

705b782c7b592108236dacdffb2f1b178a045fe3.sourceText: 帕莎老师全名帕莎 吾曼儿。曾是新疆歌舞团和东方歌舞团独舞演员，８０年代电影《海市蜃楼》的女主角，现在香港演艺学院教授新疆舞和东亚舞。
705b782c7b592108236dacdffb2f1b178a045fe3.translatedText: >Teacher Pasha’s full name is Pasha Wumaner. She was a solo dancer in the Xinjiang Song and Dance Troupe and the Oriental Song and Dance Troupe, and the heroine of the 1980s movie "Mirage". She now teaches Xinjiang dance and East Asian dance at the Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts.

b0b9cc4bd3caaa90dc17861430e01b0351b51991.sourceText: 亚省希望中文学校新网站研发实录
b0b9cc4bd3caaa90dc17861430e01b0351b51991.translatedText: A record of the research and development of the new website of the Alberta Hope Chinese School

82447af502acc7d8f14c09eae91264fd96d1cecb.sourceText: 亚省希望中文学校新网站研发实录 为了提升亚省中文学校形象，增强宣传力度，同时为了在教学过程中更好地利用最新网络…
82447af502acc7d8f14c09eae91264fd96d1cecb.translatedText: A record of the development of the new website of the Alberta Hope Chinese School In order to enhance the image of Chinese schools in Alberta, enhance publicity efforts, and make better use of the latest network in the teaching process...

5fe05b57794fd340bef5b175339461a66bc9ea7c.sourceText: 为了提升亚省中文学校形象，增强宣传力度，同时为了在教学过程中更好地利用最新网络技术、完善学校日常管理，亚省希望中文学校新的网站历经5个多月的开发与调试，于2015年2月15日成功升级改版上线。现将本网站的主要功能及研发历程与大家分享一下。 1、网站架构及展示更专业化。整个学校的网站系统开发采用的是当前非常主流的教育平台系统，开设课程、艺术长廊、师生园地、学习资源等信息重点展示，网站前台和管理后台分别独立部署，确保系统数据安全；网站的页面布局更合理、页面风格美观大气、功能简洁实用，见图1。
5fe05b57794fd340bef5b175339461a66bc9ea7c.translatedText: In order to enhance the image of Chinese schools in Alberta, enhance publicity efforts, and make better use of the latest network technology in the teaching process and improve daily management of schools, the new website of Chinese schools in Alberta was successfully upgraded and launched on February 15, 2015 after more than 5 months of development and debugging. Now I will share with you the main functions and development process of this website. 1. The website structure and display are more professional. The entire school's website system is developed using the current very mainstream education platform system, which focuses on displaying information such as courses, art galleries, teachers and students' gardens, and learning resources. The website front desk and management backend are deployed independently to ensure system data security; the website's page layout is more reasonable, the page style is beautiful, and the functions are simple and practical, as shown in Figure 1.

d178fcafd0f50af2e644280d651f44230be50ae8.sourceText: 2、网站用户功能全面，满足学校中长期教学发展需求。网站用户功能主要包括以下几个主要用户功能模块： （1）家长、学生用户主要包括：在线选课、注课及改选课（包括历史注课信息），缴费管理，在线投票（对学校各类事件进行独立投票），在线注册Parent Duty，与老师在线实时交流，在线作业管理（提交作业），个人成绩管理等。 （2）教师用户主要包括：在线师生交互，教学班级学生信息管理，教学课程管理，在线家庭作业管理（在线布置作业、批改作业及成绩评定），以及学生成绩管理等。 （3）学校管理用户功能包括：课程管理（课程开设、注课等各种功能），教师管理（通过教师的在线作业及与学生交互情况对教师教学进行管理），前台各种信息（图片、视频等）发布管理，收费管理（实时对账户balance，方便安全—-如何对家庭账户的操作均由日志记录），各种基于用户数据的详实统计报表，见图2。
d178fcafd0f50af2e644280d651f44230be50ae8.translatedText: 2. The website has comprehensive user functions to meet the school's medium and long-term teaching development needs. The user functions of the website mainly include the following main user function modules: (1) Parents and student users mainly include: online course selection, course registration and course change (including historical course registration information), payment management, online voting (independent voting on various school events), online registration for Parent Duty, online real-time communication with teachers, online homework management (submission of homework), personal score management, etc. (2) Teacher users mainly include: online teacher-student interaction, teaching class student information management, teaching course management, online homework management (online assignments, homework corrections and performance assessment), and student performance management, etc. (3) School management user functions include: course management (various functions such as course opening, class registration, etc.), teacher management (managing teachers’ teaching through teachers’ online assignments and interactions with students), release and management of various information (pictures, videos, etc.) at the front desk, charging management (real-time account balance, convenient and safe—how operations on family accounts are recorded by logs), and various detailed statistical reports based on user data, see Figure 2.

bc072aa20b7649fa9c841c60968038c2973e73ca.sourceText: （4）网站管理用户功能：由于网站采用的是模块化功能设计方案，所以，使用学校可以按照本校的需求自己调整设置网站的功能菜单及页面展示方案，同时各种操作非常方便，均无需专业人员进行操作。 （5）广告管理功能：通过提供师生在线实时交互平台（包括在线作业功能），因此中文学校网站就具有稳定访问用户（这些用户对一些商家具有很强的吸引力），这样就可以通过在网站为一些商家提供广告发布功能，从而就能为学校带来一定的创收。 3、创新的网站开发模式。由于每个中文学校的办学经费均非常紧张，而开发这样专业的网站费用非常高，不是学校一时能承担得起的。本次网站开发主要是由本校学生家长徐占洋老师免费赞助开发（徐占洋是来自大陆高校的ASU访问学者，大陆拥有专业研发团队），在网站正式投入使用后，每月仅需支付少量的维护费用。同时，网站投入使用后，网站的广告发布功能收入可以承担网站的维护费用，甚至为学校带来较大的创收。在这种创新模式下，学校实现了零成本投入改版升级网站的目标。 新网站投入使用以来，获得了广大师生的一致好评。徐占洋老师和他的团队在网站开发期间不辞辛苦一遍遍的更改内容力求网站完美无缺并且主动为我们设计了许多我们都没有想到的功能。新网站上线只是希望中文学校网络化教学的一个新的开始，希望中文学校将不断努力，与南京硕博信息技术开发工作室一同合作致力于利用先进的计算机网络技术为广大学生提供更好的学习条件和环境。
bc072aa20b7649fa9c841c60968038c2973e73ca.translatedText: (4) Website management user functions: Since the website adopts a modular functional design, the school can adjust and set up the function menu and page display scheme of the website according to the needs of the school. At the same time, various operations are very convenient and do not require professionals to operate. (5) Advertising management function: By providing an online real-time interaction platform for teachers and students (including online homework functions), the Chinese school website has stable visiting users (these users are very attractive to some merchants), so that it can provide advertising publishing functions for some merchants on the website, thereby generating a certain amount of revenue for the school. 3. Innovative website development model. Since the funding for each Chinese school is very tight, the cost of developing such a professional website is very high and cannot be afforded by the school at the moment. The development of this website is mainly sponsored and developed free of charge by teacher Xu Zhanyang, a parent of the school's students (Xu Zhanyang is an ASU visiting scholar from a mainland university, and mainland China has a professional R&D team). After the website is officially put into use, only a small amount of maintenance fees need to be paid every month. At the same time, after the website is put into use, the revenue from the advertising publishing function of the website can cover the maintenance costs of the website, and even bring greater revenue generation to the school. Under this innovative model, the school achieved the goal of revamping and upgrading its website at zero cost. Since the new website was put into use, it has received unanimous praise from teachers and students. During the development of the website, Mr. Xu Zhanyang and his team worked tirelessly to change the content over and over again to make the website perfect and proactively designed many features for us that we had not thought of. The launch of the new website is just a new beginning for the online teaching of Hope Chinese School. Hope Chinese School will continue to work hard and work with the Nanjing Shuobo Information Technology Development Studio to use advanced computer network technology to provide better learning conditions and environment for the majority of students.

0c5099f8cd9813af00ab2ecaa3f5c5d70db2c3c6.sourceText: 多国暂停飞中国航班 境外滞留游客可申请改签
0c5099f8cd9813af00ab2ecaa3f5c5d70db2c3c6.translatedText: Many countries have suspended flights to China, and tourists stranded overseas can apply to change their flights

65dc2e6b1cec85e91b03f9a4ddfa7d4f4d4625ff.sourceText: 【财新网】（记者 田佳玮）随着新冠疫情向海外扩散，多个国家宣布加强边境管控，取消或暂停往返中国的部分航班。滞留…
65dc2e6b1cec85e91b03f9a4ddfa7d4f4d4625ff.translatedText: [Caixin.com] (Reporter Tian Jiawei) As the COVID-19 epidemic spreads overseas, many countries have announced to strengthen border control and cancel or suspend some flights to and from China. Stranded...

fe056f7a6fc3dda6298952a661f42cb96d29b739.sourceText: 【财新网】（记者 田佳玮） 随着新冠疫情向海外扩散，多个国家宣布加强边境管控，取消或暂停往返中国的部分航班。滞留国外的部分中国游客的去留成为问题，近期有计划赴境外者，也可能将会受到影响。
fe056f7a6fc3dda6298952a661f42cb96d29b739.translatedText: [Caixin] (Reporter Tian Jiawei) As the COVID-19 epidemic spreads overseas, many countries have announced to strengthen border control and cancel or suspend some flights to and from China. The destination of some Chinese tourists stranded abroad has become a problem, and those who plan to go abroad in the near future may also be affected.

085e7bfa96cb3aad85b611c73734e0087e90581d.sourceText: 截至发稿时，海外各国确诊病例数量共有70例，分别为：泰国14例，日本7例，韩国4例，美国5例，越南2例，新加坡7例，马来西亚7例，尼泊尔1例，法国4例，澳大利亚7例，柬埔寨1例，加拿大2例，德国4例，斯里兰卡1例，阿联酋4例。
085e7bfa96cb3aad85b611c73734e0087e90581d.translatedText: As of press time, there are 70 confirmed cases in overseas countries, namely: 14 cases in Thailand, 7 cases in Japan, 4 cases in South Korea, 5 cases in the United States, 2 cases in Vietnam, 7 cases in Singapore, 7 cases in Malaysia, 1 case in Nepal, 4 cases in France, 7 cases in Australia, 1 case in Cambodia, 2 cases in Canada, 4 cases in Germany, 1 case in Sri Lanka, and 4 cases in the United Arab Emirates.

0c334bf2481959a48883e628a92fa4f94b2556a7.sourceText: 新加坡航空旗下的廉价航空酷航于1月27日宣布，经中国相关部门批准，将于1月29日、30日派两个单程航班从新加坡直飞武汉。两班飞机应是协助大量武汉人从新加坡返程。
0c334bf2481959a48883e628a92fa4f94b2556a7.translatedText: Scoot, a low-cost airline owned by Singapore Airlines, announced on January 27 that, with the approval of relevant Chinese authorities, it will send two one-way direct flights from Singapore to Wuhan on January 29 and 30. The two flights were supposed to help a large number of people from Wuhan return from Singapore.

869f553392bfe3cf4afd0e99eb7f52215d7dcc16.sourceText: 两架酷航班机运载总人数尚不得而知。中国驻新加坡使馆官员向记者透露，使馆也在向新加坡有关部门询问滞留在新的武汉人总数，对方回复需要时间统计，暂时无法提供准确数据。驻新加坡领侨处近期收到要求从新加坡返回武汉的申请，而申请数字基本与酷航这两架包机人数相当。
869f553392bfe3cf4afd0e99eb7f52215d7dcc16.translatedText: The total number of people carried on the two Scoot aircraft is unknown. An official from the Chinese Embassy in Singapore revealed to reporters that the embassy is also asking the relevant departments in Singapore about the total number of people stranded in Wuhan. The other party's reply will take time to calculate and accurate data cannot be provided for the time being. The Consular Office in Singapore has recently received applications to return to Wuhan from Singapore, and the number of applications is basically the same as the number of people on the two Scoot charter flights.

c5653f19031c399d667c6d72922b37dcb9dc5b3b.sourceText: 酷航原本运营一条新加坡与武汉直飞路线TR120，每日两班飞机往返，机型均为波音787-900，每班飞机可承载290到300人。1月23日因新冠疫情停飞，于1月24日将一百多名原计划返程武汉的改签游客送至杭州。
c5653f19031c399d667c6d72922b37dcb9dc5b3b.translatedText: Scoot originally operated a direct flight route between Singapore and Wuhan, TR120, with two flights a day. Both planes were Boeing 787-900, and each flight could carry 290 to 300 people. Flights were suspended on January 23 due to the COVID-19 epidemic, and more than 100 changed tourists who originally planned to return to Wuhan were sent to Hangzhou on January 24.

3a011b51744df1af3777093d291d26bcd7e34e6c.sourceText: 新加坡政府同时宣布，从1月29日起，将禁止所有持有中国湖北省签发护照的新访客入境新加坡。同时，过去14天内到访过湖北的新访客，也不得入境新加坡。
3a011b51744df1af3777093d291d26bcd7e34e6c.translatedText: The Singaporean government also announced that starting from January 29, all new visitors holding passports issued by Hubei Province in China will be prohibited from entering Singapore. At the same time, new visitors who have visited Hubei in the past 14 days are not allowed to enter Singapore.

d00bcbb3c6d2e6f34da9708bf6b8b77001ff985b.sourceText: 1月26日，日本在国内确诊第四例新型冠状病毒感染肺炎病例。日本首相安倍晋三于1月27日表示，将会把本次病毒定为《感染症法》中的“指定感染症”。此举将能够依法强制患者住院和限制就业，感染者的医疗费用则将由日本政府承担。
d00bcbb3c6d2e6f34da9708bf6b8b77001ff985b.translatedText: On January 26, Japan confirmed its fourth case of pneumonia caused by the new coronavirus in the country. Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe stated on January 27 that the virus would be designated as a "designated infectious disease" under the Infectious Diseases Act. This move will force patients to be hospitalized and restrict employment in accordance with the law, and the medical expenses of infected people will be borne by the Japanese government.

53381b425472945788ac3aa2bce68529b4b05702.sourceText: 日本厚生劳动省负责传染病事务的一名官员向财新记者确认，日本政府承担在日新型冠状病毒肺炎患者医疗费用的原则，将不分患者国籍，一体适用。在被问及日本政府后续为什么不会公开患者国籍时，这位日本官员表示：“我们工作是了解病情、让患者住院；传播与疫情相关的信息。在这个过程中，与国籍为何是没有关系的。”
53381b425472945788ac3aa2bce68529b4b05702.translatedText: An official in charge of infectious diseases at the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare of Japan confirmed to Caixin reporters that the principle that the Japanese government bears the medical expenses of patients with new coronavirus pneumonia in Japan will apply regardless of the patient's nationality. When asked why the Japanese government would not disclose the patient's nationality in the future, the Japanese official said: "Our job is to understand the condition, hospitalize the patient, and disseminate information related to the epidemic. In this process, the nationality has nothing to do with it."

e26a2c5487daa2b10c9069af85d567eb2bb7851f.sourceText: 他还说，如果公开患者的（国籍），使得有人能知道（患者）身份，有可能会导致对中国人造成不应该的偏见或人权侵害。
e26a2c5487daa2b10c9069af85d567eb2bb7851f.translatedText: He also said that if the patient's (nationality) is disclosed so that someone can know the (patient's) identity, it may lead to undue prejudice or human rights violations against the Chinese.

2200b115a93c48b80714337a94a4558ff2cb8587.sourceText: 对于因为武汉“封城”，暂时不能返回武汉、但面临签证到期的中国游客，大阪出入国在留管理局在接受财新记者采访时称，考虑到此次的新冠疫情，短期滞留日本的旅客，如果有妥当理由，能够申请延期签证；如果理由不妥当或不合理，就不会被批准。他说，将会根据游客的具体情况而定，目前不方便透露具体的条件和标准。
2200b115a93c48b80714337a94a4558ff2cb8587.translatedText: For Chinese tourists who are temporarily unable to return to Wuhan due to Wuhan's "lockdown" but are facing expiration of their visas, the Osaka Immigration Bureau said in an interview with Caixin reporters that considering the COVID-19 epidemic, travelers staying in Japan for a short period of time can apply for a visa extension if they have valid reasons; if the reasons are inappropriate or unreasonable, they will not be approved. He said that it will be determined based on the specific situation of tourists, and it is not convenient to disclose the specific conditions and standards at the moment.

be47427e9e4336c79dbb7fa94fe8f469cd0fe4cb.sourceText: 根据世界卫生组织1月28日公布的数字，泰国目前确诊新冠病毒感染者数量为14例，是中国以外确诊人数最多的国家。
be47427e9e4336c79dbb7fa94fe8f469cd0fe4cb.translatedText: According to figures released by the World Health Organization on January 28, Thailand currently has 14 confirmed cases of COVID-19 infection, making it the country with the largest number of confirmed cases outside China.

442563c4b9a891950a2de84aa3380799ab80cd27.sourceText: 泰国政府和移民局在1月26日就发布通告，取消无法返回武汉的游客延期滞留泰国的罚款，以为游客提供便利。
442563c4b9a891950a2de84aa3380799ab80cd27.translatedText: The Thai government and Immigration Bureau issued a notice on January 26 to cancel the fines for tourists who are unable to return to Wuhan for extended stays in Thailand to provide convenience for tourists.

c6be028c1aa3c40b12da0cf4d5f70a3bfebce9b2.sourceText: 韩国政府于1月28日表示，将派四架包机飞往武汉，疏散那里的大约700名韩国公民。
c6be028c1aa3c40b12da0cf4d5f70a3bfebce9b2.translatedText: The South Korean government stated on January 28 that it would send four charter flights to Wuhan to evacuate approximately 700 South Korean citizens there.

34bf6c11c7e4ada899a676045538c584303e2f59.sourceText: 据韩联社1月29日报道，韩国韩亚航空于1月29日表示，决定从2月1日起暂时停飞仁川至桂林、海口两条航线，3日起暂停仁川至长沙航线，以防控新型冠状病毒肺炎疫情。韩亚航空将在密切关注疫情防控工作进展后再决定重启运行的时间。
34bf6c11c7e4ada899a676045538c584303e2f59.translatedText: According to Yonhap News Agency's report on January 29, South Korea's Asiana Airlines stated on January 29 that it had decided to temporarily suspend the Incheon-Guilin and Haikou routes from February 1, and the Incheon-Changsha route from February 3 to prevent and control the new coronavirus pneumonia epidemic. Asiana Airlines will determine the time to restart operations after closely monitoring the progress of epidemic prevention and control work.

a502f147252ff55ccf194781f73732dac6315faa.sourceText: 韩国保健福祉部于1月27日将新型病毒的警报级别从“注意”上调至“警戒”。此后，韩亚航空启动对策本部，指示乘务员在机上佩戴口罩，在机场、维修等地配备口罩和消毒洗手液等。
a502f147252ff55ccf194781f73732dac6315faa.translatedText: South Korea's Ministry of Health and Welfare raised the alert level for the new virus from "caution" to "alert" on January 27. Since then, Asiana Airlines has activated its countermeasures headquarters, instructing flight attendants to wear masks on board, and providing masks and hand sanitizer at airports, maintenance and other locations.

65fce93173176f5c4534abdab90707c480d427a7.sourceText: 韩亚航空表示，将为所有旅客免费退改签机票，并决定向疫情严重的武汉伸出援手，捐赠救援物资。从1月31日起，仁川至成都和北京航班上将装载价值相当于4000万韩元（约合人民币23.6万元）的口罩和医疗用品，紧急运送至武汉地区。
65fce93173176f5c4534abdab90707c480d427a7.translatedText: Asiana Airlines stated that it will provide free refunds and changes to air tickets for all passengers, and decided to lend a helping hand to Wuhan, where the epidemic is severely affected, and donate relief supplies. Starting from January 31, masks and medical supplies worth the equivalent of 40 million won (approximately RMB 236,000) will be loaded on flights from Incheon to Chengdu and Beijing for emergency delivery to the Wuhan area.

275047d4c731aabbef74fa62ca21ebb7976bfec2.sourceText: 1月28日，首尔航空也停飞了仁川至张家界和临沂航线。济州航空将从1月29日和30日起停飞韩国釜山、务安至张家界的两条航线。易斯达航空也决定于1月30日到2月29日停飞清州至张家界航线，还正在考虑暂停其他中国航线。据悉，韩国德威航空和真航空的赴华航线也处于停飞状态。
275047d4c731aabbef74fa62ca21ebb7976bfec2.translatedText: On January 28, Air Seoul also suspended flights from Incheon to Zhangjiajie and Linyi. Jeju Air will suspend its two routes from Busan and Muan in South Korea to Zhangjiajie starting from January 29th and 30th. Eastar Airlines has also decided to suspend flights from Qingzhou to Zhangjiajie from January 30 to February 29, and is also considering suspending other China routes. It is reported that the routes to China of South Korea's Tulway Air and Jin Air are also suspended.

82bbd659ee36ed8d9529e49c9a09e0f2a7a189f0.sourceText: 据大韩贸易投资振兴公社（KOTRA）消息，1月30日和31日，韩国政府与民间共同筹措的200万个口罩，防护服、护目镜各10万套医疗救助物资将转交给中国。
82bbd659ee36ed8d9529e49c9a09e0f2a7a189f0.translatedText: According to the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency (KOTRA), on January 30 and 31, 2 million masks, 100,000 sets of protective clothing, and goggles each jointly raised by the South Korean government and the private sector will be transferred to China.

71bc9f1d2a68188f9a6ba87f3253f81f754484e3.sourceText: 另外，大韩民国驻武汉总领事馆、大韩贸易投资振兴公社（KOTRA）中国地区总部、武汉代表处、及韩国企业WIITECH CORPORATION也共同捐赠防护口罩8万个(包括儿童口罩2万个)。
71bc9f1d2a68188f9a6ba87f3253f81f754484e3.translatedText: In addition, the Consulate General of the Republic of Korea in Wuhan, the China Regional Headquarters of Korea Trade and Investment Promotion Agency (KOTRA), the Wuhan Representative Office, and the Korean company WIITECH CORPORATION also donated 80,000 protective masks (including 20,000 children's masks).

81ff473e5199efc0dd91e58fb59b8d3f11eb4781.sourceText: 菲律宾移民局于1月28日宣布，暂停对中国游客签发落地签证。菲律宾移民局局长莫任特（Jaime Morente）在一份声明中表示：“我们正在采取措施减缓客流量，这可能有助于阻止新冠病毒的传播”。
81ff473e5199efc0dd91e58fb59b8d3f11eb4781.translatedText: The Philippine Immigration Service announced on January 28 that it would suspend the issuance of visas on arrival to Chinese tourists. "We are taking steps to slow down passenger flow, which may help stop the spread of COVID-19," Immigration Bureau Director Jaime Morente said in a statement.

b7407b09262d47945ed28eb90bf6cf7ae95dd075.sourceText: 马来西亚首相办公室于1月27日宣布，暂时禁止来自武汉市及湖北省的中国公民入境，即时生效。
b7407b09262d47945ed28eb90bf6cf7ae95dd075.translatedText: The Prime Minister's Office of Malaysia announced on January 27 that it would temporarily ban the entry of Chinese citizens from Wuhan City and Hubei Province, effective immediately.

9f4595a30f6824aafaee535e2b1258766b4cda1f.sourceText: 南亚国家斯里兰卡于1月27日夜间确诊首个新冠病例。据斯里兰卡媒体1月28日报道，1月27日晚间，斯里兰卡宣布立即暂停向中国游客发放落地签证。斯里兰卡官方表示，此举旨在抑制新型冠状病毒的传播。
9f4595a30f6824aafaee535e2b1258766b4cda1f.translatedText: The South Asian country Sri Lanka confirmed its first new coronavirus case on the night of January 27. According to Sri Lankan media reports on January 28, on the evening of January 27, Sri Lanka announced that it would immediately suspend the issuance of visas on arrival to Chinese tourists. Sri Lankan officials said the move was aimed at curbing the spread of the novel coronavirus.

a72384825f456484ad607a64ea5684cf8310a4f0.sourceText: 加拿大航空于1月26日在其官方网站上发表声明称，将在接下来的数周时间内取消飞往中国的部分航班。
a72384825f456484ad607a64ea5684cf8310a4f0.translatedText: Air Canada issued a statement on its official website on January 26 that it would cancel some flights to China in the next few weeks.

37272a1204e5f6d74f1d89a8540a268d04f039b5.sourceText: 该声明称，前往浦东国际机场、北京首都国际机场的乘客可以在4月20日之前退票，或者改签；前往武汉天河国际机场的乘客，可以在6月20日之前退票或改签。退票乘客将得到全额退款。如果改签到相同的舱位则不收取任何费用，改签到不同舱位则收取差价。
37272a1204e5f6d74f1d89a8540a268d04f039b5.translatedText: The statement said that passengers going to Pudong International Airport and Beijing Capital International Airport can refund or change their tickets before April 20; passengers going to Wuhan Tianhe International Airport can refund or change their tickets before June 20. Passengers who cancel their tickets will receive a full refund. If you change your booking to the same cabin class, no fee will be charged. If you change your booking to a different cabin class, the difference will be charged.

34080c27ae07a3d47f30cec51f5bc7af47881dfe.sourceText: 美国联合航空公司（United Airlines）于1月28日表示，由于日益增多的冠状病毒病例，对飞往中国的航班的服务需求“大幅下降”，因此，将在2月1日至2月8日之间暂停从美国飞往北京、香港和上海的航班。
34080c27ae07a3d47f30cec51f5bc7af47881dfe.translatedText: United Airlines said on January 28 that it would suspend flights from the United States to Beijing, Hong Kong and Shanghai between February 1 and February 8 due to a "significant decline" in demand for services to China due to rising coronavirus cases.

9723eee2d26f0d22c7d4c385a598c7e6f812a6b5.sourceText: 受影响的往返行程共有24趟：涉及香港到旧金山和纽瓦克之间；北京到华盛顿杜勒斯，芝加哥奥黑尔和纽瓦克：从上海到旧金山、纽瓦克和芝加哥奥黑尔。
9723eee2d26f0d22c7d4c385a598c7e6f812a6b5.translatedText: A total of 24 round-trips are affected: between Hong Kong to San Francisco and Newark; Beijing to Washington Dulles, Chicago O'Hare and Newark; and from Shanghai to San Francisco, Newark and Chicago O'Hare.

3b869f031f1a66e27c0960ca3e3292fe8e0f736d.sourceText: 达美航空和美国航空暂未减少飞往中国的航班，但表示随着新冠病毒的传播，正在密切监视局势发展。
3b869f031f1a66e27c0960ca3e3292fe8e0f736d.translatedText: Delta Air Lines and American Airlines have not yet reduced flights to China, but said they are closely monitoring the situation as the coronavirus spreads.

387ffbbc706f02cda833fefb5871585099588b44.sourceText: 哈萨克斯坦外交部副部长努雷舍夫于1月27日表示，为了防范新冠病毒扩散，将要求中国公民申请签证时提供疫检证明，同时暂停向中国公民发放电子落地签证。他还表示，考虑到会影响哈萨克公民返国，暂时没有计划完全关闭与中国的边界。
387ffbbc706f02cda833fefb5871585099588b44.translatedText: Kazakhstan’s Deputy Foreign Minister Nuryshev stated on January 27 that in order to prevent the spread of the new coronavirus, Chinese citizens will be required to provide quarantine certificates when applying for visas, and the issuance of electronic visas on arrival to Chinese citizens will be suspended. He also said that considering that it would affect the return of Kazakh citizens, there are no plans to completely close the border with China for the time being.

2346657963c1117be2d8ef74d711c5328174d547.sourceText: 英国目前没有发现境内有感染的新冠病例。但英国外交部1月28日宣布，将于1月30日从武汉撤侨，但目前还滞留在中国其他省的英国公民可能比较难以撤离。英国外交部同时建议，英国公民不要去中国进行“不必要”的旅行。
2346657963c1117be2d8ef74d711c5328174d547.translatedText: There are currently no confirmed cases of COVID-19 in the UK. However, the British Foreign Office announced on January 28 that it would evacuate citizens from Wuhan on January 30. However, it may be more difficult for British citizens who are currently stranded in other provinces of China to evacuate. The British Foreign Office also advised British citizens not to make "unnecessary" travel to China.

8be0d9875341a0fc8fd5462527ae050f0f4225a2.sourceText: 英国航空公司官方网站上显示，1月和2月将没有飞往中国的直航。此前，英国航空公司每天都有从武汉直飞伦敦希思罗机场的航班。
8be0d9875341a0fc8fd5462527ae050f0f4225a2.translatedText: British Airways official website shows that there will be no direct flights to China in January and February. Previously, British Airways had daily direct flights from Wuhan to London Heathrow Airport.

547dc13e08a25f181d5131fcc28895f92cbb4f61.sourceText: 俄罗斯乌拉尔航空（Ural Airlines）于1月27日宣布，由于新冠病毒爆发，将中止飞往中国的航班。乌拉尔航空新闻办公室在一份声明中称，乌拉尔航空取消了从俄罗斯秋明州和叶卡捷琳堡飞往中国惟一目的地海南省的所有航班，直到疫情消除。
547dc13e08a25f181d5131fcc28895f92cbb4f61.translatedText: Russian Ural Airlines announced on January 27 that it would suspend flights to China due to the outbreak of the new coronavirus. Ural Airlines has canceled all flights from Russia's Tyumen region and Yekaterinburg to Hainan Province, China's only destination, until the epidemic is eliminated, Ural Airlines' press office said in a statement.

9b9c14d29fee64f0dcbe5bf0b17e20b1feedd225.sourceText: 根据中国国家移民管理局于1月29日发布的消息，中国公民在入境日本、韩国、越南、印度、英国、印度尼西亚、法国、缅甸、意大利、阿联酋、马来西亚、斯里兰卡、澳大利亚等国家时，需要提交健康状况申报表
9b9c14d29fee64f0dcbe5bf0b17e20b1feedd225.translatedText: According to the news released by the National Immigration Administration of China on January 29, Chinese citizens need to submit a health status declaration form when entering Japan, South Korea, Vietnam, India, the United Kingdom, Indonesia, France, Myanmar, Italy, the United Arab Emirates, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Australia and other countries.

57d2e639500dca4aab5cbf2d368c66319cff85c5.sourceText: 气如虹：合胜堂的所在地
57d2e639500dca4aab5cbf2d368c66319cff85c5.translatedText: Qi Ruhong: The location of He Sheng Tang

33a9310eae270adefcc3dd76692568034edf697d.sourceText: 气如虹：合胜堂的所在地 上週四月九日星期一，美国合胜堂凤凰城支堂举行成立典礼，晚上在钱得乐市凤城酒家设宴招待宾…
33a9310eae270adefcc3dd76692568034edf697d.translatedText: Qi Ru Hong: The location of He Sheng Tang On Monday, April 9th last week, the Phoenix branch of Hesheng Church in the United States held an inauguration ceremony. In the evening, a banquet was held to entertain guests at the Fengcheng Restaurant in Chandelier City...

9d7cffcb982027a73278e4bc6c3eb9ffa080b026.sourceText: 上週四月九日星期一，美国合胜堂凤凰城支堂举行成立典礼，晚上在钱得乐市凤城酒家设宴招待宾客，可算是亚利桑那侨界庆祝农曆戊戌春节的压轴联欢会，将欢乐气氛作最后的凝聚，不同凡响。晚宴循例安排主持人与贵宾致词，加上精彩活动接二连三，从开始到结束，在合胜醒狮的舞动下，在黄培乐师的扬琴演奏中，在三藩市变脸艺人的特技戏法裡，在此间爱国侨胞高唱〈中华民国颂〉，以及幸运抽奖的呼声，节目丰富，使整个宴会充满了兴奋情绪，欢欣热闹。
9d7cffcb982027a73278e4bc6c3eb9ffa080b026.translatedText: On Monday, April 9th last week, the Phoenix branch of Heshengtang Church in the United States held an inauguration ceremony. In the evening, a banquet was held at the Fengcheng Restaurant in Chandelier City to entertain guests. It can be regarded as the finale party for the Arizona overseas Chinese community to celebrate the Lunar New Year. It condensed the joyful atmosphere into an extraordinary event. The dinner included speeches by the host and distinguished guests as usual, and a succession of exciting activities. From the beginning to the end, with the dancing of the He Sheng Lion Dance, the dulcimer playing by musician Huang Pei, the stunts of the San Francisco face-changing artist, the patriotic overseas Chinese singing "Ode to the Republic of China", and the call for a lucky draw, the rich program made the entire banquet full of excitement and joy.

a2743e452d0d8403cf8dc8a0631dfb52da490230.sourceText: 我孤陋寡闻，知识有限，对合胜堂了解不深；这次获得美西侨报社长方慧贤代为邀请，有幸叨陪末座，因而得知多少概况。原来合胜堂在美国具有悠久历史的侨团，实力雄厚，团结侨胞，互助合作，敦亲睦邻，向来不忘善举，造福社区。今回能够号召全美各地总堂、支堂的元老、首长与昆仲们代表到凤凰城来主持庆会，真个魄力非凡；并邀请中华民国驻洛杉矶经文处廖建勋副主任莅临指导，同时凤凰城各侨界代表、社会贤达亦获邀出席，联欢共庆，济济一堂，体现出其团队精神雄伟，众志成城，值得讚扬，值得借鉴。
a2743e452d0d8403cf8dc8a0631dfb52da490230.translatedText: I am ignorant, have limited knowledge, and do not know much about Hop Sheng Hall. This time, I was invited by Fang Huixian, the president of the American Overseas Chinese Newspaper, and I was lucky enough to accompany the last seat, so I learned a lot about the general situation. It turns out that Hop Sing Tong is an overseas Chinese organization with a long history in the United States. It has strong strength, unites overseas Chinese, helps and cooperates with each other, maintains amity and good neighborliness, and never forgets its good deeds to benefit the community. This time, we are able to call on the elders, heads and representatives of the main churches and branch churches across the United States to come to Phoenix to host the celebration. It is truly courageous. We also invite Liao Jianxun, the deputy director of the Cultural Office of the Republic of China in Los Angeles, to come and give guidance. At the same time, representatives of the overseas Chinese community and social sages in Phoenix are also invited to attend, celebrate together, and gather together. It reflects the majestic team spirit and united efforts. It is worthy of praise and reference.

149a00138c601fe7242c92c346b20432681f0c47.sourceText: 合胜堂当晚盛会过程，在报章上和网路上已有详细报导，图文并茂，在此无须多所赘言。我所要讲述的，那是最令我注意的，最引起我好奇的，是美西侨报登载几个支堂的所在城市，其中四个地方「波伦、舍路、美利云、旦佛」，我完全不熟识，觉得非常陌生；我来美定居二十年了，虽然不懂英文，中文却很通透，不少美国的地方有几个译名我都知晓，比如：凤凰城即费尼斯克和斐匿，三藩市就是旧金山，罗省是洛杉矶，火奴鲁鲁等于檀香山，达拉斯有朋友谐称大利市厖等等，认识不算少，偏偏这四个地区我前所未闻，惟有简略查询，发觉其中三个还有不同的音译，波伦又叫砵伦，美利云又叫美利允，旦佛又叫典化，更令我有如丈八金刚棗摸不着头脑，对我来说，这三个名字更为陌生，真个从未听闻；奇怪的是，现在中文很流行，新闻报导以及电子网路传播，几乎全部採取惯常使用的新译名，为什麽部份侨胞们还不改变作风，仍然喜欢旧译名呢？
149a00138c601fe7242c92c346b20432681f0c47.translatedText: The grand event at Hop Sheng Hall that night has been reported in detail in newspapers and on the Internet, with pictures and texts, so there is no need to elaborate here. What I am going to talk about is what caught my attention the most and aroused my curiosity the most. The Spanish-American Overseas Chinese Newspaper reported on the cities where several branch churches are located. Four of them, "Bolun, Shilu, Meiliyun, and Danfo", are completely unfamiliar to me and feel very strange. I have been living in the United States for twenty years. Although I don’t understand English, my Chinese is very fluent. I know the translations of many places in the United States. For example, Phoenix is Phoenix and Phoenix, San Francisco is San Francisco, Los Angeles is Los Angeles, Honolulu is Honolulu, and a friend of Dallas calls it Dali City. Pang and so on, I know a lot, but I have never heard of these four areas. I only made a brief search and found that three of them have different transliterations. Bolun is also called Bolun, Meiliyun is also called Meiliyun, and Danfo is also called Dianhua. It makes me as confused as Zhangba Jingangzao. Generally speaking, these three names are more unfamiliar and have never been heard of. What is strange is that now that Chinese is very popular, news reports and electronic network dissemination almost all use the new translations that are commonly used. Why do some overseas Chinese not change their style and still prefer the old translations?

01181889c74f912b5404b456da98e72256c20336.sourceText: 在这一头雾水不知宗的情况下，我有如侦探查桉般，来个澈底追查，寻求答桉。幸好现代网路发达，讯息畅通，许多网民喜欢把资料上载，只要按键搜索，上下古今的典故，宇宙间天文地理，世界的举动变化，都能迅速显示出来，方便无比；以往的时代就没有机会享受这种福气，要慢慢到处追查，费尽心机，未必得到结果。好像这场合，我询问过好几人，都和自己一样，摇头摆手，最接近的只能指出「旦佛应该是丹佛」，其馀就不晓得了。
01181889c74f912b5404b456da98e72256c20336.translatedText: In this confused situation, I was like a detective investigating the matter, conducting a thorough investigation to seek answers. Fortunately, the modern Internet is developed and information is unobstructed. Many netizens like to upload information. Just press a button to search, allusions from ancient and modern times, astronomy and geography in the universe, and changes in the behavior of the world can be quickly displayed, which is extremely convenient. In the past era, we did not have the opportunity to enjoy this kind of blessing. We had to slowly track down everywhere and spend all our efforts, but we may not get the results. It seems that on this occasion, I asked several people, and they all shook their heads and waved their hands like myself. The closest one could only point out that "Denfo should be Denver", and I didn't know the rest.

baa297a974b482b9377b13d8a65e8b6bb6a91bc5.sourceText: 我心有不甘，锲而不捨，终于在网上找寻到结果：波伦或砵伦是俄勒冈州的波特兰，舍路是华盛顿州的西雅图，旦佛或典化就是科罗拉多州的丹佛，其中美利云或美利允最难寻找，不是名城大埠，不知位置何在，经过反覆查阅有关资料，才知道属于加利福尼亚州范围，再从加州地图搜索，看见那是离首府加沙缅度不远的城市，英文为Marysvill，一世纪前为着名的淘金小镇，那时就有华人约六千之众，难怪合胜堂很早就在该处成立支堂，据资料显示，现在合胜堂每年都在当地聚集举行小年会呢！
baa297a974b482b9377b13d8a65e8b6bb6a91bc5.translatedText: I was unwilling to give up and persevered, and finally found the results online: Portland or Portland is Portland, Oregon, Shilu is Seattle, Washington, Denver or Dianhua is Denver, Colorado. Among them, Merrion or Merrion is the most difficult to find. It is not a famous city or big port, and I don’t know where it is. After repeatedly checking the relevant information , only then did I know that it belongs to the state of California. Then I searched on the map of California and saw that it is a city not far from the capital of Gaza Burma. It is called Marysvill in English. It was a famous gold mining town a century ago. At that time, there were about 6,000 Chinese people. No wonder Hop Sheng Church established a branch there very early. According to the data, Hop Sheng Church now gathers there every year to hold a small annual meeting!

cfceac1d466bf06a6eafee88ea0345cb71eb0aec.sourceText: 哦！我总算舒了一口气，认识合胜堂所在地的几个城市，从而知道那几个美国城市另有中文译名，新旧对照非常有趣，增广了见闻，由此发觉自己知识竟然这麽贫乏，虽然来美廿年，虽然年近八旬，还有不少地区名称未识，难怪有人说活到老就要学到老呢！
cfceac1d466bf06a6eafee88ea0345cb71eb0aec.translatedText: >Oh! I finally breathed a sigh of relief. I got to know several cities where Hop Sheng Hall is located, and I learned that those American cities have Chinese translations. It was very interesting to compare the old and new, which broadened my knowledge. I realized that my knowledge was so poor. Although I have been in the United States for 20 years, and even though I am nearly 80 years old, I still don’t know the names of many places. No wonder some people say that you should learn as you live!

1ae2946e55d2e3a3437dadd424f303d5f0053201.sourceText: 欢欢乐乐庆羊年—羊羊得意

d5ab9c2d1759a5962eaa14758f7ab730c68c3773.sourceText: 记凤凰城华人基督教会中文学校庆新年闹新春 凤凰城 凤鸣 告别了快马加鞭的马年，迎来羊羊得意的羊年，鳯凰城华人基督教会中文学校的师生们，于2015年2月22日下午1：30 Pm，在教会的东侧停车场红红火火、热热闹闹、开始了庆羊年的闹新春特别教学活动。在震耳欲聋的锣鼓喧天声中，以舞狮拉开帷幕，只见一头黑白花大狮子，在锣鼓声中向舞狮人张牙舞爪、步步紧逼，可能舞狮人是新手，吴莹老师在一旁指导，短短的三，五分钟，当锣鼓声 戞然停止后，只见舞黑狮的两位学生，拿掉狮饰装，露出庐山真面目，原来是两个满头大汗、气喘吁吁的学生，感谢这些有爱心的同学，为给同学们带来欢乐，在紧张的学习中，抽出时间辛辛苦苦练习，真心的付出与摆上，众人以热情的掌声回报他们。接下来是中文学校舞蹈班的同学们表演舞蹈，由低年级的小同学表演舞蹈”好朋友”开始 ，可爱的小同学两人一对，在地毯上像花丛中的小蝴蝶一样，翩翩起舞、惟妙惟肖，看得人赏心悦目，她们则乐在其中。还有舞蹈”山村小姑娘” ，”伞舞”， 都是些天真活泼的小女同学的率真、倾情表演，为孩子们的精彩表演喝彩！最后上埸表演的是，由张老师指导的中国武术班，4位女同学和6位男同学同时上埸，清一色的白T血衫黑裤子，整齐划一的骄健拳术、威武雄键的步伐，然后两个两个重新上埸，表演各自拿手的拳术套路，他（她）们都是中国武术的爱好者，从小练得一身好功夫，可以强身健体，长大为社会做贡献。 表演节目结束后，同学们由低年级到高年级排起队，领取老师们为他们精心准备的煎水饺和年糕，这两样食品是中国传统过年必备的。农历正月初一的伊始，吃饺子取”更岁交子”之意，”子”为”子时”，交与”饺”谐音，有”喜庆团圆”吉祥如意”意思。 年糕 是东亚过年的一种传统食品，年糕与”年高”谐音，有年年高的意思，象征收入、职位或小孩子的知识和身高都一年比一年高。还有长青团契的长辈们给他们发红包。看着小同学个个欢蹦乱跳、喜笑颜开地跑到爷爷奶奶面前，大声或小声地叫着：爷爷奶奶新年好！从心里往外高兴，甜美的一声爷爷奶奶新年好，听得心里真是甜丝丝美兹兹的，这些从小在教会长大的孩子，就是有礼貌，又有爱心又爱主，他（她）们就是希望。学生们高高兴兴的吃着煎饺和年糕，口袋里装着红包，交头接耳，蹦蹦跳跳回到各己的教室，进行下一价段的特别教学活动。 我带上像机到二楼活动室，教室内的特别教学活动已经开始，简七班的一位女同学正在讲演”习俗释说” 。接下来是中正班的”说一说数字吉祥话” ，简体六班魏雨晨同学的琵琶独奏”送我一支玫瑰花” ，简体六班任珊珊同学介绍”春节习俗”，从腊月二十三到正月初一，简体四班的”猴子捞月亮”，简体八班的”彷生学。AP中文班演出的”中国古代4大美女”。所有节目都围绕着中国年的元素，同学们都表演的有声有色，把平常学到的知识都融解、揉和、贯串在节目中。后来我又到另外几个教室去采访，有的在讲有关羊年的故事，有的在做手工，有的在画画，这一天的中文课，对学生们来说是一个丰富多彩、别具一格、有特殊意义的一堂课。 凤城华人基督教会的中文学校，他们的春节特别教学活动，已经连续好多年， 组织者很有智慧，步步活动紧凑有序，在文艺节目表演结束之后，分初级班、中级班、高级班，分三步进行，各年级都有与新年有关的教学活动。在高级班还有”中国诸子百家介绍和猜谜语”，通过这次春节特别教学活动，让学生们在欢乐中，学到了中华民族的传统文化，和民族民俗的意义。这是一次有意义又成功的特别教学活动，希望他们再接再厉能越办越好、越办越精彩！ 如要了解学校更多信息，请登陆学校网站：gpccs.org 或打咨询电话：480-369-0519。
d5ab9c2d1759a5962eaa14758f7ab730c68c3773.translatedText: Phoenix Chinese Christian Church Chinese School celebrates the New Year Phoenix Fengming Says goodbye to the fast-paced Year of the Horse and welcomes the proud Year of the Sheep. The teachers and students of the Phoenix Chinese Christian Church Chinese School started a special teaching activity to celebrate the New Year of the Sheep at 1:30 pm on February 22, 2015 in the east parking lot of the church. Amidst the deafening sound of gongs and drums, the lion dance kicked off, and a large black-and-white lion was seen. It opened its teeth and claws, and pressed forward step by step amidst the sound of gongs and drums. The lion dancer may be a novice. Teacher Wu Ying was on the side to guide. In just three or five minutes, when the gongs and drums sounded, After the dance stopped, the two students of the black lion dance took off their lion decorations and revealed their true colors. They turned out to be two students who were sweating profusely and panting. Thank you to these caring classmates for bringing joy to the students. During the intense study, they took the time to practice hard and showed their sincere dedication and dedication. Everyone rewarded them with enthusiastic applause. Next was the dance performance by the dance class of the Chinese school, starting with the dance "Good Friends" performed by the lower grade students. The cute little students, in pairs, danced on the carpet like little butterflies in the flowers, lifelike and pleasing to the eye, and they enjoyed it. There are also dances such as "Mountain Girl" and "Umbrella Dance". They are all candid and passionate performances by innocent and lively little female students. Applaud the wonderful performances of the children! The last performer was the Chinese martial arts class guided by Teacher Zhang. Four female students and six male students came to the field at the same time. They were all wearing white T-shirts and black pants, and they performed uniform and arrogant boxing skills and powerful steps. Then they came back to the field two by two, performing their own special boxing routines. They (she) are all fans of Chinese martial arts. They have practiced good kung fu since they were young. They can strengthen their bodies and contribute to society when they grow up. After the performance, the students from lower grades to senior grades lined up to receive the fried dumplings and rice cakes carefully prepared for them by the teachers. These two foods are necessary for the traditional Chinese New Year. At the beginning of the first day of the first month of the lunar calendar, eating dumplings means "Gengsui Jiaozi", "zi" means "Zi Shi", and "Jiao" is a homophone for "dumplings", which means "happy reunion" and "good luck". Nian Gao It is a traditional food during the New Year in East Asia. Rice cake is homophonic to "niangao", which means that the income, position or knowledge and height of the children are getting higher and higher year by year. The elders of the Evergreen Fellowship also send them red envelopes. They watch the little students running up to their grandparents with joy and laughter, shouting loudly or quietly: Happy New Year from the bottom of my heart! I was happy and said a sweet Happy New Year to my grandparents. It was really sweet in my heart. These children who grew up in the church are polite, caring and love the Lord. They are the hope. The students happily ate fried dumplings and rice cakes, filled their pockets with red envelopes, whispered to each other, and jumped back to their classrooms to conduct special teaching activities for the next period. I took the camera to the activity room on the second floor. The special teaching activities in the classroom had already begun. A female student from Class 7 of Simplified Chinese was giving a lecture on "Explanation of Customs". Next was "Say Lucky Words on Numbers" from Class 6 of Simplified Chinese, and the pipa solo "Send Me a Rose" by Wei Yuchen from Class 6 of Simplified Chinese. , Ren Shanshan, a classmate of Simplified Chinese Class 6, introduced the "Spring Festival Customs". From the 23rd of the twelfth lunar month to the first day of the first lunar month, "Monkey Fishing for the Moon" in Simplified Chinese Class 4 and "Bionics" in Simplified Chinese Class 8. "The Four Beauties of Ancient China" performed by the AP Chinese class. All the programs revolved around the elements of the Chinese New Year. The students all performed vividly and integrated the knowledge they usually learned into the program. Later, I went to several other classrooms to interview. Some were telling stories about the Year of the Sheep, some were doing crafts, and some were painting. The Chinese class on this day was a colorful, unique and special class for the students. The Chinese School of Fengcheng Chinese Christian Church has held special Spring Festival teaching activities for many years. The organizers are very smart and the activities are compact and orderly. After the cultural program, the classes are divided into junior classes, intermediate classes, and advanced classes. Each grade has teaching activities related to the New Year. In the advanced class, there is also "Introduction and riddle guessing of hundreds of Chinese philosophers". Through this special Spring Festival teaching activity, students learned the traditional culture of the Chinese nation and the significance of national folk customs in joy. This is a meaningful and successful special teaching activity. I hope they will continue to work hard to make it better and more exciting! To learn more about the school, please visit the school website: gpccs.org or call the consultation hotline: 480-369-0519.

7af7ab6894dc126c3e16ddff53ed0fd70867a24a.sourceText: 美国亚利桑那州华人历史协会 张肇鴻 10月11日早上，我们前往玛里斯维尔(Marysville)，这里曾被称为“黄金之乡”，在淘金时代繁华一时，其规模仅次于有“大埠”之称的三藩市（San Francisco ），以及有“二埠”之称的沙加缅度（Sacramento），而早年的华人把Marysville称之为“三埠”。 在排华时期，三藩市和沙加缅度的华人社区多被放火烧毁和砸烂驱赶，很多华人就来到这个当时仍属农业区的“三埠”，祈求在祖宗和神明的庇佑之下躲过劫难。 北溪古庙（Bok Kai Temple ）是这次旅游中参观的第一座庙宇，其位置在当年的唐人街中心，也是当时华人的议事厅。 北溪古庙由首批来到加州淘金的华人所兴建，距今有近一百七十年的历史，已被列入到“美国名胜古迹”，成为全美11个受保护的历史遗迹之一。 [Photo] 北溪庙前大合照 摄影 李苏 笔者在北溪庙前的亭阁上录得多幅对联，其中有一副对联曰： 北美臻繁荣 有赖我侨同肇造 溪乡无水患 全凭帝力显神通 北溪庙有很多华人先辈遗留下来的物品，例如衣服、三吋金莲鞋，在帽子介绍中有由稻草、芦苇编织的，可浸入水中，日晒时水份蒸发可散热，也可免被雨淋。还看到了蓑衣、工具，及各种冷兵器等等。 [Photo] 女淸装陈列 摄影 李苏 [Photo] 古色古香的家具 [Photo] 各种帽子 [Photo] 簑衣 可以想像到华人先辈当时的勤力和辛劳，不但与天斗与地斗，还要防避各种歧视与迫害，但最终还是撑起一片属于自己的天地。正如对联上所写的：“北美臻繁荣 有赖我侨同肇造”。 马里斯维尔的华人，从1870年代末期开始，每年在“龙抬头”那天举行盛大的节日活动。最早的那条巨龙，是1878年从中国定制並通过海运过来的，据闻花费了7,000美元。节庆舞龙是一件大事，许多其它唐人街的华人没有这个实力，可见当年这里的华人社区有多么兴旺发达。 [Photo] 从中国运来的巨龙 我在庙内翻拍了这些相片，看到了当年华工的另一种风貌：他们把辫子一缠，把大手一叉，其气魄和阵仗，确实要比我们想象中的要强势得多！ [Photo] 华人的舞龙队伍 庙中供奉着各路神仙和华陀等，让人顶礼膜拜。当年许多华人特备香烛、金猪等三牲祭品前往还神许愿，並求灵签，以祈愿“祐我祯祥”。（保祐我们幸福） [Photo] 光绪九年（1883年）的牌匾 [Photo] [Photo] 与众不同的八仙形像 [Photo] 各路神仙和人物 北溪古庙俯瞰着河道，传闻得到了神明的庇护，过往遇到的水灾，使其它地方受到了严重的破坏，唯独小镇安然无恙，因此，在上面的对联中便写有：“溪乡无水患，全凭帝力显神通。” 馆内还有大量的资料图片，反应白人对中国人的欺压和歧视，这些材料用中、英文说明，兹录下几段文字： “1864 年 1 月，中央太平洋铁路公司是由21名中国个体组成”。 “1867年6月，中国铁路工人进行了为期八天的罢工，以抗议工资不公平。与白人相比，同样的工作华人工资就降低了30%至50%，而他们通常都在更加困难和危险的位置上工作”。 “19世纪70年代：反华运动 – 由于严重失业问题和种族主义，工会领导人对中国移民发出强烈抗议，被指责为美国人低工资和失业的原因，还被指责道德腐败”。 ……… 今期团友的高光时刻，是介绍一位老北京，他名叫李苏，旅游集体照大都经由他所拍摄，很多特写镜头，也是他的艺术作品。李苏说，能为大家服务是他的骄傲。我们都很感谢李大哥。有次拍集体照时，我请他入位，並用他的相机按下快门。这是团体排列得最整齐的一次，也可能是李苏大哥唯一在大集体中的照片，也让我骄傲了一回。 作为亚利桑那历史协会的一员，拍摄和搜集资料是我的任务，但我会在文章中引用李大哥的好照片，並尊敬地写上他的名字。 [Photo] 集体“正” 照 （轩佛市） [Photo] 李苏大哥在“中国胡同”留影
7af7ab6894dc126c3e16ddff53ed0fd70867a24a.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association Zhang Zhaohong On the morning of October 11, we went to Marysville, which was once known as the "Golden Country". It was prosperous during the gold rush era, and its size was second only to San Francisco, known as the "Big Port", and Sacramento, known as the "Second Port". In the early years, the Chinese called Marysville the "Three Ports". During the anti-Chinese period, most of the Chinese communities in San Francisco and Sacramento were set on fire, smashed and driven away. Many Chinese came to the "Three Bu", which was still an agricultural area at the time, to pray for the protection of their ancestors and gods to avoid disasters. Bok Kai Temple was the first temple visited during this tour. It was located in the center of Chinatown and was also the meeting hall of the Chinese at that time. The Beixi Ancient Temple was built by the first batch of Chinese who came to California to seek gold. It has a history of nearly 170 years. It has been included in the "American Landmarks" and has become one of the 11 protected historical sites in the United States. [Photo] Group photo in front of Beixi Temple. Photography by Li Su. The author recorded several couplets on the pavilion in front of Beixi Temple. One of the couplets says: The prosperity of North America is due to the co-creation of our overseas Chinese. There is no flood in Xixiang. It is all due to the power of the emperor. Bei Khe Temple has many items left by the Chinese ancestors, such as clothes, three-inch golden lotus shoes, and hats woven from straw and reeds. They can be immersed in water. When exposed to the sun, the water evaporates to dissipate heat and protect them from rain. We also saw coir raincoats, tools, various cold weapons, etc. [Photo] Display of women's clothing Photography Li Su [Photo] Antique furniture [Photo] Various hats [Photo] Coir raincoat You can imagine the diligence and hard work of the Chinese ancestors at that time. Not only did they fight against the sky and the earth, but they also had to avoid all kinds of discrimination and persecution, but in the end they still built a world of their own. As the couplet says: "The prosperity of North America depends on our fellow overseas Chinese." Since the late 1870s, the Chinese in Marysville have held a grand festival every year on the day when the dragon raises its head. The earliest dragon was custom-made and shipped by sea from China in 1878, reportedly costing $7,000. The festive dragon dance is a big event. Many Chinese in other Chinatowns do not have this ability, which shows how prosperous the Chinese community here was back then. [Photo] The giant dragon brought from China. I took these photos in the temple and saw another look of the Chinese laborers back then: they twisted their braids and crossed their big hands. Their courage and battle were indeed much stronger than we imagined! [Photo] Chinese dragon dance team. Various gods and Huatuo are enshrined in the temple, and people worship them. At that time, many Chinese specially prepared incense, candles, golden pigs and other three animal sacrifices to return to the gods and make wishes, and prayed for fortune sticks to pray for "blessing me and good fortune". (Bless us happiness) [Photo] Plaque from the ninth year of Guangxu (1883) [Photo] [Photo] Unique image of the Eight Immortals [Photo] Various gods and figures The Bei Xi Ancient Temple overlooks the river. It is said to have been protected by the gods. Floods encountered in the past caused serious damage to other places, but the town was safe and sound. Therefore, the couplet above reads: "There is no flood in Xi Township, and it is all due to the power of the Emperor." There are also a large number of information and pictures in the museum, reflecting the oppression and discrimination of the Chinese by white people. These materials are explained in Chinese and English. Here are a few paragraphs: "1864 January In September, the Central Pacific Railroad Company was composed of 21 Chinese individuals." "In June 1867, Chinese railway workers went on an eight-day strike to protest unfair wages. Compared with whites, Chinese wages were 30% to 50% lower for the same job, and they usually worked in more difficult and dangerous positions." “1870s: Anti-Chinese Movement – ​​Due to severe unemployment problems and racism, union leaders launched strong protests against Chinese immigrants, were blamed for low wages and unemployment among Americans, and were accused of moral corruption.” ......... The highlight moment for this group group is to introduce an old Beijinger named Li Su. Most of the group photos taken during the trip were taken by him, and many of the close-ups are also his works of art. Li Su said that he is proud to serve everyone. We are all very grateful to Brother Li. Once when we were taking a group photo, I asked him to take a seat and clicked the shutter button with his camera. This is the neatest group arrangement ever, and it may be the only photo of Brother Li Su in a large group. It also makes me proud. As a member of the Arizona Historical Society, it is my task to take photos and collect information, but I will quote Brother Li’s good photos in the article and write his name respectfully. [Photo] Group "positive" photo (Xuanfo City) [Photo] Brother Li Su took a photo in the "China Alley"

93cbbf815fd815417292aeecf42ded11595021c0.sourceText: 另类感恩节—华裔同爬山（组图） （清宝报道） 2011年11月24日是美国的传统节日感恩节，是全家团圆的日子。身在海外的华裔则希望通过这个假期，增进友人之间的感情。中国科学家工程师专业人士协会凤凰城分会（科工专）组织了一场别开生面的爬山活动，别以为就是跟着爬山的道路行走，这回真让人体验爬山”爬”的感觉。 早上１０时参加活动的二十多人陆续来到凤凰城南山脚下。科工专会长徐强，活动的组织者黄雯，Amoy一声令下，带队出发。原来打算按公园登山路线上山，可是不知谁的提议，放弃公园的路线，自创险路，爬起了”野山”。幸好活动参加者都身强体健，队中还有一位骨科医生保驾护航，参与者没有犹豫就陆续跟上（切勿模仿）。 没有了路，只能靠手脚一起爬，平时敲打键盘的手，抓在冰冷的棱角分明的岩石上，那个感觉的确很爽，因为有太久时间没有和大自然有个亲密接触了，脚磕碰着小小的着力点，就迅速将身体送到目标位置。动作一定要敏捷否则，手的力量就支持不住了。几个小朋友和年轻人陆续到了最前面，后面的大姐，大哥们就相互扶持，互授经验，一步一步的向前挪，不知有多少次在队伍听大家嘴里说：”不行了，不行了。” 可是脚还是停不下。树缝间的一点小植物也能成为着力点，让一个个大汉矫健的爬到山上。爬着爬着，大家开始喊累，Amoy的太太就用包包来帮大家背水。还有的走在前面，坐在石头上，给后面的朋友加油，完全是一支互助气氛非常浓郁的冒险队。 艰难前行 与岩石的亲密接触 无限风光在险峰，几乎所有人都登上了第一个大云石岭，大家互相庆贺，拍照。站在高高的山顶，俯视脚下，形状各异的巨石，真可以用气势磅礴来形容，我们出发集合的那个巨大的教育中心建筑已经成为了小方块。远远望去，山下似乎来了一个马队，也有人骑马上山过感恩节的吗？虽然那个马帮很吸引我们的眼球，可是大家心里还是颤颤地，怕他们看到我们后，打电话报警…. 无限风光在险峰 上山容易，下山难。到了下山的时候，同样是险境重重。上山被很多人踩过的地方，沙土已经松动，沙粒滑落到岩石的表面，特别的滑，有的人绕道而行，有的几个人在一起手拉手形成人梯，有惊无险，非常顺利的抵达山脚下。好家伙，这可不得了，走到了山下的路，小朋友们就开始喊太无聊了，还有兴致高的，要求还要再爬一个有难度的山。没办法，”领导”们最后决定兵分两路，一路继续”野爬山”一路在山脚下准备美食。 云石顶之巅 感恩节”冒险队” 美味就该吃得底朝天 知名的Amoy卤蛋和泡菜，黄雯的凉面，还有Tinna的虎皮尖椒最受欢迎，风卷残云，几乎都被一扫而空，Amoy得意的开始吹着前无故人，后无来者的”卤蛋和泡菜”，吃多少都不会腻，这个就是他独家秘方，而且要想真正吃到全凤凰城最好的爆炒腰花，就一定要跟着Amoy。有为Amoy鼓掌叫好的，也有在一边不服气犟嘴的。参与者一起享受美食，一起聊天，从中国上海中山医院来凤凰城参加学术交流活动的顾宇彤医生受到热捧。有脊柱，关节等病症者也乘机来了个免费咨询。科工专会长徐强更是临时动议，把活动参与者都邀请回家，开了个即兴感恩节聚会，吃火鸡，改成品烤鸡，美酒，香茶，样样都有，大家一起谈政治，谈海外生活，谈医疗直到晚上11点，才不舍的散去。
93cbbf815fd815417292aeecf42ded11595021c0.translatedText: Alternative Thanksgiving Day - Chinese Americans climb mountains together (Photos) (Qingbao Report) November 24, 2011 is Thanksgiving, a traditional holiday in the United States. It is a day for family reunion. Chinese Americans overseas hope to use this holiday to enhance the relationship between friends. The Phoenix Branch of the Chinese Professional Association of Scientists and Engineers (Science and Engineering College) organized a unique mountain climbing activity. Don’t think that it is just walking on the mountain climbing road. This time, you can really experience the "climbing" feeling of mountain climbing. At 10 o'clock in the morning, more than 20 people participating in the event arrived at the foot of Nanshan Mountain in Phoenix City. Xu Qiang, president of the Science and Technology Institute, Huang Wen, the organizer of the event, and Amoy gave the order and led the team to set off. Originally, I planned to follow the park hiking route up the mountain, but at someone’s suggestion, I abandoned the park route, created my own dangerous path, and climbed the “wild mountain”. Fortunately, the participants were all in good health, and there was an orthopedic surgeon in the team to protect them. Participants followed without hesitation (do not imitate). There was no way, so I could only crawl with my hands and feet. The hand that usually typed on the keyboard was grasped on the cold, angular rocks. It felt really good, because it had been a long time since I had had close contact with nature. When my feet hit a small point of strength, I quickly sent my body to the target position. The movements must be agile, otherwise the strength of the hands will not be able to support it. Several children and young people arrived at the front one after another. The elder sisters and brothers behind them supported each other, taught each other experience, and moved forward step by step. I don’t know how many times I heard everyone in the team say: "I can’t do it, I can’t do it." But they still couldn’t stop. A few small plants between the trees can also become a focal point, allowing big men to climb up the mountain vigorously. After crawling, everyone began to complain that they were tired, so Amoy’s wife used her bag to help everyone carry water. Others walked in front, sat on the rocks, and cheered for their friends behind. It was an adventure team with a strong atmosphere of mutual help. Difficulty moving forward, close contact with the rocks, unlimited scenery on the dangerous peaks, almost everyone climbed to the first Big Marble Ridge, everyone celebrated each other and took photos. Standing on the top of a high mountain, looking down at the huge rocks of different shapes below, it can be described as majestic. The huge education center building where we set out to gather has become a small square. Looking from a distance, it seems that a horse team is coming down the mountain. Are there people riding horses up the mountain to celebrate Thanksgiving? Although the caravan attracted our attention, everyone was still trembling in their hearts, fearing that they would call the police after seeing us... Infinite scenery on dangerous peaks It is easy to go up the mountain, but difficult to go down the mountain. When it came time to go down the mountain, there were also many dangers. At the place where many people have stepped on the mountain, the sand has become loose, and the sand has slipped to the surface of the rock. It is particularly slippery. Some people took a detour, and some held hands together to form a human ladder. They arrived at the foot of the mountain smoothly without any danger. Good guy, this is incredible. When we reached the bottom of the mountain, the children started shouting that it was too boring. Some of them were very interested and asked to climb another difficult mountain. There was no other way, so the "leaders" finally decided to split into two groups and continue "wild climbing" all the way to prepare delicious food at the foot of the mountain. The Thanksgiving "Adventure Team" at the top of Yunshiding should be eaten to the fullest The famous Amoy braised eggs and kimchi, Huang Wen's cold noodles, and Tinna's tiger pepper are the most popular. Almost all of them were sold out. Amoy proudly started to brag about the "braised eggs and kimchi" that has never been eaten before or since. You will never get tired of eating it. This is his exclusive secret recipe. If you want to truly eat the best stir-fried kidneys in Phoenix, you must follow Amoy. Some applauded Amoy, while others were dissatisfied and snarled. The participants enjoyed the food and chatted together. Dr. Gu Yutong, who came to Phoenix from Zhongshan Hospital in Shanghai, China to participate in academic exchange activities, was well received. People with spine, joint and other diseases also took the opportunity to come for free consultation. Xu Qiang, the president of the Institute of Science and Technology, made an impromptu move to invite all the participants home and held an impromptu Thanksgiving party. They had turkey, baked chicken, fine wine, fragrant tea, and everything. Everyone talked about politics, overseas life, and medical care until 11 o'clock in the evening, and they reluctantly dispersed.

4ec3efa6908c5120756e72072958d485588604e6.translatedText: Teach you four ways to save money with high interest rates that will last a lifetime! [1. Relay Savings] 12 Certificate of Deposit (one-year term), 36 Certificate of Deposit (three-year term), 60 Certificate of Deposit (five-year term)...

56ebaac040b7aa3cb71764fe42b31d10e74ddab9.sourceText: 教你四种高息存钱法 一辈子受用哦！ 【1、接力储蓄】12存单(一年期)、36存单(三年期)、60存单(五年期)。12存单每月1单，一年12单，第二年开始每月都有1单到期，本金利息加新投入的钱又转存。36存单(三年期利率更高)以此类推。60存单(五年期利率更高)以此类推 专家点评：适合收入比较稳定，又没什么较大开销的家庭，可以取得较高的利率。 【2、利息滚利储蓄】如果你有一笔额度较大的闲置资金，你可以选择将这笔钱存成存本取息的储蓄，在一个月后，取出这笔存款第一个月的利息，然后再开设一个整存整取的储蓄账户,把取出来的利息存到里面，以后每个月固定把第一个账户中产生的利息取出存入整存整取账户，这样不仅存本取息储蓄得到了利息，而且其利息在参加整存整取储蓄后又取得了利息。 专家点评：即使你选择较低风险的储蓄，也要尽可能让每一分钱都滚动起来，包括利息在内，尽可能让自己的收益达到最大的程度。 【3、分开储蓄】假定有1万元现金，将它分成不同额度的4份，分别是1000元、2000元、3000元、4000元，然后将这4张存单都存成一年期的定期存款。在一年之内不管什么时候需要用钱，都可以取出和所需数额接近的那张存单，这样既能满足用钱需求，也能最大限度得到利息收入。 专家点评：这种方法适用于在一年内有用钱预期，但不确定何时使用，一次用多少的小额闲置资金。用分开储蓄法不仅利息会比存活期储蓄高很多，而且在取出时也能将损失降到最低。 【4、台阶储蓄】假定手中有5万元现金，可以平均分成5份，分别开设一年期、两年期、三年期、四年期、五年期的存单。一年后1万元到期后加新存入的钱改成五年期的，二年后1万元到期后改成五年期，以此类推，五年后最后一个到期也改成五年期，以后每年都有钱到期，都是五年期的，赚取高利息。 专家点评：此方式较适合生活支出有规律有计划的家庭，让你的生活井井有条。
56ebaac040b7aa3cb71764fe42b31d10e74ddab9.translatedText: teaches you four high-interest saving methods that will last a lifetime! [1. Relay savings] 12 certificates of deposit (one-year period), 36 certificates of deposit (three-year period), 60 certificates of deposit (five-year period). 12 certificates of deposit (12 certificates per year). Starting from the second year, one certificate will expire every month, and the principal interest plus the newly invested money will be transferred. 36 certificates of deposit (higher interest rate for three-year period) and so on. Expert comments: Suitable for families with relatively stable income and no large expenses, and can obtain higher interest rates. [2. Interest rolling savings] If you have a large amount of idle funds, you can choose to deposit the money as a savings with principal and interest. After one month, withdraw the first month's interest on this deposit, and then open a lump sum savings account, and deposit the interest into it. In the future, you will withdraw the interest generated from the first account every month and deposit it into the lump sum account. In this way, not only the principal deposit and interest saving will get interest, but also the interest will be obtained after participating in the lump sum savings. Expert comments: Even if you choose lower-risk savings, you should try your best to make every penny roll over, including interest, to maximize your returns as much as possible. [3. Separate savings] Suppose you have 10,000 yuan in cash, divide it into 4 parts of different amounts, namely 1,000 yuan, 2,000 yuan, 3,000 yuan, and 4,000 yuan, and then deposit these four deposit certificates into one-year time deposits. Whenever you need money within a year, you can withdraw the deposit certificate that is close to the required amount. This will not only meet your money needs, but also maximize your interest income. Expert comments: This method is suitable for small idle funds that are expected to have money within a year, but are not sure when to use it and how much to use at one time. Not only will the interest be much higher with the separate savings method, but the loss will also be minimized when withdrawing. [4. Step Savings] Suppose you have 50,000 yuan in cash, which can be divided into five equal parts, and you can open one-year, two-year, three-year, four-year, and five-year certificates of deposit. After one year, when the newly deposited money matures, it will be changed to a five-year term. After two years, when the 10,000 yuan matures, it will be changed to a five-year term. By analogy, the last maturity after five years will also be changed to a five-year term. After that, money will mature every year, all of which will earn high interest. Expert comments: This method is more suitable for families with regular and planned living expenses to keep your life in order.
