7061c78e5f38197d554c318b3d038463b4fc0b3b.sourceText: 《明日歌》出自明代，由钱鹤滩所作，(还有另一首《明日歌》由（明）文嘉所作，内容大致相同) ，诗文如下：
7061c78e5f38197d554c318b3d038463b4fc0b3b.translatedText: "Tomorrow's Song" comes from the Ming Dynasty, written by Qian Hetan, (there is another "Tomorrow's Song" written by (Ming) Wen Jia, the content is roughly the same), the poem is as follows:

90fc0be5b7776c6d7f41c4f5c852054cd4c3e60c.sourceText: 明日复明日，明日何其多。 我生待明日，万事成蹉跎。 世人若被明日累，春去秋来老将至。 朝看水东流，暮看日西坠。 百年明日能几何？请君听我明日歌。
90fc0be5b7776c6d7f41c4f5c852054cd4c3e60c.translatedText: Tomorrow comes tomorrow, there are so many tomorrows. If I live to wait for tomorrow, everything will be in vain. If the world is tired of tomorrow, spring will pass and autumn will come. Watch the water flowing eastward in the morning and the sun setting in the west in the evening. How many tomorrows can there be in a hundred years? Please listen to my song of tomorrow.

dfb77d8bcf86e1cf0172427e9327c66103e5cc19.sourceText: 诗文解释：一个明天接着又是一个明天，明天是何等的多啊！可是人的一生如果在等待中度过，那麽，他将虚度光阴，一事无成。世上的人们如果被明日所羁绊，则年复一年，光阴飞逝，暮年将会在不知不觉中到来。早晨看河水东流而去，傍晚看夕阳西下，一日之中无所事事。百年之中又能有多少个明日呢？请大家听一听我的明日歌吧。
dfb77d8bcf86e1cf0172427e9327c66103e5cc19.translatedText: Poetry explanation: One tomorrow follows another, how many tomorrows there are! But if one spends his life waiting, then , he will waste his time and achieve nothing. If people in the world are fettered by tomorrow, time will fly by year after year, and old age will come unknowingly. They will watch the river flow eastward in the morning and watch the sunset in the evening, doing nothing during the day. How many tomorrows can there be in a hundred years? Please listen to my song of tomorrow.

4ecbc30039c589b48d55db70d10c55973b0924f2.sourceText: 但是，世上无绝对，对于辛苦了一辈子，年届退休的人士而言，对”明日”的看法又是如何的呢？请看《明日歌》新解：
4ecbc30039c589b48d55db70d10c55973b0924f2.translatedText: However, there are no absolutes in the world. For those who have worked hard all their lives and have retired, there is no guarantee of "tomorrow". What do you think? Please read the new explanation of "Tomorrow Song":

69c446b0015be628bcfbc0fcf015024a106060cf.sourceText: 明日复明日，明日何其多？（都说一个明天会接着一个明天，但”明天”真的还会有很多吗？） 我生待明日，万事成蹉跎！（一生中大都是在向往明天中度过，所以很多事被蹉跎了！） 世人若被明日累，春去秋来老将至。（世人如果能有明日的积累，才会年复一年地走向暮年。） 朝看水东流，暮看日西坠。（退休了，早晨看看河水东流，傍晚看看夕阳西下，一日平安无事多好！） 百年明日能几何？请君听我明日歌！（百年之中又能还有几个明日呢？好好珍惜！就请你听听我的《明日歌》吧！）
69c446b0015be628bcfbc0fcf015024a106060cf.translatedText: Tomorrow comes tomorrow, so many tomorrows? (It is said that one tomorrow will follow another, but are there really many "tomorrows"?) If I live for tomorrow, everything will be wasted! (I spend most of my life longing for tomorrow, so many things are wasted!) If the world is tired of tomorrow, spring will pass and autumn will come. (If the world can accumulate tomorrow, it will move towards twilight year after year.) Watch the water flowing eastward in the morning and the sun setting in the west in the evening. (If you are retired, watch the river flowing eastward in the morning and the sunset in the west. It would be nice to have a peaceful day!) How many tomorrows can there be in a hundred years? Please listen to my song of tomorrow! (How many tomorrows can there be in a hundred years? Cherish it! Just listen to my "Song of Tomorrow"!)

acc30cea0293c8a1db9714303e5a7e7eea1bf724.sourceText: 连贯解释：都说一个明天会接着一个明天，但”明天”真的还会有很多吗？一生中大都是在向往明天中度过，所以很多事被蹉跎了！世人如果能有明日的积累，才会年复一年地走向暮年。退休了，早晨看看河水东流，傍晚看看夕阳西下，一日平安无事多好！百年之中又能还有几个明日呢？好好珍惜！就请你听听另类的《明日歌》吧！
acc30cea0293c8a1db9714303e5a7e7eea1bf724.translatedText: A coherent explanation: It is said that there will be one tomorrow after another, but are there really many "tomorrows" in life? Spending time in longing for tomorrow, so many things will be wasted! If the world can accumulate tomorrow, it will move towards old age year after year. When you retire, watch the river flowing eastward in the morning and the sunset in the west. How many tomorrows can there be in a hundred years? Please cherish it!

9f46c24d21ccc6a8ff42d04e18effb6b6b1805f1.translatedText: Cui Zengqi: Hometown Trip (11) – Hangzhou Trip 2 Hangzhou is famous for its beautiful West Lake and has also spawned many love stories. As soon as I arrived in Hangzhou…

9486f010ef3225c8b323c914dae400459895eb66.sourceText: 杭州，以美丽的西湖而闻名天下，也衍生出许多爱情故事。 一到杭州，导游就介绍了西湖的三绝，孤山不孤，长桥不长，断桥不断的由来。 这孤山不孤是指位于西湖中的一座小山，明清两代的皇帝把这里辟为皇家花园，皇上自称是孤家，因而取名为孤山。 它虽是孤岛，但东连白堤，西接西冷桥，有平湖秋月，中山公园，西冷印社，和知名的楼外楼等著名景点，更因岛上种植了许多梅花，腊梅代表美女 ，因而它有美女相伴，并不孤单。 长桥只是一座普通的单孔石拱桥，只因梁山伯与祝英台在这里十八相送，送来送去把它给送长了，痴情绵绵扯不断，山伯永恋祝英台。 那断桥更是完完整整的一座桥，许仙与白娘子在这里借伞定情，经历了雷锋塔的磨难，他们的婚姻曾一度中断，但忠贞的爱情使他们又在断桥言归于好，相亲 相爱在西湖之滨。 因为这些美丽的传说，青年男女都喜欢选择杭州作为他们谈恋爱或结婚的地方。 西湖边柳树成荫，碧绿的草地上，坐着一对对男男女女，他们面对迷茫的湖水，在垂柳下憧憬着美好的未来，他们怎能想到，在他们共同生活的道路上，还会遇 到多少荆棘险滩，需要他们去共同面对，人类就是这样一代代的谱写着一曲曲或喜或悲的动人故事。 人生啊！ 就是那样奇特，不论老一辈怎样苦口婆心的教导，青年人总按捺不住他那青春冲动的欲望，去探索那美好的憧憬，那是他们一生最幸福的时光。 只是在实践中，人们才意识到婚姻的真正含义。 婚姻在不同的阶段有着不同的内容，青年时代是追求风流，中年时代是家庭责任和培育子女，而到了老年，更多的是相互关心和帮助。 乘着游船游西湖，是杭州人为外地游客安排的首选节目。 我们从苏堤上船，沿途观赏苏堤春晓，平湖秋月，柳浪闻莺，三潭印月，花港观鱼和雷峰夕照等美景。 徘徊在这美景中，真使人流连忘返，舍不得离去。 西湖的水面还是那样的平静，湖面上飘着轻轻的薄雾，我使劲地向湖里望去，想看清梁祝或许仙白娘子爱情的真影，随着船的前进，湖水已显得 混浊不清，像传说中那样纯真的爱情在现实生活中确实已很难找到，在以经济效益为中心的今天，婚姻中掺杂的铜钱味越来越浓，加上独生子女的娇惯，不 懂得相互尊重和忍让，现在有的城市离婚率竟高达百分之三十。 说起婚姻观念和方式，随着时代的发展有着很大的变化。 我们父辈的婚姻基本上还都是父母之命，媒酌之言，讲究门当户对，靠婚后培养感情。 结婚形式比较隆重，要花轿迎娶，拜天地，拜高堂，摆酒席，闹洞房，城里人比较洋派的就改为汽车迎亲，披婚纱，开派对。 1949后的中国大陆，把过去的结婚仪式都说成是封建的和资产阶级的，一概予以批判。 那时解放军刚进城的时候，流传着一句顺口溜’干部三件宝，爱人钢笔表’干部的婚姻一般都是领导介绍，服从组织，革命需要，婚礼十分简单。 比较时兴的是：同事们聚在一起，领导讲个话，新郎新娘介绍一下认识过程，请大家吃点花生瓜子喜糖就完成了婚礼，简朴而节省。 到我结婚的年代，依然沿袭着简单的婚礼，只是随着时代的进步，干部三件宝已发展到自行车，收音机，缝纫机了。 到了八十年代以后，过去的结婚礼仪逐渐恢复，并逐步配套完善。 现在三件宝已升级为汽车，房子和家具了。 而且，分工也很明确，房子汽车由男方负责，屋里的东西女方来办。 正当我们在西湖边游览的时候，一辆披着彩带的卡迪拉克加长的大轿车，尾随着10多辆各种高级轿车的车队从我们身边开过，这就是当前中国城市结婚的写照，我 说不清楚现在中国结婚至少花多少钱，我只听说结婚花费已成为有些家庭的沉重负担。 告别了西湖，我们来到了盛产龙井茶的梅家坞，这里是一片丘陵地，缓缓的山坡上布满了茶林，导游给我们介绍，龙井茶叶长得好是因为得天独厚，这里的气候温和 ，雨量充沛，钱塘江沿坡下流过，民间称此地为’不雨山长涧，天云山自阴’，温暖潮湿的气候培育了特别的品种，加上纯净的虎跑泉水，泡出的茶水甘甜 醇香。 长期饮用，有减肥和治疗糖尿病的功效。 对华侨归国，茶场给我们七折优惠，再加买五送一，店家做了一笔好生意。 中午请我们在村里吃了一顿农家饭，大盘的无污染新鲜菜蔬，现宰的活鸡活鸭，加上驰名的西湖醋鱼，大家都很高兴。 在这里，我们也听到了带有浓重京腔的杭州官话。 说来也怪，苏南那么一小片地方，口语会有那么大的差别，而杭州话更有其不同的特点，每个词带着浓重的儿音，小孩叫”小娃儿”;筷子叫” 筷儿”; 吵架叫”闹架儿”，原来杭州官话是吴语和北京话的混合，这是南宋时期大批官员和百姓迁居此地所形成的。
9486f010ef3225c8b323c914dae400459895eb66.translatedText: Hangzhou is famous for its beautiful West Lake, which has also given rise to many love stories. As soon as we arrived in Hangzhou, the tour guide introduced the three unique features of West Lake: the mountains are not isolated, the bridges are not long, and the bridges are broken. This Gushan Bugu refers to a small mountain located in the West Lake. The emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties turned this place into a royal garden. The emperor claimed to be a Gu family, so he named it Gushan. Although it is an isolated island, it is connected to Baidi in the east and Xileng Bridge in the west. There are famous attractions such as Pinghu Qiuyue, Zhongshan Park, Xileng Seal Society, and the famous Louwailou. Moreover, because there are many plum blossoms planted on the island, wintersweet represents beauties, so it is accompanied by beauties and is not alone. The Long Bridge is just an ordinary single-hole stone arch bridge, because Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai saw each other off here at the age of eighteen. They sent each other back and forth until they grew up. Their infatuation continued, and Shanbo loved Zhu Yingtai forever. The Broken Bridge is a complete bridge. Xu Xian and White Snake took an umbrella here to make love. After experiencing the ordeal of Lei Feng Tower, their marriage was interrupted for a time, but their loyal love made them reconcile on the Broken Bridge and fell in love on the shore of the West Lake. Because of these beautiful legends, young men and women like to choose Hangzhou as a place for them to fall in love or get married. The willow trees by the West Lake are shady, and on the green grass, pairs of men and women are sitting. They face the confused lake and look forward to a better future under the weeping willows. How could they have imagined that on the road of their common life, they will encounter many thorns and dangerous shoals that they need to face together. This is how mankind composes a touching story of joy or sorrow from generation to generation. Life! It's so strange. No matter how earnestly taught by the older generation, young people can't restrain their youthful impulse and explore the beautiful longing. That is the happiest time in their lives. It is only in practice that people realize the true meaning of marriage. Marriage has different contents at different stages. In youth, it is about pursuing romance, in middle age, it is about family responsibilities and raising children, and in old age, it is more about caring and helping each other. Taking a cruise on the West Lake is the first choice program arranged by Hangzhou people for foreign tourists. We boarded the boat from Sudi, and along the way we enjoyed the beautiful scenery such as the spring dawn on Sudi, the autumn moon on the flat lake, the singing of orioles in the willow waves, the moon reflected in the three ponds, fish watching in Huagang and the sunset on Leifeng. Wandering in this beautiful scenery, it really makes people linger and reluctant to leave. The water of the West Lake was still so calm, with a gentle mist floating on the lake. I looked hard into the lake, trying to see clearly the true love of Butterfly Lovers or the White Snake. As the boat moved forward, the water of the lake became turbid. It is indeed difficult to find pure love like the legend in real life. Today, when economic efficiency is the center, the smell of copper money in marriage is getting stronger and stronger. Coupled with the pampering of the only child, it is no longer easy to find. Know how to respect and tolerate each other. Now the divorce rate in some cities is as high as 30%. Speaking of marriage concepts and methods, there have been great changes with the development of the times. The marriages of our fathers' generation were basically ordered by our parents, a matchmaker, a good match, and the cultivation of relationships after marriage. The form of marriage is more grand, involving a sedan, worshiping heaven and earth, worshiping in a high hall, setting up a banquet, and having a bridal chamber. Those in the city who are more Western-style will instead welcome the bride in a car, put on a wedding dress, and hold a party. In mainland China after 1949, all wedding ceremonies in the past were described as feudal and bourgeois, and all were criticized. At that time, when the People's Liberation Army first entered the city, there was a popular saying: "The three treasures of cadres are the pen and watch of the lover." Marriages of cadres were generally introduced by leaders, obeyed the organization, and required revolution, so the wedding was very simple. What is more popular is: colleagues get together, the leader gives a speech, the bride and groom introduce the process of getting to know each other, and everyone is invited to eat some peanut and melon seed wedding candies to complete the wedding, which is simple and economical. By the time I got married, simple weddings were still the norm, but as the times progressed, the three treasures of cadres had developed to include bicycles, radios, and sewing machines. After the 1980s, the past wedding etiquette was gradually restored and the supporting facilities were gradually improved. Now the three treasures have been upgraded to cars, houses and furniture. Moreover, the division of labor is also very clear. The man is responsible for the house and car, and the woman is responsible for the things in the house. While we were visiting the West Lake, a Cadillac extended sedan covered with colorful ribbons drove past us, followed by a convoy of more than 10 luxury cars. This is a portrayal of weddings in Chinese cities. I can't tell you how much it costs to get married in China. I only heard that wedding expenses have become a heavy burden for some families. After bidding farewell to West Lake, we came to Meijiawu, which is rich in Longjing tea. It is a hilly land with tea forests on the gentle slopes. The tour guide introduced to us that Longjing tea grows well because of the unique climate here. , rainfall is abundant, and the Qiantang River flows down the slope. Folks call this place "the rainless mountain has a long stream, and the Tianyun Mountain is self-shading." The warm and humid climate has cultivated special varieties. Coupled with the pure Hupao Spring water, the tea brewed is sweet and mellow. Long-term drinking has the effect of losing weight and treating diabetes. For the overseas Chinese returning home, the tea shop gave us a 30% discount, plus we bought five and got one free. The store did a good business. At noon, we were treated to a farm meal in the village, with a large plate of pollution-free fresh vegetables, freshly slaughtered live chickens and ducks, and the famous West Lake vinegar fish. Everyone was very happy. Here, we also heard Hangzhou Mandarin with a strong Beijing accent. It’s strange to say that in such a small area in southern Jiangsu, there are such big differences in spoken language, and Hangzhou dialect has its own unique characteristics. Each word has a strong baby sound. Children are called "Xiao Wa'er";

d9c188ee5f67cf3ab5ded00410004042abb8dafc.sourceText: “听乡音 寄乡情”亚省凤凰城开平同乡会中秋联欢 （亚省时报记者甄松伟亚省凤凰城报道） 开平话，开平夹房歌，粤曲这一个个有鲜明文化特色的开平乡音在凤城酒家响起，移民美国超过半个世纪的，开平老乡，当地知名专栏作家佳叔（邝添权）拿出自己的”全家福”，他的儿子上台（第二代华人移民）讲述了父母以及自己在凤凰城努力拼搏的经典华人家庭故事。浓浓的乡音，浓浓的乡情，9月2日下午，把两百多名亚利桑那凤凰城的开平乡亲携幼扶老，以及当地的华人朋友，从四面八方齐聚一起，共庆中秋。乡亲们在这异国他乡常年为工作而忙碌，难得在这劳工节长周末欢聚一堂，大家情绪高涨，兴高采烈，场面温馨热烈。 联欢会由开平同乡会副会长司徒日贤先生和余江英女士主持，司徒先生简单介绍此次联欢会的相关情况，联欢会由会长甄硕钦先生致辞，甄会长感谢各位乡亲和嘉宾前来参加中秋联欢会，感谢支持并慷慨解囊赞助此次活动的各商家以及各位乡亲，逐一介绍了参加此次联欢会活动的嘉宾。 联欢会上并推介了凤凰城知名人士佳叔（邝添权）的全家福照片，这照片由《亚省时报》推荐参加中华全国归国华侨联合会主办的《全家福》照片征集活动比赛，获得二等奖，当场佳叔太太还出示了获奖证书，舞台上展示着这次获奖的大幅全家福照片，博得与会乡亲的热烈掌声，表示祝贺。佳叔的两位公子，任职医院院长的邝健富和任高级工程师的邝悦富，兴致勃勃地上台向乡亲们介绍他们这个大家庭，他们虽然在美国出生，但不忘乡音，能听会说通常的家乡四邑话，随后用英文通过翻译告诉大家，他们的父母从小就教导他们为人之道，记住自己是中国人，记住中华传统文化，家庭和睦，事业有成，为社会作出贡献。 联欢会上还进行精彩的文艺表演，合唱团演唱了多首大家耳熟能详的歌曲，台湾阿里山歌舞，小提琴独奏，高胡，扬琴小合奏，更加使乡亲们惊叹的，在这异国他乡能听到家乡的民歌，从加州洛杉矶远道而来余源先生即席演唱了开平夹房歌，”中秋真高兴，开平聚乡亲，靓酒靓菜烧卖干蒸，西餐中餐品种精；好歌声，彩云追月情，凤城大堂欢笑声，家家幸福乐绵绵。佳叔好家庭，子孙系精英，一张和谐好相片，世界得奖人羡称；冇得顶，乡娌齐贺庆，喊齐举杯胜胜胜，宗枝叶长永繁荣”。亲切的家乡民歌腔调，那每段结尾全场的齐声”哟呵”，把乡亲们尤其是年长的老华侨带回来家乡。 除了精彩的文艺演出，联欢会还有丰富奖品抽奖，大家一起分享了开平同乡会和邝添权伉俪送出的大蛋糕，整个联欢会高潮迭起，欢声笑语。
d9c188ee5f67cf3ab5ded00410004042abb8dafc.translatedText: "Listen to the local accent "Send Nostalgia" Mid-Autumn Festival Gala of Kaiping Hometown Association in Phoenix City, Alberta (Alberta Times reporter Zhen Songwei reported from Phoenix City, Alberta) Kaiping dialect, Kaiping house songs, and Cantonese operas all have distinct cultural characteristics in the Fengcheng Restaurant. Uncle Jia (Kong Tianquan), a fellow from Kaiping and a well-known local columnist who has immigrated to the United States for more than half a century, took out his "family portrait." His son (a second-generation Chinese immigrant) took the stage and told the classic Chinese family story of his parents and himself working hard in Phoenix. With a strong local accent and a strong nostalgia, on the afternoon of September 2, more than 200 Kaiping folks from Phoenix, Arizona, with their young and old, as well as local Chinese friends from all over, gathered together to celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. The folks are busy with work all year round in this foreign country. It is rare for them to gather together on this Labor Day weekend. Everyone is in high spirits and joy, and the scene is warm and warm. The party was hosted by Mr. Situ Rixian and Ms. Yu Jiangying, vice presidents of the Kaiping Association. Mr. Situ briefly introduced the relevant situation of the party. The party was delivered by the president, Mr. Zhen Shuoqin. Chairman Zhen thanked all the folks and guests for coming to the Mid-Autumn Festival. He also thanked the merchants and fellow villagers who supported and generously sponsored the event. He introduced the guests one by one. At the party, the family photo of Uncle Jia (Kong Tianquan), a well-known person in Phoenix, was also promoted. This photo was recommended by the "Alberta Times" to participate in the "Family Portrait" photo collection competition sponsored by the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, and won the second prize. Mrs. Jia Shu also presented the award certificate on the spot. The large-scale family photo that won the award was displayed on the stage, winning warm applause and congratulations from the attending folks. Uncle Jia's two sons, Kuang Jianfu, who serves as hospital director, and Kuang Yuefu, who serves as a senior engineer, enthusiastically took the stage to introduce their big family to the villagers. Although they were born in the United States, they did not forget their local accent and could hear and speak the usual Siyi dialect of their hometown. They then told everyone in English through a translator that their parents had taught them how to be a human being since they were young, remember that they are Chinese, remember the traditional Chinese culture, have a harmonious family, have a successful career, and contribute to society. There was also a wonderful artistic performance at the party. The choir sang many familiar songs, including Taiwan's Alishan song and dance, violin solo, gaohu, and dulcimer small ensemble. The villagers were even more amazed that they could hear the folk songs of their hometown in this foreign country. Mr. Yu Yuan, who came all the way from Los Angeles, California, sang the Kaiping Jiafang song impromptu, "in Autumn is really happy, folks gather in Kaiping, delicious wine and delicious dishes, steamed shaomai, Western and Chinese food are exquisite; good singing, colorful clouds chasing the moon, laughter in the lobby of Fengcheng, every family is happy. Uncle Jia has a good family, descendants are elites, a harmonious and good photo, the world's award-winning people are envious; if there is no winner, the villagers celebrate together, shout and toast, and the branches and leaves of the clan will prosper forever." The friendly tone of hometown folk songs, and the chorus of "yo ho" at the end of each section, bring the folks, especially the older overseas Chinese, back to their hometown. In addition to the wonderful cultural performances, the party also included a lucky draw for rich prizes. Everyone shared the big cake presented by the Kaiping Association and Mr. and Mrs. Kuang Tianquan. The whole party was filled with climaxes and laughter.

8d94f7f3e7fb394aefe3918b73197b46ed728f53.sourceText: （亚省时报） 沃尔玛的黑色星期五广告已在网路上外泄，今年该商场主打是平面电视，最便宜的一台只要98元。 （网路照片） 一年一度的感恩节后首个「黑色星期五」购物特卖倒数计时，零售商为拼年度业绩，几家主要零售商陆续公开特卖内容，3C电子商品仍是主要商品，且价格再度下探， 让买家惊呼连连，有意感恩节时漏夜甚至提早数日排队抢购。 监测黑色星期五最新商场情报的网站BFads透露，今年几家零售商如沃尔玛（Wal-mart）、Best Buy和标的（Target）等，抢攻业绩的主力是平面电视，有意将还在观望 价格的买家一网打尽。 在两年前一台要价上千的46吋LCD平面电视，今年竟出现298元的抛售价，若不在意尺寸大小、品牌，19吋只要98元，另一Dynex品牌的24吋、1080P更 达破纪录的79.9元，过去被视为高价位电子商品的平面电视，打低到百元以下的价格。 当然，零售商扔出这种价钱者，皆非主流品牌。 即使如此，在Best Buy文宣广告中，赫然发现夏普（Sharp）42吋、1080P的LCD平面电视，也是不含税200元有找的199.99元破盘行情，黑色星期五的特卖俨然成为「平面电视 大战」。 在两周前仍在物色平面电视的河滨加大周同学说，目前卖场找到最便宜的，是西屋（Westinghouse）32吋1080P平面电视，价格200元左右。 如今看到黑色星期五文宣后下定决心，要在感恩节提早两天去搭帐棚，和几位留学生一起排队抢电视。 而包括Best Buy、沃尔玛、标的三大零售商均宣布，感恩节后的凌晨12时便开门营业，比往年提早五到六小时，还将在开门前两小时发排队号码牌，并加 派警卫人员现场维持秩序。 除电视机外，今年黑色星期五另一最夯的电子特卖品是蓝光（Blu-Ray）播放机，过去几年平均要价数百元，如今不但价格跌到百元以下，甚至还加入Wi -Fi无线上网功能，民众可透过该机器收看Netflix的高传真电影，同时卖场也提供诸多好莱坞电影光碟片，平均在4.99到9.99元间，相当平价。 准备换购电脑、游戏机者，今年也​​有不少破坏行情的商品，三大零售商广告中出现179.99元的笔记电脑，PlayStation 3 160GB的主机包含游戏和操纵杆只要199元，这些商品价格都让 准备黑色星期五的狩猎族垂涎三尺。
8d94f7f3e7fb394aefe3918b73197b46ed728f53.translatedText: (Alberta Times) Wal-Mart's Black Friday ads have been leaked online. This year, the mall's main focus is flat-screen TVs, and the cheapest one only costs $98. (Internet photo) The countdown to the annual "Black Friday" shopping sale after Thanksgiving is counting down. In order to compete for annual performance, several major retailers have successively disclosed the special sales content. 3C electronic products are still the main products, and the prices have dropped again, making buyers exclaim. They intend to miss the Thanksgiving night or even queue up several days in advance to buy. BFads, a website that monitors the latest shopping mall intelligence for Black Friday, revealed that this year several retailers, such as Wal-mart, Best Buy and Target, are focusing on flat-screen TVs to compete for sales, intending to catch all buyers who are still waiting to see the price. Two years ago, a 46-inch LCD flat-screen TV that cost thousands of dollars was sold for NT$298 this year. If you don't care about size or brand, the 19-inch TV only costs NT$98. Another Dynex brand's 24-inch, 1080P TV sells for a record-breaking NT$79.9. Flat-screen TVs that were considered high-priced electronic products in the past have been priced below NT$100. Of course, none of the retailers offering such prices are mainstream brands. Even so, in Best Buy's promotional advertisement, it was shockingly discovered that Sharp's 42-inch, 1080P LCD flat-screen TV is also priced at 199.99 yuan for 200 yuan excluding tax. The Black Friday sale has become a "flat-screen TV war." Zhou, a student from UC Riverside who was still looking for a flat-screen TV two weeks ago, said that the cheapest one currently found in the store is a 32-inch 1080P flat-screen TV from Westinghouse, priced at around NT$200. Now after seeing the Black Friday promotion, I have made up my mind to set up a tent two days early for Thanksgiving and line up with several international students to grab a TV. Three major retailers, including Best Buy, Wal-Mart, and Target, have announced that they will open at 12 a.m. after Thanksgiving, five to six hours earlier than in previous years. Queuing numbers will be issued two hours before opening, and additional security personnel will be deployed to maintain order on site. In addition to TVs, another of the most popular electronic sales items on Black Friday this year is Blu-Ray players. In the past few years, the average price has been several hundred yuan. Now, not only the price has dropped to less than a hundred yuan, but it also has Wi-Fi wireless Internet access function. People can watch Netflix's high-fidelity movies through this machine. At the same time, the store also provides many Hollywood movie discs, with an average price of 4.99 to 9.99 yuan, which is quite affordable. For those who are preparing to exchange for computers and game consoles, there are many products that disrupt the market this year. Laptops for 179.99 yuan appear in the advertisements of the three major retailers, and PlayStation 3 160GB consoles include games and joysticks for only 199 yuan. The prices of these products have made hunters preparing for Black Friday salivate.

7dde0dc75b497adbbdf75a9c5b4e5f8e279f87a8.translatedText: Reuters: Hu Jintao personally intervened in the "defection case" of Chinese officials to the United States. Reuters released exclusive news on June 1 that the Chinese state...

142b622ea62026b2a2c80d64cd50cb32511bfd16.sourceText: 路透社6月1日曾发布独家消息称，中国国家安全部一名官员被怀疑多年为美国当间谍而遭逮捕。6月15日再次发布独家消息称，中国国家主席胡锦涛2012年亲自介入，命令调查此次事件。
142b622ea62026b2a2c80d64cd50cb32511bfd16.translatedText: Reuters released exclusive news on June 1 that an official from the Ministry of National Security of China was arrested for being suspected of spying for the United States for many years. Exclusive news was released again on June 15, saying that Chinese President Hu Jintao personally intervened in 2012 and ordered an investigation into the incident.

19ae91d43f9d469a59cd6e2945e431eccfca7523.sourceText: 英国路透社6月15日援引两位消息人士的话称，一位中国安全部官员因涉嫌向美国提供情报令中国国家主席胡锦涛十分恼火。消息人士透漏，这位官员为一位副部长陆忠伟的助理，在2012年1月到3月之间被捕，2011年，中国在美国的间谍接二连三被揭露后，中国安全部开始提高警觉。
19ae91d43f9d469a59cd6e2945e431eccfca7523.translatedText: British Reuters quoted two sources as saying on June 15 that a Chinese Ministry of Security official was suspected of providing intelligence to the United States, which made Chinese President Hu Jintao very angry. According to sources, the official was an assistant to Deputy Minister Lu Zhongwei and was arrested between January and March 2012. After Chinese spies in the United States were exposed one after another in 2011, the Chinese Ministry of Security began to increase vigilance.

82e26d50ec1dd88f140257cf18137e75b329fc06.sourceText: 另外，消息人士透漏根据安全部内部的调查，这位副部长助理已经为美国中央情报局工作数年，将中国在海外的间谍网络信息提供给美国，这起事件是近20年以来性质最为恶劣的间谍活动。
82e26d50ec1dd88f140257cf18137e75b329fc06.translatedText: In addition, sources revealed that according to an internal investigation by the Ministry of Security, the deputy assistant minister has worked for the CIA for several years and provided information about China’s overseas spy networks to the United States. This incident is the most egregious espionage activity in the past 20 years.

9e4df10847943b62a166c730379b56dcb8488dac.sourceText: 路透社评论称，此次消息人士提供的信息是对此事件的确认，虽然中美对此消息都保持沉默，避免中美关系再出现危机。目前，这位中国安全部官员的身份仍然没有公开，只知道他的职务是副部长陆忠伟的助理。
9e4df10847943b62a166c730379b56dcb8488dac.translatedText: Reuters commented that the information provided by the source was confirmation of the incident, although both China and the United States remained silent on the news to avoid another crisis in Sino-US relations. At present, the identity of this Chinese Ministry of Security official has not been disclosed. It is only known that his position is assistant to Deputy Minister Lu Zhongwei.

f2ad4953815b48737376162c694f9af88cddca3a.sourceText: 消息人士拒绝详细说明这位助理如何前去美国，以及连累中国间谍的过程。但是，他们说：”此事件牵扯政治、经济和战略情报。”另外，陆忠伟已被认为不会受到正式的惩罚。胡锦涛命令扩大调查以后，结果证明陆忠伟并没有为美国搜集情报。
f2ad4953815b48737376162c694f9af88cddca3a.translatedText: The sources declined to elaborate on how the assistant came to the United States and how he implicated Chinese spies. However, they said: "This incident involves political, economic and strategic intelligence." In addition, Lu Zhongwei is considered not to be formally punished. After Hu Jintao ordered an expanded investigation, the results proved that Lu Zhongwei did not collect intelligence for the United States.

b00612512d2b4884d1ea81bacd12d29808ce4e46.sourceText: 中共高层认为，陆忠伟在雇佣这位助理之前，没有进行例行的调查，这是违反规则的行为。其中一个消息人士称：”陆忠伟的问题在于他录用助理的时候没有进行仔细调查，而今年是非常敏感的时期，中央政府不希望制造任何麻烦。”
b00612512d2b4884d1ea81bacd12d29808ce4e46.translatedText: Senior officials of the CCP believed that Lu Zhongwei did not conduct routine investigations before hiring this assistant, which was a violation of the rules. One of the sources said: "Lu Zhongwei's problem is that he did not conduct careful investigation when he hired his assistant. This year is a very sensitive period, and the central government does not want to cause any trouble."

220aab0dc39531904579b33587df02f9977ecc9e.sourceText: 而此前，中国外交部拒绝对此事件发表任何评论。路透社评论称，中国国家安全部是最不透明的机构，没有设立公开网站以及发言人。美国国务卿希拉里（Hillary Clinton）也拒绝对此事件发表任何言论。这次间谍案是1985年国家安全部官员俞强声叛逃美国后被曝光的最严重的间谍案。俞强声的兄弟俞正声现任上海市委书记。
220aab0dc39531904579b33587df02f9977ecc9e.translatedText: Previously, the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs refused to make any comment on this incident. Reuters commented that China’s Ministry of National Security is the most opaque agency and does not have a public website or spokesperson. US Secretary of State Hillary Clinton also refused to make any comment on the incident. This espionage case is the most serious espionage case exposed since Yu Qiangsheng, an official of the Ministry of National Security, defected to the United States in 1985. Yu Qiangsheng’s brother Yu Zhengsheng is currently the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee Secretary.

2c5f002bcccfeb4860daa1466a18674f0c1a5a3f.sourceText: 俞强声叛逃后对美国揭发了中情局分析员金无怠为中国间谍的身份。金无怠在1986年被宣判长期监禁前夕在美国监狱中自杀身亡。据说这次国安间谍案可能使主管安全工作的政治局常委周永康受到巨大压力。
2c5f002bcccfeb4860daa1466a18674f0c1a5a3f.translatedText: After Yu Qiangsheng defected, he exposed the identity of CIA analyst Jin Wuluo to the United States as a Chinese spy. Jin Wusao committed suicide in a U.S. prison on the eve of being sentenced to a long term in prison in 1986. It is said that this national security espionage case may put Zhou Yongkang, a member of the Politburo Standing Committee in charge of security work, under tremendous pressure.

f12ab011742fc4e601ab89b50a3409f1463f7533.sourceText: 此前，路透消息指，被捕官员被美国中情局招揽，提供政治、经济及战略情报，但未悉他能接触何种级别的情报。消息人士还称，该名官员收到数以十万计的美元酬劳，事件造成很大的破坏。
f12ab011742fc4e601ab89b50a3409f1463f7533.translatedText: Previously, Reuters reported that the arrested official was recruited by the CIA to provide political, economic and strategic intelligence, but it was unknown what level of intelligence he had access to. The source also said the official was paid hundreds of thousands of dollars and the incident caused a lot of damage.

The event started with the three hearing ceremonies to the Buddha and Bodhisattvas led by Citao, the head of Tzu Chi Liaison Office in Phoenix City.

619d740dbc26d494499f02eddb42f6a221d75e72.sourceText: 这几年天灾人祸不断，地、水、火、风、四大不调。慈济人将爱心紧紧相连，在2012年奔赴风灾，水灾等救助活动中。慈济人的这种爱的足迹踏遍了71个国家及地区。在重灾区，别人是逃出来，慈济人是走进去，不分种族，在第一时间协助灾民重建家园，发放食物用品，兴办医院学校等。摄像机记录下了他们2012年的努力，在活动中与大家一起分享，希望大家多珍惜幸福的生活，并把自己的爱心送给那些需要的人。就如当天大家带回慈济的小竹筒，只要将用省的零钱储存起来，可能就能带给灾区孩子一块面包，一杯牛奶。慈济精进班的小朋友，以及慈济人的师姊师兄，用手语歌给大家带来了祝福，也告诉大德们环保，多吃素食的好习惯。慈济引导大家改善小小的生活习惯，就能享受自己的幸福，并帮助别人。
619d740dbc26d494499f02eddb42f6a221d75e72.translatedText: In recent years, there have been constant natural and man-made disasters, and the four elements of earth, water, fire, and wind are out of harmony. Tzu Chi people are closely connected with love and went to rescue activities such as typhoons and floods in 2012. This kind of love footprint of Tzu Chi people has traveled to 71 countries and regions. In the hardest-hit areas, while others escaped, Tzu Chi people walked in, regardless of race, to help the victims rebuild their homes, distribute food and supplies, and set up hospitals and schools, etc., regardless of race. The camera recorded their efforts in 2012 and shared them with everyone at the event. I hope everyone will cherish a happy life and give their love to those in need. Just like the small bamboo tube everyone brought back to Tzu Chi that day, as long as you save the change, you may be able to bring a piece of bread and a glass of milk to the children in the disaster area. The children of Tzu Chi Advanced Class, as well as the senior sisters and brothers of Tzu Chi staff, brought blessings to everyone by singing in sign language, and also told the adults about the good habits of environmental protection and eating more vegetarian food. Tzu Chi guides everyone to improve their small living habits so that they can enjoy their own happiness and help others.

a179d71fb0d45fee2808b2a239143d25b2b5c37a.sourceText: 发放福慧红包是每次活动中最让大德们期待的时刻。每一个红包都满载着上人无量的感恩与祝福。今年众人广入经藏行大忏悔，福慧红包也依此精神来设计。上人希望天下苍生，广行环保弘人文。虽然上人不能亲临祝福现场，由惟宗师兄与慈涛师姊代发红包，但上人通过画面作了开示与祝福。 最后，两百多名会众点亮心灯，举高齐眉，齐声虔心祈福，祈求人心淨化，风调雨顺，祈愿来年是个平安吉祥的福慧年。
a179d71fb0d45fee2808b2a239143d25b2b5c37a.translatedText: Distributing blessing and wisdom red envelopes is the most anticipated moment in every event. Every red envelope is filled with the Master’s immeasurable gratitude and blessings. This year everyone is going to the Sutra Collection to practice great repentance, and the blessing and wisdom red envelopes are also designed in this spirit. The Master hopes that all people in the world will promote environmental protection and promote humanities. Although the Master could not attend the blessing in person and had Brother Wei Zhong and Sister Citao handing out red envelopes, the Master gave instructions and blessings through the screen. Finally, more than 200 members of the congregation lit their heart lanterns, raised their eyebrows high, and prayed in unison for purification of people's hearts, good weather, and a peaceful and auspicious year of blessing and wisdom in the coming year.

d0dbccbe4b8d29727fca26865f246075240860be.sourceText: 亚省华总换届王盛君荣任新会长 侨学界中秋国庆筹备委员会成立 亚省华总换届王盛君荣任新会长 侨学界中秋国庆筹备委员会成立 5月19日，亚利桑那州华人华侨总会（亚省华总）在凤凰城中国文化中心召开年度会议，来自各侨团侨领、留学生代表等出席了会议。因会长王建民目前在中国工作而缺席会议，会议由中华海外联谊会理事、华总荣誉会长杨文田主持，首先回顾了一年来亚省华总和大家所做的各项工作，并感谢各界对亚省华总的始终支持。华总财务总监吴宁介绍了华总的财务情况，来自图桑市的华人代表雷宏向参会的各位代表介绍了图桑市华人华侨的活动情况并表示将一如既往地支持参与华总的活动。华总董事吴亮祖对会长换届选举作了说明和介绍，经全体到会成员投票选举，王盛君荣任新一届会长。 新任会长王盛君先生在发言中感谢大家对他的鼓励和信任，表示自己将不辜负重托，在自己的任期里，带领全体会员团结互助，奉献公益，在促进中美两国经济文化交流，尤其是要为促进祖国经济与亚利桑那州的交流与合作多作贡献，同时会积极参与亚省侨社事务，在支援祖国建设，维护祖国统一，推动融入和谐侨社建设，弘扬中华文化，发挥应有的贡献。他坚信团结就是力量、集体的智慧会让华总迅速成长为亚省社团的重要一支力量，也将会发展成为美国侨界最具有影响力和凝聚力的组织之一。 迎中秋庆国庆活动亚省侨学界9月16日登场 亚省侨胞庆祝中华人民共和国成立63周年并欢度中秋筹备委员会在5月19日同时成立，会议通过杨文田、吴亮祖、 徐强 、吴宁为大会总召集人、华总会长王盛君、华总常务副会长、图桑华人代表雷宏、亚利桑那州立大学中国学生学者联谊会（ASU)会会长长王德轩、亚利桑那州大学中国学生学者联合会（UA)学生会会长长仇玺源、北亚利桑那州中国学生学者联谊会会长于宏、雷鸟商学院中国学生学者联谊会会长夏欢、出任本次活动的执行主席。 华总董事、川渝联谊会会长陈志钢、美中文化交流协会会长古亚瑜负责策划及制作节目并担任庆祝活动文艺演出执行主席。筹委会一致通过今年在亚利桑那州立大学MU大礼堂举办大型中秋国庆庆祝活动。日期定为9月16日晚上6点，同时中国国内协侨单位和美国侨报将提供的大量丰富图片将向亚省侨界展现新中国建国63年以来，祖国在经济科技文化等领域上的骄人成就。 下面是参与共同主办中秋和国庆筹备的主要组织名单： 亚利桑那州华人华侨总会(亚省华总) 亚利桑那州立大学(ASU)中国学生学者联谊会 亚利桑那州(UA)中国学生学者联谊会 北亚利桑那州（NAU)中国学生学者联谊会 雷鸟商学院中国学生学者联谊会 旅美科学家工程师专业人士协会凤凰城分会 亚省华人高科技协会 凤凰城华美半导体协会 鳳凰城姐妹市成都委员会 美国福建海外联谊会 中国福建省侨联亚利桑那州联络处 亚省美中文化艺术交流协会 亚省川渝联谊会 亚省云南同乡会 美国侨报 亚省华人网 www.azchinese.com 欢迎更多组织加入我们迎中秋庆国庆的活动。 更多新闻，请访问亚省华总网站： www.azchinese.org
d0dbccbe4b8d29727fca26865f246075240860be.translatedText: >The Overseas Chinese and Academic Circles in the Province of Alberta re-elected Wang Shengjun as the new president. The Overseas Chinese and Academic Circles in the Mid-Autumn Festival and the National Day Preparatory Committee was established. The Provincial Chinese and Academics Association in Alberta re-elected and Wang Shengjun was appointed as the new president. The Overseas Chinese and Academic Circles in the Preparatory Committee for the Mid-Autumn and National Day was established. On May 19, the Arizona Chinese Association (Arizona Chinese Association) held its annual meeting at the Chinese Cultural Center in Phoenix. Overseas Chinese leaders from various overseas Chinese groups and representatives of international students attended the meeting. President Wang Jianmin was absent from the meeting because he was currently working in China. The meeting was chaired by Yang Wentian, director of the Chinese Overseas Friendship Association and honorary president of the Chinese Association. He first reviewed the work done by the Chinese Association of Alberta and everyone in the past year, and thanked all walks of life for their continued support to the Chinese Association of Alberta. Wu Ning, the financial director of Huazong, introduced the financial situation of Huazong. Lei Hong, a Chinese representative from Tucson, introduced the activities of the Chinese in Tucson to the participating representatives and expressed that he would continue to support the activities of Huazhong. Wu Liangzu, Director of Hua General Manager, explained and introduced the election of the president. After voting by all members present, Wang Shengjun was elected as the new president. In his speech, the new president Mr. Wang Shengjun thanked everyone for their encouragement and trust in him, saying that he will live up to the great trust. During his term, he will lead all members to unite and help each other, contribute to public welfare, and promote economic and cultural exchanges between China and the United States, especially to promote exchanges and cooperation between the motherland’s economy and Arizona. At the same time, he will actively participate in the affairs of overseas Chinese communities in Alberta, support the construction of the motherland, safeguard the reunification of the motherland, promote the integration of harmonious overseas Chinese communities, promote Chinese culture, and make due contributions. He firmly believes that unity is strength and collective wisdom will allow Huazong to quickly grow into an important force in the Alberta community and will also develop into one of the most influential and cohesive organizations in the American overseas community. The Overseas Chinese Community in Alberta took part in the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day activities on September 16. Overseas Chinese in Alberta celebrated the 63rd anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China and celebrated the Mid-Autumn Festival. The preparatory committee was established at the same time on May 19. The meeting approved Yang Wentian, Wu Liangzu, and Xu Qiang. , Wu Ning is the general convenor of the conference, President of the Chinese Students and Scholars Association Wang Shengjun, Executive Vice President of the Chinese Students and Scholars Association, Lei Hong, Tucson Chinese representative, Wang Dexuan, President of the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of Arizona State University (ASU), Qiu Xiyuan, President of the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of the University of Arizona (UA), Yu Hong, President of the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of Northern Arizona, and Xia Huan, President of the Thunderbird Business School Chinese Students and Scholars Association, serve as the executive chairs of this event. Chen Zhigang, General Director of Hua and President of the Sichuan-Chongqing Friendship Association, and Gu Yayu, President of the US-China Cultural Exchange Association, are responsible for planning and producing the program and serving as executive chairmen of the cultural performances of the celebration. The organizing committee unanimously agreed to hold a large-scale Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day celebration at the MU Auditorium of Arizona State University this year. The date is set at 6 p.m. on September 16. At the same time, a large number of pictures provided by China's domestic overseas Chinese association units and the American Overseas Chinese Newspaper will show the overseas Chinese community in Alberta the remarkable achievements of the motherland in the fields of economy, science, technology, culture and other fields since the founding of the People's Republic of China 63 years ago. The following is a list of major organizations involved in co-hosting the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day preparations: Arizona Chinese Association (ASU Chinese Students and Scholars Association) Arizona State University (ASU) Chinese Students and Scholars Association Arizona (UA) Chinese Students and Scholars Association Northern Arizona (NAU) Chinese Students and Scholars Association Thunderbird Business School Chinese Students and Scholars Association Phoenix Chapter of the Association of Scientists and Engineers Professionals in the United States Alberta Chinese High-Tech Association Phoenix China-American Semiconductor Association Phoenix Sister City Chengdu Committee Fujian Overseas Friendship Association of the United States, Arizona Liaison Office of the Overseas Chinese Federation of Fujian Province, Arizona, U.S.-China Cultural and Art Exchange Association of the Province, Sichuan-Chongqing Friendship Association of the Province of Yunnan, Yunnan Association of the United States, Overseas Chinese Newspaper of the United States, Chinese Network of the Province of Alberta www.azchinese.com We welcome more organizations to join us in celebrating the Mid-Autumn Festival and the National Day. For more news, please visit the Alberta Chinese Association website: www.azchinese.org

acb69e29cc7cfaefba8cc280688f8a0462d2203e.sourceText: 美玉米歉收 恐爆发全球粮食危机 国际粮食政策研究所(IFPRI)警告，世界最大玉米生产国美国的作物因干旱受损，可能即将引爆一场全球粮食危机。 彭博信息引述IFPRI所长樊胜根(Shenggen Fan)说，政府必须采取行动预防危机，美国必须停止使用该国40%玉米产量的生质燃料计划，以增加对畜牧业的玉米供给。由政府和国际组织支持的IFPRI，是联合国监控粮价的农业市场信息系统(AMIS)的一部分。 樊胜根说：”主要问题是政策，必须停止生产生质燃料，因为这推升全球粮价，使许多穷人饱受折磨，特别是妇孺。如果我们不采取紧急行动，危机将很快再度爆发。” 樊胜根说，印度和中国等国家必须释出存粮，以帮助穷人因应粮价上涨，政府则需避免实施出口禁令，以免2008年全球粮食危机重演。 玉米12月期货14日在芝加哥期货交易所盘中涨0.9%至每蒲式耳(bushel，英斗)7.99美元，黄豆11月期货涨0.5%至每蒲式耳16.0925美元。 从食物、家畜饲料到增甜剂都用到的玉米，10日涨至每蒲式耳8.49美元历史新高；玉米自6月15日以来已大涨57%，推升FAO追踪的7月全球粮食通膨比上月攀升6.2%，是2009年11月来最大涨幅。 根据美国农业部，半世纪来最严重的中西部旱灾导致玉米减产，推升价格，美国占2011至2012年度全球玉米产量的36%和全球交易量的39%。 FAO秘书长达席瓦呼吁美国政府暂停其主导的乙醇生产计划，让更多作物用于粮食和畜牧饲料。逾180名美国国会议员也呼吁环保署(EPA)降低国内今年和明年的乙醇消耗规定，或暂停该措施。
acb69e29cc7cfaefba8cc280688f8a0462d2203e.translatedText: The failure of the U.S. corn harvest may lead to a global food crisis. The International Food Policy Research Institute (IFPRI) warns that the crops of the United States, the world's largest corn producer, are damaged by drought and may be about to trigger a global food crisis. Bloomberg News quoted IFPRI Director Shenggen Fan as saying that the government must take action to prevent the crisis, and the United States must stop the biomass fuel plan that uses 40% of the country's corn production to increase the supply of corn to the livestock industry. IFPRI, supported by governments and international organizations, is part of the United Nations' Agricultural Market Information System (AMIS), which monitors food prices. Fan Shenggen said: "The main issue is policy. The production of biomass fuel must be stopped, because this has pushed up global food prices and caused many poor people, especially women and children, to suffer. If we do not take urgent action, the crisis will break out again soon." Fan Shenggen said that countries such as India and China must release grain reserves to help the poor cope with rising food prices, and governments need to avoid imposing export bans to avoid a repeat of the 2008 global food crisis. December corn futures rose 0.9% to $7.99 per bushel on the Chicago Board of Trade on the 14th, and November soybean futures rose 0.5% to $16.0925 per bushel. Corn, used in everything from food, livestock feed to sweeteners, rose to a record high of $8.49 per bushel on the 10th; corn has surged 57% since June 15, pushing global food inflation tracked by the FAO to climb 6.2% in July from the previous month, the largest increase since November 2009. According to the U.S. Department of Agriculture, the worst drought in the Midwest in half a century has reduced corn production and pushed up prices. The United States accounted for 36% of global corn production and 39% of global trade volume in 2011-2012. FAO Secretary-General Da Silva called on the U.S. government to suspend its ethanol production plan to allow more crops to be used for food and livestock feed. More than 180 members of the U.S. Congress have also called on the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) to lower domestic ethanol consumption regulations for this year and next year, or to suspend the measure.

b12d715399c78ae54de3307cf9234840173f195b.sourceText: 阿派奥警长被告歧视 法官听证 阿派奥警长，最近坏消息不断。继司法部15日指控他及属下有「普遍侵犯民权」行为后，联邦地区法官史诺22日再就西语裔控告阿帕约种族歧视(racial profiling)诉讼，举行听证。 本桉原告是一批西语裔。他们宣称，在一些交通号志值勤的警察，只因看到车上有西语裔就毫无缘由拦车检查，盘问移民身分。 史诺法官可有三种裁决：一、让此桉交付审判。二、不予受理，就此了结争议。三、裁决阿派奥基于种族歧视执行移民法。原告要求法庭裁决阿帕奥及其属下侵犯他们的宪法保障权利，并宣布必须制定防止种族歧视的保护措施。 针对阿派奥警长办公室执行新移民法而兴讼的桉件，愈来愈多。由于司法部指控阿派奥及其属下侵犯民权，马里科巴郡警长办公室的数十名移民监狱警察，已失去盘查囚犯移民身分的联邦权力，21日交出他们的联邦身分徽章。 本周提出的诉讼包括一名女性西语裔囚犯控告该郡工作人员侵权，违反州及联邦监禁规定，怀孕期间让她戴脚镣手铐，甚至在2009年她剖腹生产后，仍是如此。
b12d715399c78ae54de3307cf9234840173f195b.translatedText: Sheriff Apao was accused of discrimination and the judge heard. Sheriff Apao, there has been a lot of bad news recently. After the Department of Justice accused him and his subordinates of "widespread civil rights violations" on the 15th, federal District Judge Snow held a hearing on the 22nd on the lawsuit filed by Hispanics against Arpaio for racial profiling. The plaintiffs in this case are a group of Hispanics. They claimed that police officers on duty at some traffic signals stopped the vehicle for no reason and asked about their immigration status just because they saw Hispanics in the car. Judge Snow can make three rulings: 1. Let the case go to trial. 2. The case shall not be accepted and the dispute shall be settled accordingly. 3. Ruling that Apao enforced immigration laws based on racial discrimination. The plaintiffs asked the court to rule that Arpaio and his subordinates violated their constitutionally guaranteed rights and to declare that protections against racial discrimination must be enacted. There are an increasing number of lawsuits filed against the Arpaio Sheriff’s Office over its enforcement of the new immigration law. Dozens of immigration jail police officers at the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office have lost their federal authority to check inmates' immigration status and surrendered their federal identification badges on the 21st as the Justice Department accused Arpaio and his subordinates of civil rights violations. Among the lawsuits filed this week is a lawsuit filed by a female Hispanic inmate who accuses county staff of violating state and federal prison rules by keeping her in shackles during her pregnancy, even after she gave birth by C-section in 2009.

666e6a1541a975bc0c6237de68ed9f51216b3afe.sourceText: 唐孝先：《美加大观园》令人怀念的罗立尔博士
666e6a1541a975bc0c6237de68ed9f51216b3afe.translatedText: Tang Xiaoxian: The memorable Dr. Luo Lier in "The Grand View of the United States and Canada"

fc18be9041ffc0ccd53f13b51036830c49dd3f84.sourceText: 唐孝先：《美加大观园》令人怀念的罗立尔博士 凤凰城 唐孝先 凡是上个世纪七零年代至九零年代曾在亚利桑那州立…
fc18be9041ffc0ccd53f13b51036830c49dd3f84.translatedText: Tang Xiaoxian: The memorable Dr. Luo Lier in "The Grand View of the United States and Canada" Phoenix City Tang Xiaoxian Anyone who has studied in the Department of Industrial Engineering at Arizona State University from the 1970s to the 1990s...

59104400a0e934a6605d6f75e92d0288875bf87e.sourceText: 凡是上个世纪七零年代至九零年代曾在亚利桑那州立大学工业工程系就读的亚洲各国留学人员，一定会知道在那裡任教的德温 罗立尔（Dwayne Rollier）博士。这位学识精深、德高望重、充满爱心、平易近人的教授，不幸于2003年年底因心脏病复发逝世，享年68岁。布希总统为他签发了褒扬 状。 很多来自中国大陆、台湾、香港的留学生、访问学者得到过他的帮助，他们惊悉噩耗，无不为痛失良师益友悲伤哀悼，为这样一位毫不利己、专门利人的大好人过早离开人间深感惋惜。
59104400a0e934a6605d6f75e92d0288875bf87e.translatedText: Anyone who has studied abroad in Asia and studied in the Department of Industrial Engineering at Arizona State University from the 1970s to the 1990s will definitely know Dr. Dwayne Rollier who taught there. This profound, respected, caring and approachable professor unfortunately passed away due to a recurrence of heart disease at the end of 2003 at the age of 68. President Bush issued a certificate of commendation for him. Many international students and visiting scholars from mainland China, Taiwan, and Hong Kong have received his help. They were shocked to learn the sad news, and they all mourned the loss of their mentor and friend. They felt deeply sorry that such a good man who was not self-interested and dedicated to benefiting others passed away prematurely.

8825daf9267f44cd9542e4f494a48d60b497e24f.sourceText: 德温 罗立尔1936年出生在奥克拉荷马州伊尼德（Enid）市。他先后毕业于奥克拉荷马州立大学和佛罗里达州立大学，获数学统计学士、硕士学位和数学博士 学位。随后曾在军中服务，任职于美国陆军司令部、军事空运指挥部和伊格林（Eglin）空军基地等单位。1971年9月，罗立尔博士应聘来亚利桑那州立大 学任教，2001年退休，期间还担任工业工程系副系主任14年之久，辅佐多位系主任，难能可贵。他开设课程15门以上，发表主要论文三十多篇。
8825daf9267f44cd9542e4f494a48d60b497e24f.translatedText: Devin Rollier was born in 1936 in Enid, Oklahoma. He graduated from Oklahoma State University and Florida State University, receiving bachelor's and master's degrees in mathematical statistics and a PhD in mathematics. He later served in the military, serving in units such as the U.S. Army Command, Military Airlift Command, and Eglin Air Force Base. In September 1971, Dr. Lolier was hired to teach at Arizona State University. He retired in 2001. During this period, he also served as the deputy director of the Department of Industrial Engineering for 14 years, assisting many department chairs, which was commendable. He has taught more than 15 courses and published more than 30 major papers.

8ad4eec14056e44c7a9a5a5f4d0691d1180c12f2.sourceText: 1989 年2月，我自费来美国亚利桑那州立大学英文系当访问学者。出国前我在一所高等学校教英语，在该校办的出国人员外语培训班兼课时认识一位来自美国的青年教师 克里斯 瑟伦（Chris Thron）。临行前我去克里斯家辞别，他给我写了一封介绍信，「你第一次去美国，人地生疏、举目无亲，遇到困难找教会，他们一定会帮助你的。」克里斯把 他所属的教会和牧师姓名也写在信上。
8ad4eec14056e44c7a9a5a5f4d0691d1180c12f2.translatedText: In February 1989, I came to the United States as a visiting scholar in the English Department of Arizona State University at my own expense. Before I went abroad, I taught English at a university. I met a young teacher from the United States, Chris Thron, during the foreign language training class for overseas students held by the school. Before I left, I went to Chris’s house to say goodbye, and he wrote me a letter of introduction, “It’s your first time in the United States, and you’re unfamiliar with the country and have no friends. If you encounter difficulties, go to the church. They will definitely help you.” Chris also wrote the name of the church and pastor he belonged to on the letter.

7bdf2aaebfdcdf0bc392c0d03a2ce42d2fa04d5c.sourceText: 我用人民币买了上海至洛杉矶、洛杉矶至凰凤城的飞机票，到人民银行兑换了限额的50美元，就告别亲人，飞越太平洋，到一个完全陌生的国家去了。
7bdf2aaebfdcdf0bc392c0d03a2ce42d2fa04d5c.translatedText: I used RMB to buy air tickets from Shanghai to Los Angeles and Los Angeles to Phoenix City. I went to the People's Bank of China to exchange the limited amount of 50 US dollars, then said goodbye to my relatives, flew across the Pacific, and went to a completely unfamiliar country.

816541e54e0c652c3f9d098124d521e51528895c.sourceText: 到了凰凤城机场，总算打电话联繫上我的导师。他让我在机场等一下，先让他的一个学生接我到一处健身房，他再接我到他家过夜。我在上海登机时穿了一件当时流行 的风衣。我告诉我的导师，我的特徵是穿了一件雨衣。不久他的一位女学生果然很容易在候机室找到我，并说凰凤城很少下雨，没有人穿雨衣的，所以一下子就找到 你了。
816541e54e0c652c3f9d098124d521e51528895c.translatedText: After arriving at Huangfengcheng Airport, I finally called my instructor. He asked me to wait at the airport and let one of his students take me to a gym, and then he would take me to his house for the night. When I boarded the plane in Shanghai, I wore a windbreaker, which was popular at the time. I told my mentor that I was distinguished by wearing a raincoat. Soon one of his female students found me easily in the waiting room and said that it rarely rains in Huangfeng City and no one wears a raincoat, so she found you right away.

cd45ffeab25f47fe74081509bcdb910ce93ce12f.sourceText: 当晚我在导师家过夜。他很风趣，喜欢说笑话。我记得他说过你们中国话很难学，特别是那声调，要是不当心把「妈」叫作「马」，麻烦可大了。他还说，「今后你回中国要是当了教育部长，不要忘记邀请我访华呀。」
cd45ffeab25f47fe74081509bcdb910ce93ce12f.translatedText: I spent the night at my tutor’s house that night. He is very funny and likes to tell jokes. I remember he said that your Chinese language is difficult to learn, especially the tones. If you accidentally call "Mom" "Ma", you will be in big trouble. He also said, "If you go back to China and become the Minister of Education, don't forget to invite me to visit China."

39968009a822a61700ee847ad8d6e735de5c9335.sourceText: 第二天他把我送到很多中国学生住的公寓，有四个好心人收留了我。那是一间中间一厅、两边两卧房的公寓，月租450美元，水、电、煤气全包。每间卧房住两名留 学生，我住中间客厅，睡沙发，每月摊50美元，他们四人每人摊100美元。并说他们已将当月房租缴了，等我有钱再补缴，不着急。这当然很合理，但我不吃不 喝一个月下来，50美元正好用光。太太替我借来以备急用的400美元，缝在衬裤口袋裡，绝对不能用。
39968009a822a61700ee847ad8d6e735de5c9335.translatedText: The next day he sent me to an apartment where many Chinese students lived, and four kind people took me in. It was an apartment with one living room in the middle and two bedrooms on both sides. The monthly rent was US$450, and water, electricity, and gas were all included. There are two international students living in each bedroom. I live in the middle living room and sleep on the sofa. I pay US$50 per month, and each of the four of them pays US$100. They also said that they had already paid the rent for that month and would pay it back when I had money, so there was no rush. This is certainly reasonable, but after a month of not eating or drinking, I used up all my $50. The $400 my wife borrowed for me for emergencies was sewn into my pants pocket and must not be used.

54eeabf4cd4515d8d16f1046e3527cc2f2375eaf.sourceText: 正在一筹莫展之际，我想到那封介绍信。 按照理克里斯的教导，我拨通了凰凤城第一神召会的电话，向接电话的小姐略作自我介绍，那位小姐问了我的电话号码，说一会儿给你回电。果然她给我回电，给了 我他们教会长老、亚利桑那州立大学教授德温‧罗立尔办公室的电话，并说他能帮助你。挂上电话后我马上给罗立尔教授打电话，他很热情，约我第二天上午去他办 公室见面，还详细说了哪幢大楼、几号门等。
54eeabf4cd4515d8d16f1046e3527cc2f2375eaf.translatedText: When I was at a loss, I thought of that letter of introduction. Following Rickles' teachings, I dialed the number of the First Assembly of God in Huangfeng City and briefly introduced myself to the lady who answered the phone. The lady asked for my phone number and said she would call you back later. Sure enough, she called me back and gave me the phone number of the office of Devin Lolier, the elder of their church and a professor at Arizona State University, and said he could help you. After hanging up the phone, I immediately called Professor Rollier. He was very enthusiastic and asked me to meet in his office the next morning. He also told me in detail which building, door number, etc.

7654f08aef43e17821a93c7afebd5d684b38c43b.sourceText: 我在罗立尔博士办公室见到他。他那时才五十多岁，身材魁梧，英俊神气；脸色红润，早生华髮。我先呈上克里斯写的私人介绍信，他看了一遍还给我，说他是基督徒，没有介绍信也会帮助人。
7654f08aef43e17821a93c7afebd5d684b38c43b.translatedText: I met Dr. Rollier in his office. He was only in his fifties at that time, tall and handsome, with a ruddy complexion and long hair. I first presented a personal letter of introduction written by Chris, and he read it over and returned it to me, saying that he was a Christian and could help people without a letter of introduction.

bde74beaa1b8d61c4c4976bc8d20eb892ce67cd2.sourceText: 他说他住在学校附近，仅一英里半远，没有汽车骑自行车也行。他家有一间空房间，如果我不嫌髒可以搬去住，像自己家裡一样，不收房租。他随手给太太打了一个电 话，说又有一位中国人要住到我们家来了。电话那头不但完全同意，而且热情欢迎。说好星期六上午他开车来接我，还给了我他家的电话号码。那天是星期三。
bde74beaa1b8d61c4c4976bc8d20eb892ce67cd2.translatedText: He said he lived near the school, only a mile and a half away, and could ride a bicycle without a car. There is an empty room in his house. If I don't mind it being dirty, I can move into it, just like my own house, without charging rent. He casually called his wife and said that another Chinese was coming to live in our house. The person on the other end of the phone not only fully agreed, but also welcomed me warmly. We agreed that he would drive to pick me up on Saturday morning and gave me his home phone number. That day was Wednesday.

dba7d7c5f93f907b1e839215a25bd67e462da435.sourceText: 罗立尔太太当过护士，当时住在一位非常有钱的老太太家裡，日夜照顾这位九十多岁的老太太。
dba7d7c5f93f907b1e839215a25bd67e462da435.translatedText: > Mrs. Rollier worked as a nurse and lived in the home of a very wealthy old lady, taking care of the ninety-year-old lady day and night.

2dd47ea24655156d7490c09d8bb8b53abc45b01a.sourceText: 我向室友说明我要搬到一位美国教授家去住了，他们为我高兴，表示理解。星期六上午罗立尔博士开了他那辆凯迪拉克汽车接我过去。我在他家住了五个月，那是我一生中一段难以忘怀的日子。
2dd47ea24655156d7490c09d8bb8b53abc45b01a.translatedText: I explained to my roommates that I was moving to live with an American professor. They were happy for me and expressed their understanding. Dr. Rollier picked me up in his Cadillac on Saturday morning. I lived in his house for five months, which was an unforgettable time in my life.

f6931bcc9b4c773bda76c6298218e51bc29336d9.sourceText: 他把我带到安排我住的房间，恐怕不够乾淨，他居然拿了溼毛巾跪下来爬到床底下擦地板！一个美国博士、大学教授，这样没有架子，我万万没有想到。看看挂衣壁橱裡衣架不多，他拿来不少衣架。他还告诉我，在我之前住在这间房间裡的中国访问学者，现在已是西安交通大学副校长了。
f6931bcc9b4c773bda76c6298218e51bc29336d9.translatedText: He took me to the room where I was staying. I was afraid it was not clean enough. He actually took a wet towel and knelt down and crawled under the bed to wipe the floor! I never expected that an American doctor and university professor would have such no airs. Seeing that there weren't many hangers in the closet, he brought a lot of hangers. He also told me that the Chinese visiting scholar who lived in this room before me is now the vice president of Xi'an Jiaotong University.

545238d07d0352b892761528ee58e455044cff56.sourceText: 罗立尔博士说，我就叫他名字Dwayne好了，而他倒很客气地称呼我 Mr.Tang。然后他把我介绍给他的家庭成员。
545238d07d0352b892761528ee58e455044cff56.translatedText: Dr. Rollier said that I would just call him Dwayne, and he called me Mr. Tang very politely. Then he introduced me to his family members.

9ac63ff4f2f3d4b4403913186c45dd48ab1b6248.sourceText: 晚上他主动要我给国内家裡打一个电话，他先替我查好国家代号，再问好城市代号。那时打中国的国际长途很贵，他从未提过电话费。
9ac63ff4f2f3d4b4403913186c45dd48ab1b6248.translatedText: In the evening he took the initiative to ask me to call my home in China. He first checked the country code for me and then asked me about the city code. At that time, international long distance calls to China were very expensive, and he never mentioned the phone bill.

760772295f092b540258b8a375de5ae65490cb83.sourceText: 星期日他把我带到凰凤城第一神召会做礼拜，给我介绍了好多朋友。晚上，他和太太请我到一家很高雅的港式中国餐厅用晚餐。
760772295f092b540258b8a375de5ae65490cb83.translatedText: On Sunday he took me to the First Assembly of God in Huangfeng City to worship and introduced me to many friends. In the evening, he and his wife invited me to have dinner at a very elegant Hong Kong-style Chinese restaurant.

8b35ed4b360dbf632b43548ea639dd0fe4242a09.sourceText: 罗立尔太太知道我手头拮据，让我去替那位老太太採橘子，时薪5美元。我做了八小时，挣到40美元，付清住公寓那些天数的租金，还有结馀。
8b35ed4b360dbf632b43548ea639dd0fe4242a09.translatedText: Mrs. Rollier knew that I was short of money, so she asked me to pick oranges for the old lady, earning $5 an hour. I worked eight hours, earned $40, paid off the rent for the days I lived in the apartment, and still had a balance left.

6e4cd7ae9a1d4ff62a9f7eee23ac9b70c9d9fd75.sourceText: 罗立尔博士是一个十分虔诚的基督徒，爱主耶稣，也爱世人。他在凰凤城第一神召会长老会当执事20年，把服务教会作为人生一大乐事。我看到他还在唱诗班唱诗。圣诞节在台上搭了架子，唱诗班人员站上去，用人组成一棵有几层楼高的巨大圣诞树，他也在其中。
6e4cd7ae9a1d4ff62a9f7eee23ac9b70c9d9fd75.translatedText: Dr. Rollier is a very devout Christian who loves the Lord Jesus and loves the world. He has been a deacon at the First Assembly of God Presbyterian Church in Huangfeng City for 20 years and regards serving the church as a great joy in his life. I saw him singing in the choir. On Christmas Day, a structure was set up on the stage, and the choir members stood on it and used people to form a huge Christmas tree several stories high, and he was among them.

36198be25f882ef82c293e53030c99ff4983c848.sourceText: 他关爱弱势群体，把许多需要帮助的人，如寡妇、孤儿、外国人和急待呵护的婴儿等接到家裡，让他们住，供他们吃，照顾他们，爱护他们，尽量使他们过得舒舒服服。他和他那也是基督徒的太太帕蒂（Patty），把满腔热血倾注在渴望怜爱的人们的心裡。
36198be25f882ef82c293e53030c99ff4983c848.translatedText: He cared for the disadvantaged and took many people in need, such as widows, orphans, foreigners and babies in urgent need of care, into his home, letting them live, feeding them, taking care of them, loving them, and trying to make them live as comfortably as possible. He and his wife, Patty, who was also a Christian, poured their hearts into the hearts of people who longed for love.

0c27e1b15fbefcb8e8565bc8868ed1b154d75b9f.sourceText: 我曾在他家遇到两位室友，一位是来美国看望男友的金髮碧眼德国女郎，另一位是来美国读护理的奈及利亚黑人姑娘。她们或借宿数天，或暂住数月。我曾听罗立尔博士亲口告诉过我：他有一次教一位来自巴基斯坦的留学生开车，这位留学生把汽车开翻到河裡去了，他也毫无怨言。
0c27e1b15fbefcb8e8565bc8868ed1b154d75b9f.translatedText: I once met two roommates at his house. One was a blond German girl who came to the United States to visit her boyfriend, and the other was a black Nigerian girl who came to the United States to study nursing. They may stay for a few days or stay temporarily for several months. I once heard Dr. Rollier tell me personally: He once taught an international student from Pakistan to drive, and the international student overturned the car into a river, and he had no complaints.

4314a794d5c8b2b54b72287b54eae161cc08bde3.sourceText: 罗立尔太太多年来不怕麻烦，不辞劳苦，收集朋友家准备处理的多馀衣服、鞋子、家俱、炊具、餐具、玩具、儿童用品等等，储放在家裡，再分送给需要的人。
4314a794d5c8b2b54b72287b54eae161cc08bde3.translatedText: Over the years, Mrs. Rollier has not been afraid of trouble and worked tirelessly to collect excess clothes, shoes, furniture, cooking utensils, tableware, toys, children's supplies, etc. that were prepared to be disposed of by friends' homes, store them at home, and then distribute them to those in need.

df3480aa2e8600f46cc07b79984b4a3f71717471.sourceText: 罗立尔夫妇结褵43年，未曾生育。夫妇俩终生恩爱，从未有过龃龉。他们先领养一名白人女孩 Dede当女儿，后又领养一名非洲裔男孩 Matthew作儿子。他对这个儿子特别关心，当时儿子正值青春期，周末两人常常一同出去吃饭，促膝谈心，防范Matthew交上不良朋友或染上吸毒恶 习。现在 Dede有四个孩子，Matthew有一个孩子，可谓子孙满堂。
df3480aa2e8600f46cc07b79984b4a3f71717471.translatedText: The Loliers have been married for 43 years and have never given birth. The couple remained in love throughout their lives and never had any disagreements. They first adopted a white girl, Dede, as their daughter, and then adopted an African-American boy, Matthew, as their son. He was particularly concerned about his son, who was in adolescence at the time. The two of them often went out to eat together on weekends and talked to each other to prevent Matthew from making bad friends or getting into drug habits. Now Dede has four children, Matthew has one child, and they are full of descendants.

6989e993f6dcbcfc43f9a4438545e085a01c1d68.sourceText: 1979年有一批越南难民来美国，教会号召有条件的家庭接纳他 们，帮助他们学英语、熟悉美国社会，教他们如何生活、就业，使他们逐渐走上自立之路。罗立尔夫妇去机场接来一位越南华裔青年Ke。Ke因为长期饥饿，身体 十分虚弱，不能吃乾食。罗立尔太太煮了粥一口一口喂他，让他慢慢恢复体力。罗立尔教他开车，帮他找到工作。不久罗立尔夫妇还担保Ke那美丽的越华溷血女朋 友Sy从澳大利亚来美国。他们俩在罗立尔家团聚、结婚、生儿育女，罗立尔太太一手操办。Ke和Sy早已买了汽车、房子，还买了游艇；不久前换了新的大房 子，实现了美国梦。他们的三个子女Tony,Suzi和Sandra都上了大学。Ke和Sy与罗立尔一家的恩缘故事，在越南人中传为美谈。
6989e993f6dcbcfc43f9a4438545e085a01c1d68.translatedText: In 1979, a group of Vietnamese refugees came to the United States. The church called on qualified families to accept them, help them learn English, become familiar with American society, and teach them how to live and find jobs, so that they could gradually embark on the road to independence. The Luo Lier couple went to the airport to pick up Ke, a Vietnamese and Chinese young man. But due to long-term hunger, he was very weak and could not eat dry food. Mrs. Rollier cooked porridge and fed him bite by bite, allowing him to slowly regain his strength. Rollier taught him how to drive and helped him find a job. Soon the Loliers also guaranteed that Ke's beautiful girlfriend Sy, who was of Vietnamese and Chinese blood, would come to the United States from Australia. The two of them reunited, got married, and had children at the Rollier house, and Mrs. Rollier took care of it. Ke and Sy have already bought a car, a house, and a yacht; they recently bought a new big house, realizing the American dream. Their three children, Tony, Suzi and Sandra, are all in college. The story of Ke and Sy's relationship with the Lolier family is a favorite among Vietnamese.

4a4be54fbc99f5f9fd401764e51e4df229c80aca.sourceText: 都是白人的罗立尔夫妇对人们的爱，不仅超越种族、超越肤色、超越国籍，而且还超越语言隔阂、生活习俗、文化差异、政治背景和宗教信仰。
4a4be54fbc99f5f9fd401764e51e4df229c80aca.translatedText: The love of the Loliers, both white, for people not only transcends race, skin color, and nationality, but also transcends language barriers, living customs, cultural differences, political backgrounds and religious beliefs.

3091a0715a3e4776b5da19474d5938e150b4ffef.sourceText: 两岸三地的原留美学生，多次盛情邀请罗立尔博士去中国旅游，有一次终于成行。罗立尔夫妇到了香港后，不巧发生中美撞机事件。作为土生土长的美国人，又是基督 徒，加上几十年来不断读到、听到在中国大陆的基督徒惨遭迫害的大量事例，他们感到害怕，决定放弃进入中国大陆，实为一件憾事。
3091a0715a3e4776b5da19474d5938e150b4ffef.translatedText: Former students studying in the United States from both sides of the Taiwan Strait and three places have warmly invited Dr. Lolier to travel to China many times, and once he finally made the trip. After the Loliers arrived in Hong Kong, a plane collision between China and the United States happened. As native Americans and Christians, and having read and heard numerous cases of persecution of Christians in mainland China for decades, they felt frightened and decided to give up entering mainland China. It was a pity.

ee0c030150d8410917d8e6cd10516cb4ce27aaec.sourceText: 假如你有机会 去亚利桑那州立大学所在的大学城坦佩（Tempe）罗立尔家作客，你将看到客厅裡有华人朋友赠送的数不清的礼品、纪念品、工艺品。牆上挂着超大型折扇，金 色的扇面上有的画着孔雀开屏，有的画着百鸟朝凤。旁边挂着竹刻对联，还有各色各样的中国结。玻璃柜裡和桌子陈列着文房四宝、筷子、算盘、中国画、景泰蓝、 纸扇、团扇、折扇、檀香扇、竹器、漆器、滕器、瓷器，丝绸被面，绣衣娃娃，还有中国印章、印泥等等。琳琅满目，叹为观止，彰显主人一家浓浓的中国情结。
ee0c030150d8410917d8e6cd10516cb4ce27aaec.translatedText: If you have the opportunity to visit the Rollier family in Tempe, the university town where Arizona State University is located, you will see countless gifts, souvenirs, and handicrafts from Chinese friends in the living room. Extra-large folding fans hang on the wall. Some of the golden fans are painted with peacocks in full bloom, while others are painted with hundreds of birds approaching the phoenix. Hanging next to it are bamboo-carved couplets and various Chinese knots. The four treasures of the study, chopsticks, abacus, Chinese paintings, cloisonne, paper fans, round fans, folding fans, sandalwood fans, bamboo ware, lacquer ware, Teng ware, porcelain, silk quilts, embroidered dolls, Chinese seals, ink pads, etc. are displayed in glass cabinets and tables. The dazzling array of items is breathtaking, highlighting the owner’s family’s strong Chinese sentiment.

d1b3ebc57fd97108e9371a3d276214c6d57fce05.sourceText: 警员后来调查的结果是，这个家庭的五名成员轮番对小女孩虐待，因而警方拘捕了这五人。周二，警方又用同样理由逮捕了迪尔家庭的第六人，大卫迪尔，小女孩的父亲。
d1b3ebc57fd97108e9371a3d276214c6d57fce05.translatedText: The police later investigated and found that five members of the family took turns abusing the little girl, so the police arrested the five people. On Tuesday, police arrested a sixth member of the Diehl family, David Diehl, the girl's father, for the same reason.

edc0c4841ff616c9ec8208d1874559ab153757f3.sourceText: 警方说，差点被他逃走了。

27d1f145b391d9cc69936018b4a9a6b69b71c4c8.sourceText: (周桦报道 台湾联合日报网 )由国际新移民华人作家笔会(The Chinese Immigration Writers Association)、国际东西方研究学会文学院、华人网络电视台联合主办，文心社、《世界华人周刊》、《新华人报》、魅力Houston网站等联合协办，以”回归自然”为主题，畅谈”不一样的天空”的国际新移民华人作家北美笔会于2013年5月24至27日国殇日的长週末，在休士顿东北离尘隔嚣的幽静乡间庄园隆重举行。
27d1f145b391d9cc69936018b4a9a6b69b71c4c8.translatedText: (reported by Zhou Hua, Taiwan United Daily News), sponsored by the International New Immigrant Chinese Writers PEN Association (The Chinese Immigration Writers) Association), the School of Liberal Arts of the International Association for Eastern and Western Studies, and Chinese Network Television, co-organized by Wenxinshe, "World Chinese Weekly", "New Chinese News", Charming Houston website, etc., with the theme of "Return to Nature", the International New Immigrant Chinese Writers talked about "Different Sky" at the North American PEN Association During the Memorial Day long weekend from May 24th to 27th, 2013, it was held grandly in a quiet country manor in the northeast of Houston.

bd8d5b0f1f05680a5fa0a3c59cd840202f4ddb5c.sourceText: 此届文学笔会的共同主席为陈瑞琳和少君（凤凰城），副主席为方国祥（方氏庄园主），洛冰（Galaxy公司代 表）。应邀参会的北美代表有：诗会评委非马先生（海外着名诗人、画家）； 美国华裔英文畅销书小说家闵安琪； 国际新移民华人作家笔会创会会长，早期网络文学开创者少君； 着名评论家、作家陈瑞琳； 加拿大资深媒体人、电视台新闻製作人、海外着名专栏作家丁果； 耶鲁大学着名学者、作家康正果； 小说家、诗人施玮； 小说家、美华文协现任会长沙石； 加拿大诗人川沙； 小说家芜华； 小说家张惠雯； 资深记者、报告文学作家申小雨； 陝西电视台着名导演张晓春； 西安电影製片厂编剧马洁； 西北大学现代文学研究室主任周燕芬教授； 影视製片人张世军； 中国江苏社科院《世界华文文学论坛》编辑李良。 大会秘书组成员，包括秘书长：周桦（资深记者、媒体人），副秘书长：赵美萍（《知音》杂志海外编辑），生活秘书：陈瑞红（网络作家）。
bd8d5b0f1f05680a5fa0a3c59cd840202f4ddb5c.translatedText: The co-chairmen of this literary pen were Chen Ruilin and Shaojun (Phoenix City), and the vice-chairmen were Fang Guoxiang (owner of Fang Manor) and Luo Bing (Galaxy company representative). Table). The North American representatives invited to participate in the meeting include: Mr. Fei Ma, a well-known overseas poet and painter, who is a judge of the Poetry Society; Min Anqi, a Chinese-American best-selling novelist in English; Shao Jun, the founding president of the International New Immigrant Chinese Writers PEN Association and the founder of early online literature; Chen Ruilin, a famous critic and writer; Ding Guo, a senior Canadian media person, TV news producer, and a famous overseas columnist; Kang Zhengguo, a famous scholar and writer at Yale University; Novelist and poet Shi Wei; Novelist and current president of the American Chinese Literary and Art Association Sha Shi; Canadian poet Chuan Sha; novelist Wu Hua; novelist Zhang Huiwen; senior journalist and reportage writer Shen Xiaoyu; famous director of Shaanxi TV station Zhang Xiaochun; screenwriter Ma Jie of Xi'an Film Studio; Professor Zhou Yanfen, director of the Modern Literature Research Institute of Northwestern University; film and television producer Zhang Shijun; editor of "World Chinese Literature Forum" of Jiangsu Academy of Social Sciences, Li Liang. Members of the secretarial team of the conference include Secretary-General: Zhou Hua (senior journalist and media person), Deputy Secretary-General: Zhao Meiping (overseas editor of "Zhiyin" magazine), Life Secretary: Chen Ruihong (Internet writer)

86d5206781e4ac43d562a854f78dbeb0e8b365b5.sourceText: 笔会共同主席作家陈瑞琳(左)和笔会创会会长，早期网络文学开创者少君，手持市长颁发的5月25日为”新移民作家日”文告合影
86d5206781e4ac43d562a854f78dbeb0e8b365b5.translatedText: Writer Chen Ruilin (left), co-chairman of PEN. Shaojun, the founding president of PEN and the founder of early online literature, took a group photo holding a proclamation issued by the mayor for May 25th as "New Immigrant Writers Day"

fe4803743911f752cea5144d08768d1ff35d2db1.sourceText: 5月25日上午在庄园临湖的长廊裡，举行了笔会开幕式：主席宣佈休士顿市长颁发的5月25日为”新移民作家日”，并宣读来自中国世界华文文学学会、北美作家协会、文心社及美华文协等组织的贺信；同时代表【国际东西方研究学会文学院】为作家们颁发研究员聘书，接着作家们向赞助商举行赠书仪式。
fe4803743911f752cea5144d08768d1ff35d2db1.translatedText: On the morning of May 25th, the opening ceremony of PEN was held in the promenade of the manor facing the lake: the chairman announced his retirement Mayor Dayton proclaimed May 25th as "New Immigrant Writers Day", and read out congratulatory letters from the World Chinese Literature Society of China, the North American Writers Association, Wenxin Society, and the American Chinese Writers Association; at the same time, on behalf of the [International Association for Eastern and Western Studies School of Literature], the writers were awarded researcher appointment letters, and then the writers A book donation ceremony was held to the sponsors

588eec2a5ff848c593fc67ffc581266bae325560.sourceText: 在庄园临湖的水榭长廊裡，来自各方的知名作家代表们，齐聚一堂，参加了笔会开幕式
588eec2a5ff848c593fc67ffc581266bae325560.translatedText: In the waterside corridor of the manor near the lake, representatives of well-known writers from all walks of life gathered together to participate in the opening ceremony of the PEN meeting

4e94eccc69669168e1171e6faae0d7406ef41027.sourceText: 于休士顿城中区的生态绿洲 Discover Green 公园，以高楼大厦为背景，作家们合影留念
4e94eccc69669168e1171e6faae0d7406ef41027.translatedText: in the ecological oasis in the middle of Houston. Discover Green Park, with high-rise buildings as the background, writers took photos

f6fa46051dc4d58288078106e547105d671ffafc.sourceText: 5月27日，代表们依依不捨，满载能量而归。本次笔会能召集北美各地的诗人、作家、学者、媒体人以及来自国内的影视专业人员群聚一堂，交流互动，并能让会议圆满成功，归功于共同主席陈瑞琳和少君的辛劳策划，秘书组成员们的协力合作；并得益于方国祥庄园主、Galaxy公司、北美科发影视传媒集团、味全食品公司、张哲瑞律师，以及首都银行、恆丰银行及国泰银行等企业商家朋友在物力和财力上的大力支持。
f6fa46051dc4d58288078106e547105d671ffafc.translatedText: On May 27, the delegates were reluctant to leave and returned full of energy. This PEN Conference can bring together poets, writers, scholars, media people from all over North America, and film and television professionals from China to gather together for exchanges and interactions, and the success of the conference is attributed to co-chairs Chen Ruilin and Shaojun's hard planning, the cooperation of the members of the secretarial team; and the strong material and financial support from the owner of the manor Fang Guoxiang, Galaxy Company, North American Kefa Film and Television Media Group, Weiquan Food Company, lawyer Zhang Zherui, as well as corporate friends such as Metrobank, Hengfeng Bank and Cathay Bank

a0d603a5742d5a2d290c24f4392858be360d2992.sourceText: 缓解压力 海外学子有妙招
a0d603a5742d5a2d290c24f4392858be360d2992.translatedText: Overseas students have tips to relieve stress

a66d4f012614f247c0848b7d2ed5593478e82eec.sourceText: 近日，一篇《博士，你还好吗？》的公号文章对攻读博士学位时的压力进行解读，引发不少学子的共鸣。诚然，不论攻读哪个级别的学位都会有压力，在海外就读的时间成本和经济成本以及中外环境差异等原因，容易使海外学子陷入焦虑状态。
a66d4f012614f247c0848b7d2ed5593478e82eec.translatedText: Recently, an article "Doctor, are you okay? "The public account article explains the pressure when studying for a doctorate, which resonates with many students. It is true that no matter what level of degree you pursue, there will be pressure. The time and economic costs of studying overseas, as well as the differences between Chinese and foreign environments, etc., can easily make overseas students fall into a state of anxiety.

d545957684a05e0eff98de463e603d6a5cfbbf70.sourceText: 分析原因 查找症结
d545957684a05e0eff98de463e603d6a5cfbbf70.translatedText: Analyze the reasons and find the crux

733e1652a6b418a6a56f72a53b1772010e3ddb34.sourceText: 在日本攻读护理学专业的刘柳(化名)最近很是苦恼。在某个证书的考试中，她连续3次英语考试失利，这不仅让她学习英语的热情几近消失，甚至让她对于自己在大龄时选择出国读书的自信产生动摇。”在很短的时间内，翻译3篇专业的论文，这对于我这个”半路”捡拾英语的人来说特别困难。这种挫败感让我彻底没有信心参加这项考试了。而英语，我也是”憎恨”了很久。”刘柳在说到考试挫折时，仍透着郁闷。
733e1652a6b418a6a56f72a53b1772010e3ddb34.translatedText: Liu Liu (pseudonym), who is studying nursing in Japan, has been very distressed recently. In a certain certificate exam, she failed the English exam three times in a row. This not only made her enthusiasm for learning English almost disappear, but also shaken her confidence in choosing to study abroad when she was older. "Translating three professional papers in a short period of time is particularly difficult for me, who picked up English halfway. This frustration made me completely lose confidence in taking this exam. And I have also "hated" English for a long time." Liu Liu was still depressed when talking about the setbacks in the exam.

8bbff8ee184ffb3c7c9981cc000b38899a527b6e.sourceText: 对于海外学子来说，生活压力是学习压力之外压在学子头上的又一座”大山”。”我身边有很多同学是自费来西班牙读书的，面对国外高昂的物价，他们会选择边打工边读书。这种边学习边打工的安排极有可能造成钱也没赚到，学习也没搞好的后果。”现就读于西班牙加泰罗尼亚理工大学的毛彦鑫叹息着说。
8bbff8ee184ffb3c7c9981cc000b38899a527b6e.translatedText: For overseas students, the pressure of life is another "big mountain" that weighs on students besides the pressure of study. "Many of my classmates come to Spain to study at their own expense. Faced with the high prices abroad, they will choose to work and study at the same time. This kind of arrangement of studying and working at the same time is very likely to result in no money being earned and no good study." Mao Yanxin, who is currently studying at the Polytechnic University of Catalonia in Spain, said with a sigh.

b0af2b54658939cfa7292ef6f22547aaebb49ee5.sourceText: 留学海外产生的时间和空间距离让读于英国帝国理工学院的盛鑫很是感慨：”我出国这几年，每次回国都能感觉到父母年龄的增长和身体状况的变化。自己年纪渐长，而父母却在愈发老去，这让我有一种恐慌的感觉。”
b0af2b54658939cfa7292ef6f22547aaebb49ee5.translatedText: The time and space distance caused by studying abroad made Sheng Xin, who studied at Imperial College in the UK, very emotional: "In the past few years, I have been abroad and I can feel the increase in age and changes in physical conditions of my parents every time I return home. I am getting older, but my parents are getting older, which makes me feel panicked."

7497f8cdc8a182403f4b8071ce08d7184e685e41.sourceText: 冷静定位 及时沟通
7497f8cdc8a182403f4b8071ce08d7184e685e41.translatedText: Calm positioning Communicate in a timely manner

26c9028f622957dd88969fa35829ff78e65de41b.sourceText: 其实，缓解压力的方式有很多，除了加入社团、找人倾诉、玩游戏、蒙头大睡或酣畅淋漓地聚餐外，准确定位自我、制定未来规划也很有效。
26c9028f622957dd88969fa35829ff78e65de41b.translatedText: In fact, there are many ways to relieve stress. In addition to joining a club, finding someone to talk to, playing games, sleeping with your head covered, or having a hearty dinner party, it is also very effective to accurately position yourself and formulate future plans.

a05497ef7f29ebba7263ff205b361f86b6d29eb9.sourceText: 毛彦鑫目前在读博士4年级，今年或可能是他读博的最后一年。在就业的蓝图开启之前，毕业论文横在他眼前。”毕业论文的撰写和答辩是一大难题。在外语环境下，整理思路和书写材料都是一种挑战。很多论文题目的完成难度很可能超过了三到四年所能到达的研究水平。所以，很多博士延迟毕业，压力极大。”就博士论文选题，毛彦鑫认为，在决定时要评估好自身的水平，不要野心太大。”一定要聆听自己内心的声音，沉思、梳理、分析会让你头脑清醒，也有利于学习的顺利进行。”
a05497ef7f29ebba7263ff205b361f86b6d29eb9.translatedText: > Mao Yanxin is currently in the fourth year of his Ph.D. study, and this year may be his last year of Ph.D. Before he could start his career plan, his graduation thesis lay before him. "The writing and defense of graduation thesis is a big problem. In a foreign language environment, sorting out ideas and writing materials is a challenge. The difficulty of completing many thesis topics is likely to exceed the research level that can be achieved in three to four years. Therefore, many PhDs delay graduation and are extremely stressed." Regarding doctoral thesis topic selection, Mao Yanxin believes that when making a decision, you must evaluate your own level and not be too ambitious. "You must listen to your inner voice. Meditation, sorting, and analysis will keep your mind clear and conducive to the smooth progress of your studies."

eb76d2b747d84f5117ed2a566ea46be30f739899.sourceText: 古人云：”父母在，不远游，游必有方”。经常沟通、关心父母是盛鑫对待父母的方式。每年固定次数与家人见面也是他盼望的事。”年华老去不可逆转，抓紧当下才是关键。我会把在国外学到的一些健身方法告诉父母，让他们更科学地锻炼身体。”
eb76d2b747d84f5117ed2a566ea46be30f739899.translatedText: The ancients said: "If your parents are around, if you don't travel far away, you will travel well." Frequent communication and caring for parents are how Sheng Xin treats his parents. He also looks forward to seeing his family a few times a year. "Getting older is irreversible, seizing the moment is the key. I will tell my parents some fitness methods I learned abroad to let them exercise more scientifically."

c41c57dbc7ce6f69821e79cb4d2f3f0de0ffcf23.sourceText: 就读于美国得克萨斯州莱斯大学的宋萍，喜欢沉浸在实验室做实验的氛围中来排解学习中的压力。”很多问题都是自己想得太多、做得太少所致，才会产生苦恼和困惑。让自己忙碌起来，让生活充实起来是不错的解压方式。”面对生活和学习压力，宋萍喜欢通过收看国内电视台的综艺节目来排解。”很多困惑其实大部分是因为想家，除了跟父母视频之外，收看国内的电视节目，看一些国内的流行风尚也能给自己如同身在国内的幸福感。”
c41c57dbc7ce6f69821e79cb4d2f3f0de0ffcf23.translatedText: Song Ping, who studies at Rice University in Texas, USA, likes to immerse herself in the atmosphere of laboratory experiments to relieve the stress of study. "Many problems are caused by thinking too much and doing too little, which leads to distress and confusion. Keeping yourself busy and enriching your life is a good way to relieve stress." Faced with the pressure of life and study, Song Ping likes to relieve stress by watching variety shows on domestic TV stations. "Most of the confusion is actually due to homesickness. In addition to video chatting with parents, watching domestic TV programs and watching some domestic fashions can also give yourself a sense of happiness as if you were in China."

13c4ad280776c43faf6f0b7255c865df40e43604.sourceText: 起伏有时 学会从容
13c4ad280776c43faf6f0b7255c865df40e43604.translatedText: There are ups and downs sometimes. Learn to be calm.

d4e0c726ced0562a083eea6c6d1a40621f5d3b58.sourceText: 生活中的不如意不可避免，海外学子要学会从容面对。宋萍将某些”心灵鸡汤”比作是”打鸡血”，猛然一剂下去挺管用，但效果短暂。有时候，可以来一剂猛药，这对调节情绪、积极地生活学习很有效。另外，宋萍建议，学子要有自己的做事主见，不必过度在意别人对自己的印象。”有一颗强大的内心，不管是对海外学子，还是对国内的学生而言，都是很必要的。”
d4e0c726ced0562a083eea6c6d1a40621f5d3b58.translatedText: Dissatisfaction in life is inevitable, and overseas students must learn to face it calmly. Song Ping compared some "chicken soup for the soul" to "injecting chicken blood". A sudden dose is effective, but the effect is short-lived. Sometimes, you can take a strong dose of medicine, which is very effective in regulating your emotions and living and studying actively. In addition, Song Ping suggested that students should have their own opinions on doing things and not be overly concerned about other people's impressions of them. "Having a strong heart is very necessary for both overseas students and domestic students."

aee6038a007cb83d4c7135f84fdc128aef48bf97.sourceText: 毛彦鑫在调侃自己的解压方式时，用了”比惨”二字。”跟一堆博士一起聊聊天，说说自己的惨事，这样既能知道自己的苦恼在别人的眼中是怎样一回事，又能了解到其实别人也遭遇过类似的情况。”比惨”会的末尾，大家再互相打气。那个氛围和作用还是很不错的。”
aee6038a007cb83d4c7135f84fdc128aef48bf97.translatedText: When Mao Yanxin joked about his way of decompressing, he used the word "comparison". "Have a chat with a group of doctors and talk about your own misfortunes, so that you can not only know how your troubles appear in the eyes of others, but also understand that others have actually encountered similar situations. At the end of the "misery comparison" meeting, everyone cheers each other up. The atmosphere and effect are still very good."

80eb9e61e798385c8f049792fd111fbd6805f753.sourceText: 面对回国潮，盛鑫深知归国就业肯定会压力重重。”国内各方面的发展越来越好、越来越快，吸引了越来越多的海外留学人员回国发展，因此，与同龄人之间的竞争压力肯定会越来越大。”但是盛鑫也很自信地表示，他会迎难而上，更加努力地学习，用知识和实干不断完善自己。(张亚楠)
80eb9e61e798385c8f049792fd111fbd6805f753.translatedText: Facing the wave of returning to China, Sheng Xin knows that returning to China for employment will definitely be stressful. "The domestic development in all aspects is getting better and faster, attracting more and more overseas students to return to China for development. Therefore, the pressure of competition with peers will definitely become greater and greater." However, Sheng Xin also confidently said that he will face the difficulties, study harder, and constantly improve himself with knowledge and hard work. (Zhang Yanan)
