6fb192c9496307d250efe253ac3b7018cc32c0fb.sourceText: 全美华人科学家工程师专业人士协会凤凰城分会（ACSE 科工专）韩祀瑾报 道： 11/4/2017 继科工专于今年四月成功举办【敦煌与丝路】讲座后，应社区要 求，我们于十一月四日在亚利桑那州立大学举办了第二期相应有关论坛【丝绸之路古今谈：从张骞出使到一带一路】。主讲人陈怀宇教授，先后于北师大、北大、普林斯顿大学获得学士、硕士和博士学位，目前在亚利桑那州立 大学历史哲学宗教学院与国际语言文化学院主讲佛教与中国宗教。他主要研 究中国文化史与丝绸之路上的各种宗教和古历史古文化，出版多部中英文书籍和论文，是美国、中国大陆、台湾和新加坡的多种期刊和专著的编委。
6fb192c9496307d250efe253ac3b7018cc32c0fb.translatedText: Phoenix Branch of the American Association of Chinese Scientists and Engineers (ACSE) reported by Han Sijin: 11/4/2017 Following the successful lecture "Dunhuang and the Silk Road" held by the College of Science and Technology in April this year, at the request of the community, we held the second corresponding forum "Talk about the Silk Road in Ancient and Modern Times: From Zhang Qian's Mission to the Belt and Road Initiative" on November 4 at Arizona State University. The speaker, Professor Chen Huaiyu, received his bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees from Beijing Normal University, Peking University and Princeton University. He currently lectures on Buddhism and Chinese religion in the School of History, Philosophy and Religion and the School of International Languages ​​and Culture at Arizona State University. He mainly studies Chinese cultural history and various religions and ancient history and ancient cultures on the Silk Road. He has published many books and papers in Chinese and English. He is an editorial board member of various journals and monographs in the United States, Mainland China, Taiwan and Singapore.

b7d2f6f2ca9949369394472b6455a32f685b986c.sourceText: 自从中国近年提出”一带一路”，古老的陆上丝绸之路和海上丝绸之路添加了现代的因数，成为当代世界的新经济和政治热点。陈教授以历史、地理、 考古学、人类学、民族学、政治、宗教等多角度、全方面展示了丝绸之路的 由来，迁移和进化。在一个半小时的讲座中，陈教授展示了上百张图片，精准讲解了许多名词和事件，澄清了许多概念，并分享了他独到的研究心得和 个人观点。四十余各界人士兴趣盎然地聆听了讲座，包括一位完全不懂中文的老者，感谢一位志愿者实时口译了讲座的精彩要点。
b7d2f6f2ca9949369394472b6455a32f685b986c.translatedText: Since China proposed the “One Belt, One Road” initiative in recent years, the ancient land Silk Road and Maritime Silk Road have added modern factors and become new economic and political hot spots in the contemporary world. Professor Chen demonstrated the origin, migration and evolution of the Silk Road from multiple perspectives such as history, geography, archaeology, anthropology, ethnology, politics, religion, etc. In the one-and-a-half-hour lecture, Professor Chen showed hundreds of pictures, accurately explained many terms and events, clarified many concepts, and shared his unique research experiences and personal opinions. More than 40 people from all walks of life listened to the lecture with great interest, including an old man who did not understand Chinese at all. Thanks to a volunteer who interpreted the highlights of the lecture in real time.

60828200f2b020ab9df9651cd1f248cdce077db2.sourceText: 最后听众和陈教授的问答使讲座达到了第二次高潮。原定半小时的答问时间延长到了一个多小时。结束后多人仍围着陈教授交流，迟迟不愿离去。有听 众提问了最近的凤凰城热点，保护文化中心拆除的问题，听众和主讲人阐述和交流了各自的观点和看法。
60828200f2b020ab9df9651cd1f248cdce077db2.translatedText: The final Q&A between the audience and Professor Chen brought the lecture to its second climax. The originally scheduled half-hour question and answer time extended to more than an hour. After the lecture, many people were still gathering around Professor Chen to communicate and were reluctant to leave. An audience member asked about the recent hot spot in Phoenix, the issue of protecting the demolition of the Cultural Center. The audience and the speaker elaborated and exchanged their respective views and opinions.

74787de1ad425ad20cad6d7ffb922e310fd5886f.sourceText: 这次由旅美科工专协会凤凰城分会，亚利桑那州中国青年商会，亚利桑那州华人华侨总会，亚利桑那州高科技协会及亚利桑那州中国学生学者联谊会共同主办的讲座是科学工程及文化系列讲座（SEC 论坛）的系列讲座之一。会务组感谢李江（科工专会长），韩祀瑾（科工专干事），苏日启（科工专干事），郝海英等义工，高薇佳（亚省中国青年商会会长），李赫（ASU 中国 学生学者联谊会主席），胡珍（科工专副会长），袁亚华（华总会长），杨文田（华总理事长），以及为本次活动成行而付出宝贵时间和精力的所有侨界朋友。 会后，部分与会人员与陈教授合影留念。
74787de1ad425ad20cad6d7ffb922e310fd5886f.translatedText: This lecture, co-sponsored by the Phoenix Chapter of the Association of Science and Technology Professionals in the United States, the Arizona Chinese Youth Chamber of Commerce, the Arizona Overseas Chinese Association, the Arizona High-Tech Association and the Arizona Chinese Students and Scholars Association, is one of a series of lectures in the Science, Engineering and Culture Lecture Series (SEC Forum). The conference team would like to thank Li Jiang (President of the Science and Engineering Institute), Han Sijin (Science and Engineering Director), Su Riqi (Science and Engineering Director), Hao Haiying and other volunteers, Gao Weijia (President of the China Youth Chamber of Commerce in Alberta), Li He (ASU China President of the Students and Scholars Association), Hu Zhen (Vice President of the Science and Engineering College), Yuan Yahua (President of Hua), Yang Wentian (Chairman of Hua), and all overseas Chinese friends who have devoted their precious time and energy to making this event possible. After the meeting, some participants took photos with Professor Chen.

0ccbf7ce7dcd5343f399a3876c777c8e637eb372.sourceText: 自选：扣安全带还是收罚单 （亚省时报） 一名本地青少年驾车与重型卡车相撞，万幸因扣了安全带而救了小命。虽然躺在医院昏迷了三个月，却活过来。现在他帮助交警展开” Click It or Ticket ”行动，提醒人们扣安全带，注意交通安全。 最近，交通警察在凤凰城地区留意驾车不扣安全带的司机，重点在提醒，也会发出罚单。在亚利桑那州，不扣安全带是二等罪。 ”我肯定死翘翘了，如果没有扣安全带，”19岁的科恩说。”虽然老套但实用地说一句：为了您和他人的安全，请在开车时扣好安全带。”
0ccbf7ce7dcd5343f399a3876c777c8e637eb372.translatedText: Choose: Buckle up or get a ticket (Alberta Times) A ​​local teenager's car collided with a heavy truck. Fortunately, he buckled down and saved his life. Although he lay in a coma in the hospital for three months, he survived. Now he helps the traffic police launch the "Click It or Ticket" operation to remind people to buckle their seat belts and pay attention to traffic safety. Recently, traffic police have been paying attention to drivers who do not buckle their seat belts in the Phoenix area. They focus on reminding and issuing fines. In Arizona, failure to buckle a seat belt is a second-degree crime. "I would have died if I hadn't buckled up," said 19-year-old Cohen. "It's a cliché but a practical thing to say: For your safety and the safety of others, buckle up when driving."

0235323e30410f2d3e7784b002fd868b70effcf3.sourceText: 心水： 多妻主义者 于原其望人的神色很专注，仿佛在捧读难懂的易经，他观望的过程享受着滋润心肺的喜悦。 自然是指对方是异性，同性在眼中像浮云，不留半分色彩。 他天生是崇尚多妻主义者，不幸的是早年娶亲，迎回的竟是妒妇，患上”气管炎”妻管严之绝症，令他痛不欲生。 在被妒妻严治下，他的主张多妻理论成为空谈。 十多年来的婚姻生活止水无波，给人的印像是伉俪情深、恩爱无比。 夫妻俩只是形影不离，出双入对，尤其是他们挂在脸上的笑姿，充满了甜蜜幸福。 太太温柔体贴，身材婀娜诱人，对​​丈夫要求百依百顺；唯一坚持的就是不能让他单独一人在外，全天候的随侍在侧，成为幸福的最佳保障。 更妙的是，她为满足男人的好奇心，购买了中外几十种不同类别的三级片，让丈夫大饱眼福。 后来也身体力行，扮演主角各种挑战技术，令丈夫性趣高涨。 真正做到了出得厅堂，能入厨房，上得大床，贤妻良母淫娃三种角色均溶于一身。 老于有妻如此贤慧，真是几生修到。 可是，多妻主义的思想并没有因此泯灭，妒妻如何出尽浑身解数，始终是相同一个肉体；但无法有行动自由，艳遇也只能变成梦想了。 他在过度的压抑后竟陷入了一埸的恋情里。 周末麻将台前、来围城的都是妻的闺友；在麻将声里递烟捧茶，首先发现阿湄水汪汪的眼睛同他注视。 他仿佛触电，她如蝉翼的薄衫，美妙曲线隐隐现现，眉目传情在刹那中展开。 他找 到沙发上一个最佳视角位置饱餐秀色，倾刻间把盈溢的爱情泼向阿湄，渐入佳境时用眼色开始为她宽衣解带，阿湄赤身裸体横在他眼前任由他 进攻、、、、、、 那天，阿湄缺席，阿娇替代，于原其的眼睛一如往常，在阿娇玲珑的玉体上驰骋。 阿娇完全没想到，她饱满的乳房正被「吸吮」？ 她起立到浴室，身上宛若褪尽衣裳，任由那对痴痴的眼光抚摸。 于原其不断改换恋爱对象，只要姿色娇美，不论已婚未婚，来到家里和太太搓麻将的，通通变成他的情人。 秀色可餐，他沉醉在群芳各类燕瘦环肥的肉体里，最令他兴奋的是搂抱妒妻时；关闭电源，每次角色转换，不是阿湄就是阿红或者阿雪。 他满意于那种不同女人的剌激，道高一尺魔高一丈，妒妻本领再大，竟也斗不过一位『「多妻主义」者的决心。 被于原其注目的女士，看不出那眼光有淫邪的东西，只蕴含脉脉纯情，他用捧读女人的肉体去医治「气管炎」、、、、、、、、、、、、、 、。

He enjoyed the joy of nourishing his heart and lungs while watching. Naturally, it means that the other person is of the opposite sex, and the same sex is like a floating cloud in the eyes, leaving no color at all. He was born to be a polygamist. Unfortunately, when he got married early, he got a jealous wife. He suffered from "tracheitis", a terminal disease of strict wife control, which made him miserable. 8108160a4568a7d86adc1a4cec32a08ff949b732.sourceText: 汪静玉，笔名王一冰，上世纪七十年代中期出生，14岁开始发表作品，17岁独自闯荡大江南北，18岁保送武汉大学中文系，2001年就读于武汉大学新闻学院研究生班。曾在《北京文学》、《青年文学》、《作家》、《芙蓉》等杂志上发表中短篇小说。作品多次被选刊转载和选入选本并多次获奖。著有诗集《青春的馈赠》、小说集《爱是绿叶》、《邂逅天堂的后窗》，出版长篇小说《天堂眼》、《夏天里最后一朵玫瑰》等9本书，其中《天堂眼》在全国引起较大的反响。2009年赴美。
8108160a4568a7d86adc1a4cec32a08ff949b732.translatedText: Wang Jingyu, whose pen name is Wang Yibing, was born in the mid-1970s. She began publishing works at the age of 14. At the age of 17, she traveled across the country alone. At the age of 18, she was recommended to the Chinese Department of Wuhan University. In 2001, she studied in the graduate class of the School of Journalism of Wuhan University. He has published short stories and short stories in magazines such as "Beijing Literature", "Youth Literature", "Writer", and "Furong". His works have been reprinted in selected journals and anthologies many times and won many awards. He is the author of the poetry collection "The Gift of Youth", the novel collection "Love is Green Leaves", and "The Rear Window of Encountering Heaven", and has published 9 books including the novel "Eye of Heaven" and "The Last Rose of Summer". Among them, "Eye of Heaven" has caused great repercussions across the country. Went to the United States in 2009.

fdb91e5ed3f311d4438a253e65c3b35833705701.translatedText: Tax burdens make wealthy Chinese give up their U.S. passports. To many wealthy mainland Chinese who immigrated to the United States, the U.S. passport is like a monster that cannot be put back in the bottle. They are in Vietnam...

a8a24c0063c09132d3423c93b0c4e463bb5e83ec.sourceText: 31岁的家庭主妇吴（音）大约一年前开始盘算这件事，”我后悔死了，我所有的朋友都后悔死了”，吴讲起美国公民身份时说，”我永远也不会回去。”她想法改变的背后原因是纳税。根据美国法律，公民和永久居民（绿卡持有者）不论住在哪里，其世界范围的收入都要被征税。
a8a24c0063c09132d3423c93b0c4e463bb5e83ec.translatedText: Wu (sound), a 31-year-old housewife, started thinking about this matter about a year ago. "I regret it to death, and all my friends regret it to death." Wu said about her U.S. citizenship, "I will never go back." The reason behind her change of mind was paying taxes. Under U.S. law, citizens and permanent residents (green card holders) are taxed on their worldwide income regardless of where they live.

dc11a5913288c91d809a2d85df542127458d9484.sourceText: 在美国纳税是严肃的法律问题，但很多移民在决定变成美国公民时却未认识到这点。2010年3月，华盛顿通过《外国账户合规纳税法案》，目的就是打击在国外的偷税者。不光纳税是个问题，美国公民和绿卡持有者还面临繁琐的美国税收申报要求，在美国境外银行开户时也常遭遇麻烦。据统计，放弃美国公民身份的人从2006年的280人上升到去年的1780人。”由于纳税负担，考虑放弃美国公民身份的趋势将持续”，普华永道会计师事务所税收服务合伙人安东尼 佟说。
dc11a5913288c91d809a2d85df542127458d9484.translatedText: Paying taxes in the United States is a serious legal issue, but many immigrants fail to realize this when they decide to become U.S. citizens. In March 2010, Washington passed the Foreign Account Compliance and Tax Payment Act, with the purpose of cracking down on tax evaders abroad. Not only is paying taxes a problem, U.S. citizens and green card holders also face cumbersome U.S. tax filing requirements and often encounter trouble when opening bank accounts outside the United States. According to statistics, the number of people renounced their U.S. citizenship rose from 280 in 2006 to 1,780 last year. “The trend of considering renouncing U.S. citizenship due to the tax burden will continue,” said Anthony Tong, a tax services partner at PricewaterhouseCoopers.

7abf8e893b3b9aec4ca60adfd0b73e4ec38ebe90.sourceText: 从事移民工作的香港律师蒂默斯邓说，很多（中国）富人在申请美国公民身份的过程中了解到美国税务机构将监视其全球收入后，就中途放弃了，”很难找到一名税收申报历史没有瑕疵的中国企业家。”
7abf8e893b3b9aec4ca60adfd0b73e4ec38ebe90.translatedText: Timothy Teng, a Hong Kong lawyer who works on immigration, said that many wealthy (Chinese) people give up midway through the process of applying for U.S. citizenship after learning that U.S. tax agencies will monitor their global income. "It is difficult to find a Chinese entrepreneur with an unblemished tax filing history."

803d671eac6bc85d9e9e3aac1b905bf4229a5430.sourceText: 放弃美国公民身份也要付出很大代价。邓说完成这一过程需花上一两年，还有高额法律咨询费用。但移民美国的中国内地人数量仍在上升。很多人是为寻求更好的医疗、环境和资产保护。
803d671eac6bc85d9e9e3aac1b905bf4229a5430.translatedText: There is also a high price to pay for giving up U.S. citizenship. Deng said it would take a year or two to complete the process and would involve high legal consultation fees. But the number of mainland Chinese immigrating to the United States is still rising. Many are seeking better health care, the environment and asset protection.

be6cf348f4726d435b88c37a7c850ab420034486.sourceText: 美加快递解未成年庇护申请几成泡影 偷渡客回国可能受害 据路透社报道，数万名无人陪伴的未成年今年以来逃离那些暴力充斥的国际，但在美墨边境地区被抓获，美方边境设施难以应付，也引起如何解决这个问题的激烈辩论。 美国一架飞机运载33名从6个月到16岁的少年和26名妈妈前我全世界谋杀比例最高的城市、洪都拉斯San Pedro Sula。洪都拉斯第一夫人加西亚（Ana Garcia de Hernandez）到机场迎接，表示关心。 加西亚说，”许多人（妈妈）都是背负巨债，她们现在可怎么还？” 星期五的那批人员是美方上周第二批遣返，第一批是40人星期一被送回洪都拉斯。 随后，那架飞机又将3名4-14岁的男孩、1名9岁女孩和4名妈妈及另外22名妇女送回萨尔瓦多。 其中一名26岁的妇女奥勒兰纳（Keli Orellana）回到洪都拉斯之后说，她带着6个月大儿子在美方拘留中心待了8天之后，已经衰竭。但回到洪都拉斯，她又欠下偷渡?#29436;?000美元债务。她希望奥巴马能给这些移民一个机会，而她们只希望能够留下并工作。 但美国移民和海关执法局发表声明说，根据遣返程序或加快遣返措施，更多带着儿童的成人将被送回洪都拉斯、危地马拉和萨尔瓦多。 路透社说，来自中美洲国家的移民都是因为去年10月以来那些国家犯罪猖獗和黑社会太野蛮而投奔美国。许多人是借款交给偷渡蛇头，指望他们带自己进入美国。 上周是奥巴马总统承诺加快递解程序之后首批遣返。奥巴马下周将会晤洪都拉斯、危地马拉和萨尔瓦多领导人，讨论合作遏制儿童偷渡潮问题。 另据《纽约时报》报道，随着美国加快递解，庇护申请恐成泡影。 报道说，随着本财年以来5.7万名未成年偷渡边境时被抓获，政府官员和国会议员都希望通过加快递解程序来遏制偷渡潮。 但是，上周的面谈却显示许多年青移民面临递解风险大增。很多被扣押在边境巡逻站的未成年接受面谈时，因为感觉不安全，没有透露他们在家乡遭遇的风险，有些人心不在焉，有些人害怕陌生人，有些人是因为心理创伤而不愿多说；他们所有人都对法律程序了解很少。 圣安东尼奥法律服务机构Raices主管莱恩（Jonathan Ryan）说，许多孩子被送回去都可能受害。他的机构在莱克兰空军基地（Lackland Air Force Base）已经审议了3000名被拘留未成年的情况，发现至少一半应当得到某种签证。
be6cf348f4726d435b88c37a7c850ab420034486.translatedText: The application for express delivery of asylum for minors from the United States and Canada is almost in vain, and stowaways may be harmed when they return home. According to Reuters, tens of thousands of unaccompanied minors have fled violence-ridden countries this year, but have been caught at the U.S.-Mexico border. U.S. border facilities are struggling to cope with the situation and have triggered fierce debate on how to solve the problem. A U.S. plane carried 33 teenagers ranging from 6 months to 16 years old and 26 mothers to San Pedro Sula, Honduras, a city with the highest murder rate in the world. The first lady of Honduras, Ana Garcia de Hernandez, greeted him at the airport and expressed her concern. Garcia said, "Many people (mothers) are carrying huge debts. How can they pay it back now?" The group of people on Friday was the second group of people repatriated by the United States last week. The first group of 40 people was sent back to Honduras on Monday. Subsequently, that plane returned three boys aged 4 to 14, a 9-year-old girl, four mothers and 22 other women back to El Salvador. One of the women, Keli Orellana, 26, said after returning to Honduras that she was exhausted after spending eight days in a U.S. detention center with her 6-month-old son. But when she returned to Honduras, she owed another $29436;?000 debt for smuggling. She hopes Obama will give these immigrants a chance, and they just want to be able to stay and work. But U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement issued a statement saying that more adults with children will be sent back to Honduras, Guatemala and El Salvador under removal proceedings or expedited removal measures. Reuters said that immigrants from Central American countries have defected to the United States because of the rampant crime and brutal underworld in those countries since October last year. Many people borrow money from smugglers and expect them to take them into the United States. Last week marked the first batch of deportations following President Obama's pledge to speed up the deportation process. Obama will meet with the leaders of Honduras, Guatemala and El Salvador next week to discuss cooperation to stem the tide of child smuggling. According to the New York Times, as the United States speeds up deportations, asylum applications may come to nothing. According to reports, with 57,000 minors being caught smuggling across the border so far this fiscal year, government officials and members of Congress hope to curb the tide of smuggling by speeding up the deportation process. But interviews last week showed many young immigrants are at increased risk of deportation. When interviewed, many of the minors detained at Border Patrol stations did not disclose the risks they encountered back home because they did not feel safe, some were distracted, some were afraid of strangers, some were too traumatized to say much; all of them had little understanding of the legal process. Jonathan Ryan, director of Raices, a legal services agency in San Antonio, said many children could be harmed by being sent back. His agency has reviewed the conditions of 3,000 minors detained at Lackland Air Force Base and found that at least half should receive some kind of visa.

9d4c9a633bd0dba28bc7eff44502bc268f809b57.sourceText: （华人耆英会供稿）十一月初，凤凰城华人耆英会召开了全体理事会议，讨论了年度选举的有关事宜。按照耆英会章程，决定今年十二月十三日（星期五）上午九时，在本会会所召开全体会员大会，选举新一届主席，副主席和相关职员。耆英会自1979年创建以来，按照协会”团结华人耆英，增进会员福利” 的宗旨，许多热心为大家服务的义工，为耆英会的发展做出了重要贡献。耆英会在侨联和广大侨胞的关心和帮助下，先后建成和扩建了耆英会会所，建成了康宁和康乐两座老人公寓。组织会员积极参与各类文化体育和旅游活动。 知名侨领余文劲先生长期指导和支持该会的日常活动，永远顾问吴英蕃先生每年向该会提供资助。登记会员已达1100多人，是凤凰城侨社中人数较多的社团。耆英会会员已成为侨社活动中不可或缺的重要成员，每次侨社活动中都少不了耆英会员的身影。年度会员大会是耆英会的一件大事，这次选举将为耆英会增添新的成员，注入新的活力。我们期望全体会员认真行使自己的选举权，选出2014年度的新职员。也希望愿意为大家服务的会员积极报名参选。侯选人提名将于十二月六日前在耆英会公告栏上进行和公布。未缴纳会费的会员请在选举前缴纳会费。
9d4c9a633bd0dba28bc7eff44502bc268f809b57.translatedText: (Contributed by the Chinese Senior Citizens Association) In early November, the Phoenix City Chinese Senior Citizens Association held a plenary council meeting to discuss matters related to the annual election. In accordance with the articles of association of the Senior Citizens Association, it has been decided that at 9:00 am on Friday, December 13 this year, a general meeting of members will be held at the association’s clubhouse to elect the new chairman, vice-chairman and relevant staff. Since the Association for Senior Citizens was founded in 1979, in accordance with the association's purpose of "uniting Chinese senior citizens and enhancing the welfare of members", many volunteers who are enthusiastic about serving everyone have made important contributions to the development of the Association for Senior Citizens. With the care and help of the Overseas Chinese Federation and overseas Chinese, the Senior Citizen Association has built and expanded the Senior Citizen Club, and built two apartments for the elderly, Kangning and Kangle. Organize members to actively participate in various cultural, sports and tourism activities. The well-known overseas Chinese leader Mr. Yu Wenjin has long-term guidance and support for the daily activities of the association, and the permanent consultant Mr. Wu Yingfan provides funding to the association every year. It has more than 1,100 registered members, making it the largest association among overseas Chinese associations in Phoenix. Members of the Senior Citizens Association have become indispensable and important members in the activities of the overseas Chinese community. They are indispensable in every overseas Chinese community activity. The annual general meeting is a major event for the Senior Citizen Association. This election will add new members and inject new vitality into the Senior Citizen Association. We hope that all members will conscientiously exercise their right to vote and elect new staff for 2014. We also hope that members who are willing to serve everyone will actively sign up for the election. Nominations of candidates will be made and announced on the bulletin board of the Senior Citizens Association before December 6. Members who have not paid their dues are asked to pay their dues before the election.

d2b8358b21cc410a8184e17e8d8730c032d36cd9.sourceText: 巴拿马运河扩建，加州干着急？ 根据巴拿马前总统Martin Torrijos 2006年签署的法案，截至2014年，美洲航运的重要通道巴拿马运河将扩建一条新河道，届时将接受更大吨位的轮船通过巴拿马运河，使得美国东西岸海运更加快捷迅速。 加州各港口原本可以因此获益，但无奈受到环保等方面的掣肘，加州港口扩建速度根本无法满足2014年巴拿马运河扩建后的货物吞吐量。 南加州政府联合会（Southern California Association of Government, SCAG）9日联合前旧金山市长Willie Brown等人，发起「迎接巴拿马运河」活动（Beat the Panama Canal），旨在要求加快加州港口建设，减少审批程序 和时间，以便创造就业并迎接未来的挑战。 活动的协办者，非营利组织工作第一联合会（Job 1st Alliance）表示，迎接巴拿马运河活动不仅限于港口，还涉及到65个以上的公共和私人建设工程，旨在呼吁环保以及决策组织加速这些建设的审批时间和程序，不仅能在当前经济不振的状况下提供更多就业，而且使得加州基础设施建设升级，迎接未来挑战。 这些建设项目都已获得资金支持，但在环保等方面遭到阻力，迟迟不能动工。 该组织主席Wally Baker说，中国通过一项建设项目审批仅需几个月，而加州却可以长达15年，这种速度如何跟中国竞争？ 而旧金山前市长Willie Brown则表示，迎接巴拿马运河活动如果成功，将使得加州这头睡狮醒来，迎接更多挑战。 此活动得到包括新港滩政府在内的加州多个组织的支持。 「民主的痛苦」折磨加州已不止一两天。 今年4月，经济学人杂志就曾专门以「过度民主？」（Too Much Democracy?）为题，就加州过于繁琐的民主程序制约社会和经济发展做过讨论。 这次活动也是以巴拿马运河借题发挥，希望加州基础设施建设加速。
d2b8358b21cc410a8184e17e8d8730c032d36cd9.translatedText: Panama Canal expansion, is California in a hurry? According to the bill signed by former Panamanian President Martin Torrijos in 2006, the Panama Canal, an important channel for American shipping, will expand a new channel by 2014, which will allow ships with larger tonnage to pass through the Panama Canal, making shipping from the east and west coasts of the United States faster and faster. California ports could have benefited from this, but due to environmental constraints, the expansion rate of California ports simply cannot meet the cargo throughput after the expansion of the Panama Canal in 2014. The Southern California Association of Government (SCAG) joined forces with former San Francisco Mayor Willie Brown and others on the 9th to launch the "Beat the Panama Canal" campaign, aiming to speed up the construction of California ports and reduce approval procedures and time in order to create jobs and meet future challenges. The co-organizer of the event, the non-profit organization Job 1st Alliance, stated that the activities to welcome the Panama Canal are not limited to ports, but also involve more than 65 public and private construction projects. It aims to call on environmental protection and decision-making organizations to speed up the approval time and procedures of these constructions, which will not only provide more jobs in the current economic downturn, but also upgrade California's infrastructure construction to meet future challenges. These construction projects have received financial support, but have been delayed in starting construction due to resistance from environmental protection and other aspects. Wally Baker, chairman of the organization, said that it only takes a few months for China to approve a construction project, but it can take up to 15 years for California. How can this speed compete with China? Willie Brown, the former mayor of San Francisco, said that if the Panama Canal campaign succeeds, California, the sleeping lion, will wake up and face more challenges. The event is supported by several California organizations, including the Newport Beach government. "The pain of democracy" has been tormenting California for more than a day or two. In April this year, The Economist magazine devoted a special discussion to the topic "Too Much Democracy?" on California's overly cumbersome democratic procedures that restrict social and economic development. This event is also based on the theme of the Panama Canal, hoping that California's infrastructure construction will be accelerated.

5c2d2f48ea3b86edc88f6161cd9e75090829cf41.sourceText: 美国邮局网站增中文和西班牙文服务 美国人口当中说西班牙语及汉语的民众快速增长，现在美国邮局网站usps.com上提供西班牙文和简体中文服务，从追踪包裹、查找邮政编号与了解邮政服务等等，提供移民更多方便。 在美国，西班牙语及汉语的普遍程度仅次于英语。多种语言选择是美国邮局网站usps.com最新的、重要的功能改进。usps.com在2010年有4亿1千3百万次造访，每天超过 130万。根据美国人口普查2009年的社区调查，华裔是美国最大的亚裔群体，达380万人。
5c2d2f48ea3b86edc88f6161cd9e75090829cf41.translatedText: The U.S. Post Office website adds Chinese and Spanish services. Spanish- and Chinese-speaking people in the U.S. population are growing rapidly. The U.S. Post Office website usps.com now provides Spanish and Simplified Chinese services, including tracking packages, finding postal numbers, understanding postal services, etc., providing more convenience for immigrants. In the United States, Spanish and Chinese are second only to English in popularity. Multiple language options are the latest major feature improvement to the United States Post Office website usps.com. usps.com had 413 million visits in 2010, more than 1.3 million visits per day. According to the 2009 U.S. Census Community Survey, Chinese Americans are the largest Asian group in the United States, with 3.8 million people.

e603d69347f764f8c7dadffdd02f6a3fda2727d7.sourceText: 亞省馬吳後援會參加洛杉磯造勢活動（图） （亚省时报） 由中華民國立法院副院長曾永權所率領的友好訪美團，日前抵達洛杉磯，包括台灣加油讚執行長金溥聰，國民黨海外部主任夏大明，國民黨新生代立委參選人江啟臣、蘇俊賓、錢薇娟、陳以真、邱於軒等一行人，與來自美西南各地包括亞利桑那州馬吳後援會代表超過一千多名僑胞搖旗吶喊，讓友好訪美團充分感受到僑民的熱情，也期望未來能讓出馬角逐的總統、副總統搭檔馬英九、吳敦義能打拚再四年，台灣更向前。 亞利桑那州馬吳後援會，由國民黨亞省國民黨直屬分部常委王瑋(王亭)帶隊，包括委員蔡昌，朱家佑，謝茵，楊永慧，鄧凱蒂，曹嘉儀，劉長樂夫婦都參與這次造勢活動，對於這群不辭勞苦長途跋涉，代表亞利桑那泛藍僑胞力挺馬吳的精神，獲得台灣加油讚執行長金溥聰以及中國國民黨海外部主任夏大明高度讚賞。 左起: 聖地牙哥分部常委黃莉莉，亞利桑那州直屬分部常委王瑋(王亭)，雅凱迪亞分部常委吳寶璘，蒙特利公園市分部常委何家燕以及來自南加州各地的黨部及馬吳後援會負責人。 經過十多天的鐵馬疾行軍般的訪問行程，友好訪美團一從舊金山飛抵洛杉磯，就馬不停蹄趕到洛杉磯馬吳後援總會所舉辦的大型造勢活動會場，受到現場超過千名支持者的熱烈掌聲歡迎，現場瞬間旗海飄揚，熱血澎湃，現場正副總統候選人馬英九吳敦義的大型看板寫著 「繼續向前行，台灣繼續贏」的標語，更顯示僑胞們對於國內選情的熱情與關心，對馬英九總統過去四年執政的肯定，以及對未來馬吳執政的清廉品質充滿信心。活動一開始全場高唱中華民國國歌，同時播放正副總統候選人馬英九以及吳敦義院長為造勢活動所製作的影片，從經濟成長，失業率降低，投資環境改善，並以國台客語向僑胞們宣示維護國家決心，獲得現場來賓的共鳴。 為了支持青年參政，讓國民黨注入新活力，這次立委選舉提名11位40歲以下的菁英參選，其中包括此次訪美團五位團員，前新聞局局長蘇俊賓，江啟臣，前籃球國手錢薇娟，新聞主播陳以真以及留美碩士邱於軒等，亞省國民黨直屬分部常委王瑋(王亭)特別以高價，標下由台南市選區的蘇俊賓所準備的鄭成功娃娃，祝蘇俊賓的立委選舉高票當選成功。 當助選團團長曾永權上台時特別提到馬英九總統上任之初台灣先後捲入水災、金融海嘯，卻能臨危不亂，讓台灣2010年GDP成長率躍昇亞洲第二、全球第四名，瑞士洛桑管理學院更評鑑台灣競爭力世界第六名，成四小龍之首。友好訪美團團長曾永權帶領下，團員們向現場支持者深深鞠躬，感謝僑民們的熱情相挺。現場播放中華民國國旗歌為背景音樂的競選短片，跟著優美旋律全場一起高唱，接著五位立委參選人分別帶了個人選擇的物品拍賣籌選舉經費，現場僑胞也熱烈競標，以實際行動表達支持。隨後美西南地區各地後援會負責人手持國旗上台，一同揮動國旗黨旗，高唱愛國歌曲，高喊中華民國萬歲和「馬英九當選」口號，現場氣氛到達最高點。許久未見到的海外熱情在這場造勢活動當中，重新燃起了僑胞們關懷台灣，熱愛中華民國的熱血。友好訪美團從台灣出發先後訪問華府、紐約、波士頓、休士頓、舊金山與洛杉磯等六個城市，在最後一站洛杉磯圓滿落幕。
e603d69347f764f8c7dadffdd02f6a3fda2727d7.translatedText: The Alberta Ma-Wu Supporters Association participated in the Los Angeles campaign (photo) (Alberta Times) A goodwill delegation led by Zeng Yongquan, Vice President of the Legislative Yuan of the Republic of China, recently arrived in Los Angeles, including Jin Puchong, CEO of Taiwan Comes Together, Xia Daming, director of the Overseas Department of the Kuomintang, and the new generation of Kuomintang legislative candidates Jiang Qichen, Su Junbin, Qian Weijuan, Chen Yizhen, Qiu Yuxuan and others. , and more than a thousand overseas Chinese from all over the southwestern United States, including representatives of the Ma-Wu Support Association in Arizona, waved flags and cheers, allowing the friendly visiting delegation to fully feel the enthusiasm of the overseas Chinese. We also hope that the presidential and vice-presidential partners Ma Ying-jeou and Wu Dunyi who will compete in the future can work hard for another four years and Taiwan will move forward. The Arizona Ma Wu Supporters Association is led by Wang Wei (Wang Ting), a member of the Standing Committee of the Kuomintang branch of the Arizona KMT, and includes members Cai Chang, Zhu Jiayou, Xie Yin, Yang Yonghui, Deng Katie, Cao Jiayi, Liu Changle and his wife. They all participated in this campaign. The spirit of this group of people who worked tirelessly to travel long distances to support Ma Wu on behalf of the Arizona pan-blue overseas Chinese was highly praised by Taiwanese cheering CEO Jin Pucong and the Chinese Kuomintang Overseas Department Director Xia Daming. From left: San Diego branch standing committee member Huang Lili, Arizona branch standing committee member Wang Wei (Wang Ting), Acadia branch standing committee member Wu Baolin, Monterey Park branch standing committee member He Jiayan, as well as party and Ma Wu supporter association leaders from all over Southern California. After more than ten days of a galloping visit, as soon as the friendly visit group flew from San Francisco to Los Angeles, they rushed non-stop to the large-scale campaign venue held by the Ma Wu Support Association in Los Angeles. They were welcomed with warm applause by more than a thousand supporters at the scene. Flags were flying in the scene and blood was surging. A large signboard of the presidential and vice presidential candidate Ma Ying-jeou and Wu Dunyi read The slogan "Keep moving forward, Taiwan will continue to win" further demonstrates the enthusiasm and concern of the overseas Chinese for the domestic election situation, their affirmation of President Ma Ying-jeou's rule for the past four years, and their confidence in the integrity of Ma and Wu's future governance. At the beginning of the event, the entire audience sang the national anthem of the Republic of China, and at the same time played videos produced by presidential and vice presidential candidates Ma Ying-jeou and President Wu Dunyi for the campaign, focusing on economic growth, reduction of unemployment, improvement of the investment environment, and using Taiwanese Hakka to declare to overseas Chinese their determination to safeguard the country, which resonated with the guests present. In order to support youth participation in politics and inject new vitality into the Kuomintang, this legislative election has nominated 11 elites under the age of 40 to run, including five members of the delegation visiting the United States, former Information Bureau Directors Su Junbin, Jiang Qichen, former national basketball player Qian Weijuan, News anchor Chen Yizhen and Qiu Yuxuan, a master's degree student in the United States, and Wang Wei (Wang Ting), member of the Standing Committee of the Kuomintang Branch of the Province of Alberta, especially bid at a high price for the Zheng Chenggong doll prepared by Su Junbin from the Tainan City Constituency, wishing Su Junbin success in the legislative election with a high vote. When the leader of the campaign team, Tsang Yong-quan, came to power, he specifically mentioned that when President Ma Ying-jeou took office, Taiwan was involved in floods and financial tsunami, but it was able to stay calm in the face of crisis, making Taiwan's GDP growth rate jump to second in Asia and fourth in the world in 2010. Switzerland's Lausanne Management School even rated Taiwan's competitiveness as sixth in the world, ranking first among the Four Tigers. Led by Zeng Yongquan, leader of the friendly delegation to the United States, the members bowed deeply to the supporters at the scene and thanked the overseas Chinese for their enthusiastic support. A campaign short film with the national flag anthem of the Republic of China as the background music was played live, and the audience sang along with the beautiful melody. Then each of the five legislative candidates brought items of their personal choice to be auctioned to raise election funds. The overseas Chinese on site also bid enthusiastically to express their support with practical actions. Afterwards, the heads of support associations from various regions in the southwestern United States came to the stage holding national flags, waving national flags and party flags, singing patriotic songs, shouting "Long Live the Republic of China" and "Ma Ying-jeou was elected", and the atmosphere at the scene reached its highest point. The overseas enthusiasm that has not been seen for a long time has been rekindled in this campaign, and the overseas Chinese's passion for caring for Taiwan and loving the Republic of China has been rekindled. The goodwill visit to the United States started from Taiwan and visited six cities including Washington, New York, Boston, Houston, San Francisco and Los Angeles, and ended successfully at the last stop in Los Angeles.

The electricity cost for a 10,000-square-foot factory in the Chandler data center is only $600,000 per year, which is much cheaper than in Los Angeles.

5d1f68a0ff6c3e929896e0270f3ecdfaeb968198.sourceText: 本月早些时候，总部设在休斯敦的辛辛那提贝尔子公司CyrusOne说，它购买了40亩地在钱德勒，打算兴建一个1万平方英尺的数据中心，六月保健巨头帕特里克医生，宣布在16 街和Buckeye，凤凰城机场中心购买14亩地兴建数据中心。
5d1f68a0ff6c3e929896e0270f3ecdfaeb968198.translatedText: Earlier this month, Houston-based Cincinnati Bell subsidiary CyrusOne said it purchased 40 acres in Chandler with the intention of building a 10,000-square-foot data center, and in June health care giant Dr. Patrick's announced it was buying 14 acres at 16th Street and Buckeye to build a data center at the Phoenix Airport Center.

d21ddb41c44f27436c6714778a53aa9fec80056c.translatedText: John McCain and four other senators inspected the Arizona border

0bba4aca9bfbcfd5a69ea2ac4f9c724ffe6917bc.sourceText: 约翰 麦凯恩等四个参议员巡视亚利桑那州边境线 （本网编译）周三四个参议员在边境诺加利斯（Nogales）巡…
0bba4aca9bfbcfd5a69ea2ac4f9c724ffe6917bc.translatedText: John McCain and four other senators inspected the Arizona border (Compiled by this website) Four senators patrolled the border in Nogales on Wednesday...

9b8fb5fcb3b42bd921a1760bfb6a283e04c17560.sourceText: （本网编译）周三四个参议员在边境诺加利斯（Nogales）巡视。本次巡视活动是由参议员约翰 麦凯恩（John McCain）和杰夫 弗莱克（Jeff Flake）主办的。他们俩都是负责移民改革计划的成员。来自纽约州的民主党参议员舒默，以及科罗拉多州民主党参议员迈克尔班纳特加入了他们的队伍。 他们亲临边境来看看边境面临的真正问题。诺加利斯是图桑的一部分，是亚利桑那州问题最多的边境线之一。根据报告，与其他9个边境地区比，这里逮捕了最多的非法越境者以及贩毒分子。 一个原因是叫漏斗效应，他们看到更多来往的人流是来自墨西哥比较安全的区域。另一个原因是这里有钢丝网，保护亚利桑那的的边境。看上去应该是比较安全的地区，然而实际上却是犯罪率最高的部分。 参议员们希望通过这次巡视，让参议员们能感觉到下月即将亮相的移民改革计划的必要性。
9b8fb5fcb3b42bd921a1760bfb6a283e04c17560.translatedText: (Compiled by this website) Four senators inspected the border in Nogales on Wednesday. The tour was hosted by Senators John McCain and Jeff Flake. Both are members of the group responsible for immigration reform. They were joined by Democratic Sen. Schumer of New York and Democratic Sen. Michael Bennet of Colorado. They came to the border to see the real problems facing the border. Nogales is part of Tucson, one of Arizona's most problematic borders. According to the report, the largest number of illegal border crossers and drug traffickers were arrested here compared with the other nine border areas. One reason is called the funnel effect. They see more traffic coming from safer areas of Mexico. Another reason is the wire fence that protects Arizona's border. It looks like it should be a relatively safe area, but it actually has the highest crime rate. Senators hope the tour will give them a sense of the need for the immigration reform plan to be unveiled next month.

525822d60e103150418fe0c9a896f3f5dd637047.sourceText: 中国政府成为世界各国，特别是美国顶尖人才的追求者。中国政府2011年底宣布”外专千人计划”，在未来10年招募1,000外国学术以及商业顶级人才，进行创新研究。这意味着曾在美国国家航空航天局任职的精英科学家们将在上海或北京安新家。而此前，中国航空公司在美国举行的飞行员招聘会上，高薪挖走美国数百名飞行员。
525822d60e103150418fe0c9a896f3f5dd637047.translatedText: The Chinese government has become a pursuer of top talents from all over the world, especially the United States. At the end of 2011, the Chinese government announced the "Thousand Talents Plan for Foreign Experts" to recruit 1,000 top foreign academic and business talents in the next 10 years to conduct innovative research. This means that elite scientists who have served at NASA will find new homes in Shanghai or Beijing. Previously, Chinese airlines poached hundreds of American pilots at high-paying pilot recruitment fairs in the United States.

a54b34d576a20c7be916c623cc7e49deb124cc08.sourceText: 近年，中国很多大学开始大量聘请外籍教授，这反应了中国大学的趋势。不但如此，中国政府也开始新的项目吸引外国的顶尖人才。中国与全球化中心王辉耀(音译)称，”我们希望更多的外国教授能够来中国。”
a54b34d576a20c7be916c623cc7e49deb124cc08.translatedText: In recent years, many Chinese universities have begun to hire a large number of foreign professors, which reflects the trend of Chinese universities. Not only that, the Chinese government has also started new projects to attract top foreign talents. Wang Huiyao (transliteration) of the Center for China and Globalization said, "We hope that more foreign professors can come to China."

06eec8c5525624321ae7399493b8ce9f5370c645.sourceText: 中国的科研实验室和企业难以招到合适人才，这由来已久。随着高科技产业增长和研发费用比重的提高，人才缺口或将持续加大。为此，中国确立人才优先发展的战略布局，多次开展鼓励留学人员归国活动，其中一项旨在从西方引进2000名华裔优秀人才。
06eec8c5525624321ae7399493b8ce9f5370c645.translatedText: China's scientific research laboratories and companies have a long history of difficulty recruiting suitable talents. As the high-tech industry grows and the proportion of R&D expenses increases, the talent gap may continue to increase. To this end, China has established a strategic layout that prioritizes the development of talents, and has carried out many activities to encourage overseas students to return to China, one of which aims to introduce 2,000 outstanding Chinese talents from the West.

a9f7293048d377ad453cb24eb7828e78497d701a.sourceText: 这预示着中国摒弃传统的”使用华人”政策并加大开放程度。俄勒冈大学国际事务专家西蒙(Dennis Simon)表示，中国将人才视为提高竞争力和创新力的下一场全球大赛，并决心赢得这场确保实现经济调整目标的竞争。新的人才池是从?#20013;国制造?#36716;向?#20013;国创造?#30340;关键。但事情并非总能称心如意。
a9f7293048d377ad453cb24eb7828e78497d701a.translatedText: This indicates that China will abandon the traditional "use Chinese" policy and increase its openness. Dennis Simon, an international affairs expert at the University of Oregon, said that China views talent as the next global competition to improve competitiveness and innovation, and is determined to win this competition to ensure the realization of its economic adjustment goals. The new talent pool is the key to moving from "Made in China" to "Created in China". But things don't always go their way.

6fbba70f6d6881e923df325be846c7fd279b069c.sourceText: 但是，西蒙说，最优秀的华裔专家尤其是科技领域人才尚未决定重返中国。一些人仍在观望。家庭因素也是重要障碍，许多华裔人才不希望子女遭受中国”高考地狱”的折磨。单凭回国人员解决不了创新问题。
6fbba70f6d6881e923df325be846c7fd279b069c.translatedText: However, Simon said that the best Chinese experts, especially those in the science and technology field, have not yet decided to return to China. Some are still waiting and watching. Family factors are also an important obstacle. Many Chinese talents do not want their children to suffer from China’s “gaokao hell”. Returnees alone cannot solve the innovation problem.

0debd9982cdd1b227e9282a7ce966f8026e1afe5.sourceText: 中国最大挑战是营造更有利于企业家精神的环境，打破既有体制并挑战常规。在允许和鼓励更多”特立独行”的思行之前，中国不可能实现创新，其实验室和企业也生产不出北京渴盼的突破性新产品。
0debd9982cdd1b227e9282a7ce966f8026e1afe5.translatedText: China’s biggest challenge is to create an environment more conducive to entrepreneurship, break the existing system and challenge conventions. Until more "unconventional" thinking is allowed and encouraged, China will not be able to innovate, and its laboratories and companies will not be able to produce the breakthrough new products that Beijing craves.

b4ec48909624ee19f4b6cf8a26f99f3eac119d0a.sourceText: 根据中国官媒新华社2月的报道，中国自从启动”外专千人计划”以来，中国已经招募了超过200名申请者，这些专家大多来自美国、日本、德国等。王辉耀称，”外专千人计划”是”千人计划”的拓展项目，而”千人计划”已经招募了1,600人，其中大部分为华裔学术人才。
b4ec48909624ee19f4b6cf8a26f99f3eac119d0a.translatedText: According to a report by China's official Xinhua News Agency in February, China has recruited more than 200 applicants since it launched the "Thousand Foreign Experts Program". Most of these experts are from the United States, Japan, Germany, etc. Wang Huiyao said that the "Thousand Talents Plan for Foreign Experts" is an expansion project of the "Thousand Talents Plan", and the "Thousand Talents Plan" has recruited 1,600 people, most of whom are Chinese academic talents.

596f0cf61331e9919975b5fe95407fd0bc023c11.sourceText: 根据”外专千人计划”，每一位来华专家都会获得100万人名币以上或将近160,000美元的补助，科学研究人员可以得到300万~500万人民币的研究津贴。由于在西方国家，研究人员很难获得研究基金，中国的投资自然吸引众多西方过年的研究人员。
596f0cf61331e9919975b5fe95407fd0bc023c11.translatedText: According to the "Thousand Talents Program for Foreign Experts", each expert in China will receive a subsidy of more than 1 million yuan or nearly 160,000 US dollars, and scientific researchers can receive a research allowance of 3 million to 5 million yuan. Since it is difficult for researchers to obtain research funds in Western countries, Chinese investment naturally attracts many Western researchers who spend the New Year.

29fe7b592f66d22a6712037e707647e03cff5ee9.sourceText: 此前，美国彭博资讯社报道，目前，由于美国航空公司班机机长退休时间较晚，飞行员面临着晋升难的问题，再加上近年来，受经济衰退的影响，美国航空业增长放缓，飞行员就业压力极大。同美国公司相比，中国航空公司能够为飞行员提供更加优厚的待遇。
29fe7b592f66d22a6712037e707647e03cff5ee9.translatedText: Previously, Bloomberg News reported that currently, due to the late retirement of American Airlines flight captains, pilots are facing the problem of difficulty in promotion. In addition, in recent years, affected by the economic recession, the growth of the U.S. aviation industry has slowed down, putting great pressure on pilot employment. Compared with American companies, Chinese airlines can provide pilots with more generous treatment.

9fe772a60a79cd9d33b46d84d3ef214163ee2f12.sourceText: 报道援引一名在美国航空公司工作的副驾驶员的话称，如果去中国工作，他不仅能获得机长一职，还可以获得现有工资两倍的待遇。另一名在该公司工作13年的副驾驶员也表示，已经决定放弃美国的工作，和妻子去中国工作。
9fe772a60a79cd9d33b46d84d3ef214163ee2f12.translatedText: The report quoted a co-pilot working for American Airlines as saying that if he went to work in China, he would not only be able to get the position of captain, but also get twice the current salary. Another co-pilot who has worked for the company for 13 years also said that he has decided to give up his job in the United States and go to work in China with his wife.

dbfb0a5ffbe7fe3acc4eb4d725b758db233591b4.sourceText: 中国民航总局（CAA）的公布数据显示，目前，中国飞行员仅有24,000人，到2015年底，这一人数将达到40,000人。另据中国春秋航空公司相关负责人
dbfb0a5ffbe7fe3acc4eb4d725b758db233591b4.translatedText: Data released by the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAA) show that currently, there are only 24,000 pilots in China, and by the end of 2015, this number will reach 40,000. According to the relevant person in charge of China Spring Airlines

37a1263f7179f53ec4b5bf5794f5a6f3dfa6c061.sourceText: 透露，现有1,700名外国籍飞行员在中国工作。
37a1263f7179f53ec4b5bf5794f5a6f3dfa6c061.translatedText: , there are currently 1,700 foreign pilots working in China.

fd8875bf071c16d0175e1b27451a24772999e414.sourceText: 同时，中国运输飞机最多、航线网络最发达、年客运量最大的南方航空公司不久前表示，2012年该公司将招录4,400名飞行员，其中包括100名外国籍飞行员。中国国际航空公司也将于2012年大幅增加招聘的外国飞行员数量。
fd8875bf071c16d0175e1b27451a24772999e414.translatedText: At the same time, China Southern Airlines, which has the largest number of transport aircraft, the most developed route network and the largest annual passenger volume, recently stated that it will recruit 4,400 pilots in 2012, including 100 foreign pilots. Air China will also significantly increase the number of foreign pilots it recruits in 2012.

56636d89526076345c61376bfa5cdf5c09e5d3d4.sourceText: 对于面临就业难、升职难、前景不佳的美国飞行员而言，中国提供的丰厚条件自然极为诱人，随着中国经济的发展，以及中国境内外游客人数的攀升，中国航空业还将为来华务工的外国飞行员提供广阔的发展空间。
56636d89526076345c61376bfa5cdf5c09e5d3d4.translatedText: For American pilots who face difficulties in employment, promotion and poor prospects, the generous conditions provided by China are naturally very attractive. With the development of China's economy and the increase in the number of tourists from China and abroad, China's aviation industry will also provide broad development space for foreign pilots who come to China to work.

4b026971b873f57c59cc1cf92cc879841d205c05.translatedText: Qu Jiahe, a Chinese-American boy from Arizona, won the prize in the national duck stamp finals (picture) In the national duck stamp painting finals that just ended today, from Chandle...

c695018f7f5bc778390990714a74d2fa802770cd.sourceText: 在今天刚刚结束的全国鸭邮绘画总决赛中，来自Chandler15岁的华裔少年曲 嘉 禾（Jiahe Qu）以精湛的画技绘制的连帽秋沙鸭荣获全国第三名。这是自美国国会1994年创办青少年鸭邮比赛以来亚省选手第一次荣获全国前三名。作为全国的获胜者，除了将获得政府颁发的奖金外，其作品将在全国巡回展出一年，曲 嘉 禾及其家长也将获邀请免费前往华盛顿参加全国的庆典活动。曲 嘉 禾自幼酷爱绘画，曾多次在各种绘画比赛中获奖。她目前每周利用课外时间在小苏画室（Xiao Su Studio）学习绘画。
c695018f7f5bc778390990714a74d2fa802770cd.translatedText: In the national duck stamp painting finals that just ended today, Qu Jiahe, a 15-year-old Chinese boy from Chandler The hooded merganser painted by Qu) won third place in the country with his superb painting skills. This is the first time since the U.S. Congress established the youth duck mail competition in 1994 that an Alberta athlete has won the top three in the country. As a national winner, in addition to receiving a prize from the government, his or her work will be exhibited nationwide for one year. Qu Jiahe and his parents will also be invited to Washington for free to participate in national celebrations. Qu Jiahe has loved painting since he was a child and has won many awards in various painting competitions. She currently spends her extracurricular time studying painting at Xiao Su Studio every week.

07b4c0c60cd8fb3fa943ba8edec6d0fb96819a79.sourceText: 有二十年历史的每年一度的全国鸭邮绘画比赛是美国国会立法由内政部举办的绘画比赛，其宗旨主要是促进自然环境保护，及其教育等。每年三月份各州产生一名最佳优胜者，进而进行全国范围的最终大赛。全国第一名的作品还将被印制成美国邮票流通发行。
07b4c0c60cd8fb3fa943ba8edec6d0fb96819a79.translatedText: The annual National Duck Post Painting Competition with a history of 20 years is a painting competition organized by the Department of the Interior legislated by the U.S. Congress. Its purpose is mainly to promote the protection of the natural environment and education. Each state selects the best winner in March each year, and then conducts the final nationwide competition. The top-ranked work in the country will also be printed on U.S. stamps for circulation.

7daf2b89af40ea51575704d4e161fcc90610e333.translatedText: Investment Immigration China's richest people must choose carefully

2bf6b8264e81c7d9588f3be13712ef82ab75b67a.sourceText: 投资移民 中国富豪须谨慎选择 《华尔街日报》网站3月19日文章，原题：中国富豪谨慎选择美投资移民项目 …
2bf6b8264e81c7d9588f3be13712ef82ab75b67a.translatedText: Investment immigration Chinese rich people must choose carefully their investment immigration "Wall Street Journal" website article on March 19, original title: China's richest people should carefully choose U.S. investment immigration programs...

b5a0291ab76be643bbe4a1bce45f50b03c0475b7.sourceText: 约翰内斯冯特拉普是电影《音乐之声》描绘的那个家庭的家族成员。过去一年半中，他在努力吸引外国人投资他位于佛蒙特州的滑雪小屋和酿酒厂。他已3次飞往中国向数百位富豪兜售项目。他常引述父母逃离奥地利的故事，甚至不情愿地带领一群北京小孩儿表演《雪绒花》。但到目前为止这些努力得到的响应是：仅有5位投资者投入250万美元，和他的目标差很远。
b5a0291ab76be643bbe4a1bce45f50b03c0475b7.translatedText: Johannes von Trapp is a member of the family depicted in the movie "The Sound of Music". He has spent the past year and a half trying to attract foreign investment into his ski lodge and winery in Vermont. He has flown to China three times to sell projects to hundreds of wealthy people. He often quoted the story of his parents' escape from Austria, and even reluctantly led a group of Beijing children in a performance of "Edelweiss." But the response to these efforts so far is that only five investors have invested $2.5 million, a far cry from his goal.

55d618d71bf3721dfb4b980a304240a2a831a840.sourceText: 奥巴马一直倡导被称为EB-5的移民计划，以此作为创造就业的引擎。去年一财年美国企业通过此计划募集了超过18亿美元。7641位希望成为美国移民的人被授予签证，其中80%是中国人。但正如冯特拉普发现的，潜在投资者正变得越来越挑剔。
55d618d71bf3721dfb4b980a304240a2a831a840.translatedText: Obama has long championed the immigration program known as EB-5 as an engine for job creation. U.S. companies raised more than $1.8 billion through this program last fiscal year. Visas were granted to 7,641 people who wished to immigrate to the United States, 80% of whom were Chinese. But as von Trapp discovered, potential investors are becoming increasingly picky.

3075fb39b14c2d5a9b56eca2602c0826d058eb89.sourceText: 金融危机以来，无数美国公司利用EB-5项目筹资。希望投资的中国人数量猛增，助长了热潮。成百上千家中国的移民咨询公司帮助美企寻找投资者，从中收取手续费和佣金，最高达到每名投资者17.5万美元。（但）一些项目并未提供足够多就业机会，导致美移民机构扣发绿卡。还有消息说，一些投资资金消失在那些破产企业或彻头彻尾的欺诈中。
3075fb39b14c2d5a9b56eca2602c0826d058eb89.translatedText: Since the financial crisis, countless American companies have used the EB-5 project to raise funds. The boom has been fueled by a surge in the number of Chinese looking to invest. Hundreds of Chinese immigration consulting companies help U.S. companies find investors and charge fees and commissions, which can reach up to US$175,000 per investor. (But) some projects did not provide enough employment opportunities, causing the US immigration agency to withhold green cards. There are also reports that some investment funds disappeared into bankrupt businesses or outright frauds.

b5cf7730f9df02ec6699212b9d21fcb37916fc91.sourceText: 美证券交易委员会上月表示在芝加哥联邦法院提起首宗针对EB-5项目的诉讼，称一酒店会展中心项目推广人员以欺诈手段售出超过1.45亿美元证券，并从250多位中国投资者那里收取了1100万美元的行政事业性费用。
b5cf7730f9df02ec6699212b9d21fcb37916fc91.translatedText: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission said last month it filed the first lawsuit against the EB-5 project in Chicago federal court, claiming that a hotel and convention center project promoter fraudulently sold more than $145 million in securities and collected $11 million in administrative fees from more than 250 Chinese investors.

189ca9ac4a02acf20c8bb0e03bad3fe746befb8f.sourceText: 能力不足或诚信不足的美国生意人所宣传的问题项目令中国投资者不安。在上海为EB-5签证提供咨询的AlbertYoung说，没人真正了解规则，很多人为招揽投资者不惜做出虚假陈述。据他所知，有些中国家庭因为没有绿卡而被遣返回国。
189ca9ac4a02acf20c8bb0e03bad3fe746befb8f.translatedText: Questionable projects promoted by American businessmen with insufficient ability or integrity have made Chinese investors uneasy. Albert Young, who advises on EB-5 visas in Shanghai, said no one really understands the rules and many are willing to make false statements to attract investors. As far as he knows, some Chinese families have been deported back to their country because they did not have green cards.

5fc2b61ac0d3b5a5ca60fa7987eb49537a69e4bd.sourceText: 气如虹：说话也要讲技巧 凤凰城 气如虹 这两个月来，由于看到几个城市不同译名引起的困扰，增添与朋友们閒聊翻译的话题，进而注意到相似谐音闹笑话的事，还发觉我们日常的谈话，发言和聆听之间，存在误会的机率甚高，稍为疏忽则产生反效果，聆听发言必须谨慎，以免出错 ，铸成遗憾。同时，说话的人也有责任，小心谈吐，语气清楚，勿令人误解。 从种种资料显示，人与人沟通一定要互相对话，那是最原始的动作，也是永恒不变的姿态；惟一差別，是不同语言须靠翻译表达思维，其他对答方面完全无异；不论什么民族，说听之间处境都一样。也就是说，聆听者固然要谨慎小心，发言者也不可大意；在人际关系相当密切的社会，说话要有分寸，不能胡言乱语，所谓「出得你口，入得人耳」，留有深刻印象；若总是说三道四，不理会別人感受，「得罪人多，称呼人少」，便会口舌招尤，惹火烧身。 在现实社会里，说话也要讲技巧，因应情势发言，不要信口开河，不要反口覆舌。「一言既出，驷马难追」，是人们明白的道理；「一言九鼎」，可知说话的重要性，千万不要胡说八道；「一诺千金」，指出说话要算数，不轻言许诺，答应下来就要履行。 社会上，每人都要说话，每天都要说话。有人说话很悅耳，有人说话很难听，这就有关说话的技巧问题。在社交场合，互相谈话，须具备起码的认识，不要自说自话，目空一切，应顾及对方的感受。无论是首先发言或者回答话题，也要审视眼前情况，说出恰当的语句，展现本身的品格与说话的技巧。 有位美女穿着一套漂亮礼服出席宴会，获得朋友大加赞赏，她却说：「不算美呀，这衣服我在平货摊贩处购买嘛。」她以为这样是自谦，实是不适当的回答，使到赞美者有自讨没趣的尴尬。 有的人很懂得说话。早期在越南堤岸，有位售卖祭帐店子的老板，遇见分別很久的朋友，寒暄过后，此君竟然不懂忌讳，询问「生意好吗？」这是相当难以回答的话题，那老板却轻描淡写，非常技巧地回应：「噢，人家平安我大吉咯！」 众所周知，在广东人的圈子里，广东话的「空」与「凶」同音，为了忌讳，凡是空的都以「吉」代替，故而有吉房、吉屋、吉地等词句出现，至於「大吉」，则有两个解释，正面是指非常吉利，相反即是什么都没有，商店亏本结束营业，便叫关门大吉。该祭帐店老板说「人家平安我大吉」，表示別人家里平安没有丧事，自己当然生意空白，没有收入了。 另外一则讲究说话技巧的，是一位象棋高手，在社团中颇有名气，形成态度有点傲慢，一次，有位棋艺更厉害的友人，看不顺眼，决心要挫其锐气，邀请他切磋棋艺，比赛胜负。结果连续三盘，他都败北，回到家里，左邻右舍询问结果如何，他若无其事地说：「棋赛相当精彩，我俩棋艺不相伯仲，势均力敌，绞尽脑汁应付每一步棋，第一盘我没有赢，第二盘他没有输，第三盘，我要求和局，他偏偏不肯，没办法！」 哈哈！这就是说话也要讲技巧，明明失败了，却说得非常动听，等于「屡战屡败」改为「屡败屡战」一般，属于巧妙的措词。 最近这一阵子，美国总统川普和朝鲜金正恩的对话，同样是运用说话的技巧， 互相过招。金说：「美国必须好好想想，和南朝鲜当局联合举行喧嚣的军事挑衅，拟议中的北韩与美国高峰会将有什么命运？」弦外之音是想取消会晤，但不明言，以留有转圜余地；川普的回应：「很遗憾，基於你最近声明中展示的极度愤怒与公开敌意，我感觉目前举行这一筹划已久的会谈并不合适。」跟著，也巧妙地安排挽留语调：「为了朝鲜人民的福祉，以后还有机会举行两国峰会的。」 这两国元首的对话，同样讲究技巧，只不过，带有浓厚孩子气，好像两个顽皮淘气的儿童，爱玩耍，又爱捣蛋，恼怒的时候互相谩骂，互相威吓，过后心平气和，又高兴称赞著对方，一会儿又赌气，不同你玩了。虽然各自施展说话技巧，却嫌过於儿戏，不值得效法。
5fc2b61ac0d3b5a5ca60fa7987eb49537a69e4bd.translatedText: Qi Ruhong: You also need to be skillful in speaking. Phoenix Qi Ruhong In the past two months, due to the trouble caused by different translations of several cities, I have increased the topic of translation with my friends, and then noticed the similar homophonic jokes. I also discovered that in our daily conversations, between speaking and listening, there is a high chance of misunderstanding. A slight negligence will have the opposite effect. We must be careful when listening to avoid mistakes and regrets. At the same time, the speaker also has the responsibility to be careful with his words and speak clearly so as not to be misunderstood. Various data show that when people communicate, they must talk to each other. It is the most primitive action and an eternal gesture. The only difference is that different languages ​​must rely on translation to express thoughts. There is no difference in other aspects of dialogue. No matter what nationality, the situation between speaking and listening is the same. In other words, listeners must be cautious, but speakers must not be careless. In a society with very close interpersonal relationships, one must speak in a measured manner and not talk nonsense. As the saying goes, "what goes out of your mouth, goes into other people's ears," will leave a deep impression. If you always make irresponsible remarks, ignore the feelings of others, and "offend many people, but praise few people," you will be in trouble with your words and get burned. In the real world, you need to be skillful when speaking, speak according to the situation, and don't talk nonsense or regurgitate. "A word once spoken is hard to follow" is a truth that people understand; "A word is worth a thousand words" shows the importance of speaking, and you must not talk nonsense; "A promise is worth a thousand gold" means that you must keep your words, do not make promises lightly, and you must fulfill your promises. In society, everyone has to speak, every day. Some people's words are pleasant to the ear, while others' words are difficult to hear. This is a matter of speaking skills. In social situations, when talking to each other, you must have a basic understanding. Don't talk to yourself and be arrogant. You should take the other person's feelings into consideration. Whether you are speaking first or answering the topic, you must also examine the situation at hand, speak appropriate sentences, and show your character and speaking skills. A beautiful woman attended a banquet wearing a beautiful dress and was highly praised by her friends. However, she said, "It's not beautiful. I bought this dress at a street vendor." She thought this was a modesty, but it was an inappropriate answer that made the person who praised her feel embarrassed. Some people know how to talk. In the early days of Vietnam, there was an owner of a shop that sold ritual tents on the embankment. He met a friend whom he had not seen for a long time. After exchanging pleasantries, he unexpectedly asked, "How is the business?" As we all know, in the circle of Cantonese people, the words "empty" and "unfortunate" in Cantonese have the same pronunciation. To avoid taboos, everything that is empty is replaced by "auspicious", so there are words such as auspicious house, auspicious house, auspicious place, etc. As for "lucky", there are two interpretations. The positive side means that it is very auspicious, and the opposite side means that there is nothing. If a store closes its business at a loss, it is called closed. The owner of the memorial service store said, "I'm lucky if others are safe." He meant that other people's homes were safe and there were no funerals, so of course his business would be empty and he would have no income. Another story about speaking skills was about a chess master who was well-known in the club and had a somewhat arrogant attitude. Once, a friend who was even better at chess didn't like it and was determined to dampen his spirit. He invited him to discuss their chess skills and determine the outcome of the game. As a result, he lost three consecutive games. When he returned home, his neighbors asked about the result. He said nonchalantly: "The chess match was quite exciting. Our chess skills were equally matched. We were evenly matched and racked our brains to deal with every move. I didn't win the first game, but he didn't lose the second game. In the third game, I asked for a draw, but he just refused. There was nothing we could do!" Haha! This means that you need to be skillful in speaking. You have obviously failed, but you still say it very beautifully. It is like changing "repeated battles and defeats" to "repeated defeats and battles". It is a clever wording. Recently, the dialogue between US President Trump and North Korea's Kim Jong-un also uses speaking skills to compete with each other. Kim said: "The United States must think carefully about the fate of the proposed summit between North Korea and the United States if it jointly holds noisy military provocations with the South Korean authorities." The implication is that he wants to cancel the meeting, but does not say it clearly to leave room for maneuver; Trump's response: "It's very "Unfortunately, based on the extreme anger and open hostility shown in your recent statement, I feel that it is not appropriate to hold this long-planned meeting at this time." Then, he also cleverly arranged the tone of reservation: "For the well-being of the North Korean people, there will be opportunities to hold summits between the two countries in the future." The dialogue between the two heads of state also requires skills, but it is full of childishness, like two naughty children who love to play and make trouble. When they are angry, they scold and intimidate each other, then they become calm and happily praise each other, and then they are angry and stop playing with you. Although they each used their speaking skills, they thought it was too childish and not worthy of imitation.

7ba3455af59de35aac7f9f983e9958e3a40d71ed.sourceText: 对于这种说法我持有比较强烈的反对意见，经过反复观看比赛录像， http://www.youtube.com/v/3wfUTYhURTw 尤其是6分钟的时候的特写以后，我个人认为，假如要给出一个是否故意的百分比的话，我认为罗伯斯80%是故意的。理由称述如下：
7ba3455af59de35aac7f9f983e9958e3a40d71ed.translatedText: I have a strong objection to this statement. After repeatedly watching the game video, http://www.youtube.com/v/3wfUTYhURTw, especially the close-up at 6 minutes, I personally think that if a percentage is given as to whether it was intentional, I think 80% of Robles did it on purpose. The reasons are stated as follows:

5a32a0362354cc10dbc587e534135b15e7c571f8.sourceText: 1. 第一次打手未遂。请大家注意罗伯斯五指张开的程度，一般只有人在踉跄，中心部 位的时候才会出于本能的把五指张开，以备在跌倒是撑住地地面。而当时罗伯斯根本没 有出现踉跄或者中心不稳的情况，所以这种手部动作是极不寻常的。
5a32a0362354cc10dbc587e534135b15e7c571f8.translatedText: > 1. The first thug attempt failed. Please pay attention to the degree of opening of Robles's five fingers. Generally, only when a person is staggering, he will instinctively open his five fingers in the center to support himself on the ground in case of a fall. At that time, Robles did not stagger or be unstable at all, so this hand movement was extremely unusual.

429886eec2bae321378d19bdf9c2ad4d318eb308.sourceText: 2. 很多人认为第一条不够有说服力。那我们来看第二次的打手成功。比较第一次未遂 和第二次成功，我们会发现一个更加不寻常的端倪。一个技术成熟的运动员技术成形是 经过千百次的机械运动形成条件反射形成的，是非常稳定的。而比较第一次和第三次打 手的甩臂的高度差就会发现两者差距甚大，第二次远高于第一次，摄像机是固定的，给 我们提供了极好的高度参照。这说明第一次罗伯斯没有捞到以后，故意抬高了手臂以提 高打到的几率。并且在第二次打手的同时，罗伯斯开始很明显的向刘翔靠近。
429886eec2bae321378d19bdf9c2ad4d318eb308.translatedText: 2. Many people think the first one is not convincing enough. Let's look at the success of the second thug. Comparing the first attempt and the second success, we will find an even more unusual clue. A technically mature athlete's technical formation is formed through conditioned reflexes through thousands of mechanical movements, and is very stable. Comparing the height difference between the thug's swing arm for the first time and the third time, you will find that the difference between the two is very large. The second time is much higher than the first time. The camera is fixed, which provides us with an excellent height reference. This shows that after Robles failed to catch the fish the first time, he deliberately raised his arm to increase the chance of hitting it. And while hitting him for the second time, Robles began to obviously get closer to Liu Xiang.

c3397f4d571779170f7e3c1759e54cc1599506b6.sourceText: 3. 我们再来看，还是基于技术成熟的运动员技术是非常稳定的这有点，第三次的打手 就更加不寻常。假如说手臂高度差存在随机性（虽然我不是很认可，或者认为这种随机 性在千百次强化条件反射以后已经非常小），那第三次打手手部动作竟然由五指张开状 变成了握拳状，并且小臂肌肉有一个明显的紧绷的过程。所以这时候罗伯斯已经靠的离 刘翔更近了，认为已经没有必要张开五指捞了，同时我个人觉得也更有可能罗伯斯发现 打手对他的速度影响并不大，并且终点线就在眼前，就只加握拳，紧绷小臂肌肉。
c3397f4d571779170f7e3c1759e54cc1599506b6.translatedText: 3. Let’s look at it again. Based on the fact that the skills of mature athletes are very stable, the third hitter is even more unusual. If there is randomness in the height difference of the arms (although I don't really agree with it, or think that this randomness has been very small after thousands of times of intensive conditioned reflexes), then the hand movement of the beater turned from the spread of the five fingers to the shape of a fist for the third time, and there was an obvious tightening process in the forearm muscles. So at this time, Robles was already closer to Liu Xiang, thinking that there was no need to open his fingers to fish. At the same time, I personally think it is more likely that Robles found that the thug had little effect on his speed, and the finish line was in front of him, so he just clenched his fists and tightened his forearm muscles.

16914b0e4d0bae9aa4c27a027d834dbf366de2a8.sourceText: 4. 回头看罗伯斯向刘翔靠近的过程，也存在这明显的故意性。靠近不是由于中心不稳 ，并且不是匀速的。
16914b0e4d0bae9aa4c27a027d834dbf366de2a8.translatedText: 4. Looking back at the process of Robles approaching Liu Xiang, there is also this obvious intentionality. The approach is not due to center instability and is not uniform.

71b991ad975be521429b96c2d11458c9ff2b4946.sourceText: 基于以上4点arguements，我认为故意性应该在80左右。假如要还原事件应该是这样的 ，罗伯斯在刘翔后半程强大的冲刺能力的压力下”激情”决定打手，第一次张开五指， 没有捞到，第二次抬高了甩臂高度，并且张开五指，终于打手成功，同时开始想刘翔靠 近（靠近应该是和抬高甩臂高度的决定同时做出的，都是为了增加打到的几率）。第三 次罗伯斯认为已经离刘翔够近了，所以必要再张开手指捞，也同时是因为罗伯斯发现打 手对他的速度影响并不大，并且终点线就在眼前，就只加握拳，紧绷小臂肌肉，直接以 小臂横击刘翔小臂。最后怕罪行暴露，赶紧拥抱，其实为欲盖弥彰。刘翔最后冲刺的表 情可以陪台词：WTF！ 有也反驳者认为”故意的话之前还真的要好好练，打手还要节奏不受影响”。对于这种 说法的前半句话，我想故意性不等于有预谋性，激情犯罪也是故意的，但不是有预谋的 ，就如药家鑫的激情杀人0.0 对于后半句话，可以想象，打手对于施加的一方来说是有 准备的，所以他的节奏不会手太大印象，而对于遭受的一方来说完全没有心理准备，节 奏很容易被打乱。
71b991ad975be521429b96c2d11458c9ff2b4946.translatedText: Based on the above 4 arguments, I think the intentionality should be around 80. If we want to restore the incident, it should be like this. Robles "passionately" decided to hit under the pressure of Liu Xiang's strong sprinting ability in the second half of the race. He opened his five fingers for the first time and failed to catch it. He raised the height of his swing arm and opened his five fingers for the second time. Finally, he succeeded in hitting. At the same time, he began to want Liu Xiang to get closer (the approach should be made at the same time as the decision to raise the height of his swing arm, both to increase the chance of hitting). The third time, Robles thought he was close enough to Liu Xiang, so he needed to open his fingers to fish again. At the same time, Robles found that the thug had little effect on his speed, and the finish line was in front of him, so he just clenched his fist, tightened his forearm muscles, and directly struck Liu Xiang's forearm with his forearm. In the end, he was afraid that his crime would be exposed, so he hugged him quickly, which was actually to cover up his crime. Liu Xiang's expression during the final sprint can accompany his line: WTF! Some rebuttals said, "If you do it on purpose, you really need to practice well beforehand, and the beater's rhythm must not be affected." For the first half of this statement, I think intentionality does not mean premeditation. Crimes of passion are also intentional, but not premeditated, just like Yao Jiaxin's passion killing 0.0. For the second half of the sentence, it is conceivable that the thug is well prepared for the inflicting party, so his rhythm will not make too big an impression, but for the victim, there is no psychological preparation at all, and the rhythm is easily disrupted.

a93e5a5ba3444418faa3f12ae79e83870b485cc9.translatedText: Fuel prices drop again, but they may rise at any time (Alberta Times) The Arizona Automobile Association said that after several consecutive weeks of decline, the state's auto fuel prices may rise at any time...

73770b948501ce43a40b5052d72833858d67cdca.sourceText: 燃油价再降 但攀升随时可能 （亚省时报）亚利桑那汽车协会说，经过连续数周下行后，本州汽车燃油价格有随时攀升的可能。 上周，东谷的油价又跌了。周四，燃油平均价为$3.026，比前一周降了0.03美分。当天，全州无铅普通汽油平均价为3.27美元，比前一周低了一美分。 七月，本州的燃油价格降了15美分。但AAA说，预计本州在8月将经历一个小幅上升，为2009年以来的首次。 ”数周来价格跌幅收窄，表明亚利桑那州在过去四个月中享有的燃油价格红利很快走到尽头，”亚利桑那州汽车协会的通信和公共事务总监琳达格尔曼说。 ”如无意外，这种上扬应该是暂时的，到夏季驾驶高峰期结束，炼油厂过渡到使用跟便宜的冬季混合燃料时，油价将再次下降。” 上周四，全国油价平均为3.53美元，同比增长超过4美分。 图森油价是全州最低，每加仑3.16美元，旗杆埠最高，每加仑3.52美元。
73770b948501ce43a40b5052d72833858d67cdca.translatedText: Fuel prices drop again, but they may rise at any time (Alberta Times) The Arizona Automobile Association said that after several consecutive weeks of decline, the state's auto fuel prices may rise at any time. Last week, gas prices in the East Valley fell again. On Thursday, the average price of fuel was $3.026, down 0.03 cents from the previous week. The statewide average price for unleaded regular gasoline that day was $3.27, one cent lower than the previous week. In July, fuel prices in the state dropped 15 cents. But AAA said it expects the state to experience a slight increase in August for the first time since 2009. "The narrowing of price declines over the past few weeks suggests that the fuel price dividend Arizona has enjoyed over the past four months is quickly coming to an end," said Linda Gelman, director of communications and public affairs for the Arizona Automobile Association. "Barring no surprises, this increase should be temporary, and by the time the peak summer driving season is over and refineries transition to using cheaper winter fuel blends, oil prices will fall again." On Thursday, the national average oil price was $3.53, an increase of more than 4 cents year-over-year. Gas prices in Tucson are the lowest in the state at $3.16 per gallon, while Flagstaff has the highest prices at $3.52 per gallon.

9bb219ca35cd3f8d1731335ac51eb37ffa54265d.sourceText: 黄慧莉律师法律信箱（十五） 1． 我现在是否可为我小孩办Obama 总统在2012 年6月15日发布的延缓驱逐二年，并申请工作许可﹖ 他在两年前已有递解出境令﹖ 申请非多少﹖ 答﹕2012年8月15日起﹐只要符合规定的人可以向已民局申请2年工作许可﹐包括已被递解出境者﹐申移民局请费为$465 期满还可申请延期。 申请人必须符合以下条件﹕?必须在16岁以前来美国﹐ ​​出生与1981年6月15日以后者?在2012年6月15日当天人在美国，并且已经持续居住在美国5年。 意即2007年6月15日一直住到现在﹐包括当时是偷渡美国﹐或合法进入美国﹐签证已过期者。?目前人正在就学，或已从高中毕业，或已经取得高中同等学历，或曾经当兵?未曾被判重罪、严重轻罪、或多个轻罪，也没有对国家机密或公共安全有威胁的人。?目前年龄15岁至30 岁半。 这对很多从小就在美国读书生活，却因为没有合法身分而担心受怕会被遣返的人而言是个非常好的消息。 符合上述条件者不仅不会被遣返，还可以申请工作许可。 但是，这个延缓驱逐二年并可申请工作许可的命令是个暂时性的命令，未来能不能延期要视美国总统大选结果及国会立法来决定。 如果你本身有移民申请并或其他特殊情况的话，则要考虑后果，最好与移民律师沟通咨询。 2． 我与美国公民结婚3年在美国登记的，他从来没有主动为我申办绿卡。 婚后，他多次以欠债、买房子等事为由向我要钱。 我怀疑他是结婚骗钱，但又心存幻想，希望他能改好。 我们争吵的时候，他说你大陆的房产要给我一半。 有时他也对我有暴力行为 丈夫结婚骗钱，又不给办绿卡，他说我们在律师楼领的结婚证是无效的﹐如果我不给他钱﹐他要到中国和另一个女的结婚﹐我怎么办呢？ 答：你的先生是美国公民。 如果他对你有家暴行为，即便他从未为你申请过绿卡，你也可以自己单独为自己申请绿卡。 我们还想让你明白的是，家庭暴力除了打骂之外，还包括精神虐待、经济虐待等。 所以，你应该把你的婚后状况与有经验的律师详谈。 如果你先生在没有与你离婚再去大陆与别人结婚，那他就是犯了重婚罪，就要受到法律的制裁。 另外他若真是这样做了，这也是家庭暴力的一种。 还有，美国律师是没有资格开具结婚证书的。 在美国，结婚双方要到自己所在的地方政府有关部门登记结婚，完成所有登记手续，拿到政府颁发的结婚证书，双方的婚姻才有效。
9bb219ca35cd3f8d1731335ac51eb37ffa54265d.translatedText: Lawyer Huang Huili's legal mailbox (15) 1. Can I now apply for the two-year moratorium on deportations issued by President Obama on June 15, 2012, and apply for a work permit for my child? He had a deportation order two years ago? How much does it cost to apply? Answer: Starting from August 15, 2012, as long as those who meet the requirements can apply to the Immigration Bureau for a 2-year work permit, including those who have been deported, the application fee for the Immigration Bureau is $465. You can also apply for an extension after the expiration date. Applicants must meet the following conditions: They must have come to the United States before the age of 16, be born after June 15, 1981, be in the United States on June 15, 2012, and have continuously resided in the United States for 5 years. This means that they have been living in the United States from June 15, 2007 until now, including those who smuggled themselves into the United States or entered the United States legally and whose visa has expired. ?The person is currently in school, has graduated from high school, or has obtained a high school equivalency degree, or has served in the military? ?Has not been convicted of a felony, gross misdemeanor, or multiple misdemeanors, and has not been a threat to state secrets or public safety. ?Currently aged 15 to 30 and a half years old. This is very good news for many people who have been studying and living in the United States since childhood, but are worried about being deported because they have no legal status. Those who meet the above conditions will not only not be deported, but can also apply for a work permit. However, this order to postpone deportation for two years and allow people to apply for work permits is a temporary order. Whether it can be extended in the future depends on the results of the US presidential election and congressional legislation. If you have an immigration application or other special circumstances, you have to consider the consequences and it is best to communicate with an immigration lawyer. 2． I have been married to an American citizen for 3 years and registered in the United States. He has never taken the initiative to apply for a green card for me. After marriage, he asked me for money many times on the grounds of debts, buying a house, etc. I suspected that he was cheating for money through marriage, but I still harbored illusions and hoped that he could change for the better. When we were arguing, he said he would give me half of your mainland property. Sometimes he also behaves violently towards me. My husband cheated me out of marriage and refused to apply for a green card. He said that the marriage certificate we obtained at the lawyer's office was invalid. If I don't give him money, he will go to China to marry another woman. What should I do? Answer: Your husband is an American citizen. If he has committed domestic violence against you, you can apply for a green card for yourself even if he has never applied for a green card for you. What we also want you to understand is that in addition to beating and scolding, domestic violence also includes mental abuse, financial abuse, etc. Therefore, you should discuss your post-marital situation in detail with an experienced lawyer. If your husband goes to the mainland to marry someone else before divorcing you, then he has committed bigamy and will be punished by law. In addition, if he really does this, it is also a type of domestic violence. Also, American lawyers are not qualified to issue marriage certificates. In the United States, both parties must register their marriage with the relevant local government departments where they are located, complete all registration procedures, and obtain a marriage certificate issued by the government before the marriage is valid.
