170ad2067c4758ed87fc546bdd0f1472abe47c43.sourceText: 【凤凰笔会】慧明：秋瞥上海 图桑 慧明 秋天到了，鸽子又想穿过云端，去寻找蓝天。可在雾霾的压迫下，只得无奈…
170ad2067c4758ed87fc546bdd0f1472abe47c43.translatedText: [Phoenix PEN] Huiming: A glimpse of Shanghai in autumn Tucson Huiming Autumn is here, and the pigeons want to fly through the clouds again to find the blue sky. But under the pressure of the haze, we have no choice but...

39f3d624c9cabb53f41d2087efc9c90b2a8efdb4.sourceText: 秋天到了，鸽子又想穿过云端，去寻找蓝天。可在雾霾的压迫下，只得无奈地垂下翅膀，乖乖地做广场鸽。
39f3d624c9cabb53f41d2087efc9c90b2a8efdb4.translatedText: Autumn is here, and the pigeons want to go through the clouds again to find the blue sky. But under the pressure of the haze, I had no choice but to lower my wings and behave like a square pigeon.

5390b703c9a56113ca1b673a160d71783503060c.sourceText: 可永远向往赚钱的沪人依旧像鸽子一样，在城市里传诵、附和克强关于上海自贸区的兴奋。电视上的官员一如既往地陈述大报的精神：已经正式挂牌、登记入住如云；刚学会夹包的小白领，推一下眼镜，很城府地点着头：这是向新加坡的挑战，夺回世界第一贸易大港等等。外资中资银行还在推推搡搡，扭扭捏捏是否进驻外高桥的仓库，黄牛们却在登记处排起了长队，抢注地盘，拿出当年购买认购证那样的热情。不曾想地铁上休闲的老姐俩说话误遮拦，吴侬沪语随着车厢咣当宣扬：啥个自贸区，就像小菜场，摆只摊头只管自己买自己卖。好像一语道破天机似的。
5390b703c9a56113ca1b673a160d71783503060c.translatedText: But Shanghainese, who are always eager to make money, are still like pigeons, spreading and echoing Keqiang’s excitement about the Shanghai Free Trade Zone in the city. The officials on the TV stated the spirit of the big newspaper as always: it has been officially listed and checked in like a cloud; the young white-collar worker who had just learned to pack his bag pushed up his glasses and nodded politely: This is a challenge to Singapore, to regain the world's largest trading port, etc. Foreign-funded and Chinese-funded banks are still pushing and shoving, hesitating whether to enter the warehouse in Waigaoqiao, but scalpers lined up at the registration office to grab the site, showing the same enthusiasm as when they bought subscription certificates. Unexpectedly, the two old ladies relaxing on the subway accidentally blocked their words, and Wu Nong's Shanghainese was loudly preaching along with the carriage: What kind of free trade zone is like a small market, just set up a stall and just buy and sell by yourself. It was as if the secret had been revealed.

d37cd0d226c6792a328d8475ff1c6b5ff88afbae.sourceText: 哪怕再涌出一万幢高楼，哪怕天上掉下个金銮殿来，上海人都晓得，那不属于自己。最实惠的是吃到自己肚皮里的东西。你开你的香格里拉五星级酒店，我照样在侬对面的弄堂幺泥角落开个小店，卖盐水毛豆、百叶干丝加特色红烧肉的家常小菜。大酒店辉煌不再，却不防碍招待所大饭堂生意红火—放下身段，茅台装进矿泉水瓶避一下岐山风头也未尝不可。秋风骤起，大闸蟹成了所有河蟹毛蟹的代名称，什么蟹只要绑住张牙舞爪就是大闸蟹，一下从能从水坑池塘爬上厅堂，那店即使原先叫小吃排挡也即刻蓬荜增辉，人气顿升。上海也跟着提升名气，好像大闸蟹是沪上的土产名牌似的。
d37cd0d226c6792a328d8475ff1c6b5ff88afbae.translatedText: Even if 10,000 more high-rise buildings emerge, even if a golden palace falls from the sky, the people of Shanghai will know that it does not belong to them. The most affordable thing is to eat what is in your own belly. You open your five-star Shangri-La Hotel, and I will open a small shop in the Yaoni corner of the alley opposite Nong, selling home-cooked side dishes of salted edamame, dried shredded louver and special braised pork. The grand hotel is no longer glorious, but it does not hinder the prosperous business of the guest house's dining room - it is not a bad idea to put down your posture and put in a bottle of mineral water from Maotai to avoid the limelight of Qishan. The autumn wind blows suddenly, and hairy crabs have become the synonym for all river crabs. Any crab that can be tied up and show its claws is a hairy crab. It can climb from the puddle pond to the hall at once. Even if the restaurant was originally called a snack stall, it will immediately become more popular and popular. Shanghai has also increased its reputation, as if hairy crabs are a famous local product in Shanghai.

41a17d80c0354222cbe97fb270d891802f3dc99f.sourceText: 老百姓吃的比先前好多了，虽然五元一笼小包让工薪者都能尝得起，但退休老人依旧在汤面里漂几片菜叶打发幸福时光。新亚大包豆浆油条挡不住洋叔麦当劳、必胜客联袂进攻，也禁不起兰州拉面、四川火锅和肉馅饼肉夹馍围追堵截，在年青人和学生里逐渐失去了地盘。但低端吃相不会破坏在高层旋转餐厅里俯瞰芸芸众生的好口味、好心情，歌舞生平的大小戏依然在云端剧场天天上演。
41a17d80c0354222cbe97fb270d891802f3dc99f.translatedText: The common people are eating much better than before. Although the five-yuan packets make it affordable for working-class people, retired elderly people still spend their happy time floating a few vegetable leaves in soup noodles. Xinya's big bags of soy milk and fried dough sticks couldn't stop the joint attack of McDonald's and Pizza Hut, nor could they withstand the pursuit of Lanzhou ramen, Sichuan hot pot and meat pies and steamed buns. They gradually lost ground among young people and students. However, the low-end food will not destroy the good taste and good mood of overlooking all living beings in the high-rise revolving restaurant. The dramas of singing and dancing life are still performed every day in the cloud theater.

55f7bf83727a476d1565a2d75e095fa6d5f98318.sourceText: 酒一下肚，不管真假，人们立马豪气万丈，不管校友朋友聚会，还是家宴小聚，口气便似平地起高楼那般，让人不知深浅：您先打二十万到帐上，以后的事好说。或者浪头比天高：关掉那个终端，不过损失几百万云云。好在无论街上还是车上十个中有八个都在崇拜乔布斯，看手机，玩手指，没人关心别人的口水乱溅。股评家即便没喝两盅，也胆大包天，才不在乎给人下套之嫌，依旧一次又一次大胆地为人们画着馅饼一样的陷阱；官倒从钢材到武器，民倒从网购到网卖，一切到了台上都变成了商业家。全民都高唱着现在是金融以钱生钱的时代，以钱为成功的标志，像当年全民摇语录，打鸡血那般兴奋。每个人都摸着自己认为最靠谱的那块石头过河上岸，不管那块石头是否有被人丢弃的历史。唯有实业家反倒羞羞涩涩，唯唯诺诺不敢大发声，夹着尾巴过活，生怕哪天税务、卫生城管、公安找上门来寒暄喝茶。
55f7bf83727a476d1565a2d75e095fa6d5f98318.translatedText: After drinking, no matter whether it is true or false, people are immediately arrogant. Whether it is a gathering of alumni and friends or a family dinner, their tone is like building a high-rise building from the ground up. Or the wave is as high as the sky: shutting down that terminal will only result in a loss of millions. Fortunately, eight out of ten people on the street or in the car were worshiping Jobs, looking at their phones and playing with their fingers, and no one cared about other people's saliva. Even if stock commentators haven't had a drink, they are still so bold that they don't care about being suspected of tricking others, and they still boldly draw pie-like traps for people again and again; from steel to weapons, from online shopping to online selling, everyone has become a businessman on the stage. The whole people are singing that now is an era in finance where money is used to make money, and money is the symbol of success. They are as excited as when the people shook the quotations and got chicken blood. Everyone crosses the river and gets on the shore by touching the stone they think is most reliable, regardless of whether that stone has a history of being discarded. Only the industrialists are shy, submissive and do not dare to speak out loudly, living with their tail between their legs, for fear that one day the tax, health and urban management, and police will come to greet them and drink tea.

708d1977565c0d0a1c6d4ec3a9a5d81ee1eba126.sourceText: 上海已经是年轻人的天下。早上九点前地铁里的老人和沪语几乎都是异类，热热闹闹地混杂着中国国语和无数方言以及德语英语马来语的十六条地铁，载着无数的青年才俊和草根每天从哪里来，再带回哪里去。地铁上喧哗的话题比过去少得多，尽管打电话的效果比过去好得多。但显现的见解和时髦依然令人耳目一新。有点雾霾算什么，可以挡掉紫外线，侬现在晓得上海小姑娘为啥这样白！这个”霾”我读书的辰光倒不认得，现在广播里天天讲！年轻的中年的半老的让座给人的比过去多得多，尽管也有人心安理得地坐在老人专座上玩着手机。好在送菜到城市的菜农大妈有自己的扁担，很知趣很有效地用它抵抗着地铁的摇晃。
708d1977565c0d0a1c6d4ec3a9a5d81ee1eba126.translatedText: Shanghai is already dominated by young people. Before nine o'clock in the morning, the old people and Shanghainese speakers in the subway are almost all aliens. The sixteen subway lines are a lively mixture of Chinese Mandarin, countless dialects, German, English and Malay, carrying countless young talents and grassroots people from wherever they come every day, and take them back to where they are. There are far fewer noisy conversations on the subway than in the past, although making phone calls works much better than in the past. But the insights and fashion shown are still refreshing. A little haze is nothing, it can block ultraviolet rays. Now I know why the Shanghai girl is so white! I didn’t recognize this “haze” when I was studying, but now it’s talked about on the radio every day! There are far more young, middle-aged and middle-aged people giving up their seats to others than in the past, although there are also people who are sitting contentedly on the seats reserved for the elderly and playing with their mobile phones. Fortunately, the vegetable farmers who deliver vegetables to the city have their own carrying poles, and they use them wisely and effectively to resist the shaking of the subway.

7c5362edbffa4c526d4fa913550b3c2ba22c8ea9.sourceText: 走出任何一个地铁口，立即会被车水马龙的地面世界包围。交通设计者的现代缜密思路让老人和守规矩的人受益也困惑：绿灯人行道行走的老汉被转弯的汽车电动车逼得步履维艰；公交车停站放下升降台阶，让走路踉跄的长者体面地上了公交，不想急性的小伙却在接轨的平台上摔倒。几十上百个地铁口都有相应的公交车和摩托侍候，只要说得出地点，别人也听得懂，你便可以直达目的。遗憾常用沪语乡音问路，套个感情近乎，不想总遭横眉冷对：”请讲普通话”，愧得老者环顾四方，不知身首何处。
7c5362edbffa4c526d4fa913550b3c2ba22c8ea9.translatedText: Stepping out of any subway entrance, you will immediately be surrounded by the bustling world above. The modern and rigorous thinking of transportation designers benefits and confuses the elderly and rule-abiding people: an old man walking on a sidewalk with a green light is forced to walk hard by a turning electric vehicle; when a bus stops, the lift steps are put down to allow the staggering elderly to board the bus decently, but the impatient young man falls on the connecting platform. There are corresponding buses and motorcycles waiting at dozens or hundreds of subway entrances. As long as you can tell the location and others can understand it, you can reach your destination directly. It's a pity that I often ask for directions in the local dialect of Shanghainese to try to get close to each other. I don't want to be greeted coldly and coldly: "Please speak Mandarin." The old man looked around in shame and didn't know where he was.

716745ec0c8580e3580f27659dbfac20a135f998.sourceText: 街上车上家里饭桌十有八个低头总在找段子和信息，生怕错过一次将会永远失去晋升、发财和美女相遇的机会。手机导致文化娱乐化和简约，也造就一语道破天机的本事，让世人刮目相看。”捣浆糊”的提法还记忆犹新，”过度”便成今秋新宠。拿着老翁的医疗账单，虽然医生的龙飞凤舞书法大都不识，但天文数字的账单让老妪不禁喃喃自语”过度治疗，过度治疗”了。不想医生轻描淡写一哼，不过度，哪来奖金？
716745ec0c8580e3580f27659dbfac20a135f998.translatedText: Eight out of ten people on the street, in the car, or at the dinner table at home are always looking for jokes and information, for fear that if they miss one, they will forever lose the opportunity to get promoted, get rich, and meet beautiful women. Mobile phones have led to cultural entertainment and simplicity, and also created the ability to reveal secrets in one sentence, which has impressed the world. The reference to "mashing" is still fresh in my memory, and "excessive" has become a new favorite this autumn. Taking the old man's medical bill, although most of the doctors couldn't read his calligraphy, the astronomical bill made the old woman mutter to herself "over-treatment, over-treatment." I don’t want the doctor to make an understatement, but if I don’t overdo it, where will the bonus come from?

3b8eac6acdab16c73e4a80582f3eef84b121f567.translatedText: It must be said that it is incisive.

24d67955a3875613c89a7c67471c1b30f049895b.sourceText: 无数的高楼见缝插针地树立在每一块空地，压挤着原先亚洲第一高楼国际饭店不见了踪影，连同上海地质不宜造高层的说法统统被压到了地下，一劳永逸解决几代人造房的担忧。不过没人以为过度，只见地质学家托着领导蓝图说上海流沙沉淀适于高层建筑；外地人一喝上海饮水便知怪味，水质学家不像当年发声评价沪上的水质名列世界之末，只是强调什么样的口味熟悉了就好，黄浦江上秋天不会再漂死猪，水质明显提高。怪不得茶叶越卖越贵，唯有大红袍铁观音才能镇住各路邪水怪汤。汽车和口罩成正比互相攀升畅销，专家教授人文思想偶尔在经济大潮里露一下灵光，铮铮有词地论证着滚滚的汽车尾气与雾霾无关。
24d67955a3875613c89a7c67471c1b30f049895b.translatedText: Numerous high-rise buildings have been erected in every open space, squeezing the International Hotel, which was the tallest building in Asia, and disappeared. Together with the statement that Shanghai's geology is not suitable for building high-rise buildings, it has been pushed underground, once and for all, solving the worries of generations of man-made houses. However, no one thought it was excessive. The geologists, relying on the leader's blueprint, said that Shanghai's quicksand sedimentation is suitable for high-rise buildings. Outsiders will know the strange taste when drinking Shanghai's drinking water. Water quality scientists did not comment on the water quality in Shanghai as being the worst in the world. They only emphasized that familiar tastes are good. Pigs will not float to death on the Huangpu River in autumn, and the water quality has been significantly improved. No wonder tea becomes more and more expensive as it sells. Only the Dahongpao Tieguanyin can suppress all kinds of evil water monster soups. Cars and masks are increasing in sales in direct proportion to each other. Experts and professors' humanistic ideas occasionally show their light in the economic tide, arguing with eloquence that billowing car exhaust has nothing to do with smog.

620486975f6d4a212963a259a3eb02dcd7f8037e.sourceText: 在权势和财势面前，什么过度都属正能量，只有秋霾和冷雨在为上海的过度发展而轻轻呜咽
620486975f6d4a212963a259a3eb02dcd7f8037e.translatedText: In the face of power and wealth, any excess is a positive energy. Only the autumn haze and cold rain are gently sobbing for the excessive development of Shanghai

ec360eef1f0114e2e8cd231538c21f639ff47443.sourceText: 呜咽吧，什么都挡不住喜悦兴奋的家乡上海。哪怕《相约星期六》被《非诚勿扰》打得落花流水，没了踪影，却不妨碍无数大妈举着为女儿的佂婚牌，不惧日晒雨淋，演着一场又一场空山不见人的相亲记。哪怕兜里没几个钱，十元一条不知真假的真丝围巾比唱歌还好听。难忘今宵是官员和老人的最爱，上海人心里最喜欢的歌永远是明天会更好。画着蓝图在上海地面和地下搭着积木的人一个个远走高飞，或北上飞黄腾达，或身陷囹圄，都不妨碍欢乐百姓憧憬捂心—-该不会明天冒出个空中楼阁？
ec360eef1f0114e2e8cd231538c21f639ff47443.translatedText: Sob, nothing can stop the joy and excitement of my hometown Shanghai. Even though "Saturday Date" was completely beaten by "If You Are the One" and disappeared, it did not prevent countless aunts from holding wedding cards for their daughters, braving the sun and rain, and acting out one blind date after another without anyone in sight. Even if you don’t have much money in your pocket, a ten-yuan silk scarf of unknown authenticity is better than singing. "Unforgettable Tonight" is a favorite among officials and the elderly. The favorite song among Shanghainese people is always "Tomorrow Will Be Better". People who drew blueprints and built building blocks on the ground and underground in Shanghai have left one by one, gone north to achieve great success, or are in jail. This does not stop the happy people from holding their hearts in longing - will there be a castle in the air tomorrow?

f0f08368b83ea076d55fb0aade2ed38d919fa13e.sourceText: 上海，上海，好像天天与你见面，却又不识你真面目。犹如多年老友见面，声音脾性依旧，猛一谋面，惊诧不已，咋纵横多了这多皱纹?
f0f08368b83ea076d55fb0aade2ed38d919fa13e.translatedText: Shanghai, Shanghai, it seems like I see you every day, but I don’t know your true face. It's like meeting old friends for many years, their voices and temperaments remain the same. When they meet each other suddenly, they are surprised, why do they have so many wrinkles?

a9f7dbd1a4ca44921e35ce712de5de937853dc02.sourceText: 也许秋天就是这般，收获和失落并存，春天就不一样了？
a9f7dbd1a4ca44921e35ce712de5de937853dc02.translatedText: Maybe autumn is like this, gain and loss coexist, but spring is different?

3b53923fb21de0ea0d6c65d0fc816794bbe58c9f.sourceText: （美中文化艺术文交流协会 来稿）十一月三日和四日美中文化艺术文交流协会”汗血天馬”画家李成(范融)先生应邀在Chandler Mailton High school举行了為期两天的关於中国画的讲座。两天中约有150多名学生和部分老 师 参加了听课，他們十分认真地学習了觧了关于中国画的基夲知识和有关中国画和西洋画的不同处；以及相互之间的交流和影响等知识。随后大家又十分有兴趣地,认真地在画家的指导和盧老师的帮助下学习了如何画”櫻桃红了”. ”蝦趣”. ”年年有鱼”,”聖誕花红”等作品。
3b53923fb21de0ea0d6c65d0fc816794bbe58c9f.translatedText: (Contributed by the U.S.-China Cultural, Art and Cultural Exchange Association) On November 3rd and 4th, Mr. Li Cheng (Fan Rong), the "Sweat-blooded Pegasus" painter of the U.S.-China Cultural, Art and Cultural Exchange Association, was invited to hold a two-day lecture on Chinese painting at Chandler Mailton High School. During the two days, more than 150 students and some teachers participated in the lectures. They studied very seriously the basic knowledge of Chinese painting and the differences between Chinese painting and Western painting, as well as the mutual exchanges and influences. Then everyone was very interested and carefully learned how to paint "Cherry Red", "Shrimp Fun", "Fish Every Year", "Christmas Bonus" and other works under the guidance of the artist and the help of Teacher Lu.

036c190f7166b96c61760e9e4b10e12d61f1da12.sourceText: 作品展示（右 画家李成）

b9ad7826eca151599a608b1932d03fde297f01f3.sourceText: 许多同学非常开心並有成就感,这是一次愉快的成功的宏扬中华文化的活动,受到了同學们和老师们的热烈的欢迎,校长也特别写信表示感谢! 这是一次十分有意义的在年轻一代中培养和加強美中文化文流和友谊的活动的良好开端。
b9ad7826eca151599a608b1932d03fde297f01f3.translatedText: Many students were very happy and had a sense of accomplishment. This was a happy and successful event to promote Chinese culture. It was warmly welcomed by classmates and teachers. The principal also wrote a special letter to express his gratitude! This is a good start for a very meaningful event to cultivate and strengthen cultural exchanges and friendship between the United States and China among the younger generation.

ea27364fc12cac62f9d320b51402b66f888767ab.translatedText: Phoenix Chinese Christian Church’s community medical services bear witness to God’s great love [Phoenix Chinese Christian Church reported by Fengming] On the morning of October 27, 2012…

bfb2ce60e6874dd2c7013dfe3313856cc361f97d.sourceText: 凤凰城华人基督教会社区医疗服务一见证神的大爱 【 凤凰城华人基督教会 凤鸣报道 】 2012年10月27日早上8点钟，当我准时到达教会，看到教会的同工志愿者们都已到位，桌椅己摆放好、样样都井然有序。负责接待的同工们，面帶微笑热情地接待每一位来宾，根据来宾的要求，将他（她）们帶到每个检查项目的桌前，有秩序地排好队，有服务人员邦助填写所需要的表格，等待检查。 这次教会社區医疗服务，早在三个月前就己开始着手计划，由教会提供场所和义工，由亚省亚太社区促进会、KEEP Kidnry Early提供医疗资源。整个健康社区日提供〝免费乳癌和子宫颈癌检查〞，〝免费肾脏早期评估计划〞和〝免费接种流感疫苗〞以及测量血压、检血、血糖与验尿、胆固醇水平检测、量身高体重等各项服务。 这次教会社区医疗服务，教会有60多位同工参加服务，亚省亚太社区促进会请20多位医护人員参加。他 (她) 们从早上7点多就到达教会，每人在不同的岗位上，一直工作到下午1:00Pm结束。乳癌和子宫颈癌检查则延至下午5:00Pm才结束，辛勤工作了一整天，但他(她) 们每个人都很欣慰。因为据不完全统计，有350～400人受益。其中测血压、验血、血糖、验尿、胆固醇水平的受益人160位，乳房检查43位、流感疫苗160多位。其中包括中国人、韓国人、越南人、墨西哥人和少数美国人。他(她) 们大多是来美国移民、没有經济收入、需要邦助的社区居民。感谢神，通过教会这次的社区医疗服务，藉着医疗人員及同工们見証的爱心，使社区居民能感受到主的大爱，进而愿意听闻和接受福音。
bfb2ce60e6874dd2c7013dfe3313856cc361f97d.translatedText: Phoenix Chinese Christian Church’s community medical services bear witness to God’s great love [Phoenix Chinese Christian Church reported by Fengming] At 8 o'clock in the morning on October 27, 2012, when I arrived at the church on time, I saw that the church's co-workers and volunteers were all in place, the tables and chairs had been placed, and everything was in order. The co-workers in charge of the reception warmly received each guest with a smile. According to the guest's request, they were brought to the table of each inspection item and lined up in an orderly manner. There were service staff to help fill in the required forms and wait for the inspection. This church community medical service was planned as early as three months ago. The church provided the venue and volunteers, and the Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association of Asia and Pacific Asia and KEEP Kidnry Early provided medical resources. The entire healthy community day provides "free breast and cervical cancer screening", "free kidney early assessment program" and "free flu vaccination" as well as blood pressure measurement, blood test, blood sugar and urine test, cholesterol level test, height and weight measurement and other services. This time the church community medical service, more than 60 co-workers from the church participated in the service, and the Asia Pacific Community Promotion Association of Asia invited more than 20 medical staff to participate. They arrived at the church at around 7 a.m. and worked at different positions until 1:00 p.m. The breast cancer and cervical cancer examinations were postponed until 5:00 pm. It took a long day of hard work, but each of them was very happy. Because according to incomplete statistics, 350 to 400 people have benefited. Among them, 160 beneficiaries had their blood pressure, blood tests, blood sugar, urine tests, and cholesterol levels measured, 43 received breast examinations, and more than 160 received influenza vaccines. These include Chinese, Koreans, Vietnamese, Mexicans and a handful of Americans. Most of them are community residents who immigrated to the United States, have no financial income, and need state assistance. Thank God, through the church’s community medical service this time, and through the love witnessed by medical staff and co-workers, community residents can feel the great love of the Lord, and then be willing to hear and accept the gospel.

9cd8de72c2ca610d3a2d41b0f40d386769270df1.sourceText: 执法人员不好当 上周因公殉职的两名两名尤马郡边境巡逻员的告别仪式分别于周三和周四举行。他们是在 5 月 12 日驾驶 SUV 追捕毒贩过程中与火车相撞身亡的。 联邦调查局 (FBI)16 日公布的统计数据显示，去年全美有 56 名执法人员因公殉职，比 2009 年增加八人。 56 名被害警察中，除一人是被车撞死外，其余都是被枪打死， 38 人遇难时身穿防弹衣。 FBI 的初步数据显示，被谋杀的警察中有 15 人遭伏击遇害，八人在调查可疑人士过程中丧命，七人是在执行驾车追捕任务或拦检中死亡，六人是在前往处理骚乱时丧生，其余则在其他的执法任务中殉职。 此外，去年还有 72 名警察死于意外，比 2009 年的 48 人增加 50% 。被谋杀和因事故而死的警察人数， 2009 年分别都是 48 人。
9cd8de72c2ca610d3a2d41b0f40d386769270df1.translatedText: Farewell ceremonies for two Yuma County Border Patrol agents who died in the line of duty last week were held on Wednesday and Thursday respectively. They were killed when their SUV collided with a train while chasing drug dealers on May 12. Statistics released by the FBI on the 16th showed that 56 law enforcement officers died in the line of duty across the United States last year, eight more than in 2009. Among the 56 police officers killed, except for one who was hit by a car, the rest were shot to death. 38 of them were wearing body armor when they were killed. Preliminary FBI data shows that 15 of the murdered officers were ambushed, eight died while investigating suspicious persons, seven died during vehicle pursuits or stops, six died while responding to a disturbance, and the rest died in other law enforcement duties. Additionally, 72 police officers died in accidents last year, a 50 percent increase from 48 in 2009. The number of police officers murdered and killed in accidents was 48 each in 2009.

b15b2103c2252c96c2b22fe59e0a77e171d1e7fe.sourceText: 我们的朋友- 淑瑛! 我们怀念您! 作者: 黄慧莉律师 每周末,我都会照例的把我的法律专栏 Email给妳的亚美报,这样重复的动作算来是否也有10年了吧?最后一次妳给我 Email回复”谢谢”是2011年8月6日,我还正想打电话给妳问说: ”今年妳要回台湾看妳妈妈吗?”孝顺的妳总是每年回去,惦记着妈妈的身体,妳希望妈妈来美国住,但她不肯.去年妳回台湾,妳照样的在台湾辛苦得要把每周要出版的亚美报做好,然后遥控美国能及时印报. 去年为了我回台湾时不用另外买高速网络卡,替我省钱,妳还借我网络卡. 得知恶耗,我太震惊!发抖,流泪,无法接受!无法接受啊! 多年前,妳带妈妈来我办公室,她说我太瘦了,就哭了,我不好意思问为何哭,也许她知道我同她都是客家人,看我工作辛苦又胃口不好,心疼我,她的慈爱真心真令我感动! 后来,好友兰怡2005年骤然去世,我很难过,妳不断安慰我,告诉我妳姐姐在很年轻的时候,睡一觉第二天突然去世,妳们全家多年来都痛苦,特别是妈妈,但妳们仍要坚强过日子. 现在我无法想象她老人家如何面对生命? 或许妳也部份承袭了客家女人的勤奋血统,妳一人独撑亚美报,从打字,排版,邀搞,拉广告,大部份都一人包了,妳说拉广告部份是妳最弱的一环,不好意思向客户收广告费, 每周印报,送报, 因为经费不足,无法雇很多人,很多事情必须亲自亲为,我劝妳不要太辛苦了,但妳说没办法,先生女儿也一起帮妳做. 我想我欠妳很多散文吧? 除了每个月的法律专栏,妳也很辛苦邀搞,我后悔没帮妳更多一点,答应给亚美报写些散文但都没写,当我写这篇文章,都已太晚了. 惦记妳办报辛苦,我还帮妳联络了洛杉机的一家报社及印刷厂,发现他们的印刷费比凤凰城便宜很多,妳很兴奋,和特地到洛杉机和那老板谈,但发现,那位老板想有意用合作的方式以便他们要在凤凰城有些影响力,妳毅然决然得拒绝了,因为妳说,办报也是一种良心事业,妳不希望为了经费问题,而被一种政治思想控制,这样对读者不好,我佩服妳的公义正直. 上次一起吃饭时,妳说去 Washington D.C. 看妳上医学院的儿子,妳说妳很心疼,因为 D.C. 生活费很贵,儿子为了省钱,在很远的地方租房子,冰天雪地下,要走很远的路之后坐公交车,之后再坐轻轨电车,再走路到学校,非常辛苦,为了省机票钱找到特价回家的机票,他宁愿坐飞机到 Tucson 再开车回凤凰城?一边听妳描述,一边我都要跟着妳掉泪了,妳说妳看儿子回来之后,妳一直担心,一直无法释怀, 我还开玩笑说,我会麻烦住在 DC 的亲戚朋友,帮他介绍女朋友照顾他,要妳不要再想了,妳的儿女都非常独立,非常优秀, 拿最好的全额奖学金念大学,常为父母着想,也从不让父母担心他们, 有一对儿女如此,真得很为妳和妳的先生感到骄傲. 而妳的先生无怨无毁的支持妳,除了全时间工程师的工作外,也辛苦帮妳送报,真的是无庸致疑的好先生. 多年前妳说虽然和亚省时报的甄先生有些办报理念不同,但妳仍尊敬这位长者,甄太太身体不好,妳有空就要去看她,可见妳的爱心不会因为因情况不同而改变. 除了办报, 妳又热心小区的活动,好几次客家同乡会的活动,还是靠妳大力支持登报宣传呢!而且今年双十国百年国庆筹备,妳也大力帮忙,妳怎么就留下其他的工作人员独自离开呢?还有许多妳多年的朋友们呢?许多怅惘?许多无解?许多苦痛! 想起昨日种种都历历在目,无限悲戚!在我们心目中,妳永远那么爽朗,那么美丽, 那么热心助人. 妳的笑声,妳的爱心,将是在家人在朋友心目中永不抹灭的. 淑瑛!真的真的很怀念您!
b15b2103c2252c96c2b22fe59e0a77e171d1e7fe.translatedText: Our friend - Shu Ying! We miss you! Author: Lawyer Huang Huili Every weekend, I will email my legal column to your Asian American newspaper as usual. Does this repeated action last for 10 years? The last time you replied "Thank you" to my email was August 6, 2011. I was about to call you and ask: "Are you going back to Taiwan to see your mother this year?" Being filial, you always go back every year, thinking about your mother's health. You hope that your mother will come to live in the United States, but she refuses. Last year, when you returned to Taiwan, you still worked hard in Taiwan to prepare the Asian American newspaper that was published every week, and then remotely controlled the United States to print the newspaper in time. Last year, you lent me a network card so that I didn't have to buy another high-speed network card when I returned to Taiwan. This saved me money. I was so shocked when I learned the bad news! I was shaking and crying. I couldn't accept it! I couldn't accept it! Many years ago, you brought your mother to my office and she cried because she said I was too thin. I was embarrassed to ask why I was crying. Maybe she knew that she and I were both Hakkas. Seeing that I worked hard and had a bad appetite, she felt sorry for me. Her kindness really touched me! Later, my friend Lan Yi passed away suddenly in 2005. I was very sad. You kept comforting me and told me that your sister died suddenly the next day when she was very young. Your whole family has been in pain for many years, especially your mother, but you still have to live strong. Now I can't imagine how her old man faces life? Perhaps you also partly inherited the hard-working blood of Hakka women. You support Asia-American Newspaper by yourself, doing most of the work from typing, layout, invitations, and advertising. You say that advertising is your weakest part, and you are embarrassed to charge advertising fees from customers. You print and deliver newspapers every week. Due to lack of funds, we cannot hire many people, and we have to do a lot of things ourselves. I advise you not to work too hard, but you said you can't help it, so your husband and daughter also help you. I think I owe you a lot of essays, right? In addition to the monthly legal column, you also worked very hard to do it. I regret not helping you more. I promised to write some essays for the Asian American Newspaper but I didn't write them. When I wrote this article, it was too late. Thinking about your hard work in running a newspaper, I also helped you contact a newspaper and printing factory in Los Angeles. I found that their printing fees are much cheaper than those in Phoenix. You were very excited and went to Los Angeles to talk to the boss, but you found that the boss wanted to use cooperation. In order for them to have some influence in Phoenix, you resolutely refused because you said that running a newspaper is also a conscientious undertaking. You don't want to be controlled by a political ideology for the sake of funding. This is not good for readers. I admire your justice and integrity. The last time we had dinner together, you said that you were going to Washington D.C. to see your son who was in medical school. You said that you were very distressed because the cost of living in D.C. was very expensive. In order to save money, your son rented a house far away in the snow and ice. He had to walk a long way, take a bus, then take a light rail tram, and then walk to school. It was very hard. In order to save money on air tickets, he found a special ticket home. He would rather fly to Tucson. Driving back to Phoenix? As I listened to your description, I almost cried with you. You said that after your son came back, you were worried and couldn't let it go. I also joked that I would trouble my relatives and friends living in DC to introduce him to a girlfriend to take care of him. I asked you to stop thinking about it. Your children are very independent and outstanding. They went to college with the best full scholarships. They always think about their parents and never let their parents worry about them. Having a son and a daughter like this, I am really proud of you and your husband. And your husband supports you without complaint. In addition to working full-time as an engineer, he also works hard to help you deliver newspapers. He is undoubtedly a good husband. Many years ago you said that although you had different newspaper running ideas from Mr. Zhen of the Alberta Times, you still respected this elder. Mrs. Zhen was in poor health and you would visit her when you had time. This shows that your love will not change due to different circumstances. In addition to running a newspaper, You are also enthusiastic about community activities, and several Hakka Association activities were promoted in newspapers with your strong support! Moreover, you also greatly helped in the preparations for the National Day of the Double Tenth National Day this year. Why did you leave other staff members to leave alone? And many of your friends for many years? Many regrets? Many no solutions? Many pains! Thinking of yesterday, everything is still vivid in my mind, and I am infinitely sad! In our hearts, you will always be so cheerful, so beautiful, and so eager to help others. Your laughter and your love will never be erased in the hearts of your family and friends. Shuying! I really miss you!

fc10b044e6e205f4bf8742ca48a3586fec951836.sourceText: 沙漠明珠 | 美国亚利桑那州华人历史（六十六）历史原创书籍与刊物—亚利桑那州华裔军人二战英雄纪事 (续)
fc10b044e6e205f4bf8742ca48a3586fec951836.translatedText: Pearl of the Desert | Chinese History of Arizona, USA (66) Original historical books and publications - The Heroic Chronicles of Arizona Chinese Soldiers in World War II (continued)

379115ef130fad570d4424c1659e06263dd31fea.sourceText: 亚利桑那华人历史协会 张肇鸿 华裔军人邓作霖（Douglas L. Dong），1942年1月加入美国陆军，…
379115ef130fad570d4424c1659e06263dd31fea.translatedText: Arizona Chinese Historical Association Zhang Zhaohong Douglas L. Dong, a Chinese soldier, joined the U.S. Army in January 1942,...

d88004d6faaf612f59ddf8cab8ecceea8a5868b5.sourceText: 华裔军人邓作霖（Douglas L. Dong），1942年1月加入美国陆军，在加州基地受训练两周便赴前线，从印度的孟买转往中国昆明，进驻美第14航空大队，成为前锋话务接线员，战斗在前线。
d88004d6faaf612f59ddf8cab8ecceea8a5868b5.translatedText: Chinese soldier Douglas L. Dong, joined the U.S. Army in January 1942. After training at a California base for two weeks, he went to the front line. He was transferred from Bombay, India to Kunming, China, and was stationed in the 14th U.S. Air Force Group, where he became a forward operator and fought on the front line.

9680249d25641694c80ab4f1e2073ed1512c21d1.sourceText: Harry Ong是一名餐饮服务的警长 ，资料上只有几行字：＂Harry Ong， 1942年2月2日入伍，成为美国陆军航空兵，1944年4月，从弗吉尼亚的新港出发到印度孟买，然后转至昆明，加入第14航空队的驻华空军特遣队。后来分配到中国上海，在那里他遇到了他未来的新娘Jean。＂
9680249d25641694c80ab4f1e2073ed1512c21d1.translatedText: Harry Ong is a sergeant in catering services. There are only a few lines in the information: "Harry Ong, Enlisted in the U.S. Army Air Corps on February 2, 1942. In April 1944, he departed from Newport, Virginia, to Bombay, India, and then transferred to Kunming to join the Air Force Task Force of the 14th Air Force in China. He was later assigned to Shanghai, China, where he met his future bride, Jean. "

ce4b03ec548d500ac9b4490d860798136bac4502.sourceText: 在二次大战的欧洲战埸，也有多位亚省华裔军人参加过著名的战役。
ce4b03ec548d500ac9b4490d860798136bac4502.translatedText: In the European battlefields of World War II, many Chinese soldiers from Alberta participated in famous battles.

abd534f509c796af11fdcfc5adcbef06ed58c85e.sourceText: 美国陆军炮兵指挥官Robert E. Ham，他1940 年 7 月加入梅萨（MESA）的亚利桑那州国民警卫队，曾为西点军校预备队员。他参与二战中的多个重大战役，包括巴拿马运河区保卫战，到过英国、法国、比利时等国家，参加过德国莱茵兰战役，法国诺曼底战役。在对鲁尔河的大规模陆军进攻中，他们的部队顶住了德军炸毁大坝的洪水，占领了科隆并完成莱茵兰战役。Robert E. Ham从军40年，1981 年 4 月以中校军衔退役。
abd534f509c796af11fdcfc5adcbef06ed58c85e.translatedText: U.S. Army Artillery Commander Robert E. Ham, who joined the Arizona National Guard in Mesa (MESA) in July 1940 and was a reserve member of the West Point Military Academy. He participated in many major battles in World War II, including the defense of the Panama Canal Zone. He traveled to the United Kingdom, France, Belgium and other countries, and participated in the Battle of the Rhineland in Germany and the Battle of Normandy in France. In a massive Army attack on the Ruhr River, their troops withstood the flooding caused by the Germans' blown dams, captured Cologne and completed the Rhineland Campaign. Robert E. Ham served in the Army for 40 years and retired in April 1981 with the rank of Lieutenant Colonel.

26a2068c4812ee173a828b7ef95c1dad8ae2a19e.sourceText: Kun Dan Gong，他是一位B-24重型轰炸机的维修机师，转战在欧洲战区，在英格兰、格陵兰，蒙特利尔，加拿大，冰岛等等基地维修战机。参加过欧洲空中进攻，意大利战役，西西里岛战役，诺曼底战役。
26a2068c4812ee173a828b7ef95c1dad8ae2a19e.translatedText: Kun Dan Gong, he is a B-24 heavy bomber maintenance pilot. He moved to the European theater and repaired fighter aircraft at bases in England, Greenland, Montreal, Canada, Iceland, etc. Participated in the European air offensive, Italian campaign, Sicily campaign, Normandy campaign.

adb4df332f6244a36407c1f9460741facadb6454.sourceText: 邓粤钿(Henry Ong) ，担任B-24轰炸机上的无线电通讯兵，B-24是当时的重型轰炸机。他们常在夜间执行任务，深入敌方轰炸。 1944年8月6日，邓粤钿执行第30次任务，去轰炸德国柏林的发动机工厂。但飞机被炮火击中，机组人员跳伞后被德军所俘虏。1945年2月，德国人迁移整个战俘营。邓粤钿与超过一万人的战俘开始了“死亡之旅”，步行了一千英里，从德国东走到西部。因战况不利德军，又从西部再折返回东部。 1945年5月4日，邓粤钿被英军救出。
adb4df332f6244a36407c1f9460741facadb6454.translatedText: Henry Ong served as a radio operator on the B-24 bomber, which was a heavy bomber at the time. They often perform missions at night, bombing deep into the enemy's territory. On August 6, 1944, Deng Yuedian carried out his 30th mission to bomb the engine factory in Berlin, Germany. However, the plane was hit by artillery fire and the crew parachuted out and were captured by the Germans. In February 1945, the Germans moved the entire prison camp. Deng Yuedian and more than 10,000 prisoners of war began a "death journey" and walked a thousand miles from east to west Germany. Because the battle situation was unfavorable to the Germans, they turned back from the west to the east. On May 4, 1945, Deng Yuedian was rescued by the British army.

d2fc26c6ce5ec490af4e0d4933c19fd9c9e31078.sourceText: 关永业（Quan Wing Yip）所在的部队是美军第101空降师，是美国陆军的一支空中突击部队，二次大战被派往欧洲战场，首次参加的就是诺曼底战役。 1944年6月5日夜，他随部队在位于卡昂和瑟堡半岛之间的诺曼底海岸跳伞降落，任务是确保桥梁安全，切断德国军队通信及补给。
d2fc26c6ce5ec490af4e0d4933c19fd9c9e31078.translatedText: Quan Wing Yip's unit is the 101st Airborne Division of the US Army. It is an air assault force of the US Army. During World War II, it was sent to the European battlefield and its first participation was the Battle of Normandy. On the night of June 5, 1944, he parachuted down with his troops on the coast of Normandy between Caen and the Cherbourg Peninsula. His mission was to ensure the safety of the bridge and cut off the German army's communications and supplies.

5b23e3fbaa335dd28037cd7f0e84dc7dd2c6c27a.sourceText: 在二次大战中，亚省有8名华裔军人加入美国海军。其中有人参加了＂中途岛海战＂，有人参加了＂硫磺岛战役＂，还有人在＂密苏里＂号战列舰上，见証日本侵略者在投降书上无条件签字的历史一刻。他们虽然只是普通的导航通讯兵或者是炮手，但在那波澜壮阔的战争年代，却为亚利桑那州的华人历史增添了浓抹重彩的一笔。
5b23e3fbaa335dd28037cd7f0e84dc7dd2c6c27a.translatedText: During World War II, eight Chinese soldiers from Alberta joined the U.S. Navy. Some of them participated in the "Battle of Midway", some participated in the "Battle of Iwo Jima", and some witnessed the historical moment when the Japanese aggressors unconditionally signed the instrument of surrender on the battleship "Missouri". Although they were just ordinary navigation and communication soldiers or gunners, they added a lot of color to the history of the Chinese in Arizona during those magnificent war years.

9f23e505b41b92865230dd6ae18342443e4ad706.sourceText: Dong M. Hom，1944年2月加入美国海军，在爱达荷州新兵训练营经过8周的培训，成为导航方面的信号通信兵，其后开赴太平洋战场，从中途岛战役再到硫磺岛战役，向战斗的舰队进行燃料补给。
9f23e505b41b92865230dd6ae18342443e4ad706.translatedText: >Dong M. Hom joined the U.S. Navy in February 1944. After eight weeks of training at the Idaho Recruit Training Camp, he became a signal and communications officer in navigation. He then went to the Pacific battlefield, from the Battle of Midway to the Battle of Iwo Jima, to provide fuel to the fighting fleet.

f635135e110780586acfd941e291dfc52b3a33e1.sourceText: 华裔海军余明德（Tom Bon Yee ）于1943年入伍，在圣地牙哥海军基地受训后到密苏里号战舰上服役，是舰上的一名炮手。1945年3月18日，密苏里号协同米切尔的快速航母编队空袭了日本九州地区的机场和濑户内海的舰船。随后参加了进攻冲绳岛的作战。
f635135e110780586acfd941e291dfc52b3a33e1.translatedText: Tom Bon Yee, a Chinese-born Navy man, enlisted in the army in 1943. After training at the San Diego Naval Base, he served on the USS Missouri as a gunner on the ship. On March 18, 1945, the USS Missouri cooperated with Mitchell's fast aircraft carrier group in air attacks on airports in the Kyushu region of Japan and ships in the Seto Inland Sea. Later he participated in the attack on Okinawa.

2c7bfb140ce494436ff4e8a6b2ca5f2d6ca8d675.sourceText: 1945年8月15日，日本宣布无条件投降， 1945年9月2日，密苏里号上的美国海军官兵们纷纷站在平台上，爬到炮台上，坐在围栏上，亲历目睹往日穷凶极恶日本帝国低头伏降。余明德是其中的一位，他见証了这历史上庄严的一刻。
2c7bfb140ce494436ff4e8a6b2ca5f2d6ca8d675.translatedText: On August 15, 1945, Japan announced its unconditional surrender. On September 2, 1945, the U.S. Navy officers and soldiers on board the Missouri stood on the platform, climbed to the fort, and sat on the fence to witness with their own eyes the extremely vicious Japanese Empire in the past. Yu Mingde was one of them, and he witnessed this solemn moment in history.

978bb5f83cb07c79d71826d2f9f5acf57d50daa3.sourceText: 在二次大战中，“斐匿华人救国后援会＂，积极购买中国政府的＂战争债券＂，1943年3月下旬，＂美洲国民日报＂文章中有一段文字特别让凤凰城华人感到骄傲：＂斐匿华侨救国后援会发动献金运动，以助在国内建筑难童保育院，选出邓以笙、余康中、邓觉世、邓尧世、邓文华、邓香泉、关崇琼、邓遇隆、邓楷隆、邓同衍、邓子溢、邓协隆、邓艺业、邓枢隆、邓植世、邓扶章等十六人为募捐员，一日之间募捐得国币二十三万元，计值美金一万二千元，交给参加欢迎代表带至三藩市呈献与蒋夫人。＂在当年美西城市26个华人社团中，斐匿华侨募捐数目位于榜首。
978bb5f83cb07c79d71826d2f9f5acf57d50daa3.translatedText: During the Second World War, the "Philippine Chinese National Salvation Support Association" actively purchased the Chinese government's "war bonds". In late March 1943, the "American National Salvation Association" There is a paragraph in the article in the daily that makes the Chinese in Phoenix City particularly proud: "The Feini Overseas Chinese National Salvation Support Association launched a donation campaign to help build a nursery for needy children in the country, and selected Deng Yisheng, Yu Kangzhong, Deng Jueshi, Sixteen people including Deng Yaoshi, Deng Wenhua, Deng Xiangquan, Guan Chongqiong, Deng Yulong, Deng Kailong, Deng Tongyan, Deng Ziyi, Deng Xielong, Deng Yiye, Deng Shulong, Deng Zhishi and Deng Fuzhang were fundraisers. The national currency of 230,000 yuan, valued at 12,000 U.S. dollars, was handed over to the welcoming representatives and brought to San Francisco to present to Mrs. Chiang. "Among the 26 Chinese associations in Western American cities that year, Fei Ni overseas Chinese ranked first in the number of donations.

99cdf3b2318c9b73d697cbd8f65e9cd836fa2f29.sourceText: “亚利桑那州华裔军人二战英雄纪事”以《飞虎战魂》之名出版，把华裔军人的战迹及时代背景结合起来描述，让我们重新感受华裔军人的英雄气概，体会胜利成果来之不易，世界和平的难能可贵。
99cdf3b2318c9b73d697cbd8f65e9cd836fa2f29.translatedText: "Chronicle of the Heroes of Chinese-American Soldiers in Arizona in World War II" was published under the name of "Flying Tiger Fighting Spirit". It combines the description of the battle deeds of Chinese-American soldiers with the background of the times, allowing us to re-experience the heroic spirit of Chinese-American soldiers, realize that the victory is hard-won, and world peace is valuable.

6bf131ed1643d3531aec89fb801fd3d0fa9c7a4f.sourceText: 《飞虎战魂》设计了两个封面，并由亚省书法家陈普提字。中国华侨历史博物馆收藏此书并颁发了荣誉证书，台湾侨委会把《飞虎战魂》滙集到纪念抗战胜利70周年的书册中，昆明飞虎队博物馆及多个图书馆也将此书存档。
6bf131ed1643d3531aec89fb801fd3d0fa9c7a4f.translatedText: "Flying Tiger Fighting Spirit" designed two covers, with calligraphy by Alberta calligrapher Chen Puti. The Overseas Chinese History Museum of China collected this book and issued a certificate of honor. The Overseas Chinese Affairs Council of Taiwan collected "Flying Tiger Fighting Spirit" into a book to commemorate the 70th anniversary of the victory of the Anti-Japanese War. The Kunming Flying Tigers Museum and many libraries also archived this book.

1903136924cfc024a3ecc3c820184149d91251a4.translatedText: Facing the U.S. anti-double and anti-counterfeiting investigation, the China Mechanical and Electronics Chamber of Commerce hopes to resolve the Sino-U.S. wheel trade friction. Source: Xinhua News Agency, The reporter learned from the China Chamber of Commerce for Import and Export of Mechanical and Electronic Products on the 11th...

844b4d29b495d766094abde7220667988af7410e.sourceText: 记者 11 日从中国机电产品进出口商会获悉，面对美国国内产业对中国输美钢车轮提出的双反调查申请，中国生产企业将利用法律武器积极应对，机电商会希望代表中国车轮行业与美国相关行业进行磋商，争取以行业合作方式尽力化解双方贸易摩擦。
844b4d29b495d766094abde7220667988af7410e.translatedText: Reporter 11 Japan learned from the China Chamber of Commerce for Import and Export of Mechanical and Electronic Products that in the face of domestic industries in the United States filing an application for anti-dumping investigations on Chinese steel wheels exported to the United States, Chinese manufacturers will actively respond with legal weapons. The Chamber of Commerce of Mechanical and Electrical Products hopes to negotiate with relevant industries in the United States on behalf of the Chinese wheel industry and strive to resolve trade frictions between the two sides through industry cooperation.

54a51f570a866d6a7f27fe2c7489d61ac82d31c1.sourceText: 美国国内产业日前向美国国际贸易委员会和美国商务部提出对中国出口钢车轮进行反倾销和反补贴调查申请。预计美国商务部将于 4 月 19 日决定是否立案，美国国际贸易委员会将于 4 月 20 日召开此案损害初裁的听证会。
54a51f570a866d6a7f27fe2c7489d61ac82d31c1.translatedText: The U.S. domestic industry has recently submitted an application to the U.S. International Trade Commission and the U.S. Department of Commerce for anti-dumping and countervailing investigations into China's exports of steel wheels. The U.S. Department of Commerce is expected to decide whether to file the case on April 19, and the U.S. International Trade Commission will hold a preliminary hearing on April 20 to determine whether the case is harmed.

245550a5891f6cc46eb9ce3e750841f25ea38028.sourceText: 机电商会有关负责人表示，随着我国汽车零部件产业的不断发展壮大，部分汽车零部件企业已达到国际一流水平，但在与国外企业竞争过程中，部分国外企业在正常商业竞争过程中无法获胜，便频繁利用贸易救济措施限制、打压我国相关出口企业。
245550a5891f6cc46eb9ce3e750841f25ea38028.translatedText: The relevant person in charge of the Chamber of Commerce for Machinery and Electronics said that with the continuous development and growth of my country's auto parts industry, some auto parts companies have reached the world's first-class level. However, in the process of competition with foreign companies, some foreign companies are unable to win in the normal business competition process, and they frequently use trade remedy measures to restrict and suppress my country's related export companies.

95cdaab545eae892d24d2234b248d633146a698b.sourceText: 这位负责人介绍说，近年来我国车轮企业已经先后四次遭受南非、印度、澳大利亚、欧盟反倾销调查。在造成我国企业出口难的同时，也严重损害了上述国家广大下游用户和消费者的利益。而此次案件如获立案，将成为 2009 年以来美国对我国机电产品发起的第一起双反调查。
95cdaab545eae892d24d2234b248d633146a698b.translatedText: The person in charge said that in recent years, my country's wheel companies have been subjected to anti-dumping investigations by South Africa, India, Australia and the European Union four times. While causing difficulties for Chinese enterprises to export, it has also seriously damaged the interests of downstream users and consumers in the above-mentioned countries. If this case is filed, it will be the first double-reverse investigation initiated by the United States into my country's mechanical and electrical products since 2009.

f10778eb32a3c18f3909a917b11f8576321c8738.sourceText: 该负责人表示，作为我国车轮出口企业行业代表，坚决反对一切形式的贸易保护主义，将积极协助企业应对该案。
f10778eb32a3c18f3909a917b11f8576321c8738.translatedText: The person in charge said that as an industry representative of my country's wheel export enterprises, we resolutely oppose all forms of trade protectionism and will actively assist enterprises to deal with the case.

35cc5f6f1cec4e7b0e96882c5693820b3c693214.sourceText: 据了解，机电商会与中国汽车工业协会日前已经共同组织召开了此案的应对工作会，共有 16 家主营钢车轮生产企业参加会议。这些车轮生产企业一致表示将积极应对该案，坚决利用法律武器维护自身合法权益，并希望我国政府有关部门加大交涉力度，为汽车零部件企业开拓国际市场提供助力。
35cc5f6f1cec4e7b0e96882c5693820b3c693214.translatedText: It is understood that the Chamber of Commerce for Machinery and Electronics and the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers have jointly organized a response meeting on this case. A total of 16 major steel wheel manufacturers participated in the meeting. These wheel manufacturers unanimously stated that they will actively respond to the case and resolutely use legal weapons to safeguard their legitimate rights and interests. They also hope that relevant departments of the Chinese government will intensify negotiations to provide assistance to auto parts companies in exploring the international market.

56fbc89e3f511908e08f35536d047b83005ba3e5.translatedText: Overseas Chinese scholars have found a good opportunity to return to China to start a business and develop. From the Arizona Chinese Association (Hua Zong): In the Western economy, especially the American economy, has fallen into...

ac917435980305f8d4135e876aa3443f7ce82621.sourceText: 来自亚利桑那州华人华侨总会（华总） ：
ac917435980305f8d4135e876aa3443f7ce82621.translatedText: From the Arizona Chinese Association (Hua Zong) :

b40cdf1399d86d26aa18535c76ed57ec5d14b5f7.sourceText: 在西方经济尤其是美国经济陷入新一轮危机的时刻，为了帮助海外中国学人找到回国创业与发展的良机，中华海外人才网、北美洲中国学人国际交流中心、上海威佑商务咨询公司、深圳才外才信息科技公司将联合于2011年12月举办”2011冬季海外学人创新创业项目推介会（上海）暨江南考察行”活动。
b40cdf1399d86d26aa18535c76ed57ec5d14b5f7.translatedText: At a time when the Western economy, especially the U.S. economy, is in a new round of crisis, in order to help overseas Chinese scholars find good opportunities to return home to start businesses and develop, the China Overseas Talent Network, the North American Chinese Scholars International Exchange Center, Shanghai Weiyou Business Consulting Company, and Shenzhen Caiwaicai Information Technology Company will jointly organize the "2011 Winter Overseas Scholars Innovation and Entrepreneurship Project Promotion Conference (Shanghai) and Jiangnan Inspection Trip" in December 2011.

a31a76d6294be74b7e39203a1d1591b3619d677b.sourceText: 本次活动是第二次在国内召开。首届活动于2011年7月在上海、南京江宁、无锡宜兴及宁波等地成功举办。在7月份的首届活动中，全国各地政府、开发区、企业、风险投资公司等140家单位共197名代表参加，与50名海外学人进行了项目对接，并取得了丰硕的成果：70%以上的莅会海外学人均表示通过活动与国内的政府或投资人达成了强烈的合作意向，甚至正式签约。有关7月份活动的详情以及成果，请参见附件中的”2011夏季海外学人创新创业项目推介会成果总结”。
a31a76d6294be74b7e39203a1d1591b3619d677b.translatedText: This event is the second time held in the country. The first event was successfully held in Shanghai, Nanjing Jiangning, Wuxi Yixing and Ningbo in July 2011. In the first event in July, a total of 197 representatives from 140 units including governments, development zones, enterprises, and venture capital companies across the country participated in the project docking with 50 overseas scholars, and achieved fruitful results: more than 70% of the overseas students who attended the event stated that they had reached a strong intention to cooperate with domestic governments or investors through the event, and even formally signed contracts. For details and results of the activities in July, please see the "Summary of Results of the 2011 Summer Overseas Scholars Innovation and Entrepreneurship Project Promotion Conference" in the attachment.

b799d960aec764fca49ff9e6fefe81ab4037d5d4.sourceText: 组委会在延续7月份首届项目推介会的成功经验的基础上，将进一步扩大活动的规模、强化活动的效果，再次举办”2011冬季海外学人创新创业项目推介会（上海）暨江南考察行”活动。相信通过本次活动，必能为贵协会会员提供回国创业与发展的优质平台，以及卓有成效的服务与帮助。特此，诚邀您及贵协会共同合作，并组织贵协会会员参与本次活动。如贵协会愿意，我们组委会将把贵协会名称列入本次活动的协办单位，从而扩大贵协会在中国的影响力。
b799d960aec764fca49ff9e6fefe81ab4037d5d4.translatedText: Based on the successful experience of the first project promotion meeting in July, the organizing committee will further expand the scale of the event, strengthen the effect of the event, and once again hold the "2011 Winter Overseas Scholars Innovation and Entrepreneurship Project Promotion Conference (Shanghai) and Jiangnan Inspection Trip" event. I believe that through this event, it will provide members of your association with a high-quality platform for returning to China to start businesses and develop, as well as effective services and assistance. We hereby sincerely invite you to cooperate with your association and organize your association members to participate in this event. If your association is willing, our organizing committee will include your association's name as a co-organizer of this event, thereby expanding your association's influence in China.

99d2a920746b2098a83c920f416f9dcb8ac4d7d3.sourceText: 活动介绍 ”2011冬季海外学人创新创业项目推介会（上海）暨江南考察行”活动组委会，将联合参与活动的各地政府，对报名项目进行审核筛选，入选者将获得最高500美元的国际旅费补助，同时活动期间的国内食宿交通将由组委会免费提供。有关活动的其他具体情况及报名细则，请见下文邮件，或查阅附件中的”2011冬季海外学人创新创业项目推介会（上海）暨江南考察行活动”文件：
99d2a920746b2098a83c920f416f9dcb8ac4d7d3.translatedText: Activity Introduction "2011 Winter Overseas Scholars Innovation and Entrepreneurship Project Promotion Conference (Shanghai) and Jiangnan Inspection Trip" event organizing committee will work with local governments participating in the event to review and screen the registered projects. The selected candidates will receive an international travel subsidy of up to US$500. At the same time, domestic accommodation and transportation during the event will be provided free of charge by the organizing committee. For other details about the event and registration details, please see the email below, or refer to the attached document "2011 Winter Overseas Scholars Innovation and Entrepreneurship Project Promotion Conference (Shanghai) and Jiangnan Inspection Tour Activities":

ef3220aa16d1e084a195f7977819ae76480154d7.sourceText: 活动日程 12月15-16日：2011冬季海外学人创新创业项目推介会（上海） 活动参与者为来自全国各地的政府与开发区、创业园区、风险投资公司及民间资本拥有人。每位海外学人均有现场PPT展示、现场演讲推介以及与国内各类单位和投资人面对面交流的机会。 12月17 – 22日：海外学人江南考察行 考察江浙3至5个城市，与当地政府、开发园区、企业、风险投资人、资本拥有人等进行深入交流和对接。备选考察地为：嘉定、江阴、太仓、张家港、慈溪、绍兴、嘉兴、金华、镇江、常州、湖州、扬州、徐州、杭州等。
ef3220aa16d1e084a195f7977819ae76480154d7.translatedText: Event Schedule December 15-16: 2011 Winter Overseas Scholars Innovation and Entrepreneurship Project Promotion Conference (Shanghai) Participants of the event are governments, development zones, entrepreneurial parks, venture capital companies and private capital owners from all over the country. Each overseas scholar has the opportunity to have on-site PPT presentations, on-site speech promotions, and face-to-face communication with various domestic units and investors. December 17-22: Overseas scholars visited Jiangnan to inspect 3 to 5 cities in Jiangsu and Zhejiang, and conduct in-depth exchanges and docking with local governments, development parks, enterprises, venture investors, capital owners, etc. Alternative inspection locations are: Jiading, Jiangyin, Taicang, Zhangjiagang, Cixi, Shaoxing, Jiaxing, Jinhua, Zhenjiang, Changzhou, Huzhou, Yangzhou, Xuzhou, Hangzhou, etc.

a45e543d8a2cb1c9691f2ce04af2ee87ce306b6e.sourceText: 报名人条件： 1、在新能源、新材料、医药及生物技术、化工、先进制造业、IT软件、电子信息、现代服务业等各类领域中拥有知识产权和智力成果并有意回国创业的海外学人； 2、欢迎那些拥有各上述领域创业项目，但不能长期回国的海外学人报名（大会组委会将代其在中国申办公司、申请政府扶持资金、寻找办公场地、配备工作人员等）。
a45e543d8a2cb1c9691f2ce04af2ee87ce306b6e.translatedText: > Applicant conditions: 1. Overseas students who have intellectual property and intellectual achievements in various fields such as new energy, new materials, medicine and biotechnology, chemical industry, advanced manufacturing, IT software, electronic information, modern service industries, etc. and intend to return to China to start a business; 2. Overseas students who have entrepreneurial projects in the above fields but cannot return to China for a long time are welcome to register (the organizing committee of the conference will apply for companies in China on their behalf, apply for government support funds, find office space, staff, etc.).

edb7c362c424562c75359b2790adf5a0e8e3e810.sourceText: 报名材料： 1、项目简介1份（需包含项目内容、项目现状、技术领先程度、创业团队简介、寻求合作方式等基本信息，涉及技术及商业机密的内容可隐去） 2、个人简历1份 3、报名表（请见附件）
edb7c362c424562c75359b2790adf5a0e8e3e810.translatedText: Registration materials: 1. One copy of the project introduction (must include basic information such as project content, project status, technological leadership, introduction to the entrepreneurial team, cooperation methods, etc. Contents involving technical and commercial secrets can be omitted) 2. One copy of personal resume 3. Registration form (please see the attachment)

ced67196b93298b2735f2051ae4142bbe274d27a.sourceText: 补贴标准： 1、海外学人报名参加活动无报名费。 2、所有参与活动的人员在活动期间（自报到起至活动结束）的交通、食宿等均免费。住宿的最低标准为双人标准间。 3、大会组委会及各考察地政府将对报名人员及其所持项目进行审核。 同时通过大会组委会及地方政府审核的人员，将受邀全程参加上海项目推介会及江南考察行活动，并按以下标准获得国际旅费补贴：欧美地区500美元/人，亚洲及澳洲地区300美元/人，国内1000元人民币/人。 通过大会组委会审核、但未通过地方政府审核的人员，将受邀参加上海项目推介会，并按以下标准获得国际旅费补贴：欧美地区250美元/人，亚洲及澳洲地区150美元/人，国内500元人民币/人。
ced67196b93298b2735f2051ae4142bbe274d27a.translatedText: Subsidy standards: 1. There is no registration fee for overseas students to register for the event. 2. All participants will have free transportation, food and accommodation during the event (from registration to the end of the event). The minimum standard of accommodation is a double standard room. 3. The organizing committee of the conference and the local governments of each inspection area will review the applicants and their projects. Those who have passed the review by the conference organizing committee and local government will be invited to participate in the Shanghai project promotion meeting and Jiangnan inspection trip, and receive international travel subsidies according to the following standards: US$500/person in Europe and the United States, US$300/person in Asia and Australia, and RMB 1,000/person domestically. Those who have passed the review by the conference organizing committee but not the local government will be invited to participate in the Shanghai project promotion meeting and receive international travel subsidies according to the following standards: US$250/person in Europe and the United States, US$150/person in Asia and Australia, and RMB 500/person domestically.

e44f27f45ca4e8df2978bd51975aa8a7f74f1426.sourceText: 报名办法： 请发送报名材料至：亚利桑那州华人华侨总会（华总）副会长王盛君 mingzhu1@yahoo.com

ccac0ff41b6347c27e175d118a3fef4e9c43449a.translatedText: Activity quota: 100 people for the 2011 Winter Innovation and Entrepreneurship Project Promotion Conference (Shanghai); 40 people for the overseas scholars’ inspection trip to Jiangnan. International students who are interested in participating in this event, please hurry up. You are welcome to call us for details of this event!
