eacec1b4bbcebd473204a2142024afa965417195.sourceText: 图桑 慧明 晴雯的标致和美丽是大家公认的，长得”水蛇腰，削肩膀，眉眼又有些像林妹妹”。这林妹妹基本就是红楼的美人模子，任何女孩只要往这个模子面前一站,各种眉眼嘴脸就现出不同的特色来了。即便当今，你说某个女孩眉眼像林妹妹，或者一点嗲声有那妹妹的余音，都会让女孩喜笑颜开。所以，晴雯对自己的长相是有点自信的。 曹雪芹对晴雯也是有偏爱的，在《红楼梦》中金陵十二钗又副册之首的就是晴雯。让所有初读红楼的人不解的是，为何一个出生贫寒，屡遭买卖的丫鬟会有这么高的地位？ 一般说来，一个人成年以后的思维和作派和年幼的经历往往有关。比如从小由于社会地位和生理缺陷受人歧视，成年后就会不自觉地敌意或报复比自己有才和更加出彩的人。但晴雯身为奴婢，却少有这些负面的东西。当年她虽然是作为奴婢卖给老奴婢赖嬷嬷的，”贾母见她生得伶俐标致，十分喜爱。故此赖嬷嬷将她孝敬了贾母使唤”，刻意贬低她就是奴才的奴才了。但她却没有奴婢之类女孩的奴性，喜欢自觉不自觉地打别人的小报告，讨好巴结主人。相反，她却得了美人的许多心理便利，因为她认为，从十岁卖给人家，到进红楼大院，都是由于自己的天生丽质。 这点丽质对于女孩来说是很重要的。后人评价晴雯很喜欢套上政治的标签，诸如是什么旧礼教的叛逆，只身抵抗封建社会等等，包括她的死引起了读者对封建社会的无比痛恨等等，其实都是些扯淡话。晴雯的心理支柱就是那么的简单：我就美丽，我怕谁！ 有了美丽才有自信，才会对狗一样的听差王善保家的横眉冷对，才能对行苟且之事，讨好宝玉的袭人讽刺有加。甚至敢说”难道谁又比谁高贵些？冲撞了太太，我也不受这口气”！ 那个王善保的老婆在王夫人面前诬告晴雯：”别的还罢了，太太不知道，头一个是宝玉屋里晴雯。那丫头仗着模样儿比别人标致些，又长了一张巧嘴……一句话不投机，她就立起两只眼睛来骂人，妖妖调调，大不成个体统！”其实还正说对了晴雯。 这晴雯就是想倚势自己的丽质，想和宝玉建立一种不一般的朋友关系。麝月、碧痕、秋纹这类铺床叠被送水捧茶的角色，她是不会去刻意求仿的；袭人那种性伙伴角色她更是不屑的。晴雯在意的是和做宝玉做一种不似主仆之类的，像宝黛那样可以精神对话的朋友。所以当她听到袭人说了一句”原是我们的不是”的时候，便冷笑了：”我倒不知道’你们’是谁，别教我替’你们’害臊了！……连个姑娘还没挣上去呢，也不过和我似的，哪里就称起’我们’来了？”猜想就是这美人心理让晴雯不服这世间没有”相”，却喜欢用”色”取悦于主子的人。 但这世上从来是树大招风，美人遭妒的。晴雯以为靠着美丽和独见就可以和宝黛建立不同的亲密关系，可以抵挡红楼任何邪风的。但她错了，那些不甚美丽的，被她清高地歧视的，诸如王善保家的，袭人和王夫人们组成婆婆嘴联盟时，美丽就不是她们的对手了。这也就是曹雪芹在红楼开始给晴雯下的判词：”霁月难逢，彩云易散。 心比天高，身为下贱。风流灵巧招人怨。 寿夭多因诽谤生，多情公子空牵念”的原因了。 其实，晴雯心是高的，但最后她还是忍命了，生命的最后对宝玉后悔地说：”我虽生得比别人好些，并没有私情勾引你，怎么一口死咬定了我是个’狐狸精’!我今儿既担了虚名，况且没了远限，不是我说一句后悔的话：早知如此，我当日–” 这个悔言可真令人悲哀。曹雪芹也够狠的，让这么一个美女早早离开了红楼话题，还让她几乎放弃了美丽理念—
eacec1b4bbcebd473204a2142024afa965417195.translatedText: Tu Sang Huiming Qingwen's beauty and elegance are recognized by everyone. She has a "snake-like waist, narrow shoulders, and her eyebrows look a bit like Sister Lin." This sister Lin is basically the beauty model of the Red Mansion. As long as any girl stands in front of this model, her various features will appear. Even today, if you say that a girl's features look like Sister Lin's, or that her little slur has the lingering sound of that sister, it will make the girl smile. Therefore, Qingwen is somewhat confident in her appearance. Cao Xueqin also has a preference for Qingwen. In "A Dream of Red Mansions", Qingwen is the first among the twelve beauties of Jinling. What puzzles all those who are new to The Red Mansion is why a maid who was born in poverty and has been bought and sold many times has such a high status. Generally speaking, a person's thinking and style as an adult are often related to his childhood experiences. For example, if you have been discriminated against due to social status or physical defects since childhood, you will unconsciously become hostile or retaliate against people who are more talented and outstanding than you as an adult. But as a slave, Qingwen rarely has these negative things. Although she was sold as a slave to the old slave Nanny Lai, "Jia Mu saw that she was smart and beautiful and loved her very much. Therefore, Nanny Lai treated her as a filial piety to Jia Mu." She deliberately belittled her as a slave of slaves. But she doesn't have the servility of girls like slaves. She likes to tell other people's stories consciously or unconsciously, to please her master. On the contrary, she has gained many psychological advantages of beauty, because she believes that from being sold to others at the age of ten to entering the Red Mansion Courtyard, it is all due to her natural beauty. This beauty is very important for girls. Later generations commented that Qingwen liked to use political labels, such as being a rebel against the old ethics, resisting feudal society alone, etc., including the fact that her death caused readers to hate feudal society, etc., but these are actually all nonsense. Qingwen's psychological support is so simple: I am beautiful, who should I be afraid of! Only with beauty can you have self-confidence, and be cold-eyed towards the dog-like footman Wang Shanbao's family, and be sarcastic towards those who behave casually and please Baoyu. He even dared to say, "Who is more noble than the other? I offended my wife, and I don't tolerate this tone"! The wife of Wang Shanbao falsely accused Qingwen in front of Mrs. Wang: "There is nothing else, but my wife doesn't know, the first one is Qingwen from the Baoyu House. That girl is prettier than the others, and she has a clever mouth... If she doesn't say anything, she will raise her eyes to curse people, she is so charming, so unbecoming!" In fact, she was right about Qingwen. Qingwen just wanted to take advantage of her beauty and establish an unusual friendship with Baoyu. She would not deliberately imitate characters like She Yue, Bi Hen, and Qiu Wen, who were bedfellows, given water and tea, and she even disdained sexual partner characters like Xi Ren. What Qingwen cares about is to be a kind of friend with Baoyu who is not like a master or a servant, but who can have spiritual conversations like Baodai. So when she heard Xi Ren say, "It's our fault," she sneered, "I don't know who 'you' are, don't make me feel ashamed for 'you'! ... She's not even a girl yet, and she's just like me, how can she call her 'us'?" Guess it was this beauty mentality that made Qingwen dissatisfied with the fact that there is no "appearance" in the world, but people who like to use "color" to please their masters. But in this world, big trees attract the wind, and beauties are jealous. Qingwen thought that relying on her beauty and uniqueness, she could establish a different kind of intimate relationship with Baodai and be able to resist any evil wind in the Red Mansion. But she was wrong. Those who were not very beautiful and were discriminated against by her, such as the Wang Shanbao family, when Xi and Mrs. Wang formed a mother-in-law alliance, beauty was no longer their opponent. This is the reason why Cao Xueqin gave Qingwen the verdict at the beginning of the Red Mansion: "The bright moon is rare, and the colorful clouds are easy to disperse. Her heart is higher than the sky, but her body is humble. Being romantic and clever attracts resentment. Longevity is mostly due to slander, and sentimental young masters miss her in vain." In fact, Qingwen's heart was high, but in the end she endured her life. At the end of her life, she regretted to Baoyu and said: "Although I was born better than others and I have no personal feelings to seduce you, why do you insist that I am a 'vixen'! Today, I have a false reputation, and there is no limit to my future. I am not saying a word of regret: If I had known this, I would have-" This regret is really sad. Cao Xueqin was ruthless enough to make such a beautiful woman leave the topic of Red Mansions early, and almost gave up on the idea of ​​beauty—

a0ffc7792909e44fce0a37e4a4445f6730f9867d.sourceText: 房产知识问答 问: 什么是 Home Inspection? 为什么买屋时还要花个几百元来做 Home Inspection? 答: Home Inspection(房屋检查)可以让购屋者对屋况有一个详细和整体性的了解，一位合格的专业房屋检查员可以为您提供深入、公正的房屋检查报告，报告上应该要记载关于房屋结构的状况，列出什么东西需要修理或更换，并对一些主要设备，诸如冷气机、暖炉、热水炉等设备的状况做出一个评估。在亚利桑那的制式化购屋合约中，已预先列出买屋者在购屋合约成立后的10天内有权利做专业房屋检查，并依据检查结果要求售屋者改善，或做出是否购买的决定，所以Home Inspection是对购屋者的一个保障。 问: 什么是 REO? 答: REO是Real Estate Owned的缩写，简单的说它就是银行持有的房屋，也就是所谓的Bank Owned，Foreclosure时银行收回的房子。 问: 购屋要慎选地区，请问该如何得知某地区的经济、治安状况，环境是否安全等问题? 答: 很多信息都可以在互联网上免费取得，像是: www.CrimeReports.com 、 www.FamilyWatchDog.us 这两个网站，只要输入您想查询的房屋地址，便会以地图的方式显示出附近的犯罪活动地点、性罪犯的照片、罪行及住家地址等数据，至于地区的经济、人口状况，则可以在 www.BestPlaces.net 这个网站中找到信息。 如果您有任何房地產方面的問題，非常歡迎您打電話到專線 (480) 612-4545 或email至 Rich@RichLiao.com
a0ffc7792909e44fce0a37e4a4445f6730f9867d.translatedText: Real Estate Questions and Answers Q: What is a Home Inspection? Why do you have to spend hundreds of dollars on a Home Inspection when buying a house? Answer: Home Inspection allows home buyers to have a detailed and comprehensive understanding of the condition of the house. A qualified professional home inspector can provide you with an in-depth and impartial home inspection report. The report should record the condition of the structure of the house, list what needs to be repaired or replaced, and make an assessment of the condition of some major equipment, such as air conditioners, heaters, water heaters, etc. In Arizona's standardized home purchase contract, it is stated in advance that the home buyer has the right to have a professional home inspection within 10 days after the home purchase contract is established, and based on the inspection results, the home seller will be required to make improvements or make a decision on whether to purchase. Therefore, Home Inspection is a guarantee for home buyers. Q: What is REO? A: REO is the abbreviation of Real Estate Owned. Simply put, it is a house owned by a bank, also known as Bank Owned. Foreclosure is a house repossessed by the bank. Question: When buying a house, you must choose an area carefully. How can you know the economic and security conditions of a certain area, whether the environment is safe, etc.? Answer: A lot of information can be obtained for free on the Internet, such as: www.CrimeReports.com, www.FamilyWatchDog.us For these two websites, as long as you enter the address of the house you want to query, a map will display nearby criminal activity locations, photos of sex offenders, crimes, home addresses and other data. As for the economic and demographic status of the area, you can find information on the website www.BestPlaces.net. If you have any real estate questions, you are welcome to call the dedicated hotline (480) 612-4545 or email to Rich@RichLiao.com

75b68388492a17d7915b997547e361aa250032dc.sourceText: 筑边界墙 亚利桑纳州向全美国募款 （亚省时报） 亚利桑那州再度在移民问题上採取严厉手段，州议员向全国民众募捐，准备在该州与墨西哥交界的每吋边界上筑起围牆，成为一个州为了制止非法移民和毒品走私，迄今提出的前所未有举措。 提出这一方案的参议员史密斯说，自从亚州在专门网站上呼吁，访问该网站的民众要向全世界展示美国民众的决心，和一切都能做到的精神以来，全国民众已向边界牆计画捐出了约25万5000元资金。但这笔资金仅够边界围牆半哩长的费用，史密斯估计，边界牆的总费用是3400万元。 筑建边界牆的计画是本州採取的最新举措，试图在全国掀起一场新的争论，讨论联邦政府能否制止非法移民的问题。法官的裁决终止了SB1070的主要规定，州长在向联邦最高法院上诉，要求推翻法官的裁决。布鲁尔还签署了边界围牆的法案。 批评准备筑建边界牆的人士说，这项计画不但耗资巨大，而且也没有效果。他们说，联邦政府花费数十亿元资金建造的边界牆，都没能制止非法移民的涌入。 试图越界的偷渡客和走私者，是通过切断、绕过、翻越或者挖地下通道的方式越境，南部地区仅上周就在诺格拉斯镇的边界线上，发现了两处毒品走私隧道。 史密斯参议员的支持者说，联邦政府在保证边界安全上几乎没有任何作为，因此他们新筑边界围牆的计画，将填补毒品走私和偷渡客的漏洞。
75b68388492a17d7915b997547e361aa250032dc.translatedText: To build a border wall, Arizona is asking for donations from all over the United States (Alberta Times) Arizona is once again taking a tough approach on immigration, with state lawmakers asking for donations from the nation to build a wall along every inch of the state's border with Mexico, an unprecedented step by a state to curb illegal immigration and drug smuggling. Senator Smith, who proposed the plan, said that people across the country have donated about $255,000 to the border wall project since the state called on people who visit the website on a special website to show the world the determination of the American people and the can-do spirit. But the funding only covers half a mile of border wall, with Smith estimating the total cost to be $34 million. The border wall plan is the latest step the state has taken to try to spark a new national debate over whether the federal government can curb illegal immigration. The judge's ruling terminated key provisions of SB 1070, and the governor is appealing to the Supreme Court to overturn the judge's ruling. Brewer also signed a border wall bill. Critics of the proposed border wall say the project is expensive and ineffective. They say the federal government has spent billions of dollars building a border wall that has failed to stop the influx of illegal immigrants. Smugglers and smugglers who try to cross the border do so by cutting off, bypassing, climbing or digging underground passages. In the southern region, two drug smuggling tunnels were discovered on the border of Nograles town last week alone. Senator Smith's supporters say the federal government has done little to secure the border, so their plan to build a new border wall will close loopholes for drug smuggling and smuggling.

7b05bf533c6559c85a54d478fa8efa53579edd6e.sourceText: 自从新东方艺术学校开办后，两年来，为凤凰城侨联总会的选美佳丽提供了一个良好训练的场所，学校有专业的老师，有正规的练舞场地，还有会议室 方便义工开会和评选作品，更重要的是，在这个多功能的平台上，聚集着一批热心支持和无偿付出的义工，在百忙之中来抽时间来为华人社区作服务和奉献。 这一期的〝点将台〞，我们向提供这平台各类资源的新东方艺术学校、吕丽华校长、胡秋子艺术总监、还有提供免费食物的余妈妈和一大批义工们，国庆青少年作文 绘画比赛的参赛者和评委们，表达最衷心的感谢！ 侨联总会每年对选美佳丽的培训都是从多方面进行的，参加选美佳丽所得到的名次固然重要，能在培训期间学到的各种智识和快速成长更是一种收获，每个人的 人生中都会有亮点，我们祝福这一届的佳丽能在选美培训过程中学习进步提高，在七月四日的国庆日华丽转身，以最大限度发挥自己的潜质，在选美中有亮丽的 表现！ 自从去年侨联总会联系《太阳鸟》网站，展开对佳丽进行首次网上投票竞选活动，得到王浩和秋香等网站主办人的大力的支持和协助，取得了十分良好的成果，凤凰于飞， 世人瞩目！ 今年侨联再次通过《太阳鸟》网站，举办2012年度凤凰城华裔小姐网上投票竞选活动，时间从6月16日的零时开始至7月1日零时结束，为时半个月，优胜者 可得到百分之五的加分。 希望大家能大力支持，踊跃投票。
7b05bf533c6559c85a54d478fa8efa53579edd6e.translatedText: Since the opening of the New Oriental Art School, it has provided a good training place for the beauty pageants of the Phoenix Overseas Chinese Federation Association in the past two years. The school has professional teachers, formal dance practice venues, and conference rooms to facilitate volunteers to hold meetings and select works. More importantly, on this multi-functional platform, a group of enthusiastic supporters and free volunteers have gathered, taking time out of their busy schedules to serve and contribute to the Chinese community. In this issue of "Point General Platform", we would like to express our most heartfelt thanks to New Oriental Art School, Principal Lu Lihua, Art Director Hu Qiuzi, who provide various resources on this platform, Mama Yu who provides free food, and a large number of volunteers, as well as the contestants and judges of the National Day Youth Composition and Painting Competition! The Federation of Overseas Chinese Federation trains beauty pageant beauties every year from many aspects. The ranking obtained by participating in the beauty pageant is important, and the various knowledge and rapid growth learned during the training are even more rewarding. There will be highlights in everyone's life. We wish this year's beauties to learn and improve during the beauty pageant training process, and turn around beautifully on the Fourth of July National Day to maximize their potential and perform brilliantly in the beauty pageant! Since last year, the Overseas Chinese Federation contacted the "Sunbird" website to launch the first online voting campaign for the beauties. With the strong support and assistance from website organizers such as Wang Hao and Qiuxiang, it has achieved very good results. The Phoenix has taken flight and attracted the attention of the world! This year, the Overseas Chinese Federation once again organized the 2012 Miss Chinese Phoenix Online Voting Campaign through the "Sunbird" website. It started at 0:00 on June 16 and ended at 0:00 on July 1. It lasted for half a month and the winner was selected. You can get 5% extra points. I hope you can support it and vote enthusiastically.

dc13e2e4eb0b3b5c4acf312ef0f05bd986064c83.sourceText: 2011年凤凰城汉字文化节是由亚省中华语文学院主办.自二月起至九月陆续展开一连串庆祝精彩一百的各项活动,所有活动均非常圆满成功.凤凰城汉字文化节的各项 活动是结合华人社会与主流社会,共同宣传汉字文化,中华文化,及促进多元文化交流. 2011年凤凰城汉字文化节至美国主流数十所学校,包括有大学,中学,小学,与幼稚园,进行义务的汉字文化教学,中华文化推广,台湾民俗才艺指导,多元文化交流,及举办美国学校 学生正体字书法比赛,国画比赛,儿歌童诗朗诵,汉字宾果游戏,书写汉字吉祥辞句,及中华节庆活动和中华美食品尝等. 2011年凤凰城汉字文化节与亚省一千位女童军共同庆祝汉字文化节;与凤凰城市和邻近城市的一万多名儿童在国际儿童节举办汉字文化活动;与凤凰城八千多个学生 在凤凰城市政府的多元文化活动中合作举办汉字文化活动,共同​​推广汉字文化与中华文化.同时汉字文化节也和亚省中西大学及亚省州立大学合作,与数千位大学生们共同宣传汉字文化,中华文化和进行多元文化交流. 2011年汉字文化节在中文学校举办汉字文化台湾民俗艺术比赛,并与凤凰城中文学校联合举办中文学校学生中华节庆海报比赛等,每位得奖学生都有奖状,奖牌,和精美的学用奖品. 2011年凤凰城汉字文化节举办的各项活动顺利圆满,很成功的宣传汉字文化,中华文化,与台湾民俗,同时也结合主流,共同推广汉字文化,传扬中华文化,促进多元文化交流.非常感谢 凤凰城姊妹会台北姊妹市委员会与橙县文教中心的支持,感谢义工们的辛苦与奉献,和感谢所有参与的学生,老师和家长,使2011年凤凰城汉字文化节能如此多元丰富和杰出成功。
dc13e2e4eb0b3b5c4acf312ef0f05bd986064c83.translatedText: The 2011 Phoenix Chinese Character Cultural Festival was hosted by the Chinese Language Institute of Alberta. From February to September, a series of various activities were held to celebrate the wonderful centenary. All activities were very successful. The various activities of the Phoenix Chinese Character Cultural Festival combine the Chinese society and mainstream society to jointly promote Chinese character culture, Chinese culture, and promote multicultural exchanges. In 2011, the Phoenix Chinese Character Culture Festival went to dozens of mainstream schools in the United States, including universities, middle schools, elementary schools, and kindergartens, to provide voluntary Chinese character culture teaching, Chinese culture promotion, Taiwanese folklore talent guidance, multicultural exchanges, and held American school students' calligraphy competitions, Chinese painting competitions, children's song and poem recitations, Chinese character bingo games, writing Chinese characters auspicious phrases, and Chinese festival activities and Chinese food tastings. In 2011, the Phoenix Chinese Character Cultural Festival celebrated the Chinese Character Cultural Festival with a thousand girl guides in Alberta; held Chinese character cultural activities on the International Children's Day with more than 10,000 children in Phoenix and neighboring cities; and held Chinese character cultural activities with more than 8,000 students in Phoenix The Phoenix City Government cooperates in organizing Chinese character culture activities in the multi-cultural activities of the Phoenix City Government to jointly promote Chinese character culture and Chinese culture. At the same time, the Chinese Character Culture Festival also cooperates with Central and Western University of Alberta and Alberta State University to jointly promote Chinese character culture, Chinese culture and conduct multicultural exchanges with thousands of college students. In 2011, the Chinese Character Culture Festival held the Chinese Character Culture Taiwan Folk Art Competition in Chinese schools, and jointly organized a Chinese festival poster competition for Chinese school students with Phoenix Chinese School. Each winning student received a certificate, medal, and exquisite academic prizes. All the activities held by the Phoenix Chinese Character Culture Festival in 2011 were a success. They successfully promoted Chinese character culture, Chinese culture, and Taiwanese folk customs. At the same time, they also combined with the mainstream to jointly promote Chinese character culture, spread Chinese culture, and promote multicultural exchanges. Thank you very much. Thanks to the support of the Taipei Sister City Committee of the Phoenix Sisters Association and the Orange County Cultural and Educational Center, thanks to the hard work and dedication of the volunteers, and to all the students, teachers and parents who participated, the 2011 Phoenix Chinese Character Cultural Festival was such a diverse, rich and outstanding success.

d29843d262618b784721b5eb44374475599c20af.sourceText: 母亲节游子吟 王齋先 多少母爱多少泪。多少辛酸母无怨。 为儿女昼夜劳苦而失落了美丽少女的青春。 脸上的皱纹，头上的白发，是母亲慈爱的冠冕。 举目仰望神，低头思母恩！ 烏鴉反哺盡孝心，羔羊跪乳報母恩。 遊子想回報，慈母已歸天。 海能枯，石會爛，哦！慈母的慈愛永遠不改變。 夜半聞鐘聲，思母淚濕襟。 三更母子同一夢，兩地認不清。 今逢母親節，禱告祈求神。在主同在下。 求主傳遞遊子異國他鄉思母吟！
d29843d262618b784721b5eb44374475599c20af.translatedText: Mother's Day Wandering Son's Song Wang Zhaixian How much maternal love and tears. How bitter it is that the mother has no complaints. Toiling day and night for the sake of their children has resulted in the loss of the youth of a beautiful girl. The wrinkles on the face and the white hair on the head are the crown of mother's love. Lift your eyes to God and bow your head to remember your mother! The crow shows its filial piety by feeding back the baby, and the lamb kneels down at its breast to repay its mother's kindness. The wanderer wants to repay her kindness, but her loving mother has passed away. The sea can dry up, and the rocks can rot, oh! A mother's love never changes. Hearing the sound of the bell in the middle of the night, my breasts were wet with tears as I missed my mother. Mother and son had the same dream in the middle of the night, but they couldn't recognize each other clearly. This Mother’s Day, let’s pray to God. In the presence of the Lord. Ask the Lord to send the wanderer’s cry of missing his mother in a foreign country!

3e0afd7970eea4bcbb18471ea998db5a80d66370.sourceText: 准备货币 人民币最被看好 一迭100元的人民币上，压着100美元的美钞。美国信用评级首次遭到史坦普调降后，中国谴责美国举债成瘾对世界经济造成的威胁，且质疑美元仍能继续是全球准备货币的地位。(欧新社) slideshow 美国债信降级，美元作为国际准备货币的超强地位也随之进一步动摇，一直在寻找另一种准备货币的国际社会再度对人民币寄予厚望，不过仍有专家对中国拯救全球经济的能力存疑。 伦敦「金融时报」指出，其实不待信评机构宣布，美国债信在许多国家心中早已降级。而美元地位也受到波及，这都要归咎于经济疲弱，美国上半年国内生产毛额（GDP）仅成长0.8%。根据摩根资产管理(JP Morgan)的调查，第二季消费者个人支出的成长率，几乎创下非衰退时期的最低数字。 全球经济需要另一种准备货币，问题是尚无可靠的替代选择。欧元近来因欧元区成员国经济动荡而失去优势。日圆虽拜日本央行作风比美欧保守之赐，状况相对好些，价位也不断上扬，却还不成气候。瑞士法郎避险性强，却易受欧洲大环境波及，并且须受瑞士央行防堵收购瑞士法郎的惩罚措施节制 。 情况日益明显，在中国解除对资本帐的限制之后，人民币是最被看好的准备货币，而且这种情况的到来会比大多数人想象的要早。汇丰银行新任执行长欧智华认为，人民币需要五到十年才能取得这个地位，不过这种评估与香港许多经济学家的看法相比，显得太过保守。 欧智华日前在一项简报会上，表达了对美元既爱又恨的心情，表示明知美元会继续走弱，偏偏它又无可取代，实在找不到替代货币。 话虽如此，美国仍须利用这次机会明智地分配它的资本，因为迟早有一天，世上其他国家会在其他地方找到比今天更好的投资选择。 香港加拿大皇家银行的经济师贾克森认为，美国上次衰退时，中国推出6220亿美元的大规模刺激经济计划，不仅本国经济增长，还实时稳定全球经济。但通膨、房地产泡沫和增长的债务，将影响中国再度挽救全球经济的能力。
3e0afd7970eea4bcbb18471ea998db5a80d66370.translatedText: Preparing Currency The RMB is the most promising. On a stack of RMB 100, there are US$100 bills pressed down. After the U.S. credit rating was downgraded for the first time by S&P, China denounced the U.S. debt addiction as a threat to the world economy and questioned the dollar's continued status as the world's reserve currency. (European News Agency) slideshow The U.S. debt credit rating has been downgraded, and the U.S. dollar’s ​​super status as an international reserve currency has been further shaken. The international community, which has been looking for another reserve currency, once again has high hopes for the renminbi. However, there are still experts who have doubts about China’s ability to save the global economy. London's "Financial Times" pointed out that in fact, the credit rating of the United States had already been downgraded in the minds of many countries before the credit rating agencies announced it. The status of the US dollar has also been affected. This is all due to the weak economy. The US gross domestic product (GDP) grew only 0.8% in the first half of the year. According to a survey by JP Morgan, the growth rate of consumer personal spending in the second quarter was almost the lowest in the non-recession period. The global economy needs another preparedness currency, the problem is that there is no reliable alternative yet. The euro has recently lost ground due to economic turmoil among euro zone member states. Although the Japanese yen is in relatively better shape thanks to the Bank of Japan's more conservative approach than the United States and Europe, and its price continues to rise, it is not yet a problem. The Swiss franc is highly risk-averse, but it is easily affected by the European environment and is subject to the Swiss National Bank's punitive measures to prevent the purchase of Swiss francs. It is becoming increasingly clear that the yuan is the most favored reserve currency after China lifts its capital account restrictions, and this will happen sooner than most people think. HSBC's new chief executive Gulliver believes it will take five to ten years for the yuan to achieve this status, but this assessment appears too conservative compared with the views of many economists in Hong Kong. At a briefing recently, Gulliver expressed his love and hate for the US dollar, saying that he knew that the US dollar would continue to weaken, but it was irreplaceable and there was really no alternative currency. Having said that, the United States must use this opportunity to allocate its capital wisely, because sooner or later, the rest of the world will find better investment options elsewhere than today. Jaxon, an economist at Royal Bank of Canada in Hong Kong, believes that during the last recession in the United States, China launched a large-scale economic stimulus plan of US$622 billion, which not only grew its own economy but also stabilized the global economy in real time. But inflation, real estate bubbles and growing debt will affect China's ability to once again save the global economy.

045dde1c86dd363c4c33a42ec2c32e8870c6f44c.sourceText: 叶倾城：末班车 相识那年，他３０岁，她２９岁。 那之前，是相似的下乡、返城、求学、工作转瞬间，流年如山逝水沉，轻易便坠进大龄青年的陷阱。 碰面的那，都从对方的脸上读出了自己的芳华不再。 整个一场恋爱，仿佛也不过是看看电影，在散场后的街上走一走，聊聊天，话渐渐说尽了，只有脚步声，一前一​​后轻轻敲着寂静的夜。 相处半年，是该决定的时候了，感情却始终淡如一杯白水。 他明白人条件相当，算是般配，也知道年岁不饶人，这次耽误了，以后机会不会更多只有更少，心里却念念地记着两人的疏离和陌生。 那，电影格外长，秋雨下得一塌糊涂，遍地泥泞。 他拔腿就追，深​​​​一脚浅一脚，泥水飞溅也来不及看一眼，上气不接下气还不停挥手：”等一等，等一等！”看她快跑不动了，他 不假思索，回身一把抓住她的手拖着她拼命地跑。 他们好不容易追上的时候，车已缓缓开动，司机怨气冲天，大骂他们耽误他的时间。 他来及回嘴，只是庆幸自己终于赶上了末班车，半晌才陡地发现，她喘得腿都软了，整个人半靠在他身上。 车一路散了架般哐啷哐啷，寒风从破了的车窗刮进来，两人都瑟瑟发抖。 他终于迟疑地伸出手环住她，忽然把一切想得清清楚楚。 他们都已经走到青春的尽头，他是她的末班车，她也是他的末班车，除此之外，他们不再有其他的选择，而一旦错过，就没下一班车了。 在最害的关头，他们很自然地彼此地支撑，一起追赶，无论车况多么坏，司机的态度多么差，也无论身边的那个人是不是一个陌生人。
045dde1c86dd363c4c33a42ec2c32e8870c6f44c.translatedText: Ye Qingcheng: The Last Train The year we met, he was 30 years old and she was 29 years old. Before that, it was a similar process of going to the countryside, returning to the city, studying, and working in a blink of an eye. The years passed by like mountains and rivers, and it was easy to fall into the trap of older youths. Those who meet each other can read on each other's faces that they are no longer young. The whole love affair seemed to be nothing more than watching a movie, walking on the street after the show, and chatting. The words gradually ran out, and there were only the sounds of footsteps, one after another, tapping gently in the silent night. After being together for half a year, it was time to make a decision, but the relationship was always as light as a glass of water. He understands that people have the same conditions and are a good match, and he also knows that age is not forgiving. If you delay this time, there will be no more but fewer opportunities in the future, but in his heart he keeps thinking about the alienation and strangeness between the two. Well, the movie was extremely long, and the autumn rain made it a mess, making everything muddy. He ran after her, kicking her in and out, not even having time to take a look at the splashing mud and water. He was out of breath and kept waving his hands: "Wait a minute, wait a minute!" Seeing that she could hardly run, he turned around without thinking, grabbed her hand and dragged her to run as fast as he could. When they finally caught up, the car was already moving slowly, and the driver was furious and yelled at them for delaying his time. He had time to reply, but he was just glad that he finally caught the last train. After a while, he suddenly realized that she was panting so much that her legs were weak, and her whole body was half leaning on him. The car rattled like it was falling apart all the way, and the cold wind blew in through the broken window, making both of them shiver. He finally hesitantly reached out and put his arm around her, suddenly thinking everything clearly. They have both reached the end of their youth. He is her last bus, and she is his last bus. Apart from this, they no longer have any other choice, and once they miss it, there will be no next bus. At the most critical moment, they naturally support each other and catch up together, no matter how bad the condition of the car is, how bad the driver's attitude is, or whether the person next to them is a stranger.

10aad6a279c5be15cda5972686ea03ac614e7eb4.sourceText: 美国男性在经济复苏时期拿走超过三分之二的私人公司新就业，扭转了女性就业增长的长期趋势。 美国女性就业在经济大衰退中比例上升，一度超过男性成为多数。 新就业中出现令经济学家困惑的现象：目前新趋势的一个主要动力就是数十万名男性工人进入原来女性为主的零售业。 根据劳工统计局的数据，到11月结束的一年中，将近128万男子得到新工作，而新就业女性为60万人。 尽管大批男子重返制造业和服务业，却没有很多人再度从事目前仍然处于停滞的建筑业。 零售业新增男性工人21.69万人，大约相当于传统上男性集中的金融服务业新增人数的五倍；但零售商仅仅招聘9000名女性工人。 制造商新增加男性工人25万人，却裁减女性工人3.3万人。 穆迪分析经济学家斯威特说，”它证明就业市场是多么困难，厖男人正在拿走原来人们以为他们不会去干的工作。”他还提到失业人数为美国就业空缺的4.5 倍。 女性占美国就业的比例–包括私人公司和政府机构–在2009年10月达到49.99%，因为当时建筑业和金融服务业大裁员。 劳工统计局的数据显示，女性就业比例已经下降到49.4%。 劳工统计局经济学家贾科布斯说，该机构并没有研究为何新工作向着男性倾斜的原因。 但工薪家庭研究团体的一名主管说，那种转移是男子在经济衰退初期首当其冲之后的钟摆效应。 现代家庭理事会共同主席库恩兹说，教育和医疗卫生就业正在遭削减，这些都是传统的女性工作为主的行业。 斯威特说，促使男子进入新领域的最重要因素也许是失业救济就要到期。 他说，”他们要决定，你是要退出劳动力队伍还是抓到什么是什么？”
10aad6a279c5be15cda5972686ea03ac614e7eb4.translatedText: U.S. men took more than two-thirds of new private company jobs during the economic recovery, reversing a long-term trend of female employment growth. The proportion of women employed in the United States increased during the Great Recession, once surpassing men to become the majority. The emergence of new jobs has baffled economists: One of the main drivers of the new trend is the entry of hundreds of thousands of male workers into the formerly female-dominated retail sector. Nearly 1.28 million men gained new jobs in the year ending in November, compared with 600,000 newly employed women, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics. While men are returning to manufacturing and services in droves, not many are returning to construction, which remains stagnant. There were 216,900 new male workers in the retail industry, which is about five times the number of new people in the financial services industry, which has traditionally been dominated by men. However, retailers only recruited 9,000 female workers. Manufacturers added 250,000 new male workers but laid off 33,000 female workers. Sweet, an economist at Moody's Analytics, said, "It proves how difficult the job market is and that big men are taking jobs that people thought they wouldn't do." He also mentioned that the number of unemployed people is 4.5 times the number of job vacancies in the United States. Women's share of U.S. employment - including private companies and government agencies - reached 49.99% in October 2009, amid massive layoffs in the construction and financial services industries. According to data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics, the proportion of women employed has dropped to 49.4%. Jacobs Jacobs, an economist at the Bureau of Labor Statistics, said the agency does not study why new jobs are skewed toward men. But a director at the Working Families Research Group said that shift is a pendulum effect after men bore the brunt of the recession in the early days. Coontz, co-chair of the Council on Modern Families, said jobs in education and health care, traditionally female-dominated industries, are being cut. Perhaps the most important factor driving men into new fields is the impending expiration of unemployment benefits, Sweet said. He said, "They have to decide, are you going to drop out of the workforce or are you going to catch what is?"

a6771f4a2b12fe703f0d2424f23a0af2b19919f3.sourceText: 爱达荷州食品公司召回猪、牛和鸡肉 爱达荷州一家公司19日宣布召回33500磅全熟的肉类和家禽产品，原因是这批肉类可能遭到细菌污染。 美国农业部食品安全及检验局21日证实，爱达荷州的B和D食品公司的肉类可能受李斯特菌污染，有致命威胁。 这批肉类有五个不同产品组成，分售到亚利桑那州、加利福尼亚州、科罗拉多州、爱达荷州、俄勒冈州、犹他州、华盛顿州、蒙大拿州和俄亥俄州。 这些产品包括：*10磅/箱的2包5磅’ROYAL ‘THE TEMPURA KING’ ROYAL TEMPURA CHICKEN, Fully Cooked Tempura Chicken Breast,’ 产品号码：’A-4615’，分销在加州、科州、爱达荷州、俄勒冈州、犹他州和华盛顿州；*10磅/箱的2包5磅’BLINGS! CHICKEN BREAST WITH PARMESAN FLAVORING,’ 产品号码：’A-4844’，主销爱达荷州和蒙大拿州；*30磅/箱的’KETTLE COOKED CHICKEN BREAST PIECES,’ 产品号码：’A-3025-30’，这些销售点在亚利桑那州和加州。 以上肉类出厂日期为2012年12月6日。B和D食品公司发言人称，该公司通过微生物测试发现问题，但目前没有受到任何人因此发病报告。
a6771f4a2b12fe703f0d2424f23a0af2b19919f3.translatedText: Idaho Food Company recalls pigs, beef and chicken An Idaho company announced on the 19th that it is recalling 33,500 pounds of fully cooked meat and poultry products because the meat may be contaminated by bacteria. The U.S. Department of Agriculture's Food Safety and Inspection Service confirmed on the 21st that meat from B and D Food Company in Idaho may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes, posing a fatal threat. The meat was made up of five different products and was sold in Arizona, California, Colorado, Idaho, Oregon, Utah, Washington, Montana and Ohio. These products include: *2 packs of 5,10 lbs/case of ‘ROYAL ‘THE TEMPURA KING’ ROYAL TEMPURA CHICKEN, Fully Cooked Tempura Chicken Breast,’ Product Number: ‘A-4615’, distributed in California, Colorado, Idaho, Oregon, Utah and Washington; Product number: 'A-4844', mainly sold in Idaho and Montana; *30 pounds/box of 'KETTLE COOKED CHICKEN BREAST PIECES,' product number: 'A-3025-30', these sales points are in Arizona and California. The above meat production date is December 6, 2012. A spokesperson for B and D Foods said the company discovered the problem through microbiological testing, but there have been no reports of anyone getting sick as a result.

10928ab37d3063651b1d636c08ca63b9d2704fc6.sourceText: 华人先驱登陆北美纪念塑像碑设计出台（图） 佳佳 在160年以前,旧金山只是浩瀚的太平洋边一个荒凉渔埠。1848年加州发现金矿后,大批先辈华人赴美淘金，他们飘洋过海从旧金山唯一可以避风的海滩登岸后,从这里出发去谋生计。这里自然而然形成为华工的集散地。久而久之,人们约定俗成称这个避风港湾叫”中国海滩”。 在上世纪三十年代, 中国海滩被改名为”斐兰海滩”（是以旧金山前市长、联邦参议员詹姆士斐兰的名字命名的）。为了还历史本来面目,让历史记住华人对美国开发的贡献, 旧金山著名侨领钟武雄伉俪出钱出力,多方奔走,终于感动了美国朝野有识之士,获得了支持。八十年代，经美国国会批准, 将这个海滩永久命名为”中国海滩”。为了让这一难得的名称永留青史, 钟武雄伉俪捐资在海滩边建造了一个硕大的花岗石纪念碑,中文碑文是: 中国海滩( CHINA BEACH )，英文碑文是:”自淘金潮以来,这个海滩便是金山湾华裔的宿营地, 他们为这个年青城市的需要而奋发努力, 已协助建立了一个极重要的工业和传统。” 由于命名经过了严格而又完整的法律程序,在美国官方版图中, 在世界著名的金门大桥岸边海滩上,永远标上了让所有华人自豪的字眼: CHINA BEACH 。”中国海滩”石碑高高耸立在旧金山太平洋之滨,成为该市一个旅游胜地。”中国海滩”石碑也让历史永恒记住: 美国的开发和发展,华人功不可没! 去年11月，安成伩先生率领的美中文化产业交流促进会考察团一行，在犹他州雪松市参加了世界文化伟人斯诺夫人铜像捐赠典礼后，访问了北加州。同期会晤了92高龄的钟武雄先生和旅美社会活动家、成功企业家方李邦琴等多位知名人士，并专程参观了”中国海滩”纪念碑。该座花岗岩石纪念碑,巍然屹立在160年前华人登陆北美的旧金山海岸边,以缅怀开启了美中交流先河的中华先贤。考察团成员漫步在太平洋之滨,近观碧海兴波,鸢飞鱼跃,风帆点点,淸风拂面;远眺金门大桥,长虹卧波,虎踞龙盘,气象万千。碑前绿草如茵;碑下雪浪翻滚。中国著名雕塑艺术家刘玉山、塑像家蒙复旦等考察团成员，为这人间仙境所陶醉！他们灵感逸飞,即兴勘察，提出了扩建旅美华人奋斗史塑像群的构思,获得了在场中外人士的一片赞赏和支持。 侨居本地的企业家、美中文化产业交流促进会秘书长罗燕为落实这一宏伟设想,三个多月以来,不畏寒冬,不辞年假,出钱出力在美中两地多方奔走,终于获得初步成果:”旧金山中国海滩—华人登陆北美塑像纪念碑”的总体规划设计方案（初稿）终于问世。该设计方案在几个预选案中颖脱而出：设计气势磅礴，造型优美生动，金字塔型铜铸塑造，高达五米有余，直指白云苍穹；以花岗岩石作基础，以天然黑大理石刻碑文。旅美愈半个世纪的资深成功华裔、美中文化产业交流促进会高级顾问钟武雄、方李邦琴等人士表示：这个在旧金山扩建”中国海滩—华人登陆北美塑像纪念碑”之提议, 是中国民间外交的壮举！其纪念意义将超越国界,超越政治,涵盖二岸三地及融入美国社会的华裔华人,必将记入美中交流之青史。我们一定竭尽全力，取得美国朝野支持，让这个纪念碑早日巍然耸立在太平洋之滨，以彰华人之丰功！ 几年来,美中文化产业交流促进会主办和促成举办了美中交流的多项重大活动:成功推进了”WBC英雄赛事”、河南电视台”武林风走进美国—决战拉斯韦加斯”世界自由博击大赛 ；策划举办了世界文化伟人、著名作家斯诺夫人铜像捐赠活动,获得中西各界人士高度赞评。这次提出在旧金山扩建” 中国海滩—华人登陆北美塑像纪念碑”的计划，是一个划时代的大手笔。据悉，完成此项计划，将历时一年多，耗资愈百万美金，已有美中诸多成功企业表示了捐赞意愿；届时，美中有关重量级人士将出席隆重而热烈的揭幕典礼，并举办由中外一流名星所组合的大型文艺庆祝晚会和以”绿色畅想，环境保护”为题的高峰论坛会等活动。 附图说明： ”中国海滩—华人登陆北美塑像纪念碑”设计方案图: 设计气势磅礴，造型优美生动，金字塔型铜铸塑造，高达五米有余；以花岗岩石作基础，以天然黑大理石刻碑文。 受美中文化产业交流促进会安成伩主席的委托,秘书长罗燕(右一)副理事长言立(左一)向旅美著名侨领方李邦琴女士(左二)钟武雄先生(右二)呈送聘状和”中国海滩—华人登陆北美塑像纪念碑”设计图
10928ab37d3063651b1d636c08ca63b9d2704fc6.translatedText: The design of the monument commemorating the arrival of Chinese pioneers in North America was unveiled (photo) Jia Jia 160 years ago, San Francisco was just a desolate fishing port on the edge of the vast Pacific Ocean. After the gold mine was discovered in California in 1848, a large number of Chinese ancestors went to the United States to pan for gold. They crossed the ocean and landed on the only beach in San Francisco that could be sheltered from the wind, and set out from here to make a living. This place naturally became a distribution center for Chinese workers. Over time, people have come to call this haven "China Beach". In the 1930s, China Beach was renamed "Phelan Beach" (named after former San Francisco mayor and U.S. Senator James Phelan). In order to restore the true colors of history and let history remember the contribution of the Chinese to the development of the United States, the famous overseas Chinese leaders in San Francisco, Mr. and Mrs. Zhong Wuxiong, donated money and efforts, and worked in many ways. Finally, they moved the minds of the American government and the public and gained support. In the 1980s, with the approval of the U.S. Congress, this beach was permanently named "China Beach". In order to keep this rare name forever in history, Mr. and Mrs. Zhong Wuxiong donated money to build a huge granite monument on the beach. The Chinese inscription is: CHINA BEACH, and the English inscription is: "Since the gold rush, this beach has been the campground of Jinshan Bay Chinese. They have worked hard to meet the needs of this young city and have helped to establish a very important industry and tradition." Due to the strict and complete legal process of naming, the words that make all Chinese proud are forever marked on the official map of the United States on the beach on the shore of the world-famous Golden Gate Bridge: CHINA BEACH. The "China Beach" stone monument stands high on the Pacific Ocean in San Francisco and has become a tourist attraction in the city. The "China Beach" stone monument also reminds history forever: The Chinese have contributed indispensably to the development of the United States! In November last year, a delegation from the U.S.-China Cultural Industry Exchange Promotion Association led by Mr. An Chengyi visited Northern California after attending the donation ceremony of the bronze statue of the world cultural great Mrs. Snow in Cedar City, Utah. At the same time, we met with many celebrities such as Mr. Zhong Wuxiong, a 92-year-old man, and Fang Li Bangqin, a social activist and successful entrepreneur living in the United States, and made a special trip to visit the "China Beach" monument. This granite stone monument stands majestically on the coast of San Francisco, where the Chinese landed in North America 160 years ago, to commemorate the Chinese sages who pioneered exchanges between the United States and China. The members of the delegation walked along the shore of the Pacific Ocean, taking a close look at the waves in the blue sea, flying kites and leaping fish, fluttering sails, and gentle breeze blowing on their faces. They also looked at the Golden Gate Bridge from a distance, with a rainbow lying on the waves, a tiger sitting on a dragon's plate, and a myriad of phenomena. There is green grass in front of the monument; snow waves are rolling under the monument. The famous Chinese sculpture artist Liu Yushan, sculptor Meng Fudan and other members of the inspection team were intoxicated by this wonderland on earth! They were inspired, conducted impromptu surveys, and came up with the idea of ​​expanding the group of statues of the struggle history of Chinese in the United States, which won praise and support from people at home and abroad. In order to implement this grand idea, Luo Yan, a local entrepreneur and secretary-general of the U.S.-China Cultural Industry Exchange Promotion Association, braved the cold winter and took annual leave for more than three months, spending money and effort to travel in the United States and China. Finally, preliminary results were obtained: the overall planning and design plan (first draft) of "San Francisco China Beach - Chinese Landing in North America Statue Monument" was finally released. This design plan stood out among several pre-selected projects: the design is majestic, graceful and vivid, with a pyramid-shaped copper cast, more than five meters high, pointing directly to the white clouds and sky; it is based on granite stone and the inscription is engraved on natural black marble. Zhong Wuxiong, Fang Li Bangqin and other senior and successful Chinese Americans who have been in the United States for half a century and senior advisors of the US-China Cultural Industry Exchange Promotion Association said: This proposal to expand the "China Beach-Chinese Landing in North America Statue Monument" in San Francisco is a feat of Chinese people-to-people diplomacy! Its commemorative significance will transcend national boundaries and politics, covering the two Taiwan Straits and the Chinese people who have integrated into American society. It will surely be recorded in the history of U.S.-China exchanges. We must do our best to gain support from the U.S. government and opposition parties so that this monument can stand majestically on the shores of the Pacific Ocean as soon as possible to honor the great contributions of the Chinese people! In the past few years, the U.S.-China Cultural Industry Exchange Promotion Association has hosted and facilitated a number of major events for U.S.-China exchanges: it successfully promoted the "WBC Heroes Competition" and Henan TV's "Martial Arts Style Enters the United States - The Showdown in Las Vegas" World Free Fighting Competition; planned and organized the bronze statue donation event of Mrs. Snow, a world cultural great and famous writer, which was highly praised by people from all walks of life in China and the West. The plan to expand the "China Beach - Monument to the Chinese Landing in North America" ​​in San Francisco is an epoch-making undertaking. It is reported that the completion of this project will take more than a year and cost more than one million U.S. dollars. Many successful companies in the United States and China have expressed their willingness to donate. At that time, relevant heavyweights from the United States and China will attend the grand and enthusiastic opening ceremony, and hold a large-scale cultural celebration party composed of first-class Chinese and foreign celebrities and a summit forum with the theme of "Green Imagination, Environmental Protection" and other activities. Explanation of the drawing: "China Beach - Chinese Landing in North America Statue Monument" design plan: The design is majestic, graceful and vivid, with a pyramid-shaped copper cast and a height of more than five meters; it is based on granite stone and the inscription is engraved on natural black marble. Entrusted by Chairman An Chengzu of the U.S.-China Cultural Industry Exchange Promotion Association, Secretary-General Luo Yan (first from right) and Vice Chairman Yan Li (first from left) presented the employment letter and the design of the "China Beach-Chinese Landing in North America Statue Monument" to the famous overseas Chinese leader in the United States, Ms. Fang Li Bangqin (second from left) and Mr. Zhong Wuxiong (second from right).

f10e6dcc5b1f6b044378193c5990b7e421186a07.sourceText: 超市餐饮糕点三合一—“欣欣”完善“一站式”休闲采购中心 细心的人应该会发现10月初开始，欣欣超市发生了变化，餐饮部的香港快站变成了欣欣小站，头牌菜”贵妃鸡”摆在并不起眼的位置，可是每天都有人按时排队 来买。 糕点部似乎也换了新师傅和招牌”欣欣饼家”，新鲜的糕点源源不断的准时出炉。 超市，餐饮，糕点统一管理统一优质服务 怎么几天不见都变了？ 记者找到欣欣超市的负责人赖甲乙先生，他很忙，这边要接受采访，那边还有电话公司的服务人员在等着，还没开始聊天，赖先生就先道歉，说也许采访到一半 的时候，可能会被别的事情打断。 原来欣欣超市就是一站式采购的定位，除了超市其他附属部分都成功出租了，为什么要拿回来呢？ 大部分人都会为自己的工作做减法，赖先生怎么做起了加法？ 这就成为了记者最感兴趣的问题。 赖先生说，以前的租客都做得不错，但是不管是谁在经营，超市，餐饮，糕点都是一个整体，应该相互扶持，相互补充，抱成一个团，才有竞争力。 他希望三个部分是统一的服务水准，统一的管理规格，这是改变的初衷。 是美食，更是艺术，欣欣饼家创意出新品 ” 糕点不仅是食品更是艺术，有些糕点不仅是味道好，仅艺术造型就能让人产生购买的欲望。”赖甲乙说出了自己对欣欣饼屋的基本期望，希望找到和自己经营理念有碰撞 的人。 在9月多，赖先生就找到了还在纽约工作的糕点师陈奕胜。 他很年轻，却已经有了二十多年的从业经验。 他能基于传统的制作工艺，创作出符合现代糕点理念的新作品。 如今您到欣欣​​超市，有两种新式糕点记者强力推荐，第一个是鲔鱼包，第二是芋头酥。 鲔鱼英文是Tuna.鱼肉鲜美，口感香嫩，外面的面包松软可口，浓香沁鼻，是那些不爱甜面包朋友的最爱。 芋头酥也和鲔鱼包一样都是真材实料，馅可不是芋头香精的效果，而是正宗的槟榔芋烘烤而成，用料考究，工艺精湛。 赖先生说遇到陈师傅的时候正是中秋节期间，是糕点师傅最忙的时候，为了等到陈师傅的最后答复，欣欣超市扛住经营压力，耐心等待，同时也做好陈师傅一家人来 凤凰城的准备。 有付出，就有回报，陈师傅对”欣欣饼家”的基本要求也不仅仅是满足超市的供应，还打算开拓聚会，红白喜事，自​​助餐厅等市场的糕点供应。 一品”贵妃鸡”，欣欣小站容大佛 ” 外卖的铺头酒店的享受”用这句话来形容欣欣小站一点都不夸张。 招牌菜”贵妃鸡”就是在很多酒店都未必能品尝到的菜。 一提到”贵妃鸡”，业内人士都知道主厨是谁，他是2008年在德州奥斯汀厨艺大赛获得Iron Chef金奖的King Ma。 赖甲乙先生为了请这位”食神”出山，可是费了不少功夫。 处于半退休状态的King Ma已不再为薪水发愁，可是老朋友要求帮忙，King还是遵从几年前答应过的话，有需要一定会帮赖先生的忙。 小站开张没多久，就已经有人冲着”贵妃鸡”来小站吃饭。 几乎可以一年不进肉食的记者，也战战兢兢地品尝起这传说中的”贵妃鸡”。 说实话，品尝鸡肉最让记者脑袋发麻的就是那黏黏的鸡皮。 主厨King亲自端出了”贵妃鸡”，鸡肉非常干净，切得整齐，肉质透亮，鸡皮紧绷绷地裹在鸡肉上，好像比普通的鸡肉结实很多。 记者夹了一块放到嘴里，一咬下去，鸡皮鸡肉在一瞬间全部断开，非常有韧性，肉质滑嫩，鸡皮却脆嫩爽口，太美妙了，忍不住惊叹，这可是现实生活 中的”食神”！ King非常谦虚的说，没什么特别的，因为每个厨师的菜，都会说话。 自己说好没用，要顾客发自内心的赞赏才重要。 做了四十多年的菜，他总结出了做出好菜诀窍就是”勤劳，善于琢磨”。 ” 贵妃鸡”都是他亲手烹饪的，他有几个非常挑剔的习惯，第一要求鸡肉一定干净，他每天做菜都要检查鸡肉上的细毛是否处理干净了，第二 是给鸡肉按摩，否则吃到嘴里的鸡肉味道绝对不同，第三是讲究刀工。 不是味道好了，菜就做完了，一定要切得美观，而且还必须剔除腿骨，因为腿骨会变碎，妨碍顾客咀嚼。 记者一边听着一边吃着，不知不觉盘子里的鸡肉就不多了…. 熟悉欣欣超市的都知道，这里除了有新鲜的蔬菜和肉品，更有很多地道的台湾产品，原来常常是冲着这些台湾产品去的，现在更是想周末带着全家人去逛逛，一起 分享King主厨手下的特色菜，例如：莲藕小炒皇，渔乡炒米面，海南鸡饭等。 临走的时候，还能到欣欣饼家带上一周的早点，鲔鱼包，芋头酥，椰蓉面包，蛋挞…
f10e6dcc5b1f6b044378193c5990b7e421186a07.translatedText: Three-in-one supermarket catering and pastries - "Xinxin" completes the "one-stop" leisure purchasing center. Careful people will notice that starting from the beginning of October, Xinxin Supermarket has changed. The Hong Kong Express Station in the catering department has become the Xinxin Station. The first dish, "Queen's Chicken", is placed in an inconspicuous position, but people line up on time every day to buy it. The pastry department also seems to have a new chef and the signature "Xinxin Bakery", and fresh pastries are continuously baked on time. Supermarkets, restaurants, and pastries are managed under unified management and provide high-quality services. Why has everything changed after not seeing each other for a few days? The reporter found Mr. Lai Jiayi, the person in charge of Xinxin Supermarket. He was very busy. He had to be interviewed here, and there were service personnel from the telephone company waiting there. Before they started chatting, Mr. Lai apologized and said that maybe halfway through the interview, he might be interrupted by other things. It turns out that Xinxin Supermarket is positioned as a one-stop shopping. Except for the supermarket, other ancillary parts have been successfully leased. Why should we take it back? Most people do subtraction for their work. How did Mr. Lai start adding? This has become the question that reporters are most interested in. Mr. Lai said that the previous tenants have done well, but no matter who is running the business, supermarkets, restaurants, and pastries are a whole. They should support each other, complement each other, and work together as a team to be competitive. He hopes that the three parts will have unified service levels and unified management specifications. This is the original intention of the change. It is food, but also art. Xinxin Bakery creates new products. "Pastry is not only food but also art. Some pastries not only taste good, but the artistic shape alone can make people want to buy them." Lai Jiayi expressed his basic expectations for Xinxin Bakery, hoping to find someone who collides with his business philosophy. In September, Mr. Lai found pastry chef Chen Yisheng who was still working in New York. He is very young but has more than 20 years of experience in the industry. He is able to create new works that are in line with modern pastry concepts based on traditional production techniques. Now when you go to Xinxin Supermarket, there are two new pastries that the reporter strongly recommends. The first is tuna buns, and the second is taro cakes. Tuna in English is Tuna. The fish meat is delicious and the texture is tender. The bread on the outside is soft and delicious, and the aroma is strong and refreshing. It is the favorite of those who don’t like sweet bread. The taro cakes are made of real ingredients like the tuna buns. The filling is not the effect of taro essence, but is made from authentic betel nut taro baked with exquisite materials and exquisite craftsmanship. Mr. Lai said that when he met Master Chen, it was during the Mid-Autumn Festival, which is the busiest time for pastry chefs. In order to wait for Master Chen’s final reply, Xinxin Supermarket endured the operating pressure and waited patiently. At the same time, it was also prepared for Master Chen’s family to come to Phoenix. If you give, you will be rewarded. Master Chen's basic requirements for "Xinxin Bakery" are not only to meet the supply of supermarkets, but also plan to expand the supply of cakes to parties, weddings, weddings, cafeterias and other markets. A taste of "Royal Chicken", Xinxin Station is a big Buddha. "The enjoyment of a takeaway shop and hotel" is not an exaggeration at all to describe Xinxin Station. The signature dish "Queen's Chicken" is a dish that may not be available in many hotels. When it comes to "Queen's Chicken", everyone in the industry knows who the chef is. He is King Ma, who won the Iron Chef gold medal in the 2008 Austin Cooking Competition in Texas. Mr. Lai Jiayi spent a lot of effort to invite this "God of Cookery" to come out. King Ma, who is in a semi-retired state, no longer worries about his salary. However, when an old friend asked for help, King still followed his promise a few years ago and would definitely help Mr. Lai if needed. Not long after the small station opened, people were already coming to the small station for dinner because of the "Royal Concubine Chicken". The reporter, who could avoid eating meat for almost a year, tasted the legendary "Royal Concubine's Chicken" with trepidation. To be honest, the sticky chicken skin is what makes this reporter’s head tingle the most when tasting chicken. Chef King personally served the "Queen's Chicken". The chicken was very clean, neatly cut, and the meat was translucent. The chicken skin was tightly wrapped around the chicken, which seemed to be much stronger than ordinary chicken. The reporter took a piece and put it in his mouth. When he bit it, the chicken skin and chicken were all broken off in an instant. It was very tough, the meat was smooth and tender, and the chicken skin was crispy and refreshing. It was so wonderful that I couldn't help but marvel, this is the "God of Food" in real life! King said very modestly that there was nothing special about it, because every chef’s dish speaks for itself. It’s useless to say yes yourself, it’s important to have customers’ heartfelt appreciation. Having been cooking for more than 40 years, he concluded that the secret to making good food is "diligence and good at thinking." The "Royal Concubine Chicken" is all cooked by him. He has several very picky habits. The first is that the chicken must be clean. He has to check whether the fine hair on the chicken has been cleaned every day when cooking. The second is to massage the chicken, otherwise the taste of the chicken in your mouth will definitely be different. The third is to pay attention to knife skills. The dish is finished just because it tastes good. It must be cut beautifully and the leg bones must be removed, because the leg bones will break into pieces and hinder customers from chewing. The reporter ate while listening, and unknowingly there was not much chicken on the plate... Anyone who is familiar with Xinxin Supermarket knows that in addition to fresh vegetables and meat, there are also many authentic Taiwanese products. I used to go there for these Taiwanese products, but now I want to take the whole family to go shopping on weekends and share Chef King's special dishes together, such as: Stir-fried Lotus Root, Fishtown Fried Rice Noodles, Hainanese Chicken Rice, etc. Before leaving, you can go to Xinxin Bakery to bring a week's worth of breakfast, including tuna buns, taro cakes, coconut bread, egg tarts...

773bf66ca523b71e5dbb1b5147c25bb7d56d3733.translatedText: The warmth of winter - Phoenix Chinese School raises cans for the poor

d4b5a3d13f15969f74e44b1402de7e0f32056301.translatedText: The warmth of winter - Phoenix Chinese School raises cans for the poor (Contributed by Phoenix Chinese School) The weather in Arizona has entered December this year, and in the warm...

e4f4ea42d4c63a61a813764cbfeb4a7193f6deb2.sourceText: 今年亚利桑那的气候进入了十二月，在暖烈太阳的照射下，完全不见冬天的踪跡。虽然如此，岁末节庆，紧接著感恩大餐之后，大家又忙著一年最期待的圣诞节！凰凰城中文学校每年在这个时候，有个重要的活动就是罐头捐赠，这是我们关怀社会的行动之一。 由於慈济基金会凤凰城联络处今年发放给贫户的食品严重短缺，我们学校由学生代联会发起，在会长郑奕弘、副会长傅世婷及干部张家豪、陈懌陞、吴易霖积极参与下於十一月十一日正式展开募捐㓉动。凰凰城中文学校再次发挥大家庭人飢己飢的精神，总共捐出了三百九十三份罐头与乾粮。其中一百一十七份是由基础二张明道所捐。他一如往年，请受邀参加他生日庆生的小朋友以罐头代替生日礼物，将所收全数捐赠给学校。他小小年纪在募捐的行列表现的却一点也不小！学生代联将颁发奖状给张明道，谢谢他如此尽心。而每个家庭的捐献也都是善行表率，在这个暖冬送上我们的暖意！
e4f4ea42d4c63a61a813764cbfeb4a7193f6deb2.translatedText: The climate in Arizona has entered December this year. Under the warm sun, there is no trace of winter at all. Even so, after the year-end festivities and the Thanksgiving dinner, everyone is busy with the most anticipated Christmas of the year! At this time of year every year at Huanghuangcheng Chinese School, an important activity is canned food donation, which is one of our actions to care for the society. Due to the severe shortage of food distributed to poor households by the Phoenix Liaison Office of Tzu Chi Foundation this year, our school was initiated by the Student Representatives Association and officially launched a fundraising campaign on November 11 with the active participation of President Zheng Yihong, Vice President Fu Shiting, and cadres Zhang Jiahao, Chen Yisheng, and Wu Yilin. Huanghuangcheng Chinese School once again showed the spirit of a big family and donated a total of 393 cans and dry food. One hundred and seventeen of them were donated by Foundation 2 Zhang Mingdao. As in previous years, he asked the children invited to his birthday celebrations to give cans instead of birthday gifts and donate all the proceeds to the school. Even at such a young age, he performed very well in fundraising! The Student Representative Federation will award Zhang Mingdao a certificate to thank him for his dedication. And each family's donation is an example of good deeds, sending us warmth in this warm winter!

d298e77b2924cbeb3c67a0a047a6cdeee896601b.sourceText: 罐头募捐 学生代联将募得的全数捐赠於十二月二日交由慈济凤凰城联络处负责人慈滔师姊代表接收，希望為他们发放食品短缺现象暂时舒解！这就是凤凰城中文学校的文化，如果您想对我们多一点了解，或想加入这个学习中文的大家庭，请与校长程秀玲联络（480-620-1982）或参观学校网页( http://www.clsphoenix.org/ )。凤凰城中文学校邀请你加入我们的团队。
d298e77b2924cbeb3c67a0a047a6cdeee896601b.translatedText: Canned Donation Fundraising Student Federation will hand over all the donations raised to Tzu Chi Phoenix Liaison Office representative Sister Ci Tao on December 2, hoping to provide them with temporary relief from food shortages! This is the culture of Phoenix Chinese School. If you want to know more about us, or want to join this big family of Chinese learning, please contact the principal Cheng Xiuling (480-620-1982) or visit the school website (http://www.clsphoenix.org/). Phoenix Chinese School invites you to join our team.

cf1638a24e25a064e7dfcf8a18c6daed2c21131d.sourceText: 本文” 有雷” ，将披露部分人士认为应该禁止使用的英文词汇，不喜勿入。
cf1638a24e25a064e7dfcf8a18c6daed2c21131d.translatedText: This article is "troublesome" and will disclose English words that some people think should be banned. If you don't like it, don't read it.

a5a56ef5b46448b8de123c17365c1daed9a38f24.sourceText: 美联社报导，” 财政悬崖” （ fiscal cliff ）获得最多提名，是最应该禁用的词语。
a5a56ef5b46448b8de123c17365c1daed9a38f24.translatedText: The Associated Press reported that "fiscal cliff" received the most nominations and is the word that should be banned.

5bdc7c993cfd5a7e88cb1998b9ad01ab404f256d.sourceText: 财政悬崖是指美国国会若没有采取办法，全面性增税减支措施明年自动启动，经济可能受到巨大冲击。媒体过度频繁使用这个词，收看新闻时不想听到这个词都不行。
5bdc7c993cfd5a7e88cb1998b9ad01ab404f256d.translatedText: The fiscal cliff refers to the fact that if the U.S. Congress fails to take measures, comprehensive tax increases and expenditure cuts will automatically start next year, and the economy may suffer a huge impact. The media uses this word too often, and you can’t even watch the news without wanting to hear it.

bc420d0724da9e1bf5afba22aa6fb45e5c49f8c3.sourceText: 密西根州苏必略湖州立大学公布第 38 届年度” 误用、滥用与普遍无用，应禁用的字汇表” ，披露剧情的” 爆雷警告” （或有雷、有雷慎入， Spoiler alert ）、踢皮球（ kick the can down the road ）、趋势（ trending ）及人生清单（ bucket list ）都入列。
bc420d0724da9e1bf5afba22aa6fb45e5c49f8c3.translatedText: Lake Superior State University in Michigan released the 38th annual "List of misused, abused and generally useless words that should be banned". Spoiler alert, kick the can down the road, trending and bucket list are all listed.

c547f48fed9eee7bb6a8393138ed815d2f772d46.sourceText: 这个不具约束力、玩笑性质的词汇表，是根据美国、加拿大及其他地区民众所提出的应禁用字汇所制成。
c547f48fed9eee7bb6a8393138ed815d2f772d46.translatedText: This non-binding, tongue-in-cheek list is based on words that people in the United States, Canada and elsewhere have suggested should be banned.

ca15571751e6e823663979b1ab68687703fd8085.sourceText: ” 有雷慎入” 提醒读者或观众接下来的内容将提及电视剧或电影的关键剧情，不过，这个看似贴心的词语对许多人来说，已经被用得过于泛滥。
ca15571751e6e823663979b1ab68687703fd8085.translatedText: "Be careful when entering" reminds readers or viewers that the following content will mention the key plots of TV series or movies. However, this seemingly thoughtful word has been used too often for many people.

b01c1f245e2d3ccdb691ece055d8fef8654a0ffe.sourceText: 提议禁止者认为，爆雷警告” 被用在预告某人要披露琐碎的讯息，不管怎样都要用上这个词，令人反感” 。
b01c1f245e2d3ccdb691ece055d8fef8654a0ffe.translatedText: Proponents of the ban believe that thunder warnings "are used to warn someone about disclosing trivial information. It is offensive to use this word anyway."

ad37f3ea8992bb42b46973def03b6b6f4a945b8a.sourceText: 其他上榜的字还有” 超级食物” （ superfood ）、大师（ guru ）、” 创造就业机会者 ”（ job creators ）及双倍下注（ double down ）。
ad37f3ea8992bb42b46973def03b6b6f4a945b8a.translatedText: Other words on the list include "superfood", guru, "job creators" and double down.

eddc0882e150c5852a384ba033cc9ec83790ecc6.sourceText: “准生证”背后的故事 （纽约时报中文网） 2012年12月3日早上，国家计生委宣传教育司新闻管理处副处…
eddc0882e150c5852a384ba033cc9ec83790ecc6.translatedText: The story behind the “Birth Certificate” (New York Times Chinese website) On the morning of December 3, 2012, Deputy Director of the Information Management Office of the Publicity and Education Department of the National Family Planning Commission...

3bed42c94a44e995a6f2bde7d6c1be197a81a9be.sourceText: 2012年12月3日早上，国家计生委宣传教育司新闻管理处副处长蔡菲给我发来短信：”有关信息请关注中国人口网。”打开电脑，计生委网站的头条新闻就是：”我委发出通知要求各地切实解决好群众办证难问题”。
3bed42c94a44e995a6f2bde7d6c1be197a81a9be.translatedText: On the morning of December 3, 2012, Cai Fei, Deputy Director of the Information Management Office of the Publicity and Education Department of the National Family Planning Commission, sent me a text message: "Please pay attention to the China Population Network for relevant information." When I turned on the computer, the headline news on the website of the National Family Planning Commission was: "Our committee issued a notice asking all localities to effectively solve the problem of people's difficulty in obtaining certificates."

600fa216ca26fd344d11124a18bee43a1481966b.sourceText: 通知的主要内容是”切实简化办证流程、解决流动人口等人群办证难问题”，其中提到”对于流动育龄夫妻因长期或多次、多地流动无法证明婚育状况、信息核实确实存在困难等特殊情况，受理地可依据当事人的承诺，为其办理生育服务证（登记）。”简言之，对于流动人口而言，可以就地办理准生证。
600fa216ca26fd344d11124a18bee43a1481966b.translatedText: The main content of the notice is to "effectively simplify the certificate application process and solve the difficulty in obtaining certificates for migrant populations and other groups." It mentions that "for migrant couples of childbearing age who are unable to prove their marriage and childbearing status due to long-term or multiple migrations to multiple places, and who have difficulties in information verification, the place where the application is accepted can apply for a maternity service certificate (registration) for them based on the commitment of the parties." In short, for the floating population, birth certificates can be obtained locally.

09463f2dd9f2b22a151692284ac2164eb0dd73b4.sourceText: 短短一个多小时，这则新闻就被推送到各大网站的头条，微博里更是十分热闹。不少网友@我，说看到这个新闻就想到了我，想到了我给未出生的孩子办证难的经历，想到了2012年9月21日发表于纽约时报中文网的文章 《被”批准出生”的孩子》 。还有网友戏称”高明勇打赢了”。
09463f2dd9f2b22a151692284ac2164eb0dd73b4.translatedText: In just over an hour, this news was pushed to the headlines of major websites, and Weibo was even more lively. Many netizens @me said that they thought of me when they saw this news, and my experience of difficulty in obtaining a certificate for an unborn child. They also thought of the article "Children who were "approved to be born"" published on the New York Times Chinese website on September 21, 2012. Some netizens joked that "Gao Mingyong won the battle."

68f49b026e7ee0986c8a2c2ed03c4668f0c32264.sourceText: 《被”批准出生”的孩子》发表后，在新浪微博上被转发上千次，评论数百次。之后我将文章贴在网易和新浪的博客，网易博客三天的点击率已将近40万，新浪博客的点击率一天之内也达到了十几万。之后我在发表于人民网的一份《全国人口与计生舆情周报》（2012.10.8?012.10.14）（由深圳市中鸿在线公司整理）中发现，《被”批准出生”的孩子》被列入”计生博文、论坛”排名第一。
68f49b026e7ee0986c8a2c2ed03c4668f0c32264.translatedText: After "Children Approved to Be Born" was published, it was forwarded thousands of times and commented on hundreds of times on Sina Weibo. Afterwards, I posted the article on NetEase and Sina blogs. NetEase's blog had nearly 400,000 hits in three days, and Sina's blog had a hit rate of hundreds of thousands in one day. Later, I found in the "National Public Opinion Weekly Report on Population and Family Planning" (2012.10.8-012.10.14) published on People's Daily Online (compiled by Shenzhen Zhonghong Online Company) that "Children Approved to Be Born" was ranked first in "Family Planning Blogs and Forums".

f12cd97db3f55debef327d64d5a311669843ba99.sourceText: 我以前听说孩子出生要办准生证，总没有当回事，以为正常走程序就行了。没想到，这却成为我个人在2012年的最大事件。2012年4月，妻子一怀孕，我们就开始联系老家的计生办，给孩子办准生证。没想到，条件符合，材料齐全，却因不同地区间的规定不统一而被卡住了。9月，妻子的肚子日隆，可是”准生证”还没有拿到。我在微博上将经历简单写了一下，没想到引起很多人的共鸣，应纽约时报中文网的邀请，将这件”小事”写成了《被”批准出生”的孩子》。
f12cd97db3f55debef327d64d5a311669843ba99.translatedText: I had heard before that a birth certificate was required for the birth of a child, but I never took it seriously, thinking that I could just go through the normal procedures. Unexpectedly, this became my biggest personal event in 2012. In April 2012, as soon as my wife became pregnant, we started to contact the family planning office in our hometown to apply for a birth certificate for our child. Unexpectedly, although the conditions were met and the materials were complete, I was stuck due to inconsistent regulations in different regions. In September, my wife’s belly was growing, but she hadn’t received her “birth certificate” yet. I briefly wrote about my experience on Weibo, and unexpectedly it resonated with many people. At the invitation of the New York Times Chinese website, I wrote this "little thing" into "Children Approved to Be Born."

bc27d045eab4bc452cba433e4fb6ef6a0c0dc4e3.sourceText: 国庆期间，经中间人协调，我和妻子专门坐火车回老家，拿到了准生证。我想，这个事情可能就结束了。
bc27d045eab4bc452cba433e4fb6ef6a0c0dc4e3.translatedText: During the National Day, through the coordination of an intermediary, my wife and I took a train back to our hometown and obtained the birth certificate. I think this matter may be over.

ca6176e9b29d06be8b4586f4fabf75981a3589c1.sourceText: 过了国庆，10月12日，我所供职的报社《新京报》热线电话告诉我，说国家计生委在联系我，请我尽快回电话。看到消息，心中一惊，不知是福是祸。虽心中存疑，我还是尽快给对方回了电话。
ca6176e9b29d06be8b4586f4fabf75981a3589c1.translatedText: After the National Day, on October 12, the newspaper I worked for, the Beijing News, told me via hotline that the National Family Planning Commission was contacting me and asked me to call back as soon as possible. I was shocked when I saw the news, not knowing whether it was a blessing or a curse. Although I had doubts, I called him back as soon as possible.

32ea1b21b494ec0fef65b3120a3fc7299e639ad7.sourceText: 联系我的，是国家计生委流动人口服务管理司的工作人员（应对方要求，因为职责所限不具有对外发布信息的权力，因此不提及姓名），他想沟通有关《被?#25209;准出生?#30340;孩子》这篇文章事宜，态度很友好。说实话，得到国家计生委的积极回应，我再次感到出乎意料。
32ea1b21b494ec0fef65b3120a3fc7299e639ad7.translatedText: The person who contacted me was a staff member of the Migrant Population Service Management Department of the National Family Planning Commission (in response to the request of the other party, because he did not have the authority to release information to the public due to his responsibilities, his name will not be mentioned). He wanted to communicate about the article "An Expected Birth of a Child", and his attitude was very friendly. To be honest, I was once again surprised to receive a positive response from the National Family Planning Commission.

a3606563dc7b3f6464924df1998fa148e99350ea.sourceText: 他首先对我在办理准生证过程中遇到的困难向我道歉，然后问我自己的准生证办得怎么样，我说已经办好了。
a3606563dc7b3f6464924df1998fa148e99350ea.translatedText: He first apologized to me for the difficulties I encountered in applying for the birth certificate, and then asked me how my application for the birth certificate was going. I said it was done.

c176f16c85260a639c2aa15430990e5acafbcdba.sourceText: 他还感谢我对他们工作提出的意见，问我有什么诉求，我提了三点建议：一、办证难不是孤立的个案，从舆情反应看，很多人都有切肤之痛，更多的人还在办证难的路上，期待能在制度层面解决问题；二、现在舆论正在聚焦办证难，希望能正视民意，给予积极回应，而不是让怨愤之气继续积累；三、在正式的解决办法出台前，能否开通一个”绿色通道”，让正处在办证难中的人群，问题能得到较好的解决。
c176f16c85260a639c2aa15430990e5acafbcdba.translatedText: He also thanked me for my opinions on their work and asked me if I had any demands. I made three suggestions: 1. Difficulty in applying for a certificate is not an isolated case. Judging from the public opinion response, many people feel the pain, and more people are still on the road to difficulty in applying for a certificate. They look forward to improving the system. Second, public opinion is now focusing on the difficulty in obtaining a certificate. We hope that public opinion can be faced squarely and a positive response can be given, rather than allowing resentment to continue to accumulate. Third, before a formal solution is introduced, can a "green channel" be opened so that the problem can be better solved for people who are having difficulty in obtaining a certificate.

76cb121ca1dc06f5a07248b50d152b9b363c96dd.sourceText: 当时，对方回复说：”《被’批准出生’的孩子》这篇文章影响较大，是办证难的典型问题，类似问题也有过调研，预计12月初会推出相关的’管理办法’。”
76cb121ca1dc06f5a07248b50d152b9b363c96dd.translatedText: At that time, the other party replied: "The article "Children approved for birth" has a greater impact and is a typical problem that makes it difficult to obtain a certificate. Similar issues have also been investigated, and relevant 'management measures' are expected to be launched in early December."

c107c8f3f85e08848a62de0b22373340f0e33a18.sourceText: 我当时提出，想与国家计生委流动人口服务管理司司长王谦对话，并依据要求发了采访提纲，提出了包括计生委有关”准生证”办理的现有规定是出于什么考虑，国家计生委是如何监测舆论呼声的，面对舆论如何在制度层面解决问题，以及是否会取消”准生证”等问题。后来，按照计生委内部规定，采访事宜转移到计生委的宣教司，新闻管理处的副处长蔡菲一直与我保持沟通联系。再后来，因十八大的召开，采访一直推迟，至今尚未落实。
c107c8f3f85e08848a62de0b22373340f0e33a18.translatedText: I proposed at that time that I wanted to have a conversation with Wang Qian, Director of the Migrant Population Service Management Department of the National Family Planning Commission, and sent an interview outline as requested, including the reasons for the existing regulations of the National Family Planning Commission on the processing of "Birth Certificates", how the National Family Planning Commission monitors the voice of public opinion, how to solve problems at the institutional level in the face of public opinion, and whether the "Birth Certificate" will be cancelled. Later, in accordance with the internal regulations of the Family Planning Commission, the interview matters were transferred to the Publicity and Education Department of the Family Planning Commission. Cai Fei, deputy director of the Information Management Office, has been in constant communication with me. Later, due to the convening of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the interview has been postponed and has not yet been implemented.

f93627719cc38e1d6bd4ee08077a7af2f4725ccd.sourceText: 期间，为了配合采访，更为了准确把握”准生证”问题的严峻性，清华大学媒介实验室（也称”清研咨询”）也在我的请求下进行了一项关于《”准生证”该取消吗？》的专项调查。此次调查是根据他们自主研发的NetTouch网络调查系统对实名制样本组随机发放问卷展开，回收有效问卷1011份，受访者均为已婚人士。其中办理过”准生证”的占受访人的92.4%；感到办”准生证”困难的占44.2%；认为流动人口办准生证不需要回老家办理占60.1%。
f93627719cc38e1d6bd4ee08077a7af2f4725ccd.translatedText: During the period, in order to cooperate with the interview and more accurately grasp the seriousness of the "Birth Certificate" issue, the Tsinghua University Media Laboratory (also known as "Qingyan Consulting") also conducted a study at my request on "Should the "Birth Certificate" be cancelled? 》Special investigation. This survey was carried out based on their independently developed NetTouch network survey system, which randomly distributed questionnaires to a real-name sample group. 1,011 valid questionnaires were recovered, and the respondents were all married people. Among them, 92.4% of the respondents have applied for a "Birth Certificate"; 44.2% find it difficult to apply for a "Birth Certificate"; and 60.1% believe that migrants do not need to go back to their hometown to apply for a birth certificate.

87658c9cc67ccbbee37f93cc634d81163cbec587.sourceText: 这个调研结果与我个人所观察到的舆情反应基本一致。解决”准生证”办证难的问题，确实是势在必行，民意所向。
87658c9cc67ccbbee37f93cc634d81163cbec587.translatedText: The results of this survey are basically consistent with the public opinion reactions I have personally observed. It is indeed imperative to solve the problem of difficulty in obtaining the "Birth Certificate" and it is what public opinion wants.

45e6efd80a9c20b8a44418b2a01e09005279b9eb.sourceText: 所以，12月3日一大早，看到国家计生委的通知，我心里确实高兴，国家计生委公开回应民意，正面民众难题，做出政策调整，毕竟推动事情往前走了一大步。
45e6efd80a9c20b8a44418b2a01e09005279b9eb.translatedText: So, early in the morning on December 3, I saw the notice from the National Family Planning Commission, and I was really happy. The National Family Planning Commission publicly responded to public opinion, faced people's problems, and made policy adjustments. After all, it took a big step forward.

c1a16a1727fdf96340c292bb777f0ea03c2f21e2.sourceText: 但是随后，不少网友在微博上告诉我，他们看到”通知”后，立即与本地的计生部门联系，发现不容乐观。12月4日，网友@溪雨棠说：”我昨天打电话到12356，对方回答是根据北京市计生委的要求，夫妻双方必须有一方是北京市户口，才可以在京办理准生证，通知是不具法律效应的。”这位网友感叹说：”如果不能落实到实处，画的大饼再好看也没用。”
c1a16a1727fdf96340c292bb777f0ea03c2f21e2.translatedText: But then, many netizens told me on Weibo that after seeing the "notice", they immediately contacted the local family planning department and found that it was not optimistic. On December 4, netizen @xiyutang said: "I called 12356 yesterday, and the other party replied that according to the requirements of the Beijing Municipal Family Planning Commission, one of the spouses must have a household registration in Beijing before they can apply for a birth certificate in Beijing. The notice has no legal effect." The netizen lamented: "If not If it can be implemented, it will be useless no matter how beautiful the picture is. "

3983483835504288fcdf7e15480b6122e89bb307.sourceText: 一位在计生系统工作的不愿意公开姓名的朋友告诉我，国家计生委原定今年12月要推出一个”管理办法”，因内部有分歧，暂时搁浅。据他介绍，分歧在于如何给”准生证”定位，”准生证”究竟是为人口管理服务，还是为生育而服务，如果是前者，涉及到计生政策的变革；如果是后者，涉及到办事流程的简化。定位不同，调整的力度也不同。
3983483835504288fcdf7e15480b6122e89bb307.translatedText: A friend who works in the family planning system and did not want to be named told me that the National Family Planning Commission was originally scheduled to launch a "management method" in December this year, but it was temporarily shelved due to internal differences. According to him, the difference lies in how to position the "Birth Control Certificate". Whether the "Birth Control Certificate" serves population management or fertility. If it is the former, it involves changes in family planning policies; if it is the latter, it involves the simplification of service procedures. The positioning is different, and the intensity of adjustment is also different.

7d5d3e97d5a5356d1c917164ab21831279cf97b9.sourceText: 之后我与最初跟我沟通的那位流动人口管理司的工作人员联系，询问是否是因为”准生证”的定位问题阻碍了”管理办法”的出台，对方回应说，这个定位是针对”准生证”的讨论，而非针对流动人口管理问题，因为职责所限他无法给出答案。
7d5d3e97d5a5356d1c917164ab21831279cf97b9.translatedText: After that, I contacted the staff member of the Migrant Population Management Department who initially communicated with me and asked whether the positioning of the "Birth Certificate" was hindering the introduction of the "Management Measures". The other party responded that this positioning was for the discussion of the "Birth Certificate", not for the management of the floating population, and he could not give an answer due to limited responsibilities.

721524b44ff8d012247cbb7474266305ed36291e.sourceText: 就我个人经历来看，解决流动人口等人群办证难问题，真不该再难了，真不能再拖了，真不用想复杂了。而在现实操作中，12月3日的”通知”的行政效力和法律效力难免有限，如果基层部门阳奉阴违该怎么办？能否为受困者开通一个救济功能的”绿色通道”？我期待比”通知”更具法律效力的措施，来切实解决问题。
721524b44ff8d012247cbb7474266305ed36291e.translatedText: From my personal experience, it really shouldn’t be any more difficult to solve the problem of difficulties in obtaining certificates for migrants and other groups of people, it really can’t be delayed any longer, and it really doesn’t need to be complicated. In actual operation, the administrative and legal effects of the “Notice” on December 3 are inevitably limited. What should we do if the grassroots departments violate it? Can a "green channel" with a relief function be opened for the trapped? I look forward to measures with more legal effect than "notices" to effectively solve the problem.

8664c33be1c5d3da825cbdf89afe379636f8c457.translatedText: Gao Mingyong works in the media.

06c67a6d784428970531782eaf398b965d7c5b2b.sourceText: 钱德勒华裔议员黄馨民庆功宴盛大举办 近十位主流政客争相来拜票
06c67a6d784428970531782eaf398b965d7c5b2b.translatedText: The celebration banquet for Chandler Chinese Congressman Huang Xinmin was grandly held. Nearly ten mainstream politicians rushed to come and vote

a908c3486ccd2c97c605970a2b05f31a1b28508d.sourceText: 钱德勒华裔议员黄馨民庆功宴盛大举办 近十位主流政客争相来拜票 近四百五十中美嘉宾于10月7日晚相聚在C-F…
a908c3486ccd2c97c605970a2b05f31a1b28508d.translatedText: Chandler Chinese Congressman Huang Xinmin's celebration banquet was grandly held. Nearly ten mainstream politicians rushed to come and vote. Nearly 450 Chinese and American guests gathered at C-F on the evening of October 7th...

a41750d36a9455b2ec134a5d3236be2d1cabf7b7.sourceText: 近四百五十中美嘉宾于10月7日晚相聚在C-Fu gourmet餐厅，为钱德勒市华裔议员黄馨明竞选胜利共襄盛举。这是凤凰城历史上少有的因华人参政胜利而举办的大聚会。三年磨一剑，华人的坚韧，华人的努力，让政坛注意到了一股新兴的力量，所有的来宾都非常的激动，在亚利桑那，特别是钱德勒华人比较集中地区，华人政治意识和政治实力提升掀开了新篇章！
a41750d36a9455b2ec134a5d3236be2d1cabf7b7.translatedText: Nearly 450 Chinese and American guests gathered at C-Fu on the evening of October 7th. The gourmet restaurant co-hosted the event for Chandler City Councilman Huang Xinming’s election victory. This is one of the few large gatherings held in the history of Phoenix City due to the victory of Chinese participation in politics. After three years of sharpening a sword, the tenacity and efforts of the Chinese have attracted the attention of an emerging force in the political arena. All the guests were very excited. In Arizona, especially in the area where Chinese are concentrated in Chandler, a new chapter has been opened for the improvement of Chinese political consciousness and political strength!

c3b2930aea5ac84860007b23706732f87417d11e.sourceText: 邓朝驹（左） 余文劲（右）

23645ca733577496f0406e1e9fc6ad8a684bc15b.sourceText: 近90岁的资深侨领余文劲先生，亲自为黄馨民站台。他表示希望我们华人更加团结，发出我们的声音，保护我们的权益。
23645ca733577496f0406e1e9fc6ad8a684bc15b.translatedText: Mr. Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader who is nearly 90 years old, personally supports Huang Xinmin. He expressed the hope that we Chinese would be more united, make our voices heard, and protect our rights and interests.

580160536349f9bd593e4cd457d4bfa8f4c02c10.sourceText: 黄馨民与义工合影留念
580160536349f9bd593e4cd457d4bfa8f4c02c10.translatedText: >Huang Xinmin took a group photo with volunteers

174cc812134b2345d29cdbe417ac489b27368d88.sourceText: 黄馨民是第三次参选钱德勒议员，经过前两年的磨练， 没有大牌政客的支持，非常有限的竞选经费，精心策划竞选活动，走草根路线，争取每一个选民，整个团队的共同努力，以及华人社区的大力支持，黄馨民高票当选，华人社区欢欣鼓舞。
174cc812134b2345d29cdbe417ac489b27368d88.translatedText: Huang Xinmin is running for Chandler for the third time. After two years of training, without the support of big-name politicians, very limited campaign funds, carefully planned campaign activities, taking a grassroots route to win over every voter, the joint efforts of the entire team, and the strong support of the Chinese community, Huang Xinmin was elected with a high vote, and the Chinese community was delighted.

90ef2468b3f4f18dff5f02263a69e8b3fa43e552.sourceText: 黄馨民首先非常感谢大家的支持，他说现在要保证自己政治纲领得以实施，要履行诺言，为钱德勒的市民办事实。同时也觉得是一个非常好的机会与其他议员共事，相互学习。
90ef2468b3f4f18dff5f02263a69e8b3fa43e552.translatedText: >Huang Xinmin first thanked everyone for their support. He said that now he must ensure the implementation of his political program, fulfill his promises, and achieve results for the citizens of Chandler. At the same time, I also feel that it is a very good opportunity to work with other MPs and learn from each other.

77fff9b0fd2ddb35367b06dde874acd242e6414d.sourceText: 值得一提的是庆功宴上来了近十位的主流政客，他们有马山参加全美参议员竞选的Mccain的代表，第九区州议员的Davd Giles， 州议员候选人Bob Robson，钱德勒议员候选人Matt Eberle等。他们纷纷来祝贺黄馨民的当选，同时这次黄馨民大获全胜，让主流政坛看到了华人在南区的实力。在活动中他们自我介绍，希望能得到更多华人的支持。
77fff9b0fd2ddb35367b06dde874acd242e6414d.translatedText: It is worth mentioning that nearly ten mainstream politicians were present at the celebration banquet. They include Mccain’s representative who is running for the U.S. Senate race, Davd Giles, the state representative from the 9th District, state representative candidate Bob Robson, Chandler candidate Matt Eberle, etc. They came to congratulate Huang Xinmin on his election. At the same time, Huang Xinmin's resounding victory allowed the mainstream political arena to see the strength of the Chinese in the Southern District. They introduced themselves during the event, hoping to gain support from more Chinese people.

6364a6470fdaa24257790e454619920815b2ec62.sourceText: 在前来拜票的候选人中，我们又看到了一位华人的身影，他是张传东，英文名Andy Zhang, 他将竞选凤凰城Roosevelt School Board。 居住在Roosevelt学区选民可以乘胜追击，11月8日大选日中为他投票。 Roosevelt学区覆盖凤凰城南山地区下面是地图，方便市民查询。希望有更多华人，参与到政治活动中，扩大华人的影响。将注重教育，勤劳善良等华人优秀品质影响更多人。
6364a6470fdaa24257790e454619920815b2ec62.translatedText: Among the candidates who came to vote, we saw another Chinese figure. He is Zhang Chuandong, whose English name is Andy Zhang. He will run for Phoenix Roosevelt School Board. Voters who live in the Roosevelt School District can take advantage of his victory and vote for him on November 8, General Election Day. The Roosevelt School District covers the South Mountain area of ​​Phoenix. Below is a map for the convenience of citizens. I hope that more Chinese will participate in political activities and expand the influence of the Chinese. We will focus on education, hard work, kindness and other excellent Chinese qualities to influence more people.

74104cc5d1239b671c13ebc97f8b22943428e5dd.sourceText: 当晚，华联主席李健，侨联主席邓洪钺都上台讲话支持华裔参政，亚省中华总会，希望中文学校，现代中文学校，亚省艺术学院，亚省旗袍会，斐匿工商分会， 北京中医，同心堂 等组织都派代表表示支持。随着华人参政意识的提高我们期待更多的华裔政坛新秀出现，我们用选票发出自己的声音。
74104cc5d1239b671c13ebc97f8b22943428e5dd.translatedText: That night, Li Jian, Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, and Deng Hongyue, Chairman of the Overseas Chinese Federation, both took the stage to speak in support of Chinese participation in politics, the Chinese Association of Alberta, Hope Chinese School, Modern Chinese School, Alberta Art Institute, Alberta Cheongsam Association, Fei Ni Industrial and Commercial Branch, Beijing Traditional Chinese Medicine, Tongxintang Other organizations sent representatives to express their support. As the awareness of Chinese participation in politics increases, we expect more Chinese newcomers to emerge in politics, and we use our votes to make our voices heard.

d262c517a78b16fc9c9a851c27206b2017bf5190.sourceText: 今年12月12日- 14日在凤凰城将召开全美中文学校第10次全国代表大会，这是全国性的华文教育大会第一次在本州召开。夲地各中文学校及一批热心人士正紧张地工作，目前巳初见端倪。大会日程及主要报吿人己经硧定，来自全美中文教育的代表正在报名登记，应邀出席大会的美中教育界相关负责人、国侨办相关负责人和中国驻美领事舘的官员及夲州、相关市政府的官员己初步确定。大会组委会诚邀亚利桑那州各界人士参加，共同为传播中华语言文化的千秋大业同济一堂，共商大计。
d262c517a78b16fc9c9a851c27206b2017bf5190.translatedText: December 12th this year - The 10th National Congress of Chinese Language Schools across the United States will be held in Phoenix on the 14th. This is the first time that a national Chinese language education conference will be held in this state. Chinese schools in Guangdong Province and a group of enthusiastic people are working intensively, and the first signs are beginning to appear. The agenda and main speakers of the conference have been decided. Representatives from Chinese education across the United States are registering. The relevant persons in charge of the US-China education sector, the relevant persons in charge of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office, officials of the Chinese Consulate in the United States and officials of Guizhou and relevant municipal governments who are invited to attend the conference have been initially determined. The organizing committee of the conference sincerely invites people from all walks of life in Arizona to participate and discuss plans together for the great cause of spreading Chinese language and culture.
