dc610d58b3e67883d037c7960b8ac6765c86c282.sourceText: 《沙漠明珠》广受欢迎 据亚利桑那州立大学图书馆副研究员何乐平先生来讯：近日他到访凤凰城公共图书馆, 约见了藏书发展部主管凯瑟琳.沙利文, 向她介绍了《沙漠明珠》（作者：张肇鸿）的内容和作者, 并把书赠与了她. 凯瑟琳对图文并茂的 《沙漠明珠》很感兴趣，并称赞书的封面设计得非常好。她说,”The author did a great job in depicting the history of Chinese immigrants in the Great Phoenix Metropolitan Area. This book is a great asset to our library …”她肯定地说, ”这些书不久就会上架与读者见面,”并表示要把此书陈列在凤凰城公共图书馆的Arizona Room (该馆的小型博物馆)供大众参观。何乐平先生并对《沙漠明珠》作者表示，很高兴您的书如此受欢迎。谢谢您为华人社区作出的贡献。
dc610d58b3e67883d037c7960b8ac6765c86c282.translatedText: "Pearl of the Desert" is very popular. According to a message from Mr. He Leping, an associate researcher at the Arizona State University Library: He recently visited the Phoenix Public Library and met with Catherine Sullivan, the director of the collection development department. He introduced the content and author of "Pearl of the Desert" (author: Zhang Zhaohong) to her, and gave the book to her. Catherine was very interested in "Pearl of the Desert" with pictures and texts, and praised the book's cover design for its very good design. She said, "The author did a great job in depicting the history of Chinese immigrants in the Great Phoenix Metropolitan Area. This book is a great asset to our library..." She affirmed, "These books will be on the shelves soon to meet readers," and said that the book will be displayed in the Arizona Room of the Phoenix Public Library (the library's small museum) for the public to visit. Mr. He Leping also expressed to the author of "Pearl of the Desert" that he is very happy that your book is so popular. Thank you for your contribution to the Chinese community.

49ce22249b4b7cfc82b54afdb74865bf980c6598.sourceText: “红锅自助餐厅”烧红自助餐厅市场(图) 5月22日”红锅自助餐厅”（Red Wok Buffet）在托马斯路隆重开业（3434 E. Thomas Road, Phoenix, AZ 85018），餐厅内红色的主色调，简洁，雅致的装修，伴随着庆祝开业的鲜花，掌声，和祝贺，真和”红锅”这个热热闹闹的名字很匹配… … ”红锅”的味道与众不同 又一个自助餐厅开张了，和亚利桑那内大大小小的自助餐厅开业程序上非常相似，可是细细推敲，才发现这里果然是与众不同，不要心急，接下来，记者可不是要介绍自助餐厅里哪个具体的]特色菜，而是要介绍这个自助餐厅行业的特色菜红锅自助餐厅的老板张明雨是最早来亚利桑那开自助餐厅的福建老板，他告诉记者，他的自助餐厅旗帜鲜明，就是要做出地道的墨西哥风味。一句话让记者对采访有了兴趣。 新的不是菜而是观念 红锅自助餐厅的老板张明雨似乎让我们看到了一个新信号。他们在整个菜系的结构上有全面的调整。墨西哥人喜欢吃虾，和煎炸的鱼，他们就从这来做文章，加大这两种原材料的菜式，而减少一些墨西哥人不喜欢的生鲜。墨西哥人喜欢玉米，在采购玉米的时候，老板是一定会自己来把关。墨西哥人喜欢颜色比较丰富而且热烈的菜肴，于是在菜的色彩​​搭配上，一定要比传统中国自助餐厅来的大胆，在口味上，墨西哥菜肴的口感都比较重一些，所以一定要一改中国南方的清淡， 这是红锅自助餐厅在大的菜系结构上的调整，小得到具体的某几种墨西哥风味的主打菜例如：墨西哥春卷，墨西哥馅饼。 再看细节，从前台的服务生后台的大厨都能看到墨西哥人，他们是又能说英文又能说西班牙语，力图在这个给顾客最地道的墨西哥风味的服务。 红锅自助餐厅选在墨西哥朋友比较密集的地区，张明雨想要做出的是墨西哥风味的自助餐厅，不是中国墨西哥风味，目的就是要经得起地道墨西哥人的地道考验，是不是墨西哥风味就只会吸引墨西哥人呢？老板的答案当然是否定的，那些喜欢虾，喜欢鱼，喜欢辣，喜欢重口味的朋友，喜欢墨西哥口味的各种族裔的朋友都会来，还有本师傅是店里的绝活，他手下的寿司是出神入化，无论哪国人都会迷上。自然，墨西哥人肯定是最大最直接的受益者。为什么选择他们作为重要的目标客户？这是张先生结合自己多年的经营经验得出的决定，自助餐厅的传统特点就是让那些大家庭收益。墨西哥人的家庭单位，都比较大，一家都会有5至6个，或者近10个的成员，所以这样的家庭最适合到自助餐厅就餐。 红的不是一个锅而是一个行业 看到”红锅”，看到它后面的经营者，记者也不得不再想得更遥远一些，以后也许吃自助餐不是看哪家离家近了，很可能出现川味自助餐厅，湘味自助餐厅，我们喜欢哪个口味就上哪家去。20世纪90年代初由中国福建人开的自助餐厅风靡全美，它的特点就是菜肴可选择性多，量丰富，无限量的供给，价格公道，让你一次吃个够，特别适合大聚会。自助餐厅这种新的形式，在亚利桑那迅速成长起来，这让当地的餐馆业全面洗牌，很多亚利桑那的老字号都在那个时候受到的严峻的挑战。自助餐厅菜色大都相似，基本是按地区人口分布比例，在大凤凰城地区陆续开设，几年内也进入饱和状态，2008年美国经济危机以后，餐馆业也受重大影响，2010年我们看到很多实力雄厚的自助餐厅，开了，倒了… …业内人士都在研究他们未来的路在哪里？红锅自助餐厅的老板张明雨是最早来亚利桑那开自助餐厅的福建人之一，他的太太是亚利桑那餐馆会的副主席张华芳，他们在长期的经营中总结菜的制作，总结顾客的需求，然后用这些实际的第一手数据，去策划自己的未来，不断尝试着突破自己，突破自己行业固有的模式，希望这个”红锅”能烧得更猛烈些… … 最后”红锅”老板张明雨和张华芳让记者向所有支持他们的朋友表示感谢，他们说没有朋友们的支持他们也很难走到这一天。 红锅自助餐厅 墨西哥风味佳肴
49ce22249b4b7cfc82b54afdb74865bf980c6598.translatedText: "Red Wok Buffet" Red Wok Buffet Market (Photo) On May 22, "Red Wok Buffet" grandly opened on Thomas Road (3434 E. Thomas Road, Phoenix, AZ 85018). The main color of red in the restaurant, simple and elegant decoration, accompanied by flowers, applause, and congratulations to celebrate the opening, really matches the lively name of "Red Wok"... The taste of "Red Wok" is unique. Another cafeteria has opened, and the opening procedure is very similar to that of large and small cafeterias in Arizona. However, after careful consideration, I found that this place is really different. Don't be impatient. Next, the reporter is not going to introduce a specific special dish in the cafeteria, but to introduce the specialties of this cafeteria industry. Zhang Mingyu, the owner of the Red Pot Buffet Restaurant, is the first Fujian owner to open a buffet restaurant in Arizona. He told the reporter that his cafeteria has a clear banner, which is to make authentic Mexican flavors. One sentence made the reporter interested in the interview. What is new is not the food but the concept. Zhang Mingyu, the owner of the Red Pot Buffet Restaurant, seems to have given us a new signal. They have made comprehensive adjustments to the structure of the entire cuisine. Mexicans like to eat shrimp and fried fish, so they make a fuss from this, increasing the amount of these two raw materials in their dishes, and reducing some fresh foods that Mexicans don't like. Mexicans love corn. When purchasing corn, the boss will definitely check it himself. Mexicans like colorful and lively dishes, so the color combination of the dishes must be bolder than that in traditional Chinese buffet restaurants. In terms of taste, Mexican dishes are heavier, so the lightness of southern China must be changed. This is an adjustment of the large cuisine structure of the Red Pot Buffet Restaurant, and some specific Mexican-style main dishes such as Mexican spring rolls and Mexican empanadas. Looking at the details, you can see Mexicans from the waiters at the front desk to the chefs at the back. They can speak both English and Spanish, trying to provide customers with the most authentic Mexican-style service here. The Red Pot Buffet Restaurant is located in an area where Mexican friends are relatively dense. What Zhang Mingyu wants to create is a Mexican-style buffet restaurant, not a Chinese-Mexican style. The purpose is to withstand the authentic test of authentic Mexicans. Does Mexican style only attract Mexicans? The boss's answer is of course no. Friends who like shrimp, fish, spicy, heavy flavors, and friends of all ethnic groups who like Mexican taste will come here. Also, the chef is a unique skill in the store. His sushi is so good that people from all nationalities will be obsessed with it. Naturally, Mexicans are definitely the biggest and most direct beneficiaries. Why choose them as important target customers? This is a decision made by Mr. Zhang based on his many years of business experience. The traditional feature of the cafeteria is to benefit those big families. Mexican family units are relatively large, with 5 to 6 or nearly 10 members in a family, so it is most suitable for such families to eat in cafeterias. What is popular is not a pot but an industry. Seeing the "red pot" and the operators behind it, the reporter had to think a little further. In the future, maybe the buffet will not depend on which one is close to home. It is very likely that there will be a Sichuan-style buffet restaurant or a Hunan-style buffet restaurant. We can go to whichever one we like. Buffet restaurants opened by Chinese people from Fujian in the early 1990s have become popular across the United States. They are characterized by a large selection of dishes, rich portions, unlimited supplies, and reasonable prices, allowing you to eat enough at one time. They are especially suitable for large gatherings. The new form of cafeterias grew rapidly in Arizona, which completely reshuffled the local restaurant industry. Many time-honored Arizona restaurants were severely challenged at that time. Most of the buffet restaurant dishes are similar. They are basically based on the regional population distribution. They have been opened in the greater Phoenix area and have reached saturation within a few years. After the U.S. economic crisis in 2008, the restaurant industry was also greatly affected. In 2010, we saw many strong buffet restaurants open and collapse... Industry insiders are studying their future path? Zhang Mingyu, the owner of the Red Pot Buffet Restaurant, was one of the first Fujianese to open a buffet restaurant in Arizona. His wife is Zhang Huafang, the vice president of the Arizona Restaurant Association. They summarized the production of dishes and customer needs during their long-term operations, and then used these actual first-hand data to plan their own future. They constantly try to break through themselves and break through the inherent model of their own industry. I hope this "red pot" can burn more fiercely... Finally, the owners of "Red Pot" Zhang Mingyu and Zhang Huafang asked reporters to express their gratitude to all the friends who supported them. They said that without the support of their friends, it would be difficult for them to reach this day. Red Pot Buffet Restaurant Mexican Cuisine

18076f48fa99c71a1667475166cfbc2224faea7b.sourceText: 民调：亚省消费者乐观 （亚省时报） 尽管今年春天油价疯涨，但亚利桑那州的消费者仍对本州的经济持乐观态度。 周一公布的亚省消费者信心指数与上月相差无几，根据落基山民调公司数据，指数自一月起就没有变化。 消费者信心指数（Consumer Confidence Index ，CCI）是反映消费者信心强弱的 指标 ，是综合反映并量化消费者对当前经济形势评价和对经济前景、收入水平、收入预期以及消费心理状态的主观感受，是预测经济走势和消费趋向的一个先行指标，是监测经济周期变化不可缺少的依据。 指数 由消费者满意指数和消费者预期指数构成。消费者的满意指数和消费者预期指数分别由一些二级指标构成：对收入、生活质量、宏观经济、消费支出、就业状况、购买耐用消费品和储蓄的满意程度与未来一年的预期及未来两年在购买住房及装修、购买汽车和未来6个月股市变化的预期。 亚省消费者信心指数，从一月的69.5稍降至四月的68.5，降幅不大。根据目前资料显示，自2008年以来，每年一月和四月的指数都是全年的最高。 凤凰城大都会的汽油价格在3月28日见顶，当时的平均价格是3.93美元/加仑。但ASU经济学家认为，居民忧心油价的不稳定，仍对四月份的CCI造成影响。这位ASU教授曾预测今夏的油价飙升至5美元/加仑。 亚利桑那的就业市场依然悲观。在四月有53%的居民认为工作难找，在一月这项数据是56%。 以上民调是落基山民调公司在4月9日至17日进行，采访了700名本州居民。
18076f48fa99c71a1667475166cfbc2224faea7b.translatedText: Poll: Alberta consumers optimistic (Alberta Times) Despite skyrocketing gas prices this spring, Arizona consumers remain optimistic about their state’s economy. Alberta's consumer confidence index released Monday was about the same as last month, with the index unchanged since January, according to Rocky Mountain Polling Corp. Consumer Confidence Index (CCI) is an indicator that reflects the strength of consumer confidence. It comprehensively reflects and quantifies consumers' evaluation of the current economic situation and subjective feelings about economic prospects, income levels, income expectations and consumer psychology. It is a leading indicator for predicting economic trends and consumption trends, and is an indispensable basis for monitoring changes in the economic cycle. The index consists of consumer satisfaction index and consumer expectation index. The consumer satisfaction index and consumer expectation index are respectively composed of some secondary indicators: satisfaction with income, quality of life, macroeconomics, consumer spending, employment status, purchase of durable consumer goods and savings, and expectations for the next year, as well as expectations for the purchase of housing and decoration, purchase of cars, and changes in the stock market in the next six months in the next two years. The Alberta consumer confidence index fell slightly to 68.5 in April from 69.5 in January, a slight decrease. According to current data, since 2008, the index in January and April every year has been the highest in the whole year. Gas prices in the Phoenix metro area peaked on March 28, when the average price was $3.93 per gallon. However, ASU economists believe that residents' concerns about the instability of oil prices will still have an impact on the CCI in April. The ASU professor predicted gas prices would soar to $5 a gallon this summer. Arizona's job market remains pessimistic. In April, 53% of residents thought it was difficult to find a job, and in January this figure was 56%. The above poll was conducted by Rocky Mountain Polling Company from April 9 to 17, and interviewed 700 state residents.

6c89431be6b489838914230db445a521a935aa5f.sourceText: 心水：瞎子摸象 瞎子摸象 心水 美国第一位登月太空人杭思朗先生(Neil Armstrong)出八月廿五日因心臟病辞世，享年八十二岁；全美政府机构及公共场所都下半旗致哀，纪念这位被誉為「国家英雄」的伟大人物。 这位传奇英雄个人的一小步，却是人类探索太空的一大步；在他成功登月之前的人类歷史及古人，都无法知悉月球的真面目。当然、也因他的成功，而将中国人千百年来有关嫦娥奔月的美丽神话故事击破。 对於空茫无际的太空，地球上渺小的人类一直充满好奇；从人类始祖「元谋人」开始至今几百万年，有文字记载的史实不到万年。号称有五千年的中华文明，在过去几千年里，几乎都在為更换朝代自相残杀、斗争、吞併。而千百年来其他民族也莫不是在為统治者的野心而东征西伐，用流成河的鲜血肥沃著荒凉的地球黄土。 及至几十年前杭思朗先生登月的这一大步跨越后，才如轰雷般震撼著人类对外太空的强烈探勘愿望。掘起的东方巨龙中国、不久前还史无前例的派出了首位女太空人飞出地球外空傲游了。 这些太空探索壮举、无非是明白了人类所在的地球，正日渐因被过度开发而危机处处。诸如南北极因暖化后大量融冰、生态变动，海水平面渐涨，终会浸没沿海陆地城镇，希望在将再不宜人类居住的这颗蓝色球体崩塌前，人类能移到更好的生存环境。 古代华厦子民们，眼中的「天下」，是无法超越「海棠叶」形的地方，江山只是「逐鹿中原」成功后就能得到；秦始皇统一的所谓国家，其实这些子民也都是炎黄子孙。 随著洋人航海业发达，人类在各自土地上生活万千年后，终於知道天涯外海角处还有其他相同人类生活著，各国人民不再孤单了。科技发达至今，太空望远镜的远程探勘结果，「宇宙」正应了经文中那句「三千大千世界」广阔无涯无边的大。 在天空上存在的千亿万亿颗闪烁的星星中，难道除了地球上的「人类」与其他动物生灵外，就再无生命存在了吗？於是「外星人」成了人类文明最想寻觅到的宇宙生物。 科学家早已向太空发射无数电波和讯号，世界各国各个宇航局、太空站的电波接收器，莫不日夜忙碌工作，盼能收到来自外空的电波或回应？可惜、為了种种理由，这些太空机密档案，并非我们普通人能知悉。也因此、外星人传闻才会甚嚣尘上。 有宗教信仰的人，只要相信了「上帝」，「天主」、「阿拉」，「佛菩萨」、「太上老君」等等，自然不必探究诸如人类起源、地球、宇宙初始等等问题。只要打开新旧约经书、可兰经、佛经或道德经，都有记载，也就不必為此烦心了。 可是、七十亿人类中，并非全都有宗教信仰啊，不少科学家、天文学家、文学家、物理学家们，由於求知欲强烈，又不相信各类不同「宗教」经典的撰述，才会在国家支持力量下，发展太空技术和天文学，无非想破解至今人类无非确知的种种疑问。 很年青的时候，每当星月映照之夜，经常仰望天宇，对闪烁群星发呆，想像嫦娥的孤寂、牛郎织女星的妻凉故事。当然还有孙悟空大闹天宫的西游记神话，让我对太空充满了无比的好奇。 忘了何时开始捧读有关天文学的著作，了解光速与光年的计算，银河系、恒星、行星等星球的距离，越看越迷茫。越懂本应该是了解越多，可是、居然发现懂得越多，对天宇所知竟是越少？原因是「宇宙」之无穷、无尽、无际、无边大，实非小小脑袋所能想像所能装载。 地球大小在宇宙中，只像海滩上沙堆中一颗不起眼的小小沙粒；比蜗牛角还要细小呢；可是、人类各个国家不断磨擦、战争，真是「蜗牛角内争」而已，值得吗？有远见的各国领导人，应该化干戈為玉帛，人类更要淡化「国家」观念，爱国爱乡都是「小爱」，大爱、博爱是「爱全人类」、「爱地球」，彼此合作，共同保护、珍惜我们生存的唯一「地球」。 科学家说将来地球会被太阳「撕裂」，这就是物理学家最新的宇宙「大撕裂」理论。因此、世界末日将发生在167亿年后地球爆炸、时间消失前的第16分鐘。 牛津著名科学家罗杰、彭罗斯爵士研究宣称，发现宇宙大爆炸前，还存在另一个宇宙的证据？另位著名科学家史蒂芬、霍金教授则说宇宙已发生多次「大爆炸」了。宇宙学理论认為，黑洞将宇宙内的物质全部吞噬，发生相碰撞导致又一次宇宙大爆炸？ 引述上两段报导文字，是想让读者知道，渺小的人类实在不必杞人忧天，不论世界末日是真是假，宇宙如何形成？大爆炸前是否已另有「宇宙」，在岁月漫漫的时间长河上，人类对太空的探索，不外是「瞎子摸象」吧了! 二零一二年九月四日於墨尔本。
6c89431be6b489838914230db445a521a935aa5f.translatedText: Favorites: A blind man touches an elephant. A blind man touches an elephant. Favorites. Neil Armstrong, the first American astronaut to land on the moon, died of a heart attack on August 25 at the age of 82. Flags were flown at half-mast in government agencies and public places across the United States to commemorate this great man known as a "national hero." This legendary hero's small personal step is a giant step for human exploration of space. Before his successful landing on the moon, human history and ancient people were unable to know the true face of the moon. Of course, because of his success, the beautiful Chinese myth about Chang'e flying to the moon for thousands of years was shattered. The tiny human beings on earth have always been curious about the vastness of space. From the time of the ancestor of mankind "Yuanmou Man" to the present for millions of years, the written historical facts are less than 10,000 years old. The Chinese civilization, which is said to be five thousand years old, has been killing, fighting, and annexing each other for the past few thousand years to change dynasties. And for thousands of years, other nations have also been marching east and west for the ambitions of their rulers, fertilizing the desolate loess of the earth with rivers of blood. It wasn’t until Mr. Hang Silang’s big step to land on the moon decades ago that mankind’s strong desire to explore outer space was shaken like thunder. The rising dragon of the East, China, not long ago sent the first female astronaut to fly outside the earth for the first time in history. These feats of space exploration are nothing more than understanding that the earth where humans live is increasingly in danger due to over-exploitation. For example, due to the massive melting of ice in the Arctic and Antarctic, ecological changes, and rising sea levels, coastal land towns will eventually be submerged. It is hoped that humans can move to a better living environment before this blue sphere, which is no longer suitable for human habitation, collapses. In the eyes of the people of Huaxia in ancient times, the "world" was a place that could not transcend the shape of "begonia leaves". The country could only be obtained by successfully "racing for the Central Plains"; the so-called country unified by Qin Shihuang, in fact, these people were also descendants of Yan and Huang. With the development of foreigners' navigation industry, after thousands of years of living on their own lands, human beings finally learned that there are other similar human beings living in the corners of the world, and people of all countries are no longer alone. With the development of science and technology, the results of remote exploration by space telescopes show that the "universe" corresponds to the vastness of the "three thousand worlds" in the scriptures. Among the hundreds of billions of twinkling stars in the sky, is there no life except "human beings" and other animal life on earth? Therefore, "aliens" have become the cosmic creatures that human civilization most wants to find. Scientists have already launched countless radio waves and signals into space. Radio receivers at various aerospace agencies and space stations around the world are busy working day and night, hoping to receive radio waves or responses from outer space? Unfortunately, for various reasons, these secret space files are not accessible to us ordinary people. This is why rumors of aliens are so popular. As long as people with religious beliefs believe in "God", "God", "Allah", "Buddha", "Tai Shang Laojun", etc., they naturally do not need to explore issues such as the origin of mankind, the earth, the beginning of the universe, etc. As long as you open the Old and New Testaments, the Koran, the Buddhist scriptures or the Tao Te Ching, they will all be recorded, so you don’t have to worry about it. However, not all of the seven billion human beings have religious beliefs. Many scientists, astronomers, litterateurs, and physicists have a strong thirst for knowledge and do not believe in the writings of various "religious" classics, so they develop space technology and astronomy with the support of the state. They just want to solve various questions that humans have no doubt about until now. When I was very young, every night when the stars and the moon were shining, I would often look up at the sky and stare at the twinkling stars, imagining the loneliness of Chang'e and the story of the marriage of Cowherd and Vega. Of course, there is also the myth of Journey to the West in which Sun Wukong causes havoc in the Heavenly Palace, which makes me extremely curious about space. I forgot when I started reading books about astronomy, understanding the calculation of the speed of light and light years, and the distances of the Milky Way, stars, planets and other planets. The more I read, the more confused I became. The more you understand, the more you should understand, but you actually find that the more you understand, the less you know about Tianyu? The reason is that the infinite, endless, boundless, and boundless "universe" is beyond the imagination and capacity of a small mind. In the universe, the size of the earth is only like an inconspicuous small grain of sand in the sand on the beach; it is even smaller than a snail's horn. However, the constant friction and war between various human countries is really just "internal strife in a snail's horn". Is it worth it? Far-sighted leaders of various countries should turn conflicts into friendship. Humanity should also downplay the concept of "country." Patriotism and love of hometown are "small loves." Big love and fraternity are "love for all mankind" and "love for the earth." They should cooperate with each other to protect and cherish the only "earth" for our survival. Scientists say that the earth will be "torn apart" by the sun in the future. This is physicists' latest theory of the "big rip" in the universe. Therefore, the end of the world will occur at the 16th minute before the earth explodes and time disappears 16.7 billion years later. Famous Oxford scientists Sir Roger Penrose claimed in their research that they found evidence that there was another universe before the Big Bang? Another famous scientist, Professor Stephen Hawking, said that the universe has experienced multiple "big bangs". According to cosmological theory, black holes swallow up all the matter in the universe and collide with each other to cause another Big Bang? The purpose of quoting the two paragraphs of the report is to let readers know that small humans do not need to worry unreasonably. Regardless of whether the end of the world is true or false, how did the universe come into being? Is there a "universe" before the Big Bang? In the long river of time, human exploration of space is just a "blind man trying to figure out the elephant"! September 4, 2012 in Melbourne.

e3f01a43c72b657da876ba76463760c15ce4050f.sourceText: （本网讯 谢成彦）2014年9月21日，连续第五次参加”凤凰之夜”中国合作面面观的论坛。主持人Steven在开场用最近美国股市引起轰动的”阿里巴巴”以及中国人以6000块钱来买一只苹果手机作为例子，来阐述中国对世界经济的影响，以及中国市场的巨大潜力。然而这些影响只是个开始。随之产生的问题是美国人如何从世界上这个最大的市场–中国，获益;美籍华人这个既了解中国又熟悉美国的特殊群体，如何发挥自己的优势，在职业规划上取得先机。这就是”与中国合作面面观”举办的重要意义。
e3f01a43c72b657da876ba76463760c15ce4050f.translatedText: (news from this website) Xie Chengyan) On September 21, 2014, he participated in the "Phoenix Night" forum on all aspects of China's cooperation for the fifth consecutive time. At the beginning, host Steven used the example of "Alibaba" that has recently caused a sensation in the US stock market and the Chinese people buying an iPhone for 6,000 yuan to explain China's impact on the world economy and the huge potential of the Chinese market. But these impacts are just the beginning. The question that arises is how Americans can benefit from China, the largest market in the world; how can Chinese Americans, a special group that understands both China and the United States, leverage their advantages and gain a head start in career planning. This is the significance of the "Aspects of Cooperation with China" event.

35ce7dd251e7741fd950cc7d5284f56adaedbdc8.sourceText: 作为记者这是每一年期待的采访事件。不是因为多少能遇见一些亚利桑那的”牛”人，而是在每一年的演讲者中都能有那么几个让人称牛的人。这次要提的是Pactera执行营销总裁吴建。他的演讲题为”全球化之路-Pactera的故事”。吴建和在凤凰城的很多华人有类似经历。他毕业于上海同济大学，后来获得南加州大学计算机硕士学位。2002年-2004年曾任Wenditel Inc.公司产品开发副总裁，Wenditel Inc.是美国一家专注于在线支付的电子商务公司。
35ce7dd251e7741fd950cc7d5284f56adaedbdc8.translatedText: As a reporter, this is the interview event you look forward to every year. It's not that you can meet a few "cow" people from Arizona, but that there are a few people who are called "cow" among the speakers every year. This time I want to mention Wu Jian, executive marketing president of Pactera. His speech was titled "The Road to Globalization - The Story of Pactera". Wu Jian and many Chinese in Phoenix have similar experiences. He graduated from Tongji University in Shanghai and later received a master's degree in computer science from the University of Southern California. From 2002 to 2004, he served as Vice President of Product Development at Wenditel Inc., an American e-commerce company focusing on online payments.

831c4263cec339d52ae335726929be2edebb2495.sourceText: 2004年，看到中国经济迅速崛起，吴建选择了海归，加入了中国的Pactera公司。具有多年在美国工作经验的吴建，依然还记得自己第一次代表新公司到美国来谈合作的情景。前期一切顺利，就当他带着公司的老总到达美国的时候，对方拒绝洽谈合作。吴建说当时就傻了，都已经到了美国连谈的机会都没有。不能心在就打道回府呀。好说歹说，他才得知原因。合作的公司了解到他们公司作为某大公司的服务供应商，竟然连提供服务ID都没有。对于美国公司来说，根本不可能与这样的公司合作，根本连谈的机会都没有。可事实是Pactera的确在中国为这个大公司提供的服务。只是美国人重视的这个手续，他们没有向合作方索要而已。现在反而成了”非正规军”的罪证。吴建求着当时洽谈的负责人，把如何能证明自己公司曾经跟某大公司提供服务，需要哪些资料和手续，他们合作还需要当地或者中国公司达到哪些要求，合作才可以进行。他们一边打听，一边落实。从零开始，适应每一项规则，非常不易。尽管吴建在美国呆了那么多年，相当熟悉海外市场，可是这一步一步走来，是一个纠结成长而痛苦的过程。适应了规则，他们公司就在新环境下迅速成长。当年Pactera一直积极想要合作的公司，如今已经被Pactera远远超过。十年Pactera成长为中国为据点的最大的IT服务公司，有着超过22000名专业人员为它的全球客户提供世界级的商业／IT咨询、解决方案以及外包业务等服务。吴建说现在先做好中国的老大，全球化是一个必然趋势，Pactera的全球化指日可待。他找出2012年中国最引人注目的大公司，其中没有阿里巴巴，可是2014年，阿里巴巴成为了不仅是中国，而是让世界注目的大公司。Pactera会是下一个吗？
831c4263cec339d52ae335726929be2edebb2495.translatedText: In 2004, seeing the rapid rise of China's economy, Wu Jian chose to return overseas and joined the Chinese company Pactera. Wu Jian, who has many years of working experience in the United States, still remembers the first time he came to the United States to discuss cooperation on behalf of a new company. Everything went well in the early stage, but when he arrived in the United States with the company's CEO, the other party refused to discuss cooperation. Wu Jian said that he was stupid at that time. He had already arrived in the United States and had no chance to talk. You can't just go home if you don't care. After all, he finally learned the reason. The cooperating company learned that their company, as a service provider for a large company, did not even provide a service ID. For American companies, it is simply impossible to cooperate with such a company, and there is no chance to even talk. But the fact is that Pactera does provide services to this large company in China. It's just that Americans attach great importance to this procedure, and they don't ask for it from their partners. Now it has become the evidence of the "irregular army". Wu Jian asked the person in charge of the negotiation at the time to explain how he could prove that his company had provided services to a large company, what information and procedures were needed, and what requirements local or Chinese companies needed to meet before the cooperation could proceed. They inquired about it and implemented it at the same time. Starting from scratch and adapting to every rule is not easy. Although Wu Jian has been in the United States for so many years and is quite familiar with overseas markets, this step by step has been a tangled and painful process of growth. After adapting to the rules, their company grew rapidly in the new environment. The companies that Pactera had been actively trying to cooperate with back then have now been far surpassed by Pactera. In the past ten years, Pactera has grown into the largest IT services company based in China, with more than 22,000 professionals providing world-class business/IT consulting, solutions and outsourcing services to its global customers. Wu Jian said that the first step is to be the boss in China. Globalization is an inevitable trend, and the globalization of Pactera is just around the corner. He identified the most eye-catching large companies in China in 2012, and Alibaba was not among them. However, in 2014, Alibaba became a large company that not only attracted the attention of China, but also the world. Is Pactera next?

8a2bc6f08aceefc6a9f31cbdc64a979379d451d9.sourceText: Pactera成长,吴建个人职业生涯的成长，他们的选择，让我看到了一群光着脚奔跑的人，无畏！他们适应规则，突破规则，重建规则。阿里巴巴来了，Pactera会来，越来越多的中国公司也将占领国际舞台，我们，华裔美国人的机会是不是就来了？ 论坛结束后，我看到亚利桑那州立大学市场专业的学生，挤到演讲者身边跟他们谈中国市场，并留下名片说，如果有机会希望能到中国发展。我在想这是多么好的机会，为什么亚利桑那中国留学生们没有抓住这样的机会，问问现在他们公司最需要什么样的人才，或者问他们大公司在走向国际化的过程中，有留学背景的学生会有什么优势和劣势？同样期待看到更多和吴建一样背景的海外华裔工程师，希望他们在中国公司走向国际化的过程中找到新机会
8a2bc6f08aceefc6a9f31cbdc64a979379d451d9.translatedText: The growth of Pactera, the growth of Wu Jian's personal career, and their choices made me see a group of people running barefoot, fearless! They adapt to the rules, break the rules, and rebuild the rules. Alibaba is coming, Pactera will come, and more and more Chinese companies will occupy the international stage. Will opportunities come for us, Chinese Americans? After the forum, I saw marketing students from Arizona State University crowded around the speakers to talk to them about the Chinese market, and left their business cards saying that they hoped to develop in China if given the opportunity. I was thinking about what a great opportunity this was. Why didn’t the Chinese students in Arizona seize this opportunity and ask them what kind of talents their companies need most now? Or ask them what advantages and disadvantages would students with overseas study background have in the process of internationalization of large companies? We also look forward to seeing more overseas Chinese engineers with the same background as Wu Jian, and hope that they will find new opportunities in the process of Chinese companies going international

376d2b26352ffbbc1086e9b02e24673c71233789.sourceText: 中国合作面面观 值得期待。
376d2b26352ffbbc1086e9b02e24673c71233789.translatedText: Aspects of Chinese cooperation worth looking forward to.

930e427e860f9662c5c4e43d1886cdf35769132b.sourceText: 等我青年时，已不太敢下水了，游完之后头发就臭不可闻，鸭子不怎么飞回来，河蟹更少咬绳。到现在，我直逼苍孙，斑鸠河一带沿岸有很多生态居住的广告，可只见泥沙俱下，河蟹、斑鸠和野鸭几乎绝迹。
930e427e860f9662c5c4e43d1886cdf35769132b.translatedText: When I was young, I no longer dared to go into the water. My hair smelled terrible after swimming, ducks rarely flew back, and river crabs rarely chewed the rope. Up to now, I am close to Cangsun. There are many advertisements for ecological living along the Turtle River, but all I can see is mud and sand, and the river crabs, turtle doves and wild ducks are almost extinct.

2772d615b59b909f32a26de43aad8dcb333f735b.sourceText: 各位领导，请问，这些河现在连河蟹都不居住了，为什么你们还要求人类和谐居住。这是我关心的问题。
2772d615b59b909f32a26de43aad8dcb333f735b.translatedText: > Leaders, please ask, these rivers are no longer even inhabited by river crabs, why do you still require humans to live in harmony. This is my concern.

b4787448e207f54fad2a6649d11492af5688d79c.sourceText: 所以就想谈谈你们的使命。我曾经单纯地以为你们是抱着同归于尽的想法要把GDP搞上去，也不易。后来才知道你们就差洗脚也用纯净水，很多的家人已在安置在更安全的市区。还有那两个从外地空降的主要领导，任期一满就将远走高飞，所以，你们不是来服务的，你们是来开矿的，什邡不过是你们的矿区，四十万什邡人正是你们的钼铜矿石。当然，荣幸的是，你们不知道当地群众其实很想挽留你们，他们散完步也叹息着：让这一拨蚊子吸血也好啊，吸饱了它们就趴在肉上睡觉，要是赶它们走，换一拨蚊子来，更吃不消了。
b4787448e207f54fad2a6649d11492af5688d79c.translatedText: So I just want to talk about your mission. I once simply thought that you wanted to perish together. It is not easy to increase GDP. Later I found out that all you needed was pure water for washing your feet, and many family members had been relocated to safer urban areas. There are also the two main leaders who were parachuted in from other places. They will leave as soon as their term of office expires. Therefore, you are not here to serve, you are here to mine. Shifang is just your mining area, and the 400,000 Shifang people are your molybdenum copper ore. Of course, fortunately, you don't know that the local people actually want to keep you. They will sigh after taking a walk: It's okay to let this group of mosquitoes suck blood. When they are full, they will lie on the meat and sleep. If you drive them away, a new group of mosquitoes will not be able to bear it.

040a78196d8f9dd2c44c2eaffe20621b2855115f.sourceText: 你们正身体力行地解释着你们奇怪的使命，所谓发展模式：就是把四、五十万人民的利益，切换成四五个人的利益。把五十年的使命，浓缩为五年的任期。任期轮转，换战术再来一遍。
040a78196d8f9dd2c44c2eaffe20621b2855115f.translatedText: You are personally explaining your strange mission. The so-called development model is to switch the interests of 40 to 50 million people into the interests of four or five people. Condensing a fifty-year mission into a five-year term. Term rotation, change tactics and do it again.

49127e9a20c26f7755c68ab3a6b8bbbed3b9c23e.sourceText: 各位领导，你们知道这些民众其实也无所谓了，他们早就有此生把化学元素周期表尝遍的准备。据我了解的情况，最早的那一拨不明真相的群众去到什邡政府时，更在乎的是你们得给出合情合理的解释，而不是强硬的通知。可你们强硬惯了，虽然在黄岩鸟、钓鱼岛、越南问题上你们和你们的同僚特别擅长对外国人做出友好的解释，第一时间脑弧射就反射出无偿捐款、高档校车和大熊猫，可是对同胞，你们第一时间会反射出装甲车、防暴盾牌、棍棒。跟外面沟通时，你们总会想起”两国拥有高度一致的根本利益”这样的句子，跟里面沟通时，你们总会使用”不顾国家大局，不考虑通盘计划”…..让我经常搞不清你们跟我们一个国籍，还是日本人。日，本人。
49127e9a20c26f7755c68ab3a6b8bbbed3b9c23e.translatedText: Dear leaders, you know that these people actually don’t care. They have long been prepared to taste the periodic table of chemical elements in this life. As far as I know, when the first group of people who didn't know the truth went to the Shifang government, they cared more about you giving a reasonable explanation rather than a tough notice. But you are used to being tough. Although you and your colleagues are particularly good at making friendly explanations to foreigners on the Huangyaniao, Diaoyu Islands, and Vietnam issues. The first thing your brain reflects is free donations, high-end school buses, and giant pandas. But to your compatriots, you will immediately think of armored vehicles, riot shields, and sticks. When communicating with the outside world, you always think of sentences like "the two countries have highly consistent fundamental interests." When communicating with the outside world, you always use "regardless of the overall situation of the country and the overall plan."... I often can't figure out whether you have the same nationality as us or whether you are Japanese. Japanese.

c646ea75d01f1872e240d0a40df5a16121110899.sourceText: 各位正在GDP和Tear gas之间连夜奋战的领导，你们已很熟悉第一个英文缩写了，不幸的是，我发现你们居然开始尝试后一个英文单词，Tear gas，是的，催泪瓦斯…..我以为这是一道关于文明很本质的鸿沟，也是你们发病的前兆。所以我写这封信，并不是来证明你们只是维稳手段不明智、太粗心、肾上腺冲动了……这么说是美化你们。我们都是成年人了，在这个事事要装麻木的时代，你我的肾上腺其实都只会在床上冲动。不是吗？所以我要说，你们中的很多人正因为一种奇怪的使命，走向几十年前的那个对立面。
c646ea75d01f1872e240d0a40df5a16121110899.translatedText: Dear leaders who are fighting all night between GDP and Tear gas, you are already familiar with the first English abbreviation. Unfortunately, I found that you have actually started to try the last English word, Tear gas, yes, tear gas... I thought this was a very essential gap in civilization and a precursor to your illness. Therefore, I am not writing this letter to prove that your measures to maintain stability are unwise, too careless, and adrenaline-driven... To say this is to glorify you. We are all adults, and in this age where we have to pretend to be numb about everything, your adrenal glands and mine are actually only excited in bed. Isn't it? So I want to say that many of you are heading towards the opposite side of what you were decades ago because of a strange mission.

9398a89bbd921eb90ee73912a694f195f7614224.sourceText: 我看到一些照片，有十来岁小孩倒在大街上无人理睬的，有一个妇人被追得狼奔豕突，终于被我警英勇KO在地的，当然最动静皆宜的是一组对比照片：前一张是08年地震后，一个女孩子手举纸片，上写”解放军，我们爱你”后一张是一名白衣女孩跪在一排威武的防暴盾前面。这照片我不知是否实地拍摄的，但它们精准说明了什邡以及更多矿区的事情。我说的不是什邡而是十方的事情，这封信也想写给各地防暴大侠，你们上游打了抗议污染的群众，然后回到下游喝被污染的自来水。你们不是矿的主人，为何不抬高三公分。当然我知道这么说显得很没智商，因为，过去我曾把这个国家比为一个小区，我们只是没被承认业主权利的住户，可现在我发现小区还好，这里已全然变成了一个矿区。可是各位领导，你们该知道，你们开的不是矿，是一条条生命，你们驱散的不是居民，而是民心，在无数个病句中，这次你们使用的最为别致：”少数别有用心的民众用花盆和矿泉水瓶袭击政府机关”VS”为了控制局面，有关部门出动手持盾牌、棍棒、催泪瓦斯、震爆弹的军警”。
9398a89bbd921eb90ee73912a694f195f7614224.translatedText: I saw some photos. A teenage child fell on the street and was ignored. There was a woman who was chased and was finally knocked to the ground by our police. Of course, the most moving and moving photos are a set of comparison photos: the former one is after the 2008 earthquake, a girl holding a piece of paper with "PLA, we love you" written on it. The latter one is a girl in white kneeling in front of a row of powerful riot shields. I don’t know if these photos were taken on site, but they accurately illustrate what happened in Shifang and other mining areas. What I am talking about is not Shifang but Shifang. I also want to write this letter to the anti-riot heroes everywhere. You beat up the people protesting against pollution in the upper reaches, and then go back to the lower reaches to drink polluted tap water. You are not the owner of the mine, why don't you raise it by three centimeters. Of course, I know it seems unintelligent to say this, because in the past, I compared this country to a community, and we were just residents whose rights as owners were not recognized. But now I find that the community is not bad, and it has completely turned into a mining area. But leaders, you should know that what you are opening is not a mine, but a life. What you are driving away is not the residents, but the hearts and minds of the people. Among countless sick sentences, the one you used this time is the most unique: "A few people with ulterior motives used flower pots and mineral water bottles to attack government agencies" vs. "In order to control the situation, the relevant departments dispatched military police armed with shields, sticks, tear gas, and explosive bombs."

458c12bca1cf5552638bee9f598c282f1f34f558.sourceText: 于是，花盆和矿泉水瓶成为大规模杀伤武器了。
458c12bca1cf5552638bee9f598c282f1f34f558.translatedText: As a result, flower pots and mineral water bottles have become weapons of mass destruction.

e6eeb60b06356328128ef59f7c3b3405423feeea.sourceText: 各位领导，写到这里，这封信其实是想了解你们的秘密棗我最近一次去什邡，是512大地震期间，那天我领一支混编救援队经过时，在一片一片歪倒的房子后面，发现一座屹立的水泥厂，同行者说。那就是修了五所不倒希望小学的汉龙集团。虽然那份功劳更应属天天用铁锤敲打着水泥柱的屌丝监工，句艳东，但我们爱屋及乌，仍肃然起敬，我还写了那篇文章。可是刚听说宏达集团与汉龙集团是堂兄弟关系。我不见得会把两者强行牵扯在一起，可我很关心，为什么一个救孩子于死地，另一个却要置孩子于死地。在整个汶川大地震前后，为何干好事时见不到当地政府，干坏事时却赫然在目。什邡的书记和市长，先请把那九千万重建款拨入宏达钼铜开发的事说清楚吧，全国人民的重建款，不是拿来毒害什邡人的。
e6eeb60b06356328128ef59f7c3b3405423feeea.translatedText: Dear leaders, I am writing this letter to learn your secrets. The last time I went to Shifang was during the May 12th earthquake. When I led a mixed rescue team to pass by, I discovered a standing cement factory behind the crumbling houses, a traveler said. That is Hanlong Group, which has built five surviving Hope Primary Schools. Although the credit should go to Ju Yandong, the diaosi supervisor who hammered the concrete pillars every day, we loved him so much that we were still in awe, and I even wrote that article. But I just heard that Hongda Group and Hanlong Group are cousins. I may not force the two to be involved together, but I am very concerned about why one saves the child from death while the other wants to put the child to death. Before and after the Wenchuan earthquake, why was it that the local government was not visible when doing good things, but clearly visible when doing bad things? Secretary and mayor of Shifang, please first make it clear that the 90 million reconstruction funds allocated to Hongda Molybdenum Copper Development. The reconstruction funds from the people of the whole country are not used to poison the people of Shifang.

069bde9ab4642262801f12e66b22d0038a4a9ecd.sourceText: 不仅什邡，08年大地震后，整个灾区的官员们莫名其妙拥有一种奇怪的使命，即：买豪车是为了重建，挪用赈灾款是为了重建，重度污染也是为了重建，贪污也是为了重建…..因为一场灾难，你们获得太多的犯罪豁免权和不被批评权，更重要的是棗你们被惯坏了，自我英雄催眠，强烈的悲剧崇高感，有时候连你们自己都产生幻觉，搞不清此时是在贪污还是在重建，是个人账户还是项目账本，是别人的老婆还是自己的情妇，所以你们做出公然袭击民众的决定并不突然，你们深思熟虑，且大义凛然。我认为，当烟雾升起、驱散民众那一刻，你们甚至想到要向上级报功请愿，哦，当机立断处理了一起由别有用心的人挑起的群体事件……此案例可向全国推广。
069bde9ab4642262801f12e66b22d0038a4a9ecd.translatedText: Not only Shifang, but also after the 2008 earthquake, officials in the entire disaster area inexplicably have a strange mission, that is: buying luxury cars is for reconstruction, misappropriating disaster relief funds is for reconstruction, severe pollution is for reconstruction, corruption is also for reconstruction... Because of a disaster, you have received too many criminal immunity and are not approved. Judgment, more importantly, you have been spoiled, self-heroic hypnosis, and a strong sense of tragic sublimity. Sometimes even you yourself have hallucinations, and you can't figure out whether you are embezzling or rebuilding, whether it is a personal account or a project ledger, someone else's wife or your own mistress, so your decision to openly attack the people is not sudden. You are thoughtful and righteous. I think that when the smoke rose and the people were dispersed, you even thought of reporting to your superiors and petitioning for credit. Oh, you acted decisively to deal with a mass incident provoked by people with ulterior motives... This case can be promoted across the country.

0227aeb872f542720db91603dd5a699290a7e1a3.sourceText: 这样一种奇怪的使命感，让中国发生的自然灾难，从来不是单个的，就像你们扔出来的震爆弹。
0227aeb872f542720db91603dd5a699290a7e1a3.translatedText: Such a strange sense of mission makes the natural disasters in China never individual, just like the detonation bombs you throw out.

4016baea08d82e865c04f5663db1085e713ade0e.sourceText: 这个国家已变成一个极大的矿区，这样下去，你们不只会把地球镂空，也会把人心镂空。
4016baea08d82e865c04f5663db1085e713ade0e.translatedText: This country has become a huge mining area. If this continues, you will not only hollow out the earth, but also hollow out the human heart.

cc22ff7d86f778898bde475d9e3fb8fbd9853e4f.sourceText: 最后，我正在成都，会开车前往什邡，我不会围攻也不会煽动，只是想看看这座曾经很熟悉的小城，遥想一下鸭子河里那些飞来的花脸鸭，和草绳上的河蟹。当然谨记变态辣椒一个醒世名句：自我懂事之后，这里让我感动的东西，就只剩下催泪瓦斯了。
cc22ff7d86f778898bde475d9e3fb8fbd9853e4f.translatedText: Finally, I am in Chengdu and will drive to Shifang. I will not besiege or instigate. I just want to see this once-familiar town and think about the colorful ducks flying in the duck river and the river crabs on the grass rope. Of course, keep in mind the famous saying of Perverted Pepper: After I became sensible, the only thing that moved me here was tear gas.

26b503576c3f53591abfdff6997beac621c9b6fe.sourceText: 去过胡夫水坝的游客肯定记得Rosie’s Den餐馆。上周五一场大火导致胡夫水坝以南的这家地标性餐馆烧毁。 金谷消费局长奥斯本说，Rosie’s Den餐馆的火势从地下室开始，因电线短路所致，并迅速吞噬了这座1930年代的建筑物。他说，地下室原有的木墙助长了火势蔓延。 餐馆老板罗斯拉森说，她没有买火灾保险。她说，志愿者们在帮她清除瓦砾和捐赠金钱，帮她重建。奥斯本局长说，餐馆已成一片废墟。最惨的是该餐馆不属任何消防局所辖。所幸相邻的礼品店没有受到殃及。
26b503576c3f53591abfdff6997beac621c9b6fe.translatedText: Visitors who have been to the Cheops Dam will definitely remember Rosie’s Den restaurant. A fire destroyed the landmark restaurant south of the Khufu Dam on Friday. Golden Valley consumer chief Osborne said the fire at Rosie’s Den started in the basement due to a short circuit in electrical wiring and quickly engulfed the 1930s building. He said the basement's original wooden walls contributed to the spread of the fire. Restaurant owner Rose Larson said she did not have fire insurance. She said volunteers are helping her clear rubble and donating money to help her rebuild. Chief Osborne said the restaurant was in ruins. The worst part is that the restaurant is not under the jurisdiction of any fire station. Fortunately, the adjacent gift shop was not affected.

1309ac6caef62ffe82fe5b5b99c931816db0b258.sourceText: 国民党亚利桑那直属分部特订於三月九日下午一时，於康乐大厦举办纪念黄花岗烈士专题演讲座谈会。今天我们纪念黄花岗之役，不仅因為在七十二烈士中有海外华侨，更重要的是為了珍惜中华民国民主制度来之不易的成果。并且继续支持中国国民党，為实现孙中山先生三民主义的理想而奋斗不懈。 本次座谈会特别邀请了鲍家麟教授，金鐘影后谷音， 国民党中央候补委员姚其川教授，全美台湾同乡联谊会副会长吴程远及名作家少君教授出席，和大家一起庆祝这特别的纪念日。 论坛中， 我们安排有专题演讲，包括 黄花岗之役(正史、野史及妇女贡献) ，国民党海外分部未来的建设与展望，海外党员的心声。 同时也有开放式的讨论，希望结合亚省侨界现状，徵求各方意见，為党分部今后工作提出建议。我们也希望关心国民党直属分部发展建设的朋友们，踊跃参加发表意见。
1309ac6caef62ffe82fe5b5b99c931816db0b258.translatedText: The Arizona branch of the Kuomintang has specially scheduled a special lecture symposium in commemoration of the Huanghuagang Martyrs at 1:00 pm on March 9 at the Kangle Building. Today we commemorate the Battle of Huanghuagang not only because among the seventy-two martyrs there were overseas Chinese, but more importantly because we cherish the hard-won achievements of the democratic system of the Republic of China. And continue to support the Chinese Kuomintang and work tirelessly to realize the ideals of Dr. Sun Yat-sen's Three People's Principles. This symposium has specially invited Professor Bao Jialin, Queen Elizabeth II Gu Yin, Professor Yao Qichuan, alternate member of the Central Committee of the Kuomintang, Wu Chengyuan, vice president of the Taiwanese Association of America, and Professor Shaojun, a famous writer, to attend the symposium to celebrate this special anniversary with everyone. In the forum, we have arranged special speeches, including the Battle of Huanghuagang (official history, unofficial history and women’s contribution), the future construction and prospects of the KMT’s overseas branches, and the voices of overseas party members. At the same time, there was also an open discussion, hoping to solicit opinions from all parties based on the current situation of the overseas Chinese community in Alberta and make suggestions for the future work of the party branch. We also hope that friends who are concerned about the development and construction of branches directly under the Kuomintang will actively participate and express their opinions.

6e24b3862fb2a903d1ffa00ba6eca553ae6dd400.sourceText: 新东方艺术学校召开新学年教师工作会议（图） （禾禾报导）2012年8月1日晚上七点，新东方艺术学校在本校内召开了新学年全体教师工作会议， 安排新学年教学工作及部署中秋汇报演出和画展 。参加会议的除了任课教师外还有学校的多名管理人员。会议由校长吕丽华主持。会议议题分为三个部份。吕校长首先回顾和总结了在过去的一学年里学校的教学工作，总结了经验并找出了不足；然后对新学年的教学和管理工作进行了部署和安排；最后对各科的任课老师在教学目标和劳动纪律方面提出了具体的要求。 吕丽华校长发言（左） 吕校长在会上再次强调了新东方艺术学校办学的宗旨和意义。她说，我们是中国人，在美国就要有我们自己的声音。所以，从大的方面讲，我们学校的宗旨就是”传承中华文明，开创美好未来”；从小的方面讲，就是要让我们的孩子了解和知道中国的文化和艺术，增强他们做为中国人的后代所应具有的民族自尊心、自信心和自豪感。此外，新东方艺术学校做为亚省华人社区的一分子，应尽已所能，为增强华人社区的凝聚力贡献力量。吕校长在会上多次强调了教学质量对于学校的重要性，她说教学质量是学校立足的根本，我们一定要做到让孩子们学有所成，让家长放心地把孩子们送来。 工作会议现场 众所周知，新东方艺术学校的强项是中国民族舞蹈的教学，她们拥有一支非常优秀的专业舞蹈教学的队伍，邱晓蓉、胡秋子、刘欧、陈思等多名受过专业舞蹈教育的老师一直是新东方教师队伍中的中坚力量。此外，今年新加盟的陈蔚萍老师，北京舞蹈学院研究生毕业，华中师范大学音乐学院舞蹈系副教授，曾担任过系主任。同时，新东方还开设了由美国人CHUC ERICSEN和闻琳玲执教的拉丁舞的课程，在社区里也很受欢迎。在刚刚过去的亚省华裔选美的晚会中，由新东方的八位老师和学员共同表演的拉丁舞给现场观众留下了深刻的印象。更值得一提的是学校又开设了肚皮舞的课程，肚皮舞是目前风靡全球的将女性减肥和健身及提升女性身心灵气完美结合的一种舞蹈。本课程将由中国著名的肚皮舞表演艺术家汤可老师担任。 在新学年里，新东方还将开设芭蕾舞课和以培训仪态仪表为目的的模特课。此外，武术课的教学也很有特色，今年将继续由少林寺和尚释延清师傅主持。钢琴课也继续由年轻的钢琴表演艺术家叶青青老师担任。 学校在新学年的工作安排中尤其加强了美术课的教学。有两位新老师加盟新学年的教学工作。著名美术家徐威东老师，他除了教授画画课之外，还开设了颇受孩子们欢迎的泥塑课。MINA老师毕业于ASU美术专业，专业水平颇高。两位老师可谓是强强联合，使我们有理由相信，新学年的美术课将会令社区里所有的学生和家长耳目一新。 新东方艺术学校接下来的工作是为即将来临的中秋汇报演出和画展做准备。9月30号，学校将在CHANDLER艺术中心进行一年一度的汇报演出和画展。整场晚会将完全由学生和学员们担任。学校的每个孩子和学员都要参加，他们将在歌舞、武术和钢琴方面向家长和社区汇报这一年来的学习成果。同时，在晚会开始之前，学校将在演出大厅的前厅举行画展，作品都是由学校的学生们自己创作的。 新东方艺术学校在教学的同时，也十分热心公益事业。学校内开设了中文图书馆，向广大华人社区开放，同时学校也号召大家将自己家不用的旧图书、杂志和音像制品捐赠到学校的图书馆来，以便让更多的华人获益。 更傎得一提的是，新东方艺术学校将在学校内开设”新东方文化讲坛”，每周一期，主要由亚省的知名学者、文化界名人主讲。同时也将为每一位愿意来讲坛分享自己的故事、经验和心得的朋友提供机会。 在会上，每位老师和管理人员都谈了自己在新学年的教学安排和工作重点。老师们对于新东方艺术学校的未来充满了信心。
6e24b3862fb2a903d1ffa00ba6eca553ae6dd400.translatedText: New Oriental Art School held a new school year teacher work meeting (picture) (Hehe Report) At 7 pm on August 1, 2012, New Oriental Art School held a new school year teacher work meeting in the school to arrange the teaching work of the new school year and arrange the Mid-Autumn Festival report performance and art exhibition. In addition to classroom teachers, many school administrators attended the meeting. The meeting was chaired by Principal Lu Lihua. The meeting topics are divided into three parts. Principal Lu first reviewed and summarized the school's teaching work in the past school year, summed up experience and identified shortcomings; then deployed and arranged the teaching and management work in the new school year; and finally put forward specific requirements for teachers in each subject in terms of teaching objectives and labor discipline. Principal Lu Lihua spoke (left) Principal Lu once again emphasized the purpose and significance of New Oriental Art School at the meeting. She said, we are Chinese and we must have our own voice in the United States. Therefore, from a large perspective, the purpose of our school is to "inherit Chinese civilization and create a better future"; from a small perspective, it is to let our children understand and understand Chinese culture and art, and enhance their national self-esteem, self-confidence and pride as the descendants of the Chinese people. In addition, as a member of the Chinese community in Alberta, New Oriental Art School should do its best to contribute to enhancing the cohesion of the Chinese community. Principal Lu emphasized the importance of teaching quality to the school many times at the meeting. She said that teaching quality is the foundation of the school. We must ensure that children succeed in learning and that parents can send their children with confidence. Working meeting scene As we all know, the strength of New Oriental Art School is the teaching of Chinese folk dance. They have a very excellent professional dance teaching team. Qiu Xiaorong, Hu Qiuzi, Liu Ou, Chen Si and other teachers who have received professional dance education have always been the backbone of the New Oriental teaching team. In addition, the newly joined teacher Chen Weiping this year graduated from the Beijing Dance Academy and is an associate professor of the Dance Department of the Conservatory of Music of Central China Normal University. She once served as the department director. At the same time, New Oriental also offers Latin dance classes taught by Americans CHUC ERICSEN and Wen Linling, which are also very popular in the community. At the recent Alberta Chinese Beauty Pageant, the Latin dance performed by eight teachers and students from New Oriental left a deep impression on the audience. What's more worth mentioning is that the school has opened belly dance courses. Belly dance is a dance that is currently popular all over the world and perfectly combines women's weight loss with fitness and improvement of women's body, mind and spirit. This course will be taught by Tang Ke, a famous Chinese belly dance performing artist. In the new school year, New Oriental will also offer ballet classes and modeling classes for the purpose of training on appearance. In addition, the teaching of martial arts classes is also very unique. This year it will continue to be hosted by Master Shi Yanqing, a monk from Shaolin Temple. Piano lessons also continue to be provided by young piano performing artist Ye Qingqing. The school has especially strengthened the teaching of art classes in its work arrangements for the new school year. Two new teachers have joined the teaching staff in the new school year. The famous artist Xu Weidong, in addition to teaching painting classes, also offers clay sculpture classes that are very popular among children. Teacher MINA graduated from ASU with a major in fine arts and has a high professional level. The two teachers are a powerful combination, which gives us reason to believe that the art classes in the new school year will be refreshing for all students and parents in the community. The next work of New Oriental Art School is to prepare for the upcoming Mid-Autumn Festival report performance and art exhibition. On September 30, the school will hold its annual report performance and painting exhibition at the CHANDLER Art Center. The entire evening will be staffed entirely by students and cadets. Every child and student in the school is required to participate, and they will report to their parents and the community on their learning achievements during the year in singing, dancing, martial arts and piano. At the same time, before the party begins, the school will hold an art exhibition in the front hall of the performance hall, with works created by the school's students themselves. While teaching, New Oriental Art School is also very enthusiastic about public welfare. A Chinese library has been opened in the school, which is open to the Chinese community. At the same time, the school also calls on everyone to donate old books, magazines and audio-visual products that are not used at home to the school library so that more Chinese people can benefit. What's more worth mentioning is that New Oriental Art School will open a "New Oriental Culture Forum" in the school, which will be held once a week and will be lectured mainly by well-known scholars and cultural celebrities in Alberta. At the same time, we will also provide opportunities for everyone who is willing to come to the forum to share their stories, experiences and insights. At the meeting, each teacher and administrator discussed their teaching arrangements and work priorities in the new school year. The teachers are full of confidence in the future of New Oriental Art School.

0c6d15bbfcf0e110ffdd87c4d13f52a41e141f46.sourceText: 亚利桑那清华校友纪念母校百年华诞（图） 2011年4月24日是清华百年校庆日。百年是清华大学发展史上的一个里程碑。在校庆日到来之际，世界各地的清华校友也在积极准备，与母校同庆百年。亚利桑那清华校友多年来一直关注母校的发展也举办了自己的庆祝活动。来自亚利桑那州立大学，英特尔，霍尼韦尔公司，Amkor公司，Onsemi等公司学校的近一百校友和他们的家属们参加了4月23日中午在阿罗黑德公园举行的庆祝清华百年校庆烧烤活动。 活动于当天中午十一点开始，校友们陆陆续续来到了公园。新的朋友互相介绍，老的朋友在一起叙旧。大家一边享受刚烤出来的烤肉，一边观看者母校的幻灯片，看着熟悉的校园，很多校友们想起了那青葱岁月 … …。”清华育我，我爱清华。”校友们庆幸自己在清华园里开始了自己的人生跋涉，在清华园里留下人生的美好记忆。在人生的征途上，清华学子秉承”自强不息，厚德载物”的校训，在不同的工作岗位上，为社会和人类的发展作着自己的贡献。在亚利桑那大部分清华学子都在高科技行业工作，他们以自己扎实的学术基础，谨慎刻苦的学术态度，活跃创新的工作意识，在各行各业内为母校画上华美的一笔。幻灯片里还包括了清华大学建校以来所取得的巨大的成就和学校的最新动态，让在海外的校友了解现在的清华，每时每刻都能感受到清华人的责任和无处不在的清华情结。
0c6d15bbfcf0e110ffdd87c4d13f52a41e141f46.translatedText: Arizona Tsinghua alumni commemorate the centennial anniversary of their alma mater (photo) April 24, 2011 is the centenary anniversary of Tsinghua University. One hundred years is a milestone in the development history of Tsinghua University. As the school anniversary approaches, Tsinghua alumni around the world are also actively preparing to celebrate the 100th anniversary of their alma mater. Arizona Tsinghua alumni have been paying attention to the development of their alma mater for many years and organized their own celebrations. Nearly a hundred alumni and their families from corporate schools such as Arizona State University, Intel, Honeywell, Amkor, Onsemi and other companies participated in the barbecue event celebrating Tsinghua University’s centenary held at Arrowhead Park at noon on April 23. The event started at 11 noon that day, and alumni came to the park one after another. New friends are introduced to each other, and old friends catch up with each other. While enjoying the freshly baked barbecue, everyone watched the slideshow of their alma mater. Looking at the familiar campus, many alumni thought of those green years... "Tsinghua educated me, I love Tsinghua." The alumni are grateful that they started their life journey in Tsinghua Garden and left beautiful memories of life in Tsinghua Garden. On the journey of life, Tsinghua students adhere to the school motto of "continuous self-improvement and moral integrity" and make their own contributions to the development of society and mankind in different jobs. Most of Tsinghua students in Arizona work in the high-tech industry. With their solid academic foundation, cautious and hard-working academic attitude, and active and innovative work consciousness, they have made a glorious mark for their alma mater in various industries. The slides also include the great achievements made by Tsinghua University since its establishment and the latest developments of the school, so that overseas alumni can understand the current Tsinghua University and feel the responsibility of Tsinghua people and the ubiquitous Tsinghua complex at every moment.

44d73a0a230e2dff5d275273970d320238ecbeb6.sourceText: 中国道家音乐一代宗师华彦钧（1893-1950），小名阿炳，江苏无锡人，1914年21岁时就是无锡城裡道馆雷尊殿当家道士。 「34岁那年双目相继失明，因生活所迫，流浪街头，卖艺为生。」（见2006年2月10日扬子晚报网《无锡阿炳，一城何来两故居》），故有外号瞎子阿炳。从此阿炳穷困潦倒，贫病交迫，终其一生。阿炳又是一位蜚声中外的民间音乐家，他演奏的《二泉映月》跻身世界十大名曲之列。 2010年02期《苏州杂志》上发表了冬苗的《陆文夫一生的「阿炳情缘」》，该文曾被《扬子晚报》、《报刊文摘》转载。作者冬苗（董淼的谐音笔名）自称是着名作家陆文夫的老朋友，文中记述陆文夫在阿炳死后不久，採访阿炳妻子董催弟（另有写成董彩娣，「催」、「彩」无锡话中同音。笔者）的经过。同样这篇文章，隐去作者名字，题目改为《1950年瞎子阿炳上吊自杀的内幕?#12299;，近日在微信公众平台广泛流传，66年前阿炳的死因，如一石激起千层浪，让人们难以置信。 笔者是无锡人，民乐爱好者，阿炳的二胡曲《二泉映月》，我喜爱得如痴如醉；阿炳的人生经历，我从中学时代就开始想探索。我查阅大量资讯，都说阿炳因病去世，属正常死亡；世界上只有唯一这篇文章，变换不同的题目，转述陆文夫的「上吊自尽」说，为非正常死亡。 支持阿炳因病去世说的主要例证有： 《维基百科》：1950年12月4日华彦钧病逝，终年57岁，无后，葬于无锡西郊𤨪山一和山房道教墓地。其妻董彩娣于1951年3月27日病故。 《百科百度》：1950年12月4日阿炳病逝，终年57岁，葬于无锡西郊㻧山脚下「一和山房」道士墓。 2006年4月14日《人民日报海外版》第15版（中华文物）载有苏迅《「二泉映月」诞生地》一文，文中说：「这年（1950年，笔者）12月12日（另说12月4日，笔者），阿炳大口吐血，一代大师的生命之焰在这座破落小阁楼中溘然而灭。」 2009年12月16日《世界日报》F4版刊登戎林文章《二泉映月和瞎子阿炳》，说到「令人悲痛的是，阿炳这个音乐界的奇人，由于贫病交加，在抗日战争胜利后的第二年（指1946年，笔者），竟然吐血不止，在病榻上拖了四年，直到一九四九年（实为一九五〇年，笔者），当北京音乐学院（应是中央音乐学院，笔者）请他北上执教时，他竟然离开了这个世界。」 网络文章《1950年瞎子阿炳上吊自杀的内幕?#12299;中写道： 陆文夫还很年轻的时候，刚从苏高中毕业，返回老家泰兴；在华中大学集训半年，又跟随解放军渡江，到《新苏州报》社当记者。偶尔听了二胡曲《二泉映月》，热泪盈盈，整个身心受到强烈震撼，夜不能眠，挥之不去，便专程去了一趟无锡城，到崇安寺雷尊殿去访问瞎子阿炳。那时，大概是1950年冬天，下了场罕见的大雪，天气极为寒冷，滴水成冰。 陆文夫来得迟了，他没有见到《二泉映月》的作曲者；差了一步，瞎子阿炳已在半个月前过世了（正确日期应该是1950年12月4日上午9时许）。正所谓，失之交臂，阴阳阻隔。瞎子阿炳的老伴董催弟（现误传为董翠娣或董彩娣），在阿炳灵前点香、烧锡箔。阿炳没有遗像，半桌上只有简陋的白木牌位，写着「华彦钧之位」几个毛笔字。据他妻子董催弟说，阿炳是上吊自尽的。他虽给天津客人（中央音乐学院杨荫浏、曹安和二人从天津来），录了《知心客》等曲子，一个铜丸（铜钱）亦没有捞到。那天起身，阿炳想弹弹三弦（家中仅有一把破三弦），取下一摸，咦，蒙上的蛇皮，被老鼠啃了一个大洞，阿要触霉头！阿炳又犯瞎心思了，他想，这样寒冬腊月，怎麽会有老鼠出现？一定老天爷跟他过不去，不准他弹曲，不让他活下去啦，再加上烟瘾发作，呵欠连连，一把鼻涕，一把眼泪，家中短粮已久，颗粒全无，借贷无门，饿得直在受不住。趁催弟出去讨点冷饭时，一个想不开，抽出道袍上的腰带，樑上一挂，去见阎王嘞！ 所以，瞎子阿炳（华彦钧）是上吊自尽的，不是如今《无锡市地方志》上记载，患病身亡。 老陆这次探访，记录了不少真实可靠的第一手资料。他请董催弟到前街「王兴记」吃了碗双浇麵，包了几隻小笼馒头给阿炳上供。临走时，塞给催弟八万人民币；那是旧币，相当于如今的人民币八元。 读完这一节，我顿生疑问，让我一一说来。 1， 阿炳的《二泉映月》、《听松》 和《大浪淘沙》等六首二胡、琵琶曲，1950年9月2日起在无锡录音，分两次录完。录音在阿炳生前，从未在公开场合播放，陆文夫人在苏州，怎麽会听到《二泉映月》呢？ 1951年天津人民广播电台首次播送《二泉映月》，同年阿炳录下的六首曲子，才灌製成胶木唱片。
44d73a0a230e2dff5d275273970d320238ecbeb6.translatedText: Hua Yanjun (1893-1950), a great master of Chinese Taoist music, nicknamed A Bing, was born in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. In 1914, when he was 21 years old, he became the head Taoist priest of Lei Zun Hall, a Taoist temple in Wuxi City. "At the age of 34, he lost his sight in both eyes one after another. Due to the pressure of life, he wandered on the streets and made a living by performing arts." (See "Wuxi A Bing, two former residences in one city" on the Yangtze Evening News website on February 10, 2006), so he was nicknamed Blind A Bing. From then on, Abing lived in poverty, suffering from poverty and illness throughout his life. Abing is also a well-known folk musician at home and abroad. His performance of "Two Springs Reflecting the Moon" ranks among the top ten famous songs in the world. Dong Miao's "Lu Wenfu's Life of "Abing's Love"" was published in the 02 issue of Suzhou Magazine in 2010. The article has been reprinted by "Yangtze Evening News" and "Newspaper Digest". The author Dongmiao (a pseudonym of Dong Miao) claims to be an old friend of the famous writer Lu Wenfu. The article describes Lu Wenfu's interview with A Bing's wife Dong Cuidi (also written as Dong Caidi, "Cui" and "Cai" are homophones in Wuxi dialect. The author) shortly after A Bing's death. The same article, with the author's name omitted and the title changed to "The Inside Story of Blind Man A Bing's Hanging Suicide in 1950?#12299;, has been widely circulated on the WeChat public platform recently. The cause of A Bing's death 66 years ago was like a stone that stirred up thousands of waves, making people unbelievable. The author is from Wuxi and a folk music lover. I love Abing's erhu piece "Er Quan Ying Yue" so much. I have wanted to explore Abing's life experience since middle school. I checked a lot of information, and they all said that A Bing died of illness, which was a normal death. There is only one article in the world, which changed different titles, and quoted Lu Wenfu's theory of "suicide by hanging", which was an abnormal death. The main examples supporting the theory that Abing died of illness are: "Wikipedia": Hua Yanjun died of illness on December 4, 1950, at the age of 57, with no issue, and was buried in the Taoist cemetery of Shanyihe Shanfang in the western suburbs of Wuxi. His wife Dong Caidi died of illness on March 27, 1951. "Encyclopedia Baidu": Abing died of illness on December 4, 1950 at the age of 57. He was buried in the Taoist Tomb of "Yihe Shanfang" at the foot of Ershan Mountain in the western suburbs of Wuxi. On April 14, 2006, the 15th page of "People's Daily Overseas Edition" (Chinese Cultural Relics) carried Su Xun's article "The Birthplace of "Two Springs Reflect the Moon"". The article said: "On December 12 of this year (1950, the author) (also December 4, the author), Abing vomited blood, and the flame of life of a great master was extinguished in this dilapidated small attic." On December 16, 2009, the F4 page of "World Journal" published Rong Lin's article "Er Quan Ying Yue and Blind Man A Bing", saying, "What is sad is that A Bing, a strange man in the music industry, suffered from poverty and illness in the second year after the victory of the Anti-Japanese War (referring to 194 In 1949 (actually 1950, author), he continued to vomit blood and stayed on the hospital bed for four years. It was not until 1949 (actually 1950, author) that he left this world when the Beijing Conservatory of Music (should be the Central Conservatory of Music, author) asked him to go north to teach. The online article "The inside story of blind man A Bing hanging himself in 1950?#12299;" wrote: When Lu Wenfu was still very young, he had just graduated from Suzhou High School and returned to his hometown of Taixing. He trained at Huazhong University for half a year, then crossed the river with the People's Liberation Army and worked as a reporter for the "New Suzhou News". Occasionally, I listened to the Erhu song "Two Springs Reflect the Moon" and burst into tears. My whole body and mind were deeply shocked. I couldn't sleep at night and couldn't let it go. So I made a special trip to Wuxi City to visit the blind man A Bing at the Lei Zun Hall of Chong'an Temple. At that time, probably in the winter of 1950, there was a rare heavy snowfall, and the weather was extremely cold, with dripping water turning into ice. Lu Wenfu arrived too late, and he did not meet the composer of "Two Springs Reflect the Moon"; he was one step too late, as the blind man A Bing had passed away half a month ago (the correct date should be around 9 a.m. on December 4, 1950). As the saying goes, a missed opportunity is a barrier between yin and yang. Blind Abing's wife, Dong Cuidi (now mistakenly known as Dong Cuidi or Dong Caidi), lit incense and burned tin foil in front of Abing's spirit. There is no portrait of Abing, and there is only a simple white wooden tablet on half of the table, with the words "Hua Yanjun's position" written in calligraphy. According to his wife Dong Cuidi, A Bing hanged himself. Although he recorded songs such as "Intimate Guest" for guests from Tianjin (Yang Yinliu and Cao Anhe from the Central Conservatory of Music came from Tianjin), he did not get a single copper pill (copper coin). When he got up that day, A Bing wanted to play the sanxian (there was only one broken sanxian at home), so he took it off and touched it. Hey, the snake skin covering it had been gnawed into a big hole by mice. He was about to get into trouble! A Bing was confused again. He thought, how could there be mice in such a cold winter? God must be having trouble with him, forbidding him to play music and live. In addition, he was addicted to cigarettes, yawning again and again, with runny nose and tears. The family had been short of food for a long time, with no food left, no way to borrow money, and he was so hungry that he couldn't bear it. While I was urging my brother to go out to ask for some cold food, I couldn't think about it anymore, so I took out the belt from my Taoist robe, hung it on the beam, and went to see the King of Hell! Therefore, the blind man A Bing (Hua Yanjun) hanged himself. It is not recorded in the "Wuxi City Local Chronicle" that he died of illness. During this visit, Lao Lu recorded a lot of authentic and reliable first-hand information. He asked Dong to go to "Wang Xingji" on Qian Street to eat a bowl of double noodles and make a few steamed buns for A Bing. Before leaving, he gave his brother 80,000 yuan; that was an old currency, equivalent to eight yuan in today's currency. After reading this section, I suddenly had questions, so let me explain them one by one. 1. Abing's six erhu and pipa songs, including "The Moon Reflected in Two Springs", "Listening to the Pines" and "Big Waves Washing the Sand", were recorded in Wuxi on September 2, 1950 and were completed in two sessions. The recording was never played in public during A Bing's lifetime. How could Mrs. Lu Wen hear "Two Springs Reflect the Moon" in Suzhou? In 1951, Tianjin People's Broadcasting Station broadcast "Two Springs Reflecting the Moon" for the first time. In the same year, the six songs recorded by Abing were recorded into Bakelite records.

08ad57a4084f92f1d7603bdca51cf569daee29db.sourceText: 2， 阿炳的牌位，并不是简单「华彦 钧之位」几个字，阿炳的邻居许忆和说：「?#38463;炳堂兄华伯阳取出阿炳的神主牌位，牌位外层写着：先祖师华彦钧霞灵位，嗣孙徒卫晨奉祀。」 3， 《世界日报》曾刊载方永施《华 彦钧创作二泉映月》一文，说「一九五〇年夏天，杨荫浏先生听到他（阿炳，笔者）生活情况，知道他不久人世，觉得此天才音乐家，如不留一点作品在世上，那太可惜了，于是约同同事曹安和、黎松寿、祝世匡等先生到无锡去找阿炳，实地为他录音，同时给予资助。」，并非「一个铜丸（铜钱）亦没有捞到。」 4，阿炳三弦「蒙上的蛇皮，被老鼠啃了一个大洞」，并不是发生在阿炳临终那天。2002年12月22日的第979期《世界周刊》上发表了无锡人郭罗基的文章《瞎子阿炳长街行 二泉映月裡的叹息》，文章中提到，抗日战争胜利后一段时间，郭罗基在无锡街头看不见瞎子阿炳的身影，他「看了杨荫浏先生的叙述才知道，瞎子阿炳有点迷信（他本来就是道士嘛），因为老鼠咬断了他的琴弦，咬破了蛇皮，他认为不吉利，从此罢休，弦管绝音。」 5， 笔者小时候，有道士到家裡 来拜忏，我近距离看到道士所穿道袍上不用腰带。阿炳临终所在的房间，没有可以上吊的樑，何以「抽出道袍上的腰带，樑上一挂，去见阎王嘞！」更何况他是体力极度虚弱的盲人？并且阿炳平时也不会把道袍当作家常便服穿，他入殓时才会更换上道袍。 6， 王兴记是无锡有名的馄饨 店，原址公园路路北，城中公园南面，靠皇亭小吃区。上世纪五十年代初，笔者经常跟母亲到王兴记吃馄饨。门面不大，进店堂有多张八仙桌。往裡走左转，有火车高背椅式的雅座。我和母亲就坐在雅座吃馄饨。那时王兴记还卖小笼包子（无锡话叫小笼馒头），不卖麵条的，所以何来「双浇麵」请阿炳遗孀吃？以各色麵点着称的无锡拱北楼麵馆，近在咫尺，何不去拱北楼吃麵？ 以上诸疑点，让笔者认为阿炳「上吊自尽」说不能成立。 那麽冬苗怎麽会写出这样一篇文章呢？ 《世界日报》是北美最大的华文媒体，在美国、加拿大华人社区影响广泛。2002年12月22日《世界日报》附刊《世界周刊》刊载的郭罗基的文章《瞎子阿炳长街行 二泉映月裡的叹息》，自1993年4月就定居加拿大蒙特利尔的文化人冬苗，一定阅读过。 郭罗基在文章裡，回忆他亲眼目睹阿炳刚与世长辞的现场情境： 1950年，我在机关工作。（郭罗基时任无锡学生联合会主席。笔者）我们的机关位于图书馆路。一个冬天的早晨，忽然听得妇人的哭声，好不凄凉。我走出机关，寻声探问哭者谁？那时工作极忙，无暇旁顾。我在这裡进进出出无数次，竟然没有注意到隔壁弄堂（小巷）裡就是雷尊殿。 走进雷尊殿，有人告诉我：「瞎子阿炳死了。」我心头一怔。哭者正是董彩娣。我看到瞎子阿炳身穿道袍，躺在那裡，还是戴着墨镜。这是一位在我少年生活中留下印记的人物，我向他深深鞠了一躬，永别了。我深悔没有及早知道与瞎子阿炳为邻，他也许需要帮助。 我打了一个电话给民政局社会救济科。对方答应：「你放心，我们派人去料理。」我再也没有过问。二十几天后，又听说，董彩娣也死了！一对穷夫妻，平生多恩爱，也许她要追上去扶他过奈何桥吧！ 冬苗文章裡和郭罗基文章裡有两处完全吻合，1，阿炳死时身穿道袍；2，阿炳的遗孀董彩娣（董催弟）在阿炳死后二十几天也去世了。 作家陆文夫于2005年7月9日去世，冬苗的文章发表于2010年初，陆文夫在4年半前就不在人间。陆文夫到底有没有採访过阿炳遗孀，冬苗的文章是不是凭自己的想像力，加上一些历史资料虚构而成，在文章发表时就死无对证了。 冬苗老先生本人也于2015年12月24日去世。我们无法核实他的《陆文夫一生的「阿炳情缘」》是「史实文章」，还是他的「虚构小说」，看来无疑就是「虚构小说」了。 由此可知，阿炳「上吊自尽」不是事实。
08ad57a4084f92f1d7603bdca51cf569daee29db.translatedText: 2. A Bing's tablet is not simply "Hua Yanjun's place". A Bing's neighbor Xu Yihe said: "?#38463; Bing's cousin Hua Boyang took out A Bing's tablet of the god. On the outer layer of the tablet, it was written: The spiritual tablet of the ancestor Hua Yanjunxia was enshrined by his descendant and disciple Wei Chen." 3. "World Daily" once published Fang Yongshi's "Hua Boyang" The article "Creation of Two Springs Reflecting the Moon" by Yanjun said, "In the summer of 1950, Mr. Yang Yinliu heard about his (A Bing, the author's) living situation and knew that he would soon die. He felt that this talented musician would not leave any works in the world. , that was such a pity, so I asked my colleagues Cao Anhe, Li Songshou, Zhu Shikuang and others to go to Wuxi to find A Bing, record him on the spot, and provide financial support at the same time. "It's not that I didn't get a single copper pill (copper coin)." 4. "The snake skin covering A Bing's Sanxian was gnawed into a big hole by rats" did not happen on the day when A Bing died. The 979th issue of "World Weekly" on December 22, 2002 published the article "Blind Man A Bing's Long Street Walk" by Guo Luoji from Wuxi. "A Sigh in the Moon Reflected by Erquan", the article mentioned that some time after the victory of the Anti-Japanese War, Guo Luoji could not see the blind man A Bing on the streets of Wuxi. He "read Mr. Yang Yinliu's narration and realized that the blind man A Bing was a bit superstitious (he was originally a Taoist priest). Because the mouse bit off his strings and tore through the snake skin, he considered it unlucky, so he stopped and the strings became silent." 5. When the author was a child, a Taoist priest came to his home. When I came to worship and repent, I saw from a close distance that the robes worn by Taoist priests do not require belts. The room where A Bing died had no beam to hang himself on. Why did he "take out the belt from his Taoist robe, hang it on the beam, and go see the King of Hell!" What's more, he was a blind man who was extremely weak? Moreover, A Bing would not wear the Taoist robe as casual clothes at home. He would only change into the Taoist robe when he was enshrined. 6. Wang Xingji is a famous wonton shop in Wuxi. Its original location is north of Gongyuan Road, south of the city park, and close to the Huangting snack area. In the early 1950s, the author and my mother often went to Wang Xing Kee to eat wontons. The storefront is small, but there are several Eight Immortals tables in the store. Go inside and turn left, and there are train high-back chair-style seats. My mother and I were sitting in the private seats eating wontons. At that time, Wang Xingji still sold Xiao Long Steamed Buns (called Xiao Long Steamed Buns in Wuxi dialect), but not noodles, so how could he treat A Bing's widow to eat "double-poured noodles"? Wuxi Gongbei Lou Noodle House, famous for its various types of noodles, is just around the corner. Why not go to Gongbei Lou for some noodles? The above doubts make the author think that the theory that Abing "hanged himself" cannot be established. So how could Dongmiao write such an article? "World Journal" is the largest Chinese-language media in North America and has wide influence in the Chinese communities in the United States and Canada. Dong Miao, an intellectual who has settled in Montreal, Canada since April 1993, must have read Guo Luoji's article "Blind Man A Bing's Sigh on the Long Street" published in the supplement "World Weekly" of "World Daily" on December 22, 2002. In the article, Guo Luoji recalled the scene where he witnessed A Binggang's death: In 1950, I worked in a government agency. (Guo Luoji was the chairman of the Wuxi Student Union at the time. Author) Our office is located on Library Road. One winter morning, I suddenly heard a woman crying, which was so sad. I walked out of the office and asked who was crying. I was very busy with work at that time and had no time to care. I've been in and out of here countless times, but I didn't even notice that the alley (alley) next door is Lei Zun Temple. When I walked into Lei Zun Hall, someone told me: "Blind man A Bing is dead." I was startled. The cryer was none other than Dong Caidi. I saw the blind man A Bing lying there in Taoist robes, still wearing sunglasses. This is a figure who left a mark on my teenage life. I bowed deeply to him and said goodbye forever. I deeply regret not knowing sooner that I was living next to a blind man, A Bing, and that he might need help. I made a call to the Social Relief Section of the Civil Affairs Bureau. The other party promised: "Don't worry, we will send someone to take care of it." I never asked again. Twenty days later, I heard again that Dong Caidi was also dead! A poor couple had a lot of love in their lives. Maybe she would catch up and help him cross the Naihe Bridge! There are two points in Dongmiao's article that are completely consistent with Guo Luoji's article. 1. A Bing was wearing a Taoist robe when he died; 2. A Bing's widow Dong Caidi (Dong Jidi) also passed away twenty days after A Bing's death. The writer Lu Wenfu passed away on July 9, 2005. Dong Miao's article was published in early 2010. Lu Wenfu passed away four and a half years ago. Whether Lu Wenfu had interviewed A Bing's widow, and whether Dong Miao's article was made up of his own imagination and some historical data, there was no confirmation when the article was published. Mr. Dong Miao himself passed away on December 24, 2015. We are unable to verify whether his "Lu Wenfu's Life and Love with Bing" is a "historical factual article" or his "fictional novel". It seems to be undoubtedly a "fictional novel". From this we can see that it is not true that A Bing "hanged himself".

4560b998b9f41c02c2fe48dcfee41d3544488244.sourceText: 亚省现代中文学校举办保护视力专题讲座 （亚省现代中文学校供稿） 2018年3月31日，亚省著名眼科医生D…
4560b998b9f41c02c2fe48dcfee41d3544488244.translatedText: > Alberta Modern Chinese School held a special lecture on vision protection (Contributed by Alberta Modern Chinese School) On March 31, 2018, the famous ophthalmologist D...

ee5a5e2778f04bb754ecc8784d313f25ec9e7779.sourceText: （亚省现代中文学校供稿） 2018年3月31日，亚省著名眼科医生Dr. Mark Page来到坐落于ASU Tempe主校园的亚省现代中文学校，为学生和家长举办了一场别开生面的保护眼睛专题讲座。60多位学生和家长在观看了”Screenagers”录像后，进一步加深了解了电脑和手机的蓝光对眼睛造成的损害。学生和家长在与Dr. Page一问一答中学到了很多书本上学不到的知识，深感保护眼睛的重要性。
ee5a5e2778f04bb754ecc8784d313f25ec9e7779.translatedText: (Contributed by Alberta Modern Chinese School) On March 31, 2018, Dr. Mark Page, a famous ophthalmologist in Alberta, came to ASU The Alberta Modern Chinese School on the main campus in Tempe held a unique lecture on eye protection for students and parents. After watching the "Screenagers" video, more than 60 students and parents gained a deeper understanding of the damage caused by blue light from computers and mobile phones to their eyes. Students and parents learned a lot of knowledge that cannot be learned in books through the questions and answers with Dr. Page, and deeply felt the importance of protecting their eyes.

6da7027a58f63b94137234e04d368718b99e0992.sourceText: Dr. Page是亚省现代中文学校的老朋友了，他曾多次作为主要赞助商赞助”CCSA Golf Fundraising Tournament”。此次，他又自愿来我校举办保护眼睛专题讲座。感谢Dr. Page为我们举办的精彩讲座。感谢学生和家长们的参与和支持。感谢王玉兰, 陶世诚, 田韶微, Allan Yang，赵涛, Pennie Zeng, 苗玉良，彭凯，Fannie Tam等义工，为组织这次专题讲座所付出的努力。
6da7027a58f63b94137234e04d368718b99e0992.translatedText: Dr. Page is an old friend of the Alberta Modern Chinese School. He has sponsored the "CCSA Golf Fundraising Tournament" as the main sponsor many times. This time, he volunteered to come to our school to hold a special lecture on eye protection. Thanks to Dr. Page for organizing this wonderful lecture for us. Thank you to students and parents for your participation and support. Thanks to Wang Yulan, Tao Shicheng, Tian Shaowei, Allan Yang, Zhao Tao, Pennie Zeng, Miao Yuliang, Peng Kai, Fannie Tam and other volunteers for their efforts in organizing this special lecture.

7af1ca4b3486d291b8f4df1b5f5b4d619590d286.sourceText: 亚省现代中文学校除拥有一支由众多无私奉献的义工们组成的团队，同时，还拥有一支由许多倾心尽力的优秀教师组成的团队。他们平时在教书的同时，更注重育人。学校通过学生会经常组织同学们利用周末的休息时间去当地慈善机构做义工，使孩子们从小懂得参与社区和回馈社区的意义所在。Dr. Page于2017－2018学年，支持亚省现代中文学校设立的”PAGE Scholarships”专项奖学金，就是用以表彰资助那些为亚省现代中文学校义务服务，积极参与社区，并在亚省现代中文学校注册的高中学生。感谢Dr. Page支持亚省现代中文学校设立的”AGE Scholarships”专项奖学金。更多详情，请浏览亚省现代中文学校网站 www.ccsarizona.org 。 还有一个月，本学年就要结束了。在此，董事长陶世诚和校长王玉兰衷心感谢老师的辛劳，义工的奉献，家长的支持，以及社区的关爱！（摄影：赵涛）
7af1ca4b3486d291b8f4df1b5f5b4d619590d286.translatedText: >Alberta Modern Chinese School not only has a team composed of many selfless volunteers, but also has a team composed of many outstanding teachers who give their best. While they usually teach, they pay more attention to educating people. Through the student union, the school often organizes students to use their weekend breaks to volunteer at local charities, so that children can understand the meaning of participating in and giving back to the community from an early age. In the 2017-2018 school year, Dr. Page supported the "PAGE Scholarships" special scholarships established by the Alberta Modern Chinese School to commend and support high school students who have voluntarily served the Alberta Modern Chinese School, actively participated in the community, and registered at the Alberta Modern Chinese School. Thanks to Dr. Page for supporting the “AGE Scholarships” special scholarship established by the Modern Chinese School in Alberta. For more details, please visit the Alberta Modern Chinese School website www.ccsarizona.org. In one month, the school year is coming to an end. Here, Chairman Tao Shicheng and Principal Wang Yulan sincerely thank the teachers for their hard work, the volunteers’ dedication, the parents’ support, and the community’s care! (Photography: Zhao Tao)
