520651ab2e5fd62f0aa7231dd720447aeeef1728.sourceText: 美国亚利桑那州华人历史协会 张肇鴻
520651ab2e5fd62f0aa7231dd720447aeeef1728.translatedText: Chinese Historical Association of Arizona, USA Zhang Zhaohong

e6529b662a48b98b60ea9d9b7836dc7d00506055.sourceText: 我们继续沿着百年前华工淘金的足迹前往探访，下一站是“我走”（I,go)小镇，再到 “哦不”(O,no)小镇。
e6529b662a48b98b60ea9d9b7836dc7d00506055.translatedText: We continue to follow the footsteps of the Chinese gold rushers a hundred years ago. The next stop is the town of "I, go", and then the town of "O, no".

217b6330256c0159a100bae8fcad380ec471f717.sourceText: “我走”和“哦不”两个小镇均位于北加州“杀死他”（Shasta)县。彼此相距很近。据闻当年白人排挤华工，开始时华工语言不通， 本着“惹不起躲得起”，无奈地说“I go”而被迫离开，于是“I go” 就被白人当成了此地的名字。之后，华人向北转移4英里，到另一个山地继续淘金。当又一批白人强迫他们离开时，华人不买账了，毅然说出了“O,No!”。从此据守这个新矿直到淘金结束。于是 O,No! 就变成了一个地名。
217b6330256c0159a100bae8fcad380ec471f717.translatedText: The two small towns of "Let's Go" and "Oh No" are both located in "Shasta" County in Northern California. Very close to each other. It is said that at that time, the white people excluded the Chinese workers. At first, the Chinese workers did not understand the language. In the spirit of "they can't afford to offend but can afford to hide", they reluctantly said "I go" and were forced to leave. Therefore, "I go" was regarded as the name of this place by the white people. After that, the Chinese moved 4 miles north to another mountainous area to continue panning for gold. When another group of white people forced them to leave, the Chinese didn't buy it anymore and resolutely said "O, No!". From then on, he stayed in this new mine until the end of the gold rush. So O,No! became a place name.

39b4ebe90ed65254e9ad4bbbc212b69da4e301de.sourceText: 这两个地名可能只是华人对歧视奋起反抗说法而已。目前，这里除有小店、邮局外，当年华工的遗迹已是了无痕迹。
39b4ebe90ed65254e9ad4bbbc212b69da4e301de.translatedText: These two place names may just be the expressions of Chinese resistance against discrimination. At present, apart from a small shop and a post office, there are no traces of the remains of the Chinese workers here.

7527d06f3711c95feb7eccdbe61c77f9a83ef858.sourceText: 为了历史的纪念，我们请”I go”的小店老板和“O,No”的邮局人员在纪念横额上签名留念。
7527d06f3711c95feb7eccdbe61c77f9a83ef858.translatedText: In order to commemorate history, we asked the shop owner of "I go" and the post office staff of "O, No" to sign the commemorative banner.

15280b01349caef5677541ac5cf9f4284f7ba6aa.translatedText: "O, No" the post office clerk signed the commemorative banner

a6e28bcbdbdb67b6d49bd9e408b2bf99e6d412fe.sourceText: 我们继续前往淘金遗址“杀死他”州立历史公园(Shasta State History Park)参观。“杀死他”正确的中文翻译应为“沙斯塔”，是位于北加州的一个县。在1850到1880的淘金年代，沙斯塔是一个繁华的小镇，当时这里有几千名淘金华工。
a6e28bcbdbdb67b6d49bd9e408b2bf99e6d412fe.translatedText: We continued to visit the gold mining site "Kill Him" ​​State Historical Park (Shasta State History Park). The correct Chinese translation of "Kill Him" ​​should be "Shasta", which is a county in Northern California. During the gold rush years of the 1850s to 1880s, Shasta was a bustling town with thousands of Chinese gold rush workers.

bfe8937a0d21f088afad46602dea587733adce85.sourceText: “杀死他”当年也是一个充满暴力和凶杀的城市，“Shasta “是一个法国矿工领袖，在一次冲突中丧命，后来就以他的名字命名了这个小镇。因为有大量的淘金工人在此地工作和生活，让小镇充满了繁荣，至今，仍可以到一些老旧房屋的红砖墙壁，部分需要用加强支撑以防倒塌。
bfe8937a0d21f088afad46602dea587733adce85.translatedText: "Kill him" was also a city full of violence and murder. "Shasta" was a French miner leader who was killed in a conflict. The town was later named after him. Because there are a large number of gold miners working and living here, the town is full of prosperity. To this day, you can still see the red brick walls of some old houses, and some of them need to be strengthened to prevent collapse.

1a9741d414b5073d628b03a97a6139846ac98b0c.sourceText: 在回程的巴士上，我们有了另一 翻的收获，《再见赛珍珠》的作者徐和平老师，和我们讲述了有关“赛珍珠”的故事。
1a9741d414b5073d628b03a97a6139846ac98b0c.translatedText: On the return bus, we had another revelation. Teacher Xu Heping, the author of "Goodbye Pearl Buck", told us the story about "Pearl Buck".

d58c69e6abed66ee2bf0dd3b4363760e41517b6b.sourceText: 赛珍珠是一个美国牧师的女儿，三个月大的时候，随父母来到中国江苏镇江。她是中国成长的美国女孩，她学的第一种语言是中文，接受的是孔教，直到15岁时才去上海读中学。之后，她返回美国读大学。结婚后和丈夫再次回到中国。她体验农村个生活，积累素材，並在金陵大学、中央大学和东南亚大学教授英语。1931年她出版了《大地》以及《大地》三部曲，之后又写出更多以中国题材小说和传记文学的作品，因此在1938年获得诺貝尔文学奖。《大地》三部曲的英文本一共印行了70多版次共数百万册，她的作品被翻译成140多种文字，改变世界对中国的认知，增加了西方对中国的同情，从而在二战中对中国抗日战争给予极大的声援和支持。
d58c69e6abed66ee2bf0dd3b4363760e41517b6b.translatedText: Pearl Buck is the daughter of an American pastor. When she was three months old, she came to Zhenjiang, Jiangsu, China with her parents. She is an American girl who grew up in China. The first language she learned was Chinese and she received Confucianism. She did not go to Shanghai to attend middle school until she was 15 years old. Afterwards, she returned to the United States to attend college. After getting married, my husband and I returned to China again. She experienced rural life, accumulated materials, and taught English at Jinling University, Central University and Southeast Asian University. In 1931, she published "The Earth" and the "Earth" trilogy, and later wrote more Chinese-themed novels and biographical works, for which she won the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1938. The English version of the "The Good Earth" trilogy has been published in more than 70 editions and millions of copies. Her works have been translated into more than 140 languages, changing the world's understanding of China and increasing the West's sympathy for China, thus giving great solidarity and support to China's Anti-Japanese War during World War II.

936bf4ae37371cd174eba17330b627a7ff99a10c.sourceText: 也是她首先发起要废除美国的《排华法案》：“当时，日本军国主义者和汪伪政权为挑拨和离间中美同盟，直接指责美国的排华法案说明了美国的道德伪善。日伪大肆宣传美国政府对华人的歧视：“美国人不要你们。他们只想让你们帮他们打仗。他们的《排华法案》就是针对你们的，说你们没有资格当美国公民……”。赛珍珠于1942年2月，在纽约阿斯特酒店集会上发言极力呼吁：“假如不放弃白人至上的观念，美国会输掉这场战争。日本在亚洲打种族牌是一个有效武器，因为种族偏见是美国民主最薄弱之处。为了打赢战争必须合作，美国必须团结不同肤色族裔国家的人。此时中国人民浴血抗击日本侵略已经进入第5年”。
936bf4ae37371cd174eba17330b627a7ff99a10c.translatedText: She was also the first to initiate the abolition of the Chinese Exclusion Act in the United States: "At that time, the Japanese militarists and the Wang Puppet regime, in order to sow discord and alienate the Sino-US alliance, directly accused the US Chinese Exclusion Act of demonstrating the moral hypocrisy of the United States. The Japanese puppets trumpeted the US government's discrimination against the Chinese: "Americans don't want you. They just want you to help them fight the war. Their "Chinese Exclusion Act" is aimed at you, saying that you are not qualified to be American citizens..." In February 1942, Pearl Buck spoke at a rally at the Astor Hotel in New York and strongly urged: "If we do not give up the concept of white supremacy, the United States will lose this war. Japan's racial card is an effective weapon in Asia because racial prejudice is the weakest point of American democracy. In order to win the war, we must cooperate. The United States must unite people from different ethnic groups. At this time, the Chinese people's bloody fight against Japanese aggression has entered its fifth year."

d42e971bbc5afae2d70b59ac42fcd0a3996b543e.sourceText: 在美国正义力量的强烈要求和社会舆论的强大压力下，美国众议院于1943年5月召开了关于废除《排华法案》的听证会。赛珍珠亲赴国会作证。她理直气壮並慷慨陈词必须废除《排华法案》的两大理由：一、民主是美国人引以为豪的象征，到处宣扬。但民主首先是要求人类平等和公平。而《排华法案》与之相悖，玷污了民主精神，必须加以废除。
d42e971bbc5afae2d70b59ac42fcd0a3996b543e.translatedText: Under the strong demands of the righteous forces of the United States and the strong pressure of public opinion, the U.S. House of Representatives held a hearing on the repeal of the Chinese Exclusion Act in May 1943. Pearl Buck went to Congress to testify. She confidently and generously stated the two main reasons why the Chinese Exclusion Act must be repealed: First, democracy is a symbol of pride for Americans and is promoted everywhere. But democracy first requires human equality and fairness. The Chinese Exclusion Act is contrary to this and tarnishes the spirit of democracy and must be abolished.

4e8962a85c9b22b41d08ecfd72612507e2ab10bd.sourceText: 二、目前共同抗战的需要。中华民族是勤劳勇敢和热爱和平的伟大民族，现正在对日本帝国主义的入侵和占领进行艰苦卓绝的斗争。当前这场反对德、日法西斯战争能不能取得胜利，正取决于中国抗战的坚持和胜利，取决于美国能不能取得中国人民的信任和支持。
4e8962a85c9b22b41d08ecfd72612507e2ab10bd.translatedText: > 2. The current need to fight the war together. The Chinese nation is a great nation that is industrious, brave and peace-loving. It is currently engaged in an arduous struggle against the invasion and occupation of Japanese imperialism. Whether the current war against German and Japanese fascists can be successful depends on China's persistence and victory in the war of resistance, and on whether the United States can win the trust and support of the Chinese people.

2a123685eb271d2ff4ffb111f83a2e191f0a6389.sourceText: 赛珍珠尖锐地指出：“每一个中国人都知道美国有个《排华法案》。中国人再也不能容忍它的存在。
2a123685eb271d2ff4ffb111f83a2e191f0a6389.translatedText: Pearl Buck pointedly pointed out: "Every Chinese knows that the United States has the Chinese Exclusion Act. The Chinese can no longer tolerate its existence.

b4d1cc7bd725861155d9fe4f0d346e72610d8cdf.sourceText: ”作为美国人的赛珍珠，在这场历史性演说有理有据、震撼人心。它让美国朝野感到《排华法案》再没有理由继续存在下去
b4d1cc7bd725861155d9fe4f0d346e72610d8cdf.translatedText: " As an American, Pearl Buck's historic speech was well-founded and shocking. It makes the US government and opposition parties feel that there is no reason for the "Chinese Exclusion Act" to continue to exist

c7ee8b87bbf45ba3c7e3120b57c90cdee1e55a97.translatedText: Oil prices continue to fall in summer. Good news for travelers

5fcc103369857803dae125c8be609d2ec34fb506.sourceText: 夏季油价续下跌 旅行族福音 （亚省时报） 今年夏季美国石油价格可望继续下跌，对期待暑期旅游的人来说，这…
5fcc103369857803dae125c8be609d2ec34fb506.translatedText: Oil prices continue to fall in summer. Good news for travelers (Alberta Times) U.S. oil prices are expected to continue to fall this summer. For those looking forward to summer travel, this...

4345ca71b35aabb6fc58c21ee7416e511150b05e.sourceText: 油价即便在 7 月及 8 月有可能回升，但不会重回每加仑 4 美元或 5 美元以上的价位。美国汽油零售价查询网站 Gasbuddy.com 共同创办人托尔斯认为，美国油价虽然仍在历史高点，但较数个月前的油价为低。
4345ca71b35aabb6fc58c21ee7416e511150b05e.translatedText: Even if oil prices may rise in July and August, they will not return to prices above $4 or $5 per gallon. Toles, co-founder of Gasbuddy.com, a website for checking the retail price of gasoline in the United States, believes that although U.S. oil prices are still at historical highs, they are lower than the prices of a few months ago.

eab65b3950149baff4a8c10817b0adf3415f196f.sourceText: 托尔斯说，今年 4 月上旬美国无铅汽油平均价格达到高峰每加仑 3.91 美元。美国汽车协会（ AAA ）的资料显示， 5 月 28 日的平均价格已下降到每加仑 3.64 美元，下跌近 7 ％。专家预估， 6 月份全美汽油的平均价格每加仑将再下降 10 美分，到接近夏季尾声时才会回升。
eab65b3950149baff4a8c10817b0adf3415f196f.translatedText: The average price of unleaded gasoline in the United States peaked at $3.91 per gallon in early April this year, Toles said. The average price on May 28 had dropped to $3.64 per gallon, a drop of nearly 7%, according to AAA. Experts predict that the average price of gasoline nationwide will drop another 10 cents per gallon in June before picking up toward the end of summer.

71ea2ddf6bab7d9ddc823f483bd95e3ea53f47e6.sourceText: 影响油价的因素很多，专家的预测有时会因此失去准头。据” 石油价格信息服务” 的首席石油分析师科罗萨表示，全球经济不稳定、希腊大选、担心欧洲衰退、飓风季节来临、可能影响中东石油供应的伊朗制裁案的紧张情势等，都是可能左右油价的不确定因 素。
71ea2ddf6bab7d9ddc823f483bd95e3ea53f47e6.translatedText: There are many factors that affect oil prices, and experts' predictions sometimes lose their accuracy because of this. According to Korosa, the chief oil analyst of the "Oil Price Information Service", global economic instability, the Greek election, concerns about European recession, the coming of hurricane season, and tensions over Iranian sanctions that may affect oil supply in the Middle East are all uncertain factors that may affect oil prices.

843622a821c7b18e99389649cb658657ce8094bd.sourceText: 美国各州的油价表现各有不同，西部的华盛顿州、俄勒冈州和加利福尼亚州的油价，因各种因素包括大型炼油厂因火灾关闭，近来急速上升，例如华盛顿州塔科马市的平均油价曾达到每加仑 4.30 美元，较全国平均价格高 69 美分。依 AAA 的资料，华盛顿州 5 月 28 日的石油平均价格 为 3.75 美元。
843622a821c7b18e99389649cb658657ce8094bd.translatedText: The performance of oil prices varies from state to state in the United States. Oil prices in the western states of Washington, Oregon and California have risen sharply in recent times due to various factors, including the closure of large refineries due to fires. For example, the average oil price in Tacoma, Washington, once reached $4.30 per gallon, which is 69 cents higher than the national average price. The average price of oil in Washington state on May 28 was $3.75, according to AAA.

3ada9809ac170fbd79971cd22a4d944508110f9c.sourceText: 文章说，开车族虽然因为油价意外的下跌到 4 美元以下而松了一口气，但现实是，目前油价仍处高点，对消费者而言，还是造成不小的负担。
3ada9809ac170fbd79971cd22a4d944508110f9c.translatedText: The article said that although car owners were relieved that the price of oil unexpectedly dropped to less than 4 US dollars, the reality is that the price of oil is still at a high point, which still poses a considerable burden to consumers.

e5fd061b4d24a8e646c7cf8b7288fad2371cd3c2.sourceText: 福建：黑中介击碎出国就业梦
e5fd061b4d24a8e646c7cf8b7288fad2371cd3c2.translatedText: Fujian: Rogue intermediaries shatter the dream of employment abroad

a39b4496937657d22276df6b3d1b47adceb684ec.sourceText: 福建：黑中介击碎出国就业梦 虽然近年来世界经济疲软，但在中国，想到国外”淘金”的人…
a39b4496937657d22276df6b3d1b47adceb684ec.translatedText: Fujian: Rogue intermediaries shatter the dream of employment abroad Although the world economy has been weak in recent years, there are still many people in China who want to "dig for gold" abroad...

907a491f6f3d2554bde941f9f37d5a480b861092.sourceText: 虽然近年来世界经济疲软，但在中国，想到国外”淘金”的人依旧不少。有人为了省事方便，盲目相信中间人，在未订立书面委托合同，就直接将钱交给中间人去办理，到头来，不但浪费了时间，也可能白白损失金钱。
907a491f6f3d2554bde941f9f37d5a480b861092.translatedText: Although the world economy has been weak in recent years, there are still many people in China who want to "dig for gold" abroad. In order to save trouble and convenience, some people blindly trust the middleman and hand over the money directly to the middleman without entering into a written entrustment contract. In the end, not only is time wasted, but money may also be lost in vain.

ed47b5420d69a847826d3b1430648a6053de930e.sourceText: 21日福建蕉城区法院透露，于近日宣判了一起此类案件，希望对出国就业心切的人有所借鉴，提醒出国就业一定要找正规的中介机构办理。
ed47b5420d69a847826d3b1430648a6053de930e.translatedText: On the 21st, the Jiaocheng District Court of Fujian Province revealed that it had recently pronounced a case of this kind. It hopes to serve as a reference for those who are eager to work abroad, and reminds people who want to work abroad to find formal intermediaries.

cae9459dbbfd1f8f9b0124d4b7f07c67d3460fb6.sourceText: 委托中间人办理出国就业手续
cae9459dbbfd1f8f9b0124d4b7f07c67d3460fb6.translatedText: Entrust an intermediary to handle the procedures for employment abroad

b9ccdcf608e6507d99fd739e7520335c0518b2bb.sourceText: 据院方介绍，谢某与陈某是同乡旧友，在2011年春节期间她们俩见面聊起了出国就业的事。陈某说，他认识一个在新加坡陪读名叫王某的人，可以办理出国从事演艺工作的批文。谢某获悉，立即叫陈某帮忙打听办理该批文所需费用。
b9ccdcf608e6507d99fd739e7520335c0518b2bb.translatedText: According to the hospital, Xie and Chen were old friends from the same hometown. During the Spring Festival in 2011, they met and talked about employment abroad. Chen said that he knew a person named Wang who was accompanying him in Singapore and could apply for approval to go abroad to engage in performing arts. Xie learned that he immediately asked Chen to help inquire about the fees required to apply for the approval.

0fca283ec49f442d70ebf594f753f69a6b03901e.sourceText: 陈某问后，告之每人需3.5万元。而谢某的另外两个朋友听说此事后，表示也想出国。
0fca283ec49f442d70ebf594f753f69a6b03901e.translatedText: > After Chen asked, he was told that each person needed 35,000 yuan. When Xie's other two friends heard about this, they expressed that they also wanted to go abroad.

eccff6a02c7aff2b920e1476668445a3b4f6aef4.sourceText: 三人想法告之陈某，并希望在金额上能缩减部分。经陈某与王某讨价还价后，告诉谢某每人需3.2万元，但在办理手续前，每人需先交5000元。
eccff6a02c7aff2b920e1476668445a3b4f6aef4.translatedText: The three people told Chen about their idea and hoped to reduce the amount. After Chen and Wang bargained, they told Xie that each person needed 32,000 yuan, but before going through the formalities, each person had to pay 5,000 yuan.

b442e97304ad0020a009396e5feb89ea8893d866.sourceText: 在三人预付了1.5万元给陈某后一周，陈某告知批文到了，随后将剩余的8.1万元一并交于陈某。而陈某随即给了谢某三张写着英文的批文，同时告诉他可以凭着批文以及她们自己的护照直接前往新加坡，并可以在批文上注明的演艺公司工作了。
b442e97304ad0020a009396e5feb89ea8893d866.translatedText: One week after the three people paid 15,000 yuan in advance to Chen, Chen informed him that the approval document had arrived, and then handed over the remaining 81,000 yuan to Chen. Chen immediately gave Xie three approval documents written in English, and told him that they could go directly to Singapore with the approval documents and their own passports, and work in the performing arts company indicated on the approval document.

e32582571f7f764aaed1c3f078cc5799f9bb4d18.translatedText: 84,000 yuan in exchange for three fake approval documents

d4849ebdd1968aaaa0f1760d1a61afb344d7a5ec.sourceText: 谢某等人高兴之余，马上便买了去新加坡的机票。然而，天有不测风云，刚过两天，陈某打电话告诉谢某说那家公司出了一点事情，她们三个暂时去不了了，并要求他们先把机票退了，再等一个星期，重新办理批文。
d4849ebdd1968aaaa0f1760d1a61afb344d7a5ec.translatedText: Xie and others were so happy that they immediately bought tickets to Singapore. However, something unexpected happened. Just two days later, Chen called and told Xie that something had happened to the company and the three of them could not go for the time being. He asked them to refund their tickets first and wait a week for a new approval.

0e4e3749b0f10afcb0939cc56af2dfb523480f6a.sourceText: 过了一周，新的批文没有办下来，谢某起疑，并通过在新加坡的朋友向新加坡劳工部查询了原先的三张批文，答复说是假的。
0e4e3749b0f10afcb0939cc56af2dfb523480f6a.translatedText: A week later, the new approval document was not issued. Xie became suspicious and checked the three original approval documents with the Singapore Ministry of Labor through friends in Singapore. The reply said that they were fake.

020a9fc7aeba8f31e42d7f0e5f96809a517fe0c1.sourceText: 得知真相后，谢某多次找陈某退款，2011年3月陈某退了1.2万元给谢某，并声称这些钱本来是留着给他们办理保险用的，其余的8.4万元已经汇给王某了。气愤之余，谢某把陈某告上了法庭。
020a9fc7aeba8f31e42d7f0e5f96809a517fe0c1.translatedText: After learning the truth, Xie asked Chen for refunds many times. In March 2011, Chen refunded 12,000 yuan to Xie, claiming that the money was originally reserved for them to apply for insurance, and the remaining 84,000 yuan had been remitted to Wang. In anger, Xie took Chen to court.

2685cfda5153e3f1ec308130d717655631758afd.sourceText: 法院判中间人承担还款责任
2685cfda5153e3f1ec308130d717655631758afd.translatedText: The court ruled that the intermediary was responsible for repayment

e186e70db0f76948f7f7b9f76b344080f5fa610a.sourceText: 蕉城法院审理认为：谢某与王某未曾见过面，办理出国就业的事都是通过陈某，汇款也是陈某汇给王某的，故谢某与陈某之间委托合同关系成立。但谢某与陈某之间的合同违反法律、行政法规的强制性规定，属于无效合同。
e186e70db0f76948f7f7b9f76b344080f5fa610a.translatedText: The Jiaocheng court held that: Xie and Wang had never met, and all matters related to overseas employment were handled through Chen, and the remittance was also remitted by Chen to Wang, so the entrustment contract relationship between Xie and Chen was established. However, the contract between Xie and Chen violated the mandatory provisions of laws and administrative regulations and was an invalid contract.

07985a5685940d7f847dbcef9be95957b7b27544.sourceText: 《国务院关于加强出入境中介活动管理的通知》第一条规定”凡从事为出国定居、探亲、访友、继承财产、留学、就业及其他非公务活动提供信息服务、法律咨询和帮助申办签证及境外联络、安排等中介活动，必须报经所在省(自治区、直辖市)人民政府有关部门审核并报国务院有关部门审批，凭国务院有关部门颁发的经营许可证到工商行政管理部门办理注册登记”；第五条规定”出入境中介机构要严格遵守国家法律、法规和有关政策规定，不得超范围经营，不得委托其他机构或个人代理有关业务。”陈某并无为他人办理出国就业的中介资质，违反了上述规定，因此谢某与陈某之间的合同属于无效合同。根据法律规定无效合同主要发生以下法律后果：(一)返还财产，即无效合同签订后，一方从另一方取得财产的，应当返还给对方；不能返还或者没有必要返还得，应当折价补偿。(二)赔偿损失，即因无效合同给当事人造成损失的，有过错的一方应当赔偿对方的损失；当事人双方都有过错的，应当各自承担相应的责任。由于谢某仅要求陈某返还8.4万元，于法有据，法院予以支持。
07985a5685940d7f847dbcef9be95957b7b27544.translatedText: Article 1 of the "Notice of the State Council on Strengthening the Management of Entry-Exit Intermediary Activities" stipulates that "Anyone who engages in intermediary activities such as providing information services, legal consultation and assistance in applying for visas and overseas contacts and arrangements for settling abroad, visiting relatives, friends, inheriting property, studying abroad, employment and other non-official activities must be reported to the relevant departments of the people's government of the province (autonomous region, municipality directly under the Central Government) for review and approval, and shall be reported to the relevant departments of the State Council for approval. The business license issued by the relevant department must be registered with the industrial and commercial administration department." Article 5 stipulates that "entry and exit intermediaries must strictly abide by national laws, regulations and relevant policies, and shall not operate beyond their scope, and shall not entrust other institutions or individuals to act as agents for relevant business." Chen has no intermediary qualifications to handle employment abroad for others and violated the above regulations. Therefore, the contract between Xie and Chen is invalid. According to legal provisions, the main legal consequences of an invalid contract are as follows: (1) Return of property, that is, after the signing of an invalid contract, if one party obtains property from the other party, it shall return it to the other party; if it cannot be returned or there is no need to return it, it shall be compensated at a discount. (2) Compensation for losses, that is, if the invalid contract causes losses to the parties, the party at fault shall compensate the other party for the losses; if both parties are at fault, they shall each bear corresponding responsibilities. Since Xie only asked Chen to return 84,000 yuan, it was well-founded in law and the court supported it.

6d2eea8303165e8410b796def6fdb1ac503f4bd5.sourceText: 受骗多与合同不规范有关
6d2eea8303165e8410b796def6fdb1ac503f4bd5.translatedText: Being deceived is mostly related to irregular contracts

84050dc684e22118c1ee1ef71d666a30b89a0010.sourceText: 出国就业本是好事，像本案这样找私人办理，连正式的书面协议都没有签订，办理手续费用和中介佣金的数额混在一起，这不但给法官裁判带来麻烦，消费者付出去的钱也有可能追不会来；有的虽找中介机构办理，但订立的合同又极其简单，中介公司提供的服务包含什么内容、费用具体构成、办理期限、违约退款事项等都未作明确规定，一旦有异议，依据这样的合同，消费者根本无法保护自己的权益。法官提醒想出国就业的人员，应找正规的具有资质的中介机构办理，委托合同的各项条款也应明确。
84050dc684e22118c1ee1ef71d666a30b89a0010.translatedText: It is a good thing to go abroad for employment. In this case, it is handled by a private person without even a formal written agreement. The handling fees and the amount of the intermediary commission are mixed together. This not only brings trouble to the judge, but also The money paid by consumers may not be recovered; some may find intermediaries to handle the matter, but the contracts concluded are extremely simple. The services provided by the intermediaries, the specific components of fees, processing deadlines, refunds for breach of contract, etc. are not clearly stipulated. Once there are objections, consumers cannot protect their rights and interests based on such contracts. The judge reminded those who want to work abroad to find a formal and qualified intermediary agency, and the terms of the entrustment contract should also be clear.

e2defc642c3763ba6c99fdbc3c649703f0b0aa71.sourceText: 南加州大学（USC）2011年秋季中国留学生入学新生讲座现场
e2defc642c3763ba6c99fdbc3c649703f0b0aa71.translatedText: University of Southern California (USC) 2011 Autumn Lecture for Chinese International Students Admissions

83d30a51685999497d15a319f87af43d5d585b3e.sourceText: 美国南加州各大学的开学时间将近，来自中国各地的新留学生已基本全部安全抵达。负责新同学接机和住宿安排的各大学的中国学生学者联谊会，目前正在各大学陆续分别举办专场欢迎新同学的各类讲座，由学长和学姐们相信留学生们介绍和分享在美生活的各类注意事项和学习心得。2011年8月21日下午，南加州大学（USC）中国学生学者联谊会在校园内办了一场2011年秋季入学新生讲座，近千名新入学的青年学子将SGM礼堂挤得水泄不通，过道上都坐满了同学。
83d30a51685999497d15a319f87af43d5d585b3e.translatedText: The start of the semester for universities in Southern California is approaching, and almost all new international students from all over China have arrived safely. The Chinese Students and Scholars Association of each university, which is responsible for the airport pick-up and accommodation arrangements for new students, is currently holding various special lectures to welcome new students at each university. Seniors and seniors will introduce and share various precautions and learning experiences of living in the United States with international students. On the afternoon of August 21, 2011, the University of Southern California (USC) Chinese Students and Scholars Association held a lecture for freshmen entering in the fall of 2011 on campus. Nearly a thousand newly admitted young students packed the SGM auditorium and the aisles were filled with classmates.

53631eff0218b7fa58ebaefc8d135a7742e19d98.sourceText: 联谊会主席王昊王首先向新学子们介绍了联谊会组织的各类活动和服务，以及联络方式。欢迎新学子们成为这个大家庭中的一分子，在今后能够和谐相处，互相帮助。寄语新留学生们能多参加活动、多交朋友，顺利渡过第一个学期。
53631eff0218b7fa58ebaefc8d135a7742e19d98.translatedText: The chairman of the fraternity, Wang Haowang, first introduced the various activities and services organized by the fraternity to the new students, as well as their contact information. We welcome new students to become part of this big family so that they can live in harmony and help each other in the future. I wish the new international students to participate in more activities, make more friends, and get through the first semester smoothly.

7f58cabb155a6ce06aa23537d24bd369f131aea3.sourceText: 亚利桑那州长否决“反同性恋”法案

292965b35de91cfc9bbef0563d072182f92d62ff.sourceText: 亚利桑那州长否决“反同性恋”法案 布鲁尔表示，该法案可能带来”意外和负面的后果”。…
292965b35de91cfc9bbef0563d072182f92d62ff.translatedText: Arizona governor vetoes "anti-gay" bill Brewer said the bill could have "unintended and negative consequences." …

19a50ecb019ea0bbcaee10c62c76fc2d165b2711.sourceText: 布鲁尔表示，该法案可能带来”意外和负面的后果”。 反同性恋法案被某些社会保守人士称为保护宗教自由的法案。但反对人士批评说，这是将反同性恋歧视行为合法化。
19a50ecb019ea0bbcaee10c62c76fc2d165b2711.translatedText: Brewer said the bill could have “unintended and negative consequences.” The anti-gay bill has been called a bill to protect religious freedom by some social conservatives. But opponents criticized it as legitimizing anti-gay discrimination.

1f2839950ab062e70f0c4e2fdcc0228b0a4ba1cd.sourceText: 她说，从未听说亚利桑那州有企业东主的宗教自由被侵犯的事情。
1f2839950ab062e70f0c4e2fdcc0228b0a4ba1cd.translatedText: She said she had never heard of a business owner's religious freedom being violated in Arizona.

1f554619f130009ea8ee37f838ea3c7ab8e9f1a9.sourceText: 亚利桑那州平等机会主席魏宁格对BBC表示，否决反同性恋法案向那些用宗教为借口的人士发出了一个明确的信息，即我们已受够了歧视的对待。
1f554619f130009ea8ee37f838ea3c7ab8e9f1a9.translatedText: Arizona Equal Opportunity Chairman Weininger told the BBC that vetoing the anti-gay bill sends a clear message to those who use religion as an excuse that we have had enough of discriminatory treatment.

8be8593e46fa4713c17f7d106bb6540fe8e80b4b.sourceText: 说话做事不按常理出牌 美国开启””任性””施政
8be8593e46fa4713c17f7d106bb6540fe8e80b4b.translatedText: The United States has begun a "willful" policy, speaking and doing things that do not follow common sense.

5a32793f3ea2a8f8a8fc03c0bc3a2a759e4c59ed.sourceText: 说话做事不按常理出牌 美国开启””任性””施政 说话做事…
5a32793f3ea2a8f8a8fc03c0bc3a2a759e4c59ed.translatedText: It has spoken and acted inconsistently with common sense.

31ea2c3258bf226a35412982ad6822d547ef841b.sourceText: 说话做事不按常理出牌 美国开启”任性”施政
31ea2c3258bf226a35412982ad6822d547ef841b.translatedText: The United States has embarked on "willful" governance

b424527428e6e0dce2d5704bde0ad820eee1e670.sourceText: 特朗普就任美国总统将满一年，就其施政，美国国内”正反”评价泾渭分明。研判美国对外政策，新华社世界问题研究中心研究员王发恩以”任性”来形容。
b424527428e6e0dce2d5704bde0ad820eee1e670.translatedText: > It has been one year since Trump took office as President of the United States. Regarding his policies, there are clear "pros and cons" evaluations in the United States. When evaluating U.S. foreign policy, Wang Fa'en, a researcher at Xinhua News Agency's Center for World Issues Research, described it as "willful."

95a54b3e8bf10b0dbd840c11973bdb44f16dee09.sourceText: ”特朗普是个非典型政客，说话做事常常不按常理出牌。在美国的传统政治精英即所谓”建制派”眼里，特朗普像个”另类”，”王发恩说。
95a54b3e8bf10b0dbd840c11973bdb44f16dee09.translatedText: "Trump is an atypical politician. He often speaks and does things that do not follow common sense. In the eyes of the traditional political elite in the United States, the so-called "establishment", Trump is like an "alternative"," Wang Fa'en said.

97495cf28f0caaf2e08c5b759912aa797660f432.sourceText: 当地时间2017年12月22日，美国华盛顿，美国总统特朗普在白宫的椭圆形办公室签署1.5万亿美元税改法案，此乃美国最近逾30年来最大规模减税行动。
97495cf28f0caaf2e08c5b759912aa797660f432.translatedText: On December 22, 2017, local time, in Washington, the United States, U.S. President Trump signed a $1.5 trillion tax reform bill in the Oval Office of the White House. This is the largest tax cut in the United States in more than 30 years.

e0b0905a231efcf5625fffa5245b8a87c5575fcb.sourceText: 这种”另类”表现也许源自特朗普的商人特质。他逢事强调”以结果为导向”，尤其在外交领域，特朗普希望看到显而易见、立竿见影的”结果”。一旦”结果”满足不了预期，就会直接反作用于双边关系。而他想要的”结果”，就是最大化地实现美国利益，即他上台前高调表态、上台后反复强调的”美国优先”原则。
e0b0905a231efcf5625fffa5245b8a87c5575fcb.translatedText: This "alternative" performance may be due to Trump's businessman qualities. He emphasizes "result-oriented" in every situation, especially in the diplomatic field. Trump hopes to see obvious and immediate "results." Once the "results" fail to meet expectations, it will directly have a negative impact on bilateral relations. The "result" he wants is to maximize the realization of American interests, that is, the "America First" principle he made a high-profile statement before taking office and repeatedly emphasized after taking office.

93d2154e5c577a5ef7ce43f0f0bb7958ae0257dd.sourceText: 王发恩说：””美国优先”是”你输我赢”，是”零和博弈”。只要不符合”美国利益”，协议说撕就撕。美国以往所谓的”国际规则””负责任大国”等等都成为过去。”
93d2154e5c577a5ef7ce43f0f0bb7958ae0257dd.translatedText: Wang Faen said: ""America First" means "you lose and I win" and a "zero-sum game." As long as it is not in line with the "interests of the United States," the agreement will be torn up at any time. The so-called "international rules" and "responsible power" of the United States in the past are all things of the past."

6e899135010213dbc57a8e1616fbe33a2963c170.sourceText: 特朗普上台不到一年，美国先后退出《跨太平洋战略经济伙伴协定》(TPP)、应对全球气候变化的《巴黎协定》、联合国科教文组织以及联合国主导的《移民问题全球契约》制订进程，伊核协议面临困境，连北美自贸区协议及多个双边经贸协议也存亡不定。12月初，特朗普又宣布美国承认耶路撒冷是以色列首都，并着手准备将美国驻以大使馆从特拉维夫迁至耶路撒冷。此举冲击了国际社会对巴以问题的基本共识，招致国际舆论强烈反弹。
6e899135010213dbc57a8e1616fbe33a2963c170.translatedText: Trump Less than a year after President Trump came to power, the United States successively withdrew from the Trans-Pacific Strategic Economic Partnership (TPP), the Paris Agreement to address global climate change, UNESCO, and the United Nations-led Global Compact on Migration. The Iran nuclear agreement is facing difficulties, and even the North American Free Trade Agreement and multiple bilateral economic and trade agreements are also in doubt. In early December, Trump announced that the United States recognized Jerusalem as the capital of Israel and began preparations to move the U.S. Embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem. This move impacted the basic consensus of the international community on the Palestinian-Israeli issue and triggered a strong backlash from international public opinion.

c86962c2027e693e9c4dacfa5cd8ec18041e8b0b.sourceText: 12月21日的联合国大会表决通过谴责美国耶路撒冷政策的决议。表决前，总统特朗普和美国驻联合国代表黑莉明确警告会员国”反对美国会失去援助”，这对一个联合国安理会常任理事国来说十分罕见。有媒体认为，美国的影响力在”衰减”：并不是说美国的硬实力下降，而是它作为世界”唯一超级大国”，从”道义”高地滑落。
c86962c2027e693e9c4dacfa5cd8ec18041e8b0b.translatedText: On December 21, the United Nations General Assembly voted to adopt a resolution condemning the United States’ Jerusalem policy. Before the vote, President Trump and U.S. Representative to the United Nations Nikki Haley explicitly warned member states that "if they oppose the United States, they will lose aid." This is very rare for a permanent member of the United Nations Security Council. Some media believe that the influence of the United States is "declining": it does not mean that the hard power of the United States is declining, but that as the world's "sole superpower", it has slipped from its "moral" high ground.

982dab650b8d8ceb013161813b4265725a18a56f.sourceText: ”特朗普这一连串单边举动引发全球关注，传统盟友也有很多怨言，”王发恩说，以上种种，凸显了一年来美国对外政策的”任性”，使过去以美国价值观为”标杆”构建基本规则秩序的西方世界无所适从，让国际社会对美国未来走向有很大疑虑。
982dab650b8d8ceb013161813b4265725a18a56f.translatedText: "Trump's series of unilateral actions have attracted global attention, and there have been many complaints from traditional allies," Wang Fa'en said. All the above have highlighted the "willfulness" of U.S. foreign policy over the past year, leaving the Western world that used American values ​​as the "benchmark" to build a basic rules order at a loss as to what to do, and causing the international community to have great doubts about the future direction of the United States.

eb4e995148f8fd5331b8ce61388b2a8571882820.sourceText: 不过，王发恩指出，纵观特朗普的行为轨迹，有一点是清晰和肯定的：那就是一切政策都服务于”美国优先”这一国家利益。这或许是判断特朗普治下美国对外政策走向时，各类”不可测”因素中”可测”的关键线索。(沈敏)(新华社专特稿)
eb4e995148f8fd5331b8ce61388b2a8571882820.translatedText: However, Wang Faen pointed out that looking at Trump’s behavioral trajectory, one thing is clear and certain: that is, all policies serve the national interest of “America First”. This may be the key clue to the "measurable" among various "unpredictable" factors when judging the direction of U.S. foreign policy under Trump. (Shen Min) (Xinhua News Agency special article)

6d2f9fe93a9abb42e5337d2edcbd6296b2654eb9.translatedText: Houses for rent in the greater Phoenix area are hot Jinxin Real Estate News Many people flock to the open rental houses to view the houses. Desperate rent seekers posted multiple offers at the same time...

4268313ab7d55ce7559cce076b838a7c1f09ad3a.sourceText: 很多人蜂拥而至，到开放的出租房，看房。 绝望的求租者同时发出多个房子的求租要求。 大凤凰城的出租市场火爆。 最热的地区在凤凰城市中北部，斯科茨代尔南部，格伦代尔，坦佩市中，钱德勒和吉尔伯特（central and north Phoenix, south Scottsdale, Glendale, central Tempe, Chandler and Gilbert）。 格雷，高级住房贷款工作人员，打算在北斯科茨代尔租一个4600平方英尺的房子，他发出了四个申请。 第一天晚上就收到了一个拒绝信。 他不得不写一些更详细的申请信，包括他个人的生活内容，并保证一定会像保护自己的房子一样，保护出租屋。 一同附上了全家人的照片，希望可以通过努力获得想要租的房子。 目前主要的租客是因为房屋遭法拍，无法贷款购买新屋的家庭，以及因工作迁移，到凤凰城的新移民。 今年的6月和7月是十年来，完成租赁合同最多的月份，出租的速度快了三倍。 7月全地区的房屋空置率为38天，是12年来最短的空置时长。 更多有关房地产的信息请咨询金信地产的Tinna(480)287-0180 E-mail:Goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com。
4268313ab7d55ce7559cce076b838a7c1f09ad3a.translatedText: Many people flocked to the open rental houses to view the properties. Desperate rent-seekers put out requests for multiple properties at the same time. The rental market in Greater Phoenix is ​​booming. The hottest areas are central and north Phoenix, south Scottsdale, Glendale, central Tempe, Chandler and Gilbert. Gray, a senior home loan officer, was looking to rent a 4,600-square-foot home in North Scottsdale, and he sent out four applications. I got a rejection letter on my first night. He had to write a more detailed application letter, including his personal life content, and promised to protect the rental house just like he protected his own house. I have attached a photo of the whole family, hoping that through hard work I can get the house I want to rent. The current main tenants are families who cannot get loans to buy new houses because their houses have been foreclosed, and new immigrants who have moved to Phoenix for work. June and July of this year were the months with the most completed leases in the past decade, with leasing rates three times faster. The region-wide vacancy rate was 38 days in July, the shortest vacancy period in 12 years. f14b6fc64b9983ee96c3bab0604f69ae33404c4e.translatedText: Hope Chinese School raises funds for the school for the children of Tibetan herders (Draft of Hope Chinese School 11/22/2014) Charity and helping the poor are the characteristics of the Chinese nation...

c2ed816dada90f43d8277f60396c4ede68c35608.sourceText: (希望中文学校11/22/2014稿) 乐善好施、扶贫帮困是中华民族的传统美德，希望中文学校学生会将这种传统美德和感恩节文化结合在一起，倡导同学们有一颗感恩之心，关爱之心，在校内展开了希望爱心行动。希望中文学校的老师、家长和学生都积极响应，为中国边远地区四川色达一所藏族牧民孩子的学校筹款。边远地区生活物资及其缺乏, 孩子们需要基本的文具和衣服，学生会计划将募集到的资金全部捐给甘孜州色达中心学校，给山区学童准备一份圣诞新年礼物，礼物包括学习文具及基本用品，这次爱心行动得到64 位爱心人士的支持共筹款$662。 小善大爱, 让我们一起向地球另一边的孩子们给予爱心，给予希望!
c2ed816dada90f43d8277f60396c4ede68c35608.translatedText: (Draft of Hope Chinese School 11/22/2014) Being charitable and helping the poor are the traditional virtues of the Chinese nation. It is hoped that Chinese school students will combine this traditional virtue with the Thanksgiving culture, advocate students to have a grateful heart and a caring heart, and launch the Hope and Love Action in the school. It is hoped that teachers, parents and students of Chinese schools will actively respond to raise funds for a school for the children of Tibetan herders in Seda, Sichuan, a remote area of ​​China. There is a shortage of daily necessities in remote areas, and children need basic stationery and clothes. The student union plans to donate all the funds raised to Seda Central School in Garze Prefecture to prepare a Christmas and New Year gift for school children in mountainous areas. The gift includes school stationery and basic supplies. This charity action has received the support of 64 caring people and raised a total of $662. Small kindness and big love, let us work together to give love and hope to the children on the other side of the earth!

73b1cefda476ffee9643c2bdd4cc5d23cb22cc83.sourceText: 感谢学生家长丁鼎先生为这次爱心行动所做的短片： http://youtu.be/auiZl7hi82c 亚利桑那希望中文学校学生会在校内发起为甘孜自治州色达中心学校的捐助活动, 如果你愿意伸 出援助之手，也欢迎加入我们的爱心行动。请联系azhopedonation@yahoo.com. 感谢以下参加这次爱心行动的爱心人士:

efd3ea7da0ec70cfc7c82a530ace965edb4a3215.translatedText: Han Han's latest blog post "Chongqing American Drama" comments on Wang Lijun's palace drama. What can mobilize public opinion institutions today will become negative news tomorrow, and what can activate the state machinery today will tomorrow...

7dff3c4d9b6b9551fc970fa8a515a1ceb6c7ca34.sourceText: 昨天夜晚，相信很多网友和我一样，拼命刷屏人民网。我估计这是人民网第一次迎接来这么多真正的人民。刷屏的目的只为了三个字，王立军。
7dff3c4d9b6b9551fc970fa8a515a1ceb6c7ca34.translatedText: Last night, I believe many netizens, like me, were desperately scrolling through People's Daily Online. I think this is the first time that People's Daily Online has welcomed so many real people. The purpose of swiping the screen is just for three words, Wang Lijun.

34cfe239e00f5fae18522f81a3d1739333b4ba9a.sourceText: 宫廷大戏一出，我这样的民间闹剧就相形见绌。在这次闹剧中，由于我猪一样的发挥，深感愧对观众。没有想到王立军出现了，而主人公又去了美国大使馆，这就是美剧了。再次回头看看自己扮演的国产连续剧，真的太小儿科了。
34cfe239e00f5fae18522f81a3d1739333b4ba9a.translatedText: >When the palace drama comes out, the folk farce like mine pales in comparison. In this farce, because of my pig-like performance, I deeply feel ashamed of the audience. Unexpectedly, Wang Lijun appeared, and the protagonist went to the US Embassy. This is an American drama. Looking back at the domestic TV series I played in, I realized they were too childish.

09254d01bbea447bb6714d569f264dc11b8fa610.sourceText: 这又让我突然想到了常年在各个县城参加拉力赛发车时的情景。因为我是种子车手，所以都是县里的领导给我发车，但到了第二年，主持人喊着一样的头衔，出现的却是不一样的脸。发车过程结束以后，伴随着主持人的一句”请领导下”，我注视领导的背影，感慨万千。当然这其中有升迁的有栽的，而重庆具体发生了什么，在这种政治八卦里，我们终究是看不清楚的。大路消息深藏不露，人民网不仁，我就只能顺着小道一路攀爬，拼凑出了个大概。在这个过程里，我代入了王立军同志的内心，得出了一个字，累。
09254d01bbea447bb6714d569f264dc11b8fa610.translatedText: This suddenly reminded me of the scene when I participate in rally starts in various counties all year round. Because I was the seeded driver, the leaders of the county gave me a start. But in the second year, the host shouted the same title, but a different face appeared. After the departure process was over, with the host's words "please lead me", I looked at the leader's back and was filled with emotion. Of course, there are those who are promoted and those who are not, but what exactly happened in Chongqing, after all, we cannot see clearly in this kind of political gossip. The news on the main road was hidden, and People's Daily Online was unkind, so I could only climb along the trail and piece together a rough idea. During this process, I entered the heart of Comrade Wang Lijun and came up with one word: tired.

15230260e6baf1e0327394e04b445dd8d9aeb696.sourceText: 中国的官员本身就是极其分裂的，他们上午进会场，晚上进会所，一方面要学习和领会六十年代风格的文件，一方面又要在互联网上仔细分辨微博和QQ的区别，而他们在批评美国的同时也要精确的知道美领馆的位置。在这里，你读不懂中国。我由衷的替他们觉得辛苦。今天只是跟了一个晚上的重庆美剧，过程跌宕起伏，消息层出不穷，连我都觉得需要休假式治疗了，何况当事人王立军，估计已经休克了。
15230260e6baf1e0327394e04b445dd8d9aeb696.translatedText: Chinese officials themselves are extremely divided. They go to conference venues in the morning and clubs in the evening. On the one hand, they have to study and understand 1960s-style documents, and on the other hand, they have to carefully distinguish the difference between Weibo and QQ on the Internet. While criticizing the United States, they also need to accurately know the location of the U.S. consulate. You can't understand China here. I sincerely feel sorry for them. Today I just watched a Chongqing American drama for one night. The process was full of ups and downs, and the news kept coming out. Even I felt that I needed vacation-style treatment, not to mention that the person involved, Wang Lijun, was probably in shock.

f0016f9e74907ad174e45629472847c6604ac4ba.sourceText: 所以我不明白，中国的官员们究竟是怎么想的。很多人都想当官，这是肯定的，尤其是当了大官，想做生意的时候根本不用像吴英那样自己想办法筹钱，最后还换个死刑，只需要安排一个亲属，垄断一块资源，致电一下银行。官员做到了一定的程度，上上下下都不是我们普通人可以理解的，因为上海大火而辞职的官员很快就可以去新疆当官，好在不是被派往克拉玛依。今天能调动舆论机构的，明天就成负面新闻，今天能开动国家机器的，明天就被国家机器带走。对于官员，大家已经不再用腐败和清廉来形容了，只有得势和失宠。而大家也不知道重庆将要发生些什么，尽管这个城市刚刚去香港唱过红，而在此之前，香港人只听过张国荣唱的《红》。
f0016f9e74907ad174e45629472847c6604ac4ba.translatedText: So I don’t understand what the Chinese officials are thinking. Many people want to be officials, that's for sure, especially if they become high-ranking officials. When they want to do business, they don't have to think of ways to raise money themselves like Wu Ying did. In the end, they were sentenced to death. They only need to arrange for a relative to monopolize a resource and call the bank. Officials have reached a certain level, which is beyond the comprehension of ordinary people. Officials who resigned because of the fire in Shanghai will soon be able to serve as officials in Xinjiang. Fortunately, they were not sent to Karamay. Those who can mobilize public opinion institutions today will become negative news tomorrow; those who can mobilize the state machinery today will be taken away by the state machinery tomorrow. For officials, people no longer use the terms corruption and incorruptibility to describe them, but only those who gain power and those who fall out of favor. And everyone doesn't know what will happen in Chongqing, even though this city has just gone to Hong Kong to sing "Red", and before that, Hong Kong people had only heard "Red" sung by Leslie Cheung.

d2db9626fe3388767ac0d8d6b200632ec22687f8.sourceText: 这次的破朔迷离，让我知道未来的中国，其实不需要预想一个什么颜色，红也好，蓝也好，都抵不过透明。
d2db9626fe3388767ac0d8d6b200632ec22687f8.translatedText: This time of confusion made me realize that China in the future does not need to predict a certain color. No matter whether it is red or blue, it is not as transparent as it is transparent.

5dea3ca78b3716c028404bcf7689b4d7ac2e2853.sourceText: 遭枪击女议员首次亮相国会 遭枪击的本州岛女议员吉福兹1日首次在国会亮相，参加众议院有关提高美债上限及削减赤字协议的投票。 综合媒体8月1日报导，众议院1日晚表决通过两党达成的提高美债上限及削减赤字协议，在总计269张赞成票（反对票为161张）中，有一票是由头部遭枪击却大难不死的民主党女议员加布里埃尔吉福兹投出。 这是今年1月枪击案发生后吉福兹首次在国会亮相。投票现场的录像显示，吉福兹着浅蓝上衣，戴一副黑框眼镜，神色看上去不错，但步履稍显蹒跚。相信是为方便治疗着想，她的头发剪得极短。 吉福兹在投票现场现身后，立即被议员们簇拥起来，并受到起立鼓掌的欢迎，一名同样与吉福兹来自亚利桑那州的议员更轻轻吻了她一下，将现场气氛推向高潮。 ”加布里埃尔重返华盛顿，支持两党议案，以避免发生经济危机。”投票开始后，吉福兹在其推特（twitter）账号中写道，表明自己对31日两党达成的提债及削减赤字协议投下赞成票。 今年1月8日，现年41岁的吉福兹在图森市与选民见面时，一名22岁青年突然向人群开枪，酿成6死12伤的惨剧。袭击中子弹穿过吉福兹的左脑，但她大难不死，事后奇迹般地活了下来。 在伤情逐渐稳定后，吉福兹转往休斯顿一家康复中心接受治疗。今年5月中旬美国”奋进号”航天飞机最后一次执行飞行任务时，吉福兹曾前往发射现场为自己的宇航员丈夫马克凯利送行，当时也是她遭到枪击后首次在公开场合露面。
5dea3ca78b3716c028404bcf7689b4d7ac2e2853.translatedText: The congresswoman who was shot made her first appearance in Congress. The congresswoman Giffords, who was shot, made her first appearance in Congress on the 1st, to participate in the House of Representatives' vote on raising the U.S. debt ceiling and reducing the deficit agreement. Comprehensive media reported on August 1 that the House of Representatives voted on the evening of the 1st to pass the bipartisan agreement to raise the U.S. debt ceiling and reduce the deficit. Among a total of 269 votes in favor (161 votes against), one vote was cast by Democratic congresswoman Gabrielle Giffords, who was shot in the head but survived. This is Giffords' first appearance in Congress since the shooting in January this year. The video of the voting scene showed that Giffords was wearing a light blue shirt and a pair of black-rimmed glasses. He looked good, but his steps were slightly unsteady. I believe her hair was cut extremely short for the convenience of treatment. After Giffords appeared at the voting site, she was immediately surrounded by congressmen and received a standing ovation. A congressman who is also from Arizona and Giffords even kissed her gently, bringing the atmosphere to a climax. "Gabriel returned to Washington to support bipartisan bills to avoid an economic crisis." After the vote began, Giffords wrote on his Twitter account, indicating that he voted in favor of the debt raising and deficit reduction agreement reached by the two parties on the 31st. On January 8 this year, when the 41-year-old Giffords was meeting with voters in Tucson, a 22-year-old young man suddenly opened fire on the crowd, resulting in a tragedy that killed six and injured 12. The bullet passed through the left side of Giffords' brain during the attack, but she survived the attack and miraculously survived the incident. After his injury gradually stabilized, Giffords was transferred to a rehabilitation center in Houston for treatment. In mid-May this year, when the U.S. Space Shuttle Endeavor performed its final mission, Giffords went to the launch site to see off her astronaut husband, Mark Kelly. It was also the first time she appeared in public since she was shot.

4da8c2633e7ba71b6c487b758d386f6d8577aa71.sourceText: 美国世纪大干旱，很多人担心国家的粮仓，食品价格上涨。 事实上，在美国，如果知道什么时候购买食物，可能会节省很多钱。 以下是一些指导原则： 肉类：每周一至周五的早上，可说是最佳购买肉类的时间，消费者经常看到?#29305;价?#30340;标志，必须在当天中午前出售，甚至可能会发现50%或更多的 折扣。 时令蔬果：购买时令的水果和蔬菜，价格通常较低，因为产量较多，杂货店也不希望看到它们最终腐烂。 美国农业部在网站列出的时令水果和蔬菜的最佳购买时机。 鸡蛋：大多数的购物者可能不知道，当接近逾期之时，杂货店把鸡蛋减价销售。 对于某些食品来说，逾期的日期，等同于食品可以安全吃用的最后一天限期。 但是，鸡蛋可以在逾期后3至5个星期，仍是放心食用，因为不用担心而可购买减价鸡蛋。 已熟食品：如果你喜欢烤鸡，寿司和其他已熟食物，它们可能是更为昂贵的。 但是，在杂货店关闭前一个小时，你可以前往购买，因为许多商店不会把已煮熟食物，留待翌日销售，预计大约有40%或以上的折扣。 面包和烘焙食品：傍晚和晚上，一些商店会将面包等降价大约50%，否则，商店也随将面包等弃置。 此外，越来越多的一元店销售的面包，价钱比较杂货店便宜一半到三分之一。 冷冻火鸡：在感恩节和圣诞节之前，有一些食品杂货商会降低火鸡的价格，以吸引消费者，但是，最好的价格往往是假期结束之后，商家也试图促销未售出的火鸡 ，免得占用了大量的空间。 礼品券：使用它来购买日常用品，例如番茄酱，卫生纸，人造黄油和谷类。 消费者都知道周日出版的报纸，送上大量的优惠券，但是，最精明的疯狂优惠券消费者，均知道每月1日，很多的网站是最狂热的送出优惠券，例如：coupons.com ，redplum.com，thriftytiff.com等，均报价新一轮的优惠券。 超市购买杂物：周三是最好的一天。 因为，每周超市杂货店的减价销售，几乎总是在周三开始。 如果你想购买减价货品，又不会担心受欢迎的项目早已销售，周三是最好的选择，消费者也不多。 为了减少冲动购买和省钱，消费者应该做一个列表，只购买清单上的货品，尽量每周一次，甚至不要带孩子。
4da8c2633e7ba71b6c487b758d386f6d8577aa71.translatedText: The Great Drought of the Century in the United States, many people are worried about the country's breadbasket and rising food prices. In fact, in the United States, you can save a lot of money if you know when to buy food. Here are some guidelines: Meat: Arguably the best time to buy meat is Monday through Friday morning, as consumers often see price tags that must be sold by noon that day, and may even find discounts of 50% or more. Seasonal Fruits and Vegetables: Buying fruits and vegetables when they are in season usually costs less because there are more of them produced and grocers don’t want to see them end up rotting. The USDA website lists the best times to buy seasonal fruits and vegetables. Eggs: Most shoppers may not know that grocery stores put eggs on sale when they are close to their expiration date. For some foods, the expiration date is equivalent to the last day the food is safe to eat. However, eggs can be eaten 3 to 5 weeks after the expiration date, because you don’t have to worry and can buy eggs at reduced prices. Prepared foods: If you like grilled chicken, sushi and other cooked foods, they may be more expensive. However, you can go shopping an hour before the grocery store closes because many stores will not hold cooked food for sale the next day, and expect discounts of around 40% or more. Bread and baked goods: In the evening and evening, some stores will reduce the price of bread and other items by about 50%, otherwise the store will discard the bread and other items. In addition, an increasing number of dollar stores sell bread that is half to one-third cheaper than grocery stores. Frozen turkeys: Before Thanksgiving and Christmas, some grocers will lower the price of turkeys to attract consumers. However, the best prices are often after the holidays are over, and businesses also try to promote unsold turkeys so as not to take up a lot of space. Gift Vouchers: Use them to buy everyday items like ketchup, toilet paper, margarine and cereal. Consumers all know that newspapers published on Sundays send out a large number of coupons, but the most savvy coupon-crazy consumers know that on the 1st of every month, many websites are the most enthusiastic about sending out coupons, such as coupons.com, redplum.com, thriftytiff.com, etc., all offering a new round of coupons. Grocery shopping at the supermarket: Wednesday is the best day. Because weekly supermarket and grocery sales almost always start on Wednesday. If you want to buy something on sale without worrying about popular items already sold out, Wednesday is your best bet when there aren't many shoppers. In order to reduce impulse purchases and save money, consumers should make a list and only buy the items on the list, try to buy them once a week, even without children.

798283d9085cd4c462b216a2f81fd86442198353.sourceText: 心水：心中无事一床宽 心水 现代人对于医治失眠的方法多不胜数，各种各类偏方往往令失眠者趋之若鹜；当然、最直接了当不外吞颗安眠药。一旦要靠药片治疗，将会有无穷后患，也就是所谓的「后遗症」，这无疑是饮鸩止渴。 最为人知的方法是数羊，但未必有效。以下是一则有名的数羊故事，不坊记下让大家笑笑。某君多年来为失眠所苦，对能医治此症的方法都尽量去试。他终于听到「数羊」这则洋人妙法，当晚躺卧床上后，便开始认真细数。一只羊、两只羊、三只羊、十只羊、百只羊、千只羊一直数下去；到了万只羊时，竟然高兴到睡意全消。想到每只羊值一百澳元的话，岂非有了百万元财产？有了百万元之后，开始想要如何运用这笔钱了 漫漫长夜辗转难眠，左翻右动，越急越难入睡；那份不堪言的苦，真个如人饮水冷暖自知了。从事劳力者，因为整天劳动，全身早已疲倦不堪，往往上床就打呼噜。被失眠折腾的大多数是劳心者与有闲阶级，自然还有少数是因体康原因，如血气过虚，或得亢奋症。 有宗教信仰的人，越虔诚的信众，越不会失眠，那是宗教的无形力量。这些信众把今生来世、个人运程，死活等大小事都交托予菩萨、满天神佛或天主、上帝或阿拉真主。因而、凡事较乐观，至于信者是否真能永生？不劳外人挂心也。 信者绝对相信都能被其崇拜对像所庇佑，心安理得，少了种种担忧，自然能安然寻梦了。 打坐是佛教一种灵修，最大目的就是收敛野马之心；将心安于身内，将心定于一处。若心能安，也就能静，自然易入梦境。当然、这个方法必要有师傅指点，才不会「走火入魔」，伤及身心。 天主教教友们，可试颂念玫瑰经；佛教教众默颂心经或「阿弥陀佛」佛号；心诚则灵，必然会在聆听自己的念经声中沉沉入睡。 受失眠之苦者，有些老生常谈的守则是该相信的:如黄昏后就不要喝浓茶、咖啡等含有咖啡因的饮料，我每日午后三时开始，这类饮品就不沾唇了。持之以恒、多年来成了习惯，绝对有助安眠。 常失眠、除了因体康问题外，最大原因都是大脑被刺激，脑神经细胞每分每时都在工作；如喝浓茶饮咖啡加强咖啡因在脑内作祟，遇到高兴或悲伤的事，大喜大忧情绪起伏不定，都直接影响脑部而难安枕。 心经」内有四句经文:「心无挂碍、无挂碍故、无有恐怖、远离颠倒梦想。」真是佛经中的「金句」；也是「心经」的精华所在。人如能做到或修到「心无挂碍」这种境界，脑中自无杂念，脑神经平静无波，心安心定心静心宁，那会失眠呢？ 读过借用上联引为本文题目的对联如下: 「心中无事一床宽 、眼内有尘三界窄 」 如能「心中无事」也就与心经经文「心无挂碍」同理了；没任何事情放在心上，将一切杂事杂念都抛到云霄。躺在床上，必然感觉眠床又大又宽又舒适，保管轻松自如的很快寻梦去了。 只要明白世间本无事，庸人自扰之；做人千万不要自寻烦恼，放下执着，抛开一切，心就会自在，了无牵挂，躺到床上必然安睡甘甜如蜜。 生活起居，作息时间要有规律；人的生理时钟运行得极准，不要扰乱了它。旅行发生的时差，之会令人失眠，作怪者正是人体生理时钟。每晚定时上床，寝室不要太亮或太暗，睡前喝半杯牛奶或食两个奇异果，有助安眠。 不要让杂念老在脑中纠缠，上床后、将所有日间的事务、未完工作、尤其是人际间的是非恩怨都抛之脑后。天大的事都可以留待明天解决，坚定的相信，天下没有什么大不了的事。凡事一笑置之，心中自然无事，岂会失眠呢？ 千万不要倚靠安眠药，一旦上了瘾，对肝脏的危害将会后患无穷。只要学习「心无挂碍」，上床前养成「心中无事」，将胡思乱想种种念头和自寻的烦恼全抛掉。放下一切，闭上眼睛，包能好梦如蜜芬芳、甘睡到天亮。 二零零九年十二月廿九日于无相斋。
798283d9085cd4c462b216a2f81fd86442198353.translatedText: Favorite: A clear mind means a wide bed. Favorite: A clear mind means a wide bed. Modern people have countless ways to treat insomnia, and various folk remedies often make insomniacs flock to them; of course, the most straightforward one is to swallow a sleeping pill. Once you have to rely on pills for treatment, there will be endless consequences, also known as "sequelae". This is undoubtedly drinking poison to quench thirst. The most well-known method is counting sheep, but it may not be effective. The following is a famous story about counting sheep. I would like to jot it down to make everyone laugh. A certain person has suffered from insomnia for many years and has tried every possible method to cure the disease. He finally heard the wonderful foreign method of "counting sheep". After lying in bed that night, he began to count carefully. One sheep, two sheep, three sheep, ten sheep, one hundred sheep, one thousand sheep kept counting; when they reached ten thousand sheep, they were so happy that all their sleepiness disappeared. Thinking about it, if each sheep is worth 100 Australian dollars, wouldn’t it mean that you have a million-dollar fortune? After having one million yuan, I began to think about how to use the money. I tossed and turned in the long night, turning left and right, the more anxious I became, the harder it was to fall asleep. The unspeakable suffering was like a person who knows whether drinking water is warm or cold. People who work as laborers are already exhausted from working all day long, and they often snore when they go to bed. Most of the people who suffer from insomnia are hard-working people and the leisure class. Naturally, a few suffer from physical health reasons, such as excessive blood and qi, or hyperactivity. People who have religious beliefs, the more devout the believers are, the less likely they will suffer from insomnia. This is the invisible power of religion. These believers entrust everything from this life to the next, personal destiny, life and death, and other matters to Bodhisattvas, gods and Buddhas in the sky, God, God, or Allah. Therefore, everything is more optimistic. As for whether believers can really live forever? Don't worry about outsiders. Believers absolutely believe that they can be protected by their idols, feel at ease, and have less worries, so they can naturally pursue their dreams in peace. Meditation is a kind of spiritual practice in Buddhism. The biggest purpose is to restrain the wild horse's heart; to calm the mind within the body and fix the mind in one place. If the mind can be at peace, it can also be calm, and it will naturally be easy to fall into dreams. Of course, this method must be guided by a master so that it will not go too far and harm the body and mind. Catholics can try reciting the Rosary; Buddhists can silently recite the Heart Sutra or the name of "Amitabha"; sincerity leads to spirituality, and they will surely fall asleep listening to the sound of their own chanting. Those who suffer from insomnia should believe in some commonplace rules: for example, do not drink strong tea, coffee and other caffeinated drinks after dusk. I avoid such drinks from 3pm every day. If you persist and become a habit over the years, it will definitely help you sleep well. In addition to physical health problems, the biggest reason for frequent insomnia is that the brain is stimulated, and the nerve cells in the brain are working all the time. For example, drinking strong tea and coffee increases the caffeine in the brain, encountering happy or sad things, and the ups and downs of great joy and worry, all of which directly affect the brain and make it difficult to sleep peacefully. There are four verses in the "Heart Sutra": "The mind has no worries, no worries, no fear, stay away from disturbing dreams." It is really a "golden sentence" in the Buddhist scriptures; it is also the essence of the "Heart Sutra". If a person can achieve or cultivate to the state of "no worries", where there are no distracting thoughts in the mind, the brain nerves are calm and waveless, and the mind is calm and peaceful, then what will happen to insomnia? I have read the couplet quoted from the first couplet as the title of this article as follows: "There is nothing in the heart, the width of the bed is wide, there is dust in the eyes, and the three realms are narrow." If you can "have nothing in the mind", it is the same as the "mind is free from worries" in the Heart Sutra; don't take anything to heart, and throw all the trivial matters and thoughts into the sky. Lying on the bed, you will definitely feel that the bed is big, wide and comfortable, and you will soon be dreaming with ease. As long as you understand that there is nothing in the world and no one bothers you; as a human being, you must not seek troubles for yourself, let go of your attachments, and throw away everything, your heart will be at ease, without worries, and you will surely sleep as sweet as honey when you lie down on the bed. In daily life, work and rest times must be regular; the human biological clock runs extremely accurately, so do not disturb it. Jet lag during travel can cause insomnia, and the culprit is the human body's biological clock. Go to bed at the same time every night, and the bedroom should not be too bright or too dark. Drink half a glass of milk or eat two kiwi fruits before going to bed to help you sleep well. Don't let distracting thoughts linger in your mind. After going to bed, put all the day's affairs, unfinished work, especially interpersonal disputes and grudges behind. All big things can be left to be solved tomorrow. Firmly believe that there is no big deal in the world. If you laugh at everything, your mind will naturally be at peace. How can you suffer from insomnia? Never rely on sleeping pills. Once you become addicted, the harm to your liver will be endless. Just learn to be "mindless", cultivate "mindless" before going to bed, and throw away all the random thoughts and self-inflicted worries. Let go of everything, close your eyes, and enjoy sweet dreams as fragrant as honey, and sleep happily until dawn. On December 29, 2009, in Wuxiangzhai.

322b723aaf92b45f52356f5b77c5bdabbfbf0417.sourceText: 中国目前有逾四千贪官外逃 中高级干部增多 《人民日报》海外版 中国官员因经济犯罪外逃始于上世纪80年代末，分析诸多出逃事件，不难看出：聚敛财产?#28023;外安家?#36164;产转移?#25321;机出逃?#28382;留不归，是贪官外逃的一般步骤。 据中国社科院《中国惩治和预防腐败重大对策研究》课题组的资料估计，中国目前有4000多名官员境外在逃。中纪委称，近30年来，外逃贪官携走资金达500多亿美元，平均每人卷走近1亿元人民币。 从外逃人员的级别构成看，中高级领导干部特别是厅处级干部逐渐增多。外逃的贪官过去大多是级别较低的官员，而近年来级别较高的领导干部逐渐增加，如国家电力公司原总经理、正部级官员高严，海南省财税厅原厅长刘桂苏等。 从外逃人员的职业分布来看，金融系统工作人员、国有企业负责人，尤其是大中型国有企业的负责人所占比重较大。据有关方面统计，这些人占了携款外逃总人数的70%以上。 反腐专家介绍，目前案值大、官位高的贪官外逃的”乐土”往往集中在美国、澳大利亚、加拿大等移民国家，在这些国家甚至已经形成了具有中国特色的”贪官一条街”、”腐败子女村”。此外，中美洲一些国家和太平洋岛国，也被一些贪官看成是庇护所。而一些小贪官则逃亡在周边国家，如泰国、越南、缅甸、菲律宾、蒙古和俄罗斯等。 2010年初，中纪委、监察部与中组部、公安部、司法部、外交部等17个部门建立了防范违纪违法公职人员外逃工作协调机制部际联席会议制度，形成了抓反腐倡廉建设的工作合力。 中纪委副书记吴玉良近日表示，中国政府高度重视腐败分子外逃的问题，大力开展境外的追逃和追赃工作。近几年已经通过引渡、遣返和司法协助、警务合作等国际执法合作的方式，将一批逃往国外的腐败分子缉拿归案。 与此同时，他还介绍防逃网络正在逐步建立，特别是针对近年来出现的腐败分子利用外国投资移民政策获取身份、转移赃款等问题加强了防范工作。 吴玉良表示，下一步将建立健全国家工作人员出入境登记备案和证件集中保管的制度；加强资金监测，严厉打击地下钱庄等非法金融活动；加强国际执法合作，将腐败分子缉捕归案。 中国政法大学教授莫世健近日表示，赖昌星案以其涉案金额和层级已经成为外逃经济犯案件的风向标。赖昌星最终被遣返，具有象征性影响。这不仅将宣告那些外逃经济犯即使套上”政治犯”的外衣，也不能逃过司法审判，而且赖昌星外逃十多年最终仍被遣返的下场，就是告诉那些准备外逃的贪官”此路不通”。
322b723aaf92b45f52356f5b77c5bdabbfbf0417.translatedText: Currently, more than 4,000 corrupt officials have fled China, and the number of mid-level and senior cadres is increasing. "People's Daily" Overseas Edition The flight of Chinese officials due to economic crimes began in the late 1980s. Analyzing many flight incidents, it is not difficult to see that amassing property? According to estimates from the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences' "Research on Major Countermeasures to Punish and Prevent Corruption in China", there are currently more than 4,000 officials in China who are at large abroad. The Central Commission for Discipline Inspection said that in the past 30 years, corrupt officials who have fled abroad have taken away more than 50 billion US dollars, with an average of nearly 100 million yuan per person. Judging from the level composition of the fleeing people, the number of middle- and senior-level leading cadres, especially department-level cadres, is gradually increasing. Most of the corrupt officials who fled used to be lower-ranking officials, but in recent years there has been a gradual increase in the number of higher-ranking leading cadres, such as Gao Yan, the former general manager of the State Power Company and a ministerial official, and Liu Guisu, the former director of the Hainan Provincial Department of Finance and Taxation. Judging from the occupational distribution of the expatriates, financial system staff and heads of state-owned enterprises, especially those of large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises, account for a larger proportion. According to relevant statistics, these people account for more than 70% of the total number of people who fled with money. According to anti-corruption experts, the current "promised lands" for corrupt officials with high case scores and high official positions to flee are often concentrated in immigration countries such as the United States, Australia, and Canada. In these countries, "corrupt official streets" and "corrupt children's villages" with Chinese characteristics have even been formed. In addition, some Central American countries and Pacific island countries are also regarded as havens by some corrupt officials. Some petty corrupt officials have fled to neighboring countries, such as Thailand, Vietnam, Myanmar, Philippines, Mongolia and Russia. In early 2010, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, the Ministry of Supervision, and 17 departments including the Central Organization Department, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Justice, and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs established an inter-ministerial joint meeting system for the coordination mechanism to prevent the flight of public officials who violate disciplines and laws, forming a joint effort to fight corruption and promote integrity. Wu Yuliang, deputy secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, recently stated that the Chinese government attaches great importance to the issue of the flight of corrupt elements and vigorously carries out overseas pursuits and recovery of stolen goods. In recent years, a number of corrupt elements who fled abroad have been arrested and brought to justice through extradition, repatriation, judicial assistance, police cooperation and other international law enforcement cooperation methods. At the same time, he also introduced that an anti-escape network is being gradually established, especially in response to the problems that have emerged in recent years such as corrupt elements using foreign investment immigration policies to obtain identities and transfer stolen money. Wu Yuliang said that the next step will be to establish and improve the system for entry and exit registration and centralized custody of documents for national staff; strengthen fund monitoring and severely crack down on illegal financial activities such as underground banks; strengthen international law enforcement cooperation and arrest corrupt elements. Mo Shijian, a professor at the China University of Political Science and Law, said recently that the Lai Changxing case has become a benchmark for cases of fugitive economic criminals due to the amount and level involved. Lai Changxing was eventually repatriated, which had a symbolic impact. This will not only declare that those fleeing economic prisoners will not be able to escape justice even if they are disguised as "political prisoners," but the fact that Lai Changxing was eventually deported after more than ten years of fleeing is to tell corrupt officials who are preparing to flee that "this road is not possible."

8bc6419c196e3c260edfbf6851ebd1141f730a2a.sourceText: 薄案腥风血雨 怕被牵连 大陆掀起黑金“逃亡潮”
8bc6419c196e3c260edfbf6851ebd1141f730a2a.translatedText: The Bo case is a bloody one, and for fear of being implicated, the mainland has set off a "fleeing wave" of black money

39a6240d27ad7c53b4d8be0ef00738b08e886345.sourceText: 薄案腥风血雨 怕被牵连 大陆掀起黑金“逃亡潮” 中共18大临近加上前重庆市委书记薄熙来案被揭发后，外传掀起…
39a6240d27ad7c53b4d8be0ef00738b08e886345.translatedText: The Bo case has been a bloody one, and for fear of being implicated, the mainland has set off a "fleeing wave" of black money. With the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China approaching and the case of former Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Secretary Bo Xilai being exposed, rumors have set off...

3c0396c715793f41212072418477ef86f7d65efb.sourceText: 中共18大临近加上前重庆市委书记薄熙来案被揭发后，外传掀起大陆黑金「逃亡潮」，军中相关的秘密账户资金急欲逃出大陆，以免受薄案向上延烧牵连，而对岸的台湾成为了外逃资金最大目的地。
3c0396c715793f41212072418477ef86f7d65efb.translatedText: The 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China is approaching and the case of former Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Secretary Bo Xilai has been exposed. Rumors have set off a "fleeing wave" of mainland black money. Funds in secret accounts related to the military are eager to escape from the mainland to avoid being implicated in Bo's case. Taiwan has become the largest destination for escaped funds.

227cdfb83a7212d332d502cbdf1f84fa53588bf7.sourceText: 台湾「卓越杂志」双月刊在6月当期报导称，中共领导层在薄熙来案揭发后加强整肃军队。今年首季，中国对外国非金融类直接投资达160亿美元，比去年同期大幅急升九成五。
227cdfb83a7212d332d502cbdf1f84fa53588bf7.translatedText: Taiwan's "Excellence Magazine" bimonthly reported in the June issue that the CCP leadership stepped up its military purge after the Bo Xilai case was exposed. In the first quarter of this year, China's foreign non-financial direct investment reached US$16 billion, a sharp increase of 95% compared with the same period last year.

f403aba4d5daf5966cd3106a06e3a780a2abdfbd.sourceText: 大陆薄熙来下台事件腥风血雨，整肃余波所及，一股庞大看不见的秘密资金逃难潮，正持续安静地流出海外，指向台湾。
f403aba4d5daf5966cd3106a06e3a780a2abdfbd.translatedText: In the bloody aftermath of the Bo Xilai ouster in mainland China, and the aftermath of the purge, a huge invisible wave of secret funds continues to quietly flow out of overseas countries and is directed towards Taiwan.

1350fc26fe50f27950526998b5cce3dd1d6a37fe.sourceText: 报导指出，大陆资金外逃台湾多透过台商担任中间人，经地下金融渠道汇款，在台湾购买豪宅等物业洗钱，又或伪装成外资向台政府申请投资。有台商表示，近日接获28亿元新台币(约9346万美元)的洗钱任务，买了数家上市公司及房地产，未来仍有数宗。
1350fc26fe50f27950526998b5cce3dd1d6a37fe.translatedText: Reports pointed out that mainland funds fleeing Taiwan mostly use Taiwanese businessmen as intermediaries, remit money through underground financial channels, launder money by purchasing luxury homes and other properties in Taiwan, or apply to the Taiwan government for investment disguised as foreign capital. A Taiwanese businessman said that he recently received a money laundering task of NT$2.8 billion (approximately US$93.46 million) and purchased several listed companies and real estate, and there will be several more cases in the future.

76c5aaf50d05f54bed9afceea07a9cf44d056b4b.sourceText: 报导又指，部分逃出大陆的资金可能先经第三地，再流入台湾，透过台商及大陆个人游等结汇，以及地下汇款渠道，回流大陆，形成国际黑钱逆流。
76c5aaf50d05f54bed9afceea07a9cf44d056b4b.translatedText: The report also pointed out that some of the funds escaping from the mainland may first pass through a third place, then flow into Taiwan, and then return to the mainland through foreign exchange settlement by Taiwanese businessmen and mainland individual tourists, as well as underground remittance channels, forming a countercurrent of international black money.

1745bf750fb8800b5ee682f5a822d87aebed87ee.sourceText: 据报导，某台商数年前曾协助中资来台投资置产，最近循同一管道，又接获安排新台币28亿元的任务，于是他买了几家上市公司及房地产，不着痕迹。他说，后面还有好几笔，在大陆领导人习近平全面接班前，得干净利落地安排好。
1745bf750fb8800b5ee682f5a822d87aebed87ee.translatedText: According to reports, a Taiwanese businessman helped Chinese investors to invest in Taiwan a few years ago. Recently, through the same channel, he received the task of arranging NT$2.8 billion, so he bought several listed companies and real estate without leaving any trace. He said that there are several more transactions to come, which must be neatly arranged before mainland leader Xi Jinping fully takes over.

7ca7c6c891074d00f77c986a7495ffc8b1125a09.sourceText: 台商担任中资「藏钱」的白手套及人头，多半很低调，警觉性极高，看中下手的标的其实并不张扬，化整为零，以免引起注意，更不会是市场注意的明星对象。
7ca7c6c891074d00f77c986a7495ffc8b1125a09.translatedText: >Taiwanese businessmen serve as white gloves and heads for Chinese-funded "money hiding". Most of them are very low-key and extremely alert. The targets they fancy are actually not public, and are broken into parts to avoid attracting attention, let alone being a star target of the market's attention.

c97758188705d201c57cd0d6a15aeae4131a6c80.sourceText: 报导指，今年第一季，中国对外国非金融类直接投资达160亿美元，比去年同期大幅上涨了95%，透露大陆资金外逃讯号。熟悉大陆人士指出，薄熙来的斗争事件愈演愈烈，第二波、第三波往上发展到他的总靠山江泽民系统，军系相关的秘密账户急欲逃出大陆。
c97758188705d201c57cd0d6a15aeae4131a6c80.translatedText: Reports indicate that in the first quarter of this year, China’s foreign non-financial direct investment reached US$16 billion, a sharp increase of 95% over the same period last year, revealing a signal of capital flight from the mainland. People familiar with the mainland pointed out that Bo Xilai's struggles have intensified. The second and third waves have developed into the system of his total backer Jiang Zemin, and secret accounts related to the military are eager to escape from the mainland.

20790aae107c88beb379c324fe3e2779b4791a3c.sourceText: 报导指，中南海政治斗争形成的金钱暗流，台湾，不失为方便权宜的选择，因为两岸商务往来频繁，台商往往可以扮演白手套及安排此间人头等工作，加上地下金融管道畅通，透过所谓的「地汇」，只要在大陆交付人民币，扣掉黑市的汇差及利息，就可以在台湾取得新币，甚至不需要绕道第三国。
20790aae107c88beb379c324fe3e2779b4791a3c.translatedText: Reports indicate that due to the financial undercurrent caused by the political struggle in Zhongnanhai, Taiwan is a convenient and expedient choice. Due to the frequent business exchanges between the two sides, Taiwanese businessmen can often play white gloves and arrange first-class work here. In addition, underground financial channels are smooth. Through the so-called "local exchange", as long as the RMB is delivered in the mainland and the black market exchange difference and interest are deducted, the new currency can be obtained in Taiwan without even detouring to a third country.

319927f1ea7ba388e7ab51b06a2a10946a0347e6.translatedText: How Women Live a Wonderful Life

e4cd298e921ca594ff95c085cfc1f7a8659dfed4.sourceText: 女人如何活的精彩 （亚省时报） 一个女人可以生得不漂亮，但是一定要活得漂亮。无论什么时候，渊博的知识、良好…
e4cd298e921ca594ff95c085cfc1f7a8659dfed4.translatedText: How Women Live a Wonderful Life (Alberta Times) A ​​woman may not be beautiful, but she must live a beautiful life. No matter when, profound knowledge, good...

241363b49d7b925fe414594cf27f981c31e394c8.sourceText: 一个女人可以生得不漂亮，但是一定要活得漂亮。 无论什么时候，渊博的知识、良好的修养、优雅的谈吐以及一颗充满爱的心灵，一定可以让一个人活得足够漂亮。 活得漂亮，就是活出一种精神、一种品位、一份至真至性的精彩。 一个人只要不自弃，相信没有谁可以阻碍你进步。 每一种创伤，都是另一种成熟。 我现在，唯一拿的起放不下的是筷子，唯一陷进去出不来的是被窝。 。 。 所有的人都想停留在山顶，但所有的乐趣和成长发生在往上爬的过程中。 我不要太依赖你，因为依赖，所以期望，因为期望，所以失望。 一女生跟男朋友分手了，旁边她同学安慰她：”那男的有什么好，土木工程的，一听就知道又’土’又’木’的！’旁边软件工程的男同学一听， 心都凉了半截… 李开复和乔布斯都喜欢说一句话－follow your heart。 翻译成中文就是－怂。 当朋友忽略你时，不要伤心，每个人都有自己的生活，谁都不可能一直陪你。 当一只玻璃杯中装满牛奶的时候，人们会说”这是牛奶”；当改装菜油的时候，人们会说”这是菜油”。 只有当杯子空置时，人们才看到杯子，说”这是一只杯子”。 同样，当我们心中装满成见、财富、权势的时候，就已经不是自己了​​；人往往热衷拥有很多，却往往难以真正的拥有自己。
241363b49d7b925fe414594cf27f981c31e394c8.translatedText: >A woman may not be beautiful, but she must live a beautiful life. No matter when, profound knowledge, good cultivation, elegant conversation and a heart full of love can definitely make a person live a beautiful life. To live beautifully is to live with a spirit, a taste, and a truly wonderful life. As long as you don't give up on yourself, I believe no one can hinder your progress. Every trauma is another kind of maturity. Now, the only thing I can't pick up and put down is my chopsticks, and the only thing I can't get out of is my bed. . . Everyone wants to stay at the top of the mountain, but all the fun and growth happens on the way up. I don’t want to rely too much on you. Because of dependence, I expect, and because of expectations, I am disappointed. A girl broke up with her boyfriend. Her classmate next to her comforted her: "What's so good about that guy? He's in civil engineering. You can tell he's both earthy and wooden!" When the male software engineering classmate next to him heard this, his heart dropped... Kaifu Lee and Steve Jobs both like to say a word - follow your heart. Translated into Chinese it means - coward. Don't be sad when a friend ignores you. Everyone has their own life, and no one can stay with you all the time. When a glass is filled with milk, people will say "this is milk"; when it is replaced with vegetable oil, people will say "this is vegetable oil". Only when the glass is empty, people will see the glass and say "this is a cup". Similarly, when our hearts are filled with prejudice, wealth and power, we are no longer ourselves; people often like to have a lot, but it is often difficult to truly own themselves.

f3518ea062c6094cacc72ff2d81e2fb417caaa7a.sourceText: 令人倦怠的华语电影节

b989d37588cc1532e1b41fe396d81ec3d52ab7ea.sourceText: 令人倦怠的华语电影节 【多维新闻】第15届上海国际电影节落幕，华灯熄灭，观众退场，记者们也疲倦地打包踏上回…
b989d37588cc1532e1b41fe396d81ec3d52ab7ea.translatedText: The Tiring Chinese Film Festival [Multi-dimensional News] The 15th Shanghai International Film Festival has come to an end, the lights have gone out, the audience has left the venue, and the reporters have packed their bags and headed back tiredly...

8529197aa93492cae95909d0c501dd6a7aeb3b6b.sourceText: 【多维新闻】第15届上海国际电影节落幕，华灯熄灭，观众退场，记者们也疲倦地打包踏上回程。这倦怠不是因为体力消耗，而是来自心底的深沉困惑：人们办国际电影节的底气是什么，是上海，是中国电影，或是中国的电影市场？
8529197aa93492cae95909d0c501dd6a7aeb3b6b.translatedText: > [Multi-dimensional News] The 15th Shanghai International Film Festival has come to an end, the lights have gone out, the audience has left the venue, and the reporters have also packed their bags and headed back tiredly. This fatigue is not due to physical exertion, but from the deep confusion in my heart: What is the basis for people to hold international film festivals? Is it Shanghai, Chinese films, or the Chinese film market?

1a976abf2a930555ee59154527f73cf28b10adbf.sourceText: 这样的情绪，缘自于一些基本的数据。上半年，80多部国产片的票房仅占三成；截止到6月，华语片中的票房头把交椅，竟然还是《大魔术师》。中国电影市场对好莱坞政策才刚开放一点（增加进口片配额和分账），本土电影就一败涂地，毫无招架之力。《杀生》导演管虎在论坛上预感大事不妙：”2012年是危机的一年，我可能失去从业资格”。这位导演最近拍了一部据他说是非常商业的电影《痞子，戏子和厨子》，以挽救”从业资格”。
1a976abf2a930555ee59154527f73cf28b10adbf.translatedText: Such a sentiment comes from some basic data. In the first half of the year, more than 80 domestic films accounted for only 30% of the box office; as of June, the top box office among Chinese films was still "The Magician". The Chinese film market has just opened up its policies to Hollywood (increased import film quotas and split accounts), but local films have failed miserably and are unable to resist. "Killing" director Guan Hu had a premonition that something bad was going to happen at the forum: "2012 is a year of crisis, and I may lose my qualifications to work." The director recently made a film that he said was very commercial, "The Ruffian, the Actor and the Cook" in order to save his "professional qualifications."

31f090f52ba069fc7cea1ae20a156739e238f237.sourceText: 另一方面，华语电影海外市场频亮红灯，《赤壁》《投名状》《唐山大地震》《金陵十三钗》，用今年的评委、对好莱坞市场烂熟的著名制片人张家振的话总结，就是”垮掉了”。对此，业内人士很着急，在电影节上展开讨论，如何讲故事给世界听？这个论题透着卑微，让人不自觉地要反问：为何要讲给世界听，不如先讲给自己听吧。
31f090f52ba069fc7cea1ae20a156739e238f237.translatedText: On the other hand, the overseas market of Chinese-language films has been in red light frequently, such as "Red Cliff", "Reporter", "Tangshan Earthquake" and "Jinling Thirteen Hairpins". In the words of this year's judge Zhang Jiazhen, a famous producer who is familiar with the Hollywood market, they are "broken". In this regard, people in the industry are very anxious and start discussions at film festivals. How to tell stories to the world? This topic is so humble that it makes people unconsciously ask: Why should we tell the world about it? Why not tell it to yourself first?

988bf4ac240f712012c06bb92680b49ab9bfb9c3.sourceText: 与此同时，华语片在国际电影节上再无斩获（自家门前办的电影节除外），王小帅、顾长卫、王全安、娄桦这些年均铩羽而归。而贾樟柯已具导师范儿，办公司做新导演项目，签演员先签自己的老婆，忙得不亦乐乎。自己的电影《在清朝》好几年了，一直没个准信。贾导透露出的口风，似乎是不让拍。所以贾导今年大力呼唤分级，批判审查。他和陆川惺惺相惜，后者的《王的盛宴》万事俱备，始终等不到上映的东风。
988bf4ac240f712012c06bb92680b49ab9bfb9c3.translatedText: At the same time, Chinese-language films have no success in international film festivals (except for the film festivals held in front of their own homes). Wang Xiaoshuai, Gu Changwei, Wang Quanan, and Lou Hua have all failed in recent years. And Jia Zhangke has already become a mentor. He is running a company and working on new director projects. He signs actors first before signing his wife. He is very busy. It's been several years since my movie "In the Qing Dynasty" was released, but I still haven't been able to get it right. Director Jia seemed to be refusing to allow filming. Therefore, Director Jia vigorously called for classification and critical review this year. He and Lu Chuan cherished each other. The latter's "The King's Feast" had everything ready but could not wait for its release.

90f1e2584d3ba077f733ada9637caa76c877f01b.sourceText: 严苛而且限制多多的审查制诚然束缚创造力，可是，审查真的是万恶之源？冯小刚可不这么认为，他反问：如果把审查都取消了，也不让一部好莱坞进来，咱们的电影是不是都能大卖？评委张家振则评价：上半年的国产电影，我没看到一部是好的。至于审查，伊朗的审查制度严苛程度不亚于我们，今年的亚洲新人奖评委会主席、伊朗著名导演阿米尔 纳得瑞（作品有《追火车的街童》和《水》《风》《沙》）笑说，过去的伊朗电影，不可以拍女人，不可以拍恋爱，更别提床戏了。所以大家都去拍儿童片。于是，伊朗有了《小鞋子》、《追火车的街童》，有能力的人总能用不同的方式表达。至于金爵奖影片《熊》，是一部细腻的伦理片，绝对是审查框框内的作品。不知道这是否会令自诩怀才不遇的导演们脸稍稍红一下？
90f1e2584d3ba077f733ada9637caa76c877f01b.translatedText: Strict and restrictive censorship does indeed constrain creativity, but is censorship really the root of all evil? Feng Xiaogang didn't think so. He asked: If we cancel all censorship and don't let a Hollywood film come in, will all our movies be successful? Judge Zhang Jiazhen commented: I didn’t see any good domestic movies in the first half of the year. As for censorship, Iran's censorship system is no less stringent than ours. The chairman of this year's Asian Newcomer Award jury and the famous Iranian director Amir Naderi (whose works include "Street Chasing the Train", "Water", "Wind" and "Sand") laughed and said that in the past, Iranian films were not allowed to shoot women, love, let alone sex scenes. So everyone goes to make children’s films. As a result, Iran has "Little Shoes" and "Street Boy Chasing a Train". People with ability can always express themselves in different ways. As for the Golden Goblet Award-winning film "The Bear", it is a delicate ethical film that definitely falls within the censorship framework. I wonder if this will make directors who think they have unappreciated talents blush a little?

eac51def578b8b4cc8761a38fa62efb19ecdc5f8.sourceText: 拍片似乎有了进步，几年前的《木乃伊3》，中方只负责提供拍摄场地和后勤，现在的《环形使者》《云图》《钢铁侠3》，已开始介入投资和发行环节。不过，金爵评委会主席让雅克阿诺一语中的：合拍片的目的，只有一个棗赚钱。好莱坞看中的，不过是你有钱，以及你的市场够大。你不可能主导剧情创意，中方投资会给电影带来点中国元素，比如有一部合拍片说的是：为了抵抗外星怪兽进攻，秦始皇建了万里长城。
eac51def578b8b4cc8761a38fa62efb19ecdc5f8.translatedText: Filmmaking seems to have made progress. For "The Mummy 3" a few years ago, China was only responsible for providing the shooting location and logistics. Now for "Looper", "Cloud Atlas" and "Iron Man 3", China has begun to intervene in the investment and distribution links. However, Jean-Jacques Annaud, chairman of the Golden Goblet jury, hit the nail on the head: the purpose of a co-production is to make money. What Hollywood only cares about is that you have money and your market is big enough. You can't dominate the plot creativity. Chinese investment will bring some Chinese elements to the movie. For example, there is a co-production that says: In order to resist the attack of alien monsters, Qin Shihuang built the Great Wall.
