6b3e51bf8a988c2a1207a667cd880c53fa4a909f.sourceText: 唐孝先： 回忆筹办坦佩中文学校 中国大陆实行改革开放后，赴美国的留学人员、各类移民，逐年增多，给亚利桑那州大凤凰城地区华人社区增添了新生力量。 上世纪九十年代中期，我和庞邦成、季良俊二位先生谈起，鉴于来自江苏的人士较多，能否成立江苏同乡会，开展联谊活动，他们十分赞同。于是亚利桑那州第一个新移民组织江苏同乡会(Association of Jiangsu Provincials)于1994年正式成立，同时产生第一届理事会，由庞邦成（会长）、季良俊（副会长）、唐晓宣（唐孝先，秘书长）、于小光、蒋新民、成燕、曹艺等七人组成。 江苏同乡会在州政府注册为非营利组织。在第一次理事会上，一致认为我们要为华人同胞做好事、办实事。成燕等提出，来自大陆的留学生子女，已到学龄时期，急需一所教汉语拼音、普通话、简体汉字的中文学校，让孩子们从小就有学习中文的机会。理事会决议筹办中文学校，推派我具体负责。季良俊提议，学校取名坦佩中文学校(Tempe Chinese School)，因为那时州立大学留学生及家属，绝大多数住在坦佩，大家同意。 当时白手起家、从无到有，面临四大难题、一个未知数；即上课场所、经费、师资、教材，有多少学生会来报名。我与坦佩市政府联系，找到坦佩公共图书馆旁边免费提供社区活动的场所Edna Vihel Activity Center。我就去接洽，定好开学典礼的会场，谈妥借用教室一学期。每周六上午上课，但有几次教室已有安排，只得临时去州立大学MU里找教室上课。 那时的留学生，几乎都要勤工俭学，收入有限，所以坦佩中文学校开办第一学期，每位学生的学费仅收二十美元。 我们在华人超市中国面厂的布告栏里贴上招聘中文学校教师的广告，有位从上海来探亲的郭素行女士应聘，庞邦成和我登门拜访后，决定聘请郭老师为学校第一位教师。 江苏同乡会筹办中文学校过程中，也得到亚利桑那州立大学中国学生学者联谊会的大力支持。有位来自台湾的热心人士张方济先生，找到当时联谊会会长丁宗豪先生，表示希望办大陆背景的中文学校，并能提供教材。丁先生很快把张先生介绍给我们，我们欢迎他的参与。 我到各个公寓群体去走访中国大陆留学人员，了解他们子女的情况，记下电话号码。一共约二、三十个孩子会来入学。 经过大半年的筹备，1995年秋天一个星期六，坦佩中文学校在Edna Vihel Activity Center的一间Community Room举行开学典礼，我担任校长。 参加开学典礼的，除了学校师生、家长、江苏同乡会会员、州立大学同学外，关心学校的社区人士也来热情祝贺、慷慨捐款。 简短的开学典礼一结束，郭老师就给孩子们上课。 本地中文报纸都有坦佩中文学校成立的报道。国内刊物《江海侨声》（现名《华人时刊》）1995年第11期上，刊登《美国亚利桑那州诞生一所中文学校》一文，作者署名唐晓宣。 不久郭老师探亲期结束，返回上海；同时学生人数增加，要分班上课，又聘请陆平老师、李航老师等来校任教。 中华人民共和国駐洛杉矶总领事馆，曾派理事前来学校看望师生、家长，并拨出赞助款。 在借用这个活动中心免费教室上课期间，我不止一次收到中心负责人的信件，抱怨有些家长大声说话，部分学生秩序较差，影响别人。我及时与大家沟通，提请注意。然而有些习惯难以改掉，很遗憾，学期结束前我收到Edna Vihel Activity Center书面通知，由于上述原因，拒绝下学期把教室继续借给坦佩中文学校使用。 寒假期间，我们在坦佩College与Alameda两条路的交叉处西南角的University Presbyterian Church，借到星期六空置的主日学教室，寒假后在此继续上课，但要缴低廉的租金。 坦佩中文学校建校之初，江苏同乡会理事会代行学校董事会职能。随着学校不断扩大，情况不断变化，需要有以家长代表为主体的管理机构，来决定学校的办学方向、选用教材、课程设置等具体问题。因此，江苏同乡会顺应形势，结束学校的管理，我也告别师生、家长，离开学校，由陈普先生出任坦佩中文学校第二任校长。 坦佩中文学校现已改名为希望中文学校。 Email: wm-tang@hotmail.com
6b3e51bf8a988c2a1207a667cd880c53fa4a909f.translatedText: Tang Xiaoxian: Recalling the preparations for the establishment of the Tempe Chinese School. After mainland China implemented reform and opening up, the number of overseas students and immigrants in the United States increased year by year, adding new strength to the Chinese community in the greater Phoenix area of ​​Arizona. In the mid-1990s, I talked with Mr. Pang Bangcheng and Mr. Ji Liangjun about the possibility of establishing a Jiangsu hometown association to carry out social activities, given that there are many people from Jiangsu. They were very in favor of it. As a result, the Association of Jiangsu Provincials, the first new immigrant organization in Arizona, was formally established in 1994. At the same time, the first board of directors was formed, consisting of seven people including Pang Bangcheng (president), Ji Liangjun (vice president), Tang Xiaoxuan (Tang Xiaoxian, secretary-general), Yu Xiaoguang, Jiang Xinmin, Cheng Yan, and Cao Yi. The Jiangsu Association is registered as a non-profit organization with the state government. At the first council meeting, it was unanimously agreed that we should do good things and do practical things for the Chinese compatriots. Cheng Yan and others pointed out that the children of international students from mainland China who have reached school age are in urgent need of a Chinese school that teaches Chinese pinyin, Mandarin, and simplified Chinese characters, so that the children can have the opportunity to learn Chinese from an early age. The board of directors decided to establish a Chinese school and appointed me to be responsible for it. Ji Liangjun proposed that the school be named Tempe Chinese School because at that time, most of the international students and their families at the state university lived in Tempe, and everyone agreed. At that time, we started from scratch and faced four major problems and one unknown: namely, class venues, funding, teachers, teaching materials, and how many students would sign up. I contacted the City of Tempe and found the Edna Vihel Activity Center, which offers free community events next to the Tempe Public Library. I went to contact him, decided on the venue for the opening ceremony, and agreed to borrow the classroom for one semester. Classes are held every Saturday morning, but there are several times when the classroom has been arranged, so I have to find a classroom at the state university MU temporarily. At that time, almost all international students had to work-study and had limited income. Therefore, in the first semester of the Tempe Chinese School, the tuition fee for each student was only twenty US dollars. We posted an advertisement for Chinese school teachers on the bulletin board of the Chinese Noodle Factory in the Chinese Supermarket. Ms. Guo Suxing, who was visiting relatives from Shanghai, applied for the job. After Pang Bangcheng and I visited, we decided to hire Teacher Guo as the first teacher of the school. In the process of organizing the Chinese school, the Jiangsu Association also received strong support from the Chinese Students and Scholars Association of Arizona State University. An enthusiastic person from Taiwan, Mr. Zhang Fangji, approached Mr. Ding Zonghao, the president of the association at that time, and expressed his hope to open a Chinese school with a mainland background and provide teaching materials. Mr. Ding quickly introduced Mr. Zhang to us and we welcome his participation. I went to various apartment groups to interview people studying abroad in mainland China, to learn about their children and write down their phone numbers. A total of about 20 to 30 children will come to school. After more than half a year of preparations, on a Saturday in the fall of 1995, the Tempe Chinese School held its opening ceremony in a Community Room of the Edna Vihel Activity Center. I served as the principal. In addition to teachers and students, parents, Jiangsu Association members, and state university students, people from the community who care about the school also came to warmly congratulate and make generous donations. As soon as the brief opening ceremony ended, Teacher Guo taught the children. Local Chinese newspapers have reported on the establishment of Tempe Chinese School. The domestic publication "Jianghai Overseas Chinese" (now known as "Chinese Times") published the article "The birth of a Chinese school in Arizona, USA" in the 11th issue in 1995. The author was signed by Tang Xiaoxuan. Soon, Teacher Guo's family visit period ended and he returned to Shanghai. At the same time, the number of students increased, and classes were divided into classes. Teachers Lu Ping and Li Hang were also hired to teach at the school. The Consulate General of the People's Republic of China in Los Angeles once sent directors to the school to visit teachers, students and parents, and allocated sponsorship funds. While I was using the free classroom in this activity center to attend classes, I received letters from the person in charge of the center more than once, complaining that some parents spoke loudly and some students were in poor order, which affected others. I communicated with everyone in a timely manner to draw your attention. However, some habits are hard to break. Unfortunately, before the end of the semester, I received a written notice from the Edna Vihel Activity Center. Due to the above reasons, I refused to lend the classroom to the Tempe Chinese School next semester. During the winter vacation, we borrowed a vacant Sunday school classroom on Saturdays at the University Presbyterian Church at the southwest corner of the intersection of College and Alameda roads in Tempe. We continued classes here after the winter vacation, but we had to pay a low rent. When Tempe Chinese School was founded, the Jiangsu Association Council acted as the school board of directors. As the school continues to expand and the situation continues to change, a management organization with parent representatives as the main body is needed to determine the school's direction, textbook selection, curriculum and other specific issues. Therefore, the Jiangsu Association complied with the situation and ended the management of the school. I also said goodbye to the teachers, students, and parents, and left the school. Mr. Chen Pu became the second principal of Tempe Chinese School. Tempe Chinese School has now been renamed Hope Chinese School. Email: wm-tang@hotmail.com

0f20c99bb8c8d2ed5d5b7acfb4378235964d4f9c.sourceText: 婚后的女性，身兼数职，肩上也有责任，更要珍爱自己。 婚后女性在筹划家事的时候，爱老公、爱家人是自然的事情，也不能把自己给忘了。 珍惜自己也是珍爱家庭。 一、懂得求大同，存小异的女性 婚后，个性不同的两个人生活在一起，生活习惯、脾气性格、爱好爱好会有所不同。 假如过于挑剔，非得把对方改变得符合自己的标准，很可能令对方产生不满和反感：我就是这样子，改改改，那还是我自己吗大事求同，小事存异，那才是明智 的。 二、经济相对独立的女性 假如以为嫁了个老公就由由然确当起少奶奶，好吃懒做；或是堂而皇之的把老公当成自己的长期免费饭票，这样的思想很危险。 一旦经济上完全依靠于老公，婚姻就轻易变味。 一个女性可以赚钱不太多，但也得能够自食其力。 即使要考虑做个全职妈妈也得三思，尽管我们知道全职妈妈的付出实在不少，但是由于没有实际的经济收进而让功劳显得苍白。 除非老公全力支持、或是家底殷实、或是由于其它原因实在没有办法，切勿轻易辞往工​​作。 全职太太的日子过得久了，由于自己没有收进，难免有些底气不足。 即便老公不会看低，自己偶然的忐忑不安也会尾随而来。 三、对自己依然保持自信的女性 自信的女性，本身就是一种魅力。 假如自己都不能认可自己，有怎叫别人认同自信不仅仅建立在外表上，还需要内涵、修养、品德的映衬。 举止优雅的女性比漂亮的女性更有韵味，温文尔雅的女性比泼辣干烈的女性更能让人接受。 提升自己的修养，也许是每个婚后女性不能停止的一门作业​​。 四、懂得爱人，同时也爱自己的女性 婚后的女性，身兼数职，肩上也有责任，更要珍爱自己。 婚后女性在筹划家事的时候，爱老公、爱家人是自然的事情，也不能把自己给忘了。 珍惜自己，实在也是珍爱家庭。 女性在一个家庭中的重要性是勿容置疑的，假如把女性比做一个掌舵的人，一点儿也不为过。 前方的人在奋力划桨，后方的人在坚定把舵，才能协力把这小船顺利驶向目的地。 五、大事不糊涂，小事不计较的女性 一个家，总有一摊子事。 大事要讲原则，不糊涂，鸡毛蒜皮的小事最好不要太计较，太挑剔。 假如经常由于无关痛痒的事情导致夫妻之间发生口角，久而久之感情不仅不能升温，还可能导致爱情消失，亲情冷却。 假如抱怨和唠叨常在耳边回响，又如何能快乐起来呢。 六、具有一定的持家才能的女性 要经营好自己的家庭，没有一定的持家才识就会觉得力不从心。 女性要学会成为一个恰到好处的”管家”。 家庭如何​​良性稳步发展，女性往往发挥着很重要的作用。 夫妻双剑合壁是完美的配合，这样的情形只能回于上天的造化；但是夫妻间的取长补短，似乎就轻易得多。 婚后的女性，不仅要在治家的方法上，学习一些东西，让自己能开心快乐、游刃有余地处理家庭方方面面的事情，避免焦头烂额，心力憔悴。 七、能依然保持自己的爱好的女性 女性婚后要依然能保持自我，切不可沦为家庭的牺牲品。 假如除了家庭、老公、孩子，没有自己的时间爱好、爱好，娱乐等等，那么稍微来自家庭的一些微小的不如意，就极轻易感到失落、郁闷。 婚后女性应当保持自己的一两样爱好，空闲的时候有一个独立的心灵花园，现实生活中有一个属于自己的朋友空间。 拥有快乐婚姻的女性，不一定是很聪明的女性。 但是以稀里糊涂的心态度日的女性，幸福快乐只会离自己更远。
0f20c99bb8c8d2ed5d5b7acfb4378235964d4f9c.translatedText: Married women hold many jobs and have responsibilities on their shoulders, and they must cherish themselves. When a married woman is planning family affairs, it is natural to love her husband and family, and she should not forget herself. Cherish yourself and cherish your family. 1. Women who know how to seek common ground while reserving minor differences. After marriage, two people with different personalities live together, and their living habits, temperaments, and hobbies will be different. If you are too picky and insist on changing the other person to meet your own standards, it is likely to make the other person dissatisfied and resentful: This is how I am, if I change it, will I still be myself? It is wise to seek common ground on big things and leave differences on small things. 2. Women who are relatively financially independent. If you think that after you marry a husband, you can just become a young mistress and be too lazy to do anything; or if you openly regard your husband as your long-term free meal ticket, this kind of thinking is very dangerous. Once you are completely financially dependent on your husband, your marriage will easily turn sour. A woman can not make much money, but she must be able to support herself. Even if you want to consider being a stay-at-home mother, you have to think twice. Although we know that stay-at-home mothers pay a lot, the lack of actual financial income makes the credit pale. Unless your husband fully supports you, or your family is well-off, or you have no choice due to other reasons, do not quit your job easily. The life of a full-time housewife has been going on for a long time. Since I have no income, I inevitably feel a little lack of confidence. Even if your husband doesn't look down on you, your occasional uneasiness will follow. 3. Women who remain confident in themselves. A confident woman is a kind of charm in itself. If you can't recognize yourself, how can you get others to recognize you? Confidence is not only based on appearance, but also requires connotation, cultivation, and moral character. Women with elegant manners are more charming than beautiful women, and gentle women are more acceptable than aggressive women. Improving one's self-cultivation may be a task that every woman cannot stop after marriage. 4. Women who know how to love others and also love themselves. Women after marriage have multiple jobs and responsibilities on their shoulders, and they must cherish themselves. When a married woman is planning family affairs, it is natural to love her husband and family, and she should not forget herself. Cherishing yourself is actually also cherishing your family. The importance of women in a family is unquestionable. It is not an exaggeration to compare a woman to a person at the helm. The people in front are rowing hard, and the people behind are holding the rudder firmly. Only by working together can the boat sail smoothly to the destination. 5. Women who don’t care about big things and don’t care about small things. There is always something going on in a family. You should be principled and not confused about big things. It is best not to be too fussy or picky about trivial things. If quarrels between husband and wife often occur due to insignificant things, not only will the relationship fail to heat up over time, but it may also lead to the disappearance of love and the cooling of family affection. How can we be happy if complaints and nagging are always echoing in our ears. 6. Women with certain housekeeping talents. If they want to run their own families well, they will feel powerless without certain housekeeping talents. Women must learn to be a proper "housekeeper". How a family develops healthily and steadily, women often play a very important role. The two swords of a husband and wife are a perfect match, and such a situation can only be attributed to God's good fortune; but it seems much easier for a husband and wife to learn from each other's strengths and offset their weaknesses. Married women should not only learn some things about how to run a family, so that they can be happy and handle all aspects of family affairs with ease, and avoid being overwhelmed and exhausted. 7. Women who can still maintain their own hobbies Women must still maintain themselves after marriage and must not become victims of the family. If you don’t have your own time, hobbies, entertainment, etc. besides your family, husband, and children, then you will easily feel lost and depressed due to some minor dissatisfaction from your family. After marriage, women should maintain one or two hobbies of their own, have an independent spiritual garden in their free time, and have their own space for friends in real life. Women who are happily married are not necessarily very smart women. But women who approach life with a confused attitude will only be farther away from themselves.

e415f315684bc744704aeb38cf32517fe4b780df.sourceText: 美绿卡申请审理时间被批不实 移民局更新查询系统
e415f315684bc744704aeb38cf32517fe4b780df.translatedText: The U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Service updated the query system

ac25848067e90a6834d9d1cb85564a8574347a16.sourceText: 美绿卡申请审理时间被批不实 移民局更新查询系统 中新网3月23日电 据美国《世界日报》报道，美联邦国土安全…
ac25848067e90a6834d9d1cb85564a8574347a16.translatedText: The U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Bureau updated the query system. The U.S. Immigration Bureau updated the query system. China News Service, March 23. According to the U.S. "World Journal", the U.S. federal homeland security...

e925c73e6d44cb2fd1f83bef03ed80f0d1642da0.sourceText: 中新网3月23日电 据美国《世界日报》报道，美联邦国土安全部督察长办公室(Office of Inspector General)上周公布调研报告，指美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)在其网站上公布的绿卡审理时间不实，对移民申请者毫无帮助。对此，移民局22日更新了查询网站，致力让绿卡申请审理时间查询能更准确。
e925c73e6d44cb2fd1f83bef03ed80f0d1642da0.translatedText: China News Service, March 23. According to the U.S. "World Journal", the U.S. Department of Homeland Security's Office of Inspector General (Office of Inspector) General) released a research report last week, saying that the green card processing time published by the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) on its website is inaccurate and does not help immigration applicants. In this regard, the Immigration Bureau updated the inquiry website on the 22nd, striving to make the green card application processing time inquiry more accurate.

04aa7bad894de39195801d988a0a5fd2336a1cda.sourceText: 国土安全部督察长办公室上周的报告指出，USCIS通过其网站公布的各区域办公室(field offices)对各类别绿卡的审理时间不实，其显示的时间跟各区域办公室实际处理所需的时间并不相符，完全无法让申请者从中获知绿卡申请所需的时间。
04aa7bad894de39195801d988a0a5fd2336a1cda.translatedText: A report from the Office of the Inspector General of the Department of Homeland Security last week pointed out that the USCIS processing time for each category of green cards published by each field office through its website is inaccurate. The time displayed is not consistent with the actual processing time required by each field office, and it is completely unable to allow applicants to understand the time required for green card applications.

cfdff0e575545280d507022575b709424b6b7968.sourceText: 报告发现，从2011财年开始，绿卡申请平均所需时间，早已比USCIS设立的120天时限超出两倍有余。譬如截至2017年5月，2017财年USCIS绿卡审理平均时间为282天，超出其所设时限两倍多。
cfdff0e575545280d507022575b709424b6b7968.translatedText: The report found that since fiscal year 2011, the average time required for green card applications has been more than twice the 120-day time limit established by USCIS. For example, as of May 2017, the average USCIS green card processing time in fiscal year 2017 was 282 days, more than twice the time limit set by USCIS.

2d6f5f61cb063b32c4aa3b4550e43165a9eeb710.sourceText: 作为回应，USCIS于22日更新了查询网站，新网站将采用一种新型自动计算方法计算绿卡和移民审理时间。该计算方法仍处于测试阶段，目前可计算四类表格的审理时间：N-400入籍申请表格、I-90申请更换绿卡表格、I-485申请绿卡表格、I-751申请去除条件性绿卡的表格。
2d6f5f61cb063b32c4aa3b4550e43165a9eeb710.translatedText: In response, USCIS updated the query website on the 22nd. The new website will use a new automatic calculation method to calculate the green card and immigration processing time. This calculation method is still in the testing stage and can currently calculate the processing time for four types of forms: N-400 naturalization application form, I-90 application form for replacement of green card, I-485 application form for green card, and I-751 application form for removal of conditional green card.

aae03b356ea100d5c2ea7c87ddde030f02e3d23b.sourceText: USCIS表示，新网站将更准确反映申请者查询审理大致所需时间。若一份申请表的审理时间大大超过正常所需时间，申请者就可以联系USCIS询问。查询上述四类表格的审理时间时，新网站将采用一种新的自动计算方法。
aae03b356ea100d5c2ea7c87ddde030f02e3d23b.translatedText: USCIS stated that the new website will more accurately reflect the approximate time required for applicants to inquire and process. If the processing time of an application form is much longer than the normal time, the applicant can contact USCIS to inquire. When querying the processing time of the above four types of forms, the new website will use a new automatic calculation method.

bc22993f8a850b3c16d4cbc82c47f8fd6319a8fc.sourceText: 新算法将时间范围的最小单位缩小至两周，而旧算法的最小时间单位则为六周。新网站显示的审理时间从USCIS收到申请之日算起，审理时间范围的低端为移民局审完50%递件所需时间，高端则为审完93%递件所需时间。
bc22993f8a850b3c16d4cbc82c47f8fd6319a8fc.translatedText: >The new algorithm reduces the minimum time unit of the time range to two weeks, while the minimum time unit of the old algorithm is six weeks. The processing time displayed on the new website is calculated from the date USCIS receives the application. The low end of the processing time range is the time it takes for the USCIS to review 50% of the submission, and the high end is the time it takes for 93% of the submission to be reviewed.

463ea99311424081ceabae08d2757bf061bb27b4.sourceText: 中国大陆应无惧多党制 佳叔 西方美英国家最讲民主，着重人权，但美英未及履行民主人权，他们的警察随时开枪殴人等事。籍着911防恐对边境出入人不人道歧视，以治乱世用重典法监狱严刑新加坡亦讲民主人权。但新加坡都不尊重民主人权，他们对人民掷烟蒂或涂鸦都受到苔刑，也籍着世纪立的国安法，随时拘捕可疑人士无限期监禁。相反的对着民主人权状况已有所改善的中国大陆，视而不见，夸大其事，每次拘捕一名异议份子或驱散一群民众，却被欧美人士拿出民主人权来评击。 由于近年全球经过西方民主人权大风大浪吹袭，世界很多国家都遍地开花，如埃及叙利亚的反霸权；泰国，菲律宾的反贪污；台湾和香港的反无能，民众群集上街呐喊。如果政府真的霸权贪污或无能，上街抗议，情有可原，但只是全意发牢骚的党争，那是件遗憾的事。 中国大陆因为维持一党制，没有在野政党对抗，没有上街游行权利，每次民众受屈与警察冲突，都是官说官话。因此常被西方人士误指没有民主人权。中国大陆政府为表达西方对政府的信心和维护政府的民主人权又何惧开放政党，容纳有识人士，共同鞭策，促进国家繁荣？ 新加坡世纪的安定繁荣，全凭李光耀总理的雅量，他能容忍异己人士，不似中国人气量狭窄，不容许他人高强，而”恶其能而不能用，嫉其才而致死”的劣性。李光耀比蒋介石还要反共，蒋介石不容半个共产党人，异己人士，结局如何？但李光耀不排共，还容纳共产党人，异己人士。所谓知己知彼，使人心服口服。英国统治香港100年，全是善用以华制华策略。日本也效法利用汪精卫伪政府，控制中国半边山河，若不是两颗原子弹，恐怕中国现在不知变成怎样呢？
463ea99311424081ceabae08d2757bf061bb27b4.translatedText: Mainland China should not be afraid of the multi-party system. Uncle Jia The United States and the United Kingdom in the West are the most democratic and emphasizing human rights. However, the United States and the United Kingdom fail to implement democracy and human rights. Their police shoot and beat people at any time. By using 911 to prevent terrorism, they inhumanely discriminate against people entering and leaving the border, and use heavy laws, prisons and torture to control troubled times. Singapore also advocates democracy and human rights. However, Singapore does not respect democracy and human rights. People who throw cigarette butts or graffiti are punished with mosses. They also use the national security law established in the century to arrest suspicious persons at any time and imprison them indefinitely. On the contrary, mainland China, where the situation of democracy and human rights has improved, turns a blind eye and exaggerates the situation. Every time a dissident is arrested or a group of people are dispersed, European and American people criticize democracy and human rights. As the world has been hit hard by Western democracy and human rights in recent years, many countries around the world have begun to protest against hegemony, such as Egypt and Syria's anti-hegemony; Thailand and the Philippines' anti-corruption; Taiwan and Hong Kong's anti-incompetence, and people have taken to the streets to shout. If the government is really hegemonic, corrupt or incompetent, taking to the streets to protest is understandable, but it is a pity if it is just a partisan fight full of complaints. Because Mainland China maintains a one-party system, there is no confrontation between opposition parties and no right to march on the streets. Every time people feel aggrieved and clash with the police, it is all official talk. Therefore, people in the West often mistakenly say that there is no democracy and human rights. In order to express the West's confidence in the government and safeguard the government's democratic and human rights, why is the Chinese mainland government afraid of opening up political parties, accommodating knowledgeable people, and jointly promoting national prosperity? Singapore's century-long stability and prosperity are all due to Prime Minister Lee Kuan Yew's magnanimity. He can tolerate dissidents, unlike the Chinese who are narrow-minded and do not tolerate others' superiority. They "hate their abilities and fail to use them, and they hate their talents to death." Lee Kuan Yew was even more anti-communist than Chiang Kai-shek. Chiang Kai-shek would not tolerate even half a communist or any dissident. What would be the outcome? However, Lee Kuan Yew did not exclude communists, but also tolerated communists and dissidents. The so-called knowing yourself and the enemy makes people convinced. The British have ruled Hong Kong for 100 years, and they have always made good use of the strategy of using China to control China. Japan also followed Wang Jingwei's puppet government and controlled half of China's mountains and rivers. If it hadn't been for the two atomic bombs, what would China have become now?

860a263fefc2cfbf6e727887f410c17b447fbdd3.sourceText: 沙漠明珠 | 美国亚利桑那州华人历史（十五） 凤凰城华人餐馆历史
860a263fefc2cfbf6e727887f410c17b447fbdd3.translatedText: Pearl of the Desert | History of Chinese in Arizona, USA (15) History of Chinese restaurants in Phoenix

d733e38f36bdf45b680e0002131c05ae22394f5c.sourceText: 1.最早的“美国厨房”（American Kitchen） 1900年，在凤凰城（Phoenix）的唐人街已有…
d733e38f36bdf45b680e0002131c05ae22394f5c.translatedText: 1. The earliest "American Kitchen" (American Kitchen) In 1900, there was already...

97897425b98ad4e4da11af1d4520347c451602e7.translatedText: 1. The earliest "American Kitchen" in Chinatown in Phoenix (Phoenix) Kitchen)

a9456876734c26572f3be2e3449833e43e035d8f.sourceText: 1900年，在凤凰城（Phoenix）的唐人街已有三间中式、英式、法式的餐厅皆为华人所经营。“美国厨房”（American Kitchen）地址在31-33 North Center Street 。餐馆最早的东主是“Tom Yu”, 留有一张1904年的照片。继承者是余康中（Sing Yee）。余康中学贯中英，经营有方，与当时的政商关係良好，不少初到埠的宗亲被收留工作或得其帮助，是斐匿余氏家族的开埠功臣。“美国厨房”几十年来是主流社会的热门餐厅. 一直在“第一唐人街”中存在，成为极少数未被迫迁到其它地方的餐馆，经营至1951年1月5日才歇业。
a9456876734c26572f3be2e3449833e43e035d8f.translatedText: In 1900, there were already three Chinese, British, and French restaurants in Chinatown in Phoenix, all operated by Chinese. "American Kitchen" is located at 31-33 North Center Street. The earliest proprietor of the restaurant was "Tom Yu", and there is a photo from 1904. The successor is Sing Yee. Yukang Middle School was proficient in Chinese and English, well-run, and had good political and business relations at the time. Many clan members who had just arrived in the port were taken in to work or received help from them. They were the Fei Ni Yu family's heroes in the opening of the port. "American Kitchen" has been a popular restaurant in mainstream society for decades. It has always existed in "First Chinatown" and became one of the few restaurants that was not forced to move to other places. It did not close until January 5, 1951.

2279bbe36246b7f32195169e859d5bc8fe419a04.sourceText: 到1920年代，凤凰城有三间受欢迎的餐厅：”文华咖啡厅(Mandarin Café)、”北京咖啡厅”(Peking Café)和”金龍餐館”(Gold Dragon)。
2279bbe36246b7f32195169e859d5bc8fe419a04.translatedText: By the 1920s, Phoenix had three popular restaurants: the Mandarin Café, the Peking Café and the Gold Dragon.

ada3e2c19a92ee79beaac1046ca13482a30ffff1.sourceText: 1928年，＂上海楼＂(SingHigh)开业, 东主是余沐新 (英文姓名＂Kai Y. Lee＂)。上海楼提供传统的＂杂碎”餐, 在美国主流社会响誉四方。这间在旧唐人街繁华地段开业的中餐馆，曾经有过两次搬迁。餐馆名号后来改为＂上海杂碎楼＂(Sing High Chop Suey House), 所提供的杂碎餐已传世三代，广受食客欢迎。很多美国人和其他族裔从上海楼品尝到”正宗杂碎”后，继而热爱上中国菜。餐馆从开业直到2019年售出为止，已经运营有90年的历史。
ada3e2c19a92ee79beaac1046ca13482a30ffff1.translatedText: In 1928, "SingHigh" (SingHigh) opened. The proprietor was Yu Muxin (English name "Kai Y. Lee"). SingHigh provided traditional "chop suey" meals. Well-known in mainstream society in the United States, this Chinese restaurant opened in a prosperous area of ​​old Chinatown. The restaurant's name was later changed to "Sing High Chop Suey House". The chop suey meals provided have been passed down for three generations and are popular among diners. Many Americans and other ethnic groups fell in love with Chinese food after tasting the "authentic chop suey" from Shanghai House. The restaurant had a history of 90 years from its opening until it was sold in 2019.

6d1bcf51851029ba2460e5aec78767dcd9da8e4a.sourceText: 到了1940年代，凤凰城（Phoenix）多间华人餐厅被记录在资料中, 包括有金光咖啡厅(Golden Shine Café), 中国茶园(China Tea Garden), 小屋咖啡厅(Hut Sut Café)和饭碗(Rice Bowl)等等。
6d1bcf51851029ba2460e5aec78767dcd9da8e4a.translatedText: In the 1940s, many Chinese restaurants in Phoenix were recorded, including the Golden Shine. Café), China Tea Garden, Hut Sut Café and Rice Bowl, etc.

f7cbe1b78f2a3fa0fbaffd458fd5eb53101a336d.sourceText: 黄氏餐馆在早期是间民宅建筑，建于1926年。地址在1141 East Buckeye Road 。
f7cbe1b78f2a3fa0fbaffd458fd5eb53101a336d.translatedText: WONG’S CHINESE DINING was originally a private building and was built in 1926. .

f8d86404968ffa5eb6e39dc6d738f141a418bd20.sourceText: 1941年，这座民宅被华人邓侨隆（Kew Lung Tang）买下。邓氏于 1927 年从中国广东移民到凤凰城。1942 年，他的房屋旁边加盖了一间杂货店，取名为” K.L. Grocery＂。
f8d86404968ffa5eb6e39dc6d738f141a418bd20.translatedText: In 1941, this house was bought by Kew Lung Tang, a Chinese who immigrated to Phoenix from Guangdong, China in 1942. In 1942, he built a grocery store next to his house and named it "K.L. Grocery".

908a68a528df41fdf286939775444aea9125f0c9.sourceText: 在搜集历史资料中，最常碰到的问题，是很多老侨只有英文姓名而缺少中文姓名，亦因华裔二代多不识中文，很多时只知道祖父辈姓名的四邑话读音，而没有准确中文的姓名。所以很多时候要从历史资料积累中才能找到答案，或用译音代替。这位“邓侨隆”之所以能够得到他的中文名字，是因为联系到了他的儿子邓贺铮，他提供了其父亲在某文件中用毛笔签名而得到确认。
908a68a528df41fdf286939775444aea9125f0c9.translatedText: When collecting historical data, the most common problem encountered is that many overseas Chinese only have English names but lack Chinese names. Also, because most second-generation Chinese do not know Chinese, they often only know the Siyi pronunciation of their grandparents' names, but not their Chinese names. Accurate Chinese name. Therefore, the answer often needs to be found from the accumulation of historical data, or replaced by transliteration. The reason why this "Deng Qiaolong" was able to get his Chinese name was because he contacted his son Deng Hezheng, who provided his father's signature with a brush on a document for confirmation.

9e26699006fe2b00d212f4f3a0d737b104f0a49d.sourceText: 二战后，中国杂货商面临着来自新超市的日益激烈的竞争。邓氏杂货店于1964年改为“邓氏筷子餐馆“（Tang’s Chop Stick Restaurant），并经营了四十多年。直到1985年，住宅连餐馆卖给了华人Chung Lan and Mee Ling Wong（中文译音：钟南和黄梅玲），餐馆改名为“黄氏中餐馆”（ Wong’s Chinese Dining）。这间餐馆后来由其他华人接手，并继续运营至今。
9e26699006fe2b00d212f4f3a0d737b104f0a49d.translatedText: After World War II, Chinese grocers faced increasing competition from new supermarkets. Tang’s Grocery Store was renamed Tang’s Chop Stick Restaurant in 1964 and operated for more than 40 years. Until 1985, the residence and restaurant were sold to Chinese Chung Lan and Mee Ling Wong (Chinese transliteration: Zhong Nan and Huang Meiling), and the restaurant was renamed "Wong’s Chinese Dining". The restaurant was later taken over by other Chinese and continues to operate today.

8c7be5a6dd1e15ea4c8f63ddb4ac3d151a694632.sourceText: 这座历史建筑已有95年的历史，在凤凰城属于华人早期的住宅/杂货店 /餐馆的混合型建筑，有特别的代表性，被列入了“凤凰城历史遗产名录”（Listed on Phoenix Historic Property Register ）。这也是凤凰城第一间列入历史遗产名录的中餐馆。
8c7be5a6dd1e15ea4c8f63ddb4ac3d151a694632.translatedText: This historical building has a history of 95 years. It is an early Chinese residential/grocery/restaurant mixed building in Phoenix. It is particularly representative and is listed on the "Phoenix Historic Property Register". It is also Phoenix's first heritage-listed Chinese restaurant.

51610367648881fef36ccea7989d03392149fd03.sourceText: 餐馆东主关崇琼（D.H. Toy）是凤凰城历史上最成功的华商之一。香格里拉餐厅有450人座位，碗碟专门在洛杉矶订做。客人大多是美国人, 也是中国家庭所喜爱的地方，除了婚礼和喜庆，宗亲社团也常在崇琼楼设宴，这是当年凤凰城最风光的中餐馆。
51610367648881fef36ccea7989d03392149fd03.translatedText: Restaurant owner D.H. Toy is one of the most successful Chinese businessmen in the history of Phoenix. The Shangri-La restaurant has seating for 450 people, and the dishes are specially made in Los Angeles. Most of the guests are Americans, and it is also a favorite place for Chinese families. In addition to weddings and celebrations, clan associations often hold banquets at Chongqiong House. It was the most popular Chinese restaurant in Phoenix at the time.

df0462f5dab0227d09eec95be7eeac40d98c5b1c.sourceText: 薪水高门槛低 护理工人成纽约华裔社区新移民就业热点

Finding a job is a top priority for new immigrants after coming to the United States, but due to the language barrier, there are no relevant jobs...

7dd9943e7745658e090be4ff8aff2a2f1e425eff.sourceText: 薪水高门槛低 护理工人成纽约华裔社区新移民就业热点 新移民来美后找工是头等大事，但由于语言不通，没有相关职业资格证书等问题让不少华裔移民望工作机会兴叹，哪种工作如今需求最高，门槛又相对较低呢？ 如今，纽约的独居老人越来越多，对护理工人的需求也就相对增长，而且护工的入职门坎低、工作稳定且薪水较高，成为新移民热捧的职业。 早些年，初来美的华裔新移民就职首选为餐馆或衣厂，而随着餐馆业收入不稳定且福利较差，制衣业迁离美国本土等原因，此类工作也逐渐不受新移民青睐。如今，在华埠有着数万耆老，他们日常所需的身体护理和保健对护工需求非常大。 在不少职介所，护工成了需求最旺的行业。华人新移民初来乍到，语言不通，没有职业资格证书，但只要报名缴纳数百元，参加为期2个星期的培训班，就可以拿到家庭护工资格证书，立刻就可以上岗就业。 康怡家庭护理亚裔市场总监黄雪莉介绍说，在纽约有着很多独居老人，在华埠尤甚，不少老人因为想要留在生活方便的华裔社区而拒绝搬到外州与子女同住，而对耆老的护理也包含在纽约州白卡的服务项目内，这就给讲中国话的新移民提供了很多机会。 联成公所顾问赵文笙表示，护工行业压力小，薪水福利较好，但相关的规定也十分严格。迟到，代工，通过照顾直系亲属骗工资，偷窃现象在华裔护工中并不少见，不少移民因触犯相关行业法规被辞退。 照顾耆老需要一对一的护理，这给很多新移民提供了工作机会，但如何严格遵守相关规定，做到规范执业，正规培训并提升职业道德也就显得十分重要。
7dd9943e7745658e090be4ff8aff2a2f1e425eff.translatedText: With high salary and low threshold, nursing workers have become an employment hotspot for new immigrants in the Chinese community of New York. Finding a job is the top priority for new immigrants after coming to the United States. However, due to language barriers and lack of relevant professional qualification certificates, many Chinese immigrants are disappointed when looking for job opportunities. Which kind of jobs are in the highest demand and have relatively low thresholds? Nowadays, as more and more elderly people live alone in New York, the demand for nursing workers has also increased. Moreover, nursing workers have low entry barriers, stable jobs and high salaries, making them a popular occupation for new immigrants. In the early years, new Chinese immigrants who first came to the United States preferred to find jobs in restaurants or garment factories. However, as the income in the restaurant industry is unstable and benefits are poor, and the garment industry has moved away from the United States, such jobs have gradually become less popular among new immigrants. Today, there are tens of thousands of senior citizens in Chinatown, and their daily physical care and health care needs are in great demand for caregivers. In many employment agencies, nursing workers have become the industry with the highest demand. New Chinese immigrants have just arrived, have language barriers, and do not have professional qualification certificates. However, as long as they sign up and pay a few hundred yuan and participate in a two-week training class, they can obtain a home care worker qualification certificate and start employment immediately. Shirley Huang, the Asian marketing director of Kornhill Home Care, said that there are many elderly people living alone in New York, especially in Chinatown. Many elderly people refuse to move out of state to live with their children because they want to stay in the convenient Chinese community. And care for the elderly is also included in the New York State White Card service items, which provides many opportunities for new immigrants who speak Chinese. Zhao Wensheng, a consultant at Liancheng Office, said that the nursing industry has low pressure and good salaries and benefits, but the relevant regulations are also very strict. Arriving late, doing work for others, defrauding wages by taking care of immediate family members, and stealing are not uncommon among Chinese caregivers. Many immigrants have been fired for violating relevant industry regulations. Taking care of the elderly requires one-to-one care, which provides job opportunities for many new immigrants. However, it is very important to strictly abide by relevant regulations, standardize practice, provide formal training and improve professional ethics.

3826b41c897be82bb5f6718d4a013aca51dfdd2e.translatedText: [Phoenix PEN] Aqi: Also talk about whether March 8 is 23 or 24 Phoenix City Aqi Wenruo talked about Professor Yu Dan’s report at a World Chinese Literature Conference on the Sunbird website...

0aaa12287df82c6a8549c028e5c93143517954a1.sourceText: 文若在太阳鸟网站谈及于丹教授在一次世界华文文学大会上的一个报告。报告中描述一个小溷溷在布店买布，非説三八等于二十三，一名小和尚路见不平，坚持三八等于二十四。于是小浑浑以脑袋、小和尚以帽子打赌。两人找到老和尚评理，结果老和尚判定三八二十三是正确的。她以这个故事向世人介绍这是中华文化的精华所在。我听到这个故事大概是二十多年前的事了，一位朋友曾神祕地攷过我这个买布的问题，主人公不是大和尚和小和尚，説的是孔夫子敎导颜回的故事。我听后觉得很有趣，也佩服孔老夫子确实高人一等，赞赏他处理问题的灵活性。他用三八应该是二十三的哲理保住了小溷溷的脑袋，而颜回只输掉了一个帽子。
0aaa12287df82c6a8549c028e5c93143517954a1.translatedText: Wenruo talked about Professor Yu Dan’s report at a World Chinese Literature Conference on the Sunbird website. The report describes a young boy buying cloth in a cloth shop, who insisted that 38 equals 23, but a young monk saw injustice and insisted that 38 equals 24. So Xiao Hunhun bet with his head and the little monk with his hat. The two found the old monk for comment, and the old monk concluded that 3823 was correct. She used this story to introduce to the world that this is the essence of Chinese culture. I heard this story probably more than 20 years ago. A friend once mysteriously asked me about the problem of buying cloth. The protagonists were not the big monk and the little monk. It was a story about Yan Hui who was taught by Confucius. I found it very interesting after listening to it, and I also admired that Master Kong was indeed superior to others, and appreciated his flexibility in handling problems. He used the philosophy that thirty-eight should be twenty-three to save Xiao Mingming's head, while Yan Hui only lost one hat.

5094f8bac8a775c04e0426bce889523942d4f82a.sourceText: 后来，我渐渐觉得不对。如果三八可以是廿三，世上还有没有真理？这是颠倒黑白溷淆是非。这个故事和当年四人帮支持交白卷英雄张铁生的思想何其相似。上世纪七十年代，一位名字叫张鉄生的青年，在参加全国高考理化课目时交了白卷，却说是因为忙于阶级斗争和生产队的工作，无暇复习功课，于是，四人帮肯定他的白卷是对旧教育制度的反叛，并冠之以白卷英雄而被特别彔取。按照这个处事逻辑，学生不用读书，工人不用做工，强盗抢劫了民财，若是为了家有生病的老母，法官就不应判他抢劫财物罪，而应为他立孝子牌坊。
5094f8bac8a775c04e0426bce889523942d4f82a.translatedText: Later, I gradually felt something was wrong. If thirty-eight can be twenty-three, is there any truth in the world? This is confusing right and wrong. This story is very similar to the Gang of Four’s thoughts in supporting Zhang Tiesheng, the hero who failed to win the test. In the 1970s, a young man named Zhang Tiesheng submitted a blank paper when he took the physics and chemistry subjects of the national college entrance examination, but he said that he was too busy with class struggle and work in the production team to review his homework. Therefore, the Gang of Four affirmed that his blank paper was a rebellion against the old education system, and dubbed him a white paper hero, so he was specially exploited. According to this logic, students do not need to study, workers do not need to work, and robbers have robbed people's property. If it is for the sake of a sick mother, the judge should not convict him of robbing property, but should build a filial memorial arch for him.

f6cc4093beccf0236bef0bda85dd994a15dab79d.sourceText: 三八是否廿三还是廿四的夲质区别还在于是法治还是人治。三八廿四是数学的基本定理，不能有任何违反。认定三八廿四就是法治。即一切按规矩办事，依法办事。我们常常觉得美国人办事太死板，脑袋转不过弯来。我们看到他们的法官宣判犯人数罪并罚入监一百四十年，超过生命极限，大感不解。我们看到美国联帮政府会关门，但人民生活工作照常。这都是法治的结果，反之，三八二十三就是人治。在这个故事中就是孔夫子说了算。封建时期皇上说了祘，没有了皇上谁大谁説了算。中国的反右派，送劳改，文化大革命斗走资派都是三八二十三的结果，是和尚打伞，无法无天。出现那么多贪污腐败份子也是三八廿三的思想使他们一步步䧟入泥潭，甚至发展到不管三七二十一的地步，把法律和道德准绳完全抛之脑后。
f6cc4093beccf0236bef0bda85dd994a15dab79d.translatedText: >The essential difference between whether March 8th is 23rd or 24th is the rule of law or the rule of man. 3824 is the basic theorem of mathematics and cannot be violated in any way. We believe that 3824 is the rule of law. That is, everything should be done according to the rules and the law. We often feel that Americans are too rigid in doing things and cannot turn their heads around. We were very puzzled when we saw their judges sentence the guilty to multiple crimes and send them to prison for 140 years, which is beyond the limit of life. We see that the federal government in the United States will shut down, but people's lives and work will continue as usual. These are all the results of the rule of law. On the contrary, 3823 is the rule of men. In this story it is Confucius who has the final say. In the feudal period, the emperor had the final say. Without the emperor, whoever is greater will have the final say. China's anti-rightists, sent to labor camps, and the Cultural Revolution's fight against the capitalist roaders were all the result of 3823. They were monks holding umbrellas and were lawless. The emergence of so many corrupt elements is due to their 3823 thinking, which has led them step by step into the quagmire, and even developed to the point where they don't care about 3721, completely forgetting the law and moral principles.

9ce643463b7604e58b051b9993c92e115c5afd60.sourceText: 总之，三八二十三的故事不是中华文化之精华，而是遗害中华民族数千年之糟粕。至于故事的真实性,只有待専家们去考証了。
9ce643463b7604e58b051b9993c92e115c5afd60.translatedText: In short, the story of 3823 is not the essence of Chinese culture, but the dross that has harmed the Chinese nation for thousands of years. As for the authenticity of the story, only experts can verify it.

6a638072c0ee347a94abe99dc63c84317bfee31b.sourceText: 苹果推出两款新手机后股价下跌
6a638072c0ee347a94abe99dc63c84317bfee31b.translatedText: Apple's stock price fell after launching two new mobile phones

71a57458514342a7bca1e40aad0a7c52b601af93.sourceText: 苹果推出两款新手机后股价下跌 BBC报道，在苹果公司同时推出两款新iPhone手机之后，公司的股票价格出现…
71a57458514342a7bca1e40aad0a7c52b601af93.translatedText: Apple's stock price fell after launching two new mobile phones The BBC reported that after Apple launched two new iPhone mobile phones at the same time, the company's stock price appeared...

929fb1ec5ba11441499c4d49477a97abe1832021.sourceText: 苹果在星期二（9月10日）推出最先进的iPhone5S和价格相对便宜的iPhone5C手机。但是，最基本的具有16GB存储量的iPhone5C手机售价740美元，在许多人看来仍然过于昂贵。 分析人士认为，投资者担心苹果最新推出的两款手机无法帮助其扩大在新兴市场的份额，因而导致公司股价下跌。
929fb1ec5ba11441499c4d49477a97abe1832021.translatedText: Apple launched the most advanced iPhone 5S and the relatively cheap iPhone 5C mobile phone on Tuesday (September 10). However, the most basic iPhone 5C phone with 16GB of storage costs $740, which is still too expensive in the eyes of many people. Analysts believe that investors are worried that Apple's latest two mobile phones will not help it expand its share in emerging markets, thus causing the company's stock price to fall.

63635c442a85669ffd995312de2ebef089e51666.sourceText: 星期三（9月11日），苹果收盘价格为每股467.7美元，下跌了5.4%。苹果公司目前感觉到，他们在试图扩大这些市场的行动中受到韩国三星和中国华为的严峻挑战。
63635c442a85669ffd995312de2ebef089e51666.translatedText: On Wednesday (September 11), Apple's closing price was $467.7 per share, down 5.4%. Apple currently feels it is being severely challenged by South Korea's Samsung and China's Huawei in its attempts to expand into these markets.

1b088a660166ccbd48b822deccb1e606b2435e2a.sourceText: 美国金融和投资咨询公司Janney Montgomery Scott首席投资战略师卢斯基尼（Mark Luschini）说，苹果为吸引新市场而给出的最新价位并不低，令投资者不满。
1b088a660166ccbd48b822deccb1e606b2435e2a.translatedText: Mark Luschini, chief investment strategist at Janney Montgomery Scott, an American financial and investment consulting firm, said that the latest price Apple offered to attract new markets was not low, which dissatisfied investors.

fc55c9e7f5e2a1137ae7952ce2a73dc23846841a.sourceText: 他特别指出，苹果产品的价格无法和竞争对手相比。苹果曾经用自己的iPhone产品在发达市场获得巨大成功，但是没有能够在中国和印度这类新兴市场复制这样的成功。
fc55c9e7f5e2a1137ae7952ce2a73dc23846841a.translatedText: He specifically pointed out that the prices of Apple products cannot be compared with those of competitors. Apple has achieved great success in developed markets with its iPhone products, but has not been able to replicate such success in emerging markets such as China and India.

f8a3aac9ecc9a01ed9d7c21378c3ebc820ef4160.sourceText: 分析人士说，苹果产品价格较高仅仅是造成上述结果的原因之一，另一个重要的原因是，在这些新兴经济国家，电话运营商往往不愿意对手机本身做出补贴。
f8a3aac9ecc9a01ed9d7c21378c3ebc820ef4160.translatedText: Analysts say that the higher prices of Apple products are only one of the reasons for the above results. Another important reason is that in these emerging economies, phone operators are often unwilling to subsidize the mobile phones themselves.

7ac0e18072efcf7c29ba624de0552533fd11b17d.sourceText: 在这种情况下，价格低廉的手机对消费者来说更合适。此前，许多人曾预测苹果将推出低端手机来吸引这些国家的消费者。
7ac0e18072efcf7c29ba624de0552533fd11b17d.translatedText: In this case, low-priced mobile phones are more suitable for consumers. Previously, many people had predicted that Apple would launch low-end mobile phones to attract consumers in these countries.

c4cc796791e6b436df1eac4025059aa9151872c9.sourceText: 但分析人士认为，iPhone5C的价格没有低到足以抓住全球商业机会的程度，也不能吸引那些不能得到电话运营商补贴的顾客。
c4cc796791e6b436df1eac4025059aa9151872c9.translatedText: But analysts believe that the price of iPhone 5C is not low enough to seize global business opportunities, nor can it attract customers who cannot get subsidies from phone operators.

0a07e9567c8f92b3d809b9e41e34d37046e42cb3.sourceText: 还有分析人士指出，现在苹果面临的问题是，他们是不是真的希望占据这些新兴市场，还是希望继续把自己定位在高端手机生产商的位置上。
0a07e9567c8f92b3d809b9e41e34d37046e42cb3.translatedText: Some analysts pointed out that the problem facing Apple now is whether they really want to occupy these emerging markets, or whether they hope to continue to position themselves as a high-end mobile phone manufacturer.

4ec8987afd14d8d1a2e328f55ba149ac465b7767.sourceText: 中国智能手机叫板”廉价”iPhone

e08230ea810973a6b8af0f9502d23e1a7c795ce2.sourceText: 《华尔街日报》报道，虽然三星电子(Samsung Electronics Co.)和苹果公司(Apple Inc.)瓜分了智能手机行业的大部分利润，但这两家公司的国际市场占有率却不断下滑，究其原因，就是中国等市场涌现出价格更低的替代品：中国的大量初创企业推出了售价只有苹果和三星手机一半的高配置手机。
e08230ea810973a6b8af0f9502d23e1a7c795ce2.translatedText: The Wall Street Journal reported that although Samsung Electronics Co. and Apple Inc.) has shared most of the profits in the smartphone industry, but the international market share of these two companies has continued to decline. The reason is that lower-priced alternatives have emerged in markets such as China: a large number of Chinese start-ups have launched high-configuration mobile phones that are half the price of Apple and Samsung phones.

cd2f99bc598f5fff432f930e895dbfc43a4def93.sourceText: 在香港深水埗的电子产品市场，随处可见可与苹果和三星手机相媲美的更低价智能手机。
cd2f99bc598f5fff432f930e895dbfc43a4def93.translatedText: In the electronics market in Sham Shui Po, Hong Kong, you can see cheaper smartphones that are comparable to Apple and Samsung mobile phones.

c011d8d27f78524726d38a636b740f0748544002.sourceText: 以中国生产的卓普小黑C2 (Zopo C2)手机为例。这款搭载安卓(Android)系统的智能手机拥有完整的高清屏幕，1,310万像素的摄像头以及高速图像处理器。而这样一款高配置手机的售价仅略高于300美元，与三星Galaxy S4和苹果iPhone超过600美元的裸机价格相比更具诱惑力。此外，小米公司(Xiaomi Inc.)新推出的小米3智能手机售价仅为人民币1,999元（约合327美元），而金立(Gionee)的Dream D1智能手机售价更是低至230美元。
c011d8d27f78524726d38a636b740f0748544002.translatedText: Take the Zopo C2 mobile phone produced in China as an example. This Android-powered smartphone has a full HD screen, a 13.1-megapixel camera and a high-speed image processor. The price of such a high-configuration mobile phone is only slightly more than 300 US dollars, which is more attractive than the bare metal prices of Samsung Galaxy S4 and Apple iPhone of more than 600 US dollars. In addition, Xiaomi Inc.'s newly launched Mi 3 smartphone is priced at only RMB 1,999 (approximately US$327), while Gionee's Dream D1 smartphone is priced as low as US$230.

0b93cd977ac2464f76fe81ddc9682a7a6475d77f.sourceText: 据研究机构Canalys提供的数据显示，目前三星电子在中国智能手机市场排名第一，市场占有率达到18%，而随着其他手机厂商实力的壮大，苹果公司的排名已经落至第七位，市场占有率仅为5%。
0b93cd977ac2464f76fe81ddc9682a7a6475d77f.translatedText: According to data provided by research organization Canalys, Samsung Electronics currently ranks first in China's smartphone market, with a market share of 18%. As other mobile phone manufacturers have grown in strength, Apple's ranking has fallen to seventh place, with a market share of only 5%.

943dbc61ba8d6e7b61e57747e96fd93255e83aff.sourceText: 苹果”低端”策略令人失望

ea9ae7a464f81f2de66dcfc700a08e4d60863711.sourceText: 《华尔街日报》报道，苹果公司股票周三遭到了投资者的惩罚，因投资者认为周二推出的新款iPhone系列并未引入一套新的低价策略。
ea9ae7a464f81f2de66dcfc700a08e4d60863711.translatedText: The Wall Street Journal reported that Apple's stock was punished by investors on Wednesday because investors believed that the new iPhone series launched on Tuesday did not introduce a new low-price strategy.

d8b7a90b79072a42d14e5659c260d6c621945f27.sourceText: 投资者的反应凸显出苹果面临的巨大挑战。长期以来苹果一直将自己的产品定位为奢侈品：以高端自居可能会限制公司的增长，尤其在发展中国家。但为迎合普通大众市场而降价的策略也会削弱公司的盈利能力，破坏一贯的公司形象。
d8b7a90b79072a42d14e5659c260d6c621945f27.translatedText: The investor reaction highlights the huge challenges facing Apple. Apple has long positioned its products as luxury goods: a premium look that could limit the company's growth, especially in developing countries. But the strategy of cutting prices to cater to the general mass market can also undermine a company's profitability and undermine its consistent corporate image.

811ce4c4af8e4b8a45742e34c6594a317773360d.sourceText: 与即将推出的高端iPhone 5S相比，苹果的iPhone 5C基本上是将去年机型换上一个新的塑料外壳，为消费者提供了一个低价选择。iPhone 5C备受争议，合约机最低价为99美元，裸机最低价549美元。
811ce4c4af8e4b8a45742e34c6594a317773360d.translatedText: Compared with the upcoming high-end iPhone 5S, Apple's iPhone 5C basically replaces last year's model with a new plastic shell, providing consumers with a lower-priced option. The iPhone 5C is controversial. The lowest price is US$99 for the contract model and US$549 for the bare model.

4bddb1cd89a1ff4e4cf17cefb73d1305d6b9a976.sourceText: 一些人认为，iPhone 5C的定价不够低，无法帮助苹果在与三星电子(Samsung Electronics Co.)和其他对手的竞争中取胜。三星电子等公司通过提供售价不到100美元的低价手机已经从苹果手中夺走了智能手机市场份额，在发展中国家和首次购买智能手机的消费人群中尤其受欢迎。
4bddb1cd89a1ff4e4cf17cefb73d1305d6b9a976.translatedText: Some believe the iPhone 5C is not priced low enough to help Apple compete with Samsung Electronics Co. and other rivals. Companies such as Samsung Electronics have taken smartphone market share away from Apple by offering low-priced handsets that cost less than $100 and are particularly popular among developing countries and first-time smartphone buyers.

99a4ca0f8514a4b59fa20c31ab9f7fef398b0109.sourceText: 在中国，大部分手机售价不到400美元，而iPhone 5C裸机价格要卖到733美元。第二季度苹果在中国的市场份额降至5%。
99a4ca0f8514a4b59fa20c31ab9f7fef398b0109.translatedText: In China, most mobile phones sell for less than US$400, while the bare iPhone 5C costs US$733. Apple's market share in China fell to 5% in the second quarter.

cb662a11e558824fa6955414940a1c9b3a7af35d.sourceText: 瑞士信贷(Credit Suisse)分析师Kulbinder Garcha在写给投资者的报告中称，市场上充斥着很多低端手机。
cb662a11e558824fa6955414940a1c9b3a7af35d.translatedText: Credit Suisse analyst Kulbinder Garcha said in a report to investors that the market is flooded with many low-end mobile phones.

e32c785783d54539c9fb778dd3b959f98fe3be34.sourceText: 至少有三位券商分析师在周三下调了苹果公司评级，都因为对新品感到失望。截至周二收盘，苹果股价较6月底上涨了25%，然而，股价仍较去年9月份高于700美元的纪录高点相去甚远。
e32c785783d54539c9fb778dd3b959f98fe3be34.translatedText: At least three brokerage analysts downgraded Apple on Wednesday, all because of disappointment with new products. As of Tuesday's close, Apple's stock price was up 25% from the end of June. However, the stock price is still far from its record high of more than $700 in September last year.

9776a3c71e6f0eccfa7d5bf2c75d072d0b0b7ce1.sourceText: 张柏芝经纪公司发声明：锋芝正式离婚
9776a3c71e6f0eccfa7d5bf2c75d072d0b0b7ce1.translatedText: Cecilia Cheung's agency issued a statement: Feng Zhi is officially divorced

810a371b5de189e49f160984132d074444a59f48.sourceText: 张柏芝经纪公司发声明：锋芝正式离婚 【多维新闻】张柏芝经纪公司新亚洲娱乐8月22日下午3点，对外发表锋芝夫妇的…
810a371b5de189e49f160984132d074444a59f48.translatedText: Cecilia Cheung's agency issued a statement: Feng Zhi is officially divorced [Multi-dimensional News] Cecilia Cheung's agency, New Asia Entertainment, released a divorce statement on August 22 at 3 pm on the couple's divorce...

260a9d519a31e801297f91ca9e5af3493b05e330.sourceText: 【多维新闻】张柏芝经纪公司新亚洲娱乐8月22日下午3点，对外发表锋芝夫妇的离婚声明，纷扰将近3月的锋芝婚变传闻终于尘埃落定。
260a9d519a31e801297f91ca9e5af3493b05e330.translatedText: [Multi-dimensional News] Cecilia Cheung's agency, New Asia Entertainment, released a divorce statement on August 22 at 3 pm on the couple's divorce. The rumors of Feng-Chi's marriage that had been turbulent for nearly three months have finally settled.

6a977527a2a563e65e75492782be5c13c0f4ceae.translatedText: Cecilia Cheung and Nicholas Tse divorce

0b2974edd6bce791e1ec49fcf9daeee2159be891.translatedText: The following is the original text of the statement:

5591a880ab635cb05c32ff8e7f00e25af5bea38f.sourceText: 本人张柏芝、谢霆锋正式宣布我们因性格不合而共同决定离婚。有关离婚事宜，我们已和平地达成协定。
5591a880ab635cb05c32ff8e7f00e25af5bea38f.translatedText: I, Cecilia Cheung and Nicholas Tse, officially announce that we have jointly decided to divorce due to personality differences. Regarding the divorce, we have reached an agreement peacefully.

5b834dbfbdba0bf4e21daafbe37b2dbc810e01b7.sourceText: 我们将共同管养我们的两个孩子，一切皆会以两小孩的幸福成长为主要考虑因素。
5b834dbfbdba0bf4e21daafbe37b2dbc810e01b7.translatedText: We will jointly manage our two children, and everything will take the happy growth of the two children as the main consideration.

795acf605c64ab1f1b3d184277a57e67869010d9.sourceText: 就近月有关传媒报导关于我们的离婚事宜，实质上与事实不符。 我们保留追究之权利，亦请大家不用再为此事作胡乱猜测。
795acf605c64ab1f1b3d184277a57e67869010d9.translatedText: Relevant media reports in recent months about our divorce are essentially inconsistent with the facts. We reserve the right to pursue the matter, and please do not make any wild guesses about this matter.

bb8448c740230c26169a586ee14e44114a158c2d.sourceText: 我们在此向各界对我们两人及家人的关心表示衷心感激，亦希望大家给予我们两人及家人尤其一对小孩宁静的生活空间，让其开心快乐成长。
bb8448c740230c26169a586ee14e44114a158c2d.translatedText: We would like to express our sincere gratitude to all walks of life for their concern for us and our families. We also hope that everyone will give us and our families, especially a pair of children, a peaceful living space so that they can grow up happily.

fc80952598b4fca7e6d00249968d7de4ed9c6f41.sourceText: 本声明以后，我们将不会就离婚事宜再作任何回应。
fc80952598b4fca7e6d00249968d7de4ed9c6f41.translatedText: After this statement, we will not make any further response on divorce matters.

f3c1ac324f3cdbdff7dac8e2400c5e2352ba8cac.sourceText: ”锋芝”拉锯三月 ”婚变”峰回路转
f3c1ac324f3cdbdff7dac8e2400c5e2352ba8cac.translatedText: "Feng Zhi" saw the tug of war in March The "marriage crisis" took a turn for the worse

7cf93bb29909784fc076378a22b24218a84bbec1.sourceText: 谢霆锋跟张柏芝自5月传出婚姻亮红灯，随即进入冷静期分居，拉锯三个月终达成共识，过程可谓峰回路转。
7cf93bb29909784fc076378a22b24218a84bbec1.translatedText: > Nicholas Tse and Cecilia Cheung reported that their marriage was in doubt in May, and then they entered a cooling-off period and separated. After three months of back and forth, they finally reached a consensus. The process was a turn of events.

282f9f9ba66f13851ffb1b52fbe30b497d8a7b98.sourceText: 召见律师。6月，正在吉隆坡拍戏的谢霆锋急召律师飞去当地见面，亲自向律师咨询法律意见后，已死心的他决定与张柏芝离婚，并透过律师向她发出离婚协议书，一刀两断。
282f9f9ba66f13851ffb1b52fbe30b497d8a7b98.translatedText: Summon a lawyer. In June, Nicholas Tse, who was filming in Kuala Lumpur, urgently summoned his lawyer to meet there. After consulting the lawyer in person for legal advice, he decided to divorce Cecilia Cheung and sent her a divorce agreement through his lawyer, making it a clean break.

aa574440bf1fa87d0cac43ecc6b47f421cdd4fed.sourceText: 发出声明。6月24日，谢霆锋发出声明：”本人经过再三的深思熟虑后，今日终于作了一个沉痛的决定，从今天起本人将着手处理家事。”
aa574440bf1fa87d0cac43ecc6b47f421cdd4fed.translatedText: issues a statement. On June 24, Nicholas Tse issued a statement: "After careful consideration, I finally made a painful decision today. From today on, I will start to deal with family matters."

601117ade32804aa3487bee3328f190acaaa61be.sourceText: 商讨细节：谢霆锋为了一对儿子能健康成长，意向共同拥有抚养权，于7月14日，谢霆锋召律师团队到其独居的柏舍密谈个半小时，解决抚养权和财产分配的问题。
601117ade32804aa3487bee3328f190acaaa61be.translatedText: Discussing details: Nicholas Tse intends to jointly have custody rights for the healthy growth of his two sons. On July 14, Nicholas Tse called a team of lawyers to the Baishe where he lives alone for half an hour to discuss custody and property distribution issues.

2076be60f24f22941dd4e01911b2794bf2b043e6.sourceText: 达成共识：8月1日，”锋芝”自婚变后第二度会面，据知，之前一直拖延不肯签纸离婚的张柏芝，终于妥协。8月18日，”锋芝”秘密返回香港继续谈判，达成共识。
2076be60f24f22941dd4e01911b2794bf2b043e6.translatedText: A consensus was reached: On August 1, "Fengzhi" met for the second time since their marriage. It is known that Cecilia Cheung, who had been delaying and refusing to sign the divorce papers, finally compromised. On August 18, "Fengzhi" secretly returned to Hong Kong to continue negotiations and reach a consensus.

d2457b3d61a156bfd287a233e2444f96e34dbc06.sourceText: 全美各地方政府进入招聘解冻期
d2457b3d61a156bfd287a233e2444f96e34dbc06.translatedText: Local governments across the United States have entered a hiring freeze period

0e185ceab839e8cb1c50be175d06d31e2e657307.sourceText: 全美各地方政府进入招聘解冻期 《华尔街日报》报道，美国各城市正在开始招聘新教师、消防员和警察。在经济衰退结…
0e185ceab839e8cb1c50be175d06d31e2e657307.translatedText: Local governments across the United States have entered a hiring freeze period. The Wall Street Journal reported that cities across the United States are beginning to recruit new teachers, firefighters and police officers. At the end of the recession...

71939096dc869a2567e695e5076d5e9b10f259a6.sourceText: 《华尔街日报》报道，美国各城市正在开始招聘新教师、消防员和警察。在经济衰退结束四年后，地方政府就业长期大幅下滑的状况似乎已经出现逆转。
71939096dc869a2567e695e5076d5e9b10f259a6.translatedText: The Wall Street Journal reported that cities across the United States are starting to recruit new teachers, firefighters and police officers. Four years after the recession ended, the long and sharp decline in local government employment appears to have reversed.

5d6db466c8806d035d4e57bb230d4ea521796fc2.sourceText: 在社区培训新警察之际，马萨诸塞州市政警察院校正在满负荷运营。与此同时，明尼阿波利斯最近新招聘了20多名消防员，结束了长达五年的招聘冻结期。内华达州包括拉斯维加斯的克拉克县的学区今年将招聘700名新教师，这是五年来的首次大规模招聘。
5d6db466c8806d035d4e57bb230d4ea521796fc2.translatedText: >The Massachusetts Municipal Police Academy is operating at full capacity as communities train new police officers. Meanwhile, Minneapolis recently hired more than 20 new firefighters, ending a five-year hiring freeze. Nevada's Clark County school district, which includes Las Vegas, will hire 700 new teachers this year, its first major hiring in five years.

b87397fab0975e8b794fb732116b9a5823a3daa0.sourceText: 美国劳工部(Labor Department)公布的月度就业数据显示，地方政府在过去八个月中有七个月新增员工，为五年来持续时间最长的一次。今年迄今，经季节因素调整后地方政府新增就业人数4.6万人。到6月份，地方政府就业人数为1,408万人，为逾一年半以来的最高水平，但仍远低于2008年中期1,461万人的峰值。地方政府员工数量占总体政府员工数量的65%。
b87397fab0975e8b794fb732116b9a5823a3daa0.translatedText: Monthly employment data released by the U.S. Labor Department showed that local governments added new employees in seven of the past eight months, the longest streak in five years. So far this year, seasonally adjusted local government employment has increased by 46,000. By June, local government employment stood at 14.08 million, the highest level in more than a year and a half but still well below the peak of 14.61 million in mid-2008. The number of local government employees accounts for 65% of the total number of government employees.

231ad6dad77fc1e89bbf3685bdd8b89a2855fe3b.sourceText: 在以前的经济复苏过程中，整个政府部门开始增加员工的时间要更早。即便是现在，由于预算被削减，且外界正在讨论公共部门适宜的员工规模问题，联邦机构和州政府也仍在裁员。
231ad6dad77fc1e89bbf3685bdd8b89a2855fe3b.translatedText: In previous economic recoveries, government agencies as a whole began adding staff earlier. Even now, federal agencies and state governments are cutting jobs as budgets are slashed and the appropriate size of the public sector workforce is debated.

3c5558dda1da9fc62c14107b8ac4ae332e87cd7a.sourceText: 从地方政府的情况看，税收收入增加、一些社区投票通过增税措施以及美国经济整体正在复苏的情况正在推动地方政府招聘新员工。
3c5558dda1da9fc62c14107b8ac4ae332e87cd7a.translatedText: From the perspective of local governments, increased tax revenue, some communities voting to pass tax increases, and the overall recovery of the U.S. economy are driving local governments to recruit new employees.

034055185a237d639088b5d2bce16489b070da82.sourceText: 西景高中(Westview High School)校长Mike Chamberlain说，情况有所好转。他将招聘五名新教师。这所学校位于俄勒冈州波特兰附近的比佛顿学区。该学区计划为下一学年增加150名教师。自2010年以来这里已经裁剪了17%的教师和其他有资质的教员。 地方政府通常可以在招聘方面获得更多公众支持，因为通过学校、公园和警察这些方面，他们与纳税人关系密切。但地方政府招聘的进一步增加可能面临许多阻力，因为一些市政当局还有仍未解决的财政挑战。
034055185a237d639088b5d2bce16489b070da82.translatedText: Westview High School Principal Mike Chamberlain said the situation has improved. He will hire five new teachers. This school is located in the Beaverton School District near Portland, Oregon. The district plans to add 150 teachers for the next school year. Since 2010, 17% of teachers and other qualified teaching staff have been laid off. Local governments can often get more public support for hiring because they have close relationships with taxpayers through schools, parks and police. But further increases in local government hiring may face many headwinds, as some municipalities have unresolved fiscal challenges.

b6a1dacd1aa670a6e9fe731771b56bcf9c4807c6.sourceText: 比如芝加哥，该市最近裁掉了2,100名教职工，因为其学区正在应对退休金系统存在大概80亿美元资金缺口的问题。各大城镇市政部门还面临不断增加的员工医疗成本和联邦支出削减问题。
b6a1dacd1aa670a6e9fe731771b56bcf9c4807c6.translatedText: Consider Chicago, which recently laid off 2,100 teachers and staff as its school district grapples with an estimated $8 billion shortfall in its pension system. Cities and municipalities also face rising employee health care costs and federal spending cuts.

6a786f3cd3deb5b8602027a342e959f23070276b.sourceText: 尽管在美国整体经济带动下一些市政当局的房产税收入有所回升，但是这并不是一个普遍现象，并且如果经济走软，还会面临风险。目前尚不清楚市政当局是否会重演繁荣与衰落的交替循环，这曾导致他们在经济衰退前税收增加之际扩大员工数量，然后在税收收入下降并且居民随之纷纷抵制进一步增税之际大幅裁员。
6a786f3cd3deb5b8602027a342e959f23070276b.translatedText: While some municipalities have seen a rebound in property tax revenue, driven by the overall U.S. economy, this is not a universal phenomenon and is at risk if the economy weakens. It's unclear whether municipalities will repeat the boom-and-bust cycle that led them to expand their staffs as tax revenues rose before the recession and then slash their staff as tax revenues fell and residents resisted further tax increases.

9e2ee00175ebfadb3a7bd97094b91d8738962c72.sourceText: 罗格斯大学(Rutgers University)经济与公共政策教授塞尼卡(Joseph Seneca)说，这些都是非常痛苦的决定，是否会成为持久的教训，仍有待观察。
9e2ee00175ebfadb3a7bd97094b91d8738962c72.translatedText: Joseph Seneca, a professor of economics and public policy at Rutgers University, said these are very painful decisions and it remains to be seen whether they will serve as lasting lessons.

16bb4e4d618ddda601abab30c0a1fb083d68818d.sourceText: 凤凰城不打算再重演这个循环。过去三年，这个有近150万人口的美国第六大城市的全职员工数量下降了6.7%。近几周，该市招聘了自2009年以来的首位新警察，但该市市政执行长卡瓦佐斯(David Cavazos)预计，即便房地产税收入反弹，市政当局就业人数将继续下降。他采取了一系列成本节约措施，比如让市民来做逮捕登记工作，以节省警察人手，还要求垃圾和回收在同一天进行。这些措施令该市每居民平均市政员工比例降至40年低点。
16bb4e4d618ddda601abab30c0a1fb083d68818d.translatedText: Phoenix has no intention of repeating this cycle. Over the past three years, the number of full-time employees in the nation's sixth-largest city of nearly 1.5 million people has fallen 6.7%. In recent weeks, the city has hired its first new police officer since 2009, but Chief Executive David Cavazos expects municipal employment to continue falling even as property tax revenue rebounds. He implemented a series of cost-saving measures, such as having citizens do arrest bookings to save police manpower and requiring trash and recycling to be done on the same day. These measures have brought the city's ratio of municipal employees per resident to a 40-year low.

283654a1c2e16a6d29b36413968848d72adbe15d.sourceText: 卡瓦佐斯说，创新、效率和用更少的人力来做的更好，这才是未来全国、各州和地方政府的趋势所在。
283654a1c2e16a6d29b36413968848d72adbe15d.translatedText: > Innovation, efficiency and doing better with less manpower are the future trends for national, state and local governments, Cavazos said.

3556d168b40c57894a37a7c648673c73914af7ba.sourceText: 男人也想找個能依靠的人 （亚省时报） 有的人认为这么说是一种懦弱，其实不然，因为是人都需要一个依靠， 因为人生在世有很多的事情会使人感到心痛，也会心力交瘁，会很累， 都需要一个可以靠一靠的 地方，休息一下。 依靠不是女人的专利， 男人也需要，有的时候会比女人更需要。 常听女人们说，想找一个坚实的臂膀靠一靠，得到一个安慰和坚实。 其实男人也是需要的，他不是在找一个比自己更加坚实的臂膀， 而是找到一个可以让自己安稳的休息的柔软，不是坚实而是温存的栖息。 男人的依靠是有别于女人的依靠，他的依靠来自于一个轻轻的问候，来自于一个简单的亲昵，也可能来自于女人的一个娇滴滴的撒娇，也会从女人的关心的埋怨中得到 一个安慰。 有的时候男人需要女人的唠叨，也需要女人的埋怨， 更需要女人的没完没了地说着她们这一天的经历。 你也许会看到一个大男人躺在自己女人的怀抱里，听着女人的诉说， 就像是一个小孩子听着母亲的故事一样那么的认真，而且还有着那么多的瞌睡。 他们听女人说话，不是想知道什么，只是想听音乐一样， 享受着一种来自自己爱的人的心底的抒发。 男人需要理解，更需要一点关心，哪怕是一个微不足道的问及也是一种美好。 有人说讨厌自己女人的唠叨，这是不假， 因为这个女人唠叨的是使男人厌烦的话题， 那是真得会使男人觉得那不是在听自己女人的诉说，而是在听一种噪音。 男人还怕寂寞，比女人还要害怕。 他们害怕自己的女人不再说话，也不再说心里的话。 他们惧怕自己女人的远去，即使很短时间的离开也会惴惴不安。 男人的依靠，来自于对感情的执着和忠诚， 他们觉得情感的执着和忠诚比任何事情都重要，因为他们最怕的就是后院起火， 因为那会使他们从此失去一种信念，那就是失去生命 的意义。 生命的意义就是来自于人性的忠实。 一旦男人觉得人性的缺失了， 那么他们就会觉得这个世界就此不再有任何可以信任的东西， 那么就会变为一个行尸走肉，从此不会有任何的快乐可言。 男人的依靠还来自于尊重， 他们认为彼此的情感上的尊重仅次于对感情的忠实和执着。 他们认为一切感情都来自于执着的忠诚和彼此的尊重， 这种尊重来自于细微的言表，不见的是一种隆重的仪式。 也许就是一个生日的简单礼物，也许就是一个简单的举止， 都是对自己的尊重。 有的时候他们不需要那么具体的东西， 只需要一个发自内心的关怀。 这一点男人既虚荣也很实际。 男人在最忧伤和失落的时候，也会像女人一样，哭出来，那只是一种宣泄， 这个时候只需要女人的一个动作棗摸摸头，说几句安慰的话，不要走开， 和他一起享受 静寂，这就足够了。 男人其实有的时候也很烦， 只是不像女人那么实在，都是偷偷做出来的，他们嘴上都不会说的。 男人也很脆弱，因为他们承受的要比女人要承受的多， 即使是一个比男人强势的女人也不会有多于男人的承受， 因为男人是上帝塑造的一个需要承受的载体，你逃不 掉！
3556d168b40c57894a37a7c648673c73914af7ba.translatedText: Men also want to find someone they can rely on (Alberta Times) Some people think that it is cowardly to say this, but it is not true, because everyone needs someone to rely on, because there are many things in life that can make people feel heartbroken, exhausted, and tired. They all need a place to lean on and take a rest. Reliance is not just for women, men need it too, sometimes more than women. I often hear women say that they want to find a solid arm to lean on to gain comfort and solidity. In fact, men also need it. He is not looking for an arm that is stronger than his own, but a soft place where he can rest peacefully, not a solid but a gentle perch. A man's dependence is different from a woman's dependence. His dependence comes from a gentle greeting, from a simple intimacy, or from a woman's coquettish coquettishness, or from a woman's concern and complaint. Sometimes men need women’s nagging, women’s complaints, and even more, women’s endless talk about their day’s experiences. You may see a grown man lying in the arms of his woman, listening to the woman's story, just like a child listening to his mother's story as seriously as he does, and he is dozing off a lot. When they listen to women, they don't want to know anything, they just want to listen to music and enjoy the expression from the heart of the person they love. Men need to understand and even need a little care. Even a trivial question is a kind of beauty. Some people say that they hate their women’s nagging, which is true, because this woman is nagging about topics that annoy men. It really makes men feel that they are not listening to their women’s words, but listening to a kind of noise. Men are also afraid of loneliness, even more than women. They are afraid that their women will no longer speak or speak what is in their hearts. They are afraid that their women will go away, and they will feel uneasy even if they leave for a short time. Men's reliance comes from their emotional persistence and loyalty. They feel that emotional persistence and loyalty are more important than anything else, because what they fear most is a fire in the backyard, because that will make them lose their belief, that is, the meaning of life. The meaning of life comes from the fidelity of human nature. Once men feel that there is a lack of humanity, they will feel that there is no longer anything trustworthy in this world, and they will become a walking zombie, and there will be no happiness at all from now on. Men's dependence also comes from respect. They believe that each other's emotional respect is second only to loyalty and persistence in feelings. They believe that all feelings come from persistent loyalty and mutual respect. This kind of respect comes from subtle expressions of words, but not from a grand ceremony. Maybe it's a simple birthday gift, maybe it's a simple gesture, it's all respect for yourself. Sometimes they don't need something so specific, just a heartfelt concern. This man is both vain and practical. When men are most sad and lost, they will cry like women. It is just a kind of catharsis. At this time, all the woman needs is to touch her head, say a few words of comfort, don't walk away, and enjoy the silence with him. This is enough. In fact, men are also annoying sometimes, but they are not as real as women. They do it secretly and they will not say it. Men are also very fragile, because they bear more than women. Even a woman who is stronger than a man will not bear more than a man, because a man is a carrier shaped by God who needs to bear, and you can't escape!

d334b68f7ad2527127436447c364e9a236ab952e.sourceText: 7月26日上午燄阳高照,气温飚升至华氏109度。没出城避暑的家长们带者小朋友陆续抵达慈济凤凰城会所,参加儿童精进班的亲子营活动。教育课务组安排了瑜跏、排舞、慈济手语、书法四堂课,藉着室内轻鬆的活动,来増进亲子间的互动和感情。最后大家享用志工准备的爱心甜点后,圆满结束。 慈济的敎育注重于生活敎育和人文精神,育善种和培养慈悲・ 证严上人慈示:敎育的目标在于啓发孩子们的智慧,使之増长慧命。孩子们了解生命的价値,即能开阔心胸做一个能为社会人群付出的人。这就是爱的续,让人看见社会未来的希望。 慈济凤凰城儿童精进班将于今年8月9日(星期六)9:30AM~12:30PM 开课,希望4歳~10歳的孩童踊跃报名参加。 地点:2145 W. d334b68f7ad2527127436447c364e9a236ab952e.translatedText: The sun was shining brightly on the morning of July 26, and the temperature soared to 109 degrees Fahrenheit. Parents who had not left the city to escape the summer heat arrived with their children one after another at the Tzu Chi Phoenix Club to participate in the parent-child camp activities of the Children’s Advanced Class. The education team arranged four classes: yoga, line dancing, Tzu Chi sign language, and calligraphy. Through relaxed indoor activities, the interaction and affection between parents and children were enhanced. Finally, everyone enjoyed the loving desserts prepared by volunteers, and the event ended successfully. Tzu Chi’s education focuses on life education and humanistic spirit, cultivating seeds of kindness and cultivating compassion. Master Cheng Yen kindly stated: The goal of education is to inspire children’s wisdom and enable them to grow their wise lives. When children understand the value of life, they can broaden their minds and become people who can contribute to society. This is the continuation of love, which allows people to see hope for the future of society. Tzu Chi Phoenix Children’s Advanced Class will start from 9:30AM to 12:30PM on August 9th this year (Saturday). We hope that children aged 4 to 10 will actively sign up. Location: 2145 W. Elliot Rd. Chandler AZ 85224 Phone: (480) 838-6556 (Monique)
