3b63ddd5b01648d3606828227bad8ac079e4cc91.sourceText: 学校将禁售糖果、高卡路里饮料 （亚省时报） 农业部1日首次提出使学校出售的零食更健康的广泛新标准，几乎禁止学校出售所有的糖果、高卡路里饮料和油炸食物，以对抗儿童肥胖。 根据农业部建议的规定，现在学校贩卖机中充斥的Skittles糖和Sprite汽水，将改成水、低卡路里饮料、减肥汽水和烘烤的薯片；现在学校餐厅点菜部分出售油腻腻的Mozzarella起士条和玉米片，将必须改为较健康的披萨、水果杯和优酪乳。 这些规定是根据2010年国会通过的儿童营养法制定的，目前的标准规定了联邦政府补贴学校早餐和午餐的营养内容，但大多数学校餐厅有点菜的部分，出售其他的食物，农业部的新规定包括对学校出售的所有食物所含的脂肪、卡路里、糖和钠，都加以限制。 农业部规定，学校出售的大部分零食必须低于200卡路里，小学和初中只能出售水、低卡路里的牛奶，或100%果汁或蔬菜汁，高中可以出售一些运动饮料，但在12盎司的容量中，只能含60或75卡路里。 这些标准适用于贩卖机、午餐点菜部分，和通常在学校出售的其他食物，不适用于学校内的募款活动或烘焙义卖的食物，但各州可自行规定这些活动的食物营养标准。农业部的标准也不适用于学校课后运动比赛或戏剧表演的零食摊食物、从家中带往教室庆祝活动的食物，和学生从家中带往学校自己吃的食物。 学校、食品业者、利益团体和批评者有60天的时间，可以对此新规定提出评论和修改建议，农业部在定桉后，这些规定最快可能于2014学年执行。 根据公共利益组织科学中心的民调显示，家长希望学校餐 厅有所改变，「这样家长就不用担心孩子用午餐钱去买糖果和高卡路里饮料，而不是买健康的学校午餐」。
3b63ddd5b01648d3606828227bad8ac079e4cc91.translatedText: Schools will ban the sale of candies and high-calorie drinks (Alberta Times) The Agriculture Department proposed broad new standards for the first time on the 1st to make snacks sold in schools healthier, banning almost all candies, high-calorie drinks and fried foods in schools to combat childhood obesity. According to the regulations proposed by the Department of Agriculture, the Skittles sugar and Sprite soda currently filled in school vending machines will be replaced by water, low-calorie drinks, diet soda and baked potato chips; the greasy Mozzarella cheese bars and corn chips currently sold in the a la carte section of the school cafeteria will have to be replaced by healthier pizza, fruit cups and yogurt. The rules were established under the Child Nutrition Act passed by Congress in 2010. Current standards set the nutritional content of federally subsidized school breakfasts and lunches, but most school cafeterias sell other foods as part of a la carte portions. The USDA's new rules include limits on fat, calories, sugar and sodium for all food sold in schools. The USDA stipulates that most snacks sold in schools must contain less than 200 calories. Elementary and middle schools can only sell water, low-calorie milk, or 100 percent fruit or vegetable juice. High schools can sell some sports drinks, but they can only contain 60 or 75 calories in a 12-ounce container. The standards apply to vending machines, lunch a la carte portions, and other foods typically sold in schools. They do not apply to food at in-school fundraisers or bake sales, although states can set their own nutritional standards for food at those events. The USDA's standards also do not apply to snack stand food at school after-school sports games or theater performances, food brought from home to classroom celebrations, and food brought from home to school for students to eat themselves. Schools, food businesses, interest groups and critics have 60 days to comment and make suggestions for changes to the new regulations, which could be implemented as early as the 2014 school year after the Ministry of Agriculture finalizes them. According to a poll by the public interest organization Science Center, parents want changes to school cafeterias "so parents don't have to worry about their children using their lunch money to buy candy and high-calorie drinks instead of buying healthy school lunches."

eafc72f987d773bdcbda930871c472ee6af2cff0.sourceText: 在《学习时报》读到一篇署名宫春科的文章”美陆军战时弃用贝雷帽的启示”，说是美国陆军不久前宣布，士兵今后穿著作战服时不必戴贝雷帽，改 戴有檐巡逻帽。
eafc72f987d773bdcbda930871c472ee6af2cff0.translatedText: I read an article in "Study Times" signed by Gong Chunke, "Inspiration from the U.S. Army's abandonment of berets during wartime." It was said that the U.S. Army recently announced that soldiers will no longer need to wear berets when wearing combat uniforms in the future, and will instead wear brimmed patrol hats.

95a070fbdbc56a1b467d1baa710f52783432ebf5.sourceText: 世界上许多国家都将贝雷帽作为制式军服的一部分，并与除礼服外的各种制式服装搭配，有着广泛的运用领域，一些功勋卓著的部队甚至用所戴的贝雷帽命名。 这种似乎是国际通用的帽子，美军说废弃就废弃，原因何在呢？
95a070fbdbc56a1b467d1baa710f52783432ebf5.translatedText: Many countries in the world use berets as part of their standard military uniforms, and match them with various standard clothing except formal dresses. They are widely used. Some troops with outstanding achievements are even named after the berets they wear. This kind of hat seems to be used internationally, but the US military discards it immediately. Why?

2ca5e253573b47f3cbea7608bca4fb4fc6fd1b0e.sourceText: 这个贝雷帽倒不是美国人的”知识产权”，它的历史可以追溯到十五世纪中。 法国西南部比利牛斯地区，旧时称加斯科尼省。 那里有许多牧羊人，很有个性。 据说加斯科尼人喜欢吹牛说大话，生活不拘小节，衣服穿脏了，反过来接着穿几天。 所以法国人要说”加斯科尼式洗衣服”，就是说把衣服反穿。 就是这些不拘小节的加斯科尼人最早用棕色羊毛编织出了圆形的无沿软帽，用来遮阳挡雨。
2ca5e253573b47f3cbea7608bca4fb4fc6fd1b0e.translatedText: This beret is not an American "intellectual property". Its history can be traced back to the mid-15th century. The Pyrenees region in southwestern France, formerly known as Gascony. There are many shepherds there with great personalities. It is said that Gascon people like to brag and talk big, live informally, and wear dirty clothes for several days. So the French say "wash clothes Gascon style", which means wearing clothes inside out. It was these informal Gascon people who first knitted round bonnets from brown wool to protect them from the sun and rain.

1caff2444b290d615396e1ad22997558f422e85f.sourceText: 由于帽子四面浑圆，没有帽檐，戴在头上风也刮不下来。 干活累了，几个牧羊人摘下帽子擦擦汗，放在地下当坐垫，海阔天空侃侃而谈。 加斯科尼人还喜欢用贝雷帽在头上的位置表达不同的信息。 如果把帽子方方正正地戴在头上，意思是说”嗨！严肃点，别小看了我”；如果把帽子压低到眉毛的位置，那就是有点疑神疑鬼，对别人不大信任；如果歪戴 帽子，则表示满不在乎，好汉做事好汉当的一种气概。
1caff2444b290d615396e1ad22997558f422e85f.translatedText: Because the hat is round on all sides and has no brim, the wind cannot blow it off even if it is worn on the head. When they were tired from work, several shepherds took off their hats to wipe their sweat and put them on the ground as cushions, chatting about the vast sea and sky. Gascons also like to use the position of the beret on the head to express different messages. If the hat is worn squarely on the head, it means "Hey! Be serious, don't underestimate me." If the hat is lowered to the eyebrows, it means you are a bit suspicious and don't trust others; if you wear the hat crookedly, it means indifference, and the spirit of a good man doing things like a good man.

563767e05dc0c58c123360a72e6493aa2df63dc4.sourceText: 加斯科尼人发明的贝雷帽首先被邻近的巴斯克人接受。 巴斯克地区在法国和西班牙交界处，比加斯科尼地区开放。 来到巴斯克的旅行者发现了这种奇特的帽子，称之为”巴斯克贝雷帽”，把它们带到了法国其他地区，逐渐成为全国性的时尚。 在很长一段时间里，无论是牧羊人还是农民、工人乃至男女学生都喜欢戴贝雷帽，法国军队也装备了贝雷帽。 于是，贝雷帽与长棍面包、葡萄酒一样成了法国和法国人的象征。
563767e05dc0c58c123360a72e6493aa2df63dc4.translatedText: The beret invented by the Gascon people was first adopted by the neighboring Basques. The Basque Country is on the border between France and Spain, open to the Gascony region. Travelers who came to the Basque Country discovered this peculiar hat, called it "Basque beret", and brought them to other regions of France, gradually becoming a national fashion. For a long time, both shepherds, farmers, workers and even male and female students liked to wear berets, and the French army also equipped them with berets. As a result, the beret, like baguette and wine, became a symbol of France and the French people.

a6c4f870ddef926a09674d8290d63175b1100836.sourceText: 在二战德国占领时期，许多法国人特意以戴贝雷帽来表示不屈不挠的民族气节。 时过境迁，战后出生的法国青年人追逐新的时尚，不再青睐传统的贝雷帽。
a6c4f870ddef926a09674d8290d63175b1100836.translatedText: During the German occupation in World War II, many French people deliberately wore berets to express their indomitable national integrity. Times have changed, and French young people born after the war are chasing new fashions and no longer favor the traditional beret.

248f3abc5a2e2fee355c0303c41fa1134aefef26.sourceText: 话说回来，美国大兵到底为什么弃用贝雷帽呢？ 《学习时报》那篇文章引用一名美国军人的话描述戴贝雷帽的感受：”我讨厌在脑袋上戴一只湿袜子。而且，戴着它，皮肤出疹子。”所以，美军战时 不再佩戴贝雷帽，是倾听一线士兵呼声的结果。 虽然贝雷帽有便于折叠、不怕挤压、容易携带、美观等优点，但是作战和执勤中的美军发现贝雷帽没有帽檐、不能遮太阳、吸汗差，所以美军放弃了贝雷帽。
248f3abc5a2e2fee355c0303c41fa1134aefef26.translatedText: Speaking of which, why did American soldiers abandon berets? The "Study Times" article quoted an American soldier describing the feeling of wearing a beret: "I hate wearing a wet sock on my head. Moreover, wearing it makes my skin rash." Therefore, the US military no longer wears berets during wartime, which is the result of listening to the voices of frontline soldiers. Although berets have the advantages of being easy to fold, not afraid of being squeezed, easy to carry, and beautiful, the U.S. military during combat and on duty found that berets had no brim, could not block the sun, and had poor sweat absorption, so the U.S. military gave up on berets.

08f77f4d13213fb49a68eb6eb01b6d1a2845c8b1.sourceText: 亚省加入其他州起诉电子书 亚利桑那州总检察长汤姆霍恩上周三宣布，亚利桑那州将和其他15个州的检察长一起提出诉讼，对抗全国最大三书商和苹果公司哄抬电子书价格。 ”竞争者间同价同售是非法的，”霍恩在一份声明中强调。因电子书被抬高价格，消费者损失了约100万美元。 根据检察长办公室资料，麦克米伦，企鹅，西蒙舒斯特三公司连同其他出版商，与苹果合谋，将最受欢迎的书从$12.99提高至$14.99，这迫使所有电子书网店在相同价格出售书籍，变相使全行涨价。 诉讼希望制止价格垄断，消除同价同售，使消费者更多选择。 与此同时，亚马逊周三宣布计划调降电子书的价格。一些主要商品的价格从$14.99可能会降至$9.99美元或更少。 出版商和书商认为，政府反垄断诉讼案的最终结果将是一个”真正的交换”，即另一种形式的”垄断”。亚马逊目前已在同行业中占主导地位，届时﹐将会更加”手握所有的牌”。消费者的任何胜利都将是短暂的。 电子书已存在十几年，亚马逊2007年推出首台Kindle电子书阅读器后，电子书销售大增，一度取得90%的市场份额；但苹果Ipad出世后，情形有所改变。迄今﹐亚马逊已控制约60％的电子书市场。有人认为﹐当亚马逊拥有足够的竞争优势，它或可能主宰自己的条款，另一种形式的垄断就会开始。
08f77f4d13213fb49a68eb6eb01b6d1a2845c8b1.translatedText: Alberta joins other states in suing e-books Arizona Attorney General Tom Horn announced last Wednesday that Arizona will join the attorneys general of 15 other states in filing a lawsuit against the country's three largest booksellers and Apple for gouging e-book prices. "It is illegal for competitors to sell products at the same price," Horn said in a statement. Consumers lost about $1 million due to jacked-up prices for e-books. According to the Attorney General's Office, Macmillan, Penguin, and Simon & Schuster, along with other publishers, conspired with Apple to increase the price of the most popular book from $12.99 to $14.99, which forced all online e-book stores to sell books at the same price, thereby causing the entire industry to increase prices. The lawsuit hopes to stop price monopoly, eliminate products sold at the same price, and give consumers more choices. Meanwhile, Amazon on Wednesday announced plans to cut the price of e-books. Some major items may drop from $14.99 to $9.99 or less. Publishers and booksellers believe the end result of the government's antitrust lawsuit will be a "real exchange," another form of "monopoly." Amazon currently dominates the industry, and by then, it will even more "hold all the cards." Any victory for consumers will be short-lived. E-books have existed for more than ten years. After Amazon launched its first Kindle e-book reader in 2007, e-book sales increased significantly and once achieved 90% of the market share. However, after the birth of Apple's iPad, the situation changed. To date, Amazon controls about 60% of the e-book market. Some argue that when Amazon gains enough competitive advantage that it may dictate its own terms, another form of monopoly will begin.

1828c7e352f70503fc38f6d11859955f530b7b88.sourceText: 读罗元先生的”字”有好几年了，后来做了他的邻居，不仅能看到他更多的字，而且能在书墨翰香中亲自观摩。这对一个喜欢艺术的人来说，是何等的幸运。 2004年9月,湖北美术馆成功举办了罗元先生的书法作品展览，在参展的作品里,我看到了著名金石书画家曹立庵先生的影子。曹公的书体笔力遒劲洒脱、高古老辣、雄强古朴，注重书写意境的营造和文字本身的造型，以凝重之风及隽永之趣而卓尔不群。罗元先生是曹公女婿，他的隶书自然深受曹公的熏染，随着时间的推移，他在寻求自我完善过程中也表现出一些不安于现状的举动，他的生活阅历和学识随着年龄的增长变得丰富而厚重起来，在此基础上逐步形成了自己独有的艺术风格。 隶书特别讲究端庄、古朴、凝重、雅致，给人观赏的美感，并带来极强的装饰艺术效果。罗元先生在创作过程中，对字的点画粗细、用笔轻重,十分讲究对比和谐，要想把隶书写得充满生气，并给人纵逸的艺术美感，又要非常在意紧凑而匀称的结字和纵行横列的谨严章法，这是一个严峻的挑战。 在多年的探索过程中，罗元对运笔、轻重、大小、虚实以及字体的多种变化，已经能上下承应，气韵贯通。最近看了他刚刚完成的几幅书法作品，较之以前，字里行间多了一份凝重和大气。 作为湖北省对外文化交流协会副秘书长，在文学修养上罗元特别重视向前辈学习，曾得到徐迟、碧野等老作家的指点和帮助，在和这些名家交往的过程中，他们的思想不断撞击着他的艺术感觉，让他时时迸发出让人惊讶的艺术灵感。在书法艺术实践上早年有缘就教于曹立庵、黄亮、吴丈蜀等名家，得到他们的指导，经过多年的摸索，逐步地形成了自己的书写风格。 罗元先生不仅研究字，还研究我国的古典文献，书法和古典文化分不开。多年来他潜心于书法创作，忘情于翰墨，他的书法以隶为本，以篆辅之。经过多年的探索和研究，他的书法特点逐渐显示出来了。 罗元始终认为，书法一定要用发展的审美眼光来看，因为历史在进步，社会在发展，审美观、审美情趣将随着社会的发展而发展，为了不让人产生视觉上的审美疲劳，书法家应具有与时俱进的艺术眼光，书法艺术应和其他艺术很好地融会贯通，找到一个共同的支撑点，吸收其他艺术领域的丰富营养，以便跟上时代的步伐，真正成为现代人的艺术享受。
1828c7e352f70503fc38f6d11859955f530b7b88.translatedText: I have been reading Mr. Luo Yuan’s calligraphy for several years, and later became his neighbor. Not only could I see more of his calligraphy, but I could also observe it personally in the fragrance of calligraphy and ink. What a blessing for a person who loves art. In September 2004, the Hubei Art Museum successfully held an exhibition of Mr. Luo Yuan's calligraphy works. In the exhibited works, I saw the shadow of the famous epigraphic calligrapher and painter Mr. Cao Li'an. Cao Gong's calligraphy style is vigorous and free, noble, old-fashioned, powerful and simple. He pays attention to the creation of artistic conception and the shape of the words themselves, and is distinguished by his dignified style and timeless interest. Mr. Luo Yuan was the son-in-law of Cao Gong, and his official script was naturally deeply influenced by Cao Gong. As time went by, he also showed some uneasiness with the status quo in the process of seeking self-improvement. His life experience and knowledge became richer and thicker with age, and on this basis, he gradually formed his own unique artistic style. Official script pays special attention to dignity, simplicity, solemnity and elegance, giving people a sense of beauty and bringing a strong decorative art effect. In the process of creation, Mr. Luo Yuan pays great attention to contrast and harmony in the stipple thickness of the characters and the weight of the strokes. In order to make the official writing full of vitality and give people an indulgent artistic beauty, he must also pay great attention to the compact and well-proportioned knots and the rigorous organization of the vertical and horizontal lines. This is a severe challenge. In the process of many years of exploration, Luo Yuan has been able to adapt to the various changes in brushstrokes, weight, size, virtuality and fonts, and the style is consistent. Recently I saw some calligraphy works he had just completed. Compared with before, the lines are more solemn and grand. As the deputy secretary-general of the Hubei Provincial Foreign Cultural Exchange Association, Luo Yuan attaches great importance to learning from his predecessors in terms of literary accomplishment. He has received guidance and help from old writers such as Xu Chi and Bi Ye. In the process of interacting with these famous writers, their ideas constantly collided with his artistic feelings, causing him to burst out with surprising artistic inspiration. In the practice of calligraphy art, he had the opportunity to learn from famous calligraphy masters such as Cao Li'an, Huang Liang, and Wu Zhangshu in his early years. After receiving their guidance, he gradually formed his own writing style after years of exploration. Mr. Luo Yuan not only studies calligraphy, but also studies my country’s classical literature. Calligraphy is inseparable from classical culture. Over the years, he has devoted himself to calligraphy creation and lost his passion for calligraphy. His calligraphy is based on official script and supplemented by seal script. After years of exploration and research, his calligraphy characteristics gradually emerged. Luo Yuan always believes that calligraphy must be viewed from an aesthetic perspective of development, because history is progressing, society is developing, and aesthetics and aesthetic taste will develop with the development of society. In order to prevent people from visual aesthetic fatigue, calligraphers should have an artistic vision that keeps pace with the times. The art of calligraphy should be well integrated with other arts, find a common support point, and absorb the rich nutrition of other art fields in order to keep pace with the times and truly become an artistic enjoyment for modern people.

4cfd1fe74ff642c4f6becf94b0f97cab5b89e647.sourceText: 少妇呼麻后开车 婴儿忘在车顶 （亚省时报） 警方表示，一名吸食大麻的妈妈不小心，将坐在儿童安全座椅内的5周大儿子放在车顶上，直接开车上路，她今天在凤凰城被捕。 凤凰城警方发言人霍姆斯指出，这名男婴在一个十字路口中央从车顶掉落，被发现时没有受伤，身体系在座椅上。 他说，警方依虐待儿童和重伤害罪嫌将这名19岁小妈妈克劳瑟收押监禁。为防男婴受害，他已被送到当地医院，由州政府的儿童保护服务处监护。 霍姆斯在纸本声明中说：”嫌犯似乎将男婴放在车顶上即驱车离去，忘记男婴还在车顶。”警方表示，克劳瑟和男友事发前在公园吸食大麻，并载着男婴去买啤酒。警察拦下他们的车，她男友因涉嫌在受药物影响状况下驾车，且载有男婴，遭警方逮捕。 霍姆斯说，警方得知，克劳瑟对于男友被捕感到心烦意乱，因此驱车前往友人家中，”显然多抽了一两管大麻”。 他表示，克劳瑟约在午夜离开，当时男婴在安全座椅内熟睡，她将儿子放到车顶上。克劳瑟显然到家时才发觉男婴已不见。
4cfd1fe74ff642c4f6becf94b0f97cab5b89e647.translatedText: A young woman drove after becoming intoxicated and forgot her baby on the roof of the car (Alberta Times) A marijuana-smoking mother was arrested in Phoenix today after she accidentally put her 5-week-old son in a child safety seat on the roof of her car and drove off, police said. Phoenix police spokesman Thomas Holmes said the baby boy fell from the roof of the car in the middle of an intersection and was found uninjured with his body strapped into a seat. He said that the police detained the 19-year-old mother Crowther on suspicion of child abuse and serious injury. The baby boy was taken to a local hospital as a precaution and is in the custody of the state's Child Protective Services. Holmes said in a written statement: "The suspect appeared to have put the baby boy on the roof of the car and drove away, forgetting that the baby was still on the roof of the car." Police said that Crowther and her boyfriend smoked marijuana in the park before the incident and took the baby boy to buy beer. The police stopped their car and her boyfriend was arrested on suspicion of driving under the influence of drugs with a baby boy in his car. Holmes said police learned that Crowther was upset about her boyfriend's arrest, so he drove to a friend's house and "apparently smoked an extra pipe or two of marijuana." He said Crowther left around midnight with the baby boy asleep in his safety seat and she put him on the roof of the car. Crowther apparently didn't realize the baby boy was missing until he got home.

6646ec9c839c9e72ce79ee21d932ccf918af1e54.translatedText: Phoenix's median home price continues to rise. An ASU research report shows that home prices in the Phoenix metropolitan area increased by 34% in October compared with last year. The median home price in October of this year was $157,000, compared with $116,000 in October 2011, the report said. The report from the ASU College of Business says the supply of homes and apartments in metro Phoenix has grown 31% in the past three months. The 10 cities/towns with the fastest home price growth in the state are: Arizona City: 43%, El Mirage: 40%, Casa Grande: 39%, Youngtwon: 39%, Maricopa: 38%, San Tan Valley: 38%, Phoenix: 36%, Tolleson: 36%, Wittman: 35%, Coolidge: 33%. A few cities to watch include: Glendale: 38%, Mesa: 21%, Tempe: 20%, Chandler: 18%, and Scottsdale: 14%.

The third Phoenix Asia Cup football match came to a successful conclusion on April 23. Group A, Thailand and Myanmar Stars (Galaxy) won first place, TeaGuk won Group B, Thailand and Myanmar Gravity won first, and Alberta Vietnam (AZVN) won second. In the finals, Galaxy defeated Gravity 3-2 to win the championship, and Gravity ranked second. The Vietnamese team in Alberta defeated the TeaGuk team 6-1 and won the third place. In this competition, Phoenix City China (GPC) performed poorly in the group stage and did not enter the finals.

e543b1bb5ce0af4c1a37863bf66d8bff7a5196c9.sourceText: （本网讯）４月１０日中午１２时，在亚太社区促进会（亚促会）的例会上举行了一个简单而别致的颁奖典礼，凤凰城市政法庭(Phoenix Municipal Court)首席女法官（Chief Presiding Judge）邓周雅定女士获得了２０１３亚促会评选的”杰出亚裔女性奖”。资深侨领余文劲，大凤凰城华人侨团联合总会（侨联）会长张华芳，亚促会创始人徐凯莱，亚促会执行长道格平野（Doug Hirano），侨联终身顾问邓贺铮以及亚裔各社区代表共同见证这一特别的时刻。
e543b1bb5ce0af4c1a37863bf66d8bff7a5196c9.translatedText: (News from this website) At 12:00 noon on April 10th, a simple and unique awards ceremony was held at the regular meeting of the Asia-Pacific Community Promotion Association (Asia Promotion Association). The Chief Presiding Judge of the Phoenix Municipal Court (Phoenix Municipal Court) Judge) Ms. Deng Zhou Yading won the "Outstanding Asian Women Award" selected by Asia Promotion Association in 2013. Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader, Zhang Huafang, president of the Federation of Chinese Overseas Chinese Organizations in Greater Phoenix (Overseas Chinese Federation), Xu Kailai, founder of Asia Promotion Association, Doug Hirano, CEO of Asia Promotion Association, Deng Hezheng, lifelong consultant of the Overseas Chinese Federation, and representatives of various Asian communities witnessed this special moment.

077a8239f63901907f904bdb212b492e4d6e1785.sourceText: （左至右）张华芳，徐凯莱，余文劲，邓周雅定，道格平野，菲律宾社区代表 邓周雅定，现任凤凰城市政法庭首席女法官，并已经在职八年。从1986年，她就成为了亚利桑那州首位亚裔女法官，并亚利桑那州百年庆典时，获得48位最有魅力女性之一，她获得的各种殊荣数不胜数。很多人不了解她现在做的事情，邓法官非常通俗的比喻了一下她的职位，就是法院里的CEO。每年她管辖下的法院要处理三万五千多个官司，比如交通罚单，家庭纠纷等等，因此这个法庭处理的都是最忙碌，最琐碎的案件，但也是与普通市民的生活最息息相关的案件。因为她的特殊职位，不能在五月亚促会的筹款晚会上，接受这个奖项，于是亚促会还是专门为邓法官细心准备了这个朴素而庄严的颁奖典礼。邓法官说：”非常感谢社区能给她这个殊荣，这个奖和其他的很多奖项都不同，也许不会把她的名字放的很大，名流千古，但是这是亚裔，华裔的认可，就像是家乡，家人，对她的努力的认可，她觉得这是一种非常特殊的感情。”发言中，性格开朗的 邓法官非常的感动，几乎几度落泪。 资深侨领余文劲也对邓法官的获奖表示祝贺，更对亚促会多年来为社区做的服务表示赞赏！
077a8239f63901907f904bdb212b492e4d6e1785.translatedText: (left to right) Zhang Huafang, Xu Kailai, Yu Wenjin, Dengzhou Yading, Doug Hirano, Filipino community representatives Deng Zhouyading is currently the chief female judge of the Phoenix Municipal Court and has been in office for eight years. Since 1986, she has become the first Asian female judge in Arizona, and was one of the 48 most attractive women during the Arizona Centennial Celebration. She has received numerous honors. Many people don't understand what she is doing now. Judge Deng gave a very popular metaphor to her position, which is the CEO of the court. Every year, the courts under her jurisdiction handle more than 35,000 lawsuits, such as traffic tickets, family disputes, etc. Therefore, this court handles the busiest and most trivial cases, but they are also the cases most closely related to the lives of ordinary citizens. Because of her special position, she could not accept this award at the Asia Promotion Association’s fundraising gala in May, so the Asia Promotion Association carefully prepared this simple and solemn award ceremony for Judge Deng. Judge Deng said: "I am very grateful to the community for giving her this honor. This award is different from many other awards. It may not put her name in a big name and make her famous throughout the ages, but it is the recognition of Asians and Chinese, like the recognition of her hometown and family for her efforts. She feels this is a very special feeling." During the speech, Judge Deng, who has a cheerful personality, was very moved and almost shed tears several times. Yu Wenjin, a senior overseas Chinese leader, also congratulated Judge Deng on winning the award and expressed his appreciation for Asia Advancement’s service to the community over the years!

0a70f0d9103666ce46110074d539296671472b5a.translatedText: >Yu Wenjin (left) congratulates Deng Zhouyading (right) for winning the award

61098b3057cba7be7481bbde716cb73c3e5af203.sourceText: ２０１３年一共有三位女性获此殊荣，他们分别是华裔邓周雅定法官，坎迪斯卢博士(Candace Lew, MD, MPH)以及埃塞尔(Ethel Luzario)。在5月11日的亚促会的筹款晚宴上将会讲述他们的故事，并为其他两位获奖者现场颁奖。
61098b3057cba7be7481bbde716cb73c3e5af203.translatedText: A total of three women won this honor in 2013. They are Chinese Judge Deng Zhouyading, Dr. Candace Lew, MD, MPH, and Ethel Luzario. Their stories will be told at the Asian Development Association’s fundraising dinner on May 11, and awards will be presented to the other two winners on the spot.

b4f96c764c9cb607d49d7d52bc3f5a246c15fa31.translatedText: More arrests and fewer arrests for illegal immigrants? The Border Agency refutes a police sergeant in Cochise County, this state, claiming that when Border Patrol officials ask state police to perform their duties, they only need to "drive away" illegal immigrants...

93847e0219def154390ad551af8cbd5d023dd896.sourceText: 对付偷渡多赶少抓？边境局反驳 本州柯柴斯郡一名警長宣稱，邊境巡邏官員要求州警執行勤務時，只要「驅趕」非法移民，而無須逮捕他們的談話曝光後，引起國安部高官反駁。 ABC新聞網報導，柯柴斯郡警長戴福上週接受福斯新聞台訪問時說，一名海關與邊境保護局(CBP)高官告訴他，在某些特定期間，邊境巡邏員接獲的命令是，減少逮捕的人數。他說：「這位長官告訴我，現在的任務是嚇走非法移民，而不是逮捕他們。」 海關與邊境保護局局長費雪5日發出一封措詞嚴厲的信給戴福，駁斥他的說法。 費雪指出：「那個說法百分之百錯誤。最令人困擾的是，該說法對每天辛苦工作、冒險執勤的邊境局人員是不公平的。而該說法居然出自一位執法人員之口，更令人感到受冒犯。」 費雪表示，邊境局的政策是逮捕每一位越過邊境的非法移民，他還邀請戴福隨同邊境巡邏員一同執行勤務，了解實地工作狀況。 戴福堅稱，他的消息來源可靠，而且令人警惕。他說：「我不會虛構此事。我可以很確定的說，這些消息都來自每天執行邊境巡邏任務的人員和其他聯邦政府官員。」 國安部部長珍妮納波利塔諾指出：「美國與墨西哥邊境情況失控的說法完全不是事實。她說：「這些說詞有政治目的，這是不對的。面對我們已經和正在做的工作，繼續如此放話，不但產生負面效果，對於認真執法的公務員也不夠尊重。
93847e0219def154390ad551af8cbd5d023dd896.translatedText: To deal with illegal immigrants, more arrests and less arrests? Border Agency Rebuttal: A police chief from Cochise County in this state claimed that Border Patrol officials asked state police to only "destroy" illegal immigrants when performing duties without arresting them. After the conversation was exposed, senior officials of the Department of Homeland Security refuted it. ABC News reported that during an interview with Fox News last week, Cochise County Sheriff Dave said that a senior Customs and Border Protection (CBP) official told him that during certain periods, Border Patrol agents were ordered to reduce the number of arrests. He said: "The chief told me that the task now is to scare away illegal immigrants, not to arrest them." Customs and Border Protection Director Fisher sent a stern letter to Dafoe on the 5th to refute his statement. Fisher pointed out: "That statement is 100 percent wrong. The most troubling thing is that this statement is unfair to the Border Agency personnel who work hard every day and take risks on duty. And it is even more offensive that this statement came from a law enforcement officer." Fisher said that the Border Agency's policy is to arrest every illegal immigrant who crosses the border. He also invited Daifu to accompany the Border Patrol agents to perform duties and understand the working conditions on the ground. DeFoe insists his sources are reliable and alarming. He said: "I will not make this up. I can say with certainty that these information come from people who perform Border Patrol tasks every day and other federal government officials." Department of Homeland Security Secretary Jeanne Napolitano pointed out: "The statement that the situation at the U.S.-Mexico border is out of control is completely untrue." She said: "These statements have political purposes, which is wrong. In the face of the work we have done and are doing, continuing to make such statements will not only have a negative effect, but also disrespect the public servants who are serious about enforcing the law."

058bd0cafe981edbd015483a84ff004689e5441f.translatedText: Data Interpretation of Gun Violence in the United States

b110d87a539d4c27479a727047f8957977f89652.sourceText: 美国得克萨斯州南部萨瑟兰斯普林斯镇一座教堂5日上午遭遇枪击，包括老人和儿童在内，26名居民在做礼拜时遇害；枪手一人，已经毙命。另有20多人受伤。
b110d87a539d4c27479a727047f8957977f89652.translatedText: A church in the town of Sutherland Springs in southern Texas was shot on the morning of the 5th. 26 residents, including the elderly and children, were killed during worship; one gunman was killed. More than 20 others were injured.

46de1ee049e54610472a5942c4058b5e8d929742.sourceText: 德州州长格雷格.阿博特说，这是德州历史上伤亡最惨重的一起枪击事件。
46de1ee049e54610472a5942c4058b5e8d929742.translatedText: Texas Governor Greg Abbott said that this was the deadliest shooting in Texas history.

a67d5f9e72061de2fab08f1d5ed9e8437b786aaf.sourceText: 枪击案发生在德州，并不令人意外。在美国各地政治光谱上，德州非常靠右，拥枪文化在这里根深蒂固。纽约哥伦比亚大学梅尔曼公共卫生学院2015年一项研究显示，德州居民持枪率为35.7%，高于全美29.1%的平均水平。
a67d5f9e72061de2fab08f1d5ed9e8437b786aaf.translatedText: The shooting occurred in Texas, which is not surprising. On the political spectrum across the United States, Texas is very far to the right, and the pro-gun culture is deeply rooted here. A 2015 study by the Mailman School of Public Health at Columbia University in New York showed that the gun ownership rate among Texas residents was 35.7%, higher than the national average of 29.1%.

8ec9ea7c2b05b8e25d422d653bd367bec1e2342b.sourceText: 德州对枪械的管控非常松。根据布雷迪预防枪支暴力研究中心发布的枪械管控松紧程度年度排名，德州在全美50个州排第34位，评分为F，是最低的一档。
8ec9ea7c2b05b8e25d422d653bd367bec1e2342b.translatedText: > Texas has very loose control over firearms. According to the annual ranking of gun control tightness released by the Brady Research Center to Prevent Gun Violence, Texas ranks 34th among the 50 states in the United States, with a score of F, the lowest level.

1defa69ec7d6341495b3941dd49e385f48d39815.sourceText: 《今日美国报》5日报道，德州允许登记过的合法持枪者在大多数公共场所携带枪支，允许合法持枪的学生把枪装在枪套里带去学校。州议会今年早些时候把申请手枪持有许可证的费用从140美元调低到40美元，相关法律已于9月1日生效；州议会还允许申请者通过网络课程学习手枪射击。
1defa69ec7d6341495b3941dd49e385f48d39815.translatedText: USA Today reported on the 5th that Texas allows registered legal gun owners to carry guns in most public places, and allows legal gun owners to bring their guns to school in holsters. The state Legislature earlier this year lowered the fee for applying for a handgun license from $140 to $40, and the relevant law took effect on September 1; the state Legislature also allowed applicants to learn to shoot pistols through online courses.

348686c0c940ceffb39507242ebbd3a6bbfce8fe.sourceText: 德州枪械致死事件发生率也很高。美国疾病控制和预防中心数据显示，德州枪械致死人数2011年为2599人，此后逐年增加。2015年，德州3203人死于枪口，为全美最多；致死率为10万分之11.7，高于同年全美平均水平。
348686c0c940ceffb39507242ebbd3a6bbfce8fe.translatedText: Texas also has a high rate of firearm deaths. Data from the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention show that the number of gun deaths in Texas was 2,599 in 2011 and has increased year by year since then. In 2015, 3,203 people in Texas were killed by guns, the most in the United States; the fatality rate was 11.7 per 100,000, higher than the national average in the same year.

963356790727add5d4de503b2456974a69998ce3.sourceText: 围绕枪械管控，萨瑟兰斯普林斯教堂枪击案将引发新的辩论。发生枪击案的原因很多，也很复杂。但无论怎样，枪械管控越松，死于枪口的概率就会越高。
963356790727add5d4de503b2456974a69998ce3.translatedText: The Sutherland Springs church shooting will spark new debate over gun control. The reasons for shootings are many and complex. But no matter what, the looser the gun control, the higher the probability of dying from a gun.

923c34d3d97212af16fd9bde66c4481c64380b5d.sourceText: 德州执法官员说，枪手使用一支”鲁格”AR系列的突击步枪行凶。警方没有透露枪支具体型号。据美国媒体报道，调查人员正在查看这名嫌疑人在社交媒体上发的帖子，其中一条展示他持有的AR-15型半自动突击步枪。
923c34d3d97212af16fd9bde66c4481c64380b5d.translatedText: Texas law enforcement officials said that the gunman used a "Ruger" AR series assault rifle to commit the crime. Police did not disclose the specific model of the gun. According to US media reports, investigators are reviewing the suspect's social media posts, one of which shows the AR-15 semi-automatic assault rifle he holds.

d9fecd4515c9482e9953c156f2b6a86e6c1d2597.sourceText: 这种半自动武器是美国近年来多起严重枪击案的凶器，包括2012年科罗拉多州奥罗拉市电影院枪击案、康涅狄格州桑迪.胡克小学枪击案，2015年加利福尼亚州圣贝纳迪诺市枪击案，2016年佛罗里达州奥兰多市夜总会枪击案。
d9fecd4515c9482e9953c156f2b6a86e6c1d2597.translatedText: This semi-automatic weapon has been the murder weapon in many serious shootings in the United States in recent years, including the 2012 movie theater shooting in Aurora, Colorado, the Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting in Connecticut, the 2015 shooting in San Bernardino, California, and the 2016 nightclub shooting in Orlando, Florida.

1f50deec5d6d20623d3a200c2fdcd80b6fe1a6da.sourceText: 1994年，美国国会通过法律，禁止制造、贩卖和持有攻击性武器以及容量超过10发的大容量弹夹，包括上文提到的半自动武器。然而，这项法律只有10年有效期。2004年到期后，虽然支持控枪的人士一直寻求禁止售卖半自动武器，但所有的立法努力都失败了。性能堪比军用步枪的半自动武器畅销无阻，是美国频繁发生死亡率高、伤亡众多的大规模枪击案的重要原因。
1f50deec5d6d20623d3a200c2fdcd80b6fe1a6da.translatedText: In 1994, the U.S. Congress passed a law prohibiting the manufacture, sale, and possession of assault weapons and large-capacity magazines with a capacity of more than 10 rounds, including the semi-automatic weapons mentioned above. However, this law is only valid for 10 years. Although gun control advocates have sought to ban the sale of semi-automatic weapons since it expired in 2004, all legislative efforts have failed. Semi-automatic weapons with performance comparable to military rifles are selling like hot cakes and are an important reason for the frequent mass shootings in the United States with high mortality rates and numerous casualties.

05875560abc64c06bccaf2d8ccda7db8337f4ffb.sourceText: 横向比较，美国的枪械管控在发达国家中是失败的，枪械暴力堪称最严重。
05875560abc64c06bccaf2d8ccda7db8337f4ffb.translatedText: In horizontal comparison, gun control in the United States has failed among developed countries, and gun violence is the worst.

e772d3f651686a5f8919f5d2b2c60a30f2ab89c0.sourceText: 有研究显示，在德国，死于枪击的概率跟坠机差不多；在英国，跟楼梯失足摔死差不多；在日本，跟被雷劈死差不多。而在美国，被枪击致死的概率是德国的15倍，英国的31倍，日本的310倍。
e772d3f651686a5f8919f5d2b2c60a30f2ab89c0.translatedText: Studies have shown that in Germany, the probability of dying from a gunshot is about the same as that of a plane crash; in the UK, the probability of death is about the same as falling down the stairs; in Japan, the probability of death is about the same as being struck by lightning. In the United States, the probability of being shot to death is 15 times that of Germany, 31 times that of the United Kingdom, and 310 times that of Japan.

47a1093d525dc2624e9f93c7430d34bfaf900e7f.sourceText: 据美国疾病控制和预防中心统计，2011年至2015年，美国平均每天有32人被枪杀，58人用枪自杀，加上走火等意外，平均每天有93人死于枪口。2016年，美国有超过3.3万人死于枪口。
47a1093d525dc2624e9f93c7430d34bfaf900e7f.translatedText: According to statistics from the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, from 2011 to 2015, an average of 32 people were shot and killed every day in the United States, and 58 people committed suicide with guns. Including accidents such as fires, an average of 93 people died from gunpoints every day. In 2016, more than 33,000 people were killed by guns in the United States.

1bb163c04d871a59c401e9de8af2ecdc4f45c5a5.sourceText: 美国到底有多少支枪？美国国会下属研究机构算过，今天美国人均持枪量是1968年的两倍。美国民间总计有超过3亿支枪，相当于平均人手一支枪。
1bb163c04d871a59c401e9de8af2ecdc4f45c5a5.translatedText: How many guns are there in the United States? A research agency affiliated with the U.S. Congress has calculated that the number of guns owned by Americans today is twice that of 1968. There are more than 300 million guns in the U.S. private sector, equivalent to one gun per person.

a876b66f9021f01ed42dd216f8a0532afbef6268.sourceText: 美国每年枪支产量很大。司法部下属酒精、烟草、火器和爆炸物管理局2016年统计报告显示，美国1986年枪支产量是304万支，2014年高达905万支。最近这些年是美国30年来枪支产量增长最快的时期，一部分是出口，但绝大部分在本土销售。
a876b66f9021f01ed42dd216f8a0532afbef6268.translatedText: The United States produces a large amount of guns every year. The 2016 statistical report of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives under the Department of Justice shows that U.S. gun production was 3.04 million in 1986 and as high as 9.05 million in 2014. The past few years have been the fastest growing period in U.S. gun production in the past 30 years. Part of it is exported, but most of it is sold domestically.

6d2b894dc415f94f042d7006aa852676b6635b4f.sourceText: 美国国会民主、共和两党控枪之争的背后有经济利益、政治游说，也有文化影响、法律障碍。每年只要有严重枪击案发生，控枪就会成为热议话题，但每次都不了了之，这次恐怕也不会例外。(金旼旼)(新华社专特稿）
6d2b894dc415f94f042d7006aa852676b6635b4f.translatedText: Behind the debate over gun control between the Democratic and Republican parties in the U.S. Congress are economic interests and political lobbying, as well as cultural influences and legal obstacles. Whenever serious shootings occur every year, gun control will become a hot topic, but every time it remains silent, and this time will probably be no exception. (Kim Min-min) (Xinhua News Agency special article)

cfb079bc262b532fcd4a48a872284d69544a4f16.translatedText: Obama wishes New Year greetings to Asians. He recalls his childhood New Year experiences and wishes them peace and health. The 23rd of this month is the first day of the Lunar New Year in the Year of the Dragon. U.S. President Obama, his wife and the State Council...

407d5f3cfaa13c653f09530454c19dc8780cf6a6.sourceText: 奥巴马向亚裔拜年 忆儿时过年亲历祝福平安健康 本月23日是农历龙年新年的大年初一，美国总统奥巴马伉俪及国务卿希拉里克林顿19日发表谈话，给亚太裔拜年，代表美国人民祝贺全美亚太裔农历新年，希望每一个庆祝春节的人都获得平安、繁荣和健康。 奥巴马在白宫发布的贺岁辞中表示，”米歇尔和我向所有庆祝农历新年的人们，致上最佳的祝愿！”奥巴马总统同时在白宫官网的视频上亲自向亚太裔拜年。 奥巴马回忆童年在夏威夷过农历新年的兴奋情景：游行、烟花、与亲友同聚厖他说，农历新年总是充满了庆祝和希望的时光。他说，今年，在国内及世界各地的美国人欢迎龙年之刻，”请不要忘记我们国家的特质，因为我们的多样性而强大，由于不同文化而更丰盛。” 奥巴马祝福大家新的一年平安、昌旺、健康。 希拉里在由国务院发表的声明中说：?#19990;界各地民众正以丰富和不同的传统欢迎龙年来临。美国各地小区的亚裔美国人将与亲友庆祝他们旺盛的传统，以及使我们大家结合在一起的关系。?BR> 她说：”奥巴马总统与我都致力于与亚太地区人民建立21世纪的伙伴关系，我们也将继续与我们的盟友和伙伴加深关系，同时加强持久的友谊和合作。” 希拉里说：”在这新的一年以及未来的年代，让我们继续合作实现新的机会，并使我们面对的共同挑战获得进展。”
407d5f3cfaa13c653f09530454c19dc8780cf6a6.translatedText: Obama wishes Asians New Year's greetings. He recalls his childhood New Year experiences and wishes them peace and health. The 23rd of this month is the first day of the Lunar New Year in the Year of the Dragon. U.S. President Obama and his wife and Secretary of State Hillary Clinton delivered speeches on the 19th to send New Year greetings to Asian and Pacific Islanders. On behalf of the American people, they congratulated Asian and Pacific Islanders across the United States on the Lunar New Year and hoped that everyone celebrating the Spring Festival would be safe, prosperous and healthy. In a New Year's message released by the White House, Obama said, "Michelle and I extend our best wishes to everyone celebrating the Lunar New Year!" President Obama also personally sent New Year greetings to Asian and Pacific Islanders in a video posted on the White House's official website. Obama recalled the excitement of celebrating the Lunar New Year in Hawaii during his childhood: parades, fireworks, gatherings with family and friends. He said that the Lunar New Year is always a time full of celebration and hope. He said that this year, Americans at home and around the world welcome the Year of the Dragon. "Please do not forget the characteristics of our country. We are strong because of our diversity and richer because of different cultures." Obama wished everyone a safe, prosperous and healthy new year. Hillary Clinton said in a statement issued by the State Department: People around the world are welcoming the Year of the Dragon with rich and diverse traditions. Asian Americans in communities across the United States will celebrate with family and friends their strong traditions and the relationships that bind us all. ?BR> She said: "President Obama and I are committed to building 21st century partnerships with the people of the Asia-Pacific region, and we will continue to deepen relationships with our allies and partners while strengthening lasting friendships and cooperation." Hillary said: "In this new year and in the years to come, let us continue to work together to realize new opportunities and make progress on the common challenges we face."

c019fba94aa1a38045884a8f2d0067ce5fd1cd35.sourceText: 凤凰城出租屋价格又上涨了 现在在凤凰城续租房子的朋友就会发现房租都上升了。房屋销售的价格还是比较稳定，出租屋的价格上升了。 根据亚利桑那州立大学凯利商学院的最新数据，房租比去年同期上涨了5.7%。典型的公寓的租金上涨幅度超过了5%。凤凰城租房的需求量还是比较大，这是驱使租金价格上涨的动力。 目前，买房的人没有以往那么多。一些人信用不太好，或者没有首付款。其他有的因为所住的地区房价太高，买不起，最好的选择就是租。他们中还有一些就是不能肯定自己在一个地方能安定下来。 11月出租的房屋有2742栋，几乎是房屋销售数量的一半，也与全年的销售和出租的比例相符。2012-2013年出租只有房屋销售数量的三分之一。 公寓发展商看中现在的发展契机，已经有8000多个公寓正在兴建。与一年前相比，现在找一个合适租金的出租屋难多了。两个卧室的公寓，均价在900美金一个月。11月独立屋的出租的均价在$1152. 这个价格相当于购买一个27万5千的房子，首付10%，利息4， 三十年贷款每个月支付的费用。 从短期来看，因为2015年超级杯橄榄球赛在凤凰城举行，看到三月份的房租价格，不知会不会有更多人，望而却步，选择买房。更多有关亚利桑那房屋的资讯，请咨询房地产经纪Tinna Xie 480-287-0180 Tinna@platinumaz.com
c019fba94aa1a38045884a8f2d0067ce5fd1cd35.translatedText: The price of rental houses in Phoenix has risen again. Friends who are now renewing their lease in Phoenix will find that the rent has increased. The price of house sales is still relatively stable, and the price of rental houses has increased. According to the latest data from Arizona State University's Kelley School of Business, rents are up 5.7% from this time last year. Typical apartment rent increases exceed 5%. The demand for rental housing in Phoenix is ​​still relatively high, which is the driving force behind rising rental prices. Currently, there are not as many people buying houses as in the past. Some people don’t have good credit or don’t have a down payment. For others, the housing prices in the areas where they live are too high and they cannot afford it, so the best option is to rent. Some of them are just not sure they can settle down in one place. There were 2,742 homes for rent in November, almost half of the number of homes sold and consistent with the sales-to-rent ratio for the entire year. In 2012-2013, rentals accounted for only one-third of the number of housing sales. Apartment developers are betting on the current development opportunities, and more than 8,000 apartments are already under construction. Finding a rental at the right rent is much harder than it was a year ago. The average price for a two-bedroom apartment is $900 per month. The average rental price of a detached house in November was $1,152. This price is equivalent to the monthly payment of a 30-year loan with a 10% down payment, 4% interest, and a 275,000 house. In the short term, because the 2015 Super Bowl will be held in Phoenix, I wonder if more people will be deterred by the rent prices in March and choose to buy a house. For more information about Arizona homes, please contact real estate agent Tinna Xie 480-287-0180 Tinna@platinumaz.com

cb619a5fe8071e960b4ed65fa609f249f09df228.sourceText: 治粤八年南天王——传奇人物陈济棠 余玉书 （五）通款曲共军绕岭南（中） 陈济棠表面上对蒋介石颇为恭顺，对中央的命令就算是阳奉阴违，但手段上却相当圆滑。由于他不像桂系李宗仁那样具有问鼎中原的野心，只是固守广东一隅，极其量将势力范围扩展到邻近的广西地区而已。由于他大智若愚，处事一向低调，因此机警如蒋，亦毫不察觉。 陈生于广东防城，现时则改属广西，但事实上他的祖籍却是广西博白。而他手下的文武大员则多为高雷人氏（高州雷州），其中不少是替其出谋献策的智囊团，他们一致认为广东部队并非黄埔嫡系，所以能够保存整实力，乃由于蒋的中央军征战频烦，北伐之后，又与山西的阎锡山、陕西的冯玉祥、广西的李宗仁发生”中原大战”，现又集中全力于对付中共军队，四次围剿均无功而退，对于陈济棠这支非嫡系的广东部队，暂无力对付，只有加以拉拢。 第五次围剿逼在眉睫，许胜不许败，表面上陈被任命为南路军总司令，遂被智囊们认为是老蒋的一石二鸟之计，既可将共军围堵而一举歼灭之，又可以藉此消耗一些非主流派的地方武力。于是他们向陈济棠建议：只要共军答应遇其门而不入，就准其绕道西进，不加拦截。于是陈便一方面向蒋要求军饷械，一方面摆出拦截姿态，派出两个军集结在江西广东边境，但关乎此役胜负所在的碉堡战略，由信丰至南康一线的建筑工程，却故意拖延，未能如期完成。 至于负责拦截的将领，奉到密令：”不求有功，但求保存实力”，能拖则拖，尽量减少与共军正面接触。其后进一步派遣少将参谋杨幼敏，独七师师长黄质文，独一师师长黄任寰与中共粤赣军区司令兼政委何长工，及长期的第三国际特务头子潘汉年举行秘密谈判，双方达成协议： 就地停战，取消敌对局面。 互通情报，用有线电通报。 解除封锁。 互相通商，必要时红军可在陈的防区设后方，建立医院。 必要时可以互相借道，红军有行动事先告诉陈，陈部撤离四十华里，红军人员进入陈的防区用陈部护照。 陈济棠吃里扒外到如斯地步，蒋介石及其特务竞蒙然不知，但中共中央军委主席朱德及副主席周恩来却当机立断，下令向最有利处突围转进。
cb619a5fe8071e960b4ed65fa609f249f09df228.translatedText: The Southern Heavenly King who governed Guangdong for eight years - the legendary Chen Jitang and Yu Yushu (5) The communist army marched around Lingnan (center) On the surface, Chen Jitang was quite deferential to Chiang Kai-shek, and even if he obeyed the central government's orders, he was quite tactful in his methods. Because he did not have the ambition to conquer the Central Plains like Li Zongren of the Guangxi clan, he just stuck to a corner of Guangdong and expanded his sphere of influence to the neighboring Guangxi region as much as possible. Because he is as wise as a fool and always keeps a low profile in everything he does, he is as alert as Chiang and does not notice it at all. Chen was born in Fangcheng, Guangdong, and now belongs to Guangxi, but in fact his ancestral home is Bobai, Guangxi. Most of the civil and military officials under him were from Gao Lei people (Gaozhou Leizhou), and many of them were think tanks who gave advice to him. They all believed that the Guangdong army was not directly related to Huangpu, so it was able to maintain its strength because Chiang's Central Army had frequent campaigns. After the Northern Expedition, The "Central Plains War" broke out with Yan Xishan in Shanxi, Feng Yuxiang in Shaanxi, and Li Zongren in Guangxi. Now they are focusing all their efforts on dealing with the CCP army. Four encirclement and suppression campaigns failed without success. For the time being, they were unable to deal with Chen Jitang, the non-direct Guangdong army, and could only win over them. The fifth encirclement and suppression campaign was imminent, and victory was not allowed. On the surface, Chen was appointed as the commander-in-chief of the Southern Route Army. Therefore, think tanks believed that it was Chiang Kai-shek's plan to kill two birds with one stone. He could not only encircle and annihilate the Communist army in one fell swoop, but also use it to consume the local force of some non-mainstream factions. So they suggested to Chen Jitang: As long as the Communist army promised not to enter when they encountered him, they would be allowed to take a detour and march westward without interception. So on the one hand, Chen asked Chiang for military pay and equipment, and on the other hand, he adopted an interception posture and sent two armies to gather on the Jiangxi-Guangdong border. However, the construction project of the fortress strategy, which was crucial to the victory or defeat of the battle, from Xinfeng to Nankang, was deliberately delayed and failed to be completed as scheduled. As for the generals responsible for the interception, they were given a secret order: "Not seeking merit, but seeking to preserve strength." They delayed as long as they could and minimized direct contact with the Communist troops. Later, Major General Yang Youmin, Commander of the Seventh Division Huang Zhiwen, and Commander of the Single Division Huang Renhuan were further dispatched to hold secret negotiations with He Changgong, commander and political commissar of the Guangdong-Jiangxi Military Region of the Communist Party of China, and Pan Hannian, the long-time Third International spy chief. The two sides reached an agreement: to cease the war on the spot and cancel the hostile situation. Exchange information and report by wire. Unblock. Communicate with each other, and if necessary, the Red Army can set up rear areas and build hospitals in Chen's defense area. When necessary, they can borrow passages from each other. If the Red Army has any actions, Chen will be notified in advance. Chen's troops will evacuate forty miles away. Red Army personnel will use Chen's passport to enter Chen's defense area. Chiang Kai-shek and his spies were kept in the dark about Chen Jitang's corruption. However, Zhu De, Chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Communist Party of China, and Zhou Enlai, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, made a prompt decision and ordered a breakout to the most advantageous position.

629c4d14c3340895bd9d64b796d29e504bf7fa66.sourceText: 开平同乡会理事茶话会充份肯定端午节庆会圆满成功(图) 记者清宝 7月10日中午，开平同乡互助会召开理事会议。 有二十七位理事参加了这次在凤 城酒家举行的茶话会。会上, 大家热烈地议论了6月6日端午节, 热烈庆祝该会成立的盛况。会长甄 硕钦、名誉会长关宗任、常务理事胡寿柏、张华芳四人以当场”请饮茶”来表示, 感谢大多数理事在 这次活动中,自始至终同心同德, 通力合作，出力出钱, 从而得到众多的开平乡亲、开平之友的积极 响应, 使这次盛大的活动圆满成功。 该会副会长关兆峰主持了本次会议 。他首先与大家一起总结理事们在这次筹备工作所作的努力。 他说, 大多数的理事, 都是以责无旁货的态度, 分工承担, 亲力亲为, 做好大量的具体的准备工作, 保 证了整个活动顺利举行。大家说，理事们的贡献，真是不胜枚举，报纸上报导，受篇幅所限，恐 怕是挂一漏万。比如，常务理事、财政组组长司徒日贤夫妇奉献很大。为准备节目，他夫妇俩掏腰 包、挤时间，约请了一班开平好友，作了多次的排练。盛会时，自费邀请了一班好友人来助庆。引 领好友们一齐出台，载歌载舞，为大会给带来了”人靓歌甜”的快乐时光。另外，财务组在会上， 把该会成立三个月来的开支实况向作详细了报告。大家说”收得好，管得好，要发扬光大！”理事 们希望，本会才刚刚开始，日后要继续吸收会员，扩展会务，要为乡亲们办更多的福利事 业呢！ 会上，对近期如何组织乡亲们的互助互动活动进行讨论，理事会成员都认为选择适当时间组织 大众开展喜闻乐见的活动，是完全必要的，可多多建议，多多出力。大家表示．都在期待近期的聚会。 最后，会长甄硕钦传逹家乡开平市侨务部门来电，表示对本会成立的热烈祝贺！并希望本会 能组团回乡观光。理事们很高兴，希望能选择一个适众的时机，争取实现。当场有几位理事相约， 近期将先行回乡，表现出一片爱乡念亲的感情。
629c4d14c3340895bd9d64b796d29e504bf7fa66.translatedText: The Kaiping Fellowship Association directors’ tea party fully affirmed the success of the Dragon Boat Festival (photo) Reporter Qingbao At noon on July 10, the Kaiping Mutual Aid Association held a board of directors meeting. Twenty-seven directors attended the tea party held at Fengcheng Restaurant. At the meeting, everyone enthusiastically discussed the Dragon Boat Festival on June 6, and celebrated the establishment of the association. President Zhen Shuoqin, Honorary President Guan Zongren, and Executive Directors Hu Shoubai and Zhang Huafang expressed their gratitude to most of the directors for their "invitation to drink tea" on the spot, for their concerted efforts, cooperation, and financial contributions throughout this event. As a result, they received positive responses from many Kaiping folks and friends of Kaiping, making this grand event a complete success. Guan Zhaofeng, vice president of the association, presided over this meeting. He first summarized with everyone the efforts made by the directors in this preparatory work. He said that most of the directors took the attitude of shouldering their responsibilities, divided the work, and did a lot of specific preparations personally to ensure that the entire event was held smoothly. Everyone said that the contributions of the directors were too numerous to mention. Due to space limitations, the newspaper reports probably only missed one of them. For example, executive director and finance group leader Situ Rixian and his wife have made great contributions. In order to prepare for the show, he and his wife spent their money and time, invited a group of friends from Kaiping, and rehearsed many times. At the grand event, I invited a group of friends to celebrate at my own expense. Leading friends to perform together, singing and dancing, it brought a happy time of "beautiful people, sweet songs" to the conference. In addition, at the meeting, the finance team gave a detailed report on the association's expenditures in the three months since its establishment. Everyone said, "Collect it well, manage it well, and carry it forward!" The directors hope that this association has just begun. In the future, we will continue to attract members, expand our affairs, and do more welfare projects for the folks! At the meeting, there was a discussion on how to organize mutual aid and interactive activities for the villagers in the near future. The board members all believed that it is absolutely necessary to choose an appropriate time to organize activities that the public enjoys and see, and they can give more suggestions and efforts. Everyone said. They are all looking forward to the gathering in the near future. Finally, President Zhen Shuoqin called the Overseas Chinese Affairs Department of Kaiping City, his hometown, to express his warm congratulations on the establishment of the association! We also hope that our association can organize a group to go back to our hometown for sightseeing. The directors are very happy and hope to choose a suitable time to realize it. Several directors met at the scene, and they will be returning to their hometowns in the near future, showing their love for their hometown and relatives.

6b18c3f32360bb396d7f2d65a9cc626fb8eae9fe.sourceText: 这一组数字来自一家和美国政府合作的非盈利组织周一发布的统计报告。
6b18c3f32360bb396d7f2d65a9cc626fb8eae9fe.translatedText: This set of figures comes from a statistical report released on Monday by a non-profit organization that cooperates with the US government.

669f38a3ede443f9f78ded22b4894e1d83b49dcd.sourceText: 国际教育机构和国家教育文化部称，外国赴美留学生每年贡献大约240亿美元，其中三分之二都来自于他们的家庭援助。
669f38a3ede443f9f78ded22b4894e1d83b49dcd.translatedText: According to international education institutions and the Ministry of Education and Culture, foreign students in the United States contribute approximately US$24 billion every year, two-thirds of which come from their family assistance.

e005961a9a66cdd06e6c3448dfd2645f1cd1f800.sourceText: 根据发布的数字， 有819644名留学生在2012-13学年赴美学习。其中排名前五的是中国、印度、韩国、沙特和加拿大。该数字是创纪录的，比去年同期高7%，比十年前高40%。 尽管数字在增加，国际生源占全体学生的分量仍不足4%。
e005961a9a66cdd06e6c3448dfd2645f1cd1f800.translatedText: According to released figures, 819,644 international students studied in the United States in the 2012-13 academic year. The top five are China, India, South Korea, Saudi Arabia and Canada. The figure is a record, 7% higher than last year and 40% higher than a decade ago. Although the numbers are increasing, international students still account for less than 4% of all students.

b398cf91c191d5ce86961f01aeae5688fe0ac721.sourceText: 911事件发生后，来美学生曾一度减少，主要原因是因为签证难度增加，而今该数字又恢复增长活力。
b398cf91c191d5ce86961f01aeae5688fe0ac721.translatedText: After the 911 incident, the number of students coming to the United States decreased for a time, mainly because of the increased difficulty in obtaining visas. Now, the number has resumed its growth momentum.

72e90c38850258210b65135ba8aa6d55762dddc2.sourceText: 大约有23.5万留学生来自中国，增长量达到21%。中国蓬勃发展的中产阶级，用他们固有的”美国大学教育质量高”观点刺激了留学需求。其中1/3中国学生选择了工商和管理专业。
72e90c38850258210b65135ba8aa6d55762dddc2.translatedText: There are approximately 235,000 international students from China, an increase of 21%. China's booming middle class has stimulated demand for studying abroad with their inherent view that "American university education is of high quality". One-third of Chinese students have chosen business and management majors.

78bc2063bee1db8a89e04f5953571dd5b0e10b25.sourceText: ”中国学生和他们的家长寻求高质量的教育，了解国家化教育的重要性，这就使得美国成了他们的留学首选地，因为我们确实有能力吸引国际留学生。”美方研究机构负责人说。
78bc2063bee1db8a89e04f5953571dd5b0e10b25.translatedText: "Chinese students and their parents seek high-quality education and understand the importance of nationalized education, which makes the United States their first choice for studying abroad, because we do have the ability to attract international students." said the head of a US research institution.

c2ec4bd54cc590614c34b6bfc14020b9cff396e1.sourceText: 国际留学生首选的学校有位于洛杉矶的南加州大学，伊利诺伊州厄巴纳-香槟大学，伊利诺伊州香槟分校，纽约大学，哥伦比亚大学纽约校区等。
c2ec4bd54cc590614c34b6bfc14020b9cff396e1.translatedText: The preferred schools for international students include the University of Southern California in Los Angeles, the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, New York University, Columbia University New York Campus, etc.

c698fea8d9e07d7fcb5934a5ff384ab17c7343d7.sourceText: 作为对比，有283332名美国学生在海外学校就读，这一数字相比去年增长了3%。他们首选的留学地点包括英国、意大利、西班牙、法国和中国。
c698fea8d9e07d7fcb5934a5ff384ab17c7343d7.translatedText: For comparison, there are 283,332 American students studying in overseas schools, a 3% increase from last year. Their preferred study abroad destinations include the UK, Italy, Spain, France and China.

b8e78d3601ea36c49fd2b671820a215994d70098.sourceText: 因为北京奥运会的宣传效果，以及更多英语授课的产生，中国开始发挥对美国学生的吸引力。 美国政府推出了一个10万精英项目，其目标是从2010年开始，在四年内向中国外派10万美国学生。
b8e78d3601ea36c49fd2b671820a215994d70098.translatedText: Because of the publicity effect of the Beijing Olympics and the emergence of more English-taught courses, China has begun to attract American students. The U.S. government has launched a 100,000 elite program with the goal of sending 100,000 American students to China within four years starting in 2010.

afda0da06ca2bce626e4e6357c8dc3ecf3b27a85.sourceText: 报告显示：2011-2012学年，有14887名美国学生在中国留学，增长了2%。
afda0da06ca2bce626e4e6357c8dc3ecf3b27a85.translatedText: The report shows: In the 2011-2012 school year, 14,887 American students studied in China, an increase of 2%.

Picture...

07eb49092fdfb322ee4ad50a71418e20ddc635d9.sourceText: 伊利诺大学将持续四年对州内新生提供学费”冻涨”优惠，然而学费已经比州内生高的国际生，新学年学费仍免不了继续调涨，究竟要培养一位美国大学的国际生，要付出多少成本？以学费高居全美之冠的芝加哥大学为例，尽管芝加哥地区房租比其他美国都会区便宜，但没有任何奖学金补助的情况下，2018年就读芝加哥大学的大学生，一年学杂费就要花掉7万2000美元左右，换句话说，取得芝大学士头衔至少要投下30万美元重本。
07eb49092fdfb322ee4ad50a71418e20ddc635d9.translatedText: The University of Illinois will provide a "frozen increase" in tuition fees for in-state freshmen for four consecutive years. However, international students whose tuition fees are already higher than those for in-state students will inevitably continue to increase in the new academic year. How much does it cost to train an international student at an American university? Take the University of Chicago, which has the highest tuition fees in the United States, as an example. Although rent in the Chicago area is cheaper than in other American metropolitan areas, without any scholarship subsidies, college students studying at the University of Chicago in 2018 will spend about US$72,000 in tuition and miscellaneous fees per year. In other words, obtaining a bachelor's degree from the University of Chicago requires an investment of at least US$300,000.

f5011dd55bbc649549251cd583c928c78816a9d6.sourceText: 根据优投房网站分析芝加哥的西北大学、芝加哥大学，波士顿的波士顿大学、东北大学、哈佛大学、麻省理工学院，洛杉矶的洛杉矶加州大学、加州理工学院、南加大，旧金山的柏克莱加州大学、史丹福大学，还有纽约的哥伦比亚大学、纽约大学等学校的学杂费，加上附近房租的中位数情形。
f5011dd55bbc649549251cd583c928c78816a9d6.translatedText: According to the Youtoufang website, we analyze the tuition and fees of Northwestern University and the University of Chicago in Chicago, Boston University, Northeastern University, Harvard University, and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology in Boston, the University of California at Los Angeles, California Institute of Technology, and the University of Southern California in Los Angeles, the University of California at Berkeley and Stanford University in San Francisco, and Columbia University and New York University in New York, plus the median rent in the vicinity.

d2368059be7ef48046850696383266737f3f0be1.sourceText: 报告显示，2018年这五个城市中的知名大学，以芝加哥大学光学费就要5万4656元最高，而最低的是洛杉矶加州大学4万1265美元。如果算上学杂费的话，许多中国留学生最青睐的纽约哥伦比亚大学，2018年学杂费高达7万2710美元高居各校之冠。
d2368059be7ef48046850696383266737f3f0be1.translatedText: The report shows that among the well-known universities in these five cities in 2018, the University of Chicago has the highest tuition fee of $54,656, while the lowest is $41,265 at the University of California, Los Angeles. If tuition and fees are included, Columbia University in New York, which is favored by many Chinese students, has tuition and fees of US$72,710 in 2018, ranking highest among all schools.

e4fff26a148439bae6d0875a03f85552126f75ae.sourceText: 在房租方面，旧金山地区的房租中价，每个月高达4450美元，比较之下，芝加哥地区的租金中位数最便宜，每个月只要1800美元。
e4fff26a148439bae6d0875a03f85552126f75ae.translatedText: In terms of rent, the median rent in the San Francisco area is as high as $4,450 per month. In comparison, the median rent in the Chicago area is the cheapest, at only $1,800 per month.

99008f92d286af3760e7865e3ea781bad8a192c7.sourceText: 就读芝加哥伊利诺大学工程系大三的中国留学生Alice告诉本报，她现在一年学费是3万1612美元，目前与另一位同学租住在学校附近公寓，每个月房租是700美元，其他基本生活开销包括食物、手机费、网络费，每个月大概是400到500美元，此外，每个月购物、社交等费用约400美元，一年下来，5万美元的开销跑不掉。她说，这算是一般消费，许多读学费昂贵学校的同学，家里每年起码要准备8万到10万美元供留学。
99008f92d286af3760e7865e3ea781bad8a192c7.translatedText: Alice, a Chinese student who is studying in the engineering department of the University of Illinois at Chicago in her third year, told this newspaper that her annual tuition fee is US$31,612. She currently rents an apartment near the school with another classmate. The monthly rent is US$700. Other basic living expenses include food, mobile phone bills, and Internet fees, which are about US$400 to US$500 per month. In addition, monthly shopping and social expenses are about US$400. Over the course of a year, US$50,000 in expenses cannot be run away. She said that this is considered general consumption. Many students who study in expensive schools have to prepare at least US$80,000 to US$100,000 per year for their families to study abroad.

7e76b4776cc8fd2260496c9f3d57eaa30244238c.translatedText: > Guests visited the History Museum of Sichuan Film and Television University

74d0a8220948f5ece70953d2479db72699c09139.sourceText: 成都12月26日讯 12月16日，美国亚利桑那大学代表团来四川电影电视学院（以下简称为川影）访问交流。川影董事长黄元文、院长罗共和、舞蹈系主任陈志惠、英语教学部副主任仪雪、摄影系副主任郝建等学院领导，与亚利桑那大学艺术学院院长Tannis Gibson女士，亚利桑那大学法律系教授及中国交流合作项目负责人王永刚就未来两校国际合作等相关事宜展开座谈，双方达成共识并正式确立了合作关系。
74d0a8220948f5ece70953d2479db72699c09139.translatedText: News, Chengdu, December 26 On December 16, a delegation from the University of Arizona visited Sichuan Film and Television Academy (hereinafter referred to as Sichuan Film Academy). Sichuan Film Festival Chairman Huang Yuanwen, Dean Luo Gonghe, Dance Department Director Chen Zhihui, Deputy Director of English Teaching Yi Xue, Deputy Director of Photography Department Hao Jian and other school leaders held discussions with Ms. Tannis Gibson, Dean of the School of Art at the University of Arizona, and Wang Yonggang, professor of the University of Arizona Law Department and director of the China Exchange and Cooperation Project, on future international cooperation between the two schools. The two parties reached a consensus and formally established a cooperative relationship.

13d426d7885e3df3e8b407d2e7a26d57d646932e.sourceText: 亚利桑那大学访问团先后参观了川影安仁校区、金牛校区教学实训场地。在参观校史馆时，学院办公室主任刘国富等向来宾介绍了川影建校历程。在参观校园电视台时，嘉宾们观看了校园新闻，并了解了学院一体化演播室、录音棚等硬件设施，亲身感受了学院实践教学的成果。Tannis Gibson女士对学院各实训场地的教学模式和教学设施表现出浓厚的兴趣。对学院硬件设施水平、学生专业水平表示高度赞赏，并咨询了课程设置等相关情况，希望双方能加强合作、互相学习。
13d426d7885e3df3e8b407d2e7a26d57d646932e.translatedText: The University of Arizona delegation visited the teaching and training venues of Sichuan Film Academy’s Anren Campus and Jinniu Campus. When visiting the school history museum, Liu Guofu, director of the college office, and others introduced the history of Sichuan Film School's establishment to the guests. When visiting the campus TV station, the guests watched campus news, learned about the college's integrated studio, recording studio and other hardware facilities, and experienced first-hand the results of the college's practical teaching. Ms. Tannis Gibson showed strong interest in the teaching models and teaching facilities of the various training venues of the college. He expressed high appreciation for the level of the college's hardware facilities and the professional level of the students, and consulted on the curriculum and other relevant information, hoping that both parties could strengthen cooperation and learn from each other.

b93c18821e2e9af2c05034bb2883c664f8a51102.sourceText: 亚利桑那大学（The University of Arizona）是世界知名高等学府，美国最负盛名的公立研究型大学之一。两校的艺术专业有许多共通之处，合作空间巨大
b93c18821e2e9af2c05034bb2883c664f8a51102.translatedText: The University of Arizona is a world-renowned institution of higher learning and one of the most prestigious public research universities in the United States. The art majors of the two schools have many things in common, and there is huge room for cooperation

b93605c602166f6c74b1ef821aab97109f71b468.sourceText: 双方在会议室洽谈合作
b93605c602166f6c74b1ef821aab97109f71b468.translatedText: The two sides discussed cooperation in the conference room

6e7f7ff049cbc63f4ac0e1c89db45751d19cb2fe.sourceText: 随后的座谈会上，Tannis Gibson女士首先表示在参观了川影两校区后令她感触颇深，她高度认可了学院的校园环境、设施设备、教学模式及人才培养。双方领导接着对两校的专业设置、课程合作方式、教学理念等进行了详细交流。黄元文、罗共和着重了解了亚利桑那大学与中国其他大学合作开展的”微校园”项目进程，并就舞蹈专业等合作方式及可行性进行了深入讨论，达成了在音乐、舞蹈、摄影专业开展进一步合作的共同意愿。罗共和表示，希望未来能与亚利桑那大学展开更多、更深入的交流项目，为两校师生提供更广阔的平台，促进交流学习。
6e7f7ff049cbc63f4ac0e1c89db45751d19cb2fe.translatedText: At the subsequent symposium, Ms. Tannis Gibson first said that she was deeply impressed after visiting the two campuses of Sichuan and Yingying. She highly recognized the campus environment, facilities and equipment, teaching mode and talent training of the college. The leaders of both sides then had a detailed exchange on the professional settings, curriculum cooperation methods, teaching concepts, etc. of the two schools. Huang Yuanwen and Luo Gonghe focused on understanding the process of the "Micro Campus" project jointly carried out by the University of Arizona and other universities in China, and conducted in-depth discussions on cooperation methods and feasibility in dance majors, and reached a common intention to carry out further cooperation in music, dance, and photography majors. Luo Gonghe expressed the hope that more and more in-depth exchange projects can be carried out with the University of Arizona in the future to provide a broader platform for teachers and students of the two schools to promote exchanges and learning.

bac8a780522c142e106d229695250f4c2b9d320f.sourceText: 川影董事长黄元文、院长罗共和等与来宾展开座谈
bac8a780522c142e106d229695250f4c2b9d320f.translatedText: >Chairman of Sichuan Film Studio Huang Yuanwen and Dean Luo Gonghe held discussions with the guests

ffb9ae821dfd485160939464ee2e181f6fb78f83.sourceText: 为实现中西方教育共行，不同艺术形式之间的交流碰撞，川影与美国亚利桑那大学经过探讨后确定建立惠及两校学生的合作关系。包括：”微校园”合作项目、双学位办学合作、教授教学方式的交流互访。
ffb9ae821dfd485160939464ee2e181f6fb78f83.translatedText: In order to realize the coexistence of Chinese and Western education and the exchange and collision between different art forms, Sichuan Film Academy and the University of Arizona decided to establish a cooperative relationship that will benefit students from both schools after discussions. Including: "micro-campus" cooperation projects, dual-degree school cooperation, and exchanges and visits of professors' teaching methods.

28f3559cf65f171306e86ffab077ecfbc9c0230e.translatedText: Ms. Tannis Gibson, Dean of the School of Art at the University of Arizona, speaks

175d0d3c2b23ff5b42e1f7b1fa598414b28d7076.sourceText: 亚利桑那大学法律系教授、中国交流合作项目负责人王永刚讲话
175d0d3c2b23ff5b42e1f7b1fa598414b28d7076.translatedText: Wang Yonggang, professor of the University of Arizona Law Department and director of the China Exchange and Cooperation Project, speaks

5737f21e7df1f5240c51a5cdf0ca6ea002cb2296.sourceText: 川影一直致力于成为一所与众不同的一流艺术学院，这不仅体现在学院独特的教学模式、浓厚的艺术氛围、先进的教学设备等方面。此次与美国亚利桑那大学展开的深入交流与合作，也是学院为莘莘学子不断搭建新的学习平台，为学生的成长成才和未来发展而不断创造机会的又一次探索实践。如今川影学子已遍布海内外，践行着学院对”教育要海纳百川、艺术在相互交流碰撞中学习”的理念。
5737f21e7df1f5240c51a5cdf0ca6ea002cb2296.translatedText: Sichuan Film Academy has always been committed to becoming a distinctive first-class art college, which is not only reflected in the college's unique teaching model, strong artistic atmosphere, advanced teaching equipment, etc. This in-depth exchange and cooperation with the University of Arizona in the United States is another exploration and practice of the college to continuously build new learning platforms for students and continuously create opportunities for students’ growth and future development. Nowadays, Sichuan Film School students are spread all over the country and abroad, practicing the college's philosophy of "education should be inclusive of all rivers, and art should be learned through mutual exchanges and collisions."

21fd16ef96318d7dd975c8d1889e49c45a48254e.sourceText: 奥巴马贝纳坦诚相见 防悬崖仍无进展 在距坠”财政悬崖”越来越近时，奥巴马总统与国会众院议长贝纳13日晚在白宫举行第二次会晤。尽管对外界宣称这是一次”坦诚的见面”，但谈判显然没有显著成效，让外界对避免”财政悬崖”缺乏进展的焦虑情绪升温。 这是奥巴马和贝纳两人9日后首度于白宫会面，但仍无法显示两党在解除增税和大幅减支危机的措施上是否取得进展。 奥巴马说，谈判步调缓慢是因为共和党国会议员内部分裂，使贝纳难以进行谈判。贝纳则看法不同，批评奥巴马坚持上调美国最富裕的2%人群税率,将就业和经济复苏置于险境。 白宫发言人卡尼(Jay Carney)重申奥巴马对上调这部分人群税率的承诺,且埋怨共和党在这个关键的议题上无动于衷。 奥巴马在接受明尼亚波里斯WCCO电视台访问时说，他希望共和党人对向富人增税改变态度，那应该并不困难，”不增税的概念已经变成有如许多共和党人的宗教，我认为贝纳的党团内部有争执，有时对他不买账，使他不愿意看起来向我让步，因为这将伤害他在自己党团中的地位。” 贝纳则指责奥巴马拖延谈判。奥巴马坚持对收入在25万元以上的家庭提高税率，以减少联邦赤字；贝纳说，他反对提高税率，愿意透过防堵税法漏洞和限制扣除额来增加税收。 共和党内部，越来越多的人则倒向奥巴马对富人增税的要求，因为若不能达成预算协议，布什时代的减税将在31日失效，明年所有的人都会增税。 北卡罗来纳州国会参议员共和党人布尔说：”我认为现在不要再辩论税率了，我们支持对中产阶级延长减税，等我们开始谈税务改革时，再辩论最高税率应该是多少。” 众院民主党领袖波洛西也说，时间宝贵，两党都必须全力以赴研拟出解决方案。她说：”我们需在未来几天达成协议，找出解决之道。”
21fd16ef96318d7dd975c8d1889e49c45a48254e.translatedText: Obama and Boehner speak candidly, and there is still no progress in preventing the cliff. As they are getting closer to falling off the "fiscal cliff", President Obama and House Speaker Boehner held their second meeting at the White House on the evening of the 13th. Although they claimed it was a "candid meeting", the negotiations obviously did not achieve significant results, which heightened the outside world's anxiety about the lack of progress in avoiding the "fiscal cliff". This was the first meeting between Obama and Boehner in the White House in nine days, but it still failed to show whether the two parties have made progress in lifting the crisis of tax increases and deep spending cuts. Obama said the slow pace of negotiations was due to internal divisions among Republican congressmen, making it difficult for Boehner to negotiate. Boehner had a different view, criticizing Obama for insisting on raising taxes on the richest 2% of Americans, putting jobs and economic recovery at risk. White House spokesman Jay Carney reiterated Obama's commitment to raising tax rates for this group of people and complained that the Republicans were indifferent on this key issue. In an interview with WCCO TV in Minneapolis, Obama said he hopes Republicans will change their attitude about raising taxes on the wealthy, and that shouldn't be difficult. "The concept of not raising taxes has become like a religion for many Republicans, and I think Boehner's caucus has had internal disputes and sometimes not buying into him, making him unwilling to appear to be conceding to me because it would hurt his standing in his own caucus." Boehner accused Obama of delaying negotiations. Obama insisted on raising tax rates for families with incomes above $250,000 to reduce the federal deficit; Boehner said he opposed raising tax rates and was willing to increase taxes by closing loopholes in the tax law and limiting deductions. Within the Republican Party, more and more people are backing Obama's request to raise taxes on the wealthy, because if a budget agreement cannot be reached, the Bush-era tax cuts will expire on the 31st, and everyone will have their taxes increased next year. "I think we should stop debating tax rates now," said Republican Senator Burr of North Carolina. "We support extending tax cuts for the middle class, and when we start talking about tax reform, we will then debate what the top tax rate should be." House Democratic leader Pelosi also said that time is precious and both parties must work hard to work out a solution. She said: "We need to reach an agreement in the next few days and find a solution." "

3952ab445f7b21fa174f2b122ccf358df6e1361a.sourceText: 九团体联合举办中秋联欢晚会 〔亚省时报〕 一年一度的中秋传统佳节即将来临。月圆人圆，海外华人以各自独特的方式来庆祝这个佳节。今年，凤凰城亚省开平同乡会、美中文化交流协会、亚省笔会、亚省作家协会、亚省时报社、亚美报社、清华校友会、川渝同乡会，凤城大酒家等团体正在筹备联合举办联欢晚会, 并表示欢迎凤鳯城小区团体加入行列 ( 需在8月8日前报名) 。 7月31日中午, 这九个团体的代表在凤城酒家举行了筹备会议，一­致表示:: 自愿献出一份力量，赞助一份经费，同心协力把这次活动办得有声有色，以一块月饼，一壶清茶的方式，团聚在一起，在溶溶的月光下，载歌载舞，畅叙嫏情, 欢度温馨的节日。 会议决定,活动­将于9月10日（周身六）晚上6:30─9:30在凤城酒家举行(2075. N Dobson Rd. )。当晚节目有: 赏月品尝月饼，精彩文艺演出，精美晚宴，幸运抽奖，最后是交谊舞会、 会上还作了分工。开平同乡会会长甄硕钦、关宗任、关兆峰及顾问胡寿栢、王玮婷等献爱心. 出钱买月饼供与会者一起品尝。荣誉会长关宗任又捐献一批银元供抽奖、关兆峰俰凤城东主何贵森提出, 要组织多些礼物, 让侨胞们都能得奖。美中文化交流协会和川渝同乡会古雅瑜、李成、陈志钢当场承担排演精彩文娱节目。同乡会爱好跳舞人士, 携手组织交谊舞会。凤城酒家老板何恭栢说，已经准备好一份适时的夏季消暑精美菜谱，供参加活动的侨胞大享口福。 这次中秋晚宴，餐费每位20元。参加筹办的各团体将给每位补贴5元，每位只交15元。有意参加者可与自己所属团体报名。尚未以归属团体的, 欢迎当场入会, 也可以个人身份，向凤城酒家报名(自行交费)，截期8月25日前。由于酒家座位局限，报名从速。 报名联系人如下： 开平同乡会 关兆峰 602-690-144余江英602-200-4984 甄硕锐602-538-9376 美中文化交流会 古雅瑜480-720-2181 李成480-775-3625 亚省笔会 佳叔 602-614-5558 作家协会 许庄玲 480-730-9989 亚省时报 孙涧萍 602-269-3062 亚美报 王淑英 602-538-9988 清华校友会 陶敏 480-747-5417 川渝同乡会 陈志钢 480-705-9116 凤城酒家何贵森、何恭栢 Tel 480-855-4047,Fax480-855-4045
3952ab445f7b21fa174f2b122ccf358df6e1361a.translatedText: Nine groups jointly held a Mid-Autumn Festival Gala [Alberta Times] The annual traditional Mid-Autumn festival is approaching. The moon is full and people are round, and overseas Chinese celebrate this festival in their own unique ways. This year, groups such as the Phoenix Kaiping Association of Alberta, the US-China Cultural Exchange Association, the Alberta PEN Club, the Alberta Writers Association, the Alberta Times, the Asia-American Newspaper, the Tsinghua Alumni Association, the Sichuan and Chongqing Association, and the Fengcheng Restaurant are preparing to jointly host the gala, and welcome Fengcheng community groups to join the party (registration is required before August 8). At noon on July 31st, representatives of these nine groups held a preparatory meeting at Fengcheng Restaurant, and unanimously expressed: They will voluntarily contribute their efforts, sponsor a share of funds, and work together to make this event a great event. They will gather together with a moon cake and a pot of tea, sing and dance, talk about their love, and celebrate a warm festival under the melting moonlight. The meeting decided that the event will be held at Fengcheng Restaurant (2075. N Dobson Rd.) from 6:30 to 9:30 pm on September 10 (Saturday). The program that night included: admiring the moon and tasting moon cakes, wonderful artistic performances, exquisite dinners, lucky draws, and finally a social dance. There was also a division of labor at the meeting. Kaiping Association presidents Zhen Shuoqin, Guan Zongren, Guan Zhaofeng and consultants Hu Shoubai and Wang Weiting showed their love and paid for mooncakes for the participants to taste together. Honorary President Guan Zongren also donated a batch of silver coins for the lottery. Guan Zhaofeng and Fengcheng proprietor He Guisen proposed that more gifts should be organized so that all overseas Chinese could win prizes. Gu Yayu, Li Cheng, and Chen Zhigang from the U.S.-China Cultural Exchange Association and the Sichuan-Chongqing Association were responsible for rehearsing exciting entertainment programs on the spot. People from the same hometown who love dancing work together to organize social dances. He Gongbai, owner of Fengcheng Restaurant, said that he has prepared a timely and exquisite summer recipe for the overseas Chinese participating in the event to enjoy. This Mid-Autumn Festival dinner costs 20 yuan per person. Each group participating in the organization will give each person a subsidy of 5 yuan, and each person will only pay 15 yuan. Those who are interested in participating can sign up with their own group. Those who have not yet belonged to a group are welcome to join on the spot. You can also register as an individual at Fengcheng Restaurant (pay the fee yourself). The deadline is August 25th. Due to limited seating in the restaurant, please register as soon as possible. The registration contact persons are as follows: Kaiping Association Guan Zhaofeng 602-690-144 Yu Jiangying 602-200-4984 Zhen Shuorui 602-538-9376 US-China Cultural Exchange Association Gu Yayu 480-720-2181 Li Cheng 480-775-3625 Alberta PEN Association Jia Shu 602-614-5558 Writers Association Xu Zhuangling 480-730-9989 Alberta Times Sun Jianping 602-269-3062 Asian American News Wang Shuying 602-538-9988 Tsinghua Alumni Association Tao Min 480-747-5417 Sichuan and Chongqing Association Chen Zhigang 480-705-9116 Fengcheng Restaurant He Guisen and He Gongbai Tel 480-855-4047, Fax480-855-4045

52ab8c4035b7cbc954d48ae75d49067dbb5f6db7.sourceText: 今年重大枪击案 层出不穷 （亚省时报） 康乃迪克州桑迪胡克小学14日爆发致命枪击案，是美国今年最新1起重大滥射血案。以下是近年死伤惨重的枪击事件： 1999年4月─2名全副武装的青少年闯入科罗拉多州利特敦（Littleton）可伦拜高中（Columbine High School），枪杀13名学生和教职员后自杀。 2002年10月─2名男子在华府以狙击方式枪杀至少10人，引起恐慌。 2004年11月21日─1名男子在威斯康辛州北部猎鹿时朝8人开枪，造成6死。 2005年3月12日─1名男子在威州布鲁克菲尔德（Brookfield）喜来登饭店（Sheraton Hotel）的教会活动上开火，造成7死4伤，之后自杀身亡。 2007年4月16日─1名持枪男子在维吉尼亚理工暨州立大学（Virginia Tech）杀害32人后自杀。 2007年10月7日─威州克兰登（Crandon）1名副警长在前女友的公寓开枪造成6死1伤后自杀。 2009年4月3日─1名越南移民在纽约州宾安顿（Binghamton）的移民服务中心开枪，杀害13人后自杀。 2009年11月5日─1名持枪男子在德州胡德堡（FortHood）美军基地开枪，造成13死32伤，嫌疑人为陆军少校。 2011年1月8日─时任联邦众议员的吉佛兹（Gabrielle Giffords）在图桑（Tucson）遇刺，这起枪击案造成6死13伤，吉佛兹也在伤者之列。 2012年4月2日─1名持枪男子在加州奥克兰1所基督教大学犯案，造成7死3伤。 2012年7月20日─丹佛郊区奥罗拉（Aurora）戏院在放映蝙蝠侠系列电影”黑暗骑士：黎明升起”（The Dark Knight Rises）时，1名蒙面持枪男子于戏院内滥射，造成12死58伤。 2012年8月5日─威州橡树溪市（OakCreek）的锡克教寺庙举行周日仪式时，1名持枪男子开枪杀害6人，之后被警方射杀。 2012年12月11日─1名持枪男子在俄勒冈州购物中心开火，造成2死1伤后自杀。 2012年12月14日─1名全副武装的持枪男子在康州新镇（Newtown）1所小学杀害至少20名儿童和6名成人，还有1具遗体在新镇另1处寻获。持枪男子也身亡。
52ab8c4035b7cbc954d48ae75d49067dbb5f6db7.translatedText: Major shootings have emerged one after another this year (Alberta Times) The fatal shooting at Sandy Hook Elementary School in Connecticut on the 14th was the latest major indiscriminate shooting in the United States this year. The following are the deadliest shooting incidents in recent years: April 1999 - Two armed teenagers broke into Columbine High School in Littleton, Colorado, shot 13 students and staff before committing suicide. October 2002─Two men killed at least 10 people in a sniper attack in Washington, causing panic. November 21, 2004 - A man shot eight people while hunting deer in northern Wisconsin, killing six. March 12, 2005 - A man opened fire at a church event at the Sheraton Hotel in Brookfield, Wisconsin, killing seven and injuring four before committing suicide. April 16, 2007 - A gunman killed 32 people at Virginia Tech and then committed suicide. October 7, 2007 - A Crandon, Wis., deputy sheriff shot six people in his ex-girlfriend's apartment, killing six and injuring one before committing suicide. April 3, 2009 - A Vietnamese immigrant opened fire at an immigration services center in Binghamton, New York, killing 13 people before committing suicide. November 5, 2009 - A gunman opened fire at the US military base in Fort Hood, Texas, killing 13 and injuring 32. The suspect was an Army major. January 8, 2011 - Then-Congresswoman Gabrielle Giffords was assassinated in Tucson. The shooting killed six and injured 13. Giffords was also among the injured. April 2, 2012─A gunman committed a crime at a Christian university in Oakland, California, killing seven and injuring three. July 20, 2012 - During a screening of the Batman movie "The Dark Knight Rises" at a theater in Aurora, a suburb of Denver, a masked man with a gun opened fire indiscriminately inside the theater, killing 12 and injuring 58. August 5, 2012 - During a Sunday ceremony at a Sikh temple in Oak Creek, Wisconsin, a gunman shot and killed six people before being shot dead by police. December 11, 2012─A gunman opened fire at an Oregon shopping mall, killing two and injuring one before committing suicide. December 14, 2012 - A heavily armed gunman killed at least 20 children and 6 adults at an elementary school in Newtown, Connecticut. One body was found in another part of Newtown. The man with the gun also died.

8e5411289ce0bfbac70053c24d58c121a12c4b05.sourceText: 轻轨在美莎市的工程即将在近月开工。 美莎市官员说，整个工程将花费三年，包括沿线117个土地并购。 铁路线将拆除13个临街建筑物的全部或部分。 第一期工程将移动9个沙井，为未来的轨道连接20英尺的地下管道。 根据工作需要，关闭大街一侧。 美莎官员说，他们计划在夏季开设一英里的工地，因为夏季是企业的淡季，希望给沿线企业减少干扰。
8e5411289ce0bfbac70053c24d58c121a12c4b05.translatedText: The light rail project in Mesa City will start in the next month. Mesa city officials said the entire project will take three years and include 117 land acquisitions along the route. The railway line will see all or part of 13 street frontage buildings demolished. The first phase of the project will move nine manholes to connect 20-foot underground pipes for future tracks. The Main Street side will be closed as work requires. Mesa officials said they plan to open a one-mile site in the summer, a slow season for businesses, and hope to reduce disruption to businesses along the route.

91f167acdddfc163cd5f7dd18b58d18b88139a3f.sourceText: 金信地产新闻：瞄准理想房屋的四个小窍门 很多新的购房者都很头疼，不知道要买什么样的房子。面对数千的房屋，不知道如何是好！美国的购屋专家提出了四个缩小购屋范围的小窍门。 第一 列出对未来房屋的需求，例如需要什么类型的房子，独立屋，连体屋，还是公寓？需要几个房间，什么学区？越具体越好。 第二 最好在购屋前做好房贷的评估。这样可以针对自己的实际购买能力，买到可以承受的房屋。 第三 购房者最好在购房网站上多做些寻找。通过照片，视频等信息，对房屋有一个基本的预判，这些信息有利于帮助购房者实地看房，做一些比较。 第四 提醒购房者忽略装饰上的缺陷，把更多的重点放在一些不容易改变的因素上。例如墙的颜色，装饰品的风格都很容易改变，反而房屋的位置，尺寸，房间的结构等问题是购房者需要关注的主要问题。 更多的购房问题，请咨询金信地产的Tinna 电话480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
91f167acdddfc163cd5f7dd18b58d18b88139a3f.translatedText: Jinxin Real Estate News: Four Tips for Targeting the Ideal House Many new home buyers have a headache and don’t know what kind of house to buy. Faced with thousands of houses, I don’t know what to do! America’s home-buying experts offer four tips for narrowing down your home-buying options. First, list the needs for future housing. For example, what type of house is needed, a detached house, a townhouse, or an apartment? How many rooms are needed and in what school district? The more specific the better. Second, it is best to do a home loan evaluation before buying a house. In this way, you can buy a house that you can afford based on your actual purchasing ability. Third, it is best for home buyers to do more searching on home buying websites. Through photos, videos and other information, we can have a basic prediction of the house. This information will help buyers see the house on the spot and make some comparisons. Fourth, remind buyers to ignore decorative defects and focus more on factors that are not easy to change. For example, the color of the walls and the style of the decorations are easy to change. Instead, the location, size, and structure of the room are the main issues that home buyers need to pay attention to. For more questions about home purchasing, please contact Tinna from Goldtrust Realty. Tel: 480-287-0180 E-mail: goldtrustrealty2010@gmail.com
